“Mom, I don’t need it.”
Jack Clark shook his head slightly and pushed the card back: “A classmate told me about the Qi Blood resources today too, but I don’t need them.”
“You don’t?” Doris Raven was puzzled.
Jack Clark nodded: “There are only two situations where one needs Qi Blood resources. One is when they lack talent and need the resources to make up for their foundations.”
“The other is when they have great talent, and the replenishing of Qi Blood is to speed up the cultivation process to establish the foundation ahead of others, striving to always be a step ahead.”
“My situation is that I have some cultivation talent but not a genius, so I can just follow the normal cultivation procedure without the need to compete with others.”
“Jack, are you sure you don’t need Qi Blood resources?”
“Don’t worry about the money. If you think it’s not enough, I can borrow some from Sister Vernon.” Doris Raven was hesitant, as she knew her son’s physique had always been poor.
Jack was slightly moved and yet helpless: “Mom, I really don’t need it.”
In the end, after Jack’s persuasion, Doris Raven reluctantly believed that he indeed didn’t need to replenish his Qi Blood and left with a trace of doubt.
Jack didn’t lie to her; he really didn’t need it.
Even if he used all 90,000 yuan, it would only accelerate his Foundation Establishment by half a month. After all, once the Body Casting Skill was completed, he would still need to meditate on the Lotus Stand.
Moreover, cultivating True Martial Arts was only the beginning after building the foundation.
As a result, it wasn’t worth it to ‘spend the family fortune’ to rush for this little time.

chapters.title: Chapter 10
chapters.content:
10 Chapter 10 Gene Fusion
Translator: 549690339
The next day, Jack Clark had just entered the classroom and sat down when Justin Welan in front of him came over.
“Jack, did you know? Jane Aiken, who is ranked first, completed her Foundation Establishment yesterday afternoon and has already gone to Building C today to take up True Martial arts.”
“That was fast.” Jack was a little surprised.
Establishing a foundation in just two days, even if they’re from a wealthy family with abundant resources, requires immense talent. This can be observed from their class leader Crystal Leinster.
Justin Welan nodded somewhat enviously: “Not just her, I heard that the top ten in this list will all be completing their Foundation Establishment in the next few days.”
“Including our class leader. It is said that she has visualized up to the tenth petal, her Qi Blood circulation is eight times in half an hour, and she is expected to establish her foundation day after tomorrow at the latest.”
Jack then curiously asked, “What about you, Mr. Willard? What is your cultivation progress?”
“Me? I am doing quite alright.”
Justin Welan gave a laugh and then complained, “Jack, can you stop calling me Mr. Willard? I am such a good-looking guy, you could call me Justin.”
Jack nodded, “No problem, Mr. Willard.”
“Justin, it’s Justin!”
“I got it, Mr. Willard.”
“…Jack, I’m going to stop talking to you for three hours!” Seeing his obstinance, Justin Welan angrily turned around and started chatting with the little beauty at the front desk.
At this, Jack could only smile.
He merely seems mature and is not aged, so why should he make a fuss about being called Mr. Willard. Is he going to take a knife and slash himself?
Probably because some people have already completed their Foundation Establishment, Jack noticed that everyone was very focused and serious in today’s Cultivation class.
However, it was a pity that talent did indeed exist.
Some people had been practicing for three days but were still making no progress, some were progressing well, and others were making astonishing progress.
For example, our Martial Art Committee Member Matt Watkins.
Jack didn’t know the progress of his visualization, but Matt Watkins was able to transport Qi Blood seven times in half an hour, and it seemed that he did it with ease, without using his full strength.
We don’t even need to mention Class Leader Crystal Leinster. She managed to transport Qi Blood eight times in less than half an hour, then found a place to sit cross-legged and continued meditating.
Their spirit power was incredibly abundant, which was very different from Jack, who needed to recover for half a day after every meditation session.
Obviously, they must have also used some kind of resources that could replenish or activate their spirit power.
After a thoughtful moment, Jack managed to transport Qi Blood twice today and didn’t continue his cultivation. This took him 20 minutes each time, with proficiency improving by +2, and his physique attribute increasing by +0.1.
The progress in cultivation was average, but the improvement was steady.
As the school bell rang, Jack, who hadn’t sweated much but felt a bit tired, packed his things and prepared to leave.
“Jack, wait a sec.”, Justin Welan came jogging over.
“What’s up?”
Justin came panting, hehehe, “It’s only four o’clock now, what’s the rush to go back? Why don’t you join the Flower Tea Club with me?”
Jack looked at him strangely, “You still have time to join a club? Our class leader is about to establish her foundation.”
Although Jack had never asked about Justin’s family background, he felt that Justin’s family was probably quite well-off, at least not lacking money. Justin also has good talent, isn’t this the time to work hard to establish his foundation early?
Justin didn’t seem to care, “No rush, no rush, my brother said, the path to cultivation lies in finding the right balance and not being too obsessed with short-term gains.”
“It’s normal for the class leader to establish her foundation a few days earlier because she has better talent. There’s no point in comparing with her, and…” When he got to this point, Justin suddenly stopped talking.
He even looked back, as if he was afraid that Crystal Leinster would suddenly appear again, which made Jack want to laugh a little.
In the face of Jack’s strange gaze, Justin changed the subject, “Jack, don’t you think cultivation is too dull? It’s more pleasant to look at beauties, it helps to relax your spirit.”
“Let me tell you, after my observation over the past few days, the beauties in the Flower Tea Club are ranked number one in martial high school, there are many high-quality beauties in it.”
“Not to mention the senior sisters from sophomore and senior years, there are also many juniors who are beautiful young girls like us.”
“Just imagine, on a hot summer day, sitting with a group of youthful beauties drinking tea, chatting… doesn’t it feel very comfortable and cool?”
Justin seemed to have already imagined himself surrounded by a group of beauties. His face was intoxicated, so he didn’t see the increasingly strange look in Jack’s eyes.
“So, Jack, what do you think?”
Ahem!
Jack coughed lightly, “Your suggestion is good but I have to return early to attend to something, you should go by yourself.”
“Oh, by the way, look back.”
Upon saying this, Jack patted Justin Welan’s shoulder and gave a nod to the girl standing behind him with her arms crossed, then turned around and left.
Behind me!
Justin was shocked and quickly turned around, just to see Crystal Leinster glance at him flatly, drop the word “Disgusting”, and just walk past him.
Justin was a bit stunned. He didn’t say anything bad about Crystal Leinster this time. How come he became disgusting?
…
The next morning, Glenn Clark, standing upstairs, shouted, “Bro, I’m going out to play with my friends and won’t be home for lunch.”
A voice came from upstairs, “Go ahead.”
Today is Saturday, there’s no need to go to school, but Doris Raven has to work overtime and isn’t at home.
In the room, the Six-legged Salamander, which was already twenty-eight centimeters long, was lying on the desk.
The Salamander had a wide and flat head. Its tender white body looked quite delicate. It had a tail like a small tadpole, and overall it was rather adorable.
Its Avatar Evolution value had accrued to 9 points, and its body size was approaching the species limit.
The Salamander was seen eating fish meat piece by piece. The fine teeth in its mouth were chewing, making a chewing sound.
While eating and digesting, with the Salamander’s stomach as the center, a faint flow of heat spread throughout its body, beginning a new round of growth.
With the visible disappearance of the fish meat on the desk while it was eating, two plates of food, which were more than twice the volume of the Salamander itself, were gone within half an hour. After two rounds of growth during this time, the Salamander had grown to a length of thirty centimeters.
At this time, a line of text appeared in front of Jack.
“Your Salamander Avatar has gained one Evolution point through a large amount of food.”
“Your Avatar has reached the growth limit of the species, and it can no longer grow by continuing to eat. The current accumulation of Evolution points has reached 10 points, which meets the Evolution requirements.”
“Would you like to start Evolution?”
“Remark, the potential of this Avatar is quite low; after evolution, it won’t significantly enhance the host’s combat power. You can choose to absorb a gene from another species to improve its potential during the evolution.”
Seeing that last line of remark, Jack sat up abruptly, his face even showing a touch of joy: “Absorb other species’ genes to enhance potential!”
Jack had always been worried about the problem of the Salamander Avatar being too weak.
Although it can break through the species limit by evolving, but what’s the point even if it grows to one meter or ten meters long? It’s still flesh and blood, can it withstand a bullet?
Forget about combat power, those weak limbs would probably find it hard to run quickly with the weight of that huge body then.
But now…action

chapters.title: Chapter 11
chapters.content:
11 Chapter 11 Evolution
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark hesitated slightly, then asked softly, “How do I operate this genetic absorption, and are there any restrictions?”
After a few days of research, Jack found that the attribute page didn’t have any intelligence. It would only send a reminder when certain conditions were met.
When it came to the prompt being triggered, it would also respond to his questions.
Sure enough, a row of transparent text slowly appeared.
“To start the Evolution, the Salamander Avatar must completely devour the creature whose genes are to be fused, absorbing its strongest genes to optimize itself.”
“Note, each time you start Evolution, only one type of gene can be fused.”
“Only one type of gene can be fused each time, but even so, this is good enough.” Jack licked his lips and suppressed the excitement in his heart.
At this moment in his mind, countless thoughts emerged, thinking about which creature’s genes he should fuse into the Salamander Avatar.
With each Evolution able to fuse one type of creature’s genes, Jack was confident that after a few more Evolutions, the Salamander Avatar would become extremely powerful.action
First, he ruled out elephants, lions, and tigers.
Not to mention whether he could get these animals, but even if he did, he wouldn’t be able to eat them in a short time. Besides, these animals actually have average genetic potential.
Although elephants are the largest animals on land, their power, speed, and agility are not outstanding, including lions and tigers.
As for the most extreme creatures on Earth, they are naturally insects.
Ordinary ants can lift objects weighing dozens of times their own body weight, something that mammals cannot do because of their small size and extreme structure.
And then there are fleas, which can instantly jump more than 200 times their body length, equivalent to a person 1.7 meters tall jumping to a height of more than 200 meters.
So, after thinking it over for a moment, Jack locked his target on insects.
However, he didn’t know much about insects, but that wasn’t a problem.
Jack opened his computer, entered “What is the strongest insect in the insect world” in the search page, and dozens of hot words appeared below.
The Six-legged Salamander was too weak, and its limbs could hardly support its own crawling, so Jack’s first choice was to strengthen its power.
……
At nine in the morning, Jack took a taxi to the largest flower, bird, fish, and insect market in the city.
Here, all kinds of pets, whether flying, crawling, or swimming, can be found.
For example, his Six-legged Salamander pet was purchased here.
On the street, Jack walked directly into a store called Exotic Birds and Insects, and asked the young man sitting and drinking tea by the side of the coffee table, “Boss, do you have any Unicorn Beetles here?”
“Unicorn Beetle, yes.” The young boss nodded.
Compared to the ant, which can lift dozens of times its body weight, the Unicorn Beetle has the title of the strongest insect, with a record of lifting up to 850 times its own weight.
This power burst far exceeds any other creature or insect.
The young boss led Jack inside, pointed to a few boxes on the shelf and introduced, “I have three types of Unicorn Beetles.”
“They’re the common Double-fork Rhino Beetle, the rare Tras South Sea Beetle, and the even rarer Hairy Elephant Beetle. Which one do you want?”
Of the three types of Unicorn Beetles, each is of a different size. The largest, the Hairy Elephant Beetle, is about half the size of Jack’s palm and about ten centimeters long. The South Sea Beetle is similar in size.
With a glance, Jack chose the smallest one: “Boss, I want a Double-fork Rhino Beetle.”
“Alright, fifty dollars apiece. Do you need to buy some feed?”
“No need.”
After paying with scan code payment, Jack left the Flower, Bird, Fish, and Insect Market with a small box containing the Unicorn Beetle and took a taxi back. He was rather eager.
In the upstairs room, the Six-legged Salamander lying on the table looked at Jack as the box with the Unicorn Beetle was placed nearby.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack opened the box and grabbed the Unicorn Beetle.
Compared to the Hairy Elephant Beetle, which was about half a palm size and more than 10 centimeters long, the Double-fork Rhino Beetle was only about 5 centimeters long, not too exaggerated.
At this moment, as if sensing its fate, Jack felt a strong force straining in his hand, the Unicorn Beetle struggling.
Unfortunately, facing the fingers that held both sides of its body, it was useless no matter how strong it was, directly being held by Jack by the head and body and snapped in half.
With a click, the Unicorn Beetle was killed and its head and body separated.
Then, it was slowly eaten by the Salamander.
At the same time, Jack called out the attribute page, moving his thoughts and clicking on the “Start Evolution” option at the bottom.
Boom!
With the confirmation, Jack felt a long-held fiery power burst in the Salamander Avatar, sweeping through its entire body like a torrent.
Under this Evolution Energy, the Salamander Avatar’s bones, muscles, and even deeper genes were changing, and its cells were undergoing furious division and compression.
Meanwhile, as the Salamander Avatar began its Evolution, a flow of heat emerged in Jack’s body, strengthening his muscles, bones, and cells.
This change took him by surprise.
However, compared to the torrent-like Evolution Energy in the Salamander Avatar’s body, the amount that appeared in his body was much smaller, only making him look somewhat stronger.
The Evolution took almost half an hour.
By the time it was finished, the appearance of the Salamander Avatar on the table had changed significantly.
It was still 30 centimeters long, but its body had become much more slender and harmonious. Its previously ribbed abdomen was now covered in solid muscle.
The wide, flat skull had become slightly rounder, and the three pairs of feathered horns on both sides had become serrated, emitting a hard, keratinous color, unlike the previous fleshiness.
The dorsal fin on its back had spread from the rear half of the body to the neck area and had become a white, keratinous, serrated shape, extending to the tail and becoming wide and flat once again.
The biggest change, however, was in its slender limbs, which had now become twice as thick, strong, and powerful, especially in the muscular hind legs, full of explosive power.
Even the tips of its claws had turned black, growing sharp, keratinous edges, exuding an aura of sharpness.
These were just the external changes.
In Jack’s perception, the Salamander Avatar’s bones had all become even sturdier, and its muscles, like strands of steel wire, were filled with explosive power.
These changes were brought about by the absorption of the Unicorn Beetle’s genes.
The strength of the Unicorn Beetle lies in its powerful muscle fibers and sturdy exoskeleton, which allow it to exert and bear up to 850 times its own weight.
One could say that the Salamander Avatar had Evolved into another species, only retaining some resemblance to the Six-legged Salamander on the outside.
After sensing the changes in his Avatar, Jack then called out the attribute page with a thought.
Physique: 10.5
Strength: 10
Agility: 9
Spirit: 13.5
Talent: Soul Split
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Skill [Progress 21/100] Body Casting Skill [11/100]
Avatar Body: Hexagonal Power Lycophyte
Level: Low-level Transcendent [An ordinary creature that has Evolved once and barely touched the Boundary of Transcendent; adult body length limit 70 centimeters, average combat power]
Talent: Strength [Powerful muscle fibers and bones, with the potential to exert a hundred times its own strength, Note: The current body strength can only exert ten times the power]
Evolution Value: 0/50

chapters.title: Chapter 12
chapters.content:
12 Chapter 12: Hundredfold Strength
Translator: 549690339
This time, after the Avatar Evolution, Jack Clark’s main body also received feedback, and all four major attributes received a 3-point increase, reaching the level of an ordinary person.
The Spiritual Attribute even surpassed that of a normal person.
This change was an unexpected delight.
But the change in the Salamander Avatar was even more exaggerated, evolving directly from a weak organism to a low-level Extraordinary Creature, gaining a talent called Divine Strength.
Although the note indicated that the current Avatar could only burst ten times its strength, its potential reached a hundred times, as long as the body’s strength kept up.
Now, this talent may not seem that powerful, and at this size, a hundredfold burst is nothing special. But what if the Avatar evolves to be tens of meters, or even hundreds of meters long?action
At that time, a hundredfold burst of its own power would be enough to shake the heavens and the earth.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack Clark weighed the Avatar again.
Before evolution, the 30-centimeter salamander weighed only seven ounces, but after evolution, it weighed more than three pounds at the same size, with a density increase of about five times.
After weighing, further tests were conducted.
For example, crawling, the strong limbs allowed the Avatar to crawl quickly on the ground, much more agile than before, like a small lizard.
At the same time, the claws of the limbs could tear paper, like a sharp little knife.
As the bones were strengthened, even the teeth became sharper, and the bite force was stronger, capable of easily crushing fish skulls.
Jack Clark was very satisfied with the results of this Evolution. His Avatar had finally gone from weak to a ferocious carnivorous beast, even if it was only the size of a puppy now.
Then, Jack Clark used his consciousness to control the Avatar to crawl around the room and adapt to the changes after the Evolution. He only stopped when he felt that it was about enough.
“Now it’s time for today’s cultivation.” Jack Clark opened his eyes.
He wondered what changes there would be in his cultivation now that his physical constitution as a whole had improved.
With anticipation, Jack Clark sat cross-legged on the bed, closed his eyes, and focused his mind, entering the meditative state.
In the dark space of consciousness, a lotus made of dashed lines slowly rotated. Three petals of the lotus were clearly visible, representing Jack Clark’s three-petal progress.
At this moment, the stronger Spirit Power covered the lotus.
Under this meditative Spirit Power, a transparent petal slowly became clear from the bottom up, solidifying, and even the texture on it could be seen clearly.
“Sigh! One petal.”
Jacks Clark exhaled and a smile appeared on his face.
This time the cultivation progress was +9, Spiritual Attribute +0.2, which was twice as fast as before, and the sense of mental fatigue after cultivation was not as strong as before.
But soon, Jack Clark’s eyes showed a thoughtful look as he thought of the person who ranked first in the freshman ranking.
He could now condense a petal of a lotus at a time, and if he cultivated twice a day, it would take him six days to complete the Lotus Platform Meditation Method under normal conditions, and his Mental talent would become upper-level.
But that female student named Jane Aiken completed Foundation Establishment in two days. Even if she used resources to nourish her Spirit Power, her basic Spiritual Attribute should be at least 20 points or more.
Moreover, her physical constitution should also be at least 20 points. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have been able to complete the foundation in two days, even if she had resources to replenish Qi Blood.
And there were geniuses like Crystal Leinster who ranked in the top 100, who were expected to complete their Foundation Establishment in four or five days.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark slowly exhaled, suppressing the faint sense of superiority brought by the attribute page, and not underestimating others.
After a short break, Jack Clark continued to practice the Body Casting Skill.
Then he discovered that the cultivation speed had indeed improved, and the flow of Qi Blood in his body had become much richer, and the effect of body refining was better and more sustainable.
It took just forty minutes for Jack Clark to transport Qi Blood for three turns in a row, each turn taking thirteen minutes.
After the cultivation, Jack Clark revealed a satisfied expression on his tired face: “Not bad, both the speed and durability of transportation have improved by half compared to before.”
This time the cultivation progress was +3, Physique +0.1.
Like the Spiritual Attribute, the basic Cultivation Methods’ effects on strengthening the physique were becoming lower and lower. Jack Clark estimated that by the time he reached ten turns, he could increase his physique by at most 2 to 3 points.
However, even so, today’s harvest was still tremendous.
Especially the evolved Avatar, which made Jack Clark realize its potential and importance to him.
But he soon had a headache.
The feeding demand of the evolved Hexagonal Power Lycophyte was simply too large. Although it was only thirty centimeters long, the appetite had increased several times larger than before, requiring several pounds of fish meat in one meal.
“It feels like my family will go bankrupt before long…” In the afternoon, Jack Clark looked at the Avatar, which had grown a centimeter longer, and fell silent.
According to the growth rules of the Avatar, every time it consumed food equal to its size, it would experience micro-growth once. It needed to achieve two consecutive micro-growths to gain 1 point Evolution value.
In other words, the Hexagonal Avatar now had to consume three pounds of fish meat in one meal, twelve pounds in four meals a day, and that was just for now.
In the future, when it grows to sixty or seventy centimeters long or even evolves again to be one or two meters long, maybe it will have to eat one or two hundred pounds of meat a day?
Thinking of this, Jack Clark sighed, “I’ll just set it free after it evolves again.”
The Six-legged Salamander was an amphibious ‘fish’. When it evolved again, Jack Clark was planning to throw it into the river to find food by itself. Luckily, there was a small river not far from his home.
This river extended along the edge of the city, and if you went several dozen miles east, it would reach the entrance of a large river. There was abundant fish food in the river, enough to support the growth of the Avatar afterward.
The reason it wasn’t released now was that it was too dangerous outside.
As the New Era began, it wasn’t just humans who could cultivate and become stronger. Many wild animals also mutated, and many Mutated Beasts appeared.
However, unlike humans who could cultivate and become stronger, the evolution speed of those Mutated Beasts was slow. Most of them were not very strong, and none could resist mankind’s firepower.
Even so, the wilderness was no longer as safe for ordinary people as before.
It wasn’t so bad around the city, as the officials would regularly clean up the area, and upon receiving news of Mutated Beasts appearing in villages and towns, there would be official personnel handling it.
But that wasn’t the case for those untouched deep mountains and old forests where many powerful Unique Beasts were silently evolving. Ordinary people who ventured there were only seeking death.
The most dangerous place, however, was the ocean.
The ocean covered an area several times larger than land, and the deepest parts reached more than 10,000 meters, teeming with a terrifying number of species.
With such a large number, naturally, more Mutated Creatures would emerge.
Especially those whales that were originally huge, and some of the giant bizarre creatures in the deep sea. They were among the first to evolve with the opening of the New Era.
Once these creatures mutated, their power would become terrifying.
Fortunately, these creatures still preferred to live in the depths of the ocean, and the shallow waters were still under human control, allowing ships to sail and catch seafood.
However, the deep-sea areas where Mutated Giant Beasts appeared were already designated as forbidden zones.
By the same logic, shallow waters cannot raise large turtles.
At present, most of the rivers in the mainland were safe.
Although some fish had become much more ferocious, it was not uncommon to see fish of several tens or even hundreds of pounds flipping around, but there had been no incidents of them attacking and eating people.
At least not in the United Federation where he lived. Jack Clark wasn’t sure about other member countries.

chapters.title: Chapter 13
chapters.content:
13 Chapter 13: King of Martial Arts
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark’s home was in the suburbs, although still within the city limits, it was actually an old urban village.
The surrounding buildings were all low-rise two or three-story houses, with each house having its own small courtyard, and not far away was a tributary of a surging river.
The next day was Sunday, afternoon.
On a hot summer’s day, Jack sat at his computer desk, browsing the internet for posts about Mutated Beasts and the Cultivation World.
Not until he deliberately paid attention to these news did he realize that in recent years, all the allied countries had been stepping up their efforts to suppress the emergence of Mutated Beasts within their borders.
Especially the Yama Rainforest, where there were so many Mutated Beasts that it was out of control. Someone even took a picture of a hundred-meter-long giant python in the river.
This level of Mutated Beast had already reached the range of Giant Beasts.
Apart from that, there were upheavals in many parts of an allied country.
Leading them were some cultivators who were not willing to let ordinary people hold power. They claimed to establish a country for cultivators so that everyone could practice cultivation.
Some people analyzed that there were shadows of Evil God Sect Cultists behind these upheavals.
Many people were paying attention to this international event, and there were on-site videos posted by local people.
In the video, many strong cultivators were charging at the positions of machine-gun nests, completely ignoring the dense gunfire. Their terrifying speed allowed them to cover hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye.
Their every move burst with terrifying power, casually crashing walls and flipping armored vehicles. In the blink of an eye, the positions were destroyed.
Facing these strong men, the ordinary soldiers were as weak as lambs awaiting slaughter.
Only occasional explosions, launched grenades, and even anti-tank rockets could slightly hinder them.action
In the video, it only took more than ten minutes for the city’s administrative center to be breached, filled with burning fire, screams, and sporadic gunfire.
After watching all this, Jack felt somewhat relieved that he hadn’t traveled to these chaotic allied countries.
At this moment, Glenn Clark’s voice came from downstairs: “Brother, are you eating watermelon?”
Jack shouted to the door: “Cut it and I’ll eat it.”
“I knew you’d say that.” Downstairs, Glenn took a watermelon out of the freezer, quickly cut it into pieces, and then brought it upstairs.
Glenn slipped into the room and put down the watermelon, curiously looking at the computer: “Brother, you’re also paying attention to the Koroya’s cultivator and official battle events, huh.”
Jack picked up a slice of watermelon, somewhat surprised: “You know about this too?”
Glenn took a proud bite of watermelon, mumbled in his mouth: “Of course, I’m going to be the King of Martial Arts. Isn’t it natural for me to pay attention to international events?”
“King of Martial Arts, I’m also the Pirate King,” Jack scoffed.
Glenn was puzzled: “Brother, what’s the Pirate King? The king of the ocean? Is he very powerful?”
Jack was speechless: “With the name Pirate, he’s definitely a thief who runs around everywhere chased by the navy. You tell me, is he powerful?”
“Well, forget about it. I want to be the strongest King of Martial Arts in the whole world.”
As he sat on the edge of the bed eating watermelon, Glenn asked, “By the way, brother, I saw a lot of frozen fish in the freezer when I opened it just now. Can we finish eating so much?”
“And frozen fish doesn’t taste good at all, it has a scattered flavor.”
“These aren’t for us to eat.”
Glenn blinked, puzzled: “If it’s not for us to eat, then who is it for?”
“There! For it.” Jack pointed with his chin at the desk where a 32-centimeter-long, stout Six-legged Salamander was lying lazily.
After his reminder, Glenn noticed the salamander lying beside the water tank and was immediately stunned: “Is this… your pet!?”
“Yes.”
“Really that pet! How did it get so big so quickly?” Glenn was a bit surprised.
He remembered that last week his brother was sick with a fever, and when he had come in to take care of him, the salamander had looked very small, just a bit bigger than a newborn– how come it had grown even larger than a puppy in just a week?
“It must have mutated.”
Jack casually said, “It’s been eating more and more these days, and its size has surged, but it’s not dangerous at all. Lil’ Glenn, look… roll over.”
As he spoke, Jack pretended to make a roll-over gesture toward the salamander avatar.
In Glenn’s eyes, the somewhat fierce-looking six-legged salamander promptly rolled over.
“Wag your tail.”
“Raise your paw…”
Next, Jack directed and acted out a few more gestures, and then controlled the avatar with his consciousness, leaving Glenn dumbfounded.
Regarding the existence of the salamander avatar, Jack didn’t plan to hide it from his family and couldn’t even if he wanted to since it had to eat so much every day.
He could hide it for a day or two, but eventually it would be exposed, so it was better just to tell them outright.
After all, pets with mutations were not uncommon, and the authorities had management measures in place, so most household pets that mutated were required to be registered at the local branch office.
Of course, the main reason was that these mutated pets were weak and recognized their masters, obeying their commands.
If the pet were aggressive and posed a significant threat to the surrounding residents, it would be forcibly taken away by the authorities.
For a pet like the salamander that was only slightly bigger than a puppy, even if it had mutated, it didn’t seem to have any aggressiveness, and it was enough to just mention it to the family, no registration was necessary.
Once it evolved next time, he would put the avatar in the river.
So, when they had dinner that night, Jack took the initiative to mention this matter to Doris, who didn’t really care, only asking him to be more careful when feeding it.
In her impression, even if the tiny pet had mutated, it was just a slightly bigger fish.
…
On Monday, Jack walked into the classroom and immediately sensed a restless atmosphere among the class.
As soon as he sat down, he learned from his classmates’ chatter that it was because Crystal and Matt, two class leaders, had successfully reached the Foundation Establishment stage after consulting with the teachers yesterday.
Yesterday had been a weekend, but some students who loved the spacious venue had come to cultivate.
Justin approached and whispered, “Jack, how are you feeling? Any sense of urgency?”
Jack glanced at him, took the textbook for that morning’s lesson from his desk drawer, and said indifferently, “Urgency is useless, just keep cultivating slowly.”
“That’s the spirit! What does it matter if others break through quickly? I’ll just go on my way.”
Justin could tell that Jack’s nonchalance wasn’t feigned, but that he genuinely didn’t care about being left behind academically by his peers.
Not like the rest of the classmates.
When they heard that the Class Leader and others had successfully reached the Foundation Establishment stage, and they themselves were still on the fourth or fifth stages of blood circulation and energy transport, they suddenly became anxious.
It was as if being anxious would be helpful, so why didn’t they work harder on cultivation every day when they went home?
“By the way.”
At that moment, Justin seemed to remember something and said, “Jack, I’ll be reaching the Foundation Establishment stage tomorrow too.”
“I won’t be able to cultivate with you in Area C after that, so remember to work hard.”
“So all this was just a build-up to tell me this.” Jack glanced at him and shook his head, too lazy to pay him any attention.
“Heh… I just wanted to surprise you, but you’re not playing along.” Justin grinned with some regrets.
He would reach the Foundation Establishment stage tomorrow, which would be just about a week in total, an excellent talent indeed.
Looking at the somewhat lewd-looking Justin, Jack was a little surprised that this guy, who seemed so sly and wily, was actually a genius.

chapters.title: Chapter 14
chapters.content:
14 Chapter 14 Freya Louise
Translator: 549690339
The next day, as expected, Justin Welan and another male student successfully established their Foundation.
And then, within a few days, another female student in the class succeeded in establishing her Foundation, followed by two more the day after…
As a result, there were fewer and fewer people in the cultivation classroom in the afternoon, and the atmosphere became increasingly restless.
After successfully establishing their Foundation, they would go to Area C for cultivation. That area was the real Martial Sects Area, where freshmen of Senior One who had established their foundation, as well as sophomores and seniors were located.
The two sides were like people from two separate worlds.
After establishing their Foundation, Crystal Leinster and the others rarely attended the cultural classes in the morning. Occasionally they appeared, but they were always in a hurry, as if they were too busy to spare any time.
At the same time, their aura became more and more oppressive, sharp, and daunting to the classmates who were close to them.
This situation made those classmates who hadn’t established their Foundation even more impatient. Every day, their cultivation classes in the afternoon became more focused and diligent in contrast to their initial laziness.
Unfortunately, talent was something you either had or you didn’t.
In the blink of an eye, another week passed, and twelve people in the class had established their Foundation. With nearly half of them gone, the classroom seemed much emptier.
On Monday, after spending a pleasant weekend, Jack Clark entered the classroom and saw Justin Welan sitting at his desk.
Besides him, Crystal Leinster and Matt Watkins, the two class leaders, were also present.
Justin Welan grinned as he greeted Jack, “Hey, Jack, it’s been so many days, did you miss me?”
Jack was speechless, “You’re not a beauty, so what’s there to miss?”
“Besides, you just went to Zone C to cultivate True Martial, not like you were gone for good. Aren’t you back today?” Jack shook his head and ignored him.
Looking at Jack, who took out his textbook and prepared for class, Justin blinked and after a long time, couldn’t help but ask, “Jack, aren’t you curious about the difference between True Martial and Basic Cultivation Methods?”
Seeing Justin’s eager, “Ask me, ask me!” expression, Jack replied indifferently, “Why be curious? Anyway, I will be able to cultivate it after a while.”
“… Jack, you’re no fun at all.” Justin was a bit frustrated.
He had arrived early today, waiting for a long time, just to see Jack ask him to describe what True Martial was like. He hadn’t expected this outcome.
This reaction was such a contrast to the little beauty in front of him who had excitedly asked him all sorts of questions. He had waited so long for nothing.
In response, Jack just smiled, he really wasn’t in a hurry.
At four in the afternoon, accompanied by the melodious school bell, class ended.
In the cultivation classroom, Jack, who was cultivating, slowly finished his session, the boiling Qi Blood in his body gradually subsiding.
“Almost there,” feeling the abundant Qi Blood in his body and the faint fatigue after carrying out seven turns, Jack revealed a smile on his face.
During this period, he had made great progress. His Meditation Method had been perfected five days ago, visualizing twelve petals.
He could also perform Qi Blood carry for half an hour and complete seven turns.
Unfortunately, as he became more proficient, his progress slowed down. Now, after practicing once, completing seven turns in one go only increased his results by 4 points; otherwise, he would have made a breakthrough already.
But even so, in about three more days, he should be able to complete his Foundation Establishment.
His timing was just right, establishing his Foundation within fifteen days, which showed average talent – not great, but also not bad.
After resting for a while, Jack took a bath, put on his dried clothes after washing them once, and came out.
At that moment, a female student also came out from the girls’ changing room. Seeing Jack, she smiled and asked, “Jack, are you going back?”
“Yes.” Jack nodded.
“Coincidentally, I also plan to go back early today. Shall we go together?”
“Sure.”
This female student was named Freya Louise, and she was a classmate Jack had gotten to know last week. The two would occasionally exchange cultivation experiences during this period.As they shared half of the way home, they slowly became more familiar with each other over time after bumping into each other a few times.
Under the scorching sun and tree shade by the roadside, Freya Louise and Jack Clark walked side by side. A gentle breeze carried the faint fragrance of shampoo as it blew past them.
“Jack, I saw you didn’t seem to struggle with the seven turns carry today. You should be close to breaking through, right?”
“Probably in a few days.”
Freya glanced at the figures running in the distant playground and whispered, “I can now carry nine turns within half an hour with my perfect meditation and Qi Blood.”
“After using the Burst bear blood essence to cultivate tonight, I should be able to establish my foundation by tomorrow.”
Jack showed a faint smile on his face, “Congratulations.”
Freya turned to look at Jack, her beautiful face encouraging, “Keep going, Jack. I’ll go ahead and wait for you by Area C.”
Jack smiled and nodded, “Yeah, let’s do our best together.”
As they were talking, the two walked out of the tree shade, and sunlight fell on Freya’s milky, creamy face, her skin faintly glowing like transparent.
Jack’s gaze paused for a moment at this sight.
During this time, Jack observed that the girls in their class were all pretty, with class leader Sherry Lesser being the most beautiful.
With her curly purple hair, exquisite face, and stunning figure, she was at the goddess level.
Then, there was Freya.
Unlike Sherry, whose beauty was delicate, Freya had a lovely and pure appearance. Her white cheeks were tender and delicate as a baby, and her features were beautiful.
Her lovely phoenix eyes were long and narrow, and each time she smiled, her eyes would slightly squint into crescents, exuding a hint of enchantment.
Standing at around one meter sixty-eight, her silky black hair was tied with a bow of white butterfly ribbon, and the white ribbons mixed with her hair gave her a fresh aura.
This strange charm, pure but somewhat enchanting, was enough to outshine the other girls in the class.
Even Jack was occasionally stirred by the inadvertent flirtatiousness she exuded, and couldn’t help but sigh that she was a natural beauty.
The two walked together for a while until they parted ways at a three-way intersection.
When Jack returned home, it was precisely five o’clock. Carrying several big and small bags, the largest two contained more than twenty pounds of frozen fish.
Over twenty pounds of fish meat would be enough to feed his Avatar for two days.
In the kitchen, Jack gutted the palm-sized Beltfish one by one, washing the organs clean and setting them aside. In no time, he’d filled the basin.
On the second floor, the forty-seven centimeters long Hexagonal Power Lycophyte lay half on the table, with its egg-sized head raised slightly and its three pairs of red teeth wide open, looking like a small lion.
Although the Avatar wasn’t very big yet, it had begun to have a predator’s intimidating presence.
Jack placed the basin of fish meat in front of the Salamander Avatar and controlled it to eat. Its mouth opened, and it tore the fish apart with a gaping bite.
In the face of its sharp teeth, the fish meat was easily torn apart and swallowed in a few bites. Its eating speed was astonishing.
Eating, digesting, growing.
Soon, the six pounds of fish meat in the basin were consumed, and the lizard’s body grew visibly thicker and longer, reaching forty-eight centimeters in length.
With a full stomach, the Avatar lay on the table to digest its food.
Jack sat on a chair, lost in thought. He was thinking about which gene to integrate into his Avatar next time.
His Avatar could evolve and integrate talents from other creatures’ genetic material, giving it infinite potential.
But having too many choices could be painful too, because there were too many talents from insects and animals that humans couldn’t comprehend, no matter how powerful they were.
For example, the Tiger Beetle’s instant two hundredfold speed increase, the mantis shrimp’s supersonic burst attack, and more…

chapters.title: Chapter 15
chapters.content:
15 Chapter 15 Breakthrough
Translator: 549690339
In the morning, on his way to school, Glenn Clark, carrying a backpack, walked ahead.
When Glenn saw a bun shop by the road, he, feeling a bit hungry, turned his head to look at Jack Clark, and was about to say something when he suddenly paused and exclaimed in surprise.
“Brother, you seem to have grown taller recently.”
Jack responded casually, “I know, it’s probably because of my Cultivation.”
The Hexagonal Power Lycophyte had evolved, augmenting his physique by 3 points. During this period, he was practicing the Body Casting Skill to enhance Qi blood and strengthen his body, raising his physique by nearly 2 points.
In such a scenario, not only did Jack’s height increased from 1.7 meters to 1.73 meters, his originally thin figure became more muscular, upright and tall.
Even his pale face had more color on it, making him more handsome and healthy.
“Does cultivation help to grow taller? What a pity, I’m only thirteen years old and can’t start cultivating yet.” Glenn sounded a bit envious, and then pointed at the bun shop.
“Bro, I’m still a bit hungry, I want to eat two buns.”
Jack looked at him strangely, “Why don’t you buy some?”
“Hehe, I’m out of money.”
Jack frowned, “Didn’t I just give you living expenses on Monday?”
“…Well, I recently have a big appetite, I’ve finished all the money.” Glenn’s eyes dodged, somewhat uncomfortable looking at Jack.
“Is it?” Jack expressed doubts.
Since meals are taken care of in the school cafeteria at noon, Jack gives Glenn living expenses every week, and besides, there’s some pocket money each day.
Although it is not much, it should be enough for his expenses.action
As for Jack himself, sorry, but he is in charge of managing household affairs; the household expenses every month lie in his hands. After school, he is responsible for buying groceries and cooking meals.
However, he had been keeping an Avatar recently, so the food at home was slightly worse.
Could it be because of that?
After thinking for a moment, Jack took out a hundred from his pocket and gave it to him, saying somewhat annoyed, “Here, take it. And next time, tell me early when you run out of money.”
The purchasing power of money in this world is similar to the Earth where Jack lived in his previous life. A bowl of noodles cost about ten bucks. Today was Wednesday. A hundred would be enough for Glenn for the next few days.
Initially, Jack planned to give him fifty, but seeing Glenn’s tall and mighty figure at just thirteen years old, he felt fifty would not be enough for his appetite.
“Thank you, brother.”
Glenn cheerfully took the money, bought two big buns, and finished them in a few bites.
When the two reached the street corner, a few girls wearing middle-school uniforms walked over from the other side and waved to Glenn after seeing him.
“Glenn, hurry up.”
“Wait for me, Brother, I’m leaving first.”
“Go.”
Glenn left with a smile.
“Glenn, is that your brother?”
“Yeah.”
“Glenn, your brother is really handsome.”
“Of course, my brother is the most handsome, and his academic performance is excellent. He was the top student in our grade and got admitted into South Sky Martial Height, and he’s now cultivating True Martial.”
“Wow, your brother is so awesome.”
Hearing the conversation coming from a distance, Jack shook his head.
……
When he arrived in the class, Jack scanned the classroom and did not find Freya Louise. It appeared she had made a breakthrough to ten turns and had gone to the teacher for foundation establishment.
The classroom, with one lesser student, felt increasingly empty. This feeling made most students more anxious, and their minds wandered during the morning’s cultural class.
Half a month ago, everyone was still a smooth-sailing freshman, chattering and joking around.
But only after ten or so days, as more people left to establish their foundation, the class of dozens of students was divided into different tiers. There was a sense that those who broke through later were worse off.
So, during the afternoon Cultivation class, everyone, even without anyone maintaining discipline, practiced with exceptional intensity.
But many times, the more effort they put in, the more desperate they become.
Because they realized they seemed to be incapable.
Accompanied by the school bell, the lights of Essence Blood Stone were turned off, and everyone in the Cultivation Classroom slowly ended their practice, with the majority looking exhausted.
“Woohoo! I can barely move to the fifth stage even till now…” A female student couldn’t bear the silent pressure and broke into tears.
Apart from her, there were also other students with faces of unwillingness and bitterness.
They had been practicing for half a month, and could only continuously reach the sixth stage in Qi blood transportation. They could only reach the fourth stage at the fastest in half an hour.
In this case, they could hardly complete half an hour to ten turns within a month. Even if they barely established their foundation later, it would also mean they didn’t have much Cultivation Talent.
Jack saw all this, but didn’t think much of it. After resting a little, he packed up and prepared to go home.
If they didn’t have Cultivation Talent, then they didn’t have it. There was no need to insist. There were other fields in this world where one could make their mark too.
Of course, regardless of the world, power is privileged. Being able to cultivate True Martial Arts and becoming strong without relying on external forces is naturally better.
Under normal conditions, Jack would be among these people. With a weak physique, even with a pretty good Mental Talent, he would not be able to cultivate martial arts.
Just the physique aspect was a limit to him.
In his faint sentimentality, Jack, with his shoulder bag, walked out of the school at a relaxed pace.
Night!
In the room, Jack practiced the Body Casting Skill, which was like a fusion of Tai Chi and ancient yoga, his form reminiscent of a dragon.
He constantly switched among the eighteen positions, moving smoothly and naturally, which was completely different from his initial clumsiness, having become almost instinctual after practicing more than two hundred times.
At the same time, the Qi blood within his body, which was several times thicker than before, was slowly fortifying his body, emitting an astonishing amount of heat, just like a furnace.
Whoosh!
All of a sudden, Jack halted and took a deep breath, a surge of burning hot air rushed out for half a meter before dissipating.
“Finally, I have reached half an hour to ten turns.” Jack had a smile on his face. At this moment, he only felt his whole body’s Qi Blood flowing smoothly, his Blood Qi steaming, and he didn’t feel the usual fatigue.
After nearly a half month of continuous hard-practice, he finally made a breakthrough, and moreover forced to break through the talent limit, even Jack was filled with a sense of accomplishment at this time.
On the desk, the fifty cm long, arm-thick Hexagonal Power Lycophyte also had a satisfied look on its face.
After a moment’s rest, Jack moved his realm of thought, calling out the attribute page.
Physique: 12
Strength: 11
Agility: 10
Spirit: 15
Talent: Soul Split
Cultivation Methods: First-grade Lotus Platform Meditation Method [progress 100/100], Body Casting Skill [100/100]
Avatar: Hexagonal Power Lycophyte…
Evolution value: 25/50
Both basic methods have each increased his physique and spiritual attributes by 2 points, and the increased physique has also improved his strength attribute by 1 point.
At this time, his overall attributes were 20 percent higher than ordinary people, and his spirit was 5 points higher than an average person.
The result was that his thinking and consciousness were much faster than before when he was pondering things recently.
At the same time, the growth of his Avatar has been steady during this period, resulting in eating much more.
But this level of consumption was still bearable.
Jack put away the attribute page, a hint of expectation on his face: “I hope I won’t be disappointed with the foundation establishment tomorrow.”
The preliminary practice before the foundation establishment was so laborious and difficult. If the changes after establishing the foundation tomorrow were too poor, it would not be worthy of his efforts during this period.

chapters.title: Chapter 16
chapters.content:
16 Chapter 16 Transcendent
Translator: 549690339
In the early morning, Jack Clark followed the crowd and walked into the school gate.
What came into view were faces full of vitality, both men and women, all seemingly full of hope for the future.
Nowadays in the Summer District, anyone who goes to high school is required to learn Body Casting Skill. Therefore, even some humanities students have full spirit and look radiant.
Such a scene occasionally gave Jack the illusion that everyone in this world was as strong as a dragon.
Past the humanities Teaching Building, Jack crossed the Building B where he had spent half a month and then arrived at the Building C behind it. The entrance was the first floor office area.
Seeing Jack entering, the woman behind the side office desk asked, “Which class are you a freshman in?”
“Class 3.”
“Class 3 is managed by teacher Lori Parma, go to the third floor and find him. You can take the elevator up from there.” After saying that, the woman also pointed out the direction for Jack.
“Thank you.” Jack politely expressed his gratitude and then took the elevator to the third floor.
This was a floor that was even more spacious than the cultivation classroom, with an area of over a thousand square meters. Apart from several load-bearing pillars with a diameter of 2 meters, there was hardly any obstruction in the middle.
Various equipment and high-tech products were arranged all along the large floor’s sides, and the space was divided into separate cultivation areas covering dozens of square meters each.
At this time, it was still early and no students were cultivating.
Not far from the entrance, Lori Parma, who had shown his face on the first day, was sitting in his office, browsing the computer.
Seeing Jack knocking and entering, Lori Parma thought for a moment and said solemnly, “Class 3, Jack Clark.”
“Yes, teacher.”
Jack was a little surprised that the teacher could call out his name, given that they had only met once when the teacher introduced himself.
Of course, Jack didn’t know that the teacher had already looked through everyone’s information at the beginning of the semester.
Lori Parma nodded satisfactorily, “Not bad, full of spirit and Qi Blood.”
“You have a decent talent for completingfoundation establishment in half a month.”
“Take this information and review it. In ten minutes, after you finish reading, I’ll take you to establish the foundation.” Lori Parma pushed a folder in front of him over to Jack.
Jack didn’t hold back and sat down opposite Lori, picking up the folder.
From the slightly worn cover of the folder, it could be seen that it had been read by many people. The contents inside were about precautions for the upcoming foundation establishment.
The so-called foundation building is the process of guiding Qi Blood into the body, which is to attract the extraordinary energy that roams the world.
In the past, this world only had various rays and magnetic field waves, so ordinary people could not transcend no matter how hard they cultivated.action
It wasn’t until fifty years ago that the New Era began, and with the appearance and disappearance of giant beasts from the cracks, countless extraordinary energies poured into the earth.
However, these energies scattered between heaven and earth were too diluted for ordinary people to perceive. Only those with innate awakenings could cultivate and become stronger.
Faced with this situation, some strong cultivators and countries joined forces, studied for many years, and created the First Generation Cultivation Method.
After several optimizations and popularizations, the Meditation Method and the Body Casting Skill were created for them to cultivate, strengthening their bodies and activating their spirits.
To further ensure successful foundation building, every first-class university has built special cultivation rooms.
Inside the cultivation room, the extraordinary energy that was dispersed was five times greater than outside, allowing beginners to feel and capture the extraordinary energy more easily, guiding it into their bodies for refinement.
In theory, the first time to establish foundation is a life-changing transformation, so the better the foundation, the longer the foundation building state will last, and the greater the gains.
In addition, the document contains many details that need to be noted to avoid any mistakes by beginners that may lead to failure in the foundation building.
Looking at the young man who had put down the information, Lori Parma said solemnly, “Have you finished reading it?”
Jack nodded, “I’ve finished reading.”
“Alright, follow me.”
Lori Parma got up and led Jack out of the office. At that moment, several elevator doors opened, and more than ten students came pouring out.
Among these people were Justin Welan, Crystal Leinster, and Matt Watkins, who had already established their foundations in class, including Freya Louise, who had just completed her foundation building the day before.
Seeing Jack, Justin showed a happy smile, “Jack, you’re finally here.”
“Not too bad, only lagging behind you guys for so many days.” Jack smiled.
Justin patted Jack on the shoulder enthusiastically, feeling very happy.
“I knew you’d be fine.”
Freya, with her long hair tied with a butterfly ribbon, walked over with a smile on her beautiful face, her charming phoenix eyes slightly narrowed.
Seeing their classmates, Crystal and Matt nodded slightly, to which Jack responded with a smile.
Just as Justin was about to say something, Lori Parma interrupted, “Alright, there’ll be plenty of time to catch up later. Don’t waste everyone’s time.”
Justin smiled at the teacher, “Right, Jack. Hurry up and build your foundation. After that, you can choose a True Martial Cultivation method.”
“Good luck!” Freya gave an encouraging look.
After nodding and saying hello, Jack followed Lori into the elevator, but instead of going up, they went all the way down to the underground negative fifth floor.
Stepping out of the elevator, there was a row of corridors with closed rooms on both sides.
Jack stood aside while Lori went to a counter that resembled a self-service vending machine in front of him, inputting data, verifying his identity, and a card was dispensed by the machine.
While Jack was waiting, several more teachers came down one after another, followed by one or two students.
“Go ahead, Room 15. Remember, the longer you can persist, the better.”
“Okay.”
Jack took the card and found Room 15. As soon as he inserted the card, the heavy metal door slowly opened.
When Jack entered, the door slowly closed again. Then the second layer of the white glass door in front of him opened a gap, and a cool breeze blew in suddenly.
This was the phenomenon of the high-concentration extraordinary energy flowing into the low-energy zone.
Jack didn’t dare to delay and quickly passed through the glass door; the door closed automatically as it sensed him entering.
This was a small room about three to four meters long and wide, covering about ten square meters. There was a faint white light on the ceiling, and apart from that, everything was very simple.
Whew!
Jack took a deep breath, stood in the middle, and without any fancy preparations, began to cultivate.
The basic requirement for foundation building was to reach ten turns in half an hour with the Body Casting Skill, which meant that one had to practice it once every three minutes. The purpose was to make the body’s Qi blood boil.
At the same time, the Meditation Method was used to make the Spirit Power more condensed and pure, allowing it to transport Qi blood faster and catch the free extraordinary energy outside more quickly.
With Jack’s cultivation, the eighteen positions of the Body Casting Skill changed continuously, with increasing speed, and Qi blood circulated faster and hotter throughout his body.
When completing ten turns continuously, his whole body was like a steamer, with Qi blood emitting high temperature, and the Spirit Power became even more sensitive due to the active Qi blood.
Immediately, he felt a seemingly non-existent energy drifting around him, which was very faint and elusive.
Now’s the time!
Jack’s expression tightened as he practiced the Body Casting Skill at an even faster speed. At the same time, his Spirit Power pulled a strand of the sensed external energy into his body.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 17
chapters.content:
17 Chapter 17: First Layer Heaven
Translator: 549690339
As the energy entered his body and touched the boiling Qi blood, it was like sparks igniting gasoline; Jack Clark felt as if his entire body was set ablaze.
Of course, it was only a metaphor, not that he was literally on fire.
As strands of extraordinary energy were absorbed into his body, Jack’s burning Qi blood became even more vigorous, and at the same time, it circulated throughout his body.
Under the influence of the extraordinary energy, the nature of his blood Qi underwent some special changes. As it circulated through his body, his muscles and bones were greatly strengthened.
This strengthening included the five viscera and six bowels, fascia, and nerves.
This feeling was somewhat similar to the previous improvement during the Avatar Evolution, which involved a comprehensive enhancement of physical fitness and a significant improvement in all aspects under the effect of extraordinary energy.
Every minute, Jack’s body became stronger and stronger.
This situation made him cultivate even harder, using his Spirit Power to frantically guide the extraordinary energy into his body.action
If the boiling Qi blood cultivated by the Body Casting Skill was the foundation for igniting the extraordinary energy,
Then the strength of the Spirit Power cultivated by Meditation determined how much extraordinary energy could be guided within one minute and how long one could persist.
Both were indispensable.
The person who could think of and create such a Foundation Cultivation Method was simply a genius.
As Jack began the Foundation Establishment, many classmates in the classroom looked at the empty seat where he usually sat.
Next to him, a short-haired female student said enviously, “I think Jack hasn’t come yet because he has already broken through and went to Teacher Parma for the Foundation Establishment.”
“I don’t think so,” another male student shook his head.
“I remember that when Jack first practiced the Body Casting Skill, it took him almost fifty minutes to complete a cycle, while most other students needed just twenty to thirty minutes.”
“His talent is among the worst in the class; how is it possible for him to establish the foundation faster than us?”
“No, I think he must have broken through.”
“Although his first Qi Blood transfer was slow, I noticed that his progress in subsequent cultivation classes improved rapidly, and he was already able to transfer eight cycles with ease yesterday.”
“I also think he has broken through.”
“I envy him. I’m only at the seventh stage now, and I can only transfer six cycles within half an hour. I don’t know when I’ll be able to break through.”
“You’re better than me. I can only transfer five cycles at a time. Any more, and I feel dizzy and exhausted.”
“You’re only at the fifth stage after half a month? You have no hope. I advise you to choose cultural studies instead.”
“Woo!! I’m only at the fourth stage, what should I do…”
…
The Foundation Establishment state persisted for a long time; Jack only slowly ended his practice when his Spirit Power was exhausted to the point that he could no longer guide external energy into his body.
Whew!
Jack took a deep breath, opened his eyes, and the exhaustion and excitement in his gaze were evident.
The exhaustion was due to the excessive mental exertion, while the excitement stemmed from the rewards gained from this period of cultivation.
With the successful Foundation Establishment, Jack could now clearly feel the boiling Qi blood in his body, making him feel full of strength and as if he could punch through a wall with one fist.
Of course, this feeling was due to the illusion created by the sudden and massive improvement in his physique.
Suppressing his excitement, Jack summoned his attribute page with a thought and immediately saw Physique 21, Strength 20, Agility 19, and Spirit 24.
All four major attributes had increased by 9 points, which was twice that of ordinary people.
Moreover, Jack vaguely felt that not only his physique had improved significantly during this Foundation Establishment, but there seemed to be some other indescribable changes in his body as well.
Lost in thought, Jack opened the door.
Seeing the handsome youth walking out, Lori Parma nodded in satisfaction: “Good, a Foundation Establishment in two hours; this result is already considered above average.””It seems like you’ve gained a lot. Let’s go and choose your own True Martial Arts.”
“Yes, Teacher.” Jack Clark followed excitedly.
Foundation Establishment success is only the beginning, the real journey into cultivation starts now.
Following Lori Parma, the two took the elevator all the way to the 33rd-floor rooftop. The place was like a large library, filled with bookshelves and paper books.
Just as Jack Clark thought that those books were the True Martial Secret Scripts, Lori Parma led him to another area similar to the internet cafe private room area.
“Each room has a computer. After you enter your Student ID and pass the face recognition, you can browse the Cultivation Methods within your permission range after your basic data is inputted.”
“Remember, the school divides new students’ initial permissions into three days, one week, two weeks, one month.”
“Since you’ve broken through Foundation Establishment within a half month, you’re eligible to learn two low-level martial arts. Once you’ve chosen your Cultivation Methods, you cannot change them, so choose carefully.”
“If you want to learn higher-level or other Cultivation Methods in the future, you need to exchange Contribution Points. There’s an explanation on the computer about what Contribution Points are.”
“By the way, those books outside are some Daoist and Buddhist scriptures, introductions to the various allied countries, and some information about Mutated Beasts and cultivators. It wouldn’t hurt to read more during your cultivation breaks.”
“Alright. I’m going to find someone to drink tea with. You go ahead.”
Having explained this to Jack Clark, Lori Parma entered an office nearby where a middle-aged man was watering flowers and plants on the balcony.
Jack Clark found an empty room and locked the door behind him. He sat down on the sofa in front of the computer and began inputting his student number.
“Beep! Student ID 2055…967… Begin facial recognition…”
Accompanied by the intelligent voice, a faint red light shot out from the webcam on the monitor and scanned Jack Clark’s face.
“Verification passed, welcome to the Heavenly Intelligence System. Now for data entry, please follow the instructions to test your data on the nearby Tester.”
“Please begin with the first test, arm strength.”
“Data testing, huh.” Jack Clark got up and came to the arm strength machine, grabbed the rings on both sides, took a deep breath, and his upper body muscles burst with power.
“Arm strength 102 kg, data uploaded, please begin fist strength test.”
Punch!
“Fist strength 210 kg, data uploaded, please begin kick strength test.”
Boom!
“Kick strength 290 kg, data testing complete.”
“Your basic data has reached the entry standard for First Level Heaven, and you are eligible to receive Contribution Points. Currently, you can receive 3 Contribution Points every month.”
“Now, please have the student choose True Martial Arts.”
With that said, a browsing option for Cultivation Methods appeared on the computer.
However, Jack Clark did not immediately choose a Cultivation Method but stood there, recalling the feeling of his power burst just now.
Arm strength of 100 kg, fist strength of 200 kg, and full-strength kicking power approaching 300 kg. If such power were to fall on an ordinary person, it would be enough to kill with a single kick.
This power is only the entrance to the True Martial Arts, a cultivation system worthy of slowly suppressing the technological civilization.
Feeling a sense of wonder, Jack Clark sat back down in front of the computer, clicked Browse, and more than fifty Cultivation Method names appeared on the monitor.
Each Cultivation Method could be viewed in detail when clicked on.
“Bright Moon Formula, primarily Defense, secondary Burst, after cultivation, the body surface becomes as hard as jade, upon grand accomplishment can withstand submachine gun and rifle bullets.”
“Light Sword Art, after cultivation, the sword light is swift and agile…”
“Explosive Bear Fighting Body, focuses on strength, secondary Defense, after cultivation, abundant Qi Blood, incredible strength, few can compare in the same grade Cultivation Methods.”
“Ghost Shadow Leg, focuses on speed, secondary Burst, after cultivation, speed is astonishingly swift, like a ghost upon grand accomplishment, and immune to infrared detection.”
“Dragon Elephant Power, focuses on strength…”

chapters.title: Chapter 18
chapters.content:
18 Chapter 18: Heavy Weapons
Translator: 549690339
Having read all the introductions to the cultivation methods, Jack Clark leaned back on the sofa, deep in thought.
He found that all the methods had only three levels, with a cultivation limit of Third Layer Heaven, which was the limitation of low-level martial arts.
Since there were low-level martial arts, there must be high-level or even top-tier martial arts that ordinary people could not learn; they would require higher permissions.
And permissions were proportional to their breakthrough Foundation Establishment time; the faster the breakthrough, the higher the initial permissions.
No wonder Crystal Leinster and others who already had good natural talents were also willing to spend a lot of resources to quickly break through the Foundation Establishment; they must have known about the permissions thing early on.
Thinking about this, Jack couldn’t help but recall the day when Justin Welan deliberately waited for him to tell him about the Qi Blood resources that could replenish Qi Blood and speed up cultivation.
At that time, Justin Welan might not have just been reminding him to pay attention to his body, but also obliquely suggesting that he spend money to buy resources to accelerate his Foundation Establishment.
Unfortunately, even if Justin Welan had explicitly told him at that time, he had no way to do anything about it.
Because he had no money, and his talent was inferior to others; his breakthrough in half a month’s time had been due to factors like his Avatar Evolution and Attribute Page Solidified Proficiency.
During this contemplative moment, Jack’s attention returned to the choice of a cultivation method.
These methods could be roughly divided into two categories: body cultivation and weapon-based ones.
Body cultivation methods were further divided into those focusing on strength, defense, speed burst, and short-distance movement techniques, leg techniques, etc., while weapon-based ones were even more diverse.
However, no matter which type of weapon, Jack found them all to be extremely exaggerated.
For example, the Sword Skill of the cultivation method for sword techniques required the chosen sword not to be shorter than 1.5 meters and not longer than 2 meters.
That’s insane; isn’t 2 meters already a giant sword?
And for the Meteor Hammer technique, the suggested data for matching objects specified that the hammerhead should weigh at least 100 kg; otherwise, the full power could not be unleashed, and the heavier the weapon, the better.
Apart from that, several other knife techniques were also no exception, with the most exaggerated being a technique called Hegemon Ten Slashes, requiring the knife to be 3 meters long and 0.5 meters wide.
How is this even a knife? It’s more like a door panel.
However, considering that the people who created these methods had targeted them for dealing with mutated beasts, Jack could somewhat understand.
After all, those mutated beasts had body sizes of several meters or even over ten meters, not to mention the huge giant beasts; if the weapon was too small, wouldn’t it just tickle them?
In the course of his reflection, Jack finally chose one main cultivation method, the Dragon Elephant Power, and one blade technique, the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, with a suggested weapon length of 2 meters.
After deciding on a cultivation method, Jack took a deep breath.
It was quite troublesome to choose because of his indecisiveness since although all these cultivation methods were low-level, each seemed excellent;
Once mastered, they could even ignore the attacks of light firearms.
Moreover, each cultivation method was designed to exploit a certain advantage of the human body to the extreme, specifically for killing.
Next, it was time to exchange for cultivation materials.
That’s right; True Martial Arts could be potent, but their cultivation could be problematic, as many physical cultivation techniques required supplementary resources to get started.
For example, to get started with Dragon Elephant Power, one needed to apply a mutated beast called Tyrant Elephant’s blood on their body during cultivation, to gain some attributes of the elephant.
Once successfully cultivated, the person’s strength would greatly increase.
When Jack finally decided on a cultivation method, a virtual helmet slowly descended above his head, and without hesitation, he put it on.
“Identity verification in progress… Verification passed.”-
“Please relax, and don’t be nervous. Initiating data transfer for Dragon Elephant Power and Mind’s Eye Bright Knife…”
A screen appeared before Jack’s eyes, and on it, a burly middle-aged man at least 2 meters tall began to practice Dragon Elephant Power.
On the man’s body, gas and blood flow routes appeared like arrows following a certain rule…action
These images, transmitted through special pupil memory light beams, could be maintained in the brain without forgetting for a month, being in a state of instant recall.
And one month was enough for new students to get started with a method….
When Jack came out, Lori had already left.
Jack took the elevator to the third floor, but he couldn’t find Lori. Instead, he saw Justin, who was practicing not far away. Justin’s eyes lit up when he saw him.
Excitedly, Justin ran over with his hands wearing spiked gloves, which looked like motorcycle helmets. He was about to pat Jack on the shoulder, but Jack quickly blocked it.
“Are you trying to kill me?”
“Haha… sorry, just a habit.”
Justin chuckled and put his hand down. Then, he curiously asked, “Jack, tell me, what are your basic stats like? For example, your punching force?”
There was no need to hide it, Jack casually said, “Arm strength 102, punching force 210, kicking force 290, just enough to reach the First Layer Heaven.”
“Arm strength of 102, and punching force only at 200 kg, it seems you haven’t learned any fighting techniques.”
Normally, people with professional training could have a punching force three times their arm strength, even four times for those who specifically trained for muscle enhancement.
Justin laughed and said, “But it’s already pretty good. With your basic stats reaching the First Layer Heaven, you’ll receive contribution reward points every month, which can help you quickly enter the world of True Martial.”
The First Layer Heaven threshold was having an arm strength of over 100 kg and doubled constitution after Foundation Establishment.
“Moreover, I remember that you initially had an average physique, not even reaching the standard of an ordinary person.”
“That’s right.” Jack nodded. His body was originally weak and appeared somewhat malnourished.
“That means your body has high compatibility with strengthening physique and increasing strength cultivation methods. The Body Casting Skill could enhance your constitution by 0.6 times.”
“Only in this way can it explain how you broke through to the First Layer Heaven all at once.”
At this point, Justin couldn’t help but show envy.
Having high compatibility with certain cultivation methods, such as strength and defense, was also a form of hidden talent. As long as you choose the right method, you can achieve twice the result with half the effort.
“I guess I’m just lucky,” Jack said modestly.
He knew Justin misunderstood, but it worked out for the best.
When his avatar evolved again, his physique would definitely improve greatly. This reason could be used to cover up the sudden explosion of his strength in the future.
“By the way, Justin, what were your stats when you reached Foundation Establishment?” Jack asked, wanting to know the stats of these ‘geniuses’ who had reached Foundation Establishment within a week.
“Me? I did alright.”
Justin grinned smugly, “My arm strength was 140, punching force 340, and kicking force was 420. How about that, am I not impressive?”
“You should know that Crystal Leinster’s arm strength was just 130 when she completed Foundation Establishment, so I’m even stronger.”
Jack nodded, “Indeed, that’s impressive.”
Using an average untrained person’s arm strength of 50 kg, Justin had a physique of at least 28 when he completed Foundation Establishment, 6 points higher than him.
Body Casting Skill’s enhancement might have only given him an increase of two or three points, or else he wouldn’t have been envious of Jack’s 0.6 times enhancement.
Plus, considering an estimated 10-point improvement during Foundation Establishment, he must have had a base physique of 16 points before practicing, well beyond ordinary people.
With additional resources to replenish Qi Blood, it was no wonder their cultivation speed was so fast.
“Jack, don’t listen to him bragging.”
At this moment, Freya approached and said, “Justin, don’t forget that the average arm strength of women is only 40 kg.”
“Even if Class Leader had practiced some physiques before, having an arm strength of 130 kg after Foundation Establishment indicates that her base physique is three times stronger than an ordinary person, even higher enhancement than you.”
“Really? Did I remember it wrong, aren’t men and women’s base strength the same?”
With his bluff called out, Justin looked confused.

chapters.title: Chapter 19
chapters.content:
19 Chapter 19: Sticking Together
Translator: 549690339
Ignoring the feigned ignorance from Justin Welan, Freya Louise looked towards Jack Clark, suggesting, “It’s almost noon, shall we go eat together?”
“The canteen in the Martial Sects Area is different from the one in the humanities section. There’s Unique Beast meat every day.”
Upon hearing this, Jack became curious: “Unique Beast meat, what’s the difference in taste compared to ordinary meat?”
“There’s not much difference in taste, it’s just chewier and more nutritious since the meat in the canteen is from ordinary farmed Unique Beasts.”
As she spoke, Freya Louise brushed her hair behind her ears.
At this moment, the office door opened in the distance, and Lori Parma glanced at the three of them: “It’s still a bit early for lunch, Jack, come over and sign some agreements.”
“…Alright, teacher.” Not knowing what to sign, Jack hesitated, greeted Freya and Justin, and followed Lori into the office.
“This is the ‘Law Prohibiting Cultivators from Using violence against Ordinary People’ and this is the ‘Non-Disclosure Agreement for Cultivation Methods’.”
“Also, this is the ‘School Weapon Management Contract’ and the ‘Cultivator Daily Notice Instructions’ and ‘Guidelines for Taking Action in Unjust Situations’…”
As she spoke, Lori Parma took out a stack of documents from the drawer and gave them to Jack.
