“I know what you’re thinking, but I advise you not to think about it. Do you think the agreement you signed earlier was for what?” Justin rolled his eyes.
“Moreover, we freshmen can only learn the first three levels of high-level martial arts. The subsequent martial arts require the exchange of Contribution Points.”
“In addition, each high-level martial arts has its own distinguishing features and is easily distinguishable, so no one would dare to divulge it privately. It’s very easy to be found out.”
“Once caught, the consequences are severe, so no one would take the risk for that little bit of money.”action
“Moreover, tuition *fees of 100,000 for one level are legitimate learning fees, but they are not so valuable secretly. Both the buyer and the seller take great risks.”
“As a result, wealthy people don’t need to buy it. They can obtain it through other legitimate channels. Those with no money can’t afford it”
Speaking of which, Justin shrugged: “And high-level martial arts are not as important as you might think. The real core of the Three Great Alliance Nations is resource monopoly, top-tier martial arts, and secret books.”
Although the whole world has joined the United Federation, in fact, due to autonomy, it is more like a human camp alliance, rather loose inside.
Among them, the strongest three countries are the main ones, followed by more than ten medium-sized countries and dozens of small ones.
“Secret books.” Jack revealed a puzzled look in his eyes.
Justin shook his head: “Don’t ask me, I don’t know what secret books are. I only heard my brother mention it once.”
At this time, Justin suddenly said, “Jack, I heard that Sawyer Levin suffered a loss at your hands the other day. What do you think? Do you want to experience the power of high-level martial arts?”
“Practice with you?”
“Hehe, how about it? Are you scared?”
After lunch, Jack took a short rest and then found a classroom with Justin to practice. However, before they started, several onlookers arrived.
Seeing Jack’s questioning gaze, Freya Louise smiled faintly, “Justin told us about it, asked us to cheer you on, just afraid he’ll make you cry later.””Jack Clark was speechless. Did he look that vulnerable?
Moreover, it hadn’t started yet. Who would win or lose was still unknown.
“Hehe, I’m just being cautious.” Justin Welan across laughed.
The short-haired female student named Vera Lee clenched her fists and shouted to Jack Clark, “Go for it, Jack! Give Justin Welan a swollen head.”
Crystal Leinster stood nearby with her arms crossed, alongside Sawyer Levin, who had practiced with Jack Clark a few days ago. They both seemed quite interested in the upcoming battle.
“Students, learn from each other and go easy. Let’s get started.”
Theclass leader spoke up, and the two stood five meters apart, their expressions suddenly serious. Their bodies slightly lowered, and a powerful aura enveloped them.
Justin Welan said solemnly, “Jack, the cultivation method I practice is called Mysterious Martial Thick Earth True Decision, known for its defense and strength. The strength I cultivate carries a rebound power, be careful.”
Jack Clark took a deep breath and said in the same solemn tone, “Come on.”
Justin Welan stepped hard on the ground, like a giant turtle turning over, shaking the ground slightly. Emitting a heavy aura, he charged towards Jack at a much slower speed than Sawyer Levin.
But his aura was even more majestic and domineering. When he reached Jack, he pushed forward with both palms.
Jack activated his Dragon Elephant Power, and in an instant, his whole body’s muscles swelled, exuding a fierce aura. He countered with both palms without showing weakness.
Bang bang!
Their four palms collided, and the compressed air exploded with a muffled sound.
Soon, Jack’s face changed slightly as a thick rebound force came from the other side, causing him to involuntarily take half a step back. He became even more excited and shouted.
“Again!”
Roar! Accompanied by a faint roar of an elephant, Jack’s muscles swelled even more. His bones crackled, and a more ferocious power burst forth.
Bang bang!!
The two exchanged punches and palm strikes again, producing muffled explosions. Powerful forces scattered throughout their bodies, causing the ground beneath them to shake slightly.
“Continue,” Justin Welan also got excited, his aura became heavier and thicker, like a spiky-armored Mysterious Martial tortoise relentlessly attacking.
Jack, on the other hand, was like a ferocious giant elephant. The two were like two newborn giant beasts wrestling, making the cultivation room full of muffled sounds of heavy object collisions.
Under their tremendous power, their movements created raging winds with awe-inspiring momentum.
But Jack was soon at a disadvantage.
Because his overall strength was indeed weaker than Justin Welan’s, this gap came from various aspects.
Dragon Elephant Power mainly cultivated strength. When Jack broke through the first layer, his enhancement was about one-fold, and there was a certain increase in defense.
As for Justin’s Mysterious Martial Thick Earth True Decision, Jack felt it enhanced Welan’s strength by about 1.5 times, and the high-level skill made the resulting power more cohesive and substantial.
In addition, its defense was not weaker, besides the strange rebound force that always reflected a portion of Jack’s strength back, making him very uncomfortable.
Moreover, Jack’s foundational strength was also weaker than Justin Welan’s, so he was under pressure in various aspects.
However, as the two continued to fight, Jack’s proficiency in using Dragon Elephant Power increased, and many previously unclear techniques became more fluid.
Combined with the more sensitive perception after cultivating the Inner Eye, he often managed to block Justin Welan’s attacks and counterattack at critical moments, making him flustered and barely maintaining an undefeated record.
At this time, Freya Louise and the others were also watching very seriously.
They thought about how they would defend against such attacks and how to counterattack, summarizing their experiences.
Without using weapons, the gap between First Layer Heaven freshmans was not big. It was just that because of the characteristics of their cultivation methods, some people had greater strength and some had faster speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 29
chapters.content:
29 Chapter 29: Cultist
Translator: 549690339
Bang!
Jack Clark and Justin Welan unleashed a full-force strike, their fists and palms colliding with a muffled explosive sound. Both were sent staggering back several steps by the powerful counterforce.
“Stop, no more fighting.”
A heavily sweating Justin Welan gasped for air and waved his hand to signal a halt to the fight.
Seeing this, Jack also stopped and took a long breath.
At this moment, both of their bodies were soaked with sweat, their skin flushed red, and they radiated intense heat, a sign of Qi Blood seething within them.
After steadying their inner breath, Justin complained, “Jack, we were just having a friendly spar, you really didn’t need to go all out.”
At first, both were restrained and held back their full strength in their exchanges. However, as the battle intensified and their blood boiled, Jack’s strikes became heavier.
Faced with this situation, Justin naturally didn’t hold back, and the two of them exchanged increasingly fierce blows.
Jack touched his slightly swollen left cheek and smiled, “Well, isn’t this just a fair competition? I got carried away. Besides, I got hit by over ten more punches than you did, so I’m actually at a disadvantage.”
“You really think we can count it like that? Look at my face.” Justin pointed at his swollen eyes, defiant.
Although Jack had been hit by more punches, they mostly landed on his back or shoulder; with only one on his face, he was much better off than Justin.
At this point, not only Justin but also Freya Louise and the others on the sidelines did not expect the fight to be so brutal.
Freya came up to Jack and looked at his cheek with curiosity, “Jack, does it hurt?”
“What do you think? You want to try?” Jack’s gaze fell upon her pure and pretty face, feeling slightly tempted.
Such a beautiful face – one punch would probably make her cry for a long time.
Freya quickly shook her head, “No.”
“Hey, Justin, your arm is swollen.” Vera Lee poked Justin’s left arm with her finger, causing him to grimace in pain and quickly dodge.
“Don’t touch, it hurts!”
Crystal Leinster came over with a small bottle in her hand, “I have a bottle of Special Ointment here that can quickly reduce swelling and improve blood circulation. You two take it and apply it on each other.”
“Thanks, Class Leader.” Justin took the ointment without hesitation and went with Jack to the changing room to apply it.
As they watched the two leave, Vera Lee playfully stuck her tongue out, “I never thought that Jack, who seems so gentle and cultured, would fight so crazily.”
Sawyer Levin, who had been silent, nodded, “Yeah, Justin really had it rough.”
Despite Jack being at a disadvantage, and being hit more often, for some reason, everyone felt that Justin was the one who had a harder time.
At this moment, Sawyer felt somewhat relieved that he had chosen to give up when he was pushed back by a punch a few days ago.
Otherwise, he might have ended up like Justin, and who knows what the rest of the class would have thought of him.
Crystal suddenly asked, “What do you think? If I invite Jack to join our club again, will he refuse?”
Vera blinked her big eyes, puzzled, “Class Leader, why would you invite him again?”
The other two were also surprised.
As high school students, all of them cared about face; logically, after being refused once, Crystal should not have thought of inviting him again.
Crystal slowly said, “Because he has great courage and strong fighting instincts. If he joins our club, he would be a good teammate.”
The others just saw how intense the fight was, but she saw more.
For example, Jack’s fearlessness in the face of adversity and how his fighting style became even more ferocious amidst the calm. Also, his instincts to exchange injuries while avoiding vital points during the fight.
People like him were born to be warriors, with an unwavering will.
Freya spoke softly, “I think he would still refuse.”
“Alright, let’s pretend I never mentioned it.”
……
“Hiss! Jack, be gentle.”
In the changing room, Jack applied the ointment to Justin’s shoulder. Any slight pressure on it would make him squeal like a pig, which left Jack speechless.
“Why are you such a big man, yet so afraid of pain? Look at me, I’m not afraid at all.” Saying that, Jack applied the ointment to his own chest without a care.
“Nonsense, I chose the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Formula because I’m afraid of pain.”
“Besides, don’t lie to me. When you were applying it to yourself, you were much gentler. When you applied it to me, you used a lot more force.” Justin rolled his eyes.
“How could that be? Am I that kind of person?” Jack smiled and put down the empty ointment bottle.
After applying the ointment, the two moved their bodies around. Their Qi Blood indeed flowed more smoothly than before, and the swelling quickly subsided.
Jack asked, “Mr. Willard, what’s your current arm strength?”
Justin didn’t hide it and replied, “190 kg, and the strengthening of the first layer of the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Formula is one and a half times.”
“I see.” Jack nodded.
His own arm strength was just over 150 kg. Considering the difference in their Cultivation Methods, it was only natural that Justin would be able to suppress him completely.
With this calculation, the strength of those who practiced Advanced Skills should be around the same as Justin’s. It would be a bit difficult for Jack to beat them. He pondered.
Exchanging injuries could only be considered a last resort.
Moreover, if the overall attributes were suppressed, as long as the opponent was cunning enough, Jack would actually come out worse in an exchange of injuries.
“It was painful today, but it felt good. Especially you, Jack. I didn’t expect your strength to improve so much that we could actually keep up with each other in battle.” Justin rubbed his eyes as he spoke.
“No, you were much better, Mr. Willard.” Jack said, trying to flatter him.
Justin was speechless, “If I were better, I wouldn’t have ended up like this.”
“Isn’t it because you let me do that?” Jack laughed.
“You think I would believe that?” Justin rolled his eyes.
At this point, Jack suddenly asked, “Mr. Willard, do you know what’s been going on the past few days? I see law enforcement officers everywhere on the street.”
Yesterday and today, the streets were filled with law enforcement, which made Jack curious about what had happened.
As for why he asked Justin, it was because Justin had well-connected sources of information.
“No big deal. I heard that two Evil God Sect Cultists appeared, and they are now being tracked down and investigated.”
“Cultists? Those who caused chaos in Koroya?” Jack’s face turned serious.
Noticing his solemn expression, Justin reassured him, “Don’t worry, Jack. It’s not the small country of Koroya here. No matter how many of those guys come, they will die.”
“Although we don’t see many cultivators in society, there are many experts in our city, especially among our school’s teachers.”
“However, it might be a little dangerous these days, so don’t wander around at night if you don’t have to.” Finally, Justin reminded him once more.
At five in the afternoon, Jack left the school after the swelling in his face subsided. On the way, he took out his mobile phone and searched for news about Koroya.
He discovered that it had been half a month since the situation in Koroya had become more and more serious.action
Almost half of Koroya was showing signs of rebellion led by cultivators, and besides that, there were also some Evil God Sect Cultists mixed in among them.
These so-called Evil God Sects were dangerous elements that had emerged in recent years, mostly appearing in small backward countries in the South. They often caused chaos.
Therefore, every time they appeared, they would be quickly eradicated by the local official forces.

chapters.title: Chapter 30
chapters.content:
30 Chapter 30: The Second Evolution
Translator: 549690339
When Jack returned home, Glenn had already cleaned a plate of fish meat.
“Bro, the Mutated Beast you’re raising is eating more than me, and it’s getting bigger and bigger. Won’t it eat up our house at this rate?” Glenn was worried.
He felt that their diet had been getting worse lately, and it should all be because of the Mutated Beast his brother was raising.
In the past, he could eat his fill of meat every day, but since more than half a month ago, although there was still meat every day, it seemed to run out after just a few bites, leaving only vegetables on the plate.
During this time, he could only eat a little more when he cooked for himself, which was one of the reasons he actively went home to cook every day.
Thinking of this, Glenn, for the sake of his own stomach, suggested, “Bro, why don’t we eat the Mutated Beast? I heard its meat is very nourishing.”
Jack glanced at him with a strange look, “This suggestion sounds good. What flavor do you think would be delicious?”
Glenn’s eyes lit up, thinking it was a possibility, and excitedly suggested, “Bro, I think barbecue flavor and garlic flavor would be more fragrant, and of course, spicy flavor would work too.”
“Bro, wait a minute, I’ll get a knife.” Glenn excitedly ran back to the kitchen, picked up the cleaver, and was about to go upstairs to kill the Six-legged Salamander.
Jack said irritably, “You really thought I was serious? Put the knife down.”
“Ah? Bro, we’re not eating it?” Glenn was disappointed.
Jack waved his hand, “All you think about is food. This is the Mutated Beast I raised myself.”
“But your concern is not unreasonable. This Mutated Beast’s appetite has been increasing lately. I plan to release it in a few days.”
“…Let it go.” Glenn suddenly felt it was such a waste.
What a waste, that’s Mutated Beast meat…
“Alright, don’t be upset.”
Jack patted his shoulder, “You’re still young and don’t understand some things. Just listen to me, go cook our dinner.”
“Alright.”
Although Glenn didn’t know why his brother wanted to release the beast, his trust in him since childhood kept him from overthinking it.
Not caring about Glenn’s tangled thoughts, Jack took the plate of fish meat to the second floor.
In the room, the Six-legged Salamander that had grown to sixty-eight centimeters in length lay on the floor, looking more and more majestic, especially with the three pairs of red feather horns on both sides.
Whether it was because it had evolved or simply grown, the Six-legged Salamander’s vision had improved significantly.
Through the Salamander’s low-angle view, Jack could clearly see his own appearance and the room’s furnishings, although everything appeared enormous and oppressive.
After making sure his Avatar was full and satisfied, Jack cultivated once more before going to bed.
…
The next day, on the way to school, there were still enforcers around. It seemed that the two cultists hadn’t been caught yet. Jack thought about it.
As soon as he entered the classroom, he found it much busier than usual. Everyone was discussing the upcoming ranking competition.
A few students who had just established their Foundation were complaining about the unfairness. They had only just entered the First Layer Heaven a few days ago, while many classmates had been cultivating for half a month.
In such a situation, they would be far behind in terms of basic physique and skill mastery, with no hope of standing out.
Compared to them, those who had broken through half a month ago were excited, rubbing their hands with anticipation, believing that this was their chance to become famous at school.
With everyone at the First Layer Heaven, they felt that if they tried their best, they might have a chance to make it into the Top 50.
As for those who had not yet established their Foundation, they could only watch enviously.
“I think Class Leader Crystal should have no problem making it into the top ten this time.”
“You’re underestimating Class Leader. I think she has a chance to make it into the top five. Yesterday afternoon at the sparring training, Class Leader defeated Bryant and two others in a joint clash.”
“Yeah, I think Class Leader has the strength to make it into the top five. Her sword skills are amazing.”
Many classmates gathered around Crystal, who sat in the front row, admiring her for overpowering three classmates in a joint effort during yesterday afternoon’s training.
After Jack’s and Justin’s battle yesterday afternoon, Crystal and the others had also noticed the issue of actual combat experience.
So yesterday afternoon, she called all the Foundation Establishment students in the class together in her capacity as Class Leader.
She claimed that it was to improve the overall strength of the class so that they could achieve good results in the upcoming ranking competition and organized the actual combat training.
Most people had no objection to this suggestion, and they had all been itching to test their skills. So, the sparring during their afternoon training was lively.
“I think Matt has a chance to make it into the top ten this time. He’s a genius who reached Foundation Establishment in just three or four days, like Crystal.”
“That’s right, Matt is very strong too. In yesterday’s training, Justin was easily defeated by him. He’s definitely making it onto the list.”action
“Haha… You guys flatter me. My strength is actually average. Yesterday, I only won by a lucky chance.”
“And besides, we’re all still students, so the priority is friendship. It doesn’t really matter how we rank. As long as we learn from each other and make progress, that’s enough.”
Jack sat down in his seat and looked at Justin in front of him with a puzzled expression, “What happened? You even got beaten by the class council member yesterday?”
Justin felt wronged, “I wasn’t beaten, we just sparred a bit, and besides, I hadn’t fully recovered from my injuries after fighting you, so I just lost a couple of moves.”
“Really?” Jack felt that he was just being stubborn.
After fighting Justin yesterday, Jack had found a Personal Cultivation Room to focus on cultivating the Dragon Elephant Power, so he hadn’t participated in the training.
At this time, Jack asked curiously, “Justin, what do you think about Matt and Crystal’s strength?”
Justin hesitated for a moment, “…Very strong. I haven’t practiced with Crystal, but I don’t think I’m her match. Her aggressive and fierce swordsmanship particularly counters mine.”
“As for Matt, he’s just a little bit stronger than me.”
“I understand.” Jack nodded slightly in agreement.
Although Justin spoke insincerely, these early breakthrough Foundation Establishment geniuses were indeed very strong, able to suppress students like him who also cultivate Advanced Skills.
Wuwuwu! At this time, a whimpering sound came from the front.
Justin quickly turned back to console, “Ah Yue, it’s okay. Even if you can’t cultivate True Martial Arts, you can still go to a prestigious university.”
“Look, General Emma Louise isn’t any different. She didn’t practice True Martial Arts either, but now at only thirty years old, she has become a Federation Major General. Let me tell you…”
Not only was it the girl who sat in front of Justin.
While the excited Martial Cultivation students were discussing the ranking competition, the emotions of the classmates who were still at the Sixth and Seventh Stages after nearly a month of cultivation were quite low.
Jack saw this but could do nothing. Talent wouldn’t change because you were unhappy with it.
Moreover, they were already lucky. They had the opportunity to systematically learn True Martial Arts in high school.
In some allied countries, information about True Martial Arts and cultivation resources were controlled by the upper class, and ordinary people had no chance to access them. This was also the reason why these small countries had become more chaotic in recent years.
After all, not everyone is content to be at the bottom for a lifetime.
At four o’clock, with the sound of the school bell, Jack slowly opened his eyes and prepared to go home.
For the first time since he started cultivating True Martial Arts, he left school this early to go home. The reason was very simple – his Avatar was about to begin its second evolution.

chapters.title: Chapter 31
chapters.content:
31 Chapter 31: Heavy Armored Beast
Translator: 549690339
When Jack Clark returned home, Glenn Clark hadn’t finished school yet.
Throwing the backpack on the sofa, he went up to the second floor.
In the room, the Six-legged Salamander, which had grown to 70 centimeters after eating once in the morning, lay on the floor. Its black bean-like eyes quietly watched Jack Clark.
With anticipation, Jack took a box from the drawer, picked one of the three Iron Beetles, and put it into the mouth of the Six-legged Salamander.
“Begin.”
Boom!
Accompanied by Jack’s confirmation, the evolution energy within the Six-legged Salamander, which had already reached the requirements for evolution, erupted like a flood.
That was the energy of evolution that had been accumulating in its body. As it passed through, the salamander’s whole body cells crazily split, compressed, and became stronger.
Moreover, deep inside the Avatar’s body, the originally fixed Genetic Sequence began to evolve in a stronger and more perfect direction after absorbing the Iron Beetle.
Crack crack!
On the Avatar’s smooth and tough surface, layers of blackish chitinous bones grew like scales at a visible speed.
At the same time, a heat flow appeared out of nowhere inside Jack’s body.
However, compared to the weak feeling of the first time, this time’s evolution energy increased by more than ten times, and the strength of muscles and bones skyrocketed at a terrifying speed.
This kind of enhancement was holistic. His whole body cells constantly divided, compressed and became more explosive, just like the Avatar’s, and the internal organs became stronger…
This evolution lasted for almost an hour.
Phew!action
Jack exhaled and opened his eyes. His clear black and white pupils looked as bright and radiant as a black gem, and a faint oppressive feeling radiated from them.
Feeling the surging power in his body, Jack showed a smile because this improvement exceeded his expectations.
With excitement, Jack called up the attribute page with a thought.
Level: First Layer Heaven
Physique: 58
Strength: 60
Agility: 52
Spirit: 55
Talent: Soul Split
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Method [Perfect], Dragon Elephant Power [First Layer], Heart’s Eye Bright Knife [Sword Skill First Layer, Heart’s Eye?]
Avatar: Hexagonal Armored Beast
Level: Low-level Unique Beast [Evolved twice Extraordinary Creature, adult body length limit 3 meters]
Talent: Strength [Powerful muscles and bones that can unleash a hundred times their own power]
Defense [Special body surface structure, steel hardness armor with a hundred times its volume and pressure defense, note, the defense decreases in weak areas of the armor]
Evolution value: 0/300
“All four major attributes have increased by 30 points, which means a three-fold enhancement of ordinary human physique. A single attribute has even surpassed the First Layer Heaven Limit.”
Jack’s gaze swept over the changes in his attributes, and then his attention shifted to the Avatar’s data below.
The Avatar’s name became Hexagonal Armored Beast, which had nothing to do with the salamander anymore. Its level was at the Low-level Unique Beast, and the body size growth limit was 3 meters.
However, these were not important. The Defensive Talent below caught Jack’s eye.
“As I expected, I have gained another talent.” A smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
With a hundred-fold increase in defensive power and the ability to burst out a hundred-fold power with his talent, his avatar would be safe as long as he was careful.
After checking the details of the attribute changes, Jack closed the attribute page and looked at the Heavy Armored Beast avatar on the ground.
Its body length was still seventy centimeters, the same as when it first evolved, but its density and weight had increased several times, and it was even thicker horizontally.
Its entire body was covered in black exoskeleton armor, including its abdomen, especially the back, which looked like a piece of armor stitched together.
Even the dorsal fin that runs from its head to its tail became blunt and thick, including the tail that occupied half its body covered in black ringed armor.
After evolution, its limbs became stronger and more powerful, and were also covered in smaller scale armor, with claws as sharp as small daggers.
Its once wide head was now covered in a black exoskeleton, with protruding eyebrow bones protecting its eyes, as if it were wearing a helmet.
Apart from that, its upper and lower jawbones became even more protruding, revealing two rows of sharp teeth and even four sharp canine teeth.
The two sides of its head extended outward like tiny wings, with the three pairs of feather horns becoming completely hardened, their colors becoming even more vivid red, giving it a somewhat ferocious appearance.
At this point, the Heavy Armored Beast avatar looked like a completely fierce and mutated beast. It was hard to imagine that it was originally a Six-legged Salamander no bigger than a palm.
At that moment, the sound of the front door opening came from downstairs.
Glenn Clark saw the backpack on the sofa and shouted at Jack upstairs, “Bro, you’re back.”
Jack replied from upstairs, “Mm, I had to leave early today. You go and cook, and I will go out for a bit.”
“Oh.”
After dealing with Glenn with a casual remark, Jack rummaged through the wardrobe to find a double shoulder backpack and then, using his consciousness, he carefully guided the Heavy Armored Beast to crawl inside.
Once the Heavy Armored Beast was curled up, Jack pulled up the zipper and lifted it by the strap. He immediately felt the weight in his hand and the sound the strap made under the heavy burden.
By his estimate, the Heavy Armored Beast weighed at least eighty kilograms, an astonishing weight.
However, this weight was nothing to him, who had an average physique five times that of an ordinary person.
Jack carefully carried the backpack outside, avoiding any damage to it from the Heavy Armored Beast, and walked to the riverside hundreds of meters away under the sunlight.
Ordinarily, releasing a mutated beast like this should be done in secret during the night, which suited the atmosphere.
Then, when coming back in the night, he would encounter some accidents, and something else would happen, like playing the hero saving a damsel, fitting the plot better.
As his thoughts ran wild, Jack soon reached the riverside and followed the riverbank downwards.
After checking his surroundings and seeing that no one was around, he put down his backpack, unzipped it, and the black unique beast slipped into the river through the weeds.
Gurgle! A few bubbles burst out, and the Heavy Armored Beast swam along the riverbed.
Suddenly, another underwater scene appeared in Jack’s eyes.
From the Heavy Armored Beast’s perspective, the surrounding vision became blurry, and with the help of sunlight, it could see clearly within a range of about ten meters in the two-meter deep water.
Here, the weeds swayed, small fishes swam, and suddenly a large fish weighing several pounds appeared, scaring the small fishes into a frenzy.
Just as the fish swam past the Heavy Armored Beast, it was suddenly bitten in half by the Heavy Armored Beast’s powerful jaws with a crunch.
Chewing on the fish meat, the Heavy Armored Beast, controlled by Jack’s consciousness, swam along the small river towards the main stream, tens of miles away.
Only deep water would have big fish, and a wide river would have abundant resources. It was now ready to kill and eat until it was full.
At that moment, the Heavy Armored Beast felt a faint sense of excitement, as if it were experiencing the freedom of the sky and the vastness of the sea. It had been kept in the room for too long.
Not only was the space too small, but also the food was insufficient.
If there had been enough food, the Heavy Armored Beast’s avatar could have evolved ten days earlier. However, due to Jack’s limited resources, the night time was basically wasted.

chapters.title: Chapter 32
chapters.content:
32 Chapter 32: Can Only Help So Much
Translator: 549690339
After his Avatar entered the river, Jack Clark turned around to leave. Yet, due to the distraction of controlling the Heavy Armored Beast swimming around, he seemed a little distracted along the way.
It was the same during dinner in the evening.
Seeing Jack Clark who kept halting his meal, Doris Raven, sitting opposite him, expressed her concern, “Jack, are you okay?”
“Ah, yeah, I’m fine.,” Jack replied, snapping back to his senses.
Just earlier, the Heavy Armored Beast had encountered a one-meter-long Big Green Fish at the riverbed. Without giving it another thought, Jack pounced it, flipping over the larger green fish swiftly.
Despite the considerable size difference, the Heavy Armored Beast simply trapped the Green Fish underneath its claw. Its immense strength made the fish completely immobile at the riverbed.
After this evolution, the Avatar’s talent for a hundredfold increase in strength was fully unleashed. Now, a single claw can exert a force of over a thousand kilograms, which is terrifyingly formidable.
And this was only because it was only seventy centimeters long at this stage, still in its juvenile phase.
Once the Heavy Armored Beast grows to three meters and weighs hundreds or even thousands of kilograms, its strength at the same size will reach a horrifying level.
After dinner, Jack went upstairs to practice under the pretext of cultivation, while continuing to control the Heavy Armored Beast swimming.
Approximately after an hour, they finally arrived at the mouth of the river, dozens of miles away.
With the river water surging under the ivy-covered riverbank, a menacing black head protruded from the water.
Jack looked around through his Avatar, there were no buildings nearby and the river dyke behind him was desolate with only scattered street lamps along the riverside road.
The yellow earth bank here was several meters above the water level, suitable for burrowing and creating a cave.
Although the Six-legged Salamander was amphibious and could stay in the water for an extended period, Jack believed that a nest on the bank would be safer.
Under Jack’s control, the Heavy Armored Beast dug out an underwater cave entrance with its double claws, and then expanded it, digging upward.
Soon, a dark hole was dug, which was several meters deep and turned upward in twists. The deepest part occupied an area of two square meters.
Then, Jack dug out another small vent above the entrance to the cave.
Phew!
In the room, Jack exhaled and slowly opened his eyes.
Controlling the Avatar in the wilderness was different from inside the house. Jack had to keep his attention diverted to avoid accidents caused by a delayed response to the Heavy Armored Beast.
Even if it didn’t affect him, the loss would still be considerable.
After all, as long as the Heavy Armored Beast continued to evolve, it would not only become a powerful force, but each evolution would also bring a massive improvement to his strength.
So, it was only after burrowing a cave for hiding that Jack was able to withdraw most of his mental focus, preparing to start the night’s cultivation task.
However, Jack barely started cultivating when he felt something different.
As a much thicker amount of his Qi Blood circulated through his body, the free extraordinary energy around was attracted and then refined inside his body by his spirit power.
This was happening both in terms of circulation speed of his Qi Blood and the amount of extraordinary energy absorbed. Since both rates had doubled, the overall cultivation speed was increased by twofold.
He felt that the Dragon Elephant Power, which he had initially anticipated to take four months to break through to the First Layer, could now possibly achieve that breakthrough in just over a month.
This change took Jack by surprise, and then he began cultivating even harder.
As his Qi Blood kept circulating, refining the free energy between heaven and earth, Jack’s muscles, tendons, and fascia were being continually strengthened, getting more sturdy each time they circulated.
Of course, this strengthening was a slow process.
……
In the morning, just as he left his house, his younger brother Glenn Clark came up to him and compared their heights before exclaiming in surprise, “Brother, have you grown taller again?”action
Just a month ago, Jack was only 1.7 meters short compared to the 1.75 meters tall Glenn, who has been that height since he was thirteen.
During this period, Jack had unintentionally grown as tall as Glenn due to the continuous strengthening of his physique and his cultivation.Not only had his height increased, the once thin body had also become more robust. This robustness was not the fierce strength Glenn possessed, but a harmonious symmetry.
The upper body was slightly muscular, his shirt being strained in the process. His trousers straight, combined with a tall and straight posture, gave him an aura of radiant vitality.
“I’ve been growing recently,” Jack Clark responded casually.
Both brothers were headed to school. Just as they reached the crossroads that led to the city area, a girl walked over from the side. She waved at Jack upon seeing him.
The girl had a slim and elegant figure, her waterfall-like black hair was tied back with a white butterfly knot. With a pure and beautiful face, she appeared as a striking sight wherever she stood.
Glenn exclaimed in surprise, “Bro, she seems to be waving at you.”
“Yes, she’s my classmate,” Jack nodded as he smiled slightly at Freya passing by.
At this point, the green light for pedestrians came on and Jack, followed by Glenn, turned towards her, “It’s not often we meet, shall we walk together?”
“Sure,” Freya nodded gently.
Glenn moved closer and said naively, “You’re so beautiful, you’re just like a fairy from the costume dramas.”
“I’m sorry, this is my little brother, Glenn.” Jack was a bit embarrassed.
Freya suppressed a giggle, “No worries, your brother is so adorable.”
As the three of them walked forward, Glenn sped up to reach Freya’s other side, curiously asking, “Are you and my brother close?”
Freya paused, “…We’re just classmates.”
“Oh, here I was thinking you and my brother were good friends,” Glenn seemed a bit disappointed.
“Friends…probably…I guess.” Freya mentioned, her gaze moving towards Jack, blinking.
Jack smiled, replying, “Of course, we are.”
Thinking about it, they’ve known each other for quite a while. They’ve been getting along pretty well since their days of learning the Body Casting Skill. Basically, their relationship was not any different than that of friends.
At this point, Glenn noticed a few of his friends up ahead. He waved his hand to Jack, “Bro, pretty sister, I have to go first.”
As he ran off to join his friends, Glenn gave Jack a meaningful wink which seemed to suggest, ‘Bro, I’ve done all I could.’
Jack was left speechless.
After Glenn left, Jack and Freya walked towards school side by side, casually discussing their cultivation experiences.
Upon entering the school gate, they bumped into their classmate, Vera. Her eyes widened in surprise as if she had just seen something extraordinary.
In the classroom, Jack had just sat down when Justin Welan, who was sitting in front of them, turned around to talk to him. A surprised whisper followed, “Jack, why does it feel like you’ve grown stronger?”
Jack glanced at him, “What do you mean stronger?”
Justin looked puzzled, “Strange, be honest, have you used any cultivation resources after you got home yesterday?”
“Do you really think I, who can’t even afford the resources for replenishing Qi Blood during Foundation Establishment, can afford cultivation resources?” Jack was speechless.
“That seems reasonable but…” Justin’s confusion deepened.
He had just fought with Jack a few days ago, so he was quite sensitive to the changes in Jack’s aura.
As soon as Jack sat down today, Justin sensed a faint threat from him. It was still the same person, but for some reason, there was an inexplicable sense of oppression.
But how could Jack pose a threat to him?
He knew Jack’s talent very well. Jack might have a promising future because of his steady personality, but Justin didn’t believe Jack could suddenly have a breakthrough and surpass him.
They were just First Layer Heaven, still in the realm of physical cultivation, not even at the stage of Sixth-level Heaven, where enlightenment mattered most. How could his strength suddenly skyrocket?
“Could I be wrong?” Justin scratched his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 33
chapters.content:
33 Chapter 33 Underwater Hunt
Translator: 549690339
In the afternoon, there were only a dozen people practicing in the large cultivation room.
Genius Crystal Leinster and Matt Watkins from the class had their own small groups and rented a club practice room.
As the surrounding classmates practiced boxing, swordsmanship, and other weapons, Jack Clark held a sword in one hand behind his back, slightly closing his eyes.
He had not been able to enter the state of Heart’s Eye before in his cultivation.
However, today when he calmed his breath and focused his mind, a vague image appeared in his mind.
His 55-point Spiritual Attribute was equivalent to five to six times that of ordinary people. The powerful Spirit Power naturally spread out, covering a range of several meters.
Under normal conditions, a cultivator’s Spirit Power would also increase in the later stages, allowing the mind and will to be released and perceive everything around them.
But when your Spirit Power perceives an opponent in the distance, they can also detect you instantly.
Therefore, the creator of this cultivation method thought of another shortcut by tapping into the human Five Senses, cultivating them to their limit, and ultimately developing a mysterious Sixth Sense.
At that time, as long as there was a malicious glance on them, regardless of the distance, they could perceive it instantly, even surpassing an opponent’s timing in battle.
As the mantra appeared in his mind, Jack slowly concentrated his Spirit Power on his senses of hearing, smelling, touching, etc., and stimulated these senses infinitely with the sword’s edge.
He didn’t know if it was because of his enhanced strength or evolution, but soon Jack’s body hair could feel the weak flow of air around him.
These fluctuations were caused by the ripples of the air being stirred by the practice of those around him and the sharp vibrations of their weapons tearing through the air.
As his mind quieted, Jack’s mind became like a transparent mirror, with ripples constantly fluctuating on it, forming some fragmented, vague lines.
This cultivation session lasted until noon.
Jack slowly opened his eyes, looked at the classmates who had finished their practice and were preparing to have lunch, and summoned the attribute page with a thought.
As expected, under the Sword Skill remark, the Heart’s Eye finally made its entrance.
Upon seeing this, Jack smiled. As long as he had entered the Heart’s Eye state once and it had been recorded on the attribute page, he could slowly improve his skill with diligent cultivation.
After everyone left, Jack went to a strength tester and took a deep breath.
He saw his body sinking, his body’s Qi Blood operating feverishly, and the muscles in his right arm and upper body slightly swelling, generating a furious power.
Boom!
Under Jack’s punch, the strength tester embedded in the wall shook violently, and the numbers on it went wild before stopping at 1650.
Nearly six times the strength attribute of ordinary people allowed Jack to have four hundred kilograms of arm strength.
Furthermore, after practicing Dragon Elephant Power, the special characteristic of solidifying his strength increased his terrifying impact by one fold, resulting in an instantaneous explosive force of over 1600 kilograms with a single punch.
That was just a simple power explosion.
Next, Jack went to the Speed Testing Area and did a test, with data showing twenty-four meters per second.
Although this speed was already fast, Jack was slightly puzzled.
Based on the normal speed of ordinary people of over six meters per second, his agility attribute of five times that of ordinary people should give him thirty meters per second, right?
Or is speed different from strength in that personal movement speed is affected by external factors such as gravity and air resistance, and cannot be simply converted by a linear multiplier?
While feeling puzzled, Jack conducted some more tests.
He found that except for his movement speed—which was slightly slower than expected—his nerve response was equivalent to five times that of ordinary people, and his body was also highly coordinated and agile.
Apparently, the agility attribute wasn’t just about speed; it also included body coordination and nerve response.
Moreover, at this point, he could still slowly improve his physique and strength while practicing Dragon Elephant Power.
It seemed that the evolution of his Avatar had also raised his limits, and he was different from those classmates who could no longer improve their physiques after reaching the First Layer Heaven Limit.
……After completing his daily cultivation in the afternoon, it was already four o’clock, but Jack didn’t leave the school, and instead went to the thirty-three-layer data room.
Every day after cultivation, whenever he had time, he would go to the top floor to find books to read, which helped to enrich his knowledge and prevent him from being ignorant in the future.
Under official control, however, this information cannot be found online.
When Jack, with two books in hand, arrived at the reading area, he saw the girl with black hair like ink sitting in her usual spot by the window, her head slightly bowed as she quietly read.
As Jack sat down across from her, Freya Louise seemed to sense something and looked up slightly.
Seeing that it was him, a faint smile appeared on the girl’s pretty face, and she nodded to Jack before lowering her head to continue reading.
Jack also returned the smile and began reading his own book.
At this time, the sunlight shining outside the window cast a warm glow over the two, making the atmosphere a bit lazy and leisurely…
Bang!
Under the ten-meter-deep river surface, water exploded as a 75-centimeter-long Unique Beast, clad in heavy armor, suddenly burst from the riverbed, biting into the abdomen of a big fish swimming above.
This was a black fish 1.5 meters long, weighing several tens of kilograms, with sharp teeth in its mouth.
The attacked fish twisted its body frantically, trying to break free with a burst of power, but at that moment, a claw unexpectedly struck its head with astonishing force.
Crack! The skull of this snake-headed black fish had been shattered by the Heavy Armored Beast’s palm.
After killing the black fish, which was twice its length, the Heavy Armored Beast began to feed, its sharp teeth and powerful bite easily tearing apart the food.
However, with human-like consciousness, the Heavy Armored Beast was picky, eating only meat and showing no interest in the innards.
As the scattered innards slowly sank, they were immediately swarmed upon by finger-sized small fish, tearing them apart frenziedly.
Big fish eat, small fish pick up scraps – this was the ecology beneath the great river.
Soon, the nearly 100-kilogram black fish had been devoured, and its terrifying ability to digest the food had visibly bulged the Heavy Armored Beast’s body.
The grown Heavy Armored Beast looked even more massive and ferocious.
Blurble! After emitting a string of bubbles, the Heavy Armored Beast’s tail flicked, and it went to search for its next target.
But at this time, a dark shadow flashed past deep in the murky waters.
Bang!
A powerful impact struck the Heavy Armored Beast’s belly, sending it flying several meters, continuously tumbling in the water.action
As the Heavy Armored Beast tried to adjust itself, the creature that attacked it once again charged at an astonishing speed, this time aiming for its head.
At this moment, Jack could finally see the appearance of the attacker. It was a fish over 2 meters long, covered in gray scales resembling a sturgeon.
However, the sinister mouth filled with sharp teeth, capable of biting off a person’s thigh in one bite, was much more fierce than a sturgeon.
The fish’s speed was incredibly fast, almost appearing in front of the Heavy Armored Beast in a blink of an eye, and then…
With a muffled ‘thud,’ the Mutated Sturgeon Fish was struck in the mouth by the Heavy Armored Beast’s tail, its body instantly flipping from the terrifying force.
Even though there was a three-fold difference in size between the two, it was the Mutated Sturgeon Fish that was flipped, leaving it dazed for a moment.
At this time, the Heavy Armored Beast had already pounced, its double claws tearing into the sides of the Mutated Sturgeon Fish’s body,slaughtering the scales with razor-sharp claws.
The injured Mutated Sturgeon Fish struggled frantically to throw off the Heavy Armored Beast clinging to its body but to no avail; meanwhile, the Heavy Armored Beast opened its mouth wide.
Crack!
Under the terrifying bite of the Heavy Armored Beast, the Mutated Sturgeon Fish’s spine had been snapped and its body stiffened, losing the ability to fight back, and became food.
In this body of water without powerful Mutated Beasts, the Heavy Armored Beast, with its fearsome strength and astonishing defense, was virtually without enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 34
chapters.content:
34 Chapter 34: Terrifying Defense
Translator: 549690339
“Jack Clark… Jack Clark.”
At six in the afternoon, Freya Louise looked at the lost-in-thought Jack Clark and couldn’t help but call his name twice.
“Ah… What’s up?” Jack Clark withdrew part of his attention.
Freya tucked her falling hair behind her ear, pointed at the wall clock, and softly said, “It’s already six o’clock. I’m heading back. Want to walk together?”
It’s already six, time flies when you’re ravaging the rivers. Jack Clark nodded sentimentally, “Okay.”
The two got up, put back the books they had borrowed, and walked out of the building.
At this time, most students immersed in their cultivation were heading home one after another. They walked out in pairs, discussing the forthcoming ranking competition.
The sun set in the west, and the sunlight was no longer as scorching as it had been in the afternoon.
A gentle breeze brushed past the girl’s hair, bringing with it the faint fragrance of shampoo.
Jack Clark turned his head and looked at her stunningly beautiful profile. He casually asked, “Freya, are you going to participate in the competition next Monday?”
Freya shook her head, “My cultivation method is special, and I don’t have much combat strength at the beginning, so I don’t plan on participating.”
He always heard her talk about her special cultivation method. Jack Clark couldn’t help but ask curiously, “What kind of cultivation method do you practice that doesn’t have much combat strength at first?”
However, the girl’s lips tightened, revealing a faint smile, “This question is a secret. You’ll find out during the Second Grade trial.”
Jack Clark helplessly said, “…Alright.”
“What about you? You’ll be participating in this ranking competition, right?” Freya asked back.
“Yeah, I’ll be participating.”
Jack Clark nodded, “In the past few days, I feel like I’ve made a breakthrough in my cultivation, so I’m planning to participate in the ranking competition and exchange experiences with my classmates and accumulate combat experience.”
Freya didn’t think much about this reason.
In her view, both she and Jack Clark practiced low-level cultivation methods. His initial talent was average among the new students, and participating in the ranking competition may just be to join in the fun.
After all, there were more than a hundred ordinary ‘geniuses’ in front of them who established their foundations and practiced advanced cultivation methods within a week.
There’s a considerable gap between Jack Clark and those people in terms of talent and level of the cultivation methods they practiced. There’s no chance he can make it into the top 50.
Along the way, the two chatted and walked like ordinary friends.
However, Freya noticed that occasionally, while talking, Jack Clark would become lost in thought. Perhaps he was not well-rested because of his recent intense cultivation.
Thinking of this, she couldn’t help but feel admiration.
It doesn’t matter if his talent is slightly lacking, as long as he works hard at cultivation, taking one step at a time and accumulating slowly, he will eventually reach heights unimaginable by ordinary people.
…
On Friday, the second day, the seniors went through a day of monthly exams. Many students looked bitter after receiving each test paper.
Helpless, they had spent all their energy on cultivation during this time and had no interest in studying books.
Hurriedly, the exams ended, and there was no school on Saturday.
Instead of going to school to cultivate as usual, Jack Clark went to the bustling Commercial Street, planning to practice in the noisy environment.
Today, he was dressed in a white T-shirt, gray pants, and white flat shoes – simple and casual attire.
With a tall figure, fine and handsome facial features, and a clean face, he attracted many looks as soon as he sat down under a tree shade.
Especially the girls in cool outfits who passed by this sunny handsome youth, they would deliberately stop, pretending to check out the surrounding shops.Unfortunately, even though some of these beauties are pretty and have sexy figures, the youth closed his eyes and started meditating as soon as he sat down, unable to see the view around him. Some female students who wanted to approach him stopped when they saw this.
Undisturbed by the outside world, Jack Clark closed his eyes and entered the special state created by his acute five senses.
With his keen hearing filtering out useless noises and his sense of smell distinguishing the people and objects around him, the touch-sensitive hairs all over his body sensed the flow of air in the space…
Once familiar with this state, Jack Clark divided his attention.
For the past month, he’s been practicing multitasking.
Although he couldn’t completely control two bodies with ease, he could already focus on his main body while partially controlling the Heavy Armored Beast.
The vast river with its turbulent waves was hundreds of meters wide and more than forty meters deep at its deepest point. It was home to countless aquatic creatures, many of which had undergone slight mutations due to the environment.
Near the riverbank, a creature the length of 80 centimeters and covered in heavy armor crawled out of a hole and swam toward the deep water area. Its limbs were thick and strong.
After being released for just two days, the Avatar had already grown 10 centimeters due to abundant food. Its figure became more massive, its defense stronger, and its strength more exaggerated.
At the same time, its evolution value increased at a rate of 5 points per day, far exceeding its previous growth rate.
Of course, this was also inseparable from Jack’s diligence in controlling the Heavy Armored Beast to feed at every opportunity, including getting up to eat in the middle of the night.
Soon, Jack controlled the Heavy Armored Beast to reach the deep water area more than twenty meters deep, where the visibility was murky and only a vague range of five to six meters was visible.
Before they swam far, a huge figure appeared in the Heavy Armored Beast’s sight.action
It was a ferocious fish mutated from a Crocodile Swallow Eel, three meters long with a long crocodile-like mouth. Its body was covered in thick scales and its back even grew sharp bone spurs.
When the Heavy Armored Beast noticed it, the fish caught sight of the small creature and came charging at it, ready to make a meal of it.
To the mutated Crocodile Swallow Eel, more than three meters long and as thick as a human body, an 80-centimeter Heavy Armored Beast was considered a small target, which the Eel could bite off in one gulp.
The Heavy Armored Beast calmly watched the mutated Crocodile Swallow Eel speeding toward it, watching indifferently as its wide-open mouth tore through the water, leaving splashes in its wake.
Bang!
With the Heavy Armored Beast not dodging, the mutated Crocodile Swallow Eel’s big mouth fiercely bit its stomach and back, releasing a ripping force under its immense kinetic energy.
In the past, the Unique Beasts relied on high-speed impact, using their kinetic energy and sharp teeth to tear their prey to pieces. But today… it was like biting an alloy steel.
The mutated Crocodile Swallow Eel’s sharp teeth shattered. Choked with pain, the Eel grew even more violent.
It clamped down on the Heavy Armored Beast with its massive biting force, twisting its enormous body wildly underwater to shred the hard prey in its mouth.
But even after the mutated Crocodile Swallow Eel had exhausted itself, the Heavy Armored Beast remained unscathed in its mouth.
Even the relatively weaker belly armor only had a small scratch, showing the terror of the Defensive Talent.
It seemed as if the Unique Beast was biting at the Heavy Armored Beast’s belly and back, but in fact, during its burst of strength tearing and biting, all the force was being distributed throughout its body by the exoskeleton structure.
Combined with the multi-layered internal structure which could gradually weaken the pressure on the body and the strength of the external armor which increased as its size grew.
All these factors combined made the Heavy Armored Beast’s defense terrifying.
Unable to tear it apart, the exhausted Unique Beast had no choice but to release the Heavy Armored Beast.
At this moment, the Heavy Armored Beast, which had just tested its defense, swung its tail and gathered its muscle strength in a twist of its body. With a powerful blow from one of its claws, it struck the Eel’s head.
Bang! The impact caused water to explode, and the mutated Crocodile Swallow Eel’s skull collapsed. Blood mixed with white liquid spewed out, and it was hammered to death by the Heavy Armored Beast’s one swift claw.
The Heavy Armored Beast killed the mutated fish and swallowed a large chunk of flesh and blood torn from its back, chewing it with blood flowing, looking extremely ferocious.

chapters.title: Chapter 35
chapters.content:
35 Chapter 35: Synchronous Strengthening
Translator: 549690339
“It didn’t seem to have any effect.”
In the pedestrian street, Jack, who had been sitting all afternoon, slowly opened his eyes, his face showing a hint of disappointment.
He originally thought that cultivating his Heart’s Eye in a noisy place like the pedestrian street would be helpful for his cultivation and more compatible with his cultivation method. However, the progress was just like yesterday.
It seemed that he was thinking too much.
Lost in thought, Jack stood up and left.
As he sat there, he basked in the sun and practiced cultivating his Heart’s Eye. Along the way, several beauties had come over to strike up a conversation.
However, at that time, Jack was in a state of cultivation, with half of his consciousness focused on hunting and battling with his Avatar as a Unique Beast, so he had no desire to engage with them.
Having fun hunting various mutated fish deep in the river is better than engaging with women.
…
On the second day, Sunday, Jack didn’t go to the pedestrian street or school.
In the sunlight, he sat cross-legged in the wooden corridor of the backyard, trying hard to practice his Dragon Elephant Power. At the same time, a part of his mind was on the Heavy Armored Beast.
More than ten meters deep underwater, the Heavy Armored Beast had just hunted a common mutated fish more than three meters long and was now eating it.
After a few days of rampant hunting, the Heavy Armored Beast had become the ‘ruler’ of an area with a radius of several kilometers. None of the mutated fish targeted by it could escape.
At the same time, with its constant eating and growing, its body was becoming bigger and heavier.
Huh?
Suddenly, Jack stopped his cultivation and opened his eyes.
Just now, he felt a faint warm current in his body, similar to the sensation when his Avatar evolved. Could it be…
Jacks’ thoughts shifted, and the attribute page appeared.
In just two days, the Four Major Attributes had unknowingly increased by 2 points. Among them, the highest strength attribute had reached 63 points.
“My various attributes are slowly increasing,” Jack was somewhat surprised. Then, an incredible speculation emerged in his mind.
Synchronous Strengthening.
As the Heavy Armored Beast Avatar grew, his body would also be influenced and continuously become stronger.
Before, the reason why he didn’t notice the synchronicity was that his previous Six-legged Salamander was too weak. It was so weak that even a little growth in it couldn’t cause any noticeable change for Jack, who was practicing True Martial Arts.
Only after the second evolution, when the Heavy Armored Beast’s size had exceeded a certain threshold, did it begin to affect Jack, whose physique had already reached 60 points.
Thinking about this possibility, Jack’s breathing became more rapid.
If his speculation was correct, how terrifying would his body become once his Avatar grew to be thousands or even millions of meters long due to Synchronous Strengthening?
Would he be able to destroy a planet with one punch?!
Jack was excited, “It seems that from now on, I need to devote more energy to cultivating my Avatar.”
Compared to the slow progress of True Martial Arts, the growth rate of the Heavy Armored Beast was much more exaggerated. It was only just under one meter now and not yet noticeable, but it would be terrifying after a few more evolutions.
Especially after entering the deep sea and growing to hundreds or thousands of meters…
On Monday, due to the Freshman Ranking Tournament, South Sky Martial Height was bustling with activity, with nearly two thousand freshmen rushing to the Sports Center in the Cultivation Area.
It was a stadium specially built for competitions, large enough to accommodate tens of thousands of people.
At this time, the four big screens hanging from the ceiling of the sports hall were broadcasting South Sky Martial Height’s school news, while the stands around were full of freshmen who hadn’t established their Foundation yet.
Beneath the stands, in an area equivalent to four football fields, there were fifty Martial Arts Arenas each spanning six meters long and wide. Each Martial Arts Arena was divided into four rows, ranging from number one to fifty.
As they weren’t uniformly assigned, the first two arenas stood out.
At this moment, at the south entrance of the sports stadium, freshmen were lined up in ten different queues, registering at ten self-service registration machines.
On each of their faces, there was excitement, agitation, anxiety, and nervousness.
As these newcomers were registering, on the upper part of the stands, a few upper-grade students who weren’t wearing school uniforms had their arms crossed. One of them asked uninterestedly,
“Gary, what did you call us here for?”
The long-haired youth with a smile on his face replied, “What else could it be? Of course, it’s to watch the competition together.”
Someone disdainfully said, “A bunch of Foundation Establishment rookies at the First Layer Heaven, what’s so interesting about this match?”
“Zhang Yao is right. These guys haven’t even cultivated their True Strength yet. Watching them fight is like watching children play house. I don’t know why the school insists on hosting this competition.”
An envious senior student said, “Yeah, I heard that as long as they rank in the Top 50, they’ll get an extra 5 Contribution Points every month. It’s as easy as picking them up.”
One should know that those Second Grade students, during their time in school, only received ten Contribution Points a month. If they wanted more Contribution Points, they needed to complete tasks for it.
However, these freshmen only needed to be in the top fifty to be almost on par with them, thanks to their monthly allowance.
The long-haired youth shook his head: “Don’t underestimate this group of freshmen. They’ve only been in school for a month, and some have already broken through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“Gary, you’re talking about that freshman named Jane Aiken, right? Breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven in half a month – her talent is already on par with that monster, Carol Koch.”
The long-haired youth smiled bitterly: “Not just her, there are several other powerful characters among these new students. One of them has a perfect compatibility with his cultivation method.”
“What, perfect compatibility?!”
“How is that possible?!”
This news surprised those few senior students.
The long-haired youth shrugged: “Don’t look at me like that. I heard it from Elder Polis. It should be correct.”
“Although that new student hasn’t broken through to the Second Layer Heaven yet, they have Innate Divine Strength and practice the Advanced Skill Ox Devil Mountain-Shaking Formula. Their power is extremely terrifying.”
“…What a monster,” one of the senior students swallowed.
With Innate Divine Strength and the inherently powerful Advanced Skill Ox Devil Mountain-Shaking Formula, the power under perfect compatibility would reach a terrifying level.
“It seems that this freshman class should not be underestimated.” The other senior students became serious.
On the other side, Jack, carrying a long knife on his back, had just completed his registration.action
“Jack, over here!”
Just as Jack squeezed out of the crowd, Justin Welan from afar waved to him. Around him were several other Class 3 students, who were vaguely separated into three groups.
One group was led by class leader Sherry Lesser, with Justin Welan, Sawyer Levin, and Vera Lee around her.
The other side was a small group led by Matt Watkins, followed by several other classmates who hadn’t joined their club.
Seeing Jack walking over, Justin Welan grinned, “Jack, if you’re unlucky enough to run into me later, I won’t hold back.”
As he spoke, he patted the thick shield on his back. The shield was ten centimeters thick, covered in cone stings, and was clearly his weapon.
Such a thick, heavy shield, even if made of an alloy much lighter than ordinary steel, still weighed more than a hundred kilograms – it was a true heavy weapon.
Jack smiled slightly, “If you encounter me, just give it your all. My goal this time is to participate, gain practical experience, and not worry about winning or losing.”
Sherry Lesser nodded, “That’s right, this is just an ordinary competition, and everyone’s strength is average. It’s mainly for exchanging experiences and not taking victory or defeat too seriously.”
“Class Leader is right.” Jack nodded humbly.

chapters.title: Chapter 36
chapters.content:
36 Chapter 36: Concession
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark surveyed his surroundings as everyone’s heads filled his vision.
These students, like them, were gathered in groups according to their classes, forming more than forty teams, and the estimated number of competitors would be around five hundred.
It was Jack’s first time seeing so many True Martial Arts freshmans. They were all strangers since they usually practice in different buildings.
Besides, the students who had just established their Foundation in a few days chose to give up, otherwise, the number of participants would even be higher.
“Silence!!”
As the broadcast rang out, the entire audience went quiet.
Following the sound, they saw more than a dozen teachers sitting on the main stage in the distance, including James Clark and Lori Parma.
In the middle of the teachers, a middle-aged man with a full beard held a microphone and said in a deep voice, “I am Vernon Leinster, the class teacher of Class 1, and the referees for today’s competition are the teachers present here.”
“Cultivation is a very boring task, especially for freshmen like you. Many people gradually slack off after experiencing the novelty of it.”
“That’s why the official organization has arranged this competition to let you recognize the gap between you and your peers, and by acknowledging the shame, you can strive harder in your cultivation.”
“You have no idea how much it costs our country to train you.”
“Don’t take this for granted, you should know that every resource you use is earned by other soldiers who are fighting on the battlefield.”
“At the same time, each of these cultivation methods was created after the founders exhausted their mind and body. The division of initial access rights exists because those who waste their opportunities have no right to enjoy them.”
“Of course, when I say ‘wasters,’ I am not referring to students who establish their Foundation slowly, but to those who become complacent, lazy, and unambitious after obtaining cultivation opportunities .”
“In the next three years, these people will be gradually eliminated from the school.”
Vernon Leinster said solemnly: “With that said, let me add two more points.”
“On the internet these days, there are widespread rumors that those who cannot establish their Foundation within a month have no cultivation talent or have only low talent if their Foundation was established just in time.”
“To me, these statements are completely nonsense. Establishing a Foundation is just a beginning, so what if it is a bit slow?”
“You should know that cultivation is a continuous process of self-improvement and breaking through limits. In the late period, every breakthrough of a realm is calculated in increments of ten or twenty years.”
“Every breakthrough of a Major Realm is a sublimation and a transformation of one’s life level. It’s incomparable to the one or two months slower start in Foundation Establishment.”
“Everybody, remember that cultivation is a long, tough journey. Only those with determination and perseverance can make it to the end.”
“The initial pace is just like stumbling blocks along the road that you can easily crush with only a little effort.”
“If you cannot even endure this little bit of grinding, no matter whether you cultivate or enter other industries, you will be mediocre in your entire life.”
Many students who had established their Foundation within a month were inspired by the passionate words of the class teacher named Vernon Leinster.
Even some freshmen who had given up in the audience stands once again ignited their faith in cultivation.
That’s right, they were only half a month or a month slower, so why couldn’t they cultivate?
“Alright, it’s about time, and now I’ll tell you the rules of the competition.”
“The competition is divided into three rounds. In the first round, everyone will fight consecutively against six opponents, each round lasting ten minutes. One point added for a win and one point deducted for a loss.”
“Teachers will determine the winner and loser based on their fighting performance if there is no outcome within ten minutes.”
“After the first round, the top 200 scorers will advance.”
“The second round will be a Martial Arts Arena defense battle. Each person only has one challenge opportunity, and defending against four opponents will be counted as a successful defense.”
“After determining the Top 50, the third round of free challenge matches will begin. If you are not satisfied with your current arena ranking, you can challenge the top ten.”
“Winners continue, losers’ ranking remains unchanged.”
“By the way, although the positions of the top 50 are different, the Contribution Points rewarded every month are the same.”
“Alright, let the competition begin. Everyone, based on the names displayed behind the arena numbers on the big screen, starts the first round.”
“I am at No.13 Arena.”
“I am at No.9 Arena…”
“I am at No.45…”
“I am at No.2 Arena, haha, Class Leader, Jack, I’ll go first.” Saying that, Justin Welan excitedly ran towards the No.2 Challenge Platform in the distance.
Jack then saw his name at the No.49 arena as well.
After greeting Crystal and the others, Jack hurriedly jogged over.
There was already a female student standing on the arena. She was ordinary-looking and said politely when she saw Jack hopping onto the arena, “Hey classmate, shall we have a simple friendly exchange without weapons?”
“Sure.” Jack nodded, and placed his knife at the side of the arena.
“Attention, No.49 Arena, the competition will officially start in three seconds.”
With the electronic announcement, Jack and the female student both looked serious and silently counted to three in their hearts. The girl opposite suddenly shouted.
“Be careful.” The moment her voice fell, the girl erupted with incredible speed, even faster than Sawyer Levin.
It was clear that her main cultivation method was in speed.
But… Bam!
Jack blocked the girl’s high kick with his left arm, not moving an inch, disregarding the girl’s explosive force of several hundred kilograms.
At the moment she was blocked, the girl twisted her body in mid-air and performed a triple kick at lightning speed, targeting Jack’s head and neck weak points.
But all of her attacks were effortlessly blocked by Jack, who reacted even faster.
Just as the girl’s strength ran out on her third kick, and while she was retreating mid-air, Jack moved like lightning, grabbing her ankle with one arm like an elephant trunk.action
Ah! The girl in mid-air was shocked.
Immediately she felt an enormous force attacking her, and she was directly thrown by Jack more than ten meters away, crashing down at the bottom of the arena with a loud bang.
The girl falling from the sky startled several nearby students.
Looking at the girl still dazed on the ground, unable to stand up due to her sore butt, Jack smiled slightly: “Thank you for letting me win.”
This girl was more powerful than Sawyer Levin, specializing in leg techniques and speed as well.
Unfortunately, she encountered Jack, whose speed, strength, and reaction exceeded the First Layer Heaven Limit, and was instantly crushed and defeated.
The teacher’s voice came through the arena’s loudspeakers: “No.49 Arena, student Jack Clark wins, the second round of the competition will start after an eight-minute break.”
Jack looked up, saw the camera on the pillar, and smiled: “Teacher, I think I can start the next match without resting.”
It wasn’t that Jack was showing off, but that the girl he just fought was too weak, and there was no need to waste time resting.
“…Fine.” the teacher on the Main Stage hesitated for a moment.
Immediately, a burly youth with a heavy hammer weapon on his back excitedly ran to the No.49 arena and jumped onto the stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 37
chapters.content:
37 Chapter 37: Sweeping Across
Translator: 549690339
The youth with the heavy hammer on his back was nearly 1.9 meters tall, with a sturdy build. After leaping onto the Martial Arts Arena, he excitedly looked at Jack Clark in the distance, “Class 19, Marcus Lee.”
“…Class 3, Jack Clark.” Jack Clark also announced his name.
Marcus Lee reminded, “Brother, I cultivate the Advanced Skill ‘Chaos Heavy Hammer’. If you feel that you can’t withstand it later, admit defeat early, don’t get hurt.”
Marcus Lee then grasped in his hand the heavy hammer behind him, which was two meters long, as thick as an arm, with the hammerhead as huge as a washbasin, and its surface completely blunt.
“Thank you for the reminder.”
Jack Clark nodded solemnly. Nevermind the Advanced Skill, just the opponent’s hammer alone was probably close to a hundred kilograms. Anyone who could use such a heavy weapon would naturally be no weakling.
With a clang, Jack Clark drew out a 2 meters long straight blade.
The strength of the First Layer Heaven Limit only gave him a basic advantage, but the outcome of the battle was not about comparing physical strength, but also depended on combat sense and the blessings of cultivational methods.
Kill!
A vast outburst of Qi Blood surged within Marcus Lee, like a furious giant bear charging at Jack Clark, the huge hammerhead waving in the air caused a piercing howl, the aura was shocking.
Jack Clark inhaled deeply, his body’s Dragon Elephant Power started to circulate, in an instant, all of his muscles swelled up a size, radiating a furious aura he advanced in retaliation.
Jack Clark burst out at an even faster speed, attacked in response to the attack, slashed down with a knife held in both hands.
Clang!
In mid-air, at the moment when the knife and hammer collided sparks scattered, a piercing collision sound echoed, afterward, a fearsome counter-shock strength erupted, causing Jack Clark’s mouth to throb with pain.
Across from him, Marcus Lee didn’t fare much better. Like Jack Clark, he was pushed back a step by the counter-shock force.
After a single move, both sides appeared evenly matched, but the previously confident Marcus Lee’s expression became solemn.
Because heavy weapons naturally had a strength advantage, coupled with the inertia of swinging and his charging kinetic blessing, he could have unleashed an impact force far beyond its limit.
In this situation, his opponent could actually somewhat match him with just a knife, the pure power was already beyond him, but… wasn’t this even better?
Marcus Lee’s blood was boiling with excitement, “What strong power, continue.”
As he spoke, he circulated the internal skill in his body, a stronger force transmitted to his arms, swinging the hundred-kilogram heavy hammer – he spun around with his waist as the axis and blasted out another hammer.
This strike, carrying the inertia of power, not only had greater strength but also greater speed, the piercing howl and afterimage instantly appeared above Jack Clark’s head.
But this time Jack Clark did not block head-on. His figure slightly shifted and he vanished from his original spot.
Boom!
The heavy hammer, carrying over a thousand kilograms of force, smashed into the Martial Arts Arena. Under the furious power, the hard stone slabs instantly shattered, countless tiny shards splashed out in all directions.
Clang!
Jack Clark appeared at Marcus Lee’s side, horizontal chop, but was deflected by Marcus Lee’s timely use of the hammer shaft.
But immediately Marcus Lee’s face changed because the moment he blocked the blade, Jack Clark reversed his grip and gave a pull, allowing the sharp blade to slide along the handle towards his palm.
The sudden change of move scared Marcus Lee into letting go hastily. But after spinning around to retract and avoid the range of the straight blade’s attack, he turned around and kicked the middle of the hammer shaft.
Under the power unleashed, the freed hammer shaft spun around with the hammer head as the center, he tried to repel Jack Clark and take back the attacking rights. Jack Clark, however, directly made an overbearing slash down.
Clang! Under the scattering sparks, a smile tugged at the corner of Jack Clark’s mouth.
You’ve lost.
Boom! With the ground vibrating beneath him, Jack Clark rushed forward, the two-meters-long straight blade in his hand pierced the air, the gleam of the blade flashed and appeared at the chest of Marcus Lee who was three meters away.
Looking at the blade tip which suddenly stopped at his chest, Marcus Lee was still somewhat unresponsive.
Jack Clark slowly withdrew his blade, smiled, and said, “Thank you for conceding.”
“Amazing”, Marcus Lee slowly exhaled, then he quickly admitted defeat, picked up his heavy hammer, and straightforwardly jumped off the Martial Arts Arena.
“No.49 Arena, student Jack Clark wins. Do you require a break?”
“Yes.”
This time Jack Clark did not choose to carry on fighting continuously. He withdrew his blade, stood tall, and was gradually calming his boiling Qi Blood, reviewing the experience gained from the fight just now.Marcus Lee was actually quite strong, even under the full burden of his heavy weapon, his frontal strength was not inferior to Jack Clark’s.
Unfortunately for him, in the very first match, he faced Jack Clark, who was not only equal in strength, but faster in reactions and greater in overall strength.
Moreover, as soon as Marcus launched his attack, Jack disrupted his rhythm by overpowering him with sheer force.
If Marcus was ever given an opportunity to wield his heavy hammer, amassing momentum with his inertia and hammer technique, it would take Jack at least ten moves to defeat him.
After a brief rest, Jack started his third fight.
The opponent was a spectacle-wearing youth. The boy…was utterly terrified when Jack powerfully cut down his weapon with a single swipe, and he quickly admitted defeat.
Then came the fourth battle. This time, the opponent was a cute girl wearing a lovely hair decoration. Her weapon was a 1.5 meter long thin sword.
However, after a mere three swift blows, the cute girl was made to cry by the aggressively spirited Jack.
The female student sobbed, “I quit!”, dropped her sword, and jumped off the martial arts arena. Witnessing this made Jack somewhat embarrassed – did he perhaps go too far?
