Then came the fifth match. The opponent was a student who had just crossed into the Foundation Establishment stage this month. Jack, in one swift motion, sent both the boy and his weapon flying several meters away.
After such a domineering move, the boy was terrified and promptly conceded defeat.
It wasn’t until the sixth match that he had a slightly stronger competitor.
This time, it was a girl who looked haughty; her attitude resembling one who thought the world owed her a fortune. Her weapon was the same as Jack’s.
The girl didn’t bother with chit-chat; as though believing Jack didn’t deserve to know her name. In a flash, she was at his side with an afterimage following her.
So fast! This speed was out of the First Layer Heaven category, even Jack was a little surprised.
Clang!
Jack blocked the incoming knife with his blade. The collision of their bladed weapons caused sparks to fly.
But, the girl’s face changed slightly as she was forced to retreat because of the furious power transferred to her through her sword.
In the First Layer Heaven, the main characteristic of True Martial Arts is power enhancement. Thus, the power doubles, becoming wild and fierce, while agility and speed are average, adhering to the ‘victory by strength’ route.
If a cultivator emphasizes agility, their speed would far exceed that of their peers. They would have nimble movements, but wouldn’t have as much strength as the strength-based cultivators.
For someone like Crystal Leinster, who specializes in sword skills, their sword moves would be lethal and complex, but their speed and strength would be quite mediocre in comparison.
In general, each cultivator has their own merits.
Like the girl in front of him, she cultivated a method focusing on agility and her speed was startlingly fast.
Just as she was retreating, her body moved at an odd angle. Like a phantom, she reappeared at Jack’s right side and aimed another stroke at his lower body.
Clang! Clang! Clang!!
Jack, immovable as a mountain, with sharp eyes, precisely blocked the phantasmal afterimages and the strange streaks of sword light surrounding him. Sparks flew with each clash.
But after just over ten moves, the girl explosively retreated to a distance five meters away. Her hand, which was gripping her long knife, shook uncontrollably, while her palm bled.
Even though her speed was fast, and her movement ghost-like, her strength fell far short of Jack’s.
Each time their swords met, she felt an overbearing power shaking her arm numb and causing pain in her palms. After only ten strokes, she was already wounded.
Jack exhaled a breath, smiled gently, and said, “You have been lenient.”
Humph! The girl gave Jack a deep glance, snorted coldly, and turned around to jump off the arena.
“Number 49 arena, student Jack Clark wins. You have completed your matches. Please step down for rest and wait for the results.”
Knowing he was definitely going to advance, Jack jumped down from the arena with a smile on his face.
After decisively defeating six opponents in a row, Jack’s performance aroused the attention of some teachers on the main stage.
Lori Parma even let out an astonished sound.
On his mind was Jack Clark, a student who had established the Foundation in less than a month. He had cultivated the power exploding Dragon Elephant Power, and his special sword skill was the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife.
But his combat power performance today seemed a bit too strong; even two ‘geniuses’ who had cultivated Advanced Skills were not his match.

chapters.title: Chapter 38
chapters.content:
38 Chapter 38: Attacking the Weak with Strength
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark wasn’t surprised that he won easily.
Although his Dragon Elephant Power had only been cultivated to the First Layer Middle Stage, his basic attributes were at least twice as strong as his opponents. If he lost, it would be a problem.
In this world, there was no such thing as the weak defeating the strong, only the strong triumphing over the weak.
If you can win, it means you are stronger than the opponent.
Even some genius students who were rumored to be able to fight across realms in the cultivation world would still have an edge in either a sudden power explosion or a stronger secret skill than their opponent.
They could only have an advantage in closing the gap between the two sides’ realms, and be able to fight across realms.
Descending from the Martial Arts Arena with his long knife, Chen Chu started watching other matches.
There were students carrying weapons around the fifty arenas, with names constantly changing on the big screen above their heads. Many people in the audience were cheering for their classmates.
Boom!
Under a violent energy wave, a male student holding a stick… or rather, a pillar, smashed his opponent off the Martial Arts Arena. His almost 2-meter-tall figure was even more fierce than Marcus Lee, emitting a terrifying aura.
What a terrifying strength. When Chen Chu looked at the iron column – over 3 meters long and as thick as an adult’s thigh – even if it was made from lightweight alloy, it would still weigh hundreds of kilograms, his eyes twitched.
Who is this guy? He’s so fierce. Chen Chu was shocked.
Does he have innate divine strength since he’s using such a heavy weapon? His arm strength must be more than a thousand kilos. There’s no way a First Layer Heaven cultivator has this much power.
Chen Chu had thought that his basic attributes exceeded the First Layer Heaven limit and that he should be among the top in this batch of freshmen. He didn’t expect to see such a powerful person – a total monster!
Chen Chu took a deep look at that giant-like male student and headed towards the next arena.
At this moment, not only Chen Chu, but also the students in the audience seats were getting worked up. The fast-paced action with heavy weapons was electrifying.
As the heavy weapons collided, the air above the entire arena was filled with a rumbling sound.
In contrast to the engrossed freshmen, the teachers on the main stage didn’t particularly mind. To them, these freshman competitions were nothing remarkable.
They were too slow and their strength was too weak. They didn’t even possess True Strength, let alone the Power of Heaven and Earth carried by True Strength.
While they casually watched the video monitors, occasionally, a teacher would shout at an arena where a student couldn’t hold back, declaring the more dominant side victorious.
At this time, a teacher asked in confusion, “Mr. Lester, why do you think the higher-ups allocated so many resources this time and let all the first-class universities focus on cultivating this batch of freshmen?”
Vernon Leinster shook his head slightly, “Not just this batch, but every year from now on, freshmen from the three major Federation countries will receive more resources than previous batches.”
Lori Parma was surprised, “What? The training resources are increasing every year, and it’s happening throughout the three major Federation countries? Is it because our side has won a great victory on the battlefield?”
The other teachers also showed excitement, thinking this was the reason.
Just as these teachers were getting excited, Vernon Leinster’s expression turned solemn and he shook his head slightly, “No, it’s because the Fifth Army Corps has opened up several new Resource Points.”
“As for the situation on the battlefield, it remains tense. The Third, Ninth, and Fifteenth Army Corps are under great pressure, witnessing at least one king-level battle every month.”
“Under these circumstances, the casualties of the army corps in various countries have been increasing in the past two years, and more fresh blood is needed.”
“That’s why the higher-ups have allocated these additional resources, urging us to expand our training targets, not to give up on even those students who establish their foundations within two months.”
Vernon Leinster’s words made the faces of these teachers turn solemn.
“So, the situation is becoming even more critical?”After a while, Lori Parma slowly exhaled, “But even so, is there any need to use resources to cultivate freshmen who can’t establish their Foundation within a month?”action
“If these resources were tilted towards the second and third-year students, their growth rate might be faster.”
Vernon Leinster shook his head: “You can’t see it like that, the growth of the second and third-year students is already fixed, so allocating more resources to them won’t have much effect.”
“On the other hand, these freshmen, although those who break through the Foundation Establishment a month later have indeed poor initial talents and their cultivation speed is despairingly slow.”
“But with such a huge base of talent in the Three Major Federation Countries, if another Mysterious Martial King were to emerge, it would be a significant gain for the Human Race.”
“I think this is also the intention of the higher-ups, to use resources to expand the cultivation base of humans, hoping that a few more ‘monstrous’ talents who have accumulated a lot can emerge and enhance the foundation of the Human Race.”
Lori Parma and others nodded thoughtfully.
Having finished his matches early, Jack Clark wandered around visiting various Martial Arts Arenas, and during this time he saw Crystal Leinster cleanly defeating her opponent and the two nodded to each other as they passed.
He also saw Sawyer Levin being defeated by a very strong female student and leaving the stage disheartened.
Suddenly, Jack Clark stopped and his eyes fell on the No.9 Arena ahead, where a beautiful girl who looked almost identical to Crystal Leinster was standing with a sword.
Unlike Crystal, this girl’s hair was black with a hint of blue, her face always carried a gentle smile, and her eyes were soft, giving people a feeling of watery warmth.
Her opponent was also a female student who wielded a long, slender Samurai sword.
After nodding to each other, the two sides immediately took action, turning into two shadows that collided.
Clang, clang, clang!!
The fierce swordlight and the sharp sword shadows intertwined as the two figures spun around, leaving faint afterimages and showing great strength.
Both girls focused on Sword Skill and Blade Skill; one had swift and dazzling knife flashes, while the other had sword lights that filled the space like water, captivating the surrounding audience.
Clang!
Suddenly, a dazzling spark burst open, and the girl wielding the Samurai sword let out a suppressed hum. Her figure appeared at the edge of the arena, her face pale.
“I lost.” Reluctantly dropping a sentence, the girl with the Samurai sword jumped off the stage.
“No.9 Arena, student Mandy Leinster wins. You have completed your matches, please step down and rest while waiting for the results.”
The girl named Mandy Leinster stood with her sword collected, slightly nodding to the watching classmates around her, showing excellent manners before jumping off the stage and leaving.
“Is this the Class Leader’s sister? Her strength is quite impressive.” Jack Clark pondered.
Just now, both of their movement speeds had reached the First Layer Heaven Limit, which ordinary people couldn’t keep up with, not inferior to the arrogant girl Jack finally defeated.
With this speed, ordinary people couldn’t see their movements clearly, let alone the kinetic blessing and sharp swordsmanship brought about by speed.
This level of strength ranked among the top freshmen present, but Jack could see that Mandy Leinster had defeated that girl quite easily and had plenty of room to spare.
“If it weren’t for this ranking competition, I wouldn’t have known that there are so many experts among the freshmen.” Jack shook his head and sighed, his slight sense of superiority due to his enhanced physique vanishing without a trace.
This little advantage was not enough for him to sweep through his peers; he needed to work harder on cultivating his Devouring ability.
Over five hundred participants, fifty arenas, one match every ten minutes, and with each person completing six matches, the first round didn’t end until noon.
Everyone dispersed for lunch.

chapters.title: Chapter 39
chapters.content:
39 Chapter 39 Good Luck
Translator: 549690339
Noon, canteen.
As soon as Jack Clark sat down, Justin Welan came over with his tray, frowning, “Jack, I have no hope of advancing this time.”
“What happened?” Jack Clark was a bit surprised. With his strength, even if he couldn’t make it into the top 50, he shouldn’t be unable to pass the first round, right?
At this time, Crystal Leinster, Sawyer Levin, Vera Lee, and Freya Louise also came over.
Freya Louise and Crystal Leinster sat down across from them, while Vera Lee and Sawyer Levin sat at the next table.
Crystal shook her head, “Justin’s luck was too bad. His first opponent was Jane Aiken, and he just surrendered right away.”
Justin Welan defended himself, “That’s because she held a realm advantage, I’m not stupid, of course, I would choose to surrender against a Second Layer Heaven expert.”
As if afraid of being underestimated, Justin Welan shrugged his shoulders, “It’s not just me, even if you, Class Leader, faced her, it would be the same, there’s no hope.”
“Or rather, in this ranking competition, no one can shake her position as the number one.”
“She’s so strong?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.action
Welan reasoned, “Of course, when breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven, there would be a significant increase, just like our Foundation Establishment, and the arm strength would increase by at least 100 kilograms.”
“Besides, experts in the Second Layer Heaven realm have True Strength, especially when she cultivates advanced skills, the explosive increase under True Strength is at least three to four times.”
“Who can be her opponent in this situation of being crushed in all aspects?”
Jack Clark silently nodded, with an estimated basic strength of 400 kilograms, plus at least a three-fold boost from True Strength, as well as faster speed and kinetic energy amplification.
Her casual strike could easily explode with an impact force of 3,000 kilograms, or more than three tons. Indeed, no one could compete with such strength.
Even that guy who fought with an iron column might not be enough.
As the most monstrous genius in South Sky Martial Height, Jane Aiken’s true combat power should be terrifying.
Jack Clark then became confused, “But wait, just losing one match shouldn’t be a problem for you to advance to the first round, right?”
With more than 500 people, and each person playing six matches, there wouldn’t be too many undefeated people. So it shouldn’t be a problem to enter the top 200 even if you lose one match.
“The problem is that I lost three matches.”
Talking about this, Justin Welan looked bitter, “In the second match, I met a pervert holding a pillar, his strength was terrifying, and I was directly smashed off the Martial Arts Arena with his three stakes.”
“Then, although I won three consecutive matches, in the sixth match I met a guy named Marcus Lee who practiced Chaos Heavy Hammer, and his skill happened to restrain me.”
“Due to my miscalculation, I was hit by his hammer technique and was knocked off the Martial Arts Arena with over twenty consecutive strikes, even though I had a great defense.”
“…Your luck is indeed quite bad.” Jack Clark didn’t know what to say about this.
Having finished talking about himself, Justin Welan casually asked, “By the way, Jack, how about you? How many matches did you lose?”
Ah…
Jack Clark coughed, humbly said, “I’m fine, I guess, my luck is not bad, the opponents I met were not ‘very strong,’ so I should have a chance to advance.”
“Your luck is so good.” Hearing that, Justin Welan couldn’t help but feel envious.
However, he didn’t think much about it and assumed that Jack Clark was indeed lucky, and the opponents he met were ordinary players who had established their foundations within half a month or a month.
Crystal Leinster and Sawyer Levin also thought the same.
But as soon as Jack Clark finished speaking, Freya Louise across from him couldn’t help but smile with her lips pressed, looking at him with a strange gaze.
At that time, Crystal and the others were competing and didn’t know who Jack’s opponents were since there were too many people around and the venue was too large.
However, she had been watching Jack from the audience seats all along.It was not his luck, but his absolute strength that swept through all his opponents, including Marcus Lee, who defeated Justin Welan.
She was shocked for a long time, as just a few days ago, Jack Clark couldn’t even beat Justin Welan.
Jack Clark looked at Crystal Leinster and curiously asked, “What about you guys, Class Leader?”
“I’m fine. I didn’t encounter any tough opponents.” Crystal’s tone was relaxed and breezy.
At the other table, the short-haired girl, Vera Lee, raised her hand and said with a smile, “I only lost two matches. I should have a chance to advance, better than Justin Welan and Sawyer Levin.”
“I lost three matches.”
Sawyer Levin was also a bit depressed. He had bad luck and encountered three ‘geniuses’ who practiced advanced cultivation methods. Otherwise, he should have advanced to the second round without any problems.
After lunch, everyone returned to the Sports Center.
There was still an hour before the afternoon matches, and Jack Clark found a random seat in the audience area.
At that moment, a faint fragrance wafted, and it was Freya Louise sitting behind him. She leaned forward curiously and asked, “Jack, did you break through to the First Layer Heaven Limit?”
Jack Clark turned his head and looked at the girl’s side profile, shook his head and said, “No, but I did make some progress in Dragon Elephant Power recently.”
“Dragon Elephant Power?” Freya was puzzled.
Jack Clark nodded and whispered, “Yes, my cultivation of Dragon Elephant Power has become smoother, and my strength has doubled, so I was able to defeat those people today.”
“True Martial Compatibility.” Freya was startled.
“I feel that this should be the reason.” Jack Clark knew he couldn’t hide it from her, so he prepared to use this reason to cover up the changes in him.
True Martial Compatibility was an enigmatic concept that even the creators of cultivation methods couldn’t determine.
Freya marveled, “To give you the power comparable to the First Layer Heaven Limit in just a week, it seems that your compatibility with Dragon Elephant Power is at least high-level. What a pity.”
At this point, her face showed a look of regret.
Because Dragon Elephant Power was just a low-level martial art, if Jack Clark practiced a high-level power type skill, perhaps he might have a chance to catch up to Jane Aiken.
Jack was not concerned, “It’s okay. Once I cultivate Dragon Elephant Power to its grand accomplishment and accumulate enough contribution points, I can exchange it for a high-level skill.”
“Maybe by then, I’ll be even more compatible with that skill.”
As long as the main True Martial Art was cultivated to its grand accomplishment, it could be replaced with higher level skills of the same type, which would automatically overwrite the original True Martial Art.
Therefore, Jack was not too worried about the fact that Dragon Elephant Power was a low-level martial art.
During the waiting period, seeing that there was still time, Jack Clark’s consciousness involuntarily sank, and his perspective suddenly switched to the Heavy Armored Beast’s.
In the dry cave, the ninety-centimeter-long Heavy Armored Beast slowly opened its eyes, stretched its limbs, and entered the river through the underground cave entrance.
Gurgle! Gurgle!
Bubbles rolled, and the Heavy Armored Beast gently swayed its tail, its ferocious figure swimming towards the deeper part of the river.
Soon, at the ten-meter-deep river surface, a half-meter-long grass carp appeared within the Heavy Armored Beast’s line of sight.
The black shadow lay quietly at the bottom of the river, motionless, like a piece of wood, watching the grass carp swim closer until half a meter away…
Bang!
Mud flew up, and the Heavy Armored Beast suddenly swung its tail, causing the water to explode behind him. Its figure resembled a sword shooting out, biting the head of the grass carp in one go.
Crack! The terrible biting force crushed the grass carp’s skull, making it extremely brutal.
The half-meter-long grass carp was quickly consumed by the Heavy Armored Beast, which then turned into a black shadow and disappeared, continuing to search for the next prey.

chapters.title: Chapter 40
chapters.content:
40 Chapter 40: Overbearing
Translator: 549690339
At half past one, with the teachers taking their seats, the names of the top 200 applicants appeared on the four twenty-meter long and ten-meter wide big screens in the Sports Center.
At this time, Jack Clark finally took his attention away from the full and satisfied Heavy Armored Beast.
“So unlucky, I didn’t make it.” Justin Welan cried out in agony, as his name wasn’t on the big screen.
As a ‘genius’ who established his Foundation within a week, he was probably the only one who didn’t make it to the next round.
After all, even Vera Lee was lucky enough to advance to the second round. Jack Clark glanced over and found his own name in the first row, showing a smile on his face.
“All those who advanced, enter the arena and begin the second round of the martial arts competition.”
“Remember, stop when you have a winner.”
With Class 1’s director, Vernon Leinster, speaking, all the named students got up from the audience seats, picked up their weapons, and entered the field one after another.
After Crystal and the others had gone down, Jack also got up and carried his long knife.
It was then that Freya Louise gestured to him to cheer up, with a smile in her eyes: “Good luck, Jack, try to get into the Top 50.”
Jack turned and smiled at her, while Justin Welan on the side was a little confused.
What was going on? Where did they get the confidence to break into the Top 50?
When Jack came to the field below, many people had already eagerly jumped onto the fifty Martial Arts Arenas.
According to the rules, those who took the lead and won four consecutive matches could be considered successful defenders and would no longer accept challenges. In this case, the later the remaining opponents, the stronger they would be.
“Class 15, Derrick Raven, who wants to challenge?”
“Class 4, Brad Allen, who wants to come up and challenge?”
“Me, Class 9’s Hank Ferguson…”
Jack didn’t rush to the stage but turned to look at the No.1 arena in the distance, where a girl in a black trench coat with her long hair tied in a ponytail was standing sideways.
While other arenas had people eager to challenge, there was no one coming up to the No.1 arena, as if it were an invisible forbidden area.
“That’s Class 1’s Jane Aiken, huh.” Jack took a deep look at the girl before turning to walk towards the No.49 arena.
At No.2 arena, the male student carrying the pillar had an amazing aura, delivering a direct blow that sent a classmate flying together with his weapon, exuding an astonishing pressure.
As he passed the No.10 arena, he saw Crystal standing on top, fighting fiercely against a male student with a pair of hand knives.
At the No.29 arena, Matt Watkins and another male student were evenly matched.
At No.34 arena, Marcus Lee, who had been defeated by Jack Clark earlier in the morning, was swinging his heavy hammer, knocking a male student off the arena after thirteen consecutive strikes, his face showing a crazed laugh.
But before he could be happy for long, he saw Jack walking over from not far away, and his face suddenly stiffened with a smile.
Fortunately, Jack just gave him a light look and, under Marcus’s somewhat nervous gaze, walked towards the rear.
“Thank goodness he didn’t come to challenge me, it scared me to death.” Marcus patted his chest.
When Jack arrived at the No.49 arena, there were already two male students fighting each other. Seeing this, he stopped and watched with a few nearby students.
Those who made it into the top 200 were all strong.
Therefore, every time the two collided, a large number of sparks burst out from their weapons under the powerful impact, and the shock waves from the collision made the air hum.
Bang!
After more than twenty moves, the less skilled male student was kicked off the Martial Arts Arena.
“Thank you.”
At the No.49 arena, a buzz-cut male student showed a triumphant smile, glanced around, and shouted, “Who else wants to come up?”
There were only 200 students in the top fifty Martial Arts Arenas, so there weren’t many people around each arena, and those who didn’t have to compete were sitting in the audience seats.
These students around the arena were watching, comparing their own strength, and thinking about which arena would be more suitable for them to challenge, as each person had only one chance.
“I’ll go up.”
Just when a student on the side was eager to have a try, Jack jumped onto the two-meters-high Martial Arts Arena, which immediately made the buzz-cut male student’s expression slightly tense.
From this seemingly handsome male student, he inexplicably felt a faint sense of oppression.The bald male student was silent for a moment before introducing himself, “Class 37, Derrick Raven.”
“Class 3, Jack Clark.”
After saying that, Jack Clark pulled out a two-meter-long straight blade from behind him. Derrick Raven didn’t dare to be careless, so he circulated the Qi Blood within his body, and a powerful aura spread out.
In the audience seats, when Jack Clark jumped onto the No.49 Martial Arts Arena, Freya Louise’s gaze shifted to this side.
At the same time, Justin Welan also looked over and asked thoughtfully: “Freya, be honest, are you two hiding something from me?”
The long-haired girl slightly pursed her lips, revealing a smile, “You’ll see.”
“…” Justin Welan was speechless.
Kill!
On the Martial Arts Arena, Derrick Raven shouted and suddenly charged forward, appearing in front of Jack Clark in the blink of an eye after covering four meters. Both of his hands gripped his knife and slashed down from above.
The snow-white blade tore through the air, emitting a sharp scream. It was like a white light falling from the sky, and the resulting wind from the knife even made Jack Clark’s face hurt from the pressure.
Clang! Sparks flew.
Jack Clark blocked Derrick Raven’s full-strength slash effortlessly with one hand holding his horizontal knife. His body didn’t even shake, completely neutralizing the impact of the slash.
This scene made Derrick Raven’s face turn pale, and the gazes of the students watching below slightly congealed.
Because this meant that Jack Clark’s strength far exceeded Derrick Raven’s.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s formidable Qi Blood exploded, and his muscles swelled in an instant. His imposing manner changed sharply, like a giant elephant that had just been awakened.
Clang!
Under an astounding burst of strength from Jack Clark’s wrist, Derrick Raven was directly forced to retreat several steps.
At that moment, Jack Clark stepped forward and slashed, producing an instantaneous sharp and raging wind that howled in Derrick Raven’s ears, causing his body hair to stand up from the intense sense of death.
Clang! Derrick Raven held his knife with both hands in front of him, and sparks flew again.
Under the wild power, Derrick Raven was directly forced to retreat several steps after Jack Clark’s overbearing slash. Before he could react, the piercing sound of raging wind howled again.
Clang, clang, clang!!
Without any extra movements, Jack Clark simply stabbed horizontally, vertically, and horizontally again with his knife. Each slash was terrifyingly fast, each containing an impact force of over a thousand kilograms.
Under such terrifying power, Derrick Raven couldn’t withstand it, even if he practiced advanced cultivation methods.
After just four slashes, Derrick Raven was knocked off the arena by Jack Clark’s overbearing strikes, his trembling arms and the sore muscles making it difficult to even grip his weapon.
“Thank you.”
On the Martial Arts Arena, Jack Clark slowly put away his straight blade, and his stunningly handsome face showed a gentle smile. It was impossible to see any traces of his previous overbearing and violent demeanor.
“I, lost.” Derrick Raven said with some bitterness.
Soon after, when Jack Clark decided not to rest, the second student jumped onto the No.49 Martial Arts Arena.
“Class 15, Zachary Lyons.”
“Class 3, Jack Clark, be prepared.”
Roar!
Accompanied by the faint roar of an angry elephant, Jack Clark looked like a furious giant elephant with his two-meter-long straight blade tearing through the air, carrying a sharp howling as he slashed horizontally.
Clang, clang, clang!!
With three consecutive slashes, Jack Clark directly knocked the freshman named Zachary Lyons off the Martial Arts Arena, creating an oppressive atmosphere.
The surroundings suddenly fell silent.
For True Martial students, First Layer Heaven was still at the Foundation Establishment stage. As a result, their matches tended to be monotonous and dull, focusing mostly on strength and speed.
Only when both parties had similar strengths would their matches involve the clash of exquisite moves and battle awareness.
With Jack Clark’s current strength, as long as his opponents hadn’t reached the First Layer Heaven Limit, he didn’t even need to use his sword skills. He simply relied on his absolute strength and speed to cut through everything effortlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 41
chapters.content:
41 Chapter 41: The Untouchable Ahead
Translator: 549690339
Under normal circumstances, the strong would naturally pursue higher rankings, so the strength of the students defending the martial arts arenas towards the end would be weaker.
However, the overwhelming pressure displayed by Jack Clark didn’t seem like a weaker opponent.
Thus, after the second challenger was defeated, the students watching the surrounding two or three martial arts arenas hesitated for a moment, with no one stepping up.
In the martial arts arena, Jack looked around and asked, “Is there no one to challenge?”
“I’m in.”
At this moment, a male student carrying a huge sword like a door panel came over. Seeing that no one was coming up to the No.49 arena, he quickly jumped up in excitement.
“Class 1, Mullen Weisz.”
“Class 3, Jack Clark.”
The two of them politely introduced themselves and their classes. Then, Mullen Weisz reminded Jack while drawing his forty-centimeter-wide and over two-meter-long huge sword from behind him.
“Brother, my cultivation method is the advanced Imperial Capital Giant Sword, which overpowers people with force. You need to be careful.”
Unexpectedly, the opponent was so straightforward that he even revealed his cultivation method. Jack hesitated for a moment and introduced his own: “…I practice the low-level martial arts Dragon Elephant Power, mainly focusing on strength. My power is quite ‘big’.”
“What…low-level martial arts?”
Mullen Weisz was stunned, then a relaxed smile appeared on his face: “Brother, although I don’t want to take advantage of you, I have to take your rank for the extra contribution reward points.”
Jack looked at him weirdly, “It’s alright, if I lose, it just means my skills are not as good.”
“Let’s begin and decide the winner.”
As Mullen Weisz pointed his sword, his entire aura suddenly changed, with an oppressive feeling spreading and a strong momentum.
Such strength… Jack squinted his eyes, his expression becoming a little more serious, because he felt that Mullen Weisz might be as strong as Marcus Lee.
Boom! Mullen Weisz stomped on the ground, causing a slight tremor under the enormous force. He then charged towards Jack with his sword in hand. With one swing, the sword came crashing down.
Clang!
When the swords collided, sparks flew in all directions, and the invisible shock wave even swept the surrounding air.
How is that possible! Seeing Jack, who blocked his sword, Mullen Weisz was taken aback. Didn’t you say you practice low-level martial arts?
Out of respect for Mullen, Jack held the sword with both hands and blocked Mullen’s attack. He then used his Furious Power to repel Mullen.
Immediately after that, he swung his sword diagonally…clang! Sparks flew.
He swung his sword again.
He slashed with both hands and turned around to attack with full force…clang, clang, clang!!
After five consecutive slashes, Mullen was pushed back to the edge of the martial arts arena, and he was completely baffled by Jack’s overwhelming power.
Just then, another slash tore through the raging wind, appearing before Mullen’s eyes. Unable to dodge it, Mullen subconsciously blocked it with his sword horizontally.
Clang! Due to the tremendous force, Mullen fell off the martial arts arena.
Jack took a deep breath, put his sword away and stood still. Looking at the slightly confused Mullen below, Jack smiled and said, “Student Weisz, it seems that the No.49 rank still belongs to me.”
“I… Jack, do you really practice low-level martial arts?” Mullen Weisz was still baffled.
Jack nodded: “Yes.”
Mullen Weisz’s face immediately revealed an expression of agony: “Damn, if I had known, I wouldn’t have challenged you. I lost a lot this time.”
Initially, he saw that the students in the front martial arts arenas were quite fierce. So, without being completely confident, he intentionally came to the back to challenge.
He thought that the students defending these martial arts arenas would be weaker and that he could win easily. After all, the rewards for the top 50 were the same, and he didn’t care about his specific rank.
Who knew that he would randomly pick a martial arts arena and encounter a freak who practiced low-level martial arts but could crush him with absolute strength?
And since each person had only one chance to challenge, he could only watch the competition from the sidelines.
Thinking of this, Mullen Weisz felt even more upset.
But there was nothing he could do. He had lost, so he could only turn and leave.
After witnessing Jack’s strength, the students at the surrounding martial arts arenas dared not step forward. After waiting for a while, a female student arrived from the front.
This female student had a similar thought to Mullen Weisz. She wanted to take advantage of the situation by challenging the arenas towards the back. Seeing that there was no one in the No.49 arena, she jumped up in excitement.Then… Jack Clark sent him flying with three strikes.
After winning four matches in a row, Jack Clark firmly secured the 49th ranking.
Phew!!
At the Number 50 Arena next door, Zac Lyons, who had just defeated a challenger, gasped for breath and admired Jack Clark from ten meters away, “Dude, you’re really awesome.”action
In contrast to all his exhausting victories, the expert on the other side was like the autumn wind sweeping away dead leaves, taking down all challengers in just a few strikes.
Jack Clark grinned modestly, “Not at all, it’s just that my luck is better than yours.”
Zac Lyons rolled his eyes, “Brother, don’t be so modest, we all saw how fierce you were just now.”
“Brother, why don’t you go to the front?” Zac Lyons was curious.
Jack Clark shook his head modestly, “The students ahead are too strong, I don’t think I’m their match, so it’s nice to be able to mix in the back ranks.”
“I don’t want to talk to you anymore.” Zac Lyons was speechless, placed his weapon down, and sat down cross-legged to recover.
As in the first round, there was a short break after each battle to recover strength.
Standing on the stage, Jack Clark looked into the distance, where the competition was still fierce. It was estimated that it would take another half an hour for the second round to end.
While waiting idly, Jack Clark silently analyzed today’s gains.
Although most of his opponents were easily dealt with, their reactions and tactics during the battle were helpful from another perspective.
On top of that, the reason he could do so easily was that his strength had improved these days, with his power attribute reaching 68 points.
His current arm strength was about 450 kilograms, which was nine times that of an ordinary person – not the six times shown on the data.
It seemed that the higher the Four Major Attributes were, the greater the growth in all aspects, rather than increasing according to normal multiples.
In the audience seats, Justin Welan was numb, looking suspiciously at Jack Clark on the Number 49 Arena, “What’s going on? How did Jack become so powerful all of a sudden?”
He knew that there were more than a hundred ordinary ‘geniuses’ in the whole school who had breakthroughs within a week. Most of them, except for a few with bad luck like him, made it into the top 200.
In this situation, Jack Clark’s overwhelming strength shown by dealing with four challengers in a row was enough to enter the top ten of the grade.
Was this still the Jack Clark he knew? The good friend who had barely managed to establish his foundation in half a month and cultivated two low-level martial art techniques?
Or was it that Jack Clark was just playing him during their sparring a few days ago?
Freya Louise smiled slightly, whispering, “It’s because of the True Martial Compatibility. He said that when he practiced Dragon Elephant Power these days, his strength doubled strangely.”
“… True Martial Compatibility, no wonder.”
Justin Welan suddenly realized, “I remember when Jack was establishing his Foundation, his compatibility with physique and strength-enhancing skills was very high. I didn’t expect that…”
As Justin Welan said this, he paused, and then his face showed a look of regret.
That’s because the Dragon Elephant Power was just a low-level martial skill with limited potential.
Even if Jack Clark could make rapid progress in the First Layer Heaven and Second Layer Heaven due to his high compatibility, the gap between him and those who practiced advanced techniques would still be huge.
This gap wasn’t just about the upper limit of martial skills, but also the amplification and burst moves.
At the First Layer Heaven, there was no True Strength, and the True Martial Arts skill only condensed the power, so the gap between the low-level martial arts and the advanced ones was not very obvious.
At this time, the low-level martial arts had an amplification of one time, while the advanced ones were about 1.5 times.
But after cultivating True Strength at Second Layer Heaven, the low-level martial arts only had a two-fold increase, while the advanced one started at three times.
Some people with high compatibility could even burst out four times or even five times the amplification.
It meant that in the early stage of Second Layer Heaven, when everyone’s basic strength was 400 kilograms, the strength-type low-level martial arts could burst out with more than 2,000 kilograms of impact.
But under the amplification of high-level martial arts True Strength, that basic strength could easily burst out with over 3,000 or even 4,000 kilograms of power.
And this was just the basic strength, not to mention the burst moves that came with advanced martial skills.
So after the Second Layer Heaven, the gap between the two sides would widen rapidly.
In addition, breaking through the Second Layer Heaven with advanced martial skills would allow faster refinement of Heavenly Energy, more refined True Strength, and other advantages…
Thinking of this, Justin Welan couldn’t help feeling regretful.
If Jack’s initial talent had been better and he had established his foundation within a week, he would have been able to cultivate an advanced martial skill, but now… sigh!

chapters.title: Chapter 42
chapters.content:
42 Chapter 42: You Can Be a Bit Arrogant
Translator: 549690339
Fifty arenas held matches at the same time, with the second round only taking an hour to finish.
Under the gazes of more than two thousand people, accompanied by the big screen being refreshed in the stadium, only fifty names remained at the top.
Jack Clark saw his name ranked at 49th and revealed a faint smile on his face.
Besides him, he also saw the names of familiar people. Crystal Leinster successfully defended the 10th place, Matt Watkins at 29th, and Marcus Lee, whom he defeated, at 34th.
It was just that Mandy Leinster, the Class Leader’s sister, was ranked at 40th.
This ranking made Jack Clark slightly apprehensive because he felt that this girl named Mandy Leinster was very strong, maybe even stronger than Marcus Lee.
On the main stage, Vernon Leinster announced, “The second round of the competition is over. Now we have the challenge matches. Those who aren’t satisfied with their ranking have one chance to challenge someone in the top ten.”
“If you win, you move forward; if you lose, your original ranking remains unchanged. Is there anyone who wants to challenge now?”
“Me, I want to challenge the 20th place.”
“I want to challenge the 10th place.”
“Me, I want to challenge the 15th place too…”action
They were all first-year freshmen, all at the First Layer Heaven. With no worries about their rear, who would be afraid of who? As a result, many of those with lower rankings chose to challenge those ahead.
Including Zac Lyons, who was ranked 50th, who chose to challenge Mandy Leinster, who was ranked 40th.
On the other hand, Jack Clark didn’t make a move, and no one challenged the top-ranked Jane Aiken.
Under everyone’s attention, the challenges quickly ended, and all those who challenged the top ten failed. In contrast, some who challenged those ranked in the 20s and 30s succeeded.
“Now I announce that the first game of the Freshman Ranking Tournament is over.”
“On the main stage, Vernon Leinster solemnly said, “All freshmen who ranked in the top 50 will be granted an extra five contribution points per month during school time, lasting until the second grade.”
“In addition, all students will receive a 20% discount when exchanging school resources.”
As soon as Vernon Leinster finished speaking, a staff member hurriedly came up to him and whispered something in his ear.
After listening, Vernon Leinster nodded slightly, then said gravely, “I have some matters to attend to with the teachers present, so everyone can disperse. Your contribution points will be credited to your Student IDs tomorrow.”
After saying this, the teachers hurriedly left.
Jack Clark carried his knife to the audience seats, where Justin Welan excitedly shouted, “Jack, you really made a big splash this time, making it into the top 50!”
Jack Clark replied with a smile, “Is it really that exaggerated? It’s just 49th place.”
Justin Welan was speechless, “Jack, you’re good at everything, but your humbleness always makes me want to hit you, seriously.”
Pff! Freya Louise couldn’t help but laugh at his words.
Justin Welan snorted, “It’s just 49th place. If you don’t want it, give it to me. I didn’t even get into the second round of the competition. I’ve had worse luck than you.”
Freya Louise came up to Jack Clark and smiled, “Actually, you can be a little more arrogant, Jack, because being in the top 50 of the freshmen is really impressive.”
Out of the nearly two thousand students in their grade, over seven to eight hundred have successfully established their Foundation. Additionally, there are over a hundred so-called ‘geniuses’ cultivating Advanced Skills.
Under such circumstances, for Jack Clark, who was practicing the low-level Dragon Elephant Power, to make it into the top 50 was quite a surprise and astonishment to all who knew him.
Including Crystal Leinster and Matt Watkins, no one thought that there would be someone in their class who could make it into the top 50, especially since that person seemed to have an average initial talent.
That’s why Freya Louise said he could be a little more arrogant because he had earned it.
Jack Clark smiled and said, “Okay, I’ll be a little more arrogant, at least until everyone breaks through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
Laughing and chatting, the three of them mingled with the crowd and left the stadium.Over two thousand people left the sports stadium in groups and went their separate ways.
Today’s competition was intense and exciting for the participants, but not many people attached great importance to it at the vast South Sky High Martial Arts Campus.
Even the school authorities only had some teachers present, with no leaders attending.
As for the senior students, most of them were not at school, and only a few of those who were at school came to watch out of interest.
For them, a First Layer Heaven competition held no attraction, and they would rather spend the time cultivating.
…
It was only three o’clock in the afternoon, and while Justin Welan and others went to practice, Jack Clark followed Freya Louise to the thirty-third floor to read.
After flipping through a bookshelf, Jack took out a book on Mutated Beast anatomy while Freya had already sat by the window with a book of Taoist Scriptures in her hands.
Jack sat down across from her and asked curiously, “Why do you always sit in this spot?”
Freya brushed a strand of hair away from her ear, revealing a pretty, fair side profile, and said with a smile, “Because the view is wide open and I can enjoy the sunshine.”
“Don’t you think reading quietly in the lazy, slanting sun in the afternoon is very poetic?” With that, the girl playfully winked at Jack.
Unexpectedly, Jack was stumped and replied, “…You talk a lot, but you have a point.”
With that, the two shared a faint smile before each lowering their heads to read, savoring the rare afternoon time.
It didn’t look like they had just experienced an intense and spectacular competition.
However, while claiming to read, Jack’s mind was mostly sinking into the Heavy Armored Beast.
The brief glory of today was not getting to his head; he was well aware that his current advantage would not last long.
If he wanted to maintain or even surpass the strength of those ‘geniuses’ in the Second Layer Heaven, he could only count on his Avatar’s further Evolution.
Beneath the surging river’s surface, the ninety-centimeter-long Heavy Armored Beast wandered around, its eyes scanning through the murky water for prey.
A school of upward curved mouth fish swam by above, varying in lengths of nearly a meter to a few tens of centimeters.
However, the Heavy Armored Beast merely glanced at them before resuming its leisurely patrol along the riverbed.
After hunting these past few days, Jack found that these common fish species were generally low in nutrients and the best nutrition came from mutated large fish species.
The same-nutrient Mutated Fish could deliver several times more high caloric energy after being consumed, greatly promoting the growth of the Heavy Armored Beast.
Suddenly, a huge shadow with astounding speed charged into the school of fish ahead, breaking the water and swallowing a one-meter-long upward curved mouth fish in its large mouth.
It was a mutated fish more than three meters long, resembling a large-mouthed catfish, covered with black scales, and its massive head made up half of its body, measuring about a meter wide.
Its mouth was filled with numerous sharp teeth, and its four one-meter-long barbels floated as it consumed more than ten upward curved mouth fish in just a few passes, showing its ferocity.
BANG!
At that moment, the riverbed mud exploded, and the previously slow-moving Heavy Armored Beast burst forth with strength on its limbs and charged towards the mutant catfish amidst the rolling mud.
Noticing the incoming Heavy Armored Beast, the huge mutated catfish did not retreat but advanced, and its huge mouth opened wide like a black hole, emitting a powerful suction force.
GULP! The mutated catfish swallowed the Heavy Armored Beast in one bite.
Compared to the over three-meter-long and one-meter-wide mutated catfish, the Heavy Armored Beast, which was less than one meter long, was just a small guy, and it was eaten…
Suddenly, the mutated catfish went crazy, rolling violently in the water, and thick blood gushed from its gills.
A black skull burst out of the mutated catfish’s head, and the blood from the three pairs of feather-horns on either side filled the black armor of the beast, making it look extremely ferocious.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 43: 43: Raging Wind and Storm
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Raging Wind and Storm
Translator: 549690339
The Heavy Armored Beast wreaked havoc in the river and returned to the cave on the riverbank to rest and digest after getting its fill.
Withdrawing his consciousness, Jack Clark looked up and saw it was already past five in the afternoon. The orange-red sunset slanted in, casting streaks of light and shadow on the ground.
“It’s this late already.” Jack exclaimed.
Since the Heavy Armored Beast was released, Jack, who was constantly using his consciousness, felt that time passed so quickly that a day was gone in the blink of an eye, and there seemed to be no time to do anything.
At this time, Freya Louise closed her book, looked at the time and whispered, “It’s about time, shall we go back together?”
“Sure.” Jack nodded.
As usual, the two put their books back in place and took the elevator out of the Teaching Building.
On the tree-shaded Pedestrian Walkway within the School, the sunset penetrated through the branches, casting scattered spots of light.
Walking side by side, Freya suddenly asked, “How do you feel after sweeping up so many cultivating ‘geniuses’ today?”
Jack thought for a while: “…Well, those people are actually pretty strong.”
Freya slightly tilted her head, “Why do you say that?”
Jack explained, “Didn’t you notice? Although I suppressed them with absolute strength during the battle, they weren’t in a panic.”
“Even when caught off guard by my sudden burst, their instinctive reactions were very standard, and they didn’t panic after a single defeat.”
“This shows that their will and temperament are very tenacious. As long as they accumulate more combat experience, they will become formidable when their strength improves.”
“You know, I didn’t even notice that.” Freya blinked.
When she thought back to Jack’s battle today, she found that it seemed similar to what he had described, as those people didn’t panic even when faced with Jack’s crushing strength.
At the same time, she also admired Jack for being so sober at this time. Chatting, the two walked out of the School and followed the street… Boom! Suddenly a thunderous sound shook their ears. The sky was still clear, with no dark clouds in sight, but raindrops as big as beans fell densely from the sky. The sudden thundershower caught everyone off guard, and the streets were filled with people running to take cover from the rain. Cars were also hard to come by in half a day.
Especially due to the raging wind, people couldn’t even open their eyes.action
Jack and Freya were also drenched, and the nearest shelter was several tens of meters away down the road.
“We can take shelter from the rain over there.” In the midst of the downpour, Jack hurriedly led Freya to run towards a small park by the roadside with a pavilion, originally a place to escape the summer heat.
By the time they ran into the pavilion, their clothes were soaked. Jack was fine; he wiped his face and shook off the water droplets from his hair.
However, Freya was a bit disheveled, her long hair wet and draped over her back, entwined with the white butterfly ribbon, revealing her clean and beautiful face.
Her trousers were also tightly wrapped around her body due to the dampness, revealing her well-proportioned and slender legs.
“Stop staring!” Freya blushed slightly, as she hid from Jack’s gaze.
Jack retracted his appreciative gaze, smiled and said, “It’s not my fault. Who told you to be so beautiful and have such a good figure.”
He didn’t show a hint of the embarrassment a youth should have on his face, and his candid demeanor made Freya feel less shy and tense.
Jack casually asked, “I wonder how long this rain will last.”
Freya was indeed distracted and looked up, thinking, “This kind of thundershower usually doesn’t last long. It might stop in half an hour.” Summer thundershowers are always like this, sudden and unpredictable. Sometimes the sky is as clear as it can be, and the next moment it’s covered in dark clouds.
Sometimes, even when the sun is shining brightly, heavy rain suddenly pours down, catching people off guard.
As Freya predicted, the rain began to lighten after about ten minutes, turning into a lighter drizzle, which lasted less than half an hour.
As the strong wind died down and the heavy rain stopped, puddles were everywhere on the streets, and leaves were scattered on the ground. Illuminated by the remaining glow of the setting sun, everything looked hauntingly beautiful after the devastation.
Looking up at the sun that hadn’t set yet, Jack shook his head helplessly, “What a weird weather.”
As he said this, he began to unbutton his clothes, startling Freya, who immediately took a few steps back and asked warily, “What are you doing, Jack!?”
Jaked replied in annoyance, “What do you think? Do you think you can walk back like this?”
At this point, Jack had already removed his shirt, revealing his strong upper body. The eight clearly visible abdominal muscles exuded a masculine aura.
For the two who practiced True Martial Arts, getting soaked didn’t matter, as they wouldn’t catch a cold.
“Stop staring and put this on to cover yourself.” This time it was Jack’s turn to say.
Freya averted her gaze, somewhat embarrassed, and put on Jack’s wet shirt.
On the way back, passers-by cast strange looks at Jack, who was walking shirtless, revealing his well-toned body.
Especially the women; the younger ones would be embarrassed, but the married women would continue to stare with scorching eyes.
When they reached the intersection where they parted ways to go home, Freya said somewhat shyly, “I’ll wash and return your shirt tomorrow.”
“Alright.” Jack nodded.
When he returned home, Glenn Clark asked about Jack not wearing a shirt and then was casually dismissed by Jack.
After dinner, Jack practiced Dragon Elephant Power and Mind’s Eye Bright Knife before taking a bath. He lay in bed, let his consciousness sink in and arrived at the Heavy Armored Beast’s side.
It was already eleven o’clock at night, and he planned to eat his fill before resting.
However, just as Jack’s consciousness controlled the Heavy Armored Beast and was about to crawl out of the cave and into the river, he suddenly heard the sound of explosions and roaring coming from the rear.
The water surface was rippling from the tremors.
The sudden change made the Heavy Armored Beast pause as it slightly poked its head out of the water.
He saw over a hundred meters away on the riverside slope, more than ten figures were chasing each other at breakneck speed. In the blink of an eye, they appeared close by.
At the same time, a few Armored Cars were following closely behind, with the high-wattage searchlights on the cars illuminating a large area in front of them like daylight.
At this moment, a man in the chase leaped up high like a Roc and slapped it out with his palm.
Boom!
In an instant, the air exploded, and the violent force, like a tangible raging wind, blew away the turf in the range of tens of meters, creating a terrifying and intimidating scene.
Facing this strike, the two people in the front had to turn around and fight back. Glowing red blood shadows appeared around them, forming two transparent blood pythons as thick as water barrels, blocking their path.
Boom! Boom!
Under the force of the Overbearing slap, the two blood pythons shattered, and the Red Impact swept across the range of more than ten meters, resulting in trembling ground and flying dust and gravel.
And because of this retaliatory slap, the figures behind swiftly surrounded the two in all directions..

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 44: 44: True Martial Arts Phantom
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: True Martial Arts Phantom
Translator: 549690339
The two people surrounded in the center were tall, covered in black robes, with an appearance that couldn’t be exposed.
Eight people were surrounding them, including middle-aged men dressed in law enforcement uniforms and South Sky Martial Height teachers such as Lori Parma.
At the same time, several armored cars stopped a hundred meters away, with laser headlights shining as bright as daylight, and soldiers aiming their sniper rifles at the two people.
At this moment, Vernon Leinster, who had stopped them with a palm strike, slowly came forward and said coldly, “You minions of the Evil God, it was bad enough that you caused trouble in Koroya, but you dared to come to Eastern Summer.”
“Speak up, who is supporting you?”
One of the black-robed men spoke hoarsely, “1 don’t understand what you’re talking about, we are here to promote the will of the great supreme god, Akunus.”
“Hmph! You won’t admit it.”
Vernon Leinster’s gaze was icy, “Do you think we can’t find out if you don’t tell us? Without anyone supporting you, how could you sneak around for so many days without being discovered?”
“Let me guess, your land route was blocked, and the air route was impossible, so you had to take the water route.”
“And, of the few groups and forces in this city related to water routes that could avoid various checkpoints…”
At this moment, the two cultists suddenly shouted frantically, “For the great Akunus!”
Boom!
In an instant, red light surged around the two people, transforming into two even larger blood python phantoms that circled around several meters. A strong, evil aura spread out.
Seeing this, Lori Parma and the others around them changed their expressions slightly and took a step back.
“Be careful, use True Power Protection on your body, and don’t let the polluted blood touch you.”
Bang, bang!!
At this moment, two soldiers holding sniper rifles on the armored cars a hundred meters away suddenly fired, and a large piece of red light exploded in front of the two cultists.
The two bullets, capable of penetrating armored cars, tore through the blood python’s bodies, creating two basin-sized holes before being stopped by an invisible force right in front of the cultists’ thighs.
“You don’t need to take action, just blockade the surroundings and prevent anyone from coming to support them.”
As Vernon Leinster spoke, an overwhelming aura burst from his body. Under the heavy pressure, a two-meter-high black Furious Ape phantom slowly formed behind him.
Boom!
Vernon Leinster’s aura suddenly increased several times, and with his will and True Power Aura spreading out, the pressure became solid, making the surrounding air seem to freeze, heavy and terrifying.
“He’s actually a Seventh Layer Heaven powerhouse and has condensed a true martial arts phantom!” The two men’s faces changed drastically. Weren’t the high-ranking powerhouses here supposed to be absent?
Roar!
In the Furious Ape phantom’s roar, Vernon Leinster leaped high into the air several meters, his whole body shining with black True Power. He swung down with a palm strike.
At the same time, the Furious Ape phantom behind Vernon Leinster also struck down with a palm, stacking the attack and condensing it into a ten-meter-wide black palm print.
Boom!
As soon as the palm print appeared, a terrifying pressure fell from the sky onto the two cultists, making the bones in their bodies crackle.
The ground around the two men within a ten-meter radius suddenly sank, forming a palm print more than ten centimeters deep, its might horrifying.
Facing this almost irresistible attack, the two cultists suddenly looked up, their faces revealing vehement fanaticism without any fear.
“Great Akunus, we are willing to offer everything we have, just to have your trace revealed in this world. Appear now, Nine-headed God.”
Accompanied by the prayer filled with eerie madness, the blood light on the two men’s bodies became more intense, and a powerful force burst from within them.Hiss hiss hiss!!!
Amid the burning blood light, hideous blood python heads emerged, transforming into a Nine-headed Blood Python howling towards the sky, all happening in the blink of an eye.
The nine thick serpent heads hissed as their entwined bodies coiled like blood pillars towards Vernon Leinster in the sky, violently colliding with the falling palm print.
Boom!
Red and black light erupted in the air, the violent power like the explosion of hundred kilograms of high explosives. The shockwave raised smoke and dust, sweeping across dozens of meters.
The terrifying explosion made the earth tremble, and the streetlamps on the nearby riverside road detonated with a bang, all shattered by the explosion’s shockwave.
Such frightening destructive power made the Heavy Armored Beast in the distant river surface tense up its entire body.
It took several minutes for the smoke and dust to calm down, revealing an eight-meter-wide crater at the center, and on the bottom of the pit were only a few broken limbs and bodies of the ‘black-robed men.’
Lori Parma and the others nullified their external True Strength, walked over with solemn expressions, and stood at the edge of the pit – “These people are crazy, they just blew themselves up.”
The middle-aged man in law enforcement uniform said in a deep voice: “That’s what makes them terrifying. Before joining the Evil God Sect, these people were just ordinary Triplex cultivators.”
“But after joining the Evil God Sect, they obtained something called god’s blood, which allowed many of them to break through to Fourth Layer Heaven or Fifth Layer Heaven, with their strength skyrocketing.”
“And once the situation turns unfavorable, these madmen will burn the god’s blood and explode, with the explosion power enough to severely injure or even kill stronger experts.”
“Because of this, many experts in the Koroya royal family have been severely injured in sneak attacks, leading to the increasingly deteriorating situation.”
Vernon Leinster walked over with a somewhat solemn expression, “It’s indeed troublesome. After they burn the so-called god’s blood, their strength almost increases by a whole level.”
“Originally, they had just the strength of entering the Sixth-level Heaven, but after the explosion, they were almost equal to one of my strikes.”
Lori Parma rolled her eyes, “Mr. Lester, stop pretending. We know that your strength is excellent after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, but they are not equal to your strike.”
The other school teachers also looked envious and annoyed, as if seeing Vernon Leinster flaunt made them uncomfortable.
“Hey, are you guys dissatisfied? If you’re not satisfied, you should break through as well.” Vernon Leinster chuckled.
Lori Parma said enviously, “We’d love to, but we’re just short of it.”
“But since you have already broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, you should be going back there, right?”
Vernon Leinster nodded, “Yeah, I’ve applied to be transferred to the frontline battlefield. I will leave after this semester.”
“It’s just that recently, the Evil God Sect has been increasingly rampant, spreading among the small allied countries in Koroya, and I don’t know how the higher-ups will handle it.”
While they were talking, an armored car from a distance drove over, and then some soldiers came down to collect the broken limbs and remnants of the two cultists, preparing to bring them back for research.
After tidying up, everyone got in their car and left, and the riverside returned to tranquility once again.
It was not until then that the water plants on the distant riverside shook slightly, and the Heavy Armored Beast head peeked out of the water surface, staring in shock at the distant crater.
Jack Clark didn’t expect high-ranking True Martial Experts to be so powerful, just being at the Seventh Layer Heaven and unleashing such terrifying destructive power with one strike.
They were much stronger than the martial arts hall experts he had seen in the videos.
He had also heard for the first time terms like true martial arts phantom, Evil God, god’s blood, etc.
It seemed that this world was more dangerous than he had imagined.
After taking a deep look at the large crater, the Heavy Armored Beast slowly disappeared under the river surface. It needed to eat a Mutated Fish to calm its nerves, as this world was too dangerous..

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 45: The Beginning of Turbulence
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: The Beginning of Turbulence
Translator: 549690339
The next day, the weather was gloomy. When Jack Clark got up, he did some exercises, had breakfast, and went out with Glenn Clark.
Looking at Jack Clark walking ahead, his figure becoming more upright and robust, faintly exuding a sense of oppression, Glenn Clark was somewhat puzzled.
“Bro, why can’t we in junior high start cultivation?”
A month ago, his brother still looked skinny. Now, in just over a month, he has become so handsome and mighty. It was enviably impressive.
Jack Clark explained, “Because your bodies have not fully developed yet, and various bodily functions are not perfect, cultivating the overbearing True Martial too early may result in some abnormal changes.”
“We still have to wait.” Glenn Clark seemed a little disappointed.
Jack Clark glanced at him and reminded, “This is the experience gained after many years of official research, it won’t be wrong.”
“When you get to high school, as long as you have the talent, you can naturally cultivate. Schools have systematic training and favored resources, which are safer than your own exploration.”
“Also, don’t trust those sophistries on the internet. Don’t practice those incomplete True Martial cultivation methods, or you might end up in trouble. Understand?”
“1 know, brother.”
Seeing that Glenn Clark had taken his words to heart, Jack Clark nodded and didn’t say anything more.
For some reason, the internet was currently full of confusing opinions, where discussions that anyone could cultivate in True Martial were prevalent.
Furthermore, there were people spreading various cultivation methods on the internet.
Although these methods were quickly filtered and removed by the authorities, some had still managed to leak out.
For example, Jack Clark had screen-captured several pieces.
He found that these were low-level martial arts with only two or three layers, and the content was incomplete. Without going through the Foundation Establishment step, it would be very difficult to cultivate successfully.
Even if some gifted genius really managed to cultivate successfully with these, without subsequent methods, they would be stuck at the First and Second Layer Heaven.
It was unclear what the people releasing these incomplete methods were thinking.
Under current Federation laws, almost everyone would have a chance to cultivate when they entered high school in the Three Great Alliance Nations.
Whether they could succeed in their cultivation or not would depend on their talent.
As for those small and medium-sized allied nations outside of the three big ones, due to local laws and some agreements formed when the Federation was established, the Federation could not interfere too much.
Therefore, while ordinary people in some countries had the opportunity to learn cultivation methods, in some small allied nations, the True Martial was controlled by the higher-ups and ordinary people had no chance to come into contact with it.
Were the purposes of those people on the internet to disrupt those small allied nations?
Lost in thought, Jack Clark arrived at school. However, he did not go to the cultural class classroom, but directly to the Cultivation Area on the third floor of Building C.
The test last Friday had come to an end. His results were not bad, he didn’t need to study anymore.
“Jack Clark is here.”
“Ah, Darren, you’re here.”
“Jack Clark, well done yesterday.”
As soon as Jack Clark walked into the third floor, some students greeted him. They were far more enthusiastic than before. Of course, this was the influence of having placed 49th.
After a day of fermentation, the basic information of everyone in the Top 50 on the school official website had been dug out.
Others were fine, the worst of them were ordinary ‘geniuses’ who established their foundation within a week, especially Jane Aiken who was in the first place, making people feel desperate.
Among these people, however, Jack Clark was the only ‘ordinary’ student who established a foundation half a month ago and practiced low-level martial arts.
Being able to break into the Top 50 in the midst of these strong figures was not the work of a weak person, so the name Jack Clark also had a certain fame among the new students.
However, it was just a little bit of fame. Compared to Jack Clark, Howard Lee, the second place, was the real sensation in South Sky Martial Heights.
It was rumored that he was capable of carrying a huge load when enrolling, possessed Innate Divine Strength, had a basic arm strength of over 600 kilograms, and increased to 900 kilograms after breaking through the First Layer Fleaven.
In addition, his cultivation method compatibility was perfect, and the basic increase of just the First Layer Heaven had reached twice as much.
With full strength, his power could reach a terrifying level of 3-4 thousand kilograms.
With such a terrifying power, using a 500 kilogram alloy steel pillar as a weapon, he would crush all peers. No one could match him at the same level.Some even say that Jane Aiken wouldn’t be a match for him.
No choice but to admit, his strength is just too absurd.
Facing the greetings from his classmates, Jack Clark politely responded to each one before finding an empty cultivation zone to start today’s practice.
At noon, Jack bumped into Justin Welan in the cafeteria.
Or rather, Justin Welan came up to him with a bright smile, saying: “Jack, have you thought about what cultivation resources you’d like to exchange for?”
“Not yet,” Jack shook his head.
The school’s cultivation resources are expensive, and they can only be exchanged with Contribution Points.
Without yesterday’s entry into the Top 50 and the additional reward, Jack’s monthly 3 Contribution Points would only be enough to exchange for some trivial things.
Justin Welan suggested, “Your compatibility with the Dragon Elephant Power method is very high. You don’t need to worry about your martial arts practice, so 1 suggest you exchange for resources that can strengthen your constitution.” “As long as your physique reaches the First Layer Heaven Limit soon, you will quickly be able to break through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“For that, 1 recommend you exchange for Level 1 Life Crystals, Dragon Blood Paste, or Cold Crystal Liquid.”
To Justin Welan, because of Jack’s high compatibility, his power bursts strongly and his main martial arts practice progresses fast. What holds him back now is his insufficient physique.
What he didn’t know was Jack’s physique had already surpassed the First Layer Heaven limit, the factor restricting his breakthrough to Second Layer Heaven was actually the progress in martial arts practice.
Regarding this misunderstanding, Jack didn’t explain, but just nodded, “Okay, I’ll check it out at the Logistics Department later.”
“Justin, how much longer before you break through?” Jack asked, somewhat curious.
“About half a month.”
Justin Welan said, “Although I was unlucky this time and didn’t make it into the Top 50,1 still have 4 Contribution Points every month.”
“Coupled with the remaining points from last month, I’ll just have enough to exchange for a Life Crystal to strengthen my constitution. I predict I’ll reach the First Layer Heaven Limit in about a week.”
“Then I’ll condense my Qi Blood for another week, and 1 should be able to break through.”
“You only need a week to cultivate True Strength.” Jack was a bit surprised.
After reaching the First Layer Heaven Limit, you need to keep circulating the martial arts method, when the Qi Blood is condensed to the extreme, True Strength is born. For those quickly progressing like Jane Aiken this takes about a week.
In comparison, those with lesser talent require half a month, a month, or even two months. It’s really stressful.
And it’s not just Second Layer Heaven, each breakthrough of each Layer Heaven is like a barrier. Many people with insufficient talents get stuck at Third Layer Heaven for a lifetime.
This is why the school divides authority grades based on initial talents.
You can’t help it. People with good talents practice faster, break through realms more easily, maximize the effects of resources of the same level, and have a lower difficulty practicing advanced martial arts techniques.
On the contrary, if a person with mediocre talent is given advanced martial arts, he or she will find it hard to practice.
Because the entry difficulty is higher, the required resources are more precious, and breaking through the realms is more difficult.
Of course, nothing is absolute. After all, there are always a few rare prodigies among such a large population in the entire world.
In response to Jack’s surprise, Justin Welan proudly said, “1 am a genius after all. Although my initial practice speed is a bit slower than theirs, 1 am pretty awesome in other aspects.”
Jack pondered for a bit and said, “Like having a weaker realm barrier.”
“Hehe… you could say that, just like how your constitution is highly compatible with strength based cultivation methods.” Justin Welan paused for a bit, and didn’t deny it.
From his perspective, Jack was also someone with talent.
“I feel that within the next week, many of the people in the Top 50 will break through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“So envious. They get an extra 5 Contribution Points each month, and a 20% discount when exchanging their resources.” Speaking to this point, Justin Welan showed an envious expression.
Jack also sighed with a nod, “Yes, with the tilt of the resources this time, many talented students who originally would need a month to breakthrough will be able to do so very quickly.”
The gap between having resources and not is huge.
For example, Justin Welan who would normally require almost a month and a half to practice can reach the First Layer Heaven Limit a week earlier by using a Life Crystal.
Faced with this situation, Jack also felt a bit of pressure..

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 46: Breakthrough, Elephant Pattern
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Breakthrough, Elephant Pattern
Translator: 549690339
After dinner, Jack Clark and Justin Welan came to the Logistics Department together.
While Justin Welan went to exchange for the Life Crystal, Jack Clark went to the self-service query machine on the side, entered his Student ID, and checked the resources that were suitable for him to exchange.
There were very few resources available for freshmen of First Layer Heaven, a total of twenty-three types divided into the categories of strengthening constitution, increasing cultivation speed, and assisting in breakthroughs in realm.
Jack Clark looked through them and found five resources that could help accelerate his Dragon Elephant Power, including the Ice Crystal Snow Lotus and the once-exchanged Tyrant Elephant Essence Blood.
However, the Tyrant Elephant Essence Blood required 20 contribution points.
With his current 8 points, including his ranking reward, he would have to wait another month to exchange it. As for the other four resources’ effects…
Just as Jack Clark was pondering, Justin Welan walked over, “All Chu, how’s it going?”
Instead of answering, Jack Clark casually asked, “You’re done exchanging?”
“Yeah, this thing. Just one of them cost me 5 contribution points. It’s such a rip-off.”
While saying that, with a painful expression, Justin Welan casually tossed a thumb-sized, multifaceted crystal-like object to Jack Clark, who hurriedly caught it.
After all, it was something worth thousands, but just as Jack Clark caught the Life Crystal, a row of transparent text only he could see appeared.
“Crystalized life energy detected. Convert to Attribute points?”
Crystalized life energy, Attribute points? Seeing the transparent text in front of him, Jack Clark was slightly stunned and subconsciously asked in his mind.
“What are Attribute Points, and what are they used for?”
Upon his inquiry, the transparent text in front of him changed.
Attribute points are a special power converted from life energy, which can enhance talents, cultivation methods, external weapons, etc.
Seeing this, Jack Clark’s eyes lit up.
From now on, the problem of weak initial talents and slow cultivation progress would no longer be his shackles.
“All Chu, what’s wrong?” Watching the suddenly frozen Jack Clark, Justin Welan was puzzled.
“Oh, nothing.”
Jack Clark came back to his senses, handed the Life Crystal back to him, and said, “I’m going to exchange for a Life Crystal too.”
“Alright, I’m going to cultivate. If you need anything, come find me.”
Justin Welan didn’t think too much about it because he had suggested Jack Clark exchange for this resource earlier.
Watching Justin Welan leave, Jack Clark approached the counter and politely said, “Teacher, I’d like to exchange for cultivation resources.”
“Enter your student ID.”
“You have 8 contribution points and a 20% discount permission. What do you want to exchange for?”
“Two Level 1 Life Crystals.”
“Wait a moment.”
Soon, two thumb-sized white crystals appeared in Jack Clark’s hands. After thanking the teacher, he turned and left.
Returning to Building C, Jack Clark applied for a private Personal Cultivation Room. Looking at the two white crystals in his hand, he chose to convert them.
Hum!
As Jack finalized the decision, an invisible power enveloped the crystals. The two Life Crystals became transparent at a visible speed and finally turned into powder with a “pop” sound.
“You have converted two crystalized life energies, one yielding 5 Attribute Points and the other yielding 3 Attribute Points.”
“Are there different amounts contained in the two crystals?” Jack Clark thought as if gaining an insight.
Strength: 71
Agility: 58
Spirit: 61
Talent: Soul Split+
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Skill!Complete] Dragon Elephant Power+[Beginner, First Layer]Mind’s Eye Bright Knife+[Sword Skill First Layer, Heart’s Eye?]
Attribute Points: 8
Avatar Body: Hexagonal Armored Beast…
As his Heavy Armored Beast grew over the past few days, Jack Clark’s four main attributes also improved. Due to practicing the Dragon Elephant Power, his physique and strength attributes were much higher than agility and spirit attributes.
Now, after obtaining attribute points, Jack Clark found both his cultivation methods and talent showed a plus sign”+” behind them, which seemed to indicate they could be strengthened.
When Jack Clark focused on the “+” next to the Dragon Elephant Power, a new prompt appeared in front of him.
“Do you want to consume 7 attribute points to raise the level of Dragon Elephant Power?”
“To enhance the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, 10 attribute points are required. Insufficient current attribute points.”
“Insufficient attribute points to enhance Strength Talent, Defense Talent, and Soul Talent…”
Jack Clark tried testing all the options marked with a plus sign”+” and found out that he had enough attribute points only to strengthen the Dragon Elephant Power.
As for why Mind’s Eye Bright Knife required 10 points, he thought it was due to his different progress in practicing this cultivation method.
As for the talent…
“Strengthen the Dragon Elephant Power.”
Accompanied by Jack Clark’s confirmation, an extremely pure and special energy appeared out of thin air inside his body. It then began to flow and rotate wildly along the route of the Dragon Elephant Power.
