As the energy continued to rotate, his muscles and bones were strengthened at an astonishing speed, while beneath his skin, a tough membrane was gradually forming…
Boom!
As the energy had rotated wildly more than 300 times around his meridians, faint elephant-skin patterns emerged on Jack Clark’s body. His Qi Blood congealed suddenly.
At that moment, an overbearing and violent force was born within his body, causing his aura to soar exponentially. He was like a giant elephant that had just awakened, exuding a strong sense of oppression.
After a long time, Jack opened his eyes slowly; a shadow of some terrifying energy flashed through them.
Clenching his fist, feeling the explosive power in his body, he exclaimed, “Did I just break through to Second Layer Heaven? That was so easy!”
Dragon Elephant Power, which would have taken him a month to break through, was successful in an instant using attribute enhancement. This insane efficiency left Jack Clark breathless.
If he had enough Life Crystals, wouldn’t that mean his cultivation speed could skyrocket like a rocket?
But… he lacked money. On top of that, since the crystals were controlled by the higher-ups, even if he had money, he couldn’t buy them outside. So, he still lacked Contribution Points…
Exhaling slowly, Jack suppressed the impatience and greed in his heart.
No need to rush; take it easy.
With strengthening from attribute points and avatar synchronously enhancing his physique, he only needed to follow his plan, in order to slowly reach the pinnacle step by step.
In this situation, being impatient might even lead to accidents.
Did he need to be in a hurry? No.
Jack Clark’s state of mind slowly returned to normal, then he took a deep breath, and the overbearing force within his body erupted. In an instant, his entire body swelled up a size.
Boom!
The ground shook, creating a raging wind as Jack appeared in front of a wall ten meters away in the blink of an eye. His right arm swelled, and elephant patterns emerged.
Roar! Accompanied by the sound of the wind and the elephant’s roar, Jack punched the tester in the corner of the Cultivation Room.
Boom!
The air exploded with an enormous boom. The terrifying power contained in Jack’s punch created a tangible wind, while the alloy tester shook violently.
Instantly, the numbers on the tester fluctuated, finally stopping at 3970 kilograms.
At this moment, Jack stepped back half a step, spun around and swept his right leg like a battle axe, with violent wind barreling towards the alloy test board.
Boom!
The entire tester shook under the terrifying force of that kick, with its numbers fluctuating wildly, finally stopping at 5650..

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - 47: The Influence of  Consciousness
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: The Influence of Consciousness
With a punching strength of over 3,900 kg, and a kicking strength of almost 5,700 kg.
Jack Clark was very satisfied with these numbers.
The Dragon Elephant True Strength of the Second Layer Heaven was more overbearing, more fierce, and increased the strength twice directly.
At the same time, the breakthrough in the realm allowed him to undergo a transformation, adding 30 points each to his physique and strength attributes, especially the strength breaking through 100.
That's almost ten times that of an ordinary person.
In addition to that, his spirit and agility attributes also increased by 20 points each, which could be described as a rapid increase in strength.
Furthermore, the elephant pattern formed in the Second Layer Heaven greatly increased his defense. He was able to withstand a solid alloy test board with his flesh and blood, and only felt a bit of pain from it.
After all, the effect of strength is mutual.
It could be said that among the low-level martial arts, Dragon Elephant Power already belongs to the strongest category, which combines both strength and defense. The only drawback is that the consumption of the burst is a bit fast.
Jack Clark felt that now when using True Strength, at most, he could only perform ten full-strength attacks before he was exhausted.
And without using the True Strength burst, maintaining a constant state of combat would be no problem for him even fighting at full strength for a day and a night.
Next, Jack Clark began to practice the matching moves of the second layer of Dragon Elephant Power, Dragon Elephant Furious Quake. Both arms swept across like an elephant's legs, and every movement came with a violent howl.
Under the burst of fierce True Strength, the entire cultivation room seemed to be buzzing.
....
Busy times always pass quickly.
It was just after four in the afternoon. With the sound of the school bell, Jack Clark finally completed today's cultivation.
Although attribute points can improve martial arts, Jack thinks that daily cultivation still cannot be neglected. After all, even tiny gains count, and it's better to make progress bit by bit.
And the enhancement brought by attribute points only eliminates part of the cultivation process; he still needs to get familiar with the techniques and strength through practice, or else he won't be able to unleash the full power.
Upon arriving at the thirty-third floor, Jack found that Freya Louise was already reading a book and still sitting by the window, although there was no sun today.
He flipped through a bookshelf and found a book about "The Relationship Between Mutant Beasts and Mythical Creatures."
As Jack took his seat opposite her, the girl on the other side slightly raised her head and revealed a faint smile at the corner of her mouth. However, she soon let out a soft "eh?" and hesitated to speak.
"Jack, has your strength improved again?"
In Freya's eyes, Jack had gained a mysterious oppressive aura that felt heavy and aggressive, as if a giant creature was sitting in front of her.
A girl's intuition?
Jack paused for a moment and nodded: "....Mm, today I exchanged some cultivation resources, and after using them, my strength has improved a little."
"Congratulations."
Freya gently smiled as she didn't give it much thought, then pointed to the bag on the table and said, "By the way, thank you for the clothes you lent me yesterday. I've already washed them."
"No need to be so polite."
Speaking of this, Jack thought of her appearance after being caught in the rain yesterday.
Jack smiled, feeling a touch of youth and vitality.
Yes, I am in the prime of my life. While being cautious in my actions as a person, when dealing with life, I can actually be a bit more willful.
For example… Jack's gaze swept across her pretty innocent face, and the corners of his mouth raised slightly.
In the midst of the subtle romantic atmosphere, Jack flipped through the book in his hand with passing interest, but his consciousness sank deeply, focusing on the Heavy Armored Beast.
Inside the cave, the meter-long Heavy Armored Beast, covered in light black armor, slowly opened its eyes, moving its limbs, and leaving deep footprints on the ground with its claws.
Although the Heavy Armored Beast was only one meter long, due to its high density, it already weighed more than 100 kg, and its body was as heavy as if it was cast from steel.
Twenty meters deep in the cold water of the river, Jack controlled his avatar to swim slowly. Occasionally, groups of fish of different sizes swam by.
The Heavy Armored Beast had no interest in these ordinary fish, its target was the mutated fish with mutations on their bodies.
After swimming for half an hour, suddenly, a ferocious mutated fish more than two meters long appeared in its field of vision.
This fish had a cone-shaped head, yellow cheeks, and was covered in palm-sized silvery scales. Its body shone with a silvery light, and its wide open mouth was full of sharp teeth.
The Heavy Armored Beast's eyes lit up and its tail whipped violently, sending the sand on the riverbed surging up as it charged forward.
Just as the Heavy Armored Beast launched its attack, the two-meter-long mutated ferocious fish also noticed it.
With its size advantage, the ferocious mutated fish didn't attempt to dodge but instead charged towards the Heavy Armored Beast at an even faster speed. It opened its huge mouth, hoping to bite off the Heavy Armored Beast's head in one bite.
Bang! Just as the mutated fish's huge mouth was about to close, the Heavy Armored Beast's claw struck its upper jaw from the side. Under the terrifying force, half of the mutated fish's head collapsed.
The mutated fish was killed instantly.
Looking at the floating corpse of the mutated fish in the water, the Heavy Armored Beast approached leisurely, hugged its back with both claws, and bit down on its head.
Under the terrifying bite force, the ferocious mutated fish's head was crushed.
Blood mixed with white spread in the water, making the black Heavy Armored Beast look extremely ferocious.
After killing the prey, it was time to eat. Jack controlled the Heavy Armored Beast to tear up the body of the mutated ferocious fish and began devouring it, taking large bites of fish meat.
As time went on, with the constant hunting and killing of mutated fish, Jack's consciousness became colder and more ruthless when transforming into the Heavy Armored Beast.
He became more decisive and proficient when hunting, feeling no discomfort when shredding and devouring prey. On the contrary, he felt a sense of pleasure and exhilaration after the brutal killing.
The Heavy Armored Beast consumed most of the bones and meat of the ferocious mutated fish, including the valuable fish glue.
After eating, the Heavy Armored Beast's speed increased at a visible rate, growing a little thicker and longer.
It then swam another ten miles deep into the river before killing another two-meter-long ordinary mutated fish. It wasn't until the Heavy Armored Beast had eaten and drunk its fill that it returned to the cave to digest.
By the window seat, Jack withdrew his consciousness and a flash of cold, violent emotion appeared in his eyes. The whole person's aura suddenly became terrifying.
But this feeling was just fleeting. As Jack closed his eyes and opened them again, his gaze had already returned to its usual warmth.
Jack pondered and thought, "This is an issue that needs some attention."
Facing Freya, who had closed her book and looked up, Jack said with curiosity, "Attention, what should I be paying attention to?"
"Nothing."
Jack gave a slight smile and changed the subject, "It's almost six o'clock, shall we head back together?"
"Okay." The girl nodded.
Jack followed Freya as they returned the books to their original place, then, carrying the bag containing his clothes, entered the elevator.
At this time, not just them, but other classmates who had been reading also left one after another.
In the elevator, as more and more classmates entered, Jack stepped back slightly, shielding Freya, who was standing in the corner, behind him. As a result, the two were standing rather close.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - 48: They are so powerful
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: They are so powerful
Translator: 549690339
In the evening, Jack Clark sat cross-legged on his bed, his mind guiding his True Strength to circulate continuously along the second layer route of Dragon Elephant Power.
He could clearly feel the transparent True Strength radiating a suction force as it circulated, forcibly refining and absorbing the free Extraordinary Energy from his body.
Unlike before, it didn’t require Spirit Power to guide it into the body, and its cultivation efficiency was several times faster than before the breakthrough.
After refining those free energies, this True Strength would grow stronger with each circulation, then return to the Dantian and start a new round.
However, unlike the internal power described in martial arts novels that travelled through the meridians with the Dantian as the starting point, the route of True Strength was extremely complex.
Not only would it move under the fascia and skin, it would also shuttle through muscles and bones, and its passage would temper and strengthen the physique throughout the body.
This was why the physique of True Martial Practitioners gradually strengthened.
The Dragon Elephant Power, the main force and defense, had a better tempering effect on the physique. After cultivating it, the explosive power of the muscles was stronger, and the skin became tougher.
Almost an hour later, Jack Clark opened his eyes.
Phew!
Jack Clark exhaled heavily, perceiving the changes after cultivation, and then murmured thoughtfully, “This progress is a bit slow.”
The First Layer Heaven is mainly meant for tempering the physique and generating True Strength. Therefore, you need to refine your physique to about five times that of an ordinary person with a limb strength of 300 kg to touch the edge of a breakthrough.
After breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven, the cultivator’s focus will be placed on strengthening True Strength until the Dantian is filled, and the tempering of the physique becomes secondary.
The physiological limit for the Second Layer Heaven is about 800kg of arm strength.
This is not the human biological limit, but the tempering effect limit of the Second Layer Heaven’s True Strength on the body.
Only by breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven can the stronger True Strength continue to temper and strengthen the body.
But as cultivators don’t need to strengthen their physique to the limit, as long as True Strength fills the Dantian, continually compressing True Strength into a mist to achieve breakthroughs.
Therefore, some extreme cultivators will pay less and less attention to strengthening the physique and focus more on the breakthrough of True Strength.
Because the higher the realm, the more terrifying the power of the True Strength that is cultivated, it could even fight by controlling the power of Heaven and Earth.
Compared to high-level cultivators, especially those at the Ninth Heavens, the increase in body strength of hundreds or thousands of kilograms is negligible.
Only those who have been stuck at a realm for several years or even decades will spend energy tempering their physique to the extreme limit of the current realm.
Because tempering and strengthening the physique during cultivation will consume some True Strength and affect the progress of cultivation.
With Lori Parma’s teachings in mind, Jack Clark estimated that if he wanted to fill his Dantian with True Strength, it might take almost half a year under normal cultivation conditions.
“Half a year, huh,” Jack sighed as he thought about it.
After two Avatar Evolution sessions, his physique had improved and his talent was no less than those ‘geniuses’ who had breakthroughs within a week by relying on resources.
Under such circumstances, it would take half a year to break through to the Third Layer Heaven. So how long would it take for those who establish their foundation in half a month, a month?
Once again, Jack felt the difficulties on the path of cultivation. It would take at least half a year for him to breakthrough from the Second Layer Heaven to Third Layer Heaven. What about from the Third Layer to the Fourth Layer?
Considering the increase in difficulty with each Layer Heaven’s breakthrough, it will take at least two years for those with less talent to break through to the Third Layer under normal cultivation…
When he thought of this, Jack couldn’t help feeling fortunate.
Luckily, he had attribute points that could directly enhance and break through the realm of the Cultivation Method.
The next afternoon, Jack, who had been cultivating his sword skill all morning, ran into Crystal Leinster and Justin Welan in the cafeteria, they were in line too.
“Jack, over here,” Justin waved at him.
When Jack came up behind him, Justin anxiously said, “Jack, have you heard?”
“You haven’t said anything yet, what am I supposed to have heard?” Jack couldn’t help but retort.
“Heh… 1 thought you knew already.”
Justin chuckled, then started gossiping, “This morning, I heard that Howard Lee, who was ranked second, and Kyle Hawk, who was ranked third, both broke through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“I heard that Howard Lee achieved the foundation in three days and had already reached the limit of the First Layer Heaven. After coming in second place this time, he directly broke through with the help of the cultivation resources.”
Jack nodded, “I know him.”
Jack had a deep impression of that formidable student who wielded heavy weapons and stood two meters tall – after all, he was the guy who fought with an iron columniWhile talking, they got their meals and took their trays to an unoccupied table.
After sitting down, Jack Clark looked at the purple-haired girl across the table and asked curiously, “Class Leader, how long do you think it will take for you to break through?”
As a genius ranked tenth in the competition, Crystal Leinster was very popular among the freshmen. She was not only beautiful, but also very strong.
Crystal Leinster thought for a moment: “I used some resources yesterday to strengthen my constitution to the First Layer Heaven Limit, next I need to nurture and consolidate my True Strength. I estimate it will take a few more days.”
“Class Leader is amazing, you are about to break through so quickly.”
While praising Crystal, Jack’s tone was very sincere, as if he had completely forgotten that he had broken through to the Second Layer Heaven yesterday.
Crystal shook her head: “There is nothing to be proud of. 1 just used some resources to break through ahead of time.”
Originally, Crystal estimated that she would be able to break through a little over a month after her Foundation Establishment. Now it was just a week ahead, so she didn’t feel anything special about it.
Moreover, not only Crystal broke through, over the course of the next week or so, many people ranked in the top fifty also broke through to the Second Layer Heaven.
Meanwhile, some rumors about Jack Clark began to circulate.
They said the reason he was able to make it into the top fifty was due to his high level of compatibility with the Dragon Elephant Power, which gave him an explosive strength exceeding the limit at the First Layer Heaven.
Even so, he only managed to scrape through to the 49th place.
Once the ‘geniuses’ who cultivated advanced skills broke through to the Second Layer Heaven, his little advantage would be crushed.
Moreover, according to the cultivation speed of low-level martial arts, even if he exchanged resources to speed up his cultivation, it would still take him at least a month to break through to the Second Layer Heaven.
By that time, not to mention the top fifty, the cultivators who practiced advanced martial arts and hadn’t made the ranking would have broken through ahead of him.
Any one of these people could suppress Jack. His rank among the top 49 in the grade would no longer be an honor, but a subject of mockery for being a title-holder without substance.
“What are your thoughts after hearing all this?”
Thursday, afternoon.
In the reading room on the thirty-third floor, Freya Louise relayed all the comments she had seen on the official website.
Jack thought for a moment and nodded, “1 don’t have any thoughts on it. They are correct, those people do indeed have a much better cultivation talent than me.”
Seeing Jack’s calm demeanor, unmoved by outside opinions, Freya Louise blinked her beautiful eyes, and asked curiously, “Aren’t you afraid that someone will challenge you after breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven?”
Although according to school rules, the ranking of the sophomores won’t change, if anyone really defeated Jack, their popularity would definitely skyrocket.
“I’m not scared.”
“Why?” Freya Louise asked, puzzled.
Jack chuckled, “Those ranked above me won’t make a move, and out of those who didn’t make the ranking, only the ones who cultivated advanced skills pose me any danger.”
“But those people can only get 5 contribution points in a month, which is even fewer than me now, and they don’t have the 20% Discount Permission, so they can’t exchange many resources.”
“By the time they break through, I will probably have broken through as well. As for who will win or lose at the same realm, it’s still up in the air.”
Jack didn’t tell anyone that he had already broken through because it defied common sense.
After all, he had only shown a mediocre level of talent before. Even if he had high compatibility with True Martial, it would be too conspicuous, so there was no need to say it.
Of course, he wasn’t planning to feign weakness to take advantage of others. He simply preferred to act low-key and didn’t feel the need to boast about it everywhere.
But if anyone provoked him, he wouldn’t hesitate to slap them down.
Seeing Jack’s serene demeanor, unruffled by external influences, Freya Louise couldn’t help but laugh.
The two of them chatted casually for a while, then each immersed themselves in the atmosphere of reading.
Of course, while Jack seemed to be reading, most of his attention was on the Heavy Armored Beast.
The menacing Unique Beast, now grown to 1.3 meters, slowly entered the river.
More than a week had passed since Jack broke through to the Second Layer Heaven, and during this time, the Heavy Armored Beast spent every day either hunting or on its way to hunt.
As the Heavy Armored Beast continued to grow, becoming increasingly powerful and menacing, Jack noticed that there were fewer and fewer mutated big fish in this stretch of the river, with him often having to swim several miles before encountering one.
As a result, just searching for prey each day was a waste of time.
Beneath the surface of the river, about ten meters deep, the Heavy Armored Beast was chewing on some fish meat, its eyes thoughtful. “It seems that once the Heavy Armored Beast evolves again, we will have to go looking for food in the sea..”

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - 49: Believers in God can have eternal life
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Believers in God can have eternal life
Translator: 549690339
The next morning, Jack Clark just walked into the school not far away when he met an acquaintance.
It was Marcus Lee, who had been defeated by him in the ranking competition. As he saw Jack coming, he excitedly said, “Jack, you’re finally here.”
“…What’s up?” Jack looked at him puzzledly.
Marcus smirked and said, “I’ve been waiting for you here today to tell you that I’ve broken through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“And then?”
Marcus was at a loss for words, “Uh… Don’t you feel any pressure?”
Jack looked at him strangely, “Why should I feel pressure? Are you going to challenge me to avenge your defeat that day?”
“Of course not, I, Marcus Lee, am not the kind of person who takes advantage of others’ weakness.”
Marcus proudly said, “Although I was careless that day, I admit my defeat wholeheartedly.”
He continued, “I’m here today to tell you that I’ve already announced on the official website that if anyone wants to challenge you after you break through to the Second Layer Heaven, they’ll have to defeat me first.”
“…What kind of development is this?” Jack was confused.
Marcus snorted, “As someone who has defeated me in the First Layer Heaven, those who want to trample you to get ahead would be trampling me too, so 1 can’t let them have their wish.”
“Besides, we’ve become friends since our fight. You don’t have to thank me for such a trivial matter.”
No, when did I say I would thank you?
Also, when did we become friends? Jack was a bit lost for a moment.
“Wait, why are you so sure that I’ll be weaker than you when I break through to the Second Layer Heaven?” Jack looked at Marcus with a strange gaze.
During this period, as the Heavy Armored Beast grew, his various attributes were improving, and his physique alone had reached 115 points, with a strength attribute of 120.
With that said, his fist strength amplified by Dragon Elephant Power had already surpassed 4,000 kilograms.
Under these circumstances, even if these ‘genius’ students like Marcus break through and their True Strength becomes more powerful, Jack still has the confidence to overpower them.
There’s no way around it, their base attributes were simply too far behind.
Marcus said it as a matter of course, “Of course, I’m a genius who has cultivated Advanced Skills. My strength has improved greatly after breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“But don’t be discouraged. When we become sophomores, we can take part in trials and have many opportunities to earn Contribution Points.”
“By then, you can try to accumulate Contribution Points and exchange them for Advanced Skills and cultivation resources. Maybe you’ll be able to catch up with me one day.”
“Keep it up, Jack. 1’11 be waiting for you up ahead.” With that, Marcus left with full confidence, not giving Jack a chance to speak.
Jack took a deep breath.
Forget it—there’s no point getting angry at his idiocy. Jack comforted himself and suppressed the urge to beat Marcus up.
“Did you hear? Half of the country of Koroya has fallen.”
“Yeah, 1 heard that many people died. Those cultivators wanted to establish the Earthly Divine Church, proclaiming that the Day of Judgment is coming and that only faith in God can grant eternal life.”
“Do you guys think there really are gods in the world?”
“What is a god? A being powerful enough to surpass a social group. We cultivators can become gods through our cultivation.”
Jack walked into the Cultivation Room, the discussion about the situation in Koroya filling the air.
It had been more than a month since the Koroya unrest, and the situation had not only failed to stabilize but had intensified.
The Federation Congress was currently discussing whether to intervene.
Under Federation rules, each member state has autonomy under the unified regulations, and only when a major event affects the Human Federation can the three major countries have an excuse to intervene.
“I hope it doesn’t affect us here,” Jack said. He had gotten used to his current life and didn’t want it to be disrupted by accidents.
“Jack, you’re here.” One of the male students greeted Jack.
Jack smiled and nodded back, “You guys come so early every day.”
A student with a few moles on his face shrugged, “We can’t help it. Our talent is a little worse than others, so we have to work hard.”
In recent times, Jack’s fame had skyrocketed, and he had become close with many classmates in his class.
Or rather, it was these classmates who had taken the initiative to get close to him.
Not for the purpose of flattering, but because he had won them face as a student with ordinary talent.
They talked for a while before starting their cultivation that day.
As usual, Jack began practicing his Sword Skill.
Among the students cultivating, Jack stood in the middle of the crowd with his sword, closed his eyes, and instantly entered a focused state.
In Jack’s void mind, he could faintly see the outlines of three people around him, sending out waves as they practiced.
Compared to the progress of Dragon Elephant Power, which improved step by step through cultivation, the Heart’s Eye, which relied on insight, was much slower in its progress.
It had been a month since he began practicing, and he could only sense the energy within a range of about ten meters.
At his current rate, Jack didn’t know how long it would take to reach the realm described in the Sword Skill introduction—where one could sense the malice in their surroundings with a thought.
Time seemed to fly by, and before he knew it, several days had passed.
It had been more than half a month since the ranking competition on the seventeenth of October.
Thanks to the stimulation of that competition, many freshmen had been encouraged to establish their Foundation, and Senior One students who practiced cultivation now make up almost half of the freshman class.
This ratio was much higher than in past years. In previous years, there were only one-third who practiced cultivation as freshmen.
Moreover, half of them would choose to give up due to the slow progress of cultivation during their sophomore or senior years, and only a tenth of them would graduate after breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven.
And that was only in recent years.
You have to know that in the era when the Foundation Establishment Method was not popularized—about ten years ago—only one in many dozens of students were able to cultivate each year.
You could say that back then, everyone who could cultivate was a genius, and they were all very strong by now.
Like the Martial Cultivation Teachers we have now.
At noon, as Jack looked at the bustling canteen, he chose a less crowded window to line up. But as soon as he lined up, Justin Welan joined him.
Justin excitedly patted Jack’s shoulder and enthusiastically said, “Jack, did you miss me after not seeing each other for a few days?”
Jack turned back and casually replied, “What do 1 need to miss you for? Introduce me to a girlfriend?”
“Are you sure you want me to introduce you to a girlfriend? Didn’t you say women would only hinder your sword drawing speed?” Justin’s eyes lit up. He knew many beautiful girls.
These days, people had been coming to him daily to inquire about Jack’s information. If Jack was willing, Justin wouldn’t mind helping him make the introduction.
“You actually took it seriously.”
Jack was speechless and changed the subject, “However, you didn’t mention it, but I haven’t seen you much lately.”
“…We’re brothers, man, good brothers. You being like this really breaks my heart.” Justin looked so aggrieved that Jack couldn’t help but shiver.
“Stop looking at me like that, or I fear I won’t be able to hold back from giving you a punch.” As he spoke, Jack took a step back.
“Alright, no more joking. Jack, I’ve finally broken through to the Second Layer Heaven.”
“Really? Congratulations, congratulations, that’s amazing.” Jack praised him sincerely.
However, Justin found it suspicious for some reason. He felt that something was off..

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - 50, Dominating the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 50:, Dominating the World
Translator: 549690339
Justin Welan was his best friend at school and had been very helpful in the early days, so Jack was genuinely happy about his breakthrough.
However, looking at a smiling Jack, Justin said somewhat speechlessly, “I was truly happy, after all, among freshmen, only about thirty have managed to reach the “Second Layer Heaven”.
“But just now, I suddenly found myself unable to share the joy.”
“Why?” Jack looked at him, puzzled.
Justin leaned in and said quietly, “Jack, when did you manage to reach the “Second Layer Heaven”?
A month ago, Justin noticed a subtle change in Jack. Jack seemed to emanate a faint oppressive aura, almost as though he had become much stronger.
At that time, he asked Jack about it, but Jack simply dismissed his query. Therefore, Justin didn’t think more of it.
But who would have guessed that in the subsequent ranking competition, Jack demonstrated absolute strength overpowering many geniuses – a sight so shocking that Justin froze at the moment.
And just now, he felt that same subtle oppressive aura from Jack. It was so familiar and… disturbing.
This time, he wouldn’t make a mistake. This guy had become stronger again, even putting pressure on him who had reached the “Second Layer Heaven”.
Seeing this, Jack no longer hid the truth and laughed: “Not long, I just made the breakthrough yesterday.”
At first, because his breakthrough was too quick, he didn’t want to publicize it.
Now, half a month has passed. As an unconventional ‘genius’, his breakthrough into the “Second Layer Heaven” could be seen as surprising, but also entirely plausible.
Upon hearing Jack’s admission, a look of ‘I knew it’ crossed Justin’s face: “I knew it, I was not mistaken.”
“How did you tell 1 have made a breakthrough, Mr. Willard?” Jack looked confused.
After the breakthrough, he had always concealed his aura using his Spirit Power. Up until now, no one realized that he was already in the “Second Layer Heaven”.
“Because I have been sensitive since I was a kid, especially to changes in aura.” Justin looked rather smug as he discussed his talent.
“…” Jack didn’t feel like talking anymore.
It was only after a great deal of effort and using enhancements to finally cultivate the Heart’s Eye Realm, which provided a keen sense of impending danger and malicious gazes.
However, this guy turned out to be naturally sensitive to changes in aura.
This ability might not be overwhelmingly powerful, but it could come as a surprise in certain situations, making it another form of unconventional talent.
While they were carrying their meal trays and looking for a table, Freya Louise, not far from them, waved them over.
Just as Jack and Justin sat down with Freya, Vera Lee, who was sitting with her, curiously asked, “What were you two talking about just now? You’ve been chatting for quite a while.”
Despite spending the last two months voraciously eating, this short-haired girl who had been somewhat cute is now visibly overweight, even as she spoke with a chicken drumstick in her mouth.
Justin nonchalantly replied, “Nothing much, we were just discussing that both Jack and I have reached the “Second Layer Heaven”.
“What, both of you have made a breakthrough! …Cough, Cough…” Vera was so startled she almost choked on her chicken leg.
Justin glanced at her, unable to hide the smugness on his face: “Of course, I’m a genius after all. The “Second Layer Heaven” isn’t a big deal, just took me about a month and a half”
But at this time, no one was paying attention to him. Vera turned to Jack, surprised, “Jack, when did you make a breakthrough, how did you manage it so quickly?”
You should know, she made the Foundation Establishment two days earlier than Jack, but she is still some way off from reaching the “Second Layer Heaven”. She doesn’t even know how long it would take for her to make the breakthrough.
“I made a breakthrough yesterday due to some fortuitous circumstances. Likely related to the Dragon Elephant Power compatibility.”
Jack explained with a smile: “In addition to the contribution reward points for the Top 50 and the 20% Discount Permission, 1 also exchanged some resources to speed up the process.”
“So that’s how it is, but you are still amazing,” Vera said, somewhat envious.
Upon hearing Jack Clark saying that he had made a breakthrough yesterday, Freya Louise, standing near by, slightly chuckled and revealed a light smile. She was not completely convinced.
With the class leader breaking through, and you guys also breaking through, all of us are still stuck at the same stage, not knowing when we can break through to Second Layer Heaven,” Vera Lee expressed with a face full of sorrow.
Create a short, fictitious …cough, I should be close too,” Freya Louise coughed and removed herself from the group that was still stuck at the ground.
“What, Freya, are you also about to breakthrough? How is that possible?” Vera Lee was taken aback again, her eyes wide in disbelief.
Freya Louise brushed her hair behind her ears and murmured, “Ever since I found the reading method to improve the compatibility, my cultivation speed has increased a lot.”
Thinking about Freya Louise’s cultivation method, which only needs to read the Taoist and Buddhist classics to improve the compatibility of cultivation skills, not only Vera Lee, but even Jack Clark himself felt a bit envious.
“So, I’m the only one most miserable. You guys are too bullying,” Vera Lee was a bit frustrated.
Justin Welan suddenly said, “Hey, Jack, since we have all broke through to Second Layer Heaven, would you be interested in a skirmish?”
“Are you sure?” Jack Clark looked at him strangely, wondering why he was seeking a beating.
Justin Welan confidently said, “I admit you are very strong, but now, we all have broken through to the Second Layer Heaven and condensed True Strength. I don’t believe you can suppress me.”
“You should know that this time it hasn’t been a simple breakthrough. After knowing that I practiced the Black Tortoise Solid Earth Skill, my brother especially sent me a bottle of Giant Beast Essence and Blood.”
“Giant Beast Essence Blood !” This time, not only Jack Clark, but even Freya Louise, and Vera Lee were all surprised.
Anything that has the name ‘Giant Beast’ is very expensive, even the ordinary Giant Beast Essence and Blood, it starts from 50 contribution points on the school exchange list.
Justin Welan chuckled and said: “It is a common giant beast named Mountain Giant Tortoise. When I broke through, I absorbed its essence blood, and all aspects of me have improved substantially.”
“Normally, the True Strength increase for breaking through to Second Layer Heaven with advanced skills is about three times, but my defense has increased by five times, isn’t it scary?”
“Aside from this, my strength has also greatly increased after absorbing the Giant Beast Essence and Blood. If I encounter that guy Marcus Lee now, I am confident that he cannot break my defense.”
Jack Clark suddenly asked, “What about Howard Lee?”
The complacent smile on Justin Welan’s face suddenly froze.
Snicker!
Freya Louise and Vera Lee couldn’t help but laugh. Especially Freya Louise, she had witnessed the scene where Justin Welan was hammered down by Howard Lee.
In the middle of the banter, the four of them finished their meal. After a short rest, they arrived at the cultivation room on the third floor.
At this time, everyone was taking a nap, so there weren’t many people. Jack Clark and Justin Welan stood more than ten meters apart, whilst the audience, Freya Louise and Vera Lee, were much further away.
Justin Welan licked his lips, excitedly saying: “Jack, I have always been your elder brother. Last time in the contest I suppressed you, and this time will be the same.”
“Today, I, Justin Welan, will rise from here and dominate the South Sky Martial Height era.”
Looking at Justin Welan, who suddenly became overly excited, Jack Clark and the others, who were far away, felt somewhat speechless.
Especially Jack Clark, he didn’t know when this guy became his elder brother. Who was older was still uncertain.
However, Jack Clark didn’t deny that he was suppressed during the last contest. But today….thinking of this, Jack Clark’s eyes gradually revealed expectation.
He was really looking forward to see the expression on Justin Welan’s face after being suppressed by him.
At the same time, he was also looking forward to the power of advanced skills after breaking through to Second Layer Heaven. It was his first time fighting with someone who was also at the Second Layer Heaven since his breakthrough.
With the cultivation of True Strength, the characteristics of each True Martial Arts will gradually be revealed.
The power explosion of the main strength will be stronger, the speed of the speed classes will be faster, let alone the defense of the golden body. At the second Layer Heaven, it can ignore ordinary swords and spears..

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - 51: Overbearing
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Overbearing
Translator: 549690339
This time, both of them used weapons. Justin Welan still carried that person-height, heavy shield with more than a dozen centimeters of sharp spikes all over it, looking like a hedgehog.
“Here it comes.”
With a low roar, a majestic and heavy aura erupted from Justin Welan, and a faint earth-colored light emerged on his skin.
Boom!
Justin Welan charged towards Jack Clark with a thunderous roar, and the ground shook slightly with each step he took. The onlookers seemed to see a gigantic turtle charging forward.
Jack Clark was instantly excited, feeling his blood boil.
Roar! Accompanied by a faint elephant roar, an explosive force burst from Jack Clark’s body, and he grabbed the blade with both hands, transforming into a blurred shadow and shot out in an instant.
At this moment, his speed exceeded forty meters per second, and he collided fiercely with the shield, the straight blade carrying terrifying power as it slashed on the shield.
Boom! The air exploded, like the sound of a giant bell.
Jack didn’t activate his True Strength for this attack, relying solely on his normal power burst.
But with the added kinetic energy from his speed, the power of that blade was at least close to three thousand kilograms. It struck the shield, sending out sparks and emanating a powerful airwave.
But Justin Welan stood like a formidable Black Tortoise Solid Earth defense, his feet steady on the ground as if rooted, not even swaying in the slightest.
Jack’s attack was perfectly deflected by Justin’s shield, forming a triangle on the ground.
Under the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth True Skill, his aura connected to the earth beneath him… the concrete floor connected them, keeping him from being moved as long as he stood still. To shake him, Jack’s burst of power would need to be at least twice his own, otherwise, he wouldn’t budge at all.
Whoosh!
Jack’s figure flashed to the side of Justin, the straight blade of his knife tearing through the air, creating an ear-piercing wind due to its incredible speed.
Boom! The furious blade was again blocked by the spiked shield, unable to shake Justin in the slightest despite the explosion of stray sparks.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Jack circled around Justin, slashing several times, but all were blocked by the rapidly spinning shield. From a distance, it looked like Jack’s blade was purposely striking the shield, strangely enough.
“I told you, I’m really strong now.”
Amidst triumphant laughter, Justin Welan charged forward with his shield, like a giant turtle flipping over, as a ferocious wave of countershock suddenly erupted.
Boom! The shield and straight blade collided fiercely, and Jack Clark managed to hold Justin back with both hands on his blade, his figure remained as steady as ever.
“How is this possible, your strength!” Justin Welan was somewhat surprised.
Jack Clark smiled and nodded, praising, “Not bad, your strength has indeed improved a lot after your breakthrough, both in defense and power burst.”
“Next, I’m going to get serious.”
With that, Jack Clark’s True Strength erupted from within, and his muscles swelled under the stimulation of True Strength, as a wild aura shot up to the sky.
At this moment, he was like an enraged giant elephant.
Boom!
With the support of True Strength, Jack Clark clasped the blade with both hands, and in an instant, the air in front of the blade’s edge began to glow red due to the friction from its speed.
Boom!
At the moment of the blade and shield meeting, a muffled thunderous roar erupted, and Justin Welan felt an overwhelming force engulf him, causing him to involuntarily retreat several steps.
Each step caused a slight vibration on the ground, as the majority of the force was channeled to it through his cultivation technique.
Boom!
Without giving Justin Welan a chance to react, Jack Clark charged forward with a step, the ground shaking and the raging wind roaring, as he once again slashed at the center of the shield. The overbearing power sent Justin back several steps once again.
Boom! Boom! Boom!jack Clark took one step and one swing, directly forcing Justin Welan to retreat with his unrivaled and furious strength. The faint earthy glow on his body surface constantly shook and grew darker.
Continuously pushed back by the terrifying strength, Justin Welan’s arms became numb, with an expression as if he had just seen a ghost.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s aura was extremely fierce. Seventeen consecutive strikes forced Justin Welan to retreat thirty meters from head to tail until he was close to the wall before stopping.
Looking at the beautiful youth standing with his sword in the center of the arena, and his black hair flying wildly, the distant Freya Louise’s eyes shone.
Vera Lee, on the other hand, opened her mouth wide in disbelief. Wasn’t it said that once everyone had their breakthrough to Second Layer Heaven, Jack Clark, who practiced low-level martial arts, would appear mediocre in strength?
Is this mediocrity? Even Justin Welan, who has absorbed the Giant Beast Essence and Blood and is stronger on all sides than an ordinary ‘genius,’ was beaten without a chance to fight back.
“Mr. Willard, do you want to continue?”
“No, let’s not fight anymore.” Justin Welan trembled as he put down his shield. As his True Strength dissipated, he felt a slight soreness all over his body.
Phew! This feels great.
Jack Clark took a long breath, feeling incredibly refreshed at this moment. This was the first time he had unleashed his full strength without restraint since his breakthrough to Second Layer Heaven.
Among his classmates, only Justin Welan, the ‘Mysterious Martial,’ could withstand such overbearing slashes from him.
In normal conditions, with the sharpness of an alloy straight blade and Jack Clark’s speed and strength, even a small car in front of him would be split in half with one swoop.
As for why he didn’t continue to slash a few more times, it was because he had run out of True Strength.
This is the drawback of low-level martial arts; the True Strength cultivated is not enough. From his initial breakthrough which lasted ten moves, to half a month later, he can now only unleash his full power seventeen times.
But looking at Justin Welan’s appearance, it seemed like he has abundant True Strength remaining after withstanding those slashes, just that he was frightened by Jack Clark’s violent aura.
Of course, this doesn’t mean that Justin Welan is stronger than him. It just shows that the various advantages of high-level martial arts are significant, including amplification and True Strength endurance.
If it were a life-and-death battle, Jack Clark would be confident in killing him within five strikes.
After all, there is no need for a frontal clash when overwhelming the opponent in both speed and strength. It would be more efficient to sneak attack and kill Justin Welan from behind while he’s retreating continuously.
Justin Welan rubbed his shoulders and said helplessly, “Jack, why is your strength so great? Wasn’t your breakthrough just two days ago?”
“It should be because of the Dragon Elephant Power. My strength has grown stronger and more overbearing as I practice this skill. Therefore, my strength has also become stronger after my breakthrough.”
Jack Clark casually found an excuse.
Justin Welan didn’t believe it, “Come on, my Black Tortoise Solid Earth Skill also focuses on defense and strength, and I have even absorbed Giant Beast Essence and Blood, but it’s not as exaggerated as yours.”
Jack Clark shook his head, “Then it should be because of my compatibility with the Dragon Elephant Power. I’m not very clear myself.”
“…” Justin Welan had nothing to say in response to this reason.
After all, the True Martial Pact is indeed a universal excuse. Haven’t the girls with average talent just flipped through a book to catch up with the practice speed of this so-called ‘genius’?
Among the freshmen, there is also a freak, which is the second place Floward Lee.
He has a perfect match with the high-level martial arts he practiced, and his strength is also exaggerated. Before breaking through the Second Layer Heaven, he was already using an iron column weighing several hundred kilograms as his weapon.
Thinking of this, Justin Welan regretted, “If I had known your strength was so abnormal, I wouldn’t have sparred with you. The repair cost for the weapons this time will be at least a few thousand.”
Both of their weapons were made of F Grade Alloy. Under Jack Clark’s seventeen full-powered strikes, his shield had already been slashed with many deep marks and was full of dents.
Even some of the sharp spikes were broken off.
Similarly, under the mutual impact, Jack Clark’s straight blade also curled inward with many notches appearing on the edge. This situation can only be alleviated when True Strength could cover the weapon later on.
Jack Clark’s eyes lit up, “Mr. Willard, are you going to repair your weapon? By the way, can you help me repair my knife too?”
“…Alright.”
Knowing Jack Clark’s financial situation, Justin Welan agreed readily, even though it seemed like he was just being suppressed moments ago..

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - 52: Entering the Sea Mouth
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Entering the Sea Mouth
Translator: 549690339
“Unfortunately, Jack Clark, your sword skill and primary cultivation method don’t complement each other.”
“Also, it seems that your sword skill is just at the beginner level, not even breaking through the first layer. Otherwise, with your power explosion and agility, your strength would be much stronger.”
At past four in the afternoon, in the thirty-third-floor reading room, Freya Louise holding a Sutra of Great Compassion, said with a bit of regret.
Dragon Elephant Power is mainly focused on strength and defense, but the low-level martial arts of Heart’s Eye Bright Knife makes it difficult for Jack to fully demonstrate his advantages, not to mention that his sword skills are just at the beginner level.
In contrast, Justin Welan, with his Black Tortoise Solid Earth Skill, which has a built-in shield defense combat method, has greatly increased his combat power after just breaking through.
Similarly, other high-level cultivation method practitioners also have their complementary battle techniques. Their strength surpasses that of ordinary people after breaking through the Second Layer Heaven.
For this issue, Jack just smiled faintly and said indifferently, “It’s okay, I’m already very satisfied with my current strength.”
“After all, there’s no such thing as a perfect situation in the world. Thinking too much won’t change the current situation, so steady cultivation is enough.”
Freya praised him, “Jack, 1 find that your mindset is very suitable for the path of cultivation.”
“Not at all, you’re not bad either. You’re silently about to break through the Second Layer Heaven.” Jack complimented her back.
“Why do 1 feel like we’re just blowing smoke at each other’s accomplishments?”
“I’m just stating the facts.” Jack responded with an innocent expression.
Freya smiled and lowered her head to read her book.
Seeing this, Jack also smiled and picked up a book to flip through casually. He seemed to enjoy this time every afternoon, whether it was habit or something else.
With a beauty by his side, both were reading without disturbing each other. This atmosphere made him feel very relaxed and comfortable.
Feeling the warmth of the sunlight from the window on his body, Jack’s consciousness suddenly sank, and a Unique Beast hidden deep in the riverbed more than thirty meters underwater opened its eyes.
Gurgle, gurgle!!
The black Heavy Armored Beast, which had grown to 1.5 meters long with the thickest part as thick as its waist, spat out a bubble and whipped its tail to stir up the mud.
With its heavy armor, erect dorsal fin, sturdy limbs, and red feather horns on both sides of its head that spread like wings, the Heavy Armored Beast now looked even more ferocious.
After eating all the Mutated Fish in the riverside surroundings within a radius of tens of miles, Jack controlled the Heavy Armored Beast to swim downstream in the river for the past two days, reaching the mouth of the sea more than a hundred kilometers away.
As the mouth of the sea approached, the width and depth of the river surface increased, and the number of fish also increased, such as…
From a distance, a ferocious Mutated Fish shot towards the Heavy Armored Beast at an astonishing speed, its fanged teeth-filled mouth viciously biting at the Heavy Armored Beast’s neck.
Under normal conditions, these ferocious Mutated Fish would use their explosive speed to tear their prey apart with the Kinetic Energy of their instant burst.
But today… the moment the fish’s mouth bit the Heavy Armored Beast’s neck and the upper and lower jaws collided with the thick scale armor, a crisp click sounded.
When the Kinetic Energy failed to tear its prey apart, the force reacted on itself, and half of the fish’s lower jaw broke under the impact.
Boom! Water splashed all around.
The Heavy Armored Beast swung its front claws, hitting the Mutated Fish’s head with a terrifying force, causing its head to collapse, shatter, and blood mixed with white substance splattering everywhere.
This was the Heavy Armored Beast’s hunting method: luring enemies to attack with its terrifying defense and killing them in an instant with a counterattack.
As for why it chooses this mode, of course, it’s because it’s too slow.
With its increasing size and stronger defense, the Heavy Armored Beast’s weight had reached an astonishing level.Even if the Heavy Armored Beast could exert a hundred times its strength, it was still affected by gravity, making its speed and agility in the water no match for these streamlined fish.
Under the surging river surface, as the Heavy Armored Beast tore and chewed its food, the thick scent of blood spread, attracting many small fish about the size of a finger.
Every time the Heavy Armored Beast chewed, some scraps of flesh and blood splattered out from between its teeth, drawing swarms of small fish.
Occasionally, a small fish would be swallowed by the Heavy Armored Beast, but it couldn’t stop their frenzy.
As the Heavy Armored Beast was finishing off, a ferocious fish that was more than two meters long, it suddenly paused and looked into the distance.
About ten meters away in the blurry river water, a huge shadow circled around, seemingly observing the Heavy Armored Beast, and emanated a faint sense of danger.
This was the first time the Heavy Armored Beast had encountered such a dangerous feeling since it had been released into the water.
The Heavy Armored Beast couldn’t help but release the fish head it was holding, its muscles tensed, and the three pairs of red feathered horns on its head opened, ready to attack.
However, seemingly feeling that the Heavy Armored Beast was not an easy opponent, the six-meter-long creature circled around for a bit before disappearing into the depths of the water.
It was not until the mutated fish disappeared that the vigilance in the Heavy Armored Beast’s eyes gradually dissipated. “1 didn’t expect such a ferocious mutated fish to be lurking so close to the mouth of the river.”
“I need to be more careful.”
As he contemplated, Jack moved his consciousness, controlling the Heavy Armored Beast to swim towards the shore a few kilometers away, preparing to dig a nest to settle down first.
Although there were some mutated fish here that gave him a sense of danger, the abundant food also met the growth needs of his Avatar, so Jack naturally wouldn’t leave.
On the way to the shore, the Heavy Armored Beast hunted another mutated sea wolf-like fish over two meters long for food.
Having eaten its fill, Jack controlled the Heavy Armored Beast to dig a new hole on the riverbank before slowly withdrawing his attention, only to find the girl opposite him watching him.
“What’s wrong? Is there something on my face?” Jack asked, touching his cheek in confusion.
Freya calmly looked away, whispering, “Nothing, it’s just getting late, and you were spacing out, so I was wondering if I should wake you up.”
“It’s almost six o’clock already. Time flies so fast.” Jack glanced at the clock on the wall and couldn’t help but sigh.
At that moment, Freya suddenly asked, “By the way, Jack, are you free this Sunday?”
Jack was puzzled, “Why, what’s up?”
Freya nodded slightly, “During cultivation this afternoon, the class leader said that the hundred acres of lotus flowers at Moon Lake are in full bloom, and he’s planning to organize a group outing on Sunday.”
“Aside from the five of us in our club, Shirley Lesser, the class leader’s sister, is also going. She asked me to see if you wanted to join.”
Faced with this question, Jack neither agreed nor disagreed but only smiled and looked at the girl opposite him, “Well, do you want me to go?”
Freya’s gaze flickered, and she casually said softly, “I think you can go take a look. We’ve all been cultivating since the beginning of the semester, and everyone’s a bit mentally exhausted.”
“We can treat this as a relaxing trip, so we can continue cultivating with a better mindset afterward. What do you think?”
Jack nodded, “You make sense.”
The girl’s eyes sparkled, “So, are you going?”
Jack nodded affirmatively, “Yes, after all, even if I don’t give face to the class leader, 1 have to give face to you, Freya.”
At this response, the girl just smirked and turned her head away, her eyes filled with laughter..

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - 53: It’s a Pity It’s Not You
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: It’s a Pity It’s Not You
Translator: 549690339
In the midst of Jack’s busy days of attending school, cultivating his avatar, and controlling his secondary character’s eating, a few days passed by in a flash.
On October 21st, Sunday, it was sunny.
At half past eight in the morning, Jack didn’t wear his school uniform today. Instead, he wore a white T-shirt, gray trousers, and white flat shoes, exuding a relaxed vibe.
Glenn, who was lying on the sofa playing with his mobile phone, asked curiously, “Bro, are you going out?”
Jack nodded, “Yeah, 1 have an appointment with friends to see lotus flowers.”
Glenn’s eyes lit up immediately and he sat up, “Guys or girls? Is Sister Freya Louise there?”
“…what kind of reaction is that?” Jack was speechless.
Glenn chuckled, “I’m just concerned about you, bro. Just tell me if you’re going with Sister Freya Louise or not.”
“She’s there.”
“Good. Have fun, bro. I’m going to a friend’s house to play later.” Glenn urged Jack to leave, making Jack shake his head.
Young but thinking a lot.
Jack waited for a few minutes at the train station before taking the bus to the meeting point.
Moon Lake, located on the east suburban of the city, was a scenic area consisting of several lakes of various sizes. Every year when the lotus flowers bloom, many people come to visit.
When Jack arrived at the entrance of the scenic area, he found that he was the last to arrive. Crystal Leinster, Justin Welan, Freya Louise, and Sawyer Levin and Vera Lee were already waiting for him.
In addition to them, there were Mandy Leinster and three other people, one male and two females, whom he had met during the ranking competition.
Jack felt embarrassed and apologized, “Sorry, the bus was delayed today.”
Class leader Sherry Lesser didn’t mind and said, “It’s fine, we just arrived. The gathering time was set at 10 o’clock. You’re not late since there are still a few minutes to spare.”
Today, Sherry Lesser wore a white short-sleeved T-shirt and tight jeans. Her waist was thin and her legs were long and straight. Her slightly curly purple hair was tied at the back of her head with a hairpin.
Coupled with her stunningly beautiful face, she looked dainty and efficient, exuding the aura of a beautiful young girl.
The others also dressed casually. For example, Justin Welan and Sawyer Levin were like Jack, wearing T-shirts, casual pants, and sneakers.
Compared to the male students, the female students’ outfits were much more attractive.
For example, Freya wore a double-layered dress today, with a transparent white outer layer and a red fitted T-shirt underneath, showing off her slim waist and full chest.
The lower part of her outfit was a pair of straight women’s capri pants, revealing her fair ankles and delicate feet clad in silver high-heeled sandals.
As usual, her hair was tied back with a butterfly ribbon. A few strands of hair hung in front of her forehead, revealing her fair and exquisite face.
She also wore a silver crystal necklace around her neck and a pair of silver butterfly earrings. Under the sunlight, she seemed to be shining.
Jack found her delicate and beautiful attire today surprisingly breathtaking.
Seeing Jack’s gaze, Freya was a little shy, averting her eyes and pretending to casually brush her hair behind her ear before turning her head slightly.
At this moment, a girl with the same stunning face as Sherry Lesser but with blue hair tips, walked over and smiled, “Student Clark, hello. I am Mandy Leinster from Class 9.”
Unlike Sherry Lesser, known for her cool temperament, decisive actions, and queen-like demeanor, Mandy’s voice was gentle, just like her attire.
She wore a blue and white striped dress, with her soft hair draped over her shoulders. Her entire being exuded a gentle and stunning aura, making people feel comfortable.
Seeing her take the initiative to greet him, Jack naturally also smiled, “Hello. It’s an honor to finally meet you — I’ve long admired Mandy.”
“Why is that?” Mandy blinked her beautiful eyes, curious.
“Because…”
Cough, cough!!
As Jack was about to say that he had heard of her reputation for a long time, Justin Welan next to him coughed twice, making Jack change his words, “Because of the relation with the class leader.””We’ve long heard that the class leader has a sister who, like her, has outstanding talent and is beautiful, and they both made it into the top 50 freshmen.”
Facing Jack Clark’s praise, Mandy Leinster smiled gently and introduced her companions: the somewhat beautiful female student was called Maria Jenkins, and the male student was Laurant Quartley.
After everyone got acquainted, class leader Sherry Lesser gave out nine tickets to the group, and they lined up to enter the scenic area.
“Wow! So many lotuses!”
As soon as they entered the scenic area, Vera Lee exclaimed in amazement, seeing countless lotus leaves spreading out on the large and small lakes up ahead, with white, red, and pink lotus flowers swaying gently.
Among the boundless sea of lotus leaves and flowers, wooden bridges connected in all directions, filled with tourists coming to enjoy the scenery.
Such beautiful scenery made everyone feel refreshed and relaxed.
“Let’s hurry and go see the pink flower sea over there.”
“I brought a camera.”
“I brought one too, let’s take lots of beautiful photos.”
Compared to the more restrained boys, even Freya Louise was excited upon seeing such scenery, and she jogged over to follow Sherry and the others.
A group of girls laughing and playing together was quite eye-catching, especially when there were a pair of tall, beautiful twins among them.
Apart from that, there was also the equally beautiful and delicate Freya Louise; so many high-quality girls together became a part of the scenery as well.
Justin Welan approached Jack Clark: “Jack, do you have any feelings of infatuation?”
“What infatuation?” Jack pretended not to understand.
“Stop pretending, Jack. Aren’t you attracted to class leader and her sister? They’re twins, and they’re both so beautiful.” At this point, Justin chuckled lasciviously, appearing somewhat lewd.
Jack was speechless: “Justin, can you not be so lewd? And do I have to be attracted to them just because they’re beautiful? Can’t I just appreciate them with an admiring gaze?”
“Also, we’re only in Senior One, and we’ve just started cultivating. Shouldn’t we focus our hearts and minds on cultivation now?”
Justin disagreed somewhat: “Jack, what’s wrong with being in Senior One? Don’t high school juniors count as men?”
Jack was somewhat interested: “Alright, they count as men. So what, are you planning to chase after the class leader and her sister?”
Justin quickly shook his head: “No, I’m not.”
“Why not?” Jack was a bit surprised.
“Because I know my own worth. The class leader and her sister are too beautiful; they’re not my type.”
“Then why did you ask me if 1 was infatuated?” Jack was speechless.
Justin reasoned: “Because I think you can pull it off, Jack. If I were as handsome as you, I would have chased after class leader’s younger sister a long time ago.”
“To be honest, ever since 1 met you on the first day of school, I’ve felt that you and the class leader make a good couple.” Justin urged: “Seriously, 1 think your chances of success in pursuing the class leader are pretty high.”
Jack was speechless: “Why do you have that feeling?”
“Because you’re so handsome that even I, a man, am a bit jealous.”
Faced with this reasoning, Jack didn’t know how to refute it for a while.
But did he really think he was that handsome? Jack was a bit doubtful; although he felt he was quite handsome every day when he looked in the mirror, he didn’t think it was that exaggerated, was it?
“Wait, if you were as handsome as me, why wouldn’t you pursue the class leader?” Jack reacted and changed the topic.
Justin looked at Jack strangely: “Isn’t that obvious? Class leader has a terrible temper; if I were you, I’d definitely choose the gentle-natured Mandy Leinster.”
“…Why is it me again?” Jack was speechless.
“Because you’re handsome.”
…Faced with this reasoning, Jack was at a loss for words for the time being..

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - 54: Huge Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Huge Changes
Translator: 549690339
After teasing and chatting, Jack Clark and Justin Welan caught up with the lively group. A crowd of ‘youngsters’ frolicked through the sea of lotus flowers.
When Crystal and the others had taken nearly all their pictures, it was already noon.
Everyone found a somewhat fancy restaurant in the scenic area to solve the lunch problem, and as for the bill, it was generously taken care of by Justin Welan.
After lunch, the afternoon was free to spend.
The summer sun was blazing, so Justin Welan together with Laurant Quartley and Sawyer Levin found a fishing spot under the shade of a lakeside pavilion. Crystal and the others girls went off somewhere else.
As for Jack Clark, he crossed the walkway over the lake to a small island in the middle. A large tree was planted in the center of the island, its shade covering more than ten meters around it.
Underneath the tree, a lawn was spread out; the lush grass and gentle breeze making it a perfect place surrounded by lotus flowers.
This spot was ideal for a nap.
However, just as Jack was about to close his eyes under the tree, another figure came and sat down next to him: it was Freya Louise.
After sitting down, she brought out a simple easel from her backpack and set it up, followed by a folding drawing board, paintbrush, and portable color palette.
Her not-so-large backpack looked like a treasure chest, surprisingly devoid of cosmetics or anything girl-related.
Curious, Jack asked, “1 didn’t expect you to have this hobby. How well can you paint?”
The young girl pursed her lips lightly and laughed, modestly responding, “It’s fine, 1 guess. It’s been my hobby since I was young.”
Feeling a touch drowsy, Jack lounged lazily and said, “Then go ahead and draw, I’ll take a nap.” He then closed his eyes and fell asleep under the gentle breeze.
The girl tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear, glanced at Jack laying on the grass, then took off her shoes, sat cross-legged, held a paintbrush in her hand, and then started looking around for inspiration.
In a somewhat blurry state, Jack did not wake up until around 2 pm.
As he opened his eyes, the girl was still sitting cross-legged beside him, completely engrossed in her painting.
The painting on the easel was in its final stages, featuring vivid green lotus leaves and white and pink lotus flowers in full bloom, giving off an authentic feel.
Even an outsider like Jack found Freya Louise’s painting pleasing.
After looking at it for a while, Jack closed his eyes again. This time, however, he wasn’t sleeping but was sinking his consciousness into his Heavy Armored Beast Avatar.
On the chaotic stone-banked riverbank, a 1.7-meter-long, crocodile-looking creature, even more ferocious than a real crocodile, was slowly moving from a burrow under water.
With continuous growth and slaughter, the dark Unique Beast gradually became more dominant and fierce, gradually accruing an aura of ferocity and tyranny.
Under Jack’s control, the Heavy Armored Beast began its hunt of the day…
“Jack… Jack…”
While Jack was wreaking havoc on the rivers as the Mutated Beast, he vaguely heard someone calling his name and reopened his eyes.
Seeing him awake, Freya Louise waved her phone: “The Class Leader is calling for a gathering.”
“What time is it?” Jack was still a bit groggy.
“Four thirty.”
“That soon.” Jack sat up and was handed a painting.
The young girl’s mouth curled into a light laugh: “I’m giving you this painting as a memento of today’s outing.”
“…Thank you.” Jack took a brief pause and then accepted it. Looking at it in his hand, he realized he had mistaken it for the initial lotus painting that Freya had been working on.
On the A3 paper, there were blue skies, white clouds, and a small island in a lotus-covered lake.
Under the shade of a tree on the island, a youth was taking a leisurely nap, with a girl seated close by, capturing the beautiful lakeside view on her easel.
In the painting, whether it was the lotus leaves, the island, or even the figure of the boy was clearly visible, as if they were all real and jumping off the page. J ack Clark exclaimed, “What impressive drawing skills.”
The girl who was packing up turned her head to look at him, a smile in the corners of her eyes. She then folded the easel and put it in the bag, carefully stowing away the color palette as well.
After about ten minutes, the two of them gathered with a crowd of cheerful youths at the entrance of the scenic area, concluding the day’s visit.
Monday.
Jack was about to go to his cultural class as usual, but the moment he walked into the classroom, he sensed something was amiss.
The classmates were whispering to each other, discussing something quietly.
Jack sat down at his seat, then tapped the shoulder of Justin Welan who was in front of him. He curiously asked, “Mr. Willard, what happened?”
Justin turned around and asked surprisingly, “Jack, don’t you know?”
“Know what?” Jack was confused.
Justin lowered his voice, “The news last night, the official report states that Koroya has been occupied. The local cultivators have overpowered the present rulers.”
“Also, the cultivators revealed their affiliation with the Evil God Sect. They claim they want to establish an earthly divine nation for some God named Akunus.”
“Currently, the Federation is discussing a proposal to send military troops to crush these Evil God Sect Cultists. The military expedition is likely to take off by the end of the month.”
“Um… these big events don’t seem to have anything to do with us, do they?” Jack felt puzzled.
He hadn’t heard about all this, partly because he was not in the habit of watching news, but majorly because he spent his time on cultivation and transforming into a Unique Beast for hunting after returning home the day before.
“It doesn’t.”
Justin nodded and said, “But given the pressing international situation, shouldn’t we respond correspondingly too? After all, we are the future buds of the Federation.”
J…, Jack was speechless.
Initially, Jack thought all this was too distantly related for the students to worry about.
However, within a couple of days, as the Federation passed the proposal to send troops to Koroya, rumors started surfacing in the school.
It was stated that the authorities of the school were studying whether to send some freshers along with the Federation’s troops to Koroya for late-period practice.
Jack didn’t pay attention to those rumors. As always, he only focussed on attending school, cultivation, controlling the Heavy Armored Beast’s feeding, and was steadily increasing his strength every day.
October 31st.
In the Personal Cultivation Room, Jack’s muscles were slightly swollen, he seemed to have conspicuous Elephant lines on his body. Frightful oppressive breath emanated from him, making him appear like an enraged elephant.
Suddenly, Jack sped up causing a raging wind to blow as he rushed in front of the Tester. His punch sped out with the force of a cannonball.
Bang!
Under the fierce power released, the air was directly blasted. The strength tester set in the wall vibrated so violently that the numbers on it began to climb crazily.
Finally, it stopped at a terrifying number – 7000 kilograms.
It had been almost a month since he had broken through into the Second Layer Heaven. Although the Dragon Elephant Power was slow in advancing, the Avatar was continuously evolving and growing.
At this point, Jack’s physique attribute had reached more than 130 points, and his strength attribute had even crossed over to 140. This was equivalent to being fourteen times that of an average person.
With his terrifying physique, his basic arm strength alone could reach an astonishing 1200 kilograms, far exceeding the Second Layer Heaven’s limit of 800 kilograms.
With the enhancements of True Strength and the impact carried by the Burst of speed, his Full-Force Strike could cause a dreadful force of seven tons.
In such a situation, even if a huge elephant were in front of him, its skull would be smashed by a single punch, its body overturned. Jack seemed like a humanoid beast.
Whoosh!
Jack exhaled, slowly suppressing the bubbling Qi Blood inside his body. Seeing the data on the tester, he broke into a smile..

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - 55: We are all ordinary people
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: We are all ordinary people
Translator: 549690339
November 1st, the day when the monthly contribution points are deposited.
Jack Clark has been looking forward to this day for a long time.
Because with the contribution points, he can exchange them for a Life Crystal, and with a Life Crystal, he can convert attribute points to enhance his Cultivation Method progress.
Helplessly, Jack Clark has realized that his innate talent for comprehension Cultivation Methods is truly ordinary.
His Dragon Elephant Power is steadily improving after reaching the Second Layer Heaven, but his Mind’s Eye Bright Knife has been stuck at the beginner’s level. Despite cultivating for such a long time, he still hasn’t fully entered the Heart’s Eye Realm.
This is even with a fixed proficiency from the attribute page.
This made him question whether he lacked talent in that aspect or was it because his soul was split, which rendered his spiritual comprehension poor?
However, regardless of the reason, nothing could stop him from breaking through the Sword Skill realm today by forcefully strengthening his attributes.
Just as Jack Clark arrived at school, he received a message calling all Second Layer Heaven freshmen for a gathering.
In the Teaching Building conference room, Jack Clark found many familiar faces which included all of those on the top 50 of the new student ranking, including the first rank holder, Jane Aiken.
In the month following the ranking competition, almost all the listed people have made their breakthrough to the Second Layer Heaven.
Apart from them, there were also some ‘geniuses’ who were only a hair’s breadth away from the listed people and also managed to breakthrough in the last half of the month, including Justin Welan and Freya Louise.
The conference room was huge, with seventy-plus students occupying only a small portion of it. Jack Clark took a seat within Class 3’s circle.
Jack Clark looked at Freya Louise by his side and asked quizzically, “Why have we been called suddenly? What happened?”
The girl whispered, “It should be related to the Koroya situation.”
Jack Clark nodded thoughtfully, thinking about the rumors that had been circulating in the school these past few days.
Before long, a few teachers walked in. Leading them was a middle-aged man wearing glasses. Following behind him were the head of Class 1, Vernon Leinster, and Lori Parma.
After the bespectacled teacher sat down, he cast his gaze around the conference room and nodded satisfactorily, saying, “Very good, so many freshmen have broken through to Second Layer Heaven in the first semester of this year.”
Then he introduced himself, “Hello everyone, I am Laurant Hawk, the Dean of Martial Height. I’ve been away from school for a while, so this is my first time meeting everyone.”
“This gathering is related to the situation in Koroya.”
“Currently, the higher-ups have notified all first-rate Universities in our country to organize an expedition of new students to gain experience. The minimum requirement is the Second Layer Heaven.”
“After deliberation, our school has decided to respond to this call and organize a batch of new students to participate.”
Just then, Jane Aiken in the first row raised her hand. Laurant Hawk paused, gave a slight nod to this number one freshman genius since he remembered her.
“This classmate, please go ahead if you have any questions.”
The girl stood up and asked doubtfully, “Teacher, I’ve also been following the Koroya situation. There are strong men there who can ignore even heavy artillery, high-ranking powerhouses who are at the Seventh Layer Heaven.” “What role can we, the Second Layer Heaven freshmen, play in the face of such high-level cultivators?”
She’d put it subtly, without saying that it was akin to courting death.
Addressing this question, Laurant Hawk gave a slight smile, “You don’t need to worry about this problem. There are others to deal with those high-ranking powerhouses. Your targets are those ordinary cultists.”
“Although Koroya is currently in chaos, it poses no threat to our vast Federation, and powerhouses will shortly step in.”
“Once the rebels and the powerhouses of the Evil God Sect are suppressed, the remaining work will be carried out jointly by the students from Universities and the deployed military.”
“Currently, in the entire Koroya region, the Evil God Sect has cultivated a lot of low-level cultists. These people are weak and spread doomsday ideologies everywhere. They need to be cleared.”
“Of course, this weakness is from our perspective.”
“Most of these cultists possess the strength of the First and Second Layer Heaven, and if allowed to cause chaos, they will still create some disorder in society. These cultists, who are weak from our perspective, will still create some disorder in society, thus there is a need for a batch of elite support.”
“However, it would be a waste to send Senior Students there since those are just First and Second Layer Heaven cultists. They have their own matters, and that’s why we have considered you.”
“Besides this, there’s a probability that you might encounter hidden core members of the Evil God Sect after they scatter. Therefore, there’s a certain danger in this trial, and it isn’t compulsory.””Everyone will have three days to consider, and we expect to set off in a week.”
“Moreover, the target of this trial is not mutant beasts, but those cultists of the Evil God Sect. Students who choose to participate should be prepared to kill.”
“For now, killing a First Layer Heaven cultist merits 1 contribution point, a Second Layer Heaven ones earns 3 points, and a Third Layer Heaven one awards 10 points. The higher the rank, the more points you receive.”
As soon as Laurant Hawk finished, the burly Howard Lee voiced out his doubts, “Teacher, why does it earn only 3 points to kill a Second Layer Heaven cultist? Isn’t that a bit low?”
Not just him, other interested students also had this confusion.
After all, the resources they used to cultivate to the Second Layer Heaven far exceed ten points. Killing one of those cultists earned only three points, isn’t that too cheap?
However, many didn’t care about the fact that this involved killing. Cultivation isn’t for fun; life and death fights are the norm.
Laurant Hawk shook his head slightly, “For those of you who are Second Layer Cultivators who have gone through Orthodox teachings, the cultists of the same level are no match.”
“Their strength comes from the secret skill of the Evil God Sect which is feeble and has no supportive skills. Calling them Second Layer Heaven is already complimenting them.”
“Of course, this is under the situation of direct confrontation.”
