“Some cultists are cunning and deceitful, their experience in life and death battles are richer than yours. It is best to not underestimate the situation when facing them.”
Next, Laurant Hawk answered some other students’ questions before announcing the end of the meeting.
As Class 3 walked out of the conference building, Justin Welan asked, “Jack, will you participate?”
Jack Clark came back to his senses and pointedly asked, “What about you guys?”
Freya Louise shook her head slightly, “I’m not sure. Entering the trial as a first-year student and facing a certain level of danger, 1 need to discuss this with my family.”
Justin Welan scratched his head, “1 also need to ask at home.”
Crystal Leinster: “Me too.”
Matt Watkins gave a small, confident smile, “I’ll go. And, I suggest that all those who can should go.”
Matt’s words caused everyone to pause and look at him.
“Remember, at South Sky Martial Height, we are among the top 50 talents. But have any of you thought about how many first-class universities there are across the country?”
“When we broaden our gaze to Eastern Summer, or even the entire Federation, how many fresh cultivators can reach the Foundation Establishment within a week? Thousands, or tens of thousands?”
The weight of Matt’s words made everyone instinctively feel an oncoming wave of pressure.
Yes, at South Sky Martial Height, there are more than a hundred ‘geniuses’ who can reach Foundation Establishment in a week. However, Eastern Summer has dozens of first-class universities, equivalent to thousands of people.
If you also count the new students from the lower-ranked schools, the number skyrockets. This is the number for one semester of this year.
As the fundamental cultivation methods are being popularised and resources are favoured, the number of cultivators has exploded in recent years.
Matt casually remarks, “In South Sky Martial Height, there is truly only one, or maybe one and a half geniuses.”
Although he didn’t disclose their names, everyone knew who he was referring to.
Jane Aiken and Howard Lee with his Innate Divine Strength.
“Under such circumstances, if you don’t want to remain obscure, you must seize every opportunity to improve, surpass yourself, and surpass everything.” “After participating in this trial, you can not only get a lot of resources, but also further stimulate your potential under the pressure of life and death battles.” “By then, you will be able to convert the resources you gain into your cultivation strength. Your rate of improvement will be several times higher than it is now.”
“Once we return from the trials, our strength will be much greater than that of non-participating students. We may even leave them far behind.”
“This is why most cultivators in the second and third grades are not at school. They are all honing their skills outside, pushing their limits to the extreme.”
“Of course, there are risks with rewards, so everyone should consider it
carefully..”

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - 56: Intuition of the Mind
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Intuition of the Mind
Matt Watkins’ words shook everyone’s hearts. In the past, they had never paid attention to this point, always basking in the glory of being ‘geniuses/
But their natural endowments were only average in the entire country, let alone in the larger Federation.
On the way to the Logistics Department, Jack Clark also pondered this issue.
Should he go? Or not go?
Under normal conditions, with the synchronous strengthening of a Heavy Armored Beast Avatar, he only needed to survive for another year or two. Then his strength would naturally surpass that of his peers with genius talents.
Right, it was estimated that he would need to endure for more than a year to surpass a genius like Jane Aiken.
After the second evolution, the Heavy Armored Beast s evolution points increased rapidly due to abundant food, but at the same time, more energy was needed for its body to grow.
Thus, it would take about two months for the beast to reach the requirements for the third evolution, with an increase of 5 points every day.
What about the fourth evolution? Half a year?
As his physique strengthened, those geniuses also progressed at an alarming rate. After reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven or Fifth Layer Heaven, having pure power and speed might not necessarily make them a match for True Martial Experts.
After all, those who reached the Sixth-level Heaven or above could resist heavy weapons. And after reaching the Seventh-level Heaven, the power of their True Strength would be even more terrifying.
In this case, his physical body must be strong enough to withstand missiles to be on par with high-ranking powerhouses.
But if he chose to take the trial, he would face certain dangers, and at the same time, the rewards would be great.
Killing those cultists could earn a lot of Contribution Points, which could then be exchanged for Life Crystals. By then, his strength would soar like a rocket.
Moreover, his actual combat strength had already reached the Third Layer Heaven, and his survival rate was higher than that of all his classmates. If he was careful, he should be fine.
After all, this was a freshman trial, not meant to kill them. The school and the official authorities would do their best to keep the risks within their bearable range.
After analyzing the pros and cons of going and not going, Jack Clark temporarily made no decision, planning to wait a few days to see what would happen.
“Teacher, I want to exchange for two Level 1 Life Crystals.”
“Enter your Student ID.”
“Verification passed, you have 8 Contribution Points this month and are eligible for 20% off exchange privileges. Do you confirm that you want to exchange all of them for Life Crystals?”
“Confirmed.”
After waiting for a while, Jack Clark walked out of the Logistics Department with two Life Crystals. On the way, he transformed them into attribute points and was lucky enough to get 9 points.
“To strengthen the Dragon Elephant Power to the third layer, 20 attribute points are required. Currently, there are not enough attribute points to strengthen.”
Personal Cultivation Room, Jack Clark paused upon seeing the words floating in front of him: “As expected, it takes more attribute points to break through the third layer of Dragon Elephant Power.”
He wasn’t surprised by this result.
After a moment of contemplation, Jack chose to strengthen his Sword Skill.
“Consume attribute points to strengthen the Mind s Eye Bright Knife.”
As Jack’s voice fell, the 10 attribute points on the page disappeared in an instant. At the same time, a stream of special energy emerged in his mind. Bang!
Jack’s consciousness roared, his perception spread throughout the entire Cultivation Room as if it exploded, and he sensed the outside world from another angle as if his soul had left his body.
At the same time, information about Sword Skills crazily poured into his mind, and his body underwent subtle changes.
His arms became stronger, his palms rougher as if he had practiced with a sword for several years. A sharp aura gradually emitted from him.
After an unknown period of time, Jack opened his eyes with sharp gazes, seeing faint blade lights circulating within them.
“What a strange feeling from this enhancement.”
With a thoughtful look. Jack raised his palm like a knife and waved it. Instantly, an invisible sharpness protruded between his fingers, and the air made a faint tearing sound.
Unlike breaking through the Dragon Elephant Power, rhe breakthrough in Sword Skills made Jack feel as if he had forcibly compressed and absorbed the experiences of practicing the sword for several years.
Now, he was like an old swordsman who had used a sword for many years. Not only was he instinctively adept with his Sword Skills, but his body also had memories of practice.
The biggest harvest from this breakthrough was that he had completely entered the realms of Heart’s Eye Perception.
Even if he closed his eyes at this moment when he was in the Personal Cultivation Room, he could still sense the situation inside and even outside.This perception was not from released spirit power but a mysterious induction similar to the sixth sense, where one seemingly gained an extra pair of Heart s Eye to perceive danger and killing intent.
After quietly feeling the changes brought about by this breakthrough, Jack Clark called up his attribute page with a thought.
In the following days, Jack focused on the international situation.
Right after the Federation conference passed the motion, a group of Federation cultivators brazenly parachuted in and carried out beheading operations against rhe rebels and Evil God Sect in rhe major cities of Koroya.
This surprise attack killed most of the high-level strongmen of the rebels and Evil God Sect on the spot.
Meanwhile, during the beheading operation, elite Federation troops also entered the major cities of Koroya on a large scale via airdrop.
With the help of the air force and navy’s firepower, a total of tens of thousands of fighter and bomber runs were carried out in just two days, talcing control of all the main cities.
In addition, the already gathered army and armored troops through sea and air transport around Koroya launched an attack at the same time, encircling and annihilating the remaining rebels.
Facing such overwhelming power, the entire Koroya territory was captured in just three days.
Obviously, before the Federal Assembly was convened, the Federation had already begun assembling troops in preparation for suppressing the insurgents, and the conference was merely a formality.
Hence, the danger of this trial might be even lower than anticipated.
At the same time, this battle also indirectly displayed the terrifying power of the Human Federation, crushing the power of a small allied nation as effortlessly as swatting a fly.
“Mom, the school is organizing an outing for trials, and I might have to go on a long trip next week,” Jack said to Doris Raven during dinner.
After breaking through to the Heart s Eye Realm and possessing a wide range of keen intuition for perceiving danger, he finally decided to participate in the trial after weighing the pros and cons.
As a cultivator, if he didn’t have rhe courage to participate in such a low-level trial under the protection of the school and the Federation, how could he even face the ferocious mutated beasts?
And although he could choose not to participate this time, rhe Mutated Beast Trial, a must for sophomores, would come next?
His character was steady and low-key, not timid.
When other Second Layer Heaven classmates dared to participate in the trials, he, whose strength was comparable to Third Layer Heaven, felt embarrassed for being too cautious.
Everyone was in the same boat, so there was nothing to be afraid of.
Of course, what made him determined was the power displayed by the Federation, which quelled the entire Koroya territory in just three days and killed most of the high-ranking insurgents and Evil God Sect experts.
The remaining ones were chased by the Federation’s powerhouses, with no way to escape to the heavens or the earth.
Doris Raven was startled and then asked with concern, “Trials? Is it dangerous? How long will it take?”
Jack shook his head, “There’s no real danger. We’re just freshmen, and the difficulty of rhe trials arranged by the school won’t be too high, unlike the Mutated Beast Trials we ll face as sophomores.”
“However, the place we’re going to this time is quite far, and it might rake a month or two.”
Doris nodded, “As long as there’s no danger, but it’s going to take quite a while.”
Looking at the sunny youth in front of her, Doris suddenly realized that since high school, her son’s changes had been getting bigger, and now he was going to go out on his own.
This was his first time being away from home for so long.
“Bro, is everyone in your grade going to this trial?” Glenn Clark asked curiously.
Jack shook his head, “Only the top 100 in the grade qualify. Oh, by the way, the school held a freshman ranking competition before, and I ranked 49th.”
Saying this, Jack remembered that he hadn’t mentioned this to his family before.
“Bro, you’re amazing,” Glenn exclaimed in excitement and admiration, “1 heard that this term of South Sky Martial Height has many geniuses, and you still managed to make it to the top 49. You’re truly my brother.”
“Uh… how did you know that this term at South Sky Martial Height had so many geniuses?” Jack asked, somewhat puzzled.
“Hehe… my classmate told me. He also said that there’s a girl named Jane Aiken in your school who’s dominating the whole grade and is just amazing.”
Jack was speechless, “…Where did you pick up these adjectives?”
Glenn’s excitement aside, Doris Raven’s eyes grew warmer and prouder when she learned of her son’s excellent performance in school..

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - 57: Darren Callum, Battle Armor
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Darren Callum, Battle Armor
Translator: 549690339
After dinner, leaving Glenn Clark to do the chores like washing the dishes, Jack Clark went upstairs to cultivate.
He practiced Dragon Elephant Power as usual, then sank his consciousness and focused on his Avatar.
In the pitch-black cave, the ferocious black Unique Beast opened its eyes and started moving its increasingly heavy body, leaving deep claw marks with every step.
Soon, the cave entrance underwater wavered as a dark shadow vaguely appeared in the river.
Bang! Under the deep water, water splashed as the Heavy Armored Beast tightly bit the neck of a mutated fish four meters long, its body covered in thick scales, and its dorsal fin like a spiky forest.
No matter how fiercely the mutated fish struggled, it could not escape the Heavy Armored Beast’s mouth, being held down firmly at the riverbed with its astonishing power.
Although the Heavy Armored Beast was half the size of that mutated fish, its weight far exceeded the mutated fish. With the talent to unleash a hundred-fold power, it completely crushed the fish in all aspects.
Finally, with a click, the mutated fish’s spine was bitten off, and the strong smell of blood spread along the river, making the black Unique Beast appear even more ferocious.
As the Heavy Armored Beast began to tear the fish meat and eat, Jack Clark was slightly distracted, weighing which genes to fuse in the Heavy Armored Beast next time.
An electric eel that could generate its electricity or focus on enhancing agility and speed?
As Jack considered, he gradually leaned towards prioritizing speed.
At the moment, the Heavy Armored Beast already possessed the talents of defense and strength, almost instantly killing all mutated creatures of the same size.
However, as its body grew larger, it exposed some weaknesses.
For example, its increasingly heavy body is affected by external gravity, making it slower and slower.
This was not a problem in the water; its speed was only slightly worse than that of the fishes. But on land, its deep footprints slowed it down further…
November 5th, in the morning.
“Teacher, I’d like to sign up for the trial.”
Upon arriving at the school, Jack Clark immediately signed up with Lori Parma.
Seeing the youth standing before him, Lori Parma had a deep impression of him because Jack Clark was the only freshman who broke into the top fifty of the grade with low-level martial arts.
Moreover, more than half a month after the ranking competition, he had already broken through the Second Layer Heaven.
This scenario could only indicate that his true martial arts talent far surpassed many so-called ‘geniuses’.
Unfortunately, the rule determining the access privileges based on initial cultivation talent came from higher-ups. Otherwise, with Jack Clark’s talent and the cultivation of advanced skill, his strength would have been even stronger.
In a reflective mood, Lori Parma spoke solemnly, “Are you sure you want to participate in the trial?”
Jack nodded, “Yes.”
“Alright, sign this agreement. It contains information about the risks of this trial, precautions, and some benefits offered by the school,” said Lori Parma, handing Jack Clark a document.
Jack took the document, sat down, and began to read it carefully.
The first page detailed the possible risks they might encounter, such as handguns, submachine guns, grenades, bombs, and even covert sniper attacks. Apart from the risk information, there was also a waiver for weapons and legal restrictions. All students participating in the trial could carry weapons, and officials would give a set of special full-body armor.
This equipment was similar to bulletproof vests, covering the entire body, with the inner layer made of special steel mixed with a flexible material and lightweight alloy on the outer layer to create a thin battle armor.
The weakest parts of the armor, like the joints, could block handgun bullets, while the front could resist rifle bullets. It is also resistant to puncturing.
Even if the bullet penetrated the surface alloy, it would be stopped by the flexible steel wires on the inner layer, penetrating at most into the muscles without causing piercing damage.
The strongest part of this armor was its helmet. Made of a thicker alloy, the helmet could withstand even sniper bullets, but couldn’t resist armor-piercing bullets.
Thus, it was only suitable for facing light firepower; one should still avoid heavy firepower like rockets and anti-equipment sniper rifles.
While the entire armor weighed about thirty kilograms, it was made specifically for cultivators, as ordinary people would have difficulty moving in it.
As for the lifting of legal restrictions on killing, as long as it involved rebels or cultists wielding weapons posing a threat, it was permissible to kill on the spot.
Simply put, it was a license for violence. Seeing this, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be taken aback.
With the speed, power, and explosion of a Second Layer Cultivator, combined with the full-body armor that ignores ordinary firearms, a charge into the ranks of ordinary rebels would be overwhelming.
However, those who kill will eventually be killed.
The contract also included a life-and-death statement, stating that if a participating student died in battle, the school would provide some compensation but not assume responsibility.
After carefully reading all the terms, Jack Clark signed his name.
Lori Parma took the signed contract and reminded, “Cultivate well in the meantime. We’ll gather at the school on Sunday morning, and a special plane will take us to Koroya.”
“We? Are you going too, teacher?”
Lori nodded: “Yes, I am one of the teachers leading the team this time, and I will be responsible for dealing with the possible experts from the other side.” Hearing this, Jack hesitated for a moment, but couldn’t help but ask curiously: “Teacher, can I ask how many realms you have reached?”
“Why, are you curious?”
“A little.”
Lori smiled: “I don’t mind telling you. My realm is at the peak of Sixth-level Heaven, but I’ve been stuck there for years.”
“You haven’t broken through for years.” Jack was stunned.
Lori snorted: “Do you think breaking through realms is as simple as drinking water? You should know that many people are stuck in the Fourth Layer Heaven or Fifth Layer Heaven for their entire lives.”
Speaking of this, Lori got emotional: “Your generation is lucky. So many of you have broken through to Second Layer Heaven in Senior One.”
“If it was more than ten years ago, even in their twenties, those who could break through to the Second Layer Heaven were considered geniuses.”
Jack was taken aback: “That’s extreme.”
Lori speechless: “Of course, back then there was no Foundation Establishment method, schools didn’t have a lot of resources, and there weren’t even a tenth of the people who could directly cultivate True Martial and enter the door.” “Moreover, even if they successfully entered, their progress was extremely slow. Those who broke through one realm per year were super geniuses, while it was normal to break through to the Second Layer Heaven after two or three years of cultivation.”
“Back in the day…” After Jack opened the floodgates, Lori got more animated and shared with him the cultivation situation in the past decades.
Not only did Jack not find these stories boring, he was even more interested in them, and learned a lot of new information he hadn’t known before.
In addition to breaking through to the Third Realm and other cultivation experiences.
Among the nearly eighty ‘genius’ Second Layer Heaven students of the whole school, Jack included, some chose to sign up, but there were also those who chose to give up.
Not everyone has the courage to face the massacre directly; after all, they are still in Senior One and are just teenagers.
In the end, only around fifty of those eighty decided to participate.
In the afternoon, Jack arrived at Crystal and their club’s activity room.
In the rest area, Crystal, Justin, Freya, Matt, Mandy, and Maria were chatting. When Jack arrived, they greeted each other one by one.
Compared to Class 3, Class 9 has only had two people break through to Second Layer Heaven so far.
As the initiator of this gathering, Matt said: “Just yesterday, the Federation announced the suppression of the Koroya rebels and the beginning of economic and civilian recovery.”
Crystal nodded: “In contrast to the vast Human Federation, the strength of the Koroya rebels is nothing.”
“If it weren’t for the rules set when the Human Alliance was established, the Federation would have quelled the rebellion long ago.”
Matt cautiously said: “But we cannot take this lightly. It’s chaotic out there, so 1 suggest we form a small team.”
“That way, in battle, we have people watching our backs and helping each other, avoiding sneak attacks. What do you think?”
“Sounds good.”
“I agree to it…”
Jack didn’t object either. After all, having a little more security was better with these familiar faces than with other students.
So, everyone joined a chat group called South Sky Three Nine to stay connected.
As soon as Jack entered the group, he recognized everyone by their avatars, but his eyes became strange when he saw their usernames.
Crystal’s username was ‘Queen’, which suited her personality. The seemingly gentle Mandy’s username was ‘Gentle Sea Breeze’, which was quite girlish.
Freya’s was ‘Dream Catching Clear Song’, which matched her temperament.
But what kind of ghost was Justin’s ‘Super Chirpy Bully’?
And Matt, who seemed calm and wise, had a username of “If Youth Isn’t Wild We Are in Vain”..

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - 58: Early Preparations
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Early Preparations
Translator: 549690339
After leaving the activity room, Jack Clark went to the cultivation classroom to practice Sword Skill and Dragon Elephant Power, and only finished after the school bell rang past 4 o’clock.
Today he didn’t go to the Reading Room to read, he left the school early instead.
Walking out of the school gate, Jack Clark took a taxi to the Flower, Bird, Fish, and Insect Market.
It was still the same pet store with birds and insects. As he walked in, Jack Clark said familiarly: “Boss Lee, where are the insects I ordered?”
Seeing it was a familiar customer, the boss showed a smile: “Here, 1 put them in a box. I packed you a few more, just in case they die on the way.”
With that, Boss Lee led Jack Clark to a shelf inside, and there was a small box about twenty centimeters long and wide with some rotten leaves for bedding.
On these leaves, four insect-like creatures of about three centimeters long were crawling around. Their body surfaces were narrow and gleaming with a metallic luster.
The most unique feature of these insects was their bulging compound eyes and the unusually long legs.
“These insects are quite common, but they’re a bit tricky to catch. The creatures in the wild are getting more and more aggressive, and many of them have started to show some minor mutations.”
“Since we’re all familiar here, you can have them for just four hundred this time.”
“Okay, thank you, Boss Lee.”
Jack Clark didn’t haggle and directly transferred him four hundred bucks, took the box and a box of mealworms that Boss Lee gave as food, and left the pet store.
This was what Jack Clark had prepared for the Heavy Armored Beast’s next evolution.
It was an insect named Tiger Beetle, which fed on meat.
The most famous feature of these insects was their speed, regarded as the fastest in the insect world. They could move a distance of up to 300 times their body length in an instant.
Once Jack Clark determined that the next target of the Avatar Evolution was to enhance speed, he checked many related resources and finally decided on the Tiger Beetle.
By then, after absorbing the genes of Tiger Beetle, even if they just get a tenfold increase in their body length’s movement speed, it would be a significant boost for the Heavy Armored Beast.
In fact, for the third avatar evolution, Jack Clark did consider Mutated Beasts.
However, ordinary mutated beasts had only greater strength and stronger defense than the Heavy Armored Beast of the same size.
As for those powerful mutated beasts with unique abilities, it was not something he could afford or kill at this point.
Besides that, Jack Clark also considered some special creatures, like the tardigrade.
These creatures, which are said to be the undeath, have a frightening level of vitality and can survive in extremely high and low temperatures, adapting to various environments.
They could even survive in outer space through special abilities.
However, after carefully reviewing the information on these creatures, Jack Clark gave up.
Because the so-called tenacity of life claimed to be able to survive hundreds of years in a dehydrated dormant state to escape from the environment.
During this state, similar to suspended animation, they can do nothing. They would be helplessly awaiting death if they encountered an enemy at that time.
In reality, their active life cycle was only a few weeks long, and the undeath claim was overly exaggerated.
“Bro, why did you come back so early today?”
It was past 5 o’clock. Glenn Clark, who had returned from school, was surprised to see that his brother was already home.
“Yeah, I had something to do, so I left early.”
Jack Clark then called Glenn over, pointed to the box on the table, and said: “Glenn, after I go for the trials later on, remember to help me feed these.”
Glenn looked at the Tiger Beetle on the table with curiosity and asked: “Bro, what kind of bugs are these?”
Jack Clark casually found a reason: “Tiger Beetle. It’s my new pet. Just drop a few mealworms in there each day.”
“No problem, bro.”According to the current growth rate of the Heavy Armored Beast, it is expected to reach the third evolution by the end of the month, and by then, Jack might still be in Koroya.
So Jack decided to have Glenn take care of feeding the Tiger Beetle.
When the Avatar was about to evolve, he would call Glenn and have him go out at night to throw the box containing the Tiger Beetle into the river.
As for the reason, any excuse would do.
After arranging everything, Glenn volunteered to cook, and he was becoming more and more diligent lately. Seeing this, Jack went upstairs with the Tiger Beetle to cultivate.
In reality, he leaned back in the chair and his consciousness sank.
Suddenly, under the muddy sand of the surging river, a black, lizard-like head emerged, looking fierce against the backdrop of three pairs of red feather horns.
The mud churned as a Heavy Armored Beast, like a crocodile, swam out from the riverbed.
During this time, Jack had been controlling the Heavy Armored Beast to continue eating almost around the clock, as long as he felt it had digested enough.
However, this area was the estuary, with deep and wide rivers, and there were also some ferocious fish that could adapt to fresh water, like the scaly Mutated Shark and the horned Tiger Whale.
Facing these large Mutated Fish over eight meters long, the Heavy Armored Beast would either turn away or sink into the mud.
Without a clear understanding of the strength of these massive Mutated Fish, there was no need to fight them. Getting injured would be a loss, slowing down the evolution and growth.
Under thirty meters of river water, the water was muddy, and the Heavy Armored Beast could only see vaguely within a range of ten meters or so.
Just as the Heavy Armored Beast was swimming around, a shadow over three meters long entered its field of vision in the distance, and the Heavy Armored Beast’s eyes lit up.
In comparison to humans, the strength of the Mutated Beasts in the water was easier to judge. Generally, the larger the body, the stronger they were, but there were some exceptions.
For instance, the Heavy Armored Beast had encountered a two-meter-long Mutated Fish that looked like a sharp sword, with a terrifying speed.
At that time, it only took an instant to shoot by and tear a Mutated Fish over three meters long in half, before facing the Heavy Armored Beast and being eaten together.
However, the Heavy Armored Beast also paid a price, as it suffered a wound on its abdomen that was half a meter long and a few millimeters deep, caused by the sword-shaped Mutated Fish.
This was the first time the Heavy Armored Beast had been injured since its evolution. Although only a small part of the exoskeleton armor on its belly had been cut open, it still had a scare.
After all, the exoskeleton armor on its abdomen was only two centimeters thick, and if the Mutated Fish were ten times stronger, it would pose a threat to the Heavy Armored Beast.
Since that day, Jack had become much more cautious.
At this moment, the Mutated Fish also spotted the Heavy Armored Beast. Due to the difference in size, it didn’t run away but instead approached it.
It was a small Mutated Shark covered in gray scales, with sharp teeth in its mouth.
Upon seeing the fierce appearance and the sturdy, sharp limbs of the Heavy Armored Beast, the Mutated Shark didn’t attack immediately but swam cautiously around it.
Seeing this, the Heavy Armored Beast pretended to be clumsy, slowly turning around in place, retracting its limbs on both sides of its body, showing a timid and defensive posture.
Soon, after circling the Heavy Armored Beast a few times and not sensing any danger, the Mutated Shark swung its tail and launched a fierce attack from behind.
In the blink of an eye, it reached the back of the Heavy Armored Beast, its sharp mouth wide open, biting down hard on the back of its head.
At this moment, the seemingly clumsy Heavy Armored Beast suddenly sank and appeared below the Mutated Shark, grabbing its body with its claws.
Rip!
The Heavy Armored Beast’s claws tore through the Mutated Shark’s scales, and with a powerful bite, it tore a huge bloody hole in its belly.
Blood gushed out instantly, staining the surrounding river water red.
When facing the four-limbed Heavy Armored Beast, these Mutated Fish had no chance of escaping once caught, and in just a few bites, the Heavy Armored Beast ripped apart their stomachs and killed them.
In the blood-red seawater, the black Unique Beast began to devour its prey, each bite tearing off chunks of fish meat, looking increasingly fierce..

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - 59: Hundred Boats Vying to Stream
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Hundred Boats Vying to Stream
Translator: 549690339
It was Sunday, and Jack Clark was still in his usual outfit of a white t-shirt, black casual pants, and flat shoes, carrying a backpack with two sets of clothes in his hand.
Doris Raven and Glenn Clark saw him off at the entrance to the courtyard.
Doris voiced her concerns: “Jack, you need to be careful this time. I’ve heard that things are pretty chaotic in Koroya, people die there every day.”
After learning that Jack was going on this trial with his teacher, Doris had become particularly attentive to the matter, so she had done some additional research and knew that the trial site would be in Koroya.
In contrast to Doris’s concern, Glenn was merely curious and excited.
Jack responded with a small smile: “Mom, don’t worry. The situation there is now controlled by the Federation, and we students are just going to observe.” “Even if a few powerful experts slip through the net, the stronger adults like our teachers will block them. At most, a few fledglings will get through to give us some combat experience.”
After comforting Doris, Jack waved goodbye, slung his backpack over his shoulder, and headed toward the school.
When Jack arrived at the school gate at nine in the morning, there were already two buses waiting, filled with students who had chosen to take part in the trial. Upon seeing Jack, Justin Welan excitedly waved at him: “Jack, over here!”
This time, Jack wasn’t the last to show up. Crystal Leinster, Freya Louise, and some others hadn’t arrived yet.
The two boys stood at the edge of the crowd. Jack looked at the excited Justin and curiously asked: “Mr. Willard, why are you participating in this trial? You don’t really need to, do you?”
For most students, the trial was a chance to earn contribution points, gaining combat experience was only secondary.
After all, they’d have plenty of opportunities to sharpen their combat skills in the future when they’re more advanced in their cultivation.
Therefore, someone like Justin who was rich and even had people to provide him with high-level resources really had no need to take risks.
He could just continue cultivating in peace, wait until next year to break through the ‘Triplex’, then join the trial when his strength was greater, which would be much safer.
Justin huffed with some indignation: “Jack, are you looking down on me, Justin Welan? If you dare to go, why wouldn’t I?”
Jack gave him a sidelong glance: “It’s not like you’re stronger than me or anything.”
Justin chuckled and pretended not to hear his comment: “No real reason, actually. 1 just want to go and see what it’s like. My dad and my older brother both support me on this.”
“According to my brother, cultivating requires unyielding determination.”
“If I can’t even dare to participate in a trial supervised by the school, how could 1 dare to face those terrifying giant beasts in the future? Where would I get the courage to comprehend the great terror between life and death?”
“As long as my family doesn’t object, I, the mighty Justin Welan, will certainly not be afraid. And, 1 have brought some good stuff with me this time. My cultivation will certainly soar.”
“By then, none of the likes of Jane Aiken and the Class Leader will be a match for me, hahaha…”
His excitement grew as he spoke, and in the end, Justin even burst into laughter, as if he had already seen himself rising up during the trial and overpowering all the geniuses of his age.
“Ahem…”
While Justin was immersed in his fantasy, Jack cleared his throat and looked at him with an odd expression: “Mr. Willard, I think you should take a look behind you before you laugh.”
Justin’s laughter froze on his face, and a sense of foreboding rose in his heart. No way, it can’t be this unlucky. The Class Leader heard him again, right?
With this thought, Justin slowly turned his head, only to see Crystal quietly standing behind him, with a pink ladies’ backpack on her back.
Additionally, Matt Watkins, Freya, Mandy, and Maria were also there, the three girls stifling their laughter.
“Ha, hahaha… Good morning, everyone.” Justin gave a chuckle, his smile perfectly natural, without a hint of embarrassment.
The others, already accustomed to Justin’s habit of boasting, just glanced at him indifferently.
After everyone else had gathered, Vernon Leinster, Lori Parma, and some other teachers also arrived.
This time, fifty-seven students from South Sky Martial Height were participating in the trial. After confirming that everyone had arrived, the students and teachers all boarded the two buses.
Two hours later, they arrived at a suburban airport, and after going through some check-in procedures at the airport, the bus directly took Jack and the others to the runway.
On the side of the runway, two sci-fi style large airliners quietly stood.
But calling them airliners wouldn’t be as accurate as calling them fighting passenger planes.
Under the airplane, two large-caliber machine guns were installed on the left and right, in the middle was a special weapon similar to a railgun with a barrel about thirty centimeters thick.
In addition to these, there were short-range air missiles and other airborne weapons suspended under the wings, and even a bomb release port at the belly of the plane.
There was no other way. With the continuous emergence of mutated beasts, many birds had also mutated, especially some large eagles.
Over the years, whenever satellites detected threatening powerful mutated birds, the authorities would send out cultivators and fighters to exterminate them, not giving them a chance to grow.
If they allowed these mutated birds to continue to breed and grow, humans would slowly lose their air superiority.
However, this extermination operation only targeted large or powerful mutated birds, those with some signs of mutation but with average strength were ignored.
There was no helping it, there were too many to kill.
Therefore, these weapons were used to guard against those ordinary mutated birds, preventing them from causing air accidents.
After everyone got off the bus, Vernon, holding a name list, said gravely, “Your weapons and the battle armor given to you are in the belly of the plane, remember to claim them after getting off the plane.”
“Also, there are two trial locations this time, Kaleb Tuul city and Lester City in Koroya. Now, I will start calling names.”
“Those who are called will board Flight 075, which 1 will lead to Kaleb Tuul city.”
“Jane Aiken.”
“Present.”
“Crystal Leinster.”
“Here…”
Those whose names were called walked up into the airplane with their bags.
After more than twenty names were called, Jack was shocked to find that except for him and Justin, everyone else from Class 9 and Class 3 had boarded Flight 075.
Unexpectedly, this ad hoc team hadn’t even started and was already disbanded.
Jack shook his head, swung his backpack over his shoulder, and followed Lori Parma and the other three teachers onto Flight 076.
Due to the modifications, a part of the large airplane was occupied by weapons and ammunition and could barely seat about thirty people, including Jack.
“Ladies and gentlemen, I am the flight attendant for this flight, which is expected to last eleven hours. If you need anything during the flight, please feel free to find me.”
“Please fasten your seatbelts now and carefully read the flight manual placed on your seat.”
“It details what to do in case of an attack by a mutated beast during the flight…”
Buzz!
Accompanied by the roar of the engines, the two airplanes began to taxi one after the other during the flight attendant’s explanation, spreading their wings towards the heights of the clouds.
Moreover, one or two fighting passenger planes took off from every city in Eastern Summer that had first-class universities and headed in the same direction.
Seen from space, it gave a sense of a hundred boats racing, giving a sense of vigor and vitality..

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - 60: Energy Cannon
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Energy Cannon
Translator: 549690339
When the airplane finished its climb, the excitement of Justin Welan from the adjacent seat was hard to suppress as he looked at the boundless sea of clouds outside with gleaming eyes.
Suddenly he said, “Jack, do you think we might be attacked by missiles or something before the plane lands?”
“…Could you say something more pleasant?” Jack Clark was speechless.
Novice cultivators like them would be helpless if they encountered an airborne missile attack, even parachuting in low altitude wouldn’t guarantee a safe landing.
“Hehe… I’m just nervous,” Justin Welan let out a shy laugh.
Jack gave him a side glance, “First time on a plane, huh?”
“You make it sound as if you’ve been on a lot of flights before.”
Justin Welan rolled his eyes, “Now is not the same as fifty years ago, flying has become a dangerous mode of travel, no one would choose to fly unless necessary.”
“Alright, the flight is going to take a while, I’m going to get some sleep.”Jack Clark grinned, of course, he didn’t mention how he had once gotten sick on planes.
Jack closed his eyes, seemingly asleep but in fact, his consciousness sank and he turned into a Heavy Armored Beast, beginning his hunt of the day.
The growth of the Heavy Armored Beast literally depends on a lot of eating – as in the early days, the essence derived from the food turned into evolution values feeding its growth.
Therefore, during this period, the Heavy Armored Beast spends its time eating or traveling to eat, almost never returning to its lair during daylight, and only hiding in the muddy riverbed after eating its fill.
Similarly, under this circumstance, Jack was busy yet fulfilled, spending half of his daily energy here.
The majority of the long flight, barring meal times, Jack appeared to be ‘sleeping’, making Justin Welan quite envious.
He too wanted to be this calm.
Boom! Boom!!
Jack was startled awake by a sudden roar, no sooner had he opened his eyes, he noticed some panic inside the cabin.
At the cabin door, flight attendants were hurriedly calling out, “Everyone stay calm, don’t panic, we have only encountered a group of normal mutated birds.” “Quiet!”
Just then, a low roar that echoed throughout the cabin managed to calm the shaken students.
Standing at the cabin door, Lori Parma from First Class solemnly told them, “As cultivators, you must stay calm while disasters befall, and remain keen to your surroundings.”
“What does it tell if you lose your composure without even knowing what’s going on?”
Bang! Bang!
As Lori was lecturing them, Jack saw missiles hung under the wings of the plane being blasted off and machine guns underneath the cabin roaring continuously, the recoil making the plane shake slightly.
Boom! At that moment, a violent vibration erupted abruptly.
Even Lori couldn’t help but frown, “They even had to use the energy cannon.”
Fortunately, a few minutes later the roaring machine guns gradually ceased and all the students received the news that the group of mutated birds had been completely wiped out.
“That was thrilling,” Justin Welan trembled with excitement.
Jack shook his head, “Sure it’s thrilling, but it’s really irritating to have no control over my own safety.”
Over the following hour, they encountered several more attacks from ordinary mutated birds. It seemed that there were many mutated animals in the area through which the plane was flying.
After passing through that area, there was no more trouble, and after three more hours of flight, they arrived at their destination above Lester City.
They had set off a little after ten in the morning, and due to the time difference, it was evening when they arrived in Lester, where the temperature was slightly lower than in Mist River.
Looking down from the airplane, they could see the city below was full of scars, many places had turned into ruins, buildings had collapsed, and roads had been damaged.
As the plane landed on the runway, everyone breathed a sigh of relief and began to exit the plane one by one.This was a somewhat rundown airport, not very large, the distant tower building gave off a worn feel of several decades past.
By the runway, a band of soldiers attired in black combat uniforms were already waiting.
Lori Parma and his two other teacher colleagues went to them. Parma, dressed in a Second Lieutenant’s uniform, spoke quietly with one of the sergeants while Jack Clark and his student peers waited at some distance.
The idle Jack Clark swept his gaze over the desolate airport, then let it fall on the submachine guns and rifles in the hands of these soldiers.
These guns were a bit different from the regular firearms – bigger caliber, longer body, and the entire gun coated in a metallic sheen, it was apparent at a glance that it was quite heavy, with immense destructive power.
Besides that, Jack Clark could also detect from these soldiers the vibe of the First Layer Heaven cultivators.
However, unlike them – the students, the soldiers’ Qi Blood feel was more steady, profound, their ten-odd men blending together as if a single individual, not as lively as them.
At this moment, Lori Parma walked over to them and spoke solemnly, “Everyone line up, collect your weapons and battle armor, then go to the room over there and put on your gear.”
“Yes.”
Jack Clark’s gaze turned intense, they actually had to put on their battle armor right after getting off the plane, could it be that the situation here was more severe than he had anticipated?
Queuing up, Jack Clark quickly received his long knife and a suitcase.
In the boys’ room near the airport, Jack Clark opened the suitcase, a black-red folded armor suddenly appeared before his eyes.
Following the instructions, Jack Clark started to put on the special steel wire-made pants and fixed the thin but firm alloy around his thighs, kneecaps, and calves.
Then came the chest armor, besides the joints, light alloy covered his front chest, back, shoulders, and arms as well. Lastly, specialty gloves and metal battle boots.
The last piece was a science fiction-like helmet, fully made of reinforced alloy, still black and red with ballistic glasses around the eye area.
As soon as the students put on this gear, their disposition greatly changed, carried a solemn air about them, like some super soldiers from the future.
Justin Welan, holding his helmet, came over beside Jack Clark and started showing off, “Jack, don’t I look cool?”
Jack Clark nodded, “Not bad, looking somewhat human.”
“What do you mean by somewhat human, this is total awe-inspiring dominance.” Justin Welan was not convinced.
Standing one meter eighty-five tall, Justin Welan wearing the full set of armor looked broad and wide. If he puts on the helmet, there would be no sign of him being a 16-year-old adolescent.
Jack Clark was likewise, his physique improved continuously along with the cultivation, diet, and nutrition during the past two months. His height had already reached one meter eighty-two.
However, compared to the tougher Justin Welan, Jack Clark was just a touch more evenly built, upright and tail, a perfect golden inverted triangle.
At this time, after putting on the black and red armor he looked gallant and handsome, stepping out made the few fellow female students’ eyes lit up.
Noticing the gaze of those female students, Justin Welan showed a mournful expression, “Jack, I have a feeling I will need to keep my distance from you whenever we go out.”
“Why is that?” Jack Clark, with the long knife at his back, was puzzled.
“There’s no why, it’s a man’s choice.”
Jack Clark was speechless, “What kind of gibberish is that.”
With that, he glanced at his classmates, each of them had got weapons like a long sword, pole, etc strapped on their backs. There were some special weapons as well.
For instance, the Spiked Shield on Justin Welan’s back that’s wider and taller than a person, Howard Lee had a ‘pillar’ strapped on his back that’s as thick as a thigh and three meters long.
Lori Parma looked at the fully equipped group, speaking solemnly, “The Federation’s earlier attack has completely destroyed the road between this airport and Lester city- it still hasn’t been repaired.”
“We’re the first batch of freshmen from the Martial Arts School sent for aid, now we have to travel more than ten kilometers on foot crossing that destroyed section of the road, there’s a troop-transport vehicle waiting on the other side.”
“At present, the situation in Lester city has not completely stabilized, the federal forces only control the urban region, there are still small bands of rebels resisting in other areas.”
“Therefore we might encounter attacks later, it’s best if everyone puts on their helmets to avoid any accidents, understood?”
“Understood..”

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - 61: Furious Slaughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Furious Slaughter
Translator: 549690339
Following the guidance of the ten-man squad, Jack Clark and the others left the airport.
They had only walked four kilometers along the road when the roadside became pockmarked and rough, showing signs of bombardments by heavy artillery and missiles.
The ferocity of the Federation’s military offensive a few days ago was evident.
Crossing a section of the broken road several kilometers long, a group of low-lying buildings appeared in front of everyone, which should have been a small town.
But the small town was now in ruins, with large pits and bullet holes from explosions everywhere, as well as traces of fire.
The squad leader leading the way said solemnly, “Be careful, everyone. This small town was once occupied by a rebel force of a thousand men and was later defeated by our army.”
“But most of these rebels are locals and very familiar with the terrain. During our patrols these days, we often see…”
Before the squad leader could finish speaking, Jack felt a strong sense of danger coming.
A hundred meters away in the small town, a dark-skinned middle-aged man stood up on a flat-roofed house, carrying a shoulder-mounted rocket launcher.
In an instant, the sharp whistling sound rang out as a rocket, trailing a fiery tail, soared toward everyone.
“Looking for death.”
The female teacher in front uttered a low growl, and a terrible aura burst forth from her body. The powerful Blue True Power, like a flame, enveloped her entire body.
Boom!
The ground exploded, and the female teacher transformed into a blur, instantly appearing dozens of meters away and slapped the rocket.
Bang! The explosion from the rocket sent a ball of fire and smoke far into the distance.
In the midst of the flames and smoke, the female teacher’s blue True Power, like a flame, flickered around her, leaving her unharmed and exuding an astonishing oppressive aura.
At this moment, over a hundred figures emerged from the ruined buildings in the small town more than a hundred meters away. Most of them held rifles, submachine guns, and even heavy machine guns.
One person wielded a grenade launcher.
Apart from that, ten black-robed Evil God Sect cultists appeared, shouting, “Open fire, and kill all the Federal Geniuses!”
Lori Parma also shouted, “Soldiers take cover on the spot, leave the cultists to us, all students join forces to kill all the rebels!”
As Lori Parma spoke, gunfire erupted from afar, with countless bullets flying towards everyone.
The first to be hit was the teacher who stopped the rocket, engulfed by the numerous bullets, causing her blue True Power, like a flame, to constantly tremble from the impact.
“Kill!”
Lori Parma and another middle-aged teacher unleashed their terrifying auras, their external red and white True Power danced like flames, and in an instant, they vanished on the spot, leaving behind a trail of afterimages as they disappeared.
Boom! Boom!
Midway, the two of them directly intercepted and destroyed two rockets aimed at them in mid-air. The overbearing display caused the attackers’ faces to change dramatically.
A few ordinary rebels even trembled with fear, wanting to flee.
The leading Evil God Sect cultist’s face darkened: “What’s going on? The information stated that there was only one advanced cultivator.”
“Don’t be afraid, continue shooting to deplete their True Power. They won’t last long. Sweep them with heavy machine guns.” After speaking, he gestured for the others to retreat.
They may be fanatical Evil God Sect cultists, but they were no fools.
Boom! The wall collapsed.
The female teacher blinked and passed through the barrage of bullets, crumbling the wall blocking her path with a palm strike. She leapt high into the air towards an Evil God Sect cultist.
However, the cultists were not weak either. The two strongest among them were only slightly weaker than Lori Parma. Seeing that they couldn’t retreat in time, the cultists’ blood-colored strength erupted as they tried to gang up on the female teacher first.
At the same time, Lori Parma and the other teacher also charged into the small town with white waves, with a terrifying speed of more than a hundred meters per second, lunging towards the other cultists.
Compared to the two leaders, these cultists were considerably weaker. Some of them were even only at the Second Layer, and one was instantly killed by Lori Parma’s palm strike upon contact.
An intense battle erupted instantly, walls collapsing and houses exploding as they disappeared into the outskirts of the small town.
Seeing this scene, Justin Welan licked his lips, carrying the Spiked Shield in front of him, and excitedly said, “Jack, let’s go too.”
Jack, wearing a helmet, nodded slightly and reminded, “Watch out for the grenades.”
With the full body armor protection, the ordinary rifles and submachine guns wouldn’t pose a fatal threat, and the impact of the bullets could be ignored.
However, grenades and rockets were still extremely lethal to them.
“Kill!” As soon as Jack finished speaking, Howard Lee, wearing black-red armor and carrying an iron column, charged forward like a furious tank.
Although he appeared reckless in his charge, his path zigzagged, evading most of the bullets, with the armor blocking the few that hit him.
In addition, more than ten excited freshmen out of the remaining twenty joined in the charge, also using obstacles to dodge bullets and relying on their armor defense when they couldn’t avoid.
Seeing this, Jack did not hesitate, drew his long knife, and swiftly moved like a gust of wind, ghost-like as he circled from the side.In the Second Layer Heaven’s cultivation, these students’ speed far exceeded ordinary people with over five times the physique of ordinary people.
Even wearing battle armor and heavy weapons, the slowest one’s explosive power was close to twenty meters per second, and it only took a few seconds to cover a hundred meters.
Jack Clark’s speed was even faster, almost over fifty meters per second, and in a blink of an eye, he charged into the small town from the side.
Bang!
Jack Clark stepped on the red brick wall, and the powerful force created cracks on the wall. He then leaped into the air, directly jumping onto the four-meters-high flat roof.
There, three dark-skinned, fierce-looking rebels were squatting on the edge, firing wildly at the incoming freshman students.
As rebels who had experienced several months of chaos, these men reacted very quickly. When Jack jumped up, their faces changed drastically and they decisively fired their guns.
Bang, bang, bang!
Numerous bullets landed on the roof, stirring up smoke and dust, but they all missed their target.
At the moment when they pulled the trigger, Jack had already disappeared from the spot with even greater speed, his figure suddenly appearing two meters to their left.
Without hesitation, a two-meter-long straight blade tore through the air, like a flash of white light passing through the three men in an instant.
Pu, pu, pu!
Under the unparalleled sharpness of the blade, the three men were instantly killed. Even the rifles in their hands were cut in half and fell to the ground, hot blood gushing out.
Although it was his first time killing, Jack’s eyes were cold, and he showed no emotion at the sight of the severed limbs and broken bodies on the ground.
For him, such bloody scenes were already common. After all, he had swallowed hundreds of Mutated Fish, let alone killing human beings.
However, just at this moment.
Bang, bang, bang!
A string of bullets passed through where Jack had just stood, and sparks and smoke erupted on the rooftop.
Behind a two-story small building, a rebel hid behind the stairwell. As soon as he saw Jack kill his three companions, he decisively fired at Jack.
But at the moment, he fired his gun, Jack, feeling the dangerous aura, had already moved aside.
This was the terrifying power of the Second Layer Heart’s Eye Realm, which allowed a keen perception of danger and the line of sight filled with murderous intent.
Boom!
Wearing battle armor, Jack was like a raging mammoth. After dodging the rifle fire, he leaped high and landed on the opposite rooftop, turning into a shadow that slammed into the door with a boom.
Bang!
Under the violent force, the wooden door of the stairwell was shattered in an instant, and the rebel behind the door was directly knocked flying, crashing into the wall behind him like a lump of mud.
By then, Jack’s figure had already flashed down the stairs, and the two rebels holding a heavy machine gun and a submachine gun at the entrance below looked back in horror.
Pu, pu!
The flash of the blade passed by, and the two rebels had not even reacted before they were killed by Jack. Their heads soared into the air, and bright red blood spurted out.
Jack, who had consecutively killed six rebels, rushed out of the flat building and saw that it had already turned chaotic outside. The students, relying on their armor defense, charged and crashed amidst the rain of bullets.
Especially Justin Welan, who had a faint earth-colored light flow on his body, carrying a shield more than one meter tall and over ten centimeters thick, completely ignoring the bullets and directly charging at a modified off-road vehicle trying to escape.
Bang! One person and one car collided, causing a powerful shockwave on the surrounding ground.
When the off-road vehicle with a speed of tens of kilometers per hour collided with Justin holding the shield, the ground under his feet shook with a roar, and fine cracks spread out. However, his body remained motionless.
That off-road vehicle was directly stopped by the collision, its head deformed, and the sudden stop caused the gun-wielding rebels inside to be thrown off balance and cry out in panic.
At this moment, the 2-meter-tall Howard Lee jumped down from the side building, and the iron column three meters long in his hand whistled and smashed heavily onto the off-road vehicle.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force, the off-road vehicle was blown up by Howard’s pillar, flames erupted, and the rebels inside were instantly reduced to a bloody mess.
The explosion of the vehicle caused the gasoline to splatter onto Howard and catch fire.
“Damn, Howard, stop stealing my kills!” complained Justin Welan.
Howard, with flames burning on his leg, ignored him. Exuding an overbearing aura, he carried the iron column and chased down the fleeing rebels in the distance.
Boom! In the distance, a careless freshman was blasted into the air by a grenade. He rolled several times on the ground and couldn’t get up.
Before the rebel holding the grenade launcher could continue to fire, a heavy sword suddenly swung down from the side, cutting him and his weapon in half, and the bloody scene was terrifying.
Mullen Weisz, who was standing beside, was very excited.
Elsewhere, there were flickers of fire, continuous gunshots, and screams. Bullets flew everywhere, and hand grenades exploded chaotically. Blood and fire filled the air.
It was hard to imagine that these freshmen were experiencing their first battle..

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 62: Quick Spear within Seven Steps
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Quick Spear within Seven Steps
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark glanced around, not going after the rebels, but turning his gaze toward the depths of the small town.
For him, killing these ordinary rebels wasn’t of much use.
But the cultists were different, each one was Contribution Points.
Judging from the cultists being chased by Lori Parma and the others, Jack Clark noticed a few of them were not very fast, and their aura was only at the Second or Third Layer Heaven.
With that thought, Jack Clark’s figure vanished in an instant, and within a blink of an eye, he appeared in front of the three-story building dozens of meters away.
Bang!!
Jack Clark, who had jumped five meters high, landed on the edge of the window, and then leaped into the air again, grabbed the outer edge of the wall, and jumped up to the roof of the Third Floor.
At this time, chaos had erupted everywhere, so standing at a high point, he didn’t have to worry about being sniped by hidden guns.
Under the dark red sunset, standing on the highest building in the small town, Jack Clark looked out and saw the figures of Lori Parma and the others on the east side of the small town.
Now, only four of the ten Evil God Sect Cultists were left. Lori Parma was suppressing two of them while the other two teachers were each hunting down one of them.
As they went, waves of hand-slashes of True Strength, sword qi, and knife light were flying out more than ten meters, and when they landed, they exploded like high explosives, causing houses to collapse. It was terrifying.
Seeing this, Jack Clark’s eyes flashed with regret, as he thought he could easily defeat some weaker cultists, but they didn’t last even a few minutes.
But there were only five corpses on the ground.
Jack Clark’s eyes suddenly paused. Following the battle traces of Lori Parma and the others through the small town, he saw only five corpses, one was missing.
“Over there.” Jack Clarks figure leaped off the small building and landed on the roof of a fiat house across the street.
Following that, his figure swiftly darted toward the west side of the small town like a shadow, disappearing into the street in the blink of an eye, at an astonishing speed.
As Jack Clark jumped down from the distant building, Lori Parma, who was fighting, turned and glanced back.
Seeing that Jack Clark was chasing the fleeing cultist, there was a flash of admiration in her eyes.
At the edge of the western part of the small town, the black-robed cultist rushed out, panting heavily, with a pale face and bloodstains on the corners of his mouth.
After leaving the small town, the cultist’s expression loosened, and excitement emerged as he looked at the forest ahead. As long as he entered the forest, he could escape back.
He would tell the fanatics that this time the ambush was a trap.
With this thought, Kroos’ spirit was lifted. Then his face changed abruptly, and he suddenly threw himself to the left.
At the very moment Kroos fell, a long knife flew like a cannonball, emitting a piercing shriek, and with a “bang”, it fiercely stabbed into a tree trunk more than ten meters away.
The half-a-meter-thick tree trunk was pierced directly by the long knife, breaking its branches with the force it carried.
If Kroos reacted a bit slower, he would have been killed by the straight blade.
More than thirty meters away, Jack Clark walked out of the small town with heavy footsteps, his eyes cold behind the face mask, emanating an intense oppressive force.
Kroos struggled to get up from the ground, looking at Jack Clark, his expression gradually becoming crazed and vicious: “You, a high school junior at the Second Layer Heaven, dare to chase me. You’re courting death.”
You know I’m a high school student. Jack Clark’s eyes squinted involuntarily, sensing that today’s attack might not be that simple.
At that moment, a burst of madness sprouted from Kroos, and eerie red patterns like worms appeared on his exposed face and hands, radiating a strange red light.
This red light carried a strong smell of blood, causing Jack Clark to instinctively feel disgusted.
Second Heaven Peak, huh?
Feeling the aura bursting from the cultist, Jack Clark maintained a calm expression.
“Die!”
With a furious shout, Kroos was enveloped by a red light, looking like a vicious blood python as he pounced at Jack Clark. The blood spike in his hand tore through the air like a python’s fanged teeth.
Roar! Accompanied by a faint elephant roar, Jack Clark erupted a fierce aura, and his figure expanded as if he was an enraged giant elephant charging forward.
Both sides…
Just as both parties were about to collide, a raging wind howled, and Jack Clark’s figure shimmered slightly and passed by Kroos effortlessly.
This made Kroos, who expected Jack Clark to engage, so upset that he almost spat out blood. He quickly stopped and turned around, only to see Jack Clark standing under a large tree more than ten meters away.
Spurtljack Clark pulled the straight blade out of the tree trunk and said indifferently, “You’re too stupid to think I would duel you unarmed while you’re holding a weapon.”
It would be foolish not to use a weapon against these sinister Evil God Sect cultists, and who knows if there’s a deadly poison on the Blood Thorn.
Jack Clark’s words made Kroos’ face look ugly, feeling insulted; and before he could speak, a sharp aura burst from Jack Clark’s body.
With a boom, he shattered the ground, disappearing at a speed that blurred the naked eye.
Watching Jack Clark transform into a black shadow and shoot towards him, Kroos’ face suddenly turned sinister as he threw the Blood Thorn like a dart.
Clang! Jack Clark, running at high-speed, slashed the Blood Thorn in half with his knife.
By that time, Kroos had pulled out a huge handgun, similar to the Desert Eagle but with a double the caliber, a triumphant expression on his face.
These students are still too naive; didn’t they know that a gun is faster within seven steps?
As Kroos aimed the gun at him, Jack Clark’s hairs stood on end, his intuition telling him that the gun had immense power to penetrate full body armor protection.
Boom! The gunshot from Kroos’ handgun rang out like a cannon.
Jack Clark, who was only three meters away, suddenly dodged backward by bending and lowering his body, feeling a sharp breath whizz past him in an instant.
Clang!
Kroos, who missed the first shot, didn’t have a chance for a second as Jack Clark instantly slid up to him and slashed the handgun with a backhand swing, severing it.
Jack Clark, flipping up and turning around, swung his left arm wildly, exploding the air with a burst of strength, clashing his palm with Kroos’, who had dropped the gun handle and lunged at him.
Bang! At the moment of their collision, a terrifying circle of transparent shockwaves exploded.
Pu!
Kroos’ face changed instantly, spitting out a mouthful of blood, retreating several meters under the terrifying power of that punch, and his arm muscles tore open, bleeding profusely.
“Aren’t you Second Layer Heaven?”
Kroos stared at Jack Clark with a resentful face, as their high school junior was even more treacherous and concealed his strength to deceive him, pretending to be Second Layer Heaven.
That punch almost ruined his arm; this power was not Second Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark stood with his knife and said indifferently, “My realm is indeed Second Layer Heaven, and I’ve just broken through. You’re just too weak.”
That cultist’s aura was clearly at the peak of Second Layer Heaven, but it felt ’empty’ to Jack Clark when they clashed.
That red power crumbled upon contact with True Strength, and apart from making him feel slightly uncomfortable, it couldn’t shake the overbearing Dragon Elephant True Strength.
His physique was even weaker, probably only at the First Layer Heaven limit; if not for the bizarre increase of Red True Power, Jack Clark could have killed him with a single punch just now.
“How is this possible?!” Kroos refused to believe that the power he had obtained at such a great cost was so weak.
Unfortunately, Jack Clark had no interest in telling him more, his eyes turned cold, and a sharp aura burst out of him, creating an explosive roar of a raging wind.
“Not good!” Seeing the rapidly magnifying sword light, Kroos instinctively wanted to dodge…Pu!
Jack Clark’s figure appeared behind him, slowly retracting his knife.
Only to see a bloodstain on Kroos’ neck, followed by a scorching spray of blood, his lifeless body and head leadenly falling to the ground.
Mind’s Eye Bright Knife second-layer ultimate move, Light King Slash!
An explosion of double the speed in close range, slicing through everything with an extremely condensed blade edge.
But it consumes more energy, and only after breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven can it be used consecutively.
Jack Clark chose this sword skill for this very reason – his physique would become stronger as his Avatar evolved, making this move terrifying in the later stages.
Jack Clark let out a slow breath, and the tension in his heart loosened a little after confirming the cultist’s death.
Although the fight from then until now was only a few moves, it was highly dangerous.
Especially since he didn’t expect the cultist to have a hidden ‘cannon’ in his bosom, but luckily he was cautious, always on guard when he sensed a slight danger from him.
Otherwise, he might not have been able to dodge if he was shot at close range.
“These guys are just as cunning and treacherous as the teachers said, without any sense of martial arts virtue..”

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - 63: Information Wall
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Information Wall
Translator: 549690339
By the time Jack Clark came back carrying the corpse of the cultist, the battle had already ended.
Most of the hundred or so rebels had been killed, and more than a dozen had surrendered. The soldiers who had guided Jack and his classmates were cleaning up the battlefield and collecting weapons and ammunition.
The freshmen who had participated in the battle were excitedly chatting, talking about how brave and fierce they were in the battle just now.
Some students even took out their mobile phones and posed with the rocket launcher for selfies.
Even Justin Welan stood in front of the burnt and deformed off-road vehicle, making a one-handed pose with his thick shield, and asked his classmates to help take pictures.
Of course, there were some injuries in this battle, like the student who was hit by a grenade and was lying on a stretcher screaming, but his voice was full of energy.
With six to seven times the physical strength of ordinary people and the defense of full body armor, he was only mildly injured by the explosion of small-sized grenades.
Some other students also sustained light injuries, such as chest armor being pierced by bullets and the special steel wire stopping the bullets halfway into the muscles.
In addition, some of the freshmen had already taken off their helmets, their faces pale as they leaned against the wall and gasped for breath.
They were fine when they were tense before, but once the battle was over, these youths who had seen blood for the first time were immediately frightened by the cruelty of the war.
Looking at those limbs severed and corpses mangled, some students couldn’t bear the sight and even vomited.
However, it wasn’t just them, those seemingly excited freshmen were actually also tense, but they were just venting their emotions in another way, including Justin Welan.
After all, they were just youths, and this was their first time on the battlefield, witnessing such bloody scenes.
Even Jack Clark, who after the battle ended and had withdrawn from the cold and calm state when hunting with the Heavy Armored Beast, felt a little uncomfortable looking at those mutilated bodies.
Seeing Jack carrying the cultist’s corpse with a knife in one hand and the corpse in the other, the other students also reacted.
Mullen Weisz looked upset, “Damn, how could I forget about that.”
Marcus Lee also felt regret, “Yeah, I was so excited just now, I forgot that killing these cultists would earn Contribution Points.”
“Miscalculated,” Zac Lyons shook his head.
Justin Welan approached curiously and asked, “How is it, Jack? What is the strength of this cultist?”
Jack nodded, “As the teachers said, their strength is weaker than their realm.”
“For example, this one’s realm is equivalent to the Second Layer Heaven Peak, but his basic physique is only at the First Layer Heaven Limit, and his blood-colored True Strength is weak and not well-concentrated.”
“So weak,” Justin Welan was surprised.
As Jack was talking, Howard Lee, who was carrying a pillar, also walked over with heavy steps and said solemnly, “Because these cultists are the result of external rapid success, it is normal for them to be weaker.”
“External force?” Jack looked at him.
Howard Lee nodded, “It’s similar to the empowerment in Buddhist scriptures, where stronger fanatics perform Secret Skills to enhance them. The process is painful and has a low success rate.”
“These low-level cultists mostly come from this kind of process…”
The classification of the Evil God Sect Cultist is quite simple. Those below the Third Layer Heaven are ordinary cultists, and those from the Fourth Layer Heaven to the Sixth Layer Heaven are called fanatics.
As for the strong men above the Seventh Layer Heaven, they are bishops, responsible for managing and controlling the followers below them.
As Jack and the others were discussing, Lori Parma and the other two teachers along with the soldier platoon leader came back, all of them looking somewhat disheveled.
It couldn’t be helped. Those senior fanatics were too crazy. They almost got injured in the explosion of two Initial Stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven fanatics. Fortunately, they were prepared.
As for the other three Fourth Layer Heaven fanatics, they didn’t give them a chance to self-destruct, killing them lightning fast. Adding to a few Second or Third Layer Heaven ordinary cultists, they were almost wiped out.
Lori Parma said solemnly, “Though the strength of this attack is not weak, it is not as strong as we expected. It should be just a probe, and those guys did not fully take the bait.”
The female teacher nodded slightly, “It’s normal, after all we leaked the information that there was only one teacher leading the team, and the reinforcements were all Second Layer Heaven freshmen.”
“But those people won’t be so easily fooled. This time they obviously just sent a small squad to test us.”
“They must have been prepared for two possible outcomes: if the information turned out to be accurate, half of them would engage the leading teacher while the others joined the rebels to kill the freshmen; if the information turned out to be false, their losses would not be too serious.”
While they were talking, Jack walked over with the cultist’s corpse and paused when he heard the conversation of the teachers from a distance.
It turned out that their ambush was a trap laid by Lori Parma and the others.
Jack threw the cultist’s body to the side and politely said, “Teacher, there is also a Second Layer Heaven cultist here who was killed by me.”
Lori Parma praised, “Well done, I will add it to the system when we get back to base.”
A smile appeared on Jack’s face, having earned a small profit upon arrival.
The other two teachers and the squad leader also glanced at Jackin the chaos of that first encounter with battle, this freshman actually had the heart to chase and kill the cultists without getting injured.
“I remember you’re Jack Clark from Class 3, right?” The female teacher started.
Jack nodded: “Yes, teacher.”
The female teacher chuckled: “I’m Sylvia Lyons, the teacher of Class 9, and I’ll be in charge of Group 2’s freshman teaching next semester. Are you interested in joining us?”
Uh … Jack was dumbfounded.
Lori Parma said irritably: “Sylvia, I’m still here. If you want to poach someone, you should at least find a time when I’m not here.”
Sylvia Lyons didn’t care: “I just think this freshman has a good temperament and talent, and I’m afraid you guys who only know about cultivation all day long will mislead him.”
“That’s pure slander. I cultivate and focus on cultivation, but 1 am also doing my responsibilities.” Lori Parma argued.
Sylvia Lyons smiled: “Really? But I heard that someone only showed up once when the freshmen were establishing their foundation, and then they completely neglected their duties.”
“The Meditation Method and Body Casting Skill of Foundation Establishment have templates. Whether you can practice them depends entirely on your talent. 1 don’t need to be there all the time, do I?”
Ahem!
The squad leader coughed: “Two teachers, it’s getting late. Why don’t you take the students and continue on, and I’ll take care of things here.”
“All right.”
Since the squad leader stepped in to mediate, Lori Parma took the opportunity to give in, because he indeed felt a bit guilty.
This year, when the new batch of students entered the school, he had just had a breakthrough, and so, he left the Foundation Establishment in the hands of the Class Leader and Martial Art Committee Member, and went into retreat.
But just like he said, the matter of Foundation Establishment in the systematic template of the school completely depended on talent, and there was no impact whether he was there or not.
It’s just not nice to say that.
Leaving eight soldiers to guard the captives, the two soldiers led everyone through the small town.
They then followed the broken road for several kilometers before they saw a convoy of more than a dozen military vehicles and armored cars parked on the edge of the forest from afar.
Lori Parma and the other three teachers went to talk with the major in the convoy, and Jack and the others boarded two military vehicles separately.
Soon, the convoy started and headed towards Lester City.
“Jack, what do you think of this caption?” In the car, Justin Welan, who had taken off his helmet, handed his mobile phone over to Jack and asked for his opinion.
“What is this?”
Jack took the phone and saw that Justin was posting on the social media. It’s just that the content was not about flaunting food, but pictures taken earlier.
The first picture was him holding a shield in front of a wrecked off-road vehicle, then a single soldier rocket launcher, and the third picture was a pile of rebel corpses and the ruined small town.
The caption below read, “The winter break is coming, and as a mercenary of Koroya’s expedition, 1 just had an intense battle right upon arrival, slaying hundreds of enemies. It’s so enjoyable!!”
Justin Welan was excited: “How about it, Jack? Doesn’t my caption have that chaotic end-of-days vibe?”
Jack returned the phone to him and said, “I can’t see any chaotic end-of-days vibe, but there’s a strong sense of self-satisfaction and show-off.”
Justin Welan disagreed: “Jack, you’re not fun at all. It’s not showing off, it’s simply a happy share.”
As he spoke, he happily clicked on the post. After a while, there were a string of replies below.
Not only Justin Welan, but also other students were posting on social media.
In the posts, they bragged about how many enemies they killed today and how brave they were at that time, and so on.
However, whether it was Justin Welan or those students, they all blocked friends who were non-cultivators when posting on social media.
This was the school’s requirement. There was a clause in the contract signed during the Foundation Establishment that they should not mention too much about cultivation in front of ordinary people.
It also includes various resources and cultivation methods information.
When signing up for this trial, the contract Jack signed also had confidentiality requirements, and they were not allowed to reveal too much about Koroya to ordinary people.
It seems that the Federation has always been deliberately blurring the information about cultivators being superior to ordinary people.
This kind of information blurring is actually quite terrifying. Ninety percent of the ordinary people in this world live in their own information cocoons, where cognition, insight, and thinking are all trapped by layers of barriers.
Most of the information they receive comes from the internet and television, such as self-media, hot searches, traffic news, and various high-heat topics.
Many people seemingly receive a lot of information every day and can see things happening all over the world, but in the end, they seem to have gained nothing but emotional output.
