However, with the continuous outbreak of events in Koroya and the appearance of chaos in other small allied countries, there are signs that the boundaries between Transcendents and ordinary people are gradually being broken..

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 64 Is This Your Special?
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Is This Your Special?
Translator: 549690339
As the convoy approached Lester, some buildings came into view.
However, compared to the thriving Mist River City, this city gave Jack Clark a sense of backwardness reminiscent of the eighties. The roads were dusty and the buildings were dilapidated.
Only the city center had some skyscrapers, the rest were one or two-story houses. The slightly better buildings were only three or four-story red brick edifices.
By the time they entered the city, it was already dark. Jack noticed that there were hardly any people on the street. Occasionally, a few figures would hurriedly disappear into the dim alleys.
Apart from that, there were few streetlamps on the gray roads, with a light bulb emitting a yellowish glow only at considerable intervals.
Jack was a bit puzzled, “Isn’t it already 2055? Why is Koroya so rundown?”
Although the progress of civilian technology has slowed down in this world due to the rise of Martial Arts, the fields of biological medicine and weapons research are even more advanced.
In addition, network technology has been gradually booming in recent years. For example, QR codes and Micro-chat, a WeChat-like software, have gradually occupied the market.
At the same time, online and ecommerce businesses are also on the rise, showing signs of an imminent era of prosperity. It’s completely like a different world compared to the backwardness here.
Regarding Jack’s confusion, Justin Welan shrugged, “That’s normal. Many factors influence the development of economy and civilization, such as the local environment.”
“And it so happens that the rulers of Koroya do not wish for development here.”
Jack squinted his eyes, “To maintain their rule.”
Justin nodded, “Correct. When the Federation was established back then, these backward countries of the third world like Koroya were feudal.”
“In order to consolidate their rules, the Koroya high-level officials have blocked the dissemination of True Martial Arts over the years, and the development of network and technology is also very backward.”
“Especially for some high-tech products, they are basically only accessible to the wealthy.”
“Of course, another reason is that there are few cracks here, leading to a poor cultivation environment, hence they have managed to remain unchanged for decades, and the Federation is too lazy to pay attention.”
“After all, the first law that enabled the formation of the Federation was the Human Camp Alliance, but they could not interfere in the internal affairs of other countries unless it impacted the Federation.”
While the two were chatting, the convoy entered the military base in the city center under the gaze of several hidden observers.
The area was a bit bustling here, with one high rise after another ranging from ten to twenty floors. The streets were wide and clean, adorned with advertisements and pictures of local celebrities everywhere.
The lead armored car parted ways with Jack and their group at an intersection. The two troop carriers and the sedan the teachers were in continued forward, eventually stopping outside a hotel.
At the hotel steps, some people in military uniforms were already standing there.
Seeing Lori Parma’s trio dismount from the vehicle, a middle-aged man with the rank of Major General laughed and came down: “You’ve all had a tough journey.”
The trio of Lori Parma quickly responded politely: “Greetings Major General Hong, it’s not tough, it’s our responsibility.”
“It’s a pity that this time we didn’t catch any big fish, just a team of ordinary fanatics probing.”
“No worries, wiping out a small team is equivalent to weakening them. We just need to push forward according to plan next, no need to rush.”
At this time, Jack and others also got out of the vehicle. The spectacle of the freshmen, all clad in black-red armor and carrying various large cold weapons, was quite spectacular.
“Let’s go, let’s first take care of dinner, we can discuss other matters tomorrow.”
“You guys flew in an airplane for so long and experienced a battle, you must all be hungry.”
“Alright.” Led by the three teachers, Jack and the other students entered the hotel.
However, with the military receiving party taking care of everything, Jack and other students were only in charge of eating and drinking. After they were full, the staff led everyone upstairs.
With more students from other schools expected to arrive, the military arranged two people per room. Under such circumstances, naturally, Jack chose to room with Justin.
18th floor, Hotel Room 1808.
“Finally, we can rest.” Justin set his shield against the wall, making a dull thud when it landed, then tossed his knapsack onto the bed.
“Jack, do you want to bathe first, or shall I?”
“Either is fine.”
“Alright, I’ll go first, then it’s your turn.”
While Justin went to take a bath, Jack also took off his battle armor. This place was a safe zone under the control of the military, so there was no need to carry it with him all the time.It was already eight o’clock in the evening, and Jack Clark was standing by the window, looking out. He noticed that the surrounding area was pitch black, with only sporadic lights in the area controlled by the military.
“I didn’t expect there to be such underdeveloped areas in this world,” Jack murmured, his eyes narrowing in contemplation.
From the current situation, Koroya might be more complicated than he had imagined. The federal army, high-order cultivators, Evil God Sect Cultists, and rebels.
But what roles did they, the trial students, play in all of this?
No matter what role he played, he decided to prioritize stability, trying to earn more Contribution Points to improve his strength, and make progress in breaking through the Third Layer Heaven as soon as possible.
While Jack was deep in thought, Justin Welan, drying his hair, walked out and said, “Jack, it’s your turn.”
“Okay.”
After a quick bath, Jack changed his clothes and came out to see Justin lying on the bed, smiling as he chatted on his phone.
“Take a look at the group chat, Jack. There’s something good.”
“What good stuff?” Jack went over, picked up the phone, and opened the chat app to find that there were already 99+ unread messages in the 3-9 Chat Group.
In confusion, he opened the group to see Crystal Leinster and the others chatting merrily.
After they got off the plane, they too were attacked, just like Jack and his group. During the fight, Crystal had bravely killed more than a dozen rebels, showing none of the meekness one might expect from a girl.
But what surprised everyone most was that Freya Louise had sniped a Third Layer Heaven believer.
Yes, sniped.
The girls in the chat group had posted many photos, including Crystal standing on an Armored Car with a long sword, looking heroic, and Mandy Leinster standing with her sword sheathed.
What was rather unusual was Freya’s photo.
In the photo, the girl was wearing a Dark Red Armor and carrying a sniper “gun” that was over 2 meters long and 30mm thick, looking very sci-fi and incredibly cool.
Jack Clark: “@Freya, what’s going on? Why are we given cold weapons while you have a sniper cannon?”
Freya: “[Playful] Didn’t I tell you before? My Cultivation Method is special.”
Jack Clark, speechless: “…And this is what you call ‘special’? Could it be that your True Martial Arts is called Gunfight Skill?”
Mandy Leinster popped in, curious: “What is Gunfight Skill?”
“Just something I made up.” Jack coughed.
Freya explained: “I’m following a special cultivation path. My Cultivation Method can mask my own murderous intent and aura, and lock onto the aura of enemies from a distance.”
“With such a Cultivation Method, I don’t have much face-to-face combat power, but 1 can deliver much more damage at my level by using special firearms.”
“For example, I could silently kill enemies two kilometers away with this 28mm caliber anti-material sniper ‘gun’, using special armor-piercing bullets.”
“Even a Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator might be killed if they’re caught off guard.”
“Aside from that, this gun of mine can also be used as a cannon. If shot continuously with burning explosive bullets, it can actually demolish a building in a short amount of time.”
After Freya finished her explanation, the entire chat group went silent.
Jack, stunned: “Won’t this be cheating?”
Freya: “[Sticking out tongue] This gun of mine was originally prepared by my aunt for my second-grade trials. It is meant for hunting large Mutated Beasts.” “And there’s a cost to taking this route too. Initial power is weak, and it’s only after breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven that you have real combat power.”
“In fact, this kind of Cultivation Method is already mature within the military. Some strong people use specially developed cutting-edge weapons and can even kill terrifying Giant Beasts that a Hydrogen Bomb can’t.”
Crystal Leinster: “I’ve heard you mention this in the afternoon, but I’m still unsatisfied.”
Matt Watkins: “Yeah. While we’re struggling on the front line, you killed a Third Layer Heaven cultist in the back with ease. That’s 10 Contribution Points for you.”
After this, the chat group was bombarded with comments against Freya.
Can’t help it. Her weapon was just too overpowered..

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 65: The Desire for Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: The Desire for Destruction
Translator: 549690339
After condemning Freya Louise’s weapon, everyone exchanged their experiences in being attacked and fighting today.
Although the temporary team was disbanded just as it started, sharing information on both sides still had some usefulness.
For example, the cultists who attacked Crystal Leinster’s group were different from those they encountered, as their skin would turn black and their muscles would bulge in combat, having strong strength and defense.
It seemed that the sect followers were not from the same faction or church as the Evil God Sect Cultists here.
By the time they had finished chatting, it was already 10 PM. While Justin Welan was still playing on his mobile phone, Jack Clark put down his phone, staring at the ceiling in deep thought.
After seeing Freya Louise’s sniper ‘cannon,’ he wondered whether he should prioritize increasing his defense when he had more attribute points later on.
Jack Clark hadn’t thought about this before he encountered the cultists, but today’s sudden battle made him feel a strong sense of crisis.
For advanced cultivators with True Power Protection, the threat of ordinary firearms could be ignored, but that’s not the case for low-level cultivators like them.
For example, this afternoon, without the battle armor prepared by the school in advance, no one would dare to charge against the sweep of rifles, submachine guns, and even heavy machine guns.
Although they had already broken through to the Second Layer Heaven, even the weakest of them had a physique seven times stronger than an ordinary person, they were still made of flesh and blood, unable to withstand bullets capable of penetrating a few millimeters of iron.
However, battle armor could only defend against ordinary bullets, not against special weapons, such as the enhanced ‘Desert Eagle’ of that cultist and Freya Louise’s sniper cannon.
Especially for snipers like Freya Louise hiding in the dark, the threat to freshmen like Jack Clark from the Second Layer Heaven was even more significant.
After all, when facing a cultist attack, one could choose to resist head-on, fight or retreat, but if targeted from a hidden position, death or heavy injury would follow.
“Let’s see the effects of strengthening a few points at that time.” Jack Clark made up his mind, closed his eyes, and was immersed in observing the Heavy Armored Beast.
Thousands of kilometers away, by the broad estuary of a river, a hideous black Unique Beast emerged from its lair and disappeared into the water, stirring up mud and sand.
As the Heavy Armored Beast grew in size, its defense and strength also skyrocketed under the influence of its talent, making this once somewhat dangerous estuary its hunting ground.
Bang!
Underwater, the splash exploded as the Heavy Armored Beast slapped out a claw, smashing half of the head of a regular Mutated Fish more than 3 meters long.
Crack!
The Heavy Armored Beast bit out a blood hole the size of a washbasin and chewed with its upper and lower jaws. The thick blood mixed with fish meat residues spilled from its teeth, looking fierce and terrifying.
The 3-meter-long Mutated Fish weighed about two hundred kilograms, which the Heavy Armored Beast devoured in less than ten minutes.
Jack Clark could keenly feel that as the energy was transformed, the Heavy Armored Beast’s cells throughout its body were constantly dividing and compressing, and its body expanded visibly, defying biological growth rules.
The outer armor became thicker and harder.
Still not enough.
Feeling the sense of emptiness within, Jack Clark… The Heavy Armored Beast’s tail slightly swayed, continuing to patrol the deep water in search of its next prey.
Freshwater and seawater mixed here in the wide, deep river that bred numerous ferocious freshwater fish and some Mutated Sea Fish that could adapt to freshwater occasionally appeared.
As the Heavy Armored Beast swam a few kilometers away, a shadow more than five meters long loomed nearby, its massive body exuding a sense of oppression.
This Mutated Fish had thick scales all over its body, resembling a grouper but more massive. The fanged teeth in its slightly open mouth were intimidating.
As soon as this fish appeared, the small fishes around it scattered.
However, the Heavy Armored Beast’s eyes brightened.
Looking at the Heavy Armored Beast lunging like a crocodile, the Mutated Grouper remained calm. When the Heavy Armored Beast was about two meters away from it, its mouth suddenly swelled several times larger.
Boom!
A terrifying suction force came from the Mutated Grouper’s mouth, and in an instant, the water within a few meters’ range in front of it collapsed into a vortex, swallowing the Heavy Armored Beast along.
This was the grouper’s hunting skill: suddenly opening its mouth wide when approaching its prey, using the water discharged from its gills to create potent devouring power to swallow its prey.Now that it had mutated, its devouring power had become even more formidable, almost transforming into a natural talent that allowed it to swallow everything within several meters.
Once prey was swallowed, the inner teeth inside it would tear and eat the prey, like…
Boom!
The mutated grouper, which had swallowed more than half of the Heavy Armored Beast’s body, struggled wildly, stirring the surrounding water chaotically.
At the same time, scarlet blood gushed out from its gill area, turning the surrounding water red in the blink of an eye and emitting a strong smell of blood.
Thud! The mutated grouper’s head was torn in half, and the blood-soaked Heavy Armored Beast slowly crawled out, just like when it had killed the large catfish before.
Thanks to its terrifying defense, the Heavy Armored Beast’s favorite thing was when these mutated fish swallowed it, allowing it to kill them without much effort.
Clutching the massive mutated grouper corpse, the Heavy Armored Beast began to eat.
Today was another blissful day, a chance to eat its fill.
Meanwhile, many small fish were attracted by the scent of blood and swarmed towards the Heavy Armored Beast.
Whenever the Heavy Armored Beast chewed and bit, they scrambled for the scraps of flesh and blood that overflowed from its mouth, and they were swallowed by the Heavy Armored Beast while feasting.
The next morning, more than twenty freshmen in black-red armor gathered outside the hotel, each carrying their heavy weapons.
Lori Parma and the other three teachers stood at the front, with seven second lieutenants in military uniforms behind them.
Looking at the refreshed students who had rested for a night, Lori Parma said solemnly, “From today on, you will be divided into seven groups, with four people in each group.”
“Your mission is to cooperate with the patrol teams and search according to the requirements of the area, finding the cultists hidden in the crowd.”
“Remember, every single one of these cultists has blood on their hands and is beyond redemption. Kill them mercilessly once you find them.”
“As for the rebels, they can be captured alive after neutralizing the threat, provided they surrender and stop resisting.”
“This is a special bone from the Blood God Sect, whose aura can help you quickly identify hidden Blood God Cultists in the crowd.”
There was a table in front of everyone, on which was a red bone a meter long, half a meter wide, and seemingly part of a spine from some giant creature.
“Is this blood bone?”
Curious, Justin Welan walked over, only to be assailed by a thick, blood-curdling evil scent, which forced him to retreat quickly.
Lori Parma continued, “In addition, each team will have an advanced cultivator secretly following you, including me and the three teachers. You don’t have to worry about encountering advanced cultivators.”
“But our target is the fanatics who may appear. We won’t care about ordinary cultists; you and the soldiers in your team will deal with them.”
“If you encounter a Fourth Layer Heaven fanatic attacking, everyone can choose to retreat immediately. Don’t make futile resistance; the gap between the Second Layer Heaven and them is too great.”
“Also, I have put some high-level resources with unlocked permissions in the Trial Group. There are introductions for each resource, and you can consider exchanging them later.”
“Besides, if you have any questions about cultivation during your rest time, you can ask me or Teacher Lyons in the group chat…”
Lori Parma then reminded everyone of several other details, after which a staff member distributed a portable micro-camera and wireless earpiece to each person.
Afterward, the teams were formed. Jack Clark and Justin Welan, along with two other male students, formed a temporary team.
One of them was Zac Lyons, who had ranked 50th in the Martial Arts Arena, and the other was called White Veil. The four followed Second Lieutenant Carl Raven and left.
It was finally time for a massacre. Jack’s eyes slightly reddened.
He didn’t know if it was because half of his soul was human and the other half was a mutated beast, but as he continued to hunt and devour, his desire for destruction and rampage grew stronger within him.
This was also the reason he had chosen to participate in the trial.
Too much restraint could accumulate stress and stir up unbearable emotions.
If not vented, something might go wrong one day, like….

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 66: Ambush and Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Ambush and Kill
Translator: 549690339
“Currently, most of the top rebels and Evil God Sect members have been suppressed, and all cities are under Federation control.”
“However, many rebels did not give up after they dispersed, and with the support of the Evil God Sect, they started to launch guerrilla attacks on the Federation.”
“Because we are short of manpower and some cultivators and Evil God Sect cultists have infiltrated the rebels, our military’s patrol teams have suffered some casualties recently.”
On the way to join their squad, Second Lieutenant Jason Raven briefed Jack Clark and the others on the current situation.
Soon, they arrived at their ‘squad.’
Seeing the ten armored cars equipped with machine guns and machine gun cannons and two sci-fi-like main battle tank squads before them, Jack Clark and the other three were shocked.
They originally thought it would be a patrol team of a dozen or so people, but they didn’t expect such fierce equipment.
Jason Raven complained, “For us, facing the rebels head-on would be a piece of cake. The real trouble comes from those cultivators hiding in the dark.”
“They hide among ordinary people, and it’s difficult to predict their sudden attacks. If they miss, they take advantage of the complex terrain to escape, and their speed is so fast that we can’t catch up.”
“There are also those who hide in civilian houses far away and use rockets and sniper rifles to attack us. Although these ordinary weapons don’t have much power, they are very troublesome.”
“We can’t use heavy artillery since we need to protect ordinary people, and we can’t chase them on foot either. That’s why those guys have become increasingly arrogant in the past few days.”
Jack Clark nodded, “Second Lieutenant Raven, we understand your concern. We’ll deal with those cultivators hidden in the crowd, and you’ll deal with the rebels.”
In his perception, the soldiers here emitted a First Layer Heaven Qi Blood aura, which was stable and heavy.
This was a special Federation Cultivation Method that mainly focused on strengthening the body and assisting with various powerful weapons. Once they formed a battle formation as a group, their firepower would be terrifying.
But their individual combat abilities were weak, at least before breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Unlike Martial Height School, which aimed to cultivate geniuses, the military emphasized teamwork, and most people who joined the military had average talent.
After all, the geniuses had already been discovered during high school. They joined the military after high school graduation because their talent was insufficient, but they were unwilling to live an ordinary life.
Jason Zhang told Jack Clark about these general facts when he asked earlier, but he didn’t go into detail on specific information.
Jason Raven politely said, “We’ll need your help when the time comes.”
Justin Welan smirked, “Actually, 1 prefer charging under a hail of bullets and smashing those guys to pieces with my shield.”
…Hearing his words, Jack Clark and Zac Lyons, the White Veil, ignored him.
No wonder, he was wearing bulletproof black armor and carrying a heavy alloy shield that was more than ten centimeters thick. Under those circumstances, even heavy gunfire could not harm him.
But could the others withstand that?
At this time, Zac Lyons, who had previously talked to Jack and ranked 50th in the Martial Arts Arena, asked doubtfully, “Second Lieutenant Raven, aren’t there any strong cultivators in the military?”
“There are, but they form separate special squads and are not located here.”
After the briefing, the convoy set off. Two main battle tanks were positioned at the front and rear, sandwiching ten armored cars in the middle, while the four of them took positions in the off-road convertible vehicles in front and back.
Soon, the armored convoy left the bustling military-controlled area and entered the ordinary urban area filled with low-rise flat houses.
A sense of desolation, bleakness, and gloom suddenly engulfed them.
After more than three months of chaos, the city’s economy had deteriorated. Only a few scattered vendors could be seen along the roadside, selling various daily necessities.
Although there were some people on the streets, most of them hurried along with sallow faces, showing signs of malnutrition.
As the Federation military’s armored convoy passed by, the people’s faces showed awe, while some children curiously looked at the soldiers in the vehicles.
Especially the four men in black armor, who were either sitting or standing on the front and back off-road convertible vehicles, their tall and sturdy figures attracted much attention.
This was the purpose of the patrol team: deterrence.
When ordinary people saw the Federation’s military patrolling daily and the rebels hiding in the dark like rats, the space for the rebels to survive among the public would shrink.Moreover, the Federation military is only responsible for suppressing the chaos, and a new system composed of local residents is being established.
When the new official system is established later, and various legal systems are in favor of ordinary people, the rebels will have nowhere to hide because the entire Koroya will be their enemy.
The rebels also understand this, so they have been constantly creating chaos with the Evil God Sect Cultists recently, trying to deter and delay.
Soon, the convoy entered a narrow street, with pedestrians and low bungalows on both sides, and Jack Clark, who was standing on the off-road vehicle, changed his expression slightly.
“Be careful!” In a low shout, feeling the impending danger, Jack Clark’s silhouette flashed as he jumped off the off-road vehicle.
Just as he shouted, a rocket roared from more than thirty meters away, completely disregarding the life and death of the ordinary people around him.
But at this moment, a small device on the first main battle tank emitted a red beam, and the beam flashed past the rocket, causing it to explode in mid-air.
Bang!
The hot fireball burst open, and the powerful explosive shockwave mixed with metal fragments radiated in all directions, sweeping through a range of tens of meters. Two ordinary people on the roadside screamed in pain when caught in the explosion.
Jack Clark’s gaze swept over the small device on the tank, and a touch of surprise flashed in his eyes before he shouted, “Leave the guy thirty-five meters away to me.”
Having said that, the muscles in his legs swelled slightly, and with a Power Explosion, Jack Clark burst out with terrifying speed, turning into a black shadow and instantly crossing more than thirty meters.
With a thud, Jack Clark stepped on a red brick and leaped up to the two-story rooftop.
There, a dark-skinned middle-aged man frantically dropped the rocket launcher and grabbed the automatic rifle hanging on his chest, wanting to shoot at Jack Clark.
But…
Puff! The sharp Sword Skill tore through the air, and with a flash of white light, the man was instantly killed by Jack Clark.
Boom!
At this moment, the wall of the staircase room on Jack Clark’s side collapsed, and a burly figure rushed towards Jack Clark from the dust, his whole body exuding a strong murderous aura.
It was clear that this was a premeditated ambush.
The convoy behind was also attacked again, and several fierce shadows rose from the panicked crowd and pounced on the armored vehicles, trying to attack the soldiers inside.
Justin Welan and the other three jumped off the vehicle and blocked them with their Blood Qi bursting.
At the same time, many armed rebels appeared on the surrounding bungalows, and the sound of gunfire erupted, creating chaos all around.
Countless gravel splashed and fell on the battle armor, making a crackling sound. Amidst the smoke and dust, a spark erupted as Jack Clark blocked an attack with both hands holding the sword.
Immediately afterwards, he counterattacked with a wind-whistling slash.
Clang clang clang!!
Knife lights tore through the air amidst the smoke and dust, creating a piercing whistling sound. The friction between the blade and the air produced a red light that caused dazzling sparks to burst open continuously.
Boom! Suddenly, the burly figure rolled out from the dust and landed at the edge of the rooftop two feet away.
“How is it possible? Wasn’t he just a Second Layer Heaven freshman?!” The burly man with a large machete in hand looked shocked and doubtful in front of him.
Jack Clark stood there with a cold expression in his eyes, holding the sword and said, “Another Second Layer Heaven Peak cultivator, but you’re not a cultist of the Evil God Sect.”
Unlike the cultist he had killed yesterday, this man had demonstrated an extremely solid cultivation foundation during the battle just now.
His physique and True Strength had reached the Second Heaven Peak, and every move he made unleashed a terrifying power of nearly 4,000 kg. The degree of True Strength condensation was not less than Jack Clark’s.
On top of that, his Sword Skill, as proficient as instinct, had withstood more than ten moves from Jack Clark in an instant without being at a disadvantage.
If it had been Justin Welan or Zac Lyons, that strike might have actually caught them off guard and inflicted heavy injuries if not death.
Unfortunately, he met Jack Clark, whose intuition had sensed the hidden murderous intent from the side the moment he jumped onto the rooftop.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s eyes slowly turned red, filled with an intense desire for slaughter. Regardless of whether he was an Evil God Sect Cultist or not, he would kill first and ask questions later..

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 67: 67: Be Stronger
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Be Stronger
Translator: 549690339
The burly man, looking at Jack whose killing intent was soaring, licked his lips, his murderous intent becoming even more intense: “Kid, you must be among the top-most talented in the new students, right?”
In their information, these Senior One trial freshmen have only cultivated for two months, each just having made a breakthrough to the Second Layer Heaven – all of them geniuses.
But the youth in front of him, having just entered the Second Layer Heaven, was able to put up a fight against him. This kind of person would definitely belong to the most talented in school.
“The most talented?” Jack’s lips curled into a playful smile, “I’m only ranked 49th on the school’s new student ranking. What do you think about that?” “What, how is that possible!”
The burly man couldn’t believe it. A genius who managed to breakthrough to the Second Layer Heaven in just two months and whose combat power is comparable to the Second Heaven Peak, was ranked only 49th!?
So just how monstrous are the ones in the front?
And these are just freshmen from a first-class university in the Eastern Summer Country of the Federation. Has the Eastern Summer become this terrifying?
Or is it that the Koroya people are too incompetent, not being able to breakthrough to the Second Layer Heaven after cultivating for over a decade?
In a moment, the burly man’s life was thrown into doubt by a simple sentence from Jack.
Jack was not interested in wasting time with him, his voice icy, “Now it’s your turn to take my strike.”
As Jack let out a low roar, his muscles bulged and his whole body suddenly expanded. A brutal and overbearing aura burst out, resembling an enraged elephant.
Boom!
Tattoos appeared on Jack’s body. With a stomp, the floor shook and he instantly transformed into a black afterimage. His ears were filled with the shrieking of a raging wind due to his extreme speed, resembling thunder.
In his hand, the two-meter-long straight blade struck so swiftly that its physical form almost disappeared, transforming into a red and white light appearing above the burly man’s head.
Simply terrifying speed. It was so fast that the burly man’s consciousness almost couldn’t react, and the red and white light from the blade sent him into a panic.
Under the threat of death, he instinctively raised his knife to block.
Boom! The burly man’s face changed instantly as their knives touched. He felt an unstoppable force, akin to an avalanche or a tsunami.
Crack!
Under the terrifying force, the burly man’s knife fiercely sank and crushed his shoulder blade. Following that, under the overwhelming force of the avalanche and tsunami, he knelt on the ground.
Splat!
Blood spurted from the burly man’s mouth as he was wounded by the strike, followed by an even more intense aura of death advancing on him.
He had no time to react. A red and white light instantly crossed his neck.
Jack, having instantly killed the burly man, didn’t change his gaze. His figure flickered as he dived from the building. The moment he landed, he turned into a gust of wind and swept over the street, ordinary people only saw a blurry dark shadow flash.
It was not until then that the burly man’s neck spurted hot blood and his body fell with a heavy thud.
The soldiers on the armored vehicle were controlling the heavy machine guns and cannons to suppress the rebels. The horrifying large-caliber bullets left big holes in the walls.
Especially the cannons.
These ordinary brick houses simply could not withstand the heavy machine gun and cannon fire. They were shattered like rubble, along with the rebels behind them.
Boom!
At this moment the main tank unleashed a blast of fire, collapsing an abandoned building dozens of meters away, burying the machine gunner and the rebels inside.
By the time Jack returned, more than half of the dozens of rebels ambushed around had been killed, and the rest were frightened by the terrifying firepower and were fleeing in panic.
As for Justin Welan and the others, they were in a narrow alley chasing four cultists dressed in black robes, attempting to escape through the complex terrain.
Zac Lyons and White Veil were each holding off one Second Heaven Cultist. They held an overall advantage in strength, but the cultists were more experienced, making it difficult for them to take them down quickly.
Justin Welan, dressed in his battle armor and holding a heavy shield, was engaged in combat with two cultists in another alley. His strong defense allowed him to ignore their attacks, but he also found it difficult to take them down quickly.
Because he lacked a strong offensive method, he could only continuously charge and block.
However, if any cultist tried to escape, he would exert his full strength, crashing into them and forcing them to avoid revealing their backs.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s figure blinked in the distance, sprinting over with a whistling wind, and the heavy battle boots landed on the ground, emitting a dull vibration.
Seeing him, Justin Welan’s eyes lit up, and he excitedly said, “Jack, hand over the guy on the left to you.”
“Alright.”bender
Jack Clark’s eyes were icy cold. His figure flickered, covering more than ten meters like a ghost, appearing in front of a somewhat skinny cultist.
Such terrifying speed scared the cultist who held the crescent curved blade and whose aura was in the early stage of Second Layer Heaven. He hurriedly swung several blade shadows at Jack Clark.
Boom! Jack Clark’s right arm muscles swelled, and he swung his blade.
An ear-piercing shriek rose in an instant, tearing through the air and annihilating those blade shadows. The terrifying blow cut the cultist’s curved blade and upper body in two.
Thud!
The broken curved blade and corpse fell to the ground. The blood sprayed out, dyeing the ground red and giving off a strong bloody smell.
Next to the corpse, Jack Clark, in his Dark Red Armor, stood with his blade, emitting an invisible aura of dominance. His murderous aura was intimidating, causing the faces of some civilians peeking from behind their windows to turn pale.
Not only those civilians, but even Justin Welan and the other cultist were frightened by Jack Clark’s power. Everyone was in the Second Layer Heaven, why could you kill him with one slash?
At this time, Jack Clark slightly turned his head to look at the two, an invisible murderous intent in his eyes sent chills down their spines.
The cultist fighting Justin Welan tensed up suddenly, and his reaction slowed down.
Justin Welan would naturally not miss this opportunity, and his entire physique burst with True Strength.
“Mysterious Martial Heavy Lean.”
With a low shout, Justin Welan’s entire body glowed with an earthy brilliance, and he shot out like a cannonball, his thick shield slamming into the cultist.
With such tremendous force, the cultist was slammed into the wall of a bungalow behind him. The wall instantly collapsed, being punched through by a hole with a diameter of 3 meters.
Or maybe, half the wall had collapsed.
Cough,cough!
After a few dry coughs, a dusty Justin Welan walked out with his shield, with fresh red blood dripping from the shield covered with sharp spikes.
Having killed an enemy, Justin Welan was in a good mood and couldn’t help but joke, “Jack, 1 feel like you, also in the Second Layer Heaven, are several times stronger than me.”
At this time, Jack Clark had already put away his murderous intent. He shook his head slightly, “Several times is exaggerated, I’m only ‘a little’ stronger than you.”
“As for the earlier cultist at the early stage of the Second Layer Heaven, his physique was equivalent to the First Layer Heaven. His blood color True Strength collapsed under my attack, and it’s quite normal for me to kill him with one blow in such a situation.”
“If I had to fight him many rounds before killing him, wouldn’t it show that we’re weak, right?”
Justin Welan wasn’t sure, “…But when you put it that way, it does seem right.”
“Wait a minute, why do I feel like you’re calling me weak?”
“Mr. Willard, you’re different. Your main Cultivation Method is defense, not strong in attack, being able to pin down two cultists just now already proves your strength.”
“That’s more like it…” The two of them walked out of the alley at this point.
Looking at the two of them covered with dust, Carl Raven jumped down from the Armored Car, expressing concern, “Are you two ok?”
“We’re fine.”
Carl Raven’s face revealed a smile, “That’s good to hear. It was fortunate you were there, otherwise, those guys would have definitely managed to escape after a little disturbance.”
Meanwhile, Zac Lyons and White Veil also finished off their opponents and walked over, their bodies emitting a bloody smell.
Everyone waited for a moment, and the newly formed law enforcement team arrived. They were in charge of post-battle cleanup while Jack Clark and the others continued their patrol.
It seemed that the fight just now was but a minor episode..

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 68: 68: Gods Creation Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Gods Creation Plan
Translator: 549690339
At the same time when Jack Clark and his squad were being attacked, another squad led by Howard Lee in the other part of the city also encountered an assault.
The attackers were still a combination of rebels and ordinary cultivators, catching the squad off guard.
As both convoys were engaged in battle, a flying vessel resembling a airship floated at an altitude of ten thousand meters over the city, with several officers looking down from above.
Behind them, more than a dozen staff members were busily working in front of computers, with some of the sci-fi equipment constantly flashing with colorful lights.
“Report, the energy detector has detected two unfamiliar Fourth Layer Heaven fluctuations, but the other party is cunning and didn’t give us a chance to lock on.”
“In the citywide fixed-point lightwave detection, several suspicious moving crowds have been detected in the south of the city, and the Falcon Squad has been called to keep track.”
“Report, no suspicious targets were found around squad Al and A 5 during the attack.”
“Traces of a small group of rebels were found outside Ross Town, 47 kilometers east of the city. Shall we dispatch a mixed ground-air team to suppress them?”
“Keep monitoring, don’t worry about rhe small group of rebels. Our target is the main force of the Blood God Sect that fled here. Don’t scare rhe snakes off prematurely/’
“Yes.”
On the rooftop of the highest building in Lester City, General Laird Hawk, dressed in a military uniform, stood at rhe edge with a telescope, looking over the surroundings.
After a long time, Laird Hawk said in a deep voice, “These guys hide really well.
With so many ‘geniuses’ showing up, they still can control themselves from taking action/’
The adjutant next to him nodded slightly, “The people of the Evil God Sect have always been good at hiding. They’ve been working secretly for years, and only stood up this time.”
“Now that the Blood God Sect and the Giant God Sect were hit by the Federation’s Thunder, most of their experts were killed, and the rest became frightened birds.”
“These two days, our multiple attempts to bait them only lured out some ordinary cultists and it might be difficult to find them in the short term/’bender
“Also, I feel that the experts who followed the convoy should have been exposed, otherwise, only two squads would have been attacked. The ones they hate the most are the Federal Genius.”
Laird Hawk nodded slightly, “Your analysis makes sense, bur as long as they don’t want to give up the Koroya pathway, they won’t be able to hide for long.”
“By the way, rhe higher-ups are preparing to use this place as a trial point for the new generation, getting ready for the upcoming Gods Creation Plan/1
“Also, have the Logistics Department equip those freshmen with some auxiliary weapons. In rhe civilized era, the battles are still just about slashing each other, their techniques are too simple.”
Jack Clark and Justin Welan stood on the off-road vehicle in the middle of the squad, their eyes occasionally scanning the pedestrians with awe on rhe side of the road, wary of possible enemies.
At this moment, the Shield-wielding Justin Welan said enviously, “Jack, you’ve already killed three cultists, right? All of them are Second Layer Heaven.”
According to the school’s given price, a Second Layer Heaven cultist is worth 3 Contribution Points. That is to say, Jack Clark earned 9 points in just two days.
It was equivalent to the reward he received for two months at school.
“Not bad, just good luck,” Jack Clark smiled.
Although 9 Contribution Points seemed a lot, it was actually only equivalent to 9,000 dollars. In the blackmarket, it’s tens of thousands. And this stuff came from the lives of three Second Layer Heaven experts.
When calculated like this, one would find that the values of both sides were completely unequal.
However, many times the “price” cannot be calculated like this because Contribution Points can be exchanged for officially monopolized cultivation resources, which cannot be bought even with money.
Contribution Points can only be obtained through schools or official channels. No matter how rich you are, you can’t convert money into Contribution Points.
There won’t be a situation where a tycoon donates millions to the government and can get thousands of Contribution Points to waste at will.
In the High Martial Era, the rich were just wealthy. It was those peak powerhouses who controlled power and resources – those king-level existences that changed the colors of Heaven and Earth with a single thought.
This is also why people like Justin Welan, Matt Watkins, and others need to go to school.
Moreover, the exchange of high-level resources requires authorization. Ordinary cultivators don’t have the qualifications for exchanging high-level resources, so even if the rich can get some Contribution Points, they can only get low-level resources.
Justin Welan rolled his eyes, “I knew you would say that, “just luck,’ “not bad,’ what a ghost!.”
Facing Justin Welan”s complaints, Jack Clark just smiled and then reminded him, “Alright, we’ll talk more when we get back. Pay attention to our surroundings.”
“Yes.” Justin Welan”s countenance turned solemn, and he concentrated on his surroundings .Although they looked cool standing on the off-road vehicle, it was actually quite dangerous. If the enemy had sniper rifles, they would be the first targets, not the soldiers inside the Armored Car.
It was evident that they were treated as another type of bait, and most of the Freshmen noticed this.
However, no more attacks occurred during the morning.
At noon, everyone returned to the hotel to eat and rest.
According to the schedule, Jack Clark and the others had no tasks in the afternoon, and everyone could stay in the hotel to cultivate or team up to search for cultist tracks actively.
If it were in school, these students might rest after cultivating for two hours, but after experiencing continuous battles, everyone felt a sense of urgency.
Desperately wanting to get stronger.
As a result, Justin Welan and the others went to the Military Base for cultivation in the afternoon, but Jack came to the basement level one.
The hotel had been requisitioned as a lodging base for supporting students from various schools, and the underground garage was also converted, sealed off, and turned into the Logistics Department.
Seeing the youth coming out of the elevator, the female staff member behind the desk enthusiastically said, “Hello, what would you like to exchange?”
“I have an 80% discount exchange privilege at school. Can 1 use it here?” Jack asked.
The female staff member smiled and said, “Yes, both the school system and the military base here are connected to the Heavenly Intelligence System, and the privileges are universal.”
Jack nodded, “That’s good. I want to exchange two Level 1 Life Crystals.”
“Okay, please enter your school and Student ID on the computer for verification.”
Jack sat in front of the computer and entered South Sky Martial Height and his Student ID as required.
“Verification passed, please wait a moment.”
Soon, two white multifaceted small crystals appeared in Jack’s hand.
“By the way, Student Clark, here is a set of battle auxiliary items prepared by the military for you. Please check it.”
“Battle auxiliary items.” Jack was slightly startled, looking at the female staff member taking our a briefcase-sized box from the shelf behind her.
The female staff member put the briefcase on the table and reminded, “The items inside are explosive, please handle them carefully, and there’s an instruction manual after you open it.”
Explosives. Jack’s expression changed, and he did not dare to be careless.
Carrying the briefcase, Jack returned to the hotel room before deciding to exchange with his realm of thought.
Two life crystals were enveloped by an Invisible Power, silently turned into powder, but only 8 Points Attribute were converted this time.
Glancing at the attribute page, Jack focused his attention on rhe small box on the table, curious about what was inside.
Click! The briefcase was opened, and inside quietly lay nine differently shaped metal items, a sci-fi-style pistol, and an instruction manual.
“Triggered High-Explosive Metal Bomb, suitable for long-range delivery, explodes upon impact after disarming, effective killing range of 5 meters, shockwave coverage of 10 meters.”
“Sticky delayed bomb, suitable for special operations, can be attached to target objects with a choice of 3 seconds, 5 seconds, or 10 seconds delayed explosion, extremely strong penetration/’
“Induction Shock Bomb, suitable for long-range delivery, forms a shockwave instantly upon explosion, highly penetrating, extremely lethal to Fourth Layer Heaven organisms and below.”
“Black Steel Automatic Pistol, 20mm caliber, maximum ammunition capacity of 9 bullets, bullets propelled by special metal explosives, strong recoil, can blow up a regular Mutated Beast’s skull in one shot.”
“This item is given out for free for the first time, subsequent bombs and bullets can be exchanged with Contribution Points.”
After reading the instructions, Jack was a bit surprised, “The military’s newbie package? Bombs and pistols.”
Jack picked up the pistol, which was more like a hand cannon, and played with it for a while. With these items, they had more options in combat.
Whether it was the bombs or the Black Steel Pistol, they were small and did not affect carrying or switching use. Enemy would likely be caught off guard easily.
After examining for a while, Jack pur down the gun and prepared to do something serious. He hesitated as he looked ar rhe battle armor placed in the corner of the room.
His hesitation was whether to accumulate a few more days, save up 20 attribute points to strengthen Dragon Elephant Power and break through the Third Realm, or strengthen the defense of rhe battle armor first.
But after only a brief hesitation, Jack’s eyes became determined..

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 69: Enchantment
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Enchantment
Translator: 549690339
With Jack Clark’s current strength, he can even slay Third Layer Heaven believers, and rely on more than a hundred agility points to compete with Third Layer Heaven renegade cultivators.
Therefore, there is no urgent need for a major increase in combat power. Of course, these attribute points can’t strengthen much either.
On the other hand, he has always been a bit uneasy about defense.
He is most afraid of being targeted by the rebels’ sniper rifles, especially anti-equipment weapons equipped with armor-piercing bullets that can shoot several times faster than the speed of sound and can penetrate steel plates 20mm thick.
If he is locked onto by his enemies during battle, even if he senses the danger in advance, he may not be able to react in time.
The two battles he faced were not too bad; the enemies used rocket attacks with obvious weapons. With their speed, they didn’t give the enemy a chance to fire a second shot.
But what about next time? After all, they, these freshmen, are easily targeted at first.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark placed his hand on the battle armor and said in his mind, “Consume 2 attribute points and strengthen the battle armor.”
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, the remaining attribute points on the attribute page became 6, and at the same time, an Invisible Power enveloped the black-red armor.
In silence, the armor seemed slightly darker.
The armor didn’t seem to have changed much, but when Jack Clark picked it up, he found that it had become more ‘heavy’, giving him a sense of solidity.
Boom! Jack Clark tapped the armor with his fingers and made a dull sound.
Just strengthening it by 2 points didn’t make much of a difference. Jack Clark pondered for a moment, and continued the voice in his mind: “Consume all attribute points, strengthen the battle armor.”
Buzz!
After strengthening the armor by six attribute points at once, the air around the armor emitted a faint hum, and a faint gleam flashed across it.
After this strengthening, the surface of the armor seemed slightly dull, giving people a profound feeling. In addition, the overall structure of the armor seemed to have undergone subtle changes.
Fortunately, there was not much change in appearance, just a faint sense of oppression. This change seemed normal after being tempered by the battles and bloodshed of the past few days.
As Jack Clark was looking at the strengthened armor, two rows of transparent text appeared in front of him.
“Made of ordinary alloy and soft steel wire, the current sturdy attribute of this full body armor is +8, which is a normal Transcendent item with decent defense.”
“The surface alloy can withstand ordinary sniper bullets, the inner steel wire can stop armor-piercing bullets, and the helmet can withstand sniper armor-piercing bullet attacks.”
“Note: Due to material limitations, the maximum sturdiness attribute can be strengthened by io points. To further improve the quality of the item, it can be infused with advanced materials.”
“It unexpectedly became a Transcendent item directly.” Jack Clark showed a satisfied expression on his face.
The effect after strengthening did not disappoint him. The body armor can now withstand sniper bullets, making him no longer worry about being targeted with sniper rifles.
Moreover, this kind of strengthening is somewhat similar to enchanting, without making significant changes to the overall appearance.
At this moment, Jack Clark glanced at the straight blade placed on the table and thoughtfully said, “The strengthening effect of the defense is so good, what about the blade?”
The F Grade straight blade is known for its sturdiness, and its sharpness is not much different from ordinary steel blades.
If the attribute points were used to strengthen it to the point of cutting iron like mud, a careless Third Layer Heaven cultivator might be cut in half together with their weapon.
But after thinking about it for a moment, Jack Clark shook his head and put the thought behind him.
It’s still too early to consider these things. He should first increase his cultivation to the Third Layer Heaven, and by then, with the continuous enhancement of his Constitution provided by the Avatar, he would be among the strongest in the Third Layer Heaven.
Next, Jack Clark sat cross-legged and began to practice Dragon Elephant Power…
Huh?
After just performing two rotations of the Cultivation Methods, Jack Clark exclaimed in surprise, because he found that the cultivation effect here was much worse, and the concentration of Transcendent energy between the Heaven and Earth was too low.
If the concentration of Transcendent energy in Mist River City was io, it might only be 1 here.
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, frowning, “Is this the reason for the poor cultivation environment that Mr. Welan mentioned?”
But the question is, why is the concentration of Transcendent energy so low here on the same planet, while the concentration is so high in Eastern Summer?!ack Clark was somewhat puzzled for a moment.
“That’s right.” Jack suddenly thought of something, took out his mobile phone and opened the Trial Class Group. Sure enough, he found that some classmates were discussing this issue as well.
At the same time, the official solution had already been prepared.
Lori Parma mentioned before they set off that he had issued a list of senior resources with unlocked permissions, which included an energy crystal that could only be exchanged at the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Unlike Life Crystals from Mutated Beasts that can strengthen the constitution, Energy Crystals are pure energy aggregates that come from special mineral veins.
They contain pure energy that can be absorbed by cultivators to accelerate cultivation or quickly recover True Strength, and have no other effects.
However, due to its scarcity, this type of crystal is a strategic resource and can only be exchanged by those who are officially recognized and have reached the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Moreover, the officials were quite generous this time, as the energy crystals, which originally cost fifteen Contribution Points, could be exchanged for just five points, equivalent to a 30% discount.
Besides, considering that these freshmen have not yet earned enough Contribution Points, they could even buy on credit.
However, each person could only exchange for two crystals a month, and any excess would be normal price. Under normal circumstances, a Second Layer Heaven cultivator wouldn’t use up the energy of a single crystal in a month.
Having read the information about the energy crystals, Jack flipped through the list again and even saw Giant Beast Essence and Blood, but the contribution points required for the exchange were too high.
Moreover, for him, no cultivation resources could compare to the attribute points converted from Life Crystals.
About half an hour later, Jack put down his phone and planned to go to the Logistics Department for an energy crystal on credit after dinner.
Seeing that it was still early, Jack sank his consciousness and arrived at the Heavy Armored Beast’s location.
At the bottom of the river where it flows into the sea, a black, ferocious Unique Beast slowly lifted its head from the muddy sand, using its limbs to stir up the rolling mud.
As a month passed, the Heavy Armored Beast’s body became increasingly ferocious and thick, with stout and sharp limbs, appearing like a heavily armored lizard or crocodile from afar.
Also, as it continued to slaughter, an aura of violence and tyranny gradually enveloped its body, scaring away many small fish and shrimp that approached it.
For instance, now, as the Heavy Armored Beast passed by, two meters long “small fishes” were suddenly frightened, instantly swimming out more than ten meters away with a flick of their tails.
Fortunately, the Heavy Armored Beast disdained eating these common fish, and with a cold glance, continued searching for those mutated ferocious fish.
In the evening, a sweaty Justin Welan opened the door to his room and saw Jack sitting in front of the window. Thinking he was cultivating, he shouted, “Jack, let’s go eat.”
“Is it time to eat already?” Jack slowly opened his eyes.
The two went to the third-floor restaurant one after another, and Jack found that his classmates were also covered in sweat, as if they had gone through a fierce battle.
After getting their food, Jack sat down with his tray and asked curiously, “What were you guys practicing this afternoon? You all look like you’ve been fighting for three days and nights.”
“The concentration of Extraordinary Energy here is too low, and it’s too slow to improve by meditating.”
Justin Welan ate big mouthfuls, his voice muffled, “So we spent the afternoon competing against each other, increasing our combat experience. We fought all afternoon.”
It seemed that everyone was the same.
Justin suddenly said, “By the way, Jack, you’ve seen the resource list on the trial group chat, right? Like energy crystals that can speed up our cultivation.”
“I’ve seen it,” Jack said as he took a bite of ordinary Mutated Beast Meat.
Justin nodded, “I’ve seen it, that’s good. But I don’t recommend you exchange for it.”
“Why?” Jack paused his hand.
Justin mysteriously whispered, “Just trust me. Eat up, and I’ll show you something good when we get back.”
“What’s the good thing?”
“You’ll know soon, don’t worry, brother, I won’t cheat you.”
“Alright then. “

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 70: Innate Desire
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Innate Desire
Translator: 549690339
“Hehe, I’m well prepared for this trial.”
In the room, Justin Welan confidently unzipped his backpack and dug his hand inside, pulling out a fist-sized blue crystal.
“Here, Jack, catch.” Justin tossed the crystal to Jack Clark.
“What is this…”
As soon as Jack caught the blue crystal, he felt a pure energy flowing within it, so rich that it was almost tangible.
However, unlike the Life Crystal, the attribute page had no reaction to this item.
Jack looked at Justin’s backpack: “Is this the good stuff you mentioned when you set off?”
“Yep.”
Justin grinned: “My brother sent me a few Blue Crystals after learning that 1 was coming here for the trial.”
“This is a better resource than the Energy Crystal Body. The energy contained within is more pure and abundant. Generally, only Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators use it.”
“You should know that as Second Layer cultivators, our True Strength is weak, and our refining speed is slow. When we introduce the crystal’s energy into our bodies, about 60% will evaporate and dissipate.”
“That’s why officials restrict low-level cultivators from using it, because it’s too wasteful.”
Jack asked curiously, “So isn’t using Blue Crystals for cultivation even more wasteful for you?”
Justin nodded, “Under normal conditions, that would be true. That’s why my brother coated these Blue Crystals with a special substance.”
“This substance acts like an insulator, preventing the flow of energy and only leaving a tiny, nearly undetectable hole, which is this white dot.”
“With this setup, we won’t draw out too much energy during cultivation, and the waste rate can be maintained at around 30%, which is way more cost-effective than exchanging Energy Crystal Bodies.”
“On top of that, my brother also got me a special resource that can change my physique. As soon as 1 absorb it, my fighting power will skyrocket.”
“Hehe, Jack, 1 wasn’t joking with you. This trial is the beginning of me, Justin Welan, dominating the world.”
Even Jack couldn’t help but be envious at this moment.
Look at that. This was the proper way for a second-generation successor: leaving for a trial well-prepared with full sets of resources.
Such treatment… it’s just too enviable. With a sigh, Jack casually threw the Blue Crystal back to Justin.
Justin quickly caught the Blue Crystal and looked at Jack puzzledly: “Jack, what are you doing? That’s for you.”
“For me? No, you keep it, it’s too valuable.” Jack was surprised, and immediately shook his head in refusal.
A regular crystal at a 30% discount would cost five points. A Blue Crystal would cost at least thirty or forty points each. Although they had a good relationship, Jack felt that it wasn’t quite at that level yet.
Justin nonchalantly said, “My brother gave me several of these Blue Crystals. One is enough for me to cultivate for two months; I can’t use them all.”
“Besides, we’ve gone through a lot together, and we’re good brothers. What’s a single Energy Crystal Body?” Justin forcibly shoved the Blue Crystal into Jack’s hand.
Looking at the valuable Blue Crystal in his hand, Jack bitterly smiled, “Justin, your generosity is putting me in a tough spot, after all, we’re just classmates.”
“Jack, you should know that this kind of resource doesn’t mean much to me, but it’s important for you right now, so there’s no need to refuse.”
“You should save your Contribution Points to exchange for the necessary matching resources, maximizing your results.”
“I consider you a brother. Since the first day of school, 1 felt a strong connection with you.”
Justin said seriously, “My brother used to say that if you meet a like-minded classmate in high school, you should sincerely become friends because that person might become a brother you can trust to have your back.”
“The path of cultivation is long and arduous, and no one can guarantee smooth sailing. Having one or two or a few brothers to support each other makes the journey easier and less lonely.”
“So if you regard me as a brother, just accept it. When you make it big, just remember to leave a share for me. Although, 1 feel that possibility is slim since I’m about to take off.” Justin finished speaking, and then chuckled.
His words left Jack slightly speechless, and in the end, Jack nodded and accepted the Blue Crystal. If he kept refusing, it would seem insincere, so he could find another way to repay Justin later.
“That’s more like it, we’re all men, let’s keep it simple.” Justin laughed when he saw Jack accept the Blue Crystal, then continued explaining.”Actually, if it weren’t for attending this Koroya Trial, my brother wouldn’t have given me these advanced resources, and the official wouldn’t have released the Energy Crystal Bodies.”
“It’s because our body strength is not enough; we can’t digest these high-purity energies.”
“But we have experienced two battles in the past two days. When faced with life-threatening situations, our body’s genes will instinctively release information to become stronger.”
Jack Clark narrowed his eyes: “So, what Matt Watkins mentioned, the potential stimulation?”
“Exactly, in order to ‘survive,’ both the body and the subconscious will desire to become stronger, absorbing all the energy and resources that are beneficial to oneself to the extreme.”
“Under such circumstances, as long as ‘energy’ can keep up, our cultivation speed will be faster than during our time at school.”
“This is also why the school requires all students to participate in Mutated Beast Trials after their sophomore year, but we just got ahead this time.”
“Of course, there are advantages and disadvantages in this situation. For example, we just broke through to the Second Layer Heaven, and maybe we will die at the hands of advanced cultivators tomorrow.”
“So, Jack, work hard to become stronger.”
After reminding Jack Clark, Justin Welan took out another Blue Crystal and a yellow crystal from his bag, holding one in each hand he sat on the bed and started to cultivate with great effort.
That’s the advantage of having high-level cultivators at home. Jack felt a bit envious.
Justin Welan once mentioned that his brother was a high-level cultivator. According to the division of high-level cultivators with Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Layer Heaven, his brother’s strength should be at least above the Seventh Layer Heaven.
In this case, not to mention resources, but even some of the cultivation experience would be much more advantageous than Jack, who is just an ordinary person, making their path of cultivation smoother.
Of course, Jack didn’t feel jealous, after all, it was what they deserved.
Just like his own family, when he becomes a high-level cultivator in a few years, when Glenn Clark enters high school, he will prepare everything for Glenn too.
Moreover, Jack felt that it’s not just Justin Welan, but Mandy Leinster, Crystal Leinster, and Matt Watkins must have been prepared for the trial as well.
Only those from ordinary families, like him, would be completely ignorant of the truth about this trial and unprepared.
Or even if he knew all this, he wouldn’t be able to prepare anything. There’s just no way to do it; his family is neither rich nor well-connected.
As for why the school teachers didn’t tell them this, it’s unnecessary.
After experiencing two battles, anyone would strive hard to cultivate. There is no need for reminders since auxiliary cultivation energy crystals can be obtained on credit beforehand, with no delays.
Feeling emotional, Jack also sat cross-legged, holding the Blue Crystal and began cultivating.
Boom! The moment Jack started to use the Dragon Elephant Power, he felt a vast amount of energy inside the Blue Crystal being disturbed, wanting to rush out crazily.
Then, just as Justin Welan said, the solid coating blocked that energy, leaving only a tiny, almost invisible ‘hole’ for the energy to pass through.
Under the suction force of the Dragon Elephant Power, a strand of tiny but pure energy flowed into Jack’s body. When it touched his True Strength, it instantly exploded, and the dense energy spread and filled his entire body. Gasping!!
The energy was too dense. Jack felt that with each breath he took, his True Strength grew a little more.
The True Strength circulation had an enhanced effect on strengthening his physique, and all his muscles and bones were more eager than ever to absorb energy at a speed several times faster than before.
At this rate, Jack felt that he might be able to break through to the Third Layer Heaven in just four to five months instead of over a year under normal conditions, even without using Attribute points.
Moreover, this was just for him, whose talent was average. It might be even faster for geniuses.
But he cannot refine it all at once. Jack crazily operated his Dragon Elephant Power, trying to refine all the energy inside his body.
However, just as Justin Welan said, their True Strength was weak, and much of the Heavenly Energy in their bodies could not be refined in time. This energy overflowed from the body and then dissipated into the air.
At this moment, Jack, who had never experienced such a wealthy battle before, felt extremely distressed, as it was too wasteful.
This time, he cultivated for almost three hours until his spirit felt tired. Then, he and Justin Welan took turns taking baths and went to ‘rest’ early.
In the middle of the night, Jack woke up on time, and his consciousness plunged into the Heavy Armored Beast. He slowly crawled out of the cave and entered the river to look for a midnight snack….

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71: 71: The Dead
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: The Dead
Translator: 549690339
The next morning, more than twenty freshmen wore black-red armor and gathered outside the hotel with all sorts of exaggeratedly shaped weapons on their backs.
They all had a high-power pistol strapped around their waists and nine differently shaped metal bombs hanging behind them, fully armed and exuding a killing aura.
As for the student who was injured by the grenade, he was still in the medical room for recovery, expected to stay there for a week.
Soon, each team assigned an off-road vehicle with no roof to pick them up, and they all hopped on agilely.
Wearing the battle armor, their bodies were already bulky, not to mention the 2 meters long weapons they carried. They couldn’t even fit into a car with a roof.
Standing on the off-road vehicle, Justin Welan, who was holding a heavy shield, suddenly asked curiously, “Jack, why does your battle armor look better than ours?”
Jack’s Enhanced +8 Armor was relatively darker compared to the other students’, giving a sense of heaviness overall.
Zac Lyons and White Veil also noticed this and showed confusion in their eyes.
Facing this question, Jack smirked slightly, “Because I sprayed a matte film on the armor. How about it? Doesn’t it look much cooler than yours now?”
The armor’s color change was a simple issue, and he casually found a spray paint excuse.
To hide the truth more convincingly, Jack had actually gone to the Logistics Department early in the morning to ask for a can of matte spray paint.
“Damn, bro, you’re a genius! Why didn’t 1 think of that?”
Zac, who already had a carefree personality, beamed with excitement, “After today’s mission, I’ll go get a can of spray paint and turn my armor gold, haha.” White Veil was excited too: “Gold’s too tacky. 1 think silver is cooler.”
Justin Welan chimed in enthusiastically: “No, no, your ideas are too monotonous. 1 think adding a pair of metal wings on the back would be cooler.” …No, are your imaginations getting a little too wild? Jack had a strange feeling that the upcoming test might take a weird turn.
A few minutes later, Jack and his three friends met up with the squad of the armored team.
However, today’s patrol area was further away, closer to the suburbs.
As tanks and armored cars rumbled into the areas with dilapidated roads and worn-down houses, pedestrians and motorcycles quickly made way.
None of the better cars, e.g., sedans, were in sight, which made Jack feel as if he were in a third-world country, a stark contrast to the prosperity of Eastern Summer.
On both sides of the road, the Koroyan civilians watched the armored squad pass with awe.bender
This situation gave Jack a feeling that they were the villains, strutting with cannons and rifles in the underdeveloped Koroya.
Cough! How could that be possible? They were Federation special soldiers here to suppress the Evil God Sect.
Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly in the vehicle as he seemed to be resting his eyes. In reality, he had entered the Heart’s Eye state to sense his surroundings with his sixth sense.
In this state, as long as there was a hostile gaze on him, he could sense it immediately.
However, no enemies appeared until the armored team passed through this area. At that moment, Carl Raven in the leading tank received a command.
“All vehicles, be alert. The fifth team is ambushed and surrounded by a large number of enemies. Come with me for immediate support.”
With the announcement on the walkie-talkie, the leading tank roared as it turned its head, and its speed instantly soared to 8o yards, stirring up billows of smoke and dust on the already dilapidated road.
Jack and his friends were also invigorated and stood up quickly, for enemies meant income.
The fifth team’s patrol area was adjacent to Jack’s, so it took them less than ten minutes to see the flames and hear the explosions and gunfire in the distance.
This was already a suburban area, and up ahead was a relocated and uninhabited urban village.
At the moment, more than two hundred rebels were relying on buildings and traps, trapping the fifth armored team at the street entrance. Two tanks had already lost their mobility, and several armored cars were overturned due to explosions.
As for the accompanying freshmen, one of them lay motionless on the ground, while another was heavily injured and rescued by soldiers who struggled to push him onto an armored car.
“All tanks, follow my lead and prepare to assault the enemy’s vantage point from the front.”
“Spread out the armored vehicles and encircle them from both directions. Heavy machine guns and mobile phones, spare no ammunition, and provide cover fire for teammates to counterattack.”
“But be careful; there may be several cultivators among the rebels, so don’t get too close.”ln just a blink of an eye, Carl Raven instructed the armored squad to attack, and then Jack Clark heard his voice through the earpiece.
“Jack, the fifth squad has been ambushed. One of your classmates died on the spot and one was seriously injured. The injured student is being treated now.” “Two other students chased three cultists deep into the east of the urban village and their current situation is unknown. I suggest you go and provide support first.”
“What, someone died!”
Hearing that a classmate had died, Zac Lyons and the White Veil members all changed their expressions slightly, and so did Justin Welan and Jack Clark.
Although they knew there was some danger in this trial, they didn’t expect anyone to die on the second day. Weren’t there teachers or military experts following them?
However, now is not the time to think about these things.
Jack Clark said in a deep voice: “No need, 1’11 go alone to provide support. Mr. Willard, Zac, you cooperate with Second Lieutenant Carl and make sure to annihilate these rebels.”
“Including the cultivators within the rebels, if there are any at the Third Layer Heaven, encircle and delay them.”
They had already witnessed Jack Clark’s strength in the past two days. Three Second Layer Heaven cultists were nothing to fear, and even if he encountered Third Layer Heaven opponents, he could safely retreat.
Hence, Justin Welan and the others nodded and said solemnly: “Leave it to us.”
With their strength, under Carl Raven’s firepower suppression, once they charged into the crowd, it would be a total massacre.
Although a killer is always killed, the death of their classmate filled their hearts with killing intent.
Jack Clark’s figure flashed as he jumped off the vehicle. With a burst of full strength, he turned into a black shadow that disappeared on the spot, and in the blink of an eye, he rushed out hundreds of meters.
Zac Lyons was shocked: “Damn, Jack’s speed is so fast.”
“That’s right, my brother is very powerful.” Justin Welan said with pride, then jumped off the car with his heavy shield, and the heavy, domineering aura erupted from him.
Seeing this, Zac Lyons and the White Veil members didn’t hesitate, and the three teamed up. Under the cover of heavy firepower from the tanks and armored cars, they took advantage of the terrain and charged from the side.
Still far away, three metal bombs whistled past, accurately landing behind several rebel positions.
Boom Boom Boom! In an instant, there were explosions and screams.
For Justin Welan and the others, whose physiques were more than ten times that of an ordinary person and had cultivated True Martial, throwing bombs was a piece of cake and didn’t require any special training.
Boom boom! At this moment, two tank roars sounded, and the shells accurately collapsed two two-story buildings. More than a dozen fierce rebels were directly buried.
Whoosh!
A raging wind whistled by Jack Clark’s ears as the surrounding scenery frantically receded. His figure dashed like the wind through the rundown buildings, and soon found the bodies of three cultists along the traces of battle.
Following the signs of battle, he quickly located the two classmates.
Under the abandoned elementary school teaching building, Marcus Lee, wearing battle armor and wielding a two-meter-long heavy hammer, smashed two opponents from the Evil God Sect and forced them to retreat continuously. Bang!
The heavy hammer weighing hundreds of kilograms smashed into the wall, creating a large hole in an instant. Amid the smoke and dust, the heavy hammer swung, shattering the chair thrown by the enemy.
At this moment, Marcus Lee was imposing, pressing the two late Second Layer Heaven cultists.
Not far away, on the playground, there were three unrecognizable bloody corpses, and in a more distant corner, a student in battle armor leaned against the wall, breathing weakly.
There was a large blood hole in his thigh.
Thud! Jack Clark’s figure fell from the wall with a heavy thud of his metal battle boots hitting the ground.
The injured classmate’s face changed suddenly: “Be careful, there’s a sniper on the roof.”
In the instant the classmate spoke, Jack Clark had already moved several meters away in a flash.
At the same time, he faintly heard the sound of a silenced gunshot, and the place where he was just standing exploded with a bang, leaving a head-sized hole.
Bang Bang Bang! Jack Clark dodged three consecutive shots in advance.
His figure was like a ghost, and within a few flashes, he entered the school stairwell..

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 72: 72: Slaying the Triplex
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Slaying the Triplex
Translator: 549690339
Heavy footsteps swiftly passed through the stairway, and Jack Clark almost jumped several meters with one step. His figure flashed across each floor, reaching the sixth floor rooftop entrance in seconds.
Bang!
With a kick from Jack Clark, the iron door of the rooftop flew off horizontally. However, he didn’t rush out but immediately crouched close to the wall.
On the distant rooftop, a man in black tight-fitting clothes held a crude sniper rifle, his eyes sharp. As the iron door was kicked off, he fired three consecutive shots in an instant.
Bang Bang Bang!!
Bullets pierced through the doorway, blasting three large penetrating holes in the concrete wall, but at the same time, he also revealed his position.
Two black objects flashed by, and the man in black observed a slight change in his expression. He hurriedly dodged to the side while a Late-stage Third Layer Heaven Red True Power burst from him.
Boom boom!!
Two impact-triggered concussion bombs exploded upon landing, engulfing a range of over ten meters in searing flames. Powerful shockwaves blasted through the floors, scattering countless debris.
At the same time, Jack’s figure burst out from the doorway in the instant the metal bombs exploded. His whole body exuded an overbearing aura as he charged toward the edge of the explosion.
The man dressed in black had blood-colored True Power circulating around him, his face pale.bender
It seemed like although he had escaped from the center of the explosion at the first moment, he was still injured by the impact of the blast.
Bang!
The long knife unleashed a raging wind with a whistling sound, its sharp edge causing the man in black to change his expression. A bloody light surged over his 2-meter-long sniper rifle.
Bang!
The sharp blade collided with the blood-covered rifle, and in an instant, a tangible force exploded, forming shockwaves and unyielding winds.
Thud!
Hitting the ground with a dull noise, Jack landed and stood with his knife, his icy gaze fixed on the cold man two meters away as he said calmly.
“I didn’t expect the person hiding in the shadows and shooting to be a Third Layer Heaven cultivator. You’re truly a group of rats hiding in the gutter.”
In response to Jack’s mockery, the arrogant Boris sneered, “For us cultivators, the means are not important, as long as we can kill people.”
Then Boris menacingly continued, “Worthy of being the Federation’s genius, not running away upon encountering me at the early stage of the Second Layer Heaven. You have quite the guts.”
“Soon, 1’11 break your limbs, skin you, pull your tendons, and throw you into an ant nest, where countless ants will feast on your flesh and pick your bones clean. You’ll regret coming here.”
Jack was unmoved by his threat, his eyes even revealing a faint excitement.
As his strength attribute approached 150 points, his arm strength increased to 1200 kg, far surpassing the 800 kg limit of the Second Layer Heaven.
Furthermore, with the breakthrough of the Dragon Elephant Power and the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife to the second layer, his agility and physique surpassed 100 points, significantly outperforming Second Layer Heaven cultivators.
Under such circumstances, Second Layer Heaven cultists and cultivators would barely pose a threat to him, providing no sense of oppression.
Of course, Jack wasn’t a fool. If he encountered a Late-stage Third Layer Heaven cultivator, he would simply turn and run.
