Third Layer Heaven cultivators have shifted their focus to True Strength, with body strengthening being secondary. Moreover, the standard for the Third Layer Heaven is having the illusory True Strength fill the Dantian to reach a foggy state.
Under these conditions, True Strength provides a stronger enhancement in various aspects and can coat the body and weapons to increase defense and damage.
However, that referred to normal Third Layer Heaven cultivators. In the first strike just now, Jack had roughly estimated the strength of the Evil God Sect Cultist before him.
His physical strength was only equivalent to that of a Second Layer Heaven, while his True Strength was in the Third Layer Heaven, but lacking solidity. As long as his True Strength was exhausted, a single slash would be enough to kill him.
So… Huh!
Jack took a deep breath, instantly releasing all his True Strength within his body. His muscles swelled up, Dragon Elephant patterns surfaced on his skin, and his entire body exuded a wild aura, like an enraged giant elephant.
Especially his arms, under the effect of the Light King Knife, showed bulging veins, resembling two stout elephant legs that radiated an oppressing atmosphere.
“Kill!” With a low shout, the ground trembled. Jack instantly unleashed the Light King’s Fury, transforming into a residual shadow and charged toward Boris amidst a howling gale.”Courting death.”
Feeling underestimated, Boris was completely enraged. His entire body, including the unique sniper rifle in his hand, was covered with Red True Power, and he fired a shot at Jack Clark.
Bang!
At close range, the bullet missed Jack Clark.
Just before Boris fired, Jack had already crouched down and dodged the bullet. A pitiless knife light that looked like a pirefining sliced the air from bottom to top.
Clang!
The blade light was as fast as lightning, striking Boris’s sniper rifle, which he had blocked his chest with. The rifle, covered with True Power, was extremely hard, and only produced sparks.
However, Boris’s face changed in response to the mountain-like and tsunami-like terrifying force, as he was slashed and sent flying by the overbearing power, crashing into the wall several meters away with a bang.
At that moment, the blade light slashed down again, cutting through the air and hitting the wall just as Boris rolled out of the way. Half of the wall collapsed with a loud bang from Jack’s single blow.
Whoosh! A gust of wind roared behind Jack Clark, who turned around and clenched his left fist, a punch like a cannonball.
Boom!
The battle armor-covered fist and the red palm collided, causing a violent explosive burst of air.
Just as their fists and palms touched, Jack’s Dragon Elephant True Strength was shattered by the Third Layer Heaven’s blood-red True Power. However, Boris wasn’t happy at all.
He could only feel a sheer overbearing and horrifying force surging through his palm, shaking his blood-red True Power. The overbearing punch sent him retreating several steps back.
Take advantage when they are sick.
As Boris was retreating from the punch, Jack was already pouncing on him, his straight blade slashing out with terrifying blade lights that engulfed him.
Boris’s face changed slightly, and he hurriedly held up his True Power-covered sniper rifle to block his body.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Under Jack’s full strength, he was like a mad elephant, his blade lights as fast as lightning, giving Boris no chance to dodge or counterattack. The impact force carried by each slash was extremely terrifying.
Each slash would cause Boris to retreat several steps under the force of the terrifying power, his body-covered red True Power constantly shaking and eventually dimming…
After fifteen consecutive slashes, Jack finally stopped and slowly sheathed his knife.
In front of him, Boris’s hands were bloody and mangled, desperately gripping the broken sniper rifle, his chest caved in, and blood slowly flowing out of his eyes, ears, mouth, and nose.
In his eyes, there was a strong unwillingness.
He never thought that one day he would be killed by a Second Layer cultivator with such overbearing and unmatched power.
“Die for me!” At that moment, Marcus Lee’s angry roar rang out from below, holding his heavy hammer with power that had been built up to the limit.
Boom, boom!! With the classroom walls collapsing, the two Evil God Sect followers, who had been barely holding on for a long time, were instantly smashed into pulp by Marcus Lee.
“Ahhhh…” Marcus Lee, holding his heavy hammer and shouting in anger, had just wiped out all the enemies.
He had watched helplessly as his classmates were killed in a sneak attack. This anger and the fear of being so close to death made him want to vent in an all-out way, killing all the enemies.
No one had expected that the Evil God Sect followers would be so fearless of death.
Not only did they bury countless explosives and landmines along the way, they even strapped bombs to themselves and ambushed the armored squad, catching everyone off guard and exploding them.
Add in the ambusher with the anti-equipment sniper rifle…
Thud! Jack Clark jumped down from the building using leverage and landed outside the classroom.
“Jack Clark.” Seeing his acquaintance, Marcus Lee’s anger eased slightly.
Jack Clark said solemnly, “The sniper has been killed by me, there are no other enemies around. You take the injured classmate and follow me from behind, I’ll go back to support.”
“Alright.” Marcus Lee nodded..

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 73: Source Pollution
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Source Pollution
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark’s figure shot through the dilapidated buildings at a fast speed, covering tens of meters in a second, and quickly crossed half of the urban village to return to rhe front battlefield.
However, the battle here is already nearing its end.
Buildings were collapsed by rhe heavy artillery of tanks, and there were huge bullet holes left by the machine gun fire everywhere, and the ground was filled with bloodied rebels’ corpses.
This time, almost half of the urban village was affected by the battle, and many buildings were ignited by the artillery fire, with billowing black smoke rising under the burning flames, and the air was filled with the smell of gunpowder.
Luckily this place has already been abandoned.
Boom! At this moment, the roar of a distant tank echoed, and a shell fell on a group of rebels hiding on the rooftop, with the explosion’s fire engulfing the entire building.
By this time, some soldiers have already come down from the armored cars, compressing the battlefield by dividing into small teams and surrounding the remaining rebels who were resisting by relying on a few small buildings.
As for Justin Welan and the other two, they were standing next to a half-collapsed building, panting, their battle armors dyed red with blood, and their bodies radiating a strong smell of blood.
In addition to them, there was also an armored convoy that came to support, which was also the reason why the rebels were wiped out so quickly.
Howard Lee, who looked as mighty as a giant, slowly picked up his iron column, and in front of him, an off-road vehicle trying to flee was directly crushed.
The rebels inside had already turned into a mass of flesh and blood, unrecognizable.
Jack Clark s figure flashed and landed in front of Justin Welan and the others: “Mr. Willard, are you guys okay?”
“I’m fine. I had a great time killing. Jack, you didn’t see me when I was holding the heavy machine gun and sweeping the area with it. I was so cool.” Justin Welan said excitedly.
However, his heavy shield was now full of potholes, many of the sharp edges were broken, and many parts were embedded with deformed bullets halfway in.
There was even a trace of a hand grenade explosion on it.
Zac Lyons grinned, showing an effort to wave his hand, “1 won’t die either.” His chest was covered with several small dents where the alloy had been punched in, probably by being shot by high-powered bullets.
Although the bullets did not penetrate the alloy, the impact still made him cough up blood uncomfortably, feeling like his ribs were broken.
White Veil was in better shape among the three, practicing a speed-based Cultivation Methods and matching swordsmanship Although looking a bit embarrassed, his demeanor was somewhat relaxed.
“Jack, what’s the situation on your side?” Justin Welan asked.
“It’s alright, Marcus Lee is fine.”
Jack Clark nodded, “Another classmate was shot in the thigh by a sniper rifle, but there was no life-threatening danger, as for the sniper who attempted to assassinate from the dark, I killed him.”
Zac Lyons frowned, “These Evil God Sect guys and those rebels really don’t fear death.”
White Veil shook his head, “It’s not that they don’t fear death, but their thinking is influenced or polluted by the existence of rhe source after practicing the quick-success methods of rhe Evil God Sect.”
“Including those rebels who cooperated with the Evil God Sect, many people’s thinking might have been unconsciously influenced, otherwise they wouldn’t be so crazy.”
“Their thinking can be influenced by the ‘source’; the Evil God Sect’s Cultivation Methods are so scary!” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
White Veil bitter smiled, “I was also shocked when 1 first heard about it, but this is the terrifying aspect of the Evil God Sect; their Cultivation Methods are different from the true martial ones we practice.”
“Or to say that those Cultivation Methods are not meant for humans to practice at all, it s very strange.”
As they spoke, the four walked towards the armored convoy in the back.
On their way passing an overturned armored car, although the soldiers inside had already evacuated. Jack Clark and Justin Welan, White Veil, still joined forces to flip it back over.
However, when they saw the half-charred corpse of their classmate with a bloody hole in his chest shot through by an anti-equipment sniper rifle, the four fell silent.
He didn’t expect anyone to die in battle just after two days, and that too under the circumstances where there was an expert secretly following behind.
At this moment, Jack Clark was very grateful that he prioritized strengthening defense, although he had dodged those sniper bullets in advance.
But there’s a huge difference in the concept of not being able to block and being able to block but dodging the attack anyway.
In a short while, Howard Lee, carrying an iron column, and rhe other three students came over as well.
Following them, Lori Parma and female teacher Sylvia Lyons and another military expert, who were as fast as ghosts, jumping over from the buildings in a few leaps.
Thump! The military expert casually threw down the two cultist corpses in his hand..
In Lori Parma’s hand, she held a heavily injured fanatic who had been knocked unconscious.
Lori Parma fell silent for a moment before speaking in a solemn voice, “Since you’ve chosen the battlefield, you’re no longer just students; you are soldiers. Death and injuries are inevitable.”
“He died fighting against the Evil God Sect. The school and officials will ensure that his family is well-compensated.”
“But his death won’t be in vain. 1 assure you, the Evil God Sect and the rebels will soon pay for this classmate’s demise.”
A student had died on the morning patrol, a piece of news that caused a huge stir among the new freshmen.
On the way back, when Justin Welan and rhe others learned that the sniper Jack Clark had killed was a Third Layer Heaven cultivator, they were somewhat surprised.
Although cultists of the same level were slightly weaker than normal cultivators, a Third Layer Heaven cultivator still held a significant advantage over a Second Layer Heaven cultivator.
“Don’t look at me like that,”
Jack Clark spread his hands, “Mainly, that cultist was quite weak, and 1 had first hit him with a concussion bomb, which allowed me to kill him by sheer luck.”
“Think about it, if that guy were very strong, would he need to hide with a sniper rifle for sneak attacks?”
“That makes sense.” Zac Lyons nodded, agreeing with this explanation.
However, while Zac and the others believed him, Justin Welan couldn’t help but feel suspicious, as he found Jack’s tone to be rather familiar.
Jack initially thought that his classmates would be on edge for a few days, but to his surprise, Justin and Zac hurried off to the Logistics Department the moment they returned to the hotel.
One of them wanted to add color to their battle armor, while the other decided to add wings to his.
“It seems everyone is adapting quite well,” Jack mused as he came to the underground Logistics Department once again to manage his resources.
Today, he had killed a Third Layer Heaven cultivator, which was worth io contribution points. Adding this to the one point he had left over from yesterday, he now had a total of 11 contribution points.
Jack spent eight points and exchanged them for two Level 1 Life Crystals.
This time, however, his luck was poor, and one of the crystals had a meager amount of energy. Upon converting it, Jack only gained 6 Points Attribute, at which he could only shake his head in speechlessness.
Back in his hotel room, Jack immediately chose to strengthen his battle armor by consuming 2 points attribute.
As Jack spoke, an Invisible Power enveloped the black-red armor he had yet to remove, causing the color to deepen slightly.
The helmet felt slightly heavier now.
And the armor’s attribute was now I Solidity* io I
During today’s rescue mission, when he was under sniper fire from the rooftop, Jack had only dodged two bullets. The third sniper bullet had grazed the side of his shoulder.
There was no choice – the sniper bullet was just too fast; even though his Heart’s Eye had sensed danger in advance, it didn’t mean he could avoid all the bullets.
If he had worn normal armor, the sniper bullet would have easily torn through the alloy, leaving a severe injury on one side of his shoulder.
But against the Solidity+8 strengthened heavy shoulder plating, the bullet could only produce a shower of sparks before brushing past, its kinetic energy completely ignored by Jack.
Today’s battle made Jack realize once more the importance of defense. As a result, when he returned, he decided to strengthen his battle armor to its current limit without a second thought.
With Solidity+io, the alloy armor covering Jack’s entire body could now withstand sniper armor-piercing bullets, ensuring that he no longer had to worry about ambushes from hidden snipers.
Jack glanced at his remaining 4 Points Attribute and suppressed the urge to strengthen his weapon.
In the afternoon, as Jack practiced Dragon Elephant Power in his room, he partially focused his attention on the Heavy Armored Beast.
The now over 2-meter-tall black Unique Beast became even more menacing. Although its body wasn’t very large, it had already become the dominant force in this estuary.
An invisible Killing Intent filled the area wherever it went, terrifying the ordinary small fish and shrimp, causing them to flee in a hurry.
All Mutated Fish that entered the range of its waters became prey to the Heavy Armored Beast, even those large fish that were twice as big as itself.
As time went by, with continuous growth and devouring, the Heavy Armored Beast’s Evolution value had accumulated to over 200. It was expected that it would undergo its third evolution in about half a month..

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 74: Wings
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Wings
Translator: 549690339
In the afternoon.
As Jack Clark was controlling the Heavy Armored Beast to eat and drink enough, Justin Welan excitedly ran back in, shouting at the door, “Jack, look at me! Don’t I look cool?”
On the balcony, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes.
“What’s cool…? You really did add wings.”
Justin Welan was wearing a clean black-red battle armor, and behind him were a pair of metal-made black folding wings that covered half of his body, making him look very imposing.
But…did it have to be so flashy? Jack was a bit confused, thinking the others were just making empty talk.
Justin Welan walked up proudly and even spun around in front of Jack: “Hehe… Does it look imposing now?”
Jack was speechless: “Imposing, yes, but these wings alone must weigh at least twenty or thirty kilograms, right? Along with the weight of the armor, don’t you feel it’s heavy when you run?”
Plus his heavy weapon, a hundred or nearly two hundred-kilogram shield, his total weight reached over two hundred kilograms – running away from enemies during a battle would be nearly impossible.
“It’s a bit heavy, but it adds safety,” Justin Welan said proudly.
“My weapon is an alloy heavy shield, and 1 take a frontal assault approach in battle. Even sniper armor-piercing bullets can’t penetrate my shield, but the back is vulnerable.”
“Now that I have these metal wings in the back, it’s like adding another layer of defense, and I even paid extra for the military factory to use thicker alloy.”
“In this case, even if I’m shot from behind with a sniper rifle, it won’t penetrate my armor. How about that, am I smart?”
Jack nodded in admiration: “…Indeed, you’re smart. What about Zac Lyons? Did he also add wings?”
“No, his Cultivation Methods are different from mine. If the load is too high, it affects agility. So, he only doubled the armor on the front and back and added some glittering gold plates.”
“It’s not just us. Many of our classmates have gone to the base factory to reinforce their armors, even at the cost of some speed.”
At this time, Justin Welan suggested, “Jack, I recommend you add some reinforcement to the front and back of your armor to protect against hidden snipers.”
I thought the death of that student wouldn’t affect us much, but it seems everyone has noticed the defense issue.
“I noticed this issue early on, but I don’t need it. Overly-heavy armor will affect my speed,” Jack continued.
“Don’t forget, what Sword Skill am I cultivating? As long as there are hostile gazes on me, I will sense them. Sniper rifles aren’t a big threat to me.”
Justin was stunned and then reacted: “I almost forgot, Jack, you’re cultivating the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife and have really reached the Heart’s Eye realm.”
Talking about this, he couldn’t help but show a look of envy on his face.
He had also heard of the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, and was very interested in the Heart’s Eye realm, which could sense danger in advance.
Unfortunately, his brother had told him that he didn’t have that talent.
Ordinary people couldn’t cultivate that Sword Skill, and even if they tried, they could only learn the ordinary Light King Knife, unable to enter the Heart’s Eye realm.
“Jack, do you want to cultivate with me at the base cultivation ground?”
Jack shook his head: “No need, 1 like to cultivate quietly by myself.”
“…Alright,” Justin nodded.
In the conference room, General Laird Hawk sat in the main seat, flanked by his staff, adjutants, several Colonel-ranked military experts, and Lori Parma.
Laird Hawk said gravely: “Today, a genius and five soldiers died in a rebel ambush, and I’m deeply regretful.”
“However, it’s their sacrifice that has allowed us to capture a high-ranking fanatic.”
“Through my Secret Skill, I’ve interrogated and locked in on the main base of the fleeing Evil God Sect and the remaining main force of the rebels.”
“Right now, three special reconnaissance teams have already set out and are expected to arrive at the outskirts of the mountain range in two hours, closely monitoring with satellites.”
“I’m issuing the combat mission now. At nine o’clock tonight, the Third and Fifth Armored Brigades will be ready to depart, and they must arrive at the combat location within two hours.”
“After nightfall, the Fifteenth Long-range Rocket Artillery Regiment will set off to the designated combat location and cooperate with the supporting air bombing squadron for saturation bombing.”
“As for those Evil God Sect experts hiding in the mountain belly, 1 will request a bomber carrying fusion energy for energy cannon bombardment to destroy the mountain peak along with them.”
“Also, after 6 pm, there will be a citywide electronics silence…”
Before dinner, everyone received a command not to sleep tonight, as there would be action, and then their mobile phones lost signal.
Justin was excited: “Jack, do you remember the fanatic Mr. Perry caught? There must be a big operation tonight. This time I must kill more cultists!”
Jack squinted his eyes and reminded: “Be careful then. Safety first, killing the enemy second.”
At ten o’clock that night, the hotel lobby was brightly lit.
All twenty-five students gathered one after another. However, the atmosphere that was supposed to be solemn and murderous had turned a bit strange.
Zac Lyons, in his glittering golden armor, looked as dazzling as a comic book superhero. He walked around, showing off.
A classmate couldn’t help but envy: “Zac, where did you get those golden paints? They look like gold.”
“Hehe, I paid a big price for someone to tune this paint for me. They guaranteed it’s waterproof, wear-resistant, and won’t fade for a year,” Zac said proudly.
“Zac, aren’t you afraid you’ll be targeted by the enemy, glittering like that in the night?”
“Afraid? I could lose my life, but coolness is a lifelong affair.”
“Justin, your wings are not up to date. They’re too outdated. Look at me, I have three pairs of white Angel Wings, and they can be opened and closed.”
White Veil proudly showed off his silver battle armor in front of Justin, and behind his back were three sets of wings of different sizes, slowly opening and closing under the control of mechanical devices.
Compared to White Veil’s armor, Justin’s black wings were a bit ordinary and lacked extravagance, but it had better protection because of their thickness.
Besides them, the armor of most of the students had undergone more or less changes.
Some had thickened armor on the front and back, protecting themselves tightly. Some even installed spider-leg-like springs on their backs; it looked very strange.
It must be said that the base’s temporary military factory was impressive, as they could modify anything.
As a result, when Lori and the other teachers arrived and saw this scene, they were all stunned..

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 75: The Strike that Pierces Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: The Strike that Pierces Heaven and Earth
Translator: 549690339
The teacher called Ella Raven was confused: “What’s going on?”
“This battle armor has been developed and evaluated from various aspects, and it has been finalized after retaining the advantages of agility, flexibility, and defense.”
“Now, you guys are adding thickness and flashy wings, which will have a great impact on the overall performance of the battle armor and weaken its combat effectiveness.”
Zac Lyons bitterly smiled: “Teacher, when people die, what’s the use of agility?”
His words made Lori Parma and the other two slightly silent, thinking of the student who was sniped and assassinated, realizing what they were worried about.
Lori Parma said solemnly: “Let’s go.”
Under the night, armored cars and troop transport vehicles passed through the sealed roads at a low speed of fifty yards.
Except for the leading armored car that turned on the headlights, the following vehicles followed with low beams.
It was not until they left the city that the armored car in front began to speed up, followed by the convoy at the rear, and the roaring vibrations were transmitted far away in the wilderness.
The base of the cultists was nearly 100 kilometers away from Lester City, located in the middle of a small mountain range, hiding in a naturally formed Empty Belly Cave.
In addition, in the valley under another mountain, the remnants of the main force of the rebels, who had once occupied Lester City and been defeated, were hidden.
Because most of these rebels are locals, they have many spies.
Usually, the main force is gathered at the base, and most of the low-level personnel are scattered and integrated into villages and towns with various identities, so the Federation military cannot distinguish them temporarily.
After all, it’s only been a few days since the Federation defeated the rebels, and they haven’t had time to establish a complete intelligence system.
At the same time, these civilians have a vague hostility towards the Federation’s military, believing that they are preventing the rebels from rescuing Koroya and allowing them to continue to be enslaved by the royal family.
These ordinary people don’t know the consequences if they let the rebels establish the Divine Nation on earth.
An hour and a half later, under the night sky, there were faintly undulating mountain peaks on the horizon, and Jack Clark and the others on the open truck suddenly became serious and looked up at the sky.
From the night sky came the buzzing sound of fighters, dozens of fighter aircraft flew over from thousands of meters high, followed by Powerful Aerial Bombs falling from the sky.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Far away in the mountain ranges, firelight rushed into the sky, and the dazzling light illuminated the horizon. Even separated by a long distance, Jack Clark and the others could hear the rumbling of the missile explosion.
And this was only the beginning.
As the first bombing of the fighter aircraft left, countless firelights burst out from the far left, and dense rockets whistled through the sky with a piercing scream.
At the same time, the Howitzer Troop in the right side, which had already reached its position, also launched an attack, and heavy cannonballs fell from the sky.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Under the bombardment of countless shells, the earth was shaking.
Especially at this moment, the fighters’ whistling sound came again from the sky. More than a dozen heavy ground-penetrating missiles fell precisely, and in an instant, the blazing flames erupted on the mountainside.
With the deafening roar, the terrifying momentum made Jack Clark and others all frown.
This was the power of modern weapons. Even Lori Parma, a Senior martial artist who could withstand individual rocket attacks, would face only death when confronted with such bombardment.
Even Vernon Leinster, a high-level cultivator, would have the same fate if he could not escape from the center of the explosion within a short time.
As for Jack Clark and others, low-level martial artists with Second and Third Layer Heaven, their bullying of ordinary people and resisting rifle and submachine gun bullets was acceptable.
If they encountered such a bombing, a single aerial bomb could send them to the west.
“The bombing has begun, and the armored vehicles and troop transport vehicles continue to move forward.” With the command, the convoy that had been stopped started again.
At this time, they were still more than ten kilometers away from the Rebel Base.
As they continued on their way, Jack suddenly raised his head and saw a thick beam of light falling from the sky at an altitude of 10,000 meters, instantly falling on the bombed mountain peaks.
Boom! The light of the nuclear explosion illuminated the heaven and earth in an instant.
Under that terrifying beam of light, the mountain peaks towering thousands of meters high collapsed with a bang, and billions of tons of boulders and soil collapsed, like the sky was falling and the earth was cracking.
At this moment, everyone was in a trance, unable to believe their eyes as they looked at the distance.
They originally thought it was just a large-scale siege battle, but they didn’t expect the military to actually use such a terrifying firepower.
Apart from the saturation bombing of numerous rockets and missiles, they were now deploying a weapon that was as terrifying as nuclear weapons, capable of collapsing a large mountain in one hit.
By the time the armored vehicles arrived at the foot of the mountain range at full speed, the bombing had ended, and the aftermath of the explosion and the big pits were visible everywhere.
As soon as the convoy stopped, Lori Parma and several military experts jumped off and shouted: “Special Forces, clear the Rebel Base. Ordinary soldiers follow up and expand the scope. Don’t let a single person go.”
No sooner had he finished, than the Senior experts burst out with red and blue True Strength and turned into a blazing flame under an impressive aura, transforming into a dazzling light and shooting out.Jack Clark and the others hurriedly jumped off the transport vehicle.
Seeing Lori Parma and the rest disappear at the foot of the mountain in the blink of an eye, Zac Lyons was shocked: “Wow, Old Parma and the others are so fast!”
Justin Welan snorted, “Nonsense, they are Sixth Heavenly Layer experts, their basic physique is at least thirty times that of ordinary people, not to mention their terrifying True Strength.”
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed: “I’ll go first, you guys follow behind.”
After saying that, Jack Clark didn’t wait for them. He stepped on the ground and instantly erupted with a terrifying speed of fifty meters per second, rushing up the mountain with a howling wind.
After the military’s saturation bombing, the Evil God Sect and the rebel experts were either dead or heavily injured. Now was the best time to pick off their heads.
Even if some experts managed to avoid the bombing by relying on the terrain, there were still people like Lori Parma who were skilled enough to deal with them. All he had to do was rush up and collect their heads, which would earn him Contribution Points.
If he missed this opportunity, he didn’t know when such a good thing would happen again.
Not only Jack Clark, but the other students also understood this, so they hurriedly shouted, “Jack Clark, don’t hog all the benefits, leave some for us too!”
“Wait for me.”
“Damn, why can Jack Clark run so fast when we’re all in the Second Layer Heaven…”
Jack Clark ignored the other students. When he climbed the first hill through the pockmarked crater, he saw an astonishing scene a kilometer away in the light of the fire.
He saw Lori Parma and the others each holding a huge weapon, some with long knives more than three meters long, and some with halberds more than four meters long. Most importantly, these weapons were all glowing.
What’s more, the power of these weapons was also terrifying.
Jack Clark saw Lori Parma swing his long knife, and a seven-meter-long Sword Qi instantly fell on the anti-aircraft fortification on the side of the mountain waist.
Bang! The Sword Qi exploded, and the scattered fierce energy was incredibly sharp, instantly smashing the few rebels and the fortification inside, raising smoke and dust in the sky.
The terrifying destructive power far exceeded what they had shown in the battle at the airport. It seemed as if they were two different levels with or without weapons, which greatly surprised Jack Clark.
At the same time, he was also puzzled. When Lori Parma and the others had gotten off the vehicle earlier, they had no weapons with them, so were they Space Equipment?
Lori Parma and the others moved quickly. By the time Jack Clark climbed the small hill, they had already disappeared into the darkness.
Jack Clark’s eyes flickered for a moment, and then he dashed towards the rebel base.
The terrain here was treacherous, and many parts of the mountainside were suitable for defense. Even under saturation bombing, many people still managed to survive with the help of fortifications.
For example, Jack Clark found a defensive position just as he rushed up the mountainside.
The only problem was that this position had already suffered heavy casualties, and only a few rebels and a cultivator had managed to escape into a cave.
Jack Clark turned on the mini-camera on his body, and with a flash, he rushed into the cave. Puchi! In the dark, the light of the knife flickered, and the three rebels who hadn’t recovered yet, were beheaded.
Boom! In the dark, Jack Clark turned around and threw a punch, shattering the air, and his terrifying fist instantly landed on the chest of a cultivator attempting to ambush him from the corner.
Under the violent and overbearing power, the chest of the Second Layer Heaven cultivator collapsed, spewing blood from his mouth, and slammed into the mountain wall, dying instantly.
After killing several people in an instant, Jack Clark didn’t look back as he rushed out of the cave and continued to sprint up the mountain.
The information provided on the way indicated that there were more than 1,400 main forces of the rebels at this base. There were dozens of ordinary cultivators, most of whom were in the First and Second Layer Heaven.
There were about ten in Triple Heaven.
As for the two Fourth Layer Heaven rebel leaders, they had been staying with the Evil God Sect experts, which was the mountain peak that had been hit by the drilling missile and bombarded by energy weapons.
Bang! Bang! Bang! As Jack Clark reached the mountainside, gunfire suddenly erupted from the half-collapsed anti-aircraft position in front of him.
Because there were too many bullets and they were too fast, even though Jack Clark sensed the danger in advance, he couldn’t avoid them all. Or rather, he didn’t avoid them this time.
Otherwise, wouldn’t the armor he had enhanced be wasted?
Ding ding ding! Dozens of bullets hit the armor, creating a dense burst of sparks. One heavy machine-gun bullet even hit his face guard.
But other than leaving a small mark on the faceguard and causing Jack Clark to tilt his head back slightly, it didn’t cause any damage.
Under the hail of gunfire, Jack Clark crossed more than thirty meters in an instant, broke through the wooden wall in front of him, and rushed into the defensive position, sweeping with a fierce wind with his straight blade.
Wherever the knife passed, three rebels were instantly cut in half, and a large number of blood and organs spewed out, accompanied by shrill screams of despair.
In front of Jack Clark, more than ten rebels armed with rifles and submachine guns had no power to resist. In just two flashes, they were all killed.
“Die!” In the instant that Jack Clark killed all those ordinary rebels, the soil in the back exploded, revealing a rebel who had been hiding under the collapsed wood and soil.
“Not pretending to be dead anymore.”
With an indifferent voice, Jack Clark turned around and slashed, overtaking the Second Layer Heaven rebel who had been cut in half from bottom to top, and the battlefield fell silent.
There was only the gurgling blood flowing out, almost dyeing the ground red. Jack Clark, dressed in dark red armor, stood among more than ten corpses, like a devil, exuding a terrifying murderous aura..

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 76: Mutated Giant Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Mutated Giant Beast
Translator: 549690339
There was more than one way up the mountain, and the twenty-plus special forces soldiers were divided into seven teams to charge up, followed by fully armed soldiers.
When encountering strong resistance, the special forces soldiers would throw a few metal bombs directly, blowing the remaining rebels sky-high.
When they ran out of metal bombs, the soldiers behind them would use single rocket launchers and grenade launcher heavy machine guns for firepower suppression.
If there were cultivators trying to break through and escape, they would be intercepted by these special forces students, cooperating to slowly clear the way up.
After all, not everyone was like Jack Clark, with a speed comparable to a normal Third Layer Heaven, able to detect danger in advance and equipped with battle armor that could ignore light firearms.
However, there were also some fierce fighters among them.
For example, the small team composed of Justin Welan, Howard Lee, Zac Lyons, and White Veil, had far surpassed most of their peers.
Justin Welan led the team with a heavy shield, recklessly charging and attracting firepower. He would ignore hand grenades and only dodge when faced with individual rocket launchers.
Behind him, Howard Lee and the others would take advantage of the night to flank and clear the way at a speed not much slower than Jack Clark’s.
After all, the remaining rebels had been bombarded to the point of severe injury, with few left unscathed, let alone reinforcements or support.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Outside the valley, under the night sky, Jack Clark was like a raging giant elephant, emitting a terrifying aura as he attacked ferociously, each of his attacks causing piercing shrieks.
His opponent was a Third Layer Heaven cultivator, and from his aura, he was probably at the Mid Phase of Third Layer Heaven.
However, this rebel leader had already been injured by a missile strike, his power less than 20%, and he happened to encounter Jack Clark charging up the mountain during his escape.
Splat! After taking eleven hits from Jack Clark, Kaleb spat out a mouthful of blood and his grey True Power aura began to dim.
Feeling the weakening of his aura, Jack’s own aura surged in an instant, unleashing a blade light that doubled both his speed and power in a fierce slash.
The terrifying blade instantly tore through Kaleb’s external True Power, cutting off his machete, and then bisecting his body…
In the valley, the rebel positions consisting of brick houses had turned into ruins, with craters three meters wide and ten meters deep scattered everywhere, the surrounding dirt still emitting heat.
The place was littered with rebel corpses, densely packed together under the glow of the fire, resembling a scene from hell.
However, not everyone had died – there were some rebels who had survived in the collapsed buildings and caves, waiting for the bombing to end before scattering in all directions.
Among the darkness, a group of over a dozen rebels had just run out of the valley when they saw a figure in the distance, the leading rebel shouted: “Stop, who’s there?”
But the figure didn’t stop, instead charging at them faster. The rebel leader’s expression turned grim: “It’s an enemy, kill him.”
Bang, bang, bang!! Gunfire erupted, countless bullets engulfed Jack Clark, sparking in all directions, but they failed to damage his Strengthened Battle Armor in the slightest.
For Jack at this point, the twenty-meter distance was nothing, as he instantly charged into the crowd while being struck by bullets, and with a flash of his blade, limbs and broken bodies flew everywhere.
Splash, splash!!
Carving through the enemies effortlessly, Jack had killed more than ten people in the blink of an eye, including the First Layer Heaven cultivator who led the group.
Jacks’s eyes were slightly red at this point, cold and filled with a terrifying aura of brutality. He dashed past the corpses with a single leap.
His target was the rebel headquarters.
However, when Jack stormed into the valley, the rebel base was deserted, with nothing left but the ruins and corpses.
Whoosh, whoosh!!
Jack refused to believe it and continued to search through the collapsed buildings, looking for any heavily injured cultivators that had survived – killing them would also count towards his Contribution Points.
Huh?
Just as Jack was passing by a collapsed cliff, he stopped suddenly and turned around sharply, his sharp gaze falling on the pile of broken stones at the base of the distant mountain wall.
He could vaguely sense a suppressed, violent aura coming from behind the pile of stones.
“We’ve been discovered, Koi, go out and kill him.” Upon hearing a faint female voice, the suppressed violent aura burst forth in an instant.
Boom!
The collapsed stone mill exploded like a high explosive, the ground trembled as a huge figure with a violent aura emerged, instantly turning into a dark shadow that leaped dozens of meters in the blink of an eye.
Boomijust as Jack Clark dodged the attack, the collapsed building behind him was directly hit by the enormous figure, sending rubble and bricks flying everywhere and filling the air with dust and smoke.
At this moment, Jack finally saw what the creature was.
A mutated beast resembling a bull, over 4 meters tail, 8 meters long, with two pairs of sharp horns on its head, its entire body bulging with muscles, and its skin dark and shining with a metallic luster.
The mutated beast now exuded an aura similar to that of a cultivator, its aura domineering, its blood-red eyes fixed on Jack with murderous intent.
Its mouth was also full of fanged teeth, which would undoubtedly cause severe pain if it were to bite.
After the mutant beast rushed out, a slightly dark-skinned, beautiful woman with a hot body stood at the entrance of the cave.
Five soldiers stood beside her, each holding a heavily modified rifle with a thick barrel, their faces tense as they guarded her.
At this moment, the woman shouted again: “Koi, kill him! Don’t let him escape!”
Moo!
The mutated black bull roared ferociously, its massive body charging toward Jack with a thunderous sound. The ground rumbled as it landed on its hooves, like a heavy tank.
Facing this mutated beast, which was even larger than an elephant, Jack naturally didn’t rely on brute force; he deftly evaded the attack with a slight sway of his body.
And as the mutated beast passed by, he swung his knife horizontally in a dragging slash.
Tear!
As the blade crossed the mutant beast’s abdomen, it was like cutting steel, producing a harsh, sharp sound and leaving a long wound as it capitalized on the momentum of the beast’s charge.
However, the wound was only a centimeter deep and over 2 meters long, which didn’t even manage to cut through the skin of the mutated beast, let alone damage the underlying muscles.
“Such strong defense, is this a mutated beast!?” Jack exclaimed as he looked at the mutated beast, which had demolished the building and slowly turned around to face him.
If his knife had struck a small car just now, it would’ve been sliced in half, but it hadn’t even managed to completely cut through the skin of the mutated beast, which was as if it were a thick layer of alloy.
Moreover, this thick, several centimeters thick hard alloy was full of toughness.
Moo!
The mutated beast, which had missed its target, let out an angry growl; its eyes became even more violent as it charged once more, its colossal body exploding with terrifying acceleration, like a sports car achieving a hundred meters in three seconds.
Amidst the raging wind, Jack dodged again by swaying sideways.
But as he was about to swing his sword at the mutated beast’s abdomen, a sudden, intense sense of danger struck him, and he retreated explosively without even thinking.
Moo! With an angry roar, the mutated black bull stomped its front hooves against the ground, instantly creating an earth-shaking effect, and a powerful shockwave swept through tens of meters around it.
The speed of the shockwave was too fast, so even though Jack had sensed the danger ahead of time and leaped backward, his body still stiffened due to the powerful shockwave.
However, this stiffness lasted only an instant; his body returned to normal in the blink of an eye as his True Strength circulated within him.
Woosh! At that moment, a sharp whistling sound rang out next to his ear as a tail as thick as a human thigh, resembling a steel cable, tore through the air, sweeping toward him.
Jack blocked the tail with his knife mid-air.
Bang! The tail, like a steel cable, struck the blade, bending it before the latter half slammed heavily into Jack’s shoulder, eliciting an instant explosion of terrifying strength.
Jack was sent flying more than ten meters away due to the force, only coming to a gradual halt after skidding several steps upon landing.
Gazing at the mutated black bull’s snake-like tail that was over 3 meters long, Jack slowly let out a breath, his expression solemn: “So powerful.”
At that moment, he felt extremely grateful for having the foresight to prioritize defense; otherwise, that hit would have caused more than just boiling Qi Blood—it would have injured him.
Jack slowly flexed his wrist, looking at the mutated beast preparing to attack again, while his fierce and sharp aura burst forth.
As his True Strength circulated, his entire body swelled, the tattoos on his skin under the battle armor becoming visible, and a terrifying oppressive force emitted from him.
The muscles on his arms holding the knife bulged even more, making the battle armor creak from the pressure.
After two probing moves, Jack had roughly gauged the strength of the mutated beast, which belonged to a typical Level 3 Mutant Beast, equivalent to a cultivator in the Third Layer Heaven.
Such mutated beasts possess enormous strength and terrifying defense that can easily withstand light firearms, requiring heavy artillery or anti-equipment sniper rifles to be killed.
Apart from this, mutated beasts that reached Level 3 also have a special ability, like the earth-shaking attack the beast had just unleashed.
Under normal conditions, cultivators need to reach the Third Layer Heaven, with their True Strength augmented and possess Knife or Sword Aura to inflict lethal damage to these beasts.
Although Jack hadn’t reached the Third Layer Heaven, he remained confident in his ability to kill the mutated beast..

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 77: Exploding with One Punch
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Exploding with One Punch
Translator: 549690339
Mutated Beasts, treasures in their entirety. After going through so much information about them, Jack Clark naturally wouldn’t let this Mutated Black Bull go.
But just when Jack Clark was preparing to burst forth with all his strength, the woman in the cave behind the distant mountain suddenly shouted, “This man is too flexible! Koi can’t handle him. You all attack together to restrict his movement.”
“Yes.”
“Seeking death.”
Upon hearing the woman’s voice, Jack Clark’s eyes instantly turned cold.
Those five men were not weak, all of them were cultivators. Even with average strength, their outstanding physiques and the modification of their Great Power Guns still posed a ‘small’ threat to him, especially as he was focusing on dealing with the Mutated Beast.
Just a single strike from the beast’s tail had several tons of strength. If its sharp bull horn hit him head-on, even the Strengthened Battle Armor would be pierced through.
As such…
Whoosh! Jack Clark’s figure disappeared from its location in an instant.
Upon seeing the fast-approaching shadow, the woman’s eyes narrowed, immediately shouting, “He’s coming, fall back. Block the cave entrance and suppress him with alternating shooting.”
In that instant, their group of five orderly retreated several meters, their Great Power Rifles targeting the entrance of the cave. Firelight exploded, and deafening roars ensued.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The Great Power Guns, with their thickened muzzles and increased ammunition, had a massive recoil that would have shattered a normal person’s shoulder blade. They could only be used by cultivators.
Much like the Black Steel Pistol that Jack Clark carried on his waist, these were close-range weapons for dealing with same-level practitioners.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
With continuous firing from five Great Power Rifles, the cave interior echoed with deafening noise. Bullets as powerful as those from sniper rifles sealed off the entrance.
But what was the point of Jack Clark using so many attribute points to enhance his armor?
BANG! BANG! BANG! BANG!
The armored Jack Clark skated past the side of the cave, sparks flying as each large caliber bullet hit his chest, shoulders, and thighs.
Each bullet, more than ten millimeters in diameter, packing a terrifying kinetic energy within, had the power to puncture and even shatter a human body, but when they struck Jack Clark…
“How is this possible! Normal armor can only block rifle bullets, right?” The sight of Jack Clark making his way towards them amidst the gunfire sent a wave of fear across the faces within the cave.
BOOM!
Sweeping his blade, Jack Clark’s terrifying slash ripped through the raging wind. Almost too fast to follow with the naked eye, three First Layer Heaven Guards standing together were cleaved in half.
Instantly after killing these three, Jack Clark turned and kicked. His right leg, covered by the armor, swung through the air like a Battle Axe, causing a burst of air. In an instant, he was in front of the Second Layer Heaven guard to his left.
CRACK!
The forceful strength caused the enemy’s front gun muzzle to bend. His chest caved in, and he was violently kicked away, flying more than ten meters and crashing into the mountain wall.
Just then, the last rebel guard’s eyes hardened. Knowing there was no escape, he turned his gun muzzle, aiming directly at the back of Jack Clark’s head and pulled the trigger.
BANG! BANG! BANG!! Three consecutive large-power bullets roared out, sending shock waves through the air which were then caught by Jack Clark’s outstretched left palm.
Seeing the few deformed bullets, still smoking, caught in the palm of his hand, the guard who had just emptied his cartridge stared in disbelief.
From the Federation Special Forces Soldier’s aura, he could tell that their realms were the same. They were all at the Second Layer Heaven, but why was this guy so strong?
His Second Layer Heaven companion had been killed with a single blow. How did these bullets, which could easily blow an elephant’s head to smithereens at close range, end up being casually caught?
What about the razor-sharp kinetic energy, even if the armor defense was terrifying?
BOOM!
At the exact moment of the rebel’s distraction, Jack Clark directly gave him a devastating kick to the chest. With terrifying strength, the man’s chest collapsed, spurting blood as he flew towards the outside of the cave.
All this happened within a few seconds. It wasn’t until then that the woman recovered, her face turning pale as she shouted, “Don’t kill me, I am…”
Bam! Before she could finish talking, Jack Clark punched her head and blew it up with his left hand.
For this woman with a ruthless temperament, who could control the Mutated Beast, Jack would show no mercy. In his eyes, only a dead enemy was a good one.
At this time, the ground outside the cave rattled. When the Mutated Black Bull saw Jack’s punch kill the woman, a fierce light exploded in its eyes, filled with rage.
Moo!
Roaring, the over four-meter tall Giant Beast charged into the cave. Its colossal body almost filled the entire cave entrance, giving off a violent aura.
Boom!
The stampeding Mutated Black Bull ripped through Jack’s afterimage, and violently slammed into the wall deep inside the cave. Immediately, the entire cave shook, with countless bits of gravel falling.
Taking advantage of the moment the Mutated Black Bull hit the wall, Jack appeared behind it, his blade flashing like lightning, slashing towards its rear leg joint that was twice as thick as an elephant’s.
Rip!!
The sharp blade cut into the rear leg of the Mutated Black Bull, making a sharp, piercing sound, and finally left a two-centimeter deep, several dozen centimeters long wound, faintly revealing the dark red muscle beneath.
Even with a full-strength blow, Jack could only cut through the skin of this Mutated Beast; its defense was terrifying.
Sighing, Jack retreated explosively.
Bam! The Mutated Black Bull, sensing that it had been attacked, swung its tail. Like a black python slicing through the sky, it exploded the air within several meters in an instant.
Pity that Jack, nimble as a flea, couldn’t be hit by the Mutated Black Bull when forewarned of the attack.
Inside the dim cave, Jack, who had dodged the tail sweep, reappeared like a ghost next to its head, thrusting his sharply pointed blade straight at its eyes.
Moo!
Feeling the attack, the Mutated Black Bull abruptly lifted its head, its upper body and forelimbs rising high, then violently dropping.
Boom! The ground trembled, the invisible shockwave sweeping almost across the entire cave, shaking loose dust and sending countless bits of gravel flying.
But this time, Jack had only faked his attack, disappearing from where he was when its forelegs lifted.
The cave must be where the Mutated Black Bull was usually kept. The entrance was five meters high, and three “zhangs” (10.74 meters) deep was a stomach-like cave that was about twenty meters long and wide and ten meters high.
Digging a space this large must have taken a lot of effort, but usually, it was only enough for the Mutated Black Bull to turn around.
Such terrain was very advantageous for Jack. At the moment when the shockwave dissipated, he reappeared like a phantasm behind the Mutated Black Bull.
Squeak!!
The sharp blade precisely slashed at the wound on the rear leg joint. The cut felt like slashing through a tough, gel-like substance and had a lot of resistance, but it was much less defensive than its skin.
With one swipe, Jack tore a forty-centimeter long, five-centimeter deep wound, almost splitting open the side of the Mutated Black Bull’s rear leg, exposing even more vivid red tendons.
Moo!
In pain, the Mutated Black Bull let out an even more enraged roar, furiously whipping its thick tail behind, managing to hit Jack as he was retreating.
Bam!
Jack was like a bowling ball. Under one hit of the bull’s tail, he smashed into the cave wall eight meters away, the brutal force making his Qi Blood boil.
The very moment the blind cat hit the dead mouse, the Mutated Black Bull inside the cave turned around abruptly, its eyes savage, and with mad momentum, rushed violently towards him.
Boom! Gravel flew everywhere, smoke and dust pervaded the air.
This attack, besides blasting a crater several meters in diameter into the cave wall, did not harm Jack at all.
In this narrow cave, the massive size of the Mutated Black Bull was quite a handicap. The time it took for it to do one full rotation was enough for Jack to have made several rounds around the cave.
Moo!
The Mutated Black Bull roared in anger and immediately rotated its huge body, preparing to charge out of the cave.
It was not highly intelligent, but it too had realized that continuing to fight in this narrow space could cost it its life.
“Where do you think you’re going?”

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 78: Slaying Change
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Slaying Change
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark obviously wouldn’t let the Mutated Beast at hand get away.
Just as the Mutated Black Bull stirred up a raging wind, crushing the woman and the corpses of the rebels, a vicious sharp aura burst forth from Jack, and in an instant, he used Light King’s Fury to appear behind the beast.
Bang! The power of the doubled-edge strike echoed loudly, still targeting the wound on the black bull’s hind leg.
Jack’s goal was simple: to incapacitate the Mutated Black Bull and determine whether it lived or died later.
Rip!
With the help of the Mutated Beast’s charging Kinetic Energy and the eruption of Light King’s Fury, the wound was torn open another ten centimeters, exposing the underlying fascia. The hot blood gushed out of the arteries.
Moo!
The pain made the Mutated Black Bull let out an angry roar, and its galloping figure suddenly stopped. Its sturdy hind leg kicked back with the force of the wind, but Jack narrowly dodged it by the skin of his teeth.
But…
Bang!
Jack, who had avoided the hind leg kick of the Mutated Black Bull, did not escape from its tail. As the tail swept like a black python, it slammed onto his shoulder, and he was smashed into the mountain wall by the terrifying strength.
However, this was the entrance to a cave, and the Mutated Black Bull could not turn around. At the same time, it didn’t want to fight this agile “insect” anymore.
After three consecutive strikes, it had already felt the danger of death. In addition to the earth-shattering bombardment earlier, it now just wanted to escape – to get far away from this deadly place.
After all, its master was already dead, and no one would prepare food for it anymore.
Moo! The Mutated Black Bull roared excitedly as it burst out of the cave. Its massive body was like a super tank rumbling towards the mountain ditch.
Along the way, the smoke and dust rolled, crushing all the collapsed buildings or road-blocking wreckage in its path.
In the cave, Jack pulled his body out from the stone wall, suppressed the boiling Qi Blood in his body, and the muscles in his legs swelled up. In an instant, he disappeared from his original spot.
Watching the distant rumbling of the escaping Mutated Black Bull, Jack chased after it, yelling, “1 killed your master. Don’t you want to avenge him?”
Moo! What responded to him was the Mutated Black Bull’s angry growl, but its body continued to run towards the mountain without looking back.
However, with Jack’s full strength burst, his speed was slightly faster than the Mutated Black Bull, so the distance between the man and the beast gradually closed in.
At this moment, several figures appeared on the hillside in front, and in the faint light of the burning fire, Jack recognized them as Justin Welan and others and let out a long shout.
“The Mutated Beast has been injured by me. Stop it.”
“A Mutated Beast!”
“It’s so big.”
As Zac Lyons and others were amazed, Justin Welan’s eyes lit up: “This Mutated Beast is injured?” Excited, he didn’t think too much, and carrying the heavy shield, he rushed down from the hillside.
Jack was shocked behind him and quickly shouted, “Damn, Mr. Willard, you can’t withstand its impact.”
“What?”
By this time, Justin Welan had already charged down the hillside, looking at the massive rampaging Mutated Beast with its earthy glow. A thick and heavy aura erupted.
After Jack’s reminder, Justin Welan avoided the direct collision and placed the heavy shield diagonally in front of the Mutated Black Bull’s path.
Bang! The galloping Mutated Black Bull’s knee collided with the heavy shield, and the terrifying force of the impact sent Justin Welan flying like a cannonball.
Thud! Justin Welan crashed into the partially collapsed brick house dozens of meters away, and the wall crumbled, with countless bricks and debris falling and smoke and dust filling the air.
However, with his obstruction, the momentum of the Mutated Black Bull came to a halt.
“Take this, my Column of Heaven!”
Accompanied by the low shout, Howard Lee, who was following behind, jumped about ten meters high. The 3-meter-long, thigh-thick pillar in his hand fiercely slammed into the black bull’s head.
Bang! The terrifying force of the impact exploded in a circle, even the Mutated Black Bull was somewhat dazed and staggered back a few steps.
But the strike merely dazed it.
“It’s not even hurt.” Howard Lee, whose arms were numb from the reaction, could not help but be amazed, watching the Mutated Beast without any injuries.
“Of course, it wasn’t effective. You hit it in the hardest part of its body – its head.”
“With that, Jack Clark’s feet smashed the ground with a loud bang, and he once again burst forth with Light King’s Fury, instantly doubling his speed, as if teleporting behind the black bull.”
“Seizing the moment when the mutated black bull was dazed by the impact, he fiercely brought down his sharp and unparalleled sword.”
“With one slash, the fascia at the rear joint of the mutated black bull’s leg was severed completely by Jack Clark, revealing the thick and dense joint bones underneath.”
“Moo!”
“The mutated black bull let out a pained roar. The rear leg joint, now devoid of the protection of fascia and muscle, could no longer support its massive body, and with a crack, the joint broke, and it fell onto its side.”
“Wearing the golden armor, Zac Lyons also rushed down, exclaiming excitedly, ‘Damn, Jack, you actually cut off one of its legs, we’re going to make a fortune this time.’
Jack shook his head: “It’s still early, it just can’t run away, it doesn’t mean it has no offensive power.”
As the two spoke, Mr. Willard with three sets of Angel Wings of Light attached to his back, Howard Lee carrying an iron column, and Justin Welan who had crawled out of the pile of bricks all came over.”
Looking at the mutated beast who was more than 2 meters tall even when lying down, Justin grinned his teeth, “This guy is so powerful, it should be a Level 3 Mutant Beast, where did it come from?”
“This mutated beast was raised by a woman from the rebels. Not only is it powerful, it also has strong defenses and an ability to create shock waves by stomping on the ground.”
“After we kill it together, we’ll share the spoils. And be careful of its tail,” Jack reminded them.
If it wasn’t for Justin and the others stepping in to stop it, the mutated beast might have really escaped in the night, since it was more familiar with the terrain here.
Therefore, Jack didn’t plan to hog the spoils to himself.
In this situation, it was equivalent to sharing the risk. After all, he had only severed one of the mutated black bull’s rear legs, not killed it.
In this state, the cornered mutated beast might become more dangerous.
The others also understood this reasoning, but since the spoils wouldn’t be small if they killed this mutated beast, none of them declined.
“Now that it has lost its mobility, we need to be vigilant for attacks from its mouth, horns, and tail. Mr. Willard, you take the heavy shield in front to draw its attention.”
“When it attacks Mr. Willard, Howard, you take the chance to hit it from the other side and daze it with your pillar, and we’ll target its weak points like the eyes and ears.”
“If we can finish it, we do it; if not, we retreat and look for another opportunity.”
“Alright!”
Without the ability to move, the mutated beast was like a sitting target. Justin roared, and his Mysterious Martial True Power erupted as he fearlessly charged forward holding the heavy shield.
There wasn’t a trace of fear or hesitation on his face; he was born to be the meat shield.
“Moo!” At this point, the mutated black bull’s eyes were blood-red, and it was overflowing with murderous intent. Knowing it might die today, it forcefully charged at Justin rushing towards it.
Boom! Underneath the sharp horns, the heavy shield that even a thick-caliber machine gun couldn’t penetrate sank in, and the terrifying force sent Justin flying back.
However, this time without the blessing of the charging kinetic energy, he only flew more than ten meters away and rolled twice after landing with a thud.
Just as Justin was sent flying, Howard jumped high, slamming the iron column on the bull’s head, forcing the massive head to the ground with his Overbearing strength.
“Now’s the time!”
As Jack and Zac shouted, they struck on the left and right, each with a sword piercing the dazed black bull’s eyes. The tough eyelids were penetrated by Jack’s sword, sinking halfway in, while Zac’s sword also pierced through the eyelids and exploded the eyeball.
Meanwhile, the White Veil accurately stabbed its sword through the bull’s ear, sinking deep in by several centimeters, and then quickly withdrew and backed off after landing the attack.
At that moment, the mutated black bull let out a furious roar and violently stood up despite its injuries. As it did so, it forcefully swung its massive head in the direction of Zac and the White Veil.
Boom! Boom!
The unlucky two were hit by the bull’s head. Even though it was just a glancing blow, the power of this mutated beast was too terrifying, sending them flying more than ten meters away.
Thud! The frenzied mutated black bull stood up only to fall back down again due to its broken rear leg, and in its agonizing pain, it rolled around wildly on the ground.
The violent scene scared everyone to retreat, as being run over by the beast in this state would be disastrous even with their battle armor. If that happened, they’d be in deep shit.
About ten minutes later, the mutated black bull finally stopped moving, and its massive body lay there motionless..

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 79: Gratitude for the Gifts from
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Gratitude for the Gifts from
Nature
Translator: 549690339
Looking at Justin Welan who was limping towards him with a heavy shield, Jack Clark asked with concern, “Mr. Willard, are you okay?”
“I’m fine, I just landed awkwardly just now. A little circulation of Qi Blood will fix it,” Justin Welan said excitedly.
“I didn’t expect that before reaching the Second Grade, we have already killed a Level 3 Mutant Beast.”
Zac Lyons, who came over, touched the corpse of the black bull and exclaimed with the tough feeling transmitted to his hand, “These Mutated Creatures are too gifted. Just a mutated black bull is this powerful.”
Doris Raven, who was a little upset after being swiped away, lamented: “Compared to us human cultivators, these Mutated Beasts have too many advantages.”
“Incredible strength, thick skin, and meat, along with that kind of talent ability similar to a superpower.”
“In comparison, aside from being more agile, we humans can’t compete in any aspect. If we hadn’t figured out True Martial Arts, the consequences would be unthinkable.”
Howard Lee said solemnly, “Because of this, for decades, the officials have spent a lot of manpower and material resources to clean up these Mutated Beasts to curb their growth.”
Jack Clark also nodded with a sigh, “Correct, if we let these Mutated Beasts continue to grow, they will become more and more dangerous for mankind.”
Since even a mutated black bull is so powerful, if those tigers and explosive bears mutate, their strength will be even more terrifying.
If it wasn’t for True Martial Arts and various weapons, humans would be no match for these Mutated Beasts of the same level.
But while humans can suppress Mutated Beasts on land, what about those giant creatures under the deep sea? Thinking about this, Jack Clark faintly felt a sense of unease.
At this moment, Justin Welan suddenly said, “You contributed the most to this Mutated Beast, Jack. If we hadn’t cut off its hind legs, we would have been helpless.”
“I think you should get 60%, and each of us four should get 10%. What do you all think?” He, being a close friend, considered Jack’s benefits first.
Upon hearing this, Zac Lyons and Doris Raven, who were also part of the small team, nodded in agreement.
They indeed didn’t contribute much, so they didn’t object to this distribution.
“This distribution is fair.” Howard Lee also had no objections.
“This… isn’t this a little too much?” Jack hesitated. He originally intended to take 40% as his share, especially since Justin Welan had been knocked off twice.
Justin Welan didn’t care and said, “What’s there to fight for over a Level 3 Mutant Beast? If we exchange it with the school, we’ll earn just 20 Contribution Points.”
“Speaking of which, I have a suggestion.”
Howard Lee looked at the four of them: “This Mutated Beast is useful all over. Be it its skin tough as alloy, nourishing meat, or the four horns and bones.”
“If we put these on the market for sale, at least we’d get a selling price of five hundred thousand.”
“Five hundred thousand, such a big difference.” Jack was somewhat surprised.
20 Contribution Points, with each point in the Black Market ranging between three to five thousand, which is only about one to two hundred thousand. There’s not much to say about the official price, one point is about a thousand, the difference is more than twenty times.
Zac Lyons bitterly smiled, “Can’t help it, Contribution Points can be exchanged for resources, simply put, its actual value is already very high.”
“But what Howard Lee is saying is right. This kind of mutated beef is priced higher in the market, the powder from grounding the Cow Bone is a favorite of some rich people. It strengthens the bone when eaten.”
“Even the cow skin is a good thing, it can produce high-end luxury goods or special armor, the overall value indeed exceeds five hundred thousand.”
Howard Lee continued to say, “Today everyone has made quite a bit of contribution, it doesn’t matter if we get a few more or less. So, I was thinking, based on the market price, I want to buy this Mutated Black Bull with money.” “I wonder if everyone could give me a favor?”
Zac Lyons looked at Howard Lee, seemingly thoughtful, “If I remember correctly, you practice the Advanced Skill Ox Devil Mountain-Shaking Formula, don’t you? You want to purify the Essence Blood of this Mutated Beast.”
“Correct.”
Howard Lee generously admitted, “The Essence Blood of this Bovine Mutant Beast benefits my cultivation method greatly. After using it, it would produce better results than ordinary resources.”
“Since that’s the case, I have no objections.”
Doris Raven shrugged, “I don’t mind either.”
Under the circumstance of getting 10%, they will have 2 Contribution Points. If they exchange it for money, they will get fifty thousand. Even though they can’t convert this money into Contribution Points, it can be useful in other ways.
Howard Lee had given him face just now, so Justin Welan naturally had no objections, especially since they made good gains today.
As for Jack Clark, he nodded after a moment of contemplation.
Three hundred thousand is a significant income for his family, so Doris Raven won’t have to work overtime every day then.
Because both of her sons are studying, especially one who is in high school Cultivating True Martial Arts, Doris Raven has been working overtime voluntarily to earn more money recently.Even on weekends, he’d come to work, despite Jack Clark’s attempts to discourage him. But to no avail.
After divvying up the Mutated Beast, there were faint sounds of footsteps in the distance. It seemed the main group had finally caught up. This meant the evening’s battle was almost over.
Consequently, Jack had no further plans to continue the search. He looked at Justin Welan and asked curiously, “So, how did you guys fare tonight? Did you encounter many rebel cultivators?”
At this, a grin spread across everyone’s faces.
Justin gave a sly laugh, “We were quite lucky, actually. On our way, we encountered three Triplex Cultivators crippled by aerial bombs.”
“Aside from them, we found some scattered rebels mixed with First and Second Layer Heaven cultivators. After taking them down, each of us earned roughly 20 contribution points tonight.”
For each individual to have gained 20 Contribution Points, their haul was pretty impressive.
“How did you guys get so lucky?”
Jack couldn’t help but scoff, “I was up front and could only find one heavily injured Triplex. There were a few Second Layer cultivators, but the rest were all from the ranks of the First Layer Heaven Rebels.”
Despite this, he had scored the most tonight. He estimated his contribution points to fall within about 35 or so.
Justin chuckled, “That’s just luck. Who asked you to choose that central path up the mountain?”
“After the concentrated bombing, even the stupidest rebels would realize they’ve been exposed. The survivors would definitely choose to retreat down the sides of the mountain.”
Jack shook his head, “All I wanted to do was to pick up the leftovers from our teachers. If I could find a Fourth Layer Heaven that they’d heavily injured, it would be a windfall.”
“Who knew I’d only encounter ordinary First and Second Layer Heaven cultivators all the way.”
Initially, Jack had advised Justin not to go too far ahead, but after the bombing, it was he who surged to the front. It was all to scavenge for spoils.
While caution was generally good, it was essential to evaluate each situation differently.
While they were talking amongst themselves, shadows of soldiers gradually appeared on the distant hillsides.
Soon, other classmates also gathered. They were all astonished to see a Mutated Beast that was even larger than an elephant had been slain by Jack’s group.
Half an hour later, accompanied by the somewhat bedraggled but exalted Lori Parma and the others, the night’s battle finally concluded.
In this battle, more than fifteen hundred enemies had been killed, essentially wiping out the rebels in Lester City and the main force of the fleeing Evil God Sect, including even a high-level Archbishop.
Also among them, there were a few fanatics from the Fourth and Fifth Layer Heaven.
Of course, the majority of these individuals had been wiped out by that one strike that had leveled heaven and earth. The few that were heavily injured were found and executed by Lori Parma and the others.
Unlike them, Jack and his group had only dealt with the smaller fries; even so, a few individuals who recklessly charged forward ended up injured.
Under the gushing river water, a fierce aura enveloped the heavily-armored black Mutated Beast. Its cold eyes were locked onto the seven-meter-long sea python ahead.
Back at the hotel, Jack couldn’t sleep, his mind still buzzing with excitement. As a result, he mostly focused on the heavy armored beast.
Unexpectedly, just as he had emerged from the riverbed mud, he had encountered this pitch-black, poisonous sea python, which had discovered him at the same time.
And considered the 2.6-meter-long heavy armored beast as its prey.
The Sea Python was fast in the river, its thick body twisting as it shot towards the heavy armored beast like a dark line, reaching it in a blink of an eye.
Seeing that the black creature seemed not to react, the sea python’s eyes revealed a cold and brutal color. It enlarged its mouth to reveal four sharp teeth and bit down ruthily.
Crack! Crack!!
The oversized fangs clamped on the shoulder of the heavy armored beast, but couldn’t pierce through the black armor. The venom exuded from the hollowed-out teeth had naturally failed to seep in as well.
Faced with this, the sea python didn’t give up. Its body wrapped around the heavy armored beast in an attempt to squeeze it to death.
This was a snake’s common hunting method, but today…
The armored beast stretched out its claws and grabbed the python’s neck, pulling it off its shoulder and biting down on its head.
Bam! Under the horrifying biting force, half the head of the Sea Python was crushed by the heavy armored beast, with the dense blood immediately spreading in the water.
The body of the python whose skull had been crushed stiffened in death but wrapped around the heavy armored beast even tighter, making a screeching sound with its terrifying constriction force.
The heavy armored beast didn’t mind at all and started eating the python’s body satisfactorily.
Thanks for nature’s gift..

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 80: True Strength Tempering
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: True Strength Tempering
Translator: 549690339
At ten o’clock in the morning, Jack Clark was woken up by a phone call.
“Jack, 1 just received a transfer message of 340,000 and the note reads [For student Jack Clark), what’s going on?” Doris Raven sounded a little panicked on the phone.
She didn’t know what Jack had done for someone to transfer so much money to him all at once.
Howard Lee transferred the money from the Mutated Black Bull so quickly.
Jack, somewhat surprised, reassured her, “Mom, don’t worry, it’s the money I got from killing a Mutated Beast with my classmates yesterday. It’s clean and legal.”
“Hunting a Mutated Beast?”
On the other side of the phone, Doris was stunned and even more surprised, “Didn’t you go to the Koroya Trial? How did you end up killing Mutated Beasts? Are you injured?”
“I’m not hurt. It was just a coincidence that we encountered this Mutated Beast while on a mission yesterday, so we killed it casually.”
“As long as you’re not hurt.” Doris on the other side of the phone breathed a sigh of relief.
Knowing that the money was legitimate, Doris felt better and suggested, “Jack, I’ll keep this money for you first, and you can use it to buy a house and get married after you graduate.”
“Uh… aren’t you thinking too far ahead?” Jack said, somewhat amused.
Marriage was too far off for him.
However, he had heard a woman tell him this before, asking him to save his salary to buy a house and get married.
At this thought, Jack felt a little moved.
After a slight silence, Jack softly said, “Mom, you don’t have to save this money. I think you can hire someone to redo the inside and outside of the house.”
“For example, repair the missing ceramic tiles on the outer wall and fix the peeling and cracked walls in the living room.”
“Also, the washing machine broke down twice last month, so let’s just replace it, as well as other old appliances…”
Before he could finish, Doris interrupted, “It doesn’t matter about the renovation. It’s fine the way it is now. You worked so hard to earn this money, so it shouldn’t be wasted.”
Jack persuaded her, “Mom, you don’t have to save this money. I am already at the True Martial Second Layer Heaven and will break through to the Third Layer Heaven in less than two months.”
“By then, when 1 join the Mutated Beast Trials in the second grade, killing a Mutated Beast will earn me hundreds of thousands. This money is nothing.”
“Moreover, Jim has been eating more and more lately, so we can treat him better with the food at home.”
“When my strength is stronger in the future, I’ll let him eat Mutated Beast Meat every day to establish a solid foundation in cultivation, so he can be ahead of other classmates when he enters high school.”
Jack used to wonder why the initial physical constitution of Justin Welan was so high. The reason is that they had started eating Mutated Beast Meat early on.
Of course, they ate the gentler energy Mutated Beast Meat, which was mild in energy content.
If ordinary people ate the powerful Mutated Beast Meat, indigestion would cause death.
And because ordinary people have poor absorption capacity, they need to eat for a long time to slowly improve their physique. This is also why Mutated Beast Meat is so expensive.
Under Jack’s bright description of their future, Doris finally agreed to renovate the house as he requested.
When she returned to the office, the smile on Doris’s face could have been seen by a blind man.
Sister Vernon, who was sitting across from Doris, couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Jenny, did you encounter some good fortune? You look so happy.” Doris happily replied, “Didn’t 1 just receive a text message on my phone? The transfer notification of over 300,000 scared me.”
“What, 300,000!”
“Jenny, where did you get the money?” The surrounding colleagues exclaimed in amazement.
Jenny laughed, “I was shocked too. Since the transfer note had my son’s name,
I called him.”
“Then 1 found out that it was the money he and his classmates shared after killing a Mutated Beast, and Jack said he would break through to the Third Layer Heaven in just a few months.”
Sister Vernon across from her was shocked, “Breakthrough to the Third Layer Heaven in just a couple of months!? Jenny, hasn’t your son been in high school for just over two months!?”
Her son had also practiced cultivation when he was in high school a few years ago, but he failed to achieve Foundation Establishment due to poor talent, so she knew a bit about cultivation realms.Many geniuses at South Sky Martial Height only manage to break through the Third Layer Heaven in their sophomore year.
Doris Raven, who had no concept of cultivation speed, nodded and said blankly, “Yeah, it’s only been a little over two months.”
At this point, another colleague hesitated and said, “I remember you mentioned last week that your son went to the Koroya Trial.”
“My husband works in education, and 1 heard that South Sky Martial Height did send some freshmen to the Koroya Trial, but only a few geniuses could sign up.”
“Hmm, Jack broke through the Second Layer Heaven some time ago, and he even participated in the Freshman Ranking Tournament, ranking 49th in grade.”
Other colleagues immediately exclaimed, “Jenny, 1 didn’t expect your son to be a genius.”
“Yeah, and he’s 49th in his grade, too. That’s amazing.”
Many colleagues congratulated Doris Raven and spoke with envy.
