Hearing the noise outside, the office supervisor furrowed his brows and walked out, but he soon returned with a smile on his face after standing outside the crowd for a while.
Jack Clark didn’t know about all this, and after being awoken by the phone call, he simply sat up. Meanwhile, Justin Welan was still sound asleep on the other bed.
Holding his mobile phone, Jack hesitated for a moment and clicked open the Trial Group, then clicked on Lori Parma’s avatar to start a private chat.
“Teacher, do you have time now?”
Lori Parma’s reply came quickly, with a message sent in just a few seconds.
“Jack, what’s up?”
Jack asked curiously, “Teacher, when I followed you guys up the mountain last night, 1 noticed that the weapons in your hands seemed a bit different from ours.”
“And I don’t think you guys had weapons with you when you got off the car…?”
“I know what you want to ask.”
Facing Jack’s inquiry, Lori Parma answered readily, “As cultivators, we naturally have weapons too, but we usually keep them in Sumi Equipment to nourish them.”
“That’s a kind of equipment containing space, and after you break through the Fourth Layer Heaven, you can exchange for it, so don’t be curious.”
“In addition, our weapons belong to Extraordinary Equipment, which is different from the ordinary alloy weapons of freshmen, and can allow us to exert greater combat power.”
“Extraordinary Equipment!? Jack’s tone was a bit shocked.”
Of course, what shocked him was not the strength of Lori Parma’s weapons, but the idea of attribute strengthening.
Lori Parma didn’t know about these, and reminded him, “Extraordinary Equipment is also the weapon-involved after the Fourth Layer Heaven, so it’s useless for you to learn about these now.”
“However, if you feel that ordinary alloy weapons are too weak, you can try using True Strength to temper battle armor or weapons after breaking through the Third Realm.”
“Although weapons tempered solely by True Strength are not as strong as Transcendent weapons, they are more solid and sharp than ordinary alloys, and I will send you the tempering techniques later.”
“But under normal conditions, 1 don’t recommend you doing this, as it will slow down your cultivation progress, and I wouldn’t have told you if you hadn’t asked me.”
“Compared to tempering weapons with True Strength in the Third Realm, it’s more valuable to break through the Four Layer Heaven and smelt Transcendent weapons earlier, as the former was eliminated 20 years ago.”
After that, Jack asked some more cultivation questions and put down his phone with a faint smile on his face.
Lori Parma’s words just now had resolved some of the concerns he had after strengthening his battle armor.
Although the strengthened armor was very defensive, it also risked exposing some of his secrets.
After all, if everyone else’s armor gets damaged in battle and yours doesn’t, anyone would be suspicious.
Then there’s the issue of the armor’s color changing after being strengthened, but luckily he thought of an excuse at the time causing the serious atmosphere of the trial to be a bit off.
Now, there’s a better excuse to cover it up, and he’s about to break through the Third Realm soon.
Jack got up, tidied up, put on the black and red-trimmed military uniform given by the military, and prepared to go to the dining hall to eat… breakfast, and then exchange life crystal for a breakthrough.
As they had eliminated the main forces of the Evil God Sect Cultists and rebels in Lester City last night, Jack and the others were given two days of rest time.
And due to the reduced threat, their mission would be adjusted at that time, and they wouldn’t have to patrol every day..

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 81: Breaking through the Third Layer Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Breaking through the Third Layer Heaven
Translator: 549690339
It was still that female staff member who greeted Jack Clark enthusiastically when he walked out of the elevator, “Student Clark, are you here to exchange some resources again?”
Jack nodded, “Yes, could you please check how many contribution points 1 have first?”
Last night, after submitting the recording of the battle to verify his individual kills, Jack went to sleep and was still uncertain about the exact number of contribution points he’d earned.
“No problem. Please enter your student ID and verify your face.”
Soon, the female staff member replied with a surprised tone, “Student Clark, you now have a total of thirty-six contribution points.”
No wonder she was surprised. Many trial students had exchanged materials in the morning, with most having around ten contribution points, and only three of them had reached twenty points.
In contrast, Jack had earned thirty-three points, which meant he had killed the most rebels last night.
Thirty-three points, huh?
Jack wasn’t surprised by the gains. Adding the twelve points from the Mutated Black Bull, his total earnings last night should have been forty-five.
This amount was roughly equivalent to half a year’s rewards at school, and that was with the extra income for being ranked 49th in his grade.
Otherwise, under normal circumstances, he couldn’t even get that many contribution points in two semesters.
As the saying goes, one can’t get rich without windfalls, and a horse can’t get fat without grazing at night.
If it weren’t for the fact that everyone was living in the technology era, where cultivators were not accustomed to carrying cash, Jack could have seized even more money from the rebels last night.
With that thought, Jack wondered about the source of funding for the rebels; did they not perform transactions at all?
While racking his brains, Jack politely said, “Can you help me exchange for three Level 2 life crystals?”
A Level 2 life crystal costs fifteen contribution points. After an 80% discount, it costs twelve points, and Jack’s contribution points were just enough to exchange for three crystals.
The levels of life crystals are determined by the mutated beasts they come from. Those from Level 2 beasts contain more and purer life energy, and they are therefore much more expensive.
However, Jack’s group hadn’t found any life crystals in the Mutated Beast they had killed last night.
According to the information Jack had learned, the rate of life crystal production was very low, and only the extremely powerful mutated beasts of the same level would have them in their bodies, such as Level 1 Peak or Level 2 Peak beasts.
It was tested that when a Level 2 Peak Mutated Beast made a breakthrough and advanced to a Level 3 Mutated Beast, the life crystals inside its body would dissolve and disappear.
That’s because the energy of life crystals formed had been used for its breakthrough, which was very similar to how Avatars evolve after accumulating enough evolution value.
Similarly, after breaking through an evolution, everything needs to be consumed and accumulated again.
Compared to these mutated beasts, the potential of Avatars is greater. For example, each evolution can absorb the characteristics of creatures and turn them into talents, and there is no bottleneck in evolution.
Like cultivators breaking through realms, mutated beasts can also get stuck when trying to break through their levels. Many mutated beasts fail to advance even on their deathbeds.
With three life crystals in hand, Jack rode the elevator back to the eighteenth floor, bumped into Marcus Lee who was on his way out to eat, just as he stepped out of the elevator.
Seeing Jack, Marcus Lee curiously asked, “Jack, 1 heard that you guys killed a Level 3 Mutated Beast last night?”
Jack Clark smiled, “We were just lucky. It was a Mutated Black Bull with average attacking power. Howard Lee, Justin Welan, and 1 managed to kill it together.”
Marcus Lee was speechless, “There you go again saying you were just lucky. Can you stop being so humble? It’s okay to be awesome, you know?”
Jack grumpily retorted, “Nonsense, should 1 boast about how amazing 1 am instead of being humble by crediting it to good luck?”
“Well, why not? If I killed a Level 3 Mutated Beast, I’d definitely brag about it to other classmates.”
Jack Clark shook his head, “Forget it, 1 don’t have a thick skin like you do.”
Since they were both teenagers, neither had the sophistication nor maturity of adults, so Jack and his classmates spoke casually with each other.
After some mutual teasing and banter, Marcus left for the cafeteria while Jack returned to his room.
Justin Welan was already out of the room, leaving Jack alone, which was perfect for him to make a breakthrough.
Compared to Level 1 life crystals, Level 2 life crystals were larger and light blue in color, glinting with dazzling ice-blue glimmers under sunlight.
Jack stared at the life crystals and thought, “Convert all of them into attribute points.”
In an instant, the three crystals turned to dust under the influence of an invisible force, and simultaneously, a row of transparent text appeared before Jack’s eyes.
Three Level 2 life crystals yielded 11,12, and 12 attribute points, accumulating to a total of 35.
In comparison to Level 1 life crystals, the amount of life energy contained in Level 2 life crystals mainly depended on one’s luck, which could add up to one or two extra points.
Seeing the 39 attribute points displayed on the transparent page, Jack felt like he had struck rich overnight, as it was the first time he had accumulated so many attribute points.Taking a deep breath, Jack Clark said solemnly: “Spend 20 attribute points to strengthen the third layer of Dragon Elephant Power.”
As his voice dropped, the Dragon Elephant True Strength in his body suddenly burst into action.
With every cycle of Dragon Elephant True Strength, Jack’s muscles and skin were strengthened, the elephant patterns on his skin became more distinct, and finally merged together.
The True Strength in his dantian, originally thin, swelled at double the rate, gradually filling the entire dantian, and then turned into a vortex, spinning wildly.
The thin Dragon Elephant True Strength continued to compress and refine, gradually giving birth to a faint black mist.
Bang! The entire dantian shook violently in an instant, and an illusory elephant roar blasted like thunder.
In an instant, Jack was enveloped by an aura as fierce as a raging elephant, his clothes and hair moving as if in a breeze, emitting a black glow, full of a heavy sense of oppression.
True Strength turns into mist, covering the whole body – the standard of Third Layer Heaven.
As he successfully broke through, Jack slowly opened his eyes and retracted the aura with a thought.
n
Is this the feeling of the Third Layer Heaven?” Feeling the more violent power inside his body, Jack’s face showed a brilliant smile.
To break through the Third Layer Heaven in just over two months would definitely shock many people beyond words.
However, precisely because it was too shocking, Jack didn’t dare to publicize his breakthrough, so he had to wait for some time before slowly showing his progress.
If anything, people already saw his fighting power as freakish due to his high compatibility with Dragon Elephant Power, including several recorded victories against opponents in Third Layer Heaven.
After feeling the surge of power within his body, Jack summoned his attribute page with a thought.
Realm: Third Layer Heaven
Physique: 145^165+
Strength: 155-H85+
Agility: 115^125+
Spirit: 113^118+
Talent: Soul Split
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Methodi Complete]Dragon Elephant Power+[Third Layer]Mind’s Eye Bright Knife+[Second Layer]
Attribute Points: 19
Equipment: Common Armored Battle Suit[Solid+io]
Avatar: Hexagonal Armored Beast
Level: Low-level Unique Beast
Talent: Strength, Defense
Evolution Value: 240/300
This time, the biggest increase from the Dragon Elephant Power breakthrough was in strength, boosting by 30 points, followed by 20 points in physique, with agility and spirit not showing significant gains.
However, even now, his base attributes have already exceeded the limit of the Third Layer Heaven.
Under normal conditions, those at the Second Heaven Peak would have a basic arm strength of 800 kilograms, while a cultivator who just broke through the Third Layer Heaven would generally have a basic arm strength of around 1,000 kilograms.
With continuous cultivation, the base arm strength of a Third Layer Heaven Peak cultivator would reach 2,000 kilograms.
However, the power of True Martial doesn’t lie in physique alone, as no matter how much humans cultivate, their physique can’t compare to the massive mutated beasts and giant beasts.
The real strength of cultivators lies in their True Strength.
For example, Jack right now can cover his entire body with fog-like True Strength, granting him four times the strength and even greater defense.
In addition to this, the mist-like True Strength can attach to weapons, forming knife and sword aura, fortifying the weapon while greatly increasing its attack power.
Now, just after breaking through, Jack’s combat prowess surpassed most cultivators of Third Layer Heaven because of his terrifying base attributes, likely placing him somewhere between the mid to late stage.
However, without comparison, Jack still isn’t quite sure how strong he is right now.
Moreover, his endurance is a bit worse because the initial Dragon Elephant True Strength isn’t as abundant as those in the middle and late stages.
At this point, Jack can be considered a genuine cultivator, gradually rising above the ordinary.
With a formidable body density, elephant-patterned skin membrane, and True Strength Protection, Jack could even resist ordinary bullets and grenade explosions with nothing but his flesh and blood.
Not to mention the terrifying strength burst and movement speed; if he were to appear in ancient times, Jack would practically sweep the world by himself, and his abundant endurance would ensure he wouldn’t be exhausted to death even if he fought for several days and nights in a row..

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 82: Mysterious Yellow and Thick Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Mysterious Yellow and Thick Earth
Translator: 549690339
Boom boom boom boom!!
In the base’s Personal Cultivation Room, Jack Clark’s figure moved like the wind, and every action exploded with terrifying power.
Every punch landed on an alloy steel pillar wrapped in mutated beast skin, causing the two-meter high, half-meter diameter pillar to shake continuously and the air to explode.
When each foot landed on the ground, the ground quivered, like angry elephants stepping on the ground, and the aura was ferocious.
With 185 strength attribute points, Jack’s basic arm strength reached a terrifying 2100 kg.
Add to that the threefold increase from Dragon Elephant Power, the explosive force of True Strength, and the acceleration of the kinetic energy from movement, his casual punch now exceeds ten tons.
Ten tons of solidified force concentrated on the size of a fist, hitting out at an extremely fast speed, causes a tremendous pressure every time it lands on the alloy steel pillar.
As for the backlash strength of punches and kicks on flesh, it was directly blocked by the strong defense of the elephant print pattern after breaking through, allowing him to vent the explosive power within his body freely.
This is the main strength and defense characteristic of Dragon Elephant Power. After cultivation, it significantly enhances power explosion and defense, although it is slightly weaker in agility.
Rumble!
Suddenly, Jack let out a low growl like an elephant, his muscles swelled and his entire body surged up, the momentum on his bodyincreased several times, and his arms, thick as pillars, slammed down.
Boom!
In an instant, the air exploded, and circles of transparent shockwaves burst open. The solid and heavy alloy pillar made a screeching noise, and even metal cracks appeared at the welding points below.
The third layer move of Dragon Elephant Power, angry elephants trampling the sky.
An instant explosion of Unrivaled Domineering Power to shatter enemies, different from the second move sweep, belongs to a single burst killing move.
Huff!
Jack slowly gasped and stopped, dripping with sweat. At this moment, he only felt a refreshing feeling all over his body.
This feeling of venting power was too invigorating.
After a short rest, Jack looked at the remaining attribute points and decided not to use them to strengthen his weapon. Instead, he planned to save up for two more days to break through Heart’s Eye Bright Knife.
As the Dragon Elephant Power he practiced had the characteristic of amplifying strength, the power of the True Strength sword qi that it attached to the weapon when he reached the Third Layer Heaven was average and not as sharp as the Sword Skill after breaking through.
The difference between the two is like that of a rough iron sword and a steel sword. One seems sharp but blunts after a few cuts, while the other is tough and sharp and can cut hair with a single blow.
True Martial Cultivation at the Third Layer Heaven is a small watershed. Those who cultivate with matching sword and knife skills in their main cultivation methods will display their advantages at this time.
In the early stage, they are mediocre in all aspects, their single strength burst can’t compare to Jack, and their speed and agility can’t compare to others. But after breaking through the Third Layer Heaven, their killing power soars.
Unrivaled Sword Qi, sharp sword light, and even stronger lethality.
Unless Jack and the others also cultivate a set of sword or knife techniques, doing so would disperse their energy a lot, so each has its advantages and disadvantages.
It’s four o’clock in the afternoon.
Under the sunlight, Jack, dressed in a red-trimmed black military uniform, was walking in the base, preparing to head back when he heard the “one, two, one, two” chant ahead.
He saw more than thirty soldiers led by Second Lieutenant Jason Raven, running around the base with weight-bearing armor weighing more than 100 kg on their bodies.
Not only did Jack and the others get two days of rest after the battle last night, but these soldiers also had two days of respite.
When seeing Jack, Jason shouted, “Salute!”
Immediately, the thirty people lined up in two rows saluted Jack neatly, making him hurriedly return the salute, but his movements seemed somewhat clumsy.
He couldn’t help it. He had never been in the military before, and suddenly gaining the identity of a special forces soldier took some getting used to. His military salute was learned by imitating others.
Jason chuckled, “Comrade Jack, did you just finish cultivating?”
Jack nodded, “Yes, you guys are also doing your training.”
“Yeah, these guys slept as soon as they got back yesterday. To keep their spirits up, I’m making them run a dozen laps.”
After exchanging greetings, Jason continued to lead his subordinates in Qi Blood training, while Jack returned to the hotel next to the base.
As soon as he entered the room, he saw Justin Welan sitting cross-legged on the floor, meditating, with a blue crystal and a yellow crystal in his hands, surrounded by a vast aura.lt seemed that Justin Welan heard the door open, and he slowly opened his eyes.
Jack Clark was a bit surprised: “Mr. Willard, how come you came back so early today? Didn’t you practice with the other students?”
These few days, Justin had been patrolling and going on missions in the morning, practicing shield battles in the training field in the afternoon, and moving True Strength only in the evenings.
Of course, his afternoon practice was actually him holding a heavy shield for the other students to attack at will, and then mockingly ridiculing them for not being able to push him back even half a step.
“I have to work hard.”
Justin looked envious: “Howard Lee is going to refine almost seven portions of Level 3 Mutant Beast Blood Essence this time, and they are from bovine mutant beasts that perfectly fit his cultivation method.”
“Once he refines those blood essences, not only will his strength skyrocket, he might even break through the Third Layer Heaven soon.”
Jack was surprised: “Is his Blood Essence absorption rate that high?”
Under normal conditions, cultivators have an absorption limit for each kind of resource, just like drug resistance, including Life Crystals.
The same goes for Demonic Beast Blood Essence, with the first absorption being the most effective and then gradually decreasing, by the fourth portion, the effect is almost negligible.
Level 3 Bovine Mutant Beast Blood Essence costs 10 Contribution Points per portion, obtained by refining the mutant beast’s blood, muscle, and bone marrow.
After refining, the value of the beast’s flesh and blood drops significantly, making most of it useless.
Moreover, the price of having an expert refine the mutant beast’s blood essences is high. Howard Lee spent more than 500,000 on it, which might earn him some Contribution Points, but the total won’t be much.
Naturally, Jack wouldn’t be at a loss either. After all, with the official recycling rate, he would get 12 Contribution Points, which is only worth a little over 10,000 yuan.
“Jack, have you forgotten that his cultivation skill compatibility is at a perfect level?”
“Under such conditions, his speed, power, and efficiency in using Blood Essences and resources are extremely exaggerated. He could absorb up to ten portions without a problem.”
“So exaggerated?” Jack was surprised.
Although his Dragon Elephant Power is said to have a high compatibility level, he knew it was fake, so he didn’t have a clear idea of how good the compatibility really was.
Justin rolled his eyes: “Your Dragon Elephant Power is only of high compatibility and it’s already so fierce. He, on the other hand, has perfect compatibility with his Advanced Skill, so of course, it’s exaggerated.”
“If anyone in our enrollment can catch up to Jane Aiken, Howard Lee has the best chance.”
“This guy has Innate Divine Strength, and he also has a perfect match with the Ox Devil Mountain-Shaking Formula, an Advanced Strength Skill. Once he accumulates enough power, he will soar into the sky.”
Jack exclaimed: “Amazing, it seems 1 need to practice even harder.”
At this point, Justin said with a smirk: “But he has a lot of Demonic Beast Blood Essences to help him, and I have the Mysterious Yellow Crystal. Once 1 break through the Third Layer Heaven, I might catch up to him.”
“Mysterious Yellow Crystal.” Jack looked at the earthy yellow crystal in his hand.
Justin proudly said: “Yes, that’s it. My brother sent it to me from the mythical world. It’s a high-level resource containing the aura of Solid Earth.”
“After absorbing the aura of Solid Earth from inside, my Black Tortoise Solid Earth Skill’s defense will become stronger, and my body will become a Mysterious Yellow Body containing the aura of Solid Earth.”
“Haven’t you noticed that my defense has gotten stronger recently? Last night, I was hit and flew twice by that mutant beast, but I was fine, all because of the absorption of the Solid Earth Aura.”
“…Damn.” Staring at the smug Justin, Jack remained silent for a while before finally uttering a curse.
Shit, Jack really wanted to punch him. At that moment, he suddenly felt an itch in his hand and wanted to give Justin a good beating.
Let this guy brag for a while.
However, why the aura inside the Mysterious Yellow Crystal was a Solid Earth aura, Jack was too lazy to ask.
While feeling envious, Jack took a cup of tea and went out to the balcony to bask in the sun and soothe his emotions. At the same time, he planned to practice by taking on the persona of the Heavy Armored Beast, slaughtering the opponent.
Looking at Jack’s frustrated face on the balcony, Justin started to snicker.
Alright, it’s your turn to be envious. Relying on your Dragon Elephant Power’s high compatibility and its overbearing strength, you always show off during fights. It’s about time you experienced some envy.”
But looking at Jack, it seems like his strength has improved again. The invisible oppressive aura he exuded when he came in earlier made me feel a bit uncomfortable.
I have to work harder. Thinking of this, Justin closed his eyes and continued his cultivation..

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 83: Blood-drenched Cannibalism
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Blood-drenched Cannibalism
Translator: 549690339
Outside the balcony, Jack Clark appeared to be sunbathing and resting, but in reality, his consciousness had already sunk and arrived at the Heavy Armored Beasts side.
It had been over forty days since its second evolution.
After continuous devouring and evolution, the Heavy Armored Beasts body had swollen another round, appearing thicker, heavier, and like a lizard with armor.
In particular, the three pairs of feather horns on both sides of its head were blood-red, half a meter long, and covered with sharp spikes, making the Heavy Armored Beast look extremely fierce and domineering.
At a depth of more than 20 meters, the Heavy Armored Beast placed its limbs on both sides of its body, its sturdy tail swaying slightly, searching for suitable prey.
Biu!
A shadow flashed by like lightning in front of it, and if the Heavy Armored Beast hadnt been observant, it might not have noticed it.
biu! The sound of the barely discernable water flow cutting through the air rang out as the shadow appeared again, this time flashing past the Heavy Armored Beasts back.
What is that? Its so fast, murmured the Heavy Armored Beast, surprised.
Since the Heavy Armored Beast had entered the water, it had eaten no less than
200 ordinary mutated fishes, but it had never encountered one with such speed.
Even the one that had left a white mark on the Heavy Armored Beasts belly couldnt compare.
Biu!
Just as Jack Clark was startled, the black shadow flashed past the Heavy Armored Beasts left side again. Due to the depth of the water and the distance of more than ten meters, the exact appearance could not be clearly seen.
But it was evident that the mutated fish had set its sights on the Heavy Armored Beast.
Now, the behavior of this mutated fish should be observing the Heavy Armored Beast and looking for the right opportunity to attack.
Since youre showing up at my doorstep, I wont be polite: The Heavy Armored Beasts tail moved, and its heavy body slowly swam forward, seemingly unaware of the mutated fish.
Suddenly, a black shadow appeared behind the Heavy Armored Beast and appeared beside it with terrifying speed. The sharp-toothed jaws bit down viciously on the Heavy Armored Beasts tail.
Because the speed was too fast, the Heavy Armored Beast didnt react until the bite was on its tail.
Bang! The kinetic energy from the rapid movement flipped the Heavy Armored Beast over, and thencrack, a row of teeth mixed with blood slowly sank and floated in the water.
The mutated fish, which had failed to kill the Heavy Armored Beast and had its full set of sharp teeth shattered, immediately loosened its grip in pain, wanting to escape. But could it just show up and leave?
Boom!
At the moment it released its tail, water exploded; the Heavy Armored Beast suddenly twisted its body due to the full force of its muscles, and its claws struck the mutated fish.
It might not be fast in moving, but that didnt mean its close-range attack speed was slow either.
Under the effect of Hundred-fold Power, the Heavy Armored Beasts left paw slammed into the mutated fishs back, crushing the fishs body into two pieces.
The terrifying force even formed an underwater shockwave, causing violent water currents that only subsided after rushing out more than ten meters.
As its body grew, the Heavy Armored Beast, with its two talents, became even more terrifying. Its defense was invincible at the same level, and the Hundred-fold Power was horrifying, completely unmatched by its size.
Only at this point did the Heavy Armored Beast see what the mutated fish looked like.
In the blood-stained turbid river water, the two pieces of the more than two meters long, flat and long, sharp-bladed fish, covered with gray scales, slowly sank and floated.
On the back of the mutated fish, a row of dorsal fins spread out like sailboat masts. Its head was even more ferocious, resembling a sea wolfs elongated mouth filled with sharp teeth.
However, they had been shattered by the Heavy Armored Beasts tail.
No wonder it was so fast; just by its shape, the Heavy Armored Beast could tell that the focus of this fishs mutation was its speed.
Unfortunately, being fast alone was useless. If its defense was too weak, it would be slapped to death as soon as the opportunity arose.
The tail flicked, and the Heavy Armored Beast moved forward and grabbed one half of the mutated fishs body with one claw. Its jaws filled with sharp teeth bit down and tore off a large chunk of flesh to devour.
Although the flat and elongated mutated fish looked quite long, the sum of its flesh weighed only a few hundred kilograms and was soon consumed by the Heavy Armored Beast.
Not satisfied, it wreaked havoc near the estuary, only swimming towards the shore to return to its lair to rest and digest when it felt full.
In the ten meters deep river, as the Heavy Armored Beast approached the shore, something with a splash fell into the water, slowly sinking in front of it.
Looking at the palm-sized little fish, struggling with the fishhook stuck in its dorsal fin, the Heavy Armored Beast revealed surprise.
Whats going on; is someone fishing here?
Suddenly, the corner of the Heavy Armored Beasts ferocious mouth lifted, revealing its sharp white teeth. Its sharp right claw reached out and gently grabbed the small fish to pull it up.
As the water level dropped instantly, the middle-aged man on the shore holding a fishing net excitedly shouted, Its here! Quick, pull it up!
I see it! replied another middle-aged man holding a fishing rod, pulling hard.bender
Squeak, squeak!! The enormous force caused the nine-meter-long fishing rod to bend to its limit, the fishing line supporting hundreds of kilograms making squeaking noises.
Damn, its so heavy; this fish must weigh at least a few hundred pounds.
< >Really? Are you serious?
Serious; Im not lying to you. Remember, Im a cultivator with Second Layer Heaven strength. Just one shake of my arms can lift hundreds of kilograms.! cant believe I cant pull that fish up in one go, it must be huge.
True, hurry, Im going to use my mobile phone to take a photo of it for you.
Watch me, once I exhaust that fishs energy by tiring it out, 1 can forcefully pull it up. Today will be my brightest moment
On the shore, two middle-aged men who came out to relax struggled desperately to reel in their catch, but they couldnt budge the big fish underwater.
It only made them even more excited.
Under the water, the Heavy Armored Beast lazily laid on the riverbed with its right claw holding the fishhook, letting them tug. Occasionally, when it was in a good mood, it would raise its claw and give them a little motivation.
About half an hour later, the Heavy Armored Beast, feeling it had played enough, suddenly reached out with its left claw and held down a small fish more than 20 centimeters long swimming past.
On the shore, Brian Raven suddenly felt a lightness in his hand and exclaimed excitedly, Its coming! He then swung the rod forcefully upwards.
Bang! The river water splashed, and a small fish more than 20 centimeters long shot out of the water, falling onto the shore with a smack.
Looking at the struggling little fish on the grass, the bewildered expressions on Brian Raven and his friends faces asked what happened to the huge fish I hooked?.
For the next two days, everyone was practicing diligently.
After going through several life-and-death battles and gaining a large amount of Contribution Points to exchange for resources, this was the best time for cultivation.
Jack Clark was no exception.
Breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven, his efficiency in absorbing energy while practicing with Blue Crystals skyrocketed. Hes able to refine all the originally dissipating 30% energy without wasting a bit.
During these two days, apart from cultivating, the members of the group occasionally chatted, exchanging information about the enemies they encountered and combat experiences.
Upon Jacks inquiry, it turned out that Crystal Leinsters sisters, Matt Watkins, and Freya Louise had reserved some cultivation resources for themselves.
After continuous battles during this period and being close to death, not only Jack, but also Crystal and others strengths had grown tremendously.
On the morning of the third day, Jack donned his battle armor and gathered outside the hotel.
After several fiery battles, all the freshmens faces had lost their childish innocence and had become much more mature and resolute.
However, the styles became more eccentric.
After two days, the other classmates battle armor had changed. Some followed Zac Lyons example and painted theirs gold, while others added wings like the White Veil.
But the wings werent Angel Wings; they were the kind that draped over half the body and could be folded, like a Sky Set.
Besides those, some added black cloaks to their heavy battle armor, which looked quite dashing as well.
Even Howard Lee, the thick-browed, big-eyed guy, not only reinforced the entire armor but also welded four horns from the Mutated Black Bull onto the shoulders and back of his battle armor.
With four curved horns each measuring over a meter long and carrying a three-meter-long pillar on his back, he resembled a formidable ancient warrior.
In such a situation, it was Jack Clark, who didnt modify his armor, who looked relatively ordinary and out of place among his classmates.
Should 1 modify my battle armor too? Just as Jack was pondering this problem, Lori Parma and the other two teachers walked out.
Lori Parma said solemnly, The main force of the Evil God Sect in Lester City has been annihilated, so most of the military experts and troops will be transferred to other areas to provide support.
What, teacher, youre leaving?
What about us? The crowd suddenly became restless, as everyone was surprised by this news.
Lori Parma spoke solemnly, Dont panic. Teacher Sylvia Lyons will stay here, and you have an important task.
According to the interrogation, there are more than ten ordinary Blood God Cultists hiding in Lester City, with the strongest person being a Triplex. Their purpose is to spread Blood Seeds.
As the name suggests, Blood Seed is an evil power seed that can turn ordinary people into real cultivators once absorbed.
Those who absorb the Blood Seed are called blood disciples and can rapidly increase their power by hunting and refining the blood essence of ordinary people.
Zac Lyons exclaimed, Refining blood essence Isnt that cannibalism!?
Lori Parma said solemnly, Yes, thats the terrifying aspect of the Blood God
Sect. Many of the sects experts killed by the alliance earlier were Blood Envoys.
The Blood God Sect has been secretly infiltrating Koroya for a long time, fostering a group of Senior Blood Envoys and a large number of indoctrinated cultists by killing and refining blood essence in this barren land.
Thats why the Federation is ruthless towards the Evil God Sect, as these people have long gone mad.
Lori Parmas words made everyones face look very ugly and heavy.
But you dont have to worry. In Lester City, only ordinary Blood Seeds are being spread, and there arent many of them. Their growth potential is capped at the Third Layer Heaven.
If those Blood Seeds werent so difficult to distinguish from ordinary people, they would have been wiped out earlier.
From now on, you can act individually or in teams. Pay attention to places where murders occur, and youll likely discover some clues.
In addition, there are still some scattered remnants of the rebels in the area. You need to clean them up to prevent them from joining forces with the Evil God Sect in other cities and making a resurgence
Afterward, Lori Parma gave Jack and the others a few more tips before finally dismissing them..

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 84 Dark Age
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Dark Age
Translator: 549690339
Wearing battle armor and carrying heavy weapons, Jack Clark and Justin Welan stood at the street corner, drawing the attention of passersby.
As the Federation defeated the rebels and suppressed the remnants in the last two days, Lester City had regained some vitality.
For example, there were noticeably more pedestrians on the street, and vehicles occasionally drove by on the road. Some shops and restaurants on both sides had also reopened.
However, after the meeting, Justin Welans face had been looking terrible.
Jack Clark couldnt help but ask, Mr. Willard, are you constipated this morning? Why do you keep making that sour face?
Justin Welan gave a bitter smile, Its because of the Blood Seeds.
Wasnt it said that the spread of ordinary Blood Seeds wouldnt allow them to break through the Third Layer Heaven? Whats there to worry about? Jack Clark frowned.
Its mainly because the Blood Seeds reminded me of some unpleasant things.
What things?
Justin Welan looked serious, Under normal conditions, when we cultivators step into the First Layer Heaven, we absorb Transcendent energy from Heaven and Earth to enhance ourselves.
But just over fifty years ago, when such cultivation first began, the energy between Heaven and Earth was even more barren in our world than in Koroya. It was possible for cultivators to not break through the Second Layer Heaven for ten years.
Then someone came up with the cannibalism cultivation method, referring to the Giant Beasts that had descended for the first time back then.
At the beginning of the New Era, Giant Beasts frequently appeared. The most famous example was the World Serpent that appeared in the Aohedi Sea. It coiled in the sky above the city and swallowed millions of people in one gulp.
It was said that the sky was covered by a giant swallowing mouth, and countless ordinary people turned into blood foam, forming a blood river that surged into the sky.
The fundamental reason was that after they came to our world from their high-energy world, they couldnt adapt to the environment and instinctively wanted to replenish their energy.
From this perspective, some crazy cultivators determined that humans are also energy sources and conducted a series of experiments, including refining the flesh and blood of cattle and sheep.
I dont know the specific process, but as the blood refining method spread, the whole world fell into a five-year Dark Age.
You must know that at that time, there were more than 150 countries around the world, with a population of more than three billion people, but after those Innate Awakened Ones suppressed the chaos and established the Global Federation, there were only more than two billion people left.
Jack Clark suddenly felt a chill, as if an endless smell of blood was coming towards him.
Approximately one billion people died unnaturally within ten years. What a desperate and dark era that was; the mountains of corpses and seas of blood could not even be described.
Nevertheless, Jack was still puzzled, How come 1 havent seen any information about the deaths of nearly a billion people on the internet?
Justin Welan spread his hands, Of course, its been erased. The technology at that time was far less advanced than it is now, and information wasnt as developed.bender
In this situation, news of massacres and slaughters in some places would turn into rumors once it spread thousands of miles away, and most people would just treat it as idle talk.
Those who witnessed or experienced it personally were mostly dead, and only a small number joined the military and became strong cultivators.
Under these circumstances, after the official fading of the history for decades, almost no ordinary people remember these events now.
People nowadays only know that the period was chaotic, and there were Giant Beasts everywhere devouring humans. Many people died due to local military missile attacks.
At the same time, this is also one of the reasons why the official control of cultivation methods, wheel fishing, and cultivators is so strict, to avoid such a situation from happening again.
I only learned about this when my elder brother had a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven last year. In his excitement, he accidentally let the information slip and told me when I questioned him.
At that time, I just felt dumbfounded after hearing it. Hundreds of millions of people had been eaten by those crazy cultivators. At this point, Justin Welans face looked extremely terrible.
Jack Clark let out a long sigh and said solemnly, So, the Blood Seeds are the cannibalism cultivation method from back then?
Correct, but not completely.
Justin Welan nodded, Many of those madmen back then were Innate Awakened Ones who created numerous terrifying blood refining techniques, even capable of massacres on a large scale.
Blood Seeds are just one of them. It is said that this kind of cultivation method has a Blood God Origin, and the strong man who controlled the Origin at that time had split countless Blood Seeds and granted them to ordinary people.
Finally, when those peoples strength had reached a certain level, that strong man would take back all their power, and in a very short period of time, become a terrifying existence.Jack Clark suddenly said, Blood God Sects supreme god, Akunus.
It should be it. Justin Welan nodded seriously.
These people, they deserve to die. A killing intent appeared in Jack Clarks eyes.
Its normal for cultivators to have ideological disputes and grievances, but nobody can tolerate the act of eating their own kind for cultivation.
Even if Jack Clark had never seen the so-called Blood God, at this moment, he was filled with hostility towards this unknown strong man named Akunus.
The population of Lester Urban Area is more than 700,000, and with the administered villages and towns, the overall population is over a million.
Under such circumstances, for twenty Special Forces Soldiers to search for cultists and hidden blood disciples among a million people is like finding a needle in a haystack.
However, this problem is easy to solve.
After learning that blood disciples needed to kill to quickly increase their strength, many students, including Jack Clark, came to the local Law Enforcement Bureau.
As Special Forces Soldiers, they easily obtained the authority to view recent death case files.
However, due to the previous rebel incident, many files are currently missing. The newly established Law Enforcement Bureau only had the files of homicide cases from the past week.
Hey, line up, one at a time. Zac Lyons spread his arms, signaling his classmates not to squeeze in.
Sitting in front of the computer, viewing the files, White Veil cooperated and shouted, Everybody, dont rush. Theres only one computer. Once Ive determined a target, Ill make way.
Soon it was Jack Clarks and Justin Welans turn.
Jack Clark reminded, Mr. Welan, rule out those who died from illness or old age, and focus on those who died unnaturally in the past few days.
With his Hearts Eye Perception and the enhanced Five Senses as his physique improved, Jack Clark was confident that he could detect blood disciples within a range of tens of meters.
I understand.
Got it, a death case occurred here the day before yesterday. The victims were two adults, and their corpses were found withered and hidden in a ditch.
Okay, okay, its our turn.
As soon as Justin Welan confirmed a target, the classmates behind him urged him to make way. They were all eager to eliminate harm for the people.
More than half an hour later, the two appeared in the suburbs. Their eyes scanned the low and shabby brick houses, the narrow and dilapidated roads, and the rubbish and debris on both sides.
Not far away, several dark-skinned men in tattered clothes sat with lifeless eyes at the entrance of their homes.
The first impression this place gave Jack Clark was dirtiness, chaos, decay, and despair, with no trace of modern civilization.
Its no wonder that the Koroya royal family deserved to be overthrown by the rebels, but unfortunately, those people shouldnt have teamed up with the Evil God Sect.
Otherwise, even if they had overthrown the Koroya royal family, the Federation would not have intervened.
Of course, Jack Clark knew that his assumption was a bit far-fetched. After all, the Koroya royal family controlled Cultivation Methods and the military, leaving ordinary people with no power to resist.
This was also the reason why the Evil God Sect could develop secretly here. Desperate people wouldnt miss any hope, even if that power was poisonous.
However, now that the official authority here is supported by the Federation, the place should gradually develop in line with international standards.
Lets go, Jack Clark said, striding forward, with Justin Welan following.
The alloy cast battle boots made a dull sound as they stepped on the ground. As the two walked by, the elderly sitting in front of the door just glanced at them weakly.
Old people sunbathing, children hiding behind doors sneakily watching them, insects crawling underground, and rats searching for food in garbage piles.
Everything around them was exposed under Jack Clarks Hearts Eye Perception..

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 85: The Brothers of the Heavy Armored Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: The Brothers of the Heavy Armored Beast
Translator: 549690339
In the office, Colonel Henric Cobb praised, These freshmen are not bad, they actually thought of going to the Law Enforcement Bureau first.
Across from him, Sylvia Lyons shook her head, This method can only catch fools. After today, the rest of them will definitely hide.
I dont know how long it will take to dig out all these rats.
Henric Cobb sighed, Theres no other way. The level of modernization here is too low, and everything is chaotic at the moment. They can only rely on slow investigations.
In any case, they are just ordinary Blood Seeds. Even if we let them grow for a month or two, they wont be able to cause much trouble.
This is precisely what the higher-ups want; to temper this new generation of cultivators and consume Akunus Blood God Origin in the process.
It has split so many Blood Seeds throughout the Koroya Territory. Even though most of them are low-level, the consumption is still huge, especially when the thoughts contained within the blood disciples are extinguished.
Of course, if those senior Blood Seeds grow up, it would also provide a great deal of nourishment for it. However, this is Federation territory, and such a situation wont be allowed to occur.
Sylvia Lyons nodded, As long as you are not anxious, thats fine. By the way, 1 heard that there will be people coming from other schools in a few days?
Cameron Raven nodded, Yes, these freshmen come from two second-tier universities. They will also join in the hunt for the blood disciples, but Im afraid there wont be enough of them to kill by then.
Walking through a dirty and messy alley, Jack Clark suddenly stopped.
Jack Clark looked up and saw a low courtyard in front of him. There was no door, and inside, two dark-skinned young men were fixing a tricycle.
When they saw Jack Clark and the others, their faces showed restraint and awe, and they smiled apologetically, Excuse me, sir, may I ask what is the matter? Nothing, just curious how you plan to die? Saying that, Jack Clark slowly drew the long knife behind him, and a heavy oppressive aura spread from his body.
At the moment Jack Clark drew his sword, the faces of the two men changed.
Not good, run! A thick, bloody scent erupted from the two of them, but their realm was only First Layer Heaven, which made Jack Clark feel somewhat disappointed as they were too weak.
Boom!
At that moment, the sound of a wall collapsing came from the side room.
Leave these two to you. As he spoke, Jack Clark put his feet through the ground, and his burly figure suddenly moved, turning into a black and red shadow that slammed into the wall.
Boom!
Bricks and rubble flew in all directions, and smoke and dust filled the air. Jack Clark directly smashed two large holes through the wall, and his figure vanished in the blink of an eye.
Justin Welan, holding a heavy shield, slowly walked towards the two cultists with a heavy, overwhelming aura, and asked, How many people have you killed since acquiring the Blood Seed?
The eyes of the two young men turned red unconsciously, and despite Justin Welans oppressive aura, they showed no fear, sneering, Not many, only five.
Five lives, just to break through to the First Layer Heaven. You really deserve to die.
As his words fell, Justin Welans aura burst forth, and he suddenly charged like a Mysterious Martial turtle clad in spike armor, his speed three times faster than usual.
Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Formulas Second Layer killing move, Mysterious ATartial Tempest.
Knowing that they couldnt escape, the two blood disciples showed a fanatical expression and shouted, Death is just a return to the supreme embrace of Akunus. Burn with us!
In an instant, a faint blood light ignited on their bodies, and under the intense glow, their aura doubled, and they charged at Justin Welan with an evil aura.
Boom! Boom!!
The charging trio collided in the blink of an eye, and the two blood disciples exploded immediately. Countless pieces of flesh and blood flew in all directions, and even Justin Welan was shaken back two steps by the impact of the explosion.
Looking at the limbs and corpses on the ground, Justin Welans face turned ugly, Crazy.
While he easily dealt with the two blood disciples, Jack Clark had caught up with the fleeing person in a dirty and chaotic alley.
Seeing the thin woman clad in a linen robe stop, Jack Clark slowly asked, Do you want to come with me willingly, or should 1 break your limbs and take you with me?In the past, he would kill the cultists outright, but today Jack Clark intended to capture one alive to hand over to Sylvia Lyons or a military expert, hoping to gain some useful clues.bender
As soon as he spoke, the womans face revealed her madness: You Federation dogs, one day, the great Akunus will bring the end of the world to cleanse this world.
For the great Akunus As she spoke, a powerful aura of Second Layer Heaven realm burst forth from her, and her right hand reached into her bosom
Bang!
At that moment, Jack Clark exploded with frightening speed, breaking through the air with a flash of his blade, almost instantly sweeping past her.
This blade was terrifyingly fast, so fast that the woman had no time to react.
Only then did a red line spread across her forehead, and with a pop, her blood and flesh gushed out, her body split into two halves on the floor.
Jack Clark slowly sheathed his knife, eyes cold: As expected, they are lunatics, already burying explosives here and planning to die together.
Upon entering this alley, Jack Clark had already sensed the dangerous atmosphere pervading his surroundings.
Thats why he spoke, diverting the cultists attention while observing her expression and body movements, not giving her the chance to press the remote control.
By the time they returned to the courtyard, the law enforcement squad had already arrived.
Leaving the matter of the corpse to them, Jack Clark and Justin Welan exchanged words: Did you find anything?
Justin Welan shook his head: Nothing, everything in the house was normal, and no clues about other cultists were found.
These guys seek death at the slightest disagreement, seeming normal on the surface while actually insane. Their existence seems only to create chaos.
Jack Clark suggested: Lets go, well talk more on our way back.
They boarded the off-road vehicle of the Law Enforcement Bureau and returned by noon.
On the third floor of the cafeteria, Jack Clark was just eating when his gaze suddenly paused.
At the depth of over twenty meters beneath the dark riverbed, a mutant alligator, seven meters long, with a body covered in black scales, stood on all fours, its eyes cold as it stared ahead.
At this spot, the Heavy Armored Beast looked somewhat surprised at the mutant alligator.
Similar black scales, similar sharp claws on all fours, ferocious large mouths, stout bodies and tails.
Apart from the differences in their heads and the feather-like horns on both sides, the two mutated creatures gave the impression that they were mutated from the same species.
Despite hunting in the river for so long, the Heavy Armored Beast had never seen a mutated creature similar to itself before, even though this fellow was an alligator.
Roar! The Heavy Armored Beasts mouth opened slightly, letting out a low growl as a greeting.
Gurgle! Gurgle!
In contrast to the friendly Heavy Armored Beast, the mutant alligator was far less courteous, letting out gurgling vibrations from its mouth as its massive body menacingly approached.
Seeing this, the Heavy Armored Beasts gaze turned colder.
Roar! The Heavy Armored Beast let out a final warning growl.
At the same time, the mutant alligator had already come within five meters of the Heavy Armored Beast, its huge body suddenly pouncing at it, treating the Heavy Armored Beast as prey.
Seeking death.
Seeing the mutant alligator pounce in the blink of an eye, the Heavy Armored Beasts forelimb muscles bulged.
Bang!
The waters exploded, and the seven-meter-long mutant alligator was sent flying by the Heavy Armored Beasts claw strike. Its massive body rolled continuously along the murky riverbed, its flesh and blood blurred by the impact.
At this moment, the mutant alligator that was struck hard began to doubt its existence in life??

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 86: Too Amazing
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Too Amazing
Translator: 549690339
Under the murky river surface, right when the mutant alligator was sent flying, the Heavy Armored Beast quickly caught up and lunged at it, its robust left claw swiftly striking down.
Boom! With one claw from the Heavy Armored Beast, the mutant alligators head plunged directly into the riverbed.
Due to the tremendous force, half of the mutant alligators body sank into the ooze, immediately struggling fervently, its gargantuan body exuding an astonishing amount of strength.
For a moment, the entire riverbed turned muddy, with turbulent water spraying.
Under normal conditions, crocodiles can hold their breath for an hour or two underwater, and this mutant alligator, having undergone mutation and evolution, had naturally stronger breath-holding capacities.
But, a few minutes later, with a stark crack, the frantically struggling mutant alligator stiffened abruptly.
Looking at the mutant alligator, whose neck was broken under its own grip, the Heavy Armored Beast exhaled a burst of bubbles, a hint of regret in its eyes.
Originally, when it saw this similar mutant alligator, it was considering the idea of recruiting it to serve as a little brother. Having a bodyguard following around when it went out seemed quite nice.
Who knew this creature was so foolish.
The Heavy Armored Beast gripped the body of the mutant alligator with its two claws, a tear trickling down from the corner of its mouth as it bit down fiercely.
Um! The Heavy Armored Beasts eyes brightened as it found the taste of this crocodile to be seemingly good, its meat having more chewiness than those of the mutated fishes.
Jack, Jack. Seeing Jack lost in thought, Justin Welan across from him called out twice.
Whats up? Jack snapped back to reality.
Justin looked at him curiously before saying, 1 was suggesting whether we should split up and act independently in the afternoon. We might be more efficient that way.
That works, Jack nodded. Initially, he formed a team with Justin intending to take care of him.
With his cultivation at the Third Layer and keen perception, any blood disciples he encountered wouldnt escape at all.bender
Jack cautioned, I have a feeling we need to get down to business in the afternoon. After this wave of sudden attack, those blood disciples will probably hide deeper and wont be as easy to catch.
Thats what I was thinking too.
After lunch, the duo soon arrived at the Law Enforcement Bureau. Some folks over there didnt even have lunch, they were engaged in browsing dossiers, Jack quickly zeroed in on a suspicious location.
At two in the afternoon, Jack arrived alone at an ageing community south of the city. As he drew closer, his keen olfactory sense could detect a faint stench of blood, his gaze fleeting to a building nearby.
As his physique grew stronger, even without relying on his Hearts Eye, Jacks hearing, vision, and sense of smell had all transcended human limits.
Treading on the dim stairwell, each of Jacks footsteps was heavily laden.
When passing by the third floor, someone tried to exit. Upon opening the door, he was immediately startled by the sight of Jack, draped in dark red armor with a sword slung on his back, hurriedly shutting the door.
Ignoring these ordinary folk, Jack slowly ascended, his acute senses detecting the faint smell of blood in the air.
His steps finally paused before the door of 603 on the sixth floor.
Knock knock knock! Jack gently knocked on the door.
Who is it? A mans voice emerged from inside.
In a deep voice, Jack said, Delivery man.
Boom! The moment the words left his mouth, Jack directly slammed onto the iron door. Under the impact of his terrifying strength, even the doorframe and the wall were sent flying inward.
Within the diffuse smoke and dust, Jack, decked in dark red armor, looked coldly at the panicked glasses man in the living room, who was handsome and clean-cut.
Below him, in the corner of the sofa, one could vaguely see a ghastly pale dead mans hand.
Whatwhat are you doing? Confronted by the wall-breaking entrance of Jack, the glasses man exuded an air of fearful tension.
Jack coldly retorted, Stop pretending, even if I closed my eyes, I would still be able to smell the strong stench of blood on you.
His cover blown, the glasses mans face changed as he lamented in grief and indignation, Why, why cant you all let me go? I just want to live, just want to live well.
As he spoke, the energy of his Blood Qi at the peak of the First Layer Heaven burst forth from his body. Grabbing the coffee table with his two hands, he flung it towards Jack, while he turned and dashed towards the window.
Boom! The coffee table in mid-air exploded with a deafening sound. In the blink of an eye, Jacks figure appeared like the wind behind the glasses man, slashing his overpowering knife down.Thud! The man with the glasses was suddenly split into two halves, crashing onto the ground with a loud thud, and bright, hot blood spurted out, rapidly painting the floor red. The scene was both bloody and brutal.
One contribution point secured.
In his calm voice, Jack Clark flicked his wrist, shaking off the blood on his blade, before pulling out his phone to call the law enforcement team to take over the clean-up.
Next, Jack Clark took up another mission, but unfortunately, the blood disciple who had committed murder three days ago had managed to cover their tracks well.
By the time he had finished his days work and returned to the hotel, it was already past five in the afternoon. Most of his classmates were already back, with many of them wearing smiles on their faces, signaling a day of successful harvests.
However, not everyone had managed to track down the blood disciples.
Furthermore, after today, the remaining blood disciples would most likely become more cautious. As time went on and they continue to kill and refine their Essence Blood, they would become even more powerful.
According to Justin Welans estimates, these creatures could make rapid progress equivalent to half a month of hard cultivation in their school by killing just one person. Their strength enhancement was akin to strapping a rocket to their back.
Although they would need time to refine after killing someone, the ease with which they could enhance their powers explained why there was such an enormous bloody massacre decades ago.
After dinner, Jack Clark headed to the basement logistics department.
Today, having killed a Level 2 cultist and a Level 1 blood disciple, he had exactly enough for 4 contribution points, which could be exchanged for a Level 1 Life Crystal.
The person on duty behind the counter this time was a different one. Seeing Jack Clark, he greeted warmly, Hello, what would you like to exchange?
One Level 1 Life Crystal.
Alright, please wait a moment.
In the elevator, Jack Clark reached into his pocket and gripped the Life Crystal, thinking, Convert attribute points.
Youve converted a crystalized Life Energy, gaining 4 attribute points.
Seeing the 23 free attribute points on his attribute page, a smile spread across Jack Clarks face.
These points were enough for him to enhance his Minds Eye Bright Knife to the third layer. Once his blade could convert True Strength into sharp Sword Qi, his combat power would once again surge tremendously.
When Jack Clark returned to his hotel room, he saw Justin Welan lounging on the sofa: Ah Chu, youve come back at just the right time. Freya Louise was just mentioning you in the chat.
Did she need something from me? Jack Clark asked, puzzled.
No, she was just wondering why you havent been active in the chat recently.
Of course Ive been cultivating, said Jack Clark, puzzled.
His motivation for cultivation was running high since he had just broken through to the Third Layer. Plus, he had to spend time transforming into the Heavy Armored Beast and laying waste to the rivers. Every day was chock-full with activities.
Especially today when he had been preoccupied with killing, he barely had any time for cultivation. Even while controlling the Heavy Armored Beast to feed, he found himself somewhat distracted.
I knew it, Justin Welan shook his head.
However, after Justin Welans reminder, Jack Clark did log into the chat group to post a message before curiously asking, By the way, Class Leader, has Jane Aiken broken through to the Third Layer Heaven?
Crystal Leinster, Huh, Jack Clark, how did you know she broke through?
Jack Clark paused: I just asked.
Freya Louise chimed in: Today, Jane Aiken encountered a Third Layer rebel cultivator. Even though she was only at the Second Layer Heaven, she managed to kill him with her overwhelming power.
Then, less than half a day after she returned to the base, we heard she had broken through to the Third Layer Heaven. Isnt she amazing?
Jack Clark exclaimed: Amazing indeed. She is undoubtedly the number one prodigy of South Sky Martial Height.
The tone of his voice didnt hint in any way that he himself had already broken through to the Third Layer Heaven.
Justin Welan acknowledged with envy: Her extraordinary talent has already been very clear. Its been over a month since she broke through to the Second Layer Heaven. Its completely normal for her to have suddenly broken through to the Third Layer Heaven now.
Especially after going through so many battles here and having an abundance of resources.
But even as he said this, Justin couldnt help but feel a tinge of envy. He too wished he could breakthrough as easily as drinking water, just like Jane Aiken..

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 87: Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Monster
Translator: 549690339
The next morning, Justin Welan and the others went to the Law Enforcement Headquarters again, wanting to check if there were any new murders or people killed by blood disciples in other places yesterday.
As for Jack Clark, he went to the neighboring military base and requested a Cultivation Room.
Jack Clark exhaled slightly, somewhat expectant, and a voice echoed in his mind: Consume 20 attribute points, enhance Hearts Eye Bright Knife to Third Layer Heaven.
Buzz!
With the disappearance of 20 attribute points, Jacks consciousness was instantly pulled into a mysterious realm.
Similar to the Hearts Eye but more vast, it seemed as if the entire persons heart was infinitely magnified, covering the entire Cultivation Room and extending several dozen meters in diameter outside.
Within this range, Jack could sense the wind blowing and the ripples of air flow.
This kind of perception was very mysterious, not the clear image of releasing Spirit Power, but more of an indistinct intuition.
At the same time, a sharp power was born out of thin air within Jacks body, automatically circulating and opening a new route in his body.
This circulation route was different from the Dragon Elephant Power that covered his entire body, with the most involvement in his upper body and arms, eventually returned to the Dantian after ten cycles.
Facing this sharp True Strength, the Dragon Elephant True Strength in the Dantian instantly burst out, rushing with a thick and ferocious aura.
Bang! The two True Strengths collided, causing a violent shockwave.
Jack didnt react to any of this, as he was currently immersed in the third realm of Hearts Eye, allowing the two True Strengths within his Dantian to collide and intertwine.
He didnt know how much time had passed.
When Jack woke up, he found that the True Strength in his body had doubled, and the originally thick Dragon Elephant True Strength had become a bit sharper.
Jack was not surprised with this result, because after breaking through to the third layer of Sword Skill, True Strength would be born from the outside in, called Sword Qi.
If there were other main Cultivation Methods at this time, then this Sword Qi would merge with the True Strength.
In the Cultivation Room, Jack gently unsheathed his sword, and the True Strength in his body followed the new circulation route in his arms, merging into the blade, instantly revealing a layer of black Sword Qi.
Compared to the faintly shining blade, the black Sword Qi was more condensed, as if an inch-long faint black blade had been added, emitting a sharp edge.
Whoosh!
Jack simply waved his straight blade lightly, and the sound of air being torn apart echoed in the air, terrifyingly sharp.
Afternoon.
In the revitalized and bustling area, Jack, dressed in black-red armor and carrying a long knife, walked down the street, with a black cloak swaying slightly behind him.
This appearance contrasted sharply with the styles of the surrounding commercial shops and was very eye-catching.
However, most pedestrians just glanced at him and then looked away in awe, not daring to stare directly at the figure in battle armor.
Although Jack and the others had only arrived in Lester for a week, everyone knew not to mess with these black-red armored Special Forces Soldiers.
These Special Forces Soldiers had followed the armored Squadron to patrol the entire city, killing many rebels in the gunfire, and their strength was terrifying.
Its been said that they have been hunting down dangerous elements in the past few days and even broke into houses to kill people.
It is said that one of them carried a heavy shield weighing hundreds of kilograms, and after killing a person, would shake all the egg yolks in the house before leaving, which was extremely brutal.
Too terrifying!
Jack didnt know what these people were thinking. His attention was focused on himself, or rather, on sensing those gazes.
Awe, this gaze is a bit fearful, this one doesnt have any feeling.
Curiosity, mockery, this one seems to carry some hatred. Did a family member of his join the rebels and get killed by me
As the Hearts Eye broke through to the Third Layer, the indistinct perception became even more sensitive, and Jack could almost sense the gaze upon him.
Moreover, unlike the vague perception of the Second Layer, he could even sense the faint emotions carried by these gazes.
However, sometimes being too sensitive was not a good thing, as it made Jack feel like needles were falling on him at every moment, which was very uncomfortable.Thats why he came here, planning to practice his control by relying on the gazes of pedestrians.
He wanted to train this sensitive response to be normal, only retaining the stress response to malicious intent, otherwise, his nervous system would soon be exhausted.
Because constantly sensing the emotions carried by those gazes would consume his mental willpower, he must control it.
For example, hypnotize oneself subconsciously, set a predetermined program, only targeting malice and killing intent would elicit a reaction
Hmm?
At this moment, Jack Clark suddenly looked up to his left, his gaze passing through the buildings glass, landing on a young man in a suit and leather shoes on the fifth floor.
Although this guy looked normal, Jack felt a strong malice from his eyes.
1 didnt expect to gain something unexpected just by coming here to practice Cultivation Methods. Jack said, the corners of his mouth slightly raised, he entered the lobby, took the elevator to the fifth floor.
This was a foreign trade shopping company named Allist, Jack directly pushed the glass door open and walked in, his gaze swept over the several workers inside.
Seeing Jack in his battle armor, the female receptionist hurriedly stood up, saying nervously, You, hello, can I help you with something?
From under his face mask, Jacks gaze swept over her, saying indifferently, I suspect that there are dangerous individuals hiding in your company, I need to check.
All! How, how could that be? Comrade, are you mistaken, we are a legitimate foreign trade company with qualified operating licenses
The female receptionist was terrified and panicked, constantly explaining.
But Jack wouldnt pay any attention to her, and went straight to the office with the managers sign.
At this moment, the office door was opened.
The elite young man in a suit and leather shoes walked out, smiling and said, Sir, 1 am the manager here. If you have any issues, you can talk to me.
As the young man came out, Jack paused for a moment.
Surprisingly, he couldnt smell any blood on the young man, nor did he have that disgusting feeling that came instinctively from Evil God Sect Cultists.
If it wasnt for his Hearts Eye intuition after breaking through telling him that this person had a problem, he definitely wouldnt think this person had a problem.
Jack couldnt help but exclaim, Such a strong hiding ability, in my normal perception, you are almost as ordinary as a regular person.
Immediately, the young mans expression changed slightly, his expression stiffened, and he forced a smile, Im sorry, I dont understand what youre talking about?
No need to pretend, do you want to come with me to the Federation Military Base, or should 1 cut off your limbs and take you away? With that, a heavy oppressive aura spread from Jack.
Very impressive, I didnt expect you to find out even in this situation.
Seeing that Jack had recognized him, the young man no longer pretended, his eyes became cold and sharp, his gaze swept over Jack and the other employees, and he said with regret.
You shouldnt have come up here. You freshmans just started cultivating not long ago and then suddenly broke through to the Second Layer Heaven. You should have a brighter future as a genius.
And my employees who have been with me for a year, they are hardworking and conscientious, Im somewhat reluctant to let them die with me.
Unfortunately, you insisted on seeking death, so I will have to oblige.
By the way, 1 havent eaten a genius before, 1 wonder what the difference is between your flesh and blood and that of ordinary people.
As he spoke, the young mans eyes turned blood red, his entire body muscles continuously expanded, and red scales that resembled snake scales constantly grew out on his body.
Ripping!bender
Muscles tore the clothes apart, and, in the blink of an eye, a muscular monster more than 2 meters tall, with sharp double claws and covered in red scales appeared in front of everyone.
A fearful aura flowed like fresh blood on its body, emitting an instinctive fear that felt like a rabbit encountering a fierce tiger.
That sense of horror, as if facing a natural enemy, made the employees bodies stiff, their expressions fearful.
Most importantly, the aura of this red monster was from the Third Layer Heaven realm.
It was not like the cultist Jack encountered initially in the third realm who gave people a weak feeling, nor like the rebel who had been heavily injured by a missile.
This monster was strong, its aura alone was oppressive enough to make the surrounding air seem to solidify, full of horrifying oppression..

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 88: Unrivaled Sweep
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Unrivaled Sweep
Translator: 549690339
All!
Seeing the manager turned into a red monster in the blink of an eye, the female receptionist felt extremely terrified, and her whole body went limp as she collapsed to the ground.
Even Jack Clark was a bit astonished at this point.
He had thought that he caught an ordinary Blood Disciple but unexpectedly, he grabbed a big fish who could also transform.
At this moment, an employee tried to run outside in fear.
Trying to leave? Everyone, stay put!
The red monster looked fierce as its body suddenly moved with incredible speed, bursting the air and appeared behind that employee in an instant.
Rip!
The claw covered with red scales tore through the air, making a sound like ripping fabric. The employee looked back in despair as the claw aimed at her chest, ready to disembowel her in the next moment.
Bang!
Jacks black long knife slashed upwards on the red monsters arm. The sharp blade and blood-colored True Strength collided, instantly exploding a circle of black and red halo.
The overbearing force even pushed the red monster back several steps.
What a strong defense! Jack stood in front of the employee, looking at red monster with only a blood mark on its arm and feeling surprised.
Unlike ordinary cultists whose True Strength could be easily broken, the True Strength on this monster was very condensed, almost one centimeter thick, and the defense of the red scales was also extraordinary.
Although he had not used Sword Qi in that strike, his current strength and subsonic slash could tear through even a tanks armor.
But in this situation, Jack only managed to tear through its protective True Strength and barely scratched the surface of the monsters scales.
The red monster looked coldly at Jack, its voice hoarse and heavy, Youre not a Second Layer Cultivator.
Originally, the monster thought Jack was a freshman and didnt take him seriously. It planned to kill the female receptionist and several employees first to prevent them from exposing more information if they escaped.
But unexpectedly, this freshman was quite strong, capable of tearing through its protective True Strength and repelling it with a single strike.
Jack, standing with his sword, said calmly, When did 1 ever say I was in the Second Layer Heaven? As he spoke, a faint layer of black True Strength appeared on his body.
However, compared to the red monsters True Strength that was one centimeter thick, Jacks True Strength on his body was only a thin layer, and that was only after his True Strength doubled due to his breakthrough in sword skills.
He couldnt help it, as he had only broken through the Third Layer Heaven three days ago.
How is it possible? Werent the freshmen in your batch only cultivating for more than two months?! The red monster showed horror and disbelief in its
eyes.
Jack didnt mind and replied, I indeed only cultivated for more than two months, but is the Third Layer Heaven that difficult?
Of course, he didnt say these words to boast but to provoke the monster. Jack was well aware that his rapid breakthrough was due to the attribute points he had acquired.
Damn, damn, all you geniuses must die! Jacks indifferent tone made the red monster extremely furious and envious.
It had taken a year, even transforming into this inhuman monster and killing hundreds to finally break through to the Third Layer Heaven at such a cost, but these geniuses
All! Im going to kill you, kill you!
The monsters Blood Qi surged as it pounced towards Jack like a demon emerging from a blood pool, exuding a terrifying murderous and bloody aura.
Boom! A fierce and violent aura erupted from Jack, his entire body suddenly expanding like a waking giant elephant, fearlessly charging towards the monster.
In his hand, the long knife was like lightning, with Sword Qi enveloping it and creating a raging wind.
Boom!
The sharp combat knife slashed at the monsters thick arms, and an intense shockwave instantly erupted from the collision between the Sword Qi and blood-colored True Strength, exploding a halo of light.
The substantial black Sword Qi was incredibly sharp, almost tearing through the thick layer of blood light before it dispersed.
Clang! The monsters scales seemed to be made of alloy, sparking and shattering under the blade, revealing the tough and blood-red muscle underneath.
Just as the knife tore through the monsters arms, Jack swung it horizontally with both hands, using the overbearing and violent force to smash the monster into the wall with its hands still held by him.
Immediately, the brick wall collapsed with a bang, bricks scattering everywhere, and smoke and dust filled the air.
In the corridor, the monster quickly got up as soon as it landed, its arms slashed with wounds more than ten centimeters long and several centimeters deep, blood flowing from them.bender
But the wound healed at a visible speed.
Such a terrifying recovery ability! Jack squinted his eyes as he pursued the monster.
Roar!
The injured red monster became even more ferocious, its blood light increasing, making its body even larger. The terrifying aura almost filled the entire corridor, accompanied by a raging wind as it pounced at Jack once more.
Jacks knife was wrapped in Sword Qi, his gaze cold and unyielding. He charged forward without fear, shattering the tiles under his heavy alloy battle boots.
Bang! Plop!
The monsters left claw gripped tightly, the blood-colored True Strength circulating on its palm, enduring the tearing of the blade, and looked at Jack with a ferocious smile on its face.
Hahaha Ive got you.
In the midst of its wild laughter, the monsters right arm swelled, its muscles becoming more prominent, the sharp claws slamming down, ready to tear Jack to pieces even if it meant harming itself in the process.
Due to its cultivation instinct, the monster believed that as long as it restricted Jacks combat knife, it would be as if cutting off one of his arms.But just then, Jack Clarks left hand let go of the knife handle and formed a fist with his palm, covered in battle armor.
Bang!
The black and blood-red True Strength covered fists collided, and the air was almost squeezed into a substantial transparent shockwave. Under the violent counterforce, both of them couldnt help but retreat.
In the struggle, the red monsters left hand felt pain, and couldnt help but let go of the combat knife.
This blow was evenly matched.
The result made the monsters face look very ugly and unbelievable.
The person who originally gave it the Blood Seed said that their monster form had unparalleled strength and strong defense, and humans of the same level couldnt compete with them.
But now
Bang!
Just as it was in a daze, Jack Clarks aura surged as he stepped forward. The ground shook, and he transformed into a black shadow, appearing in front of the monster.
Bang! The black Sword Qi slashed horizontally, blasting through the air and chopping down with unmatched power.
I dont believe youre tougher than me!
The monsters eyes revealed a crazed look. It directly ignored the long knife slashing at its chest, its thick arms coming together and fiercely slamming towards Jack Clarks head like a destructive heavy hammer.
Splatter! Boom!
