The incomparably sharp Sword Qi tore through the blood-light, and the sharp blade struck its chest, leaving a half-meter-long and ten-centimeter-deep, terrifying wound. Blood gushed out as its guts squirmed.
As Jack Clark struck and injured the red monster, its thick arms slammed into the air, landing on his left shoulder the moment he tilted his head slightly.
Boom!
Under the burst of strength, Jack Clarks body slightly sank, like an unshakeable mountain. The ground beneath him cracked, splitting open with multiple fissures.
At that moment, Jack Clark appeared to be more like a monster than the monster itself. The terrifying armor defense and strong body allowed him to directly withstand the full-force attack.
Jack Clark turned his head slightly, his cold gaze fixed on the ferocious-looking red monster, speaking calmly, So this is your strength? It seems a bit weak.
At this moment, the red monster was completely mad.
In its madness, it tried to sweep its claws around to grab Jack Clarks head, but he quickly dodged by ducking down. Immediately after, he charged forward with wild momentum, crashing into the monster.
Boom! The walls collapsed, and amidst the smoke and dust, both of them charged into the advertising company opposite. The panic-stricken ordinary people inside screamed in terror.
Boom, boom, boom!
The two massive beasts tangled and charged headlong, destroying everything in their path, whether it be office desks or walls. The entire floor was shaking as the terrifying impact spread.
Suddenly, the exterior wall of the building exploded, creating a massive hole.
Amidst the scattering cement debris, Jack Clark held his knife with both hands, stabbing it into the blood-covered red monsters chest. He stood on top of it as they fell together from the fifth floor.
The two fell from the sky, slamming heavily into a sedan parked on the side of the road. The terrifying impact completely crushed the car, with the rolling airwaves being extremely shocking.
The sudden turn of events frightened the surrounding pedestrians, who screamed and backed away.
On the wreckage of the car, Jack Clark looked down, confirming that the monster had lost its life and was indeed killed by him before slowly removing his bloodied long knife.
At this moment, he was wearing black-red armor, with the blood-red liquid flowing over it. Standing on top of the monster with his knife, he was enveloped in a terrifying aura.
This scene terrified many onlookers from afar.
At the same time, some daring pedestrians were excitedly using their mobile phones to capture the scene.
Jack Clark ignored those pedestrians, reached into his pocket, and made a phone call.
Within ten minutes, two military trucks had arrived. Some soldiers jumped off and saluted Jack Clark before carrying the monsters corpse away.
Jack Clark also left with the truck.
As for the damaged building, the wrecked car, and some ordinary people injured in the battle, it wasnt up to him to deal with.
It seems that my monster talent will be exposed. On the truck, Jack Clark was a little vexed as he looked at the gruesome dismembered corpse of the monster.
Originally, he wanted to test his limits and see if he could encounter a blood disciple, but he unexpectedly caught a big fish a monster with the realm of Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase and late phase combat power.
Though earning ten contribution points all at once was excellent, it also exposed his breaking through to the Third Realm.
After all, his classmates with average strength might be fooled, but Teacher Lyons, who presides over them, was not stupid and very observant.
However, Jack Clark was only slightly annoyed and not worried, because High Martials principle is to cultivate geniuses, and the school isnt afraid of monsters; rather, they fear wasting resources on ordinary people.
In school, where all resources need to be earned through contributions, theres no need to worry about jealousy and scheming. Otherwise, Jane Aiken and Howard Lee would have to hide.
However, he will attract more attention now, unable to remain low-key. He has to be more cautious about certain things that need attention.
Jack Clark was mentally prepared for this situation. After all, with his circumstances, his strength would only increase at a slow pace in the beginning. Once he accumulates enough power during the early stage, his growth will be explosive.
Third Layer Heaven is only the beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 89: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body
Translator: 549690339
1 dont know if Jack Clarks luck is good or bad today.
As soon as he returned to the base, he encountered Sylvia Lyons, who also came back from outside.
Inside the base, Sylvia Lyons looked at the monsters corpse being carried down from the car with some surprise: Theres actually a defective product.
Defective product? Jack Clark, who jumped out of the car, showed a puzzled expression in his eyes.
The Blood God Sects Blood Seeds are divided into three levels: low, high, and top.
Sylvia Lyons explained: Those who absorb the low-level Blood Seed are called blood disciples, just like the ones you killed in the past few days, and they are very weak.
Even if they grow unrestrictedly, they can only reach the Second or Third
Layer Heaven, and their combat power is average among their peers.
But the blood envoys who absorb the high-level Blood Seed are different; their growth limit is generally between the Fifth and Sixth Layer Heaven, and they have a non-human combat form.
This combat form comes from the Nine-headed Demon Serpent Beasts Essence Blood contained in the Blood Seed. It is not inferior to ordinary cultivators in terms of combat power at the same level, and even stronger.
The leaders of the Evil God Sect who were suppressed by the Federation were those who absorbed the high-level Blood Seed and Blood God Envoys, besides some high-ranking Blood God Messengers.
However, people have different physiques, and the fusion of Blood Seeds is the same. This is a defective product that has fused high-level Blood Seeds but cannot even break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
I originally thought that under the sweep of that adults will, all the high-level and above blood envoys in Koroya would be dead. I didnt expect that there would be one left here.
He should be the person in charge of the followers who spread the Blood Seeds. As for why he was missed, its simple: hes too weak. Sylvia Lyons concluded.
Uh Jack was surprised by this result.
Unexpectedly, he accidentally killed the person in charge of the remaining Evil God Sect followers in Lester City.
Jack regretted, Its a pity that these guys are like programmed: as long as I try to force them to reveal information about other people, they go crazy.
Earlier, after suppressing the foreign trade manager, Jack wanted to cut off his limbs and capture him alive.
However, as soon as he asked a question about the Evil God Sect, the other party went crazy in an instant, burned their Essence Blood, and their strength skyrocketed. In this situation, Jack could only kill them with all his strength.
Because there is a very weak thread of a strong mans thoughts contained in the Blood Seeds they merged with. That thread of thoughts lurks and is dormant most of the time.
However, when someone threatens to force them to reveal information about other followers, that thread of thought will be activated, affecting their will to burn their Essence Blood and fight to the death.
In this situation, only high-ranked powerhouses above the Seventh Layer Heaven can disperse that thread of thought and force them to reveal information.
Thats why we told you to kill them on the spot once you find them. After finishing, Sylvia Lyons looked at Jack with a smile and suddenly asked:
When did you break through to the Third Layer Heaven?
Jack knew that he couldnt avoid it, so he coughed and said, 1 broke through this morning and then went out to find a blood disciple to test my sword skills. 1 didnt expect to bump into this guy.
True Martial Cultivators cant see the specific realm of others unless they actively burst their True Power Fluctuations, they can only vaguely sense the strength of others, plain and simple
For example, when a high-level expert faces an ordinary cultivator, the ordinary cultivator feels inexplicable invisible pressure, which indicates that the person is powerful as long as they are not stupid.
There is little reaction on high-order experts, in turn.
Moreover, Jack didnt lie to her. He indeed broke through to the third layer of the Sword Skill this morning.
Sylvia Lyons paused for a moment, and then said in a relaxed tone: You have good talent; by the way, 1 remember you were practicing the Dragon Elephant Power, right?
Yes, teacher. Jack nodded.
Sylvia Lyons smiled and said: Our school has a Dragon Elephant Overbearing Body True Scripture. Its an advanced skill created by the powerhouse who broke through the Seventh Layer Heaven after creating the Dragon Elephant Power.
Keep it up, young man. You deserve that skill. Upgrading to the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body from the Dragon Elephant Power not only makes it stronger but also saves time for transferring cultivation.
Also, talent should be demonstrated.
Under the leadership of those adults, the Federation has no such thing as suppressing geniuses. On the contrary, the stronger the talent, the more attention they receive, and the more permissions and resources they get.
After saying that, Sylvia Lyons left with her hands behind her back, leaving Jack deep in thought.
Dragon Elephant Overbearing Body True Scripture. Jack sighed and shook his head slightly.
To exchange for an Advanced Skill, you need 300 contribution points. It doesnt sound like much, but when you convert it, its only 300,000 yuan, which is less than what Howard Lee gave him the other day.
However, the problem is that contribution points are difficult to earn and save.
Three hundred contributions, it might not be enough to kill all the blood disciples in Lester City, unless they figure out a way to make extra money.Actually, under normal circumstances, exchanging for Advanced Skill is something considered by sophomores.
By that time, those with good talents who practiced advanced cultivation methods would have broken through to the Third Layer Heaven, or approached the Second Layer Heaven Peak, and could participate in the Mutated Beast Trials.
As long as they killed more than a dozen Level 3 Mutant Beasts or forty to fifty Level 2 Mutant Beasts, they could exchange for an advanced Skill, complete with six levels.
But who would have thought that Jack Clark would break through to Third Heaven so quickly, before the end of the first semester of Senior One?
However, after reaching the Third Layer Heaven and wanting to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, even a genius would need to cultivate for a long time, almost over a year. So, Jack Clark was not in a rush.
Lets go out and have a try. Every bit of accumulation helps, and even without Advanced Skill, it doesnt mean we cant break through.
With this thought, Jack Clark summoned the attribute page with a thought, looking at the Dragon Elephant Power and Sword Skill that had broken through to the Third Layer, and the + sign that still existed behind it.
When his attention fell on the Dragon Elephant Power, a row of transparent text appeared before his eyes.
Limit Enhancement of Dragon Elephant Power requires 50 attribute points, current attribute points are insufficient, unable to enhance.
What is Limit Enhancement? Can Dragon Elephant Power break through to the
Fourth Layer with attribute enhancement, or will there be a qualitative change? Jack Clark pondered.
At dinner, when Justin Welan and others heard that Jack Clark had killed another Second-level Blood Servant again, earning ten contribution points, they were all very envious.
There was nothing they could do, as they had been out and about all day, and only one guy with good luck had encountered a Second Layer Heaven Blood Servant.
Because Jack Clark had a previous history of killing Third Layer Heaven believers head-on, Justin Welan and the others didnt think much, assuming that the Third Layer Heaven strength today was also average.
In the following three days, Jack Clark worked hard at his job.
But apart from catching a First Layer Heaven shrimp who couldnt help but kill and found his whereabouts, he had no harvest.
As they continued their hunts, the hidden Blood Servants in Lester City became more cautious.
Compared to Lester City, where a single battle wiped out the Rebel Army and the remnants of the Evil God Sect, other places, including the cities where Crystal Leinster and others were located, were very lively.
Today, there was unrest here, and ambushes and counterattacks were happening there.
If it wasnt a case of the rebels attacking some small town, it would be about how many people were killed by the Evil God Sect Cultists.
Gurgling! Bubbles rolled, and below the river surface, the now 2.8-meter-long black Unique Beast swam slowly, searching for a target to hunt.
Seeing that Blood Servants are hard to find, Jack Clark simply focused on the Heavy Armored Beast.
As time went on, the Heavy Armored Beasts size grew even larger, and the accumulated Evolution value gradually approached the threshold of the third Evolution.
Jack Clark had a feeling that once the Heavy Armored Beast evolved for the third time, even if there was no breakthrough in True Martial Cultivation, its combat power would reach the Fourth Layer Heaven.
During this time, due to the Heavy Armored Beast hunting every day, the wide estuary of Mutated Fish became sparse.bender
There was no other way, as they were almost all eaten.
After swimming for nearly twenty minutes, a 5-meter-long Mutated Fish with a 2-meter-long dorsal fin like a banner appeared.
Boom! The heavy Armored Beast gave a powerful flick of its tail, and the river water behind it exploded in an instant, fiercely pouncing on the Mutated Fish.
Because of the size difference between the two, the Mutated Bannerfish, which had just hunted a big fish, did not react and looked at the Heavy Armored Beast with a somewhat astonished look in its cold eyes.
Boom! The Heavy Armored Beast swung its claws out, and the sharp, heavy claws shattered the river water, carrying a terrifying force onto the Mutated Bannerfishs head.
Bang! Half of the Mutated Bannerfishs head collapsed and exploded, and thick, fresh blood poured out from the collapsed head, staining the surrounding river water red.
Now, although the Heavy Armored Beast was only 2.8 meters long, its weight had exceeded 5 tons due to its density, and its power had become even more terrifying with a hundredfold burst of talent.
A casual claw could unleash a terrifying force of over a hundred tons, exceeding the bodys weight.
In the red blood-stained water, the Heavy Armored Beast opened its mouth wide, biting into the Mutated Fish and tearing off a chunk of flesh weighing tens of kilograms and devouring it.
Delicious. After all, this was a freshly killed fish.
What could be fresher than killing and eating on the spot?
However, this Mutated Fish, if placed on the market, could at least sell for several thousand or tens of thousands. The Heavy Armored Beast needed to eat at least a few of them a day, wouldnt that mean eating tens of thousands a day?
Thinking about this, Jack Clark couldnt help but be glad that he chose to release it, otherwise, even the landlord wouldnt be able to afford it..

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 90: Winter Vacation Mercenaries
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Winter Vacation Mercenaries
Translator: 549690339
November 18th.
After having breakfast in the third-floor restaurant, Jack put on his battle armor, strapped on his long knife, and then took the elevator to the first floor with Justin Welan.
He then discovered that the layout of the first floor had changed a lot today.
A few more staff members had been added to the original reception area, with a sign on the counter that read Mission Location.
At the same time, a huge LCD screen was hung on the wall behind them, displaying a high-definition map of Lester City and the surrounding villages and towns.bender
Zac Lyons, White Veil Marcus Lee and the others were standing in front of the counter talking about something.
Jack walked over curiously, Mission location? What is that?
Jack, youre here.
We just asked, and it seems that the Federation has integrated data from all parties to preliminarily establish an intelligence department covering the entire Koroya, divided by city.
Starting today, we dont need to run around looking for the whereabouts of blood disciples ourselves, we just need to wait for missions in the hotel.
When the local department obtains information about blood disciples or rebels, they will release missions to us, which makes the process faster and more accurate.
As for the Contribution Points, they will be calculated based on the completion of the mission, including some non-slaying blood disciple missions, which will also be rewarded.
It does make things a lot more convenient. Jack nodded.
The situation in Lester City had struck him as a mess.
The official institutions were paralyzed, the law enforcement departments were being re-established, and the rebel cultists were infiltrating and fighting with the military from time to time.
But after more than ten days, the situation had finally stabilized.
However, looking at this mission release platform, Jack felt an inexplicable sense of incongruity. He felt like he was going abroad as a mercenary during the winter break.
At this time, White Veil called, Beauty, beauty, has the mission not been refreshed yet?
The female staff member behind the counter smiled politely and said, Im sorry, we are currently liaising with various departments, and there are no missions being refreshed in the background for the time being.
At this time, Sylvia Lyons came out of the elevator and waved her hand to disperse the crowd. Alright, dont surround here. Data sorting takes some time.
As everyone dispersed, Sylvia Lyons called out to Jack, Jack, hold on.
Whats the matter, maam? Jack paused.
Sylvia Lyons smiled, I just happen to have a mission for you.
In more than two hours, a group of freshmen will arrive in Lester City by plane. They come from two second-tier universities, totaling about thirty people.
Originally, Colonel Cameron Raven was supposed to greet them, but he and I have something urgent to attend to, so we plan to hand it over to you.
Take a few others with you later to greet them, and be their guides. Introduce them to the situation here and things they need to be aware of.
The reward will be five contribution points.
After finishing, Sylvia Lyons quickly left the lobby, as if she really had something urgent to deal with.
Jack, pick me.
Jack, arent we good brothers?
Jack, I want to go too
As soon as Sylvia Lyons left, Jack was surrounded by a group of classmates who were all eager to go with him to welcome the new students.
Without saying anything, there was one Contribution Point to be gained just by going around, like picking up freebies, and they could also show off in front of the new students. These guys were all excited.
Ahem!
Jack coughed dryly, Brothers, there are only 5 points of contribution for this mission. Its not enough to share.
Its okay, we dont want Contribution Points.
I dont want any either.
We mainly want to show off, ahem, explain our experiences of tracking and killing those blood disciples to the new students who have just arrived.
I want to show off my wings to the new beauties.
Whats so good about wings? Are they as handsome as my Golden Armor?
Seeing everyones enthusiasm, Jack naturally could not refuse. He could only accept all the rewards with a tearful smile and set off with ten enthusiastic classmates.
Among them were Justin Welan and Zac Lyons, as well as White Veil Marcus Lee and Mullen Weisz.
Of course, not all classmates were interested in welcoming new people. Some went back to practice, while others waited in the rest area.
Since they were all wearing battle armor, the use of cars and buses would be inconvenient, so Jack asked the base for three military transport trucks and drivers, and headed directly to the airport.
More than ten days had passed, and the destroyed road had been initially leveled and could be driven on directly.
However, when Jack passed through the small town, he looked around and found that everything was normal, with no discoveries.
It was still the same military airport, but the overall structure had been repaired, and the place looked less dilapidated. The stationed soldiers were still the same small team.
Standing by the runway, everyone leaned against the truck, bored. Zac Lyons said enviously, I heard that after Howard Lee absorbed the Demonic Beast Blood Essence, his strength skyrocketed like crazy.
Mullen Weisz nodded, Indeed, the day before yesterday, I was tracking a Second Layer Blood Disciple with him and the disciple tried to escape in an off-road vehicle.
Goodness, Howard directly smashed the person and the car with a single pillar, an absolute monster.
Wow, thats amazing. Marcus Lee exclaimed.
Mullen Weisz: I suspect he has already broken through the Third Layer Heaven.
Really? So soon? Zac Lyons wondered.
Its possible.
Justin Welan analyzed, He absorbed the blood essence of seven power-type Mutated Beasts, his own Cultivation Methods are a perfect fit, and he also exchanged resources with Contribution Points.
For the second-ranked genius in the school, its no surprise to break through to the Third Layer Heaven at this time, especially considering that Jane Aiken had broken through a few days ago.
Marcus Lee genuinely envied, These guys are freaks, one after another. Its only been a little more than a month since breaking through the Second Layer Heaven.
However, its true that coming to Koroya this time was a good choice. I originally estimated that if I had stayed in school to practice, it would take at least half a year to break through to the Third Layer Heaven.
But now, as long as the resources for cultivation can keep up, I feel that 1 have the chance to break through to the Third Layer within two months.
Zac Lyons nodded, Im about the same.
Especially after slaughtering those blood disciples or suppressing the rebels and returning, the efficiency of practicing and absorbing the energy of crystals is several times higher than usual.
I feel like my entire body and True Strength in my Dan-Tian is active, madly absorbing energy to become stronger.
Justin Welan nodded, Thats the purpose of the trial to bring us close to death, witness death, and stimulate our inherent genetic desire to pass on.
During the subsequent waiting, everyone shared their combat gains from this period, as well as stories about the cunning and treacherous blood disciples they had met.
Humm!!!
At this time, a hum came from the sky. In the distance, a huge transport plane slowly descended from the horizon, landing sharply at a low altitude, and sliding fiercely.
The large fuselage slid on the runway, rolling up a raging wind, and finally stopped slowly near everyone under the command of the Control Tower.
When the plane came to a stop, the prepared gangway was pushed close to it, and the hatch opened.
Two middle-aged individuals came out first, followed by a number of young people, their youthful faces filled with excitement, curiosity, and anticipation.
They looked exactly like Jack and his classmates when they first arrived in Koroya..

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 91: Blow, Blow Hard!
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Blow, Blow Hard!
Translator: 549690339
Similar to when Jack and his friends arrived, the new students lined up to collect their weapons and luggage with battle armor after getting off the plane.
At this time, Jack and the others also went over.
Jack politely said, Hello, teachers, my name is Jack, and these are my classmates. We are all from South Sky Martial Height.
Because Teacher Lyons and Commander Raven from the garrison had urgent matters and couldnt come, I am responsible for picking you up and taking you back to the Base Hotel.
At this moment, Jack wasnt wearing his helmet; his handsome face and polite manner immediately made the two teachers feel good about him.
One of the male teachers with a cultured and refined temperament smiled and said, Hello, Student Clark and everyone else, I am Emmitt Wesley, a teacher from Kenny Harper.
The other teacher, who had a strong build and looked like a sports coach, also courteously said, I am Jerrold West, the team leader and teacher from Los Angeles Martial Height. Thank you for your help this time.
As Jack greeted the teachers, the new students who had just arrived looked at them curiously.
Or rather, these new students were mainly looking at the exaggerated battle armor of Justin Welan and the others, each of them shining golden and having gorgeous wings, full of chunibyo vibes.
Facing those gazes, Justin Welan and the others didnt feel ashamed. Instead, they held their helmets in their left hands and puffed out their chests proudly.
Pfft!
One of the new students, a handsome youth, couldnt help but sneer, These guys are too funny, modifying their battle armor like this.
Dont they know that the original design of this battle armor took into account factors such as load, defense, speed, and flexibility before determining its form?
Now theyve added so many metal wings and thickened armor, the burden of excessive weight will greatly affect their flexibility and speed, causing more harm than good.
As soon as the youth finished speaking, Justin Welan became unhappy, Brother over there, youre being superficial. Without thickened armor on the battlefield, even sniper bullets cant be blocked. One shot and youre down.
At that time, flexibility and speed are useless. Staying alive is the most important thing.
Meanwhile, Marcus Lee echoed, Exactly, those newcomers dont know anything. Theyve never seen a charge through the hail of bullets and the barrage of thousands of rebels.
Yeah, I remember when I carried a heavy machine gun and swept through it, charged up and collapsed the bunker with a single sword strike, killing both men and bunker, Mullen Weisz boasted without politeness.
The mocked White Veil pointed to the armor on his chest, which had an indentation, and sneered, Look at this, when 1 was attacked by a blood disciple, I was directly hit in the chest by a sniper bullet.
According to the normal armor defense, they wouldve punched a hole the size of a fist. Now you tell me, does flexibility and defense matter?
Thiss just a bullet; on the battlefield, various shells and fragments are flying everywhere. Look at my back armor; at that time, it was hit by fragments of a heavy artillery shell.
If it were your current lightweight armor, it wouldnt be just muscle swelling; my spine wouldve been penetrated and brokenbender
When faced with those students who had arrived earlier, talking about either resisting heavy machine gun fire or charging through the hail of bullets and barrage of thousands of rebels, the new students were immediately silenced.
However, not everyone was so gullible. One male student pointed to Jack, Thats not right. If thickening armor is so useful, why didnt that person modify his battle armor?
Youre talking about Jack. Can he be compared with ordinary people? Justin Welans gaze was strange.
Zac Lyons nodded, Thats right, Jack is different from us. Hes our South Sky Martial Heights genius. Several Third Layer Heaven immortals have already died at his hands.
Apart from that, he once entered a rebel camp alone, and after killing many rebel cultivators, he killed a Level 3 Mutated Black Bull with a single slash.
Hiss!
Hearing Jack killing a Level 3 Mutant Beast with a single slash, the new students who knew what that meant instantly gasped, looking in shock at the handsome youth.
Some of the female students had eyes that sparkled, making Jack a bit embarrassed.
Damn, those guys exaggerated too much.
Especially the one who talked about the back armor being hit by an artillery shell fragment. That was obviously a small dent that was caused by practicing with Marcus Lee yesterday.
However, only Jack and his friends knew the truth.
At this moment, the new students, as well as teachers Emmitt Wesley and Jerrold West, couldnt really tell what was true and what was false.
Before they arrived, they knew that Lester City was one of Koroya City, and there had indeed been a battle fought previously that eliminated over two thousand rebel remnants.But the problem was, killing a Level 3 Mutant Beast, and one known for its defense and strength among the Bovine Mutant Beasts, even if this student named Jack Clark had incredible strength, it shouldnt be possible, right?
Unless his cultivation level was already at the Third Layer Heaven, and he was practicing a top-tier Advanced Skill making him this powerful, but how could that be possible?
Its only been two and a half months since Senior One started, excluding the time for Foundation Establishment, to break through the Third Layer in two months, this kind of monster Thinking of this, the two teachers couldnt help but exchange glances.
No wonder he was chosen as the representative for the welcoming committee.
For a moment, both teachers regarded Jack Clark as South Sky Martial Heights Monster Genius.
They mistakenly guessed that he had already broken through to the Third Layer Heaven.
Cough!
Jack Clark coughed lightly, worried that the more they talked the more exaggerated they would become, and suggested, Teachers, its getting late, why dont we get in the car first?
Emmitt Wesley nodded, his tone gentle, Yes, it just so happens that on the way you can give us an overview of the situation here.
Thats part of our responsibility, no problem.
Then Jack Clark reminded them, By the way, teachers, before getting on the car, I suggest the new students go to those two rooms over there to change into their battle armors.
Change into battle armors now? Is Lester that dangerous? Jerrold West was startled.
Last time, Lori Parma and the others were contacted by Laird Hawk and the military before they arrived to set up a trap, so Jack Clark and the others were told to put on their battle armors as soon as they got off the plane.
This time, before Jerrold West and the others arrived, they received information that the situation in Lester City was stable, with only a few ordinary blood disciples and scattered rebels left uncleaned.
Jack Clark smiled slightly, On the day we arrived, we were attacked by rebels. One of our classmates was hit by a cannonball and was blown away. If it werent for the battle armor, he wouldve died on the spot.
Although the situation is relatively stable now, and the rebels and blood disciples are no longer daring to show their faces, its better to be safe than sorry, in case some of those who dont fear death are still lurking.
After all, those guys are all crazy, and their actions cant be judged by common sense.
Emmitt Wesley nodded, Student Clark makes sense, everyone heard that, right? Boys and girls, split up and go to separate rooms to change into your battle armors.
With the teachers giving orders, and Jack Clark telling them how dangerous the outside world was, the students hurriedly went to change into their battle armors.
Those who came here for training were no fools; they were all geniuses from the two schools.
However, compared to South Sky Martial Height, which could send out more than fifty students at a time and still have many who gave up the opportunity, the number of geniuses from these two Second-tier universities was significantly less.
Even though the students put on their battle armors, none of them put on their helmets.
Jack Clark didnt say anything about it because they didnt wear them either, after all, they were still within the airports controlled area.
Soon enough, everyone got on three military transport trucks, with Jack Clark, Justin Welan, the two teachers, and ten new students in the first one.
The rest were divided into two groups and sat with the new students in the last two trucks, acting as guides and enthusiastically explaining (boasting about) their glorious records to the newcomers.
Justin Welan was no exception.
Sitting between two female students, he looked serious as he talked about the first time he accompanied an armored patrol unit and encountered a rebel rocket attack. At that time, he bravely intercepted the rocket with his heavy shield, preventing any harm to the innocent
As for Justin Welans boasting, Jack Clark didnt pay any attention; it just so happened he could relax and stay vigilant, looking around the surroundings.
Even though the blood disciples and rebels had been almost wiped out and could no longer stir up any waves, it was always better to be cautious. He remained vigilant every time he left the Safe Zone.
Suddenly, the small, dilapidated town appeared before them again in the blink of an eye.
Hmm?
Jack Clark furrowed his brows as he looked at the small town approaching in the distance. He sensed a faint sense of danger, and his eyes immediately sharpened.
Although he had deliberately observed and sensed the area when he passed by in the morning, he found nothing at the time, and now its been only two hours since
Suddenly, Jack Clark yelled, Stop!

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 92: Explosion
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Explosion
Translator: 549690339
As veterans of the battlefield, the drivers halted the trucks immediately upon hearing Jack Clarks stern warning. The two vehicles behind also quickly stopped.
Squeak, Squeak!!
Under the abrupt break, many students jolted forward due to inertia, thankfully no one fell out, after all, they were all cultivators of the Second Layer Heaven.
Whats happening?
Whats going on?
Swish, Swish, Swish!!
As the freshmen began to ask anxiously, Zac Lyons, Marcus Lee, and others didnt hesitate to put on their helmets, grasped their weapons, and jumped down from the truck.
Jack Clark and Justin Welan also put on their helmets and leapt down.
Emmitt Wesley and Jerrold West, their figures flashing, appeared ghost-like on top of the truck. Their sharp eyes immediately scanned the small town ahead, as it was the most likely place for an ambush.
However, after a quick scan, the two men found nothing and exchanged puzzled glances with Jack Clark, Student Clark, did you spot something?
Jack Clark looked at the small town a hundred meters away, and slowly said: There are people ambushed inside, but the number isnt very large.
He had just felt a few malicious gazes.
But what made him yell stop was not those eyes, but a strong sense of danger. It seemed that if they proceeded even a little further, they would die.
Thinking about this, Jack Clark looked ahead. The four-lane road that had once been bombed by an air raid had been filled up with hard soil. Although it wasnt concrete, it was passable.
But now, Jack Clark observed carefully and found that some hard soil had been turned over.
Although the diggers had filled it back up, camouflaged it, and made it old and dry, the wheel tracks were slightly different from those of the previous trucks.
Justin Welan, bearing a heavy shield, perked up, Jack, are they blood disciples?
At this time, Marcus Lee and others also came over.
Jack Clark nodded slightly: It might be the rebels. Theyre over there leaving it to you.
Speaking, Jack Clark pointed towards the edge of the town, where a house had turned into a pile of bricks after being bombed.
But be careful and dont take the road ahead.
Marcus Lees eyes lit up: Brothers, there are Contribution Points coming through the door. Whoever catches them first is the one
Charge!
Before Marcus Lee finished speaking, Justin Welans aura burst forth. A subtle earthy glow covered half the heavy shield and with a rumble, he sprinted off.
Damn, wait for us.
The others were startled. A wild aura of the mid and late stages of Second Layer Heaven exploded from everyone and they quickly chased after him, as if delaying would mean missing a meal.
This scene left the freshmen behind, stunned.
Thanks to Jack Clarks warning, Justin Welan and the others didnt take the road. In the blink of an eye, they crossed dozens of meters, and charged towards the pile of bricks with wild aura.
Damn! Theyve spotted us, retreat.
Boom!
The brick heap exploded dramatically and amidst the flying debris, seven hidden figures rushed out, decisively sprinting towards the small town, trying to use the layout to escape.
These peoples auras spread between the First and Second Layer Heavens, and their movements were swift and decisive. They were obviously not those mad blood disciples.
Just then, one of the fleeing figures suddenly turned around. The man holding a single person launcher let out a howling rocket.
Damn. The White Veil leading the pack was taken aback and quickly dodged out of the way.
Boom! The piercing flames devoured a space of two yards. The shockwave from the explosion mixed with shrapnel flew everywhere, causing Marcus Lee and others to falter.
After all, they were still in the Second Layer Heaven and couldnt summon True Power Protection, but
Hahahayou still cant outrun me. Justin Welan, who was originally behind, carrying his heavy shield, ran straight through the shockwave and flames with a wild aura, laughing uproariously.
Just as this happened, a dozen black shadows flew precisely towards Justin Welan, scaring him into quickly plunging his heavy shield in front of him and hiding behind it.Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The explosion from more than ten grenades swallowed Justin Welan.
However, compared to the explosion of a rocket, the blast wave of a hand grenade was much smaller. Trailing behind, Mullen Weisz and the others let out cheerful laughter.
Justin Welan, you can choke on dust behind us with that cumbersome thing. Among the roaring laughter, nine figures swooshed through the flames, seemingly fearless of the explosive debris.
Especially a few agile folks, they quickly closed in and tossed a few dark shadows.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! An even more intense explosion erupted, which were clearly metal bombs they had exchanged anew their power several folds stronger than the ordinary grenades.
Blocked by the metal bombs, Marcus Lee and others who stormed into the small town quickly caught up with the rebels and engaged them in combat. Bang! Bang! Bang!! Gun noises and loud roarings from grenade explosions filled the small town, signifying an intense battle.
Excuse me, gentlemen, Jack Clark casually said, Should we clear the explosives buried in those irregular wheel tracks ahead?
No problem.
Both nod, and Jerrold West leapt high off the truck, soaring over ten meters into the air. His red True Strength danced around him like flames, emitting terrifying aura.
However, compared to Lori Parma and others, Jerrold Wests aura was weaker.
He soared into the air, aiming at four places identified by Jack and slapping them in the air. Four husky True Strengths instantly shot out and fell on the road twenty meters away.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!! An intense explosion erupted instantly, the flames shot over twenty meters into the sky, spreading over thirty meters.
The violent shockwave of the explosion vibrated the truck, raising rolling smoke and dust and splattering debris, making the students on the car turn pale instantly.
All were scared by the terrifying explosion. If Jack hadnt shouted to stop, and they had driven straight through.
Those lunatics they must have buried hundreds of kilograms of explosives.
Even Jack was somewhat horrified. If he hadnt practiced the Minds Eye Bright Knife and advanced it to the more sensitive Third Layer.
Jerrold West landed back on the ground amidst the shock wave, looking somewhat apprehensive, Student Clark, thank goodness for your sharp observations. Even if we could withstand most of the explosive impact, some of us would still get hurt.
Jack Clark modestly said, Oh, not at all. I just practiced a perception type of cultivation method, so I felt something was off as we approached the small town.
Actually, I didnt know there were so many explosives buried at the beginning.
Perception type cultivation methods, huh. Desire filled Jerrold Wests eyes.
Although their danger intuition honed in on a battlefield would react if they proceeded another ten meters or so, it wasnt as advanced as Jacks, who had sensed it way ahead of time.
Unfortunately, those methods related to perception were all about talent, and not everyone could master them and cultivate them to a grand accomplishment status.
Meanwhile, the fight in the small town quickly concluded. Marcus Lee emerged first, hammer in one hand, pulling a heavily injured rebel with the other.
Following him were the other classmates, their bodies emanating murderous auras.
Justin Welan came out last, cursing, You guys are so heartless. 1 blocked so many grenades and bullets for you and yet, you didnt even leave one for me. Zac Lyons, with a weapon on his back, shrugged, Cant help it. Its all about who is faster, who is slower, in such a situation. Its not our fault that youve chosen the heavy shield as your weapon.
Haha, 1 just killed a Second Layer rebel. Scored three Contribution Points.bender
Damn it, I chose a First Layer Heaven one, its boring. Died in two strikes. Why are you guys rushing these things, not even leaving a live prisoner?
Luckily, Marcus Lee was smart enough to just shatter the lower half of that guy.
Well question him later on how he learned we were coming to pick up the freshmans and ambush here. Maybe well dig up a big fish.
Bullshit, do we need to question that? Mullen Weisz scornfully asked.
Such a big airplane descending from the sky could be seen within tens of kilometers. And this path is a must-pass to return home. If 1 were them, Id ambush here too.
Moreover, these rebels have lurked here once before. Its easier to hide under the lamp, with actually a higher chance of success.
Its a good thing that Jack Clark has sharp senses.
Damn, what youre saying makes sense..

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 93: Ocean Giant
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Ocean Giant
Translator: 549690339
On the truck, under Emmitt Wesley’s interrogation, the heavily injured rebel confessed all his information.
As Mullen Weisz speculated, this elite rebel squad had been hiding in a nearby village after their main force was wiped out, not daring to show themselves.
When the plane flew over their heads earlier, someone guessed that it was a new batch of Federal Martial Height Genius coming to support them.
So they made a temporary plan to ambush them outside the town on a dirt-fill road, aiming to kill some geniuses in revenge against the Federation.
They hid under a pile of bricks that they had dug out earlier, making it hard to expose themselves and not coming out regardless of whether the explosion was successful or not, allowing them a flexible offense and defense.
Little did they know they would encounter Jack Clark, a freak who could detect their position through his gaze.
The hotel base became much livelier with the addition of thirty freshmen.
After experiencing the ambush and witnessing Marcus Lee’s fierce fighting style as a “senior”, these freshmen lost their arrogance.
Over the next few days, the freshmen were very humble and, following Sylvia Lyons’ request for experienced members to guide newcomers, they accompanied Zac Lyons and others on their daily outings.
Some freshmen even modified their battle armors by adding extra thickness, welding wings, or installing four spider-like folding mechanical arms.
As a result, Lester City’s trial atmosphere became increasingly strange.
Meanwhile, as the intelligence system improved, any murder in Lester City or missing person in the surrounding villages would be reported to the task platform.
This included reports from civilians who discovered traces of rebels.
At such times, the task platform would issue missions for Jack Clark and others to quickly drive to the scene and investigate, eliminating many tedious intermediate procedures.
Under these conditions, the blood disciples and rebels hidden in Lester City were constantly uncovered, and their living space was shrinking.
Although some trial participants were injured, there had been no deaths so far, and everyone was making rapid progress in their constant combat and resource exchange.
This atmosphere was fitting for a trial.
However, having too many people had a disadvantage – there were not enough tasks to go around, and sometimes there would be no gains for several days. Seeing this, Jack Clark simply focused all his energy on the Heavy Armored Beast.
November 25
Under the deep water, a 2.95-meter-long mutant beast covered in thick black armor slowly swam, its eyes surveying its surroundings with a faint golden glow.
Following its frenzied hunting and growth, the Heavy Armored Beast had become the absolute ruler of this wide estuary.
Even Mutated Fishes that were five or six meters long would either flee from it from afar or become the Heavy Armored Beast’s nourishment for growth.
Crunch! The Heavy Armored Beast chewed on a “snack” over a meter-long, contemplating whether it should venture into the open sea.
Almost all Mutated Fishes larger than 1.5 meters in the estuary within tens of kilometers had been eaten by it.
Today, after patrolling for half an hour, it hadn’t discovered any “big” food, leaving Jack Clark somewhat annoyed.
Eventually, after pondering for a while, the Heavy Armored Beast flicked its tail and swam towards the open sea with a mixture of nervousness and anticipation.
Originally, it had planned to enter the sea only after its third evolution for safety reasons.
But now, with the ‘scarcity’ of food and the rapid increase in its strength, Jack Clark decided to take a look.
Boom! The black Mutated Beast, nearly three meters long, silently passed through the waves at the freshwater-sea boundary, feeling a sudden discomfort in its lungs.
Gurgle, gurgle!!
At a depth of more than ten meters, the Heavy Armored Beast exhaled a stream of bubbles, shaking its head before allowing its body to acclimate to the seawater.
Compared to estuaries twenty or thirty meters deep, the depth of the estuary mouth was only around ten meters due to the long-term impact of silt and mud, making the sea water murky and full of countless small fish and shrimp.
The Heavy Armored Beast swam about ten miles out when the water depth gradually reached thirty or forty meters.At a distance, a huge shadow slowly swam at the bottom of the sea, thirty meters deep, causing all the fish and shrimp in its path to flee in a panic.
It was a mutated catfish, eight meters long with a seven-meter-long tail and a wingspan of ten meters. Its elongated body was covered with scales due to mutation.
What drew the most attention was the sharp black bone spur at the tip of its tail, which was one meter long, likely not only sharp but also highly poisonous.
At this moment, the mutated catfish was feeding, its enormous mouth producing a powerful suction force, sweeping all the small fish, shrimp, and soft-bodied creatures below like a vacuum cleaner.
The seawater filtered to remove the fish and shrimp was sprayed out from the gills on both sides, stirring up a tidal wave of water flow.
Seeing such a huge mutated fish, the Heavy Armored Beast, which had not eaten for a long time, felt its eyes turn red and excitedly charged forward with a flick of its tail.
Gurgle!!
Watching the approaching black mutated beast, the mutated catfish issued a warning and threatening sound. With its ten-meter-long body spread out, it suddenly stirred up a violent current.
Bang!
The water flow, strong enough to lift a sedan, crashed into the Heavy Armored Beast and exploded like waves hitting a reef rock, unable to budge the beast in the slightest.
With a swing of its tail, the Heavy Armored Beast dodged the gigantic wings of the mutated catfish and launched a burst of speed, landing behind it, and then brought down its double claws.
Bang! Astonishingly powerful with a full-force strike, the Heavy Armored Beast slammed the ten-meter mutated catfish down into the seabed, stirring up numerous sands and mud, and letting out a gurgle of pain.
Just as the Heavy Armored Beast prepared to pounce to shatter the catfish’s head, the seawater behind it suddenly burst open, and a bone spur as thick as an arm was shot like a heavy artillery.
The mutated catfish’s full-strength strike reached subsonic speed, and the Heavy Armored Beast couldn’t dodge it in time, or perhaps it just didn’t bother, and faced it directly with the thickest part of its back armor.
Boom!
As the subsonic-speed bone spur hit the Heavy Armored Beast’s back armor, a ring of substantial shockwaves exploded, forming a transparent bubble that rushed out more than ten meters away.
Creak!
The thickest part of the Heavy Armored Beast’s armor made a creaking sound, and the one-centimeter-thick black keratin on the surface cracked. The violent impact further slammed it onto the catfish.
This was the first time the armor had been shattered since the Heavy Armored Beast’s second evolution, especially as its armor was getting increasingly harder with its growing body.
Considering a surface layer of the armor had been cracked under these conditions, one can imagine how powerful the catfish’s attack was.
Although the bone spur also broke due to the intense collision.
However, the strike inadvertently helped the Heavy Armored Beast. With the aid of this tremendous force, it slammed onto the catfish’s body, its four claws grabbing its back, and bit down hard on its head.
Due to the terrifying biting force, a bloody hole was created in the back of the catfish’s brain, even crushing the skull underneath.
But because of its immense size, the brain was not damaged. Facing the threat of death, the mutated catfish struggled violently, stirring up turbulent waves and rolling sands with its double wings.
Yet it couldn’t shake off the Heavy Armored Beast on its back.
At that moment, the Heavy Armored Beast’s left claw reached out, its thick claws gripping and tugging at the wounded area created by its bite on the mutated catfish’s head. With a sudden pull, the catfish stiffened.
After killing its prey, the horrifying and ferocious Heavy Armored Beast began feasting on the mutated catfish, tearing off hundreds of pounds of flesh and blood with each bite.
Rolling blood seeped out through the wounds, turning the surrounding water red. Countless small fish smelling the blood scent swam over.
However, when the fish and shrimp approached within ten meters, they all stopped, terrified by the invisible aura of ferocity that permeated the surrounding area.
At that moment, two gray sharks, each seven meters long, slowly emerged, the pungent scent of blood exciting them.
Feasting on its prey, the Heavy Armored Beast suddenly turned its head. At some point, its black vertical pupils were stained with blood, exuding a chillingly brutal and terrifying aura.
Instantly, the two gray sharks stiffened, then hastily turned and swam away.
Seeing this, the Heavy Armored Beast slowly returned to its feast, its body now stained red by the fresh blood oozing from the catfish’s body, appearing even more ferocious..

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 94: Steadfast Like a Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Steadfast Like a Mountain
Translator: 549690339
The ten-meter-wide Skate appeared large, but its flattened body was only a few tons in weight.
It took the Heavy Armored Beast about an hour to eat the entire fish while digesting at the same time.
As the entire skate was digested, the Heavy Armored Beast grew in size at a visible rate, reaching nearly 3 meters in length and becoming more massive.
Having eaten its fill, the Heavy Armored Beast found a coral reef and dug a deep hole under it to perch.
On the hotel rooftop, under the sunlight, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, sensing his body steadily getting stronger under the warmth appearing from nowhere within. A look of satisfaction appeared on his face.
Although he has not made a breakthrough in his realm during this time, his strength has steadily increased.
In half a month, his strength attribute has broken through two hundred points.
Through Jack Clark’s test, his arm strength had reached 2,400 kilograms, surpassing the 2,000-kilogram basic strength limit of the Third Layer Heaven.
And because all four major attributes were growing overall, his speed and reaction were comparable to a cultivator in the Third Layer Heaven who majored in agility-focused cultivation methods.
As for the spiritual aspect, having an extremely high spiritual attribute seemed to have a boost on his Heart’s Eye Realm, making his Third Layer Heart’s Eye even more acute than what was written in the cultivation methods description.
As for the special aspects of having a higher spiritual attribute, Jack Clark has not found any yet.
At this moment, Jack Clark felt himself becoming more and more like a Hexagonal Fighter with the synchronous strengthening of his Avatar, in all aspects equal to or stronger than a cultivator of the same level.
In the corner of the cultivation site, a great aura burst out as Justin Welan was covered in earth-colored True Strength, making him look like a heavy Mysterious Martial turtle.
“Hahahaha… I finally broke through the Third Layer Heaven,” Justin Welan opened his eyes and laughed triumphantly.
It has been a month and a half since his breakthrough into the Late Second Heaven. Justin Welan participated in trials, experienced life-and-death battles, and used high-quality resources for intense cultivation.
Finally, he made a breakthrough today.
White Veil, Zac Lyons, Marcus Lee, and others who were engaged in daily practice off in the distance, were envious upon seeing this.”
They didn’t expect this guy, who didn’t even make it into the Top 50, to break through the Third Layer Heaven before them. Was there any justice or law?
Seemingly knowing what they were thinking, Justin Welan got up and looked over at them, smirking, “What’s the matter, not convinced? Want to practice with me?”
“Don’t say I’m bullying the smaller ones; you can all come at me together.”
“Damn, how arrogant!”
“Since you insisted, it would be a disservice not to join you. Brothers, let’s all attack together!”
In a low voice, Zac Lyons, who was already in the Late Second Heaven, and the others, released a strong aura from their bodies. Their figures suddenly moved forward, raising a raging wind as they charged at Justin Welan.
Especially Marcus Lee, who held a heavy hammer; his aura was the most violent, like an enraged beast charging at the forefront. The hundred-kilogram hammer burst through the air and slammed down.
Bang!
The heavy hammer smashed onto the yellow True Strength covered heavy shield. In an instant, a shockwave erupted, shattering the air within a one-meter radius’] ;?>
Despite that violent attack, Justin Welan, holding the heavy shield, remained unyielding, like an immovable mountain, radiating a heavy oppressive feeling.
At that moment, White Veil and Zac Lyons appeared on Justin Welan’s left and right. The knife and sword in their hands stirred up an ear-piercing, raging wind and slashed down, showing no sign of a friendly competition.
“Come on, let’s see my Mysterious Martial Moving Mountains!” Justin Welan’s aura surged as he let out a low shout. In the midst of the yellow light, an invisible gravity seemed to appear.
The original knife and sword, which slashed toward his left and right, were forcibly redirected onto the heavy shield. The yellow True Strength on its surface didn’t even waver.Justin Welan scoffed, “Haven’t you guys eaten? Put some more effort into it.”
“All, I refuse to believe we can’t break your turtle shell!”
Feeling mocked, the three people stopped talking and attacked the heavy shield in front of Justin frantically, not caring about any techniques or the fact that Justin was behind it.
They couldn’t believe that being just one realm behind, the three of them combined couldn’t even shake the heavy shield.
But… boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Sharp swords slashed, and after gathering strength from the Chaos Heavy Hammer, Marcus Lee bombarded the shield relentlessly. Yet, Justin, who was holding the heavy shield, remained unmoved.
As he said, when he absorbed the earthy aura from the Mysterious Yellow Crystal and broke through the Third Layer Heaven, his defense would reach a terrifying level.
Even Marcus Lee, who once suppressed him at the First Layer Heaven, couldn’t budge him at this moment when he was attacking.
This was the terrifying part of True Martial. As cultivators gained stronger True Strength, the differences in their main cultivation methods became more and more distinct.
The defense of those who focused on defense got stronger, and the speed of those who focused on speed got faster…
When Jack Clark, dressed in a black and red-trimmed military uniform, walked into the cultivation room, preparing to stretch his muscles, he saw Marcus and the other two panting and sitting on the ground.
In front of them, Justin Welan was mocking them with a smug face.
Curious, Jack Clark came over and asked, “What are you guys doing?”
Zac Lyons said bitterly, “Jack, you came just in time. Hurry up and give this guy a good beating; he’s too arrogant. It’s just a breakthrough to the Third Layer Heaven.”
“Mr. Willard has had a breakthrough,” Jack said with a smile.
Jake didn’t feel surprised at Justin’s breakthrough, as although this guy always talked big, he had indeed been cultivating very hard recently.
Considering various factors and senior resources, it was normal for him to break through before Crystal Leinster and the others.
However, according to their recent chat, Crystal and the others seemed to be close to a breakthrough themselves. At the latest, it wouldn’t be more than half a month, as she was the class’s top genius.
Justin grinned proudly, “As I said, I’m a genius. I was just too lazy to cultivate before, otherwise, Jane Aiken would never have a chance.”
…Suddenly, including Jack, all four of them were speechless.
There was nothing wrong with this guy except for his habit of bragging, which made people want to punch him.
Moreover, he wasn’t even comparing himself with Crystal anymore but with the monster, Jane Aiken.
Seeing this, Jack couldn’t help but feel an itch to challenge him, “Mr. Willard, I want to test your defense too. How about you and 1 have a match?”
Feeling excited, Justin was about to agree, but then hesitated, “Nevermind, you’re even more perverse. I don’t want to look for trouble.”
Although Jack never mentioned his breakthrough, both Justin and Zac felt that the guy must have quietly broken through the Third Layer Heaven.
Recently, the invisible pressure around him grew stronger, and every time they met, it felt like they were facing a hibernating giant beast rather than a person.
This was also the reason why Zac had called Jack to beat Justin.
At this moment, the door to the Personal Cultivation Room opened in the distance, and the over 2 meters tall, imposing Howard Lee strode out.
After breaking through the Third Layer Heaven, his aura became even more astonishing. Just by approaching them, everyone could feel an oppressive weight bearing down on them.
It seemed as if a giant was walking towards them, somewhat similar to Jack.
Howard Lee’s eyes swept over Jack and suddenly said, “I heard you guys talking about Justin breaking through the Third Layer Heaven.. Perfect timing, I have a plan and I wanted to ask if you guys are interested?”

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 95: King-level Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: King-level Bloodline
Translator: 549690339
Facing Howard Lees invitation, Justin Welan curiously asked, What plan?
Hunting mutated beasts.
Mutated beasts. Everyone was taken aback.
Howard Lee said solemnly, Youve all felt it, too, havent you? Lately, as the blood disciples and rebels are gradually being wiped out, our income from Contribution Points has become less and less.
Zac Lyons shrugged, Its not just less, its gone.
As the situation became clearer, more and more civilians were reporting, and the blood disciples and rebels hidden in Lester City and its surroundings were almost completely wiped out.
Furthermore, with the addition of dozens of new trial freshmen, in the situation of too many monks and not enough porridge, Liu Feng and his friends who had not received missions for several days could only come here to work hard on cultivation.
Howard Lee said solemnly, No missions mean no Contribution Points, and without them, we cant exchange for the resources suitable for us, so our strength cant continue to advance rapidly.
Especially since the fourth layer of the advanced skill requires 50 Contribution Points to be exchanged in the future, I have placed my focus on an area 300 kilometers away from Lester.
As the largest mountain range in Koroya, the Kata Mountain Range stretches for thousands of miles; it is home to many wild animals, and mutated beasts emerge endlessly.
However, the environment here is poor, so although there are mutated animals, they are not very strong. Moreover, in the past years, the experts from the Koroya royal family often joined forces to sweep the area, so they did not run rampant.
But due to the previous unrest, the Koroya royal family hasnt had a chance to sweep this year, which has given us an opportunity.
During this time, 1 spent more than 400,000 hiring people to search the mountains, 1 found a suitable target, a group of Iron-Armed Black Ape Mutated Beasts.
Upon hearing this, Marcus Lee frowned, Howard, a group of mutated beasts is not easy to deal with.
A single Level 3 Mutant Beast, with their current strength, could easily be killed when surrounded, but dealing with a group of them was entirely different in terms of danger.
Howard Lee nodded, I know that, but this group of Iron-Armed Black Apes is not too troublesome. Most of them are Level 1, and there are only six at Level 2.
However, my target is the leader of the Black Apes, a Level 3 Peak
Golden-backed Violent Ape that is suspected to have awakened a trace of King-level bloodline.
Justin Welan exclaimed, What, a Level 3 Mutated Beast with a trace of King-level bloodline!
The faces of the others, including Jack Clark, also became serious.
Just as there are geniuses among humans, there are also powerful talents among mutated beasts, each of which is far more terrifying than normal mutated beasts.
Among them, the most powerful talents are called Mutated King Beasts, which have traits similar to those of mythical creatures in their lineage.
The more obvious the ancestral traits are, the more terrifying their combat power will be.bender
Once, a Golden Eagle ancestor, resembling a roc, had shot down more than ten advanced fighters, ignoring missile bombardment, before it was finally killed by a Ninth Heaven Expert.
However, while their combat power is terrifying, these Mutated King Beasts are also very valuable.
For example, this Golden-backed Violent Ape, even with just a trace of
King-level bloodline, is worth more than an ordinary Level 4 Mutated Beast, at least So to 100 Contribution Points.
The specific price will ultimately depend on the condition of the mutated beast s corpse.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark couldnt help but be tempted, because he needed Contribution Points or Attribute Points.
Howard Lee looked at Zac Lyons and the others and said solemnly, This Violent Ape is very powerful; ordinary Second Layer Heavens would die at the touch of it, so only Third Layer Heavens can participate in this operation. I plan to set off one week from now. If you can break through to the Third Layer Heaven within this time, we will go together.1
Then, he looked at Jack Clark and Justin Welan, How about it, do you have any interest in that Violent Ape?
He highly valued Justin Welans defense, and he had never been able to see through Jack Clarks strength, even though he had broken through to the Third Layer Heaven for more than ten days now.
If Jack Clark was willing to join, he felt that the trip to the Kata Mountain Range would be more or less stable.
Pm a bit interested.
Jack Clark nodded, But when the time comes, if we kill all those Violent Apes, how will the spoils be divided? By headcount or by effort put in?
Howard Lee said solemnly, The overall gainswill be converted according to value, and then divided based on the effort put in, with more rewards for those who contribute more and less for those who contribute less, which is fair.
Jack Clark nodded, Okay, 1 have no objections. However, if there are Life Crystals, I want priority in choosing. The Golden-Backed Furious Ape is at the peak of Level 3. Regardless of whether it has a king-level bloodline, the probability of it containing Life Crystals in its body is quite high.
Additionally, there should be one or two more crystals amongst the ordinary mutated beasts. By then, adding one Level 3 Life Crystal would be enough to provide the attribute points needed to fully enhance his Dragon Elephant Power.
Pm okay with that. Howard Lee had no objections.
Justin Welan also nodded and said: If Jack joins, 1 definitely cant miss out, just remember to inform me when it s time to leave.
After discussing the necessary preparations, the group went their separate ways.
On the way back, Justin Welans said: It seems that after breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven, Howard Lees strength will have an explosive increase, otherwise he wouldnt have dared to target the Golden-Backed Furious Ape. Jack Clark nodded: He has Innate Divine Strength, and a perfect match with True Decision. I estimate that his combat power will be at least at the peak of Third Layer Heaven after breaking through.
For cultivators, the realm is one thing, and combat power is another.
Take himself for example, whether its Dragon Elephant Power or Clear Blade Realm, both are at the initial stage of the Third Layer, but his combat power is comparable to the peak of the Third Layer due to his foundation in physique.
Howard Lee had previously absorbed the essence blood of seven Mutated Black Bulls, and his cultivation method primarily focused on strength. After breaking through the Third Realm, the amplification of his Advanced Skill may have exceeded five times.
Even compared to Jack, it wasnt possible for him to surpass Howard in terms of Power Explosion, not to mention that Howard also had the high-level True Martial battle technique.
Unless Jacks base physique increases drastically again.
As for rhe Golden-Backed Furious Ape, its strength was also considerable. As a Level 3 Mutated Beast King with a hint of king-level bloodline, its combat power was likely at least at the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven.
Therefore, even Floward Lee didnt have full confidence, so he needed them to join forces.
For the next two days, those who wanted to participate in this operation, like Zac Lyons and others, practiced almost nonstop, trying to see if they could break through to the Third Layer Heaven ahead of time.
Justin Welan was also doing pretty much the same, training with the Blue Crystal and Mysterious Yellow Crystal every day to increase his defenses before the departure.
As for Jack Clark, of course he was concentrating on being a mutated beast, rampaging in the sea not far from the estuary, hunting down mutated fish over 5 meters in size.
Two days later, in rhe evening.
Under rhe seawater more than 20 meters deep, the 3-meter long Heavy Armored Beast became even more ferocious and fierce as it tore and fed on a 6-meter long sailfishs flesh and blood.
As rhe Heavy Armored Beast devoured and digested in big mouthfuls, more high-energy heat was absorbed, gradually accumulating rhe evolution value to 300 on the attribute page.
Finally enough.
On the balcony, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, picked up his mobile phone from the coffee table, and dialed a number.
Bro. Glenn Clarks voice came from the orher side.
Jack asked: What time is it there, Jim?
Three oclock in rhe afternoon.
Three oclock, huh? Jack calculated the swimming speed of the Heavy Armored Beast and the approximate distance of the estuary from his home, then said,
At eight oclock tonight, take the box containing the Tiger Beetle to the riverbank, tie it with a rope, and tie the other end to a small stone and throw it under the bridge pier.
Huh? Glenn, who was in class at the time, was puzzled and didnt know why he had to do this.
What huh? Just do as I said.
Glenn was still confused: But, bro, why do you want to throw it there?
Its a deal I made with a friend. You just do as I say. Jack casually came up with an excuse. As for whether Glenn believed him or nor, Jack didnt know, but in any case, Glenn did believe him.
Alright. In rhe end, Glenn, who couldnt figure ir out, obediently complied.
There was no helping it; after all, it was his brother who asked him to do it.
After hanging up the phone, the fierce and ferocious mutated beast under the sea surface propelled its massive energy toward the river opening with a powerful flick of its tail

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 96: On-shelf Testimonial
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: On-shelf Testimonial
Translator: 549690339 |
Brothers, it’s going to be on the shelves tomorrow at 12pm.
To be honest} I’m a bit excited. The original goal for this book was to reach about 20,000 collections and be satisfied with just 1,000 to 2,000 initial subscriptions, but the results have exceeded my expectations.
1 am very grateful for the support of my brothers along the way, and I also appreciate the occasional comments from my editor, Luming.
This book is not just about giant beasts, but rather it tells the intertwined stories of the main character and his avatar from two perspectives, which develop independently but also affect each other.
Only after both the main character and the avatar grow stronger will their paths overlap to a certain extent.
Due to the book’s title, many readers may think it s just about giant beasts, neglecting the words “Mythical Era11 mentioned at the beginning.
Of course, there is content about giant beasts, and after the Heavy Armored Beast has evolved three times, it will gradually increase and sometimes occupy more than half of the content.
But whether it’s the human society where the protagonist is now, or the ocean full of mutated beasts, these are just glimpses of the vast mythical world filled with giant beasts.
This world is somewhat related to the traditional mythical system but not entirely. It’s vast, boundless, and extraordinary. It spans countless time and space, and that’s why it’s called the mythical world.
Humans here are merely struggling for survival…
Ah, I won’t spoil anything further! Now let’s talk about the updates after the launch.
Due to Warm Sun’s Silver Alliance, 1 have promised to deliver a minimum of 10,000 words tomorrow and an additional ten chapters starting with 3,000 words each, but this will use up all my accumulated chapters.
Therefore, to ensure quality, I can only guarantee a minimum daily update of 8,000 words after the launch. More will depend on my condition, and 1 hope my brothers can understand.
As for the issue of the combat power system, don’t worry. It has a complete framework, and the latter part of simply enhancing the cultivation level will not forcibly upgrade the realm level.
The reason that strengthening the cultivation level earlier could elevate the realm level was that it was too weak and directly driven.
Same goes for Extraordinary Equipment, attribute points are not omnipotent, and there won’t be a situation of getting a bunch of artifacts by crazily strengthening an item. And I’ve deleted the part about Justin Welan’s equipment.
My brothers are right; we need to ensure the uniqueness of the main character.
Speaking of this, you can vote. After Late Fourth Layer Heaven, the protagonist will change his weapon and combat skills because the current weapon cannot bring out his strength characteristics.
After changing the weapon, the Heart’s Eye Realm will not be affected, and the strengthened attributes will not be wasted. So everyone can leave a message about which new weapon seems more domineering.
A four-meter-long heavy halberd, Eight Desolate Refining Hell!
A three-meter-long slash blade, Unparalleled Destruction!
A four-meter-long heavy hammer, Heavy Destruction!
Brothers, see you tomorrow at noon…. remember to support the official subscription, okay?

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 96: Third Evolution, Sword Armor King Beast (First Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 96: Third Evolution, Sword Armor King Beast (First Update)
Translator: 549690339
Mist River, 7:30 in the evening.
Glenn Clark came down from the upstairs holding a box containing a tiger beetle and called out to Doris Raven, who was watching TV in the living room, “Mom, I’m going out for a walk.”
Due to the good public security, Doris was not worried about his safety and just reminded him, “Don’t go too far, okay?”
“I know.”
“Wait, you’re going for a walk, why are you taking your brother’s pet insect?” Doris looked curiously at the box he was holding.
“Oh, my brother called me in the afternoon and asked me to set it free.” Glenn blinked.
He had no choice. The request from his brother to tie a rope and throw it into the water was too far-fetched. If he told Doris, he might be seen as deliberately causing trouble, so it was better to say he was setting it free.
“Your brother called you.”
Doris paused and then asked with concern, “Did he say anything about how he’s doing over there? Is he injured? How’s the food?”
“I heard Koroya is very backward, with unstable signals and frequent power outages in some places…”
“Cough! Mom, my brother is fine, he’s doing very well.” Glenn hurriedly interrupted.
And without waiting for Doris to speak, he ran out, “Mom, I’m leaving now.”
It was almost December, and the weather was getting colder. Fewer people were out at night, and there were only a few elderly people with their children for a walk along the riverside.
Following Jack Clark’s instructions, Glenn came to the bridge by the river, took out a rope, tied up the box containing the tiger beetle, and attached a small stone to one end of the rope.
After testing the weight, Glenn suddenly threw the stone and the box together out into the water.
Splash! The water splashed, the stone quickly sank to the bottom, and the box with a few small holes in it floated on the water’s surface, held in place by the stone.
“Is this okay?” Looking at the floating box in the water, Glenn was a bit uncertain, and after thinking for a moment, he took out his mobile phone.
Due to the time difference, Koroya was in the middle of the night.
Jack Clark, who hadn’t slept all night, answered the phone as soon as it rang.
“Brother, I’ve thrown the tiger beetle into the river.”
“Hmm, 1 know. You can go back now.”
As Jack spoke, a three-meter-long black mutated beast was lying quietly under the water near the bridge, slightly raising its head to look at Glenn by the river.
“Oh, then I’ll go back.”
Since Jack said there was no problem, Glenn hung up the phone and left.
About ten minutes after Glenn left, it was already 8:30 in the evening. The dim water under the bridge churned, and a huge black head emerged from the water’s surface.
The half-meter-long sharp spikes on both sides of its head, and the three pairs of blood-red feather horns angrily erect, gave the heavy-armored beast an aura of unspeakable majesty.
Thump! The Heavy Armored Beast swallowed the tiger beetle along with the box in one bite, and then disappeared under the water surface.
Half an hour later, the black mutated beast came to the junction of the tributary and the main river and returned to the cave entrance it had dug on the riverbank.
Of course, its current nest was no longer able to accommodate its larger size. The Heavy Armored Beast stretched out its double claws, and the water in the area instantly became turbulent and muddy.
Soon, a cave appeared with an entrance below the water, the passage five meters deep, and a width and length of six meters on the inside.
Not until then did the Heavy Armored Beast crawl into the center, crushing the wooden box it had been holding in its mouth for so long.
At the same time, Jack Clark, who had arrived on the hotel rooftop, heard a voice in his mind that said “Evolution”.
Boom!
Jack’s voice was like pressing a button, and a fierce torrent of heat erupted like a wave inside the Heavy Armored Beast, thousands of miles away.
The accumulated evolution energy this time was much more than the previous two times. The muscles, bones, and even the external bone armor of the Heavy Armored Beast decomposed at a visible speed as the energy passed through them.
That’s right, they decomposed at the cellular level, recombined, split, and compressed the density to become even more terrifying.
The originally stable genes also began to recombine and optimize, evolving in a direction more suitable for themselves after absorbing a part of the speed factor represented by the tiger beetle.
Meanwhile, an intense heat energy appeared out of nowhere inside Jack, exploding like a bomb, and engulfing his entire body with rolling heatwaves.
As the heatwaves passed, the already powerful physical constitution soared at a terrifying speed, doubling, quadrupling, quintupling…
As his physique grew stronger and his cell density increased, Jack’s body exuded an increasingly heavy aura.
This evolution took even longer than the last one, taking almost two hours to complete.
By then, the sky was already bright, and the rising sun shone golden light on Jack’s face, which glowed like a jade carving.
Jack slowly opened his eyes, his black-and-white pupils were tinged with a touch of gold, his gaze was indifferent, and there was a faint sense of dignity and sanctity.
But this anomaly was only a fleeting moment.
Jack moved his body a little and could clearly feel that as his physique strengthened and cell density increased, his body became much heavier.
His skin had become tougher, his muscle fibers had greater explosive power, and his bones were harder than alloy, capable of bearing greater strength.
“The improvement this time is a bit exaggerated.” In amazement, Jack called up the attribute page with a mental command.
Realm: Third Layer Heaven
Physique: 285+
Strength: 306+
Agility: 247+
Spirit: 241+
Talent: Soul Split+
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Method, Dragon Elephant Power+[Third LayerJMind’s Eye Bright Knife+[Third Layer]
Attribute points: 3
Equipment: Common Armored Battle Suit[Solid+io]
Avatar: Hexagonal Sword Armored Beast
Level: Intermediate Mutated Beast[A mutated ferocious beast possessing three powerful talents, ranked as a king among its peers, with extremely formidable combat power]

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 96: The Third Evolution, Sword-
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 96: The Third Evolution, Sword-
Armor King Beast (First update)—2
Translator: 549690339
Talent: Strength +[ioox Strength Burst iDefense +[ioox Heavy Pressure
Defense I
Agility +[A special bodily structure and limbs with a high degree of potential strength, allowing an instantaneous burst of thirty times the normal speed; effectiveness under water is somewhat reduced. ]
Evolution Value: 0/3000
In this evolution, Jack Clark s four major attributes have each increased by 100 points. The overall enhancement in every regard is utterly terrifying.
