He feels that even if he doesn’t use his True Strength, standard bullets would be unable to pierce his skin due to its density, and his increase in strength is even more terrifying.
Squeak! Squeak!
Jack Clark s hand is gripping the huge water tank on the rooftop. As he slightly pulls, the metal frame of over ten tons begins to creak from rhe deforming metal.
Feeling rhe terrifying strength bursting from the muscles in his arm, Jack Clark releases his grip satisfyingly: “This is just pure arm strength, and I’ve reached over four thousand kilograms already.”
The physique attribute becomes stronger the more it’s pushed in the later stages, each increase making it stronger than the last. Like now, there’s almost a doubling of strength between two hundred points and three hundred points.
After a simple test with close to double the strength, Jack Clark turns his attention to the data of the avatar below.
The name has changed to Hexagonal Sword Armored Beast, and the level has increased to intermediate Mutated Beast. This level division is slightly different from human classification of the Mutated Beast.
Jack Clark feels that the current Sword Armored Beast’s level among Mutated Beasts should be around the start of Level 4.
Taking into account the previous lower level, it seems the attribute page has broken Mutated Beasts into lower, intermediate, and higher levels, which correspond to Levels 1 to 9.
Of course, even though the level is in the early stages of Level 4, the note about the Mutated Beast King means that the strength of the Sword Armor Beast after evolution greatly exceeds its own level.
Glossing over this information, Jack Clark s attention lands on the third talent, ‘Agility.
Storing energy, bursting with thirty times the normal speed in an instant. Jack Clark was somewhat surprised; he did not expect the talent he gained this time to not be a hundred-fold increase.
Jack Clark thoughtfully: “It seems that even if it’s a talent, speed is still affected by air resistance and gravity.”
Strength Talent comes from potent muscle fibers and dense bones throughout the body, while Defense comes from special hard external body armor. They are both bodily talents.
But speed isn’t.
Even though the speed talent after evolution mainly comes from the ability to store energy and to have terrifying joint muscle elasticity, it is still affected by the external world after a burst.
Or maybe it’s because this talent comes from the physical body so it is still subjected to physical rules.
If the evolution awakened similar to the rules, or perhaps transcendent speed talents, they should then be able to disregard physical rules.
After looking through all the data carefully, Jack Clark then transfers to the Sword Armor Beast’s perspective
In the pitch-dark cave, a pair of black eyes adorned with golden vertical pupils slowly open as Jack Clark is unable to see the physical changes due to lack of light, so he slightly exerts the limbs’ strength.
Boom!
The riverbank slope explodes greatly, with several tons of dirt being hurled into the air as if a missile had hit it. The water splashes everywhere, and the earth shakes as smoke and dust fill the air.
From amidst the cloud of smoke and dust, a pitch-black Mutated Beast appears by the riverside.
After this evolution, the Sword Armor Beast’s body has become more robust and proportionate. It has grown from three meters to four meters in length, with the additional meter being the tail.
The formerly short tail now takes up half of the body and becomes more slender towards the end, giving it an agile feel. Especially at its tip, a ten-centimeter long, black bone spur as sharp as a spear or sword is formed.
His body is still covered with layers of armor-like exoskeleton that gives off a metallic sheen from the black, although it isn’t as thick as before, the defense remains formidable.
Simultaneously, the limbs also curve more elegantly robust, and the muscles in the lower body and hindlegs are bulkier. It seems like it could stand up just by exerting a little force.
Meanwhile, the row of obtuse angles on its back have become elongated and sharp, spanning from its brain to its tail, like over ten long black swords.
Aside from that, its head has become more 3-dimensional and sturdy, with prominent eyebrow bones. The upper and lower jaw edges have well-defined angles as if it was a dragon’s head surrounded by the black bones.
On both sides, the three pairs of red feather horns are redder with a light red glow, like a jade artifact. The ice-cold gaze from its flaxen vertical pupils exudes an imposing manner unspokenly.
This instant, the Sword Armor Beast gives off a brutal ferocious aura, as if it is a terrifying Unique Beast born to slaughter.
Roar! The Sword Armor Beast opens its mouth slightly and emits a tiger-like roar. The sound is deep and solid.
Boom!
The dirt explodes fiercely, leaving four large holes in the ground. With the terrifying counteracting force, the Sword Armor Beast vanishes instantly, leaving behind only an afterimage.
Thump! Water splashes on the river1 s surface hundreds of meters away, with tons of water shoved upwards as if from a fountain. It doesn’t start to fall until it reaches over ten meters in height.
Under the river s surface, the Sword Armor Beast shoots forward like a dark shadow at an astonishing speed.
Many fish didn’t even have the chance to react before they were swallowed by its fierce mouth, leaving only a tail or half a head floating in the water.
It took the Heavy Armor Beast a long time to travel the over one hundred kilometers distance from the estuary to the tributary convergence, but the evolved Sword Armor Beast took just over half an hour.
That’s equivalent to a speed of around one hundred fifty kilometers per hour, even faster than the fastest fish in the ocean.
Of course, this comparison is before mutation. After mutation, many oceanic fishes’ speed becomes terrifying. Like that knife fish he encountered before..

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 96: Third Evolution, Sword Armor
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 96: Third Evolution, Sword Armor
King Beast (First Update)_3
Translator: 549690339
This evolution not only gave the Sword Armor Beast the Agility Talent, but it also made it become more agile and fierce, shedding off the heaviness of its Heavy Armored Beast form.
Bang! At the junction of saltwater and freshwater, a dark shadow tore through the waves and plunged into the ocean.
Although its size did not change much, the Sword Armor Beast was not as fearful of the ocean as before. Its figure was like a dark shadow, rushing towards the deep outer sea.
Because only deeper waters could spawn more powerful Mutated Fish.
It wanted to devour those stronger Mutated Fish so that it would have more energy to grow and gather more evolution value for the upcoming Fourth Evolution.
Just as the Sword Armor Beast was swimming out more than 20 kilometers in the ocean, it came to a place with a depth of more than 50 meters.
A 10-meter-long, snake-like dark shadow appeared before its eyes. The Sword Armor Beast immediately erupted with a terrifying burst of power from within its body.
Bang! The water behind it exploded and the Sword Armor Beast shot out like a black arrow, appearing in front of the distant dark shadow in the blink of an eye, reaching out with both claws.
Squirt Squirt!!
Under the horror of speed and sharp double claws, the head of the Mutant Eel, resembling a python and covered in yellow scales, was instantly torn apart.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Like a real python, the decapitated Mutant Eel’s corpse remained stiff, its body as thick as a bucket twisting and thrashing madly in the sea, spurting blood.
In the blink of an eye, the surrounding seawater within tens of meters was dyed red with blood, emanating a strong bloody smell.
When the corpse of the Mutant Eel stopped struggling, the pitch-black and fierce Sword Armor Beast slowly swam over.
Its double claws grabbed the body of the eel, and it began to eat it like it was eating a spicy strip, with thick blood and flesh overflowing from its sharp teeth and drifting in the water.
However, at this moment, not a single small fish or shrimp that smelled blood dared to come close.
Although they lacked intelligence, they had the instincts of living beings. At this time, they could instinctively feel a terrifying murderous aura coming from the front and did not dare to approach.
Crunch crunch! In a short while, the ten-meter-long, one-ton Mutant Eel was completely eaten by the Sword Armor Beast.
Under the biological energy transformed by the food, the Sword Armor Beast’s body visibly grew bigger, becoming even more fierce.
And its Evolution value increased by 1 point directly.
It seemed not much, but the problem was that the Sword Armor Beast had just casually devoured an ordinary Mutant Sea Eel. According to this speed of eating, would! it increase by dozens of points in a day?
At this time, the Sword Armor Beast flicked its tail slightly, went to the bottom of the sea, and grabbed the Eel’s head, which was as big as a bucket, with one of its claws.
However, it did not eat it but crushed it with a crack.
“Nothing?” The Sword Armor Beast rummaged through the crushed eel debris, but did not find a Life Crystal.
The Sword Armor Beast only needed the blood and flesh of living beings to be transformed into energy and accumulate Evolution value.
Therefore, Jack Clark had been wanting to test whether the Sword Armor Beast would gain more energy from swallowing crystals or if it would be more cost-effective for him to transform Life Crystals into Attribute points.
However, before this, he had no idea whether it was due to bad luck or something else, the ordinary Mutated Fish hunted by the Heavy Armored Beast in the river did not have Life Crystals.
However, compared to the ordinary Mutated Fish in the river, there were more and stronger Mutated Beasts in the endless ocean, even with sizes exceeding 100 or 200 meters, such Giant Beasts were not few in number.
Those places usually became Deep Sea Forbidden Zones, where human ships dared not approach.
Even aircraft carriers carrying a battle group and accompanied by True Martial Experts passing by would face the risk of being completely destroyed, because the ocean was the home field of those Deep Sea Giant Beasts.
The Sword Armor Beast threw away the debris it had captured, and its fearsome figure swam away to find its next target.
The conditions for Life Crystals were extremely harsh. They only appeared when a creature reached the peak evolutionary stage, so the Sword Armor Beast was not too disappointed.
No big deal, it would just continue killing and would eventually find a crystal inside a Mutated Fish.
As expected, in the resource-rich ocean, the Sword Armor Beast hadn’t swum a few kilometers before a huge dark shadow appeared in its field of vision.
With several evolutions, the Sword Armor Beast had extremely sharp vision. Under the faint light reflected by the moon on the sea surface, it discovered this food source in advance.
It was a nine-meter-long Mutant Fat Fish. Its body was covered in brown scales, as wide as two meters at its widest point, and it looked like a bus. Its slightly open mouth had four sharp canine teeth, appearing quite fierce.
Compared to the slender Mutant Eel, this Mutant Fish was much more powerful. Therefore, the Sword Armor Beast slowed down its speed and approached it slowly, with its tail swinging back and forth.
However, the Mutant Fat Fish was very sharp. Just as the Sword Armor Beast approached it within ten meters, it reacted abruptly, turned its head back, and a grey power erupted from its body.
Bang!
In an instant, the Mutant Fat Fish, covered in grey power, looked like a heavy armored tank, and a short-distance underwater explosion erupted at a terrible speed, as it slammed towards the Sword Armor Beast.
This burst of speed from the seemingly clumsy Mutant Fat Fish caught the Sword Armor Beast by surprise. It involuntarily stepped back, and reached out with both claws.
Boom! Tens of tons of turbulent water exploded, blasting the surrounding muddy sand and silt tens of meters away, and the turbid shock waves calmed down only after traveling a long distance.
But the Sword Armor Beast, which looked several times smaller, remained firm. Its hind legs’ muscles swelled and sunk into the seabed, holding the huge Mutant Fat Fish steadily in front of it.
This outcome left the Mutant Fat Fish, which had used its talent to accelerate in a short distance and ram its prey to death, somewhat dumbfounded.
However, it might be dumb, but the Sword Armor Beast was not. As it blocked the impact of the Mutant Fat Fish, its double claws’ muscles swelled, and a terrifying burst of power erupted as it suddenly tore apart.
Pu! The grey power on the surface of the Mutant Fat Fish was directly torn by the double claws, followed by its ten-centimeter-thick scale armor and flesh, exposing the white bones underneath.
Bang! In extreme pain, the Mutant Fat Fish spewed water from its mouth and opened its giant jaws to bite the side of the Sword Armor Beast…
Squirt! At this moment, a dark shadow pierced through the water, the speed of which almost reached subsonic levels. A black light flashed and pierced through the head of the Mutant Fat Fish.
It was the sword-shaped tail of the Sword Armor Beast, which also possessed a Charging Ability.
As it looked at the dead Mutant Fish, there was no ripple in the Sword Armor Beast’s cold, pale golden vertical pupils. Its tail gently pulled out of the fish’s head with a little force.
At this moment, with its hind legs standing on the seabed and its double claws gripping the Mutant Fish, the Sword Armor Beast looked like a humanoid monster. Its long and sharp tail swayed slightly in the water, looking incredibly fierce.
However, the Sword Armor Beast didn’t care whether it was fierce or not.. It was thinking that after eating such a big Mutated Fish, it should be able to provide four or five Evolution points, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 97: Destroying Cities and Strongholds - The ’Terrifying’ Jack Clark (Second Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 97: Destroying Cities and Strongholds – The ‘Terrifying’ Jack Clark (Second Update)
Translator: 549690339
At the entrance of the tributary to the river, more than ten minutes after the disappearance of the Sword Armor Beast, two figures appeared, with True Strength from the Fifth Layer Heaven circulating within their bodies.
Looking at the huge hole blown open in the river dyke and the massive footprints of the mutated beasts at the bottom of the giant craters, one of the middle-aged men said with a somewhat solemn tone.
“The light wave detector up ahead showed that a Level 4 Mutated Beast with energy fluctuations appeared here. 1 originally thought that a giant evolved creature had emerged in the river.”
“But, looking at these claw marks, it doesn’t seem to be an aquatic mutated beast.”
Another person shook his head slightly: “Not necessarily, from the direction of those claw marks, the mutated beast entered the river in the end, so it could be a mutant alligator.”
“Or maybe a mutated aquatic creature with evolved limbs.”
At this point, the two men fell silent.
After a long time, the middle-aged man slowly said, “That mutated beast has entered the river, so it’s not easy to trace. However, according to past evolutionary patterns, it will follow the water flow towards the ocean.”
“The richer energy in the ocean compared to the faint heavenly energy contained in the rivers is more attractive to these creatures.”
Another person nodded, then said solemnly, “In any case, there are more and more mutated creatures appearing in the rivers. 1 feel we need to find a way to control them.”
“We can — after we go back, we will propose to the higher-ups selective fishing for fish that are longer than 2 meters and have signs of mutation.”
“I think we can also mobilize the power of the masses…”
In the early morning, Hotel Lobby, Jack Clark, clad in dark red armor, emerged from the elevator.
Already 1.85 meters tall and imposing, his metal battle boots would make a dull thud on the carpet with every step, giving people a sense of stability like a mountain.
The ragged black hair that hadn’t been trimmed for three months now covered his ears. As he walked, his bangs swayed slightly, his features were handsome and dashing in appearance.
“Jack Clark.”
“Big brother Jack.”
“Jack, are you going out?”
Seeing Jack coming out, the students from South Sky Martial Height and those from the other two schools in the lobby all greeted him warmly.
Compared to the inconspicuous identity he had at school, Jack’s popularity skyrocketed after arriving at Lester, with a high reputation among classmates and later freshmen.
Even the monstrously gifted Howard Lee couldn’t suppress him.
Facing these friendly greetings, Jack responded with a smile, no trace of his ferocious and overbearing demeanor during battle visible.
Exiting the hotel, Jack went to the military district and applied for a rugged off-road vehicle that had been modified so that students in battle armor could drive it themselves.
With his sword placed diagonally on the back seat, Jack drove away.
Soon the off-road vehicle entered the main road out of town, bustling with traffic and seemingly more lively.
After nearly a month’s time, the situation in Koroya had been completely stabilized, except for a few major cities.
The newly-established United Official had abolished the royal system, issued many popular laws in this period and conscientiously implemented them, making the Koroya people increasingly identify with the Federation.
Of course, the recovery after the overthrow was slow.
Soon, Jack arrived at the desolate abandoned urban village on the outskirts, the place where the South Sky Martial Height student had died.
Parking the car outside, Jack walked in with a calm expression.
In the dilapidated three-story hall, Jack took a deep breath, and in an instant, a violent aura burst forth from him. His muscles expanded, and his entire body surged with a powerful punch.
Boom! A punch covered in black real power was unleashed, instantly causing an explosion in the air in front of him. The half-meter-thick concrete pillar was also blown apart, ignoring the fragments that scattered in all directions.
After punching through the load-bearing pillar, Jack moved swiftly, emitting a piercing screech like a rampaging mammoth slamming heavily into the wall in the distance.
Boom! The wall collapsed, and the entire building shook amidst the smoke and dust.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Jack was like a rampaging giant beast, rampaging through the abandoned urban village, his every movement bursting with terrifying power to destroy everything.
He appeared to be insane and overbearing.
With the collapse of the low-rise buildings and high-rises in his hands, the ground shook, and a rolling cloud of smoke and dust surged into the sky, as vague glimpses of sharp sword lights shredded everything.
Of course, Jack wasn’t crazy – he was just testing his strength after the sudden increase in physique to avoid not being able to fully control his power later on.
But with his current strength, the commotion he created while testing at the base was too great, which is why he had come here deliberately.
More than an hour later, amidst the thick smoke, Jack slowly emerged from the urban village where half of the buildings had collapsed, his expression calm.
At noon, in the cafeteria.
As Jack finished ordering food and was about to sit down at a table with his tray, Justin Welan waved and called out to him from not far away, “Jack, over here.”
Jack walked over and sat down. Justin curiously asked, “Jack, where did you go this morning? I didn’t see you at the practice field.”
Jack casually replied, “I drove around aimlessly, thinking maybe I’d get lucky and catch a blood disciple or something, but unfortunately 1 didn’t run into anything.”
Justin chuckled, “That’s normal, now it’s not as chaotic as it was when we first started.”
“After more than half a month, especially with the crazy sweep of the new trial students, those bloodthirsty creatures who had to kill someone every week were basically wiped out.”
At this time, Justin said, “By the way, Jack, did you hear about the Class Leader’s breakthrough?”
“The Class Leader has broken through too? Impressive,” Jack praised.
Justin rolled his eyes, “…Jack, why do I always feel like punching you when I hear you praising someone else as impressive?”

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 97: Destroying Cities and Strongholds - The ’Terrifying’ Jack Clark (Second Update_2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 97: Destroying Cities and Strongholds – The ‘Terrifying’ Jack Clark (Second Update_2)
Translator: 549690339
“Why?”
Jack Clark looked at him curiously: “What’s wrong with acknowledging someone else’s strength?”
“Normally, there’s nothing wrong with it.”
“But there’s a problem when that person is you.”
Justin Welan gritted his teeth: “You’re obviously getting more and more powerful, and you’re more fierce in battle than anyone else, but you always act modest and gentle in front of us.”
“Is that interesting?”
Jack was puzzled: “Naturally, 1 should be decisive in the face of an enemy, quickly taking them down. What does that have to do with me being modest and easygoing in my daily life?”
“Do I need to act domineering, awe-inspiring, or cold and indifferent towards everyone?”
“That’s not necessary.”
Justin Welan was a little twisted: “I mean, you can act more dominant and strong-willed, so 1 can have some confidence when I try to show off.”
“What does your showing off have to do with me?” Jack was baffled.
“Of course, it matters.”
Justin Welan was speechless: “Every time I break through a realm and become more powerful, I want to show off in front of Zac Lyons and others, but you always casually come out.”
“And you’re obviously even stronger than me, yet you always look so modest. This makes me feel like trying to show off is pointless.”
Jack couldn’t help but laugh: “You can’t blame me for that. How about next time, 1’11 wait until you’re done showing off before 1 come out?”
“Fine, but remember, you said it yourself.”
As they chatted and laughed, the two finished their meal, and each went their separate ways, with Justin returning to his diligent cultivation.
Jack went to the rooftop of the hotel and sank into his thoughts.
On the coral reefs more than 50 meters underwater, the fierce black Mutated Beast lay still, its golden vertical pupils scanning its surroundings.
After devouring two large Mutated Fish in the morning, the Sword Armor Beast had patrolled its territory to familiarize itself with the environment.
Although the deep sea was rich in resources, it was also extremely dangerous. Even the Sword Armor Beast couldn’t afford to be careless; otherwise, it would be in danger if it suddenly encountered a Ninth-Level Mutant Beast.
As Jack was lost in thought, a two-meter-long grouper slowly swam past the coral reef outside. When the grouper approached the coral reef where the Sword Armor Beast was, boom! Instantly,sea water exploded, and a sword spike pierced out like a black streak of light.
Thud! The sword spike instantly penetrated the grouper’s head, killing it before it could even feel pain.
Not all creatures were like the Sword Armor Beast; many fish had weak eyesight and relied on other senses to detect changes in water currents and their surroundings.
It was only then that the Sword Armor Beast moved slightly; its tail coiled around the fish head and brought it to its mouth for a bite.
The Sword Armor Beast hugged the grouper with its double claws and tore it apart, eating it while its tail swayed behind it, and its fearsome body swam further into the deep sea in search of prey.
December 2nd, in the morning.
Jack, wearing battle armor, carried his helmet in his left hand as he walked out of the elevator, his black cloak fluttering behind him.
Outside the hotel, four modified trucks were parked, and fully armed Howard Lee, Justin Welan, and Marcus Lee were waiting for him.
All three of them had placed their weapons in the back of their respective trucks, especially Howard Lee’s weapon, which had been extended from three meters to a terrifying four meters in length.
The heavy Steel Pillar made the four truck wheels sink slightly.
Seeing Jack coming down, Howard Lee nodded slightly: “Everyone is here. Let’s get ready to go.”
“Alright,” Jack had no objections.
With that, the four of them got into their respective trucks, and as the engines started, they drove off into the distance while the classmates watched.
A curious student from Kenny Harper High School asked, “What are they going to do? They look like they’re going far.”
Leaning against the hotel wall with his arms crossed, Zac Lyons said enviously, “They are going to do something big.”
That student from Kenny Harper High School was somewhat astonished, “Is it big? Did they locate the traces of a Third Layer Heaven immortal?”
“Pfft! As if a Third Layer Heaven immortal would warrant the cooperation of the four of them.” The White Veil, who was also leaning against the wall, couldn’t help but laugh.
These freshmen arrived late, and during this time, they were chasing after those blood disciples and rebels; all they encountered were some ordinary First and Second Layer Heaven folks.
They had never seen Jack and Howard Lee take action.
For those two guys now, it wouldn’t matter if they encountered a Third Layer Heaven blood disciple or even a Fourth Layer Heaven Acolyte – they had a high chance of defeating them on their own.
It’s a pity that when they thought about this, the two felt a little regretful.
After a week of intense cultivation, only Marcus Lee managed to break through yesterday and was qualified to participate in the hunt for the King Blood Mutant Beast.
As for those four modified trucks, they were provided by Howard Lee.
In addition, he had prepared food and water for the several days they would be in the mountains; Jack and the others only needed to focus on eliminating the Mutated Beasts.
That’s the generosity of a big-shot.
Of course, the teachers had been informed of this operation beforehand, and they only allowed the four of them to leave the Lester territory after receiving permission. Otherwise, if something happened, it would be difficult for her to explain to the higher-ups.
After all, the four were all geniuses who had broken through to the Third Layer Heaven in a short period of time.
The Kata Mountain Range stretched across half of Koroya, while Lester City was about 150 kilometers away from the nearest entrance of the mountains, passing through two small cities along the way.
There were also some rough roads to navigate during the journey.
So they set off early in the morning, and it was almost 2 p.m. when they arrived at the foot of the mountain. There, the terrain was flat, and there were already five Koroya people camping outside the forest..

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 97: Destroying Cities and Strongholds - The 'Terrifying' Jack Clark (Second Update)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 97: Destroying Cities and Strongholds The Terrifying Jack Clark (Second Update)_3
Translator: 549690339
These people looked resolute, and each had a rifle or submachine gun on their backs and even heavy weapons like grenade launchers in their tents.
They were the mercenaries hired by Howard Lee.
Although they were ordinary people, they were experienced in traversing the mountains and forests, and their combat capabilities were strong, specializing in searching and capturing ordinary mutated creatures.
Of course, the mutated creatures they had captured before were common creatures with some traces of mutation, not even at the level of Level 1 Mutated Beasts.
So, this time they suffered losses; four out of the nine members died on their way to track the Mutated Beast.
However, since they were in this line of work for money, they were mentally prepared and didnt harbor any dissatisfaction or resentment.
Upon seeing Howard Lee getting off the car, the burliest middle-aged man from Koroya greeted him warmly: Boss, youre here.
Howard Lee spoke solemnly, Take care of the car for me. After we come out, I will transfer the remaining payment to you.
No problem, boss.
Boss, this is the map I drew. I marked all the locations with dangerous Mutated Beasts on it. The mercenary handed Howard Lee a piece of sheepskin.
While they were speaking, Jack Clark and the others also got off the car, wearing small backpacks with supplies and holding their weapons in hand.
The path ahead was filled with dangers, so it was safest to keep the weapons close at hand.
However, as the mercenaries saw the long knife, heavy shield, heavy hammer, and iron column Howard Lee carried, awe was evident on their faces.
As the four strode into the mountains, the burliest man couldnt help but shout, Boss, be careful, especially of the common mutated poisonous insects and poisonous snakes.
Dont underestimate them.
Of course, this mercenary wasnt that kind-hearted.
He was mainly worried that these Federal geniuses might die carelessly, causing him not only to lose the remaining payment but also bring trouble upon himself.
In response, Howard Lee simply waved his hand, signaling that he understood.
After breaking through the Third Layer Heaven, Marcus Lees physique, the weakest among the four, was more than ten times stronger than an ordinary person, with his arm strength exceeding 1,000 kilograms.
Even wearing heavy armor and holding heavy weapons, they moved like the wind in the mountain forest, walking on the road when there was one and jumping directly across the mountain gaps and cliffs when there wasnt.
They traversed two mountain peaks in just half an hour with their astonishing speed.
As for the weeds and thorns on the way, the ordinary poisonous insects and snakes were ignored, as they were unable to cause any hindrance to the four in their full battle armor.
However, after running over thirty kilometersbender
Bang!
A 2-meter-long iron column covered with Red True Power smashed down, producing a raging wind, and a wild boar weighing more than a thousand jin was instantly crushed into minced meat.
Overbearing as ever.
Howard Lee, who had killed the wild boar, shook the iron column in his embrace. The True Power shook off the blood and flesh stuck to it, and he slammed it onto his shoulder. With the four over one-meter-long curved angles as a backdrop, he looked like a demon.
This wild boar was just a small intermission.
The four continued on their way, and suddenly, Jack Clark swung the knife in his hand, cutting through the side forest, and a four-meter-long colorful poisonous snake was sliced in half.
After a glance at the snakes corpse, the four continued to rush forward calmly. But after traveling another few kilometers, Marcus Lee suddenly leaped high into the air and slammed the heavy hammer down with force.
Bang! The dead leaves in front exploded in an instant.
A 2-meter-long, brown-spotted camouflage Giant Lizard had its head blown open, splattering flesh and blood while emitting a strong smell of blood.
Justin Welan couldnt help but complain, Damn, why do these animals seem so aggressive?
Jack Clark shook his head, Not only are they aggressive, but these creatures have also shown signs of mutation. Although their strength is only slightly stronger than ordinary creatures, its not a good sign.
At these words, the faces of the others also turned somber.
They usually lived in cities, where they could buy everything they needed from markets, so they had no idea how serious the situation in the deep mountains and wild forests had become.
There were aggressive wild creatures everywhere, and many of them had faint signs of mutation on their bodies.
And this was the case in Koroya, a poor and barren place. What about in the energy-rich Eastern Summer?
With Eastern Summers environment and vastness, the number of mutated creatures in their deep mountains and wild forests would only be more numerous and terrifying.
No wonder the government organizes senior students from various universities to hunt Mutated Beasts every year while sending the military to blockade several dangerous mountain ranges.
Officials from local armed departments also frequently clear out nearby wild areas, nipping these dangerous mutated creatures in the bud for ordinary people.
However, they had a faint vision of a terrifying future where mutated creatures covered the mountains and plains.
Soon, the four progressed another ten kilometers deep into the mountains. As they passed by the foot of a mountain, a ferocious roar echoed from above.
Roar!
A giant black bear with a shoulder height of more than 2 meters, a body length of 5 meters, and a weight of more than two tons rushed down from the mountain forest, apparently treating the four as prey invading its territory.
Justin Welan was immediately excited, Dont take action, let me handle this.
On the way, it was mainly the other three who took action, easily slaying the mutated creatures that attacked them, which made Justin Welan eager to flex his muscles.
Justin Welans body was then covered in the light of Mysterious Martial Thick Earth, which, together with his heavy shield, emitted a heavy, mountainous atmosphere.
Kill!
In a battle cry, Justin Welan, like an armored Mysterious Martial beast, charged toward the Mutated Black Bear rushing down from the mountains. In the blink of an eye, both collided.
Boom! Amidst the violent impact, the earthen light surged, dirt exploded under Justin Welans feet, and the ground shook. But his seemingly much smaller figure remained unfazed.
In contrast, the bear that collided with him let out a scream, with over a dozen bloody holes in its side from the spikes on the heavy shield, and it was knocked more than ten meters away by the terrifying counterforce.
Half-covered in blood, the black bear rolled a few times upon landing, struggled a little, and then stopped moving.
This was the power of the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Formula not only was its defense formidable, but it also had a certain degree of counterforce at the First Layer.
Now that Justin Welan had broken through the Third Realm, the counterforce of his heavy shield was even more powerful, killing the black bear with the addition of his own charging power.
Of course, the black bear appeared so vulnerable only because it was a Level 1 Mutated Beast.
Marcus Lee shouted, Justin Welan, stop showing off! Its just a Level 1 Mutated Beast. Hurry up and lets go.
Damn it! Justin Welan flipped him the middle finger, couldnt he show off just a little longer?

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 98: Berserk Demon Ape, Sword Armor Dragon Elephant Beast (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Third Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 98: Berserk Demon Ape, Sword Armor Dragon Elephant Beast (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Third Update)
Translator: 549690339
According to the map provided by the mercenaries and compared with the mobile satellite map, the Iron-Armed Black Ape was about 150 kilometers away from their entry point into the mountain.
During the journey, they had to cross nine peaks, two small rivers, and pass through the territories of three dangerous Unique Beasts.bender
Of course, this danger was for the mercenaries. In the eyes of Jack Clark and the others, these were just one Level 3 and two Level 2 Mutated Beasts.
The Level 3 Mutated Beast was a 13-meter long Glasses King Snake, known for its speed, strength and venomous fangs. Its scales were strong enough to withstand bullets from the Snake Scale Rifle.
At that time, two of the mercenaries were devoured by this Glasses King Snake. They had to throw more than a dozen high-explosive grenades to escape pursuit.
The other two Level 2 Variant Beasts were a giant crocodile that inhabited the river beach and a 9-meter long Spike Wolf.
Shall we kill it?
At sunset, in the forest on the hillside, Jack Clark and the others looked ahead where a black python over 10 meters long was coiled around a tree trunk.
Its flattened neck was a meter wide, giving its hideous snake head a more oppressive appearance.
At this time, the King Python slightly raised its head, its black pupils looking coldly in the direction of Jack Clark and the others. It had obviously noticed them from more than 10 meters away.
As a snake species, its senses were not limited to its eyes but also its sense of smell and heat perception.
However, as a Level 3 Mutated Beast, Jack Clark and the others did not take it seriously. They were now discussing whether to kill it or bypass it and return later.
After all, a Level 3 Mutated Beast was worth several hundred thousand dollars and would yield 20 contribution points if handed over to the official, which was much simpler than killing ten Second-layer Blood Servants.
Howard Lee said in a deep voice, I suggest bypassing this Glasses King Snake and coming back to kill it later. Otherwise, carrying its corpse will be too troublesome; itd be a waste if we have to leave it.
Jack Clark nodded, In that case, I suggest also bypassing the other two Mutated Beasts.
Alright. Justin Welan and Marcus Lee had no objections.
Ill lead it away.
As Jack Clark said this, he dashed out of the forest and appeared more than 10 meters away in the open space. Picking up a human head-sized stone from the ground.
Bang! With terrifying power, the stone flew out like a cannonball, hitting the Glasses King Snake accurately on the head.
The enormous force turned the stone into powder and the resulting kinetic energy sent the snakes head flying.
Hiss!
The Glasses King Snake was immediately enraged by Jack Clark. It let out a cold hiss and its body slid down the tree in an instant, moving like a black line.
The King Pythons thick body effortlessly moved through the grass and shrubs, forming a snake path, its speed as fast as the wind, quickly crossing dozens of meters.
The Glasses King Snake had a reputation for being swift, and after mutation, its speed was even more astonishing.
But Jack Clark was even faster, creating a huge explosion of air and disappearing from the spot.
So fast. Seeing Jack Clark and the python, who had vanished in the blink of an eye, the other three were slightly startled.
It was strange that Jack Clark, who cultivates strength-based cultivation methods, was so fast, it made them puzzled.
Actually, since coming to the Koroya Trials, many people noticed that Jacks agility and speed are unusual. He did not seem like a cultivator who mainly focused on strength.
But no one asked more about this, including Justin Welan.
After all, everyone had their secrets. For example, Howard Lee, everyone knew that his goal in organizing the group was most likely the Essence Blood of the Golden-Backed Violent Ape.
Otherwise, why would they hunt the more dangerous ape group instead of hunting other Mutated Beasts?
Quickly getting rid of the Glasses King Snake, Jack Clark caught up with the others. The foursome ran another 20 kilometers, and when they crossed the territory of the giant crocodile, suddenly stopped.
There was no choice, it was night time.
At this time, they were still about 40 kilometers away from the mountain where the Iron-Armed Black Ape was.
In the afternoon, the four of them had run more than 110 kilometers in six hours. Their average speed was around 20 kilometers per hour, which was obviously slow for their strength.
But there was no choice, it was difficult to navigate the mountain forest, and both Justin Welan and Howard Lee were heavily burdened.
The four quickly set up a tent under a cliff where the ground was made of stones, which was relatively safer. After agreeing to take turns keeping watch every three hours, they all rested.
In the tent, Jack Clark sat cross-legged, holding a nearly depleted Blue Crystal for cultivation.
At the same time, he divided his focus, sinking his consciousness into the Sword Armor Beast.
Due to the time difference, it was still daytime there, and sunlight passed through the sea surface to provide light for the deep water.
In the coral reef more than 30 meters below the water, a black, hideous, and five-meter-long Unique Beast opened its eyes, and its huge body swam out.
After five days of devouring a large number of Mutated Fish, the Sword Armor Beasts growth was several times faster than in its Heavy Armored Beast form, making it more ferocious.
During these days, the lowest amount of accumulated evolution value per day was around 20 points, and on some days, it reached 30 or 40 points.
The reason was that the oceans mutated organisms provided more energy for the Sword Armor Beast, causing it to grow faster and accumulate more evolution energy.
Under the influence of the synchronicity with its Avatar, Jack Clarks strength also steadily increased, and his physique constantly improved.
In fact, Jack Clark had considered the issue of synchronization. Since the growth of the Avatar could affect him, could he also influence the Avatar in return?
Of course, this influence wasnt related to physique, as his speed in cultivating True Martial Refinement simply couldnt compete with the Avatars growth.
He wondered if the Sword Armor Beast could also cultivate?
As a Mutated Beast, it inherently had a high affinity with Extraordinary energies. Otherwise, it would not be able to absorb energy to mutate..

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 98: Berserk Demon Ape, Sword Armor Dragon Elephant Beast (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Third Update)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 98: Berserk Demon Ape, Sword Armor Dragon Elephant Beast (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Third Update)_2
Translator: 549690339
For example, at this moment, the Sword Armor Beast could sense the rich energy contained in the surrounding seawater, but it didnt know how to absorb, refine, and store it.
Was this issue due to the fact that the Avatar wasnt originally a Mutated Beast, but evolved from an ordinary Six-legged Salamander?
As a result, although it had devoured and accumulated abundant energy in its flesh and blood, it could not grow stronger by slowly absorbing Heavenly Energy like other Mutated Creatures.
This issue might be resolved with its fourth evolution, in which it would acquire a transcendent talent to absorb energy.
As the Sword Armor Beast pondered, a potential prey appeared on the seabed within its sight.
It was a 4-meter long red crab with huge 8-meter-wide claws, which were holding on to and devouring a 3-meter-long grey shark.
Glug, glug!!
The Sword Armor Beast swam over, bubbles spewing from its nostrils. Its fierce appearance instantly alarmed the mutated crab, which fixed its two large eyes on the beast.
Gurgle! The crabs mouth emitted a warning sound.
Ignoring the warning, the menacing Sword Armor Beast continued to approach. Seeing this, the mutated crab released the half-eaten shark and slightly turned sideways, aiming its claws towards the beast.
As the Sword Armor Beast drew nearer, the tense atmosphere between them intensified, reaching a critical point.
When the distance between them was only about 5 meters, the mutated crab suddenly sprung into action with its six claws, its tremendous body rapidly lunging towards the Sword Armor Beast, claws wide open.bender
Bang!
In an instant, as the mutated crabs claw snapped shut, a transparent circle of air exploded in all directions, demonstrating the terrifying power of its strike.
However, the Sword Battle Beast had dodged the attack.
The moment the crab lunged, the Sword Armor Beast flashed through the water like a shadow, appearing behind mutated crab with even greater speed.
Raising its heavy hindquarters, the Sword Armor Beast lifted its claws high, a ferocious and violent aura burst from its body, while its forelimb muscles bulged and claws transformed into palms.
Dragon Elephant Power, Third Layers Battle SkillAngry elephants trampling the sky.
Boom!
The instant the Sword Armor Beasts double claws struck the mutated crabs back, the surrounding seawater exploded, creating white shockwaves that spread more than ten meters away.
Under the terrifying strength, the crabs tough, several centimeter-thick alloy-like back cracked and shattered. With one hit, its entire body broke apart and exploded.
For a moment, a ten-meter radius around the scene was shrouded in tumbling mud, mixed with blue blood and crab roe.
A few minutes later, the Sword Armor Beast looked at the scattered crab claws and the few remaining edible pieces of crab meat, feeling a bit regretful that it didnt hold back its strength.
Crunch!
With one bite, the Sword Armor Beast bit through the huge crab claw. A delighted look appeared in its eyes as it chewed the delicious crab meat.
It was because its approach was correct.
Although the True Strength cultivated by the True Martial Arts couldnt be synchronized with the Avatar, some of the combat techniques and explosive power skills were universal.
Just now, the strike unleashed the Sword Armor Beasts terrifying talent for hundred-fold power, and the force was solidified as a substance.
Although it couldnt multiply the force several times due to the absence of the Dragon Elephant True Strength, the more focused and concentrated power was clearly more destructive.
If it were before, its claws would have only broken the mutated crabs shell, rather than shattering the shell and releasing a shockwave as it did now.
In this situation, even if the Sword Armor Beast couldnt cultivate True Strength, its ability to use some of the True Martial battle techniques had dramatically increased its power.
Realizing this, the Sword Armor Beast was overjoyed. After cheerfully devouring the remaining crab meat, it disappeared into the depths of the ocean with a flick of its tail.
Under the dark night sky, after being on duty for three hours, Justin Welan came to Jack Clarks tent and called out, Jack, its your turn.ln the tent, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, a cold and fierce light flashing deep in his pupils before returning to his usual gentleness.
Alright, you can go rest now.
With that, Jack Clark opened the tent and walked out.
The deep mountain old forest at night was very dangerous, and even the four of them did not dare to be careless, including Jack Clark.
Keeping watch, he stood guard with his hands behind his back on a large stone, his body covered in black-red armor to prevent being ambushed by poisonous insects, and his Hearts Eye Perception was at its maximum.
Howl!
Roar!
Chirp!
Various screams and roars continuously came from the distance, where danger lurked. Vaguely, a pair of cruel eyes in the forest tens of meters away were looking in their direction.
Jack, who sensed the malice, slightly turned his head to look at it, his gaze sharp and cold.
However, it was too dark, and even Jacks physique vision could not be the same as during the daytime. He could only see a blurry silhouette of a cheetah-like creature.
This Mutated Beast, with its tail, was about six meters long and was standing on a tree trunk more than ten meters high, with most of its body hidden by leaves.
It seemed to sense that Jack was not easy to provoke, and eventually, the Mutated Beast chose to leave. Jack did not bother chasing after it to kill it.
A Level 1 Mutated Beast, killing it would only yield two or three contribution points. The main thing was that it was not easy to carry.
After a night, the next day, the four of them simply had breakfast, tidied up a little, and continued on their journey, climbing over mountains and ridges.
After killing more than a dozen ordinary mutated creatures which were not afraid of dying, they finally arrived at the mountain forest where the iron-armed black apes dwelled.
The trees here were between 30 and 50 meters high, with dense foliage and arm-thick vines hanging down between the branches. On them, black chimpanzees, three meters high, climbed and played.
Among these black apes, six giant apes, five meters tall, stood out. Their thick arms were even thicker than humans, and their dark skin had a metallic luster.
According to the information introduction, these iron-armed black apes had coarse hair and thick skin. Ordinary Level 1 black apes could ignore ordinary bullets, and their speed was agile.
Meanwhile, Level 2 iron-armed black apes were even stronger. Rifle and submachine gun bullets would feel like itching to them, and their strength was terrifying.
Also, these Mutated Beasts, like humans, would use weapons. In battle, they would carry tree trunks to sweep or throw stones weighing more than a hundred kilograms like cannonballs, which made them very dangerous.
As for the golden-backed violent ape, no specific information was available.
Justin Welan, carrying a heavy shield, asked excitedly, Shall we just start?
Marcus Lee frowned, I havent seen the golden-backed violent ape. What if its hiding and ambushes us?
Howard Lee said solemnly, Its simple. Well take action to lure those iron-armed black apes down. After killing more than a dozen of them, the golden-backed violent ape will definitely appear.
At that time, Justin and 1 will confront the golden-backed violent ape, while Jack and Marcus will quickly kill the iron-armed black apes that can be killed to avoid being disturbed during the battle.
Finally, well work together to take down the golden-backed violent ape.
Of course, if the golden-backed violent ape isnt here, its even better. Well kill all these Level 1 and Level 2 iron-armed black apes first, and then itll be much easier to deal with the violent ape.
Jack Clark nodded, Sounds good.
Of course, this proposal could hardly be called a plan; it was just a straightforward attack.
Although there were many mutated beasts, most of them were Level 1 with only a few Level 2, and they were no match for the four of them at this point.
The only thing worth paying attention to was the golden-backed violent ape..

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 99: Unparalleled Slaughter, Ancient
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 99: Unparalleled Slaughter, Ancient
Ferocious Beasts (For the Warm Sun League Master’s additional update, the 4th update)
Translator: 549690339
Gazing at more than twenty iron-armed black apes perched on tree branches, Marcus Lee’s eyes revealed a thirst for blood as he said solemnly, “Let’s go.”
“Let’s.”
With a low shout, the four stomped their way to the clearing outside the forest, instantly attracting the attention of the iron-armed black apes.
One of the Level 2 black apes let out a ferocious howl, and instantly the tree vines swayed as the black apes gathered at the edge of the forest, standing on branches and screeching.
As the rulers of several forests in the vicinity, the black ape troop consumed a large amount of food daily, eating both fruit and meat, so they valued their territory highly.
To them, all outsiders entering their territory were invaders. Kill and devour them to deter other dangerous creatures.
However, unconcerned by their warning, Jack Clark and his companions continued to advance slowly.
Seeing this, the Level 2 black ape let out another long howl, and more than ten iron-armed black apes, each over 3 meters tall, jumped down from the treetops and charged towards the group with ferocious expressions.
In the simple-minded creatures’ eyes, despite the dangerous aura exuding from the four humans, their small size made them easy targets. More than ten ordinary members should be enough to crush them to a pulp.
“I’ll take care of it.”
As he watched the black apes charge, Justin Welan was enveloped in heavy earthy true strength, which also covered the heavy shield he held.
Bang! The ground trembled, as Justin Welan rushed forward with the heavy shield like a Mysterious Martial turtle. Every step he took made the ground shake slightly, and his momentum was astonishing.
In the blink of an eye, he collided with an iron-armed black ape over 3 meters tall.
Bang! The air exploded with force.
Under Justin’s unyielding defense, the black ape’s arms smashed onto the heavy shield without shaking him at all. Instead, both of the ape’s arms were broken by the spiked shield, and it spat out blood and flew backward.
Successful in killing a Furious Ape with just a charge, Justin Welan smirked, “Hehe, just because I specialize in defense doesn’t mean 1 can’t attack.”
Ao Ao Ao!! The surrounding three black apes howled in panic and anger. Their expressions became even more ferocious, as their sturdy and hard arms erupted with several tons of force, some even lifting up gigantic boulders.
They wanted to crush this creature that had killed their companion into a pulp.
Boom!
A tangible ripple of impact exploded, and as Justin held the heavy shield above his head, the ground within a few meters of him rolled like a wave while his figure remained immovable.
Earthy true strength circulated around him, transferring all the impact and gravity to the ground beneath him.
“Get the hell out of here.” With a low growl, Justin’s arms burst with power, and with a deafening bang, he sent the three iron-armed black apes that had overwhelmed him flying.
“Hahaha… Justin, you’re still more suited as a meat shield. Dealing with these guys is up to us.”
Laughing loudly, Howard Lee had blue true strength erupting from him. With ferocious momentum, he leaped high from behind Justin, smashing through the air with a heavy hammer weighing hundreds of kilograms.
Bang!
Under the terrifying force of the heavy hammer, the black ape that tried to block with its iron arms had its flesh and blood exploded and bones shattered, with the head blasted to pieces by the overbearing hammer.
Ao Ao!!
Such a terrible death scene enraged the surrounding iron-armed black apes even more. They rushed towards the two like a group of mini-giants, wanting to tear them to shreds.
But… “Get the hell out of my way!”
With a fierce shout, Howard Lee swung his heavy hammer, sweeping away the four approaching Furious Apes. The places where the heavy hammer connected either shattered bones or sent flesh and blood flying.
So-called iron arms capable of withstanding rifle bullets were nothing in front of absolute strength.
Bang! Another iron-armed black ape had its head smashed by Howard Lee, with flesh and blood flying everywhere. Hot blood spurted several meters high, drenching him completely in red, while his murderous aura grew even more intense.
Seeing their companions being killed within a few breaths and several others seriously injured, the remaining iron-armed black apes on the treetops became agitated and roared fiercely as they charged down.
Including the six Level Two Variant Beasts over 5 meters tall that jumped down from the trees, their gigantic bodies shook the ground as they landed.
Actually, ape-like creatures fear pain and death the most. Under normal conditions, witnessing the ferocity of their enemies and the deaths of one of their kind would scare them away, not daring to approach.
But perhaps due to their mutation, this group of iron-armed black apes was even more ferocious and fierce, still unafraid at this point.
Of course, it was also possible that the presence of the gigantic Level 2 black apes made the iron-armed black apes believe they still had a chance of victory.
That’s fine too.
As the mutated black apes charged down with fierce momentum, Jack Clark and Howard Lee stopped watching the show, and their violent, overbearing aura suddenly erupted.
Seeing the brawny Howard Lee covered in red true strength and wielding a four meters long iron column, a black ape 6 meters tall roared, raised its column-like arms and smashed a massive boulder weighing over a thousand kilograms at him.
Not only was this Ape’s strength powerful, but it also knew how to use weapons. This attack could crush an armored car in its path.
Boom! Covered in red true strength, Howard swung the iron column like a thick thigh, creating a white wave in the air as it struck the boulder.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force, the boulder in the Ape’s hands exploded into countless shards, scattering everywhere. The unparalleled iron pillar did not lose its momentum as it swept up a raging wind and smashed into the black ape’s body.
Bang!
Under this strike, the black ape’s head and upper body instantly exploded into numerous pieces of flesh, spreading across a range of more than ten meters, even staining Howard’s armor red.
At this moment, with Howard holding a four-meter iron column, blood-red armor drenched in blood, and framed by long curved horns, he resembled a ferocious demon.
The terrifying aura temporarily frightened the other iron-armed black apes, who did not dare to approach.If Marcus Lee was crazy, Jack Clark was downright furious.
Clad in black-red armor and wielding a long knife, he burst forth at an astonishing speed, shattering the air and stirring up torrents of white waves as he appeared before a Level 2 Mutated Black Ape.
Because he was moving too fast, the black ape had no time to react, only comprehending the sight of the black blade tearing through the sky and dominating its entire field of vision.
Splat! The sharp blade sliced through everything, instantly bisecting the iron-armed black ape from top to bottom.
At this moment, Jack stomped the ground, the half-meter radius underfoot exploding, his figure rocketed forward with a trail of white waves and appeared before a Level 1 black ape a dozen meters away.
Seeing the terrifying figure that appeared in front of it in an instant, the 3-meter-tall black ape let out a frightened howl, barely raising its arms before it was also sliced in half by the black blade.
After killing it, the combat knife didn’t lose momentum and slammed into the ground.
Boom! In an instant, violent Sword Qi erupted, shattering the ground within several meters under the overbearing power of the Dragon Elephant art, sending countless shards of rocks and dirt flying.
At this moment, the bisected Level 1 black ape’s body exploded, countless blood mixed with organs splattered everywhere, including the distant Level 2 black ape that also exploded only now.
Amidst the blood-filled sky, Jack’s figure was like lightning, moving like teleportation with afterimages as he weaved through the crowd of shocked and furious iron-armed black apes, wreaking havoc with his blade.
With a speed exceeding 100 meters per second, the unparalleled black blade covered in Sword Qi met no equal at that moment, including the several Level 2 Mutated Black Apes.
Anywhere it went, the blade made an unstoppable path of bi-section.
Just a few breaths, and Jack had already killed more than a dozen black apes. Broken corpses split into two lay on the ground, dyeing the ground red with blood and emanating a thick scent of blood.
At this moment, only then did Marcus Lee manage to kill a few, while Howard Lee had only just managed to retrieve the iron pillar from the corpse of the second Level 2 black ape.
As for Justin Welan, though his defense was unparalleled while carrying the heavy shield, he lagged in terms of killing speed. The whole person was dumbfounded at the sight of the corpses steaming from the heat.
At this moment, not only the three of them, but also the two remaining Level 1 black apes were completely on edge, their ferocious faces showing human-like fear upon realizing the situation.
Wu wu! These several iron-armed black apes let out fearful howls from their mouths, then turned around and frantically rushed towards the forest behind them.
That monster was too terrifying, too terrifying, only the king could handle it.
Watching the two fleeing iron-armed black apes, Jack’s figure suddenly halted, with blood dripping from the long knife in his hand, his gaze was cold, but he did not continue to pursue.
Because, he needed those black apes to lure out the golden-backed violent ape.
Only by now did Justin Welan swallow and look at the blood-stained Jack in the distance, “Man… Jack, how did you become so fierce!”
Marcus Lee also looked at Jack with a stunned expression. He couldn’t understand how all of them had just broken through the Third Layer Heaven, why was Jack so abnormal?
Especially since he had been practicing low-level martial skills like Dragon Elephant Art.
It was known that after breaking through the Third Layer Heaven, because of his advanced skill cultivation, Marcus Lee’s power burst and True Strength were stronger than an average person.
Combined with the Chaos Heavy Hammer Cultivation Method, even at the early stage, his combat power was comparable to the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase.
But Jack had been able to crush him since the First Layer Heaven, and was even more ferocious in the Second Layer Heaven. He didn’t expect that after the Third Layer Heaven, he would simply be on a whole other level compared to them.
On the other hand, Howard Lee only looked at knife-wielding Jack with a slightly solemn expression, not too surprised at his terrifying combat power.
Throughout the entire South Sky Martial Height First Grade, other than Jane Aiken, he only couldn’t see through the students he had come into contact with during the trial period.
That’s why he specifically invited Jack this time, who didn’t disappoint him and showed combat power that completely surpassed the Third Layer Heaven.
At this time, Jack shook his wrist, shaking off the blood on the knife and said with a shake of his head: “It’s not that I’m too strong, but that these Mutated Beasts are too weak.”
“Although these Level 1 and Level 2 Mutated Beasts have decent strength, defense, and agility, it also means they are somewhat mediocre in all aspects.
ii
“Moreover, with my level suppression, the Sword Qi-covered blade can easily tear through their bodies, and my strength is even greater than theirs.”
ii
In this situation, it’s only natural that they can only be easily sliced and killed by me, who is faster and stronger, with no match.”
Although Jack’s analysis made sense, as the defensive capabilities of these Mutated Black Apes was not as strong as that of the Mutated Black Bulls. However, both Justin Welan and Marcus Lee knew that it wasn’t for this reason.
But for Jack’s humble personality, Justin Welan had already gotten used to it.
Roar! At this moment, a roar that shook the mountain forest erupted in the distance. The sound contained a terrifying aura, like that of the king of ten thousand beasts.
Immediately after that, the trees on the mountainside shook madly, countless birds soared into the sky in terror, as if an enormous creature was charging over.
“It’s coming.”
The four of them became solemn, knowing that their target, the golden-backed violent ape, had appeared.
With its tribe nearly wiped out, the golden-backed violent ape would definitely go berserk, and once it appeared, it would launch a thunderous assault.
From the roar to the commotion, it only took a minute for the terrifying Mutated Beast to traverse several kilometers, charging down from the mountainside, crashing through countless trees along the way.
Boom! A golden-black figure leaped high into the sky, tens of meters above the ground, then slammed down from the sky, instantly breaking the earth below and stirring up a whirlwind of smoke and dust.
In the smoke and dust, a towering eight-meter-tall ape, its muscles exploding, devoid of hair, and covered in black scales, stood in the crater.
What was most striking was its back, where a row of golden scales extended from its head to its tail, radiating an unbreakable will.
This was the reason it was called the golden-backed violent ape.
But at this moment, the violent ape’s expression was ferocious and terrifying, its blood-red eyes fixed intently on Jack and the other three, its body emanating an aura of extreme violence and ferocity.
Under this violent aura, even the four of them became more solemn.
Especially the slightly weaker Marcus Lee, who even swallowed nervously.
This anxiety came from the instincts of living beings, as if they were not facing a violent ape, but a terrifying creature from ancient times..

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 100: Pushing with Strength, I am Invincible (For Alliance Leader Warm Sun, the fifth update today)
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 100: Pushing with Strength, I am Invincible (For Alliance Leader Warm Sun, the fifth update today)
Translator: 549690339
Looking at the many Iron-Armed Black Ape corpses on the ground, the furious Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King beat its chest, a muffled thunderous sound reverberating, its aura growing increasingly brutal and ruthless.
Roar! A terrifying power aura circulated around the Berserk Ape King’s body, like substantial black light, and with a sudden ‘boom’, it vanished from its original spot.
“Watch me harness the power of Mysterious Martial Moving Mountains.”
Justin Welan’s internal True Strength exploded, an overwhelmingly mountain-like aura erupted, and his body was covered by an earth-colored light. He shouldered the heavy shield before everyone.
Just as he raised his shield, the vanished Golden-Backed Ape King appeared before him, its gigantic black fist dominated his field of vision and heavily strike downwards.
Under the dreadful power aura, the air beneath the black fist was squeezed into a substance-like transparency.
Boom!
The gigantic fist almost drowned Justin’s heavy shield. In an instant, the earthy True Strength around Justin trembled, and the ground within a radius of two yards centered around him shattered.
The violent shockwave kicked up dust and forced Jack Clark and his team to retreat.
“I’ve said before … My defense is invincible.”
The fresh dirt in the deep pit over a meter deep tossed and turned, Justin stubbornly shouldered the heavy shield, his face glowing red due to the trembling True Strength. Yet, his tone was unabashedly reckless.
Roar!
The Golden-Backed Ape King roared ferociously, infuriated that its punch didn’t smash this bug.
A more terrifying power aura exploded in an instance from the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, which felt provoked. Ignoring Jack Clark and the others behind him, its body muscles inflated.
Boom! Boom!
Two gigantic black fists blasted everything. They fiercely hammered with horrifying speed onto the diameter of 1.5 meters, 2 meters long “small” shield.
Boom! Above the heavy shield, tangible yellow-white air shockwaves layered up and exploded.
Under the terrifying power, the ground within a radius of ten meters quaked, cracked, shattered. Around Justin, numerous clumps of earth were blasted apart.
It gave off a terrifying illusion of the earth sinking in.
Even Justin Welan, who had absorbed the Giant Beast Essence Blood and Mysterious Yellow Crystal’s heavy earth aura to enhance his defense capabilities, couldn’t withstand this blow.
In the billowing smoke and dust, Justin’s figure sunk. He knelt on one knee. His full-body battle armor and bones creaked. His yellow True Strength vibrated crazily, appearing dim and unclear.
Having been hammered almost underground by a punch, his face was flushed. He desperately propped himself up, shouting, “Damn it, aren’t you guys going to act?”
“Hey! Didn’t you tell us to leave it to you?”
Though they said that, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King was too fast. Including Jack Clark, no one expected its power to be so horrifying.
Just a series of two punches almost blasted Justin to pieces.
You could see Marcus Lee’s eyes sharpen, his whole body ‘bam!’ shouldered the heavy hammer and charged forward. His heavy hammer, tearing through the air with tremendous force, fiercely smashed towards the Golden-Backed Ape King’s… kneecap.
There was no other way, in comparison to the eight meters tall Golden-Backed Ape King, they who were less than two meters tall, were mere midgets. Even wielding heavy weapons, they couldn’t reach it.
Boom! The air exploded into a circle of white shockwaves.
You could see Marcus Lee getting blasted away with just a casual punch from the Golden-Backed Ape King. His entire body, like a cannonball, instantaneously flew over a hundred meters and ‘bam!’ crashed into a huge tree with a diameter of two meters.
Row! The trunk shattered, numerous scattered fragments, the whole tree shivered crazy, shedding leaves.
Marcus Lee, embedded in the trunk, lost all strength in his body, unable to get up for the time being. The robust and enforced armor on his chest deformed and shattered under the terrifying force.
His entire body’s aura appeared extremely weak.
Roar!
The Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, who had blasted away a fly, roared with murderous fury. A frightening aura enveloped its body, preparing to smash the tiny insect in front of him that couldn’t hold on any longer into a meat paste with its fist.
At this moment, Howard Lee drew a deep breath. A formidable lung capacity almost sucked up all the air in front of him. An extremely overbearing and hot Blood Qi exploded from his body.
Boom! The ground exploded. Howard Lee’s whole body was circulated by red True Strength, like the Great Strength Bull Demon, he leaped up several meters.
In his hand, the four-meter-long Iron Pillar emitted a red glow. As if a collapsing heavenly pillar, the pole swung down at Carney Turner, bringing a terrifying aura with it.
Under this terrifying power, a transparent shockwave appeared below the Iron Pillar as the air was squeezed out. It swept up a violent wind wave and smashed heavily onto the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape’s raised arms.
Boom!
Under the pure terrifying power explosion, a ring of black and red shockwave exploded between the fists and the Iron Pillar. The Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King’s figure involuntarily sunk, his foot sinking a meter into the ground.
The power contained in Howard Lee’s strike was unimaginable.
Roar!
The furious Golden-Backed Ape King roared. Suddenly, he shook his arms and sent Howard Lee — man and pillar — flying dozens of meters away. After landing, he retreated several steps before stopping.
Just as Howard Lee’s expression changed, his body’s aura exploded even more fiercely, and he lifted the Iron Pillar to brutally smash at the front.
Boom!
The Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King appeared instantly. Its eyes fierce, its body’s aura violent, its giant fist savagely smashed onto the Iron Pillar; under its dreadful power, the alloyed Iron Pillar started deforming.
With just a single punch, Howard Lee was blasted back over a dozen meters by an even more overbearing force, his feet plowing two deep furrows into the ground; it was terrifying and appalling.
Just as the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape was about to strike again and kill the enemy, who posed a slight threat to it, a shrill wind noise exploded in its ear.
It was the scream emitted by the air after being torn apart. The Berserk Ape King only felt a sharp chill rapidly attacking from behind.
Roar!
Not having enough time to turn around, it let out a furious roar. Suddenly, it straightened up its body. Its upper body muscles swelled as its entire body’s robust scales tightened, especially the golden scales on its back, which protruded prominently..

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 100: Pushing with Strength, I am Invincible (For Alliance Leader Warm Sun, the fifth update today)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 100: Pushing with Strength, I am Invincible (For Alliance Leader Warm Sun, the fifth update today)_2
Translator: 549690339
Clang!
The battle knife covered in black Sword Qi tore through the air, and the strike originally aimed at the neck had hit the back of the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King due to it suddenly standing up straight.
At the instant when the Sword Qi hit the golden scales, it was dispersed by an invisible force.
Then, the sharp blade hit the scales, causing a large number of sparks and shattered more than ten black scales, leaving a two-meter-long mark.
Boom! As Jack Clark paused in mid-air, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King violently swung its arm, and the strong right arm covered in black scales swept over like a raging wind.
Jack Clark, unable to dodge in mid-air, immediately hardened his gaze as his body was covered in black real power, with his arms crossed in front of him.
As for why he didnt use the knife, of course, he was afraid that the combat knife would be broken, and his attack methods would be limited as a result.
Boom! Jack Clark in mid-air was like a fly, directly swept hundreds of meters away by the Golden-Backed Violent Ape and smashed against a big tree near Marcus Lee.
The one-meter-thick trunk was broken directly by Jack Clark, and as the tree crown collapsed and the branches flew, he landed on his feet.
As he suppressed the boiling Qi Blood in his body, Jack Clark stepped out of the forest under Marcus Lees surprised gaze, his sharp and fierce aura even stronger than before.
Weakly seated on the ground, Marcus Lee was somewhat stunned: Jack Jack Clark, youre all right?
Jack Clark turned around and looked at him strangely: Im fine.
Although the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape Kings sweep was powerful, Jack Clarks physique was originally terrifying, coupled with the solid Enhanced +10 armor defense.
Therefore, the hit only caused his Qi Blood to be slightly blocked, and just by circulating True Strength for a moment, he was back to normal.
Of course, this also had to do with not being directly hit by the Furious Apes fist. Otherwise, wouldnt he have taken a small injury?
But Marcus Lee didnt know what to say for a moment.
After being swept away by the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape, his whole body was now heavy with True Strength, his chest stuffy, and at least one rib was broken, but Jack Clark was fine?
Jack Clark shook his head: Mr. Lee, youre still too weak. Remember to work hard on your cultivation when you go back. Leave the upcoming battles to us.
With that, Jack Clark strode forward, forming a triangle with Howard Lee and Justin Welan to confront the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King.
Noticing that these insects posed a certain threat to it, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King suddenly fell silent, coldly glaring at the three with its bloody eyes.
It seemed to be thinking.
At this moment, Jack Clark said solemnly: Howard, you and Mr. Willard engage the Ape King from the front, and Ill try to find a way to cripple one of its legs first.
Watch out for its golden back. Those golden scales seem to have a strange power that not only makes its entire bodys scales more solid but also disperses our real power.
Immediately, the two understood his intentions; he was preparing to use the same tactic against the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King that worked against the Mutated Black Bull.
Due to its size, this Golden-Backed Berserk Ape had terrifying strength, horrifying defense, and frightening speed. Only Jack Clark could keep up with it.
In the brief exchange just now, its strength was even stronger than they had estimated, approaching the Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage.
Boom! The air exploded at that moment, and the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King instantly disappeared from its original position, appearing behind Justin Welan as if through teleportation.
Obviously, the intelligent Ape King had identified Justin Welan as the weakest and planned to kill him first, but
In an instant, the piercing howl behind the Golden-Backed Ape King rang out again, and the sharp aura attacked once more. It was Jack Clark who had also burst through the air and caught up with its speed.
Faced with the sharp blade that could still shatter its scales even after the Transcendent power was dispersed, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King couldnt help but care and hurriedly turned around and slammed both arms down.
Boom! In an instant, the ground within a ten-meter radius cracked, and countless rocks and dirt soared into the air. The shockwave, mixed with the smoke and dust, rushed out more than ten meters away .The raging wind blew, causing grass and trees to scatter violently, with a startling momentum.
However, Jack Clarks slash was just a feint, and he dodged away at the moment the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King turned around.
With Jack Clarks distraction, Justin Welan and Howard Lee successfully regrouped.
Howard Lees muscles swelled with blood, making his battle armor creak and a furious aura erupted from him, like a Bull Demon wielding an iron column and ruthlessly sweeping everything away.
Bang! Even the Golden-Backed Ape King was forced to step back after being hit by the overbearing attack, instantly becoming even angrier, as if it was a small insect that had annoyed it.
Its massive arms bulged with black light, emitting a terrifying aura of strength. Bang!
Justin Welan managed to take the brunt of this terrible blow with his heavy shield, and in an instant, the ground beneath him exploded, and countless soil was sent flying by the furious apes terrifying power.
At this time, with no need to defend, Howard Lee once again leaped high from behind Welan, and the four-meter-long Iron Pillar swept through the air with a brutal force.
At the same time, sharp claps of thunder roared, and with a trailing white wave, Jack Clark appeared behind the golden-backed violent ape. The combat knife covered in black Sword Qi emitted a sharp and terrifying aura.
Facing attacks from both sides, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King quickly turned its massive body, its powerful arms sweeping horizontally to fend off both Howard Lee and Jack Clark, while displaying a surprising level of agility.
But
Bang! The frontal attack from the iron column struck the Furious Ape Kings left arm. Even it was forced to halt momentarily under the force of the berserk Bull Demon.
At this moment, Jack Clarks afterimage flickered and he dodged the powerful arm sweeping above him. His knifes lightning-fast slash struck the Furious Ape Kings thick left leg.bender
Squeak!
The sharp Sword Qi tore through the black light covering the Furious Ape Kings body, shattering its scales and struggling to cut into its muscles before evaporating into nothingness due to exhaustion.
But just at that moment, Jack Clark quickly retreated and pulled his knife to make a cross slash.
Spurt!
Hot blood sprayed out of a wound more than a meter long and about twenty centimeters deep, and the pain caused the Golden-Backed Furious Ape King to become even more enraged. It unleashed a terrifying force with its arms, furiously slamming down.
Bang!
Justin Welan, still holding his heavy shield, suddenly became the target of the apes fury.
Under the horrifying impact, Justin Welan spat out a mouthful of blood and was forced to kneel on one knee. The earth around him shattered violently within a ten-meter radius.
Upon seeing the furious Golden-Backed Wild Ape, Howard Lee let out a roar and the red True Strength enveloping his body thickened, making him even more berserk and resembling a giant as he charged forward with his iron column.
Bang, bang, bang!
As Howard Lee recklessly collided head-on with the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, Jack Clark transformed into a black afterimage, encircling the ape at a terrifying speed and occasionally slashing with his knife.
And every slash was aimed at the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape Kings injured left leg.
Although the Ape King dodged with agility, preventing Jack from striking the same spot, in just a short time, its left leg turned into a bloody mess.
Facing Jack Clark, who was almost as fast as itself, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King was both shocked and furious, being entangled by Howard Lee.
Roar, roar, roar! The savage roar shook the entire mountain forest..
