chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 101: Thick Earth Like a Mountain, Tearing Everything Apart with One Blade (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Sixth Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 101: Thick Earth Like a Mountain, Tearing Everything Apart with One Blade (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Sixth Update)
Translator: 549690339
With continuous injuries, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King became even more brutal and violent. Its muscles swelled, and its terrifying black power wrapped around its arms like hammers of destruction.
Each blow left a crater several meters wide on the ground.
While confronting it head-on, Howard Lees blood boiled with each internal impact, his arms blood vessels ruptured, and even his battle armor was shattered.
Under these circumstances, Howard Lees aura became even more insane.
His arm, wielding an iron column, was enveloped in blood-colored True Strength. Each strike created explosive circles of white shockwaves, terrifying and mad-like a demon.
Facing such a crazed Howard Lee, even the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape could not ignore the threat, and it dared not let the iron column infused with terrifying power land on its body or head.
Whenever the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King tried to attack this dangerous human with its full power, Justin Welan would run from the side to interfere.
Wielding a heavy shield, Justin Welans defense was formidable, barely holding up against the Golden-Backed Berserk Apes full-power blows, although it would exhaust him every time.
But every time Jack Clark and Howard Lee were distracted, he could catch his breath and recover.
So whenever Howard Lee was hit and rolled out, Justin Welan would use True Martial Mysterious Martial Moving Mountains to redirect the Golden-Backed Berserk Apes attacks onto his heavy shield.
This taunt-like technique enraged the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape, always losing its chance to deliver a decisive blow.
On top of that, it had to guard against the unparalleled blade-wielding insect.
Boom!
Howard Lee, holding the iron column, and the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape clashed with all their might once more. The bottom half of his body was forced into the ground by the terrifying power, as the surrounding soil swirled like a land dragons contour.
Under the impact of Howard Lees insane collision, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape couldnt help but retreat two steps and pause.
At that moment, the air behind it exploded, and Jack Clark appeared like a dark shadow on its left side, holding a straight blade with black Sword Qi engulfing it, cutting through everything.
After fighting for so long, Jack Clark had managed to leave more than a dozen deep wounds on the Apes left rear leg. However, only two of those wounds were at the same spot.
This raging ape seemed violent, yet cautious always wary of Jack Clark continuously attacking its wounds at the same location.
But this time, as the Ape paused, Jack Clark seized the opportunity, and the blades light left a trail of afterimage in the air as it instantly slashed at the largest wound on the leg.
Splash! The Sword Qi tore through the steel bar-like muscles, peeling layer by layer underneath until it finally slashed onto the Golden-Backed Berserk Apes thick leg bone, with the blade even digging in several centimeters deep.
But just then, Jack Clark felt a strong sense of danger, as the combat knife inside the wound suddenly tightened and clamped the straight blade.
At the same time, the seemingly off-balanced Ape King showed a ferocious grin, its massive body spinning abruptly, and its right arm muscles swelling.
Above, the black light circulated as the terrifying power gathered.bender
Boom! The huge, black fist exploded in midair, covering the sky and eclipsing the sun. Even before it landed, the raging wind and gravity made Jack Clark feel suffocated.
At this moment, an incredibly fierce light shone in the Ape Kings blood-red eyes, as if to say, Ive finally caught you, pesky insect.
But just as the Ape King showed a ferocious smile, behind the mask, Jack Clarks face showed no signs of panic.
You think youre the only one with great strength?
In the faint voice, Jacks left arm muscles inflated like a balloon, and a violent aura of strength erupted like an enraged elephant.
Instantly, the large and small fists collided, and time seemed to pause for a moment, followed by a thunderous roar.
Bang! A pale black shockwave exploded, sweeping up a raging wind.
Under the sheer, overbearing, and terrifying force, Jacks robust left arm bent slightly, and the battle armor on his fist emitted cracking sounds from the unbearable weight.
The ground beneath him shattered and exploded, creating a crater several meters wide, with his feet sinking over a meter into the dirt, leaving a two-meter wide punch mark around him.
Pure Power Explosion alone wasnt enough for Jack, whose strength attribute exceeded 300, to defeat the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King.
After all, the opponents sheer size was dozens of times larger than them.
However, the Ape King was also in pain due to its larger area coming into contact with Jacks concentrated force, causing a segment of its middle finger bone to shatter and the counteractive force to push it back.
Bang!
As it recoiled, Jack broke free from the dirt and shot up with both hands grabbing the knife handle while True Strength flowed into the long blade guided by a special path.
Light King Slash!
Countless tiny, sharp Sword Qi erupted from the blade held by the raging apes muscles, tearing and shattering the surrounding flesh like a storm before
Squeak Squeak Squeak!!
With a grating sound, Jack Clark, who had burst out at full strength, pulled the long knife, almost sawing through the Golden-Backed Berserk Apes leg bone, leaving just a bit of bone residue connecting it.
At this moment, Jack Clark fled immediately after drawing his blade.
Roar!
The pain of a broken leg bone drove the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape into madness, exploding with dazzling black light and wildly pounding its fists like mountain-crushing hammers onto Jack Clarks afterimages.
Boom! The ground shattered, countless pieces of dirt flying into the air, creating a sky filled with dust and smoke.
Roar Roar Roar!! The Golden-Backed Ape King with a severed left leg went berserk, destroying everything nearby. At this moment, Howard Lee and Justin Welan didnt dare approach and retreated continuously.
Dozens of meters away, Jack Clark held his slightly deformed combat knife, panting, looking as calm and indifferent as ever..

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 101: The Smashing Blade that Cuts the Earth as Massive as Mountain, (An additional chapter sponsored by warm sun guild leader, the sixth update) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 101: The Smashing Blade that Cuts the Earth as Massive as Mountain, (An additional chapter sponsored by warm sun guild leader, the sixth update) _2
Translator: 549690339
In the state of battle, Jack Clarks will fully entered the state of the Sword Armor Beast.bender
Cold, ruthless, mad.
Suddenly, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King that was wreaking havoc in the surrounding dozens of meters abruptly halted.
Its massive palms slammed into the ground, terrifying power burst from its intact right leg muscle as it leaped several dozen meters into the air with a bang.
Its trying to run!
Watching the Golden-Backed Ape King descending towards the mountain forest, Jack Clarks eyes sharpened, the dirt beneath him exploded, and he too leapt several dozen meters into the air.
Boom!
In mid-air, Jack Clark, like a cannonball, was struck directly by the palm of the golden-backed violent ape and harshly slammed into the forest hundreds of meters away, shattering several trees before coming to a halt.
Jacked Clark was already significantly weaker than the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape in sheer power; added to the constraints of his own weight and body size, he was directly sent flying without any leverage in the air.
Yet because of his strike as interference, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape in mid-air also halted its momentum due to the counterforce and fell to the ground with a thunderous crash.
At the moment Jack Clark made his move, Justin Welan rushed over carrying his heavy shield, yelling, We cant let it escape!
Not only can I take it, but I can also deal it. In his roar of fury, Justin Welans body emitted a yellow light, and as the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape landed, he leaped high into the air.
Mysterious Martial Thick Earth, suppress it for me! As Justin roared, he unleashed a force heavier than anything, as if a colossal piece of earth was falling from the sky.
Even though he was only about 1.8 meters tall and seemed insignificant compared to the 2-meter tall ape, the moment he landed on its chest, Justin seemed as heavy as a mountain. Under the tremendous yellow aura, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape was pinned down, its ferocious face revealing a horrified roar.
Howard Lee, of course, did not miss this opportunity.
Following close behind, he burst forth with all his strength, his body glowing red like a Bull Demon. His iron column hit the Golden-Backed Berserk Apes head with the force of a mountain avalanche.
Boom!
Even the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape couldnt withstand Howard Lees all-out attack. Large pieces of scale exploded, blood flowed from its fractured skull, its head buzzed and consciousness blurred.
Whoosh! A shadow in the sky flashed, and Jack Clark turned into a dark shadow descending from the sky. His 2-meter long slash blade, like a streak of light, pierced through the eye socket and the eye of the ape.
In the blink of an eye, it was completely buried in its brain.
At that moment, both Jack Clarks and Howard Lees faces changed drastically. They moved instinctively to evade.
Howard Lee even left his weapon, the iron column, to one side, and Jack Clark also released his grip on the sword handle. In the blink of an eye, he pulled Justin Welan back by the neck and retreated.
In the instant when Jack Clark grabbed his neck, Justin also reacted, discarding his heavy shield.
Roar roar roar!!
The Golden-Backed Ape King roared suddenly, wildly attacking everything around it. In a flash, the ground trembled, the fierce wind howled, and fragments of stone and dust were scattered over a range of several dozen meters.
Almost a minute later, the legless Golden-Backed Berserk Ape abruptly stiffened, its massive body collapsed with a loud bang, kicking up a cloud of dust.
Finally dead. Justin Welan collapsed, his tension drained. He lay on the ground taking deep breaths, a wry smile on his face.
Weve lost a lot this time. My hard-won Thick Earth spirit.
The all-out attack he had just launched was the result of absorbing the Thick Earth Spirit from the Mysterious Yellow Crystal.
He could instantly release the Thick Earth Spirit he had refined, combining it with his True Strength to form a weight heavy as a mountain to suppress his enemy.
However, this meant he would need to accumulate such a large amount of Thick Earth Spirit over at least a month again.
Moreover, the remaining Thick Earth Spirit inside that Mysterious Yellow Crystal could only allow him to perform this move one more time at best.
The good news was that his physique had already undergone a qualitative change during this period of cultivation with the Thick Earth Spirit. Otherwise, such losses could have made him weep.
Howard Lee took off his helmet, revealing his crude and fierce face, with blood still flowing from the corner of his mouth, staining his chin and neck red.
Even with his innate divine strength, he had suffered heavy injuries in the face-on clash with the terrifying Golden-Backed Ape King.
Contrarily, Jack Clark was in a much better condition. Apart from feeling some muscle soreness and loss of much of his true strength, he was relatively unscathed.
At that point, Marcus Lee, struggling to drag his hammer, walked over and grunted, Damn it, is this what a Level 3 Mutant Beast is like? Did you trick us, Howard Lee?
Of course not, Howard Lee glanced at him and stated firmly, It is indeed a Level 3 Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King. Its power is terrifying due to its king-level bloodline. Why would 1 need your help if it were weak?
Ugh Marcus Lee was speechless since Howard Lees words made sense.
Considering the terrifying power Marcus Lee had displayed in the battle, overpowering the third layer heaven, he alone would have being enough to defeat the ape, if it was weak.
At this point Jack Clark spoke up, Take a rest, both of you, use some medicine to heal yourselves. Ill go ahead and check out the situation.
Alright.
This time, all three of them anticipated the possibility of getting injured, so they all traded contribution points for Blood Jade Fruit, a healing resource.
It comes from the fruit of a special type of plant called blood vine. Consuming it replenishes ones Qi Blood, allowing quick recovery from external injuries. Even broken bones can be visibly reconnected in a short time, without affecting any movement.
Although its effects are excellent, it is very costly. As such, Jack Clark, who believed he wouldnt get injured, didnt trade for it.
In his perspective, even if he got minor injuries, it would not be worth using valuable contribution points to heal.
Given his present body constitution, his endurance and recovery rate are quite terrifying.
After three phases of avatar evolution, Jack Clark even tested by cutting his own finger once. The deep, bone-visible wound healed naturally in just one minute. Thats the advantage of a high physique attribute.
Upon reaching the gigantic corpse of the golden-backed berserk ape, Jack Clark leaped onto its huge head. Grasping the blade hilt, which was only about twenty centimeters long, he pulled hard.
With a pull, blood and white matter flowed out while Jack Clark moved towards the chest of the dead ape with the knife, took a deep breath, and stabbed down forcefully.
Even though the ape was dead, its defense was still formidable. Jack Clark managed to tear a wound of over one meter in its chest with some difficulty.
Ignoring the gushing blood, Jack Clark reached into the wound. He soon beamed with joy as he found a pigeon-egg-sized red crystal drenched in blood in his hand. It was unmistakably a level 3 life crystal.
High concentration of life energy detected in the crystal. Do you want to transform it into attribute points? Without choosing to do so at the transparent text appearing at the bottom of his eye, Jack Clark decided not to, considering Howard Lee and the others were still around.
After about half an hour of rest, the trio had largely recovered from their injuries. Howard Lee carried the giant corpse of the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape, which was heavier and larger than an elephant.
Jack Clark, Justin Welan, and Marcus Lee each carried the corpses of six Level 2 mutant beasts.
Each Level 2 Mutant Beast corpse could be traded to the officials for 6 to 7 contribution points, and sold for more than a hundred thousand. Therefore, they couldnt just leave the money behind.
As for the corpses of the Level One iron-armed black apes, although their hides were also valuable and could be sold for three to four hundred thousand collectively, they were simply too many to carry.
Jack Clark regretfully glanced back before leaving with the other three.
From a high altitude view, it looked as if four ants were moving objects several times bigger than themselves. It was a comical sight.
As the four men passed by, all snakes, insects, rats, and ants went into hiding, terrified by the oppressive killing intent they were emitting..

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 102: The Stroke of a Dog Tycoon, A Stunning Return (Added for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Seventh Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 102: The Stroke of a Dog Tycoon, A Stunning Return (Added for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Seventh Update)
Translator: 549690339
Awooo!
The giant wolf, standing 3 meters tali at the shoulder, with sharp spikes all over its body, was roaring fiercely. Each time it swung its huge, sharp claws, it tore apart the surrounding trees.
But in front of Marcus Lee, who was swinging his heavy hammer and making explosions in the air, this Mutant Beast was pounded without a chance to fight back.
The swirling heavy hammer, making one hit after another and each hit gathering stronger wind and power, accumulated on Marcus and made him even more imposing.
Booom!
After twelve consecutive heavy blows, this Spike Wolf, with thick skin and agile form, was struck dead by Marcus directly, its chest caved in, its head smashed.
Hoo!
Marcus put away his hammer, looking satisfied at the corpse of the mutant beast he had killed: Not bad, this is what a Mutant Beast should look like. That Furious Ape was just freakish.
At this moment, Justin Welan, who had been watching the battle from afar, urged: Marcus, stop showing off there. Its just a second-level mutant beast. Hurry up, pick it up and lets go.
Marcus was instantly stunned.
He looked at the huge body of the Spike Wolf, then at the two second-level iron-armed black ape corpses they had bundled up, and his legs suddenly felt weak.
This Spike Wolf weighed at least several tons, plus two six-meter tall black ape corpses. Although he could carry them in his True Strength burst, he feared that he might be exhausted and dead by then.
But he was not willing to abandon them. These were all Contribution Points!
At this time, Jack Clark suggested: Marcus, 1 think its better to cut down some trees and make a big raft to pull these Mutant Beast corpses.
Marcuss eyes suddenly lit up.
Yes, dragging was way easier than carrying them. Immediately he excitedly said, Mr. Willard, come and help me with this.
But just when they prepared to make a wooden raft, Jack Clark frowned slightly, Howard, I dont think carrying the Mutant Beast corpses back this way is a good idea.
They could run one to two hundred kilometers a day when they set out, but carrying these several tons or ten tons of Mutant Beast corpses wouldnt work. It was only half a day and they had only traveled more than thirty kilometers.
Moreover, he also planned to kill the Glasses King Snake and the giant crocodile variant beasts. By then, with more than a dozen giant Mutant Beast corpses, four people could not take them back in one trip.
Indeed, thats a problem. Howard Lee nodded and thought for a while.
Lets do this, Ill make a call and rent a heavy transportation helicopter from the nearby stationed army to bring these Mutant Beast corpses back.
This solution made Jack Clark pause, It indeed works, but it could be quite expensive, no?
Not a big deal, just over a hundred thousand at most. Howard Lee replied nonchalantly.
To these filthy rich men, a hundred grand is like ten dollars in their eyes.
Jack Clark thought for a while and said, In that case, let the helicopter come later. We will go and kill those two variant beasts and transport them back together.
Ill go hunt that King Python, and youll kill the giant crocodile.
Saying that, they left after saying goodbye to Justin and Marcus, and then they both set off separately. But with only two breathing motions, Jack Clark had already left Howard Lee far behind.
There was no other way, Jack Clark was just too fast. Thats why he chose the Glasses King Snake that was further away.
At this time, Jack Clark could run at around seventy meters per second without unleashing his True Strength. But with True Strength unleashed, he could reach over a hundred meters.
Although Dragon Elephant True Strength mainly enhances muscle strength, the muscles in his legs are still muscles, the increase in strength did also greatly enhance his speed.
However, the mountain road was rough and there were many bushes, so it took Jack Clark more than half an hour to traverse fifty kilometers and arrive at the territory of the Glasses King Snake.
Hiss Hiss!
The moment Jack Clark appeared, the Black Python that had been coiling around the big tree instantly raised its head, a coldness in its icy eyes.
It recognized this two-legged creature that had provoked it and then ran away.
As the saying goes, seeing ones enemy makes ones blood boil. Even more so the vindictive Mutant Python, its massive body was like a black shadow sliding down the tree, bringing with it a storm and shooting out.
Wherever the python passed, grass and trees would lay flat in both directions, forming a winding snake path. In a blink of an eye, it had spread to the front of Jack Clark.
But this time, Jack Clark didnt run. Instead, he drew his slash blade from behind. Instantly, a fierce and sharp aura exploded from his body, causing the air to roar.
Boom!
The violent wind was howling, grass and trees were dancing wildly, a streak of black blade light crossed more than ten meters, passing by the Glasses King Snake that was shooting towards him.
Splatter!
The grass and trees within a few meters radius were cut off at their waist, accompanied by the enormous python head that flew into the sky. The icy snake eyes that were flying in the sky were filled with confusion.
What happened? Why is the sky spinning?
Pfft! The hot blood spurted out from the wound, the lifeless python body of more than ten meters long struggled crazily, breaking the surrounding trees, making stones fly around.
Only when the corpse no longer struggled, did Jack Clark coldly come forward, sheathed the blade, picked up the snake head from the ground, and carried the snakes body back to meet up with the other.
A level 3 variant python was very valuable. Its snake fangs, snake venom, flesh, snake skin, and even snake bones were all very valuable. In addition, it could also be used to practice refining Essence Blood.
Of course, the flesh and snake bones of the variant beast became useless this way.
This was also why the Essence Blood of a variant beast was so expensive.
Carrying the huge pythons corpse on his shoulder, it took Jack Clark an hour to return, and Howard Lee wasnt back yet.
Watching Jack Clark come back with the python corpse that was more than ten meters long and as thick as a water barrel, Justin Welan laughed, I told you Jack wouldnt take too long.
Impressive. Marcus muttered after a long moment.
Looking at the smooth wound on the snakes head, it was obvious that it was killed with one clean cut. But this was a level 3 Mutant Beast, any ordinary cultivator at the Triplex would consider it a win just to beat it.
After all, not only these Mutant Beasts were gigantic and powerful, they also possessed a specific kind of talent, making them stronger than cultivators of the same level in some areas.
For example, when Marcus first encountered this Glasses King Snake, he had estimated that he could directly confront this variant beast. But if it wanted to run away, he could do nothing.There was no choice, for the speed of its movement was simply too fast and this mutated Glasses King Snake also possessed potent venom. One careless move could result in the tables being turned and they could get killed.
After waiting for a bit longer, they saw Howard Lee coming back, with the carcass of a 9-meter giant crocodile carried on his shoulders and an iron column held in one hand.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
On the flat mountaintop with trees chopped off, the heavy transport helicopter was gradually landing, stirring up a whirlwind that scattered the debris on the ground.
Despite being a heavy transport helicopter, there was still a machine-gun installed beneath it, with air-to-ground missiles hanging on both sides to guard against potential airborne mutant beasts.
Jack Clark and the others were gripping onto the steel ropes dropped down. They secured it at the four corners of a massive raft piled high with mutant beast corpses. After ensuring everything was secure, they made an OK gesture to the helicopter pilot above.
Squeak! Squeak! Squeak! Accompanied by the helicopters ascent, the steel ropes pulling the raft emitted a heavy grinding sound.
Fortunately, when they made the raft, they had chosen trees so thick it would take two men with arms stretched wide to circle it. Some of the logs even had a diameter exceeding half a meter, and the thickest among them was one meter in diameter.
Therefore, carrying three to four tons of weight wouldnt pose a problem.
Watching as the helicopter flew further and further away, Jack Clark calmly said, Lets go, its time for us to head back.
Yes, weve been out for two days. Lets go.
Upon saying this, the four of them shot forward. In the blink of an eye, they became small dots that disappeared into the depths of the mountain forest.
With the burden of carrying the mutant beast carcasses gone, the four of them, familiar with the path, moved at a swift pace. By six oclock in the afternoon, they had emerged at the mouth of the mountain where they had entered.
Looking at the weary Howard Lee and his group, their battle armor worn and smeared with blood but exuding a stronger and heavier aura, the mercenaries around them showed looks of awe on their faces.
The burly man in the lead asked hesitantly, Boss, you guysare you alright?
It was no wonder he was hesitant. When the four of them had set off for the mountains, they were full of energy, their battle armor shiny and new.
But when they returned, their conditions seemed somewhat poor. For instance, Marcus Lees breastplate had cracked and deformed, three of the four horns on Howard Lees armor were broken, and his arms were even completely bare.
Moreover, Justin Welans heavy shield that he was carrying was pitted, twisted, and deformed, with all its spikes broken. Jack Clark seemed to be in a slightly better condition, but his short cloak was so tattered it barely covered him. All four of them had returned empty-handed, causing the mercenaries to worry about their final payment.
Howard Lee said in a deep voice, Were fine. The final payment has already been transferred to your accounts. It should arrive soon. Lets go, we should leave this place first.
H
As long as you guys are fine. Thats good. The burly man showed a face full of smiles.
In the midst of their conversation, the four men tossed their weapons into the back of the car, got in the drivers seat and started the engine, heading back to Lester.
When the four of them returned to the base, it was almost 10 p.m., but the lights outside the hotel were still bright. Thats because the empty space was filled with a pile of mutant beast corpses.
Especially the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King which was eight meters long. Even in death, the ferocious aura emanating from it was enough to make many students hearts race.
There was also the gigantic snake head placed on the ground that was already a meter high. Its cold snake eyes were trying their best to terrify people.
Then, amid the roaring of the engine, four modified pickup trucks pulled up.
Following closely, the four imposing figures got out of the car. The invisible pressure that they emanated made many Second Layer students feel suffocated.
Watching Jack Clark and the others, their battle armor dirty and disorganized, those who were on good terms with them, like Zac Lyons, White Veil, and Mullen Weisz, gathered around and expressed their admiration.
You guys really hit the jackpot this time, having killed so many mutants.
Mullen Weisz had an expression like he had suffered a big loss: Damn it, just a day after you guys left, 1 had managed to break through to the Third Layer. I missed out big time this trip.
Hehe actually, it was a good thing that you guys didnt go.
Justin Welans face couldnt conceal his smugness: You guys just dont know how terrifying that Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King was. Marcus almost got smashed to death with a slap.
Marcus Lee retorted indignantly, What do you mean almost got killed by a slap? My Qi Blood was just scattered, and I couldnt get up for a while.
Moreover, 1 dont know who was the one that was knocked down by the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape Kings fists and couldnt even stand up. If it werent for Howard and the others coming to the rescue hmph.
ii
So many mutant beast corpses.
Jack Clark, big brother Jack, you guys are too incredible.
Not at all, this time it was mainly Howard leading.
True to his reputation as the second-best in the ranking competition
Hey, hey, guys, 1 also performed very well this time. Look at my heavy shield, even though it got beat up by the King-level mutant beast, it still managed to stay intact.
In the midst of the bragging about how fierce the combat had been and how amazing they were from Marcus Lee and Justin Welan, Jack Clark and Howard Lee withdrew from the crowd with a smile and walked over to Sylvia Lyons.bender
Teacher Lyons.
Sylvia Lyons nodded approvingly, Good job, daring to hunt down a mutant beast with traces of a king-level bloodline while being at the initial stage of the Third Layer, and even succeeding in doing so.
Not at all, we were just fortunate, Jack Clark humbly responded.
Initially, Sylvia Lyons didnt know that the target of the four men this time was a mutant beast with a King-level bloodline. She thought it was just a few ordinary Level 3 Mutant Beasts.
Otherwise, she wouldnt have approved this expedition.
After all, a mutant beast with even slight traces of a king-level bloodline is formidable. It is simply no match for cultivators at its level, let alone four students in the initial stages of the Third Layer.
Under normal conditions, such an expedition would be tantamount to seeking their own deaths.
But now, its already a fait accompli and they have successfully hunted down this mutant beast, so nobody was bothering about this issue anymore. Sylvia Lyons then asked,
How are you planning to deal with these mutant beast corpses?
Howard Lee said in a deep voice, Except for the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape, the rest will be handed over to the officials for recycling.
On the way back, the four of them had already agreed on this.
Jacks priority was Life Crystals, Howards goal was the Essence Blood extracted from the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, while Justin Welan and Marcus Lee needed Contribution Points.
So they decided to exchange the ordinary mutant beasts for official rewards, as for the corpse of the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape and the Life Crystals, they would convert them into Contribution Points and then divide them up according to the final gain..

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 103: Dragon Elephant Limit, True Martial Divine Rhyme (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Eighth Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 103: Dragon Elephant Limit, True Martial Divine Rhyme (Extra chapter for Warm Sun Alliance Leader, Eighth Update)
Translator: 549690339
Eight level-2 mutated beast corpses, because several were cut in half by Jack Clarks blade, and the rest were seriously damaged, which ended up earning them 50 Contribution Points in total.
Apart from that, the spectacled King Python earned them 20 points, making a total of 70 Contribution Points.
However, the real big haul this time were the Variant Fierce Apes with the faint trace of a King-level bloodline. The Level 3 Life Crystal was worth 40 Contribution Points, and after losing the crystal, the corpse still worth 50 points.
They had been out for three days, and the four of them earned a total of 160 Contribution Points together. It was an absolute fortune. It was not only easier than chasing down blood disciples and rebels, but it was also extremely profitable.
But such a good thing could only happen once.
After all, to find the location of these Mutated Beasts, Howard Lee spent hundreds of thousands hiring mercenaries to search deep in the mountains for more than ten days, consuming lots of manpower and resources.
Not only is this place barren, but every year, the experts from the Koroya Royal Family would clear and collect materials, resulting in the scarceness of high-level Mutated Beasts.
The next morning, Howard Lee and Marcus Lee, who had rested for the night, came to Jack Clarks room to split the loot.
Marcus started first, somewhat embarrassed: This time I played the least useful role, especially during the hunt for the Furious Ape. Just give me 20 Contribution Points.
Twenty, is that a bit too little? Jack hesitated.
Although they decided before setting off that whoever contributed more would get more, there was a minimum for this, or else no one would want to team up with them in future.
After all, nobody likes those who take more than their fair share.
Giving you twenty points is definitely not okay.
Meanwhile, Justin Welan shook his head: 1 think Jack and Howard should each take fifty points, and Marcus and 1 should take thirty points each. How about that?
Howard said solemnly, Okay.
Jack nodded, 1 dont have any objections either.
Although the final battle ended with Jacks decisive strike against the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape, if it werent for Howard, who bravely took the brunt of the attack despite being injured, Jack would not have been able to wear the ape down in the first place.
Moreover, Justins burst of power towards the end was also crucial; otherwise, the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape might have escaped.
Once it entered the mountain forest, it would have been more difficult to kill.
After all, there were trees everywhere in there, and with that terrifying strength of the Furious Ape, they might not be able to kill it if it started swinging sky-touching trees around.
This Faced with this proposal, Marcus was hesitant, feeling like he didnt deserve it.
Justin rolled his eyes, Whats wrong with you? Stop hesitating like a woman.
Minority submits to the majority, lets just settle it this way.
In the end, Jack Clark got 50 Contribution Points, a Level 3 Life Crystal worth forty Contribution Points, and an additional 10 Contribution Points.
Howard got the corpse of the Golden-Backed Furious Ape, while Justin and Marcus both got 30 Contribution Points, making everyone very happy.
You have transformed a highly-concentrated Life Crystal and gained 44 attribute points.
After dividing up the loot and the others dispersing, Jack chose to transform the Life Crystal and gained even more attribute points than he had expected.
The Federations pricing of Life Crystals was based on the purity of life energy rather than the concentration.
Generally, the difference between Level 1 and Level 2 Life Crystals is about threefold. The difference between the second and third levels is not even three times, but just over two times. However, since the life energy is purer, the price remains three times higher.
For most cultivators, the high-purity life energy has a better effect on enhancing their physiques, but it is not cost-effective for Jack Clark.bender
Nevertheless, it does not matter; once the Sword Armor Beast enters the sea, there will be an additional source of life crystals. His accumulated contribution points can be used for other purposes.
For example, for exchanging advanced skills and other extraordinary materials.
Even so, the attribute points he converted this time are equivalent to the sum of three Grade 2 Life Crystals, and he cant help but smile on his face.
But its still not enough.
Jack takes the elevator to the Underground Logistics Department and sends his dentedblade and badly cracked combat knife for repair.
He has some money and quite a few contribution points now, so he doesnt feel right about asking Justin Welan to help him fix his knife anymore.
Jack politely said, Excuse me, but I also want to exchange for a Level 1 Life Crystal and an energy crystal.
Justin Welan gave him a Blue Crystal with plenty of energy, which was originally intended to last three months before his trial was over and returned to school.
But who would have thought that Jacks breakthrough was too fast, and the energy absorption speed surged several times after the Third Layer Heaven. He had absorbed the Blue Crystal that night when he left the base.
He now has a total of 35 contribution points. After exchanging for a Life Crystal and an energy crystal, he still has 26 left.
Although the Life Crystals still have a 20% discount, the already 30% discounted Energy Crystals can no longer be discounted.
You have converted a life energy crystal and gained 4 attribute points.
In his Personal Cultivation Room, Jack saw the 51 attribute points on the attribute page, expecting that, in his mind, he exclaimed, Limit Enhancement Dragon Elephant Power.
As Jacks voice fell, 50 attribute points disappeared. At the same time, a vast energy poured into his dantian, and the Dragon Elephant True Strength suddenly surged.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Faintly, a torrential roar like rushing rivers echoed in Jacks body. The Dragon Elephant True Strength crazily expanded and circulated, and the muscles, skin, and bones where it passed were greatly enhanced.
To go from the Third Layer Heaven to the Fourth Layer Heaven, one needs to expand the dantian three times.
The actual true strength to be contained needs to be ten times the original amount. Then, after continuous compression and refining, the true strength will be liquefied. Only after completing the first qualitative change in strength can the breakthrough be achieved.
At this moment, under the enhancement of the attribute points, the Dragon Elephant Power expanded by a fraction with every circle of circulation, and the true strength became more substantial. Even all the meridians in the body were expanding.
In addition, Jack also felt that something inside his body was converging. It seemed to be the essence of the Tyrant Elephant Essence Blood he had absorbed during his Foundation Establishment.
These essence blood materials changed the nature of his skin and muscles, making them tougher, and the true strength contained a trace of the wild nature of the Tyrant Elephants power.
With the extreme enhancement of the technique at this moment, this essence was converging in some way that Jack couldnt understand, towards the dantian.
Under Jacks watchful eyes, the non-existent yet very real dantian in his body quickly expanded to twice and three times its size. His true strength also doubled in size.
Am 1 going to break through?
Just as Jack thought he would be able to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven at a pace that far surpassed all geniuses, there was a sudden tremor deep within his dantian.
Roar!
An overbearing and furious roar of an elephant resounded, and a vague phantom of a giant elephant, about ten meters tall and twenty meters long, appeared in the center of the dantian.The terrifying giant elephants muscles exploded, emitting an extremely violent aura of power. It seemed like it could topple mountains and level rivers with a single move, its aura domineering and overbearing.
Tyrant Elephant!? Watching the terrifying giant elephants shadow, Jack Clark was shaken at heart.
From its size and emitted aura, Jack could be sure that this giant elephant was at least a Level 6 or even Level 7 mutated creature.
But such a terrifying Mutated Giant Beasts Essence and Blood was only 20 points per bottle?
The official support for cultivating students is really generous.
Jack sighed in his heart, now understanding why the contribution points were so precious. Because under normal conditions, such a Mutant Giant Beasts Essence and Blood would be at least 50 points each.
While Jack was sighing, the giant elephants shadow kept shrinking and finally condensed into an ancient elephant-shaped rune in the center of his dantian. Although he couldnt comprehend it, he understood its meaning.
After a long while, Jack, who had finished his enhancements, slowly opened his eyes, feeling the surge of True Strength within his body. With a thought, he called up the attribute page.
Realm: Third Layer Heaven
Physique: 315+
Strength: 340+
Agility: 250+
Spirit: 241+
Talent: Soul Split+
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Method, Extreme Realmization Dragon Elephant Skill [Third Layer], Hearts Eye Bright Knife+[Third Layer]
Rune: Elephants Fury[This is an incomplete True Martial Rune; when activated, it can burn the users Qi Blood and True Strength, increasing ten times the defense and strength, just like a Tyrant Elephant sweeping everything]
Attribute points: 1
The effect of this extreme enhancement was astonishing, allowing Jack to form a True Martial Rune while still in the Third Layer Heaven, increasing his True Strength by five times and making it even more thick and condensed.
In addition, his dantian expanded to triple its limit, and his meridians were widened and more robust, able to withstand stronger bursts of True Strength.
His realm directly broke through to Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, and with a bit of cultivation, he could reach the Late Phase.
With the breakthrough of the Limit Enhancement, Jacks physique and strength attributes both skyrocketed by 30 points.
Of course, the biggest gain was the True Martial Rune. Although it was noted as incomplete, it had a horrifying increase in Jacks combat power.
Under the influence of this True Martial Remnant Symbol, the power of his Dragon Elephant Art was now equivalent to ordinary advanced skills, with the normal strength enhancement increased from three times to five times.
When the rune was activated, its power was even stronger. With a ten times increase in strength and defense, even if the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King appeared in front of him now, it would be forcefully suppressed by Jack.
It could be said that this breakthrough had increased his combat power by several times.
Boom!
In the cultivation room, Jacks body was circulating with thick black True Power, emitting an extremely violent and domineering aura of strength. Every movement caused the air to tremble.
He was getting familiar with his skyrocketing power.
After the Limit Enhancement, the Dragon Elephant Art made his power even more domineering and violent.
Inside the base, Jerrold West, Emmitt Wesley, Sylvia Lyons, and Cameron Raven in military attire walked together.
Sylvia Lyons indifferently said, We have been searching for a month, and it seems like the crack is really not around Lester City.
Cameron Raven slowly said, The General left us behind as a precaution.
Besides, its better that the crack is not here; otherwise, we four Sixth Layer Heavens would not be able to stop the God Envoy lurking in the Evil God Sect.
Jerrold Wests expression was somewhat solemn, I heard that the Evil God Sect attaches great importance to the crack in Koroya and wont let the Federation find and destroy it so easily. This time, there may be fallen people appearing.
Fallen people! The four were instantly shocked.
At this time, not far away, Jack, who had just finished his cultivation, walked out of the cultivation room. The four of them paused for a moment.
In their eyes, Jack now seemed like a giant elephant, creating an invisible pressure that made the surrounding air somewhat heavy.
Cameron Raven was surprised, True Martial Divine Rhyme, this student is from South Sky Martial Height, isnt he?
Yes. Sylvia Lyons nodded, a hint of shock flashing in her eyes.
Cameron Raven praised, No wonder he is from one of our Eastern Summers First-Class Universities, there are so many talented geniuses. The cultivation method hes practicing should be related to strength and elephants.
I remember theres an advanced skill in South Sky Martial Height called Dragon Elephant Overlord Body. After cultivation, ones strength would be extremely fierce and violent, sweeping everything.
Faced with this question, Sylvia Lyons remained silent.
Of course, she wouldnt say that Jack was practicing the low-level martial skill Dragon Elephant Art else this guy would definitely think of ways to steal him for the military.
Originally, when Jack killed the Third Layer Heaven immortal earlier, Sylvia was already somewhat shocked. She couldnt believe the even more shocking things that followed.
Yesterday, the few of them killed the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King and came back. And now, in just half a month, he had actually cultivated the low-level martial techniques True Martial Divine Rhyme.
While Sylvia Lyons was still in shock, Jerrold West and Emmitt Wesleys performances were actually quite composed.
Emmitt Wesley sighed, I felt that this student named Jack Clark was extraordinary when he came to pick us up. His talent is definitely among the first rank at South Sky Martial Height.
II
It turns out I wasnt wrong. In just over three months, he broke through to the Third Layer Heaven and even cultivated the True Martial Divine Rhyme. The new students nowadays are really amazing.
Yes, youngsters can be awe-inspiring. Jerrold West nodded in agreement.
By the way, I heard this morning that four freshmen from South Sky Martial Height entered the Kata Mountain Range and hunted more than ten Mutated Beasts.
Among them, there is even a Mutant Fierce Ape with a trace of king-level bloodlines. Could it be
Sylvia Lyons nodded, Yes, its the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape killed by Jack Clark and three other Third Layer Heaven freshmen.
Immediately, Cameron Raven, Jerrold West, and Emmitt Wesley praised South Sky Martial Height and Jack Clark once again, without noticing the increasingly odd expression on Sylvia Lyons face.
She felt that even if she told the three of them that this freshmans initial talent was only mediocre and only reached Foundation Establishment half a month ago, they wouldnt believe it either.
It seemed that when she returned, she would have to report it to the principal. Otherwise, it would be too unfair for Jack Clark, who had accumulated a lot and burst forth as a hidden genius..

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 104: Skin like Steel and Jade, Mutated Crystal Horn Fish (Extra update for Warm Sun Alliance Chief, Ninth update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 104: Skin like Steel and Jade, Mutated Crystal Horn Fish (Extra update for Warm Sun Alliance Chief, Ninth update)
Translator: 549690339
Hello to the three teachers and Colonel Brock, how are you?
Seeing the four people walking towards him, Jack Clark greeted them politely.
Emmitt Wesley laughed loudly: Haha Student Clark, its good to see you too. Youve achieved another breakthrough in such a short time. It seems that we Eastern Summer people have quite a few talents.
Indeed, a dragon among men, praised Jerrold West.
Cameron Raven smiled and said, Jack, you should visit the military barracks more often when you have the time. The battle achievements of the soldiers during their cultivation might inspire you.
By the way, I remember that General Ravens younger brother, Mr. Laurant Hawk, happens to be the head instructor at South Sky Martial Height. I guess we are all family.
Jack Clark was puzzled and surprised by their enthusiasm and said, I did not expect the head instructor and the general to be brothers.
Cameron Raven smiled, Its quite normal. The Federations military and colleges are both dedicated to cultivating the backbone of humanity, just with different focuses.
In such a situation, many strong cultivators will hold positions in both the military and colleges. Jack, if youre ever interested in the military, feel free to join
Cough!
At this time, Sylvia Lyons interrupted Cameron Raven, stepping forward and said, Jack, youve made good progress, but after your next breakthrough, remember to cover your body with your spirit will to keep your aura in check.
As she spoke, Sylvia Lyons slapped her palm onto Jack, instantly sweeping his body with a fierce surge of her willpower, suppressing the invisible charm leaking from him.
The oppressive air that Jack unintentionally emitted disappeared, and he looked much more ordinary.
Sylvia Lyons waved her hand at him, I remember your spirit seemed a bit exhausted when you returned yesterday. Youve been training hard today, so go get some rest.
I looked pretty lively when I returned last night, didnt I?
Despite being puzzled, Jack sensed Sylvias intentions to have him leave and politely greeted the others before departing.
On the way back, recalling the behavior of the four people earlier, Jack whispered to himself, It seems that they noticed something because I didnt fully conceal my aura.
After finishing his cultivation, Jack also tried to cover his body with Spirit Power, restraining the invisible oppressive air emitted, to prevent people from detecting it.
But he didnt know whether it was because the breakthrough was too big or his simple aura restraining method didnt work.
Pondering, Jack returned to the hotel.
It was already noon, so he went straight to the restaurant on the third floor.
Jack soon realized that many people were looking at him, which made him frown. What was wrong? Hadnt Sylvias intervention fully concealed his breakthrough aura?
At this moment, Justin Welan came over, asking curiously, Jack, what did you do? Your skin has suddenly become so good-looking?
Skin? Jack paused.
Yeah.
Justin said enviously, Youre already handsome, and now your skin is suddenly looking great too. Dont you see all those female students drooling?
Now, Jacks skin was as delicate as jade, and he had a calm and composed demeanor that drew attention.
This was also the reason he was being stared at.
So that was the reason. Jacks eyes flickered, and he casually found an excuse: It should be because of the Level 3 Life Crystal I received.
Level 3 Life Crystal has a beauty effect too? Justins eyes lit up.
Im not sure. It could also be because of my Cultivation Methods, Jack didnt make any definite statement.
Actually, it should be due to his Dragon Elephant Power. The introduction of the cultivation method had mentioned that when Dragon Elephant Power is cultivated to the extreme, some unique effects might appear on the body.
One of them is having skin as tough as steel but with the form of jade.
However, he definitely couldnt tell Justin this. After all, everyone thought he had just broken through the Third Layer Heaven not long ago, so suddenly cultivating his method to the extreme was too exaggerated.
As for whether or not Justin would exchange for the Level 3 Life Crystal just to look whiter, Jack didnt care.
Even if he didnt say anything, Justin would still exchange for the Level 3 Life Crystal to speed up his physique cultivation, so the truth wouldnt have much impact.
After eating, Jack returned to his room and prepared to cultivate using the energy crystal he had exchanged for.
Compared to the Blue Crystal that Justin had given him, the crystal that could only be exchanged by Fourth Layer Heaven cultivators had a much lower energy purity and quantity.
With a deep breath, the Dragon Elephant Power circulated, and the formidable suction emanated from Jack, attracting the sparse, transcendent energy to converge towards him.
At the same time, a stream of pure energy flowed from the crystal into Jacks body through his palm, which was rapidly refined by the overwhelming Dragon Elephant True Strength, resulting in almost no waste.
Once his internal cultivation was on track, Jack slowly divided half of his mind to where the Sword Armor Beast was.
As his Spirit Power grew stronger, he became more proficient with multitasking.
Under normal circumstances, he could now easily operate from two perspectives. Only when the Sword Armor Beast or his main body encountered a battle would he concentrate most of his attention.
The light was dim in the sea, more than 60 meters deep.
A Unique Beast, almost six meters long, swam slowly, carefully sensing the fluctuations and smells of the surrounding seawater, searching for prey to hunt.
At this depth, even the Sword Armor Beast couldnt see far, and everything beyond 20 or 30 meters was vague and murky .The Sword Armor Beast swam in the water for half an hour, but the schools of fish it encountered were mostly 1 to 2 meters of seafood. There were no larger ferocious mutated fish.
It seems that most of the mutated fish in this area have been eaten. Well need to go further and deeper, the Sword Armor Beasts tail flicked, disappearing into the darkness.
For safety, the Sword Armor Beast has been active within a 50-kilometer range of the coast this week, with the deepest place being only 70 meters, covering the surrounding hunting range.
However, the number of mutated fish in a sea area is limited. Under its constant hunting, those more than 5 meters long and reaching the mutated level have been almost eaten up.
This time, the Sword Armor Beast swam out several dozens of kilometers in one breath before slowing down.
It was already more than 100 kilometers away from the coast, and the sea below was pitch black, with no way of knowing how deep it was.
The reason the Sword Armor Beast stopped was that it had a keen sense of out-of-placeness when it arrived here. The heavenly energy contained in the sea was much denser.
Strange, is there something good nearby? The Sword Armor Beasts eyes scanned the surroundings, its golden vertical pupils revealing caution.
It was because it found the place to be eerily quiet, with no marine life visible at all.
Just then, the Sword Armor Beast suddenly looked towards the bottom left, where a massive shadow flashed by, and the water waves caused by its movement rippled far away.
Interesting. The Sword Armor Beast flicked its tail and chased after the massive shadow.
Under the combination of power, defense, and agility, it was confident that as long as it did not provoke the marine giant beasts, it could escape any danger from ordinary mutated fish.
Soon, the Sword Armor Beast caught up to the depths of 200 meters, 300 meters. The intense water pressure from all directions forced it to slow down.
However, at this moment, a faint light emerged from the dark depths in the distance. The Sword Armor Beast could not help but become cautious, slowly approaching.
At the bottom of the sea, about 500 meters down, a volcano-like small hill emerged, but instead of magma in the crater, it was covered with red and blue corals.
These corals emanated a faint blue and red glow, bringing some light to the surrounding pitch-black sea area.
At this moment, around the crater, seven-meter, ten-meter, and even more than ten or twenty-meter mutated fish slowly swam around, their huge mouths slightly open, swallowing something.
These mutated fish resembled giant groupers with a short blue horn on their heads. Their entire bodies, scales, and fins were blue and crystal-clear, looking like beautiful blue crystals.
Looking at the group of about twenty mutated fish, the Sword Armor Beast almost drooled.bender
However, it didnt rush forward recklessly. It hid in the dark sea, quietly waiting and observing.
This was its first encounter with mutated fish schools, so it was unsure what differences there were between them and other mutated fish species.
As the Sword Armor Beast patiently waited, half an hour later, one by one, the 7-meter Crystal Horn Fish turned away, followed by the second and third.
After the 7-meter ones left, the 8-meter and 9-meter ones followed, leaving only three fishes over 15 meters long, circling around the crater.
The Sword Armor Beast lay low on the pitch-black ocean floor, waiting for another half-hour. Seeing that the three massive Crystal Horn Fish had no intention of leaving, it gave up the idea of going over to take a look.
In the darkness, the Sword Armor Beast slowly retreated along the bottom of the sea, avoiding causing too much water disturbance that would be detected.
After it exited the sea area for several kilometers, it flicked its tail and quickly swam to the upper-left direction, where some 7-meter long Crystal Horn Fish were.
In the water, the Sword Armor Beast was very fast, swimming more than 10 kilometers in a short time, and caught up with a Crystal Horn Fish at a depth of over 100 meters.
The mutated fish was hunting at this time. Its target was a school of more than 1-meter long mackerel with faint traces of mutation, its enormous body charging wildly and devouring nonstop.
Occasionally, the blue crystal on the fishs head would shoot out a weak blue light beam, reaching more than 10 meters away. All the mackerel hit by the blue light beam would stiffen up.
The seawater was even frozen and turned into an arm-thick, more than
10-meter long ice crystal before being shattered and melted by the swaying water.
This scene caused the Sword Armor Beasts eyes to narrow.
It was a mutated fish capable of energy attacks. According to the official classification of mutated beasts, this mutated fish had reached at least Level 4.
However, in the Sword Armor Beasts perception, this Level 4 Crystal Horn Fish seemed a bit weak, as the danger it emitted was not even comparable to that of the mutated fat fish?
Strange.
In its confusion, the Sword Armor Beast revealed cold and ruthless eyes, as its black and hideous body silently approached.
When the distance between them was less than 20 meters, the Sword Armor Beasts tail suddenly flicked, explosively bursting forth with terrifying speed. Like a black shadow, it tore through the water.
Bang!
The pouncing Sword Armor Beast struck the back of the Crystal Horn Fishs brain with a single claw swipe. In that instant, the water under the claw exploded, and the terrifying force and speed of the swipe almost created a vacuum.
With such a horrifying attack and such terrifying speed, the Crystal Horn mutated fish had not yet reacted, and half of its brain was shattered like a watermelon.
Blood mixed with white matter splattered everywhere, turning the surrounding seawater red, and the thick bloody smell made the black mutant beast seem even more terrifying.
The surrounding mackerel school burst apart in the invisible murderous aura, frantically fleeing.
The Sword Armor Beast was not interested in the mackerel with only faint traces of mutation. It excitedly grabbed the Crystal Horn Fishs body and bit down on the back.
Crack!
Sharp teeth tore through the fish scales, ripping off a large chunk of flesh and blood. More blood spewed out, rendering the surrounding seawater within a range of tens of meters even redder.
The Sword Armor Beasts eyes lit up as it tasted the rich energy contained in the mutated fishs flesh and blood..

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 105: Terrifying Growth, Starting to Make a Move (Extra for Warm Sun Alliance Master, Tenth Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 105: Terrifying Growth, Starting to Make a Move (Extra for Warm Sun Alliance Master, Tenth Chapter)
Translator: 549690339
Deep under the sea, a seven-meter-long Mutated Fish was being devoured by the Sword Armor Beast at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Besides some indigestible organs like intestines, the fish bladder and even bones were all crushed and eaten by the Sword Armor Beast, due to its inability to consume energy as well.
With this mutated fish in its stomach, the size of the Sword Armor Beast visibly grew several centimeters, and its body swelled significantly larger.
Crack Crack!!
With its left claw, the Sword Armor Beast grabbed the half-meter-long Crystal Horn, like eating a blue popsicle, using its sharp and hard teeth to crush it.
Feeling satisfied and full, the Sword Armor Beast floated in the seawater, thinking to itself.
This energy-attacking mutated fish had a level close to early Level 4, but its strength was very weak. It felt like it couldnt even compare to an ordinary Level 3 Mutant Beast.
However, the energy contained in its flesh and blood was very rich, almost several times that of a mutated fish of the same size, especially the blue Crystal Horn, which felt like an energy crystal body.
It seemed to be related to those luminous corals on the volcanos mouth.
At this thought, the Sword Armor Beast licked its sharp fangs, and its massive body slightly shook and disappeared into the dark deep sea.
Back in his hotel room, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes.
Feeling the warm currents appearing out of thin air within his body, Jack couldnt help but smile. Sure enough, the sea was the real home of the Sword Armor Beast.
Only the ocean had endless mutated creatures for the Sword Armor Beast to grow rapidly.
As for absorbing the genes of flying birds and soaring in the sky, and hunting on the land, Jack had never thought about it before.
Would the land-based mutated beasts be enough for the Sword Armor Beast to eat? Would the Human Federation allow a mutated beast to grow infinitely?
Of course not.
Even if he demonstrated that he could control the Sword Armor Beast, the Human Federation would not let this mutated beast grow infinitely and would also expose many of his secrets.
In such a situation, it would naturally grow quietly in the depths of the ocean, not drawing any unwanted attention.
Just now, that single Crystal Angelfish not only made the Sword Armor Beast grow a lot, but also raised his Four Major Attributes by almost a few points, with an amazing increase.
If the Sword Armor Beast eats all the Crystal Angelfish, not only will it grow, but also Jacks Four Major Attributes will skyrocket. By then, his strength will become even more terrifying.
Just that, Jack couldnt help but smile bitterly while looking at the slightly transparent energy crystal in his hand: The cultivation consumption of the Third Layer Heaven is so high.
The Second Layer Heaven could quickly absorb a months worth of energy crystals. He had just been cultivating for an afternoon and had consumed one-tenth of that energy.
However, the cultivation speed of directly absorbing energy crystals is indeed fast.
Jack estimated that at this rate, even without using attribute points to strengthen himself, it would take at most half a month to break through to the late period, and more than three months to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
But in doing so, he would have to consume at least nine energy crystals, which would be dozens of Contribution Points since he could only exchange two at a 30% discount per month.
At this thought, Jack hesitated a bit.
Contribution Points were much more important to him. After the Dragon Elephant Power condensed True Martial Rune, he was full of expectations for the strengthening of the Minds Eye Bright Knife.
He didnt know what changes would occur after this Sword Skill reached its maximum strengthening.
Besides, he also needed to prepare to exchange the Advanced Skill Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and he wanted to strengthen his equipment as well.
During the Hunt for the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, he was able to easily defeat it due to his strength, Enhanced +10 Armor, and strong physique, only suffering a boil of his Blood Qi from several Furious Ape attacks.
However, this battle also exposed the weakness of his weapon not being hard or sharp enough.
If his straight blade were indestructible and unparalleled, with his speed and strength, he would have no equal at the same level, be it mutated beasts or humans.
So its still because hes poor
In the following days, besides cultivation, Jack was wreaking havoc in the deep sea, ambushing and attacking Crystal Angelfish, devouring them to grow and increase his strength.
However, those Crystal Angelfish seemed to have some intelligence.
After those five seven-meter-long Crystal Angelfish were killed by the Sword Armor Beast, the remaining ones became more alert and would not stray too far from the volcano mouth to find food.
They would often cluster in groups of two or three, making it difficult for the Sword Armor Beast to act.
After all, as individual fish, it could rely on its terrifying speed to ambush and kill them in an instant.
But once they gathered together, the Sword Armor Beast would be attacked by other Crystal Angelfish the moment it killed one of them.
That kind of ice-cold light beam that could freeze seawater and living beings, the Sword Armor Beast didnt want to touch it unless necessary since it had no confidence in its magic resistance.
While Jack focused on evolution and increased his strength, the others werent idle either.
Marcus Lee and Justin Welan were also concentrating on cultivation, while Howard Lee disappeared once more.
By the time he appeared again, he should have absorbed the essence blood of the Golden-Backed Violent Ape and increased his strength.
Because of Jacks group of fours motivation, other students of South Sky Martial Height, like Zac Lyons, cultivated even harder, trying to break through to the Third Layer Heaven as soon as possible and catch up to them.
In this situation, students from the other two schools also felt the invisible pressure.
Although they were from different schools, they were all genius cultivators who had reached Foundation Establishment within a week;, so why did they feel that the gap between them was getting bigger?
So these students also actively took on missions, chasing and killing the few scattered blood disciples in the city like mad dogs.
Some students even went to the surrounding small towns and cities without any mission, wanting to see if they could come across any luck.
Under such stable conditions, the economic situation in Lester City and its surroundings slowly recovered. Many commercial streets regained some vitality at night.
.. Two hundred meters deep within the dark sea, a group of giant squids ranging from one to two meters in length panicked and fled, hunted by two Crystal Horn Mutated Fish.
Each of the Crystal Horn Mutated Fish were over eight meters long, their bulky bodies even more imposing than a great white shark, and the one-meter blue crystal horn on their head gave off an oppressive aura.
At this moment, the two Mutated Fish spread out to the left and right, shooting beams of light from their horns that froze several giant squids and formed icicles in the water, as thick as a thigh and tens of meters long.
For these weaker, mutated giant squids, the energy-attacking Crystal Horn Mutated Fish were like a devastating dimensional attack.
After devouring hundreds of squids, the well-fed Crystal Horn Mutated Fish ceased their attack and stopped chasing the escaping school of fish, their bodies pivoting slightly, about to return
Bang!
In the distance, the seawater exploded, a dark shadow tore through the current, and instantly traversed a hundred meters, appearing beside a Crystal Horn Mutated Fish, its strong and sharp claw striking down.
Boom! Under the terrifying force and speed, a circle of white shockwave exploded from the seawater, creating a blast several meters wide.
With a single strike, half of this Mutated Crystal Horn Fishs skull shattered, and it was instantly killed by the Sword Armor Beast. Thick blood and white fluids burst forth, tinting the sea water red.
While the Sword Armor Beast launched its attack, the Crystal Horn Fish several meters away reacted, its head shooting out a blue beam of light.
Seeing this, the Sword Armor Beast ignored the attack, charging forward while holding the dead Mutated Fishs body.
Through its observations during these few days, it discovered that the blue cold light was indeed powerful. However, its penetrating power would be greatly weakened after passing through a living beings body.
Moreover, it couldnt be used for an extended period; it seemed to have limited energy.
For example, the intensity and brightness of the beam shot by the exhausted Crystal Horn Fish, both its concentration and brightness had been halved compared to before.
This was why the Sword Armor Beast had remained hidden for so long, waiting until the Mutated Fish were satiated before making a move.
Whoosh! The blue beam pierced through the Mutated Fish corpse; in an instant, a layer of ice appeared on half of the Crystal Horn Fishs body, emitting an icy chill.
After the beam weakened again from passing through the thick carcass, by the time it reached the Sword Armor Beasts body, all that was left was a faint blue radiance.bender
Still, the Sword Armor Beast felt an astonishing coldness sweep over it, causing its body to stiffen slightly. However, the icy chill was quickly dispersed by the surging, scorching Qi Blood within it.
Bang! The half-frozen Mutated Fishs corpse, still moving at full speed, viciously collided with the other Mutated Fish, the enormous impact flipping it over.
For a moment, the seawater trembled, causing splashes to erupt.
As the other Mutated Fish flipped over, a black bone spur pierced through everything, like a black afterimage, instantly penetrating its skull and completing the double kill.
In the dark sea, the two colossal corpses over eight meters long slowly sank and floated, their scarlet blood gushing out from their wounds and dyeing the surrounding seawater red.
On the side, the increasingly baleful-looking, more than seven-meters-long black Mutant Beasts tail swayed slightly, its icy cold golden vertical pupils exuding a fierce aura.
It seems that I was overly cautious before. This cold light does have a strong killing power against regular creatures, but its effect on Extraordinary Creatures like myself is much weaker.
With continuous evolution and growth through cellular division and condensation, the Sword Armor Beasts body density became increasingly terrifying, its bones extremely solid and its muscles containing formidable power.
Although its talent lay in strength, defense, and agility, all of which were body-strengthening types.
However, this didnt mean that there wasnt any extraordinary energy in its body. Its just that this extraordinary energy had merged into its flesh and blood, turning into scorching hot Qi Blood, which instinctively burst out to disperse the cold light when it was attacked earlier.
Of course, there was also the fact that the previous cold light attack was relatively weak.
If it were to face a full-strength attack from that Crystal Angelfish during its prime, or even continuous attacks from four or five Crystal Angelfish, the Sword Armor Beast wouldnt be able to endure it now.
This was also the reason why it had been lurking for several days, and finally attacked when it encountered two Crystal Angelfish that were stranded.
After all, safety comes first.
The ocean was vast, and there was no need to stick to guarding these Crystal Angelfish. Therefore, during this period, in addition to observing these fish, the Sword Armor Beast was also hunting in the distance.
Excited, the Sword Armor Beast moved its right and left claws to grab the two huge prey, swinging its tail, and swimming toward its temporary nest tens of miles away.
It couldnt help it; the two fish were huge.
Even with its terrifying digestive ability, itd take a long time to finish eating them, so naturally, it would return to a safe nest.
Otherwise, what would it do if it were eating and suddenly bumped into larger Crystal Angelfish that had gone out in groups to find food?
After understanding the intensity of the cold light beams emitted by the Crystal Angelfish, the Sword Armor Beast maintained a sly approach to hunting and killing several more in the following days.
In this situation, its evolution value continued to skyrocket, increasing by tens of points every day. It felt that within two months, it would reach the requirements for its fourth evolution.
Of course, this was based on the premise of constantly eating Crystal Angelfish with abundant energy, which was obviously impossible.
Time passed quickly, and it was December 17th.
In the afternoon, the cold sun painted the land golden.
Sitting cross-legged on the hotel balcony, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes. His gaze was icy cold, with a hint of brutality and fierceness, as if he was a terrifying human-shaped fierce beast.
However, this terrifying aura was only fleeting. When Jack Clark opened his eyes again, his gaze had become gentle as jade.
Finally starting to exert strength, huh?
Feeling the increasingly dense and terrifying warm current that was continuously strengthening his body, a faint smile appeared on Jack Clarks peerlessly handsome face.
From a ten-centimeter-long Six-legged Salamander to its current state, the Avatar had gradually begun to exert its power.
Aside from becoming more and more monstrous and gigantic, it also helped Jack Clarks body to grow in strength at a terrifying speed, quickly surpassing those esteemed geniuses of the same level.
Just now, his highest strength attribute had surpassed 400 points, with a physique of over 360. It had been just over half a month since the Sword Armor Beasts third evolution.
Of course, the rapid increase was also related to the group of Crystal Angelfish.
With abundant high-energy food, both the Avatar and the main body were growing rapidly. During this period, the evolution points had accumulated by several hundred points.
At that moment, all the students received a meeting message.. Jack Clark paused for a moment, What happened?

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 106: Strange Changes in the King's
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 106: Strange Changes in the Kings
City, Howard Lees Challenge (Extra for Warm Sun Alliance Master, Eleventh Chapter)
Translator: 549690339
In the evening, dozens of new students who had just finished their meeting flooded into the third-floor restaurant.
Some of these students looked hesitant, some excited, and others envious and regretful, discussing the situation in Kaierla in pairs or groups.
Justin Welan was also a bit excited, Jack, what do you think about us applying to go to Kaierla too?
Jack Clark thought for a moment, then shook his head slightly, Theres only half a month left in the trial, lets not get involved in this mess. Its a bit dangerous there.
With Koroyas new political system in place, most of the Evil God Sect cultists and rebels in the cities have been wiped out, and this trial is nearing its end.
A couple of days ago, Sylvia Lyons mentioned in the chat group that they would be able to return to the school by the end of the month.
The reason they have to wait for more than a dozen days is that there are still some scattered cultists and rebels hiding among ordinary people and in the deep mountain forests.
At the same time, there has been a resurgence in several major cities.
In particular, in the kings city of Kaierla, there suddenly emerged many Second Layer Heaven and Third Layer Heaven immortal disciples, as well as senior blood envoys of the Fifth and Sixth-level Heaven.
In addition, there were even fanatics and high-order bishops of the Fourth and Fifth Layer Heaven from the Giant God Sect, causing great chaos when they suddenly burst forth.
Although these Evil God Sect experts were quickly suppressed and defeated by the militarys strongmen, they also caused a lot of casualties.
Currently, the university teachers stationed in major cities have received orders to call in reinforcements.
The matter discussed by the three teachers, Sylvia Lyons, Jerrold West, and Emmitt Wesley, at the previous meeting was about this. Tomorrow morning, Sylvia Lyons and Jerrold West would fly to Kelter.
As for Emmitt Wesley, he will stay behind to hold the fort.
Students who have broken through the Third Realm could also apply to join the reinforcement mission, although no one had applied so far.
Justin Welan lamented when he realized that Jack did not want to go, But Crystal and the others want to sign up. Arent we missing out if we dont go?
Them, huh? Jack frowned slightly.
An hour ago, Crystal Leinster and the others in Kaleb Tuul city also received the notice, and team members Crystal Leinster, Mandy Leinster, Matt Watkins, and Freya Louise all wanted to sign up.
They spoke about it in the 3-9 Chat Group, but Jack and Justin were still in a meeting at the time.
Unlike Jack, who broke through a month ago, and Justin, who broke through more than half a month ago, Crystal and the others had made breakthroughs one after another in the past few days, with Freya being the latest three days before.
Of the students over there, only Maria Jenkins was a little short and could not go-
And its not just them.
Of the 57 South Sky Martial Height students participating in the trial, about half of them had broken through the Third Realm, excluding a few unlucky ones who were injured from the beginning and the one guy who died.
The rest, who had not yet made breakthroughs, were either at the peak of Second Heaven or in the late stage, and on the verge of entering the Third Realm.
While this number may seem exaggerated, it should be noted that these new students had spent most of their time in Koroya either fighting or on their way to battle, experiencing multiple life-and-death situations.
With the contribution points multiplier in place, its normal to achieve rapid progress by exchanging a large number of resources, compressing the breakthrough time of half a year to a year into two months.
Of course, the most unusual among these people is Jack, whose strength leap is even more exaggerated.
Just the fact that he had broken through to the middle phase of the Third Layer
Heaven in one month surpassed all most people.
Without knowing the exact progress of the monstrous Jane Aikens cultivation, Jack wouldnt dare to claim that his current realm is the highest.
But in terms of combat power, he is confident that he looks down upon all his classmates. Now, his physical strength is becoming more and more terrifying, and an ordinary early stage Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator might not even be able to withstand one of his strikes.
However, there were too many Evil God Sect experts hidden in Kelter this time, unlike in Lester City, where there were only small fries in the First and Second Heaven Realm.
Moreover, with the trial coming to an end and his avatar gradually gaining strength, he just wants to wait quietly for the trial to end and is no longer in a hurry for contribution points.
After all, once he breaks through the Four Layer Heaven a few months after returning, he will more or less complete his first year. And when his avatar continues to evolve for half a year, his strength will become incredibly terrifying when he participates in the Mutated Beast Trial as a sophomore the following year.
Easily slaying over a dozen Level 3 Mutant Beasts to collect 300 Contribution Points, he would be able to exchange high-grade Cultivation Methods and soar to the heavens.
Of course, there is also another reason: during the previous meeting, he had a fleeting feeling of intense danger when he accidentally thought of going to Kelter.
Justin Welan, unaware of these details, regretted, If youre not going, Jack, I wont go either. Theres no fun in showing off in front of Crystal and the others alone.
Jack was speechless, You are only at the third rank, what are you going to show off over there? Be careful, a Fifth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy might just slap you to death.
Justin Welan smirked, Heh Jack, dont underestimate me.
Feeling proud, Justin Welan said, Ive now fully absorbed the Thick Earth Qi, greatly increasing my defense. Even if its a Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator, I have confidence 1 can withstand it.
Your defense is indeed impressive, Jack admitted reluctantly.
About half a month ago, Justin Welans Mysterious Martial Thick Earth True Ability could withstand the attack of a golden-backed violent ape. With a trace of a king-level blood lineage, its combat strength was close to the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven at the time.
Of course, at that time, Justin Welan could only take on two consecutive attacks, and any more than that would get him smashed to death.
After dinner, the topic came up again in their team chat group.
Jack reminded, There are too many high-level experts in Kelter, so I dont recommend you guys go there. If you encounter a powerhouse above the Fifth Layer Heaven, you might not even have a chance to resist.
I think just the opposite.
