Matt Watkins chimed in, Right now, the militarys strongmen are in control of the kings city, and once the reinforcements converge tomorrow, their high-end power will be more than ten times that of the Evil God Sect cultists.
H
Under these circumstances, 1 think the risk level is actually quite low. At that time, we just need to follow behind and focus on dealing with ordinary blood disciples.
With our teams strength, we can easily defeat ordinary Third Layer Heaven blood disciples and have a chance to surround and kill Fourth Layer Heaven experts, gaining a lot of contribution.
Uh Matt Watkins, now I understand why your screen name is Why be a
Youth If Not Reckless.
Jack Clark didnt expect that this thick-browed and big-eyed guy, who looked sophisticated and calm, would actually be an adventurer, no wonder he had encouraged everyone to participate in the trial at first.
However, his words did indeed make the others feel tempted.
Crystal Leinster said, Weve thought about this issue and came to a conclusion that is not too different from what Matt Watkins said. With the numerous strong men gathered, Kaleb Tuul is the safest city.
We just have to follow behind and focus on the opposing ordinary cultists, and we can harvest a lot of Contribution Points.
At that time, when we return to school to consolidate our cultivation, we might have a chance to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven before the sophomore trial, far ahead of other classmates.
Freya Louise came out and asked curiously, Jack, you seem to not want us to go to Kaleb Tuul?
Jack Clark nodded, Well, I think everyone has made great progress in this trial, so theres no need to take risks. Just wait for the return with peace.
That flash of dangerous intuition in the afternoon just passed, and Jack Clark couldnt be sure if it was wrong.
After all, it was nearly a thousand kilometers away from Kaleb Tuul. Even if he told it to Crystal Leinster and the others, they wouldnt believe it since it was too exaggerated. So Jack Clark just advised from the side.
But this reason was obviously not enough. So after a little chat in the small study group, Crystal Leinster and the others decided to go anyway.
Seeing this, Jack Clark didnt say anything more, as everyone had their own stance.
The next morning, they were still at the old airport. Jack and others stood by the runway to see off teachers Sylvia Lyons and Jerrold West.
In addition to them, several Third Layer Heaven freshmen also decided to go for reinforcement.
They included Zac Lyons, who had just broken through not long ago, White Veil, as well as Mullen Weisz and Howard Lee, who had been practicing in seclusion for a long time.
After more than ten days in seclusion, Howard Lee, who absorbed the blood essence of the golden-backed violent ape, had an increasingly terrifying aura. His more than 2-meter height standing there was like a giant, full of oppression.
Looking at Jack Clark, Howard Lee was a little regretful, I didnt expect you to not sign up. I was even thinking about who could kill more blood disciples this time.
Im also a little surprised that you, who were the craziest to kill at that time, didnt go this time. Mullen Weisz, carrying a heavy sword, looked regretful.
Jack Clark smiled faintly, The main reason is that Ive recently made some breakthroughs in True Martial Arts cultivation and want to take some time to consolidate, so 1 dont plan to go to this muddy water.
As they talked, Justin Welan and Marcus Lee were also chatting with Zac Lyons and White Veil nearby.
They said something about Jack and Justin Welan not going and that their Killing Squad was dissolved. Jack Clark was a bit confused; when did he join a killing squad?
At that moment, Howard Lee suddenly said, Jack, would you like to have a match when we return?
A match? Jack raised his eyebrows.
Howard Lees eyes were full of Battle Intent, and he said solemnly, Yes, an all-out fight.
After more than ten days, the terrifying force of even just a trace of king-level blood essence in him had made great progress not only on his True Martial Arts Cultivation but also on his physical strength. His strength had surged dramatically.
But today, when he saw Jack again, Howard Lee felt that the unfathomable sense of oppression on him was still there.
It was obvious that it wasnt just him whose strength had surged, but also Jacks mysterious cultivation had made a terrifying improvement. This made Howard Lee become full of fighting spirit.
He really wanted to know how strong Jack really was.bender
Facing Howard Lees challenge, Jack Clark didnt avoid it. With a faint smile on his face, he nodded and said, Alright, lets find a time to have a match after we return.
Howard Lee was curious about Jacks strength, and likewise, Jack was also interested in his combat power after the continuous breakthroughs.
He was eager to know whose strength was stronger: his own steadily strengthening physique or the Innate Divine Strength Howard Lee, who had mastered the power-type cultivation methods.
After making a simple agreement, Howard Lee, Mullen Weisz, Zac Lyons, and White Veil followed Sylvia Lyons and boarded the plane one after another, taking off into the sky with a roar of engines.
As they watched the plane disappear into the horizon, Marcus Lee suddenly sighed, Time flies so fast. Its been almost two months in the blink of an eye.
Justin Welan nodded, Yeah, its so fast that weve broken through the Third Realm.
Jack Clark shook his head, Justin, I feel like youre not sighing, but showing off.
Hehe Did I show off? Justin Welans face was full of smugness.
By the way, Marcus Lee, why didnt you go this time?
Marcus Lee said naturally, Since Jack didnt go, something must be wrong. So I thought about it and decided not to go too.
Uh
This reason left Jack Clark speechless, Just dont blame me for making you earn fewer Contribution Points later.
Heh! You can only spend Contribution Points if youre alive.
This time, many Third Layer Heaven geniuses went to Kaleb Tuul, holding similar thoughts to Crystal and the others, thinking that it would be safer with a large number of strong men gathered there.
But Marcus Lee still held the same opinion as Jack Clark, that too many strong men might cause accidents.
This was not Lester City, where there were only a few Fourth Layer Heaven advanced cultivators around, and they were wiped out by the military as soon as they appeared.
After experiencing two months of trials of fire and blood, the group became more cautious as their strengths surged.
Including Jack, after witnessing the real combat power of senior strong men like Lori Parma and others, he became even more cautious and careful, losing that initial fearlessness.
Of course, this was just their thoughts; other people were even more proactive in trying to improve themselves by taking advantage of the pressure in Kaleb Tuul.
Amidst the laughter, the three of them walked out of the airport with other classmates who had come to see them off and boarded a dedicated vehicle to leave..

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 107: The Mountain Peak Collapses, The Battle of the Ninth Heavens (Added for Alliance Master Warm Sun, Twelve)
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 107: The Mountain Peak Collapses, The Battle of the Ninth Heavens (Added for Alliance Master Warm Sun, Chapter Twelve)
Translator: 549690339
With the departure of the two lively fellows, Zac Lyons and White Veil, Jack Clark felt the Hotel Base seemed a bit quieter.
However, this had no effect on him.
Back at the hotel, Jack Clark continued his cultivation, only slowing down because he was unwilling to exchange Contribution Points for more Energy Crystal Body, which affected his regular rate of cultivation.
During his cultivation, Jack found himself drawn into the consciousness of the Sword Armor Beast.
Under the sea surface, two hundred meters deep, the eight-meter-long Unique Beast lay hidden in the darkness. Its body was perfectly still, and even the fiery red, ghastly feather horns on both sides were slightly retracted.
Not far from it, three Crystal Corner Mutated Fish, each ten meters long, were patrolling their territory, searching for the dangerous creature that had continually attacked members of their species.
Over the past ten or so days, the Sword Armor Beast had almost wiped out over a dozen Crystal Corner Mutated Fish below nine meters long.
Under such circumstances, the slightly intelligent Mutated Fish became more vigilant. The remaining six ten-meter long Mutated Fish patrolled their territories daily.
On top of that, every day one of the three gigantic Mutated Fish, measuring fifteen, twenty, and twenty-three meters long respectively, would come out to patrol the surrounding sea area of a dozen kilometers.
But the ocean was not like the land; it was a three-dimensional space.
So, as long as the Sword Armor Beast stayed motionless on the pitch-black seabed hundreds of meters deep, those Crystal Corner Mutated Fish would not discover it.
Unless of course they happened to encounter each other face to face in close range due to bad luck.
It was only when the three Crystal Corner Mutated Fish moved away and the Sword Armor Beast perceived calm in the nearby water did it slightly move, “These guys are too vigilant. It’s not easy to kill them.”
Based on its perception, the Sword Armor Beast was confident that it could obliterate a single ten-meter long Crystal Corner Mutated Fish on its own.
However, handling the three gathered together would be a bit problematic. The energy attack speed of their freezing light beam was too fast, and the Sword Armor Beast couldn’t guarantee that it would be fine if it was frozen.
But if it were to attract a Crystal Corner Mutated Fish around ten or twenty meters long, even the Sword Armor Beast would find it troublesome.
After all, these creatures were not physically strong, but their energy attacks were incredibly powerful due to their high level. The cold light capable of freezing everything was something even the Sword Armor Beast was wary of.
“Forget it, let’s spare them for now.” After weighing his options, the Sword Armor Beast chose to turn around and leave them be, planning to eat them once its strength increased.
Under the dark deep sea, the equally dark and horrifying Variant Beast vanished in a blink of an eye.
With the speed of the Sword Armor Beast, it quickly left the sea area of several tens of kilometers and started to ascend as soon as it was far from the territory of the Crystal Corner Mutated Fish.
However, the ocean was the ocean. Just as the Sword Armor Beast swam up to a depth of over 50 meters, two ten-meter long Mutated White Sharks appeared in front.
Compared to regular White Sharks, these two mutated ones were huge, their bodies covered with grey armor-like scales, their mouths filled with sharp teeth.
The sunlight filtering through the water at this moment allowed the Sword Armor Beast to see far, but also made it easier for other fish to see it.
Thus, just as the black Variant Beast approached within dozens of meters, the two Mutated White Sharks noticed it.
Compared to these two muscular Mutated White Sharks, the Sword Armor Beast seemed somehow less intimidating although it had a ferocious look, its tail took up half its body.
Due to this, the two Variants swung their tails immediately, churned up turbulent seawater and charged towards the Sword Armor Beast creating a pincer attack. Their speed was incredibly fast.
Buzz!!
Just as they approached the Sword Armor Beast, the two Mutated White Sharks opened their mouths and an invisible ultrasonic roar exploded. The shockwave caused all the small fish and shrimp within a range of tens of meters to flop over, belly up.
Even the Sword Armor Beast was somewhat taken aback.
It didn’t expect that the White Sharks, despite not having vocal cords, would possess ultrasonic attack capabilities after mutation. The shock even left it a bit… unharmed.
Roar! The Sword Armor Beast unleashed a roar that was unlike a tiger yet eerily similar, the sound cutting through the sea water, echoing with an intangible sense of authority.
Amid the roar, the ferocious black Variant Beast flashed to the side, its left claw swiping with monstrous power hit the approaching Mutated Shark in the head. The terrifying force caused an explosion of seawater and flesh.
At the same time, its tail at the back swung like a divine dragon, tearing through the sea water like a black afterimage, and smacking hard into the head of the variant beast on its right. The pressure immediately caused its scales to explode and its flesh to burst open.
Originally, the tail strike was aimed to pierce through its skull, but the Mutated White Shark reacted quickly and dodged the bone spur that could have killed it instantly.
Even so, the horrible force carried by the black tail still sent the Mutated White Shark flying, causing it to roll over and over in the sea water.
Splutter! The instant the right Mutated White Shark was sent flying, the Sword Armor Beast burst forward with terrifying speed. Within the blink of an eye, it was right in front of the stunned White Shark on the left.
Its forelimbs’ muscles suddenly bulged, and in an instant, a terrifying force converged from all over its body. Its two claws descended like a palm.
Boom!
Material-like force exploded in the sea water, a circle of white shockwave detonating in the sea. The head of the Variant White Shark, even larger than a sedan car, instantly burst open.
Immediately, dense blood and white matter spurted out, painting the surrounding sea water red.
While its body belonged to a Variant Beast, the Sword Armor Beast’s main consciousness was still Jack Clark. Therefore, whenever it attacked its prey, it preferred attacking the head, back, belly, and other vulnerable spots.
Just as the Sword Armor Beast instant-killed a Mutated White Shark, the other one sensed the violent aura radiated by it when it released its power for the attack. A sense of escape instinct arose.
This instinct was like a seal encountering a Tiger Whale with no courage left to fight back.
Following its instinct, the Mutated White Shark wanted to escape. But just as it turned around, a shadow flashed in the sea water. The next second, the menacing Sword Armor Beast appeared before it.
After three evolutions, the body structure of the Sword Armor Beast had been optimised and adjusted, making its speed in the water extremely terrifying.
Buzz!
Seeing an escape was impossible, the Mutated White Shark’s eyes turned blood red and it went into a battle frenzy. It gave out another ultrasonic attack, opening its huge mouth to reveal hundreds of fang-like teeth.
Thud!
The Sword Armor Beast grabbed the upper and lower jaws of the white shark with its two claws. Its terrifying strength prevented it from closing them, and simultaneously, their huge bodies collided. The surrounding sea water churned with rolling waves.
Bump! Bump! Bump! Bump!! Struggling with its mouth gripped, the Mutated White Shark wriggled its body furiously, releasing astonishing power, but…
Slash! Accompanied by the muscular expanding claws of the Sword Armor Beast, with its terrifying strength it rips directly through the head of the white shark. Blood burst out in an instant.
In just a bit, the sea water within dozens of meters was dyed red with the gushing blood of the two mutant white sharks.
In the blood-stained sea water, an eight-meter long black fearsome unique beast slowly surfaced, revealing its terrifyingly violent aura, like a king of all unique beasts.
And when the Sword Armor Beast was devouring the white shark’s flesh and blood, on the hotel balcony, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, frowning slightly.
“It’s just a Level Two Variant Beast.”
Through the energy embedded in the flesh and blood, Jack Clark could confirm that the two mutant white sharks, about ten meters long, were merely at a late-stage Level Two, hence why they were so easily killed.
But they were quite powerful for Level Two Variant Beasts evolved with supersonic abilities. It appears that even after mutation, sharks remain formidable creatures.
At the same time, Jack Clark keenly noticed that in the ocean, one cannot fully judge a creature’s level based on size, especially those marine life that are innately large.
But the two Level Two white sharks weren’t completely useless. At least after eating tthem, the size of the Sword Armor Beast had increased significantly, and Jack Clark’s Four Major Attributes had also increased by one point.
Also, he had gained two more Evolution Points.
While Jack Clark was engrossed in his hunting and food,
Thousands of miles away from him, countless powerful individuals had converged on Erica Knowles.
Eastern Summer had 72 first-class universities altogether and even more secondary and tertiary institutions. Each leader of a university was an advanced cultivator of the Sixth-level Heaven.
Especially the top-class schools, such as South Sky Martial Height, had up to six teachers leading the way, all at the peak of the Six Heavens or in the Seventh Heaven.
In such a situation, the number of elite powerhouses gathered in Erica Knowles was enormous.
That night, a terrifying battle broke out in the mountains, tens of kilometers away from Kelter. The skies were filled with shining light, shaking rumbles and ground-shattering impacts.
Even a mountain peak was completely destroyed.
The next morning, the chat group ‘Three Nine’ was going crazy.
“@Jack Clark, @Justin Welan, you missed out a lot by not coming.”
Matt Watkins was a bit excited: “An action from the peak powerhouse of the Ninth Heavens occurred last night. Even tens of kilometers apart, the fear-inspiring power was palpable, too scary.”
Crystal Leinster also exclaimed: “I know they said that the peak powerful individuals could strike down an aircraft carrier and ignore the surrounding warships and bombings. I originally thought it was an exaggeration.”
Justin Welan popped out, saying in shock: “Such powerful individuals have actually appeared this time, how can this be? Isn’t it said that the top strong ones are not in this world?”
Mandy Leinster said gently, “It is said that a fallen individual from the Ninth
Heaven has emerged. The powerhouse came to counter him.”
Freya Louise also said, “Last night, many high-ranking powerhouses from the Seventh and Eighth Heavens emerged as well. They were walking in the air, jointly besieging the bishop and god envoy of the Evil God Sect.”
“The scene was too grand last night. Fortunately, we chose to come; otherwise, we wouldn’t have seen this spectacle.” Matt Watkins continued to provoke them.
Justin Welan was a bit sour, “What scene, you think you can fool me? The range of the high-ranking powerhouses is too great. You small prawns don’t dare to go close.”
“Let alone see it, as soon as you get close, the terror of the True Martial Will could severely injure you.”
Matt Watkins, who was exposed, was a bit awkward: “Although we couldn’t see it, we could feel that terrifying power.”
“And we didn’t come out empty-handed. While those high-ranking powerhouses were besieging the strong individuals from the Evil God Sect, we went after those ordinary cultists.”
At this moment, Jack Clark curiously asked, “How so? What did you get?”
Though he was a bit curious about the grand scene from last night, he didn’t envy them at all since even the peak powerhouse of the Ninth Heaven had appeared.
Such powerhouses were rumored to be capable of crushing mountains and valleys, and their flesh bodies could move at supersonic speeds. Whenever they fought, it spanned a distance of tens of kilometers.
In such a situation, daring to watch is just seeking death.
“Not much, I only killed two cultists at the Second Layer Heaven, and one at the Third Layer Heaven.” Matt Watkins was a bit proud, completely dropping his steady and shrewd mask.
Crystal Leinster, “I’ve killed one cultist at the Second Layer Heaven and one at the Third Layer Heaven.”
Mandy Leinster, “Two cultists at the Third Layer Heaven.”
Freya Louise, “A Blood Envoy at the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“Freya Louise, you’ve actually killed a Blood Envoy at the Fourth Layer Heaven!” Justin Welan was surprised.
The Blood Envoys are not weak after absorbing high-level blood seeds. Even when faced with talents of the same level, they have an advantage. Considering that Freya Louise just broke through the Third Realm…
Freya Louise, “[Blinking Eyes] I was lucky. That Blood Envoy was injured by some advanced cultivator. Even so, I exhaused an Armour-Piercing bullet.”
Alright, forget that their weapons are unique. With her special sniper cannon and high-damage bullets, combined with a special cultivation method that decreases her presence and a mask killing intent,
She is naturally an assassin.
In addition to their well-divided responsibilities within their four-member team, with Crystal Leinster, Mandy Leinster and Matt Watkins fighting on the front lines, while Freya Louise secretly looking for high places from where to snipe
This meant that they were invincible in Kaleb Tuul city, having killed more cultists and rebel cultivators than Jack Clark and his team, boasting illustrious accomplishments.
At this moment, Jack Clark asked, “Were all the strong individuals of the Evil God Sect all killed?”
Crystal Leinster replied, “No, it’s hard to kill powerhouses of that level if they want to escape, especially some lunatics who would explode herself at a disagreement, making people wary.”
“It is said that in the end, one-tenth of the strong individuals from the Evil God
Sect managed to escape. However, most of them were heavily injured.”
Jack Clark frowned, “In this case, be careful for the next operation over there.”
“Okay, we understand..”

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 108: Sword Armor Beast Injured, Deep Sea Black Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 108: Sword Armor Beast Injured, Deep Sea Black Dragon
Translator: 549690339
Because of Freya Louise and the others, Jack Clark paid a bit more attention to
Erica Knowles situation and occasionally asked about their situation in the group chat.
He didnt know why those Evil God Sect members were so crazy, but battles erupted outside of Kroya City for the next few days.
Apart from that, many blood disciples and cultists infiltrated the city at the cost of their own lives, attacked key Kroya official figures, and caused explosions, creating a great deal of chaos.
However, these desperate counterattacks from the Evil God Sect couldnt shake the local situation.
There were some strong men stationed in the city, with Triplex geniuses patrolling and hunting, and outside the city, there were Sixth-Level and even Seventh-level high-order powerhouses taking action.
Moreover, each time these powerhouses appeared in groups of ten, an astonishing number.
Top-tier powerhouses above the Seventh Layer were also occasionally seen under the Heaven and Earth Trap, locating and killing one after another. The situation gradually stabilized.
This chaotic situation didnt stabilize until five days later.
Seeing this, Jack Clark gradually stopped paying attention to that side and shifted his focus back to the Sword Armor Beast.
On December 25th, less than a week before the end of the trial, the Sword Armor Beast, now nine meters long, was slowly swimming under the 300-meter deep sea, completely covered in black with a row of sharp, long spines on its back.
As it grew, the Sword Armor Beasts appearance became increasingly fierce and majestic, with a slight resemblance to the dragons in myths and legends.
Of course, it was only a slight resemblance.
At this time, several hundred meters in front of it, a 17-meter-long, flat-bodied Mutated fish with a seven-meter-long saw-toothed structure was hunting.
The prey was a group of eight-meter-long Mutated bull sharks.
This Mutated saw-toothed fish was very fast, like a sharp blade cutting through the sea water, leaving behind bisected shark corpses in its wake.
Within a short period, more than ten bull shark heads were killed, and their thick blood turned the surrounding seawater red. It exuded a strong, bloody smell.
It seemed that this Mutated fish bore a grudge against the bull sharks.
After killing all the sharks, it only ate a bit of the organs and then swam about, watching as small fishes attracted by the bloody smell nibbled at the bull shark corpses.
However, as it swam, it didnt realize that another Mutated Beast was watching it from afar.
Through the Sword Armor Beasts observation, this Mutated saw-toothed fishs strength was very strong, and its ability was likely related to its speed. It was no less fast than the Sword Armor Beast in its normal explosive state.
Furthermore, whenever there was a strong wave of energy on its body, dark arcs of light would shoot out from its teeth, and the rays were extremely sharp, cutting prey apart with ease.
Nevertheless, even so, the Sword Armor Beast was prepared to hunt it down.
With each meal and growth, its entire body cells would divide and compress, so its density became increasingly terrifying, and its strength naturally grew increasingly fearsome.
In addition to the three major Talents of Strength, Defense, and Speed, Jack Clark had recently discovered other abilities of the Sword Armor Beast.
For example, the seemingly decorative feather horns on either side, which, after multiple evolutions, had developed a Perception function. This allowed it to perceive objects far away through subtle disturbances in seawater.
This was also the reason why it could hide in the depths of the dark sea and detect and observe the Mutated saw-toothed fish from afar.
The Sword Armor Beast was like an excellent hunter. Its tail moved slightly, weakly stirring up water waves, and it slowly approached from directly below.
Boom!
An explosion occurred in the deep sea water: the Sword Armor Beast violently shot out like a dark sharp arrow, surging upwards.
Enveloped by a strong sense of crisis, the huge body of the saw-toothed fish twisted abruptly, like a noodle bending into a C shape, barely evading the Sword Armor Beasts sudden
Splash!!
In the moment it brushed past, the Sword Armor Beasts sharp claws slashed and tore through scales, leaving four wounds several meters long and 0.5 meters deep on the waist of the saw-toothed fish.
Blood flowed, and the intense pain as the seawater licked its wounds infuriated the Mutated saw-toothed fish. Its blood-red eyes were filled with brutality, glaring at the Sword Armor Beast, tens of meters above it.
The low-intelligence creature couldnt understand why this black thing, which was more than twice smaller than itself, dared to attack it.
Regardless, it was determined to rip the black creature apart.
In a frenzy, a powerful wave of energy was emitted from the saw-toothed fishs body. The seawater behind it exploded, and it accelerated instantly to pounce towards the Sword Armor Beast above its head.
The moment it closed in on the Sword Armor Beast, several dark arcs of light shot out from its seven-meter-long saw-teeth, as if sharp blades of light were tearing through the sea water.
But the Sword Armor Beast was even faster, its dark form flashing far away in an instant.
It had no choice. Those dark arcs of light were too sharp, and the Sword Armor Beast did not want to be sawed directly without knowing whether they could harm it.
Whiz whiz whiz!!
The two Mutated Beasts charged and tore through the sea, causing towering waves at a terrifying speed, and in the blink of an eye, they reached the sea surface.
Bang!
Suddenly, the sea waves violently exploded, and the huge saw-toothed fish soared into the sky with a vicious, dark Sword Armor Beast beneath it.
After about ten minutes of struggle, the Sword Armor Beast finally found an opportunity to shoot it up from below, sending it flying more than ten meters into the air with nowhere to leverage itself.
In mid-air, the Sword Armor Beast extended its double claws, grabbing the abdomen of the saw-toothed fish tightly. The two Mutated Beasts then slammed into the ocean with a loud crash, splashing water dozens of meters high.
Being held by the Sword Armor Beast, the saw-toothed fish struggled fiercely in the ocean. Despite exerting a terrible force of hundreds of tons with the waving of its head and tail, it couldnt shake off the Sword Armor Beast beneath it.
In this situation, the Sword Armor Beast, possessing flexible limbs, held an absolute advantage.
Splash! Splash!
The Sword Armor Beast clung tightly to its abdomen, its ferocious mouth biting and tearing nonstop. Under the powerful bite force and sharp teeth, the thick scales shattered with each bite.With every bite, the Sword Armor Beast tore off several hundred kilograms of flesh and blood from the saw-toothed fish.
In the blink of an eye, a huge bloody hole was bitten into the belly of the saw-toothed fish, with countless blood spurting out, mixed with some organs. Gradually, the struggle of the saw-toothed fish became weaker and weaker.
A few minutes later, the huge corpse of the saw-toothed fish floated on the sea surface, sinking and floating with the waves, while the surrounding sea water was dyed red by its flowing blood.
However, the Sword Armor Beast that killed this ferocious Mutated Beast did not immediately eat it but turned its head to look at its left hind leg.
There were several 0.5-meter-long wounds there.
The mutated saw-toothed fish still managed to cause damage to the Sword Armor Beast even at the last moment of its life. The razor-sharp black saw teeth left a light injury on the beast.
Three of the attacks left a centimeter-deep scar on the back shell, and the outer layer of the weaker hind leg was cut in half.
Fortunately, its Defensive Talent was strong enough, and the scales were solid. This incomparably sharp energy blade did not hurt the muscle underneath.
Compared to the previous injury, this one was the most serious one the
Sword Armor Beast had ever incurred since its evolution.
After all, back when it first entered the sea, the tail thorn of the mutated catfish only shattered a small piece of the outer bone shell.
However, what shocked the Sword Armor Beast was not the small wound but the fact that the damaged outer bone scales were healing at a visible speed.
In just a few minutes, the four cracks had recovered to their original state.
This terrifying recovery power even surprised Jack Clark. Could it be that the regeneration ability of the Six-legged Salamander has become stronger after three evolutions?
Moreover, this regeneration was not only for the flesh and blood but also had an amazing effect on its outer bone scales.
Pondering, the Sword Armor Beast dragged the corpse of the mutated saw-toothed fish and sank it, disappearing from the sea surface in the blink of an eye.
Kilometers away on the sea surface, a steel battleship over 300 meters long was sailing, with various giant ship guns and missile launchers all over it.
In addition to that, there was even a 20-meter-long, futuristic-looking weapon resembling a laser cannon or electromagnetic device in the middle of the ship.bender
At this moment, several military officers were standing on the command platform, looking at the sea surface where the Sword Armor Beast and the saw-toothed fish disappeared. One middle-aged man was astonished and asked, Was that black Unique Beast a dragon just now?
Another one shook his head and laughed, How could it be? Dragons are just a myth. Even in the mythical world, there are no real divine dragons.
Of course, if you really want to count, some terrifying giant beasts with dragon-like forms in that world can be considered real dragons in some sense.
Even in terms of power, they are more terrifying than the dragons in myths.
The one just now should be a Jiaolong-like beast that awakened its ancestors traits after mutation. However, its strength is impressive, as it can hunt down mutated fish of such a large size.
Another middle-aged man sighed, The sea is getting more and more dangerous, with mutated creatures lurking everywhere, and their size is enormous.
If these Mutated Beasts could, like the Unique Beasts on land, maintain the ecosystem by constantly hunting down powerful Unique Beasts, it would be fine. But the sea is too deep and vast; humans cannot get involved.
I feel like at this rate, in less than thirty years, the ocean will be out of control.
Yes, the other two also looked solemn.
Forget it, lets not talk about this. Those higher-ups will have enough headaches dealing with this. Our mission this time is crucial, so lets keep moving.
As the giant ship turned into a small black dot, a black Unique Beast suddenly emerged from the sea, looking at the direction the ship was leaving in astonishment.
Is this the navy battleship of this world? It looks so powerful.
While sighing in wonder, the Sword Armor Beast reached out with its left claw, and a pure, dazzling crystal appeared, which turned out to be a Level 4 Life Crystal.
The Sword Armor Beast didnt risk getting injured and killed the mutated saw-toothed fish just for the richly energized flesh and blood, but also for the possible existence of Life Crystals.
Jack Clark had always wanted to test whether Life Crystals were useful to the Sword Armor Beast.
If they were useless, the Life Crystals obtained by the Sword Armor Beast in the future could be kept and converted into Attribute points for him. But if they were useful, they would have to be allocated rationally.
Thinking of this, the Sword Armor Beast directly ate the crystal.
Just as the Life Crystal entered its stomach, a majestic Life Energy exploded within the Sword Armor Beasts body. The cells all over its body began to divide and compress crazily.
In just a few minutes, the body of the Sword Armor Beast grewlarger, and its body length increased by ten centimeters, which was almost equivalent to its growth after a day of hunting.
In addition, the Evolution value under the attribute page also surged by 30 points.
The result left Jack Clark stunned and then, with a bitter smile.
The reason for the shock was that the effect of the Sword Armor Beast eating the Life Crystal was excellent, even more exaggerated than purely devouring the flesh and blood of Mutated Beasts.
The bitter smile was also due to the excellent effect.
A Level 4 Life Crystal not only caused the Sword Armor Beasts body size to grow dramatically, but also increased its Evolution value by several dozen points, which was no less than his conversion into Attribute points.
However, since this growth could also be accumulated by eating meat, the Life Crystals obtained later could be kept and taken back after the trial was over
On the balcony, as Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes while sitting cross-legged, a trace of ruthlessness flashed across his eyes, and an intangible heavy aura radiated from him, causing the air to become somewhat stagnant.
As his physique was continuously strengthened and its density increased over time, his basic strength had already exceeded the limit of Fourth Layer Heaven and could be compared to a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator.
However, this comparison was only based on basic strength and did not represent his combat power, as after reaching the Third Layer Heaven, the focus of cultivators shifted to True Strength.
Simply put, the physical body was like a giant steel battleship, and True Martial was like the power system and weapons mounted on it.
A larger, more robust battleship could carry a more powerful power reactor and more, stronger weapons along with sufficient ammunition depots. Both were indispensable.
As for his current combat strength, Jack, who had not taken action for more than half a month, had no idea.
Thinking of this, Jack lowered his head and clenched his fists, feeling the strength that had grown a bit stronger following the growth of the Sword Armor Beast and smiled..

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 109: Physical Talent, Freya Louise Heavily Injured
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 109: Physical Talent, Freya Louise Heavily Injured
Translator: 549690339
As Jack Clark stood hands akimbo by the balcony, gazing down thoughtfully below.
The door to the room opened, and a sweat-drenched Justin Welan walked in, saying cheerfully, “Jack, you’ve finished your cultivation, huh? Too bad you weren’t at the training field just now.”
“Otherwise, you would have seen the dismal look on Marcus Lee’s face, hahahaha.”
Justin Welan was delighted, he couldn’t help it. He was hammered off the martial arts arena by more than a dozen strikes from Marcus Lee in the freshman ranking tournament, and he would hold this grudge for a lifetime.
But now, only two or three months have passed, and both have broken through to the Third Layer Heaven, but the situation has reversed.
Earlier on the training field, the two of them were practicing against each other, and he stood still, allowing Marcus Lee to gather his strength up to the thirty-six hammer limits of the Chaos Heavy Hammer, but he was unable to shake the defense of the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth.
Jack suddenly turned around and asked, “Did you beat him?”
“…” Justin Welan’s smile froze on his face in an instant.
Justin Welan was speechless: “Jack, you will offend people with your talk.”
Jack just smiled.
Justin demonstrated his terrifying defense when he was hunting the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King in the previous period.
But extreme defense also reveals some weaknesses, such as the mediocrity of instant explosive movement speed, and his insufficient damage to enemies.
At this point, Justin came to the balcony, suddenly looked at Jack with a puzzled gaze: “Jack, let’s be honest, did you have another breakthrough in your strength?”
Knowing that he has a keen sense of Qi, Jack didn’t hide it, and nodded vaguely saying, “Well, not bad, there’s ‘a bit’ of progress.”
Justin rolled his eyes: “Modesty, keep being modest, do you think I don’t know that your strength is now several times stronger than it was at the beginning of the month?”
Because they all live in the same room, he has been sensitive to the increasingly terrifying aura emanating from Jack’s body these days.
He knows his strength has been greatly improving every day, although he is unaware of the specific progress.
Moreover, because everyone has been making less progress due to the lack of contribution points in this period, it is a bit strange that Jack’s strength is still growing rapidly compared to them.
Therefore, Justin suspects that Jack might have awakened some physical talent, just like Howard Lee’s Innate Divine Strength.
This situation has occurred many times in the cultivation world. Many people who only have average talent for Foundation Establishment start to accelerate their strength progression after they start cultivating, shining brightly.
At this point, Justin changed the subject and said with relief, “Fortunately we didn’t go to Erica Knowles, the class leader said in the group chat earlier that two geniuses died yesterday.”
“What a pity, they broke through to the Third Layer Heaven after cultivating for three or four months. If these geniuses do not die, they are expected to be at least Seventh Layer heaven powerhouses in the future.”
“Since ancient times, gains and risks coexist. Those who kill will always be killed.”
Jack said indifferently, “Those geniuses went to Erica Knowles and made as many contributions as we had for the previous two months in just over ten days.”
“But high returns often come with high risks,”
“After all, some of those in the Evil God Sect are also very strong, especially those blood envoys who have fused with high-level Blood Seeds. Every one of them has undergone mutations.”
More than 300 geniuses who have broken through the Third Layer Heaven in this period, including Crystal Leinster and her three friends, went to support Erica Knowles.
Compared to them who team up and move in groups, many of the geniuses from dozens of first-class martial arts schools are lone rangers, or teams of two or three people.
Under such circumstances, it would not be bad if they met an ordinary Third Layer Heaven believer, but if they met a fanatic or a Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy, even they would not fare well.
This is also why Jack didn’t want to go initially. There are numerous powerful practitioners there, and the risks have exceeded his estimates.
The federal top level also noticed this situation, but no one cared, including the Ninth Heaven Peak power.
After all, they have already reduced all possible dangers to the lowest level, and at the same time, they have informed the risks about the Koroya Trial, including this support for Erica Knowles.
Under such circumstances, come if you want to come, don’t force it if you don’t want to.
The official can only provide all the basic preparations. How far you can grow depends on your own chance. If you want more resources, go and fight, fight, push yourself to the limit and stand at the forefront of the times.
If they die in such circumstances, it just means that it was fated to be so.
The world has never lacked geniuses.
They are not nannies, they also have their stuff to do, and this time in order to deal with the invasion of the Blood God Sect and the Giant God Sect, several high-ranking powerhouses fell.
Those people were geniuses back then.
However, Crystal Leinster and the others were lucky enough to survive without danger, even after some close encounters, only receiving minor injuries at most.
On the other hand, White Veil, Zac Lyons, and Mullen Weisz, who went there at the same time, have already been injured several times, almost died when White Veil encountered a blood envoy in the early stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven three days ago.
White Veil is still lying in the hospital, because he’s not willing to use contribution points to exchange for advanced healing resources.
As for Howard Lee, after absorbing the Essence Blood of the golden-backed violent ape, his strength reached a higher level and directly killed two early-stage Fourth Layer Heaven fanatics, making a name for himself.
Justin suggested, “Jack, we’re going back in a few days, do you want to go shopping for some local products together this afternoon?”
“… Sure.” Jack nodded.
Time flew by, and he had been out for almost two months. To be honest, he did miss home a bit.
Justin grinned, “Alright. Let’s have our meal first, and then we’ll also call Marcus.”
After this trial, Jack has gotten quite closer to several people from the school. They were comrades in arms who have fought side by side and faced danger together.
In the afternoon, the three of them drove an off-road vehicle to the mall in the city center.
With the passage of two months, Lester City’s economy has recovered. Although their only department store wasn’t crowded, there were still people everywhere.
“Gentlemen, the wood carvings in this store are one of the specialties of our area. The store has been open for decades, and you can take a look to see if there are any styles you like,”The store manager, with a broad smile on his face, led Jack Clark and the others into an art-inspired wood carving shop.
The sales assistant inside hurried over upon seeing them, nervously saying, “Welcome, feel free to look around. If you see anything you like, let me know, and I’ll get it for you.”
Well, it couldn’t be helped. Even without considering the imposing figures of Marcus Lee and Justin Welan, their black uniforms with red edges alone were enough to command an invisible deterrent here.
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “No need to rush, we’re just having a look.”
At that moment, Justin Welan approached a black-gold statue half-human in height with interest, “Jack, this carving of a Wind Splitter Tiger is not bad, you could buy it to place on your desk.”
The salesperson immediately began explaining, “You have a good eye for a customer. The wood used for this sculpture is Mutant Steel Wood, heavy as iron and resistant to insects, and it has a faint sandalwood scent.”
“After being carved with care by one of our masters, it perfectly replicates the aura of the high-level mutant beast, the Wind Splitter Tiger, and has great ornamental value.”
Jack Clark glanced at him, “Such a big thing, can you carry it easily?”
H
Uh… I guess so.”
Just then, Marcus Lee picked up a delicate wood carving the size of his palm that resembled a Mutant Dragon Lizard, “1 think this one is good. I’m sure my sister will love it.”
“You have a sister, Marcus?” Justin Welan expressed surprise.
Marcus Lee replied gruffly, “Rubbish, is it strange for me to have a sister?”
“It’s not really strange. It’s just, are you sure your sister will like this sculpture of a Mutant Dragon Lizard?”
While the two of them were bantering, Jack Clark took a liking to a wood carving about 30 centimeters tall. It was a sculpture of a furious mountain giant ape standing by the hill.
The person who carved it was very skilled. The ape’s fur seemed as realistic as a live beast. Its expression filled with rage and violence, and it looked just like a real Mutant Beast.
Next, led by the manager, the men visited other shops. For Doris Raven, Jack Clark bought a golden necklace with dazzling gemstones.
After the onset of the Transcendent Era, the prices of gold and gemstones have been decreasing year by year. Now, they can barely maintain the status of ordinary luxury goods.
There were also a few other goods.
After buying some local specialties, Jack Clark and his friends returned to cultivating, waiting for the trials to end.
However…
At eleven in the evening, as Jack Clark was relentlessly slaughtering the mutated beasts under the sea, he and Justin Welan’s mobile phones vibrated, someone was @ing them.
“Who is looking for me at this hour?
ii
With a puzzled look on his face, Justin picked up his mobile phone. Suddenly, his face changed, and he sat up, “Jack, something’s gone wrong. Freya Louise is badly hurt.”
“What!”
Jack Clark on the bed, who had his eyes closed, suddenly opened them and sat up. As he turned his head towards Justin Welan, a terrifying murderous intent flashed in his eyes which were still immersed in the Sword Armor Beast state, startling him.
“Jack Clark, don’t scare me. They’re only injured, not dead.”
Jack Clark took a deep breath, his eyes blinked slightly; when they opened again, they had returned to normal. His brows crinkled, “Did they say exactly what happened?”
“No, Mandy just @ed us in the group chat, saying that everyone had been injured and was in the hospital. She didn’t say anything else after that”.
Jack Clark said in a deep voice, “I’ll give her a call and ask.”
Normally they wouldn’t contact each other by phone, unsure whether the other party was on an outbound mission or cultivating. If they needed to communicate, they would just do it in the group chat.
Jack Clark scrolled through the list of team contact numbers he had saved, found Mandy’s number, and immediately dialed. The call was answered after two rings.
“Mandy, what’s the situation over there?”
Mandy on the other end of the line chuckled bitterly, “The target was us this time. A high-ranking Blood Envoy in the Mid-Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven who excels in stealth and assassinations.”
“The reason we were targeted was because we killed his brother—the Blood Envoy that was assassinated by Freya on our first day in Koroya.”
“…” Jack Clark paused, had not expected this.
Pausing, Jack Clark spoke in a grave voice: “What is the current condition of Freya and the others? Is there any danger to their lives?”
“My sister and Matt Watkins weren’t severely injured. After using Mysterious Jade Pulp, they have largely recovered. However, Freya got injured rather badly, her heart got impacted.”
“Although the Mysterious Jade Pulp has fixed most of the external injuries, the shaking of her heart has resulted in Qi Blood deficiency, so she needs to rest in the hospital for a while.”
“You don’t need to worry about safety. This is the core area of the Federation. As long as the Blood Envoy dares to approach within a kilometer, he will be detected.”
Jack Clark’s brows slightly creased, “Koroya has many high-level, and even high-ranking powerhouses. How did the culprit manage to run away after attacking you in the city?”
Mandy replied with a bitter smile, “I don’t know what happened, but a large number of strong people were transferred away from Kelter yesterday. Currently, only ten teachers are stationed.”
“However, after learning that there is still one Fourth Layer Heaven’s Blood Envoy, Howard Lee and the others are conducting a city-wide search. The situation now is not clear.”
Jack Clark then asked about some details, and only after getting all the answers did he hang up the phone, falling silent.
In actuality, he had entered the Heart’s Eye Realm, letting his mind wander. Jack focused on sensing his intuition when he thought about going to Koroya.
Perhaps it was because the situation there had already almost concluded, so this time, the intuition in his mind did not react.
Jack Clark opened his eyes, speaking deeply, “Old Justin, let’s head to Koroya.”
Justin’s eyes lit up, “I knew you would want to go, Jack. The guy who dare injured the squad leader and Freya Louise is done.”
After knowing that they weren’t in any life-threatening situation, Justin Welan also grew more relaxed.
Jack Clark glanced at him, spoke lightly, “We’re all classmates and we get along well. Naturally, we should go and see them since they are now injured.”
“I understand, I understand.” Justin Welan grinned, “I understand.”
“Understand your head, get up and pack your bags ASAP. After packing, I will go find Professor Zhao. You go and borrow a modified off-road vehicle from the base next door..”

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - no: Descending upon Erica Knowles, Found You
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter no: Descending upon Erica Knowles, Found You
Translator: 549690339
It was 11:30 at night.
Seeing Jack Clark suddenly come to him, Emmitt Wesley suggested, “We don’t have any transport planes in Lester now, so if you want to go to Erica Knowles, you’ll have to drive yourselves.”
“However, the road conditions in Koroya are a bit tricky, so you’d better be prepared.”
Jack Clark nodded, “Yeah, we know, and we’ve already rented a modified off-road vehicle from the base. We just need you to report it for us, sir.”
As the trial recruits of the Special Forces, Jack and his team needed approval to leave Lester, otherwise their sudden disappearance would cause some trouble.
So they sought out Emmitt Wesley late at night, saying a close classmate was injured and they needed to go see him.
Emmitt Wesley smiled slightly, “Since you’ve already made preparations, be careful on the road.”
After talking with Emmitt Wesley, Jack Clark and Justin Welan, who had rented the car, went back to their room, put on their battle armor, picked up their weapons, and left with their luggage in tow.
Despite the fact that most of Koroya was now relatively stable, the two were still fully armed for safety.
However, as the two of them rode the elevator out of the hotel, they saw Marcus Lee, also fully armed, carrying a heavy hammer and grinning while waiting for them in front of the modified off-road vehicle.
“Jack, Mr. Willard, it’s so unfair of you guys not to tell me you were going to Erica Knowles.”
Justin Welan was speechless, “We’re going to kill someone, not play. Do you think you can handle a Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage Blood Envoy sneak attack?”
Marcus Lee turned serious, “1 know, it’s because of what happened to Crystal Leinster and the others. The news is all over the Trial Class Group now.”
“Although I can’t handle a Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage Blood Envoy’s sneak attack, 1 can hide! Besides, the more people, the stronger we are. What if I find him first?”
“If you want to come, just get in the car,” Jack interrupted. “You don’t need to do anything at the time, just leave it to me. It’s just a Fourth Layer Heaven after all.”
Saying that, Jack threw his suitcase and long knife into the back of the extended off-road compartment before getting into the driver’s seat and starting the car.
After his breakthrough in the Dragon Elephant Limit Enhancement, Jack estimated that his fighting prowess, including the activation of runes, was around the Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage.
Now, with his base attributes increased even more over the past two weeks, a Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage would not be unbeatable.
“Damn, Jack, you’re amazing! ‘Just a Fourth Layer Heaven,’ huh? We’ll kill him for sure.” Marcus Lee grinned and hurriedly got into the car.
Soon, accompanied by the roar of the engine, the elongated off-road vehicle disappeared into the night.
Just as Emmitt Wesley had said, the roads in Koroya were terrible.
As a backward country, Koroya had only a single National Highway connecting its major cities even before the chaos. After the chaos, many bridges and road sections were destroyed and blown up.
So, even with satellite navigation, it took Jack and his teammates a full day to drive the more than 700 kilometers, arriving near Erica Knowles the next afternoon.
Justin Welan rubbed his sore neck as he looked at the retreating road signs, “Finally, we’re almost there.”
Marcus Lee nodded in agreement, “Yeah, finally.”
Bumping along for a day and a night, they ate dry food when hungry and slept in the truck when tired. Even as cultivators, they felt somewhat uncomfortable.
In contrast, Jack, who had been focused on driving all day, didn’t feel as uncomfortable as his comrades, mainly because his physique was far superior to theirs.
As the sun set, a huge city appeared before the trio’s eyes.
Compared to Lester, which felt like something from the Eighties, Erica Knowles had a more modern vibe, with skyscrapers dominating the cityscape and the roads being much wider and smoother.
Overall, it reminded Jack of the early 2000s, with a touch of prosperity.
As they approached the city, more vehicles began appearing on the highway, along with people walking on the roadside.
However, once inside the city, Jack and his two friends could keenly sense the lingering scent of blood and fire.
Many damaged buildings were cordoned off, with excavators and other machinery tearing them down nearby. Some roads were barely passable due to the severe damage.
In addition, there were large black scorch marks on some buildings, uprooted trees by the roadside that had yet to be dealt with, and Koroya soldiers stationed every few steps.
Following the address, Jack drove the off-road vehicle to a hospital in the south of the city, only to be stopped by the soldiers at the entrance.
“This area is a Controlled Area. Please park your vehicle outside and verify your identity before entering.”
“It’s such a hassle just to enter a hospital.”
Justin Welan was unhappy, “These guys are useless, boasting of being
First-class Martial Height geniuses, but not able to kill the remaining Blood Disciples in the city for ten days.”
Marcus Lee chimed in with a nod, “Exactly! If we were here, we would have caught them and crushed them one by one long ago.”
“Stop bragging, you two. Do you think this is Lester?” Jack shook his head and parked the car in an outdoor parking lot nearby.
Bang, bang!-
With heavy footsteps, the trio, dressed in dark red armor, stepped down from the vehicle, their expressions calm. After completing face recognition at the hospital gate, they proceeded inside.
Behind Jack, the flamboyant Justin Welan and Marcus Lee followed.
There was no choice; compared to Jack, who had only replaced his black cloak, Justin Weian’s black wings and the barbs on Marcus Lee’s armor joints were all very conspicuous.
However, the hospital staff were accustomed to seeing special forces soldiers in battle armor, since there had been many injured people in recent times, including trial recruits and regular soldiers..

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 110: Descending upon Erica Knowles, Found You_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 110: Descending upon Erica Knowles, Found You_2
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark and his companions arrived at the Inpatient Department’s reception and politely inquired, “Hello, I’d like to know which floor and room a patient named Freya Louise was admitted to last night?”
Due to the hasty departure last night, Jack hadn’t had a chance to ask these questions.
“Please, wait a moment while I check,” the young nurse nervously said, hurriedly looking up the information on her computer.
It couldn’t be helped that despite the three of them concealing their auras, they still emitted some invisible Killing Intent after killing many cultists and even Mutated Beasts during this period.
While it didn’t bother cultivators with strong spirit qi, ordinary people had a hard time enduring it.
Quickly, the nurse nervously said, “That patient is in the 6th floor, Room 07, single room.”
Jask, who was holding his helmet, thanked her politely, “Thank you.”
“You’re, you’re welcome.”
At this point, Justin Welan suddenly remembered something and asked, “By the way, is there a patient named White Veil here? Which floor and room is he in?”
“White Veil? Just a moment.”
“He’s also on the 6th floor, but his room number is 46.”
“Alright, thank you.”
Soon, the three of them arrived on the 6th floor and saw the slightly tired-looking Crystal Leinster and Mandy Leinster standing in the corridor. They both looked surprised upon seeing the trio.
“Jack Clark, Justin Welan, what brought you here?”
Justin Welan grinned cheekily, “Class Leader, you guys are injured, after all. As classmates and club members, we had to come and visit.”
Jack nodded slightly, “It seems like you’re indeed not seriously injured, Class Leader. What about Freya and Matt?”
“Matt’s fine too; he left the hospital this morning to track down information on that Blood Envoy. Mandy and 1 are here taking care of Freya.”
As they spoke, Crystal and Mandy exchanged a glance, surprise in their eyes.
Because for some reason, the moment the three men approached them, they felt a heavy oppressive feeling coming from Jack, like a terrifying Giant Beast was coming their way.
But how could that be…?
While the two women were astonished, Jack asked skeptically, “Logically, the fact that Freya killed that Blood Envoy should have been internal information. How did that person learn that the person who killed his younger brother was Freya?”
“And, you guys don’t have a set schedule for your actions, plus Freya’s Cultivation Methods can conceal her own aura and Killing Intent. How did they find you?”
Mandy whispered, “We thought about the first question after coming back. We concluded that the other party must have taken an official from Erica Knowles hostage, and that person must have a high status.”
“After all, only someone high up in the new official hierarchy would have access to our data.”
“As for the second question, that guy is very cunning. He used two Third Layer Heaven blood disciples as his life substitutes.”
“When we were chasing those two blood disciples, Freya decided to shoot the one who was about to get away, and he quickly locked onto our location.”
“Fortunately, we weren’t far away at the time, and when we heard Freya’s cry in our earpiece, we quickly rushed over.”
“However, that person was very powerful, and the three of us were no match for him.”
“At that moment, if it weren’t for the injured Freya using a secret treasure from her aunt to repel that person, and the teacher in charge arriving in the distance after receiving the distress call, the consequences would’ve been unthinkable.”
“He’s that cunning and sly,” Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
At this point, Justin Welan gave Marcus Lee a look, “Jack, you go check on Freya. We’ll go see how White Veil is doing. We’re all good friends, after all.”
Marcus Lee immediately agreed, grinning, “That’s right. We’ll see how White Veil is doing. That guy used to show off all the time after he arrived at Erica Knowles. He must be miserable this time.”
Jack just shook his head in disbelief at their schadenfreude.
Jack nodded slightly to Crystal and Mandy, then gently pushed open the door to the ward and entered.
He saw the girl lying quietly on the hospital bed, her hair strewn around her, her face pale and her exquisite, pretty face looking somewhat transparent in the sunlight coming from the window.
At this moment, she seemed so fragile, as if she would shatter with the slightest touch. It was the first time Jack had seen her like this.
In the past, the vivacious girl had been energetic and lively, with a touch of playfulness. When she was quietly reading, she was the picture of tranquility, and sitting together with her always made Jack feel comfortable.
But now…
Perhaps sensing someone by her bedside, Freya’s eyelids fluttered as her eyes slowly opened, revealing both surprise and happiness on her weak face.
“Jack, what are you doing here?”
The moment she saw Jack, the girl’s eyes seemed to brighten slightly.
Jack smiled gently, “I heard you were injured, so I drove over from Lester. Jamey is here too.”
A gentle expression appeared in the girl’s eyes as she softly said, “I’m fine; it’s just that my heart vessels were shaken, and my Qi Blood is a bit weak. 1 should recover after resting for a few days.”
Jack nodded, “Alright, you just focus on resting. I’ll take care of that guy.”
Although the saying goes ’killers will be killed,’ this time it involved his ‘good friend,’ and Jack wouldn’t let it go so easily since he wasn’t a saint.
“You and Class Leader need to be careful.”
Freya warned, “That person is good at hiding and might be even more powerful than he’s shown, as he could block my Thistle Blood Ring that my aunt gave me.”
She thought that Jack meant to join Crystal and the others in hunting the Blood Envoy. Jack didn’t explain, but nodded slightly, “Don’t worry; I won’t be careless.”
Jack then curiously asked, “What is that Thistle Blood Ring that could repel a Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage expert?”

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 110: Arriving at Kerya, Found You_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 110: Arriving at Kerya, Found You_3
Translator: 549690339
It seemed like the girl knew he would be curious. Her eyes narrowed into crescent moons, revealing a smile as she explained, “It’s a one-time use secret treasure made from high-level mutant beast materials.”
“I usually wear it on my wrist, and once it detects a life-threatening danger, it will activate and burst out with great power to repel the enemy.”
“However, this is a one-time consumable, and it’s very precious. My aunt only gave me one before I came here.”
“And when 1 go back, my aunt will definitely scold me.” After saying this, the girl playfully stuck out her tongue.
As for this, Jack Clark could only say that he was genuinely envious.
This was the difference between ordinary people and cultivation families. Compared to those who had come with high-level resources and defensive secret treasures like her, Jack was far behind.
Being penniless, he had to strive hard to acquire everything on his own.
Afterward, Jack spent some time talking with Freya Louise about their trip to Kaleb Tuul city. Throughout the conversation, the girl’s face was always filled with a smile.
It was only when Freya started to look tired that Jack let her rest properly and left the ward by pushing the door open.
Jack looked at Crystal Leinster and said gently, “Class Leader, I’ll go with Mr. Willard to sort out our accommodation and other issues. Please take care of them here.”
Crystal nodded, “Alright, you guys go ahead and report first. We’ll figure out how to catch that guy together tomorrow.”
“Alright, no problem.” Jack nodded.
Next, Jack went to the White Veil ward at the end of the corridor. Entering, he saw Justin Welan and the nearly-healed White Veil chatting away.
Jack walked in with a slight smile, “How are you feeling? Recovering well, right?”
“Hehe, just a small injury.” White Veil laughed.
“Tsk, Jack, don’t listen to his boast. This guy had several ribs broken before, but luckily he didn’t injure his organs.”
“…That’s serious.” Jack paused for a moment.
However, he didn’t ask why White Veil didn’t exchange for high-level recovery resources – not everyone was like Justin Welan or Crystal Leinster.
For someone from an ordinary family like White Veil, Contribution Points were to be saved as much as possible.
White Veil didn’t care and said, “It’s no problem. I’ve almost recovered now. Minor issue.”
“As long as you’ve recovered.”
After spending some time in White Veil’s ward, Jack said, “Alright, White Veil, we won’t disturb you any longer. We’ll come back tomorrow to see you.”
“Sure.” White Veil smiled and nodded, evidently happy that Jack and the others had come to see him.
After greeting the Leinster sisters in the corridor, the three left the hospital.
However, when they arrived at the parking lot, Jack didn’t start the car. Instead, he opened the trunk and carried the long knife on his back, making Justin and the others puzzled.
“Jack, aren’t we going to report?”
Jack calmly said, “No rush. Let’s first circle around and check the situation.
That guy’s target is Freya, so he might be hiding nearby.”
“If he could find out that Freya is the one who killed his brother, he must also know that she’s here recovering from her injuries.”
“You’re right. That guy could be lying in ambush nearby.” Justin Welan and Marcus Lee also reacted and quickly put on serious expressions, hefting their heavy shield and hammer onto their backs.
The area around the hospital was relatively open with few buildings. The three of them, dressed in battle armor and armed with weapons, stood out conspicuously as they walked around the surrounding residential buildings.
Soon, Jack’s mouth curled up into a smile.
“Found you..”

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - ill: The Age of Great Conflict,
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter ill: The Age of Great Conflict,
Unparalleled Sharpness of the Blade
Translator: 549690339
“Let’s go, back home.”
After determining roughly where the enemy was, rather than directly leading Justin Welan and the others to attack, Jack Clark chose to leave to avoid startling the enemy.
He didn’t even look back.
His unusual behavior made Justin Welan and Marcus Lee exchange glances. Both of them nodded slightly and said nothing, following Jack Clark’s departure.
Not until they got back to the car park and got into the car did Justin Welan ask, “Jack, did you find that guy?”
Jack Clark started the off-road vehicle and nodded slightly, “Almost. When I got there, 1 sensed a gaze on me, layered with a strong ill will.”
“Damn, Jack, your Heart’s Eye ability is quite useful,” Marcus Lee couldn’t help but express envy.
Being able to sense the enemy merely from a line of sight, detecting danger ahead of time, it would be false to say he did not envy this ‘talent’ developed through True Martial Cultivation.
Jack Clark gave a faint smile, “You can cultivate the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife too.”
Marcus Lee shook his head: “Forget it, my temperament is definitely unsuited to cultivating the Heart’s Eye. The mysterious essence of such a skill makes my head hurt just by looking at it.”
As for the special sword skill, the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, over the years it wasn’t just Jack Clark who had exchanged it. Many people had only managed to develop the Light King Knife after several years of cultivation.
The realm of Heart’s Eye is too challenging.
Even if someone manages to cultivate to the first layer, their five senses would just become a bit sharper. Breakthroughs to the Second Layer are extremely rare, and nearly no one reached the Third Layer in the span of the past ten years.
As such, Marcus Lee lost interest after a cursory glance when he was exchanging Cultivation Methods.
Without the Heart’s Eye, the Light King Knife is just a common Sword Skill. For geniuses like them, more attractive are the advanced techniques.
Moreso, the True Martial Arts techniques are numerous beyond counting. Even successful cultivation of the Heart’s Eye cannot guarantee against being ambushed, because some methods can mask one’s aura and killing intent.
Like Freya Louise, for instance.
Moreover, there are some people who inherently have a weak presence. After cultivating corresponding methods, they can even erase traces of their own existence, making them perfect assassins.
So ultimately, it’s still oneself who’s most powerful, while Cultivation Methods are just aids.
The base of Erica Knowles is controlled by the military, barring ordinary people from getting close. Only after clearing several checks was Jack Clark and his group able to park their car outside the Service Hall.
As soon as they got out of the car, several youths, all dressed in dark red armor and carrying weapons, walked by. They emanated the formidable aura of the Third Layer.
When they entered the hall, Third Layer freshmen could be seen everywhere, each emanating a very strong aura, no less mighty than that of Marcus Lee or Justin Welan.
Marcus Lee was somewhat emotional, “I’m suddenly a bit glad that I participated in the trial. Otherwise, 1 might still be stuck in school, struggling to breakthrough to the mid-period of Second Layer.”
“Indeed,” Justin Welan also solemnly nodded in agreement.
In this place, geniuses who broke through to the Third Layer with the span of four months are everywhere – some of them even give off an aura that oppresses the both of them. These formidable auras were no less intense than Howard Lee’s.
Jack Clark said tersely, “Quit lamenting. Haven’t you thought that this is where a portion of the most talented Senior One freshmen from Eastern Summer have congregated?”
“So it means we are also one-in-ten-thousands elites, right?” Justin Welan’s eyes lit up.
Marcus Lee responded, “Of course, we’ve always been geniuses.”
Jack Clark shook his head, not bothering to engage these two fools who were always thinking of showing off.
However, they weren’t wrong. There are over 500 million people in Eastern Summer, and every year there are over two million Senior One freshmen. This year it is estimated that there will be several hundred thousand Cultivating Freshman.
Among them, First-class Universities have the highest rate of Foundation Establishment, followed by the second-class, and even less for third-class. The reason behind this, Jack Clark wasn’t clear.
And this trial has practically encompassed all the geniuses from first, second and third-tier martial arts high schools. Nearly five to six thousand Second Layer freshmen participated in the trial.
Over the span of two months, almost two thousand geniuses broke through to the Third Layer, with 70% of them being from First-Class Universities.
So, when Marcus Lee said he was one in ten thousand geniuses, he wasn’t wrong.
These pieces of data were gleaned by Jack Clark from chats with trial participants like Los Angeles Mark Massy during his free time.
With broadening exposure, Jack Clark realized his initial assessment of over one million cultivators, but no more, was an underestimate. Just in Eastern Summer alone, there are already several hundred thousand students cultivating at schools.
In addition to these are the graduates from previous years, martial cultivators trained en masse by the military, and cultivators hired by large groups from among the general public.
Even if the cultivation environment was extremely harsh ten years ago, no foundation-achievements method was available, and not even one in tens of students could cultivate, the accumulated number over time is still quite terrifying.
After all, in the fifty years of the New Era, he had never heard of any advanced cultivators growing old and dying.
This is just Eastern Summer, not counting the entire Human Alliance.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark felt an immense sense of an impending era of strife.
Of course, although most of those he estimated are low-level cultivators, high-end ones shouldn’t be too many as the path of Cultivation gets harder the deeper it goes.
Moreover, most of these cultivators are not in this ‘world’.
Soon, the trio completed their registration procedures and were each assigned a single room.
Leaving the Service Hall, Jack Clark handed the luggage and keys to Justin Welan. “Mr. Willard, help me bring the luggage to the room. 1 have some preparations to make.”
“Sure.”
Following the sign directions, Jack Clark took the elevator to the Underground Logistics Department of the base.
Why did they always like to build the Logistics Department in the basement of the base?
While muttering his complaints, Jack Clark stepped out of the elevator and saw the busy staff – about a dozen new students in armor were lining up..

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 111: The Age of Great Conflict,
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 111: The Age of Great Conflict,
Unparalleled Sharpness of the Blade_2
Translator: 549690339
Soon it was Jack Clark’s turn, he entered his Student ID for verification and politely said, “I want to exchange two Level 2 life crystals, one Electronic Micro-Control Sleeve Gun, and one Micro Liquid Bomb.”
“Wait a moment.”
Since the last exchange, Jack Clark had 26 Contribution Points left unused, and because there was no task, it did not show any increase. This time he used them all up.
Next, Jack Clark applied for a Personal Cultivation Room, closed the door, and the voice sounded in his mind, “Convert points attribute.”
“You have converted two crystals into life energy and gained twenty-seven points attribute.”
“I got 27 points this time, not bad.” Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction, then drew the straight blade from his back.
He originally kept these Contribution Points to strengthen his Sword Skill, but this time, to deal with that potentially Late Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy, he had to use them in advance.
That’s right, Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
When Freya Louise said at the hospital that the Blood Envoy was very powerful and possibly not mid-period Fourth Layer Heaven, Jack Clark was already on alert.
And the gaze from the residential building before only made the hair on his back stand up, feeling a dangerous aura as soon as it rested on his back.
Anyone who could bring him a sense of danger at this point was obviously very powerful.
Moreover, the difference between Fourth Layer Heaven and Third Layer Heaven was substantial, with True Strength even more powerful, able to form a protective True Strength layer over three centimeters beyond the body, impervious even to normal sniper rifles.
Unless the True Strength was exhausted.
Besides, their True Strength could also be released externally, slashing out long-range damage similar to Sword Qi, far surpassing Third Layer Heaven in combat power.
Thus, even Jack Clark did not dare to be careless, what if his basic strength was stronger? If he couldn’t break through the other’s protective True Strength, everything would be futile.
Jack conjured the realm of thought in his mind: “Spend 10 Points Attribute, strengthen the combat knife.”
If True Strength wasn’t enough, he could compensate with reinforcement. This was his preparation.
However, unlike strengthening the battle armor, when Jack Clark issued the command, a row of transparent text appeared before his eyes: “Please choose weapons strengthening direction, currently can choose ‘solidity’ ‘sharpness'”
…Jack Clark was slightly stunned. He didn’t expect that there would be a distinction between solidity and sharpness and looked at the twenty or so free attributes on the attribute page.
“Solidity, Sharpness, strengthen 10 points each.”
Buzz!
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, an Invisible Power enveloped the straight blade. Instantly, he felt a heaviness in his hand, probably some several kilograms heavier.
The combat knife now looked somewhat heavier, the color deep and dark, a faint white cover flowing around the snowy blade, emanating a sharp breath.
At the same time, only he could see the transparent text floating on the blade, just like when he first strengthened his battle armor.
“A combat knife forged from ordinary alloy, currently solidity +10, sharpness +10, ordinary Transcendent Weapon, possesses a solid blade and sharp edge, the blade having a weak demon-breaking effect.”
“Note: Due to material limits, the attributes of solidity and sharpness can only be strengthened to a maximum of 10. To improve the basic quality, one can incorporate Transcendent Materials in the future.”
“It actually has a weak demon-breaking effect.” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised, and then he swung his hand holding the long knife slightly.
Pop!
The air suddenly made a sound like tearing fabric, it goes without saying how sharp the reinforced combat knife was, while the blade gave one a strong and unyielding heavy feeling.
As Jack Clark’s physical body became increasingly stronger, this alloy long knife, which had been handy for use in the First Layer Heaven, was now somewhat lagging behind.
After every intense battle, the blade would either be nicked or even deformed, requiring repair or even replacement, and he was even afraid that too much strength would shatter the blade.Now that these issues have temporarily been resolved after strengthening, Jack Clark is quite satisfied with the results in every aspect, feeling like it was a good deal.
After enhancing his weapon, Jack also tied the Electronic Micro-Control Sleeve Gun on his left arm.
Although it is called a gun, it is more like a dart shooter. The firing end is tied to the lower arm, while the back end is connected to the mechanism on his upper arm. It includes twenty meters of special steel wire.
When fired, the small harpoons have the horrifying kinetic energy that is capable of piercing through ten centimeters of cement. Once it goes through a cement wall, the hooks within the head of the harpoon spring out to prevent dislodgement.
The special steel wire connected to it has a load capacity of five-hundred kilos, sufficient for a cultivator like Jack Clark to use when there are no leverage points in mid-air.
To retract it, simply press the control switch, the chip within the harpoon’s hook will spring back, and the micro-motor on the upper arm can retract the steel wire within two seconds.
As for the micro liquid bomb, its core material comes from a Mutated Beast. The liquid has high-explosiveness properties, even a fragment as small as a fingernail has an explosive power comparable to high-explosive grenades.
This is the benefit of having official support. They provide all kinds of items and equipment, comprehensively overpowering evil god sect cultists of the same level.
However, these excellent items are a bit expensive, like the sleeve gun and micro liquid bomb that Jack exchanged this time – each one costs 1 Contribution Point.
At 8 pm, the three of them drove to the vicinity of the hospital after dinner, finally parking at the corner of an eighteen-story building.
In the heavy footsteps, Jack Clark and Justin Welan got out of the car, Jack reminded them, “Our enemy this time is a Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy, so be careful.”
“I will go up and force him out. You guys are responsible for preventing him from escaping. Mr. Willard, you focus on defense. Marcus, you agitate him when the time is right.”
“I will take care of the killing.”
“Alright.” The two nodded with solemn expressions.
In fact, Marcus Lee could have skipped this siege on the Blood Envoy. After all, there’s a huge gap between the initial stages of the Third Layer and the Fourth Layer. Normally, they should have asked for back-up.
But since Jack was confident, Marcus, who isn’t afraid of death, was more intrigued about how powerful Jack’s combat abilities are now, rather than worrying about the Blood Envoy.
