Almost a month has passed, and this abnormal guy’s power must have increased quite a bit.
This is a commercial building. When Jack appeared, the security guard at the entrance immediately stood up, “Sorry, may 1 ask…”
Squeak squeak!!
Jack reached over, tearing the iron gate off the wall, and coolly said, “The Special Forces Soldier is at work, no interference by irrelevant people, otherwise, immediate execution.”
A wave of killing intent made the ordinary security guard stiff as a board, daring not to move a single bit.
Boom!
Jack’s metal battle boots smashed the ground. He launched himself like a raging wind into the building, shattering the glass door with a bang, displaying an overbearing aura.
Or perhaps he intentionally created a commotion.
Jack didn’t take the elevator, but rushed directly into the stairwell, the heavy rumbling echoing back and forth in the staircase.
In the evening, to avoid alerting his target, Jack didn’t look back. Hence he could only vaguely determine that his target was somewhere in the middle of the building.
But it’s not difficult to handle this situation. If the enemy refuses to show his face, he would adopt a harassing strategy.
Each heavy step broke the concrete of the stairwell, causing the floor to vibrate. Jack was like an angry elephant charging straight ahead.
He came here not only to avenge Freya Louise and others while eliminating a hidden danger but also to measure his own strength.
In recent times, his power has been improving by leaps and bounds. Plus, his desire to vent his destructive urges by massacring as the Sword Armor Beast has been increasingly rearing its head..

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 112: Transcendent Battle, Rune's Might
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 112: Transcendent Battle, Runes Might
Translator: 549690339
As the rumbling vibrations spread throughout the building, Jack Clark rushed to the fourteenth floor in just a few breaths and suddenly stopped at the stairwell entrance of the corridor. He stood with his knife, eyes sharp, looking around.
The dim corridor lights flickered and all was silent, but Jacks eyes narrowed slightly.
In his perception, there was a sense of danger surrounding him, it was obvious that the Blood Envoy had been alerted, but he could not determine its exact location.
However, there was no hurry, as long as the enemy dared to look at him
Boom! Jacks black real power burst out, his whole body swelling suddenly, and with a violent explosive momentum, he smashed the air and lunged at the room six meters away.
The black Sword Qi flowed around the two-meter-long combat knife in his hand, cutting through the air like a black pirefining.
At that moment, the room door exploded.
A more terrifying aura erupted from inside, and as the rich blood-red light shone, a long spear pierced through, with half a meter of red light exuding a sharp aura.
Bang! The instant they made contact, the Dragon Elephant True Strengths Light King Sword Qi formed by the Third Layer Heaven was dispersed by the red Spear Radiance.
It couldnt be helped; there was a vast difference in quality between the True Strength of the Third Layer Heaven and that of the Fourth Layer Heaven, especially the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
But as the Sword Qi was dispersed, the snow-white blade of the combat knife tore through the Spear Radiance, and with immense power, it struck the long spear.
Boom! The collision of the knife and the spear triggered an explosion of power. The shockwave shattered the surrounding air, making the whole corridor vibrate like the clang of a huge bell.
As the powerful counter-shock pushed the knife and spear apart, a palm covered in red scales penetrated the raging wind, like a red python pouncing at Jack.
Roar! Amidst the faint sound of an angry elephant, a thick arm covered in battle armor smashed through the air, clenching its fist and colliding with the red palm.
Boom! As the substantial power burst out, the surrounding air exploded once again, and the black-red energy surged like a raging wind, creating a stunning scene.
The two adversaries disengaged after exchanging blows with knives, spears, fists, and palms. As Jack was being pushed back several meters by the powerful red True Power, the red figure disappeared into the corridor in an instant.
Where do you think youre going?
With a furious roar, Jack stomped on the ground, shattering it beneath his heavy battle boots, and shot out like a black bolt of lightning. His combat knife tore through the air, slashing at the end of the corridor.
The dark figure hidden in the shadows burst open, revealing the red long spear once again. The red True Power flowed around it, sweeping up a howling gale as it moved.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Their exchange of blows was as fast as lightning, and every collision between the knife and spear created terrifying vibrations.
Whenever a flash of Sword Qi or Spear Radiance fell on the corridor walls, the walls shattered, and rubble splattered as if two giant beasts were destroying everything in their rampage.
Boom! As the wall collapsed and smoke and dust filled the air, the black Sword Qi and red Spear Radiance swept across and collided, causing the two of them to be pushed back once again, stopping at opposite ends of the office.
Finally, Jack was able to see the Blood Envoys appearance clearly.
Standing at two meters tall, the figure was muscular and massive, just like the monster he had slain before. When it erupted, its entire body was covered in red scales, and its face was horrifying.
A layer of blood light flowed around the monster like battle armor, and a black, eerie cape hung behind it, seemingly the reason it was able to conceal its aura and become invisible.Compared to the monstrous Blood Envoy, Jack Clark, who was dressed in black-red armor and holding a knife, seemed far more normal, but the aura around him seemed even more terrifying and fierce.
As expected, he is in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven realm. Jack Clarks eyes were cold.
Although the opponent concealed his aura, based on the strength he displayed during their brief earlier exchange, Jack Clark could confirm that the Blood Envoys realm was definitely in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Thats because he could completely suppress a cultivator at the Mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
The main reason the opponent concealed his realm was probably to avoid attracting high-level experts of Fifth and Sixth Level Heaven for pursuit.
After all, the Early and Middle stages of the Fourth Layer Heaven were still within the range of being barely handled by geniuses, but the Late stage must be suppressed as early as possible.
However, a Late Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator was indeed a bit troublesome. His True Strength was terrifyingly profound, and the condensed Spear Radiance was so sharp that it almost completely shattered his Sword Qi with a single sweep.
If it werent for strengthening his combat knife before coming, its weak demon-breaking property and peerless sharpness might have been enough to cut the Spear Radiance, making it difficult for him to kill his opponent today.
Looking at the violently furious Jack Clark, Carlos spoke in a low voice, Federal dog, 1 thought I hid myself well. How did you find me?
Do you really think I will tell you? In an indifferent tone, a terrifying force within Jack Clark was activated.
Roar! A deafening roar of the Tyrant Elephant resounded in the room. Behind him, a shadow of a terrifying phantom flashed by, and his muscles swelled, making his battle armor creak.
After confirming that the opponent was indeed at the Late Fourth Layer Heaven realm, Jack Clark directly activated the Rune Elephant Rage, and his Qi Blood and True Strength burned vigorously within him.
Boom!
The floor beneath his feet shattered like powder, and the air exploded. In an instant, Jack Clark shot out at a terrifying speed, his imposing aura as fierce and domineering as a roaring Tyrant Elephant.
With his strength and defense increased tenfold, Jack Clarks speed was terrifying to the point where it was almost invisible to the naked eye. A black and white sword light slashed through the air.
Carlos face changed at this strike, and his Late Fourth Layer Heaven True Strength completely erupted, flooding the room in red blood light.
Boom! The condensed black Sword Qi clashed with the red True Strength and collapsed immediately. However, the exposed sharp white blade underneath tore through the Spear Radiance and slashed onto the spears body.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force that could topple mountains and seas, even Carlos couldnt help but turn red, and his whole body sank as the floor within several meters crumbled beneath him.
Boom boom boom!!
The two who fell into the thirteenth floor began fighting madly once again at terrifying speeds, and every room they passed through was torn apart by their sharp and overbearing aura.
However, unlike before when Jack Clark was slightly at a disadvantage, this time, it was Carlos who was being suppressed by the even more fearsome power of Jack Clark when the rune burned. With every movement, the Elephants Rage echoed faintly, its might terrifying and frightening.
In particular, Jack Clark didnt even bother to defend himself. He allowed Carlos to strike him with his spear and Spear Radiance while his sharp blade tore through everything and aimed for Carlos weak points.
In this situation, Carlos was even more restricted and hesitated to directly confront the terrifying blade.
The edge of the knife was so sharp that, combined with the terrifying physical strength of the Federal Genius, it could potentially cut Carlos in half with a single slash if he didnt try to block it.
However, if he tried to block the strike with his Blood-drenching Soul-stealing Spear, the dreadful power unleashed by Jack Clark with every slash still shook his arms to the point of trembling.Boom! At this moment, an almost completely destroyed window on the thirteenth floor exploded, and two figures, one red and one black, appeared in the air, attacking each other with fists.
Bang! A substantial impact wave blasted open.
Under the Furious Power, Jack Clark flew back a few meters, while Carlos was slammed into the building wall by the Furious Power, his eyes flashing brightly as he thrust his long spear into the wall.
Immediately, the long spear drew a large shower of sparks, and Carloss face showed a cold expression as he slid down.
Falling from a height of about 40 meters on the thirteenth floor would be uncomfortable even for him, and this time, the Federation genius who had an astonishing strength at the Third Layer Heaven would be injured if not killed.
At that time
Suddenly, in mid-air, Jack Clark waved his left hand, and a finger-sized mini-spear shot out with a whoosh, viciously piercing through the wall, and the steel wire suddenly tightened.
Bang!
Jack Clarks left hand, like a knife, was covered in battle armor as his fingers penetrated the cement, directly clawing out five deep scratches on the wall as he fell downward.
Countless fragments and dust fell along the way.
As for the spear on the wall, it was automatically retrieved the moment Jack Clark leaned against the wall.
However, due to the delay, Carlos landed before Jack Clark, hitting a sedan parked by the roadside with a bang, and then his inner power burst out, transforming into a blood light and shooting out.
He wanted to retreat.
Carlos knew very well that this was a Federation-controlled area, and once he got entangled, senior strong men would soon come to his aid. In that case, he would suffer even if he wasnt killed, but
He saw a figure rushing out from the roadside, and it was Justin Welan, who was carrying a heavy shield. The thick yellow true power erupted from him, like a mountain range blocking Carloss path.
However, the Late Fourth Layer Heaven Carlos was even faster, stepping on the road and turning into a red light to sweep past Justin Welans side.
Mysterious Martial Moving Mountains.
In a low roar, an invisible force field erupted from Justin Welan, and the ground around it seemed to collapse slightly. Carlos, who was supposed to bypass him, bizarrely pounced on him.
ii
Since you want to die, Ill fulfill your wish. Carloss eyes showed a strong killing intent, and the blood spear in his hand was like a dragon, engulfed in dozens of centimeters of spear radiance, crashing down.
Boom!
Even Justin Welan couldnt withstand the terrifying attack of the Late Fourth Layer Heaven. The yellow true power covering the heavy shield was shaking madly and collapsing, and the ground within a five-meter radius was cracking loudly.
Spurt! Blood spurted from his mouth, and Justin Welan was blasted back several meters by the hit, his legs leaving deep scratches on the road.
And me.
At this moment, a raging wind howled from the side, and a Blue True Power-imbued heavy hammer filled the air, crashing down in the air during the moment when Carlos repelled Justin Welan.
Get lost!bender
With a harsh yell, Carlos swept his three-meter-long spear in a horizontal arc, and under the night sky, it burst open like a fan of red light, sweeping the strong wind and slamming into Marcus Lee.
Bang!
The handle of the hammer in Marcus Lees hand bent, and he was sent flying backward like a cannonball, crashing into a sedan more than twenty meters away with a boom, crushing and dragging it several meters.
Suddenly, a sharp whistling sound exploded behind Carlos, and it was Jack Clark who had landed and sprinted. In just an instant, his figure crossed tens of meters, accompanied by the faint roar of an elephant and a waterfall-like light from his knife.
Carlos turned around abruptly, and a madness appeared on his hideous face, Dont think Im really afraid of you, ah
Seeing that he couldnt escape, Carlos completely erupted, and the thick bloody smell soared into the sky, his body glowing red with the shadow of a blood python flashing faintly.
Under the red glow, Carlos, who was covered in red scales, looked like a demon from hell, emanating a nauseating, ferocious blood aura.
Bang!
The red-light-wrapped long spear collided with the combat knife, and the ground beneath Carlos shattered with a bang.
Between the two, the black and red true power turned into violent air currents and exploded, with a powerful momentum.
Hiss! In the strong wind, a blood-red spear qi burst out like a blood python, tearing through the air and carrying a sharp aura towards Jack Clarks face.
Behind the face armor, Jack Clarks eyes were cold, and he disregarded the backlash as he waved his long knife.
Bang! The sharp, unparalleled straight blade slashed through the spear qi, and the moment the combat knife and spear qi collided, the spear qi shattered violently.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
With the knifes light like snow, shattering the spears radiance, Jack Clark blocked the three sudden thrusts from Carlos and then fiercely pounced on him, his entire body wrapped up in the roaring wind and slashing down with full strength.
Boom!
Under the domineering power, Carlos was blasted back several meters with a bang, slamming into a sedan parked by the roadside, flipping it over, and then his face changed as he dodged aside.
Boom!
The instant Carlos dodged, the knife light slashed down like a torrent, and the sedan was cut in half instantly, leaving a three-meter-long crack on the ground.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Under the explosion of the True Martial Remnant Symbol, the unrivaled and unparalleled speed of Jack Clarks power made him a terrifying opponent, as he and the red light transformed by Carlos intertwined madly.
Both of their movement speeds exceeded too meters per second, and their attack speeds were even faster, making them barely visible to the naked eye as the energy spread everywhere.
Whenever a red spear qi fell on the ground, a half-meter-wide hole would be blasted out of the hard road.
And the black knife light was even more terrifying, as the greening trees on both sides of the road were toppled one after another, and passing vehicles exploded, causing even the streetlamps to fly like toys, horrifyingly powerful.
Thankfully, this was near a hospital, and the military had imposed martial law, so there were no pedestrians at night. Otherwise, the aftermath might have killed or injured hundreds.
This was the terror of the advanced cultivators who had crossed the Triplex
Heaven, who had truly stepped into the realm of the transcendent..

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 113: Dragon-Elephant Roars, Killing
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 113: Dragon-Elephant Roars, Killing
Late Fourth Layer Heaven Period
Translator: 549690339
Just as Jack Clark and Carlos crashed through the building and fell, a figure appeared on the rooftop of a hospital a few hundred meters away.
This middle-aged man seemed to emit the powerful aura of the Sixth-Level Heaven realm, his eyes like lightning, focusing on the two people entangled on the faraway street.
“These Blood God Sect guys really don’t fear death, there’s actually one lurking around the hospital.” Vickers Lee’s eyes grew cold, followed by a hint of surprise.
That’s because he found that the freshman in battle armor, whose realm was only in the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, was holding his own against a Blood Envoy in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
“Which school does this freshman come from? His combat power is so exaggerated, already on par with lan Clark from my school. He has actually condensed the True Martial Divine Rhyme at this realm, what a monster.”
Not only the middle-aged man, but with the cultivators’ sharp senses, Crystal Leinster, Freya Louise, and others all heard the explosion’s vibration from afar.
Apart from them, some other injured freshmen couldn’t help but look in that direction.
Unfortunately, they were hundreds of meters away, and the night and obstacles obscured their view, so they had no idea what was happening on the other side.
Boom!
After taking a direct spear hit, Jack Clark was thrown back, crashing the wall, but at the same time, his long knife almost sliced off half of Carlos’s body, with blood gushing out.
Clang! Carlos’s long spear hit the ground, his face slightly pale. The thick Blood Qi in his body stopped the terrifying wound from bleeding, and then new flesh began to emerge at a visible speed to heal the injury.
As a Senior Blood Seed, the mutated Carlos had a terrifying recovery ability as long as his stored life force was sufficient.
But at this time, a shadow burst out of the smoke and dust, like a raging wind, the long knife slashed again.
Thump!
Under the terrifying Power Explosion, Carlos, who was recovering from his injury, blocked with his spear, but even so, he was sent flying and hit a streetlamp.
Then, Carlos quickly rolled on the ground, and instantly, the black knife light flashed past, cutting off the streetlamp.
Carlos jumped up from the ground, his 3-meter-long Blood-drenching Soul-stealing Spear radiated a red light as he swept it horizontally, generating a large amount of red light screeching in front of Jack Clark.
Thump! Jack Clark blocked it with his long knife, remaining rock-solid. With ten times the strength and a defense buff, he directly ignored the impact of the Fourth Layer Heaven True Power.
Immediately after, the two collided again, the aftermath of the battle was terrifying, and everything caught in it would be destroyed.
But the more they fought, the more frustrated Carlos became.
That’s because his True Power consumption increased rapidly during the fierce battle, but the Federal Genius’s aura on the other side became even more violent and vigorous, like a blazing flame.
The activated Elephant’s Fury Rune would burn Qi Blood and True Power. Under normal conditions, this kind of consumption would be extremely terrifying and couldn’t last long.
But the problem was Jack Clark’s physique was too strong; although he was in the Third Layer Heaven True Martial Realm, his physique was comparable to a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator, thus allowing him to maintain his burst for a long time.
Even if his True Power was exhausted, he had his vigorous Blood Qi to support him.
Clang! Each strike of the knife and spear at their near Subsonic Speed generated massive sparks with an explosion of Qi.
In the continuous battle, cracks and holes appeared on Carlos’s alloy long spear, and even the spear tip was chopped off by the sharp long knife at some point.
“You can’t kill me.” Carlos’s face showed madness as he faced the incoming knife without dodging.
Thud!
The sharp knife light tore through the protective True Power and the Red Scales, slashing across Carlos’s shoulder and cutting a terrifying wound deep enough to reveal his organs.
Just as Jack Clark slashed down, Carlos’s long spear shot out like a poisonous dragon, piercing the air with a sharp whistle as it landed on Jack Clark’s chest.
Boom!
Red spear light tore through black True Power, striking the Enhanced +10 Armor on Jack Clark’s chest. Under the terrifying force, the battle armor gave out unbearable cracking sounds.
Thump! The alloy embedded in Jack Clark’s chest broke open, and the weakened spear light struck his chest, sending him flying and crashing a sedan.
Boom!
The sedan’s gas tank exploded, and as the flames roared, Jack Clark’s tall figure stood up from the wreckage as if nothing had happened, his aura more ferocious and oppressive.
Meanwhile, Carlos’s wounds quickly healed under the flashes of blood, but his aura weakened considerably.
Suddenly, both of them sprang into action again, turning into a red and black light, colliding with each other.
Boom! The violent True Power exploded, creating tangible shock waves and strong winds sweeping the surroundings, and both of them were blown away upon contact.
One crashed into a wall, the other broke a large tree.
Thump! Bricks exploded. Jack Clark stood up from the collapsed wall, the black True Power circulation dispersing the smoke and dust, revealing his shattered shoulder armor.
After being hit hard by a Late Fourth Layer Heaven True Power combined with the sharp Spear Radiance, even the Strengthening +10 Battle Armor couldn’t fully withstand it.
However, with the battle armor’s defense and the defensive boost of the Elephant’s Fury Rune, Jack Clark only suffered some Qi Blood shaking in the injury exchange.
On the other side, Carlos lifted the tree off his body and climbed up. A hole pierced his abdomen, with flesh rapidly growing around it to heal the wound.
Watching the rapidly recovering but increasingly weakened Carlos, Jack Clark’s eyes grew colder.
Would he be afraid to trade injuries for injuries?
With a loud crash, the ground shattered and the two engaged in a frenzied battle again, the intensity escalating relentlessly. The battle’s aftermath destroyed everything in the vicinity as they continued their brutal trade of injuries..

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 113: Dragon-Elephant Roars, Killing Late Fourth Layer Heaven Period_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 113: Dragon-Elephant Roars, Killing Late Fourth Layer Heaven Period_2
Translator: 549690339
Just a moment later, half of the street had been destroyed by the two fighters, dozens of cars shattered, and some cars exploded and burned with leaping flames, lighting up the night.
Such terrifying chaos had long alarmed the surrounding residents.
Some people hid in their houses, shivering, some screamed, while some others stood excitedly upstairs, watching the inhuman battle below, even recording it on their mobile phones.
Of course, such a situation naturally led to a wave of calls to the police, the nearby law enforcement bureau’s phone lines were almost flooded by residents.
Upon hearing that there were two powerful cultivators fighting and destroying half of the street, the news quickly spread to the special forces base, and some people were immediately alerted.
It couldn’t be helped – there were too many geniuses gathered in Freya and not enough opponents, the common cultists and blood disciples were almost all killed off during this period.
At the other end of the street, the injured Justin Welan and the weakened Marcus Lee stood together, staring dumbfoundedly at the distant battle.
Marcus Lee swallowed his saliva, “Damn, why do 1 feel like we’re not on the same level? We’re supposed to be the ‘geniuses’, right?”
Justin Welan shook his head, “If a genius is someone who reaches Foundation Establishment in just one week, then there are too many geniuses in this world.”
“My brother once said, the school’s system is outdated, and real geniuses can’t be distinguished by the time it takes them to reach Foundation Establishment, like him in those days.”
Justin Welan chuckled, “Who would have thought that a freshman who took fifty minutes to practice Body Casting Skill in the first Foundation Establishment class would suddenly soar to the top?”
“Reaching Third Layer Heaven in four months, and even fighting against a Fourth Layer Heaven blood envoy with Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase cultivation, and that faint roar of Elephant’s Fury every time he makes a move…”
“Sure enough, I have a good eye. 1 felt that Jack was extraordinary from the first day of school and became friends with him.” At this point, Justin Welan looked smug.
At this time, exerting their full strength, they could sense that Jack Clark’s True Martial realm was the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, but his combat power was… somewhat inhuman.
Marcus Lee couldn’t stand his smug look and exposed the truth, “Didn’t you say that you became friends with Jack Clark because he’s too handsome?”
“…Did I say that?” Justin Welan looked blank.
Marcus Lee nodded seriously, “Yes, you did.”
Do you think you can pass it off as cute, like a pretty girl? Marcus Lee snorted and didn’t miss any opportunity to strike at Justin Welan.
Just then, Jack and Carlos smashed into the wall of a warehouse, and their swords and spears shredded and threw piles of neatly stacked cardboard boxes into the air.
Whoosh! Amidst the flying debris of cardboard boxes, a spark suddenly ignited.
The injuries on Carlos by now were getting heavier, with wounds all over his body, several so deep that the bones were visible, and they weren’t healing anymore.
With his True Strength and vitality rapidly depleting, his inhuman regenerative ability was lost.
Jack, who had slaughtered a defective blood disciple before, was well aware of this, so he was not afraid to trade injuries with Carlos.
But by now, Jack was also in bad shape, his once sleek battle armor now marred with dents and holes, many pieces of alloy torn away, revealing the special steel wires beneath.
This was the might of a Senior Blood Envoy.
Carlos’s physical strength had surpassed the Fourth Layer Heaven’s limit, with an estimated basic strength of 5000 kilograms, as well as the augmented power and astonishing speed from his blood-colored True Strength after transformation.
At the same time, his defense was not weak, either, with powerful protective True Strength and steel-hard scales on his body, and corrosive blood-colored True Strength that Jack’s Strengthened Battle Armor struggled to withstand.
This was the horror of advanced cultivators with transcendent True Strength. “Alih…” Carlos, slowly being suppressed, suddenly let out a furious, crazed roar, his face distorted, and intense unwillingness shone in his blood-red eyes. He couldn’t accept being suppressed to this extent by a Third Layer Heaven cultivator.
“Even if 1 fall into hell, 1 will kill you today!”In a fierce roar, Carlos’s energy surged once more, and a layer of crimson blood seeped through his skin, making him look like a demon.Roar!
Jack Clark suddenly let out a long howl, his voice thick and permeated with the angry roar of the Tyrant Elephant. The violent sound waves at close range caused Carlos to pause involuntarily.
In an instant, the glow of his sword swarmed, the combat knife tearing through the blood-colored True Strength and slashing down on Carlos’s shoulder. At the same time, the black Sword Qi suppressed within the blade burst out with a bang.
Light King Slash!
Bang! Countless sharp, tiny fragments exploded within the flesh and blood, directly tearing apart half of Carlos’s muscles. Blood spurted out, and he screamed in agony.
In extreme pain, Carlos became even more frenzied, and his spear without a head shot out in an instant. Jack slightly dodged, and it hit his chest armor on the other side.
Boom!
Jack flew out and hit a load-bearing pillar, causing it to collapse in smoke and dust. But immediately after, he shrugged off the debris and bricks covering his body with a blast.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Carlos, who had been severely injured, continued to grow weaker, while the warehouse fire intensified, gradually engulfing the entire building.
Squeak, squeak, squeak!!
Over ten modified off-road vehicles sped at a hundred kilometers per hour before suddenly pulling up in front of the building. The brakes screeched as the vehicles turned a corner, and the doors opened with a bang.
A dozen figures wearing battle armor excitedly jumped out.
Among them was Zac Lyons, who was surprised to see Justin Welan looking somewhat weak. “Why are you two here?”
Justin Welan rolled his eyes: “Nonsense. Our Class Leader and classmates were all beaten up. How could we not come to take revenge?”
“This time, Jack is really angry. Look, he’s over there, pressing down the Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy and beating him up so badly that even his mother won’t recognize him.”
“… Justin, I have a feeling your words might get you punched.” Marcus Lee spoke with an odd tone.
He knew that Jack had rushed over not because of Crystal Leinster, but because of that female student named Freya Louise. Hadn’t he seen him stay in the ward for a long time?
But Justin’s words just now could easily lead Zac to misunderstand that Jack came because Crystal was injured. If this matter got out…
“Ahem! I didn’t say anything wrong.”
Justin coughed and explained: “We in Class 3 have always been a united group, and this time we even set up a small squad to keep in touch.”
“You guys are really dedicated.” Zac was a little envious.
Hearing that classmates had been injured, they directly raced over for thousands of miles to take revenge. It’s hard not to be envious of such a loyal friendship.
At this time, the other training students stood to the side, watching the warehouse sending out vibrations and roaring sounds in the distance, with no intention of intervening.
This was an unwritten rule in the trials; whoever found the prey would claim it, and others were not allowed to steal it. Only when the battle reached a point where they could not hold on could others step in.
Roar!
Suddenly, Justin and the others heard the elephant’s roar in the distance, the ground shaking, and powerful explosions erupting.
Boom, the warehouse collapsed under the blaze, and a torrent of sparks filled the sky. The thick, rolling smoke covered the night, creating a terrifying sight.
In the midst of roaring flames, Jack, wearing tattered battle armor, slowly emerged. The black True Power flowing around him kept the raging fire away from his body.
At this moment, he held a sword in his right hand and a nearly severed corpse in his left, exuding a heavy oppressive aura.
Such a display of power even made these geniuses look at him with respect..

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 114: Only a Genius Can Fight Across Levels, The Half-Human Half-Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 114: Only a Genius Can Fight Across Levels, The Half-Human Half-Beast
Bang!
Jack Clark, who had just walked over, threw rhe corpse on the ground, looked at rhe trial freshmen, and his gaze fell on Zac Lyons. He said with a chuckle “Everyone is here.”
At this moment, Justin Welan hesitated, “Jack, your injuries aren’t severe right?”
Jack Clark looked quite miserable right now. The battle armor alloy on his chest, shoulders, and back was almost destroyed, some areas were dented and deformed, and the inner layer of steel wire was exposed in the broken areas.
The most tragic part was his right arm. The battle armor on his entire arm was almost torn apart, revealing the strong arm underneath.
As for the black cloak behind him, only a small piece was left draping over his shoulder. The only good thing was his heavy helmet, which only had a few charred traces from being burned.
Jack Clark casually said, “I’m fine, just need to repair this suit of battle armor.
This was the advantage of having strong defense. Under the +10 defense of his battle armor, even Carlos’ attacks that traded damage only destroyed his battle armor.
As for the terrifyingly dense flesh underneath the battle armor, the jade-like skin was repeatedly shaken, and the Qi Blood boiled, bur then the True Strength circled back, restoring it to its original state.
In this situation, Carlos simply couldn’t fight. In the end, he was blasted by Jack using a Micro Liquid Bomb, and was instantly killed with a full-force strike.
As for the shattered battle armor, it could be repaired later. As some of the parts were destroyed, the enchantment of +10 solidity had disappeared.
At this point, the battle armor on Jack Clark s body was just a little harder than an ordinary battle armor, looking as if it had been tempered with True Strength, and no one would care.
At this moment, a youth carrying a long sword took off his helmet, revealing a handsome face with a faint hint of battle intent in his eyes, “You’re quite strong, my name is Ian Clark, and I am from River Martial Height.”
Jack Clark paused for a moment and then nodded, “…South Sky Martial Height,
Jack Clark.’1
Ian Clark looked at Jack Clark with great interest, proposing, “Student Clark, you are very strong. How about we learn from each other after the trial is over?”
Let’s talk about it if there’s a chance.
Jack Clark felt a terrifying and sharp Sword Qi from this youth, but he didn’t come to compete with others this time, so he didn’t agree.
Suddenly, there were noisy fire alarms in the distance, and the law enforcement team’s patrol cars rushed over. The fire was put out, and the aftermath was dealt with.
There was no choice. Although rhe Blood Envoy was killed this time, the destruction caused during the battle was also severe.
Two layers of buildings with holes punched through them, half of the street destroyed, warehouses burned down, and a few ordinary people affected by the aftermath of rhe battle.
However, these matters had nothing to do with Jack Clark, and the local officials would handle the compensation.
Pity, the reward for killing a Late Fourth Layer Heaven and an Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven was the same: thirty contribution points. The long spear and cloak were destroyed in the battle, and their value was gone. It was unclear whether this battle was a win or a loss.
That night, rhe news that Jack had found and killed the Blood Envoy surprised Crystal Leinster and the others the most.
You really killed that Blood Envoy!?
In the room, Jack Clark, who had just returned from taking a bath and was still drying his hair, was greeted by Crystal Leinster, Mandy Leinster, and Matt Watkins, who had already found out some information.
Looking at the handsome young man with a decisive face in front of her, Crystal Leinster’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
That was a Mid-Stage Fourth Layer Heaven elite Blood Envoy, not an ordinary cultist with weak Qi Blood. Just two days ago, she and her friends were injured after only a few exchanges.
If it weren’t for Freya Louise’s secret treasure temporarily repelling the Blood Envoy, which made him retreat due to the teacher’s guard, someone might have died.
Of course, in the Eastern Summer, there were not few students from their school who could counteract Fourth Layer Heaven Acolytes in the Triplex realm.
For example, Howard Lee and Jane Aiken from their school had killed more than one Fourth Layer Heaven cultist during this time.
But the problem was that those Fourth Layer Heaven cultists were only in the early stage. In this period, only two Mid-Stage Fourth Layer Heaven cultists were defeated, one of whom was rhe one killed tonight.
At this point, Crystal Leinster and the others still assumed that the Blood Envoy was at the Mid-Stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Of course, what surprised them primarily was Jack s initial apparent talent, which was only average. He managed to make it into the Top 50 in the ranking competition, which was already astonishing.
Unexpectedly, after just two months of not seeing each other, his strength had far surpassed everyone else’s.
In contrast to the shocked Crystal Leinster, Mandy Leinster, who had blue hair, was relatively calm and watched the scene with a faint smile on her beautiful face.
Ahem!
Jack Clark coughed, “Class Leader, don’t be so surprised. Actually, I’m not that great. I was just lucky to kill that Blood Envoy this time! ”
‘It seems that Blood Envoy was wounded by Freya’s secret treasure. In addition, Mr. Willard and the others were nearby, and at the last moment, I used a Micro Liquid Bomb to catch him off guard and injured him.”
With ail these factors combined, I barely managed to win.
This battle that crossed realms seemed exaggerated, but when combined with Jack’s external explanations, it seemed reasonable.
They were the most talented geniuses of the Eastern Summer’s new generation. It would be embarrassing if they couldn’t fight across levels against these inheritance-less Blood Envoy cultists.
What is a genius? They not only had to cultivate quickly but also have stronger combat power compared to other cultivators of the same level. Being able to fight the late stage during the early stage or late stage while fighting the next realm is what makes them geniuses.
Otherwise, people who consumed so many resources but had combat power similar to ordinary cultivators would be even worse than mediocrity.
Moreover, Jack Clark did not lie. The Blood Envoy indeed had injuries. There was a shallow wound on his shoulder that had not healed, although it was of little importance .Matt Watkins shook his head slightly: “Although it is said, it is still very surprising.”
At this point, Matt’s gaze becomes a bit complicated.
At the beginning, he was the most determined among them about the trial target, wanting to use life-and-death battles and large resources to make rapid breakthroughs and stand our among the rookies.
It couldn’t be helped, even though his family was not bad, it was not comparable to the Lin sisters, whose parents were both high-level cultivators, and not comparable to Justin Welan, whose elder brother was a high-level cultivator.
And let’s not mention the other geniuses with good talent and wild cultivation backgrounds in the school.
Now two months have passed, he has quickly broken through from the Second Layer Heaven to the Third Layer Heaven, his battle experience in life-and-death fights is extensive, and his gains have reached his expectations.
However, who knew Jack Clark would be the one to make the most progress this time? Though he is also at the Third Layer Heaven, he has the power to slay the Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage, even if that person was injured.
The next afternoon in the hospital bed, Freya Louise chuckled softly: “Last night you scared everyone, Class Leader was in shock for a while.”
By the bedside, dressed in a military uniform, Jack Clark lowered his head slightly to peel an apple and smiled when he heard this: “Was it that exaggerated? 1 just killed a Blood Envoy.”
“Yeah, just a Blood Envoy.11 Freya Louise imitated Jack’s relaxed rone, and after finishing her sentence, she couldn’t help but laugh, her face showing a bit of color.
Today, only Jack Clark came to the hospital. Justin Welan and Marcus Lee followed Zac Lyons and others to take on a mission, with the target being the small town about 50 kilometers away from Erica Knowles.
There were residents reporting suspected traces of cultists there, but Jack Clark felt they would come up empty after looking at the mission’s description, so he didn’t follow along.
Lin sisters were also stimulated by Jack Clark’s fighting strength. They just recovered and already took a mission outside the city to earn more Contribution Points before the trial ended.
Although Erica Knowles hasn’t announced a specific time, since yesterday, some Kroya freshmen from small cities have begun to return.
Students in other cities, including those in Lester City, also received notifications to pack up their belongings, expecting an airplane either tomorrow or the day after.
This trial wiii finally come to an end along with rhe extermination of the Evil God Sect’s high-end powerful men and the establishment of the new official structure of Kroya in alignment with the Federation.
As for Jack Clark.
After hearing Howard Lee say they haven’t caught any new blood disciples or Giant God Sect cultists for two days, he lost interest in tasks with uncertain information.
Whoosh! Ar this moment, the fruit knife in Jack Clark’s hand flashed, cutting the fruit into eight pieces and placing it on a plate.
Putting the fruit plate for her beside him, Jack casually asked: “Freya, did you bring any Taoist books or Buddhist scriptures when you came this time?”
Freya blinked her beautiful eyes: “Are you interested in these scriptures too?
Jack Clark shook his head slightly: “It’s not really interest, mainly after the two months of trials, experiencing numerous battles, I feel that I need to purify my heart.”
The girl tilted her head slightly, surprise flashing in her eyes: “Post-murder syndrome?”‘
A little bit.” Jack Clark nodded. His ambiguous answer led Freya to think he indeed had a bit of post-murder syndrome.
After all, he was just a high school youth, who enjoyed a relaxing campus life before, and in the blink of an eye, he came to fight and kill on a battlefield full of blood and fire.
Under such circumstances, everyone’s mental state was strongly impacted, but they usually suppressed their feelings by being busy with cultivation and tasks.
I borrowed three scriptures this time, one Taoist Clearing Heart Sutra, and two Buddhist More Sutra and Laghmana Sutras, which one do you want to see?”
As she said this, Freya took out three paper books from under her pillow. Of course, these books were not originals, but the newly printed 2055 editions.
As Jack Clark picked up the Clearing Heart Sutra, Freya said softly: “Reading these scriptures requires calming your heart and slowly reading them. 1 didn’t actually get into it at first.”
After reading a few more times, I found that they contain some profound spiritual philosophies, which gave me a feeling of clarity and baptism in my soul.”
I wonder what kind of environment those ancients wrote these profound scriptures.”
The wisdom and certain ideological realms of the ancients were no worse than today’s people. The difference is only the environment and level of civilization.”
After saying this, Jack Clark stood up: “You rest well, 1 will go outside and see if
I can read it11
This hospital used to be a private hospital for rhe royal family and the wealthy, so the single rooms are nor only spacious, but also come with balconies for overlooking the surroundings.
Jack Clark sat on a chair with the Clearing Heart Sutra, slightly lowered his head and started reading.
&
Of course, he wasn’t suffering from any post-murder syndrome. He just wanted to learn from Freya, and see if these scriptures could help him clear his mind and purify the ferocity
Luring this period of fighting battles, the previously suppressed desire for destruction and killing was released.
However, the influence of the Sword Armor Beast Avatar’s consciousness on him still exists.
Or rather, it’s not a matter of consciousness, but that he is essentially half-human and half-ferocious beast, with no distinction between the main body and the avatar.
Therefore, when the consciousness is mainly focused on the main body, he is rational, cautious, and gentle, whereas when it’s concentrated in the avatar, he becomes cold, cruel, brutal, and vicious.
Both parts are him, inseparable. Just during this period, as the Sword Armor Beast becomes stronger and stronger, the desire for ferocity and destruction in his heart is also magnifying.
Therefore, he needs to suppress this desire a little bit, at least not show it in human society.
After all, half of him is ‘human’.
Seeing the handsome youth sitting quietly outside the balcony, Freya Louise’s mouth corners murmur, her eyes showing a hint of gentleness, then she closed her eyes and slowly fell asleep..

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 115: Ability Selection, Terrifying
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 115: Ability Selection, Terrifying
Giant Beast
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
Under the water, at a depth of a hundred meters, the sea was in a violent turmoil as two marine giant beasts fought ardently against each other.
A gray squid with a body length of seventeen meters, flailed its tentacles wildly. Each of its eight tentacles were as thick as a bucket, and covered with dangerous-looking suckers lined with sharp teeth.
Each strike of the tentacles unleashed incredible destructive power, churning the surrounding waters into a muddy mess.
Right now, it was on the defensive.
The other beast, slightly larger, almost ten meters long and black, resembled a fierce dragon. It circled the Mutated Squid at an alarming speed, continuously launching attacks.
Each swipe of its claws would leave a horrifying wound on the squid’s tentacles, occasionally even tearing off a piece.
Consequently, within a short amount of time, the blood of the squid turned the surrounding seawater even deeper blue, driving the Mutated Squid into a frenzy. Its two longest tentacles swept across like giant pythons.
Bang! Bang! The thick tentacles caused the water to burst, but utterly failed to catch the Sword Armor Beast, which in turn ripped one of the tentacles apart with one of its claws.
These two main tentacles differed from the other shorter auxiliary tentacles of a few meters in length. They served as the primary weapons for hunting and fighting for the Mutated Squid. The sword Armor Beast tearing it apart caused it to emit a piercing scream, almost like that of a baby.
Squelch!
At that moment, a rich black energy surged out from beneath the Mutated Squid, enveloping the surrounding area within several tens of meters in a blanket of darkness within the blink of an eye.
Inside this range, the Sword Armor Beast could not sense the movement of the water, nor see a thing. It could not even feel the touch of the seawater as it moved its limbs, as if it was in a dead, silent domain.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Sword Armor Beast finally sensed the vibrations. Within the darkness, giant tentacles coiled around it, wrapping it up like a rice dumpling and dragging it towards the squid’s gaping maw.
Originally, the squid used ink to escape, expelling a large amount of black ink to obstruct its enemy’s view while making its getaway.
However, after numerous mutations, the function had become a special ability that temporarily shrouded the prey’s senses, including vision and even awareness.
Within the range of this dark energy, the squid could move freely to quickly capture its prey, then use its strong tentacles to constrict and suffocate it before slowly devouring it.
But today… Roar! Accompanied by a roar that was reminiscent of a tiger’s, the Sword Armor Beast’s muscles surged, and it struggled with a terrifying burst of power.
Crack! Crack! Crack! With a hundred-fold power, the Mutated Squid’s tentacles were snapped apart one-by-one by the Sword Armor Beast. It extended its claws and grabbed the Mutated Squid’s body, tearing it right apart.
Squelch!
The seven-meter-long body of the Mutated Squid was almost torn in half by the Sword Armor Beast, gushing massive amounts of dark blue blood that turned the surrounding seawater dark blue in an instant.
This was far from the end though. At that moment, black bone spurs shot out and stabbed through the three huge, wriggling hearts within the flesh, thoroughly killing it.
In that instant, the darkness in the sea vanished, revealing the ferociously twisted form of the Sword Armor Beast that had caught hold of the two halves of the squid’s corpse. It exuded a terrifying, murderous aura.
The battle was now over. Next, it was time to eat.
Clutching the corpse of the Mutated Squid, the Sword Armor Beast began to tear huge chunks from it, chewing and swallowing the massive tentacles as if they were spicy sticks. Despite its cold-eyed demeanor, its gaze appeared deep in thought.
These Mutated Beasts, exceeding Level 4, all possessed a power relating to energy attacks. Like a talent, their powers would increase along with their strength.
Now that its physical enhancements included strength, defense, and agility, the Sword Armor Beast needed to acquire an energy category for its Fourth Evolution.
Otherwise, it would be at a disadvantage when facing Level 6 or higher mutated beasts, let alone the mobile disasters known as Giant Beasts.
However, it now faced the problem of which power to choose next.
At present, the energy talents it could think of included the electric power of ordinary electric eels and the blue cold light of Crystal Corner Mutated Fish.
Though it had encountered other mutated creatures with abilities recently, such as the sawtoothed fish and mutated beasts capable of controlling deep-sea vortexes and bubble bombs, these abilities were quite average.
Furthermore, in order to absorb the genes of other creatures, it required the creature to be devoured whole during their evolution. This imposed certain limitations.
For example, creatures that were too large could not be consumed entirely within a short period of time.
As such, the electric eel became its top choice — not only could it be purchased, but its electrical power was also quite potent in water.
However, Jack Clark had reservations about choosing the electric eel.
Jack Clark’s concern was that the ‘electric eel’ was too weak. This weakness refers to the creature’s innate characteristics.
For example, the Unicorn Beetle could pry objects hundreds of times its own weight, while the Iron Beetle boasted a defensive structure that could withstand pressures up to thirty thousand times its own body weight.
There was also the Tiger Beetle, whose speed was so fast that even he could not keep up with its instantaneous movement.
Of course, insects could achieve such absurd power only due to their small size and unique structure. If translated to human size, they might crush themselves under their own weight.
However, this didn’t matter for the Avatar.
The Avatar possessed the ability to fuse, optimize, and selectively choose gene traits when evolving. Therefore, Jack Clark was only concerned about the strength of that specific aspect.
Compared to insects that could surpass their own limits, the electric power of the electric eel seemed quite average.
This was the reason behind Jack Clark’s concern – what if, after the Fourth Evolution, the Sword Armor Beast absorbed the electric power of the electric eel, but the power was not strong enough to condense into a talent? Then it would be a huge loss!
Alternatively, should it search for a mutated electric eel or another low-level mutated creature with a special power to devour?
Just as the Sword Armor Beast had almost consumed the seemingly long but not very meaty Mutated Squid, it suddenly felt a terrifying aura approaching from a distance.The strong aura even miles away made the Sword Armor Beast instinctively want to flee.
Boom boom boom!! The sea water in front of it exploded, countless marine creatures frantically swarmed from a distance, passing by the Sword Armor Beast.
There were all kinds of fish and even mutated whales twenty to thirty meters long fleeing as if a terrifying creature was chasing them.
Such terrible power made the Sword Armor Beast tense as well.
However…
Bang bang bang!! The Sword Armor Beast shot towards the sea surface like a black shadow, hitting all ordinary fish in its way into bloody foam.
In just a blink of an eye, the Sword Armor Beast crossed a hundred meters and appeared on the sea surface.
Then it saw the sky had darkened somehow, with dark clouds rolling in the distance, lightning flashing, and raging winds causing tsunamis of tens to hundreds of meters high.
In the towering waves, many marine creatures that could not escape in time fell with the waves and were killed by the terrifying force, becoming floating corpses on the water.
Such a terrible scene was like the coming of the apocalypse.
Boom! At this moment, a huge thunderbolt descended from the sky, like a Thunder Dragon winding between heaven and earth, striking the sea surface and splashing water everywhere.
Under the glare of the thunderbolt, the Sword Armor Beast vaguely saw a terrifying giant beast wreaking havoc in the sea far away.
Even tens of kilometers apart, the giant’s body was visible, like a fortress in the sea, with a slight movement causing gigantic waves.
Deep Sea Forbidden Zone!!
Instinctively, this word appeared in the Sword Armor Beast’s mind.
During this time, after temporarily letting the Crystal Corner mutated fish go, it had been hunting in a certain direction, staying between one to two hundred meters deep underwater.
Through its research during this time, the Sword Armor Beast discovered that the deeper the sea, the thicker the Heavenly Energy, and the stronger the mutated creatures that roamed and lived there.
It was not clear why for the time being, and it could only investigate further when its strength improved in the future.
But unexpectedly, it had unknowingly approached a deep-sea forbidden zone and encountered the terrifying giant beast coming out to sea.
Feeling the terrifying aura that surged like a storm from a distance, the Sword Armor Beast suppressed its body’s instinctive impulse, took a deep look at the terrifying giant beast, and then turned away.
It seems that it still cannot go too far from the coast at present, and should hunt within two to three hundred kilometers of the coast in the future.
The Sword Armor Beast mixed in with the fleeing marine creatures, and as the distance from the giant beast’s activity range increased, the terrifying aura gradually weakened, until…
Boom!
Suddenly, the ocean began boiling again, and numerous predators launched their attacks on the surrounding prey.
Including the Sword Armor Beast who had its eyes on a fifteen-meter long, sharp-spiked Adapted Bannerfish. Its double claws, like falling pillars, crashed down.
Bang!
In an instant, the seawater rolled, and a terrifying force created a huge vacuum impact bubble deep in the sea. The Adapted Bannerfish’s head exploded under the double claws.
This was the terrifying power of the Sword Armor Beast now.
With its growing size, its Talent of Hundred-fold Power Burst was ever more formidable.
Combined with the instantaneous burst speed of Agility Talent, a mutated beast one rank higher than it would be instantly killed if caught off guard, making its combat power terrifying.
Evening.
On the balcony outside the ward, Jack Clark’s aura grew heavier as his body temperature increased.
However, his Spirit Power immediately surged, covering his whole body, and the heavy aura caused by his terrifyingly dense flesh instantly vanished.
Withdrawing his attention from the Sword Armor Beast, Jack Clark looked at the scripture in his hand, rubbing his forehead with a sigh, “As I thought, these scriptures are not for ordinary people to read.”
Although he had been paying attention to the Sword Armor Beast most of the time, Jack Clark had flipped through the Clearing Heart Sutra several times during the afternoon.
Even though he recognized all the characters, he found the content very confusing when they were combined.
However, there were some gains. For example, after quietly looking through it for an afternoon, Jack Clark’s mind became calmer, and it seemed to be somewhat effective.
Knock knock!!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door, then a middle-aged female doctor in a white coat and a nurse entered the ward. Seeing this, Jack Clark got up and went inside.
There, Freya Louise had already woken up.
“Ms. Louise, I’ve looked over your test report today, and your various indicators have returned to normal, although your cardiovascular function is still a bit weak.”
“You’ll need to stay in the hospital for observation for two more days, and if there are no abnormal changes, you can be discharged.”
Freya Louise nodded slightly, “Thank you, Dr. Elie.”
The middle-aged female doctor shook her head, “It is us who should be grateful. If it weren’t for the Federation’s intervention, Koroya under the rule of the Evil God Sect would have become hell.”
Following that, the female doctor gave a few more instructions before politely leaving.
Seeing this, Jack Clark smiled..

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 116: The End of Return, First Contact
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 116: The End of Return, First Contact
Translator: 549690339
Freya Louise’s injury was not too serious, which was good news, but it was getting late, so Jack Clark chatted with her for a while and then left the hospital.
Driving back to the base a few kilometers away, Jack Clark had just gotten out of the car when he met someone familiar.
A few meters away, Jane Aiken, in her black-red armor with a tall figure and no helmet, gor out of her modified off-road vehicle that had just stopped.
When Jack saw her, the girl noticed him as well, paused for a moment and nodded in recognition: “Jack Clark, I remember you, but you went to Lester City.”
There were nearly fifty classes in South Sky Martial Height’s Senior One, and the two of them were not in the same class. Jane Aiken’s impression of Jack Clark was still at 49th place in the freshman ranking competition.
He was the only freshman to make it into the top 50 with low-level martial arts, and she was surprised when she heard her classmates talking about it at the time.
Jack’s face broke into a smile: “1 didn’t expect to meet Jane Aiken here, just returned from an outbound mission?”
“Yes, I was tracking a fanatical cultist of the Giant God Sect with an Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven,” Jane Aiken’s character was somewhat light, but not as cold as imagined.
As they talked, they walked side by side towards the base building.
I saw it in the trial group this morning Matt Watkins said you rushed from Lester City yesterday and found and killed that Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy last night,” the girl turned slightly, her eyes curious, “Can you tell me how you found that person?”
After the attack on Crystal Leinster’s team, many people searched the city the next day, including her, who planned to come back later and try to find the Blood Envoy.
Not to mention that everyone came from the same school, but the 30 contribution points alone were of interest to many people.
However, his concealment ability was very strong, and no one could find any trace after searching for a day, so they all thought the Blood Envoy had escaped from Erica Knowles.
Jane Aiken thought for a moment, “It has to do with my martial arts. I cultivated a realm called Heart’s Eye, which can keenly sense hostile gazes around me.”
After guessing that the Blood Envoy might be hiding near the hospital, I deliberately circled it, and the special forces’ battle armor did indeed catch his attention.”
Through the gaze, 1 located his position and then it was simple.
Jane Aiken halted abruptly, turning to look at Jack Clark with sharp eyes, and a terrible Sword Intent flowing through them: “Heart’s Eye Realm! The one called Mind’s Eye Bright Knife?”
Is this martial art so famous?” Jack was surprised by her reaction.
Of course.”
Jane Aiken’s terrible Sword Intent slowly converged: “This martial art is low-level, but it was sensational more than a decade ago because of a man named Jonathan West.”
“Unfortunately, it is too hard to cultivate and gradually became unpopular. 1 didn’t expect that you, Jack, managed to cultivate it to the third layer, allowing you to track enemies through their gaze and locate their position.”
Jane Aiken modestly replied, “Not at all, it’s just luck.
Jane Aiken shook her head: “It’s not luck. Being able to cultivate Heart’s Eye to the third layer means you have a high level of enlightenment in martial arts related to the mind and intent.”
I didn’t expect Jane Aiken to know so much about Mind’s Eye Bright Knife.”
Because I’ve tried to exchange it before, but unfortunately, this martial art doesn’t suit me.”
As they talked, the two arrived at the base building. Since Jane Aiken still had to hand over the task, Jack Clark continued to walk towards the back of the cafeteria.
Once inside the base, trial students in battle armor could be seen everywhere, making Jack, who was dressed in military uniform, stand out even more.
He had no choice, as his battle armor was severely damaged and still under repair.
Jack, over here.
After Jack has picked up his meal in the cafeteria, Justin Welan, who had already returned, waved at him. Sitting beside him were Zac Lyons, Marcus Lee, and the discharged White Veil.
These guys had the best relationship now, going out on missions together.
Jack sat down and casually asked, “How was it? Did you gain anything today?
Don’t mention it.”
Zac Lyons complained, “Seven or eight people scrambled for a simple mission to track down a cultist, and by the time we got to that small town, we found out the news was wrong.”
Marcus Lee nodded, “The news being wrong is one thing, but those guys didn’t give up. They practically turned that small town upside down before leaving.”
…That includes you, right?” Jack tried to hide his smile.
Ah! No.”
White Veil coughed to cover up, “We just thought the scenery around that small town was nice, so we went sightseeing for half a day.”
At this moment, Justin Welan suddenly said, “Oh right, Jack, have you seen the news in the big group?”
Jack shook his head, “No, I haven’t checked my phone this afternoon. Is there any new notice?”
“Both Mr. Lester and Mr. Perry have notified in the two groups that the war on their side has ended, and they will arrange for the new students of Erica Knowles to return in three days.”
Three days, huh.” Jack nodded slightly, figuring it was about right.
Zac Lyons said, “We discussed it today and decided to exchange all our contributions for resources, or we won’t be able to exchange for some good stuff when we go back.”
“For example, Silver Ring Fruit, which can significantly strengthen one’s physique, is not only much cheaper here but also not on the school s exchange list.”
And resources like Seven-leaf Flower that enhance True Strength activity, and Extreme Cold Liquid that improve True Strength purity, can’t be exchanged after we go back.”
…1 don’t need to exchange anything.” Jack thought for a moment.
After killing the Blood Envoy last night, he had 30 more contribution points on his account, but it wasn’t enough to exchange for a life crystal for the ultimate enhancement of Mind’s Eye Bright Knife.
As for high-level martial arts, it was even more out of reach, but for him, other precious resources with strange effects were not so important.
“By the way, haven’t Crystal and the others come back yet?””I didn’t see anyone; 1 don’t know if they’re back yet.”
Over the next two days, Jack Clark focused most of his attention on the Sword Armor Beast, visiting the hospital in the afternoon to chat with Freya Louise and read scriptures for half a day.
On the third day, Lori Parma and the others returned to the base, dusty from their journey, each of them emitting an oppressive aura.
Especially Vernon Leinster and other Seventh Layer Fleaven high-level cultivators, the pressure from the terrifying energy fluctuations surroundin them made it difficult for the others to breathe even when they were suppressing it.
Then, Jack and the others received the notice to pack their belongings and gather at the base entrance at 1 PM.
Finally going back.
At Erica Knowles’ airport, Jack Clark and the others, wearing military uniforms, sat on chairs waiting to board the plane, with their luggage, weapons, and armor boxes in front of them.
Through the Control Tower’s glass, they could see various airplanes raking off and landing on the scattered runways outside, bustling with activity.
It couldn’t be helped, as unlike ordinary cities with only one or two schools participating in a trial, this time Erica Knowles gathered dozens of schools’ geniuses and teachers, who needed to be sent back in batches.
We re on flight 018, and it’s almost our turn.” Justin Welan looked up at the changing numbers on the big screen with anticipation.
Jack Clark also showed a faint smile on his face.
There were quite a few people returning to South Sky Martial Height from Erica Knowles this time, including thirteen Triplex Heaven trial students, as well as five teachers including Vernon Leinster, totaling eighteen people.
Among the freshmen, besides Justin Welan and Crystal Leinster, there were also Howard Lee, who appeared a few days later, Kyle Hawk – the third in the freshman ranking and Jane Aiken, etc.
“Attention please, flight 018 will be boarding soon. South Sky Martial Height students, please proceed to runway 4 for boarding.”
Accompanied by the Control Tower’s broadcast, Jack Clark and the others quickly got up, carried their weapons, and lined up with their big and small luggage to walk out of the Control Tower.
Underneath the airliner loaded with a large number of attack weapons, Lori Parma and the others were already waiting for them. When they saw them come out, they shouted, “Put your weapons and luggage in the cabin and make sure they’re securely fastened.”
Teacher Parma, long time no see.
Teacher Lyons, you seem to have gotten prettier.”
Director Leinster, how many high-level guys did you take down this time?”
Justin Welan and the others greeted Lori Parma and the others with playful smiles, without the initial restraint. Vernon Leinster snorted, “Hurry up, don’t you want to go back earlier?”
Yes, yes…
There wasn’t much luggage for the more than ten people, but the main problem was the weapons, especially the iron column that Marcus Lee had thickened and lengthened to four meters. It was not only long but also extremely heavy.
Hum!
With the roar of the engines, the airplane glided along the runway and then suddenly lifted into the sky.
This time, Jack Clark and Freya Louise were seated in the same row, with the girl leaning by the window. After the plane entered the stratosphere, she turned her head slightly and whispered to Jack Clark.
Jack, do you want to read?
Jack Clark smiled gently, “You read, I’m going to take a nap.
The girl nodded lightly, “Okay.
This was not their first time on a plane, and everyone was much more composed compared to the excited shouting when they first arrived. After takeoff, they all closed their eyes to rest.
Jack Clark was no exception, sinking his consciousness to the Sword Armor Beast’s side.
In the oceanic area 200 kilometers near the coast and 100 meters below the sea surface, a ten-meter-long, pitch-black, and ferocious-looking Sword Armor Beast was lurking at the seabed.
A hundred meters ahead, a fourteen-meter-long, barrel-thick, and brightly colored Mutant Sea Python was hunting a Great White Shark.
At that moment, the huge body of rhe Sea Python had wrapped the seven-meter-long shark, and under the terrifying constriction, the shark had lost its struggle, with its internal organs almost crushed.
Hiss!
Just then, the Mutant Sea Python suddenly released the shark, its ferocious snake head glancing towards the left side of the seabed, where a black Mutated Beast had already approached it by more than twenty meters.
The moment the Mutant Sea Python discovered the beast, the Sword Armor Beast’s limb muscles swelled, and its power burst forth in an instant.
Bang! The seabed shook violently, and thousands of tons of mud, sand, and gravel mixed with seawater exploded. Bursting forth with its Agility Talent, the Sword Armor Beast soared out.
Even because of its extreme speed, a white transparent shock wave appeared in front of its body, flashing past the Mutant Sea Python’s face in an instant.
Crash!
Before the Mutant Sea Python could react, its huge snake head exploded into countless pieces of flesh and blood, killed in a second by the single swipe of the Sword Armor Beast’s claw as it flew past.
In the murky seawater filled with mud, sand, and blood, the Sword Armor Beast slowly swam over from the distance, its cold gaze passing over the Sea Python’s corpse, finally landing on the crystal located in the torn wound.
A Level 3 Crystal.
Immediately, the corners of the Sword Armor Beast’s ferocious mouth curled up slightly, extending its huge right claw and gently digging out the pigeon egg-sized crystal.
Having been in the sea for so long, it had eaten a large number of Mutated Beasts, but so far it had only harvested two crystals.
It couldn’t be helped; these crystals only existed in the bodies of Mutated Creatures at the peak of their evolution.
However, this time the Sword Armor Beast didn’t devour the crystal, and instead used its sharp claw to scrape off the Sea Python’s scales, cut a piece of snake skin, made a makeshift snake skin bag, and wrapped the crystal with it.
It then cut out a long strip of snake skin to make a rope, tied the bag, and struggled to put it around its neck, planning to leave it for Jack Clark to convert into Attribute points when he returned.
Compared to the Sword Armor Beast consuming the crystal and converting it into Evolution value, it was more cost-effective for Jack Clark to convert it into Attribute points at the moment.
After all, the Evolution value could be accumulated by devouring the flesh and blood of Mutated Beasts..

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 117: Transforming Heaven and Earth, The Existence Above Gods
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 117: Transforming Heaven and Earth, The Existence Above Gods
Translator: 549690339
Eleven hours of flight time plus the reverse timezone difference, by the time they approached Eastern Summer, it was already morning.
Compared to the mutated bird attack on their way there, the return journey was quite smooth.
As Jack Clark looked at the golden clouds illuminated by the sunlight, he couldn’t help but feel a bit emotional, and recalled everything that happened during this trial.
In summary, there were surprises, but no real dangers. His cultivation level skyrocketed to Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, and his combat power far exceeded his current realm. In normal conditions, he would be slightly stronger than a Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage.
If he activated the Elephant’s Fury Rune, his combat power would be able to suppress and kill a Late Fourth Layer Heaven, and he could maintain this burst of power for about twenty minutes. After that, he would be weak for about two days.
The longer the burst of power, the weaker he would be afterward, after all, his Qi Blood would be burning away.
This was also the reason why Jack Clark didn’t take on any tasks after killing the Blood Envoy, his legs were weak.
While Jack Clark was leaning against the window and looking at the boundless sea of clouds in a pensive mood, he didn’t notice that Freya Louise’s face had turned a faint shade of red.
It couldn’t be helped; Jack’s line of sight would brush across her face. Freya knew that Jack wasn’t staring at her, but she was still a little shy.
Under the sunlight, the girl’s slightly flushed face was pale but also rosy, and her profile was very attractive.
At this moment, the announcement suddenly came on with a flight attendant’s voice, “Attention, we are about to enter Eastern Summer airspace.”
…? Jack Clark returned to his senses, his eyes filled with confusion, and wondered what’s so special about entering Eastern Summer airspace.
At this time, the clouds outside the window became thinner, and they could vaguely see the undulating mountains and surging rivers on the ground below, as if a magnificent and beautiful painting.
Then the airplane seemed to pass through some kind of enchantment, and Jack Clark only felt an overwhelming Heavenly Energy rushing towards him.
Whew! Jack Clark took a deep breath, his face showing a surprised look. Turning his head, he saw that not only him, but Zac Lyons, Marcus Lee, and the others had similar expressions.
At this moment, Lori Parma’s figure appeared at the front cabin door, his voice deep, “Everyone must have felt the change, right?”
“Yes, teacher.”
White Veil nodded, “The feeling just now was like returning from a barren desert to a vibrant oasis, it’s so strange, we didn’t feel this way before.”
“Because you have always been living in Eastern Summer with its rich Heavenly Energy, you are used to it, and your previous strength was too weak to notice the difference.”
Lori Parma suddenly asked, “Do you know why the school divides the initial authority based on Foundation Establishment time and gives more resources to students with better talents?”
As he spoke, Lori Parma looked at Jack Clark.
It couldn’t be helped; Jack Clark was the only one cultivating a low-level martial arts here. Seeing this, he could only cooperate and shake his head.
Lori Parma said indifferently, “Because resources are limited, these resources include the cultivation resources you exchange for use, as well as the Heavenly Energy within Eastern Summer.”
“These Heavenly Energies are not air and are limited resources. The more cultivators who absorb them, the greater the consumption, and the concentration of Heavenly Energy between heaven and earth will become lower and lower.”
“Just like ordinary biological mutations, under the rich energy, unborn fetuses and growing children will also be affected.”
“This is also the reason why there are more and more people with cultivation qualifications in my Eastern Summer and one of the reasons for controlling the dissemination of Cultivation Methods.”
“Before a solution is found, the authorities will not fully liberalize cultivation methods, otherwise, the benefits will not be worth the loss under the crazy consumption of Heavenly Energy.”
“You must know that a genius who has cultivated to the King-level is far more important than tens of thousands of ordinary cultivators in terms of peak power and creation value.”
“Of course, the officials have not given up on those with average qualifications, providing them with standard cultivation resources and support. However, whether they can stand out is up to them.”
“After all, the initial Foundation Establishment is just the first screening and cannot detect all geniuses. Moreover, not being a genius does not mean they have no value in life.”
“The Human Federation is a whole, composed of billions of people, and everyone can find their suitable position and reason for existence in the federation.”
“Just like us, our talent during our school cultivation days was only average.
After more than ten years, we have gradually cultivated to the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, becoming teachers of the school.”
“What, teacher, your talents back then were only average?”
Zac Lyons was a little surprised, “You are now at the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, don’t tell me those geniuses in your same period are in the Eight Layer Heaven, or even the Ninth Heaven and above?”
Lori Parma nodded, “It’s about right, but many of them have already died.”
Immediately, the entire cabin became quiet, with astonished looks on everyone’s faces.
“Many of them died!!” White Veil swallowed hard.
Lori Parma calmly said, “As geniuses, they enjoy more resources from the federation but also bear more responsibilities. Under these circumstances, the dangers they face are far greater than ours.”
“Some have fallen on more tragic battlefields, some have died in battles against terrifying giant beasts, and some have disappeared on the road to exploring unknown territories.”
“Of course, all of this is voluntary, and no one has forced them. Even we have fought on the frontline battlefield for many years, experiencing countless bloody battles.”
“Cough, let’s get back on track, these matters are still too far away from you. As this generation of new talents, the better you perform, the more resource support you will receive.”
“For example, in this trial, in addition to the contribution points resources you have already received, those who break through the Third Realm during the trial will have access to secret method permissions.”
“The top 100 in battle achievements will also receive additional rewards. Almost all of these people have a record of killing Fourth Layer Heaven Acolytes at a higher level.”
Am I included? Jack Clark’s eyes flickered slightly, and he couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Teacher, what are the additional rewards?”
Lori Parma glanced at him, nodded slightly, “Higher exchange and information privileges, such as the advanced Cultivation Method for your Dragon Elephant Power, the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, which ordinary students cannot exchange.””In addition, you can also pick a free common skill, which normally costs hundreds of contribution points to exchange for.”
Upon hearing this, Jack Clark’s face broke into a smile, not expecting so many additional gains.
Especially that secret method worth 100 contribution points, which was almost equivalent to his total earnings from this trial.
At this moment, Marcus Lee curiously asked, “Teacher, can 1 ask how the Invisible Heavenly Energy is confined within the Eastern Summer territory by the Federation?”
To this question, Lori Parma simply said, “It’s easy, just set up an Enchantment that covers the entire Eastern Summer and only restrains the Heavenly Energy.”
“…Enchantment?” Everyone looked at each other.
“Don’t think too much about it, this is a means beyond the King-level.”
“And the person who set up the Enchantment covering the entire Eastern Summer is even more powerful than a conventional deity and is above even the gods themselves.”
“Moreover, not only Eastern Summer, but also Western Simon and Northern
Berlin have such nationwide Enchantments.”
“Alright, we’ll be arriving at Mist River in about an hour. Go home and rest for two days, then report to the school the day after tomorrow.” Having said that, Lori Parma returned to the front cabin.
However, the information he just revealed shocked everyone.
Jack Clark was also a little surprised.
He never knew that the entire Eastern Summer was covered by a huge, boundless Enchantment, restraining the Heavenly Energy from flowing outwards without affecting the penetration of matter.
As for where this Heavenly Energy came from, it was, of course, the mythical world where those Giant Beasts resided.
Jack Clark turned his head slightly and looked at the equally shocked Freya Louise, puzzled, “Freya, are you hearing this for the first time too?”
“Yes.” The girl nodded slightly.
Jack found it strange, “Don’t you and the Class Leader both have high-level cultivators in your family? How come you don’t know about these things?”
“Who said 1 have cultivators in my family?” The girl couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Jack, the corners of her eyes smiling, like a little fox with a hint of seductiveness.
Freya Louise then explained, “And even if it’s the Class Leader’s family, 1 don’t think they’d tell them in advance either.”
“Some information, if you don’t have enough strength and realm, knowing it in advance will only cause worry, and may even lead to unrealistic expectations affecting your cultivation mindset.”
