“Your family doesn’t have high-level, 1 mean, no cultivators?” Jack quickly caught the point.
He had always thought that Freya’s background was similar to Crystal Leinster’s, never expecting she would be ordinary like himself… No, ordinary families couldn’t afford a sniper cannon like that.
Not to mention the guns, just the bullets that could kill Third Layer Heaven and Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoys were extremely valuable.
Regarding this question, the girl only smiled at the corner of her eyes and didn’t reveal more.
Not only Jack Clark but also Zac Lyons and others were discussing enthusiastically. Clearly, their minds were greatly shocked, as well as envious.
They envied Jack and the other guys who made a cross-level killing, could choose a secret method, and have higher core authority in the school after returning.
The next hour passed quickly. With the engine’s noise decreasing, the plane suddenly jerked and landed on the runway.
On the side of the runway, Vernon Leinster and six other teachers stood in front, sternly saying, “You have made great progress in this trial and have lived up to the expectations of the school.”
“But we teachers and the school are just builders and guides, we can only provide protection and support within a certain range.”
“Whether you become a top-level powerhouse or a Nine Layers Heaven in the future still depends on your own efforts.”
“Alright, according to the rules, weapons and equipment should still be stored in the school, and the staff will help you with transport after getting off the flight, giving you a ride along the way.”
“Get in the car, everyone.”
Jack Clark and the others boarded the school shuttle bus one after another and before long, two buses entered the city area, with towering skyscrapers in view and bustling traffic on the streets.
Jack Clark inexplicably felt like he had returned to a civilized society again. There’s no choice, Koroya was just too backward and poor.
“Jack, I’m suddenly a bit nervous, what should I do?” Justin Welan, who was sitting in the front seat, was a bit nervous.
Jack was speechless, “What are you nervous about? We just went to the trial and didn’t do anything like killing people or arson, besides, it’s only been two months.”
Justin looked at him in surprise, “Didn’t we go to kill people and set fires?”
Pfft! Freya couldn’t help but laugh at the side.
Crystal Leinster who was sitting opposite didn’t seem too happy, “Justin Welan, if you can’t speak properly, don’t open your mouth. We represent justice to suppress those evil cultists, not to kill people and set fires.”
ii
Uh… This is what Jack said, class leader, why are you blaming me?” Justin looked somewhat wronged.
Crystal justified her actions, “1 can’t beat that guy now, so how can I say anything about him? What if he challenges me in front of everyone after school starts?”
“So you’re just bullying me, class leader, you’re too realistic.” Justin looked aggrieved.
Sitting with Crystal, Mandy Leinster chuckled, “Not realistic, this is called a wise man knowing his circumstances. My sister has always been like this.”
Returning to the familiar city, everyone’s tense spirits completely relaxed. Jokes and laughter filled the atmosphere on the bus, making it less somber.
On the other bus, Vernon and the other teachers were discussing the school rewards for outstanding students on this trial, in addition to the official rewards..

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 118: The Domination of the Dragon-
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 118: The Domination of the Dragon-
Turtle, Eight Desolate Purification Hell (Big Chapter)
Translator: 549690339
Because his home was on the edge of the city, Jack Clark was the first to arrive home.
Mr. Willard, Freya, Class Leader, and everyone else, 111 be getting off the bus now. See you at school the day after tomorrow.
After saying goodbye to everyone, Jack carried the box with the gifts and got off the bus. He waited for the bus to leave before he prepared to cross the street.
It was already past ten oclock in the morning, and the train station was still some distance away from his home.
However, before Jack could get close, a neighbor who was working in the courtyard of the house next door saw him and couldnt help but shout: Doris, your son Jack is back!
It couldnt be helped, after two months, Jack had grown taller, reaching 185 centimeters. His military uniform with a black base and red edges made him look very handsome and eye-catching as he walked down the street.
The first to rush out was Glenn Clark, who had grown even taller over the past two months. He was now about 178 centimeters tall and looked even more stalwart and imposing.
If Jack didnt know Glenn was only thirteen years old, he would have mistaken him for a muscle trainer.
Glenn hugged his brother excitedly and took the luggage from his hand: Brother, youre finally back.
Jim, arent you going to school?
Its winter break, brother.
Its winter break already. Jack paused for a moment, then recalled that it was already January 2nd.
With a tiger-like face, Glenn said, Yeah, its only half a month before the New
Year. Its a good thing you made it back, or our home would have been very lonely this year.
Just then, Doris also came out.
Looking at the slightly excited Doris, Jack said gently, Mom, Im back.
Its good to be back, its good to be back. Doris carefully examined Jack and found that he wasnt injured and looked energetic before she finally relaxed a little.
Two months had passed, and Jacks face was much more mature, showing a firm and resolute look, full of vigor and vitality.
Despite feeling proud of the change, Doris also felt a little heartache.
Upon returning home, Jack was pestered by Glenn to tell him about the Koroya Trial. Jack chose to tell him some things he was allowed to share and omitted any details about the fighting.
At the same time, he presented the gifts he had brought back to them.
By the way, Jack, your birthday is in ten days.
At lunchtime, Doris suddenly said: I heard from Glenn that youve made a few good friends at school. Theres a girl named Freya who is very pretty. Do you want to invite them over for dinner on your birthday?
After saying this, Doriss eyes were full of expectation.
Cough! No, no need. Its just an ordinary birthday; theres no need to go through all that trouble. I- Ill just have a cake. Jack almost choked and quickly shook his head.
It was just an ordinary birthday, after all. Inviting guests to dinner would be too much trouble.
Doris looked a bit disappointed: Well, 1 was thinking we could have a lively celebration with your friends over for your birthday. Just last month, I got a promotion at work, and my income has increased a lot.
Jack shook his head decisively: Lets wait for my twentieth birthday then. That would be more meaningful.
Alright.bender
After dinner, Jack spent the afternoon being bombarded with questions by Glenn. In the end, he managed to get rid of him by saying that he needed to cultivate.
However, Jack was not lying to him.
In the afternoon, Jack sat cross-legged on the corridor in the backyard and his majestic Dragon Elephant True Strength began to circulate within his body. Immediately, the surrounding rich Heavenly Energy gathered around him.
While drawing in the Heavenly Energy, Jack used half of his spirit to check in on the Sword Armor Beast.
Golden sunlight filtered through the seawater, rendering the 100-meter-deep underwater world colorful. The 10-meter-long Unique Beast lazily lay on a coral reef.
At this moment, the Sword Armor Beast had just finished eating and was resting. It was also enjoying the scenery with a relaxed spirit, after all, it was not made of iron.
This time, the Sword Armor Beasts ferocious aura was hidden, making it seem harmless to fish.
However, even so, no fish dared to approach it.
It couldnt be helped that its 10-meter-long body had an innate deterrence, not to mention its ferocious head and blood-red feathered horn on both sides making it look terrifying.
But just then, a school of fish scattered in front, and countless fish of various sizes swam past the Sword Armor Beast.
Seeing this, the Sword Armor Beast opened its eyes, and a cold light appeared in its golden vertical pupils because this situation indicated the appearance of a powerful Mutated Beast.
Sure enough, a giant shadow appeared in the distance shortly after.
The thick, pillar-like limbs were covered in scales, the heavy, reef-like brown turtle shell was covered in sharp spikes, and a ferocious head that looked like a Flood Dragon.
Most importantly, this 26-meter-long and 10-meter-tall Mutant Giant Turtle exuded a heavy aura.
This Mutant Giant Turtle was powerful, and even the Sword Armor Beast felt a potent sense of danger facing it, making its eyes sharpen instantly.
Roar!
The Sword Armor Beast slowly stood up and let out a warning growl from its mouth. The vibrating sound waves rippled far away in the water, causing many fish to turn their stomachs.
Although there was a significant difference in size between the two, the Sword Armor Beast was not afraid, as it could escape with its speed if it could not win.
In response to its warning, the ferocious Mutant Giant Turtle glanced coldly at the Sword Armor Beast and ignored it, walking straight past it with its colossal body.
It was actually ignored. The battle-ready Sword Armor Beast paused.
As it watched the dust stirring up behind the giant turtle crawling on the sea floor, the Sword Armor Beasts eyes moved. It noticed that the giant turtle seemed to be heading towards the Mutated Crystal Angelfishs Territory.
Since returning from the open sea, the Sword Armor Beast had been hunting near the Mutated Crystal Angelfishs Territory..

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination, Eight Desolate Hell's Refining (Big Chapter) !
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination, Eight Desolate Hells Refining (Big Chapter) !
Translator: 549690339
It had no intention of letting those mutated fish, rich in energy, go, and was also interested in the luminous corals on the volcano mouth.
However, it couldnt resolve the situation against the Crystal Angelfish, measuring over ten to twenty meters in length, at least for now.
If faced with just one, the Sword Armor Beast felt that it should have no problem killing it. As its size grew to ten meters, its strength also increased many times.
Unfortunately, these creatures gathered in groups and never left the volcanic vent, which left the Sword Armor Beast helpless.
That freezing cold light attack was too strong. It didnt want to risk its life for a few bites of mutated fish meat if it couldnt instantly kill three of them.
But now
The Sword Armor Beasts tail moved slightly, and it followed the Mutant Giant Turtle from afar.
As the Sword Armor Beast moved forward, the seabed in front of it became lower and lower, reaching depths of 400 to 500 meters into pitch darkness.
Even the Sword Armor Beast could only vaguely sense its surroundings through its feather horns, including the huge shadow several hundred meters away.
Soon, faint light came from a distance, which was the habitat of the Crystal Angelfish.
Boom!
As the Mutant Giant Turtle approached within 100 meters, the Crystal Angelfish suddenly went into a frenzy.bender
It seemed as if both sides had a grudge.
Hiding in the darkness, the Sword Armor Beast saw the three huge Crystal Angelfish suddenly move and attack the Mutant Giant Turtle with six other Crystal Angelfish, each ten meters long.
As soon as they approached, six beams of blue light the thickness of thighs and three half a meter thick beams burst out. The sea water instantly froze into ice pillars where the beams passed, giving off a terrifying chill.
Crack, crack, crack!!
The overwhelming cold light enveloped the Mutant Giant Turtle, and in a blink of an eye, it and the surrounding sea water were covered in a layer of blue hard ice over two meters thick.
What a powerful icy energy. Staring at the ice mountain over ten meters high, the Sword Armor Beasts eyes narrowed.
But at this moment, cracks appeared in the frozen ice mountain, followed by a sudden explosion, revealing the unharmed Mutant Giant Turtle inside.
A layer of earth-colored ripples flowed over the giant turtles body, emitting a heavy, immovable aura like a mountain. It moved its limbs and continued to crawl towards the volcano mouth.
This scene reminded the Sword Armor Beast of Justin Welan, strong in defense but weak in attack.
Watching the Mutant Giant Turtle continue to move, the Crystal Angelfish became even more agitated. The blue crystal horn on their heads lit up again, and beams of blue cold light burst out.
With a series of thumping sounds, the Mutant Giant Turtle was once again frozen into a thick ice mountain under the terrifying cold energy.
And this time, due to the sustained output of the Mutated Crystal Angelfish, the blue hard ice on its body kept increasing in thickness, gradually forming an ice mountain more than 50 meters high and over a hundred meters wide on the seabed.
Under these circumstances, even the giant turtle couldnt move with a pile of ice weighing tens of thousands of tons, and it was pinned heavily on the seabed.
However, with such a huge energy output, the light on the heads of the six 10 meter-long Crystal Horn Fish soon dimmed, and their bodies emitted a weak breath, quickly stopping.
Then, with the blue light beams shot out by the 15-meter, 20-meter, and
23-meter Crystal Angelfish, their crystal horns also grew weaker and weaker.
Woo!
From beneath the ice mountain, a sound like a whistle suddenly rang out. In an instant, the thick brown light on the Mutant Giant Turtles body began to vibrate, even causing the surrounding seabed to shake.
Boom, boom, boom!!
With the tumultuous shockwaves, countless mud and sand rose, the seawater churned, and cracks appeared on the heavy ice mountain, which shattered incessantly.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Heavy ice blocks fell on the seabed, causing slight vibrations, while some of the smaller fragments floated towards the sea surface.
In the swirling mix of ice and bubbles, the Mutant Giant Turtle slowly crawled out and continued towards the volcano mouth, ignoring the Mutated Crystal Angelfish.
Seeing the giant turtle crawling halfway up the slope, the Crystal Angelfish became even more restless. One of the ten-meter-long fish couldnt help but rush up, trying to push it away.
However, when the Mutated Crystal Angelfish collided with the giant turtle, it couldnt budge it at all.
In comparison to the 26-meter-long, massive, four-legged turtle, the 10-meter-long Crystal Angelfishs strength was like that of an infant.
Bang, bang!! Two more Crystal Angelfish couldnt help but rush up, slamming hard against the giant turtle, but it still only tickled it.
Bang!
At that moment, the seawater exploded, and the giant turtles head burst out at a terrifying speed, leaving an afterimage as it bit into the nearest Crystal Angelfish.
Its toothy jaws bit tightly into the Crystal Angelfishs body, ignoring its struggle. As the biting force burst out, the sharp teeth tore through the fish scales, and then, crack!
Under the terrifying biting force, the giant turtle directly bit the Crystal Angelfish into two pieces, its ferocious mouth tearing and devouring it, with blood and flesh spreading in the water.
The other Crystal Angelfish scattered in panic upon seeing this, including the three giant ones, which only dared to swim at a distance and did not approach.
It seemed they had seen this scene a few times before.
Soon, the giant turtle finished eating the Crystal Angelfish and continued to crawl towards the volcano mouth above.
With the Crystal Angelfish no longer blocking its way, the giant turtle quickly climbed to the mouth of the volcano and opened its big mouth, crunching and devouring the glowing coral reefs.
Seeing this, the Crystal Angelfish swimming nearby became even more anxious. They couldnt help but shoot freezing cold light again, but they still couldnt stop the giant turtle.
With a terrifying defense provided by its heavy armor and the thick, heavy aura of the yellow halo emanating from its body, the giant turtle was able to completely ignore those freezing light beams..</p

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination,
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination,
Eight Desolate Hells Refining (Big Chapter)_3
Translator: 549690339
Each time the one-meter-thick ice on its back was covered, an earthquaking yellow halo cracked the ice, letting the Crystal Angelfish despair.
The Sword Armor Beasts eyes narrowed in the darkness.
It wondered whether it should intervene and stop the Giant Mutant Turtle.
Clearly, these coral-like objects might be some Treasure of Heaven and Earth, otherwise the Crystal Horn Fish and the Giant Turtle wouldnt be fighting for them.
Plus, it seemed that this kind of incident happened more than once.
But the Sword Armor Beast suppressed the impulse to act for just a moment.
Because the Mutant Giant Turtle had some restraint towards it.
In its estimation, its rank among Mutated Beasts should be at Level 4 Peak, and with its three innate physical talents, it could easily kill ordinary Level 5 Mutated Beasts.
Even some Level 6 Mutated Beasts could be defeated, like the largest Mutated Crystal Angelfish, the Sword Armor Beast was confident it could kill a single one.
However, this Mutated Giant Turtle was estimated to be around Level 6 Peak, and the pervasive defense on its body made the Sword Armor Beast feel like it would have no way of attacking it effectively.
As for killing it after exhausting its energy, the Sword Armor Beast quickly gave up on the idea.
Through its earlier observation it keenly noticed that this giant turtles abilities were likely related to the earth, and standing over the seabed its defense and recovery capabilities were quite scary.
Of course, the main reason was that the Sword Armor Beast lacked energy-type talents, which led to some restrictions when it came to combat abilities.
Whether it was offense or defense.
In this situation, Jack Clark became even more expectant of the fourth evolution of the Avatar, wondering how much the Sword Armor Beasts combat ability would improve after acquiring an energy-type talent.
As the Sword Armor Beast continued to lurk and the Crystal Angelfish were persistently attacking, the Mutated Giant Turtle rapidly devoured the luminous corals around the volcano mouth.
Woo! Over the small volcano crater, the Mutated Giant Turtle roared, the sound thick and powerful, as it spread far without being hindered by sea water.
Boom!
A heavy, extensive aura erupted from the Mutated Giant Turtle, with its momentum skyrocketing, and red and blue energy lights radiated from its body as it started to change.
The expanding body cracked open the spiked turtle shell, and cracks appeared on the surface, revealing a new, sturdier turtle shell underneath.bender
Besides this, the Mutated Giant Turtles limbs grew even more sturdy, its skin covered with thicker new scales, and even sharp talons emerged from its thick and heavy legs.
And the most noticeable change was in the head.
Its neck, covered in scales, became more robust and elongated, while the two sharp horns on its menacing head burst through the skin. In an instant, a formless pressure spread throughout the ocean.
When the two sharp horns emerged, the Mutated Giant Turtle had a breakthrough to Level 7, and it seemed to awaken some kind of bloodline inside its body.
The powerful pressure caused the Sword Armor Beast to narrow its eyes as it recognized an eerily familiar feeling.
In the previous third evolution, some sort of genetic power had awakened inside its body, granting it a similar king bloodline aura, which granted it strength far beyond its peers.
In the face of this terrifying pressure, the remaining three Crystal Angelfish that had been attacking relentlessly stiffened, revealing a touch of fear in their eyes, then instinctively retreated.
Woo roars!
The Mutated Giant Turtle, successful in evolution, let out an excited howl. Its formerly whistling-like sound gradually turned into a low growl, as an intangible shockwave erupted and grew stronger and stronger.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!
The terrifying shockwave force impacted within a range of more than a hundred meters, causing the sea water in this diameter to boil like an explosion.
Within the range of the sonic wave shock, the Crystal Horn Fish were unable to resist; their blood boiled throughout their bodies, and after only a few breaths, the remaining five ten-meter-long Crystal Angelfish were all shaken to death.
Their blood exploded while their mutilated corpses sank and floated in the boiling sea water.
Under the violent shockwave, the three Crystal Angelfish, over fifteen meters in length, could not withstand the force and began to retreat furiously, barely escaping the attack range before they finally left without looking back.
Boom!
Long dormant beneath the Mutated Giant Turtle, the hundred-meter-high small volcano collapsed under the shockwave, burying the surroundings in rolling mud and sand.
It wasnt until this moment that the Mutated Giant Turtle slowly stopped the shockwave; its 30-meter-long body stood on the volcanic ruins, like a dragon-beast roaring in Domination.
In the darkness, the Sword Armor Beast glanced at the several Crystal Horn Fish corpses around the Mutated Giant Turtle, its figure slowly retreating, then finally turned and disappeared.
And in a surprising coincidence, the direction it left was the same as one of the fleeing Crystal Horn Fish.
Deep in the over-two-hundred-meter dark sea floor, a fifteen-meter-long, weakened Crystal Horn Fish swam rapidly, trying to get away from the now-terrifying Mutated Giant Turtle.
But it didnt know that several hundred meters behind it, a ferocious, black Unique Beast was rapidly approaching, and in just a moment, had reached just a hundred meters behind it.
However, this Crystal Angelfishs perception was very sharp, and as the Sword Armor Beast came within tens of meters of it, it suddenly stopped.
Boom!
The explosive roar of the sea water suddenly burst, and in the darkness, an even darker figure cut through the sea water, its appearance in an instant to the left of the Crystal Angelfish.
Facing the sudden attack, the Crystal Angelfish abruptly turned its head, its huge mouth wide open in anger, as a powerful stream of water shot out like a water cannon.
Thump!
The powerful water jet hit the Sword Armor Beast, but it ignored the impact, its double claws carrying terrifying strength, smashing into the side of the Crystal Angelfishs head.
Boom!
Sea water exploded, and under the terrifying double claws, the Crystal Angelfishs scales shattered while its flesh burst, and the sturdy skull collapsed, forming two large pits with a diameter of over a meter..

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 118: Dragon Turtle Tyranny, Eight
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 118: Dragon Turtle Tyranny, Eight
Desolate Refining Hell (Big Chapter)_4
Translator: 549690339
The colossal body was overturned by the furious power, tumbling and retreating dozens of feet in the sea before stopping.
However, the Crystal Horn Fish had strong and sturdy bones and a powerful life force. Even if there were two bloody holes on the side of its head, it didnt die.
Just as the Crystal Horn Fish stabilized its body, the raging seawater exploded again, and the ferocious Sword Armor Beast burst out at a terrifying speed and pounced over.
The Sword Armor Beasts muscles swelled all over its body, and the endless terrifying power converged on its double claws, which looked like a pair of demon claws that covered the sky and fell down fiercely.
However, that Crystal Horn Fish had grown to this stage through countless battles. As the Sword Armor Beast pounced, the deep blue crystal horn on its head shone brightly.
Bang!
The Sword Armor Beasts full-force strike directly blasted half of the Crystal Horn Beasts head, but its rear half was hit by a dying counterattack of the blue light beam, and the rear half was covered by blue solid ice in the blink of an eye.
The terrifying cold formed more than a meter-thick blue ice, penetrating the outer armor and affecting the muscles and flesh underneath. The muscles became stiff, and the blood coagulated.
However, at this time, the Sword Armor Beasts vigorous Qi Blood burst from within its body, and its tail curled around, shattering the solid ice on its body with a bang.bender
Huh! It seems not very strong.
After ambushing and killing the Mutated Crystal Angelfish in two moves, the Sword Armor Beast spat out a string of bubbles, showing a human-like smile on its hideous face, looking even more ferocious.
Grabbing the body of the Crystal Horn Fish with its double claws, the ferocious Sword Armor Beast took a fierce bite, tearing the fish scales and devouring a piece of flesh and blood weighing hundreds of kilograms.
Yummy yummy!!
Savoring the rich taste of bloody flesh in its mouth, the Sword Armor Beast took another bite, tearing off a large piece of flesh and blood. The gushing blood dyed the surrounding sea red, but no fish dared to approach.
All were deterred by the invisible fierce aura emanating from the Sword Armor Beast.
As a source of rich energy that attracted the Sword Armor Beast, the flesh and blood of the Crystal Horn Fish turned into a raging turmoil that exploded the moment it entered the stomach.
With abundant biological energy, the Sword Armor Beasts body grew larger as it ate, expanding at a terrifying speed.
The speed of energy conversion and absorption became even more terrifying.
In less than an hour, the 10-meter-long Sword Armor Beast devoured the even larger Crystal Horn Fish, even chewing up its bones and discarding only a few intestines it didnt fancy.
After devouring the energy-rich Crystal Horn Fish, the Sword Armor Beast grew by half a meter, nearing 11 meters, appearing even more imposing and ferocious.
Its Evolution value also increased by 40 points in one breath, reaping rich rewards.
In the darkness, the Sword Armor Beasts cold stare looked in the direction the other Crystal Horn Fish fled as its huge body disappeared into the darkness.
I hope those two Crystal Horn Fish havent gone far or been targeted by other large Mutated Creatures.
Otherwise, the Sword Armor Beast might break its heart.
In the evening, as the sun set in the horizon, the reddish-orange light painted the clouds a crimson hue.
Chen Chu was sitting cross-legged on the backyard corridor. His aura grew stronger as he slowly opened his eyes, revealing a hint of regret.
The remaining two Crystal Horn Fish disappeared into the deep sea after their territory was destroyed, their whereabouts unknown.
The ocean was too vast. Even the slightest change in direction could lead to a huge distance after swimming for dozens of miles.
Chen Chus eyes showed a faint coldness as he whispered, That Mutant Giant Turtle will be eaten by the Sword Armor Beast after its fourth evolution.
Although this time, because of the Giant Turtle, the gathered Crystal Horn Fish were scattered, giving the Sword Armor Beast a hearty meal.
But the losses were also considerable.
Two Crystal Horn Fish estimated to be sixth-level slipped away, six late-stage level 4 ones were eaten by the Giant Turtle, and the Luminous Coral, whose use was unknown, was lost as well.
The Sword Armor Beast had been eyeing these things for a long time.
Because of this, it had changed its lair to be near the Crystal Horn Fishs territory, waiting to kill them when it became stronger.
Who would have thought that someone would intervene halfway through?
In the next two days, Chen Chu lived a peaceful life, cultivating, eating, and helping with some chores at home, the time passing in the blink of an eye.
On the third day, early morning, Chen Chu had breakfast early and went to the school to report.
It was a rule in True Martial High School that after breaking through the Third Realm, one had the privilege of not wearing a school uniform. So today Chen Chu wore a white long-sleeved T-shirt and gray casual pants.
It was already January, and the weather was cold, but Chen Chu didnt have to worry about the weather.
Walking along the familiar road to school and seeing the cars coming and going, Chen Chu couldnt help but feel a hint of nostalgia. Things had changed.
Two months ago, he was just an immature high school student who had just achieved some success in cultivating True Martial Arts and was full of vigor.
More than two months later, he was already a battle-hardened Special Forces Soldier, with more than a hundred ordinary people and around twenty or thirty cultivators killed by his hands.
At this time, True Martial High School was also on winter break, and the school seemed much quieter.
Of course, the winter break was only for the humanities students, and most first-grade martial cultivation freshmen would still come to school to practice using the equipment and fields.
As for sophomore and senior martial cultivators, they were rarely seen in school, giving the impression that True Martial High School only had first-grade students.
Today, Chen Chu met a familiar person as soon as he entered the school gate.
Seeing Chen Chu walking towards her, Vera Lee smiled and greeted, Chen Chu, long time no see.
Chen Chu also smiled faintly, Long time no see, Vera Lee.. How have you been lately?

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination,
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination,
Eight Desolate Hell’s Refining (Big Chapter)_5
Translator: 549690339
“Not bad, but you guys are far ahead of me.” Vera Lee said, envy flashed in her eyes.
Once she was also a member of Crystal Leinster’s small club, with average talent. She even established her Foundation two days earlier than Jack Clark. But after two months, she had just broken through the Second Layer Heaven for some time, while Jack Clark and the others had returned with the Third Layer Heaven realm, widening the gap to a point of despair.
However, there was no use in thinking about this now. After all, she was ineligible to participate in the trials due to her weak cultivation at the time.
Moreover, even if she had broken through at the time, she might not have dared to try, just like those thirty-odd sophomores who broke through to Second Layer Heaven but didn’t participate in the trial.
After chatting with Vera Lee, the two parted ways at the entrance of the Teaching Building.
Jack Clark had to find Lori Parma for reporting first.
It was still the office on the Third Floor, and the other people hadn’t come yet.
Jack Clark knocked on the door and politely said, “Teacher Parma.”
There was no way he wouldn’t be polite.
Jack Clark had seen the fierce appearance of Lori Parma holding a weapon, and her combat power was very exaggerated.
Moreover, after returning this time, he faintly felt that Lori Parma’s aura had become more oppressive, as if there were signs of a breakthrough.
“Jack Clark, come in.”
Looking at the entering Jack Clark, Lori Parma suddenly asked, “What realm do you have now in your current cultivation?”
Jack Clark hesitated for a moment: “…I estimate that in a little over a week, I’ll be able to break through to the Late Third Layer Heaven.”
After Koroya absorbed that Energy Crystal Body, Jack Clark hadn’t exchanged any more, so his progress was slower in this period until he returned back to normal.
There was no need to hide it. If there was anything strange, it could be attributed to the compatibility of the cultivation skill or his physical talent.
Including the fact that he exchanged Life Crystals every time, he just had a special talent for his physical body.
Anyway, his strength and agility were no longer a secret. Moreover, he had indeed cultivated the Dragon Elephant Power to its limit, and it couldn’t be hidden once they fought.
Nevertheless, it still startled Teacher Parma: “When on the airplane, I felt that your aura was much more powerful than that of others. I didn’t expect to be almost at the late Third Layer Heaven now.”
“And I heard from Sylvia Lyons that you have cultivated the Dragon Elephant Power to the peak of True Martial Divine Rhyme.”
Then Lori Parma thought for a moment, “Late Third Layer Heaven, huh? There should still be enough time.”
Jack Clark was puzzled, “Teacher, enough time for what?”
“Of course, it’s the problem of your cultivation method.”
Lori Parma said slowly, “With your talent, even without a senior cultivation method, it’s estimated that you can break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven in at most three months. But I don’t recommend you to do that.”
“Is it because of the attribute of True Strength?”
During this time of study, Jack Clark was no longer as naive as he was before. He knew that after the Fourth Layer Heaven, True Strength would undergo a qualitative change, and it would gain special attributes because of the cultivation method.
Just like the Senior Blood Envoy he killed, his True Strength attribute was corrosion, which couldn’t be completely defended even by the +10 battle armor with enhanced solidity.
“That’s right.”
Lori Parma nodded, “If you break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven like this, even if your compatibility with Dragon Elephant Power is perfect, the power of the qualitative changing True Strength will at most be comparable to an ordinary Senior Skill.”
“But if you break through with the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, your True Strength after the qualitative change will be terrifying. You should know that the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body is among the strongest in Senior Skills.” “The Dragon Elephant Overlord Body is so strong!” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
“Of course, it’s a cultivation method that is very domineering even among Senior Skills. Furthermore, there are also top-tier cultivation methods corresponding to the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.”
“When the time comes, you don’t need to switch your method, and you can directly cultivate it. In one fell swoop, breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, saving a lot of time and resources, and steadily reaching the peak of the True Martial Nine Layers.”
“In that case, do 1 need to suppress my breakthrough time now…?” Jack Clark frowned slightly.
It would be the next semester of Senior One after the New Year, and he had half a year to participate in the Mutated Beast Trial to earn a large amount of Contribution Points when he became a sophomore. Wouldn’t all this time be wasted?
In fact, Jack Clark’s original plan was to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven normally, and after all, his Dragon Elephant Power after the Limit Break would be comparable to ordinary Senior Skill.
Moreover, he estimated that it would take about two months to break through, not three months as Lori Parma said.
By then, with the boost of the Fourth Evolution of the Sword Armor Beast and the enhancement of the Four Major Attributes during normal cultivation, his combat power would be among the strongest even within the Fourth Layer Heaven.
In this way, by the time he went to the Alien Beast Battlefield as a Second Grader, killing a few Level 4 Mutated Beasts at random would give him enough Contribution Points to exchange for a Senior Skill.
Lori Parma shook her head, “No need to suppress, didn’t 1 just say that there’s enough time?”
“As the concentration of Heavenly Energy in Eastern Summer becomes stronger, more and more low-level Mutated Beasts appear in ordinary mountain ranges, out of the primitive mountain ranges sealed by the military.” “Therefore, a large-scale cleanup operation is conducted every year to control the number and strength of these ordinary Mutated Creatures.”
“After deliberation, the officials decided to increase the number of large cleanups to twice a year, allowing all senior martial arts schools to share some of the pressure and granting freshman participation.”
“In this way, freshmen can accumulate practical experience earlier, earn extra Contribution Points, and grow faster.”
“In fact, this plan has been discussed for a long time. It is the real trial mission for freshmen in the senior martial arts schools and will continue in the future. Koroya was just an accident.”
“With your record of killing a Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy, this cleaning mission should be no challenge for you. Randomly killing dozens of ordinary Mutated Beasts would be enough to meet your exchange requirements.”
“…A cleaning mission.” Jack Clark was speechless for a moment.
He didn’t expect that this was the real freshman mission, and the previous trial in Koroya was completely accidental..

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination, Eight Desolate Hell’s Refining (Big Chapter)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination, Eight Desolate Hell’s Refining (Big Chapter)_6
Translator: 549690339
At this point, Lori Parma smiled and said, “Of course, if you think those ordinary Mutated Beasts are not challenging, you can apply to me in advance to enter the Alien Beast Battlefield.”
“Under normal conditions, as long as one breaks through the Third Layer Heaven, students from any grade can apply.”
“However, in previous years, there were hardly any freshmen who broke through the Third Layer Heaven in the first semester of their first year, so this requirement was not announced.”
“Advance application… never mind.” Jack Clark shook his head slightly.
If he hadn’t known about the cleaning mission, he might have been a little tempted.
But knowing there were plenty of opportunities to earn Contribution Points coming up, he temporarily dismissed the idea of going out, as the Fourth Evolution of the Fourth Layer Heaven Armor Sword Beast was more important.
Having said that, Lori Parma waved her hand, “Alright, this will be announced in a couple of days. There’s still time before then, so go to the thirty-three floors and pick a secret method.”
As one of the top hundred people in this trial, Jack Clark received a reward to choose a common skill for free.
Speaking of secret methods, Jack couldn’t help but ask, “Teacher, what is the difference between the secret methods and the True Martial Arts we practice?”
Lori Parma thought for a moment, “There is a big difference. True Martial Arts is a holistic progression, and as long as you practice, you will steadily improve. Secret methods, on the other hand, are a type of extreme strengthening.”
“At the same time, secret methods can be divided into four major categories: Strengthening Type, Amplification Type, Burst Type, and Special Type.”
“As the name suggests, Strengthening Type can enhance strength, speed, and I remember there is a secret method that can amplify twice the basic strength of the cultivator when it reaches grand accomplishment.”
“Twice.” Jack was surprised.
Twice doesn’t seem like much, but it’s important to note that this is basic amplification, not True Strength.
That is to say, if the maximum limit of the Fourth Layer Heaven is four thousand kilograms of arm strength, then practicing this secret method can push it to eight thousand kilograms, which is nearly the same as his current strength.
Jack couldn’t help but become interested and asked, “Teacher, is this secret method difficult to practice?”
If he practiced this secret method, wouldn’t his basic strength double, and his full-strength explosive power jump directly to the Fifth Layer Heaven?
Lori Parma looked at Jack and knew what he was thinking, “The difficulty of practicing this secret method is manageable. A talented person can achieve success in half a year.”
“However, while it is said to be twice as much, the actual increase has a limit. At grand accomplishment, it can increase up to three tons, or three thousand kilograms, of basic strength.”
“In other words, all ordinary secret methods have a certain upper limit, whether it is strength amplification, speed burst, or natural attribute enhancement…”
Through Lori Parma’s introduction, True Martial Arts was likened to a complete sedan, while secret methods were like amplification parts or other functional equipment for a specific part.
And these secret methods all have a certain limit, and after the cultivator enters the high-order realm, they will seem rather mediocre.
As a result, many people choose to practice one or two secret methods to improve their strength after breaking through the Third Layer Heaven and Fourth Layer Heaven, but they do not exchange and practice too many of them.
After all, one has limited energy and cannot neglect the essence to focus on secret methods, which would hinder the progress of the realm.
When they had talked enough, Lori Parma suggested, “Your next opponents are mainly Mutated Beasts, so you can consider practicing the Cast Soldier Skill for your first secret method.”
“Cast Soldier Skill.” Jack’s eyes twinkled.
Lori Parma laughed, “Didn’t you wonder before why our weapons are so powerful? When you go up and see the introduction of that secret method, you’ll understand.”
With a puzzled look, Jack took the elevator to the 33rd Floor Reading Room.
As it was still early today, and the winter vacation, the reading room was empty. Jack went straight to the ‘internet cafe cubicle’ area where he had learned the martial arts before.
He found a small cubicle at random, closed the door, turned on the computer, and entered his Student ID for verification.
“Verification passed, welcome to use the Heavenly Intelligence System.”
“Your current permission in South Sky Martial Height has been upgraded to 11+ level, you can exchange all low-level martial arts, ordinary secret methods, and resources below Fifth Layer Heaven.”
“In addition, you can also query some secret information below 11+ level permissions. Reminder, secret information cannot be leaked arbitrarily.”
11+ level, his permission was raised so high after this trial. Jack was a little surprised.
When he achieved Foundation Establishment within half a month, his initial access level was 1+ level, and he could freely choose two Low-Level Martial Arts methods.
Those who achieved Foundation Establishment within a week, like Justin Welan, were at II- level, while Crystal Leinster and others who achieved Foundation Establishment in three to four days were at II level.
There was only one 11+ level in the whole school, Jane Aiken, who achieved Foundation Establishment in two days and reached the Second Layer Heaven within half a month.
Latterly, after ranking 49th in the ranking battles, Jack’s permissions were promoted to 11- level, indicating that his talent is similar to those ordinary geniuses.
According to Justin Welan, there is a higher level of talent permissions above 11+ level. As long as they don’t die halfway, those monsters would at least be top-level powerhouses of the Ninth Heavens.
Jack clicked on the permissions behind the name, and immediately four options appeared below, representing Martial Arts, Secret Methods, Resources, and Information.
Clicking on the Secret Method option, the screen changed instantly.
Compared to Low-Level Martial Arts, there are only twenty-one secret methods. Jack clicked on each secret method introduction, and the contents were roughly similar to what Lori Parma had told him.
Enhancing basic strength by three tons in the Strengthening Type, increasing speed by 30% in the Burst Type, and allowing True Strength to become flaming hot or icy cold in Attribute Type, and so on.
However, compared to these, the Special Type secret methods are much more mysterious and have only two of them.
One of them, called Hidden Deity, can help conceal and blend one’s aura and traces with surroundings if practiced successfully, and even more so when reaching grand accomplishment..

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination, Eight Desolate Hell’s Refining (Big Chapter) ?
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 118: Dragon-Turtle Domination, Eight Desolate Hells Refining (Big Chapter) ?
Translator: 549690339
This secret method caught his eye.
Because the exaggerated speed of cultivation promotion had always been giving Jack Clark some headaches, although he didnt plan to play the pig to eat the tiger, he also did not want to always be exposed under the spotlight.
If he practiced this secret method, in the future when his cultivation has an explosive breakthrough, it would not be exposed immediately, but rather selectively revealed at a reasonable time.
And the other secret method is weapon casting.
Weapon casting, as the name suggests, is to cast ones own transcendent weapon. Official orthodox cultivators would generally try to practice this secret method after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven.
Thats because the F Grade alloy weapons they use are already the limit of weapons made from ordinary materials.
These weapons are fine against low-level mutated beasts, but they lack power when facing high-level mutated beasts with energy defense, and a terrifying physique.
Including the Sword Qi and Blade Qi after the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Because those high-level and top-tier mutated beasts have been tempered by Heavenly Energy for a long time, they have strong immunity to energy, and ultimately, it all comes back to the weapon.
Faced with this problem, some powerful people jointly researched a secret method called Cast Soldier Skill.
Based on alloy weapons, it integrates the cultivators True Strength, spirit, and even Essence Blood with transcendent materials through secret methods, thus casting powerful transcendent weapons.
These weapons are solid, sharp, and completely integrated with the user, making them extremely easy to use. A/loreover, they possess a part of True Martial characteristics.
The higher the level of a transcendent weapon, the stronger its power.
Some peak powerful peoples weapons are even comparable to legendary artifacts, possessing a variety of terrifying might, which is very frightening.
However, practicing secret methods consumes a lot of time and energy.
Especially the Weapon Casting Secret Skill, which not only requires a long time to temper and refine the weapon quality with True Strength but also requires various transcendent materials to upgrade its level.
After looking over all these, Jack Clarks eyes became rather strange.
Because transcendent weapons are very similar to the legendary treasures, and the weapon casting skill is similar to his attribute strengthening.
In other words, this secret method is of no use to him, but at the same time, to cover up the later strengthening of transcendent weapons issues, he still has to choose or exchange them in the future.
Thinking about this, Jack Clark felt a headache and temporarily didnt confirm whether to choose Weapon Casting or Hidden Deity for the free quota.
Then Jack Clark clicked on the resource options, flipped through them, and set his eyes on the special items.
Sumeru Wrist, low-level space equipment, made from special materials that contain weak space power, possesses an internally expandable shapeless void space of three cubic meters.
Exchange requirement: Fourth Layer Heaven realm, 11+ level authority, 500 contribution points. This item contains an identification mark, not tradeable.
500 contribution points. Jack Clarks eyes widened.
However, considering that this was related to space, it seemed that 500 contribution points, or 500,000 yuan, were not that expensive, and even quite cheap.
If the wealthy people were told that they could buy a storage space for only 500,000 yuan, they would certainly go crazy.
But 500 contribution points Its so hard to accumulate them.
Jack Clark shook his head, returned to the Cultivation Method option, and found the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body True Martial.
Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, one of the most powerful high-level cultivation methods, exchange requirement: 300 contribution points, authority requirement: 11+ and above.
This method requires the use of dragon-type mutated creatures essence blood to establish the foundation at the Fourth Layer Heaven Time. Upon grand accomplishment, the Dragon Elephant Battle Body is condensed, possessing a part of the Dragon Elephant Behemoths power, with an overbearing strength to dominate everything.
Power of the Giant Beasts, Dragon Elephant Battle Body! Jack Clark held his breath.
However, without contribution points now, he could only look at it enviously. bender
Then Jack Clark went back to the Senior Skill area again, but this time he searched for Advanced Combat Skills, focusing on heavy weapons.
As his physique became more and more terrifying, Jack Clark felt that the combat knife was too light and couldnt bring out his increasingly terrifying strength advantage.
In addition, the level of the Light King Blade Technique was also limited, and there was no corresponding combat skill to exert stronger True Strength after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven.
As for whether the attribute-enhanced straight blade would be wasted or not, he didnt need to worry about it, because with the Sword Armor Beast collecting Life Crystals, there wouldnt be too little attribute points in the future.
And at that time, he could also integrate the combat knife into a new weapon and inherit some of the enhanced characteristics.
However, South Sky Martial Heights advanced combat skills were limited to nine parts. The only one, Hegemon Thirty-Six Slash Knife Method, didnt seem satisfactory to Jack Clark after reading the introduction.
In the end, his eyes fell on a High-level Combat Skill called the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd.
The Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, characterized by its heavy and sharp aspects, sweeps across all directions, and needs a natural Divine Strength wielder to practice. When practiced to the extreme, it dominates all directions, with ghosts wailing and gods howling.
And to exchange for Advanced Combat Skills, he only needed 100 contribution points. Howeverhe doesnt have them now.
Jack Clark shook his head and clicked on the information section, seeing a lot of content that ordinary people and students didnt have access to.
For example, each Martial Height has the duty of suppression, assisting local authorities in protecting the security of cities. Each Martial Height teacher comes from the front-line battlefield, a Sixth Heaven cultivator, who generally rotates every five years.
In addition, the core of every citys First-class Martial Height or Second-tier Martial Height School has a special Light Wave Detection Tower that radiates to the surrounding city.
Especially in coastal areas, these Light Wave detectors can accurately detect the energy fluctuations emitted by level 3 or above Mutated Beasts, lock down their landing location, and quickly respond to protect local areas from being invaded by Mutated Creatures.
This piece of information made Jack Clark ponder; energy fluctuations, huh?
Compared to human cultivators, mutated beasts large bodies and their inability to restrain the energy fluctuations in their bodies did indeed make them easy to detect through such methods.
It seemed that later on, Sword Armor Beast had to be cautious about its strength too..

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 119: The Demonic Dragon that
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 119: The Demonic Dragon that
Devours Everything and has Evolving Bloodline (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
After staying on the thirty-third floor for almost an hour, Jack returned to the third floor.
As he stepped out of the elevator, he ran into Justin Welan leaving Lori Parmas office. Curious, Justin asked, Jack, I heard from Mr. Perry that you went to choose a secret method.
Which secret method did you choose?
Not far away, Crystal Leinster, Matt Watkins, and Freya Louise, who were sitting in the rest area chatting, also looked over curiously.
After returning from the trial this time, they also gained permission to exchange for secret methods, but unlike Jack, they needed 100 contribution points to exchange for one.
Jacks mouth twitched slightly: I havent decided whether to choose Weapon Casting or something else.
Justin suggested, I think Weapon Casting Secret Skill is good. Your sword skill is strong, and if you study it now, you can forge your own transcendent weapon after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven.
Ill think about it again Jacks tone was a bit melancholy.
Because if he chose Weapon Casting, he would be wasting 100 contribution points. But even if he didnt choose it this time, he would still need to exchange to strengthen his transcendent weapon in the future.
Otherwise, some things would be difficult to explain and would easily arouse suspicion from others. He wanted to avoid this situation if possible.
After all, his exaggerated speed of improvement was already attention-grabbing.
Jack, your tone doesnt sound very happy, Justin said, puzzled.
Of course, thinking about the loss of 100 contribution points, he could hardly be happy. However, despite grumbling inwardly, Jack said,
I guess so. Im actually more interested in another secret method.
Hey! Wanting them ail, huh? I understand.
As the two of them went to the rest area and Jack sat down, Crystal suddenly asked, Jack, Mr. Perry said earlier that you have cultivated Dragon Elephant Power to the realm of the True Martial Divine Rhyme?
Jack was slightly taken aback, not expecting Lori Parma to reveal this. Was he trying to create a catfish effect?
Then he modestly said, It was just luck. I didnt expect to be able to cultivate Dragon Elephant Power to such an extent.
Hearing Jack admit it, Crystal and Matt, who had been shocked earlier, paused for a moment, their feelings becoming complicated.
As the class leader and the martial arts committee member with the best talent, they never imagined that after just two months away, they would be overtaken by Jack by so much.
Reaching the middle phase of the Third Layer Heaven was one thing, but he had even cultivated Dragon Elephant Power to the True Martial Divine Rhyme realm.
This was a realm that even the creator of the cultivation method couldnt deduce, surpassing the perfect fit. No wonder his combat power was so exaggerated that he could defeat a Blood Envoy in the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Until now, both of them still believed that the Blood Envoys realm was at the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Compared to their complex feelings, Freya Louise showed a faint smile on her face.
Justin laughed, Forget about both of you, even I was surprised that night. I never thought Jack would cultivate Dragon Elephant Power to this level.
Now, even if Jack breaks through to the Four Layer Heaven in a month, I wont be surprised.
Cough! Dont listen to Mr. Willards nonsense. Breaking through to the Four Layer Heaven in a month is too exaggerated. How could it be possible? Jack coughed and then changed the subject.
By the way, Class Leader, you also know about the cleaning plan that will be announced in a few days, right?
Crystal nodded, Yes, Mr. Perry mentioned it earlier. Well assist the local authorities in dealing with the mutated creatures in the surrounding deep mountains and old forests.
However, these low-level Mutated Beasts are no longer a challenge for us, so I am considering going to the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Uh Its not because of the pressure I brought, is it?
After thinking about it, Jack advised, Class Leader, I dont think theres any need to rush. We just broke through to the Third Layer Heaven not long ago, and what we need now is to settle down.
After all, our senior year has just ended, and we have plenty of time. Besides, you guys havent fully absorbed and refined the resources you exchanged earlier.
During this time, you can consolidate your progress, and maybe you will break through to the mid-stage of the Third Layer Heaven.
By then, you can complete some cleaning missions, accumulate contribution points to exchange for a secret method to practice, and increase your combat power to the current realms limit.
At that time, applying to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield will be much safer and more efficient in killing Mutated Beasts, dont you think?
Jack had also read some information about the Mutated Beast Battlefield before.
Although they could pre-register after the Third Layer Heaven, the problem was that there were not only Level 3 Mutated Beasts there, but also more of Level 4 and 5, including Level 6.
Under these circumstances, if they went, they would just be at the bottom, with a much higher level of danger than the Koroya trial.
Even the sophomores there were mostly just standing by, and the real main force was those elite third-graders who were about to graduate.
Each of these third-graders had a cultivation level of Four or even Fifth Layer Heaven, and their combat power was extremely strong.
Of course, this was Jacks own plan.
Knowing that there would be cleaning missions to earn a lot of contribution points in the future, he decided not to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield for a short while.
His next goal was the advanced skill of Dragon Elephant Overlord Body while preparing for the fourth evolution of his avatar. bender
Especially for the Sword Armor Beasts fourth evolution, compared to the uncertainty of the ocean, the discovered mutated creatures on land were easier for him to obtain.
Therefore, he planned to lookup which low-level mutated creatures talents are most suitable for the Sword Armor Beast to absorb.
Freya Louise flicked the strands of hair next to her ear, nodded slightly, I think Jack is right, were just freshmen, theres no need to be impatient.
As for Justin, he smirked, I dont mind, my defense is very strong now, Im not afraid of being attacked by a Level 3 Mutated Beast..
Wanna gift the story? Try one.

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 119: Swallowing Everything, Bloodline Evolution of the Demonic Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets) !
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 119: Swallowing Everything, Bloodline Evolution of the Demonic Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets) !
Translator: 549690339
“But you won’t be able to kill it either.” Jack Clark’s sudden comment made Justin Welan’s smile freeze.
Ahem!
Ignoring him, Justin Welan said cheerfully, “Also, my brother sent me a few more Blue Crystals recently, and my cultivation speed has been rising rapidly.”
“Maybe 1’11 break through to the mid period before you and the Class Leader, so whether I take missions or not doesn’t really matter to me.”
As his strength improved, Justin Welan was able to use many of the resources his brother had prepared for him, making his cultivation speed and combat power even surpassing Crystal Leinster and the others.
Seeing Justin Welan’s boastful tone, not just Jack Clark, but also Crystal Leinster and Freya Louise didn’t want to talk to him anymore.
As for Jack Clark, he had to rely on himself for everything. Although Crystal Leinster and Freya Louise’s parents were high-level cultivators, their own cultivation consumed a lot of resources too.
Moreover, with two sisters sharing resources, they naturally couldn’t compare to Justin Welan.
Jack Clark had lunch in the cafeteria.
He couldn’t help it, the school food was cheap and also provided Mutated Beast Meat.
If he ate at home, not to mention the taste, the nutrition and quality alone would not be as good as the school’s food.
Not just Jack Clark, many students from ordinary families also held this idea, which was one of the reasons why they came to school during winter vacation.
After lunch, Jack Clark went back to the thirty-three floors.
He searched the bookshelf and found what he wanted, the latest edition of the Low-level Mutated Beast Encyclopedia, a total of seventeen volumes.
In these years, with each sweep, the number of low-level Mutated Beast species discovered by the officials had exceeded more than ten thousand.
Many low-level Mutated Beasts mutated from wild animals, while some were the offspring of mutated creatures that had mutated again, changing their species altogether.
This cross-species mutation or Evolution of life has puzzled countless biologists and life scientists while also providing many valuable data points.
Therefore, the officials would reorganize the low-level Mutated Beast data every three years.
Pulling out the first volume, which is twenty centimeters thick, Jack Clark sat down in his usual spot.
But today, Freya Louise wasn’t there. She went back after chatting with Jack and the others.
Sitting down, Jack Clark turned his head and looked out the window. The sky was cloudless, the sun was bright, and the sunlight seeping through the glass brought warmth.
On such lovely weather, it would seem like a waste not to have some slaughter.
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Jack’s mouth as he lowered his head to open the book. Part of his attention went to the Sword Armor Beast.
On the sea surface, the sea waves rose and fell. A black colossus, eleven meters long, floated on the water, raising its head slightly to look forward, where three ‘little’ Tiger Whales were frolicking.
The three ten-meter-long little Tiger Whales, covered in black and white scales, repeatedly jumped out of the water, each time splashing water all over.
As for why they were called little, it was because two twenty-seven- and twenty-eight- meter-long adult Tiger Whales were swimming nearby, their bodies covered with even thicker scale armor.
The twenty-eight-meter-long Tiger Whale had a horn on its forehead, and water swirled around it, exuding a formidable aura.
Even after mutating, these creatures were still at the higher end of the food chain.
As a water column dozens of meters high sprayed out, the massive Tiger Whale with a horn swayed its tail and swam towards the Sword Armor Beast.
A powerful sense of oppression followed.
No one who hadn’t faced it before could imagine how terrifying a nearly thirty-meter-long, two-story-high Tiger Whale could be. Its enormous mouth was like a black hole devouring everything.
Seeing the massive Tiger Whale approaching, the Sword Armor Beast’s dragon-like head emerged from the water, and its six red feather horns on both sides spread out, looking ferocious and fierce.
At the same time, an air of horrible fierceness emanating from the Sword Armor Beast carried a faint warning.
Although the aura from this Tiger Whale was intense, the Sword Armor Beast didn’t seem too intimidated.
With its defense and speed, it could retreat even if it couldn’t win.
If the Tiger Whale dared to provoke it, the Sword Armor Beast wouldn’t mind taking the opportunity to taste the Tiger Whale. With its Evolution speed, it could wipe them all out in at most a month.
The massive Tiger Whale circled at a distance around the black Mutated Beast, perhaps sensing that it wasn’t easy to mess with, and suddenly emitted a whining sound.
… I don’t understand your beast language. The Sword Armor Beast showed a vague expression while looking at the huge but childish-sounding male Tiger Whale in the distance.
Whine whine!!
The Tiger Whale performed a few leaps out of the water near the Sword Armor Beast, then fell with a loud bang back into the sea, twisting and swimming below.
As it swam far away before returning, its head emerged from the water and continued to call out to the Sword Armor Beast with a whining sound.
You want me to follow you? Roar! The Sword Armor Beast’s face was even more confused, and its mouth opened slightly to emit a thick, low roar like a tiger.
Whine Whine!!
Roar Roar!!
It wasn’t clear if the Sword Armor Beast had misunderstood or the Tiger Whale understood its roar, but after circling around the Sword Armor Beast again, it swam towards the few Tiger Whales.
Seeing this, the Sword Armor Beast hesitated for a moment before its ferocious body twisted slightly, following the Tiger Whale.
The male Tiger Whale in front turned its head, seeing that the Sword Armor Beast followed, it continued to make whining sounds, its tone filled with joy. Soon, it joined the whale group.
Whine whine!! The two adult Tiger Whales started communicating in whale language, which surprised the Sword Armor Beast.
In the past, the Tiger Whales were one of the ocean’s overlords, known for their ferocious combat power and high intelligence. They didn’t expect that their intelligence would increase even further after mutating..

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 119: Swallowing Everything, The Demon Dragon of Bloodline Evolution (Seeking Monthly Pass) 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 119: Swallowing Everything, The Demon Dragon of Bloodline Evolution (Seeking Monthly Pass) 3
Translator: 549690339
Soon after the two Tiger Whales finished communicating, the female Tiger Whale and three young ones all turned to look at the Sword Armor Beast, their eyes gleaming with intelligence.
Whale sounds!!
At that moment, the male Tiger Whale called out to the Sword Armor Beast with a couple of low sounds, after which its enormous body abruptly turned around, seemingly leading it somewhere.
Should 1 go and take a look? Slightly hesitant, the Sword Armor Beast decided to follow, curious about where the Tiger Whale planned to take it.
With the Tiger Whale leading the way, the two mutated beasts swam towards the deep sea, moving at high speeds. Every now and then, the Tiger Whale would glance back to ensure the Sword Armor Beast was keeping up.
About an hour later and perhaps 100 to 200 kilometers away, the Tiger Whale suddenly dove deeper.
We’re almost there?
Catching up, the Sword Armor Beast followed the Tiger Whale to depths up to three hundred meters, four hundred… seven hundred meters deep.
By the time they reached eight hundred meters, they were enveloped in pitch darkness. The water pressure emanating from all sides increased tremendously, and the Sword Armor Beast could sense an increasing heat in the water.
The water temperature was rising, and the concentration of Heavenly Energy within the sea water surged.
Feeling the Tiger Whale’s silhouette ahead, the Sword Armor Beast, filled with anticipation, quickly caught up. Soon, they reached a depth of a thousand meters, where a faint red glow became visible.
We’re almost there?
The Sword Armor Beast perked up, its tail swishing forcefully as it sped up to catch the Tiger Whale.
Soon, a trench several kilometers long and six meters at its widest, and over two hundred meters deep in most parts, came into view.
Beneath the fissure, scorching magma churned, emitting a dim reddish glow.
The heat from the erupting magma made the surrounding sea water boil and bubble, releasing harmful gases that made the seafloor hazy.
Within the depths of the cracks around the magma, over a dozen varied sized red sea eels, the shortest being eight meters and the longest twenty-one meters, were coiled.
These mutated creatures swam around the seabed cracks, ingesting the scorching substances brought forth by the erupting magma.
Especially the three mutated sea eels surpassing fifteen meters in length. Their bright red bodies even faintly pulsed with firelight, emanating a dangerous aura.
The robust bodies covered in red scale armor, with heavily built hideous heads, resembled formidable red Flood Dragons.
A male Mutated Tiger Whale swam above the crack, letting out a low call. The sharp horn on his head slightly inclined, seeming to point at the deepest part of the trench.
There, golden magma roiled, with several red stones sinking and floating, giving off a red halo.
Upon seeing those several red stones, the Sword Armor Beast’s eyes instinctively reddened, and its fierce aura, which had been withheld, erupted.
At this moment, the Sword Armor Beast felt an instinctual urge compelling it to devour those ‘stones,’ to kill all creatures that would stand in its way.
A male Tiger Whale let out an anxious call, with urgency seeping into its usually calm tone.
Roar! The Sword Armor Beast quelled the instinctual urge within it, letting out a low growl to signal to the Tiger Whale that it was alright.
Roar, roar!!
Whale sounds!!
Underneath the dimly lit open sea, the Sword Armor Beast let out a low roar. The deep, resounding sound infused with faint telepathic wavelengths echoed throughout the sea water.
Through this journey, the Sword Armor Beast had learned to pick up some ‘beast language,’ which basically involved telepathy.
These formidable mutated creatures could blend their mental wavelengths into their voices, allowing them to psycho-communicate their intentions.
However, this method of communication required high levels of intelligence and strength from the mutated creatures, as they had to incorporate telepathic wavelengths into their voices.
Apart from that, the content of this method of communication could not be too complex. For example, should the Sword Armor Beast tell the Tiger Whale to slap something with its hand, the whale would certainly be unable to comprehend.
That’s because the concept of a ‘hand’ does not exist in their vocabulary. Such a term was human-made.
Currently, they could only communicate simply, like expressing understanding or agreement, or deciding to take down the red guys together and share the spoils evenly.
In a low growl, the Sword Armor Beast and the Tiger Whale agreed. The former would draw away the powerful mutated red eels, and the latter would be responsible for killing them.
Furthermore, two of the red eel’s corpses must be given to the Sword Armor Beast.
At first, the Sword Armor Beast demanded all of them.
But the Tiger Whale knew that the flesh of the mutated red eels was precious and refused to kill without any gain. It wanted to bring back some for the younger Tiger Whales.
In the end, due to the Sword Armor Beast’s reasoned argument, ‘Only I can go down there,’ the Tiger Whale reluctantly agreed to kill the biggest two for the Sword Armor Beast, and the rest of the red eel corpses would be its.
Roar! The Sword Armor Beast growled, its black beastly figure suddenly shooting out from the darkness and quickly stormed into the seafloor crack from a distance.
The enormous figure of the Tiger Whale withdrew slowly, concealing itself in the dark water behind it, quietly waiting.
The water in the trench was hazy and scorchingly hot. The lower it went, the higher the temperature, so when the Sword Armor Beast plunged fifty meters deep, the temperature already exceeded the boiling point of one hundred degrees Celsius.
However, such temperature had no effect on the Sword Armor Beast’s current physically robust state.
As the seafloor trench was several kilometers long and the Sword Armor Beast had hidden among the murky water bubbles blending into the surroundings, the mutated red eels were none the wiser.
Gurgle gurgle!! At the bottom of the crevice, amidst the scorching hazy seawater, the Sword Armor Beast quietly approached a red eel eleven meters long and thicker than a barrel.
The mutated red eel was opening its mouth wide, facing the churning magma several meters below and swallowing the heated organic matter that surged upwards.
Just then, the Sword Armor Beast flexed its muscles subtly. With a momentary burst of energy, it launched itself explosively from the rocky sea bed.
Being eleven meters long and having undergone numerous rounds of evolution, the Sword Armor Beast was denser than alloy and weighed nearly a thousand tons. Even a casual swipe from it could produce forces of several hundred tons..

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 119: Swallowing Everything, Bloodline Evolution of the Demonic Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 119: Swallowing Everything, Bloodline Evolution of the Demonic Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_4
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, under the influence of the Hundredfold Talent, a claw instantly burst with terrifying power, and this nearly ioo,ooo-ton force was concentrated within a range of 2 to 3 meters.
Instantly, the pressure under its claws reached a terrifying level.
Boom! The sea water exploded, and the head of the mutated red eel instantly turned into a bloody mist.
Immediately afterwards, the power of this claw didn’t decrease and blew a huge deep pit in the Crevice Mountain Wall below, with countless rocks and dirt splattering everywhere, and the mountain wall trembling with terror.
The huge movement instantly caught the attention of the other mutated red eels, and they turned their heads to look.
Then they saw a black Unique Beast of a ‘normal’ size biting the body of one of its companions, making a swoosh sound as it broke through the sea water and rushed to higher-ups.
Immediately, the mutated sea eels began to riot collectively.
Especially those three eels that were 15 meters, 18 meters, and 21 meters long, they seemed like red dragons roaring out.
Gurgle, gurgle!!
The huge red eel at the front opened its mouth slightly, emitting a gurgling vibration, with red flames tumbling in its mouth, emitting a scorching heat.
Biting the red eel’s corpse, the Sword Armor Beast blinked and rushed out of the seabed crack with rolling smoke and dust, followed by a large group of mutated red eels.
The closest one was the 21-meter-long mutated red eel, which was only more than 40 meters away from the Sword Armor Beast.
Of course, this was under the condition that the Sword Armor Beast deliberately slowed down. Otherwise, with just one Burst, it would be able to shake off these guys.
Staring at the black creature daring to hunt its offspring, the leader of the mutated red eels showed a fierce glint in its eyes, and when it was about 20 meters away, it opened its mouth wide.
Whoosh!
A red fiery pillar as thick as a meter spewed out from its mouth, boiling the sea water wherever it passed. Steaming white mist evaporated, but it was immediately solidified by the surrounding sea water.
From a distance, it looked like a fiery pillar wrapped in mist, piercing everything, and it came to the back of the Sword Armor Beast in the blink of an eye.
Under the scorching high temperature, the Sword Armor Beast, which was biting the food, twisted its body like a black shadow, dodging the flame attack of the mutated red eel.
In contrast to the Crystal Horn Fish’s blue light beam that almost ignored the medium, the power of this mutated red eel’s attack was stronger, but its speed was much slower.
At this time, both sides had rushed out of the seabed crack a mile away, and the surrounding light became darker.
Just as the three largest sea eels approached the Sword Armor Beast one after another and opened their mouths to prepare for a collective breath attack, the tail of the black Unique Beast slammed hard in front of them.
Boom! The sea water was instantly torn apart by the terrifying force, and in an instant, the Sword Armor Beast burst out with a terrifying speed, turning into a black shadow and disappearing into the darkness ahead.
At this moment, a huge figure rushed out from the darkness on the other side. It was the Single-horned Tiger Whale that had been ambushing for a long time, with its huge mouth wide open.
Bang! A terrifying devouring force exploded, and an invisible sucking force enveloped an area of more than 90 meters.
As they gazed at the suddenly appearing Tiger Whale, the largest mutated red eel showed a look of surprise and anger. Even if its intelligence was low, it knew that they had been deceived and fell into a trap.
But it was too late for them to react by this time.
Under the terrifying devouring force of the Tiger Whale, the sea water within a radius of 100 meters began to rotate rapidly, forming a vortex. Under the terrifying force, eels with a length of 8 to 10 meters were drawn into it.
Bang, bang, bang!!
Those ordinary mutated sea eels just came close to the big mouth of the Tiger Whale and were torn apart by the formidable force at the center of the vortex. Countless blood mixed with flesh and blood was swallowed by the Tiger Whale in one mouthful.
In the blink of an eye, half of this group of mutated sea eels were killed by the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
At this point, only four eels with a length of more than 10 meters, and three mutated sea eels of more than 15 meters were struggling. The strongest mutated sea eel even managed to reach the edge of the vortex.
This is the weakness of wide-range abilities. The larger the range, the more dispersed the destructive power.
Just as the strongest mutated sea eel escaped, and the other two mutated sea eels came to the edge of the vortex, the experienced Tiger Whale suddenly closed its big mouth.
Bang! Under the terrifying counter-shock force, the originally rapidly rotating sea vortex exploded with a thunderous sound, and the water flow was violently shaken. The eels are directly shocked and dizzied.
In the chaotic water flow, the Tiger Whale charged all over the place, shattering the water flow one by one and swooping at the bewildered sea eels, with its mouth wide open.
Boom!
The terrifying biting force caused the sea water to explode, and the two 11-meter-long sea eels were instantly bitten and severed. Their corpses and debris spread out with the sea water.
At this moment, three fiery red columns pierced through the chaotic sea water, emitting a scorching heat and fiercely falling on the back of the Tiger Whale, its head and side of its body.
Under the terrifying high temperature, even the Tiger Whale couldn’t resist, and its hard black scales gradually began to crack and even showed signs of melting.
However, compared to the 28-meter-long and bulky Tiger Whale, the burns within one or two meters only caused it some pain.
In a swift motion, its tail swung in the sea, and the huge body moved horizontally, slamming hard toward the mutated sea eel spouting flames dozens of meters away.
The powerful force blew the sea water apart, and the three mutated sea eels were directly hit by the Mutated Tiger Whale and sent flying.
There was no other way; the size difference between the two sides was too big.
It was not only the body length but also the thickness. The 28-meter-long Tiger Whale’s tonnage was almost several dozens of times that of the longest sea eel.
Angered, the three red sea eels that were sent flying let out gurgling noises. Ignoring the suppression of their level and body size, they charged at the Tiger Whale like three red dragons.
As the three largest mutated red eels fought the Tiger Whale, a black shadow shot out from the darkness.
They saw the Sword Armor Beast blink and cross a distance of several hundred meters in a flash, fiercely pouncing in front of a 12-meter-long sea eel that had been rolled to the edge of the battlefield by the raging waves..

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 119: Swallowing Everything, The Demon Dragon of Bloodline Evolution (Seeking Monthly Pass)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 119: Swallowing Everything, The Demon Dragon of Bloodline Evolution (Seeking Monthly Pass)_5
Translator: 549690339
As a Mutated Beast, this mutated red eel was extremely ferocious. Its mouth opened wide to reveal its sharp fanged teeth, and it lunged at the neck of the Sword Armor Beast.
The speed of its attack was like a python probing its head.
However, it was fast, but the Sword Armor Beast was faster. Its sharp black right claw tore through the seawater, and with a single strike, it burst the eel’s head, scattering countless blood and debris.
In an instant, a headless mutated sea eel corpse was sinking and floating in the water.
Mutated Beasts of the same size stood no chance against the Sword Armor Beast, which killed them instantly one after another, before its Sword Armor Beast form burst out once again.
This time, its target was another 12-meter-long mutated red eel.
