Seeing the ferocious Unique Beast approaching, the red eel, which had witnessed its own kind being killed within seconds, was frightened and tried to flee, attempting to burrow back into the seabed fracture.
It was the creature’s survival instinct, thinking that the deep-sea crack with rolling magma would be the safest place, completely forgetting that the black Unique Beast could also go down there.
But as the red eel swam only a few tens of meters away, the black Unique Beast charged at an even faster speed, its immense claw striking directly at the large mouth that was turning back to attack.
Boom!
Under the terrifying power of the black claw, the upper and lower jawbones of the mutated sea eel shattered, followed by half of its head being smashed.
Immediately, countless pieces of flesh and blood splattered everywhere, turning the surrounding seawater even murkier and red.
In the dim water, the black Unique Beast stood next to the red eel corpse, its ferocious head looking back into the distance, emanating a brutal aura.
Far away, only two of the largest mutated red eels were left fighting the Tiger Whale.
However, it would be more accurate to say that the fight was a one-sided suppression. The Tiger Whale simply didn’t care about their attacks, constantly tearing and biting with its massive body.
As soon as its enormous mouth bit down on them, these mutated red eels simply couldn’t withstand the terrifying bite force.
In reality, if it hadn’t been for the fear of the unknown abilities of these mutated red eels, the Sword Armor Beast alone could have slaughtered the entire group.
Seeing the massive and agile Tiger Whale suppressing the two mutated red eels, the Sword Armor Beast didn’t make a move, and instead dived into the seabed fracture.
Passing through the billowing smoke, the Sword Armor Beast quickly arrived above the golden magma.
The water temperature here had already reached over 200 degrees Celsius, and even though the seawater appeared stationary, it was, in fact, constantly boiling. Even the Sword Armor Beast felt a slight discomfort while breathing.
After all, its body was still made of flesh and blood, albeit tempered by Transcendent energy to become unrivaled and unparalleled in density.
Looking at the four red stones sinking and floating in the magma, the Sword Armor Beast suppressed its natural instincts, and at the same time, back in school, Jack Clark slightly raised his head.
In the large Reading Room, there were only a few classmates besides Jack Clark who were reading.
Jack took out his mobile phone, logged into the school official website, and after entering his Student ID and logging into the system, he typed into the search bar keywords like ‘red stones’, ‘special attraction to Mutated Beasts’, and clicked search.
Suddenly, more than a dozen links popped up, and one caught Jack’s eye. As he gently tapped the screen, a detailed description appeared.
“Blood Crystal, a special environmental-induced bloodline resource, can change the bloodline attributes of creatures to a certain extent, the effect is determined by the environment in which the Blood Crystal is nurtured.”
“This item is ineffective on humans but is often used by cultivators to train Mutated Beast battle pets. Exchange rate: 30 contribution points per ordinary Blood Crystal. Current stock in South Sky Martial Height: none…”
“As expected, it’s a bloodline-related item.” Jack’s eyes were flickering as he read the description on the computer.
Meanwhile, in the depths of the seabed fracture, the Sword Armor Beast gazed at the red stones rolling in the golden magma, its eyes filled with excitement.
It thought that perhaps it wouldn’t have to wait for the Fourth Evolution, and could gain the talent of energy abilities in advance.
At this moment, the Tiger Whale, with the longest red sea eel corpse clenched in its mouth, swam over, making excited whining noises.
It was urging the Sword Armor Beast to quickly grab the good stuff since the enemies had been taken care of.
The Sword Armor Beast roared, signaling the Tiger Whale to stay back and asking where the other mutated red eel corpse was.
The Tiger Whale whined, insisting that the Sword Armor Beast should hand over the goods first, and then it would fetch the remaining corpse.
The Sword Armor Beast roared, refusing to comply.
Under the Sword Armor Beast’s strong demand, the male Tiger Whale had no choice but to turn around and fetch the remaining 18-meter-long mutated eel corpse from several hundred meters away.
While the Mutated Tiger Whale swam away, the Sword Armor Beast(), squatting on the edge of the crack, peered into the dark surroundings, feeling a faint sense of danger..

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 119: Swallowing Everything, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 119: Swallowing Everything, The
Demon Dragon of Bloodline Evolution (Seeking Monthly Pass) _6
Translator: 549690339
It was clear that it wasn’t just this mutated tiger whale; other mutated organisms were also eyeing these blood crystals, lurking around during their battle with the red eels.
Shortly, the mutated tiger whale brought over the corpses of two eels, gently placing them in front of the Sword Armor Beast, blinking its lively eyes expectantly.
Although this creature understood the art of ambush, it seems a bit naive, not considering the scenario where the Sword Armor Beast might retreat into the cracks with the two sea eel corpses, giving it nothing.
Whimper whimper whimper!!
Under the urging of the tiger whale, the Sword Armor Beast spread open its claws, revealing four blood crystals, then took out the two largest ones and placed them in front of itself.
Among the four blood crystals, the largest was as big as a fist, while the smallest was only as small as an egg.
Roar roar roar!! One “fish” for the two of us.
Whimper!! The tiger whale looked at the two considerably smaller blood crystals in front of it, then looked back at the two in front of the Sword Armor Beast, a confused look flashed in its eyes.
Everyone got the same number, but why did it feel like it was short-changed?
Roar! There is something amiss in the surroundings, take quickly and go.
In a low growl, the Sword Armor Beast put the two largest blood crystals in its mouth, grabbed the bodies of the two mutated sea eels with its claws, and rushed to the bottom of the sea fissure.
The tiger whale didn’t dare to delay either, it slightly opened its mouth, and a suction power was transmitted. It swallowed the two smaller blood crystals into its mouth in a blink of an eye.
The deeper the water, the larger and higher level the lurking mutated organisms will be.
This is why the Sword Armor Beast usually stays above a water depth of three hundred meters, instead of hiding at the riverbed like before.
If the mutated tiger whale hadn’t led the way this time, it would not have dared to come down to the thousand meter deep waters where who knows what terrifying mutated beast could be encountered in the dark environment.
After all, its feather horn perception isn’t omnipotent; if it encountered a top-tier mutated beast with a body length of hundreds of meters, it won’t even be able to run.
Boom boom boom!!
The sea water above the crack suddenly exploded, with an unknown creature’s low growl and a powerful aura of a mutant beast, the waters below became increasingly murky.
The Sword Armor Beast didn’t pay attention to these, with the two mutated red eel corpses in its claws, it delightfully arrived at the depths of the fissure.
This place is narrow, very suitable for it to burst out in power.
If the large creatures from the surface came looking for trouble, it won’t mind showing them what extreme physical strength looks like.
Arriving at the seabed fissure filled with rolled-up poisonous gas, the Sword Armor Beast opened its mouth and spat out the slightly smaller blood crystal, pulling open the python skin bag on its neck and stuffing it inside.
According to the information Jack Clark had read, one only needs to eat one blood crystal, eating more is useless, but the effect is better the larger it is.
This is also the reason why it is so generous.
Besides, that tiger whale isn’t lacking in intelligence or power, there’s no need to turn hostile.
And it seems to have a keen sense of these ‘heaven and earth treasures’, the Sword Armor Beast wanted to see if there would be any more opportunities for cooperation in the future.
As for the remaining one, Jack Clark hadn’t decided whether to sell it to the school or what to do with it.
Expectantly, the Sword Armor Beast crunched on the blood-colored stone in its mouth. With its current biting force and the solidity level of its teeth, it could even eat metal as if they were beans.
Waiting until it felt that it had chewed enough, the Sword Armor Beast swallowed it down in one gulp mixed with seawater.
Boom!
The shattered blood crystal just entered its stomach, a blazing energy instantly exploded and swept over the entire body of the Sword Armor Beast, causing its whole body to start boiling.
Underneath the raging energy, the muscles, bones, bone marrow, and even genes of the Sword Armor Beast underwent a special transformation. This feeling was similar to the previous three evolutions.
Only, it wasn’t as intense…
I’m so hungry.
The Sword Armor Beast lifted its head, its light golden vertical pupils had somehow been covered in blood, grabbing the mutated sea eel corpse in front of it and started devouring it.
It brutally tore off a mouthful of flesh and blood with each bite.
It would usually take at least two hours for the Sword Armor Beast to fully digest two eighteen-meter-long and twenty-one meter long mutated red eels, due to their dense bodies.
But at this moment, every cell in its body was sending out signals of hunger. The food that just entered its stomach was immediately digested and before it knew it, it had finished devouring one of the eels.
It’s not enough.
The Sword Armor Beast grabbed the other mutated red eel’s corpse and continued to feed. It wasn’t until it had devoured both the mutant beast corpses that its feeling of hunger subsided slightly.
By this time, it had undergone a significant transformation.The entire body was covered in a pitch-black exoskeleton, with gaps flashing red lights, radiating scorching heat. Meanwhile, the body became more robust, bursting with an explosive force.
Especially, its limbs were even more muscular and typically vigorous, with ghastly sharp toenails. Even its neck had significantly lengthened and thickened.
Additionally, with the three pairs of red feathered horns on its sides, which were more distinctly colored red, sharper, and with the hint of flames leaping around them, it looked very imposing and horrifying.
At this moment, the twelve meters long Sword Armor Beast resembled a demon dragon lurking in the abyss of the sea. As it breathed in and out, it spewed out scorching heat, causing the seawater to churn and emitted a dreadful pressure.
“Is this the change due to bloodline transformation?”
In the reading room, feeling the changes in the Sword Armor Beast’s body, Jack Clark’s eyes showed a trace of shock as he subconsciously summoned the attribute page.
Realm: Third Layer Heaven
Physique: 475+
Strength: 512+
Agility: 423+
Spirit: 414+
Talent: Soul Split+
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Skill, Dragon Elephant
Power [Extreme Realmization] Heart’s Eye Bright Knife+[Third Layer)
Rune: Elephant’s Fury [incomplete]
Attribute points: 8
Equipment: Standard Combat Knife[+io Solidity, +10 Sharpness]
Avatar: Hexagonal Sword and Armour Flame Beast
Level: Intermediate Unique Beast[King of its ranks among unique beasts of the same level, possessing three powerful talents and one ordinary talent)
Talents: Strength +[ioox Strength Burst]Defense +[ioox Pressure
Defense]Agility+[3ox Instantaneous Speed Burst, slightly weakened underwater]
Blazing Flame +[An ordinary physiological talent, can emit a temperature of 100 degrees Celsius from its body and exoskeleton, and has a very high resistance to fire and energy attacks.
This talent can be evolved by absorbing hot energies to purify its bloodline, or it can increase strength by consuming attribute points]
Evolution value 1320/3000
Jack glanced at his own attributes, and then his attention fell on the changes of his avatar below.
The name had changed to Hexagonal Sword and Armour Flame Beast, and it had gained another talent.
The ability to emit a temperature of 100 degrees Celsius from the body… didn’t seem to be that useful. Didn’t emitting high temperatures in the sea mean a continuous consumption of energy?
A bit comforting was that the talent could evolve. Even without using attribute points to strengthen it, it could evolve and become stronger by devouring materials with high thermal energy.
Additionally, it made the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s resistance to energy attacks stronger, which was more important.
For example, when encountering Crystal Horn Fish again, it could charge up and kill them while enduring their freezing glows, rather than being wary of them all the time.
Of course, this good effect had much to do with the Sword Armor Flame Beast itself. Ordinary unique beasts wouldn’t change so much after eating. Otherwise, the starting price wouldn’t be 30 contribution points per piece.
Then, Jack’s gaze fell on the evolution value below, and the corner of his mouth unconsciously lifted slightly.
At this time, it had been just over a month since the Sword Armor Beast’s third evolution, yet its evolution value had already accumulated over a thousand; the speed was getting faster and faster.
Of course, accumulating so quickly has a lot to do with devouring those high-level mutant creatures.
Compared to the ‘barren’ river, the sea was too rich, full of mutated organisms everywhere.
Especially those mutated beasts exceeding fifteen meters were full of rich energy in their flesh and blood. Eating one was equivalent to hunting dozens or even hundreds before.
During this period, when the Sword Armor Flame Beast was lucky, it could accumulate sixty to seventy evolution points in a day.
Even when it was unlucky, it could still accumulate tens of points. After all, although the sea was rich in resources, most of them were still common mutated fish of level one or two.
Although there were many unique beasts above level four, they were not everywhere. There was no way; the ocean was too big.
But now, with the improved strength of the Sword Armor Flame Beast and an expanded hunting range, the level of the unique beasts it hunts would be higher, and the next accumulation of evolution points would be even faster.
It was estimated that it would reach the requirement for the fourth evolution in a little over a month, even faster than the previous three evolutions.
Then, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had merged with the new talent, would surge in strength once more, moving a step closer to the dream of ruling the sea as a ten-thousand-meter giant beast..

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 120 Bull Devil Battle Body, Swallowing Energy
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 120 Bull Devil Battle Body, Swallowing Energy
Translator: 549690339
Deep in the seabed, the Sword Armor Flame Beast that had completed its ‘evolution1 slightly raised its head, its cold golden vertical pupils gazing at the cracks above it that had become quiet.
The deep sea more than a kilometer in depth was incredibly dark, with only the faint light from the rolling magma, and the gurgling sound of bubbles mixed with gas breaking the silence.
Ordinary people wouldn’t last long in such a quiet and lifeless environment without going insane, not to mention the lurking dangers everywhere.
Jack Clark wondered if the Single-horned Tiger Whale had managed to leave or was taken down by even more powerful mutated creatures lurking in the darkness.
Recalling the intense battle fluctuations emitted from above at the time, the Sword Armor Flame Beast chose not to leave. Instead, it swam to the golden magma several hundred meters away and began devouring the scorching substances in the water.
After its physique transformation, the Sword Armor Flame Beast gained the ability to devour ‘heat,’ and having just completed its bloodline evolution, it needed to replenish a large amount of blazing energy.
Moreover, Jack Clark wanted to see if consuming scorching substances by the Sword Armor Flame Beast could be converted into evolution value.
If scorching substances could replace biological energy and its growth rate was no slower than hunting mutated beasts, it could sleep in a magma ocean and grow infinitely.
Soon, the underwater cracks fell into silence…
At five o’clock in the afternoon, Jack Clark walked out of C Building, ready to go home.
The campus was relatively quiet at this time, and a cold winter breeze blew by. Jack Clark couldn’t help taking a deep breath, immediately feeling refreshed from head to toe.
He couldn’t help it; a good mood made everything seem great.
Jack had been in a good mood all afternoon because of the gains from the Sword Armor Flame Beast, and his face still had a gentle smile on it now.
However, at this moment, a towering figure appeared in front of him, standing there quietly watching him.
Seeing Howard Lee, who was clearly waiting for him, Jack Clark suddenly remembered their promised battle and said, “I almost forgot about our engagement.”
“What do you think, should we apply for a testing grounds now?”
Unlike the minor battles of First Layer Heaven, battles between Triplex cultivators were much more destructive. Therefore, they either went outside the city to find a suitable place for training or applied for a professional venue on school grounds.
Otherwise, they would have to pay for any damage caused by the fight.
As it happens, his strength attribute had recently broken through 500, and his basic arm strength reached a terrifying 10 tons.
With such a terrifying base strength under the augmentation of Dragon Elephant True Martial, Jack Clark could now unleash a shocking level of destruction with just a wave of his hand.
Therefore, he was not afraid to face this Innate Divine Strength genius who had a perfect match with his main strength cultivation method. In fact, he even wanted to see whose strength was greater.
However, in contrast to Jack Clark’s excitement, Howard Lee said solemnly, “I’m not here to spar with you today. Instead, I want to postpone our battle.” “Postpone, why?” Jack Clark paused slightly.
Howard Lee admitted openly, “Because I don’t have the confidence to beat you right now, so I’m planning to wait until everyone breaks through the Four Layer Heaven then have a full-strength battle.”
The incident where Jack Clark had killed a Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy after defeating Erica Knowles was well-known to everyone. Most students even believed that Blood Envoy was in the mid-period of Fourth Layer Heaven. However, after visiting the corpse of the Blood Envoy out of curiosity, Howard Lee felt something was off.
As a genius with Innate Divine Strength, he had a keen sense for physical strength and was certain that the Blood Envoy’s physical refinement had surpassed the limit of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Although Jack Clark later gave a reasonable explanation, Howard Lee, who knew him to some extent, was aware it wasn’t that simple.
It was evident that Jack Clark had become stronger during the time he kept a low profile after killing the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape, so powerful that Howard Lee felt he couldn’t compete.
So, he decided to postpone the battle as he wanted a spirited and evenly matched fight.
Jack Clark narrowed his eyes at this moment. Howard Lee had no confidence to win now, yet he was confident that he could do it after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven. Looks like he was preparing some big moves.
As for this issue, Jack Clark naturally didn’t mind.
Although Howard Lee’s combat power might have an explosive increase after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, why would Jack Clark remain stagnant?
“Fine, we’ll fight after reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven,” Jack Clark nodded.
Howard Lee said solemnly, “I won’t hide it from you. After absorbing that thread of King-level Essence Blood from the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, I am confident that I can condense the Bull Devil Battle Body in the Four Layer Heaven.”
“Battle Body,” Jack Clark’s expression turned serious.
Battle Body, similar to true martial arts phantom, was a symbol of high-level cultivators and could only be condensed after breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven to form the True Martial Battle Body.
Of course, the Bull Devil Battle Body mentioned by Howard Lee was certainly not the Eight Layer Heaven’s True Martial Battle Body; otherwise, that would be too exaggerated.
It should be similar to the Domineering Body of the Advanced Skill Dragon Elephant Technique. The only difference was that the Domineering Body could only be cultivated after reaching the Extreme Sixth level, while this guy-jack Clark slowly said, “I didn’t expect that thread of King-level Essence Blood to be such a significant boost for you.”
Seemingly afraid that Jack Clark would assume he had gained an unfair advantage, Howard Lee said solemnly, “That thread of King-level Essence Blood was just one of the factors, not all of it.”
“I have a naturally unique physique, and due to my perfect compatibility with Bull Devil Shaking Mountain, after consecutively absorbing complete essence blood of the Mutated Black Bull and Golden-Backed Furious Ape, my physique has undergone the first stage of transformation,” he explained.
“To condense the second-stage Bull Devil Battle Body, 1 still need to exchange for eight matching high-level resources, which are expected to consume more than 600 Contribution Points.”
“So, I’ve applied to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield tomorrow.”
In fact, even if Howard Lee hadn’t explained, Jack Clark wouldn’t have cared, as he had gained a lot from that hunt as well. Specifically, he had condensed the True Martial Remnant Symbol, and his cultivation technique’s power had greatly increased..

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 120 Bull Devil Battle Body, Swallowing Energy_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 120 Bull Devil Battle Body, Swallowing Energy_2
Translator: 549690339
As for others being able to use their resources ten times more effectively, Matt didnt think much of it as it was other peoples expertise.
However, this also indirectly showed that Howard Lee was worth befriending.
Jack showed an anticipatory look on his face and said, I didnt expect you to have such a move hidden. But it doesnt matter, when that time comes, my strength will be stronger than it is now.
Seeing Jack not thinking too much, Howard nodded and walked away, his footsteps heavy, like an ancient giant full of oppression.
Watching Howards back disappear, Jack muttered, I didnt expect this guys physique to undergo a second metamorphosis. Indeed, I shouldnt underestimate people in this world.
True Martial Cultivation is a process of changing ones physique, causing weak humans to gradually transcend and evolve in the direction envisioned by the creator of the cultivation method.
For instance, the Dragon Elephant Power could transform Jacks physique towards a Level 6 Mutated Beast Tyrant Elephant. At its ultimate grand accomplishment, Jack would be as powerful and have strong defenses like the Tyrant Elephant.
Of course, this strength is only within the scope of low-level martial arts.
Jacks combat power far exceeded his realm mainly because his basic attributes were too terrifying.
Advanced Skills targeted top-level colossal beasts. Once the second transformation of Howards physique was successful, his combat power would definitely be on par with Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivators.
Thinking about this, Jack couldnt help but turn his head and look back with faint curiosity in his eyes.
If the second-ranked Howard was so monstrous, what kind of strength did that young girl who had always been above Howard and suppressed the entire generation of South Sky Martial Heights freshman have?bender
Officially, Mutated Beasts were divided into low-levels from 1 to 3, and high-levels from 4 to 6.
From Level 7 onwards, Mutated Beasts grew to 50-60 meters or even 70-80 meters long and could be classified as Giant Beasts, with the strongest Level 9 beasts being known as Top-level Colossal Beasts.
Above Level 9, just like human strongmen, they were called King-level Beasts.
At night, after dinner, Glenn ran upstairs and shouted from outside, Bro, lets go fishing tonight.
Fishing?
Jack opened the door and looked at him, puzzled: When did you start liking fishing?
Not exactly liking fishing.
Glenn explained, A month ago, there was a fishing prize event. If you catch a fish over 1.5 meters long and over 50 kilograms in weight, you get a reward of 500.
In addition to the prize money, the official will also buy back the fish at a fair price, which means one big fish is worth around one or two thousand. As a result, people are sitting by the river all month.
A month ago, Sword Armor Beast just had a breakthrough, followed by the fishing event. Jacks eyes narrowed slightly.
It seemed that the officials had been paying attention to the abnormal changes in the river, and they were preparing to kill those mutated big fish in advance, to suppress their growth.
You want to make money by fishing?
Yes, I asked mom for money to buy a rod and a fishing line back then, and 1 went fishing by the riverside at night.
A few days ago, 1 caught one big fish weighing about 60 kilos, sold it, and earned a total of over 1,400 with the prize money. Glenn couldnt help but laugh at this, looking quite happy.
Jack looked up and down at Glenn and praised, Not bad, 1 didnt think youd have a talent for fishing.
What he praised was not Glenns ability to fish, but his behavior of going to school during the day and fishing at night to make money to help out at home. But theres only one fishing rod. What am I going to do?
Glenn had already prepared for this, he smirked, Didnt 1 make money a few days ago? So, I bought you one too. Bro, lets go.
Alright. Jack nodded.
Its not that he was interested in fishing, but he didnt want to let Glenn down, who wanted to show off his accomplishments for the past month, excitedly in front of his brother.After all, compared to fishing for money, he would later casually earn at least 100,000 credits for killing a Level Two Variant Beast.
In the evening, as the sky darkened and Jack Clark went to the small river with Glenn Clark and the fishing rod and bucket, they indeed saw many people fishing at night on both sides of the river.
Most of them were middle-aged people.
Brother, there are not many people there. Lets use this to bait first. 1 specifically hung small live fish on the fishing line. You watch this fishing rod, and Ill watch that one
Having fished for a month, Glenn Clark seemed quite professional.
However, it was not known whether it was because there were not many big fish in this river or because there were more people than fish. By midnight, they had only caught a few carp weighing about ten kilograms.
Glenn Clark was quite disappointed by this.
Time flew by, and over the next two days, Jack Clark repeatedly went to the school for free meals while also checking on the Sword Armor Flame Beast and observing the consumption of the hot material nearby.
Jack Clark, good morning.
Darren, I heard youve already broken through the Third Realm.
Well, 1 just got lucky and broke through.
Amazing. Were just at the Second Layer Heaven.
Stephen Lee, youre not bad; youve already broken through the Second Layer Heaven. Im still lingering at the peak of the First Layer Heaven, and I dont know when Ill be able to condense True Strength.
On the third day, Jack Clark walked into the school and met many familiar classmates along the way, as well as some ordinary classmates who barely knew each other from the next class.
However, this time, everyone seemed more enthusiastic than before.
Jack Clark responded politely to all the classmates who greeted him, not becoming haughty due to his superior strength.
Soon, Jack Clark reached the First Floor Service Hall outside Building C, blending into the crowd.
Jack Clark, over here. Freya Louise, standing on the distant steps, waved at him gently.
Crystal and Mandy Leinster stood beside her, with Justin Welan, White Veil, Zac Lyons, and Marcus Lee not far away, talking quietly about something.
Matt Watkins, a student from their class, was also nearby chatting with Kyle Hawk, who ranked third in their class.
Previously, those who had good relationships with Crystal Leinster, like Sawyer Levin, Laurant Quartley, and Vera Lee, were also present but seemed a little restrained.
Apart from them, Jack Clark also saw many familiar faces all students who had participated in the trials, forming small groups and chatting with each other.
It was obvious that they had left their classmates far behind.
Half of the students who returned from the trials had broken through the Third Layer Heaven, while those who had not were in the late period of the Second Layer Heaven or even at its peak, close to entering the Third Layer Heaven.
Besides, after experiencing blood and fire, they now emitted a calm temperament, with sharp and aggressive eyes.
In comparison to them, those classmates who stayed in the school or hadnt broken through the Second Layer Heaven at that time seemed naive, both in mentality and strength.
Although two months had passed, nearly all the geniuses who had achieved Foundation Establishment in one week had broken through the Second Layer Heaven.
Moreover, some students accumulated knowledge bit by bit and caught up.
However, including Jack Clark and the others, there were now only about 160 freshmen at South Sky Martial Height above the Second Layer Heaven, and the rest were still struggling at the First Layer Heaven.
And in this period, only a few dozen people achieved Foundation Establishment, totaling about 900.
This was the result of Vernon Leinsters passionate speech back then, which made some of the dissatisfied freshmen persist and successfully establish their foundations after three or four months..

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 121: Seabed Frozen, Ferocious Waves Soar to the Sky
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 121: Seabed Frozen, Ferocious Waves Soar to the Sky
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark walked over and greeted everyone first, then looked at Freya Louise and asked curiously, Why havent you come to school these days?
The girl blinked her eyes and whispered, My aunt took me for special training.
She said 1 was useless because 1 brought so many good things but still got hurt.
To this, Jack could only show concern and ask, Is it hard?
Not really. Its mainly about learning how to use some special equipment, and by the way, she helped me improve my weapon sniper rifle.
By the way, Jack, the cleaning mission and precautions for this time have been announced. They are on the big screen at the back. Take a look.
Okay.
Jack looked at the notice wall behind him where the big screen was filled with various rules and introductions.
This cleaning mission was to start on the fifth day of the year, targeting all deep mountain old forests across the country.
Mist River, which was responsible for a section between two intersecting mountain ranges, used three small towns near the mountain ranges as mission distribution points.
At the same time, to make it more convenient, students participating in the cleaning mission could apply to rent a vehicle to drive there and load the Mutated Beast corpses.
However, applying for a vehicle required a drivers license from the school, and only those who could drive safely and skillfully were allowed to do so.
After all, this was not the chaotic Koroya where people could drive recklessly with cars.
Besides, there were various restrictions such as not hurting ordinary people or damaging public and private properties while hunting the mutated beasts.
There were also limitations on the tasks that could be taken. Freshmen of First
Layer Heaven could only take Level 1 Mutated Beast tasks, Second Layer Heaven could take Level 2 and below, and so on.
If the target mutated beast was a group type, teams could be formed.
Rewards for task completion were based on the number and level of mutated beasts killed. Level 1 mutated beasts were worth 2 contribution points, Level 2 were worth 6 points, and Level 3 were worth 18 points.
This contribution reward points were one-tenth lower than what Jack and the others got from killing unique beasts in Koroya.
The reason given by the school was that each mission required accurate information, and the deducted tenth of the contribution was used to pay for pros investigation fees and expenses.
At the same time, students who killed mutated beasts could also choose to convert their rewards into money, with a price of 80% of the market value. It would earn them a lot more compared to contribution points.
Of course, under normal conditions, no student would exchange it for money, as contribution points were more valuable.
At this point, Justin Welan and others walked over, laughing, Jack, you dont need to look at it. These novice tasks have no difficulty for us.
Zac Lyons said casually, Justin is right. For us geniuses, these tasks are just a waste of time.
White Veil crossed his arms and nodded, Thats right, these low-level mutated beasts are just one-sword kills, no pressure at all.
Their relaxed expressions and disdainful tone completely ignored the mutated beasts, which was in stark contrast to the worried and serious expressions of the students around them who frequently glanced over, showing a mix of envy and speechlessness.
Of course, if they were at the Third Layer Heaven, would they need to worry?
Jack was speechless, dont pretend here, youre all just at the Third Layer
Heaven. Youre not advanced cultivators of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
And dont be careless. Remember that level doesnt represent combat power. Some low-level mutated beasts have special abilities, and their threat level may be even stronger than some Level 3 Unique Beasts.
As Jack spoke, Marcus Lee stepped back a bit, distancing himself from Justin and the others, as if to say, dont include him in this.bender
Cough,cough!
Justin coughed twice and hurriedly said, We know all that, were just joking around. After saying that, all three of them had a sly and proud expression on their faces.
Jack and Freya Louise exchanged glances, shook their heads, and ignored these idiots.
At this point, Crystal Leinster suddenly said, Jack, Matt Watkins, Justin Welan, and Marcus Lee, weve decided to team up and apply for the Alien Beast Battlefield on the third day of the new year.
The third day of the new year, are you not participating in the cleaning mission? Jack was surprised and looked at Zac Lyons, who had just been laughing and teasing that ordinary mutated beasts were too weak.
Dont look at me like that. Zac Lyons shrugged, Youre the one whos going to break through the late stages of Third Layer Heaven quietly, and youre such a tough and freakish combatant.
If we dont try harder, we might not even be able to see your back in a couple of years.
Justin also had a sad face, Yeah, I didnt really want to go, but 1 cant help it,
Jack, youre too monstrous. Its so much pressure to be your brother.
All of them were geniuses with a sense of arrogance.
Two months had passed since Jack had overtaken them, becoming a powerful and exaggerated fighter. In such a situation, no one would admit defeat and would want to strive harder and push forward even more.
However, they werent really impulsive, choosing to apply half a month later and using this time to consolidate their cultivation.
So its my fault for improving too fast? For a moment, Jack didnt know what to say.
Crystal Leinster looked at Jack and calmly said, Jack, dont think too much. Its not because of you that we decided to apply for the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Just yesterday, Jane Aiken, Howard Lee and several other students applied early for the Alien Beast Battlefield, even without planning to celebrate the New Year.
This is the attitude that our generation of cultivators should have, with a brave and aggressive mentality, treading on thin ice, never stopping and pushing forward to overcome all obstacles and reach the peak of True Martial.
Are these young people really that determined and mature?
Looking at their serious expressions, Jack couldnt help but give a bitter smile, I may not be able to go with you. There are some things I havent prepared yet.
He meant that he hadnt confirmed the mutated beast for his avatars fourth evolution yet. However, Justin and the others thought it was about the advanced skill.
They knew that Jack was planning to make a killing in the cleaning mission to earn enough contribution points to exchange for Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and even though they thought so, they were right.
So Crystal Leinster and the others just nodded regretfully, not trying to persuade him to join.
After the discussion on this topic, everyone dispersed.
Most of them went to take their driving tests, as the school was efficient in handling matters. They only needed to scan the traffic rules and then drive skillfully around the test site to pass.
In the afternoon, Jack came to the thirty-third-floor reading room, flipped through it, and took out the second volume of the Low-Level Mutated Beast Encyclopedia.As Jack sat down opposite her, the girl looked up slightly and noticed the hesitant expression on Jacks face. She smiled faintly and said, Are you a bit confused?
Jack nodded, A little, Im surprised you didnt go with them this time.
Freya Louise was not among those who left with Crystal Leinster and others on a team after the new year.
Just when Jack thought Freya would give a reason, the girl suddenly said, Because Im afraid that youll be lonely all by yourself, so 1 decided to stay and accompany you.
Jack was momentarily taken aback.
Whoosh!
The girl burst out laughing and said playfully, Im just kidding. Mainly, my aunt has a training plan for me, and some things are not ready yet.
But Ill also participate in the cleaning mission. Shall we team up then?
Teased, Jack said unhappily, We can team up, but Im worried that you wont be able to keep up with me.
Thats fine, you can be the main force, and 1 will assist. Just give me one-fifth of the contribution points we earn, the girl didnt seem to care much.
This is what you said.
Yes, what I said.
After a playful chat, the girl lowered her head and immersed herself in the tranquility of reading the scriptures. Jack smiled and turned the pages of the newly-bound book.
At the moment, he had already taken an interest in the abilities of two Level 2 Mutated Beasts.
But he felt that they were not strong enough.
At the same time, seemingly reading, Jack, focused most of his attention on the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
Below the eerily dark and silent deep-sea rift, golden magma churned. The twelve-meter-long Sword Armor Flame Beast, resembling a black demon dragon, slowly closed its mouth.
A faint disappointment flashed in its cold, pale gold vertical pupils.
Two days had passed, and the changes in the beast after consuming a large amount of fiery substances were not insignificant.
Its internal temperature had increased from 100 to 150 Celsius, and faint flames flickered between the feathered horns on both sides, making it look even more magnificent and majestic.
As for its expectation of converting the lavas heat energy into biological energy, it was indeed possible, but the conversion rate was too slow.
After two days, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had only grown one centimeter, and its evolution value had increased by 2 pointsa far cry from hunting mutated creatures.
However, this ability was not entirely useless; maybe once its talent grew stronger, it might be able to hibernate and grow stronger within the magma.
Contemplating, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swayed its body, tail flicking as it stirred up the rolling seawater and swam towards the rift above, traversing more than 200 meters in the blink of an eye.
Just as it emerged from the seabed rift, the Sword Armor Flame Beast suddenly stopped, its four claws landed on the ground, and its eyes coldly stared ahead.
From the darkness, a red mutated fish emergedaround 21 meters in length, elliptical in shape, and covered in blue velvet-like fringe.
The blue fringe on the mutated fish emitted an astonishing chill, freezing the surrounding seawater into a thin layer of white ice as they passed. It resembled snowflakes underwater.
As they were close to the seabed rift, the water temperature was around tens of degrees Celsius. Thus, the thin layer of ice would constantly appear and fade, creating a fascinating scene.
Instead of densely packed sharp teeth, the mutated fishs mouth sported four fanged teeth more than two meters long, seemingly capable of biting through anything.
Clearly, the mutated fish had been waiting for the Sword Armor Flame Beast to emerge, and it had been very patient.
Looking at the icy blue fringe on the mutated fish, the Sword Armor Flame Beasts eyes grew colder. If it were before, it might have been somewhat intimidated by this type of icy energy, but now
Whoosh! A surge of hot Qi blood erupted from the Sword Armor Flame Beast, shaking the seawater around it. Its entire body emitted a red glow, and its limbs muscles swelled up dramatically.
Boom! The hard rock beneath the Sword Armor Flame Beast shattered, creating cracks that spread out to a distance of more than ten meters.
Under the impact, the Sword Armor Flame Beast shot forward like a black beam of light. Due to its extremely fast speed, a white shockwave even appeared around it, emitting a piercing howl.
In an instant, the Sword Armor Flame Beast appeared in front of the mutated beast and extended its double claws, disregarding the floating blue fringe as it slammed down with a roar.
Boom!
Amidst the terrifying impact, the seawater exploded as the mutated fishs five-meter-thick ice layer instantly formed and shattered. The massive fishs body was hit by a tremendous force, sending it flying a hundred meters away and kicking up a cloud of sediment.
Despite the fishs ice layer shield, nearly half of its body was still torn apart under the impact, with ice-blue blood and flesh debris spreading everywhere.
However, as a mutated creature, its vitality was strong.
The blue, velvet-clad mutated fishs body was suddenly enveloped in a dazzling blue light, and in an instant, a terrifying chill burst forth into a blue halo.
Crack! Crack!
In the blink of an eye, a 20-meter radius was covered in a layer of solid blue ice, including the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had charged at it again, and the mutated fish itself.
This indiscriminate ice-surface ability was powerful, and prey had no chance of escaping. Every time, it would kill its prey by freezing them to death and feasting on them slowly.
But today within the blue ice, the Sword Armor Flame Beasts body shimmered with a red glow, and the scorching temperature emitted by its body blocked the incoming cold energy from reaching it.
At the same time, its entire body swelled with muscles, and a terrifying power burst forth.
Roar!
With the Sword Armor Flame Beasts roar, it struggled, and cracks immediately snaked through the surrounding ice. Subsequently, it shattered the ice with a loud bang, along with the velvet on the mutated fishs body.
In the midst of the shattered ice fragments, the black and red alien beast, standing upright like a human, exuded a terrifying aura, appearing extremely fierce..

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 122: The Return of the Giant Beast,
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 122: The Return of the Giant Beast,
The Extreme Swordsmanship
Translator: 549690339
Deep under the pitch-black sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, adorned with black and red patterns, flicked its tail and swam upward with astonishing speed, causing the icy sea water to retreat wildly in its wake.
Meanwhile, the Sword Armor Flame Beast clutched the mangled body of a mutated fish in its claws, but it didn’t devour it right there. Instead, it swam guardedly, keeping an eye on its surroundings.
When the Sword Armor Flame Beast had zoomed to a water depth of 300 meters in a blink of an eye, a dark figure suddenly attacked from the left.
Pft!
In the darkness, water currents sliced through. The Sword Armor Flame Beast, with its slender tail, instantly skewered the dark figure and carried its corpse towards the sea surface.
Boom! The wild waves exploded, and a gruesome black unique beast surfaced.
Based on the direction and speed outlined by the Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast estimated that it was now over eight hundred kilometers away from the coast.
However, its current direction was different from where it had previously encountered the Deep Sea Giant Beast.
In contemplation, the Sword Armor Flame Beast peered into the water behind it.
On its tail hung a strange mutated creature. The creature, about eight meters in length, resembled a snake but had no scales or head, only a mouth full of sharp teeth.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast glanced at the strange beast, then began devouring the blue fluffy mutated fish. It had been two days since it had last ‘eaten’.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast certainly didn’t expect to encounter a mutated fish right after setting out today.
From the energy contained within the flesh and blood of the fish, the Sword Armor Flame Beast estimated that the mutated fish was around Level 5, in its late period of progression.
This creature had a powerful ability to burst forth all the cold energy within its body using the blue fluff on its skin, matching the lethality of an ordinary Level 6 Mutant Beast.
Very quickly, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, starved for the last two days, swallowed half of the blue Fluffy Mutated Fish. Its enormous body visibly bulged.
Then, the Sword Armor Flame Beast slightly turned its massive body and reached out its right claw, gripping the body of the Mutated Fish swung towards it by its tail. A slight exertion of force from both its claws tore the fish into two.
Caught by surprise, the Sword Armor Flame Beast noticed a crystal emitting a radiant glow embedded within the fish’s flesh on its left.
A Level 3 Life Crystal.
A smirk appeared at the corner of the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s mouth as it carefully prised out the Life Crystal. It held the crystal gently between its claws and slowly placed it into the snakeskin bag hanging around its neck.
Given its current strength level, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had to handle the crystal with care. The slightest additional pressure, and the crystal risked being crushed to pieces.
Since Jack Clark’s return to Eastern Summer three to four days ago, the Sword Armor Flame Beast has hunted and eaten many mutated fish. However, only a few had Life Crystals inside them.
Up until now, it has collected only two Level 3 Life Crystals.
However, collecting two Level 3 Crystals over three to four days was still quite a windfall, equivalent to eighty contribution points.
This unexpected gain put the Sword Armor Flame Beast in a good mood. It took a joyful bite from the fish and in less than a few minutes, had eaten the entire mutated fish.
Just as it had barely had its fill, a dark figure burst through the sea surface in the distance and charged towards the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
Just as the dark figure was about to reach it, the Sword Armor Flame Beast suddenly retaliated. Its massive right claw swept across with a terrifying force, and with a roaring sound, exploded the advancing fish’s half head along with sea water.
Boom!
The sea water exploded, shooting up to a height of more than ten meters. Simultaneously, the body of a mutated shark flung into the air and then smashed back into the sea with a thud.
Scarlet blood oozed out from the shattered skull, turning the surrounding sea water red.
After easily killing another attacking mutated fish, the Sword Armor Flame Beast caught the food that presented itself. A solemn look flashed in its eyes.
Contrary to its expectations, even after placing the Blood Crystal into the snakeskin bag of the Mutant Sea Python, it still attracted these mutated creatures to a great extent.
It seems necessary to get rid of this thing ahead of time.
With this thought, the Sword Armor Flame Beast suddenly dived deep. Once it reached a depth of about twenty meters, it swam towards the coast at an astonishing speed.
Resources for bloodline evolution held a tremendous attraction for these mutant beasts, especially since the sea water seemed to diffuse the scent. This made the Sword Armor Flame Beast too afraid to keep it.
Though it has only encountered two Level 3 Mutant Beasts attacking so far, this tactic also saves it from having to actively search for food- mutated fish were delivered right to it.
But what if it attracts a Level 7, or even a Level 8 mutated creature?
At five o’clock in the afternoon, when the bell rang, Jack Clark and Freya Louise walked out of the school together. After parting ways halfway, Jack Clark took out his mobile phone and called Glenn Clark.
“Jim, tell mom that I won’t come home for dinner tonight. A classmate has invited me to his house, I’ll be staying there overnight,” he said.
“Oh, okay, bro.” Glenn didn’t give it much thought.
When he had just returned a couple of days ago, Jack Clark had shared some of the events that happened in Koroya with them, including those about close friends like Justin Welan and Zac Lyons.
As for safety, would there be any issues with Jack Clark, who has now advanced into the third layer of the realm ‘Triplex’?
After hanging up the call, Jack Clark waved down a cab: “Mister, to the express train station, please.”
“Sure, please take a seat.”
The express bore resemblance to the high-speed trains of the previous world. However, due to the manifestation of Unique Beasts, it only connected major bustling cities. The peripheral and remote places, those with more mutated creatures bearing unique manifestation traces, did not have this connectivity due to high maintenance costs incurred by occasional destruction of infrastructure.
Mist River City was about eighty kilometers away from the nearest coastal city—a city the Sword Armor Flame Beast had originally set out from to go to sea. It would take just over half an hour to reach via the express train.
At six in the evening, Jack Clark mixed with the crowd and stepped out of the train station.
From the steps, he curiously surveyed the city named Los Angeles.
Compared to neighboring Mist River, this coastal city was somewhat less bustling and the overall buildings were shorter, likely to guard against typhoons.”Thankyou, and 1’11 have one of these, and these too…” At the roadside stall outside the train station, Jack Clark pointed at a few appetizing snacks and asked the vendor to pack them up.
While packing Jack’s snacks, the stall owner said warmly, “Young man, judging by your accent, I take it this is your first time in Los Angeles, right?”
Jack’s smile was slight, “Yes, and since it’s winter break, I decided to travel a bit.”
At a height of 1.85 meters, with a straight posture and a handsome but mature face, Jack looked just like a college student right now.
No one could imagine that he was merely a freshman in high school.
“Here you go, that’d be 18 dollars.”
“Okay.” Jack handed over the money upon receiving the bag. He then walked to the side of the road and hailed a cab.
“Driver, please take me to the Seaside.”
The wide open Seaside was windy with roaring sea waves. Standing atop the dam, Jack savoured the overwhelming view of the endless sea with a deep sense of tranquility.
Although he has ravaged the sea in his Mutated Beast form for quite some time, this was his first time enjoying the boundless ocean from a high vantage point in human form.
At the same time in Jack’s perception, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was still more than 300 kilometers away. It was expected to return only by night, which was perfect.
After all, he wouldn’t dare let the Sword Armor Flame Beast appear in broad daylight, especially when he knew that high-ranking warriors of these cities had light wave sensors.
Night, midnight.
The seaside was pitch black. Amidst the sounds of the howling raging wind, Jack took a turn around a high point in the dark before appearing at a rocky beach full of rocks.
With a few flashes, Jack landed on top of a reef rock that was several meters tall, gazing at the front.
Under the dim night, a row of dorsal fins, as sharp as long swords, broke through the sea surface, followed by a thick black scale armor that shone with a metallic luster, and dark red glows emitting from its gaps.
Boom!
The seawater exploded as the black Mutated Beast, standing at a shoulder height of four meters and a body length of over twelve meters, emerged from the sea.
The body is covered with rolling seawater, sliding along the crevices of the full-body scale armor, then evaporated by the high temperature radiating from its body, turning into a plume of white steam spreading out.
Its dragon-like head, covered with black armor, adorned with three pairs of red feather horns on both sides, radiating hot temperature and dancing flames, rendering the beast majestic and fierce.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast, with its powerful heat and towering frame, left a deep one-meter footprint on the beach with each heavy step it took. The force of its walk was enough to inspire awe.
There was no other way, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body density was just too astonishing.
Although not obvious in the sea, once ashore, there was almost a sound with each step it took.
The black Mutated Beast walked up to Jack. Its massive dark head raised up to a height of more than five meters, holding level with him, who was standing on the reef rock.
In an instant, Jack felt an intense sense of oppression and blistering heat hitting him head-on.
This intimidation comes from the differences in their size. A creature twelve meters long, four to five meters high, might not sound too intimidating, but when you meet it face to face, the heaviness of its presence leaves you mute.
It seems as if the Sword Armor Flame Beast could swallow Jack whole with just minimal effort.
Of course, swallowing is impossible since they are both ‘himself.’
At this time, Jack was watching it, and it was watching him too. Seeing himself from two perspectives gave him a peculiar feeling.
Standing before this formidable black beast, Jack felt a touch of sentimentality. Who would’ve thought that a few months ago, this giant beast was just a palm-size six-legged salamander?
Looking at the imposing ‘himself’, Jack actually felt he looked pretty awesome.
However, after having a brief look, Jack extended both his hands.
Simultaneously, the Sword Armor Flame Beast also slightly tilted its massive head toward him, making it easier for ‘himself’ to grab things.
Jack opened the sea python skin bag hanging from the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s neck, and reached into the sea water to feel around, and then pulled out two life crystals and the blood crystal.
Roar!
With a roar as majestic as a tiger’s, the colossal black Mutated Beast stirred a gust of fierce wind as it turned around to leave. As it departed, its tail swept across the sand, wiping away the footprints it had made.
Boom! With a splash, the Sword Armor Flame Beast quickly vanished, taking care not to be discovered by the ‘strong men’ who would rush over later.
Although prior to the Sword Armor Flame Beast setting off to sea, Jack has already scanned the surrounding area to make sure no one was around, he couldn’t let his Avatar linger at the shore too long due to the high-ranking warriors’ use of light wave sensors.
A secret is only a secret if nobody knows about it.
After the Sword Armor Flame Beast had swum a few kilometers into the sea, Jack only then retrieved part of his consciousness as he lowered his gaze to look at the life crystal in his hand, and a voice echoed in his head.
“Convert attribute points.”
“You have converted two life energy crystals, respectively giving you 36 and 38 attribute points.”
Compared to the crystal that came from the body of the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, these two crystals from normal Level 3 Peak Mutated Beasts contained much less life energy.
Yet, the two crystals combined provided Jack with 74. points. Coupled with the existing eight points, Jack’s attribute points added up to 82 in an instant.
Such a large number of attribute points excited Jack, but rather than reinforcing directly, he called out the attribute page, and his gaze fell under the data of the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
“You lack the current attribute points of too points to enhance/avatar’s Blazing Talent.”
sign later but never prompted.
Even the worst Blazing Talent requires one hundred points. No wonder those powerful talents all had a”+”
I’m not sure what the enhancement requirements are for my avatar’s strength, defense, and agility talents, and what about my Soul Talent?
In thoughtful contemplation, a voice echoed in Jack’s mind, “50 points will be deducted from your attributes, and Limit Enhancement will be applied to Mind’s Eye Bright Knife.”
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 123: The Rune Blade, Piercing the Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 123: The Rune Blade, Piercing the Soul
Translator: 549690339
The power of the Light King Blade Technique is generally impressive, what people value most is the profound and mysterious Heart’s Eye.
As Jack Clark’s limit enhancement cultivation method reached its peak, his consciousness seemed to explode, scattering into countless thoughts around him, the intangible matter vanishing into the depths of the void.
At the same time, Jack’s True Strength flowed from his dantian, following some unfamiliar routes, each circulation becoming increasingly powerful, and his aura sharp and intimidating.
Whenever an invisible breeze came within a meter of Jack, a tearing sound could be heard, as the sharp aura surrounding him sliced through it.
Suddenly, Jack’s thoughts scattered across the depths of the surrounding space began to shrink rapidly.
Boom! A sound like the opening of Heaven itself exploded in the depths of his mind. A vast Sea of Consciousness gradually took shape in the void.
In this seemingly empty consciousness space, Jack’s immense mental power began to condense, eventually forming a rune that looked like a combination of both text and a knife, thanks to the special “strength” it brought back from the void.
As the rune condensed, a surge of information flooded into Jack’s mind.
“Blade of Void Cutting, formed by the combined mental and spirit power, possessing the ability to annihilate all illusory forces.”
A blade cutting through the physical body, a heart cutting into the soul?
In a soft murmur, Jack slowly opened his eyes. His gaze was incredibly sharp, and the air around him subtly ripping apart as his eyes moved across it.
Feeling the changes occurring within him, Jack’s eyes revealed a hint of astonishment.
After this limit enhancement of his sword skill, his realm naturally broke through to the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven, his True Strength doubling in intensity and becoming more refined.
In addition to the breakthrough in realm, the meridians throughout his body expanded and became more tenacious, able to withstand more powerful bursts of True Strength.
However, the biggest gain for Jack was his change in mental power, which became more acute under the influence of the rune.
Moreover, if anyone dared to attack him with a spiritual intention, activating the Blade of Void Cutting Rune would instantly annihilate their invading forces.
Of course, the annihilation had its limits.
If the opponent’s mental or soul intent was much stronger than Jack’s, the rune would certainly shatter.
Aside from that, Jack’s newly developed intuition granted him an almost sixth sense, making him even more perceptible to his surroundings.
For example, right now.
As if pondering something, Jack turned his head towards the distant left, where a few flashes of light suddenly appeared, followed by an extremely fast approach.
With the arrival, an oppressive, strong aura filled the air.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! In the blink of an eye, three figures, emitting either red or blue glows and exuding Sixth-level Heaven auras, landed nearby.
“We detected the presence of a Mutated Beast around here.”
“Strange, there’s no trace of the beast, didn’t it come ashore?”
“Hey, have you seen any powerful Mutated Beasts around here?” The several figures swept their electric-like gazes across the surroundings before finally landing on Jack.
As the flame flickered, Jack recognized one of the figures and unexpectedly said,”… Teacher Jerrold.”
Teacher Jerrold West, with his imposing figure, was also somewhat surprised. He looked at Jack standing on a remote reef rock and asked, “Student Clark, what are you doing here?”
As they spoke, the three figures crossed dozens of meters in just a couple of flashes, landing on the reef rocks below. Seeing this, Jack also leaped down from above.
Jerrold West enthusiastically introduced, “Let me introduce you. These two are also teachers at Los Angeles Martial Height.”
“This is the genius from South Sky Martial Height 1 mentioned, the one who took care of our freshmen during their time at the Koroya trial.”
The other two teachers’ gazes warmed considerably upon learning that Jack had been helpful to their freshmen in Koroya.
Jack politely greeted, “Nice to meet you, teachers.”
One of the middle-aged teachers laughed, “No wonder he’s a genius from South Sky Martial Height! With your Late-stage Third Layer Heaven cultivation at such a young age, it’s truly impressive.”
Jack’s breakthrough had just happened, and his aura was on full display, so the three teachers could clearly see his Late-stage Third Layer Heaven realm.
“Oh, that’s nothing compared to the expertise of you three teachers,” Jack said humbly.
This time, Jerrold West, puzzled, asked, “Oh, by the way, student Clark, why are you here so late?” The other two teachers were also curious.
After all, normal people wouldn’t be standing on a reef by the sea in the middle of the night.
Facing this question, Jack already had an answer prepared, “Recently, I’ve been stuck in the Middle Phase of the Third Layer Heaven and felt quite frustrated. Then, 1 suddenly thought about coming to the seaside.”
“Maybe the boundlessness of the sea can help me relax my frustrated mind.”
“Unexpectedly, I had an enlightenment while observing the unity of the sea and sky in the evening, so 1 started to cultivate here, just breaking through to Late-stage Third Layer Heaven a while ago.”
“Ah, so that’s what happened.”
The three teachers were amazed, not expecting Jack’s breakthrough to stem from a mere glimpse at the sea. Although it had much to do with him being stuck at the peak of the middle period, his talent was still astonishing.
With a feigned innocence, Jack asked curiously, “Speaking of which, Teacher Jerrold, why did you suddenly come here?”
“We received an alert from the school’s safety center, stating that the Light Wave Detector detected a high-energy Mutated Beast in this coastal area, so we rushed here to investigate.”
The Light Wave Detector was a special device that combined energy and invisible light waves to detect the energy fluctuations of all individuals in the vicinity of the city.
As opposed to cultivators who could conceal their auras, Mutated Beasts constantly emitted powerful fluctuations that were often ten to dozens of times that of cultivators at the same level, making them easy to identify.
As for why the Heavy Armored Beast’s Third Evolution hadn’t activated the Detector during their previous encounter at the Mist River, it was simply because the creature was too weak at the time and was masked by the river.
At this moment, Jack Clark thoughtfully said, “So, the surging waves in the front were due to a powerful Mutated Beast lurking underwater.”
“Oh? Student Clark, have you seen that Mutated Beast?”
Jack Clark nodded: “Yes, it didn’t come ashore, but it caused the waves far away and showed part of its body. It’s probably because I picked up this Blood Crystal on the beach.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark opened his palm, revealing a blood-red stone the size of a fist, still covered with some sand.
“… You actually picked up a Blood Crystal, what luck.” Looking at the blood-red stone, Jerrold West and the others were at a loss for words, apart from being envious.
They came to the beach for a walk, accidentally made a breakthrough to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven, and even picked up a high-grade resource that was worth dozens of Contribution Points during their walk on the beach.
Jack Clark humbly said, “I was quite surprised too.”
Previously, Jack Clark was considering how to explain the origin of the Blood Crystal, since some things can’t be hidden from those who are genuinely concerned.
He didn’t expect to meet Jerrold West and the others, now they were his witnesses.
As for whether they would be covetous, Jack Clark was not worried, a few dozen Contribution Points wouldn’t cause them to do such a thing.
“Student Clark, it’s late, and it might not be convenient for you to go back. Would you like to stay at Los Angeles Martial Height for the night?”
“Thank you, Mr. West.” Jack Clark didn’t hesitate.
That night, Jack Clark stayed at Los Angeles Martial Height. The next morning, there was even a school car that sent him to the train station, leaving him somewhat embarrassed by their hospitality.
When he returned to school, Jack Clark told Lori Parma about what happened last night.
“You just had a breakthrough to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven and also picked up a Blood Crystal.” Looking at the Blood Crystal on the desk, Lori Parma shook her head with a bitter smile.
That luck…
Then, Lori Parma pondered, “Your breakthrough speed is faster than I imagined, but that’s also good, the probability of approval will be higher.
“Teacher, what needs approval?” Jack Clark paused slightly.
Lori Parma shook her head: “It’s nothing, just go on with your own business.”
Although puzzled, Jack Clark still nodded, took the Blood Crystal, and went straight to the Logistics Department.
“Hello, I found a Blood Crystal, and 1 want to know how many Contribution Points it can be exchanged for.” With that, Jack Clark put the Blood Crystal on the counter, and the staff member inside quickly took it over.
This Blood Crystal was useful for Mutated Beasts, but not for humans. It didn’t have any effect on the attribute page when he held it in his hand.
There was no need to keep it under these circumstances. Jack Clark planned to sell it to the school in exchange for some Contribution Points to use later.
Hello, classmate. This Blood Crystal has excellent quality, and according to your authority, the recovery price is worth 40 Contribution Points.”
It’s actually worth 40 points?” Jack Clark was surprised.
The staff member nodded, “Yes, this Blood Crystal has excellent quality, containing a powerful and hot attribute, so its price is much higher than ordinary Blood Crystals.”
Suddenly, Jack Clark felt a bit regretful. If he had known that these Blood Crystals were so valuable, he would have given one less to the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
With this 40 points, plus the 30 points from killing the Blood Envoy, he had accumulated a total of 70 points, making up a quarter.
Despite the regret, Jack Clark went to a private room in the ‘Internet cafe’ on the thirty-third floor, closed the door, entered his Student ID.
“Identity Verification Passed…”
“Please relax, student. The Secret Method Yingshen will begin data transmission…”
As Jack Clark chose to redeem the Yingshen, a stream of data and images were transmitted into his mind through a special memory light beam…
The Sword Armor Flame Beast was detected even when it was only staying at the seaside for a minute by Light Wave Induction.
Although psychologically prepared, Jack Clark was still a little surprised.
To avoid accidents when the Sword Armor Flame Beast evolved for the fourth time, Jack Clark felt that he needed to study a method to hide his aura.
Just in time, he needed it too, while he would consider learning Weapon Casting Secret Skill after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven.
As for whether the method to hide the aura of his main body during cultivation would work for the Avatar, he didn’t have to worry. Even if it couldn’t be fully practiced, it would still have some effect like the Angry Elephants Trampling the Sky.
“I never expected that Spirit Power and Qi Blood could be used this way.” After a long while, Jack Clark, who had completed the Secret Skill Inheritance, closed the computer.
Jack Clark closed his eyes slightly, allowed the Secret Skill information to circulate in his mind, and then the thought echoed in his mind: “Consume 20 attribute points, strengthen the Secret Method Yingshen.”
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, the 32 remaining points on the attribute page turned into 12.
At the same time, an invisible force led a majestic amount of spirit from the Sea of Consciousness, fused with the Qi Blood, and gradually formed a rune-like imprint.
However, compared to Elephant’s Fury and the Blade of Void Cutting Rune, the ‘Hidden’ rune formed by merging Qi Blood and spirit was much simpler.
When this Blood Qi Hidden Rune was completed, it came to Jack Clark’s chest and integrated into his body, instantly spreading out as an invisible ripple to wrap around his entire body like a membrane.
Underneath this invisible Qi membrane, the invisible pressure that Jack Clark’s body emitted, even after being repressed, gradually disappeared.
A surprised look appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes: “So that’s how it is, these Secret Skills aren’t ‘Cultivation Methods,’ but runes simulating certain abilities.”
These Secret Skills were formed by combining powerful mental intent with Qi Blood, condensing into ‘runes,’ which could be activated to exhibit their effects without relying on the human body’s meridian circulation.
So, theoretically, the Sword Armor Flame Beast could also practice this method.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark was excited, but he didn’t bother to go out, simply sat in a chair, and concentrated his attention on the Sword Armor Flame Beast in the distant sea.
Gurgle, Gurgle!!
Lying on a coral reef at a depth of 200 meters beneath the sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast blew out a string of bubbles, and a serious human-like look appeared in its golden vertical pupils.
Then, a trace of delight slowly emerged as it was really feasible, although the progress was slow….

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 124: Electric Ray, World Rift
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 124: Electric Ray, World Rift
Translator: 549690339
At 4 p.m., in the reading room, Jack Clark was quietly flipping through the fifth volume of the Mutated Beast Encyclopedia.
In recent years, there have been too many mutated creatures appearing globally, with varying strengths. Some of them can even be domesticated and bred like pigs and sheep in the past.
Currently, one of the largest types of mutated beasts being raised is the mountain woolly pig, mutated from the previous mountain black pig.
After mutating, the size of these creatures is several times larger than before. They can basically grow to two tons when they reach adulthood, with a high meat output rate and can be fed with just forage and plants.
However, even a creature this size, with a not so bloodthirsty and violent temperament, can unleash terrifying power when slightly angered. It is not something ordinary people can raise.
As a result, large-scale breeding groups usually rent more than a dozen mountains and employ cultivators with Second or Third Layer abilities to manage the farm.
This is also one of the places where ordinary cultivators with average cultivation talents, who only reach the Second Layer upon high school graduation and lack the courage to fight, can go.
Of course, Jack Clark would not become a breeder.
He is looking at these common mutated beast materials to find devouring targets for his Avatar’s fourth evolution.
Although the Sword Armor Flame Beast has already acquired an “energy”-type talent in advance, its fire ability is mediocre in the sea, and its explosive damage is not very powerful.
Besides, who would complain about having too many abilities?
Jack Clark is very cautious about his Avatar’s fourth evolution absorbing ability, as this is related to the future fighting power of the Sword Armor Flame Beast among mutant beasts of the same level.
Any mutated beast that can evolve to Level 7 or above is very powerful, and at least has two or more talents.
As Jack Clark was quietly reading, a warm current appeared in his body, constantly blending into his body and strengthening his flesh.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast had made some progress in half a day of cultivation earlier, and had gone hunting. At this moment, the warm currents emerging in his body were the feedback from the growth of the mutated beast.
This connection, Jack believes, should be related to their shared “soul.”
As “souls” from the same source, no matter how far apart they are, Jack and his Avatar’s consciousness and perspective are always synchronized, and there is no delay.
It’s like there is a twist in time and space between the two.
And those “evolutionary” energies that appear out of thin air in his body are flowing through the “channel, fold” between their two souls.
This also explains why he can “synchronize” his strengthening and why neither his cultivation method nor the Avatar’s talent can be shared, because the channel only allows evolutionary energy to pass through.
Of course, these are just Jack’s guesses. Even the attribute page does not have detailed notes on his soul talent.
Suddenly, Jack’s gaze paused, landing on the pages of the book in his hands.
[Electric Ray, a common Level 1-2 Variant Beast, the largest known body length is seven meters, 0.5 meters thick, presumably mutated from the electric eels of the old era.
It has been found in some mountain streams and rivers in Long White Mountain. It can release powerful electric shocks instantaneously, posing a threat in the water no less than a common Level 3 Mutant Beast]
“Long White Mountain, huh.”
Jack pondered and noted down the location where this mutated beast appeared, remembering that Long White Mountain was one of the clearing mission points after the new year.
With the addition of the Electric Ray, Jack has temporarily confirmed four targets for now.
The other three targets are the Level 3 Mutant double-headed mutated ice python with ice abilities, the Level 3 Mutant Illusion White Fox with tail illusion abilities.
In addition, there is a Level 3 Mutant Earth Black Bear, which has the talent to twist the surrounding gravity several meters away, forming force fields.
They represent ice, illusion, electric shock, and gravity, respectively.
Of course, due to their levels, these mutant beasts’ abilities are not very strong. But this is not important for Jack.
What he values is the characteristics of these abilities.
As long as the Sword Armor Flame Beast can devour these abilities and transform them into talents, he can later enhance them to a terrifying extent through attribute strengthening.
Busy times always pass quickly. Although it is winter vacation at school, Jack spends each day very fulfilling.
Every day he is either cultivating or looking up information while simultaneously controlling the Sword Armor Flame Beast to hunt mutated creatures. Both his main body and Avatar are steadily growing.
In such a situation, a few days blink past quickly.
At 5 p.m., accompanied by melodious bell sound, Freya Louise, who was immersed in the scriptures’ artistic conception, raised her head and sighed, “Another day has passed.”
“Yes.” Jack nods.
The girl tucked a strand of hair behind her ear and said quietly, “Since we got back, 1 feel like my spirit and thoughts have become much lazier.”
“It’s normal. After all, this is not the chaotic Koroya, where we don’t need to be tense all day long.”
With that, the two got up together, returned the borrowed books to their original positions, and took the elevator out of the teaching building with a few scattered classmates who were also reading.
Walking in the campus, Jack noticed that, unknowingly, red lanterns and colorful lights were hung on the roadside tree branches and streetlights, full of festive atmosphere.
Freya Louise looked forward with anticipation and said, “There are seven days left before the New Year. 1 heard that there will be lantern exhibitions along the Mist River from the Lunar New Year’s Eve to the 15th day of the first month.”
“In addition, there will be a grand fireworks show on the evening of the 28th before the New Year. Many fireworks manufacturers from surrounding cities will participate, and it will be very beautiful.”
After saying this, the girl turned to look at Jack Clark, her bright eyes flickering slightly.Jack Clark understood her meaning, and couldn’t help but laugh lightly, “I don’t know if this year’s lantern festival will be good, want to go together?”
The girl’s eyes were filled with a smile, and she nodded gently, “Okay, we can call the Class Leader and the others then.”
Jack Clark paused slightly,”… Yeah, the more people the merrier.”
While talking, the two of them walked out of the school campus.
Following the familiar road towards home, they didn’t part ways until the daily separation point where Freya waved lightly before turning to walk down another street.
Standing at the red light intersection, Jack Clark watched the girl’s figure disappear in the distance, feeling a strange sense of youth and campus life, as if the Mutated Beasts and Avatars were just illusions.
Chatting with a beautiful female student every day, making plans to go to the lantern festival and watch fireworks together… Suddenly, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed.
Three hundred meters below the dark sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had originally been lying on the sea floor practicing the Hidden God Method, raised its head abruptly, shock in its cold, vertical pupils.
Only to see hundreds of meters ahead of it, limitless Heavenly Energy gushed out like a torrent, the pure Heavenly Energy causing the surrounding sea water to boil.
Under the impact of the dense energy, the sea water within a range of several hundred meters became incredibly pure and clear, as if it were the sweetest spring water in the world.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast took a breath from a hundred meters away, feeling its body brimming with strength and energy.
At this moment, the gap where Heavenly Energy was pouring out continued to expand, a blue light slowly appearing on the pitch-black sea floor, as a rift resembling a gate gradually opened.
The rift was more than three meters in length and half a meter wide, appearing as if it connected to another world – not an ocean, but an ice-covered plain.
Bang! Right at this moment, the sea within a ten-kilometer radius exploded with turbulence, and countless species of marine life swarmed towards this spot.
Among these sea creatures were large Mutated Sharks and Sea Pythons, as well as ordinary small fish and shrimp the size of palms, all rushing madly towards the rift.
However, not everyone could handle the depths of more than three hundred meters.
