Many small fish and shrimp were crushed by the water pressure halfway down, while only those mutated organisms with a size larger than a few meters could swim down.
Among them, leading the charge was an eight-meter-long, mutated bigmouth shark whose entire body was covered with black scales, its tail frantically swaying as it lunged towards the rift.
Within just a few breaths, it had charged down from above, only to…
Bang! The sea water burst open, with the Mutated Shark smashing head-first into the rift, its skull broken and bleeding, and the Sword Armor Flame Beast even hearing the sound of bones cracking through the water.
That rift seemed to be right across, but appeared to be separated from this world by some kind of barrier, with only invisible Heavenly Energy able to pass through.
This could be seen from the fact that seawater was churning around the rift, yet not a single drop could seep through.
Unfortunately, this was only noticed by the Sword Armor Flame Beast, while those mutated creatures without much intelligence went on a frenzy, madly charging at the rift.
Bang Bang Bang Bang!!
Suddenly, the sea floor was filled with the sound of collisions, with many fast but not strong enough mutated fish being killed directly by the shockwaves.
And those mutated fish who didn’t make it across refused to give up.
After regaining their senses, the ordinary mutated fish started to swarm, and within the blink of an eye, a fish ball with a diameter of over a hundred meters formed at the bottom of the sea.
During the madness, many weaker mutated fish were crushed to death, their bodies bursting and a thick stream of blood spreading, mixed with numerous corpses sinking down.
This madness lasted for more than ten minutes, and then the Sword Armor Flame Beast felt the ‘amount’ of Heavenly Energy pouring out in front of it constantly weakening.
Finally, just like how it had appeared suddenly, the rift suddenly disappeared.
This scene left the Sword Armor Flame Beast pondering, and it roughly understood now why the deeper the ocean, the denser the Heavenly Energy present.
Compared to the land, which could be controlled, the ocean occupies a much larger area, which naturally means the appearance of more rifts leading to the mythical world.
It might even be possible that there are stable passages connecting to the mythical world beneath the 10,000-meter deep sea.
Subconsciously, the Sword Armor Flame Beast thought of the Deep Sea Forbidden Zone, where gigantic creatures, as big as mountains and their terrifying strength, made humans feel at a loss.
With their size and strength, the normal ocean world simply could not support them unless…
At this moment, with the disappearance of the world rift in front of them, the mad mutated fish slowly started to calm down.
Then, some mutated sharks, squid, and other fierce creatures, whose bodies were eight meters or ten meters in length and stood higher in the food chain, looked at the densely packed food surrounding them, their eyes filled with ferocity.
Only they didn’t see that in the distance, a black and red mutated beast, resembling a deep-sea demon dragon, slowly rose up, releasing a sudden surge of ferocity in an instant.
Roar! With a violent roar, the sea water exploded, and in an instant, the Sword Armor Flame Beast burst into the sea, like a black light charging into the group of mutated fish.
Every time its double claws fell, they would blast the skull of a mutated beast larger than five meters, and every time its black and slender tail swayed, it would pierce right through a mutated fish.
In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen enormous mutated fish had been killed.
As for the suddenly appeared rift, it held no use to the Sword Armor Flame Beast, but the mutated fish attracted by the rift were like food served on a silver platter.
Faced with this gift from nature, it would naturally not hold back.
In just a few minutes, the water in this area turned a bloody red, with the corpses of dozens of mutated fish larger than five meters floating and sinking to the bottom of the sea.
Amidst the dead mutated fish, a grotesque black-red mutated beast grabbed a mutated fish with each claw, happily devouring it with big bites..

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 125: Life Screening, Deep Sea Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 125: Life Screening, Deep Sea Monster
Translator: 549690339
In the courtyard, Glenn Clark, who was tidying up the fishhooks, looked up and noticed the smile on Jack Clark’s face and couldn’t help but be curious, “Bro, what are you laughing at?”
Jack casually said, “Nothing, 1 just ate something on the way home, and I’m in a good mood.”
“By the way, how was your catch today?” Jack changed the topic.
Speaking of this, Glenn, who has been immersed in fishing recently, brightened up his eyes and excitedly said, “I caught another big fish today, 1.3 meters long and weighing 38 kilograms.”
“That’s incredible.” Jack was somewhat surprised.
“How much did you sell it for?”
Glenn grinned, “I didn’t sell it. I’m keeping it for now, and we’ll eat it on your birthday in two days. We’ll have a feast with the whole fish.”
“…Alright, let’s eat it in two days.” Jack paused for a moment.
Jack suddenly asked, “Glenn, do you want to eat Mutated Beast Meat?”
Although the fish Glenn caught had some traces of mutation, they were not true mutated beasts, and their meat could only be said to be a little better than that of ordinary fish.
“Yes.”
Glenn’s eyes immediately brightened, but then he hesitated, “But bro, that Mutated Beast Meat is so expensive, and I heard that ordinary people can’t eat it arbitrarily.”
“It’s alright. After the New Year, the school will organize a big sweep to clear the lurking mutated beasts in the surrounding mountains. I’ll bring back a mutated beast with mild blood and flesh content.”
With Jack’s current combat power, ordinary mutated beasts would fall effortlessly in front of him. The sweep after the New Year would be an opportunity for him to harvest Contribution Points.
The next two days flew by without any major incidents.
As the holiday season approached, the festive atmosphere became increasingly strong, and local official television stations began broadcasting highlights from their gala programs.
January 13th, Jack’s birthday.
Today, Doris Raven took a day off specially and went to the vegetable market early in the morning to buy a lot of vegetables. Together with the big fish Glenn had caught, the whole family was busy.
Jack didn’t “slack off” today either, helping with the cooking.
Jack’s family was small, with only one cousin on his father’s generation, and the elders were said to have died in the chaotic era that year.
Later, the Federation was established, and Jack’s father and cousin were brought up by the only surviving aunt, who had already passed away many years ago.
As for Doris, there was only one uncle in the older generation in the countryside. Her parents had passed away due to illnesses several years ago.
Yes, they passed away due to illnesses.
Since the beginning of the New Era, the incidence of diseases in countries around the world has increased significantly every year, sometimes even a severe cold can lead to the deterioration of the body’s organs and rapid death.
This was one of the reasons why the world’s population hadn’t grown much in the past fifty years.
The restaurant was filled with more than a dozen dishes on the table.
Glenn excitedly poured a glass of clear wine for Jack and Doris, stood up happily and said, “Bro, 1 wish you a happy birthday and hope you become the most powerful martial artist soon.”
Doris also held her glass, her eyes gentle, “Jack, Mom wishes your path to be smoother and smoother, your studies to be successful, and for you to be safe and sound.”
Facing the blessings of his only two closest relatives in this life, Jack also stood up, holding his wine glass with a smile, “Thank you, Glenn, Mom, I’m very happy today.”
“Don’t worry, 1 will study and cultivate hard to make our Clark Family prosper more and more.” With that, Jack drank the clear wine in the glass.
Glenn originally wanted to buy white wine, but Doris sternly refused, stating that underage people were not allowed to drink alcohol.
“Alright, let’s eat. We’ve all been busy since morning.”
“Yeah, let’s eat.”
“Hehe, I’ll take the big fish head. I’ve been craving it for a few days.”
Although there were only three of them, the atmosphere at lunch was lively. Jack and Glenn ate more than half of the dishes.
With his enhanced physique, Jack’s digestion ability became more and more terrifying, as did his daily consumption.
However, a cultivator’s consumption can be maintained by cultivating and transforming Heavenly Energy, so they can eat more or less without starving to death.
As for Glenn’s huge appetite, both Jack and Doris had become used to it.
After all, thirteen-year-old Glenn was in the growth stage, needing more nutrition. But such a huge appetite still made Jack doubt if he was about to awaken some kind of talent.
For example, like Howard Lee’s Innate Divine Strength.
After all, before turning fourteen, he was close to 1.8 meters tall, with a burly and fierce frame. In two or three years, wouldn’t he rush to two meters?
After lunch, Doris was asked by the neighbor next door to play mahjong, and Glenn happily went out with his fishing rod. He was going to fish for their “extra meal” dinner.As for Jack Clark, he had his own business to attend to. He came to the wooden corridor in the backyard, sat cross-legged, and began to cultivate.
Although he had attribute points that could save time and achieve a breakthrough in his cultivation methods, with his continuous improvement, Jack’s understanding of cultivation had become even deeper.
Cultivation is not only about pursuing power, but also about the realm and willpower.
This is a path that allows ordinary people to transcend and surpass deities, so it’s destined to be long and difficult, and one must not be blinded by the smooth progress in the early stages.
The sea waves surged on the surface, and a huge black-red Mutated Beast, with a body length of nearly 14 meters, floated on the water, lazily basking in the sun.
Today was its birthday, and it was in a good mood, so it came up for some fresh air.
However, life is full of ups and downs. Just when the Sword Armor Flame Beast decided to take a break today and not kill any other creatures, another ferocious Mutated Beast targeted it.
At a depth of more than 200 meters underwater, a 26-meter-long Mutated Beast with a crocodile-like head covered in heavy outer armor plating was swimming slowly.
Below it were a pair of huge sharp claws, while the rear half of its body had six tentacles similar to those of an octopus, covered in suction cups. Its swimming movements appeared very strange.
This was an extremely fierce deep sea monster, and the Sword Armor Flame Beast responded when it got within a range of 200 meters.
Bang!
Water waves churned on the surface, and the equally ferocious Sword Armor Flame Beast suddenly dived. Its pale gold vertical pupils looked coldly at the deep-sea monster swimming upwards from below.
Seeing that the black Mutated Beast didn’t flee, the terrifying tentacle monster continued to approach slowly. Its massive body radiated an astonishing oppressive aura, while its similarly cold eyes revealed its ferocity and greed.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s size was just too deceptive.
In this ocean, where size and energy aura are generally used to measure strength, most of the Mutated Beasts that target the Sword Armor Flame Beast are larger in size.
However, they never imagined that this smaller ‘food’ would have a body density dozens of times greater than theirs, possessing terrifying power far exceeding its size.
Moreover, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had been practicing the Hidden God Method during this time. Although it had not yet completely succeeded, its aura had been somewhat restrained, making it even more deceptive.
When the deep-sea monster approached within 100 meters of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, its tentacles spread out like a chrysanthemum, and the mouths on the tentacles emitted a… hum!
There was no roar or scream, only invisible rings of ultrasonic waves spreading underwater. The Sword Armor Flame Beast instantly felt a terrifying low-frequency vibration explode beside its ears.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Within a range of tens of meters around the Sword Armor Flame Beast, the bodies of marine creatures suddenly exploded.
Both the hard-shelled creatures and the ordinary Mutated Fish, which had developed scale armor due to slight mutations, couldn’t withstand the terrifying low-frequency vibrations and exploded.
Even the defensively powerful Sword Armor Flame Beast felt invisible vibrations penetrating its external armored scales, affecting its flesh and blood.
However, the power of the vibrations that passed through the layers of the exoskeleton and scales and reached its internal organs was reduced to a fraction, only making the Sword Armor Flame Beast feel a little uncomfortable.
Roar! The Sword Armor Flame Beast let out a violent roar, and in an instant, its Blood Qi boiled, and an aura of terrifying ferocity erupted from its body. Its tail suddenly swung.
Bang! The seawater exploded.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast, almost half the size of the deep-sea monster, tore through the water like a black arrow. In the blink of an eye, it reached the deep-sea monster’s face.
At that moment, the mouths on the tentacles suddenly let out baby-like cries. Ah…
Boom! The invisible low-frequency vibrations turned into tangible sound waves that converged, with its power soaring several times. The seawater in front of it instantly shattered and exploded due to the force of the vibrating sound waves.
Under the intense shockwave, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body couldn’t help but stall, followed by an explosion of water as it shot to the side.
At the very moment the Sword Armor Flame Beast disappeared, a pair of sharp claws passed by where it had just been.
These were the huge sharp claws of the deep-sea monster, with a black glow flowing on them. Where they passed, the seawater was invisibly split, leaving behind eight pitch-black cracks that refused to heal for a long time.
Witnessing this scene from a distance of 100 meters, the Sword Armor Flame Beast rarely showed a solemn color in its eyes.
This deep-sea monster was powerful, bizarre, and extremely cunning.
It first used invisible vibrations to attack and infuriate the Sword Armor Flame
Beast, attracting it to attack. As it approached in an instant, the attack turned into a highly concentrated, far more powerful shockwave.
Under such circumstances, most attackers would be seriously injured or even killed by the shock.
Even if it hadn’t killed its opponent, it still had its sharp and sinister double claws.
However, do you think you’re the only one with abilities?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s cold pupils contracted slightly, and the scorching energy within its body circulated. In an instant, its muscles swelled, especially its hind legs and tail…
Boom! The seawater behind the Sword Armor Flame Beast exploded, and in an instant, a vacuum shockwave burst out tens of meters.
Under the effect of its innate swiftness, the Sword Armor Flame Beast seemingly teleported, spanning a distance of 200 meters and turning into a black beam in the deep-sea, flashing past.
Despite the terrifying speed, even the monster, which had been dominating the battle until now, revealed surprise in its eyes, as its huge double claws instinctively crossed to protect its head.
Behind it, the tentacles spread out like a chrysanthemum emitted an even more terrifying scream.
Boom, boom, boom!! Terrifying sound wave vibrations caused the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s entire body and external scales to vibrate, and the surrounding seawater shattered due to the explosion, emitting thunderous roars.
Roar!
Ignoring the terrifying vibrations, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had already reached the monster’s face, let out a violent roar with both claws raised as the endless terrifying power within its body gathered.
Boom!
With a hundred-fold power and the technique of angry elephants trampling the sky, its strength burst forth like a tangible force, instantly obliterating the seawater in front of it and leaving behind a pitch-black vacuum.
Under such a terrifying force, the deep-sea monster’s protective claws were instantly broken, and its body leaned back to dodge its head.
Boom!
A large piece of the monster’s heavy armor scales crumbled, its chest caved in, and its huge body was blasted back tens of meters by the strike, causing the surrounding seawater to become chaotic. It suffered a heavy injury with just one hit..

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 126: Magnetic Energy Weapon, Single-Kill King-Level Giant Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 126: Magnetic Energy Weapon, Single-Kill King-Level Giant Beast
Translator: 549690339
The Agility Talent with 30 times instantaneous movement speed still had 20 times effect underwater.
Such terrifying kinetic energy combined with a hundred-fold power explosion, even with the deep sea monster possessing an advantage in level and size, was heavily injured by the Sword Armor Flame Beast with a single hit.
Just as the Sword Armor Flame Beast was preparing to pursue and finish off the deep sea monster,
The monster that was blown away in the distance let out a resentful growl, its four black eyes stared dead at the Sword Armor Flame Beast that wounded it. Then the six tentacles behind it retracted.
Bang! Like an octopus moving, the deep sea monster instantly accelerated and rushed out, however, the direction was towards the deeper sea.
Roar! You want to run?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast let out a low roar, and its body burst out.
Hum!
Intense sonic vibrations came from below, but the Sword Armor Flame Beast only slightly wavered its body and quickly took on an arc to chase.
Boom! The deep sea water exploded.
Once again storing up its agility to burst, the Sword Armor Flame Beast appeared instantly behind the deep sea monster, its sharp double claws tearing two of the tentacles with an afterimage.
Immediately, the sonic vibrations weakened.
Roar!
The monster with its tentacles torn let out a scream, suddenly turned its head and bit towards the Sword Armor Flame Beast. Its wide-open ferocious mouth was full of sharp fanged teeth, as if it were the abyss.
However, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was even more agile. In a twist, it swooped down on the monster’s head like a shadow, tearing the energy layer on its body and its scale armor.
Flesh and blood flew for a moment.
Boom boom! Under extreme pain, the deep-sea creature struggled madly in the cloudy water.
Before long, the seawater slowly calmed, and a severely damaged corpse floated in the dim sea, with the Sword Armor Flame Beast beside it, drenched in blood.
At this moment, the Sword Armor Flame Beast emanated a terrifying aura of brutality that frightened the surrounding fish, which had smelled blood and approached, to scatter instantly.
If this monster had not glanced at the Sword Armor Flame Beast with resentment while escaping, it might not have chased at all.
For such a creature with strange abilities, a strange development direction, and a high level of intelligence that holds grudges, the Sword Armor Flame Beast would have to hunt it down mercilessly to avoid future conflicts.
Otherwise, would it come back for revenge from the deep sea someday?
Although Sword Armor Flame Beast was confident that no mutated beasts could match its progress, it was better to kill such a strange enemy sooner.
It just so happened that it hadn’t hunted this morning.
Tear! The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s double claws ripped the monster’s scales and took a bite, immediately filling its mouth with flesh and blood, and a sense of satisfaction arose.
Sure enough, being full is a creature’s primary motivation.
The next day, Jack Clark took a taxi to the northern suburbs after receiving a phone call.
“This is the place.”
Jack got out of the car and looked at the vast area in front of him, with soldiers on duty, resembling a research institute and a military base.
At this moment, Freya Louise opened the door of the guard room in the distance and waved to him, “Jack, over here.”
The girl was wearing a loose white t-shirt with long sleeves and gray pants, full of youthful vitality.
As Jack walked over, he asked curiously, “Freya, why did you call me here?”
“I wanted to show you something amazing. You’ll find out what it is soon.” The girl winked playfully, looking mysterious.
At that moment, the soldier inside the guard room said politely, “I’m sorry,
Miss Louise, but we’ll need your friend to register.”
“I almost forgot about that. Jack, you need to input your ID for registration.” This place has high security. “Alright,” Jack agreed and entered the guard room. However, when Jack input his ID, a remark for a Second Lieutenant-level
Special Forces Soldier immediately popped up, and the two soldiers beside him saluted with solemn expressions.
With a snap, the soldiers saluted Jack.
Jack instinctively returned the salute.
After entering the base, Freya asked in surprise, “Jack, how did you get the
Second Lieutenant’s rank?”
“Probably because of the Koroya trial,” Jack said thoughtfully, recalling the official’s praise during a previous encounter at a base, but he hadn’t taken it to heart at the time.
During the Koroya expedition, Jack had gained over a hundred contribution points, raised his school’s authority level by three, and received the official reward for outstanding performance.
That reward was the Secret Skill worth a hundred contribution points.
Apart from that, Jack had heard whispers in the past few days that the school had additional rewards for outstanding students this time.
Freya nodded in approval, “You must have impressed the military with your
performance in Koroya and been awarded an honorary rank.”
“Although the rank doesn’t have much practical use for now, it will be much more convenient for you when you interact with the military in the future.”
With that, the girl changed direction, “Over there is the Research and
Development Area; let’s go to the Testing Area.”
With her hands behind her back and a spring in her step, the girl led the way to a wide-open area behind several unique buildings.
This place looked like a shooting range, but several times larger, with Jack estimating the farthest target to be about a thousand meters away.
“You brought me here to watch you shoot?” Jack’s eyes fell on the 2.5 meters long and 30+ millimeters wide ‘sniper rifle’ on the shooting table.
However, unlike the picture he had seen in the chat group before, this sniper rifle had been upgraded and modified, with additional designs and patterns on its body..

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 126: Magnetic Energy Weapon, Single-kill the King-level Giant Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 126: Magnetic Energy Weapon, Single-kill the King-level Giant Beast_2
Translator: 549690339
Freya Louise smiled and said, “Since we re going to form a team together, I should show you my ‘strength1 . Besides, I train every day.”
As she spoke, she picked up the huge sniper rifle, loaded the five thick, long bullets into the magazine, and snapped it into place.
“This is a Black Bone Armor-piercing Bullet, 28 millimeters in diameter. The bullet tip is made from a Mutated Beast’s bone spur, which is as hard as steel-core alloy but twice as heavy.”
“Most importantly, this bullet tip can penetrate 30% of the Extraordinary energy, specifically designed to kill Level 3 or above Mutated Beasts.”
“Aside from that, the propellant of these bullets is made of Crystal Powder Explosive, which has ten times the power of grain propellant, making the muzzle velocity of the bullet reach 1,300 meters per second.”
“Of course, the explosive power also comes with stronger internal pressure when the bullet is fired, which purs higher demands on the Gun Barrel. The recoil force can even send a person flying.”
The girls held the sniper rifle in both hands, showing a shooting posture.
At the same time, a transparent True Strength emanated from her body, flowing into the sniper rifle along her palm. Instantly, the patterns on the gun lit up one by one.
Jack Clark’s eyes twitched as Ereya Louise suddenly disappeared from his perception.
Though she was still within his line of sight and he could capture her in his vision, his other senses told him that there was no person’ there.
This was more than just a concealment of aura, but also a reduction in presence, making it even more exaggerated than his own Hidden God Method.
At that moment, the girl suddenly pulled the trigger. The gun barrel burst into flames in an instant.
Boom…!! Five shots were fired continuously, and since the speed was too fast, the explosion sounds were almost simultaneous. The tremendous recoil force raised a raging wind, making the girl’s hair flutter in the air.
At the same time, a thousand meters away, the smoke and dust filled the target, which was a one-meter-thick concrete wall surrounded by a layer of Mutated Beast scale armor.
When the smoke cleared, Jack Clark saw five fist-sized holes penetrating the center of the concrete wall.
Such frightening penetration power could not even be stopped by a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator s True Strength nor the thick-skinned Level 4 Mutated Beast.
in addition, the initial speed of almost four times the speed of sound was dangerous for Jack Clark even if he could sense the danger in advance and slightly delay his reaction.
This was the power of modern weapons, which a regular cultivator could not withstand despite years of hard training.
Noticing the astonishment on Jack Clark s face, the girl pursed her lips and laughed, a hint of pride evident in her crescent eyes, as if she were a little girl showing off her toy to a friend.
“Just now was the armor-piercing bullet, which focused on penetration. Next up are the High-Burning Explosive Bullets/’
Freya Louise then loaded ten even thicker and longer bullets into the magazine from the already arranged table. After clicking it into place, she aimed the sniper rifle slightly.
Boom boom boom boom boom!!
An explosion instantly occurred on another hillside a thousand meters away. The violent explosion almost engulfed an area of tens of meters, dirt and debris filled the sky, and flames burned ferociously.
After ten minutes of continuous burning, the flames gradually extinguished, revealing ten, nearly 3-meter diameter craters on the hillside.
Despite being merely sniper explosive rounds, their power was almost comparable to cannonballs. Well, no, with a 28-millimeter caliber, there’s practically no difference between them and a cannon.
This instant fire suppression was enough to provide teammates with powerful fire cover, especially when ammunition was plentiful.
At this moment, Freya Louise had only slid back one meter after the ten continuous high-explosive shots, with some True Strength consumed, but both the gun and herself remained in a good state, able to provide continuous fire suppression.
“How about that?” The girl looked at Jack Clark.
Jack Clark nodded, “The single-target attack is strong, and the firepower is impressive, but the major weakness is still quite apparent.’1
“Your close combat ability is too weak. If a Level 3 Shadow Demon Leopard were to ger within too meters of you, you might not even be able to run.”
In Jack Clark’s mouth, the Shadow Demon Leopard was an extremely agile Mutated Beast. Although only at Level 3, its innate ability allowed it to burst into Subsonic Speed instantly.
Similarly, against such agile cultivators, her pure True Strength with little potency would make it difficult for her to defend herself if attacked up close.
In contrast to Jack Clark’s Overbearing Coagulated True Strength of Triplex Heaven, Freya Louise s True Strength, which she cultivated through her special methods, was as loose as cotton.
This kind of True Strength only had an average increase of about twice in all aspects of the body, which belonged to the weakest of the low-level martial arts.
Freya Louise sighed, “There’s nothing 1 can do about it. My Cultivation Methods are like this before breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
Jack Clark was suspicious, “So does that mean your close combat capabilities will significantly improve after reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven?”
“Of course.”
Feya Louise raised her chin, “Before the Fourth Layer Heaven, what restrains me is simply the sniper rifle not being flexible enough. Hand cannons at close range can be easily dodged by opponents through the direction of the gun barrel.”
“Besides, with the current conventional handguns, even at their maximum potency, they can’t pose a lethal threat to cultivators or Mutated Beasts above the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“That’s why 1 was injured during my encounter with Erica Knowles.”
“But once I break through the Fourth Layer Heaven, combining firearms and T ranscendent Materials to forge a Transcendent Weapon that obeys my every command will change everything.”
“Transcendent Firearms can have inscriptions engraved, powered by Crystal Energy, and can release kinetic energy that is tens, even hundreds of times more powerful than grain propellant.”
“At the same time, the bone bullet tips can be refined by me, increasing not only their piercing power against Extraordinary energy but also allowing them to make a 60-degree change in direction after being shot..”

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 126: Magnetic Energy Weapon, Single-Kill King-Level Giant Beast_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 126: Magnetic Energy Weapon, Single-Kill King-Level Giant Beast_3
Translator: 549690339
“In this situation, having a transcendent hand cannon would give me a formidable close combat strength, even if the enemy gets close to me.”
After hearing Freya Louise say that the bullets in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven could bend in flight and were even more powerful, Jack Clark didn’t know what to say.
“…Now that you mention it, it seems like your path is much simpler than our cultivation; you just need to increase the power of your firearms.”
The girl stuck her tongue out: “Of course it’s not that simple. 1 also need to cultivate, and my future combat strength will be tied to my transcendent firearms and technological progress.”
“This path is called the Integration of Science and Martial Arts, and the core idea is to treat firearms as ‘life-bound magical treasures,’ focusing on enhancing technological weapons.”
“Moreover, cultivators need to possess an intangible, non-material True Strength that encompasses all attributes. They cannot have any attributes, which places great limitations on them.”
“The strongest person on this path is a Ninth Heaven Peak power, with terrifying combat strength. He once single-handedly killed three King-level Beasts.”
“However, due to the limitations of technology, he has been stagnant at this realm for many years. There are pros and cons.”
“Aside from that, the official researchers have always been investigating the fusion of transcendent and technological weapons, energy weapons, many of which have powers beyond the range of nuclear weapons.”
“The Simon Empire is further along in this field than we are. In our Eastern Summer, orthodox True Martial cultivation remains the mainstream, and there are more high-end cultivators.”
“Alright, let me show you the trump card my aunt prepared for me.”
With that, Freya Louise grabbed an energy crystal from the table and snapped it onto the sniper rifle, while also switching to a thicker, black gun barrel.” Next, she pushed a black object into the magazine.”
“This is the latest small magnetic-energy weapon developed by my aunt.”
“Replacing electrical energy with crystal energy, using True Strength to activate, and inscriptions to bind, it can achieve an initial velocity of 3,500 meters in an instant.”
“The bullet used is a gold armor-piercing bullet, with a surface covered in a thin membrane that can reduce the hindrance of extraordinary energy. At ten times the speed of sound, its instantaneous penetration power is terrifying.”
As she explained, the crystal on the girl’s sniper rifle lit up, and energy was drawn from it into the gun, activating all the inscriptions.
Hum!
Accompanied by the charging sound, the rifle emitted a hum, and an astonishingly dangerous aura emanated from the oily-black gun barrel.
Biu!
Accompanied by a faint sound, Jack Clark’s terrifying vision only caught a fleeting residual image as an instant later, a black dot appeared on a small hill 1,500 meters away.
One shot, and the dirt on the hillside was pierced straight through, leaving a head-sized hole that went through about 20 meters.
Although it seemed unimpressive at first glance, the terrifying penetrating power made Jack Clark feel that even wearing +10 battle armor wouldn’t be enough to withstand it, and he would be torn apart by a single shot.”
“According to my aunt, this shot could even kill an ordinary Level 5 mutated beast,” said Freya Louise as she put down the sniper cannon.”
“However, its weakness is quite obvious: the wind-up is too long, and the dangerous aura it emits is too strong, making it easy for cultivators and mutated beasts to sense it. It can only be used on stationary targets.”
“And it also burns money.”
After hearing Freya Louise’s explanation, Jack Clark noticed that the energy in the energy crystal of the sniper rifle had been depleted. In other words, that shot just cost 15 contribution points.
Adding the cost of the bullet, of which the value was unknown, he couldn’t help but agree: “It really does burn money, but the power is indeed great.”
Next, the girl introduced some other bullet effects to Jack Clark and let him try shooting the gun as well.
However, he stopped after firing only a dozen shots, because it was too expensive. According to Freya Louise, a real Black Bone Armor-piercing Bullet would cost one thousand points, which was equivalent to one contribution point, and that was just for the money part.
It was then that Jack Clark realized how extravagant Freya Louise usually was.
According to her, under her aunt’s insistence, she had to train for an hour every day, firing hundreds of armor-piercing bullets, incendiary bullets, and high-explosive bullets for practice.
Even though her marksmanship was accurate within a kilometer, she still had to train daily to maintain her feel for the gun. As a result, even though practice bullets were cheaper, she still spent tens of thousands of dollars a day.
Although she also felt that this practice was wasteful, there was no choice, as it was all in pursuit of the intuition that her aunt said could hit any target at the peak of cultivation.
It was similar to Jack Clark’s Heart’s Eye, but also different. Anyway, it was very complex..

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 127 After ten years, brother, I have come to find you again.
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 127 After ten years, brother, I have come to find you again.
Translator: 549690339
2Sth of the lunar year
The festive mood is getting thicker.
Children in new clothes are playing around in rhe streets and alleys. The streets are decorated with lanterns and brightly colored streamers. Doris Raven sends Jack Clark and his brother to buy New Year’s goods.
Then they are busy doing a lot of things like cleaning the house front and back, and a day is gone in rhe hustle and bustle.
In the evening, the Clark brothers stand outside the door and look at Doris inside, asking: “Mom, are you sure you don’t want to join us?”
“No, you guys go have fun.”
“Alright then.*
Tonight, there is a festive firework display by the Mist River, so it’s very bustling. Before it gets dark, a stream of people is heading towards the riverside, including the Clark Brothers.
Due to the annual firework display, small vendors with keen business sense have already set up stalls along the street to sell various snacks, toys, and fireworks.
As soon as the two Clark brothers get off the bus, they see a dense crowd on the riverbank street and it’s jam-packed. Glenn Clark excitedly says, “Bro, there are so many people today.”
“Yes, many indeed.” Jack Clark looks around and spots Frey a Louise and the others not far away.
“Let’s go over there, my classmates are there.”
Jack leads Glenn over to where Freya, Crystal Leinster sisters, Vera Lee and Jodie Shaprio are standing in front of a stall selling masks.
Across them, Justin Welan, Zac Lyons, White Veil, Marcus Lee and Mullen Weisz and Sawyer Levin are squatting in front of a candy stall, watching the stall owner skilfully shape various Mutated Beasts.
Walking over, Jack scolds and says, “You guys, you are this big and you still like candy.”
Justin turns his head: “Jack, you are here.”
Zac rebutted: “Hey! Jack, you’re wrong about that. Aren’t we all just high school students?”
“We are all youths, what’s wrong with eating candy?”
“Exactly.” Marcus nods in agreement, biting off the tail of a unicorn-turtle-shaped candy in his hand.
At this moment, White Veil comes over: “Jack, do you want one? The jelly candy sold by this stall owner is added with honey from the Golden Winged Bee, it’s really tasty.”
The Golden Winged Bee is a common mutated creature, not even a Unique Beast, but its honey is very delicious. It’s sweet without being greasy, and contains natural floral fragrance.
A bite will give you the feeling of returning to nature, so it is very expensive.
At this time, combined with the stall owner’s lifelike candy blowing s lulls, it’s no wonder the business is so good.
Of course, you have to blow the candy yourself, not the stall owner. The stall owner is only responsible for shaping it with two bamboo-stick-like tools, otherwise no one can swallow it.
“…Golden Winged Bee’s honey, never mind, I don’t like candy.” In order to maintain his previous image, Jack Clark still refused.
“You actually don’t like candy, never mind this kid, do you want it? My treat?”
“Yes, I do.” Glenn is not polite at ail.
At this time, Jack Clark remembered that he hadn’t introduced his brother yet, so he says: “Oh, this is my younger brother, Glenn Clark, he’s in junior high school. Jim, this is White Veil, Marcus….”
“Hello Brother White, Hello Brother Marcus, Hello Brother Justin…” As Jack introduced them, Glenn politely greeted each of them, which made them all grin from ear to ear.
Justin generously says, “Little tiger, your brother and I are good friends. Tonight is on me, grab whatever you want to eat or buy.”
Glenn’s eyes lit up instantly, but he still looked at Jack.
Jack nonchalantly says, “Justin’s family is rich. Since he’s said that, you feel free to indulge yourself tonight.”
“Hehehe!! Thanks, Brother Justin, then 1 won’t be polite.”
At this time, Glenn hesitates: “But I made an appointment with a few classmates to roam the firework show together. It wouldn’t be good to split the cost of the food…”
“Classmates, boys or girls?” Justin curiously asks.
Glenn looks somewhat embarrassed: ’They’re all girls.”
“That’s good.”
Marcus gives a thumbs up: “Jack, your brother takes the cake.”
“Impressive, he’s only in junior high and he’s already calling several female classmates to hang our together.”
Zac Lyons and the others can’t help gasping.
Justin feels even more like he has met a kindred spirit and says: “It’s good if they are girls. Tonight, you guys can eat whatever you want. If you’re tired, you can find a place to rest, just come to me to reimburse later.”
“Much obliged, Brother Justin.” Glenn grins from ear to year.
Despite his rough exterior, Glenn did have some cunning in him. Seeing that the guys are getting more and more out of control, Jack can’t help but chase them away.
“Okay, okay, Jim, go find your classmates. Don’t go crazy with them.”
As soon as Jack’s brother Glenn was gone, Freya Louise and the others came over from the opposite side. Watching the several men with lecherous faces, they asked curiously: “What are you laughing about?”
“Nothing, just that Jack introduced us to his brother.” With that, Justin and the others started laughing again, looking more lecherous.
Vera Lee asked curiously: “Is Jack’s brother as handsome as him?”
“Handsome… seems a bit inferior.” Zac Lyons and the others glanced at each other and found that although Glenn Clark is also tall and mighty, he doesn’t quite have the handsome looks of Jack dark.
Suddenly there was a commotion in the distance, and someone shouted: “It’s starting.”
The sky seems to have darkened at this time, according to the announced time, the boats launching fireworks on the river surface are ready.
“Come on, let’s find a better spot.”
Jack points to the small hill in the distance: “Let’s go over there, although it’s a bit far, we can see clearly with our eyesight, and the high terrain can give us a panoramic view.”
“That place is indeed good, let’s go.”
Having said that, they all squeeze out of the crowd and come to the hillside hundreds of meters away from the riverside. They are not the only ones, many people are already waiting there..

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 127 After ten years, brother, I have come to find you again_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 127 After ten years, brother, I have come to find you again_2
Translator: 549690339
Whoosh! Accompanied by a sharp whistling, a stream of fire rushed up from the river surface to hundreds of meters high.
With a bang, a massive golden firework, covering hundreds of meters, burst open, like a blooming golden lotus, illuminating both banks as if it were daylight.
With the rumbling of explosions in the sky, dazzling fireworks filled the sky, many even forming ferocious and fierce Mutated Beast patterns after exploding.
“Wow! That looks like a Golden Winged Scaled Dragon.”
“Damn, such a realistic mountain giant ape, 1 guess it’s about a hundred meters tall.”
A dozen or so teenagers sat in groups on the grass or stood on rocks, admiring the rare spectacle before their eyes.
Justin Welan’s eyes sparkled, excitedly saying, “This year’s factory-made fireworks are of good quality. 1 will order some to set off tomorrow night.”
Zac Lyons bitterly said, “Damn, it’s good to be rich like you guys, just ordering these ten thousand-dollar fireworks without a second thought.”
“Mr. Lewis, don’t be so sour. With your current strength, this money is nothing to you. After entering the Alien Beast Battlefield, killing a Level 3 Mutant Beast would be worth hundreds of thousands.”
Jack Clark and Freya Louise sat on the grass, watching the brilliant fireworks in the night sky. The girl whispered, “After so many years, 1 finally see the fireworks party in Mist River again.”
Jack looked at her, somewhat puzzled, “Why? Haven’t you come to see it before?”
The Mist River organizes a fireworks party one or two days before the New Year every year, which has almost become a tradition. In Jack’s memory, ‘he’ has seen it many times.
For Jack’s confusion, the girl whispered, “1 watched it a few times when I was little. Then 1 followed my father to live in Simon for ten years, and only returned this year.”
“So, it’s been almost ten years since I’ve seen it.” After finishing, the girl’s eyes were slightly blurred as she looked at the brilliant fireworks in the night sky, and it was unimown what she was thinking.
“No wonder.”
After the fireworks show, it was time for the New Year celebration, and Jack’s family, although small in number, was very lively.
Within the blink of an eye, several days passed, and on the third day of the New Year, Jack came to school to see Justin Welan and the others off.
The Alien Beast Battlefield was several primitive mountain ranges that had been sealed off by the military. Before the New Age, they were famous for their primeval forests, and some changes occurred later on.
Inside the mountains, Mutant Beasts emerged in an endless procession, and the speed and strength of their evolution far exceeded the outside world, making the area extremely dangerous.
To prevent powerful Mutant Beasts from breaking through and posing a threat to ordinary people outside, a strong man eventually laid down a huge enchantment seal.
Separating the primitive mountain ranges from the outside world, the Mutant Beasts could not leave, ordinary people could not enter, and entrance could only be accessed through the designated entrance.
This time, not only Crystal Leinster and the others, but also some Level 3 freshmen and over twenty senior students who came home for the New Year formed a group of nearly forty people.
When Jack came to see them off, Crystal and the others had not arrived yet. Instead, Justin Welan, Zac Lyons, and White Veil had all arrived early.
By this time, they all had weaponry on their backs, and boxes with battle armor were placed nearby.
After Jack came over, Justin Welan grinned and said, “Jack, we’ll go scout first, and you’ll catch up as soon as you finish your Dragon Elephant Overlord Body transfer.”
Jack nodded slightly, “Yeah, 1’11 catch up as soon as I’m ready.”
Zac Lyons seemed a bit reluctant, “There’s something missing without you joining us this time, Jack.”
” Missing a leader.” White Veil added.
Zac Lyons clapped his hands, “Right, that’s what I meant.”
They were a team during the Koroya Trial, and whenever they encountered enemies or fought, Jack was always the most courageous and responsive, instantly raising their morale.
If the others were slower, they wouldn’t even be able to pick up a single head, let alone have a share in the loot.
“… Go away, you guys aren’t going to commit murder and arson, so what do you need a leader for?” Jack said before laughing himself.
As the group chatted, Mullen Weisz and a couple of others, carrying a heavy hammer and a huge sword, arrived. The six of them joked and chatted, trading barbs with no sense of tension.
About ten minutes later, the Leinster siblings and Freya Louise finally came together.
Two girls who looked identical in appearance, height, and figure stood together, drawing attention, especially when exquisite-faced Freya Louise was added to the mix.
As soon as the three appeared, they attracted the attention of everyone present.
Justin Welan exclaimed, “Jack, have you noticed? The Class Leader and the others seem to be getting more and more beautiful.”
“Indeed.” Jack agreed, nodding his head.
He didn’t know if it was because they had grown up or experienced more, but Jack also found Crystal Leinster, Mandy Leinster, and Freya Louise all seemed to be even more beautiful than before.
Justin Welan sighed, “Such beautiful girls, 1 wonder who will be lucky enough to have them in the future.” After saying this, he stared straight at Jack.
“Uh… why are you looking at me?” Jack asked, puzzled.
Seeing Jack feigning ignorance, Justin Welan couldn’t help but say, “Jack, can you bear to let someone else have them?”
Jack, speechless, replied, “Don’t go talking nonsense. They’re coming, be careful they might clean you up.”
As the two whispered, Crystal and the others approached with their weapons slung on their backs and luggage in tow.
Seeing them, Jack greeted them actively, “Class Leader, Mandy, when you get there, be careful, and prioritize safety. If anything happens, let Mr. Willard handle it.”
Crystal nodded, “Don’t worry, that was my plan from the beginning, otherwise, I wouldn’t have formed a team with him.”
Before the groups could exchange pleasantries, the bus driver on the side of the road shouted from the window, “Everybody, get on the bus, we’re ready to leave..”

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 127 After ten years, brother, I have come to find you again_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 127 After ten years, brother, I have come to find you again_3
Translator: 549690339
Everyone immediately put down their luggage and weapons.
“Goodbye, Jack Clark.”
By the window, Justin Welan shouted, “Jack, remember to check the chat group when you have time. 1’11 record some videos of the Alien Beast Battlefield for you.”
“Okay, I’ll check my phone when I have time.” Jack nodded.
Marcus Lee, who was also sitting by the window, excitedly shouted, “Jack, remember to come early. Don’t wait until I’ve broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven to come.”
“Marcus, are you daydreaming? Do you think you can break through the Fourth Layer Heaven within a month?”
“Who knows, maybe 1’11 have good luck and find a top-tier resource that could help me break through two realms in a row?”
“Do you think it’s possible?”
The two transport buses slowly started up, accompanied by the roar of the engines as they drove out of the school.
As he watched the bus filled with his familiar classmates disappear from the street corner, Jack, standing at the school gate, couldn’t help but feel a little emotional. He wondered what changes would have taken place when they met again.
They might be very surprised then.
These guys all thought that by going to the Alien Beast Battlefield early, they could catch up and even surpass him in terms of realm by using the resources and environment there.
Unfortunately, they had no idea that he’s only one step away from breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Next, he would just wait for the cleaning mission to begin in two days, harvest his contributions, soar to great heights, and then add on the Synchronous Strengthening from the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s Fourth Evolution.
By then, his combat power should be enough to surprise everyone.
Thinking of this, Jack couldn’t help but smile and turned to the slender girl beside him, “Let’s get going.”
More than a hundred meters deep under the sea, colorful coral reefs attracted various types of marine life.
Above the coral reefs lay a ferocious beast over fifteen meters long, covered in black scales, with a dark red glow shining through the gaps between the scales.
However, at this moment, the giant beast’s aura was restrained, and it remained motionless as if it were a black stone, surrounded by many beautiful fish that swam around it.
With the efforts of recent times, the Hidden God Method of the Sword Armor Flame Beast had made some progress, and it could perfectly restrain its own aura under static conditions.
However, this state was only suitable for lurking; once it moved, the terrifying Qi Blood emitted from its flesh would break through the cover of the Secret Skill.
Perched on the coral reef, the giant beast thoughtfully watched the small fishes swimming back and forth in front of it.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast had noticed that its growth rate had slowed down somewhat in the past few days.
Of course, this slowing referred to its increase in size, as its evolution value still accumulated at a stable rate.
“Is it reaching the Evolution Limit?” the Sword Armor Flame Beast wondered.
Jack knew from the beginning that living organisms have growth limits, such as the Six-legged Salamander which could only grow up to 30 centimeters initially, then 70 centimeters after one evolution.
It had grown from a Six-legged Salamander that could be easily crushed by a child to a gigantic beast with a length of fifteen meters by breaking through its limits through evolution.
Obviously, it had reached the limit of its third evolution once again, and its size would probably stop growing at 18 or 20 meters.
But more than fifty days had passed since its third evolution, and its evolution value had accumulated to 2,000. With more effort, it would almost be enough to evolve within a month.
Of course, if it had good luck during this time and could hunt down and eat several Level 6 Mutant Beasts every day, the growth rate of its evolution value would be even faster.
But that was wishful thinking.
Although Level 6 Mutant Beasts were nothing special in the ocean, the problem was that it dared not wander around recklessly. Who knew if it would randomly encounter a Level 9 Giant Beast that would swallow it whole?
The ocean was too vast, and nobody knew what creatures were hidden down in the dark depths.
Even during this time, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was extremely cautious, expanding its hunting range gradually along known and explored areas.
However, although this method was safe, it was time-consuming, and with bad luck, it might encounter only ordinary Level 3-4 Demonic Beasts during the day.
While the Sword Armor Flame Beast was deep in thought, a faint whimpering sound came through the sea water.
Hearing the unique call, the Sword Armor Flame Beast could not help but look up.
On the turbulent sea surface, a huge beast, 29 meters long, was rolling about it was the Single-horned Tiger Whale that had once cooperated with the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
Not far behind it were the three Little Tiger Whales and the Female Tiger Whale.
At this point, both Little Tiger Whales had grown significantly larger, reaching 12 meters in length, and had red markings along their scales to indicate that they had consumed the two Blood Crystals.
Bang! At that moment, a black ferocious Demonic Beast burst out of the sea water in the distance and the Single-horned Tiger Whale cheered.
Whimpering! “Brother, I’ve finally found you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 128: Talent Strengthening, Involving the Power of Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 128: Talent Strengthening, Involving the Power of Time
Translator: 549690339
On the sea surface, the Sword Armor Flame Beast let out a low growl.
Roar! What do you want from me?
The immense Single-horned Tiger Whale rolled on the sea surface, creating huge splashes, but its voice was gentle.
Chirp chirp! I found something good, let’s go get it together.
Instantly, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s spirit was lifted.
Roar! What is guarding that place?
This Single-horned Tiger Whale was not stupid. If there were only benefits, it certainly wouldn’t come looking for it. Clearly, the place was either narrow or guarded by powerful Mutated Beasts.
Chirp chirp! The place is a bit small, I can’t fit in. And there are two annoying guys guarding it.
Although the two beasts could communicate through mental fluctuations, this kind of communication was quite vague since the tiger whale didn’t possess human cognition or thought processes.
Finally, after roughly determining that the two “annoying guys” were shorter than the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast decided to check it out.
As long as there were no high-level Mutated Beasts that were larger than the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had the confidence to suppress them. Hence, “Roar! Lead the way, let’s fuck them up!”
Chirp chirp! Fuck them up.
With a turn of its enormous body, the Single-horned Tiger Whale took the lead towards the Outer Sea, followed by the Sword Armor Flame Beast. The sharp, black, long spikes on its back tore through the sea waves.
Chirp chirp! While passing by the Tiger Whale Group, a few curious Little Tiger Whales chirped as if greeting the Sword Armor Flame Beast passing by.
This time the distance was even further than the last time. Both the whale and the beast swam for almost two hours before stopping, and then the Single-horned Tiger Whale submerged.
Seeing this, the Sword Armor Flame Beast followed. In just a while, the two Mutated Beasts reached a thousand meters deep under the sea. The surroundings were pitch-black and silent, and the sea water was ice-cold.
Upon reaching this depth, the Sword Armor Flame Beast expanded its perception to the maximum, to avoid being ambushed by a Deep Sea Giant Beast lurking in the darkness.
Chirp chirp! We’re almost there.
Only a few tens of meters away, the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s call could be heard, but the sound was so soft that it was swallowed up by the natural fluctuations of the sea water before traveling much further.
As expected, after swimming a few more kilometers, the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s body slowly decelerated, and the Sword Armor Flame Beast immediately reduced its speed, its sleek and powerful body aligning parallel to the whale.
At the same time, it realized why the tiger whale had stopped.
A hundred meters away on the pitch-black seabed, a mountain peak several hundred meters tall emerged from the ground. However, that wasn’t important; the critical part was the cave on the mountainside.
Emitting a faint blue light, the cave entrance was guarded by two Double-headed Mutated Giant Pythons, their bodies, 27 meters and 19 meters long, respectively, covered in blue and white scale armor.
On both heads of the larger python grew a sharp horn, resembling a Flood Dragon, exuding an astonishingly oppressive aura.
From the invisible aura sensed, the Sword Armor Flame Beast knew that these two Double-headed Giant Pythons were very strong, much stronger than other Mutated Beasts of the same size.
No wonder it had sought its help. Clearly, even without the cave’s size restriction, the Single-horned Tiger Whale might not necessarily be able to overpower them.
Or rather, it wouldn’t choose to take the risk.
Based on its observations during this period, the Sword Armor Flame Beast found that the hunting methods of these deep-sea Mutated Beasts mainly depended on their body size and type of creature.
Under normal conditions, a Mutated Beast 20 meters long would not hunt prey of a similar size but would prey on those less than 10 meters in size.
To avoid getting injured and then targeted by other stronger Mutated Creatures, they’d adopt this tactic.
There were almost no beasts like the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which specifically targeted prey much larger than themselves, or even twice their size since this behavior would mean certain death under normal conditions.
At this moment, the Single-horned Tiger Whale let out a low sound.
Chirp chirp! I’ll deal with the big one; you take care of the small one. After we kill them and go in, we’ll split the good stuff half-half.
Roar! No problem, but how did you find out there’s something good in there? The Sword Armor Flame Beast was a bit puzzled.
With a diameter of about five meters, the cave entrance was definitely too small for the Single-horned Tiger Whale. Under such circumstances, how did it know there was something good so deep underwater?
Chirp chirp! 1 smelled a nice aroma when I swam above it. Saying that, the Single-horned Tiger Whale gently shook its single horn, the tip of which had many dense small holes.
These small holes would emit faint energy fluctuations when filtering seawater.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast paused for a moment.
Unexpectedly, the evolved single horn of this whale wasn’t for fighting, but for treasure hunting or, rather, had a perception function.
Perhaps it was because of the single horn that it didn’t provoke the Sword Armor Beast as it sensed it was not to be trifled with.
Just then, the two Deep Sea Giant Pythons sensed them with their cold snake eyes, and a circle of greyish-black mist spread around their bodies, dissolving into the surrounding sea water.
Roar! They spotted us. Let’s fuck them up!
With a low snarl, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s fierce and fiery aura burst out. Its claws pressed down on the seabed, stirring up rolling sands and shooting them out.
However, it did not charge head-on but circled around in an arc, leaving the frontal attack to the Single-horned Tiger Whale due to its huge size.
It was simply a natural meat shield, just like Justin Welan.
Bang! The seawater exploded.
Taking advantage of its size, the Single-horned Tiger Whale directly charged towards the two Giant Pythons, its body draped in thick, armor-like scales, akin to a deep-sea tank.
Hiss! Eyeing the approaching Single-horned Tiger Whale, the two Deep Sea Giant Pythons let out a chilly hiss, and their coiled bodies suddenly sprang out to meet it.
As the two sides closed in to within a hundred meters, the mouth of the Single-horned Tiger Whale opened wide, and in an instant, a powerful suction force engulfed the two giant pythons and the surrounding seawater..

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 128: Talent Strengthening, Involving the Power of Time_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 128: Talent Strengthening, Involving the Power of Time_2
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
The seawater within a hundred-meter radius erupted, turning into a rapidly spinning vortex under the powerful swallowing force, dragging the two Deep Sea Giant Pythons towards the whale’s mouth like a black hole.
But just as the Tiger Whale launched its attack, circles of gray halos burst out from the bodies of the two Deep Sea Giant Pythons.
Silent and invisible, the originally raging seawater where the gray halos passed by slowed down, and the huge water vortex even began to slowly dissipate.
And when the halo swept across the Single-horned Tiger Whale, its originally fast-moving body suddenly stalled, as if it had entered slow motion, moving slowly at the bottom of the sea.
Behind it, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had originally planned to encircle them with the Single-horned Tiger Whale, was also hit by the gray halos and moved slowly in the water.
It also smelled a faint fishy scent from the traces of the gray halos, which made its head feel a bit dizzy.
However, the Sword Armor Flame Beast just shook its head, and the feeling of dizziness disappeared instantly. Its powerful fiery physique directly let it ignore the Double-headed Sea Python’s toxin.
While it could, the tiny marine creatures around it were not so fortunate. They continuously melted under the grey halos and were quickly dissolved into poisonous water by the terrifying toxins.
Such terrible toxicity was even surprising for the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
And the strange ability.
It not only had the highly corrosive toxin that could dissolve everything in the water, but it also had the slow-motion effect, which slowed their bodily reactions by more than ten times under the gray halos.
Hiss hiss!!
Unaffected by the slow-motion halos, the two Deep Sea Giant Pythons were extremely flexible. One lunged at the swaying Single-horned Tiger Whale, and the other at the Sword Armor Flame Beast behind it.
In just an instant, the 19-meter-long Double-headed Giant Python appeared in front of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, its two ferocious snake mouths wide open, biting down on its head and neck.
But what if their bodily reactions slowed down by more than ten times?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s right-claw muscles swelled up, instantly bursting the seawater, and with a remaining afterimage, it shattered the seawater and slapped the Deep Sea Giant Python’s head fiercely.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force, the left side of the giant python’s head exploded in blood and flesh, and its body was slapped away with a tremendous bang, crashing heavily into the mountain wall dozens of meters away.
You can slow down, but can’t I use my speed talent to burst?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s gaze was cold. As it slapped away that Giant Python in an instant, its four claws crushed the seabed, and it burst out like a black shadow under the Agility Talent.
Bang! The Sword Armor Flame Beast bit into the neck of the python whose head had been blown up.
Hiss hiss!! The Giant Python let out a tragic scream as the Sword Armor Flame Beast clamped on its neck, its huge body bursting with thousands of tons of force and struggling madly.
At the same time, the gray halos containing extreme toxicity and slow-motion effect continued to spread on its body.
However, these toxins had just landed on the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body when most of them were dissipated by a strong, hot energy, and the rest disappeared without a trace after entering its body.
As a Six-legged Salamander, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was naturally gifted with powerful regeneration and toxicity.
Although its evolution talents had been spent on strength, defense, and agility, the two abilities still grew stronger as the Sword Armor Flame Beast grew.
In addition to the horrific physical strength, it directly ignored the python’s deadly poison.
Only that strange slow-motion ability had some impact on it, but it still couldn’t stop its upper and lower jaws from slowly exerting force. Finally, with a crack sound…
Even the python’s barrel-thick neck and spine were snapped by the Sword Armor Flame Beast. Only a small bit of skin and flesh remained connected and the rich, fresh blood spurted out, staining the surrounding seawater red.
Boom boom boom boom!! The dead python did not relax, its 19-meter-long body frantically rolled in the sea. Countless rocks were swept away, and the mud and sand rolled around.
After the Sword Armor Flame Beast killed the Mutated Giant Python, the gray energy covering the vicinity disappeared, and it restored its normal movement.
It looked back to the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which now had its neck bitten by the python’s two heads. Still, it was in no real danger.
It couldn’t be helped. Whales originally had thick blubber, and after this Single-horned Tiger Whale mutated, it also grew a one-meter thick layer of scale armor, like regular armor.
At this point, although the giant python had bitten into it, its sharp teeth could not penetrate the fat and skin behind the hard scale armor after passing through it.Under such circumstances, it was impossible to inject more potent toxins.
However, the Tiger Whale was smart, closing its eyes and other vital parts when being attacked. As for the python’s strongest constricting…The size difference was too big, and it couldn’t constrict at all.
Seeing this, the Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t care and rushed into the blue cave.
Instantly, the giant python that was biting the single-horned Tiger Whale panicked. Its two massive heads quickly let go of the single-horned Tiger Whale and swam back hurriedly.
Boom! Just as the double-headed giant python rushed into the cave, the seawater in front exploded, and a black Colossus hanging with its limbs on the cave roof pounced down with terrifying aura.
After storing power in the sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast appeared almost instantly above the Double-headed Giant Python’s heads, bursting with a frightening speed of 20 times its size.
The speed was so fast that it couldn’t react in time. Even the sluggish gray light on its body was flashing, sensing the terrifying power coming from its two heads in an instant.
Boom boom! Under the thick giant claws, the two huge python heads larger than a small car were instantly blown open. Half of the head was blasted by the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s sneak attack.
Under the terrifying power, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s double claws and entire body slammed into the cave floor, shattering the ground instantly and causing the mountain to tremble.
For a moment, rocks and debris rolled down, and a large amount of muddy sand mixed with the giant python corpse rushed out of the cave, creating a horrifying scene.
It took almost a few minutes for the rolling sea to calm down, revealing the collapsed cave entrance that was twice as large and the towering, grotesque black and red figure beside the python corpse.
At this time, the single-horned Tiger Whale swam by, making an excited noise.
Chirp chirp chirp! Brother, well done! Hurry up and get the goodies inside.
Roar! Don’t rush me; 1 know.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t bother with this guy, who was completely useless, unable to kill a mutated beast only slightly smaller than itself in two moves.
Roaring, the Sword Armor Flame Beast turned around to look inside the cave. It wasn’t until now that it had the mood to take a look at the surroundings.
The blue radiance came from blue ores that emitted light.
These ores looked like crystals, scattered on the cave walls. If it weren’t for the fact that there was no energy fluctuation, the Sword Armor Flame Beast would have almost thought that it had discovered blue crystal mines.
Although there was no energy fluctuation, the blue ores seemed to radiate and emitted light instinctively, making the Sword Armor Flame Beast feel uncomfortable.
It felt that staying for too long would cause damage to its body.
No wonder the two double-headed giant pythons were coiled outside.
As it pondered, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swam downwards through the winding cave for hundreds of meters, and then an empty cave appeared before its eyes.
In the depths of the cave, a stalactite more than ten meters long hung from the ceiling. Tiny blue lights circulated throughout the cave, converging at the tip of the stalactite.
Under the convergence of these blue lights, it gradually condensed into blue liquid.
Three fist-sized blue liquids sank and floated in the sea below, looking as clear and transparent as pearls. Although they were liquid, they did not mix with seawater, emanating a faint halo.
Compared to those uncomfortable ores, the moment the Sword Armor Flame Beast saw those three pearl-like liquids, its devouring instinct surged up again.
Good stuff. The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s eyes brightened, and its tail swayed slightly as it swam over.
Looking at the floating blue liquid in front of it, the Sword Armor Flame Beast revealed curiosity. It stretched out a sharp claw and gently touched it, and the drop of liquid bounced away instantly.
Was it not mixing with seawater due to its higher density and the presence of special energy?
With anticipation, the Sword Armor Flame Beast opened its mouth and swallowed a blue pearl along with the seawater. The moment it entered its stomach, an icy cold energy spread throughout its body.
Boom!
Under the influence of that cold energy, the temperature of the blistering energy inside the Sword Armor Flame Beast skyrocketed, and the temperature of the flesh and blood emitted in an instant rose from over a hundred Celsius to three hundred.
Immediately, red light burst from the cracks in its scales, with flames burning and jumping. Even the thick black scales turned slightly red due to the high temperature, looking like red-hot steel.
The temperature of the surrounding seawater rose sharply, and bubbles tumbled.
Whoosh! Good stuff! The Sword Armor Flame Beast exhaled hot breath from its nostrils, and its eyes excitedly stared at the remaining two blue “pearls..”
Wanna gift the story? Try one.

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 129: Level 4 Crystal, Contribution Points are Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 129: Level 4 Crystal, Contribution Points are Here
Translator: 549690339
1 didn’t expect it to be a resource to strengthen extraordinary talents.
Looking at the remaining two blue ‘pearls’, the Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t hesitate and swallowed another one.
Just like before, the moment the blue energy entered its stomach, it exploded and merged with the intense energy throughout its body, although the effect this time was much weaker.
The temperature of the intense energy circulating through its flesh and blood rose from three hundred to four hundred Celsius.
Even so, the heat emitted by the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body became even more scorching, with red flames dancing between the gaps of its full-body scale armor, making it look awe-inspiring and terrifying.
It was like a fire giant beast.
These flames were not ordinary plasma fire, but energy flames fueled by the extraordinary energy contained within the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body.
So even in the sea water, they burned continuously, causing the surrounding sea water to boil and cook some microorganisms.
But isn’t it strange for a flame giant beast to appear deep in the ocean…?
Just when the Sword Armor Flame Beast thought that something was off, suddenly, it felt an itch in its throat and couldn’t help but cough… cough cough roar!
In the midst of the coughing growl, a burst of flame suddenly shot out from the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s mouth. The intense heat caused the sea water to boil and surged forward… but vanished after just a meter.
1 can breathe fire now! The Sword Armor Flame Beast became excited instantly.
Although its current fire breath is weak, it could still be considered a natural talent. After its fourth evolution, its fire talent might become even more powerful.
At that time, if it absorbs and fuses another natural ability, its combat power under the dual natural talent would become even more terrifying.
Ying ying ying!!
At this moment, the Single-Horned Tiger Whale’s call came from outside the cave.
Roar roar!! Don’t rush, brother, I’ll leave half of the good stuff for you. The Sword Armor Flame Beast growled back a few times before looking at the remaining blue ‘pearl’.
Yep, half is right.
The high temperature on the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body receded, and then it reached out its right claw, gently holding the remaining blue pearl and started swimming towards the outside.
When the Sword Armor Flame Beast reached the cave entrance, it saw the Single-Horned Tiger Whale anxiously swimming back and forth, seemingly impatient.
Upon seeing the Sword Armor Flame Beast emerging, the Single-Horned Tiger Whale immediately brightened up and approached excitedly.
Ying ying ying!! Brother, where’s the good stuff?
Roar roar!! Here it is. There were two inside, I ate one and left the other for you.
Fearing that it wouldn’t understand, the Sword Armor Flame Beast sent segmented mental fluctuations while exposing the blue pearl in its open right claw. To make it understand the meaning of the numbers, it even held up two fingers with its left claw in a V shape.
Ying ying ying!! ‘Brother’ is very thoughtful.
The Single-Horned Tiger Whale happily opened its mouth wide and slightly inhaled, swallowing the blue pearl without intending to share it with its child this time.
Whoosh!
An astonishingly powerful Blood Qi erupted from the Single-Horned Tiger Whale, shaking the ocean floor. Black and white lights flickered on its body, emitting an extremely heavy aura.
Level 6 Peak, is it close to Level 7?
Watching the even more formidable Single-Horned Tiger Whale, which even slightly grew in size to almost thirty meters, the Sword Armor Flame Beast pondered.
Ignoring the Single-Horned Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast looked at the corpses of the two Double-headed Giant Pythons.
With their combined power and talents, these two Sea Pythons were very strong. Under the dull halo’s influence, other mutated creatures at the same level could hardly dodge their attacks.
Once bitten by them, the intensely poisonous infusion that could even dissolve living organisms would most likely cause death.
Unfortunately for them, today they encountered the tough-skinned Single-Horned Tiger Whale and the physically fearsome, poison-resistant, Sword Armor Flame Beast with its speed burst talent.
In fact, with the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s combat power, it could have killed them instantly if it had seized the opportunity. However, it was cautious at first because it didn’t know their abilities.
According to the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s estimate, the nineteen-meter one was probably at Level 4 Peak, and the twenty-seven-meter one should be at the Level 6 Early Stage.
Compared to other mutated creatures, python-type creatures had much longer bodies of the same level.
With this thought in mind, the Sword Armor Flame Beast suddenly moved and swam towards the corpse of the Level 4 Giant Python.
As the Single-Horned Tiger Whale’s aura was deterring other creatures, and due to the previous intense poison and corrosion, no small aquatic creatures could be found in this sea area at the moment.
Splat!
The sharp claw tore through the python’s scales and flesh, and then at a position below its head, a crystal-clear Life Crystal appeared.
Level 4 Life Crystal. The Sword Armor Flame Beast carefully picked it up with its fingertip and placed it into the python’s skin hanging from its neck…
Well, during the talent enhancement earlier, its Level 3 Python Skin Bag hanging from its neck was slightly deformed by the heat.
Tearing down the deformed snake skin bag, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swam towards the corpse of the Level 6 Giant Python and tore off a large piece of python skin with its sharp and nimble claw.
Ying ying ying!! From the side, the already enhanced Single-Horned Tiger Whale approached, curiously watching the busy Sword Armor Flame Beast, not understanding what it was doing.
Roar roar!! Don’t distract me. The Sword Armor Flame Beast waved its claw to signal it to stand back a bit.
Soon, a simple Level 6 Pure Python Skin Bag was made, and the Level 4 Crystal was put inside. Then, the Sword Armor Flame Beast also pulled out the tendons of the Double-headed Giant Python to use as a rope.
Ying ying ying!! I want one too. Seeing the bag hanging from the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s neck with Life Crystal inside, the Single-Horned Tiger Whale’s eyes lit up.
It used to carry (snatch) good stuff back to its mate and calf by holding it in its mouth, but many good things would melt instantly once inside..

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 129: Level 4 Crystal, Contribution Points Have Arrived !
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 129: Level 4 Crystal, Contribution Points Have Arrived !
Translator: 549690339
If they had this thing, wouldn’t it be much more convenient?
Roar roar!! It’s useless, your neck is too thick, even if you hang it, it will fall off. The Sword Armor Flame Beast refused.
It wasn’t interested in wasting time making another snake skin bag, not to mention it would be useless even if it did. The Mutated Tiger Whale’s body shape belonged to a streamlined ellipse, with no place to hang.
Did it even have claws?
Next up is the Deep Sea Giant Python corpse ownership. Under the analysis of the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s contribution to the cooperation, it obtained the corpse of the Level Six giant python.
After happily devouring it, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body grew more than ten centimeters in length at a visible speed, and its Evolution value increased by 30.
Whimpering! Brother, let’s go back. As soon as the Sword Armor Flame Beast finished eating the sea python, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which had already swallowed another sea python earlier, called out.
Roar! Wait a minute.
With a low growl, the Sword Armor Flame Beast came up to the cave, standing on two legs and raising its double claws high. The boundless strength converged as its whole body muscles swelled instantly.
Bang! With a terrifying blow of a hundred-fold power from the Sword Armor Flame Beast, the cave, including half of the mountain wall, collapsed, the earth shook, and the rolling mud and sand dispersed.
After destroying the cave with a single blow, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swam out of the muddy seawater and let out a low roar.
Roar roar!! Remember this place, let’s come back when we have good things again.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Whimpering! Brother, you’re still the smart one.
Roar! That’s right.
With a low growl and a cry, the two Mutated Beasts, who came to plunder, eat, take everything, and destroy the cave, swam away and disappeared into the dark sea.
Nothing unusual happened on the way back. Two hours later, the Sword Armor Flame Beast returned to its familiar sea territory.
There, four Tiger Whales were hunting, their prey being a school of Mutated Sharks. The massive Female Tiger Whale charged around, scattering the school of fish.
The three little Tiger Whales cooperated in hunting, skillfully killing one after another of the ordinary mutated sharks that were eight or nine meters long.
Whimpering! Brother, do you want to eat together? Seeing this, the
Single-horned Tiger Whale extended an invitation.
Roar roar!! Forget it, I’m not interested in these low-level Mutated Beasts. You guys eat by yourselves, come call me again when you find something good next time.
