As its size increased, the Sword Armor Flame Beast found that eating ordinary Level 1 and Level 2 Mutated Beasts could only maintain its daily consumption.
After eating those foods, most of the energy would be converted into physical movement and consumed, leaving only a little nutrition for body growth.
In this situation, Evolution values simply couldn’t accumulate.
To grow, it had to hunt high-level mutated organisms of similar levels to itself, as the flesh and blood of those Mutated Beasts contain more abundant Life Energy.
In the afternoon, on the thirty-third floor of School Building C.
On Jack Clark’s body, who was quietly reading the Mutated Beast Encyclopedia, a heavy breath flashed by. As the Sword Armor Flame Beast grew, his Four Major Attributes increased by three.
Suddenly, the mobile phone on the table lit up slightly, and someone @ed him.
3-9 Group.
Justin Welan: “Haha… Jack, we’ve reached the outer periphery of the Alien Beast Battlefield, take a look.”
As he spoke, Justin Welan sent up more than a dozen photos.
In the pictures, Justin Welan, Zac Lyons, and White Veil stood on the edge of the cliff, with the earth cracked behind them and a drop of thousands of meters.
Beneath the cliff, boundlessly sprawling forest stretched to the sky, and soaring mountains rose from the ground, with Cloud Mist surrounding the mountains.
The vast appearance was as if it didn’t belong to this world at all.
In the distance, some huge flying birds could be vaguely seen shuttling through the clouds, and there were buildings built by humans on the ground below, many of which had strange shapes and were full of sci-fi style.
Just looking at the photos, Crystal Leinster felt a primitive aura coming at her face, inexplicably a little shocked.
Justin Welan chuckled, “Jack, how about it, isn’t there a feeling of being shocked?”
“I heard that not only is it big, but it also contains countless resources and Mutated Beasts. Most of our second and third-grade students are stationed inside for a long time.”
Doris Raven said indifferently, “It’s a pity that Jack, you didn’t come with us. In such a high-pressure environment, your talent would adapt and progress faster.”
Jack shook his head somewhat speechlessly, “Are you people saying this just to make me envious?”
“Hehe, how could that be? We just want to share the new environment with you.” After saying that, Justin Welan even sent a wretched emoji.
Jack shook his head, “Don’t let your guard down, no matter when, opportunities always coexist with danger, otherwise so many Senior Students wouldn’t be eliminated every year.”
“Plus, at most I’ll be there a month after you guys, are you sure that your combat power will be able to surpass mine by then?”
…Jack’s words silenced the small group.
While they might be able to catch up with his realm at the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven, but that fighting power that could kill an enemy at a higher realm while being at mid-period Third Layer Heaven…
Doris Raven sent a ‘waving’ emoji, “Scatter, scatter, we can’t continue this topic.”
Justin Welan: “Jack, there is a separation between the inside and the outside world, and the information is interrupted. We won’t chat today. I’ll contact you again when I have time to get out from the entrance later.”
Jack smiled and put down his mobile phone.
January 22, the fifth day of the Lunar New Year.
“It’s only been a few days since the New Year, why is the school organizing activities again?”
At the entrance of the school, Jenny was a little worried.
“Mom, it’s fine.”
Jack smiled slightly, “This time, it’s just a small task for one or two weeks. We students will mainly assist the local armed department in cleaning up those ordinary Mutated Beasts.”
“Besides, for me now, ordinary Mutated Beasts are nothing dangerous, I can kill them with a single sword..”

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 129: Level 4 Crystal, Contribution Points Are Here_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 129: Level 4 Crystal, Contribution Points Are Here_3
Translator: 549690339
“At that time, the Mutated Beasts I kill will count as my income. A normal Level
1 Mutated Beast can be sold for 20,000 to 30,000, Level 2 for tens of thousands, and no need to mention Level 3.”
“Making money is making money, but you still need to be cautious.” Having experienced getting more than 300,000 last time, Doris Raven also knew that those Mutated Creatures were worth a lot of money.
“Mmm, I know.”
“Bro, what about my Mutated Beast Meat?” Glenn Clark blinked from the side.
Jack Clark smiled: “Don’t worry, I won’t forget.”
“Alright, Mom, Glenn, I’m leaving now.”
While most people were still enjoying the New Year holidays, many students in training attire, carrying large weapons, arrived at the express train station.
Seeing those weapons which were 2 to 3 meters long and weighing more than hundreds of kilograms, the ordinary people around were suddenly stirred and looked astonished.
As for those gazes, the students didn’t care but instead felt excited and proud, showing off their thick and long weapons on their backs.
After all, they used to be restricted by various school regulations before, despite cultivating True Martial Arts and becoming very strong, they had to appear the same as ordinary people in daily life.
It’s very uncomfortable to have power but not be able to show it off and constantly suppress it.
Among the excited students lining up for the train were Jack Clark and Freya Louise.
However, Jack Clark was not only carrying a combat knife but also holding a suitcase containing battle armor. The once broken battle armor had been repaired.
After the enchantment was gone, the repaired battle armor was only slightly stronger than ordinary armor, but it still had a strong Defense under the full coverage of Dragon Elephant True Strength.
Next to Jack Clark, Freya Louise was also carrying a 2-meter long box containing a disassembled sniper rifle. There were also two large suitcases at her side.
One contained battle armor, and the other contained ammunition.
These were things ordinary cultivators couldn’t get hold of, and they weren’t on the school’s exchange list either. They required special permissions, and only she could bring them in large and small boxes.
At this time, Jack Clark turned back and whispered, “Are you sure you want to split the contribution two to one?”
Freya Louise nodded slightly: “Mmm, otherwise, I’d be taking too much advantage of you.”
The two had agreed to team up for this cleaning mission, but when it came to the distribution of Contribution Points, Freya Louise had a different opinion. She felt that splitting it equally was taking advantage of Jack Clark.
Although with her firepower, she could kill a Level 4 Mutated Beast if she had the opportunity, and kill a Level 3 one with a single shot, the problem was that the mission was not just about killing.
According to the officials’ requirements, during this cleaning mission, students needed to bring back the corpses of Mutated Beasts after killing them.
As a result, the students who had run a dozen or even dozens of kilometers into the mountains could only complete one task a day since the Mutated Beasts were all huge creatures.
Especially those Level 3 Mutated Beasts, most of them had a starting weight of several tons.
Under such circumstances, only someone like Jack Clark, who had a terrifying basic strength, could carry several tons of Mutated Beasts and run like the wind, completing several tasks in a day.
That’s why Freya Louise suggested that she would take one-third of the contribution while Jack Clark took two-thirds. The more effort they put in, the more they got.
“The train has arrived, please carry your belongings and get on the train in order.”
“Special announcement: For the Martial Height students boarding this train, please be mindful of the weapons you carry and do not cause harm to public facilities and others.”
“Let’s go.”
Jack Clark’s eyes showed expectation as he followed the crowd into the carriage.
With his strength, maybe he could earn 300 Contribution Points in just three days..

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 130: Control Release, Carry the Mountain and Walk
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 130: Control Release, Carry the Mountain and Walk
Translator: 549690339
Unsure if the official was slowly loosening the control of information about True Martial, recently, there has been more and more content about cultivation online, and many topics were even quite sensitive.
This time, Jack Clark and others had to go by car and were allowed to carry weapons with them.
Of course, weapons were allowed, but the provision against attacking ordinary people was still in place.
Moreover, apart from South Sky Martial Height, this time students from another second-tier school in the same city and five third-tier schools also participated in this mission.
Together with students from other martial arts schools in different cities, they flocked to mission points in small towns, creating quite an impressive momentum.
This time, Jack Clark and Freya Louise chose Hundred Mountain Town as their mission point, which is over 50 kilometers away from Mist River and just outside the meandering Long Hundred Mountain Range.
An hour later, the spacious armed department mission hall in Hundred Mountain Town was full of students carrying weapons.
These students huddled in groups, all looking up at the big screen on the wall in front of them, their faces filled with tension, excitement, and anticipation.
Among them, there were about 20 people wearing dark red battle armor, mostly elite students who participated in the trial and returned.
A majority of them were from South Sky Martial Height, while the remaining six were from the neighboring South Mountain Second-tier Martial High.
As for the five third-level martial high schools, at that time none of them had broken through the Second Layer Heaven, including the least number of participants in this cleaning mission.
There were about 200 freshmen from South Sky Martial Height who chose Hundred Mountain Town, and together with students from nearby schools, there were probably just over 300 people.
Most of these students were in the mid or late period of the First Layer Heaven, with nearly 100 in the Second Layer Heaven, and only 11 like Jack Clark were in the Third Layer Heaven.
Among them, nine were from South Sky Martial Height, and the remaining two were from South Mountain Martial High.
Currently, there are more than 30 students in the first grade of South Sky Martial Height who have broken through into Third Layer Heaven, including some fresh students who made a breakthrough after consolidating their cultivation for a period of time after the trial.
Crystal Leinster, Jack Clark, and Howard Lee were among the 20 or so people who applied in advance to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield.eastern fantasy
Others were more cautious like Jack Clark, choosing to accumulate through this big cleaning mission to prepare for a stronger entry.
That serrated pig mission is good, a Level 1 Mutated Beast, with a main attack of collision and biting. The mountain forest where it is located is only 16 kilometers away from the town.
At that time, we can park the car at the foot of the mountain, and we only need to run 10 kilometers.
Zhang Fei, lets choose that Blue-eyed Fox mission. That Mutated Fox isnt big and its threat level is low, its just faster and more agile
Compared to the genius like Jack Clark who had experienced battlefield fights, these regular strength freshmen were much more cautious.
Even when facing Level 1 Mutated Beasts, they were prepared to form three or four-man teams, as they lacked defensive armor and combat experience.
Vera Lee and Sawyer Levin also formed a team, then walked over to Jack Clark, who was carrying a combat knife, in the middle of the hall, and asked expectantly.
Jack Clark, do you want to go together?
No.
Jack Clark shook his head slightly: Freya and I are aiming for the Level 3 Mutated Beasts deep in the mountains. You guys wont be able to keep up with my speed.
Considering his classmates, Jack Clark turned them down more tactfully.
Level 3 Mutated Beasts, admiration appeared in Vera Lees eyes, while Sawyer Levins gaze was somewhat complicated.
Only a semester had passed, and the classmate who once contended with him had reached Third Layer Heaven, and according to the Class Leader, even slayed a Fourth Layer Heaven beast.
While he struggled to catch up, he only reached the mid-Second Layer Heaven, and could only team up with Vera Lee to hunt ordinary Level 2 Mutated Beasts. The gap was too big.
At this time, Freya pointed to the middle of the big screen and whispered, Jack Clark, there are three Level 3 missions not far from each other. Shall we take them together?
On the big screen, a high-definition map of the hundreds of kilometers of the mountain range around Hundred Mountain Town was displayed. There were shimmering lights along the edge of the mountain range. These were the detected locations of the Mutated Beasts.
These lights were divided into three colors, each color representing a mission level, making them easier to distinguish.
For this clean-up, freshmen of First and Second Layer Heaven could only take one mission at a time, while those in Third Layer Heaven could take two.
This was to prevent people from maliciously occupying many close-by missions and slowing down the cleaning process.
Jack and his companion could take up to four missions at a time.
Among the three adjacent missions, one was to hunt two Level 3 Mutated Cloud-patterned Tigers that were entrenched on the edge of Long Hundred Mountain. Their hunting range spanned tens of kilometers and was very close to areas outside the mountain.
In order to prevent them from threatening passing vehicles and pedestrians outside the mountain, they were considered a priority target.
In this era, there was no animal protection law, and everything revolved around the needs of humans. Any mutated creatures that emerged beyond control were cleaned up immediately.
Accompanied by the roaring engine of their modified truck, Jack Clark and Freya quickly drove out of the small town and arrived at the nearest entry point into the mountains after more than an hour on the National Highway.
Lets park the car here, Jack Clark parked the vehicle by the roadside and placed a special duty card on it.
Click! Click!
Freya assembled the over-2-meter long coarse sniper rifle, then attached several magazines filled with armor-piercing and incendiary bullets to her waist.
When were near the target, 111 go ahead, and youll be careful and watch out for the surroundings when youre looking for a commanding position.
The girl nodded confidently, Dont worry, Im well-prepared this time. Look.
With that, she tapped her left wrist, and four soybean-sized points on a wristwatch-like device on the band flew out like insects, heading in four different directions with a whoosh..

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - 130: Control Release, Carry the Mountain and Walk_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 130: Control Release, Carry the Mountain and Walk_2
Translator: 549690339
The wrist device emitted a blue radiance, forming a 3D projection that showed a clear image of the area within a 100-meter radius.
This mini monitoring device is equipped with a high-definition probe and also has energy wave sensing and infrared sensing. Any mutated creatures within 100 meters will trigger an alarm.
Clearly, the attack on Erica Knowles last time left some lingering fear in the girls, making them more cautious about their surroundings.
For his part, Jack could only look on enviously and then nod: Its good to be prepared. Lets go.
From here, their target was more than 40 kilometers away in a straight line, and they would have to cross four mountain peaks. This was nothing more than a half-hour journey for the two of them.
Wearing full battle armor, Jack ignored the thorny shrubs in the mountain forest, climbing mountains and crossing rivers as before when hunting for golden-backed violent apes.
The girl following him was not to be outdone. With her True Strength in operation, she maintained a speed of several tens of meters per second without falling behind.
Meanwhile, as Jack and the others carried out their mission, many freshmen spread out from the small town. At the same time, armed unmanned helicopters took off from the town.
These helicopters would be scattered within a 200-kilometer radius, and rush to support if an emergency occurred anywhere.
The official side attached great importance to the trials of the new students. Each person was issued a smartwatch with a built-in map projection function to help them locate the specific spots of their tasks quickly.
In addition, if the students faced life-threatening situations they could not handle, they had the option to make an emergency call for help.
Compared to them, the treatment Jack and the others received going to Koroya felt like they were treated as stepchildren. They got nothing, and their beginners gift package only included a gun and nine bombs.
It was a bit ironic that their batch, who were the geniuses, got lesser protection during their trial than these ordinary cultivation students.
Was it because geniuses should experience more hardships?
It should be around here. On the wind howling hillside, Jack slightly lowered his head and tapped his covered wrist.
Immediately, a blue radiance shot out, forming a 20-centimeter-wide virtual projection on his wrist, showing the mountain range where Jack was.
In the projection, there was a yellow circle representing the activity range of the two Level 3 Mutant Beasts, and a white dot that represented Jack on the right side of the circle.
Mutant Beasts were not stationary creatures, and this was one of the dangers when hunting them.
When you thought you were the hunter, the Mutated Beast might be hiding behind you, ready to deliver a fatal blow. For example
Roar!
A deafening roar exploded, and a strong wind rose behind Jack. A huge white tiger, eight meters long, four meters tall at the shoulders, and over ten meters long with its tail, roared and charged out.
The huge tigers limbs were thicker than a load-bearing pillar, and the claws on its paws were tens of centimeters long, giving off an oppressive aura.
In the instant the white tiger pounced, the dirt underneath Jacks feet exploded, and he vanished from his spot, as if teleporting, appearing above the tigers head.
Roar!
With a barely audible elephant-like trumpet, the air exploded, and a fist covered in black real power and battle armor, accompanied by a circle of white shockwaves, violently slammed down.
Boom!
A circle of black and white shockwaves burst open on the tigers head, followed by a shrill scream.
Under Jacks punch, the tigers skin that could withstand ordinary sniper rifle bullets burst open, its skull collapsed, and blood mixed with white liquid spurted out.
The giant tigers body crashed to the ground with a bang and rolled a few times before stopping due to inertia.
Jacks expression remained calm after killing a Level 3 Mutant Beast with a single punch, showing no signs of agitation.eastern fantasy
For him now, ordinary Level 3 Mutant Beasts did not even require him to draw his weapon. He could just kill them with a punch using his Unrivaled Domineering Power.
Roar, roar!!
Hundreds of meters away, a tiger-shaped Mutated Beast, larger by a whole size, let out a shrill roar, its blood-red eyes fixed on Jack, filled with murderous rage.
Just as Jack thought this mutated white tiger would pounce on him for revenge, it turned around to flee into the deep forest.
Apparently, having witnessed Jack killing its companion with a single punch, this slightly intelligent Mutated Beast knew it was no match for him and chose to retreat instead.
But just then, the white tigers head that had just turned around burst open with a bang, and a basin-sized bloody hole was blown through it.
Its enormous body fell to the ground with a thud.
On the hillside a kilometer away, Freya Louise stood up with her sniper rifle, its barrel still emitting a faint wisp of smoke.
Seeing this, Jack smiled and gave her a thumbs up for a job well done.
Soon, Jack dragged the corpses of the two mutated tigers out of the mountain forest and stacked them up.
Looking at the girl who swooped down, Jack pointed in another direction: You go deal with that White-feathered Golden Eagle, and 111 deal with that Horned Lizard.
Carrying a long rifle, Freya nodded: No problem, well meet back here.
Since this area was the territory of the mutated white tigers, although they had been killed, the scent they left behind would still deter other Mutated Beasts from invading, at least for a short while.
So Jack and Freya split up, darting into the mountain forests on either side, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Tweet!
Deep in the mountain range, more than 60 kilometers away, a nine-meter Golden Eagle with mutated wings soared at a high altitude. Every time it flapped its wings, a raging wind was stirred up.
This was a White-feathered Golden Eagle that had just broken through to Level 3. As a bird of prey, it faced greater danger from the outside world.
After it was spotted some time ago, it was immediately put on the hunting list. Fortunately, Freyas weapon was somewhat effective against it.
Whoosh! Suddenly, the Golden Eagles wings folded, and it dived down like a fighter jet at a terrifyingly fast speed that left afterimages in its wake..

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 130: Control Release, Carry the Mountain and Walk_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 130: Control Release, Carry the Mountain and Walk_3
Translator: 549690339
Boom! On the branch of a tree, a three-meter tall White Ape didnt have time to react before its head and half of its body were crushed by the Golden Eagles talons. With a flap of its wings, the Golden Eagle then soared towards the sky
Bang! The scorching explosion penetrated the chest of the Golden Eagle, which had just risen a hundred meters. Unwillingly letting out a piercing scream, its gigantic body tumbled downwards, engulfed in roaring flames and billowing black smoke.
On a mountainside, 1500 meters away, Freya Louise half-squatted on the ground, ejecting an incendiary bullets shell with a click. She took her sniper rifle and climbed down the rugged mountain wall.
Soon she arrived in the forest below, where she found the mutated Golden Eagle with two huge holes in its chest and most of its feathers burnt off.
The corpse of the White Ape was still clutched in its talons.
To avoid the Golden Eagle fleeing too far away after being pierced through the chest and not dying immediately, she had chosen a double shot this time: one to pierce the armor and another incendiary bullet.
Fortunately, birds are relatively lightweight. The nine-meter wingspan and four-meter body length of the Golden Eagle only weighed about a ton. If Freya Louise had to, she could still manage to drag it, after True Strength burst out of her.
An hour and a half later, Freya Louise, panting, emerged from the forest and returned to where theyd split up.
There, Jack Clark was sitting atop a nine-meter-long, one-horned Giant Lizards corpse, which resembled a dinosaur from ancient times, waiting for her.
Seeing Freya Louise approaching while dragging the gigantic Golden Eagles corpse, Jack Clark grinned and asked, How was your trip? Did you run into any accidents?
Not bad. The Golden Eagles territory is close to the White Tigers. Theyve killed almost all the mutated creatures around them.
As Freya Louise spoke, she looked at the three massive mutant beast corpses in front of her and felt the pressure.
For them, hunting the Level 3 Mutant Beasts was easy, but carrying the valuable mutant beast corpses back would be a bit of a hassle.
Freya Louise, in particular, had already been exhausted from dragging the lightest bird-type mutant beast for twenty kilometers.
Knowing what she was thinking, Jack Clark got up with a laugh. Lets go. Ill take care of these mutated beasts. Good start today.
Killing four third-level mutant beasts so easily and gaining more than seventy contribution points made even Jack Clark excited.
It was still early, so he planned to hurry back quickly and take on another mission to earn more points.
With that, Jack Clark laid out several arm-thick vines hed prepared. He placed the two seven-ton tiger corpses next to one another, followed by the three-ton one-horned lizard and the one-ton Golden Eagle.
The pile of four mutated beast corpses was more than five meters high. Jack Clark wrapped the sturdy vines around the stack over ten times, turning it into a neatly packed cargo.eastern fantasy
Jack Clark took a deep breath, grabbed the cargo with both arms, and unleashed his True Strength.
Heave!
At Jack Clarks cry, the eighteen-ton cargo was suddenly lifted up and slammed onto his shoulder. He began to run heavily, each step leaving a deep footprint and rumbling like a small moving hill.
From a high-altitude perspective, it was like an ant carrying something ten times its size on the ground, a combination of comical and awe-inspiring.
As for Freya Louise, she was stunned as she watched the small hill charge into the forest.
She knew Jack Clarks basic strength was formidable, but she had never imagined it to be so exaggerated that he could slay these mutated beasts so easily.
She had thought Jack Clark would only be able to carry one beast at a time after killing them.
In that case, he could quickly make three trips back and forth, and together with her dragging the Golden Eagle, they would be able to carry all these mutated beast corpses out of the mountain within half a day.
But she never expected Jack Clarks basic strength to be so great. It was not just the Triple and Quadruple Heaven that could reach these limits; even the Fourth Layer limit arm strength was only four thousand kilograms.
No wonder his combat prowess was so exaggerated Stunned, Freya Louise quickly chased after him..

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 131: Astonishing Harvest, Flame Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 131: Astonishing Harvest, Flame Demon
Translator: 549690339
It took the two of them only half an hour to enter the mountain, but it took Jack Clark almost two hours to carry the 17-ton Mutated Beast out of the mountain.
There was no other choice; the Mutated Beasts were too large, and there were many places in the mountain where they couldnt run. They were either stuck by trees or dragged by other objects.
Every time this happened, Jack Clark would use his True Strength to break through and create a path.eastern fantasy
Thus, even he was somewhat panting when they finally made it down the mountain.
With a loud bang, Jack Clark threw the packaged Mutated Beast corpses onto the truck, causing the tires to sink, and half of the bodies of the Giant Lizards and tigers were hanging outside.
With its 8-meter long body, this extended medium-sized truck struggled to carry the Mutated Beasts, becoming completely overloaded. However, Jack Clark no longer cared about this.
Jack Clark let out a breath, and looked at the approaching Freya Louise with a pleasant expression: Lets go, get in the car.
Not bothering to wipe the blood off his body, Jack Clark sat in the drivers seat.
After Freya Louise had also taken her place in the passenger seat, the truck trembled as it started up, struggling to carry the several gigantic Mutated Beast corpses towards the small town.
Wow, Mom, thats a massive tiger!
Damn, who is that tough guy? It only took half a day to kill four Mutated Beasts, Mutated Tigers, Giant Lizards, all of which should be Level 3. The freshmen these days are really amazing.
Yeah, I remember during last years big hunting mission, it was really hard for the armed department guys in town to kill a single Level 3 Mutant Beast. As a small town at the foot of Long Hundred Mountain, the residents here often saw Mutated Beasts, and some retired soldiers with cultivation lived here, leading to a strong folk spirit.
Many online images and videos of Mutated Beasts were taken by these people when they went into the mountains, and some even made a living from it.
Not only shooting videos, they also helped with capturing ordinary Mutated Creatures to be raised as high-end pets and sold, forming an alternative business line.
However, at this time, not only Jack Clark and Freya Louise, but also other students who had completed their missions were returning.
The thing was, the Mutated Beast corpses in their cars were somewhat small, almost all of them Level 1, with only a few of them Level 2.
An embarrassed logistics staff in the armed department said to an ordinary student: Excuse me, could you help move the Mutated Beast corpses off the car?
No problem.
Jack Clark stood by the car, grabbed the bundled Mutated Beast corpses with both hands, and the bulging muscles of his arms exerted force. With a loud bang, he threw them to the ground.
The intertwined vines that held the corpses shattered, and the four Mutated Beast corpses scattered, occupying half a room.
This scene made the staff member envious.
Unfortunately, his talent was not enough back then, and he couldnt establish his Foundation after two months of cultivation.
Two designated Level 3 Mutated Beasts, Cloud-patterned Tigers, one designated Unique Beast One-horned Lizard, and Golden Eagle, a total of 72 contribution points, have been transferred to your Student ID.
Thank you, Jack Clark said with a smile.
At this rate, he might be able to accumulate 300 points in three days.
Of course, this had a lot to do with his strength being much higher than others; it was almost an instant kill. Even Freya Louise could kill these Level 3 Mutated Beasts with one hit.
After all, her weapon was too overpowered, and although she had a weak close combat ability, you had to be able to approach her and discover her to play a role in the first place.
Another advantage was that the official mission provided precise coordinates, saving them a lot of time.
If Jack Clark could only kill and not have to carry the bodies, he could complete more than a dozen Level 3 Missions a day, accumulating hundreds of contribution points.
But this was impossible because the purpose of the officials was to train these freshmen.
Jack checked the time, and it was only 1 p.m. He turned to Freya Louise, who was waiting by his side: Lets eat first, then continue.
Mm.
Considering the limited number of Level 3 Mutated Beasts in these deep mountain old forests, especially those discovered for missions, it was a case of first come, first served, as there were also other Triplex cultivators besides them.
The girl nodded: In the afternoon, when choosing a mission, lets see if there are any Mutated Beast Horde missions. Level 2 should also be acceptable. Youre right. 1 almost forgot about that. Jacks eyes lit up; killing a group of Level 2 Mutated Beasts was more profitable than killing a single Level 3 Mutated Beast.
However, when Jack, dressed in Dark Red Armor, carrying a combat knife, and covered in blood, and Freya Louise walked into the cafeteria, some of the students who had not taken a mission were taken aback.
Many freshmen with weaker courage could hardly breathe under the invisible, heavy Killing Intent.
So scary! Who is he?
Seems to be Jack Clark from South Sky Martial Height.
You mean the one who practiced low-level martial arts and made it to the Top 50 in the ranking competition at South Sky Martial Height?
Yes, thats him. I heard that he also participated in the Koroya Trial earlier, breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven and killing a Fourth Layer Heaven Evil God Sect Cultist.
Hes amazing!
Amidst the surrounding discussions, Jack and Freya Louise took their food and found an empty spot to sit down. He then asked quizzically, Its strange, why do the freshmen from Tier 3 martial arts high schools seem so weak?
Freya Louise whispered, Its normal, because theyve been semi-abandoned from the start.
What do you mean? Jack asked hesitantly.
I can tell you, but you mustnt let others know.
Freya Louise glanced around, then whispered softly so only the two of them could hear, My aunt told me that all new students have been filtered once before entering high school.
Through the annual physical examination, the micronutrients contained in
blood can be used to determine with a 30% probability whether a person has cultivation talent or not..

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 131: Astonishing Harvest, Flame Demon 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 131: Astonishing Harvest, Flame Demon 2
Translator: 549690339
“In this case, people with higher overall qualifications will enter the first-class universities, followed by the rest. Even though it seems that everyone enters school uniformly.”
“Of course, because the probability is low, the officials will allocate a lot of ordinary students to various schools, but there will be fewer in first-class universities.”
“No wonder,” Jack Clark nodded thoughtfully.
At the beginning, when he was picked up by Koroya, he felt that there was a big gap in the number of geniuses between first and second-rate universities. He didn’t expect that they had already gone through a screening process.
In the afternoon, Jack Clark and Freya Louise took two more Level 3 missions, one for a 14-meter-long Mutant Rock Python and one for a 10-meter-long Giant Jungle Crocodile.
The Mutant Rock Python’s head was blown off by Freya, while the lurking Giant Jungle Crocodile, who was planning a sneak attack, was chopped in half by Jack Clark with a single blow.
Both missions took them deep into the mountains for tens of kilometers, and by the time they returned with the Mutated Beast corpses in their car, it was already past 8 o’clock in the evening.
“Classmate, your 36 contribution points have been transferred to your student
ID.”
“Thank you.”
Jack Clark and Freya, both carrying their combat knives, walked out of the Logistics Department with their helmets in hand. They looked at each other and couldn’t help but smile.
Today, they killed six Level 3 Mutant Beasts, earning a total of 108 points. Jack Clark alone got 72, while Freya got 36, earning more than Jack’s previous hunt of the golden-backed violent ape.
Glancing at the slowly darkening sky, they didn’t take any more missions.
At night, in the personal dormitory behind the Armed Department, Jack Clark, who had eaten dinner and taken a bath, stood on the balcony in deep thought.
Today, on his first day, he earned 72 points of contribution, plus 30 points from Erica Knowles’ killing of the late Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy, and 40 points from the Blood Crystal he exchanged with the school.
At present, he has accumulated a total of 142 contribution points.
However, Jack knew that this situation was only for today.
Because the number of Level 3 Mutant Beasts within a mountain range is limited.
This afternoon when he took on missions, he noticed that the number of Level 3 missions on the map had decreased by more than half. It was clear that those Third Layer Heaven students were no slouch either.
Assuming one kills one, and adding those killed by Jack and his party, more than a dozen Level 3 Mutant Beasts were eliminated today.
Thinking of this, Jack felt fortunate that those who had broken through the Third Layer Heaven, especially Jane Aiken and other geniuses, had already applied to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Otherwise, if they had come to share as well, the Level 3 Mutant Beasts might have been wiped out in just one day, and he might have been lucky to get two or three of them.
With this thought, Jack couldn’t help but smile at the idea that Justin Welan and the others leaving early seemed to be a good thing.
But suddenly, Jack’s eyes narrowed.
Under the night sky, amidst the turbulent waves and scattered reefs, two massive Mutant Beasts were confronting each other in the sea.
One was a nearly 16-meter-long Sword Armor Flame Beast, with black and red colors swirling all over its body, while the other was a 26-meter-long creature resembling both a crocodile and a whale.
It looked like a crocodile because of its long, narrow mouth filled with sharp teeth, which when opened wide could tear apart a bus in one bite.
However, its body was thick and heavy like a whale, covered with scales, and had two pairs of strong fins on its belly and a slender tail that exuded a tyrannical aura.
Most importantly, this Mutant Crocodile Whale had a powerful energy fluctuation on its body – it was very strong.
However, this time it was not the Sword Armor Flame Beast that picked a fight, but rather the massive sea dragon Mutant Beast that targeted the Sword Armor Flame Beast as its prey.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast had already encountered such situations many times, but in each case, it turned the attackers into its food.
Gurgle! Gurgle!
The Mutant Crocodile Whale spat out bubbles as it slowly circled the Sword Armor Flame Beast with its fins, trying to create a sense of pressure to make its prey panic.
But… Boom!
Water splashed all over the sea, as the Sword Armor Flame Beast disappeared instantly, as if teleporting, and crashed into the Mutant Crocodile Whale tens of meters away in an instant.
It was only at this moment that a terrifying impact wave appeared and tore through the sea surface, forming a huge wave that exploded.
As the Sword Armor Flame Beast grew larger, the power of its three great talents became more and more terrifying.
The sudden burst of the Sword Armor Flame Beast left the Mutant Crocodile Whale with no time to react, feeling only a terrible impact on the side of its body as its massive form was sent flying for a hundred meters with a thunderous crash.
Sea water raged where it passed, carrying rolling waves, and an even more miserable scream emerged from its mouth.Under the fierce attack of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, not only was it knocked away, half of its body’s flesh and blood was blasted open, revealing the large, stark white bones underneath.
There were eight wounds that were more than three meters long and one meter deep, with traces of charring on the edges.
This was because its scales were hard, its flesh was tough, and the energy that covered its entire body resisted most of the power of the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s attack.
Otherwise, that attack just now would have been enough to blast its abdomen open.
Roar!
A hundred meters away, the Mutated Crocodile Whale, with half of its body bleeding, was spurred by its ferocity and stared intently at the faint figure in the darkness not far away.
A strong blue energy erupted from its body, causing the blood in its wounds to stagnate and quickly recover flesh at a visible speed.
At the same time, its muscles swelled all over its body, increasing by a third in the blink of an eye, and a heavy, terrifying aura of power spread out.
The terrifying aura of power caused the surrounding seawater to faintly solidify, with the seawater within tens of meters calm and waveless, which was quite frightening.
This was a Mutated Beast that primarily evolved in terms of its physical strength and regenerative abilities, which was quite rare in the sea.
However, the Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t mind this, as its pale golden vertical pupils remained cold and emotionless.
Competing with it in terms of physical strength? Seeking death.
Roar! The ferocious Unique Beast with black and red intertwining ripped through the seawater and roared out, while the Mutated Crocodile Whale also let out a violent roar and boldly stepped forward.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
The surrounding sea surface exploded as the two Marine Giant Beasts fought, with each collided explosion of power causing seawater to rise tens of meters high, creating a terrifying momentum.
Each time the massive fins of the crocodile whale slashed, they would unleash thousands of tons of impact force, and each collision with its strong body would shatter the surrounding reefs, creating huge waves.
Many small fishes that failed to evade in time were directly killed in their battle, and within a moment, the sea surface was littered with the corpses of various marine creatures.
In this battle, the Sword Armor Flame Beast fought quite excitedly, with its muscles swelling all over its body, pushing up its black scale armor, and going head-to-head with the large-bodied Mutant Crocodile Whale.
Boom!
On the sea surface, the Mutated Crocodile Whale’s sturdy tail, which was ten meters long, swept horizontally, rolling up violent waves. The Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t dodge in the slightest, reaching out with its sturdy claws.
Boom!
The terrifying force of the attack made the Sword Armor Flame Beast tremble involuntarily, its powerful hind legs standing dead on the reef rocks below the water surface, exploding with terrifying power from within its body.
Roar! Accompanying the roar of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, it stood on its hind legs on the reef, its claws swelling, directly lifting the mutated crocodile whale by its tail.
Boom! A giant beast twenty meters long burst from the sea surface, only to be slammed down heavily, with countless Seawater explode under the violent force, and a torrential rain falling.
Underneath the sea surface, the hard reef rocks were shattered by the mutated crocodile whale, and the terrifying counter-shock force broke its whole body’s scales and sent its flesh flying.
This was the difference between having wisdom and not having it.
The mutated crocodile whale only knew to rely on its powerful body for combat, not knowing how to use the surrounding environment, and was directly smashed by the Sword Armor Flame Beast, causing its consciousness to be muddled.
Above the sea surface, as the mutated crocodile whale was momentarily stupefied by the blow, the black Unique Beast stood on the reef behind it, standing upright with its body in flames.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s terrifying power flowed into its claws, its sturdy arms ablaze, and under the influence of its substantial power, it formed a circle of fiery snakes coiling around it.
Boom!
Accompanied by the enraged Dragon Elephant’s hundred-fold power landing, the thick scales on the mutated crocodile whale’s head shattered, its skull collapsed, and half of its head exploded.
In an instant, countless blood and water mixed with liquid splattered everywhere, dyeing the surrounding sea surface a dark red.
On the blood-red sea surface, there stood a ferocious Unique Beast wrapped in black scales, with a row of sharp spikes on its back and flames burning on its body, like a demon.
Especially the three pairs of red feather horns on either side of its head, with golden red flames burning on them, forming a circle of fire and making the Sword Armor Flame Beast look even more terrifying.
The battle was over, and now it was time to eat.
This mutated crocodile whale was massive, several times larger than the double-headed giant python, and even though the Sword Armor Flame Beast ate and digested it in intervals, it still took a long time.
By the time the sky began to lighten, there was one more giant, broken animal skeleton among the coral reefs below the sea.
By the side of the skeleton, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had harvested dozens of evolution points and grown by several tens of centimeters in length, swam and disappeared into the sea in the blink of an eye.
Many of the bones of this mutated beast were more than a meter thick, as hard as iron, and had little nutrition, so the Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t bother to waste its teeth on them..

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 132: Three Hundred Contributions, Fame Spreads Far and Wide
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 132: Three Hundred Contributions, Fame Spreads Far and Wide
Translator: 549690339
“At 7 am, Freya Louise, wearing her battle armor, knocked on Jack Clark’s door. Jack, who had been ‘fighting’ until late last night, opened the door still feeling a bit sleepy. He rubbed his eyes and greeted, “Morning, Freya.”
The girl urged, “Hurry up and get dressed. Let’s see if we can take on another mission today.” As she spoke, she handed the battle armor she was holding to Jack.
After returning last night, she had taken the armor to be cleaned and dried.
Moreover, Freya knew that Jack was waiting to exchange Contribution Points for Advanced Skills, so she wanted to get to the mission hall early. Otherwise, there might not be any Level 3 missions left.
“Hold on a second.”
Soon Jack put on his battle armor, picked up his combat knife, and went with Freya to the mission hall.
When the two entered the mission hall, they noticed some changes to their classmates.
After experiencing yesterday’s battle with Mutated Beasts, the students who saw blood became a bit more resolute in their expressions, and there was an air of solemnity surrounding them.
Of course, not everyone completed their missions.
Some freshmen, facing the hideous Mutated Beasts for the first time, not only performed poorly in battle, but almost lost their lives. Many people were injured.
They were not like Jack, who has the combat power far beyond his realm.
Below the Fourth Layer Heaven, lower-level cultivators actually have no advantage when facing Mutated Beasts. On the contrary, they are at a disadvantage because of their size, strength, and defense.
At this time, Jack saw Vera Lee and Sawyer Levin not far away and walked over.
“How’s it going? Everything went well yesterday, right?”
The slightly chubby girl excitedly said, “Thank you, Jack. If it wasn’t for you reminding us to lure the Mutated Beast into the open, we might not have been able to kill it.”
“That Furious Ape was too agile and powerful. If it stayed in the trees, it would’ve been difficult.”
Sawyer Levin also sincerely thanked, “Jack, thank you.”
Jack smiled slightly, “It’s nothing, we’re all classmates. And I’ve dealt with ape-type Mutated Beasts before, so I know their strengths and weaknesses.” At this time, Freya also smiled faintly, “Now that you’ve gone through a real battle, you’ll be much calmer in the future. But be careful when choosing missions.”
Vera Lee gratefully nodded, “Yes, we will be cautious.”
As they spoke, the four looked at the missions displayed on the big screen for today.
Over the years, the authorities have set up hidden monitoring points in every deep mountain old forest, keeping an eye out for Mutated Beasts around.
They distinguish their levels based on their size and the energy waves they emit.
For some uncertain cases or when large Mutated Creatures are found, they would mobilize high-definition satellites to assist in determining whether to kill them in advance.
Apart from that, civilians around the small town might also report clues, which ultimately became these missions.
These tasks were mostly Level 1, spread across the edge of the mountain ranges. Level 2 was next, but Level 3 missions were much rarer and mostly found deep in the old forests of deep mountains.
These Mutated Creatures were not foolish. After years of being hunted, they knew that the ‘humans’ from the city were terrifying. The more powerful they were, the further away from the city they stayed.
However, there were only five Level 3 missions refreshed this morning. Seeing this, Jack and Freya exchanged glances, then separately took the three closest missions.
Although they were the closest, the furthest two were still more than 70 kilometers from each other. The other two missions were taken by Third Layer Heaven students.
Soon, Jack and Freya swiftly completed procedures and drove away.
At a river in the mountain range tens of kilometers away, the surrounding rainforest was dense and the terrain relatively flat.
A Mutant Panther about 3 meters tall and 7 meters long, covered in black scales, hid behind the trees, watching down below.
On the river beach below, a 6-meter-long ordinary Mutant Alligator, also covered in scale armor, was basking in the sun.
Suddenly, the Mutant Panther moved, instantly becoming a blur as it leaped tens of meters, appearing lightly beside the alligator.
Crack! The alligator barely reacted when it was bitten at the back of its head by the panther, its spine directly snapped by the terrifying force, killed instantly.
After evolving, this scale-armored Mutant Panther was even more frightening in terms of speed.
However, just as it was about to take the alligator up a tree to enjoy it slowly, a figure wearing dark red armor blocked its way.
Seeing Jack, who had appeared out of nowhere, the Mutant Panther’s eyes flashed with caution, and its muscles tensed.
On this black and red figure, the Mutant Panther felt a terrifying, malicious aura surrounding it, extremely frightening.
It was as if it wasn’t a ‘human’ in front of it, but a far more terrifying beast.
Boom! The alligator’s corpse in the panther’s mouth fell to the ground. Then, a powerful aura burst from the panther, enveloped in black light…
Whoosh!
Without launching an attack, the Level 3 Mutated Beast instantly turned into a black afterimage, disappearing on the spot and entering the mountain forest in the blink of an eye.
This result left Jack slightly stunned, as did Freya on the hillside, who was setting up her sniper rifle to shoot.
Boom! Stones exploded on the river beach with a piercing noise. Jack’s figure shot out like an arrow with a long white wave trailing behind him.
Compared to the talent that could eliminate air resistance of the scale-armored Mutant Panther, Jack’s momentum was far more astonishing.
In just a moment, Jack emerged from the woods, dragging the two-ton corpse of the Black Mutant Panther. He was surrounded by a murderous aura, exuding a heavy oppressive sensation..”

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 132: Three Hundred Contributions,
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 132: Three Hundred Contributions,
Fame Spreads Far and Wide_2
Translator: 549690339
“Jack Clark, you caught up with it and killed it so quickly!” Freya Louise was somewhat surprised.
This Mutated Beast was known for its speed, having an instantaneous burst of almost 150 meters per second. Moreover, it was quite familiar with the surrounding jungle.
If it were only Freya, she would have to give up on the chase, as this stealthy, agile creature was too difficult for her to handle.
“It’s fine. This Mutated Beast had a fast short-distance burst, but couldn’t maintain it for long. It only ran a few kilometers before I caught up and killed it with one strike.”
“Let’s go, our next target is the mountain giant bear.” The tasks they received were all in a straight line, but they would have to travel around a hundred kilometers along the mountain range.
One of the beasts was extremely cautious and remained submerged in a deep pool throughout the year. It was a Mutated Blue Bull, and they would need Freya’s help to lure it out.
“The Level 3 Mutant Beast missions are gone!?”
At a little past three in the afternoon, Jack Clark and Freya Louise, who had completed their tasks, stood in front of the counter, looking somewhat speechless at the flashing map on the big screen.
“Yes, that’s right, students.” The polite female staff member behind the counter replied.
“Currently, the Long White Mountain range, bordering this area, stretches for over two hundred kilometers, with a depth of one hundred kilometers. There are only twenty-one Level 3 Mutant Beasts within this range with confirmed traces.”
“In the span of these two days, you’ve killed nine of them, while the twelve other Level 3 Mutants have been slain by other students. Now they have all been cleared out.”
“However, these are only the Level 3 Mutant Beasts detected around the mountain range. There are still some Mutant Beasts deep in the mountains that have not been discovered yet.”
“We’ll have to wait for the reconnaissance team to venture deeper into the mountains with their equipment, then they’ll provide feedback and generate missions based on that.”
“If you don’t want to wait, you can also venture deep into the mountains yourselves. For these undiscovered Level 3 Mutant Beasts, the Logistics Department will pay you 20 contribution points as a reward.”
The vast Long White Mountain range stretches for thousands of kilometers, with the widest parts being three to four hundred kilometers wide. With countless mountain peaks and valleys throughout, even officials cannot monitor every area.
Right after the staff finished speaking, Carney Lee, not far away, said with some disbelief, “Jack Clark, aren’t you guys a bit too overpowered? You killed ten Level 3 Mutant Beasts in less than two days.”
“I was wondering why there were so many Level 3 missions yesterday, but they were gone this morning. I can’t believe you killed them all.”
Carney Lee was also a Third Layer Heaven student of the South Sky Martial Height. He had met Jack Clark back when they had traveled to Koroya at the Kaleb Tuul City.
Carney had some bad luck today, having just missed out on a Level 3 mission, and thus had just come back from completing a Level 2 one.
Jack Clark smiled, “Well, what can 1 do about it? It’s not my fault that you guys are slow. I only killed half of them, anyway.”
As if there’s any difference. Carney Lee was speechless.
As they chatted, Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the Level 2 missions.
He had his fill of mindlessly searching for Level 3 Mutant Beasts in the depths of the mountains.
Not only would it take a lot of time and effort to find them, but carrying the Mutated Beasts back would be very troublesome. It might take three or four days just to kill one Mutant Beast.
Under these circumstances, it was naturally more cost-effective to choose the surrounding Level 2 Mutant Beasts with confirmed locations. They would wait for Level 3 missions to be refreshed before taking them on again.
Fortunately, there were still quite a few Level 2 missions available since the other students weren’t very efficient in completing them.
Jack Clark’s eyes lit up when he saw a freshly-refreshed Mutated Beast Horde mission.
A forest of wild peach trees, each standing ten to twenty meters tall, was home to a group of gray monkeys with massive split claws, ranging in height from two to four meters.
In the bright afternoon sunlight, some of these clawed gray monkeys sat basking in the sun, while others played and frolicked amongst the branches.
As a Mutated Beast Horde, their numbers allowed them to dominate this part of the forest, with all fruits and ordinary creatures included in their diet.
Even other Mutated Creatures knew about this group of Mutated Gray Monkeys and didn’t dare invade their territories.
But today… BANG, BANG, BANG, BANG’.!
Amidst the air burst, two Level 2 Gray Monkeys and five Level 1 Gray Monkeys had their heads and chests blasted open with huge bloody holes, instantly killing them.
CHIRP, CHIRP, CHIRP, CHIRP!!
The sudden turn of events threw the monkey horde into chaos, with the remaining few screaming in terror as they dashed into the peach forest. BOOM! The howling gale accompanied Jack Clark as he charged into the peach forest, with a loud explosion of air. Wearing battle boots, Jack Clark stepped on the sturdy trunk of a tree, causing its bark to crack.
The recoil sent Jack Clark leaping high into the air, more than ten meters, before he swung his long knife down. The blade momentarily brushed the neck of a gray monkey attempting to elude him amongst the branches.
Jack Clark then plunged down like a cannonball.
THUD! The dirt beneath Jack Clark’s feet exploded.
At that moment, he spun around and slashed with his long knife, its black edge slicing through the approaching gray monkey, which stood over three meters tall, with blood red eyes.
Jack Clark then lunged forward, aiming to take down the last gray monkey perched high up on a tree.
With one overbearing punch, the gray monkey’s arms shattered, its chest caved in, and it flew back in a burst, breaking the peach tree behind it.
Under Jack Clark’s relentless pursuit, the trio of clawed gray monkeys that had fled into the forest were wiped out in the blink of an eye.
But when the bloodstained Jack Clark, wearing battle armor, carried the corpses of the three Mutated Beasts out and laid them down in the open space, both Freya Louise and he hesitated for a brief moment.
Freya hesitated: “Tie them up?”
Jack hesitated as well, “…No need, just tie their tails together and drag them along.”
“Alright…”
A thirty-meter long “train” of Mutated Beast corpses soon appeared in the mountain forest, with every creature in their path retreating in horror.
In the evening, when a truck loaded with gray monkey corpses returned to the small town, many students who had already arrived back were shocked..

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 132: Three Hundred Contributions, Fame Spreads Far and Wide_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 132: Three Hundred Contributions, Fame Spreads Far and Wide_3
Translator: 549690339
“The group of Crack Claw Grey Monkeys was defeated so quickly, they’re too strong.”
After this group of Mutated Beasts was discovered, they were considered somewhat troublesome. Even teams of Second Layer Heaven students did not dare to take them on, and even single Third Layer Heaven students found it a bit dangerous.
Unexpectedly, the task was completed in less than half a day.
Today, a total of three Level 3, three Level 2, and seven Level 1 were killed, for a total of 86 points, which was a bit less than yesterday’s.
As a result, Jack Clark received 57 points, bringing his total to 199. The rapid growth of his Contribution Points excited him.
But while Jack was fighting, the other classmates were not idle.
After all, there were hundreds of Second Layer Heaven students alone in Hundred Mountain Town, along with later-stage First Layer Heaven students. The missions in Hundred Mountain Town were being completed at an alarming rate.
As a result, Jack’s income plummeted in the following days.
Even though he and Freya Louise didn’t team up in these few days and competed fiercely for Level 1 tasks, it still took them almost five days to gather the remaining 100 Contribution Points.
In just one week, nearly all Level 1 Mutated Creatures in the outskirts of the mountain range were eradicated.
At dusk, after dinner, Jack returned to his dormitory and stood on the balcony, playing with a Level 2 Life Crystal he had obtained today.
“When 1 go back tomorrow, should I change my location?”
He currently had 302 Contribution Points, enough to exchange for the Advanced Skill Dragon Elephant Overlord Body. Therefore, Jack planned to return to school tomorrow to switch to that Advanced Skill.
At the same time, he was considering whether to change to another mission town.
He had killed nearly half of the known Mutant Beasts in this mountain range, including most of the Level 3 Mutant Beasts.
However, such overwhelming power was not interesting. After killing a few more, it became somewhat dull.
If it weren’t for the Contribution Points, he would have gone deeper into the mountain ranges to find more powerful Mutated Beasts to fight.
No wonder Crystal Leinster and the others were not very interested in this cleaning mission. Compared to these low-level exotic beasts, the powerful Mutated Beasts were more challenging.
But changing to another small town might not make much difference either.
He didn’t know who leaked his progress to the school’s group chat, saying he had wiped out half of the Level 3 Mutant Beasts in Hundred Mountain Town in just two days. This made other students very nervous.
Particularly those Third Layer Heaven students, who immediately took on missions and killed the remaining few Level 3 Mutant Beasts.
In addition to that, they actively took on missions in the following days, with many even forming teams to continuously kill the remaining Level 2 Mutant Beasts.
It was as if they were afraid he would go there to snatch them.
Of course, if it weren’t for Freya telling him about this the second day, Jack would have indeed planned to go there and snatch a few Level 3 Mutant Beasts on the third day of the mission.
“These guys, is it really worth it.”
At the thought of this, Jack shook his head, and the thought in his mind echoed: “Transform Attributes.”
“You transformed a high-purity solid Life Energy, obtaining 13 Attribute Points.”
“This time, I actually got 13 points.” Jack paused for a moment.
During this time, not only he but other students who had killed Mutated Beasts had also obtained some Level 1 Life Crystals and used them upon their return.
Compared to Levels 3 and 4, these Level 1 Life Crystals had a much higher output rate.
Looking at the 25 attribute points on his attribute page, Jack looked up at the night sky and whispered with anticipation, “Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.”
He had been looking forward to this advanced technique, which even Lori Parma and Sylvia Lyons praised, for a long time. For this, he had worked hard for so many days to finally accumulate 300 Contribution Points.
Actually, more than half a month ago, Lori Parma had subtly mentioned to Jack that he could help arrange for the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body based on his performance in Koroya, without needing Contribution Points.
However, this might result in more losses, seemingly related to some paperwork he had submitted.
Faced with this choice, Jack ultimately decided to accumulate Contribution Points himself.
After all, there would be a major cleaning mission after the new year. For someone with a combat power far beyond the Third Layer Heaven, these low-level Mutated Beasts were simply Contribution Points delivered to his door.
It was more like he was here to pick up Contribution Points rather than participate in the mission, so there was no need to give up a watermelon for a sesame seed.
“I wonder what Mr. Perry and the others are up to, being so secretive,” Jack shook his head..

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 133: Deep Sea Giant Chapter, Bloody
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 133: Deep Sea Giant Chapter, Bloody
Battle with the Wounded Avatar
Translator: 549690339
As its need for food increased over time and its strength improved, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had grown to more than seventeen meters long and gradually resembled a giant beast, continuously expanded its territory.
Night!
At a depth of 100 meters, the ferocious Sword Armor Flame Beast swam with a majority of its energy concealed, propelling its tail and cast in deep sea water like a black shadow.
The massive body stirred up ripples in the water, but it did not attract much attention.
This area was a small underwater mountain range, with uneven terrains and deep sea areas up to several thousand meters deep. In from of it was a mountain peak just a few dozen meters below the surface.
In such a complicated environment, even the Sword Armor Flame Beast had to be careful, expanding its range of perception to its maximum and taking note of the surrounding water fluctuations.
After all, no one knew if there were deep-sea giant beasts lurking in rhe trenches below.
However, there were also more resources of mutated creatures here. Today, it had already eaten several Level 4 and Level 5 mutated beasts.
At this moment, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had just swum over a sea trench, and in front of it was a mountain peak erected from the seabed. The highest peak was just a hundred meters below the sea surface.
Just as rhe Sword Armor Flame Beast swam over the mountain peak, it slightly swayed its tail and…
Boom!
From the collapsed mountain peak, gigantic tentacles erupted from the whirling muck, covering the Sword Armor Flame Beast from all directions like a Heaven and Earth Trap.
The sudden change made the Sword Armor Flame Beast react even faster, its terrifying internal power exploded in an instant, and the massive body shot up like a black shadow towards rhe sky.
Boom! The seawater exploded, and the 17-meter-long black colossus soared several dozen meters high, with huge tentacles chasing from below.
Bang!
The Sword Armor Flame Beast leaped out of the water, creating an arc in the air before diving back in several dozen meters deep. It then turned around with its gaze fixated on icy coldness.
Before it was a gigantic octopus with a height of 19 meters, twelve tentacles, and the longest four tentacles reaching over 20 meters in length.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast had seen mutated octopuses before and had even eaten a few, but this mutated octopus was particularly terrifying.
It had a colossal body that was as tall as a six-story building and was covered in thick black keratin with densely packed spikes radiating a metallic quality.
Its eight stout auxiliary tentacles were also covered in black keratin, with suction cups full of teeth that stirred up violent currents when slightly shaken.
As for the four 20-meter-long main tentacles, a mutation had occurred, the front segment was completely keratinized and had transformed into a huge scythe with serrated edges.
This was a mutated octopus that had evolved towards slaughter, resembling a demonic beast with black energy coursing through its body. Its terrifying aura emitted was even stronger than the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
This was a Level 7 Mutant Beast, and even among Level 7 creatures, it was far from weak. Its form alone made this evident, but what was unknown was its special talent.
Apart from that, rhe Mutated Octopus had a strong ability to remain hidden. Its presence was undetected by the Sword Armor Flame Beast until it launched its attack and felt no dangers or energy fluctuations.
Dressed as a mountain peak, the Mutated Octopus cleverly wrapped itself in a layer of sand, making it extremely cunning and treacherous.
Now, with its four pairs of gigantic crimson eyes fixated on the Sword Armor Flame Beast, the creature exuded a sense of brutality and greed.
It was evident that it had considered the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which had entered its territory, as food.
At this time, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was also contemplating whether it should eat the Mutated Beast or offer itself, believing that eating this giant beast would increase its Evolution value by ar least too points.
Although it was currently at the mid-period of rhe sixth level, it still remained fearless in the face of this formidable Level 7 Mutant Beast.
Just as the Sword Armor Flame Beast was contemplating whether or not to fight ar the cost of some injury, rhe Mutated Beast made rhe first move.
Bang!
With a sudden contraction of the eight auxiliary tentacles, water exploded behind the Mutated Octopus and, propelled by the strong shock, it launched itself towards the Sword Armor Flame Beast with astonishing speed.
At the same time, two of the thick main tentacles swept towards the Sword Armor Flame Beast. The force and speed at which they collided with the seawater were extremely frightening.
Well, you were the one who started this.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s eyes sharpened, and its body emitted a red glow7 , transforming into raging flames. Its figure vanished from the spot with a bang, breaking the seawT ater.
Boom! Boom!! The two gigantic tentacles fell on the reef rocks behind it, instantly shattering the iron-like rocks, and thousands of tons of reef stone rolled into the sea trench.
At this point, the flames continued to burn around the Sword Armor Flame Beast. It appeared with a terrifying speed beside the Mutated Octopus, its massive claws…
Woo!
Letting out a siren-like cry, the Mutated Octopus saw the black energy flow through rhe tentacles beneath its body. Sweeping through the area, the violent seawater within a 100-meter range surged up, creating enormous waves.
The raging seawater turned into a vortex as it mixed with the black energy. The huge tentacles were hidden within, crushing everything in their path, leaving a trail of devastation.
Apparently, its talent ability was creating a heavy water vortex full of immense pulling forces, both offensive and defensive in nature.
This move was similar to the Single-horned Tiger Whale1 s Devouring Vortex, but it became even more terrifying when combined with the dozen thick tentacles.
Especially when the seawater mixed with the black energy, it became viscous and heavy. Once trapped, mutated beings would struggle to escape.
But that only applied to ordinary mutated beings.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The Sword Armor Flame Beast continued to swim in the vortex. Its powerful, overbearing body directly shattered the vortex water currents while nimbly dodging the sweeping tentacles..

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 133: Deep Sea Giant Chapter, Bloody Battle with the Wounded Avatar_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 133: Deep Sea Giant Chapter, Bloody Battle with the Wounded Avatar_2
Translator: 549690339
Suddenly, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swung its thick right claw.
Boom!
The moment the right claw came into contact with the swinging tentacle, a terrifying force was transmitted, causing the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body to tremble slightly and its colossal figure to pause involuntarily.
However, that tentacle also suffered. Under the blow of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, both the surface energy shield and scale armor were torn apart, leaving four wounds over a meter deep.
Although the Sword Armor Flame Beast didn’t explode with its Strength Talent in this attack, it was still clear how formidable the Mutated Octopus’s defense was.
As the Sword Armor Flame Beast nearly tore off one of its tentacles and its body paused, the remaining dozen tentacles suddenly curled up and swept over with raging sea waves.
But at this moment, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had already transformed into a dark shadow tearing through the sea waves, soaring into the sky and covering hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye, evading the attack.
Bang!
The Sword Armor Flame Beast dodged the attack, but the mountain peaks behind it didn’t. Dozens of meters wide in diameter, the mountain tops were directly ground to dust and leveled by the tentacles.
The height dropped by more than twenty meters in an instant. The surrounding sea water became muddy and filled with countless shattered rocks and silt.
Boom!
An explosion erupted on the sea surface, and the Mutated Octopus, like a deep-sea monster, pursued the creature above the water. Its gigantic tentacles churned and furiously smashed the sea waves, causing huge splashes.
This creature is really annoying.
Not far away on the sea surface, the Sword Armor Flame Beast looked at the Mutated Octopus with its tentacles curling around it, feeling slightly troubled.
Compared to this Mutated Octopus, those mutated marine life with only fins and a mouth, which at most evolved a talent, were much easier to hunt.
On the contrary, once such multi-footed creatures mutated, they became very troublesome.
With offensive and defensive capabilities, talents, and agility, the contest came down to a powerful body and strength.
They needed to get rid of those tentacles.
With that in mind, the pale-gold vertical pupils of the Sword Armor Flame Beast flashed with ferocity, and the terrifying endless power within its body exploded, causing a sudden burst of sea water behind it.
Boom! In an instant, the Sword Armor Flame Beast turned into a black and red sword tearing through the ocean, with its fearsome speed causing the water to rise in shock waves on both sides, reaching more than ten meters high.
Under the effect of its Agility Talent, the Sword Armor Flame Beast instantly entered the heavy water vortex around the Mutated Octopus, and its right claw muscles swelled before swinging at a thick tentacle.
Boom! With a hundred-fold Power Burst, the sturdy and tenacious tentacle was severed in an instant, and the sea water mixed with flesh and blood turned even darker in color.
At the moment when the Sword Armor Flame Beast cut off a tentacle, its body was hit by two other tentacles due to the pause in its movement.
Under a terrifying force, even the Sword Armor Flame Beast was sent flying. It landed with a bang over a hundred meters away, causing a splash of water and a burst of sea waves tens of meters high.
But it was useless!
The external bone scale armor of the Sword Armor Flame Beast was best suited for dealing with such pure blunt force, with its powerful defense capable of withstanding a hundred times its own weight.
As a result, the moment it fell into the sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast instantly shot out and surged hundreds of meters, evading four more giant tentacles that came crashing down behind it.
Immediately, the surrounding sea surface became even more furious.
From over two hundred meters away, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, engulfed in flames, circled around the Mutated Octopus, preparing for a second attack.
As powerful as the Agility Talent was, it required a charging process, preventing instantaneous continuous explosions. Otherwise, within the vast ocean, there would have been no place the Sword Armor Flame Beast couldn’t reach.
The same applied to the Strength Talent, a hundred-fold power burst also needed a charging process.
Otherwise, it would not be a burst talent, but a constant hundred-fold power.
As the fierce flames burned on its body, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s Qi Blood boiled even more, blood flowed faster, muscles became more explosive, and its aura became more terrifying.
Boom! The sea water exploded.
Once again, the Sword Armor Flame Beast burst into terrible speed with its Agility Talent, like a black and red beam piercing through the heavy water vortex around the Mutated Octopus.
Boom!
With a hundred-fold Power Burst, another tentacle of the Mutated Octopus that was blocking its front was severed. A large amount of blood and flesh, along with the severed tentacle, fell into the sea, splashing water everywhere.
Woo!
The Mutated Octopus roared angrily, its voice resembling a horn’s buzzing. Its four sturdy curved knife-like tentacles crushed everything in their path, with one of them even heavily slashing the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force, the body of the Sword Armor Flame Beast instantly formed a V-shape, and it was smashed down from top to bottom into the deep sea by hundreds of meters. The black scales on its back shattered and cracked within a meter range.
The power of this attack was terrifying. The Mutated Octopus concentrated its unparalleled power on the bent corner of its tentacle, which even the Sword Armor Flame Beast couldn’t withstand.
Crack crack! The broken external bone scale armor on its back healed at a visible speed, making cracking sounds.
Meanwhile, deep in the sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast shot out by hundreds of meters, escaping the giant tentacles behind it.
This opponent is too strong. A rare touch of excitement emerged in the eyes of the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
In the time since entering the ocean, apart from that terrifying giant beast it couldn’t rival, this was the first time it had encountered an opponent that gave it a sense of oppression.
Then let’s fight.
Boom boom boom boom! As the Sword Armor Flame Beast ignored its injuries and repeatedly exploded with speed to destroy the tentacles of the Mutated Octopus, the entire sea area erupted.
The Mutated Octopus, unable to catch its opponent, grew even angrier. The black light shimmering on its body made it look like a black demon king as its tentacles ripped apart everything within a hundred-meter range.
Especially the four giant curved knife-like tentacles, which furiously slashed and caused tremendous sea waves, but they were all avoided by the Sword Armor Flame Beast..

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 133: Deep Sea Giant Chapter, Bloody Battle with the Wounded Avatar_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 133: Deep Sea Giant Chapter, Bloody Battle with the Wounded Avatar_3
Translator: 549690339
As more and more auxiliary tentacles were destroyed, and even a curved blade tentacle was broken off, the eyes of the Mutated Octopus grew increasingly bloodshot, filled with endless brutality and just a touch of… fear.
Although its mutation turned it more ferocious and violent, this octopus – one of the most intelligent marine life forms – also became smarter.
It noticed that after just a short battle, it only had five tentacles left.
While that flexible guy had been hit by it several times, he simply carried on charging like nothing happened, fearless and with an increasingly fierce and violent aura.
Under these circumstances, the Mutated Octopus wouldn’t be able to deal a fatal blow to the enemy unless it could wrap its black body around that guy.
And if things continued this way, once its tentacles were completely destroyed, it would become useless bald food and be eaten by that black creature.
For a moment, the violent and ferocious Mutated Octopus started to think about retreating.
But just then, the flaming Sword Armor Flame Beast erupted with terrifying speed again, transforming into a black and red beam that traversed the heavy water vortex and lunged forward.
And this time, the target of the Mutated Octopus was its head.
In an instant, the Mutated Octopus’ two pairs of eyes turned bloodshot red, and its remaining tentacles, like deep-sea Flood Dragons, frantically attacked the Sword Armor Flame Beast from all directions.
Boom! The seawater exploded, and after tearing off another auxiliary tentacle, the Sword Armor Flame Beast fiercely shot at the sharp-angled head of the Mutated Octopus.
Squeak! Squeak!
The sharp double claws ripped apart the black protective energy outside the Mutated Octopus’ body, its hard scales, and then its flesh and blood, while the octopus tentacles simultaneously bombarded the back of the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
Especially those three curved tentacles, which could not be entirely defended against by the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s unbeatably solid exoskeleton, shattering large pieces of its outer armor.
But the Sword Armor Flame Beast, already familiar with its opponent’s attack limits, was undaunted.
As long as you can’t kill me, you’ll be the one to die today.
Roar! The Sword Armor Flame Beast let out a ferocious roar, its sturdy hind legs and claws tearing apart the Mutated Octopus’ body, standing firm, and then executing a power explosion with the claws in its head.
Roar, roar, roar! Under the terrifying power eruption of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, the chitin armor and resilient flesh of the Mutated Octopus constantly cracked, gradually being torn apart.
Boom, boom, boom, boom! Facing the threat of death, the Mutated Octopus became even more insane, its remaining tentacles wildly wrapping around the Sword Armor Flame Beast in a frantic attempt to pull it off its body.
In particular, the suction cups on the tentacles, filled with sharp teeth, were madly biting into the cracked scales, trying to tear them apart.
Splat!
At that moment, a flash of black light appeared, and the sharp tip of an arrow shot out, bursting one of the Mutated Octopus’ eyes, and then suddenly pulling out another eye…
At this moment, both the Sword Armor Flame Beast and the Mutated Octopus went mad, entangling with each other.
Especially as the crazed Sword Armor Flame Beast unleashed its full power, its double claws tore a massive wound that almost split the Mutated Octopus’ head in two, causing a torrent of dark blue blood to gush out.
At the same time, the strength of those tentacles holding the Sword Armor Flame Beast weakened…
A little over ten minutes later, the sea area finally calmed down, with a strong blue blood staining the surrounding seawater a deeper shade of blue within a range of hundreds of meters.
