Having its nine brains and three hearts destroyed, and its head almost torn in half, the corpse of the Mutated Octopus floated in the water, riding the waves.
Next to the corpse of the Mutated Octopus, the red light on the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s body was dim, most of its bone spurs on its back broken, and many parts of its black exoskeleton bone scales were damaged.
Even the bone spur on its tail had broken off a part.
This time, it could be said that it was the most tragic battle the Sword Armor Flame Beast had ever faced since its evolution, but its eyes were now filled with ferociousness and a bloodthirsty excitement.
The feeling of close combat with a deep-sea giant beast was just too thrilling.
Moreover, this Mutated Octopus was very powerful – not only had it reached Level 7, but it also possessed an attribute similar to a king-level bloodline, making its combat power far surpass its level.
After taking a short rest and waiting for most of its injuries to heal, the Sword Armor Flame Beast acted like a diligent bee, burrowing into the depths of the sea to collect these tentacles one by one.
These were food containing abundant energy, a single one being equivalent to a Level 5 mutated beast, and couldn’t be wasted.
Once it had eaten this high-level mutant beast, its body would grow significantly, and its evolution value might increase by more than a hundred, which was a bountiful harvest indeed.
It was just a little tiring.
The next morning, Freya Louise couldn’t help but pause when she saw Jack Clark.
“What’s wrong?” Jack Clark touched his cheek, puzzled. He remembered washing his face.
The girl shook her head slightly: “Nothing, it’s just that you seem to be more ‘ferocious’ than yesterday.”
“Ferocious?”
Jack Clark hesitated for a moment, then came up with an excuse: “Maybe it’s because I’ve been fighting and killing non-stop lately, and the stench of blood is lingering on me.”
“Perhaps.” The girl nodded slightly, but her womanly intuition told her that it probably wasn’t the real reason.
Jack Clark smiled: “I’m going back to school for a while.”
“Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.” Freya Louise’s eyes twinkled, looking forward to it as well.
If his combat power were already this terrifying just by relying on low-level martial skills like Dragon Elephant Art, how much stronger would Jack Clark become once he cultivated the more powerful Dragon Elephant Overlord Body?
Jack Clark suddenly asked: “By the way, Freya Louise, don’t you need to switch to advanced skill cultivation?”
The girl shook her head: “I don’t need it.”
“…You don’t?” Jack Clark hesitated for a moment.
“Because my cultivation method doesn’t require understanding the True Martial Will and doesn’t need to change my physique. Instead, my True Strength needs to remain pure and attributeless,” she explained.
“Only then can 1 refine various Transcendent Firearms after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, integrating, assembling, and upgrading them without conflicts.”
“Of course, this is also the reason for my weak melee combat power, as 1 rely too much on weapon equipment.” When talking about these things, Freya Louise’s tone was very calm.
“What a peculiar cultivation path,” Jack Clark sighed softly.
Then he parted ways with Freya Louise at the dormitory, walked straight out of the armed department, and arrived at the express car station a few hundred meters away. After waiting for a while, he boarded a bus back to Mist River..

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 134: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, Nine Layers of Heaven in One Year
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 134: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, Nine Layers of Heaven in One Year
Translator: 549690339
Wearing a leisure suit, Jack Clark returned to school at around nine in the morning.
“Jack, over here.”
In the Office Building, Sylvia Lyons, who was not far away, waved to Jack: “Lori Parma has been closed-door training for over a week and asked you to find me when you get back.”
“… No wonder I couldn’t find her. I’ve troubled Teacher Lyons.” Jack was taken aback by not being able to find Lori.
“It’s no problem; let’s go.”
Sylvia stood up and led Jack towards a building in the back.
“Advanced skills are different from low-level martial arts. They involve martial intent, and simple pupil image transmission can only transfer content below the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“Complete advanced inheritance or content above the fourth level requires the use of the True Martial Stone Tablet.”
On the way, Sylvia detailed to Jack the precautions to take when inheriting advanced skills.
Soon, the two arrived in front of a square building ten meters high.
There were not many people around, but when Sylvia entered, she underwent identity verification five times in a row.
At the same time, while verifying her own identity, she registered Jack so he could come in by himself next time he wanted to exchange other advanced skills or martial techniques.
Entering the building, the two walked through a long corridor and finally arrived at the Central Lobby.
In the middle of the lobby, a ten meters high, gray stone tablet stood emitting a heavy aura, the invisible oppressive force giving Jack palpitations.
“Don’t mind it; the True Martial Stele has no offensive power. That invisible oppressive force is the True Martial Will left by some strong men.”
“Alright, go over there and activate the True Martial Stone Tablet after verifying your identity.”
As instructed by Sylvia, Jack approached the activation device on the side wall.
“Welcome to the Heavenly Intelligence System, please input your student ID for facial recognition and pupil verification…”
“Identity verified. Please choose the cultivation method to learn.”
“You have chosen Advanced Dragon Elephant Skill. Learning requires 11+
Permission, 300 Contribution Points…”
“Requirement met. Dragon Elephant Domination Will activating…”
Hum!
Accompanied by a prompt sound, a pure energy flowed into the gray stone tablet along the ground pathway.
Suddenly, the stele vibrated slightly, and many patterns on it lit up. A True Martial Will was activated soon after.
Roar!
A roar like the combined sound of a dragon and an elephant rang out in Jack’s mind, terrifying and oppressive as if a true dragon had descended. The sound shook his will slightly.
Sylvia continued: “Go ahead, put your hand on the True Martial Stele and swear, ‘Never betray the Human Race.’ Then you can inherit the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.”
“Also, the stele will take a wisp of your soul breath as proof of being an elite of the human race during the pledge. This wisp of breath will not harm you, so don’t be afraid.”
Soul breath?
Suppressing the impulse to accept the inheritance immediately, Jack turned back and looked at Sylvia with a puzzled expression: “Teacher, is it really necessary to go through all this trouble just to exchange one advanced skill?”
Jack didn’t know what soul breath was, but he knew that anything involving the soul must be important.
In response to Jack’s inquiry, Sylvia gave a wry smile: “In fact, it wasn’t so troublesome before. Even if one had only cultivation talent, they could choose any cultivation method they wanted, regardless of whether it was high-level or low-level.”
“Because in that era, every person with cultivation aptitude was extremely precious.”
“But over a decade ago, due to a person’s betrayal, the official began to vigorously reform, setting various thresholds and requirements, including the current school system.”
“Who was that person? Such a huge impact.” Jack was shocked.
With a complex tone, Sylvia said: “He was a genius.”
“A genius!”
Jack paused, then asked doubtfully: “Since he was a genius, why did he betray the human race? Were his parents persecuted and killed from a young age, and he also suffered from social injustice?”
Betraying the ‘Human Race’ was different from betraying a country or Federation.
The latter targeted a specific system, whereas the former was directed against the entire ‘human’ race, just like the Blood God Sect, which merged blood seeds to kill and improve their strength.
Moreover, his betrayal changed the various education rules throughout the Federation and made it exceedingly difficult for Jack to cultivate advanced skills.
Sylvia shook her head: “The Federation and the school didn’t wrong him, and his parents were also alive and well back then. They were both renowned high-level cultivators, and their family was happy and harmonious.”
“Besides, his monstrous talent was extraordinarily terrifying. He was not an Innate Awakened One, but more terrifying than one. He reached Ninth Heavens in one year.”
“… Wait, Teacher, are you sure you haven’t made a mistake? Ninth Heavens in one year!” This time, Jack was truly astonished.
It had been almost five months since he started to practice True Martial, and he had only reached the late stage of Third Layer Heaven, even with his attribute points.
With his mediocre talent, Jack knew that if he normally practiced, he might have barely broken through the Second Layer Heaven now, and it would take him at least one to two years to reach the Third Layer Heaven.
However, the person who betrayed the human race reached the Ninth Heavens in one year!!
Sylvia looked at Jack, seemingly very satisfied with his stunned expression, and nodded: “You heard me right; that person was indeed that monstrous.”
“He enrolled in school and chose an advanced skill called the Profound Heaven Sword Scripture. It was a special sword scripture that emphasized comprehension and enlightenment.”
“Initially, his cultivation progress was slow, taking almost three months to break through the First Layer Heaven. But then he exhibited his terrifying talent, advancing a Layer every month.”
“In just a few months, he broke through the Sixth Layer Heaven’s limit and even created subsequent cultivation methods, breaking through to the Ninth Heavens in one breath..”

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 134: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, Nine Layers of Heaven in One Year_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 134: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, Nine Layers of Heaven in One Year_2
Translator: 549690339
“At that time, the terrifying talent demonstrated by this person shocked the entire cultivation world, including the kings above the Ninth Heavens.”
“Even a Supreme Expert returned from the mythical world and took him there.”
It is said that after going to the mythical world, he quickly broke through the king-level, and his combat power was terrifying, but within two years it was reported that he had betrayed the Human Race, causing a stir in the Federation.”
“Later, the top level of the Federation discussed and thought that the cultivation system at that time was too indulgent to freshmen, including resources, and everything came easily.”
“Under this circumstance, it makes the newcomers feel that everything is taken for granted; they should be provided by the school and the country and do not appreciate or feel grateful.”
“Humans are a complicated species, only what comes from their own efforts will be cherished, and only through hardships will life become more meaningful.”
No, I don’t want hardships. Jack Clark complained internally.
At this moment, Sylvia Lyons suddenly said, “By the way, that person also practiced the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife and reached the highest realm of the Third Layer within a month.”
“Because of him, the low-level sword skill of the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife made a splash at that time, and many people chose it.”
Upon hearing that the other party also practiced the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, Jack Clark paused and asked subconsciously, “Was that person named Jonathan West?”
“Huh! You know him?” Sylvia Lyons was somewhat surprised.
Jack Clark shook his head, “1 heard the name from someone, but I don’t know anything else.”
At the beginning, when Jack Clark met Jane Aiken at Erica Knowles’, they had briefly chatted because of the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, and he heard about Jonathan West from Jane Aiken.
I see.” Sylvia Lyons nodded and continued.
“Because of Jonathan West, everyone who practices Advanced True Martial to the Fourth Layer has to make a vow in front of the True Martial Stele, similar to a Soul Contract.”
“The only constraint of the contract is not to betray the Human Race.”
“Once betraying, the established vow will come into effect as soon as the betrayer appears in the territory of the Human Race, and the True Martial Stele will react, then locate the place.”
“Of course, that True Martial Stele is not the imitation here, but the Clan
Protectors’ Divine Stele with the power of artifacts.”
So that’s how it is.”
After Sylvia Lyons’ explanation, Jack Clark no longer had such resistance to the oath being taken with a strand of soul breath.
Coming to the front of the True Martial Stele, Jack put his hand on the stele, took a deep breath, and said solemnly, “I, Jack Clark, swear never to betray the Human Race!”
Hum! As Jack spoke, a power deep inside the stele was activated, transformed into an invisible force that enveloped his entire body.
At this moment, a row of transparent text appeared in Jack’s eyes.
“Rule-type force detected, about to absorb soul breath, currently you can choose to use 20 attribute points to simulate soul breath instead, do you want to simulate?”
Unexpectedly, the attribute panel responded, Jack paused for a moment, and then a wave of thought sounded in his mind.
“Select to simulate soul breath.”
Although Jack no longer had much resistance to the True Martial Stele absorbing soul breath, it was better to be cautious when it came to matters related to the soul.
As Jack confirmed, the remaining 25 attribute points on the attribute page instantly turned into 5, and at the same time, a unique power emerged within his body.
As the soul breath was absorbed by the invisible force on the stele, Jack vaguely felt an invisible vortex suddenly appear within the stele.
The soul breath was guided through the vortex by the invisible force, and then disappeared with the vortex.
At this moment, as the contract was established, Jack’s consciousness shook violently and was directly pulled into the True Martial Stele by the powerful force of will.
Roar!
The roar that shook his consciousness exploded, a terrifying giant beast as tall as a mountain, covered in scale armor, with the body of an elephant and the tail of a dragon, the feet of an elephant and the claws of a dragon, the head of an elephant and the mouth of a dragon, charged towards Jack.
Bang!
The moment the Dragon Elephant collided with Jack’s consciousness, it suddenly shattered, sending countless streams of information into his brain, as well as a seed of willpower.
After a while, Jack slowly opened his eyes with shock still lingering on his face.
Advanced Skill after the Fourth Layer Heaven, in addition to the qualitative change of True Strength, there is also a change in mental willpower, allowing humans to control the power of Heaven and Earth with their tiny bodies like a Giant Beast.
At the same time, Jack finally understood why there is no Meditation Method after Foundation Establishment.Because advanced skills come with cultivation for mental willpower.
At the same time, as Jack Clark exits the inheritance, the runes on the gray stele in front of him gradually dim, and the terrifying dragon elephant aura becomes several times weaker.
Perhaps after one or two more heritages, the Overbearing Dragon Elephant thought contained within the stele will dissipate.
After accepting the advanced skill inheritance, Jack Clark applies for a Personal Cultivation Room to close himself in.
When transitioning from low-level martial arts to advanced ones, you need to start cultivating from the first layer again. This is called transition cultivation, breaking through one layer at a time with the new skill’s route of operation.
At this time, the original low-level True Martial strength will transform into a more powerful high-level True Martial strength, and the physique will be further tempered and strengthened.
Under normal circumstances, it might take a slower person two months, maybe a little over one month for a faster person.
However, the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body belongs to the promotion skill of Dragon Elephant Power, and Jack Clark’s transition cultivation should be much simpler.
In Sylvia Lyons’ estimation, Jack Clark is expected to cultivate the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body to the Third Layer in about ten days, just in time for the start of school.
However…
In the Cultivation Room, as Jack Clark’s true power inside his body follows a more complex route of circulation, his aura becomes heavier, more violent, and resembles a suppressed volcano.
The First Layer, the Second Layer, the Third Layer…
When the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body breaks through to the Third Layer, Jack Clark’s true power within his body emanates an overbearing aura, which is more concentrated, and his meridians become more tenacious and wide.
At this time, the more overbearing Dragon Elephant True Strength increases the enhancement of the base strength and defense from the original five times to six times, raising Jack Clark’s combat power once again.
No wonder it is one of the strongest advanced skills; just one transition cultivation has increased his strength by so much.
Keep in mind that ordinary advanced skills have only a four times amplification in the Tripleplex Heaven, just one time more than those powerful low-level martial arts.
The difference between high and low-level skills will be significantly evident after the Fourth Layer Heaven, not only in terms of the upper limit, and this is also the reason why Lori Parma advised Jack Clark to break through the Four Layer Heaven with advanced skills.
However, at this point, Jack Clark slowly stops, calls up the attribute page with a thought, and his gaze falls on the remark that has become the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.
“Current cultivation progress: Late-stage Third Layer Heaven. To strengthen this skill to the Fourth Layer requires 30 attribute points.”
“Reminder: When this skill is strengthened to the Fourth Layer, it must be used in conjunction with high-order dragon variant beast essence blood, otherwise, the strengthening effect cannot reach its peak.”
“Reminder: Insufficient attribute points, unable to strengthen.”
Looking at the floating transparent text in front of him, Jack Clark’s gaze flickers slightly.
Just like the Tyrant Elephant Essence Blood needed for the entry of the Dragon Elephant Power, the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body also needs supporting essence blood to lay the foundation for the second physique transformation when breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
And the breakthroughs for the following Fifth Layer and Sixth Layer will also require continuous absorption of dragon-type creature essence blood to cultivate.
Eventually, the flesh will reach the second quality change, condense the Overlord Body, obtain the power of the Giant Dragon Elephant, and sweep away everything with an absolutely overbearing strength.
At the same time, just like the initial Tyrant Elephant Essence Blood, the school’s inventory has essence blood resources prepared for students who cultivate the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and the first exchange only requires 30 points.
Still a 10% discount, ten times cheaper, as you know that under normal conditions a bottle of high-order dragon essence blood requires 300 points of contribution.
No choice, a variant beast with a trace of dragon bloodline is just like a variant creature with a trace of king-level bloodline; it belongs to the king among its peers.
Not to mention the high-order dragon variant beasts, their terrifying combat power naturally makes their essence blood extremely valuable as well.
That’s also why the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body is so powerful.
By breaking through to the Fourth Layer Heaven with the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, Jack Clark’s flesh and true strength will undergo a qualitative change under the Dragon Power, gaining a powerful dragon-based True Martial Attribute.
By then, he’ll be like a dragon variant beast among humans, and with the power of high-level Dragon Elephant alone, his combat capabilities will far surpass his peers.
By then, with his increasingly terrifying fleshly strength, it’s hard for Jack Clark to imagine how powerful his combat abilities will be after the breakthrough.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark takes a deep breath, suppressing the urge to continue cultivating.
Thirty contribution points would take him no more than two days, just killing a few Level 2 Variant Beasts would be enough. Just today the second round of cleaning missions got refreshed.
Also, after working hard for this period, the fourth evolution of the Sword Armor Flame Beast is not far off.
Next, he will also need to find the time to search for those few special variant beasts which his Avatar can absorb and devour…

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 135: Electric Ray, The Single-horned Orca’s Rescue Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 135: Electric Ray, The Single-horned Orca’s Rescue Request
Translator: 549690339
After exchanging for an Advanced Skill and completing the first three cultivation phases, Jack Clark did not go home but instead took the fast car back to the Hundred Mountain Town.
At this point, the sky was gradually darkening. There were many students returning to the small town streets, carrying weapons and possessing a residual bloody smell despite their earlier cleansing.
“Jack Clark, the second round of tasks have refreshed today. Why didn’t you participate?” On the road, a student carrying a combat knife enthusiastically greeted him.
This clean-up phase lasted half a month. The second round of task refresh was a re-survey of the surroundings, encompassing the range deep into the mountains using the detection equipment carried by professionals.
This second round’s tasks quantity and accuracy of information were slightly off. Many tasks noted that suspected mutated creatures were spotted in these areas.
Therefore, even if Jack Clark was not present in the morning, there was no real loss. He just missed out on taking two tasks.
However, seeing the other party’s enthusiasm, Jack Clark was naturally not aloof. He responded with a smile, “I went back to the school today, had some things to handle.”
“Then you’re quite at a loss. This morning there was a mutated beast horde task refresh. Elvis Raven and his group took it on together, earning several dozen contribution points.”
As he said this, a look of envy crossed this student’s face.
This student was a classmate from Class Four next door. Jack had a slight impression of him. The Elvis Raven he mentioned was also a Third Layer Heaven student who had returned from the trial.
He had joined forces with five or six others who had returned from the trials, a Second Layer Heaven student with battle armor, and had completed several high difficulty tasks this period.
Of course, all the contribution points they jointly earned did not amount to what Jack alone earned.
At this point, another classmate from the back called, “Brother Chen, take me along to hunt Level 3 Mutant Beasts.”
Jack Clark chuckled and nodded, “Sure, once we kill the unique beast, you can help carry the corpse down the mountain. It would make it much easier for me.”
“Ha… Brother Chen, forget what I just said.” The late period First Layer Heaven classmate immediately gave a sheepish laugh.
With his basic arm strength of 300kg, carrying a three-ton Level 3 Mutant Beast corpse was akin to courting death.
On the way back to the temporary dormitory, many classmates greeted Jack zealously. This included students from the neighboring second-tier and third-tier martial high schools.
The reason was simple. In the past few days, during the return trip from hunting Mutated Beasts, Jack would usually help out if he encountered a fight and saw the classmates at a disadvantage.
With his strength, he could casually pick up a 100kg stone from the ground and threw it over, killing an ordinary mutated beast.
Although he only intervened a few times, word quickly spread among the students about Jack’s formidable strength, humility, and strong sense of justice.
As a result, he had a high popularity among these classmates recently.
In the cafeteria, Freya Louise looked across at Jack Clark, whose aura felt increasingly oppressive, and asked in surprise, “You went back to exchange for the Cultivation Methods this morning, and you’ve completed the cultivation already?”
“Yes, I cultivated for half a day in the Cultivation Room, and the nature of the True Strength has been transformed.” Jack Clark nodded.
“Well, you are the genius who cultivated the Dragon Elephant Power and brought out the True Martial Divine Rhyme.”
Freya grinned before changing the subject, “You should be preparing for the breakthrough to the Fourth Layer Heaven next, right? Do you have enough Contribution Points?”
Jack Clark gave her a glance, “Why, are you planning to lend me some ‘money’?”
The girl nodded casually, “Sure. 1 still have sixty Contribution Points unused. You can use them. You can repay me when you go to the Alien Beast Battlefield for trials.”
Because True Strength needed to be kept ’empty’, her choices of resources were much narrower. Plus, her aunt provided all her ammunition and other supplies.
Therefore, aside from exchanging for resources that would speed up the absorption and stimulation of her True Strength, she didn’t depend on Contribution as significantly as Jack did.
In reality though, this dependence was just to speed up their progress.
Otherwise, Jack could still steadily cultivate at his own pace. However, doing so would not result in the dramatic improvement in strength he had achieved so far; he would be at least several times, perhaps even ten times slower.
“Let’s see in a few days. If 1 am short of Contribution Points then, 1 will borrow some from you.” Jack chuckled. He neither accepted immediately nor declined.
If the tasks in the next few days were all Level 1, bringing in little Contribution, he might have to borrow from her in order to exchange for dragon essence blood.
Fortunately, the situation was not that dire.
The next day, Jack landed three Level 2 tasks. However, these tasks were spread relatively far apart, deep into the mountains several tens of kilometers, and thus, the day swiftly passed.
In the ensuing days, while completing his tasks, Jack was also searching in the Long White Mountain for the traces of the electric ray, the double-headed mutated ice python, and the Earth Black Bear.
The three Mutated Beasts each corresponded with lightning, ice, and gravity.
The abilities of the double-headed mutated ice python and the Earth Black Bear were kept as backup, in case he failed to find the electric ray before the Sword Armor Flame Beast underwent its fourth evolution.
By then, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, with two talents of ice and flame, or flame and gravity, would still be very strong.
As for powerful abilities related to space, these had not been discovered among the known low-level exotic beasts, and if there were, they would be categorised as Senior or high-order beings.
Just like the double-headed sea python they had encountered before, their sluggish talent could also be classified as a subset of time.
Deep into the Long Hundred Mountain, 150 kilometers away, in the mountain stream just over ten meters wide, the small river suddenly started boiling. In the blink of an eye, the bodies of numerous fishes of various sizes floated up.
A six meter long, barrel-thick eel, covered in black scales, was coiling in the raging river surface. On its body, blue arcs of electricity were dancing.
It wasn’t until the river was filled with dead fish that the electric eel slowly stopped, its ferocious mouth biting into a 0.5 meter long fish for its meal..

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 135: Electric Ray, The Single-horned Orca’s Rescue Request_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 135: Electric Ray, The Single-horned Orca’s Rescue Request_2
Translator: 549690339
This is the hunting method of the electric ray, which has almost no natural enemies in the river due to its electric power.
Even a higher-level mutant alligator doesn’t dare to provoke it in the water.
In fact, these creatures with the ability to generate electricity are not native to Eastern Summer; they were introduced by some “enthusiasts” and have since multiplied.
At this moment, as the mutant eel, resembling a lightning python, swam leisurely on the river surface, eating without haste,
Jack Clark, dressed in dark red armor and carrying a seven-meter-long unique beast corpse on his shoulder, looked down from the hillside with surprise.
He had been hunting in Long White Mountain for four days and had unexpectedly discovered this mutated electric ray just as he was returning from completing his mission today.
Similarly dressed in red armor and carrying a sniper rifle, Freya Louise looked down in astonishment, “That looks like an electric ray, a creature with an electric attribute that has no natural enemies in the water.”
The two accepted missions near each other and entered the mountain together.
However, Freya was not so lucky – her mission note mentioned that there might be Level Two mutated creatures inhabiting the mountain forest, but she found nothing when she went to look.
Jack thought for a moment, “Freya, use a regular bullet to kill that electric ray, but don’t shatter its body.”
For the Sword Armor Flame Beast, the only requirement is to digest a complete target creature during evolution, so all he needs to do is to bring back the corpse of this mutant eel.
“Alright!”
The girl nodded, ejected the armor-piercing bullet clip with a click, and replaced it with a regular sniper bullet.
Compared to the Black Bone Armor-piercing Bullet capable of going through Level 3 or even 4 mutated beasts, this regular bullet was much cheaper, specifically used for taking down normal mutated beasts.
Of course, even a regular sniper bullet, given its 28mm caliber, would still have the power of an anti-aircraft gun.
Bang! With the gunshot from the hillside, the electric ray feeding on the river surface had its head blown open in an instant, leaving a huge bloody hole.
Fresh blood gushed from the wound, quickly dying the surrounding river surface red.
Jack threw the mutated beast corpse on his shoulder down and dashed down the hillside in a flash.
As he swiftly skimmed across the river surface, Jack grabbed the enormous mutant eel corpse and splashed up large amounts of water.
In the evening, the two drove back to the small town.
After handing over the Level 2 mutated beast corpse to the Logistics Department and completing the mission, Jack rented a cold storage space to keep the eel’s body.
He told Freya that he was planning to bring it back to taste the rare electric ray meat.
He wasn’t lying – he did plan to bring it back to eat.
A hundred meters beneath the sea surface, the water was murky as a black-red colossal beast over eighteen meters in length, covered in sharp spikes across its back, swam slowly, radiating a terrifying aura.
After devouring the mutated octopus a few days ago, its physique had become even more massive and ferocious.
As it grew, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s oppressive presence as a giant creature became more evident.
Many sharks and other creatures fled in terror from a distance, not daring to approach, even with its aura concealed; only small palm-sized fish seemed unafraid.
At this moment, dense schools of fish swam around the Sword Armor Flame Beast, forming a striking contrast with its huge, ferocious body.
After its battle with the ferocious mutated octopus, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had stayed away from the deep sea, hunting in the two-hundred-kilometer coastal depth range.
The deeper sea areas had too many dangerous creatures, and it planned to wait until its fourth evolution before venturing deeper.
However, this meant that as the mutated creatures over ten meters in size within this sea area were continuously devoured, food gradually became scarce.
As for the fish under ten meters, they were just a snack for it now and didn’t help it grow any bigger.
At this moment, another mutated creature entered the sensing range of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which instantly brightened its eyes and showed a terrifying, fierce aura just for an instant.
Boom! Under the terrifying aura, the silver small fish swimming with it scattered in an uproar.
Scaring away those small fish that could easily expose its presence, the Sword Armor Flame Beast moved its tail slightly and swam towards its food several hundred meters away.
A few hundred meters away, a mutated ribbonfish-shaped creature, fifteen meters long, covered in silver scales and studded with sharp spikes, was hunting.
It bit a five-meter-long ordinary shark in its mouth, and a strong chill spread from its mouth, freezing the shark.
After the prey was frozen to death, the ferocious mutated ribbonfish slowly released its mouth, ready to eat…Boom!
Suddenly, there was an explosion in the seawater, and before the mutated ribbonfish with freezing bite ability could react, its head was smashed by a giant claw.
Thick blood dyed the seawater red, and a huge black beast grabbed the mutated ribbonfish’s corpse with one claw, the other holding the shark.
Crrack, crrack! The Sword Armor Flame Beast wolfed down most of the shark’s flesh and blood in a few bites.
When this picked-up snack was finished, it started eating the mutated ribbonfish with both claws, taking a large chunk with each bite and crushing the spikes with its sharp teeth.
It was only when it reached the ribbonfish’s belly that the Sword Armor Flame Beast dealt with it slightly.
As a ‘human,’ it still had some psychological barriers concerning excrement, so it always processed the mutated creatures it had hunted.
While the Sword Armor Flame Beast was swimming and eating seafood, suddenly another mutated creature over ten meters long entered its sensing range..

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 135: Electric Ray, The Single-horned Orca’s Rescue Request s
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 135: Electric Ray, The Single-horned Orca’s Rescue Request s
Translator: 549690339
It was a thirteen-meter-long Tiger Whale covered in black and white scales. Upon seeing the fearsome Sword Armor Flame Beast, it let out excited cries.
Seeing the Tiger Whale swimming towards it, the Sword Armor Flame Beast opened its mouth slightly and let out a low growl.
Roar! Are you the third child of the stupid big family?
Ying Ying Ying!!
However, compared to the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which could convey its meaning precisely, this Little Tiger Whale could only cry ying ying ying. As for the meaning, it could only be guessed.
The ‘Little’ Tiger Whale swam around the Sword Armor Flame Beast for two laps and then swam forward, looked back after swimming a certain distance, and continued to cry ying ying ying.
Roar! Are you asking me to follow you?
Ying Ying Ying!! The Little Tiger Whale nodded slightly in the water and swam forward.
Did that Single-horned Tiger Whale guy find something good again?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast’s eyes sparkled, and with a flick of its tail, it followed, swimming more than twenty kilometers along the way.
Boom!
Water splashed on the sea surface, and a fierce, black head covered with gorgeous feather horns burst out of the water. A giant Single-horned Tiger Whale sank and floated in the water in the distance.
Almost half a month had passed since they last saw each other. The
Single-horned Tiger Whale had grown to thirty-one meters in length. The oppressive aura it radiated was several times stronger than before, clearly having broken through Level 7.
However, its condition was not very good at the moment. Its enormous body was covered in shattered scale armor, with many deep, bone-exposing wounds and weak breath.
Fortunately, those wounds had not bled further, slowly healing under the circulation of a black and white strength.
A twenty-eight-meter-long Female Tiger Whale was guarding it nearby, and her eyes showed agility and joy upon seeing the Little Tiger Whale and the Sword Armor Flame Beast emerge from the water.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale’s spirit was instantly lifted, and it called out.
Ying Ying Ying!! Brother, I finally found you.
Roar!! How did you end up like this?
As the Sword Armor Flame Beast roared, it swam over, its eyes sweeping over the claw-like wounds on the Single-horned Tiger Whale, looking slightly solemn.
This Single-horned Tiger Whale was very powerful, and even the Sword Armor Flame Beast felt it would take some effort to fight it after its breakthrough.
Yet it was injured by an unknown Mutated Beast at this moment, and it seemed to be a creature with sharp claws.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale cried out angrily: Ying Ying Ying!! Brother, you have to take revenge for me. They ‘fish’ are too many for me to handle alone, and they bully me too much.
Roar!! How many, and what do they look like?
Ying Ying Ying!! There are quite a few, I can’t count.
Roar!! I don’t really want to go out right now, so let’s take revenge for you later.
Upon hearing that there were many Mutated Creatures who had injured the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast lost interest immediately.
Since the opponent had beaten the Single-horned Tiger Whale to such an extent, it was obviously not weak, and the numerous creatures would make it difficult for the Sword Armor Flame Beast to come out on top.
Moreover, it was nearing its Fourth Evolution, so everything needed to be stable.
Upon hearing that the Sword Armor Flame Beast was unwilling to take action, the Single-horned Tiger Whale became anxious and quickly cried out: Ying Ying Ying!! There are only two of them that are powerful, the others aren’t very fierce.
Roar!! How did you provoke them? The Sword Armor Flame Beast asked curiously.
Ying Ying Ying!! 1 sensed something good. They were guarding it, and 1 was beaten as soon as 1 got close.
Hearing about the good thing, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s tone suddenly changed: Roar!! What? You were just looking at it and they beat you? That’s too arrogant.
Roar!! Let’s deal with them; how dare they hurt you, my brother.
Suddenly, the Single-horned Tiger Whale was excited.
Ying Ying Ying!! Alright, let’s go once 1 recover a bit.
With its simple intelligence, it didn’t notice the change in the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s tone. All it knew was that with its ferocious brother helping, those creatures were as good as dead.
However, the wait ended up taking almost a day.
It wasn’t until the next morning that the heavily injured Single-horned Tiger Whale managed to recover most of its strength. In the meantime, the three Little Tiger Whales and the Female Tiger Whale took turns hunting for it to eat.
It seemed like all its efforts in nurturing a big family were not in vain.
The next morning, after almost fully recovering, the mo Giant Beasts swam to the Outer Sea one after another, ready to pull off a big heist.
Oh, wait, actually, it’s to take revenge for the Single-horned Tiger Whale..

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 136: The Underworld River, Swallowing Instinct
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 136: The Underworld River, Swallowing Instinct
Translator: 549690339
A hundred meters below the sea surface.
The thirty-one meter long Single-horned Tiger Whale, covered in thick black and white armor, swam quickly. With each swing of its gigantic body, it stirred up strong currents.
Alongside it was a ferocious Unique Beast covered in black-red scaled armor.
Compared to the colossal Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was not only shorter but also less thick and heavy. However, the invisible oppressive aura that it emitted was no less than the whales.
Rather, compared to the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which usually preyed on ordinary mutated creatures, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which specialized in hunting creatures of its own size or even larger, was even more ferocious.
Over a long period of hunting, an intangible vicious aura gradually accumulated around it.
Once this invisible aura was released, it would instantly scare away the surrounding fish, making the tails of ordinary Mutated Fish go soft and motionless.
Roar! Weve been swimming so long, how much further is it?
Chirp! Almost there.
In comparison to the previous two times, the Sword Armor Flame Beast estimated it had swum more than five hundred kilometers this time, reaching the distant seas where it usually would never venture.
Here, the seawater below became even darker and deeper, and several vague, fleeting breaths made the Sword Armor Flame Beast shudder.
Chirp! Were here.
With a cheerful call, the guiding Single-horned Tiger Whale suddenly dived deeper, with the Sword Armor Flame Beast following behind.
Soon, the two Giant Beasts arrived at a depth of eight hundred meters below the deep sea and continued to dive quickly. One thousand meters, one thousand five hundred metersThe surrounding water pressure grew stronger and stronger.
This place was likely a sea trench, and by now, the water temperature had become freezing cold. The Heavenly Energy contained in the water was almost twice as dense as that on the sea surface.
The two Giant Beasts continued to dive.
They soon reached a depth of three thousand meters, where the surrounding water pressure surged once again. At this point, even the Sword Armor Flame Beast felt a little uncomfortable, finding it more difficult to breathe.
But there was a change up ahead. A faint green glow emanated from the pitch-black seabed trench, like a gloomy river stretching for kilometers leading to death.
Even the Sword Armor Flame Beast found this sight somewhat creepy Oh, no, it was creepy to beasts.
This time, the Single-horned Tiger Whale let out a low call: Chirp! Be careful, brother. There are many of them, especially the two big fellows.
As it got closer, the Sword Armor Flame Beast found out what had injured the Tiger Whale.
They saw that deep within the sea trench covered with green ore, several crustacean creatures with four pairs of long legs and a giant pincer, resembling both crabs and spiders, dwelt.
These Mutated Creatures were numerous and covered in a thick, integrated shell. The smallest of them had bodies over ten meters long and eight meters wide, with their four pairs of spider legs extending over twenty meters when fully spread.
The larger ones were about twenty meters long, with their spider legs spreading more than thirty meters wide. Their armor-like gray-black shells exuded a sense of heaviness and solidity.
As for the big fellows mentioned by the Single-horned Tiger Whale, they were two Giant Beasts with a body length of up to thirty meters and large spider legs stretching nearly fifty meters wide.
However, due to the overly slender legs, the oppressive aura was a bit weaker, but they were still considered Level 7 creatures.
At the same time, around this sea trench were numerous skeletons of giant creatures, densely covering the ground, showing just how vicious these Crustacean Mutant Beasts were.
As the saying goes, enemies are especially red-eyed when they meet. After bringing its brother to take revenge, the Single-horned Tiger Whale charged forward from the darkness.
Boom!
With the Tiger Whales massive mouth wide open, a terrifying suction force erupted, transforming into a Devouring Vortex covering a range of over a hundred meters.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The raging vortex dragged everything around into it, muddying the water with sand and rocks and causing ores and four Crustacean Mutant Beasts, each over twenty meters in length, to rotate within it.
Crack! Crack!
Under the deep-sea strangulation talent, those Crustacean Mutant Beasts that had been dragged deep into the vortex had their slender spider legs continuously breaking, followed by their giant pincers.
Within the blink of an eye, the four Mutated Beasts turned into bare conical shapes, with one of them being seized by the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Squeak! Squeak! Squeak!
Under the terrifying bite force, the body of the Crustacean Mutant Beast let out a huge metal grinding sound, tearing apart but not being crushed by the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
These creatures had very solid bodily structures.
At this moment, the entire sea trench was in turmoil, as numerous Mutated Crustacean Beasts emerged from the dark rocks below and crawled en masse towards the area.
There were more than thirty of them in total.eastern fantasy
Although most were small Crustacean Mutant Beasts with a body length of just over ten meters and four pairs of fully spread spider legs extending to twenty meters, their collective momentum was nevertheless quite imposing.
Seeing this, the Single-horned Tiger Whale became even more violent and spat out the dead Crustacean Mutant Beast from its mouth.
Powerful black and white energy erupted from its body, covering it completely, especially the few meters thick front part of its head which formed a huge black and white whale-shaped shield.
Apparently, this layer of black and white energy shield was its evolved new ability.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
With the thick shield protecting it, the giant Tiger Whale charged into the horde of Crustacean Mutant Beasts like a battle tank, ramming and sending them flying one after another.
Under the powerful impact force, many smaller Crustacean Mutant Beasts were sent flying, their spider legs breaking and smashing against the trenchs walls on both sides.
For a time, the seabed quaked, and the water flow grew violent.
However, those Crustacean Mutant Beasts were not to be underestimated either.
Their pincers were very sharp and possessed a mysterious black-blue energy on them, exuding a sharp aura..

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 136: The Underworld River, Swallowing Instinct_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 136: The Underworld River, Swallowing Instinct_2
Translator: 549690339
These giant pincers covered in dark blue energy were extremely sharp, able to tear through the energy shielding on the Single-horned Tiger Whales body and viciously clamp onto it.
Especially the strongest two of them, their huge pincers clamped down with a thunderous boom as the Single-horned Tiger Whale charged, tearing through the energy shield and thick scale armor, leaving four massive wounds.
Furthermore, these Crustacean Mutant Beasts were very agile. When their colossal bodies were flung away, their eight legs moved quickly in the water, controlling their landing.
Bang!
Just then, an enormous black claw descended from the sky, with a crash landing on the head of a small Crustacean Mutant Beast that was over ten meters long.
The terrifying force caused the seawater to instantly explode, and the shell thicker than tank armor cracked and crumbled, with half of the body smashed to pieces by the Sword Armor Flame Beast in one strike.
At the same time, a black bone spur penetrated through the seawater. It shot out at an almost sonic terrifying speed, piercing through the head of a Crustacean Mutant Beast that landed on one side.
As the density of its body increased and its length approached the twenty-meter growth limit, the power of the Sword Armor Flame Beast became more and more terrifying.
Its muscle explosion increased its strength even further, as its scale armor grew thicker and more robust. Its speed was also more agile, far surpassing many times that of other Mutated Beasts of the same level.
In particular, after that battle with the deep-sea octopus a few days ago, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had been practicing controlling its Power Explosion talent.
At present, it could barely make the muscles of its right claw swell, its strength stabilizing at around ten times. Under this condition, its casual strikes could unleash a horrifying power.eastern fantasy
Only when the full-force Power Explosion increased by tens or hundreds of times would it need to accumulate power.
At this time, tens of times of power were condensed within a two-meter range of the Sword Armor Flame Beasts right claw, resulting in an instant explosion of tremendous pressure that was almost annihilating everything.
Even though the Crustacean Mutant Beasts shell was astonishingly thick and tough, comparable to alloy, and their body structure was somewhat similar to that of the Iron Beetles, they couldnt withstand the Sword Armor Flame Beasts attack.
As a result, the Single-horned Tiger Whale charged head-on, attracting the attention of most of the Crustacean Mutant Beasts.
With most of its aura hidden, the Sword Armor Flame Beast lurked in the darkness, continuously killing the scattered Crustacean Mutant Beasts.
Working together, in just a short while, more than ten Crustacean Mutant Beasts were killed under the Sword Armor Flame Beasts massive claws. It was only by this time that the other Crustacean Mutant Beasts realized that something was wrong.
Squeak!
Accompanied by a sharp cry, the largest Crustacean Mutant Beast roared in rage, its giant spider legs moving rapidly as it turned to pounce on the Sword Armor Flame Beast in the distance.
With a solid base in the seabed, the speed of this Crustacean Mutant Beast was rapid. In the blink of an eye, its massive form, accompanied by turbulent currents, covered several hundred meters.
However, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was not slow either. In a flash, it turned into a black shadow and dodged the attack.
Boom!
The black Mutated Beast slammed out a claw, shattering the half-shell of a twenty-meter long Crustacean Mutant Beast. Its black tail passed through the wound, smashing its brain and killing it.
In comparison to the Crustacean Mutant Beasts that were more than ten meters long, those that reached twenty meters had stronger defenses.
Crack! The pincer emitting black and blue light fell on the Sword Armor Flame Beasts back, creating a string of Vacuum Bubbles.
Even the Sword Armor Flame Beast couldnt defend against the sharp edge of those pincers, which had cut two huge scars that were one centimeter deep and several meters long.
Bang!
Attacked, the Sword Armor Flame Beast turned around, its two claws falling simultaneously. The terrifying Power Explosion shattered half of the twenty-meter long Mutated Beasts body.
The seawater was also blasted into a circle of vacuum, creating a shockwave that spread tens of meters away, with an astonishing momentum.
In the murky seawater, the Sword Armor Flame Beast glanced at its rapidly healing scale armor on its back, its icy gaze not showing any fluctuation in the faint golden vertical pupils.
Its outer armor was not like the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which, although appeared thick, had only average defenses.
The black and blue energy wrapped around the pincers had a strong tearing property against the protective energy, but was ineffective against the hard outer armor.
In addition, the majority of the attacking force was repelled by the special structure of the outer armor, making it impossible for the sharp pincers to genuinely penetrate the Sword Armor Flame Beasts defenses.
Squeak! Squeak! Squeak! Brother, keep on killing, lets finish off these tough guys!
Looking at the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which nimbly shuttled through the sea trench and continuously killed one Crustacean Mutant Beast after another, the Single-horned Tiger Whale was very excited and its massive body charged forward once more.
Boom! The furious Devouring Vortex stirred the seawater, holding and restraining some Crustacean Mutant Beasts that wanted to gang up on the Sword Armor Flame Beast.
At this moment, the tail of the huge whale swung and, with a bang, swept away the giant Crustacean Mutant Beast behind it as two more wounds were torn open on its body.
Meanwhile, under the pursuit of another giant Crustacean Mutant Beast, the Sword Armor Flame Beast continued to kill the smaller Crustacean Beasts.
Soon, in the relentless killing of the two gigantic beasts, about thirty Crustacean Mutant Beasts were killed in just a brief moment, their spider legs crushed into pieces.
Only two of the largest Crustacean Mutant Beasts remained, their spider legs spread across forty to fifty meters.
Squeak! Squeak! Squeak! Squeak! Watching their offspring being nearly wiped out, the eyes of the two Crustacean Mutant Beasts turned red, emanating an insane killing intent.
Roar! Roar! One beast, one head.
Squeak! Squeak! Lets finish them off!
Amid the low roar, the Sword Armor Flame Beast charged toward the giant Crustacean Beast on the left first.
Boom! Boom! Like scythe-like spikes, two-meter-diameter giant legs smashed down from the sky, landing heavily on the seabed and stirring up rolling sand. The Sword Armor Flame Beast skillfully dodged with a flash.
Seeing the black Mutated Beast lunging towards it, the giant Crustacean Mutant Beast swept its two pincers across, one left and one right, bringing up furious sea waves that rolled in..

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 136: The Underworld River,
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 136: The Underworld River,
Devouring Instinct_3
Translator: 549690339
As the battle went on, sand and rocks flew around, creating quite a frightening scene. The most important aspect was the moment the two giant pincers clamped down, slightly resembling the eruption of a mantis shrimp.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast instinctively dodged to the side.
Boom, boom!! The two deep-sea-like blasts erupted simultaneously, blasting past the Sword Armor Flame Beast and hitting the sea trench cliff hundreds of meters away.
In an instant, the mountain wall shook and collapsed, and countless broken stones splattered around, creating two huge deep pit craters over ten meters in diameter.
Such terrifying power left the Sword Armor Flame Beast, who had narrowly escaped the attack, in shock.
Apparently, in addition to the Black Power that made the giant pincers incredibly sharp, they also had the instantaneous explosive ability similar to that of a mantis shrimp.
Whoosh! At this moment, red flames leaped around on the Sword Armor Flame Beast, transforming it into a Fire Giant Beast in the blink of an eye, radiating intense heat.
At the moment of the Crustacean Mutant Beasts pincer explosion, the Sword Armor Flame Beast dodged the attack, stretching out its double claws to grab the Crustacean Giant Beasts left pincer and landing on its hind legs, standing upright.
Boom!
Under the horrifying hundred-fold power burst, the enormous Crustacean Mutant Beast was directly swung up by the Sword Armor Flame Beast, accompanied by a raging torrent of sea water, and slammed into the ground.
In an instant, the entire sea trench shook violently, with shockwaves stirring up endless silt, making the area within hundreds of meters range muddy.
At the same time, the belly of the overturned Crustacean Giant Beast was exposed. Not waiting for it to react, the Sword Armor Flame Beast pounced on it.
At the moment the Sword Armor Flame Beast landed on its belly, the Crustacean Giant Beast, sensing death, went crazy, thrashing its long legs around.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!! The sharp legs, up to 2 meters in diameter, shattered rocks and kicked up silt, making the seawater even murkier and creating a massive commotion.
But because of their excessive length, the legs couldnt reach the Sword Armor Flame Beast that was on its belly, leaving the Crustacean Giant Beast no choice but to howl helplessly as its abdomen was torn apart.
At that moment, the Sword Armor Flame Beasts double claws unleashed their power, ripping the Crustacean Giant Beasts belly apart. Its huge body then slammed to the ground with a loud thud, not moving anymore.
Meanwhile, as the Sword Armor Flame Beast battled and killed one Crustacean Giant Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Whales fight with another was much more brutal.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale stubbornly bit and held onto half of the Crustacean Giant Beasts body, ignoring the giant wounds left by the pincers, and madly charged at the mountain wall.
Each time they collided with the sea trench cliff from hundreds of meters away, a horrifying impact would occur, with hundreds to thousands of tons of broken stones falling, turning the sky dark.
The sight of this crazy fighting style caused even the Sword Armor Flame Beast, who had already killed a Crustacean Giant Beast, to twitch in the corner of its eyes.
Compared to humans, when beasts have similar defense, strength, agility, and energy protection, they put their size and combat experience to the test.
Obviously, this Single-horned Tiger Whale knew how to make use of its tough skin and thick flesh.
About ten minutes later, the entire sea trench finally calmed down. The Single-horned Tiger Whale angrily smashed and spit out the corpse of the Giant Beast with its mouth, which had half of its body and several long legs dangling.
Ying Ying Ying!! Brother, we won.
Looking at the Single-horned Tiger Whale, covered in huge wounds and battered but with a gleeful expression in his eyes, the Sword Armor Flame Beast speechlessly shook its head.
Roar Roar!! Your combat skills are too clumsy; you harm the enemy by a thousand but suffer eight hundred yourself.
Ying Ying Ying!! What does one thousand and eight hundred mean?
Roar Roar!! It means you should be more agile next time, so you dont kill the enemy while leaving yourself covered in scars.
Ying Ying Ying!! I wish 1 could, but I was born like this. The Single-horned Tiger Whale looked enviously at the Sword Armor Flame Beasts sharp claws and flexible tail.eastern fantasy
Roar Roar!! Enough talk. Where are the good things?
Ying Ying Ying!! Over there.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale then led the way to the end of the green sea trench with a flick of its massive tail.
Swimming along the sea trench, which looked like a river in the underworld, the Sword Armor Flame Beast sensed that the Heavenly Energy around them grew thicker as they neared the end of the trench.
When they reached the end, they saw a faint green light emanating from a narrow crack on the mountain wall that was less than 0.5 meters high and less than three centimeters wide.
Rich Heavenly Energy continuously poured out from the opposite side of the crack, emitting a refreshing aura that invigorated the beast.
Compared to the World Rift that the Sword Armor Flame Beast had accidentally encountered earlier, this green crack was slightly smaller but much more stable.
In the Heavenly Energy flowing out were mixed some special green energy. These energies drifted through the seawater like catkins and would adhere to the surrounding rocks when they landed.
Gradually, the stones turned green, glowing like ore.
Apart from that, right below the crack, some green energy that looked like essence gathered, turning into tiny green crystal grains that sank to the seabed.
Seeing those green crystal grains, the Sword Armor Flame Beast felt an instinctual urge to devour them..

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 137: Surge in Evolution Value, Moving Mountains and Filling Seas (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 137: Surge in Evolution Value, Moving Mountains and Filling Seas (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
Roar!! Is this the good stuff you were talking about?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast looked at the tiny bits of green crystal particles under the crack, which added up to not even a small handful, and felt somewhat displeased.
Whimper!! These good things couldnt be kept, they were all eaten by those guys. The Single-horned Tiger Whale swung its tail and explained with a whimper.
Roar!! How are we supposed to share this? The Sword Armor Flame Beast pointed with its huge claw.
Such a small amount of stuff, it felt like it wouldnt even fit between its teeth. Was it supposed to use its giant claws to pick up a little bit and smell it?
Whimper!! Brother, you helped me take revenge this time; you can eat all these good things. The Single-horned Tiger Whale seemed very righteous.
However, the Sword Armor Flame Beast knew that this guy wasnt that stupid. Otherwise, he wouldnt have come to find it after discovering these good things and realizing that he couldnt beat those guarding Crustacean Giant Beasts.
Roar! Then 1 wont be polite.
Saying that, the Sword Armor Flame Beasts tail swayed slightly and swam over. Its huge mouth opened wide, and a strong suction force emerged, swallowing the green crystal grains scattered on the rocks.
As these crystal grains were swallowed into its belly, an extremely pure and vigorous life energy exploded inside the Sword Armor Flame Beasts body.
Crack crack!!
Under the influence of that life energy, the Sword Armor Flame Beasts body began to expand like an inflating balloon at a visible speed, its exoskeleton armor became thicker, and its breath became fiercer.
Just a small amount of green crystal grains had caused the Sword Armor Flame Beasts body size to skyrocket, reaching 19 meters.
Besides, its Evolution value had also suddenly surged a lot, from over 2500 to more than 2700, which was only a little over 200 points away from the requirement.
Phew!! Such an amazing growth. The Sword Armor Flame Beasts eyes suddenly turned red, and its gaze, filled with intense killing intent, looked at the green cracks.
Those Crustacean Mutated Beasts deserved to die, for they actually ate up all the life crystals accumulated over the years.
No wonder they could grow so big and so many in number.
While the Sword Armor Flame Beast was thinking hatefully about whether or not it should go back and kill those Mutated Beasts one more time, the Single-horned Tiger Whale behind it called out enviously.
Whimper!! Brother, shall we leave now?
Roar!! Wait, we cant just leave this place.eastern fantasy
The Sword Armor Flame Beast signaled for the Single-horned Tiger Whale to go a little further away, then it rushed up to the sea trenchs edge over 200 meters high and stood upright behind the cliff.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast raised its double claws, and the terrifying power gathered beneath its swelling muscles.
Boom!
As the Sword Armor Flame Beast unleashed its Power Explosion, half of the mountain wall collapsed, and countless huge rocks and debris fell with muddy sand, submerging the sea trench.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast felt that the place was still not safe, so it continuously attacked the sides of the sea trench, which was more than 200 meters deep and 100 meters wide, ultimately destroying that section.
It wanted to bury this place and use it as a fixed resource gathering point. It would return later when the life crystal particles had accumulated more and dig them out.
Of course, the premise was that no other perceptive Mutated Creatures discovered it.
In the muddy seawater, the Single-horned Tiger Whale looked at the almost destroyed and filled sea trench, feeling somewhat dumbfounded.
Whimper!! Brother, if you bury this place, how will we eat next time?
Roar!! Its simple, just dig a hole to get in.
Whimper!! How to dig?
Roar!! With claws, dummy.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale looked at its thick fins, and then at the sharp four-clawed Sword Armor Flame Beast, feeling puzzled. Was it supposed to dig with its head next time?
Roar!! Lets go and eat all those guys.
This time the harvest was not limited to the life crystals but also the corpses of dozens of Mutated Beasts.
However
Crack!! The Sword Armor Flame Beast tore apart the armor of a 15-meter-long Crustacean Mutated Beast and looked at the bit of flesh and blood in its abdomen with some speechlessness.
The unyielding beast grabbed a hard, sharp, one-meter-thick spider leg and broke it with a burst of power from its double claws.
Looking at that white, meat-like, fascia-like substance in the middle of the spider leg, the Sword Armor Flame Beast felt a bit pained: These guys used everything to grow their exoskeleton armor.
These Crustaceans had grown very quickly by guarding the cracks, but their biological features had all been developed into their exoskeleton armor, and there was not even a tenth of the flesh and blood inside their bodies.
But even a mosquito is still meat, and the Sword Armor Flame Beast did not give up.
Like eating a giant crab, crack, crack, it dismantled the bodies of the Crustacean Mutated Beasts one by one and tore them apart.
Mmm, this Super Emperor Crab may have less meat, but it tastes chewy, and the energy is rich. It might take half a day to cook it in a pot.
Mmm, it seems that theres a paste inside the body of this Super Emperor Spider Crab, which looks disgusting and sticky, but it tastes quite good.
If grilled on volcanic magma, it might taste even better.
The legs of this one never mind, the exoskeleton armor is too hard to chew, its not as good as eating the head.
Huh! Not bad, the flesh of this one is a bit tender and fragrant.
As the Sword Armor Flame Beast was dissecting a 20-meter-long Crustacean Mutant Beast, a bright crystal appeared in its eyes.
Level 4 Life Crystal.
The corners of the Sword Armor Flame Beasts mouth curled up slightly, revealing a ferocious smile.
Using its huge claw, the Sword Armor Flame Beast carefully picked up the Life Crystal, which looked as small as an imperceptible grain of sand, and gently put it into the snake skin bag under its neck.
With the addition of a crystal, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was in a great mood. Like a diligent little bee, it nibbled and nibbled until it had eaten all the Crustacean Mutated Beasts before finally stopping..

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 137: Evolution Value Skyrockets, Moving Mountains and Filling Seas (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 137: Evolution Value Skyrockets, Moving Mountains and Filling Seas (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
Dozens of differently sized Mutated Beast Meats were devoured, providing the Sword Armor Flame Beast with another hundred Evolution points, causing it to grow to 19.5 meters long.
At this point, it seemed to become even more massive and terrifying.
Ying ying ying! Let’s go, let’s go.
Roar! Let’s go.
With that, the two colossal Mutated Beasts moved towards the sea surface, one ahead and one behind, reaching the surface within a few breaths.
Boom!
A huge splash erupted, and a giant 31-meter-long Tiger Whale burst out of the sea surface, flying several meters high, before crashing down with a loud bang to create massive waves.
It seemed that the Single-horned Tiger Whale was delighted to have its revenge.
Behind the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Sword Armor Flame Beast looked much more low-key, hiding its figure about 10 meters below the water’s surface, following the sense of direction given by its main body.
This was how the Sword Armor Flame Beast ensured it wouldn’t get lost in the sea.
Through the location of Jack Clark’s main body, it could constantly determine its own direction and then calculate the distance based on the ups and downs of the seabed and water depth.
Of course, this method could only be used in familiar sea areas, and once entering the deep sea, it could only be used to determine direction.
“Today, there are only four level 1 missions and one level 2 mission refreshed.
It seems that almost all the Mutated Beasts in this batch have been killed.”
In the mission hall, many students looked at the high-definition mountain map on the big screen and sighed slightly.
At this moment, the map was bright and clean, and there hadn’t been any mission refreshes for more than ten minutes. The few missions that had been refreshed were scattered in all directions.
“Tomorrow will mark the half-month mission’s end, the official’s calculation is accurate.”
“This is normal – every year, the officials conduct a big sweep, killing these Mutated Beasts like cutting leeks, one batch after another for decades.”
“You’re right. Thanks to the country’s Heaven and Earth Trap arrangement, these newly evolved Mutated Beasts have nowhere to hide.”
“Actually, we should be grateful that the officials have been suppressing the growth of Mutated Beasts. Otherwise, the wilderness would be far more dangerous, especially for ordinary people.”
“Even so, the number of incidents involving Mutated Beasts harming people has been increasing year by year.”
“Yes.”
“Tomorrow, this place might end early, 1 made a good harvest this time, earning 19 Contribution points.”
“Awesome, 1 only earned 13 points.”
“But I’ve cultivated to the Late-stage of First Layer Heaven. After going back to exchange a Level 1 Life Crystal and energy resources, I should be able to break through the Second Layer Heaven soon.”
Another student in the Second Layer Heaven boasted, “You guys are really useless. It took you nearly half a month to earn this much! 1 earned a total of 41 Contribution Points this time.”
“Of course, if I were in the Second Layer Heaven, 1 would have earned that much too…”
In the hall, more than 300 students were sitting or standing, discussing their harvest from this trial in groups, their faces excited and thrilled.
For these students, who had only received three or four Contribution Points in the previous month, everyone made a fortune from this cleanup mission.
Students who were in the First Layer Heaven generally earned more than ten points, some even more than twenty points.
Students in the Second Layer Heaven earned a bit more, with most earning thirty or forty points, especially those who were elites that had returned from the trial.
The most impressive student in the Second Layer Heaven earned over seventy Contribution Points.
These geniuses could fight a Level Two Mutated Beast on their own, and when faced with an ordinary Level Two Mutated Beast, they could even take on two.
If it weren’t for having to delve deep into the mountains, they would have been able to earn more points if they didn’t have to spend more than half their time traveling and transporting the corpses of Mutated Beasts.
Of course, the ones who gained the most from this trial were the geniuses of the Third Layer Heaven.
Those who had returned from the trial and broken through to the Third Layer Heaven in just over four months were all formidable, and could even kill a Level 3 Mutant Beast on their own.
These people had mostly accumulated around one hundred Contribution Points, and this was only due to the scarcity of level 3 missions after the first two days.
Out of all of them, Jack Clark’s harvest was the largest.
Excluding the 300 points needed to exchange for the Dragon Elephant Overlord
Body, he had earned more than 80 points this week, accumulating over 300 points in total.
This total did not take into account the 70 points he already had.
Freya Louise, who had followed Jack Clark for several days, also earned a lot. Along with her efforts after they separated, she earned around 140 points in total.
Of course, the main reason Jack Clark was able to earn so much was his terrifying base strengthen the First Layer Heaven, those students with a strength of six or seven hundred kilograms in their arms can drag a one-ton Mutated Beast corpse with the support of True Strength.
Foundation Establishment cultivators in the Third Layer Heaven with an arm strength of one or two thousand kilograms can barely drag a Level 3 Mutated Beast corpse out of the mountains, taking half a day to do so. On the other hand, Jack Clark can carry a ten-ton Mutated Beast and sprint.
Not to mention a Level 2 Mutated Beast.
Even a Level 2 Mission can accumulate a considerable number of Contribution Points by running more than twice a day.
However, not everyone was able to gain something this time; some students were scared at the sight of blood, and instead of earning Contribution Points, they were sent to the hospital by Mutated Beasts.
In addition, some students who came to join in the fun chose to go back after experiencing a battleground, including more than a dozen in the Second Layer Heaven.
That’s because they realized they didn’t have the courage to face danger.
Rather than battling Mutated Beasts, they yearned for a peaceful and stable life.
There were quite a few people like this. After Senior One, many students who had broken through the First Layer Heaven would choose to switch to the humanities.
After all, not everyone had the spirit of adventure, and only a few dared to go to the battlefield and fight those terrifying Mutated Beasts.
Of course, after switching to the humanities, it doesn’t mean they would stop cultivating; they just wanted to quietly cultivate without competing with classmates for resources.
No one could say their choice was wrong.
After all, many geniuses fell to the wayside under such competition, while these classmates who chose to cultivate quietly, though progressing slower, managed to survive in the rear.
Of course, the school and country would no longer provide resources or fixed monthly contributions to these students.
That is, unless they made outstanding contributions to society and the country in the future.
From the corner of her eye, Freya Louise looked at the handsome youth beside her and whispered, “When you go back tomorrow, you’ll be preparing to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven, right?”
In Freya’s opinion, Jack Clark was already on the verge of breaking through the late stage at the beginning of last month. Now, a month has passed, and he should already be in the late-stage Third Layer Heaven.
Once they return and exchange for the dragon essence blood and other enhancement resources, Jack Clark should be able to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven soon with his terrifying talent.
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Almost.”
He currently had 89 Contribution Points, more than enough to exchange for the dragon essence blood. He just hadn’t gone back yet to earn more Contribution Points.
After breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven tomorrow, the Sword Armor Flame Beast’s Evolution value would almost have accumulated to 3000.
Once his Avatar has evolved, Jack Clark will be heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield.
By then, with his strength, slaying a Level 4 Mutated Beast would be as easy as cutting vegetables, and the speed of earning Contribution Points would be even faster, possibly reaching a thousand in a month.
“Look, another mission has been posted.”
“Hold on, it’s a Level 4 Task.”
The suddenly-refreshed Level 4 Task immediately made the hall lively.
Although the official would clear them yearly, Mutated Beasts with special talents could evolve to Level 4 within a year, just like humans.
Or perhaps they were mutants that slipped through the net in previous years, hiding deep within the mountains before growing to Level 4 over several years.
However, once they reached Level 4, these Mutated Beasts could no longer hide.
Due to their size and talent, their need for food would be even greater, which meant they had to expand their range of activity and inevitably be discovered by humans.
“Mutated Dragon Armor Beast, a Mutated Beast suspected of awakening a trace of Dragon Bloodline. Level 4, strong combat ability. Requires a team of five elite Third Layer Heaven or higher to take on the task.”
“This task is 130 kilometers deep into the mountains; if no one takes it within one day, the military expert will handle it.”
Upon seeing the introduction flashing on the big screen, someone exclaimed, “It actually awakened a trace of Dragon Bloodline. What a waste.”
“Heh! Now no one can complete it.” Someone gloated.
Mutated Beasts were not weaker than cultivators of the same level due to their size and talents. This time, the beast also happened to be a powerful Dragon-type creature.
Such creatures, like those who had awakened a trace of king-level bloodline, had combat abilities far exceeding their own realms, making them terrifying.
Moreover, at Level 4, even geniuses in the Third Layer Heaven couldn’t necessarily compete and kill them, plus the risk was considerable as someone might die.
Therefore, no one stepped forward at first.
Even Carney Lee and Elvis Raven, who had broken through to the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase in just a few days with the help of numerous resources, exchanged bitter smiles with each other.
Because the gap was too wide.
At that moment, Jack Clark, carrying a combat knife on his back, stepped forward, scanning the surroundings and said indifferently, “If no one is willing to take on the task, then 1’11 handle it..”

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 138: Giant Beast Jack Clark, Super Electromagnetic Cannon (Requesting Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 138: Giant Beast Jack Clark, Super Electromagnetic Cannon (Requesting Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark.
Seeing Jack Clark step forward, many people’s eyes paused for a moment, especially those students from South Sky Martial Height.
As the previous trial had returned, many people had heard of the exploits of Jack Clark and others.
For instance, he and Howard Lee, Justin Welan, who had just broken through to the Third Layer Heaven, had, with their initial stage of the Third Layer Heaven, hunted down a King-level Bloodline Mutant Beast at the peak of the Third Layer Heaven.
Moreover, near the end of the trial, they had went to Erica Knowles, defeated, and killed the Blood God Sect Blood Envoy in the mid-stage of Fourth Layer Heaven with the Third Layer Heaven.
Adding to their frightening combat power that almost swept those Mutated Beasts recently, perhaps he really does have the hope of killing that Dragon Armor Beast.
At this time, Elvis Raven who had reached mid-stage of Third Layer Heaven said subtly, “Jack Clark, your strength is indeed great, but as this Level 4 Task requires teaming up, how about…”
Jack Clark shook his head: “I have a team.”
As he spoke, wearing her battle armor and looking heroic, Freya Louise came out who carried a huge sniper rifle behind her, her delicate face beaming a faint smile.
“But the task requires a team of five elite Triple Realm…” Elvis Raven still hesitated to give up as it would have at least been a super task that would have contributed more than a hundred points.
Under normal conditions, ordinary Level 4 Mutated Creatures would be worth about fifty or sixty contributions, but the value of bloodlines belonging to this Dragon class would be doubled.
Jack Clark spoke lightly: “This is not a problem, my authority allows me to ignore that requirement.”
Returning from the trial, the seemingly useless advancement to 11+ had a lot of invisible benefits.
Not only could it view many hidden information, require a lower exchange, but also during these special tasks, complete them with a higher authority that disregarded requirements.
In the afternoon, sunlight spilled through the branches.
Through the mountain forest, Jack Clark and Freya Louise, carrying their combat knives on their backs, swiftly passing, almost blinking, tens of kilometers away, running with the girls closely following behind Jack Clark.
Taking more than half a day to get over the 100 kilometers of the Deep Mountain, including locating the path on the map and the fact they started in the morning.
Of course, this was because Freya was with him. Otherwise, at Jack Clark’s speed, it would take at most an hour and a half to arrive, even in the rugged mountain roads.
In the situation of 100 meters a second, it would take less than half an hour to travel more than 100 kilometers in a straight line.
Suddenly, Jack Clark and the two stopped and stood at the edge of a cliff.
Below was a huge canyon spanning tens of kilometers. In the middle of it, rocks and stones were everywhere, with lush trees on both sides, wet and tranquil air.
Too quiet to be normal.
