Jack Clark lifted his wrist, and a pale three-dimensional projection map flickered slightly on it.
After comparing it with the map, Jack Clark nodded: “This is it.”
“According to satellite shooting and photonic image detection, the range of predation for that mutated creature covers tens of kilometers around it, but it mostly resides in this canyon.”
“Freya, you find a sniping point up there, and when the opportunity arises, provide me with fire support. I’ll go down and draw it out.”
The girl nodded, reminding, “Be careful, the talent of this mutated beast, which awakened to the dragon bloodline, is unknown and might be very powerful.”
“Yeah, I won’t underestimate it.”
Although his combat power had reached the Late Fourth Layer Heaven or even its peak, Jack Clark still didn’t underestimate it, nor underestimated Freya’s ‘lethality’.
This was also the reason he called Freya over, to have an extra insurance.
Whoosh!
Jack Clark directly jumped off the mountain cliff, and covered by battle armor, his right hand was wrapped in substantial black real power. His five fingers pierced into the rock as if poking into tofu.
In the sound of broken rocks, Jack Clark slid directly down the hundred-meter-high cliff, and let go of his hand about ten meters above the ground.
Boom! Wearing battle boots, his legs sank 0.5 meters into the ground. Immediately after, Jack Clark nonchalantly pulled his feet out of the dirt and onto solid ground.
Standing at the base of the cliff, Jack Clark glanced around and suddenly let out a long dragon-like howl that echoed throughout the Deep Mountain.
In that moment, countless birds were frightened and took flight from the mountain forest.
Boom!
The ground shattered, and Jack Clark charged through the air in a raging wind. The long white wave burst out behind him, tearing open a sharp whistling sound as he dashed through the middle of the canyon.
These powerful mutated creatures all had territorial concepts, so there was no need to look for them at all.
As long as Jack Clark provoked them by displaying his aura, they would come to his doorstep on their own.
Grrr! Just when Jack Clark had crossed a distance of more than a kilometer and rushed to the middle of the canyon, he heard a fierce roar followed by a raging wind.
Boom, boom, boom!
The trees in the forest burst open, and amidst the swaying branches, a
17-meter-long mutated creature with yellow scales covering its five-meter tall body rushed out.
The ferocious Whipoorwill’s aura was astounding, carrying the breath of legend, the terrifying Dragon Might that sent chills down their spines.
As the Dragon Armor Beast breathed, it crossed hundreds of meters in distance, its tremendous speed stirring up a violent wind as its gigantic claws swooped down on Jack Clark, who had intruded on its territory.
With a roar, a huge shadow fell down heavily.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark disappeared, a ten-meter-high rock weighing tens of tons exploded beneath the Dragon Armor Beast’s claw. Numerous fragments scattered, smoke and dust rolled, an astonishing sight.
Grrr!
Accompanied by the ferocious roar, a thick dragon tail swept vicious winds through the smoke and dust, instantly appearing in front of Jack Clark with a remnant shadow.
This time, Jack Clark didn’t dodge anymore. The black real power emerged, and an overbearing and violent aura erupted from his body, causing his whole being to instantly expand into a circle.
Grrr! A dragon chant echoed, and the light from Jack Clark’s knife in hand seemed like a streak of pitch-black lightning in the sky.
A horrifying slash fell upon the dragon tail in an instant, and a circle of black and yellow impact exploded immediately..

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 138: Giant Beast Jack Clark, Super Electromagnetic Cannon (Requesting Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 138: Giant Beast Jack Clark, Super Electromagnetic Cannon (Requesting Monthly Ticket)_2
Translator: 549690339
Immediately, the ground under Jack Clark shattered with a crash, and his whole body was blasted back more than ten meters under an astonishing force, gouging out two deep marks on the ground.
“That strength, it’s not quite right,” Jack’s expression became slightly serious.
With the six-fold increase of Dragon Elephant Body Truth Power, the combat knife slashed out at a subsonic speed. It could cut down half a building with a single strike.
However, when the combat knife tore through the protective energy on the tail of the Mutated Dragon Armor Beast and landed on its scale armor, it was blocked by a crimson blood light above.
Those crimson energies, like a blood net, covered the entire Dragon Armor Beast, weakening sharp attacks terrifyingly.
It was as if the ability had evolved explicitly to counter slashing and tearing weapons or fanged teeth.
Obviously, this blood power was its Dragon Talent, and in combination with the thick and durable dragon scales, it had a perverted defense.
In this situation, even the Strengthening +10 combat knife, which had some demon-crushing properties, could only open the scale armor and leave a 0.5-meter long and io-centimeter deep wound.

However, this wound was nothing more than a fruit knife scratch to the huge mutated beast.
Roar!
An injured Mutated Dragon Armor Beast let out a furious roar in an instant. Its enormous body turned and attacked, clawed-wing clouds tearing apart Jack’s afterimage.
In an instant, Jack leaped up, and as the Dragon Armor Beast landed, its knife light scattered like a whiplash, exuding a sharp breath as it slashed towards its thick neck.
But the Mutated Dragon Armor Beast reacted astonishingly, and when it detected the coming sharpness, its body suddenly leaped forward.
Clang!
Sparks burst out, and the unmatched sharp knife left a 2-meter-long, 10-centimeter-deep crack on the back of the Dragon Armor Beast, barely splitting open the thick scale armor.
But most of the sharp tearing force was still repelled by the bloodline power, causing Jack to frown slightly.
And in the moment his knife swung and paused in mid-air, the Dragon Armor Beast’s thick tail burst through the air again, sweeping towards Jack’s left arm. Bang!
A terrifying force exploded and a round of transparent airwaves opened up, Jack’s whole body blasted out and vanished into the depths of the forest with a white shockwave.
At the moment when the nimble and fierce Dragon Armor Beast hit Jack with its tail, a sudden flash of light appeared in the distance, followed by a fierce explosion engulfing it.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!
Raging, intense shock waves from the explosion swept through tens of meters, burning everything in its path, shattering rocks, and setting off an angry howl from the Dragon Armor Beast consumed by the high combustion explosion. Roar! Amidst the raging wind, the giant Dragon Armor Beast burst out of the sea of fire, its aura fierce, preparing to charge towards Freya Louise on the far side of the mountain cliff.
As a high-level mutant beast at the fourth level, it had a certain level of intelligence and knew that such long-range attackers needed to be taken down first.
But at that moment, a furious figure shot out of the forest.
At almost supersonic speed, the fierce aura of Jack appeared beside the Dragon Armor Beast; his leg stretched out like a battle axe.
Under the terrifying power, the Dragon Armor Beast, weighing tens of tons, was kicked out with a bang, crashing into and shattering a several-ton boulder tens of meters away.
At this moment, Jack turns his back on the combat knife, his figure more burly and imposing. The Qi Blood of his whole body burns like black and red radiance wrapping around him, emitting a terrifying and oppressive aura.
Jack’s low voice resounded through the earpiece.
“Freya, the talent of this mutated beast is absolute defense. Outside its yellow protective energy, there is also a feature on the surface of its scale armor that greatly eliminates sharp kinetic energy.”
“With the strengthening of the dragon bloodline, its defense has reached a terrifying state where it is difficult to cause fatal injuries, unless the attack strength exceeds the defense limit.”
“Next, I’ll draw its attention and deplete its bloodline power. You prepare the Gold Electromagnetic Armor Piercing Bullet and find a chance to give it a shot.” When faced with such an extreme defense, aBoundary creature in the mid-period of the fourth layer of heaven, and a powerhouse comparable to the peak of the fourth layer of heaven, the thin combat knife would not be able to bring out Jack Clark’s full strength.
Seeing this, he simply gave up the combat knife and directly activated the Elephant’s Fury Rune to enter burst mode.
Strength – it’s not like he didn’t have it.
Roar! The Dragon Armor Beast in the distance got up from the ground and roared furiously. Its eyes were filled with rage and hostility, as it unbelievably got kicked by this insect.
Unforgivable.
In its fury, the Dragon Armor Beast moved its vast body, rolled up a raging wind, and rushed towards Jack Clark at a terrifying speed, its huge claws flashing with cold light and striking an alarming pose.
Boom!
Dirt erupted under Jack Clark’s feet, and he blasted off like a bullet, appearing in front of the Dragon Armor Beast instantly at an even faster speed, sweeping its legs wrapped in a black and red whirlwind.
Dragon Elephant Upside Down, the third layer complementary move of Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.
Boom!
At this moment, Jack’s power was no less than that of the Giant Beast, and even more flexible and overbearing. Just like an upside-down Dragon Elephant, his strike kicked the beast and sent it flying.
As the Dragon Armor Beast’s body was sent flying and fell tens of meters in a flash, dirt exploded under Jack’s feet, and he blasted through the air at subsonic speed and chased after it.
Roar, roar, roar! Bang, bang, bang!
A kilometer away on the mountain cliff, Freya Louise had a shocked expression as she watched the shaking ground below, the exploding rocks, and the rolling smoke and dust in the valley.
Especially when Jack gave up the combat knife and used the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body to fight the Dragon Armor Beast head-on. The overbearing and unparalleled aura was astonishing.
It gave Freya the illusion that Jack was an Overbearing Dragon Beast..

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 138: The Beast Jack Clark and the Super Electromagnetic Cannon (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 138: The Beast Jack Clark and the Super Electromagnetic Cannon (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
Jack Clark was suddenly sent flying by the claw of the Dragon Armor Beast. His figure, followed by after-images, crashed into a huge rock tens of meters away, smashing it to pieces.
However, shards of rock instantly exploded. The seemingly more ferocious Jack Clark got to his feet.
With True Power Protection, armor defense, and the strengthening of the Ten Times Defense, Jack Clark’s Defense reached a horrifying level, nothing short of the Dragon Armor Beast’s.
Roar!
The Dragon Armor Beast, with some of its scales broken, let out a savage roar. Its eyes glinted maliciously as it rushed at Jack Clark, who was charging towards it.
It refused to believe it couldn’t kill this insect.
Boom boom boom!! The man and the beast once again clashed. Where they passed, the earth cracked, trees broke, and stones exploded.

Suddenly, Freya Louise heard Jack Clark’s voice in her ear.
“Prepare.”
In the midst of the smoke and dust, Jack Clark took advantage of an opportunity to grab hold of the Dragon Armor Beast’s sturdy tail. His arm muscles bulged in an instant, a Power Explosion. He heaved the Mutated Beast, which weighed tens of tons in the air.
Hum!
Freya Louise, who had been prepared on the mountain cliff, narrowed her eyes. The Magnetic Energy Gun Barrel on the Magnetic Energy Weapon she held in her hand, which was over two meters long and twice as thick, lit up with an inscription, humming.
“Drop!” A sudden severe command exploded.
Jack Clark, who had twirled the Dragon Armor Beast by its tail ten times in the blink of an eye, suddenly put all his strength into a downward throw. In an instant, the earth in front of him cracked, countless dirt flying in the face of the horrifying power shock.
At the same time, Freya Louise pulled the trigger.
Biu!.
In an instant, all the hairs on Jack Clark’s body stood on end, sensing a terrifying danger approaching. The speed was so fast that it momentarily stunned the consciousness.
Bang! The Dragon Armor Beast, which had just been smashed into the ground, had not reacted yet. The thin red silk net left on its head was instantly torn by the Magnetic Energy Weapon.
Following that, scales on its lower jaw and back of the head exploded, flesh and blood flying everywhere. The huge head was blasted by this shot from Freya Louise, creating a face basin-sized through and through wound.
After piercing through the Dragon Armor Beast’s head, that Magnetic Energy Bullet finally left a fist-sized pitch-black deep hole in the ground and disappeared.
Such a terrifying penetrating killing power made even Jack Clark, who had seen it for the second time, freeze his gaze momentarily.
Phew! Feeling the life force disappearing from the Dragon Armor Beast’s body, Jack Clark slowly let out a breath. The violent and overbearing aura on his body gradually calmed down.
Then his aura weakened, and his face turned a bit pale, feeling the sensation of being hollowed out after seven consecutive discharges.
Feeling his legs starting to soften, Jack Clark gave a wry smile. The Elephant’s Fury Rune was indeed powerful, but it was a little harsh on the body.
While resting and recovering slightly, Jack Clark looked at the Mutated Beast in front of him, which was still over three meters high even when lying down, and pondered.
He found that compared to the Mutated Creatures in the ocean, these Mutated Beasts on land with claws, limbs, and flexible tails seemed stronger.
At that moment, Freya Louise slid down from the mountain wall with her sniper rifle on her back, and her figure quickly rushed over.
In a few breaths, the girl had run over. Looking at Jack Clark, who had been standing there immobile for a while, she asked with concern, “Jack Clark, are you alright?”
“Cough! I’m fine, just a bit weak from the previous burst. I’ll be okay after a bit of rest.”
“Glad to hear you’re fine.” At his words, Freya Louise let out a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, the burst didn’t last long. After only half an hour of rest, Jack Clark could feel his body filled with strength again.
“Let’s go, we should head back.” Pulling the tail of the Mutated Dragon Armor Beast, his body’s True Power Circulation resulted in a Power Explosion. He started running with a rumbling sound.
This was a task only he could do. Faced with the Mutated Beast corpse that weighed several tens of tons, Freya Louise was simply overpowered..

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 139: Breaking through the Fourth Layer of Heaven, The Terrifying True Power Attribute (Additional chapter for the Thirteenth Alliance Master)
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 139: Breaking through the Fourth Layer of Heaven, The Terrifying True Power Attribute (Additional chapter for the Thirteenth Alliance Master)
Translator: 549690339
When Jack Clark and his friends returned, it was already late at night. Even Jack struggled to haul the nearly forty-ton carcass of the Dragon Armor Beast for half a day before leaving the mountain.
Then, with great difficulty, they managed to load the beast onto a rented flatbed truck, which was usually used for transporting large excavators, and drove it back.
At this time, there were still many people in the armed department. These guys were sitting or standing on the steps outside the mission hall, waiting to see if Jack could complete the mission.
Therefore, when they saw Jack driving the truck and bringing back the seventeen-meter-long Mutated Dragon Armor Beast that resembled an ancient tyrant dragon, the armed department became excited.
“Damn, Jack really killed that Mutated Dragon Beast!”
“Such a powerful aura! Even from this distance, I feel like my legs are trembling. No wonder it’s a dragon bloodline mutated beast.”
“So strong!”
“Why do 1 feel like we’re not attending the same school? We’re all first-grade students, why can Jack even slay such a powerful mutated beast, while I’m still at the late period of First Layer Heaven…”
“At least you’re at the late period. I’m only at the mid-period…”
“I have a feeling we were tricked by our class teacher Vernon Leinster. He said that talent wasn’t important, but it seems pretty important, doesn’t it?”
Amid the astonishment of their classmates, Jack dragged the Mutated Beast to the Logistics Warehouse.
There were bright lights and staff working overtime, or rather, they were waiting specifically for him.
Gulp!
Just seeing the enormous Mutated Dragon Armor Beast made the staff member’s face turn pale, and his legs tremble. He forced a smile and said, “Student Clark, can you please get this mutated beast off the truck?”
“No problem.” Jack jumped onto the truck, and roared as he lifted the Mutated Dragon Beast off the truck. This action caused both the truck and the ground to shake violently.
A Level 4 Mutated Beast with a trace of Dragon Bloodline, even though it wasn’t high-order, was worth 120 contribution points to the officials. Jack was quite satisfied with this price.
However, Freya Louise had made a great contribution during the mission, so Jack insisted on splitting the points. Freya got 50 points, while Jack received 70.
In total, he now had 159 contribution points in hand.
February 6th, Sunday.
As the cleaning mission was announced to be over, all the students with bountiful gains began to return, each one wearing their broken weapons and lining up at the train station.
Compared to half a month ago, these students now emitted a stronger Killing Intent, and their expressions had become more mature and determined.
However, Jack didn’t take the same ride as the others. Instead, he rented a cold chain transport truck from the Logistics Department and drove it back to Mist River with Freya.
At ten o’clock in the morning, the truck stopped outside their courtyard. Jack, who was driving, rolled down the window and shouted inside, “Jim, open the gate.”
“Coming, bro.”
Upon hearing Jack’s voice, Glenn Clark excitedly ran out of the house. Seeing the truck, he hesitated for a moment, “Bro, did you buy a truck?”
“No, I rented it. It’s carrying Mutated Beast Meat, so hurry up and open the gate.”
Upon hearing the words “Mutated Beast Meat,” Glenn’s excitement grew. “Alright, bro.”
As Glenn pushed open the gate, Doris also came out.
Once the gate was open, Jack skillfully reversed into the courtyard, parking the cold chain transport truck inside.
Fortunately, after he had kicked down the old tree, a space became available in the left side of the yard, which perfectly accommodated the fully-sealed truck.
After parking the truck, Jack jumped out of the driver’s seat, and it was only then that Glenn noticed Freya in the passenger seat. He immediately called out cheerfully, “Sister Freya Louise, you’re here!”
With a warm smile, Freya replied, “Yes, I was on my way back today, so I decided to carpool with Jack.”
Then the girl jumped out of the truck as well.
At this moment, Glenn excitedly introduced Freya to Doris, “Mom, this is the Sister Freya Louise I told you about.”
The girl, who had just jumped down from the truck, looked poised and elegant. She smiled, “Hello, Auntie, my name is Freya Louise, and I’m in the same class as Jack at school.”
Since there was no battle today, the girl was wearing a white long-sleeved T-shirt with form-fitting pants and white sneakers. Her long hair was still tied with a white butterfly ribbon, and the dangling white ribbon and black hair strands intertwined, giving her a fresh and delicate appearance.
Seeing the beautiful and elegant girl before her, Doris smiled warmly, “Hello Freya, come on in and have a seat”
At that moment, Jack, who had been left out, coughed, “Mom, there’s no need to sit down. In a while, Freya and I still need to go to school.”
As Jack spoke, he opened the back door of the truck, revealing the large chunks of Mutated Beast Meat that filled more than half of the truck’s cargo space.
“Mom, this is the Mutated Black Armored Water Buffalo meat. Although it’s only Level 2, its energy is gentle, and ordinary people can digest it.”
“However, since you’ve never eaten Mutated Beast Meat before, you can only eat at most one pound a day. After half a month, you can gradually increase the amount.”
Jack had promised Glenn to bring him mutated beast meat and naturally didn’t forget.
“So this is Mutated Beast Meat,” Glenn said excitedly, looking over the meat and eager to touch it. Seeing mutated beast meat for the first time made him hungry.
“Bro, there’s even python meat!”
Glenn exclaimed when he noticed the corpse of the electric ray curled up in the far end of the truck, taking up quite a bit of space.
“That’s not python, it’s a Mutated Electric Ray.”
“However, you guys can’t eat its flesh because the energy contained in it is too stimulating.”
“Oh,” Glenn nodded, not thinking too much about it. He assumed the electric ray was for Jack himself..
