chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 139: Breakthrough to the Fourth Heaven, Terrifying True Strength Attribute (Extra Update for Thirteenth League Master )_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 139: Breakthrough to the Fourth Heaven, Terrifying True Strength Attribute (Extra Update for Thirteenth League Master )_2
Translator: 549690339
Then Jack Clark instructed Glenn Clark to bring out an electric wire from the house, connecting it to the power input underneath the cold chain cargo truck to avoid insufficient cooling.
Of course, selling a Level 2 Mutated Beast and spending over a hundred thousand to rent the truck wasnt to store Mutated Beast meat, but to store the electro-optical ray eel corpses.
Next, Jack Clark transferred 20,000 yuan to Glenn Clarks mobile phone, asking him to buy several large freezers later to transfer the Mutated Beast meat out.
As for the remaining money, it would be his pocket money.
With the improvement of his abilities, slaying low-level Mutated Beasts easily, the 10,000 or 20,000 yuan that used to be a significant amount to Jack Clark no longer mattered much.
No wonder people like Justin Welan, casually spent tens of thousands of Qi Blood resources during the Foundation Establishment stage.bender
For those with high-level cultivators in their family, that amount of money is indeed insignificant.
As Jack Clark instructed Glenn Clark, Freya Louise, standing nearby, spoke with Doris Raven in a low voice, the corners of her eyes smiling.
Although the two women met for the first time, they didnt feel unfamiliar and got along well, chatting about everyday matters and things related to Jack Clark.
On the way to school, Jack Clark couldnt help but wonder, You and my mom are meeting for the first time right? Why does it feel like you two are very close?
Regarding this question, the girl chuckled softly, I guess I just clicked with Auntie.
For women, a single word may be too many if they dont get along, but if they like each other, they might feel an instant connection even if they meet for the first time.
Really? Jack Clark was somewhat skeptical.
The girl grinned and nodded, Yes.
Chatting, the two returned to South Sky Martial Height shortly.
The schools opening day was soon, and the school had become livelier, with more people present even on Sundays.
As Jack Clark and Freya prepared to go to the Logistics Department, they saw Lori Parma approaching from a distance, a terrifying atmosphere emanating from his body.
The atmosphere was so strong that it affected reality, distorting the air around him, giving the illusion that space was subtly distorted.
As Lori Parma approached, Jack Clark exclaimed in surprise, Teacher, have you broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven?
Lori Parma nodded slightly, Yes, during my trip to Koroya, I fought with an early-stage Seventh Layer Heaven bishop, and after killing him in a Reverse Defeating move, I finally broke through that barrier.
I returned and closed off for more than half a month, finally stepping into the Seventh Layer Heaven, but I didnt expect to meet you guys just after leaving.
As he spoke, a smile involuntarily appeared on Lori Parmas serious face.
Jack Clark and Freya exchanged glances, a trace of strangeness flashing in their eyes, as Lori Parmas actions just now didnt look like he had just left the closed door.
It seemed more like he had already circled the school once.
In particular, the terrible atmosphere lingering around him now, with his current realm, it wouldnt be so hard for him to completely conceal his breakthrough aura, right?
Ahem!
Well, Teacher Parma, congratulations on your breakthrough to the high-order stage.
Im about to go to the Logistics Department, so I wont bother you anymore.
Alright, go ahead, Lori Parma nodded, then continued strolling around the school with his hands behind his back, surrounded by the powerful Seventh Layer Heaven aura, radiating an astonishing oppressive force.
He looked as if he wanted to yell, Ive broken through the Seventh Layer Heaven, come out and see.
Watching Lori Parmas figure disappear into the distance, Freya couldnt help but chuckle, I didnt expect Teacher Parma to have this hobby.
Jack Clark also smiled, Its normal. As long as one is a person, they wont refuse to Ahem! They wont refuse the opportunity to show off in front of others.
Having said that, the girl swept her hair to the side and softly said to Jack Clark, Next, youre going to the Logistics Department to exchange dragon essence blood, so I wont go with you. Ill wait for your good news at the browsing room.
I havent settled down to read the scriptures in a while, and I feel like my ethereal state has slipped a bit.
Okay, Jack Clark nodded.
The two separated at Teaching Building C. Jack Clark went to the Logistics Department.
But today, the Logistics Department was bustling with returning students all exchanging cultivation resources useful to them, so it was nearly half an hour before it was Jack Clarks turn.
Hello, I would like to exchange a bottle of high-order dragon essence blood and one Level 3 Life Crystal.
High-order dragon essence blood. The staff member inside suddenly looked up,shocked.
High-level resources were not something ordinary students could afford to exchange, starting at a hundred points of contribution, and high-order dragon essence blood was even rarer.
Jack Clark coughed dryly, explaining, I practice the advanced skill Dragon Elephant Overlord Body and have a 20% Discount Permission to exchange dragon essence blood.
I see.
Please wait a moment. The essence blood has a discount of thirty points, and the Level 3 Life Crystal is forty points. You have a 30% Discount Permission for resource exchanges, so a total of 58 contribution points will be deducted.
As his privilege level increased to II+, Jack Clarks previous 20% discount privilege from the ranking battle became a 30% discount, making resource exchange even cheaper.
However, this discount didnt apply to already discounted resources.
Soon, Jack Clark walked out of the Logistics Department, holding a bottle of dragon essence blood and a Life Crystal, not bothering to have lunch, and immediately applied for a Personal Cultivation Room.
Youve converted one Life Energy Crystal, gaining 37 attribute points.
Seeing the transparent page at the bottom of his eyes change to 4.2 free attribute points, Jack Clark opened the bottle containing the dragon essence blood, and drank it in one gulp.
At the same time, a thought echoed in his mind, Strengthen the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body to the fourth level..

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 139: Breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, the Terrifying Attribute of True Strength (Added more for the thirteenth league leader) 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 139: Breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, the Terrifying Attribute of True Strength (Added more for the thirteenth league leader) 3
Translator: 549690339
Unlike practicing Dragon Elephant Power at the First Layer, to breakthrough to the fourth Layer of Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, one should directly swallow the essence blood of a dragon variant beast.
At this moment, as Jack Clark swallowed the dragon blood, a furious and overbearing fiery power exploded within his body in an instant, wreakly havoc.
In this world, the situation where one could absorb the power of a mutated beast by merely drinking its blood essence does not exist.bender
Just like two incompatible gene types, once the essence blood containing the energy of the mutated beasts flesh is swallowed, it would become a poison, wildly destroying the body.
In particular, this vial contained the essence blood of a seventh-tier dragon variant beast, whose terrifying destructive power was too much for even Jacks body to withstand.
However, just as Jacks countenance faltered slightly, his Dragon Elephant True Power in his dantian wildly raged, bursting out of his dantian and encapsulating the essence blood that was damaging his body.
With the addition of incredibly pure energy, combined with the essence blood, the Dragon Elephant True Power circulated wildly within Jacks body at a speed dozens of times its usual rate.
And because it was circulating so fast, it made a sound like a raging river.
As the True Power refined, hints of dragon blood power were purified and continually merged into Jacks flesh and blood, altering his physique.
Meanwhile, the nature of the Dragon Elephant True Power was also changing while refining the essence of dragon blood, becoming more overbearing and cohesive, much like True Dragons Power.
Concurrently, the Dragon Elephant Will Seed in Jacks sea of consciousness exploded and his spiritual power wildly circulated, gradually manifesting a massive phantom in his sea of consciousness.
With each breakthrough, Jacks breathing became heavier, more massive, like a hibernating elephant and dragon.
When one normally breakthroughs to the Fourth Layer Heaven, a cultivators True Power undergoes a qualitative change. This qualitative change does not particularly affect the physical body but greatly magnifies the power of True Power.
If the True Power at the Third Layer Heaven is mist, then the True Power at the Fourth Layer Heaven is liquid, with the power to concentrate and explode being several times that of the Third Heaven.
As it is a higher-level skill, and one of the strongest at that, Dragon Elephant Overlord Body cultivators physical bodies and True Power while breakthroughing and absorbing the essence of dragon blood will change simultaneously.
For instance, right now, there seemed to be glistening patterns akin to dragon scales faintly emerging on Jacks body, with the originally invisible strength within his flesh gradually manifesting.
This intangible yet concrete strength originated from flesh and blood, slowly integrating with the continuously circulating True Power. The original black Dragon Elephant True Power gradually became dark red.
At this moment, a droplet of liquefied dark-red True Power was born in Jacks dantian.
Howls! Vague dragon and elephant roars echoed as if from the void, howling in defiance.
Boom!
Jacks consciousness roared, a terrifying aura broke out from his body, forming a wind wrapping him as it exploded. The strong wind made his clothes and hair rustle with a bang.
Half an hour later, Jack slowly opened his eyes, his pupils had become double-layered. The outer layer was as black as the starry sky, and the inner layer was an indistinct golden vertical pupil.
Both eyes radiated a cold, majestic and terrifying oppressive feeling, just like a cruel real dragon.
However, this terrifying aura disappeared as soon as Jack closed his eyes and opened them again.
So this is the feeling of the Fourth Layer Heaven, Jack said extending his right hand and waved slightly. Instantly a raging wind swept through the cultivation room.
Jack looked at the wall more than ten meters away, took one step, an inch-deep footprint was left on the hard floor like iron with a thud.
Jack appeared as if he had teleported tens of meters away in an instant, his right arm muscles bulged slightly overlaid with heavy dark red True Power circulation, he smacked down with his palm.
Boom!
With a single palm strike, one half of the wall that could withstand the peak attack of the Fourth Layer crumbled and collapsed. Numerous shards of alloy pelted onto the small forest outside with clattering sounds.
Of course, Jack was well aware that there was an uninhabited small forest behind the wall; otherwise, he wouldnt dare test it recklessly.
Looking at the half of the wall that had collapsed under his one palm, Jack paused for a moment.
After breaking through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, there was a qualitative change in his full body strength, transforming from nebulous to real, and when he got released with True Power, it caused a terrifying increase in power.
Apart from the horrifying changes, his True Power had also become very domineering, increasingly solidified, and when released, it had explosive characteristics like a bomb.
Such terrifying changes, even Jack himself couldnt help but be shocked, this time the changes from the breakthrough were evidently larger than he had anticipated.
Jack took a deep breath, subdued his excited mood, and with a thought, he summoned the attribute page.
Realm: Fourth Layer
Physique: 595^645
Strength: 640^690
Speed: 540^560
Spirit: 531^581
Talent: Soul Split+
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Stand Meditation, Dragon Elephant Overlord Body+ [Fourth Layer, physical body possesses true dragon attribute, True Power is unmatchable like Dragon Power] Minds Eye Bright Knife [Limit Break]
Secret Skill: Hidden Deity+ [Beginner Level]
Rune: Elephants Fury [Incomplete] Cut through the Void [Incomplete]
Attribute Points: 12
Equipment: Sharp Battle Knife
Avatar: Hexagonal Sword and Armor Flame Beast
Evolution Value 2870/3000
This time the breakthrough made the attributes of physique, strength, and spirit increase by 50 points each, and speed only increased by 20, which was clearly related to the special features of the cultivation methods.
However, these were not important, what changed the most was that he gained dual attributes, the bodys Strength became tangible, and True Power became as overbearing and solid as Dragons Power.
When the strength of flesh and blood became real* and could merge with True Power, Jacks terrifying physical strength was fully unleashed, and his battle power soared.
After carefully examining the changes in the data on the attribute page, Jack closed his eyes again to comprehend the changes in this breakthrough.
This breakthrough was not just about physical body and True Power, there were significant changes in consciousness and spirit as well.
In the deepest depths of his sea of consciousness, which had been opened up a long time ago, the incomplete Cut through the Void resembling a sword or rune was hidden, and in the center of his sea of consciousness, a huge dragon elephant phantom stood towering.
The dragon tail on the elephant body, draped in dragon scales, the elephant foot has dragon claws, below the elephants head with huge tusks, was a big mouth full of fanged teeth, and its whole body was emitting a terrifying aura that could oppress anything.
Underneath this dragon elephant phantom, which was formed by Jacks condensed spirit and flickered in and out of existence, his sea of consciousness became incredibly stable. And when he observed this phantom with his consciousness, various realizations about dragons and elephants arose in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 140: Monster Swordsmanship, Jack Clark Blocked (Extra Chapter for Alliance Leader Thirteen)
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 140: Monster Swordsmanship, Jack Clark Blocked (Extra Chapter for Alliance Leader Thirteen)
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark’s palm strike that collapsed half of the cultivation room wall caused a huge shock.
Coupled with the overbearing aura that far surpassed the average Fourth Layer Heaven, it immediately attracted the attention of some strong men in the school.
As Jack closed his eyes and continued to absorb the changes from his breakthrough, several powerful figures flew in..
The first to arrive was Lori Parma, who had just broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven and had been wandering around the school for half a day. His eyes widened in surprise when he saw Jack’s powerful aura.
At this time, Vernon Leinster appeared at the edge of the forest, staring at Jack standing beside the collapsed wall, and couldn’t help but pause: “…Fourth Layer Heaven.”
Lori Parma showed a smile and nodded casually: “Yes, Fourth Layer Heaven, not bad, it took him almost half a year to breakthrough since he entered the school.”
At this time, Sylvia Lyons landed and said irritably, “Lori, stop showing off here, you know that the students in your class are the first to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“And, you just broke through the Seventh Layer Heaven before us, is it necessary to wander around the school like a fly, annoying people?”
Facing Sylvia’s sarcasm, Lori Parma just smiled without saying anything.
At this time, a few more Martial Cultivation Teachers appeared, their eyes filled with surprise as they looked at Jack.
One of the middle-aged men said gravely, “His True Strength’s overbearing aura after the breakthrough is heavy and carries a faint pressure of dragon-type creatures, he must be cultivating the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body!”
“Yes, the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body,” Lori Parma nodded.
At this moment, Jack slowly opened his eyes and politely greeted each of the Martial Cultivation Teachers: “Teacher Parma, Teacher Lyons, Teacher Leinster…”
He knew most of these teachers, except for the two who had accompanied him during the Koroya trials.
Lori Parma suddenly said, “Jack, you just broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, and as teachers, we have some details to explain to you, so come with me to the office first.”
“… Okay, teacher.” Jack nodded.
At this time, a teacher named Jone Fiore couldn’t help but say, “Lori, what’s the hurry, we won’t ask about his True Martial Attribute of his breakthrough.”
“The better, now everyone disperse, disperse, please.”
After breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, Lori Parma was full of vigor and even dared to gesture to his senior cultivator Vernon Leinster to leave.
For this, Vernon Leinster just smiled, then nodded slightly to Jack before turning around and leaving.
Jack used his realm of thought to slowly restrain his overbearing aura, and then followed Lori Parma and Sylvia Lyons away.
As for the collapsed wall of the Cultivation Room, no one mentioned it.
Although under normal conditions, Jack would be responsible for paying for the repair, everyone chose to ignore it in the face of this super-genius who broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven for the first time in half a year.
It was also one of the purposes for Jack to not restrain his aura after his breakthrough.
With his cultivation breakthrough to the Fourth Level, his combat power leaped to the Fifth Layer Heaven, and he no longer needed to tread as carefully as before.
In the past, he had no foundation behind him and always felt a little uneasy, so he acted humbly and cautiously, which was an instinct of self-preservation.
In the office, Lori Parma looked at Sylvia Lyons who had entered and asked curiously, “Lady Lyons, what brings you here?”
Sylvia folded her arms and said matter-of-factly, “Of course I’m here to watch the excitement. Besides, I can also be considered Jack’s half-teacher, much more qualified than you.”
However, Sylvia Lyons was not wrong.
During the Koroya Trial, Lori Parma only stayed in Lester City for a few days, and after leaving, Sylvia offered many suggestions to Jack regarding cultivation.
In addition, she was also the one who helped him exchange advanced skills earlier, and she told him about the details that he should pay attention to.
Cough!
Lori Parma coughed at Sylvia’s words, then turned to look at Jack, feeling a little emotional, “Your sudden breakthrough to the Fourth Layer Heaven has truly shocked everyone.”
“However, it’s good as you broke through earlier than that monster Jane Aiken.
1 should be able to approve your trial rewards soon.”
“Rewards? Didn’t I already get a Secret Skill?” Jack was a little surprised, although he had heard some rumors before.
Lori Parma said solemnly, “1 once said that the purpose of establishing this school is to cultivate geniuses, so there will be more resources allocated to those with outstanding talent.”
“But this resource allocation is divided into stages because the so-called ‘talent* is too general, and even Supreme Experts can’t see a person’s future.”
“That’s why there are school ranking competitions and various trials, as gold will shine eventually, but it needs to be polished.”
“During the previous Koroya Trial, your cultivation breakthrough speed, combat power leap, and achievements were all in the top fifty, so I applied for extra resource allocation on your behalf.”
“It’s the teachers’ duty, such as Lady Lyons helping her student Mandy Leinster to apply for resources worth 100 contributions, and I also helped Crystal Leinster, Justin Welan, and others.”
“These resources will be distributed this coming week, on Monday, but…”
Before Lori Parma could finish, Sylvia Lyons interrupted irritably, “But he was too greedy, applying for too many resources at once, so it was blocked by the higher-ups.”
“… Teacher, what did you apply for on my behalf?” Jack asked curiously.
Lori Parma felt a little embarrassed: “It’s not that much. 1 submitted two proposals, one to reward you with the Sumeru Bracelet, and the other for a cultivation package worth more than 4.00 contributions..”

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 140: Monster Sword Intent, Jack Clark Blocked (Extra Chapter for Alliance Leader Thirteen)!
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 140: Monster Sword Intent, Jack Clark Blocked (Extra Chapter for Alliance Leader Thirteen)!
Translator: 549690339
“The cultivation package contains resources to help you break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven quickly, as well as a transcendent material for refining transcendent weapons after entering the Fourth Layer.”
“I just didn’t expect you to break through so quickly…”
When they came back earlier, Lori Parma had asked Jack Clark about when he roughly planned to break through.
Only when Jack said that he estimated it would take about two months to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven did Lori think about the timing, and submitted an application for an additional resource package.
By the time the semester starts, these resources would be approved and help Jack break through faster, and immediately after breaking through, he would be able to refine his own transcendent weapon.
Lori Parma just finished speaking when Jack Clark couldn’t help but be surprised, “That much?”
No need to mention the Sumeru Bracelet, it’s worth 500 contribution points each and requires high authority, while the other cultivation package is also worth more than 400 contribution points.
Even a slightly less valuable cultivation package would be worth almost as much as what Jack earned from the cleaning mission this time.
Sylvia Lyons shook her head: “That’s why it wasn’t approved.”
“That much?”
Lori Parma was somewhat unconvinced, “Then why did the applications submitted by Vernon Leinster for Jane Aiken and Elijiah Raven for Howard Lee get approved? Their numbers are also similar.”
“It’s not the same.”
Sylvia Lyons said indifferently, “Jane Aiken not only has a cultivation talent but also demonstrated her outstanding ‘enlightenment’ during the trials. She cultivated the Sword Intent during the Third Layer Heaven, which made her a true monster.”
“Howard Lee is almost the same, with his ‘Innate Divine Strength’ talent and perfect integration of advanced skills. His performance in the trials was also eye-catching, completing the first physique transformation.”
“As for Jack Clark, although he has cultivated the Dragon Elephant Power to the True Martial Divine Rhyme, displaying the ability to leapfrog a level in battle, the problem lies here.”
“Dragon Elephant Power is just a low-level martial arts, which does not mean that he has such comprehension and integration with advanced martial arts, so the final potential evaluation is slightly lower than that of Jane Aiken.”
“But now there is no problem.”
Sylvia Lyons looked at Jack Clark with a smile on her face: “Now that you have broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven in less than half a month after transferring to the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, your speed has surpassed everyone’s expectations, including mine.”
“No one can question your potential now. What you need to consider next is whether to choose the Sumeru Bracelet or the cultivation resources.”
“Can I choose?” Jack Clark was somewhat tempted.
Lori Parma nodded, “Yes, but now that you have already broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, I suggest you choose the Sumeru Bracelet.”
“The Alien Beast Battlefield is different from the previous small-scale trials. The situation there is more complicated, and sometimes you may encounter desperate situations lasting one or two months.”
“At that time, if you have a storage space to carry food and resources, you can hold on for much longer and have a higher survival rate.”
“In addition, the Sumeru Bracelet is also connected to True Strength, which allows you to store your weapons in it during normal times, and achieve a tempering effect during cultivation.”
“Then I choose the Sumeru Bracelet.”
In fact, even if Lori Parma hadn’t suggested it, Jack Clark would have chosen the Sumeru Bracelet anyway, because most of the resources in that cultivation package had very little effect on him.
Not all of them were Life Crystals.
Then Lori Parma reminded him, “After reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven, you will need to try to refine transcendent weapons. Whether or not you have transcendent weapons is very important for advanced cultivators.”
“Even the most ordinary transcendent weapon can enhance a cultivator’s combat power by 10%.”
“In addition, when you go to the Alien Beast Battlefield later, if you have enough resources, try to refine a set of extraordinary battle armor for extra protection.”
“For you, improving your cultivation is just a matter of time, but the premise is to survive.”
“Over the years, I’ve seen many geniuses, some with monstrous talents that are no less than you or Jane Aiken. Each of them has swept their peers.”
“But in the end, many of them die in some dangers or battles due to accidents or miscalculating their own strengths, which is a pity.”
Jack Clark kept Lori Parma’s reminder in his heart, then spoke awkwardly,”… Um, teacher, I didn’t redeem the Weapon Casting Secret Skill.”
“You didn’t redeem the Weapon Casting Secret Skill? Didn’t you have a free opportunity?” Lori Parma was taken aback.
He had previously reminded Jack Clark specifically to redeem this secret method early so as to practice it in preparation for refining transcendent weapons after breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark was somewhat embarrassed, “At that time, I was more interested in another secret method to converge my aura. I thought 1 wouldn’t break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven so quickly, so I didn’t choose Weapon Casting.”At the side, Sylvia Lyons casually said, “How simple is this? Old Perry, just add a Weapon Casting Secret Skill to the application for the Sumeru Bracelet.”
“I don’t believe they’ll dare to block us this time, it’s just a secret method.”
Teacher Parma thought about it before nodding, “Alright, Jack Clark breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven within one semester and being the first to break through in this term’s South Sky Martial Height is already enough reason.”
Hearing this, Jack felt grateful.
Of course, he deliberately brought up the matter of the Weapon Casting Secret Skill, since letting him spend another 100 contribution points to exchange the not-so-useful secret method felt a bit of a loss.
Now that he has this genius-monster identity, better make use of it while it’s free.
Next, Teacher Parma continued to remind Jack of some things to pay attention to, such as not casually revealing his True Martial Attribute to others.
The True Martial Attribute involved the Seventh Layer Heaven’s True Martial Phantom, battle body, and even the domain of the Ninth Heaven; if enemies knew about it, he could easily become a target.
Although many strong men can analyze and calculate others’ True Strength attributes through their characteristics and power.
However, with dozens of variations in just fire attribute alone, it’s hard to pinpoint the exact True Martial Attribute of others.
In the end, Teacher Parma breathed out, “Come to think of it, this might be my last time chatting with you about these things.”
“Teacher Parma, are you leaving?” Jack paused.
Teacher Parma nodded, “That’s right, I’ve already talked to Mr. Lester, and I’ll head to the Frontline Battlefield with him in a few days, finally getting rid of the boring days at school.”
Speaking of this, Teacher Parma couldn’t help but show a smug expression in his eyes but then consoled Jack.
“Little Jack, don’t be sad. Our school in Eastern Summer isn’t like the sects in Berlin; we teachers are just guides on your cultivation path and can only take care of the initial stages.”
“Especially after you’ve broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, we don’t have much to teach you anymore. The most we can offer are some cultivation insights, how far you can go in the future depends on you.”
“Okay, I understand, teacher.” Jack nodded.
As for being sad… What’s that? He was just surprised by Teacher Parma’s departure.
At the same time, he was grateful for the guidance he had received and the help given this time to secure resources but, to be honest, there wasn’t much more emotion than that.
After leaving the Office Building, Jack looked up at the sun in the sky, it was probably around two in the afternoon. He couldn’t help but head towards the dining hall.
He hasn’t eaten lunch yet.
On the way to the dining hall, Jack’s eyes revealed his contemplation.
He still had 101 contribution points left in his hand, which wasn’t enough to exchange for the 300-point high-order dragon blood. So, what about exchanging the Combat Skill Eight Desolations Refining Inferno Halberd?
The Sword Armor Flame Beast had two Level 4 Life Crystals in its hands, which could potentially be converted into more than 100 attribute points, just enough to strengthen the combat skill and new weapon.
As for the Transcendent Weapon… There were no materials, he’d have to wait until he went to the Alien Beast Battlefield to consider that.
Only after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven did Jack realize he was even more impoverished.
The Dragon Elephant Overlord Body’s fifth level required dragon essence blood, attribute points, transcendent materials for weapons and battle armors, and besides all that, there were also the upgrades of combat skills and secret skills…
Thinking about all this, Jack suddenly felt a headache.
Of course, he could also not rely on resources and cultivate slowly, after all, those who created these cultivation methods also went through slow cultivation and breakthroughs.
But after getting used to the feeling of rapid cultivation progress, if you asked Jack to spend two to three years breaking through the Fifth Layer Heaven, he’d naturally be unwilling. With that time, he might even reach the Nine Layers Heaven.
This two or three years is just an estimate after his physique has been constantly evolving and his talent has increased. If it’s his initial medium talent, it might take at least ten years. After the Fourth Layer Heaven, many people’s progress gets stalled for ten or eight years.
However, with his current strength comparable to the Fifth Layer Heaven, as long as he’s careful, he shouldn’t have much problem going to the Alien Beast Battlefield.
As a traverser, Jack had a sense of pride in his heart. Knowing that he almost got blocked because his ‘talent’ wasn’t enough, and the resources being applied for made him feel a bit annoyed.
How monstrous is Jane Aiken and Howard Lee’s talents? Can they be more monstrous (Attribute Panel, Avatar Strengthening) than him?
And just as Jack arrived at the dining hall to have lunch, his breakthrough to the Four Layer Heaven, which had not been kept secret, quickly spread and made waves within the school’s official website.
Or rather, it caused a huge stir..

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 141: Loading Battle Armaments,
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 141: Loading Battle Armaments,
Beyond the World (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
Is it fake? Senior One starts the next semester tomorrow, and hes already broken through to the Four Layer Heaven?
Its indeed exaggerated! Im having a hard time accepting it because Im still in the late period of First Layer Heaven.11
Yeah, if Jane Aiken suddenly breaks through to Four Layer Heaven, I could understand, but Jack Clark? 1 remember it took him half a month to reach Foundation Establishment.
Upstairs, the half-months Foundation Establishment is already old news. 1 knew he was extraordinary when he ranked 49th in the ranking competition using low-level martial arts.
So how extraordinary?
Did you forget that he just killed a Level 4 Mutated Beast with a Dragon Bloodline yesterday? Even if hes not in Four Layer Heaven, isnt his strength comparable to it?
Yesterday he didnt kill the mutated beast with the Dragon Bloodline alone. The wound on the mutated beast s head was clearly caused by Freya Louises sniper cannon.
UhmYou guys are looking down on my Darren? He has solo killed multiple enemies in Four Layer Heaven.
Exactly, Jack is our role model. He defeated those geniuses with mediocre talent and low-level martial arts. Im sure its very hard to swallow.
999,1 knew Darren was insane in Leinster, but 1 didnt expect him to be even more insane than I thought. Worthy of the title Darren.
Pfft!
In the afternoon, on the 33rd Floor Reading Room, Freya Louise couldnt help but laugh when she saw this comment. She slid her finger on the phone screen and chuckled.
I knew your breakthrough would surprise everyone.
Jack Clark on the opposite side, smiled, Well, not everyone. For example, you dont seem to be shocked.
At this point, after Jack Clarks breakthrough, even when sitting there with his aura retracted, his body radiates a heavy oppressive feeling, as if a huge dragon was sitting there.
The girl blinked her beautiful eyes: Because Im used to it.
Indeed, as someone who watched Jack Clark surpass his classmates geniuses step by step, and even surpass all rhe geniuses in the entire grade, Freya Louise has indeed become accustomed to his exaggeration.
Youre almost breaking through to the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, right? Jack looked at Freya Louise.
The girl nodded: Yeah, probably in the next few days.
Calculating, its been almost two months since her breakthrough to the Third Layer Heaven, coupled with Erica Knowles and a large number of Contribution Points obtained during this time, she should be progressing rapidly.
Breaking through to the middle phase at this time can only be said to be mediocre, which should be related to her declining status in the ethereal state.
Previously, Freyas cultivation speed was no less than Justin Welans when she entered the ethereal state and had a high degree of compatibility with the Cultivation Methods. Recently, she has slowed down a step.
Not only her, but many geniuses who were in the Third Layer Heaven during the trial period have also broken through to the middle phase recently.
According to this comparison, Crystal Leinster and others who have already gone to the Alien Beast Battlefield for nearly a month should have also broken through early, as they had consolidated more than a month before leaving.
At this time, Freya Louise asked, Jack, what are your plans for the future?
Jack thought for a moment: Next, I plan to consolidate, and in a few days, 111 apply to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield.
During these few days, 1 plan to cultivate an Advanced Combat Skill. Im currently considering a Heavy Halberd Skill, which can fully unleash my strength.
Freya nodded: The Light King Knife really cant keep up with your current cultivation. If you dont have a matching combat skill for the Four Layer Heaven now, will you have enough Contribution Points?bender
Jack nodded: I will. I only need 100 Contribution Points for that Advanced Combat Skill, and I currently have 101.
Just enough? The girl nodded thoughtfully when she heard the words.
Next, Freya asked Jack about his breakthrough experience and the process of True Power Quality Change. Jack told her what he could say.
Although he used Attribute points to force the breakthrough, he did not forget the process and insights.
The stormy sea was dark, and the storm was raging, with raging winds whipping up a tsunami that slammed everything.
On the sea surface, a nearly 20-meter long, hideous, huge, and black-red colossal beast drifted with the waves, its cold golden vertical pupils looking straight ahead.
There, a mutated creature resembling a lizard but with a huge turtle shell growing from the middle of its body was hunting. It was about 32 meters long.
In addition to the black carapace covered horn, the other parts of this mutated beasts body were covered with black scales, its limbs were like fishs fins but had claws, which looked very strange.
It is unknown whether this creature initially mutated from a cheating sea turtle or a lizard having an affair.
At this moment, it was biting the dead body of a giant king squid which was more than ten meters long in its mouth, tearing and chewing it without caring about the shrinking tentacles on its head.
Soon, the usual giant king squid was swallowed by the Variant Armored Lizard, and the rainwater flowed down its hideous mouth, washing away the blue blood on its head.
Just then, a tsunami tens of meters high roared down onto the Sword Armor Flame Beast from above, causing water droplets to fill the sky and a deafening sound.
Under the surging waves, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was like a black shadow, crashing through turbulent currents as it swiftly swam.
At this time, another tsunami tens of meters high rolled up, and the raging tsunami was like a wall of water blocking the sky. It fell towards the Variant Armored Lizard.
Just when the mutated lizard was careless and let the tsunami hit it, the seawater suddenly exploded, and a huge black shadow mixed with saliva rushed down.
Boom! The tsunami slammed down onto the sea surface, accompanied by the angry roar of the mutated lizard.
Bang, bang, bang! The sea surface burst open, and dozens of water columns several meters thick rose into rhe sky, only falling down after reaching tens of meters high..

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 141: Loading Battle Armaments,
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 141: Loading Battle Armaments,
Beyond the World (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
Amidst the towering water columns, the over thirty-meter-long Variant Armored Lizard constantly weaved. The thick turtle shell covering its left side blasted apart, and its flesh and blood became unrecognizable as it gushed out continuously.
Under the aggressive attack of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, aided by the tsunami, the Variant Armored Lizard reacted quickly. It used its most robust back shell to block the devastating blow in no time.
Otherwise, that strike would have blown up its head.
At this moment, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, which was slightly smaller than the lizard but exhibited an even more vicious aura, relentlessly shattered wave after wave as it rapidly approached.
But just when the Sword Armor Flame Beast closed to within fifty meters of the Variant Armored Lizard, a fierce water column erupted beneath it.
Bang! The raging water column, with the help of the surging waves, directly launched the Sword Armor Flame Beast into the air dozens of meters high, before it mixed with the waves and crashed down heavily.
Boom!
Beneath the turbulent and murky sea surface, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swiftly stabilized its body with a twist, then darted into the water a hundred meters below.
Although the sea surface was raging with giant waves, the water at a depth of over a hundred meters was relatively calm, with only occasional surges of murky undercurrents.
Using its feather horns to sense the position of the Variant Armored Lizard, the Sword Armor Flame Beast quickly arrived below it, its muscles swelling as a terrifying force gathered.
Boom! Under the influence of its swift talent, the sea water behind the Sword Armor Flame Beast exploded, forming a huge white wave that surged dozens of meters.
Due to the tremendous countershock force, the Sword Armor Flame Beast charged upwards like a streamlined torpedo.
Because it moved so fast, an impact layer formed on the surface of the Sword Armor Flame Beast, where it shattered the water at the sound barrier. It instantly pierced through the waves and appeared right beneath the Variant Beast.
As the ferocious alien beast attacked once more, the Variant Armored Lizard revealed a surprised expression in its eyes.bender
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! A series of devastating water currents erupted from all directions, fiercely colliding with the Sword Armor Flame Beast. However, it couldnt sway the beast even an inch.
This Variant Beast had the ability to control seawater, creating powerful water columns and pulling waves. The ocean was almost its home turf.
Unfortunately for it, regardless of how fierce the raging waves were, they were still just water and couldnt actually damage the terrifyingly defensive Sword Armor Flame Beast.
At this point, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was just over a hundred points away from reaching 3000 Evolution points. In order to start evolving sooner, it was determined not to let this Variant Beast escape.
Quickly, the Sword Armor Flame Beast shattered wave after wave that blocked its path, pouncing onto the Variant Armored Lizard.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
At that moment, the surrounding seawater exploded fiercely. Amidst the ferocious fight and biting between the two massive beasts, countless scales were smashed, and blood and flesh splattered everywhere. The scene was tremendously intense.
However, compared to the overwhelming waves of the tsunami, the two twenty- to thirty-meter-long variant beasts seemed tiny, occasionally being swallowed by waves weighing millions of tons.
Ten minutes later, as the typhoon continued to move, the waters in this area gradually calmed down.
On the sea surface, the raging waves had carried the thirty-two-meter-long Variant Armored Lizards corpse, leaving huge, gnawed wounds and its shell ripped apart.
As for the lethal blow, its neck was almost completely torn off, with only a bit of skin hanging on.
Next to it, the Sword Armor Flame Beast was recovering from its injuries. Black scales were shattered all over its body and were healing at a visibly fast pace.
A few minutes later, the Sword Armor Flame Beast gripped the corpse of the Variant Armored Lizard and disappeared beneath the sea surface.
Though humans couldnt control the oceans conditions like they could with land mutant beasts, they still had high-definition satellites constantly monitoring the vast sea and recording information about the whereabouts of giant beasts.
Therefore, the Sword Armor Flame Beast rarely lingered on the sea surface for long periods of time.
After all, compared to fish-like mutant beasts, the Sword Armor Flame Beast had a distinct appearance that was too ferocious and easy to recognize.
Deep under the sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast, whose tail was swinging as it devoured and tore the Variant Armored Lizard, was eating and sensing the location of Jack Clarks main body as it swam towards the Los Angeles coast.
At 5 PM.
In the Reading Room, Jack Clark partially withdrew his attention from the Sword Armor Flame Beast and slightly lifted his head. He gazed at the brilliant sunlight outside the window, his eyes filled with depth.Almost there.
After devouring the Level 7 early-stage Mutated Beast, Sword Armor Flame Beasts evolution value had reached nearly 2,900. It would be ready for its fourth evolution in at most two or three days.
Whoosh!
At that moment, a pure and vigorous aura burst from the girl opposite him. Her long hair fluttered without wind, exuding the aura of the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase.
She had a breakthrough. Jack Clark turned his head and looked at Freya Louise, somewhat astonished.
Earlier, she had said that she might need another two days to break through the middle phase. But she unexpectedly broke through after just sitting here for a while and studying Scriptures this afternoon.
Even Jack couldnt help but feel envious of such an easy and relaxed cultivation method.
The girl on the opposite side looked up at him then, her eyes bright and deep, like a cloudless sky, crystal clear, leisurely, and profound.
For some reason, Jack felt as if she was standing far away, as if she was outside the world itself.
Jack shook his head to dispel the strange feeling, and smiled, Congratulations on your cultivation progressing one step further, beautiful Freya.
At this moment, the girl regained her senses, blinked, and the infinitely distant feeling in her eyes disappeared. She smiled lightly, Its just the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase. Im still far behind you who are in the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Jack smiled, I have only taken a step forward. The path of cultivation is long and arduous, and a moments difference cannot determine the future.
Freya nodded, Im not in a hurry. My aunt has already designed a cultivation path for me. After I reach the Fourth Layer Heaven, I can equip myself with real combat gear.
Combat gear? Dont you already have that sniper cannon gun? Jack asked, surprised.
Freya shook her head, Thats just the weapon 1 use before entering the Fourth Layer Heaven. Integration of Science and Martial Arts cant be that simple, or it wouldnt be a separate path.
Looking at the mysterious girl, Jack was a little curious, I didnt expect you to have this up your sleeve. Can you tell me what your combat equipment is?
I wont tell you yet. There was a playful sparkle in the girls eyes.
Lets go together to find Mr. Perry and apply to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield. Ill see if I can break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven before the end of this semester, otherwise, you guys will be far ahead of me.
Alright, lets go together.
With that, the two of them stood up, Freya put back the book she borrowed, and they both went downstairs to find Lori Parma, submitted their application, and then waited for notification.
The shuttle to the Alien Beast Battlefield is not available at any time; they would have to wait for placement.
When Jack returned home from school, he saw Glenn Clark busily carrying chunks of Mutated Beast meat weighing several dozens of kilograms up and down.
Seeing Jack entering the courtyard, Glenn wiped his sweat, Bro, youre back.
Jack was speechless, Didnt I tell you to wait for me to come back and move this stuff together?
Glenn smiled sheepishly, Its okay, Im strong. I can do it by running a few more trips. You just focus on cultivation; Ill handle these little things.
I bought three big freezers. 1 cleared out the storage room, and moms cooking in the kitchen
As he spoke, Jack began to help, tying up the half-frozen Mutated Beast meat with ropes, lifting two tons with one hand.
That was only because the doorway wasnt wide enough.
Then, carrying four pieces of frozen meat weighing more than 300 pounds, Glenn looked at Jack enviously and said, Bro, youre so strong.
This isnt much. Once you start cultivating, youll be strong too.
Jack turned his head and glanced at Glenn, who was burly and fierce, able to easily carry more than 300 pounds of meat while still speaking casually. His gaze was a bit strange.
Did this guy not realize his own strength?

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 142: The Eight Wastes Heavy Halberd, The Return of The Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 142: The Eight Wastes Heavy Halberd, The Return of The Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Translator: 549690339
“Jim, have you got everything you need?”
“Yes, I have.”
“Jack, what about you?”
“Mom, I don’t need to bring anything, the weapons are stored in the school.”
“I’m not talking about weapons; even cultivators have to read books, right? Otherwise, wouldn’t you become illiterate?”
“All! Look, I will get the books for this semester at school.”
Today is the beginning of the next semester, and early in the morning, Doris Raven is urging the two brothers to bring everything they need. The question is, do they have anything to bring?
As the two brothers walked side by side, Glenn Clark is excited, “Bro, that Mutated Beast Meat is really delicious. 1 feel like I’m full of energy these days.”
Jack remains silent, “You’d better not say that in front of mom, or she’ll think she never fed you enough before.”
“Don’t worry, bro, I won’t say that in front of mom.”
Glenn chuckled, his head resembling a tiger’s, “Besides, even though I was full every day before, 1 always felt hungry quickly and wanted to find something to eat.”
“It’s probably a ‘nutrition’ issue.” Speaking, Jack looked at the burly and fierce-looking Glenn beside him and couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
Damn, is this a thirteen-year-old ‘kid’?
With a waist as thick as a water barrel, arms that could straddle a horse, and strong thighs full of power, he seemed to be ready to play the role of Zhang Fei if he just put a beard on his face.
Jack thought about it, “In the next few days, Jim, you can try eating more Mutated Beast Meat. However, if you feel too full, stop eating.”
Over the past two days, he had noticed that Doris Raven’s physique was similar to that of ordinary people, and eating a little Mutant Beef was enough for her.
However, Glenn’s body was strong in absorbing energy. It might be just as Jack had sensed. From the time he was a young child, he was a ‘genius.’.
At this moment, after eating the Mutated Beast Meat that Jack brought back, the energy from the food was sufficient to meet the conditions, and Glenn’s physique might gradually awaken.
Of course, Jack’s talent wasn’t bad either.
Although his innate physique was a bit weak, his Mental Talent was very strong, being above average even with half of his soul split.
If he hadn’t experienced Soul Split and had an attribute page back then, and he was just a person with awakened memory, he might have become an extraordinary genius with strong perception instead.
Lost in thought, the two brothers parted ways at the intersection.
Along the way, Jack saw many students in school uniforms walking and cycling. The only difference was that Jack didn’t have to wear a uniform anymore.
Just like the beginning of the previous semester, the entrance of South Sky Martial Height School was bustling today, and the vehicles dropping off students almost blocked the street leading to the school gate.
“Jack, good morning.”
“Darren, you’re here too.”
“Jack, 1 heard you broke through the Four Layer Heaven, that’s amazing!”
As Jack prepared to walk into the school as relaxedly as before, along the Pedestrian Walkway, many familiar and unfamiliar classmates greeted him warmly.
Not only were there cultivation students, but also those humanities students who had given up cultivating after a week or half a month.
“I just got lucky.”
“It was a fluke, a fluke breakthrough.”
“It’s good, but it’s a pity that you didn’t persist in Foundation Establishment back then. I think you have a lot of talent too. You learned faster than me in the first Body Casting Skill cultivation class…”
Faced with these warm greetings, Jack responded with a smile on his face and a gentle tone.
This continued until he walked into the Martial Sects Area.
In the next semester of Senior One at South Sky Martial Height, students who chose humanities or martial arts began to ‘divide into classes.’ Five classes of martial cultivation students formed a group.
However, joining the group would happen in a few days, today was just the day to report.
When Jack arrived at Lori Parma’s office, he saw him sitting in his chair, talking on the mobile phone with someone, and gesturing to Jack to look at the box on the desk.
Upon seeing this, Jack quickly walked over.
As expected, when he opened the box, a metal-like wristwatch, with a surface entwined with silver material, appeared. “Your Sumeru Bracelet has been approved, try to input your True Strength and realm of thought along with it to make an imprint,” Lori Parma put down his phone.
“At that time, only you will be able to use and open this bracelet unless someone else wipes out your imprint with a stronger realm of thought.”
Space Equipment, a must-have for committing all sorts of crimes.
Jack showed a smile on his face and followed Lori Parma’s instructions to input True Strength first, then his realm of thought along with it.
In an instant, a void space about three cubic meters appeared in Jack’s perception.
This space relies on the bracelet, and its size and shape changes according to his thoughts, such as elongating or becoming wider and flatter.
When Jack imprinted his Spiritual Imprint on the ‘core’ of the space, an indistinct connection was formed between them.
In his perception, he could open the space at any time, and when his spirit covered an object, he could put it inside. It was very convenient and flexible.
However, there shouldn’t be any strong True Strength fluctuations nearby when putting things in and out of the space, or it would interfere with the Spatial Fluctuations.
“This time, your application for the Weapon Casting Secret Skill has also been approved, and I’ve given you access. Practice it more when you have time and forge your own Transcendent Weapon as soon as possible.”
Jack sincerely thanked him, “Thank you, teacher.”
This time, Lori Parma saved him nearly 6oo Contribution Points, almost the total amount of contribution points he had obtained since joining the school.
“You’re welcome, that’s what I’m supposed to do. I’ve also applied for over loo contribution point subsidies for Crystal Leinster and Justin Welan,” Lori Parma waved his hand, indicating Jack to go about his business..

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 142: The Eight Wastelands Heavy Halberd, The Return of the Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 142: The Eight Wastelands Heavy Halberd, The Return of the Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
Having stepped out of the office, Jack Clark went to his storage locker and with a mere thought moved his combat knife and battle armor into his bracelet.
Jake Clark murmured, “This thing really is convenient.”
At this moment, his mobile phone rang from his pocket, causing him to pause. Who could be calling him at this time?
Upon checking the caller ID and seeing it was Freya Louise, he couldn’t help but ask, “Freya, aren’t you at school? Why are you calling me all of a sudden?” “Come to the Logistics Department.”
“What’s going on?”
The girl on the other end responded quietly: “Help me move something.”
“Moving stuff, huh? I’m good at that. Wait for me.”
Despite his confusion over what she could possibly need help with given her arm strength of one to two thousand kilograms, Jack Clark still promptly agreed, arriving at the logistics department shortly afterwards.
It was the first day of school, so the Logistics Department was fairly empty, save for a young girl with delicate features standing in front of the counter, smiling brightly at the sight of Jack Clark walking in.
On the counter behind her was a halberd with a three-meter-long handle as thick as a goose egg. The halberd’s entire body was entwined in gold thread against a black background, with a sharp point at the end that resembled a spear.
The halberd’s tip was fifty centimeters long, had barbs, and the slash blades on both sides extended over half a meter, arching forward and sloping back. It was similar to the Square Sky Halberd, but exuded a more overbearing and powerful air.
Predominantly suitable for stabbing forward, the weapon would also be ideal for a person of Jack Clark’s strength to cleave and sweep.
Upon seeing this, Jack Clark halted.
Gracefully folding her hands behind her back, the young girl smiled at Jack Clark. “Take it. As a good friend, consider this a belated birthday gift from me.” The look in Jack Clark’s eyes suddenly became complicated.
He hadn’t expected that she would gift him a battle halberd, a day after he casually mentioned the contribution points he’d just earned were enough to exchange for a halberd technique.
Compared to the battle knife worth 10 contribution points, this type of heavy weapon was much more expensive. Particularly this halberd, which was clearly extraordinary, would cost at least 30 points.
Jake Clark inhaled deeply: “How did you know I just had my birthday?”
“Your mom quietly filled me in yesterday morning. She said you should have invited us to a celebratory meal for your birthday, but it seemed like you were too shy to invite us.”
“I never would have guessed you could feel shy.” Unable to suppress herself, the girl broke into laughter.
Cough!
Jake Clark coughed: “It’s not that I was shy. 1 just thought there was no need to make a fuss over an ordinary birthday. I’m not some bigshot.”
Freya Louise shook her head: “You might not be now, but who can say for certain in a couple of years. There’s a saying ‘ain’t nobility and rogues just different seeds?'”
Given Jack Clark’s terrifying talent of the Fourth Layer Heaven in just half a year, his cultivation level would definitely exceed the Seventh Layer Heaven in a couple of years. Such a powerful man would have some clout in Mist River.
The young girl blinked her beautiful eyes and pointed to the halberd on the counter. “This is the first time I’ve given someone a gift. You wouldn’t embarrass me by not accepting it, right?”
“Alright, I’ll accept your gift.” Jack didn’t hesitate. After all, it was only thirty contribution points. To him now, that wasn’t a big deal.
Jake walked up and grabbed the handle of the halberd in the middle. He immediately felt the weight in his hand.
This battle halberd was a total of three-point-six meters long, with its widest part nearly one meter in width. It probably weighed around a hundred and fifty kilograms. Ordinary people wouldn’t even be able to drag it, but Jack lifted it up effortlessly with a slight exertion of strength.
Jack swung the huge halberd a couple of times casually. An instant raging wind bellowed within the Logistics Department. It was so formidable that it created an overbearing and invincible aura.
When Jack stopped, Freya Louise couldn’t help but exclaim, “Looks like you really are suited to this kind of heavy weapon.”
“Indeed it feels way more comfortable.” Jack nodded.
Having accepted the gift, the two walked out of the Logistics Department shoulder to shoulder. The staff heaved a sigh of relief as the pair showing off their ‘love’ finally left.
When they exited the Logistics Department, following a thought from Jack, the halberd disappeared into his bracelet, subsequently causing the invisible interior space of the bracelet to expand momentarily.
Noticing this, Freya Louise looked surprised. “The Sumeru Bracelet, did Mr.Perry help you apply for it?”
“You knew about this?”
The young girl shook her head, “Mr. Perry also sent me a message earlier to collect my reward. But 1 didn’t expect that you would receive a Sumeru Bracelet.”
As someone who had slain the Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy and a cultist, Freya Louise’s Battle achievments were not inferior to Crystal Leinster, and she also received additional rewards.
However, their rewards were resources that were compatible with their Cultivation Methods.
Suddenly, Freya Louise said, “Right, you were planning to exchange for the Advanced Halberd Skill, aren’t you? Then this halberd will be forged into a Transcendent Weapon.”
Jack nodded,”Yeah, I plan to forge it as soon as 1 have the Transcendent Materials.”
“In that case, shouldn’t this weapon have a name?”
He didn’t care much about the name of the weapon, but seeing Freya Louise’s anticipation, he couldn’t help but smile and say, “Why don’t you help me choose one?”
“Sure.”
Freya Louise nodded excitedly. After some contemplation, she said, “Considering your fighting style is domineering, strength is peerless, and you wield a battle halberd that is well-suited for cleaving,”
“Also, the cultivation method you want to exchange for is called Eight Desolate Refining Hell, so why not just name it Eight Desolate Battle Halberd?”
“When you reach the Ninth Heavens, one strike from the halberd will cause the mountains and rivers to crumble, the giant beasts to wail, even the gods and ghosts will flee, sweeping the eight wastes.” While speaking, she even enthusiastically waved her hand in the air.
Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, isn’t naming it after the Cultivation Method the same as not naming it at all?
While inwardly making fun of her, his face remained composed as Jack nodded appreciatively, “Nice name. When I forge this into a Transcendent Weapon, 1’11 have ‘Eight Desolate Battle Halberd’ engraved on it.”
Seeing that her suggested name was adopted, Freya Louise was extremely pleased. Waving at Jack Clark she said, “In that case, you should go and exchange for your advanced combat skills. I’ll go find Mr. Perry to collect my things..”

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 142: The Eight Wastelands Heavy Halberd, The Return of the Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 142: The Eight Wastelands Heavy Halberd, The Return of the Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
Translator: 549690339
After saying that, the girl walked away lightly with her hands behind her back, heading towards Teaching Building C.
Jack Clark watched her receding figure and smiled, before turning and walking in another direction.
Just like advanced skills, the inheritance of advanced combat skills at the realm of the Fourth Layer Heaven and above also contains martial intent. So, Jack Clark came to the outside of that square building again. freeweb(n)ovel
Following Sylvia Lyons procedure from that day, Jack Clark went through layers of identity verification before entering.
Passing through the long corridor, Jack Clark came to the Inheritance Hall, which, although unguarded, was monitored by the Heavenly Intelligence System the entire time.
Welcome to the Heavenly Intelligence System, please enter your Student ID
Facial bone verification passed, pupil verification passed, please choose the Cultivation Method you want to learn.
You have chosen the advanced combat skill Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, which requires II Authority and 100 Contribution Points. Requirements met, Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd intent is being activated
Just as with last times inheritance of Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, but without the oath this time, Jack Clark pressed his palm directly onto the stele. Boom!
Jack Clarks consciousness shook and was pulled into the stele. He saw a big halberd that emitted a terrible aura slashing horizontally from a distance, shattering the sky and the earth wherever it passed.
At the moment when the big halberd hit Jack Clarks consciousness, Jack Clarks consciousness roared, and countless mysterious information poured into his mind, leaving him in silence.
Whoo!
Above the sea surface, a huge fishing boat sounded its horn, and the staff behind threw a long trawl net, starting todays work.
In the era when there were more and more mutated marine organisms, fishing boats were still able to catch fish.
However, the fishing boats now needed to be solid and large enough to withstand collision from average mutated creatures. The nets must also be strong; otherwise, the fish would tear them apart and escape.
Also, the fishing targets needed to be precise. With the assistance of sonar detection, ordinary mutated fish were the only targets.
And the fishing could only be done in shallow seas less than a hundred meters deep, not too far from the shore to avoid danger.
Although fishing is now much more complicated than before, there were more marine organisms in the near seas over the years, most likely due to mutation, allowing them to support many lives still.
At the control panel, a young man looked at the sonar detection and wondered, Its strange, Captain. Ive noticed that there are fewer large mutated creatures recently.
The captain, who was steering the boat, didnt care much, Maybe theyve swum away. These mutated creatures arent our livestock, they wont stay in one place.
Plus, its better if there are fewer large mutated creatures. Otherwise, they might target our catch and tear the nets, making it very troublesome to repair them.
As they spoke, the fishing boat dragged the big net and slowly passed through this sea area.
It was not until the fishing boat became a tiny dot that a huge shadow emerged from the depths of the sea.
Sharp dorsal fins, a body length of 20 meters, and thick, distinct black scale armor shone with a dark red glow, emitting an intense heat.
On either side of the ferocious head, three pairs of red feathers with sharp spikes spread out up to 3 meters long, with flames dancing on them, looking very imposing and overbearing.
By now, three days had passed since the beginning of the semester.
For the past few days, in order to accumulate enough evolution value as soon as possible, it had been killing almost madly. It didnt let go of any mutated creatures that were over five meters long that it encountered.
Under these circumstances, almost all the mutated fish in this sea area had been eaten, finally reaching the requirements for the fourth evolution.
After glancing at the fishing boat that had become a small dot, the Sword Armor Flame Beast submerged itself, disappearing from the sea surface.
On its body, the Hidden God Method it had been cultivating diligently for more than a month was operating, turning into invisible power fluctuations that enveloped its entire body, concealing its aura and energy fluctuations.
The Sword Armor Flame Beast had now reached the peak of intermediate Mutated Beasts, with a terrifying aura.
According to the distinction of three tiers of Mutated Beasts, an intermediate
Mutated Beast at its peak was equivalent to a Level 6 Peak, which was two levels higher than Jack Clarks body that had just broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven
As soon as this fourth evolution was completed, the Sword Armor Flame Beast would break through to Level 7, becoming a high-order creature.
By then, having absorbed the electrical power of the electric ray, along with the scorching flames it already possessed, it would have the talents of dual natural powers.
He only wondered if the power of this fire talent would be enhanced during this evolution. bender
Thinking of this, a hint of eagerness emerged in the Sword Armor Flame Beasts cold golden vertical pupils.
Under the sea surface, the Sword Armor Flame Beast swam towards the Los Angeles Coast, carefully concealing the energy fluctuations on its body to avoid being detected by the detectors when it got close to the shore.
The fourth evolution was imminent, and it didnt want any accidents to occur..

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 143: The Fourth Evolution, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 143: The Fourth Evolution, The
Phenomenon of Double Pupils
Translator: 549690339
In the afternoon, before school ended, Jack Clark and Freya Louise, who received the notice, came to Lori Parmas office.
So far, including you two, there are fifteen people who have applied to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield. They are all freshmen from this term and have been preparing to go there by now. bender
The gathering time is set for Sunday.
At that time, I will depart with you, but I will be going to the Frontline Battlefield.
Hearing these words, Jack Clark couldnt help but ask curiously, Sir, the frontline battlefield you mentioned is in the mythical world, isnt it?
A smile appeared on Lori Parmas face: Why, curious about it?
Yes! Both Jack Clark and Freya Louise nodded the head.
Lori Parma slowly said: Its a boundless world with rich extraordinary resources. In these years, we humans have been expanding and opening up territories in there.
However, as we further explore and extend into that world, humans have come into conflict with many creatures.
There exist horrendous giant beasts like those in tales, bizarre and unknown terrifying monsters, powerful alien civilizations, therefore, the major forces of various countries have been deployed there in these years.
There are countless strong individuals there, terrifying battles are happening daily, significant amounts of ammunition and provisions are consumed, and large-scale weapons like Hydrogen Bombs are often used on the frontline.
There are even weapons more destructive than nuclear weapons, which can annihilate all creatures within a hundred-mile range once used. Even experts of the Ninth Heavens cant survive.
In addition, there are battlefields for the powerhouses above the king-level, where with a wave of their hand, they can cause a landslide, fly in the sky or travel underground, they are tremendously terrifying
But Lori Parma stopped talking here, and Jack Clark couldnt help but ask: Sir, is there more??
No more.
Lori Parma laughed: According to the rules, 1 still cant tell you more detailed information. If you want to know more, get stronger quickly, and you will naturally know by then.
Mr. Perry is seriously teasing us. said Jack Clark as he walked out of the teaching building.
Upon hearing this, the girl chuckled lightly.
Speaking of this, Jack Clark was somewhat longing: Mythical giant beasts, terrifying monsters, and other civilizations, I didnt expect the world over there to be so vast and mysterious.
But Mr.Perry said nuclear bombs and Hydrogen Bombs are often used there. Arent they afraid of nuclear radiation?
Freya Louise said softly: Nuclear radiation only has a strong impact on the genes of ordinary creatures, and once a creature mutates, its body becomes incredibly powerful and its genes are stable.
In addition, all mutated creatures above the senior level have strong transcendent power within their bodies, which can isolate external harm, including radiation. Therefore, the problem of radiation is not so troublesome for advanced creatures. freeweb novel.co m
That makes sense. Jack Clark nodded. f(r)eeweb
At this moment, the girl brushed off her hair and whispered: 1 may have to do some preparations in the next few days and wont be coming to school. So, see you on Sunday.
Ok, see you on Sunday.
After they parted, Jack Clark came home at five oclock, and Glenn Clark had already returned.
Jack Clark unplugged the plug underneath the refrigerated truck and shouted inside: Jim, Im going to deliver the electric ray meat. 1 will be back late, so dont wait for me for dinner.
Okay, brother. Glenn Clark responded from inside the house.
A few days ago, when Jack Clark moved the Mutant Beef into the freezer, he told Glen about his plans to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield for a long time.
The electric ray left at home cant be eaten by Glenn and others, so Jack would make an excuse to find a buyer and sell it.
Hum! Accompanied by the start of the engine, the refrigerated transport vehicle slowly left the courtyard, leaving Mist River according to the navigation and heading towards Los Angeles.
An hour and a half later, Jack Clark arrived again at the seaside road by the estuary.
At this time, it was getting dark, but there were still scattered figures at the seaside. Therefore, Jack Clark simply stood on the sea embankment to enjoy the scenery, quietly waiting for night to fall.
He stood there for an hour.
It wasnt until after eight oclock that there were no people left by the sea. Only then did Jack Clark take a deep breath, went to the rear of the vehicle and opened the door. Immediately, a wave of cold rushed out.
The six-meter-long electric rays corpse, frozen into a large loop in the low temperature, weighed over a thousand kilograms in its frozen state.
Jack Clark lifted the heavy body of the electric ray, came to the seaside, and then his whole bodys muscles expanded, and endless strength poured out from within his body.
Boom!
With a full-strength throw from Jack Clark, the over-one-ton-rays corpse flew out like a cannonball and smashed onto the sea surface a hundred meters away with a boom, splashing water everywhere.
In order not to cause trouble, Jack Clark only unleashed his physical strength this time and did not activate the True Strength.
Soon, the rays corpse that fell into the sea sank, and at this time, a huge shadow flashed beneath the sea surface, and it bit the rays corpse in one mouthful.
At this moment, Jack Clark, standing on the shore, took off his upper clothes and jumped into the sea with a swish. His arms moved like wind wheels, turning up powerful waves and shooting out.
Soon, Jack Clark, who had arrived a hundred meters away, dove into the water. In there, the ferocious behemoth, twenty meters long, lay on the seabed, holding the corpse of the ray in its mouth.
By the time Jack Clark dived down, the Sword Armor Flame Beast raised its head, blowing out a string of bubbles from its mouth, to facilitate him to take away the Life Crystal it was holding beneath its neck.
This time, in order to avoid any accidents, Jack Clark was so cautious that he didnt even let the Sword Armor Flame Beast show up on the sea surface.
Even if it had the Hidden Deity Method to converge its aura and energy fluctuations, it was the same.
This evolution was crucial for both the Sword Armor Flame Beast and him, and no accidents could be allowed.
Therefore, after taking away the two Level 4 Life Crystals, Jack Clark immediately turned and rushed out of the water, he swung his arms and swam back to the shore.
When he got ashore, Jack Clark vibrated the True Strength in his body, shaking off most of the sea water on his pants. Then he put on his clothes, got in the car and left immediately after starting the engine..
