chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 143: The Fourth Evolution, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 143: The Fourth Evolution, The
Phenomenon of Double Pupils_2
Translator: 549690339
Meanwhile, as the Sword Armor Flame Beast was quickly swimming towards the outer sea to find a suitable place to evolve.
Youve converted two high-purity life energy crystals and gained 72 and 93 attribute points, respectively.
Is the gap between level 4 life crystals so big? Halfway there, Jack Clark paused slightly as he casually converted those two life crystals into attributes.
There was almost a twenty-point difference between level 4 crystals, which seemed to be related to the size of the mutant creature from which the crystal originated.
When Jack returned home, it was already past nine oclock.
Jack, youre back! Your dinners in the kitchen, warming up.
Mom, keep watching your TV, ill get it myself. Wheres Jim?
He went fishing again.
Alright.
After Jack brought home mutated beast meat, Glenn Clark had given his fish to the government, and although the money he got wasnt much, he was enjoying it.
After dinner, Jack went back upstairs.
At the same time, out at sea, the Sword Armor Flame Beast reached the reef group where it had once killed a mutant crocodile whale, more than 200 kilometers away from the coast.
By bypassing the outer reefs, the Sword Armor Flame Beast reached the area beneath a small island that was only more than a thousand square meters in size and protruded more than 10 meters above the water surface.
During the third evolution, the Heavy Armored Beast had been hibernating for more than two hours, so Jack expected this fourth evolution would take even longer, and thus a safe place was needed.
Underneath the small island, the Sword Armor Flame Beasts claws swung and cut through the hard reef rock as if it were tofu.
Soon, a cave with an entrance five meters wide and deep, twisting dozens of meters into the mountain belly and measuring 40 meters in length and width, was excavated beneath the water surface.
For safety, the cave entrance passage was blocked by broken rock debris dug out by the Sword Armor Flame Beast, and the seawater became murky.
Only then did the Sword Armor Flame Beast slowly swim into the middle of the cave, its mouth biting wide open and greedily swallowing the defrosted electric ray it consumed in less than a second.
At the same time, Jack, standing by the window, moved his thoughts: Evolve!
As Jack confirmed, the boundless evolutionary energy that had been accumulating in the Sword Armor Flame Beasts body hundreds of kilometers away erupted like an earthquake.
This time, the accumulated evolutionary energy was even more astonishing, and under the beasts crazed roar, its entire body of flesh and bones shattered and regenerated.
All the cells in its body were dividing and compressing at a terrifying speed, then dividing and compressing again.
As it absorbed the genes of the electric ray inside the Sword Armor Flame Beast, its originally strong and stable genetic sequence began to collapse, reorganize, optimize, and initiate the fourth life leap.
In an instant, the aura on the Sword Armor Flame Beast became even more terrifying, causing trepidation as if a horrifying creature was lurking within the cave.
Under the shroud of this frightening aura, it even permeated through the crevices of the cave and spread outside, causing the surrounding seawater to boil and countless underwater creatures to flee frantically.
The awe-inspiring power of the beast was apparent.
At the same time, in the room, a violent heat wave erupted in Jacks body, and under the scorching energy of evolution, his cells were also crazily dividing and compressing.
His flesh and blood were rapidly growing stronger at a terrifying speed.
As Jacks bodys strength escalated, his originally repressed aura of power involuntarily spread out, becoming increasingly heavy and oppressive.
Like an overbearing dragon beast, the solidified heavy aura around Jack pushed the air within a one-meter radius away, generating invisible gusts of wind.
Instantly, the curtains danced, and his black hair flew.
However, luckily, no one saw this scene, otherwise it would have been too frightening.
This evolution took a long time for the Sword Armor Flame Beast and only ended almost five hours later, which was also the darkest time just before dawn.
Jack slowly opened his eyes, and in his black pupils, a hint of gold appeared, his gaze cold and mysterious, exuding a sense of majesty and nobility.bender
Like a supreme emperor.
As had happened the previous time he broke through, the dual pupil illusion disappeared as Jack slowly closed his eyes, then opened them again.
This avatar evolution provided a greater improvement to the main body than the previous one. Although his martial arts realm was still in the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, Jack felt that he could kill someone at the Fifth Layer Heaven with a single punch.
In amazement, Jack activated his attribute page with a thought.
Realm: Fourth Layer Heaven
Physique: 645 > 950
Strength: 690 -> 1015
Agility: 560 -> 865
Spirit: 581 -> 895
Talent: Soul Split+
Cultivation Methods: Lotus Platform Meditation Skill, Dragon Elephant Overlord Body* [Fourth Layer]Minds Eye Bright Knife[Limit Break]
Secret Skill: Hidden Deity* [Beginner]
Runes: Elephants Fury[Incomplete]Cut through the Void[Incomplete]
Attribute Points: 177
Equipment: Sharp Battle Knife [Solidity +10, Sharpness +10]
Avatar Body: Hexagonal Thunderflame Colossus
Level: High-Level Mutant Beast[Monarch of Unique Beasts with Seven Talents]
Mortal Body Talent: Strength+[Top-tier, a hundred times physical strength explosion]Defense+ [Top-tier, a hundred times physical crushing defense]Agility+[Senior, thirty times instantaneous moving speed of the body]
Regeneration* [Low-tier, able to quickly restore the flesh body by consuming energy, can consume 100 attribute points to strengthen, upgrade to intermediate level after three transfers]
Toxin+[Low-tier, can secrete powerful corrosion venom between teeth, corrode flesh and blood, can consume 100 attribute points to strengthen, upgrade to intermediate level after three transfers]
Transcendent Talent: Blazing Flame*[Intermediate, thousands of degrees Celsius high temperature permeating between flesh and blood, can condense energy explosion containing 5000 degrees Celsius flaming breath]
Thunder [Intermediate, powerful force of thunder throughout the body, capable of producing, transforming, storing lightning energy, and forming a thunderstorm magnetic field shattering everything when it bursts..]

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 143: Fourth Evolution, Double Pupil Phenomenons
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 143: Fourth Evolution, Double Pupil Phenomenons
Translator: 549690339
Evolution value 0/30000bender
This time, Jack Clarks physique increased by more than 300 points after the evolution, and his strongest attribute, strength, even broke through 1000 points, which was extremely terrifying.
Moreover, this time his physique, agility, spirit, or soul strength were all greatly improved.
It allowed him to crush cultivators of the same level or even one realm higher in all aspects of basic data, greatly enhancing his combat power, not just in terms of power explosion.
However, in comparison to Jacks own changes, the changes of his avatar were even more exaggerated.
Its name changed to Thunderflame Behemoth, and its level entered the high-order Level 7 realm. At the same time, the talents below were divided into two categories: physique and transcendent, with more detailed remarks.
It seemed that the attribute page was also being optimized as he grew.
Or rather, this attribute page was originally an alternative soul talent for him, but it had not condensed into shape because of the reason for the rebirth through crossing.
With the awakening of his former consciousness and the activation of soul power, it revealed itself.
Now, as his knowledge and information grew more comprehensive, the talent1 of the attribute page evolved to become more detailed after each evolution.
Chen Chus gaze fell thoughtfully on the talent data of the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Among them, strength and Defensive Talent were top-tier, and the Agility Talent gained during the third evolution was senior level. No wonder Jack always felt that the Agility Talent was weaker than the strength and defense.
In addition, the inherent Regeneration and Weak Toxin talents of the
Six-legged Salamander also finally formed during the Fourth Evolution, although they were at a low level.
The previously acquired Intense Heat Talent also had its power increase several times during this evolution, reaching an intermediate level. Jacks whole body could emit a high temperature of thousands of degrees Celsius.
In addition, he could now expel the blazing breath that could melt metals.
With the addition of the Thunder Talent acquired this time, the strength of the avatar instantly became terrifying.
It seems that with each evolution, the level of talents acquired is getting weaker.
Seeing this, Jacks brows furrowed, and for a moment he couldnt figure out whether it was due to the number of avatar evolutions or the mutated creatures absorbed this time.
After a long time, Jack, who had finished reading all the attribute changes, finally exhaled and shifted his attention to the evolved Thunderflame Behemoth.
In the pitch-black cave, a ferocious behemoth with a length of 25 meters, covered in intense flames, and leaping with lightning on its dorsal fin, opened its golden vertical pupils.
Boom!
With the rising of the Thunderflame Behemoth, the infinite flames mixed with terrifying power exploded, instantly destroying the roof of the cave and causing half of the small island to collapse.
During the earth-shattering event, a figure radiating black-red light landed on half of the collapsed island with a bang. The rock beneath its claws cracked, and the ground trembled.
Roar!
The black-red ferocious giant beast let out a roar, and a circle of sound waves containing a terrible majesty exploded. In an instant, the seawater around the island exploded, producing circles of waves.
After the Fourth Evolution, in addition to the changes in talent, the appearance of the Thunderflame Behemoth has also undergone significant changes.
The body was burning with red flames, the blue arcs jumped on the back fin, and the body length increased from 20 meters to 25 meters.
However, most of this length was added to the tail.
The original tail, which occupied half of the body, had this time grown by three meters, and was covered with black-red scales, becoming more slender. The black bone spurs at the end of the tail were even more sharp and menacing.
The body, which had grown two meters, became stronger, the muscles bulged, and the whole body was covered with heavy black-red exoskeletons, exuding an unshakeable solidity.
In addition, the pair of hind legs became even more sturdy and powerful, containing a horrifying explosive power.
The flexible, elongated foreclaws in front were like arms, and the explosive muscles made them more suitable for close combat, fierce and agile.
There was also a significant change on the back. The sharp dorsal fins that resembled long spikes became thicker, and the uneven coral reef rocks stretched from the head to the tail.
The appearance of the dorsal fins was similar to that of Godzillas, but they were much more heavy and hard. At this time, arcs of lightning jumped between the black-blue dorsal fins, and the electric light sparkled.
Apart from those, the giant beasts head became even wider and thicker. The head grew a number of short black horns pointing straight to the sky, resembling a demon dragon emerging from the abyss of hell.
Especially the three pairs of red feathered horns on both sides, with golden-red flames leaping above them, burned like a circle of flame crown under the majestic aura of the giant beast.
Suddenly a terrifying aura erupted from the Thunderflame Behemoth, the flames of the body flourished, and even the roots of the black-blue dorsal fins lit up, emitting dazzling blue light.
Boom!
In an instant, centered on the Thunderflame Behemoth, endless blue electric light exploded, like a spherical lightning net expanding rapidly, sweeping a range of 100 meters in the blink of an eye.
Lightning as thick as an arm fell on the island, causing rocks to scatter. When it fell on the sea surface, the seawater exploded, and arcs of lightning overflowed.
In the blink of an eye, countless small fish and shrimp corpses floated to the surface within a range of one kilometer.
As the spherical lightning net exploded, the Thunderflame Behemoth suddenly looked up, opened its mouth wide, and the red light inside converged.
And in an instant, a pillar of fire spewed out.
Boom!
One meter in diameter, the scorching pillar of fire roared out. The high temperature instantly annihilated the air, kept expanding, and reached a thickness of five meters by the time it reached 200 meters.
Soon after, the pillar of fire exploded and turned into a circle of scorching hot flame aura, which rushed out a hundred meters, illuminating the night sky and appearing extremely spectacular.
However, after the explosion, the flames and electric arcs on the Thunderflame Behemoth dimmed.
Even the flames on his body gradually extinguished, leaving only the dark red scales emitting a high temperature to roast the air.
Four claws standing on the island, which had melted into magma and then slowly cooled, the Thunderflame Behemoths golden vertical pupils revealed excitement.
After this evolution, its strength had become very terrifying, and although its body length was only 25 meters, it was already considered a giant beast.
Not to mention, after testing its scorching breath and the power of lightning just now, it did not disappoint. Strong transcendent talents finally made it lose its shortcomings.
However, compared to the mythical giant beasts that make humans helpless, it was still just at the beginning.
With that in mind, the Thunderflame Behemoth looked towards the distant sea and, in an instant, the rocks under it shattered. Its massive body turned into a black shadow and leaped up several hundred meters before crashing into the sea with a splash..

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 144: Thunder Giant Beast, Avatar Targeted by the Authorities
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 144: Thunder Giant Beast, Avatar Targeted by the Authorities
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
Accompanied by the sea waves exploding and rushing to a height of tens of meters, the shadow of the Thunderflame Behemoth disappeared from the sea surface in an instant.
As soon as it entered the water, the Thunderflame Behemoth quickly discovered the differences.
For example, it was now more agile in the water, and with each flick of its tail, it could propel itself much farther; its normal speed was more than twice as fast as before.bender
At this moment, there was an invisible force flowing around its body, acting like a lubricant to reduce the resistance of the seawater.
Moreover, the dorsal fin on its back, which could store, convert, and produce electricity, was emitting a series of faint electric waves.
These electric waves were imperceptible, like a radar system that covered a range of hundreds of meters. When they encountered an object or life form, they would react.
At that time, these faint electric waves bounced back and were sensed by the sensing cells of the dorsal fin, which then transmitted the information to the brain.
Compared to the eyesight and the feather horn sensing the fluctuations of the water flow, this was the third sensing method, almost allowing the Thunderflame Behemoth to monitor its surroundings in all directions.
In such an situation, almost no mutated creature could ambush it. As long as they approached a certain range, they would be detected unless they were not in the same spatial dimension.
This change made the Thunderflame Behemoth even more excited, and its huge body surged and swam in the sea before disappearing into the deep sea in the blink of an eye.
At the moment the Thunderflame Behemoth burst onto the scene, an alarm went off at a coastal surveillance base hundreds of kilometers away, where staff members quickly gathered.
Report: A high-energy Level 7 reaction has been detected 170 kilometers off the coast, at coordinates 735, longitude 4175, and latitude 98169 on the sea surface.
Have the satellite monitors been assembled?
Yes, weve immediately transferred three nearby high-definition satellites, but due to weather and nightfall, only a few blurry photos were taken.
As the staff reported, three huge pictures appeared on the big screen, showing the Thunderflame Behemoth standing on a broken island from three different angles.
However, just as the staff mentioned, the images were somewhat blurred.
The screen showed a black and red creature standing in the Thunderstorm Domain, with a halo of flames burning on its head, illuminating the surrounding sea surface.
But due to the darkness of the night, it could only be vaguely seen as a sleek black mutated creature with flames burning on its body.
Even if it was just a blurry image, everyone present could still feel an invisible pressure coming
What about the other data?
According to the comparisons and surroundings, this mutant beast is between twenty-three and twenty-seven meters in length, with a shoulder height of four to six meters. Its peak energy fluctuation at the moment of eruption reached Level 7 Peak.
Suddenly, the middle-aged man with the rank of Lieutenant General looked serious and said solemnly, This should be a newly promoted mutant beast, and a king beast with the potential of becoming a king.
This mutant beast is terrifying. Its energy burst just after promotion has reached the Level 7 Peak, and it seems to have swum into the outer sea based on its final trajectory.
Classify the data of this mutant beast as top-secret, lock down the images, and have the satellites always pay attention to its movements when it surfaces in the sea.
Lets hope its final destination is one of those deep-sea tunnels and that it doesnt cause any trouble in the human world.
Following the generals orders, several of the densely packed satellites in outer space adjusted their positions slightly to target this sea area.
At the same time, it was visible that some enormous objects floated quietly at even higher and more distant orbits.
After the Thunderflame Behemoth entered the sea, Jack Clark withdrew part of his focus and continued to ponder the changes that this Avatar Evolution brought to him.
However, Jack gradually became contemplative.
He discovered that it seemed as if his main body and avatars relationship was not Synchronous Strengthening, but equivalence.
Synchronous Strengthening meant that as his avatar strength increased, his main body would increase by the same amount. For example, now that his avatar had reached Level 7, he should be a condensed human form of a Level 7 Mutant Beast.
But it was obviously not the case with his realm still at the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven. Although his physique was already stronger than a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivators, his strength far exceeded it.
In fact, Jack had noticed this issue earlier.
Since his avatar began to evolve for the first time and started to feedback some power, the increase in the strength of his main body was nowhere near the growth rate of the avatar.
By now, it was estimated to only be a few hundredths of a percent.
That is to say, even though the avatars growth and evolution also strengthened the main body through feedback, the extent of the strengthening was merely equivalent to the volume of the human body.
The reason for this should be the influence of the soul.
Both the avatar and the main body belonged to the same soul, so when the avatars body evolved and grew, the main body, which was considered part of the same entity as the avatar, was also strengthened accordingly.
Although Jack had already noticed this result, he was still somewhat disappointed.
He initially believed that his human body would eventually become an even more terrifying existence as his avatar continued to grow.
After all, when a giant beast with an alloy-like density and a body length of 10,000 meters is compressed into the size of a human, the invisible gravitational force it emits would tear everything around it apart.
In other words, by that point, he would be a humanoid celestial body.
Of course, although a little disappointed, Jack soon put the issue behind him. After all, one must learn to be content and know that there is no such thing as having everything perfect in the world.
Moreover, although it was already confirmed that the relationship between the two was equivalence in strengthening, no one could be sure that the potential of the avatar was stronger than the main body.
After all, the avatar could continuously devour and evolve, while the main body could also cultivate and strengthen itself, relying on attribute points to increase its cultivation level at a terrifying speed..

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 144: Thunder Giant Beast, Avatar
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 144: Thunder Giant Beast, Avatar
Targeted by the Authorities_2
Translator: 549690339
Or rather, the main body and the avatar are more like two separate paths.bender
One creature evolves, using its absolute physical body and evolved talents to crush everything, while the other path is more like the cultivation of laws.
With the breakthrough of the Fourth Layer Heaven, Jack Clark has a deeper understanding of cultivation.
In comparison to the innate advantages of those giant beasts, even if human flesh evolves, they still cant compare to them. Therefore, True Martial cultivation has been explored as a means to become stronger.
From the very beginning of Strengthening Constitution through tempering, to the changes that occurred after cultivating True Strength, and the True Martial arts phantom and the Law Domains in the Seventh Layer Heaven and the Ninth Heavens.
Not to mention those strong men who can cover an entire country with enchantments. Their abilities are already comparable to many legendary gods in myths and legends.
Rather, many ordinary rural gods in those folk tales are no match for the Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator.
Just as Jack Clark was feeling emotional, his eyes suddenly narrowed.
This is really a small world for enemies.
At a depth of more than 300 meters, the Thunderflame Behemoth, suddenly stopped after charging hundreds of kilometers under the sea.
It was biting a Mutated Spearfish more than ten meters long, and its double claws were holding the body of the Mutated Spearfish while devouring it with large bites, tearing off hundreds of kilograms of flesh and blood with each bite.
However, what made the Thunderflame Behemoth stop was not eating, but sensing the Mutant Beast several hundred meters ahead.
This was an area of towering seabeds, similar to a hilly area, where a ferocious Dragon Turtle with a body length of 37 meters was squatting more than 200 meters deep.
That thick, spiky turtle shell, its strong limbs as thick as mountain pillars, and the ferocious dragon head with two long horns.
It was the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that had previously snatched its Volcanic Coral Resources, broke through from the Level 6 Peak to Level 7 in one breath, and awakened the Dragon Bloodline.
Not to mention the six Crystal Horn Fishes it ate and the two escaped Crystal Horn Fishes more than ten or twenty meters long, which caused heavy losses to the Sword Armor Beast guarding it.
If it hadnt been for the intervention of this Dragon Turtle, the Sword Armor Flame Beast could have reached the requirements for the Fourth Evolution almost a week earlier.
With this thought, flames began to burn between the scales of the Thunderflame Behemoth, blue arcs jumped between its dorsal fins, and a terrifying aura spread.
In an instant, the huge Dragon Turtle hundreds of meters away stood up sharply, its eyes staring intently at the darkness ahead.
There, a ferocious Mutated Beast with flames burning on its body and jumping with lightning slowly appeared. Although its body was much smaller than it, its aura was even more terrifying.
Roar!
The Dragon Turtle roared with a low growl, the thick yellow light flowing on its body, and the aura instantly connected to the seabed below, emitting a heavy, mountainous sensation.
Apart from that, a strong and oppressive force burst out of its body. Under the influence of Dragon Might, all the marine life within a range of hundreds of meters around it fled in fear.
However, this Dragon Might had no effect on the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Roar!
With a roar, a fiercer and more powerful Dragon Might burst from the Thunderflame Behemoth, and under the terrifying aura, a ring of white waves exploded around it, making a shockingly loud noise.
Bang! The two mighty auras, both containing the Dragon Might, collided with each other, and the surrounding sea water roared and shook.
After reaching the Seventh Layer, the spirit and will of these creatures combined with their internal energy transformed their aura from formless to substantial, interfering with reality.
If they were human strongmen, they could even combine their will and spirit with martial arts to transform it into a phantom, commanding the strength of Heaven and Earth to sweep away all obstacles. Ordinary people would struggle just to stand in their presence.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Behemoth in the distance disappeared from its original location, followed by a boom, and an implosive shock wave of tens of meters in range exploded under the sea.
This was the phenomenon caused by its speed exceeding the speed of sound.
The Thunderflame Behemoth appeared as if it had teleported to the side of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, its double claws swelling with muscle and burning with flames and lightning, smashing down with the force of collapsing heavens.
BoomiWith a terrifying strike, the deep-sea Dragon Turtles energy shielding, which was as thick as one meter, went into a maddening frenzy, and its body sank deeper into the ocean floor, about tens of meters deep.
In an instant, the surrounding rocks broke, and huge cracks spread hundreds of meters.
This deep-sea giant turtles ability was similar to Justin Welans cultivation methods, transferring most of the attacking force to the Earth while connected and absorbing the Earths strength to enhance its own defense.
So even if the Thunderflame Beheamoth had unleashed all its ordinary power with the strike without its talent burst, it only managed to shake the turtles body.
And just as the Thunderflame Beheamoth unleashed its powerful attack and paused briefly in the water, a sudden roar resounded.
The dragon turtlehead, which had retreated into its shell, burst out.
The speed of this attack was so fast that it nearly reached the speed of sound.
The ferocious dragon mouth opened wide and appeared in front of the Thunderflame Beheamoth in an instant.
As a turtle species, a turtles ability to project its head in an attack has always been fast; otherwise, they wouldnt be able to catch food.
However, at this moment, the Thunderflame Beheamoth suddenly turned its head back, its golden vertical pupils cold, and its ferocious, sturdy right claw swung out at a speed impossible to discern.
Bang!
Under the horrifying strike, the Dragon Turtles energy shield, only half a meter thick on its head compared to its back, lasted only a moment before collapsing explosively.
Immediately after, the hard dragon scales were also torn apart by the sharp claws, flesh and blood burst, and a shrill scream was let out.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth had long anticipated the turtles head projection and had launched its previous attack near the turtle shell to lure it out.
But the defense of this deep-sea Dragon Turtle was indeed strong. It wasnt killed by the strike and only ended up with half of its face in a bloody mess.
It was truly a powerful mutated beast, worthy of having awakened a dragon bloodline.
Biu! At this moment, a pitch-black afterimage grazed the retreating Dragon Turtles head, carrying terrifying power as it landed on the shell behind it.
Puff!
Wrapped in flames, the black tail spike paused briefly before piercing through the one-meter-thick yellow shield on the dragon turtles body and more than a meter deep into the alloy-like hard turtle shell.
This attack was greatly horrifying, and if it werent for the Dragon Turtles head retreating quickly, it might have been killed by the Thunderflame Behemoths instant chained combination attack.
Though their sizes differed considerably, the Dragon Turtle found itself being suppressed in just an instant of combat, despite also awakening a dragon bloodline.
Humm! Sensing death brush past it, the Dragon Turtles body burst with terrifying vibrating shockwaves that exploded into yellow ripples.
Boom boom boom boom!!
As the terrifying shockwaves erupted, the surrounding seawater boiled, exploded, and all matter was ground to dust and destroyed by the invisible vibration force.
Even the hard seabed beneath the Dragon Turtle crumbled under the fearsome shockwaves, collapsing with a loud bang in just a few breaths.
Immediately, rolling mud and sand surged into the sky.
In an instant, the seawater within a kilometer range became extremely turbid, with surging waves creating a terrifying sight. The power of this move was several times stronger than before.
Obviously, the deep-sea Dragon Turtle had been growing during this time, making its close-range shockwave burst ability even more potent, capable of pulverizing everything around it.
The terrifying vibrations lasted nearly ten minutes, and by the time everything had quieted, the deep-sea giant turtle had vanished
No, not vanished, but it had buried itself.
As they looked at the faint yellow light emanating from the collapsed hill beneath, even the Thunderflame Behemoth, which had moved out of its hundreds of meters attack range, couldnt help but be stunned.
Youre not the ferocious mutant beast? How come youve just exchanged two moves, havent even warmed up, and youre already hiding?
For a moment, even the Thunderflame Behemoth was somewhat stunned by this move..

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 145: Burning the Sky and Boiling the Sea, Merging Techniques (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 145: Burning the Sky and Boiling the Sea, Merging Techniques (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Translator: 549690339
Under the murky depths of the deep sea, the Thunderflame Behemoth observed the scene ahead with a cold gaze.
After collapsing the seabed hill, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle buried itself twenty meters deep, with yellow energy shrouding its body, gradually blending in with the surrounding broken rocks.
Soon, a brand-new hill appeared on the seabed, with the power of the earth flowing on its surface, emitting a profound heaviness.
Even the Thunderflame Behemoth felt speechless in the face of such defensive tactics. It never expected that the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle would have such a move up its sleeve.bender
It seemed that this should be the talent it had acquired when it broke through Level 7 and awakened the Dragon Bloodline.
Under normal conditions, Level 7 high-ranked mutated creatures would possess two types of talents. Still, those who had awakened the Dragon Bloodline or king-level bloodlines would have one additional talent.
And this talent would be formidable.
At this moment, if the Thunder flame Behemoth wanted to continue attacking the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, it would have to destroy hundreds of thousands of tons of rocks above it, and much of the impact force would be dispersed by the seabed.
But did they really think they could be safe by hiding inside?
Whoosh!
Accompanied by the release of scorching breath, the Thunderflame Behemoths internal fiery power burst forth explosively. In an instant, the flames on its body surged, and the intense flames emitted temperatures of thousands of degrees Celsius.
Immediately, the surrounding sea water began to boil, producing large white bubbles.
Buzz! With the endless scorching energy gathering inside its body, the golden red flames burned on the feather horns on both sides of the Thunderflame Behemoths head, creating a faint fire crown above it.
An even more dazzling light emerged from its wide-open mouth.
Boom!
A scorching breath with a diameter of 1 meter and a temperature of 5000 degrees Celsius shot out; wherever it went, the seawater boiled, resembling a fiery pillar wrapped in white steam.
This flame breath was not an ordinary plasma flame, but a highly pure Heavenly Energy-transforming scorching flame, which would not be extinguished even in the depths of the sea.
In addition to that, the breath of the Thunderflame Behemoth contained a powerful impact force, making it instantly explode and vibrate on contact with the small hill, spewing out countless flames.
Under the impact of the scorching flame breath, the rocks melted visibly within a range of more than ten meters. Hot magma was continuously thrown out and then cooled down under the blanket of sea water.
Even the yellow energy contained within the rocks could not withstand the scorching flame breaths attack, gradually revealing a blazing pathway that went deeper downwards.
Simultaneously, with the endless eruption of scorching energy, the sea areas waters boiled, the terrifying energy fluctuations driving many mutated creatures away.
More frightening was the invisible ferocious Dragon Might that spread around the Thunderflame Behemoth when it exerted its full strength.
However, the Thunderflame Behemoth had only just advanced and made a breakthrough. After persisting for two minutes, the scorching flame breath in its mouth gradually weakened, eventually extinguishing suddenly.
At the same time, the flames burning on its body suddenly dimmed, leaving only a few small fire sparks dancing, and its aura weakened considerably.
Its endurance was still lacking.
Looking at the nearly twenty-meter deep and five-meter-wide massive pit that had almost reached the Dragon Turtle and was gradually cooling near its depth, the Thunderflame Behemoth felt somewhat speechless.
In fact, it was not due to its poor endurance, but rather, this breath-attack technique was originally one of the mutated creatures most potent moves, possessing massive power but also entailing massive consumption.
If the energy was endless, it would simply breathe everywhere it went upon seeing someone.
Meanwhile, even though the Thunderflame Behemoths breath weakened considerably, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle buried underground had no intention of coming out.
That was because it knew that the most potent aspect of this fearsome dragon beast was not its breath but the terrifying power contained within its body. It had almost been killed in a single encounter.
Just as the Thunderflame Behemoth stared at the stable small hill, flexing its sharp double claws, preparing to dig through the hill if the breath attack wouldnt work, the small hill began to tremble slightly.
Yellow energy spread across, and a crack appeared; following that, the low roar of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle came from within.
Roar!! I, you, enemies, for, trying to kill me?
Huh, this mutated beasts intelligence is quite high. The Thunderflame Behemoth paused, its eyes revealing a hint of surprise.
The so-called intelligence was not about intelligence.
One could say that as long as a creature had undergone a mutation and evolved, it would have some intelligence, which would increase with the creatures level, even surpassing humans in some cases.
However, intelligence did not mean that the other party was smart. Many mutated creatures, regardless of being at Level 8 or 9, were still just beasts just smarter ones.
They still followed the beastly instincts to survive, hunt, and fight.
For example, the deep-sea monster that had attacked Jack Clarks birthday party had a high IQ and held grudges, only to be eaten by the Sword Armor Flame Beast in the end.
Intelligence referred to cleverness and wisdom. These intelligent creatures understood learning, communication, contemplation, and self-awareness.
For example, the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
As for this Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, it seemed that it had not communicated much with other creatures. Although it knew how to imbue its roars with mental intent, its expressions were fragmented..

Translator: 549690339
Because it didnt remember seeing this fierce Dragon Beast before, let alone stealing its resources. This Dragon Beast was so terrifying, how could it dare to steal from it?
Huh, it even dares to deny it! Thunderflame Beheamoths eyes become cold.
Roar! Youve forgotten that quickly? I personally witnessed you eating my Luminous Coral and then evolving into a Dragon Beast.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle beneath the small hill was instantly stupefied.
When Thunder flame Beheamoth mentioned evolution and breakthrough, the Dragon Turtle finally understood what it meant by resources and fish, as well as the black Mutated Beast it had encountered on the way.
No wonder it had a sense of familiarity towards the red feather horns on each side of this Dragon Beasts head.
Butthis terrifying Dragon Beast was actually that weak black Unique Beast from before!!
Thinking of this, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was extremely shocked. It never thought that in such a short time, the negligible Mutated Beast could have become so terrifying.
Among turtle-like creatures, the concept of time is very slow.
To the Thunderflame Beheamoth, almost two months had already passed, but in its eyes, it had only eaten a few meals and taken a few naps.
And then, that unremarkable black Unique Beast had come for a fight.bender
Roar! Idid not steal. I was first on the scene.
Roar! Then, 1 moved. The fish occupied it. To level up, that is the only time I would go and eat
Because there was too much content to express, this time the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared for a long time.
It basically meant that it didnt steal the Thunderflame Beheamoths resources and that it was the first to discover the place.
But after consuming the first batch, it left. When it returned, finding the place occupied by Crystal Horn Fish, a conflict ensued.
This also explained why these Crystal Horn Fish seemed to recognize the Dragon Turtle.
So youre saying, Im in the wrong?
A low growl erupted from the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Roar! Lets not talk about the resources for a moment. You scared away the big Crystal Horn Fish that I was saving to eat. What about the small ones that you have eaten?
Faced with the righteous indignation of Thunderflame Beheamoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle beneath the small hill was somewhat bewildered.
It hadnt expected that those powerful and sizable Mutated Fish were actually the food that the then small (about ten meters) black Mutated Beast had been raising.
However, considering the terrifying combat power of this Dragon Beast, the story of it keeping Mutated Fish twice its size seemed plausible.
Roar! Sorry, Idid not knowthey wereyourfood.
With continuous exchanges, the speech of this Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was improving, and it expressed its apology to the Thunderflame Beheamoth with continuous low roars.
After all this, the killing intent in the Thunderflame Beheamoths heart also subsided somewhat.
It had no choice, it knew that it had been somewhat unreasonable just now.
But the rule in the world of Mutated Beasts is survival of the fittest, just like when it was a small ten-meter beast, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle passed by without even sparing it a glance.
The reason it was willing to talk this time was because, in the previous battle, the Thunderflame Beheamoth had demonstrated overwhelming strength.
So, regardless of the time, the strength is the only standard to measure status and attitude.
Just as the Thunderflame Beheamoth was thinking of letting the matter go since killing it would be too much trouble, and was preparing to leave, the Dragon Turtles low, hesitant growl came from the fissure.
Roar! Iwillcompensate you.
Thunderflame Beheamoth turned its head: Roar! What will you use to compensate me?
Roar! 1 know a place with good food. Iwilltake you there.
The Thunderflame Beheamoths eyes lit up instantly. It hadnt expected such a turn of events, and roared with delight: Roar! Alright, come out and lead the way.
Roar! If I come out, youcanthit me.
Roar! Dont worry, as long as you dont lie to me, I definitely wont hit you.
Then, we can consider the previous matter settled.
Roar! Really?
Roar! 1, Thunderflame, always keep my word. This is quite famous in the sea. If you dont believe me, go ask Joe 1 mean Joe.
Roar! Who is Joe?
Roar! A Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Roar! Whats a Single-horned Tiger Whale?
Roar! You talk too much! Are you coming out or not? If not, 111 start digging! It seemed that the deep-sea giant turtle had been scared by the Thunderflame Behemoths previous outburst. Despite its repeated assurances, the turtle still hesitated and kept asking questions.
Its incessant inquiries were starting to wear on the Thunderflame Behemoths patience.
Sensing that the Thunderflame Behemoth was getting annoyed, cracks started to form on the small hill on the seabed. Amidst crumbling stones, the Dragon Turtle that had been buried twenty meters underground emerged.
Luckily for it, the Thunderflame Behemoth really had no plans to attack.
Roar!! Lets go, lead the way, Im still not full.
Roar!! Mmm, Thunderflame, you, follow me.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded hastily, moving its sturdy limbs and heading towards the pitch-dark deep-sea direction. However, its speed was somewhat slow.
In the morning, when Jack Clark came downstairs for breakfast, Glenn Clark, who was eating an egg, looked startled. Bro, why are you bigger?
Bigger, what is bigger? Jack Clark was confused.
Glenn Clark scratched his head and tried to describe it. Its like Its a bit scary, like youve filled the entire room.
Youre talking about my aura.
Jack Clark casually replied, Its nothing, 1 made some progress in last nights cultivation, so you might feel some pressure and discomfort. Itll go away in a couple of days.
With the surge in his physical attribute and his cultivation entering the Fourth Layer Heaven, the initial Hidden God Method could no longer fully conceal his aura.
This situation would probably last for a day or two, until his intense Qi Blood calmed down.
Although he could continue to strengthen the Secret Skill with attributes, especially while holding more than a hundred and seventy Points Attribute, Jack did not choose to do so.
Oh, 1 see. Glenn Clark suddenly realized, then looked at Jack Clark with admiration.
But bro, you are so powerful. I hear that you are now the number one genius at the South Sky Martial Height, breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven even before Jane Aiken.
Jack Clark sat down, picked up a piece of fried egg, and casually asked, You heard from your classmates again?
As for school matters, Jack rarely mentioned them at home. No matter how powerful he became, his family remained the same.
Hehe! Teresa Lee told me. Glenn Clark chuckled.
Teresa Lee.
Jack Clark thought for a moment and suddenly asked, Isnt her brother Marcus Lee?
Glenn Clark was surprised, Eh! Bro, how did you know? I only found out a few days ago that her brother is Marcus Lee.
I heard Marcus mentioning that he has a sister before, I didnt expect it to be true. Jack Clarks expression was a bit weird.
He didnt expect that his younger brothers classmate was indeed Marcus Lees sister, and their relationship seemed to be good. What was this about?
Alright, eat up and hurry off to school.
Bro, arent you going to school today?
I plan to go outside the city and find a place to train. I wont go to school today. My strength is too strong now, and I cant fully unleash it at school.
Oh, 1 see. Glenn Clarks eyes revealed admiration.
Jack Clark had a lot to do that morning. After breakfast, he returned the empty refrigerated truck to the rental place, then took a cab to the outskirts.
Whoosh!
A figure flashed across the forest at an astonishing speed. In no time, Jack Clark covered more than ten kilometers and arrived at a valley in the deep mountains filled with scattered stones.
Upon reaching, Jack Clark leapt onto a five-meter-high boulder, held the heavy Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, and closed his eyes slightly. As he pictured the information about the Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill, he opened his eyes abruptly and a realm of thought emerged in his mind.
Consume 30 Points Attribute to strengthen the Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd.
Unlike the beginner Secret Skill, the Advanced Combat Skill of the Eight Desolations Refining Inferno required higher mastery. Even though Jack Clark could master it after a month of hard work, there was no need to waste that time.
However, the attribute page did not immediately perform the enhancement. Instead, a string of transparent text appeared in front of him.
Detecting that part of this battle technique overlaps with the Light King Knife. Do you choose to merge the two battle techniques? After merging, the Halberd Skill will become sharper.
Jack Clark hesitated slightly.
Merge!

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 146: Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, Tang Sanzang’s Reincarnation
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 146: Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, Tang Sanzang’s Reincarnation
Translator: 549690339
Along with Jack Clark’s determination, the martial intent imprint of Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd Inheritance in his Sea of Consciousness burst open in an instant, accompanied by vast and magnificent information.
At the same time, a sharp and heavy force was born out of thin air within his body, operating on a different path from the Advanced Dragon Elephant Skill.
Unlike the Light King Knife which only cultivates the upper half of the arms, as an Advanced Combat Skill, the running route opened by the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd almost covered Jack Clark’s entire body.
Part of it overlapped with the route of the Light King Knife, so when that power was in action, it continuously absorbed the sharp aura of the Light King Knife in the meridians.
This power grew stronger with every circulation.
At the same time, Jack Clark’s arms underwent subtle changes, becoming much thicker, and the palms rougher, like an expert who had been using heavy halberd weapons for a year.
Gradually, an overbearing and powerful aura diffused from Jack Clarks body. With the war halberd slanting in his hands and standing on top of the giant rock, he looked like an unparalleled fierce general.
“Not enough,” Jack suddenly opened his eyes, and the idea echoed in his mind.
“Continue to consume attribute points and strengthen the halberd technique to the small accomplishment stage.”
With the halberd technique at the beginner stage, he was proficient in mastering the moves of Eight Desolate Refining Hell. The small accomplishment stage represented a higher level of mastery, grasping the essence of halberd techniques.
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, the attribute points on the page instantly decreased by 80, and a mysterious comprehension burst forth from his heart.
At the same time, the True Power circulating in his body roared and vibrated, and under the mad circulation, it opened up two special running routes with great difficulty.
These two routes involved many tiny blood vessels and obscure meridians.
When these two special circulation routes were completely formed, Jack Clark’s Qi Blood surged in his chest, back, and arms, revealing faint red traces that looked like a picture of a divine demon.
Bang! The rock under Jack Clark’s feet shattered, and he soared up like a cannonball, reaching hundreds of meters into the air.
In his hands, the black and red halberd skill flickered and stretched for more than a meter. With the flashing black and red light, there was a terrifying feeling that the sky and earth were changing color in a split second.
Woo!
With a wailing and terrifying Ghost Wailing sound, Jack Clark unleashed a terrifying aura, surrounding him with a circle of black and red energy waves reaching more than ten meters, like a demon god descending from the heavens.
Bang!
The terrifying impact turned the huge rock, several hundred tons and more than ten meters high, into an explosion.
Countless fragments covered an area of 100 meters like cannonballs, making a crackling noise when they fell to the ground, accompanied by the horrendous sound of rolling smoke and dust.
At that moment, a black and red halberd light soared into the sky from amidst the smoke and dust, like a ten-meter-long heavy halberd sweeping the Eight Wastes and exploding as a black and red circle of light.
Bang, Bang, Bang, Bang!!
As the ring-shaped black and red light circles burst open three meters, all the falling debris in the passage was shattered, turned into powder by the sharp swirling halberd skill.
It was not until after rushing more than ten meters that the domineering ring of black and red True Power finally exploded, turning into a raging wind that blew away the surrounding smoke and dust, revealing Jack Clark’s figure.
At this moment, the black and red True Power circulated around him, and the heavy halberd in his hand slanted behind him, pointing towards the ground. His whole body emitted a terrifying aura that resembled both a divine and demonic presence.
Amid this terrifying aura, mixed with ferocity, ruthlessness, and the overbearing presence of the Dragon Elephant, it seemed extremely terrifying.
In front of him, the rock hill dozens of meters high had been leveled to the ground, and a series of half-meter wide, more than ten-meter long sharp cracks on the ground extended in all directions.
From a distance, it looked like a weeping ghost face had appeared on the ground, extremely terrifying.
Ghost Wailing Divine Howl! Sweeping the Eight Wastes!
These were the two powerful moves of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd that he had mastered after reaching the Small Achievement Realm. The former had terrifying power in single combat, while the latter was a sweeping group attack for bloody battles in the Eight Desolations.
When performing the Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, Jack Clark’s internal True Power had to first circulate through the special route of the Eight Desolate Halberd, similar to a special energy storage and property conversion.
Finally, when it converged on the War Halberd, the power of the True Strength would surge several times, and it was incredibly sharp.
Combined with Jack Clark’s terrifying physical strength and the explosive properties of Dragon Elephant Skill, the power was so strong that it could destroy a small four or five-story building with a single blow.
And this destruction would leave it completely shattered into pieces.
The Sweeping Eight Wastes move was similar, but it ran through another special route, transferring the True Power within Jack Clarks body into a ring-shaped sweeping force with razor-sharp whirls.
Jack Clark pondered, “My current fighting power should be in the middle to late stages of the Fifth Layer Heaven, right?”
When breaking through the Four Layer Heaven with the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, his physical strength was fully developed under the ‘Real’ attribute, and his fighting power reached at least the Initial Stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Now, after two days, his strength attributes had surged by 300 points, breaking through 1,000, with a basic arm strength of around 25 tons.
Combined with the small accomplishment of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, his strength was taken to the extreme, easily delivering unparalleled sharpness and fierceness with every blow.
Therefore, Jack Clark estimated his fighting power should be at the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven and above.
However, he couldn’t be 100% sure yet since he hadn’t fought against any Fifth Layer Heaven cultivators before and didn’t know how much stronger the True Power would become after breaking through the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Also, this comparison was with ordinary Fifth Layer Heaven cultivators and not those geniuses.
After all, while he cultivated Advanced Skills and Advanced Combat Techniques, the geniuses weren’t far behind. Especially the second and third-grade students, who had been cultivating for even longer.
On the Alien Beast Battlefield, their contribution points would be gained faster. They might have cultivated several secret skills, pushing a certain aspect to the limit.
Moreover, with the support of Transcendent weapons and even extraordinary battle armor, their fighting power would be higher than their realm..

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 146: Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, Tang Sanzang’s Reincarnation !
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 146: Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, Tang Sanzang’s Reincarnation !
Translator: 549690339
However, this refers to the geniuses, not all second and third-year cultivators being so strong.
After all, just like the freshmen of his class, most of them have average talents and are still struggling in the First Layer Heaven.
In deep thought, Jack Clark’s overbearing aura bursts forth, instantly turning into a black-red radiance that shoots out.
In his hands, the combat halberd’s black-red radiance surges, continuously slashing, stabbing, cleaving, and sweeping.
Each attack carries a terrifying power. The black-red radiance howls as it falls on the rocks, causing them to explode, shattering the ground beneath it and leaving ditches behind.
For a moment, the entire valley is filled with rumbling explosions, countless rocks shattering, trees collapsing, and the sky is full of splashing debris and smoke and dust.
After breaking through to the Fourth Layer Heaven and having his attributes skyrocket again, Jack Clark’s fighting strength can be said to have undergone explosive growth.
It isn’t until half an hour later, when the valley full of debris and fallen trees has slowly quieted down, that Jack Clark, holding his halberd, lets out a long breath.
The feeling of unleashing his power without restraint is exhilarating.
At this moment, Jack Clark calls up his attribute page with a thought.
Jack Clark’s gaze scans the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd that has reached minor completion and falls on the remaining 67 attribute points below.
After a slight hesitation, he gives up on the idea of spending 50 attribute points to strengthen the Hidden God Method, saving it for later to refine a transcendent weapon.
At the same time, he doesn’t spend attribute points to strengthen the solidity and sharpness of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd because he doesn’t need to.
When he goes to the Alien Beast Battlefield later and exchanges transcendent materials to refine transcendent weapons, the halberd will inherit the enchanting properties that the combat knife had been strengthened with before.
In this way, he can save 20 attribute points.
In the afternoon, the sun is shining brightly.
Deep under the sea, nearly a thousand meters down, a 37-meter-long Deep Sea Dragon Turtle crawls on the seabed, each step stirring up large amounts of mud and sand.
Next to it, a 25-meter-long Thunderflame Behemoth swims slowly.
Compared to the terrifying speed of the Thunderflame Behemoth, which travels three to four hundred kilometers in an hour, the Dragon Turtle is very slow, like an old man taking a leisurely stroll.
It’s been half a day, and they’ve only moved a little over two hundred kilometers.
And not only is it slow, but it also talks a lot, like a reincarnated Tang Monk who keeps lowly howling and growling incessantly.
Roar! Thunderflame, why don’t you say Thunderwater instead?
Roar!! By the way, what’s the meaning of Thunderflame?
Roar! Why are you so much more powerful than me despite both of us being dragon beasts?
Roar!! I’m obviously much bigger than you.
Finally, the Thunderflame Behemoth can’t take it anymore and growls angrily: Roar!! Can you stop your bullshit and just lead the way?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle turns to look at him with curiosity in its eyes: Roar!! What does ‘bullshit’ mean?
To the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which has no concept of human language, some special words with hidden meanings often heard from the Thunderflame Behemoth’s mouth are very intriguing.
Ah…Immediately, the Thunderflame Behemoth feels like an old blood surging to his throat, his claws trembling, forcibly suppressing the urge to hit the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle hard and growls angrily.
Roar!! Bullshit means I want you to stop your nagging, and also, can’t you go faster… No, start swimming!
Roar!! You’re at the bottom of the sea, not on land. What’s so fun about crawling slowly?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle looks a little wronged. Wasn’t it just asking what ‘bullshit’ and ‘nagging’ meant?
Then the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle growls low: Roar!! Can’t swim, scared!
Faced with this answer, the Thunderflame Behemoth is almost speechless and would roll his eyes if he could, though his eyes don’t work like humans’, and he can’t actually roll his eyes.
Previously on their way, the Thunderflame Behemoth had asked this question, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s answer was that it didn’t feel safe when its limbs were not on the seabed.
Only when its limbs are on the ground and it crawls slowly does it feel secure and not afraid of being attacked by other mutated creatures.
So, no matter what it does, it must ensure that its limbs are on the ground so that its defensive talent can be maximized.This was not just caution, but an extreme fear of death. No wonder it was beaten up earlier and directly buried itself in the mountain.
At this moment, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes showed curiosity: Roar!! Thunderflame, land, what is that?
Roar! Unable to stand it anymore, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared and slapped the huge turtle shell directly with one palm.
With a casual swipe, the Thunderflame Behemoth caused the sea water to explode, accompanied by a circle of white shockwaves. The Dragon Turtle’s body sank heavily, its limbs sinking several meters into the ground.
Roar! Shut up, and don’t make a sound until we get to that place.
Having been nagged for so long, the Thunderflame Behemoth finally snapped, its golden vertical pupils filled with murderousness.
Flames across its entire body suddenly ignited and soared, emanating intense heat.
Woo roar!! I won’t say anything! I won’t say anything!
Feeling the murderousness emanating from the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was scared as its neck shrank and it didn’t dare to speak again.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Behemoth felt the surroundings quiet down, with only pitch-black seawater and deadly silence around it, leaving only the fluctuation of water brought about by their swimming.
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Behemoth exhaled a hot breath, and with one thought, it retracted the leaping flames on its body.
Maintaining the flames on its body was like walking naked in a snowy field. The surrounding seawater would continue to boil and consume its energy.
If it were on land, with the flames fully unleashed, ordinary creatures couldn’t even approach it.
By now, they had arrived at over two thousand meters deep in the sea. From time to time, the Thunderflame Behemoth would feel large shadows flashing past in the distance and encounter some strange creatures.
These creatures that inhabited the pitch-black, silent depths of the sea since birth were all bizarre and hideous in appearance, scaring anyone who saw them.
Only a few of them appeared somewhat normal.
For example, a Mutated Fish over four meters long with a transparent body and a faintly glowing head slowly swam past several hundred meters away.
However, before it swam too far, a huge shadow flashed and swallowed the Luminous Fish, instantly plunging the surroundings back into absolute darkness.
It mutated to emit light in such a dark environment. Wasn’t that asking for death? The Thunder flame Behemoth slightly shook its head, its tail wavering as it continued to swim forward.
However, at this moment, the deep-sea giant turtle let out a faint low growl: Roar!! Thunderflame, just now, there seemed to be, a very strong, mutated creature that passed by.
Along the way, the nagging wasn’t without gain, as its expression became more fluent and coherent.
Roar! There was one, but it wasn’t very strong, and I couldn’t be bothered. The Thunderflame Behemoth casually replied.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes showed admiration: Roar! Worthy of you, I was, startled just now.
That was just an ordinary Level 5 Mutated Creature. You’re a Level 7, and a Dragon-type Giant Beast. You were startled? What are you afraid of?
Of course, these words were only thought by the Thunderflame Behemoth and not spoken aloud.
Because it was afraid that once it spoke, this hard-to-silence fellow would start asking questions again.
Unfortunately, the Thunderflame Behemoth still underestimated the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s ability to chatter. It curiously asked: Roar!! Thunderflame, why are you, silent?
The Thunderflame Behemoth’s double claws clenched instantly, and the strength gathered in its body, its eyes full of murderousness.
This guy simply wouldn’t stop talking. Couldn’t it be quiet for a while?
Just as the Thunderflame Behemoth was about to strike again, its eyes suddenly focused, as it felt that the Heavenly Energy in its surroundings had become much richer.
Moreover, as they continued to approach, the concentration of Heavenly Energy was almost doubling.
Soon, a bright, glowing world appeared before its eyes.
At the bottom of the sea, nearly three thousand meters deep, in a mountain valley filled with colorful corals emitting faint lights, the pitch-black seabed was adorned as if it were the Crystal Dragon Palace.
This valley stretched for several kilometers and was over one kilometer wide at its widest point; it was filled with large coral clusters up to tens of meters high and small clusters of coral.
Within it, countless palm-sized silver small fishes swam among the coral reefs, their bodies shimmering with silver light, starkly contrasting with the pitch-black silence around them, as if they were in a different world.
Even the Thunderflame Behemoth was stunned by such a magnificent sight.
It had never expected to find a place like this deep beneath the sea..

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 147: Swallowing and Shattering, the Power Limit Increases
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 147: Swallowing and Shattering, the Power Limit Increases
Translator: 549690339
As the Thunderflame Behemoth was surprisedly looking down, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles expression became serious, and it let out a low growl: Theres a very fierce one here!
At this moment, they were at the foot of the mountain, in a pitch black area, several kilometers away from the valley below.
The Thunderflame Behemoth spoke in a low voice: I saw that guy you mentioned, but thats not important. Whats important is the good stuff you mentioned. Where is it?
At the end of the Coral Valley below, a giant beast with a body length of fifty-seven meters lay quietly, emanating a terrifying aura.
This giant beast resembled a blue whale, but its front half was more round and heavy. Its open mouth was filled with sharp teeth, slurping massive amounts of seawater like a black hole.
In addition, it was covered in thick, sharp gray spikes, standing quietly at a height of more than twenty meters, like a small hill.
A mutated creature this big would naturally be very strong.
Even though they were several kilometers away, they could still feel the invisible energy fluctuations emanating from its body, which made the Thunderflame Behemoth take it a bit more seriously.
It was clear that this behemoth, presumably in the late stage of Level 7, was very powerful, at least an elite monster.
And it constantly released its aura as a warning, telling other observing mutated creatures not to provoke it.
At this time, the deep-sea giant turtle let out a low growl: Those fish, good stuff, eat them, very powerful.
1 see. The Thunderflame Behemoths gaze fell on the silver small fishes swimming through the coral reefs, feeding on the microscopic organisms living on the coral.
It turned out that these were the resources.
Suddenly, the huge Gray Behemoth down there opened its mouth slightly, and a tremendous suction force instantly swallowed several larger silverfish swimming in front of it.
Due to the difference in size, it felt almost like drinking a mouthful of water.
Immediately, the surrounding silverfish scattered and swam to the coral reefs further away.
At this time, the Thunderflame Behemoth growled: What is this guys ability?
Knowing oneself and the enemy is the key to victory.
Although it considered itself to be strong in battle, the Thunder flame Behemoth was cautious when facing a Level 7 late-stage behemoth with a body length more than twice as long as its own and a body width over ten times greater.
I dont know. I passed by earlier and left as soon as 1 saw it.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtles reply left the Thunderflame Behemoth momentarily at a loss for words.
Just passing by? Clearly, you discovered something good but were scared off by that giant beast. Moreover, you did not even dare to test it out in a fight. And to think you are a dragon-type giant beast.
As mutated creatures with the awakened characteristics of dragons, each of them was strong in battle. A Level 7 early-stage creature could even fight against a Level 7 late-stage one.
Youll charge down with your defensive talent and see what its ability is, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared in a low voice.
Instantly, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle pulled in its neck: Im afraid!
Fear my ass! Just charge! Your defense is so strong, and Ill help too. If we win, Ill share some of the small fish with you.
Really?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtles head shot out, its eyes filled with surprise. It didnt expect the Thunderflame Behemoth to be willing to share some with it.
My word is as good as gold in this sea area. Ive cooperated with many mutated creatures before; otherwise, how could I have grown so quickly?
Whether it was the temptation of the silverfish or the trust in the Thunderflame Behemoths words, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle took a deep breath, and an overwhelming, heavy aura erupted from its body in an instant. Boom! A burst of yellow energy burst out, enveloping its entire body, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles aura connected with the earth beneath it as it walked heavily towards the bottom.
With each step the Dragon Turtle took, the seabed trembled as if it was carrying a heavy mountain on its back.
In the valley below, the huge Gray Behemoth suddenly raised its head, and a substantial aura erupted from its body, creating rings of white sea waves.
At the same time, the giant beast opened its mouth and let out a vibrating roar.
Roar! Solid sound waves rolled up surging waves, and with a bang, they rushed out a hundred meters. The sound was terrifying.
Boom! The seabed shook, and the Gray Behemoths massive tail flicked. Its huge body swept up a violent current and charged toward the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had just reached the foot of the mountain.
As a Dragon Variant Beast, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle still had some fighting spirit.
Seeing the Gray Behemoth lunging toward it with its enormous mouth wide open like it could swallow the Dragon Turtle whole, the latter roared back without showing any weakness then withdrew its head.
Boom!
The huge mouth, almost the size of the Gray Behemoths head, clamped down fiercely onto the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, swallowing nearly half of its body, and a massive impact erupted in an instant.
Boom, boom, boom!
The surrounding hundred meters of the seabed shook with a thundering crash, as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle at the center caused massive cracks filled with broken rocks and seawater to explode outward.
The thick yellow light on the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles body vibrated wildly, but it was not bitten through by the Gray Behemoth. Connected to the earths aura, the Turtle was immovable like it had taken root.
Just when the Gray Behemoth exerted force, its sharp fangs slowly pierced through the yellow energy.
Several of the longest fangs even touched the thick shell of the Dragon Turtle, making a shrill, grating noise.bender
But at that point, it couldnt go any further; The Deep Sea Dragon Turtles defense was just too horrifying.
Amidst the darkness, just when the aura-concealing Thunderflame Behemoth thought the giant beast would loosen its bite and then unleash a more potent attack with its talent, the Gray Behemoths body suddenly flowed with a gray light.
Squish, squish!
In the blink of an eye, the spikes on the Gray Behemoths body grew rapidly, transforming into spear-like spikes over ten meters long, shooting out like an exploding hedgehog..

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 147: Swallowing and Shattering, the Power Limit Increases_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 147: Swallowing and Shattering, the Power Limit Increases_2
Translator: 549690339
This time, the explosion was all-encompassing, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which was bitten by the giant mouth, was bombarded by metal cone spears, causing its body to tremble under the terrifying impact force.
In the end, with a bang, the Dragon Turtle was knocked into the ground by more than ten metal cone spears that grew from the head and chin of the Gray Behemoth, leaving only a bit of its turtle shell exposed above the ground.
Roar! With a furious roar, the Gray Behemoth that had just knocked down the invading Mutated Creature stirred up massive waves as the raging sound waves mixed with the sea water.
In the midst of the roar, the Gray Behemoths mouth suddenly emitted a terrifying devouring suction, capable of swallowing everything, with a power no less than that of the Single-horned Tiger Whales Devouring Vortex.
Immediately, the ground around the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle cracked and shattered within a range of hundreds of meters, and countless rocks were washed towards the mouth of the Giant Beast by the sea water.
In the abyss-like mouth of the monster, the sharp teeth quickly grew into a terrifying shredder, grinding everything that was sucked in, sending chills down ones spine.
However, no matter how much it swallowed, the yellow light on the Deep Sea Giant Turtles body flowed, and its limbs remained motionless under the turtle shell, as if slowly melting into the earth.
Okay, so this guy just took a hit and got scared.
In the dark, the hidden Thunderflame Behemoths body crouched down, and its thick muscular limbs bulged slowly while faint blue arcs danced on their surface.
Boom! With a surge of heat, the Thunderflame Behemoth burst into flames, and the seabed within a range of tens of meters below it collapsed and exploded.
In an instant, the Thunderflame Behemoth, which had activated its swift ability, turned into a dazzling flame that pierced through hundreds of meters before crashing into the sea urchin-like Giant Beast with a bang.
Boom! The terrifying red shockwave mixed with the roaring sea water and rushed out hundreds of meters.
Under the horrifying impact, the Gray Behemoth let out an astonished and angry roar, its massive body directly blown away by the Thunderflame Behemoth.
More than ten metal cone stingers on its side were shattered, and half of its body collapsed, revealing the gray flesh beneath the cracked heavy gray scale armor.
There was no blood!
Looking at the distant Gray Behemoth that had rolled more than ten times before stopping, the Thunderflame Behemoth standing next to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had cold eyes.
Had this Mutated Creatures flesh and blood undergone qualitative changes after reaching Level 7 due to its talent?
As the burning Thunderflame Behemoth stood next to it, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles head emerged, letting out an excited low growl.
Roar roar! Thunderflame, beat it!
Roar! Stay out of this.
Alright. Hearing the roar of the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, who had just been beaten up, stretched out its limbs and scurried away, not appearing as sluggish as before.
Meanwhile, the Gray Behemoth, which had been blown away by a hundred meters from the impact, saw the gray liquid energy flox-vang between the shattered scales, and its wounds healed visibly fast.
Roar!
The Gray Behemoth, which had been blown away and injured by a single blow, let out a roar of anger. With a flick of its tail, the water behind it exploded, and it charged at the Thunderflame Behemoth with a menacing aura.
Bam! The seabed shattered, and the figure of the Thunderflame Behemoth disappeared instantly from its original position.
The Gray Behemoth, covered in metal cone stingers, was astonishingly fast, like a high-speed train traveling at 300 kilometers per hour, causing violent underwater currents as it chomped down.
Whoosh! In an instant, the rocks within a range of tens of meters disappeared, devoured in one bite by the beast, which then slammed its massive body into the mountain wall at a downward angle with a bang.
Bam! Under the terrifying impact, the mountain wall collapsed within a range of hundreds of meters, and countless fragments flew out like cannonball projectiles, tumbling far away in the muddy sand.
Witnessing such a horrible attack, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had already fled far away, could not help but shrink its neck.
Fortunately, the Giant Beast in front of it did not use this move to attack it, otherwise it would have been knocked deep into the ground.
Not far away, the unaffected Thunderflame Behemoth watched as the Gray Behemoth emerged from the murky sea water, exuding an awe-inspiring aura.
In the golden vertical pupils of the Thunderflame Behemoth, there was a faint flicker of flame and lightning.
Roar!
In the ferocious roar, the Thunderflame Behemoths aura surged, and the endless flames evaporated and boiled the surrounding sea water, stirring up vortexes of white gas that rushed towards the sky.
Roar! The Gray Behemoth on the other side also let out a violent roar, its aura bursting forth, refusing to show weakness.
Boom! The two Giant Beasts collided, their massive bodies bursting through the water and rushing towards each other with overwhelming power, like red and gray underwater meteors.bender
Boom!
Just as they were about to approach each other within tens of meters, the Gray Behemoths huge mouth opened in anger, unleashing an endless sucking force in an attempt to swallow the Thunderflame Behemoth and grind it apart in its mouth.
Under the terrible devouring force, the sea water flowed into a vortex towards its mouth, and after being torn apart by the spinning metal teeth, it was sprayed out from both sides of its gills.
At this moment, a flash of fire flickered on the Gray Behemoths head it was the Thunderflame Behemoth that had evaded its devouring attack.
The over twenty-meter-long Thunderflame Behemoth fell from above, and after tearing apart several of the thick metal cone stingers, it landed on the Gray Behemoth, as the blue radiance beneath its dorsal fin intensified.
Rumble!
With the Thunderflame Behemoth at the center, countless arcs of thunder exploded, and as the arm-thick lightning network rapidly expanded, the sea water within a range of hundreds of meters boiled.
In this area, countless blue arcs flickered, penetrating and scorching everything in their path.
The Gray Behemoth beneath the Thunderflame Behemoth was even worse off, as the endless Thunderbolt Power flowed through the metal cone stingers and covered its entire body, making it look like a rice dumpling wrapped in lightning..

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 147 Swallowing and Crushing, Increasing the Upper Limit of Strength s
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 147 Swallowing and Crushing, Increasing the Upper Limit of Strength s
Translator: 549690339
Especially when most of its body had metalized, it convulsed continuously in an instant, and its eyes turned white.
At the same time, the endless scorching energy of the Thunderflame Behemoth gathered, and a dazzling radiant glow flashed from its ferocious mouth, spewing out a scorching breath.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
The scorching pillar of fire landed on the Gray Behemoths head, creating a rumbling vibration. The blast from the bursting flames evaporated the surrounding sea water, blowing it away and forming exploding rings of red and white light halos.
The high temperature of 5000 degrees Celsius was enough to melt even diamonds, let alone metal. Even if this Giant Beasts body was now metalized, it couldnt withstand it, and its surface-level defense energy was instantly breached.
Under this breath, the thick skin of the Giant Beast gradually began to melt and was punctured. The metallic flesh and blood mixed with energy continued to dissolve.
Roar!! Under intense pain, the Gray Behemoth, paralyzed by the electric shock, let out a painful roar. free(w)ebnovel
With the intense stimulation of death, the endless power within its body burst out, and more sharp spikes grew all over its body. The larger ones stretched out more than a dozen meters, and while the smaller ones were several meters long, they were still sharp and deadly.
The Thunderflame Behemoth too was hit by countless metal spikes, but knowing that this moment was critical, it did not evade, or rather, it couldnt be bothered to do so. Its four claws clung tightly to the Gray Behemoths armor.
Boom Boom Boom!!
One by one, the sharp metal spikes struck the Thunderflame Behemoth, making a heavy impact and creating shockwaves, but they could not push it away.
Those spikes, capable of penetrating metal armor, struck its black and red scaled armor, only leaving some white traces, and the strongest two only managed to shatter a layer of the scale armor on its abdomen.
Such terrifying defense made the Gray Behemoth surrender in utter despair.
At this time, the breath from the mouth of the Thunderflame Behemoth had pierced through its flesh and was beginning to melt its skull under the formidable impact.
In extreme pain, the Gray Behemoths huge body began to struggle frantically, its tail waving and rolling. For a moment, the seabed vibrated and the water currents roared.
Suddenly, the struggling body of the Giant Beast stiffened, and its tail slammed into the seabed with a boom, no longer able to move.
At the same time, the breath of the Thunderflame Behemoth, standing on it, dimmed, and only a little spark jumped around its body. Between its dorsal fins, a faint arc of electricity occasionally flickered.
Roar Roar!! Thunderflame, youre amazing.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle trotted over, looking at the Thunderflame Behemoth excitedly.
Roar Roar!! Dont worry, I promised to share some with you, and I wont lie to you.
After saying that, the Thunderflame Behemoth got off the Gray Behemoth, caught its sturdy tail with its left claw and swam down to the coral valley.
The battle is over, now its time for the harvest. I wonder what benefits those silver small fish will bring.
Dragging the corpse of the Gray Behemoth to Crystal Valley, all the small fish around immediately scattered, being startled by the invisible Dragon Might emanating from the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Whoosh!
With a swing of its huge right claw, the Thunderflame Behemoth caught a silverfish slightly bigger than a palm effortlessly. It felt like holding dust.
