For the current Thunderflame Behemoth, palm-sized silverfish were too tiny. Even if they were stuffed in its mouth, it couldnt feel them, so it swallowed them whole with seawater.
Hmm! Just as that fish entered its stomach and was being digested, the Thunderflame Behemoth showed a surprised look.
In its perception, the energy in its body increased by a little. bender
This increase was not only in terms of the total amount but also the limit.
To put it simply, the energy contained in the flesh and blood of the newly evolved Thunderflame Behemoth was about 1000 units, which could maintain two minutes of scorching breath and one thunderstorm.
But after eating that silverfish, the energy in its flesh and blood became 1001, both the limit and the total amount increased by one unit.
Of course, these 1000 units are only an analogy, because the Thunderflame Behemoth is also unable to measure how much energy is contained in its flesh and blood.
Especially in the cells within the dark blue dorsal fins on its back, which have the ability to convert bioenergy into storage of electricity and release it.
Although increasing by one-thousandth didnt seem to make much difference overall, but
The eyes of the Thunderflame Behemoth passed over the silverfish scattered throughout the valley, numbering in the thousands. Its mouth corners turned up slightly, revealing a sinister smile..

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 148: Guardian Dragon Beast, Mythical Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 148: Guardian Dragon Beast, Mythical Domain
Translator: 549690339
Just as the Thunderflame Behemoth looked at the silverfish excitedly, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle followed and crawled down.
Looking at it, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared: Roar! I count forty percent of these fish as mine, and you take ten percent.
As it spoke to clarify the difference between four and one, the Thunder flame Behemoth stretched out its double claws, one hand showing four fingers and the other a middle finger.
Roar! Mmm, Thunderflame, you eat more, I eat one, thats fine. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded excitedly, not thinking for a moment that it had taken too little.
In its mind, it was fine if the ferocious Thunderflame ate it all, and since it couldnt beat it and didnt dare say anything, it was already very good that it was talking and giving it a share.
Roar! Dont eat the little ones; save them for breeding. The Thunderflame Behemoth reminded.
Roar! I know, I know, if 1 eat them all, there will be nothing left.
As it spoke, the Deep Sea Giant Turtle excitedly rushed up, its huge mouth slightly opening in front of a coral over ten meters high, and in an instant, a strong suction force emerged.
Under this suction force, the surrounding water rolled and swirled, engulfing more than a dozen silver small fish into its mouth.
As a Deep Sea Giant Beast, even without the talent to control water, when evolved to the level of Thunderflame Behemoth and Dragon Turtle, it could influence the surrounding sea water with its own will and strength. bender
Of course, this ability to control ordinary water currents was not very helpful in battle, so it was only useful for things like brushing teeth.
As the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle began eating, the Thunderflame Behemoth also swam over, its ferocious mouth opening wide with each bite, sending out a huge suction force that devoured the silverfish in between the corals.
As the silverfish, rich in energy, were swallowed one by one, the once-exhausted energy within the Thunderflame Behemoth surged wildly.
The originally extinguished flames on its body began to burn again, dazzling arcs of electricity leaping between its dorsal fins from head to tail, and its aura grew increasingly terrifying.
It seemed that these silverfish were symbionts of these Luminous Corals.
Even with the two Giant Beasts sweeping and devouring them, the silverfish only hid in the crevices of the corals and did not have the intention to swim out of the valley.
Soon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, who had eaten almost all the silverfish in a corner of the valley, stopped. The originally one-meter-thick yellow energy in its body skyrocketed.
On the other side, the Thunderflame Behemoth continued to wreak havoc, but when it had devoured nearly three thousand silverfish, and its internal energy had surged twice, there was a faint look of regret in its eyes.
It had reached its limit.
Just like the Blue Pearl it had eaten earlier, there was an absorption limit for these resources, or rather a limit to the resources own improvement.
Previously, when it had consumed 1,500 silverfish, the effect was gradually weakening and had now diminished to one-tenth of the original effect with each silverfish it consumed.
However, the slowed limit increase remained, and the energy replenishment aspect was still effective.
No wonder the Gray Behemoth didnt eat all of these silverfish; it must have reached its improvement limit long ago.
As for why it guarded this place, of course, it was for long-term consumption. If it slowly accumulated, the total energy for it would still slowly increase, and it could also replenish energy in the process.
Therefore, even though the effect had slowed down, the Thunderflame Behemoth still continued to devour the silverfish.
Not until it had swept from one end of the valley to the other, and had eaten more than four thousand adult silverfish, did it stop.
At this point, its internal energy had increased 2.2 times, and the blazing hot flames on its body burned fiercely, boiling the sea water within tens of meters around it.
After eating the silver small fish, the Thunderflame Behemoths gaze finally turned to the corpse of the Gray Behemoth.
The silverfish could only enhance its extraordinary energy, not allow its physical body to grow. Although this extraordinary energy could also be converted into biological energy, it was not cost-effective.
Squeak!
Under the terrifying biting force and sharp teeth of the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Gray Behemoths scale armor was shattered, and thousands of kilograms of flesh and blood were torn off.
The metallic-textured flesh made a squeaking metallic sound when torn, and there wasnt even much blood.
This made the Thunderflame Behemoth feel that it wasnt eating meat but chewing on a metallic mountain.
Each time its sharp teeth chewed, a teeth-gritting squeaking sound was made, and finally, the Thunderflame Behemoth simply swallowed it after only chewing twice.
As this flesh and blood entered its stomach, a warm energy spread out, and the abundant life energy invigorated the Thunderflame Behemoths spirit.
Although it had a metallic texture, it was still digestible, and the life energy it contained was very vigorous; one bite was nearly equivalent to a Level 3 Mutant Beast.
Once it finished eating the Gray Behemoth, its size might even burst several meters.
Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Behemoth excitedly opened its mouth wide, and with another fierce bite, tore off thousands of kilograms of flesh and blood, chewing it up with gusto, eating more and more energetically.
While the Thunderflame Behemoth clung to the Gray Behemoths corpse, eating and tearing it apart, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle in the distance watched with bulging eyes.
This Thunderflame guy was too vicious, being able to chew through such a tough creature and still swallow it; didnt it worry about getting a stomachache later from indigestion?
Under the astonished gaze of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Thunderflame Behemoth continued to eat. Gradually, less and less flesh remained on the Gray Behemoth, revealing a massive metal-like skeleton.
From last nights evolution until now, the Thunderflame Behemoth had hardly eaten anything and was already starving. fre(e)
Moreover, it should be due to the secondary evolution that its ability to digest and convert food had become even more terrifying. With an ample food supply, its body started growing at a terrifying speed.
Its black-red scale armor became even thicker, constantly growing larger, and its body became more robust and fierce, its length increasing by more than ten centimeters in just a short while.
Half a day later, when only a nearly sixty-meter-long, completely metalized skeleton remained in the valley, its feast was finally over..

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 148: Guardian Dragon Beast, Mythical Domain_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 148: Guardian Dragon Beast, Mythical Domain_2
Translator: 549690339
There was also the ferocious behemoth that had grown to 28 meters.
This gray behemoth that had been devouring silver small fish for a long time contained astonishing energy within its body, including its flesh and blood, allowing the Thunderflame Beheamoth to experience astonishing growth.
This gray behemoth was similar to the Crystal Horn Fish that they had encountered before.
However, its strength was a hundred times greater, not only allowing the Thunderflame Behemoth to grow three meters in a single breath but also providing more than three hundred evolution points.
Plus, with the extraordinary energy in its body multiplying more than twice, it could be said that today was a big win.
At this moment, the massive body of the Thunderflame Behemoth suddenly moved, approaching a deliberately preserved coral cluster in the corner.
Immediately, its giant claw stretched out, and the energy swirled, forming a current trapping the dozens of adult silverfish hidden inside the coral before carefully stuffing them into the snake skin bag under its neck.
Jack Clark planned to bring them back for himself to try.
If the Thunderflame Behemoth ate these fish, their total limit of extraordinary energy would increase, and if he tried them, their cultivation might grow rapidly.
Se??ch ?ew?o?e? / o?g o? ?oo?l?
As for the snakeskin bag under the neck, it was no wonder that it was made from the skin of a Level 6 Mutant Sea Python. Even when subjected to the flame roasting on the surface of Thunderflame Behemoth’s body, it had not been burnt.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth glanced at the remaining silverfish fry and then looked at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle lying in the distance, dozing off, and suddenly let out a low growl.
Grrr!! You stay here and guard this place from now on. I will give you half of the small fishes that grow.
Half.
The eyes of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle lit up.
Grrr!! Really, Thunderflame?
Grrr!! Yes, starting from now on, this is your territory. Remember to emit your aura to deter your surroundings, and if there is a Mutated Beast trying to take it, retreat first, then find me.
The Thunderflame Behemoth didn’t say that if a Mutated Beast tried to take the territory, it would attack them.
This timid guy would shrink back if faced with a stronger Mutated Beast of the same level, and if the opponent dared to come after sensing the Level 7 dragon aura, their strength would undoubtedly not be weak.
Leaving this place unattended would be a waste. These silver small fishes, which lived in symbiosis with Luminous Coral, should grow very fast and were regenerative resources.
Although eating one of them would only provide a small increase in growth, if they ate batches of them and consumed tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands, their energy limit could increase several times more.
Grrr!! Yes, yes, I will watch over this place.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded excitedly. Dodging an attack and running away was its specialty.
Moreover, watching these silverfish here, it could occasionally enjoy a bite. It didn’t care where it was, as it usually wandered around the sea.
Compared to the pitch-black and silent deep sea, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle preferred the bright and shiny area of the coral.
It had always wanted to take over this place as soon as it laid its eyes on it but was too afraid of the violent creature that lived there.
With a happy mood, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out a low growl.
Grrr!! Thunderflame, how do you eat so fast?
Grrr!! What’s under your head? It’s so strange; it can hold fish.
Grrr!! Thunder…
Grr! Shut up, goodbye.
Seeing that this chatterbox was about to start talking again, the Thunderflame Behemoth let out a low growl. Its massive body burst through the sea with a boom, shooting out.
In the blink of an eye, it disappeared into the dark sea.
It is now past four in the afternoon.
Jack Clark, who was sitting cross-legged in the backyard corridor with his aura restrained, slowly opened his eyes, feeling the slightly increased strength in his body, a faint smile appearing on his face.
After devouring the Level 7 Colossus, not only did his Avatar undergo significant growth, but his four major attributes also increased by 32 points, making the improvement even more exaggerated.
In a good mood, Jack Clark reached out and picked up the insulated cup placed on the side, taking a sip of water.
Feeling the faint sweetness and bitterness of the tea on his lips, Jack Clark subconsciously compared the taste to that of ‘metal’ meat he had eaten before.
Then he realized that maybe high-order Mutated Beast Meat tasted good raw as well.
What am 1 thinking? Jack Clark shook his head, throwing this strange thought to the back of his mind.
Sitting cross-legged in the corridor, looking at the skyscrapers in the distance, Jack Clark suddenly had a strong sense of disconnection.
He felt that the ferocious and fierce Mutated Beasts and the terrifying creatures in the deep sea were completely different from the worldly picture before him, full of civilization and prosperity.
Yet, they truly existed.
Not to mention the students studying the True Martial, but martial arts halls had also recently started live streaming performances and teaching some basic training methods to gain name recognition.
Furthermore, the entertainment industry of this world was also connected to cultivation.
For example, some science fiction and Mutated Beast movies didn’t require special effects or backgrounds. Instead, they directly captured Level 3 Mutated Beasts as props.
Apart from that, it’s said all instructors on those movie sets were martial arts experts.
Nowadays, many popular stars had common talents, and only after high school, they had reached the First and Second Layer Heaven of regular cultivators.
These students with average talents could not graduate from Martial Arts High in three years, so they usually transferred to the humanities in their senior year and then applied to universities with humanities majors, graduating and becoming stars.
Martial High didn’t have universities after graduation.
As a result, the martial arts on TV were real martial arts, enhanced by the use of props, making the performance extremely realistic and satisfying for ordinary viewers.
Even Jack Clark’s mother had recently become interested in watching these science fiction and fantasy movies because of his cultivation.
As Jack Clark thought about the contrasting aspects more and more, he suddenly frowned.
Having swum tens of kilometers out of the Deep Sea Valley beneath hundreds of meters of sea water, the Thunderflame Behemoth came to a halt and looked down at its neck, extending its huge claw to touch the snakeskin bag below.
With the seawater churning, the corpse of a dead silverfish floated out of the mouth of the snakeskin bag.
Not only was it dead, but the silverfish corpse was also decomposing at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just a short while, its body was like a liquid that melted into the surrounding seawater..

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 148: Guardian Dragon Beast, Mythical Domain_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 148: Guardian Dragon Beast, Mythical Domain_3
Translator: 549690339
“So, it turns out that they’re symbiotic. No wonder these fish don’t leave the canyon even when they’re eaten,” lamented the Thunderflame Behemoth.
“What a pity.” Sitting cross-legged in the corridor, Jack Clark also showed a look of regret. Indeed, in this world, nothing is ever perfect.
With this in mind, Jack slowly closed his eyes and once again submerged himself in his cultivation practice.
Whoosh, whoosh!!
As his powerful Dragon Elephant True Strength circulated, a strong suction force emanated from Jack, pulling in the Heavenly Energy within a range of tens of meters around him.
While his True Strength swallowed the Heavenly Energy, Jack’s consciousness immersed itself in the Sea of Consciousness, sensing the ‘dragon elephant’ aura invisibly emanating from the Dragon Elephant Phantom, refining his willpower.
After reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven, cultivators must not only continue refining their True Strength, but also comprehend the true essence of ‘True Martial’ and refine their Power of Will.
Only when True Strength is condensed to the extreme in the Fourth Layer Heaven and the Power of Will transforms from abstract to concrete, merge with True Strength, can one make a breakthrough to the Fifth Layer Heaven.
The so-called Power of Will, like the mental power that Jack had previously cultivated in the Heart’s Eye Realm, is a special power deriving its inspiration from Giant Beasts.
Se??ch ?ew?o?e? / o?g o? ?oo?l?
When a living creature evolves into a King-level Beast, a domain extending over thousands of meters will form around it.
For example, a Giant Beast capable of controlling fire will create a world of flames around it, incinerating everything and turning the land into magma. Ordinary missiles would explode before they even get close to it.
Around a Giant Beast capable of controlling frost, an ice zone will form, freezing everything in its vicinity. This is the true terror of Mythical Giant Beasts.
When the pioneers first observed this phenomenon of power surrounding the Giant Beasts and affecting the world, they created Advanced Skills that contained willpower cultivation.
When a cultivator breaks through the Seventh Tier, their willpower, merging with their True Martial, will form the true martial arts phantom, allowing them to wield the Power of Heaven and Earth and experience a dramatic increase in their combat prowess.
When a cultivator reaches the Ninth Heavens, they will even condense a Law Domain similar to that of Mythical Giant Beasts, gradually undergoing deification and gaining the ability to traverse the skies and the earth.
Of course, all of these were still a long way off for Jack, who had only recently broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven and had just begun practicing the power of will.
But perhaps it was because of his previous experience cultivating the Inner Eye and condensing runes, Jack was making rapid progress in sensing the Dragon Elephant Phantom during his practice.
As Jack immersed himself in his practice, his mobile phone, which was placed beside him, suddenly vibrated. Someone had mentioned him in a group chat.
Slowly opening his eyes, Jack turned to look at his phone.
3-9 Group.
Justin Welan: “Hahahaha… Jack, I finally made it out alive. Congratulate the great Grandpa Walton on surviving the battlefield.”
Jack replied: “Mr. Willard, how did you end up on the battlefield?”
Although it’s called the Alien Beast Battlefield, Martial Height Cultivators are actually quite far from the actual battlefield. That area is under the jurisdiction of the military’s stationed forces.
“Haha, of course.”
Justin Welan proudly said, “This time, 1 fought valiantly in the great battle against the Alien Beasts, conquering all before me. If 1 can consolidate my cultivation soon, 1 might be able to make a breakthrough to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven!”
It had been more than three months since Justin had broken through to the Third Layer Heaven. He had managed to advance to the mid-stage just before setting off for the Alien Beast Battlefield at the beginning of the year.
Despite his unassuming appearance, Justin was a genius who managed to complete his first physical quality transformation around the same time as Howard Lee. He possesses an especially strong defense.
Of course, his rapid progress had a lot to do with the high-level resources his brother provided.
Jack responded: “So you haven’t made a breakthrough to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven yet?”
“…I feel like it’s coming soon,” Justin hastily replied.
Jack did not let it slide, a faint smile on his face: “How soon is soon?”
“Ahem! Let’s not discuss this topic for now. Jack, in a moment I will upload a video for you so that you can experience the excitement of the Alien Beast Battlefield.”
“I was lucky this time. The Communications Major at the military base happens to know my brother, so I can use the military hotline to contact you. Hehe.”
As he spoke, Justin eagerly began uploading a large video, which took more than ten minutes to finish uploading..

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 149: Heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield, Half a Year's Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 149: Heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield, Half a Years Time
Translator: 549690339
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Countless rockets and missiles rained down from the sky, covering a plain tens of kilometers away and blowing up countless approaching Mutated Beasts under the barrage of gunfire.
The number of rockets and missiles was dozens of times that of Koroyas night, almost half of the sky was filled with the trails of the missiles and rockets flying past.
Apart from that, stationed at mountain walls, cliffs, and rear positions tens of kilometers away, howitzers and anti-aircraft guns roared unceasingly, pulverizing everything with countless cannonballs emitting piercing screams.
Under the terrifying saturation bombing, almost the entire heaven and earth trembled and shook, with fire, roaring, and the howls of the Mutated Beasts as the melody of this world.
At the same time, Mutated Birds with wingspans of tens of meters circled in the sky, engaging in rolling dogfights with unmanned combat aircraft. Occasionally, flaming fighter aircraft were shot down in flames.
And when these unmanned fighters were destroyed, they would explode violently, and the corpses of the Mutated Birds in the sky would continue to fall.
Occasionally, a blue and white light beam would burst from the rear Military Base, piercing through the heaven and earth, and bombarding a flying Mutant Beast with a wingspan of over fifty meters across tens of kilometers.
That kind of energy attack was similar to the energy light column that had destroyed the mountain peak before, but much smaller, like a mini version.
Nevertheless, every time an energy beam was fired, it would clear a pathway in the sky, and all the Mutated Creatures in its path would be wiped out.
This was the video that Justin Welan had sent up, full of shocking impact, even more exciting than those sci-fi blockbuster movies.
However, the video was only ten minutes long, and it suddenly stopped when the missiles and rockets in the sky were still rumbling and falling.
Justin Welan chuckled, How about that, Jack, isnt it shocking? This is the romance that a man should have, what Koroyas got is nothing.
Jack Clark took a deep breath, When did this battle happen?
Yesterday.
Yesterday, huh. Jack nodded.
In the introduction to the Alien Beast Battlefield that Jack had seen before.
The area there was a fusion of between the mythical world and this world, vast and full of tiny cracks with rich energy.
As for the terrain of the Alien Beast Battlefield where Justin Welan and the others were, it was similar to two V-shaped valleys connected upside-down. One end was a wide plain with fertile land and rich in minerals.
The other end had undulating mountain ranges spanning more than six thousand kilometers, with the widest part stretching over three thousand kilometers vertically.
In this situation, the military built a huge Military Base in the middle of the two V-shaped valleys, guarding the plain area to prevent Mutated Beasts from breaking out of the Enchantment.
At the same time, the plain was being developed, planting high-energy crops with energy content and exploiting resources.
Every half a year, the military would use a top-tier resource to attract and gather most of the Mutated Beasts within a radius of a thousand kilometers, and then annihilate them with saturation bombing.
This was the origin of the name Alien Beast Battlefield. The operation took half a month to prepare.
Like a large-scale sweeping in the outside world, the main purpose was to suppress the total number of Mutated Beasts around the garrison and reduce the pressure.bender
The Martial Height Base for each Martial Cultivation school was built along a line, facing the Mutant Mountain Range that stretched for thousands of kilometers.
There were many stable resource output areas around this Martial Height Base.
A part of these resources was provided to the teachers and officials, while the other part was provided to the students. This was the main source of cultivation resources for Jack and the others before.
There are two types of tasks for students who go inside.
The first is mainly to assist the teachers in guarding the Resource Points, which can provide a stable monthly contribution, similar to working a job.
In addition to this, the environment is also suitable for cultivating faster than the outside world, which is why most of the second and third-year students are almost never at the school.
Of course, this kind of task is not just about sitting and playing, but defending against Mutated Beasts that might come to snatch resources, which still involves certain risks.
The second type of task is to venture deep into the mountains to hunt high-level Mutated Beasts, hone oneself, and search for new Resource Points or Heaven and Earth Treasures.
Compared to the first types comfort, the second type is more dangerous but also yields more rewards.
Its usually the powerful geniuses who choose this path.
Thinking of that, Jack couldnt help but be curious, Mr. Willard, how many Mutated Beasts have you killed since you got there?
He didnt ask about the realm improvement, as that would be too hurtful.
Still, even so, it took Justin Welan a while to respond, Jack, I dont think this topic is interesting, lets change the question.
Seeing this, Jack couldnt help but laugh. Serves you right.
This guy, after breaking through the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, had an even stronger defense but still average damage output. He probably had some difficulty even killing a Level 3 Mutated Beast.
In this case, his achievements were naturally not ideal.
Jack laughed, Alright, lets not talk about hunting Mutated Beasts then. How about this: how many Mutated Beast corpses did you move on the Alien Beast Battlefield yesterday?
. Justin Welan didnt know what to say again.
Every time the Military Base gathered high-level and low-level Mutated Beasts within a radius of a thousand kilometers and started the annihilation mission, the Martial Height Bases nearby would send out some students to support them.
Of course, this support was to help clean up the battlefield.
Those Mutated Beasts who could break through that firepower blockade were basically Level 5 and Level 6 and were dealt with by strong men. Those students in the Third and Fourth Layers going up there were only looking for death.
Justin Welan was speechless, Jack, Ive worked hard to find a connection and share a video with you, and youre hitting me like this? Thats not brotherly of you.
Jack Clark smiled, Alright, then lets talk about something happy?

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 149: Heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield, Half a Year's Time_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 149: Heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield, Half a Years Time_2
Translator: 549690339
Justin Welan subconsciously asked, Whats the happy news?
Jack Clark casually said, 1 broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven a few days ago.
Justin Welan was silent for a moment, then exclaimed excitedly, Damn, Jack, you really reached the Fourth Layer Heaven in just over a month? Are you serious!?
Although he had said before that he wouldnt be surprised if Jack Clark broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven in just over a month.
But that was just a casual joke at rhe time.
Counting from the time Jack Clark broke through the Third Layer Heaven to now, its only been a little over three months, and he suddenly broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, his cultivation speed is terrifying.
Thinking about this, Justin Welan, who was sitting in the communication room, was full of envy, because he was still struggling in the mid-period of the Third Layer Heaven.
Of course its true, and Im coming over this Sunday too.
Wuwul! Jack, youre finally coming. I can show off with you again, its so boring without you.
Justin Welan became excited.
Every day following the Class Leader and the others as a meat shield, we only encounter Level 3 Mutated Beasts, which pose no challenge at all. 1 cant even show off
Facing Justin Welans complaint, Jack Clark kindly reminded, Mr. Willard, this is the 3-9 Group. Although there is a delay with Class Leader and the others, they will still see it later.
Suddenly, the group showed that Justin Welan had withdrawn more than ten messages.
Seeing this. Jack Clark smiled and changed the topic, By the way, how are the Class Leader and the others?
Speaking of this, Justin Welan complained, Class Leader and Mandy Leinster are not being considerate. They have been hanging out with third-grade seniors for over a week.
Hanging out with third-grade seniors?1 Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Yeah, that senior sister seems to be a former student of their parents. After learning that they had come in, she took the initiative to invite them to practice deeper in the mountains.
Speaking of which. Jack, you probably wouldnt have guessed that their parents used to be teachers at South Sky Martial Height.
It is indeed quite surprising.
Jack Clark nodded, then casually asked, By the way, what about Jane Aiken and Howard Lee who entered more than half a month earlier than you guys?
Jane Aiken has made great progress. I heard shes about to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, and shes been in closed-door cultivation for the past few days.
As for Howard Lee, hes been stimulated by those senior geniuses and has been deep in the mountains for half a month. He said he wouldnt be back until he breaks through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Thats crazy. Jack Clark was quite surprised.
That guy has indeed always been very crazy Afterward, Jack Clark chatted with Justin Welan for a while more about their situation on the other side before hanging up the phone.
Sunday morning, at the gate of the courtyard.
Doris Raven and Glenn Clarks faces were full of emotion. The last time they bid farewell to Jack Clark was during the New Years holiday.
They didnt expect that he would leave again just a few days after returning.
Jack Clark smiled and said, Mom, dont worry about me, Ill take good care of myself.
Jenny gently said, 1 cant help much with your cultivation, but 1 wont be a burden to you. Just remember to be extra careful.
As Jack Clark began to cultivate True Martial Arts and step by step became one of the most monstrous geniuses in South Sky Martial Height, Doris Raven felt both proud and a sense of loss.
Because she realized she couldnt help much anymore.
Although it seemed like she hadnt been able to help much with his cultivation before, having her son at home would make the atmosphere livelier.
At this moment, Jack Clark looked at the tall and mighty Glenn Clark, Jim, youre the only man in the house when Im not here, take care of mom.
If something happens that you cant handle, go to the schools guidance office. They have a way to notify me.
Glenn Clark nodded seriously, Dont worry, brother, Ill take good care of the house.
Alright, Im going to school now. When we run low on Mutated Beast meat, Ill get more for you.
After saying that, Jack Clark waved goodbye to them and left the courtyard empty-handed.
As for luggage and stuff, Jack Clark only had a few sets of clothes, which he stuffed into the Sumeru Bracelet.
Now, the Sumeru Bracelet contained his battle armor, the Light Desolate Bartie Halberd, some mineral water, and Alien Beast Jerky. With the addition of clothes, the three cubic space was almost filled up.
Jack prepared the water and jerky for some special situations.
After all, cultivators still needed to eat even though they could absorb the energy of Heaven and Earth to offset some of their bodys consumption, but they couldnt reach the stage of transcendence yet.
In such cases, rhe food in the bracelet might come in handy one day.
Soon, Jack arrived at the south gate of the schools cultivation area, where a bus was already waiting.
It was nor yet time to leave, but many students who had applied for the Alien Beast Battlefield had already gathered. Everyone was carrying weapons, luggage, and battle armor.
In such a situation, Jack, with his empty hands, seemed somewhat special.
Carney Lee envied, Jack Clark, I heard that rhe school rewarded you with the Sumeru Bracelet after breaking through rhe Late Fourth Layer Heaven. It seems to be true.
What breakthrough reward? That was because of my outstanding performance in Koroya. Jack Clark corrected.bender
Carney Lee shrugged, Its all pretty much the same. Theres nor much difference. Anyway, among rhe freshmen, you are the best.
Is best an inappropriate description? Jack Clark paused for a moment.
Elvis Raven joined in with a grin, Indeed, rhe wording isnt right. It should be insanely cool.1
Jack Clark couldnt help but smile and shook his head, You guys are exaggerated..

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 149: Heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield, Half a Year Time_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 149: Heading to the Alien Beast Battlefield, Half a Year Time_3
Translator: 549690339
Someone had once said, when you start to accumulate wealth, youll find that everyone around you is a good person.
Similarly, as Jack Clark exhibited increasingly formidable talent, people around him might have been filled with envy but their attitude was predominantly of friendliness and enthusiasm.
Many classmates, whom he had never met or heard of before, would now take the initiative to greet him when they ran into him on the street.
At this point, a youth who was dressed in white casual clothing and with a scholarly demeanor, more like a scholar than a cultivator, strolled up to Jack Clark with a smile on his face.
Had I known that there would be a dragon-type high-level mutant beast appearing at Hundred Mountain Town, I would have chosen that mission too.
Jack Clark smiled, saying, Its good that you didnt. Otherwise, I wouldnt have earned so many contribution points.
This youth was Kyle Hawk, who was ranked third in the newcomer rankings but he did not go to the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Compared to Jane Aiken who was the first-ranked and Howard Lee who came in second, Jack Clark hasnt interacted much with this third-ranked genius, only having met at school.
As the third in the freshman ranking, Kyle Hawk naturally had impressive talent.
Although Jack Clark couldnt sense his actual realm because he was not emanating his True Power Aura, he predicted that the other party should have broken through to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven.
Meanwhile, Freya Louise arrived from a distance.
Striding with her long hair tied in a ponytail, she swayed with liveliness, carrying a huge suitcase in each hand, with a box for her sniper rifle slung over her back.
Jack Clark went over, took one of the suitcases from her and asked casually, Why are you so late today?
Freya laughed softly, Cant help it. My aunt packed some stuff for me when 1 was leaving, so I got delayed.
Packed some stuff?
Looking at the two huge suitcases, big enough to fit a person inside, Jack hesitated and then asked, Dont tell me, theyre stuffed with ammunition?
Exactly. Im estimating that its going to be around half a year over there, so I have brought a lot of ammunition: a thousand Black Bone Armor-piercing rounds, eight hundred Explosive Incendiary Rounds, three hundred Focused High-Pressure penetration rounds and a hundred of the Magnetic Energy Black Gold rounds.
Besides long-range sniper bullets, I also have five hundred Pistol Anti-Split rounds for close combat and a hundred Micro Liquid Bombs
By the time the girl finished speaking, Jacks face was numb.
It seemed that Freyas two boxes of ammunition were enough to wage a small war, akin to one man suppressing an entire armored squad with his firepower. Be it as it may, it wasnt surprising coming from someone with a military research base at home.
In the middle of Jack Clarks reflections, the others began to arrive one after the other, followed by Lori Parma and Vernon Leinster.
Are we all here?
Teacher, all present.
Then put your luggage away, get on the bus one by one, and lets move out
As the bus pulled out of the school gates, Jack Clark reflexively looked back at the increasingly distant school and had a feeling that by the time he came back, everything might be different.
The station to get to the Alien Beast Battlefield is different from civilian ones; its located within the military base.
When Jack Clark and the others descended from the bus, they followed Lori Parma into the platform. Soon, a pitch-black train slowly drove into the station.
The black train, like a winding black dragon, emitted a heavy aura, and when it stopped before Jack, he even had the impression that it was a living creature.
Not just him, the rest of the students also had solemn expressions on their faces.
Then Lori Parma turned around and shouted, Note that we are in carriage 05, keep following behind, and dont get lost.
Yes, teacher.
Luckily, once they got on board, Jack found the interior of the carriage to be normal, with no apparent difference from an ordinary train.
After everyone had settled their luggage, the train slowly started, hammering and clanging, its speed increasing to eventually rush out of the city.
Just when Jack thought that everything would go smoothly, after three hours of travel, a dense fog suddenly appeared ahead, into which the pitch-black train plunged headfirst.
When the express train entered the thick fog, everyone had the illusion of space twisted around them.bender
There was nothing but fog outside, but Jack felt the speed of the train surge manifold.
Is this the Endless Mist? Jack was pensive.
According to the information he had read, it was said that the stable passageways into the mythical world and a few closed-off mountain ranges inhabited by unique beasts in the country were all enclosed by Endless Mist.
And this mist was the Seal.
An hour later, the trains speed dropped sharply, and the fog ahead dissipated. They had now arrived in an open space between mountain forests, next to a normal train station.
Passengers, please note, weve arrived at Nine Mountains Station. All Special Forces Soldiers heading to the Snowy Mountain Range should disembark now. The train will stop for ten minutes, while the other passengers can remain seated.
With the continuous broadcast, a line of weapon-carrying, luggage-toting students gradually stepped out of the train.
Ten minutes later, the train started again, quickly vanishing into the mist.
Down the line, people kept disembarking until the afternoon.
Passengers, please note, weve arrived at Moat Station. All Special Forces Soldiers heading to Moat Transfer Station should disembark now. The train will stop for ten minutes
Lori Parma spoke solemnly, Jack Clark, youve arrived. After getting off, follow the instructions and dont run around.
Lori Parma and Vernon Leinsters destination was the passageway at the farthest end. So, it was time to part ways with Jack and the others. Who knew when they would meet again?
Goodbye, Teacher Parma, Teacher Vernon.
Goodbye, Teachers!
Everyone bade farewell to the two teachers, then excitedly and anxiously took their luggage and stepped down the train one after the other.
Jack too, carried one of Freyas suitcases.
Just as he was about to step off the carriage, Lori Parma suddenly spoke, Jack Clark, remember to work hard on your cultivation after you go in and strive to strengthen yourself in every possible way. You have half a year.
Teacher, what half a year? Jack looked back, puzzled.
Just then Vernon Leinster moved his lips, his voice resonated in Lori Parmas ear: LoriParma, dont say it, weve only heard rumors about that issue, its still not confirmed.
Instantly, Lori Parma paused and then continued, Its nothing, I just mean that remember to work hard on your cultivation and strive to strengthen yourself in every possible way. 111 be waiting for you on the Frontline Battlefield.
Okay, got it, Teacher.
Jack looked at the duo puzzled, pretending that he hadnt heard Vernons whisper wrapped in True Strength. Nodding, he stepped off the train and found himself facing the magnificent scene he had seen before.
The earth abruptly ended, an endless vast wilderness forest lay before his eyes.
Alien Beast Battlefield, here I come..

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 150: Glorification in Public, Ranked Sixth
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 150: Glorification in Public, Ranked Sixth
Translator: 549690339
Behind them, the endless grey fog spread outward, forming a wall of fog thousands of meters high. In front was a cliff plunging down thousands of meters, no wonder it was called the Moat Station.
While Jack Clark and the freshmen stood at the cliffs edge, looking at the vast wilderness forest in the distance in a trance, a mans voice sounded over the stations loudspeaker.
Aspiring cultivators over there, stop staring and come over to check in.
Jack Clark and others turned their heads, noticing for the first time a guardhouse building a few dozen meters away.bender
Cough!
Jack Clark cleared his throat: Lets go over first. We still need to rush to the Nine Rings Mountain Range where the schools located.
Kyle Hawk, in flowing white robes, nodded, Thats right, this is just the entrance to the Alien Beast Battlefield. We still have a long way to go to get to the school.
Carney Lee said excitedly: Lets go, brothers.
As those guys hurried off towards the guardhouse, Jack Clark voluntarily helped carry a suitcase for Freya Louise, the smiling girl following behind with another one in her hand.
Facial recognition completed, fingerprint approved, South Sky Martial Height First Year Student, Kyle Hawk.
Facial recognition completed, fingerprint approved, South Sky Martial Height First Year Student, Carney Lee
Under the facial verification system, as everyone walked past the entrance of the guardhouse, their identities were announced electronically, precise and stringent.
Having completed the identity verification, the fifteen students walked towards a massive elevator platform behind the guardhouse according to the sign.
While technically an elevator platform, it was essentially a row of ten or so massive elevators installed on the cliff, designed to transport people and goods.
Inside the guardhouse, a soldier dressed in military uniform expressed some astonishment: This batch happens to be freshmen from South Sky Martial Height again.
Another person nodded in agreement: Indeed, the freshmen from South Sky Martial Height this year are strong, so many geniuses have broken through to the Third Layer Heaven in just one semester.
Each generation is stronger than the last.
While the two were talking, Jack Clark and the others had already reached the elevator platform and lined up. Seeing this, a soldier shouted, Please stand steady, students. May your martial luck thrive.
With the soldiers blessing, the colossal elevator suddenly descended at a breathtaking speed.
The raging wind howled in their ears, the descending speed almost reaching a hundred meters per second. The ground enlarged rapidly before their eyes, and they reached the bottom in just over ten seconds.
As the elevator slowly came to a halt, Elvis Raven couldnt help but clutch his chest: Damn, I almost thought we were going to crash.
Carney Lee shook his head: Its a surprise that you, a Third Layer expert, got so scared by a bit of weightlessness.
Bullshit, even Third Layer experts would be scared of a rapid descent of a hundred meters per second, were not High-Ranking Powerhouses. Elvis Raven retorted.
While the two were bickering, Jack Clark looked over at Freya Louise, noticing that she was relatively composed.
Freya Louises eyes were narrowed slightly, forming a crescent-moon smile as she said, This little bit of weightlessness doesnt scare me. I jumped from an altitude of over 10,000 meters last year before I even started my cultivation.
A year ago, at the age of fifteen, a jump from 10,000 meters. Jack Clark was slightly surprised as he looked at the girl before him.
He didnt expect that she had not only been good with guns daily, but also seemed to excel in all aspects, at least better than he had imagined. Jack Clark certainly didnt dare to go skydiving at the age of fifteen.
As for the sinking acceleration of over a hundred meters per second, ordinary people definitely could not bear it; they might even slam their heads on the elevator ceiling due to weightlessness.
But Jack Clark and his peers were all Third and Fourth Layer cultivators. With the operation of True Strength, their feet were rooted to the ground as if they had taken root.
Outside the elevator was a large square, filled with enormous trucks transporting goods, while occasionally armed soldiers could be seen patrolling.
This was a military base, similar to a cargo transfer station.
At this time, a captain officer came over, first checked the time on his wristwatch, then looked at Jack Clark and others and said in a deep voice, Students from South Sky ATartial Height?
Yes. Jack Clark and the others nodded.
The captain officer said firmly, Before you came, your teacher has applied for a flying fighter aircraft for you. Its at the No. 5 Airport runway over there. Lets go, Ill escort you there.
Everyone, who hadnt expected they would have to take an airplane, paused: We appreciate it, comrade.
No need to be formal, were all in this for Eastern Summer.
Under the guidance of the captain, they crossed the outskirts of the military base and arrived at the so-called No. 5 Airport after walking for slightly over twenty minutes.
All eyes were filled with awe immediately.
On the vast and wide airport runway, hundreds of unmanned combat aircraft with wing spans of tens of meters were parked, along with hundreds of dark thirty-meter-wing-span fighters.
On several separate runways, there were a dozen energy bombers of more than seventy meters in wing span and over a hundred meters in total length, with a futuristic design.
They recognized these types of combat aircraft because they had seen pictures of them.
Aside from these, in some hangars, there were some special combat aircraft that Jack Clark and others hadnt seen before.
The aircraft they were boarding was one of those special combat aircraft. It was over thirty meters long and just over twenty meters in wingspan, resembling a sharp bird.
When they arrived at the aircraft, the captain touched a piece of equipment on his left arm, and the aircrafts tail slowly lowered to extend a boarding ramp.
Seeing the surprise in Jack Clark and others eyes, the captain couldnt help but introduce it, This is a new generation of energy anti-gravity warplanes, codenamed Bluebird.
The main body material is cast from a combination of exotic beast bones and alloy, with several times the firmness of aerospace alloy but lighter in weight. Most importantly, this type of aircraft has high energy adaptability, capable of igniting an energy shield for combat with mutated birds..

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 150: Glorification in Public, Ranked Sixth_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 150: Glorification in Public, Ranked Sixth_2
Translator: 549690339
The Kinetic Energy that powers the engine is supplied by high-purity energy crystals while the inscriptions etched on the surface absorb and supplement the Heavenly Energy surrounding it.
This fighter aircrafts performance, speed, agility, and the power of its carried weapons are all more than ten times those of their predecessors.
However, the Heavenly Energy concentration outside does not meet the requirements, so you cannot see it outside.
As the captain introduced, everyone boarded the aircraft, placed their weapons and luggage on both sides of the fixed position as required, and sat down along the seats on both sides.
By the time everyone had fastened their seat belts, the captain had already arrived at the fighters cockpit, where a pilot had already taken a seat.
Hum!
Accompanied by the vibrating hum, this futuristic-styled fighter aircraft slowly slid out of the warehouse. Soon after, a strong magnetic force erupted below it, followed by a sudden upward thrust from the rear.
Boom! With the violent thrust, the fighter aircraft slanted and rushed into the sky, reaching the speed of sound in just two breaths and rushing into the skyline with a piercing roar.
Under the intense sense of weightlessness, even Jack Clark was taken aback as he watched the white clouds outside the window retreat at breakneck speed.
When the fighter aircraft finally reached a stable flight speed at twice the speed of sound, Clark let out a breath and shook his head at Freya Louise beside him, 1 feel like the style has changed so much since we entered this place.
Freya said softly, Its normal since most of the nations strength has gone into military research in recent years.
Whether its True Martial Cultivation or military weapons, equipment, materials, etc., they have all been constantly explored and researched, creating a significant gap with civilian use.
Instead of being reassured, Jack Clark felt a sense of unease from Freyas words.
In theory, the era of High Martial and Mutated Beasts should see rapid technological development.
After all, many technology researches constrained by materials could make breakthroughs in the Transcendent Era, but in this situation, all countries have been concentrating their resources and energy on the military for decades.
It gives a strong sense of insufficient firepower, so they desperately develop it.
What is it that makes the Human Race, who have surpassed nuclear weapons in weapon research and whose single cultivators are already comparable to myths and legends, have such a strong sense of crisis?
The words Frontline Battlefield flashed through Jack Clarks mind.
Under supersonic flight, the fighter aircraft quickly covered more than 500 kilometers and arrived at Nine Rings Mountain.
As the fighter aircrafts altitude dropped substantially, buildings erected among the forests came into Jack Clarks view, adding a touch of civilization to the endless forest.
Besides that, some construction groups were faintly visible in the distant skyline, stretching like a straight line.
Whoo! The Bluebird Battle Machine descended vertically under several antigravity engines control, landing steadily at the South Sky Base square.
When the cabin door opened and Jack Clark and others walked off the aircraft, their Class 3 teacher, James Clark, came towards them from the side of the square.
James Clarks expression remained solemn, nodding slightly to the captain who had disembarked with them, Thank you for your help this time, Johann Drake.
Captain Drake showed a smile, Teacher Clark, youre too polite. Im also an alumni of South Sky Martial Height, so I should send my junior colleagues here.
Carney Lee was surprised, Comrade Captain, you were a student of South Sky Martial Height too!?
Everyone else, including Jack Clark, also showed an astonished look, not expecting this 20-something captain to have come from their school.
Johann Drake smiled and nodded, Yes, but my talent isnt as good as yours. When 1 graduated, 1 barely broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven, joined the military, and became a captain.
Curious, Jack Clark asked, Teacher Clark, how come youre here?
It was reasonable for Lori Parma and others to be Martial Cultivation Teachers, but it was unexpected to see James Clark, a humanities class teacher, at an Alien Beast Battlefield.
James Clark calmly said, Dont be surprised, its just my turn to take duty here. Next semester, someone else will come.
Alright, follow me to get your dormitory assignments, then Ill find someone to show you around here, and well worry about other matters tomorrow.
But just as James Clark finished speaking, a thirty-meter high, ten-meter wide wall to the left of the squareor rather, a large screen, suddenly lit up.
A row of red large characters appeared on it.
Eric Polis, Cloud Mountain Martial Height, Fourth Layer Heaven Realm, broke through on February 13th, ranked 23rd on the First-grade Talent Rankings!
The row of red characters was as big as people, blinking red light, and almost everyone in the square could see it. Carney Lee and others who had just arrived were taken aback.
What the hell is this?
A first-year student from Cloud Mountain Martial Height, at the Fourth Layer Heaven, only ranked twenty-third.
This is too exaggerated, Jack Clarks breakthrough last week was already shocking, I didnt expect there to be so many monsters in the first year who broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven!bender
At this moment, the row of large red characters slowly shrank, and the Eastern Summer Southern Region Talent Rankings for the third, second, and first grades appeared on the big screen.
Jack Clarks gaze skipped over the first two grades and fell on the first-grade list.
The first place was someone named Freddy Nelson, from Light Martial Height, who broke through the Fourth Layer on February 1st, six days before Jack Clark.
Then there were the second and third places
Ian Clark, River Martial Height, ranked 15th on the Talent Rankings, broke through the Fourth Layer on February 8th.
Hmm! Jack Clarks gaze slightly moved and landed on the 16th place on the Talent Rankings.
Jane Aiken, South Sky Martial Height, ranked 16th on the Talent Rankings, broke through the Fourth Layer on February 11th.
Rank sixteenth, unexpected that Jane Aiken had already broken through for two days. Jack Clark thought to himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 150: Glorification in Public, Ranked Sixth_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 150: Glorification in Public, Ranked Sixth_3
Translator: 549690339
Look, Jane Aiken has also broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
As everyone looked up in awe at the huge ranking board, a person hurriedly rushed back to the entrance of the square, and it was Justin Welan.
At this moment, his battle armor was a bit dirty, carrying a heavy shield on his back. Seeing Jack Clark, he excitedly shouted, Jack, youre finally here!
Justin Welan excitedly ran over and greeted: Freya Louise, you all are here too.
After greeting Freya Louise, Justin Welan turned to Jack Clark and said, Hehe!
1 calculated the time, and you should be here by now, so I rushed back in advance.
Come on, Jack, lets pretend to be cool No, lets go register.
Saying that, he hurriedly grabbed Jack Clarks arm and ran towards the big screen underneath.
Justin Welan excitedly explained: The Unique Beast Battlefield data is separate from the outside world so you need to log in. Here, enter your Student ID for verification
Cough!
Jack Clark coughed: Take your time with the registration Why are you more eager than me?
Hehe, isnt it because 1 want to see you shining, Jack? Justin Welan chuckled.
With Jack Clark passing the verification and then pressing his palm on the detector device below, the big screen suddenly lit up again, and another row of large red characters appeared.
Jack Clark, South Sky Martial Height, Fourth Layer Heaven realm, breakthrough on February 6th, ranked 6th in the first-grade talent list.
At this moment, not only in the South Sky Martial Height base.
A whole row of large characters appeared on the screens in the base squares of the eighteen first-class and more than forty second-class Martial Height schools throughout the Southern Unique Beast Battlefield.
Jack Clark!
Thousands of kilometers away from the base of the River Martial Height, lan Clark looked up at the name on the huge screen, and the figure who walked out from the blaze appeared in his mind subconsciously.
Hahahaha! I knew it, Jack, youd be able to steal the spotlight as soon as you arrived.
Looking at the large red characters on the big screen showing Jack Clarks 6th place ranking, Justin Welan laughed out loud.
But Jack Clark was a little confused: Mr. Willard, when did this list come out?
He didnt see this on the Unique Beast Battlefield information he had read earlier.
Mr. Willard chuckled, I heard from some seniors that it only appeared a few months ago, around the time we went to Koroya. Its divided into talent rankings and achievement rankings.
But a few months ago, the talent rankings only covered Second Grade and Third Grade. Last month, they added First Grade after some freshmen broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven and entered the Unique Beast Battlefield.
This list covers the eighteen first-class and forty-one second-class Martial Height bases in the Southern Unique Beast Battlefield. Whenever theres a change, huge red characters will appear on the screen for everyone to see.
For example, right now, many people in the Southern Martial Height bases know theres a genius named Jack Clark.
How about it, Jack, doesnt it feel great?
Jack Clark turned back and looked at the envy, surprise, and astonishment on the faces of his classmates and Captain Johann Drake. He couldnt help but shake his head: A little bit, 1 guess. It would be false to say it doesnt.
Everyone has a desire to perform, which is an instinct from deep within the genes that no one can avoid. Its just like women who love to wear beautiful clothes and men who like to be on the stage.
Its just that more composed and mature people can control this desire.
Mr. Willard proudly said, Hehe, 1 know this feeling is great, so 1 hurried back to see you show off, not even waiting for Mr. Lewis and the others.
Not the point, why are you so excited about me stealing the spotlight Jack Clark was speechless.
At this time, James Clark came over, glanced at Jack Clark, and casually said: Justin Welan, youre back just in time. Take them to their dormitories and introduce them to the specifics of this place.
Okay, teacher, leave it to me.
Justin Welan excitedly waved and said, Brothers, lets go. Ill show you around the base first, and greet those genius seniors along the way.
Are new students arriving? The second semester of Senior One hasnt started yet, right?
The new students this year are so strong!
Yeah, along with the first two groups, there are already more than forty who have broken through the Third Layer Heaven!
On the steps at the entrance of the base, many seniors wearing ordinary combat suits were watching the group of new students below with complicated expressions on their faces.
Most of these second-grade seniors were at Second Layer Heaven, with a few in the initial stage of Third Layer Heaven.
Thats right, they were that weak.
In this world, geniuses were only a minority; even among martial cultivation students from First-class Universities like South Sky Martial Height, not many could keep progressing vigorously.
Over six hundred students had reached Foundation Establishment in the last batch of South Sky Martial Height, but only four hundred were left in the second year.
During this period, those students with poor talent, who couldnt bear the boredom and challenges of cultivation, or were afraid to fight because of the blood, eventually gave up and chose humanities.
There were quite a few of them.
For example, when school started a few days ago, Jack Clark noticed that about a hundred out of the approximately nine hundred Foundation Establishment students had chosen to switch to humanities.
By the time the next semester starts, there will be more dropouts, just like the current second-year seniors.
At present, among the more than four hundred second-year seniors, only over two hundred had broken through the Third Layer Heaven, while around two hundred were still struggling in the late stages of the Second Layer Heaven.
For now, these students could only take on ordinary tasks for the base or hunt Level 1-2 Variant Beasts nearby to earn Contribution Points and accumulate combat experience.
Only those who had broken through the Third Layer Heaven would venture into the mountain ranges, and those four or even five-layered monster geniuses would dare to go far away from the base.
Apart from that, there were about two hundred third-grade seniors above the second year, who had a cultivation base of at least the Third Layer Heaven, and many of them had broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
The strongest among them had reached the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven, ready to break through at any time.
All in all, there were about six hundred students from South Sky Martial Height in the Alien Beast Battlefield. Including logistics staff and ordinary workers, the total population was about eight hundred.
However, many students were not usually based here, with only four hundred to five hundred permanent residents.
As Justin Welan introduced the situation while leading the group around the base, everyone gained a general understanding of it.
There were several areas in the base, including: dormitory area, cultivation retreat area, logistics area, canteen, information and tasks area, and workers dormitory activity area.
In addition to these, due to the magnetic field and seals, the base was cut off from the outside world. Only a dedicated underground cable could be used to connect to the rear Military Base.
During this time, Justin Welan briefly mentioned the two modes of tasks, but only a few words were spoken about them.
At this time, only geniuses were able to come here in advance. No one would choose conservative tasks. The purpose of coming here was to fight against mutated beasts, hone oneself, and gain combat experience.
Of course, the most important thing was Contribution Points.
With that, they could exchange a large number of cultivation resources suitable for themselves, to improve more quickly.bender
After roughly understanding the basic information about the base, Jack Clark and the others finally went to the logistics management department to register and be assigned a dormitory.
The dormitories here were divided into several male and female buildings, with one individual room for each person, not much different from those in the school.
When these arrangements were done, Zac Lyons, Marcus Lee, White Veil, and Mullen Weisz had finished their tasks and returned to the base. A group of them excitedly came to visit the newcomers..

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 151: Monsters Everywhere,
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 151: Monsters Everywhere,
Suppressing the World
Translator: 549690339
Evening.
After dinner, at the edge of the square.
Looking at the gradually bustling base, Marcus Lee lamented: Damn, I didnt know that being in the Third Layer Heaven was nothing until I came here. 1 should have learned from Jack Clark and come a bit later.
Zac Lyons also seemed lost: Yeah, at school, we were geniuses who broke through to the Third Layer Heaven in the first grade, but here, the Third Layer Heaven is everywhere.
Coming here so eagerly, not only did we fail to pretend, but we were also heavily hit. Its only those Contribution Points that can give me a little comfort.
Jack Clark crossed his arms, leaned on the railing, and said wordlessly: Why do 1 feel like you two are singing and rejoicing? Are Contribution Points easy to earn here?
Hehe! Its alright, its alright.
Speaking of this, the White Veil gang all laughed hehe, looking somewhat wretched.
Marcus Lee was excited: There are too many Mutated Beasts here. In less than a month after coming here, we have earned an average of over a hundred Contribution Points.
But its a bit tiring. We go out early and return late every day, running for hundreds of kilometers, and sometimes staying outside for two or three days. Especially when carrying the corpse of a Mutated Beast across the mountains, its easy to encounter other Mutated Creatures attacking, and we have to be on guard all the time, which is very troublesome.
As soon as they finished speaking, Jack Clark exclaimed in surprise: Youve been here for so long, and the average person has only earned just over a hundred Contribution Points?
In Jacks mind, there were Mutated Beasts all over the place, and by casually killing a few Level 3 creatures, he could earn hundreds of Contribution Points. If he worked a little harder, wouldnt Contribution Points come pouring in?
Moreover, he had earned more than four hundred points just by being outside for half a month.
Of course, these guys couldnt compare to him, but even so, their harvest was much less than Jack had expected.
Not too many, Jack.
Zac Lyons was satisfied: Its just over half a month, and I earned 120 points, which is equivalent to the total I gained during the Koroya trial, plus the points I got from Erica Knowles.
Mullen Weisz also nodded in satisfaction: Indeed, its not bad.
Its a pity that we havent broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, otherwise, we could go deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to search for Resource Points.
Compared to hunting Mutated Creatures and carrying their corpses back, finding a resource point can get at least five hundred Contribution Points, and if you can develop it for a long time, theres a follow-up share.
Dont worry, well have enough bread.
White Veil was confident: With the speed of our current harvest of Contribution Points, we can quickly break through the Fourth Layer Heaven by exchanging a large amount of cultivation resources and fighting.
Yes, work hard to break through the Fourth Layer as soon as possible. We cant let Jack be arrogant for too long.
Cough! Im not arrogant. Jack coughed dryly, defending himself.
Zac Lyons hummed: Not arrogant yet, but its time to wait for your brothers when you are pretending.
Exactly.
Mullen Weisz stirred up trouble: Justin Welan said he had something to do, so he sneaked back alone, and as a result, the four of us had to carry that Level 4 Mutated Beast corpse, panting and struggling.
Faced with their accusations, Justin Welan only smiled smugly with raised eyebrows.
Freya Louise stood nearby, looking at the rolling mountains in the distance, listening to her classmates bragging and talking nonsense, her lips curled into a smile.
After some aimless talk, Jack Clark looked at the big screen standing on the side of the square, where the Genius List and Achievement List were displayed, switching between the two every ten minutes.
The genius list of the three grades only recorded the top 100, but currently, there were only more than 20 in the first grade.
Jack suddenly said: Speaking of which, how much do you know about those geniuses up there?bender
Jack was somewhat interested in these geniuses who could make the top 100, but the rankings only had their names, with no indication of their schools or specific cultivation levels.
It seemed that only when there were changes, would the red letters appear, showing those.
However, facing Jacks inquiry, the expressions on the faces of Zac Lyons and White Veil were a bit awkward.
Marcus Lee coughed: Well, we actually dont know much about it.
Zac Lyons scratched his head: We are just in the mid-stage of the Third Layer Heaven, and we are still a little bit behind the breakthrough. So we havent paid much attention to the genius list.
Okay. Jack shook his head speechlessly.
At this moment, Justin Welan laughed, Asking them about this is useless. Since they arrived, their minds have been filled with killing Mutated Beasts and fighting day and night.
Justin Welan, as if you didnt go with us. Zac Lyons was unconvinced.
Justin shrugged: Although I usually go with you to kill Mutated Beasts, I go to the senior students dormitory every night when 1 come back.
It so happens that there are a few seniors in the third grade who 1 know, or rather, they know my brother, which, if you think about it, is almost the same as knowing me, hehe.
But when my brother graduated, those seniors were just freshmen, so I can only say that our relationship is not bad.
This guy is a natural communicator and gossip expert. Jack praised: How about it? What did you find out?
Justin shook his head: They actually dont know much either. Currently, I only know that there are five geniuses on the list from South Sky Martial Height, two in the second grade, namely Carol Koch and Sam Boyce.
Carol Koch is the one who ranked first on the Genius List in the second grade. It is said that he has already broken through to the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, making him the most monstrous one in the second grade. Ranked at twenty-sixth, Sam Boyce is at the Initial Stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven. These people are very strong and have been sharpening their will and fighting skills in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range for years.
In addition, three third-graders from South Sky Martial Height are on the list, respectively, Denny Raven at fifth place, Steven Lee at nineteenth place, and Betty Leinster at thirty-fifth place.
Among the three, Denny Raven is at the Peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven, while the other two are in the late stage. Everyone in the third grade who made the list is at least at the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven..

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 151: Monsters Everywhere, Suppressing the World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 151: Monsters Everywhere, Suppressing the World_2
Translator: 549690339
However, the genius list for second-graders is a bit weaker, with only over 50 reaching the initial stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and the rest being at the peak of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark was thoughtful, So all third-graders have broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven?
Is the Fifth Layer Heaven strong? Of course, it is. Knowing that it took Lori Parma and others a dozen years to reach the peak of Sixth-level Heaven and only recently broke through to the Seventh Layer, one can understand how amazing these geniuses are.
Although Lori Parma once said that their talent at that time could only be considered average, it depended on the environment at the time.
More than a dozen years ago, there were no Foundation Cultivation Methods, and every person who could cultivate was actually a genius. In that situation, having average talent was already no weaker than Justin Welan and others today.
In such a situation, breaking through to the Fifth Layer Heaven in less than three years of cultivation, almost each of these individuals was considered a monster in their respective Martial Height Schools.
At this time, Justin Welan shook his head again, But the genius list is generally considered to be of little significance, recording only the highest-ranked individuals in the current realm. What really matters is the Achievement List.
After all, everyone can see the realms, but battle strength is the standard for measuring a persons strength.
Extraordinary battle armor, transcendent weapons, the cultivation of secret skills, and the comprehension level of Advanced True Martial arts all determine the strength of battle power.
The Achievement List is ranked in two ways, the first being the accumulation of points for killing mutated beasts over the long run, and the higher the points, the higher the ranking.
As for the second way, as long as your strength is strong enough, you can challenge anyone ahead of you in the ranking. If you win, you can take their place.
Of course, as long as the other party is willing to accept the challenge, under normal conditions, no one will refuse.bender
Currently, the 1,000th rank on the Achievement List is 1000th Ranked Pill Tinsley, who is said to have reached the Late Fourth Layer Heaven and once hunted a Mid-Stage Level 5 Mutated Beast alone.
Damn, even the 1,000th rank gatekeeper can hunt down level 5 mutant beasts. Zac Lyons exclaimed in surprise.
Justin Welan rolled his eyes, No shit, thats the top 1,000 of South Sky Martial Height geniuses. You think theyre weak?
One thousand people may sound like a lot, but there are already hundreds of geniuses from South Sky Martial Height here.
Moreover, the Southern Battlefield covers eighteen first-tier and more than forty second-tier Martial Highs. There are currently more than 20,000 students in the battlefield.
According to the information Justin Welan gathered, there were over 600 people who broke through to the Fifth Layer Heaven in the second and third grades, and there were more than 4,000 people who reached the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Under such circumstances, almost all of those who could make the top 1,000 on the Achievement List were the best of the best, with the highest value added.
And these achievements cannot be faked. In the entire Alien Beast Battlefield, there are hundreds of high-definition satellites hanging, forming an area network called the Sky Base Satellite.
All satellites are controlled by a supercomputer.
Of course, in this space where distortions are prevalent and Heaven and Earth are sealed, those Sky Base Satellites are more like alternative transcendent weapons, hanging at an altitude of several hundred thousand meters.
These satellites monitor the movements of mutated creatures within a range of 3,000 miles in front of and behind the military and Martial Height bases, and more than 2,000 miles in depth on the left and right.
Once a large number of mutated beasts gather in groups near the base, a warning will be issued, and a saturation bombing will be carried out in advance to eliminate them.
At the same time, as soon as a battle with energy fluctuations above the Fourth Layer Heaven occurs, the nearby satellites will automatically focus, including duels between students.
As long as the weather permits, even at night, satellites can use energy-spectrum night vision.
Along with the input of information from the dead bodies of mutated beasts brought back by students or the location of chips carried by both parties in battle, basic anti-fraud measures are guaranteed.
However, this monitoring is only around the base.
Due to magnetic fields and spatial fluctuations, the Sky Eye Satellites monitoring range can only cover half of the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Especially deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to the southeast of the Martial Height Base, where there are clouds and mist swirling, and magnetic fields are chaotic, there are countless high-level mutated beasts hidden, and even high-ranked mutated creatures are said to be found in the depths.
As a result, every year there are students who never return in pursuit of breakthroughs and exploration of the deep resources of the mountain range, and it can be assumed that they have died.
At the same time, students who go on outbound missions within a few hundred miles of the base are also injured from time to time, or even die in the mouths of mutated beasts.
After all, as long as its a battle, a little carelessness can determine life or death, so the casualty rate here is not low every year.
Of course, if you are afraid of death, you can choose ordinary missions issued by the base and only move around the surrounding safe areas.
If the fifth layer peak is ranked first, then it should not take me long to surpass and suppress them, right? Jack Clark thought.
However, these people should have strong fighting power, especially those ranked in the top 100 on the Achievement List, who may have the fighting power above the Sixth Layer Heaven.
As the most talented group of monsters from dozens of Martial Height Schools, they would be somewhat embarrassed if they couldnt even cross the Major Realm after accumulating for several years.
While Jack Clark was pondering, Marcus Lee reminded, Jack, I know your battle power far exceeds your realm, but 1 still suggest you be more cautious since you have just arrived here.
Jack Clark nodded in response to his kind reminder, Yeah, I wont be careless.
At this time, Justin asked, Jack, what are your plans? Will you team up with us or act alone?
Zac Lyons and a few others looked at him with anticipation.
If Jack, who had amazing battle power, joined their team, hunting mutated beasts in the future would be much easier.
Unfortunately, after thinking about it, Jack shook his head, Id better act alone during normal times. You guys are too slow and cant keep up with me..

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 151: Demons Everywhere, Repressing the World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 151: Demons Everywhere, Repressing the World_3
Translator: 549690339
However, if you encounter a powerful Mutated Beast that you cannot handle, or a horde of high-level mutated beasts, you can join forces with me.
With his combat prowess, even if he stabilizes a bit, his hunting targets are still level 4 Mutated Beasts or higher, including and not limited to ordinary level 5 ones.
These types of Mutated Beasts are enormous, astonishingly powerful, and the environment around them is even more dangerous; Within everyone, maybe only Justin Welan can keep up a little.
Though Freya Louise has strong attacking power, her self-defense ability is too weak. Following him would also be very dangerous.
At this time, Jack Clark smiled again and said: However, dont you guys be disappointed. Even though I am not teaming up with you, we still have Freya.
You should be aware of how strong her offensive power is. Even against Dragon Variant Beasts with Late Fourth Layer Heaven combat strength, as long as she finds an opportunity, she can kill.
Just as Jack Clark finished speaking, Justin Welan, who had anticipated this, chuckled and said: Even if you didnt mention it, we would never forget about beauty Freya Louise. We have been waiting for her.
With her around, we can dare to approach those nests that have two or three Level 4 Mutated Beasts.
Thats right, by the time, we will have Justin Welan attracting fire at the front, with Marcus Lee, Zac Lyons, and Mullen Weisz as the main attackers, while Freya Louise is responsible for heavily attacking those Mutated Beasts from a distance.
As for White Veil, he has the strongest mobility, responsible for scouting ahead and protecting Freya during the battle.bender
By then, our Killing Squad will have a higher killing rate. When we carry back those corpses of Mutated Beasts, we wont need to fear those high-flying mutated birds.
Jack Clark and Freya had discussed team issues on the way here, analyzing the pros and cons and his plans for the future.
So when they mentioned this issue, the girl standing on the side kept smiling and silently watched Jack and Justin converse.
Speaking of which, how do you usually carry back the corpses of Level 4 Mutated Beasts that weigh dozens of tons across mountains and rivers? Jack Clark asked, somewhat perplexed.
Its not that he looked down on people like Marcus Lee. The most powerful among those in triplicate could now muster around two thousand kilograms. Reaching the ultimate strength of the triplex, they can only lift about two tons.
Justin Welans strength is expected to be around 3-4 thousand kilograms due to the dramatic change in his physique.
Under these conditions, their full strength burst under the amplification of True Strength is just over ten tons. The three people combined can lift up the ordinary Level Four Mutated Beast corpse of two to three dozen tons.
But such a full-strength burst cannot last; they would be exhausted in half an hour at most.
