Thinking about carrying it for hundreds of kilometers over mountain roads, they would have to rest for several days. But from the sound of it, they usually only take one or two days for each outbound mission.
Thats simple.
Justin Welan chuckled: The Logistics Department here includes something called anti-gravity disks that were developed by the school, powered by energy crystal fragments.
To exchange for one, you need to contribute ten points and it can offset about five tons of an items own weight. The value of five-point energy crystal fragments can be used five times under normal conditions.
And if four anti-gravity discs are used together, it can form an anti-gravity magnetic field that allows the corpse of the Mutated Beast to float off the ground, making pulling it along very easy.
Oh, 1 see, so this kind of high-tech black tech exists. Jack Clark was suddenly enlightened, thinking of the Bluebird Battle Machine that had brought them over in the afternoon.
And theres this. At this point, Justin Welan opened the wristwatch on his wrist. Immediately a blue light flickered, and a stereoscopic map popped up in front of everyone.
I see you and Freya Louise are both wearing this wristwatch, but you need to upgrade it to link up with the satellite to update the surrounding map.
Over the years, as Martial Height students explored deeper into the mountains for battles and killing, some safe routes devoid of mutated creatures have been established.
Under normal circumstances, when we go to look for Mutated Beasts, it tends to be in unexplored corner areas, but when we return after hunting Mutated Creatures, we will take those set routes.
Firstly, its safer, and secondly, we can avoid some dangerous places. Some areas are teeming with malicious True Strength and energy, or Space Distortion points
Then Justin Welan and others gave Jack Clark a lot of precautions they should takeall experiences they had gathered since they arrived here.
Though when Jack Clark and the others upgrade their wrist data tomorrow, the school will upload similar information to them.
But naturally, the details from Justin Welan and the others, with their firsthand experiences, were undoubtedly clearer and more explicit.
As Justin Welan and the others conversed, within just half a day after arriving, Jack Clark and Freya had gained a thorough understanding of various aspects of this place.
They chatted until around ten oclock in the evening. After that, everyone returned to their dormitories to rest, gather energy, and prepare for departure the next day..

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 152: Steady Growth, Magma Fire Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 152: Steady Growth, Magma Fire Tree
Translator: 549690339
Late at night, in the dormitory
After taking a bath, Jack Clark lay on his bed, pondering over what he had witnessed and heard today.
It was apparent that the situation in the Alien Beast Battlefield was very different from the school, or rather, this was the true way of cultivation and life for a cultivator.
A martial artist, battles as well!
While in school, weapons could not be taken out, sparring could only be done with classmates and limited to the school, power couldnt be displayed externally and it shouldnt affect ordinary people.
In such circumstances, everyone felt restrained and repressed, including Jack Clark.
However, after arriving at the Alien Beast Battlefield, there were countless Unique Beasts to hunt and fight, or even venture deep into the mountains in search of Heaven and Earth Treasures.
Apart from that, one could also compete with geniuses from other schools, instead of being confined to a small school.
There were too many geniuses here, with students gathered from over a dozen First-class Universities and over forty Second-tier Martial Highs, even the monster-like Jane Aiken didnt seem so dazzling anymore.
Even for him, with Attribute points to strengthen his breakthrough in the realm, there were still five people who broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven faster than him.
Of course, this only referred to the speed of cultivation breakthroughs, not combat prowess.
In terms of pure combat power within the same realm, Jack Clark was confident that he was invincible among his peers.
As for the Achievement List, Jack was also somewhat interested, wondering where his current strength would rank?
Nevertheless, these were all secondary. His primary goal was to refine the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd and battle armor into Transcendent Weapons, further enhancing his combat power.
Afterward, it would be to hunt higher-level Mutated Beasts, exchange high-order Dragon Blood as soon as possible to strengthen his Dragon Elephant Power to the sixth level or even the extreme rune level.
By then, maybe he wouldnt need to break through the Seventh Layer to condense a true martial arts phantom and manage to clash with the Eight Layer.
While pondering, Jack Clark also paid some attention to the Thunderflame Beheamoth
Night!
One hundred meters deep in the sea.
A black-red Colossal Beast, now thirty meters long, appearing even more stately, was eating. A mutated Tiger Whale over twenty meters long was caught in its claws.
Every bite of its ferocious mouth tore off a large chunk of flesh and blood from the tiger whale, spraying countless blood, rendering the surrounding sea water completely red.
The intense smell of blood attracted numerous marine organisms.
But as soon as these mutated creatures approached the hundred-meter range, they would tremble all over and panickedly flee under the invisible Dragon Might.
After gaining a significant increase in strength, the Thunder flame Behemoth had been fighting, hunting, and eating furiously for the past few days, thus its body grew rapidly, and the Evolution value also increased by several hundred points.
With the growth of its body, the strength of the Thunderflame Behemoth increased significantly, and it became even more unbridled in the ocean.
Soon enough, the hundred-ton shark whale was devoured by the Thunderflame Behemoth, only leaving behind some remains that it couldnt swallow, and most of the bones were chewed and consumed.
Feeling satisfied after eating and drinking, the Thunderflame Behemoth revealed a hint of satisfaction on its face.
The taste of todays seafood was good, containing rich energy, and the delicious taste of the flesh and meat lingered on its palate, making it crave more.
Perhaps it could focus on hunting mutated tiger whales to eat in the future.
Thinking about this, the Thunderflame Behemoth casually stretched out a huge claw, very human-like, and picked out a piece of bone stuck between its teeth, about half a meter in size.
After resting for a while in this coral reef area, the Thunderflame Behemoths tail swayed slightly, and its massive figure disappeared in the blink of an eye into the darkness, searching for the next seafood to satisfy its hunger.
Just like the land, the ocean had its ups and downs. The Thunderflame Behemoth quickly arrived in a deeper sea area.
Because of its back-and-forth hunting, it was now about 700 kilometers away from the coast, already in the deep-sea range, and there were even more powerful mutated creatures in the deep sea below.
Bang!
An explosion occurred on the sea surface, and two huge mutated creatures were fighting each other.bender
One was a tiger whale, fifteen meters long, with dark red patterns on its surface. The hot temperature emanated from its body, giving off an astonishingly strong Blood Qi aura.
The other was a Giant King Squid with a body length of over ten meters and including its tentacles, a total length of over twenty meters. The giant tentacles, as large as pythons, churned the sea water, creating a frightening sight.
Despite the Giants King Squid being longer, both sides were evenly matched in their battle.
The mutated tiger whales body was thick and massive, covered with thick black and white scale armor. Each high-speed impact directly struck its body against the giant squids, with its mouth tearing at the squid.
Once a tentacle was caught in the tiger whales mouth, the whale would roll and tear it off.
The tentacles, covered with suction cups and sharp teeth, although wrapping around the tiger whale, could only bite and shatter some scale armor on the surface without wounding the flesh.
As the intense battle between the two creatures ensued, suddenly a dark shadow emerged from the deep sea below.
Boom! The sea surface exploded like a missile, water splashing in all directions as a ferocious giant beast burst into the sky, its enormous double claws gripping the Giant King Squids body was forcefully torn apart.
Spurt! Countless blue blood rained, turning the raging sea surface deep blue, as well as the black-red ferocious giant beast holding the Giant King Squids corpse tightly.
Roar! Roar!! Are you Big Joes second brother?
With a low roar, the Thunderflame Behemoth grabbed and tore the Giant King Squids body in half and bit off a tentacle and swallowed it.
Seeing the stately Thunderflame Behemoth, the tiger whales eyes filled with excitement as it eagerly swam towards it, circling around, and called out excitedly.
Whimper! Uncle, dad, looking for you.
Compared to that third brother, this second whale tiger was much more powerful and could barely communicate with the Thunderflame Behemoth..

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 152: Steady Growth, Magma Fire Tree_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 152: Steady Growth, Magma Fire Tree_2
Translator: 549690339
What the hell is an uncle?
Roar! What, Joe found something good again? Thunderflame Beheamoths eyes lit up.
Ying Ying! I guess so.
Little Tiger Whales answer was a bit vague because they rarely went treasure hunting with Single-horned Tiger Whale, basically waiting for it to bring back good things, so they didnt know if they had found anything good.
Roar! Lead the way, lets go check it out.
Thunderflame Beheamoth was very clear about the character of Single-horned Tiger Whale, either it found something good but couldnt handle it, or it was beaten by mutated creatures and wanted to call for revenge together.
And it was very likely the latter, otherwise these little tiger whales wouldnt be searching for it everywhere.
The sea is too big, and unlike humans who have ways to communicate, finding a single beast at sea is like finding a needle in a haystack.
Fortunately, Thunderflame Beheamoth has a fixed range of activities, so there is hope that these little Tiger Whales will find it by chance.
Following behind Tiger Whale Second Brother, Thunderflame Beheamoth swam back towards the coast for more than 200 kilometers.
Then they saw Single-horned Tiger Whale in a reef shallow sea area.
At this time, as expected, it was somewhat embarrassed, its heavy scale armor damaged, and there were many injuries from bites and burns.
At this time, the wounds still havent healed, so you can imagine how much heavy injury it had.
Although this guy was seriously injured, it must be said that he was very tough, and his body had grown to a length of 38 meters at this time.
The huge body exuded heavy breath and boundless strength, and it was obvious that its strength had also increased recently.
In addition, the female Tiger Whale guarding beside it had also grown close to 30 meters in length, with heavy breath, and vaguely had signs of breaking through to the high-order level.
Damn, this guy eats too well.
Seeing this scene, even Thunderflame Beheamoth couldnt help but feel a little envious.
Having a treasure hunting talent was awesome; they spent every day in the deep sea looking for heaven and earth treasures, growing rapidly and feeding a whole family who grew fat and plump.
But if it werent for this family holding him back, Single-horned Tiger Whale might have grown even faster.
Indeed, once a man gets married, he is bound by his family, whether he is human or a mutated beast.
However, as Thunderflame Beheamoth was thinking about this, he saw Single-horned Tiger Whale suddenly become excited upon his arrival: Ying Ying Ying! Brother, youre finally here.
Roar! What have you done, why are you beaten like this again?
Thunderflame Beheamoth couldnt bear to see it like this.
Thinking back, ever since it entered the sea, it had been either fighting or hunting down mutated creatures stronger than it, and even so, it had rarely been injured.
Thinking of this, Thunderflame Beheamoth roared speechlessly.
Roar! Youre really useless, tell me, wheres the guy this time? Ill avenge you.
After the fourth evolution, there were fewer areas in the ocean that Thunderflame Beheamoth feared, and even if it couldnt win against a level 9 giant beast, it could still escape.
Of course, this escape is from far away or sensing it and running away, its not the same if it gets close, after all, thats a level 9 giant beast.
So this time Thunderflame Beheamoth was very righteous.
Of course, one reason for being so righteous was that the high-order mutated creature at least was a good meal, plus the good thing discovered bybender
Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Together, it was worth it to take action.
However, Single-horned Tiger Whale didnt know these things. Hearing that Thunderflame Beheamoth was so righteous and wanted to avenge it, its eyes filled with gratitude.
The gazes of the female killer whale and Second Little Brother towards Thunderflame Beheamoth became more intimate, and they made low, ying ying ying calls.
Tiger Whale Second Brother even approached and affectionately rubbed this uncle.
And then
Ying Ying Ying!! Ouch!
The little Tiger Whales tail flicked, and it hurriedly ran away from Thunderflame Beheamoth, which had just been hit by a thick bolt of electric lightning emitted by Thunderflame Beheamoths autonomous defense.
Roar! Little Second Brother, Ive got electricity on me, dont get too close.
Thunderflame Beheamoth reminded him.
At this time, Single-horned Tiger Whale shook its tail and stirred up a large piece of sea water: Ying Ying Ying! Brother, you dont have to help me take revenge this time, that guy has already been eaten by me.
Huh! Not bad at all, not even asking me for help this time.
Roar! Since you killed that guy, why are you looking for me?
Thunderflame Beheamoth was a bit puzzled.
Ying Ying Ying! Theres something good at that place, but its hard to get.
Okay, the problem is with the environment and terrain again.
Roar! I got it, lets go, lead the way, get some good stuff.
Ying Ying Ying! Lets go, get some good stuff.
This time they were not going to fight, so Single-horned Tiger Whale didnt wait for the injury to recover, flicked its tail and went straight ahead, followed by Thunderflame Beheamoth.
This time the two swam for several hours in the southeastern direction of the outer sea, covering a distance of about 800 kilometers to reach their destination.
Of course, mainly because Single-horned Tiger Whale was too slow; otherwise, it would have taken only two hours for Thunderflame Beheamoth to reach its destination.
Gurgle gurgle!
Far away from the sea surface, the sea water was boiling, and a lot of white steam mixed with various poisonous gases burst out, forming a gray mist that filled the sea surface within a range of more than 10 kilometers.
In the surrounding sea area, there were few living creatures. The water temperature was as high as 60 or 70 degrees Celsius. It was clear that there was an active volcano underneath, still spewing magma.
Upon arriving here, Single-horned Tiger Whale suddenly dived down. Seeing this, Thunderflame Beheamoth, who had been underwater all along, followed suit.
This time, they only dived down more than 500 meters, and a volcano mouth with a diameter of more than one hundred meters, looking like a melting furnace, appeared in front of Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Rolling scorching magma kept erupting and flowing out, then cooled by the surrounding seawater to turn into black volcanic rock, accumulating a lot of toxic gases..

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 152: Steady Growth, Magma Fire Tree_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 152: Steady Growth, Magma Fire Tree_3
Translator: 549690339
Especially in the middle area of the volcano mouth, the golden-red magma lake constantly churns and releases intense heat that causes the surrounding sea water to continuously boil.
Ying ying ying! Brother, the good stuff is inside. There was a guy who could spit fire here, and I ate him after our fight.
However, the good things are in the fire, I cant get them out.
In the magma. A look of surprise appeared in the eyes of the Thunderflame Behemoth, could it be another kind of fire resource?
Roar! Ill go and have a look!
With a low growl, the Thunderflame Behemoth swung its tail and swam towards the volcano mouth. Within a breath, it crossed hundreds of meters and reached above the magma.
This kind of magma that doesnt cool even in the deep sea, has a temperature of thousands of degrees Celsius, and even the Single-horned Tiger Whale doesnt dare to stay in contact for a long time.
However, for the Thunderflame Behemoth itself, which can emit high-temperature flames, it doesnt matter. Or rather, after coming here, it feels like its Qi Blood has become more active.
Whoosh!
The flames on the Thunderflame Behemoths body automatically burned, and even its breath released intense flames. Its huge body plunged directly into the magma lake with a bang.
Immediately, a large amount of magma splashed up, making a sizzling noise as it came into contact with boiling seawater.
After entering the magma lake, instead of feeling uncomfortable, the Thunderflame Behemoth felt a sense of relief, like a dragon in the ocean.
At this moment, all the cells in its body were crazily absorbing the heat energy that surged from all directions, and the flames on its body became more and more vigorous, its temperature was even slowly rising.
This change made the Thunderflame Behemoth pause for a moment, and it remembered that it had the ability to absorb intensely hot energy substances.
Its just that the Blazing Talent level was very low back then, resulting in a general absorption efficiency, so the Thunderflame Behemoth ignored it afterward.
Now that the Blazing Talent had undergone two evolutions, it had leaped from ordinary to intermediate level, and its ability to absorb heat energy had become much stronger.
At this moment, in the endless magma fire sea, invisible energy surged into its body one after another.
Some of this energy was refined by flame energy to enhance its talent bloodline, while some of it was transformed into biological energy for body growth, allowing its body to grow slowly.
Jack Clark was even surprised to find that the Evolution value of the Thunderflame Behemoth had increased by 1 point just by taking a half-hour bath in the magma.
After rolling in the scorching magma for half a day, the Thunderflame Behemoth remembered its main task, and its huge body involuntarily wrapped around the magma and dived down.
However, it dived only less than two hundred meters before it sensed the good things in Single-horned Tiger Whales mouth through its burning feather horns.
In the magma fire sea, the feather horns that could sense seawater fluctuations could still vaguely sense a range of tens of meters while burning in the flames.
For example, at this time, on the rock of the volcanic mountain wall, a small tree was growing. It was more than five meters tall, with blood-red crystal-clear roots resembling dragon whiskers deeply embedded in the hard-as-iron rocks.
Like red crystals and ores, the trunk, covered with scale-like patterns, stretched out branches. The tiny flame leaves slowly absorbed nutrients from the surrounding molten rock.
On the nine branches, seven transparent red fruits were formed.
Among them, four fruits were the size of a fist, with a liquid-like flame substance flowing inside. The remaining three fruits were much smaller, still immature and unclear inside.
When the Thunderflame Behemoth sensed the magma fire fruits, a devouring urge surged from within its body and its flames flared up even more intensely.
Joe, youre really lucky.
With a sigh, the Thunderflame Behemoth suppressed the urge to devour them right away, gently picked two magma fire fruits, and swam back to the volcano mouth.
Bang! Amid the splashing magma, the Thunderflame Behemoth entered the seawater. In an instant, a large area of seawater evaporated, filling the air with steam that was then compressed by the surrounding water.
Ying ying ying! Brother, you finally came out; 1 almost thought something had happened to you.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale excitedly approached.
Roar! There are four good things, we get two each, half for each beast.bender
The Thunderflame Behemoth growled, spreading its huge claws and revealing the two magma fire fruits it had picked.
Ying ying ying! OK, brother, half for each beast.
Seeing the two tiny magma fire fruits in the Thunderflame Behemoths claws, the Single-horned Tiger Whale nodded excitedly and sucked them both into its vast mouth.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth continued to roar: I feel comfortable staying in the flames and magma here, so I will live here from now on.
Roar! Also, if you find any good things and meet someone you cant beat, dont be stubborn. Come here and find me, dont be accidentally eaten by other Mutated Creatures one day.
Seeing that everyone was already on familiar terms, the Thunderflame Behemoth reminded the Single-horned Tiger Whale not to lose its life carelessly one day.
Ying ying ying! Brother, 1 got it.
With the magma fire fruit in its mouth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale nodded and excitedly turned away. It was going to take the good things back to the Little Tiger Whale to eat.
As for whether there were only four magma fire fruits under the volcano mouth, the simple-minded Single-horned Tiger Whale did not think too much.
If a good brother said there were only four, then there must be only four.
Watching the Single-horned Tiger Whale leave with the good stuff for its son, the Thunderflame Behemoth shook its head and suddenly plunged into the magma.
It was its turn now.
Once again, beneath the magma fire tree, the Thunderflame Behemoth directly picked two fire fruits and swallowed them along with the scorching magma in one gulp.
In an instant, infinite burning power exploded from its stomach, and its flesh and blood showed traces of transparent crystallization, emitting even hotter flames.
Boom! Endless golden-red flames burst out from the Thunderflame Behemoths body, spraying ten meters away, and the temperature even reached 2,000 degrees Celsius.
Under the powerful scorching shockwave, a flaming hollow was squeezed out of the 200-meter-deep magma lake, making an astonishing scene.
The effect is so strong! A look of surprise appeared in the eyes of the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Two magma fire fruits instantly increased its Blazing Talents power, not only raising the temperature of its bodys surface to 2,000 degrees, enough to melt gold and iron, but also doubling its bodys total energy.
This increase was on top of the growth from devouring the silver small fish earlier.
That is to say, at this moment, its internal Blazing Flame energy is more than six times that of when it first evolved, and it is expected to last for more than ten minutes in full-powered burst breathing.
As for how strong the breath is now, it would need to test it on a high-level mutant beast to know..

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 153 Life and Death Illusion, Rank 948
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 153 Life and Death Illusion, Rank 948
Translator: 549690339
The next morning, there was a constant influx of people in the mission hall situated at the front of the square.
One by one, cultivators clad in ordinary battle armor or even more audacious, superb transdimensional armor, walked in and out.
Most of these cultivators aura was at the Triplex Heaven and above, and quite a few at the Quadruplex Heaven. All of them carried massive weapons on their back, some even emitting a pale glow.
Obviously, those were transcendent weapons.
Thai Mountain squad is two members short for carrying the corpses of the mutated beasts. Bring your own anti-gravity disks if interested. Minimum requirement is Triplex Heaven.
God Sword Team is expanding, looking for two members at the early stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven or higher. Our target is the Level 5 mutated beast, so its best to have transcendent weapons
In the bustling crowd, Jack Clark and Freya Louise, dressed in armor, updated their personal intelligent devices on the equipment around them, led by Justin Welan.
They completed networking with the Sky Base Satellite and updated the map.
After all this was sorted out, they came to the front door of the mission hall, where Zac Lyons and others, clad in armor and carrying weapons and supplies in their backpacks, were already waiting.
Justin Welan waved his hand: Jack, well leave first, well get in touch when were back.
Jack Clark nodded: Go ahead, be careful, especially take care of Freya, her close combat defense ability is too weak, although she has a high single attack power.
Marcus Lee slapped his chest and assured, Dont worry, Jack, as long as were around, she wont get hurt at all. Its a mans promise.
Yes, dont worry, Mullen Weisz nodded in agreement.
Zac Lyons nodded, Thats it, dont underestimate us, the Chaotic God squad. We are strong among the teams in the Triplex Heaven. We always defeat Level 4 mutated beasts without any injuries.
Why do 1 feel that according to you all, I have absolutely no close combat abilities?
Meanwhile, the girl carrying a sniper rifleloaded with clips and miniature bombs strung across her waist and backclicked her high-power pistol and nestled it into her thigh armor, creating a heroic image.
Jack Clark smiled and shook his head, Its not the same, youre a shooter, bound to be more fragile than these meat shields or warriors. They should stand up when theres danger.
After some casual conversation, they waved goodbye to Jack and walked away.
No sooner had the six members of the team left than Carney Lee, carrying a heavy sword, approached Jack Clark and, standing on the stairs, sighed: After coming here, I feel like a dog among the Triplex Heaven.
Jack Clark nodded, No need to feel that. Here, the Triplex Heaven is just a foot soldier.
Carney Lee was at a loss for words: Jack, 1 was just lamenting. You really didnt need to be that direct.
Jack Clark laughed: Its not to bring you down, but a fact, but compared to them, 1 see more potential in you.
Think about it, they spent two or even three years to reach the Triplex Heaven, and you caught up just with a semester of cultivation. Isnt that a greater potential?
So buck up, young man.
Now that sounds human. Goodbye, I am also about to leave. Saying that, Carney Lee waved at Jack Clark and marched towards the exit of the base.
The first-grade students who came here early were all geniuses, and every genius had their pride. They had limited good relationships, and most of them preferred to be loners.
Phew! Jack Clark blew out a sigh of air, ready to leave.
But at this very moment, a large screen at the side of the square nearby lit up.
Jane Aiken, with the cultivation of the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, reverse defeating The Lans Martial Arts Baihong. Her Sword Intent is Life and Death Illusion, offensive and unmatched, the current ranking on the Achievement list is 948.
All of a sudden, Jack Clarks steps faltered, surprise gleaming in his eyes as he, along with other students, looked up at the striking red characters on the big screen.
Defying a stronger genius with the cultivation of the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, the Sword Intent is Life and Death Illusion, offensive and unmatched!
Impressive! She seems to be the first freshman to make it within the top 1000 on the achievement list, and she also seems to be from our South Sky Martial Height!
She is from our South Sky Martial Height, ranked 16th on the First-grade Talent Rankings.
Yikes! These new students really are incredible. 1 get the feeling these freshmen are even more monstrous than the last batch.
Not just you, 1 have that feeling too. So, we should work hard, otherwise us old fellows will soon be left in the dust.
Work hard? We are only at the late period of the Triplex Heaven, we are already left in the dust.
Amid the whisperings of the seniors, Jack Clark wore a subtle smile. No wonder she was the girl who continued to dazzle everyone since high school.
She broke late in her cultivation a few days ago, now, she made a strong comeback, becoming the first to kill into the top 1000 on the achievement list.
There were three routes going down the mountain of the South Sky Martial Height Base, all of which were eight-lane cement roads with a width of tens of meters. The roads were sturdy enough for a vehicle weight of 100 tons and led in three different directions.
Aside from these, there were many defensive buildings around. The gun barrels protruding from the Weapon Fortress above were as thick as 0.5 meters, and as long as ten plus meters, even more fearsome than those destroyers ship guns.
However, looking at the surroundings, they didnt seem to have been used much.bender
At this time, figures were constantly soaring over the three major roads, covering dozens of meters in the blink of an eye. Among them was Jack Clark.
Although the base also had trucks, off-road vehicles, and other modern facilities, students like them who had chosen the freedom to move around, entering the mountains for practice, none of them chose to rent.
Because ten kilometers out of the base, vehicles are useless. There are no roads.
In a moment, Jack Clark rushed down from the mountain and a large stretch of evenly flat rice fields, orchards came into view.
In these rice fields and orchards, some workers were operating construction machinery and working, filled with the atmosphere of rural farming and industrialized cultivation..

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 153 Life and Death Illusion, Rank 948_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 153 Life and Death Illusion, Rank 948_2
Translator: 549690339
But the problem is that this place is crawling with Mutated Beasts on the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Even Jack Clark couldnt help but pause at this scene, and then continued to fly past.
These are the staff specially recruited by the Martial Height school, who sign contracts and are responsible for cultivating the agricultural land around the base, planting rice and other crops.
After all, the school base has a large population of several hundred for most of the year, consuming a lot of food daily. In addition to Mutated Beast Meat, ordinary rice, vegetables, and fruits are also indispensable.
Since this place is hundreds of kilometers apart from the large base in the rear, and there are numerous ups and downs of mountain ranges in between, the transportation is troublesome. Therefore, it has given rise to the profession of farming on the Alien Beast Battlefield, which is self-sufficient.
The Heavenly Energy is rich here, the land is fertile, and rice and other crops not only mature three times a year but also have higher yields and contain more nutrients.
Therefore, it only takes cultivating the land in a 10-kilometer range around the base of the mountain to maintain the daily consumption of South Sky Martial Height Base.
Moreover, it is not just these school bases; there are also large-scale cultivation safe zones in those Military Bases, as well as mineral mining and guarding of special resources.
In addition, there are hundreds of thousands of ordinary Mutated Beasts being raised.
Over the years, the food and Mutated Beast Meat produced here have been sold back in large quantities to the outside world.
Therefore, the demand for ordinary workers in the Alien Beast Battlefield is huge, and a large number of personnel are recruited every year for ordinary jobs, which offer extremely high salaries.
Of course, high pay means high risk, as this is the Sealed Mountain Range swarming with mutated creatures.
Even with students patrolling the base daily and soldiers patrolling around the military base, there are still Mutated Beasts wandering around, causing many ordinary workers to be killed or injured every year.bender
However, despite this, the jobs here are still in high demand, and connections are required to get in.
Because the rich energy environment inside is beneficial to their offspring, their physiques will slowly change after living here for a long term, and they may have a cultivation physique one day.
But these were too far from Jack Clark, so he just glanced over them and didnt pay much attention.
Under Jack Clarks ordinary speed of 100 meters per second, the 10-kilometer distance was quickly covered in two minutes, and his figure soon vanished deep into the mountain forest.
After Jack Clark underwent his Fourth Evolution, not only did his strength attribute break through to 1,000 points, but his physique also reached a terrifying level of over 950, and his agility attribute reached more than 800.
Jack Clark tested before that even with just his physical strength alone, he could reach a subsonic speed of more than 200 meters per second at his full strength.
And once he activated the Dragon Elephant True Strength, his strength could skyrocket several times, allowing him to break through the sound barrier and reach supersonic speed instantly, an incredibly fast pace.
So for him, one second for every 100 meters was like an ordinary persons casual walking speed, with no consumption at all during normal traveling.
This is also the reason why he didnt plan to join a team. There was no way around it since the fundamental attributes of both sides were too different, and Justin Welan and others couldnt keep up with him anymore.
Among the steep mountains and valleys, a dark red figure flashed rapidly.
Suddenly, Jack Clarks right hand reached out, and the black and red Dragon Elephant True Strength circulated on his palm, instantly grabbing a large shadow that pounced from the side.
This was a nine-meter-long venomous python with a body as thick as a thigh and pitch-black all over.
Before allowing the ferocious python to struggle, Jack Clark suddenly exerted force on his hand, and with a bang, its head was crushed.
Immediately, countless flesh and blood exploded and were blocked by the body-protecting True Power around Jack Clarks body, and he casually threw the wildly writhing corpse on the ground.
The figure of Jack Clark, who had casually crushed a Level Two Variant Beast, disappeared in an instant.
The goal he had set for this outing was Level 4 or higher Mutated Beasts, preferably Level 5. He had no interest in those low-level Mutated Beasts worth just a few contribution points.
Or rather, he didnt look down on them, but he didnt have time to take them with him.
As for the requirement that the corpses must be brought back to exchange for contributions, Jack Clark was also somewhat annoyed.
If only he could gain experience like in a game without having to deal with the corpses, he could easily earn 800 or even 1,000 points a day with his current strength.
Of course, that could only be wishful thinking.
After all, neither the school nor the official were running a charity, and the corpses of Mutated Beasts could be brought back to refine Essence Blood, flesh, scale armor, fur, and other materials.
Boom!
Jack Clark, who had just charged out ten kilometers, slapped his hand, and in an instant, the air exploded, causing the head of a pouncing leopard to burst with a loud noise, killed by a single palm strike.
The six-meter-long body slammed on the ground with a thud and rolled several times before stopping.
Countless blood sprayed from the neck, staining the surrounding weeds and ground red.
After glancing at the Mutated Beasts corpse, Jack Clarks expression remained calm, and his figure flashed as he continued to sprint toward the depths of the mountain range.
In less than half an hour, Jack Clark had already run more than 100 kilometers, and along the way, he had casually killed eight low-level Mutated Beasts and more than ten ordinary Mutated Creatures.
This was still the case where he maintained his movement speed of 100 meters per second and restrained his aura. If he moved slower, he would encounter more attacks.
And restraining his aura didnt mean invisibility. Unless he hid in the dark completely motionless, he would still be spotted by Mutated Creatures.
This is the Alien Beast Battlefield. Once out of the bases range, there are Mutated Creatures everywhere outside. A slight negligence could result in accidents and death under the sneak attack of Mutated Creatures.
After all, cultivators of the Third and Fourth Layers couldnt surround themselves with a force field and maintain their True Power to guard their bodies at all times.
And as long as they are humans, there will always be moments of carelessness, which is one of the reasons for the casualties of students who cultivate every year..

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 153 Life and Death Illusion, Rank 948_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 153 Life and Death Illusion, Rank 948_3
Translator: 54969
Next, Jack Clark crossed over twenty mountain peaks in one breath, then burst out over three hundred kilometers ahead to a cliff.
The raging wind whistled between the cliff side, and the width reached a hundred meters.
While running, Jack took a deep breath, his leg muscles swelling slightly, and in an instant, with a forceful step, the rocks underneath him exploded and he suddenly shot out.
Whoosh!
Jack turned into a black-red radiance, and in an instant, he crossed a hundred meters, falling on rhe opposite side of the cliff and then leaped off the mountain peak with several flashes.
Below was a ninety-degree inclined ridge, and a thousand meters downwards it was the mountainside where trees and plants could be found.
Boom! The heavy battle boots crushed the rocks, and Jack slid down quickly, like an extreme sports player, with sparks flying and rocks exploding along the way.
Roar!
At this moment, a furious roar suddenly sounded from the opposite mountain peak, the sound deafening. Countless birds were startled and flew up, and the wild animals ran.
Jacks eyes lit up instantly.
Having slid down the mountainside, he gripped the cliff with his hand, and with a burst of strength, he shot out, turning into an afterimage across the ridge.
In a valley tens of kilometers away, a twenty-meter-long and fifteen-meter-tall mountain giant bear was roaring.
At its feet lay a twelve-meter-long corpse of a giant deer, most of its flesh and blood gnawed and eaten away.
At that moment, the bears mouth and neck were blood-red, its body shining with yellow light, and it exuded a violent, ferocious and formidable aura.
Just then, a black and red figure appeared on the distant mountain.
Level 5, no, its Level 4 Peak/
Looking at the giant mutated beast that stood nearly twenty-three meters tall, almost eight stories high, Jacks eyes flashed with excitement.
Normally, a Level 4 Mutated Beast would fetch an official recovery price of 50 contribution points as a base, with the specific amount depending on the size, level, and intactness of the corpse.
For this type of mountain giant bear, which was at the peak of Level 4 and had an enormous size, the price would be even higher, estimated to be around seventy points.
Most importantly, this mutated beast was at the peak of Level 4, and its body might contain a Life Crystal. The price of a single Level 4 Crystal would be even more expensive than that of the mutated beasts corpse.
With this thought in mind, Jack flipped his hand, and the 3.6-meter-long Eight Desolate Battle Halberd appeared in his grasp.
Boom!
A powerful aura burst from Jack as he turned into a black shadow and swooped down the mountain, followed by a piercing sonic boom.
As Jack unscrupulously released his aura, the mountain giant bear suddenly raised its head, showing its ferocious glare and bellowed out a roar.
Roar! With a loud thud, the bears four limbs hit the ground, and its huge body charged towards Jack with a resounding rumble.
Judging by the fact that this little black dot dared to intrude into its territory and provoke it, it must be courting death.
The distance of several kilometers between the two parties disappeared in a flash, and with a blink of an eye, Jack arrived within a hundred meters of the mountain giant bear.
Roar! The running mountain giant bear suddenly stood up, and a circle of yellow light burst out from its body. Its bear fur exploded, and an unparalleled violent force erupted.
Boom!
The bears gigantic double claws swatted down, covering a ten-meter radius. The ferocious and overbearing power generated white air-waves spreading outwards, the scene astonishing.
At the same time, with a sweep of yellow light, the ground beneath Jack suddenly shattered, and dozens of rock spikes, five meters long and half a meter thick, burst out over a twenty-meter area.
Heaven and earth seemed to be sealed off at that moment.
Boom!
Just then, a circular black and red halberd light swept across, exploding the hard iron-like rock spikes wherever it went, and immediately Jacks figure disappeared.
Boom!
The very instant that Jack disappeared, the giant bear paw fell, instantly shattering the earth covering more than twenty meters. Numerous dirt and debris flew out under the violently erupting force.
The substantial yellow power created a shockwave, raising a raging wind that surged a hundred meters away, and the scene was terrifying.At the moment the giant bear shattered the ground, Jack Clark had already leaped hundreds of meters into the air. Black and crimson radiance surrounded his battle halberd like a flame, threatening and sharp.
Boom!
A horrifying aura that seemed both divine and demonic erupted from Jacks body. A vast expanse of black and red light sparkled ail around him, and the wails of vengeful spirits could be faintly heard in the void.
Eight Desolate Refining Hell, Ghost Wailing Divine Howl!
Boom!
In an instant, the black and red light-entwined halberd flew through the sky, like a thread of black-red pirefining falling from the heavens, radiating a terrifying force that caused the mountain giant bears hair to stand on end.
At that moment, the world seemed to change colors in the eyes of the mutated beast as an intense aura of death approached it head-on.
Roar!
In its panic and fury, the giant bears muscles swelled, and the yellow light on its body grew even thicker. Its enormous double claws swung up in an attempt to block the terrifying strike.
Boom!
As the two collided, the black-red light-entwined battle halberd instantly ripped through the thick protective energy on the bears paw, followed immediately by its massive paw.
Bang! Under the power that was unmatched and overbearing, the massive bears paw was directly shattered and exploded, with countless flesh and blood sprinkling in mid -air.
Without losing momentum, the black halberd, carrying a destructive radiance, slashed down and thunderously smashed onto the roaring, snapping bear s mouth.
Boom!
The sharp, overbearing black-red halberd skill exploded, instantly tearing apart the protective energy on rhe surface of the mountain giant bear s body, shattering its huge mouth and sharp fanged teeth with the explosive Dragon Elephant True Strength.
Growl!!
With half of its face gone and its skull covered in deep wounds revealing the bone beneath, the mountain giant bear let out a mournful wail, blood spurted out in great amounts.
Experiencing intense pain and the fear of death, the mutated beast abruptly turned around, attempting to flee using its three remaining limbs.
But Jack Clark, who had just burst one of its paws and half of its face with a single blow, transformed into a black-red light as he landed, colliding with the air and shooting out like an explosion.
In the blink of an eye, Jack appeared below the mountain giant bears body, leaped up while the halberd in his hand emitted a black-red radiance, and horizontally swept through its neck.
Boom!
The mountain giant bear, which had just dashed a few dozen meters, crashed to the ground with a loud thud, no longer moving after rolling once. Fresh blood gushed out from the two dozen meters long wound on its neck, like a fountain.
With just two moves in a face-to-face encounter, Jack had slain this Level 4 Peak mutated beast under his halberd.
The terror of his combat prowess far surpassed the limits of the Fourth Layer Heaven Boundary, something that even ordinary Fifth Layer Heaven cultivators would not be able to achieve.
Or rather, even an ordinary initial stage Fifth Layer Heaven cultivator might not be able to kill this Level 4 Peak giant bear.
Jack Clark stood beside the enormous mutated beast s corpse, holding his halberd, his expression cold and indifferent. Black and red light circulated around him, his aura majestic, giving off a heavy, oppressive feeling.
As Jack prepared to put away his weapon and drag the mountain giant bears corpse back, he faintly heard peoples voices in the distance.
Christopher Raven, the mutated beast is just up ahead. Hurry up!
Christopher Raven.
This somewhat familiar name made Jack pause, as if he had seen it somewhere before.
As he thought about it, the Achievement List unconsciously appeared in his mind.
Because of Jane Aiken, Jack had glanced at the Achievement List when he left, looking at her ranking position, and it seemed that this person named Christopher Raven was right behind her.
Ranked 949!
Could it be such a coincidence? Jacks eyes revealed a hint of excitement and anticipation as he slowly turned his head to look into the distance.
If this person were indeed that Christopher Raven, perhaps he could challenge him and see how strong these geniuses in the late period of the Fourth Layer Heaven really were.bender
However, the other party might not accept his challenge easily.
With that in mind, Jacks eyes fell on the mountain giant bears corpse lying next to him..

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 154: The Humble Freshman, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 154: The Humble Freshman, The
Genius Senior who was Countered
Translator: 549690339
When Jack Clark heard the roar of the Mountain Giant Bear up ahead, another group of people in a different direction also heard the beasts roar.
Five sophomores from Dragon Mountain Martial Height stood on a hillside.
Each individual was dressed in battle armor, the leaders armor even more extravagant, remelted from the scales of an unknown golden creature, emitting a halo of light.
Clearly, it was a piece of extraordinary battle armor, possessing a defensive ability far superior to ordinary battle armor.
The stout young man at the front looked into the distance, his eyes slightly squinting: The roar shakes the mountain and the aura is magnificent. That mutated beast must be at least Level 4, probably at a Level 4 Late Stage.
Having slain many mutated beasts, Christopher Raven estimated the level of this mutated beast through the powerful force embodied in its roar.
A female student in a red battle armor wore a smile: I didnt expect today to be so lucky. We have encountered a Level 4 Mutated Beast before we even left the Nine Rings Mountain Range.
The Nine Rings Mountain Range extends for over a thousand kilometers horizontally, containing fifty-nine Martial Height bases, making the nearby bases just tens of kilometers apart.
Plus, with tens of thousands of geniuses continuing to hunt deep into the mountains, the high-level mutated beasts in the Nine Rings Mountain Range were becoming increasingly rare.
Within a two hundred kilometer radius of the base, there were only ordinary mutated creatures of Level 1 and 2. Only after going three to four hundred kilometers deep into the Nine Rings Mountain Range could one encounter Level 3 Mutated Beasts.
In this area, Level 4 Mutated Beasts were rather scarce. To find mutated creatures above Level 5, one would have to venture further into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
At the same time, many mutated beasts had become more cunning and cautious due to the humans continuous hunting over the years.
High-level mutated beasts like this that roar to declare their territory are rare, usually, such creatures have migrated over from other places.
Once they discover that the living environment here is good, the mutated beasts roar to declare their territory, and then
The Martial Height geniuses who venture out for practice will be attracted.
Thinking of this, the leading Christopher Raven spoke in a low voice: We should go and check quickly, otherwise, that mutated beast might be taken away by others.
Yes, lets go.
The other four nodded and followed Christopher down the mountain in a flash.
Of the five, the leading Christopher Raven had the strongest aura, his realm nearing the peak of the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, followed by two in the Mid-stage Fourth Layer Heaven, and two in the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven.
As a result, they didnt consider the mutant beast, suspected to be a Late Stage Level 4 beast, a challenge.
As sophomores at Dragon Mountain Martial Height, everyone had weapons that were already crafted into transcendent implements, and they had also cultivated more than two Secret Skills.bender
Moreover, having cultivated Advanced Skills and battle techniques for two years, their combat strength could at least exceed one small realm.
Not to mention the well-known Christopher Raven on the Achievement List. A month ago, he single-handedly killed a Late Stage Level 4 mutant beast with a trace of a king-level bloodline.
He even used the beasts heart scale along with some Transcendent Materials to make a set of extraordinary armor.
However, just as they dashed a few kilometers down the hillside, the roar and screams of the mutated beast echoed from up ahead, prompting their expressions to change slightly.
Damn it, someone beat us to it.
Quick, lets go and check!
Within seconds, the fastest girl, Una Tennat, broke through the forests, her speed wrapping her like a blue, light, lingering echo. She yelled back, Christopher, the mutant beast is right in front, hurry up.
As she spoke, her body was surrounded by the sound of the wind, turning into a blue wind shadow and shooting up the rock, crossing hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye.
Yet when she reached the top of the hill, her body couldnt help but stop.
Down in the valley, the twenty-meter-long body of the Mountain Giant Bear lay dead and quiet, its colossal skull and bear paw torn apart and bloody.
The bright red blood stained the ground around it.
Next to the corpse of the mutated beast, a figure in ordinary dark red armor stood with a halberd, a black-red radiance flowing over him, and a heavy aura emitting off of him.
Just as she appeared on the hillside, the figure looked up at her.
Whats wrong, Una?
As Christopher spoke, he too reached the top of the hill, followed by the other three behind him, then they all saw the Mountain Giant Bear below, slain.
Indeed, someone beat us to it, Christopher sighed with a hint of regret.
Culver Douglas, another sophomore at the middle stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven, looked solemn: Where is this person from? Hes very strong. He managed to kill this mutated beast so quickly.
Indeed, very strong, another person agreed.
From the time they heard the Mountain Giant Bear declare its territory through a roar, until they traveled ten kilometers at top speed, it was only a minute or two.
The fact that the other party was able to slay it in such a short time made a considerable impression. Most importantly, the other party also had the aura of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Christopher spoke in a deep voice: The nearest in this direction is South Sky Martial Height, followed by Lans Martial Arts. It must be one of the two.
Lets go, this mutated beast already belongs to someone else. Saying so, the group prepared to leave.
As for robbing, this is a rare occurrence in the Alien Beast Battlefield.
One reason is that these geniuses all have their pride; it wouldnt sound good if word spread that they stole other peoples spoils.
The second reason is that there are over a hundred satellites watching from above, and the school also has rules against killing classmates.
Although the satellites are not always functioning effectively, so far, no one has killed others over a one to two hundred contribution points. Theres even less need to injure others to steal the corpse of a mutated beast.
Its easy to make deadly enemies this way.
Who knows if a genius who has had their spoils stolen would explode in cultivation one day, surpass, and then specifically inflict heavy injuries or even kill to avenge?

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 154: The Humble Freshman, The Genius Senior who was Countered_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 154: The Humble Freshman, The Genius Senior who was Countered_2
Translator: 549690339
Therefore, currently, the overall cultivation atmosphere in East Summer Martial Heights is relatively clean1 .
There isnt that sort of dismal cruelty of a dark society where either you target me, or I suppress you.
However, no one is perfect, and some people are just born with a dark and wicked nature.
So upon entering a thousand kilometers deep into the mountain ranges, without satellite surveillance, discovering resources poses danger not only from powerful mutated creatures but also from those behind you.
At that moment, from the valley below, Jack Clark suddenly said, Dragon Mountain Martial Height, Christopher Raven!?
His voice was not very loud, but the calm sound echoed throughout the valley, making Christopher Raven and his group of five come to a halt.
Looking back at Jack Clark, who was miles away, Christopher Raven said aloud, Thats correct, I am Christopher Raven from Dragon Mountain. I wonder which school this classmate is from?
As expected, it was him.
Jacks eyes revealed a hint of excitement, and he politely said, South Sky Martial Height, Jack Clark. Raven, I have a proposal, 1 dont know if youre interested?
What proposal? Although it was an inquiry, Christopher Raven already had a general idea of the other partys intention.
Jack Clark calmly said, I want to have a contest with you, with this Level 4 Peak Mutated Beast as a bet. If I lose, this mutated beast and any possible Life Crystals inside will be yours.
Una Tennat shook her head, As expected, another guy wanting to step on Christopher Raven to success.
After Christopher Raven entered the top thousand in the Battle Record Ranking last week, some Fourth Layer Heaven classmates from Dragon Mountain Military Base had challenged him.
After all, compared to accumulated points from slowly killing mutated beasts, nothing was faster than directly defeating Christopher Raven and entering the Battle Record Rankings.
Its just that those classmates were all defeated by Christopher Raven, and they even lost a lot of bets in the process.
Culver Douglas looked a bit serious, I didnt expect this mutated beast to be Level 4 Peak; the opponents strength is somewhat strong.
He glanced at Christopher Raven and advised, Raven, just drop it. Its not necessary to have a contest with him for a Level 4 Peak Mutated Beast. Indeed. The other three nodded as well.
For these geniuses, a ranking on the Achievement List was much more valuable than tens or hundreds of Contribution Points or, in other words, was more prestigious.
However, Christopher Raven laughed lightly, Ive decided to accept his challenge.
What! The other four were shocked.
Christopher Raven slowly said, I already know who this person is. South Sky Martial Height, Jack Clark. Dont you think this name sounds familiar?
After Christopher Ravens reminder, Una Tennat was slightly stunned and then blurted out, The sixth-ranked in the first-grade talent list?
Christopher Raven nodded, Thats right, its him.
When they returned to Dragon Mountain Base last night, it was quite late, and they didnt see the red large characters flashing on the bases large screen.
However, when they went to the cafeteria for dinner later, they also heard about a first-year student who had directly climbed to the sixth place on the talent list from other students.
Its actually him.
Wearing red battle armor, Buena Raven narrowed her eyes, It seems this freshman wants to follow the footsteps of that Jane Aiken from this morning and get on the Achievement List by Reverse Defeating you.
Daring to challenge you, this freshmans strength must be strong, and his ranking is much higher than that of the freshman this morning. We shouldnt underestimate him.bender
Christopher Raven nodded, I know, but Im also somewhat interested in him. This is a challenge from a new student to a senior, and Im not weak, am I? Thats true. The other three nodded slightly.
As geniuses who had cultivated for an additional year and spent more than half a year in the Alien Beast Battlefield, their accumulation was far beyond what Jack Clark, a new student who had only cultivated for half a year, could compare.
In particular, Christopher Ravens cultivation had reached the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, which was two small realms higher than Jack Clark.
Moreover, with his powerful extraordinary battle armor and transcendent weapon, both his defense and attack had been enhanced to the extreme.
Apart from that, Christopher Raven had also spent nearly a thousand Contribution Points, cultivating three secret skills to increase strength, speed, and Sword Qi Amplification to a small degree of success.
Therefore, even though he was only at Late Fourth Layer Heaven, his battle prowess had already surpassed the Fifth Layer Heaven.
If it werent for the limitations of his realm, he would have already killed his way into the top 500 of the Battle Record Ranking.
As for this new student who had broken through to the Fourth Layer Heaven in just one semester, although these seniors envied his cultivation speed, they still needed to compete to know if he could win against Christopher Raven.
Moreover, in a short span of one semester, he might not even have had the time to learn secret skills. Looking at the weapon in his hand, it also seemed to be an ordinary alloy weapon. Therefore, Christopher Ravens chances of winning were not small.
Confidence appeared on Christopher Ravens face, Why refuse free Contribution Points and Life Crystals when they are being handed to us? Lets go and meet this genius from South Sky Martial Height.
With that, the five of them leaped down from the hillside and swiftly crossed the forest in a few flashes to appear in the valley.
Looking at the tall figure a dozen meters away, Christopher Raven said solemnly, Jack Clark, Ill ask you one more time, are you sure you want to fight me?
Im currently at the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, have practiced three secret skills, and own extraordinary battle armor and a transcendent weapon. If you lose, dont say 1 took advantage of you.
Raven was very open and upright, revealing all his advantages.
Senior Raven is joking. I proposed this challenge, so if I lose, its just because my skills are inferior.
Jack Clark humbly said, I just arrived at the Alien Beast Battlefield and am unfamiliar with everything here. 1 happened to meet Senior Raven today, so I wanted to witness the strength of an upper-class genius.
I want to see how big the gap between us is so that I can work even harder to catch up afterward.
Jack Clarks attitude surprised Christopher Raven and the others. They had thought that a genius who challenged others the moment they met would be very arrogant, but they didnt expect him to be so humble..

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 154: The Humble Freshman, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 154: The Humble Freshman, The
Genius Senior who was Countered }
Translator: 549690339
Seeing this, Christopher Raven smiled and nodded, Alright, regardless of winning or losing today, Ill consider you a friend. Youre welcome to visit Dragon Mountain Base when youre free.
Jack Clark smiled back, Sure, Ill definitely visit the Dragon Mountain Base whenever 1 have the chance.
After saying that, the atmosphere between the two suddenly became solemn. Both tapped on their wrists to pull up a virtual touch screen and clicked on location lock.
In an instant, at an altitude of tens of thousands of meters above, a high-definition satellite camera adjusted slightly to capture the events happening in the valley below.
Of course, this satellite could only capture the general images of the two, merely serving as evidence for this challenge.
Upon locking their locations, Jack Clark and Christopher Ravens detailed information was simultaneously transferred to the supercomputer, setting them in competition mode.
If Jack Clark won, he would replace Christopher Ravens ranking; if he lost, nothing would happen.
Seeing this, the expressions of Una Tennat and the others became serious, and they retreated a distance away from the battlefield.
Boom!
Christopher Raven erupted in powerful golden True Power, causing the patterns on his golden scale armor to light up one by one. Under the golden light, a transparent battle armor around five centimeters thick formed.
Under the protection of this double layer, a heavy, unyielding aura permeated the surroundings, and the powerful presence compressed the surrounding air, turning it into a strong wind that blew off the dust within several meters of its range.
Christopher Raven then produced a three-meter-long, door-width black combat knife in his hand, which also emitted a faint golden light and a sharp breath.
As a first-year genius, Christopher Raven had also exchanged for the Sumeru Bracelet.
Junior Clark, my True Martial skill is called Eight-Armed Vajra. The corresponding Advanced Combat Skill is Eight-Armed Wheel Slash, focused on powerful and overbearing chopping. Be careful.
Thank you for the reminder, Senior. My cultivation is Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and the combat skill is Eight Desolate Refining Hell, which also focuses on a dominating and heavy style. In response, Jack Clarks body exploded with a surge of black and red True Power.
Boom!
Under the oppressive compression of this substantive force, the air around Jack Clark solidified, and the ground within three meters of his feet sank an inch.
Facing Christopher Raven, a senior genius at the Fourth Layer Heaven mid-stage, Jack Clark didnt dare to underestimate him. With the eruption of his Dragon Elephant True Strength, his entire muscle bulged, giving an overwhelming sense.
Especially the invisible, ferocious Dragon Might, which made him look like an awakened dragon beast, whether it was from absorbing high-order dragon essence blood or being tainted by his Avatar Evolution.
The invisible Dragon Might emanating from him made Christopher Raven and the others hold their breath.
How is this possible? Isnt he just an early stage Fourth Layer Heaven freshman? Una Tennat, who had retreated a hundred meters, turned slightly pale in surprise, watching Jack Clark from afar.
As a senior student at the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven, she was actually frightened by the aura emanating from Jack Clark.
Suddenly, both Jack Clark and Christopher Raven moved at the same time, causing the dirt beneath their feet to explode. In an instant, they both transformed into a black-red and golden light, shooting out towards each other.
Clang!
The Eight Desolate Battle Halberd instantly clashed with the Golden War Saber, with the black and red halberd aura entwined around the golden sword energy, momentarily stiffening before exploding like high explosives.
Boom! In an instant, the whole surrounding area shook as a black and golden radiance exploded outward. The violent eruption of True Power compressed the air, creating a circle of white shockwave sweeping through a range of tens of meters.
In the midst of the raging wind, Jack Clark stood tall and unmoving, heavy like a mountain, resembling a powerful Dragon Elephant.
On the other side, Christopher Ravens dazzling golden light flickered, the massive force from the halberd only caused him to sway slightly, as it was blocked by his golden True Power.
This strike from both sides was merely a test, so neither of them avoided it.
Feeling the heavy, dominating force from his opponent, Christopher Raven showed a look of excitement.
Previously, he had worried that this first-year genius would lack depth, and feared that he might accidentally injure his opponent if he went too far. Judging by his opponents strength now, his worries were unwarranted.bender
On the other hand, Jack Clark was also somewhat surprised.
He didnt expect that Christopher Raven would only sway under the force of his three-quarters strength strike. This remarkable combination of Transcendent battle armor and cultivation methods seemed to provide excellent defense.
In that case, Jack Clark could afford to increase his power a little..

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 155: Unrivaled, Manifesting Holiness Once Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 155: Unrivaled, Manifesting Holiness Once Again
Translator: 549690339
It seemed that after an evenly matched clash, Christopher Raven excitedly said, “Junior Clark, watch out, I’m getting serious now.”
As he spoke, the golden sword energy on Christopher’s combat knife suddenly exploded, and under the powerful counter-shock, he was sent flying ten meters backward. Then, he gripped his knife in both hands and took on the posture of charging.
Jack Clark, who was still standing in his original position, held his halberd and spoke in a deep voice: “Come.”
“Eight Rotation!”
In an instant, Christopher turned into a golden afterimage as he burst forth, with the giant combat knife in his hand and an extremely sharp meter-long golden sword energy.
Wherever it passed, the air was almost split in a three-meter wide, ten-meter long pitch-black crack, an illusion created by the instantaneous annihilation of the air.
However powerful or fast Christopher’s attacks were, Jack still managed to accurately block them with a horizontal swing of his war halberd.
Boom! The air-splitting combat knife clashed with the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd once again, creating an even more terrifying impact.
A cultivator’s battle was not only a simple hack or slash, but also involved powerful True Martial techniques.
In the violent impact created by the explosion of Dragon Elephant True Strength, Christopher’s combat knife retreated at the touch, and his figure flashed, turning into three identical figures all appearing around Jack.
The three Christophers all swung their combat knives together, with sword energy flashing above, like golden lights tearing everything apart, slashing towards Jack.
Phantom or mirage! Jack was unmoved by the sight, his war halberd swept casually along the direction of his eyesight, easily blocking the combat knife slashing from the left side with the edge of his weapon.
Boom! In an instant, the violent explosion of True Strength created a shockwave, turning into raging wind and scattering the other two figures.
Great!” said Christopher, excited to see that his Phantom Chain Slash was seen through, while Jack hardly displayed any power and remained calm.
Clang clang clang! The speed of Christopher, who had activated his secret speed technique, was astonishing. His steps were similar to the eight trigrams positioning method, and with a series of golden afterimages, he tirelessly attacked Jack.
In his hands, the light of the mighty knife became like lightning at subsonic speeds.
But Jack was not weak, remaining standing still and having his war halberd engrossed in a black-red halberd skill, practicing various moves like stabbing, chopping, sweeping, slashing, and locking, blocking all attacks.
No one could tell that he had only practiced halberd skills for a few days; he looked more like a halberd skill expert with ten years of experience.
Jack’s attack speed was even faster with the halberd in his hand, almost reaching the speed of sound at close range, causing a sonic boom every time he swung.
That was the sound of wind and thunder created by the explosion of the air.
Every time the golden sword light and black-red halberd skill clashed, a powerful impact would burst forth with True Strength overflowing and the wind howling.
Sometimes a golden sword energy would fall to the ground, tearing the earth into a crack several meters long, while the black-red halberd skill would create explosions on the ground.
In just a moment, the flying sand and stones within tens of meters resembled the fury of two giant beasts.
With such a display, Una and her group’s faces turned solemn from afar.
But what they didn’t know was that Jack hadn’t unleashed much power; he was observing the strengths and weaknesses of the power infused with Dragon Elephant’s true strength, body techniques, and battle skills in the late Advanced Skill stage.
He wasn’t challenging them for the sake of rankings, but to gauge his own strength against Christopher, a Second Grade genius, and make sure he knew both himself and his opponents.
At that moment, Jack, who had been on the defensive, suddenly let out a roar. His arm muscles instantly bulged, and a terrifying burst of power exploded as the battle halberd swept.
Boom!
A raging wind howled as the smoke and dust within tens of meters rolled over, instantly dissipating under the black-red ring of pirefining wind. At the same time, a golden figure was blasted outwards.
Boom! Christopher Raven, who was hit by Jack’s halberd and flew tens of meters, landed and involuntarily took a few more steps back before stopping.
“Such powerful strength.”
Looking at Jack Clark, who was still standing with the war halberd and had not moved from the center of the broken ground, Christopher took a deep breath and his face turned serious.
From the initial contempt, to the excitement after the first move test, and then to the calm after exchanging hundreds of moves, Christopher knew he might be in trouble today.
This First Grade genius was very strong, it was as if he were a monster.
It seemed that he couldn’t hold back any longer.
As the thought flashed through his mind, Christopher’s aura surged once again, with dazzling golden light converging on the combat knife in his hand. The sword energy swelled to two meters in an instant.
“Eight-Arm Wheel Slash!”
Christopher let out a howl, and his entire body was instantly surrounded by a circle of golden sword energy. These golden light images were like a pair of golden arms, and at the same time like sword energy.
The materialized golden sword energy tore through the air and covered more than ten meters, creating cracks in the ground as if a Vajra with eight arms were suppressing everything.
Boom!
Christopher’s figure thundered forward, like a destructive eight-arm Vajra, blasting towards Jack. Wherever he passed, the flying sand and stones seemed to plow the earth again and again.
Suddenly, the golden sword energy around him merged with the combat knife in his hand. The sword energy swelled, creating an even more terrifying golden sword light slashing down towards Jack.
Eight-Arm Wheel Slash, a killing move that released eight sword energies, combined, and instantly increased the power of the sword energy several times.
Once, with this move, he had severely wounded a Level 5 early-stage mutated beast with a single blow and later on effortlessly killed it with his teammates.
Watching the golden sword energy that almost shattered the earth, Jack’s figure suddenly moved as the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in his hand entwined with strands of black-red light, looking like a roaring Demon Dragon..

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 155: Unmatched, Showing Holiness Again_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 155: Unmatched, Showing Holiness Again_2
Translator: 549690339
Boom! The contact was instantaneous, and the violent black and red True Strength exploded like a missile, being wildly unreasonable, with countless sharp halberd skills mixed into the terrifying blast.
The shockwave of the True Strength explosion was shattered by the eight-armed spinning blade light, but at the same time it destabilized the solid and sharp pure golden blade light, which collapsed with a loud bang.
In the violent turbulent airflow, the war halberd hung horizontally, falling on the combat knife as wide as a door plate, carrying an unrivaled dominant power.
In an instant, Christopher Raven’s face changed as he felt a terrifying force like a landslide and earth crack. With a loud bang, he was thrown backward.
Because he was moving too fast, Raven was accompanied by a chain of transparent, white shockwaves caused by the sonic boom. He vanished into the forest over a hundred meters away in the blink of an eye, breaking through large trees.
The whole mountain trembled, and a large portion of the forest collapsed.
The sudden change left Una Tennat and the others astounded, frozen on the spot.
What happened? They seemed to have seen Christopher Raven being thrust out!!
But how could this be? Weren’t the two evenly matched before? How come Raven, who had just demonstrated stronger power in using combat skills, was suddenly blown away?
The four of them slowly revealed shock on their faces as they looked at the distant figure holding a halberd and standing tall, entwined with a black and red glow of dominance. This freshman was very strong; Christopher Raven might lose.
“Hahahahaha…come on!”
With loud laughter, Christopher Raven, whole body radiating a dazzling golden light, exploded out of the forest. Because he was moving too fast, he left a trail of golden light shadows behind him.
Apart from the increased speed, Raven was radiating an even more powerful aura of strength. The True Strength, which used to surround him like a golden armor, now felt as if it was burning.
“Junior Clark, the three Secret Skills I’m cultivating are Strength Enhancer, Shadow of Swiftness, and Surge of True Strength. Now, take my full-force strike – the Vajra Eight Parts Slash.”
Having said this, Christopher Raven let out a long whistle. When he was tens of meters away, he launched a series of golden sword Qi, several meters long, into the sky at a terrifying speed.
This Sword Qi did not scatter, but in the blink of an eye formed a golden halo descending from the sky. It looked like a golden waterfall gushing down, resounding with a deafening roar.
Such a powerful move made Jack Clark be slightly serious, and he took a deep breath.
Immediately, an endless physical power within him was fully released, integrated with the dominant Dragon Elephant True Strength.
In an instant, a divine and demonic aura exploded around Jack Clark, twining with black and red radiance. Around him echoed bleak wailing, and in a flash, a black and red War Halberd rose to the sky.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The war halberd, which had condensed real power, was unstoppable. Each golden sword light was shattered by the black and red halberd skill.
The scattering golden Sword Qi exploded, covering a radius of several meters around Jack Clark, just like a waterfall. It split the ground into cracks two to three meters long.
For a moment, Jack Clark’s surrounding was instantly submerged in dust and smoke, leaving only the rumbling sound of the earth shaking.
Boom!
When the war halberd and the combat knife crossed, the power that burst out instantly almost annihilated everything in the surroundings. The ground beneath Jack Clark shattered loudly. Centered around him, the ground cracked and spread to a width of 3.58 meters.
In this strike, Christopher Raven burst out with all his power. The accumulation of cultivation in the Late Fourth Layer combined with the three Secret Skills and momentum from the sky, made Jack Clark felt a heaviness in his shoulder.
But it only made Jack Clark feel a heaviness in the shoulder, and he still stood unshakeable.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s arms swelled, and the endless power within him was released. The air around him twisted and inflated, forming a violent wind blasting outwards.
Boom!
With an indescribable terrifying strength, Christopher Raven was once again blown away by Clark’s halberd strike. His figure crashed dozens of meters away, ground shaking under his heavy battle boots.
Does his strength have no limit? Seeing the dominant figure in the distance whose strength aura was becoming more and more overwhelming, a look of shock also appeared on Christopher Raven’s face.
The first probing resulted in an evenly matched confrontation, but when Christopher Raven unleashed his full strength, he was knocked away by a single strike. This time, he had even used all his power augmented by the Secret Skills, but still, he couldn’t shake Clark by an inch.
The bulky figure was like a real Dragon Elephant Behemoth, unmovable.
Even the concrete True Strength that he condenses didn’t look like it was at the early stage of the Fourth Layer at all. He would believe it if it was said to be at the peak of the Fourth Layer. It was too solid and dominant.
Just as Christopher Raven was in doubt, Jack Clark slowly spoke: “Senior Raven, it’s my turn now.”
Boom! To everyone’s shock, the sound of the sonic boom exploded in their ears.
When Jack Clark broke the sound barrier with absolute strength and speed, he felt as though the entire world had turned into the deep sea. Every step was full of resistance.
In his hands, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd became a world-threatening blade of Opening the Heavens and Earth, appearing above Christopher Raven’s head in an instant.
Boom! Christopher Raven blocked the crashing war halberd with his combat knife.
But at the moment he blocked it, his face turned red. The terrifying strength that was invincible and irresistible made his body sink, forcing him to kneel.
Boom!
Under the unrivaled domineering strength, the ground within a ten-meter radius of Christopher Raven shattered suddenly, forming a deep pit with a diameter of ten meters. Cracks spread out in all directions.
With one knee on the ground, with his face turning red, Christopher Raven stared at the back of the knife slowly pressing down on his head and the halberd side blade coming closer and closer.
When the pommel as thick as a palm, under an unstoppable force, pressed against Christopher Raven’s shoulder, the True Strength defense outside his body, which was five centimeters thick, began to vibrate.
Simultaneously, the patterns on his Golden-scaled Armor emitted dazzling light, forming a strong and rigid defense under their combined illumination.
Just as Christopher Raven, with his face turning red, was preparing to burst out with his strength to shake off the war halberd pressing on his knife, the black and red halberd skill twining around the war halberd exploded violently..

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 155: Unparalleled, Displaying
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 155: Unparalleled, Displaying
Holiness Again_3
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
As the intense True Strength exploded in front of his face, Christopher Raven was blasted away, the ground shaking and his stable and solid Golden Protective True Power completely collapsing.
Scattered strands of golden-black and red True Power fell on Christopher’s golden scale armor, making a thud sound.
At the moment when Christopher was dazed by the explosion, a War Halberd swept up the black and red light in the raging wind, sweeping unstoppably.
Bang!
Christopher was once again blasted away by Jack Clark, turning into a golden light, and fell into a forest more than a hundred meters away.
Boom!
