Before Christopher had time to land, Jack was already in hot pursuit, with a chain of white waves and sharp whistling, covering the sky, and fighting with Christopher, who was standing up again.
However, this time he didn’t fight Jack head-on, but instead continuously dodged with his body movements.
Boom, boom, boom!
The whole mountain forest trembled, with golden sword light and black-red halberd rays occasionally shooting up into the sky, causing large sections of trees to collapse and explode.
With every swing of Jack’s War Halberd, everything around him would be destroyed, rocks would explode, trees would break, and even the ground would be plowed into giant gullies.
In the battle with his blood boiling, Christopher only dodged more than ten moves before he couldn’t help but clash hard with Jack again.
Then… Boom, boom, boom!
Every time Christopher’s combat knife came into contact with the War Halberd entwined with black-red halberd rays, the halberd rays would explode, and the whole person felt uncomfortable due to the violent explosive shock, wanting to vomit blood.
If it weren’t for his extraordinary battle armor which weakened the energy impact of his True Strength, he would have been heavily injured long ago.
Not to mention the Unrivaled Domineering Power, if he doesn’t dodge it even slightly, it will sweep him away, utterly unable to resist, and be brutally suppressed…
Of course, he didn’t know that Jack was still maintaining the burst of normal strength at this time.
Looking at the collapsed towering ancient trees, and the trembling earth in the distance, Una Tennat’s face turned pale, “You’re kidding, that’s a first-year freshman!!”
Culver Douglas bitter smile: “We didn’t see it wrong, Christopher was indeed suppressed by that first-year, or it could be said that he was completely powerless.”
For a moment, the four were silent, not knowing what to say.
This is completely different from what they thought when they came down. Isn’t it supposed to be a higher level, with a deeper foundation and stronger combat power in Christopher, pressing that newborn genius?
Or is it that they are too useless, after nearly two years of hard cultivation, and still being overshadowed by a newcomer after continuous battles and bitter practice on the Alien Beast Battlefield.
At that moment, the battle that had razed half of the mountain forest suddenly became quiet.
“It’s over.”
“Let’s go and take a look…”
The four quickly exploded their True Strength, displaying their body movements, and hurled themselves towards the battle.
Within a few breaths, the four passed through the collapsed mountain forest and saw the two standing more than ten meters apart in the middle of the collapsed tree battlefield.
Fortunately, much to their relief, Christopher seemed to be uninjured, just somewhat disheveled, leaning on his knife, weak in energy, and the armor dull.
But in front of him, Jack, as always, stood holding a halberd with his True Strength retracted, but still emanating an invisible and heavy oppressive feeling that made it difficult to breathe.
Una, who was the fastest of all, flashed next to Christopher, and asked worriedly, “Raven, are you okay?”
Christopher smiled bitterly and shook his head, “I’m fine.”
After that, he turned to look at Jack not far away, gratefully saying, “Junior Clark, thank you for showing mercy.”
This time, Jack humbly said, “Where, Senior Raven is polite, in fact, I just burst out with all my strength, just luckily won one move only.”
“…Junior Clark, you don’t need to be so humble.” Christopher took a deep breath, suppressing the urge in his heart to beat Jack Clark a lot.
Did you just win me one move?
It was obvious that you beat me with absolute power, right?
However, after being convinced by Jack this time, Christopher realized how terrible this first-year genius was only after fighting with him.
Fierce and unmatched power, overbearing True Strength, terrible battle awareness, fluent handling of War Halberd as if it were innate, and terrifyingly fast speed and reaction.
It can be said that Jack has no weaknesses; He is like a complete Hexagonal Fighter, seemingly mediocre but so powerful that it is desperate.
In addition to the explosive True Strength property that will explode as soon as it is touched, it’s simply perverted, with each explosion of True Strength shock, making people turn their heads, and interrupting the rhythm of their moves.
However, the two sides stopped at the right time in this battle. After testing Christopher’s defense limit, Jack took some of his strength in the following battle.
That was the reason for Christopher’s gratitude just now. Otherwise, no matter how strong the extraordinary armor defense is, it cannot withstand the sharp and overbearing attack of the heavy halberd.
Both parties were merely sparring, not wanting to fight each other to the death over some grievances.
After a short rest and waiting for the True Strength in his body to recover, Christopher clasped his hands and said, “Junior Clark, we have some other stuff to do, so we’ll leave first. Until we meet again!”
“…Until we meet again.” Jack, who was caught off guard by Christopher’s bow, nodded politely.
Buena Raven, Culver Douglas, and Una Tennat also greeted Jack politely, and then the five of them disappeared into the mountain forest using their body movement techniques, leaving cleanly and neatly.
Watching the five of them leave, Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a thoughtful expression.
After this battle, Jack roughly evaluated his current combat power.
Under normal conditions, that is, fully releasing the body strength and Dragon Elephant True Strength, when swinging the War Halberd, the attack is around Late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven.
That is, very strong in the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, ordinary practitioners of the Fifth Layer Heaven are no match for him..

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 155: Unmatched, Showing Holiness Again_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 155: Unmatched, Showing Holiness Again_4
Translator: 549690339
After using the two killer moves of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, the instantaneous burst of attack power can reach the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, and if the Elephant’s Fury Rune is activated, it can sweep through the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Comparatively, it seems that Jack Clark’s normal combat power is only two realms higher than Christopher Raven’s.
But it should be known that the opponent’s cultivation is at the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, with True Strength several times more profound than Jack Clark’s at the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, and even more condensed and heavy.
Towards the end of the previous battle, Jack Clark’s True Strength was almost exhausted, relying entirely on his absolute physical strength to press on.
Moreover, he had to wrap the remaining True Strength around his War Halberd, preventing it from being just an ordinary alloy weapon and from being damaged or even broken by the opponent’s Transcendent combat knife.
This was also the reason why later on, Jack Clark would instantly explode the not-so-much Dragon Elephant True Strength, not giving his opponent a chance to exert their weapon and True Strength realm advantage.
So later on, when facing cross-level battles, he must end them quickly, not giving those high-level mutant beasts or enemies a chance to consume his True Strength.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark couldn’t help but sigh, “I’m still not strong enough.”
Even Christopher Raven, a genius at the bottom of the Achievement List with the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, could reach the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven in strength with the help of Secret Skills, Transcendent Weapon, and extraordinary battle armor.
Under such circumstances, the combat power of those top hundred Fifth Layer Heaven geniuses would naturally be even stronger.
Especially those third-grade monsters at the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven, their accumulation is more profound, and their Secret Skills and combat techniques must have reached the grand accomplishment stage.
Only with a powerful combat power far beyond their realm can these monster geniuses dare to venture deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range for training, fighting with Level 6 Mutant Beasts, and searching for precious resources.
“Come on, strive to break through the Dragon Elephant True Strength to the Sixth level within a month.”
After cheering himself up, Jack Clark returned to the Mountain Giant Bear, with black and red halberd light flickering on the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, tearing a huge wound on the corpse’s chest.
Soon, a crystal exuding pure life energy appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
As expected, there was a Life Crystal.
However, this time Jack Clark didn’t crawl into it, but used the War Halberd to hook the crystal and slowly extracted it.
Jack Clark held the fist-sized Life Crystal, wiped it on the fur of the Mountain Giant Bear, and then chose to convert it. Immediately, a row of transparent text appeared at the bottom of his eyes.
“You have converted a high-purity life crystal and gained 81 Points Attribute.”
Looking at his attribute page with a skyrocketing 148 free attributes, a smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
And just as Jack Clark burst out with strength, dragging the Mountain Giant Bear corpse weighing several tons with difficulty, all the base large screens flashed red lights.
“Jack Clark, with the cultivation of Early Stage Fourth Layer Heaven, has reverse defeated Christopher Raven from Dragon Mountain Martial Height. His Halberd Skill is unbeatable and overbearing, with Dragon Roar and Elephant Roar, currently ranked 949 on the Achievement List.”
Suddenly, many people at the Martial Height Base looked up, staring at the shining red large characters on the big screen with surprise, astonishment, and shock.
Among them, some students of Dragon Mountain Martial Height.
“That guy Christopher Raven was actually defeated by a first-year freshman?”
“Useless! He was actually used as a stepping stone by a freshman.”
“Next time we go into the mountains, if we run into that guy named Jack Clark, we must let him know how powerful we are at Dragon Mountain Martial Height. That guy Christopher Raven is too humiliating.”
“It’s easy to say, will you challenge him?”
“Cough! I’m just at the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, so 1 won’t embarrass the school…”
At the South Sky Martial Height Base, just as the red letters flashed, a team of five, dusty from their journey, returned, two of whom were the sisters Crystal Leinster and Mandy Leinster wearing battle armor.
When they saw the shining red characters, both of them were taken aback.
Crystal Leinster was even more incredulous, with her mouth slightly open, exclaiming, “How is that possible, Jack Clark came, and…!”

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 156: Everyone is Good, Spatial Strengthening
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 156: Everyone is Good, Spatial Strengthening
Translator: 549690339
Just as the Leinster sisters were shocked to see the row of red large characters on the big screen.
Among the five people, a tall woman wearing black armor and her long hair tied in a high ponytail asked curiously, “Is this Jack Clark the same classmate you mentioned, Little Sue?”
Crystal Leinster nodded, her eyes a bit complicated, “if there’s no accident, it should be him.”
“He said in our group chat a few days ago that he had broken through hour Layer Heaven and would come to the Alien Beast Battlefield. I didn’t expect him to make such a big scene when he arrived.”
Justin Welan was the one who tagged Jack in the group chat, so there were records of their conversation.
Later on, the Leinster sisters’ mobile phones received the chat records with a one-day delay due to the synchronizing of Justins phone, and they found out that Jack was coming.
The news that he had broken through the Four Layer Heaven before anyone else had stimulated Crystal Leinster, making her even more aggressive in her battles against mutated beasts in the past few days.
She couldn’t help it, being overtaken by so many as the class leader would leave her with no dignity at the end.
However, their crazy battles against mutated beasts and desperate absorption of resources during this time had indeed paid off, as their power aura was rolling already ar the edge of the breakthrough to the late period.
Mandy Leinster smiled gently at that moment and said, “That’s very much his style, always staying low-key and then suddenly making a name for himself.”
Betty Leinster nodded and smiled, “No wonder Crystal is cultivating so hard. Having such a formidable classmate in the class must be a lot of pressure.”
“I have met that Christopher Raven guy. He is at the late Four Layer Heaven stage, has at least two secret skills under his belt, and has extraordinary battle armor and weapons.”
“With that kind of strength, he can single-handedly kill early-stage Level 5 mutated beasts. To defeat him, our junior s strength must be ar least at Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.”
“Tsk tsk! The newcomers nowadays are so incredible – their strength spans from the early stage of Four Layer Heaven to Mid-stage of Fifth Layer Heaven. Terrifying!”
Another burly woman among the five nodded and said solemnly, “It’s indeed terrifying.”
There are many geniuses in the Alien Beast Battlefield who can fight beyond their level, but it’s hard to find a monster like Jack who can defeat senior geniuses across such a huge realm gap.
Every one of these people is a top genius in their respective martial arts schools, and as long as they don’t die, they will soon become famous on the battlefield.
At this moment, not just Betty and others, but many who saw the row of red characters on the big screen had remembered Jack s name.
Compared to the sixth-ranked genius in the First Grade, rhe 1,000th rank has more gold content and can better prove one s strength, indicating that he is not only a genius who cultivates quickly.
“The younger generation is indeed formidable.” A late-stage Third Layer Heaven senior sighed, the word old’ revealed in his undertone.
“These freshmen’s monsters are so abnormal. It took me nearly two years to reach the late stage of Third Layer Heaven, but they are already capable of defeating late-stage Fourth Layer Heaven seniors.”
A senior of the Second Class Martial Arts Base said with a complex look, “I was considered a rare genius when I achieved Foundation Establishment in just a week, but after almost two years, I still haven’t broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven. ”
“What exactly should I do to break through this True Power Quality Change and martial intent? True Martial is so difficult…”
At this moment, many people were looking at the big screen with envy and jealousy, bur some senior genius students also showed battle intent in their eyes.
“Pity that he is only in the early stage of the Four Layer Heaven. It would seem unsuitable for me to challenge him.”
While many were discussing rhe matter of ranking due to his combat achievements. Jack was struggling to carry the heavy corpse of the Mountain Giant Bear on his way back.
In the mountain forest, Jack threw the huge mutated beast’s corpse to the ground with a bang and gasped for breath.
“I can t go on like this. I have to exchange a few anti-gravity disks when I get back.”
Although one anti-gravity disk would cost 10 contribution points and can only reduce rhe weight by 5 tons, it’s quite useful after using it only five times and replacing energy crystal fragments.
Just the fact that it can reduce one-tenth of the weight would be helpful, and having four anti-gravity disks to levitate a large volume object 0.5 meters above the ground would also be convenient.
For example, this Mountain Giant Bear, weighing several tens of tons and 20 meters long, with a corpse lying more than four meters high.
In this situation, even if Jack had chosen some wide-open spaces to walk, it would still be very hard and slow, only covering several tens of kilometers in an hour.
Moreover, he had to deal with the attacks from the common mutated beasts along the way.
Although these Level 1-2 mutated beasts could be easily blasted by Jack’s slap, they were still annoying when they popped up while he was rushing.
And he felt it was a pity to leave the corpses, worth a few contribution points, behind on the road. Mosquitoes are tiny but they still have meat, right? It’s just that he couldn’t carry them.
If he had anti-gravity disks to levitate the giant bear’s corpse, even if it still weighed 20 or 30 tons, he would be able to drag it at a sprint.
Thinking about this, Jack sighed. lie had no contribution points left, so he had to go out and kill a mutated beast to earn a little just to make ends meet.
Jack picked up the giant bear’s massive head and dragged its huge corpse towards the base.
He had left in the morning and ran hundreds of kilometers, but it was already past four o’clock in the afternoon when Jack appeared at the foot of the mountain near the base.
“Damn, who is this tough guy? lie didn’t use anti-gravity disks and just carried the mutated beast’s corpse back directly! ”
“That mutant giant bear corpse weighs at least several tens of tons, right? He just dragged it back like this, his base strength must be extremely strong, maybe even reaching 10 tons.”
“His True Power Aura is only at Four Layer Heaven.. How could his physical strength reach the ten-ton limit of the Fifth Layer Heaven unless he has a physical talent!?”

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 156: These are All Good People, Spatial Enhancement !
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 156: These are All Good People, Spatial Enhancement !
Translator: 549690339
Staring at the giant bear corpse on the concrete road which resembled a moving small hill, and the tiny figure carrying it underneath, the passing seniors were amazed.
Since Jack Clark wore a helmet, no one knew who was carrying the bear corpse.
Many people only know that their base produced two monster freshmans who ranked within the top 1000, one after another, today.
Beyond that, most people don’t even know what the freshmen Jane Aiken and Jack Clark look like.
Therefore, these people just took a surprised look and then ran hurriedly to mind their own business.
The base logistics warehouse is at the foot of the mountain. On the left is a large warehouse area, and on the right is a row of offices, as well as the latest regulations jumping on the screen behind.
At this time, many staff were busy docking with the students who delivered the mutant beast.
Boom!
As a student in extraordinary battle armor turned off his Anti-Gravity Ceramic Plate, the corpse of a mutated beast more than twenty meters long fell and hit the ground with a heavy shock.
“Mr. Hawkins, come and register for me.”
“Coming. Level 5 early stage mutant triangle beast, the body is severely damaged, calculated contribution points 125.”
“And over here too, where is the attendant?”
“I’m here. Classmate, your unihorn python is eighteen meters long, the size and blood energy detection intensity is mid-stage Level 4, but the corpse of the mutant beast is broken, so 1 can only give you a base price of 50 points.”
“Fifty is fine. This mutant unihorn python was too fast, and 1 had no chance to pull my punches, so the damaged body was inevitable.”
Amidst the hustle and bustle, the enormous bodies of mutant creatures, brought in by the Second or Third Layer students using equipments, are dragged into the warehouse behind for the next procedure.
All parts of these high-level mutated beasts have value.
The horns on the head of some mutated beast corpses, armor-like scales can be used as industrial special materials, and the meat can be refined for valuable Essence Blood.
For some mutated beast corpses with less Essence Blood demand, scales, horns, skin, meat, and bones will be separated and then used individually.
Especially the meat of the mutated beasts is in short supply. Just the consumption of students and staff living in the base every day is relatively large, let alone the military base in the rear.
In addition, a lot of ordinary flesh and blood are processed and exported, sold to the society to earn a lot of money for other industrial developments.
Such as the operation of metal factories, ammunition production, research institute research, etc., these require a lot of money to promote and form a complete and massive business chain.
And those hard, tough, energy-rich scales, horns, bones, etc., over the years of research, also have other industrial uses.
For example, some powerful inscription missiles, Anti-Gravity Warplanes, energy cannons, many materials come from these refined mutant creature materials.
In addition, some of the most cutting-edge scientific experimental equipment has also integrated inscriptions with Transcendent Materials, completing many conjectural experiments that were impossible in the past.
Bang!
Jack Clark threw the bear’s corpse to the ground and gasped before shouting to the bustling staff in the distance: “Can someone come and help me stock this mutated beast corpse?”
“Coming.”
A middle-aged man from the Third Layer Heaven trotted over and said enthusiastically, “Little classmate, you seem unfamiliar. Did you just arrive as a freshman yesterday?”
Jack Clark was a little surprised, “Is it that obvious?”
At this time, Jack had already taken off his helmet and put it in his bracelet.
The middle-aged man chuckled, “It’s not that obvious, but I know almost all the students who have been to the warehouse.”
“Right, classmate, I’m Koi Hawk, the person in charge of warehouse registration. You can just call me Mr. Hawkins next time.”
Having said that, the middle-aged man handed an electronic device to Jack, “Classmate, please enter your Student ID for registration, and 1 will first measure the data of this mutated beast.”
Jack nodded, “Okay.”
Soon, as Jack entered his Student ID, Mr. Hawkins took a data measuring device and shone it on the giant bear corpse, obtaining the body length data.
Then he plunged the pointed end forcefully into the wound of the bear’s flesh and blood, and quickly popped up the blood concentration data.
“Classmate, this mutant bear is 19.8 meters long, the flesh and blood capacity is Level 4 Peak, and the body has some damage.”
“And because the beast has formed Life Crystals, the life energy contained in the whole body’s flesh and blood is weaker, so the recommended price for storage by the system is 60 Contribution Points.”
“If you have no objections, I will transfer it to your account.”
“Okay,” Jack nodded. This figure is almost the same as he expected.
Adding the higher-value Level 4 Life Crystal, the total harvest from this mutated giant bear is about 140 contribution points, not less than a common Level 5 mutated beast.
That’s the Alien Beast Battlefield.
As long as you are strong enough, from Jack’s point of view, the Contribution Points, which used to be precious and hard to earn, are now easily attainable.
Of course, the premise is to survive.
“Jack Clark.” As Mr. Hawkins transferred 60 contribution points to Jack’s student ID, seeing the popped name, his gaze paused.
Then, Mr. Hawkin’s smile became more enthusiastic: “Student Clark, the Contribution Points have been transferred. Next time you come, just call me.”
“Okay, thank you.” Jack nodded politely.
With the newly acquired 60 Contribution Points, after leaving the logistics warehouse, Jack followed the signage to the logistics material place on the mountainside where there were also quite a few people.
Each of these students had an oppressive aura, the weakest starting from the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven, many were Fourth Layer Heaven, and there were even two in the Fifth Layer Heaven..

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 156 Everyone is Good, Space Enhancements
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 156 Everyone is Good, Space Enhancements
Translator: 549690339
Because they didnt bother to hide their auras, Jack Clark was able to sense their realms.
These were the elite geniuses of South Sky Martial Height, picked from the sweeping rounds of students.
Whats more, the cultivation atmosphere here was quite good. At least in the last couple of days, Jack hadnt seen any fights erupting over minor disagreements or life and death battles occurring.
But this incidence was pretty normal.
For one, the school rules and the teachers constraints existed, and on the other hand, everyone was constantly battling mutated beasts, leaving them on edge.
Under such circumstances, everyone was mentally exhausted, leaving no energy for fights. If there was any spare time, wouldnt it be better to just rest?
Before long, it was Jacks turn in the line. He politely told the staff behind the desk, 1 want to exchange for four anti-gravity disks with energy crystal fragments.
Okay, please wait for a moment.
The staff inside were highly efficient, quickly bringing over four black disks that were ten centimeters thick, forty centimeters in diameter, and brimming with black technology.
According to the information, this kind of anti-gravity disk was made from a mineral that contained a powerful magnetic field. The production process was complex and only held by officials.
This was because it was the core material for those black technology anti-gravity warplanes.
Furthermore, the place where this magnetic mineral was produced was a dangerous resource point in the mythical world.
Therefore, even though a large number of magnetic minerals could be produced each year, even someone with Jacks official status would have to start with 10 contribution points to exchange for it.
However, for Jack and the others, these disks were just used to move mutant beast corpses and didnt have any other use.
What Jack wanted even more was space equipment with a massive space-time capability.
If he had a storage bracelet or a ring with a few hundred cubic meters of space, hunting mutated beasts and transporting resources would be very convenient in the future.
Unfortunately, each piece of this equipment was worth a fortune, even high-level cultivators couldnt procure them.
So in the end, he had to figure out a solution himself. Holding the anti-gravity disk, Jack pondered as he squeezed the four anti-gravity disks into the bracelet.
In fact, his Sumeru bracelet could still be upgraded to increase the interior space, much like the process of refining a Transcendent Weapon.
However, it needed to incorporate spatial spirit crystal mines that contained spatial energy. Such a little crystal mine costs 100 contribution points, and with the labor cost, it would probably take 150 contribution points to expand a cubic space.
But the so-called labor cost could be ignored, Jack himself could upgrade and strengthen it.
Thinking of this, Jack suddenly thought that he upgraded so fast, what if he helped others to upgrade expand their Sumeru bracelets and charged 40 contribution points each time?
But Jack quickly dismissed this idea.
Because it wasnt profitable. He gained at least dozens of points attributes each time he enhanced a transcendent level item. If he charged a fee of 40 contribution points, he might just be able to cover the cost but not make much profit.
If he charged 50 contribution points, how would it be different if others asked the school for help in strengthening their items?
The staff then said, Student, please input your Student ID.
Okay.
Eh!
When the staff took a look at the name information that popped up on the backstage, a smile appeared on his face, Student Clark, you have a thirty percent discount privilege, a total of 42 contribution points will be deducted for four anti-gravity disks.
Thank you. A smile emerged on Jacks face.
Although the Monster Genius 11+ privilege seemed unnoticeable, it discounted a large amount of contributions for Jack over a long period, especially when it came to the more expensive items.
For example, high-order dragon essence blood valued at 300 contribution points, along with 200 points attributes needed to strengthen the Dragon Elephant Power to the fifth layer, it was estimated to take 500 contribution points.
But after the discount, he only needed to pay just more than 300 contribution points.
Having exchanged his items, Jack left the logistics material place in preparation to head back into the mountains.
Although his victory against Christopher Raven that morning shot his Early Fourth Layer Heaven realm straight into the top 1000th rank on the performance list, Jack did not relax because of that.bender
There were too many geniuses here, even though he had just arrived and wasnt considered very strong, he was not at the bottom either. From now on, he planned to keep a low profile and maximize all aspects of himself.
Just as Jack was preparing to descend the mountain, three figures appeared in front of him.
Class Leader, Mandy..

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 157: Ji Changkong, A Single Strike to Destroy (Request for Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 157: Ji Changkong, A Single Strike to Destroy (Request for Monthly Ticket)
Translator: 549690339
Upon seeing the approaching trio, Jack Clark stopped in his tracks, somewhat surprised, Class Leader, Mandy Leinster.
Similarly, Crystal Leinster, who didnt expect to bump into Jack Clark, exclaimed in surprise, Jack Clark, didnt you just enter the mountain range this morning? How are you back so soon?
Jack Clark chuckled, I had good luck today. 1 encountered a Level 4 Mutated Beast several hundred kilometers out and killed it easily. The only problem was dragging it back.
It took me nearly half a day to drag the beasts corpse back, then 1 exchanged some Contribution Points for a few anti-gravity disks to make it easier next time.
Effortlessly killing a Level 4 Mutated Beast. Crystal raised her head to look at the sky, not wanting to talk to Jack Clark for a moment.
At this moment, Mandy Leinster gave a gentle smile, Jack Clark, let me introduce you. This is our senior sister Betty Leinster from the third grade. Senior Sister, this is our classmate Jack Clark.
Betty Leinster, the 35th ranked senior sister on the third-grade genius list, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised and couldnt help but look over at the smiling woman next to him.
This senior sister had battle boots about 1.8 meters high, a tall and striking figure, an exquisite face, and especially those beautiful long, narrow, and bright phoenix eyes that made one want to take a second look.
She wore an extraordinary battle armor made of black, tiny scales, with a cool design, mysterious patterns flowing on it, emitting a ring of black gold halo.
Most importantly, when Jack Clark noticed her, he keenly sensed a discreet and oppressive terrifying aura emanating from her.
This senior sister is very strong! Jack Clarks eyes narrowed slightly.
Betty Leinster chuckled, Finally meeting you in person. Youre amazing, Junior Brother Jack Clark. On your second day in the Alien Beast Battlefield, you already ranked in the top 1,000 on the Achievement List.
Jack Clark courteously replied, Not at all. My accomplishments are far from yours, Senior Sister.
Betty Leinster was not only on the third-grade genius list, but also in the top 50 on the Achievement List. Although her cultivation level was only at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, her combat power had certainly reached the Sixth Layer.
However, since Jack Clark was not familiar with her, he prepared to leave after exchanging greetings.
Class Leader, Mandy Leinster, Senior Sister, 1 have other matters to attend to, so 111 leave first. Goodbye for now.
Goodbye, junior brother.
Watching Jack Clarks figure leave, Betty Leinster pondered, It seems like this junior brother is going down the mountain. He just returned, and now hes preparing to enter the mountain range again?
Crystal Leinster nodded, He should be going out.
Although he usually appears to be quite steady, he is actually determined and full of adventurous spirit. As soon as he arrives, he definitely wants to kill more Mutated Beasts and accumulate Contribution Points.
Little Sue, you seem to know this junior brother very well. A smile flashed in Betty Leinsters eyes.
Wha-, what do you mean? Were classmates, so its normal to know what kind of personality he has, right? Crystal Leinster calmly explained.
Betty Leinster nodded with a smile, Yes, very normal.
As for Mandy Leinster standing by, she didnt say anything with a gentle smile on her face.
While traveling at a subsonic speed of 200 meters per second, Jack Clark quickly crossed the 500 kilometers and arrived at the vertical end of the Nine Rings Mountain Range before nightfall.
He stopped at the edge of the cliff.
Opposite the cliff lay the even more dangerous Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Stretching over 2,000 kilometers in depth and spanning thousands of kilometers horizontally, it was located in the middle and later sections of the Alien Beast Battlefield.
This cliff was like a dividing line, and on the other side of it, the mountain range was filled with numerous ancient trees standing over a hundred meters tall, hiding countless mutated creatures in the dense gullies and ravines.
In addition to being shrouded in clouds and mist, the space magnetic field also fluctuated, so even the Sky Eye Satellite couldnt monitor it.
Therefore, ordinary third- and fourth-layer students generally wouldnt cross this boundary.
Chirp!
A black-winged bird, with wings spanning over forty meters, soared through the clouds from high above and dove down in a flash, leaving a lingering afterimage as it landed in the distant forest.
The ancient trees swayed, and the roar of the Mutated Beast reverberated, then Jack observed the mutated bird soaring into the sky again.
Under its thick talons, it clutched a 10-meter-long creature resembling a mountain pig, covered in heavy armor and sporting several meter-long fanged teeth. The Mutated Beast had already been killed by a single strike through its skull.
Watching the scene, Jacks eyes narrowed, because such winged mutated creatures were very troublesome. With the advantage of air superiority, they could come and go as they pleased unless their wings were broken the first time.
While Jack Clark stood at the edge of the cliff, gazing at the Cloud Mist Mountain Range across from him, a group of people emerged from the forest below the mountain cliff.
It was a team of five, three men and two women.
Two men were dragging the huge corpse of a Mutated Dragon Beast, 28 meters long, resembling an ancient tyrannosaurus with red scale armor.
Based on its size and the faint aura emitted from the corpse, the mutated dragon beast was either at Level 5 Peak or Level 6 Early Stage.
Similar to oceanic mutated creatures, the body lengths of many land-based mutated beasts varied widely even at the same level due to different species, like snakes.
Involuntarily, Jack Clarks expression turned solemn, as the small teams strength was formidable.
At this point, there were six anti-gravity disks placed underneath the mutated beast corpse, which emitted a flickering black halo, counteracting half of its body weight.bender
Together with their floating half a meter above the ground, the group moved quickly, soon charging up the slope of the nearby mountain ridge.
When they saw Jack Clark in his dark red armor standing at the edge of the cliff, none of the group members paid much attention and continued onward, dragging the enormous mutated dragon beast with its awe-inspiring aura.
But just a short distance away, the black-haired young man who was leading the group suddenly turned his head and loudly said, Classmate, it seems youre planning to set up camp nearby?

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 157: Ji Changkong, A Single Strike to Destroy (Request for Monthly Ticket) !
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 157: Ji Changkong, A Single Strike to Destroy (Request for Monthly Ticket) !
Translator: 549690339
I had that in mind.11 Jack Clark didnt expect the other party to say that and nodded immediately.
The black-haired young man kindly advised, Were getting close to the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, and the nights are perilous here. 1 suggest you find a cave or a secluded place to rest, and try not to make a fire if possible.
Jack Clark nodded politely, Thank you for the reminder.11
Seeing this, the black-haired young man nodded benevolently, then continued walking.
After they had walked a few kilometers and reached the foot of the mountain, the female student clad in red battle armor couldnt help asking, Carney, why did you warn that guy?1
Carol Koch smiled slightly, We re all students, so theres nothing wrong with a friendly reminder,
Behind her, the burly young man holding a Dragon Beasts head said with a grin, Carney, Cicely means why did you notice him?
Another female student nodded, Indeed. Weve encountered many cultivators in and out of the mountain ranges during the past year since we came to rhe Alien Beast Battlefield, but this is the first time youve actively reminded someone.
Faced with this question, Carol Koch answered with a smile, Because the others we met were traveling in groups, and they would have someone standing guard during the night-time camp, so they dont need reminding.
As for that classmate just now, he didnt have the aura of the wild mountain forest on him, so he must have just arrived at Alien Beast Battlefield and might not be very familiar with the situation here, so 1 kindly reminded him.1
Besides, having more friends means more opportunities. Who knows if todays good cause will bring other benefits in the future? For example, when Im in danger, he might lend me a hand.
Pfft!
Cicely in the red armor couldnt help but laugh, Carney, youre the most monstrous genius of South Sky Martial Height, the top person in our second-grade peers. Your strength is stronger than most third-grade seniors. If youre in danger in this situation, how could that freshman possibly keep up with you, let alone help you?bender
Carney Turner shook his head gently, Cicely, your way of thinking is not right. So-called monster geniuses are nothing more than cultivators who are a little faster than others in the initial stage.
Who knows if one day our cultivation might stagnate, stuck in one realm for ten years without making any breakthroughs?
Besides, they are also human beings. Who can guarantee that among our classmates, some wont accumulate and make a breakthrough in ten years to finally surpass us?
Moreover, the classmate who dared to venture deep into the mountains alone must be quite strong. Maybe he is a monster-grade freshman of this term. Dont underestimate him.1
For example, the junior named Howard Lee we met a few days ago, once his overbearing power breaks through the Four Layer Heaven, you might not even be his match, Cicely.
Hearing Carol talk about that burly young man like a giant, carrying a steel pillar and killing a Level 4 Late Stage Mutated Beast alive with his crazy and powerful strength. Cicelys smile faded.
Whats more important was that at that time, the young man was covered in blood, heavily injured himself, but his crazy and demonic aura made her, a Late Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator, feel frightened.
Cicely hesitated and smiled awkwardly, Do you think that person we just saw could be that strong? Are there so many monster-grade freshmen now?
Who knows?
Carney Turner laughed but didnt mention his thoughts that the person might be even stronger than Howard Lee, fearing it might hurt his close friends feelings.
Perhaps it was a connection between geniuses, but when he saw that figure standing by the cliff, Carney faintly felt that the classmate was strong.
Although he couldnt sense his approximate cultivation realm due to not releasing his True Power Aura, the inner strength emanating from him couldnt be concealed.
it was rhe aura only possessed by a strong man, an intangible authority accumulated through defeating opponents with an invincible posture time and time again.
While Jack Clark on rhe mountain cliff silently watched the group leaving, his eyes revealed a light solemnity.
The young man just now was very strong!
Through the acute perception of Hearts Eye, only that young mans presence had given Jack Clark a faint sense of danger among the five people, indicating that his combat power was at least no weaker than Jacks current level.
As for rhe other four classmates, there was no reaction from Heart s Eye, indicating that their strength was average.
Jack Clark sighed, The Alien Beast Battlefield is indeed full of geniuses. lie then leaped straight down from the cliff several hundred meters high.
However, this time he didnt grab onto the rock wall to slow his descent, bur fell straight down from the high altitude.
Boom!
With the black and red True Power surrounding him, Jack Clark smashed into the ground like a meteor, instantly creating a deep pit several meters wide, his legs buried in the ground.
Jack Clark pulled his legs out and looked up at the cliff above as if nothing had happened, a smile on his face.
Under normal conditions, let alone Fourth Layer Heaven cultivators, even Fifth Layer Heaven cultivators wouldnt dare to jump down from such a high cliff. Otherwise, they would either die or be severely injured.
But Jack Clark is different. This morning, his physique had also broken through one thousand under the influence of his Avatar s growth, making his bodily density even more terrifying.
Moreover, with the help of battle armor and Dragon Elephant True Strengths defense, jumping down directly just now only made his Qi Blood slightly boil.
With a whoosh, Jack Clarks figure flickered and disappeared into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, vanishing like a shadow.
Night.
Jack Clark found a small dry cave to stay in, and casually killed and threw out the seven-meter-long Mutated Creature that dwelled there.
Inside the pitch-black cave, Jack Clark sat cross-legged with his Eight Desolate Battle Halberd by his side, then devoted half of his attention to sensing his surroundings and cultivating.
With his current strength, being careful in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range wouldnt pose much of a problem..

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 157: Ji Changkong, A Single Strike to Destroy (Request for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 157: Ji Changkong, A Single Strike to Destroy (Request for Monthly Ticket)_3
Translator: 549690339
Especially with the agility of over 800, the speed is no less than that of advanced cultivators who specialize in agility; even if they encounter danger and cant win, they can still escape.
However, Jack Clark was awakened after only a short period of cultivation, opening his eyes to look outside.
In his perception, a powerful mutated creature had just passed by a hundred meters away; although it concealed its aura, the invisible sense of danger was still detected by Jack Clark.
Soon, the distant screams of a mutated beast rang out.
Compared to the daytime, the mountain ranges at night belonged to the mutated creatures.
A one-meter-long centipede crawled through the bushes, and then was suddenly pinned down by a claw that came from above; it was devoured by a giant creature in one bite.
A fist-sized flying insect landed on a basin-sized flower; as it sucked the nectar, the flower suddenly contracted, wrapping the insect and slowly corroding it.
In the forest, several six-meter-long gray forest wolves slowly approached a spiked boar that was foraging under a tree.
As creatures mutated, so did plants; therefore, even as they grew larger, these omnivorous creatures could still grow by eating the delicious roots or plant fruits.
Of course, they preferred to eat the flesh and blood of other mutated creatures because it was more nutritious.
At this time, the three gray wolves were already about ten meters away; they suddenly emitted a ferocious howl and burst from behind the tree, fiercely pouncing on the spiked boar.
But just as the mutated boar screamed in panic, an even larger mutated creature set its sights on them
The mountain forest at night seemed to have awakened, filled with screams and roars everywhere; the terrifying aura emitted by some mutated creatures at the edge of the sky even caused the mountain peaks to tremble, creating a terrifying scene.
In addition to these powerful mutated creatures, many Level 1 and 2 mutated creatures were also present.
These creatures crawled out of their hiding places during the day and foraged for food or hunted, forming a complete ecosystem of low-level mutated creatures.
As for high-level mutated creatures, they rarely ate, consuming one meal for a long time and absorbing more heavenly energy.
Avatars that digested food as soon as they ate, and could grow quickly by eating voraciously were just special cases.
At the cave entrance, Jack Clark watched everything happening in the distant forest with a calm expression, holding a war halberd.
An invisible but terrible Dragon Might emanated from him, causing many mutated creatures that had originally targeted him to eventually choose to retreat.
Soon a night passed, and as the sunlight penetrated the invisible mist at the edge of the sky, the noisy mountain forest returned to tranquility.
Jack Clark set off again, concealed his aura, and wandered around the outskirts of Cloud AAist Mountain Range; after crossing a small mountain range, he finally found his prey.
In the morning, a more than twenty-meter-long mutated fox with three tails lay lazily on the grass, basking in the sun on the hillside.
A hint of light blue halo circulated on its body; as it passed, the grass and trees within a few meters range were covered with a layer of frost.
Its strange that a creature capable of controlling ice actually enjoyed sunbathing.
With a sigh, Jack Clark slowly emerged from the distant forest, wearing battle armor and holding an Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
Immediately, the three-tailed blue fox slightly raised its head, and its soft blue fur fluttered without wind; its eyes cold and brutal as they stared at the approaching Jack Clark.
Roaring, the mutated beast let out a low growl, and suddenly stood up.
Because on Jack Clark, a terrifying black-red radiance gradually emanated, a heavy and frightening power aura spread out, causing the surrounding air to freeze, and the ground to sink.
When Jack Clark approached within a fifty-meter range, the three tails of the blue fox danced, and a strong blue halo burst out from its body.
The blue halo contained an astonishing coldness; wherever it passed, the earth within a ten-meter range froze, the vegetation solidified, and the area instantly turned into a world of ice.This mutated beast was demonstrating its power in this way, warning Jack Clark, who was emanating a dangerous aura, not to approach any closer.
A talent energy type, huh!
The direction of a mutated beasts evolution could vary greatly; some had powerful physical bodies, while others evolved into different forms or had average physiques but wielded energy talents.
Unfortunately, this Level 5 early-stage mutated beast was not enough to stop Jack Clark.
As Jack continued to advance, the three-tailed blue fox revealed a ferocious look in its eyes. In an instant, blue light flickered on its body, and dozens of ice shards several meters long appeared in the air.
Each ice shard was like an ice spear, instantly soaring at a terrifying subsonic speed, reaching Jacks head in the blink of an eye with a sharp whistling sound. Bang!
Jack swung his war halberd, and an instant circular ring of black-red light burst forth, creating an expanding wall that shattered all the incoming ice.
After his sweeping strike, Jack took a deep breath, and an endless torrent of terrifying power was released from his body.
Bang!
Under the fusion of physical strength and Dragon Elephant True Strength, a fiery black-red overbearing aura enveloped his body, and the invisible breath squeezed the surrounding air, causing waves of air to surge.
Boom! The ground exploded.
Roar!bender
At the moment Jack disappeared, the three-tailed blue fox bristled with fear, sensing the strong aura of death. Its three tails shined with dazzling blue light.
Whoosh! Whoosh!! Substantial blue cold air surged like a wave in all directions, freezing even the air in its path, enveloping a range of tens of meters.
Despite Jacks supersonic speed, instantly closing to within ten meters of the mutated blue fox, he could not evade the all-around, indiscriminate attack.
Even though there was black-red True Strength protecting him, the chill seeped through the protection and a layer of frost formed on the surface of his armor, penetrating and invading his body.
Thump!
Surrounded by black-red light, the overbearing Jacks scorching-hot Qi Blood instantly shattered the frost on his armor, and then he soared high into the sky.
At the moment Jack leaped a hundred meters high, a three-dimensional ice mountain, covering a range of over 30 meters and more than 20 meters high, emerged below.
The center of the ice mountain was the mutated blue fox, emanating a blue, cold light.
However, its ability to burst forth did not manage to freeze Jack; instead, it had trapped itself in the ice mountain.
At that moment, a large swath of black-red light surrounded Jack in midair, like a demon god; the black-red light on the war halberd in his hand surged, and suddenly fell.
In an instant, the sky and earth changed colors in the eyes of the three-tailed blue fox.
Bang!
The moment the black-red light-entwined war halberd landed on the ice mountain, black-red sharp halberd lights exploded, instantly forming a ferocious, weeping ghost face.
Immediately after, the power burst forth.
Boom! In an instant, the entire frozen small world collapsed, ice shards exploded, and the terrifying war halberd with its horrifying power pierced through everything, like a rainbow light smashing the mutated beasts skull to pieces, killing it instantly!
Thump! Jacks heavy figure landed on a several-meters-high icy surface, surrounded by black-red light, holding a halberd, exuding a fearsome power.
At his feet, the gigantic, nearly thirty-meter-long, three-tailed blue fox corpse lay silently in the ice, blood gushing from its head, dyeing the surrounding ice red..

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 158: Flame Crystal Battle Armor, Two-ton Extraordinary War Halberd
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 158: Flame Crystal Battle Armor, Two-ton Extraordinary War Halberd
Translator: 549690339
The next afternoon.
Boom!
Under the black and red halberd skill, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd swept through, instantly blowing up the head of the approaching mutated beast. Its corpse landed on the ground with a thud and rolled far away.
Looking at the corpse that spewed out countless blood, Jack Clark slowly put away the war halberd: “A Level 3 initial stage Mountain Splitting Tiger, worth 20 points when 1 take it back, not bad.”
With that, Jack walked over, grabbed the mutated beast’s robust foreclaw, which was as thick as an elephant’s leg, and dragged its seven-meter-long body back before throwing it forcefully.
Bang! The heavy mutated black tiger landed on the corpse of the Three-tailed Blue Fox, and the anti-gravity magnetic field device underneath immediately emitted a strong black light, running at full power.
At this moment, not only the Mountain Splitting Tiger, but there were also two other Level 3 mutant beast corpses on the Three-tailed Blue Fox corpse.
The combined weight of about 50 tons almost reached the limit of the four anti-gravity magnetic field devices, which made a humming noise. The energy from the embedded energy crystal was rapidly consumed.
He estimated that after this trip, it could only be used at most two more times.
Jack Clark didn’t seem to care about it.
This time he had come out to make a big move, as one single early-stage Level 5 mutated beast was not enough.
So Jack didn’t cover up the smell of blood emitted by the Three-tailed Blue Fox on his way back, and he specifically took unfamiliar routes to attract the mutated beasts’ attacks.
These mutated creatures either ambushed, sneaked attack, or attacked directly, but all were nonchalantly killed by Jack.
Under Heart’s Eye Perception, it was almost impossible for these mutated creatures to ambush him unless they could completely erase their breath and not look at him.
In the Limit Break state of the Heart’s Eye Realm, as long as there is a slight malicious gaze at him, Jack would sense it instantly.
For these mutated creatures, the flesh and blood of a high-level mutant beast would bring them significant growth if they could eat it.
Thus, even though Jack exuded an oppressive aura, many mutated creatures still attacked one after another.
After placing the mutated tiger, Jack went in front of the Three-tailed Blue Fox corpse, held its neck with his left hand, and exerted force with his swelling arm muscles.
Yell!
Under the formidable strength, Jack carried the mutated beast’s corpse on his shoulder and continued on his way, his steps heavy. With every step he took, the ground trembled slightly, and he sank deep into the ground.
Here, Jack couldn’t help but praise the black technology of the anti-gravity disks.
After four of them were combined to form an anti-gravity magnetic field, it not only offset about 20 tons of weight but also caused the object to float half a meter above the ground due to the repulsion between the magnetic field and the earth’s magnetic field.
In this way, rather than carrying, Jack was dragging the heavily mutated corpses as he ran with no ground friction, making it very fast.
When the four anti-gravity disks formed an anti-gravity field, their actual offset force reached 50 tons, which was the reason why the object floated.
However, after levitating the object, the anti-gravity magnetic field still had a heavy binding force, requiring strong strength to pull.
Thus, the official explanation was that one could offset five tons, four would have an anti-gravity suspension limit of 50 tons, and six could offset even heavier objects.
Boom, boom, boom! Amid the heavy footsteps, Jack, with the piled-up mutated beast corpses that formed a small hill, started to run. He held the battle halberd in his right hand, guarding his surroundings.
At the same time, his True Strength circulated in his body, maintaining a two-fold increase in explosive power.
However, due to the limit of the anti-gravity disk, even though Jack killed some weaker mutant beasts on the way, he didn’t take their corpses.
Moreover, the large body size of mutated creatures still posed a problem. They had to detour around valleys which could be leaped across and could not climb steep mountain peaks.
Therefore, even for Jack, the more than 700-kilometer journey eventually became more than 1,000 kilometers long, and it took him more than a day of running to return to the base on the third day at noon.
As Jack dragged the mutated beast corpses that looked like a small hill onto the road at the foot of the mountain, a Second Layer Heaven senior, who was operating a harvester in the nearby rice field, stared wide-eyed.
“Fuck! It’s that guy again.”
“What ‘that guy? His name is Jack Clark, the most monstrous genius of the first-year students,” reminded another student, who was operating a transport truck to receive the rice.
The South Sky Martial Height Base was not big. In just a few days, the newly arrived students had been investigated by everyone.
Especially Jack Clark, who ranked sixth in the genius list upon his arrival and entered the 1,000th rank of the achievement list on the second day.
The senior operating the harvester smiled bitterly, “I know it’s him, but even if he’s a monster, isn’t this too exaggerated? He killed so many mutated beasts in one trip.”
Although they saw many people carrying mutated beast corpses back every day, many larger and fiercer than the Three-tailed Blue Fox.
But most of those people were in teams. Like Jack, who hunted mutated beasts alone, were few and far between, let alone having a small hill of corpses from one Level 5 and four Level 3 mutated beasts.
Many solo hunters, even if they could kill a Level 5 mutated beast, would find it difficult to drag so many corpses back.
So when Jack arrived at the Logistics Warehouse with a pile of mutated beast corpses, warehouse manager Koi Hawk warmly greeted him: “Student Clark, over here, just put it here.”
Bang!
With Jack turning off the anti-gravity floating disk, the five mutated beasts piled up and fell to the ground, scattering and occupying a large area of space.
Phew! Jack exhaled a breath and said politely, “Manager Koi, please help me count.”
“No problem.”
Koi Hawk was very enthusiastic, using a detector to scan the five mutated beast corpses one by one, followed by checking the energy contained in the flesh and blood of the mutated creatures.
“Student Clark, the head of this early-stage Level 5 corpse is shattered, so the base price for recycling is 130 points..”

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 158: Flame Crystal Battle Armort
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 158: Flame Crystal Battle Armort
Two-Ton Transcendent War Halberd_2
Translator: 549690339
“Four Level 3 Mutated Beasts, ranging from the early to late stages, are quite damaged, worth a total of 85, bringing your total contribution to 215.”
‘If you think the price is okay, I’ll register it for you and transfer the amount to your account.”
Jack Clark nodded, “The price is fine, thank you, Mr. Hong.”
Hong Shan laughed, “No problem, just call me Old Hong.”
With this addition of 215, plus the 18 points left over from the day before yesterday and the initial 1 point, Jack now had a total of 234 contribution points.
However, he didn’t go straight to the Logistics Department but returned to the dormitory first.
After spending three days fighting in the Deep Mountain non-stop and being constantly vigilant, even he felt somewhat exhausted, especially mentally.
Upon returning to his room, Jack took a bath, cleaned his battle armor, changed into a leisure suit, and then went to eat lunch in the cafeteria before planning to head to the Logistics Department.
However, as he reached the square, the large screen in the distance suddenly lit up.
“Ian Clark, taking on Los Angeles Martial Height’s Rivus Xinson with Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, demonstrates unsurpassed sword intent, cutting through everything, current Achievement List ranking 940.”
On the square, some seniors who were about to go down the mountain or had just returned stopped in their tracks; some exclaimed, “Another genius who broke into the top 1000!”
“Yeah, it’s only been ten days since the start of the next semester, and so many freshmen have entered the Alien Beast Battlefield. Besides, three of them have now consecutively made it to the Achievement List.”
A student in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven spoke with irritation, “We re also geniuses, but it seems like it won’t be long before we’re outpaced.”
“Don’t compare yourself to them, monsters like that appear in every school each year, one or two at a time, it’s just that they’re more common this year.” “Alright, let’s not look anymore. We need to go and not come back until we’ve killed two Level 5 Mutated Beasts.”
Jack’s footsteps halted, and he looked up ar the red large characters on the large screen, recalling the youth who had once challenged him back at Erica Knowles.’
Jack chuckled, “It seems none of them are willing to be left out.”
As the most talented monsters of the various martial arts schools broke through the Four-Layer Heaven and consolidated their gains, they gradually squeezed into the top 1000 ranking on the Achievement List, making the seniors no longer their match.
Each of these monsters had incredibly potent combat abilities, capable of fighting across a major realm.
Or rather, those who couldn’t cross a major realm in combat had no claim to be the monster of their martial element – they were merely ordinary geniuses with faster cultivation speed.
When Jack arrived at the Logistics Department, he encountered a familiar face.
A tall girl in dark red armor stood in line not far away, with a slender 1.9-meter long, 10-centimeter wide battle sword on her back.
Jack walked over and smiled, “Student Aiken, longtime no see.”
Jane Aiken turned around and slightly nodded when she saw Jack queuing behind her, “It’s been almost two months, indeed, long time no see.”
After coming back from Koroya, Jane had applied for the Alien Beast Battlefield directly.
Jack looked at the ordinary alloy battle sword on her back and asked curiously, “Are you planning to craft a transcendent weapon, Student Aiken?”
As cultivators reached the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, they could create transcendent weapons. Given that Jane had just returned from the mountains, Jack guessed she might have reaped some good rewards and decided to craft a weapon.
Jane slightly nodded, “Yes?”
Jack smiled, “How coincidental, I’m also looking to exchange for some materials. What materials are you planning to exchange for, Student Aiken?”
The girl didn’t hide her intentions and said, “I’m planning to exchange for Broken Space Jade and Soul Crystal. It’ll enhance the spatial rift and mental suppression of the battle sword. How about you, Student Clark?”
“My War Halberd’s main attribute is heaviness, so 1 want to exchange for Prison Mine Stone and solid Cloud Mountain Steel.”
For cultivators in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, possessing a transcendent weapon could significantly influence their combat abilities, like the case of Christopher Raven who Jack had defeated earlier.
Although he was in rhe Late Fourth Layer Heaven with actual combat abilities comparable to the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, due to the support of transcendent battle armor and weapons, his abilities almost reached the Mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven.
During the fight, Jack dared not collide too much with his opponent’s weapon head-on.
If the True Strength covering his halberd accidentally collapsed during the clash, it would only take a couple of hits for the ordinary alloy halberd to break apart.
Of course, at the time, Jack just wanted to assess Christopher’s overall combat power structure; otherwise, a single all-out burst would have been enough to defeat him, making the weapon disparity insignificant.
This time, Jack planned to exchange for a Prison Mine Stone, referred to as the heaviest material with a density more than ten times that of Osmium. A human-head-sized piece weighs over two tons.
Most importantly, this ore has excellent energy conductivity and can be smelted into transcendent weapons, granting them the heaviness special ability.
So-called transcendent materials are those substances with energy extension and special “abilities,” like the Broken Space Jade that Jane wanted to exchange for.
This material has the ability to rupture “space.”
Of course, the term “space” here is a general concept, not an actual space rupture, but rather a description of its ability to tear through energy and matter invisibly.
It wasn’t long before it was Jane’s turn. With a 30% discount applied, she spent over 130 contribution points to exchange for two transcendent materials, then left.
Then it was Jack’s turn, I d like to exchange for Prison Mine Stone, Cloud Mountain Steel, Wind Spirit Steel, and Blazing Crystal Mine.”
“Prison Mine Stone 100 points, Cloud Mountain Steel 90 points, Wind Spirit Steel 50 points, Blazing Crystal Mine 50 points, a total of 203 contribution points after the discount.”
Jack slightly nodded, “Thank you..”

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 158: Flame Crystal Battle Armor, Two-ton Transcendent War Halberd_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 158: Flame Crystal Battle Armor, Two-ton Transcendent War Halberd_3
Translator: 549690339
Upon seeing Jack Clark exchange so many transcendent materials at once, the seniors queuing behind to exchange resources inevitably turned their gazes over.
A female student exclaimed in surprise, “Junior, are you not afraid of failure while exchanging so many main materials for your first time crafting a Transcendent Weapon?”
They had overheard the previous conversation between Jack Clark and Jane Aiken, and thus knew that it was his first attempt at crafting a Transcendent Weapon.
Normally, when a freshman tries to create a Transcendent Weapon for the first time, they would limit their contribution to around 100 points for success rate and material fusion quality.
Having more materials fused into a transcendent weapon doesn’t necessarily make it better. If the process lacks proper organization, it is impossible to maximize the characteristics of these materials.
Jack Clark responded with a slight smile, “I intend to craft a transcendent weapon and a battle armor individually with these materials. Melting two types at once should be fine.”
The female student suddenly realized: “So, that’s the case.”
Having exchanged the materials, Jack Clark proceeded to the Cultivation Area to reserve a solid Cultivation Room and closed the heavy door.
The Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, the enhanced combat knife, the human head-sized Prison Mine Stone, and a huge chunk of Cloud Mountain Steel.
Compared to the heavy attribute from the Prison Mine Stone, Cloud Mountain Steel possesses exceptional solidity as well as energy conductivity.
Fusion can greatly enhance the solidity of the Halberd.
By that time, even if his true strength were to be exhausted, Jack can still fight fiercely with the Halberd using just the formidable power of his own body, without the weapon being damaged and his battle strength significantly dropping due to the exhaustion of his true strength.
After pulling out the various materials from the Sumeru Bracelet and piling them together, Jack Clark prepared to start crafting. He held onto the tail tip of the Eight Desolate War Halberd, and a voice resonated in his mind.
“Consume 50 attribute points to enhance the Halberd.”
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, the 148 free attribute points on his attribute page instantaneously dropped to 98.
A surge of milky white power immediately covered the Halberd, the combat knife, and the ore, trailing down from Jack’s hand.
Under the illumination of the white halo, the combat knife was the first to melt, covering the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd like liquid metal, followed by the dense Prison Mine Stone, silently turning into countless powders.
Once the powder of the Prison Mine Stone and the liquid metal of the combat knife covered the Halberd evenly, the chunk of Cloud Mountain Steel slowly began to melt….
Compared to the Weapon Casting Secret Skill, which uses Spirit Qi to ignite True Strength and leverage one’s blood to smelt Transcendent Materials, Jack Clark’s process of crafting a Transcendent Weapon was much simpler.
Once the combat knife and the materials completely coated the Eight Desolate War Halberd, a series of transparent words appeared before Jack Clark’s eyes.
“Please infuse a drop of blood containing vital spirit and will to brand the transcendent weapon with the host’s imprint.”
“…Still need to use blood?” Jack paused briefly, then, using the True Strength flowing from the tip of his left index finger, forcefully made a small cut on the right hand’s middle finger.
There was some difficulty in cutting through the finger, forming a tiny wound. Subsequently, Jack circulated his Qi-blood throughout his body to gradually form a drop of radiant red blood, which began to drip down.
Plop! The drop of blood fell onto the halberd and was absorbed within the blink of an eye. Jack instantly felt a subtle connection link between himself and the Halberd.
Under Jack Clark’s unconscious intention, the words “Eight Desolate” gradually emerged at the front end of the handle of the Halberd, which was currently being fused.
Humm!
Accompanying the inscription of the name, the halberd emitted a faint hum. Amidst the swirl of black-red radiance, a heavy aura began to emanate from the Halberd.
Succeed in crafting!
Simultaneously, a string of transparent words appeared before Jack Clark.
“Solidity +10, Sharpness +10. A low-level Transcendent Weapon with ‘Heavy’ and ‘Hard’ attributes, weighing 2 tons, with a good level of Energy Conductivity.”
A good craftsman must first sharpen his tools.After spending 190 contribution points on resources, the creation of the Transcendent Weapon, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, did not disappoint Jack Clark.
While it continued to be dark in appearance, the golden patterns coiled on the pole became tighter and more compact like dragon scales.
The blade edge and both sides became sharper, faintly radiating a white glow. The invisible, sharp aura ripples unfolded, slicing through the air.
Furthermore, the halberd pulsed with a hard-to-notice black-gold radiance, bestowing it with majesty and dominance.
Jack Clark reached out and grabbed the halberd, lightly lifting it.
Under his tremendous strength that could lift up to 26 tons, lifting the two-ton Battle Halberd felt as easy as a normal person gripping a ten-kilogram weapon.
Of course, this is just a simple comparison.
Even now, if Jack Clark wanted to swing the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd with all his strength, he still needed to burst a part of his True Strength to amplify it.
Such as at this moment.
His True Strength flowed into the halberd’s handle and filled him with a sense of smoothness. There was absolutely no surface skimming sensation like before.
The Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, embedded with his heart’s blood, felt like the extension of his arm, entirely integrated.
Hum!
Atop the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, black-red light surged. The invisible, sharp aura emitting from it even cut through the robust floor, leaving cracks behind.
Just the sheer force conveyed through the halberd increased its power by ten percent, not only making it sharper but also reducing the depletion of his True Strength considerably.
But these are just the basic capabilities of a Transcendent Weapon.
Then, Jack Clark swung it with a sudden burst of strength. Wind roared inside the cultivation room in an instant.
The entire room’s air was disturbed by the invisible heavy aura radiating from the halberd, and the air in front of the halberd even created a strong gust due to compression.
Boom!
The whole cultivation room was shaken by Jack Clark’s nonchalant swing, forming a four-meter-long, ten-centimeter-wide black plane in the air.
It was a vacuum formed by an instantaneous explosion of air, and under the influence of the heavy power, it lasted for a long time.
At the same time, the fierce wind swept across the whole training room, and the violent turbulence of the air caused an alarming resonance.
Such a formidable power even made Jack Clark excited, making him nod in satisfaction and exclaim, “This is the power that a Transcendent Weapon should have.”
The successfully refined Eight Desolate Battle Halberd could almost bring his strength to its utmost limit.
After becoming vaguely familiar with his new weapon, Jack Clark put it away. He then took out his cleaned battle armor, placing Wind Spirit Steel and Blazing Crystal Mine together.
This time, Jack Clark is prepared to refine both the Transcendent Weapon and battle armor at once.
For a cultivator, a set of powerful Transcendent battle armor could serve as a second life. It could not only greatly amplify the True Strength Defense, but also possess some special abilities.
For instance, the Wind Spirit Steel Jack Clark exchanged, despite having energy conductivity, was very strong. It also came with an air recirculation purification feature.
This ability was extremely useful in places filled with poisonous gas. It could even allow Jack Clark to breathe underwater for a short time.
The Blazing Crystal Mine, True to its name, came with extremely high temperature properties. Once infused into the battle armor, the protective True Strength that penetrates the body would carry extreme heat.
This feature is primarily used to deal with defenses that have poisonous gas and hallucinogenic energy attacks, forming a double layer of protection with the Wind Spirit Steel.
Of course, the two materials cost only 100 contribution points, so the manufactured Transcendent Battle Armor could be said to be reasonably strong..

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 159: Without madness, there’s no survival, Howard Lee shouldn’t be a coward.
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 159: Without madness, there’s no survival, Howard Lee shouldn’t be a coward.
Translator: 549690339
While Jack Clark “retreated” for crafting extraordinary weapons and battle armor, a heavy figure oozing insanity walked into the base square.
His height of 2.2 meters, his dark red armor barely held in place by tensed muscles, and the four-meter-long steel bar thicker than his thigh he carried on his shoulder were all giving off a king-like presence.
It was indeed Howard Lee, who had been in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range for more than half a month.
A slow stride brought him under the big screen on the side. After inputting his student ID, he rested his hand on the sensor below, pouring in his True Strength.
Soon, red large characters emerged on dozens of screens around the Martial Height Base.
“Howard Lee, South Sky Martial Height, early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, breakthrough on the sixteenth of February, 25th in the First-Grade Talent Rankings!”
“Damn it! South Sky Martial Height again.”
“Are there so many monsters in this year’s South Sky Martial Heights? Three people have already broken through the Fourth Layer and entered the genius list in such a short period,”
“It’s not just the genius list, two of them have killed their way to the top 1,000 in the achievement list.”
At this moment, many two third-grade senior students in the South Sky Martial Height Base also looked up at the large characters on the screen.
Seeing another monster breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven in half a year, they suddenly feel fatigued.
A student at the initial stage of the Third Layer said in annoyance: “When will these days end? Every day, we have to watch others show off.”
A person next to him nodded in agreement: “Yeah, although we are all ‘geniuses,’ we have been cultivating for a year or two and still struggling at the Second or Third Layer. Why can they breakthrough at such a swift speed?”
“Nonsense, if you dare to go into the mountains to hunt mutated beasts, squeezing your potential by fighting every day, you might have already broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“Cough! Forget it then, it’s too dangerous to go deep into the mountains. I think it’s fine as it is now. Steady cultivation every day can also gradually make me stronger.”
“Exactly, those guys are experiencing life-and-death battles every day. Their minds are always tense. Their subconscious will be crazy for strength.”
“Under such circumstances, both the focus of cultivation, the activity of True Strength, and the efficiency of resource transformation are several times ours.”
“However, there are pros and cons. Their casualty rate is also high. I heard that Frank Carlson from Class 5 passed away a few days ago.”
“What? Frank Carlson from Class 5 is dead? Didn’t he already break through to the mid-stage of Fourth Layer Heaven?”
“Yes, reportedly, he was killed by a Level 5 mutated beast. Even the corpse is untraceable.”
“After receiving the notice, a teacher has departed to find and kill that Level 5 mutated beast in the hope of finding components of Frank Carlson.”
“Another one has perished. It is fortunate that we had initially chosen the conservative route.” Several seniors chatting on the steps suddenly sighed, glad that they had made the right decision back then.
After all, no matter how fast the progress, you have to stay alive to enjoy it. Over the past year, they have seen many familiar names disappearing.
“Only 25th rank!?”
Howard Lee looked up at his rank shown on the big screen with frustration. He had thought that his return after half a month of experience would amaze everyone.
At that moment, the red characters on the screen began to fade, and the screen switched to display the talent rankings of the first, second, and third grades.
As Howard Lee looked up from his name on the First-Grade Talent Rankings, he saw Jane Aiken in the sixteenth place, followed by Jack Clark in sixth place.
Howard Lee was momentarily dazed, not expecting that Jack Clark had arrived at the Alien Beast Battlefield and had broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven even before him!
Immediately, a wild battle intent gradually appeared on Howard’s face: “It’s good that this guy is here, and he has breakthrough the Fourth Layer Heaven. It’s a perfect time to settle our previous pledge.”
He had gained a lot during his time in the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Over the past two months, he had earned a ton of contribution points by hunting mutated beasts incessantly. He had exchanged about seven hundred contributions worth of complementary resources in total.
Now, not only had he broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, but he had also successfully condensed into the Bull Devil Battle Body, which would terrifyingly enhance his battle power, far surpassing his current realm.
At this moment, the likes of Jane Aiken and Ian Clark were insignificant in his eyes.
Are they just breaking through the realm ten days or half a month earlier? Can their battle power compare with him who had already condensed the Bull Devil Battle Body in the Fourth Layer Heaven?
Inside the cultivation room, after becoming somewhat familiar with the Flame Crystal Armor he had successfully crafted, Jack Clark finally left.
His weapon and battle armor had been upgraded. Now it was time to continue hunting Level 5 mutated beasts in order to accumulate contribution points to exchange for high-order Dragon Blood and break through the fifth layer.
Besides, enhancing the extraordinary equipment this time cost him two hundred contribution points and 105 attribute points.
The armor, originally damaged, only had 5 strength points left. He had used 5 more attribute points to enhance it to limit before crafting the extraordinary armor.
This means that Jack Clark had spent about three hundred contribution points on the extraordinary weapon and armor. It was worth a fortune.
However, with this set of equipment, not only has his combat power been further enhanced, but his defense is also stronger. Even faced with Level 6 mutated beasts, he could safely retreat if not able to beat them.
Just as Jack Clark was pondering whether to take the day off and set off tomorrow or to venture into the mountains now, a fierce figure appeared in the distance.
Seeing the wild Howard Lee, Jack Clark was surprised before smiling: “Long time no see, Howard Lee. It looks like you’ve already broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
Compared to Howard Lee in worn-out battle armor and wielding a heavy weapon, Jack Clark in a leisure suit seemed much more casual..

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 159: Without madness, there’s no survival, Howard Lee shouldn’t be a coward_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 159: Without madness, there’s no survival, Howard Lee shouldn’t be a coward_2
Translator: 549690339
And because of the reason for converging the breath, he now looks gentle and jade-like.
Howard Lee said in a deep voice: “Not bad, I’ve broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, but I didn’t expect you to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven before me in school.”
Faced with this question, Jack Clark just smiled: “It’s alright, I felt that my cultivation level just broke through while practicing. It wasn’t as difficult as I imagined.”
