Immediately, Howard Lee fell silent and then said solemnly: “Jack Clark, has anyone ever told you that you look like you deserve a beating when you act like this?”
Looking at the handsome young man in front of him, with a slight smile on his face, saying that cultivation was simple and easy, Howard Lee suddenly felt an urge to beat him up. This feeling was something Justin Welan could deeply understand.
“Really?” Jack Clark was a little puzzled, not knowing why he deserved a beating, but that was not important.
Jack Clark was looking forward to it: “What do you think, Howard Lee? Since we’ve both broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, why don’t we go down the mountain and find a place to spar, and finish our unfinished battle?”
At first, Howard Lee went to support Erica Knowles and made an agreement with Jack Clark to have a full-strength battle after the trial was over.
But since he was not sure that he could defeat Jack Clark at that time, this battle was delayed until both had broken through the Four Layer Heaven. This was because, after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, he would be able to condense the Bull Devil Battle Body.
At this moment, Jack Clark felt a terrible suppressed aura coming from Howard Lee, like a mad devil.
It was evident that he had successfully condensed his battle body. Just in time, his Eight Desolate Battle Halberd had been successfully refined, so he could use Howard Lee to test the power of the Extraordinary Heavy Arms.
Just when Jack Clark thought he would agree, Howard Lee coughed: “…our battle is not urgent for now.”
Then, without waiting for Jack Clark to ask, Howard Lee looked around and saw that there was no one nearby. He changed the topic: “I came to you this time because 1 want to cooperate with you on a big job.”
“A big job? Have you found traces of a Mutated Beast with a king-level bloodline again?” Jack Clark raised an eyebrow.
Howard Lee spoke solemnly: “Yes, I discovered a mutated beast horde on the edge of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range during my training. Among them, a Level 5 early stage mutated beast has king-level characteristics.”
“A level 5 mutated beast with a hint of a king-level bloodline, and your combat power has reached level 5 late stage!?” Jack Clark raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised.
It is known that a mutated beast with a hint of king-level bloodline has a combat power far superior to that of its peers, not inferior to dragon-type creatures, and its strength can span at least two small levels.
Could it be true that Howard Lee, who dared to target that mutated beast, had a battle power spanning the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven?
Was it possible? Jack Clark looked doubtful in his eyes.
Because in his perception, although Howard Lee’s aura was strong, it was only comparable to Christopher Raven’s, and even slightly weaker.
Faced with this question, Howard Lee was somewhat embarrassed: “Although I’ve broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven, my combat power is not that exaggerated. I’m still a little short and not a match for that beast king.”
“But with you added, there will be no problem.”
“You think so highly of me?” Jack Clark was a little puzzled.
Howard Lee was silent for a moment, then said solemnly: “Yes, I believe in you, or rather, I believe in my intuition. So, are you interested?”
Intuition, you’re not a woman, where does your intuition come from? Jack Clark complained in his heart.
After thinking about it, Jack Clark nodded: “Alright, since you have so much faith in me, let’s team up again for a big job. Just leave that Level 5 Beast King to me.”
As expected, this guy had become even more perverted.
When they first met, Howard Lee had felt a strong sense of danger from Jack Clark when he had condensed the Bull Devil Battle Body.
It was as if he was not standing in front of a person, but a violent explosive dragon. The invisible oppressive sensation was not less than that of the Level 5 Beast King.
It was clear that Jack Clark’s strength had become even more terrifying than before.
This was also the reason why he didn’t mention the sparring event after seeing Jack Clark, but instead prepared to postpone the battle again.
However, the perception of the beast’s instincts could also be wrong, so he used the mutated beast with king-level bloodline to test it out. If Jack Clark’s strength was not enough, he would naturally not agree easily.
This guy had always been cautious and would not make decisions beyond his capabilities.
But it was obvious… his perception was correct.
“What is the specific situation with that mutated beast horde?” Jack Clark asked.
A Level 5 Mutated Beast with king-level bloodline was worth no less than 300 points of contribution. If coupled with a few Level 4 Mutated Beasts, a fortune could be made.
However, unlike deep-sea creatures that purely compete in body size and ability, land-based mutated beasts are generally more powerful overall.
Not to mention such mutated creatures with king-level bloodlines.
Howard Lee said solemnly: “I observed the beast horde for five days and have figured out the specific situation of that mutated beast horde.”
“In addition to the Beast King, there are five Level 4 and more than ten Level 3 scale-armored alien beasts. Their territory covers hundreds of kilometers, occupying a small mountain range.”
“Five Level 4 beasts and more than ten Level 3 beasts, so many?” Jack Clark raised an eyebrow.
He was confident in dealing with Level 5 late-stage mutated beast kings, but it would be a bit troublesome if so many high-level mutated beasts were added to the side.
Of course, for him now, it’s just a little troublesome.
At this point, Howard Lee was silent for a while, then smiled bitterly: “There’s another problem. There’s a twin-winged flying dragon near the beast horde, with an aura also at the Level 5 early stage.”
“Most importantly, that twin-winged flying dragon’s shape and scale armor are somewhat similar to the mutated beasts, and I suspect it’s a special individual evolved from that group of mutated beasts.”
“In this situation, if we take action, we’ll have to guard against that Level 5 twin-winged flying dragon too.”
There is also a Level 5 Alien Beast, and it has flying ability! Jack Clark shook his head: “…we should call for help, we can’t handle such a big piece of meat by ourselves..”

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 159: Without madness, there’s no survival, Howard Lee shouldn’t be a coward_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 159: Without madness, there’s no survival, Howard Lee shouldn’t be a coward_3
Translator: 549690339
Two level 5 mutated beasts, one with flying ability and the other with king blood, and in addition to that, five level 4 and more than ten level 3. The strength of this mutated beast horde is impressive.
Even an ordinary Sixth Heaven cultivator wouldn’t dare to provoke them.
After all, although humans have comparable strength to the same level mutated beast after breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, their disadvantage still lies in their bodies.
Those mutated beasts are massive, and not easily killed even after being struck multiple times, but if a human is bitten by a mutated beast of the same level, they would most likely die instantly.
Moreover, how to bring back all the corpses of these mutated beasts after killing them is another issue.
Although anti-gravity disks can be used to reduce weight, they have a weight limit, and it’s not possible to pile all the mutated beast corpses on top of each other like playing Jenga.
As for leaving the corpses of the mutated beasts behind, it’s even more out of the question. All of them can be exchanged for Contribution Points, and losing even one would make Jack Clark feel bad.
Howard Lee nodded, “We two definitely can’t handle this big piece of meat.”
“If you hadn’t come to the Alien Beast Battlefield and made a breakthrough to the Fourth Layer Heaven, I would have prepared to team up with some late-stage Second Grade students from the Peak of Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“I believe they would definitely be interested.”
As a result of multiple years of hunting, not only have Level 4 mutated beasts in the Nine Rings Mountain Range become rare, but the situation in the outer area of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range is also similar.
As their strength increased, those high-level mutant beasts instinctively migrated to more dangerous areas of the mountain ranges, where the environment might be harsh, but the Heavenly Energy is denser.
In such an environment, the growth of mutated beasts would be accelerated.
Of course, if Howard Lee were to team up with higher grade geniuses, he would not be the one leading, and would not receive many contribution points.
In the evening, after three days away, Justin Welan and his team finally returned, looking weary from their journey.
On their three-day hunt, the six of them killed two early-stage Level 4 mutated beasts and one mid-stage Level 4. Due to their intact bodies, they earned a total of 170 points.
Although it may sound like a lot, when divided among them, each person gets less than thirty points.
Even so, Justin Welan and the others were quite satisfied, as they earned nearly thirty points in just three days, which would amount to over 200 in a month.
“What? Just helping move corpses, and each person gets at least 50 contribution points?”
At dinner that evening,
When Zac Lyons heard that Jack Clark was asking them to help move some mutated beast corpses and promised at least 50 points per person, he almost spat out his food in disbelief.
The others also had similar reactions.
Marcus Lee also showed interest, “Jack, are you joking?”
Jack Clark shook his head, “Of course not. Do 1 look like the type to joke around?”
White Veil agreed, nodding, “Not at all.”
Justin Welan curiously asked, “Jack, did you find a horde of mutated beasts and you can’t bring back their corpses after killing them all by yourself, so you’re asking for our help?”
“It was Howard Lee who found a horde of mutated beasts. There are more than twenty in total…” Jack Clark then briefly described the horde’s situation.
Upon hearing that the horde had an early-stage Level 5 mutated Beast King, everyone became serious and hesitant.
After all, that was a mutated beast whose strength was two major realms higher than theirs.
However, Jack Clark indicated that they didn’t have to worry about those. Someone would take care of the Beast King with a hint of king-level bloodline, and even the Level 4 mutated beasts would be handled by Howard Lee.
Justin Welan and the others only needed to help move the mutated beast corpses.
Or rather, their strength wouldn’t be much help anyway, so Jack Clark guaranteed at least 50 points per person, with the possibility of earning more depending on their effort.
After all, this easy opportunity to earn Contribution Points should be given to friends.
Among these people, Freya Louise’s magnetic energy cannon posed a significant threat to Level 5 mutated beasts and could serve as a backup option.
If the Twin-winged Flying Dragon were to support the mutated beast horde during the battle, Freya Louise would need to seize the opportunity to injure and restrain it.
As for asking Freya Louise to kill the flying dragon, it might be a bit challenging, and Jack Clark would have to figure out a solution in the end..

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 160: We must look down, the ancient blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 160: We must look down, the ancient blood
Translator: 549690339
The next morning, a group of people by the square were preparing to set out. Everyone was wearing battle armor and carrying weapons, among which Zac Lyons and others also carried backpacks with vital supplies and multiple anti-gravity disks.
However, when Jack Clark walked over, Justin Welan and the others’ eyes widened.
“Damn, Jack, you’ve actually refined an extraordinary battle armor?”
Then Justin Welan reacted: “No, not just the battle armor, don’t tell me that your War Halberd has also been refined into a transcendent weapon?”
Jack Clark smiled and nodded, “That’s right, I refined them both yesterday.”
“F*ck!”
“Sh*t!”
Marcus Lee and Zac Lyons all burst out with curses.
Under normal conditions, they wouldn’t have reacted so strongly, but they knew Jack Clark had only been here for four days, and just the starting material for a transcendent weapon costs at least a hundred Contribution Points.
That means that Jack Clark had earned more than 200 Contribution Points in just three or four days, then went ahead and refined both his battle armor and weapon.
Compared with their earnings of just over 100 points in half a month, it was simply unbearable and therefore, they were envious.
At this time, Freya Louise reached out and touched the shoulder armor of Jack Clark’s armor, and asked curiously, “Jack, what materials have you integrated into this extraordinary battle armor?”
Jack Clarke smiled slightly, “Transcendent Materials Wind Spirit Steel and Blazing Crystal Mine. With an increase of about 10% in True Strength protection, the solidity of the battle armor has been improved by about three times.”
“In addition to that, it has Internal Air Purification Circulation and dual-layer basic defense with external Blazing Heat Purification, which are standard features for a common extraordinary battle armor.”
Jack Clark’s choice of materials was not random; he chose them from the internal extraordinary weapon structure diagrams found in the school.
The external structure and appearance were professionally designed as well.
For example, this new armor was an extension of the original battle armor, with a deep red alloy body and many mysterious blue lines running throughout.
Red crystals covered the joints.
Furthermore, there were now three layers of slightly upward-curving blue-red shoulder armor, which appeared magnificent and heavy, emitting a faint blue-red glow all over – a hallmark of extraordinary battle armor.
In addition, the helmet had a transformation feature. When Jack Clark hadn’t pulled down his facemask, the full facemask split backwards, forming wing-like structures behind his head.
The entire set of battle armor exuded an air of dominance and magnificence, making the already handsome and valiant Jack Clark look like a Super God Warrior.
This was one of the reasons why Justin Welan and others were surprised and envious. Damn, it’s so cool! As a result, Marcus Lee and the others couldn’t help but want to reach out and touch it.
“Stay away, what are you doing?” Jack Clark retreated a step.
Zac Lyons retracted his hand awkwardly, “Just wanted to feel it, that’s all.”
Jack Clark said irritably, “Get lost, none of you are girls, what’s the point of touching it? If you like it, work hard on cultivation, break through the Four Layer Heaven, and refine your own set.”
Mullen Weisz said sourly, “How stingy.”
“That’s right, when I break through the Four Layer Heaven, I’ll refine an even cooler set.”
“I want to add wings, six pairs.”
“Sh*t, can you even carry that many wings?”
“It doesn’t matter if I can’t carry them, the important thing is to look cool. The wings on my current set of battle armor were already damaged in a previous battle, and I don’t feel like fixing it.”
“White Veil has a point, whether it’s practical or not is a minor issue, what’s more important is to be cool for a lifetime. I want to paint the surface with a layer of gold so that I sparkle wherever I go.”
“Then Zac Lyons, you’ll be chased by Mutated Creatures on the battlefield.”
“Haha… That’s really possible.”
“Actually, I think adding more spikes to the battle armor would make it more domineering.”
“Not surprising, Howard Lee, your sense of aesthetics remains so unique. Are you thinking about a Primitive War Record Suit?”
As everyone joked and laughed, they walked out of the square, then suddenly sped up, running at speeds of 100 meters per second, and in no time at all, they rushed out of the base area.
This time, Jack Clark and Howard Lee served as the main force for the hunt, with Freya Louise specifically responsible for guarding against the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, while Justin Welan faced the Level 3 Mutated Beast head-on.
As for Marcus Lee and the four ‘geniuses’, they had basically been reduced to bystanders, merely assisting Justin Welan in restraining the Level 3 Mutant Beasts and helping with moving corpses.
The group had already discussed the distribution of spoils before setting out.
Out of nearly 1000 points in contributions, Jack Clark, as the main force, claimed the lion’s share, followed by Howard Lee, then Freya Louise, and lastly, the laborers, Justin Welan and the others.
Besides, as the main force directly facing the King-level Bloodline Mutant Beast, Jack Clark would have priority in obtaining any possible Life Crystals without deducting Contribution Points.
As for Howard Lee, it goes without saying that he had his eyes on the Demonic Beast Blood Essence, although the cost would be deducted from his income.
Of course, when they heard that Jack Clark would be dealing with the Mutated Beast King, Zac Lyons and the others were initially speechless with astonishment.
On the other hand, Justin Welan and Marcus Lee, who had witnessed Jack Clark’s reversal defeat of the Blood Envoy in the Late Four Layer Heaven, were only slightly surprised.
With the map guiding them, the group took the smallest paths that students often used to get in and out of the mountain ranges, so they encountered very few Mutated Creatures attacks at the start of their journey.
Carrying a heavy sword, Mullen Weisz ran alongside Zac Lyons and the others and complained, “Why does it feel like the gap between us isn’t closing but getting farther and farther away since we came here?”
When they entered the Alien Beast Battlefield early and encountered a Level-4 Mutated Beast, Jack Clark, who had only been here for a few days, had already slain a Level-5 Mutated Beast.
Not to mention, they were now targeting a Level-5 Mutated Beast with a king-level bloodline.
Compared to Mullen Weisz’s irritability, Zac Lyons was rather more accepting and sighed, “Get used to it, this is the difference between a monster and an ordinary genius..”

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 160: We must look down, the ancient blood_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 160: We must look down, the ancient blood_2
Translator: 549690339
Marcus Lee chuckled, “Mr. Woodley, stop focusing on Jack Clark. Can’t you see he’s a complete freak?”
“You were no match for him in the Freshman Ranking Tournament. Back then, he was only at the First Layer Heaven and was cultivating low-level martial arts.”
“Not to mention that after going to Koroya, he soared to new heights, even surpassing Howard Lee.”
As he said this, Marcus Lee glanced thoughtfully at the rapidly sprinting figures in front of them, “As for now, I feel like Jane Aiken is slowly being left behind by Jack.”
“Jack’s talent might be more terrifying than anyone can imagine. Instead of comparing yourself to him and feeling uncomfortable, you should focus more on those behind us.”
“For example, our classmates in the First and Second Layer Heaven, who are still working hard at school.”
“Think about how, with just one or two more months of hard work, we can break through the Fourth Layer, and you’ll feel a great sense of accomplishment.”
Mullen Weisz looked at him in surprise, “I never thought you’d be so good at comforting yourself, Marcus.”
“Nonsense, do you want me to envy him all day long?”
The White Veil praised, “In this respect, Marcus is really better. No wonder he’s always so cheerful, even when he seems a little foolish.”
“Get lost, am 1 foolish?”
As the group behind them bantered, Jack Clark and Freya Louise walked side by side, casually asking, “How was it? Did you encounter any problems when you entered the mountains earlier?”
Justin Welan proudly replied, “With Grandpa Walton here, those mutated beasts couldn’t break our defenses. Even the Level 4 Late Stage Mutated Beast was held back by me.”
At this moment, Freya Louise chuckled, “Then you were slammed into the mountain wall.”
Justin Welan instantly complained bitterly, “Gorgeous Freya, you might kill our nice chat like this.”
As the two groups were chatting, Howard Lee, who was running upfront, had covered more than 300 kilometers in no time.
Bang!
With a swing of the four-meter-long steel pillar, half of the body of a Mutant Bird with an eight-meter wingspan was blasted off, with countless flesh, blood, and feathers spraying everywhere.
Everyone was used to such occurrences and continued to hurry on their way.
However, before they had run another ten kilometers, red True Power circulated around the steel pillar in Howard Lee’s hand, and with a blow from the sky, it smashed the head of a venomous python just as it was about to raise its head.
Howard Lee said solemnly, “We’ve entered the eastern edge of the Nine Rings Mountain. The mountains are high and the forests are dense here, and there are many low-level mutated creatures. Be careful.”
Jack stepped forward, “I’ll lead the way from now on. We must get to the Mountain Range where the Mutated Beast Horde is today, or else our journey will be delayed longer.”
Although the Light King Blade Technique had been integrated into the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, the Heart’s Eye Realm, which had been rune-fied, still remained.
So when Jack led the way, every time his heavy halberd swung, fierce winds howled, and thunder roared, as all the attacking mutated creatures were blown into a pulp.
Since the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd was refined into a Transcendent Weapon, Jack’s strength had become even more terrifying – any ordinary attack was invincible and unstoppable.
Climbing over hills and mountains, the group, who had traveled diagonally over nearly a thousand kilometers of mountain roads since morning, finally arrived at the foot of the mountain range where the mutated beasts with scale armor were located just before nightfall.
Of course, the reason it took so long was due to the relatively slow speed of Zac Lyons and the others compared to Jack’s group.
This place belonged to the other side of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. Mist filled the air between heaven and earth, and standing at the foot of the mountain, they could barely see a few hundred meters ahead in the distance.
There were towering trees here that were dozens or even hundreds of meters tall, with weeds and bushes growing higher than a person, tree vines intertwined, making it nearly impossible for ordinary people to move an inch.
Occasionally, the fierce roars of mutated beasts could be heard in the surroundings.
In addition to the shaking of grass and bushes in the distance, accompanied by a rustling sound as if something was crawling, the atmosphere was quite eerie.
However, this spookiness was in comparison to ordinary people, and Jack’s group only glanced at it before dismissing it.
At this moment, Howard Lee said in a deep voice, “It’s getting dark soon, and mutated creatures are more active at night. We should find a hidden cave to spend the night.”
Although cultivators in the Third and Fourth Layers could have a certain degree of night vision, it wasn’t far enough to have a significant effect on their combat strength.
Thus, under normal conditions, cultivators would find a safe place to spend the night when they went out, and only take action during the day.
Jack nodded, “That’s simple. With so many of us, we can search within a ten-kilometer radius. If we can’t find one, we can dig one.”
“Heh! Jack’s right. I’ll go this way.”
“I’ll go that way…”
Soon, Marcus Lee found a cave under a mountain cliff a few kilometers away, with the entrance blocked by a large rock.
As for the owner of the cave, the Level Two Variant Beast was smashed to pieces by Marcus, leaving behind a pool of blood that they could roast and eat before nightfall.
Night!
After arranging for the night watchmen, everyone who had eaten roasted Mutated Beast Meat went their separate ways, each finding a spot to sit cross-legged and begin their cultivation.
During his cultivation, Jack paid the majority of his attention to the Thunderflame Behemoth because something was wrong with it.
Whining! Uncle, come out quick.
Whining! Uncle, save me.
In the scorching seawater around the volcano, a fifteen-meter-long black and white Tiger Whale with flame patterns all over it swam around, constantly letting out whining cries for help.
Boom!
Suddenly, the magma inside the volcano exploded, and a black-red ferocious behemoth emerged, its whole body burning golden red flames and emitting a terrifyingly high temperature.
At this point, the Thunderflame Behemoth, which had been sleeping in the volcano for a few days and had absorbed a huge amount of heat, now had ancient red flame patterns on its black scales..

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 160: We Must Look Down, The Blood of Ancient Times_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 160: We Must Look Down, The Blood of Ancient Times_3
Translator: 549690339
Looking at the biggest brother of the Single-horned Tiger Whale family, the Thunderflame Behemoth let out a low growl.
Roar!! What happened? Did Joe get beaten again?
Whimper whimper!! Daddy went to fetch some delicious food and got beaten on the way back.
In comparison to the second and third siblings, the biggest brother’s strength was clearly higher, and he could communicate with the Thunderflame Behemoth. He was already showing signs of mutation.
This guy, he’s risking too much for his family.
The Thunderflame Behemoth was speechless. Just a few days ago, he had suffered a heavy injury due to a Lava Fire Fruit under the volcano, and now, not even two days later, he’s been beaten again.
Roar! Let’s go and see for ourselves.
Whimper whimper!! Okay, Uncle, I’ll lead the way.
The biggest brother of the Tiger Whale family affectionately circled around the Thunderflame Behemoth and then rushed towards the surface of the sea. Seeing this, the Thunder flame Behemoth retracted his flames and followed beneath the surface.
This time, they didn’t have to go far, and after swimming tens of kilometers, the Thunderflame Behemoth saw the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Under the night sky, the Single-horned Tiger Whale lay weakly on the shallow beach of a deserted island, more than 10 meters deep.
On its belly was a huge bloody hole, more than 2 meters in diameter, which was still bleeding. Even its wriggling organs inside could be seen.
If the attack had been just a bit stronger, this guy might have already been dead.
The two smaller Tiger Whales swam anxiously nearby, while the Female Tiger Whale quietly accompanied it, occasionally gently rubbing her huge head against the Single-horned Tiger Whale, showing her gentleness.
Bang! With the sea water exploding, a ferocious dragon head burst out of the water. With three pairs of blood-red feather horns on either side, it appeared extremely fierce and majestic.
Seeing the arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth, the two smaller Tiger Whales immediately showed excitement in their eyes and hurriedly swam towards it. The Single-horned Tiger Whale let out an aggrieved cry.
Whimper whimper!! Brother, you finally arrived.
The Thunderflame Behemoth growled annoyedly: Roar! You make it sound like you’re waiting for me to prepare your funeral rites. So tell me, what happened this time?
Whimper whimper!! 1 found another good thing this time, but that guy was very cunning. He tricked me and sneak attacked me. 1 almost didn’t make it back.
You used the Lightning Five Whip again, didn’t you?
The Thunderflame Behemoth shook his head: Roar!! 1 told you before that there must be mutated creatures guarding those resources. You need to be cautious, especially when you haven’t found the guarding mutated creatures. One day, you’ll just die in a headlong rush.
Whimper whimper!! I was very careful this time, but who would have known that guy would suddenly attack me while disguised as a stone? By the way, what does ‘die in a headlong rush’ mean?
The Thunderflame Behemoth roared annoyedly: Roar! What else could it mean? It means dying, being eaten up, of course.
Roar! So, what’s it gonna be? Do we wait until you recover, or do we take care of it now?
Seeing the miserable state of the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Thunderflame Behemoth decided to help it take revenge and see what good things it had found this time around.
Whimper whimper!! Let’s go now, or the good thing will be eaten up.
Roar! Well, let’s go then.
But just before they were about to leave, the Female Tiger Whale let out a soft cry, like a gentle wife, and gently rubbed the Single-horned Tiger Whale once again.
Because she hadn’t emitted any mental fluctuations and was using the unique “language” of the Tiger Whales, the Thunderflame Behemoth couldn’t understand what the Female Tiger Whale had said.
He only saw the previously wilted Single-horned Tiger Whale suddenly become spirited and energetic.
Whimper whimper!! Don’t worry, I’m quite formidable, and with my brother here, well definitely kill that guy. When we’re done, I’ll bring the good stuff back for you to eat.
Whimper whimper!! Brother, let’s go, let’s kick its ass.
After saying this, the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s injury had not yet healed completely, but its tail flicked, and it burst through the sea waves with a booming sound. It seemed to be full of energy.
Seeing this, the Thunder flame Behemoth looked at the big family curiously and couldn’t help but shake his head as he followed suit.
Thank goodness, this Joe guy had already given birth to three little Tiger Whales. Otherwise, The Thunderflame Behemoth might have thought he was a super simp, ready to risk his life as soon as his wife rubbed him.
But this was probably the reason why the three little Tiger Whales were able to survive, wasn’t it?
The Single-horned Tiger Whale ventured outside while the Female Tiger Whale stayed at home, looking after the three little Tiger Whales. Otherwise, in this ocean full of mutated creatures, an accident might have happened.
Following the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Thunderflame Behemoth swam further into the Outer Sea. They swam nearly a thousand kilometers apart before it was almost midnight.
Whimper whimper!! Brother, we’re here. Be careful.
With a low cry, the Single-horned Tiger Whale suddenly dived. Seeing this, the Thunderflame Behemoth followed, and in a single breath, the two giant creatures reached more than a thousand meters underwater.
Then, two thousand meters, three thousand meters…
When they reached more than five thousand meters in depth, the surrounding water pressure increased dramatically. Even the Thunderflame Behemoth felt a slight heaviness in his breathing.
At this moment, a deep sea trench appeared below, splitting the seabed open.
However, this trench was more than three kilometers wide and stretched for countless kilometers, like a crack tearing through the earth, swallowing everything.
The two giant creatures continued to dive.
At the same time, the Thunderflame Behemoth couldn’t help but feel envious.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale’s incredible talent for finding treasures allowed him to discover such deep-sea resources.
Soon, the two creatures arrived in the trench that was six thousand meters deep.
At that moment, the Single-horned Tiger Whale suddenly slowed down, and the Thunderflame Behemoth sensed a terrifying aura below that made his heart palpitate.
What a terrifying aura.
At this point, a faint red light appeared in the dark depths of the sea. It was a massive skeleton, a hundred meters long and more than ten meters in diameter, lying horizontally at the bottom of the trench.
It emitted a desolate, ancient, wild and despondent aura.
And in the middle of the bones were two drops of blood the size of a human face. They emitted a faint red glow that enveloped the entire skeleton, even blocking out the seawater.
As soon as the Thunderflame Behemoth saw those two drops of blood, an overwhelmingly strong urge to devour them welled up inside him. This urge was far stronger than anything he had ever felt before.
Obviously, this was the skeleton of a terrifying ancient creature from an unknown origin. The two drops of blood-like substance were probably the blood of that ancient creature.
This ancient creature was incredibly terrifying. Even after its death, which had lasted countless years and left only two drops of blood, it still emitted a dreadful aura that made the Thunderflame Behemoth’s heart palpitate.
And it also held an astonishing temptation.
The Thunderflame Behemoth’s instincts told him that as long as he devoured those two drops of blood, he would gain terrifying benefits..

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 161: Don’t Think About Your Wife All The Time, Hunting Moment
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 161: Don’t Think About Your Wife All The Time, Hunting Moment
Translator: 549690339
As the two giant beasts continued to slowly descend, approaching more than 300 meters at the bottom of the sea trench, the Single-horned Tiger Whale emitted a low whine.
Whining!! Brother, be careful, that guy can turn into a stone, mud, and sneak attack. Unseen.
Roar! 1 know, you don’t need to come down, just wait above.
In a low roar, the flames on the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s body flourished, emitting terrifying golden-red flames that sprayed meters away from its body, radiating a horrifying high temperature.
Instantly, the darkness of the sea trench was dispelled by the flames, and at the same time, the surrounding cold, lifeless sea water began to boil under the terrifying heat of two thousand degrees Celsius.
A large amount of sea water boiled into steam and was then solidified by the endless cold sea water and water pressure surrounding it, forming a colorful halo around the black and red Unique Beast.
Roar! Accompanied by a ferocious dragon roar, the Thunderflame Beheamoth charged at the ancient creature skeleton below with a loud boom.
However, as it dived downward, it deliberately kept away from the left side of the mountain wall, while extending its three senses to the maximum, enveloping a range of hundreds of meters around it.
However, to the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s surprise, it didn’t sense the breath or traces of any mutated life forms, as if there were no creatures lurking around at all.
Such a strange ability.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth marveled in its heart while continuing to dive toward the skeleton, its right claw engulfed in intense flames descending from the sky.
Boom!
In an instant, the sea water exploded, and under the terrifying power burst, a ring of scorching shockwaves blasted out, sweeping up rolling sea water and rushing tens of meters away.
But with the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s casual attack, the red halo covering the giant skeleton remained untouched, as if there wasn’t even a vibration, its defense terrifying.
This invisible red light is not energy! The Thunderflame Beheamoth’s eyes narrowed.
Its attack just now didn’t seem to hit an energy shield but rather an indomitable cliff of extremely hard alloy.
At this moment, at the seabed tens of meters away, a large piece of mud suddenly exploded, turning into a monster covered in countless joints and claws that shot out in an instant.
This monster showed no signs of energy fluctuations or presence before its attack, and its instantaneous attack speed reached the speed of sound.
Just in the blink of an eye, it appeared beside the Thunder flame Beheamoth with the roaring sea water.
And at this moment, the Thunderflame Beheamoth suddenly flipped its body and clawed with a dazzling firelight; the sea water in front of it was almost instantly demolished by the terrifying power.
Boom!
Under the fierce, overbearing force, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s claw shot the monster flying, creating a murky underwater flow, hundreds of meters high, at the ocean floor due to the powerful water pressure explosion.
The roaring continued relentlessly.
However, this mutated creature was strong; the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s claw only destroyed the black energy on its body surface, shattering half of its body armor and causing its flesh and blood to explode, but it didn’t die.
Boom! The mutated creature landed on the seabed hundreds of meters away, stirring up waves of mud and sand, and letting out a silent roar.
It wasn’t until then that the Thunderflame Beheamoth got a clear look at its appearance.
A nearly one hundred meters long body was covered in a colorful exoskeleton with more than a thousand sections; the nearly three-meter-wide body was flanked by countless legs similar to a centipede.
At its head and tail, it had a face with no eyes, just a mouth full of fanged teeth and a pair of huge, sinister-looking teeth.
Especially on its mouth, those giant teeth had a strange black energy flowing through them, and the surrounding sea water would disappear as soon as it got close, as if wiped away.
The almost fatal wound on the Single-horned Tiger Whale was obviously inflicted by this deep-sea monster’s teeth.
Otherwise, with its whale-shaped shield and thick scale armor, it would be almost difficult for a Mutated Beast of its same level to hurt it, let alone seriously injure it.
This is an ‘assassin’ that has evolved its sneak attack, invisibility, and one-shot kill abilities to the extreme.
Roar! The Thunderflame Beheamoth let out a dragon roar that shook the soul, and in an instant, the sea water behind it exploded, giving birth to a huge, pitch-black vacuum area.
As the sea water rushed in, the Thunderflame Beheamoth disappeared from its original position, its body radiating scorching flames appeared beside the mutant monster, reaching out with both claws.
Boom! This time, instead of using both claws to strike, the Thunderflame Beheamoth grabbed the monster’s head and stepped on the middle of its body with its rear claws.
Under the extreme heat of over two thousand degrees Celsius, the monster’s black energy on its body surface was continuously consumed and penetrated by the energy flames in just an instant.
This immediately made the monster let out a silent roar, its massive body, nearly a hundred meters long, struggled like a sea dragon, releasing terrifying power.
However, despite its strength, it couldn’t budge even a single strand of the terrifying Thunderflame Beheamoth’s hair.
Just at this moment, a shadow burst from the rear, the other head of the monster, its ferocious mouth resembling a poisonous dragon emerging from the sea, rushing toward the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s back.
But…sblood!
The flaming black sword tail pierced through everything, shot out at a terrifying speed beyond the speed of sound, and instantly penetrated that head’s neck, hanging it on the tail.
Roar!
Ignoring the monster’s struggle, the Thunderflame Beheamoth roared, and in a flash, its mouth opened wide, and a golden flame breath burst out, hitting the monster’s head.
With a temperature exceeding ten thousand degrees Celsius and a scorching high-temperature impact, the breath penetrated the monster’s skull in one shot, burning almost half of its head through.
Then it turned into a golden fire pillar, falling on the seabed below, and in an instant, the sea trench quaked with a single loud explosion releasing rings of fiery shockwaves along the seafloor..

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 161: Don’t Think About Your Wife All The Time, Hunting Moment_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 161: Don’t Think About Your Wife All The Time, Hunting Moment_2
Translator: 549690339
Under the impact of intense rolling flames, the seawater within a mile radius becomes violent and muddy, creating a shocking scene.
In front of a super soldier with maxed-out strength, agility, defense, and attack, the late-level-7 ‘assassin’ was instantly killed within the blink of an eye.
Or perhaps the Thunderflame Behemoth was too powerful. As a Mutated Beast King with seven different talents, ordinary mutated beasts of the same level had no chance to fight back against it.
Only when the mutant monster stopped struggling did the Thunderflame Behemoth cease its breath and slowly retract the intense flames emanating from its body.
Instantly, the sea submerges into darkness and silence once again.
Feeling the disappearance of the mutant monster’s aura, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which was swimming above, excitedly swam down: Buzz buzz buzz! Brother, you’re amazing!
Roar! Not bad at all.
The Thunderflame Behemoth casually tossed the monster’s corpse with its double claws and withdrew its tail from the dead monster’s head and neck before turning to look behind it.
Compared to when it first arrived, the Thunderflame Behemoth could keenly feel that the red halo on the surface of the giant skeleton had dimmed by a tiny bit.
The invisible power was weakening!
No wonder the Single-horned Tiger Whale had said there was no time to wait, as otherwise, once that layer of power vanished, the mutant monster, which had been guarding it for who knows how long, would definitely devour those two drops of ancient blood.
Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Behemoth growls and roars: Roar! Joe, we’ll each take one “beast” of that thing.
Buzz buzz buzz! Yes, one for each of us, brother. The Single-horned Tiger Whale nodded.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth continued to growl: Roar! But I think it’s better for you to absorb that drop of Ancient Blood yourself, rather than thinking about taking it back.
You have to remember that only when you become stronger can you find more resources to bring back.
Roar! Otherwise, if you save everything for your family of Tiger Whales and fail to improve your own strength, you might be killed and eaten by a more powerful Mutated Creature one day.
Roar! By then, your wife will become another Tiger Whale’s wife, and your children will be bullied by other Tiger Whales.
Seeing that this fellow has helped it obtain quite a few good things, the Thunderflame Behemoth advises it with good intentions, not wanting this fellow to be eaten by a more powerful Mutated Creature one day.
Buzz buzz buzz! Brother, my wife won’t change. The Single-horned Tiger Whale couldn’t help but defend his wife.
Roar! That doesn’t matter! So, it’s settled, you’ll eat that drop of Ancient Blood later.
Being overbearing, the Thunderflame Behemoth said, slapping the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s head with a paw. The terrifying power burst from a random paw slammed it away.
Buzz buzz buzz! Brother, be gentle, your power is too strong.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale felt a little aggrieved after being slapped away by a paw.
Roar! Look at the gap between you and me. You used to be so much taller than me, but now you can’t even handle one of my paws. Useless!
After saying that, the Thunderflame Behemoth snorted and swam toward the giant skeleton, intending to wait for the power outside to disappear and then swallow a drop of Ancient Blood.
Although it didn’t know what use it would have after eating it, the instinct from the evolution of life couldn’t go wrong, and there must be some incredible benefits.
Maybe this thing is also useful for humans. After that layer of defensive power disappears, see if we can leave a little to try on our main body.
The Thunderflame Behemoth felt that this drop of blood was more terrifying than high-order dragon essence blood.
If it were integrated into the sixth level Dragon Elephant Technique during strengthening, the strength and techniques of the main body might receive a terrifying boost.
As the Thunderflame Behemoth stayed underwater, quietly waiting, the astute Single-horned Tiger Whale showed thought in its eyes, thinking about the Thunderflame Behemoth’s words from earlier.
Was it really wrong?
Soon, the dark sea trench fell into silence.
Occasionally, mutated creatures that were attracted down would be killed by the Thunderflame Behemoth or devoured by the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Fortunately, because of the invisible red light, the attraction of the two drops of Ancient Blood reached a range of only a few hundred meters. Beyond this distance, it couldn’t be sensed.
Otherwise, even the powerful Thunderflame Behemoth may not necessarily be able to defend it.
After all, there were too many terrifying mutated beasts in the depths of the sea.
Early the next morning, everyone gathered their belongings and set out early with their weapons.
The fog had dissipated during the daytime, making it less dense.
Soon, everyone climbed to the top of a mountain peak, and Howard Lee pointed ahead and said solemnly: “After entering that mountain range, we will be entering the hunting ground of those scale-armored alien beasts.”
“Based on my observations, these mutated creatures have a certain level of organization. The Level 5 Mutated Beast King usually stays in its lair and doesn’t stray far away.”
“Those several Level 4 alien beasts patrol their territory separately, occasionally preying on mutated creatures.”
“On the other hand, the Level 3 scale-armored alien beasts would separate into small squads, hunt as a group, and then bring back a hunted prey for the Mutated Beast King to feed on.”
Compared to the Thunderflame Behemoth that digests food and constantly evolves, these normal mutated beasts have similar food requirements as before their mutation.
They can eat a full meal or be fine with eating once a week.
Because, in addition to eating, their bodies rely more on Heavenly Energy. They actively absorb energy to maintain their body’s functionality, temper their flesh, and enhance their bloodline.
“These alien beasts gather in the valley in the morning and disperse around 10 am, returning to the valley before dark.”
Jack Clark slowly said: “So, if we want to catch them all at once, it’s best to act before noon, or else it’s easy to startle the snake in the grass.”
Howard Lee nodded: “That’s the idea. There’s still more than a hundred kilometers from here to those mutated creatures’ lair, it won’t take long to get there..”

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 161 Don’t Always Think About Your Wife, Hunting Time_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 161 Don’t Always Think About Your Wife, Hunting Time_3
Translator: 549690339
Freya Louise checked her bullets, softly saying, “Considering this, 1 believe we should first take down the Twin-winged Flying Dragon.”
No matter when, having control of the skies confers a significant advantage, allowing both attack and defense, and Mutated Creatures that have evolved to fly are even more troublesome.
Howard Lee pointed towards the mountain peak on the side of the mountain ranges, “The nest of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon should be on that mountain, 1 couldn’t pinpoint exactly where when I was there.”
Next, Howard Lee pointed to another mountain peak nearby, “The valley at the base of the mountain on the side is home to those Scale-armored alien beasts, the two locations are not far from each other.”
Jack Clark pondered quietly, “Flying Unique Beasts have amazing vision, if many people go there, they will easily be discovered, and they might draw the attention of the Scale-armored alien beasts once the battle starts.”
“This is what we’ll do, we’ll split into two groups, Freya and 1 will try to take down the flying dragon first, Howard, you and your team will sneak to the lair of the Scale-armored alien beasts.”
“If those Scale-armored alien beasts become violent when we are killing the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, you delay and hold them off until we get there.” “If Freya and I cannot find the lair of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, we also will return before ten o’clock to meet up, it’s just over ten kilometers so we can get there quickly.”
“Alright.”
“Okay.”
Howard Lee and the rest had no objections to this arrangement.
After he finished speaking, Jack Clark looked at Justin Welan and the others, “Mr. Willard, your defense is strong, but it does not surpass the limit of Level 4, just assist Zac Lyons and the others.”
“And the rest of you guys, the main reason 1 brought you this time is to act as porters, don’t show off.”
Marcus Lee chuckled, “Don’t worry, we all know our own strengths, we won’t take risks. This time we came to learn how to hunt a Level 5 Mutant Beast King.”
Zac Lyons nodded in agreement, “That’s right, after we breakthrough the Fourth Layer Heaven in the future, we’ll have to find a Mutant Beast with a king-level bloodline to kill. We can’t let you hog all the bragging rights.” “Screw off, we kill the King-level Bloodline Mutant Beasts for Contribution Points.” shared Jack Clark, speechless
After joking around for a while, all of them put up serious faces, nodding their heads in agreement, then they divided into two teams and disappeared into the forest of the Vast Wilderness.
Over the decades, not only have creatures mutated, but plants have also experienced many abnormalities.
There are ancient trees with hundreds of meters in height and dozens of meters in diameter everywhere. Branches crisscrossed, blocking the sky, making it appear humid and dim. Moreover, vines have grown all over between the branches.
Facing this situation, the Black-Red True Strength circulated around Jack Clark’s body, radiating an oppressive aura. He turned into a beam of black and red radiance, charging forward.
Wherever he went, the weeds flew up and the vines were broken. Some ordinary Mutated Creatures that were lying dormant haven’t had time to react were smashed to pieces, appearing extremely domineering.
Due to the coverings of the towering ancient trees, the slight disturbance caused by Jack Clark was almost completely drowned out.
The girl, carrying a bulky sniper cannon on her back and with an array of bullet clips on her waist, burst with speed following closely behind Jack Clark.
Under Jack Clark’s full-speed charge, the two quickly arrived at the foot of the mountain where the Twin-winged Flying Dragon resided.
At that moment, a roar echoed across the sky from above. A Mutant Creature, over twenty meters long with a wingspan of more than thirty meters, flew in from a distance
It was holding prey that was over ten meters long in its claws, piercing the sky like a fighter descending onto the mountain peak.
Both of them turned their gaze, as a smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face, “Good things come to those who wait, judging by its landing spot on the western side of the mountainside, let’s go and take a look.”
“Alright.” Freya nodded, following Jack Clark as they dashed up along the mountainside.
Because the vegetation was lush, the pair of them flashed through the mountains like two shadows, swiftly covering a distance of over ten kilometers.
However, as they drew close to the western side of the mountain peak, the pair suddenly slowed down their speed.
Soon, as they approached the mountain ridge behind the mountain peak, a cave that was extended from a huge rock protruding from the middle of the cliff at a height of over six hundred meters came into view.
The two standing at the foot of the cliff could vaguely make out the tail of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon.
Jack Clark turned to Freya and said softly, “Next, I’ll climb up quietly and 1 see if I can ambush and severely injure it, if not, 1 can at least scare it into flight.” “Freya, you find a hidden and safe location and prepare the Magnetic Black Gold Armor-piercing Bullet. When it takes flight, give it a shot.”
Freya, who was in the mid-stage of the Third Layer Heaven, would not be able to hurt a Level 5 Mutated Creature unless her weapon was the characteristic sniper cannon and had a Magnetic armor-piercing bullet.
Freya nodded gravely, “Alright, but you also need to be careful.”
Jack Clark smiled, “Don’t worry, for me now, ordinary Level 5 Mutated Creatures can’t even withstand one blow.”
After Jack Clark was finished speaking he began running the Hidden God Method, hiding his breath. He came to the cliff directly beneath the nest, then his hands plunged into the rock, as if it was tofu.
From a distance, it looked like a black and red bug crawling straight up along the Straight and Steep Cliff. It was silent and swift.
As Jack Clark was scaling the cliffside, Freya had also chosen a firing position with the mountain cliff behind her. Her Cultivation Methods began circulating, gradually causing her to disappear.
Or perhaps it would be more accurate to say she was clearly there, but her presence was gone, which was very eerie.
At the same time in Freya’s hand, the Magnetic Energy Cannon Barrel was installed on the sniper cannon, the black gold armor-piercing bullet has been loaded, and the runes on the gun body were faintly glowing, charging energy. In just a short time, Jack Clark reached beneath the bird nest on the side of the cliff….

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 162: The Ultimate Strength, Little Brother, Can You Do It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 162: The Ultimate Strength, Little Brother, Can You Do It?
Translator: 549690339
On the rocks protruding from the cliff, a mutated beast resembling a lizard, covered in red scales and with wings on its back, was eating with its head down.
This mutated beast looked like a western giant dragon, but it did not have the aura of a dragon variant beast.
However, even so, its huge size and invisible Level 5 aura were impressive, and its powerful scale armor and flesh were able to withstand high-altitude bombardment.
It could easily demolish a small building with a single blow.
Moreover, the instantaneous burst of speed it achieved when it descended from the sky almost reached the speed of sound.
It can be said that although this mutated beast did not awaken its dragon bloodline, it was much more powerful than many western giant dragons in movies.
But just as the Twin-winged Flying Dragon was eating, a terrifyingly powerful aura erupted from beneath it.
Boom!
As the mountain wall below shook, a figure leaped up several dozen meters and appeared above the Twin-winged Flying Dragon. It was Jack Clark wearing black and red crystal armor.
His head was facing downward and his legs were bent, pressing against the rock wall behind him.
Immediately, Jack Clarks muscles swelled like inflated balloons, and endless strength flowed out and merged with the Dragon Elephant True Strength. In an instant, a terrifying aura erupted.
Roar!
With the roar of the Dragon Roar Elephant Roar, Jack Clarks slightly bent legs exploded with power, shattering the rock wall, and his entire body turned into a black and red beam falling from the sky.
Boom!
In an instant, heaven and earth changed color, and the red-black War Halberd wrapped in halberd skill cut across the sky, as if the sky was collapsing with a loud crash.
All of this happened in the blink of an eye. The Twin-winged Flying Dragon only had time to let out a ferocious roar, spread its wings in anger, and a tangible wave of red energy exploded from its body.
Sharp Sword Qi-like glimmers swirled around the red energy, cutting through the mountain wall, and leaving cracks several meters long. At that moment, the Twin-winged Flying Dragon seemed like a storm dragon.
Its huge body instantly soared into the sky, intending to dodge the incoming blow from above.
Boom!
The black and red War halberd pierced through everything, and under that ferociously powerful force, the raging wind collapsed, the red glow vanished, and in the blink of an eye it landed on its right wing, which was spread in anger.
Bang! In an instant, a large piece of red scale armor exploded and blood and flesh flew everywhere.
Its right wing, stretched out over fifteen meters and ten meters wide, was nearly shattered by Jack Clark’s halberd attack, with only a few broken pieces of flesh and armor hanging on the bones.
After shattering half of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s wing, the War Halberd’s momentum was not reduced, and it violently crashed into the protruding rock below.
Boom! An instant later, the sky collapsed, and the rocks that were twenty meters above the cliff and thirty meters wide collapsed, and countless broken stones fell. Smoke and dust filled the air.
Roar!
The Twin-winged Flying Dragon, which had narrowly escaped the fatal blow but had its wing shattered, let out a shriek.
In the moment its huge body rolled through the air, its tail behind it swept out, a roaring explosion of air appearing in front of Jack Clark, who had just stopped in mid-air after the strike.
In mid-air, Jack Clark didn’t expect this mutated beast to react so quickly. It was still capable of launching an attack even as it was injured. He couldn’t help but sweep his halberd.
Roar! The Twin-winged Flying Dragon screamed again, its tail shattering with a casual blow from Jack Clark, and flesh and blood splattered all over.
This was the terrifying power of True Dragon Power. When swinging the War Halberd, not only was the attack heavy and fearsome, but also sharp and unparalleled. Moreover, each strike would cause a massive explosion.
However, with no leverage in the air, Jack Clark was also slammed into the mountain wall hundreds of meters away by the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s vengeful blow, with a sonic boom accompanying it.
At once, a large section of the mountain wall exploded, and countless debris fell from the sky, filling the air with smoke and dust.
High in the air, the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, with its right wing shattered, struggled to flap its wings and, although swaying unsteadily, did not fall to the ground thanks to the red whirlwind surrounding it.
However, this Twin-winged Flying Dragon had no intention of continuing its attack. Enduring the pain, its huge body turned slightly in the air and prepared to flee.
It had been frightened by the bursting attack Jack Clark had launched from an ambush.
The blow had nearly made the Twin-winged Flying Dragon feel the breath of death.
If not for the gut instinct that made the Twin-winged Flying Dragon retreat slightly before sensing Jack Clark’s presence, that blow would have landed on its head.
Such a terrifying enemy was the first that the Twin-winged Flying Dragon had encountered since mutating. It was too frightening. It wanted to return to its group.
But just as the Twin-winged Flying Dragon was turning around, it sensed a strong sense of danger again.
Behind the rocks below, Freya Louise, who had been waiting to strike, raised her sniper cannon. The muzzle hummed and runes flashed, the gun barrel gleaming faintly as she aimed at the Twin-winged Flying Dragon hundreds of meters above her.
Bang! In an instant, the injured right wing of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon exploded once again.
However, this time the injury was not severe, only creating a basin-sized bloody hole, but the wound was located at the largest bone root of the right wing.
Moreover, half of its wing had already been shattered by Jack Clark’s single halberd strike, leaving only a few pieces of bone armor. In an instant, its right wing was completely broken and it couldn’t help but let out another miserable roar.
Roar!
Burning red blood gushed out, and the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, like a plummeting fighter aircraft, fell into the forest on the mountainside below, shaking the ground.
All of this happened in the blink of an eye.
It wasn’t until then, when Jack Clark, who had been embedded into the mountain wall, used his strength to pull himself out and fall straight down from several hundred meters above.
Thud!
The moment Jack Clark landed, the ground around him for several meters collapsed with a loud explosion. Dirt splattered everywhere, startling Freya Louise.
Because he was wearing a helmet, Jack Clark couldn’t see the astonishment on the girl’s face. Nodding at her, he praised: “Well done, Freya Louise..”

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 162: The Ultimate Power, Can You Make It, Little Brother?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 162: The Ultimate Power, Can You Make It, Little Brother?_2
Translator: 549690339
He did not expect that the Twin-winged Flying Dragon could still barely fly under such conditions.
However, fortunately, Freya Louise’s marksmanship was as accurate as ever.
The girl replaced the magnetic energy cannon barrel with a click and said modestly, “It was only because you wounded it and made it less agile, that I could hit it with one shot.”
As for why she didn’t shoot its head, of course, she was not confident.
Once a mutated beast reached level 5, it had a strong sense of danger like a cultivator. Therefore, for safety, Freya Louise chose to target its injured wings. A wing-broken flying beast was no different from a dead one.
“I’ll go kill that Twin-winged Flying Dragon first, and you follow behind.”
“Okay.”
The moment Freya Louise nodded, Jack Clark had already burst through the air with a terrifying supersonic speed, leaving behind rolling white waves.
Only the white tail in the air that lingered for a long time and the standing girl with a gun were left.
Seeing this scene, Freya Louise fell silent.
Back when he hadn’t broken through the Four Layer Heaven yet and hunted the Mutated Dragon Armor Beast, Jack Clark also burst out with a terrible near-supersonic movement speed and clashed hard with the Dragon Beast.
But at that time, he entered the extreme burst state, and it was only close to supersonic speed.
Unexpectedly, after only half a month, he could easily enter supersonic speed after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, and his physique might have already surpassed the Fifth Layer.
What a freak!
In the midst of her sigh, the girl’s figure blinked and followed.
Woo woo roar!!
In the chaos of the forest, the Twin-winged Flying Dragon with a broken right wing and only a bit of skin and meat left struggled to get up from the ground. As a level 5 mutated beast, itsPhysical strength was very formidable. Even if it fell from hundreds of meters high and broke several large trees, it would only suffer from wounds and churning Qi Blood.
However, just as it was about to find a place to hide and recover, the forest behind it exploded, and Jack Clark descended from the sky amid the dirt and debris, landing not far away.
Roar!
Looking at Jack Clark in the Black-Red armor, the Twin-winged Flying Dragon let out a fierce roar, its eyes filled with resentment. It was this two-legged creature that had wounded it.
At this point, even the less intelligent mutated beast knew that it had to kill Jack Clark if it wanted to survive the day.
Thinking of this, a violent aura erupted from the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, and its red light flourished. Sharp wind blades surrounded its body, forming a storm that tore everything apart.
Unlike other flying mutated creatures, although this mutated beast had a broken wing, its lizard-like body still retained some combat power.
With its tail added, the 28-meter-long body stood six meters tall at the shoulder, with its horrible and hideous neck and head reaching up to four floors high, making it terrifyingly menacing.
But this kind of aura was not enough to scare Jack Clark.
The Black-Red Radiance circulated around his body, and the weighty aura seemed to repel the surrounding air, forming circles of sweeping wind.
Even more so, the Black-gold Battle Halberd in his hand exuded a heavy, sharp breath, and the invisible Halberd Skill tore the ground, causing cracks.
Suddenly, the Twin-winged Flying Dragon roared violently, and its huge body, wrapped in a whirlwind of sharp blades, rushed towards Jack Clark, casting a large shadow.
Boom!
With a single step, Jack Clark seemed to shake the entire world. With a long cry, his battle halberd swept across, and a torrent of Black-Red Radiance soared into the sky.
With the Overbearing True Dragon Power, the physical strength and the heavy battle halberd weighing two tons and cutting at supersonic speed-
The force of this blow was unstoppable. It scattered the Red Storm of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, its red energy protection, hard scale armor, and huge claws.
Boom! Black-Red Radiance surged into the sky, and the flesh and blood exploded. Amid the roar of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, its right claw was blasted away by Jack Clark.
With the sharp Black-Red Radiance splattering around, several wounds three to four meters long and half a meter deep were torn open all over the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s body.
Roar! In the midst of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s wailing, the world suddenly darkened, and a terrifying aura erupted from the high altitude, which was Jack Clark who had blasted its right claw.
At this moment, it seemed that the whole world was submerged in Black-Red Radiance.
Boom!
Dazzling Black-Red Radiance fell from the sky, and under the indescribable terrifying force, the air was compressed into thick waves of liquefaction.
Under the breath of death, the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s eyes turned blood-red, and the power of a level 5 mutated beast within its body erupted wildly, faintly forming a circle of red flames burning.
Roar!
The hideous mouth, covered in red energy flames, gaped open in anger, roaring out, wanting to devour the Black-Red Radiance that fell from the sky. Bang! Under the heavy, overbearing, and unstoppable blow, half of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s head exploded, and then the Black-Red Radiance landed on the ground without losing momentum.
Boom!
Immediately, the ground collapsed with a loud noise, forming a huge deep pit. A series of cracks spread over ten meters around it, looking like a grotesque, weeping ghost face.
The shockwave caused by the explosive force turned into raging winds, sweeping up the dirt and weeds in the sky, creating quite a terrifying scene. With a bang, the massive body of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon crashed to the ground, and its heated blood spewed out like a fountain, dyeing the earth red.
After being strengthened to the Transcendent Level, the heavy battle halberd brought Jack Clark’s terrible strength to its peak.
At this moment, an ordinary level 5 mutated beast had almost no power to fight back against him.
It should be noted that Jack Clark’s realm was just at the early stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven, and he hadn’t been there for a long time..

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 162: The Ultimate Power, Can You Make It, Little Brother?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 162: The Ultimate Power, Can You Make It, Little Brother?_3
Translator: 549690339
By the time Freya Louise caught up, she saw Jack Clark pulling the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd from the Twin-winged Flying Dragon’s head and looked back at her: “I heard the roars of Unique Beasts over there. It must be Howard and the others making their move.”
“I’ll go and support them first. You follow, and we’ll drag the corpse away later.”
Without waiting for Freya’s response, Jack Clark burst through the air with a loud boom, leaving a long white trail behind him and disappeared in the distance.
Freya took a deep breath, glanced at the Level 5 Mutated Beast’s corpse, and followed…
At the bottom of a valley more than ten kilometers away, there were several Scale-armored alien beasts with lengths ranging from ten to twenty meters, resembling giant lizards.
But, calling them lizards would be an oversimplification, as these mutated creatures resembled four-legged earth dragons, terrifyingly fierce.
Apart from that, the scale armor on these beasts came in various colors, some black and red interweaved, some gray and blue intertwined, making it a dizzying array of colors.
Howard and the others hid among the trees on the hillside by the entrance to the valley.
As they observed, they suddenly heard a shrill roar from the distant sky.
Immediately, the Scale-armored Unique Beasts below began to stir, and at the far end of the valley, the largest beast looked up, staring in the direction of the scream loudly.
Another blood-curdling roar came from the sky.
At that moment, the twenty-six-meter-long, seven-meter-tall Red Armored Beast covered in red scale armor suddenly stood up and roared.
Following the Level 5 Blood Armored Beast King’s roar, the other scaly Unique Beasts crawled out from the mountain walls, boulders, and grass, emitting uneasy, restless growls while looking at the Beast King.
In the forest, Justin Welan and the others’ expressions grew serious: “Jack has made his move.”
“These mutant beasts must be related to that Twin-winged Flying Dragon.”
“They want to support the Twin-winged Flying Dragon.”
Howard said solemnly, “We can’t let these mutant beasts leave the valley, or we won’t be able to catch them all at once.”
“Marcus, you and the others go block the valley entrance and stop those Level 3 Mutated Beasts. Don’t force a fight, just outmaneuver them with the terrain. If it gets too difficult, let Justin take over.”
“I’ll hold off the Level 5 Mutant Beast King.”
Justin Welan raised an eyebrow: “Howard, are you sure you can hold off a Unique Beast with a king-level bloodline?”
It’s not that he underestimated him, but these king-level bloodline mutated beasts were too powerful. In the past, a battle with a Level 3 Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King had left them struggling and vomiting blood.
Howard replied gravely, “I’m sure. Just to hold it off for a short while, not to kill it.”
“Moreover, judging from the screams of that Twin-winged Flying Dragon, Jack should have succeeded. With his strength, he’ll be here soon.”
“Alright.”
“Let’s charge!”
With that, Howard let out a long howl, his body shimmering with red True Power. In an instant, a crazy and demonic aura erupted, and he rushed down the hill carrying a steel pillar.
“We’re up as well.”
Yellow True Power circulated around Justin’s body, exuding a heavy atmosphere. He followed with the heavy shield, but his direction was towards the entrance of the valley.
Their plan was to block the exit, preventing the regular Scale-armored Unique Beasts from escaping since they were a source of Contribution Points.
Roar, Roar, Roar!!
Faced with the sudden appearance of two-legged opponents, the scaly giant lizards roared in fury.
As Howard rushed towards the group of mutant beasts with the steel pillar, three Unique Beasts with a body length of more than ten meters and three meters high responded with a growl.
In the blink of an eye, the distance between them was only about ten meters. At that moment, Howard’s aura soared again, and his internal power burst forth like a raging storm, swinging the steel pillar.
Boom!
With incredible strength, the air in front of the reddened steel pillar seemed to be compressed into a liquid, creating a series of transparent shockwaves. Boom, Boom, Boom!!
Under the insane and overbearing power, the three-ton scaly Unique Beasts were sent flying by Howard, who was showing an amazing aura.
As the other mutant beasts were about to pounce on Howard and he was ready to send a few more flying to ease the pressure on Justin and the others, a roar came from behind.
Roar!
Upon the Blood Armored Beast King’s roar, the Level 3 and 4 Mutant Beasts that were about to pounce on Howard suddenly halted, forming a giant circle around him.
They respectfully watched as the Red Blood Armored Exotic Beast approached slowly, enveloping the area in a terrifying sense of oppression.
This Beast King was different from ordinary Scale-armored alien beasts.
Although larger in size, its body was well-proportioned and streamlined according to aerodynamics, full of explosive power potential.
Even the blood-colored scale armor covering its body was half as thin as the other scaly Unique Beasts’, clinging tightly to its body in a beautiful manner.
Combined with its long, powerful limbs, sharp claws, and the faintly discernible terrifying aura, Howard immediately felt a chill run up his spine.
This Beast King was terrifying and dangerous!
Watching a cautious Howard, the Blood Armored Beast King’s eyes were cold and merciless, along with a faint hint of mockery and ridicule.
It seemed to be mocking Howard’s recklessness, daring to provoke it, as if courting death.
In an instant, Howard’s eyes turned cold as he realized he was being looked down upon by a Mutant Beast. His body was instantly filled with the booming surge of his vigorous Qi Blood.
Bang! Howard blasted forward, barreling towards the Blood Armored Beast King with the steel pillar in hand, exuding a majestic aura.
The four-meter-long steel pillar in his hand stirred the air with a deafening roar, creating a terrifying rumble as solidified, white waves rolled like a tsunami.
Boom!
Under the seemingly carefree but incredibly fast and terrifying claw of the Blood Armored Beast King, Howard was sent flying with a loud boom.
An explosion occurred on the mountain wall a hundred meters away, and smoke and dust filled the air.
Immediately, Justin Welan and the others who had just rushed down from the valley opened their eyes wide.
No way, brother, you looked so fierce, how come you were sent flying like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 163: Bloodline Strength, Demon God Jack Clark (Request for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 163: Bloodline Strength, Demon God Jack Clark (Request for Monthly Votes)
Translator: 549690339
Roar! A non-human low growl sounded from below the smoke-filled mountain wall.
Howard Lee, who had been sent flying by the Blood Armored Beast King’s attack, stood up. His battle armor was deformed, his eyes covered in blood, filled with endless madness and demonic intent.
An incredibly hot explosion of Qi Blood erupted within him, tinting his True Strength blood-red like fresh blood, burning, and gradually a terrifying aura that made the hearts tremble spread out.
This aura was somewhat similar to the Blood Armored Beast King, and also belonged to the ‘king’.
Crack crack!
Howard Lee’s muscles continuously swelled, pushing open his modified battle armor, revealing a pitch-black steel-like body and explosive muscles beneath.
His entire body soared from 2.2 meters to 2.5 meters, like an ancient giant.
Huff huff!
In this state, Howard Lee’s aura was extremely terrifying, even creating strong winds every time he breathed. A huge, fierce, blood-colored phantom would occasionally flash behind him.
Such an astonishing aura made the Blood Armored Beast King’s eyes sharpen involuntarily.
Boom!
Howard Lee charged again, causing the dirt to explode beneath his feet with every step. The steel pillar in his hand danced, stirring up a thunderous roar, like a mad Blood Dragon.
An awe-inspiring aura!
Roar!
Seeing this tiny insect unleash even more incredible strength, the Blood Armored Beast King’s eyes were still cold, filled with ridicule and disdain.
However, although it seemed careless on the surface, the Blood Armored Beast King did not let its guard down. A more brutal and violent aura erupted from it.
Crack crack!
Instantly, with the Blood Armored Beast King at the center, the air within a ten-meter radius solidified. Following that, a large portion of ‘space’ shattered as its giant claw swept through.
This was the innate ability of the Blood Armored Beast King, Air Vibration.
However, unlike the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s indiscriminate vibrations, its shocks could solidify the air within a certain range and then shatter it, forming a destructive impact.
Boom!
As the steel pillar and the dragon claw collided, the earth shook instantly, and a circle of red and white shockwaves exploded.
Such terrifying power even squeezed the air into a solidified white halo, stirring up rolling smoke and dust, causing heaven and earth to tremble, and sending rocks flying everywhere.
Inside the 3.58-meter diameter pit, Howard Lee’s True Strength swirled around him like a Blood Flame, and it echoed through the steel pillar, effectively blocking the Blood Armored Beast King’s claw.
Compared to the human body cultivated in True Martial Arts, the flesh of these Mutated Creatures was even more powerful and robust, with dozens or even hundreds of times the terrifying power of a human being of the same level.
As a result, even after Howard Lee entered the explosive state of the Bull Devil Battle Body, he was unable to shake the Blood Armored Beast King as an Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven.
Moreover, the four-meter-long steel pillar appeared small beneath the Blood Armored Beast King’s claw, which was as thick as a room, like a slender chopstick.
Roar!
With a brutal roar, the Blood Armored Beast King’s power exploded in its claw. Howard Lee’s body sank instantly, and a flush of Blood Qi rushed to his face.
However, the battle was not about strength. With blood light leaping in Howard Lee’s eyes, he tilted his body slightly and instantly burst with power, using it to pull and influence the momentum.
Boom!
Caught off guard, the Blood Armored Beast King felt a heaviness beneath its claw, and the massive body was almost toppled by the pulling force combined with its own strength.
Roar!
Almost flipped over by an insect, the Blood Armored Beast King became somewhat violent, and its giant claw swept out.
Boom! Instantly, the ground shattered, creating a pit over 10 meters in diameter. But by then, Howard Lee had already appeared more than 10 meters away, dodging the attack.
Roar! At this moment, a roar of a dying wail echoed from the distance again.
Immediately, the Blood Armored Beast King furiously looked towards the direction where the Twin-winged Flying Dragon died, revealing strong killing intent in its eyes and letting out a fierce roar!
Roar! With the roar, a dozen or so Level 4 and Level 3 scale-armored alien beasts suddenly moved, charging towards the outside of the valley under the Blood Armored Beast King’s command.
However, as the Blood Armored Beast King also wanted to follow suit, Howard Lee charged again with his steel pillar, causing the Blood Armored Beast King’s eyes to turn cold.
Boom boom boom boom!
In an instant, the man and the beast began their furious fight.
However, it could hardly be considered a fight as the Blood Armored Beast King was merely playing. Its huge body was agile and nimble, dodging all of Howard Lee’s attacks while leaving only afterimages behind.
Every time its giant claw swept out, it would explode a large portion of the air, creating violent shockwaves that sent Howard Lee flying.
Especially its sharp giant claw, which left several deep marks on Howard Lee’s alloy steel pillar each time it swung, even with his True Strength covering and amplifying its power.
Nevertheless, Howard Lee was a genius who had made Jack Clark take more than one glance at him.
Every time he was blasted hundreds of meters away, he would quickly get up with blood streaming from the corners of his mouth and wounds appearing all over his body. His aura only grew wilder and crazier.
His body, which had swelled to 2.6 meters, was like a cast of black gold, possessing terrifying strength. Every blow stirred up a violent wind wave, with sands flying and rocks sweeping.
Such a terrifying momentum made even the Blood Armored Beast King take it a bit more seriously. Fine; the gap in strength between the two was too large for Howard Lee to make any impact on the Blood Armored Beast King.
Roar!
While Howard Lee was being crushed by the Blood Armored Beast King, more than a dozen scale-armored alien beasts let out violent roars and agilely rushed towards the valley entrance where Justin Welan and others were located.
The solitary battle was a habit of the Beast King; in contrast, these gregarious mutated beasts were more accustomed to cooperative hunts.
As for the few Level 4 scale-armored alien beasts, they lagged a little behind.
Their eyes showed hesitation, glancing at the Beast King fighting in the distance, then looking in the direction outside the valley..

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 163: Bloodline Strength, Demon God Jack Clark (Asking for Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 163: Bloodline Strength, Demon God Jack Clark (Asking for Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
