“Good to see you.”
Yellow True Power enveloped Justin Welan, his battle armor and the larger, thicker heavy shield after the modification, making him look like a battle-ready Mysterious Martial, guarding the entrance to the valley.
Bang!
A Mutated Beast that stood 3 meters tall at the shoulder and more than ten meters long charged headlong into the heavy shield at high speed. In an instant, the ground in several yards shook, breaking apart.
However, Justin Welan remained unscathed, while the Scale-armored Giant Beast that crashed into the shield suffered a bloody head, and a stronger shock force flung it more than ten meters away while it screeched pitifully.
This was the power of the Black Tortoise Solid Earth Skill – rooted in the earth, unshakeable as a mountain.
“Spread out, revolve around Justin, and take out these Level 3 Mutated Beasts one by one,” Zac Lyons shouted.
Bam!
During this back-and-forth, Marcus Lee appeared in a flash. In his hands was a hammer that broke a Scale-armored Beast’s hind legs with a loud crash. He then rolled around to avoid the tail that was rushing toward him.
Swoosh! White Veil darted around leaving behind afterimages, his long sword radiating Sword Qi as he weaved through the Mutant Beasts, leaving behind large wounds.
In contrast, Mullen Weisz, who also used a sword, was much more forceful and domineering.
With a swirling sword Qi, his heavy sword, as wide as a door, tore through a Level 3 Scale-armored Beast’s chest with a single stroke, then he was tossed flying.
Bam! Mullen Weisz was swept away by a tail that came sweeping across in mid-air and let out a scream.
“Damn it, be careful, Mr. Woodley.”
Speaking out, Justin Welan gruffly called out, a powerful force of gravity erupted from him, drawing the massive tail that was originally pounding towards Marcus Lee towards him.
Bam! Under that blow, scales on the tail of the Scale-armored Beast exploded, and flesh flew in all directions, while Justin Welan stayed unyielding.
As geniuses, though their combat prowess could not spread as fearsomely as Jack Clark’s, they had no problem slaying Mutated Beasts of the same level. Together, they were hunting Level 4 Mutated Creatures.
However, because there were more Scale-armored Beasts, they had severely injured some, but had not yet found an opportunity to kill them.
No helping it; these mutated creatures were massive and incredibly resilient.
Especially after a Level 4 Early Stage Scale-armored Beast joined the fray, everyone else, besides Justin Welan, felt an immense pressure.
Roar Roar Roar!
Just when the battle in the valley was dangerous and intense, with four Level 4 Scale-armored Beasts ready to join in and shred Justin Welan and his team into pieces, a terrifying aura appeared in the distance.
All of a sudden, the Blood Armored Beast King, which was suppressing Howard Lee and continuously knocking him back, turned its giant head rapidly.
The moment it saw Jack Clark, and especially when it smelled some Twin-winged Flying Dragon blood remaining on his battle armor, the eyes of the Blood Armored Beast King turned blood-red.
Roar!
An extremely ferocious aura erupted from the Blood Armored Beast King.
“Howard Lee, hold back that Beast King for one minute.”
Jack Clark let out a long howl and in an instant, black and red radiance flashed around him. With a god-like aura resonating from him, he leaped high into the air by a hundred meters.
At this moment, Jack Clark, like a black and red sun in the sky with his War Halberd flashing brightly, descended upon a Level 4 Scale-armored Beast with the terrifying power that seemed capable of sinking the earth.
Roar!
The Scale-armored Beast, which was 19 meters long and had a head as large as a single room, let out an enraged roar. A blue radiance surged around it as it bared its teeth to snap at Jack Clark.
The strongest attribute of carnivorous Mutated Beasts was their ferocious claws and formidable jaws. Having mutated, their fleshly bodies enhanced their instincts.
Bang!
Accompanied by the descending War Halberd, Black-Red True Power exploded, the beast’s energy collapsed, and half of its head was blown up by the formidable and sharp halberd.
From a distance, it looked like hundreds of kilograms of high explosives were detonating in mid-air, with the black-red Qi mixed with flesh and blood as it burst out several dozen meters like a raging wind.
With a single strike, a late-stage Level 4 Mutated Beast was killed instantly.
This terrifying power stunned everyone. Marcus Lee, who just smashed a Level 3 Mutant Beast to death, was wide-eyed: “My God, he’s so fierce!”
Roar!
At the end of the valley, having propelled Howard Lee away with a claw, the Blood Armored Beast King let out an even more brutal roar. His eyes turned completely blood-red, filled with a boundless killing intent.
Because the late-stage Level 4 mutant that was just killed was its first offspring.
Fueled in its rage, the Beast King, with a thunderous roar, rushed to the side of the valley wall, ready to charge at Jack Clark and tear him apart.
But just then, there was a sonic boom from afar, a steel pillar wrapped in a red radiance shot out, bringing along a ring of white sonic booms towards the Beast’s King’s head.
The powerful attack stopped the Beast King in its tracks. With a swift swipe of its claw, it sent the steel pillar flying with a bang, forcing its massive body to halt.
From afar, Howard Lee, who was covered with wounds and bleeding profusely, was more ferocious, raced towards the Beast King as if possessed, picking up a steel pillar on the way.
Seeing Jack Clark kill a Level 4 Peak Mutant with a single strike made Howard Lee even madder.
Not powerful enough! He was still not powerful enough! He could still be more powerful!
Driven by his madness and injuries, Howard Lee’s Qi Blood started burning like a fire, stirring that king-like power within him. Golden scales started forming on his body.
Boom Boom Boom! The battle became even more intense deep in the valley.
The Beast King was eager to rush over and kill Jack Clark, but madly and heedlessly fighting Howard Lee held him back. This scene was a reminiscence of the time Howard had stood up against the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King.
Under these circumstances, even though the Beast King was crushing Howard Lee, it was held back for a moment.
Roar Roar Roar!
The three remaining Level 4 Scale-armored Beasts let out a roar of terror and anger. Their enormous bodies radiated a mix of colorful and black energy. Around them, poisonous gas permeated and a raging wind swirled..

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 163: Bloodline Strength, Demon God Jack Clark (Asking for Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 163: Bloodline Strength, Demon God Jack Clark (Asking for Monthly Tickets)_3
Translator: 549690339
Under the earth-shaking aura, three Level 4 Unique Beasts pounced at Jack Clark, who had killed one of their own.
But…
Boom, boom, boom! Accompanied by the sonic boom, Jack Clark instantly transformed into a black-red pirefining and shot out.
The War Halberd swept down, collapsing a Level 4 Mutated Beast’s chest, and the massive corpse flew out.
Immediately following, Jack Clark whipped his body around, and the heavy, terrifying Eight Desolate Battle Halberd unleashed a supersonic attack, drawing out a pitch-black plane in the air.
In an instant, half of the body of the Mutated Beast that had pounced from behind was torn apart, followed by the black-red radiance rising from below.
Boom! The fourth Level 4 Mutated Beast’s neck exploded, its head flying horizontally, with scorching blood gushing out from its neck, rushing up tens of meters high and falling like a rain of blood.
In just a blink of an eye, Jack Clark had powerfully killed the four Level 4 Mutated Beasts, his dominance unmatched.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark killed the four Level 4 Mutated Beasts in a blink of an eye, the heads of the Level 3 Mutated Beasts surrounding Justin Welan and the others continued to explode.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
Under extremely precise shooting, in the blink of an eye, five Level 3 scale-armored alien beasts had their heads burst, while the other four had six bloody holes blown through them.
Suddenly, besides the Mutated Beasts killed by Zac Lyons and the others, there were only four injured Level 3 and one Level 4 scale-armored alien beasts left standing.
Roar!
Two Level 3 scale-armored alien beasts let out furious roars, their massive forms suddenly turning around and rushing towards the distant mountain wall at a shocking speed.
There, Freya Louise, clad in her battle armor, held a sniper cannon, reloading with a click.
“White Veil, Zac Lyons, block them.”
“I’ll take on this Level 4 Mutated Beast.”
After killing the four Level 4 Mutated Beasts in a thunderous manner in an instant, Jack Clark looked back and saw that the situation was under control, so he charged towards the depths of the valley.
Otherwise, Marcus Lee might die.
Roar, roar, roar! At the back of the valley, the aura on the Blood Armored Beast King became even more violent, with it roaring in madness and sending the two-legged beasts blocking its way flying.
At this moment, Marcus Lee’s battle armor was shattered, and his burly, fierce body was covered in wounds like broken porcelain, with blood flowing and true strength indistinguishable.
Within a few minutes of the battle, Marcus Lee had already sustained heavy injuries, and his weapon was nowhere to be found.
But at this moment, his aura was even more frenzied and tragic, as he forcefully intercepted the Blood Armored Beast King time and time again.
Suddenly, the Blood Armored Beast King stopped its movements and stared fixedly at the black-red figure that appeared behind Marcus Lee, feeling a strong sense of danger from Jack Clark at close range.
Marcus Lee, covered in blood, slowly turned his head and looked at Jack Clark next to him, his voice raspy, “I said…I could hold it back.”
Jack Clark slowly nodded, “You held it back. Now leave the rest to me.”
“Alright!”
As soon as he finished speaking, Marcus Lee sprayed blood all over his body, shrinking down to 2 meters tall, and fell to the ground with a thud.
At this moment, Marcus Lee’s breath was extremely weak. His entire body’s muscles were pale, devoid of any color, and he seemed to be on the verge of dying.
The sight of him in such a pitiful state moved Jack Clark, who didn’t expect Marcus Lee to fight to this extent.
Perhaps Marcus Lee had overestimated himself, thinking that he could stop the Beast King after activating his Bull Devil Battle Body and unleashing his king-level bloodline.
Otherwise, had he been more cautious, he could have dragged things out until Jack Clark’s arrival and wouldn’t have been injured so badly.
Upon realizing the terror-inducing strength of this Mutated Beast King, Marcus Lee instantly went all out, desperately trying to hold it off.
If the beast king had rushed past, Justin Welan and the others, who had only reached the Third Layer Heaven, might have been killed by it in a single breath.
At that point, Marcus Lee would have no face to face Jack Clark.
Of course, Jack Clark wouldn’t know any of this. But after seeing Marcus Lee’s tragic appearance, his gaze became even colder.As someone who was fixated on desperately improving himself, after knowing him for so long, Jack Clark regarded Justin Welan as a friend with a bit of shared sentiment.
Boom!
In an instant, Jack Clark’s terrifying aura erupted, and with his Qi Blood burning, unlimited strength was unleashed, causing the surrounding air to warp and heaven and earth to shake.
As the Elephant’s Fury Rune was activated, tenfold strength caused the ground to tremble and sink around him, and countless pebbles danced under the force of invisible power.
Howard Lee, who was the closest to him, felt like the world was coming crashing down and couldn’t help but reveal disbelief in his eyes as he looked at Jack Clark.
At this moment, not only Howard Lee but also Freya Louise, who had cooperatively killed the remaining four Level 3 scale-armored alien beasts, and had blown the head off the early stage Level 4 Unique Beast with a single shot, looked over at him.
There, Jack Clark’s aura was astonishing, and an endless stream of burning Qi Blood shaped into red flames over a meter high, making him look like a demon god from hell.
Boom! Accompanied by a sonic boom, Jack Clark instantly disappeared from the spot.
Tens of meters away, the Blood Armored Beast King let out a miserable scream as its enormous body was shot out and smashed into a mountain wall hundreds of meters away.
Boom! Half of the mountain wall collapsed, making countless stones scatter everywhere while smoke and dust enveloped the area, and the sound of large rocks falling to the ground echoed endlessly.
Seeing Jack Clark’s figure standing with his halberd while his body was engulfed in blood-colored flames after sending the Blood Armored Beast King flying, Marcus Lee couldn’t help but swallow.
“Mother, damn it, Jack Clark is too fierce.”
Zac Lyons looked on with a complicated expression: “More than fierce, it’s entirely abnormal.”
Before, the Blood Armored Beast King had crushed Howard Lee and with a casual strike, made him spit out blood, but in front of Jack Clark, it couldn’t withstand a single blow.
Moreover, due to its king-level bloodline, the Blood Armored Beast King had the combat power of at least Level 5 late stage, although its level was only at the early stage.
Roar!
At that moment, the distant smoke and dust suddenly dispersed, and the terrifying Blood Armored Beast King, leaking deadly terror, stood up.
Its large scale armor was shattered on its chest, surrounded by exploded flesh, exposing its white ribs and the squirming organs inside.
Under such heavy injuries, the Blood Armored Beast King’s aura went even crazier, as its king-level bloodline power was continuously activated due to the threat of death, making its breath more terrifying.
The terrible power even materialized, forming a layer of golden-red flames around its body.
As the terrifying king-level power was activated, the atmosphere within tens of meters of the Blood Armored Beast King was almost compressed into a solid state and cracked, creating an astonishing momentum.
When the aura reached its peak, the Blood Armored Beast King let out a roar that shook the heavens and earth, and tangible sound waves made Freya Louise and others show pained expressions on their faces.
Boom!
The ground shattered, and the Blood Armored Beast King charged at Jack Clark with terrifying supersonic speed. Numerous dark fissures surrounded it, showing the phenomenon of the surrounding solidified atmosphere being shattered.
Although the Blood Armored Beast King’s aura was terrifying, Jack Clark’s aura was even more horrifying. Accompanied by the void-piercing Dragon Roar and Elephant Roar, the heaven and earth changed color in an instant.
Boom!
The supersonic beams collided, and the ground collapsed instantly, causing a dazzling black-red circular shockwave to explode and roll up smoke and dust over a hundred meters away.
The valley suddenly became quiet.
There was no battlefield turbulence as they had expected, apart from the pattering sound of numerous stones falling to the ground due to the energy explosion.
Even the Blood Armored Beast King’s brutal roar didn’t sound again. The silence was terrifying, and the heavy atmosphere filling the air made Justin Welan and others present dare not even breathe.
After some time, as the smoke and dust slowly dissipated, the center of the battle was revealed.
They saw the Blood Armored Beast King, covered in red scales, standing quietly in the large pit with a diameter of over twenty meters, its vicious mouth wide open, and its sharp claws hugging its chest.
At its injured chest, there was a two-meter-wide hole that pierced through, showing its transparent back.
At this time, scorching blood spurted from the enormous wound, gathering in the pit below, forming a bloody pond.
At the edge of the pit behind the Blood Armored Beast King, Jack Clark stood in his black-red armor, holding a halberd.
Although his aura was already receding at this time, there was still a terrifying oppressive atmosphere surrounding him, warping the air around him..

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 164: Insufficient Gene Soul, Dark Undercurrents
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 164: Insufficient Gene Soul, Dark Undercurrents
Translator: 549690339
Just as Justin Welan and the others were shocked by the ferocity and brutality of the King Blood Mutant Beast, Jack Clark had managed to swiftly strike it down within two moves.
Standing on the edge of the crater, Jack Clark seemed dashing, but he was actually trying hard to control the trembling of his legs, or else he would have ruined his cool image in that moment.
At the same time, Jack was also surprised by the power of the Elephant’s Fury Rune when activated this time.
During his breakthrough to the Fourth Layer Heaven, after absorbing the essence of high-order Dragon Blood, he gained the ability to “truly” manifest his physical strength, allowing it to merge with True Strength for greater combat power.
Furthermore, as his physique surpassed a thousand, his flesh became even more horrifying, embodying an overwhelming Qi Blood similar to giant beasts.
Therefore, when activating the Elephant’s Fury Rune and burning both Qi Blood and True Strength, the terrifying Blood Flame almost formed into a raging fire, unleashing a terrifying force capable of destroying everything.
Due to the terrifying burning Qi Blood, the amplified muscle strength burst out, exceeding the tenfold limit of the Elephant’s Fury Rune, reaching a frightening degree.
It wasn’t just eleven or twelve times more powerful but had reached a qualitative change.
Even with the combat power reaching the late Level 5 and possessing the King-level talent of the Blood Armored Beast King, Jack managed to kill the Beast King with just two halberd strikes.
However, whenever there’s something to gain, there’s something to lose. Due to the overwhelming burst that exceeded the limit of the rune, Jack couldn’t precisely control it, much like a mountain torrent that couldn’t be stopped once it erupted.
Only a few breaths left him with a severe loss of Qi Blood, with most of it being wasted in the raging Blood Flame.
Although he promptly deactivated the rune state when he discovered something was wrong, the depleted Qi Blood would need at least half a day to recover, and that was just with a few breaths of activation.
If it were to be like when he killed the Late Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy before, burning for more than ten minutes, he might suffer a heavy injury afterward and be weakened for half a month.
Of course, Justin Welan and the others naturally wouldn’t know this.
“It’s finally over,” Justin Welan, who just let go of his heavy shield and sat on the ground panting, said amidst the pile of Level 3 Mutant Beasts.
Having been attacked head-on multiple times by various Mutated Scale-armored Beasts, even including a Level 4, he could barely stand it. After all, his True Strength had a limit.
Then, Mullen Weisz walked over, holding his waist and grinning in pain, “After breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, the first thing I’m going to do is to forge an extraordinary battle armor.”
At his waist, the solid Battle Armor Alloy had been twisted and deformed. If it weren’t for True Strength covering it at the time, it might have exploded directly.
Watching Jack Clark slaughter Level 3 and 4 Mutated Beasts like chickens might make it look easy, but that was because his combat power far exceeded theirs.
For Mullen Weisz and the others, who were also at Triplex Heaven, the power of each of these Mutated Beasts’ blows was immense. Even if they didn’t die, they would be severely injured if bitten by their terrifying mouths.
Marcus Lee and Zac Lyons walked over unsteadily.
Following them were Freya Louise, who held her sniper cannon that had accurately killed several Mutated Beasts, and White Veil, who had intercepted Scale-armored alien beasts from afar.
From the valley, Jack Clark, who had caught his breath, slowly approached Howard Lee. Despite his weakened Qi Blood, he still stood tall and straight. “How are you holding up?”
Howard Lee’s terrifyingly cracked wounds on his body had stopped bleeding, but they still looked fearsome. Hearing Jack’s words, he shook his head slightly, “I’m fine. It’s just an overconsumption of Qi Blood and shock to my Internal Organs. Nothing fatal.”
“Do you have any healing resources?” Jack asked.
Howard shook his head, his face full of madness, “No, or rather, I don’t need any healing right now. The characteristic of the Bull Devil Battle Body is that the more I fight, the stronger 1 become.”
“Especially, the heavier the injuries I receive during a battle, the greater the improvement to my Battle Body after recovering. This is the essence of the undaunted and mad Bull Devil Battle Body.”
Jack paused for a moment, not expecting that the Battle Body would be so crazy, “So… earlier, you deliberately clashed with the Blood Armored Beast King?”
Howard nodded.
“That’s right. However, this Mutant Beast King’s strength far surpasses the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King, and in order to hold it back, I couldn’t dodge. So I chose to fight it all out.”
“Weren’t you afraid I’d be a little late and you’d die?” Jack shook his head at the thought of Howard, who was completely a madman.
Howard grinned, “Well, you came, didn’t you?”
“…You know, one day, you might just die in combat like this,” Jack said in a slightly silent tone.
Howard shook his head, unconcerned, “It doesn’t matter. When I first chose the Bull Devil Battle Body instead of the powerful Bull King Battle Body, I knew the outcome.”
“If you want to push your limits and pursue continuous improvement in combat abilities, you have to pay a price. It’s an unavoidable rule.”
No wonder Howard progressed so quickly; Jack couldn’t help but envy his relentless madness for the sake of advancing his strength.
Even though Jack himself was no stranger to taking risks, he was more cautious about it.
Because Howard Lee was severely injured and couldn’t exert any strength, the task of moving the bodies of the Mutated Beasts fell upon Jack Clark and the others.
In this eight-person team, although Freya Louise was also at the Triplex Heaven, her “strength” was another matter. Her trash cultivation method could only amplify her strength two times, and she couldn’t move even one Level 3 scale-armored alien beast.
So, she had to stand guard.
However, when they started moving the corpses, Marcus Lee and Mullen Weisz stood in front of the corpse of the Level 4 Mutated Beast with a blown-up head and marveled, “Jack Clark is getting more and more terrifying.”
Mullen Weisz nodded, “Seems like what Mr. Willard said was true. Jack has awakened some kind of physical talent.”
As friends who had cultivated to this point together, they had noticed Jack’s anomaly long ago.
His powerful flesh wasn’t something that could be cultivated through cultivation methods, even if the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body he practiced later was one of the strongest advanced cultivation methods—it just wasn’t enough..

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 164: Insufficient Gene Soul, Dark Ambush_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 164: Insufficient Gene Soul, Dark Ambush_2
Translator: 549690339
Although Dragon Elephant Overlord Body Skill is famous for its strength and defense, there is a limit to the cultivator’s physique transformation and tempering, and it is impossible to strengthen speed and reaction together.
Even the grand accomplishment of the Dragon Elephant Behemoth’s power does not exaggerate the increase in combat capabilities.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be just an Advanced Skill but a top-tier bloodline Secret Book.
So, as Justin Welan initially guessed, everyone speculated that Jack Clark must have awakened some powerful physical talent, including the explosion of previous moves.
However, no one delved into this question, as everyone has their secrets, and even the school’s senior management didn’t pay much attention after the initial surprise.
The only change in his personal file was the addition of an “Advanced Talent” in the physical aspect.
Jack, Zac Lyons, and others arranged the corpses of the five Level 4 Mutated Beasts and two Level 5 Mutated Beasts side by side; each body had four anti-gravity disks placed under it.
Following that, more than ten Level 3 Mutated Beasts, each with two corpses stacked on top of each other, making the corpse of the Mutated King Beast even heavier.
In addition to this harvest, there was a Level 3 Life Crystal, which Jack took without hesitation.
Now all they had to do was wait for Howard Lee’s injuries to heal, as there were not enough people to transport the Mutated Beast corpses.
“Damn, I’m so tired. Why do these mutated creatures have to be so big?” Justin Welan rubbed his shoulders and couldn’t help but complain.
White Veil leaned on Mutated Beast’s scale armor while lazily recovering his strength, “Of course, it’s because of the absorption of Heavenly Energy.”
Zac Lyons touched his chin thoughtfully, “Speaking of which, 1 found something interesting.”
Jack walked over, “What is it?”
Zac Lyons said solemnly, “Haven’t you guys noticed? Almost all mutated creatures are animals, and there are no insects.”
“Pssh, I thought it was a big discovery.” Justin Welan was speechless.
Jack couldn’t help but smile, “This question has been researched before. It is believed that the gene structure of insects is unable to withstand the ‘expansion’ of Heavenly Energy.”
“The Heavenly Energy that surged into the mythical world is unique and can cause organisms to evolve, become giant, and even develop various forms.” “Insects’ genes are not as strong as animals’, and their extreme nature cannot withstand gigantism, plus their ‘weak’ spirits and souls can’t bear the ‘energy’.” “So, although insects have mutated over the years, they generally increase in size tenfold and then stagnate, enriching the food chain after mutation.”
“But why haven’t humans changed as these Heavenly Energies cause organisms to evolve and become giants?” Marcus Lee was puzzled.
“There’s an explanation for this as well. It seems that humans have a stronger ‘self-awareness,’ which subconsciously restrains their body from undergoing sudden mutations during evolution.”
“In addition to this, we can cultivate and master the direction of evolution ourselves, just as our physiques change directionally after we absorb Mutated Beast Blood Essence.”
“So, although we humans are also evolving, we are on another path.”
“Of course, these phenomena are not absolute. For instance, Howard Lee’s physique is considered giant. Moreover, research shows that insects are evolving and improving themselves through generations.”
“In another ten or twenty years, there may be some terrifying insect-like mutated creatures.”
With that said, even Jack’s face couldn’t help but show a solemn expression.
Are insects powerful? They are weak and easily crushed by a casual footstep.
However, if insects become as large as humans, and their body structure and all aspects of strength increase simultaneously, they will become more terrifying predators than lions and tigers.
This can be confirmed by the Sword Armor Beast during the third evolution.
The beast, which absorbed, fused and optimized the strengths of three insects, was invincible at that level, possessing two top-tier talents and one advanced dreadful talent.
Of course, the fact that the Avatar was so strong had to do with its unique talent ‘Evolution;’ not all insects will develop top-tier talents just by evolving.
But even so, the future of insects ten to twenty years later that Jack mentioned still made everyone’s faces sink.
Since these mutated beasts are already so powerful, what will happen if insects around the world become mutated beasts in the future?
“Wait, Jack, how do you know so much?” Marcus Lee finally reacted, looking at Jack strangely.
Jack also looked at him in surprise, “It’s simple; just take a glance at the
Mutated Beasts Encyclopedia and remember it.”
Marcus Lee shook his head, “I know that books can provide knowledge, but how do you have time to read? I remember there were more than a dozen books in that series, and each one is pretty thick.”
“Yeah, Jack, how do you have time to read?” Zac Lyons and others showed dissatisfaction.
White Veil nodded, “Exactly, it’s unfair.”
Everyone else was working hard on cultivation. How did Jack have time to read books? And not only did he have time, but his progress in cultivation also far surpassed everyone else’s.
Jack said ‘curiously,’ “Isn’t that an easy thing? Just glance at it and remember.” Everyone collectively fell silent.
“Damn!” Mullen Weisz couldn’t help but raise his middle finger.
Justin Welan waved his hand with a grin, “Alright, let’s disperse, or Jack will show off again. He was just showing off earlier.”
“Yes, let’s go. Let’s find a place to play on our own.”
As they said this, they actually left Jack behind, running to a tree nearby that had survived the disaster, and sat under the shade, closing their eyes to cultivate and replenish their True Strength..

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 164 Insufficient Gene Soul, Darkness Lurks_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 164 Insufficient Gene Soul, Darkness Lurks_3
Translator: 549690339
Splat!
Freya Louise, who was standing atop the corpse of a Mutated Beast, couldn’t help but laugh before hopping off.
Removing her helmet, the girl tossed her hair back and chuckled lightly,
“Those guys got discouraged by you again.”
Jack Clark also joined in the laughter, “I’m just giving them a wake-up call. Just because they’ve become cultivators doesn’t mean that they can abandon learning and become illiterate.”
“Indeed, that is a problem,” the smile in Freya Louise’s eyes grew stronger.
For these high school students, after cultivating True Martial Arts and gaining extraordinary strength, the continuous improvement felt just as addictive as playing a video game.
In this situation, many people would ignore the need for ‘study’.
Of course, this wasn’t about mathematics or sciences, but other elements related to cultivation.
For example, reading the notes of other cultivators, gaining insights from their cultivation journey, experiencing the martial art cultures of other countries, or even speculating and gaining insights from the heaven and earth.
This problem generally becomes evident after reaching the Fifth Layer Heaven realm where their lack of knowledge slows down the improvement of their martial intent.
That’s when they’ll start thinking about gaining deeper knowledge in martial arts. But those are considerations for the future. At present, their goal was to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Howard Lee’s injuries were more severe than expected, and since he did not want to use resources to heal, the group decided to rest for the day here.
? ? By the evening, the golden sunlight painted the sea surface into a magnificent gold. Waves were exploding into showers of golden light.
Beneath the surface, in the pitch-black stillness of the sea, the massive skeleton emitted a faint red glow, casting an intimidating shadow on the two giant beasts waiting nearby.
Resting on the seabed, the Thunderflame Beheamoth watched the faint red light, its golden vertical pupils radiating a cold aura.
Just then, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which had been waiting for a whole day, couldn’t help but wag its tail, stirring up a violent wave and emitting a low humming noise.
Brother, why can’t we eat it yet?
Be patient, almost there.
Compared to the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Thunderflame Beheamoth seemed calmer. It anticipated that it would be around an hour before the diluted red light would disappear.
However, leaving the ‘Blood’ uneaten for this time was a bit risky.
From the time they had killed the Mutant monster, the Thunderflame Beheamoth and the Single-horned Tiger Whale had destroyed three Level 6 and four Level 5 Mutated Creatures.
Along with the corpse of the deep-sea monster they had eaten earlier, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s size had grown another thirty-one meters.
Its Evolution value had also risen by over a hundred points.
Just as the Thunderflame Beheamoth was suppressing its eagerness and was preparing to take a rest, it suddenly noticed another giant Mutated Creature coming.
This Mutated Creature was around six hundred meters away. A special power around it had managed to keep the sea water around it undisturbed.
If it weren’t for the Electromagnetic Sensing that the Thunderflame Beheamoth had gained after Evolution, which was able to expand its sensing range to more than seven hundred meters, it wouldn’t have noticed its approach.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth growled: Big Joe, there is a common Mutated Creature sneaking towards you. Go and kill it. And don’t go too far.
This Mutated Creature wasn’t very strong, probably around Level 6. That’s why the Thunderflame Beheamoth didn’t want to handle it personally.
With the two drops of Ancient Blood about to be exposed, it had to be extra cautious.
There were other Mutated Creatures lurking in the dark sea.
However, these Mutated Creatures hadn’t come within a kilometer’s range, so the Thunderflame Beheamoth couldn’t sense their exact form, Level, or overall strength.
Leave it to me.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale hummed in agreement, and a terrifying aura erupted from its body. Its tail slammed the sea behind it, causing an explosive roar.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The turbulent water above was filled with echoes of explosions, screams of unknown creatures, and strong energy fluctuations.
About ten minutes later, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, with a few deep wounds half a meter wide and eight or nine meters long on its thick armor, swam back down.
It dragged a Mutated Creature, which was about twenty meters long and had two chicken-claw-like slender claws, in its mouth.
With the Mutated Beast in its mouth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale approached the Thunderflame Beheamoth and said in a flattering way: Bro, I can’t finish this guy. I’ll share half with you.
Sure.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth didn’t refuse.
Unlike the Thunderflame Beheamoth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale didn’t have such a horrific appetite. One Level 6 Mutated Creature would be more than enough for it to eat for a few days.
Soon, most of the flesh and blood of the Mutated Creature was devoured by the Thunderflame Beheamoth. The gushing blood stained the surroundings into a darker shade of scarlet.
Immediately, the auras of the hidden Mutated Creatures around them became more elusive.
Fully fed, the dim red light began to fade, causing the Thunderflame Beheamoth and Single-horned Tiger Whale to become increasingly serious.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth stood up slightly, as if flames burned all around it. It growled: Big Joe, after we finish eating, we’ll leave. Don’t engage with anything else.
Okay, brother.
As the invisible red light on the skeleton dimmed, the atmosphere in the black, deep sea became oppressive. Robust auras began to rise from afar.
Clearly, the Mutated Creatures knew that the critical time had arrived, and they could no longer remain patient.
Boom!
Just as the red light on the skeleton was about to disappear, this sea trench erupted into chaos. Seven black shadows roared from all directions out of the darkness.
Each one of them exuded the powerful aura of a Level 7 creature..

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 165: Evolution of Ancient Creatures, Level 9 Giant Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 165: Evolution of Ancient Creatures, Level 9 Giant Beast
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
A massive beast over fifty meters long rushed out of the furious sea, its terrifyingly huge body full of intimidation and a sense of oppression.
However, what arrived first was a golden beam of breath, which instantly penetrated hundreds of meters of distance and appeared on the left side of the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Where the beam of breath passed, the sea water instantly went berserk, and the terrifying impact force formed a spiral of white waves, showing its horrifying momentum.
But before the Thunderflame Beheamoth could react, the Single-horned Tiger Whale appeared next to him, bearing a Black and White Whale-shaped shield to block the destructive breath.
Boom!
The golden breath bombarded the Black and White Whale-shaped shield, and the terrifying explosion formed a series of golden halos that overturned the seawater in a range of hundreds of meters.
The twisted impact force mixed with the breath even knocked the Tiger Whale back, causing the shield to vibrate frantically.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s body erupted with endless golden-red flames, instantly evaporating the surrounding sea water and creating rolling tsunamis at the seabed.
Boom!!
The Thunderflame Beheamoth turned around and with a swipe of its claw, the seawater exploded like a deep-sea bomb, and the Level 7 Peak Mutant Beast, with a length of nearly 60 meters, was sent flying by its claw.
Moreover, under the terrifying force of the hundredfold explosion, the energy of the Mutant Beast collapsed, and half of its body exploded into bloody flesh, letting out a miserable howl.
Biu!
The black sword tail, burning with flames and dancing with electric arcs, burst out at sonic speed, piercing through the brain of the Level 7 Initial-Stage Monster that had pounced from behind.
Instant kill.
Boom! Just then, the left claw of the Thunderflame Beheamoth suddenly swung, and the fiery, glowing, sharp claw collided with a huge tentacle that rushed in from behind.
Immediately, a circle of Destructive Shockwaves erupted, and under the rolling tsunami, the tentacle was torn apart by the Thunderflamc Beheamoth’s claw.
In just an instant, the Thunderflame Beheamoth repelled two Level 7 Peak and Late-Period Mutant Beasts and killed one Level 7 Initial-Stage Monster.
Although all the creatures that dared to snatch the Ancient Essence Blood were powerful, each with energy fluctuations and auras far stronger than their own levels, not inferior to the Single-horned Tiger Whale,
Unfortunately, they were facing a Mutant Beast King.
As the Thunderflame Beheamoth blasted away those giant beasts, the red light that had persisted for an unknown amount of time silently shattered.
In an instant, the huge skeleton disintegrated at a visible speed, crumbling like sand and turning into dust, leaving only two washbasin-sized droplets of blood floating in the sea.
Those two droplets of blood did not mix with the sea water, but floated like blood-colored pearls, with a faint red glow flowing on their surface.
As the two droplets of ancient blood appeared, an indescribable desolate and ancient aura erupted, covering tens of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
The entire sea area erupted instantaneously.
The surrounding Level 7 Mutant Creatures went wild.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Beheamoth’s mouth opened wide in anger, and it swallowed a droplet of ancient blood in one gulp. Then, ignoring the attack from behind, it clasped its right claw around the other droplet of blood.
Boom! A tentacle dozens of meters long fell on the Thunderflamc Beheamoth, and it shot out with the help of the huge force coming from behind.
In an instant, the Thunderflamc Beheamoth arrived in front of the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which had been sent flying by the golden breath, roaring and opening its mouth wide: Roar! Open up!
The Single-horned Tiger Whale, without thinking, opened up its ferocious mouth, and then the Thunderflame Beheamoth swiped its right claw, throwing in the half-sized droplet of ancient blood.
The moment the Thunderflame Beheamoth held the blood in its right claw, most of the blood had already seeped through its claw and into its body.
So, it was not that the Thunderflame Beheamoth wanted to hoard the blood for itself.
Boom! At this moment, a terrifying aura erupted in the distance, and under the thick and terrible force, the sea area seemed to be on the verge of being overturned.
Level 9 Giant Beast!
The Thunderflame Beheamoth’s gaze grew solemn, and it roared: Roar! Run, run fast.
In the roar, the water behind the Thunderflamc Beheamoth exploded, creating an enormous black vacuum in an instant.
With the explosion of its Agility Talent, the Thunderflamc Beheamoth instantly disappeared from the spot.
Roar Roar Roar!!
The remaining few Level 7 Colossi and the terrifying hidden Colossus in the distance went berserk and chased after the Thunderflame Beheamoth in a fury.
In this situation, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which escaped in another direction, was actually ignored.
This was because the scent of the ancient blood on the Thunderflamc Beheamoth was more noticeable, covering up the slight scent on the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s body.
However, even so, the horrifying might of that Level 9 Giant Beast still scared the Single-horned Tiger Whale out of its wits, never expecting that those two drops of blood could attract such a terrifying creature.
Boom!!
Thousands of meters above the sea surface exploded, and the Thunderflame Beheamoth, which had rushed up from the deep sea within a breath, leaped up several hundred meters.
Just when the Thunderflamc Beheamoth had just burst out of the sea surface, a huge shadow emerged below it, and in the blink of an eye, it turned into a black hole that devoured everything in a range of a hundred meters.
Boom!
Hundreds of thousands of tons of seawater shot towards the sky, and amid the towering waves, a giant figure nearly two hundred meters long appeared, emanating a terrifying aura.
Although this Level 9 Giant Beast appeared last, its speed was the fastest. After swallowing a Level 7 Mutant Beast in one bite, it chased after the Thunderflame Beheamoth within a few breaths.
The gigantic mouth even looked like a black hole, emanating a terrible devouring force that tried to swallow the Thunderflamc Beheamoth that had absorbed the ancient blood in one gulp.
Thunk! The Thunderflame Beheamoth slammed into the water surface hundreds of meters away, causing splashes to fill the sky.
Just as it fell into the sea, the water behind the Thunderflamc Beheamoth exploded again, and with the help of its Agility Talent, it quickly emerged a mile away..

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 165: Evolution of Ancient Creatures, Level 9 Giant Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 165: Evolution of Ancient Creatures, Level 9 Giant Beast_2
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
The moment the Thunderflame Behemoth disappeared, the spot where it fell into the sea suddenly exploded, forming a terrifying vortex engulfing everything within a range of more than 300 meters.
It was the natural ability of that Level 9 Giant Beast.
Boom! The huge body of the distant Giant Beast crashed on the sea surface, raising waves that surged a hundred meters high, and the momentum was horrifying.
However, when this Level 9 Giant Beast fell back into the sea, it suddenly discovered that it could no longer sense the creature with flames burning on its body.
It was as if the mutated creature had disappeared from the sea out of nowhere.
Roar!
The Level 9 Giant Beast let out a roar that shook the heavens and the earth, and with a resounding boom, it created a monstrous wave and chased after the direction where the Thunderflame Behemoth’s presence disappeared.
Two thousand meters deep in the pitch-dark ocean, a stiff piece of wood without any trace of life slowly sank.
It was the Thunderflame Behemoth that had concealed its aura.
Unlike the land, the ocean is a three-dimensional structure. Especially in the waters below two or three hundred meters, it becomes pitch-black with no light, and one cannot see far.
As long as it knew how to hide, even those powerful Giant Beasts wouldn’t be able to find a ‘dead object’.
Joe, I’ve already done my best. I hope you won’t be caught by that Level 9 Giant Beast, otherwise, I can only mourn for you for a second.
The Thunderflame Behemoth, slowly sinking to the seabed, thought faintly.
With its instantaneous burst of speed, the Level 9 Giant Beast that appeared later couldn’t catch up with it. It would only have to escape two or three more kilometers before it could conceal its aura and leave.
It was just that by doing so, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which had also absorbed some ancient blood, might be in danger.
Considering the relationship they had as ‘brothers,’ the Thunderflame Behemoth eventually slowed down a bit and released the ancient blood’s aura from its body to attract that Level 9 Giant Beast.
Then it nearly got caught itself.
That Giant Beast’s speed was surprisingly terrifying, and its natural ability was amazingly powerful. It could launch an attack on the Thunderflame Behemoth from a mile away.
Lost in thought, the Thunderflame Behemoth focused its attention inside its body.
After absorbing that half-ancient droplet of blood, the Thunderflame Behemoth didn’t experience a dramatic increase in energy, strength, or a wild growth in body size.
It was as if it hadn’t consumed that drop of blood at all, but just drank a sip of seawater.
However, although there seemed to be no change on the surface, as a beast that had undergone four evolutions, the Thunderflame Behemoth vaguely sensed that some earth-shattering changes were taking place deep within its body.
After those blood droplets were infused into the body, the genes containing ancient information within the beast were gradually being activated.
As these genetic codes were slowly activated, the originally stable genetic sequence began to change, affecting the cellular structure of its entire body.
However, this change was initially very slow and faint, too weak to be noticed.
I want to sleep so much. The Thunderflame Behemoth’s eyes closed slightly, but immediately it opened them wide again, forcibly suppressing the fatigue that sprang forth.
With its full-strength burst, the Thunderflame Behemoth only took two hours to travel more than 800 kilometers to return, and then charged into the scorching magma flames with a bang.
Only after it returned to its nest did the Thunderflame Behemoth feel a sense of relief, closed its eyes, and the huge body coiled up as it slowly sank into the molten lake.
As it sank, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body emitted an invisible suction force, crazily absorbing the surrounding endless scorching energy, and the flames on its body danced even more fiercely.
At the same time, between its dorsal fins, blue lightning roared and leaped, causing the surrounding magma to explode continuously, terrifying and horrifying.
But the Thunderflame Behemoth had no energy to pay attention to these, as it was now in a state of delirious slumber and vaguely saw many unfamiliar scenes.
Countless heavenly fires descended from the sky, turning the world into a hell of flames, reducing everything to ashes.
The thick earth suddenly collapsed, cracking open a series of endless rifts. The sky fell and the earth sank, and countless massive creatures roared and wept.
In the distance, a towering giant roared up at the heavens, tearing a mountain peak from the earth and tossing it into the sky…
As these vague images emerged, a faint, wild, desolate aura emanated from the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body, making it seem like a creature from ancient times.
In the valley, everyone gathered around a fire roasting Mutated Beast Meat for dinner.
This place, as the lair of the scale-armored alien beasts, had been hunted for a long time, and there were no mutated creatures within a radius of more than ten kilometers. Therefore, Jack Clark and the others were relatively relaxed as they rested.
But when Freya Louise handed a skewer of golden brown roasted meat, brushed with honey and sprinkled with cumin and chili powder, to Jack Clark, he didn’t respond.
Freya Louise called out softly, “Jack Clark, Jack Clark…”
“…Ah! Oh, thank you.” Jack Clark came to his senses, thanked her as he looked at the roasted meat in front of him, and then took it.
The girl blinked her eyes curiously, asking, “What were you thinking about just now that you were so lost in thought?”
Jack Clark pondered and said, “I was just wondering if there were some ancient creatures and civilizations in our world.”
“It’s just that over time, those beings disappeared, and civilizations were destroyed, eventually turning into the myths and legends passed down by word of mouth.”
Across from him, Justin Welan bit into the meat, his mouth full of grease and mumbling, “Aren’t those myths and legends just made up by those Taoist and Buddhist schools and ancient people from the folk?”
“Hey! Mr. Willard, I don’t agree with what you’re saying.”
Zac Lyons shook his head and said, “If those ancient people hadn’t seen those ancient beings or immortals, how could they have come up with those legends?”

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 165: Evolution of Ancient Creatures, Level 9 Giant Beast_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 165: Evolution of Ancient Creatures, Level 9 Giant Beast_3
Translator: 549690339
“I think they must have seen something similar to the original form, and then passed it down through their barren and abstract descriptions.”
“Surely, it’s also possible that many years ago, the mythical world was connected to our world, and the monsters recorded in the Classic of Mountains and Seas were actually creatures from the mythical world.”
Marcus Lee nodded in agreement: “Yeah, Mr. Lewis’ second guess is more plausible. In fact, I’ve thought about this issue before.”
“I think that in ancient times, there might have been some cracks connecting the mythical world, which were discovered by some ancients who then absorbed Heavenly Energy to become stronger.”
“Those legendary immortals who could fly, hide, and summon winds and rains might have come through here.”
“And those blessed caves mentioned in Taoist legends might be places like the Alien Beast Battlefield but smaller, and eventually collapsed and disappeared for other reasons.”
“As for those immortals who went to the mythical world through the cracks and never returned, maybe that’s why they went there in the first place.”
Mullen Weisz sat on the heavy sword and smirked, “If that’s the case, wouldn’t humanity still have influence on the other side of the mythical world?”
White Veil shook his head in denial, “How is that possible? If those legends and myths really existed, and the immortals had really gone to the mythical world, we should have found out by now.”
Justin Welan shook his head, “You never know, White Veil. Not having found it doesn’t mean it doesn’t exist. And don’t you think the development of our Martial Arts has been too fast?”
“In just a few decades, a complete system has evolved, and there are even King-level strong men and even stronger beings above the Ninth Heavens.”
“Maybe those pioneers really did obtain some ancient inheritance and then combined it with modern information to create the True Martial system.”
“This issue is indeed possible,” Marcus Lee nodded thoughtfully.
Justin Welan excitedly said, “When I break through the Ninth Heavens and become a King-level Supreme Expert, I will explore the vast mythical world. Perhaps at the far reaches, I will find the existence of the Heavenly Court and the Immortal World.”
“Count me in,” Marcus Lee chimed in with interest.
Zac Lyons also excitedly said, “Brothers, let’s do it together. Once we find the Heavenly Court, I want to see if Chang’e is as beautiful as the legend says.”
You guys are getting it all wrong. If those people really exist, how powerful would they be after practicing for millions of years?”
Looking at the few people who had changed the subject, Jack Clark shook his head.
These guys are already thinking about becoming King-level strong men after reaching the Triplex Heaven, aren’t they thinking too much?
Let alone becoming a king, whether they can break through the Nine Layers and become Top Strong is a question.
But what they said wasn’t unreasonable either. Jack Clark pondered.
If those ancients really were the earliest pioneers of cultivation as the guesses speculated, much of the ancient myths and legends could be explained.
While thinking, Jack took a bite of the barbecue, and the rich aroma of the meat filled his mouth, making him praise, “Delicious, I didn’t expect you to be so skilled at barbecuing, Freya Louise.”
“As long as it tastes good, do you want more?” asked the praised girl with a smile on her lips.
“Yes,” Jack nodded decisively. If someone helped him barbecue, he would not refuse, and it was delicious too.
Marcus Lee across the table shouted enviously, “Freya, we want some too! You have to treat everyone equally.”
Justin Welan was annoyed, “Marcus, if you want to eat, barbecue it yourself. Freya has only two hands and the meat she barbecued is not enough for Jack.” “Right, Jack?” After saying that, Justin Welan winked at Jack and smirked, as if to say, ‘How about it, aren’t I a good brother?’
Jack unceremoniously nodded, “Indeed, the meat Freya barbecued is not enough for me. If you guys want to eat, do it yourself.”
As the group joked around, by the bonfire, the burly Howard Lee sat cross-legged, with a small stone stove made of rubble in front of him.
A flat stone slab was placed on top of the stove, and pieces of Mutated Beast meat were frying on it as the grease rolled at the high temperature and made sizzling sounds.
From time to time, Howard Lee took out some condiments from his small bag and sprinkled a bit of cumin, pepper powder, and chili powder on the meat.
He then added a bit of sauce, and the rich aroma of the meat immediately wafted out.
When the meat on the stone slab was almost done, Howard Lee slowly picked up a pair of chopsticks made of tree branches and tasted a piece of grilled meat slowly.
It was hard to imagine that this giant, who looked crazy like a demon when he fought, would eat with such care and precision to the point of being unrecognizable.
Once they had eaten and drank their fill, they shared night watch duties, and then each found a place to sit and meditate. The valley fell into silence, with the night breeze blowing gently.
However, from a distance, the roars of Mutated Creatures could be heard, reminding everyone that this was the dangerous Cloud Mist Mountain Range..

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 166: Return, Dragon Elephant
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 166: Return, Dragon Elephant
Dominating Body Fifth Layer
Translator: 549690339
Early the next day, everyone packed up and set off.
There were two Level 5 mutated beasts with bodies over twenty meters long, resembling large yachts, and five Level Z, mutated beasts with bodies ranging from eighteen to twenty-three meters.
In addition to that, there were more than ten Level 3 mutated beasts with bodies just over ten meters, all piled up like moving hills.
Below them, Jack Clark and the others were like ants carrying food, dragging objects hundreds of times their size, and moving quickly across mountains and rivers.
Because of the size of the mutated beasts, they could only travel about sixty to seventy kilometers an hour on good roads and only thirty to forty kilometers an hour on bad roads.
This was with the help of anti-gravity disks that kept the mutated beast corpses half a meter above the ground, otherwise only Jack Clark and Howard Lee could move them.
However, this black technology had its limits.
For example, six anti-gravity disks had to be placed under the two Level 5 mutated beast corpses to make them float, offsetting more than half their weight.
In addition, they had to deal with attacks from mutated creatures all around. Bang!
Following the gunshot, the head of a Level 2 Mutant Beast that charged out of the forest exploded, leaving a basin-sized bloody hole, its body rolling far on the ground due to inertia.
“Hey, more Contribution Points delivered to our doorstep.”
Wiggling in the middle, Justin Welan ran over, dragged the mutated beast’s corpse over six meters long, and then threw it forcefully onto the pile of mutated beast corpses.
At this point, not only him but also others had added several Level 2 Mutant Beasts to their piles, making the harvest full.
The smell of blood from these high-level mutated beast corpses was very attractive to ordinary mutated creatures.
Even with Jack Clark and the others’ imposing aura, many mutated creatures still tried to sneak attack, disregarding the threat.
Standing in the middle of the mutated beast corpses, the girls clicked their weapons, changing the empty clip and holding the sniper cannon, watching their surroundings with sharp eyes.
It was rare for anyone to use this method of hunting high-level mutated beasts and then killing low-level exotic beasts on the way back while dragging the corpses.
Because the strong bloody smell easily attracts more danger.
For example, right now.
Chirp!
With a sharp cry of metal and iron clashing, a huge mutated bird with wings spanning nearly forty meters appeared in the sky a kilometer above, exuding a fierce aura.
This mutated bird had its eye on Jack Clark and the others, or rather, on the two Level 5 Mutant Beast corpses.
Suddenly, everyone’s expressions became somber, their movements stopped, and Freya Louise immediately changed to an electromagnetic cannon barrel, with the crystal energy activated at all times.
Howard Lee looked up and saw the mutated bird with thick, sharp claws and scales between its feathers, his expression solemn: “Be careful, this Mutant Beast is very strong.”
Although his weapon had been damaged, after recovering most of his injuries, the aura around Howard Lee became even heavier.
Jack Clark narrowed his eyes, and in a flash, he appeared on the Blood Armored Beast King’s corpse, flipped his war halberd out, and then a domineering and fierce Dragon Might exploded from his body.
Boom!
With black and red True Strength flashing, the overbearing, material-like aura compressed the surrounding air, creating a strong gust of wind, confronting the mutated bird.
This mutated bird was the one Jack Clark had seen before entering the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, and judging by its aura now, it was probably around Level 5 Peak.
This was a powerful creature with the advantage of the sky.
Jack Clark was now prepared to enter the rune form at any time, and as long as it dared to come down, he would burst out with all his strength, even if it weakened him, and break off one of its wings.
As long as he broke its wing, he would decide its life or death.
Chirp!
The mutated bird circled a thousand meters high in the sky, spreading its wings and casting a large shadow, but it hesitated to attack, seemingly wary of Jack Clark.
Or Freya Louise’s magnetic sniper cannon.
Eventually, after circling for more than ten minutes, the mutated bird suddenly spread its wings and shot into the sky, disappearing into the clouds in the blink of an eye.
Justin Welan breathed a sigh of relief and cursed: “Damn it, that freaking mutated bird finally left.”
Marcus Lee nodded: “These flying guys are a pain, they come and go as they please; before reaching high-order, human cultivators have no way of dealing with them.”
Zac Lyons shook his head: “It’s a pity I don’t have any bow and arrow martial skills, otherwise it would be much easier to deal with these mutated birds.” Justin Welan mocked: “What era is this? Still playing with bows and arrows? Don’t guns smell good? Look at Freya, only Third Layer Heaven and a sniper cannon can kill Third and Fourth Level Mutant Beasts like slaughtering dogs.” “Ahem! Forget the guns, ordinary people can’t afford them, and they won’t help my True Martial cultivation path later on.”
As the group was talking nonsense, the girl standing in the middle of the mutated beast corpses gently exhaled, and then quickly replaced the gun barrel of the sniper cannon, guarding the surroundings.
Jack Clark also jumped down from the body of the Blood Armored Beast King.
However, he was also considering whether or not to learn a long-range attack martial skill or secret skill.
At this point, they had reached the edge of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, and as long as they crossed the mountains, their route would be much safer. Jack Clark turned back and said, “Brothers, get ready to go. And have some ambition, can you guys stop taking Level 2 Mutant Beasts?”
Every one of them was prepared for the problem of encountering attacks from mutated creatures while carrying high-level mutated beast corpses back.
In the past, when Justin Welan and the others teamed up, they would be careful to guard their surroundings, quickly enter fixed safety routes, and encounter fewer attacks because they were on the edge of Nine Rings Mountain Range..

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 166: Return, Dragon Elephant Tyrant Body Fifth Layer _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 166: Return, Dragon Elephant Tyrant Body Fifth Layer _2
Translator: 549690339
However, the Cloud Mist Mountain Range was different and more dangerous, so Jack Clark reminded them and planned to kill some Level 3 Mutated Beasts to take back.
But he didn’t know if it was good luck or bad luck, as they didn’t encounter any strong Mutated Creatures along the way, only a few of the Level One and Two.
And these guys acted like they had never seen Contribution Points before, not even letting go of the Level Two Unique Beasts.
Now they had only just reached the edge of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, picking up more than a dozen Level Two beasts and piling up, leaving them panting.
“What can we do, Jack? We haven’t even seen the hair of a Level Three or Four Mutated Beast, so we can only pick up some Level Two beasts to take back. After all, even the smallest mosquito is meat, isn’t it?”
As he said this, Justin Welan chuckled.
On a hillside of Nine Rings Mountain, a team of three people looked at the scene below in wonder: “Holy shit, who are those tough guys? They actually killed so many Mutated Beasts at once!”
Below the mountain path, the piles of corpses of over forty Mutated Beasts stretched for more than 100 meters, creating quite a shocking picture.
Going over the mountains and blocking their paths, Jack Clark and the others finally returned to the base after about a day and a half.
“Damn, finally here.” Zac Lyons sat down on his butt.
Looking at the piles of Mutated Beast corpses in front of him, Koi Hawk was surprised: “Student Clark, you guys worked together to kill a horde of Mutated Beasts, didn’t you?”
Jack Clark took a deep breath and nodded: “This time we were lucky, we found a horde of Mutated Beasts. Director Hawk, can you help us calculate our harvest this time?”
“By the way, we plan to refine the Essence Blood of that Beast King.”
“No problem, can some people come over here?”
At Koi Hawk’s shout, five staff members began to move and count the Mutated Beast corpses.
Soon, after the counting was done, Koi Hawk came to Jack Clark and the others.
“Student Clark, the high-level Mutated Beasts have had their bodies severely damaged, so I can only give you the base standard price.”
“The Level 5 early stage Twin-winged Flying Dragon is worth 130 points, the five Level 4 mid-early stage creatures together are 255.”
“As for those Level 3 Mutated Beasts, because their corpses are relatively intact, twelve are worth 355 points, and twelve Level Two ordinary Mutated Beasts are worth 84 points.”
“As for that Level 5 Beast King, after refining the Essence Blood according to your request, most of the flesh and blood is useless, and the other materials of the body are worth 50 points after offsetting the processing fees.”
“The total is 874 Contribution Points. If you have no objection, I will register it in the warehouse.”
Jack Clark nodded: “No problem.”
The official recovery price for a Level 5 Mutated Beast is between 130 and 180, and for a Level 4 it’s between 50 and 70, but due to the damage, they were only given the base standard price.
The price difference was not significant from their original estimate.
The reason for the sharp decrease in the value of a damaged Mutated Beast corpse is related to the lost blood.
These Mutated Beasts had strong bodies, and even in death, their flesh and blood didn’t rot easily, instinctively locking most of the blood inside their body, containing rich energy.
If used for extracting Essence Blood, one or two more portions could be refined.
However, Jack Clark’s fighting style was too fierce and overbearing, and almost every blow either shattered the head or caused half of the body to explode.
Under such circumstances, due to the large wound, the blood almost spilled out under the pressure from inside and outside, naturally resulting in much less value.
Unfortunately, Jack Clark couldn’t fully control the power of the Dragon Elephant True Strength explosion, and with the heavy Overbearing War Halberd, it’s impossible to leave a complete corpse in one blow.
Besides, the situation didn’t allow him to hold back. Speed was crucial, so it didn’t matter if it ended up being a bit damaged.
After handing over the Mutated Beast corpses to the warehouse, the exhausted group went back to their dormitory to clean up and take a bath.
About an hour later, they gathered in Jack Clark’s room to divide the property… no, to divide the money.
The division of benefits had already been discussed before the departure, so there was nothing to say; Jack Clark got the biggest share of 404 points, almost half.
Howard Lee’s information and his contribution in stopping the Beast King ranked second, receiving the Essence Blood. Next was Freya Louise, who took 120 points, the reason being her ammunition consumption.
For example, a single Magnetic Black Gold Armor-piercing Bullet, which consumes an Energy Crystal Body for storage, is worth 15 Contribution Points.
Then there were Justin Welan and the others who had been running around and carrying things, each getting 70 points, and the extra points were from the Level Two Mutated Beasts killed along the way.
Jack Clark didn’t want the harvest of these ordinary Mutated Beasts. Firstly, Justin Welan and the others had fought those little monsters, and secondly, with his strength, there was no need to look so greedy.
In addition, Justin Welan and the others made a contribution in the battle, adding up to 20 points in total.
After all the Contribution Points were distributed, Justin Welan, as Jack Clark’s coordinator, asked: “So, does everyone agree with this distribution?”
Marcus Lee nodded: “I have no objection.”
Zac Lyons and the others nodded as well, being very satisfied with the distribution ratio.
In this operation, Jack Clark made the greatest effort, including killing the two Level 5 Mutated Beasts.
Similarly, Freya Louise played a significant role in the battle.
If it weren’t for her shooting off one of the wings of the Twin-winged Flying Dragon, that Level 5 Mutated Beast would definitely have escaped, plus she killed several Level 3 Mutated Beasts later on.
As for Howard Lee, who was sitting nearby, he had no objections either.
If that Beast King was exchanged with the school, it would have been worth about 300 points of contribution, and after refining the Essence Blood, the other parts would still be worth 100 points.
However, half of that was used as processing fees.
Refining Demonic Beast Blood Essence from a Mutated Beast with a king-level bloodline was even more troublesome than refining it from ordinary Mutated Beasts, and because it was only at the beginner’s level and the blood flow was too much, the quantity was very small..

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 166: Return, Dragon Elephant Dominating Body Fifth Layer 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 166: Return, Dragon Elephant Dominating Body Fifth Layer 3
Translator: 549690339
The estimated yield is three portions, each worth about 70 Contribution Points, doubling the value of regular high-level Mutated Beast Blood Essence.
All in all, this time he also harvested over 200 Contribution Points.
Of course, his gains are far behind Jack Clark’s.
In his hands, he got 404 Contribution Points, plus a Level 3 Life Crystal worth 40 Contribution Points, almost equal to 450 Contribution Points.
Adding up to the 31 points he initially had, the total is 435 points.
That’s the benefit of having strong power.
However, without Howard Lee’s information and Justin Welan’s help, he wouldn’t have been able to bring back the corpses of these Mutated Beasts, so this is a win-win situation for everyone involved.
Justin Welan sat on the sofa, grinning, “With this harvest, 1 now have accumulated 150 Contribution Points, almost enough to exchange for two satisfying Transcendent Materials.”
Jack Clark looked at him strangely: “What are you going to do with Transcendent Materials at this point?”
Without breaking through Fourth Layer Heaven, True Strength won’t qualitatively change, which means they cannot support the forging of Transcendent Weapons using the Secret Weapon Casting Skill, so not just Jack Clark, other people also looked at Justin Welan in a puzzled manner.
Justin Welan grinned: “Even though 1 haven’t reached Fourth Layer Heaven, 1 can ask Teacher Clark for help in forging.”
“Er… Are you not afraid that your weapon won’t be compatible with you?” Jack Clark hesitated.
Transcendent Weapons can indeed be forged by others, but in doing so, they won’t share the same “bond” as when forged by themselves.
Justin Welan nodded: “It might be a bit worse, but a Transcendent Battle Shield can maximize my Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Defense.”
“With my current Late Stage of Third Layer Heaven cultivation, coupled with the enhanced Thick Earth atmosphere after a qualitative change, even a Fourth Level Peak Mutated Beast won’t be able to break through my defense.”
“In that case, combined with Freya Louise’s strong offensive power, we can challenge stronger Mutated Beasts and accelerate the acquisition of Contribution Points.”
“As for the compatibility issue, 1’11 just have to reforge it once 1 break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
Marcus Lee said solemnly: “In that case, I should break through Late Stage Third Layer Heaven earlier. I have already accumulated 130 Contribution Points, which can be exchanged for one portion of High-order Golden Jade Marrow.”
“Heh! I am also preparing to exchange for a Nine-Star Wind Crystal Fruit. The Wind Elemental force contained in this high-order resource is a perfect fit for my True Martial Arts.”
Ok, they were all stimulated by Jack Clark this time.
The bloody, flaming figure was too overbearing and terrifying; the Beast King, with its strength equivalent to Late Stage Level 5, was crushed and killed by Jack Clark in just two moves.
This kind of power gap is something even those monsters can’t compete with.
As “geniuses” in the same class, Justin Welan and others have their own pride; they may not catch up with Jack Clark now, but they don’t want to fall too far behind either.
Thus, they prepared to exchange for high-order resources directly and break through the Late Stage of Third Layer Heaven in one breath.
Originally, they planned to rely on their own efforts, and combined with a few ordinary resources, they would slowly cultivate and break through to save as much as possible.
After all, they already stood at the top of this class, and there was no need to push themselves so hard to break through the Third Layer Heaven early.
But now… To hell with their genius status, even a Level 4 Mutated Beast cannot be defeated by them. Are they really geniuses?
Not only Zac Lyons and Marcus Lee, but Mullen Weisz and White Veil, although they did not speak, Jack Clark knew their thoughts.
As for discouraging them, he had no intention of doing so. These guys have indeed been a bit complacent.
Having been in this dangerous Alien Beast Battlefield for so long, they still wanted to slowly work hard and accumulate, rather than taking advantage of the school’s resources for rapid progress.
As for the problem of wastage from exchanging advanced and even high-order resources, who would really care?
If they feel they are wasting it, just kill a few more Level Three and Four Mutated Beasts and continue to exchange for resources.
After all, even if it’s a waste, it’s a result of their own hard work. Breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven should be their top priority.
Jack Clark turned to Freya Louise, who was sitting nearby, and asked, “Freya, 1 haven’t seen you exchange for resources. Have you accumulated a lot of Contribution Points in your hands?”Freya Louise nodded: “1 have more than 200 contribution points in my hands now.”
“Damn, Freya, how did you get so many?” Justin Welan and the others were surprised.
“I’ve saved them up.” The girl’s mouth slightly curved upwards.
From the cleaning mission, Freya earned more than 200 points. She used about a hundred of them, and then after completing a mission with Justin Welan and the others, she received forty more points as a main contributor.
Adding in the 120 from this time, she had saved up a considerable amount.
Without waiting for Jack Clark to speak, Freya nodded and said, “Don’t worry, 1’11 splurge a bit this time and exchange for high-level resources to break through to the late stage of Third Layer Heaven sooner.”
After witnessing Jack Clark’s terrifying combat power, even Freya, who hadn’t been very competitive before, inexplicably felt a sense of urgency and wanted to break through earlier.
This was more like it. Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction.
At this time, Marcus Lee was somewhat curious and said, “Jack Clark, with ail the contribution points you’ve gained this time, what resources do you plan to exchange for?”
“High-order Dragon Blood.” Jack Clark didn’t hide it.
Justin Welan was surprised: “The fifth layer of the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body! Didn’t you just break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven?”
Jack Clark smiled: “No one said someone in the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven can’t cultivate the fifth layer of the Overlord body, right? But I’m not sure if 1 can succeed in cultivating it, 1 just want to give it a try.”
Zac Lyons hesitated: “Jack Clark, 1 have a feeling you may want to take it steady? In case you fail, the essence blood would be wasted.”
Marcus Lee and Mullen Weisz both nodded in agreement.
Advanced Skills have six layers, each layer corresponding to a realm of the First Layer Heaven, which was explored through countless cultivation experiences by those before them to allow future generations to make steady progress.
However, skills are auxiliary, and cultivation is the foundation.
Therefore, it is true that there are no restrictions for a Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator to cultivate only the fourth layer, they can also cultivate the fifth layer.
However, if one were to forcibly attempt to cultivate a higher layer of cultivation methods without the long-term refinement of heavenly energy to purify their True Strength, expand their Dantian, and temper their physical bodies, very few have succeeded in doing so.
That’s because higher-level cultivation methods require higher-level cultivation abilities.
Not only True Strength but also the cultivator’s will and understanding of the True Martial Arts they practice, as well as their body’s strength and intricate control of their physical body.
Jack Clark smiled slightly: “It’s fine; I earned hundreds of contribution points this time. If 1 fail in my cultivation attempt, I’ll just consider it a wasted trip.”
“Damn.” Since Jack Clark said so, the others naturally had nothing to say.
Next, everyone went to the Logistics Department together to exchange resources.
As for Howard Lee, he went alone to the Logistics Processing Office, waiting for his Essence Blood of the Blood Armored Beast King.
It wasn’t long before Freya and the others finished exchanging resources. Jack Clark also exchanged one bottle of High-order Dragon Essence Blood and two Level 4 Life Crystals in one go.
After the discount, he spent a total of 322 contribution points.
In the Personal Cultivation Room he applied for, Jack Clark took out three Life Crystals from the Sumeru Bracelet and thought in his mind: “Convert into Attribute Points.”
In an instant, the three crystals crumbled and vanished, and a stream of pure and special power disappeared into his body through his palm.
Suddenly, transparent text appeared in front of him.
“You’ve converted three High Purity Life Energy Crystals, turning them into 37, 85, and 88 Attribute Points respectively.”
Instantly, Jack Clark’s attribute points soared to 253, including the 43 points left over from enhancing the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, reaching an all-time high.
Only at this moment did Jack Clark take a deep breath, take out the bottle containing the high-order dragon essence blood, and drink down the essence blood that looked like liquid rubies.
At the same time, the realm of thought sounded in Jack Clark’s mind: “Consume 200 Attribute Points and enhance the fifth layer of the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.”
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 167 Talent Awakening, Double­layered World
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 167 Talent Awakening, Double-layered World
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
As the dragon blood entered the body, the familiar Furious Power exploded within Jack Clark.
However, compared to the previous discomfort when breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, this high-order dragon essence blood had much less damage to his body, probably due to the fact that they both belonged to the ‘dragon’ category.
At this moment, accompanied by Jack’s Spirit Power, an extremely pure energy appeared out of thin air, and the Dragon Elephant True Strength in his dantian wrapped around the dragon essence blood.
The True Strength, under the guidance of this power, opened up new pathways within the body, involving more intricate meridians, and formed a more powerful and delicate operation chart.
As the True Strength passed by, strands of purified Dragon Blood Essence integrated into Jack’s flesh and blood, bones, and the dragon scale patterns on his body gradually became clearer.
At the same time, half of this extremely pure energy merged into his True Strength, constantly revolving and refining the dragon blood, while the other half surged into Jack’s Sea of Consciousness.
In an instant, Jack’s consciousness trembled, being pulled by an invisible power and merging with the Dragon Elephant Phantom within his Sea of Consciousness.
Roar!
On the desolate and barren land, a Dragon Elephant with a mountainous body roared towards the sky, and an earth-shaking, sky-shattering will burst forth from its body.
As the Dragon Elephant avatar ran, an Overbearing aura, different from the mind and Spirit Power, filled Jack’s Sea of Consciousness, and his will gradually became more real.
Whoosh, whoosh!!
Accompanied by the breakthrough of cultivation, Jack’s breathing gradually became profound and heavy, even stirring the wind and howling like a hibernating Giant Beast.
On his body, the Dragon Might, full of Overbearing power, and the Furious Power like a giant elephant grew more and more powerful…
Half an hour later, Jack slowly opened his eyes, and from his bright, starry black pupils, a pair of golden vertical pupils radiated terrifying pressure.
Those golden vertical pupils, like the statue of a god in a temple, cold, majestic, gazing down at all beings.
This time, Jack didn’t directly hide the Heterochromatic Eye and instead slightly turned his head to look around.
