At this moment, in his eyes, the world faintly morphed into two layers – one layer was the normal view seen by ordinary eyes, with the air slowly flowing, carrying tiny floating dust.
The other layer of the world was somewhat vague, with faint cracks appearing in the surrounding space intermittently, then healing in a blink of an eye.
It was as if the world he was in was a bottle on the verge of breaking, bringing about an inexplicable sense of terror.
However, soon after, as Jack’s golden vertical pupils gradually disappeared from his eyes, the horrifying scenes around him also vanished.
Phew!
Jack let out a breath and pondered, “Is this Heterochromatic Eye a mutation due to the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body absorbing the high-order dragon blood, or is it affected by my constantly evolving physique?”
“If it’s related to Cultivation Methods, I haven’t heard of anyone who cultivated the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body and awakened any talents other than the True Martial Attribute.”
“So that means, it should be related to my continuously evolving flesh, or it might be a combination of both…”
With the Avatar Feedback, Jack’s body strength kept increasing, and he gradually discovered the difference between his enhancements and the normal True Martial Practitioners.
Other cultivators’ physical strength is tempered through True Strength – under the baptism of Heavenly Energy, it is a process of moving in the direction of True Martial Arts.
Similar to cast iron.
However, Jack’s enhancements are due to biological evolution. Every time the Avatar Feedback brings Evolution Energy, his body undergoes evolution, cells constantly dividing, shrinking in size, and becoming more terrifying in density.
In addition to True Martial Cultivation and absorbing high-order dragon blood, he gradually developed talents similar to those of a Giant Beast.
Of course, these are just Jack’s speculations.
Moreover, this Heterochromatic Eye talent is still in its initial awakening, and has not fully formed yet.
Putting the issue aside, Jack finally turned his attention to his body, feeling the six-fold increase in True Strength, and paused.
“Late Fourth Layer Heaven, just entered the late period. As expected, the exclusive strengthening of Cultivation Methods can no longer break through the cultivation realm in the rear.”
This time, when breaking through the Fifth Layer of the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, Jack’s cultivation realm didn’t breakthrough to the Fifth Layer Heaven in one breath as before.
As for the reason, during the breakthrough in the Cultivation Method’s strengthening, half of the ‘Attribute Energy’ was consumed in the formation of the Power of Will.
The remaining half of the energy, used to strengthen True Strength, was not enough to make his True Strength grow to the limit of the Fourth Layer Heaven, let alone break through the Fifth Layer Heaven in a single breath.
In other words, Jack’s Cultivation Method realm has now reached the Fifth Layer Heaven, but his cultivation, or True Strength, is insufficient and is still at the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
In the following days, he just needs to focus on absorbing and refining Heavenly Energy, and he will quickly cross the Fifth Layer Heaven, without any bottlenecks.
Moreover, due to the fact that his Cultivation Method has already broken through to the Fifth Layer earlier, his cultivation speed will be several times faster in the future. As long as he accumulates enough, he will be able to break through the Fifth Layer Heaven.
If he exchanges and absorbs energy crystals to enhance True Strength and other resources, his breakthrough to the Fifth Layer Heaven will be even faster because what he lacks is just energy.
Besides, there is another method: to continue strengthening the Sixth Layer of Dragon Elephant Tyrant Body and directly break through the Fifth Layer Heaven with the strengthening of cultivation level.
Actually, Jack was already mentally prepared for this result. When he initially strengthened the low-level Dragon Elephant Power to its limit, he had noticed this issue.
When consuming Attribute points to strengthen Cultivation Methods, what was strengthened were the cultivation levels, and the increase in the cultivation realm or True Strength was a byproduct of the Cultivation Method’s breakthrough.
It’s just that, in the case of the Triplex Heaven and below, the True Strength is weak compared to the strengthening of the Cultivation Methods, so it was possible to break through one realm after strengthening one layer of the Cultivation Method.
However, after the Fourth Layer Heaven, each additional layer requires a tenfold increase in True Strength and also a breakthrough in the Power of Will..

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 167: Talent Awakening, Double Layered World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 167: Talent Awakening, Double Layered World_2
Translator: 549690339 |
In this situation, after reaching the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, the split ‘Life Energy’ simply cannot promote both the advancement of the cultivation method and the breakthrough of the cultivation realm at the same time.
Although his cultivation level has only improved to the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, due to the cultivation level reaching the fifth layer and containing True Dragon Power, the power of True Strength has increased significantly.
His physical body, strengthened by the ‘Dragon Power,’ displays dragon scale patterns on the surface, making his defense even more terrifying and his power more fierce and overbearing.
Besides this… Jack Clark stretched out his right hand and pressed it slightly forward.
Accompanied by the faint True Power Fluctuation, the ground in front of him quietly trembled, creating a palm print one inch deep and several meters in diameter.
The True Power Fluctuation turned virtual into real—Power of Will!
As the Power of Will condenses, Jack’s True Strength can extend and attack without the help of a weapon.
But the newly formed Dragon Elephant Will is weak, and the initial combination of Will and True Strength doesn’t provide much help in actual combat; it can only be used as a primer for crystallizing True Strength when breaking through the Fifth Layer Heaven.
The real power of Will can only be gradually revealed and unleashed when it grows stronger and finally integrates with the whole body’s True Strength to complete the breakthrough to the Sixth-level Heaven, igniting the Flame of True Power.
Overall, this breakthrough has significantly strengthened Jack’s combat power, but how much stronger it has made him exactly will require testing with a ‘person.’
“It’s a pity. This is a school base. If I break the Cultivation Room, I have to pay,” Jack glanced at the walls of the Cultivation Room, suppressing the urge to test his strength.
Jack then took a deep breath, and the realm of thought sounded in his mind, “Consume 50 attribute points to fortify the Hidden God Method.”
Initially, the Hidden God Method was unable to conceal Jack’s breath when he first broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven and his physical body was considerably strengthened.
This was also the reason why Howard Lee felt a strong sense of danger.
Now that Jack has advanced the Fifth Layer of Dragon Elephant Domineering Qi in one attempt, his breath has leaked out, making the terrifying pressure around him almost crack the surrounding air.
Anyone with eyes would know that his cultivation level has increased dramatically.
However, he only broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven half a month ago, so to avoid unnecessary problems and prepare for entering the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, it was necessary to strengthen the Hidden God Method.
Moreover, the talent he has displayed is already dazzling enough.
Although he will hunt higher-ranking Mutated Beasts and display an even more terrifying combat power in the future, some things can only be shown, not described.
Let them use their imagination to see the potential.
As Jack’s voice fell, the Qi and Blood Glyphs that had once melted into his chest re-emerged, and then with a single explosive sound, they broke into an invisible vortex.
As the vortex devours Jack’s Blood Qi and spirit, three Qi-blood runes condense more thoroughly.
When the three small Hidden Deity Glyphs in the boundary realm fuse into Jack’s double shoulders and abdomen, a powerful invisible wave covers his entire body.
Jack’s colossal and overwhelming pressure instantly vanished.
« ? ?
“Roast pig’s feet, roast huge Mutated Pig’s Feet, big enough to eat for a whole day…”
“Come, come, come! Freshly grilled spicy Green-scaled Rabbit Meat on special sale, 100 sticks for 2 contribution points, enough to stuff yourself.”
“Classmates, over here! My ten-year secret recipe for Red-cooked Grilled Bear Paws, tender, delicious and fragrant.”
“Have a taste of the bear paw, just 3 contribution points, and you’ll be hooked! It’s perfect for sharing with your brothers and drinking all night…”
“Damn, you were still playing in the mud ten years ago, and your advertising is even more exaggerated than mine.”
“Can’t I inherit from my ancestors? And your 100 rabbit meat skewers actually cost 2 contribution points, do you think that’s a bit excessive?”
“A Level 1 Mutated Green-scaled Rabbit weighs around 500 pounds, yielding 300 pounds of meat, enough for you to skewer a thousand. You’re the real swindler.”
“Get lost! The rabbit meat on my skewers is as big as a fist, one pound per skewer. Plus the cost of my labor and other expenses, the asking price of 100 skewers for 2 contribution points is quite cheap.”
In the mountainside area behind the Martial Height Base late at night, the area was brightly lit. Many busy Seniors from the Second or Third Layer put up stalls in their free time.
They sell Mutated Beast Meat skewers, repair and refine battle armor, and a few stalls even sell ordinary resources they have privately collected, instead of exchanging them with the school.
These ordinary resources can be exchanged for 80% of the recovery price if given to the school, but for students who do not want to take any risks, they can trade them at 90% of the price and make a slightly higher profit.
Of course, don’t think the school is being unfair. The resources that are collected need special methods and an environment that requires preservation. Part of the resources that no one wants here have to be transported back.
All of these factors add to the cost.
Jack was somewhat baffled as he stared at the lively scene of the night market stalls.
Justin Welan chuckled, “How about that, Jack? You didn’t expect it, did you?”
“Indeed, I didn’t.” Jack shook his head.
As soon as Jack finished his breakthrough and was about to eat dinner, Justin sent a message asking him to come to the back of the mountain, and then he saw this scene, which completely confused him.
Isn’t this place supposed to be a tense and violent Alien Beast Battlefield?
Now you’re telling me that those guys standing behind the grills, sweating and shouting, are the geniuses of the Martial Cultivation School? The future pillars of the country?
“Hey, that’s why I brought you here today to see for yourself. Let’s go, I’m treating you to some food today. Let’s find a place to sit and wait for Freya Louise and the others..”

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 167: Talent Awakening, Double Layered World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 167: Talent Awakening, Double Layered World_3
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark shook his head: “Forget it, you’re saving your contribution points for that Transcendent Battle Shield, right? I’ll cover the bill this time.”
“Alright, going big today.” Justin Welan nodded, not arguing with Jack.
After all, Jack made a few hundred contribution points today, equivalent to several months of earnings for many Third Layer Heaven students.
Soon the two found a large table to sit at, and Justin called out familiarly: “Boss, a hundred rabbit skewers, and one bear paw from over there, please.” “By the way, it’s still the old rule that fruit wine is free to drink, right?”
“Yes, fruit wine is free.”
“Senior over there, grill a hundred skewers of Snow Jade Beast’s hind leg meat.”
“Alright, just wait a moment.”
Jack looked at him strangely: “Mr. Willard, you guys come here often?”
Justin smiled: “No, only Marcus Lee and 1 have been here twice, Zac Lyons and the others arc too busy cultivating all day, it’s no fun.”
“Also, don’t underestimate this place, many of the bosses here arc old hands.”
“In addition to those who don’t like fighting and killing, there arc some more cautious types, and some Fourth Layer Heaven seniors who just returned from the Deep Mountain.”
Jack’s eyes turned strange: “They’re relaxing their minds like this.”
Justin nodded with a smile: “Yes, they’re relaxing their minds while making some extra cash, and many of them grill meat without any cost.”
“Think about it, they just need to peel off the scale armor from those Mutated Beasts and cut a few hundred pounds of meat, it’s hardly noticeable.”
“Although these grilled skewers only cost a few points in terms of contribution, the accumulated amount is quite significant over a year, and it’s a no-cost deal.”
Jack sighed: “They’re all talents!”
“Hey! These arc just ordinary ones, I heard there are many more…”
Next, Justin shared a lot of information he’d gathered during this time with Jack.
For example, some senior cultivation students who practice agility and stealth methods, they do enter the mountain ranges, but they don’t hunt high-level mutant beasts; instead, they gather information.
For example, which areas have Level 5 and above mutant beasts, which dangerous places are suspected to have resources, where Space Magnetic Fields are distorted, and where there might be Heaven and Earth Treasures, etc.
Then they sell this information at a reasonable price.
These people have an extensive network of contacts that includes a large number of Martial Height Students in the area, forming a vast network of relationships.
Zac Lyons, Marcus Lee, and several others came over as the two talked, followed by Freya Louise.
Everyone at the base dressed casually, including Freya, who was just wearing fitted trousers and a short-sleeved T-shirt that exposed her ivory-white arms.
When the girls sat down, Jack suddenly smelled a faint scent of shampoo.
With his increasingly robust physical body, Jack’s Five Senses had become quite terrifying during this time.
He could hear the sound of mosquitoes flying hundreds of meters away in the forest, his eyes could see insects several kilometers away clearly when there was no obstruction, and his nose was even more sensitive.
Under these circumstances, he would usually suppress the Five Senses and only unlock spiritual perception, otherwise, it would be uncomfortable.
Jack glanced at Marcus Lee, Mullen Weisz, and the others, and asked, “Mr. Willard, why didn’t you call Howard Lee?”
Justin shook his head: “I sent him a message, but he said he couldn’t make it. He went straight into the mountains after getting the three bottles of Blood Armored Beast King’s Essence Blood from the Logistics Department in the afternoon.”
“Damn, how devoted is Howard to this?” Zac Lyons couldn’t help but curse.
Mullen Weisz shrugged: “It’s obvious he’s been stimulated by Jack. After all, he’s the second-ranked freshman, and now he can’t even beat the mutant beasts Jack has crushed.”
Freya burst into laughter, enjoying the sight of others being overshadowed or amazed by Jack.
At this time, the boss came over from a nearby barbecue stall with a big iron plate in his arms, shouting, “Here it is, guys, your spicy fresh Green-scaled Rabbit Meat.”
“…This is barbecue!” Zac Lyons looked at the ‘skewers’ in front of him, with five large pieces of rabbit meat the size of fists on each half-meter-long steel bar, feeling a bit dumbfounded.
A hundred skewers piled up on the table almost formed a large pile.
The burly sophomore boss proudly said: “We’re cultivators after all, it’s much more enjoyable to eat big chunks of meat and drink big sips of wine. Brothers, eat slowly, I have to get back to work.”
Jack waved his hand: “Go ahead and cat, I’m treating today, don’t be polite.”
“Let’s eat.”
After everyone was full and drunk, and had boasted enough, it was already midnight and they had eaten about 10 contribution points worth of food.
In the dormitory corridor, a young man stood with his arms folded, waiting outside Jack’s dormitory door, and his eyes lit up when he saw Jack return, enthusiastically greeting.
“Junior Clark, nice to meet you, my name is Denny Lockwood, Second Grade Fifth Group.” The cultivator took the initiative to introduce himself.
“Senior Denny, hello, are you waiting for me for something?” Jack asked, puzzled.
It seemed he hadn’t seen this Denny person before.
Denny grinned: “That’s right, I do have something to discuss with you, or rather, I have a deal to talk to Junior Clark about.. Are you interested?”

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 167: Talent Awakening, Double- Layered World_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 167: Talent Awakening, Double- Layered World_4
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed: “A deal, information about a high-level mutant beast?”
“As expected of Junior Clark, very smart.”
Denny Lockwood clapped his hands and said enthusiastically: “This time, I discovered the traces of a Level 5 late-period mutant beast in the middle of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, and there seems to be a twisted spatial zone over there.”
Jack Clark hesitated slightly, not expecting that just after Justin Welan mentioned such a group of people, one of them would come to him.
“Senior Lockwood, do you think I, a freshman at the ‘early stage’ of Fourth Layer Heaven, can kill a Level 5 late-period mutant beast?”
“Haha… Junior Clark, stop kidding.”
Denny Lockwood laughed: “The news of you killing an early-stage Level 5 mutant beast with a trace of king-level bloodline has already spread throughout the base. Everyone knows that your combat power is amazing.” “Spread everywhere!” Jack Clark raised his eyebrows.
Although he knew that the news couldn’t be hidden for long, it was still a bit strange that it had spread in just half a day, as if someone was helping to spread it.
At this moment, Denny Lockwood asked: “So, junior, are you interested in this information?”
Jack Clark pondered for a moment: “How much is it?”
A normal Level 5 late-period mutant beast is nothing special, but the suspected resources are quite valuable.
Denny Lockwood held up a hand: “Fifty contribution points!”
“Senior, why not just rob? A Level 5 late-period mutant beast is worth at most 150 contribution points, and hunting it is extremely dangerous.”
“There are resources there.”
“But you also said it’s just a suspicion.”
Next, the two sides engaged in a round of bargaining.
However, no matter how Jack Clark picked on the issues, Denny Lockwood insisted on not lowering the price of fifty contribution points.
He said that it was also very dangerous for him to venture deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, and he had to go through a lot to gather this information, not sleeping for an entire week…
But Jack Clark wasn’t a fool either, who knew how this guy found the mutated creature.
In the end, Jack Clark suggested: “Senior, we just met for the first time, and I don’t know if what you said is true or not. So, let me pay you 20 points as a deposit.”
“If I find and kill the Level 5 mutant beast or gain something from that twisted spatial zone, I’ll pay the remaining 30 points when I return.”
“Of course, if there’s a problem with your information, don’t blame me for not being polite.” With that, Jack Clark’s eyes went cold.
This senior didn’t deliberately hide his aura, and the fluctuations he emitted were around the late Fourth Layer Heaven.
However, Jack Clark felt that his aura was somewhat concealed, and his true realm should be at the peak of the Fourth Layer Heaven, also belonging to the top geniuses in the Second Grade.
But if the other party dared to deceive him, then they should be prepared not to enter the Cloud Mist Mountain Range for a lifetime.
Denny Lockwood nodded: “Alright, consider it as me making a friend. I’ll accept 20 points as a deposit first. As for the authenticity of the information, I guarantee that there is absolutely no problem.”
“If it wasn’t because I don’t like fighting and killing, and I can’t beat the Level 5 late-period mutant beast, I would have gone in to search for resources myself.”
Then Denny Lockwood reminded: “However, junior, as good brothers, we should have a clear account.”
“I will only hold this information for one week. After a week, if you haven’t taken any action, I will sell it to someone else, or else there might be accidents over time.”
The so-called accident, of course, was the discovery of the mutant beast by other cultivators.
“Agreed.”
Jack Clark nodded, and then the two completed the transaction through their smart wristwatches.
Afterward, Denny Lockwood sent him the information about the Level 5 late-period mutant beast, along with the direction, coordinates, and surrounding landmarks of the twisted spatial zone.
Watching Denny Lockwood leave, Jack Clark took out his mobile phone and sent a message to Justin Welan, asking him if he knew Denny Lockwood and if his credibility was good.
As a gossip master, Mr. Willard was quite good at handling such news.
Soon, Justin Welan replied, confirming that this guy named Denny Lockwood was a famous information hunter in the South Sky Martial Height Base and had a good reputation in the circle.
Only then did Jack Clark believe about sixty percent of the information Denny Lockwood provided..

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 168 King-Level Ticket, Giant Beast Accompanying
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 168 King-Level Ticket, Giant Beast Accompanying
Translator: 549690339
After confirming that Denny Lockwood was trustworthy, Jack returned to his room to reflect on their transaction.
Traces of a Level 5 Mutated Beast in its late stages, with a sizeable probability of having a distorted space area harboring Heaven and Earth treasures, would this information be considered expensive at 50 contribution points?
It seemed reasonable at first glance, but in Denny’s case, it was essentially pure profit.
Because he didn’t have to risk hunting the mutated beast or faced the danger to explore that special perilous area to find those potential heaven and earth treasures.
Of course, there is always a trade-off.
If Jack managed to kill that mutated beast and stumbled upon some resources, this trip would be worth at least five hundred contribution points, essentially making a fortune.
On the other hand, if he yielded nothing and only managed to kill the Level 5 mutated beast, this journey would earn just over a hundred contribution points.
This would be the case, provided he killed one or two Level 3 or 4. mutated beasts on his way back.
Although it wouldn’t be a loss, it would fetch a lesser profit, especially considering that fifty points had been taken away.
And who was the one that leaked the information about him killing the Level 5 Mutated Beast with a King-level bloodline?
This was a team effort. Along with him was another genius, Howard Lee, who had also reached Fourth Layer Heaven. Yet, Denny was certain that Jack was the Beast King slayer.
Something was definitely amiss.
Jack was certain of that before he took a bath and readied himself for bed, yet he kept one part of his consciousness on the Thunderflame Behemoth.
After absorbing the ancient blood, Jack felt as if he was half-awake, half-asleep when the Thunderflame Behemoth hibernated, causing him to daydream frequently while on the road these last two days.
Now two days had passed and the drowsy feeling was finally beginning to subside.
Underneath a volcano where scorching magma rolled, a beast thirty-five meters long, with golden-red flames burning all over its body, slowly opened its eyes.
After two days of hibernation, the Thunderflame Behemoth grew several meters larger and its appearance had undergone some changes as well.
Its head resembled the Eastern Divine Dragon even more, while those black horns growing backwards on its head became sharper, more elongated, and dense, similar to a mane.
Add to that the three pairs of blood-red feather horns fiercely protruded from its flanks. Atop them, golden flames formed a crown, giving off a mysteriously divine and majestic impression.
Besides that, its body structure became more robust, its double claws were elongated and powerful, and the muscles of his hind legs were bulging, full of bursting energy.
Whoo!
The Thunderflame Behemoth slightly parted its jaws and a terrifying golden flame spewed out, reaching more than ten meters. Wherever it burned, the magma was melted into pure liquid.
Under normal conditions, magma was a viscous, scorching liquid that contained various substances.
But now, under the golden flame spewed by the Thunderflame Behemoth, these substances were practically smelted into ‘clear’ liquid, becoming even hotter.
This was one of the acquisitions the Thunderflame Behemoth had received from its hibernation: energy control.
Previously, when it exhaled, all the scorching energy within its body needed to be gathered, similar to having a single-use attack which couldn’t be controlled once it manifested. It only had an ‘on’ and ‘off’ switch.
But now, after hibernating, the Thunderflame Behemoth discovered it could control the flames and lightning within its body much more effortlessly. Just a thought was all it needed to gather energy.
Thinking this, the Thunderflame Behemoth stretched out its right claw.
Suddenly the flames jumping around its right arm converged at its claw tip. The compression made the tip resemble molted gold, emitting a dazzling golden light.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth gently swept its claw, and wherever it pointed, magma vanished, leaving a series of black cracks of different lengths.
Then those black cracks disappeared under the pressure of the surrounding magma.
Hiss! So, Powerful! The Thunderflame Behemoth was somewhat surprised.
The overheated flame of more than two thousand degrees Celsius, compressed to ten times its size at the claw’s tip, made its claw excessively sharp, more so than divine weapons.
The energy on the claw tip’s surface exceeding tens of thousands of degrees Celsius even had the ability to completely destroy objects. This could easily rip apart the body’s protective energy or thick scale armor of beasts of the same level.
“Let’s call this Golden Flame Dragon Claw,” the Thunderflame Behemoth named this maneuver.
However, this was just the basic application of energy compression.
With this thought, the Thunderflame Behemoth looked up slightly. The flames on its body suddenly converged, and electric blue lights started hopping around on its dorsal fin, gradually spreading throughout its body.
The electrical energy went deep into the body of the Thunderflame Behemoth, stimulating its muscles, and in an instant, an inexhaustible terrifying strength was released.
Boom!
Together with a world-shaking power burst, the magma exploded in the depths of the volcano. A silhouette surrounded by lightning rose through the sky amid the rolling magma, wrapping up the Thunderflame Behemoth and propelling it hundreds of meters above the sea.
Boom! Mid-air, the magma fire pillar exploded, and it looked like raining fire. Amid the flames, a black and red dragon descended from the sky and violently crashed onto the sea surface.
The sea instantly splashed and churned. The blazing and boiling seawater shot up hundreds of meters.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
A giant black-red beast was creating havoc on the sea surface. Those massive claws stirred up waves as high as ten meters with every swing, accompanied by exploding seawaters, the scene was terrifying.
With the stimulation of the electrical energy on its muscles, calling forth the cell’s strength, the Thunderflame Behemoth was full of energy, longing to release it.
Moreover, after it woke from its slumber this time, its control over other talents was also becoming stronger.
Like now, it could control the power burst in parts, like the double claw. It could maintain up to 20 times its normal strength. As a result, each swing was as terrifying as a missile explosion..

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 168 King-Level Ticket, Giant Beast Accompanying—2
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 168 King-Level Ticket, Giant Beast Accompanying—2
Translator: 549690339
Moreover, the Agility Talent, which originally needed a pause after each burst, was now able to be used for two consecutive bursts due to the increased control of its abilities.
With a thirty-fold increase in land and twenty-fold increase in water body displacement, it became stronger in both offense and defense.
Adding the Golden Flame Dragon Claw, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s combat power suddenly increased by a level.
Its breath could now also be controlled. If it wanted 5,000 degrees Celsius of flame, it could produce exactly that, and if it wanted over ten thousand degrees Celsius, the heat would be that intense.
The changes after waking up this time surprised even Jack Clark.
After driving the Thunderflame Behemoth to wreak havoc in the seas and getting familiar with the changes in its body, Jack Clark called up the attribute page with a thought.
After briefly glancing at the four major attributes that had increased by an average of 100 points during this time, Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the remarks behind the Thundcrflame Behemoth.
Avatar: Ancient Hexagon Thunder Flame Colossus
Level: High-level Mutant Beast [Possessing seven talents, activating ancient bloodline, Unique Beast Monarch with ancient creature aura]
[ Remark: Ancient Aura – A special power from the beginning of the mythical world, when a creature reaches the peak of senior level, the ancient aura can be activated, advancing to become a mythical giant beast of ancient legends]
Seeing the newly condensed remarks on the attribute page, Jack Clark couldn’t help but show surprise and astonishment in his eyes.
He didn’t expect that the ancient blood snatched by the Thunderflame Behemoth was so exaggerated, possessing the ability to allow a Level 9 Peak Giant Beast to break through to the Mythical Giant Beast level.
No wonder that Level 9 Giant Beast was so crazy to chase after it when it sensed the ancient blood’s aura.
But this information also made Jack Clark somewhat serious.
If Giant Beasts need ancient aura to break through to Level 9, what about cultivators?
Was it that cultivators had to fulfill the ancient aura condition after reaching the peak of the Ninth Heavens in order to break through to the King level?
Lost in thought, Jack Clark redirected his attention back to the Thunderflame Behemoth.
The Thunderflame Behemoth had disappeared underwater, and its massive body swam rapidly at a depth of 100 meters, like a black and red torpedo, covering hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye.
It was going to sec how the Single-horned Tiger Whale fared.
That fellow should have a nice harvest if he didn’t die.
After the Thundcrflame Behemoth chose to hibernate in the volcano mouth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale family settled in the shallow water area of a desert island tens of kilometers away. So, the Thundcrflame Behemoth quickly swam over.
From afar, it saw three “small” Tiger Whales of different sizes, about sixteen, fifteen, and fourteen meters long, playing in the water.
From the way they played, it was clear the Single-horned Tiger Whale was fine. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be in the mood to play and would have been worried and gloomy.
But can Tiger Whales even be gloomy?
Seeing the Thundcrflame Behemoth, the three “little” fellows quickly came over excitedly.
Chirp! Uncle, are you looking for Dad? This is the eldest Tiger Whale.
Chirp! Uncle…good. This is the second Tiger Whale.
Chirp! This is the third Tiger Whale.
Seeing the Little Tiger Whales swimming around happily, the Thundcrflame Behemoth let out a roar: Roar! You guys go and play, I’ll go check on Joe.
Just as the Thundcrflame Behemoth had just approached the shallow water area, it saw a forty-meter-long Tiger Whale resting with its body covered in thick black armor.
When it reached the surface of the water, the Single-horned Tiger Whale excitedly said: Chirp! Brother, you have to look at me. Have I gotten uglier?
…The Thundcrflame Behemoth was bemused by this sudden question and roared: Roar! What ugliness?
Chirp! They all say I got uglier. The Single-horned Tiger Whale seemed somewhat wronged.
Its mate, a Female Tiger Whale, swam slowly not far away, watching over the playfully frolicking Little Tiger Whales, occasionally glancing at the Single-horned Tiger Whale with disgust.
Apparently, she thought the whale transformed by the ancient blood looked worse than before.
This left the Thundcrflame Behemoth somewhat speechless: Roar! We’ve all evolved into Mutated Creatures. Who would care about beauty? Besides, you weren’t better-looking than me before you mutated, so don’t worry about these little problems.
Suddenly, the Single-horned Tiger Whale stared in disbelief at the Thundcrflame Behemoth: Chirp! Brother, I can’t believe you have even less shame than I do!
Roar! How am I shameless? Isn’t what I said true? The Thunderflame Behemoth was somewhat irritated.
Chirp! Look at the four ugly claws you have, and that small, sharp tail and long neck. How is that beautiful? The Single-horned Tiger Whale argued.
Roar! What kind of bad taste do you have, to think that I look ugly like this? Don’t I look amazing?
The Thunderflame Behemoth was slightly disdainful. Then, it roared agaimRoar! Alright, stop talking nonsense. We both gained a lot this time, so let’s go and do something big together..

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 168 King-Level Ticket, Giant Beast Accompanying_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 168 King-Level Ticket, Giant Beast Accompanying_3
Translator: 549690339
Chirp Chirp Chirp!! What’s all the fuss about? The Single-horned Tiger Whale wondered.
Roar! Of course, it’s to go to the deep sea to find good things, make full use of your treasure hunting talent to bring back some extra food, and kill a few high-ranked mutated creatures for a feast.
Don’t you want your wife to breakthrough soon? As well as those three little ones of yours, they’ve hardly grown after all this time, you’re not much of a father.
Previously, the Thunderflame Behemoth had advised the Single-horned Tiger Whale to take it easy and not to bring everything back from the expeditions. But now, with its power increased a notch and the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s evolution into a King Blood Mutant Beast, it had started to pressurize the other to do more.
It found that in comparison to hunting mutated beasts for eating and evolving, competing for those extraordinary resources would bring about faster growth in strength.
Moreover, there are powerful mutated beasts lurking around those extraordinary resources. When the time comes, they could consume the resources and also eat those mutated beasts with it. Wouldn’t that be killing two birds with one stone?
On hearing that the ferocious and mighty Thunderflame Behemoth had now become proactive along with it, the Single-horned Tiger Whale immediately felt a strong sense of security, and its aura flared up instantly.
Chirp Chirp Chirp!! Let’s go, brother, and pull off a big job together.
With that, the Single-horned Tiger Whale…
No, he should be called Tiger Whale now, vigorously swung his tail and turned to swim towards the Outer Sea. His imposing and spirited look might make others think that he had brought a bodyguard along.
…Seems like he did get a bodyguard this time.
As it passed by the Female Tiger Whale, the Single-horned Tiger Whale let out a chirp as if greeting her.
The Female Tiger Whale responded warmly. Even though her ‘husband’ had become a bit uglier this time, none of that mattered. What mattered was that he could return safely every time.
The two giant beasts had not yet swum more than a hundred miles when the Thunderflame Behemoth let out a low growl of laughter.
Roar! Joe, let’s head this way first, we’re going to call another fellow.
With that, the Thunderflame Behemoth changed direction and swam towards the coral canyon, planning to call the Dragon Turtle too.
The incident with the ancient blood made the Thunderflame Behemoth realize the benefit of being numerous. Although this would dilute some of the resources taken, the benefits were obvious.
Having two dragon-types or King Bloods as subordinates meant that when they came across a horde of mutated beasts or found top-tier resources, there would be others to shield them while it could massacre freely.
Besides, the ocean was vast and endless, with plentiful resources. Could it, a single beast, not be able to consume it all?
Chirp Chirp Chirp!! Who are we calling?
The Single-horned Tiger Whale, somewhat puzzled, followed behind the Thunderflame Behemoth.
After its evolution this time, the Single-horned Tiger Whale was not only fiercer in its appearance, but also swam faster in the water. Very soon, they reached the coral trench one after another.
Under the pitch-dark sea, 3000 meters deep, a crystal sea trench stretching for several kilometers appeared.
In the middle of the trench, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, having grown to 40 meters in length with its back covered in spikes, was quietly lying with its terrifying head tucked inside its shell, sleeping.
Not far from the corner of the trench, by the side of the almost 6o-meter-long metal skeleton, there was another large beast skeleton, about 30 meters in length.
Clearly, while the Thunderflame Behemoth was absent, an unfamiliar Level 7 creature had attacked and was then killed by the timid Dragon Turtle.
The Thunderflame Behemoth was somewhat surprised to see the Dragon Turtle daring to fight against a same-level mutated creature and even succeeding in killing it.
Just as the astonished Thunderflame Behemoth and Single-horned Tiger Whale were approaching the trench, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, sensing the two strong auras they hadn’t concealed, was instantly awoken and stuck its head out.
Roar Roar!! Thunderflame, you came to sec me.
On seeing the Thunderflame Behemoth, joy shone in the eyes of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
The Thunderflame Behemoth looked at the corpse of the mutated beast and roared in approval: Roar! Well done.
Roar Roar!! Big Dummy… Domination, let me introduce you. This is Joe, Roar! Joe, this one is Domination, my other friend.
Roar Roar Roar!! Thunderflame, what is Domination?
Roar! It’s your name. I gave it to you. From now on, you will be known as Domination.
Roar Roar!! Domination. I have a name now, by the way, why is he called Joe?
Is it because he has a horn on his head?
Chirp Chirp Chirp!! If you hadn’t said it, I wouldn’t have noticed. I actually have a name. By the way, brother, so your name is Thunderflame.
After that, the three giant beasts roared a few times and chirped a few times, excitedly interacting… oh, no, it was the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle who were doing so.
As for the Thunderflame Behemoth, it had already backed away earlier.
Whether these two fellows had little interaction with other creatures or whatever, they chatted a lot after meeting. Them roaring and chirping made the Thunderflame Behemoth’s head spin.
And this interaction went on for half an hour. In the end, running out of patience, the Thunderflame Behemoth had to roar to interrupt them.
Roar! Enough with the idle talk. Whatever you want to say, say it on the way. We have good stuff to grab.
Chirp Chirp Chirp!! Right, I almost forgot about the main task.
Roar Roar!! Thunderflame, we’re leaving. What about this place?
The Dragon Turtle was rather upset about leaving the silver small fish in the coral reefs, which it had been guarding for over half a month and had already grown quite a bit.
The Thunderflame Behemoth let out a low roar.
Roar! Don’t worry about those fry. Eating them won’t be of much help. Even if they are occupied by other mutated creatures, it’s no big deal, we can catch and eat them when we come back.
Let’s go. Don’t waste time.
And, Domination, you’d better move quickly. If you are too slow, I’m not taking you with us.
Chirp Chirp Chirp!! Charge, let’s grab the good stuff and kill them all.
Roar Roar!! Slaughter, loot!
Looking back at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had become rowdy after just mere interaction with the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Thunderflame Behemoth was momentarily speechless.
Soon, under the lead of the Thunderflame Behemoth, the giant beasts vanished into the depths of the dark sea.
It seemed that the Dragon Turtle was really afraid that the Thunderflame Behemoth would not pick it up due to its slow speed and was furiously moving its limbs to crawl over the seabed at a speed not less than the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
It turned out that this seemingly honest and simple creature was not really slow, it had been deliberately slow during the guidance, fearing that the Thunderflame Behemoth would kill it.
It never expected that this creature, which appeared to be honest and simple, would actually have such tricks up its sleeves..

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 169: Press Her Down Hard, Invasion of Purgatory
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 169: Press Her Down Hard, Invasion of Purgatory
Translator: 549690339
When the Thunderflame Beheamoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Single-horned Tiger Whale teamed up to form a three-beast robbing squad.
The next day, Jack Clark got up early and went to the Logistics Department to exchange for four more anti-gravity disks, each embedded with an energy crystal fragment worth fifteen points.
In addition to the two extra energy crystal fragments he had exchanged as backup, Jack Clark spent another 49 contribution points after the discount.
As a result, he only had 34 contribution points left.
This time he went into the mountains, regardless of whether he found the potential resources, Jack Clark planned to kill more Mutated Beasts. Under such circumstances, he naturally had to prepare more anti-gravity disks.
Otherwise, even if his basic arm strength had exceeded 25 tons, he didn’t know how long it would take to drag the corpses of the prey weighing over a hundred tons back.
In Jack Clark’s plan, he intended to accumulate enough contributions within two trips into the mountains.
He would then exchange for the sixth level resources, break through the Fifth Layer Heaven in one breath, and condense the domineering body.
By then, he was confident that he could easily kill even a Level 6 Mutant Beast, then go even deeper into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to obtain precious resources and quickly improve like a snowball.
However, just as Jack Clark’s figure flashed, rushing out of the base’s range at a speed of over a hundred meters per second, he encountered Justin Welan and the others who had just set off.
Or rather, they were waiting for him by the side of the road.
Upon seeing Jack Clark’s figure, Justin Welan waved to him. Jack Clark’s figure stopped and looked at the six of them curiously, “Didn’t you guys set off in the morning?”
Justin Welan grinned, “Yes, but last night you asked me to find out who’s spreading the news about you, so we’re waiting for you here.”
“Mr. Willard, do you know who it is?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised, not expecting Justin’s information-gathering ability to be so fast.
“Jack, I’m sure you have no idea who it is.”
At this point, Justin Welan’s gaze was somewhat strange, and the others, including Freya Louise, had a look of barely contained amusement on their faces.
Jack could not help raising an eyebrow, “An acquaintance?”
Justin Welan still couldn’t help but laugh, “Exactly, not only is he an acquaintance, but he’s also a very close one – Howard Lee.”
“Howard Lee, why?” Jack was dumbfounded; he never thought that the person spreading the news of him killing the King Blood Unique Beast would be the rugged Howard Lee.
At this point, Freya Louise couldn’t help but chuckle while covering her mouth, “Jack, didn’t you check the news this morning?”
“…No, I put my mobile phone in the Sumeru Bracelet last night before going to bed.” Jack paused.
After obtaining the Sumeru Bracelet, he had developed the habit of storing his phone and other miscellaneous items in the storage space to prevent them from being damaged during battles.
“I knew it would be like this,” said the girl, smiling.
_”This morning, Howard Lee sent a mass message to everyone explaining why he spread the news of you killing the King Blood Unique Beast.”
“Why?”
“Because he wants to suppress Jane Aiken. He said that among the more than a thousand men in the new class of South Sky Martial Height, it’s embarrassing that they’ve been suppressed by a woman for half a year.”
“In order to overthrow ‘Jane Aiken’, he has been working hard at cultivation, but always fell a bit short and couldn’t compete.”
“This time, you defeated a Level 5 Late Stage Unique Beast in the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven. It’s not an exaggeration to call you the number one person in the first year of South Sky Martial Height, enough to firmly suppress Jane Aiken,”
For a moment, Jack was speechless, “Is this guy really that chauvinistic? Is it necessary?”
“Of course it is!”
Marcus Lee grinned, “As the saying goes, there is no first in literature and no second in martial arts. If I had your strength, I would’ve challenged Jane Aiken a long time ago to see who is the true king of the new generation of South Sky Martial Height.”
“I never thought you’d be so chuunibyou, Marcus, talking about the new generation’s king,” Justin Welan shook his head, “If you want to do it, you should be talking about being the king of the entire new generation of Eastern Summer.”
“You guys are getting off track. Forget it, don’t bring it up later, and don’t fuel the fire,” Jack reminded them.
“We’re all classmates, and there’s no need to fight for these empty titles. Even if we really want to fight, it should be for the first place on the Achievement List, which has more gold content.”
“That’s true. Before becoming the king of the new generation of Eastern Summer, Jack, you should strive for the first place on the Achievement List,” Justin Welan grinned.
Everyone else thought Jack was joking.
Although he had killed a Level 5 Late Stage king blood unique beast, the first on the Achievement List, Ethan Polis, was even stronger.
According to Justin Welan’s information, Ethan was not only at the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven, on the verge of igniting the Flame of True Power, but also had many hunting achievements of Level 6 Mutant Beasts.
The most powerful of them was even comparable to the Late Level 6 Mutant Beast, very terrifying. At present, Ethan spent most of his time in the depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, seeking a breakthrough.
“Alright, it’s getting late. Let’s all set off.”
“Jack, be careful. The middle part of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range is not like the periphery.”
“Jack Clark, pay more attention to safety.”
“Okay, don’t worry, I’ll be careful. You guys take care too, and protect Freya.”
“Hahaha… Don’t worry, Jack. After Teacher Clark helped me refine the Extraordinary Battle Shield yesterday, my Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Defense has become even stronger.”
With a wave, the entire group split into two directions and quickly left, disappearing into the vast mountain forest in the blink of an eye.
In the primeval forest, Jack Clark’s figure, clad in gorgeous black and red battle armor, flashed by at a speed that left only an afterimage, completely silent.
Only when his battle boots touched the ground would a slight vibration be emitted, and only after his figure disappeared would the wind sound of the rapidly stirred air resonate.
The improved Hidden Deity Method was even more effective at concealing his breath and traces. It wasn’t until Jack Clark disappeared that the startled Mutated Creatures reacted..

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 169: Ruthlessly Press Her Down,
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 169: Ruthlessly Press Her Down,
Purgatory Invasion _2
Translator: 549690339
After breaking through to the late stage, Jack Clark was no longer so frugal, and with the circulation of True Strength amplifying his muscular strength, he maintained a constant speed of 200 meters per second, charging recklessly.
He did not bother with the obstructing vines and bushes on his path, directly rushing past them, looking like a crimson and black sword piercing through the mountain forest beneath his battle armor covered with True Strength.
He crossed mountains and rivers, and quickly burst out of the Nine Rings Mountain, taking another route to enter the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
According to Denny Lockwood’s coordinates, the place was located on the southwest side of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, about 1,300 kilometers deep into the mountains, after which the coordinates ended.
Due to the cloud mist and the chaotic space magnetic field, the Sky Base Satellite could not monitor the area, and the map Lockwood gave him only showed the direction, approximate coordinate points, and estimated distance.
When he got there, Jack still had to search slowly for it.
Whoosh! Jack’s figure flashed past the misty mountain streams, with his speed slowing down, almost concealing his breath to the limit.
He was already 500 kilometers deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, and even Jack did not dare to be careless at this point, cautiously paying attention to everything around him.
Just then, Jack’s figure suddenly stopped, and his eyes became serious as he looked forward. The faint golden vertical pupils hidden in the depths of his eyes appeared.
He saw that more than ten meters in front of him, the originally calm air suddenly twisted.
Immediately following, at a place more than a meter off the ground, a long and narrow dark crack appeared silently, expanding nonstop to more than three meters long.
Where the crack passed, the grass and trees silently broke in two.
The crack appeared for only more than ten seconds before it disappeared without a trace.
This was one of the dangers of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, Space Cracks.
Due to their proximity to the overlapping point of the mythical world, spaces here became unstable and fragile, with the potential of cutting apart everything.
However, these Space Cracks usually appeared with strong fluctuations, so as long as one was careful, they could easily avoid them.
The trouble was the sudden large-scale space collapses that occurred. Once caught in them, even those in the Seventh Layer Heaven would die.
In the past years, some unlucky geniuses died under these Space Collapses, their bones shattered and gone, becoming a cause for regret.
However, Jack’s heterochromatic eye, which was not fully awakened, could see the cracks forming in advance, making his actions in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range safer.
The problem was that this nascent talent could not be maintained for long and could only be used as a backup method.
Once the spatial fluctuations in front stabilized, Jack’s figure flashed and disappeared among the valleys, continuing to hurry along according to the direction indicated on his smart wristwatch.
Roar!
A Mutated Beast roared ferociously on the hillside, its aura mighty as it emitted scorching flames that ignited the surrounding grass and trees.
In the midst of the roaring fire, the Unique Beast, which was shaped like a saber-toothed tiger and covered in exaggerated red scales and horns, kept roaring.
The Mutated Beast was more than 20 meters long, and with its elongated scorpion-like tail, reached more than 30 meters. The power fluctuations it emitted reached the Level 5 Peak.
In the sea of fire, the Mutated Beast moved like the wind, causing roaring vibrations with every sideways pounce and claw swipe. When it landed, the ground shattered, and raging wind and flames howled.
Its scorpion tail whipped out even more, creating an afterimage with its amazing momentum, forcing the cultivators attacking it to keep dodging.
At this time, the Mutated Beast was being besieged by four cultivators, the weakest of whom was at Late Fourth Layer Heaven, while the strongest had reached the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
The Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven cultivator was the lead attacker, with a circle of blue halo emanating from his extraordinary battle armor, blocking the flames outside his body.
On the straight combat knife in his hand, the more than 2-meter-long Sword Qi was surging, extinguishing the flames wherever it passed. When the blade light fell on the ground, it tore through the earth, leaving a long and narrow crack behind.
In the midst of the fierce battle, half of the hillside had been ignited by the Scorpion Armored Beast, with flames reaching the sky and dispersing the surrounding clouds and mist.
The explosive momentum and roaring sounds of the battle disturbed the Mutated Creatures nearby, causing them to panic and flee.
There were two Mutant Birds with wingspans of more than ten meters hovering in the sky, waiting to take advantage of the situation.
Meanwhile, a few kilometers away on a mountain peak, Jack, wearing black and red gorgeous battle armor, stood silently, watching the battle below, especially the cooperation between the people.
The team below was very strong, all equipped with Transcendent Battle Armor and Transcendent Weapons.
At this time, though they seemed to be besieging the Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast for half a day and had not yet brought it down, in actuality, they were at ease, wearing the beast down without any injuries.
Facing the cultivators’ team, which had rich combat experience and cooperation, the Mutated Beast with its fire talent did not understand how to control its consumption.
In the state of maintaining a few hundred-degree Celsius flames on its body surface at all times, the energy within its body was quickly depleted, and in just over ten minutes, the flames slowly died out.
Suddenly, its aura weakened dramatically.
At this moment, the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven Third-year Senior Students leading the charge shouted, “Attack!”
Boom, boom, boom! In an instant, the four cultivators simultaneously exploded with their full strength, two holding back the beast, one assisting, and the strongest one slashing out a dazzling sword light.
Roar!
The Mutated Beast let out a miserable scream as half of its neck was slashed open. Its scorching blood spurted out like a fountain, shooting more than ten meters high.
As the dust settled, Thomas Cardare turned his head to look at Jack from a distance, his eyes on guard.
Seeing this, Jack nodded slightly at them, and his figure disappeared in a flash.
Watching Jack disappear, Thomas Cardare said in a deep voice, “Let’s clean up and leave quickly. The commotion from the fight just now was a bit too big, and we don’t want to attract Level 6 Mutated Creatures.”
“Yeah.”
Soon, the four of them carried the several-tens-of-tons-heavy Scorpion Armored Beast’s corpse away, and the burning fire on the hillside slowly extinguished in the surrounding gathered mist as well..

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 169: Press Her Down Hard,
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 169: Press Her Down Hard,
Purgatory Demon Invasion 3
Translator: 549690339
Soon, everything returned to calm.
As Jack Clark ventured into the middle section of Cloud Mist Mountain Range, at the end of the mountain range more than 3,000 kilometers away.
In the fog-filled valley, space suddenly distorted, vibrated, and collapsed. In the blink of an eye, a huge dark crack opened and continuously expanded into a rotating blue channel.
Whoosh! A bloodied figure burst out from the depths of the channel and rolled twice on the ground when landing.
When this figure got up from the ground and saw the surrounding misty Heaven and Earth, as well as the much thinner Heavenly Energy, his face revealed a neurotic laughter.
“Hahaha…I’ve succeeded, I didn’t die.” Amidst the crazed laughter, the blood on the figure wriggled like a living thing, eventually flowing back slowly.
Even the blood on the ground seemed to flow back as if it was alive, and the bone-deep wounds on his body visibly healed in an instant.
When the weak aura stabilized slightly, the figure suppressed the excitement on his face and took out a black crystal card from his body.
Crack!
Following the figure’s movement, the black crystal card burst with a bang. Immediately, a tangible Black Power poured out, twisting and winding in the air like smoke, gradually forming a mysterious and complex special character. As this character condensed, a terrifying Power Explosion burst from the depths of the spinning Spatial Channel, emitting a dazzling Purple Energy.
Under the influx of that Purple Energy, the initially collapsing channel gradually stabilized, and another shadow appeared from its depth.
This was a very burly figure whose landing caused a thunderous rumble on the ground.
However, just like the first figure, this nearly 3-meter-tall giant was also covered in wounds, breathing weakly, and showing a relieved expression on his face after landing.
“Such an unstable crack channel is too dangerous. Fortunately, 1 didn’t die in the channel.”
With two figures appearing in succession, more figures continuously rushed out of the Spatial Channel, and each individual was heavily injured.
There was even one with only his upper body left, who let out a desperate scream upon landing: “No, 1 don’t want to die yet, save me…”
Just then, a giant foot landed.
Bang! The man’s head instantly exploded, and his half corpse instantly stiffened and stopped moving.
Seeing this, the first figure frowned and looked coldly at the burly figure: “Kranter, what do you mean by that?”
The second giant, with a crude and ferocious face, showed a grin: “It means nothing. I just thought he was in too much pain, so I gave him a quick death.” “Can’t you tell me you could save him?”
The first figure coldly snorted: “Even if that’s the case, it should be done by someone of my Blood God Sect, not you.”
The burly giant grinned and, waving his thick arm, said indifferently: “It’s fine. We’re all part of the Divine Sect Alliance. No need to thank me for such a small matter.”
The first figure narrowed his eyes, and a dense blood light spread around his body. The red light made the ground emit a corroding sound, and weeds within a few meters instantly withered and decayed.
“What, do you want to fight?”
Kranter released a heavy and Overbearing aura, causing the surrounding earth to sink with a rumble, exuding an oppressive terror.
Instantly, the situation between the two parties was on the verge of breaking out.
Seeing this, the surrounding people who had rushed out of the channel just watched with cold eyes and showed no intention of intervening; some even sneered as if watching a play.
Whoosh!
Another figure rushed out of the channel.
This was a young man in his twenties, dressed in white like snow, with a handsome face and ink-black hair casually draped behind him, giving an unconstrained and transcendent appearance.
Although the aura of this young man was also very weak, it was much better than the others, and on his clothes, there was only a little blood.
As soon as this person appeared, a hush fell over the surroundings, and everyone’s eyes showed a wary look.
At this moment, a terrifying deep and dark aura came from the depths of the Spatial Channel, causing the initially stable channel to vibrate again.
Kranter’s face changed slightly: “Not good, Master Mikus’s True Demon aura is too strong, and it’s being repelled by Blue Star.”
“Don’t worry, this channel can withstand the passage of all life below Seventh Layer Heaven, including the Purgatory Demon.”
“Of course, it can pass through, but if the luck is too bad, they will be torn apart by the numerous cracks in the channel, just like those fools.”
As the Spatial Channel continued to vibrate, a horrifying figure gradually emerged.
This humanoid figure stood 2 meters tall, with an imposing helmet that covered a cold face. Red fine scales covered the face, with a pair of curved horns slanting towards the Firmament above.
This being was dressed in a monstrous black armor, with black smoke emitting from the armor’s joints and cracks on the body, surrounding the figure in wisps of smoke.
Besides, this creature had a snake-like tail behind it, resembling a devil from hell.
As soon as this figure appeared, it emitted a terrifying aura that made people’s hearts palpitate.
Seeing this, the members around with strong auras from Blood God Sect Blood Envoy, Giant God Sect Apostle, and Shadow God Sect stealth assassins all respectfully lowered their heads, their legs trembling slightly.
In the presence of this terrifying figure, they instinctively felt fear, submission, and dared not to resist.
This was the gap between different levels of life..

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 170: Civilization War, Demon God Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 170: Civilization War, Demon God Bloodline
Translator: 549690339
Deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
As Mikus, who was dressed in black armor like a demon, came out, the spatial channel behind him faded its mysterious glow, falling into complete silence.
Mikus took a deep breath, showing a look of intoxication on his face: “Is this the air of the Blue Star World? I smell many delicious food scents.”
Ma He stepped forward and respectfully said: “Congratulations, Mikus, for being the first Purgatory God Clan to set foot on Blue Star.”
Mikus nodded slightly: “You are right, I am indeed the first True Demon who set foot into the human inner world since the start of the Civilization War.”
“Let me correct you here, we are the Purgatory True Demon Clan, no need to take on the hypocritical title of ‘God’, this title just makes me feel uncomfortable.”
Ma He, who had just made a faux pas, quickly said respectfully: “Yes, we are indeed the great True Demon Clan, I spoke incorrectly, please forgive me, Lord Mikus.”
Witnessing all this, a faint disdain surged in the eyes of the others.
At this moment, Mikus swept a glance around, his eyes gradually turning icy, “This time, Demon King Barus has spent a massive amount of resources, positioning dozens of times in succession just to send me in.”
“According to the coordinates obtained from the prisoners, this should be deep within the Southern Battlefield of the Eastern Summer human race, where the space is chaotic, the information is shielded, and it’s where the young geniuses of the human race cultivate.”
When they heard about the dozens of successive positionings, Ma He and the others all trembled.
Because every time they failed, the one who went ahead to probe would be torn to pieces by the collapsing spatial channel, leaving no trace of their existence.
“This time, the Mysterious Martial King of the human race penetrated into our True Demon territory, killing a prince who had the bloodline of a Great Demon God, which enraged all the major Demon Gods.”
“Especially that Demon God, who left the frontline battlefield to chase and kill the human Mysterious Martial King deep into the chaotic space, demanding a price to be paid.”
“Yet, even so, it failed to appease the anger of those great existences. The Demon King Barus, taken in charge, initiated a new round of killing operations against the human race, focusing especially on their stronger youths.”
“We, as the first group to enter the human inner world, have a very important mission. Once completed, it will greatly benefit us, but at the same time, it will be like plunging into enemy territory without any support.”
“In this situation, we must be cautious, therefore, until my injury has fully recovered, no one is allowed to leave and possibly expose us to unexpected dangers. Understood?”
As he said this, Mikus’s face turned chillingly cold.
Excluding those who were sent ahead to probe, their elite assault team originally consisted of fifty members, but after going through the cracks, only twenty-three survived.
On top of that, all of them were severely injured, their realm had been oppressed by a small level due to the residual space marks from the cracks. Even Mikus would need half a month to recover.
But it didn’t matter, those who died were all subordinates of the Evil God Alliance after all.
Kranter and the others said respectfully: “We understand.”
Seeing this, Mikus slowly nodded: “Don’t worry, I know you are filled with hatred for the Human Federation, so I won’t restrain you for too long.”
“This channel is our only way out. According to Demon King Banis’s plan, he will continue to consume energy to maintain this channel for one star cycle, about thirty days.”
“In at most fifteen days, you will be free to hunt those genius human races.”
Immediately, those from the Evil God Sect showed a bloodthirsty excitement on their faces.
All those who came this time were elites, with realms equivalent to those of the Sixth Layer in the human race. Each of them was extremely powerful and don’t even fear the Sixth Layer teachers sitting in the human school bases.
Of course, the prerequisite was they were in perfect condition and were not being besieged.
Moreover, due to passing through the unstable space cracks, they could not bring anything with them except for their weapons. Even the healing resources on their bodies were affected and destroyed by the power of the space storm.
Hence, they didn’t even have any high-level resources to quickly recover from their injuries. They could only rely on absorbing Heavenly Energy to slowly recover, or hunting mutated creatures around and absorbing their Essence Blood.
It’s not to say they brought nothing at all. Mikus, who was even stronger, did bring some stuff. Seeing the special bag bulging from his waist was a giveaway, but he would definitely not distribute some to these ‘subordinates’.
The three-meter tall Kranter licked his lips and said menacingly: “By then, I intend to tear off all the heads of those so-called ‘geniuses’, and make a necklace out of them.”
“Heh, I’m not interested in human heads. But before departure, the archbishop said that as long as one could bring back a scalp of a genius, he would reward them with a high-level resource.”
With bloodshot eyes filled with resentment, Ma He said: “I want to drain all the blood from these Federation dogs.”
At this point, the white-dressed young woman who had come out second last turned slightly, her figure flashed, appearing tens of meters away. Mikus’s eyes cooled instantly, speaking in a stern voice,
“Ilisa Wesley, didn’t you hear what 1 just said?”
The white-dressed young woman turned back slightly, speaking indifferently: “Mikus, the Eternal God Church is not the underling of the Purgatory Family, and you have no right to order me.”
Mikus’s eyes instantly showed an intense killing intent, speaking coldly: “In other words, you intend to defy my command?”
The white-dressed young woman stood with her hands behind her back, speaking quietly: “I have said that you have no right to command me, so there is no question of defying anything. I will go wherever 1 want.”
“Asking for death.” Bang! In an instant, a terrifying demonic might burst forth from Mikus. The majestic and powerful aura caused Heaven and Earth to darken slightly, demonstrating an alarming momentum..

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 170: Civilization War, Demon God Bloodline_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 170: Civilization War, Demon God Bloodline_2
Translator: 549690339
“Believe it or not, even if I’m injured today, my realm drops to the Five Demonic Marks, and I can only exert more than half of my strength under the Blue Star’s rules, I can still suppress you.”
“Really? I’ve never killed a Purgatory True Demon before, how about you be my first?”
While saying this, the young man in white had a golden sun appearing in his eyes, and an overbearing and scorching will surged upwards, evaporating the demonic qi around in the blink of an eye, with a terrifying power.
Just as the two were about to clash, Ma He and Lian quickly intervened: “Lord Mikus, the mission is more important, there’s no need to bother with the madmen from the Eternal God Church.”
“That’s right, sir, don’t bother with Jack Clark. He’s also from the Divine Sect Alliance, and even if he leaves, you don’t have to worry about him leaking our information.”
“With his strength, those Federation dogs can only die when they meet him, so sir, don’t worry.”
Others quickly advised, seemingly more fearful of the white-robed young man than Mikus from the Purgatory Demon Race.
Mikus remained unmoved, with his black demonic qi engulfing the skies, turning the surrounding sky black, making it increasingly terrifying.
However, watching Mikus, who seemed to be ready to make a move at any moment but had yet to do so, the young man in white suddenly chuckled lightly, his eyes’ golden sun disappearing as he turned and left, vanishing into the mist.
Mikus didn’t stop him, but there was a strange flash of light in his eyes.
It was just past 5 pm, the dense fog growing thicker and darker as it enveloped the deep mountain wilderness.
With a sweep of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, the body of a double-headed white python with a pair of claws beneath its belly and more than ten meters long burst, with countless blood and flesh splattering.
Standing amidst the strong, bloody smell with the war halberd, Jack Clark looked coldly to the left.
There, a huge Mutated Beast, black all over, more than seventeen meters long, slowly retreated, eventually disappearing into the depths of the forest.
As he watched the Level 4 Mutated Beast disappear, Jack Clark shook his head: “What a pity, I haven’t found that Mutated Beast yet, or else I would have killed it and brought it back.”
As he spoke, he dashed away in a burst of speed.
His body covered in black and red True Power, the weeds, shrubs, and branches were all shattered as he passed through them.
Compared to the vast wilderness, Jack Clark seemed as insignificant as an insect, and the noise he made during movement was absorbed by the vegetation before it could travel even a few dozen meters.
However, it was also quite difficult to find a Mutated Beast in the foggy primeval forest.
This was where Denny Lockwood had pointed out, and Jack Clark had been here for half an hour, searching for traces of the Level 5 Mutated Beast in its late stage.
In fact, he had already spotted two Level 5 Mutated Creatures on the way here.
However, this time he was not only hunting for Level 5 Mutated Beasts but also the possible resources, so he suppressed his impulse to strike.
Soon, it was getting dark.
Without finding any traces of the Mutated Creature, Jack Clark found a towering tree, over 100 meters tall, with a diameter of more than ten meters.
Standing on the two-meter-thick trunk, Jack Clark wielded the halberd to cut through it with red and black surges, tearing apart the tough bark like iron.
In no time, Jack Clark dug out a tree hole three meters long, wide, and deep.
In addition, he also preserved the bark to make a tree door so he could go in and out.
Since it was more than fifty meters up, it was quite concealed.
Sitting cross-legged in the tree hole and putting away the battle halberd, Jack took out a large piece of spicy Mutated Beast jerky and a bottle of water, eating slowly.
While he was having dinner, the surroundings awakened, and the whole Vast Wilderness Forest suddenly came to life.
Roar!
From a distance, a roar that shook the mountain forest rang out, followed by a fierce battle, emitting energy fluctuations and fierce qi that terrified many Mutated Creatures.
Howl!
A few trees near the tree Jack Clark was in shook, and two Mutated Beast auras, one Level 4 and the other Level 3, erupted in furious roars.
There were raging winds howling in the sky, with powerful Mutated Birds flying in low, and their huge wings caused an airflow that even Jack Clark could hear.
Boom!
The depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range were even more dangerous at night, and in the Heart’s Eye Realm, Jack Clark occasionally sensed the auras of Level 3 and Level 4 Mutated Creatures sweeping by.
In addition to that, there were even more Level 1 and Level 2 ordinary Mutated Creatures, like a frenzied dance of demons.
In such an environment, it was naturally impossible to cultivate casually, as the fluctuations emitted while absorbing the surrounding Heavenly Energy could easily attract the sensing of Mutated Creatures.
So, after dividing his attention to guard around him, Jack Clark turned his attention to the Thunderflame Giant Beast on the other side.
After forming a small team, the three giant beasts began to wander the deep sea.
But to Jack Clark’s disappointment, Joe, the Single-horned Tiger Whales talent in treasure hunting wasn’t as strong as he had imagined, wandering around for a day without finding any Heaven and Earth Treasure.
This was in stark contrast to his imagination that he could find resources in the Outer Sea and then kill and eat along the way.
Under the 400-meter-deep sea, the Thunderflame Giant Beast roared: “Joe, we’ve been turning around all day, and we still haven’t found anything good?”
Wailing! “Thunderflame, be patient, it usually takes me a while to find something when I come out. It’s not that fast.” The Single-horned Tiger Whale explained.
Roar roar! “Thunderflame, don’t worry, I’m not worried.”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle spoke up, before roaring and howling again.
Roar roar! “Joe, why…”
Roar! “Domination, you shut up and be quiet.” Thunderflame interrupted the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle before it could ask.
Suddenly, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle felt somewhat wronged and retracted its head, looking at the Single-horned Tiger Whale on the side, hoping it would help mediate the situation..

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 170: Civilization War, Demon God Bloodline_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 170: Civilization War, Demon God Bloodline_3
Translator: 549690339
However, the Single-horned Tiger Whale quickly turned its head, pretending not to see.
Ever since setting out in a group, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had been chattering non-stop throughout the day, endless words pouring from its mouth.
Even the Thunderflame Behemoth, with its good temper, could not bear it anymore and slapped its claw on the turtle shell, sending the Dragon Turtle deep into the seabed to suppress its incessant talking.
Following this, the three giant beasts continued wandering in the deep sea, and in the blink of an eye, a night had passed.
The next morning, streaks of golden sunlight penetrated the clouds and mist, bringing some vitality to the mysterious landscape shrouded in fog.
Accompanied by a sound of a door flying open, Jack Clark, who had been meditating for a night, slowly emerged from the tree hole.
The shiny black-red armor on his body reflected dazzling red light under the sunlight, making him look very magnificent and domineering.
Standing on the tree trunk, Jack Clark looked around, and after a moment of contemplation, his body shot out with an explosive sound, leaping a hundred meters high and disappearing into the southeast.
The roar and aura in that direction were the strongest yesterday, and he felt that the Mutated Beast he was tracking would most likely be there.
However, as the saying goes “looking at the mountains kills a horse”, Jack Clark traveled more than 30 kilometers before discovering something at the foot of a hillside.
Footprints, each five meters long and spaced more than ten meters apart, sinking more than a meter into the ground, indicated that the Mutated Creature was very large and agile.
Apart from that, the footprints were individually moving forward to the left and right. Jack Clark guessed that the Mutated Beast might be of the ape species, and his spirit was lifted as he followed the vanishing footprints.
Of course, such large footprints could also be left by Level 6 Mutated Creatures with even larger body sizes, so he remained cautious.
However, as he pursued, the footprints became shallower, sometimes more than a hundred meters apart, and instead, it was the towering trees around that bore traces of damage.
Besides, during his pursuit, Jack Clark also discovered numerous large pools of blood, along with the scattered remains of flesh and organs.
These were obviously left by the fighting Mutated Creatures last night.
After crossing two small hills and a canyon, Jack Clark finally found his target this time.
Underneath a large tree, an ape-like Unique Beast that was over ten meters tall when sitting was feasting on the corpse of a Mutated Creature, nearly twenty meters in length.
However, unlike regular ape-like Mutated Creatures, this Mutated Creature had no scale armor, but rather possessed long brown hairs over two meters long and, especially, its gigantic claws that were as long as half its body.
By this point, the long-haired Violent Ape must have been eating for quite a while, leaving only a small portion of the Level 4. Mutated Beast’s corpse.
The flow of blood staining the ground red formed a pool in a depression, emitting a strong smell of blood.
From several hundred meters away, Jack Clark, concealed in the shadow of a tree and keeping his aura hidden, did not take any action yet.
Just then, a rustling sound came from behind him; a colorful Mutated Poisonous Snake over five meters long slowly approached him.
The eye-catching color of this snake indicated its terrifying toxicity, and the leaves it passed over turned black.
However, just as the Colorful Poisonous Snake came within two meters of Jack Clark and was about to attack, his left hand, covered in battle armor, reached out and pressed down slightly toward it.
Silently, the poisonous snake was crushed under a heavy force into minced meat.
At the Fourth Layer Heaven, True Strength can be released externally, allowing Sword Qi to be created, but the released True Strength would usually dissipate after ten meters.
At the Fifth Layer Heaven, the characteristic is Power of Will; the infused Sword Qi has an explosive power twice as strong, reaching up to twenty meters.
Moreover, with Will materialized, the combined True Power Aura can interfere with matter, just like what had just happened.
When a cultivator breaks through to the Sixth Layer Heaven and Will and True Strength merge to form True Force Flame, the cultivator’s strength will greatly increase.
The current geniuses in the third grade are stuck at this level.
Under Jack Clark’s gaze, it took the long-haired Violent Ape more than half an hour to finish feasting, then it threw away the remains of the Unique Beast’s corpse and stood up.
The enormous Mutated Beast now stood over twenty-five meters tall, and its colossal size filled Jack Clark with a sense of oppression.
Roar, roar, roar!
After letting out a series of roars, the long-haired Violent Ape walked away.
As it passed, the trees swayed, their branches snapped, leaving a wide mountain road. After a while, a shadow flashed and disappeared along the road.
The long-haired Violent Ape crossed half a mountain and then vanished into a fog-churning area.
One minute later, Jack Clark’s figure slowly appeared, standing in front of the dense fog-like Space Distortion, his eyes revealing a hint of joy.
He had sensed strong spatial fluctuations ahead.
Jack Clark took a deep breath, then stepped into the mist; immediately, an intense feeling of space distortion came from all directions. Despite the space being still and empty, the feeling of distortion seemed solid.
