This upside-down, twisted feeling lasted for about a minute before Jack Clark felt a sense of lightness.
Suddenly, a canyon appeared before his eyes.
Surprisingly, the canyon was not filled with the fragrance of birds and flowers. Instead, it was filled with jumbled, jagged rocks hundreds of meters high and violent chaotic energy throughout Heaven and Earth.
There was not a trace of the breath of life in this place, including any grass or vegetation. It was filled with silence and depression.
Occasionally, pitch-black Space Cracks emerged out of thin air, tearing apart the hard rocks without a sound. Chunks of broken stones fell, making crisp noises.
This was a Twisted Space Zone similar to a secret realm, extremely dangerous.
Jack Clark slipped deeper into the rocky no-man’s land, and nearly a kilometer in, he discovered a “crack” deep in the cliff walls.
The huge crack was hundreds of meters long, more than thirty meters high, and narrowed inward.
The long-haired Violent Ape was lying at the cave entrance, fast asleep. The thick, violent, chaotic Heavenly Energy there formed a vortex, which the Violent Ape inhaled and exhaled.
Only these powerful Mutated Creatures could absorb this kind of violent energy.
Human cultivators, who need to refine the energy, could also absorb it, but with less efficiency compared to outside, the trade-off was not worth it.
As for any hidden resources that might exist, Jack Clark had not detected any traces, nor had he sensed the presence of any Heaven and Earth Treasures.
The whole way, there were no special mineral deposits either.
Wait, there seems to be something behind the long-haired Violent Ape.
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s eyes focused, looking at the narrow depths of the cave behind the long-haired Violent Ape. Among the shattered stones were some pure, milky-white crystals.
It appeared to be an Ethereal Crystal Stone containing Space Power..

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 171: The Fire of Life, Space Enhancement
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 171: The Fire of Life, Space Enhancement
Translator: 549690339
While the long-haired Violent Ape was hibernating, Jack Clark activated the Hidden God Method to conceal his aura, and he slowly approached it following the shadows of the mountain wall.
However, only the early stages of the Hidden God Method could conceal Jack’s aura, it couldn’t erase the dangerous intuition that comes from the beast’s instinct.
As a result, when Jack was about thirty meters away from the Mutant Fierce Ape, the ape opened its eyes, sensing something, and looked around cautiously.
Roar! The ape emitted a low roar, the sound wave echoed through the valley, apart from that, the entire canyon was silent.
After observing the same, always deathly quiet valley, a look of confusion was evident in the ape’s eyes.
By now, Jack, realizing he couldn’t kill the long-haired Violent Ape by ambush, took a deep breath, holding out his hand and retrieving the War Halberd from the Sumeru Bracelet.
Boom!
Accompanied by a terrifying burst of aura, the blood-red halberd bloomed, and Jack instantly transformed into a beam of light, shooting out.
Roar!
Under the intense sense of impending death, the long-haired Violent Ape’s fur bristled like an attacked porcupine, turning its body around and roaring viciously.
The golden light shimmered on its claws, which were almost half the size of its body, tearing through the air, stirring up a wave of white energy to strike the blood-red halberd at its knee.
There was no choice, this long-haired Violent Ape was too tall, standing over twenty meters tall, Jack, holding the War Halberd, could only reach its knees.
The near four-meter-long War Halberd appeared as a slender cotton swab in front of the massive claw spread over ten meters, it seemed tiny, frail, but…
Boom!
The moment claw and halberd collided, the overbearing Dragon Elephant True Strength explosively erupted, instantly transforming the rampant True Strength mixed with sharp halberd skill into a shockwave that swept through a tens of meters range.
Caught off guard by the explosive impact, the ape stumbled backwards.
At this moment, the heavy, overbearing halberd penetrated the current, reaching supersonic speed in an instant, sweeping across and forming a fan-shaped pitch-black vacuum plane.
The long-haired Violent Ape instinctively placed its giant claws in front of it for protection.
Thump! The three meters long golden curved claw was directly severed by the halberd, and blood even sprayed out from the severed area.
Roar! With two claws severed and its palm in ruins from the explosive impact, the long-haired Violent Ape roared in agony, a terrifying aura of a Level 5 Peak monster burst forth.
Buzz buzz buzz!
Accompanied by the roar of the ape, an actualized sonic wave burst forth from its core, instantly causing a surge of intense coldness to rise in Jack’s heart.
He instantly backed away in an explosive retreat.
Puff puff puff!
The special sound wave caused fluctuations in the already unstable space around it. Under resonance, black cracks of varying lengths continuously appeared and disappeared instantly in the tens of meters range.
Everything that the space cracks pass through gets sliced into two.
However, when some black cracks appeared around the long-haired Violent Ape, a faint transparent force began to ripple on its long hairs.
The presence of these long hairs that emitted transparent energy caused those spatial cracks to slightly bend.
Seeing this, Jack’s gaze slightly hardened.
He didn’t expect this ape’s hair to possess the special characteristic of disrupting space cracks. Coupled with the roaring sound waves that induce unstable spatial cracks, it was no wonder it has stayed here all along.
Even an average Level 6 Mutant Beast might not necessarily be its opponent here.
The sharp, invisible space cracks can slice through all matter; unless the power you cultivate is related to space, there are no means of defense under the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Even Jack wouldn’t dare to touch the cracks.
Moreover, this Unique Beast was not in its late period of Level 5, but at Level 5 Peak.
Thinking about this, a faint excitement appeared on Jack’s face, as this meant the Unique Beast could very likely contain the Life Crystal within its body.
Just when Jack was somewhat excited, an even stronger force erupted from the body of the long-haired Violent Ape, surrounded by an actual transparent force, it suddenly shot out from the cave with a boom.
Its enormous body stirred up a raging wind, casting a large shadow over Jack’s head; its gigantic double claws, like an eclipse, left eight black scars in the air as they descended from the heavens.
Boom!
The moment Jack vanished instantly, the earth collapsed within a tens of meters range, countless fragments mixed with shockwaves swept across the tens of meters range, smoke, and dust filling the sky.
Roar!
Suddenly, the smoke dissipated, the long-haired Violent Ape, with a thunderous boom, rolled up a raging wind, leaping high up over a hundred meters; its colossal claws blasted through the air to strike at Jack on the rock.
Whoosh!
Jack’s figure disappeared in a flash again, in an instant, the top half of the rock collapsed into countless fragments under the ape’s terrifying power.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the rage-filled onslaught of the ape, the entire valley shook violently, everything in its path was destroyed, the ground shattered, resembling ‘mountain peaks’, the chunks of chaotic rocks collapsed.
The dense smoke almost submerged half of the valley.
This Violent Ape was incredibly fast, and immensely powerful; its pair of claws was unmatched in sharpness, casually destroying mountainous rocks that weighed several hundred to thousands of tons.
Temporarily, the Violent Ape dominated the battlefield, putting Jack on the defensive.
But when the ape had swept nearly half the valley with its rage and slowly got lured to the entrance of the valley, Jack abruptly stopped, and a terrifying aura broke out from him.
Boom!
The Qi Blood True Strength within Jack’s body burned instantly, forming a pillar of raging red flames that rushed towards the sky; in an instant, the weighty, overbearing power pressed down, causing the surrounding earth to collapse and the fragments to rise.
Under that terrifying aura that was as if a Demon God had descended, the previously energetic long-haired Violent Ape revealed a look of horror on its face..

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 171: The Fire of Life, Space Enhancement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 171: The Fire of Life, Space Enhancement!
Translator: 549690339
Suddenly, Jack Clark vanished instantly, followed by a booming explosion.
The Furious Ape’s hair stood on end as an intense sense of impending death rose from its tailbone, causing it to instinctively release all its strength with an ear-piercing roar.
Roar!
Under the terrifying sonic blast, concentric shockwaves swept through the surrounding area of several tens of meters, causing the originally unstable space to tremble.
In the blink of an eye, black cracks appeared and disappeared, turning the area into a death zone.
At the exact moment when the long-haired Furious Ape roared, a dazzling black-red light burst open on its chest, and a massive amount of flesh and blood exploded from the tremendous impact, causing its chest to collapse inwards.
Its back bulged violently, emitting a cracking explosion sound, while the blood-colored light pierced through its body and only fell to the ground after reaching a hundred meters away.
In an instant, the once ferocious roaring ape’s eyes gradually dimmed, and it fell to the ground with a crash.
Its massive body smashed into the ground, and a torrent of blood gushed from its chest.
A hundred meters away, Jack Clark stood holding his war halberd, slowly calming the burning Qi Blood and True Strength within his body, as the godly and devilish aura around him gradually disappeared.
Looking at the lifeless corpse of the Furious Ape and the continuously appearing and disappearing spatial rifts around him, Jack Clark remained calm.
This Furious Ape’s realm was higher than that of the Blood Armored Beast King, but its strength was not much stronger, and its aura was no match for the Beast King with a king-level bloodline.
It could only be said that its strength was average among Level 5 Peak Mutated Beasts.
After using the ape to familiarize himself with the environment of the valley and learning which areas had spatial distortions and which were more stable, Jack Clark directly launched a full-strength attack and killed it instantly.
After all, his cultivation was only at the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, and while his ordinary combat power was stronger than the Furious Ape, defeating it and killing it were two different levels of difficulty.
This way, it would take more time and effort, and accidents could easily occur, such as causing unstable space collapses due to the fight.
So, it was better to burst out all his strength in one hit to kill it instantly, even if it meant being weakened for a while. With his previous experience, the instantaneous burst was still within his tolerable range.
After a brief recovery, Jack Clark approached the corpse of the long-haired Furious Ape and jumped onto it with a burst of strength.
Soon, Jack Clark dug out a fist-sized, crystal clear crystal, emitting circles of green light and pure life energy, from the ape’s chest.
Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile.
A Level 5 Life Crystal worth 160 contribution points, plus Mutated Beast Meat worth around 150 points—this trip was profitable even without finding resources.
Indeed, a Level 5 Life Crystal was worth only 160 contribution points, just twice as expensive as Level 4 crystals.
As mentioned previously, the higher the level of a crystal, the lesser the increase in life energy it contains—the most important factor is the purity.
This can be seen from the size changes of Life Crystals.
Akin to the Avatar Evolution’s accumulation of vast and magnificent Evolution Energy, each evolution results in a significant leap in the physical body and life level.
After Mutated Creatures reach the peak level, a crystal containing pure life energy will gradually form within their bodies, playing a role similar to ignition and catalysis.
This lights the fire of life evolution, allowing them to evolve.
Therefore, at higher levels, the exchange requirements for Life Crystals are not as expensive as one would think.
If it weren’t for the higher purity of life energy contained within, which has a noticeable strengthening effect on the body of cultivators of the same level, the price would be even cheaper.
Including the corpse of a Mutated Beast, the higher-level ones arc mainly valued for their bones, scale armor, and some special internal organs, rather than essence blood.
The value of Mutated Beast Meat, which is the majority of their bodies, has dropped significantly at higher levels.
Because ordinary people cannot digest the meat of high-level Mutated Creatures.
As for high-level cultivators, they, like Mutated Creatures, can maintain their consumption by ingesting and exhaling large amounts of Heavenly Energy, thus reducing their dependence on food.
Under these circumstances, the flesh and blood of high-level Mutated Beasts are often used as “feed” or long-lasting rations for armies on extended campaigns.
Jack Clark held the Life Crystal in his hand, and a voice resounded in his mind: “Convert to Attribute points.”
“You have converted a High Purity Life Crystal, gaining 165 Attribute points.”
Immediately, Jack Clark’s Attribute points, which had been used up due to the strengthening method, rose to 168, but were still far from the 300 points needed to strengthen the Sixth level Dragon Elephant Technique.
Moreover…
At this thought, Jack Clark’s gaze turned to the end of the mountain wall in the distance.
At the foothills, the large cave narrowed deeper inside.
Furthermore, intense spatial fluctuations were felt deeper within; at any moment, spatial rifts could form.
The white crystal stones Jack Clark saw earlier were located deep within the cracks, mixed in with some small, crushed stones. Their origin likely came from space collapse.
According to official research over many years, these collapsed space points are the conflict nodes of two worlds’ forces, which can sometimes cause collapse, piercing through certain parts of both worlds.
Under this circumstance, twisted and dangerous spatial zones are formed while drawing in some of the mythical world’s materials, which is the origin of many resources.
These resources might be minerals, plants with special powers, fruits, or some special energy aggregates.
Ethereal Crystal Stones generally appear in areas with a high concentration of space force, almost forming solid veins, or in places where space collapses.
Arriving deep within the cave, Jack Clark cautiously held his halberd and slowly hooked out three fist-sized Ethereal Crystal Stones..

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 171: The Fire of Life, Space Strengthenings
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 171: The Fire of Life, Space Strengthenings
Translator: 549690339
A radiant smile spread across Jack Clark’s face.
Three Ethereal Crystal Stones, each valued at 100 contribution points. Along with the Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast Corpse and the Life Crystal, the total worth of this harvest was six hundred contribution points.
Indeed, the stronger his strength, the faster he could acquire resources.
This explained why Justin Welan had a seemingly endless supply of senior high-order resources.
There was nothing he could do about it. Having a brother who was a senior cultivator of the Seventh Layer Heaven was indeed lavish.
However, after securing the three Ethereal Crystal Stones, Jack Clark fell into contemplation.
He was considering whether he should first enhance the space inside the Sumeru Bracelet, or save up attribute points to breakthrough the Sixth Layer of Dragon Elephant when he had enough.
It didn’t take long for Jack Clark to decide to enhance the Sumeru Bracelet first.
For him at this moment, a Sumeru Space of three cubic meters was too small. After placing his War Halberd and battle armor into it, there was hardly any remaining space.
If he encountered larger resources or valuable items in the future, it would be inconvenient to carry them.
As for exchanging the Ethereal Crystal Stones with the school and getting some contribution for breaking through the Sixth Layer of Dragon Elephant, Jack Clark gave up on that thought after some consideration.
Because it was a loss.
Other students would get 80% of the value when submitting resources to the school, but as a student with privileges, he would only get 80% of the 70%.
In other words, if he exchanged an Ethereal Crystal Stone, valued at 100 contribution points, with the school, he would only get a little more than fifty points in return.
Upon this thought, Jack Clark took a deep breath, took off the Sumeru Bracelet, held the three Ethereal Crystal Stones and the bracelet together in his hand, a thought echoed in his mind.
“Consume attribute points to enhance the Sumeru Bracelet.”
At that moment, a line of transparent text appeared before Jack Clark.
“This mineral belongs to the independent space category. Only one Ethereal Crystal Stone can be integrated each time you enhance it. It will consume 30 attribute points. Do you wish to integrate it?”
“So it can’t be integrated all at once. Yes.” Jack Clark paused for a moment before deciding to confirm.
Suddenly, the special power strengthening the items flowed from his hand, covering the Sumeru Bracelet and one Crystal Stone.
During the silent process, the Ethereal Crystal Stone gradually faded, and a faint void space within it slowly merged with the Sumeru Bracelet before eventually becoming one.
Instantly, Jack Clark perceived the space inside the Sumeru Bracelet enlarging considerably, reaching a size of five cubic meters.
“Huh!” Jack Clark exclaimed in surprise, hesitating momentarily.
“Continue enhancing.”
After consuming 90 attribute points, all three Ethereal Crystal Stones were integrated into the Sumeru Bracelet, expanding its internal space to 15 cubic meters.
This result surprised even Jack Clark.
According to the stone’s description, each Ethereal Crystal contained a discrete void space of one cubic meter. He had therefore assumed that each enhancement would only increase the space by one cubic meter.
Unexpectedly, each enhancement synchronously increased the length, width, and height of the void space after absorbing the void space within the Crystal Stone, thereby exponentially increasing the volume of space with each subsequent enhancement.
Sensing that the void space had enlarged by five times, Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction.
After collecting all the resources, Jack Clark returned to the Mutant Fierce Ape Corpse, attached eight anti-gravity disks tightly to the underside of it.
As energy was supplied and the magnetic field activated, the 6o-ton Mutant Fierce Ape slowly lifted a meter off the ground.
Four anti-gravity disks could create a strong magnetic field capable of lifting a 50-ton object, although a strength of 20 to 30 tons was needed to move it due to the automatic interaction with the Earth’s magnetic field.
However, with eight disks the lifting capacity increased to 100 tons. Even though the intertwining force between the anti-gravity disks and the Earth’s magnetic field would strengthen, it would still be much easier to move.
This way of usage was extremely extravagant. Activating it once equaled the consumption of eight contribution points. For a route of over a thousand kilometers, it would have to be activated twice.
Thus, most people would not be so extravagant.
But as Jack Clark, brimming with his bountiful harvest and carrying the Mutated Beast Corpse, was heading back.
On the large screen at the South Sky Martial Height Base, a line of red large characters was flashing.
“Light Martial Height, Freddy Nelson, with the cultivation of mid-stage Fourth Layer Heaven, Reverse Defeating Seven Origin Martial Height’s Jasper Boyce, current ranking on the Achievement list: 898th.”
“Dang! This monster who tops the First-grade Talent Rankings doesn’t make a move often, but when he does, it’s earth-shaking. He has directly leaped into the top 900 of the Achievement List.”
“Impressive.”
“Haha, our Light Martial Height is still the best.”
“Right, the two freshmen from South Sky Martial Height might have made it onto the Achievement List earlier, but they are only ranked around 940th. Their strength is far inferior to Freddy Nelson..”

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 172: Space Sword Intent, Siege of Jack Clark
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 172: Space Sword Intent, Siege of Jack Clark
Translator: 549690339
Deep within the branch range of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, at the peak of a mountain.
At the edge of a towering cliff, fierce winds howled, and Jane Aiken in ordinary battle armor sat cross-legged with clear jade-like eyes, quietly watching ahead.
In front of her, the space just beyond the cliff seemed to twist like a transparent sheet of paper, black cracks appearing now and then, only to disappear as the space healed itself within the blink of an eye.
These black cracks varied in length, some only a few centimeters long while others over a meter, cutting through and severing everything in their path, including air!
As she observed the appearance and disappearance of these space cracks, the reflections of crumbling and vanishing space gradually surfaced in Jane Aiken’s eyes.
Before, when Jack Clark broke through the Fourth Layer Heaven, Sylvia Lyons and Lori Parma had mentioned that Jane Aiken comprehended Sword Intent during the Koroya Trial.
In the eyes of the school’s higher-ups, her enlightenment was even more exaggerated than her astonishing speed of cultivation talent.
Even Jack Clark, who had cultivated low-level Dragon Elephant Power to True Martial Divine Rhyme, reaching the theoretical limit of the original creator’s realm at the Third Layer Heaven, was considered inferior to her in terms of potential talent.
It wasn’t until Jack Clark, with average talent, was the first to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven that his talent potential evaluation in the school was on par with hers, just on par.
This demonstrates the terrifying aspect of enlightenment ‘talent’.
At this moment, observing the birth and demise of these space cracks, a terrifying sword intent gradually emanated from Jane Aiken, causing her long hair to sway without wind.
Within a yard radius around her, tiny cracks appeared on the hard rocks out of thin air, weeds silently shattered, and even the air kept making a sizzling sound.
The fierce mountain stream wind would suddenly disappear once it entered a few meters range of Jane Aiken.
No, not disappearing, but being torn apart and annihilated by the invisible sharp Sword Intent, just like the constantly appearing and disappearing space cracks, horrifying and terrifying.
Sword Intent is a kind of Power of Will, stronger than ordinary willpower, unparalleled in offense and defense. Even at the initial stage of comprehension, it can increase the power of Sword Qi by several times.
Whether cultivating Sword Skill or Blade Skill, those who comprehend Blade Intent and Sword Intent will see a great improvement in their combat power.
Under normal conditions, cultivators who wish to comprehend Sword Intent must first cultivate Advanced Combat Skills to the Great Realm, and then achieve an instant breakthrough with extreme faith and Martial Arts Realm.
One can imagine how difficult this is,
And how monstrous Jane Aiken must be for comprehending Sword Intent at the Third Layer Heaven.
Of course, the so-called difficulty is only for ordinary people; geniuses are always exceptions. Otherwise, if everyone were mediocre, there would be no such thing as genius.
At this moment, Jane Aiken had been sitting here for several days. After the original comprehension of the Illusion Extinguishing Sword Intent, she had a new enlightenment after observing the space rifts.
Suddenly, Jane Aiken’s right hand fingers closed together, and a one-meter-long white Sword Qi condensed at her fingertips, with Sword Intent flowing on it. She waved her hand casually.
Whoosh!
Where the Sword Qi passed, a pitch-black trace appeared in the air, and the residual sharp Sword Intent lingered for a while.
“Not quite right.”
Looking at the black trace of the true vacuum in front of her, Jane Aiken furrowed her eyebrows and dispersed the sharp Sword Qi in her hand that only had the appearance of power.
She continued to stare ahead, her clear and bright eyes reflecting the constantly appearing and disappearing black cracks, sinking into silence once more.
As she did, the sharp intent to cut through everything on her body became even more apparent and stronger.
As Jane Aiken entered an epiphany state, her True Strength circulated automatically inside her body, swallowing Heavenly Energy and becoming stronger at an astonishing speed as her aura grew increasingly powerful.
? ? Roar, roar, roar!!!
In the forest, more than a dozen huge Mutated Beasts surrounded Jack Clark, bellowing furiously as if trying to intimidate him and snatch away their ‘food’.
These Mutated Beasts resembled rhinoceroses, covered in blue scale armor, with a thick horn on their heads, claws on their four hooves, and fanged teeth in their mouths.
Most of their body sizes were between five and six meters, three around eight meters, and the largest one was more than eighteen meters long without including its tail, making it a Level 4 Mutated Beast.
At this moment, these Mutated Beasts greedily eyed the corpse of the long-haired Violent Ape.
As a Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast, the smell of blood from the long-haired Violent Ape’s body drove them a little insane. Consuming the flesh and blood of this kind of Mutated Beast could accelerate their own Evolution.
This was also the reason why every time Jack Clark and his team dragged a Mutated Beast corpse back, even ordinary Mutated Creatures couldn’t help but attack.
Even the terrible pressure they felt from him, including the horrific death of the high-level Mutated Beast behind him, could not suppress the aggressiveness of these Mutated Creatures.
Because the desire to become stronger was their innate nature.
Of course, that had something to do with the certain confusion between human cultivators and Mutated Creatures.
In the fixed mindset of Mutated Creatures, larger size and strength were always directly proportional, the more terrifying their aura and domination.
But humans, these tiny creatures, weren’t even a mouthful to many Mutated Beasts in their eyes, nor did their True Strength emit energy fluctuations as ferocious and overbearing as Mutated Beasts.
So it gave those low-intelligence Mutated Beasts the illusion that they could be eaten.
However, there was a solution to this situation. The Logistics Department had an item called Grey Rock Tree Powder that could be exchanged for one point of contribution for a large bottle.
This Grey Rock Tree Powder was ground from tree bark and would emit a strong aroma to neutralize the smell of blood on Mutated Beasts, disturbing the olfactory senses of other Mutated Beasts.
Under normal conditions, cultivators returning from hunting would apply some of this powder, which could help them avoid a lot of trouble.
Even Justin Welan and the others had used it before, and it was only after they followed Jack Clark on their previous outing that they openly allowed the smell of Mutated Beast blood to spread..

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 172: Space Sword Intent, Siege of Jack Clark_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 172: Space Sword Intent, Siege of Jack Clark_2
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark knew about this thing too, and he had a bottle of it in his storage space, but he never used it.
Because what he wanted was to attract these mutated beasts to deliver themselves to him voluntarily.
As his physical body became more and more terrifying, Jack’s strength and physique continued to increase, all the while his agility, which had always been overlooked, gradually grew more formidable.
With over nine hundred agility points, his movement speed reached subsonic levels of three hundred meters per second under normal conditions, several times faster than his peers at the same level.
It was almost on par with those Fifth Layer Heaven cultivators who specialized in agility and speed cultivation methods.
Not to mention, as soon as his True Strength activates, resulting in a muscle power amplification explosion, Jack could instantly move at supersonic speed and maintain this burst for a long time.
Such speed was comparable to that of cultivators specializing in agility techniques of the Sixth-layer Heaven, and due to his robust physique, he had more endurance than them.
After all, once those cultivators run out of True Strength, their speed would plummet if they cannot operate their cultivation methods.
This was Jack’s greatest source of confidence.
What would he do if he couldn’t defeat those powerful mutated creatures? Of course, he would run. At supersonic speeds, he could cover twenty kilometers in a minute, he was fast!
Boom!
As the mutated beasts were slowly approaching and trying to surround Jack, a black-red radiance burst out in an instant, accompanied by the explosion of dirt.
Boom, boom, boom!
Under the swing of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, which weighed two tons and wielded at supersonic speed, three Level 2 Mutant Unicorns instantly exploded. Amid the rain of blood, Jack seemed like a sharp arrow piercing through.
Thump, thump, thump!
Moving at supersonic speed, the bodies of the Level 2 and Level 3 Mutant Unicorns couldn’t even react in time before exploding under the force of the black-red True Power, shattering into pieces.
Roar!
The Late Stage Level 4 Unicorn let out an angry roar of shock and fear. Standing five meters at its shoulders, the gray light on its body began to circulate, causing the surrounding dirt to surge like living creatures.
In the blink of an eye, a seven-meter-tall, mutated beast wearing thick, rocky armor appeared. Its powerful, dense, and crushing presence resonated from its body.
By this time, Jack had already turned into a black-red streak and appeared in front of the last nine-meter-long, Late Stage Level 3 Mutant Unicorn.
Boom!
With the explosion of the black-red True Power, a sky full of blood and flesh mixed with a furious impact, erupting more than ten meters, forming a huge red arc.
Roar!
Watching its offspring get killed in the blink of an eye by that little guy, the bloodshot eyes of the Level 4 Unicorn were filled with rage and murderous intent.
With a rumbling sound, its massive figure crushed the ground beneath it, each step making the earth shake and stirring up violent wind waves…then it turned to flee!
Jack hesitated for a moment.
Well, it seemed that the Level 4 Mutated Beast still had some intelligence. After witnessing Jack instantly killing all its offspring with terrifying speed, it knew not to mess with him.
Unfortunately, he would not let these free Contribution Points that arrived at his doorstep go to waste.
Accompanied by a sonic boom, Jack trailed a long white wave behind him, stirring up a shrill whistling sound and raging wind as he chased after them.
In an instant, Jack caught up with the fleeing Unicorn Beast that had rushed hundreds of meters away.
Roar!
Feeling the strong danger approaching from behind, the fleeing beast suddenly turned around, its huge head and half its body crashing towards Jack like a collapsing mountain peak.
Backed by its powerful strength, this blow was enough to topple a building.
The two silhouettes, one large and one small, collided in an instant.
Boom!
The indescribably terrifying force erupted onto the overbearing and heavy Eight Desolate Battle Halberd. Amidst the dazzling black-red shockwave, the body of the Unicorn Beast sank heavily, shattering the ground beneath it.
The massive, hard rock that spanned five meters atop its head exploded in an instant.
However, the defense of this Unicorn Beast was indeed formidable. It wasn’t killed in a single blow under Jack’s normal attack; instead, it merely broke the half side of the rocky armor on its body.
Apart from that, the sharp black-red halberd skill melted away on its head, leaving deep cuts exposing the bone beneath. The beast’s head was dripping with blood, which made it become even more frenzied and violent.
Roar, roar, roar!
In the midst of its frenzied roar, the beast’s wide, jagged-toothed mouth lunged ferociously at Jack, and then…
Thud!
Jack swung the War Halberd horizontally. Under the explosion of the black-red True Dragon Power, the half side of the mutant beast’s head shattered, and blood and flesh splattered all around as its massive body fell to the ground with a thud.
Standing in front of its giant mutant beast corpse, Jack, holding his halberd, showed a detached expression. His body was swirling with black-red radiance, emitting a heavy and oppressive aura.
Since one normal blow couldn’t finish it off, he would just take another swing.
After slaughtering these mutated beasts, Jack became busy.
First, he dragged the heavy, nearly ten-ton, Level 4 mutated beast to the corpse of the long-haired Violent Ape. He used his explosive strength to throw it onto the body.
Next was one of the better-preserved Level 3 Unicorn corpses, which he also placed horizontally on the ape’s legs.
By this time, they were approaching the load limit of the eight anti-gravity disks.
So, Jack swung his halberd, cutting down the horns of all the mutated beasts, including the one of the exploded Level 3 Mutant Unicorn.
These mutated creatures’ horns acted as both their battle weapons and a kind of material.
Long-term energy refining had made them as hard as alloy, and they had a certain level of energy conductivity. They had a higher degree of compatibility with the Earth System.
A single Level 2 horn would be worth about 2 Contribution Points if brought back separately, and the Level 3 one might be worth 4 Points.
Though it seemed like small numbers, together they amounted to more than twenty points, which he wouldn’t pass up.
Soon, Jack, loaded with materials like an ant displaying an incredible burst of strength, began dragging the mutated beasts, which were more than a hundred times his volume, towards the outside of the mountain..

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 172: Space Sword Intent, Siege of Jack Clark_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 172: Space Sword Intent, Siege of Jack Clark_3
Translator: 549690339
However, this time he had sprinkled a large bottle of Grey Rock Tree Powder on these corpses, which emitted a strong smell that neutralized and covered the stench of blood.
It couldn’t be helped, he could not carry them anymore.
Soon a day passed, Jack Clark had traveled nearly nine hundred kilometers of the more than thirteen hundred kilometers deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, which was quite fast.
If he ran faster tomorrow, he should be able to reach the school base before nightfall.
It was almost three thousand kilometers back and forth in three days.
For other Fifth Layer Heaven cultivator teams, it would have taken at least a week.
Fortunately, he found three Void Spirit Crystals this time, otherwise, the gain from merely killing a Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast would be mediocre.
After all, with his strength, he could easily kill two Level 5 Mutated Beasts along the edge of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range in two or three days, there was no need to go so deep.
No wonder those senior students either killed variant beasts on the periphery of the mountain range or searched for resources deep into the mountains.
In his mindful thoughts, Jack Clark found a cliff backed by a mountain wall to rest for the night.
He didn’t find a cave today, and because the mutated beast corpses were too large to dig into tree holes, he had to risk staying outside for the night.
However, as darkness gradually fell and the rolling dark clouds drifted by, Jack’s gaze sank slightly, because if it rained…
Whoosh!
Before Jack could find a new place, heavy rain began to pour. The pea-sized raindrops blanketed the world, engulfing heaven and earth in the blink of an eye.
Swoosh!
True Power circulated in Jack’s body, shielding him from the rain, and in a flash, he rushed to a spot two meters below the cliff that was slightly recessed and could barely shelter from the rain.
Looking at the heavy rain that almost drowned heaven and earth, Jack let out a small sigh.
This was the first time Jack had encountered rain during his many trips into the mountains. The tremendous force covering hundreds or thousands of kilometers made him feel insignificant.
But… Jack’s gaze shifted to the mutated beast corpses not far away, his expression slightly solemn.
In the wash of heavy rain, the tree powder sprinkled on the mutated beast wounds was quickly washed away. The dry scabs fell off as the rain soaked them, and some blood started to flow again.
This energy-laden blood condensed but did not disperse in the rainwater, slowly flowing downhill with the rainwater, rushing into the forest streams. Taking a look at the flowing blood water, then at the sky that had completely darkened, Jack Clark’s face became more solemn.
“Troublesome, thankfully we are close to the outskirts of Cloud Mist Mountain Range, otherwise, we would have to leave these mutated beast corpses behind.” Night fell completely, the heavy rain had lasted about two hours before it stopped. The post-rain forest exuded a fresh smell filled with grass and earth.
At the same time, countless nighttime-active mutated creatures emerged from their hiding spots and foraged in the damp forest.
Jack Clark sat cross-legged under the cliff, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd stood by his side.
Not far away were the carcasses of the two unicorns and the long-haired Violent Ape. The massive wounds on their bodies looked fresh from the rain wash, leaving no trace that they had been dead for a day.
At this time, the mutant beast corpses had stopped bleeding, but as the night wind blew, a faint smell of blood still drifted far away with the breeze.
Soon, the branches in the distant forest shook, and large droplets of rain fell. A pair of greedy and ferocious eyes swept over the three mutant beast corpses before settling on Jack Clark.
Soon there was a second pair, a third pair…
Attracted by the blood of the high-level mutated creatures washed away by the rainwater, almost all the mutant creatures in this forest were drawn over.
Most of these mutated creatures were Level One and Two, there were also quite a few Level Threes, and even some Level Fours were hiding in the back.
In addition, there were sharp cries of birds in the sky, the colossal wings stirring up the air, casting large shadows under the faint moonlight.
Under the attraction of the bloody smell of high-level mutant beasts, these mutated creatures, who usually fought fiercely upon meeting, had forgotten each other. All they could see were the corpses of the Level 5 Peak Mutated Beasts.
And as more and more mutated creatures gathered, one of them finally couldn’t endure any longer.Roar!
Within the roar echoing through the mountain forest, a beast resembling a ferocious tiger- over sixteen meters in length and of shoulder height five meters – broke a tree in its path and lumbered out.
This Level 4 Mutated Beast slowly approached, greedily eyeing the corpse of the long-haired Violent Ape, drool dripping from its monstrous jaws.
“It seems there’ll be no rest tonight.”
Accompanied by a faint voice, Jack Clark emerged from beneath the cliff, holding his halberd, the metallic clank of his battle boots against the rock echoing heavily.
Three mutant beast corpses totaled up to roughly two hundred Contribution Points. Jack naturally could not let these Mutated Creatures devour them.
Similarly, the Mutated Creatures longed to devour the flesh and blood of the high-level mutant beasts, as consuming it would allow them to drastically evolve and grow after absorbing the Life Factors.
As a result, neither party would back down.
Roar!
With a brutal roar, the Thunder Pattern Mutated Beast was surrounded by a green storm; with a kaboom, it crushed the ground beneath its substantial body and launched towards Jack at a terrifying speed.
Boom!
Accompanied by the dazzling burst of black-red radiance, the Thunder Pattern Unique Beast’s just leapt skull burst into pieces in mid-air, and its flesh splattered all around; its body crashed into the ground with a loud bang.
The hot blood bubbled out from the wound on the neck of the Thunder Pattern giant beast like a fountain, making the stench of blood in the surroundings more potent.
Just then, triggered by the intense smell of blood, more than ten pairs of Level Two Mutated Creatures charged out of the forest, their eyes red, and towards Jack.
These Mutated Creatures were fast, reaching Jack in the blink of an eye, having covered dozens of meters in one second, and from all directions they swarmed him.
Boom, boom, boom! At the center, Jack Clark unleashed a black-red ring of True Strength four meters high, dismembering the corpses of the Level Two Mutated Creatures as it passed by.
Blood and flesh splattered all over the sky in an instant, the whole night sky was covered with a layer of blood red.
Roar, roar, roar!
Intensely stimulated by the smell of blood, hordes of Mutated Creatures flowed out of the forest. The ground rumbled, and their roars and howls drowned out Jack.
Boom! A black and red figure exploded amongst numerous mutant beasts.
Overbearing and sharp halberd skill gushed from the two-ton halberd. Under the supersonic swing, it was invincible, and wherever it passed through, Mutated Creatures were blown apart.
No matter if it is a Level 2 Mutated Beast weighing one or two tons, a Level 3 Mutated Creatures of several tons and seven or eight meters long, or a Level 4 Mutated Creatures over ten meters long.
Under the horrifying and overbearing Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, they ended up wounded with the slightest brush and exploded upon contact. As for their attacks, they could not reach Jack whose movement and reactions were dreadful.
Even some sneaky ability attacks were sensed and dodged by the Heart’s Eye in advance. That is the greatest use of the Heart’s Eye Realm, fearless of being surrounded in battle.
Boom, Boom, Boom!
Under the black and red figure, one after another mutant beast corpses flew in all directions, and the flesh exploded, with the fresh blood spraying out all over the surrounding creatures including Jack.
In less than ten minutes, several hundred lower-level Mutated Creatures were slaughtered, their hot, scarlet blood trickling down the hillside and converging into streams.
The rich smell of blood soared to the skies, attracting even more Mutated Creatures from the distance.
Boom!
A Level 3 Mutated Birds diving from the sky was blasted apart by a halberd thrown in the air, Jack leaped over a hundred meters high with a big red halo enveloping him, swinging his halberd in mid-air.
Kill!
With a long roar, the radiance on Jack intensified, like a God descending from the heavens.
Boom!
The ground crumbled with a single blow, explosive black-red halberd skill swept across a range of twenty meters, shredding all Mutated Creatures that were in its path, forming a massive weeping ghost face..

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 173: Suppressing the Purgatory Demon, Invincible Battle Intent (Requesting Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 173: Suppressing the Purgatory Demon, Invincible Battle Intent (Requesting Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
The battle under the cliff became even more frenzied.
As more and more mutated creatures fell under the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, the stench of blood filled the air, spreading even further with the night wind.
Additionally, with the blood flowing into the small river at the foot of the mountain, the creatures of this mountain range were in a frenzy, gathering at Jack Clark’s location continuously.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
One after another, the heads of the mutated creatures exploded, the serpents and lizard species were even cleaved at the waist, the black-red radiance overpowering everything, rotting and breaking the ground.
The madness wasn’t only in the mutated creatures tonight, but the fierceness, brutality, and destructive killing desires in Jack Clark’s avatar were also completely triggered.
As his avatar grew stronger, the destructive desire in his heart became even more intense when he became half-conscious of his giant beast state.
Previously, when he learned the Taoist and Buddhist scriptures from Freya Louise, there was some effect, but it was not as effective as relieving his destructive desires through slaughter.
This was also one of the reasons why he was so ruthless and overbearing on his way into the Alien Beast Battlefield and in the mountains.
Although Jack Clark had fallen into madness, he wasn’t blinded by his destructive desires and still maintained a trace of sobriety, his expression slightly condensed.
His True Strength was consuming too fast.
Less than twenty minutes into battle, he had already slain several hundred low-level mutated creatures, and the rich Dragon Elephant True Strength in his body was also depleted by half due to the constant burst of Halberd Skill.
He couldn’t go on like this.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark’s thoughts shifted, and the True Strength circulating outside his body suddenly darkened, covering only a thin layer of the battle armor.
At the same time, the Halberd Skill on the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd shrank abruptly to just a centimeter, only retaining the coverage and blade augmentation for the war halberd.
With Jack Clark’s aura weakened, the bloodthirsty mutated creatures grow even more excited and crazy.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
The densely-packed mutated creatures lunged at Jack Clark, having long given up the idea of devouring the flesh and blood of the long-haired Violent Ape corpses.
Their welcome, a horror-inducing battle halberd swung at supersonic speeds.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Jack Clark stood atop a ten-meter-high rock, wielding the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, which produced sharp wind and thunderous roars. Each swing would send an incoming mutated creature flying.
Even those Level 4 mutated creatures, which were more than ten meters long and weighed dozens of tons, had their scales broken and exploding in bloody chunks as they were swept away by the terrifying battle halberd.
At the same time, the fifth-layer Dragon Elephant Overbearing Body Method within Jack Clark was operating madly, absorbing and refining the energy between heaven and earth, quickly replenishing his True Strength consumption.
As Jack Clark continued to slaughter, the pile of mutated beasts’ corpses under his feet grew higher and higher.
Meanwhile, under his frenzied battle halberd killing, Jack Clark’s comprehension of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd deepened. His blood-covered eyes could vaguely see Purgatory.
And the hideous mutated creatures that lunged at him were like the demons from hell.
Eight Desolate, Purgatory!
Merely having the sweeping dominance of the Eight Desolate wasn’t enough. There had to be a demonic intent to suppress one’s Infernal Purgatory through a heaven-shaking slaughter and condensing an unbeatable war intent that was both divine and demonic.
As his understanding deepened and his slaughter became more frenzied, an invisible and terrifying thought was condensing on Jack Clark’s body, with faint red light wrapping around his swinging battle halberd.
That was the materialization of Blood Evil Qi; the unwilling, fierce thoughts from the dead mutated creatures’ corpses merged with the steaming bloody aura that they emitted.
These invisible Killing Intents were supposed to disperse with the raging wind, but now they surged toward Jack Clark like birds finding a forest, condensing into wisps of red mist.
For a moment, Jack Clark’s aura became even more terrifying as if he was a crazed Demon God of slaughter.
Even though Jack Clark’s aura became more terrifying, the mutated creatures rushing toward him were fearless.
All they felt was madness and brutality, with their eyes growing blood-red.
Unconsciously, a faint layer of red, blood-stench enveloped the entire area under the cliff. When the mutated creatures approached, they would lose their sanity, leaving behind only their animal instincts.
Even the moon hanging diagonally in the sky emanated a red light, doubling in size and having a faint ominous air at the edge with a double shadow.
“Under the Blood Moon, a myriad of beasts go mad. Has it been a year now?”
In the military base thousands of kilometers away, a middle-aged man stood on the roof, looking up at the moon that emitted a faint red light in the sky and sighed softly.
This bright red moon appeared to come from their world, but it was actually a reflection of the Blood Moon from another world.
Under the illumination of this red moon, countless mutated creatures, whether in the Nine Rings Mountain Range, the vast plain behind them, or the Cloud Mist Mountain Range spanning thousands of kilometers, became agitated. The moment they met, they would engage in fierce battles as if the entire world had gone mad.
This agitation persisted for a long time, until the darkest time before dawn when the blood light that almost obscured the moon finally faded away.
At once, the agitation permeating the Alien Beast Battlefield gradually receded.
Boom!
The blood-drenched battle halberd swept at supersonic speed, bursting half the body of a mutated creature resembling a dragon lizard with a length of eight meters.
Roar! Roar!
The surrounding dozen mutated creatures let out fearful growls, looking at the dark red figure standing atop a blood-soaked mountain of corpses, their eyes filled with horror.
Under the overwhelming and endless oppressive might, the remaining mutated creatures’ limbs weakened, and they couldn’t help but slowly retreat before suddenly turning around and fleeing.
In just a few breaths, more than ten mutated creatures had rushed into the forest, disappearing into the darkness..

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 173: Suppressing the Purgatory Demon, Invincible Battle Intent (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 173: Suppressing the Purgatory Demon, Invincible Battle Intent (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339
No more? Jack Clark looked around in a daze.
At this point, his entire body was submerged in crimson blood. His Battle armor was covered with the flesh and blood of Mutated Creatures, and some places even had scratches left by claws.
After a night of relentless fighting, Jack’s True Strength was long exhausted, and in the end, he had to rely solely on his overpowering physical strength to wield his War Halberd.
By now, the entire mountain cliff was covered with the wreckage of Mutated Beast corpses, piled up, and the blood that flowed out almost formed a small river at the bottom of the hill, creating an overwhelming bloody scent.
The piled up corpses under Jack’s feet were dozens of meters high, forming a hellish scene with dense bones and flesh, which was horrifying.
Standing on top of a mountain of corpses and blood, Jack, who fought all night, exuded an alarming Killing Intent, like an invincible king.
As he watched the slowly rising sun on the horizon, a sense of unspeakable insight welled up in Jack’s heart, and an invisible aura gathered around him.
In the depths of his Sea of Consciousness, the Dragon Elephant formed by his spirit’s willpower let out a roar, and a pure, overbearing, and invincible realm of thought was about to condense.
But…
Whew! Jack let out a slow breath, disappointment in his eyes: “Still not enough, just a little bit off.”
Just now, he almost condensed the undefeatable war intent, but unfortunately, in the end, due to insufficient foundation in Martial Arts, it failed to sublimate.
Eventually, that embryonic battle intent slowly merged into his body, waiting for the next time to fully erupt.
When Jack returned to the base, it was already the afternoon of the third day.
Dragging more than 20 meters of piled up, blood-soaked Mutated Beast corpses, Jack arrived at the Logistics Department warehouse, like a diligent ant.
Bang!
As Jack turned off the anti-gravity disks, a pile of Mutated Beast corpses tumbled onto the warehouse floor.
A 20-meter-long long-haired Furious Ape, a 10-meter-long Unicorn Beast, several Level 4 Mutated Creatures, and many bloody parts of Mutated Beasts.
Jack then pulled out more than a dozen various-sized Unicorn horns, huge sharp teeth, and sharp crystal-like tail stingers from his Sumeru Bracelet.
After a night of fierce fighting, most of the Mutated Beast corpses had been blasted by Jack, but some materials were still left behind.
While cleaning up the battlefield, Jack had discarded the corpse of the Level 3 Unique Beast and chosen some more valuable materials to take back instead.
“Oh! Student Clark, you seem to have been killing your way back here,” Koi Hawk sighed as he looked at the Mutated Beast corpses all over the ground and the lingering bloody scent on Jack.
Jack nodded: “It was alright. I killed a Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. On the way back last night, I encountered a Mutated Creature riot and killed them all.”
Koi stifled a gasp and blurted out: “Mutated Creature riot, last night’s Blood Moon!”
“Blood Moon.” Jack looked at him with a questioning gaze.
Koi explained: “Blood Moon is a unique phenomenon in the Southern Variant Beast Battlefield. It occurs once a year, and there is no fixed time. It is said to be a projection of the Blood Moon in the mythical world.”
“Under the Blood Moon, all Mutated Creatures become more agitated and bloodthirsty. Once they smell blood, they go crazy.”
“…No wonder,” Jack was suddenly speechless. He had been wondering why the Mutated Creatures from last night were not afraid of dying but instead became more ferocious as they fought.
In the end, he was just unlucky.
Jack exhaled and politely said, “Please do me a favor, Mr. Hawk, and help me calculate how much is here.”
“It’s no trouble at all.”
Koi was very polite and called over two staff members to help. Soon, they had counted up the winnings from this battle.
The Level 5 Peak long-haired Furious Ape was worth 155 points. Initially, it was only valued at 145 points due to the severe damage to its chest, but the long hair on its body surface that interfered with space power slightly added 10 points.
Of course, without the innate ability of the Furious Ape to strengthen it, the hair is almost useless and needs to be collected and processed using a special method to be useful.
Aside from that, the Level 4 Unicorn Beast, whose horn had been destroyed, was worth only 50 points, along with various other materials and broken corpses.
All of this added up to 87 points, bringing the total to 292.
This haul was much more than Jack had expected. Originally, his plan was to kill a Level 4 Mutated Beast on the way back, pile it up with a Level 5 Mutated Beast, and bring it back.
The weight of one Level 4 and one Level 5 Mutated Beast, combined, would be close to reaching the Hundred-ton limit.
Even with anti-gravity disks to offset much of the weight, it would still be impossible for an ordinary cultivator to carry, let alone cross mountains and traverse one or two thousand kilometers.
Now, combined with the 33 points that Jack had saved up, he suddenly had a total of 325 points.
Jack also felt fortunate that he had been on the edge of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range last night. If he had gone any deeper, the overwhelming bloody scent might have attracted more powerful Level 6 or higher creatures.
At that point, even Jack couldn’t guarantee he could stand his ground.
Based on Jack’s estimation of himself, his normal combat strength should be at the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven, and his Rune Burst would be comparable to the Early Stage of Sixth-level Heaven, which was considered strong among the early stages.
Not bad, around the Early Stage of Sixth-level Heaven.
Although at the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, his regular combat strength had reached the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, and his burst strength had been comparable to Fifth Layer Heaven Peak, sweeping through everything below the Sixth Layer Heaven.
But now, after breaking through the fifth layer of the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body and reaching the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, his combat power didn’t span as dramatically as it did during the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven.
The reason is that the gap between each layer of True Martial Cultivation becomes larger the further along it is..

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 173: Suppressing the Purgatory Demon, Invincible Battle Intent (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 173: Suppressing the Purgatory Demon, Invincible Battle Intent (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339
If the power of the First Layer Heaven is 1, then Second Layer Heaven is 5, Third Layer Heaven is 20, and after the True Power quality change in the Fourth Layer Heaven, it becomes 100.
As for Fifth Layer Heaven, compared to the Fourth Layer, the True Power is just several times more condensed and thick, so it is roughly between 4-00 and 600.
But the Sixth Layer Heaven is a small hurdle, and with the integration of will and True Power igniting the flames of True Power, the True Power burst of Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators will be exceptionally strong.
Crushing all opponents below their own realm, the power instantly soars to over 1500.
Although this gap compared to the Fourth Layer Heaven is only around tens of times, it brings about a quality change.
As for the high-ranking Seventh Layer Heaven, after controlling the celestial powers with the second True Power quality change, it will be even stronger than the Sixth Layer Heaven, with a part of the celestial power attached to every action.
This is also the reason why Vernon Leinster casually slapped two of the early Sixth Layer Heaven Blood God Sect fanatics who burned themselves to death.
Of course, cultivators should not make a simple comparison with these numbers, as combat power involves many factors, and this is just a simple analogy.
Therefore, it is already terrifying for Jack Clark to have the ability to compete in the early stage of Sixth Layer Heaven with the Late Fourth Layer Heaven realm, crossing two major realms.
However, because his flesh is too powerful, besides his strength, his speed and reaction are also terrifyingly fast, making him seem stronger than the mid-stage Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators with the explosive power.
Instantly reaching the peak of Level 5 Unique Beast in a burst.
Compared to other Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators, his real advantage is actually his powerful flesh, the ‘real’ attribute he gained when breaking through the Fourth Layer, and the broken rune that burns Qi Blood True Power instantly.
As for the fifth layer of Advanced Skill, the Novice Advanced Combat Skills, these actually belong to standard equipment for Fifth Layer Heaven and Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators.
There is a five-layer starting point for each advanced skill for cultivators who reach the Fifth and Sixth Layer Heaven, with combat skills reaching the novice level, and they possess extraordinary battle armor and transcendent weapons.
Some people with amazing talents even just broke through to the Sixth Layer Heaven, they have already cultivated their skills and combat skills to the peak.
And even because they practiced for a longer time, their extraordinary battle armor and transcendent weapons have already been cast twice and are far more powerful than Jack Clark’s Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
It can be said that everyone who can reach the Fifth Layer Heaven and Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators is a genius, and those with poor talent have already stopped at the Fourth Layer Heaven.
With thoughts, Jack Clark walked out of the logistics warehouse and stepped onto the base square along the mountain path.
Then, sweeping the big screen, he noticed that his ranking on the achievement list had skyrocketed, rushing to 905th place in one breath.
As for the reason, it was the Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast that he killed on his own.
The Achievement List not only includes challenges but also cumulative points for killing mutated creatures, with higher points for crossing more realms.
For example, this time, Jack Clark killed a Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast in the ‘Early Stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven’ in the record.
Such a horrific span of points instantly surged, advancing more than forty places.
But this kind of extra bonus points for crossing the major realm is only for the first time, and next time it will become his ‘normal’ achievement.
And this ranking change won’t be displayed in a flashing red font, so not many people pay attention to it.
Oozing with a strong smell of blood, Jack Clark took a bath as soon as he returned to the dormitory, cleaned his battle armor, and felt refreshed after all that.
Picking up the hot water he boiled while taking a bath, Jack Clark poured himself a cup of scalding tea, drank it in one gulp, and instantly felt the hot water fill his stomach, warming his whole body.
Jack Clark let out a long breath, “Phew! I feel alive again.”
He was even surprised by the dangerous and fierce level of the battle last night.
Had it not been for his powerful flesh, even if he had no True Power but terrifying endurance, had he been a Fifth Layer Heaven cultivator, he would have been surrounded and killed by the draining of True Power.
Even with his terrifying flesh, he’s still swinging the two-ton Eight Desolate Battle Halberd with all his strength all night, and now he still feels sore muscles all over his body.
This is still the case where his strength attribute has risen to 1200 points in this period of time, with a basic arm strength of about 30 tons.
And after being strengthened by Dragon Power, he was able to maintain his peak state all night.
Just as Jack Clark was resting for a while, relaxing his mind, there was a knock on the door outside.
Jack Clark opened the door and saw Denny Lockwood standing outside, raising his eyebrows: “Denny, your news is so accurate that you knew I came back just now?”
Denny Lockwood modestly replied with a smile, “Not really, I’ve been here for two years and my information is just a bit more sensitive, can’t beat a monster genius like junior Clark.”
As he said that, Denny Lockwood exclaimed, “I didn’t expect the junior to actually kill the Level 5 later-stage, no, Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast.”
Speaking of which, Jack Clark squinted his eyes, “Are you sure you don’t know that the Mutated Beast’s level is Level 5 Peak?”
This time, if he hadn’t crossed so many cultivation realm boundaries, the wrong information might have resulted in disaster as there is a significant difference between the later stage and the peak stage.
So if Denny Lockwood knew that the mutated creature was Level 5 Peak but only told this ‘genius’ that it was a Level 5 later stage, he would have a rather insidious intent.
Feeling the faint coldness in Jack Clark’s eyes, Denny Lockwood hurriedly explained with a bitter smile, “Junior Clark, I swear I didn’t know that the mutated creature was Level 5 Peak.”
“Our reputation is the most important thing in our line of work. If you don’t believe me, you can go and ask about Denny Lockwood’s reputation..”

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 173: Suppressing Purgatory, Unrivaled War Intent (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 173: Suppressing Purgatory, Unrivaled War Intent (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_4
Translator: 549690339
“However, we, the explorers, usually don’t engage with high-level mutated organisms when we find them. We maintain a distance of two kilometers to observe and avoid being discovered.”
“As for estimating the strength of mutated beasts, we mainly rely on factors such as body size and the aura they emit. Most of the time, our estimates are quite accurate, but there are occasional errors.”
“After all, some unexpected situations can occur as a result of mutation.”
“Besides, before 1 found you, I also gauged your strength, and I felt that even if there was a little error, you would be able to escape unscathed as long as you were cautious.”
At this point, Denny Lockwood couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Junior Brother, since you killed that Mutated Beast, you must have discovered that twisted spatial secret realm, right?”
“What did you get from it?”
Jack Clark looked deeply into Denny’s eyes and finally shook his head slowly, “There was nothing but stones in that twisted space, and I didn’t find any resources.”
“Furthermore, while searching there, I encountered space cracks suddenly appearing several times. If not for my quick reactions, I might have already died inside.”
“Haha… Junior Brother, you’re joking. Those space cracks are indeed troublesome, but they can be avoided as long as you pay attention.”
“What a pity there were no resources inside.” Denny Lockwood regretted.
As for whether he really believed it or not, it was up to him. Naturally, Jack Clark would not tell him about his discoveries inside, as their deal was limited to information.
And it’s better for everyone to play dumb in some matters.
If Jack were to honestly tell Denny that his harvest this time was worth almost six to seven hundred contribution points, who could guarantee that he wouldn’t feel unbalanced, even if he didn’t show it on the surface?
At this time, Jack Clark spoke, “Although I didn’t find any resources, my harvest was still decent. Let’s transfer the remaining 30 contribution points.”
Denny, who was here to receive his balance, immediately stretched out his wrist with a smile, “Thank you, Junior Brother.”
Soon, the two completed this transaction through their smart wristwatches.
At this time, Jack suddenly asked, “Senior Brother, do you have any more information about twisted secret realms?”
Denny Lockwood grinned, “It seems that Junior Brother has also taken an interest in these.”
“Somewhat.” Jack nodded.
Compared to hunting mutated beasts tirelessly and transporting corpses, finding Heaven and Earth Treasures or special resources is not only more lucrative but also more relaxed.
Denny thought for a moment, “I do have one more special secret realm on hand, and I can confirm that there are special resources inside. It’s just that it’s more dangerous.”
Jack raised an eyebrow, “How dangerous is it?”
“I don’t know. As soon as I approach the entrance, there’s a kind of invisible sub-sonic wave that makes me feel a strong sense of danger and discomfort. So I haven’t explored further.”
“How much does it cost this time?”
“80 contribution points.”
“So expensive!”
“This time is different, Junior Brother. I can guarantee that there are special resources in this place. Since the value is higher, the price has to be a little bit more expensive.”
“This isn’t just a little bit more expensive, it’s several dozen points more.”
“Hehe! I can’t help it. Our line of work has a lot of risks. But I can assure you that the quality of the information is good. After working together once, you should know that, Junior Brother.”
Jack Clark pondered for a moment and then nodded slightly, “Alright, let’s follow the same rules as before. I’ll pay a portion of the deposit first, and the balance will be paid when I return.”
Although the information is more expensive than the last time, Denny Lockwood’s intel has proven to be reliable.
If there were some gains this time, it wouldn’t take many for Jack to accrue over 300 points of contribution, enough for his breakthrough to the Sixth Layer of Dragon Elephant Tyrant Body.
“Rest assured, Junior Brother, the information is definitely accurate this time. But be careful when you go there. If things don’t work out, retreat. After all, there’s a future for cultivators only if we’re alive.”
“Thanks for the reminder, Senior Brother. I won’t be careless.”
The two completed the transaction, and Denny also sent Jack the information and coordinates of the new secret realm..

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 174: Level Eight Giant Beast, The Power of Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 174: Level Eight Giant Beast, The Power of Domain
Translator: 549690339
After Denny Lockwood left, Jack Clark went to the edge of the balcony.
At this time, the lingering sunset shining through the twisted spatial barriers cast a fiery red glow on the undulating mountains, as if engulfed in flames.
Along with the neatly arranged fields, and the harvesting machines below the mountains, Jack Clark inexplicably experiences an illusion of civilization intertwined with savagery.
Enjoying the sunset scenery, Jack Clark suddenly shifts his attention, and a part of his consciousness returns to the Thunderflame Behemoth’s situation.
After swimming in the ocean for several days, the Single-horned Tiger Whale finally found something good.
However, this time, it was on a deserted island in the Outer Sea, not in the deep sea.
The island is small, with lush vegetation and trees, overgrown weeds, a towering small hill with a waterfall, and some ordinary Mutated Creatures inhabiting it.
Surrounding the island, the sea is littered with reef rocks that occasionally surface with the tides.
Under such circumstances, large marine life can easily get stranded if not careful.
A few kilometers away, the Thunderflame Behemoth looks up at the distant island, hesitating: Roar! Joe, are you sure there’s something good on that island?
It knows that the horn of the Single-horned Tiger Whale can filter seawater and discern the scent of Heaven and Earth Treasure from far away, but when did it become able to filter air?
Next to it, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, whose whole body is covered in black armor, sways its tail and nods affirmatively: Yah yah yah! Yes, yes, I smell something good, and it’s really good.
Roar! When could your horn smell air?
After spending a long time with the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale also learned many ‘words’, such as ‘air’ referring to the ‘gas’ it breathes each time it surfaces.
Yah yah yah! Not air, but water. There’s water flowing down from the island, so I smelled it.
Alright, so that’s how it is. The Thunderflame Behemoth nodded its head.
Next to it, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle peeked its head above the surface, gazing at the distant island and growling with excitement: Roar roar! Thunderflame, shall we go on?
It had never been on ‘land’ before.
The Thunderflame Behemoth growled: This time, only we can go up. Be careful later, usually, such places have Mutated Creatures guarding them.
Roar! Also, Mutated Creatures on land are more agile, and you wouldn’t catch up with them. So, your main task is to be the shield and withstand their attacks.
Roar roar! No problem, that’s what I’m good at. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle confidently nodded its head.
It’s just taking a beating, simple. It had been accustomed to this after roaming the ocean for so long.
Yah yah yah! Thunderflame, what about me? The Single-horned Tiger Whale hurriedly inquired.
Roar! You? … Go to the cliff behind the island. If the Mutated Creature on the island is too strong, we might jump straight down from there.
Though confident in its own strength, the Thunderflame Behemoth was not arrogant.
Before it knew how strong the Mutated Creatures on the island were, it would be cautious. What if a Level 8 Peak Giant Beast was guarding there?
As for Level 9, such a creature standing at the pinnacle would naturally emit a certain aura, deterring everything around it. They could usually sense and avoid it in advance.
Yah yah yah! Okay.
Once their respective ’tasks’ were determined, the Thunderflame Behemoth let out a low growl, and its colossal body suddenly lunged forward, kicking up furious waves as it swam towards the island.
At this moment, the shallow water near the island suddenly bulged, and a huge creature 36 meters long and over 10 meters high at the shoulders burst out of the water.
Unlike crocodiles, the middle part of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body resembles a Western Dragon, fierce and strong, intimidating, with even more powerful limbs.
However, compared to Western Dragons, it appears more slender and ferocious, especially its tail.
At this time, behind the Thunderflame Behemoth, a gigantic turtle shell emerged amidst a shower of water, followed by thick limbs and a dragon head.
With a length of 41 meters and a shell on its back, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle is even taller than Thunderflame, reaching over 20 meters, like a dark-brown moving hill.
Roar! Let’s go.
Roar roar! Charge!
The landing of the two Giant Beasts made the ground tremble with each step.
Especially the Thunderflame Behemoth, with its golden red flame burning on its four claws, each step left a footprint five or six meters wide and over two meters deep.
The soil and gravel in the footprints melted from the intense heat, turning into hard material. If it were any later, they would even turn into magma.
Because of its dense flesh, the Thunderflame Behemoth had to use this method to prevent its claws from sinking too deep into the dirt.
Compared to the land, it was more convenient in the sea. Even with its astonishing gravity, its body, filled with blood and some organs, could easily sink and float in the water under the air.
Relative to the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s footprints were huge but only half a meter deep.
At the same time, as the two Giant Beasts landed on the island, there was a beeping sound from a surveillance device at the coastal Surveillance Base.
“Report, the Mutant Beast with King-level Potential, code-named Thunderflame, has been spotted on a desert island more than 1400 kilometers from the coast.”
Because of the fire and lightning anomalies when the Thunderflame Behemoth evolved, the person in charge who detected it had directly named its file after Thunderflame.
Today’s Major who was in charge had a solemn expression and said seriously: “What is the location of that island?”
“Coordinates 1722, Latitude 8°1691, Longitude 298°158o. In addition, there is another turtle-based Evolutionary Mutant Beast next to the code-named Thunderflame Mutant Beast.”
“Immediately gather nearby high-definition satellites to closely monitor their whereabouts, and also compare their various aspects through images..”

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 174: Level Eight Giant Beast, The Power of Domain_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 174: Level Eight Giant Beast, The Power of Domain_2
Translator: 549690339
“Yes.”
With the order given, seven high-definition satellites orbiting above the ocean subtly adjusted their positions, locking onto the island below from different angles.
At this moment, the sun was setting in the west, and there wasn’t a single cloud in the sky. Soon pictures of the Thunderflame Behemoth and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle appeared on the big screen, followed by the refreshed data. “Through optical analysis and comparing with the surrounding trees, the Unique Beast codenamed Thunderflame is currently between 34 and 37 meters in length and 10 to 15 meters in height.”
“Compared to more than half a month ago, this Unique Beast’s size has increased by about 10 meters. It has grown quickly, and there have been some changes in appearance, which are likely due to evolution.”
“That turtle-like Unique Beast is 38 to 44 meters in length and 20 to 26 meters in height, with an estimated level of 7 middle tier.”
Major asked solemnly, “What about the energy fluctuations?”
“At present, the energy fluctuations of the two beasts are in a gentle state, so we cannot accurately detect them.”
“However, in the deep mountain forest of the small island, the satellite captured the traces of a third high-level mutant beast, with an estimated body length of 63 to 68 meters.”
The major’s expression changed instantly: “Is it a snake-type Unique Beast?”
“No, it resembles an Ancient Giant Crocodile in appearance and is estimated to be at Level 8 Early Stage. Based on their current trajectories, the two sides will meet in about ten minutes.”
“Closely monitor everything on that island.”
As the two giant beasts advanced, the ground on the island trembled. Trees collapsed in their wake and creatures scurried away, startling countless two-meter and three-meter wingspan seabirds into flight.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Behemoth located the stream that crossed the island through the humidity in the air.
According to the Single-Horned Tiger Kingfish, it sensed the resource aura through the island’s stream water, which indicated that the unknown Heaven and Earth treasure should be in the water.
So, as long as they followed the stream, they would soon find ‘it’ by tracing its source.
At this time, not long after coming ashore, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s chatterbox itch struck again. It growled curiously from behind the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Roar!! Thunderflame, how are you, so clever, knowing to follow, water to search?
Roar!! Why didn’t I, think of that?
The Thunderflame Behemoth glanced back at it and then ignored it, knowing that if it responded, the Dragon Turtle would only talk more excitedly.
Roar!! Thunderflame, why aren’t you talking?
Seeing that the Thunderflame Behemoth didn’t bother with it, the bored Deep Sea Dragon Turtle poked his head out curiously and roared excitedly as it surveyed its surroundings.
Roar!! How strange, is this the meaning of ‘land’? These seaweeds look a little hard, don’t shake?
Roar!! Thunderflame, why can those fish in the sky fly…
Ignoring the incessant chatter of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle behind him, the Thunderflame Behemoth continued uphill, following the slope of the mountain.
Its massive body splashed large amounts of water with each step, igniting the water with the leaping flames of its claws, and evaporating the flow of the stream.
The two giant beasts quickly arrived at the mountainside.
Just then, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s footsteps suddenly stopped, and its golden vertical pupils coldly stared ahead.
A few hundred meters away, a giant beast more than 60 meters long was resting on the ground near a small pond with a diameter of several tens of meters.
The streams of water flowed out from this pond, forming a 5-meter-wide creek that meandered into the sea.
At this moment, the giant beast’s massive body lay in the forest, its.black-brown thick scale armor layered like an exoskeleton, covering its entire body.
Overall, it resembled a crocodile, but larger and more ferocious, with transfixing black, sharp bone spurs on its back, making it look imposing and fierce.
As the Thunderflame Behemoth spotted it, the beast exceeding Level 7 also saw them. The massive body instantly stood up with a thunderous boom.
Roar!
With a brutal roar, the domineering aura of Level 8 Behemoth erupted in an instant, causing the surrounding ground to crack and collapse, raising billowing clouds of smoke and dust.
Far-off trees swayed frantically under the impact of this roar, creating a terrifying scene.
The Ancient Giant Crocodile Beast was radiating an oppressive Black Power, its cold gaze fixed on the Thunderflame Behemoth, seemingly showing off its power.
