As for the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that trailed behind, it was completely ignored by this Level 8 Behemoth. Only the fearsome Thunderflame Behemoth triggered a strong sense of danger within it.
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Behemoth refused to be outdone and burst out with an incredibly fierce aura, like that of a savage true dragon.
Boom!
Under the substantial emanation of oppressive power, the surrounding air was instantly cleared, forming a half-circle transparent shockwave that swept hundreds of meters. Raging winds howled, and dust flew wherever it went.
Simultaneously, golden-red flames spewed out from the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body, transforming it into a blazing behemoth in the blink of an eye.
With raging flames shooting ten meters high, the surrounding temperature soared instantly under the intense heat generated by the more than 2000 degrees Celsius flames.
Especially the stream beneath the Thunderflame Behemoth, it began to boil instantaneously, and the steam erupted like a high-pressure cooker, drying up at a rate visible to the naked eye.
Then there were the hard cobblestones that cracked, shattered, and gradually turned into scorching hot, black-red liquid under the golden-red flames.
Just within a few breaths, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claws were submerged in the rolling magma, and the trees and weeds more than twenty meters away withered and ignited at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Compared to the deep sea environment, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s power on land was even more terrifying. In a moment, it transformed into a scorching radiation source, incinerating everything.
Ordinary people wouldn’t even have the qualifications to approach it.
Meanwhile, blue lightning constantly leaped between the dorsal fins of the Thunderflame Behemoth. Occasionally, when one of them struck the ground, it made a deafening explosion..

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 174: Level Eight Giant Beast, The Power of Domain_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 174: Level Eight Giant Beast, The Power of Domain_3
Translator: 549690339
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle admired such power from behind and roared excitedly: “Roar! Thunderflame, I’ll go first.”
As it spoke, a heavy yellow light burst from its body like a mountain, and a majestic and immovable aura spread out as its breath connected with the earth.
Boom, boom, boom!!
With a thick yellow shield over a meter thick, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle moved with heavy steps, like a moving small hill rushing towards the ancient giant crocodile beast, initiating the attack.
Such a high-spirited momentum was completely different from its original fear of death.
Roar!
Seeing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle daring to attack it, the ancient giant crocodile beast instantly burst into rage.
Roar!
In the brutal roar, the terrifying Qi Blood of the ancient giant crocodile beast exploded, and its massive body boomed as it shot out. Wherever it passed, the earth shook, and a raging wind howled.
The unbelievable speed almost reached three hundred meters per second at supersonic speed, completely devoid of the clumsiness of its massive body, and in an instant, it appeared in front of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Boom!
As the black power-covered giant claw fell, an indescribable heavy force burst out in an instant, causing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s figure to crash and sink.
Boom!
Centered on the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the earth within a hundred-meter radius exploded, countless dirt and rubble were about to be thrown up, only to be suppressed by an invisible heavy force.
Boom! At this moment, the black light flourished on the ancient giant crocodile, making the earth within a two-hundred-meter radius centered on it sink three meters under an invisible gravity domain.
The terrifying blow directly smashed more than half of the deep-sea giant turtle’s body into the ground, leaving only a small part of the turtle shell exposed, with the yellow light above swirling madly.
As the yellow light circulated, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s body continued to sink slowly.
Well, this guy had just shown a bit of courage, yet was immediately frightened by a single claw strike from the opponent, resorting to its hiding skills.
Roar!
Seeing the Dragon Turtle sinking in front of it, the ancient giant crocodile beast roared ferociously, and dazzling black light converged in its mouth, releasing a black and red beam.
Humm!
The black and red laser-like beam instantly bombarded the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s back, causing the thick yellow light to tremble madly, and a series of black and yellow shockwaves burst out.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Those shockwaves contained intense and powerful impact forces, lifting and melting the dirt around the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that had sunk into the ground, and emitting dazzling light.
Compared to Thunderflame Giant Beast’s scorching breath, the ancient giant crocodile’s breath seemed more like a condensed energy beam with higher penetrating power.
Moreover, this ancient giant crocodile beast possessed strong battle awareness, and upon noticing that Thunderflame Giant Beast hadn’t also attacked, it prepared to unleash its full strength to eliminate the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle first.
As the beam of breath continuously bombarded it, the yellow energy shield on the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s back held up for tens of seconds before being penetrated, and fell on the dark brown turtle shell with a loud crash.
Roar! From beneath the earth, a scream resounded.
Gravity Domain, high penetration energy rays huh? From a distance, the Thunderflame Giant Beast’s eyes flickered slightly as the flames on its body surged.
Boom! With the explosion of the ground within dozens of meters range, the Thunderflame Giant Beast instantly vanished from its spot.
Boom! Roar!
Just as the giant crocodile beast was about to finish off the Dragon Turtle in one go, it let out a scream, its body’s scales shattered, and its massive body boomed as it crashed into the hillside hundreds of meters away.
In an instant, a large part of the mountain forest collapsed, stone debris scattered all around, and smoke and dust filled the air.
In the instant that the ancient giant crocodile was blasted away, the Thunderflame Giant Beast’s four claws unleashed an explosive force, turning into a scorching firelight in a flash as it gave chase.
Roar! On the shattered earth, the ancient giant crocodile had just gotten up when it saw the bright light in its eyes.
In an instant, the right claw of the Thunderflame Giant Beast appeared in front of it, the muscles swollen, the claw tips gleaming with golden scorching light as it struck with terrifying speed.
Roar! The ancient giant crocodile let out a cry of surprise and anger!
Boom! With the ancient giant crocodile at the center, a heavy force exploded, and the earth within a two-hundred-meter radius sank under hundred-fold gravity.
Under the strong gravity, even the Thunderflame Giant Beast couldn’t help but sink, and the claw it swung fell faster under the force of gravity.Roar! The giant crocodile beast let out a mournful scream.
Under the piercing effect of the sharp and terrifying claws, combined with the hundred-fold power explosion and the reinforcement provided by gravity, this blow nearly shattered the upper half of the scale armor on the head of the ancient giant crocodile beast.
Countless flesh and blood burst on the head of the giant crocodile, revealing the skull beneath it, which was dozens of times harder than alloy, and even an eye was blasted away by the Thunderflame Behemoth’s strike.
After knowing that its ability was to control gravity to form domains, the Thunderflame Behemoth adjusted for the angle of gravity pulling in this strike.
However, this giant crocodile beast is truly worthy of being a Level 8 Mutated Creature. Under its full strength, it was only severely injured and not having its head blasted off like other mutated creatures in the past.
Furthermore, it had sunk two meters into the ground under the immense pressure of a hundred times gravity, almost as if its belly was pressed against the earth.
Even the flames on its body were compressed by the energy talent-created gravity to a distance of one meter from its body, emitting an even more scorching and dazzling light.
However, although this gravity was terrifying, it only made the Thunderflame Behemoth somewhat uncomfortable.
Roar!
Seeing the temporarily immobile Thunderflame Behemoth, the ancient giant crocodile with half of its head drenched in blood let out an angry growl, and its giant mouth snapped open to bite.
Boom!
At this moment, countless thunderbolts erupted from the Thunderflame Behemoth as the center, interweaving into a hundred-meter-range Thunderstorm Domain.
Roar, roar, roar! The ancient giant crocodile roared in anger as it was struck by close-range thunderbolts, experiencing painful numbness and tingling.
However, these lightning bolts could only slightly numb the terrifying ancient giant crocodile covered in black power and could not cause real damage.
Boom!!
At the moment when the giant crocodile paused, the Thunderflame Behemoth blasted open its incoming giant mouth with a single claw.
At the same time, it was sent flying by a claw of the ancient giant crocodile, with the sharp and enormous claws scratching out a large spark on the black-red scales.
Both the Thunderflame Behemoth and the ancient giant crocodile, with their enhanced flesh bodies, had claws that could easily tear through ordinary energy shields. In the end, they both relied on their powerful flesh bodies.
Roar!
Accompanied by an enraged roar, the Thunderflame Behemoth, which had somewhat adapted to the gravity domain, swept across the scorching and raging winds and pounced ferociously, immediately igniting a fierce battle.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Both giant creatures were surrounded by gravity domains, burning flames, and thunder explosions, shattering the ground and collapsing the slopes wherever they went.
Every blow they delivered carried a terrifying power impact, vibrating the void and echoing their thick and fierce roars between heaven and earth, creating an earth-shattering momentum.
Under the influence of the gravity domain, the speed and agility of the Thunderflame Behemoth were greatly affected.
Meanwhile, the ancient giant crocodile was unaffected in the domain and could even control gravity to increase its own speed and strength. However, even with this advantage, it could barely hold its ground against the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Moreover, compared to the Thunderflame Behemoth with human consciousness, the ancient giant crocodile’s fighting style was much more crude, only having a few moves such as biting, swiping, and tail sweeping.
Therefore, though the battle appeared evenly matched, it was actually the Thunderflame Behemoth who was pressing down on the larger ancient giant crocodile, as the ancient creature’s control over its body was too strong after evolving, allowing it to quickly adapt to the gravity domain.
As for the powerful laser beam, it couldn’t be deployed because of the close combat, and the Thunderflame Behemoth was also guarding against this move.
On the island, the Thunderflame Behemoth fought fiercely, swinging its double claws. The Golden Flame Dragon Claws would cause the ground to collapse dozens of meters in an instant, and magma to churn whenever they struck.
When hitting the ancient giant crocodile, its scales broke, and blood and flesh flew.
However, as a Level 8 Giant Beast, the ancient giant crocodile possessed a terrifying speed of recovery. The wounds that revealed bones were continuously healed as flesh grew around them.
Suddenly, the blood-soaked ancient giant crocodile let out a furious roar as its massive body was caught by the neck by the Thunderflame Behemoth’s double claws and smashed into the ground several meters below.
Roar, roar, roar!! The violent roar caused the surrounding ground that had been compressed into a solid by gravity to vibrate continuously.
But under the Thunderflame Behemoth’s flaming double claws, tightly gripping its neck and right hind claw stepping on its back, the ancient giant crocodile was unable to break free for a moment.
Just then, a tail pierced through the air at an explosive speed, enveloped in scorching flames and lightning.
Under the explosive force of a hundred times the muscle power, the tail blade reached supersonic speed even in the gravity domain, emitting a sharp and piercing sound, like a dazzling light.
Boom!
The sharp tail blade, infused with terrifying power, pierced through the void, instantly penetrated through the armor, flesh, and landed on the giant crocodile’s thick skull that was dozens of times stronger than alloy under energy enhancement, creating a terrifying energy impact and piercing through with a single blow..

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 175: The Mythical King, Destruction of the Heavens Base
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 175: The Mythical King, Destruction of the Heavens Base
Translator: 549690339
The shattered earth, collapsed hillside, burning forest, massive corpses all exuded a terrifying aura.
There also stood a black-red ferocious giant beast in front of a unique beast’s corpse, its body engulfed in golden red flames, lightning bouncing about, its tail sword broken, exuding a terrifying aura.
Just as the Thundcrflame Behemoth was clenching its double claws, basking in the glory of the ended battle with its bulging muscles radiating a fierce aura, the ground trembled in the distance.
It turned out to be the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that had burrowed out of the ground at some point, running over happily with a loud, excited roar.
Roar!! Thundcrflame, you’re so mighty, you killed this big guy.
Roar!! Thundcrflame, as expected of our leader, you’re so… so cool.
Roar!! By the way, Thundcrflame, what does ‘cool’ mean? Why do you like using this word?
Looking at the excited Deep Sea Dragon Turtle crawling around it, the Thundcrflame Behemoth took a deep breath and struck out with a claw.
Bang!
With a swing of its claw, the very air exploded, and The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle – looking as large as a small hill – – was flipped over immediately and landed heavily on its back.
Dismayed by the sudden loss of grounding of its four claws, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle panicked, its limbs flailing about. It stretched its head out to a great length, pushing against the ground to right its body with much difficulty.
Thud! With a ground-shaking movement, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle righted itself and then whined.
Roar!! Thundcrflame, why did you hit me?
Looking at it quizzically, the Thunderflame Behemoth lowly roared back: Roar! Did I? I just patted you in a friendly manner. It’s just that you’re so weak, you rolled over without my even exerting any strength.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle which although larger, was more weak in terms of power, eventually chose to believe this explanation.
No choice, it can’t win in a fight anyway.
Roar! Let’s go and see what’s really down there. The Thundcrflame Behemoth let out a low roar, and moved towards the distant pond with its massive body.
Roar!! Yes, yes, let’s go get the good stuff.
Mentioning this, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle became excited.
They had braved the danger just for some fancy food, right?
Leaving the corpse of the Ancient Giant Crocodile aside, the two giant beasts quickly returned to the small pond.
The Thunderflame Behemoth retracted flames and lightning around its body, and first walked into the ‘small’ pond which, to them, was just the size of a basin.
Gurgle gurgle!! With the two colossal beasts entering, the water level of the pond rose sharply, plenty of water overflowing and filling the broken land around it.
Hmm! Something’s off with the water.
Just entering the pond, the Thunderflame Behemoth felt something was not right. One, the water was very deep. It was not as shallow as it looked from the outside, but a large hollow that went windingly downward.
Secondly, there was something wrong with the water. It contained energy comparable to the deep sea below three thousand meters.
Cracks often appeared in the deep sea, and it seemed that the sea water and water pressure had the characteristics of locking in energy. Therefore, the deeper the sea, the richer the Heavenly Energy.
Especially in places where spatial cracks had appeared, the Heavenly Energy was so dense it was like a liquid, usually occupied by Deep Sea Giant Beasts.
Roar! Keep up.
With a low roar, the Thunderflame Behemoth moved its tail and its massive body dived down, following the winding underwater path to several hundred meters below.
As they dove deeper and deeper, the cave became narrower. Many places showed signs of claw-dug excavation, obviously done by that Ancient Giant Crocodile.
By the time they reached an eight hundred meter depth, the Thundcrflame Behemoth understood why the pond water was dense with energy.
In the ‘narrow’ cave that was over ten meters wide, there were various sized gaps in the surrounding rocks, and groundwater seeped out from them.
In the middle of the cave ‘hovered’ a white crack over a meter long and several decimeters wide, with water rich in Heavenly Energy continually gushing out from the other side.
This was a very stable space crack, the Thundcrflame Behemoth could even see numerous white crystals on the other side of the bottom.
However, just because this crack was stable doesn’t mean small fishes could enter the mythical world from the other side.
Within that stable crack, tiny Black Cracks flickered in and out every moment, continuously cutting through the water that passed through the crack.
And despite the illusion of proximity, the seemingly close white sand sea bed on the other side of the crack was, in reality, very far apart.
Roar!! Thundcrflame, any treasure?
Due to the narrowness of the cave, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle could only thrust its long neck through the narrow opening from behind and barely see the crack after the Thundcrflame Behemoth took most of the space.
But there was no sign of the Heaven and Earth Treasure they were expecting.
The Thunderflame Behemoth laid its eyes on the white crystal stones on the other side of the crack and thoughtfully growled: Roar! The good stuff must have been eaten by that big guy. However, there should be more left.
During their low growls, as the ‘river’ flowed, a fist-sized white crystal flowed over from the other side of the crack.
But just as that crystal entered the crack, it silently split into three. Then one piece suddenly disintegrated and disappeared, followed by the second…
Even though it seemed only a small distance away, that crystal took several minutes to ‘flow’ through, and in the end, only about a tenth of the small crystal fell from the crack.
In an instant, a special aroma filled the surroundings, making both the Thundcrflame Behemoth and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle swallow a mouthful of saliva.
Roar! Domination, let me check the effect of this item first.
Roar!! Okay, okay, Thunderflame, you eat first. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded, having no objections.
Glug! As the Thunderflame Behemoth’s mouth opened wide, a strong suction force came out. A large amount of water along with the crystal was swallowed into its mouth..

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 175: The Mythical King, Destruction of the Heavens Base_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 175: The Mythical King, Destruction of the Heavens Base_2
Translator: 549690339
The crystal the size of a thumb was to the Thunderflame Beheamoth like a person inhaling a speck of dust—it hardly even noticed the difference.
However, when the tiny crystal entered its stomach, a powerful, pure energy began to release, making the small crystal seem as if it contained countless compressed energy.
From the stomach, this energy spread throughout its body, causing its cells to multiply and grow frantically. Its muscles swelled, its bones developed, and its outer shell expanded.
In the blink of an eye, the Thunderflame Beheamoth had grown a whole 20 centimeters, appearing even more ferocious and menacing.
The growth was not evident to the Thunderflame Beheamoth, but that was only a tenth of the crystal’s potential power.
With good luck and an entire crystal to consume, it could grow 2 meters, which was considerably more dramatic than the growth it would experience by devouring a Level 7 Mutant Beast.
Whew!
A scorching breath spewed from the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s nostrils. It looked at the white crystals covering the riverbed across the crack, its eyes nearly filled with blood.
How big would it grow if it could eat all of those super Energy Crystal Bodies across the way? One thousand meters? Ten thousand meters?…
At this moment, even the calmness of the Thunderflame Beheamoth couldn’t resist the excitement it felt.
Just like an ordinary person suddenly discovering a mountain of gold, the dazzling light blinded them, leaving only those white crystals in their eyes.
However, the energy contained in these crystals was different from that of the high-purity Life Energy in the green crystal sand they had found in the deep sea below.
It seemed that the Energy Crystal Body’s only purpose was to provide rapid growth to Mutated Creatures. This could be deduced by looking at the unchanged Evolution value on the attribute page.
Apart from that, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s cells sent out a hunger signal, as if the growth had depleted all the stored energy within its cells.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth exhaled a scorching breath, boiling the river water before it.
Roar! Domination, we don’t need those silver small fishes anymore. From now on, we will guard this place. Let Joe bring his wife and children here.
Rooar!! Yeah, yeah. We will nest here and fight to the death with anyone who dares to steal from us.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded excitedly. It had seen the changes in the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s body after it had eaten a small piece of the crystal, and the results were astonishing.
Naturally, it understood what the dense crystals on the opposite side meant.
It meant that they could grow at a faster pace.
For Mutated Creatures, size meant “strength”—the bigger the body, the stronger the physical existence, the more power contained within it, and the higher the Evolution level.
At this moment, another Crystal Stone flowed along the river into the crack, but as soon as it entered, it silently split into seven pieces.
Due to the invisible Space Cracks within the tunnel, by the time the white crystals reached the other side, only a one-twentieth of it remained—the rest had been swallowed by space itself.
Roar! Domination, this one’s a bit small. Do you want it?
Roar! Yeah, I want it.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded immediately, then opened its mouth and used powerful suction to swallow both the small crystal and the surrounding water.
Under the influence of the immense, pure growth energy, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s body grew visibly larger.
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s eyes sparkled, and it roared: Roar! Let’s go, let’s inform Joe first.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded its head.
However, it had encountered some difficulties when trying to exit.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s body was too broad, so their exit was blocked deep within the cave. It had to wait for the Thunderflame Beheamoth to turn around and leave before it could follow.
As for the Ancient Giant Crocodile, its massive body could barely squeeze in.
Bang!
The water surface of the pool exploded, and the Giant Beast with the sharp, horned turtle shell emerged, followed by the Giant Beast covered in ferocious, black and red scale armor.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth looked at the Ancient Giant Crocodile’s corpse in the distance and roared at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle: Roar! Domination, go and inform Joe about the situation here. I’m a little hungry, I want to eat something.
Roar!! Alright, Thunderflame.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded and then, with its small, quick steps, went to the beach to inform Joe. It was also a little hungry and planned to catch some Mutated Creatures in the sea for food.
As for the Ancient Giant Crocodile, it naturally belonged to the Thunderflame Beheamoth—its spoils of war.
Upon returning to the Ancient Giant Crocodile’s corpse, the Thunderflame Beheamoth opened its mouth wide and took a bite.
Crack!
Under the terrifying bite force of the Thunderflame Beheamoth, the Ancient Giant Crocodile’s thick scales, which were even harder than armor, tore apart.
The resilient flesh and blood were bitten off, several tons devoured in an instant.
The rich, bloody scent filled the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s mouth.
As an Eighth Level Beast, the flesh of this Mutant Creature held an extremely rich energy. Although its muscles were as tough as soft alloy, they were quickly chewed and swallowed by the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
As the flesh entered the Beheamoth’s stomach, a dense biological energy spread out, nourishing its empty cells like rainwater falling on a dry desert.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth immediately felt refreshed, letting out a satisfied roar and biting off another large chunk of flesh.
As the Thunderflame Beheamoth feasted, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle hunted for various mutated creatures in the sea, each over ten meters long, to satisfy its appetite.
For a while, the thought of informing the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had been forgotten.
Behind the small island, under the water’s surface 20 meters below a steep cliff, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish raised its head slightly, its sharp eyes fixated on the sharp cliff, ready for a fight at any moment.
With Thunderflame’s strength, it should still be fighting. It seemed that this time’s enemy was quite challenging.
It’s a pity that it didn’t have any claws, so it couldn’t get ashore. If it did, then it would fight alongside its big brother and destroy whoever was their enemy..

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 175: The Mythical King, Destruction of the Heavens Base_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 175: The Mythical King, Destruction of the Heavens Base_3
Translator: 549690339
Approximately an hour later, as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was still waiting anxiously, the water behind it began to churn, and a ferocious and massive Dragon Turtle swam over.
Upon seeing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle suddenly crawling up from behind, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was slightly stunned: Yiiiing yiiiing yiiiing! 1 Domination, weren’t you guys fighting up there?
Roar! It’s already over. With that, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out a satisfied burp, spitting out some bloody water and leftover flesh.
Yiiiing yiiiing yiiiing!! It’s been over!? The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish came to a halt.
Roar! Yeah.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out a proud low roar.
Roar! That guy was quite strong, but we were stronger. At that time, this turtle charged forward, taking the attacks head-on, then Thunderflame made his move. Together, we snapped and crushed that guy.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, quite the talented public speaker, made the battle sound earth-shattering with his long, ferocious head shaking and adding dramatic embellishments to how brave and powerful he was.
When it had finished speaking, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish suddenly screeched.
Yiiiing yiiiing yiiiing!! So you’re saying that Thunder flame asked you to tell me the battle is over, but instead, you went to eat first?
Roar roar!! Sorry, I was hungry at that time and forgot. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle blinked its huge eyes, trying to play it cute in order to get away with it.
Yiiiing yiiiing yiiiing!! Next time Thunderflame beats you, I won’t help you.
Left to be tense for half a day, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish swished its tail, splashing a huge wave onto the Dragon Turtle’s face, then its giant body turned and swam back towards the inner sea.
It intended to bring all the Little Tiger Whales to share the things that could help Mutated Creatures grow rapidly, especially its ‘wife’.
“Report, the battle on the island has ended with the victory of the Mutated Creature codenamed Thunderflame.”
“After the battle, the Mutated Creature codenamed Thunderflame and the turtle Mutated Beast briefly entered the water pool and emerged back ashore after more than ten minutes. They are now eating.”
“Do we need to respond?”
The Major being questioned pondered for a moment: “Report the battle data at that time, especially the energy peaks of both sides, their strengths, and the course of the battle.”
“Yes.” As the staff operated, giant images of the beasts and data analysis curves were projected onto the big screen.
“The Ancient Giant Crocodile Mutated Creature had a maximum energy peak of Level 8 Early Stage. Its ability was to create a gravity field with a range of 200 meters in the surrounding area.”
“In addition, this creature also possessed beam-type abilities. Overall, it belongs to the ordinary Eighth Level Beast category.”
“The turtle Mutated Creature had a maximum energy peak of Level 7 Peak. Its ability seemed to be defense-related, with formidable defense capabilities, capable of blocking the attack of the giant crocodile creature.”
“From its size and appearance, this Mutated Creature was estimated to be at Level 7 Mid Stage and belongs to the stronger Dragon Bloodline category.”
“The Mutated Creature codenamed Thunderflame had an instantaneous maximum energy burst reaching Level 8 Mid Stage.”
“Additionally, during close combat, there was once a brief period when seven high-definition satellite cameras lost track of it, despite no cloud mist obscuring the view, indicating that it had entered ultra-image speed.”
“Aside from that, during close combat with a more massive Eighth Level Beast, this Mutated Creature demonstrated superior strength and defensive dominance.”
“Under combined data analysis, the Mutated Creature codenamed Thunderflame was at Level 7 Mid Stage, possessing both thunder and flame supernatural attributes, ultra-image speed talent, and abilities surpassing its level in strength and defense.”
“When this Mutated Creature was first observed more than twenty days ago, it had just evolved to Level 7, with an energy peak at Level 7 Peak.”
“Comprehensive evaluation indicates a Unique Beast King with five major talents, extremely rapid growth, and highly dangerous. It is recommended to report this and request Sky Base weapons for elimination.”
“A Unique Beast King with five major talents!” The Major’s face showed a solemn expression as he looked at the images flashing with red danger lights on the big screen.
Mutated Creatures with a trace of king-level bloodline were regarded as having King-level Potential.
Such Mutated Beasts would possess one more powerful talent than creatures of the same level, making them practically invincible at their level.
Furthermore, Monarch-level Mutant Creatures had even more terrifying potential; as long as they didn’t die, they could grow into Mythical Giant Beasts comparable to King-level strong men.
Moreover, once a Mythical Giant Beast had emerged, it would be considered a Monarch among all other Giant Beasts.
These Monarch creatures would not only be terrifying in their combat abilities, but they would also possess the ‘charisma’ to make other Mutant Beasts submit to them, causing a significant commotion whenever one appeared.
With that in mind, the Major took a deep breath: “Permission granted.”
“Collate this information as quickly as possible, complete the form, and send it up immediately, while the Giant Beast is still on the island.”
“Yes.”
With the Major’s approval, the staff quickly collated the details of the discovered Mutated Creature’s battle into detailed information and sent it to the base commander.
What remained to be seen was whether the use of Sky Base weapons would be approved or not..

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 176: Brush Past Each Other, Death and Resurrection
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 176: Brush Past Each Other, Death and Resurrection
Translator: 549690339
Countless human beings in the ocean have been paying close attention to the Mutated Creatures, especially those from deep-sea forbidden zones.
In order to defend against high-level Mutated Creatures’ attack on the land and prevent damage to coastal cities, enormous resources were expended to establish a coastal detection network.
In addition, over the years, human officials have deployed numerous warships on long voyages, working in conjunction with strong cultivators in killing high-order Mutated Creatures.
More than a decade ago, a powerful king-level being even descended to slay a Mythical Giant Beast that had destroyed a coastal city and returned to the ocean.
However, these situations were relatively special, and forces were generally only dispatched when high-order Mutated Creatures attacked coastal cities or assaulted nearby ships, targeting humans.
Apart from this, if high-risk potential Mutated Creatures were discovered and judged to pose a possible danger to humans, they would be eliminated in advance.
As a result, the information about this extremely dangerous situation quickly reached the highest military level.
In less than ten minutes, a small meeting was held to discuss whether to use Sky Base weapons.
Situated around a circular conference table, a middle-aged man in his fifties sat in the main seat, with four people on either side. Among them, the two on the left both emitted the aura of high-level cultivators.
The other two people on the right were ordinary people, but they both possessed the air of research scholars.
As everyone took their seats, the middle-aged man in the main seat looked to his right and said solemnly, “Mr. Lee, what arc your thoughts on this newly emerged Monarch-level Mutant Creature?”
The Elder known as Mr. Lee flipped through several high-resolution satellite images in his hands and compared the data, then hesitated for a moment before saying, “My opinion is relatively conservative.”
“From the initial observation of this Mutated Creature until now, the satellite has captured its image on the sea surface four times, each time further away from the coast.”
“Judging from its trajectory, this Mutated Creature is approaching the deep sea.”
“Under normal conditions, if it grows to Level 9 for a breakthrough, its biological instincts will drive it to enter the mythical world through those deep-sea rifts.”
“Of course, that’s assuming it can grow to Level 9. The Mutated Creatures’ world is even more brutal; it might be devoured by a stronger Giant Beast in a couple of days.”
“Besides, in my memory of the recent incidents of coastal fishing boat attacks, I haven’t found any creatures with similar appearances to this Mutated Beast.”
“Therefore, I am temporarily judging its hostility towards humans as not strong. My suggestion is to continue monitoring; as humans withdraw from the ocean, our conflicts with marine life are minimal.”
“Otherwise, once we take the initiative to strike and fail to kill it but let it escape into the deep sea, the scene from ten years ago could be repeated.”
“Furthermore, due to the greater potential of this Mutated Creature, the threat it poses at that time would be even greater.”
After the Elder finished speaking, the middle-aged man nodded slightly and looked over to the middle-aged man next to the Elder: “Mr. Raven, what is your opinion?”
The middle-aged man seemed to be deep in thought, “My focus is more or less the same as Mr. Lee, tending to be conservative. This Mutated Creature from the ocean is capable of coming ashore and highly intelligent.”
“At just level 7, it is already aware of using the King-level intimidation to subdue other Mutated Creatures, cooperating in hunting, and even establishing a ‘social’ hierarchy.”
“We can tell this from the fact that after the battle, the Turtle-like creature was driven away by the one code-named Thunderflame, who enjoyed the spoils.”
“Under these circumstances, we need to be more cautious. Either be thoroughly prepared, such as deploying another Cloud Sea-class warship equipped with energy bombardment weapons and a late-stage ninth heaven expert.”
“In that case, even if it survived the Sky Base weapon attack by a fluke, we wouldn’t be afraid of any fish slipping through the net, and we could completely annihilate it with overwhelming force.”
“Otherwise, as Mr. Lee suggested, do not pay attention to it as long as it shows no hostility towards humans.”
“Otherwise, if the killing fails, a group of Mutated Creatures full of hostility towards humans may emerge in the deep sea in the future, possibly even affecting the situation there.”
The middle-aged man nodded slightly, looking at the head of the two people on the left: “General Lee, what are your thoughts?”
The middle-aged man said solemnly, “General, our space department has limited research on Mutated Creatures. I can only guarantee that the attack of Sky Base weapons will not miss.”
“According to the current coordinates, the closest satellite is Sky Base Satellite No. 7, a medium space-based weapon that can destroy the entire island within a few kilometers with one strike.”
“Under such power, that Level 7 Mutant Creature wouldn’t survive no matter how great its potential, unless it can teleport or burrow underground.”
As he spoke about the power of the Sky Base weapon, Major General Lance’s face was full of confidence, as it was their space department’s most successful weapon in recent years.
“Burrowing underground!”
The middle-aged man’s brow furrowed, “The information shows that there is a pool in the middle of that desert island. The two Mutated Creatures disappeared for more than ten minutes after entering it.”
Mr. Lee nodded, “Yes, this is one of the reasons for my conservative suggestion.”
The middle-aged man fell silent for a moment, then said solemnly, “Application rejected. Tell them that conditions are insufficient and continue to observe the movements of that Mutated Creature.”
“Temporarily adopt a conservative approach.”
More than a decade ago, due to the rapid development of modern weaponry and cultivation, humans tended to adopt aggressive and overbearing methods towards ocean Mutated Creatures.
Every time a high-order creature that could potentially threaten humans was discovered, they would proactively strike and annihilate it in its infancy. At that time, there were fewer deep-sea forbidden areas.
However, after the incident of a high-order King-level Potential Unique Beast escaping and eventually evolving into a Mythical Giant Beast for revenge more than ten years ago, humans’ attitude towards ocean creatures began to change..

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 176: Brush Past Each Other, Death and Resurrection_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 176: Brush Past Each Other, Death and Resurrection_2
Translator: 549690339
Furthermore, the focus gradually shifted to the mythical world, where marine resources were “scarce” and it wasn’t humanity’s home field, so the ocean was slowly abandoned.
Only control over the coastal areas was retained.
As the sky grew darker, on the deserted island, it took the Thunderflame Behemoth just over half an hour to devour nearly half of the flesh and blood of the Ancient Giant Crocodile.
At this moment, a faint feeling of ‘fullness’ came from the cells in its body, and its digestion in the stomach slowed down suddenly. The Thunderflame Behemoth stopped.
Though its digestive ability was terrifying, the flesh of a Level 8 giant beast was as tough as alloy, and it couldn’t finish it all at once.
It would probably take another two meals to finish.
Looking at the exposed black skeleton of the corpse, the Thunderflame thought to itself.
With its feeding and digestion, its size increased considerably, reaching more than 37 meters long, and its Evolution value skyrocketed by nearly two hundred points.
Its rapid growth is half due to the effect of the small crystal, which seemed to make its body more active after absorbing that kind of energy.
Accelerate growth, huh.
With thoughts, the Thunderflame Behemoth looked towards the deep pool in the distance, its massive body rumbling as it moved, taking heavy steps into the water, splashing waves.
Gurgle, gurgle!!
Accompanied by water bubbles, the Thunderflame Behemoth quickly came to the depths of the water and saw the crack emitting a faint white light.
A thumb-sized White Crystal lay quietly on the stone beneath the crack at this moment.
In just over an hour, there have been three Growth Crystals dropped, making this resource quite ‘plentiful’.
Glancing at the crystal, the Thunderflame Behemoth suppressed the urge to devour it, controlling the weak water flow to draw it close and grab it in its huge claw.
This one was meant for the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
As a beast, one shouldn’t be too greedy. The three beasts must work together fairly, otherwise, the group won’t last long if everything is monopolized.
After all, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle were only ‘simple-minded’, not fools.
Of course, being the one that contributed the most to securing this place, the Thunderflame will take the largest share, followed by the Single-horned Tiger Whale, who found this place, and lastly, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, who acted as the meat shield.
It seemed that in this instance, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle wasn’t of much use, but if it hadn’t gone up and taken a beating, which revealed that Ancient Giant Crocodile’s talent ability, things might not have gone so smoothly.
Especially its laser energy breath, which was so powerful that even the defense-focused Deep Sea Dragon Turtle couldn’t withstand it for more than a few dozen seconds.
With such power, even the Thunderflame couldn’t say it could withstand it; if it were careless, it might get injured.
Furthermore, according to the output of these Growth Crystals, there would be many more to come, so there was no need to be stingy. After all, eating crystals still required supplementary food energy.
If one could grow simply by eating the crystals…
While contemplating, the Thunderflame Behemoth slowly exited the cave.
However, when it reached halfway to the depth of the pool, a blue radiance lit up at the roots of its dorsal fin, followed by numerous little lightning bolts exploding.
Zzzzz!!
Countless blue lightning arcs covered the entire pool, causing the death of all the tiny lives and microorganisms under the terrifying thunder and lightning glow.
In fact, when the Thunderflame Behemoth came down earlier, it had noticed that there were almost no aquatic creatures in this pool.
In any case, the Ancient Giant Crocodile cleared the area to prevent the fish from devouring the fallen crystals from the cracks when it wasn’t looking.
This time, it was just taking precautions.
Bang!
As water splashed, the Thunderflame Behemoth climbed out of the pool and saw the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle standing by the edge of the pool, looking curious.
Upon seeing the Thunderflame come out, the Dragon Turtle growled.
Roar!! Thunderflame, what were you doing just now, generating electricity? Is there an enemy down there?
The Thunderflame Behemoth growled back: Roar! No enemies, I was just cleaning the water quality, to prevent small creatures from eating the crystals when we’re not around.
Suddenly, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes showed admiration with a touch of humanity in them.
Roar!! Worthily, you, Thunderflame, are truly smart.
At this point, the Thunderflame Behemoth growled: Domination, I know you don’t like to move, so I’ll leave the guarding to you. Collect the crystals.
I’ll come up once a day, and we’ll divide them together then. Every beast will get a share, so no sneaking some for yourself, understand?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded hurriedly: Roar!! Rest assured, Thunderflame, leave this place to me. I promise not to sneak any and share them with everyone.
One look at the size increase would reveal if someone cheated, so the Thunderflame Behemoth nodded, walked towards the corpse of the Ancient Giant Crocodile, grabbed its tail with its left claw, and walked upright towards the sea.
After this ancient evolution, the Thunderflame Behemoth had a better control of its body. Although it was accustomed to crawling, it had no problem walking upright, which made it more convenient in combat.
Moreover, for some reason, a faint unease filled its heart after killing the Ancient Giant Crocodile on the shore.
There was a feeling of exposure under the spotlight, as if someone was watching it, so it decided to abandon the plan of using the deep pool as its den and let the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle guard the place.
Moreover, a large amount of food was needed after consuming the Growth Crystals, so it was not convenient to stay on the island for a long time.
But where did that uneasy feeling come from?
Is there a Level 9 Giant Beast lurking in the surrounding waters? Or is it… from the sky?
With this thought, the Thunderflame Behemoth slightly raised its head and looked at the cloudless sky, eyes full of contemplation.
If there were Level 9 Giant Beasts lurking around, it should have sensed it earlier.
Each of these beasts that had evolved to reach the Biological Summit was extremely terrifying and would naturally emit a warning aura to keep the mutated creatures away from their territory..

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 176: Brushing Past, Coming Back To Life_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 176: Brushing Past, Coming Back To Life_3
Translator: 549690339
It was rare to see a Level 9 Giant Beast engaged in a covert attack, as their bodies had undergone almost a complete change, and they no longer needed to hunt for food.
Once normal mutated creatures reached Level 7, their bodies would gradually undergo a qualitative change under the influence of their gifted powers, such as the metal giant beast encountered previously.
Similarly, creatures like the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle actually had little reliance on the flesh and blood of mutated creatures.
Most of the time, they absorbed energy from heaven and earth for their consumption and purified their bloodlines to grow.
After reaching Level 8, the physical change would become even more pronounced. The flesh and blood of the Fire Giant Beast would largely crystallize into magma, and the rock-type creatures’ bodies would transform into Vajra-like rocks.
Of course, this elemental transformation was merely a description, and they still possessed the characteristics of living flesh and blood.
Among these mutated creatures, the Thunderflame Behemoth was one of a kind, just as Jack Clark’s body was different from conventional cultivators.
Capable of rapid growth through devouring, it had a strong demand for the biological energy of flesh and blood, requiring several times its body size worth of mutated creatures per day.
It would digest these foods into biological energy to supply its body’s growth and evolution.
This was also the reason why its strength had increased so rapidly — its digestion capabilities were too strong, almost like the talent for devouring.
So, it was highly likely that the human satellite had discovered it and was monitoring it from the sky; otherwise, the faint unease with no discernible origin was unexplainable.
Moreover, Jack Clark knew that human satellites monitored global mutated creatures.
As many material challenges were overcome, human military technology was becoming more and more advanced, not only in weapons, but high-definition satellites have almost covered the whole world.
It seemed that he had to be more careful in the future and only appear on the sea surface at night when there were clouds.
In the midst of pondering this, the Thunderflamc Behemoth dragged the corpse of the ancient giant crocodile beast to the seaside and disappeared with a splash beneath the sea surface.
After all, it wouldn’t trust its own safety to others. Although its original form was human.
Deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Boom!
With a ground-shaking tremor, a 32-mcter-long Mutated Beast resembling a Tyrannosaurus Rex but more ferocious slammed into the ground amidst the enveloping mist.
Its chest scale armor was broken, pierced by a massive bloody hole three meters in diameter. Just as its scorching hot blood was about to gush out like a fountain, a surge of black Demonic Qi blocked it.
Wearing black armor and surrounded by swirling black smoke, Mikus walked in front of the corpse, and the tail behind him hissed like a poisonous python, piercing through the Unique Beast’s corpse.
Omm! With the surge of black Demonic Qi, Mikus devoured and absorbed the visible blood energy along with his tail, growing stronger.
As the flesh and essence were devoured, the speed at which the Unique Beast’s corpse withered was visible to the naked eye.
In just over ten minutes, the corpse of the Level 6 Mutant Beast appeared dim and lifeless like it had been dead for half a year, giving off a putrid smell.
It was only then that Mikus, now a great deal more powerful, retracted his tail with satisfaction.
Just then, a shadow emerged from the trees behind him and knelt on one knee, respectfully saying, “Sir.”
Mikus slowly turned around and looked at the Shadow Divine Church Infiltrator hidden beneath the black robe, saying indifferently, “So, what’s the news from Cooper?”
The black-robed man respectfully answered, “Ilisa Wesley has been wandering around the mountain range aimlessly since leaving, apparently with no particular purpose. She ignored two Federal Geniuses she encountered.” “However, as the distance increases, Cooper will have some difficulty transmitting information.”
“What are those madmen of the Eternal God Church thinking all day long?” Mikus frowned slightly, then asked solemnly, “What are the others doing?” “The others haven’t exhibited anything unusual; they followed your orders and hunted mutated creatures and devoured Essence Blood to recover from their injuries within a range of tens of kilometers.”
Mikus nodded slightly, “I see. You may leave.”
After the Shadow God Sect follower had left, Mikus looked at the ’dried-up’ corpse of the Mutated Beast in front of him, and the armor on his left arm slowly cracked open.
Subsequently, Mikus took a deep breath, and his right fingertips tore through his left arm like a sharp blade, digging out a mass of wriggling black flesh with dense roots from his blood and flesh.
Ah! As the black flesh was pulled out, a piercing, ear-splitting spiritual scream erupted.
Hiss!
An invisible spiritual impact made even Mikus’s face turn pale. Enduring the headache, he decisively threw the black flesh onto the wound of the Mutated Beast’s corpse.
Upon smelling the somewhat rotten stench of the flesh, the black flesh soon squirmed like a living thing, quickly burrowing deep into the corpse of the Mutated Beast.
Bam!
The corpse of the long-dead Mutated Beast suddenly convulsed, as its body continued to tremble and struggle with growing intensity.
Glancing at the now-reactive Mutated Beast’s corpse after a successful parasitic takeover, Mikus’s eyes revealed a hint of disgust, and he vanished into the mist..

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 177: God’s Reward, Life Crystals
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 177: God’s Reward, Life Crystals
Everywhere (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
In the morning, outside the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
The scale armor of these Level 4 Mutated Beasts were shattered, covered in wound after wound. Scorching hot blood kept flowing out of the deep wounds, staining the surrounding ground red.
At the same time, the trees had fallen, and the ground was broken, having just experienced a fierce battle.
At this moment, Crystal and Mandy Leinster were sitting cross-legged in the middle of the battlefield, each holding a Blue Crystal containing high-purity energy in their hands.
As their True Strength circulated and continuously absorbed the high-purity energy within the crystals, the sisters’ auras became more and more majestic. Suddenly, there was an outburst of breakthrough energy.
Whoo!
A strong wind enveloped the sisters, their hair blowing in the wind, as they broke through to the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven.
Not far away in the shade of the trees, Betty Leinster smiled with her arms folded, “Little Sue and the others have finally broken through the late-stage Third Layer Heaven.”
“Next is to continue working hard and break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven early.”
Envious expressions appeared on the faces of the well-built third-grade female students, “To break through to the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven in the next semester of the first grade. They will definitely break through the Fourth Layer within a year.”
“This talent is enough to enter the top three in our class.”
Betty Leinster shook her head, “It’s not just talent. During this period, Little Sue and the others have been working very hard, fighting with Level 4 mutated creatures every day to squeeze out their potential.”
“Every time they fight, they seize the time to absorb resources and cultivate, so their progress is so fast.”
At this point, gratitude appeared on Betty Leinster’s face, “Julie, thank you for staying with me these days, accompanying me to patrol the perimeter of the mountain range.”
Wang Julie, a well-built woman, shook her head, “Amei, it’s not worth mentioning it. We have been friends for many years, your business is our business.”
Luo Ling also nodded slightly, “Just think of it as us relaxing.”
“But what Julie said is correct, the talent of Little Sue and the others is indeed very good; otherwise, no matter how much they fight, they wouldn’t be able to absorb and transform resources into cultivation.”
“It’s a pity that there are so many monsters in their class. Even Little Sue and the others seem a bit dim.”
“Indeed, just our South Sky Martial Height now has several breaks through the Fourth Layer Heaven, and compared to the three years we have been cultivating, we are in the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven.”
“It always feels like we won’t be able to wait for graduation, and our old guys will be surpassed.”
“How is that possible? The Late Fourth Layer Heaven requires willpower to be tempered. At this stage, enlightenment is what matters. Relying on resources can no longer accelerate the progress.”
“You just have to play your part,”
“So, Julie, rest assured that even if they are monsters, they need to take it step by step.”
“Even that Carol Koch from the second grade, who is said to have no less talent than the King Walton of a few years ago, has been grinding away at the Fourth Layer Heaven for so long before breaking through to the Fifth Layer Heaven.”
At the same time as the Leinster sisters broke through, Jack Clark once again came to the edge of the Nine Rings Mountain Range.
In the distance, the sun rose high in the sky, and a golden light beam pierced through heaven and earth amidst the clouds and mist, just falling on the mountain cliff where Jack Clark was standing, enveloping him.
Under the golden sunlight, the dark red crystal armor shone with dazzling brilliance, making Jack look like a deity.
Just at this moment, a team walked out of the forest below.
The team had three men and two women. Two of the men carried a Mutated Beast corpse, about twenty-nine feet long, with a terrifying aura estimated to be at the early stage of Level 6.
As soon as the team walked out of the forest, they saw the figure on the cliff bathed in the golden light beam and couldn’t help but pause. One of them even blurted out,
“What the hell? What’s going on?”
Jack Clark also saw the team below and twitched the corner of his mouth, thinking, “What is this? Even the heavens want me to put on a facade?”
He had just jumped to this old place, and a golden light beam emerged from the distant sky, and he couldn’t even dodge it.
While Jack was feeling emotional, sudden warmth appeared within his body, and the strength of his muscles and bones increased at a noticeable pace wherever it went.
Jack’s mouth curled up slightly.
Because this substantial strengthening had already occurred three times since last night.
With the Thunderflame Beheamoth constantly devouring, absorbing growth crystal stones, and digesting the flesh and blood of the ancient giant crocodile beast, it also provided feedback for the body while obtaining its growth.
This time, its Four Major Attributes had grown by about 40 points.
At present, the highest strength attribute had reached 1200 points, and the physique had exceeded 1100, pushing Jack’s basic arm strength to a level of thirty tons.
With his current strength, he didn’t even need to use any True Strength, and he could casually grab a bus as a toy to smash.
Not to mention the ‘true’ ability of dragon-type creatures.
It can be said that the ‘true’ characteristic he obtained when breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven was the most suitable for Jack, allowing him to maximize his increasingly terrifying physical advantage.
While Jack was feeling emotional, the sunlight dispersed, and the team of five came up to the mountain along the ridge.
Jack could not help calling out from a distance, “What a coincidence, our seniors, we meet again.”
Huh!
Surprise showed on the faces of the team of five. They looked at each other and then at Jack not far away. The young man at the front was also taken aback, “It’s you.”
Compared to more than a week ago, Jack’s ordinary battle armor had been replaced by a dark red, Gorgeous Crystal Armor.
So when they met again, Carol Koch and the others did not recognize this calm-breathing ‘senior’ until Jack took the initiative to speak.
“I didn’t expect that just a few days later, we would meet here again. It seems we are destined.”
Carol Koch smiled, “Let me introduce myself, Carol Koch from the South Sky Martial Height. May I ask your name and which Martial Height you are from?”
“Carol Koch!”

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 177: God’s Reward, Life Crystals Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 177: God’s Reward, Life Crystals Everywhere (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark’s gaze flickered slightly, not expecting that the young man he had encountered twice before, who gave him a strong feeling, was actually that monster who had suppressed all the second-grade students in the Southern Region’s Variant Beast Battlefield.
In surprise, the armor on Jack’s face cracked open, retracting to both sides and forming decorations like feathered horns, exposing his handsome face.
“I didn’t expect it to be Senior Keller. I am also a student at South Sky Martial Height, but only in the First Grade. You can call me Jack Clark.”
Cicely Raven, dressed in red battle armor, was surprised: “Jack Clark, the name seems familiar?”
Bruce Raven, a burly figure, said in a deep voice: “Ranked sixth in the First Grade, the genius who was the first in our school to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven, Mr. Faris mentioned it a few days ago.”
“So it’s Junior Clark.”
Everyone suddenly realized and looked at Jack Clark with much friendlier expressions.
Although they were in the same Martial Height Base, there were separate circles for the cultivation students of the first, second, and third grades, and they generally did not have much contact with each other.
Moreover, Jack had never met Carol Koch and the others in the school since most of his time was spent wandering around the mountain ranges.
After exchanging greetings, both sides only chatted briefly before Carol and the others continued on their way.
As they reached the foot of the mountain, Cicely suddenly said: “Do you have a feeling that Junior Clark is much stronger than he was a little over a week ago?”
Speaking of this, Bruce Raven and the others nodded their heads with serious expressions.
They had noticed it early on.
After the previous night’s battle, with the condensation of Jack’s undefeatable war intent, even if he restrained his breath, the invisible aura emanating from him would still make people feel like they couldn’t look directly at him.
Carol chuckled: “As the strongest genius of the new era, it’s normal for our junior to improve his strength quickly, just like the Junior Aiken we met a couple of days ago.”
Hearing Carol mention this, the other four couldn’t help but think of the figure sitting on the edge of the cliff with the Sword Intent soaring into the sky. They couldn’t help but smile bitterly and wonder why there seemed to be more and more insane people around them.
After Carol and the others left, Jack also made several flashes and rushed into the opposite mountain range. However, after entering the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, his speed instantly slowed down.
There was no choice. This was, after all, the Cloud IVlist Mountain Range.
Not to mention the mutated creatures and the possible Space Cracks, the clouds and mist could also not be underestimated.
Some of these clouds and mist were composed of water vapor, while others were the unique smog of the area, resistant to wind and blocking visibility. Many times, it seemed they could only see a few meters ahead.
In such a situation, running too fast could result in accidentally running into a cliff, which might also injure Jack.
This time, Denny Lockwood gave Jack the coordinates on the other side of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. He needed to enter another small mountain range hundreds of kilometers away along the outer edge.
However, when Jack arrived here, he found that this mountain range was different from the others.
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
As the black and red halberd skill swept through the air, hundreds of poison bees the size of human heads exploded within a ten-meter radius. The liquid from their bodies splashed all over the sky, mixed with broken limbs and falling to the ground.
With a sigh, Jack looked at the debris of the poison bee corpses strewn on the ground and frowned slightly.
There were too many poisonous insects and snakes in this mountain range. In addition, there was colored miasma in many places, and Jack even felt danger from some of the black miasma.
Buzz!
Accompanied by the light from the blue and red patterns on the Flame Crystal Armor, a scorching aura instantly enveloped Jack. All the gases that came into contact with him were filtered by the high temperature.
When the air passed through the breathing system and entered the mask, it was purified again by the Wind Spirit Power, and the previously somewhat dull air immediately became clearer.
Following the coordinates, Jack continued on his way, and by the time he arrived at the end of the mountain range, the sky had already darkened. He had covered about 1,200 kilometers in a day.
As before, Jack found a hundrcd-meter-tall tree, jumped up to a branch several dozen meters high, and dug out a tree hole as his resting place.
As the skies turned completely dark, this mountain range came to life.
There were crawling, flying, and fluttering sounds everywhere in the woods, including the vicinity of the tree where Jack was. He could hear the rustling noises of countless insects crawling around.
There were no fierce Mutated Beasts roaring, no wailing, just silent hunting and devouring.
There were centipedes over one meter long, toads the size of a washbasin with pustules all over their backs, and mantises half a meter tall with sharp, curved arms that flew through the branches like knives.
This mountain range was terrifyingly teeming with insects, almost all of which showed mutations. Some even reached Level 1, becoming true Mutated
Creatures.
Most of the insects in the outside world were still in their normal state, in contrast to the Variant Beast Battlefield, where it was almost impossible to see normal species from the old era.
However, these insects were only disgusting to look at and posed no threat to Jack.
After slapping and killing more than a dozen mutated creatures that had climbed up, a night passed. In the morning, Jack ate some dried meat, drank some hot water heated by the battle armor, and set off once again.
Traversing mountains and valleys, crossing mountain streams and canyons, Jack finally arrived near the coordinates after killing hundreds of poisonous insects and Mutated Creatures along the way.
Standing on the edge of a cliff several hundred meters high, Jack looked around for landmarks, and soon his gaze landed on a spot about ten kilometers to the left.
“It should be there, where the red mist is swirling between the two mountain peaks.”
Jack then jumped directly off the cliff.
Due to the prominent landmark this time, Jack arrived at the Twisted Secret Realm within a few minutes.
Here, the earth cracked open to form a canyon-like crack stretching tens of meters long and unknown distance. The gorge was filled with humidity, creating a dense red mist..

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 177: Heavenly Rewards Everywhere,
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 177: Heavenly Rewards Everywhere,
Life Crystals Everywhere (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
Translator: 549690339
These red fogs were so dense that Jack Clark could only see about ten meters ahead, and there were obvious traces of space distortion surrounding him, with violent Heavenly Energy.
Besides that, Jack began feeling uncomfortable as soon as he approached this place.
In the depths of the canyon, invisible infrasound waves spread out, making living beings inherently uncomfortable, so there were hardly any signs of life nearby.
No wonder Denny Lockwood didn’t dare to enter after confirming this place was a Twisted Secret Realm which likely contained Heaven and Earth Treasures.
“I don’t know what Cultivation Methods he practiced. He actually managed to come deep into the mountains and sensed the danger inside but didn’t go in.”
As Jack pondered, his figure disappeared into the red fog.
After entering the canyon’s cracks, Jack found that the terrain was sinking, and as he went deeper, a heatwave carried by thick red fog kept surging.
At the same time, the intensity of the invisible infrasound waves also increased.
Just then, a flash of red light came from the side and a red figure burst out at an astonishing speed, only to be caught by Jack in an instant.
It was a six-meter long mutated Red Python with red scales all over its body, and its head was ferocious, with a bulky body as tough as steel bars.
After being caught by Jack, it writhed wildly, bursting out with tremendous strength.
“There are actually Mutated Creatures here.” Surprised, Jack squeezed it casually, and in an instant, half of the python’s body exploded, with flesh and blood scattering all around.
Among the remains was a thumb-sized Small White Crystal.
This unexpected gain put Jack in a good mood, and he couldn’t help but bend down to pick it up. Although it was only a Level 1 Crystal, it was still a good thing for him.
Smack!
Next, Jack walked just a few meters downhill when he swiftly reached out with his right hand and grabbed an incoming red python, exerting a little force in his hand.
Boom! As the flesh and blood exploded, another white crystal fell to the ground.
“Are all these red pythons Level 1 Peak?!” Jack picked up the Life Crystal in surprise, then continued walking with anticipation.
Boom boom boom!!
Jack went on a killing spree and encountered many more Red Pythons, all of which he killed by crushing them in his hand.
Most importantly, these red pythons were all Level 1 Peak, and almost every one of them contributed a Life Crystal to him, quickly accumulating more than twenty crystals in his hands.
This drop rate excited Jack, as he had never encountered such ‘good luck’ before.
However, as he continued deeper underground, the invisible shocking force became increasingly powerful, making even Jack’s physical body feel uncomfortable.
On the other hand, those mutated Red Pythons, seemingly due to their long-term life here, appeared to be unaffected.
As Jack went deeper underground, the terrain became narrower, and the poisonous red gas flowed through the caves, causing the air temperature to reach over too degrees Celsius.
Boom boom boom!!
After going a thousand meters underground, the air temperature even soared to over 200 degrees Celsius, and the surrounding rocks were faintly emitting red light.
At the same time, the Level 1 Red Pythons had almost disappeared, or perhaps had been exterminated by him, leaving him with thirty-eight Level 1 Life Crystals from the journey down.
The harvest of the Life Crystals alone was nearly equivalent to two hundred contribution points, making Jack excited in such a situation.
Could it be because of the good luck he had when entering the mountain? Jack subconsciously recalled the scene at the edge of the Nine Rings Mountain Range.
Could it be due to the ‘light’ from the heavens that his luck was so good this time, killing small creatures guaranteed a 100% drop rate?
As Jack pondered, the terrain ahead suddenly widened, revealing a giant cliff not far away, and beneath it, there was blazing gas and red light.
As Jack reached the edge of the cliff, he saw a Lava River burning with flames several hundred meters below, winding along and disappearing into the darkness in the distance.
A Flood Dragon covered in flames was entrenched in the rolling Lava Lake, emitting a terrifying breath.
The invisible infrasound waves originated from the lake beneath the Flood Dragon, shaking the entire underground space, and the air here even emitted a buzzing sound..

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 178: The Endless Purgatory, First Death in the Sixth-level Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 178: The Endless Purgatory, First Death in the Sixth-level Heaven
Translator: 549690339
Deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, more than 3000 kilometers in, on a mountainside.
Boom!
A five-meter-long red knife Qi exploded, causing the ground to collapse. It tore a massive crack, ten meters long and half a meter wide, in the earth like a real knife.
Boom!
The red blade light surged again in the sky filled with dust, shattering the surrounding grass and trees within tens of meters. The rampant Sword Qi forced the white figure to retreat dozens of feet.
In the violent wind, the burly Ethan Polis held a two-meter-long combat knife, his eyes filled with anger, as he stared at the white-robed young man on a branch dozens of meters away.
“Classmate, we don’t have any grievances or hatred, so it’s rather despicable for you suddenly to attack me out of the blue, don’t you think?”
Ethan Polis was full of anger in his heart. After all, anyone would be angry if they were suddenly attacked while cultivating.
At this moment, his body was shrouded with bluish scale armor, emitting a halo. The boiling True Strength outside his body compressed the surrounding air into a violent wind, creating a formidable aura.
The white-robed youth stood leisurely on the branch with his hands behind his back, responding indifferently, “First, I’m not your classmate. Second, I attacked you face-to-face, so it’s not a sneak attack.”
“You’re not a classmate… Are you a member of the military?” asked Ethan Polis, a frown on his brow.
Due to the unique circumstances of the Alien Beast Battlefield, it took him a while to ponder the identity of the outsider.
Moreover, Ilisa Wesley appeared to be between eighteen and nineteen years old, quite young. Consequently, Ethan Polis nearly mistook him for a student from another Martial Height.
Ilisa Wesley replied indifferently, “Identity isn’t important. The fact that you’ve achieved the Peak of the Fifth Layer of Heaven at this age shows your talent is not bad. Take this move.”
Boom!
Before Ethan Polis had even spoken, a bright sun illusion appeared in Ilisa Wesley’s eyes. With his terrifying Fully-formed Will, the sky changed in color in an instant, and behind him manifested a round sun.
Ethan Polis exclaimed in astonishment, “Fully-formed Will illuminating the Heaven and Earth… How is this possible!”
Boom!
As Ilisa Wesley slapped his palm out, the Heavenly Energy within tens of meters exploded, creating a booming wave that formed a burning empty sun.
As the scorching light passed by, the trees instantly turned into flying ashes, as if the annihilating sun had come to destroy all life on earth.
Ethan Polis roared angrily, a surge of enormous will erupting from his body. With shining cyan and gold light, a huge tiger formed behind him.
However, compared to Ilisa Wesley’s Fully-formed Will, Ethan Polis’s gigantic tiger, formed from a fusion of will and True Strength, was merely an illusion.
The White Tiger roared and carried the Knife Qi in its mouth, growing to more than twenty meters in size. It charged toward the sun like a sixth-level Hegemony Tiger, attempting to tear the sky apart.
Boom! The white tiger was instantly engulfed by the sun, and as it dissipated, a violent wind swept through the range of tens of meters around it.
The sun that had swallowed the white tiger rushed down from the sky, engulfing Ethan Polis, who was charging up with his knife held high.
Boom!
The Heaven and Earth trembled as the ground broke apart, and a large swath of trees collapsed in all directions under the impact of the sun’s fiery explosion. Smoke and dust spread everywhere.
When the dust finally settled, a huge empty area appeared in the middle of the forest.
This area featured a crater with a diameter of twenty meters, surrounded by numerous circular gears.
At the bottom of the pit, the light from Ethan Polis’ battle armor had dimmed, and many gear-like cracks appeared on the tough armor, as if it had met countless sharp gears.
Even the battle armor on his arms was in tatters, revealing his bloodied limbs.
In addition, more than half of the armor on his face had shattered, revealing half of his face smeared with blood and revealing disbelief.
As the first student of the Southern Battlefield and the first on the Achievement List, how could he be defeated by a young man with Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven in a single move!?!
“I originally thought a genius worthy of my shot had appeared amongst the Human Race, but it turns out they’re so weak,” said the white-robed youth as he slowly retracted his palm, looking somewhat bored.
“Achieving the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven at the age of eighteen, your talent is already considered exceptional. Yet, you foolishly hoped to comprehend the Tiger Hegemon’s intent and break through by borrowing the battle armor made from Tiger Hegemon scale armor and a weapon forged from tiger bones.”
“Ultimately, things outside of yourself can only help so much. Even if you temper the battle armor and weapon three rounds ahead of time, what grows stronger will always be the armor and weapons, not your own will.”
“In order to manifest your will and break through the sixth level, you need to have an absolute belief of being unparalleled. You are a human, after all, not a Hegemony Tiger!”
As the indifferent voice faded away, the white-robed youth disappeared, leaving an injured and weakened Ethan Polis standing there.
“The absolute belief in being unparalleled… I am human, not a Hegemony Tiger…”
“So, I’ve been on the wrong path all this time.”
As he whispered, a powerful will surged within Ethan Polis’s body, faintly forming a colossal White Tiger. The Tiger’s imposing aura was immense.
Moreover, a green flame suddenly ignited on his body.
“Hahaha… I broke through! I broke through!” Despite his severe injuries and weakness, Ethan Polis let out delighted laughter.
Because he was the first in the Southern Region to break through to the Sixth Layer and did so by manifesting his will.
Although he was defeated today, this would not affect his future fame throughout the Southern Battlefield.
But at that moment, a pitch-black sharp blade appeared silently behind Ethan Polis. The breath on the blade was dark and obscure, seeming to come from the past and the future simultaneously.
Thump!
The blade silently pierced through the battle armor, and the smile on Ethan Polis’s face froze as he stared in disbelief at the blade’s tip protruding from his chest.
With a whoosh, black flames engulfed the blade. As the fire flickered, Ethan Polis’s True Strength, spirit, and will began to dissipate at a horrifying rate.
Thump! Ethan Polis’s emaciated corpse lay on the ground.
Only then did a puddle of black shadows slowly rise from the ground, followed by a figure shrouded in a black robe. From under the mask, a hoarse voice emerged..

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 178 Endless Purgatory, the First Death of the Sixth Layer Heaven_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 178 Endless Purgatory, the First Death of the Sixth Layer Heaven_2
Translator: 549690339
“All Federation people must die.”
With a cold gaze at Ethan Polis’ corpse, the shadowy figure flickered and appeared in the nearby forest, then disappeared silently into the darkness.
Just as the shadow left the mountain forest, a surge of violent and scorching power descended from the sky above.
Boom!
The earth shattered under the destructive black-red shockwave, raging wind howled, and the force swept away all the trees within a range of more than twenty meters.
In the midst of the howling wind, two figures, one black and one white, separated and landed tens of meters away.
The one wearing snow-white clothes was Ilisa Wesley, who had left only a short time ago.
The other figure was shrouded in black robes; with an eerie black power flowing around like a void, it seemed as if it could disappear at any moment.
Ilisa looked at the bundle of shadows and said indifferently, “Shadow God Sect’s lurking member, haven’t you followed me long enough?”
A hoarse voice came from underneath the black robes, “My Void Shadow has reached its grand accomplishment, I can blend into the surrounding shadows and shield all my breaths. How did you find me?”
Ilisa said indifferently, “Do you think I would tell someone who’s been sneaking behind me for days how I found them?”
Cooper, shrouded in black robes, fell silent for a moment, feeling that his question was somewhat foolish.
“Ilisa, aren’t you a member of the Divine Sect Alliance? Why didn’t you kill that Federal Genius earlier? And, what are you looking for here?”
Instantly after Cooper finished speaking, an invisible cold chill enveloped him.
Ilisa said indifferently, “Sometimes knowing too much can get you killed.”
Boom!
Feeling Ilisa’s killing intent, Cooper’s aura exploded to the Peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven; black power surged like leaping flames, and his figure retreated explosively.
His speed was so fast that it almost reached the supersonic speed of 400 meters per second; he vanished like a black line cutting through space.
But at this moment, with a round moon appearing behind her, Ilisa’s figure disappeared in an instant, appearing like a reflection in front of Cooper.
The round sun appeared in the sky simultaneously.
Boom boom boom!
The mountain forest collapsed, and the trees exploded.
Soon, amidst the fire and smoke filling the forest, Ilisa held a head with unyielding eyes, her gaze calm as she looked deep into the mountain ranges.
As she casually threw away the head in her hand, her figure vanished deep into the forest, with a faint voice echoing, “How dare you stalk me, looking for death. Next time I meet you, I will kill you.”
More than a thousand meters underground, the humming subsonic waves in the air made Jack Clark uncomfortable, but still within the acceptable range.
The scorching lava river flowed below the cliff, and the dancing firelight illuminated the deep red of the dim underground.
In the lava lake at the source of the small river, a Flood Dragon with a body as thick as a water tank, spanning twenty-seven meters, coiled and swallowed scorching materials.
