This Flood Dragon, like those red pythons, had a round body covered with red scale armor that emitted a metallic luster, and a head similar to a dragon with protruding bones and horns.
This scene was somewhat similar to when the Sword Armor Beast encountered mutated red eels under the sea crevice.
After awakening the fire talent similar to those Mutated Creatures, they gained the ability to absorb scorching energy and no longer needed to rely on hunting to grow.
Moreover, even the bodies of those Level 1 Red Pythons were as hard as iron, the flesh of this Level 5 Peak Serpent would be more terrifying, especially since it was in the lava lake.
In this situation, even an entire team of Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivators might not return unharmed.
However, this wasn’t an issue for Jack Clark.
Standing on the edge of the cliff with his War Halberd, Jack took a deep breath of the scorching air. In an instant, the overpowering Dragon Elephant True Strength within his body erupted.
Boom!
The void trembled, black-red radiance flickered, and the air around Jack exploded, forming circles of white waves that blew outwards.
Most importantly, the irresistible killing intent of the surging tide, instantly made the serpent below raise its head, its scales erupting, and flames burning.
Roar! The Flood Dragon stared at Jack on the cliff, who had intruded into its territory, and let out a roar like a tiger.
At that moment, flickers of black-red light shone high in the sky, and a two-meter-long halberd skill emerged from the black-gold Battle Halberd, like a meteor descending from the heavens.
Roar!
The Flood Dragon coiled in the Lava Lake roared brutally, opening its mouth wide, and firelight danced within. In an instant, a flame soared sky-high, covering a range of tens of meters.
As a Level 5 Peak Fire Mutated Creature, this Flood Dragon even possessed breathing ability.
However, its breathing ability was more like spewing fire, with flames only reaching a thousand Celsius as they scattered without any shockwave containment.
Boom!
The halberd swept across the sky, and the overbearing halberd skill tore through the sea of fire, striking the Flood Dragon’s head without losing momentum, causing black-red radiance to explode in an instant.
Boom!
Under the ferocious, overbearing attack, the scale armor on the serpent’s head burst, flesh and blood splattered, while the heavy force smashed the serpent’s head into the Lava Lake.
Boom! A large amount of raging magma flames soared into the sky, with many even splashing onto Jack who had them blocked by the True Strength circulating outside his body.
At the same time, taking advantage of the counter-shock force, Jack’s figure flew back, landing at the edge of the Lava Lake tens of meters away, the heavy battle boots crushing the volcanic rock with a clang.
Roar, roar, roar!
The Lava Lake exploded, and the bloody Flood Dragon raised its head and roared angrily. Its huge body formed an S shape as it pounced towards Jack in an instant, stirring up rolling scorching magma..

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 178: Endless Purgatory, the First
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 178: Endless Purgatory, the First
Death of the Sixth Layer Heaven_3
Translator: 549690339
Boom!!
Flames and magma merged, creating a 10-meter high fiery tsunami rolling towards Jack Clark on the shore. The soaring Flame Dragon in the scorching sea of fire had an astonishing momentum.
Bang!
Jack Clark’s aura surged, and the two-ton battle halberd swept around him as the center. Instantly, a 4-meter high black-red halo collided with the magma sea of fire.
Clank! The sky’s magma ignited, and a golden-black Battle Halberd whistled through the air at a terrifying supersonic speed, detonating and cutting through the air.
Boom!! Amidst the vast magma flames, Jack Clark blasted a Level 5 Peak Serpent, sending its massive body weighing tens of tons smashing onto a nearby cliff’s mountain wall.
Instantly, massive rocks collapsed, and smoke and dust filled the air.
Just then, Jack Clark leaped high again. A terrifying aura, like a demon or a god, burst from his body, changing the color of Heaven and Earth while a large black-red radiance enveloped him and descended from the sky.
Roar!
Amidst the violent roar, the smoke and dust below suddenly dispersed, and the bloodied half of the serpent’s body soared into the sky. Its open, ferocious mouth pounced on Jack Clark, who was falling from the sky.
Around him, flames burned to form a gigantic flame-head, exuding a swallowing, earth-devouring aura.
Bang! In mid-air, black and red flames exploded, forming a circle of substantial shockwaves sweeping dozens of meters. Immediately after, a massive body descended from the sky.
The twenty-somcthing-meter-long serpent landed on the ground, shaking it. Collapsing with its head, torrents of scorching blood oozed out, quickly painting the ground red and igniting flames on it.
Thud! His heavy battle boots landed on the ground. Jack slowly exhaled, suppressing his boiling Qi Blood and True Strength within.
With his current strength, even without activating the Elephant’s Fury Rune, he needed to give it his all to swiftly slay this Level 5 Peak Unique Beast.
Fortunately, this beast wasn’t very intelligent. It was lured on land after just one probing attack.
Otherwise, it would have been troublesome if it were still lurking in the lava lake.
Having killed the Mutated Beast, it was time to deal with the corpse, especially the high-value Life Crystal that was likely inside the serpent’s body.
Squeak! Squeak! Squeak!!
With the halberd’s skill, it struggled to slice open the serpent’s scale armor at a position slightly below its head, tearing a two-mcter-long crack. Immediately, large amounts of blood burning with flames spewed out.
Waiting until the blood flow had nearly stopped, Jack then reached in and quickly pulled out a fist-sized red crystal.
Instantly, a smile appeared on Jack’s face as he thought to himself: “Convert attribute points.”
“You converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal and obtained 159 Attribute Points.”
Suddenly, including the previous harvest, the attribute points on the page soared to 418, causing Jack to take a deep breath.
Looking at the over 400 Attribute Points on the page, Jack frowned slightly.
The Sixth Layer of Dragon Elephant Overlord Body required not only 300 Attribute Points but also a bottle of High Order Dragon Blood.
Now he had 265 Contribution Points, enough even after deducting the 50 left for Denny Lockwood.
Not to mention the relatively intact corpse of the serpent at his feet, which was estimated to be worth 150 points. When he returned, he would be able to break through to the Sixth Layer and condense the Tyrant Body.
So… Jack’s voice echoed in his mind, “Consume too Attribute Points, strengthen the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd to Great Accomplishment.”
Accompanied by the disappearance of 100 Attribute Points, Jack’s consciousness roared instantly, bringing him to a world of shattered earth and flaming Infernal Purgatory.
In the void, a battle halberd burning with black flames descended from the sky, striking Jack’s consciousness, instantly exploding with numerous profound pieces of information.
As Jack fell into the state of halberd technique epiphany, a sharp force suddenly emerged from his body.
This force first followed the paths of Sweeping the Eight Wastes and Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, and then combined the two moves to establish a third, more complex path.
Underneath the battle armor, a red rune covering Jack’s arms, chest, and back slowly appeared on his skin, resembling a broken world.
Cultivators at the Sixth Layer who ignited True Force Flame would generally practice Advanced Combat Skills to the Great Realm level.
Even some geniuses in the Fifth Layer had practiced their combat skills to the Great Realm and many had comprehended Sword Intent and Knife Intent.
Compared to those experts cultivating for many years in the Sixth Layer or those geniuses with extraordinary enlightenment and profound foundation, Jack was at a disadvantage in this aspect.
Nevermind, if enlightenment failed, Attribute Points could make up for it.
Half an hour later, Jack suddenly opened his eyes. A terrifyingly fierce, demonic aura erupted from his body, and black-red radiance gathered on the halberd.
Whistle!! Accompanied by the wailing of ghosts, an eight-meter-long black-red battle halberd burst out, forming a black vacuum pathway in the air and striking the cliff-side mountain wall.
Boom!
At that instant, the earth cracked and half of the mountain wall collapsed under the black-red halberd skill. Numerous broken rocks scattered like cannonballs in all directions.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! Large waves of magma splashed in the lake, and smoke and dust filled the air. The rumbling vibrations echoed underground incessantly.
After the smoke and dust cleared, there was a 20-meter diameter deep pit on the mountain wall, surrounded by cracks like a broken miniature world.
The Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd’s grand accomplishment killing move: Infernal Purgatory! With a single halberd strike, the earth sank.
Of course, the description in the Cultivation Method was quite exaggerated. In actuality, it was a powerful long-range attack similar to an enhanced Ghost Wailing Divine Howl.
With a unique operating path, True Strength is converted into a spiral halberd skill. When compressed dozens of times and then exploded out, it bursts in a spiral manner upon contact with the target.
Under these circumstances, coupled with the explosive characteristics of Dragon Elephant True Strength, its power is increased even further.
It’s just that it consumes quite a bit of True Strength.
And that resource… Jack looked at the slightly shaking center of the Magma Lava Lake with furrowed brows. He didn’t expect that thing to be under the magma lake.
With his current strength, his True Strength Protection could resist ordinary magma. However, if he were to venture deep under the magma lake, his True Strength would not be enough.
If it were to run out, it would be troublesome since his body still belonged to the realm of flesh and blood..

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 179: Overwhelming the South, Essence Blood of Eight-Level Giant Beast Golden Winged Scaled Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 179: Overwhelming the South, Essence Blood of Eight-Level Giant Beast Golden Winged Scaled Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
Two days later, Jack Clark dragged the colossal corpse of the Dragon Python back to school.
“Mr. Hawkins, please help me calculate this.”
“Here it is.”
Boom!
The heavy corpse, over twenty meters long, fell to the ground, causing the ground to shake slightly. The intense heat from the python’s body still lingered in the air.
The Level 5 Peak aura of the python made the surrounding “senior” students who were helping to carry the corpse rather solemn.
One of the second-grade students in the initial stage of the Third Layer couldn’t help but exclaim, “Another Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast! Junior Clark’s combat strength is too terrifying.”
“I feel that with your current strength, you can challenge the top 200 on the Achievement List.”
Jack Clark smiled and modestly replied, “No way, Senior, you’re giving me too much credit. This time, I narrowly defeated the Scale Horn Dragon Python and almost didn’t make it back.”
“As for the top 200 on the Achievement List, those seniors are all at least in the middle or late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and their strength is incredible. I’m still lacking in comparison.”
“Junior Clark, you’re good at everything, but you’re too modest.”
Since Jack Clark was mostly alone when he came here and had brought back not only a powerful Mutated Beast but also many others, these seniors had come to know him well.
At this moment, Koi Hawk had also completed his examination and laughed, “Junior Clark, this Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast corpse is intact, and the Logistics System recommends a price of 150 Contribution Points. Do you have any objections?”
“No objections,” Jack nodded. He hadn’t activated a rune burst this time to keep the corpse intact.
Furthermore, since he already had enough Contribution Points, he had sprinkled some powder to conceal the smell of the Mutated Beast corpse when he returned, allowing him to return quickly.
“Since there are no issues, I have transferred the Contribution Points to you.”
Instantly, Jack Clark had accumulated 415 Contribution Points.
After leaving the warehouse, Jack Clark returned to his room to take a bath and clean his battle armor.
Once he was dressed and had dried his hair, there was a knock on the door.
“This guy is really well-informed.”
Jack knew without thinking that it was Denny Lockwood knocking on the door.
Sure enough, he found Denny Lockwood standing outside the door, grinning, “Congratulations on your successful return.”
“Not really, it’s all because of your accurate information Senior. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have found that place so easily. It’s a pity, though, I discovered resources but couldn’t bring them back.”
“Oh, why not?” Denny Lockwood was a little surprised.
Jack shook his head, “Because it’s underneath a deep volcanic lava lake. I killed the Flame Python guarding it, but I couldn’t get it out.”
Jack didn’t lie to him this time, as he truly couldn’t bring up that incredibly deep object.
Denny Lockwood looked regretful, “What a pity.”
“But don’t worry, I’ll give you the remaining balance you deserve. Even though I didn’t get that unknown resource, my harvest this time was still quite good.”
It was all a matter of luck – last time, Denny Lockwood’s information was a mere suspicion about resources, and Jack got lucky, obtaining an additional Crystal. Conversely, this time, despite Denny Lockwood’s 100% guarantee of resources, Jack couldn’t bring them back.
Denny Lockwood nodded with a smile, “That’s true. The corpse of the Level 5 Peak Mutant Beast alone, along with its Life Crystal, is worth quite a few Contribution Points.”
Jack raised an eyebrow, wondering how this guy knew so quickly that he had killed a Level 5 Peak Mutated Beast – did he have informant in the Logistics Warehouse as well?
After transferring the remaining balance of 50 Contribution Points to Denny Lockwood, Jack asked, “Any new information after these days, Senior?”
Jack was satisfied with the information from this well-informed guy after cooperating twice and saved him a lot of time searching for resources, even if it meant sharing some of the profits.
However, this time Denny Lockwood shook his head awkwardly, “Not this time, Junior. My strength is still at the Fourth Layer Heaven. Although the Secret Skill for concealing my aura is strong, I still dare not venture too far into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.”
“Otherwise, if I were discovered by a Level 6 Mutated Creature, I’d be dead for sure.”
Upon hearing this, Jack became curious, “Which one of the school’s two Secret Skills for concealing aura did you practice, Hidden Deity or Wind Shadow Traceless?”
Denny Lockwood didn’t hesitate to answer, rather proudly, “I’ve practiced Wind Shadow Traceless, and I’ve reached the Great Realm.”
“Impressive, I didn’t think Senior could practice one Secret Skill to such a high level. No wonder you can move in and out of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range so easily,” Jack remarked with admiration.
The core of Wind Shadow Traceless was to increase the cultivator’s speed significantly to glide like the wind, while the aura concealment was secondary. However, its aura-concealing effects were still very powerful.
Denny Lockwood laughed, “Not at all, my strength is no match for Junior’s powerful and overbearing Dragon Elephant Tyrant Body.”
The two chatted a bit more, with Jack asking this well-informed guy for information about the base, before Denny Lockwood left.
After seeing Denny Lockwood off, Jack headed to the Logistics Department to exchange for High-order Dragon Blood to break through the Sixth Layer of the Dragon Elephant Tyrant Body.
However, when it was his turn in line, the staff member behind the counter apologized, “I’m sorry, we are currently out of high-order Dragon Blood.” “Out of stock?” Jack was surprised.
The staff nodded, “Yes, this type of resource is typically used by high-level cultivators, so there isn’t much in stock at the school and the Alien Beast Battlefield Base.”
“The last bottle in stock was exchanged by you a few days ago, and we haven’t had time to restock.”
Jack was speechless, “When will you have more in stock?”
“The normal replenishment cycle is once a month, and there are still ten days left until the next mobilization of supplies.” With that, the staff member glanced at the backend information Jack had logged into..

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 179: Overwhelming the South,
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 179: Overwhelming the South,
Essence Blood of Eight-Level Giant Beast Golden Winged Scaled Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets) !
Translator: 549690339
“However, since you have a high level of authority, if it’s urgent, I can help you expedite the application in the background. It should be delivered in about two days.”
Two days, that’s fine. Please help me apply.” Hearing that he only needed to wait for two days, Jack Clark breathed a sigh of relief.
“Alright, but Student Clark, this kind of application requires payment of
Contribution Points first…”
Just deduct it.
Jack nodded and directly deducted 210 contribution points before walking out of the Logistics Department.
The Martial Height base was bustling today, with many students from the Third and Fourth Layers returning from the Nine Rings Mountain Range and its surrounding areas.
When Jack arrived at the square, he saw Freya Louise, carrying a super-long sniper cannon, and Justin Welan and others walking up to him, covered in dust.
Seeing this, Jack couldn’t help but smile and walked over.
Looking at Jack approaching, Justin Welan was surprised and said, “Jack, you’re back too.”
“Just got back for a while.”
“So, how was it? Did you have a good harvest these past few days?” Jack said while looking at Freya. His gaze swept over the girl, and her battle armor seemed somewhat dirty but not damaged.
Noticing Jack’s gaze, the girl’s eyes flickered slightly, and she said softly, “Don’t worry, I’m not injured.”
At this moment, Marcus Lee exclaimed, “Hey hey! Jack, we’re still here! Don’t be so lovey-dovey with each other right when we meet.”
That’s right.” Zac Lyons and several others nodded in agreement.
Cough!
Jack coughed and said, “What’s so lovey-dovey about this? I’m just expressing normal concern and a greeting.”
He changed the subject and said, “Not bad, all of you have broken through to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven after a few days.”
Speaking of this, Mullen Weisz, who was carrying a huge sword, proudly said, “Heh! That’s right. Although your cultivation speed is fast, we’re not far behind.”
In a few days, several of them had extravagantly used high-order supporting resources to break through to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven, squeezing into the front ranks of the second echelon among freshmen.
As for the first echelon, it was certainly Jack and a few others who had broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Of course, the main reason for their breakthroughs was that their cultivation level was already close to the late-stage, plus their hard work and personal talent during this period.
Justin Welan seemed laid-back, but he had actually broken through the late-stage for over half a month. His energy now was even more profound and heavy, which meant he should be the first to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
At this moment, a row of red large characters appeared on the big screen in the distance.
“River Martial Height, Ian Clark, has Reverse Defeated Lans Martial Arts Virgil Wilbur at the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, currently ranking 915th on the Achievement List.”
Immediately following the surprise of the crowd, another row of red large characters shone on the big screen.
Long Mountain Martial Height, Ronald Travis, has defeated Lance River Martial Height Vann Shaw at the Peak of Fourth Layer Heaven, current Achievement List ranking has risen to 573.”
Unlike the freshmen, these seniors’ challenges are not called Reverse Defeating.
But soon, the red characters on the big screen changed again.
Los Angeles Martial Height…”
“Damn, what’s going on today? The rankings change so much.”
At this moment, Justin Welan’s eyes flickered, “Jack, why not challenge some of those seniors too? With your fighting strength, it should be no problem to make it into the top two or three hundred of the Achievement List.”
“Right.”
Several others’ eyes lit up as well.
Zac Lyons excitedly said, “If a freshman like you suddenly ranked in the top two or three hundred of the Achievement List, it would definitely shock everyone in the Southern Battlefield.”
“I think this proposal is good too.” Marcus Lee nodded excitedly.
After Jack’s previous performance, he could kill a level five late-stage Unique Beast in just two moves. His fighting strength had already surpassed most of the third-year senior students.
Plus, with the Fourth Layer Heaven and the title of freshman genius, it would be enough to shake the entire Southern Variant Beast Battlefield and become the undisputed Number One person of the new generation.
Thinking of this, Marcus Lee and the others were a bit excited and agitated. It was a matter of pride to have the Number One person from first-ycar students as a good friend.
Unfortunately, Jack was not very interested and shook his head, “There’s nothing to fight for in the top two or three hundred of the Achievement List. Didn’t I say it before? If I’m going to grab anything, it’s going to be the first place on the Achievement List.”
“And, my realm is not the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven anymore.
Since his breakthrough couldn’t be concealed for very long and there was no need to keep hiding it, Jack mentioned it at the appropriate time.As soon as he finished speaking, the six people, including Freya Louise, were instantly stunned.
Marcus Lee looked at him incredulously: “Jack Clark, you’ve reached the Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage? How is that possible?”
Jack Clark laughed, ambiguously saying: “Didn’t you guys also break through a little realm? It’s quite normal for me to have a breakthrough too, isn’t it?”
Damn! They’re not the same at all.” Zac Lyons couldn’t help but let out an expletive.
“Let’s go, let’s go. Jack is too demotivating; we can’t chat under this sky anymore.” Justin Welan decisively turned around and walked away, not giving Jack Clark a chance to show off.
“Yes, let’s go. We can’t stay with this abnormal person. Too demotivating.” White Veil and Zac Lyons, arm in arm, also turned and walked away.
Marcus Lee sniffed his armpit and was immediately disgusted by his own smell, shaking his head: “Oh man, I feel so uncomfortable after being out for a few days. Time to go take a bath.”
Compared to the others, Mullen Weisz didn’t even bother to find an excuse. He shouldered his huge sword, whistling as he walked away without even greeting Jack Clark.
Originally, they thought that after not seeing each other for a few days and finally breaking through to the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven, they could regain their confidence in front of Jack Clark and speak louder.
After all, there’s only a ‘little’ difference between the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven and the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven.
As for their combat power? What is that? Doesn’t everybody compare their realms?
However, they didn’t expect to hear such heartbreaking news right after they returned.
Pfft!
Freya Louise couldn’t help but laugh. Laughing merrily, she looked at Jack Clark: “Congratulations on advancing your cultivation further, leaving your fellow students in the dust and widening the gap.”
Among the eighteen first-class Martial Heights and over forty second-tier Martial Highs in the southern region, there are more than 100,000 first-ycar students, and it is estimated that about 30-40,000 people are able to cultivate and establish their foundations.
More than half of these students come from the first-class Martial Heights.
And among these students, only about thirty have broken through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, and only one has broken through to the Mid-stage Fourth Layer Heaven – it’s Freddy Nelson.
And now, Jack Clark is also included.
Of course, she didn’t know that Jack Clark’s cultivation had already reached the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, and his martial arts realm had reached the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Facing the girl’s praise, Jack Clark was surprisingly calm this time, smiling: “This is just the beginning. It won’t take long before I suppress the entire battlefield.”
As the person he knows best and has the best relationship with, Jack has to be more open in front of Freya Louise.
The girl chuckled, her laughter filled with agreement: “I’m looking forward to the day when you dominate the entire younger generation of the south, hehe!”
After saying this, the girl herself laughed first, not taking the joke seriously.
After all, the talent and combat power Jack Clark has shown step by step has become more and more exaggerated, but it has not yet reached the point where he will soon dominate the entire younger generation of the south.
Nothing significant happened in the next two days, other than the occasional changes to the Achievement List, everything went on as usual.
Mikus, who had entered the depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, continued to lie in ambush, slowly expanding his hunting range for nearby Mutated Beasts and refining Essence Blood to recover his strength.
Within the vast Cloud Mist Mountain Range, a snow-white figure was constantly shuttling through, as if looking for something.
With this situation continuing, two days passed in the blink of an eye.
Logistics Department.
Seeing Jack Clark in line, the staff member smiled, “Student Clark, your high-order dragon essence blood has arrived.”
“That’s good.” Jack Clark sighed in relief, luckily this breakthrough didn’t encounter any accidents.
Under normal conditions, the protagonist would encounter some accidents at critical moments, such as someone dying or a friend experiencing an accident, and the key resources would be robbed halfway.
The staff member behind the counter bent down and picked up a black bottle, about the size of a fist and thirty centimeters high, from the alloy safe underneath. He courteously said,
The essence blood in this bottle comes from a Level 8 Giant Beast, the Golden Winged Scaled Dragon. It should be more effective than the essence blood of a Level 7 dragon-type Unique Beast.”
A Level 8 Giant Beast, Golden Winged Scaled Dragon… Wasn’t I ordering high-order dragon essence blood?” Jack Clark was taken aback.
Although the dragon essence blood he used before was called high-order, it was actually just ordinary Level 7 dragon-type Unique Beast essence blood, and this bottle of Level 8 Giant Beast Essence Blood would cost at least 500 contribution points.
“Yes, the person in charge from the military, after hearing that you applied for the essence blood, specifically transferred it from the warehouse and remarked: ‘Gifted to student Jack Clark, wishing you a prosperous martial path.'”
Jack Clark, surprised for a moment, didn’t remember that he knew any high-ranking military officials. Weird. Confused, Jack Clark gave a slight nod, “Please return my thanks for me.”
“By the way, I would like to exchange for two Level 4 Life Crystals.”
“Alright, please wait.”
Taking the Level 8 Giant Beast Essence and Blood and the two Life Crystals exchanged at 70% off for 112 contribution points, Jack Clark applied for a Cultivation Room-

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 180: Breaking Through the Sixth Level, Godly Hegemony, Golden Dragon Double Pupil
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 180: Breaking Through the Sixth Level, Godly Hegemony, Golden Dragon Double Pupil
Translator: 549690339
Two days passed, and Ethan Polis’s corpse lay quietly in the big pit.
As time went by, the residual aura of the blazing sun from the young man in white clothes overhead gradually dissipated, and the invisible oppressive feeling that filled the surroundings disappeared instantly.
Without the residual willpower of the Seventh Layer Heaven, rustling sounds gradually came from the forest.
Soon, a common mutated creature over four meters long emerged from the forest, cautiously looked around, and slowly approached the big pit when it didn’t find any danger.
Staring at the nearby corpse, the panther-like mutated creature’s eyes revealed a trace of bloodthirsty excitement as it stepped lightly closer.
However, this mutated creature was very vigilant. Even though Ethan Polis’s corpse showed no signs of life, it still approached slowly, as if it would flee at the slightest disturbance.
As it approached the corpse, the mutated panther let out an excited growl as it smelled the scent of high-energy flesh and blood.
Just like mutated beasts, the bodies of advanced cultivators also contain high concentrations of energy in their flesh and blood due to long-term energy refining and the absorption of various resources to transform their physiques.
This ‘nutrient’-rich flesh and blood had a great attraction to mutated creatures.
Crack!
The mutated black panther bit Ethan Polis’s arm, which was covered in broken battle armor. Its tough teeth struggled to tear open the flesh, and it also crushed the smart wristwatch on his wrist.
Roar!
Suddenly, the mutated black panther let out a scream, and black blood flowed from its mouth. It fell to the ground with a thud and died.
At the same time, wisps of black poisonous gas seeped from Ethan Polis’s torn arm, and the air made a corroding sound wherever it passed.
This terrifying black mist was the energy Cooper poured into Ethan’s body when he killed him.
This unique Shadow God Sect technique incorporated a variety of highly poisonous True Strength, which could corrode the True Strength, spirit, and flesh of Sixth Heaven cultivators.
At the moment when Ethan Polis’s wristwatch was crushed, the wristwatch’s core—a green stone the size of a soybean—shattered, releasing a strong pulse signal.
This signal was very intense, flashing and disappearing in an instant, and was quickly captured by a Sky Base Satellite tens of thousands of meters above the ground.
In a Martial Height Base more than three thousand kilometers away, the Intelligence Department suddenly shook, and a staff member shouted, “Not good, Ethan’s smart wristwatch has been shattered, the signal indicates he is dead.”
Soon, a figure with a leaping True Strength flame burst out of the Hundred Dragon Martial Arts and quickly headed towards the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
At the same time, on the large screen in various Martial Height Bases, Ethan Polis, who was ranked first on the Achievement List and ninth on the Three Years of Martial Arts High genius list, slowly disappeared.
As the first in the Achievement List and a monster among the third-year students of Hundred Dragon Martial Arts High, Ethan Polis’s death caused a great shock in the base.
However, it only caused some shock in Hundred Dragon Martial Arts Base. Those from other schools who noticed it were just surprised and caused a little commotion.
After that, they went back to their routines.
Every year in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, many ‘geniuses’ die.
When they choose to enter the satellite-unmonitored, magnetically chaotic, high-level mutant beast-filled Cloud Mist Mountain Range, they are prepared for death.
This includes the teachers as well.
Because it is one of the trials, the school is not a nanny, and the officials are not interested in raising a bunch of greenhouse flowers.
Moreover, if they think the Cloud Mist Mountain Range is too dangerous, they can choose not to enter, hunt level 3 or level 4 mutated beasts outside, or stay at the base and take conservatively safe tasks.
It all depends on the students’ choices.
However, the students are ultimately part of the school, so every time a student dies, the teachers go out to help ‘avenge’ them based on the information sent the moment the wristwatch is destroyed.
If the wristwatch is destroyed outside the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, the Sky Base Satellite can accurately locate it and zoom in the image.
If it’s inside the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, the location can be roughly determined based on the strong radiation stone that shatters and sends a pulse signal.
When the approaching Martial Cultivation Teachers are within thirty kilometers of the deceased student, they can receive the weak signal emitted by the wristwatch.
This strong radiation stone signal can last for three days, even if swallowed by a mutated creature, making it easier for teachers to help collect the corpses or relics and give their families a final explanation.
While there was some unrest outside on the square due to Ethan Polis’s death, Jack Clark in the cultivation room swallowed the essence and blood of the Eighth Level Beast.
Boom!
The power contained in the essence blood of an eighth-level dragon-type Giant Beast was terrifying.
The moment Jack Clark swallowed it, an overbearing and scorching force erupted, making him feel a pain in his stomach.
Fortunately, a tremendous amount of energy appeared out of thin air in his body at that moment. Half of it rushed into his dantian, and the dormant Dragon Elephant True Strength instantly roared out.
Because the True Strength infused with this energy was so massive, it even produced the sound of rushing rivers inside Jack Clark’s body.
However, this time the Dragon Elephant True Strength did not envelop and refine the dragon essence blood as before, but merged with it to form a unique golden-red power.
Roar, Roar, Roar!
The True Strength that had combined with the essence blood of a dragon-type Giant Beast faintly emitted a dragon roar. As it circulated following the Sixth Level Dragon Elephant Technique route, all the ‘Dragon Power’ that had previously merged in his body was activated.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s terrifying physical strength erupted instantly, and substantial energy aura spread out from him as the center, causing transparent ripples to appear in the surrounding space..

chapters.title: Chapter 306: 180: Breakthrough to the Sixth Level, Divine Tyrant Body, Golden Dragon Double Pupils_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: 180: Breakthrough to the Sixth Level, Divine Tyrant Body, Golden Dragon Double Pupils_2
Translator: 549690339
This was a phenomenon in which the air was compressed to a tangible state, creating furious invisible wind waves that filled the entire Cultivation Room due to rapid air expansion.
The cultivation path for the Sixth level was more complex; under the domineering True Dragon Power, numerous obscure and minute meridians were forcibly opened, almost covering every part of Jack Clark’s body.
With each revolution, True Strength surged explosively, soon breaking through the Peak of the Fourth Layer Heaven, with abundant and boundless True Strength gathering and being crazily compressed within the Dantian.
As the True Strength constantly compressed and revolved, the Power of Will, which Jack Clark had already prepared, permeated it; creating a slowly condensing crystal within the instant at the center of the vortex.
Boom!
A mighty True Strength, several times stronger, was born. In an instant, the Fifth Layer Heaven aura on Jack Clark burst out, with True Strength within him now revolving at a faster speed.
Each time these True Strength circulated, they all returned to the Dantian; only after being purified over by that crystalline-seeming, but actually the combined core of Will and True Strength, would they increase in strength.
Simultaneously as the True Strength constantly revolved and grew, Jack Clark’s physique absorbed the overbearing Dragon Blood Essence, which assimilated into his entire body – muscles, bones, and even cells.
Gradually, tangible, yet seemingly energy-based, complete Golden Dragon Scales appeared one after another on Jack’s body, making him look like a humanoid Dragon Beast.
While the gold Dragon Scales covered his entire body, all Dragon Power within Jack Clark became instantaneously connected into one.
Roar!
In an instant, a genuine Dragon Roar Elephant Roar resounded from within Jack Clark. The man’s aura suddenly changed and a Divine Might, more overbearing than Dragon Might and more wilful than a Giant Elephant, erupted.
Boom!
Jack Clark, under the explosion of dreadfully unrivaled horrifying aura of power, ignited a white wave that burst around him. The Cultivation Room then trembled violently, causing a raging wind to howl.
Crack! Crack!
Around Jack Clark as the center point, the tough Bluestone floor cracked and sank incessantly, forming a crater of 3 meters in diameter, seemingly unable to bear his existence.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
After connecting the Dragon Power into one piece, Jack Clark’s physique was suddenly madly reinforced in another way.
Instantly, his breath became heavier, stirring up wild winds, the black hair over his back and shoulders moved autonomously despite no wind, the eyebrow center contained an unfathomable Divine Might, resembling a sleeping deity.
Simultaneously, the Dragon Elephant Phantom within Jack Clark’s Sea of Knowledge also roared.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
As the pure strength resulting from attribute point conversion merged, the transparent Dragon Elephant Phantom became increasingly clear. Gradually, a Giant Beast as enormous as a mountain appeared within Jack Clark’s Sea of Knowledge.
Boom!
Accompanied by the growing Power of Will, the spirit’s Will and Godly Dragon Elephant completely coalesced. Suddenly, a heavy aura suppressing Heaven and Earth spread out.
White Spirit cloud mists surrounded the Dragon Elephant, reminiscent of a divine beast from myths and legends, stepping all over the heavens, emanating an inexplicable might.
Under the influence of this heavy and suppressive aura, Jack Clark’s Sea of Knowledge suddenly became very stable.
At this moment, the Blade of Void Cutting Rune that had condensed during the previous Limit Enhancement to the Heart’s Eye Realm, like a knife yet also like a rune, emerged from deep within the Sea of Knowledge and instantaneously fused into the center of the Dragon’s Elephant’s eyebrow.
A peculiar sensation surged up in Jack Clark’s heart when an eye-like pattern formed at the center of Dragon’s Elephant’s eyebrow.
It felt as if an additional eye had formed at the center of his eyebrow, enabling him to observe the void of Heaven and Earth, and conjure an invisible blade to cut anything out of nothing with a mere thought.
This change surprised Jack Clark a bit, but he had no energy to study it at the moment and soon, his consciousness sank into numerous Skill Information.
After a long time, which lasted until two hours later, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, revealing starry black pupils and golden vertical pupils.
Compared with the last time, the golden vertical pupil Dragon Eyes had completely coalesced this time.
The faint eyes emitted an aura of majesty, nobility, overbearingness, and indifference unique to Dragon-type Creatures.
At this moment, in Jack’s eyes, another layer of reality became clearly apparent, as he could clearly see that cracks appeared and disappeared in the ‘deep layer’ space.
It was as if space wasn’t just one layer, but many layers overlaid.
In terms of the effect of the eye talent… apparently, there aren’t any!? Jack Clark slightly raised his eyebrows as he felt that these pair of eyes wasn’t that simple.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark called out the attribute page with a thought.
Realm: Fifth Layer Heaven [Middle stage]
Physique: 1120—1220
Strength: 1210—1450
Agility: 995—1050
Spirit: 1010—1150
Talent: Soul Split+[Top-tier]
Golden Dragon Double Pupils+[Intermediate level, capable of seeing through surface space, observing the essence of space, able to moderately influence Spatial Fluctuations when activated.
Note: This talent will peak in ability to cause space to collapse and dimension rips where the gaze reaches.]
Cultivation Methods: Dragon Elephant Overlord Body+[Sixth level, Will manifests Godly Dragon Elephant, Physique metamorphosis the second time condenses Divine Tyrant Body]Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberdfgrand accomplishment]
Secret Skill: Hidden Deity+[Minor Accomplishments]
Rune: Elephant’s Fury[Incomplete]Blade of Void Cutting[Incomplete]
Attribute Points: 18
Equipment: Eight Desolate Battle Halberd…
Avatar Body: Ancient Hexagon Thunderflame Colossus…
Jack Clark’s gaze landed on the newly awakened talent, and a hint of a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. He did not expect the awakened talent to be a power related to space.
Moreover, immediately after awakening, it was able to influence Spatial Fluctuations to some extent. As for how strong it is, he would have to test later to find out.
However, what Jack Clark placed the most value on was the ‘passive’ element of observing the essence of space.
By the time he breaks through to the Ninth Heavens in the future, perhaps he could comprehend the ‘rule’ of space with the aid of his double pupils, and if he achieves a breakthrough to the king level by that time, it would become horrifying.
Whoosh!
Jack Clark repressed his excitement, and his eyes swept across the Four Major Attributes.
This time, after his Cultivation Method breakthrough and condensation into the Overlord Body, his physique increased by a hundred points, His strength attribute soared by two hundred points, and his other attributes were also given a boost..

chapters.title: Chapter 307: 180: Breakthrough to the Sixth Level,
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: 180: Breakthrough to the Sixth Level,
Divine Tyrant Body, Golden Dragon Double Pupils 3
Translator: 549690339
However, this change was only on the surface.
Jack Clark closed the attribute page, and slowly moved his arms. In an instant, the muscles in his arms swelled, and a tremendously strong power burst out from within, shaking heaven and earth.
Bang!
Dragon Roar, Elephant Roar, the ground shook.
The fist covered in golden dragon scales punched out, and the air in front was instantly compressed into liquid, forming a rolling wall of air that smashed into the distant wall.
Bang! The entire Cultivation Room was shaking under this punch. The roaring explosion of the blast wave echoed endlessly, and the raging wind howled.
When the raging wind dissipated, a fist mark with a diameter of 3 meters and a depth of 20 centimeters appeared on the alloy-like steel wall, as if a giant’s fist had imprinted it.
“What an overbearing power.” Jack Clark exclaimed in surprise.
He had not used his True Strength just now, but merely exerted an overbearing physical power through a casual punch. He hadn’t expected its power to be so terrifying.
No wonder it was called the Divine Tyrant Body, possessing a trace of the power of the Giant Beasts.
With the Divine Tyrant Body, Jack’s flesh was now as strong as that of a dragon-type creature, transcending ordinary flesh and blood, and the golden scales on the surface provided the powerful defense of the Dragon Elephant.
In addition, the power of his entire body’s flesh and blood had now fully integrated, with a unitary force integrated with his True Strength, making it unrivaled in toughness and unparalleled in overbearingness.
Feeling the power within him that could seemingly shake heaven and earth, Jack felt as if he could kill a Sixth Heaven cultivator with a single punch.
And this time it wasn’t an illusion because he really was that strong now.
Even though his cultivation realm had only reached mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
However, the second qualitative change in the Divine Tyrant Body and the terrifying physical power conferred two advantages, causing his combat strength to explode.
As to how strong he had become, it would take a fight with a Level 6 Unique Beast to know for sure.
However, his breakthrough was not yet complete, and Jack took out the two Level 4 Life Crystals, his heart-message echoing in his mind, “Conversion of attribute points.”
“You’ve converted the high-purity crystallized Life Energy, obtaining 72 and
81 Attribute points.”
Instantly, the attribute page showed that his remaining 18 points of Attributes had increased to 171. Seeing this, Jack heart-message once again echoed in his mind, “Consume Attribute points, strengthen the Hidden God Method.”
Strengthening the Secret Skill wasn’t meant for pretense but primarily because he had less than a month left in the Alien Beast Battlefield, and it would be better to keep a low profile.
Moreover, the grand accomplishment of Concealing Breath Secret Method would be of great help whether it was for entering the mountains or for other activities.
For instance, entering deeper into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to hunt Level 6 Exotic Beasts, search for resources, and once he killed a Level 6 Exotic Beast and returned, he wouldn’t need to challenge anyone, and his Achievement List ranking would skyrocket, exposing his strength.
Of course, should he encounter one of the top ten geniuses at the peak of Fifth Layer Heaven in the mountains, he could also challenge them and see how many moves they could withstand from the current him?
As Jack’s words fell, his Attribute points instantly changed to 21 in a moment.
At the same time, an invisible power appeared out of nowhere inside his body, and the Blood Qi Runes that had been integrated into his double shoulders and abdomen emerged, shattered, and merged with that power.
Gradually, a complete and ancient Rune appeared.
• •
It was 5 PM.
“Brother, I heard you’ve struck it rich.”
“Hehe!! It’s not wealth. I only discovered a few Green Jade Snow Lotus.”
“Damn, you actually found a Green Jade Snow Lotus! How many?”
“Six. The Snow Lotus grew on the edge of a pool on the Nine Rings Mountain Range, but they hadn’t bloomed yet, so I had to wait for almost a month.” “A month, huh. Do you know how I spent this month? Eating mutated game that was killed every day. I’m about to throw up.”
“Damn, you’re so lucky.”
“Indeed, if I discovered six Green Jade Snow Lotus, I’d be willing to eat two months of wild game.” The other people around revealed looks of envy.
Green Jade Snow Lotus was a high-level plant resource. Each one was worth 60 contribution points, and after eating it and refining it, one could significantly increase the total amount of True Strength.
However, one could not eat too many. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be enough concentration of True Strength, and trying to break through to a higher realm with too many impurities would become difficult.
When discovering such wild-growing resources, these students would guard them until they ripened while also uploading the data and marking that someone was watching over the site.
This method was similar to official certification. Once certified, others could not snatch the resources away.
The main reason was to avoid resource destruction due to fighting over them and to avoid geniuses at Fifth Layer Heaven using their power to bully others.
After all, this place still fell within the scope of the school’s management fees, and the goal was to cultivate the students, not to have them fight and develop hatred among black and seedy gangs.
Of course, this method only worked around the base. Once entering the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, it was no longer effective, as satellites could not monitor the area.
After breaking through, Jack continued to cultivate for several hours. Once he had a complete understanding of his newfound strength after breaking through, he activated the Hidden God Method to conceal his energy and left the Cultivation Room.
Just as he left the Cultivation Area, he saw several Fourth Layer Heaven seniors sitting idly on the steps, chatting and joking.
At this time, large red characters suddenly flashed on the big screen at the edge of the square.
“South Sky Martial Height, Carol Koch, Reverse Defeat Kenny Harper, Achievement List Ranking 75!”
When a lower-grade student defeated a higher-grade student, it was called Reverse Defeating. With many red large characters appearing on the big screen recently, the square was filled with commotion.
“Damn, Carol Koch has actually entered the top 100 of the Achievement List. Hasn’t it been only a short time since his breakthrough into the mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven?”
“Moreover, Victor Bland was already a mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven expert last year. His strength is truly deep beyond measure..”

chapters.title: Chapter 308: 180: Breakthrough to the Sixth Level, Divine Tyrant Body, Golden Dragon Double Pupils_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: 180: Breakthrough to the Sixth Level, Divine Tyrant Body, Golden Dragon Double Pupils_4
Translator: 549690339
“What a load of crap, it’s been more than half a year and he still hasn’t reached the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, it’s more like he’s stagnating. How can someone who grinds his way to Fifth Layer Heaven by time compare to Carney Turner’s monster-like talent?”
“If you say grinding through time is disrespectful to us third-year seniors, could you grind your way to Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven and show me?”
The second-grade student of Triplex level felt a bit awkward and quickly apologized: “Sorry, senior, I misspoke.”
As the base was in turmoil over Carol Koch breaking into the top too, a few teachers, including James Clark, were standing by the window in the mountainside office building.
“Talented people emerge in every generation.” Mason Witlock couldn’t help but sigh as he looked at the shining large characters on the big screen.
“I don’t know why, but whenever I see these young people making rapid progress in their realms, and each generation becoming stronger than the last, I feel genuinely happy.”
James Clark lightly said, “It’s natural because it means our education and training system is becoming more and more perfect, and the foundation of the Human Race is becoming stronger.”
“Just think, when we graduated more than ten years ago, only a few monsters like them could break through to Fourth Layer Heaven, while we only reached the Third Layer Heaven when we graduated.”
“Who would have thought that more than ten years later, these third-grade students would have many who have reached the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven before even graduating.”
“Now look at second-year student Carol Koch, and first-year students Jack Clark, Jane Aiken, and Howard Lee. With their cultivation speed, they might break through to Sixth-level Heaven in the third grade.”
Another female teacher sighed, “I just hope that these students, after leaving school, at least have a grateful heart and not become traitors to our country.”
“What they should be most grateful for are the pioneers, like the True Martial Heavenly King who proposed the earth-shaking plan and exhausted their heart and soul to create the Foundation Establishment techniques.”
“Not to mention that in recent years, leading the various mighty armies to constantly attack and occupy a large amount of resources for domestic use, there would have been no way for these students to have these resources for their cultivation.”
The others nodded in agreement.
These students’ rapid cultivation is due to their excellent environment, where they can exchange for high-level and even high-order resources with just a little effort.
Without these resources, even monsters can’t break through Fifth Layer Heaven so quickly with just diligent cultivation alone.
As for those students with average talent, they shouldn’t dream about it without a decade or two of hard work.
At this moment, the large screen flashed red large characters again.
“Kyle Hawk, South Sky Martial Height, Realm Fourth Layer Heaven, broke through on the March 5th today, ranking 37th in the First-grade Talent Rankings!”
“Our South Sky Martial Height has another genius on the list.”
At the edge of the square, Jack Clark, who was passing by, stopped in his tracks and looked at Kyle Hawk, who was slowly putting his hand down in the distance, with a smile on his face.
“Kyle, congratulations on breaking through Fourth Layer Heaven.”
Seeing this classmate who had entered the battlefield with him more than half a month ago, Jack Clark felt a touch of sentiment in his eyes.
Because he was already in the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
Kyle Hawk, who exuded a scholarly temperament, showed a gentle smile on his face, “I’m far behind you guys, I’m already more than half a month late.”
Jack shook his head, “Half a month isn’t one or two years; this little time slips by for us cultivators. Maybe one day you will surpass us at a faster pace.”
Kyle Hawk modestly said, “It’s not that simple, I just hope you guys slow down a bit and wait for me.”
However, while he said that, Kyle Hawk’s eyes were filled with confidence.
Just as Jack said, the time difference between their breakthroughs was only half a month.
This gap is insignificant for those who have reached the Fourth Layer Heaven and later. Who knows, he might be the first to break through to the mid period, late period, or even Fifth Layer Heaven later on.
Just returning, Kyle Hawk looked worn out. After a brief chat with Jack, they both left separately.
The next morning, Jack tidied up, replenished some supplies, and set off again.
This time, he planned to go deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to hunt Level 6 Mutant Beasts and test how strong his strength was after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven..

chapters.title: Chapter 309: 181: World in the Palm, Prenatal Awakened Ones
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: 181: World in the Palm, Prenatal Awakened Ones
Translator: 549690339
In the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
A white figure flitted weightlessly above the trees, occasionally touching the branches and leaves, almost as if flying.
Sometimes a mutated bird from the sky would catch sight of him and swoop down only to become baffled as it approached within a hundred meters.
Then, it would spread its wings and soared back up into the sky, completely forgetting about its intention to kill the white insect-like creature.
In the morning, on the edge of a cliff at the depth of a tributary mountain range, Jane Aiken sat cross-legged, an invisible Sword Intent wrapped around her, exuding an aura of razor-sharpness capable of tearing everything apart.
After several days of enlightenment, her cultivation was only a hair’s breadth away from the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Apart from that, her comprehension of the Spatial Crack Sword Intent had also reached a bottleneck. The Sword Intent surrounding her was powerful, but it always fell short of fully condensing.
At that moment, a white-robed figure appeared in the distance, standing weightlessly on a branch.
Seeing the figure sitting on the cliffside, especially the beautiful and heroic side profile, a sense of nostalgia flickered in the eyes of the white-robed young man.
How similar! He thought. By now, she should also be in the Alien Beast Battlefield.
Suddenly, the white-robed young man spoke calmly, “Space is formless, unreachable by human power. What you should see is not the invisible space but the sword in your heart.”
“Use your one and only will as a sword, reflecting the momentary cracks in your heart, breaking the illusion and reality, cutting through everything…”
The voice reverberated in Jane Aiken’s mind, and the space collapsed in her eyes, her long hair flying as the air within a ten-meter radius around her solidified as if it were an invisible space.
In silence, pitch-black cracks spread out from Jane Aiken as the center.
Boom!
The invisible ‘world’ projected by her will within a ten-meter radius around Jane Aiken crumbled, and a strong gale swept through the surrounding area in an instant.
Bang!
An extremely sharp Sword Intent burst from her body and rose into the sky, forming a transparent long sword phantom of three meters in length above her head.
At the same time, her True Strength rumbled inside her body, and she instantly broke through to the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven under the Sword Intent that could tear apart everything.
But it didn’t stop there. Her True Strength continued to circulate, swallowing and assimilating the rich Heavenly Energy around her, only slowing down when she was nearing the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Mid-stage of Fourth Layer Heaven, Illusion Annihilation, and two major Sword Intents.
When her True Strength had stabilized, Jane Aiken turned her head to look into the distance.
When she saw the white-robed young man, she felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity and couldn’t help but express her gratitude, “Thank you for your guidance. May I know which martial arts school you’re from, classmate?”
The girl’s voice was crystal clear, without a single trace of impurity.
Gently smiling, Ilisa Wesley, dressed in white as snow, floated down from the branch, “It doesn’t matter which school I come from, just think of me as a passerby.”
“A passerby.”
Jane Aiken hesitated for a moment, not expecting that kind of reply.
Ilisa Wesley stood not far from the girl, speaking softly, “I saw that you were stuck in the final step of condensing Sword Intent. I couldn’t help but feel a striking resemblance to my past self, so I offered my advice.”
“Your past self? Classmate, are you also adept in the realm of thought?” Jane Aiken’s eyes showed surprise.
Throughout her cultivation journey, she had met many students from other martial schools, including several geniuses and monsters. However, she had hardly encountered anyone who had fully condensed their realm of thought.
That showed how rare people with such ‘talents’ were.
But upon recalling the advice the young man had given earlier, it seemed that his comprehension of the realm of thought was even greater than hers.
“My comprehension of the Power of Intent is not bad.” Saying so, Ilisa Wesley’s Great Sun Intention burst forth, emanating a powerful aura and a dazzling sun emerged behind him.
Jane Aiken was astonished, “Martial Arts grand accomplishment, Intent manifestation!”
Even the naturally gifted girl couldn’t help but feel shocked, for the realm exuded from the white-robed young man was only at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
However, his True Intent had already reached grand accomplishment, and he could even fully manifest it.
On the other hand, her comprehension of the two Sword Intents was only at the entry level, far from reaching minor accomplishment, let alone manifesting the Sword Intent.
That was the symbol of the Seventh Layer High Order.
As Jane Aiken was in awe, Ilisa Wesley slowly said, “Don’t be too surprised. I’ve just temporarily gone a little further than you. However, I feel like you’ve gone a bit astray.”
Jane Aiken’s eyes showed confusion, “I’ve gone astray…?”
“The so-called ‘comprehension’ talent is actually a beam of wisdom that makes us more sensitive to all things and allows us to perceive the essence of Heaven and Earth.”
“In this situation, you should not be fixated on a certain ‘Sword Intent,’ but rather observe Heaven and Earth.”
“When the entire Heaven and Earth are in your heart, the so-called space, earth, and raging wind will be at your fingertips. For example, the sun and moon in my eyes…”
As Ilisa Wesley spoke, the Heavenly Energy surged around him, gathering in his hand to form a transparent sphere with raging winds and jumping lightning inside it. The next moment, a round sun emerged while the moon set, almost creating an entire natural world.
Seeing the ‘world’ containing the mysteries of Heaven and Earth, Jane Aiken seemed to have gained an epiphany and soon fell into an enlightenment state.
As the girl’s gaze sank into silence, Ilisa Wesley stood with one hand holding the ‘world’ phantom, his eyes showing a touch of complexity.
At dusk.
Deep within another Alien Beast Battlefield, far away from the Southern Battlefield..

chapters.title: Chapter 310: 181: The World in the Palm, Innate
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: 181: The World in the Palm, Innate
Awakened 0ne_2
Translator: 549690339
Boom boom boom!!
Between heaven and earth, wild energy rages, the raging wind howls, and dazzling thunderbolts descend from the sky, exploding on the rocks.
In this environment, a youth in a Daoist robe is sitting cross-legged on the edge of the cliff while the raging winds and violent gusts are constantly causing his robe to flutter and crackle.
At this moment, an invisible attraction is emanating from the youth, and the crazy thunder and lightning energy scattered between heaven and earth is converging towards him, forming blue lightning bolts that dance around him.
From a distance, he looks like an ‘immortal’ being surrounded by thunderbolts. At this time, the space not far away suddenly twists and folds, then collapses with a loud bang, forming a several-meter-tall constantly rotating crack-like passage.
Next, a figure covered in blood with numerous bone-deep wounds all over his body bursts out from the passage and barely manages to maintain his balance as he lands.
Looking at the unfamiliar surroundings and the violent yet weakened Heavenly Energy between heaven and earth, Bart laughs out loud.
“Hahaha… I’m not dead, I made it.”
As he speaks, a strong bloody scent erupts from Bart, and the fresh blood on his body and on the ground, like a living creature, wriggles and is absorbed back into him.
At the same time, his wounds heal at a visible speed, restoring him to his former state quickly.
However, although his external injuries have recovered, his aura remains extremely weak, as the injuries engraved deep within his flesh and blood from the Space Cracks requires time to expel bit by bit.
Whoosh!
Bart suppresses the excitement and elation in his heart, and prepares to take out the magic card he carries on him to inform those on the other side of the passage that it is safe and the location is successful.
However, just then, a surprised voice sounds from behind him.
“Interesting, you’ve actually managed to open a space crack deep into the Northern Battlefield. You must be from the Blood God Sect, right? That bloody smell on you is really disgusting.”
The sudden voice causes Bart’s expression to tense, and he quickly turns his head, only to see a youth in a Daoist robe more than a hundred meters away, looking at him in surprise.
Simultaneously, a residual aura lingers on that youth, at the realm of Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
Immediately, a strong killing intent flashes across Bart’s face, his voice deep and stern, “I didn’t expect to run into a Federation lapdog as soon as I stepped out of the passage. Seems like my luck is not bad.”
As he speaks, Bart can’t help but lick his lips, his expression hideous.
If he can drain and refine the blood essence of this youth, not only will his injuries recover by more than half, but he will also be able to raise his cultivation to the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven as well.
As for not being able to win against him, Bart never even considered this possibility.
As a Late Sixth Heavenly Stage expert, even if he is heavily injured at this time, and his cultivation is suppressed to lose one Major Realm, he still possesses a crushing battle power against these greenhouse-bred geniuses.
After all, his physical body has reached the Sixth Layer, combined with his strong willpower and Sixth Layer Martial Arts Realm, he still has the battle power of the Early Sixth Heaven.
Damon Lee’s eyes narrow slightly, “So, you want to silence me by killing me?” Bart sneers coldly, “Don’t you think it’s obvious? This is the Federation’s internal territory. If I let you go now, won’t it attract a large number of pursuers?”
“So die.”
The blood light on Bart’s body flourished, and the blood energy surrounding him was like flames burning. The blood-red light dyed the surroundings, and he transformed into a Nine-headed Blood Python and shot out.
Hiss hiss!
The 20-meter-long blood python wriggles like a dragon, emitting a ferocious and tyrannical aura as if it were a real fierce beast from the wilderness.
Damon Lee’s eyes reveal amazement, “Merging your will with True Strength to release it externally, no wonder you’re so confident.” As he speaks, he stretches out his right hand and grasps slightly upwards.
Boom!
In an instant, a dazzling thunderbolt descends from the sky.
The speed of the lightning is unparalleled, and in a blink of an eye, it strikes the blood python that is roaring towards them. Under the scorching and violent Thunderbolt Power’s burst, the midsection of the Blood Python is blasted apart.
Splatter!
Tens of meters away, Bart, blasted away by the thunderbolt, spits out blood. The blood light on his body dims, his aura weakens, and a look of horror appears on his face.
“How is it possible? You can actually summon natural thunderbolts!”
Suddenly, Bart seems to think of something, and his figure trembles involuntarily,” …You, you’re an Innate Awakened One?!”
However, he immediately shakes his head, “No, it’s impossible, how could an Innate Awakened One be on Blue Star?”
“Such monsters should have been taken to the mythical world by those
king-level people from the Federation long ago.”
Lightning dances on Damon Lee’s fingertips as he curiously looks at Bart, “It’s surprising that you traitors have such deep understanding of the Federation’s internal affairs to know that Awakened Ones will be taken there.”
Bart unconsciously takes two steps back and stammers, “You… are really an Innate Awakened One!”
“You guessed right, but there’s no reward.”
Boom!
As Damon Lee speaks, he swings both his hands, and a terrifying Divine Might erupts from his body, transforming into blue lightning that surrounds him, and thunderbolts rain down from the dark clouds above.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
“No!”
Under the bombardment of the sky full of thunderbolts, the Nine-headed Blood Python that emits a strong bloody scent struggles and twists, and then explodes with a bang, turning into a sky full of blood light bursting apart.
Thud! The burnt corpse with most of its body scorched by the lightning falls to the ground, emitting black smoke.
In front of the Innate Awakened One who controls the natural power between Heaven and Earth, Bart, who is at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage and whose cultivation has fallen to the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven due to heavy injuries, is killed within a few moves.
However, as Damon Lee withdraws the lightning surrounding his body, his gaze falls slightly on the left hand of the corpse.
There, a Black Crystal Card is crushed, and the dense black energy surging out of it twists and writhes like smoke in the air..

chapters.title: Chapter 311: 181: World in the Palm, Primordial Awakener_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: 181: World in the Palm, Primordial Awakener_3
Translator: 549690339
Gradually, a complex and unknown special character takes shape.
Damon Lee is startled: “Holy shit, it’s a Two Realms Communication Talisman!”
As the character coalesces, a terrifying force erupts within the rotating spatial channel, instantly emitting dazzling purple light.
Under the influx of that purple energy, the spatial channel slowly stabilizes, and then another shadow emerges deep within it.
Boom!
Lightning bursts from Damon Lee’s body again, and with a swipe of his hands, a lightning serpent the thickness of an arm coils around his hands and strikes directly at the spatial channel.
Hum!
Under the violent and overbearing thunderbolt power, the spatial channel vibrates, and the figure that has just emerged in its depths instantly shatters and disappears.
However, at this moment, the purple light on the opposite side intensifies, and the energy that can stabilize the spatial channel floods in madly.
At the same time, a terrifying will emerges vaguely, extending through the channel as if trying to cross it and see what has happened on the other side.
Upon sensing this terrifying will, Damon Lee’s face changes slightly: “A king’s intent, there’s a king-level expert on the other side creating the channel.”
“And it’s not even an ordinary king-level!”
“No good, I only like to cultivate and I’m not good at fighting. I’d better leave this matter to the old-timers.”
Seeing that he can’t destroy the channel, lightning flickers on Damon Lee’s body and his figure shoots out like a blue snake of electricity.
In the blink of an eye, Damon Lee appears hundreds of meters away, and within a few breaths, he is at the mountain waist.
Upon reaching this place, Damon Lee flips his hand and takes out his mobile phone from the Sumeru Bracelet.
“No good, the thunderstorm energy here is too intense, and there’s no signal due to the chaotic magnetic field.”
As he speaks, lightning jumps on his body as he shoots out again. After running hundreds of kilometers in one breath and leaving the Thundercloud Mountain Range far behind, his mobile phone finally gets a signal.
“Finally got a signal.”
As he speaks, he dials a number, and as the call connects, Damon Lee exclaims loudly: “Old man, something’s not right.”
“I encountered a person from the Blood God Sect deep within the Thundercloud Mountain Range. He came out of an unstable spatial channel, and there’s a king-level expert on the other side opening a temporary channel.”
“What, a king-level expert is opening a channel in the depths of the battlefield! How did they get the coordinates?”
“I don’t know, they’re very powerful, and 1 can’t beat them.”
“Alright, I understand. Come back first.”
Soon, news of a strange king-level expert opening a channel deep within the Northern Variant Beast Battlefield and smuggling Evil God Sect experts over spreads to the External Federation Headquarters.
Subsequently, within just a few minutes, all the major powers with overlapping spaces around the globe receive the relevant information, including the military base center in the Southern Variant Beast Battlefield.
Because if they can open a channel in the northern battlefield, they can also open one in other overlapping space battlefields, so precautions must be taken.
As for the outside world, there’s no need to worry. Under the surveillance of the Sky Eye Satellite orbiting the globe, as long as the other party dares to open a channel, they will be discovered the first moment.
The defense of the human race in the rear is very tight.
Meanwhile, deep in the Evening Cloudy Mountain Range, a teacher from Hundred Dragon Martial Arts finally finds Ethan Polis’s corpse after a day and night.
At this moment, many mutated beast corpses large and small are scattered around Ethan Polis, all showing symptoms of poisoning.
When the teacher arrives at Ethan Polis’s corpse, he immediately notices his chest wound and the highly poisonous aura emanating from his body.
The teacher’s face changes slightly: “The God-Eroding Devil Technique of the Shadow Evil God Sect, how is it possible? How could there be people from the Evil God Sect here!?”

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 182 Heavenly Kings Join Hands, Fighting Throughout Their Lifetime Across Hundreds of Thousands of Kilometers
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 182 Heavenly Kings Join Hands, Fighting Throughout Their Lifetime Across Hundreds of Thousands of Kilometers
Translator: 549690339
Chirp!
Deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, accompanied by a sharp whistle, a spark shot into the sky and exploded like a firework when it reached a thousand meters high.
The released light was so dazzling, even in the evening.
As the Morning Star Signal exploded, an impulse signal much stronger than that of a smart wristwatch burst out, penetrating the clouds and mist in the sky and was received by a high-altitude satellite.
Immediately, information about the elite Shadow God Sect’s presence deep within the Cloud Mist Battlefield was relayed back.
In the Southern Variant Beast Battlefield, the large conference room was filled with high-ranking military personnel. At the same time, projections of the sixty Martial Height Base leaders were displayed on the walls.
James Clark was among them.
At the main seat, base-charge Tyler Lance said with a serious tone: “We have received a notification from the military ministry about the discovery of the elite Evil God Sect members deep within the Northern Battlefield.”
“Ten minutes ago, a member of the Hundred Dragon Martial Arts Base sent a message saying that they’ve found the traces of the Shadow God Sect infiltrators deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.”
“The death of the former Achievement List top leader, Ethan Polis, had something to do with those infiltrators. However, the situation is quite complicated since there arc traces of powerful willpower forces in the area.”
“What?!”
“How is that possible? The Alien Beast Battlefield is strictly monitored; how did they get in?”
“They couldn’t have come in through a normal route, but rather an unstable space crack.”
“Our area here is an overlapping region of two worlds, where the Void is chaotic and raging. To open a pathway, a peak king-level man would have to act, and that requires precise trans-boundary coordinates.”
“As for the coordinates, there are always ways to get them.”
“Of course, it’s also possible that a stable channel was naturally formed deep within the battlefield, and it happened to be discovered by the enemy.”
“I think the first possibility is very likely. The Purgatory Family has an ancient civilization, known to be over 100,000 years, so they might have the means to stably establish trans-boundary channels.”
Upon hearing that the Evil God Sect has appeared deep on the battlefield, the conference room fell into a heated discussion.
All the people present had solemn expressions, but no one seemed panicked.
This was their Headquarters. If a few mice managed to sneak in, they would just catch and kill them/popperly=id=>.
At this moment, Tyler Lance said in a solemn voice: “You don’t need to guess anymore. They indeed entered through trans-boundary coordinates, forcefully opening a temporary spatial crack.”
“But there’s no need to worry. When we established the Alien Beast Battlefield, we considered this possibility, and many tests were taken.”
“First, opening such a channel has a huge cost. Second, it cannot last too long, and the number and strength of those who can pass through are also very limited.”
“For example, high-ranking life forms cannot enter, and only thirty can pass through at most – including going back and forth. If the number exceeds thirty, it will collapse.”
“At the same time, the life forms that come across the unstable rift will be suppressed by the spatial marks formed by the world’s power, and their strength will temporarily fall by a Major Realm.”
“This is a kind of self-protection mechanism of a world, and it applies to us cultivators trying to invade other worlds as well.”
“This is also one of the reasons why we always travel through stable world passageways when entering and exiting the mythical world.”
Tyler Lance continued: “The purpose of this invasion should be revenge.”
“Revenge!” Many teachers showed puzzled expressions.
Tyler Lance nodded: “I just got the information from the military ministry. Six months ago, Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and Divine Martial Sky King infiltrated deep behind the Purgatory Demon Race.”
“Then, a month ago, a Demon God-Level powerhouse suddenly retreated from the frontline of the Purgatory Demon Race, relieving some pressure on the frontline.”
“But less than two weeks after the Demon God-level powerhouse left, Sky King Denny Kaye and Divine Martial Sky King returned wounded, bringing back a lot of vital information.”
“For example, during this deep infiltration mission, Mysterious Martial Sky King killed a Demon God descendant whose talent was so extraordinary that he could rival a king with his Nine Layers Demon Marks Realm and Demon God’s Form.”
“However, this exposed them, and the Mysterious Martial Sky King was pursued and hunted down by a large number of powerful Purgatory Family members, spanning a distance of hundreds of thousands of kilometers.”
“In the end, Mysterious Martial Sky King lured away a large number of powerful men, including the Demon God who rushed over from the frontline, allowing Sky King Denny Kaye and the others to bring back the intel.”
“This invasion of the Alien Beast Battlefield is likely in retaliation for this event, targeting and attacking our new generation of great talents, starting with the traitors of the Evil God Sect.”
A middle-aged man gritted his teeth: “Those traitors deserve to die. If they weren’t hiding deep within the mythical world, they’d have been eliminated long ago.”
“Those crazy followers of the Evil God Sect do deserve to die. But the most pressing issue right now is to catch those infiltrators lurking around.”
Tyler Lance continued: “At this moment, eleven overlapping spaces in various countries have received emergency notifications, calling for thorough investigation and cleaning up in order to prevent any further infiltration.”
“The Northern Variant Beast Battlefield is already confirmed to have infiltrators, and hundreds of Senior and High-Ranking Powerhouses have gathered, so they arc unlikely to cause much trouble.”
“Compared to other battlefields where most of the areas can be monitored, our situation is more troublesome.”
“The deep areas of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range and the Plain of Ten Thousand Beasts have chaotic spatial magnetic fields and pervasive mist, so even high-definition satellite images will be disturbed by the magnetic field, making it impossible to keep track.”
“Fortunately, we can now confirm that those mice are hiding deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. As such, we will initiate the Battlefield Coverage Plan as planned.”
“Now, issue the order for all students to return to the school base and wait for
the completion of this sweep operation..1 ‘

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 182: The Heavenly Kings Join Forces, Battling Through Hundreds Of Thousands Of Kilometers In A Lifetime_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 182: The Heavenly Kings Join Forces, Battling Through Hundreds Of Thousands Of Kilometers In A Lifetime_2
Translator: 549690339
“At the same time, half of the teachers stationed at each Martial Height Base will be mobilized, forming teams of three or five to enter the Cloud Mist Mountain Range and launch a joint encirclement.”
“As for the signal issue, don’t worry. The Base Satellites hanging over the Cloud Mist Mountain Range will start to burn and descend.”
“The current time is 5 p.m., and it is estimated that you will reach the designated altitude after delving deep into the mountains by tomorrow morning.”
“Meanwhile, all Phoenix Level Fighter Planes from the military will take off and enter the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to drop Pulse Signal Transmitters to inform those students who are going through trials.”
Although there is no signal in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, it does not mean that there is no way to communicate. Over the years, the military has developed several communication methods.
For example, this Pulse Signal Transmitter can send strong pulse signals to cover a range of more than a hundred miles, much like a locator signal tower.
However, this transmitter is expensive and will be discarded after its energy is used up, so it is only used in emergencies.
“Once the Base Satellite descends to the designated altitude tomorrow and releases strong pulse signals to link up with the transmitters below, the information will cover the entire Cloud Mist Mountain Range.”
