“At that time, as long as they emit the aura of the Evil God, they will be quickly sensed by the Base Satellites filled with Evil Bone Remnants, leaving nowhere for those rats to hide.”
As he spoke, a hint of coldness appeared in Tyler Lance’s eyes.
The military must have prepared for a place as special as the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. They had a complete information coverage plan in place, anticipating the invasion of the Evil God Sect and even the Purgatory Family.
The spatial fluctuations caused by the opening of a trans-boundary channel are intense, and once they appear in the outside world, they will be locked onto by the worldwide defense system and quickly encircled.
Hence, their only choice is to invade here.
“In addition, teachers stationed at the base should also closely monitor the surrounding mountain ranges. Although there are Sky Base Satellites, we must not be careless.”
“It’s best to mobilize some students to patrol the surroundings to prevent any fish that slip through the net.”
At this point, a teacher suggested, “General, there are not many enemies this time, and their strength is average. Should we organize some seniors to participate in the encirclement?”
“After all, the power of the invaders is suppressed, so they’re nothing to fear. Besides, they will face Advanced Cultivator of the Evil God Sect sooner or later after they graduate.”
Tyler Lance pondered for a moment: “Yes, but their strength should be limited to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, and they need to form teams of at least five people or follow teachers in action.”
“Also, these invaders had at least Sixth Level Heaven cultivation before coming in. Although their realm has been suppressed and has not yet recovered, we must not underestimate them.”
“Especially those madmen of the Blood God Sect, they can ignite Essence Blood or even self-destruct at the slightest disagreement.”
“Yes.”
As the orders were issued, alarms were raised at all Martial Height Bases and military bases.
Wuu, wuu!!
The sudden alarm startled all the students, who instinctively looked at the Base Main Building, not knowing what was happening.
Having been at the Alien Beast Battlefield for so long, this was the first time they heard such an urgent alarm.
“Attention, everyone, we have received an urgent notice from the higher-ups. There are experts from the Evil God Sect invading deep into the battlefield, and a large-scale search will be conducted for half a month.”
“All students below the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven should stay in the base and not go out. Wait for further notice.”
“What? People from the Evil God Sect have invaded this place?” Suddenly, the bases were abuzz.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!!
At South Sky Martial Height, just as the students on the square were getting a little flustered, four figures wearing extraordinary battle armor and ignited with True Strength flames shot out.
In just a few breaths, they rushed down the mountain and headed towards the Cloud Mist Mountain Range at an astonishing speed, like four meteors tearing across the earth.
“It’s Teacher James Clark and the others.”
“Seems like the message just now was true.”
At the same time, many students active in the Nine Rings Mountain Range and other mountain ranges also received signals to return to the base, including Justin Welan and others.
Humm!
Behind those military bases, large blue sci-fi styled fighter aircraft, even larger than the Bluebird Battle Machines that Jack Clark and the others had ridden before, took to the skies.
Boom!
At a vertical altitude of a hundred meters, they instantly accelerated to twice the supersonic speed, disappearing into the horizon with a sonic boom in the blink of an eye.
In the dark void space, nine blurry figures stood tall, surrounded by tangible black demonic Qi that seemed to surge, emitting a terrifying aura that even space couldn’t bear.
At this moment, a grand voice echoed through the void, “The Fifth Invasion Team has sent a message that their whereabouts have been discovered by the Human Race.”
Another voice hummed, “Currently, four of the eleven teams have successfully entered the Blue Star World, while the other seven have perished in the space tidal waves.”
“This is just a test, mainly to gather information on the defensive strength of the human inner world, reaction speed, and the accuracy of the coordinates already obtained. Thus, failure doesn’t matter.”
“Now that their whereabouts have been exposed, let us act earlier. It’s not bad to be able to kill some new generation of the Human Race.”
“I second that!”
“I second that!”
“By the way, Barus, I heard you let that little guy bring an Advanced Demon Species this time.”
A buzzing voice sounded in the void, “Yeah, just threw it over as a little toy. When the time comes, even if all of them die there, it will still cause the Human Race some trouble.”
Another sharp voice chimed in, “Advanced Demon Species, after parasitizing, can grow infinitely by devouring the flesh and blood of living organisms, releasing all their energy and dying in a short time.”
“A single Demon Seed, if grown, is enough to turn a mountain range into a dead zone for living beings. Well done, Barus..”

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 182 Heavenly Kings Join Hands, Fighting Throughout Their Lifetime Across Hundreds of Thousands of Kilometers_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 182 Heavenly Kings Join Hands, Fighting Throughout Their Lifetime Across Hundreds of Thousands of Kilometers_3
Translator: 549690339
Deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Over a dozen members of the Evil God Sect were either cultivating in meditation or hunting mutated beasts in the mountains to absorb their Essence Blood.
Several days had passed, and their injuries had mostly recovered.
Besides that, some of the Spatial Marks within their bodies had been expelled, their cultivation realms had recovered to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, with a few even reaching the peak.
As elite experts in the late period of the Sixth-level Heaven, although their cultivation realms had been suppressed, sliding back to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, their combat power was still very strong.
Each of them emitted a strong oppressive aura.
At the top of the mountain peak, Mikus, who resembled a demon, stood with his hands behind his back, coldly gazing at the towering mountain peaks veiled amid mist in front of him.
On his body, his battle armor emitted strands of black mist, making him look like a demon that came from hell, exuding an invisible and terrifying aura that frightened living creatures.
At this moment, Mikus’s eyes flickered slightly as he took out a cracked black crystal card from his waist.
Boom!
With the shattering of the crystal card, black smoke surged out and twisted into a rune in mid-air.
Mikus’s eyes narrowed, and he pointed at the rune. Instantly, a stream of information containing the simple command ‘proceed with the attack’ flowed into his mind.
Mikus furrowed his brows, “An accident happened?”
Previously, the order he had received was to hide in the mountains for half a month, while recovering from his injuries and waiting for other teams to arrive simultaneously.
But now, only a few days had passed, and the command for action had already been given.
Boom!
Mikus’s body erupted with a menacing demonic energy, swirling black mist shot into the sky, alerting all those Evil God Sect members in the mountains.
At this point, Mikus’s aura had already recovered to the frightening level of the Sixth Layer Heaven.
The reason for this was the small pouch at his waist, made from the skin of a mutated creature with the talent of space manipulation. It originally contained a small, natural spatial dimension.
Unlike refining a Sumeru Bracelet or a ring with spatial attributes, this small dimension was extremely stable and could traverse unstable spatial channels. However, it was too small to carry many resources, so after using it up, Mikus’s strength only recovered to the early stage of the Six Path Devil Marks.
But even with just the cultivation realm of the early stage of the Six Path Devil Marks, he was confident enough to dominate the mountain range by himself.
As long as he was not surrounded by more than ten of the Human Race’s Sixth Heavenly Layer Expert, he could easily slaughter those so-called “geniuses” effortlessly.
Within three days, he could kill dozens or even hundreds of Human Clan Geniuses. Before other bases from the rear could react, he would be able to leave through the spatial channel and receive numerous rewards.
Perfect.
Soon, twenty people gathered, and while staring at Mikus, who was exuding a terrifying demonic aura, they asked reverently, “What orders do you have for us, sir?”
Mikus looked coldly at these followers of the Divine Sect Alliance and said in a deep voice, “After a few days of healing, my strength has recovered quite a bit, so I decided not to wait any longer.”
“According to the information, there are many human geniuses practicing in this mountain range, mostly around the Fourth and Fifth Layer Heavens.”
“And since signal transmissions don’t work here, it’s a good hunting ground. You don’t have to worry about being discovered by the human bases outside too quickly.
For the next ten days, you can kill as many as you can, and then return here to gather and leave together. Understand?”
Mikus’ men instantly became excited, “Understood.
They had been impatient for a long time. As Mikus gave the command, one after another, figures shrouded in bloody demonic energy entered the mountain range.
What they didn’t know was that even more figures were rushing towards them from outside the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, with both sides heading for each other.
Boom!
At dusk, accompanied by the roaring wind and thunder, a mutated creature that pounced towards Jack Clark exploded in mid-air under the dazzling golden-red light, with blood splattering all around.
After effortlessly killing this Level 3 Mutant Beast that attacked him, Jack Clark’s figure flickered and disappeared into the mountain forest, speeding deeper into the mountain range.
He had already delved nearly a thousand kilometers into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range in just half a day since setting out.
However, since the sky was gradually getting darker, Jack decided to find a place to rest for the night.However, as soon as he rushed up to the mountain peak, his footsteps stopped involuntarily, and a look of surprise flashed in his eyes.
He saw a girl’s dark red battle armor sitting cross-legged on the opposite side of the cliff, about a hundred meters away, with a white-robed young man standing not far away, his hands behind his back and an extraordinary temperament.
Jane Aiken. Jack Clark was somewhat surprised that he didn’t expect to meet her here.
At the moment when Jack saw her, Jane, who was gazing at the sky, also caught a glimpse of his reflection in her eyes. Her eyes flickered slightly as she regained her composure and looked over.
Seeing this, Jack gave a faint smile and said in a clear voice, “I didn’t expect to meet Student Aiken in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, after many days, it seems that Aiken has made great progress.”
Even a hundred meters apart, Jack could feel an incredibly sharp sword intent emanating from Jane Aiken.
The girl’s voice was clear, “Student Clark’s progress is not slow either.”
II
Student Clark, are you planning to enter the mountain range? The night is already upon us, would you like to come over and rest for the night, so we can keep an eye on each other?”
II
Alright.” Jack paused and then nodded.
He saw his legs bend slightly, and in an instant, the rocks under his feet exploded, and he shot out like a cannonball, piercing through the clouds and mist of the mountain stream.
Bang!
Jack, who had crossed more than a hundred meters in the blink of an eye, landed on the ground, crushing the rocks beneath his heavy footsteps, and the ground trembled.
At this point, Jane Aiken also stood up, introducing Jack to the others, “Student
Clark, this is…”
As she spoke, Jane paused, because she only remembered that she didn’t know the white-robed young man’s name, and couldn’t help but look at him quizzically.
Standing with his hands behind his back on the cliff edge, the white-robed young man showed a smile on his face, “You can just call me Ilisa Wesley.”
Jack nodded politely, “Nice to meet you, Brother Wesley.”
After exchanging greetings, a hint of curiosity flashed in Jack’s eyes.
Because this Ilisa Wesley gave him an unfathomable feeling, his intuition told him that this person was very strong, even terrifyingly so.
With his current strength, he couldn’t find many people who would make him feel very strong in the vast Alien Beast Battlefield, of course, referring to the younger generation.
This was also the source of Jack’s confusion, as he couldn’t remember anyone named Ilisa Wesley in the top ten of the Achievement List?
Just as Jack was wondering, suddenly a roar came from the sky, followed by a blurred speck flying by at high altitude.
“A fighter aircraft, how could it enter the Cloud Mist Mountain Range?”
Both Jack and Jane were somewhat surprised, looking up at the supersonic fighter flying rapidly in the sky.
Chirp!
At this moment, a cry came from the sky, and a Level 5 mutated bird with a wingspan of more than thirty meters tore across the firmament, pouncing on the fighter aircraft that intruded into its territory.
Missiles were launched from beneath the fighter aircraft at supersonic speeds, instantly covering the mutated bird, and the dazzling explosion immediately lit up the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Chirp!
With an angry cry, the mutated bird emerged from the fire and smoke, its wings flicking furiously, and several parts of its body were injured.
But what greeted it was a dazzling beam of light.
Boom!
A beam of energy from underneath the Bird Fighter pierced through Heaven and Earth, instantly killing the Level 5 mutated bird and swooping around in a circle to continue deeper into the mountains.
Jack barely saw that at the edge of the sky, the fighter aircraft seemed to have dropped something, which turned into a black dot and fell into the distant mountains.
It was about several hundred kilometers away from him.
This scene was not only happening here, but fighter aircraft were also entering the mountain range from more than a dozen other directions, dropping signal transmitters one by one as they approached the middle section.
As they arrived at the latter part of the mountain range, their speed dropped, and their rear hatch doors opened.
Immediately after, ten teams of five Sixth Heavenly Layer Experts, jumped down from the military squad and disappeared into the clouds and mist in the blink of an eye..

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 183: Brother, stop showing off, the invincible path (seeking monthly tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 183: Brother, stop showing off, the invincible path (seeking monthly tickets)
Translator: 549690339
Watching the sci-fi styled fighter disappear into the sky, Jack Clark couldn’t help but wonder, “Why would a long-range bomber enter here?”
This place was still on the outskirts and at the mid-point of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, where the clouds weren’t very dense. Therefore, Jack and the others could vaguely see the fighter flying by.
Jane Aiken frowned slightly, “Something must have happened; otherwise, the military base’s aircraft wouldn’t appear in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly.
The Southern Variant Beast Battlefield was divided into two parts. The military’s activities were mainly on the Plain of Ten Thousand Beasts, while the mountainous areas belonged to the school base where students were trained.
Now that the military’s aircraft had entered the mountain area and dropped something, something must have happened.
In fact, for the vast Alien Beast Battlefield, humans had absolute control.
Whether it was the countless mutated creatures or the space magnetic field chaos and cloud-cover of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
If they wanted, the military could always organize an overwhelming force to sweep through the area.
But under normal conditions, it wasn’t necessary, since killing a group of mutated creatures would only lead to more reproduction.
Instead, it was better to treat the area, including Mutated Beasts, as an ordinary resource production site, as well as a training ground for the next generation of students to accumulate practical combat experience.
Jack Clark took a deep look at the small dot that fell behind the mountain peak in the horizon, planning to check it out tomorrow.
The cliffside where Jane Aiken was located had a good terrain, with the mountain behind and the cliff in front. There were sparse weeds in the distance on both sides. A bonfire was quickly lit.
While Jane Aiken sat in front of the fire to heat up her dry rations.
In the darkness, Jack Clark carried a black stone weighing over two tons on his shoulder and dragged a five-meter-long mutated beast resembling a wild buffalo back to the camp.
He casually threw the Mutated Beast’s corpse aside and placed the stone on the ground with a thud. Looking at Jane Aiken, he said, “Student Aiken, please trim this ironstone flat with your sword.”
Trimming the stone? Jane Aiken walked over with some confusion, took out her Transcendent Battlesword that emitted a white halo.
Following Jack’s directions, she carved the iron-hard steel stone into the shapes he wanted, “From here, trim it down, not too thick, about two centimeters should do it. Trim three stone stools and four small stone feet….”
Soon, under Jack Clark’s guidance, Jane Aiken trimmed the steel stone into the shape he wanted.
Then, under the watchful eyes of the girl and the young man standing with his hands behind him at the edge of the cliff, Jack built a stone tablet barbecue stove, covering half of the bonfire.
Next, he cleaned it with water from the Storage Space, followed by small bottles of sauce.
He then cut a large chunk of fresh Mutant Beef from the corpse, using a knife emitting a golden-red Knife Qi to slice the meat into thin slices and placed them on the stone slab to cook.
Sizzle!
Instantly, grease oozed from the beef. As Jack brushed on the sauce and flipped the meat, a rich and spicy aroma of barbecued meat mixed with cumin filled the air.
Seeing this scene, Jane Aiken couldn’t help but stare, including the young man in white at the edge of the cliff in the distance.
When the first dozen or so slices of meat were almost cooked, Jack called out, “Come, Student Aiken, have a taste of the stone tablet barbecue that Howard Lee and I learned.”
And for the always…ehem…cool Brother Ilisa Wesley over there, you should join us in eating; don’t be shy.”
With that, Jack took two pairs of chopsticks from the Storage Space and placed them next to the stone slab, indicating for Jane Aiken and the distant show-off youngster to come and cat together.
Smelling the aroma of the meat, Jane Aiken didn’t hesitate and sat down on one of the stone stools.
The white-robed young man also casually walked over with a smile, “I didn’t expect Brother Clark to be so elegant, enjoying himself even in a place with Mutated Creatures everywhere.”
“It’s not really about enjoyment, mainly because you guys are around today, and the terrain here is good. Otherwise, I would usually just handle it simply and move on.”
“This kind of outdoor barbecue is more fun when more people are eating.”
After seeing Howard Lee, that fierce guy, eating a meal so meticulously and delicately in the wild, Jack had also prepared a set of barbecue tools in his Sumeru Bracelet.
Of course, the main reason was that his Storage Space had been strengthened, and he could carry more supplies.
Soon, the three of them gathered around the 1.5-meter-long and 0.5-meter-wide stone slab to eat. There was plenty of fresh Mutated Beef behind them; they wouldn’t run out.
While eating, Jack Clark couldn’t help but become curious, “Student Aiken, what is your current level of cultivation?”
Compared to a dozen days ago, Jane Aiken’s strength had increased by several times, along with her sword intent aura.
It was evident that not only had he progressed significantly during this time, but Jane and the others had also been growing at an astonishing pace.
“Fourth Layer Heaven Mid-stage,” Jane Aiken swallowed the grilled meat in her mouth and revealed without concealment, “Recently, I’ve been observing the Space Cracks here and gained some insights, comprehending the second spatial sword intent.”
“As my sword intent broke through, my cultivation level also smoothly reached the mid-stage level, and along with today’s observation and comprehension of Ilisa Wesley’s miniature world in a palm, I feel that my realm is loosening once again.”
Jack Clark couldn’t help but exclaim, “…Amazing!”
It had only been more than half a month since Jane Aiken had broken through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, yet she had already managed to reach the mid-stage quite stably due to her comprehension of new sword intent.
However, what was most surprising was that she had already comprehended two sword intents.
Previously, during a night of bloody battle, he had fallen into a frenzied state and only touched the threshold of the undefcatable war intent. In the end, when he tried to condense it, he failed due to insufficient Martial Arts comprehension.
It was easy to imagine how difficult it was to comprehend the realm of thought.
No wonder Lori Parma had exclaimed in admiration when talking about her talent for comprehension.
At this moment, Jane Aiken shook her head slightly, “Jack, you don’t need to be so amazed; your progress has not been slow either..”

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 183 Brother, Stop Showing Off, Road of Invincibility (Asking for Monthly Tickets) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 183 Brother, Stop Showing Off, Road of Invincibility (Asking for Monthly Tickets) _2
Translator: 549690339
Although Jack Clark concealed his aura, preventing others from perceiving his exact realm, Jane Aiken could sense a powerful oppressive force from the two Sword Intents within him.
Clearly, it was not just her who was progressing; Jack Clark, who was displaying increasingly dazzling talent, was no exception.
Jack Clark spoke earnestly, “No, I’m far worse than Student Aiken, really.”
At this moment, Jack Clark didn’t have any sarcasm in his tone. Although his cultivation had already broken through to the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, he knew his own situation well.
He was well aware that only a part of his current cultivation was attained through hard work, while the other part was achieved by relying on attribute points to violate the rules.
Although those attribute points were also the result of his efforts during this period, they were still different from his own hard work.
However, people like Jane Aiken were different; they had truly relied on themselves to get here step by step.
It’s just… Student Aiken seemed a bit too frank.
It would have been simpler just to mention the breakthrough and not reveal details about the Sword Intent and its characteristics, including the fact that she had two Sword Intents.
Not only Jack Clark, but even the white-clothed young man eating barbecue across from him couldn’t help but look at Jane Aiken, seemingly thinking she was a bit… too honest.
“Speaking of which, Student Aiken, may I consult with you about your experience in comprehending Intent? I touched the condensation of Intent earlier, but unfortunately, I failed in the end.”
Jane Aiken looked surprised, “Student Clark also touched the condensation of Intent? What did you comprehend, is it Halberd Intent or Fist Intent?”
In her opinion, Jack Clark cultivated the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd and Dragon Elephant Power, so the condensed Intent would be either Halberd Intent or Fist Intent.
“Neither, what I condensed was Undefeatable Battle Intent.”
“Battle Intent, and it’s Undefeatable Battle Intent at that!”
On the side, the white-clothed young man who had been eating looked over in surprise, “Brother Clark, are you sure that the Intent you perceived at that time was Undefeatable Battle Intent?”
“Yes, I’m certain,” Jack Clark nodded.
“No wonder you failed.”
Jack Clark was slightly taken aback,”… What do you mean?”
Ilisa Wesley spoke slowly, “Battle Intent is different from Sword Intent or Blade Intent that is comprehended after reaching the limit of a technique. It’s a power that comes from the sublimation of an individual’s spirit.”
“Since what you perceived at that time was Undefeatable Battle Intent, the core foundation naturally had the absolute belief of ‘I am invincible’ and the overbearing aura that dominates the world.”
“However, at this moment, I don’t feel the absolute overbearing aura of ‘I am invincible’ or the unyielding belief of being invincible from you, which is why I was just surprised.”
Ilisa Wesley’s words made Jack Clark pause and then fall into deep thought.
Due to his experiences in two lifetimes, his character was mostly cautious and prudent, even though he occasionally had an adventurous spirit. He liked to think things through before taking action.
Even if he practiced the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, which was characterized by its domineering and forceful nature, and wielded the heavy momentum Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, he only appeared crazy and domineering during combat.
But when it came to his personality…
At this point, Ilisa Wesley said calmly, “Your personality is the biggest obstacle preventing you from condensing Undefeatable Battle Intent, but a person’s personality is innate and difficult to change in a short period of time.”
“Therefore, if you want to condense Undefeatable Battle Intent before reaching the Seventh Layer Heaven, it’s best to walk the Road of Invincibility, forcing the momentum to condense your Invincible Intent.”
Jack Clark asked subconsciously, “How do I walk the Road of Invincibility?”
Ilisa Wesley said indifferently, “One word, battle!”
Jack Clark fell silent for a moment and then sincerely thanked him, “Thank you, Brother Wesley, for your guidance today.”
“You’re welcome. Just consider it as repayment for eating your barbecue today.” “Well, didn’t I make a huge profit today?”
“I didn’t lose out cither.”
As they spoke, both of them looked at each other and laughed. The familiarity between them instantly grew, the initial politeness and distance they had when they first met was gone.
Of course, most importantly, Jack Clark didn’t feel any malicious intent from this mysterious fellow.
Night!
As Jack Clark and the others rested, many students in the middle and late sections of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range turned pale when they received the pulse signal and began to evacuate the mountain quickly.
However, some students didn’t receive the message, as the Cloud Mist Mountain Range was too vast.
Before the base satellite had descended to form full-coverage information, most parts of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range were still in a no-signal state.
Under the cover of night, in a valley in the middle and late sections of the mountain range with an abundance of Heavenly Energy, a giant over 3 meters tall wearing heavy battle armor appeared under the moonlight, emitting a terrifying aura.
The evil, dark aura coming from the giant figure made George Koontz’s face tense as he asked in a deep voice, “Who are you!?”
From this giant figure, he felt a strong malicious intent that was neither from a student nor a teacher, nor did it seem to be from the military..

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 183: Brother, Stop Showing Off, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 183: Brother, Stop Showing Off, The
Road to Invincibility (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
Translator: 549690339
Looking at the young man on the mountain wall, Kranter had a vicious smile on his face: “You Federation dogs, I’m going to tear you to pieces one by one.” Boom! The battle broke out in an instant, and the terrible explosion echoed far away.
About ten minutes later, the burly Kranter slowly walked out of the valley, holding a bloody head with a pair of eyes filled with unwillingness.
At the same time, as the invaders scattered to search for students, some even died.
Two army squads also come across a Blood God Sect fanatic and a Giant God Sect Apostle Walker.
Especially the high-level fanatic of the Blood God Sect was shocked to see the five figures surrounding him, and the True Force Flames flickering on them were even more dazzling.
Weren’t they saying that the students in these mountain ranges were only in the Fourth and Fifth Layer Heaven? Where did these Sixth Layer Heavens shrouded in killing intent come from?
Without waiting for the stunned high-level fanatic to react, one of them shouted.
“Kill!”
In an instant, a fierce battle broke out.
It quickly ended as the Blood God Sect fanatic self-destructed and the Giant God Sect Apostle Walker was decapitated.
At the same time, in the night, figures emitting True Force Flames rushed into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range from all directions.
Where these people passed, vegetation flew in all directions, and one after another Mutated Creatures were bombarded; the whole wild mountain range became chaotic, and numerous ferocious Unique Beasts howled in Heaven and Earth.
However, these Mutated Creatures were no match for these Martial Cultivation Teachers no matter how brutal they were.
These Martial Cultivation Teachers were elite forces who had withdrawn from the frontline battlefield, their realms were in the middle and late stages of the Sixth Layer Heaven, and their weapons had been forged three times over the years.
Some people’s realm had even reached the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, ready to break through the Seventh Layer Heaven at any time, similar to Lori Parma and Vernon Leinster.
After years of accumulation, their combat skills were mostly at the grand accomplishment level, some even trained to the peak and comprehended Sword Intent and Blade Intent.
With such strength, they could almost walk sideways in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, rapidly advance into the depths of the mountain range in a sweeping manner, paying attention only to the Space Cracks.
Above the sky at an altitude of hundreds of thousands of meters, huge satellites began to slide, and the remains of high-level archbishops and God’s envoys from the Evil God Sect were slowly activated inside each base satellite.
• • The next day, Jack Clark woke up early.
After tidying up, Jack Clark looked at Jane Aiken and Ilisa Wesley: “Student Aiken, I feel that the atmosphere in the mountain range is not right today, do you want to leave first?”
Jack finished speaking and glanced at Ilisa Wesley nearby.
Although the two chatted well last night, and Ilisa Wesley gave him some great advice, Jack Clark always felt that she was too mysterious.
Jane Aiken nodded slightly: “I will be careful, and if I find anything wrong, I will leave quickly.”
“Alright then.”
Jack Clark nodded and greeted them before disappearing into the mountains.
Watching Jack Clark leave, Ilisa Wesley thoughtfully said, “I didn’t expect that now in this Federation, just any ordinary Martial Height School would have a genius like Brother Clark.”
Jane Aiken nodded slightly: “Student Clark’s talent is indeed very strong.”
Recalling this classmate who rose from obscurity to prominence, although Jane Aiken had only met him a few times, each time she saw Jack Clark, she would find him even more powerful.
She admired his rate of progress even more than her own.
Because Jack Clark was different from the “geniuses” like them who had shown their talents from the beginning; he had fought his way up step by step, receiving far fewer resources than them in the early stages.
Soon Jack Clark crossed over a hundred kilometers and arrived near where he saw the fighter jet drop something yesterday. Then his eyes moved slightly.
On his wrist, the smart wristwatch he was wearing suddenly lit up and flashed slightly.
“Emergency alert: High-level Evil God Sect Cultists have invaded deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. All students below the late-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven withdraw immediately or quickly rendezvous with the teachers entering the mountains.”
“Note: These invaders are injured, and their realms are estimated to be between the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven and the early stage of Sixth Layer Heaven. They are quite powerful, so students who are confident can consider forming teams to hunt them.”
“Hint: Each invader is worth 200 Contribution Points, too Merit Value, and the captured items belong to the individual.”
“High-level Evil God Sect Cultists actually invaded here.” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Then, the bounty of two hundred Contribution Points and one hundred Merit Value made his eyes move slightly.
Especially the Merit Value.
It was even more precious than Contribution Points and acted as a higher level of “money.” It was needed to exchange for Top-tier Secret Manuals and even Mythical Giant Beast Essence Blood, materials, and top-tier special resources above Advanced Skills.
Invaders! Suddenly, Jack Clark’s brow furrowedback

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 184: King-level Arrival, the Killer Chu Batian
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 184: King-level Arrival, the Killer Chu Batian
Translator: 549690339
When Jack thought about whether Ilisa was an Evil God Sect member, he already had an answer in his heart.
That mysterious fellow was probably an Evil God Sect Cultist.
However, Jack hesitated about whether to turn back or not.
Because he did not feel any malice or murderous intent from Ilisa, neither did she have the bloody, evil aura that Blood God Cultists could hardly conceal. She was just like a normal cultivator.
Even more, she had given pointers to Jane Aiken about the path of thought.
That was why Jack hesitated.
In fact, the so-called Evil God Sect is collectively called the Divine Sect Alliance in the mythical world. Every sect has a king-level existence sitting at the helm, who proclaim themselves as gods.
All these sects are formed by strong men who have defected from the Human Race, but not all of them are enemies of the Human Race.
Only a few opposing sects, who often send people to sneak in and cause trouble, are called Evil God Sects.
For example, the Blood God, the Giant God, and the Shadow sects are closely aligned with the Purgatory Demon Race. Their territories are completely dependent on the Purgatory Family, acting as their lapdogs.
As for the other sects, some have different ideologies, some just want to enjoy being gods, and some have their own reasons.
Jack found this information after Koroya returned to the school and was promoted.
However, the information he saw was limited, as he didn’t know the titles of all the sects, the names of the kings or their power in the mythical world.
After a brief pause, Jack turned around and rushed towards the depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Considering the advice the mysterious person had given him the night before, Jack decided to leave Ilisa alone for the time being and kill some invading Blood God Cultists first.
As for Jane Aiken’s safety, he didn’t have to worry.
Because he was sure that Ilisa held no malice towards Jane, and sometimes, when Ilisa glanced at Jane unintentionally, her eyes would momentarily show gentleness.
At that time, Jack had almost thought she was Jane’s long-lost sister.
As for reporting Ilisa’s whereabouts… there was no signal.
Boom!
Jack’s speed suddenly exploded in the forest, reaching 300 meters per second. Because he was so fast, a long white wave trail was left in his wake.
His speed was entirely due to his immense strength, unlike cultivators who practiced agility-based Cultivation Methods that could eliminate air resistance and achieve instantaneous explosion.
This made his movements appear very grand.
Wherever he passed, trees and grass in the forest were uprooted, and even some trees over ten meters high were directly broken by his violent wind wave, making him seem incredibly overbearing.
He had no choice; those teachers had already entered the mountains, so if he were any slower, he might not be able to catch any of the enemy cultivators.
As Jack approached the location they were dropped off, someone else was closing in from another direction.
“Late-stage Fifth Layer Heaven, a peak Evil God Sect Cultist!” Howard Lee looked at the message on his wristwatch, and a wild battle intent emerged in his eyes.
Compared to a week ago, he seemed much stronger now, as if possessed by a demon.
Suddenly, Howard’s gaze shifted downward, as a golden-red light soared through the Vast Wilderness Forest below, like a sharp sword.
Boom! Trees and grass went flying everywhere as Jack halted abruptly more than ten meters away. The raging wind whistled around him: “Howard Lee.”
Jack was somewhat surprised, not expecting to run into anyone he knew in the mountain.
At this moment, Howard was wearing a set of blood-red heavy battle armor, with barbs on each of his joints and sharp, outward-curving beast heads on his shoulders.
In addition, the sharp horns of a Unique Beast curved behind his double shoulders, making him resemble an ancient warrior.
Most importantly, the battle armor emitted a faint glow.
Besides, the weapon he carried on his shoulder – four meters long and thicker than his thigh, wrapped with dark red dragon patterns – also emitted a red glow.
With the strong scent of a Unique Beast’s blood on him, it seemed Howard had grown quite a lot during this time.
Howard spoke solemnly, “Jack, you also received the signal of Evil God Sect elites invading. It looks like you’re planning to go into the mountains and hunt down those guys?”
“That’s right.”
“Hold on, are you also interested in the heads of those cultists?”
“A little.”
Jack shook his head: “I suggest you don’t go, those guys may be injured and in the late period of Fifth Layer Heaven or at the peak, but they are still powerful.”
“As old Sixth Heavenly Layer Experts, they can at least leapfrog one Minor Realm, even reaching the Early Sixth Heaven. If you go there, you might be killed instantly.”
Howard felt a little unconvinced: “Aren’t you also in Fourth Layer…”
Before he could finish, a domineering and terrifying aura emanated from Jack, shaking the surrounding air while faint dragon roars and elephant trumpeting echoed in the void.
In an instant, Howard’s mouth gaped wide open, and shock spread across his face.
What’s going on? Wasn’t he just in the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven a week ago? How was he suddenly in Fifth Layer Heaven now!?
“This is my confidence,” Jack smiled, pleased with Howard’s shock. Then, his figure burst through the air and continued to rush into the depths of the mountain range, leaving a trail of raging wind behind him.
As Jack disappeared into the forest depths, leaving behind a violent wind wave, Howard couldn’t help but rub his cheeks, doubting whether he was hallucinating.
A whole Major Realm raised in just over a week? Had he stumbled upon some top-tier resources, like those for raising realms?
It seemed his agreed-upon battle with Jack would have to be postponed; after all, his current cultivation realm was being suppressed and he was definitely no match for him now.
Yes, Jack now had a higher Major Realm than him. Although his own battle power was great, Jack was not weak either.
Thinking of this, Howard regained some confidence and his spirits lifted.
Soon, Jack entered the middle section of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. The fog density here was even higher, and the chances of encountering Space Cracks were also greater..

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 184: King-level Arrival, the Killer Chu Batian_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 184: King-level Arrival, the Killer Chu Batian_2
Translator: 549690339
However, after awakening his double pupils, Jack Clark was able to detect and avoid them, continuing his frantic i,ooo-kilomcter journey into the deeper part of the mountain range.
Upon reaching this place, Jack Clark stopped in his tracks.
Standing atop a towering mountain peak, Jack Clark looked around at the vast sea of clouds and the faintly discernible peaks, feeling lost as to how he would find someone in such a vast area.
After slight hesitation, Jack Clark suddenly let out a dragon-like roar, the deep and profound sound resounding between heaven and earth.
At the same time, an aura equivalent to the Initial Stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven burst out from Jack’s body after he had gathered it, the overbearing pressure compressing the surrounding air into circles of white waves and raging wind.
Roar! Roars of Mutated Beasts echoed from the foot of the mountain.
Recklessly emitting his aura, Jack Clark essentially challenged the mutated creatures, but what did it matter?
As the aura erupted, Jack Clark flew along the mountain ridge. When he reached the mountainside, a 21-mcter-long Mutated Giant Python roared and charged at him.
Boom!
The golden red Battle Halberd, enveloped in radiant light, swept across the python’s head, which was larger than a sedan. It instantly exploded, with flesh and blood splattering in all directions, and the python’s massive body slammed into the ground with a loud crash.
After condensing the Divine Tyrant Body, Jack Clark’s strength grew even more fierce, overpowering, and heavy. It was terrifying.
A casual strike with the Battle Halberd instantly killed a Mutated Creature in the late stage of Level 4, whose head couldn’t even be penetrated by an anti-equipment sniper bullet and was directly shattered by True Strength.
Glancing at the corpse of the Mutated Beast, a hint of regret appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
Roar, roar, roar!!
With his energy bursting, Jack Clark appeared like a shining beacon, occasionally attracting powerful Mutated Creatures who roared and attacked him brazenly.
And then they exploded into a rain of flesh and blood under the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
Just as Jack Clark recklessly emitted his aura, hoping to attract the Evil God Sect Cultists to actively seek him out…
High overhead, a dozen base satellites, each with a diameter of too meters, had already fallen to an altitude of 50,000 meters, emitting a brightness visible even in daylight.
Under the falling glow, pulse radiation signals were sent out in all directions.
The intense pulse information penetrated the mist, linking with the hundreds of Signal Transmitters released yesterday to form a network covering the entire Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Buzz! Everyone in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range felt their wristwatches vibrate, signaling that the network was online.
At the same time, under the perception of the Evil Bone Remnants within the base satellites, the auras of those who encountered Mutated Beasts or who burst out with True Strength to hurry along their journey were instantly detected in the mountain range.
In the Monitoring Center at the rear Military Base, most of the mountain range model covered by clouds and fog appeared on the giant screen, with black and red light dots emerging in the middle and rear sections.
“Report: Ten Evil God Sect Cultists’ auras detected. Based on the reaction of the remnants within the base satellites, they are confirmed to be from the Blood God Sect and the Giant God Sect.”
“Quickly lock the positions and notify the nearby teams to encircle and annihilate.”
“Yes.”
Under the information difference, the Evil God Sect Cultists who had entered the mountain range last night had no idea that they had been exposed and that many Martial Cultivation Teachers had already encircled them.
Only a few cautious ones sensed that something was wrong and hid their auras without exposing themselves.
Among these people, Jack Clark didn’t receive the information to lock the Evil God Sect Cultists because he was registered as an early-stage Fourth Layer Heaven practitioner.
However, at this moment, he stopped in his tracks.
By this time, it was already afternoon, and the surrounding Sky-touching Trees cast interlocking shadows, making the light dim.
Jack Clark, standing with his halberd, was enveloped in a golden-red light like a war god. His gaze penetrated the mask and looked deep into the forest on the right side, speaking indifferently.
“Come out, I’ve already detected you.”
However, after Jack Clark finished speaking, the surroundings remained silent. There was no leakage of aura, no energy fluctuations, only the slight mountain breeze brushing through the trees.
Feeling the gaze coming from within the tall bushes several meters away, Jack Clark’s mouth slightly curled up, “You think I’m bluffing you?”
Roar!
Accompanied with the Void Dragon Roar and Elephant Roar, an overarching, overbearing aura erupted from Jack Clark’s body, as if a Dragon Elephant Behemoth was awakening and exuding a terrifying aura.
Boom!
The ground beneath him shattered as Jack Clark abruptly leaped high into the air. In an instant, a terrible aura filled the space between heaven and earth.
The Halberd Skill on his war halberd stretched up to five meters long, like a giant golden-red battle halberd falling from the sky, annihilating everything in its path with its terrifying power.
Roar, roar, roar!!
In the instant the attack landed, the Dragon Roar and Elephant Roar in the void became even more profound, as if a real giant beast was stomping down from the sky, with substantial white waves rippling out in circles.
Boom!
The dark bushes below exploded, and boundless blood light flooded out, transforming into a 20-mcter-long, nine-headed Blood Python that soared into the sky.
Hiss, hiss, hiss!!
The nine hideous snake heads of the Blood Python let out hissing sounds, emitting an evil and dense smell of blood as they intertwined, forming a column of blood-colored light that soared into the sky.
Boom!
Under the Golden Red Halberd, nine snake heads immediately exploded, and the unstoppable War Halberd continued with its overpowering might, cleaving the Blood Python in half and slashing towards the horrified Ma He below.
Boom!
The heavy and overbearing War Halberd smashed onto the crossed Blood-Colored Twin Swords, and Ma He, overwhelmed by the force, felt as if the world was collapsing and sinking, as though the entire world was shaking.
Under the earth-shattering power, Ma He spat out blood. His figure sank, and both his knees crashed onto the ground with a thud.
Boom!
Centered around Ma He, the ground in a range of more than ten meters collapsed, with countless dirt thrown tens of meters high under the fierce, unparalleled force.
“How… How is this possible!”
In the circular pit, Ma He knelt on both knees, with blood-colored flames leaping on his body, staring fixedly at the sharp halberd blade that was close at hand..

chapters.title: Chapter 320: 184: King-level Arrival, the Killer Darren Callum_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: 184: King-level Arrival, the Killer Darren Callum_3
Translator: 549690339
In his hand, one of the extraordinary double swords that had completed its second forging was already broken, and his arms covered in battle armor were desperately holding the other sword below it.
At this moment, the expression on Ma He’s face was full of horror and disbelief.
He, a great master at the late Sixth Heavenly Stage, was actually being suppressed by a federal student in the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven realm and even worse, his opponent was holding a halberd with a single arm.
Although due to the spatial scars, his realm had only recovered to the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven, his Sixth Layer body, with its powerful willpower, was still no weaker than an average Six Layer.
With such strength he should easily slaughter these inexperienced geniuses who were still at the Fifth Layer Heaven, right?!
Thinking of this, Ma He’s heart was filled with unwillingness and anger.
He did not hesitate to become this inhuman form for the sake of powerful strength, but after paying such a great price, he still couldn’t beat a young kid.
In an instant, Ma He’s eyes turned red and his Essence Blood was ignited, causing his whole body muscles to swell, snake scales to grow on the surface of his body, and an eruption of powerful internal force.
Boom!
Under the burning Essence Blood, Ma He’s aura instantly increased fivefold, and he was enveloped in raging Blood Flames. His Power Explosion shook Jack Clark, forcing him to retreat.
Thump! Jack Clark landed more than ten meters away, looking calmly at Ma He, who had burned his Essence Blood and transformed into a three-meter-tall blood-colored monster with real blood pythons circling around him.
Ma He’s eyes were bloodshot, and his face was filled with madness and hatred, “Damn, all the Federation dogs like you deserve to die.”
“Especially geniuses like you from the Federation. Today I will drain all the blood from your body, hang your corpse on the mountain cliff, and let it dry for a hundred years to quench my hatred.”
Jack Clark stared at him curiously, “Are you crazy?”
Ma He angrily cursed, “You are crazy, your whole family is crazy.”
Jack Clark looked even more puzzled, “Since you’re not crazy, I haven’t killed your whole family. What do you hate? We’re just fighting to the death due to different stances.”
“…” Jack Clark’s words made Ma He pause, a trace of confusion flashed in his eyes. Right, what was he hating?
Boom!
At this moment, a sonic boom exploded, causing the dazzling golden red light to rapidly enlarge in front of Ma He’s eyes. An intense deathly aura instantly enveloped him.
Not good!
All the strength within Ma He’s body erupted, and the nine-headed Blood Pythons surrounding him roared to the sky. The nine snakeheads wrapped around Ma He, transforming into a real Blood Python and blasted out.
With the speed reminiscent of lightning, he drew a Z-shaped path.
At the forefront of the nine snakeheads, Ma He’s blood sword was like a snake’s tongue, spewing four-meter-long Sword Qi, instantly avoiding the halberd skill and stabbing towards Jack Clark.
But at this moment, the originally chopped battle halberd swept across.
Boom!
Like an intercontinental missile explosion, the earth shook and the mountains trembled in an instant. The dazzling golden-red and blood-colored lights continued to expand, and everything in their path was torn apart by the violent and sharp force.
In the midst of the turbulent wave of smoke and dust, a bloodied figure flew out, smashing heavily over a hundred meters away like a cannonball.
Thump! The bark of a large tree with a diameter of several meters and a height of hundreds of meters exploded, its branches shaking, and countless leaves falling from the sky like rain.
Cough! Cough!!
Ma He weakly leaned against the tree trunk, his battle armor shattered and covered in wounds that were so deep that his bones were visible. The surrounding flesh was torn open, revealing the wriggling blood and flesh that wanted to heal.But under an invisible sharp intention, those writhing flesh and blood always failed to heal.
At the edge of a crater with a diameter of more than ten meters, Jack Clark, wearing a black and red crystal armor, stood holding a halberd, emitting a terrifying aura so oppressive that it collapsed the void.
The ground within a few meters centered around him even sank slightly, as if it could not bear the weight.
With just two moves, a Late Sixth Heavenly Stage realm Ma He with the strength of the Sixth-level Heaven was severely wounded and on the verge of death.
This was the terrifying strength of Jack Clark after his breakthrough.
Ma He struggled to stand up, leaning on his broken Transcendent Battlesword, his expression even more crazed.
“I didn’t expect that after killing a mere Federal student, I’d be driven to this point. It seems I can’t continue fighting for the great Akunus god anymore.” “But today, even if I die, I’ll take you down with me.”
As he spoke, Ma He threw down his broken sword and knelt on the ground in a strange posture, reciting devoutly: “To seek the true path of the gods, sentient beings must pass through countless aeons. While in Hell, always think of the wise purpose…”
With Ma He’s devout recitation, the originally dim blood-colored flames on his body suddenly brightened and grew more and more vigorous. His entire being seemed to regain its former strength, as if the light of his spirit qi had returned.
Gradually, above his head in the void, a strange terrifying aura began to spread.
As if an unknown Supreme strong man who communicated with the void was about to descend with the help of his burning soul…
Bang!
With a sonic boom, a shattered golden-red world smashed towards Ma He, collapsing the ground and shattering the forest along the way, leaving a huge grand canyon on the earth.
Boom! An Infernal Purgatory attack exploded, bursting with even more dazzling golden-red light than before.
The power of dozens of times compressed instantaneously released, causing the earth to collapse and thousands of tons of mud to fly, forming a circle of destructive shockwaves that swept a hundred meters around.
No! Ma He’s cry of agony, filled with unwillingness and confusion, came from the center of the explosion.
As if asking why they didn’t wait for him to complete the ritual.
As the smoke and dust dispersed, a crater with a diameter of 20 meters appeared in the middle of the forest, surrounded by cracks as if it were a broken miniature world.
Jack Clark came to the edge of the crater and looked down at the shattered bloody remains at the bottom, saying indifferently, “Only a fool would stand there waiting for you to cast such a drawn-out attack.”
But just after he spoke, Jack Clark’s brow furrowed slightly.
From those shattered bloody remains, wisps of red mist spread out, coalescing in mid-air to form a blurred face.
Instantaneously, a terrifying aura, superior to that of mortal beings, spread out. It seemed as though a pair of invisible eyes had pierced through the endless Void and settled on Jack Clark.
Then, a terrifying voice resonated through the Void.
“Thou art quite impressive, managing to slay one of my blood bodies. At this age, you already have enough power to let me know your name.”
“Come on, mortal, tell me…”
Boom! Before the voice could finish, a golden-red light swirled around a War Halberd that swept horizontally through the air, wiping out the blood face.
Only then did Jack Clark speak indifferently, “I have not changed my name or surname, the most monstrous genius of the Northern Battlefield Sky Dragon Martial Height, Darren Callum.”
A faint voice came from the void.
“Darren Callum, I shall remember thee. When you come to the mythical world,
I will personally greet you..”

chapters.title: Chapter 321: 185 – How Could I, the Unbeatable, Run Away? Dominance Through Strength (Asking for Monthly Passes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: 185 – How Could I, the Unbeatable, Run Away? Dominance Through Strength (Asking for Monthly Passes)
Translator: 549690339
As he watched the blood mist disappearing into the void, Jack Clark’s expression became somewhat serious.
The Void Will Projection, this Blood God Akunus is quite strong.
Moreover, those Blood Envoys really are his avatars, their thoughts and ideas influenced by this ‘god’, full of hatred and madness for the Federation.
Of course, what makes him grave is the madness of these Evil God Sect Cultists.
They would burn their Essence Blood without a word, or even burn their souls if they couldn’t win. They would fight till death, extreme madness.
As for the Will descending from the Void, Jack Clark doesn’t care much.
Even if that Blood Envoy had completed the ritual, possessed by the Blood God’s Will and then burned his soul, the Blood Envoy would only have the strength for one blow.
But that one blow might be terrifying.
After all, with that existence surpassing the nine heavens’ understanding of strength, control of rules, he could at least unleash a hundred times the destructive power with a bit of his strength.
Looking at the empty crater, Jack Clark suddenly felt a headache coming.
Because with a blow from Infernal Purgatory, the Blood Envoy’s body was blasted into crumbs. Naturally, he was completely dead in this scenario, but it also meant that he couldn’t obtain the head.
He couldn’t just take a chunk of rotten meat for reporting, could he?
Whoosh! At this moment, there came the sound of breaking through the air in the distance
He saw a dazzling figure traversing the sky from the mountain ridge, covering several kilometers in a blink and rushing towards him.
In an instant, a majestic aura of the peak of the Sixth Heavens came rushing head-on, the powerful flames of True Strength even causing the Heavenly Energy to roll in the surrounding area, the aura was overwhelming.
“Teacher Clark!” Seeing the familiar face behind the transparent mask, holding a long spear and wearing the Elegant Azure and Red Phoenix Armor, Jack Clark was a bit surprised.
In addition to the surprise of meeting the class teacher here, he also felt that Teacher James’ strength seemed even stronger than he imagined.
The almost ready to step into Seventh Layer Heaven’s might made him feel solemn too.
If Jack Clark was surprised, James Clark was somewhat shocked.
Just now when the horse and the Essence Blood exploded, the base satellite above the sky had detected his aura, and in the instant of networking, it sent the message to the nearest team nearby.
Fortunately, James was only more than twenty kilometers away from here, so he quickly rushed over.
But after coming over, there was no enemy as he had anticipated, but her student.
Looking at the remnants of limbs and fragments in the pit emanating the aura of Blood God cultivation methods, and the leftover overbearing Divine Might in the air, James slowly said.
“The Sixth Layer of Dragon Elephant, you have condensed the Divine Tyrant Body!”
Jack Clark nodded: “Yes teacher, I have broken through the advanced Six Layer Dragon Elephant cultivation method and have firmly condensed the Divine Tyrant Body.”
For his own cultivation realm issue, Jack had never thought of hiding it, or rather he couldn’t hide it unless he did nothing.
Otherwise, as long as he killed a level 6 exotic beast, or as he did today kill an Evil God Sect Cultist, naturally it would expose itself.
Now that his cultivation method had broken through the Sixth Layer and he had condensed the Divine Tyrant Body, Jack felt even more confident, and some of the previous considerations were no longer issues.
But the most important thing is that in this period of time, both the school and the authorities gave him a feeling of ‘safety’.
There was no suppression or jealousy, nor was there any restraint on a genius, but instead, the overall atmosphere was positive and progressive.
“Where is your current cultivation realm at now?”
“Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.”
Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven!
James Clark was momentarily startled, because she clearly remembered that over twenty days ago, when this student entered the Alien Beast Battlefield, his cultivation was just at the early stage of Fourth Layer Heaven.
A breakthrough in less than a month to a major realm!!?
Sweeping away the shock in her heart, James’ face remained as always serious, her voice grave: “No wonder when you came in, Lori Parma asked me to pay more attention to you.”
“That’s right, your cultivation progress is quicker than we expected, but even so, you must not be arrogant. What is needed on the cultivation journey is unswerving persistence.”
“And with your talent, reaching the Fifth Layer Heaven is just the beginning, in the future, you’ll touch the threshold of Seven or Nine Heavens or even the King level.”
“I understand, teacher.”
Jack humbly agreed, and then asked: “Teacher, do you know how many Evil God Sect Cultists have come in this time?”
After thinking for a while, James replied: “According to the Intelligence Department’s estimation, the number of Evil God Sect Cultists incoming this time is about twenty, it won’t exceed too much.”
“And earlier, the base satellite network had already detected eleven bursts of Evil God Sect Cultists’ aura, multiple teams have rushed over to encircle.” “Adding the two people who were killed by military experts last night, and the one who was killed this morning, fourteen people can currently be confirmed.” Fourteen. Jack felt a sense of urgency.
If the estimated twenty or so heads, four have already died, another ten are being encircled, doesn’t that mean there are only six to seven heads left outside?
At this time, James asked: “Jack, will you be acting alone next or will you follow me?”
“Alone.”
Although Jack’s realm was only at the mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven, with his record of single-handedly killing an elite Evil God Sect Cultist without injury, he had qualified for acting alone.
James nodded: “Alright, let me apply for communication permissions for you.” Previously, when Jack was in the Alien Beast Battlefield, his identity was only that of a ‘normal’ Fourth Layer Heaven student and he didn’t have the qualifications to participate in the encirclement operation, therefore, he didn’t receive out-of-his-power-range information.
“Ms. James Clark, your application has been uploaded; please upload your current location and image.” James Clark’s watch spoke with a mechanical electronic voice.
“Your application has been approved. At the current location, the Blood God Sect Cultist has been eliminated, killed by Jack Clark, a first-grade cultivator..”

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 185 - How Could I, the Invincible, Run Away? Dominance Through Strength (Asking for Monthly Passes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 185 – How Could I, the Invincible, Run Away? Dominance Through Strength (Asking for Monthly Passes)_2
Translator: 549690339
Buzz!
Jack Clark’s smart wristwatch on his wrist shook slightly, followed by a blue light shooting out, forming a huge projection of a mountain range in midair.
There were hundreds of white dots scattered in the rear section of the mountain range. Among them, ten red-black rings were flickering slightly, representing the areas where the Evil God Sect Cultists were located.
Some white dots had already gathered around several red-black circles.
“Currently, there are more than 300 experts in the middle and late stages of the Sixth-level Heaven entering the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. They form small teams of two or three people, while those at the peak of the Sixth-level Heaven act alone.”
“Besides, some cultivation students in the late-stage Fifth Layer Heaven also joined the search.”
“Next, if you encounter an enemy that you can’t defeat during your mission, you can send a signal for help or notify other teams to encircle and suppress.”
“Also, be careful with those people from the Evil God Sect. They have more or less some strange means on them. If you can kill, kill them quickly and even grind their bones to ashes.”
“I understand, Teacher.”
Having given Jack Clark most of his instructions, James Clark disappeared in a flash. Soon after, the roar of an angry Mutated Beast came from behind a distant mountain peak.
The Cloud Mist Mountain Range was too vast and home to many powerful Unique Beasts.
As a result, when the Martial Cultivation Teachers searched the mountain range, one powerful Mutated Beast after another, originally reserved for the students’ practice, jumped out and was then slaughtered.
Looking in the direction where James Clark had left, Jack Clark lowered his head to look at the projection of the mountain range map on his wristwatch and chose to head in another direction with a black circle.
Hopefully, that head has not yet been taken away by someone else.
Just before James Clark had uploaded Jack Clark’s information and reported that he had killed a Blood God Sect Blood Envoy, a commotion erupted at the Monitoring Center of the rear military base.
“First Grade freshman, mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven!”
“He single-handedly killed a Blood Envoy at the late-stage or even the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven!?”
“Am I seeing this correctly?”
Many staff members doubted their eyes as they looked at the information about Jack Clark that had popped up on one side of the big screen.
Tyler Lance, sitting in the chair behind them, was much calmer than those astonished subordinates as he looked at the middle-aged man beside him thoughtfully:” Is this the student Mr. Leinster mentioned before?”
The middle-aged man nodded: “Yes, General. Last month, when Vernon Leinster and Lori Parma entered the Frontline Battlefield, he asked me to look after this student.”
“I’ve looked at his information before. He initially practiced the low-level Dragon Elephant Power, but he performed exceptionally well in Koroya’s trial, even cultivating the low-level Dragon Elephant Power to the point of Martial Arts Divine Charm…”
“Beware of his self-detonation.”
Boom!
As a dazzling blood light explosion occurred, a powerful shockwave swept across, causing the figures of three Martial Cultivation Teachers at the late Sixth Heavenly Stage to explode and retreat.
At this time, battles were breaking out everywhere in the rear section of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
There were encounters with high-level mutant beasts, and there were also searches and clashes with Evil God Sect Cultists.
With hundreds of Martial Cultivation Teachers hunting and killing, some cultivation students from the late-stage Fifth Layer Heaven joined together. About twenty so-called ’elite’ members of the Evil God Sect were chased and fleeing in a sorry state.
However, as long as there were battles, there would be casualties.
The destroyed ground was filled with fog in the mountain forest, trees had collapsed, and there were two corpses of students wearing battle armor lying around.
Over 2 meters tall, Mikus, wearing black armor, was surrounded by black smoke. His huge hand was holding a head, still showing an expression of horror.
It seemed that the person had never expected, even to his death, that a “person” could be so powerful.
Thump!
As he casually threw away the head, Mikus looked at the two corpses and arrogantly said, “A mere two individuals with late-stage Five Demonic Marks of the Human Race dare not to run away when they see me and even try to hunt me. They are simply overestimating their capabilities.”
“My Purgatory Family is invincible in the world, dominating the vast world for tens and hundreds of thousands of years, and no creatures are our opponents under the same level.”
Whoosh!
At this time, Mikus’s aura grew even more powerful, and the black demonic qi burned on the surface of his body.
From yesterday to now, he had killed several Level 6 Exotic Beasts and two Human Clan “geniuses,” absorbing their essence, qi, and blood, which restored some of Mikus’s strength.
However, what puzzled him was that there seemed to be too few Human Clan geniuses in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. He had only met two from yesterday to now.
Wasn’t the information saying that there were Human Clan geniuses all over the place in here?
“It seems the situation has changed.” Mikus spoke as the black demonic qi continued to converge and compress. Being cautious, Mikus’ body slowly transformed into a faint shadow.
However…
Boom!
A long spear, spanning hundreds of meters, pierced through the void with a piercing whistle. The fierce aura exuded by it couldn’t even be ignored by Mikus himself.
Boom!
The qi burst and the Spear Radiance swept over an area of tens of meters. Just as Mikus had concealed his aura and was about to disappear, his figure emerged, coldly staring at the direction ahead.
There, three figures shot towards him. As their True Strength and flames burned, they quickly landed in three different directions, surrounding Mikus.
Seeing the two corpses of cultivating students on the ground, the three teachers’ expressions turned cold.
“Purgatory Demon Race.”
“Two students are dead.”
“You damned bastard even dared to enter our world. I’m going to chop off your head, throw it under the base’s gate, and crush it forever.”
Mikus sneered as he was surrounded, coldly saying in the Federation language: “Humans, daring to act so arrogantly in front of the great Mikus, you’re courting death.”
“In just a moment, I will slowly crush your heads one by one, making you feel the despair.”
In his perception, the realm of these three humans was two at the intermediate stage of the Six Path Devil Marks and one at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, which wasn’t as high as his peak state..

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 185 - How Could I, the Unbeatable, Run Away? Dominance Through Strength (Asking for Monthly Passes)_3
chapters.content:
323  Chapter 185 - How Could I, the Unbeatable, Run Away? Dominance Through Strength (Asking for Monthly Passes)_3
Although its current realm has been suppressed due to the spatial mark and now at the early stage, but as the powerful True Demon Race, it can easily kill Human Race of the same level.
"Hmph! I've killed Purgatory Demons before"
"Exactly, as if we've never faced anything like this."
"Go, get him."
As they spoke, an even stronger aura burst out from the three teachers. At the same time, their Qi Blood circulated, and their wills combined, forming blood-red chains that seemed solid emerging from their bodies.
Crack!
An illusory chain of Blood Qi connected together, forming a web that covered a range of tens of meters, and instantly, an invisble oppressive force spread out.
Under this special willpower, the black flames burning on Mikus's body dimmed momentarily.
Mikus's expression changed drastically: "Blood Chain Lock Demon Array, you are not ordinary Human Race cultivators."
"Nonsense, I was a genius once."
Boom! Boom! Boom! !!
In an instant, the battle erupted. The three Martial Cultivation Teachers unleashed their True Strength, which was unparalleled sharp Sword Qi, Spear Radiance that intertwined and spanned over 3.58 meters.
With the added suppression of the array formed by the fusion of their willpower and Qi Blood, Mikus quickly fell into a disadvantage.
Bang! Suddenly, a dazzling black light burst forth, forming an ever-expanding fireball of flames.
In a moment, airwaves surged, fearsome shockwaves swept through the smoke and dust for over a hundred meters, giant trees collapsed, and the earth shook.
In the raging winds, a black light burst out and reappeared hundreds of meters away in an instant. It was indeed Mikus.
Now, he seemed a bit disheveled, completely devoid of his previous arrogance, and with a flash of his figure, he rushed into the depths of the forest without looking back.
"Damn! That devil had a Demon Crystal Bomb on him; otherwise, we would have killed him just now."
"Let's chase after him, Mr. Faris, you stay behind to clean up the bodies of those two students!"
"Notify the others; this is a noble of the Purgatory True Demon Race. It's quite powerful and might have inherited bloodline secrets."
After a brief exchange, two of the teachers turned into beams of light and chased after Mikus, leaving behind Flynt Freed, who was at the middle stage of the Sixth Heaven.
Looking at the corpses of the two students swept away by the aftermath of the battle, Flynt Freed shook his head slightly, walked over, and collected their bodies into the Sumeru Bracelet.
He planned to return later to hand them over to the school's logistics support department and send them back to the outside world.
As for life and death, these former 'teachers' who had returned after joining the military had seen countless lives come and go, and they were already used to it, even if these two students were talented geniuses cultivated by the school.
Geniuses only enjoy more resources, faster cultivation in the early stage, but it doesn't mean they won't die. DiisCoover 𝒖pdated novels on n(o)v./e/lbinco𝒎
Moreover, the official nurturing of geniuses has always included preparing the basic supporting resources, Cultivation Methods, which allows students to have a faster and more systematic head-start.
But if they want to access more in the future, they must display a certain level of strength, develop the habit of working hard and persevering, and not have everything spoon-fed to them.
Furthermore, in order to avoid producing flowers in a greenhouse, the school lets students face blood and opens up the Alien Beast Battlefield 'resource' point to them.
Here, the official school oversees the general direction, and students who want stability can stay in the base for 'daily' cultivation.
Those with better talent and a spirit for adventure and combat can hone themselves deep into the Nine Rings Mountain Range or even the more dangerous Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
This kind of grinding has a controllable degree of danger, and it can be considered as divided into first, second, and third levels.
As for going or not, the choice of which level depends on the student's preference.
In this sudden event, the authorities also estimated the risk level.
Unfortunately, these two students had bad luck. Not only did they not follow the request to form teams of four or five, but they also encountered a powerful Purgatory Demon Race. Otherwise, with their Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, their comprehensive strength had reached the peak of Fifth Layer Heaven and even touched the Early Sixth Heaven. Encounter with the elite of the Evil God Sect, they could escape unscathed.
Such a situation could only be said to be bad luck.
While Mikus was being chased and fleeing everywhere, Jack Clark's luck was good, and he encountered another Evil God Sect Cultist through map positioning.
In the valley, Kranter, who was three meters tall and had a more burly figure than Howard Lee, had black light flowing on his body, like a giant demon, emitting a terrible oppressive aura.
Looking at Jack Clark holding a halberd, Kranter's face showed a grinning smile: "Today, this old man is lucky, just shook off several human experts, and met a Federal Genius."
"After I crush all your bones and tear you in half in your despairing screams, just like the little guy last night," he said.
"Last night, he wailed for a long time before I finally tore his head off."
When describing last night's scene, Kranter's face showed a blissful expression, combined with his fierce appearance, it looked extremely hideous and abnormal.
Jack Clark slowly said, "So it seems that a student has already died at your hands."
"What, are you scared?" Kranter grinned, the black light on his four-meter-long Wolf Tooth Staff swallowed, and the ground beneath his feet exploded with a bang.
Boom! The air roared, and Kranter pounced on Jack Clark with a mad aura, casting a large shadow against the sunset.
But he was facing Jack Clark.
Boom!
An extremely violent power was released from Jack Clark's body, his muscles swelled and squeaked in battle armor, and his whole body was covered in golden dragon scales.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Under the release of endless physical strength, the ground under Jack Clark's feet collapses, the surrounding air bursts, forming invisible raging winds blowing in all directions, with the grass and trees bowing down within a range of ten meters.
Such a terrifying scene made Kranter's face change dramatically.
Boom!
At this moment, a battle halberd fell from the sky like a collapsing sky pillar, gathering an intangible heavy force, drawing in the surrounding light, as if the space itself was twisting.
Block it! Kranter roared in his heart, his inner power exploded completely, and his figure swelled again in an instant. He held the Wolf Tooth Staff in both hands and swept it from the bottom up.
Boom!
The moment the battle halberd and the Wolf Tooth Staff intersected, a circle of substantial black gold shockwaves erupted, and the surrounding air instantly annihilated under the terrible power, forming a twisted visual dark area.
With just one blow, Kranter was heavily injured. He was struck into the ground, forming a crater with a diameter of ten meters and half of his body was buried in the ground.
An unspeakable fear surged in Kranter's heart at what had just happened.
At this moment, he suddenly felt his hand loosen.
But before Kranter could react, golden red lights in his eyes zoomed at a speed his body couldn't keep up with... Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the heavy, overbearing attacks of the battle halberd, terrible energy shocks erupted with each strike, smashing the ground with each blow, and countless dirt flew into the sky under that substantial force.
After five halberd strikes, Jack Clark slowly stopped.
In front of him, within a range of tens of meters, there were now ruins, forming a fan-shaped pit, with cracks half a meter wide and tens of meters long spreading into the distance.
At the bottom of the pit laid Kranter, who had threatened to tear Jack Clark apart earlier, now only his upper body remained. The Wolf Tooth Staff in his hand had turned into a U-shape, and the Transcendent battle armor was shattered.
As for his lower body, it had long been shaken into mincemeat by the terrifying power of the heavy halberd.
At this time, Kranter's eyes were filled with incomprehension and astonishment.
It seemed that he could not believe that he would be killed by a Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven "student" of the Federation with an absolute dominant and invincible power.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 186: Targeting Jack Clark, Invincible in the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 186: Targeting Jack Clark, Invincible in the World
Translator: 549690339
After killing Kranter, Jack Clark slowly put away his War Halberd, and then searched the corpse.
“Strange, these guys don’t even have any storage space items. Are they that poor? Or is it that they can’t bring space equipment when they smuggle themselves over?” Jack murmured, feeling a bit disappointed.
Next, he took photographs and uploaded the data of the kill.
Then, he gathered some dry firewood to burn Kranter’s body, in order to prevent these followers of the Evil God Sect from having any means of ‘resurrection’.
Actually, Kranter was very strong. His Cultivation Methods were similar to Jack’s, both focusing on strength and defense, making his power extremely dominant.
Even though he was only at the peak of Fifth Layer Heaven due to his injuries, his fighting prowess could match up with a Mid-stage Sixth Layer Heaven cultivator.
This disbelief was why he had died in shock.
He, a powerful Sixth Heaven cultivator, was actually crushed and killed by a ‘student’, at the mid-stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, with sheer oppressive force.
The body of a Sixth Heaven cultivator is very powerful, especially this Giant God Sect Apostle who mainly cultivated his strength; it took almost an hour for Jack to burn him to ashes.
Meanwhile, as Jack was tending to the fire, the images he had previously uploaded once again caused a stir at the monitoring center.
“The student named Jack Clark has killed a second member of the Evil God Sect.”, one of them declared.
“Based on the information sent back by the teacher who pursued that cultist earlier, this cultist came from the Giant God Sect and was very strong, with combat power around the level of Mid-stage Sixth Heaven.”, another explained.
“A mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven student’s killing of a mid-stage Sixth Layer Heaven cultist… This student is remarkable. His strength could well put him in the top ten on the Southern Battle Achievement Rankings.”, came another voice.
“Forget the top ten, I have a feeling that he could easily surpass the top ten on the list.”
“Remember, he killed this Giant God Sect Apostle without any injury, which suggests that his strength has exceeded even the mid-stage Sixth Heaven stage. And he’s just a first-year. It’s scary.”
