“That’s right. I also think that the students in the top ten wouldn’t be his match. Those students haven’t fought each other; their rankings are solely based on accumulated points, which makes it quite arbitrary.”
“What happened to Ethan Polis, who was once ranked first on the list? He ended up being killed by an infiltrator from the Shadow God Sect.”
“Yeah, when these guys first infiltrated here, their strength was mostly at the late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, which is even lower than Ethan Polis who was at the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven at that time.”
“In terms of combat power, which of these ‘genius’ students doesn’t have the ability to fight across realms? Yet they were ambushed and killed under such circumstances. It’s really embarrassing for our Southern battlefield.”
When the staff mentioned Ethan Polis, the top ‘genius’ student on the original achievement list, they were all somewhat speechless, feeling that he had lost face for the Southern battlefield.
They couldn’t help it though. After all, the other kid from the Berlin battlefield, when faced with a spatial rift, not only killed an infiltrating member of the Evil God Sect, but also brought the news back.
Comparatively, their students on the Southern battlefield of this generation seemed strictly inferior.
Of course, they did not know that Ethan Polis was already heavily injured by Ilisa Wesley at that time.
If not for that, with his combat power which had killed a late-stage level 6 Mutated Beast, it was hard to tell who would have killed who. But it was likely that he would still have been assassinated by the infiltrator in the end.
Because a large part of his so-called Late Sixth Heavenly Stage power came from the extraordinary battle armor and weapon he had forged three times over.
This was why Ilisa Wesley finally looked down on him; despite reaching the Peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven, he still hadn’t seen his path clearly.
Roaring sounds were heard in the distance.
Deep in the mountain range, many level 5 and level 6 Mutated Creatures roared, their terrifying power shaking heaven and earth.
But soon, these Mutated Creatures fell to the even more formidable Martial Cultivation Teachers.
After this incident, the number of level 5 and level 6 Mutated Beasts in the deep Cloud Mist Mountain Range was expected to decrease by a large quantity and would not recover anytime soon – they were all eliminated.
And because they were pursuing the members of the Evil God Sect, their corpses could only be left there. At most, the valuable parts were cut off and taken away.
As for using the Storage Space to carry out the entire corpse… Even these Martial Cultivation Teachers did not have the financial means to upgrade the Sumeru Bracelet to that extent.
Soon, the sky began to darken.
As the day went by, out of the twenty-three infiltrators, apart from Ilisa Wesley and Mikus, who had been wounded and escaped, more than half of the others died or were injured unexpectedly.
Under the connected base satellite and those transmitters forming a network covering the entire Cloud Mist Mountain Range, their fate was inevitably sealed once their breath was exposed.
Now, only seven of them remained.
However, these people already knew that genius human cultivators were hunting them, so they hid deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, making them difficult to detect due to its vast size.
Night fell.
Kneeling on a small hill backed by a mountain wall, with a cliff about a hundred meters ahead, Jack threw the three-meter-long body of a regular Mutated Beast onto the ground, igniting a fire.
After meeting Jane Aiken, Jack found that this kind of dangerous environment was more suitable for resting than digging a hole in a big tree.
Even if he started a fire, it was less likely to attract Mutated Creatures.
Jack took out his phone during dinner, found Jane Aiken’s number in the group chat of South Sky Martial Height, opened temporary private chat and sent her a message.
Of course, he didn’t forget about the potential member of the Evil God Sect.
Almost when Jack was nearly full, Jane Aiken replied.
The content was simple, Ilisa had spent the entire day ‘exchanging ideas’ with her. Seeing this, Jack nodded slightly and didn’t ask further.
He believed that Jane Aiken, who had received the information about the infiltration of the Evil God Sect in the afternoon when the whole network was connected, would make the right decision. He didn’t have to interfere…at least for the time being..

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 186: Targeting Jack Clark, Invincible in the World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 186: Targeting Jack Clark, Invincible in the World_2
Translator: 549690339
After eating and drinking, Jack Clark cleaned up and sat down with his back against the mountain wall, starting his cultivation for today under the cliff. Humm!
As Jack Clark began to cultivate, the heavenly energy within a hundred-meter radius around him surged towards him. His pores were wide open, absorbing and exhaling the Heavenly Energy.
With the sixth-level cultivation method realm and the Divine Tyrant Body condensed with a trace of Dragon Elephant Behemoth’s strength, Jack Clark’s cultivation speed became astonishing.
He felt that even without using resources, merely cultivating in the mountains would allow him to break through to the later stage of the Fifth Layer in just over a month and reach the Six-layer Heaven within four months.
Soon, Jack Clark’s consciousness sank into cultivation and he connected with the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Under the night sky, the sea waves swayed. A nineteen-meter-long Mutated Tiger Whale frolicked in the sea with its two eighteen-meter-long siblings, making chirping sounds.
Not far away, a thirty-four-meter-long black and white Tiger Whale with a level 7 aura was swimming around, watching over the three smaller Tiger Whales.
Thanks to the hard work of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the growth of the Tiger Whale family of four had been quite good, although it had become a bit tired itself.
At this time, dozens of meters deep below the sea surface, a ferocious behemoth covered in black-red scale armor, forty-five meters long, was feasting.
Under the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claw, it held a Giant Crab that was fifteen meters long and wide, with a pair of pincers that were two meters long.
The behemoth ferociously snapped its huge mouth, crushing a huge crab pincer. The tender and chewy crab meat instantly filled its taste buds, emitting a rich meaty aroma.
Roar! Delicious. The Thunderflame Behemoth let out a satisfied growl.
This was the first time it had eaten such tasty crab.
Crack crack! The Thunderflame Behemoth chewed and swallowed the crab pincers and legs in a few bites, then bit the crab’s back shell, causing rich, oily crab meat to flow out.
Roar! This crab roe is so fragrant.
The Thunderflame Behemoth didn’t expect the mutated crabs to taste even better than their non-mutated counterparts. Each mouthful was filled with happiness from the crab roe and crab meat.
Under the giant beast’s devouring, countless remains of flesh and blood overflowed through the cracks of its sharp teeth and floated in the seawater.
Soon, the dozens of tons of Level 5 early stage mutated Giant Crab were consumed, and the behemoth’s body grew visibly larger.
But it still felt so hungry.
After eating the entire mutated Giant Crab, the Thunderflame Behemoth looked around at its empty surroundings.
In just a few days, under the catalysis of the Growth Crystal, it had grown nearly eight meters long, a shocking growth rate of over a meter per day, making its body more and more enormous.
However, the Growth Crystal could only activate their rapid growth, and the energy required for that growth still needed to be replenished, otherwise, their bodies would be pushed to the limit.
As a result, the mutated creatures within a square of several hundred miles had suffered from their relentless hunting.
To quickly replenish their energy for rapid growth, the Thunder flame Behemoth, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle needed to hunt more high-rank behemoths or find some high-energy resources.
Just as the Thunderflame Behemoth was pondering while tapping its claws on the coral, shattering it into powder, the sound of a deep roar came from the distance.
Chirp Chirp Chirp! Daddy is back! The Tiger Whale Biggest Brother swam over excitedly.
Of course, when it said ‘daddy,’ it only meant the sentiment, not actually saying the word ‘daddy.’
Chirp Chirp Chirp! Wooh… Tiger Whale Second Brother tried to mimic the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s call but failed.
Chirp Chirp Chirp! Tiger Whale Third Brother couldn’t ‘speak’ yet.
The three ‘small’ Tiger Whales swam around the returning Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, excitedly rubbing their bodies against it until the Female Killer Whale came over and made them step back.
Chirp Chirp Chirp! The Female Killer Whale gently rubbed her head against the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
Chirp Chirp Chirp!
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish caressed his ‘wife’ with its huge fin, and the two Mutated Tiger Whales exchanged words in their unique language while rubbing against each other in the sea.
This scene made the Thunderflame Behemoth’s eyes sting as the couple flaunted their love right in front of it – the single ‘dog.’
Thankfully, at that moment, a huge figure appeared on the coast. The forty-six-meter-long Deep Sea Dragon Turtle walked into the sea step by step, causing waves to roll.
In its mouth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was holding a basin-sized shell containing some water and a dozen transparent white small crystal stones.
Of course, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle wouldn’t have been smart enough to find something to hold the crystals.
Initially, it was planning to carry the crystals in its mouth, but the Thunderflame Behemoth slapped it and then found a Mutated Shell for it to use instead.
The Thunderflame Behemoth had no interest in eating other Mutant Beast’s saliva.
As the water was about to submerge its head, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle looked at the still-flirting Tiger Whale couple in the distance and let out a muffled growl with its mouth closed.
Growl Growl! Joe, stop rubbing or you’ll break your scales. Come share the loot!
Chirp Chirp Chirp! Coming!
Shortly after, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish brought its family and followed the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle to the coral reef group a few kilometers away, where the Thunderflame Behemoth was waiting for them.
After that day, suspecting he was observed by a human satellite, the Thunderflamc Behemoth had rarely come ashore, and even its exposure to the sea surface was minimal.
Growl Growl! Thunderflame, all the good things today are here.
In a low growl, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle placed the shell in front of the Thunderflamc Behemoth.
Roar! Let me see how much there is.
Thunderflame Behemoth lowered its head and looked into the shell, containing eleven crystal stones of various sizes. The largest one was about the size of a black chicken egg, and the smallest was about a circle smaller than a pigeon egg-
For these colossal creatures, over forty meters long, these small stones were as insignificant as a grain of sand in the eyes of humans..

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 186: Targeting Jack Clark, Invincible in the World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 186: Targeting Jack Clark, Invincible in the World_3
Translator: 549690339
However, whether it was the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish or the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, both were staring at the crystals with intense gazes, watching as the Thunderflame Behemoth slowly moved them with its huge claws.
Roar! Let’s stick to the old rules: divide the crystals into ten equal parts based on volume, I’ll take four parts, Joe takes three, and Domination, you also take three.
Roar! Roar! Yes, understood.
Ying! Ying! Ying! No problem.
Soon, the Thunderflame Behemoth set aside the two largest crystals, and then divided the remaining nine crystals into two smaller piles: one with four crystals and one with five crystals.
Roar! Domination, you take the part with four, and the part with more is left to Joe, since he has a bigger family.
Roar! Roar! No problem.
Technically, considering the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s ‘contribution’, it shouldn’t have occupied three parts, but it has to guard the resources later and face the constant threat of possible attacks from humans.
That’s why the Thunderflame Behemoth gave it a little more.
In this way, everyone’s share of the gains was more or less fair.
Moreover, the number of these Growth Crystals is not fixed daily; sometimes there can be more than twenty, and sometimes even just a few, much less than what it had initially expected.
As for the cause, it is related to the riverbed current on the other side.
Every afternoon and evening, for some reason, the current on the other side becomes stronger, and in just over an hour, three to four crystals could be washed over.
But when the water flow becomes gentle, it may take half a day for a crystal to fall.
However, even so, this greatly accelerated the growth of the Thunderflame Behemoth, which, in just a few days, went from being the shortest in the group to the longest.
After dividing the loot, the next step was devouring.
The Thunderflame Behemoth opened its mouth slightly and controlled the water flow to swallow the two largest Growth Crystals into its body. An instant burst of power echoed through the air.
Crack! Crack!
Visibly, the already large Thunderflame Behemoth grew to an astonishing length of forty-six meters in just a blink of an eye, appearing more ferocious and fierce.
Roar! The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also excitedly swallowed four smaller crystals, and soon its size expanded as if inflating a balloon.
Then it was the turn of Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
One crystal for each member of their family.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale swallowed the largest one, while the Female Killer Whale and the three Little Tiger Whales each consumed a small one. Instantly, they all grew visibly.
However, compared to the Thunderflame Behemoth and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the growth of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish family was much less significant.
This was still after the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had been chastised by the Thundcrflame Behemoth.
When the Growth Crystals were first discovered and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish brought its family over, it gave all the crystals to the Female Killer Whale and the Little Tiger Whales.
Subsequently, it was taught a lesson by the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claws.
How can one bring more good things to their family if they don’t improve their strength? It’s simply putting the cart before the horse.
This issue has been brought up by the Thunderflame Behemoth two or three times, but the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish might simply be too much of a “good man” and just can’t remember to prioritize itself, causing the big brother to be quite stressed.
I’m so hungry.
After eating Growth Crystals, the Thunderflame Behemoth felt even hungrier and couldn’t help but look at the forty-five-meter-long Single-horned Tiger Whale and let out a low growl: Roar! Joe, have you not found any more good stuff?
Ying! Ying! Ying! We found two far away, but they are guarded by fierce creatures. We can’t defeat them.
By “can’t defeat”, they mean Level 9 Giant Beast Guardians.
Roar! Damn it, these guys are actually occupying our good stuff.
Roar! Joe, remember the locations of those two places, and when I get stronger, we’ll go and kick their asses.
Roar! Roar! Yes, kick their asses, let them know they can’t keep the good stuff.
Ying! Ying! Ying! Don’t worry, Thunderflame, I made a mark. I’ll just wait for you to lead us to defeat them later.
The conversation between the three giant creatures was full of banditry, and they didn’t look like decent Mutant Beasts at all.
Yet, the Female Killer Whale, who was watching them loudly conspire, didn’t feel anything amiss and was even excitedly chiming in, eager to join the action.
This is the world of Mutated Creatures, where strength is supreme. There’s no order or morality like in the human world; survival of the fittest rules.
In fact, the gathering of different Mutated Creature species like this is quite rare.
As Jack Clark’s attention was focused on the Thunderflame Behemoth’s side, the air more than a hundred meters away from him twisted slightly in the darkness near the edge of the bushes.
Invisibly, the dead grass on the ground sagged slightly, forming giant footprints that gradually got closer to Jack Clark, who was cultivating cross-legged.
While invisible and hiding, Mikus suppressed his aura to the utmost, his dark red pupils hollow and devoid of any killing intent, transparent and empty.
This way, he could avoid the overtly intense killing intent in his eyes from triggering any response from his target, while also remaining vigilant to any changes in his surroundings and the target.
As the ruling clan of a vast region in the world, the Purgatory Demon Race’s power system and inheritance are more complete and powerful than the Human Race.
Especially for the Purgatory Demon nobles, nearly every single one of them has a set of complete Demon Arts Inheritance.
This Inheritance includes offensive Demon Arts and techniques, instant speed boost for escapes, or breath and invisibility control during assassinations and ambushes.
You could say it’s quite comprehensive.
That’s why he was able to escape the Martial Cultivation Teachers’ encirclement quickly after being exposed during the day and gradually move away from the center of the hunt.
Unbeknownst to him, he has encountered a Federal Genius here.
Moreover, judging from the realm aura emitted during cultivation, it’s at the Five Paths of Demonic Marks Middle Stage, which is equivalent to the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven of the Human Race.
With such a weak level of cultivation, his current strength would enable him to kill them instantly without giving them any chance to send a signal or expose anything.
Once I kill this Federal Genius and absorb his essence, blood, and Qi, my cultivation should be able to recover to the Sixth-Stage Demon Marks Intermediate Stage.
By then, if I encounter those human squads again, as long as none of them are at the peak of the Six Path Devil Marks stage, killing them will be as easy as turning my hand.
At that time, they’ll know what it means to be unbeatable at the same level, what it means to be proud in this world.
As Mikus sneered in his heart and slowly approached while controlling his breath and killing intent, Jack Clark, who had been closing his eyes in cultivation, suddenly opened his eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 187: Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon, Mythical Dragon Elephant Descends (Monthly Book Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 187: Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon, Mythical Dragon Elephant Descends (Monthly Book Ticket)
Translator: 549690339 |
“I didn’t expect Contribution Points to come knocking at this late hour.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark slowly got up, took out the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd from his bracelet, and covered his face with a mask. He looked at Mikus, who was hiding in stealth.
Jack was feeling good at this moment.
After killing the Giant God Sect cultist during the day, he had traveled almost a thousand kilometers, but did not encounter anything.
He originally thought there was no hope, because most of the cultists had been killed. But he didn’t expect someone to offer himself up for the kill at night. “Human, how did you discover me?” Mikus’ deep voice echoed as he slowly appeared in the air, his brows furrowing slightly, inexplicably feeling irritated.
This invasion had been full of setbacks.
He had originally planned to recover most of his strength within half a month, but he was exposed in just a few days and then surrounded by numerous human experts.
Being surrounded wasn’t a problem. With his recovery to the early stage of the Six Paths of Demonic Marks, he could easily kill humans of the same realm. Even those in the late stages were nothing to him.
Even if he was momentarily at a disadvantage, he could still escape. If the opponent fought to the death, Mikus could even rely on his Demon Body to exhaust the other party.
However, he didn’t expect that those humans would form groups of at least three people, and cultivate the Blood Chain Lock Demon Array, specifically designed to kill the Purgatory Demon Race elite.
Even Mikus had to pay a small price to escape when his demonic powers were suppressed.
And now, a seemingly weak human genius had discovered him while he was in stealth.
Looking at Mikus, whose appearance was different from humans, Jack’s eyes revealed a trace of surprise, “Which Evil God Sect’s apostle are you? This form looks quite strong.”
Jack had never seen the Purgatory Demon Race, nor had he encountered any related information, so he mistakenly thought that Mikus was an apostle of some Evil God Sect.
It was similar to those Blood Envoys who transformed into non-human monsters after changing their forms.
But Jack’s words made Mikus feel insulted, and his voice turned cold, “Lowly human, I am the great Purgatory True Demon, not some garbage from the Divine Sect Alliance.”
“Next, I will make you die in even more pain, as a punishment for your offense to the great True Demon Clan.”
As he spoke, Mikus took out a four-meter long demonic spear covered in scale patterns from his bracelet. In an instant, his aura changed, and a terrifying atmosphere began to spread from him as the center.
Under this terrible atmosphere, all the snakes, insects, rats, ants, and mutated creatures within a hundred meters fled in fear. This was a fear that came from the instinct of life itself.
This astonishing scene made Jack’s eyes narrow, and he said slowly, “Purgatory True Demon, you’re a different race from my Human Race, right?”
“Indeed.”
Mikus raised his chin slightly, in a proud manner, and said, “The Purgatory True Demon Clan has stood tall in the Endless World for tens of thousands of years, and cannot be compared to the Human Race that has just entered the Endless World.”
“Each member of my True Demon Clan is extremely powerful, sweeping away all other races, unrivaled among their peers, and famous throughout the Endless World.”
“So powerful! No wonder so many strong men of our Human Race have gone to the mythical world.” Mikus’s words made Jack even more solemn.
No wonder the official information he encountered when he entered the Alien Beast Battlefield gave him a feeling of severely lacking firepower, which was why they desperately developed military weapons.
It seems that tonight will be a fierce battle.
This true demon of the early Sixth Heaven should be quite strong; otherwise, he wouldn’t dare to claim invincibility among his peers when facing other races.
Immediately, Jack became excited, and his blood began to boil.
Since his breakthrough, he hadn’t encountered an opponent worth going all out against. Even the Evil God Sect Cultists with higher realms were killed in just a few moves.
Under such circumstances, he always felt that his strength had nowhere to be vented.
Jack took a deep breath, and his muscles swelled as an infinite amount of terrifying power began to be released. In a deep voice, he said, “Human Race, Darren Callum.”
Seeing the suddenly serious human, Mikus inexplicably felt a little uneasy.
What’s going on? He’s just a human genius with Five Demonic Marks in the middle stage, so why does Mikus feel that he’s somewhat dangerous?
Mikus slowly stepped forward, speaking solemnly, “Remember, your killer today will be the noble of the Purgatory True Demon Clan, Mikus Drick. Holmes Gale. Briare…”
Facing Jack, who introduced himself in a knightly manner, Mikus responded courteously, which was his etiquette as a Purgatory noble.
Of course, the main reason was that Jack didn’t call for help; otherwise, Mikus wouldn’t be interested in talking and would have attacked to kill him with thunderous force.
Boom!!
As Mikus moved, the earth shattered, and the air exploded in an instant. The black magic spear pierced the void, and the invisible demon gas enveloped the sky, shocking everyone.
Faced with such a terrifying attack, a dragon roar and an elephant roar came from Jack’s body. In an instant, his muscles exploded with power, and his body was covered with golden scales, resembling a humanoid dragon elephant.
Under the materialized Divine Tyrant aura, the air around Jack burst, forming rings of white raging wind waves with an astonishing momentum.
The halberd skill in his hands swelled to over five meters, like a colossal war halberd sweeping across, rolling up a large swath of golden red light shining in the night sky.
Facing an invincible true demon of the same realm, Jack unleashed his full power in his normal state, activating the Divine Tyrant Body.
Boom!
As the golden-red light-wrapped halberd swept down, the demon gas surrounding the magic spear collapsed in an instant. Mikus then felt an indescribable overbearing force coming at him..

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 187: Arrival of the Mythical Dragon Elephant and the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon (Book Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 187: Arrival of the Mythical Dragon Elephant and the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon (Book Monthly Ticket)_2
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
He was flung backward like a cannonball, carrying a raging wave of white energy and crashing into the mountain forest a hundred meters away. The violent impact sent the mountain forest shaking and a cloud of smoke and dust soaring into the sky.
This scene left Jack Clark dumbfounded.
No way, little brother, didn’t you say that your True Demon Race is invincible among your peers? How come you couldn’t even withstand my full-force strike in my normal state?
That terrifying aura that caused fear among living beings was indeed frightening, like a godly demon, but it was unexpectedly so weak.
Not only was Jack dumbfounded at the moment, but Mikus, who had been sent flying by the strike, was also completely flabbergasted.
How…How could I, a member of the True Demon Race, have been sent flying by a human’s attack!
And, what’s more, this human’s realm is one Major Realm lower than mine!?
Having crashed through two large trees and leaving a large pit in the ground, Mikus holding his magic spear had a bewildered expression on his face, as if questioning his existence.
Then came the shame, and following this feeling, the shame transformed into rage – a boundless rage that welled up from within him.
Boom!
Cracks started to appear in the black armor covering Mikus’s body as the boundless demon gas within him erupted, transforming into rolling black smoke that rose into the sky.
At the same time, an even more powerful and terrifying aura that made all living beings tremble spread out.
Roars!!
In an instant, all the Mutated Creatures, regardless of size, let out fearful roars within the mountain forest and, driven by instinctual fear, they frantically fled in all directions. The scene was very spectacular.
Creak…Creak!!
The sound of bones stretching could be heard from within the thick black demonic qi. Soon, with heavy footsteps, a gigantic figure emerged from the forest.
The appearance of Mikus had changed significantly. His stature had grown to over three meters, his body was covered in blood-red scales, and he had even grown a pair of robust arms under his arms.
The extra arms were each holding a two-meter-long cone sting and a narrow, 1.5-meter-long curved knife, respectively.
In addition, two large lumps had grown around his neck, making him appear somewhat disgusting and gruesome. It seemed as if at any moment, a head would drill out from within them.
What was more important was that Mikus’s aura had suddenly increased almost tenfold, forming a terrifying field of force around him that pressed the earth into continuously forming cracks.
Plus, his prominent bent corners and the poison snake-like tail swaying behind his body, all under the envelopment of rolling demonic qi, made him look like a demon incarnate; or, perhaps you could say that he was a demon.
“Human, this is my real appearance, the True Demon Body. I had sealed most of my power before for the sake of conveniently entering your world,” Mikus growled.
“You should feel proud for having the honor of witnessing my full form.”
Jack Clark slowly nodded, “I see. I was wondering why you were so weak, practically not being able to withstand a single hit.”
However, this time Jack Clark didn’t believe his words. Even a fool could tell by now that Mikus had activated his power explosion tactic, something similar to the Elephant’s Fury Rune.
Boom!
The ground exploded, and Mikus disappeared from the spot in an instant, charging toward Jack Clark at a speed surpassing that of sound.
The dazzling black light flashing on the magic spear in his hand distorted the light wherever it passed. It seemed as if space itself had been tom apart to form a black pathway.
Just as Mikus neared Jack, the magic spear in his hand burst open, turning into eight ten-meter-long black spear shadows that fell from all directions.
In an instant, a ring of round golden-red light centered on Jack Clark exploded and rapidly expanded to form a true strength energy wall that was five meters tall as it swept past, shattering and blocking all the magic spears.
Boom!
A dazzling shockwave of black and gold light burst out, causing the earth to collapse wherever it passed, with countless clods of dirt being flung violently in all directions under the terrifying force.
In the raging breeze of force, a magic spear hung in the air, surrounded by a sinister black demonic qi that seemed to form an illusory and ferocious demonic figure howling at the sky.
Especially the pitch-black spear tip that resembled a black hole was exuding a terrifying aura that could pierce through everything.
Roar!
The Dragon Roar Elephant Roar boomed, and the golden-red battle halberd shot out, streaking across the sky and earth in an instant. Its trajectory changed dozens of times, blocking the magic spear that had pierced the void.
Just at the moment of intersection between the halberd and the magic spear, the Dragon Elephant True Strength that was breathing on the halberd exploded.
Boom! The dazzling golden-red light almost lit up the night sky, setting off a ring of white waves that rolled out over a hundred meters.
With Jack Clark and Mikus at the center, the earth collapsed, forming a pit with a diameter of over twenty meters, making it seem as if two giant beasts were facing off against each other.
At this moment, Jack Clark shook his wrist as the Dragon Roar Elephant Roar resounded within his body. The burst of strength sent both of them flying.
Just as they were about to land, an explosion erupted beneath their feet and at supersonic speed, they transformed into a golden-black light and shot out, fiercely colliding once again.
Boom!
The heavy halberd emanated a dazzling golden-red light as it clashed with the pitch-black and overbearing magic spear. Their constant clash produced crackling and exploding noises.
Creak…Creak!!
The ground under Jack Clark’s feet cracked and split, with cracks spreading out over a dozen meters.
However, even though Mikus’s arms swelled with muscles and his demonic body’s strength erupted, he still couldn’t pressure Jack Clark, who was covered in Golden Dragon Scales and had the Dragon Roar Elephant Roar reverberating within him.
This was the terror of the Divine Tyrant Body, making Jack Clark like a real humanoid dragon, his strength overbearing and unrivalled.
Even Mikus, who had activated his bloodline magic and entered the incomplete Three Heads and Six Arms True Demon Body, could not suppress him with strength.
The invisible demonic might that caused fear among organisms was also blocked by the divine might emanating from Jack, causing the surrounding air to continuously produce dull rumbles as two substantive auras collided.
Looking at Jack Clark, who was wearing battle armor, and was much shorter than himself, Mikus said with a deep voice, “Darren, you have the privilege of letting me remember your name..”

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 187: Arrival of the Mythical Dragon Elephant and the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon (Book Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 187: Arrival of the Mythical Dragon Elephant and the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon (Book Monthly Ticket)_3
Translator: 549690339
As he said it, the curved knife tip in its armpit glided noiselessly toward Jack Clark.
The strange black light on the knife’s tip swirled, blotting out light wherever it passed, without making a sound, but…
Jack Clark’s hands shook, dislodging the magic spear on his War Halberd. In an instant, he shifted his right foot, the halberd forming a circular motion.
Boom! The overbearing halberd swept away the curved knife’s tip, along with the magic spear that pierced the void again.
At this moment, Jack Clark leaped forward, the halberd blasting horizontally. The Dragon Roar Elephant Roar filled his body, and his aura filled Heaven and Earth, like an enraged Dragon Elephant.
Boom boom boom!
Under the night sky, gold-red and black intertwined and collided, causing the ground to collapse, mountains and forests to explode, stirring up violent wind waves.
Earth-shattering roars echoed endlessly.
Under Jack Clark’s full power, each strike of the two-ton battle halberd reached supersonic speed.
Moreover, besides simple speed and strength, the moves were instinctively smooth, more ferocious than a combat knife when slashing and stabbing.
In addition to the versatility of its hooked bend, the halberd seemed ever-changing in his hands, blocking the oncoming magic spears, curved knives, and cone stings.
However, Mikus, who claimed to be unbeatable at the same level, was not weak either. The True Demon Body not only increased demonic Qi by tenfold but also greatly enhanced physical strength.
For a time, the battle remained evenly matched, with the aftermath destroying everything around them.
Whenever the golden-red halberd skill landed on the ground, violent explosions would ensue, forming huge deep pits, and the overflowing sharp halberd energy shattered everything around it.
However, despite the standoff, Mikus’ expression became increasingly serious.
It was well aware that the longer it entangled with the human, the greater the chance of being surrounded and killed, and its whereabouts might already have been exposed.
Besides, the partially activated True Demon Body consumed a lot of its energy.
Jack roared, “Ten Directions Demon Arrival!”
As Mikus roared, an explosion of boundless demonic Qi from its body enveloped everything like rolling black smoke, blotting out the sun.
In the darkness, black spears more than ten meters long rained from the sky, bringing a terrifying force, crashing toward Jack Clark.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
The intensive bombardment of black magic spears turned the area within several dozen meters into a ravaged wasteland, leaving only the shockwaves of destruction echoing between heaven and earth.
Roar!
At this moment, a terrifying Dragon Roar rang out in the void amidst the explosion, followed by a frightening aura that even Mikus felt.
Boom! Under the solidified aura, the dark clouds formed by the Ten Directions Demon Arrival broke apart, revealing Jack Clark at the center of the explosion.
At this point, he appeared like a different person. His height surged from 1.87 meters to 2 meters, his muscles expanded, and his battle armor squeaked under the strain.
Golden-red flames burned on his body, the fire reaching three meters high, like a dazzling humanoid torch, exuding a terrifying force that shook even the void.
An indescribable terrifying force distorted the light, faintly forming a giant beast phantom with scale armor, elephant body, dragon tail, and dragon claws behind Jack Clark.
As the Dragon Elephant phantom emerged, a sense of oppressive power filled the void, and the chanting of the dragon and elephant echoed in the emptiness of space.
“Mikus, face my move.”
As his voice fell, the golden-red flaming halberd hung in the air, the void trembling with the Dragon Roar Elephant Roar, unleashing a terrifying force from the Mythical Giant Beast.
Boom! With a single blow, a large swath of the void collapsed, a visual distortion formed by the air within a hundred meters being instantly drained.
At this moment, Mikus felt the entire world trembling, the invisible roar echoing in the void, impossible to escape or evade.
Roar!
Under the intense breath of death, Mikus’ demonic Qi erupted, rolling like a pillar of black smoke rushing into the sky, with a faint appearance of a three-headed, six-armed phantom behind it.
As Mikus swung his magic spear, the three-headed, six-armed phantom followed suit, an ethereal force blessing him, causing his momentum to surge.
The golden-red flaming halberd and the magic spear met amidst the raging demonic Qi.
Boom! A dazzling gold-red halo exploded, stirring up a white wave like a nuclear explosion, illuminating the night sky.
Under Jack Clark’s activation of the Elephant’s Fury Rune, the three-headed, six-armed phantom behind Mikus instantly collapsed.
Boom! With one blow, half of the hillside collapsed, huge cracks spreading in all directions, like a hideously twisted and weeping specter.
When the smoke and dust cleared, Mikus stood proudly in the collapsed hillside pit, holding his spear.
However, at this moment, its entire body was covered in fissures, including the magic spear, cone sting, and curved knife, resembling a shattered porcelain doll.
“…I won’t accept it!”
Thud!
Black demonic Qi spewed from Mikus’ body, the magic spear shattered, and its body collapsed backward, eyes filled with intense reluctance as it gazed at the night sky.
It hadn’t restored its family’s glory nor had it grown into a Great Demon King- How could it die in a small human place, killed by a human of a lower realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 187: Arrival of the Mythical Dragon Elephant and the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon (Book Monthly Ticket)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 187: Arrival of the Mythical Dragon Elephant and the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon (Book Monthly Ticket)_4
Translator: 549690339 |
Not far away, golden red flames burned intensely on Jack Clark’s body, emitting a terrifying aura, and his breath stirred up raging winds, making him look like an enraged beast.
Whoosh!
Feeling the life force in Mikus disappear, Jack Clark let out a breath, slowly suppressing the burning Qi Blood and True Strength within his body, restoring his normal size. Immediately after, a powerful sense of weakness spread throughout his body.
This feeling of weakness was so intense that it was as if he had experienced multiple orgasms for several consecutive days.
Boom! Leaning on his war halberd, Jack Clark panted and said with a solemn expression, “The more I progress, the greater the side effects of Elephant’s Fury become.”
With his strength and terrifying physical body improving, Jack found that the Elephant’s Fury Rune he had obtained at the Third Layer Heaven wasn’t keeping up.
The Elephant’s Fury Rune could increase his strength and Defense tenfold, which had played a significant role in previous battles.
However, as Jack’s power grew, the flaws in the Elephant’s Fury Rune became more apparent.
During the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase, he could endure intense battles for more than ten minutes, but after reaching the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, he could only unleash its power for a few moments before feeling weak for half a day.
This time, under the influence of Elephant’s Fury, his power was still terrifying. Moreover, after invoking a trace of Dragon Elephant Behemoth power, he killed Mikus, who had activated his True Demon Body, in a single blow.
But the weakness that followed was even more severe.
Jack estimated that he would need at least two days of rest to recover this time, even though he had only unleashed the power for a few seconds and his recovery ability had become stronger.
It was clear that the incomplete rune condensed by the lower-level Dragon Elephant Power could no longer serve as his trump card.
Alternatively, it could be said that the amplification of the incomplete Elephant’s Fury Rune had a limit. The weaker his strength, the more powerful the amplification effect; however, as his power increased, he had already exceeded the amplification limit.
To put it simply, when he was at the Triplex, his strength was too points, and after tenfold amplification, it became 1000.
But now, his strength had reached 10,000, so after amplification, it became 100,000. The difference between 100,000 and 1,000 was huge, which was probably why he felt so weak after just three seconds of activation.
However, this problem should be solvable.
After returning this time, he would perform Limit Enhancement on his Senior Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, which should fix the flaw in the Elephant’s Fury Rune and even make it more powerful.
With that thought in mind, Jack became determined and took a short rest before looking at Mikus.
Mikus, a member of the Purgatory Demon Race, was indeed powerful. After fully releasing his demon gas and activating his True Demon Body, his combat power reached the Late-stage Sixth Heavenly Stage, almost nearing the peak.
It should be noted that he was still injured and had his realm suppressed in the Early Sixth Heaven.
If he were in his prime, his combat power could even reach the Seventh Layer Heaven. Ordinary Sixth Layer Heaven cultivators would be no match for him, no wonder he was so arrogant.
Under such circumstances, Jack also needed to unleash all his power.
After two days of fighting, he had a clear idea of his own combat power.
He was at the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, but due to his excessively strong physical body, coupled with Dragon Power, six layers of cultivation methods, and heavy weapons, his normal combat power was at Sixth Heaven Middle Stage and relatively strong among the mid stage cultivators.
After activating the Divine Tyrant Body, he was somewhere between the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage and its peak. In an instant, his strongest burst could kill a Late-stage Sixth Heaven cultivator with the Power of the Giant Beasts but would then fall into a weakened state.
Of course, combat power was only a rough comparison, and who would emerge victorious between those in the same tier was still uncertain until they fought.
After killing the enemy, it was time for the rewards.
However, Mikus’s weapon was destroyed by the Dragon Elephant Power, and his battle armor was severely damaged when he fully released his demon gas.
At this moment, Jack’s gaze fell on the small black bag hanging at Mikus’s waist, “What is this small pouch? Space Equipment?”
As he said it, Jack grabbed the small bag and tore it off.
Yi! Jack tried to open the bag forcefully, but found that it was sealed tight by a powerful force. He immediately became excited.Because this is a space equipment, there might be good things inside.
With that in mind, Jack Clark’s golden red light circulated in his hand, allowing his spiritual will to flood in under the wrapping of True Strength.
Roar!
Just as Jack Clark’s spirit followed the True Strength into the small leather bag, he ‘heard’ a roar. A black shadow holding a halberd rushed towards him, and it was unmistakably Mikus’s spiritual imprint.
But for Jack Clark, killing a complete Purgatory True Demon might be a bit troublesome, but when it comes to spiritual will…
Buzz!
In the sea of Jack Clark’s consciousness, the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Shadow roared, and the Blade of Void Cutting Rune on his forehead flashed and instantaneously turned into an invisible blade.
This rune that had once condensed in the Third Layer Heaven had never been used before, because Jack Clark had never encountered an enemy who was good at attacking with spiritual will so far.
Thud!
With one strike from the blade that possessed the annihilating power of cutting through the void, Mikus’s spiritual imprint instantly collapsed and disappeared, completely erased from existence.
Without the spiritual imprint, as the golden red True Strength continued to pour in, large groups of black demon gas were expelled from the leather bag and gradually refined by Jack Clark.
Soon, a space the size of one cubic meter appeared in his consciousness perception.
“So small.” Jack Clark raised his eyebrows.
Moreover, not only is this space small, there isn’t much stuff inside it either.
Two black crystals similar to ores, a large piece of ore with internal flames, a 0.5 meters long golden horn, and a black copper plate with a ferocious demon on the front and ancient patterns on the back.
Jack Clark recognized the black crystal, called the Nightmare Demon Crystal, which was similar to the Blue Crystal used by Sixth Heaven cultivators, containing high-purity energy with dark attributes.
Only cultivators who practiced dark attribute techniques would use this type of crystal stone, with one being worth 50 contribution points.
As for the unknown ore, he would need to check the information when he returned, but from the aura it emitted, it should be valuable.
After all, Mikus was a nobleman and wouldn’t collect garbage.
The golden horn apparently came from mutated creatures, while the black copper plate had no special power detected by Jack Clark and was probably some kind of identification card for Mikus.
He could later hand it over to the school for evaluation to see if it could be exchanged for some ‘money’.
Apart from that, there were some traces of pure energy in the small space, which once likely held resources but were already used by Mikus to recover his strength.
But even so, Jack Clark felt that this guy was really poor.
Didn’t he always claim to be a noble of the Purgatory Demon Race? Is this what they call a noble?
Or was it that he was from a once-rich noble family that is now destitute? That would explain why he was here.
After all, anyone with a brain would know that smuggling themselves here would be no different from seeking death.
This was the Human Race’s headquarters, even if they succeeded in assassinating some Human Clan geniuses, they wouldn’t have the chance to escape alive from the furious pursuit and campaign of the human race.
Even cross-realm human experts would hunt them down.
After all, it’s not only them who have King-level strong men, humans have them too, but it seems risky to do so.
At this thought, Jack Clark was pensive.
These guys were most likely the abandoned bait. If they succeeded, all’s well, even able to ambush the Human Race King-level powerhouses. And if they failed, it doesn’t matter.
They were just some Evil God Sect cultists who were attached to them, including fallen ordinary nobles like Mikus. The Demon Clan was indeed cunning.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 188: Stars Falling, Doctrine
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 188: Stars Falling, Doctrine
Following the Words
Translator: 549690339 |
Under the night sky, over a dozen base satellites slowly descended to thirty thousand meters, emitting dazzling star-like glows, guiding the way like luminous stars.
Intense pulses of signals radiated in all directions, penetrating the clouds and mists formed by the energy barrier.
With the signals from the energy bombers, almost the entire Cloud Mist Mountain Range was covered.
Only the deepest parts of the mountain range and some areas with space distortions remained without signal under these circumstances.
Of course, this situation came with a cost. These base satellites would continue to fall, eventually landing in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Although the signal can penetrate, the image cannot, so it is not possible to clearly see people as it is outside.
Hum!
As the demon gas of Mikus in front of them burst out, one of the over ten satellites slowly descending from the high altitude reacted to a hideous skull inside.
An instant later, the voice of the staff echoed in the Military Base Center: “Report, coordinates Cloud Mist Mountain Range horizontal 1793, vertical 2108, detected a strong True Demon aura.”
“Intensity.”
“Late Level 6.”
“Lock onto the aura, notify nearby combatants to surround and eradicate it.”
“Report, there is also a smart wristwatch signal nearby, the owner is first-year student Jack Clark. Both signals overlap and are currently in battle.”
“Late Sixth Heavenly Stage Demon Clan, very strong power, notify nearby people to rush to support as soon as possible…”
In just a few moments, four teams of teachers received the signal within a 500- kilometer radius, and their figures turned towards Jack’s location.
However, it was getting late and although they had night vision, their vision could only reach a range of 100 meters and was not as clear as during the day.
So, even these teachers dared not deploy their full speed in case they accidentally collided with a space crack and died.
Moreover, dealing with the attacking mutated creatures took time, so by the time the nearest team arrived from 100 kilometers away, more than ten minutes had passed.
The battle had already ended.
“He’s dead!” The three Martial Cultivation Teachers stopped and looked at the corpse on the collapsed hillside in shock.
Weren’t they told that there was a late Sixth Heavenly Stage Purgatory Demon Race detected and that it was fighting with a genius from South Sky Martial Height? So that means… Hiss!
The three looked at Jack, who was taking inventory of supplies not far away, their eyes swept over the small leather bag in his hand.
“Jack Clark!?”
Crack! Crack!!
Jack’s battle armor mask on his face cracked open, retracting to both sides to form wing decorations, and he politely said, “Yes, it’s me, nice to meet you, teachers.”
All three fell silent, and after a while, one of the teachers gave a bitter smile: “Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven… He’s such a monster.”
At this time, a strong aura of Divine Might lingered in the air, the same as the faint aura emanating from Jack’s body.
So, the three did not question whether this Demon Clan was his kill.
But there is a big difference between defeating and killing.
Among two cultivators at the Sixth Heavenly Middle Stage, the one with slightly stronger strength could defeat the other, but they couldn’t keep the opponent from fleeing.
Even a late Sixth Layer Heaven cultivator couldn’t keep a middle Sixth Layer Heaven cultivator from escaping if they wanted to, unless they exchanged injuries, which is why the Three Teachers had a sense of sudden fear after realizing the truth.
This first-year student’s combat prowess is terrifying.
One of them sighed, “This younger generation… they’re too scary.”
“Yes,” the other two replied with a sigh.
Although, as teachers, being surpassed by the new generation is gratifying, being too strong isn’t good either, which would give them a sense of being useless.
After their regrets, one of them sent a message that the Purgatory Demon was dead, and the other Martial Cultivation Teachers’ teams that were rushing over stopped immediately.
At this point, Jack asked, “Teachers, how many invaders have been discovered and killed so far?”
One of the teachers thought for a moment: “Including this Purgatory Demon, the recorded number of people has reached seventeen. According to the higher- ups’ estimates, there should be no more than five people left.”
Jack frowned slightly, “If the remaining few people hide in a cave in the vast Cloud Mist Mountain Range for a year, what will happen?”
One of the teachers smiled faintly, “Don’t worry, once the base satellite falls tomorrow, they will have nowhere to hide.”
“Inside the base satellite is the blood of a high-level Archbishop, which can be stimulated by a rune matrix to attract the aura of cultivators practicing the same type of Cultivation Method within a certain range.”
“Only if their strength exceeds that of the blood bone owner, or if they change the nature of their Cultivation Method’s power, would they not be affected.”
“However, it is impossible for this group of invaders to do the former, and the Evil Gods, who are the source of power, won’t agree to do the latter, because these malicious beings spread power for evil purposes.”
“I see,” Jack nodded thoughtfully.
Next, the image was uploaded along with an indication that Jack had killed the Demon Clan, and then one of the teachers took out a larger Sumeru Bracelet and stored Mikus’ corpse.
These Purgatory Demon corpses have high research value, and they will be dealt with by specialists when they are taken back.
As for the things on the Demon Clan’s body, they didn’t ask about them, as those belonged to Jack’s personal spoils.’
However, when the news of Jack killing the Purgatory Demon reached the Monitoring Center in the rear base, the atmosphere was quiet as they looked at the Demon Clan corpse on the big screen.
“Ahem, I think there is nothing worth discussing about this topic, everyone continues to work.”
“Right, we’re used to shaking today, don’t mind it. It’s just a Demon Clan with an estimated combat power of late Sixth Layer Heaven.”

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 188: Stars Falling, Doctrine Following the Words_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 188: Stars Falling, Doctrine Following the Words_2
Translator: 549690339
“Brian, you’re right. Let’s not discuss this issue anymore. It’s too upsetting to talk about…”
Because the invaders were quickly eliminated, the atmosphere in the monitoring center was relatively relaxed.
The next morning, Jack Clark raised his head and looked up through the clouds at the increasingly clear satellite in the sky, his figure flashed and disappeared into the forest again.
He wanted to see if he could encounter another Evil God Sect Cultist.
Although his luck had been good so far, having killed two Evil God Sect Cultists and one Demon Clan member, perhaps there was still more to gain?
Compared to the 200 Contribution Points, Jack valued the Merit Value more.
At the same time, on the edge of the cliff at the boundary of the outer ring and the middle section.
The young man in white clothes raised his head slightly, also looking at the slowly falling meteors in the sky, and suddenly said, “I may have to leave now, I have some business to attend to.”
The girl sitting cross-legged opened her eyes slowly, turned her head to look at the young man who gave her a sense of indescribable familiarity, and slowly said, “Ilisa Wesley, who are you really?”
“Who am I?”
Ilisa Wesley looked at the clouds drifting through the cliff, his tone faintly filled with vicissitudes: “I am just a person who is forging ahead.”
A person forging ahead? Jane Aiken was slightly silent and asked directly, “What is your purpose for coming here this time?”
“You’ve already discovered, huh. Well, with those things in the sky.”
Ilisa Wesley smiled casually, “I came in to find someone. I was somewhat interested in her existence, but I didn’t expect to meet you, who was once somewhat similar to me.”
“Don’t worry, I didn’t kill anyone this time. I’m not interested in killing people either.”
“Well, it’s almost time for me to go back, or it will be troublesome if I get discovered.”
Without waiting for Jane Aiken to respond, a round moon appeared in Ilisa Wesley’s eyes, and in an instant, he silently appeared hundreds of meters away, then disappeared again with another flash.
Jane, who had already broken through Late Fourth Layer Heaven, sat still where she was.
During the two days of insights under the “world”, she gained a lot, her realm progressed rapidly and her cultivation naturally broke through to the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Excluding the abnormal Jack Clark, she had already become the number one among the new generation in the Southern Region.
Watching Ilisa Wesley disappear deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, Jane did not try to stop him, because it would have been useless to try.
Having debated with Ilisa Wesley for two days, she felt that he was becoming more unfathomable, his cultivation realm far surpassing her understanding, and his true cultivation level at least above the high-order.
Jack then spent a day shuttling through the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. However, he didn’t know if it was because all the Evil God Sect Cultists had been killed or because his luck had run out.
He didn’t even see a bird’s shadow the whole day.
In the evening, a fierce roar erupted from deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Suddenly, a mutated beast resembling a tyrannosaur, 39 meters long and possessing a Level 6 Peak, stood tall not far from the spatial channel.
On this mutated beast shrouded in black mist, numerous black tentacles that were several meters and even over ten meters long waved, making it look extremely disgusting and ferocious.
However, at this moment, this powerful creature had a guard in its eyes.
Not far away, Ilisa Wesley, dressed in white, stood with his hands behind his back, his voice cold: “I didn’t expect there to be another Demon Seed. It has grown so much in just a few days. You must have eaten a lot.”
At this time, some white strands were mixed in Ilisa Wesley’s black hair, and the look in his eyes was no longer calm and indifferent, but cold and mysterious, as if he had transformed into another person.
An inexplicably terrifying aura emanated invisibly from him, terrifying the strange mutated beast, causing it to feel wary, even afraid.
Roar roar roar!!
The Demon Seed’s tentacles waved, tearing through the air and creating rolling waves. Its huge body slowly retreated while emitting a guarded roar.
Ilisa Wesley’s eyes were indifferent, as he said faintly: “You should just stay.”
As he spoke, a round sun appeared in his eyes. In an instant, the Heavenly Energy within a hundred-meter range exploded, and under the projection of his intent, a round scorching sun descended into reality.
At the same time, a moon rose in his other eye, causing Heavenly Energy to become even more violent, forming a moon behind the sun.
Under the radiance of the sun and moon, a destructive force burst forth.
The horror of this force had not yet fallen on the Demon Seed, but its body already sank, causing the ground beneath to collapse and disintegrate, creating waves of impact radiating outwards.
Roar roar roar!!
The Level 6 Peak Demon Seed roared in horror, its black demonic qi surging, and its tentacles continuously inflated and churned in the void, skyrocketing to the sky.
But under the terrifying sun and moon radiance, all resistance was futile.As the sun and moon fell, those hideous tentacles turned to ashes as soon as they approached, followed by the gigantic Demon Seed, which shattered into pieces amidst its furious roar.
Boom!
In an instant, the sky collapsed and the earth cracked, like the explosion of a high-yield intercontinental missile, and the destructive light sphere expanded rapidly, throwing countless dirt in all directions.
When everything calmed down, only a thirty-meter diameter crater was left on the ground, and a spotless young man in white clothing stood at the edge with his hands behind his back.
Ilisa Wesley suddenly turned her head and looked at the dense misty forest in the distance, saying indifferently, “Come out, you’ve been hiding for long enough.”
A shadow in the forest trembled, and a figure hidden under a black robe ‘grew’ out of the shadows. He looked cautious and spoke hoarsely.
“You are not Ilisa Wesley from the Eternal God Church. The legend says that he only comprehends Golden Sun Intent and not the Cold Moon. Who are you!”
Ilisa Wesley… No, the young man in white slightly curved his lips, “Do you think I would tell you? A dying man doesn’t need to know that much.”
“Die.”
As the word “die” came out of the young man’s mouth, the face of the Shadow God Sect Infiltrator turned pale, and he screamed in terror, “The Word Curse Law, you are from the Holy Light God Sect… No…”
Before he could finish his words, the infiltrator’s body stiffened suddenly, and slowly fell backward to the ground, turning into a cold corpse in the blink of an eye.
Such terrifying power sent chills down one’s spine.
At this point, the white color in the young man’s hair already occupied half of his head, and the inexplicably majestic aura on his body became more and more unwieldy, even distorting the surrounding space to a certain extent.
But just as this invisible terrifying power was about to resurface, he managed to suppress it again. His eyes, however, became even colder, devoid of any human emotion, like statues in a temple.
After casually killing a Demon Seed and a Shadow Infiltrator, Ilisa Wesley suddenly looked up to the sky.
There, streaks of fire descended from the sky and plunged into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Sixteen hundred-meter wide satellites surrounded by flames descended from the sky at a terrifying speed, piercing through the clouds and violently crashing into mountain peaks, valleys, and forests.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!
In an instant, a series of violent explosions erupted, creating a powerful raging wind wave that scared all the Mutated Creatures within a ten-kilometer radius.
Crack!
One by one, in the one to two hundred meter wide meteorite craters, the severely damaged base satellites cracked and broke, and then burst open with a bang.
More than a dozen sixty-meter diameter, fifty-meter high black pyramids appeared. The tips of the pyramids gradually glowed with dazzling white light.
Buzz!
In an instant, more intense pulse radiation erupted and echoed with the signal transmitters.
Under this radiation carrying transcendent aura, the Blood God Envoy hiding in the mountain stream, the Giant God Sect Apostle hidden in the cliffside cracks,
As well as the Shadow Infiltrator hiding inside a hundred-meter tree in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, the three of them had their aura surge and voluntarily burst into powerful strength.
Suddenly, the three of them changed their expressions.
This radiation swept through the entire Cloud Mist Mountain Range. As it swept over the white-clothed “Ilisa Wesley,” his body also had some aura being triggered.
But he immediately suppressed it once more.
“I didn’t expect that the human inner circle had developed to such a point. Their scouting methods are so strong that they can even trigger the disguised aura inside me.”
“I should leave, or else it would be troublesome if discovered…”
With a faint voice, the young man in white stepped into the spatial channel.
Boom!
As the young man in white entered, the slowly rotating spatial channel that had once been silent began to tremor. Opposite to it flashing purple light, a strong energy poured in, stabilizing the channel.
Suddenly, the figure of the white-clothed young man disappeared into the space cracks.
Only a few minutes later, a strong power fluctuation suddenly erupted from the other side, and the terrifying aftershock caused the already unstable channel to tremble violently.
Boom!
With a powerful explosion, the spatial channel began to collapse. Like a mirror, dark black cracks spread out in all directions.
As the black cracks passed through, everything in their path was twisted and shattered, then consumed by the powerful suction force they emitted.
By the time the spatial fluctuations subsided, only a hundred-meter diameter pit was left in place. All physical matter surrounding it vanished amidst the collapse of the space.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 189: The Battle Ends, The True Destiny Protagonist (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 189: The Battle Ends, The True Destiny Protagonist (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
“Report, vertical coordinate 2795, horizontal coordinate 1980, Blood God Sect Cultist detected.”
“Report, the True Demon Skull has been activated, no trace of demon gas detected…”
“Report, a moment before the base satellite fell, a strong demon gas was detected in the depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, along with the aura of the Eternal God Church.”
“However, both auras disappeared after the impact of the satellite’s fall, and cannot be locked.”
“Lock the coordinates, inform nearby teams to investigate…”
At the Military Base Monitoring Center in the rear, a series of voices constantly sounded, reporting the current situation and conveying orders.
Soon, the three cultists who had exposed their auras were surrounded by nearby teams.
At the same time, James Clark and another team quickly arrived at the coordinate where Ilisa Wesley had disappeared.
But what the four saw were several silent mountain peaks and the huge pit that had swallowed the space after the collapse of the spatial channel where it originally was.
“There are strong spatial fluctuations here. The Eternal God Church’s cultist should have left through the pathway, and the temporary channel has also collapsed.”
As he said this, James Clark seemed thoughtful, thinking of the report he had received from Jane Aiken earlier.
The mysterious cultist who left should be the strange young man Jane Aiken mentioned, who came in to find someone, who was he trying to find?
In the morning, after Ilisa Wesley left, Jane Aiken had reported her situation to James Clark.
Although Ilisa Wesley had given her some guidance in the past two days, she knew the critical issue and would naturally not hide his whereabouts after losing sight of him.
Of course, the girls had some personal motives, too.
They didn’t inform their higher-ups right away; otherwise, perhaps several Martial Arts Cultivation Teachers-led teams would have surrounded the cliff by now.
After a brief hesitation, James Clark said solemnly, “There is a strong residual demon gas in the air, and there is no sign of life around. It feels like there were fierce demonic beasts here.”
“Everyone, spread out and search carefully to avoid any missing fish.”
Soon, James Clark and the other three searched the surrounding area for tens of kilometers, but found nothing, so they returned to the location of the spatial channel.
“Strange, there are definitely traces of demonic beasts here, but they seem to have been… killed?”
“Notify the higher-ups, confirm that this place is safe.”
“Report, the target has been annihilated.”
“Report, the target here has been killed…”
As all the invaders were confirmed to be eliminated, the three-day extermination battle came to an end, and everyone in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range received the news of the end.
“They were all killed like this.”
Like a huge sword pulled straight out from the earth, rising hundreds of meters atop the mountain peak, Jack Clark stared at the message on his smart wristwatch, looking stunned.
No, I didn’t kill enough… wait, I should say, I didn’t earn enough Contribution Points. How did you guys all die so quickly?
Well, it made sense if he thought about it.
With the power of the military and the hidden strength of various universities, it would be useless if it took a long time to deal with these few invaders.
Instead, it was more normal that they were quickly exterminated after being discovered.
It’s just a pity that if he had entered the depths of the mountain range earlier and encountered these invaders, killing them all, he would have made a fortune this time.
At this point, Jack Clark estimated his gains from this time silently.
600 Contribution Points, 300 Merit Value Points, and the materials worth several hundred points confiscated from Mikus’ hands, plus a copper plate whose use he didn’t know.
Counting it all, he had gotten quite a bit this time.
Especially the 300 Merit Value Points, which were equivalent to 1,000 Contribution Points, and were even more valuable because they belonged to high-level “currency.”
Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction, “Not bad, it’s like I killed a few Level 6 Mutant Beasts.”
Level 5 Mutated Creatures are valued at 130 to 150 Contribution Points, while Level 6 ones have a value ranging from 300 to 400.
This value difference is not based on more flesh and blood but on the stronger scale armor, beast skin, bones, and some organ parts after energy refining on those Level 6 Exotic Beasts.
These things, after being processed, are invaluable superconducting materials that many advanced weapons and machinery can use.
But for Jack Clark at the moment, Level 6 Exotic Beasts are easy to kill, but there’s a problem with taking them back, which is very troublesome.
These creatures primarily inhabit the depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
Not to mention each beast weighing over a hundred tons, just the six or seven thousand kilometers of distance is more than a week’s journey back and forth.
Time-consuming and laborious.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s wristwatch beeped, indicating someone wanted to contact him.
“Hello!! Jack, can you hear me?”
“Yes, I can hear you, Teacher Clark.”
“I have a few things to deal with here, and it will take about two more days. When I return, come to my office, and I’ll explain some cultivation issues.”
“…Alright, teacher.”
Ordering of things, top-tier Secret Manual? Jack Clark thought thoughtfully.
At this moment, Jack Clark thought of something, “Teacher Clark, could you help me delay the counting of the Contribution Points for the cultists I killed this time for two days?”
“Why?” James Clark on the other side was somewhat puzzled.
With Jack Clark’s record of killing Evil God Sect Cultists beyond his level, once the points are calculated, he could rush into the top ten of the Achievement List.
That’s just because of insufficient points. In terms of combat strength, he could stand at number one.
Such glory should be exciting for these young people like Jack Clark, why delay for two days?
To James Clark’s question, Jack Clark calmly replied, “I touched the Battle Intent earlier but failed to condense it due to insufficient Martial Arts foundation. This time, I want to change my path when I return.”

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 189: The Great Battle Ends, The True Protagonist of Destiny (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 189: The Great Battle Ends, The True Protagonist of Destiny (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
Using external momentum to condense invincible war intent requires gathering a surging trend. Therefore, it’s not strong enough to shock the minds of those students if he enters the top 10 of the Achievement List in advance.
After all, it’s normal for them to find it difficult to compete with him if he is in the top to of the Achievement List and had killed so many Sixth-level Heaven powerhouses.
But he needs to sweep all the geniuses in the South by challenging the monster realm of the Fifth Layer Heaven in junior level, which is more secure.
Of course, Jack Clark didn’t quite understand this. This was his first time encountering the realm of thought, especially the method of condensing without relying on enlightenment but borrowing the momentum of Heaven and Earth. So he could only pay attention to possible problems.
“…I understand, no problem.”
James Clark across took a light breath and looked shocked.
He didn’t expect Jack not only to have an amazing speed in cultivating the Dragon Elephant Power but also to be strong in understanding the realm of thought, even touching the Battle Intent.
“He wants to challenge cultivators of the same level, right?” James Clark pondered.
After asking James, Jack’s feet exploded onto the rock, and his whole body leaped hundreds of meters high, crashing onto another mountain peak more than 300 meters away.
The landscape here is peculiar.
Sharp rocks rise from the ground, hundreds of meters high, covered with green grass, wrapped in mist, looking like a fairyland from legend.
However…
Boom, boom, boom! Jack, wearing battle armor, leaps from one peak to another among the clouds. Every time he lands, there is a violent explosion, disturbing the surroundings.
At this time, Jack feels like he is crossing the sea of clouds. Although he can’t fly, he can jump.
Soon, Jack crossed the misty fairyland and dashed into the forest, quickly heading out of the mountain like a golden red flash.
Everything he passed by was shattered, whether it was plants or mutated creatures, crushed under his overbearing figure.
Suddenly, the golden red light Jack turned into flickered slightly, drawing a semicircle arc from the front.
After he disappeared, black cracks appeared silently in the surroundings and cut everything in its path into two before slowly fading away.
Under his dual pupils, these randomly appearing cracks no longer posed a threat to Jack.
This time, the harvest was rich. Jack planned to quickly go back and enhance the Sixth-level Dragon Elephant Power to the limit and see if he could condense a complete rune.
Considering how strong the incomplete Rune Elephant Rage is, wouldn t the limit of Dragon Elephant Overlord Body rune be earth-shattering?
Even Jack couldn’t help but look forward to it.
As long as the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body reached the limit, his strength would become the top of the young generation in the south, and even the so- called awakened ones would be blown away in front of him.
Bang, bang, bang!!
With a constant speed of more than 200 meters per second, Jack quickly crossed the rear part of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range and returned to the cliff before dark.
A girl in ordinary battle armor sat at the edge of the cliff as always, exuding a mysterious aura. Her breath… Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Jack looked astonished.
Just two days apart, Jane Aiken had actually made a breakthrough to the Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Besides, two terrifying Sword Intents circled around her. One was elusive, and the other was unmatchedly sharp, cutting everything.
Rich Heavenly Energy gathered toward her, continuously transformed and absorbed by her True Strength, and her strength was rising at an astonishing speed.
in this state of enlightenment, Jane Aiken’s cultivation speed was amazingly fast.
Phew!
Jack breathed heavily, looked envious, and said, “Student Aiken, is this what you mean by loosening the realm’s boundary?
At the edge of the cliff, Jane retracted her soul, the terrifying Sword Intent in her eyes slowly fading, and then turned back to calmly say.
“After watching Ilisa’s miniature world in a palm, I have gained a deeper understanding of Heaven and Earth in the past two days. It feels like I have entered a new world.”
Having said that, Jane shook her head: “It’s a pity that such a feeling is hard to describe, otherwise, it should be helpful for Student Clark to condense the realm of thought.”
…I feel that even if you say it, I won’t be able to comprehend it.
Of course, Jack only sarcastically said this in his heart, not out loud.
After all, at this time, she even thought of helping him condense the realm of thought, and Jack was a little touched.
He felt that these classmates of his were very sincere and lovely, whether it was Mr. Willard, Marcus, or Freya, while his thoughts were more complex than theirs.
At this moment, Jack looked around and asked, “Student Aiken, where is Brother Wesley?”
“He’s gone.”
Jane paused slightly and then said without hiding, “Ilisa is also a member of the Evil God Sect.”
“…Student Aiken, you found out too.”
Jane nodded slightly: “He is very mysterious, but he doesn’t seem to harbor much malice towards our Federation.”
Then, Jane added: “I informed Teacher Clark about him this morning.
“What did the teacher say?”
“She said that the information was uploaded, and they are tracking his whereabouts, and also told me to write a detailed report about my contact with him these two days.”
jack nodded. Since he had informed the higher-ups, he didn’t need to worry about it.
As for whether Jane’s two-day contact with him would affect her, Jack wasn t worried either. The official wouldn’t be so narrow-minded.
Since their contact was only through ‘discussing the way,’ it wouldn’t be suspicious.
The sky darkened as they spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 189: The End of the Big Battle, The Real Heaven’s Chosen Protagonist (Seeking Monthly Tickets) 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 189: The End of the Big Battle, The Real Heaven’s Chosen Protagonist (Seeking Monthly Tickets) 3
Translator: 549690339
Seeing this, Jack Clark brings back some dry firewood to start a bonfire, the cooking set from the night before yesterday was still intact.
There was no need to even find food as there was still plenty of meat left from the mutated bull we killed.
The weather in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range in March was cold, and the temperature was only about ten degrees. Furthermore, the flesh and blood of mutated creatures contained a lot of energy, so even after two days, it was still fresh.
Night!
The flames flickered as the two of them sat by the stone slab, eating barbecued meat.
Compared to Jack, who was eating slowly, the girl across the table was eating greasily.
She was using one hand to stir the meat on the stone slab with chopsticks while constantly sprinkling all kinds of seasonings with the other. As soon as any piece of grilled meat was done, she would take a hot mouthful regardless of the heat.
This image contrasted greatly with the genius girl who previously sat at the edge of the cliff meditating on martial arts, to the point where Jack was taken aback.
Hey, hey!!
You weren’t like this the other night, where’s your Southern Sky Martial Height’s first person’s style? Where’s your image?
“Student Aiken, do you rarely eat barbecue?” Jack who eventually couldn’t help but ask.
Jane Aiken nodded; “Very rarely. My mom prefers light food and didn’t allow me to eat this type of food from a young age.”
Jane realized at this moment that her image was a bit off. But she just smiled apologetically, not slowing her slicing of meat in the slightest.
Jack curiously asked, “Your parents must be cultivators too, to teach and have a genius daughter like Student Aiken, and they must be quite accomplished.”
Jane Aiken nodded, “My mom was a cultivator in the past, but her foundation was destroyed later on, and these years her cultivation has not only stopped advancing but even kept regressing.”
As for my father, my mom said he died many years ago.
“… He’s dead, I’m sorry.” Jack paused slightly.
Jane Aiken didn’t mind as she said, “It’s okay, many families in our era are incomplete, not just me.”
Jack nodded in agreement.
The human world has experienced many disasters walking from the chaotic era to the present, otherwise it wouldn’t take decades to only slightly recover the population.
For example, his father also died early of an illness, with nearly everyone from the previous generation in his family dead.
Just as Jack was filled with regret, Jane Aiken paused, slowly saying, “It’s just that my mother passed away last year due to her worsening injuries.”
Jack subconsciously asked, “Do you have any other family members?”
“No.” Looking at the flickering flames before her, Jane Aiken was somewhat lost in thought, losing her appetite for the barbecue.
Immediately, the atmosphere became somewhat depressed. Jack hadn’t expected that a casual conversation would jump to such a topic, and he sighed slightly as he looked at the girl across from him.
Compared to Jane Aiken, he was much better off.
At least in this world, he still had a mother and a younger brother, two family members, so he was not mentally lonely.
Jack sighed again, “I’m sorry.”
Jane Aiken came back to her senses, looking at him oddly, “Didn’t I just tell you, there’s no need to apologize, the dead cannot be resurrected, the living need to continue living.”
