“And, I promised my mother that I would live well.”
She has a good mentality. At this time, Jack changed the subject: “Student Aiken, since starting school, you have been outperforming everyone else. What’s your purpose for working so hard in your cultivation?”
He thought the previous topic was a bit heavy, so this time he switched to a more positive topic, perhaps to inspire the girl’s future hopes and expectations.
“To kill a person.”
“… To kill a person.” Jack paused, wondering if he had heard it wrong. Why does the girl across from him always disrupt the conventional, straightforward flow of the conversation?
Jane Aiken nodded, “Yes, to kill a person, it was my mother’s last wish.”
Alright, it was a grudge from the previous generation.
At this time, perhaps due to recalling her life goal, the girl opposite him had once again regained her appetite and was eating the barbecue fiercely. It appeared as if she felt that this could make her grow faster.
“Ahem! Student Aiken, how come you haven’t produced any battle armor even though you’ve been on the battlefield this long?” Jack changed the topic again.
If one calculated, Jane Aiken had entered the Alien Beast Battlefield a month and a half before him, she should have been able to gather Contribution Points rather easily with her abilities.
However, it appeared she only had a Sumeru Bracelet, and a Transcendent Battlesword.
The bracelet was a reward from Koroya’s group while the battle sword was forged at the same time as Jack’s Halberd more than a dozen days ago.
The girl answered very straightforwardly: “I’m broke, I don’t have any Contribution Points.” After saying this, she stuffed another huge mouthful of barbecue into her mouth, her cheeks bulging as she kept chewing.
Somehow, this scene looked a bit cute.
“Huh…Why are you broke? With your abilities, getting one or two hundred Contribution Points shouldn’t be difficult, right? ” Jack was a bit puzzled.
Jane Aiken shook her head: “I didn’t go kill mutated creatures, they’re too heavy, so annoying. The contribution points I used to forge the battle sword before were from a few Golden Sunflowers I picked up on the way.
“…So, when you entered the Alien Beast Battlefield this long, you just chose a cliff randomly and meditated and cultivated?”
Yes.”
“…Impressive.” After a moment, Jack didn’t know what to say.
Then Jack’s eyes gradually showed a strange color, because he realized that Jane Aiken was completely a template for Heaven’s Chosen Protagonist.
Orphaned, with an enemy as the goal of cultivation, even the talent is against heaven, just quietly cultivating like this, her cultivation is increasing at an exaggerated speed.
She is already close to reaching the Fifth Layer of Heaven after only half a year of cultivation, and after her breakthrough to the Fourth Layer of Heaven, her rate of improvement has become even more terrifying. Is this another case of reaching the Nine Layers of Heaven within a year!!
At this moment, Jane Aiken across from him also curiously asked: “Student Clark, what is your cultivation goal?”
“My goal…is to enjoy the process of getting stronger, I guess.” Jack thought for a moment.
Because the stronger he is, the more secure he feels.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 190:1 will take the lead in charging, and if there is any disagreement, I will explode.
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 190:1 will take the lead in charging, and if there is any disagreement, I will explode.
Translator: 549690339 |
Night!
After putting out the fire, Jack Clark and Jane Aiken made arrangements for keeping watch that night.
Watching over the first half of the night, Jane Aiken settled down at the edge of the cliff and quickly fell into her cultivation state. The majestic Heavenly Energy of the surroundings surged towards her, drawn by her Sword Intent. Glancing at the young girl’s dancing long hair, Jack Clark leaned against the mountain wall, crossing his legs and falling into his cultivation state.
Humm!
Accompanied by the Sixth-level Dragon Elephant Power operation, strands of Heavenly Energy entered Jack’s body through his pores, and were quickly refined by the True Dragon Power.
Every second the amount of energy cultivated was hundreds of times more than when he was in the Third Layer Heaven.
This was the terrifying effect of condensing the Divine Tyrant Body and cultivating Dragon Elephant Power to its perfection—the inhalation and exhalation of energy was like a real giant beast consuming the Heavenly Energy.
Compared with those gigantic Mutated Creatures with strong bodies and awakened talents in levels two and three, human cultivators were at a disadvantage in the early stages.
Ordinary Level 1 cultivators were no match for Level 1 Unique Beasts; Level 2 cultivators couldn’t beat Level 2 Beasts. They could only stand a chance against them after reaching the Third Layer Heaven with True Power Protection and adding weapons and battle skills.
However, once they stepped into the Fourth Layer Heaven, and their True Martial strength started showing gradually, the gap between cultivators and Mutated Beasts narrowed suddenly.
As their realms grew higher and their Senior Weapons, transcendent battle armor, Secret Skills, Advanced Skills, and willpower grew stronger, human cultivators could even surpass Mutated Creatures in power when they reached the Sixth-level Heaven.
When they reached the Seventh Layer Heaven and condensed the True Martial Phantom, human cultivators who could wield the Heavenly Energy with every move were even more powerful than the Mutated Beasts, which relied on their physical talents.
Of course, such comparisons were not absolute. Just like human geniuses, Mutated Creatures of the same level could be categorized as ordinary, elite, king blood, and dragons.
It was just that humans who possessed a complete Inheritance of cultivation methods and practices had greater potential and faster growth than Mutated Creatures.
However, just as Jack Clark was quietly cultivating, his heart suddenly moved. A part of his attention was drawn to the Thunderflame Behemoth’s side.
Roar! The cave was dug open.
Over a thousand meters deep in the sea, at the mountainside, the cave was emitting a faint blue glow. Seeing this scene, the Thunderflame Behemoth couldn’t help but let out a ferocious roar.
That’s because it had buried the cave entrance when it left before.
On the side, the forty-six-meter-long but even more robust Mutated Tiger Whale swung its tail, making a disappointed whine.
Whine, whine, whine! There’s no smell of good things inside, Thunderflame. Once, the two beasts killed two Deep Sea Double-headed Giant Pythons here, especially remembering the opponent’s poisonous and slow talents.
This was the only ability involving time that the Thunderflame Behemoth had encountered since entering the deep sea.
If it hadn’t met the requirements for Evolution at that time, it would have considered whether or not it should absorb that slow talent.
On the side, the giant sinister-looking Deep Sea Dragon Turtle curiously poked its head to take a look at the cave, then roared: Roar! The cave is too small, can’t get in.
Roar! Let me go in and have a look.
The Thunderflame Behemoth didn’t give up, and reluctantly drilled into the faint blue cave with a swing of its tail.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth had grown to a length of forty-eight meters, appearing even more fearsome and terrifying. The cave it had once casually entered had now become somewhat narrow.
However, compared to its robust state when it hunted the Ancient Giant Crocodile more than ten days ago, the Thunderflame Behemoth was now leaner, even appearing malnourished.
It couldn’t be helped. Under the effect of the Growth Crystal, its body grew rapidly, but it also demanded a higher supply of energy.
After consuming all the food in the surrounding sea area, the energy supply was running low.
This was also the reason it took the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle out for a raid.
Soon, the Thunderflame Behemoth crawled out of the cave with cold eyes: Roar! Not only have the good things inside been eaten, but the stone pillar has also been destroyed.
Whine, whine, whine! Damn it, there won’t be any good things here anymore. The Single-horned Tiger Whale was also instantly infuriated.
Previously, the Thunderflame Behemoth had described the situation inside to it, knowing that the good thing that could improve its “talent ability” was condensed by a stone pillar.
Roar! It cannot be spared. Split up and search for it. Comb through a radius of 300 kilometers. I want to eat it.
If the Mutated Creature had just dug open the hole and eaten the Blue Pearl Thunderflame inside, the Behemoth would have just felt a little regretful, then reburied it and returned later.
However, the fact that the other party dared to dig the root was simply seeking death.
If it didn’t eat that Mutated Creature, the Thunderflame Behemoth would nag at how it couldn’t reach its goal.
Roar! Damn it, eat it.
Seeing the Thunderflame Behemoth’s anger, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also joined in with a roar, ready to search the surroundings fiercely.
But just as the three Mutated Creatures were about to take action, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s gaze suddenly shifted, and it looked towards a dark area in the left.
Within the range of its thousand-meter Electromagnetic Sensing, a mutated creature over twenty meters in length, resembling a Dragon Python with a pair of horns on its head, swam towards it.
On the belly of the creature, a pair of claws had grown, emitting a powerful aura. As it passed by, the ordinary Marine Life scattered in fear.
As the ordinary mutated creatures fled, the Black Horned Serpent would emit excited growls.
It liked the sight of other creatures fearing it, as it made it feel mighty.
However, as the creature swam along, its enormous body suddenly froze, and a look of panic appeared in its eyes as it looked forward.
Because a few hundred meters ahead, three giant beasts that were even larger and had an invisible imposing aura that shook its instincts were quietly watching it.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 190: I’ll Lead the Charge, and If We Disagree, I’ll Blow Myself Up_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 190: I’ll Lead the Charge, and If We Disagree, I’ll Blow Myself Up_2
Translator: 549690339 |
Since partnering up with the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Thunderflame Behemoth had taught them the Hidden God Method through mental communication.
Although they had been practicing for some time and hadn’t grasped the basics yet, the violent aura and powerful energy fluctuations emanating from their bodies had significantly diminished.
That was why this Level 5 mutated creature didn’t sense the danger beforehand.
Roar! Let’s do this!
Charge!!
Roar roar!! Kill!
In an instant, the undersea world erupted in chaos as the three Level 7 colossi unleashed their horrifying power, quickly overwhelming the Black Horned Serpent.
One minute later, the Thunderflame Behemoth, which had devoured its share of the mutated creature, let out a contented growl.
Roar! That felt good, to teach that bastard not to steal our treasure.
As it growled, seawater mixed with residual flesh and blood flowed out of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s teeth.
Coo coo coo!! It had delicious things, so we eat it.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also shook its head and roared together with the Thunderflame Behemoth: Roar roar!! Hang out with Thunderflame, and feast every day.
The moment the Dragon Turtle finished roaring, the Single-horned Tiger Whale gave it a sideways glance, seeming to despise its lack of backbone for flattering the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Even the Thunderflame Behemoth showed a hint of amusement in its eyes, as it had never noticed before that this chatty fellow had a talent for flattery.
However, perhaps because it had been frightened by the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Dragon Turtle had been talking less this time.
Roar! Joe, lead the way. Let’s go to that sea trench and gather more treasures.
Coo coo coo!! Charge charge charge.
Roar roar!! Wait for me, guys.
Thunderflame Behemoth had previously discovered many regenerative resources while following the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Resources like the Blue Pearls that could enhance their talents, the Green Life Crystals in the deep-sea valley, and the Flame Crystal Trees beneath the volcano were just a few examples.
However, since the fruits of the Flame Crystal Tree under the volcano mouth ripened slowly, the Thunderflame Behemoth planned to return in a while to check on them.
After swimming for two hours, the three giant beasts arrived at the undersea canyon where the Single-horned Tiger Whale had been heavily injured before. The massive skeletons of the crustacean beasts still lay quietly on the seabed.
The canyon that had once been collapsed by the Thunderflame Behemoth also remained unchanged.
Excellent, nobody had touched their treasures this time.
Roar! Let’s get to work.
Excited, the Thunderflame Behemoth arrived directly above the green crack, swinging its double claws, sending hundreds of tons of stones flying with each swipe.
In just a few minutes, it had dug a huge hole a hundred meters deep.
At the bottom of the deep entrance, a half-meter-long crack emitted a green light as an extremely pure flow of Heavenly Energy poured out, making them feel refreshed after just one breath.
Most importantly, there were more green crystals gathered below the crack, giving off a desire to devour them instinctively.
The Thunderflame Behemoth carefully controlled the weak water flow, gingerly gathering the Life Crystal Particles in its massive claws, then excitedly turned around and swam out.
As soon as the Thunderflame Behemoth emerged from the hole, the Single-horned Tiger Whale excitedly approached.
Coo coo coo!! Thunderflame, I smell something good.
Roar! Not bad this time.
Thunderflame Behemoth spread open its massive right claw, revealing green crystal grains that a human could hardly see with the naked eye. It then extended a finger from its left claw and gently flicked them.
Roar! One-for-one, eat and then get to work!
Their main goal this time wasn’t only to harvest their resources but also to grab the new treasures the Single-horned Tiger Whale had discovered. The resources were just a bonus.
As the three giant beasts swallowed the green crystal grains, which weren’t even enough to fill the gaps between their teeth, a vast and mighty Life Energy spread inside the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Crack crack!!
With an ample supply of Life Energy, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s somewhat malnourished body began to swell, its muscles grew, its scale armor bulged, and it became even more ferocious.
Especially the three pairs of blood-red feathered horns on both sides of its head, which were covered in sharp spikes. Beneath the golden flames, a crown of flames formed, making it look noble and dignified.
After replenishing the energy they had lost and restoring their bodies to a healthy state, the green crystal grains also increased their Evolution value by more than a hundred points.
Feeling the overwhelming power inside its body, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared with excitement: Roar! Charge charge charge, go grab the treasures! I want to eat more.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, whose body had also enlarged, roared excitedly.
Roar roar!! Kill them all, grab everything. I’ll lead the charge later.
Coo coo coo!! I will fight ten this time.
The two giant beasts, whose sizes had grown significantly, looked imposing and then… watch the Thunderflame Behemoth, who had just roared, turn around, and use its double claws to push the debris of rocks back to seal the cave entrance again.
Watching the Thunderflame Behemoth turn around and start working again, both the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Whale looked at each other, puzzled.
Shouldn’t we charge?
After filling the big hole in the crack, the three giant beasts left, and the pitch- black seabed thousands of meters underwater returned to its silent state.
The resources discovered by the Single-horned Tiger Whale this time were far away, about 1,500 kilometers from the desert island and deeper into the Outer Sea.
It was the latter half of the night by the time the three giant beasts approached their destination.
Below the ocean at a depth of more than five thousand meters, the three fifty-meter-long gigantic beasts appeared insignificant compared to the vast ocean.
Ahead, the seabed’s mountain ranges rose up, resembling a forest of sharp, towering reef rocks that stretched for tens of kilometers.
And on these reef rocks grew a few sparse purple coral plants emitting a faint glow. When they swayed slightly, they sprayed a purple substance.
These purple particles emitted concentrated waves of Heavenly Energy, attracting many marine life to feed.
Especially the squids that were several meters long, they swam in groups between the coral reef forests, filtering and devouring the purple substance while catching some smaller fish on the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 190:1 will take the lead in charging forward, and self-destruct if there’s any disagreement_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 190:1 will take the lead in charging forward, and self-destruct if there’s any disagreement_3
Translator: 549690339 |
At the edge of the Coral Reef Forest, a Single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out a low cry in the dark sea.
Whimpering sounds!! Those guys are right in there, a lot of them, guarding something amazing in the middle.
A lot of them?
The Thunderflame Beheamoth, staring at the purple coral reef forest, pondered for a moment: Roar! Domination, charge in, and lure them out.
Roar! Just watch me, charge, charge, charge.
The impatient Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out an excited roar, charging straight ahead. A yellow light shone on its body, sending off a mountain-like aura.
In this state connected to the earth, every step the Dragon Turtle took caused the seabed to vibrate and crack, stirring up rolling, raging currents.
Boom!
A reef that was dozens of meters high was directly smashed by the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the marine life wandering around it was frightened and scattered due to its violent breath.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle charged straight ahead, smashing one reef after another, each of them dozens or even hundreds of meters tall. The colossal commotion quickly attracted the attention of the creatures lurking inside.
Whoo, whoo, whoo!!
Accompanied by whirring sounds like a steam whistle, a group of mutated creatures, ranging in length from seven meters to more than twenty meters, charged out from the depths of the Coral Reef Forest.
These mutated creatures were strange, shaped like swordfish, their entire bodies covered in blue scales, and sharp bony spurs grew at the front of their mouths.
At the same time, sharp bone armor protruded from their backs and both sides, forming three rows of sharp bone knives, sending out a sharp aura, dividing the sea water at an astonishing speed as they passed by.
Most importantly, there were a lot of these mutated creatures, at least a thousand.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth had never seen such a huge group of mutated creatures before.
Soon, a Level 3 fish with a bone sword, ten meters in length, charged in first, brutally colliding into the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle. In an instant, a violent explosion erupted.
Boom!
The exploding blue radiance burst out with amazing power, forming a vacuum shockwave bubble sweeping across dozens of meters in range.
The sudden explosion left the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle a little bewildered, not quite understanding what had happened. At that moment, a dozen more Level 2 and 3 Mutated Ancient Swordfish crashed into it.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The explosions of these mutated creatures seemed to have a cumulative effect. Under the intense blue shock wave, the yellow energy shield on the surface of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s body vibrated madly, even showing signs of instability.
Phew!
At that moment, a twenty-nine-meter-long mutated bone swordfish burst out, reaching supersonic speed in the sea, like a blue light beam.
Thud!
The sharp bone spur, five meters long and covered in blue energy, suddenly pierced through the vibrating yellow energy and slammed onto the Dragon Turtle’s thick and sharp back armor.
Crack! With a horrifying impact, the mutated fish’s bone spur snapped, but at the same time, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s sturdy backshell was pierced ten centimeters deep.
This scene took the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle by surprise.
Its Earth’s Strength defense was difficult for even level eight beasts to break through, and today its back was pierced by a level six mutated creature. It managed to breach its protective power and a bit of the outer armor.
Such astonishing power was enough to show the terrifying nature of these mutated ancient swordfish, given the huge gap in levels between them.
Squinting his eyes in the dark sea far away, the Thunderflame Beheamoth also saw this scene.
It noticed that these creatures’ self-destruct capabilities were powerful, and they had a cumulative effect. The energy could also corrode, or rather neutralize the protective energy of the mutated creatures.
Under such circumstances, in combination with the high-speed attack of the advanced ancient swordfish, they possessed amazing penetration power, even able to penetrate the scale armor of creatures of a higher level, with the support of speed and kinetic energy.
Though the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s back armor was pierced only a little more than ten centimeters, one should know that it has always been known for its defense.
If it were an ordinary level seven mutated creature, it would have been injured by that attack just now.
Moreover, there were almost more than ten Level 6 Ancient Swordfish, with continuous explosions and collective charges, those mutated fish could even reverse-kill ordinary Level 7 creatures.
Roar!
At that moment, deep in the Coral Reef Forest, two more huge figures slowly emerged.
Both mutated beasts were over fifty meters tall, with one of them reaching a terrifying size of over sixty meters, emanating the mighty aura of late Level 7 and early Level 8.
These two Unique Beasts had thick blue scale armor on their bodies, resembling Furious Apes, with a pair of huge, exaggerated claws, which were somewhat similar to that long-haired fierce ape slain by Jack Clark.
The only difference was that these two mutated creatures appeared at the bottom of the sea.
Upon seeing those two Deep-sea Water Apes, the Thunderflame Beheamoth couldn’t help but be stunned. What’s going on? Did the ape evolve into an underwater form? Even growing to level eight.
However, being land-borne mutants, the deep sea seemed to have some influence on these two water apes, such as slightly slowed movement.
Of course, this slowness was in comparison to the Thunderflame Beheamoth and Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 191: Deep sea farming, drastic increase in size
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 191: Deep sea farming, drastic increase in size
Translator: 549690339 |
As the two Level 7 and Level 8 Deep-sea Water Apes appeared, the Thunderflame Behemoth let out a booming roar.
Roar! Domination, stop defending all the time. Clear those small creatures for me.
Roar! Joe, you go deal with that Level 7 Ape Beast. Be careful of its claws and unknown abilities.
Boom!
The golden-red flames of energy burning from the Thunderflame Behemoth erupted and spread out in a high temperature of 3,000 degrees Celsius for up to ten meters.
Under the intense heat, the surrounding sea water boiled instantaneously, curling up a scorching steam that surged in all directions and illuminated the seabed with dazzling light.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Behemoth stood upright, more than thirty meters tall, and took big strides into the coral reef forest. The stone pillars along the way collapsed, making a frightening sound.
Roar Roar!!
Upon the roar of the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle seemed to remember that it had other abilities. A terrifying shockwave explosion burst from the center of its roar.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, the sea water within a range of more than one hundred meters exploded. Everything shattered under the horrifying force of the shockwave, including the Mutant Ancient Swordfish surrounding it, the hard reefs, and ’ even the seabed below their feet.
In just the blink of an eye, dozens of Mutant Ancient Swordfish surrounding it had their bodies shattered and turned into countless fragments, mixed with the exploding sea water.
Woo!
With a deep and heavy whale-like howl, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, following the Thunderflame Behemoth, opened its mouth and unleashed its terrifying devouring power.
Boom! A deep-sea vortex with a diameter of 150 meters appeared in front of them.
After breaking through to Level 7 of the Mid Stage and evolving into the ancient Tiger Whale, Joe’s talent became even more powerful. The vortex that once merely stirred the sea water now resembled a black hole.
The Mutant Ancient Swordfish that were engulfed did not even have a chance to struggle before their bodies exploded under the pressure from all directions.
Under the wide-range attacks of the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the battlefield was instantly cleared with two open spaces and more than a hundred Ancient Swordfish killed.
However, compared to the thousands of Mutant Ancient Swordfish, this death toll was not very significant.
At this moment, the horn on the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s head lit up, shooting out a black and white beam of light, which instantly fell on a Level 4 Ancient Swordfish more than two hundred meters away.
Thud! The Ancient Swordfish was directly blown away… and then shook its head.
Weak attack, seeing this the Single-horned Tiger Whale didn’t bother to use that ability again.
Roar Roar!!
Feeling the strong aura of the Thunderflame Behemoth and the Tiger Whale, the two Deep Sea Water Apes, originally rushing towards the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, stopped and turned around to charge at them.
Surrounding the two Deep Sea Water Apes were more than a hundred Mutant Ancient Swordfish, ranging in size from eight meters to more than twenty meters, with a magnificent and broad aura.
Without waiting for the four giant beasts to get close, the Level 3 and Level 4 Mutant Ancient Swordfish, as fast as torpedoes, burst out towards the Thunderflame Behemoth and the Tiger Whale.
These low-level Ancient Swordfish were like missiles, blinking and hitting the flames sprayed by the Thunderflame Behemoth and the black and white shields surrounding the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
Boom boom boom!!
After dozens of consecutive explosions, the flames on the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body suddenly dimmed, and the black and white shields surrounding the Tiger Whale shook violently.
At this moment, the four giant beasts were already getting closer. The huge claws of the two Deep Sea Water Apes emitted a white light, giving off a terrifying sharp aura.
Just passing through the water left ten black cracks that lingered for a long time in the deep sea.
Under such circumstances, combined with the shockwaves caused by the explosions of the Ancient Swordfish, one strike was enough to heavily injure creatures of the same level, forming an almost unbeatable combination.
Boom!!
Under the boom, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Level 7 Water Ape collided fiercely. The black and white shield surrounding it vibrated madly and cracked under the sharp claws.
But at that moment, the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s tail suddenly swayed, unleashing a force like a tsunami, and its thick body slammed the Water Ape away fiercely.
As the two giant creatures collided, a force of pure and ferocious power erupted and the sea waves rolled.
The battle of the giant beasts had no fancy moves, it was just…
Roar!
The Level 8 Giant Beast roared in surprise and anger, as its double claws were caught by the Thunderflame Behemoth, and the scorching flames seeped through its protective energy, making it somewhat uncomfortable.
At that moment, the muscles in the Thunderflame Behemoth’s double claws swelled up, and an incredible force erupted in an instant. It directly lifted the seventy-meter-long Giant Beast over its shoulder and slammed it hard onto the ground.
Boom! The ground shattered instantly, the sea water exploded, and a destructive shockwave swept across a range of hundreds of meters, stirring up sand and seawater.
As the Eighth-Level Giant Beast twice his size was slammed onto the seabed, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared ferociously, its right claw raised, and dazzling golden light gathered on it.
Within its body, a boundless strength surged, and its hundredfold talent exploded…
Boom! A twenty-seven meters long Mutant Ancient Swordfish slammed ruthlessly into the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Under supersonic kinetic energy, the sharp dark blue luminescent bone spikes pierced through the external flames and fell on the thick black-red shoulder armor, instantly bursting with a strong shockwave.
However, under this attack, the Thunderflame Behemoth remained unmoved, while the Ancient Swordfish’s bone spurs broke under the powerful rebound, ’ leaving only a small pit on the scale armor.
The scale armor on its body was not like the shell of a Deep Sea Dragon Turtle. Although it seemed thinner, it was sturdier and had a frightening defense that caused despair to its enemies.
At that moment, a dazzling blue light shone from within the Level 6 Ancient Swordfish, and a fierce energy explosion occurred.
Boom!
The energy contained in a Level 6 Mutant Beast’s body was already extremely powerful. At this moment, as it was burning to explode, it was like a high-yield intercontinental missile.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 191: Deep sea farming, drastic increase in size_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 191: Deep sea farming, drastic increase in size_2
Translator: 549690339 I
The destructive impact of the explosion swept across a range of over a hundred meters, instantly shocking the seabed and causing the earth to crumble. Beneath the deep sea, a massive vacuum bubble emerged.
Even the Thunderflame Behemoth could not help but step back in the face of such an intense explosion, its intense flames constantly trembling and creating huge surges of scorching waves as it collided.
Roar!
Taking advantage of the moment when the Thunderflame Behemoth was knocked back, the Level 8 Water Ape let out a furious roar, its four claws shattering the seabed, and its massive body slamming into the Thunderflame Behemoth like a mountain.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force that shook mountains and seas, the Thunderflame Behemoth, almost half the size in comparison, was blasted away like a flaming meteor piercing through the seabed.
Crash! Crash! Crash!!
Dozens of stone pillars hundreds of meters tall were shattered by the Thunderflame Behemoth before it finally crashed hundreds of meters away onto the seabed, causing the surrounding seawater to tremble and mud to chum.
ROAR! The Level 8 Deep-sea Water Ape, which had slammed the Thunderflame Behemoth away, let out an excited roar, pounding its chest with both fists.
Under its majestic roar, the Level 3 and Level 4 Mutated Ancient Swordfish, as well as the twenty-meter-long Level 5 Mutated Ancient Swordfish, all shined with blue radiance and tore through the seawater at full speed.
In the blink of an eye, the Mutated Ancient Swordfish had swarmed the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! Countless dazzling blue lights erupted in an instant.
In the aftermath of over a hundred explosions, the entire seabed shuddered, and the destructive shock created waves that rose hundreds of meters high. ’ The surrounding coral reefs within a range of several hundred meters continuously crumbled, creating an earth-shaking momentum.
The time it took for the two giant beasts to engage in combat and the Thunderflame Behemoth to be submerged by the explosions was less than a minute.
At this point, the Single-horned Tiger Whale was fighting the Level 7 Late Stage Water Ape, relying on its black and white shield to ram through any obstacles while its flippers unleashed a powerful force capable ofcrushing mountains and breaking rocks.
The gaping maw it opened intermittently created black hole vortices that shredded the Ancient Swordfish trying to rush over and explode it, suppressing the giant beast.
However, due to the lack of decisive attacks and fear of the Water Ape’s double claws, the two giant beasts continued their fierce battle for a time.
On the other hand, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was surrounded by hundreds of Mutated Ancient Swordfish, with wave after wave of destructive shockwaves erupting around it, killing dozens of lower-level Ancient Swordfish each time.
Under the overbearing shockwave attacks, almost everything around was annihilated.
But as soon as the Dragon Turtle’s outer shockwaves ended, it would be submerged in fierce explosions.
At this time, several Level 6 Ancient Swordfish waiting for the opportunity would unleash their terrifying speed, targeting the head and limbs of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Underneath the sharp bone spurs and the high-speed penetration of the bone blades on the sides of their bodies, the Dragon Turtle, whose defensive capabilities were disrupted by the shockwaves, could not withstand the onslaught.
Gashes were torn into its limbs.
Although these were just light injuries, which would be healed in a blink of an eye thanks to its powerful regenerative capabilities, it illustrated the possibility of death by a thousand cuts.
Just as the explosions subsided in the distance, a figure ablaze with golden-red flames emerged from the murky depths of the sea, slowly walking out.
It was the unscathed Thunderflame Behemoth.
With its growing body size and increasingly horrifying fleshly body, its abilities in all aspects were becoming stronger, whether it be strength, defense, or talent.
Under the fusion of its top-tier Defensive Talent with the scorching heat and lightning energy, as long as the attacks were from creatures lower than its level, they would not be able to break its defense.
In other words, unless it was attacked by creatures of the same level, even if billions of lower-level Mutated Beasts tried to kill it, it would be futile. It was that insanely formidable and terrifying.
Roar! I didn’t expect you to have Mental Talent, which can influence these Mutated Swordfish, no wonder they are fearless of death.
Roar! That was an enjoyable explosion; now it’s my turn.
In its fierce roar, the seabed beneath the Thunderflame Behemoth suddenly shattered and collapsed, forming a crater with a diameter of tens of meters before the exploding seawater followed.
Boom!
Under the terror of the circular shockwave explosion, the Thunderflame disappeared from its original position in an instant, and soon after, the Level 8 Water Ape let out a surprised and furious roar as the flames exploded on its chest.
Boom!
Under the overbearing collision of the Thunderflame Behemoth using itself as a cannonball, the Deep-sea Water Ape’s massive body crashed through half of the Coral Reef Forest.
Due to the high speed, a vacuum tunnel even formed in the surroundings, causing the coral reefs to explode, leaving behind a path of destruction.
Boom!
As it fell to the ground in an instant, a claw infused with golden light descended from the sky, slamming into the head of the Water Ape and even burying half of its body into the seabed.
Immediately, the scales on the giant Ape’s head exploded, and flesh and blood flew everywhere.
It was a scene reminiscent of when the Thunderflame Behemoth killed the Ancient Giant Crocodile.
Roar!
A strong mental shockwave erupted with the Water Ape at its center, and as the shockwave swept over the body of the Thunderflame Behemoth, its figure involuntarily paused for a moment before raising its leg.
Thud!
With a heavy stomp, the Water Ape’s body, which had just managed to prop itself up, was once again pressed heavily into the ground.
But just as the Thunderflame Behemoth raised both claws, a strong aura of death enveloped the Water Ape, causing a chill to rise from its heart.
Its instincts told it that if the Thunderflame Behemoth landed this blow, it would die.
ROAR! Under the threat of death, the Level 8 Water Ape let out a frenzied roar, vibrating the sea area, and an even stronger mental shockwave erupted.
In an instant, all the remaining Mutated Ancient Swordfish in the distance went berserk, abandoning the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Whale to charge toward the Thunderflame Behemoth, their numbers reaching over six hundred.
With such a staggering number, combined with the massive size of these Mutated Creatures, a sense of awe-inspiring momentum surged like an army of a thousand soldiers and ten thousand horses.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 191: Deep Sea Farming, Drastic Increase in Size_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 191: Deep Sea Farming, Drastic Increase in Size_3
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, the blue radiance at the basal part of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s dorsal fin lit up one after another.
Zizz!!
In an instant, centered around the Thunderflame Behemoth, endless lightning burst out, forming a spherical lightning net that swept more than a hundred meters with the thickness of arms and legs.
All those ancient swordfish with a level below four that entered the range of the lightning net stopped, and the unstable energy in their bodies was ignited by the thunder.
Boom, boom, boom! The explosion of hundreds of ancient swordfish created a terrifying shock wave that obliterated everything.
The Level 5 ancient swordfish were also ignited under such terrifying explosions, and an even more intense explosion erupted in an instant.
The horrifying power destroyed the thunder and lightning net, and the entire sea area was shaking. The explosions left the Thunderflame Behemoth and the Deep-sea Water Ape beneath it somewhat dizzy.
Just then, due to the distance, the last three Level 6 ancient swordfish rushed toward the Thunderflame Behemoth through the raging sea waters under the spirit’s call.
Under the desire to survive, the Water Ape desperately unleashed a mental shock to make the three Level 6 ancient swordfish explode near the Thunderflame Behemoth.
As for using the mental shock to affect the Thunderflame Behemoth, it had tried that, but to no avail…
Biu!
The tail of the Thunderflame Behemoth, entwined with flames and jumping with lightning, made a sonic boom under the sea, as if there were multiple afterimages flashing by.
At a terrifying speed and strength, the more than 20-meter-long Tail Sword was like a sword expert, slashing out sharp lights that minced the three Level 6 ancient swordfish charging at it into pieces of flesh.
As for why it was sword light, it was because Jack Clark had only learned Sword skill.
While the tail took care of the three Level 6 exotic beasts, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s double claws gathered terrifying power, with golden red flames and lightning materializing into two spiral rays.
Boom!
With the Thunderflame Behemoth’s strike falling, the entire seabed collapsed with a bang, and countless dirt and debris rolled like earth dragons, rushing up into the sky under the terrifying power.
The violent water flow caused by the blast rose more than a thousand meters, stirring up the surrounding muddy water and making it turbid.
When the violent water flow subsided, a huge crater with a diameter of more than a hundred meters appeared on the seabed, and the land within a range of hundreds of meters was shattered – terrifying to the extreme.
Deep in the crater, half the body of the Level 8 Berserk Ape was destroyed.
The thick protective energy, the alloy-like solid armor that was 2 meters thick, and the flesh, blood, and bones were all useless under the terrifying power of a hundred times amplification.
This is the terror of Top-tier Talent.
The innate ability that this Thunderflame Behemoth acquired when it was weak showed terrible power after it broke through to Level 7 and grew into a nearly 50-meter-long giant.
As for the other mutated creatures, like human cultivators, the higher the level, the greater the pressure to suppress.
Regardless of size, body strength, contained power, or talent power, a difference in level almost equaled complete crushing.
Unless these mutated creatures awakened the Dragon Bloodline or the King- level Bloodline, there would be no possibility of fighting across levels.
However, this point did not apply to the Thunderflame Behemoth.
As other mutated creatures gained strength and their bloodlines evolved, their bodies would be tempered by Heavenly Energy, becoming stronger and stronger and tenacious.
But as the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body and flesh were tempered by Heavenly Energy and became stronger, its unique Evolution Energy caused its entire body’s cells to undergo rapid division and compression every time it grew a little.
Under such circumstances, although its size grew larger and larger, its body density resembled a constantly collapsing neutron star, making its power more horrifying and its defense astonishing.
This was the fundamental reason why it could easily fight across levels. Its pure power and defense were comparable to that of a higher-level giant beast. Additonally, with its innate talents, fighting across a Major Realm was as simple as drinking water, allowing it to easily dominate the Early Stage of the Eighth Rank Beast at Level 7 Mid Stage.
Roar, roar, roar!!
With no more hundreds of mutated ancient swordfish to restrain it, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Tiger Whale worked together to make the Late Level 7 Water Ape let out a miserable roar.
With a bang, its head was bitten off and killed by the Single-Horned Tiger Whale.
However, in this battle, most of the magnificent Purple Coral Reef Forest was destroyed, leaving behind ruins and countless marine creatures killed by the aftermath of the fight.
These ordinary mutated creatures mainly died in the two massive explosions before and after the battle.
Standing upright, the Thunderflame Behemoth dragged the corpse of the Water Ape and walked towards the Single-horned Tiger Whale. When it approached, it roared: Roar! Let’s go and get things done.
Roar, roar!! Make something delicious to eat.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared excitedly too.
Ying ying ying!! Follow me inside.
With that, the Single-homed Tiger Whale stirred up the rolling sea water and dashed into the Coral Reef Forest in the blink of an eye, with the Dragon Turtle quickly following behind.
As the Thunderflame Behemoth looked at the corpse of the Level 7 Water Ape, it shook its head slightly, grabbed the Ape’s large leg with another claw, and dragged the two mutated beast corpses along.
Soon, the three giant beasts arrived in the center of the Coral Reef Forest guarded by those mutated creatures – a small hill that rose hundreds of meters above the seafloor.
A gigantic hollow with a diameter of tens of meters was dug out at the base of the mountain, extending downward, and pure Heavenly Energy gushed out from inside.
Feeling the surging pure energy inside, the three giant beasts were excited. Leaving the two Water Ape corpses outside the cave, the Thunderflame Behemoth took the lead and swam in. Soon, the three huge beasts reached the ground several hundred meters beneath the surface.
These giant holes were filled with purple coral plants, which swayed gently.
Compared to the sparse purple coral plants on the reef, there were more than a thousand times as many here, and they constantly spewed large amounts of purple energy substance.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: 191: Farming in the Deep Sea, Dramatically Increasing in Size_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: 191: Farming in the Deep Sea, Dramatically Increasing in Size_4
Translator: 549690339
Because of the enormous amount of energy expelled, the underground cave had almost transformed into a purple world.
Gurgle!
The Thunderflame Behemoth took a deep breath, and a pure energy burst within its body, instantly sending a comfortable sensation to every cell in its flesh and blood.
Just one inhalation, and most of the energy it had depleted in the previous battle was restored within the blink of an eye.
Roar! What pure energy.
Even the Thunderflamc Behemoth couldn’t help but let out an excited growl.
Under normal conditions, these Unique Beasts also need to convert the Heavenly Energy they absorb. Most of it would disperse back into Heaven and Earth during the conversion process.
However, the purple particles exhaled by the purple coral plants after conversion are like pure energy ‘food’. They can be directly absorbed without any waste.
The most significant thing is, the Beast can absorb so many at a breath.
Roar roar roar!!
Charge charge charge!!
The three enormous beasts directly rushed into the underground hollow that was more than a hundred meters high and had a diameter of hundreds of meters. They opened their mouths wide and began to devour and absorb the energy ravenously.
Following the endless absorption of energy, the bodies of the three beasts that had turned active due to the continuous devouring of Growth Crystals evolved and grew wildly. The Evolution Value was also skyrocketing.
Crack Crack, the body of the Thunderflame Behemoth grew at a visible speed, swiftly reaching forty-nine meters, fifty meters, fifty-one meters…
As the Thunderflame Behemoth grew, the body of the Deep-Sea Dragon Turtle and Single-horned Tiger Whale also expanded.
When the Thunderflam behemoth grew to fifty-three meters, the three giant beasts stopped as the purple energy in the surroundings was almost swallowed.
Furthermore, as the purple substances contained in the seawater disappeared, the purple corals also fell silent, and it would take a while for them to spit out a little purple substance again.
Roar! That was rash. It seems that these things are mutually symbiotic, and we shouldn’t absorb too much at once. The Thunderflame Behemoth showed some pity. No wonder those Deep-sea Water Apes didn’t devour all of this energy.
Those two Mutated Creatures are not dumb. They actually understand the concept of ‘farming’.
Ying Ying Ying!! So full, so comfortable.
Roar roar!! What a rush, but too bad, it’s all over now.
The Dragon Turtle, which had grown to fifty-two meters and the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which had grown to fifty-one meters, growled and roared, still immersed in the excitement of their growth and power surge.
Roar! Let’s go, time to get to work.
Ying Ying Ying!! Thunderflame, what do you want us to do next?
The Single-horned Tiger Whale was a bit puzzled. Weren’t all the enemies taken care of?
Roar! Both of you, go and destroy all the adjacent reef rocks and stone pillars, especially those glowing purple corals on them.
Roar roar!! But they look nice, why destroy them?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was a bit confused.
Bang! Thunderflame slapped on its thick carapace, and the massive body of the Dragon Turtle was instantly blasted dozens of meters away.
Roar! Why are you talking so much nonsense? Do as you’re told and get a move on.
Immediately, the Dragon Turtle withdrew its neck and swam out a little wronged, and seeing this, Single-horned Tiger Whale also hurriedly followed, afraid that Thunderflame Behemoth would also give it a swipe.
Old scare beast.
Humph Humph!! These guys only learn from punishment and not from memory. The Thunderflame Behemoth snorted and also swam out of the underground hollow to the top.
At this time, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and Single-horned Tiger Whale were already doing their best to destroy the reefs. Seeing that, the Thunderflame Behemoth also took a deep breath and came to the top of the small hill.
Boom!!
Half of the hill was collapsed by the Thunderflame Behemoth, and countless rubble buried the cave in the thunderous rumble. Immediately the surroundings plunged into darkness and deathly silence.
With the cave sealed and the surrounding purple corals also destroyed, no Mutated Creatures should be able to find the coral cave buried several hundred meters down.
Let’s wait for half a month and then come back to see how the purple energy is ‘growing’. By then, we can determine whether to engage in long-term cultivation or short-term harvesting based on its growth.
The Thunderflame Behemoth stood upright and pondered standing on the collapsed mountain peak.
Almost an hour later, when the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had finished their exhausting work and were panting, the Thunderflame Behemoth finally gave a satisfied nod and growled.
Roar! Let’s go, let’s go back.
Ying Ying Ying!! Thunderflame, can you let Domination do this kind of work next time? It’s so tiring.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale was flapping its fins weakly.
Roar roar!! Why me?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was a little unhappy.
Ying Ying Ying!! Because you are the youngest, the smallest, you should do more work.
Roar roar!! Why? I am the third, I am clearly older than you?
Roar! Enough, let’s go back first. If there are any disagreements, let’s fight it out when we’re back. The winner becomes the second.
Amid the low roars and growls, the three fierce beasts resembling bandits disappeared into the darkness with Thunderflame Behemoth still clutching two pieces of ‘food’ under its claws.
This time, after absorbing so much energy and eating the bodies of the two Mutant Beasts combined with eating some more Growth Crystals when they get back, their body sizes will experience another surge..

chapters.title: Chapter 343: 192: Ascending the Throne, Ranked Number One
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: 192: Ascending the Throne, Ranked Number One
Translator: 549690339 ]
Night!
Jack Clark stood with his hands behind his back on the edge of the cliff in the second half of the night, overlooking the misty abyss in front of him. He felt an inexplicable grandiose atmosphere, as if he had a bird’s eye view of the heavens and the earth, as if everything was within his control.
No wonder that guy liked standing here. It not only looks cool, but also feels so good.
At this moment, streams of heat appeared out of nowhere inside Jack Clark’s body.
Under those energies, the cells in Jack Clark’s body kept dividing and compressing, making his muscles stronger, his bones harder, and even his five viscera and six bowels more powerful.
As his flesh and blood were strengthening at a clearly perceptible speed, even though Jack Clark had already converged, the invisible aura of pure strength he emitted still scattered the surrounding gales.
After a while, Jack Clark exhaled and showed a surprised look in his eyes.
Because not only did this growth in Thunderflame Beheamoth gain him more than 1,000 Evolution points, but also increased his four major attributes by more than 100 points through the Avatar Feedback.
The strongest strength attribute soared from 1491 points to 1612.
Over 1600 strength points allowed Jack Clark’s basic arm strength to exceed forty tons.
Of course, it’s estimated because there was no precise test.
Moreover, this kind of enhancement belonged to the whole body, just… this spiritual attribute?
Jack Clark’s eyes swept across the Spirit Attribute, which had risen to 1200 points, revealing his confusion.
Logically speaking, his Spirit Attribute should have been hundreds of times stronger than that of ordinary people. When released, it should have been able to cover a range of hundreds of meters.
Even if not released, the Spirit Power, which was hundreds of times stronger than that of ordinary people, should have been very powerful. When condensed, it should have had a strong attack in the form of Mind Power.
But at this moment, Jack Clark felt that although his Spirit Power was thicker than ordinary people, it had not yet reached the exaggerated level of hundreds of times, let alone interfering with matter to form powerful Mind Power.
The increase in spiritual attributes seemed more like strengthening… the soul. Thinking of this, expectation appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes, “If the increase in spiritual attributes involves the soul, then once I break through the late stage of Nine Layers Heaven…”
Jack Clark had once read in a cultivation manual that the soul was very important above the King-level, or when a cultivator reached the peak of the Nine Layers Heaven and touched upon the rules.
It related to the understanding of the rules and the power of the rules mastered.
Before touching the rules at the peak of Nine Layers Heaven, cultivators only trained their ‘bodies’ and could not involve their souls.
The only thing that could enhance the strength of the soul was the Power of Intent. This was also the reason why geniuses who had comprehended Sword Intent and Blade Intent were so rare and valued.
If his soul was already hundreds of times stronger than that of ordinary people, then wouldn’t his strength explode once he broke through the Peak of Nine Layers Heaven!!
With the soul force of hundreds of times, controlling the rules, would the Nine Layers Heaven battle the King-level?
Let’s not get too excited, as the possibility is not yet certain.
After repeatedly chanting to himself, Jack Clark slowly calmed his excitement, lest the greater the hope, the greater the disappointment.
In fact, he would soon be able to determine whether the spiritual attribute represented the soul.
After he went back tomorrow, he planned to try to condense Battle Intent with Invincible Path. If he succeeded, he would know whether it was ‘soul’ from the changes in his spiritual attributes.
Of course, if it failed, there would be no way.
For the ethereal special power of Battle Intent, Jack Clark was not 100% sure of success.
Because of his family background, he only came into contact with the Cultivation World after high school, so his foundation was weak.
This foundation did not refer to resources but to the understanding and inheritance of cultivation, similar to how children from scholarly families are familiar with Scriptures and understand the principles of life from a young age. And up to now, although his cultivation realm had broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven, his total cultivation time was only over half a year. He didn’t have that much time to perfect his own Cultivation System.
Under such circumstances, it was actually a bit difficult for him to comprehend Battle Intent by sweeping through opponents of the same level.
Whether one has Battle Intent or not is very important for cultivators below the Seventh Layer Heaven. Otherwise, even a cultivator with the peak of Six Heavens strength would not be a match for a Seventh Layer Heaven cultivator.
The reason lay in the second qualitative change of the True Strength of the Seventh Layer Heaven strong men.
After the second qualitative change, not only is the True Strength condensed and overbearing, it can also absorb Heavenly Energy, and explode six times the power of the same amount of True Strength of the Sixth Layer Heaven.
Five times, it doesn’t sound like much.
But just think of Jack Clark’s Infernal Purgatory that shattered the earth for twenty meters with one blow. Just imagine how terrifying it would be to turn that power multiple times, and his True Strength cultivation was only at the mid-stage of Fifth Layer Heaven.
This Elephant’s Fury Rune couldn’t do it, even if the rune burned and amplified his power and defense ten times.
This power came from physical strength. Although Dragon Power was extremely fierce after becoming real, it was not like the True Strength generated by the chemical reaction of a missile explosion.
Once the Sword Intent or Blade Intent is comprehended, not only can it touch the soul early, but it can also mobilize the energy of Heaven and Earth with the Power of Intent below the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Of course, the ordinary Sword Intent and Battle Intent are definitely not as powerful as the Seventh Layer Heaven strong men.
In general, the Sword Intent that has just been entered can only increase the power of Sword Qi by 50% and bring the unique characteristics of the comprehended Sword Intent.
Once the Sword Intent reaches the small stage, the enhancement of Sword Qi and Blade Qi will instantly increase to twice as much, and when it reaches the grand accomplishment, it can appear externally, and the world will change with just a thought.
This enhancement still exists after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Both are high-level cultivators of the Seventh Layer Heaven. Those without the Power of Intent have a fivefold increase in True Strength in every move, while those with Sword Intent at a small stage have a sevenfold increase.
The gap suddenly appears.
However, life and death battles aren’t about surface data. If the combat experience and willpower are insufficient, there are cases where late-stage Seventh Layer Heaven can be defeated by early-stage Seventh Layer Heaven. Just like among ordinary people with normal physique, a fitness coach is certainly no match for a Special Forces soldier.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 192: Ascending the Throne, Ranked First_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 192: Ascending the Throne, Ranked First_2
Translator: 549690339
The night went by as Jack Clark kept… well watchdogging.
With the sunlight piercing through the clouds and mist at dawn, the mountain range gradually became quiet.
Looking at the ready-to-go Jack Clark, Jane Aiken’s eyes revealed curiosity: “When you go back this time, you’re going to try to condense an invincible war intent, aren’t you?”
“Yes.”
Jack Clark nodded, “This invasion incident has gathered all the students at the Martial Height Base. If I miss this opportunity, I won’t have the chance to challenge everyone anymore.”
“Challenge everyone, including those third-grade students?” Jane Aiken paused, as she always assumed Jack Clark was targeting those cultivation students in the second grade at the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark nodded: “Yes.”
An incredulous thought surfaced in Jane Aiken’s mind, her small mouth slightly agape: “Your current realm…?”
When they met earlier, Jack Clark was hiding his aura. Even though he was emitting an oppressive atmosphere, Jane Aiken assumed his realm was about the same as hers, both in the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
After all, just over half a month ago, Jack Clark was in the early stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven. The idea of the Fifth Layer Heaven was too mystical.
Jack Clark didn’t hide anything: “My cultivation has been smooth during this time, and a few days ago I managed to breakthrough to the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven after consecutively condensing into the Divine Tyrant Body.”
“…Impressive!” It was Jane Aiken’s turn to say these words.
Then she visibly brightened, “I originally thought my speed of progress had already surpassed everyone in my grade, to the point where I even felt a bit of chill from being at such heights.”
“I didn’t expect that in less than a month’s time, you, Student Clark, have already surpassed me so much.”
“It seems that I’ll have to be absent this time, unable to witness your sweeping of the entire South Sky Martial Height Base, and your stunning reversal against all those older geniuses.”
Jane Aiken was originally prepared to go back with Jack Clark to witness him sweeping over all the geniuses of his grade.
But after knowing that his realm astonishingly surpassed hers by two small realms, and advanced to the Fifth Layer Heaven ahead of time, she felt a sudden surge of motivation to cultivate.
Jack Clark just smiled at this, nonchalantly saying: “I’m just challenging those students in the Fifth Layer Heaven. It’s not much of an event. I’ll invite you to be the witness when I ascend the throne one day.”
“Of course, you might reach the throne before I do.”
Considering Jane Aiken’s terrifying speed of improvement after breaking through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, Jack Clark did not make an absolute statement.
After all, it would be quite embarrassing if he were to be slapped in the face.
The young girl nodded: “Okay, I will go and witness when you ascend to the throne. If I get to the throne first, I will also invite you.”
After saying all that, the boy and girl exchanged confident smiles. It seemed as if the throne, which only a few among millions could reach, was within their grasp.
Of course, both of them knew how difficult it was to ascend the throne. But as ‘geniuses’, they couldn’t show weakness at this time. Anyway, boasting wasn’t illegal.
After saying goodbye to Jane Aiken, Jack Clark quickly navigated through the Vast Wilderness Forest. At a speed of two hundred meters per second, he was almost like a black-red radiance.
Bang!
A mountain rock ten meters high was shattered by Jack Clark’s punch. The sky was filled with debris, and smoke and dust enveloped the area.
When Jack Clark crossed between two valleys, a Level 4 Mutant Beast seventeen meters long suddenly pounced from a mountain wall.
Roar! The Dragon Roar Elephant Roar echoed in the void, and a golden red light flashed.
Bang!
Under Jack Clark’s overbearing Dragon Elephant Step to Heaven punch, half of the Level 4 Mutant Beast’s body exploded, and its silhouette flashed through the rain of blood in the sky.
Soon, Jack Clark left the Cloud Mist Mountain Range and entered the Nine Rings Mountain.
Arriving here, his aura became even heavier, full of oppression, and the invincible aura that had been integrated into his body after the initial fusion failure showed signs of activation.
Roar…Bang!
A Level 3 Mutant Beast just started roaring when it was blown up by Jack Clark who was rushing past.
Bang!
A large tree that took five people to encircle was directly knocked down, collapsing with a bang.
When encountering a river hundreds of meters wide, Jack Clark burst forth at supersonic speed stepping over the water, like a sharp arrow that stirred up a huge wave.
Just as a Mutant Beast underwater emerged, it was blown up by Jack Clark’s punch.
From an aerial view, one could see Jack Clark running almost in a straight line towards the South Sky Martial Height Base.
Mountains were climbed, rivers were crossed, a straight line was drawn through the vast wilderness forest, trees were shattered, unique beasts were blown up, nothing could stop his steps.
He was using this way to build up momentum, to inspire willpower.
To condense an invincible war intent, one needed a unity of body and mind, manifesting the belief that ‘I am invincible’ and ‘I am unstoppable’.
Of course, the belief of ‘I am invincible’ meant sweeping all of the same level, being unstoppable meant no one could stand in your way, not to foolishly charge to their death when facing high-ranking powerhouses.
That wouldn’t be unstoppable, that would be stupid.
At 11 am.
As most of the students who usually spent their time outside returned, the South Sky Martial Height Base became quite lively for the past couple days, people everywhere.
Because they couldn’t leave, these second and third-year students who were used to fighting and roaming around in the mountains suddenly felt extremely bored.
They either sat on the steps chatting, or squatted in the mission hall boasting.
As for the first-grade students… there were too few of them, just thirty or forty people and not very noticeable.
Outside the Base Mission Hall, Justin Welan, Marcus Lee, Zac Lyons, White Veil, and Mullen Weisz were sitting on the steps, looking bored.
Justin looked around somewhat confused: “Strange, why isn’t Jack back yet?”
“I heard from Kyle Hawk that Jack Clark went into the Cloud Mist mountain range the morning the Evil God Sect cultists invaded, and he should be hiding somewhere now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 192: Ascending the Throne, Ranked Number One 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 192: Ascending the Throne, Ranked Number One 3
Translator: 549690339 |
While saying this, Mullen Weisz couldn’t help but laugh, “It’s about time this guy got what’s coming to him for showing off so much. He finally met his match this time.”
Zac Lyons also laughed, “Definitely, although Jack Clark is very powerful, he’s still a bit short-handed when facing those Evil God Sect cultists who are speculated to be at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven or even at the peak.” Three days passed, and everyone more or less learned about the current situation from their teachers and the official announcements made to stabilize people’s emotions.
For example, there were more than twenty invading Evil God Sect cultists, all at the Sixth-level Heaven before the invasion.
However, after entering the Alien Beast Battlefield, their realms fell to the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven or the peak due to injuries, but their strengths were all above the Sixth-level Heaven.
This is the reason why they believed that Jack Clark wouldn’t be a match for those Evil God Sect cultists.
After all, Jack Clark’s highest record is killing the Level 5 Peak Fire Serpent. Although the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven’s strength seems to be just a step away from the Sixth Layer Heaven, the difference between them is huge. Although they thought Jack Clark wasn’t a match for those cultists, they weren’t particularly worried about his safety.
Having known him for a long time, everyone knew that Jack was seemingly crazy about battles and overbearing, but he was very prudent. He wouldn’t take risks without being sure of the outcome.
Moreover, he practiced a secret skill to hide his aura. As long as he was careful, he should be fine, especially since the Cloud Mist Mountain Range was so vast ’ anyway.
At this time, White Veil looked enviously at those around him emitting Fourth Layer Heaven or even Fifth Layer Heaven aura, “1 wonder when we’ll be able to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“It feels like being at the Third Layer Heaven is just being a small fry here, with no sense of existence. It’s so hard to kill even a Level 4 Mutated Beast,” he added.
Marcus Lee nodded, “That’s true, the Fourth Layer Heaven is a qualitative change. Maybe our strength could explode many times over, and we’ll be able to fight across realms just like Jack Clark.”
As soon as Marcus Lee finished speaking, White Veil, Zac Lyons, and the others looked at him with strange eyes.
“Uh… Why are you guys looking at me like that?” Marcus Lee was puzzled.
Justin Welan said helplessly, “Marcus Lee, you’re daydreaming. Even if your strength explodes after breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, it would be great if you can cross two small realms.”
Mullen Weisz nodded, “That’s right, Jack Clark, the freak, is an exception. We definitely can’t compare.”
Although they were all geniuses and had a deep understanding of advanced cultivation methods and accompanying battle techniques, they still had some self-knowledge about their strength.
They felt that even if they broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven and underwent a qualitative change, they would only barely be able to cross two small realms, with fighting from the initial stage to the late stage being their limit.
And that’s just the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Once they got to the Fifth Layer Heaven, the gap in their cultivation methods would shrink, and they didn’t think they could cross more than one small realm unless they made a breakthrough in their cultivation methods or realm of thought.
“Wait, why is it just us? Justin Welan, aren’t you the same as us?” At this moment, Zac Lyons reacted.
Justin Welan laughed proudly at this point.
“Heh! I, Grandpa Walton, am different from you guys. When I was at the initial stage of the Third Layer, I was able to withstand a frontal attack from the Golden-Backed Berserk Ape King. Now I am in the late stage and can even fight against a Level 4 Peak Alien Beast head-on.”
“So, my talent is much higher than yours. When I break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, with the qualitative change of the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth True Ability, even an ordinary Level 5 Alien Beast won’t be able to stop me.
Justin Welan’s smug look annoyed the four of them, and Marcus Lee said faintly, “By that time, you might indeed be able to withstand a Level 5 Alien Beast’s attack, but you probably won’t even be able to kill a Late Fourth Layer Heaven Alien Beast.”
“Hahaha… That’s right. What’s the use of strong defense if you can’t even beat someone at the same level?”
Justin Welan snorted, “Hmph! Who said I can’t beat them? Once I reach the Fourth Layer Heaven, you guys will see! Even a turtle has a time when it bites.” Moreover, the second batch of high-level resources my brother sent me is about to arrive. Before long, I’ll be able to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“Damn it!”
“Let’s go, let’s go.”
“I heard there’s a beautiful sea of flowers under the back mountain. Do you guys want to go for a walk?”
“Together, together.”
Facing Justin Welan, who has a high-level cultivator brother, and receives constant shipments of high-level resources, the four of them felt nothing but envy.
So they decided to leave him out of their plans as a form of revenge. However, just as the four of them stood up, a terrifying aura appeared in the distance, and the invisible force emitted made everyone feel a sense of suffocation.
Soon, many people saw the air on the square below constantly rippling under that overbearing aura, forming a circle of transparent invisible airwaves.
Such a terrible aura, even those Sixth Layer Heaven teachers couldn’t compare.
“Who is that?!”
“Such an intimidating aura!”
Many people instinctively stood up, looking at the distance with a solemn expression, where a tall figure wearing black and red crystal armor slowly stepped onto the square.
With every heavy step he took, the ground would tremble slightly, the smoke and dust rising only to be dispersed by the invisible surrounding wind, making an astonishing display.
At this moment, the substantial power of the aura was rolling on Jack Clark, heavy and overbearing. The air even twisted under the invisible power, looking like it was collapsing and appearing terrifying.
“Jack!”
“Jack Clark.”
“It seems to be the genius student from the first grade!”
“This aura seems like the Fifth Layer Heaven, but how is it possible!?” Under the shocked and astonished gaze of everyone, Jack Clark, radiating a domineering aura, walked to the bottom of the big screen, and after verifying his identity, placed his hand on it.
Instantly, all big screens in the 59 Martial Height Bases displayed a row of red large characters:
“Jack Clark, South Sky Martial Height, Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven, First-Grade Talent Rankings, Rank One.”
First Grade, Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
In an instant, everyone couldn’t believe their eyes as they looked at that row of red characters, their faces showing horror..

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 193: Transcending the Mortal Realm, Extreme Strengthening of Golden Runes (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 193: Transcending the Mortal Realm, Extreme Strengthening of Golden Runes (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339 |
When the red large characters of the First Grade and the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven shone, almost all the students who saw them at the Martial Height Base lost their voices in an instant.
As cultivators, they knew very well how difficult it was to advance a small realm after the late-phase of the Third Layer Heaven. Many people were stuck in the Fourth Layer Heaven for half a year.
That’s why some third-grade students are still in the Third Layer Heaven.
Let alone the second-grade students, many with mediocre talent were still in the late-stage of the Second Heaven, striving to breakthrough to the Third Layer Heaven.
But now there’s a first-year student who had not just broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven, but had even reached the mid-stage!!
At this moment, not only were they dumbfounded, but many senior students in the second and third grades were also somewhat disoriented and fell into self-doubt.
Are they actually worthless?
Cultivating for three years and still in the Third Layer Heaven, while on the other hand, cultivating for one year… No, it’s only been a month since the start of the next semester for the Senior One students, which means they’ve only been cultivating for half a year.
Half a year, mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven, it was almost one realm per month.
At this moment, not only were those senior students shocked, but those geniuses from the higher grades were also shocked, feeling that the red large characters that stayed on the big screen for a long time were a bit dazzling.
This junior student… is even more monstrous than Junior Carney Turner,” said Betty Leinster, wearing a leisure suit and standing at the edge of the rooftop of the female dormitory, her hands folded across her chest and her face filled with astonishment.
Because she had to take care of the Leinster sisters, she chose to withdraw from the Cloud Mist Mountain Range after receiving the message and did not participate in the encirclement, thus she had witnessed this scene.
Crystal Leinster, who had been talking to Mandy Leinster by her side, widened her eyes and exclaimed, “Jack Clark, how is that possible!!”
At this moment, the gentle Mandy Leinster stood there with her mouth slightly agape, stunned.
Compared to the somewhat normal reactions of the two sisters, Justin Welan and his group went crazy after the shock. In a flash, they rushed to Jack Clark’s side.
Looking at the terrifying aura of Jack Clark, Zac Lyons excitedly said, “Damn! Damn…”
Stop getting so close,” Marcus Lee pushed Zac Lyons away, looking at Jack Clark excitedly, “Jack, did you find some top-tier resources for advancing your realm?”
Jack Clark glanced at him, “Do you think it’s possible?”
“Hahaha… Jack, this time you’ve really outdone yourself,” Mr. Willard laughed. “Now, who dares not to accept you as the number one among the new generation? What about Jane Aiken, Ian Clark, Freddy Nelson? They all eat dust behind your ass.”
Jack Clark looked at Mr. Willard, who was getting more and more excited, and a trace of strangeness flashed in his eyes.
He really wanted to tell them that Jane Aiken had already reached the late period of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
But upon thinking about it, he decided to forget it. Instead, Jack Clark solemnly said, “Mr. Willard, help me spread the word. At 2 pm this afternoon, after my meditation session, I will challenge all the Fifth Layer Heaven seniors at the base.”
Tell them, Jack Clark says that no one can withstand my three unbeaten moves.”
Originally, Jack Clark wanted to say one move, but after some thought, he changed it to three moves, just to play it safe and avoid being slapped in the face with some special Secret Skill.
However, even with that, the entire square burst into chaos in an instant, and those senior students who had doubted themselves and were shocked earlier came back to their senses.
“Just because you are of the same Fifth Layer Heaven, you think they can’t withstand your three moves? Isn’t that too arrogant?”
“Exactly! With just the mid-stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, people might think you’re at the peak of the Sixth-level Heaven, yet you dare say no one can withstand your three moves.”
“Right, if you have the guts, go challenge Denny Raven and see if he doesn’t blow you up in three moves.”
“Brother, I thought you’d rush up and teach him a lesson, telling him that senior students shouldn’t be insulted.”
The man said speechlessly, “I’m just in the late-stage of the Third Layer Heaven; I’m not going to teach him a lesson with my head. If I were at the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven, or better yet, the Sixth Layer Heaven, I would definitely blow him up.”
“Bullshit! If you were in the Sixth Layer Heaven, you might be even more arrogant than he is now.”
“Now that you mention it, it seems true. Hahaha.”
Although Jack Clark’s words made many senior students unhappy, feeling that he was a bit arrogant, such people were only a minority. More old timers actually got excited.
Because now, there was some excitement to watch.
In the rear buildings, many of the returning Five Heaven students had a serious expression, their gazes fixed on Jack Clark’s imposing and terrifying aura.
Even from such a distance, it shook their hearts and souls, and one could only imagine how earth-shattering it would be once they made their move.
A Fifth Layer Heaven senior student in the initial stage looked at the distorted
air around Jack Clark and said solemnly, “Overbearing.”
At this moment, Denny Lockwood suddenly appeared out of nowhere and greeted with a smile, “Junior Clark, congratulations on your breakthrough, I didn’t expect you to have such an overbearing side.”
“Very well, this is the aura that a genius should have. People are not strong when they are young and arrogant. Remember to help me give Carney Turner a good beating at that time.”
Apparently, his last sentence was the main point.
Jack Clark automatically ignored his following words, and said solemnly, “Senior Lockwood, your timing is perfect. I heard that your circle is well- informed. Can you help me with something?”
Denny Lockwood faintly guessed what it was, “Please speak.”
Notify all the Martial Height Bases, I will go one by one to challenge those senior students who are above the Fifth Layer Heaven. I want to see if there’s anyone in the entire southern battlefield who can withstand my three moves.” “Damn!”
“I thought this guy was arrogant just now, but I didn’t expect the more arrogant one to be behind him. He actually wants to challenge the entire southern battlefield.”
“Not to mention strength, just this confidence alone is admirable, at least I don’t dare.”
If Jack Clark’s challenge to all the senior students of South Sky Martial Height and saying they couldn’t withstand his three moves seemed arrogant and complacent, then everyone was shocked at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 193: Transcending the Mortal Realm, Extreme Strengthening of Golden Runes (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 193: Transcending the Mortal Realm, Extreme Strengthening of Golden Runes (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339
Because this kind of challenge is different from defeating several schoolmates, it requires fighting all the way, which greatly tests endurance and stamina.
Although Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivators have abundant True Strength, it’s not infinite, especially when both the opponent and Jack Clark himself will use their full strength to unleash powerful moves within the three strikes agreement.
Under such circumstances, the consumption of True Strength is astonishing. A Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator in the initial stage can unleash five full-strength killing moves, which would be considered impressive.
After all, these are killing moves that consume a great deal of True Strength. If they could be used consecutively, they wouldn’t be considered killing moves, but rather normal attacks.
As for the mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator, there won’t be too many more. Under normal conditions, ten consecutive moves would be the limit, as their killing moves become more powerful as their cultivation increases, resulting in increased consumption.
Therefore, even if Jack Clark’s combat power is terrifying, and no one can withstand his full-strength attack, how many times can he consecutively unleash it?
Twenty, thirty?
