When his True Strength is exhausted … many people shake their heads at the thought, feeling like Jack Clark might be getting ahead of himself.
Challenging opponents in this sweeping manner don’t count on resting for an hour after each fight to recover. Senior students from other schools won’t give you time to rest.
After all, you were so arrogant as to challenge all the same-level geniuses in the entire southern battlefield, so you should be prepared for exhaustion and defeat.
However, regardless of whether these people admire Jack Clark’s boldness or mock his ignorance, they cannot influence the development of the situation.
Soon, Jack Clark, who just ranked first on the First-Grade Talent Rankings, was challenging all Fifth Layer Heaven students from Martial Height Base, and his confidence that no one could withstand his three strikes spread throughout the entire Southern Exotic Beast Battlefield.
As other Martial Height Base students reacted with anger, disdain, sneers, or solemnity, the teachers were somewhat surprised and puzzled.
Of course, they knew how terrifying a student named Jack Clark could be.
In the recent Evil God Sect Cultist invasion, he killed two cultists and reverse defeated a Late Sixth Heavenly Stage Purgatory Demon Clan with the battle power.
Moreover, he did so without any injuries.
Such combat power already made him the number one person in Southern Martial Height.
However, even if Jack Clark had strong combat power, thinking of sweeping through hundreds of the same-level cultivators, including many who had reached the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, the peak, and possessed the power of the Sixth Layer Heaven, was it a bit too simple?
Attrition warfare is terrifying in terms of True Strength consumption.
At the rear Military Base, a Colonel who received the news was surprised: “Challenge all Martial Height Fifth Layer Heaven students, what’s this guy up to?”
A middle-aged man dressed in a Major General uniform pushed his glasses up and pondered: “He should want to walk the Invincible Path, and he may have already reached the edge of Battle Intent.”
“Battle Intent!”
“Invincible, Overbearing, or Slaughter?” someone exclaimed in surprise.
There are many types of Battle Intent formed by walking the Invincible Path, and such challenges have also appeared in the army.
Many soldiers at the critical point of Battle Intent breakthrough would challenge all the army’s high-level experts of the same level, ultimately either successfully suppressing everyone and coalescing Battle Intent or failing and having their path cut off.
At the main seat, Tyler Lance said solemnly: “Notify Jack Clark that during the upcoming battles, there is no need to hold back, all damaged battle armor, Transcendent Weapons, and even injured students will be compensated by the military.”
Someone was surprised: “General, you’re giving him a push.”
Tyler Lance showed a smile: “After so many years, it’s rare to see such an overbearing freshman, so naturally, I want to lend him a helping hand.”
With his command, Jack Clark doesn’t need to worry about causing excessive harm, injuring people, or damaging other people’s weapons when he unleashes his full power in the following challenges.
After all, walking the Invincible Path is fine, but it is somewhat difficult for others to accept a challenge at their own risk, injury, or the destruction of their battle armor and Transcendent Weapons.
Perhaps in that kind of atmosphere, those genius senior students rushed forward with heated heads and wouldn’t feel any regret even if they got hurt.
But later on, some people would surely have resentment towards Jack Clark.
After all, once Transcendent Weapons and battle armor are damaged, they need to be refined again, consuming two or three hundred Contribution Points.
Simultaneously, not everyone is as wealthy as Jack Clark, who made killing Mutated Creatures and earning Contribution Points as easy as drinking water – many students risk their lives when entering the mountain range.
Maybe one day, they would die in the mouths of Mutated Beasts.
But now, with the Military District Commander’s order, both Jack Clark and the students have nothing to worry about. They can fight with all their might.
As for whether anyone would die, they weren’t very worried. This is a martial arts challenge, not a life-and-death battle. Getting injured is okay, but if someone dies, it would be too much.
By then, without waiting for the military to intervene, the Martial Height teachers would break Jack Clark’s Invincible Path.
At this moment, Tyler Lance said solemnly: “Also, notify all students who are lingering in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to return and fight Jack Clark.” “Tell them, as long as they can withstand Jack Clark’s three strikes without losing, they can choose a free Top-tier Secret Manual.”
“At the same time, all Martial Height Base students with Fifth Layer Heaven or higher cultivation levels must not refuse a challenge from Jack Clark, otherwise their authority level will be reduced to the lowest.”
Everyone sucked in a cold breath.
“General, you’re pouring oil on the fire!”
“Hahahaha… He wants to walk the Invincible Path, right? Then let him show me his absolute strength to suppress the younger generation.”
“By the way, it would also put some pressure on those students who have been comfortable under the school’s protection for too long, their ambitious hearts growing weaker and weaker, and still nobody has broken through the Sixth Layer Heaven.”
“They’re the gathering of all the geniuses in the South, consuming countless resources. They have to show some results.”

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 193: Transcending the Mortal Realm, Extreme Strengthening of Golden Runes (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 193: Transcending the Mortal Realm, Extreme Strengthening of Golden Runes (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
Translator: 549690339
“All the better for Jack Clark to put some pressure on them, so they can see what a real genius is like. If they don’t make an effort, they’ll be left behind by the times.”
Just as the entire southern battlefield was shocked by Jack Clark, he arrived at the Logistics Department.
“Can you help me check? How much contribution can these two daggers and wolf tooth staff, as well as these two Nightmare Demon Crystals, be exchanged for?”
Jack Clark had killed three people this time, but he didn’t gain many things from them.
“Please, hold on.”
Under the powerful coercion emanating from Jack Clark, the mediocre staff members behind the counter were all a bit nervous.
There was no way around it; Jack Clark in his current state resembled a giant humanoid beast, with heavy breathing and sharp eyes.
Especially the substantial air pressure that forced the surrounding air to surge in all directions, forming invisible gusts of wind, and making his hair flutter as if blown by an unseen force.
Those who didn’t know would think he had turned on special effects.
“Student Clark, these two daggers and the Wolf Tooth Staff are all transcendent weapons, re-forged, but severely damaged, only retaining a bit of material value.”
“The weapon recovery price is 50 points, the Nightmare Demon Crystals are
100 points, and the total is 105 Contribution points.”
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s fine.”
105 contribution points, plus the original remaining 155 points and the 600 points for beheading three people, brought his total contribution to 860 points.
The 300 Merit Value points were calculated separately.
“Excuse me, could you help me identify the composition of these two materials?” Jack Clark took out a piece of flame ore the size of a basin and a golden horn the length of 0.5 meters.
The so-called identification was actually analyzing the composition using professional equipment.
The base had a detailed set of identification and analysis procedures for various transcendent materials and minerals, as well as dedicated detection devices.
“Please wait.” The staff member carried the two materials to the nearby equipment.
The analysis report was soon completed.
The internal flame-containing ore was a transcendent material, with high energy conductivity, containing a materialized ‘flame’ inside, which was non-toxic and non-radiating.
The golden horn originated from an unknown mutated creature, with high-energy conductivity, and a ‘golden’ expelling evil power inside, which exerted strong suppression on dark powers.
Both were high-order transcendent materials. The expelling evil power from the golden horn was especially rare, soul-controlling, and capable of warding off both gods and ghosts.
This attribute left Jack Clark at a loss for words; a Purgatory Demon Race member actually possessed such an item.
Putting away the materials, Jack Clark said solemnly, “I want to exchange for three sixth-grade life crystals.”
Previously, enhancing the third layer of the Dragon Elephant Power required only 20 attribute points, but the limit enhancement method doubled that requirement to 50 points.
Now, the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body was the same, with the limit enhancement method requiring 800 points.
However, as soon as Jack Clark finished speaking, the staff member clicked on the computer and looked embarrassed, “Student Clark, currently the base warehouse only has two sixth-grade life crystals.”
Jack Clark paused, “How many level 5 crystals are there?”
“Wait a moment… seven level 5-”
“Then, two level 6 and two level 5-”
One sixth-grade crystal cost 300 contribution points, each fifth-grade crystal 160 points, and after a 30% discount, the total was 644 contribution points.
Soon, Jack Clark left the logistics department with four life crystals and applied for a cultivation room to begin his closed-door cultivation.
“Attribute points conversion.” As Jack Clark’s thought waves echoed in his mind, an invisible force enveloped the four life crystals in his hand.
Silently, the four crystals turned into dust, and a row of transparent text appeared before his eyes.
“You have converted high purity Life Energy Crystals and have received 143,
158, 276, and 295 attribute points.”
With the addition of the original 21 attribute points, his total free attribute points instantly soared to 893-
Jack Clark took a deep breath, anticipation in his eyes, and thought in his mind, “Spend attribute points, limit enhancement Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.”
Boom! As the attribute points disappeared, an endless powerful and vast energy surged from within him, and the golden-red True Power in his dantian ignited in an instant.
Not bad, all the True Power erupted out of his dantian, filling his whole body and fusing with his flesh and blood under the influence of that invisible force.
Roar! Roar! Roar!!
Deep within Jack Clark’s body, dragon roars and elephant trumpeting echoed. The faint shadows of a tyrant elephant tens of meters tall stomped on the ground, a red dragon beast more than 40 meters long roared between heaven and earth, a winged dragon more than 50 meters long extended its wings and let out a piercing scream.
But the most powerful one was a golden dragon, its golden wings outspread behind it, and its 90-meter-long body bursting with terrifying power which shook the mountain.
At this moment, the giant shadow of these beasts roared fiercely, attempting to struggle, but were immediately shattered by an invisible force.
Boom!
As their deliberate thoughts being encapsulated in essence blood were thoroughly destroyed, Jack Clark’s entire body trembled, and the Power of Will fused with True Power endlessly.
With the increasing thickness of the golden True Power flowing through him, Jack Clark’s muscles, bones, and even blood were gradually dyed gold, emitting a sacred aura.
At the same time, the origin power from the absorbed Tyrant Elephant Essence Blood and dragon essence blood continuously converged into his dantian.
Under the force of the attribute points conversion, the absorbed Elephant’s Fury Rune, containing those origin powers, changed and became more complex and complete.
Soon, a complex golden rune appeared in Jack Clark’s dantian.
When his consciousness looked at the rune, Jack Clark subconsciously thought of the meaning of the two words ‘Dragon Elephant.’
Roar!
At the moment when that complete rune formed in Jack Clark’s dantian, a terrifying roar of Dragon Roar and Elephant Trumpeting pierced through the void, shaking the entire cultivation room continuously..

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 194: Tyrant Elephant, Golden
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 194: Tyrant Elephant, Golden
Dragon, Transfer to the Simon Empire
Translator: 549690339
This breakthrough took only an hour.
As the golden True Strength inside Jack Clark’s body slowly calmed down, he slowly opened his eyes, black pupils as gentle as jade, and the inner golden vertical pupils cold and majestic.
Compared to before, the inner golden dragon pupils seemed to be much clearer.
And because they were overlapping, his eyes only appeared a bit strange, without the eerie and terrifying feeling of having two pupils in one eye.
At this time, with the breakthrough, the complete rune condensed, and Jack Clark’s body, apart from the deliberately exuded domineering aura, seemed like the pressure of a giant beast had disappeared.
It gave one a feeling of returning to simplicity.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s mind moved, and he summoned the attribute page.
Because there is nothing more intuitive than the attribute page to see the details of his various changes.
Realm: Fifth Layer Heaven [Late Stage]
Physique: 1349—1410
Strength: 1612—1715
Agility: 1162—1192
Spirit: 1270—1295
Talent: Soul Split+[Top-tier]Golden Dragon Double Pupils+[Intermediate]
Cultivation Methods: Dragon Elephant Divine Power Tyrant Body[Limit Break]Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd[Great Realm]
Secret Skill: Hidden Deity+[Great Realm]
Runes: Godly Dragon Elephant[Complete Rune, possessing three-stage forms.
Elementary form: burn Qi Blood to enter Tyrant Elephant State, increasing strength by eight times.
Intermediate form: bum True Dragon Power to enter Golden Dragon State, increasing strength and defense by five times, and agility by twice.
Senior form: simultaneously burn Blood Qi and True Strength to enter Godly Dragon Elephant State, increasing strength and defense by fifteen times, receiving the Power of the Dragon Elephant Behemoth.
Note! Godly Dragon Elephant State consumes too much Power of Will, current strength is not sufficient, use with caution.]
Cut through the Void[Incomplete Rune]
Attribute points: 93
Equipment: Eight Desolate Battle HalberdfTranscendent Weapon forged once]Wind Flame Crystal Armor[Transcendent Battle Armor forged once]
Avatar body: Ancient Hexagon Thunder Flame Colossus…
Evolution value: 9200/30000
This time, most of the energy was consumed in the limit exploration of Cultivation Methods, and the rest was consumed in promoting the integration of True Strength and Power of Will.
Thus, Jack Clark’s true strength only increased by twofold, his Dantian expanded, and his cultivation realm smoothly broke through to Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
Besides, after the Dragon Elephant Skill reached its limit, Jack Clark’s body and the Dragon Power and Elephant Power that he had absorbed completely integrated into one.
From now on, he no longer needs to actively activate Divine Tyrant Body, because his body is always in the Tyrant Body state, with Divine Might attached, and unparalleled strength.
This state is similar to the True Martial Battle Body condensed at the Eight Layer Heaven, with Spirit Qi integrated, and always at its peak state.
Compared to Howard Lee, who needs to actively activate the King Blood Power to enter the Bull Demon State, and has only a small accomplishment in battle, Jack Clark’s Divine Tyrant Body has already reached the Great Realm.
At the same time, his four major attributes also improved after this breakthrough.
However, relative to his previous breakthrough, this time the largest increase in strength attribute only grew by one hundred points.
But the changes in physique are secondary, and Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the rune notes below.
The complete Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune has three states, divided into Tyrant Elephant, Golden Dragon, and the strongest Divine Might Dragon Elephant, each with a different activation cost.
And the most powerful Divine Might Dragon Elephant can instantly amplify strength and defense by fifteen times, which seems to be only five times more than the Elephant’s Fury Rune, but the upper limit is even higher.
After all, the fifteen-fold increase of the Sixth Layer or even Seventh Layer Heaven is far greater than the tenfold difference between the Triplex Layer and Fourth Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark’s eyes lingered on the Dragon Elephant Rune, slightly pondering, and suddenly an explosion of terrifying power erupted from his body.
Roar!
The furious elephant roar echoed through the Void.
With the burning of Qi Blood, Jack Clark was covered in red flames, his muscles bulging, turning into a 2 meters tall burly figure in the blink of an eye, his rough skin exuding a metallic luster.
Whoosh whoosh!!
In the Tyrant Elephant form, Jack Clark’s body exuded a terrifying power, bursting the surrounding air and forming raging winds that blew in all directions.
Squeezing his thick arm slightly, the air in his palm exploded in an instant, forming a transparent shockwave blasting outwards.
Feeling the terrible power in his body increasing eight times and the burning of Tyrant Body Qi Blood, Jack Clark’s voice was low and humming: “This state can last a long time.”
After the rune is complete, the burning of Qi Blood is no longer an uncontrollable, endless process, but a controlled, proportional continuous burn.
With Jack Clark’s current physical strength, he estimates that the Tyrant Elephant state can last for half an hour of battle.
This controlled burst can continue for half an hour without exhausting his vital energy. It is estimated that he will recover in at most ten days and half a month. If he has resources to replenish his vital energy, the recovery would be faster.
Jack Clark immediately sighed in relief.
The thing he was most afraid of was that after burning Qi Blood, just like Elephant’s Fury Rune, he would be greatly hurt if he could only burst for a while. In this way, the flaws in the rune’s trump card would be too great.
After testing the Tyrant Elephant state, Jack Clark extinguished the Qi Blood flames with a thought, and in an instant, his whole body muscles deflated and quickly returned to normal.
After a short rest, Jack Clark once again ignited the True Dragon Power with a thought, and in an instant, his Dantian was like a blazing flame, emitting endless golden light.
The golden light shone all over his body, and wherever it passed, the golden dragon power contained in the muscles and bones was activated, and his entire body was covered with a layer of energy substance- like golden dragon scales.
Roar roar roar!!
The surrounding Void was filled with dragon roars centered on Jack Clark, and a terrible Dragon Might spread out instantly, causing all living beings to instinctively feel fear and panic.
“This state… it feels strange.”
Jack Clark, now 1.9 meters tall and looking like a streamlined and fit Golden Dragon Man, felt the surging power within him, flexed his limbs, and then….

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 194: Tyrant Elephant, Golden Dragon, transferring to Simon Empire_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 194: Tyrant Elephant, Golden Dragon, transferring to Simon Empire_2
Translator: 549690339
BANG! Jack Clark disappeared on the spot, and a series of golden phantoms began to appear and disappear in the Cultivation Room.
Jack’s usual speed was already exceptionally fast, exploding with his full strength could allow him to reach supersonic speeds even with his overbearing physical body.
At this moment, under the Golden Dragon state, his entire body’s golden dragon scales seemed to hold some sort of special power. The golden light they emitted could counteract air resistance.
As such, Jack’s speed instantly became terrifying, reaching a frightening speed of around 700 meters per second, twice the speed of sound.
Very quickly, all the phantoms disappeared, and Jack reappeared in the center of the Cultivation Room.
At this point, his core was like an engine filled with gasoline, burning fiercely. With his current cultivation level in the late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, he could last about fifteen minutes.
Musing, the golden light around Jack receded, his True Strength was extinguished, and the oppressive Dragon Might that he had been releasing unscrupulously immediately disappeared.
This Limit Enhancement didn’t disappoint him. It was very powerful, especially the three-stage transformation of the Dragon Elephant Rune.
In the first stage, the Tyrant Elephant state, his power could push through anything forcibly and was suited for head-on battlefield charges. Almost no one of the same level could stand against him.
In the Golden Dragon state, he was more versatile, capable of dealing with numerous complex situations.
For example, if he encountered an enemy he couldn’t beat, he could use his burst to escape, or if he encountered an assassin of the same level, he could kill them instantly.
As for the peak Godly Dragon Elephant state, after some thought, Jack decided not to test it, because it wasn’t necessary.
Next, Jack continued to familiarize himself with his increased strength.
Meanwhile, while Jack was in seclusion and making his breakthrough.
Those geniuses in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range who were in the late and peak stages of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and ranked in the top thirty on the Achievement List, all received messages for them to return and face the challenge.
Although the school wasn’t under military jurisdiction, it was subject to the commands of the highest commanders in the Southern Variant Beast Battlefield.
It is indeed extraordinary for a freshman to reach the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, but for him to say that we won’t be able to handle three moves of his, that’s simply too arrogant.”
However, some eyes lit up, excitedly saying: “If he can’t be beaten in three moves, one can select a top-tier secret manual for free, there’s such a good deal?”
Hahahaha… How audacious. Let’s see how you defeat me in three moves.
I didn’t expect there to be someone in this world who is more boastful than
I have to meet him…” At once, these geniuses who had been preparing to stay in the mountains for further cultivation erupted in speed, rushing out from the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
If they get back too late, or if Jack, the freshman, was able to take three blows from someone else, they would miss a big opportunity.
Whether they were displeased with him, or for the sake of that top-tier secret manual, or just to get a glimpse of that monster, none of them wanted to miss this opportunity.
Especially the top-tier secret manual.
Although normally, even without a top-tier secret manual, cultivators could still reach the Seventh Layer Heaven after achieving the peak of the Sixth layer heaven by meeting the breakthrough requirements.
But just as they would for someone breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, reaching the Seventh Layer Heaven was a threshold, determining whether they could breakthrough to the Nine Layers and even touch upon the King level.
The top-tier secret manual was like a steadfast route, an intact heritage.
Under the top-tier secret manual, the true martial arts phantoms they coalesced would be more formidable, and their True Martial Battle Body would be more complete.
Too bad, we still have to set up the Heavenly Foundation Network here, otherwise we could go back to watch as well.” James Clark had seen the notification and felt a bit regretful.
II
After all, Jack was his student. Seeing a student shine would bring honor to him as well.
Unfortunately, they weren’t the same as those students. After dealing with the intruding Evil God Sect Cultists, they still had quite a few tasks to do.
Up next, they would set up defenses centered on the location where the Base Satellite fell, using it as a fixed signal tower to prevent destruction, and potential damage from mutated creatures.
Soon, a fixed network that covered the Cloud Mist Mountain Range would be formed. At that time, the landscape here would also change significantly.
With fluid communication, even the students of the Fourth Layer could delve deep into the mountains. With shared information, they could know where the dangers lie, where high-level mutated beasts are and form hunting parties.
Apart from that, it would also make it easier to find resources.
While the danger of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range was reduced and it became safer, that didn’t mean it was necessarily beneficial. Nonetheless, this was likely to happen in the short term.
That afternoon, at one forty.
The door to the Cultivation Room slowly opened.
As soon as Jack Clark stepped out of the cultivation room, he saw Justin Welan and others already waiting outside.
Jack chuckled lightly, “Everyone is here.
Justin Welan was somewhat nervous and excited, “Jack, how is it? You’re sure you’re confident, right?”
Jack glanced at him, “Do you think I would kid around?
Even though I know your character would not joke about something like this, this time the implications are too grand.”
A bitter smile crossed Justin Welen’s face, “After your announcement to challenge all the students in the Five Layer Heaven of Martial Arts, it alarmed the higher-ups in the military.”
The commander of the Southern Exotic Beast Battlefield declared that anyone who can withstand three of your moves without losing can choose a top-tier secret manual for free.”
According to the news, students from all over the Cloud Mist Mountain Range who are in the top thirty ranks in achievements and have reached the late stage or even the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven have hurried back.”
Top-tier secret manuals, that’s a huge gesture.” Jack’s raised an eyebrow.
The exchange requirement for a top-tier secret manual in the school was 3,000 merit points. If we take a 1:3 ratio, that’s almost equivalent to 10,000 points of contribution.
However, the problem was that obtaining merit was even more difficult, particularly in the Exotic Beast Battlefield where there is no channel to gain merits.
Besides, that commander also promised to compensate the military for any personal injuries or weapon damage caused by your fights,” Justin added.
A slight smile crept onto Jack’s face, “Interesting. He sees me as a sharpening stone, huh? But even so, I should thank that commander.”
With his guarantee, Jack could let loose a bit more in the coming challenges.
Jack then looked around, still not seeing Freya Louise. He couldn’t help but turn to Justin, “Mr. Willard, where’s Freya?”
He had noticed Freya wasn’t around when he came back at noon, thought she might have been held up, and didn’t pay it much mind. However, three hours later and there was still no sight of her.
At the mention of this, Justin seemed to realize something, “I was so shocked by your demonstration earlier, I forgot to tell you that Freya has left.”
Left!
Jack’s brow furrowed slightly, “When?
At this point, Zac Lyons walked over and took the conversation, “The day after that Evil God Sect Cultist invasion, Freya’s aunt entered the battlefield and took her away.”
At that time, you were already deep into the Cloud Mist Mountain Range and could not receive messages. If you could, we would have invited you to come see her off.”
Zac Lyons said excitedly, “Jack, you’ll never guess, Freya’s aunt is actually General Emma Louise, the ordinary woman who was awarded the title of Military General.”
Jack just shook his head, “I knew about this news long ago.
What, Jack, you knew about this long ago?” Justin, who was on the side, was taken aback.
After visiting the Military Base to see the girls shooting, although Freya did not explicitly say so, Jack had basically guessed that her aunt was Emma Louise.
After all, in the entire Eastern Summer, only this female general fit the criteria.
Sharing the same surname and coming from a military background.
However, what Jack did not expect was that just as he was about to reach the most glorious moment of topping the entire Southern Battlefield, Freya would suddenly depart, leaving him with a vague sense of regret.
After a brief silence, Jack asked, “Did she say anything when she left?
Yes, she said that she will be transferring to Simon Empire after this semester ends and she hopes that we, as friends, could take some time to see her off.”
Because once she leaves, she doesn’t know if she’ll have the chance to meet us again.”
What, she’s transferring to Simon Empire.” Jack Clark was taken aback.
Justin Welan scratched his head, “We were also surprised when we heard about it. We had no idea why she’d want to go to Simon Empire while she was cultivating well here.”
…I see.” Jack Clark exhaled slowly.
He remembered Freya once said her parents were in Simon Empire, so this transfer should also be because of her parents.
Let’s go, let’s not keep those seniors waiting.
With that, Jack’s gaze sharpened and he strode towards the Base Arena. His previously subdued aura of invincibility surged like an imposing storm.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 195: The Invincible Jack Clark, Who Else?
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 195: The Invincible Jack Clark, Who Else?
Translator: 549690339
In the afternoon, the base arena was surrounded by a sea of people.
Those in the Second and Third Layer Heaven and Fourth Layer Heaven students all gathered around the martial arts arena, excited and whispering to each other, looking forward to the upcoming battles.
At the edge of the arena, about 20 students with the aura of the Fifth Layer Heaven stood tall, each emitting a powerful presence.
Among them were third graders, Henric Lee and Betty Leinster, and second grader Carol Koch.
That’s right, only about 20 people.
Even in the Southern Battlefield, where all the geniuses gathered, including most of the cultivation students from the second and third grades, there were only a little over 500 people in the Fifth Layer Heaven.
It sounded like a lot, but these people were from 18 first-class and 41 second- class Martial Heights, averaging less than ten students per school.
Moreover, since most of the Fifth Layer Heaven talents had undergone initial screening, they were mostly found in the first-class Martial Heights.
The worst second-class Martial Height base had only a few students that had reached the Fifth Layer Heaven.
As a middle and upper class Martial Height, South Sky Martial Height currently had a record of 22 Fifth Layer Heaven students, most of which were in the initial stage, mid-stage, and late-stage realms.
This was also the reason why all the students in the Southern Battlefield were shocked when Jack Clark’s cultivation level was exposed earlier.
It was too exaggerated.
At this time, a solemn Bruce Raven stood behind Carol Koch, who was carrying a golden battle sword. “It’s almost time,” he said.
Cicely Raven, who was wearing a red battle armor, looked complicated. “I didn’t expect that the junior brother we met twice on the road before is such a monster. He reached the Fifth Layer Heaven in just half a year.”
As she said this, jealousy stirred in her heart.
When she enrolled two years ago, she was also a genius, establishing her foundation in just a week, but she had only reached the Late Fourth Layer Heaven stage after years of hard work, and she didn’t know how much further away she was from the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Carol Koch smiled and said, “That’s why I always tell you not to underestimate anyone. There are so many geniuses in this world, and no one can guarantee that they are the strongest.”
“Indeed,” Bruce Raven agreed thoughtfully. “Before this batch of freshmen came in, I always thought that Carol was the most talented monster I had ever seen.”
He had reached the Mid-Stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven in just his second grade, comprehending Sword Intent, and had successfully cultivated three Secret Methods to a high level, which was completely abnormal.
“With his current strength, he can kill even an Early Stage Level 6 Unique Beast with a single sword strike. Even the Mid-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven senior who challenged him earlier is no match for him,” Bruce continued.
Cicely Raven suddenly looked forward to the fight. “Carol, can you defeat that junior Clark?”
If he was able to defeat the highly popular Clark, Carol’s reputation would skyrocket as the number one among the younger generation in the Southern Battlefield.
Facing his teammates’ hopeful gazes, Carol slowly shook his head. “Chances are slim. Since Junior Clark dared to claim that no one could withstand his three moves, he must have absolute confidence in his strength.”
“Haven’t you noticed? Even the school and the military have taken a stand for Junior Clark, which means they are also optimistic about his ability to sweep away all opponents,” Carol continued.
“Besides, Junior Clark has returned from the outside world this time, so it’s obvious that something unknown has happened during the extermination mission in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.”
“Moreover, the main force to fight against him this time is not me,” said Carol, glancing at Henric Lee who was closing her eyes and concentrating nearby. “Both Senior Lee and Senior Leinster will not hold back for the sake of the top- tier Secret Manual.”
“Senior Lee has not only reached the Peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven but also cultivated the Unseen Heaven and its matching battle techniques to the Great Realm of the Sixth Level,” Carol continued.
“Although he hasn’t ignited the True Force Flame or condensed Sword Intent and Blade Intent yet, he can already be considered a Sixth Heaven cultivator.”
“Although Senior Leinster’s cultivation level is in the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, which is weaker than Senior Lee’s, she comprehended Wind Sword Intent in her second year,” Carol added.
“One year has passed, and Senior Leinster’s Sword Intent may have already reached a small level of mastery. With their strength, they have a high probability of withstanding Junior Clark’s three moves, and when that time comes…”
At this moment, everyone suddenly felt a tremor in the distance.
A figure in black and red crystal armor appeared, holding a war halberd, emitting an invincible aura filling the heavens and the earth. Every step it took caused a loud rumble as if a mountain was stepping.
It seemed as if it wasn’t a person approaching, but a giant beast with heavy, terrifying footsteps.
“Here it comes.”
“It’s starting.”
Many people’s faces showed excitement.
Jack Clark stood on the sturdily built, steel-like blue stone arena that spanned a hundred meters, scanning the surrounding seniors with a determined voice.
“First Grade, Class 3, Jack Clark. Which senior here dares to take a blow from my halberd?” At this moment, Jack Clark was surrounded by a powerful aura, speaking in an overbearing tone.
Even if he did not provoke them verbally, those Fifth Layer Heaven students must take the challenge, as they had no way to retreat and must fight under the orders of the commander.
Unless they did not want the genius’ 20% Discount Permission anymore.
At this point, a student in black armor with a cold expression said lightly, “I’ll go first. Although my cultivation level is only in the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, I don’t believe I can’t block three moves.”
“Also, junior brother should know that there are always stronger people out there. It’s better to be humble.”
“I don’t mean to disrespect the seniors here. I’m just stating the facts.” Jack Clark’s expression remained calm, but his tone was as overbearing as ever, causing some frowns.
Although they weren’t foolish and knew that Jack Clark had the strength to back up his bold words since he dared to make such a statement, it didn’t stop them from feeling annoyed.
Zac Lyons, who was following behind, was puzzled. “Why do I feel like Jack Clark is being a bit arrogant today, looking down on everyone? Wasn’t this guy very modest before?”</p

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 195: The Invincible Jack Clark Pushes Through, Who Else? _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 195: The Invincible Jack Clark Pushes Through, Who Else? _2
Translator: 549690339
Justin Welan thought for a moment, “Because he wants to unite body and mind, and be consistent in word and action.”
“What do you mean?” Marcus Lee and the others showed confusion on their faces.
Justin Welan slowly said, “If I’m not mistaken, Jack should be preparing to take the invincible path, using these people’s hands to sharpen himself and gather external momentum to cultivate his battle intent.”
That was the advantage of having high-level cultivators in the family; they knew a lot of information that ordinary cultivation students didn’t know.
At this moment, Tommy Lee’s figure flashed, crossing tens of meters and appearing on the martial arts arena. As he slowly unsheathed his combat knife, a gloomy aura spread around him.
Without any nonsense, a gray True Strength burst out instantly, his battle boots shattered the ground, and Tommy Lee’s figure resembled a gray light shooting out with a whistling wind and thunder.
Bang!
In the middle of the way, Tommy Lee split into two, slashing out two intersects five meters long with white and black lights, which intertwined like a violent Flood Dragon.
As the blade light passed, the air was cut into a black plane like a pair of scissors, spreading a terrifying sharp aura towards Jack Clark.
As a genius who had cultivated to the Fifth Layer Heaven in just over two years, Tommy Lee’s strength was formidable, and his Yin-Yang Heaven-devouring Saber had amazing power in the alternating Yin and Yang.
Bang!
On the golden entwined War Halberd, the Halberd Skill reached six meters, like a giant war halberd sweeping across nine meters, instantly causing the air to explode, with dragon roars and elephant roars.
Bang!
As the War Halberd swept across, the Yin and Yang intersecting blade lights instantly collapsed, the ground shattered, a violent explosion caused a raging wind wave, mixed with countless fragments flying tens of meters away.
Whoosh! A broken figure burst out and smashed onto the platform below.
“Damn!”
“Be careful, dodge quickly!”
Those students who were watching the excitement yelled one after another, jumping away like rabbits. Tommy Lee, who had been blasted away by the strike, landed on the ground with a bang.
Boom! Amidst the smoke and dust, a small pit with a diameter of several meters appeared on the ground, where a weak figure lay. It was Tommy Lee, with broken battle armor all over his body.
Under a single blow from Jack Clark, this talented and powerful man was heavily injured, his combat knife and battle armor shattered.
“Hiss! Tommy Lee couldn’t even take one move,” someone gasped.
“Such an overbearing strength!”
Looking at Jack Clark standing on the martial arts arena holding a halberd, everyone’s faces showed a solemn expression.
Henric Lee said solemnly, “What a strong and domineering power, he has already cultivated the Divine Tyrant Body of the Advanced Dragon Elephant Skill, and that mysterious aura of dragon roars and elephant roars in his every move seems to be True Martial Divine Rhyme.”
When Jack Clark closed the door, many people got some news about him through their teachers.
They knew that what he cultivated was one of the most powerful advanced skills, the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body.
A fourth-grade senior sister gasped excitedly, “It’s so exaggerated. He couldn’t even take a single hit from the same Fifth Layer Heaven. This junior is too strong.”
“Cough! May, pay attention to your image, your drool is dripping.”
“Really? Haha, you must have seen it wrong.”
“I’ll take the lead. Brothers, don’t give him a chance to breathe. I don’t believe that he can defeat everyone in one move even as a Fifth Layer Heaven.”
With a stern shout, Peter Vernon, who was unwilling to accept defeat, leaped up tens of meters. On his body, a black True Strength shone, and his hand-held long spear was like a dragon, curling up circles of white waves.
“Black Dragon Across the Sky.”
Roar!
With a roaring dragon chant, Wang Xiong, who descended from the sky, seemed like a black dragon, surrounded by raging winds. In the True Strength- illuminated and furiously opened dragon’s mouth, there was a sharp edge.
Hum!
The spear’s tip in the dragon’s mouth constantly vibrated, changing its position dozens of times in an instant, making it difficult to see where the spear was actually stabbing.
But did Jack Clark need to see clearly?
Bang!
Accompanied by the War Halberd sweeping across at supersonic speed, a golden light formed a whip-like flash in an instant between heaven and earth. Everything touched by the terrifying power was destroyed.
Including the black dragon descending from the sky, which was instantly blasted by the War Halberd. In mid-air, a circle of black gold shockwave exploded, and the rolling airwaves were incredibly powerful.
Bang!
In the violent airwaves, Peter Vernon, turned like a cannonball, flew straight back, smashing into a decorative mountain a hundred meters away. The mountain stones exploded, and smoke and dust filled the air.
Hiss! Many people gasped in unison.
“I don’t believe you can maintain such a powerful burst all the time.”
With a loud shout, another figure burst out from below the platform. The Fifth Layer Heaven True Strength circled around him, appearing in front of Jack like a blue streamer in an instant.
Before the battle sword in the hand of this person could be slashed, he felt a golden light flashing in front of him, followed by a terrifying eruption of power. A mouthful of blood spurted out.
Bang!
The third-grade student, carrying white waves, flew back and was flung away by Jack’s casual blow, more than a hundred meters away, causing the crowd to fall one after another.
“My foot is being crushed.”
“My buttocks!”
“Quick, give me a hand, I am hurt by the shockwave.”
Just then, a burly figure roared and rushed onto the martial arts arena. With each step, the ground would be crushed by his battle boots, stirring up rolling yellow airwaves.
“Demon-sealing Mountain-breaking Slash!”
Bang!
In addition to the Halberd Skill, the nine-meter-long War Halberd swept across, and the instant the student who had just rushed onto the martial arts arena had his battle sword shattered, his True Strength collapsed, and was once again blasted away with a boom.
“Don’t give him a chance to breathe!” With a stern shout, a golden light shot out, tearing through the air, leaving a narrow crack on the ground.
However, just as the sword light rushed halfway, it suddenly split into six, enveloping Jack with a large amount of golden light.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 195: The unstoppable Jack Clark, who else is there? _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 195: The unstoppable Jack Clark, who else is there? _3
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
“Kill!”
Boom boom boom!!
Amidst the disbelief of everyone, seventeen students at the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, and two at the Mid-Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven were sent flying by a single blow from Jack Clark.
No matter how fast they were, how exquisite their techniques were, or how powerful their burst skills were, they all crumbled instantly under the golden glow of the war halberd, which sped up to supersonic speed.
They were simply unmatchable, unstoppable, and terrifyingly formidable.
The plan of those students who had to get on the stage and fight through attrition, intending to exhaust Clark without giving him a chance to rest, was completely shattered.
Looking at the figure on the martial arts arena, surrounded by golden light and exuding an increasingly horrifying aura, many students felt inexplicably excited and stirred, their fists clenched tight.
At this moment, an equally excited Zac Lyons asked, “Justin Welan, why did you take out your phone?”
“Of course, to record today’s scene, which is likely worth a lot of money in a few years considering Jack’s terrifying talent.,” said Justin Welan matter-of-factly.
“No wonder you’re so smart. I also want to record and play this video at my wedding. Tell everyone that I and King Jack Clark are good brothers. I was cheering for him in the front row when he rose. I am sure it will be very prestigious then.”
At this moment, many people felt an inexplicable feeling that Clark had the demeanor of a king, and as long as he persisted, he was destined to ascend the throne.
On the martial arts arena, Clark listened to Justin Welan and his buddies’ conversation and couldn’t help feeling speechless.
However, he didn’t have the energy to deal with them at the moment. His eyes were fixed on the three remaining people.
Upon seeing this, Carney Turner who bore the Golden War Sword, stepped onto the arena with excitement in his eyes. “Junior Clark, I did not expect our third meeting to be on the martial arts arena.”
Clark replied slowly, “Perhaps it’s fate. The first time I entered the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, I met Senior Turner. It probably foreshadowed our eventual duel.”
Carney Turner nodded, “Perhaps… Junior Clark, my cultivation is in the Great Sun Sword Canon, which has condensed the Golden Flame Sword Intent. The swordsmanship is hot and sharp. Be careful.”
“I cultivate the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body. My Divine Tyrant Body has reached a grand accomplishment, characterized by its absolute fierce and overbearing strength. Senior Turner, please be careful.”
“Please!”
After exchanging polite remarks, Carney Turner slowly drew his battle sword. Instantly, a burning aura permeated from him as the center, affecting the Heavenly Energy within a ten-meter range.
Under the impact of the Sword Intent, he vaguely formed a circular light ring and streaks of golden light converged on the Golden War Sword, making the flames jump.
Boom!
Carney Turner sprang out of the broken rock under his feet like a golden sun.
With the convergence and blessing of the Heavenly Energy, the five-meter long golden Sword Qi expanded to seven meters. Even the flames were burning on it, creating a large sea of fire towards Clark, creating a huge momentum.
The power amplified by the Sword Intent made Carney Turner, who was at the Fifth Layer Heaven, even stronger than many expert at the Sixth Layer Heaven.
But regardless of how profound Carney Turner’s attack was, he was still faced with an unrivaled halberd.
Boom!
Under everyone’s tense gaze, the golden War Halberd swept across the void. In an instant, the terrifying power it silently radiated extinguished the sea of fire and met the Battle Sword.
Boom! A circle of blazing golden shockwave exploded, sweeping across an area of several tens of meters where the baking heat caused the air to dry up.
At the moment of the impact between the Battle Sword and the War Halberd, Carney Turner’s color changed slightly.
Boom!
Accompanied by a tsunami-like power explosion, the Heavenly Energy gathered around Carney Turner and even his True Strength collapsed under that terrifying and overbearing power.
Gurgle gurgle!
Carney Turner’s legs plunged into the ground, he couldn’t help but slide back several tens of meters, leaving two long broken marks on the martial arts arena.
However, compared to those classmates who were blown away and injured by Clark’s blow, Carney Turner was much better off with his sword-bearing arm trembling continuously, and he gave a wry smile.
“Thank you for being merciful, Junior Clark.”
Clark nodded slowly, “Senior Turner, thank you for your time.”
Carney Turner, who was hailed as the number one in the second grade in the Southern Exotic Beast Battlefield, only suffered from blood roiling and deficiency under the blow of his overbearing body comparable to the peak of the Six Heavens of Clark.
Of course, Clark had been merciful till now. If he swept his War Halberd again with the explosion of the Golden True Dragon Power, even Carney Turner would be blown up in one hit, leaving no remains.
While Carney Turner was coming off the martial arts arena with a miserable chuckle, Clark looked at the remaining two, Betty Leinster and Henric Lee.
“I’ll go.”
Saying so, Henric Lee, who was ranked ahead of Betty Leinster in his grade, strode onto the martial arts arena. An alarming and chaotic aura that drove people crazy emanated from his body.
As he stepped onto the martial arts arena, the ground and the sky around seemed to shake.
The High-Level Skill, Heaven Formlessness, is a rare cultivation method that touches upon space. When cultivated to grand accomplishment, it can twist the void, turn the four directions upside down, and even confuse others’ consciousness and vision.
Of course, Henric Lee hasn’t reached that point yet. For now, he just used the power of will mixed with the exuded aura to disturb the surrounding air, forming a chaotic field.
Then, the powerful True Strength of the peak of Fifth Layer Heaven burst out, forming a white True Strength around him, like flickering flames, emitting a heavy oppressive force.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 195- Who else is invincible like Jack Clark?_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 195- Who else is invincible like Jack Clark?_4
Translator: 549690339 I
In the rear, the teacher Mason Witlock at the base watched below, slowly saying, “Henric Logan has already broken through to the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven two months ago, and his integration of will has also been very smooth, with the hope of igniting the True Force Flame before graduation.”
“I wonder if with his strength, he can withstand Carol Koch’s grand accomplishment move of Divine Might Tyrant.”
Another female teacher hesitated, “It should be no problem, right? Even though Carol Koch’s Divine Tyrant Body is extremely overbearing and invincible, it’s still not enough to be invincible below Seventh Layer Heaven.”
Boom!
As a genius at the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven, Henric Logan’s move shattered the sky. Surrounded by formidable True Strength, the light within a tens of meters range distorted, and the Void trembled.
With a strike that caused the collapse of the Void, the air within a tens of meters range around Jack Clark was drawn out, forming a distorted field. The powerful compressing strength pressed in on him from all directions.
Roar!
From Jack Clark’s body, a Dragon Roar Elephant Roar erupted; in an instant, infinite and endless Furious Power was unleashed, and the surrounding distorted field collapsed in an instant, shattered by that terrifying strength. Boom! Just then, the Golden War Halberd spanned the Void, piercing through everything, bringing with it an overbearing and unmatched strength, blasting through the chaotic atmosphere. With one strike, it slashed down.
Boom!
Henric Logan, blocking with his combat sword, saw the Earth within a tens of meters range beneath his feet shatter. His figure sank, his face changed dramatically, and the True Strength protecting his body vibrated frantically, then collapsed.
Pu! As the True Strength collapsed, a mouthful of blood spurted from Henric Logan’s mouth, and his aura became very weak.
Upon seeing this, the Golden War Halberd, heavy as a mountain, retracted its radiance, and lifted slightly. Immediately, Henric Logan in the large pit staggered slightly, barely able to stand firm.
After one strike, Henric Logan, a talent at the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven whose combat strength had reached the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, was injured, and in an instant, many people couldn’t help but take a deep breath, the shock on their faces lingering for a long time.
“Too strong.”
The female teacher’s face was grave, “This strength is not from the Divine
Tyrant Body.”
Mason Witlock slowly said, “It’s said that he’s awakened a certain fleshly talent, similar to Innate Divine Strength. That’s probably why his Divine Might Tyrant is so terrifying.”
At this moment, continuously sweeping through his peers of the same level, Jack Clark’s invincible Battle Intent aura grew even stronger, distorting the surrounding air and filling Heaven and Earth.
Wearing black fine-scale battle armor, Betty Leinster stepped onto the Martial Arts Arena, a smile on her face: “Junior brother, let me assist you in consolidating an invincible momentum.”
Jack Clark said in a deep voice, “Senior sister Betty, please.
Whizz!
With Betty Leinster drawing her sword, a tangible green raging wind appeared around her, swirling around and growing larger until it covered a tens of meters range.
Below the Martial Arts Arena, Carol Koch exclaimed in surprise, “Senior sister Betty Leinster’s Sword Intent has indeed reached minor accomplishment.”
Whoosh whoosh!!
On the Martial Arts Arena, the raging wind howled. A shadowy figure rapidly circled around Jack Clark within the green tornado, moving so fast that even Jack’s eyesight could only catch glimpses.
So fast!
Jack’s eyes narrowed.
Wrapped in the raging wind, Betty Leinster not only moved at Supersonic Speed, but, unlike Jack, did not create a sonic boom. Instead, she merged completely with the raging wind.
Here it comes!
Swish!
The piercing hiss exploded into the air as a streak of green radiance burst forth from a dead angle behind and to the side of Jack Clark, vaguely forming the shape of a green Azure Luan Bird.
The moment the green Azure Luan Bird took shape, an invisible power descended, instantly stirring up a raging wind within a twenty-meter radius, whipping up countless green sharp blades into a storm of blades.
Boom! The two-ton War Halberd blasted through the air, surrounded by golden halberd radiance, dispelling the raging wind in its path and suppressing everything.
As swathes of wind blades dissipated, another stream of green battle sword light cut through the void on Jack Clark’s other side, with green Sword Qi compressed to its limit on it, almost turning into a flash of green light zipping by.
The space it passed through formed a pure black plane.
But by this time, it was already too late to retract the momentum of the War Halberd.
Boom!
The fist covered in battle armor shone with golden light, and in an instant, the Dragon Roar and Elephant Roar resounded throughout the void as the terrifyingly overbearing strength shattered everything in front of the fist. Including that extremely sharp green Sword Light.
Boom!
Within a range of tens of meters, the air was pulverized by a punch, with large swathes of gold and green light exploding, the ground shattered, forming a fan-shaped shockwave that swept everything within tens of meters away.
The booming sound of the air exploding resonated within heaven and earth for a long time.
When the smoke and dust finally cleared, Betty Leinster, somewhat disheveled in her battle armor, appeared dozens of meters away, her aura chaotic and her arm trembling as she held the slim battle sword.
Under Jack Clark’s punch, even Betty Leinster, with her Sword Intent in initial grand accomplishment, couldn’t take a single move!
At this moment, the aura emanating from Jack Clark became even more terrifying, invisibly distorting the surrounding air, and with the black and red Gorgeous Crystal Armor as a backdrop, he stood holding his halberd like a Golden War God incarnate.
Jack Clark slowly swept his gaze across the Martial Arts Arena and said in a deep voice, “Does anyone else dare to step up?”
Faced with Jack Clark’s challenge, the entire arena fell into a silent stupor, the atmosphere oppressively heavy.
Seeing this, Jack Clark turned and strode away, with each step causing the ground to tremble slightly, the invisible aura around him growing stronger, even showing wisps of blood-colored light.
As everyone watched Jack Clark’s figure disappear, they all breathed a sigh of relief; under that oppressive and terrifying aura, they had even felt a sensation of suffocation.
Suddenly, Justin Welan snapped back to reality.
“Quick, chase after him!”
White Veil was startled, “Chase after him for what?
Justin Welan said irritably, “Of course, to watch Jack show off. This kind of event, sweeping through all competition in one fell swoop, might only happen once in a lifetime.”
“Right, let’s hurry.”
It wasn’t just Justin Welan and his group; many students were excitedly deploying their techniques to chase after him, their faces lit up with excitement.
Because today their school at South Sky Martial Height was going to make a name for itself on the Southern Battlefield. Haha, their school’s Jack Clark was about to sweep through all the young geniuses, unstoppable by anyone.
Mandy Lewis and her sister stood on the steps, watching the crowd rush down the mountain, and Mandy asked in confusion, “Sister, aren’t you going to go watch?”
Crystal Lewis shook her head with a complex expression, “No need, we can just wait here for the news. The gap is too big, and if I watch any further, I’m afraid
my resolve will crumble.”
Meanwhile, the female teacher looked somewhat grave, “Old Mason, have you noticed? There’s something off about the blood-colored aura emanating from
Jack Clark.”
Mason Witlock nodded slightly, “…It seems like the Blood Evil Qi that can only be condensed after slaughtering countless living beings.”

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 196: Slaying All in One Day, The Invincible Jack Clark
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 196: Slaying All in One Day, The Invincible Jack Clark
Translator: 549690339 ‘
The Nine Rings Mountain spans horizontally for over a thousand kilometers, with more than fifty Martial Arts School Bases situated along the southern edge of the mountain range, each base is separated by tens of kilometers.
These bases face from south to north, blocking the countless Mutated Creatures of the Nine Rings Mountains and the Cloud Mist Mountain Range to the north with their longitudinal spans of several hundred to a thousand kilometers.
Just as Justin Welan and the others had just caught up to the foot of the mountain, Jack Clark’s figure had already disappeared at the horizon, and they could only regretfully turn back.
There was no way around it, they were too slow, and Jack Clark wasn’t interested in waiting for them.
The Nine Rings Mountain Range is different from the Cloud Mist Mountain Range; there’s no need to be cautious of random Space Cracks, and at Subsonic Speed, it took Jack Clark only a few minutes to cross tens of kilometers.
Therefore, right after Dragon Mountain Martial School received the news that Jack Clark had swept through South Sky Martial, a grand aura tinged with the intent of Blood Fiend appeared at the base of the mountain school.
Hu hu!!
A golden radiance flowed around Jack Clark, mixed with a few strands of red Blood Fiend, the invisible aura of his strength bursting the surrounding air and forming waves of white turbulence.
As those at Dragon Mountain Martial Arts School watched Jack Clark stepping onto the square, the faces of the several hundred students turned solemn, with many seniors of Second or Third Layer Heaven turning pale under his overbearing presence.
Among these people was Christopher Roach, who had once had a brief encounter with Jack Clark.
Standing with his halberd in hand, Jack Clark’s gaze swept over everyone as he said in a deep voice, “South Sky Martial, Jack Clark. I wonder if there is anyone among the Dragon Mountain Martial School Fifth Layer Heaven Seniors who can withstand three of my moves.”
From the front row of thirteen people, one young man with a bearded face stepped forward and said gravely, “I’ll go first. Seth Baldwin is eager to witness the junior’s skillful moves.”
Boom!
Speaking the name Seth Baldwin, which sounded artistic, but looking rough, the third-grade student emitted an overbearing aura that burst forth.
“Kill!”
With a low shout, Seth Baldwin charged like a wild elephant. Each step he took made the ground quake, and he moved toward Jack Clark with a ferocious and heavy momentum.
The combat knife in his hands, measuring three and a half meters long, glinted with black light, bursting the air and creating a massive, five-meter-long Shadow Axe that screamed shrilly as it cut through the air.
Watching the axe descending from the sky, Jack Clark’s eyes were cold, and at some point, a trace of blood-colored light appeared in his gaze. The muscles in his right arm, gripping the halberd, swelled explosively.
A roar! The Dragon Roar Elephant Roar resounded through the Void, and the golden light-entwined War Halberd swept out at Supersonic Speed in an instant, thunder exploding and forming a semicircular gold and black streamer.
Bang!
The Shadow Axe, capable of felling a small building, instantly collapsed, and the Battle Axe shattered, with Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven Seth Baldwin spouting blood and flying backward under the terrifying force.
Instantly, trees in the forest a hundred meters away collapsed, the ground shook, and a column of smoke and dust rose into the air.
So strong. Many people from Dragon Mountain Martial Arts School had looks of shock on their faces.
Jack Clark, surrounded by an increased presence of blood-colored aura, spoke in a deep and slow voice, “So weak. Doesn’t Dragon Mountain Martial Arts School have someone a bit stronger?”
“Damn, he’s too arrogant. Senior Roach, go beat him up.”
“Exactly, Sister Foster, your cultivation has reached Late-Stage Fifth Layer
Heaven, just withstand his three moves, and you can slap his face.”
“Right, go and deal with him.”
Jack Clark’s words instantly brought back the shocked students of Dragon Mountain to their senses, filled with righteous indignation, one after another calling for the genius seniors of Fifth Layer Heaven to take action against him.
As for them… they couldn’t win, so it was better not to step forward and embarrass themselves.
At this moment, a Martial Arts Teacher from Dragon Mountain coughed and said, “Student Clark, there’s no need for you to provoke them with words.
According to the orders, students above the Fifth Layer Boundary cannot refuse your challenge.”
“I’ll do it.”
At that moment, a handsome male student stepped forward, an explosive aura bursting from him, vibrating the air as if he were an enraged mountainous Furious Ape.
“It’s Senior Perry, he broke through to Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven last month. His realm is one small Boundary higher than that of Jack Clark; he should be able to withstand one move.”
Since Jack Clark had not released his full strength and had so far based the fights primarily on his Divine Tyrant Body’s power, no one knew that he had already made a breakthrough to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
“Eight-Arm Wheel Slash!” Finn Perry bellowed, with tangible golden sword energy bursting from his body, those lights appearing like pairs of golden arms and also like Sword Qi.
In comparison to the previously encountered Christopher Roach, who also practiced Eight Vajra True Martial, the now grand accomplishment stage Finn Perry had an even more terrifying presence.
One could see wave after wave of golden Sword Qi covering a twenty-meter radius around him, encircling his body like a Vajra with eight arms, exuding a grand and immense aura.
Boom!
As Finn Perry moved explosively, the places he passed kicked up sand and stones; the ground was plowed over by the spinning golden Sword Qi, forming multiple cracks.
Suddenly, the golden Sword Qi converged with the combat knife in Perry’s hand, and in an instant, the golden Sword Qi surged, forming a terrifying ten- meter-long blade light that ripped through the Earth.
And just as the golden blade light was raised high, in an instant, a nine-meter- long Golden War Halberd pierced through the Void and descended from the sky with a slash.
Boom!
The dazzling golden light exploded, instantly fracturing the ground within a radius of tens of meters, the terrifying force of the impact wave forming rings of tangible airwaves that swept in every direction, raising clouds of dust.
“Careful.”
“Everyone back off.”
Under that sweeping force of the ferocious impact wave, the onlooking students in the distance hastily retreated.
Soon, as the dust settled, they revealed a fan-shaped, ten-meter-wide crater in the center of the square, and lying at the bottom of the pit, with his armor in ruins and his breath weak, was Finn Perry.
Jack Clark, with his golden radiance and red Blood Fiend aura swirling around him, slowly withdrew his war halberd. His grand and domineering aura grew even stronger, suffusing Heaven and Earth and making it difficult for people to breathe.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 196 One Day Kill Through, Invincible Jack Clark_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 196 One Day Kill Through, Invincible Jack Clark_2
Translator: 549690339
An instant silence enveloped the entire venue! Many looked at Jack Clark as if he were a monster.
Even Finn Perry, in the late stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, couldn’t withstand a single move from him. Is this the fighting strength someone in the Fifth Layer Heaven realm should have?
Are we sure this first-grade student isn’t at the peak of the Sixth Heavens?
“I refuse to believe you’re really invincible. Don’t let him recover,” shouted a student, feeling inexplicably angry as he charged out, his battle sword shimmering with light.
Boom!
This third-grade student in the initial stage of Fifth Layer Heaven was instantly repelled at an even higher speed, smashing heavily into the wall, causing cracks to spiderweb and bricks to burst in all directions.
“And I…”
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Under the shocking gazes of everyone from Dragon Mountain Martial Height, with the sound of a dragon’s roar and an elephant’s bellow, Jack Clark swung his War Halberd through the air, sending all the peer geniuses who came at him flying with a single blow.
That unrivaled domineering power was unstoppable and unconquerable.
When even Natalie Foster, the highest-ranking cultivator at Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven from Dragon Mountain Martial Height, was blasted away by Jack, the entire school fell into a sudden silence.
Jack looked around and said in a deep voice, “You have my thanks!”
The Blood Evil Qi circling around him grew stronger, the blood qi that merged into his body that night gradually activating, and his eyes slowly filled with a blood-red color.
Suddenly, Jack had an epiphany. He stopped holding back the power within him, and instantly a more terrifying and overbearing aura spread forth.
Crackle crackle!!
With Jack Clark at its center, cracks spread out from beneath his feet like spiderwebs, covering a few meters, as if the Earth itself couldn’t bear his presence.
Hiss! Such a terrifying sight made the students of Dragon Mountain Martial Arts School gasp in shock.
Even the three Martial Cultivation Teachers left in charge had serious expressions on their faces.
As Great Masters in the mid-stage of the Six Heavens, they felt, at this moment, that they might not be a match for this first-grade student.
As Jack Clark turned to leave, covering ten meters in a single step, he disappeared from everyone’s sight in the blink of an eye.
After a long while, Christopher Roach swallowed hard, “I never thought that in just a half month, Junior Clark would improve to such an extent. It’s terrifying.”
Una Tennat smiled bitterly and nodded, “Yeah, who would have thought that the youth who challenged you and fought indistinguishably against you would become so dreadful.”
An expert at the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven can’t even withstand one of his moves, and losing to him one after another without even catching his breath. He’s completely a monster.”
Culver Douglas suddenly said, “If he truly sweeps the entire southern battlefield, Christopher, you might become famous too. After all, you were the first one he defeated when he entered the Alien Beast Battlefield.”
“…Ha…I feel like no fame would be better in this case,” Christopher Roach laughed dryly.
As Jack Clark was sweeping through Dragon Mountain Martial Height, the Martial School Base center also received the news.
Commander Tyler Lance mused, “It’s only been over a month since he exchanged for Advanced Skill, and he has cultivated the Divine Tyrant Body to the grand accomplishment. This talent… it’s not inferior to ‘that person’.” Tyler Lance suddenly said, “Broadcast the news as it happens next, and announce it to all bases each time this youngster sweeps through a Martial Arts School.”
“This… General, aren’t you afraid that the students might feel hopeless and despair?” a Colonel asked with a wry expression.
“If they despair due to an overwhelming gap, such people don’t deserve to continue wasting resources,” Tyler Lance replied.
Therefore, one minute after Jack Clark left Dragon Mountain, the base large screens suddenly popped up with Red Large Characters.
Following South Sky Martial Height, Dragon Mountain Martial Height has also been defeated by Jack Clark. Within his peer level, no one can withstand a single move. Godly Dragon Elephant, unrivaled domination.”
Immediately, all students at Dragon Mountain Martial Height stiffened for a moment, feeling that the line of Red Large Characters was somewhat glaring, while students from other Martial Arts Schools were shocked.
“Damn, that guy has started challenging and has already swept through two Martial Arts Schools, with not a single Fifth Layer Heaven student able to withstand a move!”
“Is this real? Isn’t his cultivation at Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven? I remember South Sky Martial and Dragon Mountain Martial both have late-stage and even peak Fifth Layer geniuses.”
“Freak!”
“Monster…”
As the entire southern battlefield boiled with excitement, about twenty minutes later, the Red Large Characters on the large screen changed again.
“Mountain and Lake Martial Height, defeated. Within his peer level, no one can withstand a single move from Jack Clark Underneath the War Halberd, Earth and Heaven crumble, blood light soars to the skies, no one can stand in his way.”
Hiss! Many people watching the large screen gasped.
“He’s already swept through another Martial Arts School so quickly. Is his True Strength really endless?”
“Nonsense, he’s been defeating his enemies in one move. Under these circumstances, fighting him in waves is pointless.”
“Based on his cultivation at Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven, at full strength, he could carry out at least a dozen or even more moves. Unless there are more peer geniuses to push him to his limit at once.”
“Otherwise, after sweeping through one Martial Arts School, he’ll be able to recover some True Strength on the way to the next base, and this cycle could lastfor a long time.”
And now it’s already four in the afternoon. Considering his current pace of challenge, after sweeping through a dozen more Martial Arts Schools, it will be nearly dark, just in time to rest for the night.”
“In this case, isn’t no one able to stop him?”
‘Could it be that he really wants to sweep through the southern battlefield this time, suppressing the young generation!?”
Amidst the numerous discussions, it took another twenty or so minutes before the Red Large Characters on the large screen changed again.
“Lans Martial Arts, defeated. Within his peer level, no one can withstand a single move from Jack Clark Beneath the War Halberd, the ground splits and the blood light reaches for the heavens, unblockable.”

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 196: Slaying through the Day, the Invincible Jack Clark_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 196: Slaying through the Day, the Invincible Jack Clark_3
Translator: 549690339
Someone excitedly shouted, “He’s slow, this time he’s slower than the last, he’s not up to it.”
“Hahaha… This guy definitely used some kind of burst secret skill earlier to achieve a sweeping strike across his level, thereby suppressing his opponent with his spirit and aura, making it impossible for them to use their full strength.”
“Now that his speed has slowed down, he must be struggling to suppress the aftereffects of the secret skill.”
“I think it’s not that simple, just watch, or else you’ll end up getting slapped in the face.”
While everyone was watching the big screen anxiously, Jack Clark, who had successively swept away two first-tier and two second-tier Martial Highs, radiated an even more terrifying aura, with blood light swirling around his body.
Everywhere he passed, the air vibrated, forming white waves that blew in all directions, causing the grass and trees to bow, as if all creatures were paying homage to him.
Before long, he traversed over mountains and through valleys, navigating over a dozen mountain peaks, until he finally arrived at Lee City Martial Height Base and then came to a halt.
In front of the base at the foot of the mountain, figures were everywhere, each one of them excited, curious, anticipatory, and solemn as they looked at him.
“Is that Jack Clark?”
“That overbearing aura is so astonishing.”
“That’s not right, how come there’s such a heavy scent of blood on him, like he’s killed tens of thousands and absorbed killing intent through a secret skill?”
“So handsome.”
“I wonder if Brother Garcetti and the others can block one of his moves.”
“How could they possibly? Brother Garcetti is only at the mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven; he’s certainly no match for him in one strike. Didn’t you see Betty Leinster, who’s ranked thirty-fifth on the Achievement List, fail to withstand a single blow?”
“Right, so let’s hope Brother Garcetti and the others suffer lighter injuries.”
While these students were discussing, the seven Fifth Layer heaven students at the very front had somewhat awkward expressions because their schoolmates didn’t have much faith in them.
Just then, a Lee City Martial teacher coughed dryly and politely said, “Student Clark, you might as well have your match here, so you can quickly move on to the next school base.”
Instantly, the faces of those seven Fifth Layer Heaven students turned green.
It’s one thing for classmates to lack confidence, but you’re a teacher, how can you bolster someone else’s morale at the expense of your own students’ pride? Although… well, they themselves weren’t confident they could block this monster for even a single move.
As for why they didn’t fight in the square above or in the Martial Arts Arena, of course, it was to avoid wasting time with repairs.
They’d already received phone calls informing them that a Fifth Layer Heaven student from Lans Martial Arts had gone mad, mouthing some unspeakable words.
Then, under Jack Clark’s angry strike, not only did the student sustain heavy injuries, with his battle armor shattered and weapon broken, but the square was also blasted into several large pits during the subsequent fight.
That was tolerable, but the explosive diffusion of the sharp halberd skill had also torn open several cracks around the area, necessitating a complete rebuild of the square.
Three minutes later, Jack Clark slowly exhaled a breath: “Thank you for conceding!”
After he spoke, he turned with his War Halberd in hand and left, his aura even more vast, overbearing, and filled with killing intent.
The teacher looked at his own geniuses, who were weak in spirit, and said enviously, “South Sky Martial really struck gold this time.”
Another female teacher nodded: “It was said that when he enrolled, he only showed mediocre talent. Who would have thought that after his breakthrough in the First Layer Heaven and Cultivating True Martial Arts, he would become unstoppable.”
“And not only is his cultivation fast, but his combat strength is also so frightening. I feel his real combat strength might have reached the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage.”
The male teacher slightly shook his head: “A Late Sixth Layer Heaven combat strength can’t defeat those people in one move.”
As Jack Clark departed, all the Martial Arts School’s big screens changed again.
Suddenly, Justin Welan excitedly shouted, “Only fourteen minutes have passed, Jack is in fine form.”
Zac Maben said enviously, “This guy is really going to become world-famous this time, sweeping through the entire battlefield, almost representing the top of the young generation in the south.”
“Ah, why isn’t that person me? If it were me, I’d be ecstatic. Just imagine, me in Golden Armor, with wings on my back, how cool would that be?”
“Your armor is too flashy. I still think my Silver Sky Battle Armor looks cooler.”
Mullen Weisz said speechlessly, “You guys, shouldn’t you be discussing how many girls’ favor Jack Clark can win over after he’s shown off at all the Martial Schools?”
“Damn, Mr. Woodley, you’ve spotted the blind spot.”
“Jack’s entry, defeating all the talents of their school in one move with such an imposing manner, is sure to attract all the girls’ eyes.”
“I can’t stand it, I’m too envious. We have to make him treat us to a night of barbecue, last time those pork hocks were too delicious.”
“Right, let’s eat him out of house and home.”
Not far away, Mandy Lewis sighed, “Sis, it’s your insight that’s sharp. Back when he was at the Foundation Establishment stage, you wanted to pull him into your squad, but unfortunately, a dragon will not live with a snake.”
Crystal Lewis immediately became speechless: “Mandy, if you can’t use idioms properly, you might as well not use them.”
As everyone watched, the red large characters on the big screen continued to change, with the number of defeated Martial Schools increasing to six, seven, ten…
He could almost be described as unstoppable and tearing through his opposition with ease.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark swept across the world with an ever-growing powerful aura, over twenty figures burst out from the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, all converging in the direction opposite to his, gathering at the last Martial School Base.
There was no choice; with Jack’s unstoppable speed, if those strongest students scattered back to their respective bases, most would miss the battle.
So the military had sent them a special message, instructing them to assemble at the last Martial School Base and wait for Jack Clark to come knocking.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 196: Slaying through the Day, the Invincible Jack Clark_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 196: Slaying through the Day, the Invincible Jack Clark_4
Translator: 549690339 |
Soon, under the tense and shocked gazes of everyone, the sky turned dark.
An entire afternoon passed, and Jack Clark had challenged twenty-seven Martial School Bases, fought two hundred ninety-three battles, and won them all; no one could match him in even a single exchange.
At Clearing Martial Height Base, the lights shone brightly.
At this moment, a vast square fell eerily silent; all eyes were on the figure standing alone, holding a halberd.
At this time, the aura of unrivaled strength and towering blood light around Jack Clark grew even more terrifying. Among the swirls of blood-red Killing Intent, one could vaguely hear countless Unique Beasts roaring and wailing in agony.
It was as if he had slaughtered countless Mutated Creatures and walked out of a Sea of Blood.
Then, a teacher from Clearing Martial Height sighed after seeing more than a dozen students defeated by a single strike: “Student Clark, you have won.” Jack Clark slowly said, “Thank you for making it easy!”
After speaking, Jack Clark turned and left, his footsteps remarkably heavy. With each step, the ground shook and cracks spread, an awe-inspiring sight.
“Phew! Is today finally going to end?” a cultivator from the Third Layer Heaven exhaled and gave a bitter smile.
