“This guy must be a monster, right? He’s been fighting from the afternoon until now, sweeping through dozens of Martial Arts Schools and defeating about three hundred peers, and he can still be this strong.”
“Let’s see tomorrow.”
Everyone thought that Jack Clark would rest for the night and recuperate before fighting again tomorrow. After all, humans aren’t made of iron; such continuous battles are hugely draining on the spirit and aura.
And for the next half an hour, indeed, there were no updates about any Martial School Bases being swept through.
But only those at the command center of the rear base knew the battle wasn’t over yet.
On the giant satellite surveillance screen, one could see the light that represented Jack Clark moving at an astonishing speed through the Martial School Bases he had swept through in the afternoon.
The reason being that South Sky Martial was situated to the left of those Martial School Bases, and Jack Clark had also swept in leftward direction that afternoon.
So after he defeated twenty-eight Martial Arts Schools there, he needed to turn back.
Suddenly, after more than half an hour, the big screen lit up again.
“Forest Mount Martial Height has been defeated by Jack Clark, no match for a single move, powerful as a force of nature.”
Instantly, all the bases erupted into commotion.
“Damn, isn’t that guy going to rest?”
“Could he be trying to slaughter his way through the entire southern battlefield in a day?”
“My gosh, we may witness history today…”
Many students who were just about to get dinner stopped in their tracks and excitedly turned back to look at the big screen flashing with red Radiance.
Indeed, after about ten more minutes, the big characters on the screen changed again.
At South Sky Martial Height Base, Zac Maben shouted anxiously, “The thirty- second one.”
Soon, Marcus Lindsay also exclaimed excitedly, “The thirty-third one.”
“The thirty-fourth…”
In the anxious and expectant eyes of everyone, especially Justin Welan and the others, the flashing lights on the big screen resembled a progress bar.
It signified the advancing conquest of Jack Clark sweeping the southern battlefield.
In that moment, not only the geniuses defeated by Jack Clark but also the regular students were nervously watching that flickering big screen.
Especially the geniuses he had beaten, who wished more than anyone else that he would sweep the entire battlefield.
If so, since everyone was blown away with a single move, it wouldn’t make them look too inadequate.
Late at night, at two in the morning, as the big screen lit up again, all fifty-seven Martial School Bases erupted into an uproar.
“The fifty-eighth one, just the last one left, go Jack!”
“Kill, kill, kill, take them all down.”
“He’s invincible! He’s really going to slaughter through the entire southern battlefield in one day…”
As countless people shouted in excitement, at Heavy State Martial Height Base, beneath the mountain, more than twenty figures with strong auras stood solemnly, their faces grave as they looked into the distance.
Among these people was the number one from South Sky Martial, Denny Rhodes.
Soon, a terrifying Aura approached from afar, and everyone’s spirits were lifted: “He’s coming.”
But when Jack Clark emerged from the darkness, everyone was stunned.
Wasn’t he on the Invincible Path? What was with the surging blood light around him?
How many ‘people’ must one slaughter to gather such terrifying Blood Fiend aura!

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 197- Bathed in Blood, Reflecting Hell, Soulless (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 197- Bathed in Blood, Reflecting Hell, Soulless (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Translator: 549690339 |
When Jack Clark first entered the school to start cultivation, the talent he displayed was above average in Spirit Power, but due to his innately weak constitution, his physical body was only rated as low.
Overall, his talent was below average.
Had it not been for the feedback from the first Evolution of his Avatar, which compensated for the shortcomings of his frail body, he would have been unable to achieve Foundation Establishment within half a month.
Moreover, he did it right on the half-month deadline.
Thus, even though he vaguely sensed that the earlier one achieved Foundation Establishment, the greater the attention they might receive, he did not use Doris Clark’s savings of 90,000 to buy resources to supplement his Qi Blood.
Because even if he used that 90,000 yuan, it would only allow him to achieve Foundation Establishment two or three days earlier, which didn’t make much difference from the half-month span.
Was Jack Clark concerned about the issue of talent?
Of course, he was. No one wants to be the worst off.
Initially, seeing his classmates progress rapidly, visualizing ten petals in one day, and advancing their Blood Qi from the fifth to the eighth turn, one would be lying if they said they didn’t feel inferior.
After all, everyone had two hands and feet. Why should there be such a big gap?
It was only because of the “thinking” of an adult, along with the existence of the Avatar and attribute page, that Jack Clark could appear so calm and unhurried at the time.
If it were not for these, he probably could only barely achieve Foundation Establishment after struggling for a month or two.
And then he would watch helplessly as those geniuses cultivated Advanced Skills, leaving him far behind, as he practiced low-level martial arts and looked up to them from his position far below the stage.
Maybe by then, he would have been shouting proverbs about fortunes changing over time, not to underestimate the poor youth.
Then it would become not to underestimate the poor middle-aged, not to underestimate the poor elderly, followed by venerating the dead above all else.
Because the gap in talent between people does indeed exist.
This talent includes physical cultivation talent, mental comprehension talent, resilient will, and comprehensive learning ability, so there is no such thing as being too poor in the beginning and accumulating riches slowly over time.
If you can accumulate and then achieve success, it is because you have an advantage in one aspect.
Otherwise, if merely hard work could make you stand at the peak, then this world would not have a lower class, and everyone would be like dragons.
Therefore, when Jack Clark today sweeps away all the monster geniuses from schools across the entire South with absolute strength, he feels an indescribable sense of relief and excitement in his heart.
He is not a saint; he has emotions and desires of love, hate, delusion, and ignorance just like everyone else, but he usually restrains them and does not show them.
At this moment, his Power of Intent becomes increasingly active, and his understanding of martial skills and Cultivation Methods deepens, reaching the state he experienced that night in the Cloud Mist after battling through the night.
This time, although he is surrounded by Endless Blood Evil Qi, his consciousness doesn’t fall into madness again, but clearly perceives an invisible Boundary Wall.
Just a little more, only a little more is needed.
As long as he can break through that invisible Boundary Wall, he will be able to condense the Power of Intent and touch Heaven and Earth.
Heavy breathing!
Jack Clark lets out heavy breaths, his eyes blood-red, with ethereal streams of blood-colored aura swirling around him, screaming like ghosts and howling like gods-he stands with a halberd as if he were a war god from Hell.
The invisible aura of bloodshed causes the people of Heavy State Martial Height in the distance to catch their breath, and many students at the Third and Fourth Layers turn pale.
Denny Rhodes’s expression is solemn, “Junior Clark, weren’t you gathering Battle Intent on the Invincible Path? What’s happening now?”
jack Clark’s voice is deep, “I’m in a good state right now, but the Battle Intent I’m gathering is related to the countless Mutated Creatures I’ve slain before.”
So it was Mutated Creatures that were killed.
That explains it.
No wonder Spirit Power around him had a faint feeling of the shrieking and wailing of Mutated Creatures.
Hearing this, everyone breathes a sigh of relief.
That terrifying aura of Blood Evil Qi was not from killing people, which was all that mattered. Otherwise, there would be no need to fight today, instead there would be procedures to investigate Jack Clark’s identity.
Looking at the ‘geniuses’ a few dozen meters away, at the late stage and peak of Fifth Layer Heaven, Jack Clark says solemnly, “Gentlemen, you are not my match, come at me all at once next.”
in an instant, the students on the hillside behind him who were there to watch the excitement stirred.
“Ha, does this guy think he’s still facing people from outside the top fifty of the Achievement List? These are monster geniuses standing at the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven.”
“Uh… is there a difference?”
“indeed, there’s a gap between those outside the top fifty and the top thirty on the Achievement List, but it’s not too big. They all are at the Fifth Layer, so I feel he’s just stating the facts.”
“That spirit, truly worthy of being the prodigy who is about to sweep the entire southern battlefield.”
If Jack Clark had said these words at the beginning, it would only make people think he’s arrogant, ignorant, and conceited.
But after carrying the terrifying record of defeating more than five hundred Fifth Layer peers in one day by sweeping fifty-eight Martial School Bases, it feels utterly justified.
Even the Martial Cultivation Teachers holding the line just furrow their eyebrows, their eyes stem as they continue to watch the scene below, jasper Forbes, ranked fifth on the Achievement List, chuckles, “I thought standing on rooftops, trees, and cliffside already made me pretentious enough, but Junior, you outdo me.”
“There’s no denying it, after tonight’s battle we definitely need to have a drink together and discuss how to come off more elegantly pretentious.”
Some start to laugh heartily, “Hahahaha… That’s audacious! Since Junior Clark is so confident, gentlemen, let’s not disappoint him.”
Dion Casady, carrying a heavy sword nearly 3 meters long and 0.5 meters wide, speaks with an eruption of aura as mighty as a mountain, “Junior Clark, I hope you won’t regret it.”
They all know Jack Clark is seeking to elevate his Will by the force of victory on the Invincible Path, and is even on the verge of condensing his Intent.
If he continues to defeat everyone with an unbeatable might, perhaps he could really succeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 197: Bathed in Blood, Reflecting Hell, Soulless (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 197: Bathed in Blood, Reflecting Hell, Soulless (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
Translator: 549690339 I
And considering their shared kinship as part of the Human Race, these geniuses had long been prepared to go easy on him, helping him with one arm tied behind their back, so to speak, in hope of adding another peerless monster to their ranks.
But disaster can spill from the mouth, and speaking too arrogantly can offend others. At this moment, as Jack Clark declared, ”Let’s all go at once,” the expressions in some people’s eyes turned slightly cold.
Clearly, they felt belittled by this ‘genius.’
As the most dazzling geniuses from the previous two sessions, they had not yet made the breakthrough to Sixth-level Heaven, but their combat strengths were all above the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage; some had even comprehended Sword Intent, Blade Intent, and Spear Intent.
When they joined forces, even cultivators who had just reached the high-order of Seventh Layer Heaven would have to avoid them.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, auras comparable to those of the Sixth Layer burst forth from these geniuses, with various colors of True Strength radiance shining brightly, and raging winds swirling around their bodies, their might shaking the heavens.
“Thousand Slaughter Dragon Slash!”
Roar!
As the dragon roared and the tiger howled, Dion Casady, wielding a heavy sword, took the lead, dashing outwards in a flash. His huge sword spewed out a yellow Sword Qi reaching six meters, like a ten-meter enormous sword being dragged behind him.
Wherever the Sword Qi passed, the Earth was torn asunder, creating a huge trench while stirring up a howling wind with terrifying momentum.
“Nine Heavens Wind God Slash!”
“Infinite Hell!”
“Seven Stars Seal Demons…”
The others also made their moves, transforming into streaks of light shooting outwards, with their powerful True Strength shining like leaping flames, as if they were on the brink of igniting the True Force Flame.
Though they had not teamed up before, these individuals launched various powerful combat techniques in an orderly chaos, striking at Jack Clark from all directions, the onslaught massive.
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark, surrounded by a blood light, was on the verge of being engulfed.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s body shone with golden red light, and with a sweep of his War Halberd, it seemed as if the energy of heaven and earth was stirred, forming an annular ring of destructive power that exploded outward.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the might of Sweeping the Eight Wastes, the seven beams of Sword Qi, Blade Qi, and axe light that first approached were all shredded, releasing a terrifying shockwave. In an instant, the ground shattered, and smoke and dirt billowed into the sky.
Within the storm of smoke and dust, a heavy halberd swept across, splitting into seven parts of surging blood red light that, almost simultaneously, struck the oncoming battle swords and long knives.
In an instant, symbols on the river, Dion Casady, and others all had a slight change in expression, feeling an indescribable terrifying power transmitted to them, True Strength trembling as they were blown away with a rumble.
Right at that moment, three dazzling beams of Sword Qi struck the soul, swift as lightning, while two beams of Blade Qi tore the Earth asunder, each carrying tremendous might that tore through the air-currents, assailing Jack Clark. Meanwhile, from high above Jack Clark’s head, two beams of gold and red Blade Qi descended from the sky, like two meteors slashing the firmament.
And all of this happened in an instant, less than a second.
The timing of the attacks was just right, seizing the moment right after Jack Clark had used Sweeping the Eight Wastes when his True Strength inside momentarily paused and could not erupt continuously. All the attacks reached him at the same time.
At this moment, if Jack Clark were to block the Sword Qi in front, he would be hit by the attacks from behind and above. If he dealt with the Blade Qi above, he would not be able to fend off the surrounding attacks.
Boom!
The ground beneath Jack Clark shattered, and he turned into a streak of red light soaring into the sky, his War Halberd piercing through heaven and earth, shattering the two beams of Blade Qi with a loud bang.
Boom boom!!
In an instant, the black gold shockwaves exploded in the air, fury unleashed, and the two figures broken by the combat knives flew backward like cannonballs, blown away by the overbearing power carried by the War Halberd. Just then, below, five beams of Sword Qi also gave chase, soaring into the sky after Jack Clark.
But awaiting them was a shift in the colors of heaven and earth and a sweeping tide of red blood light descending from the sky with a Ghost Wailing Divine Howl.
Boom! A strike from the sky smashed everything in its path, and after pulverizing the five beams of Sword Qi, the force did not diminish, and with a bang, it struck the ground.
Boom!
In an instant, the Earth within a twenty-meter radius collapsed and the golden red radiance exploded, sending countless amounts of dirt flying into the sky, scattering over a hundred meters before raining down with a patter.
Within the sweep of the shockwave, five figures let out muffled groans, being blasted away by the terrifying force.
Such fearsome might left the cultivation students who had been watching from afar profoundly shaken, watching the billowing smoke and air waves stretching out a hundred meters in disbelief.
Was this the commotion that a fight between Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivators should cause? Or was it more akin to a clash between high-rank experts of the Seventh Layer Heaven?
Just then, within the dust-choked depths, an ear-splitting roar suddenly resounded, and in an instant, a more dazzling radiance burst forth, and terrifying auras exploded.
“Nine Heavens Divine Transformation!”
“Vast Heaven Overbearing Blade.”
“Dread Shock of Gods and Demons!”
“True Dragon Seal Demons Slash!”
“Behold my Celestial Being Descending from Beyond…”
“I refuse to believe that you can sweep all of us away.”
Right when Jack Clark burst forth in an instant, sweeping away more than a dozen experts, the remaining nine pinnacle geniuses of the Fifth Layer Heaven joined hands, delivering their strongest strike.
This strike was unavoidable for Jack Clark, with its spirit, will, and power locked on him, leaving no room for escape.
But did he need to dodge?
Just as all the attacks were about to hit him, the red radiance swirling around Jack Clark intensified, a terrifying aura burst forth within him, and with a Dragon Roar Elephant Roar, golden light sparkled.
“Eight Desolate Refining Hell!”
In an instant, centered around Jack Clark, nine beams of golden red War Halberd shadows nine meters long swept all around, unleashing an earth- shaking, terrifying power and raising a massive surge of airwaves.
With two episodes of enlightenment that day and under external pressure, Jack Clark’s comprehension, awareness, and understanding of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd reached its peak at this moment.
Without resorting to the use of Attribute points to enhance it, he realized the final move that fused Sweeping the Eight Wastes and Infernal Purgatory – the ultimate technique of Eight Desolate Refining Hell.
In an instant, the nine beams of Halberd Skill blocked the Sword Qi, dragon shadows, and rotating Blade Light, and at the moment of contact, those shadows of the War Halberd emitted a dazzling light.
Boom boom boom boom!!
The nine beams imbued with fifty percent of the Infernal Purgatory’s might of the True Dragon Power exploded like nine missiles from the sky. In that instant, the light they emitted illuminated the night sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 197: Bathed in Blood, Reflecting Hell, Soulless (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 197: Bathed in Blood, Reflecting Hell, Soulless (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
Translator: 549690339
The earth shook violently, countless pieces of dirt and stone soared into the sky; the resulting destructive shockwave swept over an area of more than a hundred meters, darkening the heavens and earth, the reverberations echoing endlessly.
It took about ten minutes for the explosion to subside, and as the smoke and dust slowly dispersed, several pits each about a dozen meters in diameter were revealed amid the heavily pocked and cracked land.
Standing on this land, which resembled ruins, were about twenty figures – they were Denny Rhodes and his companions.
Compared to those ‘geniuses1 who either spat blood or had their weapons shattered and their battle armor broken by Jack Clark’s single strike, their situation was not much better.
Facing the siege of more than twenty top-notch geniuses, even Jack Clark dared not hold back; he unleashed nearly all of his strength, except for activating runes.
As a result, each of these individuals appeared somewhat weak, their arms trembling as they grasped their weapons, with a few even bleeding from the comers of their mouths, having sustained serious injuries.
But compared to these injuries, the blow to their spirits was even greater.
They had lost.
More than twenty of the strongest geniuses had united and were still suppressed by the absolute overbearing strength of this freshman.
That magnificent, grand, overbearing, invincible strength was terrifying. No matter how exquisite their moves were or how powerful their Sword Qi, as soon as they were touched by that golden red halberd wrapped in halberd radiance, their Sword Qi was instantly destroyed by that horrific strength.
Add to that an indescribable reaction and attack speed; facing the siege of more than twenty people, he still appeared completely at ease.
The gap in strength was unimaginable, making it hard to believe that his cultivation level was the same as theirs, all at the Fifth Layer Heaven.
No wonder he dared to make the outrageous claim that no one of the same rank could withstand his three moves – this peerless strength within the same rank was simply that of a monster, a monster of despair.
just as everyone was shaken to their core, at the center of the battlefield, Jack Clark, who held the War Halberd, radiated an increasingly terrifying aura, and the blood-colored light he emitted almost obscured the sky.
The Battle Intent on him, suggesting ‘Heaven and Earth like Hell, and I am invincible’, became even more terrifying, almost materializing to interfere with reality, with vague reflections of seas of blood and mountains of corpses around him.
in that vision, the corpses of Mutated Beasts piled up like mountains, and the blood that flowed out formed an ocean, with ferocious Mutated Beasts roaring up at the sky within it.
Even in that endless sea of blood, there were shades of Blood God Cultists and Purgatory Demon Race, each letting out a miserable howl.
“What is that intent?”
“Didn’t they say he was trying to condense undefeatable war intent?” “Such a strong Killing Intent, it’s not an exaggeration to call it a sea of blood and mountains of corpses, did he possibly slaughter a million… no, a hundred thousand Mutated Creatures?”
As the vision of the sea of blood and mountains of corpses emerged, everyone became slightly restless, their faces showing shock and horror.
They couldn’t understand how Jack Clark, a freshman cultivator, harbored such heavy Killing Intent or when he had killed so many Mutated Creatures.
Boom!
At that moment, the reflection of the sea of blood and mountains of corpses around Jack Clark, including the spiraling red Blood Fiend aura, began to tremble as it was slowly pressed into his body under the immense invincible intent.
Instantly, the figures of the Mutated Creatures, Blood God Cultists, and Purgatory Demon Race within the sea of blood let out even more miserable screams and wails, creating a scene of ghost wailing and divine howling.
Then with a loud boom, all the visions disappeared, everything merging into Jack Clark’s body.
As his aura receded, the oppressive feeling that filled the space between heaven and earth, as if fighting against heaven and earth, also slowly faded away, and inexplicably, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Jasper Forbes said enviously, “He succeeded.”
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which faintly reflected the imagery of seas of blood and mountains of corpses, and even the gaze itself turned red. As his terrifying gaze swept over, everyone instinctively looked away.
However, Jack Clark merely glanced at these people before turning his attention to the attribute page that only he could see.
Realm of thought: Prison Blood War Intent [A special War Intent Power bathed in blood, reflecting hell.
When battle intent is activated and begins to draw upon the Heavenly Energy, consciousness will sink into a frenzied state of blood battle, enhancing the destructive capabilities of all combat techniques by fifty percent.
Thirst for Killing: During combat, by slaying enemies and absorbing the intangible Blood Fiend Qi, one can temporarily enhance the power of their battle intent. The more lives taken, the stronger the enhancement.
Death Invincibility: When injured in battle or when Qi Blood greatly diminishes, invincible intent is activated. The graver the injury and the greater the consumption of Qi Blood, the stronger the battle intent becomes.
Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but catch his breath with anticipation upon seeing the note behind the battle intent, feeling a rush of excitement.
The ability to enhance combat techniques by fifty percent when stirring the Heavenly Energy with battle intent was not surprising, similar to the initial boosts of Sword Intent and Blade Intent.
However, Thirst for Killing, the passive ability where killing more intensifies the enhancement of battle intent through absorption of Blood Fiend Qi, gave Jack Clark pause.
That alone would have been sufficient.
Then there was Death Invincibility, which kicks in when injured or when Qi Blood significantly drops during battle, rendering one’s battle intent stronger as injuries worsen.
This trait could work perfectly in tandem with the Tyrant Elephant Form, igniting Qi Blood not only to increase strength eightfold, but also making battle intent increasingly stronger over time.
The stronger one became, the more enemies slain, the more Blood Fiend Qi absorbed, and the battle intent would grow continuously mightier… at this thought, even Jack Clark’s eyes reddened with rising fervor.
Such a special and terrifying battle intent was entirely meant for thriving on the battlefield. Once he entered the Frontline Battlefield of the mythical world in the future, wouldn’t it mean an unbridled rampage, a veritable sea of blood?!
Whew!
Jack Clark exhaled, suppressing the excitement in his heart, as his gaze swept over the other attributes, noticing no significant changes except for a sharp increase of 50 points in his Spiritual Attribute.
Spiritual Attribute!
Jack Clark’s eyes settled on the 50-point increase in Spiritual Attribute, indeed, he had guessed correctly that the Spiritual Attribute represented his soul; each time the Avatar Feedback strengthened his physical body, his spirit, Qi, and vigor nourished back into his soul, which grew ceaselessly stronger. Actually, in the instant the battle intent had condensed and ascended, Jack Clark had vaguely sensed the ‘soul’ within him that seemed to fill his body and yet was as if it didn’t exist.
Vast, boundless, as if an immense deity lay in hibernation.
At the same time, his soul’s state was somewhat peculiar: half human, half beast, half inside his body, and half existing in an unknown Void.
Or rather, that half of his soul was with the Thunderflame Behemoth.
No wonder his Spiritual Attribute was vast and unparalleled, yet his enlightenment and Spirit Power were not much stronger than others-it was because his Soul Power was tied to maintaining synchrony with the avatar.
If he wanted to mobilize his Soul Power, he likely needed to first strengthen his Soul Talent. Otherwise, merely possessing top-tier Soul Talent wouldn’t reveal more extraordinary powers.
Pensively, Jack Clark withdrew his attribute page with a thought and said politely, “Thankyou to all the seniors for your support. I was offensive before, please forgive me.”
Denny Rhodes’s eyes were complicated as he said with a mix of envy and congratulation, “Congratulations, junior, on condensing your battle intent.” “Congratulations.”
“Hahaha… Congratulations, Student Clark, for becoming the top of the young generation in the south.”
With a mild demeanor from Jack Clark, everyone was willing to step down gracefully. After all, judging by his previous demeanor, he seemed to have been under the influence of the realm of thought, so no one bore a grudge.
Or rather, any discomfort or displeasure they might have felt before had now dissipated.
“Everyone, I need to go back to consolidate my strength. See you.”
With a greeting, Jack Clark stowed his War Halberd and, in an instant, vanished into the night.
At the same time, red large characters appeared on all the screens across the square.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 198 Unparalleled Under Heaven,
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 198 Unparalleled Under Heaven,
Top-tier Secret Manual (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
The final battle had just ended, and the brightly lit Military Base Center had received the news or, more precisely, had finished watching the live broadcast filmed by a teacher from Heavy State Martial Cultivation.
As Jack Clark’s figure disappeared from the large screen, many of the military’s senior officials sat in prolonged silence.
After a long while, a Colonel exclaimed, “After this battle, the geniuses of our southern battlefield will either develop an even stronger motivation for cultivation or be utterly disheartened.”
“No need to worry about that. Once they realize that no one can withstand a single move from Jack Clark, they will comfort themselves, thinking that the problem lies not with them but with Jack Clark.”
Someone laughed, “Haha… indeed, we humans are quite adept at adjusting to external pressures.”
At this moment, a middle-aged man questioned, “Did you notice something strange just now about the War Intent this kid condensed?”
“Even though I couldn’t feel it through the screen, judging from the phenomenon of the War Intent condensation, it should belong to the Slaughter-Class. Such Power of Intent usually takes the killing of at least a million enemies to condense.”
A Major hesitated, “But didn’t he say earlier that this Blood Evil Qi came from the Mutated Creatures he had slain?”
“Since he started cultivation, the recorded kills of Mutated Creatures doesn’t even reach two hundred. How could he accumulate such immense Blood Fiend energy with so few?” someone said, furrowing their brow.
“Indeed, that’s quite odd.”
After Jack Clark’s astonishing emergence two days ago, they had all reviewed the record of this abruptly risen monster, which seemed overall inspiring and traceable.
Especially his performance after arriving in Koroya, acting cautiously in regular matters but decisively brutal in combat, almost the same as today.
According to the records, however, the number of rebels and Evil God Sect Cultists he slaughtered in Koroya tallied to only a couple hundred.
Add to that the hundred-plus lower-level Mutated Creatures he killed during his cleanup tasks, and the high-level alien beasts he had killed in the Alien Beast Battlefield within a month weren’t that numerous either.
So where did such heavy Killing Intent come from?
At the main seat, Tyler Lance slowly said, “It probably has something to do with the previous Blood Moon. On the second day after the Blood Moon disappeared, he returned to base carrying a pile of Mutated Beast corpses and wreckage.”
“According to the manager of South Sky Martial Height’s Logistics Warehouse, the young man was emitting a shocking scent of blood at the time, and even his washed battle armor made breathing laborious.”
“That night of the Blood Moon, he must have gone through a terrible bloodshed, slaying countless Mutated Creatures, gathering astonishing Killing Intent.”
“It just so happened that at that time, he touched the threshold of War Intent, sealing that Blood Evil Qi inside his body, until it triggered again today.”
“Here is a photo for reference.”
As he spoke, Tyler Lance swiped the touch screen on the table a few times, and suddenly a photo full of countless bones projected onto the large screen.
“This was taken yesterday morning by a Special Warfare team that entered the Cloud Mist Mountain Range for backup. The location is near the edge of the mountains.”
“Around this cliff hillside lay tens of thousands of dead Mutated Creatures, primarily Level 1 and Level 2, with a few Level 3 and Level 4.”
“Judging by the decomposing flesh and blood beneath many of the bodies, they estimated these creatures died about ten days ago, and all were killed by the bombardment of heavy weapons.”
“That’s also the reason I’m sure about the source of the Blood Evil Qi he carries.”
“…So many corpses.” Looking at the overhead shot from a distance, many Sixth Layer Heaven, even Seventh-level high-order powerhouses felt a shock to their hearts.
They had not expected Jack Clark to be so formidable at that time, slaying so many Mutated Creatures in a single night; no wonder he was able to sweep through the entire southern battlefield today.
And the so-called Million Bloody Qi refers to a quantity of Blood Qi equivalent to that of a million people, not that he actually had to kill a million people.
Under normal conditions, a single Level 1 Mutated Creature’s Blood Qi is more than a dozen times that of ordinary people, and the Blood Qi contained in Level 2 and Level 3 Variant Beasts is even more terrifying.
That’s why the Blood Evil Qi on Jack Clark is so intense.
However, this method of condensing War Intent is not something that ordinary people can learn.
Merely slaying over ten thousand Mutated Creatures would exhaust an advanced cultivator and even a Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator wouldn’t be able to fight continuously for so long.
As for Jack Clark… he’s a freak, his combat strength far exceeding his realm, to not mention his endurance, which is like that of a god elephant that knows no fatigue.
The reason for such a thorough investigation is because Jack Clark’s performance is too dazzling.
Faced with such a genius, the officials will grant more permissions, information, and provide more precious high-level resources; naturally, they do not wish to nurture a problem child or have an enemy’s spy infiltrating.
After confirming there were no issues with Jack Clark, the next discussion was about the treatment and privileges to be granted.
Meanwhile, the Red Large Characters flashing on all Martial School Base large screens changed.
“Heavy State Martial Height, Jack Clark defeats the top twenty-three contenders of the Achievement List in a joint assault from ranks one to twenty- three, claiming the title of the first person among the younger generation in the Southern Cultivation World.”
“Becoming the first First Grade cultivation student to crown the top rank of the Achievement List, Unrivaled Divine Might, Unparalleled Under Heaven.”
In an instant, everyone at the Martial School Base, waiting anxiously, was in an uproar.
“What, it was a siege!”
“That’s terrifying, to defeat twenty-something opponents in the late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, even at their peak, he truly lives up to the name of Unparalleled Under Heaven.”
“Is this guy really a first-year student, are we sure he’s not a king-level expert starting over?”
In that moment, every Martial Arts School Base on the entire southern battlefield fell silent, staring in disbelief at the Red Large Characters flashing on the large screens.
At South Sky Martial Height Base, Justin Welan clenched his fist tightly and shouted excitedly, “Jack was so cool this time, claiming the title of the first among the southern younger generation, he actually did it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 198 Unparalleled Under Heaven, Top-tier Secret Manual (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 198 Unparalleled Under Heaven, Top-tier Secret Manual (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339 |
“Yeah, at first I thought he was just joking,” Mullen Weisz said excitedly, his face flushing red.
Zac Maben looked envious. “All I care about is whether there are beautiful girls screaming at the scene.11
White Veil said sourly, “We’re all cultivators, not those silly little girls outside. How could we possibly scream.”
Just as he finished speaking, a second-grade senior sister nearby let out an excited scream: “Ah… Junior Clark is so handsome, I really like him.” “Hahahaha…”
Instantly, Justin Welan and several of the guys burst into laughter, slapping White Veil’s shoulder hard.
Meanwhile, far away, the Lewis sisters, Crystal and Mandy, were staring at the shining red large characters, so shocked by the achievement that they didn’t know what to say.
Brothers, let’s go, a full spread on the back mountain barbecue street! Today, I, Gale Campbell, am very happy. All the green-scaled rabbit meat is free. Eat all you want.”
“My Tom Raeeves’ secret red-cooked grilled bear paw is also free today. I had five left over from yesterday, first come first served.”
“You’ve got the nerve to offer leftovers?”
What’s there to be ashamed of? I freeze them with ice after cooking. If someone orders, I’ll serve it, ioo% hygienic and clean.”
“Haha… Not bad, everyone’s excited today. My stall’s super grilled pork trotters all at 20% off.”
“20% off, that’s practically nothing.”
“Exactly, Gale Campbell and Tom Raeeves are both offering free meals today, and you’re being so stingy.”
“Nonsense, theirs are Level 1 Mutated Creatures. Can they compare with my Level 3 mountain-rumbling scale-armored pigs? One of my pig trotters is bigger than a water tank; if I offered it for free, I’d go broke!”
“Let’s go, have a drink together.”
“Tonight, we’re not going home unless we’re drunk.”
“If you want to eat barbecue all night just say so. ‘Not going home unless we’re drunk,’ it’s all ten-degree fruit wine, you can’t get drunk on that.”
“Hahahaha…”
This night was destined to be a sleepless one for many.
Due to the shock and it being late at night, no one paid attention to the First- grade Talent Rankings on the big screen after they dispersed, where Clark’s cultivation had been updated to late-stage Fifth Layer Heaven.
And a day after slaughtering all of his peers and ascending to the top, Clark did not flaunt his achievements as many had speculated. Instead, he quietly returned to South Sky Martial Arts School in the middle of the night.
While Justin Welan and the others were excitedly eating barbecue and drinking fruit wine, he applied for a Personal Cultivation Room and went back to closed- door cultivation.
He had just condensed the battle intent of Blood Prison and needed to solidify it, while also getting accustomed to this special power that was different from True Strength, Will, and spirit.
While Clark was in closed-door cultivation, the next day the school announced that the stable information network for Cloud Mist Mountain Range was complete, and the missions were categorized by levels.
The Nine Rings Mountain Range was divided into Level 1 and Level 2, the outer regions of Cloud Mist were Level 3, the middle section Level 4, and the deep areas Level 5.
All students could compare their own strengths against the danger levels and enter the mountains. Meanwhile, the Sky Base Satellite Group would increase surveillance over the entire Southern Battlefield.
Suddenly, most of the students above Third Layer Heaven got excited. In half a day, they formed over a thousand small squads, streaming into Cloud Mist Mountain Range in droves.
Cloud Mist had been sealed for many years and contained countless resources.
The few students who normally entered could hardly discover much.
Now with Martial Cultivation Teachers’ squads clearing out the high-level alien beasts and complete information coverage, as long as one is cautious, it’s a virtual treasure trove for pioneering.
Two days later.
As the door of the Cultivation Room slowly rose, Clark, wearing casual clothes, stepped out.
His hair, having not been trimmed for months, now covered his ears, the bangs parted in a 7:3 ratio concealing his eyebrows, revealing his gentle and jade-like eyes.
His temperament was gentle, showing no trace of the invincible might that he had burst with across the entire battlefield two days prior.
Just then, Clark moved his thoughts and took out his mobile phone from the Sumeru Bracelet.
As expected, the moment he took out his phone, a series of messages appeared, from Justin Welan, Zac Maben, and others, including James Crane.
Clark first tapped on Justin Welan’s voice message.
Jack, we’re off to make money… I mean, to sharpen our skills in the outskirts of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. We’ll catch up with you for barbecue and drinks to celebrate when we’re back.”
“Damn, Clark, are you a monster? Just after one battle you’ve broken through to late-stage Fifth Layer Heaven. How are we supposed to catch up with you?” ” “Jack, when I get back, remember to sign dozens of autographs for me. In a few years when you become a king-level cultivator, I can sell these signatures and make money…”
These guys.” Clark laughed and then opened the text from James Crane.
The content was simple, asking him to drop by the office. It made Clark think of what James Crane had said before, “Is this regarding my future cultivation?” Pondering this, Clark walked towards the teachers’ office building.
“Prodigy Clark, out of closed-door cultivation, huh?”
“Senior, that’s too formal, just call me Jack.”
“Haha, Junior Clark, well done. This time, our South Sky Martial School has also made a name for itself.”
“Morning, genius Clark.”
Along the way, both the second and third-year senior students, as well as the staff, all greeted him warmly, as if the whole world had changed overnight.
Clark was mentally prepared for this scenario and responded with a smile to each greeting.
“You’re here, take a seat.”
In the office, after Clark sat down, James Crane took out a sealed envelope and handed it to him.
Teacher, what’s this?” Clark asked, his curiosity piqued as he took the envelope. As he tore it open, he sensed a warning aura fade away.
Inside the envelope was something resembling an ID card.
Upon opening, it had his brief profile and a mark for Level 6 [Heavenly Talent] identity along with a 36-digit numeric and runic secret key password.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 198 Unparalleled Under Heaven,
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 198 Unparalleled Under Heaven,
Top-tier Secret Manual (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, James Crane said into his mobile phone, “Connection complete,” then put down the phone and turned off the synchronized network camera.
Looking at a puzzled Jack Clark, James Crane explained, “This time you demonstrated Absolute Domination over the younger generation in the Southern Martial Arts World, with a talent that the official assessment has deemed at Generation-Defying Level.”
“Generation-Defying Level is the highest known level for the younger generation. It grants rights equivalent to a High-level cultivator, allowing you to access many pieces of information that were previously unavailable to you.”
“In addition, the official has now granted you permission to browse all Advanced Skill outlines.”
“Of course, you can only browse the outlines. If you wish to practice any other Advanced Skills, you’ll still need to redeem them. This is out of respect for the knowledge of the pioneers.”
“As for the password on the card just now, it’s your future core validation. Destroy it immediately after viewing.”
“In this world, there are myriad abilities, and any form of verification has its loopholes, including fingerprints, irises, and even Mental Fluctuations, but the one thing that cannot be forged is memory.”
“Only you know this key information, as does the Heavenly Core Intelligence Agency. If your login to the Eastern Summer Core Information Database does not match, you will be denied access.”
“In addition, there are some special items that require this password for verification when exchanging for a Top-tier Secret Manual.”
“Such high confidentiality,” Jack Clark said, a bit surprised.
At this point, James Crane continued, “In addition to the privileges, the military has also rewarded you with a Top-tier Secret Manual, which you can practice after reaching the peak of the Six Heavens.”
“A Top-tier Secret Manual.” Jack Clark sat up abruptly.
He was just worrying about where to earn three thousand Merit Value points to exchange for a Top-tier Secret Manual after reaching the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, but now he was directly rewarded with one.
However, James Crane shook his head slightly at this point, “But 1 don’t recommend you practice the Secret Manual right away.”
A look of confusion appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes, “Teacher, why is that?”
Looking at the youth who had become the number one among the younger generation after entering the Alien Beast Battlefield for just one month, James Crane’s eyes held a hint of sentiment, “Because your talent is too good.
“Before the Triplex Heaven, we cultivators mainly temper our bodies and change our physiques. After the Fourth Layer Heaven, we polish True Strength and Will.”
“When we reach the peak of the Sixth Layer, we’ve almost reached the limit of Martial Arts, or rather, the limit of physical martial strength. What comes next is the ‘way,’ the path.”
“What is the ‘way’? Heaven and Earth, all things, all beings are the ‘way,’ but we cannot touch or directly ‘see’ it; hence, the runes.”
“These are something the Human Experts observed from Mythical Giant Beasts and discovered in relics from the mythical world. Each rune contains special power.”
“Though called runes, they are actually manifestations of power. Under a microscope, they are incredibly complex, allowing sentient beings a more direct observation and understanding of the ‘way’.”
“When condensing the True Martial phantom at the Seventh Layer, it is not merely about tracing a rune, but using one complete rune as the core, continuously adding and filtering.”
“A simple analogy is the process of building a house, eventually forming a stronger whole, which, after fusing with the Will, manifests externally to harness the Power of Heaven and Earth.”
“However, the shape of this ‘house’ can be a Mythical Giant Beast, a Giant Dragon, or some construct their human form.”
“Therefore, the Top-tier Secret Manual that suits the creator the best is the one that verifies their own path—the followers just walk the path they’ve created.”
“The True Martial phantom condensed at the Seventh Layer and the True Martial Battle Body at the Eight Layer are both laying the foundation for assaulting the Ninth Heavens, aiming to break through to King-level.”
“Hence, many High-level cultivators find it extremely difficult to progress even a little after breaking through to Eight Layer or Nine Layers.”
“As time goes on, the difference between those paths and them grows wider, making it even more difficult to repair and transform, because the foundation has been set.”
“But you, Jack Clark, are different. With your talent, you can completely carve out your own path; on the contrary, choosing the path of others would be a suboptimal strategy.”
“Even if you eventually break through to King-level relying on your extraordinary talent, you’ll still be among the weakest, because then you would find a greater conflict with that path.”
“Of course, another reason is that the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body’s corresponding Top-tier Secret Manual, the Divine Might of the Godly Dragon Elephant, is incomplete.”
“The Secret Manual corresponding to the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body is incomplete! Why?” Jack Clark’s brows furrowed.
“Because the Senior who created the low-level Dragon Elephant Power and the Advanced Dragon-Elephant Tyrant Body died in combat more than twenty years ago, just after his strength had broken through to the Nine Layers.”
“As a result, the Divine Might and the God Elephant Secret Book he created cover only up to the Ninth Heavens, lacking the rules of the path for later practicing to the peak of Ninth Heaven.”
“By rewarding you with a Top-tier Secret Manual now, the military likely intends for you to prepare in advance and construct your own True Martial Secret Canon.”
“Create my own Top-tier Secret Manual? Teacher, you all seem to think too highly of me,” Jack Clark smiled wryly.
James Crane encouraged, “Jack, you must have confidence in yourself. After all, you’re a genius who managed to reach Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven in First Grade.”
“And your current strength is ‘only’ at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, a long way from the peak of the Sixth Layer. There’s also ample time.”
“Of course, I’m not forcing you to create your own Secret Manual; this is just a reference and suggestion for you.”
“If you reach the Late Sixth Layer Heaven later and still have no idea about creating your own Secret Manual, you can also choose a Secret Manual that fits you to cultivate.”
“Besides, I think you should start considering whether to join the military or one of the Federation’s three departments after graduation, to plan for your future path…”
Afterward, James Crane discussed a few more matters that needed attention, and Jack Clark took his leave.
This time Jack Clark’s privileges were raised by one level, plus a Top-tier Secret Manual, but there were no other substantial rewards.
It may not sound like much, but consider that the value of a Top-tier Secret Manual is tens of thousands of Contribution Points, and that’s only if you have the required access level.
In addition to the intangible benefits of a sixth-level privilege, the consolidated Battle Intent meant that showcasing his talents and sweeping the entire southern battlefield was a huge, blood-earned windfall..

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 199: Mechanical Ascension, Fusion of Man and Beast, The Arrival of the True Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 199: Mechanical Ascension, Fusion of Man and Beast, The Arrival of the True Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
After leaving the office, Jack Clark didn’t return to the dormitory but instead headed to the control room located inside the base.
As the control center for the Alien Beast Battlefield Base, its setup was quite different from that of the school; for instance, there were no reading rooms or libraries, and there was only one line of access for understanding the outside world.
Including networking with the Eastern Summer Core Intelligence Library and the Heavenly Think Tank, only the control room had the capability.
Soon, Jack passed through several security doors and arrived at a control room resembling a large computer lab, where a teacher was idly drinking tea.
Jack greeted him politely before sitting down in front of a computer screen.
Identity Verification, access permissions confirmed; shortly, dozens of options refreshed on the screen.
Compared to before, Jack now had access to more information; for example, clicking on the Skills Category would display a dense list of thousands of Cultivation Methods.
This included Top-tier Secret Manuals.
Of course, these Top-tier Secret Manuals only had their names and several dozen overviews, and applying for their study and practice was more troublesome than for Advanced Skills.
Bypassing the Skills option, Jack clicked on runes.
Immediately the page shifted, and the large screen displayed images of over a hundred complete runes, and thousands of Incomplete Runes, each representing a form of “strength.”
When Jack’s mouse hovered over a rune with the character ‘mountain,’ the image instantly enlarged, revealing its densely complex internal structure.
This ‘mountain’ character appeared to be made up of hundreds, if not thousands, of twisted strokes, quite mysterious and complicated.
“As expected, they’re all the same.” Looking at these rune images, Jack’s gaze flickered.
Having condensed both complete runes and Incomplete Runes, even through the screen, Jack was able to sense a Mysterious Aura emanating from those rune images.
However, compared to the Godly Dragon Elephant he had condensed in his body, these runes seemed much cruder, even those hundred-plus complete runes.
Because all the runes officially released were Basic Runes.
Some of these Basic Runes had decent power, while others only stirred a gentle breeze, or after being condensed, could prevent nightmares, each possessing a strange and varied strength.
Even those Incomplete Runes contained special powers.
In the information provided, despite many Basic Runes and Incomplete Runes having weak power, sometimes a combination of several of the weakest runes could Burst with terrifying strength.
Like the basic codes of a computer, they might seem useless individually, but once programmed, they can become powerful and feature-rich ‘software.’
After browsing through the rune information enthusiastically for a while, Jack logged out and opened the information section, clicking on the introduction to Simon.
Jack had always been curious about the cultivation environment and situation in those two federative empires, which were considered equal to Eastern Summer.
The reason he started by looking at the Simon Empire was naturally because of Freya Louise’s intention to transfer there.
However, as soon as he opened the cultivation information about the Simon Empire, Jack’s face showed a look of surprise, and he began scrolling quickly, soon also opening the information about the Berlin Empire.
Quickly, a complete cultivation structure of the Federation appeared before Jack’s eyes.
The three major empires, or rather the entire Human Federation, were all led by these empires and divided into three cultivation paths: the True Martial Way, the Genetic Path, and the Mechanical Fusion.
Exactly, three paths.
Compared to the purely Martial Cultivation route taken by Eastern Summer and the following major countries, the Berlin Empire took the path of fusing genes from Unique Beasts and even Giant Beasts.
Martial artists there start by practicing special Cultivation Methods, fusing Unique Beast genes, and then continuously cultivating to increase the fusion rate.
Upon breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, they could activate the Unique Beast’s power, transforming and drastically increasing their strength, obtaining a portion of the fused Unique Beast’s power characteristics with formidable combat ability.
However, those who chose this path gradually became less human and had their will impacted by the genes of Mutated Creatures, always running the risk of losing control.
As for Simon, a technologically advanced empire, they pursued the path of cultivators integrating with machinery, with the ultimate goal being… cough, human-machine integration.
For example, mainstream Mechas are made of Transcendent Materials and Mutated Creature materials, combined with mechanical and rune technology, with the cultivator at the core of the battle Mecha.
This method of cultivation is akin to crafting Transcendent Weapons, but with added technological enhancements that can accommodate various combat modules.
These combat modules include power reactors, flight engines, missiles, Machine Guns, offering exceptionally comprehensive performance and formidable firepower.
Thinking up to this point, Jack couldn’t help but recall Freya mentioning that her strength would surge after reaching Late Fourth Layer Heaven.
Equipped with combat gear, could it be wearing a Mecha??
However, these were just basic introductions to Genetic Martial Arts and Mechanical Martial Arts; more detailed information indicated that he could not view them, leaving Jack somewhat regretful.
Although the cultivation systems were different, the Human Alliance was very united within, with high-level information being shared, and the Frontline Battlefields in the mythical world cooperating with each other.
However, among the Low-level cultivators and ordinary human societies, the three major empires were blocking information, which was why Jack had not heard much about these matters before.
The official aim was for purity, to focus the resources and efforts of the three major empires fully on exploring which path was most suitable for the human race.
Decades down the line, the pure True Martial Way has made the furthest progress, with more king-level Top Strong individuals and even a few Supreme Experts emerging, while all three paths have reached their current limits and have been stagnant for years.
Therefore, officials were considering lifting the information blockade to see if they could gather the strength of the entire alliance to break through that invisible Boundary on the existing foundation..

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 199: Mechanical Ascension, Fusion of Man and Beast, The Arrival of the True Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 199: Mechanical Ascension, Fusion of Man and Beast, The Arrival of the True Dragon (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339 |
Perhaps they were already slowly loosening the control of information. Right after the Koroya incident ended, Jack Clark could clearly sense the differences on the internet.
Unfortunately, with Jack Clark’s access level, that was all he could see, and he had no idea to what extent the three paths had been pushed to their limits.
After that, Jack Clark spent half a day in the control room, browsing through many documents that he previously couldn’t access, before finally sitting back in his chair, lost in thought.
He was thinking about the words James Crane had said to him before.
Should he create a top-tier secret manual that was most suitable for himself, or should he switch to cultivating a top-tier secret manual passed down by another king-level cultivator?
Switching to another manual, with the enhancement characteristic of Attribute points, he could reach the Ninth Heavens faster and more conveniently. It wasn’t impossible to reach the Ninth Heavens or even become king-level within a year.
But the drawbacks were also obvious. Very few who walked the path of others could break through to become king-level, and furthermore, after breaking through to king-level, their combat strength was weak, and progress was difficult.
The reason was that you were cultivating someone else’s path, essentially following a template, knowing what to do but not why.
In the end, when it came time to comprehend Heaven and Earth and use personal understanding to analyze all things to perfect one’s framework, one would realize they didn’t know how to ‘add’ or ‘optimize.’
Even the strengthening from Attribute points couldn’t solve this issue.
Otherwise, Jack Clark wouldn’t have needed any complementary Cultivation Methods earlier and could have directly inferred the fourth layer of the Dragon Elephant Power for his breakthrough.
Nor would he have opted for the Limit Strengthen Dragon Elephant Overlord Body and condensed runes this time. Instead, he would have directly inferred the seventh layer Cultivation Method and condensed the true martial arts phantom.
During this time, Jack Clark had almost figured out the characteristics of Attribute points.
That is the enhancement of known ‘entities.’
For example, the Cultivation Method is a known ‘entity’ that has been created, so one can continue to strengthen and breakthrough according to the method layer by layer, even to the extreme.
Beyond that, the same applied to battle armor, weapons, the Sumeru Bracelet, and even talents evolved from flesh and body—they could all be strengthened. But when it came to the elusive and vague, involving the comprehension of the realm of thought, including Power of Will, it didn’t work.
The Power of Intent, honing one’s own willpower, was transformed from Spirit Power. While it could slightly contribute to the breakthrough of Cultivation Methods, it couldn’t be the direct object of enhancement.
Every time the Power of Will was enhanced during a breakthrough, it was because Jack Clark’s consciousness integrated with the Dragon Elephant Phantom to hone and comprehend.
As for Battle Intent and Sword Intent, Attribute points almost had no response at all.
This was why, after condensing Prison Blood War Intent, no + sign appeared afterwards.
Including the Heart’s Eye Realm, it also fell into stagnation after losing the known Cultivation Method inferences, unable to strengthen ‘Cut through the Void’ into a complete rune.
Can I really create a top-tier secret manual?
A question arose in Jack Clark’s mind.
Actually, it wasn’t impossible.
He already had the complete Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune, and next, he just needed to refer to the God Elephant Secret Book, which could cultivate up to the Nine Layers.
Then, combining his own True Martial Attribute, body, and Will, he could create a ‘path’ that completely matched him.
If other cultivators could slowly carve out their path to become king-level, he could equally create a top-tier secret manual to serve as the foundation for his aspire to the throne.
Especially in this era, which was different from the past, creating secret manuals was much less difficult, and the reason was that there were many Cultivation Methods for reference.
For instance, those Advanced Cultivation Methods, each representing a microcosm of a rune structure at their core.
Add to that, he was only at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven and still had an entire Major Realm until the peak of the Sixth Heavens, so there was ample time to perfect and create his own secret manual.
Of course, one shouldn’t be blindly arrogant.
So, just as James Crane said, Jack Clark also made a backup plan. If the secret manual was still nowhere to be seen by the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, he would directly choose another manual as his foundation.
Having made his decision, Jack Clark took a deep breath and opened the Secret Catalog.
“Confirm the application for the top-tier secret manual, Divine Might Dragon Elephant?”
“Yes,” Jack Clark clicked confirm.
“Your manual application has been uploaded. Please wait patiently for Federal Headquarters to notify you. The Secret Rubbing Version of the manual will be delivered within half a month at the latest.”
Whew! Jack Clark exhaled deeply, then stood up and strode out of the control room.
There were many things he still had to do next.
Such as the second casting of the extraordinary battle armor and Transcendent Weapon, and also enhancing the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd to the limit, to condense Battle Skill Runes.
Then, after breaking through to the Sixth Layer, acquiring the top-tier secret manual, he would need to consider his next steps.
By now, the Southern Battlefield was of little help for the significant improvement of his strength in the future.
When Jack Clark entered the Cloud Mist Mountain Range again, he was astonished to find that the peripheries were swarming with cultivator teams hunting Unique Beasts and gathering resources.
Even in the middle areas, numerous teams from the Late Period of Fourth Layer Heaven joined forces to battle against large Level 5 Alien Beasts in a brutal fight.
Clearly, stimulated by him, these students had experienced a renaissance… No, their passion for cultivation had been ignited.
Seeing this, Jack Clark shook his head slightly, his figure flashed as he continued to rush towards the deeper sections of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, because along the way, he hadn’t encountered a single level 5 or higher Alien Beast.
From setting out at noon until evening, after traveling over two thousand kilometers, Jack Clark once again delved deep into the latter section of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
“Hey hey hey!! Calling Black Bird 2, this is Pigeon, have you found anything on your end?”
“Hehe, I found a Phantom Fog Nine Leaf Ginseng here. It’s about a month away from flowering. I’ve uploaded the data and put it on sale.”
“Damn! How can you be so lucky?”

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 199: Mechanical Ascension, The Unity of Man and Beast, The Coming of the True Dragon (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 199: Mechanical Ascension, The Unity of Man and Beast, The Coming of the True Dragon (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339 I
Denny Lockwood hung up the communication with envy and jealousy, and then dialed another channel, “Hello! Hello!! Calling Sky-Piercing Monkey, please respond if you receive.”
“Sky-Piercing Monkey received, Dove, have you found anything on your side?”
Denny Lockwood said with pride, “I’ve discovered a trail of a Level 5 Alien Beast ahead of me, already sold it. What about you? Do you have any shareable information?”
“I haven’t found anything good here yet.”
“All right then.”
Just as Denny Lockwood ended the call, he suddenly felt something and his figure flashed, appearing tens of meters away.
“Senior Lockwood, such a cautious reaction,” Jack Clark said, showing a look of surprise from where Denny Lockwood had just stood more than ten meters away under a large tree.
Of course, what surprised him wasn’t Denny Lockwood’s burst of speed, but the other’s subconscious reaction.
When he intentionally released a wisp of aura, Denny Lockwood, sensing something behind him, didn’t turn around but moved away from his original position first.
“So it’s Junior Clark, you gave me quite a shock. I thought it was some powerful creature approaching, the sense of danger was so intense,” Denny Lockwood said, relieved.
Jack Clark smiled, “Senior, do you have any resource information at hand now?”
He hadn’t found even one Alien Beast above level five all along the way, which left Jack Clark rather vexed.
Denny Lockwood shook his head, “I’ve only been deep in the mountain ranges for half a day, I don’t have any high-value information at hand yet. If we’re unlucky, it might take ten days to half a month to get any worthwhile findings.”
“Alright, if Senior Lockwood comes across a Level 6 Alien Beast or a Twisted Secret Realm later, let me know, we can negotiate a good price…”
“No problem Junior Clark, I’ll definitely notify you first when the time comes.” After saying goodbye to Denny Lockwood, Jack Clark vanished into the depths of the mist-shrouded forest.
And just as Jack Clark was preparing to continue improving himself,
Outside, the invasion disturbance caused by the Evil God Sect was getting fiercer.
To invade the Alien Beast Battlefield and position in the hard-to-monitor depths of the battlefield, not only detailed information was required, but also precise cross-boundary coordinates.
As a large resource point controlled by the countries, the Alien Beast Battlefield has always been strictly supervised, and obtaining the spatial coordinates of these overlapping zones was not so simple.
Thus, following the reverse inference, some clues were followed like a vine to apprehend the culprits.
Five days later, the Simon Empire.
A small sci-fi styled aircraft over ten meters long was flying at high speed and low altitude over a wasteland.
But at that moment, a series of lights shone in the distance, and surface-to-air missiles shot towards them at an even greater speed, emitting a sharp whistling sound.
“Not good, they’ve caught up,” said a middle-aged man inside the aircraft, his complexion changing slightly as he instantly willed the sci-fi styled small aircraft to abruptly soar skyward.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
Seven missiles soared past from below, long trails of exhaust left behind in the air as white smoke, and then the missiles also rose to the sky following their target.
Under the dual locking of energy and infrared, the small aircraft had no chance of evading the pursuit of these tracking missiles.
The man inside knew this and as soon as the aircraft surged to a thousand meters high, he suddenly controlled the aircraft to turn around, diving towards the earth like a somersaulting meteor.
An instant later, the pursuing missiles reaching a thousand meters had also drawn an inverse U-shape in the sky, diving down towards the earth.
One, two, three…
Watching the earth quickly enlarging until it filled his vision, Alan counted to three in his mind and suddenly pulled with both hands.
In an instant, the aircraft lifted its nose ten meters from the ground, barely skimming over the wasteland and shooting forward, the shockwave of its rapid flight kicking up billowing smoke and dust on the ground.
Boom boom boom boom!!
The missiles descending from the sky were unable to turn in time, each one hitting the ground causing violent explosions and forming giant fireballs.
Just as Alan breathed a sigh of relief for dodging those missile locks, his expression suddenly changed as three fighter aircraft, brimming with a sci-fi aesthetic, had already surrounded him.
At the same time, the large-caliber machine guns on the wings of the fighter aircraft lit up, and in an instant, a barrage of machine gun bullets roared out. Not good!
Boom boom boom boom!!
Fifty-millimeter armor-piercing Explosive Bullets hit the ground, causing an Instantaneous Explosion and creating a path of destruction that chased after the flying vehicle before rushing into the canyon ahead.
Just as he fell into the canyon, the rune patterns on Alan’s flying vehicle lit up.
Then, with a series of crackle and crunches like a transforming robot, it morphed into a ten-meter tall gray Mecha.
At the same time, the three pursuing fighter jets also transformed as they landed, crackling and morphing into towering fifteen-meter tall fierce Mechas. Huff huff!! With engines spewing hot gusts of air from behind, the three Mechas landed at three different points along the edge of the canyon, surrounding Alan below.
Unlike the Mechas in sci-fi movies, these four were covered in various Rune Patterns, with many parts indicating materials from Mutated Creatures.
Inside the three Mechas sat three cultivators, each radiating a formidable aura, their True Strength and consciousness merged with the Mechas.
A silver Mecha, armed with a machine gun on the shoulder, a fifteen-meter sword in hand, and missiles at its waist, emitted a humming vibration, “Alan, you cannot escape. It’s best you surrender.”
“This time, your family, including the Wallace Group, will be uprooted. No one will escape settlement, and any who dare betray the Human Race are doomed to die.”
Alan’s face turned ugly, “The possibility of me surrendering is impossible.”
“Jeremy, stop wasting words with him, just kill him.”
Accompanied by the red Mecha’s commanding tone, the battle erupted in an instant…
The Berlin Empire.
Roar roar roar!!
The dilapidated martial arts hall was littered with corpses, and a five-meter tall creature, resembling a human but covered in scale armor and with a face half-human, half-tiger, was surrounded by four military-adorned figures.
At this moment, all five were exuding powerful auras, especially the four in military attire, whose aura was even stronger, and each showed some non-human features.
Such as scale armor growing on their faces, a pair of curved horns protruding from their heads, or possessing double claws that were sharply honed.
Surrounded by four equals, the Tiger Man displayed a look of despair, “I beg you, please spare my son; he’s only five years old and has nothing to do with what happened.”
“Whether he’s involved or not is for the higher-ups to decide, but you, the Tiger Roar Martial Arts Hall, conspired with the Evil God Sect to sell information and betrayed the Human Race, and there’s no denying that.” “Next, I shall execute you in the name of the Special Warfare Bureau, including everyone associated with this incident.”
“No, I only shared some insignificant information; you can’t sentence us to death.”
“Hmph! Because of the information you sold, this incident led to the deaths of over a dozen highly talented students in our country, executing you here is already a leniency.”
“What! Only a dozen died?” Tiger Man’s face showed shock and unwillingness.
“Kill him!”
The Eastern Summer Empire, Intelligence Department.
“Report, a secret line has been discovered within our nation, with two found in both the Cross Mountain Country and the Hundred Foxes Nation, all of which have been eradicated.”
“This event involved 173 individuals, and four ordinary companies with Transcendent talent, infiltrated when traveling to and from the mythical world.”
“The information has already been relayed to the base on the other side, and we will increase screening efforts moving forward.”
The dignified middle-aged man at the head nodded slowly, “Continue to closely monitor all parties moving forward. As for this incident, it’s not worth worrying about too much.”
“The Civilization War has fully erupted for a dozen or twenty years now; mutual infiltration between us and the Purgatory Demon Race is inevitable.”
As the human Inner World was being purged of traitors and spies, deep in the ocean, a Single-horned Tiger Kingfish in search of good treasures encountered a ‘dragon.’
Or rather, it had caught the attention of a terrifying ‘dragon..’

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 200: Creating the Giant Beast Secret Book, the Dragon with King-level Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 200: Creating the Giant Beast Secret Book, the Dragon with King-level Bloodline
Translator: 549690339
A hundred meters deep under the sea, the water shimmered.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had grown to a length of fifty-five meters, its body covered with thick black scales, and the two thick fins underneath its belly, looking like an ancient young kingfish.
It exuded a powerful aura in the Late Level 7, wrapped in ancient desolation, which spread invisibly for thousands of meters, causing countless mutated creatures to flee madly.
But the single-horned Tiger Kingfish looked as if facing a formidable enemy at this moment.
Over two hundred meters ahead, a seventy-meter-long giant dragon, covered in silver scale armor like a western mythical ancient dragon, was quietly watching it.
Terrifying majesty emanated from its golden dragon eyes.
Yes, a giant dragon.
Unlike dragon-type mutated creatures like the Thunderflame Behemoth that evolved step by step from ordinary mutated creatures, regressed, and reversed their bloodline, this was a real dragon.
The robust body, long and stout limbs, sharp claws, strong and tenacious tail, and fierce skull were almost identical to those of ancient dragons described in Western mythology.
In addition, it radiated a terrifying Dragon Might, as if a substantial pressure was rolling up waves of air, with a raging wind howling on the sea surface.
Roar!
Suddenly, the silver giant dragon let out a roar, and the deep dragon chant resounded under the sea. As it flapped its dragon wings, the surrounding seawater went into a frenzy in an instant.
Boom!
A hundred-meter-wide underwater tsunami roared, curling up a huge momentum and rushing toward the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish. In the violent seawater, ice spears tens of meters long emerged, giving off an astonishing chill.
Woo!
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out a deep horn-like sound, and its black hole-like mouth gaped open in anger. In an instant, the icy tsunami collapsed, torn by the huge vortex that appeared in the center.
Biu!
The moment the icy tsunami broke, a black and white light beam erupted from the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s head, piercing through the wild seawater in an instant and landing on the silver giant dragon’s head.
And then… there was no reaction.
Chirp! Chirp!! Why is my energy attack so weak?
The Single-horned tiger Kingfish felt very speechless.
It had always been envious of the scorching breath ability of the Thunderflame Behemoth.
This should be the reason why it could evolve a single-horned energy attack during its ancient evolution.
Unfortunately, the talent at the low level was still too weak.
Woo!
Thinking of this, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out a deep call, and the powerful black and white strength burst out from its body, forming a huge whale-shaped shield to cover it.
Then the enormous body suddenly turned around… and ran away.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was not stupid. The power of this dragon-type giant beast was not weaker than Thunderflame. Its strength was terrifying, coupled with the suppression of levels, so it was time to run.
Seeing this, the distant silver giant dragon that thought the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish would burst out its power and fight revealed a hint of anger in its eyes.
Roar!
The giant dragon spread its wings and, in an instant, its huge body soared into the sky, stirring up huge waves and appearing on the sea surface. With a shake of its wings, it instantly dashed thousands of meters away.
Boom!
From the sky, the silver giant dragon, who had caught up with the
Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, descended, causing an explosion on the sea surface, and rings of white seawater shockwaves blasted open.
The speed of the silver giant dragon was terrifying. In the blink of an eye, its vast body pierced through the seawater and appeared above the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which was three hundred meters underwater, and its double claws fell.
Boom!
Under the blow of the Eighth-Level Giant Dragon, the terrifying strength burst out, shattering the black and white shield of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which could withstand the attack of ordinary Eighth-Level Giant Beast.
Thump!
The enormous dragon claw landed on the back of the Tiger Kingfish, and the nearly fifty-meter-long Tiger Kingfish was slammed a thousand meters deep into the seabed.
The seabed shook, the earth collapsed, and countless mire and sand rolled up.
Woo!
The single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with its broken back scales, roared out furiously as its fierce nature was provoked. The powerful energy within its body exploded once again, creating another black and white shield outside its body.
At the thickest part of the shield in front of it, a huge sharp horn appeared, and the vast body of the Tiger Kingfish blasted through the sea water, rushing toward the silver giant dragon above it.
Roar!
Watching the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish rushing toward it, the silver giant dragon let out an excited roar, reaching out with its enormous claws covered in white power without dodging.
Boom!
At the moment when the giant dragon grasped the solidified single horn on the tiger kingfish’s head, a shockwave formed by pure power burst out in the deep sea, rolling up an endless white spree like a nuclear explosion, continuously expanding.
Roar! The silver giant dragon’s double claws muscles swelled, erupting with indescribable terrifying strength, slowly suppressing the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
Crack! With the terrible force of the giant dragon, cracks appeared on the huge single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s head, including the heavy shield.
Boom!
Under the unrivaled domineering power, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was slammed into the seabed by the giant dragon once again, with countless broken stones and dirt mixing with seawater splashing around, creating an astonishing momentum.
Woo! The horned tiger kingfish instantly became more furious, letting out a raging roar.
Boom! Boom! Boom! BOOM!!
In the thousands of meters deep sea, the intense battle between the two giant beasts caused a tempestuous scene, with terrifying cold aura and vortex that tore everything, exploding continuously.
At this moment, endless white light burst from the center of the battlefield, instantly freezing a sea area of over two hundred meters in range and turning it into a turbid underwater ice mountain.
But just then, a terrifying power burst from deep within the ice mountain, creating huge cracks.
Bang! With the shattering of the ice mountain and the seawater pouring in, the fierce battle broke out again, with the giant beast roaring and the seabed trembling.
But this time, it calmed down quickly.
In the center of the raging seawater, surrounded by some floating ice, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with its broken scales all over its body and weakened aura, was pinned to the sea floor by the silver giant dragon’s double claws, unable to move.
Roar! Roar! Roar!!
The silver giant dragon suppressing the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out an excited roar, the deep dragon chant spreading for tens of kilometers, and countless mutated creatures fled in panic under its Dragon Might..

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 200: Creating the Giant Beast Secret Manual, the Giant Dragon with Royal Bloodline_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 200: Creating the Giant Beast Secret Manual, the Giant Dragon with Royal Bloodline_2
Translator: 549690339 |
It’s over, wife, I’m doomed.
