If I had listened to Thunderflame and ate more good food to become stronger, maybe I could have run away today.
Alas, my kids haven’t grown up yet…
Just as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was lying weakly on the seabed, thinking about how miserable its wife and children would be after it was eaten…
The Silver Giant Dragon roared: Roar! You have been defeated by the great and noble Sethia. Seeing that you have impressive strength, I, the great one now give you two choices.
Either submit yourself to the Great Sethia or die.
The deep dragon roar spread through the water, containing precise and clear intent in the form of Mental Fluctuation.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was dumbfound and let out an incredulous low cry.
Whimper! You’re not going to eat me?
Roar! What would the Great Sethia do with you? You look like you have rough skin and thick meat which isn’t appetizing? The Silver Giant Dragon looked at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish beneath its claw with a strange look. Whimper! If you’re not going to eat me, why did you beat me up? The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was instantly confused.
Roar! You have traces of ancient creatures on you, your strength seems decent, and you qualify to be the first subordinate of Sethia in this world.
Roar! As an Extraordinary Species, being chosen by the Great Sethia is the supreme honor. Celebrate for it.
Having said that, the Silver Giant Dragon released the claw on the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with its ferocious head slightly raised, and its silver-golden vertical pupils filled with arrogance.
However… the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was even more baffled when released.
No, if you want to recruit me as your subordinate, you should ask, right?
How would 1 know if I’m willing to follow you if you don’t ask?
You just charged at me and beat me up. I’m so miserable, sob…
Thinking about this, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish felt really sorry for itself.
But amidst the misfortune of today, there was some surprise. It didn’t expect that this terrifying Dragon Beast would be different from Thunderflame—it didn’t eat ‘beasts’.
Seeing the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish daydreaming, the Silver Giant Dragon said impatiently: Roar! Extraordinary creature, answer the Great Sethia, do you choose to submit or die?
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish hurriedly nodded.
Whimper! I choose to submit, but I need to go back and inform my big brother first. Otherwise, if I’m gone for too long, he would worry about me.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was not a fool. Under such circumstances, it naturally chose to compromise first and then led it to find Thunderflame.
Hehe!! I will have Thunderflame kill you then.
Roar! You have a big brother?
The Silver Giant Dragon looked at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish with suspicious eyes. It felt that the Extraordinary Creature had some bad thoughts.
Whimper! Yes, he is somewhat more formidable than me.
Roar! Has it evolved traces of ancient creatures like you too? The Silver Giant Dragon was a little surprised.
Whimper! Yes, even more so than me.
Roar! Lead the way. Great Sethia wants to subdue it. The Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly.
It didn’t expect its luck to be so good. It had just arrived in this world not long ago and had already encountered two Extraordinary Creatures with traces of ancient creatures.
Soon, the Great Sethia would have an army of ancient creatures, ruling over this world.
Whimper! I need to rest a bit; my body hurts too much.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale lay on the seabed, unwilling to budge.
This time its injuries were severe, many of its scale armor broken, its Qi Blood weak, and its tail swaying in pain with every movement.
Roar! How useless, you can’t stand such a small injury! Given that you have already submitted, the Great Sethia will carry you part of the way.
Saying that, the Silver Giant Dragon stretched out its huge claw, grabbed the Tiger Kingfish’s fin, and with a powerful thrust of its Dragon Wings, burst forward at an astonishing speed.
As they moved, sea waves swelled, stirring up turbulent currents.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s speed reached 300 kilometers per hour, even while carrying a Tiger Kingfish that weighed several thousand tons. It was terrifying.
This time, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had swum far away, and it took about three hours for the two giant beasts to return to the deserted island.
By now, the Tiger Kingfish’s injuries had healed somewhat, no longer bleeding and only appearing ragged with one large piece missing and some collapsed scale armor.
Whimper! Lord Sethia, we’re here.
On the sea surface, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish led the way to the deserted island. They soon saw the three little Tiger Whales playing around the island and the Female Killer Whale swimming nearby, watching over their offspring.
Whimper! Looking at the broken-scaled Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the four Tiger Whales quickly swam over, calling out worriedly.
Buzz!
The four Tiger Whales instantly stiffened upon approaching within a range of hundreds of meters, due to the invisible Dragon Might emanating from behind.
In contrast to the ancient-evolved Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the ordinary mutated Tiger Whales faced a real Silver Giant Dragon, and that kind of suppression coming from a higher species level made them instinctively afraid and want to submit.
Whimper! Don’t be afraid; this is Lord Sethia.
Roar! This is the ancient-evolved creature you mentioned?
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes showed a hint of anger. It felt deceived, and an even more fierce aura spread out in an instant.
Whimper! No, this is my wife, and those are my children. My big brother is someone else. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish hurriedly explained.
Roar! You better not have lied to the Great Sethia. The consequences would be very serious.
Boom!
At this point, a fierce aura erupted from the island, as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle sensed the powerful aura on the sea.
Bang! The surface of the water burst open, and a Deep Sea Dragon Turtle 57-meters long and over 30-meters tall, like a small hill, burst out from the water..

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 200: Creation of the Giant Beast Secret Book, The Giant Dragon with a King-level Bloodline_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 200: Creation of the Giant Beast Secret Book, The Giant Dragon with a King-level Bloodline_3
Translator: 549690339
With Thunderflame absent and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish out on its patrol, it was responsible for guarding this place.
At this moment, a strong and unfamiliar aura drifted in from the distance as it, the keeper, must unswervingly drive that mutated creature that invaded their territory away.
Roar! Accompanied by a ferocious dragon roar, the earth shook as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle surged towards the beach along the stream with an overwhelming aura.
As its size constantly increased, and its strength improved, after following the Thunderflame Giant Beast to several major events, the once timid and fearful nature of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also underwent changes.
It discovered that it was strong as well, so it had also become braver recently.
Even though that aura was potent, carrying the oppressive might of dragons akin to its own, it was not afraid and rushed forward to fight.
If it couldn’t win, it would retreat back to the island and wait for Thunderflame’s return to join forces and kill the invader.
Bang bang!!
With sea water exploding, the enormous form of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle burst into the sea, charging towards the mutated creature that had entered their territory from several kilometers away.
But just as it had not traveled far, stepping on the seabed, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle halted abruptly, staring in astonishment at the family of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the glimmering Silver Giant Dragon.
Boom boom boom!!
Minutes later, the shell of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was shattered, lying frail and pitifully on the seabed, pinned down by one massive claw of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Roar! You now have two choices, submit to Great Sethia, or die.
At this moment, the equally miserable Single-horned Tiger Kingfish came over to persuade it: Roar! Domination, just submit for now.
Roar roar!! Joe, you traitor, how could you bring such a freakish dragon beast back here and let it beat me?
Roar roar roar!! I never intended to let Great Sethia hit you, but it acted too quickly before 1 could speak.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was somewhat speechless.
The Silver Giant Dragon, left hanging on the side, became somewhat impatient and growled: Roar! Sea Turtle, you haven’t answered Great Sethia’s question.
Roar roar!! I submit, I submit. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle hurriedly nodded.
It thought the same as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish – this guy was too strong to beat, so it was better to submit first and wait for Thunderflame’s return to deal with it.
Seeing this, the Silver Giant Dragon nodded in satisfaction, lifting its colossal claw off the back of the Dragon Turtle, and roared at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish: Good, from today onward, you are Great Sethia’s subordinates.
You should feel supremely honored to be under Great Sethia’s command.
Now follow Great Sethia, we will find a suitable place to establish our core territory and begin the conquest of this Indigenous World’s first step.
Roar roar roar!! Wait, Great Sethia, my big brother hasn’t come back yet.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish hastily called out to the Silver Giant Dragon that was about to turn and leave.
Roar! What, this Sea Turtle isn’t your big brother? Surprise showed in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Roar roar!! I’m not a Sea Turtle, I’m a Dragon Turtle. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle corrected in a low roar.
But no beast paid it any attention at the moment.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish shook its head: Roar roar roar!! No, my big brother seems to have gone out too, he’s not home, this one is the third brother, Domination.
Roar roar!! Joe, you lost to me earlier, you’re the third one.
Roar roar roar!! It is clear you lost, hiding underground and not coming out.
Roar roar!! You didn’t beat me, so doesn’t that mean you lost?
Just as the two Giant Beasts were arguing over who was number three, you roaring and I yelping, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a deep dragon roar, “Roar! Stop quarreling. When is your big brother coming back?”
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat excited. It had not expected to encounter not just two ancient creatures but three.
Yelp yelp yelp!! I don’t know.
Roar roar!! He didn’t say.
Roar! The Great Sethia is in a good mood, so let’s just wait here.
With that said, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its double wings vigorously, and with a booming sound, soared into the sky, taking the sea water up hundreds of meters high, and then with a flap of its wings, it flew onto the beach.
Boom! Accompanied by the Giant Dragon’s descent, the Earth exploded in an instant, and innumerable clumps of dirt and gravel shot up tens of meters high.
Compared to the seabed, the Silver Giant Dragon preferred staying above ground.
Meanwhile, at the Headquarters which the Silver Giant Dragon had just overtaken, the Thunderflame Beheamoth was coiled in volcanic magma hundreds of meters deep.
Upon its body, golden flames burned fiercely, erupting and emitting scorching temperatures, melting the surrounding magma into a clear red liquid.
After waiting for so long, two Lava Fire Fruits had finally ripened, which the Thunderflame Beheamoth engulfed in one bite.
Moreover, it seemed the Lava Fire Fruits were of a high level. After consuming so many, the effect hadn’t weakened, boosting the flame power of the Thunderflame Beheamoth once again.
The temperature of the golden flames burning on its body reached a terrifying four thousand degrees Celsius, almost touching the surface temperatures of a star.
However, after eating the Lava Fire Fruits, the Thunderflame Beheamoth did not leave immediately but lay on a heat-resistant rock protrusion on the mountain wall and extended its right claw.
Currently, within the Thunderflame Beheamoth, a powerful realm of thought drove the Qi Blood, which mixed with the Flame Power, continuously condensed and compressed until slowly, a rune began to take shape.
Jack Clark had confirmed that the Thunderflame Beheamoth couldn’t cultivate human Cultivation Methods.
But it couldn’t cultivate Cultivation Methods, yet it could cultivate the Secret Skill of condensing runes.
Therefore, ever since Jack had obtained the permissions to view all Basic and Incomplete Runes, he had been testing whether the Thunderflame Beheamoth could directly condense runes.
He also wanted to know if these directly condensed runes would help it.
Now, after several days of continuous cultivation, the chosen Basic Rune representing “Storage” had been outlined thousands of times and was finally about to successfully condense.
Hum!
As the ‘Storage’ rune condensed successfully, many red patterns emerged on a piece of scale armor on the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s right claw, and instantly, waves of scorching power swarmed around it.
Including the golden flames burning on its body, they also converged toward that piece of scales, and then… disappeared.
Sensing that piece of scales storing energy equivalent to a blow from the Third Layer Heaven, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s mouth corners subtly lifted, revealing a ferocious smile.
Because these directly condensed Basic Runes were effective for it.
In that case, by continuously exploring and combining, it could construct some complete runes that could enhance its strength or even create a Giant Beast Level Top-tier Secret Manual for itself.
Through the manual, it could integrate its Seven Talents into one to form a Beast Battle Body. How strong would its fighting power become then?
Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s eyes revealed a look of anticipation.
However, creating a Secret Manual was difficult, let alone a Cultivation Method that could be trained by a Giant Beast. This wasn’t something that could be accomplished overnight.
So it was better to focus on increasing its level first.
With that thought, the Black-red Colossal Beast, measuring fifty-nine meters in length and on the verge of breaking through to level eight, shot out of the volcano with a boom, causing rolling hot sea waves and heading towards the desert island..

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 201: War of Myths, Innate Runes,
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 201: War of Myths, Innate Runes,
Dragon King Tim Abott (Requesting Monthly Votes)
Translator: 549690339
Hundreds of meters deep, the black-red ferocious Unique Beast, having concealed its flames, moved swiftly through the water like a torpedo, with astonishing speed.
However, when the Thunderflame Behemoth approached the desert island, a touch of confusion showed in its golden vertical pupils.
Because it felt a powerful Dragon Might from afar, yet it didn’t belong to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, as that one wasn’t as strong.
When the figure of the black-red ferocious giant beast appeared below the deep sea, both the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle excitedly rushed over.
Roar! Thunderflame, there’s a tough guy waiting for you on the island; we both got beaten up by it.
Roar! Thunderflame, kill it, that thing is atrocious, it came up and gave me a severe beating.
Roar! What on earth is going on? Confusion flashed in the eyes of the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Under normal conditions, battles between Mutated Creatures are extremely brutal and bloody, usually ending in either fleeing in defeat or getting killed and eaten.
Yet, looking at these two, although they were severely injured, the other party hadn’t killed them; instead, it let them swim around in the sea.
Roar! Earlier, when I was in the Outer Sea looking for good stuff, I ran into that guy…
After that, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish went into detail about what happened after encountering the Silver Giant Dragon, such as how it was severely beaten and then it wanted to subdue them and others.
Once finished, both the Tiger Kingfish and the Dragon Turtle looked at the Thunderflame Behemoth with hopeful eyes, wanting its help to get revenge. Roar! I got it, I’ll go up and take a look.
The Thunderflame Behemoth nodded slightly and then swam towards the sandy beach.
As the leader, it had to intervene after the Tiger Kingfish and Dragon Turtle were attacked; otherwise, the hard-gathered subordinates would quickly disband.
It was also curious about the dragon beast that had appeared, which had the audacity to subdue numerous Giant Beasts to establish an ’empire.’
Such a notion is rare among ordinary Mutated Creatures, even those Level 9 Giant Beasts don’t have the concept of a ‘country’ in their thoughts.
As the Thunderflame Behemoth drew closer, the sea surface outside the sandy beach bulged quickly, followed by a loud splash of water, as a ferocious giant beast stood up from the sea surface.
Water cascading down the thirty-odd meters tall Thunderflame Behemoth’s body through the crevices of its thick scale armor formed spectacular waterfalls.
Roar!
As the black-red ferocious giant beast stood up from the sea surface, the Silver Giant Dragon on the beach originally lounging nonchalantly suddenly stood erect as a powerful Dragon Might burst forth from it.
Crushing, palpable pressure spread in waves of white, creating a whirling wind that swept a hundred-meter radius, with astonishing momentum.
Yet at this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon’s expression was somewhat grave, as it felt a strong sense of danger emanating from the black-red dragon beast.
Although it was smaller in size compared to it, in the world of giant beasts, strength cannot be solely judged by size.
At that moment, not only Scythia was grave, but the Thunderflame Behemoth was also solemn.
Because this silver dragon beast… no, the Silver Giant Dragon was very strong, and the Thunderflame Behemoth even sensed a terrifying aura of a king-level bloodline.
The other was not only a Dragon-type Giant Beast, but it also possessed a king-level bloodline.
And unlike the golden-backed violent ape and the Blood Armored Beast King, which only had a trace of reverting to its King-level bloodline, this Silver Giant Dragon carried a very pure and noble bloodline.
It was a descendant of a Mythical Creature, not belonging to this world.
Besides, as a member of the dragon species, the combination of factors made it incredibly strong and terrifying.
Without even engaging in combat, the Thunderflame Behemoth had already gauged the power of its opponent.
Hot breath steamed out from the nostrils of the Thunderflame Behemoth, and whoosh, a golden red flame ignited on its body, the terrifying temperature of 4,000 Celsius instantly evaporating the surrounding air.
An instant later, the sea water beneath its feet boiled, dividing due to the scorching flames and moving in all directions, accompanied by copious white steam.
Facing the king-blooded giant dragon, even the Thunderflame Behemoth dared not underestimate it.
Boom!
A savage and terrifying aura erupted from the Thunderflame Behemoth, and even more so, thick blue lightning jumped between the fins on its back.
The dazzling golden flames surrounded it, and thunder leaped upon its body; at this moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth was like a Mythical Creature, grandiose and imposing.
Instantly the Tiger Whales and Dragon Turtles in the depths became excited.
Roar! Thunderflame, go for it, it beat me up so badly earlier.
Roar! Exactly, hit it, hit it hard.
As companions, they knew just how terrifying Thunderflame was; regardless of its small size, it was mighty and could easily kill beasts much larger than itself, as easy as drinking water.
Just as the fight was about to break out, the Silver Giant Dragon suddenly growled, “Are you the big brother they spoke of?”
The Thunderflame Behemoth let out a low growl: Roar! Correct.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared.
“You’re very strong, I can feel that. How about it, are you interested in joining forces with the Great Sethia to turn this Indigenous World into a realm for the Giant Beasts?”
…The Thunderflame Behemoth was speechless, knowing all too well the deep waters behind this world.
Building a realm for the Giant Beasts in this world? Likely you’ll be suppressed by those Human Experts before you can make any significant moves.
Or say you manage to summon the Mythical Creature behind you and establish a giant beast power in the deep sea, but the moment you dare to come ashore, you’ll be obliterated.
And compared to any giant beast kingdom, it was more interested in the Silver Giant Dragon itself.
It wondered whether eating the descendant of this Mythical Creature would increase its strength or perhaps allow it to absorb some of the genes from the Mythical Beast?

chapters.title: Chapter 372: 201: Mythical Battle, Innate Runes, Dragon King Ao Tian (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: 201: Mythical Battle, Innate Runes, Dragon King Ao Tian (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
Translator: 549690339 I
Just as the Thunderflame Behemoth was thinking about this, the Silver Giant Dragon felt a sudden chill down its spine.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!!
The surroundings of the Silver Giant Dragon were suddenly filled with violent green winds. Astonishingly cold ice crystals appeared out of nowhere, forming an ice storm covering a range of two hundred meters.
Roar! Damned native creature, how dare you harbor malicious intentions towards the Great Sethia! Today, the Great Sethia will let you know the wrath of a dragon!
Boom!
Under the ice storm, the even larger Silver Giant Dragon’s wings flapped, bursting forth with a horrifying speed of several hundred meters per second.
A sonic boom rang out in an instant, and the air trembled.
Boom!
The flaming, black-and-red Dragon Claw collided with the silver Dragon Claw entwined with the frost storm, and a destructive force surged, exploding with the two giant dragons at the center.
Boom!
Underneath the two giant beasts, the ground shattered, the seawater exploded, and countless seawater mixed with dirt was thrown in all directions, forming a waterless zone over a hundred meters wide in the shallow sea.
Roar, roar, roar!!
The Silver Giant Dragon’s double claws bulged with muscles, bursting with terrifying strength, trying to overpower its smaller opponent – the Thunderflame Behemoth with a Level 7 Peak.
At the same time, the violent frost domain surrounding it formed ice blades a few meters to over a dozen meters long, creating a tearing ice blade storm under the howling winds.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Within the green violent wind, these ice blades spun at subsonic speeds like cannonballs, each possessing the terrifying power to cut through the armor of a warship.
Under such circumstances, a creature below the Seventh Layer Heaven would not even have the qualifications to approach it.
At the horrifying speed, these ice blades collided fiercely with the golden flames erupting from the Thunderflame Behemoth, exploding, with only a few of the massive ice blades being able to penetrate the flames.
Thump, thump, thump!!
The several meters long ice blades that had melted in the high temperature fell onto the searing scale armor and instantly shattered, then, in the blink of an eye, the ice was melted by the scorching flames.
As the Thunderflame Behemoth endured the ice storm attack, the blazing flames on its body were also scorching the Silver Giant Dragon at close range.
However, much like the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Silver Giant Dragon’s body was also enveloped by a powerful white icy force, creating explosive halos under the collision with the flame power.
Roar!
Suddenly, the muscles in the Thunderflame Behemoth’s arms expanded, and an unimaginable horrifying strength erupted in an instant. With a toss of both claws, the even larger Silver Giant Dragon was sent flying.
Boom!
The Silver Giant Dragon, like a small hill, crashed with a bang into the desert island’s forest hundreds of meters away.
In an instant, the forest exploded, countless dirt flew into the air, and smoke and dust rolled.
At this moment, the ground shook, and the giant beast enveloped by fire and lightning charged onto the desert island, crushing the ground and raising a violent wind wave of scorching heat.
Just then, a tyrannical dragon roar resounded from within the forest, followed by a silver figure soaring into the sky.
Roar, roar, roar!!
You dared to throw the Great Sethia! You are doomed, native dragon beast! Today, the Great Sethia will definitely defeat you!
At an altitude of a thousand meters, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an angry roar. In an instant, the white light on its body surged, its dragon mouth opened wide, and endless ice power converged.
Boom!
White icy dragon flames descended from the sky, piercing through heaven and earth, with white frosty waves forming everywhere the flames went, slamming into the Thunderflame Behemoth’s afterimage with a loud bang.
Boom! With the impact of the Icy Dragon Flame, the ground exploded, and countless ice-sealed dirt shards soared into the sky.
In the high altitude, the earth-shattering white dragon flames chased the Thunderflame Behemoth, sweeping across the earth. The ground exploded, the dirt froze and shattered, and the vegetation disintegrated wherever it went.
In the blink of an eye, a Destruction Tunnel several meters wide was formed.
Roar!
At this moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s figure flashed, and it burst forth with astonishing speed, evading the sweeping Icy Dragon Flame. Suddenly lifting its head, its double claws held a boulder weighing several thousand tons, akin to a small hill.
Thud!
Like a cannonball, the thousand-ton boulder was fired out, and the surrounding area formed rings of shock waves under its terrifying speed, a dreadful force even the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t want to endure.
Accompanied by the Silver Giant Dragon’s head shaking, the white dragon flame breat swept across the sky, instantly engulfing and freezing the boulder before it violently exploded under the dragon flame’s impact.
Boom! In mid-air, the explosion lifted stones and dust that hadn’t flown too far before being frozen by the terrifying coldness that spread from the explosion.
However, at this moment, the ground below collapsed, forming a crater with a diameter of tens of meters, and then a black figure shot up into the sky at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
Boom!
In mid-air, a circle of white, physical shockwaves swept across a range of several hundred meters, stirring up raging windwaves. The two giant beasts collided violently, and an agonized dragon roar echoed in heaven and earth in an instant.
Under the Thunderflame Behemoth’s instantaneous explosion of thirty times its body size’s speed, even the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but let out an agonized cry from the impact.
Particularly at the moment of collision, the Golden Flame Dragon Claw engulfed in flames erupted with a heaven-shattering power under the impact of the terrifying kinetic energy, tearing apart the white force on the surface of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Under the horrifying strength, the sturdy dragon scales on the Silver Giant Dragon’s chest shattered instantly.
However, as a Descendant of Mythical Beasts and a Dragon Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon’s flesh was equally powerful; the Thunderflame Behemoth’s attack had only shattered its chest dragon scales.
Only a few drops of silver Dragon Blood fell from the sky, instantly freezing a range of tens of meters on the ground.
Boom!
With another agonized dragon roar, the two giant beasts, under the white and golden light, flew out more than a thousand meters and crashed into the middle of the desert island.
In an instant, the earth shattered, countless dirt and dust soared several hundred meters high, and the air was filled with flying dust..

chapters.title: Chapter 373: 201: Mythical Battle, Innate Runes, Dragon King Ao Tian (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: 201: Mythical Battle, Innate Runes, Dragon King Ao Tian (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
Translator: 549690339
Roar!
The moment it lands, the Thunderflame Giant Beast takes advantage of the Silver Giant Dragon’s disoriented state, letting out a brutal roar and opening its ferocious mouth to bite at its neck.
With the terrifying biting force of the Thunderflame Giant Beast, if it bites the neck of the Silver Giant Dragon, it would not die today, but it would suffer heavy injuries…
Hmm!
At this moment, a complicated rune emerges on a dragon scale between the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyebrows, radiating dazzling white light. Its figure instantly disappears.
Bang!
The Thunderflame Giant Beast bites into the ground, creating a huge crater several meters deep.
Within its mouth, the earth and stones are instantly melted by the terrifying heat, forming scorching magma that flows and drips down, setting the forest on fire with the leaping flames beneath it.
Roar!
The Silver Giant Dragon, which instantly appeared thousands of kilometers away, lets out an angry roar. With its wings wide open, the earth trembles around it as the center.
On its white dragon horns, dazzling light circles flash, as if a huge dragon shadow is vaguely gathering behind it.
The towering figure is like a mountain, emitting a terrifying aura of sacredness and respect, as if it is a deity above all beings.
Crack crack!
As the terrifying shadow appears, ice spreads continuously from the ground around the Silver Giant Dragon, turning an area of more than three hundred meters into a frozen world in the blink of an eye.
At the same time, countless fragmented ice objects circle around its wings, and even the appearance of faint black space cracks emit an aura that destroys everything.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Giant Beast lets out a roar, with dazzling thunderbolts jumping on its body. It forms a thunderstorm magnetic field domain covering more than a hundred meters, composed of countless interwoven thunderbolts.
However, this time the thunderstorm magnetic field does not continue to attack but keep shrinking. The countless thunderbolt powers emit dazzling light and converge towards the head of the Thunderflame Giant Beast.
Roar roar!
Accompanied by the high-pitched dragon roar, the Silver Giant Dragon flaps its wings, and the destructive frost between its wings roars out, forming a black frosty cold current rushing towards the Thunderflame Giant Beast.
Everything where the black cold current passes is frozen and shattered, forming a pitch-black destruction channel, as if space itself does not exist.
On the other side, the Thunderflame Giant Beast’s mouth suddenly erupts with dazzling light. In an instant, a golden light column formed by blue lightning arcs and pure scorching heat spews out.
After its evolution in ancient times, the Thunderflame Giant Beast can control its body and power by heart, so it has been exploring the fusion of thunder and flame powers during this time.
At this moment, it has managed to compress the thunderbolt power to encircle its breath. Even though it’s just encircling, the power is still terrifying.
The scorching and violent Thunderflame breath keeps swelling, destroying everything in its path. The shockwave it creates shatters the ground, forming a destruction tunnel that pierces through the forest.
Boom!
The golden breath surrounded by lightning clashes with the destructive cold current. In an instant, the surrounding ground breaks, and a golden, blue and black tri-colored light sphere appears in the middle, expanding continuously.
Boom!
A light reminiscent of a nuclear explosion rises from the ground, and at thousands of meters high in the sky, the clouds are instantly dispersed by the terrifying shockwave, forming a series of circular airwaves spreading out.
Underneath, the scorching and extreme cold shockwaves sweep the ground, destroying everything in their path, causing a devastating typhoon of over ten levels and the collapse of large swathes of forest.
Such a terrifying power leaves the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the three small and one large Tiger Whales stunned and lost in the water.
When the distant explosion subsides and the smoke clears, a terrifying crater with a diameter of more than two hundred meters appears between the deserted islands, and the ground within a range of hundreds of meters has been scraped off a layer.
The forest trees further away have also disappeared, leaving behind large swaths of bare ground.
Many places around the edge of the crater are scorched and red-hot, while others are frozen in ice and frost, with residual blue arcs leaping from time to time.In the distance, a black-red ferocious giant beast stood up, with golden flames leaping around its body and lightning surrounding it. The scorching high temperature radiated from it in all directions as the center.
Miles away, an even larger silver giant dragon, whose chest injury had already healed, was surrounded by a storm mixed with frost, and its aura was just as strong.
At this moment, the two giant beasts seemed like mythical creatures that had reappeared.
Their power and the destruction they caused were both extremely terrifying. The invisible and malicious Dragon Might emitted from them made all the creatures on the deserted island tremble with fear.
Even the ordinary creatures in the surrounding sea were frantically fleeing, trying to get away from that terrible place.
Just then, the flames and lightning on the Thunderflame Behemoth suddenly weakened. It let out a low growl: Roar! Your strength is formidable; I acknowledge you.
…? The enraged silver giant dragon paused.
The Thunderflame Behemoth continued to growl: If you want to join forces with the great Thunderflame Dragon King and dominate this world, you need to show me your strength that I can acknowledge.
So that’s how it is.
Seeing that the Thunderflame Behemoth truly had no intention of continuing to fight, the blizzard around the silver giant dragon slowly subsided, and its eyes gradually regained their haughty demeanor, as it roared.
Roar! Your strength is also formidable; Lady Scythia acknowledges you too.
The Thunderflame Behemoth nodded and growled: Allow me to formally introduce myself; 1 am the ruler of this sea area and the Dragon Palace King, Thunderflame Aro, also known as Brock Abbott.
Roar! 1 am the descendant of the myth, the great Sethia… Adriana Kristine, from the Endless Gigantic Beast World.
As the silver giant dragon introduced itself with a series of names, the Thunderflame Behemoth listened in some confusion. There was no helping it; the name was too long.
Moreover, both sides were communicating through spiritual thoughts, so they had to guess at many ‘words.’
But who would bother to remember such a long name? It was enough to know that the silver giant dragon was called Scythia.
Moreover, this guy was really gullible, giving off a naive vibe from a big family. It actually believed its words so easily.
If the Thunderflame Behemoth had really wanted to kill, it could have done so the moment it let its guard down, by unleashing all its power in an instant.
As for why the Thunderflame Behemoth suddenly let go of its killing intent, it was because of the rune on the silver giant dragon’s forehead that had teleported it away in a flash with a brilliant light.
This ancient, innate fluctuation felt like a legendary rune. Moreover, it part of the space series.
If it got access to it or borrowed it for enlightenment, it might be able to understand the power of space.
Futhermore, the other party was powerful. As a dragon, it was not only terrifying in strength but also had some tricks up its sleeve.
Under such circumstances, even the Thunderflame Behemoth was not confident that it could subdue it. And even if it couldn’t win, it could still choose to fly away.
By then, its space power would be gone, and it would have gained an enemy.
Roar! Scythia, let’s go to the sea first. I’ll introduce you to my subordinates, General Tiger Whale and Prime Minister Dragon Turtle.
The Thunderflame Behemoth naturally hadn’t forgotten about the satellite in the sky that was constantly monitoring this area.
Roar! Okay. The silver giant dragon nodded.
At the same time, when the Thunderflame Behemoth walked ahead, with its back facing the silver dragon, the silver giant dragon finally let go of its last bit of guard and followed the black-red giant beast towards the ocean.
Whoo! The great Sethia is taking off.
Following behind the Thunderflame Behemoth, the silver giant dragon’s eyes showed excitement. It hadn’t expected to encounter three ancient evolved beings just upon descending on this native world.
Especially this dragon beast, whose terrifying strength was no less than its own.
Once this dragon beast joined forces with it, would dominating this world be far away?
With this thought in mind, the silver giant dragon’s steps became lighter. It faintly saw the scene of itself leading countless giant beasts to dominate this world already..

chapters.title: Chapter 374: 202: Humans Are So Terrifying! Giant Beast Asleep
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: 202: Humans Are So Terrifying! Giant Beast Asleep
Translator: 549690339
In the afternoon, when the Silver Giant Dragon Sissitia appeared on the beach, the base that had been monitoring the area issued an alert.
“Report, a Complete Dragon Beast has been discovered on the desert island where Code-named Thunderflame is located.”
“What, are you sure it’s a Complete Dragon Beast!?”
In an instant, the entire Monitoring Center was in an uproar, and many people’s faces changed. The responsible officer even suddenly stood up from his seat, with a solemn expression.
“Mobilize the ultra-high-definition camera satellite from the nearby space orbit, lock onto that Dragon Beast, I want a clear image.
“Yes.”
As the satellite zoomed in, the figure of the Silver Giant Dragon soon appeared on the big screen. Under the high-definition satellite shooting from seven angles, a complete dragon model quickly appeared.
“Body length is estimated to be between sixty-five and seventy meters, standard Western Fantastical Side Dragon Beast, no traces of other creatures on the body, level estimated at Level 8 Early Stage.”
“There are currently no energy fluctuations detected, ability unknown, overall evaluation, extremely dangerous.”
“Phew! It’s just Level 8, you scared us.”
When they heard that the Giant Dragon was estimated to be Level 8, many people breathed a sigh of relief.
The so-called complete body is the official term for King-level Beasts that have evolved into mythical creatures, their final form being identical to the creatures in the myths and legends.
The two largest categories are Western Fantastical Giant Dragons and Eastern Fantastical True Dragons. Although both belong to the Dragon-type, there is a significant difference in essence.
For some unimown reason, many marine creatures and snake Mutated Creatures in this world evolve towards Dragon-types when they evolve.
in addition to this, many Giant Beasts in the mythical world also resemble mythical creatures, such as the Dust Serpent, Nine-headed Evil Dragon, and Ancient Nick Westmore.
This is also the reason why the Human Race calls that world the mythical world.
At the same time, that’s why everyone was scared when they heard about the Complete Dragon Beast, thinking that a Mythical Giant Beast had appeared there.
At this point, someone wondered, “Strange, isn’t that where Code-named Thunderflame creature is? Why would that Dragon Beast appear there?”
Mutated Creatures have their Territory, especially those Giant Beasts that have broken through Level 7, who value their territories even more, and will fight if invaded.
As for Thunderflame Beheamoth, Dragon Turtle, and Haward Jones, they are exceptions.
After all, Code-named Thunderflame creature is known to possess King-level leadership charisma.
Colonel said in a deep voice, “Keep a close watch on the situation there, and
report the data to the higher-ups.”
“Yes.”
No one proposed to use Sky Base weapons to obliterate it like last time when they discovered Code-named Thunderflame creature.
The reason is simple, these descendants of Mythical Beasts have backers.
As long as it’s uncertain whether they have hostility and aggression towards humans, no one dares to provoke a Mythical Giant Beast by taking the initiative.
After all, the main human forces are not currently in this world, so they want to avoid any trouble if possible.
As for Code-named Thunderflame creature, it is obviously a wild mutated creature, if it can be killed early, then kill it, this may eliminate a potential threat to humans.
So there is a big difference between having a backer and not having one.
Soon, under satellite surveillance, sea water exploded, and a hideous Black-red Colossal Beast stood upright and appeared in the shallow water area.
“Report, Code-named Thunderflame creature has appeared.”
“Report, Code-named Thunderflame and Silver Giant Dragon have burst into battle.”
Hearing that the two Giant Beasts had begun to fight, many people’s expressions suddenly stirred, and one of them even excitedly said, “Great, I hope one of these creatures will die.”
“It’s even better if both can be injured.”
“That’s right.”
Under the expectant gaze of the crowd, terrible explosions suddenly erupted on the island, and the dazzling light shone through the screen, making it hard to imagine how intense it was.
“Report, the energy fluctuations of the two Dragon-type Giant Beasts’ battle have reached the Level 8 Late Stage, no, the peak value has reached the peak of the eighth level…”
“Report, the battle has stalled, and neither side is injured.”
“Not good, they seem to be talking.”
Under the astonished gaze of everyone, on the big screen, the two Dragon Beasts entered the sea one after another and disappeared.
“Report, the two Dragon Beasts have entered the sea and can no longer be monitored.”
Looking at the two terrifying Giant Beasts that disappeared on the big screen, everyone felt a little scalp tingling.
A King-level Giant Beast was enough to give humans a headache, but now an eighth-level mythical creature descendant had appeared, seemingly mixed with them.
Moreover, because the battle ended too quickly, it did not give them enough time to react.
Unlike the previous time when the Thunderflame Beheamoth was feasting on the island after the battle, allowing them ample time to discuss whether to call in Sky Base weapons.
Colonel looked at the big screen with a solemn expression, and after a slight silence, he said in a deep voice, “Organize today’s information into a table and send it to the General Command.”
This matter was beyond the scope of the Colonel’s response, so it’s better to let the higher-ups worry about it.
After entering the sea, the feeling of being watched on the Thunderflame Beheamoth disappeared instantly.
Thunderflame Beheamoth showed a solemn look, as humans had been monitoring it all the time.
Unfortunately, the Growth Crystals were important to it, as they can accelerate its growth rate, otherwise, it would have already chosen a different place to settle.
As soon as the two Dragon Beasts entered the ocean, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish swimming in the distance came over and cautiously called out.
Chirp Chirp Chirp! Thunderflame, you finished fighting?
The injured Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also swam over, a trace of awe and some regret in its eyes as it looked at the Silver Giant Dragon..

chapters.title: Chapter 375: 202: Humans are so Terrifying! The Giant Beast Sleeps_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: 202: Humans are so Terrifying! The Giant Beast Sleeps_2
Translator: 549690339
It regretted how Thunderflame didn’t smash that dragon beast hard enough. Roar! Today, King Brock Abbott and Great Sethia get to know each other through fighting, so we decided to form an alliance… No, I mean, to build an Oceanic Beast Empire with our Dragon Palace at the center.
Thunderflame Behemoth introduced the Silver Giant Dragon to Sethia: Roar! Scythia, this is Tiger Eish Big Horn, the general of the Dragon Palace, responsible for patrolling our territory every day.
Then he pointed his claw to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Roar! This is Dragon Turtle Domination, responsible for handling the daily affairs of the Dragon Palace, such as collecting the Growth Crystals produced on the island and resource gathering from other places.
Those four Tiger Whales over there are Big Horn’s family, also members of the Dragon Palace, usually responsible for guarding the surrounding area of the island.
Roar! So that’s it. The Silver Giant Dragon suddenly nodded, no wonder it met the Single-horned Tiger Whale from so far away, it was patrolling the territory.
It seems that while the Dragon Palace has few “people”, it covers a large area.
While Thunderflame Behemoth was fooling the Silver Giant Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle looked at each other, feeling a little confused.
Your Majesty, Dragon Palace, General, Prime Minister, what are these?? At this time, Thunderflame Behemoth gave them a wink and whispered: Roar! From today on, our Dragon Palace will have two Dragon Kings. Let’s welcome them.
Boom, boom, boom!! Saying that, Thunderflame Behemoth clapped its claws, and the surrounding sea water exploded instantly, forming circles of violent shock waves and echoing through the seabed.
Roar! Welcome Scythia Dragon King to the Dragon Palace.
Yingying!! Welcome, welcome!!
Yingying!!
Behind them, the four Tiger Whales who came to join in the fun also made Yingying sounds, making the atmosphere seem like a celebration, making the Silver Giant Dragon feel very comfortable.
However, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately roared lowly: Roar! Abbott, we are now both Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace, but who will take the lead in issuing orders in the future?
It seems this guy is not so easy to fool.
Thunderflame Behemoth said without changing its expression: “Roar! 1 have no interest in power, just love fighting. From now on, the Dragon Palace will naturally be led by you.”
“But as the King of Dragon Palace, you will have to take on more responsibilities.”
“For example, you need to lead the battle, expand the territory, and at the same time, collect resources to maintain the operation of the Dragon Palace. In addition, when you have time, you should also teach your subordinates to improve their combat power.”
“Roar! How about it, Sethia, are you psychologically prepared to become the
King of the Dragon Palace?”
The Silver Giant Dragon immediately roared excitedly: “No problem, the great Sethia will bring glory to you and lead you to conquer this native world.”
The words of Thunderflame Behemoth not only did not scare the Silver Giant Dragon away, but made it even more enthusiastic.
That’s because this is the purpose of the great Sethia’s arrival in this native world: To establish a Beast Empire, sweep all living beings, and become a great ‘king’ like its mother.
Moreover, as soon as it arrived, it had two transcendent creatures with traces of ancient lineage under its command, as well as a powerful dragon creature that was as powerful as itself to join forces.
Add to that its own strength, it is enough to sweep everything.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon is full of confidence.
Thunderflame Behemoth whispered, “Very well, as the King of the Dragon Palace, please use your power to build an undersea palace as our base.
What?
A large string of question marks appeared in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Thunderflame Behemoth whispered: “We have just established our Dragon Palace not long ago (ten minutes), and haven’t had time to build a magnificent residence, which doesn’t conform to the pattern of a great force.”
“As a major force, we must instill a sense of belonging and honor in our subordinates. In this case, a palace that everyone can live in is a basic requirement.”
-After all, we are the Dragon Palace, the future Beast Empire that will rule the ocean. We can’t just have everyone dig a cave in the seabed to live in, can we?” “What’s more, Sethia, your ice abilities can condense sea water and shape it, which is perfect for bricklaying… Ahem! Building a palace. So this arduous task can only be entrusted to you.”
Under Thunderflame Behemoth’s well-reasoned analysis, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately nodded and roared: “No problem, leave it to the great Sethia.”
“Roar! In order to welcome Sethia joining the Dragon Palace, let’s have a celebration feast together after the palace is built.”
“Domination, you go get the Growth Crystals from the island and then dig a deep hole in the valley to bring back all the recently condensed Life Energy Crystals.”
“Big Horn, you go too. Collect some Purple Energy that has grown in the purple coral cave for so long. Remember to wrap it in energy.
Yingying! All right.
Roar! No problem.
Although they didn’t know what kind of medicine Thunderflame Behemoth was selling in its gourd, the two giant beasts still left, raising huge waves out of trust in it.
“Roar! It sounds like our Dragon Palace has a lot of good things?” Curiosity appeared in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Thunderflame Beast whispered: “Our Dragon Palace may have been newly established, but we rule a vast territory, with multiple resource points, such as the Growth Crystals on this island that can accelerate the growth of creatures.” “In addition, there are the Life Energy Crystals I just mentioned, which contain a large amount of life energy, the purple substance that can enhance the energy of transcendent creatures, and the Lava Fire Fruit that strengthens flame energy…”
As Thunderflame continued to introduce, the Silver Giant Dragon became more and more excited. It didn’t expect their Dragon Palace to have control over so many resource points. It seemed like they would have a lot of good things to eat in the future.
At this time, the two giant dragons also reached more than a thousand meters below the sea, more than 20 kilometers away from the desert island..

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 376 202: Humans Are So Terrifying! The Giant Beast’s Deep Sleeps 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 376 - 376 202: Humans Are So Terrifying! The Giant Beast’s Deep Sleeps 3
Translator: 549690339
“Scythia, let’s build our Dragon Palace here.”
“Roar! No problem, leave it to the mighty Scythia.”
As Scythia spoke, an endless burst of white power erupted from his silver dragon body, freezing particles of seawater.
Moreover, under the influence of its domain power, these ice bodies could transform according to Scythia’s will.
Soon, under the guidance of the ‘master’ architect, the Thunderflame Behemoth, the ice castle gradually rose from the sea floor with walls thickened in some places and arched in others.
The building consisted of five palaces, each measuring over a hundred meters in height and a few hundred meters in width, supported by ice pillars as thick as ten meters.
The two largest houses were the Dragon King Halls, while the other two were the residences of the general and chancellor – the Tiger Whale and the Dragon Turtle.
Right at the front stood the Great Hall of the Dragon Palace. Over two hundred meters high and a few hundred meters wide, it was propped up by ninety-nine ice pillars and would serve as a place for future meetings and gatherings.
Surrounded by icy walls that stretched ten kilometers around and shot a hundred meters high from the seabed, in no time at all, a marvelous underwater spectacle took shape in the hands of Scythia.
Of course, the overall build of the Dragon Palace remained somewhat crude for now, but it had left both the Thunderflame Behemoth and the panting Silver Giant Dragon quite satisfied.
Moreover, considering that this ice was frozen by an eighth-level dragon’s power, it was incredibly sturdy, making it almost impossible for any ordinary Unique Beasts below level seven to cause any damage.
In the future, the palace could last for ages with just occasional maintenance from Scythia.
If ever Scythia breaks through to the mythical level, the palace could even exist for thousands, even tens of thousands of years, until the power drains away.
Once the palace was complete, the silver dragon, coming out from its brief rest, roared in confusion, “Brock Abbott, since we want to dominate this indigenous world, shouldn’t we build a palace on land?”
The Thunderflame Behemoth looked at it oddly and roared back, “When did I say I wanted to dominate the world? Didn’t I mention earlier that 1 wanted to rule the seas?”
“Why the seas?” the Silver Giant Dragon seemed even more confused.
“Roar! Because the humans on the land are terrifying, we can’t fight them. In the future, you should avoid flying in the sky as much as possible. If you are spotted, you will be besieged and killed by humans.”
“Roar! Humans, what are they?”
The Thunderflame Behemoth was stunned: “Roar! You’ve never seen humans in the mythical world?”
The Silver Giant Dragon just shook his head blankly.
“Roar! How did you end up in this world?”
The Silver Giant Dragon growled, “Roar! I came through a pathway in the territory of the Balon Beast King, located deep under the sea. Shortly after emerging, I ran into Big Joe.”
The Thunderflame Behemoth was confused. Did this mean that the human realm didn’t lie beyond the undersea passages? Or did they lie so far away that it made no sense why the dragon had never seen or even heard of humans.
That must be why the humans didn’t bother controlling the undersea passages, being too remote and void of direct conflict.
Thinking about this, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared, “Humans dominate the surface of this world. There are a lot of them. Most of them are weak individually, but they have mastered powers called technology and True Martial.”
“The power of technology gives them a view of the entire world, allowing them to launch destructive attacks at mythical beast king levels at any place, any time, and annihilate their enemies.”
“Besides that, the power of True Martial has made a few humans incredibly powerful. As far as I know, many mythical beast kings who have attacked humans have been killed.”
“This is also why I usually stay in the sea and rarely go on land. This world is very dangerous.”
“Roar! Humans are so powerful?!” the Silver Giant Dragon exclaimed, his eyes wide in disbelief.
In its understanding, mythical beast kings are incredibly powerful, each ruling over vast territories and reigning over countless creatures. Their roars could cause the very heaven and earth to tremble.
Such powerful beast kings have been killed by the humans of this world time and again, and they can launch destructive attacks comparable to the beast kings, anywhere, anytime throughout the world!?
This was terrifying. Thank goodness Scythia didn’t land directly on land. Instead, he met Brock Abbott first.
The Silver Giant Dragon breathed a sigh of relief.
Because it was still early, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle hadn’t returned yet. So, the Thunderflame Behemoth started asking the Silver Giant Dragon about the mythical world, a topic about which it had always been curious. This was also why it had humored Haman with his hand-talk in the earlier times.
Soon, while the two colossal beasts chatted, the Thunderflame Behemoth formed a slightly better impression of the mythical world.
Why was it just a slight impression? It was because all the genuine and simple giant dragon knew wasn’t much either.
According to it, he was born in a mythical beast king’s domain, which was also the territory of its mother. He had spent almost all his life living there from the time he was born.
Many colossal beasts and gigantic creatures resided in his mother’s domain. There was also a civilization of a species called Kaleb.
The civilization of this species was mediocre and their physical description didn’t match that of humans. They worshipped Scythia’s mother as the highest deity.
Several mythical Beast Kings lived around his mother’s domain. One of these was the Balon Beast King, who, according to the Silver Giant Dragon, was very powerful and had a good temperament.
Night.
Beneath the pitch-black deep-sea, large segments of white light flickered. Two ferocious giant dragons were sprawled in the main hall of the large Dragon Palace.
Right below the ten-meter-high first step of the nine-tiered platform, rested the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Whale. Below the Single-horned Tiger Whale were four Mutated Tiger Whales.
At this moment, in front of each giant beast, was an ice ‘table’ twenty meters long and ten meters wide.
Every table held two thumb-sized white crystals, a small green energy crystal grain the size of a spoonful, and a water basin-sized purple energy material water ball wrapped in power..

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 377 202: Humans Are So Terrifying! The Giant Beast’s Deep Sleep_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 377 - 377 202: Humans Are So Terrifying! The Giant Beast’s Deep Sleep_4
Translator: 549690339
Overall, today’s banquet seemed pretty decent.
However, on the Dragon King’s steps, the Silver Giant Dragon looked a bit confused at the ‘food’ in front of it, which was not even enough to fill its teeth, because this wasn’t what it had expected at all.
The Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but roar, “Brock Abbott, is this what we’re supposed to eat at the banquet?”
The Thunderflame Beheamoth replied, “Scythia, you came at the wrong time. We just harvested these Resource Points a few days ago, so not much has grown back.”
“If it weren’t for welcoming you to the Dragon Palace, we would have waited another month before gathering again.”
“But no worries, the ocean in this world is vast. Once we join forces and sweep through, there will be countless good resources.”
Roar! So that’s how it is. The Silver Giant Dragon suddenly understood.
However, looking at the little ‘things’ in front of everyone, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but feel a bit shabby, after all, this was a banquet to welcome it to the Dragon Palace.
Thinking about this, the Silver Giant Dragon reluctantly took out eight golden fruits from its Reverse Scale around its neck.
“Roar! I call this fruit the Golden Light Fruit, which contains an abundant amount of energy that can promote the growth and physical consumption of Extraordinary Creatures.”
“Not only does it taste delicious, but eating one can also keep you full for a long time.”
Under Scythia’s control, the golden fruits, ranging from the size of a small basin to that of a water tank, flew towards the coffee tables of the beasts.
The largest went to the Silver Giant Dragon and the Thunderflame Beheamoth, followed by the Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle, while the smallest ones were given to the four Mutated Tiger Whales.
This was the world of Giant Beasts, where power was respected.
Ying ying ying! It smells so good.
Roar roar! Domination, my saliva is about to flow out.
Seeing the energy-rich golden fruits before them, the Giant Beasts all became excited.
Especially the Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle, who couldn’t help but express their admiration for the Thunderflame Beheamoth in their hearts.
With just such a small amount of goodies they had already eaten and had little use for, they had exchanged it for such a big and obviously beneficial fruit for their growth.
The Silver Giant Dragon held back the pain in its heart, and pretended to be generous, “Roar! 1 didn’t bring much stuff with me since I left in a hurry, so just make do with what we have.”
Noticing that Scythia didn’t seem to be lying, the Thunderflame Beheamoth was left speechless.
Well, it turned out that after all this fuss, this guy was also a poor wretch who said he would get more good stuff from it later.
But it didn’t matter if there were no resources, its goal was the Innate Space Rune on the Silver Giant Dragon’s body.
If it could get or borrow that Innate Rune to comprehend, maybe it could understand the spatial abilities, which would also help its main body comprehend and create Top-tier Secret Manuals.
As if lost in thought, the Thunderflame Beheamoth swallowed the Golden Light Fruit along with the purple energy substance, Growth Crystal, and Life Crystal Particles in one bite.
Boom!
In an instant, endless energy exploded within the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s body, and it grew visibly at a rapid speed, cracking sounds accompanied its growth from 59 meters to 60 meters.
The astonishing growth speed made even Scythia’s eyes almost pop out in disbelief.
How was it possible that Brock Abbott’s absorption and conversion ability for these resources was so exaggerated? As soon as he ate them, he could grow, and he grew so quickly!
At this point, the Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle who also ate the fruit along with the Growth Crystal and other resources also underwent changes, but compared to the Thunderflame Beheamoth which grew a meter in the blink of an eye, their size increased only slightly, less than 10 centimeters.
With the long-term consumption of Growth Crystals, their effects were getting weaker and weaker on them. What was once 0.5 meters was now barely even 10 centimeters. The reason they grew 10 centimeters this time was because of the golden fruit.
Moreover, at this time, only part of the energy from the Golden Light Fruit had been absorbed, and much more was still stored within their bodies, slowly being digested. No wonder Scythia was so heartbroken when it took out these fruits.
While the Giant Beasts were excited and puzzled, the Thunderflame Beheamoth found that its body’s growth had stagnated after reaching 60 meters.
Its level remained at Level 7 Peak, but the energies from the Golden Light Fruit were still being absorbed by its body, or more accurately, by its Seven Talents.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth keenly felt that some sort of transformation was happening to those talents after reaching Level 7 Peak.
So sleepy, I want to sleep.
“Roar! I need to take a nap, don’t make any noise.”
With that, the Thunderflame Beheamoth slowly closed its eyes and began its breakthrough to level eight..

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 378 203 The Life of Sorrow Mysterious Martial King, Two Top-tier Secret Manuals (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 378 - 378 203 The Life of Sorrow Mysterious Martial King, Two Top-tier Secret Manuals (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
Deep in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range.
The rushing river water fell from a hundred meters high cliff, forming a waterfall curtain plummeting from the sky, with great momentum and a thunderous sound that was deafening.
In the midst of the several hundred meters high waterfall, a rock jutted out at an angle, forming an optimal viewing spot.
At the very end of the rock, Jack Clark sat cross-legged in his black-red armor, a blue radiance emanating from his wristwatch, forming large swathes of text in the air.
This was the outline of an Advanced Skill known as True Martial Grand Mountain.
It detailed the intricate essentials of this skill that sought to embody the mountain’s strength with each level, the targeted meridians, the degree of body tempering and the changes in True Strength.
Beyond that, it also described which Alien Beast Essence Blood was needed for each level, which resources containing the ponderous essence of mountains should be absorbed, and what effects could be achieved.
Except for the missing Fourth Level Will Core, this outline almost completely explained the intricacies of the skill, complex and convoluted.
An Advanced Skill capable of cultivation to the peak of the Sixth-level Heaven, touching the limits of ‘martial arts’—it could be said to contain the creator’s lifelong dedication.
Each level of the skill was tested multiple times, where a single misstep could result in heavy injuries.
Therefore, after viewing each outline of an Advanced Skill, Jack Clark always admired the achievements of the predecessors and felt deep respect for them.
After all, without these pioneers, even if he could strengthen himself with Attribute points, he would not have been able to reach the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven so quickly.
After finishing the outline, Jack Clark slowly closed his eyes. Countless characters surfaced in his mind, his consciousness working at a terrifying speed to absorb, understand, and analyze this skill.
Having decided to tread the path of creating his own Top-tier Secret Book, during this period, apart from cultivation, Jack spent his time observing other Advanced Skills through the Heavenly Think Tank.
He was enriching his own knowledge by drawing on the strengths of various experts, enhancing his intrinsic foundation in Martial Cultivation.
As for hunting Unique Beasts to earn contribution points… it’s better left unsaid.
During this time, as a large number of students poured into the outskirts of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, teams from the fourth and fifth layers ventured into the middle sections, and the whole mountain range became bustling.
In such circumstances, even if mountain ranges teemed with high-level mutated organisms, there weren’t enough to kill.
Moreover, most of the Level 6 Mutated Creatures deep in the mountain ranges were almost decimated by the sweeping teams of Martial Cultivation Teachers, and the few remaining ones went into hiding.
Additionally, due to resources that had been scavenged for many years by the so-called geniuses at the late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, Jack found himself at a loss after tearing through the Southern Battlefield and becoming the first person among the younger generation in the south.
Because there were no contribution points left to earn.
Of course, no contribution points to earn meant none of the kinds that involved hundreds or thousands at a time; there were still some Level 5 Alien Beasts in the depths of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range if one searched diligently.
For instance, right after leaving seclusion, Jack slayed a Level 5 Alien Beast and dragged it back.
However, entering the mountain range one day, searching for another, and then taking three or four days to transport it back, he barely earned a little over too contribution points in almost a week.
This irritated Jack.
In the end, he decided to devote half of his energy to setting a goal of breaking through to the Sixth Layer Heaven within a month, accumulating 500 contribution points, and observing a hundred Advanced Skills.
By then, he would likely have to consider another path.
After all, the school could provide no further assistance to him once he reached the Sixth Layer Heaven.
Fortunately, he did not need to pay contribution points for viewing Eastern Summer’s stock of Advanced Skills at the moment, which saved him a lot.
Otherwise, under normal conditions, one outline with the first three levels would cost fifty points, and to exchange for a complete Advanced Skill would require 300 points.
Meanwhile, the Thunderflame Behemoth had been in hibernation for a week, quietly completing its transformation from Level 7 to Level 8 in a state that seemed asleep but wasn’t.
While the Thunderflame Behemoth rested, the Silver Giant Dragon, now the King of the Dragon Palace, along with the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle, went on a rampage, sweeping all Level 7 creatures within a thousand kilometers surrounding the Dragon Palace.
These Level 7 creatures either submitted to it, got driven out, or were killed, and up to now, not a single Level 7 Colossus had been subdued.
The reason was simple: this fool would charge forward and start fighting upon every encounter.
As for the safety of the hibernating Thunderflame Behemoth in the Dragon Palace, there was no need to worry. It was in a semi-hibernation state and could wake up to tear apart attackers at any moment.
It was simply too sleepy and couldn’t be bothered to move, which made Jack feel drowsy all the time too.
At this moment, Jack’s wristwatch vibrated lightly; James Crane sent him a message.
“Jack Clark, come back to the Martial Arts School Base as soon as you receive this message, there’s something important I need to discuss with you.” Something important?
A look of confusion flashed in Jack’s eyes. Then, in an instant, his figure vanished from the spot with astonishing speed.
The next morning, Jack returned to the Martial Arts School Base and the moment he stepped onto the square, he saw a Bluebird Level fighter aircraft parked there, with many students gathered around it.
Next to the aircraft, Captain Johann Drake was talking to James Crane about something.
Jack walked over briskly and greeted, “Teacher, Captain Drake.”
Seeing the dust-covered Jack who had hurried back, James expressed his surprise, “I just said I thought you’d be back around noon; I didn’t expect you to arrive this morning.”
“Go, accompany Johann to the rear great base. General Lance wants to see you,” said James.
“General Lance wants to see me? Is there something the commander of the southern battlefield needs me for?” Jack paused, uncertain what the commander might want with him.
“I’m not sure about the specifics. He just told me to ask you if you were interested in two Top-tier Secret Manuals, and if you were, to head over,” explained James.
Two Top-tier Secret Manuals. Jack’s eyes lit up.
Although he had already applied for the God Elephant Secret Book, it was incomplete..

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 379 203 The Life of Sorrow Mysterious Martial King, Two Top-tier Secret Manuals (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 379 - 379 203 The Life of Sorrow Mysterious Martial King, Two Top-tier Secret Manuals (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339
If he had two more complete top-tier secret manuals for reference, it would greatly help him in deducing his own secret manual going forward.
Facing such temptation, Jack Clark naturally wouldn’t refuse, although he had a premonition that this task might not be simple, given the astonishing reward.
Humm!
Under many watchful eyes, the Bluebird battle machine slowly took off, then with a burst of powerful thrust from its tail, it roared into supersonic speed towards the Rear Base.
Before long, the fighter aircraft traversed over a thousand kilometers and appeared at the Rear Base, coming to a gentle stop on the airport’s open ground.
After passing through several stringent inspections, Jack Clark was led by a soldier to the core office of the base’s command building.
“Prodigy Clark, General Lance is inside, you can go in,” said the soldier.
Jack Clark nodded and politely responded, “Thank you for the trouble.”
The soldier hurriedly shook his head: “No trouble, no trouble at all.”
The office of Tyler Lance, the commander of the entire Southern Battlefield, was large, divided in the middle into two sections: One for daily office work, the other half filled with display screens.
Seeing Jack Clark walk in, a smile appeared on General Lance’s face, who sat behind the desk: “Haha… Student Clark’s here, come, have a seat.”
“General Lance, hello,” Jack Clark greeted politely, then sat down on the chair opposite the general.
He couldn’t help but be polite; as soon as he stepped into the office, his keen intuition immediately sensed a terrifying pressure emanating from the elder who seemed to be around fifty or sixty years old.
This pervasive, invisible pressure was so strong that even though the elder had concealed his aura, it still gave Jack Clark the illusion of facing an Ancient Beast.
Very strong. This was a fearsome strong man, at least starting from the Ninth Heavens.
Tyler Lance spoke in a gentle tone, “I’ve been meaning to talk to you for a while, but I’ve been too busy and hadn’t found the time until today.”
“Who would have thought that after more than ten years, another genius would emerge from the Southern Cultivation World. Half a year of cultivation, and you’ve reached the top of the younger generation, swallowing mountains and rivers with your momentum, invincible in your path.”
Jack Clark replied modestly, “General, you flatter me. Any achievements I have today are all thanks to my school’s cultivation.”
“Haha… This is no flattery. Although our Eastern Summer training system is now very complete, reaching this point still relies on your own efforts.”
“By the way, recently the background shows that Student Clark has reviewed several advanced cultivation methods, how was it, did you gain anything?”
Jack Clark nodded, “The gains were substantial. It was only after reading those cultivation method summaries that I realized how superficial my understanding of True Martial was, too focused on short-term improvements and neglecting to enrich myself.”
“Normal. Everyone initially focuses on their cultivation realm when they first encounter cultivation, it’s only at a certain height that one needs to turn back and learn more knowledge, to enhance their intrinsic quality.”
“And this level of insight is something many people may never reach in their lifetimes, or only at the Sixth Layer Heaven.”
“After topping the southern younger generation, you didn’t continue to seek short-term breakthroughs, instead consolidating and perfecting your own path of True Martial. This is commendable.”
“Even though it slows down your short-term progress, having a solid foundation will allow you to move steadier later on, and after you ascend to the throne, you’ll be able to go even further.”
The elder spoke as if he were a relative chatting, his tone gentle, showing no hints of being the supreme authority controlling the entire Southern Battlefield.
The elder talked with Jack Clark about many things, then his expression became serious.
“Student Clark, there’s a difficult task I want to assign to you, a task with a personal nature. I hope you won’t refuse.”
Jack Clark earnestly replied, “General, please say it. As long as it’s within my power, Jack Clark has a duty to comply.”
He didn’t speak definitively, as a task that led a commander of a battlefield to offer tw’o top-tier secret manuals as a reward must be quite troublesome.
“Protect a girl and let her die peacefully.”
“What…?” Jack Clark wondered if he had misheard.
General Lance sighed, “You heard right, protect a girl for three months, and then let her die peacefully. This is her information.”
As he spoke, General Lance pushed a folder across the desk towards Jack Clark.
In confusion, Jack Clark opened the folder, and soon a somewhat familiar woman’s photo came into view.
Of course, Jack Clark didn’t know this woman; he felt she looked familiar because he had seen her photograph in the room of his brother Glenn Clark; she was an internationally famous female celebrity currently.
That such a celebrity would need the intervention of someone like Tyler Lance seemed improbable, didn’t it?
Amid his astonishment, Jack Clark continued to flip through her profile.
Mathilda Ward, female, 19 years old.
Internationally renowned female singer, a celebrity in her prime, has released several albums in just four years…
It indeed was that celebrity, and amidst his confusion, Jack Clark turned to the last page.
Mathilda Ward, 19 years old, Mysterious Martial Sky King’s Daughter.
The daughter of the Mysterious Martial Sky King, no wonder she could ask for the assistance of such a prominent figure as Tyler Lance. However, with her status, even if there were issues, they shouldn’t need to involve him, a ‘small fry’.
And why should she be led to death?
Jack Clark looked up, perplexed, at General Lance.
Answering his inquiring gaze, General Lance sighed lightly, “Mysterious Martial, as one of the top strong men of the Human Race, has been active on the Frontline Battlefield for many years.”
“Over the years, he has suppressed countless enemies from different races and members of the Evil God Sect, even including demon kings from The Purgatory Family and Evil Gods themselves. As such, those adversaries have come to view him as a thorn in their side.”
“But as a titled Heavenly King’s strong man, his strength is too formidable, and these enemies, finding him too difficult to kill, have turned their sights on his family.”
“Or rather, not just Mysterious Martial, all king-level members of the Human Race have family who are targets for assassination by different races and the Evil God Sect.”

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 380 203 The Life of Sorrow Mysterious Martial King, Two Top-tier Secret Manuals (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 380 - 380 203 The Life of Sorrow Mysterious Martial King, Two Top-tier Secret Manuals (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339
“In this world, there are too many strange abilities: talent, special equipment, special powers, bloodlines, and even soul possession, making assassination and infiltration difficult to guard against,”
“Under such circumstances, the royal family members are all protected, which is also why people from the King’s Family are hardly seen outside or heard of.” “However, this form of protection is passive. Those with cultivation talent among the brothers and younger generations of kings are still active everywhere, and their exposure would attract countless assassinations.” -So, despite their access to countless resources and high starting points, many of them dare not reveal their identities carelessly.”
At this point, Tyler Lance’s expression turned grim, “But over the years, many geniuses of the Human Race have been assassinated, and royal family members have died. The opposing side has also paid a heavy price.”
“Including our kings quietly taking action to assassinate their geniuses or important figures, like the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s recent slaying of the
Demon God Descendant.”
“Kings would secretly launch surprise attacks…?” Jack Clark paused.
Tyler Lance shook his head, “The Civilization War is unbearably cruel; anything that can weaken the opponent is fair game, regardless of methods and identity, making them resort to extreme measures.”
“…I see,” Jack Clark nodded, indicating his understanding.
Indeed, this was a Civilization War, a racial conflict, not a skirmish between two small countries.
If one side lost, it was almost equivalent to being wiped out. In such a situation, who would consider benevolence and morality? Better to annihilate the enemy first and then talk.
At this moment, Tyler Lance sighed, “Mysterious Martial has led a life full of sorrow. Orphaned from a young age, he was raised by his elderly grandfather, who then died of illness just as he started high school and could begin
cultivation.”
“At that time, his grandfather had also adopted two young children, and under such circumstances, while cultivating, he had to raise two younger brothers, enduring much hardship.”
-After years of struggle, Mysterious Martial, driven by perseverance, made a breakthrough to the Third Layer Heaven at twenty-five and to the Sixth Layer Heaven at twenty-seven. Within the following three years, he ascended to the throne, becoming more and more unstoppable.”
“Just as he achieved king-level status, there was a fierce conflict between the Human Race and The Purgatory Family, and right then, he suppressed a demon king from the Purgatory Demon Race, skyrocketing to fame.”
“However, in the second year after his ascension to the throne, one of his brothers was stealthily attacked and killed by an expert of the refining demon
clan.”
“Twenty years ago, Mysterious Martial’s wife, on her return from the frontline, was ambushed halfway by Blood God Acunus, leaving with a damaged soul, and died six months later, leaving behind a daughter.”
