“Eighteen years ago, another brother of Mysterious Martial, while leading a team to explore a precious resource secret realm, was surrounded and killed by a group of demon kings and many experts of the Evil God Sect.”
“Afterward, Mysterious Martial pursued the demon king for over one hundred thousand kilometers, slaying him, including the five with Nine Demonic Marks and over a dozen with Eight Path Demon Marks involved in the attack. All were suppressed, but it was all in vain.”
“Ten years ago, Mysterious Martial’s eldest son, after breaking through the Eight Layer Heaven, was cornered and killed during an outbound mission after his whereabouts were leaked. The demons paid the price of four with Nine Demonic Marks and one king-level heavy injury.”
“Eight years ago, Mysterious Martial’s youngest son made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven and became a soldier on the Frontline Battlefield. However, due to his exposed identity, he was attacked en masse and died in battle.”
“Up to now, Mysterious Martial only has his younger daughter left with a soul damaged, and she won’t live for more than a few months.”
As he spoke, Tyler Lance couldn’t help but sigh deeply, his tone somber.
At this time, Jack Clark did not know what to say. A complex emotion welled up in his heart. This Mysterious Martial Sky King… had endured too much suffering.
After a long while, Jack Clark exhaled deeply, puzzled, “Couldn’t the Federation and the Mysterious Martial Sky King heal Miss Mathilda Ward’s ‘illness’?”
Tyler Lance shook his head, “Ilisa’s injury is innate damage to her Soul Source. Although the Federation and Mysterious Martial have tried everything over the years, consuming a large amount of precious resources, they could only help her grow up healthily.”
“But starting last year, her Soul Power rapidly weakened, and she’s expected to dissipate and die due to her soul collapsing in about three months.” “Everyone has come to accept this situation, including Ilisa, who is prepared to hold one last global tour before quietly entering hibernation.”
“But some people don’t want her departure to be too peaceful.” “From those traitors we captured, we learned that amidst the chaos on the Alien Beast Battlefield, two king-level soul avatars infiltrated.”
“One of them is a demon king from the Purgatory Demon Race, and the other is Blood God Acunus, filled with hatred for the Human Race.”
“Whether it’s the demon king from the Purgatory Demon Race or Blood God Acunus, both harbor deep hatred for Mysterious Martial.”
“This time, with Ilisa’s identity accidentally exposed, it’s very likely that they will personally intervene, and we also hope to draw out those two soul avatars.” “As long as we can destroy their soul avatars, it will be enough to severely damage their true bodies, and we might even find their True Bodies through the soul connection and completely surround and kill them.
“Now, Mysterious Martial is being hunted by the Demon Gods of the Purgatory Family, his life and death uncertain. If Ilisa is assassinated by the demons within the human inner circle, the entire Federation will be shamefaced to face Mysterious Martial upon his return.”
“Therefore, both morally and emotionally, we cannot let Ilisa die before her soul limit is reached.”
Jack Clark furrowed his brows and suddenly asked, “Why was Miss Mathilda Ward’s identity exposed at this time?”
“I know what you’re thinking, suspecting someone within the Federation deliberately exposed Ilisa’s identity to draw out those two king-level soul avatars, right?”
Jack Clark was silent.
The human heart is complex, and the Human Federation is composed of various powers. No one can guarantee that everyone is selflessly dedicated. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so many traitors.
At this sensitive moment, the sudden exposure of the identity of the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s young daughter cannot but make Jack Clark suspect a conspiracy.
After all, sacrificing someone who was about to die in exchange for two king-level soul avatars seemed like a favorable deal.
Tyler Lance sighed, “I know what you’re thinking. I was also enraged and demanded that the Federal Intelligence Agency conduct a thorough investigation, to dig three feet into the ground if necessary, to find the traitor.” “But after our full-strength investigation, we found out that the person who leaked Ilisa’s identity… was herself.”
“What!?” Even Jack Clark was taken aback, then admiration showed in his eyes..

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 381 204 Wordless Heaven Book, Top-tier Resources Federation Attitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 381 - 381 204 Wordless Heaven Book, Top-tier Resources Federation Attitude
Translator: 549690339
It was actually Mathilda Ward herself who leaked the information, and Jack Clark couldn’t help but admire her.
Worthy of being the Princess of the Heavenly King, even though she was unable to cultivate, her courage, insight, and vision were incomparable to ordinary people.
As for how she found out about the two avatars of the soul infiltrating their ranks, it must have been due to the “strength” she had at her disposal, in this Era of Power Supremacy, as the Heavenly King’s daughter, her status was even more prestigious than those imperial princesses.
in such circumstances, even though her life was not much longer, and she was indifferent to power, a force would still automatically gather around her. Those people, whether they were to ingratiate themselves with the Mysterious Martial Sky King, or because of interests tied with the Mysterious Martial Sky King or admiration for his character, would not overlook his sole surviving daughter.    0
As for the enmity between the Purgatory Demon King and the Blood God Akunus with the Mysterious Martial Sky King, there was, of course, no lack of hatred between them and his family either.
Mathilda Ward’s mother, two uncles, and two brothers all died under the assaults of the Purgatory Demon Race and the Blood God Sect; to say there was a sea of blood between them was no exaggeration.
Therefore, in her view, trading her remaining life of just over three months for the two avatars of king-level strong men’s souls was a very worthwhile deal. Meanwhile, living in the stable rear, Jack Clark had never imagined that the Civilization War at the frontline was so brutally cruel.
In addition to the frontal battlefield skirmishing and offensives, top-tier powerhouses from both sides were personally entering the fray.
There was no such thing as the dignity of the strong; rather, there were constant targeted assassinations of the opposing side’s geniuses, and even the surrounding and killing of the enemy strong men’s relatives, with the aim of provoking them into irrational behavior.
Besides, the infiltration between both sides was also quite terrifying. While the Human Race infiltrated the enemies’ headquarters in the rear, members of the Purgatory Demon Race and the Evil God Sect were also continuously penetrating the human rear to cause chaos in the Blue Star World.
Jack Clark said solemnly, “General, my current cultivation is only at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven. Facing king-level avatars of the soul, I’m afraid I’m not quite capable enough.”
Although he admired the life of the Mysterious Martial King, Jack Clark did not rashly agree to the proposal.
His cautious nature was not met with displeasure from Tyler Lance; on the contrary, his eyes showed appreciation: “Rest assured, before we approached you, we had already made multiple estimates.”
“Although the souls of king-level strong men are powerful, creating an avatar also results in a severe drain on their vital energy, and their strength drops significantly. It would take many years to recover.”
“Furthermore, the avatars created due to the incomplete souls are unable to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven after occupying new bodies, so the frontal threat is not that great.”
“What’s truly troublesome about them is the insight of a king-level strong man, their bizarre and varied methods, and their ability to rapidly train a large number of zealots and die-hard followers.”
‘During the battle of Koroya, the Federation almost completely wiped out the forces that the Evil God Sect had hidden and nurtured for many years. High-level zealots and even high-order archbishops were almost completely killed or injured.”
“And this is their true purpose of infiltrating this time.”
“Currently, the information we have is that Akunus has possessed an Early Sixth Heaven Blood Envoy, while the demon king has taken over a Mid-Stage Sixth Heaven zealot from the Demon God Sect.”
“Therefore, we must find a way to lure them out and eliminate them, not giving them time to increase their cultivation levels or amass fanatical followers.”
“Of course, even if the bodies they possess are only at the Sixth Layer, under the Will of a King, their combat strength is enough to cross a Major Realm. To stop them, one needs at least the strength of the Seventh Layer Heaven.” “Currently, there are quite a few Seventh Layer powerhouses in the rear, and even heroes from the Eight and Nine Layers can be dispatched, but if high-ranking powerhouses appear, they definitely will not make a move.” “Therefore, we focus on those who are at the Sixth Layer realm but have the combat strength of the Seventh Layer or above.”
“At that time, all that is needed is to hold them off for a while, and nearby Eighth Layer Experts who have been waiting will come to besiege them, not giving them a chance to escape.”
“For this mission, there are a total of thirteen candidates, including you whom I recommended.”
“Although your realm is only at the Late Fifth Layer, the combat strength you displayed in the recent battle reached the limit of the Seventh Heavenly Realm, and at that time, you hadn’t even comprehended Battle Intent.”
“Moreover, you have cultivated the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife to the realm of sensing one’s line of sight, allowing you to detect all eyes filled with hostility and malice, which is very suitable for this selection.”
“However, a Fifth Layer realm is not safe enough. To ensure more success in this operation, I’m prepared to give you a dose of Heavenly Spirit Fluid to help you break through directly to the Sixth Layer.”
Heavenly Spirit Fluid.
Jack Clark’s gaze flickered slightly.
Heavenly Spirit Fluid is a top-tier resource that can enhance any small realm below the Seventh Layer Heaven without any side effects.
including breakthroughs from the Fourth Layer to the Fifth Layer, and from the Fifth to the Sixth Layer major realm bottlenecks, it is, therefore, extremely precious.
“Furthermore, in this plan, there is another person who will work alongside you.”
“Akunus is cunning and slippery; he will definitely send out his minions to probe first, so one person is not enough for security, and it’s easy to fall into a trap.”
Tyler Lance continued, “The division of labor between you two will be clear. You’ll be responsible for Miss Joseline’s close safety, preventing and detecting the enemy, while he will be responsible for taking out the assailants.” “By the way, that guy is an Innate Awakened One. Both of you are astonishing geniuses, so you should have some common ground when the time comes.” Jack Clark said in surprise, “An Innate Awakened One.”
innate Awakened Ones refer to humans who inherently awaken their abilities. In the past, these people were known as super-powered individuals.
After the great change in Heaven and Earth, these people do not need to comprehend the realm of thought; they can control Heavenly Energy to form powerful attacks before reaching the Nine Layers Heaven.
In addition, since these individuals can also practice Cultivating True Martial Arts, each one’s combat power is exceptionally formidable, and because they naturally align with Heaven and Earth from birth, their cultivation progresses at an astonishing pace..

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 382 204 The Wordless Heaven Book, Top-tier
chapters.content:
Chapter 382 - 382 204 The Wordless Heaven Book, Top-tier
Resources, Federation Attitude_2
Translator: 549690339
A top-level resource for breaking through realms, two top-tier secret manuals, and the opponents might be two king-level soul avatars with the strength of mid-stage Seventh Layer Heaven or even stronger.
After only a brief moment of contemplation, Jack Clark decided to accept the task.
The difficulty of creating a secret manual in the short term is too great; if he could refer to two more, his chances of success would be much greater.
As for danger, his normal battle strength is at the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, with the Tyrant Elephant and in Golden Dragon State, he estimated he could match someone who had just broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
In Godly Dragon Elephant State, he should be able to compete with a stable early-stage Seventh Layer Heaven strong man.
It was by comprehending those high-level techniques and looking through the introductions to the top-tier secret manuals that Jack Clark learned why the high-order Seventh Layer is so powerful.
The Seventh Layer Heaven allows the manipulation of Heaven and Earth forces, and importantly, the runes constructed almost fuse with the body, resulting in an all-around enhancement.
After a second energy transformation of the Seventh Layer Heaven strength, the body undergoes a comprehensive enhancement – increased strength, greater speed, swift reaction, plus the overbearing True Strength and the might of Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, even when Jack Clark’s strength and Defense are increased by fifteen times in the Godly Dragon Elephant form, with a hint of Power of the Giant Beasts blessing, he dared only say he could match an early Seventh Layer Heaven strong man.
Of course, Jack Clark’s combat strength was already freakish – late-stage Fifth Layer Heaven comparable to early-stage Seventh Layer Heaven, crossing four minor realms at this time.
The reason for such exaggerated combat strength is his foundational strength reaching 50 tons, comparable to the terrifying physical strength of a Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven strong man.
Under normal conditions, the limit for foundational strength in the Fifth Layer Heaven is around ten tons, Sixth Layer Heaven body limit is eighteen tons, and upon reaching Seventh Layer Heaven, after the transformation, it exponentially increases from thirty tons.
Of course, this only refers to pure physical strength; it doesn’t mean that having an arm strength of thirty to forty tons is enough to contend with a Seventh Layer Heaven strong man.
If a person only has a physical strength of thirty to forty tons, but has not cultivated True Martial Arts, they would not even be able to defeat a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator.
After all, an ordinary Advanced Skill at the Third Layer Heaven already provides a fourfold increase in physical strength, not to mention the powerful True Strength transformation after reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven.
And once breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, the basic multiplier of True Strength enhancement to the body stays the same, but transforms into a stronger True Strength attribute.
For instance, Jack Clark’s Divine Tyrant Body, which ‘true-izes’ his physical strength, can perfectly integrate with True Strength to achieve a synergy where 1+1 equals more than 2, fully unleashing his physical power.
His terrifying combat strength is a combination of advantages from multiple aspects.
Moreover, upon his upcoming breakthrough to the Sixth Layer Heaven, his cultivation will further increase, with a True Strength transformed into flames being several times more potent than the Fifth Layer Heaven.
If he further limit breaks the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd and obtains a rune, his combat strength will be even stronger.
Currently, he has just over three hundred Contribution Points, but there are also three hundred Merit Values originally planned for exchanging for a secret manual, equating to nearly a thousand Contribution Points.
Furthermore, their task is merely to stall and hold off the king-level soul avatars once they appear, followed by top strong figures arriving for support.
So, after weighing the dangers against the benefits, Jack Clark said in a serious tone, “Since you, general, have taken every aspect into consideration, as a member of Eastern Summer, it is my duty to accept.”
“This time, I will go to great lengths to ensure Miss Ward’s safety.”
Tyler Lance nodded in satisfaction, “This mission departs in three days. Also, don’t be careless; even though they are only soul avatars, their methods are extraordinary.”
“As for the two top-tier secret manuals, you can connect to the Heavenly Think Tank online and apply at any time once you confirm.”
“Actually, the reward for this mission was only one top-tier secret manual, and the extra one is a subsidy from my personal Merit Value,” he said.
“I’ve known Mysterious Martial for many years, and Misss Joseline is like a child I’ve watched grow up. I hope she can rest peacefully in the last part of her life.”
At this point, Tyler Lance paused, “…so even if the mission fails, we can’t let her die at the hands of the Evil God Sect, otherwise none would have the face to meet Mysterious Martial upon his return.”
“This request is not just from me, but it’s also the stance of the Federation.”
Attracting two king-level soul avatars was crucial, but Ilisa’s life was equally important.
Perhaps to her, exchanging her life, which is nearing its end, for two king avatars seems a fair deal, yet Tyler Lance and the other Federal Top Level did not see it that way; some things cannot simply be measured by their value.
If the value judgments of a civilization are based purely on their worth, then today someone else could be sacrificed; tomorrow, it could be me. Soon, the hearts of the people will disperse.
After all, there is always someone of higher value than you.
Jack Clark nodded slowly, “…I understand.”
The choosing of Jack Clark for this mission was not only because he had reached the Heart’s Eye Realm but also due to his terrifying movement speed, far beyond his current realm.
Tyler Lance knew that as long as Jack Clark wanted to escape, even a late-stage Seventh Layer Heaven strong man would not be able to keep him.
Just then, a knock came from the door.
Tyler Lance said sternly, “Come in.”
The office door opened, and a military officer carried a black gold-colored sealed briefcase in, saying respectfully, “General, the encrypted blackbox sent from headquarters.”
“Okay, put it on the desk.”
“Yes.”
Once the officer had left, Tyler Lance spoke, “What’s inside here is the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book you applied for earlier.”
He placed his hand on the black box and with an influx of True Strength, seemingly activated something. The box clicked and slowly opened, revealing a ‘book’.
“The True Martial Secret Canon is the way of top strong beings, especially one created by those who have broken through to the king-level; it’s not only precious but also not to be casually disseminated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 383 204 Wordless Heaven Book, Top-tier Resources, Federation Attitude_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 383 - 383 204 Wordless Heaven Book, Top-tier Resources, Federation Attitude_3
Translator: 549690339
“Otherwise, once the Secret Book is leaked, it is easy for strong men of the same level from different races to find its weaknesses, and then specifically hunt us down,”
“But the Secret Book is also the guiding raft for the later generations of the Human Race. If everyone keeps their secrets, the upper echelons of human strength cannot grow rapidly.”
“Therefore, the Federation established the Core Secret Library to preserve Secret Books containing the creator’s will and Soul Power. Whenever someone who meets the criteria applies for a Secret Book, a copy is imprinted.”
“These Secret Books, refined from Divine Cloud Stone, are devoid of words and form, and can completely imprint the contents of the Secret Book for three months, enough time for one to comprehend and learn.”
“In addition to that, the imprinted version is extremely fragile and contains a unique ‘password,1 which is the identity key I initially gave you. If the wrong password is entered, it will automatically disintegrate.”
“So even if someone accidentally gets hold of it, they can’t decode it, not even a king-level figure, because the key’s restriction was set by a King-level strong man.”
“Also, with a chip enclosed and connected to the Heavenly Think Tank, the double protection ensures that no one but the applicant can view it.”
In the presence of Tyler Lance, Jack Clark picked up the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book and, as required, first injected True Strength and Will. Instantly, radiant light flickered at its edges, emitting an electronic mechanical sound.
“Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, True Strength intensity is compatible.”
“Mental Fluctuation verification passed.”
“Key verification passed…”
With the three verifications complete, as Jack’s Spirit Power surged into the Wordless Heaven Book, his consciousness thundered, and in an instant, he arrived in a blank space. In the distance, a virtual figure sat silently.
This figure radiated a majestic, vast, and Divine Might, an Overbearing aura, more like a mythical Dragon Elephant than a human.
Or rather, this figure was a rune embodiment simulating a Dragon Elephant, representing some kind of ultimate strength.
Even though it was just an emulation reaching the Ninth Heavens realm, it gave Jack the earth-shattering, terrifying power that seemed to shake Heaven and Earth.
It seemed that once the cultivation was successful, its strength would suffice to shatter mountain peaks, destroy the Earth, with Unrivaled Domination.
Armed with the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book and a dose of Heavenly Spirit Fluid that could let him directly break through to the Sixth Layer, Jack Clark took a fighter aircraft back to the South Sky Martial Arts School Base.
Next, he would break through to the Sixth Layer, perform Limit Break on the Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill, and reinforce his battle armor and War Halberd for the upcoming battles.
Hoo-hoo!!
Raging wind waves rolled, at noon, under many gazes, a Bluebird fighter aircraft slowly descended into the square.
The hatch opened and Jack Clark strode out.
As Jack stepped down, strong gusts blasted from underneath the aircraft, lifting off the ground and leaving under the anti-gravity effect.
Not far away, in the mission hall, Justin Welan and a few others came out, curious, “Jack, I heard you went to the military base; did they need you for something?”
Jack nodded, “Let’s talk about that later. Mr. Willard, Zac Maben, and everyone else are here. Let’s go, lunch is on me today.”
“What, you’re leaving, Jack?”
In the canteen, a table full of dishes prepared by the chef, everyone looked at Jack in surprise.
Jack nodded, “I’ve accepted a mission from the military and expect to be away for a month or two. By the time the mission is completed, the semester should be just about over.”
Marcus Lindsay suddenly became curious, “What kind of mission?”
Jack chuckled, “It’s classified, no comment.”
Mullen Weisz mused, “Jack, your strength is already sweeping the southern battlefield. Staying here is actually not suitable for you anymore, it doesn’t help you much.”
“Perhaps this is why the military sought you out.”
White Veil speechless, “Speaking of which, I don’t even know how to express my frustration.”
“Are you some kind of monster? You’ve been here just over a month and swept through the entire Southern Region battlefield, including suppressing all those second and third-grade geniuses, without giving anyone time to react.”
Zac nodded in agreement, “Indeed, if we didn’t always know you were freakish, we’d have thought you’d become someone else.”
“Just don’t know whether you will have broken through to the Seventh Layer the next time we meet.”
Jack shook his head, “Not so fast, I want to create a top-tier secret manual. Even if things go well, it will take a few months, and if things go slowly, maybe it will take half a year before I can break through to the Seventh Layer.”
“Damn it! Half a year is still considered slow?”
” Creating a top – tier secret manual!”
“Alright, alright, let’s not talk about this anymore. Let’s eat, or Jack’s going to show off again.”
“Damn it, I got shown up by him again.”
“Eat, let’s eat our fill. We have to eat more today, otherwise, we won’t get the chance once this guy leaves in a couple of days.”
While eating, Jack suddenly remembered something and asked, “By the way, have you seen Howard Lambert recently?”
“No, but Kyle Harrison said that guy’s been fighting and battling non-stop in the Cloud Mist Mountain Range. It’s said he’s even reached the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“Howard, that guy, is also ruthless.”

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 205 Light Wings Spread, Hell Domain, Departure 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 384 - 205 Light Wings Spread, Hell Domain, Departure 1
Translator: 549690339 |
In the afternoon, at the Logistics Department.
“I would like to exchange for three Prison Mine Stones, two Pleasure Crystal
Stones, and one Crystal Horn of a Fusion Beast.
“In addition, I’ll take five Level 5 Life Crystals and four Level 4 Crystals.”
As soon as Jack Clark finished speaking, both the staff and the students in line behind him showed expressions of amazement on their faces, because the materials he requested were almost worth two thousand Contribution Points. However, this was Jack Clark, the first person among the younger generation in the south. It was normal for him to be spending on a larger scale.
Moreover, being a prodigy, the school and the officials must have provided many rewards and resource allocations for him.
Thinking of this, expressions of envy appeared on the faces of the students behind him.
As for jealousy, there wasn’t any, after all, these were achievements Jack Clark fought for, and anyone who disagreed could attempt the Invincible Path themselves.
“Prison Mine Stone 300, Pleasure Crystal Stone 340, Crystal Horn of a Fusion Beast 150, nine Life Crystals 1220, totaling 2010 Contribution Points.”
“Student Clark, you have a 40% discount, bringing it down to 1206, but your account only has 356 Contribution Points and 300 Merit Value…” the staff member said hesitantly.
Jack Clark calmly said, “Convert those Merit Values into Contribution Points.”
“That might be a bit of a loss,” the staff member cautioned.
Merit Value and Contribution Points have an exchange rate of 1:3; nevertheless, the value added makes them even more precious.
“It’s fine, I can earn those few hundred Merit Values back later.”
“Alright then, please wait a moment.”
Soon, several staff members pushed a cart out from the back warehouse, straining to place the materials Jack Clark had exchanged onto the counter.
In truth, a single Prison Mine Stone the size of a human head weighed as much
as two tons.
If these staff members didn’t possess the cultivation of the Third Layer Heaven, they wouldn’t have been able to move it at all.
After putting away the materials into the Sumeru Bracelet, Jack Clark left the Martial School Base and rushed over to the deep reaches of the Nine Rings Mountain Range over a hundred kilometers away.
Deep within an untraveled valley, Jack Clark ensured there was no one around before entering the dry cave and taking out a Life Crystal to begin the conversion.
“You have converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal and obtained 149,156…” Nine Level 4 and Level 5 Life Crystals together converted into 1085 Attribute Points, and adding to the existing 93 points, Jack Clark’s Attribute Points surged to 1178.
At the moment Jack Clark’s Attribute Points broke through one thousand, his main body’s Golden Dragon Twin-pupil Talent and Avatar’s Blazing Flame and Thunder Talents all showed the option to strengthen.
“Intermediate talents require a thousand points to strengthen,” Jack Clark observed as he looked over these talents.
Low-level talents required one hundred points to strengthen once, with three advances needed to level up. Jack Clark has long guessed that intermediate talents would need at least one thousand Attribute Points to improve.
As for whether one thousand points would bring the talent up to Senior level, or whether it would need to be strengthened multiple times, he would only fmd out after trying it later.
But for now, Jack Clark’s goal was to improve himself overall; the enhancement of talents could wait.
Jack Clark took out the Flame Crystal Armor, a Pleasure Crystal Stone, the Crystal Horn of a Fusion Beast, and a Red Ore he had confiscated from Mikus from the Sumeru Bracelet.
Under normal conditions, when an average Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator forges their battle armor for the second time, they only blend in one type of Transcendent Material, because they cannot manage more.
If the Transcendent Material isn’t completely fused with the battle armor, not only will it fail to bring out the material’s characteristics, but the battle armor could even disintegrate due to conflicting forces.
This time, the Pleasure Crystal Stone that Jack Clark was preparing to blend would allow the battle armor to change size to a certain degree, compensating for the shortcomings in armor flexibly during transformations.
The Crystal Horn of a Fusion Beast had the properties of splitting and fusing, which could combine or separate at the mere thought, making it very convenient for Jack Clark to don or remove his armor during battle.
As for that piece of high-order Transcendent Material ore, it could not only strengthen the solidity of the armor but also possessed a mimicry power that could materialize flames.
Actually, for cultivators, aside from defense, “functionality” is a more significant aspect of battle armor, such as the Air Purification that Jack Clark had previously strengthened his armor with.
After all, compared to the Mecha Martial System where the human and machine become one, the True Martial Way was not as comprehensive in terms of abilities at lower levels.
After stacking these materials together with the battle armor, Jack Clark placed his hand on top of them and thought: “Use Attribute Points to strengthen battle armor.”
In an instant, a hundred points disappeared from the Attribute Page. Simultaneously, a spread of white light radiated out from Jack Clark’s hand, enveloping all materials and the armor.
Under the white radiance, the extraordinary materials crumbled to dust, slowly melting into a liquid state and fusing with the armor under the protection of Attribute Energy.
Whoosh whoosh!!
As the extraordinary materials fused with the armor, a layer of white flame, devoid of heat, erupted, suspending the armor midair and continually tempering it.
Since the armor had once integrated a droplet of Jack Clark’s blood, there was a certain connection between them. As such, during the tempering, his Spiritual Will merged with the armor, inscribing runes within it.
The forging of Transcendent Weapons was naturally more than simply fusing materials; there were also specialized blueprints, primarily for directing and exploiting the Transcendent Materials’ special powers.
Half an hour later, the white light vanished, and a battle armor with a black base, intertwined with gold and red colors, slowly emerged, casting rings of gold and red halos around it.
Overall, this set of armor appeared magnificent, robust, and domineering. At the same time, a row of transparent text appeared before Jack Clark’s eyes. “Solidity +10, possesses Wind Spirit Purification, Pleasure Transformation, Splitting and Fusing-four passive functions for high-level extraordinary battle armor, with a 30% increase in protective True Strength.
Active Function: Mimetic Light Wings-use True Strength to generate wings that burst with intensely hot airflow, allowing for temporary levitation and gliding.”

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - 205: The Wings of Light Spread, Hell Domain, Departure 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 385 - 205: The Wings of Light Spread, Hell Domain, Departure 2
Translator: 549690339
Active Function: Scorching Fire Ring, when the attack received reaches the limit, an equally strong Scorching Fire Ring burst will be formed, requiring one hour to recharge after each explosion.”
After glancing over the enhancement notes, Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction before his thoughts stirred.
Crackle Crackle!!
Midair, the battle armor suddenly disassembled and spread toward him along his palm. Amidst the crackling sounds, a figure clad in battle armor appeared inside the cave.
The scene was reminiscent of Iron Man donning his second-generation armor, with no need for Jack Clark to wear each part slowly—one by one—which was very convenient.
After briefly getting used to the newly forged battle armor, Jack Clark took out the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, followed by another Pleasure Crystal Stone, three pieces of Prison Mine Stone, and that Ward Off Evil Crystal Horn.
“Consume Attribute points, enhance War Halberd.”
The instantaneous enhancement white light once again spread from Jack Clark’s palm, covering the War Halberd and those materials.
As his physical body grew stronger, and after his base arm strength reached a terrifying 50 tons, Jack Clark felt the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd seemed a bit too light.
Although the halberd weighed two tons after a single enhancement.
Soon, as the materials were crushed and fused, and as Jack Clark’s thoughts engraved according to a template, a halberd measuring 3.8 meters long appeared in the air.
The pitch-black halberd shaft was entwined with golden-red scales, and the two 0.5-meter long cutting edges on both sides, that curved forward and slanted backward, appeared even more rough and overbearing.
Most importantly, the 60-centimeter long spearhead was razor-sharp, with a faint golden light converging inside it, seemingly ready to unleash a ground­breaking power at any moment.
“Solidity +10, Sharpness +10, a Senior Transcendent Weapon with heavy, hard passive properties, weighing 8 tons, Halberd Skill amplified by 30%.
Active Function: Ward Off Evil Golden Light, unleashes a sharp golden light under True Strength activation, shining across Heaven and Earth, dispersing darkness.
Active Function: Pleasure Transformation, doubles the weapon’s size in an instant when activated with True Strength, and under increased body size, the halberd’s own weight will reach 30 tons.
Compared to the battle armor with various passive and active functions, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd appears much simpler and more overbearing. The Pleasure Transformation function can instantly make the weapon bigger and heavier, suitable for use in Tyrant Elephant or Golden Dragon State, where the immense, heavy weapon can unleash unparalleled power.
The Ward Off Evil Golden Light, on the other hand, is something Jack Clark specifically prepared for the Blood God and for that soul avatar of the demon king.
Moreover, due to the fusion of many Transcendent Materials, both the battle armor and the weapon reached a level equivalent to one that has been forged three times, a Senior Transcendent.
Weapon equipment upgrade completed, next comes the real purpose of this time.
“Consume eight hundred Attribute points, Limit Enhancement on Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill.”
As Jack Clark’s expectant voice fell, the Attribute points on the attribute page instantly dropped by eight hundred.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s consciousness roared as he found himself in the dimly lit Hellish World, where the shattered Earth burned with flames, and countless ghosts and Demons wailed in the Void.
It was then that Jack Clark’s surging Prison Blood War Intent was triggered, and the illusion of a mountain of corpses and a Sea of Blood emerged, beginning to overlap with this fiery Hell.
Hu Hu!!
With eyes tightly closed, Jack Clark’s hair fluttered without wind, and a slowly emerging bloodstain appeared at his brow.
Simultaneously, as True Strength rapidly circulated within his body under the influence of enhanced Cultivation Methods and fused with the rapidly swelling Power of Will, he inched towards the Sixth Layer Heaven.
Hum! Jack Clark’s body shone brightly with blood light.
Under the endless flashing of blood-colored light, an illusion of a shattered Earth covered in flames, strewn with Unique Beast corpses and rivers of blood, enveloped the cave.
In the burning Blood Sea Hell, Jack Clark stood atop a mountain of carcasses, exuding a terrifying aura, as a rune resembling a bloodstain at his brow emerged distinctly.
After a long while, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which reflected the hell of a mountain of corpses and Sea of Blood, with a pair of sun-obscuring golden vertical pupils in the depths of Hell.
In this moment, Jack Clark’s gaze was cold as he looked down on all beings as though a high and mighty deity, imbued with an indescribable majesty.
Feeling the special rune flickering with red light on his brow, Jack Clark’s thoughts summoned the attribute page.
Rune: Blood Sea Purgatory [Heaven and Earth like Hell: Activates to create a 30-meter domain Projection that surrounds with Killing Intent, causing spiritual suppression on enemies and weak interference with reality.
Purgatory Infinity: Battle Intent, blended with the domain, consolidates Heavenly Energy into the War Halberd, each strike carries the power of an Illusory World; the stronger the Battle Intent, the greater the amplification.]
Looking at the notes behind the Blood Sea Purgatory Rune, Jack Clark’s eyes were full of surprise.
He hadn’t expected that the Limit Break on the halberd skill would trigger Battle Intent and prematurely grant him the power of a domain under the Ninth Heavens, albeit just an illusory projection.
Beyond that, the fusion of Battle Intent and the domain could also press the gathered Heavenly Energy into the War Halberd, making each strike unleash an even more terrifying surge of power.
This result exceeded Jack Clark’s expectations.
And this time, it wasn’t just the Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill that had improved; his Battle Intent had also soared during the comprehension of Infernal Purgatory, nearing a minor accomplishment.
It s a pity, I still haven’t achieved all my goals this time.”
Feeling that his cultivation had only reached the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven, just shy of a breakthrough to the Sixth Layer, Jack Clark felt somewhat disappointed because he didn’t achieve even a minor realm breakthrough this time.
Or rather, he was stuck at the Sixth Layer.
Originally, he had intended to leverage the halberd skill enhancement to break through to the Sixth Layer, followed by using Heavenly Spirit Fluid to advance straight to the mid period of the Sixth Heaven.
But unexpectedly, because Battle Intent was triggered, most of the energy during Attribute enhancement was consumed in forming the illusory domain.
This time, it was a mix of gains and losses.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - 205: The Wings of Light Spread, Hell Domain, Departure_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 386 - 205: The Wings of Light Spread, Hell Domain, Departure_3
However, compared to the early understanding of Domain Projection, Jack Clark could say that he made a huge gain.
Thinking of this, Jack flipped his hand and took out a small white jade-colored bottle from the Sumeru Bracelet.
As the seal of the bottle was opened, a light and spiritual aura spread out instantly, making Jack feel as if his body became lighter.
The bottleneck of Sixth Heaven that had been stuck just a step away seemed to loosen a bit.
"This truly is a top-tier resource."
Inwardly praising, Jack drank the Heavenly Spirit Fluid in one gulp, and instantly, a light and spiritual strength spread throughout his body. Wherever it passed, his True Strength became exceedingly active and his will pulsed.
Whew!
A layer of golden flames ignited on Jack's body, emitting a terrifying aura.
Under the substantial True Strength flame that burned fiercely, the air within meters was pushed aside by an invisible force, creating a raging wind that blew in all directions.
And that wasn't all. Under the influence of that light and spiritual power, Jack's True Strength circulated madly within him—onefold, twofold... It only slowed down as it approached the midpoint of the Sixth Heaven.
"Early Sixth Heaven, no... I should be able to break through to the mid-stage in at most half a month," feeling the several-fold surge in his True Strength, which became even more overbearing and condensed, Jack revealed strong confidence in his eyes.
This breakthrough to the early stage of the Sixth Heaven, adorned with a high-level Transcendent Weapon, two runes, and Domain Projection buffs, would mean his combat strength when fully unleashed was not weaker than a mid-stage Seventh Heaven. He would have a better chance facing the two King's Avatars with this power.
Heavy battle boots crushed stones as Jack walked out of the cave. Immediately the golden and red radiance flashed on his body, flames leapt, and three pairs of substantial Flame Light Wings opened behind him.
Two pairs of light wings slanted upwards, three meters long, and one pair slanted downward, two meters long, with firelight flashing, expelling hot streams of air.
Under the hot air streams expelled by the light wings, a powerful hovering force came from beneath Jack.
Unfortunately, the airflow that was enough to lift ordinary people did not shake him, clad in battle armor and holding the Eight Desolate War Halberd, due to being too heavy.
Boom!
With the ground shattering within meters, Jack leaped high into the air, over a hundred meters, with hot air waves shooting out from the wings behind him, gliding off into the distance.
Bang! A kilometer away, Jack descended from the sky, and the Earth exploded on the spot, with dazzling golden light shining, and the silhouette of a War Halberd, over ten meters long, could be indistinctly seen across the sky.
Bang bang bang bang!!
In an instant, the entire valley shook, turning topsy-turvy as smoke and dust soared into the sky.
An hour later, Jack walked out of the valley, now in ruins. He stored the weapon and battle armor into the Sumeru Bracelet, and the rune that resembled a bloodstain on his forehead also disappeared.
For the next two days, Jack was engrossed in meticulously comprehending the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book, not venturing outside.
On the morning of the third day, a Bluebird Battle Machine slowly landed on the square.
Jack stood at the edge of the square, looking at Justin Welan and the others who came to see him off, and encouraged them, "I'll go ahead this time and wait for you guys outside. Work hard on your cultivation."
"I hope that by the end of this semester, when we meet again at the third-grade seniors' graduation ceremony, all of you will have broken through the Fifth Layer Heaven."
Marcus Lindsay was speechless: "Do you think we are like you, with cultivation rising like a rocket? We are still a step away from the Fourth Layer Heaven, let alone the Fifth Layer Heaven."
Zac Maben clapped Jack's shoulder vigorously, admonishing in his tone, "Jack, you also have to work hard. Being at the late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven may be very strong here, but it's still not enough to be unchallenged outside."
"Although we don't know what mission you have this time, you will definitely encounter strongmen of the sixth or even seventh layer. Remember to be extra careful,"
White Veil nodded, "Exactly, you're only at the Fifth Layer Heaven after all."
"Do you think we don't want to rapidly increase our cultivation levels? The problem is there's just no way, sigh." Upon saying this, Justin Welan and the others couldn't help but sigh.
Damn, even though we're brothers, seeing Jack Clark's cultivation level shooting up like that still makes us a bit green with envy.
Just then, Jack Clark smiled and said, "Sorry guys, I'm already at the Sixth Layer Heaven."
"Fuck! How is that possible?" Mullen Weisz's eyes bulged, and the others weren't faring much better, all wearing expressions of disbelief.
"This time, the military gave me some Heavenly Spirit Fluid, and after drinking it, I broke through directly."
Hiss! Everyone felt a pang of envy so sharp it almost made their teeth ache—top-tier resources that could lead to direct breakthroughs in realm.
It was at that moment, Justin Welan said gravely, "Jack, be careful this time. The mission is important, but only if you're alive do hope and the future exist."
Marcus Lindsay also spoke earnestly, "Right, your safety comes first."
Zac Maben and the others nodded, "That's right, if we lose resources we can earn them back, we have plenty of time. But if we lose our lives, there's nothing left."
"Don't worry everyone, you know my character—I won't take on any missions that I'm not sure about."
With that Jack Clark waved his hand, "Alright, see you guys. Keep cultivating hard. Don't let it be that the next time we meet I've already broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven while you guys are still loafing around in the Fourth Layer Heaven."
"Damn it!"
The five of them flipped Jack Clark off, this jerk adding pressure on them even before he left.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!!
With the emission of air currents, the fighter aircraft slowly rose and then with a roaring sound, it accelerated and vanished into the sky.
As they watched Jack Clark leave, Justin Welan and the others felt a bit lost, sensing that the gap between them the next time they met would be even greater.
Suddenly, a determined look spread across Marcus Lindsay's face. "Let's go for closed-door cultivation. This time, I won't come out until I've broken through the Fourth Layer Heaven."
"Let's go, together," Zac Maben and the others said with resolute gazes.
"You can do it." Justin Welan, who had already made his breakthrough to the Fourth Layer Heaven a few days earlier, cheered them on.
"Get lost."
At the peaks of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, girls sat cross-legged at the cliffside, radiating the aura of someone at the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, with three sword intents revolving around them, piercing through heaven and earth in a terrifying fashion.
At the same time, in the middle section of the Cloud Mist Mountain Range where the aura reached the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven, Howard Lambert, who had grown to 3 meters, carried a steel pillar with a rich scent of blood all around him.
At the moment, Howard Lambert was covered in wounds, but his aura was even more crazed, as if possessed, fighting a Level 5 Alien Beast.
In the turmoil of the atmosphere stirred by the terrifying swings of the steel pillar, capable of causing landslides and splitting the earth, the Level 5 late-stage Alien Beast let out savage roars, being continually forced to retreat.
And it wasn't just them.
Under the invisible pressure brought by Jack Clark, the entire southern battlefield was filled with a feverish cultivation atmosphere, with everyone cultivating more fiercely and desperately.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - 206: Straight into the Nine Layers, Darren Callum Returns
chapters.content:
387  Chapter 206: Straight into the Nine Layers, Darren Callum Returns
"Junior Clark, this is your new ID card and information, as well as a list of names and other information about people connected with the mission target."
"This is a bottle of Shapeshifting Liquid. When applied to your face, the skin and muscle tissue becomes active. It can be minutely adjusted with the help of True Strength."
"The facial changes made by the Shapeshifting Liquid are indistinguishable from a natural face. To revert back, you just need to use it one more time."
"These sunglasses are actually an Information Intelligence Device disguised as fashion. They are connected to the official website wirelessly, and if you find someone suspicious, you can retrieve relevant information through Face Recognition within three seconds."
"In addition to that, these sunglasses also store over ten military hotline channels..."
On the fighter aircraft flying towards the border of the Alien Beast Battlefield, Johann Drake handed a folder, a box with information equipment, and a bottle to Jack Clark.
Jack Clark casually put the box and the Shapeshifting Liquid into his bracelet, then opened the folder.
Inside the folder was his 'new' identity information.
As the first among the southern younger generation, everyone believed that as long as nothing unexpected happened, Jack Clark would undoubtedly reach the king level and ascend to the Legendary Realm in the future.
Therefore, his identity had to be kept secret to a certain extent for this mission, including making some minor adjustments to his appearance.
Although the boundaries of Eastern Summer were tightly sealed and the reach of different races and the Evil God Sect was almost non-existent, for Glenn Clark and Doris Clark's safety, caution was still necessary.
After all, Jack Clark did not want his overwhelming talent to bring danger to Doris Clark and the others.
Especially after learning about the cruelty of the Civilization War, Jack Clark became even more careful and cautious—after all, he knew his own 'talent' best.
Once his cultivation reached the peak of the Six Heavens, and his Secret Book was created, he would quickly make a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer or even the Eight Layer, and reaching the king-level within a year was not impossible.
For this reason, he did not want what happened to the Mysterious Martial Sky King to happen to himself.
Compared to half a year ago, the current Jack Clark had undergone an earth-shattering change in height, physique, and temperament.
With just a little more modification to his face, no one except his close family would recognize him.
Name: Darren Callum
Age: 18.
A genius from the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy. Established Foundation two years ago, currently at the early stages of the Sixth Heaven, cultivating the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body…
A simple set of information, yet the identity existed for real, with ID cards that could pass through the Federation countries.
Moreover, his identity information was classified as highly confidential. Local government agencies had no authority to view it; his file noted his status as Special Service Personnel, and all matters were to be handled by the military.
After securing his own identity card, Jack Clark opened another file.
The global tour of Mathilda Ward was set to last three months, with one performance per week, each in a different country's megacity.
According to the information, the stops in Berlin, and Berlin posing no big issues, but attention was needed for the other nine countries' tour dates.
In recent years, those nine countries have had incidents involving the Evil God Sect, with many suspected members still in hiding, some even in collusion with local forces.
This mission was not just about luring out those two king-level Avatars; it was also a purge. The official authorities wanted to use Mathilda Ward as a means to conduct another internal sweep.
Once the plan was confirmed, the Federation had already laid a Heaven and Earth Trap along the tour's route, with stronger than the Eight Layer Heavens  waiting within hundreds of kilometers.
If Blood God Acunus and that demon king Avatar dared to show themselves or the traitors raised their heads, they would be caught by the Federation, root and branch.
When Jack Clark saw that Mathilda Ward's tour included stops in Berlin and Berlin, his eyes lit up slightly.
He had always been very interested in Genomic Martial Arts that integrated human and beast characteristics and the Integration of Science and Martial Arts in Mecha Martial Arts—now he finally had a chance to study them.
After browsing through the mission processes, Jack Clark's gaze settled on the people surrounding Mathilda Ward and their relationships.
There was an important person among this big star's circle.
Agent Crystal Boyce, 51 years old, also a board member of the Cloud Heaven Entertainment Group, with Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivation, was a classmate of Mysterious Martial King, and had a good relationship with him…!
Besides this agent, there was officially a hired professional bodyguard team around Mathilda Ward, usually responsible for the company's order and security.
Then there were the makeup artist, costume designer, music team, dance team…
As a globally renowned star with an entertainment Group dedicated to serving her, the team surrounding Mathilda Ward was enormous.
Jack Clark quickly went through all the documents, and by the time he had finished, the fighter aircraft had arrived at Moat Base where he had initially entered.
"Junior, I won't be accompanying you up there."
"In ten minutes, a Misty Train will pass by Moat Station. You'll take that train and disembark at Cloud Sea Station, where someone will be there to meet you."
"Thanks, senior."
After a greeting, Jack Clark quickly took the cliff elevator and whooshed up to the cliff above a kilometer high within ten seconds.
Nodding at the two soldiers on duty who once wished him luck in martial pursuits, Jack Clark returned to the deserted and simple platform.
Looking at the massive fissure in the Earth and the Vast Wilderness Forest stretching from the heavens to the Earth, a hint of emotion flickered in Jack Clark's eyes.
After a month and a half, his cultivation had broken through from the early stages of Fourth Layer Heaven to Sixth Layer Heaven, earning him the title of first person among the southern younger generation.
Woo woo!
At that moment, a train emerged from the mist like a writhing Black Flood Dragon, exuding an astonishing aura, giving the impression that it wasn't a train..but a living creature.
Jack Clark, no longer a novice, knew that this train, capable of moving through the mist, was constructed from the corpse of a level eight Black Behemoth.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 388 206: Straight into the Nine Layers, Darren Callum Returns_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 388 - 388 206: Straight into the Nine Layers, Darren Callum Returns_2
Translator: 549690339
Although it now resembled a train, its essence was still that of an Eighth Level Beast, which explained the terribly fearsome aura.
“Moat Station has arrived, please board the train if needed.”
As the announcement played, the doors opened, and Jack Clark walked straight in, finding the compartment empty.
With the closing of the doors, the train roared into the mist, disappearing into the Endless Mist at a remarkable speed.
Just past eleven in the morning, at the train station in the small city of Cloud Sea City on the outskirts.
A young man with a tall and straight figure and a face that was both handsome and valiant emerged from the platform, his presence exuding a faint sense of oppression, instinctively making many people step aside.
When the young man left the platform, a soldier dressed in military uniform promptly approached him and politely asked, “Hello, may I ask if you are Comrade Jack Clark?”
Jack Clark nodded slightly: “That’s me.”
The soldier immediately sighed with relief, “I’m Sean Blake, responsible for escorting you to the Martial City airport.”
“Thanks for the trouble,” Jack Clark nodded, and under the curious eyes of many onlookers, he got into the military vehicle parked by the roadside and left.
According to the route, after leaving the Southern Battlefield, Jack Clark’s first stop was at Cloud Sea City.
Then he would travel seventy kilometers to Martial City, where he would meet with Innate Awakened Ones from the Northern Battlefield and take an airplane to South City more than a thousand kilometers away.
The expected arrival time was at four thirty in the afternoon.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s appearance had also changed slightly; although it was the same person with the same handsome features, subtle adjustments had made him appear even more stern.
In fact, for cultivators, identifying a person primarily relies on the strength of their aura and the fluctuations of their spiritual will; facial features are actually secondary.
Jack Clark’s actions were mainly to avoid being identified by Face Recognition, then having Jack Clark’s identity discovered.
At this point, after adjusting a few key points of the Face Recognition, he was completely aligned with his new identity, and anyone obtaining information through Face Recognition would only have access to the superficial data associated with Darren Callum.
At one in the afternoon, the military vehicle stopped outside the airport in Martial City.
From the driver’s seat, Sean Blake politely told Jack Clark, “Comrade Jack, this is as far as I take you. Your ticket’s already been purchased; just swipe your ID card and you’re good to go.”
With the car door opening, Jack Clark got out of the vehicle.
As the military vehicle drove away, Jack Clark looked at the modern-style airport in front of him and the crowd pulling luggage through security checks, feeling an incongruity with the scene.
This morning, he was still in the Alien Beast Battlefield, where primeval forests stretched to the sky, and yet within half a day, he was back in the civilized world.
“But such a life doesn’t seem too bad,” Jack Clark smiled and strode towards the airport.
While Jack Clark was queuing for security, many people couldn’t help but steal glances at him.
His imposing height and straight posture, his pale and handsome face, and his indifferent gaze gave off a cool and overpowering presence.
Combined with the Divine Tyrant Body that naturally radiated a powerful aura, similar to that of higher life forms like the Dragon Elephant Behemoth, he stood out significantly in the crowd.
Beep beep!!
Having passed security, his identity was verified, and Jack Clark entered the airport.
Although in this world, due to biological mutations, the sky had become more dangerous than before, flights between megacities within Eastern Summer Country were still plentiful.
After all, large Mutant Birds had been dealt with, and the remaining ordinary birds posed little threat to airplanes. Those few capable of flying at ten thousand meters altitude could be taken down by the weapons mounted on airplanes.
Of course, in such conditions, plane tickets were very expensive; only individuals with substantial wealth could afford to fly, essentially the societal elite.
Since there was still time before the flight, Jack Clark casually ate something in the airport.
When Jack Clark arrived at the lobby, his gaze immediately fell upon a young man in a Daoist robe who appeared to be about eighteen or nineteen.
The young man had long hair reaching down to his waist, casually tied back with a hairpin, and an elegant and ethereal demeanor; it was just that his appearance was a bit ordinary.
Jack approached the robed young man and asked in a low voice, “Damon Lopes?”
“Darren Callum?” responded the young man in the robe, his eyes revealing surprise as he looked at the handsome man before him, astonished that this fellow seemed a bit excessively attractive.
Jacks’s lips curled slightly: “Brother Lopes, I’ve long admired your reputation.”
As Damon Lopes sized up Jack Clark, Jack was also evaluating him.
Jack Clark could see an Invisible Power naturally circulating around Damon Lopes without the latter cultivating; his body was automatically absorbing energy from between heaven and earth.
Out of politeness, though, after taking a glance, Jack Clark averted his gaze and sat down next to Damon Lopes.
At that moment, Damon Lopes whispered, “Brother Callum, can we discuss something?”
“What’s on your mind?”
Damon Lopes humbly suggested, “I feel that I’m better at defense. How about we switch roles? I’ll be responsible for protection, and you can handle any attackers.”
Jack Clark smiled: “I don’t mind, but can you discern malice through other people’s gazes?”
“It appears… 1 cannot.”
Damon Lopes sighed, “Alright then, I’ll do it. Truth is, I prefer cultivation, not really into fighting and killing.”
Jack Clark did not continue the conversation.
This time though the two of them were cooperating to protect Mathilda Ward, their duties were clear. Jack Clark, with his Heart’s Eye, was responsible for Mathilda’s close-range safety and for detecting enemies.
And Damon Lopes, at the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage with stronger strength, was in charge of handling and suppressing attackers, including intercepting Avatars of the Blood God and demon king.
In the eyes of the military’s upper echelon, even though both were at the Sixth Layer, the Innate Awakened One Damon Lopes, who controlled the Thunderbolt Power and was at a slightly higher realm, was undoubtedly stronger in battle..

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 206: Straight into the Nine Layers, Darren Callum Returns_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Straight into the Nine Layers, Darren Callum Returns_3
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark was naturally happy to have some downtime, which was perfect for taking time to comprehend the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Secret Book and deduce his own top-tier Cultivation Methods.
Just as Jack Clark was about to close his eyes and rest, Damon Lopes leaned over excitedly and whispered, “Brother Callum, have you noticed? There are so many beauties outside.”
“Look at the beauty over there in the white bodycon dress, her thighs are so white and shapely, and though she’s wearing sunglasses, she must be good-looking. I’d give her an eighty.”
“And that beauty in the red dress over there, tsk, what a stunning figure. Though her face is only a sixty, her body adds points, making her a seventy.”
Watching Damon Lopes judging and rating the women around him, Jack Clark had a strange look in his eyes and suddenly felt this guy was somewhat unreliable.
You are supposed to be the legendary Innate Awakened One, draped in a Daoist robe, looking suave, but you’re acting like you’ve never seen the world—or rather, never seen a woman before.
This doesn’t fit with your character at all.
As Jack Clark was rendered speechless, an announcement for their flight sounded from the broadcast system.
“Flight X-155 to South City is about to take off, please board the plane at Gate 3….”
“Let’s go, Brother Lopes,” said Jack Clark as he stood up.
Following the stream of people, the two walked one after the other into the airplane cabin.
It was a large airplane which could accommodate over two hundred people in the past, but after modifications and weapon installations, it could now seat only about a hundred.
Under the gaze of many passengers, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes passed through the corridor into the small door that led to the First Class section.
The First-class cabin of the large airplane had only two seats, and it was very spacious.
No sooner had they sat down than Damon Lopes leaned over, again excitedly whispering, “Brother Callum, did you notice? Those stewardesses are so beautiful; later I’ll ask if I can add one as a friend.”
“…1 don’t think that’s necessary,” Jack Clark thought with a sigh, feeling that this mission might be a bit more troublesome than anticipated.
Jack Clark shook his head and took out a white stone-like “book” from the Sumeru Bracelet.
The flight to South City would take two hours—a duration he couldn’t afford to waste.
After several days of studying, Jack Clark already had a good understanding of the overall concepts of the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Secret Book, especially the insights of the creator which greatly inspired him.
As it stands, both the secret book he was comprehending and the one he intended to create were centered around the Godly Dragon Elephant Rune.
At that moment, Damon Lopes said in surprise, “A top-tier Secret Manual, Brother Callum. Aren’t you just at the Early Sixth Heaven? Are you really starting to practice the Secret Manual so soon?”
“It’s not for cultivation.”
Damon Lopes seemed slightly confused, “Not for cultivation? Are you drawing inspiration from it to prepare your own?”
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s the idea.”
Damon Lopes exclaimed in admiration, “Amazing. I’ve seen plenty of geniuses over the years, but this is the first time I’ve met someone confident enough to create their own Secret Manual.”
“Hardly, 1 have a backup plan. If my own secret manual is still not taking shape by the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, I’ll give up on creating it,” said Jack Clark.
Curious about this, Jack Clark asked, “Brother Lopes, do you Innate Awakened Ones cultivate someone else’s Secret Manuals or create your own after reaching the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven?”
“We don’t need to do either.”
Damon Lopes was not secretive and explained, “Once we reach the peak of the Sixth Heavens, we have a special blank Secret Book. We don’t have to follow in someone else’s footsteps.”
“The so-called blank Secret Book is an empty shell built from Basic Runes. When we break through to the Seventh Layer and experience the Resonance with Heaven and Earth, our innate abilities will naturally form the True Martial Battle Body most suited to us.”
“Since everything is perfectly suited to us, condensing the True Martial Battle Body and breaking through to the Nine Layers Heaven to form a domain is not much of a challenge.”
“…” Suddenly, envy was evident on Jack Clark’s face.
Compared to those ordinary cultivators or a ‘genius’ like himself needing to create his own Secret Manual, these guys seemed to have it all.
But then Damon Lopes smiled wryly, “However, our disadvantage is quite apparent as well. Our talents are one-dimensional, and we can only take one path to the extreme.”
“As a result, our Innate talents may even become shackles when we attempt to breakthrough to the king-level.”
Of course, this so-called disadvantage was somewhat trivial. The ability to effortlessly cultivate to the Ninth Heavens or even break through king-level talents— who wouldn’t envy that?
Seeing Damon Lopes talk passionately, Jack Clark set aside the Secret Manual and started chatting with him, especially about information related to the Innate Awakened Ones.
Damon Lopes didn’t hide anything.
After all, with Jack Clark’s talent, he was going to break through the Seventh Layer very soon and naturally would come to know these things.
The two hours passed in the blink of an eye, and the airplane landed at South Sky Airport.
Jack Clark and his companion followed the crowd off the airplane and then saw a beautiful woman in her early twenties holding a sign by the runway.
It boldly displayed the names Darren Callum and Damon Lopes.
Many passengers couldn’t help but take a second look.
They had no choice; the name Darren Callum was just too… unique. When Tyler Lance asked Jack Clark to come up with a new identity, he had been momentarily stunned.
Jack Clark was nonchalant about it; let it be juvenile. It was just a codename after all.
“Let’s go, Brother Lopes, someone is here to meet us.”
Standing beside the woman holding the sign was another, more mature-looking woman who appeared to be in her thirties, exuding an air of grace.
As the two approached, the mature woman smiled and said, “You must be Mr. Darren Callum and Mr. Damon Lopes. I’m Crystal Boyce.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Boss Boyce, hello, I’m Darren Callum.”
Having checked her information beforehand, Jack Clark recognized Crystal Boyce immediately, but he hadn’t expected her to look even younger in person than in her photos. Wasn’t she supposed to be fifty-one?
Damon Lopes greeted her charmingly, “I’m Damon Lopes; I did not expect Boss Boyce to come receive us in person.”
Crystal Boyce apologized, “Initially, Miss Joseline should have come to receive you both, but she’s currently practicing a new dance for the concert preparations, so my apologies.”
Jack Clark replied calmly, “There’s no need, Boss Boyce.”
“It’s getting late, let’s get in the car. We can talk more on the way,” she said.
The four of them then boarded a luxury business car parked nearby.
With the driver at the wheel, Crystal Boyce gave Jack Clark and his companion a brief introduction to the company’s situation.
Meanwhile, the pretty assistant curiously observed the two newcomers, wondering what kind of big shots they were for the Group’s CEO to come greet them in person..

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 207: Call Me Sister, Talent Manifestation, Jack Clark’s Great Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Call Me Sister, Talent Manifestation, Jack Clark’s Great Opportunity
Translator: 549690339
South City, as the headquarters of Cloud Heaven Group, has a building of over thirty floors that serves as the group’s headquarters and is fully equipped with various facilities.
Located in the bustling downtown area of South City, the land here is extremely valuable.
When Jack Clark and his companion followed Crystal Boyce into the building, they immediately attracted the attention of many people.
“Boss Boyce is good.”
“Boss Boyce.”
With greetings all along the way, the four of them walked into the elevator, and after the elevator doors closed, Crystal Boyce said, “Misss Joseline’s practice will end in a while. 1’11 first introduce the security team of the group to you two.”
Jack Clark and his companion nodded slightly.
Soon, the elevator stopped on the fifteenth floor.
This floor only has load-bearing pillars and several load-bearing walls, creating a spacious area divided into independent cultivation areas, equipped with various basic cultivation equipment.
This layout is somewhat similar to the public Cultivation Rooms of South Sky Martial Height, only that it’s a level lower in terms of ranking.
At this moment, a dozen or so young men in black vests, with robust physiques, were practicing boxing techniques or doing daily basic training with equipment.
All of these people are ordinary cultivators. When they threw punches, the wind howled, and their movements exuded a sharp aura.
“Our company’s bodyguard team is entirely made up of Third Layer Heaven Martial Artists, all of whom are elite students from the top three domestic martial arts halls.”
“The person in charge, Mr. Lionel Lopez, is even an advanced cultivator in the late period of Fourth Layer Heaven, practicing the Cultivation Method ‘Dragon Chant Iron Body.’ With many years in the field, he has a wealth of security experience.”
“They mainly are responsible for Misss Joseline’s safety when she goes out or attends music events, and there have been no issues for several years.”
While speaking, the four walked out of the elevator and a resolute-looking man in his thirties approached them, asking in perplexity.
“Boss Boyce, did you come down yourself for something?
Although they were in the same building, Crystal Boyce was usually busy, and most matters were communicated by phone or through her assistant.
Crystal Boyce nodded slightly, “Captain Lee, could you gather everyone here for me? I have two important individuals to introduce to you.”
“Alright.”
Mr. Lionel Lopez glanced at the two young men behind Crystal Boyce, then turned back and clapped his hands, shouting, “Everyone stop for a moment and come over here, Boss Boyce has instructions.
“Coming.”
“Hello, Boss Boyce.”
The young men, soaked with sweat and looking rugged, gathered together, each one with sharp eyes and full of vitality, looking rather impressive on the whole.
Or rather, ordinary people simply could not afford their services. Although they came from martial arts schools, they were still little experts of the Third Layer Heaven. With an arm strength of over a thousand kilograms and protected by True Power, they were far stronger than ordinary people.
After the fifteen members assembled, Crystal Boyce said with a smile, “Misss joseline will soon be having a global tour, passing through various countries, especially a few that have been a bit chaotic recently.”
“To ensure her safety, a relative of Misss Joseline specially brought in Mister Darren Callum and Mister Damon Lopes, two experts, from the military.
“Of course, this isn’t because we don’t trust you all. It’s just an additional layer of protection added by that relative for this tour.
“The tasks at hand for you all will still remain the same. They will mainly be responsible for Misss Joseline’s personal safety and will only step in when you all face attacks from strong men that you cannot cope with.
Even though Crystal Boyce was polite in her words, the expressions of these young men changed slightly, including Captain Lee.
It was clear that Misss Joseline’s relative had doubts about their ability to provide security, or else they would not have brought in two so-called experts from the military.
These two were so young, even if they came from a military background, how strong could they be?
As several people among them showed displeasure in their eyes and were about to speak out, the figure of blood appeared between the eyebrows of Jack Clark, who stood behind Crystal Boyce. There was even a reflection of Blood Sea Hell in his eyes.
Boom!
in an instant, the bodyguards felt their consciousness shake, the world in their eyes changing color, with an endless crimson tide surging towards them. In the blink of an eye, their surroundings turned into a Blood Sea Hell.
The shattered Earth was ablaze, the sky a dark red, with the corpses of huge Unique Beasts lying side by side, their Blood pooling in the cracks to form blood rivers, emanating a stifling smell of blood and Killing Intent.
In those blood rivers, there were even Evil God Sect Cultists wailing and Demons roaring.
Such a terrifying sight turned these individuals pale, their faces filled with fear. These ‘elite’ cultivators, although they had good cultivation, had spent most of their lives in thriving cities and had never seen such horrifying scenes.
But as quickly as the terrifying Blood Sea Hell appeared, it disappeared just as fast.
Just as someone, frightened to the point of shaking legs, was about to collapse under that horrific psychological pressure, the overwhelming Blood Sea World collapsed and converged, disappearing into the young man known as Darren Callum.
Everyone gasped for air, their expressions horrified, with cold sweat soaking their faces.
Even Mr. Lionel Lopez, who was at the late Fourth Layer Heaven, swayed and turned slightly pale, his eyes filled with shock as he stared at Jack Clark, hardly able to believe it.
“What terrifying Spiritual Will, to drag them all into a dreadful illusion without being able to move a muscle.”
Jack Clark spoke calmly, “I hope we’ll have a pleasant cooperation henceforth.” He had no interest in playing games with these ordinary ‘people.’ To make things easy moving forward, he simply revealed absolute strength to overpower them.
For the current Jack Clark, killing these Triplex cultivators would be as easy as squashing ants.
Mr. Lionel Lopez gave a wry smile, “Looking forward to a pleasant cooperation.”
Then, Damon Lopes spoke in astonishment, “Brother Callum, have you killed millions on the battlefield? Your body actually emits such heavy Killing Intent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 207: Call Me Sister, Talent Manifests, Jack Clark’s Great Opportunity 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Call Me Sister, Talent Manifests, Jack Clark’s Great Opportunity 2
Translator: 549690339
Jack Clark was speechless, “I’m not a Killing Demon, how could I possibly kill millions of people? I just killed an excessive number of high-level mutant beasts is all.”
The dialogue between the two made all the bodyguards swallow hard.
A Blood Fiend equivalent to having killed over a million people, just how many Unique Beasts had this man, who didn’t look more than twenty years old, killed? And all of them were high-level ones at that.
The beautiful female assistant beside Crystal Boyce seemed a bit lost, not knowing what had happened.
This time, Jack Clark had only used his spirit to intimidate, bypassing Crystal Boyce and the female assistant; if he had used Domain Projection, the scene would have been a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood covering half of the building.
After ‘greeting’ the professional bodyguards, which was their way of getting to know each other, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes followed Crystal Boyce to the twenty-fifth floor.
“This is the Dance Training Area; recently, Miss Joseline has been practicing the choreography for several finale songs with the Dance Group.”
As they were introduced by Crystal Boyce, the four of them passed through the corridor and stood outside the dance studio, seeing through the glass that the training inside had already ended.
More than a dozen male and female dancers were wiping sweat and packing up.
These men and women all had ideal physiques, looking youthful and attractive.
Standing before them was their protection mission target, Mathilda Ward.
As an internationally renowned singer, Mathilda Ward was very beautiful, with a fair face, striking features, and an irresistibly sweet and pretty appearance.
Compared to the dazzlingly beautiful Crystal Lewis sisters and the delicately pretty Freya Louise, Mathilda Ward didn’t make as stunning a first impression.
However, if one looked longer, they would find her more and more attractive, the kind with excellent temperament and lasting charm.
Moreover, she was only about one meter sixty in height and had a proportionate figure, but next to others like Jack Clark who were over one meter eighty, she seemed somewhat petite.
But in this world, there were countless beautiful women; it wasn’t for her looks that Mathilda Ward was famous, but for her classic songs that had become popular in many countries.
In just a few years since her debut, Mathilda Ward had over thirty globally famous hit songs to her name, most of which were classics.
Of course, besides her exquisite singing talent and celestial voice, the quality of her lyrics and compositions played a significant role in the success of her songs.
Although her identity was not known to the public, the high levels of various countries and some top-tier forces were aware of it, not to mention the resources she possessed herself.
Under such circumstances, the so-called celebrities of society and top-tier lyricists and composers filled her inbox with their works, leaving her to choose as she pleased.
Naturally, Jack Clark understood that she deserved all of it—the achievements of the Mysterious Martial Sky King were enough to bless his descendants for many generations.
The four entered the training room, where Crystal Boyce smiled and said, “Everyone has worked hard today, go and take a rest.”
The backup dancers seemed pleasantly surprised and hastily responded.
“We’re not tired; Miss Joseline is the one who’s exhausted. She has to practice singing and train with us.”
“Yes, Miss Joseline has been working so hard.”
“Boss Boyce, goodbye, Miss Joseline.”
As they left, those female dancers in tight clothes, revealing their sexy figures, couldn’t help but cast curious glances at Jack Clark.
Helplessly, compared to the suave Damon Lopes, the handsome, cool, and oppressively steady Jack Clark attracted more attention from women.
In front of Jack Clark, those male dancers who had looked fit and handsome with light makeup on now seemed insignificant by comparison, not in the same league at all.
Once the backup dancers had left, Crystal Boyce turned to the female student, who was still wiping her sweat as she walked over, and said gently, “Miss Joseline, these two gentlemen are Mr. Callum and Mr. Lopes, who General Lance has specifically tasked with your security.”
“I know, Uncle Lance has already told me.”
With that, Mathilda Ward looked at Jack Clark and the other, apologizing, “I’m sorry to trouble you both for making a special trip because of me.”
