Damon Lopes said nonchalantly, “Miss Ward, no need for formality. I was bored staying in the Military District, so it’s good to get out. With me here, no one will hurt even a single hair on you.”
…Jack Clark gave him a weird look.
He remembered on the airplane that Damon had complained that he didn’t want to come at all, but was lured by the resources for two level breakthroughs.
It was then that Crystal Boyce spoke, “Miss Joseline, you chat with Mr. Callum and the others; I’ll go take care of some remaining matters.”
“Sure, Aunt Boyce, you go ahead, and I will entertain them.”
Once Crystal Boyce and her assistant had left, only Mathilda Ward and the two men remained in the training room. Suddenly, she said, “Gentlemen, may I ask a favor of you?”
Jack Clark politely responded, “The floor is yours.”
Mathilda Ward spoke softly, “If those two king-level Avatars really show up, please don’t worry about my safety and kill them with all your strength.”
“…Miss Ward.” Jack Clark paused slightly.
Mathilda Ward smiled and said, “Did Uncle Lance tell you that even if the mission fails, you’re to ensure my safety?”
Though it was a question, Mathilda Ward’s tone was certain.
Damon Lopes instinctively replied, “Miss Ward, how did you know?”
Mathilda Ward smiled at the corners of her eyes, “Of course, it was a guess, but given your reactions, there clearly is such an order. So, can you promise me?”
Jack Clark frowned slightly, “Miss Ward, you don’t seem to have much confidence in this plan. Hasn’t the military already set up the Heaven and Earth Trap?”
Mathilda Ward sighed, “It’s not a lack of confidence, but that the Blood God Acunus is too cunning and treacherous.”
“As a strong man who survived from the Dark Age and ascended to the level of a king, he possesses not a trace of kingly demeanor, clingy to life and scared of death, with countless Avatars..”

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 207: Call Me Sister, Talent Manifestation, Jack Clark’s Great Opportunity_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Call Me Sister, Talent Manifestation, Jack Clark’s Great Opportunity_3
Translator: 549690339
“Even though my father once pursued him for ten years in the mythical world, he only heavily injured him, cutting off his three nine-fold peak avatars and hundreds of high-order avatars.”
“Compared to that demon king’s soul avatar, Blood God Akunus is even more difficult to deal with.”
“Besides, I only have a few months left. If I can use my life to kill those two king-level soul avatars, I feel it would be worth it.”
Looking at the woman in front of them, who was smiling even while talking about her impending death, both Jack Clark and Damon Lopes showed a look of admiration in their eyes.
Jack Clark slowly said,”… Miss Ward, let’s talk about this when the time comes. After all, our mission is to ensure your safety at all costs.”
Mathilda Ward nodded, “Okay, we’ll talk about it when the time comes.”
“My words just now were to prepare you mentally. If anything unexpected happens to me, do not feel guilty.”
Just then, Mathilda Ward suddenly smiled and said, “By the way, I’ve seen your information. It says you’re both 18 years old, younger than me. Shouldn’t you call me sister?”
“Come on, say ‘Sister Ward’.”
“… Ahem! I still think calling you Miss Ward is better,” Jack Clark cleared his throat.
Damon Lopes also stylishly waved his Daoist robe and nodded, “Indeed, ‘Sister Ward’ doesn’t sound good. I’ll just call you Sister Ilisa. ‘Sister Ilisa’ sounds nicer.”
This guy, it seems like he’s become more and more unrestrained since leaving the Military District. Jack Clark shook his head from the side.
After chatting for a bit longer, the assistant who was with Crystal Boyce came in to take Jack Clark and the others to the thirty-third floor to arrange their rooms.
Their rooms were next to Mathilda Ward’s.
After taking a bath at night, Jack Clark habitually went to the balcony, staring at the bustling city night view below, showing a contemplative look in his eyes.
He was thinking about everything he had seen and heard that day.
So far, the building seemed to have no problems. Throughout the day, they hadn’t encountered any malicious gazes or detected any special aura.
Among the few people they had met, Crystal Boyce, the assistant, and the bodyguard Lionel Lopez all seemed very normal.
The only thing that surprised him was their protection target, Mathilda Ward. With her demeanor and understanding of the big picture, she was truly worthy of admiration, as expected of the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s daughter.
Even facing death, she displayed extraordinary courage and a positive passion for life, including taking her upcoming concert very seriously and not wasting a single minute.
Beyond that, she had astutely guessed Tyler Lance’s order to prioritize her safety, a very clever woman.
Lost in thought, Jack Clark’s consciousness sank toward the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s side—after some time spent working hard, the avatar was finally about to make a breakthrough to level eight.
In the thousand-meter-deep sea not far from the Ice Crystal-constructed Dragon Palace, a sixty-meter-long black-red colossal beast lay quietly on the seabed.
Before its fourth evolution, the Thunderflame Beheamoth had mostly grown by consuming, getting bigger with each meal, and progressing from level one to level seven without facing any real bottlenecks.
Compared to those mutated creatures that were stuck at each level increase due to level bottlenecks, many of which could not break through before death, the Thunderflame Beheamoth was truly a monster.
It was only when it tried to break through to level eight that it finally felt a bit of a bottleneck.
Of course, this so-called bottleneck was just the Seven Talents within its body undergoing transformation, nearly completing their transformation after about half a month of hibernation.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Beheamoth could keenly sense the ‘talents’ inside its body changing.
Strands of invisible power wove through its flesh and blood, bones, internal organs, and scale armor, slowly coalescing from intangible to tangible, forming runes that covered its entire body.
These runes represented the Top Tier Talent ‘strength,’ Top Tier Talent ‘defense,’ Advanced Talent ‘swift,’ and low-level ‘regeneration,’ low-level ‘toxin.’
And these runes were unlike any Basic Rune Jack Clark had ever seen.
The runes that were now forming in the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s body were incredibly complex.
For example, ‘strength’ was made up of countless red invisible strands of force that diffused among the flesh, composed of tens of thousands of spiraling abstract lines, covering the entire body.
As opposed to the full-body coverage of ‘strength,’ there was also ‘defense.’
The low-level talent toxin’s rune spirals were connected to the throat, several teeth, and the poison gland behind the throat, which looked much simpler than ‘strength.’
Boom, boom!!
Right at that moment, flames and thunder raged within the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Instantaneously, endless golden flames erupted with it at the center, thunder roared throughout the surrounding sea area, forming a Thunderflame Domain covering a range of two hundred meters.
However, these flames were intangible and the flashes of lightning were rumbling without affecting the sea water, as if the flames and thunder were mere illusory projections.
In the burning firestorm and thunder domain, talents related to fire and thunder also gradually took shape, forming runes that belonged to Golden Flame and Blue Lightning.
Only the Thunderflame Beheamoth could clearly sense this scene of talents turning into runes.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s original body, the Thunderflame avatar, was completely immersed in an epiphany state.
Contemplating as the runes representing seven kinds of powers formed and materialized from nothing, he experienced the enlightenment.
This was like Heaven and Earth explaining to Jack Clark what runes were, expounding on what ‘the Way’ is..

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 208 Realm Sublimation, Nuclear Explosion Between Claws, Divine Power Naturally Formed
chapters.content:
Chapter 208 Realm Sublimation, Nuclear Explosion Between Claws, Divine Power Naturally Formed
Translator: 549690339
Runes are not actually characters but are manifestations of a certain “strength”.
Since they cannot be described with words, those who observe them represent them with their own understanding of the character which includes the analysis of the textures and patterns they comprehend.
This is Jack’s weak point.
His cultivation time has been too short, and his exposure to runes has been just over half a month.
Although he managed to recognize all those Basic Runes in this time and knew that each one represented a certain strength, this understanding was only superficial.
He could only know what they were, not why they were so.
For example, a “flame” rune, he knew that it represented fire, intense heat.
But why does this “flame” rune represent fire and convey intense heat?
If he wanted to condense this rune, which focal point should he start from? What problems might arise during the formation? And what would be the specific effects after it has been condensed?
He did not know any of this.
Not to mention trying to combine a series of runes that represent different abilities to achieve the desired result.
This is where Jack lacked in high-order Martial Arts intrinsic quality.
Under normal conditions, even geniuses need several years to cultivate to the Sixth Layer Heaven, and ordinary geniuses might need several or even ten years to break through from the Sixth Layer Heaven to Seventh Layer Heaven. Such a long period of time was sufficient for them to cultivate and learn about runes.
Therefore, having obtained the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book only a few days ago, Jack had only just finished analyzing the rune structure for condensing the Seventh Layer True Martial Shadow, interpreting the meaning of each section through the general outline.
In this situation, it would take him at least another month to fully comprehend the content of the Seventh to Ninth Layers of the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book.
Not to mention creating his own secret techniques by using this as a reference. But now, as the Thunderflame Behemoth broke through to the Eighth Level, the Seven Talents manifested and condensed out of nothingness, almost bit by bit expounding the essence of “runes” to Jack.
At this moment, Jack was frantically absorbing this information, his thoughts racing at a terrifying speed, with myriad ideas clashing and sparking off like fireworks.
Many rune structures and theories he couldn’t understand before now seemed to suddenly become clear.
This kind of opportunity could be said to be unparalleled in ancient and modern times.
Because only the Thunderflame Behemoth’s realm of thought at the moment of breakthrough to the Eighth Level could perceive the process of talent manifestation and condensation; other life forms simply couldn’t “see” or “perceive” it.
Humans’ reference for runes comes from a part of the rune marks engraved on the scale armor, bones, or Crystal Corner after killing Giant Beasts, which are incomplete.
And when other Eighth Level Beasts are breaking through, most of them are hibernating, and the few that remain awake and aware only “blankly” witness this scene.
As for the Mutated Creatures, the concept of “knowledge” doesn’t even exist in their thoughts, not to mention pondering, referencing, and comprehending.
Only Jack would study, comprehend, and compare frantically with the Basic Runes he had learned during this period, absorbing countless ultimate truths of heaven and earth to enrich himself.
As Jack was immersed in the ocean of the essence of strength, trying to comprehend its profundity, time passed without him knowing, and those Talent Runes gradually receded.
The Golden Flame burned, the Thunder leaped, covering the center of a two- hundred-meter domain, and the Black-red Colossal Beast, now sixty-five meters long, slowly opened its eyes.
A faint hint of regret showed in those enormous golden vertical pupils.
Because it hadn’t seen enough.
Of course, one mustn’t be too greedy.
This gain was already huge enough.
Now, probably in only one day, no, just half a day, Jack was confident he could finish parsing the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Secret Book, because both it and the Thunderflame shared the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune as their core.
With a shift in thought, the Thunderflame Behemoth retracted its focus.
After the manifestation of Talent, the fire and thunder that previously existed only within it now appeared substantially in the Outer World, forming a prototypical domain two hundred meters in range.
Within the domain, the flames and Thunder wouldn’t dissipate, but formed a kind of constant presence, as if this ephemeral domain was an extension of its body.
Or to put it another way, this two-hundred-meter domain was actually the true form of the Talent Runes representing fire and thunder.
Therefore, the seemingly infinite intense flames and leaping Thunder were actually Power Projections, without any high temperatures, having no effect on the surrounding sea water.
But with a mere thought from the Thunderflame Behemoth, these flames could instantly burst with a terrifying heat, burning everything.
No wonder when it fought the Ancient Giant Crocodile, its Gravity Domain could burst out in an instant, because the domain was always around it.
Besides, within the domain, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s control over flames and thunder was even more effortless, for example…
The Thunderflame Behemoth lowered its head, and with a thought, the endless golden flames surged and converged toward its claw, rapidly forming a golden Light sphere in the blink of an eye.
Boom!
As the golden flames continued to compress, terrifying intense heat erupted, causing the surrounding sea water to explode into rings of purple-red shockwaves.
By then, the ten-meter-diameter Light sphere was still rotating, compressing, expanding, and then contracting, emitting an even more dazzling Radiance and terrifying heat.
Whoosh whoosh!!
The Thunderflame Behemoth exhaled Golden Firelight from its mouth and nostrils, and even its golden vertical pupils had dancing flames. Its powerful Will kept compressing the golden Light sphere.
Inside its body, the energy belonging to the Golden Flame was pouring in without end—a tenth, two-tenths…
When the Thunderflame Behemoth poured sixty percent of its body’s Golden
Flame energy into the Light sphere and compressed it to forty times its size with powerful Will and domain power, a sun appeared in its hand.
The ten-meter-diameter, seemingly substantial golden Light sphere appeared in the claws of the Thunderflame Behemoth.

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 208: Boundary Sublimation, Nuclear Explosion between Claws, Divine Power Completion_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Boundary Sublimation, Nuclear Explosion between Claws, Divine Power Completion_2
Translator: 549690339
The terrifying invisible high temperature of over a hundred thousand degrees Celsius evaporated and annihilated everything.
Even due to the excessive temperature and the terrifying concentration of energy, numerous black spots appeared around the light sphere, seeming to distort space itself.
The seawater within a range of more than ten meters had already vanished, leaving a seabed vacuum of thirty meters in diameter, devoid of water, due to the invisible release of scorching high pressure.
Under the terrifying force of the flames, the right claw of the Thunderflame Beheamoth turned red, and the scale armor on its fingertip showed signs of melting and even disintegration.
It can’t be controlled anymore.
Roar! Accompanied by a low growl, the Thunderflame Beheamoth suddenly slapped its claw down, plunging the golden sun within it into the ground.
Crack! Crack!
The earth beneath the Thunderflame Beheamoth continuously cracked, forming huge fissures that expanded hundreds of meters in all directions, with dazzling golden light shining between the cracks.
immediately after, the figure of the Thunderflame Beheamoth lifted dramatically, and beneath its feet, the earth arched up with an endless explosion of golden light.
Boom!
A nuclear bomb-like light rose from beneath the deep sea, and under the terrifying force of the explosion, circles of golden destructive shockwaves swept across a range of thousands of meters.
The land crumbled wherever the shockwaves passed, and the soil and rocks melted into magma in the blink of an eye under the scorching golden light.
The seawater boiled, with countless white bubbles mixed with the shockwaves rushing toward the heavens. The surface of the sea exploded a kilometer above, and a spray of water rushed directly up a hundred meters into the high altitude.
Under the influence of these invisible shockwaves, all the ordinary marine life in the range of several kilometers died. For a time, densely packed corpses of fish and shrimp were sinking and floating in the sea.
When the aftermath of the explosion subsided, a crater with a diameter of more than 300 meters appeared on the seafloor, the ground within a kilometer’s range looking as if it had been plowed, pitted and uneven.
Hundreds of meters away, the blasted Thunderflame Beheamoth stood on the seabed, still emitting black smoke, and its cracked scale armor was healing at a visible speed.
After a long while, the Thunderflame Beheamoth let out an excited growl.
“This move is so strong.”
The power of compressing 60% of the Golden Flame energy in its body by tens of times and releasing it instantly was even stronger than the continuous jet of exhalation.
Even because of its immense power, the instant explosion of destructive force was a bit overwhelming even for itself.
It was as terrifying as holding a nuclear bomb in its claws.
This was how power should be used; the exhalation and the flames burning on the body’s surface were simply too weak in comparison.
At this thought, the excited Thunderflame Beheamoth focused its mind, and an endless stream of lightning converged in its claws, gradually forming a hundred-meter-long battle spear in its grasp, emitting dazzling light.
Boom! The Thunder Spear had just appeared when, due to unstable energy, it exploded with a loud noise, and countless lightning bolts collapsed into the sea. Witnessing the jumping lightning around it, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s eyes revealed joy, as it found that after its talent had been ‘materialized,’ it would have more combat methods in the future.
It could compress and form a ‘fireball’ and could also create energy weapons, flexible and convenient.
in addition, to strengthen the control of Golden Flame and Thunder energy, it could even inscribe Basic Runes with functions such as stability and constraint on its double claws’ scale armor.
It could even research a set of overlapped rune arrays to be inscribed on its double claws, forming a powerful restrictive magnetic field and compressing half of the Golden Flame power in its claws by a hundred times.
By then, with one paw, one nuclear explosion, who could withstand it?
Aside from that, it could also engrave some Basic Runes in its mouth, requiring no complicated functions, just a single amplification to amplify the power of its exhalation.
And more… No rush, no rush, take it slow. The Thunderflame Beheamoth thought excitedly.
Pushing down the excitement deep within its heart, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s attention shifted back to its body. After the breakthrough, its ‘strength,’ ‘defense,’ and other talents had also evolved into tangible powers.
In the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s perception, there was a special power circulating among its entire body’s muscles. With a flick of thought, it could gather and unleash tens or even hundreds of times the ‘strength.
Aside from that, there was an overall ‘defense’ power circulating between its scale armor and bones.
Including the originally imperceptible swiftness, regeneration, and toxin powers, all could be sensed and mobilized, ready for use with a flick of thought.
It was similar to the mythical “Divine Command Powers.”
Under these circumstances, it didn’t need to create any Beast Secret Cultivation at all. All it needed was to research some runes that amplify its talents.
Roar!
At this moment, a dragon’s roar sounded from a distance. The Silver Giant Dragon appeared, leading the Tiger Whale, Dragon Turtle, and Haward Jones with vigor and enthusiasm.
Seeing the huge pit in the distance and the terrifying oppressive Thunderflame Beheamoth by the edge of the pit, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes showed surprise and joy as it howled: “Brock Abbott, did you breakthrough?” “Roar! Yes, I broke through to Level 8.” The Thunderflame Beheamoth nodded slightly.
“Roar! Hahaha, that makes the strength of our Dragon Palace even stronger! Oh, by the way, I just led Joe and the others to take down the territory of an Eighth Level Extraordinary Lifeform.”
“That guy dared to refuse to join the Dragon Palace and the Great Sethia’s invitation, simply seeking death.”
Ying ying ying! Yes, seeking death, kill it.
Roar! Abbott, I was also very brave just now, but alas, that guy ran too fast and escaped.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also let out excited roars.
During this time following the Silver Giant Dragon, they had swept across a large area of the sea, combating four Eighth Level Beasts and more than a dozen Level 7 Mutant Creatures.
Unfortunately, those creatures’ ‘intelligence’ was too low to comprehend the concept of joining the Dragon Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 208 Realm Sublimation, Nuclear Explosion Between Claws, Divine Power Naturally Formed_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 208 Realm Sublimation, Nuclear Explosion Between Claws, Divine Power Naturally Formed_3
Translator: 549690339
Some were killed in resistance, others fled, and as for the corpses, they were devoured by the Tiger Whale and the Dragon Turtle.
During this period, as the Thunderflame Behemoth lay in hibernation, all the Growth Crystals it produced in half a month were consumed by them. Although the effects were getting weaker, they still grew to sixty meters in height, reaching the peak of Level 7.
In such a state, they required even more energy, which was why the Silver
Giant Dragon kept leading them into battle.
If the Dragon Palace had two more Level 8 Giant Beasts with king’s blood or of dragon species, their combat power would skyrocket to terrifying levels. With four Level 8 Giant Beasts working together, killing a Level 9 was not
impossible.
After all, its combat power was even stronger than Brock Abbott’s.
Unlike the Thunderflame Behemoth, which began its transformation upon reaching the peak of Level 7, it seemed that the Dragon Turtle and the Tiger Whale had not yet touched that layer of barrier and needed to wait a while longer.
Looking at the increasingly ferocious Black-red Colossal Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly growled, “Brock Abbott, let us patrol the sea area together and conquer those Extraordinary Giant Beasts.
“Roar! No hurry, I’ve still got some things to do, wait a bit more,” the
Thunderflame Behemoth shook its head.
It wanted to test some of the speculations it had before, battles and killing could wait.
On the balcony, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes.
The breakthrough of his Avatar to level eight had significant feedback for him; his strongest attribute, strength, surged by two hundred points, reaching the terrifying level of two thousand.
At this moment, his basic arm strength had almost surpassed sixty tons, meaning just his physical strength alone was enough to flip over a heavy tank.
A small car was like a little toy to him, easy to throw hundreds of meters away with a casual toss.
Feeling his increasingly powerful body, Jack Clark sighed, “Mutated creatures truly have innate advantages. If humans couldn’t practice cultivation, this world would have almost certainly come under the dominion of mutated
creatures long ago.”
With the Avatar’s breakthrough to level eight, it had almost fully mastered the Seven Talents, forming a domain that covered an area of two hundred meters through Power Projection.
And yet, when a human cultivator breaks through to the Eight Layer 1 leaven to condense a combat body, they can only form a protective energy field. Forming a domain isn’t possible until the Ninth Heavens.
The reason lies in the massive size of the Unique Beasts, their bodies contain hundreds to thousands of times more energy than humans, which allows them directly stimulate runes with their robust energy to form Domain Projection.
This is one of the reasons why, after reaching the Fourth Layer Heaven, cultivators shift their focus to True Strength, ultimately following the path of the Law.
Although with each breakthrough, human cultivators’ bodies are more greatly tempered, the gains in power are limited due to physical size constraints.
As for Jack Clark, he was the exception.
The next morning, Jack Clark had just woken up when someone knocked on his door.
Marla Fiore held two sets of clothes and offered politely, “Mr. Callum, here are the clothes you requested.”
The day before, Jack Clark had asked Crystal Boyce for help in preparing a matching set of clothes for a bodyguard, since as Miss Ward’s ‘bodyguard,’ he had to look the part.
“Thank you,” he said as he took the clothes and returned to his room.
Soon after changing into a black suit, a white shirt, and wearing black leather shoes, Jack Clark, who now fully dressed the part of a bodyguard complete with a sci-fi styled pair of black sunglasses, stepped out.
Marla Fiore, waiting outside, was momentarily stunned.
If Jack Clark was handsome and elegant before, giving off an air of calm nobility, then in this outfit and wearing the black sunglasses, he was the epitome of cool.
The black sunglasses made his face appear even more fair and jade-hke, and his features more three-dimensional and sharp.
His straight and tall posture made him seem like a solid city wall, unshakeable like a mountain, exuding a strong sense of security and an astonishing charisma.
Seeing Marla Fiore frozen in place, Jack Clark calmly said, “Assistant Jessica, is Brother Lopes up yet?”
Marla Fiore snapped back to reality, a slight blush tinting her cheeks, as she quickly replied,”… Mr. Lopes is already up and is having breakfast in the dining room, Ilisa is also there.”
Regaining her composure, she politely offered, “Mr. Callum, let me take you over.”
“Thank you,” he said.
Following Marla Fiore, Jack Clark soon arrived at Miss Ward’s private restaurant, where Crystal Boyce, Damon Lopes, and Miss Ward were having breakfast.
Compared to Jack Clark, Damon Lopes still wore his Daoist robe. After all, he didn’t need to be close to Miss Ward for protection, so he could afford to dress more casually.
“Brother Callum, you look pretty cool in that outfit,” Damon Lopes said with a hint of envy as he saw Jack coming.
Ilisa and Crystal Boyce also brightened up, but since they were not very familiar with each other yet, they just smiled and signaled for Jack to sit down and join them for breakfast.
When Jack sat down, Jessica brought out a document and announced, “Ilisa has no outside arrangements today. At nine in the morning, she’s scheduled to go to the tenth-floor recording studio to record the songs ‘Gleaming like Flowers’ and ‘The Butterfly of the Heart’.”
“After that, she has lunchtime, followed by an hour of flexible training at two in the afternoon, and at three-thirty she’ll practice the ‘Homeland of the Dragons dance…'”
As a big star, Miss Ward’s daily schedule was tightly packed, but she censured it a fulfilling and busy life.
Because there wouldn’t be any time for these activities later.
Once the assistant finished reporting the day’s schedule, Crystal Boyce turned to Jack and Damon, “Do you two have any suggestions or plans?”
Jack shook his head slightly, “For now, the enemy is in the dark and we are in the light, so we can only watch and react. Miss Ward, you can continue with your planned activities as usual.”
“My perception is sharp, and I will be responsible for Miss Ward’s protection.” “Brother Lopes has formidable combat power and will be responsible for taking out any adversaries that may appear. He will have the freedom to do as he pleases, as long as he stays within a one-kilometer radius, so he can arrive instantaneously if needed.”
“Alright then, we’ll leave Ilisa’s safety to the two of you. 1 need to coordinate some things for the concert venue,” Crystal said.
After breakfast and a short rest, Jack followed Ilisa to the tenth floor.
This was her usual place for song recording and practice, equipped with world-class audio equipment, none of which Jack was familiar with or interested in.
So, after watching Ilisa enter the recording booth, Jack found a corner sofa in the studio to sit down, flipping out the God Elephant Secret Book to study.
To outsiders, it appeared as though he was reading a book.
But the reason for ‘appeared’ is that the book, upon being opened, was blank and contained nothing..

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 209 Engraving Heaven and Earth, Fusion of the Six Major Talents, That Person Seems Like My Brother (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 209 Engraving Heaven and Earth, Fusion of the Six Major Talents, That Person Seems Like My Brother (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
Outside the recording studio, Jack Clark sat on the sofa with his head slightly bowed, his mind immersed in the ‘Wordless Heaven Book’ he held in his hands.
In the void space, made up of countless runes, the shadow of the ‘Dragon Elephant’ was seated cross-legged as if sealed, emanating a mysterious aura.
Compared to the previous obscurity and complexity, the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book now seemed very simple in the eyes of Jack Clark, and many structures that had been incomprehensible at first glance became clear.
He quickly finished analyzing the True Martial Shadow structure of the Seventh Layer Heaven and began to comprehend the True Martial Battle Body section of the Eighth Layer Heaven.
The breakthrough opportunity with the Thunderflame Beheamoth had elevated Jack Clark’s rune recognition to an extremely advanced level.
Add to that the Secret Book’s synopsis, which was equivalent to an answer key, and the formulas for reference, his progress in comprehending the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book was faster than Jack had anticipated.
Just an hour later, Jack’s eyes revealed a thoughtful look.
“I hadn’t realized that the secret book is actually about engraving ‘a part of Heaven and Earth’ and integrating it into the human body – no wonder in the late stages one can fly and escape, even comparable to deities.”
Of course, this part of Heaven and Earth is the Heaven and Earth as perceived by humans, presented in the form of strength, divided into four steps.
That is, the True Martial Shadow of the Seventh Layer Heaven, the True Martial Battle Body of the Eighth Layer Heaven, the Heaven and Earth Projection Domain of the Ninth Heavens, and touching the rule at the peak of the Nine Layers.
After these four steps comes the king-level, mastering the power of the laws of ‘Heaven and Earth,’ effortlessly wielding Divine Might, becoming legendary.
However, it’s excessively difficult for humans to comprehend Heaven and Earth, let alone ‘capture’ the power of Heaven and Earth. Therefore, they came up with the idea of using runes to simulate the powers of those Giant Beasts with ‘Divine Powers.’
Simulating the aura, shape, and even the essence of strength of those Level 9 Peak Giant Beasts, and even Mythical Giant Beasts, they remodeled and reconstructed them into ‘Secret Books’ suitable for humans.
Hum!
In the void, a ‘Jack Clark’ spiritual will illusion emerged.
Immediately, the complete Divine Might Dragon Elephant Secret Book materialized within him, expanding continuously until it enveloped his entire body. Instantly, an aura that was grand, vast, and ferociously divine appeared on him.
Roar Roar Roar!!
In the void, the sounds of Dragon Roar Elephant Roar faintly echoed.
At this moment, if Jack were at the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, he would instantly merge heart and mind and, in one breath, step into the Seventh Layer Heaven to condense the True Martial Shadow.
Naturally, he would not choose the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book, as it was not the most suitable for Jack Clark.
Just then, around Jack Clark’s figure, a giant shadow composed of countless golden flame lines, the Golden Flame Giant Beast, appeared, radiating an intense and scorching divine pressure.
Then came a Giant Beast of Thunder made of blue lightning lines, a Strength Giant Beast composed of red power lines, a Defense Giant Beast of black lines…
Under Jack Clark’s manifestation of spiritual will, the giant shadows representing the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s talents for ‘Golden Flame,’ ‘Blue Lightning,’ ‘Strength,’ ‘Defense,’ ‘Swift,’ and ‘Regeneration’ appeared.
As for Toxin… Jack simply ignored it.
The Strength and Defense among these talent runes shaped Giant Beasts, in terms of completeness and the might they radiated, were even comparable to the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune.
This illustrated just how terrifying the strength and Defensive Talent of the Thunderflame Beheamoth were.
Having witnessed these talents form from nothing, Jack could almost immediately manifest them through thought.
His goal, of course, was to attempt to integrate the six major talents of the Thunderflame Beheamoth into his Secret Book, constructing an even stronger True Martial body.
If he could fuse the power and Divine Might of the Godly Dragon Elephant with the six talents of the Thunderflame Beheamoth, his True Martial body would become terrifyingly powerful.
Even with Ninth Heaven cultivation, blowing up a Mythical Giant Beast might not be impossible.
Phew! No rush, let’s take it step by step.
Jack suppressed the excitement in his heart, and with a thought, he controlled the ‘Strength’ Giant Beast shadow to dissolve, transforming into countless illusory runes that circled the ‘Jack Clark’ Rune Illusions.
But as soon as they made contact, a severe conflict erupted.
Boom! The ‘Jack Clark’ exploded with a sound.
“No good, there’s a problem with the structure. The complete runes clash too heavily; I need to rebuild from the foundation up.”
As Jack immersed the majority of his mind in constructing the foundation of the Secret Book, he still allocated a part of his attention to sense his surroundings.
With his current level of cultivation and Heart’s Eye Realm, if even the slightest hint of danger appeared within a hundred meters, he would immediately react.
Even king-level existences that concealed their aura and soul fluctuations couldn’t approach him without being detected.
Because his Heart’s Eye did not rely on spiritual or thought perception, but rather on an indistinct sixth sense—a feeling eerily profound and somewhat ‘buggy-‘
While the Heart’s Eye seemed a bit less present after breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, that was due to environmental reasons; in fact, the Heart’s Eye had always been playing a significant role.
Under the state of Heart’s Eye, no mutated creature could sneak up on Jack, and virtually no random Space Cracks could form without him sensing it just before they did.
Now back in the urban setting, the complexity of the terrain and environment still did not hinder the Heart’s Eye.
At times like these, Jack greatly admired his own forethought for choosing the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, a Sword Skill with average power, when he opted for his martial arts.
While keeping vigilant about his surroundings, Jack also emitted an invisible gravitational pull, gathering the energy between heaven and earth around him and absorbing it for refinement.
Simultaneously cultivating, contemplating, and constructing the foundation of the Secret Book, and remaining alert—it was a seamless process.
With the Divine Tyrant Body and Dragon Elephant Overbearing Body Method reaching grand accomplishment, Jack was essentially at the peak of the Sixth Heavens in terms of realm.
In such a state, his cultivation speed was fast. All he needed was to accumulate True Strength, expand his Dantian, and his cultivation would naturally reach the peak of the Sixth Layer..

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 209 Engraving Heaven and Earth, Fusion of the Six Major Talents, That Person Seems Like My Brother (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 209 Engraving Heaven and Earth, Fusion of the Six Major Talents, That Person Seems Like My Brother (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339
Based on his current rate of cultivation, Jack Clark estimated that he could break through to the Sixth Mid-Stage in half a month and reach the late period within three months, even without resources like the Blue Crystal.
Later, when he’d have to kill some Evil God Sect Cultists or traitors, he’d see if he could loot money’ from the corpses.
After that, he could exchange them for resources that would boost the growth of his True Strength, and perhaps he could reach the peak of the Sixth-level Heaven in two or three months.
By then, he would have probably created the Seventh Layer of the Secret Manual, allowing him to directly converge into the Seventh Stage True Martial Apparition.
As long as the resources kept up and the Secret Manual continued to improve, he would soon break through the Eighth Layer and step into the Nine Layers, with hopes of becoming a king-level cultivator within a year.
One-Year King, by that time, the entire Human Race would surely be shaken once again.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark’s lips curled up slightly, and this scene left the recording studio assistant who had been secretly watching him from a distance dumbfounded.
“Cough! Stop staring, Misss Jodie, even if you keep staring he won’t notice you.”
The bald middle-aged recording engineer said with some envy, “I heard this handsome guy is from the military and is also a cultivation genius.”
The assistant’s eyes widened as she exclaimed in a low voice, “A military cultivation genius! How could such a person come to be a bodyguard?”
The bald recording engineer said proudly, “Ordinary people definitely don’t qualify, but haven’t you thought about who our boss is? She’s the internationally known big star, Mathilda Ward.”
“Of course, just being a star isn’t enough, but it is said that her family is quite influential, and she has a high-ranking uncle in the military.”
“This time, as the boss is about to start her first global tour, that high-ranking military official directly sent two geniuses to temporarily protect her for her safety.”
“Our boss’s family is so powerful!!” The new recording assistant exclaimed with a face full of amazement.
The bald recording engineer declared haughtily, “Our boss has a large entertainment Group at her service, of course she’s powerful.”
Under the continuous reveal of various internal ‘rumors’ by the bald recording engineer, the assistant was soon distracted.
Like how a certain backup dancer beauty hooked up with a good-looking security guy, which receptionist received a bouquet yesterday, where the band drummer went after work yesterday-
jack Clark heard these stories too and could only remark on how rich the lives of ordinary people were.
Compared to these ordinary people, the days of those who practiced cultivation were quite monotonous, either spent cultivating or on the path to battle, but cultivating was still more exhilarating.
After all, this is the path that brings great power to oneself.
Not to mention reaching the pinnacle, just stepping out as someone from the Fifth or Sixth-level Heaven would trump most ordinary people in status.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark was on duty in the recording studio watching over Mathilda Ward, Damon Lopes, wearing a Daoist robe and sunglasses with an air of nonchalance, was wandering around the Group building.
“Hey, beauty, can I add you as a friend?”
“Sorry, my mobile phone is out of battery.”
“What a coincidence.”
“Yes, it is.”
“But no worries, I can help you charge your mobile phone.”
“Ah…?”
On the thirty-second floor, in the CEO Office, Crystal Boyce was busy dealing with the upcoming schedule and arrangements, while her assistant spoke with a bit of awkwardness.
“CEO, we have already received over thirty complaints this morning. Any attractive female employee with a good figure has been approached by Mr. Damon Lopes to add as a friend.”
“He has harassed almost every department, and the employees are very upset. Do you think we should give him a reminder?”
Crystal Boyce shook her head slightly, “Never mind, as a military genius, Damon’s actions today should not be judged superficially, there must be a deeper meaning behind them.”
Marla Fiore hesitated, “CEO, do you mean he’s doing this to patrol the Group, looking for ‘traitors’?”
“Exactly, after all, his mission is to protect Miss Jodie, and as a professional, he naturally needs to familiarize himself and check the surrounding environment and people.”
Marla Fiore had a sudden realization and expressed her admiration, “So that’s it.”
It was indeed a professional’s move; although his actions might make him appear frivolous, it effectively obscured his true purpose and wouldn’t alert any potential ‘traitor’.
At noon, in the private restaurant.
Mathilda Ward and Crystal Boyce went to the next room to rest after finishing their nutrient-rich meals, while Jack Clark and Damon Lopes sat at another table about ten meters away.
On their table were various dishes made from energy-rich Mutated Beast Meat. Waiting for Mathilda Ward and the others to leave, Damon Lopes excitedly whispered, “Brother Callum, there are so many beauties in this building, I’ve added thirty-something friends just this morning.”
Jack Clark looked at him with a curious expression, “Why are you adding them as friends? Are you pursuing one to be your girlfriend, or is it just for a one-night stand?”
As an Innate Awakened One, Damon Lopes only needed to reveal his identity and there would be plenty of beautiful women climbing into his bed without any pursuit.
“Heh heh, neither.”
Jack Clark grew even more curious, “If it’s neither, then what are you adding them for, to help you shop and haggle?”
Damon Lopes said with excitement, “Of course, it’s to chat! I’ve found chatting with these beauties to be especially interesting.”
“Just send them a red envelope, and they’ll start calling me handsome nonstop, some even invite me to go out shopping and drinking at night, saying they’ll wear their newly bought dresses for me.”
Cough, cough!!
Even Jack Clark nearly choked, and he had to ask, “How much money are you putting in those red envelopes?”
Damon Lopes said nonchalantly, “Not much, the red envelope’s maximum is just one thousand, so every time I send one, I send the full one thousand, which seems to get them really excited.”
“That’s good, I thought you were sending ten thousand at a time.” Jack Clark nodded..

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 209 Engraving Heaven and Earth, Fusion of the Six Major Talents, That Person Seems Like My Brother (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 209 Engraving Heaven and Earth, Fusion of the Six Major Talents, That Person Seems Like My Brother (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339 |
“A hundred thousand, how is that possible? Although, for us, killing a high-level alien beast nets us that much pretty easily, wouldn’t it be better to exchange that money for Contribution Points?”
“No way, do I look that stupid?” At that moment, Damon Lopes realized something.
“Not stupid,” Jack Clark smiled, “Just a bit ‘naive’.”
Then, Damon Lopes excitedly said, “Actually, chatting with those beauties is very interesting. They tell me about celebrity gossip, discuss fashion trends with me, or what dress to wear tomorrow.”
“Sometimes they will send me some of their private photos, which look very sexy. It feels like I suddenly have a lot of girlfriends.”
-I’ve decided, starting from today, Damon Lopes’s hobbies will be two:
cultivation and chatting with women.
“Your hobbies…are quite good,” was Jack Clark’s final comment.
The afternoon.
“One-two-one, walk… right, turn around, take a small half-step with the
music…”
in the dance rehearsal room, Mathilda Ward and the female dancers were practicing the choreography for a new song on stage, while the choreographer below was guiding their poses step by step.
in the corner of the rehearsal room, Jack Clark was still sitting on a chair, continuing to ‘read’ with his head down.
The next three days flew by quickly, with Jack Clark’s activities confined to the Cloud Sky Building, except for sleeping and washing Mathilda Ward was always within his field of vision.
The third day marked the start of Mathilda Ward’s global tour first concert.
Outside the largest stadium in South City, the surrounding streets were blocked off in the afternoon, denying access to vehicles, with law enforcement officers stationed at every intersection.
This tour was Mathilda Ward’s final farewell in her life, and also a cooperation
with the Federation’s official arrangement.
Therefore, the concert tickets were not for sale but were randomly drawn through the Cloud Heaven Group’s official website. All fans who wanted to attend the concert could sign up.
Each city allocated a certain number of tickets, and those who won were allowed to trade them privately. They only needed to register with their winning number and ID the day before the concert to attend.
Hence, since yesterday, tens of thousands of people from all over Eastern Summer had flooded South City via express trains, instantly filling up the surrounding hotels.
Now, as the sky slowly darkened, countless excited young men and women converged from all directions, their faces filled with excitement, eagerness, and anticipation.
“Line up, line up, ticket checking and entry are starting now.”
“Don’t push, everyone, there’s still an hour before the concert starts. Please take out your ID cards and go through security to enter.”
“Over here, we are giving away free glow sticks…”
“Hello, everyone, I’m Xiaoxiao, the host from South Television Station. Behind me is the concert site of the popular singer Mathilda Ward. Our station will broadcast this grand event live for you.”
“Earlier, Miss Ward’s agent revealed that all the proceeds from the concert merchandise will be donated to a charity fund to help children with congenital
diseases fight their illnesses.”
While tens of thousands outside started to enter, upstairs at the stadium s backstage, Mathilda Ward was sitting in her chair, surrounded by makeup artists and stylists bustling about.
Not far off, Jack Clark in a black suit and white shirt, wearing sunglasses, and Damon Lopes stood by the door, overlooking the vast crowd below.
Damon Lopes held a document in his hand, whispering.
“The security for this concert is divided into four parts: the outer perimeter is maintained by local Patrol Offices; the stadium interior security is provided by ordinary security guards hired by the company.”
“Around the stage, Lionel Lopez and others are responsible. If anyone tries to rush the stage during the concert, they’ll intercept them. We two serve as the final layer of protection.”
“These are the concert’s key points: the interactive segment in the middle, and the fan flower presentation at the end. Other than that, Mathilda Ward and the audience won’t have direct contact.”
“However, everything looks normal for now, at least the official back-end didn’t find any suspicious individuals during the first screening.
jack Clark nodded slightly, “The best is everything stays normal, so both of us can have it a bit easier.”
Of course, while they said this, both of them were aware that it was during the safest times that they couldn’t afford to let their guard down.
After all, the information showed that the two king-level soul avatars had already smuggled themselves in over half a month ago and might already be taking action in the shadows.
As the two were whispering, Mathilda Ward had finished applying her makeup for the opening of today’s event and came over, instantly giving both of them a
sense of amazement.
As the star of today, the already picturesque face of Mathilda Ward was adorned with light makeup, making her look flawlessly perfect.
Besides that, a row of tiny shimmering pieces were affixed near the corners of her eyes, making them sparkle under the lights.
in addition, she wore a figure-hugging white gown that was resplendent with silvery sparkles, its sleeves and neckline trimmed with lace patterns.
The dress flowed out from her waist, trailing behind her in a white fishtail silhouette, revealing knees covered by an underdress and showcasing ivory-like calves atop red crystal high heels.
Jack thought the phrases “regal and luxurious” and “peerless elegance” inadvertently.
With a smile playing on her lips, Mathilda asked, -What do you think? Isn’t my outfit for today beautiful?”
“…Miss Ward, you look very beautiful today,” Jack nodded.
Damon, with a beaming smile, said, -Sister llisa, even without makeup, you’re
the most beautiful.”
At that moment, Marla Fiore approached, glanced at her watch, and said, “llisa, it’s almost time. Next, you have a television station interview segment in the corridor downstairs.”
“Alright.”
Dressed in her sumptuous gown, Mathilda Ward led the way with Jack and
Damon following her down the stairs.
-Miss Mathilda Ward, the concert is starting in five minutes. Do you have anything you’d like to say to the audience here and your fans nationwide?” Facing the microphone and camera lens, Mathilda, with a poised and dignified smile, said, “Today is my first tour concert. Here, I want to thank all the friends who have followed and come to the concert…”
Meanwhile, during the live backstage interview broadcast, everyone in Eastern Summer who had an interest in Mathilda’s concert was watching the live stream.
This included mainly teenagers, as they were the main force in celebrity following.
In Mist River City, in a nice villa, six teenagers were also seated on the sofa, excitedly watching the broadcast on the big screen.
Teresa Wilson cheerfully said, “The concert is about to start, and Mathilda looks so beautiful today, even prettier than in her album’s music video.”
Next to her, the strong and muscular Glenn Clark nodded excitedly, “Yeah, very beautiful. But I think her songs are even better.
As Mathilda continued the interview while walking, the live broadcast camera inadvertently captured some scenes behind her, prompting Glenn to exclaim quietly.
“What’s that, Glenn?” another classmate asked curiously.
“Did you guys notice the person behind Mathilda?”
“Who?”
“The tall bodyguard in black clothes.”
Another teenager’s eyes immediately lit up: “That bodyguard wearing glasses looks so cool.”
“Uh… shouldn’t we be focusing on Mathilda? Why are you guys paying attention to a bodyguard? Could it be, Glenn, that you like to look at handsome guys?”
Glenn rubbed the back of his head, hesitating, “No, it’s not that. I just feel like that person looks like my brother.
Teresa shook her head: “You must be mistaken, Glenn. Your brother and mine went to the Southern Battlefield Trial. How could they possibly be bodyguards for a celebrity?”
“Seems like it,” Glenn nodded.
But as he looked at the figure occasionally flashing behind Mathilda on the big screen, Glenn couldn’t shake the feeling that it looked very familiar, as if the person really was his brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 210: The Arrogant Bodyguard, Blood God Descends, Domain Collision
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 210: The Arrogant Bodyguard, Blood God Descends, Domain Collision
Translator: 549690339
The venue, capable of accommodating sixty thousand people, was shaped like a semicircle with three sections: front, middle, and back. At this moment, the seats were already filled with spectators, all excitedly looking toward the stage straight ahead.
in their hands, they all held glow sticks distributed for free at the entrance, which would sprinkle some crystal powder when waved, just like shining stars, exceptionally brilliant.
Behind the stage, Jack Clark slightly lifted a corner of the curtain and looked out at the sea of people calmly, wondering if there might be a traitor among these audience members.
“Lights are normal.”
“Projector number three is fine.”
“OK, countdown starting, 10, 9, 8… Turn off the lights!”
Following the command from the central control, the entire venue went dark in an instant, followed immediately by the roar of a dragon’s cry.
Roar!
The vast venue burst into light as a hundred-meter-long Golden-scaled Dragon with double wings appeared in high altitude, and at the same time, streams of sparks burst from the stage’s edge.
In the dazzling light, the prelude to a song that many were familiar with began to play.
The wall at the end of the stage cracked open, and Mathilda Ward, dressed in full regalia, slowly walked out, followed by a bodyguard in a black suit, maintaining a three-step distance.
At this moment, white mist spurted from some cracks in the ground.
Suddenly, amidst the sparkling gold and swirling Cloud Mist, the girl appeared as if she were a Divine Dragon Goddess stepping out of legend as the dragon roared.
Through the eight large screens hung around the venue, everyone witnessed this stunning moment, and the entire venue erupted into excitement as countless young men and women stood up eagerly.
“Ilisa! Ilisa!…”
The shouts of tens of thousands drowned out the sound system, and the atmosphere was electric.
This center-of-attention feeling made Jack Clark, who was standing behind Mathilda, feel his blood boiling, reminiscent of the night of the Blood Moon when countless Mutated Beasts surged like a tide.
The same mountainous cries and tsunami waves made him want to grab his War Halberd and blast everything to oblivion… Cough! What am I thinking?
Jack shook his head, discarding the strange thoughts that had suddenly sprung to his mind.
The concert’s first song was a solo by Mathilda Ward, so as the 3D Golden Dragon in the air dispersed, a Light Beam landed on her, and she slowly walked towards the center of the stage, descending the stairs.
As an international star with a booming career, Mathilda Ward’s singing skills were indeed strong. Her voice was clear and gentle, pleasant to listen to, combined with the meaningful lyrics and upbeat rhythm.
Even Jack couldn’t help but praise its pleasantness.
But Jack’s brow furrowed almost immediately because he noticed he wasn’t drawing much attention, and the occasional gazes that did fall on him swiftly passed by.
Under such conditions, it was almost impossible to detect any potential hidden enemies.
With that thought, Jack’s gaze landed on Mathilda Ward.
At this moment, Mathilda had reached the center of the stage, her posture swaying slightly with the rhythm of the music, her dress fluttering, appearing both beautiful and spirited.
Not far away, a camera suspended in the air also captured this scene, moving through the air to record it and projecting it onto the screens.
However, just as tens of thousands were watching in rapture, a tall figure suddenly appeared – it was, unmistakably, the bodyguard Jack Clark standing behind Mathilda Ward.
“Man, what’s up with that guy?”
“Right, why’s he always standing there blocking the camera?” Although the young man in black on the big screen was cool and handsome with his sunglasses, everyone at the concert was there to see Mathilda Ward. Fortunately, as Mathilda moved, the camera followed her, and that man, whether a backup dancer or a real bodyguard, disappeared from the screen.
The show continued smoothly, without any surprises.
The girls on stage sang their hearts out, the dance partners moved to the beat, and the audience listened intently, except for the bodyguard in sunglasses who would occasionally appear on the big screens, which was annoying.
Over the next hour, Mathilda Ward changed her outfit three times, including multiple swaps among the dance partners, each costume different in style.
On stage, Mathilda Ward, dressed in a red-striped tight dress with a black trench coat over it, gently swayed her figure, surrounded by eight female dance partners.
With that familiar tune ringing out, tens of thousands were excitedly watching when,
on the big screen, the bodyguard in the black suit once again stood in front of Mathilda Ward, completely blocking her.
His expressionless face, behind the sunglasses, scanned all the people in the vast concert site as if he owned the stage.
“Damn, that bodyguard’s in the way again, move it, you’re blocking my view of Ilisa.”
“Oh, come on, bodyguard, move aside, don’t block the camera.
“Hey, hey!! Does that guy have a grudge against Ilisa? He’s deliberately sabotaging, always blocking the camera at crucial moments.”
“Where’s Cloud Heaven Group’s staff? Why isn’t anyone dealing with that bodyguard?”
Suddenly, the concert site was filled with indignant uproar, and many male students voiced their complaints about the bodyguard on stage; it was completely unacceptable.
At this time, not just the audience but the dance partners on stage were also confused about what prompted the bodyguard, who had been following Mathilda Ward for a few days, to act so crazily.
Lionel Lopez and the other bodyguards in the surrounding area were similarly puzzled about what Darren was up to today, constantly loitering on the stage.
Damon Lopes pressed his earpiece and said in a bewildered tone, “Brother Callum, you’ve blocked Sister Ilisa’s camera more than a dozen times. Aren’t you afraid of getting beaten up when you leave?”
In the middle of the stage, Jack Clark, who had intentionally blocked Mathilda Ward behind him, spoke calmly, “Do you think any of these spectators would dare, or rather, could beat me?”
As he spoke, he turned casually like someone with nothing to worry about, exposing Mathilda Ward behind him, who continued to sing, while he strolled over to the edge of the stage like he was on a leisurely walk..

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 210: The Arrogant Bodyguard, Blood God Descends, Domain Collision !
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 210: The Arrogant Bodyguard, Blood God Descends, Domain Collision !
Translator: 549690339
That appearance, that posture, seemed very arrogant.
Mathilda Ward just smiled as if she hadn’t seen it, and continued singing.
In the control room backstage of the concert hall, the director of the concert looked towards Crystal Boyce: “Boss Boyce, should we call that bodyguard down? He’s deliberately blocked the camera lens six times already.”
“…Don’t worry about him, just follow the normal rehearsal process.”
Although Crystal Boyce was also somewhat baffled, she knew that as a professional, Darren Callum certainly wouldn’t act without reason.
At the edge of the stage, Jack Clark looked arrogantly at the audience in front of him, ignoring their denunciations, but his gaze behind the sunglasses fell on the left side towards the front.
More than two hundred meters away, in the middle left side of the first-floor seating.
There, a woman in her early twenties was excitedly waving a glow stick, enjoying the concert like the rest of the surrounding men and women.
Looking at that rather average-looking woman, Jack’s expression became slightly solemn, “Such strong malice, and that feeling seems familiar.”
Earlier, when he first blocked Mathilda Ward from view, Jack felt countless malevolent gazes, tens of thousands of them.
Among these gazes, he felt a flash of strong malicious intent.
That malice differed from the instinctive dislike from ordinary people when he blocked their view. It was a deep, terrifying, evil gaze.
But with such a huge concert and sea of people, even he couldn’t distinguish it amidst the myriad of gazes converging; after all, his brain wasn’t a light brain computer.
However, such a situation was also comparatively easy to check since the venue was so large and most people were actually looking at the big screen.
This way, it was possible to first determine the direction, then eliminate it section by section around the stage, hence him repeatedly blocking the camera lens deliberately.
After narrowing down the range and capturing it repeatedly, Jack finally locked onto the target.
Thinking of this, Jack lightly pressed on the frame of his sunglasses: “Mr. Lopes, pay attention to Vertical 170, Row 55, that person has a problem.”
Instantly, Damon Lopes’s gaze sharpened below the stage, and a touch of purple thunder light flashed in his eyes, somewhat surprised: “Someone actually managed to sneak in, what audacity.”
Then, Damon Lopes asked, “Brother Callum, can you determine the strength of the opposer, whether they’re from the Blood God Sect or the Demon God Sect?”
Blood God Acunus obviously did not need to be mentioned; the Blood God Sect was established by it, while the Demon God Sect, belonging to the same Divine Sect Alliance, was established by the Purgatory Demon Race.
Becuase these Purgatory Demon Races and the demons and devils in mythical legends were somewhat similar, they also received worship from many crazed individuals who abandoned their souls for power.
Jack spoke calmly, “There are too many people and the auras are too chaotic to sense; if she doesn’t intend to start anything, let’s pretend we haven’t discovered her and wait until the concert is over.”
A concert with tens of thousands of people—if the opposer was very strong and an advanced cultivator battle erupted, even the aftermath could cause hundreds to thousands of casualties.
And that’s if the battle ended in the blink of an eye.
Otherwise, it’d be even more troublesome if a stampede incident were to occur.
After all, fifth-level or even sixth-level Heaven cultivators could burst into subsonic speed once they battled, with gestures that could collapse buildings and shatter the Earth.
This was also the reason why the officials strictly controlled cultivators from acting recklessly in the city.
Damon Lopes nodded subtly, “1 understand your meaning, should 1 notify the others?”
“Just inform Boss Boyce to check out her details; I doubt we’ll get much from it,” he replied.
Those who passed the first screening had no problems with their surface identities.
As for using the smart sunglasses’ facial recognition feature, due to the distance being too far and the crowd around being too large, even these high-tech sunglasses could not lock on.
During their quiet exchange, Damon Lopes casually walked over, positioning himself between that woman and Mathilda Ward in a straight line.
And so, the concert continued.
Beneath the stage, the bored Damon Lopes looked at Jack Clark swaying on the stage and couldn’t help feeling a bit envious.
The guy was handsome enough, but he was also making quite the scene today.
With his random acts of blocking the camera lens, he would surely be tomorrow’s top news in the entertainment industry of Eastern Summer.
However, in contrast to their ease, in the concert control room, Crystal Boyce’s gaze sharpened upon receiving Jack’s message: “So impatient, huh.”
With that said, Crystal Boyce turned to look towards the corner, where a young man was playing a game on his computer, clearly bored.
Crystal Boyce spoke in a serious tone, “Mr. Loore, check the identity and recent movement trail of the woman in seat Vertical 170, Row 55 on the first floor.”
“Sure, Boss Boyce.”
Soon, the woman’s identity was pulled up.
Dianna Reilly, from Dragon Mountain City in the Eastern Summer borderlands, twenty-five years old, with family assets worth tens of millions; her company mainly deals in overseas trade business.
She had cultivated before, but with extremely poor talent and officially registered as a Second Layer Heaven cultivator.
As the manager of her family’s company, Dianna Reilly had visited Cross Mountain Country for business a week prior, and had been normal since her return, with a clean identity.
“Just a Second Layer Heaven, but recently visited Cross Mountain Country,” Crystal Boyce mused.
“Mr. Loore, send her information to the Federal Intelligence Agency. Check what she did after going to Cross Mountain Country, who she met with, and keep a close eye on the people she had contact with.”
“Yes.”
At this time, during the interactive segment in the latter part of the concert, Mathilda Ward, surrounded by a group of dancers, walked down from the stage, immediately causing the professional bodyguards like Lionel Lopez to become solemn and quickly encircle the area.
“Ilisa, Ilisa….”

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 210: The Arrogant Bodyguard, Blood God Descends, Domain Collision_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 210: The Arrogant Bodyguard, Blood God Descends, Domain Collision_3
Translator: 549690339
Many people left their seats to crowd around the fence, excitedly reaching out, hoping to shake hands with Mathilda Ward as she came down from the stage.
Clinging to the microphone with her left hand and a face covered in sweat, Mathilda Ward’s smile was bright as she extended her right hand, preparing to interact with the fans.
But at that moment, the bodyguard in the black suit once again stepped between the crowd and Mathilda Ward.
Jack Clark, wearing sunglasses, looked particularly cold-hearted. He slightly lowered his head and whispered to Mathilda Ward, “Something’s not right, keep a bit of distance from the fence.”
Mathilda Ward’s gaze flickered slightly, her smile unchanged, “Everyone, don’t push, be careful, and watch your step…”
While continuing to wave at the fans, she instinctively stepped back about 2 meters, with Jack Clark standing between her and the crowd.
Behind the excited, jostling crowd, the woman named Dianna Reilly also shouted excitedly.
Therefore, the session of interacting with fans around the stage simply ended with Jack Clark’s intervention, and countless deadly gazes fell upon him.
“Boo! My only chance to get close to the goddess, ruined by that detestable bodyguard.”
“Yeah, that despicable guy.”
“Brothers, let’s dig out this guy’s real identity after the concert and viciously expose him online.”
“Right, let’s do it, he’s too arrogant.”
The concert continued, and quickly, more than two hours passed, and it finally reached its conclusion.
Amidst the calls for ‘One more song! One more!’, Mathilda Ward softly said into the microphone, “Thank you all for listening, for enjoying this wonderful time with me today.”
“Today, llisa is very happy. Even though the concert will end, the songs in our hearts will live on forever.”
“To avoid congestion next, please could the friends at the back start leaving slowly, and I will stand on stage watching until the last person exits the stadium…”
Under Mathilda Ward’s gaze, tens of thousands of spectators reluctantly left through various exits, a massive flow that took about half an hour to clear.
But there was one person who did not leave.
In the middle of the corridor some meters away from the stage, the woman named Dianna Reilly had her eyes closed, with a smile on her face, moving to the gentle music of the egress.
Her audience was Mathilda Ward on stage, the male and female dancers, and Crystal Boyce and Marla Fiore, who came out from backstage.
Additionally, there were Jack Clark on stage and Damon Lopes, Lionel Lopez, and other bodyguards below.
Even those who were usually slow to notice could see that something was off with Dianna Reilly, not to mention the professional bodyguards like Lionel Lopez all of whom wore grave expressions.
“Be careful.”
“There’s something wrong with this person.”
About a dozen bodyguards rushed to the stage to surround Mathilda Ward, their faint True Strength circulating, emitting dim lights in black, blue, and other colors.
At this point, Dianna Reilly slowly stopped, turned towards Mathilda Ward on the stage, and smiled, “Sorry, it’s been many years since I last felt this atmosphere of music, I got a bit carried away.”
“Let me introduce myself, I am Akunus.”
“Akunus!”
In an instant, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes’s expressions tensed.
They couldn’t help it; the name had too much intimidation power.
During the dark and chaotic era several decades ago, millions of humans died directly at his hands, and the number of indirect deaths was even higher, exceeding ten million.
With countless blood and wailing souls, he forged the prestige known as the Nine Blood Dragons Akunus.
At that moment, Jack Clark frowned slightly, as the aura emanating from this woman still felt like that of the Second Layer Heaven, leaving him somewhat disappointed.
Because this was merely a case of a spiritual possession by a will.
Not just Jack Clark, Damon Lopes also guessed the situation, shaking his head, “You scared me, I didn’t expect it to be just a spirit possession, how uninteresting.”
As for the other bodyguards and dancers, they looked on cluelessly. To these ordinary people and low-level cultivators, things like Evil God Sect Cultists were too far removed from them.
Let alone the supreme god’s name worshiped by the Blood God Sect.
At that moment, Mathilda Ward calmly said, “Akunus, you are a well-known figure. Isn’t it shameful for you to hide your face even when you come to see an ordinary person like me?”
‘Dianna Reilly’ revealed a sinister look on her face: “You are an ordinary person, but the people around you are not.” As she spoke, her gaze fell on Jack Clark and Damon Lopes.
“Today I am merely here to send a greeting, to notify you that 1 will soon take back what belongs to me.”
Boom!
Dazzling blood light erupted from ‘Dianna Reilly’ as the center, turning everything it passed into a blood color, becoming an endless Sea of Blood where billions of evil spirits wailed and struggled.
Facing such frightening might, Lionel Lopez and others all showed looks of terror on their faces, instinctively trembling with fear under that evil and terrifying aura that dominated all beings.
And at that moment, Jack Clark, wearing sunglasses, flashed and appeared twenty meters away at the edge of the stage, with a red radiance shining between his eyebrows.
Boom!
Instantly, a red light burst from the center of Jack Clark, similarly forming a blood river hell, mountain of corpses and sea of blood, with countless ferocious Mutated Beasts roaring madly as the Earth burned.
Boom!
Two invisible Blood Sea Hells, infused with the Power of Intent, collided with each other, causing the air to shake and explode continuously, forming rings of white shockwaves.
Under the powerful impact, the surrounding chairs were smashed to pieces and sent flying, crashing down everywhere.
Unlike the Blood Sea Hell with endless corpses sinking and floating, Jack Clark’s Domain Projection showed a shattered Earth with magma burning and crimson blood flowing and merging with the flames.
At this moment, within the two vast Blood Hells, the two individuals at the center were enveloped in overwhelming killing intent, with invisible winds whirling around them as if they were demon gods from Hell.
Such an astonishing scene rendered everyone speechless.
Especially the beautiful backup dancers behind Mathilda Ward, who never expected the quiet and cool young man who usually sat in the corner reading books to be so terrifying.
As the Domain Projections continued to clash, ‘Dianna Reilly’s’ eyes, ears, mouth, and nose gradually began to bleed, and her complexion grew paler and paler.
Being only a Low-level cultivator, she was utterly incapable of bearing the King’s Intent.
Boom!
Just at that moment, the Blood Sea collapsed thunderously, and ‘Dianna Reilly’ in the domain spewed out a mouthful of blood, staggering back several steps before barely managing to steady herself.
Looking at Jack Clark shrouded by the Blood River Hell at the edge of the stage, ‘Dianna Reilly’ let out a deep voice.
“To be able to shatter one of my Will Projections at such an age, you already have the qualification for me to know your name.”
“Is that so.” Jack Clark’s tone was indifferent.
“My Intent is about to dissipate, speak then, mortal, what is your name?”
To this, Jack Clark casually said, “Telling you doesn’t matter much, 1 neither change my name nor my seat, from the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy, Darren Callum.”
“Darren Callum! It’s you, weren’t you from the Sky Dragon Academy…” ‘Dianna Reilly’s’ face instantly showed astonishment.
And in that moment, the terrifying Will aura on Dianna Reilly’ suddenly disintegrated, and she collapsed on the ground with a thud, dead in an instant.
Seeing this, Jack Clark moved his Intent, and the surrounding mountains of corpses and sea of blood converged towards him, finally disappearing into the rune on his forehead that resembled a bloodstain.
In an instant, silence fell over the entire venue,
Looking at the tall figure wearing sunglasses at the edge of the stage, Lionel Lopez and the other bodyguards swallowed hard, feeling relieved that they hadn’t provoked them.
After the fright came shock and admiration.
Truly a genius from the military, having such terrifying strength at such a young age, he was an absolute monster.
Compared to these bodyguards and backup dancers, Mathilda Ward and Crystal Boyce appeared much calmer, although they were a bit surprised by ‘Darren’s’ perception, which was able to detect an enemy so subtly, worthy of a professional.
Below the stage, Damon Lopes couldn’t hide his envious expression.
Today, Brother Callum had really shown off, especially the way those beautiful backup dancers looked at him as if they wanted to devour him, which was enough to make anyone envious.
But wasn’t it said that the enemy would be left to me?

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 211: The Space That Carries
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Chapter 211: The Space That Carries
Everything, Three-headed Six-armed True Martial Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
The next day, the headline “The Most Arrogant Bodyguard in Entertainment History” topped the trending searches.
The post began by praising the grand spectacle of Mathilda Ward’s concert last night, including the costumes, props, and the cool and handsome dance moves; then, it moved on to complain about the bodyguard.
“This is the most arrogant bodyguard I’ve seen in my years in the entertainment industry.”
“Normally, after the concert starts, bodyguards are supposed to maintain order below the stage to prevent people from rushing onto the stage and disrupting the star’s performance.”
“But this bodyguard wandered around the stage from beginning to end of the concert, pacing back and forth.”
“Even that wouldn’t have been so bad, but whenever it was a critical moment, he would steal Mathilda Ward’s camera shots, sometimes even standing right in front of her – this isn’t a bodyguard, he’s acting like an old-timer.”
“With all that said, 1 have to commend Mathilda Ward’s temperament. Even in these circumstances, she didn’t get angry or upset; instead, she maintained a good state and finished the concert.”
“I bet that after this incident, this guy will definitely be gone, I’d gamble my career on it.”
In the middle of this article, many screenshots of the bodyguard in black were embedded, each depicting him barging into the key shots and blocking the camera.
Not only did this entertainment blogger post about it, but ever since the end of the concert last night, the word ‘bodyguard’ heated up like wildfire.
Especially on major platforms’ live broadcast videos, the barrage of comments featured phrases like ‘that damn bodyguard,’ ‘get lost,’ ‘don’t block Ihsa,’ etc.
However, the focus of many female students was different compared to the men.
-Although this bodyguard is hateful, haven’t you noticed how handsome he is?” “More than handsome, did you notice the way he walks? The invisible aura of dominance he exudes feels even more oppressing than my dad’s.”
“Who is your dad?”
“Mayor of Cloud Storage City.”
“This guy might be arrogant, but he’s so cool; watching him makes my heart flutter. Do you think this could be a special act for the concert to boost popularity?”
“Possibly…”
in Mist River City, at the dining table, Glenn Clark passed his mobile phone to Doris Clark: “Mom, take a look at this guy. I always feel like it’s Brother Jack.”
“Jack? Wasn’t he cultivating at the Alien Beast Battlefield?”
Doris Clark took the phone somewhat puzzled, her eyes landing on the black figure on stage, revealing a look of surprise.
After browsing with the phone for a while, Doris Clark suddenly said, “Jim, you haven’t told anyone else that this person looks like Jack, have you?”
Glenn Clark scratched his head: “Last night, while watching the concert live with the others at May’s place, I mentioned it, but I wasn’t sure at the time.”
Doris Clark fell silent for a moment: “Jim, don’t tell others that he’s your brother, understand?”
Although Jack Clark had slightly altered his facial features with a medicinal solution and was wearing sunglasses, as his mother, Dons Clark could not possibly fail to recognize him.
After all, it wasn’t plastic surgery; she was more than familiar with his figure and demeanor.
Yet the Jack Clark who was supposed to be at the Alien Beast Battlefield showed up at a star’s concert and hadn’t called home afterward, clearly indicating he was on some kind of mission.
Glenn Clark wasn’t stupid, he understood as soon as Doris Clark hinted at it and nodded, “Mom, I understand what you mean.”
Cloud Sky Building.
In Mathilda Ward’s private restaurant on the thirty-first floor, Damon Lopes put down his phone, looking at Jack Clark who was quietly eating breakfast opposite him, and said enviously, “Brother Callum, you’re famous now.” Jack Clark replied indifferently, “This sort of thing is meaningless to us. And by ‘famous,’ do you mean the people out there shouting to hit me with a club?” Mathilda Ward on the opposite side laughed, her eyes sparkling with humor, “It’s not all negative news. Many people are saying you’re very handsome.” “Moreover, some of my female fans have even sent private messages to my assistant, asking when 1’11 fire Brother Callum, so they can hire him as their personal bodyguard.”
The more Mathilda Ward spoke, the more envious Damon Lopes became.
Because last night had let this guy finish the act.
To this, Jack Clark shook his head; he didn’t expect the entertainment industry of this world to be so crazy.
At that moment, Mathilda Ward expressed some doubts, “What do you think was Akunus’s purpose last night? It willingly exposed itself.”
When the conversation turned serious, Damon Lopes thought for a while, ‘I think it probably wanted to intimidate us and shake things up a bit to test the protective forces around you.”
“Besides that, it likely wanted to see how the Federation would play its hand.” “If they station a strong man to protect you 24 hours a day, its True Body certainly wouldn’t dare to appear, but pretending to let down their guard would also seem unnatural.”
“After all, you are the Daughter of the Mysterious Martial Sky King, and it has already made you its target.”
With Akunus exposing itself this time, it had indeed disrupted many of the Federation’s plans at once.
Jack Clark also furrowed his brows in contemplation of the problem. Mathilda Ward shook her head, “Anyway, all of this doesn’t matter. It will definitely make a move before I die unless it decides it doesn’t want to.” Mathilda Ward didn’t continue on what ‘it’ wouldn’t want.
Then, Mathilda Ward smiled, “Let’s leave these issues for the higher-ups to worry about. Those think tanks are better at handling these things.
