Oh, we are taking an airplane this afternoon directly to Cross Mountain Country.” “The Martial Arts world there has been somewhat chaotic these past few years. The Intelligence Department has information that some cultivation families may be secretly colluding with the Evil God Sect, but it’s well-hidden.” To the side, the assistant Marla Fiore couldn’t understand, “Why would these people betray the Federation instead of just living good lives?”

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 211: The Space That Carries Everything, Three-headed Six-armed True Martial Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Chapter 211: The Space That Carries Everything, Three-headed Six-armed True Martial Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339
As Crystal Boyce’s assistant, Marla Fiore was not a cultivator, but she had long been involved in the core circle and thus knew a lot about the affairs of the cultivation world.
Mathilda Ward shook her head, “Sister Jessica, you’re not from the cultivation world, so you don’t understand.”
“For many people with average cultivation talents, in order to obtain great strength, they don’t care about the greater good of their race, nor do they care who they are trading with.”
“As long as power and resources from the mythical world are given to them, they would even sell their own souls.”
“For example, there’s a church within the Evil God Sect where, to join, one has to kill all of their relatives, sever all emotional ties, and be as mad as a demon.” In the afternoon, a row of luxury business cars was parked under the skyscrapers of Cloud Heaven Group.
This time, the first group heading to Cross Mountain Country consisted of more than thirty people, including Lionel Lopez and around ten other bodyguards, Jack Clark, Damon Lopes, Crystal Boyce, Mathilda Ward, and their assistants.
In addition to them, Mathilda Ward’s personal music team, makeup artists, costume designers, and some concert costumes would take the second airplane over.
This transnational flight was expected to take six hours, and it would take two hours before they could fly out of Eastern Summer Country’s territory.
On the transnational airplane carrying weapons, seated next to Mathilda Ward, Jack Clark took out the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Secret Book, his consciousness dipped, and he entered within the Secret Book.
The Void Space inside the Wordless Heaven Book could not only imprint Secret Books for the convenience of later learners to comprehend and study, but also possessed the function of materializing Spiritual Will.
This manifestation was different than computer data modelling; it could truly bear strength, and the Rune Illusions that condensed had real “Divine Might.” This made it very convenient for Jack Clark, as he could manifest his conjectures time after time, deducing Cultivation Methods.
At this moment, under Jack Clark’s Spiritual Will, the complete and intricate Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune emerged, constantly unfolding, with inner curves that seemed like lines yet abstract, continuously spreading, expanding. These expanding runes, derived from the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s “strength” and “defense,” combined with the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune to gradually form a human torso illusion.
Compared to a few days before, after Jack’s continuous exploration and perfection, the embryonic form of the Secret Book had already improved by “a bit,” at least now it had a torso…
Just at that moment, the Rune Torso exploded with a bang, sending Jack’s consciousness into shock.
This kind of Spiritual Will shock took even him a minute to recover from. Feeling his Spirit Power had been depleted a bit, Jack slightly furrowed his brows.
“Still no good, the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune itself represents strength, with a structure that’s complete and stable. Under such circumstances, it’s basically impossible to fuse another Giant Beast’s Rune Talents.”
“Furthermore, the Senior who created the Secret Book only constructed some basic runes on the Dragon Elephant Rune to boost its strength and defense to form the limbs and body.”
To further fuse another Giant Beast’s Six Major Talents on the Godly Dragon Elephant was more difficult than Jack Clark had imagined.
It was almost no different than fusing two Giant Beasts.
Over the past several days, Jack had tried over a hundred times. Although he made progress with each attempt, the further he went, the more conflicts he felt.
Yet, though the difficulty was great, the rewards would be immensely surprising if he managed to merge them successfully.
Therefore, Jack continued to rest for a bit before he resumed validating and constructing his own ‘path’, regardless of the spiritual shocks caused by the rune collapses.
Faced with the allure of a True Martial Body, which was stronger than ordinary Secret Books, Jack was greatly motivated.
Moreover, he had a significant advantage over those who created Secret Books. Compared to other Sixth Heaven cultivators, his Spirit Power was tens of times more substantial,
and due to his powerful soul, his Spiritual Will was very resilient.
Thus, while others had to rest after a few collapses in a day, he could continue dozens or even hundreds of times without stopping.
More than two hours later, as the airplane penetrated an invisible barrier, in an instant, all cultivators above Third Layer Heaven suddenly felt the Heavenly Energy become ‘diluted’.
It was like abruptly stepping from the primeval forest into a barren wasteland; the fresh and moist air turned dry, causing a bit of discomfort.
“We’ve left Eastern Summer Country,” someone said.
“So this is what the teacher meant when he said the Heaven and Earth outside are different from where we are,” remarked the martial arts hall youths sitting in the back of the cabin, all excited and agitated.
In contrast, Jack Clark, who was already aware of this, appeared very composed.
Alright, not to mention the big brother, but when Jack Clark first experienced it, he was quite astonished.
At this moment, Jack opened his eyes, weariness evident in them, and looked at the Wordless Heaven Book in his hand with a slight frown.
Curiosity piqued, Mathilda Ward sitting nearby asked, “Uncle Damon said, Brother Callum, you’re creating your own Secret Book, is it not going well?” Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “Not just ‘not going well,’ I haven’t even been able to construct the foundation of the Seventh Layer true martial arts phantom.”
That s not right,” Mathilda Ward said with some confusion. “Uncle Damon told me you’re practicing the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and you also exchanged for the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Secret Book for reference.” “Considering that both Cultivation Methods are derived from the same source and the core True Martial Rune is also of the same type, your creation of your ’ own Secret Book should be relatively smooth, right?”
In the Cultivation World, it was common to refer to a Secret Book of the same origin to recreate a new Secret Book based on oneself, on top of the original foundation.
In other words, that was the mainstream because very few people could create a complete Secret Book from scratch.
With this thought, Mathilda Ward became a bit curious, “Can you tell me what problems you’ve encountered? Although 1 can’t cultivate, I’ve read quite a bit about Cultivation Methods and Secret Books over the years..”

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 211: The Space That Carries Everything, Three-headed Six-armed True Martial Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: Chapter 211: The Space That Carries Everything, Three-headed Six-armed True Martial Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339
As the Daughter of the Heavenly King, Mathilda Ward’s exposure to cultivation practices surpassed that of many at high-order levels.
In addition, thinking she could engage in cultivation as a child, she had read countless books on Cultivation Methods. Sadly, due to a deficiency within her soul, she was completely unable to sense the Heavenly Energy.
Jack Clark thought for a moment and said, “By a stroke of luck, I once comprehended the rune power of another Giant Beast through its remnants and mastered its understanding.”
“That Giant Beast also specialized in strength and Defense, and it even felt stronger to me than the Godly Dragon Elephant.”
“You wish to fuse the Power of the Giant Beasts.” Mathilda Ward’s eyes paused momentarily.
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s the idea.”
“I want to use the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune as the foundation and fuse it with the rune construction of that Giant Beast to forge a stronger True Martial Body.”
“But the problem lies right here; the power of the Godly Dragon Elephant is overbearing, and the Talent Rune of that Giant Beast is almost the same, creating significant conflicts between them.”
Mathilda Ward pondered for a moment, “Based on the True Martial arts phantom that draws from the essence of a Mythical Giant Beast, it typically involves taking the essence of a single Giant Beast and integrating it within oneself.”
“There have been those who’ve considered fusing the powers of two or even several Mythical Giant Beasts to forge the strongest path of True Martial arts. Yet, all attempts have ended in failure.”
“The reason is that each Mythical Giant Beast’s power represents a complete rule. Even if they’re both strength-type Giant Beasts, their Core Runes are vastly different.”
“Just as there are no two identical people in the world, even if two people cultivate the same Advanced Skill, the True Martial Runes they condense will still have subtle differences.”
“So you’re saying it won’t work?” Jack Clark’s brow furrowed slightly.
Mathilda Ward shook her head, “Not necessarily, a strong man once thought of another method: assembly.”
“Assembly.”
“Right. Since it’s impossible to fuse the essence of two or multiple Giant Beasts, one might as well abandon the idea of completeness and instead piece together the strongest parts of these beasts.”
“To construct a shell that encompasses all, bearing all the powers of the Giant Beasts you wish to fuse. There’s no need for them to integrate with each other; they just have to operate without interfering.”
“Of course, if one could fuse these powers of Giant Beasts together, their might would naturally be terrifyingly powerful, akin to the fusion of rules.”
“However, no one has achieved this to date.”
Jack Clark slowly said, “It’s a bit like building a Mecha.”
Mathilda Ward nodded, “Exactly, the path that Simon follows is one of an external vessel bearing their True Martial path, using Mecha to support their power.”
“Regrettably, while their Mecha combat capabilities are indeed strong, becoming overly dependent on external forces makes their path extremely arduous at the Eight and Nine Layers.”
“Besides, the method of fusion between human and beast employed by the people of Berlin actually holds many points worth referencing. After reaching the Seventh Layer Heaven, they can even use the true martial arts phantom to transform into a Giant Beast.”
“Brother Jack, haven’t you two Secret Book quotas yet to claim? I think you might consider choosing one from Berlin and one from Simon.”
“You’re only at the early stages of the Sixth Heaven now; there’s truly no need to rush. Taking your time to perfect your path will lead you further.”
Mathilda Ward’s words enlightened Jack Clark.
Yes, if fusion is impossible, then I might as well take myself as the blueprint to piece together and construct a humanoid True Martial arts phantom of my own.
In due time, with the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune as the core, the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s Defense, swiftness, and regeneration as the body, and strength, Thunder, and Golden Elame forming the six arms.
And for the sake of aesthetics, it could even be designed as three-headed and six-armed.
Of course, this combination isn’t as simple as just assembly; it also involves the integration and connection between numerous Talent Runes, a point that could be addressed by referring to the genetic Secret Books of Berlin and Simon’s Mecha True Martial arts.
Luckily, because he hadn’t completely comprehended the God Elephant Secret Book yet, he hadn’t claimed any other books; now his two available quotas could come in handy.
And as for the True Martial shell that can hold and bear everything, what could be more apt than the Innate Space Runes? Or even starting over by constructing with the Innate Space Rune as the core foundation.
Of course, this is just one idea; another would be to base it on space, constructing a three-headed six-armed True Martial Battle Body centered on the talent of the Thunderflame, without the need to fuse with the Dragon Elephant.
With that thought, a smile spread across Jack Clark’s face.
Because he discovered this method seemed genuinely feasible and why it hadn’t occurred to him before was because he had read too few “books” recently and had gotten stuck in fixed ways of thinking..

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - 212 Remodeling Beast Body, Nine­headed Flood Dragon, It Actually Dares to Fight Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: Chapter 212 Remodeling Beast Body, Nine-headed Flood Dragon, It Actually Dares to Fight Back
Translator: 549690339
It was on the airplane that Jack Clark thought of the Innate Space Rune.
Under the deep sea, within the Ice Crystal Palace, the Thunderflame Beheamoth lay on the steps, pondering the scale between the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon.
The Silver Giant Dragon, feeling watched, shrank its neck and couldn’t help but growl, “Brock Abbott, why do you keep staring at the Great Scythia?”
The Thunderflame Beheamoth came back to reality, its large mouth slightly open as it growled, “Nothing, I was just thinking.”
“Growl! Really?” The Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat skeptical, always feeling like the Thunderflame Beheamoth was pondering something nefarious just before.
When the two Giant Beasts roared, even their low growls shook the palace and made the surrounding water surge.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Beheamoth growled, “Scythia, could you lend me the space runes merged into the scales on your forehead for my contemplation?”
“Growl! Brock Abbott, what are you up to?” The Silver Giant Dragon stood up abruptly, its left claw covering its head, warily eyeing the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Innate runes form naturally from the power of Heaven and Earth under special environmental conditions, containing some sort of Law Power.
Under such circumstances, whether it’s a ‘Person’ or another creature, once discovered, as long as there’s a compatibility with the rune, it can carry the Innate and merge the rune into its body.
And because the rune is Innate and complete, as long as there are no accidents, one can cultivate or grow to the Ninth Heaven Peak, similar to an Innate Awakened One.
And with even a bit of luck, one could ascend to the throne and become a Mythical Creature.
That was also why Scythia had been confined by her mother to the territory in the past, not being allowed to go out.
As long as she ate and drank well and grew slowly, with an Innate Rune merged into her being, and under the guidance of a Mythical Giant Beast, becoming a Mythical Creature was just a matter of time.
And because it had already merged, for others to obtain the Innate Rune would mean having to kill her.
Moreover, after killing, the obtained runes would also be incomplete, only part of the inscribed markings on the body, as the core of the Law Charm had already merged with their soul.
This was the reason for the Silver Giant Dragon’s instant vigilance.
If it hadn’t been for over half a month of association, being acquainted’, the recent words of the Thunderflame Beheamoth would have been enough to trigger a Giant Beast conflict.
“Growl! Don’t be nervous, Scythia, we’re ‘good friends’ who got to know each other through fighting, I won’t actually take your stuff away,”
the Thunderflame Beheamoth growled, “I’ve just had some insight into power after my recent breakthrough and wished to compare it with your runes.” “Really?” The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes showed suspicion but gradually lowered its guard.
“I surely wouldn’t deceive you, look…”
As it spoke, the Thunderflame Beheamoth extended its right claw, and suddenly dozens of fine scales lit up one by one, emitting an invisible, binding force field fluctuation.
The runes inscribed on these scales were weak, but when dozens were layered together in a matrix, they formed a strong, hundred-fold force field.
Hu!
As golden flames burned on its right claw, a golden fireball five meters in diameter quickly took shape.
With a steady stream of Golden Flame energy pouring in and the force field compressing it, the fireball gradually emitted a scorching wave that even startled the Silver Giant Dragon.
“This is my harvest from the past few days: using my sturdy scales as carriers, inscribing a rune with a magnetic constraint on them.”
“A single one of these runes has weak power, but with dozens stacked, they form a powerful binding force field.
“With the current intensity, I can compress tenfold a tenth of the Flame Power within my body, to explode with more potent lethality in battle.”
“And if I later inscribe thousands of these runes across my entire right claw, the binding force field will be stronger, perhaps allowing me to compress the Golden Flame up to a hundred-fold.”
At this point, the Thunderflame Beheamoth was somewhat excited.
It had not expected that a simple test of the theoretical magnetic confinement of plasma would prove applicable to cultivation.
Although the rune’s constraining magnetic field and the Golden Flame are not ordinary Plasma Flames, the principle was not very different.
Moreover, since the runes were embedded in scales as carriers, they usually remained dormant.
Only when needed, and when the Qi Blood within was stimulated, would they form a powerful binding force field to gather and compress flame or Thunderbolt Power.
This was something humans couldn’t achieve.
Because each rune was an energy convergence point, formed by the merging of Spiritual Will with Qi Blood, simply put, like a ‘motor’ with special power.
If there were too many runes within the body, this would obstruct the flow of True Strength, which is why one couldn’t cultivate too many Secret Skills.
But this was of no concern to Giant Beast Type Creatures, as they had no True Strength and did not need to cultivate.
Therefore, if the Thunderflame Beheamoth did inscribe its entire right claw with runes, not to mention a hundred-fold compression of the Golden Flame, even tens of times compression would be terrifying.
Moreover, this compression was constant, and not like the uncontrollable state a few days prior.
In battle, holding a fireball with temperatures exceeding hundreds of thousands of degrees Celsius, containing a hundred-fold Power in its claw, it could obliterate anything.
This was the path the Thunderflame Beheamoth planned to take next.
In the past few days, Jack Clark had been multitasking: on the one hand, he was deducing the Secret Book of the human body, and on the other hand, he was pondering the future path for his beast body.
Unlike humans who follow the Law Path, Mutated Creatures follow the path of physical Evolution, eventually awakening their talent or even evolving into Divine Power.
And such Divine Power is just another manifestation of the Law, except the Giant Beast’s Law Power is fused with the physical body..

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 212: Transforming the Beast Body, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, It Actually Dares to Fight Back_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 212: Transforming the Beast Body, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, It Actually Dares to Fight Back_2
Translator: 549690339
Therefore, Mutated Creatures and even Giant Beasts really don’t need to practice any Cultivation Methods; they just need to undergo Evolution and grow, and then naturally possess great strength.
Of course, the main reason is that Giant Beasts can’t cultivate; they have no inheritance, don’t know how to think, and cannot analyze or progress themselves.
This is the biggest difference between humans and Mutated Creatures.
And although the Thunderflame Behemoth doesn’t need to cultivate, that doesn’t mean the knowledge Jack Clark learned is useless to it.
For example, using ‘Martial Arts’ with its beast body to fight can unleash even stronger combat power.
Or inscribing various functional Basic Runes on its body or scale armor, consciously amplifying or partially remodeling its body to make itself stronger.
Just like now, only a little modification of the right claw has significantly increased its close-combat capabilities.
The next goal of the Thunderflame Behemoth is to condense magnetic field constraint runes on both scale-clad double claws, strength enhancement runes on both arms, and Burst runes on both legs.
Besides this, it plans to inscribe some basic functional runes around its tail, tail tip, Dorsal Fin, and even all over its body.
Although these runes have average functions individually, they are numerous, and because they are basic, there is almost no conflict between similar types of runes.
Moreover, since the full-body scales armor of the Thunderflame Behemoth is the strongest Transcendent Material, being powerful, solid, and having high Energy Conductivity, it is the best carrier for runes.
Once the Thunderflame Behemoth really completes this step, its strength will become incredibly terrifying.
Of course, the Silver Giant Dragon does not know any of this, but even so, it is amazed by the golden flames in the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claws and roars in astonishment.
“Brock Abbott, how did you do that?”
“Roar! It’s simple, just condense the power of the runes and inscribe them on the scale armor,” said the Thunderflame Behemoth nonchalantly.
But what seemed easy for it was incredibly shocking for the Silver Giant Dragon: “No wonder Joe and Domination both say you are smart, Brock Abbott, you’re amazing!”
Once a Mutated Creature evolves into a Mythical Creature, breeding offspring becomes very difficult.
Because the birth of each offspring consumes a large amount of their Life Origin.
Of course, in such cases, the offspring of Mythical Creatures are very powerful, just like those demigods in Mythical Legends, who are innately endowed with part of their parents’ strength.
The education of offspring by Mythical Creatures consists of using Spiritual Imprints to transfer all the ‘experience’ they know deep into the offspring’s bloodline.
This experience includes their understanding of Heaven and Earth, their grasp of strength, and as the offspring grow and their bloodlines awaken, they naturally learn it all.
Therefore, the very concept of ‘learning’ is absent in the consciousness of these creatures, let alone wondering why their power manifests as such, or why they can release fire or ice.
The Thunderflame Behemoth roared, “How about it, Scythia, do you want to learn? If you want to, 1 can teach you.”
“Roar! Yes, the Great Scythia also wants to become stronger,” the Silver Giant Dragon nodded excitedly.
The corners of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s mouth turned up slightly, appearing quite ferocious as it roared, “Learning is no problem, but humans have a saying, ‘one good turn deserves another.’
“I will pass on to you the force field constraint runes I have mastered, can you also let me comprehend your space runes, Scythia?”
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon looked wary again.
To fully display the effects of a fused innate rune, aside from killing its possessor, the other party must voluntarily spend their Soul Power to activate it.
This is different from using energy to activate runes for combat.
This type of display is more complete, bearing the full character of the innate runes, but the cost is significant consumption of spirit strength and Soul Power, and one’s own foundations would also be exposed.
Because of the fusion with innate runes, space is actually the core power of the Silver Giant Dragon; the wind and ice it often displays come from its mother’s inherited power.
As for why it uses its space power sparingly, obviously it is because the consumption is too great, and also to avoid exposure before it reaches Level 9 or even becomes a Mythical Creature.
Like now, the Thunderflame Behemoth has always been eyeing its runes.
The Silver Giant Dragon hesitated for a moment, then roared, “I can let you comprehend it, but you must promise to help me kill that many-headed guy.” “That Nine-headed Flood Dragon!” The Thunderflame Behemoth hesitated for a bit.
Today the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t go out to patrol its Territory, but lay in the Ice Crystal Palace because it had been hit.
Yes, at Level 8 Early Stage, with a double bloodline of king and dragon species, it had been struck by a Nine-headed Flood Dragon at Level 8 Late Stage.
The territory of that Giant Beast was over a thousand kilometers away from the Dragon Palace, in the Southeastern direction, deep into the Outer Sea.
Recently, the Silver Giant Dragon has been sweeping around with Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle, expanding its Territory, and then yesterday afternoon, it encountered that Nine-headed Flood Dragon.
According to the description of the Silver Giant Dragon, at the time, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was lying down sleeping, its body emitting the aura of an Eighth Level Beast, but it thought it was just an ‘ordinary’ Extraordinary Creature.
In such a case, naturally, the thing to do was to attack, knock down the other party first, then see if it could be subdued.
And of course, the result was a failure.
As a Late Stage Eighth Rank Beast with the benefits of king’s talent, that Flood Dragon’s power was terrifyingly fearsome, even touching upon a whisper of a Level 9 Giant Beast’s might.
With all nine dragon heads roaring forth, the Silver Giant Dragon, Tiger Whale, and Dragon Turtle were all suppressed.
And if the Silver Giant Dragon hadn’t faced it head-on, the Tiger Fish Grand General and Tortoise Prime Minister would have sustained heavy injuries or even been killed instead of just minor injuries.
Seeing they couldn’t win, the Silver Giant Dragon took the risk of sustaining minor injuries to cover Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle as they retreated.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 212: Modify the Beast Body, Nine­headed Flood Dragon, It Dares to Counterattack s
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Chapter 212: Modify the Beast Body, Nine-headed Flood Dragon, It Dares to Counterattack s
Translator: 549690339 |
At this point, the Silver Giant Dragon did not disgrace its role as the King of the Dragon Palace, showing a sense of responsibility, and then feeling depressed about it from last night until now.
After all, it was supposed to be the King of the Beasts that swept across the oceans of this world, and it did not expect to be defeated by a stronger Giant Beast not long after gaining prestige.
However, although a Level 8 Late Stage King Blood Giant Beast was strong, if it teamed up with the Silver Giant Dragon, it was not impossible to fight it.
At this thought, the Thunderflame Behemoth, which had been studying its strength after the breakthrough, let out a low growl: “The other party actually ignored your invitation, Sethia, and even fought back against you, unforgivable.”
“Let’s go, kill it.”
Accompanied by a roar, the Thunderflame Beheamoth suddenly stood up, its menacing 67-meter-long body covered in scale armor, with a towering Dorsal Fin, exuding an invisible sense of terror.
Although it hasn’t gone out to hunt Unique Beasts these days, but with the continuous absorption of the remaining energy of the golden fruit and Growth Crystals, Thunderflame Behemoth has grown another 2 meters.
In addition, Sethia has grown to 75 meters in the last half month with the help of Growth Crystals, and its aura has become even more powerful.
Although this fellow sneaked out, it still brought some good things in its pocket, like the Golden Light Fruit it took out that night.
However, these resources should not be much, and it’s not enough for it to eat by itself, so the Thunderflame Behemoth did not covet them.
After all, no matter what, it is a “grown-up” consciousness, and would not go so far as to coax a “little girl’s” things.
It’s just that although the Silver Giant Dragon’s body is slightly larger than the Thunderflame Beheamoth, it is not as ferocious and fierce as the Thunderflame Beheamoth, making it look a little weaker in terms of aura.
Seeing Thunderflame Beheamoth willing to take action, the Silver Giant Dragon, who had originally come to ask for its help, was immediately invigorated and excitedly climbed up and roared.
“Roar!! Kill that guy, and make sure it knows the consequences of angering the Great Sethia.”
“Roar! Charge!”
Accompanied by the roar, the two Giant Beasts stirred up the surging sea water as they swam out of the palace and quickly disappeared into the dark sea.
As for the other members of the Dragon Palace, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had been chased out by the Thunderflame Behemoth in the morning to find good things.
Since the Silver Giant Dragon took over the Dragon Palace and the Thunderflame Behemoth fell into hibernation, the Tiger Kingfish has been up to no good, always following the Silver Giant Dragon around to fight.
Although they have completely swept away the territory within a range of thousands of kilometers, the problem is that it’s useless.
Those Level 7 Colossi were either driven away or killed by them, leaving behind an “empty” sea area without any substantial gains.
Only those Mutated Creatures of Level 4 or higher could be used as food to eat.
After the Tiger Kingfish went to search for resources, the Dragon Turtle went to patrol their occupied Resource Points and collected Growth Crystals on the shore every evening.
Under such circumstances, it had almost really become the Tortoise Prime Minister in charge of internal affairs.
At the depth of more than 5,000 meters in the Dark Sea, the cold was bone-chilling, the water pressure extremely heavy, and the environment pitch-black and silent, with large black shadows flashing in the darkness from time to time.
A small hill rose several hundred meters on a desolate seabed plain.
At the foot of the mountain, a giant beast measuring more than 130 meters in length, with a pitch-black body and nine hideous Flood Dragon heads, lay quietly in sleep.
In this sea area, the Heavenly Energy which was several times denser than in other places permeated, and was swallowed and exhaled by the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, forming nine vortices.
At this moment, two ferocious Giant Beasts appeared in the distant darkness..

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 213: To succeed in the underworld, one must have power and background: King Ghidorah the Dragon (seeking monthly tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Chapter 213: To succeed in the underworld, one must have power and background: King Ghidorah the Dragon (seeking monthly tickets)
Translator: 549690339
Roar!
Simultaneously sensing the aura of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a fierce roar, and its overbearing, ferocious Dragon Might erupted.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Substantial, cyan-colored storms stirred underwater, scattered with ice crystals, instantly creating a wild vortex storm spreading across a range of hundreds of meters.
As a Level 8 World Scale Elemental Beast, even when dwelling in the deep sea, its aura remains largely unimpaired and even more potent.
Boom!
As the Thunderflame Behemoth rose from the shattering of the seabed under its feet, an ancient, ominous aura erupted and shook the depths.
Following this, dazzling flames and lightning emerged.
The surrounding seawater exploded as the temperature reached 5000 degrees Celsius and a range of 200 meters was engulfed in golden flames mixed with destructive thunder.
Centered on the Golden-blue Thunderfire Domain, boiling seawater formed circles of waves that violently diffused in all directions, reverberating across a range of hundreds of meters.
This was the true might of a Level 8 Beast that possessed king-level potential.
In the past, the Ancient Giant Crocodile grew to Level 8 by constantly devouring Growth Crystals, yet tamed to the prowess of an ordinary beast.
Similarly, the Deep-sea Water Ape, also a Mutated Creature born from resources, remained an average beast even when it reached Level 8, let alone forming a domain.
Roar, roar, roar!!
At this fearsome intensity, the hibernating Nine-headed Flood Dragon was instantly jolted awake, its horrific dragon heads letting out enraged roars.
The upper body of the Flood Dragon rose, its nine necks and dragon heads writhing, releasing an aura filled with an ancient king’s dominance.
Boom!! Centered on the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, a domain of scorching red flames mingled with the mysterious azure frost enveloped the surrounding region, covering an array of 300 meters.
Unlike the Thunderflame Behemoth and the Silver Giant Dragon’s domains, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s realm seemed to contain a peculiar gravitational force.
Under the influence of this invisible heaviness, the surrounding seawater became murky and deep, and no signs of splintering destruction emerged.
“Roar! Scythia, I will attack from the front, while you control the rear with ranged attacks. When the opportunity arises, unleash a fatal blow!”
As the Thunderflame Behemoth roared and its body moved, thunder and flames enveloped it, and the ground shattered beneath its feet. Countless broken pieces of dirt were dried and melted by the scorching heat, turning into magma.
Yet, this magma scarcely flowed far before it cooled down in the rolling seawater.
Roar, roar, roar!! The ferocious Nine-headed Flood Dragon roared, and as surrounding flames and frost circled, its colossal body lunged fiercely at the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Within the blink of an eye, they had crossed kilometers in distance.
Boom!
The first to make contact were the Thunderflame Domain and the Icefire Domain, and as they collided, a brilliant impact erupted, summoning enormous waves, lighting up the dark depths.
The two destructive forces, each carrying a domain intertwined, neutralized each other while the encased beasts charged towards one another.
The Thunderflame Behemoth’s double claws were wide open, intertwined with golden flames and blue lightning, and its Talent’s hundred-fold power caused even the space between the claws to distort.
At the same time, the three most massive and horned dragon heads of the Flood Dragon, enveloped in black energy, snapped ferociously at the Thunderflame Behemoth like a bolt of lightning.
Boom, boom!! A destructive light of gold and blue burst out, accompanied by shattering scales and spurting blood. ‘Two of the black dragon heads screeched in agony.
Only after unleashing the top-level Strength Talent, transformed into an Innate Divine Ability, could one display the formidable power of a hundred-fold instantaneously, shattering everything in its way.
If not for the Flood Dragon’s king-level bloodline and Level 8 Late Stage rank, bestowed with a sturdy body strengthened by the domain and energy, this single blow would have killed it instead of merely wounding it.
Boom! The instant the Thunderflame Behemoth sent two dragon heads flying, another black dragon head roared and fell like lightning.
As black energy circulated on its sharp teeth, the black dragon head halted against the scorching flames and thunder, biting fiercely into the Thunderflame Behemoth’s shoulder. Amidst the cracking sounds, hardened scales revealed a series of cracks.
However, that was it, as the black dragon head agonizingly growled, unveiling the harrowing power of its bite, only to just break the outer layer of the scales.
Roar! Seeing its bites doing little, the black dragon head let out a vicious roar, and the muscular explosion of its massive neck attempted to hurl the Thunderflame Behemoth… to no avail.
At once, the violent and ruthless atmosphere between the two beasts paused, as the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s eyes revealed astonishment.
After reaching Level 8, the flesh density of the Thunderflame Behemoth grew more terrifying, resembling a nightmarish creature forged from a super alloy harder than normal, considerably heavier in weight.
Under such circumstances, even the awe-inspiring Nine-headed Flood Dragon could hardly throw the Thunderflame Behemoth with a single head. If its body managed to coil around, maybe it would have some use.
Roar! Suddenly, as the Thunderflame Behemoth roared menacingly, it fiercely grasped the black dragon head, and in the blink of an eye, unleashed a daunting force.
Boom! The hundred-meter-long Nine-headed Flood Dragon blasted the seawater, its massive body plunging into the hillside hundreds of meters away, surrounded by its fire and frost domain.
Instantly, half of the hillside crumbled, seawater exploded, countless shattered pieces of dirt and rock flew, and were crushed in the blink of an eye by the fire and frost domain.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Thrilled by flinging the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Thunderflame Behemoth roared towards the sky, surrounded by golden flames and thunder, as scorching magma tumbled beneath it, resembling an apocalyptic beast that stepped out of a myth..

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 213: To mingle, one needs power and background, Dragon King Ghidorah (Seeking monthly passes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chapter 213: To mingle, one needs power and background, Dragon King Ghidorah (Seeking monthly passes)_2
Translator: 549690339
This scene left the distant Silver Giant Dragon dumbfounded.
Although it had long known that the Thunderflame Behemoth’s physical body was terrifying and unparalleled in close combat, it didn’t expect the Nine-headed Flood Dragon to be suppressed and sent flying just from meeting it face-to-face.
It seemed that after the breakthrough of the Thunderflame Behemoth this time, its strength had increased even more than what it had imagined.
At this time, the sea water in the distance burst open, and the body of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon stood up halfway. Its numerous dragon eyes were filled with fury as it looked at the distant Thunderflame Behemoth.
Roar, roar, roar!!
The two dragon heads with purple single horns had their mouths wide open in anger, and two purple rays instantly penetrated the sea water, emitting a terrifying gravitational force that enveloped the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Boom! The Thunderflame Behemoth’s figure suddenly sank, its knees buried in the seabed, and the ground instantly shattered, causing a large amount of magma to explode.
At the same time, the mouths of the two Nine-headed Flood Dragon heads with red single horns and the two with blue single horns suddenly opened inan ger > gathering endless fire and frost power within.
At this moment, a dozen-meter-long white ice spear, surrounded by a cyan spiral wind, emerged and burst forth underwater at a terrible speed exceeding the speed of sound, instantly piercing through the realm of ice and fire.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the bombardment of hundreds of ice spears, the skulls of the
Nine-headed Flood Dragon were constantly shaking, and the gathering breath in their mouths was interrupted, with the shockwaves causing various colors of the light to flash.
Boom!
A hundred meters of land shattered, and the Thunderflame Behemoth disappeared from its original position in an instant. A vacuum tunnel with a diameter of tens of meters was suddenly formed underwater.
It was a Destruction Tunnel created by the Thunderflame Behemoth with indescribable speed. The sea water swarmed in from all directions, flooding it in an instant.
At the same time, the domain of the distant Nine-headed Flood Dragon collapsed, and its huge body let out a scream before it slammed into the hillside behind it.
Boom!
At that instant, the already-half-collapsed hillside, over four hundred meters high, was completely shattered. The ground trembled, and smoke and dirt mixed with sea water rushed in all directions, the rumbling sound lingering endlessly under the sea.
Roar, roar, roar!!
As dragon heads shattered pieces of debris, accompanied by the eruption of flames, lightning flashes, and frost pulling and tearing, the two giant beasts began to fight madly in the ruins.
I he ground collapsed and the sea water exploded wherever they went, malting for a terrifying sight.
In the face of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s terrifying close combat ability, even the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which was much larger and two minor levels higher, was severely suppressed.
With invincible Defense, the Thunderflame Behemoth blatantly ignored the dragon head’s bites, and they exploded under the Hundred-fold Power of their double claws, causing the scales to crack and the flesh and blood to blur.
Every time the Nine-headed Flood Dragon tried to keep its distance from the Ihunderflame Behemoth and avoid close combat, it would be interrupted by the Silver Giant Dragon.
The distant Silver Giant Dragon had completely transformed into a ‘Mage,’ its eyes showing excitement as it continuously fired countless ice spears with flapping wings.
Each one was over ten meters long, like Ice Spearmissiles, exploding on the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, making it roar continuously. If it weren’t for its freezing power, it would have been frozen a long time ago.
In fact, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s combat prowess was terrifying. The three black single horned dragon heads among the nine were strong and tenacious, with fearsome strength and defense, making them proficient at close combat.
Apart from that, they also possessed supernatural fire, frost, and Gravity Line powers.
In this situation, the giant beast was perfect for both close and ranged combat, and its physical body was also tempered to be extremely strong, making it truly worthy of being a beast with a king-level bloodline.
But unfortunately, today it met two equally powerful giant beasts teaming up to besiege it.
In particular, the Thunderflame Behemoth, which was unrivaled at the same level in close combat, had no room to fight back when it was unable to pull away and exert its innate abilities.
After more than half an hour, the violent deep sea gradually calmed down.
1 he murky seabed within a range of more than ten kilometers turned into ruins. The ground collapsed, the small hills shattered, and the exhausted Nine-headed Flood Dragon, over a hundred meters long, lay on the seabed.
Almost every head on the nine dragon heads had cracked scales, and their flesh was a blur. The three strongest black single horn dragon heads were taking feeble breaths and bubbling.
I he Thunderflame Behemoth beside it had already retracted its domain, with only the six feathered horns on both sides of its head still jumping with golden flames, forming the Flame Crown.
Combined with the terrifying aura emanating from its body and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon lying beside it, the Thunderflame Behemoth now looked like a Giant Beast Monarch.
Invincible, overbearing, ferocious.
However, the Thunderflame Behemoth wasn’t completely unscathed. Its shoulders and abdomen had been bitten and crushed by the desperately erupting dragon heads, exposing the burning, flame-infused muscles beneath.
It was just that these wounds were healing at a visible speed at this moment, and scale armor was growing back.
So perverse!
At this time, the distant Silver Giant Dragon retracted its domain, took a step forward, spread its wings slightly, and walked over. It looked up slightly with slanted eyes, proudly roaring at the Nine-headed Flood Dragon lying on the ground.
“Roar! This is what happens when you provoke the great Sethia. Now you know how powerful our Dragon Palace is.”
Roar, roar!! The fiercely defiant Silver Giant Dragon looked at the Nine-headed Dragon lying weakly on the ground, and the strong refusal showed in the eyes of the nine dragon heads.
“Roar, roar, roar!! If it weren’t for that guy’s help, you wouldn’t be able to beat
me…”
The nine heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon roared and snarled, issuing intermittent spirit waves. Although it had lost, its eyes were filled with intense refusals.
Thunderflame Behemoth looked at the Flood Dragon lying on the ground, its eyes cold and angry, and it roared: “I am the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Thunderflame, Hegemon Brock Abbott.”
“I have been in this ‘field’ for many ‘years,’ and you are the first creature at the same level to fight me to this extent..”

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 213: To mix in, one must have power and background, Dragon King Kidora (Seeking Monthly Tickets )_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Chapter 213: To mix in, one must have power and background, Dragon King Kidora (Seeking Monthly Tickets )_3
Translator: 549690339
“Rest assured, I won’t kill you today, we won’t bring up the cause of this battle, and from now on, all grudges between you and Scythia are written off.”
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which had thought it was doomed today, was taken aback and let out a weak sigh of relief.
The battles among Mutated Creatures are brutal. The beasts that lose and cannot run away often face death, just like the Mutated Beasts that once faced it.
But as a basic survival instinct, it didn’t want to die if it could avoid it.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth then growled lowly, “You are strong and have my approval, I wonder if you would be interested in joining the Dragon Palace?”
The Nine-headed Dragon struggled, and all nine heads growled at the same time, causing chaotic overlapping sounds, “Roar roar roar!! Dragon Palace, what, is, it?”
Hearing this, the nearby Silver Giant Dragon proudly said, “The Dragon Palace is the Beast Empire established by the Great Sethia and Brock Abbott together. It will unify the sea and rule the world in the future.”
“It’s your honor to be invited to join today, normally Great Sethia wouldn’t even bother looking at average extraordinary creatures.”
Each head of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon showed confusion, “Roar roar roar!! Join, what, is, the use? I, only like, to sleep.”
The Thunderflame Beheamoth growled low, “There are many benefits to joining the Dragon Palace. For example, we can occupy broader territories and own more Resource Points that produce good things.”
“Moreover, when encountering powerful enemies, we can team up to fight them.”
“In this era, it’s hard to survive alone, because there is no strongest, there is always someone stronger. You will always meet extraordinary creatures that are more powerful than you.”
“So besides being strong, you also need influence and background.”
“For example, Sethia was not your match today, but with me on her side, you are no match for us. This is the benefit of having influence.”
“Or, if Sethia wasn’t here today, even if you couldn’t beat me, you could still escape, rather than lying on the seabed at the risk of dying at any moment.” The words of the Thunderflame Beheamoth made the Nine-headed Dragon slightly uncertain, because it felt like that was indeed the case.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth’s strength was similar to its own. Even if its melee combat power was terrifying, it could only suppress it a little. It was still uncertain who would win or lose as long as it could keep a certain distance.
As for the other Silver Dragon Beast, it was slightly weaker. Yesterday, it beat back the latter with two of its minions.
But today, under the continuous and tacit attack of the two giant beasts, it had no chance to fight back, and was eventually heavily injured.
The nine dragon heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon made sounds of hesitation. Its voices distorted, “Roar roar roar!! Join, means, companion, don’t, hit me?”
The Thunderflame Beheamoth growled low, “Joining the Dragon Palace means we are back-to-back brothers. We kill the enemies together, share the benefits, and get stronger together.”
“Roar roar roar!! Then I, join.”
The corner of the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s mouth slightly raised, and the flames were spitting out between its breaths, making it look very fierce, “Welcome to the Dragon Palace. Allow me to introduce to you.”
“This is the King of the Dragon Palace, the Frost Storm King, Scythia, who oversees all matters of the Dragon Palace.”
“Roar roar roar!! It, is, Dragon Palace, Great King?”
Confusion was in the eyes of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and it didn’t understand.
It didn’t understand why the black-red Colossal Beast entangled with thunder and fire was stronger, but the weaker one was the king.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth growled low, “In the Dragon Palace, all King-level beings are considered equal, just that Scythia has contributed more to the Dragon Palace, so she is leading.”
“With your strength, after joining the Dragon Palace, you can be conferred as the Dragon King, equal in status with me and Scythia.”
“Below us in the Dragon Palace, there are also the Tiger Fish Grand General, Tortoise Prime Minister, and several Tiger Whale Guards. Overall, our forces are very strong.”
“By the way, do you have a name?” Only now did the Thunderflame Beheamoth remember to address this question.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon was confused, “Roar roar roar!! Name, what, is,it?”
The Thunderflame Beheamoth growled low to explain, “A name is a title we use to identify each other. For example, my name is Tim Abbott, also known as Brock Abbott, and Scythia’s name is Scythia.”
“Seeing as you don’t have a name, how about I give you one? From now on, you will be called the Nine-Headed Dragon King Kidora, how about that?”
“Roar roar roar!! Ki, do, la, My king, henceforth, will be, Kidora.” With some recovery, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was excited.
When looking towards the Thunderflame Beheamoth again, its gaze invariably showed a hint of intimacy.
Because this giant beast had given it a ‘name’.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth nodded in satisfaction, growling, “Today our Dragon Palace has added a new member. Let’s assemble all ‘people’ of the Dragon Palace and hold a banquet to welcome Kidora.”
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon nearby reflexively covered its Reverse Scale with a vigilant look in its eyes, “Roar! Brock Abbott, Great Sethia has no delicious food left.”
“I almost forgot. In that case, let’s wait until Joe finds something worthwhile to celebrate Kidora’s welcoming party.”
“Roar! Let’s go, we’re going back.”
Saying this, the Thunderflame Beheamoth turned around, and with a rumble, a huge wave was set off by its massive body. It took large strides away, and with every step, the surrounding seabed would be shattered by its impact.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth’s mouth slightly raised, in a good mood.
In fact, when it first saw this mighty Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Thunderflame Beheamoth had the idea of taming it. Otherwise, it would have already burst out with its full strength to kill it.
The reason, of course, was to strengthen the Dragon Palace.
After knowing a little bit about the mythical world from the Silver Giant Dragon, it understood that one needed strength and status to survive, and it was not enough to act alone.
Otherwise, even if it had unrivaled fighting power at the same level, it might eventually encounter the predicament faced by the Nine-headed Flood Dragon today.
After all, in the vast mythical world, not only beasts, but also powerful civilizations similar to the Human Race and the Purgatory Demon Race exist. It might also be attacked by multiple beings of the same level someday.
But of course, the premise of taming this Nine-headed Flood Dragon was that no blood feud was formed between the two sides yesterday.
If the Dragon Turtle or Tiger Fish had died yesterday, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon would have had to go to its death as well. The Thunderflame Beheamoth had a little bit of affection for these two fellows.
Of course, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon didn’t know about this. Seeing the Thunderflame Beheamoth walking away, the two giant beasts also followed.
In the blink of an eye, the three giant beasts disappeared into the dark seabed..

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 214: Soul Channel, Eight-Armed Divine Ape, Starry Sky War Beast.
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Chapter 214: Soul Channel, Eight-Armed Divine Ape, Starry Sky War Beast.
Translator: 549690339
As the Three-headed Giant Beast made its way to the Dragon Palace, Jack Clark and the others took a six-hour flight spanning thousands of kilometers and arrived in Cross Mountain Country.
The bustling economic megacity of East Capital Airport in Cross Mountain Country saw their airplane gliding down for a landing, guided by the Control Tower.
On the side of the runway, over a dozen luxury cars and coaches had already parked, with a group of extraordinarily graceful individuals standing at the front, followed by several bodyguards.
As soon as the plane came to a stop and the door opened, Crystal Boyce and Mathilda Ward quickly disembarked.
Following them were Jack Clark, dressed in a suit and a white shirt, wearing sunglasses in true professional bodyguard fashion, and behind him were Damon Lopes, Marla Fiore, Lionel Lopez, and others.
A middle-aged man wearing glasses in the crowd greeted them enthusiastically:
“Hahaha… Boss Boyce, MissWard, and everyone, welcome to East Capital.”
Crystal Boyce replied with a smile:
“Mr. Klein, you are too kind. It wasn’t necessary for you to come personally; arranging someone from your team to meet our flight would have been sufficient.”
“How could that be possible? It’s Miss Ward’s first time in East Capital, and it would be disrespectful to simply send someone arbitrary to greet Miss Ward and Mr. Ward.”
“By the way, let me introduce.”
“This is the Hundred River Pavilion Master from the Heavy Mountain Pavilion, a well-known Great Master in East Capital, whose martial arts hall has made outstanding contributions to the stability of East Capital in recent years.”
“This is his daughter, Miss Janice Bland. She graduated a year ago from the Martial Arts School of East Capital with a cultivation at the Fourth Layer Heaven and is a famous genius among the younger generation in East Capital.”
“This is a director from the Suzuki Group and the President of East Capital Chamber of Commerce. His group is responsible for the lighting and sound for Miss Ward’s concert…”
As the two sides exchanged pleasantries, Jack Clark’s gaze swept over these individuals and whenever his gaze rested on someone for two seconds, detailed information about them would pop up.
Among these people were the high-level political leaders of East Capital, presidents of top-tier clubs, and experts from High-level Martial Arts Halls; all were powerful individuals whose every move could shake East Capital.
Yet, when they faced Mathilda Ward, they were all exceedingly polite, positioning themselves with a low profile.
After Acunus took the initiative to reveal his “existence,” officials had also somewhat relaxed the control over Mathilda Ward’s personal information.
Suddenly, many were taken aback, not expecting that the internationally renowned star, who had risen to fame somewhat mysteriously, was actually the young daughter of the Mysterious Martial Sky King.
At that moment, Damon Lopes leaned closer and said softly, using True Strength to contain his voice:
“How about it, Brother Callum, have you found anything?”
After the Blood God Acunus made his move, Damon Lopes became genuinely vigilant and also had a high regard for Jack Clark’s extraordinary sensory abilities.
Although it was already known, being able to discern someone’s intentions just by the way they looked at him still felt too incredible.
Jack Clark also used his True Strength to confine his voice, replying softly:
“I haven’t sensed anything unusual from these people, they should be alright, but we still can’t let our guard down.”
“I understand,” Damon Lopes nodded.
King-level beings have too many tricks up their sleeves and one must always remain cautious and vigilant.
Soon after the greetings, everyone progressively boarded their vehicles.
Lionel Lopez and his fellow bodyguards joined those of the others.
Mathilda Ward and Crystal Boyce, led by the official person in charge, Dean Klein, got into a luxury business car.
These business cars, as large as coaches, were spacious and comfortable inside, accommodating over a dozen people for casual conversation, with sound systems, air conditioning, refrigerators, and televisions—all fully equipped.
However, when Jack Clark and Damon Lopes, dressed as bodyguards, followed Mathilda Ward and Crystal Boyce onto the car, someone’s gaze flickered slightly.
Instantly, Jack Clark narrowed his eyes behind his sunglasses and took a glance at the man named Irvin Yamaki.
This man was a well-known shrine official from the Great Heavenly Ghost Shrine in East Capital. During the introductions earlier, he’d been very low- key, and after greeting Mathilda Ward, he stood on the fringe of the group, not speaking again.
The middle-aged man’s gaze was quite normal, devoid of murderous intent or malice, simply reflecting the normal human reaction of surprise.
It seemed as if he was surprised to see a bodyguard like him taking a seat in the main guest vehicle alongside Mathilda Ward.
Yet, when his gaze rested on Jack Clark, Jack inexplicably felt a touch of discomfort, as if passing by someone on the street he deeply disliked.
There might be a problem with this person.
Pensively, Jack Clark took a seat next to Mathilda Ward.
Soon the luxury coach set off, and the convoy began its journey towards the city. Along the way, Jack Clark’s attention remained on their surroundings.
It couldn’t be helped; Koroya had been ambushed twice on the stretch of road from the airport to the city, which made Jack Clark subconsciously wary of this particular section of the journey.
Add to that the presence of a potentially problematic person on the bus.
Fortunately, over the next twenty minutes, no danger presented itself, and soon a bustling metropolis came into view.
Though considered average among the mid-sized countries of the Federation, Cross Mountain Country still had a decent population and economy, with East Capital giving Jack Clark the feeling of a city from his previous life.
Speaking of which, the classification of the Federal States’ national levels must be addressed.
Since the end of the Dark Age until now, the vast Federation with its population of over two billion, the three major empires accounted for more than 1.4 billion people.
Next were eleven mid-sized countries, with populations ranging from tens of millions to over a hundred million.
Besides these were dozens of ordinary small countries with populations in the range of several millions, located all over the globe.
The ranking among countries is determined by population, military strength, economy, territory, as well as the number of cultivators and top-tier strong men.
Most king-level experts come from the three major empires, with mid-sized countries having as few as one or as many as two or three, not to mention the disparity in cultivator base which is more than tenfold.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 214 Soul Channel, Eight-Armed Divine Ape, Starry Sky War Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Chapter 214 Soul Channel, Eight-Armed Divine Ape, Starry Sky War Beast_2
Translator: 549690339 |
As for those ordinary small countries, not only do they have fewer people, but cultivators are also scarce.
The root cause is the issue of Heavenly Energy density.
Within the three major empires, the richness of Heavenly Energy is tenfold compared to the outside world; under such conditions, the number of individuals with cultivation talent who ‘mutate’ increases.
And with faster cultivation speeds, one year equates to several years outside.
As more people cultivate, a greater number of strong men emerge, which allows the Human Race to expand their Territory, resources, materials, and minerals in the mythical world, rapidly developing domestically.
This is the growing gap between empires and ordinary countries.
As for the idea of dismantling the Cover Sky Enchantment and allowing the Heavenly Energy to permeate the globe so that all humans of all countries can cultivate equally, it is foolish.
The entire Blue Star is vast; even if all the Heavenly Energy from the three major empires were released, it would not be enough to double the current energy density in small countries.
This was also the reason why the Supreme Experts chose to establish the enchantment over thirty years ago.
If they had chosen to release it back then, the number of human cultivators might not even reach one-tenth of what it is now, not to mention starting a war with the Purgatory Demon Race and opening the Frontline Battlefield.
And don’t think that the Heavenly Energy within the territories of the three major empires comes for free.
Although this energy streams from the mythical world, to maintain those Space Cracks, reinforce them, and even expand them, the three major empires have all paid a hefty price.
This is another gap between empires and medium-sized countries.
Every year, numerous Space Cracks emerge in various places of Blue Star, including within medium and small countries, but almost none are discovered and preserved in time.
Many Space Cracks are fleeting, requiring strong men to capture, consuming space-related materials to stabilize them, turning them into streams of energy.
And the biggest pathways in the current human world are the world passageways of the three major empires, stable and vast enough to accommodate the entry and exit of Mythical Creatures and king-level figures.
The Heavenly Energy that flows into Blue Star daily is as vast as the tide, sustaining the consumption of countless cultivators.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s convoy entered the city uneventfully, and he withdrew part of his attention, pressing on the side of his sunglasses to link with the wireless signal.
“Di di! Connecting to the Heavenly Think Tank…”
“Verification passed, access granted, welcome to the Heavenly Think Tank.”
Looking at the flashing screen in front of him, Jack’s will circulated tangibly, tapping lightly on the options for Secret Books, and immediately the options for the three major empires popped up.
He then clicked on Berlin.
Suddenly, names of various Genetic Martial Arts Secret Books appeared before Jack’s eyes.
Among the hundreds of Top-tier Secret Manuals, only a dozen belonged at the king-level, the rest left by Ninth Heaven Experts of the Berlin Empire.
The creators of these manuals had either become Nine-fold Peak Experts or had already fallen.
Since his goal was to reference and integrate the Power of the Giant Beasts’ Talents, Jack selectively opened several Secret Book synopses.
Soon, his gaze fell on a Secret Book named [Eight-Arm Divine Ape],
This Secret Book, when cultivated to the ultimate degree, could transform into an Eight-Arm Divine Ape, merging a part of the strength of four Giant Beasts with very powerful combat strength.
In particular, the idea of transforming the Giant Beast’s power into arms caught Jack’s attention, giving him a sense of unexpected alignment.
After settling on the Berlin Secret Books, Jack then accessed Simon Empire’s Secret Catalog.
After scanning the synopses of those manuals, he finally set his sights on a Secret Book called [Star Beast Mechanism].
The goal of this Secret Book’s creator was to see the human body as a planetary celestial body, with Mechas infused with Giant Beast materials, inscriptions, and abilities as the human-shaped star giant beast shell.
The Mecha of this Secret Book was not only massive but could also evoke a domain power similar to planetary gravity within its galaxy domain, where ‘planets’ orbited within, rendering it very powerful.
Of course, the theory was quite a bit different from actuality.
“Confirm the request for [Eight-Arm Divine Ape] and [Star Beast Mechanism] Secret Books?”
“Confirm!” Jack clicked to confirm with his realm of thought.
“Request uploaded, please wait for notification from Federal Headquarters. Mission route analysis detected for the requester… Analysis complete.”
“The Secret Rubbing Version is expected to arrive in Green Mountain City in Hundred Foxes Nation in ten days.”
Ten days, that’s about right, Jack thought.
After defeating the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the focus of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s energy would be on comprehending the Innate Space Runes, coupled with the efforts of Jack’s actual body.
In ten days’ time, he should be able to construct the basic structure of the Secret Books.
By then, after referring to the essence of the two new Secret Books in hand, as well as the creator’s experience in ability fusion, it should be quite quick to create his Secret Book.
At this thought, Jack Clark’s lips lifted slightly.
It was just after four in the afternoon.
The convoy carrying Mathilda Ward and others stopped beneath the six-star resort hotel in East Capital.
After a greeting and leaving a staff member behind, Dean Klein and his party left.
Jack followed Mathilda Ward with the staff’s guidance to the hotel’s upper floors, while Lionel Lopez and his team began taking over the hotel’s security.
Having circled around the presidential suite at the top floor of the hotel and ensuring there were no problems, Jack went to the balcony while Mathilda Ward and her assistant were sorting out their clothes.
He pressed his sunglasses twice and connected to the military channel.
“I am Zero Operator, Mr. Callum, how may I assist you?”
Jack spoke softly,
“I need detailed information on Irvin Yamaki from East Capital, including information about the Yamaki Family.”
While the sunglasses could recognize faces and pull up relevant data, that kind of information was only superficial. More detailed and deeper information required the expertise of professionals to compile.
“Please wait a moment, Mr. Callum, the relevant data will be compiled and sent to you shortly.”
Beneath the deep sea, accompanied by the faint panting of the Silver Giant Dragon, an Ice Crystal Palace spanning over a hundred meters tall and two hundred meters wide appeared, rough and grand.
“Roar! Kidora, this will be your Nine-Headed Dragon King Hall from now on.”
Several hours had passed, and the black Nine-headed Flood Dragon, whose external injuries had already healed, let out excited, chaotic roars, “Roaar roaar roaar!! Thank, thank, Scythia.”
The Silver Giant Dragon slightly lifted its head, issuing a proud roar, “No need for thanks, it is the responsibility of the King of the Dragon Palace.”
However, after speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon inexplicably felt a bit of confusion.
Something was not right. It was the King of the Dragon Palace, so why did it have to build a palace for a Giant Beast that joined the Dragon Palace?
Facing the Silver Giant Dragon’s puzzled gaze, the Thunderflame Behemoth naturally would not say ‘who told you your ability is suitable for bricklaying.’
After the Nine-headed Flood Dragon swam into the palace, curling its huge body into hibernation, the Thunderflame Behemoth turned its head to look at the Silver Giant Dragon.
“Roar! Scythia, remember what you promised me. Let’s go, Brock Abbott.”
With that, the Silver Giant Dragon spread its wings, gliding and flying into its Ice Frost Storm Dragon King Hall at the seabed, followed by the black-red ferocious behemoth.
As the two Giant Beasts entered the Dragon King Hall, one leading and the other following, frost emerged on the body of the Silver Giant Dragon, and in an instant a ten-meter-thick ice wall sealed the palace’s gate.
Not only that, as the Silver Giant Dragon’s domain power unfolded, covering the whole palace.
It was only after this that the Silver Giant Dragon lay down in the center of the hall, slightly closed its eyes, and its forehead’s Dragon Scales emitted white radiance, revealing some mysterious inscriptions.
As the complex space inscriptions on the Dragon Scales emerged, their glow formed a 3D rune projection spanning tens of meters in the air.
Like countless silver spirals forming a galaxy mirage spinning, exuding an extremely mysterious aura of space.
Under the influence of the Silver Giant Dragon’s Soul Power, the projection of runes in the air was equivalent to laying out an exceedingly complex mathematical problem, expressing each of its formulas one by one.
It instructed the Thunderflame Behemoth how to deduce the rules, where to start, and why to carry out the calculations in such a manner.
This reveal was almost as clear as the earlier transparency when the Thunderflame Behemoth made its breakthrough, observing the birth of the Seven Great Talent Runes within its body from nothing.
After absorbing and merging the Innate Space Rune, this rune became the very foundation of the Silver Giant Dragon’s laws, hence its great caution.
Also, displaying its fundamental essence before the Thunderflame Behemoth demonstrated the trust that the Silver Giant Dragon had in it.
The Thunderflame Behemoth laid on the ground, its golden vertical pupils completely focused on the space runes above, its consciousness gradually sinking into an endless realm of spatial information.
It greedily absorbed countless details to enrich itself.
Jack Clark valued this Innate Space Rune so much not only because he planned to use it as the basis for the Secret Books that were to be carried together, but also because he wanted to see if it could open a pathway.
Using the soul link between the Avatar and the original body as a base, he aimed to create a stable spatial transmission pathway that would allow items, such as Life Crystals, to pass through.
Otherwise, even if the Giant Beast Avatar was mighty, the original body could not share its resources.
But if a stable pathway could be established between them, allowing a portion of resources obtained by the Giant Beast from the ocean to be shared with the original body, Jack Clark’s power would rise at an even more astonishing rate.
Especially the Life Crystals!

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 215: The Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, One Punch Explosion
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: Chapter 215: The Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, One Punch Explosion
Translator: 549690339
An hour after Jack Clark sent a request to the local military to thoroughly investigate the Yamaki Family, Janice Bland suddenly showed up and revealed her identity.
“Military Special Service Department personnel.”
Looking at the beautiful woman in front of him, dressed in a crisp and handsome white lady’s suit with a Knife at her waist, a look of surprise appeared in Jack’s eyes.
Janice Bland bowed slightly, “Indeed, I joined the Special Service Department after graduation and am part of the East Capital’s covert investigation group, specifically responsible for incidents involving the Evil God Sect Cultists.” “However, my identity is confidential, and publicly, I am only known as a martial arts hall staff member.”
At this moment, besides the two of them, Mathilda Ward, Damon Lopes, and Marla Fiore were also in the living room.
They were all somewhat surprised, not expecting Jack to have made a discovery so soon after arriving in the East Capital.
“Upon receiving Mr. Callum’s request, I specially mobilized personnel to investigate the Yamaki Family’s affairs, but…” As she said this, doubt appeared in Janice Bland’s eyes.
Jack’s eyebrows raised, “Is it that nothing was found?”
Janice Bland nodded, “Exactly, there is nothing out of the ordinary about the Yamaki Family.”
“The Yamaki Family have been shrine priests of the Great Demon God for generations, spanning hundreds of years, and it’s said that members of the Yamaki Family have the bloodline of the Great Demon God.”
Of course, these are just rumors nobody believes, but since the Heaven-Earth Mutated event in recent history, every heir of the Yamaki Family has shown a talent for cultivation.”
The current head of the Yamaki Family, Geoffrey Yamaki, is even a Great Master in the late stages of the Sixth Heavenly Layer, slightly stronger than my father.”
“On top of that, after hundreds of years of operations, the Yamaki Family has a high prestige in the East Capital.”
Earlier, when I mobilized military forces to investigate, I found that the Yamaki Family is very ‘clean,’ with no unusual signs from the family members for more than a decade.”
“So clean, huh?” Jack frowned slightly. Could he have sensed it wrongly?
At this moment, Damon Lopes spoke slowly, “Being clean doesn’t mean there are no issues.”
At Brother Callum’s current realm, especially since he has cultivated sensing- related Cultivation Methods, this kind of clear feeling of something being wrong is almost never mistaken.”
It s just that this family is hiding very deeply, so conventional methods cannot uncover them.”
“Are you suggesting we use unconventional methods?” As she spoke, Janice Bland looked towards Mathilda Ward, sitting on the sofa with a smile, and paused hesitantly.
Mathilda Ward laughed lightly, “Miss Bland, if you have something to say, just say it. We’re all on the same side here.”
Janice Bland hesitated, “Today is the annual Ghost King Festival in the East Capital, and the festival just happens to take place not far from the Great Heavenly Ghost Shrine.”
“Now we all know Miss Ward’s identity has been ‘exposed’, so if the Yamaki Family really is up to something, and Miss Ward were to approach them proactively…”
Janice Bland stopped speaking for a moment.
“Approach them proactively, to lure them into taking action?” Mathilda’s eyes lit up, “That’s a good suggestion, I prefer taking action to waiting passively.” “Besides, it’ll give us a chance to check out the Ghost King Festival. I’ve heard about this festival back in Eastern Summer, it’s said to be very exciting.” Seeing this, Damon Lopes and Jack Clark exchanged glances, thought for a moment, but neither spoke up to dissuade her.
The highest cultivator in this family is merely at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, hardly a match for them, and it’s a good opportunity to confirm whether Jack’s sensing was incorrect.
As for informing the military to directly dispatch a force to suppress them, there’s no need.
One reason is that the family appears very ‘clean,’ and secondly, it’s not necessary to make a big fuss over a family with such ‘little1 strength; it would be quite embarrassing if it was a mistake.
“Can I join as well?” At this point, Marla Fiore’s eyes gleamed, revealing her eagerness.
After witnessing the collision of Domain Projection between Jack and ‘Dianna Reilly’ last night, Marla Fiore developed an interest in the exaggerated battle scenes of advanced cultivators.
“Miss Fiore, there might be danger this time, so you better not go,” Jack declined.
With Damon Lopes and himself, one defending and one attacking, they were confident in their ability to protect Mathilda Ward, even if a high-order Seventh Layer expert were to strike. But to add an ordinary person into the mix would complicate things.
Soon, Mathilda Ward changed into a white tracksuit, donned a Duckbill Cap, and put on plain glasses over her nose.
Seeing Jack in a black suit and white shirt, Janice Bland asked curiously, “Mr. Callum, aren’t you going to change your clothes?”
Jack shook his head, “No need. My role is as a bodyguard. Whether I change or not, others can tell who I am by my stance and posture.”
The culture of Cross Mountain Country has some similarities to that of Bird Country, with many legends involving ghosts and demons, so they have a festival called the Ghost King Festival.
As society has evolved and superstitions have been cast aside, the Ghost King Festival in Cross Mountain Country has gradually morphed into a celebration similar to Halloween, held annually.
East Capital also happened to be the city where the first Furious Ape appeared during the Heaven-Earth Mutated event.
That Level 9 Giant Beast broke into the city, causing casualties of hundreds of thousands. It was eventually lured out of the city by fighter aircraft and missiles, and then killed with a large yield nuclear bomb.
The crater from that million-ton nuclear explosion is still outside the city, about twenty kilometers away.
Under the night sky, the southern part of East Capital, near the suburbs, is brightly lit. From a high altitude, one can see countless vehicles and streams of people converging there, bustling with activity.
“Hahaha… catch me if you can.”
“I am the one-horned Ghost King.”
“Mom, I want to eat that Flower Cake.”
“No, you are changing teeth, and you can’t eat something so sweet…”
The street is swarming with people, children playing joyfully, and vendors on both sides selling all kinds of food and playthings, including many ghost masks and toys.
Intending to attract the enemy, Janice Bland and Mathilda Ward were standing at a stall…

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 215: The Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, One Punch Explosion_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: Chapter 215: The Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, One Punch Explosion_2
Translator: 549690339
‘Sweet’ roadside stall.
Janice Bland pointed to the pastries behind the glass cabinet and introduced, “Miss Ward, this is the famous Silver Thread Flower Cake from East Capital. Nowadays, very few craftsmen can make it anymore. Would you like to try it?”
Mathilda Ward, who had intentionally skipped dinner, nodded with interest. Immediately, Janice Bland waved her hand, “Boss, four servings of Silver Thread Flower Cakes, please.”
Soon, the boss handed the wrapped Silver Thread Flower Cakes to the two women.
“Here, one for each of us.” Mathilda Ward, smiling cheerfully, stuffed the paper bags containing the cakes into Jack Clark’s and Damon Lopes’s hands.
At this moment, in addition to the cakes, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes’s hands were also full of a big bunch of grilled skewers, grilled squid, meatballs, crepes, and other eats they hadn’t finished.
Along the way, whatever snack Mathilda Ward saw, she wanted to try.
Then, if she found it tasty, she would eat more; if not, she would stuff it to Jack Clark and Damon Lopes following behind her, knowing that advanced cultivatorshad ‘bigappetites.’
If they wanted to, they could eat an entire cow.
“Ilisa, those lanterns over there are so pretty, let’s go have a look.”
“Mm-hmm, just a moment.”
The two women wandered more and more energetically and seemed to be having a great time; their relationship appeared to have suddenly become much closer, confusing Jack Clark.
While Mathilda Ward and Janice Bland were enthusiastically touching this and looking at that, Jack Clark was vigilantly scanning all the people approaching, whether adults or children, old people or women.
Besides that, he spread out his intuition and sensory perception and discovered quite a few cultivators.
However, these people were all average in strength, most being from the First and Second Layer Heaven, with only a few from the Third Layer Heaven, some of whom had the faces of students.
At the same time, not far away, Jack Clark also felt some military-like presence among the cultivators, occasionally nodding slightly when his gaze met theirs.
Before they set off, Jack Clark notified the military of their plans out of habitual caution, just to prevent any unforeseen events.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark cautiously assessed the people around him, some were also observing him.
Of course, it wasn’t because they thought he was handsome, but rather they thought wearing sunglasses at night was perhaps showing off a little too much.
