Even though it was the Ghost King Festival and many people were wearing strange clothes and running around with various demon masks, those were at least ‘normal.’
“Brother Callum, there are so many beauties.”
Compared to Jack Clark’s cautiousness, Damon Lopes was interested in the beauties they encountered along the way.
“Uh… you’ve already got dozens of beautiful female friends on your mobile phone, isn’t that enough?” Facing Damon Lopes, who was acting like this, Jack Clark didn’t know what to say for the moment.
It’s not like you can say he’s lecherous; he just chats with those beauties and sends them red envelopes, always rejecting their invitations to go out for drinks or fun.
But if you say he isn’t lecherous, he’s always looking at beautiful women.
Sometimes, he even dragged Jack Clark along to join him in scrutinizing them, like a socially awkward nerd who’s never seen a beautiful woman, leaving Jack Clark at a loss for words.
Forget it, I can’t be bothered with him.
Jack Clark shook his head, focusing his attention on Mathilda Ward, sighing softly as he watched her radiant smile illuminated by the light.
About an hour later, the group of four walked past those two bustling streets and immediately the surroundings quieted down, with fewer people around.
They were now approaching the outskirts, where a small hill covered in dense trees rose ahead, a winding stone path leading to a flight of stairs that climbed the mountain.
Jack Clark and the others stepped onto the staircase.
Roadside low streetlamps cast a serene radiance, filled with a sense of mystery. Occasionally, when people ascended or descended the mountain, their faces were filled with devout expressions.
When the group reached the mountainside, they saw a sprawling temple filled with an ancient aura standing still. On either side of the large gate were two eight-meter-tall statues of green-faced demons with fanged teeth, as if guarding not the entrance to the temple but the gateway to Hell.
Janice Bland said in a low voice, “This is the shrine of the Great Demon God. As its shrine priests, the majority of the Yamaki family members live here.”
“Family head Geoffrey Yamaki, second-generation shrine priest Irvin Yamaki, Irving Yamaki, and the other three members of the third generation.”
“So few family members,” Damon Lopes exclaimed in surprise.
In his view, these local, well-known families should be thriving with many members.
Janice Bland nodded, “Since the New Era, the Yamaki family has been on the decline and typically keeps a low profile.”
Mathilda Ward looked at the demonic stone statues on both sides and said in an easygoing manner, “Let’s go, let’s take a look inside.”
By now it was past eight in the evening. As they entered, brushing past the last few visitors, the vast shrine seemed even quieter.
Inside the gates was a vast square, with an imposing Great Hall in the center and the living quarters of the Yamaki family priests behind it.
Irvin Yamaki, dressed in exquisite shrine priest clothing and sitting behind the prestige platform under the eaves of the Great Hall, looked surprised, “Miss Bland, Miss Ward, what brings you here so late?”
Janice Bland bowed slightly, “We were originally participating in the Ghost King Festival below and thought since the Great Heavenly Ghost Shrine was just above, we might as well bring Miss Ward up for a visit.”
“I see, please come in,” Irvin Yamaki gestured for them to enter.
As Jack Clark and Damon Lopes brushed past him, Irvin Yamaki gave them a polite smile, showing no signs of any problem.
The four entered the Great Hall, where, as Janice Bland worshiped the deity, a lean-faced elder in shrine priest clothing came out.
The elder also smiled warmly at everyone, seeming pleased that they had come to visit the shrine and worship the deity, the Great Demon God.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 215: Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, Exploding with One Punch_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Chapter 215: Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, Exploding with One Punch_3
Translator: 549690339
Standing behind Mathilda Ward, Jack Clark’s gaze swept across the ferocious ghost statues before finally landing on the central Great Heavenly Ghoul Statue.
The statue adorned in ancient armor, seating at 5 meters tall with a five-meter long knife lying horizontally across its knees, beneath the helmet was the face of a fierce evil spirit.
When Jack Clark looked at the statue, he felt as if his ‘heart’ could vaguely see a ferocious specter staring at him with cold eyes.
Jack Clark bound his voice with True Strength and suddenly whispered in a low voice, “Mr. Lopes, do you feel there’s something strange about that Great Demon God statue?”
Hearing this, Damon Lopes, who had also been observing the statue thoughtfully, nodded and his lips moved slightly:
“Yes, there is something, it seems there’s an aura of faith intertwined around it.”
An aura of faith. Jack Clark’s gaze flickered slightly.
In this world, where there are King-level strong men comparable to deities and even some kings who declare themselves gods and establish Divine Nations, it’s only natural that there are some special powers, such as faith.
However, this kind of akin to spirit strength is intangible, and only king-level who engage in the realm of Law Power can gather it.
Therefore, even Jack Clark had only heard of it and had not encountered it, nor could he sense it. He just felt there was something odd about the statue.
It was as if it had come to life.
As for why Damon Lopes could feel the faint aura of faith, it must be related to his ‘Innate Awakening.’
But under normal conditions, it’s quite normal for a statue that’s been worshipped for hundreds of years to have a bit of faith aura entangled around it. But is this normal?
Jack Clark and Damon Lopes exchanged glances.
Suddenly, Jack Clark said coldly, “Mr. Lopes, strike that Great Demon God statue with thunder.”
At once, everyone present paused.
Geoffrey Yamaki’s face changed slightly, and he said sternly, “Sir, this is the Great Heavenly Ghoul Statue that my family has guarded for hundreds of years. What do you want to do?”
As he spoke, a powerful black real power burst forth from him, resembling the Black Flames from Hell, emanating a tremendous aura.
Under that Sixth Heaven Late Stage Momentum, a raging wind swept through the Great Hall, and the ground cracked with fissures.
Outside the hall, Irvin Yamaki’s eyes also showed a hint of anger. For them, attacking the statue of their faith was almost indistinguishable from killing their own parents.
Boom!
At that moment, purple lightning encircled Damon Lopes, and electric sparks danced around him. Suddenly, a beam of arm-thick Purple Thunder Light wriggled and flashed, striking the Great Heavenly Ghoul statue.
Boom!
Under the thunder, the statue’s head cracked, and wisps of black smoke drifted out of the gaps, instantly filling the air with a terrifying aura that didn’t belong to humans.
“Purgatory Demonic Air!”
In an instant, Jack Clark appeared in front of Mathilda Ward, his body jumping with golden flames, and his expression solemn.
Unexpectedly, this time it wasn’t the Blood God Sect but related to The Purgatory Family.
Damon Lopes’ body was suddenly enveloped in thunder light, which drastically surged, and his hair blew without any breeze, appearing as if he wielded the Thunder of deities.
Lightning leaped in Damon Lopes’ eyes, and his voice resonated, “Who would have thought that the aura of faith entwined around this statue was actually to suppress the Purgatory Demonic Air inside it.”
“You Human Race traitors, all deserve to die.”
Seeing that their plot had been exposed, Geoffrey Yamaki’s eyes slowly turned blood-red, and even more terrifying aura erupted from deep within, his expression turning fierce.
“Originally, I did not want to get involved in this matter. What do I have to do with the Daughter of the Heavenly King? Why must you force me?”
“Today, you all must die. Roar!”
Accompanied by an inhuman bellow, Geoffrey Yamaki’s body swelled rapidly, bursting his clothes and turning, in the blink of an eye, into a towering, three- meter-tall specter wrapped in red demon light with horns on its head.
The aura around Geoffrey Yamaki suddenly exploded nearly tenfold. With Black and Red Flames burning fiercely, he nearly reached the Seventh Layer Heaven, and the entire Great Hall shook under the terrible specter’s aura.
Geoffrey Yamaki roared, “Wind Control, do not let them escape. Activate the Stone Formation.”
“Yes, father,” came the response.
With a shout, Irvin Yamaki slapped a stone pillar outside the door.
Roar, roar!
Suddenly, the roar of Dragon Roar Elephant Roar shook the Void, grand and Overbearing, the power so fierce that the whole Heaven and Earth seemed to collapse under Jack Clark’s punch.
Boom!
The Divine Might of Elephant’s Fury, with a flash of golden light, displayed the ‘Demonic God’ form, and Irvin Yamaki, whose cultivation surged from the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, was instantly shattered.
The domineering force of the punch continued unabated, smashing half of the wall of the Divine temple to pieces.
The air howled, waves surged, and a mix of flesh and blood residues, along with broken bricks and stones flew dozens of meters away, with rolling smoke and dust pervading half the square.
Immediately, everyone paused.
Including Damon Lopes who was just about to make a move.
No, brother, it’s my turn this time, stop showing off.
Faced with Damon Lopes’ resentful gaze, Jack Clark with sunglasses returned to his cold demeanor, retracting his fist.
Although the ‘guy’ wasn’t very strong, it was clear that some mechanism that had been prepared for decades was about to be activated. In such a situation, the obvious choice was to destroy everything first.
Although he felt there wouldn’t be any issues, he disliked surprises.
“Alt! I am going to kill you all.”
Watching his son being obliterated in an instant, Geoffrey Yamaki’s eyes revealed fierce madness, and a huge ghastly figure, ten meters tall, formed behind him with the demonic light.
“Your opponent is Daoist Master,” announced Damon Lopes as he waved his hand, gathering the surrounding lightning into a massive Purple Thunder Dragon that roared and collided with the immense ghostly phantom.
Boom!
In that instant, the impact exploded like a missile, and the dazzling Black Purple Destructive Shockwave erupted, causing the roof of the Divine temple to collapse, statues to shatter, and a brilliant Light Beam to pierce the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 215: Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, Exploding with One Punch_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: Chapter 215: Ghost God Family, Divine Dragon Elephant Power, Exploding with One Punch_4
Translator: 549690339
In the midst of the thundering collapse of the Divine temple, Jack Clark’s body was enveloped by leaping golden flames, forming an invisible, powerful force field that covered a circumference of 5 meters.
The rubble and explosive shockwaves that approached the 5-meter perimeter were blocked by the overbearing Divine Might, forming an insurmountable invisible wall around him.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Amid the rolling waves of smoke and dust, large bolts of lightning as thick as a man’s thigh roared, and ghastly screams echoed as both sides exploded out from the half-collapsed Divine temple.
Sensing the violent aura outside, Jack Clark’s expression was cold as he pressed a hand to his ear and said softly, “The Yamaki Family is involved with the Demon Clan, seal the mountain, don’t leave a single one.”
“Roger that!”
As the firm voice came through, dozens of figures that had been waiting at the foot of the mountain rushed into the mountain forest from all directions, each emitting the Aura of the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Within a few breaths, these experts from the military had encountered several other members of the Yamaki Family fleeing from the mountain.
Among them was a second-generation member who had run away as soon as he sensed danger, and battle immediately erupted.
In the ruins of the Great Hall, Janice Bland, wielding a Knife, spoke with a heavy tone, “The Yamaki Family really does have issues, and it’s not just a simple case of internal betrayal.”
“This must be an accident,” Jack said, his gaze falling on the statue that was still emitting wisps of black Demonic Qi. He pondered thoughtfully.
“They must have some connection with the Demon Clan. I can feel it; that demon gas is somehow different from Mikus’s.”
“And that strange Ghost God Body. Before it was activated, even I couldn’t detect anything odd about it. It seems not to be a simple fusion but more like a bloodline transformation.”
Saying this, Jack’s eyes revealed a hint of interest, clearly wanting to capture a member of the Yamaki Family to study.
Facing the abnormal situation with a calm expression, Mathilda Ward spoke softly, “They must have merged with the Essence Blood of the Purgatory Demon Race, using Berlin’s Cultivation Methods to transform their bodies towards the Demon Clan.”
“The strange thing is, where did they get the Essence Blood of the Purgatory Demon Race?”
Boom Boom Boom!!
At that moment, the air roared in the distance, a ghastly figure… no, more like a demon in the form of Geoffrey Yamaki blasted towards them, his eyes filled with fierce malice as he stared dead at Mathilda Ward.
It wanted to take Mathilda Ward hostage.
Geoffrey Yamaki was in a sorry state, with many parts of his body shattered by Thunder, his Aura weak, nowhere near the tyrannical overbearing presence he had when he had transformed.
“Roar! Get out of my way,” Geoffrey Yamaki roared, swinging his right claw.
Endless black and red demonic Qi churned, forming a giant demon claw that covered the Great Hall. The terrifying strength caused the air within a tens of meters range to collapse and the floor tiles to shatter.
“What gave you the illusion you could provoke me?” Along with the deep voice, a terrifying power of unseen proportions was released from Jack Clark’s body.
In an instant, golden light flared, and the half-collapsed Divine temple shook and trembled as if an Ancient Beast was awakening within.
Roar! Accompanied by the swing of a golden fist, the power of the Godly Dragon Elephant was invoked, and the whole Heaven and Earth seemed to shake under that terrifying, Overbearing strength.
The fearsome punch instantly shattered the demon claw that overshadowed the Great Hall.
The Unrivaled Domination not only caused Geoffrey Yamaki’s complexion to change drastically as blood spurted from his mouth, but his 3-meter high Ghost God Body was also blasted away by the formidable punch.
At the same time, Jack Clark turned into a radiant golden light that shot up into the sky, the golden flames burning furiously on his body as his palm opened wide, catching Geoffrey Yamaki’s face mid-air as if via teleportation.
Then the two plummeted from the sky.
Boom!
In an instant, the mountain forest shook, and the Earth within a twenty-some-meters radius instantly collapsed, countless chunks of dirt being thrown into the air by the terrible power, forming concentric Destructive Shockwaves.
Under the terrible impact, Janice Bland’s complexion changed drastically, and she hurriedly went to protect Mathilda Ward from the violent wind wave, especially from the debris that was being thrown like cannonballs.
All of this happened in the blink of an eye.
In the distance, Damon Lopes was surrounded by an aura of lightning, his face filled with annoyance.
In his perception, the life Aura of the elite known as Geoffrey Yamaki had vanished, killed by Jack Clark in one strike, and so once again, he missed his chance to show off..

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 216: The Decaying Body of the Ninth Heavens, Soul Exhaustion
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Chapter 216: The Decaying Body of the Ninth Heavens, Soul Exhaustion
Translator: 549690339
The once magnificent Great Heavenly Ghoul Shrine had become ruins, the earth shattered, the buildings in flames.
In a crater over ten meters in diameter, Jack Clark stood with golden flames burning on his body, his expression stern, his Divine Might permeating as circles of white waves rolled around him, his aura terrifying.
It was as if the figure standing there was not a person, but a Divine Might Giant Beast.
The oppressive aura was so intense that Janice Bland, standing some distance away with a samurai sword in her hand, trembled slightly, her expression one of shock.
Although the records mentioned that this man named Darren Callum came from the Eastern Summer military and possessed high talent, being at the Early Sixth Heaven stage at a young age.
But was this really the Early Sixth Heaven stage?
That overbearing and extreme strength directly killed Geoffrey Yamaki with one punch, even though he had transformed into what was called a ghoul form. Deservedly so for the Eastern Summer Empire, too strong!
Just two geniuses under twenty years old possessing such terrifying combat power.
While Janice Bland felt an inexplicable shock in her heart, behind her, Mathilda Ward, whom she was protecting, was calm.
At this time, on the opposite side of the crater, Damon Lopes spoke with some annoyance, “Brother Callum, next time could you leave a monster for me? I haven’t even started fighting.”
The flames on Jack Clark’s body slowly extinguished, his Divine Aura retracting, “I had no choice. It wanted to grab Miss Ward to break through the encirclement; in that situation, I could only punch it to death.”
In fact, Geoffrey Yamaki’s choice was very normal.
Having his hidden identity exposed and attempting to silence the witnesses, he realized that Damon Lopes, who wielded the power of thunder and was at the Middle Stage of Sixth Heaven, was terrifyingly strong. So, he was easily suppressed by a casual strike.
In such circumstances, to survive, the best option naturally was to capture Mathilda Ward as a hostage.
After all, the person in front of him, Janice Bland, was just a Late Fourth Layer Heaven cultivator, and Jack Clark, who had punched his son to death, exuded only an Early Sixth Heaven aura.
Even though this man’s combat power was strong, having killed his Fifth Layer Heaven early stage son with a punch, such genius should have its limits.
At least, in Geoffrey Yamaki’s understanding, he had never encountered anyone whose strength could cross a Major Realm while being at the later stages of Sixth Heaven; being able to cross a minor realm was already deemed a genius.
But unexpectedly, this time, he kicked two super alloy steel plates.
Looking at the shattered corpse of Geoffrey Yamaki at the bottom of the pit, Damon Lopes mused, “Judging by his transformed appearance, he should have fused with the genes of a member of the Talos War demon clan from The Purgatory Family.”
“It’s just strange. Where did they get the Essence Blood and genes of the Talos War demon clan?”
At this moment, Janice Bland walked over, also puzzled, “That is indeed a bit strange.”
According to the records, although this family is a cultivation family and has a few cultivators, they don’t have permission to enter the mythical world, nor do they own a company.”
“Over the years, the people of the Yamaki Family have mostly kept a low profile, only occasionally attending banquets in the East Capital’s business and political circles.”
“The problem should lie within that statue. Once we smash it open and take a look, we’ll know for sure,” said Jack Clark as golden light flowed through his hands and he casually swung his arm.
Boom!
In an instant, a three-meter long crescent of golden sword energy roared out, crossing over thirty meters and landing on the partially collapsed temple, striking the broken Great Demon God statue.
Crash!
Under the sword energy infused with explosive properties, the five-meter tall statue shattered and exploded as if it had been hit head-on by a rocket.
Once a cultivator reaches the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, they can project sword and blade Qi. However, only after reaching the latter stages of Fifth Layer Heaven does the power externally projected take on a qualitative leap. The external projection power of Sixth Heaven’s True Strength is even more overbearing.
However, Jack Clark rarely utilized this type of True Strength projection attack because it’s easy for enemies to dodge, and it lacks the close-range killing and destructive power of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
After all, his greatest advantage has always been his formidable physical strength.
At that moment, amidst the flying debris and raging winds, a gigantic withered arm flew out, landing on the ground and instantly creating a five-meter wide crater.
The arm, over two meters long and covered in black scales, had a palm that was sharp like a ghastly claw, and it was wrapped in strands of black Aura that emanated terrifying pressure.
That pressure was so formidable that even Jack Clark’s face changed, “Such a strong presence, Eighth Layer Heaven, no, this is the arm of a Ninth Heaven Purgatory Demon.”
Damon Lopes nodded gravely, “It should be the arm of a Ninth Heaven Demon Clan. Even after being severed for decades, the aura remains undispersed, wrapped in Demon Power.”
“No wonder when I came in earlier, I felt the Heavenly Energy here was more active than the surrounding area, and the concentration was somewhat higher than other places.”
“Initially, I thought it was due to the surrounding trees, but now it seems there must have been a Rift Channel here at some point, and this Demon Clan arm likely appeared then.”
This must be the Yamaki Clan’s source of Demon Clan Essence Blood and genes, originating from a demon’s severed arm.”
Of course, these were Damon Lopes’s speculations, and tracing the origins and piecing together the clues would naturally be something for the Special Service Department to investigate.
But Jack Clark felt it was more or less accurate, and it fit very well with the habits of this family over the years.
For example, finding a Demon Clan severed arm several decades ago and choosing to secretly keep it hidden. Then, in their greed for power, they studied it privately, refining the blood to infuse it in their bodies to alter their bloodline and physique.
You should know that several decades ago, existences at the level of Nine Layers were considered Supreme. At a time when king-level beings were scarce, the Yamaki Family’s choice was quite normal.
However, they did not anticipate that the era would develop so swiftly.
Afterwards, Human Race King-level powerhouses began emerging like bamboo shoots after a rain.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 216: The Decaying Body of the Ninth Heavens, Soul Exhaustion !
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Chapter 216: The Decaying Body of the Ninth Heavens, Soul Exhaustion !
Translator: 549690339
It wasn’t long before even the Ninth Heavens were no longer rare.
In such a situation, Geoffrey Yamaki, who had integrated the Demon Clan bloodline and altered his physique, felt rather embarrassed. In the end, he had no choice but to bide his time and slowly cultivate to redevelop his family.
The reason for starting anew was simply that the others had perished during the integration of the Demon Clan genetic bloodline.
After all, that was the blood of a Demon Clan being from the Ninth Heavens. Attempting to integrate it was akin to infusing oneself with Giant Beast Essence and Blood—ordinary people who rashly took it into their bodies only had one path: death.
This family was actually very cautious and kept a low profile, so much so that even when faced with Mathilda Ward, they remained indifferent.
After all, killing Mathilda Ward wouldn’t benefit them at all. Instead, it would reveal their identities, to the extent that even the Demon God Sect was unaware that a ‘Demon Clan’ descendant still existed here.
Unfortunately, they encountered Jack Clark.
If Irvin Yamaki had known he would be so unlucky earlier, he definitely would not have accepted Dean Klein’s invitation to welcome such an important person.
After the battle ended, the natural next step was to search the corpses, but… the Yamaki Family was too poor. Having developed in seclusion within the shrine for decades, they didn’t even possess storage equipment.
Because they had no contributions to the Federation, even though they had gathered some Contribution Points in the Black Market, they were not eligible to exchange them, let alone acquire resources.
However, that Demon Clan arm should fetch a fair price, likely no less than 1000 Contribution Points, as it was the remains of a Ninth Heavens Demon Clan being.
For the Human Race, it held great research and utilitarian value.
For example, within the numerous Base Satellites that had fallen to the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, there was one containing the remnants of a high-order Demon Clan corpse. This was what triggered the demon gas to sweep through the mountain ranges, ensuring no enemies were hidden.
This kind of device is also utilized in the Outer World, and it is one of the reasons why the Evil God Sect has not been able to cause significant chaos over the past decade.
Soon, a fleet of black vehicles and personnel from the Patrol Office arrived to cordon off the small hill. With the Special Service Department taking charge of the situation, Jack Clark and the others departed by car.
Back at the hotel, Jack Clark took a bath and then lay on the bed, his attention shifting to his Avatar.
Inside the sealed Ice Crystal Palace, the Silver Giant Dragon lay quietly, its brow flickering with silver radiance as countless mysterious space runes appeared on that Dragon Scale.
In mid-air, a 3D-like silver galaxy rotated slowly, revealing the mysteries of space to the Thunderflame Behemoth.
But the core essence of this Innate Space Rune, resembling an ‘Innate Divine Ability,’ had already merged with Scythia’s soul. What was displayed now was just a shell.
It was just a part of the rune’s capacity for space, representing a certain physical trace of space.
Therefore, even after the Thunderflame Behemoth’s comprehension, it wouldn’t mean it had grasped all the secrets of space. It was like having the Seven Great Talent Runes at its disposal, but that didn’t equate to being able to create Talent on its own.
Even so, that was enough.
Hum!
At that moment, the flickering silver galaxy in mid-air became unstable, pulsating rapidly, and then without sound or motion, it shattered, turning into countless white light points that vanished.
The Silver Giant Dragon slowly opened its eyes, revealing a look of exhaustion within its Dragon Eyes.
Activating Soul Power to stimulate the innate runes, even though it was a Giant Dragon, a few hours of continuance left it utterly exhausted. It groaned, “Brock Abbott, I can’t go on.”
The Thunderflame Behemoth responded with a low growl, “You’ve worked hard, Scythia. I feel that after two more times, I might comprehend the basics of ‘space’.”
“Roar! Two more times? Okay then,” the Silver Giant Dragon said with a reluctant dragon face.
The feeling of soul weakness was uncomfortable, but as a noble Giant Dragon, having promised to help the Thunderflame Behemoth understand space runes, it would not break its word.
“Roar! I’m going to sleep. I’ll continue when my Soul Power is restored.” With a low growl, the Silver Giant Dragon slowly closed its eyes and laid prone in the Ice Crystal Palace, slipping into hibernation.
Gazing at the majestic and mystical Silver Giant Dragon before it, the Thunderflame Behemoth showed a touch of satisfaction in its golden vertical pupils.
This session of comprehending the space runes had been a great harvest for it.
However, with the Silver Giant Dragon asleep, it couldn’t just sit idly by; with this in mind, the Thunderflame Behemoth extended its right claw and began inscribing force field binding runes on the fine scales.
It had been busy lately, so much so that after its breakthrough to level eight, it temporarily had no time to go out and devour Unique Beasts.
It could only wait to finish its current tasks before rushing into the Outer Sea to hunt down those level seven and level eight Giant Beasts to accumulate Evolution value and grow swiftly, aiming to break through to Level 9 soon.
The next morning, Jack Clark got up and had finished washing and brushing when he received a message that 315 Contribution Points had been credited to his account.
The Ninth Heavens Demon Clan arm, after official valuation, had seen its price plummet due to its Essence Blood being dried up and stored for too long, fetching a price of 630 points, which was then split between the two.
“Over three hundred contributions.”
Jack Clark looked at the account which, when combined with the remaining 50 points he had, accumulated to 365 Contribution Points. After some thought, he put on his glasses and connected to the Heavenly Think Tank.
His gaze scanned over a dozen types of resources that were suitable for Sixth Heaven cultivators, capable of quickly enhancing True Strength, and eventually Jack Clark chose the Blue Crystal.
“Delivery address refreshed. 360 Contribution Points deducted. The 12 Blue Crystals you exchanged are expected to arrive within an hour. Please wait a moment.”
Being a level higher than the Energy Crystal Body, Blue Crystals contained extremely pure energy that could be rapidly refined and absorbed by cultivators.
Previously, when Justin Welan took Jack Clark to Koroya, he had given Jack a Blue Crystal, and just one was enough for them, who were at the Second Layer Heaven at the time, to cultivate for two to three months.
Now, Jack Clark needed swift growth in True Strength, to reach the peak of the Sixth Heavens as soon as possible, making the Life Crystals relatively useless for him.
By Jack Clark’s estimates, twelve Blue Crystals should allow him to break through to the mid-period of the Sixth Heavens within a few days.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 216: The Decaying Body of the Ninth Heavens, Soul Exhaustion s
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: Chapter 216: The Decaying Body of the Ninth Heavens, Soul Exhaustion s
Translator: 549690339
By then, his strength would have increased “a little”, true, the breakthrough to the mid-stage of the Sixth-level Heaven wouldn’t significantly enhance his current combat power.
Because his cultivation realm was already at the “peak” of the early stage of the Sixth-level Heaven, only a step away from the mid-stage, the breakthrough would merely double his True Strength, making his combat outbursts last longer.
After washing and brushing up, Jack Clark, wearing sunglasses, made his way to Mathilda Ward’s place.
But as soon as the door opened following fingerprint verification, Jack saw Mathilda, pale and weakly leaning on the sofa, with mysterious scale runes emerging on her forehead.
In her presence, Jack keenly felt the aura of a soul, and it was fading.
Jack’s figure flashed to the side of the sofa, his expression solemn, “Miss Ward, are you okay? Do you want me to notify someone else?”
Mathilda Ward shook her head weakly: “No! No need, I’ll be fine in a moment.”
Under Jack’s watchful eye, about ten minutes later, the sensation of Mathilda’s soul continually weakening disappeared, the mysterious runes on her forehead vanished, and her complexion visibly recovered to a healthy glow.
In the blink of an eye, Mathilda, who had just appeared weak and near death, was back to normal, as if the scene had never occurred.
“I’m fine now.”
Mathilda Ward showed a smile on her face: “This weakening of the soul happens in waves; as long as I get through it, it’ll be all right.”
As for what would happen if she didn’t get through it, she didn’t say, nor did she need to.
Jack fell silent for a moment: “After touching the Ninth Heaven Touch Principle in cultivation, the soul becomes involved, and during the breakthrough to the king-level, the soul undergoes a transformation, not to mention a strong man like the Mysterious Martial Sky King.”
“So even he can’t do anything about this kind of ‘injury’?”
Having interacted for a week, Jack had grown to admire this confident, magnanimous, proactive girl who, even in the face of death, showed no fear.
He somewhat couldn’t bear to see her die like this.
“There’s no way.”
Mathilda Ward shook her head slightly: “My injury is different from a normal soul damage; it was inherently flawed from birth, like a bottle inherently hollow at the bottom.”
“Even after using various soul-typed resources over the years, I couldn’t repair that hollow, only slowing down the leakage of my soul.”
“But perhaps due to ‘drug resistance,’ starting three years ago, my soul hasn’t been able to absorb any more energy from soul-tvpe resources.”
Speaking of this, Mathilda on the sofa hugged her knees, whispering, “Actually, the feeling of clearly sensing one’s life continuously slipping away, drawing closer to death, is terrifying.”
“But I am the daughter of the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King; I can’t disgrace my father.”
“So these past fewyears, I’ve been encouraging myself, telling myself that even if I were to die, I would die standing, and even then with a smile on my face.”
“No one in the Ward family is afraid of death, just like my big brother and second brother… ”
Saying this, the girl’s eyes showed a steadfast color, and the bit of weakness that had crept into her heart when her soul was weakening gradually dissipated.
Mathilda stood up, full of energy: “Let’s go, Brother Callum, we’ll have breakfast first, then I need to practice two new songs to prepare for the concert in a few days.”
“In my life’s final chapter, I want to make the entire world remember me.”
Following the removal of the Yamaki Family, nothing much happened in the following days, and the entire East Capital remained normal, prospering as always.
Meanwhile, as Mathilda Ward’s team gradually arrived, everyone became busy, including Jack Clark, who was preoccupied with absorbing Blue Crystal to cultivate; only Damon Lopes had nothing to do.
Or rather, he too was busy, busy adding beauties as friends, then sending them red envelopes, enjoying the feeling when those beauties called him handsome.
At the same time, the Avatar continued to immerse itself in the comprehension of space runes, progressing steadily, and was close to fully understanding that
rune.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 217: Combat Divine Body, Jack Clark Takes Off, Giant Beast Illiterate (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: Chapter 217: Combat Divine Body, Jack Clark Takes Off, Giant Beast Illiterate (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
Translator: 549690339
On the morning when the Eastern City Concert was about to start, in the room, with a click, the last of the Blue Crystals turned to powder and dispersed from Jack’s hand.
Whoosh, whoosh!!
An invisible wind swirled around Jack, his black hair fluttering without wind as a terrifying aura he had been desperately suppressing within him spread out, accompanied by the sound of Dragon Roars and Elephant Roars.
After absorbing the energy of over a dozen Blue Crystals and refining them, Jack’s cultivation had finally broken through to the mid-stage of the Sixth Heaven, his True Force Flame becoming more overbearing and his Combat Techniques more powerful.
However, he didn’t care much for this breakthrough in cultivation as he was already only a step away from it.
What he truly gained during this time was the construction of the Secret Book.
On the airplane, after a conversation with Mathilda clarified his thoughts, Jack spent the following days focusing on the newly-constructed Secret Book, apart from his cultivation.
Furthermore, with his divided attention on comprehending the Innate Space Runes recently, he had gradually outlined the framework of the Combat Divine Body.
The Combat Divine Body is the name Jack chose for his Secret Book, modeled after the mythical images of Three-headed Six-armed or Law Heavenly Phenomenon conflict found in myths and legends.
In the seventh layer of the Secret Book designed over these past few days, he abandoned his initial idea of centering it around the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune. Instead, he planned to prioritize the Thunderflame Talent, with the Divine Might Dragon Elephant as a secondary element.
The Combat Divine Body that will eventually form will still possess the power of the Divine Dragon Elephant, using it to not only enhance the strength of the battle body but also to serve as a disguise.
After all, the Cultivation Methods he had been primarily practicing all along were Dragon Elephant Power and Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and the Secret Book he was comprehending was also the God Elephant Secret Book.
In fact, because of the Dragon Elephant Overbearing Body Method and True Martial Rune, it would have been simpler for him to create the secret book centered around the God Elephant Secret Book, but Jack felt it wasn’t strong enough.
Indeed, not strong enough.
The Godly Dragon Elephant is a Mythical Giant Beast, but the person who created the Secret Book back then had only grasped a portion of the ‘Divine Might’ of the Godly Dragon Elephant, which was incomplete.
In this case, it’s naturally incomparable to the Six Major Talents possessed by the Thunderflame Giant Beast that Jack controls.
Even though Thunderflame is only at level eight right now, it already has seven talents analogous to innate divine powers, of which two are top-tier, one is senior, and two are intermediate.
Moreover, as the Thunderflame Giant Beast’s level continues to increase, the prowess of its talents is also slowly growing. By the time it reaches the peak of Level 9 and makes a breakthrough to the Mythical-level, each talent will have gathered the power of the corresponding laws.
And this is assuming the talent levels don’t change.
The higher the talent level, the stronger the rune power that condenses, and the greater the Law Power that emerges when breaking through to the King- level.
To make the Thunderflame Giant Beast an invincible being after ascending to the mythical realm, Jack is preparing to enhance the Thunderflame Talent next, including his Soul Talent as well.
As for the required attribute points, they are naturally to come from Mutant Beasts.
The ocean is vast, naturally hosting a terrifying number of Mutated Creatures.
It’s just that Life Crystals are only found inside Mutated Creatures that have reached the peak of their current levels, so in the past, the Thunderflame Giant Beast did not deliberately seek them out.
It’s too time-consuming and labor-intensive.
Just like human cultivators, those Mutated Creatures cannot be differentiated in terms of the specific realm of their level unless they burst forth with all their strength in a battle.
It’s like that time when the Silver Giant Dragon encountered the Nine-headed Flood Dragon.
Although the hibernating Nine-headed Flood Dragon was radiating the aura of a Level 8 beast and seemed very powerful, the Silver Giant Dragon still couldn’t tell exactly how strong it was before it fully unleashed its power.
Not to mention that even if they collected crystals, it’s difficult to deliver them to the main body.
With a combination of various issues, this is why the Thunderflame Giant Beast hasn’t gathered much crystal energy lately, and the occasional crystal it stumbled upon was simply eaten and transformed into Evolution Value.
However, the issue of resource exchange between the main body and the beast has now found a solution.
Feeling the invisible ‘pathway’ between the main body and the beast, a smile appeared on Jack’s face.
Due to their soul unity, there had always been a ‘pathway’ between Jack and the beast, but this pathway formed by the power of the soul could only conduct ‘Evolution Energy’.
Whenever the beast’s body grew stronger, part of the Evolution Energy would flow into Jack through the Soul Channel, enhancing his physical body.
Now, with Jack’s deeper understanding of space, he had finally perceived the existence of the pathway within him clearly.
Next, if he finds a way to use that ‘pathway’ as a foundation and construct a space transmission channel within his body, he will be able to achieve a flow of resources between the main body and the beast.
This task took priority over constructing the True Martial Secret Canon for the main body and inscribing runes on the Avatar.
Below the deep sea, cracks suddenly appeared in the icy walls of the Ice- encrusted Ice Crystal Palace, and with a ‘boom,’ they shattered, revealing a gigantic black-red claw behind.
With a casual swipe of the claw that shattered the main gate, the massive and fierce-looking black-red Colossal Beast emerged, standing on the palace steps before suddenly lifting his head and letting out a roar.
Roar!
The deep roar echoed through the seabed, the sound traveling through the sea water and reaching a radius of several kilometers, making countless marine creatures tremble under the extreme ferocity of the Dragon Might.
In the distant Nine-headed Dragon King Palace, the slumbering Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s nine eyes opened.
On the edge of the desert island, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle basking on the shallow beach suddenly got up.
Besides them, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish who had been out for a few days and returned, and the three Mutated Tiger Whales which had grown to twenty and forty meters, all stirred.
Soon with the sea water churning, the hundred-meter long Nine-headed Flood Dragon appeared, wrapping its huge body around the seabed and looking at the Thunderflame Giant Beast with confusion as its nine heads roared chaotically.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Abbott, are you calling me for something?”
The Thunderflame Giant Beast growled, “Just a little matter, I’ll discuss it when Joe and the others arrive.”

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 217: Combat Divine Body, Jack Clark Takes Off, Illiterate Giant Beast (Requesting Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Chapter 217: Combat Divine Body, Jack Clark Takes Off, Illiterate Giant Beast (Requesting Monthly Votes)_2
Translator: 549690339
Soon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, 60 meters in length and over 4.0 meters in height, appeared with heavy steps. Each step it took caused the seabed to tremble violently, fracturing the earth.
Due to its thick shell, the weight of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had already surpassed 10,000 tons. Although its body density was not as immense as that of the Thunderflame Behemoth, it was still astonishing.
Following closely, the equally massive Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and four other differently-sized Mutated Tiger Whales swam down from above, all turning their attention to the back of the Thunderflame Behemoth…
Behind the Thunderflame Behemoth, inside the Ice Crystal Palace, lay the Silver Giant Dragon, weak and prostrate on the ground. This scene caused all the giant beasts, including the Tiger Whales, to pause slightly in astonishment.
What’s happening here, what have you all been doing sealed inside the Ice Crystal Palace these past few days?
Why does it seem like Dragon King Sesidya has become somewhat weak?
For a moment, curiosity and gossip filled the eyes of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, Tiger Whales, Dragon Turtle, and Female Tiger Whale.
The clueless Silver Giant Dragon was wondering what the Thunderflame Behemoth intended to do when it suddenly roared to summon all the extraordinary creatures.
Standing on a platform tens of meters high, the Thunderflame Behemoth rose up on its hind legs, appearing even more imposing.
Furthermore, the three pairs of red feather horns that spread out on both sides of its dragon head, along with the golden flames burning atop to form a Flame Crown, made it look extremely majestic and overbearing.
In comparison to the Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Behemoth, now surrounded by other giant beasts, resembled the King of the Beasts even more.
“Roar! The king and Sesidya have been in closed-door cultivation for a few days, gaining some insights into the essential nature of our powers as extraordinary creatures. For example, like this.”
With a low growl, the Thunderflame Behemoth extended its right claw, and in an instant, the endless Blue Thunder within its body gathered. A long spear, 30 meters in length and completely formed from the accumulations of thunder, appeared in its claw.
“Roar! Normally, we extraordinary creatures rely on instinct to control our gifted abilities in combat. Although strong, this approach is too crude.”
“After pondering and researching for some time, I have discovered that our abilities actually contain a certain principle of Heaven and Earth and have traces that can be followed. 1 have come to call these ‘runes’.”
“These runes are complex and varied, each possessing magical and special powers.”
“For example, inscribed on the scale armor of my right claw are Runes with the ‘Binding Field,’ which can help me compress and concentrate power more forcefully.”
With a low growl and a swing of its right claw, the Thunderflame Behemoth transformed the Thunder Spear into a blue beam that shot up into the sky, piercing through over a kilometer of sea surface.
Boom!
With the burst of thunder power compressed dozens of times, a massive blue light ball appeared on the sea surface in an instant, eradicating and vaporizing sea water within a hundred-meter radius under its destructive power.
Then it exploded with a crash, and countless bolts of lightning spread across several hundred meters of sea surface. The explosion-generated tsunami, tens of meters high, swept towards the desert island.
Such power and a form of attack different from the usual gifted abilities left the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, and even the Nine-headed Flood Dragon with their eyes wide open in shock.
Especially the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which suddenly recalled the gold scorching power contained in the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claws during their battle.
So it was the ‘Runes’ created by Abbott. No wonder it felt stronger than the flames and frost that swirled around it and more convenient than its Breath.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame, you’re too impressive, you truly are!
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out an excited roar, shaking its head vigorously, eyes brimming with ceaseless admiration.
Roar, roar!! Thunderflame, I want to learn, I want to learn.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was even more frantic, twisting its body wildly and churning the surrounding sea water into a muddy vortex, its excitement clear as it saw light…
No, that’s not it, it saw hope; it saw the hope that it too could unleash powerful energy attacks.
Roar, roar!!
The Three-headed Mutated Tiger Whales, not understanding any of this, saw their ‘father’ so excited, immediately followed and excitedly swam about, causing even more violent water currents.
Then the black Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook its nine heads and hesitated before growling, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, can I, can I learn it?”
After the Nine-headed Flood Dragon spoke, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish instinctively shrank their necks a bit, somewhat wary of the ferocious behemoth that had beaten them up before.
Of course, this was just an expression; the Tiger Kingfish didn’t actually have a neck.
The Thunderflame Behemoth growled lowly, “Of course you can. We’re all members of the Dragon Palace. Although there are some differences in strength and status, we’re all family.”
With that said, the Thunderflame Behemoth looked towards the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle and growled, “And you two, Kido has joined the Dragon Palace, and from now on, we are brothers; there’s no need to fear.”
In recent times, occupied with contemplating the space runes, the Thunderflame Behemoth had no time to pay attention to external affairs.
Hence, although the Nine-headed Flood Dragon had joined the Dragon Palace a few days ago, it was still somewhat estranged from the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Dragon Turtle, and the Mutated Tiger Whales.
Or it could be said that these creatures were somewhat wary of the ferocious Nine-headed Flood Dragon.
But now that the Thunderflame Behemoth had spoken, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, always deferential to it, was the first to roar, “Roar roar!! Kido, we’re all brothers.”
Trusting the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish did not hesitate and looked more kindly at the Nine-headed Flood Dragon as its enormous fins waved.
Roar, roar!! Brothers, we’re all brothers; let’s go find some good stuff together.
Roar roar!! Big Joe, you have the nerve to say that; haven’t you found any good things after all this time?
Roar, roar!! I want to, but the ocean is so vast, it takes time to find good things. A promising find I recently made was also guarded by a very fierce creature..

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 217: Combat Divine Body, Jack Clark Takes Off, Illiterate Giant Beast (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: Chapter 217: Combat Divine Body, Jack Clark Takes Off, Illiterate Giant Beast (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
Translator: 549690339
Actually, it’s not that the Single-horned Tiger Whale couldn’t find anything good; it had discovered some resources recently.
But compared to the time when they were at fifth or sixth level, those common low-level resources are no longer of much help, so they now target resources that would be useful to eighth level Giants Beasts.
In such cases, the quantity naturally became scarce.
After all, even if treasures of heaven and earth do appear, they would have been devoured by the surrounding Mutated Creatures in no time, leaving only the special ones behind.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Behemoth continued to growl lowly, “Right now, this king has researched three types of runes. Although the power of each individually is ordinary, they will be very powerful when many are stacked together.”
“However, this kind of deduction is very draining on Life Energy. I need to replenish, so next, you all will go out and help me search for energy to bring back.”
“At that time, this king will, according to the individual Talent Abilities of you all, help you research and deduce new runes specifically, making you all even stronger.”
Excited, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon swung its heads and roared chaotically, “Roar, roar, roar!! No problem, just, Abbott, energy, where, to find it?”
“Roar! This is simple, as long as they are Extraordinary Creatures, when they reach the Peak of their realm, their bodies will condense crystals that contain Life Energy, regardless of species and size.”
“So, you all need to search for these Mutated Creatures at the peak of their level, kill them, and bring back the crystals that contain Life Energy from inside them.”
But no sooner was this problem solved than these creatures encountered a new one.
Roar, roar, roar!! Thunderflame, what is level?
“Roar! Level is a distinction among us Extraordinary Creatures…”
Next, the Thunderflame Behemoth had no choice but to educate these island creatures about the differences in levels among Extraordinary Creatures. Compared to humans with a civilized heritage, these Extraordinary Creatures were quite muddled in their thinking, evaluating others’ strength based on size and the power of their Aura.
Although they could feel the corresponding levels, they had no clear concept of ‘level’.
To put it simply, among the Extraordinary Creatures in the Dragon Palace right now, only the Silver Giant Dragon had a bit of culture; all others were illiterate, having grown up in the wilds.
Therefore, to educate them, the Thunderflame Behemoth had no choice but to roughly simulate the Aura strength of Mutated Creatures at each level and also carved marks on the walls of the Ice Crystal Palace.
“Roar! This mark, along with the Aura strength, is about Level 1…” The Thunderflame Behemoth stood on the Ice Platform, its claws drawing large numbers on the ice wall.
“This is Level 4. Creatures at this strength level can send out their energy externally… This one is Level 8.”
“Also, when you encounter creatures whose Auras are concealed, you need to be cautious about their Talent Abilities; sometimes a higher level doesn’t guarantee victory.”
“Moreover, when you fight, don’t just charge at the sight of a beast; learn to cooperate, observe – for example, clawed creatures typically attack with claws first in combat…”
“We must learn to utilize our advantages, such as Kestra’s three dragon heads which are formidable in close combat, while the other heads have talented Breaths, which can form a tiered combat strategy…”
As it spoke, the Thunderflame Behemoth gave these creatures a thorough education.
It didn’t only explain the different levels, it also taught how to cooperate in combat, how to deal with clawed creatures or octopuses and other many-limbed creatures, and how to combine their own Talent Abilities to exert stronger combat strengths.
Suddenly, on the steps of the Ice Grystal Platform, the black and red ferocious behemoth growled continuously, while the Dragon Turtle and Tiger Whales lying below shook their heads and swayed their bodies.
Even the coiling Nine-headed Flood Dragon listened excitedly, realizing that battle could be fought this way – its previous berserk charge was too reckless.
Compared to these ‘rural’ Giant Beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon in the back was slightly better off but still listened with gleaming Dragon Eyes, not expecting the Thunderflame Behemoth to know so much.
So intelligent, surely it’s the ‘genius’ with the Mythical Giant Beast Inheritance?
After roaring non-stop for more than an hour, the Thunderflame Behemoth finally took a breath and spat out scorching golden flames before growling lowly, “Enough, get going, and get me those Life Crystals.”
“Roar, roar, roar!! Charge, charge, I want to become stronger…”
Roar, roar, roar!! Kill, get Life Crystals for Thunderflame.
Roar, roar!! And for Domination.
Accompanied by thunderous roars, one massive Mutant Beast after another excitedly burst out of the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace, scattering in all directions. After the tide of Giant Beasts left, the Thunderflame Behemoth returned to the Storm Snow Palace and began to teach the Silver Giant Dragon the Basic Rune of forcefield binding as it had promised.
Meanwhile, the surrounding seas started to boil over.
Boom!
A hundred meters below the sea surface, a nineteen-meter-long Whale Shark was sent flying by the wing-like fins of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, its half-destroyed scales shattered and blood flowing freely.
Roar, roar, roar!! Seems like Level 4 Late Stage, not Peak, no use.
After speaking, the massive body of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish turned and charged deeper into the seabed, disappearing in the blink of an eye, leaving the Whale Shark that thought it was about to die bewildered in its place.
Roar, roar!! It’s not even a Level 5 Peak, useless.
Hundreds of meters below the sea, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle spat out several tons of flesh and blood from its mouth, its eyes showing disdain as its massive body turned and rumbled away along the seabed.
Having just learned about ‘level’ distinctions, they still needed time to become practiced enough to more accurately discern what constituted a Peak creature of their level.
Lying motionless on the seabed was a Mutated Creature resembling a sailfish, measuring twenty-nine meters in length, with a massive wound beneath its neck gushing blood like a fountain.
In its dying eyes, wide open even in death, fear and cluelessness were apparent; in its last moments, it couldn’t understand why it was useless.
Roar, roar, roar!!
One large and three small Tiger Whales surrounded a school of Mutated Fish, each ten to several tens of meters in length, continuously launching attacks, segmenting the fish.
After scattering the school of fish, the four Tiger Whales joined forces and swiftly killed one after another Mutated Fish that they believed to be at ‘Peak’ level.
Unlike the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Dragon Turtle, who were wreaking havoc in the nearby oceans, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon swam further into the deep sea, prepared to hunt Beasts above Level 7.
Because the Thunderflame Behemoth had mentioned earlier that the bigger the Extraordinary Creature and the higher its level, the more Life Energy it contained.
It was time to repay Brock Abbott for the honor of naming it..

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - 218: That Bodyguard is Back, International Substitute, King-Level Online Fishing
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: Chapter 218: That Bodyguard is Back, International Substitute, King-Level Online Fishing
Translator: 549690339
“Energy and objects are different; to cross infinite distances and appear instantly on the other side, a stable pathway is needed.”
“And the formation of a spatial channel requires two docking point space runes, the power of coordinate positioning, and the carrying power to form the transmission of the spatial channel…”
In the secret space, as Jack Clark’s power of intent operated, a thread made of tiny, illusory runes emerged from nothingness and began to twist around itself.
Gradually, a hazy space rune appeared, followed by a second one.
These were two basic space runes. Next, Jack needed to use these as a foundation, and just like constructing a secret book, integrate the coordinates to start building.
Although he hadn’t touched upon the ‘path’ of the space law wielded by the Silver Giant Dragon, it had given Jack a clear understanding of the basic essence of space.
He just needed to extend from this foundation, extrapolate, and combine basic runes with properties of coordinates and tearing together, then slowly verify, and he would soon complete the ‘pathway’.
In fact, his rapid comprehension of the innate runes was also related to Jack’s inherent talent for space.
Under the state of Golden Dragon Double Pupils, he could see through the fabric of space, peering into the deeper void to ponder the mysteries of space.
Moreover, with the opportunity presented this time, after comprehending a part of the basic essence of space, he could continue to understand the power of space with the help of the double pupils.
He might even have the hope of mastering the Space Law by the time he reached the peak of Ninth Heavens.
In the corridor, Damon Lopes leaned against the wall and reminded Jack, “Brother Callum, Brother Callum… It’s time to leave.”
“Is it time to depart?” Jack looked up, closing the Godly Dragon Elephant Secret Book in his hands that resembled a white book, the silver illusions in his eyes gradually dissipating.
“Brother Callum, you’re really working too hard, pondering the secret book even while standing outside the door,” Damon said with an admiring look in his eyes.
He had seen many geniuses who reached the Late-Stage Eifth Layer Heaven and its peak within three years of cultivation, each of them top-notch geniuses at their Martial Arts Schools.
But compared to them, the talent of Darren Callum before him was not only higher, but he also worked much harder.
Through the ten and some days of contact, Damon had found that this brother, whenever he had time, would be either cultivating or on the path of contemplating the secret book, his will was unnaturally tenacious.
Even he, who claimed to love cultivation, was unable to commit to such an extent, occasionally getting distracted and engaging in other matters, like chatting with beauties.
At this moment, Jack asked, “Mr. Lopes, you’ve been wandering around the hotel a lot lately, have you discovered anything?”
Even though the surroundings of the hotel had been very normal recently, both of them did not take it lightly, given that their opponents were two king-level existences.
Even if the opponent was only a soul avatar with a cultivation realm possessing only Sixth Layer strength, the opponent’s experience, insight, and realm were still at the king level.
If it were not for the fact that the cut-out soul avatar did not contain the law and could only use the power of intent to pull on Heavenly Energy, the opponent’s combat power would be even more terrifying.
Speaking of this, Damon Lopes said enthusiastically, “These past few days, I’ve added more than twenty beautiful female friends, and there are still people looking to chat with me even at midnight.”
“Especially Xiao Qiao, every night at eleven o’clock, she sends me private photos and asks me to go out shopping.”
“But 1 never agreed; what’s there to browse at eleven o’clock? The streets are empty, are you going to watch ghost shadows?”
Asking to go out shopping in the middle of the night naturally means going to a hotel, thought Jack with a weird look. He then asked, “…How many red envelopes have you sent out these past few days?”
“Not much, just over a hundred thousand.”
“Haven’t you thought about asking one or two of them out?”
Damon Lopes looked at Jack with puzzlement, “What for? It’s said that shopping and dating with women is very bothersome, chatting is much more interesting.”
… Jack could only say that this innate awakening genius indeed had a unique way of thinking.
As for Damon Lopes’s actions of spending money to have those women fawn over him, Jack could only say that it was a luxury to be willful, and who was fawning over whom in the end was a matter of perspective.
At this point, Crystal Boyce, Mathilda Ward, Marla Fiore, as well as the beautiful backup dancers came out of the room, followed by the music team.
They had been having a meeting inside, and feeling bored, Jack had stepped out after confirming there were no anomalies, snatching the time to construct the Spatial Channel Rune.
Soon, a dozen or so sedans departed from the hotel, and from a high altitude, it was visible that many people in East Capital were converging on the Divine Light Stadium in a grand procession.
While Mathilda Ward’s fan base was in Eastern Summer, she had many fans in Cross Mountain too, due to the spread of her music and her public image.
And like in Eastern Summer, the same approach was taken, drawing a certain number of people from each city to attend the concert for free.
Compared to the stadium in the South, East Capital’s Divine Light Stadium, the largest, could only accommodate over twenty thousand and had a different layout, similar to a football pitch.
So for the past few days, Crystal Boyce had been coordinating with the local officials to remodel the stadium.
“Miss llisa, this way.”
The staff led Mathilda Ward and others to the backstage makeup room, while Jack, wearing a black suit and of tall stature, stepped forward first and entered.
Standing at the door, Jack scanned every corner sharply with his eyes, listening, smelling, and amplifying his senses, while his soul awareness spread out. Only after confirming everything was safe did he retract his gaze.
“It’s clear,” Jack said, stepping aside from the door.
While Mathilda Ward and others were preparing backstage, in the evening outside the stadium entrance, many television stations and media had already set up their cameras and began their live broadcasts.
“Hello everyone, I’m Host Erica from Banana Platform. Behind me is the concert site of the international superstar, Miss llisa Ward. The ticket checking has already started..”

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 218: That Bodyguard is Back Again, International Substitute, King-Level Online Fishing_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Chapter 218: That Bodyguard is Back Again, International Substitute, King-Level Online Fishing_2
Translator: 549690339
“Not only do we have fans of Mathilda Ward coming from all corners of the country, but many domestic celebrities have also posted before, saying they would come to watch the concert.”
“Look, the celebrity convoy has arrived.”
“Leading the way is the award-winning actress Julia Skinner, who today is wearing a white slit dress, showcasing her sexy figure.”
“Arm in arm with Julia Skinner is the popular action star Mullen Lyons.”
“It’s rumored that the two have been dating recently, but there’s been no official announcement. Some say Mullen Lyons is even a cultivator from the Third Layer Heaven.”
“The second to arrive is today’s hottest diva, Rosy Tonkin, and she looks gorgeous…”
As the audience gradually took their seats and the evening darkened, the local television station staff, who had already been contacted, also arrived backstage.
“This is the backstage of the concert site where Miss Mathilda Ward is getting ready.”
“We can see that many staff are also busy, everyone is working hard to make today’s concert a complete success.”
“Next, please follow our camera lens as we go to interview Miss Mathilda Ward…”
Accompanied by the shaking of the video camera lens, the group soon reached the makeup room’s entrance, where they were stopped by a hand.”
Dressed in a black suit and white shirt, the tall figure of Jack Clark stood like a city wall by the door, his expressionless face hidden behind sunglasses, calmly saying.
“Today’s pre-concert interviews are cancelled.”
“Damn! It’s that bodyguard, he’s still here.”
“It’s him, it’s him, that detestable guy has shown up again.”
“A bodyguard, he actually dares to prevent TV station staff from interviewing Mathilda Ward, pretty bold.”
When Jack Clark appeared on the screen, viewers around the world watching the live broadcast instantly erupted, filled with surprise, shock, and frustration…
Because that bodyguard was still there.
As a result, wouldn’t this concert also feature a bodyguard stealing the celebrity spotlight?
Not again.
Amidst the wailing of many fans, the time reached 7:50 pm, and at the shout of the backstage director, the lights of the entire stadium went out.
Woo Woo!! A deep horn sounded.
Suddenly, the sky showed a shattered image, and amidst a rumble, a battleship descended from above, surrounded by the flash of exploding firelight, with fighter aircraft projections tumbling down in black smoke.
Aboard the battleship stood Mathilda Ward dressed in a blue and white dazzling military uniform, a white and gold-trimmed military cap on her head, and her long hair dancing in the raging wind, giving off an air of stunning beauty.
But with such a stunning opening scene, many eyes actually turned to the figure standing behind Mathilda Ward.
There, the bodyguard in the black suit stood silently, immovable amid the fire and explosions, like a loyal knight guarding the military princess.
Boom!
As Mathilda Ward stepped off her anti-gravity hoverboard to the ground, fiery lights erupted around the stage, and the 3D projections in the air gradually disappeared.
Then, a passionate battle song started, and dozens of dancers rushed onto the stage— the concert officially began.
This time the stage setup was similar to Eastern Summer, with many special effects filled with the style of Cross Mountain Country.
Add to that the swaying beautiful dancers, the pleasant singing, and that gracefully stunning figure; it was truly a feast for the eyes.
Only, for some reason, many in the audience couldn’t help but divert their gaze, subconsciously searching for the tall figure wearing sunglasses.
Sure enough, at the climax of the first song, Jack Clark stood in front of Mathilda Ward, surrounded by stars, his figure visible on screens in all directions.
“Damn it, that guy is blocking Ilisa again.”
Instantly, the concert site turned into an uproar, the crowd was infuriated, just like the scene at the previous concert in South City.
From below someone shouted, “Is there a warrior who will step forward and beat that guy up? He’s too arrogant.”
“Right, if you’re a man of Cross Mountain, go up and take him down.”
“Brother, you’re shouting so loud, why don’t you go up?”
“Cough! Sorry, I’m not from Cross Mountain.”
Amidst the uproarious crowd, Jack Clark calmly moved away from in front of Mathilda Ward, strolling around the stage as if walking in his own home, drawing much resentment.
Down below, Damon Lopes dimmed his sunglasses and asked, “How is it, Brother Callum, have you found anything?”
Jack’s lips moved slightly as he replied in a low voice, “I have a feeling, but it’s not very strong, probably just a few scouts.”
In the midst of countless disdainful, disgusted, and impatient gazes, Jack Clark had vaguely sensed several malicious stares typical of Blood God Cultists.
Though those glances were faint, there was no helping it; Jack was all too familiar with these guys, constantly dealing with them.
Only the crowd was too large, and he hadn’t pinpointed their locations yet, so the search had to proceed slowly.
“Scouts, huh,” Damon Lopes sounded somewhat disappointed—he had been hoping to make a big show today in front of everyone.
The concert continued, and naturally, Jack Clark roamed the stage arrogantly, irritating many viewers in front of their TVs.
In Mist River City, today, Doris Clark and Glenn Clark were also watching the satellite live broadcast at home.
Looking at the swaggering bodyguard on stage, Doris Clark gazed tenderly.
She noticed that in just two months, Jack Clark had grown a bit taller and seemed more spirited than before, which made her feel at ease.
“Ha ha ha…”
Glenn Clark, watching the live stream comments on his mobile phone, laughed, “My brother is so cool, it’s making those guys itch with annoyance, they even talk about crowdfunding someone to beat Brother up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 218: That Bodyguard is Back Again, International Substitute, King-Level Online Fishing_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Chapter 218: That Bodyguard is Back Again, International Substitute, King-Level Online Fishing_3
Translator: 549690339
“Crowdfunding an assault on your brother, what does that mean?” Doris Clark frowned.
“It’s nothing, just a few wannabe rich second-generations in the live broadcast room claiming they’re from big groups and wealthy families who can’t stand my brother’s arrogance. They’re talking about raising money to hire someone to give him a beating.”
“But that’s the kind of talk you just listen to and laugh off. Heirs to big groups, rich second generations, since when do they have the time to watch live streams, let alone crowdfund.”
“And even if these guys really were rich second generations and hired some experts from martial arts halls, it would be a one-way trip for them. My brother is a Practitioner of the Four Skies.”
Glenn Clark wasn’t concerned.
Although he hadn’t started cultivation, due to the gradual unsealing of martial arts information on the internet recently, Glenn had gained some understanding of advanced cultivators.
He knew just how powerful a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator could be, impervious to blades and with immense strength as just the basics. It was said they had other strange and powerful combat techniques as well.
And the fighters you could usually hire from martial arts halls were only Second or Third Layer, wouldn’t they be heading to their deaths trying to go after his brother?
While the Chen family was watching the concert, in a villa at Mist River, Freya Louise was sitting on the sofa with a tablet, watching the live stream of the
event.
Seeing the arrogant and overbearing figure on stage, Freya Louises’s mouth curled into a smirk, her eyes curving like crescent moons.
This guy really is still the same as ever, seeming humble and low-profile on the outside but actually proud and domineering.
The concert in Cross Mountain Country ended smoothly, without a single incident.
in a small town on the edge of Cross Mountain Country, inside a small shop, a long-haired youth leaned back in a chair, lazily watching the LCD screen on the wall that displayed the scene of Ilisa’s concert dispersing.
Suddenly, the mobile phone on the counter rang, and the young man came to his senses. He picked up the phone and glanced at it before deciding to answer, asking indolently, “What’s up?”
A deep and robust voice came from the other end, “What are your plans now?” The young man’s smile remained unchanged as he casually replied, “Continue to bait the spot.”
The person on the other end spoke in a grave tone, “What does that mean?”
The long-haired youth chuckled, “Just now, a couple of the fishing lines I cast out broke again, but I’ve yet to figure out how they were snapped.”
“So we need to keep baiting the spot to find the pattern of how the lines are getting snapped. Only then can we target the fish and pull them out of the river.”
“Oh, and my previous fishing rods were all broken. I’m still making new ones, so I’ll need your help with the bait for the next baiting.
The person on the other side fell silent for a moment and then responded in a deep voice, “It can be done.”
And with that, the call ended.
The long-haired youth put down the phone and a smile crossed his face, “Technology is getting more and more advanced these days. I remember when phones used to need a wire to work.”
As he spoke, the youth looked up at the LCD display, at Ilisa and the black-clothed figure standing behind her, a playful glint in his eyes.
“Northern Battlefield, Sky Dragon Martial Height, Military Secret Martial Arts Academy, Darren Callum, none of those are your real identity, are they?” “Interesting, I didn’t expect to encounter such an amusing little fellow on this return.”
“The cultivation realm of Early Sixth Heaven, with something akin to Blood Sea Battle Intent, and even the projection of thoughts can form an illusory domain, allowing battle power to leap across a Major Realm.”
“Such talent would have been considered shockingly brilliant even in the past, and it’s quite pleasing to kill a genius like this.”
“But how were those fishing lines exposed?”
“Aura, fluctuations in strength, Killing Intent, or did they slip up in speech and actions? Or is it some even more mysterious detection methods?”
“Soul Eye, psychic premonition, Danger Intuition, or Heavenly Eight Diagrams…”
The long-haired youth’s eyes narrowed slightly.
He wasn’t surprised by this situation; after all, if the daughter of Mysterious Martial was so easy to kill, the decades of development of the Human Race would be a joke.
Suddenly the long-haired youth’s eyes were filled with endless blood light and Killing Intent, his expression maniacal as the entire small shop turned into Hell.
But the blood light quickly faded, and the youth’s expression returned to normal, except his gaze was ice-cold and his voice dark, “This time, I must take back the dragon.”
Just then, the phone on the table rang again, the caller ID still showing the same person.
The long-haired youth’s brow furrowed slightly as he picked up the phone, “What now?”
The voice on the other end was low and dense, “Akunus, I forgot to mention something just now…”
In an instant, the young man’s expression changed slightly, and with a crunch, the phone was crushed to pieces, “Fool.”
He had already told that guy that human technology was very advanced and, although communicating information was convenient, they had to be careful, like not shouting its name during calls, or calling each other king, and so on. Furthermore, they mustn’t use the language of the Demon Clan, and they shouldn’t mention anything including targets and plans, not a single word. Yet, foolishly, that person had let something slip so soon.
With that thought, the long-haired youth’s gaze turned icy as he vanished from the small shop in the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, at the Federal Information Center Yueshan Branch, monitoring globally.
“Report, in the past minute, thirty-one references related to Akunus were detected, twenty-seven of which were dismissed, leaving four suspect instances.”
“One of the four signals was a brief call lasting 0.15 seconds, with content containing the keyword ‘my king,’ though the accent was indistinct.
“Quickly lock down the signal’s location.”
“The call has been disconnected, with one end pinpointed to Maple Town, the other end originating overseas, requiring one minute for pursuit and location locking…”

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 219: Descendant of the King,
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Chapter 219: Descendant of the King,
Summoning Arrival, Thousands of Attribute Points Per Day (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Translator: 549690339
“Among the seven people captured this time, four are from Border Maple Town, and three are from the vicinity of Maple Town.”
“These individuals’ levels of strength are between First and Second Layer Heaven, and five of them had undergone cultivation at the Big City Willow Martial Arts Museum as ordinary students, sometime between five to eight years ago.”
“The other two were graduates of the Martial Arts School, one eight years ago and the other seven, but due to poor talent, only achieved late First Layer Heaven cultivation upon graduation.”
“None of the seven are Evil God Sect Cultists, and they do not carry the strength of the sect on them. Their recent activities and behavior as well as family and surrounding relationships are normal.”
“However, upon examination, it was discovered that their spirits have been contaminated.”
“By tracking the actions of these seven over time, the investigation finally pointed to the owner of a small shop in Maple Town.”
“But by the time military personnel arrived, they found that the small shop owner was already dead, and had been so for quite some time, with the corpse rotting away in the toilet.”
“At the same time, yesterday, the Federation Intelligence Agency suspected to have detected traces of Akunus in Maple Town while monitoring global information through astrological computers…”
The next day, on an airplane headed for the Hundred foxes Nation.
Marla Fiore was holding a folder, detailing the information report sent over from the other side of Cross Mountain.
Damon Lopes appeared thoughtful, “They’re just ordinary cultivators between First and Second Layer Heaven; they can’t carry firearms through security checks. What use does it have for it to contaminate and control these people?
“It’s probably testing for weaknesses in Miss Ward’s defenses nearby,” replied Freya Louise.
Jack calmly said, “There will likely be many more tests until they are certain that the way I detect danger comes solely from direct observation.”
Crystal furrowed her brows slightly, “In that case, Mr. Callum, shouldn’t you try to conceal it?”
Jack shook his head lightly, “There’s no need, or rather, we should let it discover this fact so that when they feel confident, they will show up.”
“Although my way of perceiving threats is indeed through the enemy s gaze, it’s not the only method,” he said, with confidence showing in his eyes.
In this world, there is no lack of Cultivation Methods and Secret Skills that can deceive one’s perception, such as the special technique that Freya is cultivating, which can shield one’s murderous intent, hostility, and even erase one’s presence.
But after the heart-eyed realm rune transformation, the true way Jack perceives danger is like a sixth sense, an ‘intuition’ from within. As long as someone possessed by a king-level spirit gets close, the invisible but intense aura of danger will instantly trigger Jack’s intuitive response, even if they mask their aura, murderous intent, or even their existence.
It will bring danger to Jack.
There are quite a few seats available in First Class on this flight to the Hundred Foxes Nation.
After discussing the matter, Damon Lopes suddenly leaned close to Jack, puzzled, “Brother Callum, last night after the concert, that beauty Rosy Tonkin came over to greet you and wanted to add you as a friend. Why did you turn her down?”
Jack looked at him curiously, “Why would 1 add her as a friend? So she can call me handsome?”
