Pfftl! Ilisa and the other girl next to him burst into laughter; they too knew of Damon’s habit of adding Beautiful Female Friends on social media, sending them red envelopes to have them call him handsome.
Damon didn’t mind Ilisa and the other girl’s laughter, and enviously said, “Didn’t she say she wanted to add you because she plans to hire you as a personal bodyguard once Sister Ilisa fires you? The first beauty of Cross Mountain Country so beautiful, and yet, Brother Callum, you actually refused.
“You believe that?” Jack shook his head, unconcerned, and not wanting to entertain him. Seeing that they had hours of flight ahead of them, he flipped his hand and took out the God Elephant Secret Book.
Last night, he didn’t sleep, and observing spatial conditions with his Golden Dragon Double Pupils, Jack had already constructed the rudiments of a Spatial Channel.
He planned to refine it further, anticipating that after a hundred or so more simulations and deductions, he might succeed.
As long as the Spatial Channel is successfully established, the life crystals obtained from Thunderflame will be supplied to him, and he will no longer have to worry about the source of attribute points.
After all, compared to earning Contribution Points and finding official exchange crystals, having an Ocean power help in collection is much faster.
A thousand meters underwater, in the Ice Crystal Palace.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was the first to return, its huge mouth wide like a black hole, lightly opened as the currents carried down five crystals of varied sizes.
Roar! Thunderflame, I’ve managed to get five crystals.”
“Roar! Not bad,” said the Thunderflame Beheamoth, looking at the three Level 5 and two Level 6 life crystals before him, nodding in satisfaction.
Getting as many crystals in one day means that the Single-horned liger Kingfish has put in a lot of effort, probably dashing through hundreds of kilometers in the sea area.
Half an hour later, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, resembling a small hill, crawled back triumphantly: “Thunderflame, look, I’ve got seven crystals for you, impressive, right?”
“Roar! Well done,” the Thunderflame Beheamoth showed delight in his eyes, taking the two Level 4, three Level 5, and two Level 6 life crystals and setting them aside.
Unexpectedly, Domination performed even better than the Tiger Whale, bringing back so many crystals.
After all, finding high-level mutated organisms at the peak of their level in the sea to kill and then tearing through their bodies to find crystals is quite time-consuming.
Among these Giant Beasts, the Dragon Turtle was better off because it had claws.
After waiting a bit longer, the four teams of Mutated Tiger Whales also returned, bringing with them eleven Level 3 life crystals and four Level 5s.
Indeed, more hands make for lighter work, though due to their strength, the Female Tiger Whale’s team focused on those below sixth level.
Finally, nearly two hours later, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah came back..

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 219: Descendant of the King, Summoning Arrival, Thousands of Attribute Points Per Day (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Chapter 219: Descendant of the King, Summoning Arrival, Thousands of Attribute Points Per Day (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339
In the mouths of this creature’s two huge black dragon heads, each clenched the corpses of colossi at the Level 7 Peak, their entire bodies exuding a terrifying aura.
One of the Level 7 colossi resembled a blue whale, sixty meters in length, while the other, like a Dragon Python, measured over seventy meters, making even the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle’s eyes twitch.
This guy was too strong; it seemed that killing two Level 7 Peak colossi was as easy as slaughtering chickens, without a single injury on its body.
And with the thick bloodthirsty and malevolent aura enveloping it, it seemed to have battled many other Level 7 Giant Beasts, just as it had been fighting all day long.
After all, to know whether a mutated creature had reached its pinnacle, you had to engage in combat.
Bang! Bang! The two colossal corpses, weighing thousands to nearly ten thousand tons each, smashed onto the seabed, causing the ice crystal ground to tremble and the sea to roar.
Kidora’s nine dragon heads swayed menacingly, growling in chaos, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, look, got any, crystals, meat, to eat for you.”
Upon knowing that the Thunderflame Giant Beast needed Life Crystals and liked eating Unique Beast meat, the creature had charged over a thousand kilometers away to hunt and bring back two Level 7 Peak colossi.
During the search for suitable colossi, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon almost swept across a wide sea area, battling all along the way.
“Roar! Let me take a look.” The Thunderflame Giant Beast approached the two colossus corpses, its sharp claw tips gleaming with fiery gold, emitting terrifying high temperatures.
Splat!!
Once divested of their talents and energy enhancements, the armor-alloy scales of the colossi were easily torn apart by the Thunderflame Giant Beast.
Quickly, a golden crystal the size of a human head appeared in its massive claw.
Feeling the immense Life Energy within the crystal, the Thunderflame Giant Beast revealed a ferocious smile and soon extracted another Level 7 crystal from within the other colossus.
Seeing the Thunderflame Giant Beast’s grim smile, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon felt pretty good, too, with each head letting out an excited roar, “Roar roar roar!! Tim Abott, is it, enough?”
After some thought, the Thunderflame Giant Beast shook its head and roared, “Still not enough; let’s go get some more.”
“Roar roar roar!! No, problem, Kidora, is very powerful.”
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon was full of vigor upon seeing it could help the Thunderflame Giant Beast and its massive body directly swam out of the Ice Crystal Palace, vanishing into the dark depths in the blink of an eye.
Seeing this, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle were not to be outdone.
Roar, roar, roar!! Keep going, charging ahead.
Roar roar!! Dominate, gather more, be more powerful.
Roar, roar, roar!! The other four Tiger Whales also let out excited calls and turned to continue their tasks.
Normally, the Tiger Whales would just eat, sleep, and then play some more, so rare was the day they could be of help, suddenly feeling a sense of fulfillment as if they weren’t just freeloaders.
After all these Giant Beasts had left, the Thunderflame Giant Beast sprawled on the Ice Crystal Platform, excitedly fiddling with twenty-nine Life Crystals.
Due to the predominance of high-level crystals, the Thunderflame Giant Beast estimated at least four thousand Attribute Points could be converted here, which even excited it a little.
However, such significant gains could only happen once or twice.
Once Tiger Whales like Abbott hunted down high-level mutated organisms that had reached their peak within a thousand kilometers radius twice, the crystal yield would drop sharply.
After all, these creatures had gained some intelligence after mutating.
Witnessing the emergence of so many menacing presences in this sea area, they would either flee or hide in the coming days.
Moreover, mobilizing the whole Dragon Palace forces to gather crystals for it was a one-time event, as these creatures weren’t its workers.
So, should I cultivate a few ‘workers’ dedicated to collecting Life Crystals?
The Thunderflame Giant Beast thought thoughtfully.
The ocean was teeming with countless mutated creatures that would continue to grow, and all it had to do was expand its territory for a continuous harvest of Life Crystals in the future.
It seems the future tasks of the Dragon Palace could be adjusted to have the four moderate-strength mutated Tiger Whales help collect Life Crystals.
In that case, it would need to enhance their strength as the three Little Tiger Whales were only Level 4 and seemed a bit weak.
While the Thunderflame Giant Beast pondered, the Silver Giant Dragon in the palace behind slowly opened its eyes.
Looking at the shimmering magnetic field constraint rune on the fine scales in its right claw, excitement sparked in the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes, for it had learned.
The method in which the Thunderflame Giant Beast taught it the runes was straightforward—the will directly imprinted the rune’s information into the brain of the Silver Giant Dragon.
The imprinted rune would continuously show in the Silver Giant Dragon’s mind how to condense and construct it until the willpower contained within was exhausted.
This technique was based on the school’s pupil information reflection technology that the Thunderflame Giant Beast had referenced.
Even the dullest could succeed after tens or even hundreds of attempts using this method, just like the Tiger Fish and Dragon Turtle, who had already cultivated a Hidden Deity Glyph.
Of course, the Silver Giant Dragon had to open its Sea of Consciousness to do so, which no beast would dare unless it had absolute trust.
“Roar! Tim Abott, do you really like these crystals?”
The Thunderflame Giant Beast growled lowly, “It’s not about liking them, these Life Crystals are very important to me.”
“Roar! 1 see. Today, Great Sethia is in a good mood and will lend you a hand.” Saying that, the Silver Giant Dragon moved and swam out as well.
In a good mood, huh? Watching the Silver Giant Dragon disappear into the seabed, the Thunderflame Giant Beast’s face revealed a sinister, human-like grin.
Then the Thunderflame Giant Beast closed its eyes and plunged its consciousness into its body, beginning to mobilize its Qi Blood and Spiritual Will to condense space runes.
Jack Clark had a clear division of labor between his human and beast bodies, one for theorizing and the other for clinical testing within the body, which is also why the Spatial Channel Rune was progressing so quickly..

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 219: Descendant of the King, Summoning Arrival, Thousands of Attribute Points Per Day (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Chapter 219: Descendant of the King, Summoning Arrival, Thousands of Attribute Points Per Day (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3
Translator: 549690339
Boom! Just then, blood surged within the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s body, and a large chunk of its flesh and blood shattered under the collapsing rune power.
But such injury was as negligible as a scratch to the Thunderflame Beheamoth. With its Regeneration Talent, the shattered flesh quickly dissolved, followed by the growth of new tissue, restoring its condition to how it originally was.
The process then continued.
Two o’clock in the afternoon.
“Dear passengers, the airplane has reached the airspace over Green Mountain City and will soon begin to taxi. The temperature outside is twenty-four Celsius, and the weather is clear…”
Following the airplane’s landing, Jack Clark and his companions arrived at the bustling city of Green Mountain in the Hundred Foxes Nation.
As a country established after the New Era and named after the fox, the cultural development of the Hundred Foxes Nation differed slightly from that of other nations.
For instance, many people in this country kept foxes, and fox-related elements were ubiquitous, with many cultivators having entered into contracts with Mutated Fox Demons.
The reason was that the King-level strong man of this country possessed an Avatar Giant Beast that had mutated from a fox and had also reached Mythical-level.
Legend had it that fifty years ago, during the Heaven-Earth Mutated event, this King-level strong man was just a Practice Zookeeper. After the mutation of heaven and earth, he awoke to powerful abilities.
And the white fox he took care of also underwent a mutation, sprouting two tails at that time.
Soon after, darkness and chaos erupted, and the original Hundred Foxes Nation was one of the first to fall, being quickly eradicated.
In such circumstances, the keeper fought his way through the turmoil and grew into a powerful King-level strong man within ten years, founding the present Hundred Foxes Nation.
And the white fox he raised continued to fight and evolve, aided by some opportunities, into the Eight-tailed Heavenly Fox Giant Beast, a powerful force and the nation’s guardian deity.
With this information in mind, Jack followed Mathilda Ward off the airplane.
There at the edge of the runway, a group of people was already waiting, and a middle-aged man at the forefront warmly said, “Miss Ward, Ms. Boyce, and everyone, welcome to Green Mountain City…”
What followed was a round of usual social pleasantries. At this moment, Jack’s gaze swept over the other four people.
Indeed, compared to the dozens who had come to receive them at East Capital, only five people had come to meet them at Green Mountain City.
Among them, three individuals—the official in charge of Green Mountain City, the secretary assistant, and the local military commander—had their information pop up when Jack’s sunglasses lingered on them for two seconds. The identity of the remaining well-built young man in his early twenties and the girl around seventeen or eighteen was not available, suggesting a very high level of confidentiality.
When Jack’s gaze swept over the young man, it paused for a moment, for this guy was even more handsome than Jack had been initially.
Handsome, indeed.
This noble-looking young man had a face like jade and features that seemed to be painted, even more beautiful than beauties like Mathilda Ward, turning into an absolute beauty if he were to dress as a woman.
Beyond that, the girl standing next to him was also remarkably pretty, with exquisite facial features and slender eyes that held a smiling charm, suggesting mischievousness.
Adorned with a pair of fluffy white fox ears on her head, she resembled a fox sprite straight out of legend.
Most importantly, despite the girl being only sixteen or seventeen, she had an intimidatingly buxom figure, giving Jack the impression that her clothes were nearly bursting at the seams.
As Jack’s gaze thoughtfully swept over her ample chest, the Green Mountain City official laughed, “Miss Ward, Ms. Boyce, allow me to introduce these two.” “This is Mr. Sinclair Moore, and this is Miss Gwen Gail.”
“Gail! Members of the Gail Family?”
Mathilda Ward and Crystal Boyce both showed astonishment in their eyes because the King-level strong man of the Hundred Foxes Nation was named Gentry Gail.
Of course, this world didn’t originally have the surname Gail, which was adopted by the strong man after ascending to the throne.
According to his public reason, he would’ve died on his path to becoming a king if not for his companion, the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox, repeatedly risking its life to save him.
Thus, the king changed his last name to Gail, echoing the legendary Gail from myth, to commemorate their brotherhood.
Now that these two people were using Gail as their surname, their identities were self-evident.
Sinclair Moore showed a smile and spoke with a gentle tone, “Miss Ward, welcome to the nation of the Hundred Foxes.”
“Your father is one of the elders I most admire. Unfortunately, I have never had the chance to meet him, but I did not expect to meet you first.”
“This time, just focus on preparing for the concert in Green Mountain without worrying about your safety. No one here can pose a threat to you. 1 guarantee it on the Gail Family’s honor.”
“In the current Federation, some people only see their own interests, which is infuriating.”
“It’s a pity that my grandfather isn’t here; otherwise, I would definitely ask him to convene a throne council and question those people about what they intend to do, putting you in such danger.”
As Sinclair Moore spoke, his gaze grew colder, filled with an unspoken authority.
Mathilda Ward, knowing he had misunderstood, smiled awkwardly, “Thanks for your concern, Mr. Gail, but this plan was my own idea, and Uncle Ling and the others already tried to dissuade me.”
“I know you released the news, but they could have stopped it. Even if their so-called meticulous plan seems comprehensive, I still cannot abide by it.”
“There is no such thing as a perfect plan in this world, and no one is a fool…”
Seeing Sinclair Moore’s tone becoming increasingly serious, the middle-aged man hastily tried to smooth things over, “Haha, Miss Ward, you’ve all traveled a long way; let’s get in the car before we talk further.”
“But Mr. Moore is correct. This time, consider it a few days’ vacation in Green Mountain to unwind, without worrying about safety issues.”
“He is already capable of summoning a portion of the Eight-tails’ powers through bloodline Secret Skills, sufficient to suppress even the soul avatars of those two kings.”
The confidence was clear on the middle-aged man’s face as he spoke.
“Mr. Gail can already summon the powers of the Mythical Giant Beast to descend!” Mathilda Ward’s eyes showed surprise.
Because this Summoning was different from the Divine Tyrant Body practice by ‘Darren Callum,’ which gained a hint of Divine Dragon Elephant Power.
It was the true Summoning part of the power of a Mythical Giant Beast, including the power of rules.
Jack Clark’s eyes also moved slightly.
This guy was able to summon the powers of a Mythical Giant Beast through bloodline Secret Skills. If he could study that method, perhaps he’d be able to summon the power of the Thunderflame Giant Beast in the future….

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 220 Jack Clark’s Identity Exposed,
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 220 Jack Clark’s Identity Exposed,
King-level Bloodline, Unrivaled Divine Might
Translator: 549690339
In the luxury business car that resembled a reception room.
At the front, Gwen Gail, only fifteen, was quietly chatting with Ilisa Ward, asking her what it was like to be a celebrity and other such topics.
Fifteen years old! (??) Could this REALLY be what fifteen-year-olds have?
At that moment, even Jack Clark was somewhat astounded.
Meanwhile, Ilisa Ward was seated next to Crystal Boyce, who was working on her documents using a mini projector, discussing the upcoming concert with Jessica Fiore.
As the person in charge of coordinating the concerts across over a dozen countries, Crystal had her hands full.
Especially since this was Ilisa’s first—and last—global tour, she wanted everything perfect, and her standards were high.
As for the potential attacks from Blood God Acunus and that demon king, these were not her concern; they were for professionals to handle.
Jack sat to Ilisa’s right, with Damon Lopes beside him, and across from him sat Sinclair Moore, a descendant of kings who had the beauty of a woman.
At this point, Damon leaned over and whispered, “Brother Callum, ever since you got on the car, you’ve been staring at Mr. Gail. Could it be that you like men?”
Cough cough!! Before Jack could respond, the handsome young man across from him began choking on his own saliva.
The seemingly concerned Gwen Gail burst into laughter: “Haha… I noticed it too, 1 just didn’t mention it.”
A smile played at the corners of Ilisa’s mouth.
Jack was at a loss for words, “…My orientation is quite normal; I only like beauties.”
Damon asked in confusion, “Then why have you been staring at Mr. Gail ever since you got on the car?”
Jack Clark coughed and admitted openly, “I’m just a bit curious about the Gail Family’s Summoning ‘Skill,’ but since it’s a family secret technique, it’s not right to ask about it rashly.”
Sinclair suddenly said from across, “You want to learn it?”
“…A little,” Jack nodded.
The others were taken aback; they hadn’t expected Jack to be interested in learning the Gail Family’s secret summoning skills.
Sinclair explained slowly, “This secret technique has strict requirements: one must possess a bloodline corresponding to a Mythical Giant Beast or fuse with Essence Blood, along with items like the scales of a Giant Beast.”
“Only by doing this can one achieve soul resonance with the summoned Mythical Giant Beast and use space-time involving secret skills to summon the shadow of the Mythical Giant Beast.”
Having said this, Sinclair paused for a moment and then looked directly at Jack, “Actually, teaching the secret technique to Brother Clark isn’t impossible.”
Jack heard the deeper meaning in his words and slowly asked, “At what condition?”
Sinclair said with interest, “Very simple, fight me with your full strength. Regardless of winning or losing, I’ll give you the Mystical Disc that records the Space-Time Summoning secret technique.”
“Don’t worry, I won’t take advantage of you. When the time comes, 1 will seal my realm to the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage and will not use any summoning secret skills.”
After his breakthrough to the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, Jack Clark updated his information online.
He had no choice; he needed precise data to unlock the top-tier secret manual that would be delivered in a few days. Otherwise, with Jack’s personality, he definitely would not have divulged his cultivation progress willingly.
“You’re a descendant of kings; even if you beat me with both of us at the same realm, there wouldn’t be much of a sense of accomplishment for you, would there?” Jack was somewhat puzzled.
Sinclair shook his head, “No, Jack… I mean, Brother Clark, you shouldn’t sell yourself short. You’re known as the first person among the younger generation in the south, titled Unparalleled Under Heaven, Unrivaled Divine Might.”
“Even descendants of kings would struggle to live up to such a title.”
“Racing over a thousand kilometers in a day, sweeping across the 59 Martial Height Bases, suppressing 587 geniuses of the same level, no one at the same realm could withstand a single move.”
“Just hearing about these feats is enough to get the blood boiling; that’s why I want to see for myself just how powerful the Godly Dragon Elephant, touted as invincible across the Southern Battlefield, truly is.”
No sooner had Sinclair finished speaking, Damon’s eyes widened: “Holy smokes, Brother Callum, so you’re that monster from the Southern Battlefield?”
“Before 1 came here, the old man mentioned a freak appearing on the battlefield—a Senior One, who reached Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven in half a year, with combat power unmatched in the Sixth Layer Heaven.”
“I couldn’t believe that monster is you, Brother Callum.”
“Hold on, this means you should be a year younger than me? Well, okay, fake identity,” Damon said excitedly. He kept clapping Jack on the shoulder, alternating between calling him a monster and a freak.
At that moment, not only Damon but also Ilisa and Crystal looked at him with surprise.
The profile Tyler Lance had given them merely stated that Jack Clark, a.k.a. Darren Callum, was at the early stage of the Sixth Layer Heaven, with combat power comparable to the early stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, and was highly perceptive and trustworthy.
That alone was already quite astonishing.
You should know that the further one advances, the more significant the suppression by realm becomes; possessing mid-stage combat power at the early stage of the Sixth Layer Heaven is considered genius, let alone crossing an entire Major Realm.
They had no idea that was just scratching the surface and that Jack had an even more impressive record of combat achievements.
Racing over a thousand kilometers in a day, sweeping through dozens of Martial Arts Schools, with no cultivator of the same level being able to withstand even a single move; it was simply fearsome.
Even Damon Lopes, an Innate Awakened One, admitted he couldn’t achieve that level.
Though his Burst of Power of Thunder was frightening, there was a limit to what one person could do; at most, he could burst forth a hundred times before his Spirit Power was drained and his True Strength was exhausted.
In contrast, Jessica, who had less understanding of these matters, fared a little better.
She simply sensed that Jack Clark, under the fake name Darren Callum, was even more formidable than she had imagined.
Sinclair, who had invested considerable effort to access Jack’s identity information, owed some favors as a result. This was only made possible because of his hard connections within the Federation as a descendant of kings..

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 220 Jack Clark’s Identity Exposed,
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 220 Jack Clark’s Identity Exposed,
King-level Bloodline, Unrivaled Divine Might_2
Translator: 549690339
At that time, Hannah Gail was just puzzled by why she couldn’t discern the identity of this bodyguard, but she understood the reason after learning about Jack Clark’s identity.
Gwen Gail said cheerfully, “Senior Jack, after my brother looked at the list of people around Sister Ilisa this morning, he has been wanting to spar with you.” “Don’t worry, Senior Jack, my brother is just a bit curious about your strength and won’t go too hard on you.”
It seemed that, without even fighting, Gwen Gail was already assuming that
J ack Clark would lose.
After all, compared to Jack Clark’s Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, her brother was a Seventh Layer High-Rank cultivator, and had even reached the Late Sevenfold Sky.
Even if he suppressed his realm to the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, his experience, comprehension of realm of thought, and high-order combat techniques would still remain high.
It might seem unfair to Jack Clark, but this world was never about absolute fairness.
Just like those cultivators of the same level facing Jack Clark.
Facing Hannah Gail’s piercing gaze, Jack Clark slowly said, “A full-on battle, sure, I, too, am eager to see just how strong a king-level inheritance is.”
Now that his identity had been exposed, Jack Clark no longer hid it, and besides, he was indeed very interested in the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill.
If he could successfully cultivate it, when Thunderflame grew into a Level 9 or Mythical Giant Beast, he would have an additional ace up his sleeve.
He also wanted to study whether it was possible to summon in reverse, for instance, the main body coming to the Avatar. If possible, he could manipulate many things when the time came.
At this moment, Hannah Gail reminded him, “Oh, Brother Clark’s identity is special, and after leaving here, he’s still Darren Callum, so everyone, don’t mix it up.”
Damon Lopes chuckled and nodded, “I understand, to avoid early targeting by the Evil God Sect and different races. Actually, 1 knew Brother Callum’s name was fake as soon as 1 heard it.”
“After all, what era are we in? Who would use such a cringeworthy name?”
My name is cringeworthy? That’s because you haven’t seen Super Chirpy Bully. Jack Clark mentally complained.
The resort hotel, set between green hills and clear waters in the suburbs of Green Mountain City, was arranged for Mathilda Ward and the others. The entire hotel was sealed off and booked.
After a short rest, the group of seven headed to the hotel’s back mountain.
On the hundred-meter high hillside, looking at the two blurry black dots a few hundred meters away, Marla Fiore asked curiously, “Who do you think is more formidable between them?”
One is a Descendant of the King, and the other is a monster with the Title of Unrivaled Divine Might from conquering a battlefield; between the two, who is stronger at the same realm?
Damon Lopes slowly said, “Logic makes me favor Mr. Gail, but rationally I’m more inclined towards Brother Clark.”
The Fox-eared girl rolled her eyes, speechless, “Damon, aren’t you stating the obvious?”
Mathilda Ward smiled, took out a pair of lady’s sunglasses similar to Jack Clark’s, and put them on. Her field of vision rapidly expanded, bringing the several hundred meters away into clear view.
The two men stood ten feet apart in the valley, hair whipping wildly in the raging wind.
Suddenly, a flickering light erupted from Hannah Gail’s body, and in the blink of an eye, he was covered in a set of silver-white battle armor, with eight white trails fluttering behind him, resembling the tails of a fox, very splendid indeed.
At the same time, a silver battle sword, two meters and fifty centimeters long and fifteen centimeters wide, materialized in his hands.
The edge of the sword gleamed with white radiance, giving off a terrifying sharpness as the ground silently cracked open with half-meter long fissures beneath its edge.
Crackle Crackle!!
At this moment, pieces flew out from Jack Clark’s bracelet and in the blink of an eye, he was covered by a thick battle armor with black as the base and gold-red spirals, releasing circles of golden-red halos.
On the shoulders of the battle armor, real flames in red shaped into a ribbon that circled around his neck, fluttering behind him in the wind.
Jack Clark’s hand now grasped a three-meter-eight long, eight-ton War Halberd.
Whoosh!
Golden flames ignited on Jack Clark’s body, and an instant later, an air of invincible Divine Might erupted, forming the phantom of a massive beast behind him.
Boom!
The ground under Jack Clark shattered, unable to bear the force, as rings of white rose up, creating a swirling storm in all directions, kicking up dust and stones, with an immense aura.
Excitement flashed in Hannah Gail’s eyes, “What an overbearing aura!”
With these words, white flames burned over Hannah Gail’s body, and a massive, divine presence soared into the sky, forming a phantom of a great white fox behind him.
Roar!
A roar like that of a Void Dragon burst forth as Jack Clark’s War Halberd swept across, launching a ten-meter long golden crescent halberd skill, sweeping up a storm of dust and roaring winds as it passed.
Hannah Gail’s battle sword radiated with Sword Qi, with one slash cutting through the air.
Boom! A ten-meter-long white Sword Qi burst forth like a laser, drawing in energy from the surroundings, which instantly transformed into a fifteen-meter colossal Sword Qi that swept across Heaven and Earth.
Boom! The golden-white shockwave erupted, radiating bright light as if a missile had exploded with a terrifying force.
In the midst of the turbulent storm, the figures clashed, the Black Gold War Halberd tearing through the waves, carrying the Overbearing Terrifying Power that shook the heavens, stirring the air.
Boom!
The massive and dominant Halberd released its Terrifying Power, causing even Hannah Gail to change his expression as the Sword Qi crumbled and his form was blasted away.
Hannah Gail, covered in silver-white battle armor, burned with white flames as he landed a hundred meters away, his legs plowing two deep furrows over a dozen meters long into the ground before stopping.
Looking at the distant vague golden figure emerging within the smoke and dust, excitement was apparent on Hannah Gail’s face, “Such dominant power, no wonder he has the Title Divine Might.”
Now that his strength had broken through to two thousand points, and the Divine ‘Tyrant Body fully unleashed, Jack Clark’s might was too terrifying to describe..

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - 220 Jack Clark’s Identity Exposed, King-level Bloodline, Unrivaled Divine Might_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Chapter 220 Jack Clark’s Identity Exposed, King-level Bloodline, Unrivaled Divine Might_3
Translator: 549690339
With the eight-ton halberd sweeping across at supersonic speeds, even Hannah Gail couldn’t take a single hit, at least not in her normal state.
Hannah Gail understood this as well, so she became even more excited, as a ferocious and sacred terrifying aura burst forth from within her.
Boom!
Flames burst into life on Hannah Gail’s body, and under the power of her bloodline, an aura ten times more powerful than before erupted, making the phantom of the white fox behind her even more distinct.
The eight tails stirred, gathering the energy of Heaven and Earth, forming white ribbons that spiraled into vortexes around Hannah Gail, boosting her aura even more.
Accompanied by the shattering of the ground, Hannah Gail transformed into a streak of white light that shot into the sky; when she reappeared at a high altitude, her figure split into eight, surrounding the area from all directions.
Eight streams of white Sword Qi, each more than ten meters long, descended from the sky, turning into a downpour of swords that engulfed the entire valley in a destructive explosion.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Under the onslaught of the white Sword Qi, the Earth was slashed open with giant cracks spanning twenty to thirty meters, stones flew everywhere, raging winds howled, and amidst the swirling smoke and dust, a golden light burst forth into the sky.
Boom!
The battle halberd, stirring the energy of Heaven and Earth, shattered one of Hannah Gail’s avatars, but in an instant, seven sword lights slashed across the sky towards Jack Clark, causing a roaring wind that churned the atmosphere as they passed.
Hum!
A shimmering red radiance flared as wings of light spread out. Jack Clark’s halberd disappeared, and under the propulsion of the flames behind him, he shot up more than two hundred meters into the air.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark vanished, the seven streams of Sword Qi collided, forming a white ring in the sky that exploded, creating a violent wind wave that dissipated after shooting out a hundred meters.
Just then, the color of the sky and earth changed as streaks of black-red light surrounded Jack Clark in the high altitude; his wings of light flickered as the ten-meter-long radiant halberd radiance pulsed in his hand.
Accompanied by mournful wails, amidst the Ghost Wailing Divine Howl, Jack Clark turned into a golden-red streak of light plummeting from the sky, his will locked onto Hannah Gail’s true body.
Thump thump thump thump!!
With Unrivaled Domination power, the halberd radiance that wiped out everything shattered each of the Heavenly Fox’s avatars, and in an instant, the halberd and sword crossed again, golden and white radiance exploding violently onto the Earth.
Boom! The ground shook, with dozens of meters around the area fragmenting, countless dirt flying out in all directions like a fountain, a rolling cloud of dust and smoke rising into the sky.
At that moment, the roaring continued, and the raging winds howled. In an instant, the dust and smoke were dispersed by an even more violent impact.
The valley was lit up with constantly colliding flashes of white and golden light, separating after each collision, each clash sending out shockwaves capable of pulverizing everything, like two Destruction Beasts fighting.
Boom boom boom!! Golden halberd radiance hit the ground causing severe explosions, creating craters of more than ten meters and sending out sharp energy that tore through the ground, leaving several-meter-long cracks.
White Sword Qi, extremely sharp, was periodically unleashed, leaving long cracks spanning tens of meters in the valley, a terrifying sight to behold.
Such a terrifying scene left Crystal Boyce and Marla Fiore, who were watching from a distance, utterly shocked.
Especially Marla Fiore, for as an ordinary person, this was her first time witnessing advanced cultivators in battle, almost like two human-shaped missiles, exploding wherever they went.
In just a short while, a valley one kilometer wide and several kilometers long had been turned into ruins, and that was with both individuals controlling the scope of their battle.
Too terrifying.
Damon Lopes watched the distant battle with excitement, a bit agitated, “Brother Callum’s strength… is very overbearing.”
As a Great Master of the Sixth Layer Heaven, only he could clearly see the situation of the battle, and even faced with an enlivened bloodline power in Hannah Gail, Jack Clark wasn’t falling behind.
That Unrivaled Domineering Power blasted everything apart, no matter what king-level combat techniques or bloodline secret skills you had, I simply used absolute speed and strength to blast everything away.
This way of fighting was unsolvable.
No matter how exquisite the moves, they all required a person as the attack target. In this scenario, Jack Clark only needed to sweep and slash, pulverizing the attacks coming from all directions.
Even if Hannah Gail used more than a dozen combat techniques and several secret skills, it was still useless, and he was even suppressed by Jack Clark.
Under the Divine Tyrant Body, a Dragon Elephant Phantom emerged behind Jack Clark, with each strike invoking Divine Might to boost it, crushing the earth within a radius of a dozen or twenty meters, causing the sky to collapse and the ground to crack.
It was then, in the smoke-filled valley covered with mountains of corpses and a sea of blood, an image emerged, and at the same time a giant claw covering dozens of meters descended from the sky.
Boom!
In an instant, an even more violent explosion shook the valley.
“Profound Sky Extreme Sword!”
A long howl resounded through the smoky sky as a thirty-some-meter-long white Sword Qi shot up, gathering the Heavenly Energy from sky and earth.
Under that vaguely Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox wrapped Sword Qi, the earth shattered with a loud boom, forming a massive crack that slashed toward the distant Jack Clark, flanked by rolling waves of energy.
“Not good, Mr. Gail’s Seal has broken,” Damon Lopes’s face changed drastically as he felt the late Seventh Layer High-Rank cultivation emanating from him.
ROAR!
A domineering roar that shook everyone’s consciousness echoed through heaven and earth. Faced with that terrifying Sword Qi which slashed through everything, Jack Clark’s Qi Blood burned within him, causing endless strength to Burst forth.
Crackle Crackle.
Jack Clark’s muscles swelled as he suddenly transformed into a 2.5-meter-tall giant, an Unrivaled Domineering Power erupting from him, squeezing the very air around him until it burst.
Even the burning Tyrant Body Qi Blood was so terrifying that it formed a more than ten-meter-tall Tyrant Elephant Phantom enveloping Jack Clark, emitting an Overbearing aura that could collapse the Void and burst the atmosphere.
At the same time, the War Halberd in Jack Clark’s hands shone with dazzling Radiance, expanding into an eight-meter-long Super Halberd that faintly sealed a Blood Sea Hell within.
Boom!
With Jack Clark’s full strength in one swing, a twenty-some-meter-long Golden Red Battle Halberd spanned the sky, accompanied by the roars of numerous Unique Beasts as it ferociously slashed down.
Boom!!
Under the collision of Halberd Skill and Sword Qi, which surpassed the ordinary Seventh Layer strength, the entire valley quaked and the earth within a hundred-meter radius shattered, sending dirt and rocks flying in all directions.
From afar, it looked like a mini Nuclear Bomb explosion, creating a massive ball of destructive Radiance flashing across heaven and earth.
Such a terrifying destructive force almost made everyone lose their minds, having not expected that a mere sparring session between two people could escalate to this point.
To say these two people were of Sixth Layer cultivation was no different from saying they were of the Seventh Layer, and they were even stronger than average Seventh Layer Heaven Cultivators.
This was the destructive power of advanced cultivators, those who touched the pathways of Heaven and Earth, having surpassed the conventional understanding of ordinary people.
On the hillside, Gwen Gail’s white fox ears trembled continuously with intense emotions, unbelieving, “How is it possible, he actually made Brother show his true strength.”
“Unparalleled Under Heaven, Unrivaled Divine Might.” Watching the distant destruction and explosion, Crystal Boyce stood stunned, a burly silhouette surfacing in her mind.
That person, back in the day, also swept through all his adversaries with Overbearing and invincible might..

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - 221: The Secret Skill of Rules, Eternal Life & Undying, Reversing Space-Time (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Chapter 221: The Secret Skill of Rules, Eternal Life & Undying, Reversing Space-Time (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Translator: 549690339
The lush valley that once teemed with vegetation had been transformed into ruins, everywhere marred by craters that spanned ten to twenty meters and riddled with massive cracks.
At this moment, a creature towering over ten meters tall, with a body length of over fifty meters including its tail, stood upright like a real Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox, with the energy of the heavens and earth converging around it, its aura overwhelming and all-encompassing.
In comparison to Vernon Lowe’s True Martial Shadow when it had just achieved a breakthrough, Hannah Gail’s True Martial Shadow at the Late Seventh Layer was even more terrifying.
Its formidable presence was almost equivalent to that of a true Level 7 late-stage Giant Beast.
In front of the giant shadow, Hannah Gail stood quietly, radiating white light, which stirred the energy of the heavens and earth to resonate with the behemoth behind him, their breathing causing tremors through heaven and earth.
Moreover, this giant shadow merged with his own aura, making every move he made seem as if two Late Seventh Layer forces were combined.
This was the terrifying aspect of human cultivators who had reached the high-order stages, far stronger than the typical Level 7 Colossi.
Of course, as a Descendant of the King, Hannah Gail’s strength was stronger than others of the same level, because an ordinary Seventh Layer True Martial Shadow wouldn’t have been this powerful.
Hannah Gail said slowly, “I apologize, Brother Clark, for not holding back enough just now.”
During the fierce battle moments ago, the seals he had carelessly set up had shattered, and he couldn’t help but use his Late Seventh Layer cultivation to slash out a sword attack.
In the midst of a crater tens of meters in diameter, Jack Clark stood two and a half meters tall, surrounded by rings of explosive energy, wielding a giant War Halberd and exuding an overbearing aura that suppressed heaven and earth.
Jack Clark said in a deep voice, “There’s no need for apologies, Mr. Gail. It’s perfectly normal to not hold back in a spar when it gets intense.”
As for whether it was genuinely an inability to hold back or a deliberate push to drive him to burst forth, only Hannah Gail knew for sure.
As he spoke, the burning blood qi around Jack Clark gradually extinguished, his imposing figure deflating like a leak had been sprung, and the battle armor adjusted itself with a series of crackles.
At the same time, his War Halberd also returned to its original length of 3.8 meters in a flash of golden light.
Regardless, this duel with Hannah Gail had helped him accumulate some combat experience against High-level cultivators, especially in their control over the energy of the heavens and earth.
With each gesture, their will stirred the energy of the heavens and earth, unleashing attacks that exceeded the strength of Sixth Layer by several, even ten times the norm, along with a sustained and inexhaustible combat power.
This was because for them, each strike consumed very little True Strength; most of it was amplified by the energy they drew from the heavens and earth.
Beyond that, Jack Clark now had a more accurate assessment of his own strength.
He could casually defeat Seventh Layer Middle-Stage Cultivators, and even grapple with those at the late period during a full strength outburst in his Godly Dragon Elephant State.
However, to rival, to defeat, and to kill were three different concepts, so he wasn’t powerful enough yet.
At that moment, Hannah Gail retracted his True Martial Shadow and, with the aura fading along with his battle armor, he transformed back into the stunningly handsome young man, refined and gentle as jade.
Looking at the overpowering Jack Clark, Hannah Gail exclaimed, “I didn’t expect Brother Clark to be stronger than I had imagined. 1 have lost this battle.”
As a Descendant of the King, he had been overwhelmed by Jack Clark when exerting his full strength at his level, which is why he couldn’t help but release a late-stage strike when his seal broke.
So in that respect, he had indeed lost.
“However, this makes me more confident in entrusting Miss Ward’s safety to you,” he added.
As a Descendant of the King and out of respect for the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Hannah Gail inherently favored Mathilda Ward, and he was somewhat angered by the recent events.
Though reason told him that cooperating with the Federation alongside Miss Ward could lead to an outcome everyone desired, he still felt a twinge of fury, being a Descendant of the King and able to empathize.
This was also a reason he wanted to test Jack Clark’s strength; there was no need to test Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One, as he was a monster no less than a king-level fighter.
But now, the anger in Hannah Gail’s heart began to dissipate.
A Sixth Layer Middle-Stage Cultivator, not an Innate Awakened One nor a Descendant of the King, and apparently not even having practiced combat Secret Book techniques, had the power to reverse eradicate someone at the middle stage of the seven heavens.
Even in his transformed state of superpower, he had only been suppressed and not injured by his late-stage strike, albeit a casual one.
Such talent was, in some ways, even more frightening than those of Descendants of the King or Innate Awakened Ones.
The Federation had indeed sent out such a formidable monster.
In such a scenario, losing one of the two of them would be no less tragic than the fall of a Half-step King.
At that point, Jack Clark’s splendid battle armor also cracked and split apart, being stored piece by piece in the Sumeru Bracelet.
As they spoke, the two men walked together, and Hannah Gail flipped his hand over, passing a black iron-like slab to Jack Clark: “Brother Clark, this contains the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill of my family.”
Jack’s face lit up with a smile as he accepted the Mystical Disc.
Hadn’t he almost played all his trump cards to fight for this very secret method?
“This is a Mystical Disc refined from the scale armor of a Cloud Sea Behemoth, capable of containing top-level skills. It probably has three more chances for understanding after years of my usage,” Hannah Gail explained.
“There’s a limit to the number of times?” interjected Jack Clark, pausing.
Hannah Gail nodded, “Of course. Top-level skills involve rules, which common objects simply cannot hold.”
“And when we study and attempt to comprehend them, it consumes some of the Divine Soul Intent left on it, so a Top-level Skill typically dissipates after about ten comprehensions.”
Jack Clark said slowly, “…I did not expect it to involve the rules, a top-level secret method. My apologies for my presumptuousness.”
Were three chances not enough? Of course, they were more than enough, or rather, Jack had made a huge gain..

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - 221: The Secret Skill of Rules, Eternal Life & Undying, Reversing Space-Time (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Chapter 221: The Secret Skill of Rules, Eternal Life & Undying, Reversing Space-Time (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
Translator: 549690339 |
This Secret Skill related to the rules that’s given away just for fighting a match truly reflects the magnanimity of someone from the King’s Family.
“Brother Callum, you needn’t worry about it. The pursuit of strength and the desire to become stronger are the motivations for us cultivators to progress. If 1 were you, I couldn’t resist either.”
With that, the two of them strode ten meters at a step, and in no time, they had walked out of the ruined valley.
Watching the two ascend the hillside, Damon Lopes felt an itch in his hands and excitedly said, “Brother Callum, when shall the two of us have a friendly sparring match?”
He wanted to test whether Jack Clark’s strength was more peerlessly overbearing or his Power of Thunder was stronger.
“What’s there for the two of us to fight about? If you’re itching for a fight, I can let you alone have your fill when those two king-level soul avatars appear later.”
Fighting Damon Lopes had no benefits; Jack Clark had no interest in wasting time.
He was now very busy, extremely busy.
He had to construct space teleportation runes, deduce his own Top-tier Secret Manual, and also find time to comprehend and research the Gail Family’s Summoning Secret Skill. There were many things to do.
And each one was very important to him.
Suddenly Damon Lopes quickly changed his tune, “No, brother, if those two guys show’ up together, how about we each take one?”
“Sorry, but my task is to spot enemies and provide close protection for Miss Ward; isn’t fighting your responsibility?”
“Brother Callum, does it not pain your conscience to say that? We are brothers, brothers who have carried arms together.”
“Uh… we haven’t actually touched any guns, have we?”
By the time the group returned to the hotel, it was already evening.
In the hotel restaurant, while everyone was waiting for the meal, the Fox-eared girl opposite blinked her large eyes curiously and asked, “Brother Callum, how did you manage to reach the Sixth-layer Heaven in seven months?”
“Moreover, it’s one thing to have a high cultivation realm, but your combat power is so terrifying. You’re practically a monster.
Suddenly, curiosity shone in the eyes of the others as well.
Jack Clark thought for a moment, “Actually, it was a bit difficult when 1 first started cultivation. For example, the first time I practiced Body Casting Skill, it took me more than fifty minutes to complete a cycle, which was the worst in
our class.”
“At that time, my practice of the Meditation Method was also very slow, but then it got a lot smoother after a while. Even so, my Foundation Establishment took half a month.”
“After establishing the foundation, 1 started cultivating True Martial Arts, and my progress w’as pretty standard at that point.
“But I don’t know which day it was when I suddenly noticed that cultivation was becoming smoother and smoother, and the power of Dragon Elephant Power was getting stronger. Then I realized cultivation seemed… quite simple.” “Then I signed up for the Koroya Trial, and found that my cultivation speed increased even faster during battle. By the time 1 returned to school, 1 was the first to breakthrough the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“After that, I entered the Alien Beast Battlefield…”
Watching Jack Clark sharing his past cultivation experiences with everyone, Damon Lopes’s eyes were filled with envy. The guy was showing off again.
However, what he envied wasn’t that Jack Clark was showing off again, but that this guy seemed to be doing it unintentionally, which was far more clever than those in the base who deliberately flaunted themselves.
After Jack Clark had finished talking about his ‘normal’ six-month cultivation experience, everyone’s faces were filled with amazement. They had not expected Jack Clark to have started off so ordinary.
And the fact that he had managed to step by step reach today, surpassing all geniuses and dominating his peers, was entirely due to his own ‘effort’.
Once Jack Clark finished speaking, Marla Fiore couldn’t help but show her envy, her red lips slightly parted as she sighed, “If only I had the talent for cultivation as well.”
Her experiences over this period had suddenly made her feel as if things like being a group secretary or a CEO’s assistant were trivial in comparison to possessing the Transcendent Power of a cultivator.
Mathilda Ward consoled her, “Jessica, cultivation talent varies from person to person; there’s no need to force it if you don’t have it. As long as you think you’re living a splendid life, that’s enough.
“Sometimes not being able to cultivate may not necessarily be a bad thing. For example, my brothers, if they didn’t have the talent for cultivation, they would probably be married with children by now.”
Crystal Boyce also nodded in agreement, “Indeed, it’s easy to lookup to someone like Young Master Gail with his amazing talent, but the responsibilities they carry are beyond the imagination of ordinary people.” “It’s often said that with great power comes great responsibility.”
“While that phrase may not be entirely accurate, in this era, when a person’s abilities grow and they enjoy more rights, they also have to take on more responsibilities.”
“By that time, even if you don’t want to get involved, the forces at play will compel you to keep moving forward, clearing obstacles, and carve out a path to survival for your family and brothers.”
It was clear that the sentiments of the two women were influenced by the Mysterious Martial Sky King; the atmosphere at the dinner table became somewhat heavy.
Then Gwen Gail suddenly blinked her big eyes and looked towards Mathilda Ward, “Sister llisa, are you free tomorrow?”
Mathilda Ward nodded, “I’m free tomorrow, what’s up?”
Her music team and Dance Group would only arrive the day after, so she had nothing to do for the next two days.
Gwen Gail excitedly said, “Let’s go to Forest Mount Nature Park tomorrow. There’s a Mutated Fox Breeding Base there with many new breeds of fox beasts.”
For some reason, this buxom girl seemed very fond of Mathilda Ward; anyone who didn’t know better would think they were sisters.
“That’s fine.” Mathilda Ward smiled warmly and did not refuse.
After the meal, everyone went back to their rooms to wash and brush.
But before returning to his own room, Jack Clark first entered Mathilda Ward’s suite.
The two-bedroom apartment was elegantly furnished, and Jack Clark scanned every corner with sharp eyes, even standing by the window to survey the surroundings.
Despite Sinclair Moore’s assurances that their stay in Green Mountain City would be absolutely safe under his protection, Jack Clark still did not let his guard down..

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 221: The Secret Skill of Rules, Eternal Life & Undying, Reversing Space-Time (Seeking Monthly Votes) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Chapter 221: The Secret Skill of Rules, Eternal Life & Undying, Reversing Space-Time (Seeking Monthly Votes) _3
Translator: 549690339 |
After all, Mathilda Ward was different from them; she was just an ordinary person, and a single sniper rifle could end her life.
Of course, Jack Clark was just taking precautions. He felt that Mathilda Ward must have a powerful trump card, given that she was the daughter of the Mysterious Martial Sky King.
If someone doesn’t quite grasp the concept of a Heavenly King’s daughter, they could think of her as the daughter of a mighty deity.
After making sure everything was alright, Jack Clark turned around and nodded slightly to Mathilda Ward, “Miss Ward, there are no issues with the room or the surroundings.”
Mathilda Ward smiled and said, “I didn’t expect Brother Jack, a genius student, to be so professional on his first job as a bodyguard. If I didn’t know any better, I would think you came from a family of bodyguards.”
Jack Clark coughed awkwardly, “Not at all, I just read some books about what bodyguards need to pay attention to before coming here, so I’m doing it by the book.”
Taking every task seriously is why your success is no accident, Little Brother Jack.”
At this point, Mathilda Ward became somewhat contemplative and went to the window, looking out at the night, suddenly asking, “Brother Jack, what do you think makes a ‘person’?”
“Miss Ward, what do you mean?” Jack Clark paused slightly.
Mathilda Ward spoke softly, “I mean, when someone gains strength or longevity by fundamentally becoming a different creature, are they still human?”
After a moment of thought, Jack Clark replied, “…I think to define a person, one should look at their essence.”
“If this ‘creature’ was not human to begin with, naturally, it is not a human.”
“But if a person becomes non-human later in life, as long as their thoughts and consciousness still identify with being human, then they are human.”
In such a case, even if they transform into a monster or a Unique Beast, their self-definition won’t change, and their behavioral and thought patterns will still follow human habits.”
“However, if one day all traces of ‘human’ disappear from them, then they have no connection to humanity anymore.”
As for the question of whether one is still human after turning into another creature, Jack Clark felt he was most qualified to speak on the subject, since half of his other self was a Mutant Beast.
“Self-definition, huh.” Mathilda Ward nodded.
In fact, this controversy has always existed in Berlin, particularly concerning those genetic martial cultivators who have integrated with Alien Beast genes to gain strength and are gradually becoming less human.
Curious, Jack Clark asked, “Miss Ward, you mentioned longevity—does immortality really exist in this world?”
“Of course it exists.”
Mathilda Ward said softly, “Fifty years have passed since the New Era began, and not a single advanced cultivator has died of old age; most have died in battle.”
“It goes without saying for high-level cultivators. After touching the path, the body’s life vitality is very strong. Medical research estimates that high-level cultivators can live for at least three hundred years.”
“As for king-level beings, when they ascend to the throne, both their soul and body are reshaped once—a soul transforms into a Divine Soul, and a body merges with the rules to become a True Body.”
“The most contacted King-level strong man among humankind at present is from The Purgatory Family; it is said many of their demon kings have lived for a thousand years, not to mention even stronger beings beyond them.”
“…A king’s lifespan exceeds a thousand years.” Jack Clark was rather surprised.
Although he had long felt his own life force was strong and that he could live for a long time, he didn’t expect just the lifespan of a king-level being to exceed a thousand years.
Does that mean if he continued his cultivation, he, too, would become an ‘Undying’ being?
Afterward, Jack Clark and Mathilda Ward chatted for a while longer before he returned to his own room, washed, and sat cross-legged on the bed with the black metal piece in his hand.
Meanwhile, deep sea, the Thunderflame Behemoth that was testing the Spatial Channel Rune with its physical body also stopped what it was doing.
There are only three chances to comprehend the Top-level Skill, and to ensure a fail-safe without wasting opportunities, Jack Clark is ready to immerse and ponder with full concentration next.
Whoo!
As Jack Clark’s Spiritual Will merged into the Mystical Disc, his consciousness plunged dramatically, finding himself in a vast expanse of Heaven and Earth.
This kind of Divine Soul Intent Inheritance and Top-tier Secret Manual were similar, both constructed a Void Space with the Power of Will, fully elaborating the ‘rule.’
However, unlike the True Martial Secret Canon, this skill was a reflection of a King-level strong man’s Divine Soul Intent, and so the ‘world’ appeared more complete.
In the vast Earth at this moment, a figure in white, snow-like garments stood tall, while at the edge of the sky was the silhouette of a Giant Beast as large as a mountain.
Then, the figure in white slowly began to speak, their Will vibrating the Void.
What is called Summoning is actually using a medium to reverse time and space, turning the space back and temporarily overlapping the space at another location with a powerful creature’s space-time.”
“This involves the forces of time and space, as well as cause and effect.”
“In the past, I touched upon the Power of Time by a stroke of chance. By resonating with the power of a Homologous Bloodline, a soul resounds with mine, using myself as the focal point…”
Accompanied by a magnetic voice, streams of ‘time’ flowed around the white figure, and ‘space’ manifested tangibly, beginning to perform ‘Summoning.’ Two hours later, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, excitement flickering in his gaze.
With the talent of his double pupils and the Innate Space Rune, his understanding of space was already profound.
He was slightly slower in comprehending the time rune altar, but after two more attempts to record it, there shouldn’t be a problem. Then, with more practice with time, he would eventually master it.
As for the Giant Beast bloodline or Essence Blood needed for Summoning, soul resonance, and a part of the Giant Beast’s body material, those were not an issue either.
The Giant Beast Avatar could simply condense a drop of Essence Blood; for soul resonance-he already had half a Giant Beast soul, and his body was the material itself.
After long-term synchronization with Evolution Energy, his physical body was the best coordinates for the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Once he succeeded in the cultivation, if he faced a powerful enemy, he could either project the Giant Beast or summon the Thunderflame Behemoth’s True Body, crushing everything.
But as exhilarating as it was, Jack Clark was clear on what he needed to do at the moment.
His focus would still be on the Spatial Channel Rune, aiming to complete the construction within a few days, after which he could transform all the Life Crystals there into Attribute points.
Then, in one go, he would enhance all his Thunderflame Beast talents and significantly strengthen himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 222: The Demon King is in action, with over 10,000 attribute points, and the Space Feather Horn.
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Chapter 222: The Demon King is in action, with over 10,000 attribute points, and the Space Feather Horn.
Translator: 549690339 |
On the other side of the planet, thousands of kilometers away from the Hundred Foxes Nation, dozens of sexy beauties in bikinis were frolicking and splashing on a private beach.
The breathtaking scene of water splashing and waves surging was a sight to behold.
Not far away, under a parasol, a long-haired youth whose appearance had changed was lazily sunbathing, admiring the attractive figures of those top models.
At that moment, the latest mobile phone on the table rang, displaying the caller ID asjFool].
The long-haired youth opened his eyes, picked up the mobile phone and hesitated for a moment before answering, “Hello, Mo Xi Mo Xi, Sa You La La, Gu Li Ji Wa.”
The strange language caught the ‘person’ on the other end off guard, and then a deep voice replied, “White Eagle, it’s Black Bird. There’s no need for the secret language.”
The long-haired youth said lazily, “I know it’s you.”
If you weren’t useful, I’d have thrown you out to be killed by those guys. Of course, the long-haired youth didn’t say the last sentence out loud.
The voice on the other end began, “I called to let you know that my fish bait is ready. Are you interested in joining?”
The long-haired youth replied casually, “I’ll pass this time, as I have other things on my hands.”
“Oh, and when your people make their move, remember to have someone film it in high definition. We might be able to analyze something from the footage.” “And don’t connect the footage to the Internet, or it’ll be traced. When the time comes, send the information recorded on a hard drive to me. I’ll give you the address later.”
The voice on the other end said cautiously, “Rest assured, I’ll be very careful
this time and won’t let the humans discover my king…”
“Fuck! Fool, you’re at it again.” In an instant, the long-haired youth’s face changed, and he squeezed the phone in his hand, crushing it with a bang.
Looking at the shattered mobile phone in his hand, blood-colored light shone in the youth’s eyes. His hair fluttered in the windless air, and his gaze was icy-cold, “He did it on purpose.”
His sudden outburst startled the far-off models. The most beautiful blonde-haired, blue-eyed woman walked over and said affectionately.
“Honey, what made you so angry?”
As she spoke, the blonde beauty wrapped her arms around the long-haired youth’s neck and pressed against him from behind, looking extremely intimate.
The anger on the long-haired youth’s face gradually faded, and he looked elegant and composed again, exuding a noble aura. He said casually, “It’s nothing, just a fool being foolish again.”
With that, the long-haired youth placed his palm on the beauty’s face and gently slid it.
Just as the blonde beauty’s face showed enjoyment and she thought some envious events were about to happen between them, the hand on her neck tightened slightly.
Crack!
The blonde beauty’s arms went limp instantly.
A minute later, dozens of corpses lay scattered on the beach, while the long-haired youth calmly walked toward a nearby seaside villa.
A few minutes after, the villa was engulfed in raging flames. The fire swallowed the corpses of the caretakers and servants, erasing any trace of the long-haired youth’s presence.
Meanwhile, just as the long-haired youth had crushed his phone in anger, a burly man dressed in a black suit and white shirt, who looked like a gangster, crushed his own phone and sneered outside a remote small town in another country.
“Humph! I’ll give you something to do. Last time you actually dared to call me a fool, you’re really looking for death.”
“I am just unfamiliar with the civilization of this world, do you think 1 am really foolish?”
As he spoke, the burly man in black looked at the dead person on the ground, casually discarded the shards of the passerby’s phone, and then dashed into the mountain forest at once.
Running at high speed with his aura concealed, the burly man crossed hundreds of kilometers in just an hour, traversing two small mountain ranges and appeared in a city on the other side.
On the city’s edge, in an abandoned warehouse, dozens of men excitedly fiddled with their weapons.
There were state-of-the-art anti-material sniper rifles, large-caliber machine guns, and hand-cannons with thick barrels specially designed for killing unique beasts.
In addition, the surroundings were filled with various high-powered firearms, single-soldier rocket launchers, short-range single-soldier missiles, various ammunition, and even two rocket launcher vehicles.
These weapons and ammunition were enough for a small-scale war.
Outside the warehouse, more than a dozen burly men with dark complexions and muscular physiques stood impassively, emanating the oppressive aura of cultivators.
As the burly man appeared with a flash, the dozen or so other burly men bowed their heads respectfully, “Greetings, my lord.”
The burly man looked at one of the leaders and said in a deep voice, “Koi, are the things ready?”
The head burly man respectfully replied, “My lord, everything is in order.” “Seventy-five long-term, experienced mercenaries who’ve fought ordinary unique beasts have been gathered. The weapons and ammunition are sourced from a factory controlled by Kutar Small Country, which has copied our research.”
“The transportation was done through the Storage Space granted by my lord, bit by bit, so the Federation won’t be able to track us.”
“Aside from that, I have also begun to scout out Kuoer Airport to Mason City’s route, looking for the best ambush spots and replaced one of the staff at the airport.”
The burly man asked, “There are no problems with the people, right?” “These people are all local idle individuals whom I’ve controlled using my spiritual intimidation. They won’t arouse suspicion as they normally wander around without a care.”
“Also, I’ve broken the scouting mission into seemingly unrelated ordinary tasks, such as casually taking pictures of trees on the roadside or snapping shots of street scenery.”
“Even if this raises the suspicion of local law enforcement, they won’t be able to discover anything after an investigation..”

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 222: The Demon King Takes Action, Over Ten Thousand Attribute Points, Space Feather Horn_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Chapter 222: The Demon King Takes Action, Over Ten Thousand Attribute Points, Space Feather Horn_2
Translator: 549690339
The burly man nodded in satisfaction, “Very good. Remember, during this time, don’t circulate the demon gas within your body to avoid detection by human ‘technology’.”
“Yes, my god.”
Although the Federation’s detection was already comprehensive, as demon king level strong, they naturally had means to shield themselves, which was also why the Federation wanted to lure them out for a kill.
As demon king level strong, their strength might be suppressed, but their methods and realms remained.
With their personal guidance and cultivation, the Blue Star World’s interior, where the Evil God Sect had almost been eradicated, showed signs of a phoenix rising from the ashes.
Afterward, the burly man gave some instructions and then disappeared, not staying with these subordinates, showing great caution.
Crystal Boyce and Marla Fiore were responsible for the concert.
The next day, at Gwen Gail’s invitation, Mathilda Ward, Jack Clark, and Damon Lopes, four people came to Green Mountain City’s largest nature park.
This place was also a breeding base for Mutated Fox Demons.
In a clean and tidy glass room, Gwen Gail squatted on the ground, holding a fluffy white fox the size of a puppy in her arms, and happily said.
“Sister Ilisa, this is the latest breed, the Three-tailed Snow Fox. Although just born, it already belongs to Level 1 Mutated Creature.”
Gwen Gail caressed the little fox, which emitted child-like soft cries, its little face showing human-like pleasure.
In this glass room, there was also a Mutated Beast resembling a white fox with a body length of over five meters plus an eight-meter tail, lying lazily in its nest.
As for the fact that her offspring was being held and played with by a ‘human,’ it didn’t mind and even showed a hint of affection when looking at Gwen Gail. Because it felt the aura of a ‘king’ on this human.
Mathilda Ward also excitedly squatted down, eyes gleaming, “Such a cute fox, Gwen, let me hold it.”
“Mm-hmm, slowly Sister Ilisa, it’s a little shy.”
While the two women were playing with the little fox, Jack Clark, still wearing sunglasses, stood quietly at the door in a bodyguard manner. His gaze retracted from those two big fierce… no, from the little fox.
Beside him, Damon Lopes, wearing a Daoist robe, leaned against the wall, looking surprised at the Mutated Fox Demons in the glass rooms along the corridor.
“The research on Mutated Fox Demons by the Hundred Foxes Nation has advanced to this extent, capable of stably cultivating high-potential, Senior-level Three-tailed Fox Demons.”
“These Mutated Creatures have high intelligence. Raising them from a young age makes for excellent companion Unique Beasts, and they can even be put together into special military units.”
“There are pros and cons,” Jack Clark had a different opinion on this matter.
Although these Mutated Creatures’ cultivation and domestication have high added value and can even be used as war beasts, if the Mutated Fox Demons continue to evolve and form a complete social structure with intelligence no less than humans, it’s possible that there will be a fox civilization in the future.
However, biological research has always been ongoing. Compared to the Hundred Foxes Nation’s principle of coexistence between humans and beasts, the experiments in some other countries are much crueler.
Not only the official Federation, but for power, longevity, or biological medicine research, there are many private labs around the world.
These laboratories are all funded by large companies and groups and capture various Mutated Creatures for research.
There have been increasing news reports internationally of laboratory explosions, powerful Mutated Creatures breaking out and causing casualties.
In the afternoon following the two women, Jack Clark saw many kinds of Mutated Fox Demons, including Three-tailed, Four-tailed, and even the Three-eyed Blood Fox with special eye techniques.
After lunch, the group visited the fox-themed natural park in the afternoon.
Forests, streams, grasslands, blue sky and white clouds.
While those two beautiful women played, Jack Clark sat cross-legged on the hillside, holding the God Elephant Secret Book in his hands, deciphering Spatial Channel Runes.
Further away, on trees tens of meters high, Damon Lopes stood with his hands behind his back, admiring the various Fox Demons nestled in the forest, his demeanor carefree and elegant.
This guy was posturing, but Jack Clark didn’t expose him.
The next three days passed in a flash. Under Hannah Gail’s guarantee, the entire Green Mountain City became very stable, with law enforcement team members visible everywhere on the streets.
Besides, there were some personnel dressed in black, all accompanied by Mutated Fox Demons five to ten meters tall, patrolling the whole city.
As the music team and Dance Group arrived one after another, Mathilda Ward also became busy.
“One, two, three, jump, right, just like that.”
“Ilisa, you stand here at that time, right, this angle looks beautiful, giving you the aura of a queen.”
In the audience seats below the stage, Jack Clark held a white book in his hands, quietly watching, while partly paying attention to his surroundings. Sitting to his left was Marla Fiore.
The secretary assistant for the day wore a black suit, a white shirt that bulged beneath, a tight mini-skirt on the lower half showing off legs encased in black stockings.
Sexy, intellectual, along with a faint scent wafting over, seemingly the fragrance of jasmine bath gel.
Yet, with a beauty nearby, Jack Clark’s focus was entirely in the book, his eyes showing a complex, rotating, silver, three-dimensional rune, exuding profound mystery.
With the Giant Beast and the original body working together these days, the Spatial Channel Rune had finally been deciphered.
By that time, the Thunderflame Beheamoth had already started to condense.
Thousand-meter-deep under the sea, the Ice Crystal Palace emitting white radiance stood as an undersea spectacle..

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 222: The Demon King in Action, Over 10,000 Attribute Points, Spatial Feather Horn_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Chapter 222: The Demon King in Action, Over 10,000 Attribute Points, Spatial Feather Horn_3
Translator: 549690339 |
In the Thunderflame Dragon King Palace, resembling an Eastern palace, the black-red colossal beast’s golden vertical pupils also revealed spiraling star-cloud-like rune images.
Its silence over the past few days had not only completed its rune research but also increased its size to seventy meters after devouring the flesh of two Level 7 Colossus.
On the Thunderflame Behemoth, the ancient Giant Beast’s oppressive aura grew increasingly heavy and terrifying.
“Let’s begin.”
Accompanied by a low growl, the powerful Blood Qi in Thunderflame behemoth’s body was gathering, its spirit and will fusing and covering the three pairs of feather horns at the sides of its head.
This rune, capable of opening a temporary spatial channel, is different from normal runes. When forcibly opening a spatial channel, it requires a strong support.
As an Eighth Level Beast, its horns, scales, and bones are all formidable transcendent materials – solid and possessing excellent energy conduction and stability.
At this moment, with Thunderflame Behemoth’s refinement, mysterious silver runes emerged on the six red feather horns covered with sharp spikes, constantly coiling and spreading.
As more and more silver patterns emerged on the feather horns, an enigmatic spatial aura gradually filled the air.
About an hour later, complete silver patterns appeared on the three pairs of feather horns, resonating with one another as a special fluctuation burst forth.
Buzz!
The three pairs of feather horns with some spatial properties emitted a faint buzzing vibration, and golden flames burned on them, forming a golden Flame Crown.
in the middle of the Flame Crown, powerful spatial energy gathered and rotated, gradually revealing a continuously rotating silver vortex.
Immediately, the corners of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s mouth lifted slightly, revealing a sinister smile. It had succeeded.
Roar roar roar!! Abbott, I, have returned.
Accompanied by the roar of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the sea water in the distance surged, stirring up violent currents.
The Flood Dragon, who had been out for several days, returned with the corpses of two Level 7 Peak Colossus, covered in a strong smell of blood, showing that it had experienced multiple battles during this time.
Bang!
Two black dragon heads loosened their grip, and the corpses of the two Level 7 Peak Colossus slammed onto the ice crystal ground, shattering a large number of cracks.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott, your food has returned.”
Seeing that two more Level 7 Life Crystals were about to fall into his hands, the Thunderflame Behemoth growled in praise, “Nicely done, Kidora.”
“Roar roar roar!! It’s a trivial matter, not worth praising.” Although the black Flood Dragon said that, its nine dragon heads were constantly swaying, showing some joy.
After the Thunderflame Behemoth extracted the two Level 7 Life Crystals, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Dragon Turtle returned one after another not long afterward.
Both colossal beasts were filled with murderous intent, having killed countless mutated organisms during these days.
Whimpering!! Thunderflame, it’s a bit difficult to find crystals this time. As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish spoke, it opened its mouth wide. The abyssal maw, with a diameter of up to twenty meters, caused the water to surge and swirl around the seven Level 5 and Level 6 life crystals.
Life crystals would be digested if swallowed, so the Tiger Kingfish and Dragon Turtle usually held them in their mouths with water currents, or wrapped them around themselves during battles.
This carrying method sounded a little abnormal, but luckily Thunderflame wasn’t interested in eating them.
“Roar! You have worked hard, everyone.” The Thunderflame Behemoth growled in encouragement and then collected the more than ten Life Crystals brought back by the two colossal beasts.
A questioning look flashed in the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame, is that enough this time?
Although they might have fought every high-level mutated organism within a thousand kilometers, and killed those who met the criteria, they would go further if Thunderflame still needed more.
That’s right, they were this straightforward, as good brothers for life. In their simple mind, it was only natural to help Thunderflame with some tasks, and this time collecting crystals was also for their own benefit.
“Roar! It’s enough for now. We’ll talk about it later.”
It’s unknown if they discussed it, but soon after, the four Tiger Whales and the Silver Giant Dragon Scythia returned one after another, bringing back a large number of Life Crystals.
Among them, the four Tiger Whales still mainly had Level 3, with a few Level 4 and Level 5, while the Silver Giant Dragon brought back one Level 7 and two Level 6 crystals.
Huff huff!!
The Thunderflame Behemoth exhaled a hot breath from its nostrils as it stared at the small pile of Life Crystals in front of it, enough to convert over ten thousand attribute points, its eyes slightly red.
It couldn’t help it, even though it was the first time it had seen so many crystals.
“Roar! You’ve worked hard, brothers. Over the past few days, I have analyzed everyone’s strengths and researched several runes to enhance your combat abilities.”
The colossuses had put in so much effort that the Thunderflame Behemoth naturally had to give something back. Seeing this, the Tiger Kingfish and Dragon Turtle below became excited.
Whimpering!! Thunderflame, I want to learn! I want to learn the power of energy condensation!
“Roar, no problem, but I think you should learn this Sharpness Rune first, which can utilize the edges of your huge fish fins.”
With that, Thunderflame Behemoth stood up, its claws flickering with golden flames, gradually condensing a ‘Slash’ Basic Rune.
