The sole function of this rune was to make materials extremely sharp.
For example, the Tiger Kingfish could condense hundreds or thousands of such runes on the edges of its large fins like wings, forming a pair of sharp giant slash blades after stacking.
By then, combined with its formidable body and terrible strength comparable to a giant dragon, the power would be extremely terrifying.
Then, learning several suitable ‘Sword Skills’ would make it even more powerful.
Thinking of this, even the Thunderflame Behemoth felt that the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish would be fierce with sword skills. Wasn’t a sword-wielding Kingfish something to be afraid of?
After hearing Thunderflame Behemoth’s words, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes lit up, and it excitedly nodded: Whimpering!! It wants to learn! It wants to crush those guys!
Being too excited, the two pairs of huge fish fins of the Single-horned liger Kingfish were constantly flapping, causing a tsunami-like wave that flipped the surrounding little Tiger Whales.
Whimpering!! Immediately, the Female Tiger Whales let out a cry of grievance, and with a fierce glare from their eyes, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish stopped awkwardly.
“Roar! If you want to learn, come here. Don’t resist later.”
Boom!
With the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claw coming down, in an instant, the huge body of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish slammed onto the ice surface. The Destructive Shockwave even shook the entire Dragon Palace.
Watching this scene, the other colossal beasts, such as the Dragon Turtle, instinctively shrank their necks.
It’s just learning runes, there’s no need to be so brutal, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 223: Breaking the Genetic Shackles,
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: Chapter 223: Breaking the Genetic Shackles,
Void Double Pupils, Talent Super Enhanced (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Translator: 5496903391
Under the Thunderflame Behemoth’s claw, the powerful Spiritual Will imprinted the ‘slash’ information into the consciousness of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, where it will continuously play the rune condensation process until it learns.
The talent ability of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish is the Double Fin Slash, while for the Dragon Turtle, it’s the mouth cannon…
No, it’s the Basic Energy Conversion Rune at the throat.
Next, it just needs to condense a few hundred runes to form a powerful transformation field, spirally transform the energy within its body, and then it can unleash a Breath attack.
This is the second generation Transformation Rune that the Thunderflame Behemoth developed after studying its own throat structure, with the Basic Transformation Rune as the core and slightly adjusted structures.
Since it promised to help them, the Thunderflame Behemoth naturally wouldn’t go back on its word.
Next is the Nine-headed Flood Dragon; this guy’s talent abilities are actually quite comprehensive, so the Thunderflame Behemoth just taught it a solidity Basic Rune.
These runes engraved on its scales all over the body can enhance defense; if it could fully engrave them, the hundreds of thousands of scale runes overlaid would form a terrifying defense amplification.
Of course, to reach this step would take at least decades. Currently, its task is to engrave the scales of its nine necks to protect its weaknesses.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, it’s still working hard to condense the binding force field. Teaching one at a time is quite enough; other considerations can wait until they have mastered what they’ve learned so far.
Roar!
Seeing the Thunderflame Behemoth that seemed to have forgotten about them, the Female Tiger Whale let out mournful cries.
The Three-headed Small Tiger Whale kept wagging its tail, behaving like a little dog trying to please it.
“Roar! You three little fellows are too low level for cultivation. Wait until you breakthrough to Level 7, and this Icing will teach you then.”
“As for you… right, what is your talent ability?”
Looking at the Female Tiger Whale, which had broken through to Level 7 long ago but had always been inconspicuous, the Thunderflame Behemoth was somewhat bewildered.
Because it seemed to have never seen this Tiger Whale exhibit its talent.
Roar! Eat, crush.
Saying this, the Female Tiger Whale opened its mouth wide and with a loud bang, bit into the Ice Crystal-transfigured square, instantly creating a hollow space with a twenty-meter diameter.
The ice crystal condensed by the Eighth Level Beast’s strength was shattered by the force contained in its sharp teeth, then got sucked into a vortex in its mouth and disappeared into another ‘space’.
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Behemoth fell silent for a moment, looking at the cringing Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, not quite sure what to say.
No wonder this guy is so afraid of his wife.
Anyone who had such a fierce wife would also be afraid.
A solitary Devouring Vortex, and a crushing talent in itself wasn’t very powerful, and it was close-range instead of an energy attack. But when combined together, it became very strong.
It was even terrifying-capable of devouring all Mutated Creatures below its level.
No wonder, even amidst caring for her children, the growth rate of this Female Tiger Whale wasn’t much slower than that of the Single-horned 1 iger Kingfish. After some thought, the Thunderflame Behemoth still taught it the Energy Conversion Rune, but this time it was to convert the devoured matter into energy.
Crushing, transforming, devouring—combined together they might exceed the expectations of all ‘creatures’.
In the audience seats, Jack Clark, whose attention had already been withdrawn from the Secret Book, revealed a hint of excitement in his eyes, though no one saw it because of the sunglasses.
There was no helping it; he was about to convert nearly ten thousand Attribute Points worth of Life Crystals, which even he couldn’t help but get excited about.
Years of cultivation… cough! No, it should be more than half a year of cultivation.
From the start, exchanging for a Level 1 Life Crystal and converting a few Attribute points to now suddenly obtaining tens of thousands of Attribute Points, the difference was too huge.
It seemed that his initial decision to team up with Unique Beasts like the Tiger Whale and later establish the Dragon Palace was the right choice.
Otherwise, even if he had mastered the method of spatial transmission, he wouldn’t be able to collect so many Life Crystals in just a few days, considering that the Thunderflame Behemoth, no matter how strong, was still alone.
But today’s tasks were not yet complete; He would have to wait until evening to find time to condense the coordinate runes.
After all, having gained so many benefits, he must still do the job (protecting Mathilda Ward) well.
This time, to deal with the soul avatars of the two King-level strongmen, the Federation had given two Top-tier Secret Manuals worth twenty thousand Contribution Points each.
In addition to that, there was also the Top-level Skill from Hannah Gail’s possession, which was no less valuable than the Secret Manuals.
That’s right, the Summoning Secret Skill was also part of the rewards for this task.
If it wasn’t for his role as Mathilda Ward’s bodyguard, Hannah Gail wouldn’t have been interested in challenging him to a fight, let alone easily allowing him to comprehend the family’s Summoning Secret Skill.
This kind of Top-tier Secret Skill created by a King-level strongman isn’t even in the Federation’s database.
Because it has already delved into the individual’s more core powers.
While Jack Clark watched the stage where beautiful girls were dancing, with one eye, he observed the group of Giant Beasts ‘cultivating’ with his other perspective.
Time passed, and it quickly approached eleven-thirty. Marla Fiore stood up and clapped her hands, “Everyone has worked hard; let’s rest a bit before lunch.”
With that, Marla Fiore walked onto the stage and handed Mathilda Ward a towel: “You’ve worked hard, Ilisa.”
Mathilda Ward wiped the sweat from her face, her cheeks still flushed with exercise: “I’m okay, actually, everyone has worked harder than me.”
As the main star of the stage, she did follow the rehearsals, but mainly to find her dance rhythm and practice a few moves in coordination with the backup dancers; the rest of the time, she sang.
Compared to her, those backup dancers who had rehearsed the choreography for a dozen songs since early morning were indeed more tired.
Hearing Mathilda Ward’s words, the tiredness seemed to fade from these people’s faces, giving them a sense of satisfaction that their efforts were recognized..

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - 223: Breaking the Genetic Shackles, Void Double Pupils, Talent Super Enhanced (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Chapter 223: Breaking the Genetic Shackles, Void Double Pupils, Talent Super Enhanced (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, Jack Clark turned his head to look at Marla Fiore: “Assistant Marla, does Miss Ward have any plans for the afternoon?”
Marla Fiore said, “This afternoon, llisa has a dress fitting. The concert is opening tomorrow night, so we need to determine early which dresses she will wear and which props she’ll use.”
“Does Brother Callum have something on his mind?”
Jack Clark shook his head: “No, just asking about the schedule.”
Suddenly, Mathilda Ward said, “Sister Jessica, this afternoon I want to read for a while. Let’s cancel the plans, and do the fitting and props tomorrow morning.”
“…Alright.” Marla Fiore was slightly stunned, somewhat puzzled as to why Mathilda Ward wanted to cancel the already confirmed schedule.
Jack Clark too paused for a moment.
At the cafeteria table, Jack Clark glanced at the ‘little bit’ of food in front of Marla Fiore and Mathilda Ward and couldn’t help but ask out of curiosity, “Don’t you girls get hungry eating just this little all day?”
Marla Fiore shook her head: “Not at all. Mr. Callum, you may think our food isn’t much, but together, the calories are enough for the day’s consumption.” In front of the two women was a small clump of rice, two prawns about forty grams each, a meticulously cooked small steak, and a serving of vegetables.
This was their lunch, which would not even suffice for Jack Clark, a cultivator, let alone his brother Glenn Clark, in a single bite.
If you fed that guy this little each day, he would’ve long since taken up residence by the riverside with a fishing rod and barbecue grill.
At this thought, Jack Clark also started feeling homesick, but he immediately suppressed the idea of making a phone call back home.
No rush. This mission is only for a little over two months, which is just the end of the next semester.
At this time, Damon Lopes, who had been out and about all morning, popped up, carrying a large portion of food cooked with Mutated Beast Meat and sat down at the three-person table.
Damon Lopes slapped Jack Clark’s shoulder with a grin: “Brother Callum, you worked hard this morning.”
“Hard work is a bit much, but where did Brother Lopes go off to this morning?” Jack Clark was a bit curious.
“Didn’t go anywhere, just bonded with some staff members, hehe, and made a few new friends along the way.”
“I find the beauties in Green Mountain City so gentle, and their voices so pleasant.”
Jack Clark paused for a moment: “…How many red envelopes did you send out this morning?”
“Not much, just tens of thousands.”
“As long as the big boss is happy,” Jack Clark nodded his head.
Tens of thousands a day, that’s about the value of killing a Level 2 Mutated Beast. Indeed, not much.
In the afternoon, inside the hotel suite, Mathilda Ward quietly read her book, enjoying the rare peace and quiet.
The sunlight was shining brightly outside the window.
On the balcony, Jack Clark sat cross-legged on a soft cushion, his eyes slightly closed as he mobilized the internal power within his body and prepared to engrave space runes on his right arm.
The runes formed by the body and Giant Beast differ slightly. As a more powerful Avatar, the Giant Beast will bear the brunt of the stress associated with opening pathways.
This is why the Thunderflame Beheamoth engraved the runes on its feather horn.
Hu hu!!
As a powerful Will surged, a strong wind encircled Jack Clark. His sleeves and hair fluttered. Solidified golden red Blood Qi converged upon his right arm.
With his spirit and True Strength merging and Blood Qi solidifying, Jack Clark’s right arm’s clothes silently shattered, starting from the wrist, as mysterious golden red runes emerged inch by inch.
These golden red runes spread up the arm like vine tendrils.
As time passed, more and more golden red runes appeared on Jack Clark’s arm, slowly covering the entire forearm, and the mysterious Aura grew stronger. Crack!
At that moment, Marla Fiore pushed the room’s door open, about to say something, but was immediately silenced by the girls on the sofa with a gesture.
After Marla Fiore approached, Mathilda Ward whispered: “Brother Callum is cultivating. Don’t disturb him.”
Then, Marla Fiore also saw the meditating silhouette of Jack Clark, the sound of the wind, his wild hair, and his arm shining with golden red Radiance. All were extraordinary.
Seeing this scene, envy appeared in Marla Fiore’s eyes.
Soon, Marla Fiore, who came to see Mathilda Ward, finished discussing business then carefully left.
Past five in the afternoon, as Jack Clark’s right arm became covered with mysterious golden red patterns and they formed a whole, an invisible Spatial Fluctuation suddenly Burst.
Humm!
With the golden red rune twinkling, the space around Jack Clark became unstable, with invisible transparent ripples spreading and Distorting.
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes and looked down at the glowing spatial runes on his right arm, smiling.
After working hard for so long… well, just a few days, he had finally managed to open the channel between his body and Avatar. Now it was time for Waken River to take off.
At that moment, Mathilda Ward’s head popped up from behind, curiously looking at the gradually fading runes on Jack Clark’s arm.
“Brother Callum, haven’t you been creating a Secret Book recently? This seems to involve space runes, right?”
Jack Clark nonchalantly replied: “I’ve been researching spatial powers recently, and today was just an experiment.” With that, Jack Clark didn’t continue.
An experiment. Mathilda Ward naturally didn’t believe Jack Clark’s words, but she didn’t press further.
Night!
After ensuring that Mathilda Ward wasn’t going out, Jack Clark returned to his room past eight in the evening.
Then he closed the door, drew the curtains, and took a deep breath in his room. He began operating the copious Golden True Dragon Power within him, activating the runes.
At the same time, in the Ice Crystal Palace under the deep sea.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth, which was already waiting, let out a low growl. Golden flames erupted on the three pairs of red feather horns on either side of the dragon head, intertwined with silver runes twinkling.
Humm!
Humm!
With runes activating, coordinates set, and golden runes appearing on Jack Clark’s arm with circles of silver radiance sparkling, the surrounding space began to twist and ripple..

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 223: Breaking the Genetic Shackles, Void Double Pupils, Super Enhanced Talent (Seeking Monthly Pass) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Chapter 223: Breaking the Genetic Shackles, Void Double Pupils, Super Enhanced Talent (Seeking Monthly Pass) _3
Translator: 549690339
The golden flames on both sides of the Thunderflame Behemoth’s head blazed furiously, forming a ring of a Flame Crown, whose center also shimmered with rings of silver radiance.
Gradually, a silver vortex with a diameter of over twenty centimeters appeared, spinning continuously.
Crackle Crackle!!
At that moment, a terrifyingly heavy force descended from above, causing the massive head of the Thunderflame Behemoth to sink slightly as the three pairs of feather horns cracked.
The formidable presence of the Spatial Channel caused the surrounding sea water to boil over, forming waves that crashed against the ice crystal walls, emitting a thunderous rumble.
A grave look appeared on the ferocious face of the Thunderflame Behemoth. Despite being psychologically prepared, opening a stable Spatial Channel spanning thousands of kilometers was more challenging than anticipated. The Invisible Power it needed to withstand was stronger than expected. After all, space is a force that can only be touched upon after reaching the Ninth Heaven Peak and coming into contact with the rule—it was still somewhat strenuous for it to forcibly open the channel.
This was even after Jack Clark had comprehended space from innate runes, whose basic structure pointed directly to the Origin of space.
Gurgle Gurgle!!
A pile of Life Crystals in the corner of the room tumbled about, caught up in the current controlled by the Thunderflame Behemoth, and formed into a crystal necklace that flew toward the center of the Flame Crown’s channel. Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh!! These crystals swiftly passed through the vortex, appearing in the room on the other side in an instant, where Jack Clark caught them one by one and quickly placed them on the ground.
Soon, dozens of Life Crystals were transferred, and shortly afterward, the Spatial Channel disappeared.
Hu Hu!!
In the room, Jack Clark sat weakly on the edge of the bed, gasping for air, his expression excited as he gazed at the pile of damp Life Crystals on the floor.
His excitement wasn’t for the Life Crystals themselves, but for the resources that would continue to be brought over from the sea.
Now that there was a stable connection between the Giant Beast and his original body, many resources discovered in the ocean could be shared with his main body, including resources.
This even included later when the Giant Beast would venture into the mythical world.
Of course, by then Jack Clark’s original form would also need to be there; otherwise, it would be impossible to open a channel that spanned worlds, unless both the original and the Avatar had broken through to the King-level. After catching his breath, Jack Clark began to convert the Life Crystals.
“You have converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 297 Attribute points.”
“You have converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 751 Attribute points…”
Along with the conversion of numerous third and fourth Level, and even large numbers of sixth-level and seventh-level Life Crystals to dust, the Attribute points on the transparent page soared at a terrifying speed.
1000, 2000, 5000…
After more than sixty Life Crystals had been converted, the Attribute points on the attribute page had soared to 11723, giving Jack Clark an unreal feeling.
These Attribute points were too many and had come too quickly.
After all, before this, he had been struggling to death for a few hundred or a thousand points of contribution.
Now with the Attribute points in hand, how should he use them?
Currently, with the Cultivation Methods such as Dragon Elephant Overlord Body and Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd maximized for Limit Enhancement, there’s nowhere to advance until the Seventh Layer Secret Book is created, so he could only enhance his talents.
Jack Clark’s gaze first fell on the Top Tier Talent Soul Split, and then he found that even though there was a plus sign, there was still no prompt to enhance it. “Attribute points have already exceeded 10,000, and yet it still doesn’t meet the requirements for enhancing a Top Tier Talent!”
Jack Clark’s brow slightly furrowed, realizing that the requirements for elevating a Top Tier Talent were higher than he had imagined.
Unable to enhance a Top Tier Talent, Jack Clark’s attention naturally shifted to the Advanced Talents.
“Would you like to spend 10,000 Attribute points to enhance Swift?”
“It takes 10,000 to enhance an Advanced Talent once.”
Looking at the prompt that appeared before him, Jack Clark pondered for a moment and ultimately decided to give up, his gaze moving to the Thunderflame and Blazing Talent of the Thunderflame Behemoth.
Boom!
With an explosion of sea water, the Thunderflame Behemoth transformed into a shadow that darted out from the palace, shooting out several kilometers while a few Little Tiger Whales frolicking nearby watched.
At the same time, a voice echoed in Jack Clark’s mind.
“Spend Attribute points to strengthen the Thunder Talent.”
“You have spent 1000 points to enhance the Thunder Talent once.”
“You have spent 1000 points to raise the Thunder Talent to Advanced, forming a new Talent…”
“You have spent 2000 points to raise the Blazing Talent to Advanced, forming a new Talent, Golden Flame…”
Boom Boom Boom!!
Endless enhancing energies surged through the Soul Channel, crossing immense distances to burst into the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body, and in an instant, explosions erupted on the seabed, with Thunder and Golden Flame erupting simultaneously.
Just as the Thunder and Blazing Talents were transforming towards Advanced Talent, Jack Clark hadn’t stopped.
“You spend Attribute points to enhance the Regeneration Talent three times, breaking the talent through to intermediate level; you spend 2000 points to enhance Regeneration; a new Talent is condensing…”
“You spend Attribute points to enhance the Toxic Talent three times… Advanced Talent is condensing…”
“You spend Attribute points to enhance the Golden Dragon Double Pupils twice; the Advanced Talent Void Double Pupils…”
As all talents of the Thunderflame Behemoth were enhanced to Advanced level, it was as if a trigger condition had been reached, and a deep force within was activated, instantly spreading an aura of desolation and antiquity.
It was the ancient Aura carried by the drop of terrifying blood absorbed in the past.
Under the influence of this aura, the genetic shackles of the Thunderflame Behemoth were broken, and some dormant ancient genes in the genetic chain were activated, bursting with terrible power.
Boom!
With the power of the ancient genes, the Thunderflame Behemoth began the second phase of its growth, and even the forces condensing into Advanced Talents were affected…

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 224: Peerless Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Monarch, Looking Directly at the Essence
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Chapter 224: Peerless Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Monarch, Looking Directly at the Essence
Translator: 549690339
Crackle Crackle!!
The Thunderflame Behemoth’s body continued to stretch, its cells dividing and compressing frantically, as its muscles became more sculpted and bulging, filled with explosive strength.
Its neck became thick and powerful, and its skull slightly deformed to appear fiercer, with prominent brow bones and the black short horns on its head growing longer and sharper, resembling a mane.
As its body changed, the heavy black and red scale armor also kept expanding and deforming, becoming more angular and rising up in blade-like sharp grooves.
At the same time, from both claws and the joints of its legs, backwards-facing barbs grew, and on its shoulders, a row of heavy bone spurs emerged, with faint flames flickering within.
The dorsal fin, which had evolved from a row of sharp spikes to robust coral, became sharp again during this growth, yet thicker compared to the third evolution of the Sword Armor Beast.
And on both sides of the dorsal fin, new black and red sharp spikes grew, forming three rows extending to the tail, which aligned with the angle of the scale armor at the tail.
It looked as if the tail had gained an extra blade forged from the union of three rows of sharp spikes.
The tail tip’s spikes also became sharper and thicker, like a sword’s edge, emanating a sharp aura, yet heavy like a knife, suitable for slashing.
These were just external changes.
Inside the Thunderflame Behemoth, the top-tier defense and strength stood firm, while Thunder and Golden Flame roared wildly.
Endless Golden Flame energy tumbled through its flesh and blood, turning into pure gold-like flames, radiating a terrifying heat capable of scorching the heavens and boiling the seas.
At the same time, the electrical cells in its dorsal fin also divided and deformed madly, each cell core seemingly adopting the shape of lightning as if they weren’t cells but thunder itself.
Even due to the overly powerful energy, the three rows of dorsal fin lit up like high-watt bulbs, emitting a deep blue radiance, and blue arcs crackled fiercely.
Apart from this, the formerly low-tier talents for regeneration and toxin had undergone earth-shattering changes, transforming the substances circulating through its flesh and blood into energy-based talents.
Moreover, the toxin, which had evolved into energy, merged opportunistically with the Golden Flame; when the green toxic energy infused with a hint of Golden Flame, it became hotter and more explosive, like oil fueling a fire. Regeneration and Agility could also fuse, allowing the burst of speed that would normally require a pause after two bursts to reach multiple bursts.
With Agility Talent that on land instantly increased its body length thirtyfold, and underwater, twentyfold, the speed burst was terrifying, but the strain and damage to the body were also substantial. Each burst caused the joints and muscles to dissolve, and even it had to pause and recover, but now…
Boom!
Golden flames erupted like a volcano from the Thunderflame Behemoth’s body, the glaring firelight covering a three hundred meter radius, with deep blue thunder roaring within.
In an instant, a ferociously terrifying aura burst forth.
Boom!
Beneath this terrifying force, the seabed trembled, the earth within a hundred-meter radius shattered, unable to withstand, forming scorching magma erupting under the fierce high-temperature flames.
The surrounding dead silent and cold sea water was obliterated, vaporized by the impact of the Golden Flame and Thunder at temperatures over ten thousand degrees Celsius, resulting in waves of destructive impact that swept a kilometer radius.
Even the sea surface was stirred up into tsunamis over ten meters high, forming rings of sea waves rushing in all directions, with an intimidating momentum.
Such terrifying force instantly alerted everyone in the nearby Ice Crystal Palace, including the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, who were cultivating, prompting them to rush out instinctively.
Looking at the ferocious beast standing amidst the Golden Flame Thunder, even the Silver Giant Dragon, a descendant of a Mythical Giant Beast, felt an oppression stemming from a more profound level of life.
As for the other ‘beasts’, there was even less need to mention, especially the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which felt even more shocked.
Not long before, the Thunderflame Behemoth was teaching them runes; how had it suddenly grown again, becoming so formidable that even they felt somewhat frightened?
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s nine heads twisted as it roared in shock, “Roar roar roar! So strong, the aura, Abbott, what has happened to you?”
Compared to the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was excited: Roar roar roar! Thunderflame, you’ve become even more powerful, so strong, so strong!
Roar roar! Thunderflame, even more monstrous, true to yourself, growing increasingly monstrous. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also roared excitedly.
After spending so much time together, the two giant beasts had long grown accustomed to the Thunderflame Behemoth’s monstrosity; if one day it wasn’t fierce enough, they would be surprised instead.
As for the four Mutated Tiger Whales, at that moment under the oppressive violent terror of the Thunderflame Behemoth, they instinctively shrank behind the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, trembling with fear.
This included the Female Tiger Whale that had grown to Level 7, unable to directly face the Thunderflame Behemoth releasing its ferocious aura without restraint.
In the center of the Thunder Fire Domain, the ferocious black-red colossal beast let out a deep roar, “Domination, if you can’t use an adjective properly, don’t use it. I’m not monstrous; I’ve become stronger.”
The Thunderflame Behemoth’s golden vertical pupils swept over all the giant beasts as it growled, “This time, I triggered a second growth while contemplating the essence of my own powers and deducing runes.”
Roar roar roar! I want to grow too, Thunderflame, you look so fierce.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes shone with envy.
Thunderflame Behemoth growled, “Wanting a second growth is simple; comprehend your talent to its limit, penetrate the essence of your own strength, and it can be achieved.”
“Roar roar roar! Abbott, how, comprehend, what is, comprehension?” The Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle both showed confusion in their nine pairs of eyes.
“Comprehension is self-reflection.”
“Take Scythia, for example. Have you ever wondered how your Ice talent is produced? Why does it form ice? What’s the principle behind it, why isn’t it water?”

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 224: Peerless Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Monarch, Looking Directly at the Essence_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Chapter 224: Peerless Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Monarch, Looking Directly at the Essence_2
Translator: 549690339
The words of the Thunderflame Behemoth made the Silver Giant Dragon pause, for it indeed had not considered this question before.
Since its birth, it had either eaten, slept, or flown around its mother’s territory every day, carefree and without worries.
As for its inherent abilities, it naturally mastered them due to the spiritual imprint of its bloodline, knowing how to use and display them, and they strengthened with each rise in its level.
“Joe, Domination, you two will soon have a chance to comprehend the nature of power.”
During the breakthrough to level eight of an Extraordinary Creature, there is a process where one’s talent takes on a physical rune form, fundamentally revealing the nature of one’s power.”
Suddenly, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes lit up with excitement, saying, roar, roar, roar!! So I am going to transform soon, great huh.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also roared excitedly, roar, roar!! So that’s how it is, as long as we break through to level eight, we can also be as mighty as you, Thunderflame.
Roar, roar, roar!! But Thunderflame, it feels like it’s still a long time before we can break through.
Anxiety showed in the eyes of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, although they had touched the threshold of level eight, they felt they still needed a long time to fully step into it.
“Roar! It’s not about breaking through to level eight that allows one to grow again, but mastering the essence of power that makes it possible,” the Thunderflame Behemoth roared to correct their misunderstanding.
This second growth, triggered by the activation of ancient genes, had provided it with a lot of ancient information about Extraordinary Beasts.
Included was information about levels.
Just like with humans, where there are ordinary, genius, top-notch geniuses, monsters, and unparalleled geniuses, there is also a distinction of talent among Extraordinary Beasts.
These include Ordinary Beasts, Elite Beasts, Lord-level Beasts, Monarch-level Beasts, and Emperor-level Beasts.
This classification points to the potential of their bloodline and also represents the strength and upper limit among those of the same level.
for example, an Ordinary Mutated Beast possesses only one low-level talent, is weak in strength, and has no hope of breaking through level four unless its bloodline evolves under some fortuitous circumstance.
Meanwhile, an Elite Mutated Beast has at least one intermediate talent, with the potential to grow to level four and stronger combat power at the same level, although the hope of breaking through to level seven is slim.
As for Mutated Creatures that awaken a hint of a king-level bloodline or a Dragon Bloodline, they are recognized as Lord-level.
Such creatures possess at least one Advanced Talent and several intermediate and low-level talents, with a fair chance of reaching level nine in potential and very strong combat power.
For example, the Dragon Turtle possesses Advanced Defense and High-level Shock, along with two intermediate talents, an instant head probe and fusing with the Earth to amplify its defense.
The Tiger Whale is the same, with Advanced Talent Devouring Vortex, Advanced Talent Whale Form Shield, while the energy attack of the horn on its head is a low-level talent, in addition to intermediate defense and intermediate physical strength talents.
This is also the reason why their combat power can leap across two minor realms.
And Monarch-level Mythical Beasts not only have more talents but at least one of them is Top Tier, possessing the potential to grow into a Mythical Giant Beast.
for example, the Silver Giant Dragon, which has both royal blood and Dragon species buffs, is a Monarch-level creature.
It has mastered the Top Tier Talent Power of Space, and other talents like High-level Storm, Ice, Strength, Agility, Defense, and several intermediate talents such as True Dragon Might.
Compared to the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which is only Lord-level, is actually a bit lacking in potential.
But because it possesses four High-level talents: Fire, Ice, Gravity Line, and Defense, as well as several intermediate talents like Strength and Regeneration.
Plus, being in the late period after reaching level eight, its combat power is so strong that it can suppress the Silver Giant Dragon, who’s in the early stage of level eight Monarch-level.
In contrast, the previous Thunderflame Behemoth was so strong because both its strength and its defense were Top Tier Talents.
Coupled with intermediate Thunder, Golden Flame, and High-level Agility, as well as two lower-level talents that can be ignored and terrifyingly dense physique, it was able to overpower them.
Now, as the Thunderflame Behemoth has reinforced its four weaker talents to Advanced status and combined their abilities, it has become a monstrous beast that is close to Emperor-level in an instant.
Indeed, it has yet to reach Emperor-level.
Because to be Emperor-level requires having four Top Tier talents before the condensation of a Law Divine Domain as a Mythical Giant Beast, with the remainder talents being at least Advanced, making it an Emperor with Absolute Domination.
At that point, not only would its combat power become even more defy the heavens, but it seems to also relate to the growth potential of becoming a Mythical Giant Beast.
Because a Mythical Giant Beast is not the limit, above them, there are even more terrifying beasts.
In the ancient information seen by the Thunderflame Behemoth earlier, those creatures that stand above Mythical Giant Beasts are massive enough to blot out the sky, causing heaven and Earth to shatter and the sun and moon to darken with their breaths.
However, these are still too far away from it.
Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Behemoth turned to look at the Tiger
Whale and the Dragon Turtle and lowly roared.
“Coming up, I will help you activate and solidify your talents. Remember, when you’re growing and breaking through to eight, do not fall into a deep slumber;
be aware and comprehend the essence of power.”
Although it was one step away from reaching Emperor level, the Thunderflame Behemoth still possessed a certain ‘power.’
It could, with the divine might of a Giant Beast Monarch, induce their potential, activate their innate powers, and enable the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle to break through beforehand.
However, this kind of potential-inducing effect is only effective the first time, unless it evolves into a true Monarch in the future.
Immediately, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was extremely excited, slapping the sea water with its double fins, roar, roar, roar!! I definitely won’t sleep, I must repo… I want to become the strongest Extraordinary Creature.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared excitedly, roar, roar!! Thunderflame, come on, do it, I want to break through to level eight.
The eyes of the Thunderflame Behemoth twitched and he couldn’t help but roar, “Domination, 1 just told you not to misuse words, and here you are howling nonsense again..”

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 224: Peerless Ferocious Beast, the Monarch of Giant Beasts, Gazing into the Essence s
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Chapter 224: Peerless Ferocious Beast, the Monarch of Giant Beasts, Gazing into the Essence s
Translator: 549690339
I don’t know what’s going on with this Tennat Monk Dragon Turtle; not only is it becoming more and more bandit-like, but it also keeps spouting a bunch of nonsensical and headache-inducing words.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Beheamoth noticed the envy in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and couldn’t help but growl lowly.
“Later, when I help them with their breakthrough, don’t resist either of you.
Let the gifted powers within you become active and see if you can gain anything.”
“Roar! Brock Abbott, can we do it too?” The Silver Giant Dragon asked with some surprise.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth growled back, “Roar! It will have a certain effect, but it won’t be as strong as that of Domination and the others. After all, your talents have already stabilized.”
Soon, the four great beasts, including the three-headed Mutated Tiger Whale, dispersed around the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace, following the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s instructions. Then, the Thunderflame Beheamoth took a deep breath.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Accompanied by the dragon’s roar and growls, the seven talents within the Thunderflame Beheamoth resonated, and in an instant, a terrifying monarchial pressure burst out, shaking heaven and earth.
However, this time there weren’t any phenomena like sea water exploding or towering tsunamis.
The invisible burst of monarchial pressure mixed with the dragon’s roaring groan, creating a mysterious force that enshrouded the seven transcendent beings.
In an instant, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had already reached the peak of Level 7, and the Single-homed Tiger Kingfish felt an intense vibration within their bodies; their gifted powers became incredibly active, and a strong drowsiness overwhelmed them.
Whimper, whimper, whimper!! Can’t, sleep!
Roar, roar!! Hold on, Domination, we will also evolve.
As the two giant beasts approached their breakthrough, the Silver Giant
Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon also showed surprise because the many gifted powers within them were also triggered.
However, compared to the Tiger Whales, which were manifesting talents out of nothing, this triggering was much less significant, merely bringing their talents back to full form.
Even so, it greatly helped them in understanding the true nature of their own powers.
Especially after being taught by the Thunderflame Beheamoth beforehand, they began to fall into self-reflection.
Gurgle, gurgle!!
The Three-headed Small Tiger Whales lay on the seabed, emitting human-like deep sleeping snores as the talent abilities and even the strength in their flesh and blood became very active.
This time they had also encountered a tremendous opportunity.
As for how much they would benefit, it was up to their luck.
If they were lucky, one might awaken a trace of a king-level bloodline and become a Lord-level Unique Beast.
The Thunderflame Beheamoth stopped roaring and looked towards the nearby Female Tiger Whale, growling, “Keep an eye on them. 1 need to find some food to replenish my energy.”
“Later, after they wake up, I’ll help you provoke a talent evolution.”
The Female Tiger Whale, excited, bowed her head respectfully and said, Whimper, whimper, whimper!! Yes, king.
After leaving the Female Tiger Whale to look after the other Giant Beasts, the Thunderflame Beheamoth, which had retracted its domain, turned around.
Between the row of horn-like spikes on its shoulder armor and the sharp spikes on both sides of its dorsal fin, there were a row of fine holes where golden flames erupted, and with a burst of powerful thrust, the Thunderflame Beheamoth shot out.
Boom!
Scorching waves of air surged as the Thunderflame Beheamoth sped away; the sea water that made contact with its body seemingly slid off, and in the blink of an eye, it disappeared into the distance with astonishing speed.
This was one of the changes after its recent growth, a jet-like acceleration combining body mutation with supernatural powers, which allowed it to move even faster underwater.
As for flying… well, he still couldn’t fly for now.
However, the Thunderflame Behemoth had a premonition that once its other talents were strengthened to the top-tier, it would be able to fly.
At astonishing speed, it took the Thunderflame Behemoth only two hours to travel more than a thousand kilometers.
Soon, at the depths of more than two thousand meters under the deep sea, it found its target, a Level 7 Giant Beast with a body more than 50 meters long and sixteen uneven tentacles.
Boom!
In the deep sea below, the sea water exploded, and in the eyes of that Level 7 Colossus, a flash of gold was all it felt before an indescribable force descended upon it, causing its head to explode in an instant.
What followed was an explosive shockwave caused by the burst of ten times the speed of sound, the roar of the explosion reverberated across the seabed, raising a surge of destructive shockwaves.
In the turbulent sea water, the ferocious and fierce figure of the Thunderflame Behemoth appeared, its double claws seizing the corpse of the Giant King Squid, devouring it while searching for its next target.
Over an hour later, having finished eating the Giant King Squid, the Ihunderflame Behemoth found a new target.
Boom! With a massive explosion below the sea, the head of the whale, over fifty meters in length collapsed, it was instantly killed without even having the chance to react.
Not just these Level 7 Colossi, even ordinary Level 8 Giant Beasts were no different.
Four thousand meters down in the dark deep sea, with the roaring thunderflame, an eighty-meter-long Black Colossus let out a cry of terror, its surroundings enveloped by its domain.
Boom!
Swift and powerful, with a claw imbued with a dazzling golden fireball, the domain of this ordinary mid-stage Level 8 Giant Beast collapsed instantly, its head exploding.
Standing in front of the corpse of the Giant Beast, with its searing blood spraying, the Thunderflame Behemoth’s gaze was cold, emanating an extremely ferocious and terrifying aura.
With the elevation of its four main talents, the next step for it was to grow to Level 9 as soon as possible, to hunt more powerful Giant Beasts, to plunder more resources to enhance itself and to nourish its true form.
Meanwhile, as the Thunderflame Behemoth began its rampage and slaughter of Giant Beasts above Level 7 in the deep sea to grow and advance, in the room, Jack Clark showed a look of confusion on his face.
At that moment, Jack’s eyes revealed a pair of black gold vertical pupils within the black pupils of his eyes, emanating a terrifying majesty. Where his gaze fell, spatial fluctuations ceased, solidifying.
Even the slight cracks occasionally appearing deep in the space vanished instantly, forcibly closed by his gaze.
Beyond that, with the dual pupils active, layers of space became void, as if the depths held an infinite void, or an endless abyss.
And then… nothing more.
The advanced Void Double Pupils seemed to only halt spatial fluctuations without much offensive power, such as not being able to shatter a swath of space with a glance.
However, in the dark void deep within, there were occasional mysterious traces flashing by, those were traces of space made manifest, similar to the aura of the Innate Space Runes he had contemplated before.
At the same time, Jack saw a page appear before his eyes, his gaze falling on the note about his talent.
Talent: Void Double Pupils [Senior, where the eyes fall, space stagnates, cracks close, can see through all illusions, straight to the essence of power!
“See through all illusions and straight to the essence of power, including the essence of space itself?” Jack’s gaze shifted slightly.
In comparison to the ‘attack’ of the Double Pupils, the ‘passive’ ability to see and even touch the traces of space is more precious.
For Jack at the moment, what he lacks are not means of combat and explosive abilities, but comprehension and understanding of all things between heaven and earth, what he lacks is time.
And this pair of eyes, capable of seeing the traces of space and even the essence of power, are more helpful to him than a battle talent.
As for the future development of the Double Pupils, with strength intensified to the ultimate, possibly able to tear through dimensions and shatter space, Jack felt that at least he needed to enhance them to top-tier or even stronger to achieve that possibility..

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 225: Innate Awakened One Jack
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Chapter 225: Innate Awakened One Jack
Clark, Bloodline Physique, Trinity
Translator: 549690339
Actually, Jack Clark was also an Innate Awakened One.
It was just that his innate awakening ability was his soul, and he had split half of it off to become a Six-legged Salamander.
And this split wasn’t just a simple Avatar, it was as if a ‘Person’ split in two, becoming two independent yet fundamentally connected special beings.
Compared to the soul split of the original body, the Six-legged Salamander had
also innately awakened, acquiring the ability to evolve, and this innate evolution ability was complete.
Moreover, with the half of the original body’s innate talent blessing it, this was why the Giant Beast Body’s strength was improving at a pace far exceeding that of the human body.
Had it not been for Jack Clark’s soul power condensing in his previous life, forming what he perceived as the attribute page, the gap between the human body and the Giant Beast would have been even greater.
To this situation, Jack didn’t really mind, because both were him.
Moreover, considering his rate of strength increase, it was actually terrifying.
In half a year, he had traversed the path that took many geniuses several to over a decade, and it was getting faster.
It was just that compared to the growth of the Thunderflame Beheamoth, the progress on the original body’s side seemed ‘slower’.
Glancing at the remaining eight hundred-plus Attribute Points, Jack hummed softly, his gaze settling on the fully-realized Hidden God Method.
This time, as the Thunderflame Beheamoth grew to a creature near Monarch level, there wasn’t much feedback to the original body in terms of strength, but there were still some changes, such as a subtle pervasive aura of fierceness.
Under one soul, this terrifying pressure coming from a higher level of life was also present in Jack.
So it was necessary to disguise a bit, not to play the pig but to surprise when least expected and also to avoid some unnecessary trouble.
“Expend 500 Points Attribute, Limit Enhancement Hidden God Method.”
In an instant, the Secret Skill rune that had blended into Jack’s entire body emerged. Infused with the energy conversion from the attribute, it became increasingly complex, gradually forming a ‘Person’.
Buzz!
As the rune coalesced, a blurry black shadow emerged behind Jack, like an invisible, intangible ghost.
As this shadow formed from the runes merged into Jack, the savage aura around him receded instantly, and it even gave the impression of being partially hidden.
It seemed that even a slight turn of the eyes would overlook him.
Another complete rune. Jack’s gaze fell on the attribute page.
Rune: Hidden DeityJConceal own aura, reduce presence, actively activating can temporarily erase self-awareness]
“Erase self-awareness!”
Jack’s gaze flickered, and he subconsciously activated the rune; in an instant, he vanished without a sound.
Although still seated at the edge of the bed, even if one’s gaze fell on him, it would instinctively be disregarded.
This scene was somewhat similar to when Freya Louise had operated her
Cultivation Methods, but his ‘existence’ disappeared even more thoroughly, even touching upon the power of a rule.
“These runes obtained from the Limit Enhancement are mysterious.”
Many people have practiced the Hidden God Method, and plenty of High-level cultivators who had been practicing for decades or two had already mastered it to a grand accomplishment, up to the limit, condensing runes.
But Jack felt that the effect of their Hidden Deity Glyphs wasn’t as strong as his.
At least, the Secret Skill’s synopsis hadn’t mentioned that upon reaching the ultimate level of practice, one could completely erase one’s presence, albeit temporarily.
Once he made a move and exposed his aura, it would automatically go away, but it was still mysterious.
Just like his Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune, which was also more complete and complicated compared to that condensed by the creator of the Godly Dragon Elephant.
Jack had discovered this when deciphering the God Elephant Secret Book, as it seemed that the runes of the Cultivation Methods he enhanced to the limit with Attribute Points reached a theoretically perfect state.
After feeling the new rune’s function, Jack’s gaze then fell on the attributes of the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Avatar Body: Ancient Six-Horned Thunder Flame Emperor Beast
Level: Ancient Beast[Owning seven talents, activating the Unique Beast pseudo-Emperor with an ancient bloodline]
Physical Talent:
Strength+[Top-tier ]Defense+[Top-tier ]Agility+[ Senior ] Regeneration* [Senior ]Toxin+[Senior I
Transcendent Talent: Golden Flame+[Senior]Thunder[Senior]
Evolution Value: 17800/30000
Because of so many talents, the attribute page has become very simplistic, and when Jack’s consciousness focused on a certain talent, a remark automatically surfaced.
For example, the Golden Flame which had been enhanced to a Senior level had a constant temperature of ten thousand Celsius, with its energy amount quintupled and an even more extreme incineration effect.
The Thunder Talent was similar, several times stronger than at intermediate level, but this increase in power had not yet led to a ‘qualitative change’, lacking a Destroy Heaven and Earth effect.
It seemed to have something to do with the Thunderflame Emperor Beast not reaching ‘Emperor level’.
Even so, after this breakthrough to level eight and a second growth, the resulting preliminary fusion of the various talents significantly boosted the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s combat power.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast, which had just touched the edge of a Level 9
Giant Beast, now had a combat power on par with or even beyond a Level 9
Early Stage or Mid-Period Giant Beast, based on the fundamental fusion of several major talents.
As to who would fall in a real battle, only the combat would tell.
Compared to those just possessing a domain at Level 8, Level 9 Giant Beasts had talents that were already integrated, forming a much stronger domain, with greater power in their Gifted Power.
In such a case, the Level 8 Early Stage Thunderflame Beheamoth being a match for a Level 9 Giant Beast could be said to be freakishly powerful.
And approaching the Fifth Evolution, it had also accumulated almost two-thirds of the required Evolution Value. Next evolution should reach Level 9 Peak; then in one go, activating the ancient aura for a breakthrough to Mythical-level.
The Fifth Evolution might be quite astonishing..

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 225: Innate Awakened One Jack Clark, Physique, Bloodline, Trinity_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Chapter 225: Innate Awakened One Jack Clark, Physique, Bloodline, Trinity_2
Translator: 549690339
The next morning, as soon as Jack Clark opened the door, he encountered Gwen Gail looking for Mathilda Ward.
The girl was dressed in a pink sleeveless long dress that reached her knees, with an outer layer of transparent pink pleated tulle, exuding youth and beauty.
Especially the pair of white fox ears on her head, they looked cute and charming as she hopped and skipped past Jack Clark with light steps.
Huh!
Gwen Gail stopped as she brushed past Jack Clark, a look of confusion crossing her face as she turned back and said, “That’s strange, how come I didn’t notice you just now, Brother Callum?”
With sunglasses on, Jack Clark replied calmly, “I’ve had some breakthroughs with my Concealing Breath Secret Method.”
“That explains it, to think I didn’t notice such a big person standing right here,” the fox-eared girl realized, then curiously added.
“Brother Callum, what Secret Skill are you practicing? It feels pretty amazing.”
Jack Clark casually replied, “Just the usual Hidden God Method, but like Cultivation Methods, its effect varies from person to person. In my hands, it’s just slightly stronger.”
“It does seem that way,” nodded the fox-eared girl, still feeling that something was off.
During their conversation, the two of them arrived at Mathilda Ward’s next-door suite, where the fox-eared girl bounced into the bedroom and called out, “Sister Ilisa, I want to go with you to try on the dresses.”
“Sure, you look so pretty, Gwen. Wearing those stage dresses you’ll look even more beautiful.”
“Hee hee, thank you for the compliment, Sister Ilisa. Though 1 feel you’re even more beautiful,” she said.
After Gwen Gail entered the bedroom, Jack Clark remained in the living room and flipped open the God Elephant Secret Book while sitting on the sofa.
The Spatial Channel was already complete, now it was time to continue deriving the secrets of the book.
He planned to directly enhance his attributes and breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven soon, and as long as he enhanced the Secret Skills faster, he could soon break through the Eight but even the Nine Layers.
As for the Summoning Secret Skill, he would see after deriving the Seventh Layer’s methods.
By then, the Thunderflame Behemoth should have grown to Level 9, touching upon the divine rules, while the projection of the Emperor level Level 9 Giant Beast would then be his second trump card.
However, as soon as Jack Clark’s consciousness sank into the secret space, in the empty white world, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils slowly appeared.
They were unmistakably the Void Double Pupils.
At this moment, the Double Pupils manifested through his Spiritual Will, and when Jack Clark looked towards the Godly Dragon Elephant’s figure, the entire rune structure magnified in his view.
Under observation akin to that of a microscope with a hundred thousand times magnification, the deeper layers of the rune structure’s information appeared simpler and more understandable to Jack Clark’s eyes.
This was the so-called “seeing through falsehoods to gaze directly at the essence” mentioned in the notes.
About an hour later, Mathilda Ward and Gwen Gail finally came out from the bedroom and called out to the Jack absorbed in the Secret Book, “Brother Callum, we’re going to have breakfast first.”
“Hmm,” Jack’s eyes, with the Black Gold vertical pupils slowly disappearing, closed the Secret Book, and stood up.
The fox-eared girl exclaimed, “Just for a while and Brother Callum is already contemplating the Secret Book. You’re really dedicated to your cultivation.” Compared to Jack, Gwen Gail found two hours of daily practice to be dull and boring, and she would often rather play with her mobile phone or stroll with her fox beast.
Mathilda Ward smiled slightly, “That’s why Brother Callum is successful, never missing any chance to strengthen himself and slowly building up until a tower is formed from grains of sand.”
Jack just smiled in response to Mathilda Ward’s compliment and said nothing.
Although several factors contributed to his current status, his consistent effort since stepping onto the path of cultivation—continually practicing and battling without a moment’s slack—couldn’t be denied.
Of course, hard work was important, but that little bit of talent (attribute page, Giant Beast Avatar) was also crucial.
When the trio reached the dining room, they saw Damon Lopes in a Daoist robe, sitting at a table, eating breakfast while laughing foolishly at his mobile phone.
At this sight, Jack Clark couldn’t help but cough and chide, “Mr. Lopes, mind your image a bit. You’re an Innate Awakened One, can you not laugh so sleazily?”
“Alt… Really?”
Finding himself under the peculiar gaze of Mathilda Ward and Gwen Gail, Damon Lopes quickly sat upright, and his demeanor turned serious once again, regaining his air of suave detachment.
Damon Lopes greeted them warmly, “Sister Ilisa, Sister Moon, good morning.” The fox-eared girl giggled, “Good morning, Mr. Lopes. Were you just chatting with those beauties?”
“No, no, I was discussing life with them,” said Damon Lopes seriously, trying to maintain his image in front of the beautiful girls.
Jack sat down next to Damon Lopes, his eyes briefly scanning over the ‘sexy’ pictures and chat conversations on Damon’s phone, giving him a peculiar look.
The kind of “life” you’re discussing must be about ‘giving life’, I guess.
Just then, a black sedan pulled up slowly downstairs, and two young men in black military clothes stepped out carrying a black gold box.
Sizzle!!
A buzz of electricity came through Jack’s earpiece, followed by the receptionist’s voice, “Mr. Callum, there are two military Special Service Personnel downstairs looking for you.”
Jack’s gaze shifted subtly, “Please, ask them to come up, I’ll be waiting in the I7th-floor dining room.”
“All right.”
Soon, under the guidance of the hotel staff, the two imposing Special Service Personnel made their way up.
Jack Clark was already waiting at the door, and on seeing the Special Service Personnel, he courteously said, “Thanks for taking the trouble to deliver this personally.”
The leading young man replied solemnly, “No need for courtesy, Mr. Callum. Now, let’s proceed with the handover.”
With that, the three of them moved to the dining area, where one of the personnel connected to the network to record while the other solemnly placed the black gold case on the table, infusing it with True Strength..

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 225: Innate Awakened One Jack
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Chapter 225: Innate Awakened One Jack
Clark, Bloodline Physique, Trinity_3
Translator: 549690339
Click! Accompanied by a unique True Power Aura, the black box opened, revealing two top-tier Secret Manuals made from white jade.
“Mr. Callum, please start the verification.”
“Okay.”
Jack nodded, picked up one of the Secret Manuals, and, following the standard procedure, first channeled his True Strength and will into it. The edge of the Secret Manual immediately flickered with light as an electronic-mechanical voice came out.
“Mid-stage Sixth-level Heaven, True Strength intensity is confirmed.”
“Mental Fluctuation verification passed… Key verification passed.”
Next was the second Secret Manual. Under the curious gaze of the audience, Jack quickly completed the unlocking of both manuals, after which two special service personnel formally saluted.
“Handover complete, Mr. Callum. We have another assignment and must take our leave now.”
“Let me see you out.”
Jack politely escorted the two special service personnel out of the restaurant.
Gwen Gail’s white fox ears twitched atop her head as she looked on excitedly: “This is the first time I’ve seen a Secret Manual handover. It seems so serious.”
Mathilda Ward laughed softly: “That’s normal, such strictness is meant to protect the Secret Manuals and also to show respect for the knowledge of those pioneers.”
“Every individual capable of creating their own Secret Manual and forging a new path possesses great perseverance and wisdom.”
“Even though due to updates and succession, many Secret Manuals from twenty or thirty years ago can’t compare to those created by Ninth Heaven experts, their achievements cannot be denied.”
“Without those pioneers, the successors wouldn’t be able to stand on the shoulders of giants and reach even further.”
“Miss Ward makes a good point.”
Returning, Jack nodded: “Creating a Secret Manual from scratch is as tough as ascending the heavens. The more 1 deduce recently, the more admiration I feel for the predecessors.”
Jack’s tone was very sincere as he spoke these words because he truly admired those people.
Without them perfecting the recent True Martial Cultivation system, structure, and overall guidelines, it would have taken him at least a year or more to construct and infer his own True Martial Secret Canon.
No, it may even have taken several years to have any hope.
Now, with three Secret Manuals as references and absorbing their essence, he was confident he could quickly deduce and create the Seventh Layer Secret Manual.
After breakfast, the group of four arrived backstage at the Blue and White Porcelain Stadium.
Although he had visited during the past few days, and with the safety assurance from Hannah Gail, Jack still went first into the wardrobe room and looked around.
After making sure there were no issues, Jack then turned and nodded slightly to Mathilda.
Gwen Gail didn’t feel offended by this precaution, but instead praised: “Brother Callum, if I hadn’t known that you joined the path midway, I would think you were a professional internal countermeasure member of the military.”
“Always maintain vigilance, never slacken.”
“Miss Gail overpraises me, this is what I should do,” Jack replied.
At this moment, Damon Lopes chuckled: “Brother Callum, 1’11 leave this place to you, I’m going to take a walk around.”
Jack nodded indifferently: “Go ahead.”
Since his responsibilities differed from Damon’s, he had no complaints about his behavior of wandering around all day.
While the two women headed to the changing rooms with the help of a costume designer to try on their stage dresses, Jack found a chair to sit and took out the Bull Devil Battle Body Secret Manual from Berlin.
As Jack’s consciousness sank, black gold vertical pupils appeared in a dim space.
This space was empty, except for the hundred-meter-tall Furious Ape that stood tall in the void and the surrounding Secret Manual’s main texts that floated in the air.
A True Martial Practitioner constructing a complete rune during the breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven would, through the resonance with Heaven and Earth, form a complete ‘external avatar.’
That is the true martial arts phantom.
That was an external Dharma body containing the path of cultivators, filled with the majestic energy of Heaven and Earth, capable of unleashing immense power.
However, the cultivators from Berlin who followed the path of genetic martial arts through the fusion of Alien Beast genes were different.
Their path involved integrating martial arts with purifying the bloodline for breakthroughs; hence, when they broke through to the Seventh Layer, they did not manifest a true martial arts phantom, but instead underwent a reverse transformation into the form of a Giant Beast.
Of course, this transformation wasn’t about becoming a Giant Beast; if that were the case, it would be more convenient to simply tame a Level 7 Colossus.
This kind of transformation was a fusion of man and beast, embodying the strength and talent of a Giant Beast while retaining a human form, becoming a more perfect and powerful life form.
This Secret Book addressed the resolution of conflicts among four types of Giant Beast bloodline talents and also included the secrets to the third body enhancement during the Seventh Layer breakthrough, which caught Jack Clark’s eye.
Howard Lambert’s Bull Devil Battle Body and his Divine Tyrant Body were both results of a secondary physique transformation, which endowed them with battle power far beyond their realms, unrivaled in their dominion.
If Jack could undergo another transformation of his physique, his combat power would climb to another level.
However, the third transformation Secret Skill in this book had stringent demands, requiring a primary Essence Blood of an Eighth Level Beast of the same type, supplemented by three portions of Essence Blood from Level 7 Colossi.
This was also the core for harmonizing the four Giant Beast talents.
By ingesting the Essence Blood of an Eighth Level Beast of the same type, one could further enhance the core talent power, while the three portions of Essence Blood from Level 7 beasts would be inscribed all over the body in the form of runes, absorbing a part of their talent power as a supplementary measure.
This requirement was, for most cultivators, tantamount to a dead end.
Under normal conditions, a Sixth-Layer cultivator trying to refine a portion of Eighth Level Beast Essence Blood would have to go all out in operating their Cultivation Methods, otherwise, their flesh would be ‘poisoned’ through.
Let alone simultaneously absorbing a portion of Eighth Level Beast Essence Blood and inscribing corresponding runes outside the body with three portions of Level 7 Beast Essence Blood.
Nevertheless, this didn’t seem to be a problem for Jack.
Because he only needed the talent of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the conflicts between internal and external use were not significant. The issue was that these were runes related to the Seventh Layer of genetic martial arts, which could not be used carelessly.
After reading the outline of the Eight-Arm Divine Ape Secret Manual, Jack slowly set down the book, pondered for a while, and then took out the Star Sky Battle Beast Mechanism.
He wanted to take a look at the outlines of the two Secret Manuals to see which structures and concepts were useful for him, choosing selectively to comprehend part of their essence.
In contrast to Eastern Summer and Berlin, Simon, who integrated Mecha, took another path altogether.
Their cultivators regarded themselves as ‘engines and operating systems,’ combining technological martial arts with a mechanical ascension path.
In the past when technology was advancing, there were many fantastical conjectures that were all but shelved due to issues with energy utilization, material constraints, power output, and other various problems.
With the dawn of the New Era, many of the problems that had constrained technological advancement were no longer issues.
Even spaceships were being manufactured, though their current speeds were not fast enough to rapidly journey beyond the star system, which is why the exploration of the cosmos was temporarily put on hold.
Quickly finishing the overview of the Star Sky Battle Beast Mechanism, Jack’s eyes faintly stirred.
Within this Mechanism manual, the cultivation method discussed ‘refinement’ of space, establishing it as a ‘world’ of power storage, which sparked his interest.
The so-called establishment of a world referred to the construction of two or more energy-storing worlds within the external equipment of the Mecha parts, similar to batteries.
Yet, due to being inscribed with spatial storage runes, and combined with talent abilities and materials, this ‘battery’ could store massive amounts of special energy.
Like two worlds possessing the power of Thunder or Flame, they could grant the Star Sky Battle Beast Mechanism terrifying bursts and sustained endurance.
As one strengthened and cultivated step by step to the Ninth Heavens, those two energy worlds could even integrate with domains to form a Star Domain, possessing strong gravitational gravity like that of celestial bodies.
The downside was, wanting everything meant Jack had to scrap what he had already half-conceived in his foundational Secret Book.
And, wanting to base it on Eastern Summer’s True Martial core, integrating parts of genes and some Mecha concepts was a massive challenge, nearly impossible.
This was an idea not unknown to the Federal top level; in fact, the top martial arts experts had studied it.
For example, the inspiration behind True Martial Arts absorbing Essence Blood from Unique Beasts to strengthen the body and even change the physique came from genetic martial arts, and some Transcendent Weapons originated from Mecha battle bodies.
But Jack was the first to be as greedy as this.
If it had been before strengthening his Void Double Pupils, Jack might have thought about it and then given up, as the difficulty was too great, and it wasn’t worth wasting so much time on.
But now… “True martial arts phantom, bloodline quality transformation, external mountings.”
Jack narrowed his eyes slightly, a bold idea emerging in his mind..

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 226: Thunder Ring Magnetic Field, Space-based Destruction, Cross-Boundary Strike
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Chapter 226: Thunder Ring Magnetic Field, Space-based Destruction, Cross-Boundary Strike
Translator: 549690339
Just as Jack Clark’s Void Double Pupils unfolded, and he concentrated on analyzing the third qualitative change, ‘world’ assembly, and deduced how to integrate it with the Combat Divine Body version 2.0.
In the depths of the ocean, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had gone into a killing frenzy.
Two thousand meters deep on the seabed, over the course of one night, after killing and devouring five Level 7 Colossi, the body length of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had grown to a formidable seventy-six meters.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast stood upright, its body ablaze with a golden fire that burnt everything in its path, and thunder leapt about its back, emitting an extremely ferocious and terrifying aura.
Under the eruption of golden flames, it created a purple plasma shockwave, forcing back the surrounding seawater to form a vacuum area of about one hundred meters beneath the ocean, as the nearby sea water boiled and churned endlessly.
Hundreds of meters away, floating in the sea, was a giant dragon more than eighty meters long, covered entirely in gray scale armor.
This colossal dragon had evolved completely, with sturdy limbs, a fierce dragon head, and thick dorsal fins on its back as substantial as gray reef rocks.
However, there were some differences between this dragon beast and Scythia, for instance, its double wings were not positioned on its back but rather were connected beneath its armpits and to its foreclaws.
Besides that, the dragon’s head was much smaller, and there were bands of blue light undulating beneath its neck, exuding the powerful aura of a Level 8 Mid Stage beast.
Yet at this moment, the larger and slightly higher-leveled dragon faced the Thunderflame Emperor Beast as if confronting a formidable enemy, its mouth constantly emitting warning growls.
From the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, it sensed a powerful oppression of bloodline hierarchy.
All of a sudden, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast let out a roaring growl, “I am the Dragon Palace Thunderflame Emperor, Tim Abbott, Brock Abbott. Now you have two choices, submit to me or die.”
Appreciating that this Eighth Level Beast possessed a Dragon Bloodline, the Thunderflame Beast did not attack immediately but considered whether it could be subdued.
It had already tasted the benefits of having many subordinates; many things became much simpler after expanding its territory and amassing numerous followers.
Yet, when faced with the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s attempt at recruitment, the gray giant dragon responded only with a growl and then, with a thunderous roar, turned around and burst through the water, attempting to flee.
Roar! Courting death.
Watching the gray giant dragon shoot out hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye, a wave of murderous intent surged within the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast. The seabed exploded beneath it, sending a shower of mud and rocks flying.
Boom!
The reactionary force from its Agility Talent burst forth, propelling the Thunderflame Emperor Beast away at a terrifying speed, carving a tunnel of destruction through the seabed to appear a kilometer away in an instant.
Roar!
Seeing the black-red colossal beast that appeared behind it in an instant, the gray giant dragon let out a roar of shock and rage.
Under the intense threat of death, the gray giant dragon erupted with a powerful surge, instantly forming a two-hundred-meter-wide Rejection Domain around itself.
Within this domain, everything was repelled, including the oppressive deep-sea water, turning into violent torrents that crashed fiercely against the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
But all these efforts simply could not shake the terrifyingly powerful Thunderflame Emperor Beast, whose fierce body instantly burst through the Rejection Domain to appear behind the gray giant dragon.
On its right claw shone a golden light, and with one strike, the very void distorted under the tyrannical force, as several dark cracks appeared.
But just then, a burst of gray radiance exploded from the giant dragon.
Whoosh!
Under the gray light, everything petrified; the air solidified, the sea water crackled, including the descending claw of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and even the space around it.
In an instant, a span of hundreds of meters turned into a piece of ‘stone,’ with only the giant dragon that emitted a gray light remaining unaffected.
However, just as it petrified the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the gray giant dragon did not think of counter-attacking, instead, its wings burst open, propelling it upwards with an even more amazing speed.
Just then, streaks of golden light gleamed from the Thunderflame Beast’s body, piercing through the rock; under the horrifying heat, its surface and the surrounding stone instantly dissolved into flowing magma.
Boom!
The ‘stone’ hundreds of meters in diameter exploded violently, shattering into countless fragments that blasted outward as lava churned and flames spewed forth.
Golden Thunderflame Light enveloped it; the Thunderflame Emperor Beast watched as the gray giant dragon sped away a kilometer in the blink of an eye, its eyes reflecting a trace of surprise.
For so long in its existence, its Agility Talent was the first to be restrained and obstructed by the abilities of another Extraordinary Creature.
Under that stone-petrifying force which altered the structure of matter, even in its swift state, it could not escape, and even the Kinetic Energy it carried was petrified.
This Talent Ability was potent, probably the awakened Dragon Talent of the beast.
Unfortunately, this giant dragon was too low in intelligence.
Amidst its regret, the mouth of the Thunderflame Beast opened wide, emitting a blinding radiance while the surrounding thunder gathered and condensed, forming four circular Thunder Rings in front and behind it.
Boom!
A golden light beam, compressed from endless scorching Golden Flame, shot forth, carrying the terror of total destruction.
And when the Golden Flame Breath passed through the four Thunder Rings, it became even more concentrated, turning into a one-meter thick golden light beam that pierced through the seabed.
Everything in the beam’s path was obliterated by the light, vaporized, with the destructive impact’s roaring thunder shaking the ocean floor.
In an instant, the gray giant dragon, having dashed over a kilometer, was overwhelmed by panic, letting out a roar of terror as the threat of death made every ounce of its strength burst forth.
Hum!
Under the dazzling gray energy, everything around it turned to stone, solidified, forming a white small hill over three hundred meters in diameter.
This was another application of the giant dragon’s Petrification Talent: it used the origin power of its talent to petrify all surrounding matter, forming a boulder more solid than alloy to cover itself.
Biu!
The super-condensed golden light beam struck the massive rock, and in an instant, the stone visibly melted, with the surrounding magma boiling and flames erupting..

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 226: Thunder Ring Magnetic Field, Space-based Destruction, Cross-Boundary Strike_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Chapter 226: Thunder Ring Magnetic Field, Space-based Destruction, Cross-Boundary Strike_2
Translator: 549690339 |
Boom!
The light beam pierced through the alloyed rocks and the gray giant dragon, hitting a mountain peak over two thousand meters away.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Heaven and Earth shook, the scorching laser’s impact force caused half of the mountain peak to collapse, magma erupted, and sea water boiled, creating circles of destructive fiery shockwaves.
Instantly, the corpses of countless marine life within a kilometer appeared, their bodies glowing red, tumbling in the raging sea water.
At this moment, the glow from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s mouth slowly extinguished, its feet standing on magma, its vertical pupils cold, as if it were a ferocious primordial beast coming from the wild, extreme brutality and violence incarnate.
The high-order Golden Flame and Thunder Talent not only were more powerful but also had some special abilities.
For instance, the Thunder Ring just now which was condensed from thunder had a function similar to an electromagnetic heating ring, forming a heavy pressure acceleration magnetic field concentrated with Thunderbolt Power.
When the Golden Flame Breath passed through the heavy pressure magnetic field, the already scorching energy of Golden Flame would be further compressed and accelerated, turning into a piercing laser beam.
Because the speed was too fast and the power too great, the Level 8 Middle Phase Dragon Blood Beast, over a thousand meters away, was instantly killed, without a chance to even dodge.
In the boiling and rolling seawater, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast approached that huge ‘stone.’
Boom! With one stomp, the Thunderflame Behemoth shattered the giant rock, revealing the gray giant dragon corpse with a punctured head inside.
Grasping the dragon’s wings and neck, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s ferocious maw cracked the dragon scales, and flesh and blood flew as it tore off a hundred tons of flesh and blood and started devouring.
Immediately, numerous remnants of flesh and blood seeped through the gaps in its teeth, floating with the sea water, malting the black-red colossal beast appear utterly savage.
As the Level 8 dragon creature’s flesh and blood were devoured, the scorching biological energy radiated from the stomach area, and the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body visibly grew at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After about two hours, the Level 8 giant dragon had been completely eaten by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, leaving only some large remnants like the spine.
These dragon spines had turned into crystalline stones under the effect of Petrification Talent and had become stone-like Super Alloy, consuming them would do little more than irritate the teeth without converting to much biological energy.
After devouring this Level 8 dragon creature, the body of the Thunderflame Behemoth swelled up directly to a size of seventy-nine meters, touching the mid period of Level 8.
Feeling a sense of fullness within its body, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast let out a satisfied roar.
After lying dormant for over twenty days and undergoing growth twice, its body was very ‘lacking’ in energy, which is why this growth spurt was so exaggerated, almost gaining ten meters in one breath.
Besides its size, the mad consumption of Evolution value also yielded more than 1,000 points, approaching twenty thousand.
However, as its body grew larger and denser, its demand for energy also increased, the energy required for each meter of growth was dozens of times w’hat it was at Level 7-
“Roar! Time to go back.”
