With a crack, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast snapped off two grey, spiral dragon horns, each four meters long and as big as a house, from the dragon’s head.
These dragon horns, condensed from the entirety of the gray giant dragon s strength, were not only High-Order Extraordinary Materials but also contained some inscriptions related to the Petrification Talent.
Once taken back and tempered with Golden Flame to extract the essence, it could be sold to the officials for about more than 1,000 Contribution Points.
Jack Clark’s speculation of ‘Peerless True Martial’ needed a large number of Contribution Points to exchange for Transcendent Materials, so he would have to put some effort into ‘himself.’
Also, once the Dragon Turtles awaken, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast plans to expand its Territory, sweeping through the ocean.
At this time, it could even fight a Level 9 Giant Beast, no longer needing to be as cautious as before, allowing it to let loose and have a grand battle.
Of course, it wasn’t blindly overconfident and knew that it wasn’t yet a match for those Late Stage 9 or peak Giant Beasts.
Not to mention those Mythical Giant Beasts lurking in the Deep Sea Forbidden Areas.
However, once it grew to Level 9 and all Seven Talents were upgraded to the top-tier, even the Mythical Giant Beasts wouldn’t be too much to wrestle with.
Uh?
At that moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast looked up at the sea surface, a trace of surprise showing in its golden vertical pupils.
Through the blurry perception of its three pairs of feather horns, a massive entity approached from afar on the sea surface, emitting a buzzing sound as it disturbed the water.
Compared to the ability to sense electromagnetic waves over two thousand meters, the feather horns’ sensitivity to water currents could sometimes be more acute, sensing strong disturbances in the sea from an even further distance.
“Report, No. 13 Physical Satellite has reached its intended orbit.”
“Report, the Cloud Sea-level Wind and Thunder Warship is expected to arrive at the designated location in thirty-five minutes, with the Phoenix Energy Bomber on board ready to launch at any time.”
Fifth Coastal Military Base of the Federation, Command Center.
Brian Roberts stood at the command platform, his gaze deep as he looked at the simulated ocean map on the big screen, and said solemnly, “What about the target’s status?”
“The target has not moved from its current location, situated seven kilometers southeast of the reference point on the desert island, roughly seven hundred meters underwater on the seabed.”
“Through energy spectrum analysis, it has been determined that the Level 9 Giant Beast is currently in a state of recovery.”
“The target is exhibiting intense energy fluctuations, and the Signal Transmitter attached to its scale armor is being eroded by energy, likely to fail within an hour.”
“Once that happens, we will no longer be able to track this Level 9 Giant Beast with precision, and the operation must be completed within an hour.”
Looking at the 140-plus-meter long giant model of the ferocious behemoth on the big screen, identical to a small hill, Brian Roberts’s gaze turned icy, “An hour will be enough.”
This very morning, the Level 9 Giant Beast attacked coastal cities of the Skywind Nation, causing tens of thousands of casualties and great panic, before being swiftly repelled by the strong human responders..

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 226: Thunder Ring Magnetic Field, Space-based Destruction, Cross-Boundary Strike_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Chapter 226: Thunder Ring Magnetic Field, Space-based Destruction, Cross-Boundary Strike_3
Translator: 549690339 |
Only because it was by the seaside, when the nearest Ninth Heaven Expert of the Human Race rushed over, the Giant Beast that felt his Aura from afar turned around and fled back into the ocean.
Brian Roberts said coldly, “Keep a close watch on the target’s status, instruct the Sky Base weapons to start charging.”
“As soon as the Wind-Thunder Battleship reaches the designated location, launch the Sky-based Strike immediately and take it down.”
Whether to intimidate those highly intelligent marine creatures or to avenge those who have died, the Giant Beast had to die today.
“Yes.”
Amid the hustle of the staff below, in outer space, a satellite shaped like the Eight Diagrams with wings spanning over five hundred meters, slowly moved.
At the same time, within the satellite, a thirty-meter-thick transparent gun barrel cracked open slowly, revealing a ten-meter-long, 0.5-meter-thick ‘bullet’ covered with Rune Patterns.
Whir!
The four pairs of unfolded ‘wings’ radiated golden light from the engraved Rune Patterns, forming circles of golden light that diffused out, exerting a strong gravity.
In an instant, sunlight from tens of kilometers around converged, and at the same time, within the Sky Base Satellite, Huge Stellar Energy absorbed and stored daily was activated.
Wooong!
Under the drive of nuclear fusion-like intense energy, section by section of the gun barrel lit up, and in an instant, an aura of terrifying power spread far and wide.
On the back of the Eight Diagrams energy-gathering wings, the Runes that shielded the Aura also emitted light, casting a subtle fluctuation that covered the energy waves initiated by the activation of the Sky Base Satellite.
As a Level 9 Giant Beast that had evolved to the pinnacle of Transcendent Life, it possessed a strong Innate sense of danger.
If the Sky Base Satellite did not conceal the energy convergence fluctuations before attacking, even the vastness of space would trigger their alertness ahead of time.
Therefore, these Sky Base Satellites hanging in space orbits not only possess powerful attacks but also have companion stealth technology to conceal energy fluctuations before deployment.
These were the experiences accumulated by the Federation over many years.
Half an hour later, a steel Battleship over three hundred meters long appeared twenty kilometers from the desert island.
In the middle of the deck, there was a black fighter aircraft with a wingspan of over sixty meters, filled with a sci-fi style, with its pilots already in place.
In the Command Center, Brian Roberts said in a deep voice, “Connect to the
Wind-Thunder Battleship.”
“Wind-Thunder Battleship, please respond if you hear this.”
“Wind-Thunder has received.”
“Launch the Sky-based Strike in one minute, and the Phoenix Energy Bomber will take off at the same time.”
“Yes.”
The power of the Sky-based Strike was immense, but these Level 9 Giants were equally formidable, with tenacious Vitality and a myriad of Talent Abilities.
Therefore, every ambush against a Level 9 Giant Beast was planned with a contingency in place.
“Countdown begins, 10, 9, 8… Attack!”
Following the command, the Sky Base Satellite in outer space orbit, fully charged, emitted a blinding radiance.
Boom!
A ten-meter-thick beam of red light descended from beyond the sky, and the formidable energy dissipating invisibly caused the atmosphere to disperse instantly, creating a Hollow several kilometers in diameter.
Next came the thermosphere, the mesosphere, the stratosphere, and as the light column descended more and more rapidly, the very front bullet’ even turned into a dazzling light.
From afar, a vertical beam of light connecting heaven and earth slowly descended, with atmospheric layers swirling around it, a spectacular and magnificent sight.
And as the Sky Base Satellite’s attack descended from the sky and penetrated the atmosphere.
Below the sea over 700 meters deep, a creature shaped like a Bow-back Armored Dragon with a body length of more than 140 meters suddenly rose up, letting out an enraged roar.
It sensed a strong feeling of crisis, yet it did not know where that scent of death was coming from.
Roar, roar, roar!!
In its terror, the Level 9 Giant Beast let out a ferocious roar, and the strength that shook Heaven and Earth centered on it, forming a tremendous domain with a radius of 500 meters.
Boom!
In the wild impact of the domain, the sea surface arched and exploded, creating a vast vortex centered around the Bow-back Armored Dragon, affecting an area of over a thousand meters.
As the sea water formed a vortex revealing the sky above, the Bow-back Armored Dragon abruptly looked up, its eyes filled with shock and fury at the dazzling light approaching rapidly from above.
At this moment, the Sky-based Strike was still tens of thousands of meters away, but the invisible wave of destruction had already made the Bow-back Armored Dragon sense the breath of death.
Roar! The ocean burst into action instantly, and a hundred-meter-thick water column shot up into the sky, attempting to intercept the light column. Simultaneously, the seabed beneath the Bow-back Armored Dragon crumbled as its enormous body shot hundreds of meters away with a thunderous blast.
As a Level 9 Giant Beast, it possessed no small measure of intelligence and naturally wouldn’t stupidly stand still waiting for the destructive attack to land.
But just at that moment, as the light column already present at ten thousand meters altitude slightly tilted, in a flash it appeared above the Bow-back Armored Dragon’s head, piercing through Heaven and Earth.
Bang! The sea surface trembled under the laser light column gathered by Huge Stellar Energy, instantly vaporizing countless sea water, followed by striking the domain below that spanned five hundred meters.
Boom!
Under the intense energy explosion, the ‘bullet’ emitting dazzling firelight penetrated the domain, shattering the thick scale armor of the Bow-back Dragon that even missiles couldn’t destroy.
Right after, the interior was activated by crystal energy wrapped around a mix of Hydrogen Bomb and Transcendent Crystal Bomb materials.
Boom!
The sea surface collapsed inward instantaneously, the ground shook, and the dazzling light of a nuclear explosion rose from the seabed, forming a thousand-meter-tall mushroom fireball, spanning several kilometers.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The apocalyptic explosion lifted a hundred-meter-high tsunami, and the desert island kilometers away shook madly, the earth fractured, and half of the island collapsed under the terrifying power.
Such a fearsome destructive force made the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, positioned dozens of kilometers away with its head just slightly above the sea surface and having witnessed the strike from the sky, look stern.
What terrifying power, is this the might of Sky Base weapons!!
If this strike were to hit the ground, the unleashed destructive force and shockwave could completely destroy a medium-sized city-utterly obliterate it.
Meanwhile, when Satellite No. 13 on the physical side initiated its attack.
In the far-off dark space beyond, a massive celestial body with a diameter of more than ten kilometers floated slowly.
On a kilometer-long cantilever of that celestial body, stood a hundred-meter-tall Black-gold Meeh, quietly observing the light that lit up on the planet below.
“This is the fourth time this year that the planet’s internal Sky Base Satellites have been activated, which is much more frequent than in previous years. It seems the ocean situation is getting more and more severe.”
“Don’t you Eastern Summer have a saying, ‘to guard against the external, you must first secure the internal’? Shouldn’t we propose a major cleansing of the ocean?”
“No need, the ocean is vast in three dimensions, and the Mutated Creatures are innumerable. Even summoning a dozen king-level returns could not exterminate these Giant Beasts.”
“After all, once they reach the Peak of Level 9 and touch that barrier, they will instinctually head to the mythical world; there’s no need to bother with them.” “The frontline situation is tense at the moment, and the Human Race has shifted its focus there. Last month, they even notified us to prepare for a cross-boundary strike..”

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 227: Combat Divine Body 2.0, Monarch Essence Blood, Merging with Myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Chapter 227: Combat Divine Body 2.0, Monarch Essence Blood, Merging with Myself
Translator: 549690339
Beneath the surging waves, the black-red colossal beast glanced at the Phoenix Bird fighter aircraft flying around the explosion center in the sky, then its figure sank and disappeared.
It wasn’t interested in what creature the Federation’s Sky Base Satellites had killed or how strong that black spot that jumped from the fighter aircraft was.
Even if it were interested, it wouldn’t matter, as it couldn’t get close.
With its current level and body size, it would be detected by radar within a few kilometers of a battleship, unless it always lurked in the deep sea thousands of meters down.
Due to the dispersal of Heavenly Energy in the sea, the intense pressure and energy concentration in the deep sea greatly affect sonar detection and energy detection.
At present, the detection equipment on battleships can only discover giant creatures above one kilometer. Beyond that depth, everything is pitch black, and nothing can be detected.
Therefore, unless it revealed itself actively, it would be difficult for humans to discover the extraordinary giant beasts beneath the deep sea.
This was also one of the reasons why humans had given up on the deep sea.
It was also why the Thunderflame Beheamoth had built the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace more than a thousand meters under the sea—because it knew humans wouldn’t discover it.
Unless a human strong man personally dived down.
Beneath the deep sea, intense hot airwaves erupted behind the black-red colossal beast as if it were a torpedo missile speeding through the water, occasionally using its tail to make slight adjustments to its direction.
After acquiring the Golden Flame Eruption ability, the activities of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast under the sea became very convenient, and it no longer needed to swing its tail to burst forth power.
And this function of flame eruption wasn’t only for swimming; it also helped greatly in combat, making its Kinetic Energy even more powerful.
However, at this moment, the originally bold and confident Thunderflame Emperor Beast had become somewhat less arrogant after its talent enhancement.
It couldn’t help it, it was strong now, but the humans who had been developing for decades were stronger.
Not just high-level cultivation strong men, various powerful weapons also made the beasts wary, like the Sky-based Strike that just descended from the sky.
Although Jack had previously seen the description of the Sky Base strike’s power in the databank, its single-target destructive power was above that of the older nuclear weapons.
But witnessing it firsthand was completely different from the descriptions; the shocking impact made even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast extremely wary.
Because it couldn’t withstand it.
But although it couldn’t withstand it, such a long-range attack couldn’t reach it. With the Agility Talent like a short-distance instantaneous movement, even Level 9 giant beasts couldn’t catch up to it.
Although it’s also a ‘human,’ the Thunderflame Emperor Beast didn’t regard the Human Race as enemies, but humans didn’t know this.
So it still had to stay low-key and not attract human attention.
It needed to amass its strength over time and continue its development under the sea, waiting to make a breakthrough after reaching Level 9 before taking action.
More than two hours later, with the help of directions and its innate positioning, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, holding on to two dragon horns, arrived at the Coral Reef Forest where it once killed the Deep-sea Water Ape.
But the once magnificent Coral Reef Forest had long been reduced to ruins, with only a few patches of purple coral stubbornly emitting a faint glow.
Coming to the small hill that the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had dug open and then filled over, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast tossed the dragon horns to one side and then extended its double claws, with one swipe, hundreds of tons of broken rock and dirt were moved.
A passageway was quickly excavated.
Within the cave a few hundred meters below, slanting downward, countless corals emitting purple radiance grew, illuminating the entire cave into a purple world.
Some purple energy materials drifted with the sea water inside the cave.
“These purple energy substances are growing a bit slow,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast remarked with some disappointment as it looked at the sparse purple energy floating in the cave.
Actually, the ‘growth’ speed of these corals wasn’t slow at all; it had been just over a half-month since the last time they welcomed the Silver Giant Dragon to the Dragon Palace banquet.
But compared to the purple energy that once filled the entire cave, it now appeared very sparse.
Well, it seems that these energy plants aren’t thriving well enough.
“Forget it, having some is better than none; let’s make do for now.”
In a low growl, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast extended its right claw. Instantly, a current gathered the drifting energy materials around, converging at its right claw, followed by an intense burning of Golden Flame.
Woo-woo-woo!! Under the terrifyingly hot flames and immense pressure, the sand-like purple energy materials were continuously compressed and tempered.
Gradually, a fist-sized purple crystal appeared in the claws of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
After it evolved to level eight, its control over strength became even more powerful, and it could even spend time gathering and compressing the energy between Heaven and Earth into tangible crystals.
Of course, this method was time-consuming and laborious, an inefficient trade-off.
These purple energy materials, similar to pure energy, were very mild and could be directly absorbed and digested by Mutated Creatures; consuming them would provide growth benefits.
This type of pure energy was also effective for Jack; it could accelerate the increase of his True Strength and was even better than the effects of the Blue Crystal.
Meanwhile, as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast condensed the purple crystal.
At noon, in the wardrobe room behind the Blue and White Porcelain Stadium, Jack slowly closed the Secret Book in his hand, and a complex rune illusion in his eyes gradually dispersed.
After several hours of analysis, with the help of the Void Double Pupils, Jack had made significant progress, and the foundation of the newly constructed total outline of the Secret Book had taken shape.
At noon, in a corner of Green Mountain City.
In broken buildings, more than a dozen figures radiating powerful Auras were scattered around.
Next to these people stood several fox beasts, each over ten meters long and adding their tails, more than twenty meters in length, looking elegant and human-like in their intelligence.
One of them, covered in black scales and only thirteen meters long, stood behind Hannah Gail, its three pairs of white eyes exuding a strange light.
Under those three pairs of white eyes, nothing unusual could hide..

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 227 Combat Divine Body 2.0, Monarch Essence Blood, Merging into Myself_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 227 Combat Divine Body 2.0, Monarch Essence Blood, Merging into Myself_2
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, three heavily injured figures were lying on the ground, along with several smashed corpses, indicating that a crushing battle had just taken place here.
A middle-aged man with the aura of the Sixth Layer approached Hannah Gail and respectfully asked, “Young Master, how should we deal with these people?” Hannah Gail said indifferently, “Take them back for interrogation, tell Mr. Wheeler not to hold back, shake their spirit consciousness, and dig out all the useful information.”
“These rats from the gutter, dare to show up in the Hundred Foxes Nation and don’t expect to leave alive.”
Having said that, Hannah Gail turned and left with the Six-Eyed Black Fox.
He dared to assure Mathilda Ward that Green Mountain City would be absolutely safe during this period, and it was not a joke.
After decades, the Gail Family and the Hundred Foxes Nation’s research and cultivation of Unique Beasts, or specifically Fox-type Exotic Beasts, were no less than those in Berlin.
Especially under the influence of the power of a Mythical Giant Beast, they had bred many fox beasts with special talents, some with terrifying senses of smell, some with double eye mutations.
Some fox beasts could even perceive loyalty and treachery, similar to Jack Clark’s spiritual sense.
Together with high-tech coordination, the city-wide screening in recent days had caught many problematic individuals.
Wandering criminal cultivators, several spies from the Demon God Sect, ordinary cultists from the Blood God Sect who had infiltrated to expand their following, and an “eye” whose spirit had been corrupted.
In the afternoon, at the sports stadium, Mathilda Ward was discussing some details for tomorrow night’s concert with Marla Fiore and Crystal Boyce on stage.
In the audience seats below, Jack Clark was sitting quietly with a white book in his hands.
In the secret space, a phantom 30 meters tall, with three heads and six arms, and four flags on its back, covered in heavy battle armor, appeared.
Of the three heads of the spiritual projection, only the middle one, which bore a clear resemblance to Jack Clark and had a cold expression, was distinct; the other two heads were quite vague.
However, at present, those two heads were just decorative, which didn’t matter.
This was the new form of the Combat Divine Body that Jack Clark had re-inferred, with added battle armor and four flags on the back.
Those four flags drew reference from external configurations of Mechas, serving as storage for the future battle body’s strength.
One contained the Power of Thunder, one carried the strength of the Golden Flame, one embodied Super Regeneration, and one bore the deadly talent.
The six arms were similar to what he had previously conceived; the strongest pair of arms represented strength, and the remaining two pairs managed the four close flags during combat.
As for swiftness and defense, they were integrated with space constituting the body and the Divine Might of the Godly Dragon Elephant served as a disguise.
After referencing three Top-tier Secret Manuals, mastering the basics of space, the Seven Talents of the Thunderflame Beheamoth, and the rune talent of the Godly Dragon Elephant, Jack Clark’s ambitions grew significantly.
The true martial arts phantom of a Seventh Layer Heaven Cultivator gathers around the cultivator’s own body, using the Unique Beast Talent or other runes as a core to form an external incarnation representing the cultivator’s path.
The stronger and more substantial the gathered true martial arts phantom, the more and stronger the Heavenly Energy it can control.
A cultivator who has just made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven normally has a true martial arts phantom about 10 meters, or just over 3.58 meters, giving the cultivator the support of five times the Power of Heaven and Earth in every move.
This is just the basic enhancement of True Strength; in addition, there’s an attribute carried by the runes, which is the talent.
For instance, if the core of the condensed phantom possesses flames, the cultivator will receive extra flame damage during combat, with the power varying according to the rune’s integrity and the phantom’s strength.
The cultivation process of the Seventh Layer Heaven is about turning the intangible into the tangible, to “solidify” the true martial arts phantom into “reality,” so that by the Eight Layer Heaven the cultivator inhales massive amounts of Heavenly Energy into the body.
At this point, the cultivator will undergo a complete bodily reforge, similar to the breakthrough of an Eighth Level Beast, assimilating with Heaven and Earth.
At this stage, a cultivator is immensely powerful, with every move having the strength and talent comparable to an Eighth Level Beast, as well as possessing human Martial Arts and formidable True Strength.
In such a condition, an Eight Layer Expert can even be a few degrees stronger than a Giant Beast of the same level, with the external representation of the Martial Arts True Body possessing earth-shaking combat power.
Of course, this phantom is still in its basic immature form and Jack will need to perfect the overall structure bit by bit, resolving the conflicts of talents.
After all, this is a human body, not a Giant Beast Body.
Nevertheless, because he had borrowed ideas from Genetic Martial Arts, Jack could now begin working on a part of the Combat Divine Body after structuring the general outline.
For instance, his Third Physical Change.
Thinking of this, Jack slowly retracted his consciousness.
Looking at Mathilda Ward and the others on the stage, Jack pointed lightly near his ear, connected to the Heavenly Think Tank, and then clicked on the Resource Options.
“Ten Pleasure Crystal Stones, one batch of Demonic Crystal Inscription Powder, four pieces of Infinite Tree Bark, one bottle of True Illusion Marrow Fluid, totaling 2985 Contribution Points, after discount 1791 points.”
“Current account balance: 5 Contribution Points, insufficient for exchange.”
“Choose to pay later,” Jack selected another option.
As a genius with level six privileges, Jack had the right to use up to 2000 Contribution Points in advance.
If he could replenish the Contribution Points within half a month of using these resources in advance, it would be fine; overdue would affect his credibility, so normally Jack would not consider using this privilege.
Previously there had been no need, but now it was different.
“Supplies have been allocated at the Green Mountain City Federal Logistics Base, please select delivery time and address.”
“Tonight at 8 o’clock, White Cloud Hotel.”
Looking at the “-1786” on his account balance, Jack’s gaze remained calm.
The materials including the Demonic Crystal Inscription Powder and True Illusion Marrow Fluid were intended to neutralize the essence blood of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and to be used as rune ink for inscribing the entire body of the battle armor.
The Pleasure Crystal Stones and Infinite Tree Bark, on the other hand, were materials for the third enhancement of the battle armor.
In Jack’s conception of the Combat Divine Body at the Seventh Layer, it consisted of three major parts: internal, external, and the Rune True Body..

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 227 Combat Divine Body 2.0, Monarch Essence Blood, Merging into Myself_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 227 Combat Divine Body 2.0, Monarch Essence Blood, Merging into Myself_3
Translator: 549690339
The external armor, as the “Mecha” carrier, allowed the true martial arts phantom to have a stronger carrying capacity, to accommodate more Heavenly Energy, and even enabled him to transform into a giant in the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Within, the flesh absorbed the Essence Blood of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, utilized a Secret Skill for the third qualitative transformation, and enhanced the core talent compatibility, becoming the “driver” of the true martial arts phantom.
There is no need to mention the Rune True Body—the Three-headed Six-armed Rune Illusions are the “Media’s” flesh and blood.
While Jack Clark was exchanging materials, the ferocious black-red Colossal Beast returned to the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace, with the Dragon Turtle and a few other Giant Beasts lying quietly nearby in hibernation.
The Aura of the Silver Giant Dragon and Nine-headed Flood Dragon was also slowly strengthening.
In the surroundings of these Giant Beasts swam Female Tiger Whales, respectfully nodding and humming softly upon seeing the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Upon returning to the Thunderflame Dragon King Palace, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast placed several purple energy crystals aside, then opened its jaws and exhaled scorching golden flames to start refining the dragon horns.
Soon, under the tempering of the energy flames of nearly 100,000 degrees Celsius, the 3 meters long dragon horns gradually dissolved and shrank, finally transforming into 2 meters long platinum spiral dragon horns.
Subsequently, the flames from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s mouth gradually extinguished.
After casually tempering the two dragon horns and tossing them aside, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast lay down, extending its right claw and pressing a fingertip against its chest.
Crackle Crackle!!
Accompanied by the relentless pressing down of the sharp claw, a crack was torn open on the chest of the Thunderflame Beheamoth, reaching deep into flesh and blood, unveiling the golden-red flesh and golden chest bone on both sides.
The golden-red flesh emitted terrifyingly intense heat, yet the surrounding golden blood flowed without spilling out.
With his will suppressing the wound’s vicinity from healing, the Thunderflame Beheamoth let out a low growl, and immediately a drop of pure golden blood slowly formed along the spine.
The Giant Beast Essence and Blood commonly available in the human market are primarily refined from the Giant Beasts’ spinal marrow, blood, and flesh, containing the essence of a Giant Beast’s life.
As for the heart’s blood, it is just blood from the core. Although it contains powerful energy, it is just energy and lacks the miraculous function that changes bloodlines.
The Essence Blood that the Thunderflame Emperor Beast refined from itself at this moment was also condensed from its own life essence.
Soon, a fist-sized drop of pure golden blood slowly floated up from the wound, emitting an intimidating aura of Dragon Might, as if it were a living Ferocious Beast.
The golden blood submerged and floated in water, radiating a tangible powerful force, creating a half-meter wide vacuum area without water around it.
However, it was not enough; the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled low again, condensing a second drop of Essence Blood.
To let the original body coalesce into a potent true martial arts phantom and forge a solid foundation fit for a king-level, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast significantly exhausted itself this time.
Whoo whoo whoo whoo!!
Exhaling intensely hot breath through its nostrils, the wound on the chest healed in the blink of an eye, and the aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast weakened considerably, its eyes revealing tiredness for the first time.
Coalescing Essence Blood severely depleted the Life Origin, with a perfectly intact Giant Beast corpse only yielding just over a dozen portions of Essence Blood
Under the circumstances of coalescing two drops of Essence Blood, even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast felt somewhat weakened and estimated it would take several days to recover.
This was despite its ability to replenish its Life Origin by devouring Mutated Creatures; otherwise, the recovery would take longer and affect its potential.
In the evening, after dinner, Jack Clark waited in the Hotel Lobby.
By eight o’clock, an official sedan arrived, followed by three individuals in work uniforms entering the hotel.
“Mr. Clark, here are the Transcendent Materials you ordered. Please confirm them,” they said.
“No problem, thank you for your efforts,” Jack replied with a satisfied smile once he confirmed the materials were correct.
Taking the materials into the Sumeru Space, Jack returned to his room, closed the door and windows, took a deep breath, and activated the space runes on his arm with the True Dragon Power.
Meanwhile, under the sea, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had been awaiting with silver spatial runes ablaze atop the feather horns on its head.
As the Golden Flame Crown emerged, a silver spatial vortex appeared, and in an instant, a profound gravitational force Burst forth from the opening in space.
Roar! Amidst a low roar, an Invisible Power swept up the purple energy crystal stones, the dragon horns, and the golden Essence Blood into the pathway.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 228: The Third Qualitative Change, Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light King
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Chapter 228: The Third Qualitative Change, Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light King
Translator: 549690339
As the last 2-meter-long white gold dragon horn, as thick as a thigh at its thickest point, barely squeezed through the spatial channel, Jack Clark instantly closed the pathway.
Huff huff!!
Jack Clark gasped for air, feeling how his True Dragon Power had depleted by more than half in less than a minute, an involuntary bitter smile spread across his face.
The consumption of opening a spatial channel was too great, even with the Thunderflame Emperor Beast bearing most of the burden.
This situation would only improve after he broke through to the Seventh Layer Heaven in the future, or after the Thunderflame Emperor Beast grew to level nine.
After resting briefly, Jack Clark turned his attention to the four damp purple energy crystals on the floor and the two drops of gold blood suspended in the air, emitting a terrifying aura.
After a moment’s contemplation, Jack Clark took out the black bottle from his Storage Space that had once contained the Golden Winged Scaled Dragon Blood Essence.
Then came the Demonic Crystal Inscription Powder, the True Illusion Marrow Fluid.
Jack Clark first sealed a portion of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s Essence Blood inside the bottle, then carefully added the colorful fluid from the True Illusion Marrow Fluid.
Glug glug!!
The moment the True Illusion Marrow Fluid came into contact with the
Essence Blood, the pure gold blood churned, filled with the aura of an Eighth Level Beast.
Then Jack Clark added the black Demonic Crystal Inscription Powder, causing the Essence Blood to boil and froth continuously.
As the life essence of a Giant Beast, Essence Blood could not be directly used as an ‘ink’ for inscriptions, needing a special neutralization and adjustment process.
With the addition of the two special materials, the Essence Blood slowly calmed down, turning into a pure, transparent gold-black state.
Seeing this, Jack Clark set the blood ink aside.
Next, he took out the Flame Crystal Armor, ten Pleasure Crystal Stones, and four silver pieces with a space pattern, containing the attribute of infinite tree bark.
Then, he placed them together with the two tempered dragon horns.
Indeed, this time Jack Clark intended to use the dragon horns of an Eighth Level Beast as Transcendent Materials to enhance the external structure and Defense Boost of the battle armor.
Jack Clark placed his hand over the battle armor, and in his realm of thought, a voice intoned, “Consume 200 Points Attribute, Strengthened Battle Armor.”
Hum!
A dense white energy spread from Jack’s palm, covering the battle armor, dragon horns, Pleasure Crystal Stones, and tree bark, dissolving them into a liquid substance.
Huff huff!! Under the burning white flames, the battle armor floated, enveloping the various transcendent substances as they merged with it.
At that moment, Jack Clark reached for the black bottle, pouring out the transparent black gold liquid within.
With his Spiritual Will as the brush, he wrapped the blood ink around the Strengthened Battle Armor, starting to inscribe it, and a mysterious pattern began to emerge on the armor.
Jack Clark, fully engrossed in etching the runes, did not notice that as he completed the Basic Runes, the battle armor itself was undergoing a transformation.
About half an hour later, Jack Clark let out a long breath, withdrew his Spiritual Will, and then his gaze suddenly stopped.
What he saw was a set of thick Golden Red Battle Armor floating in the air, its shape even more grandiose and domineering than before, and its surface was full of gold-black mysterious patterns.
The inscriptions containing the blood of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast resembled roaming Dragon Pythons, emanating a menacing and fierce presence that was captivating.
Most importantly, four slowly rotating gears hung behind the helm of the armor.
The outermost gear had a diameter of eighty centimeters, with the smallest around thirty centimeters, all in white gold, engraved with Black Gold Basic Space Runes.
Made from the fusion of infinite tree bark and parts of the dragon horns, these external components, originally designed by Jack as flags, had surprisingly taken the form of gears.
Perhaps the circular shapes were more stable, more in line with the concept of a complete world.
Observing the four gears emitting Spatial Fluctuations, Jack’s eyes reflected his pondering.
Hmm?
Just then, Jack noticed that the Basic Runes of Thunder, Golden Flame, regeneration, and Toxin—each symbolic of their respective talents—were coming into conflict on the four gears.
The force fields were incompatible.
Under the aura of the runes of Thunder and Golden Flame, the Basic Runes of Toxin and regeneration on the fourth outer and second middle gears were fading away.
They quickly vanished.
This result furrowed Jack’s brow: “These two Talent Runes actually conflict with the Thunderflame attributes within the external spatial structure.”
The cause was most likely that these two Gifted Powers were not natural elements but born from the evolution of flesh and blood.
Jack had been aware of the repulsion between forces but assumed these talents, all originating from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, would not strongly conflict.
There were no issues during simulations in the secret space earlier.
But when it came to truly constructing four external “world” components using the four talents, a powerful repulsion emerged.
In such a case, either two of the components must be abandoned or a new force similar in attributes and affinity to Thunderflame must be sought to replace them.
“A natural force close to Thunder and Flame, Light, Wind, Earth, Water… no, Water won’t work, as it contradicts Fire. Hence, Earth and Wind are suitable alternatives.
‘The Earth bears, the Wind fuels the Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, and Fire, eh.'”
Looking at the slowly rotating gears, Jack showed a bitter smile.
“It seems I will need to adjust my battle technique again. Never mind, that’s to deal with later. As long as the base framework remains unchanged, it’s time to focus on more pressing matters.”
Having said that, Jack’s will moved, and instantly the battle armor in midair split apart.
Crackle Crackle!!
In the blink of an eye, a figure clad in Golden Red Gorgeous Battle Armor with four gears rotating behind its head appeared, instantly filling the space with an awe-inspiring Sacred Breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 228: The Third Qualitative Change, Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Chapter 228: The Third Qualitative Change, Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light King_2
Translator: 549690339
Under the accentuation of vicious black gold runes on his body, Jack Clark now gave off the aura of a Hell Suppressing Light King.
Feeling the solidity and heaviness from the battle armor, Jack reached out his hand and directly swallowed another portion of pure gold Essence Blood, which instantly exploded inside his body.
Boom!
Compared to the Essence Blood of the Golden Winged Scaled Dragon he had absorbed before, the Essence Blood of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was terrifying.
As soon as it entered Jack’s body, it exploded like an atomic bomb, releasing endless scorching energy that turned into invisible ‘flames’ burning throughout his body.
However, due to the long-term reinforcement from homologous Evolution Energy, Jack’s flesh had a strong affinity with the flesh and blood of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, so the impact of the Essence Blood on his physical body wasn’t significant.
At that moment, with a thought, Jack controlled the True Dragon Power within his body to circulate in an unfamiliar manner.
This was the Secret Skill from the Eight-Arm Divine Ape Secret Manual on absorbing Giant Beast Essence and Blood to fundamentally change one’s own genetic form and acquire some attributes of the Giant Beast.
Roar Roar!!
Within Jack’s dantian, the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune suddenly emitted Dragon Roars and Elephant Bellowing, and a mountainous Dragon Elephant Phantom vaguely appeared.
Roar!
Just then, another earth-shaking roar, and an even more ferocious giant shadow emerged in the dantian, as the two giant beasts collided with a bang.
Suddenly, Jack’s dantian was in chaos, the True Strength reverberated, and under the will-fueled struggle of the two Giant Beasts’ Essence Blood, everything turned upside down.
Quickly, accompanied by the roar of the Thunderflame giant shadow, it completely shattered the Dragon Elephant, and the originally stable and complete Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune showed signs of collapse.
Roar Roar Roar!! The Thunderflame giant shadow let out a proud roar, crashing into the rune with a bang.
Suddenly, without Jack having to deduce or strengthen with attribute points,
Gradually, a more complete, complex, and mysterious rune appeared in Jack’s dantian. This was the Innate Evolution mentioned in Genetic Martial Arts.
All talents born inheritantly will evolve in the most suitable form for the cultivator, while cultivating True Martial Arts is an alternative form of evolution, an evolution of power.
As the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Rune underwent changes, the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Shadow in Jack’s Sea of Consciousness also vibrated continuously.
The will-condensed Dragon Elephant’s body continuously grew Black-Red Scaled Armor, sharp spikes emerged on its back, the Dragon Tail became longer and more pointed, and its four claws became sharper.
At this moment, not only did the dantian rune and the Sea of Consciousness phantom change, but Jack’s physical body was also undergoing a transformation, with his muscles and blood shimmering with a golden sheen, becoming tougher and more powerful.
The entire skeleton turned dark gold, exuding a sense of utmost solidity, and even Dark Gold Dragon Scales surfaced on the bones, resembling a Dragon Bone.
Under the transformative reinforcement by the Homologous Giant Beast Essence and Blood, Jack became more than human, much like when he initially condensed the Divine Tyrant Body, his physique underwent a substantial change.
At the same time, triggered by the homologous Essence Blood, Jack’s battle armor emitted Black-Red Radiance.
Under the intertwining aura of homologous powers, a phantom faintly took shape behind Jack, reaching the ceiling, three-faced and six-armed, with four light wheels slowly rotating behind its head.
However, this phantom only appeared for an instant before vanishing.
Only after his body’s Qi Blood settled down did Jack slowly open his eyes. His originally pitch-black eyes now had a ring of gold around the edges, cold, ferocious, exuding a terrifying might.
Feeling the more overbearing and ferocious power within his body, Jack prompted a thought, calling forth the attribute page.
Realm: Sixth-level Heaven [Mid Period]
Physique: 1820—2232
Strength: 2065—2575
Agility: 1495-1738
Spirit: 1621—1650
Talent: Soul Split* [Top-tier] Void Double Pupils* [Senior]
Cultivation Methods: Godly Emperor Dragon Tyrant Body [Limit Break] Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd [Limit Break]
Rune: Blood Sea Purgatory [Complete] Cut through the Void [Incomplete] Hidden Deity [Complete] Divine Might Emperor Dragon [Complete: Ignite Blood Qi to enter Tyrant Elephant State, strength increases twelve times.
Ignite True Dragon Power to enter Emperor Dragon State, strength and defense increase eight times, agility increases three times.
Note: Blood Qi Dragon Power ignited simultaneously to enter the Divine Might Emperor Dragon state, strength, and defense increase twenty times, each receiving Divine Might, Emperor Dragon Power enhancement.
Alert! Divine Might Emperor Dragon state consumes too much current Power of Will, use with caution.]
Realm of Thought: Prison Blood War Intent [Nearly a minor achievement of a special Battle Intent, bathe in blood, reflect Hell]
Attribute points: 123
Equipment: Dragon Blood Battle Armor [Top-tier Extraordinary Battle Armor with four passive functions, true strength protection amplification doubled, with Dragon Might Oppression attached.
Active Function: Mimetic Light Wings.
Active Function: Scorching Fire Ring
Active Function: Extraordinary Battle Armor, which can transform into a massive suit of armor to bear the Power of Heaven and Earth when fused with the Basic Rune Constructed True Martial Arts Phantom.
External Assembly: Wheel of the World 2/4, incomplete space component.]
With the absorption of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast Essence Blood, his four major attributes significantly increased.
The peak strength rose by more than five hundred points, with the base strength expected to surpass the fearsome level of a hundred tons.
Because this was a physique transformation, increase in strength, physique, and even agility were all over two hundred points, while the spiritual attribute only grew by several dozen points.
Beyond the physical reinforcement, the most significant change was in the cultivation methods; Dragon Elephant Overlord Body became the Emperor Dragon Divine Might Overlord Body, harnessing more overbearing powers.
As cultivation methods evolved, the runes also underwent a massive change, becoming [Divine Might Emperor Dragon], with the gains from the three transformation stages skyrocketing.
Jack clenched his fist: “It’s a pity that this transformation is only half complete.”
Because he had only referenced a portion of the transformation Secret Skill and was not following the path of Genetic Martial Arts, Jack’s current physique transformation was only half complete.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 228: The Third Qualitative Change,
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Chapter 228: The Third Qualitative Change,
Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light
King_3
Translator: 549690339 |
But even so, after absorbing the Essence Blood of the Thunderflame Emperor
Beast to transform his flesh and possessing even stronger True Dragon attributes, his strength has greatly increased.
At this point, under the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form, Jack Clark estimated that his normal battle strength was probably between the mid to late stages of the Seventh Layer Heaven.
If he entered the Tyrant Elephant or Emperor Dragon Form, he could suppress a regular strong man in the late period of the Seventh Layer Heaven, let alone the strongest Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form.
With twenty times the strength and defense, combined with the powers of Divine Might and Emperor Dragon Strength, his combat power could reach the pinnacle of the Seventh Layer Heaven.
A Sixth Heaven Middle-Stage Cultivator rivaling the peak of the Seventh Layer Heaven, plus the fact that he had been cultivating for just over half a year, this news would shock the entire global Cultivation World if it were to spread.
“Phew! This is just the beginning.” Jack Clark let out a breath.
At this moment, he had not yet reached the peak of his current Sixth Layer Heavenly Realm, and there was still a lot of room for improvement, not to mention the advancements to come after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
After external enhancements to his battle armor and absorption of Essence Blood, Jack Clark picked up a purple energy crystal, wiped it, and then put it in his mouth.
Crackle Crackle, just like eating beans, he chewed the hard-as-iron crystal to
pieces.
Whoosh whoosh!!
The pure purple energy substance dissolved within Jack Clark’s body, and immediately a vast energy surged out, his True Strength whirled crazily, growing stronger with each circulation.
By the time Jack Clark had consumed four purple energy crystals, his Sixth Layer Heaven True Strength had doubled, covering half the distance from the mid to the late stages.
“It won’t be long now, no resources needed, I should be able to breakthrough to the late period within a month. If I get more resources later, it’ll be even faster.”
As for the Contribution Points owed to the Federation, let the Thunderflame Emperor Beast kill a couple more Level 7 Colossi and gather some materials later.
He could simply temper them after, claiming they were spoils of war obtained from Mikus before; after all, only he knew the exact gains from that time.
With his current cultivation level and status, no one would bother with such trivial matters.
The next day, Jack Clark, whose aura was concealed, walked out of his room, looking no different from yesterday under the cloak of Hidden Deity Glyphs.
But when he followed Mathilda Ward to the dining room, Damon Lopes, who was drinking milk, spat it out in shock, his face a picture of disbelief.
“Damn it, Brother Callum, you… you’ve made a breakthrough again!!” Mathilda Ward paused, as Crystal Boyce also turned in surprise.
“…How did you figure that out?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
“As an Innate Awakened One, I obviously have my own abilities.
At this moment, through Damon Lopes’s eyes, Jack Clark walking towards him was not a man, but a ferocious and dreadful giant dragon, whereas before, he was an overbearing Dragon Elephant.
Compared to the Dragon Elephant, the divine charm emanating from Jack Clark now was even more terrifying.
Jack Clark calmly said, “After sparring with Mr. Gail a few days ago, I studied the Summoning Secret Skill and pondered the Secret Book; I made a slight ‘improvement’ last night.”
Damon Lopes rolled his eyes: “Brother Callum, there’s no need for modesty.” His Innate Eye allowed him to observe the Qi of Heaven and Earth, the energy of mountains and rivers, including a person’s spirit and charm.
So in his eyes, many hidden traces couldn’t escape detection, although he wasn’t able to differentiate friend from foe with just a glance like Jack Clark could, he was still powerful.
This was also one of the reasons why he was chosen for this mission, not just for his destructive powers.
The enemies this time were two King-level entities, and maybe they had some secret skill that could avoid Jack Clark’s Heart’s Eye Perception.
In such a case, Damon Lopes with his Innate Eye would serve as the second invisible barrier, forming a double defense line to ensure absolute security.
Thus, even though Damon Lopes seemed to be wandering everywhere every day, chatting up beauties and befriending them, he was indeed fulfilling his responsibilities.
Damon Lopes complained with a tinge of annoyance: “Brother Callum, why do I feel like you are the one who’s an Innate Awakened One? It’s just too abnormal, your progress at the Sixth Layer is so exaggerated.”
Jack Clark gave him a sidelong glance: “Even though I am making progress, it seems you’re not standing still either, right?”
“Heh heh, of course, I am an Innate Awakened One.” Damon Lopes said with some pride.
After using two top-tier resources in succession, his cultivation jumped from mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven to mid-stage Sixth Layer Heaven, and there was some residual energy left in his body.
Throughout this period of cultivation and absorption, coupled with his supreme talent, he was making great strides. He estimated that he could break through to the late Sixth Heavenly Stage within two months.
By then, he should be able to put a little distance between himself and this freak. Damon Lopes thought uncertainly.
Damon Lopes was always confident about his cultivation talent. Had he not been focusing his energy on refining the Innate Thunderbolt these past years, he would have already broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
But now, faced with the monstrous Jack Clark, Damon Lopes inexplicably felt a bit less confident.
He couldn’t shake the feeling that this guy was even more aberrant.
“Alright, you two stop flattering each other and have breakfast. We all know you’re both one in ten thousand geniuses,” Mathilda Ward said, laughing at her own comment.
Crystal Boyce also praised, “Both of you indeed are exceptional amongst others. It’s a pity I don’t have a daughter, otherwise, I would have introduced her to Mr. Callum.”
“Uhh… Boss Boyce, why wouldn’t you introduce her to me?” Damon Lopes felt a bit indignant.
Crystal Boyce laughed lightly, “Because Mr. Callum seems like a responsible person. As for Mr. Lopes, why don’t you first delete those dozens of friends and then we can talk about it?”
“Cough… You’re right, Brother Callum surely surpasses me by a lot, haha, Boss Boyce has good judgment.” Damon Lopes laughed it off.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 228: The Third Qualitative Change, Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light King_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Chapter 228: The Third Qualitative Change, Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Hell Suppressing Light King_4
Translator: 549690339
Deleting the beautiful female friends from his mobile phone? Impossible, that was his hobby after all.
While joking, everyone finished breakfast, and then Mathilda Ward and the others got busy preparing for tonight’s concert.
As dusk fell, a convoy stopped at the stadium’s back door, and over ten bodyguards in suits got out of the vehicles, their gazes sharp, vigilant of their surroundings.
At that moment, the business car in the middle opened, and out stepped Jack Clark in a black suit and sunglasses, his demeanor cold and his aura oppressive.
Then Mathilda Ward and Gwen Gail in a white princess dress descended from the car.
The fox-eared girl was brimming with excitement, clinging to Mathilda’s arm with shining eyes, “Sister Ilisa, is this what it feels like to be a big star? It’s so grand.”
Although she was a descendant of the king-level, she usually lived in an exclusive area and seldom went out.
Of course, with the power of her family, they could create even more buzz if they wanted to.
At that moment, from around the corner, a group of new media journalists who had been lying in wait rushed over, shouting, “MissWard, may we interview you?”
“Miss Ward, could you say a few words?”
As those journalists charged forward, they were stopped by a wall of guards formed by four bodyguards, their cameras continuously clicking.
Mathilda Ward smiled and said, “Thankyou all for your attention, but I need to get ready for the opening act. We can talk after the concert is over.”
Having said that, Mathilda waved her hand and turned towards the back door.
But the journalists seemed quite agitated, and two of them, with a quick duck, managed to slip under the guard’s outstretched arms.
Boom!
In an instant, a terrifying pressure burst forth from Jack Clark, and the very earth trembled slightly under the heavy aura, as rolling waves of tangible air formed a raging wind around them.
What mattered most was that the invisible and ferocious Dragon Might spread out, making everyone’s faces show panic, turning pale with terror.
The two journalists who rushed over immediately fell to their knees, looking at the expressionless Jack Clark with fear and horror.
After giving the intimidated journalists a cold look, Jack Clark withdrew his aura.
Then, Jack turned his icy gaze to the guards who had failed to stop the people, speaking in a cold voice, “As cultivators, you can’t even block some ordinary people, where is your sense of security?”
One of the young men bowed his head anxiously, “Sorry, Mr. Callum, we didn’t anticipate they would be so aggressive.”
But Jack Clark paid no heed to these explanations, his look cold, “Although I don’t expect you to stop those people, if you can’t even block some ordinary individuals, what use do you have?”
At this point, Lionel Lopez stepped forward, his face showing shame, “I apologize, Mr. Callum. During this time, because we had two dignitaries here, their vigilance did indeed slip.”
“Please rest assured, Mr. Callum, and MissWard, I will supervise them strictly from now on, to ensure that today’s incident doesn’t happen again.”
“I hope so, otherwise, I’ll suggest to Miss Ward that we need a new team of bodyguards,” Jack said coldly as he turned and left.
Not until Jack’s figure had entered through the back door did one of the journalists swallow and say, “It was that bodyguard.”
“He is still here.”
“That’s strange, I didn’t even notice him just now.”
“Brother, can you help me up?”
” What’ s wrong with you?”
“I think I wet myself.”
“Damn, you got scared enough to wet your pants? That’s so embarrassing.”
“No kidding, that guard turned so frightening all of a sudden, weren’t you scared? I think I saw your pants were wet too.”
“Cough, cough! Brother, you must be mistaken. Here, let me help you up.”
No sooner had Jack Clark entered through the stadium’s back door than Damon Lopes expressed regret, “How did I not seize that perfect opportunity to show off?”
“…That wasn’t to show off, okay?” Jack said, speechless.
Grinning, Damon replied, “Not much of a difference, anyway. That scene will soon spread through those journalists, after all, it’s a hot topic.”
Meanwhile, the stadium’s front door had begun admitting ticket holders.
On each side of the gate stood two Three-eyed Blood Foxes, one black fox creature with three pairs of white eyes, silently watching the audience go through the security checks.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 229: Finally Can Show Off, Tiger Overlord, Road to Becoming a God (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 229: Finally Can Show Off, Tiger Overlord, Road to Becoming a God (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
Translator: 549690339
The concert in Green Mountain City was still being livestreamed globally, anyone could enter by simply logging onto the “Mandy Yates’s Global Charity Tour” link on the Federation’s official website.
Just this ‘advertisement’ alone made countless artists and stars around the world green with envy.
After all, it had been decades since the Federation had promoted a concert like this, and anyone with half a brain knew that Mandy Yates had some serious backing.
However, while those stars were envious of Mandy Yates, many in the global security industry, particularly the bodyguards, were very envious of Jack Clark.
With the overbearing performance on Mandy Yates’s concert stage, the name ‘Darren Callum’ also came to be known by many people around the world.
That’s right, Jack Clark’s ‘name’ had been leaked, probably by an employee at Mandy Yates’s company, and then it was exposed by a media company.
When people found out that the overbearing bodyguard’s name was Darren Callum, many were taken aback at first, then came the laughter, followed by hearty mockery.
It was too juvenile, what kind of age was it that someone still went by a name as juvenile as Darren Callum?
But after the laughter, some people realized that this guy seemed to live up to his name, acting in quite an overbearing manner.
At 7:30 pm, with the venue lights going out and mysterious music starting to play, a huge purple flower bud emerged at the center of the vast stage.
Surrounded by the thirty-meter-high 3D flower bud, lively white fox beasts, ranging from ten to twenty or thirty meters in length, circled around.
White fog swirled on the ground, Unique Beasts walked around, resembling a fairyland.
Hu!
Falling from high altitude, the brilliant petals turned the purple Lotus Stand flower bud into a full-blown, spectacular and stunning purple Lotus Stand covering the entire stage.
In the center of the Lotus Stand, Mandy Yates dressed in ancient-style clothes
– a magnificent purple and red long dress accessorized with a phoenix crown – stood out as regally beautiful and dazzling.
At the same time, those three-tailed and four-tailed beasts around her all bowed down in submission.
Such a grand entrance had everyone at the site and those watching through the live streaming platform, their eyes lighting up, feeling as if they were watching a blockbuster movie.
However, after the initial shock, some people started to look around instinctively.
As expected, that annoying bodyguard was still there, standing three steps behind Mandy Yates as usual with a stern expression, just like a monarch.
Yes, a monarch.
When they saw that upright figure on the Lotus Stand, many instinctively felt he was a monarch of sorts, with Mandy Yates becoming merely a backdrop for his presence.
“Damn! What’s the deal with this Darren Callum, how come he’s always there?”
” Wuwu!! Sorry, my goddess, but now the first thing I look for is that annoying bodyguard, not you.”
“It’s over, mom, is there something wrong with my sexual orientation? I’m actually paying attention to that bodyguard.”
“Uh… as a woman, it’s normal for you to be interested in a man, right?”
“Brother Callum really made a big breakthrough this time, undergoing a fundamental change in his spirit and demeanor.” Damon Lopes commented with some envy from below the stage.
That noble, monarch-like aura was too enviable, making him wonder what Secret Skill Jack had cultivated.
Bang!
Then, as the music blared, the Lotus Stand burst open, transforming into a sky full of light petals spreading out and with most of the fox beasts disappearing like bubbles, the concert officially began.
Wu!
A ten-meter-tall, twenty-meter-long White Fox Beast, adding its tail, more than thirty meters in total, elegantly stepped towards the back of the stage and lay down.
“Hiss! That beast is actually real.”
“It’s huge!”
“It’s as tall as a three-story building just standing there.”
All around the stage, many ordinary people and low-level cultivators gasped at the sight of the Level 6 Exotic Beast, which already had some of the attributes of a Giant Beast.
Don’t be mistaken, Jack Clark now kills Level 6 Exotic Beasts as if slaughtering chickens, but that’s because he is incredibly strong.
For ordinary people, even a Level 1 Beast poses a great danger, let alone a Level 6 Exotic Beast on the verge of becoming a Giant Beast could wipe out hundreds of people instantly if it went on a rampage in such a crowded concert.
But at this moment, the beast was very docile.
Occasionally, when Jack Clark glanced at it, the huge fox face even showed a human-like cleverness, and its four fluffy tails gently swayed to please him. It’s just that no one saw this scene.
The concert’s music rhythm was upbeat, and soon the climax of the first song arrived.
“I bet that guy is going to block Mandy again.”
“No need to guess, that guy has already blocked Mandy.”
It was the same old formula, the same old flavor.
When all the camera lenses focused on Mandy Yates, Jack Clark wearing a black suit and sunglasses suddenly appeared, blocking her completely from view.
Instantly, his stern face appeared before countless onlookers.
Super Second Generation: “Ah! Damn it, I want to find someone to beat him up, someone to beat up that guy, he’s too annoying again, blocking my view of Mandy.”
On Eastern Summer’s Largest Live Streaming Platform, countless comments flooded the screen.
“Big guy, didn’t you say earlier you wanted to raise funds to beat up this bodyguard? Count me in, I’ll give up all of my three thousand salary this month.”
“And me, brothers, let’s fundraise together, to beat him up.”
“Charge!! I still have a thousand bonus this month.”
Super Second Generation: “I’ve got five hundred thousand pocket money this month; I won’t be satisfied unless we beat him up. Are there any advanced cultivators taking orders?”
“That guy is probably not weak, I feel that at least a Fifth Layer Heaven Great Master is needed to deal with him, but I doubt fifty thousand would be enough to hire such an expert.”
“No worries, we’ll crowdfund.”
“Right, crowdfund.”
“Brothers, let’s form a group, whoever wants to chip in come join, three hundred, five hundred, no amount is too small. Let’s all pitch in and find someone to beat that guy up to vent our frustrations.”

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 229: Finally Able to Show Off, Tiger Overlord, Road to Becoming a God (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Chapter 229: Finally Able to Show Off, Tiger Overlord, Road to Becoming a God (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
Translator: 549690339 I
“Yes, it’s best to make sure he can’t get on stage next time.”
“Make him lie in a hospital for a month…”
Watching the arrogant bodyguard wandering all over the stage, sometimes blocking their goddess, many male fans felt their jealousy thoroughly provoked.
Too arrogant, too enviable. They couldn’t quell the hatred in their hearts without giving him a good beating.
However, there were also those who remained calm.
“Brothers, investing… no, crowdfunding should be done with caution. Be careful that those two guys calling for crowdfunding to beat someone up are scammers…”
“I made three hundred bucks selling fish yesterday, I’m also going to join the crowdfunding.” Glenn Clark excitedly joined the group that was crowdfunding to beat someone up in Mist River City.
Hmm, they dare to beat up my brother? Just wait till I tip him off.
Jack Clark, of course, knew nothing about these developments. After wandering around the stage for a few laps, he made his way to the side of the stage.
This time there were no problems.
Although there were many disdainful stares from the audience, these were merely expressions of dissatisfaction for obstructing Mathilda Ward, not the same deep malice as from the Evil God Sect Cultists.
Those cultists’ ideologies had been influenced, including those contaminated by the spiritual control of the Blood God Acunus.
Looking at people with such eyes was like looking from a demon from hell, filled with intense malice.
This was also the reason why Jack Clark was able to accurately identify Evil God Sect Cultists.
Since there were no problems this time, Jack Clark was happy to have an easy job, his gaze resting on the beautiful figure moving around the stage, singing and interacting with the audience.
Watching that smile bloom like a flower, her face full of youthful vitality, Jack Clark sighed softly in his heart.
Who would have thought that this glowing girl had less than three months to live?
As for thinking of ways to help, Jack Clark hadn’t considered it, after all, that was an ‘injury’ that even the entire Federation, including Heavenly King Level powerhouses, were helpless to heal.
Issues involving the soul were not something a Sixth Heaven cultivator like him could consider.
This kind of imperfection was different from his Soul Split; although his soul had split and half of it had become the body of a Giant Beast, the essence of his soul was still whole.
So all Jack Clark could do was ensure to protect her with all his strength and let her choose her own method of Hibernation.
In the best seats of the first row just below the stage, Sinclair Moore sat, more handsome than most women, with Gwen Gail by his side.
At that moment, the fox-eared girl’s eyes shone brightly as she watched Mathilda Ward on the stage, somewhat excitedly, “Brother, what do you think about me becoming a big star like Sister Ilisa?”
With a bit of a headache, Sinclair Moore replied, “Moon, you still have to go to school. Let’s talk about the star thing after you graduate.”
“But didn’t you say you would support me in everything?” the fox-eared girl pouted.
“That’s different. You know about Miss Ward’s injury. She doesn’t have time, so she can do whatever she wants, but we are different.”
“We are Descendants of the King and have our own responsibilities. We’re only here for a month this time, and then I have to go back and prepare for The Road to Becoming a God.”
“You’ll have to come back with me when that time comes; I don’t feel at ease with you alone out here.”
“…Alright.”
More than two hours later, the concert ended smoothly without any incident.
It was just that damn bodyguard who once again interrupted the interaction between Mathilda Ward and her fans.
Too despicable.
Although the concert was over, many people were still busy. The new media folks were editing tomorrow morning’s articles.
Even those who were always first with the news had already sent out sensational headlines like “That Bodyguard is Still So Arrogant” and “Is That Bodyguard the World’s Most Awesome Bodyguard?”
Meanwhile, Glenn Clark was also occupied.
[International Proxy Group]
“Group admin, are you sure you can get in touch with an expert from Gunardo?”
“Yeah, admin, it’s not that we don’t trust you, but we don’t want to be fooled out of this month’s salary.”
Tyrant Blade Slashes: “Don’t worry everyone, I have a cousin in Mason City, and he is also a cultivator. The Blood Tiger Martial Arts Hall where he’s at is quite renowned locally.”
“Especially the owner, Napoleon Knowles, is a Fifth Layer expert in Genetic Martial Arts with very strong combat power. He once fought and killed a Level 5 Alien Beast as tall as a four-story building outright.”
“Hiss! That’s so powerful.”
“That’s amazing.”
Super Second Generation: “I just had someone look it up online, and there really is a Blood Tiger Martial Arts Hall in Mason City, run by Napoleon Knowles. Tyrant Blade wasn’t lying.”
Tyrant Blade Slashes: “Don’t worry, everyone. My brother holds a high position in the Blood Tiger Martial Arts Hall, and even if we can’t get Master Knowles himself to make a move, we can still find other experts.”
“Moreover, we will supervise this fundraising together, ensuring transparency. Plus, once we secure a good fighter, I will have them do a live stream, so everyone can feel assured, right?”
“Haha… Now we can rest easy, Tyrant Blade brother is generous.”
“The big shot has such extensive connections, too impressive.”
“Eh, this brother, why is your online name Tiger Overlord? Do you know Darren Callum?”
“Haha… No, I don’t know him. I just saw his name Darren Callum, so I picked an even more arrogant name to one-up him.”
“And your name is Tyrion Luther, isn’t it?”
Despite the fierce online posturing, less than 1,100 people ended up joining the proxy group in the end.
With contributions of a few hundred here and a thousand there, and a few sizable donations of ten thousand, they gathered just over a million.
Then Tyrant Blade took out a hundred thousand, and the Super Second Generation coughed up more than seven hundred thousand in one go, summing up to two million to pay as remuneration for a Fifth Layer Heaven expert to take action.
Among those in this international proxy group, aside from Glenn Clark, a few official personnel had also mixed in, such as Sinclair Moore who had been fanning the flames in the chat group earlier.
The reason, of course, was to see if there were any Evil God Sect infiltrators among them.
At night, Doris Clark got up to use the toilet and noticed a sliver of light under Glenn Clark’s door; she couldn’t help but call out, “Jim, go to sleep earlier. You have to go to school tomorrow.”
“I know, Mom.”
The next day, at the airport.
“Sister Ilisa, you’re leaving so soon?” Gwen Gail said, holding onto Mathilda Ward with a hint of reluctance.
Mathilda Ward patted Gwen Gail on the head: “The schedule is already set, and it’s not easy to change. Otherwise, I’d stay a few more days with you.”
Over there, Hannah Gail was speaking to Jack Clark in a somewhat solemn tone, “Both of you, be extra careful when you head over there.”
“Gunardo is steeped in the ways of Genetic Martial Arts. Due to policy issues, the martial arts scene there is chaotic. The Evil God Sect has been detected more frequently in recent years, and despite multiple crackdowns, they remain uneradicated.”
“They will likely take action this time with your arrival.”
Jack Clark nodded: “I know. This morning, Mr. Lopes and I already received a message about it, and we’ll be very cautious.”
This morning, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes had already received news from the Federal Intelligence Agency. There were some anomalies on the route from Kuoer Airport to Mason City.
Law enforcement officers had recently noticed that some idlers were constantly taking pictures on that route with their mobile phones.
Although inspections revealed only commonplace photos on the phones, combined with the imminent visit of Mathilda Ward, these activities seemed suspicious.
Furthermore, upon closer inspection, when combining these images, it became apparent that they covered most of the scenes on the route.
It was clear the Evil God Sect was mobilizing, even preparing an attack along the way.
To avoid spooking the quarry, the Intelligence Department pretended not to notice, readying a counter-ambush. Meanwhile, over a dozen high-definition satellites were trained on that road.
Besides that, Jack Clark also received a text message from Glenn Clark.
He hadn’t expected the guy to actually have infiltrated some International Proxy Group, where a bunch of Mathilda Ward’s fans had gathered over a million, and at the next stop, had found a Fifth Heaven cultivator ready to beat him up.
To gain trust, Glenn Clark even painfully spent three hundred bucks, enough for him to buy lots of meat buns to eat.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark was somewhat speechless.
Fifth Layer Heaven Great Expert…
Damon Lopes, eager for action, chuckled, “If those guys don’t show themselves, fine, but if they dare come out, Daoist Master will let them experience the wrath of thunder.”
Finally, it was his turn to show off.
Damon Lopes was somewhat excited.
All this time, it had always been Jack Clark stealing the limelight, such as today where international entertainment headlines featured him again.
Even though they were all Mathilda Ward’s bodyguards.
As an eager Damon Lopes looked forward to his moment, the international flight loaded with powerful weapons began to glide, then lifted off the ground sharply.
Soon, with the roar of the engines, the airplane vanished into the sky..

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 230 Ambushing Jack Clark, International Live Broadcast, The Silhouette on That Car
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 230 Ambushing Jack Clark, International Live Broadcast, The Silhouette on That Car
Translator: 549690339
First-class cabin on the airplane.
Seated comfortably on the sofa, Damon Lopes was still somewhat excited, “Brother Callum, when the time comes, you just make sure to protect Sister Ilisa and the others. Leave those guys to me.”
“…Sure.” Knowing that his desire to show off couldn’t be suppressed, Jack Clark nodded indifferently.
Marla Fiore was a bit puzzled, “The message we have so far just indicates suspicion; Mr. Lopes, are you so certain that someone will attack us en route?” “According to the habits of the Federal Intelligence Agency, when they say there’s a high probability, it essentially amounts to a certainty.”
Damon Lopes continued, “Moreover, the underground situation in Gunardo is chaotic; it has always been a target of infiltration by the Evil God Sect. For power and money, many people there don’t care about their lives.”
“That’s also why Miss Ward chose to have her concert there, but we’re currently unsure whether it’s the Blood God Sect or the Demon God Sect involved this time.”
At this point, Mathilda Ward thought for a moment, “Should we split into two teams at that time, letting Lionel Lopez and Sister Jessica follow behind us?” Damon Lopes shook his head, “I know you’re concerned about their safety, Sister Ilisa, but I don’t recommend splitting up.”
“One reason is that splitting up would signal to the attackers that we’ve noticed them, and under those circumstances, those guys might not make a move.” “Another possibility is that the attackers would take the convoy behind us as your real escort, and the one in the front is just a decoy, making them even more in danger.”
Although Damon Lopes usually flitted around women, he was articulate and astute when it came to serious matters.
Crystal Boyce nodded, “Indeed, to split up hastily would not only alert the enemy but also be more dangerous.”
“Misss Joseline, you don’t need to worry. Under the certainty that Evil God Sect Cultists will attack, the local military should provide support.”
“Besides that, the Eighth Layer Expert stationed there will also take action.”
“However, unless beings like Akunus appear, neither that expert nor high-level cultivators will show themselves. The support forces will be kept below Seventh Layer Heaven.”
The others nodded slightly at this explanation.
Jach Clark, however, was not concerned at all. He turned a flip of his hand and took out the Eight-Arm Divine Ape Secret Manual, ready to continue studying the conflict issues related to the fusion of talents.
The flight to Gunardo was even longer, almost eight hours, and naturally, he could not waste such a long stretch of time.
As for the two king-level soul avatars, they were no longer much of a threat to him.
Even if they had some powerful methods, Jack Clark could handle them with ease.
While Jack Callum was engrossed in the Genetic Martial Arts Secret Books, not far from the Ice Crystal Palace, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle began to grow with a crackle.
On the body of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, black and white radiance circulated, mixed with a faint ancient aura akin to that of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, growing ever stronger.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was much the same, with the dragon’s aura on its body becoming purer, more majestic, causing the surrounding Earth to vibrate subtly, resonating with it.
Due to the advice of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, both Giant Beasts were in a semi-conscious state, their consciousness immersed in the mysterious ambiance of the Talent Rune congealing.
Though they couldn’t fully comprehend it like the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, they were gradually approaching the essence of their own ‘path.’
Not only them, but the silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon in the distance also had silver and black radiance flickering about them, forming a domain phantom that covered two to three hundred meters.
Under the guidance of the Monarch Giant Beast’s talent, they too had gained much.
As for the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, it was hunting and devouring Mutated Creatures nearby to replenish the loss of Life Origin.
Just as the school day ended in the afternoon, Glenn Clark burst out of the classroom.
Behind him, Teresa Wilson called out loudly, “Glenn, aren’t you going to the… today?”
Having already dashed out of the classroom, Glenn turned his head and waved, “May, I’ve got something to take care of first. You guys go today.”
Explaining thus, his burly and formidable form darted past the 1.6-meter-tall ‘teacher,’ giving an impression more befitting an adult and a child.
Suddenly, it took Glenn just over ten minutes to cover what was usually a half-hour journey home, after which he hurried upstairs and turned on Jack Clark’s computer.
After Jack Clark had left, the computer which had been a reward for Glenn’s high school admission had always been used by Glenn. Officially, it was for studying, but in reality, he spent every day honing his fishing techniques.
Fortunately, there were no ‘study’ materials of Jack Clark’s on the computer, or there would have been another instance of inheritance between brothers.
Glenn had hurried back today to watch a live stream.
He logged into the software and entered the International Proxy Group he had joined the day before. Sure enough, the live stream had already started, and Glenn hurriedly clicked on the link.
Immediately, a rugged-looking man in his forties appeared in the video, speaking solemnly into the camera.
“Ladies and gentlemen, it’s one o’clock in the afternoon here, and according to the time difference, Miss Mathilda Ward’s plane will be arriving in half an hour.”
“I, Napoleon Knowles, have always believed in the principle of resolving troubles for those who pay me.”
