“Based on the information collected online, Miss Mathilda Ward’s bodyguards are all composed of Triplex high school elites, with Lionel Lopez as a Fourth Layer Heaven expert leading them.”
“And that bodyguard named Darren Callum, rumored to come from the military and serving as the close-protection officer for Miss Mathilda Ward, has a strength that is at least not inferior to Lionel Lopez, the Fourth Layer Heaven expert,” he continued.
“In my opinion, he is very likely a Fifth Layer cultivator.”
“Why do you think he’s a Fifth Layer and not a Sixth Layer?” someone asked with a curious chat message.
Napoleon confidently replied, “Simple, he is too young, looks to be no more than twenty years old. To estimate him as a Fifth Layer is already the highest appraisal I could make.”
“This man is most likely an expert in the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven..”

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 230 Ambushing Jack Clark, International Live Broadcast, The Bastard in the Car_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 230 Ambushing Jack Clark, International Live Broadcast, The Bastard in the Car_2
Translator: 549690339
As a civilian cultivator, breaking through to the Fourth Layer Heaven before the age of twenty was already the mark of a super genius, let alone breaking through to the Fifth Layer Heaven before twenty.
Such talent, even in the several First-class Martial Heights of Gunaer’s capital, would not exceed the number of ten fingers.
Napoleon Knowles stroked his beard and introduced, “To ensure nothing goes wrong, I’ve also invited my old friend Kasa to assist me.”
As he spoke, he pointed to the burly middle-aged man standing beside him, who exuded an aura like that of a Mutated Beast.
Even through the screen, as the camera lens focused on the burly middle-aged man, Glenn Clark and the others subconsciously held their breath, instinctively feeling a bit nervous.
“Kasa, like me, is also a well-known independent strong man in the underground scene of Mason City, at the Late-Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, known as the Tiger Slasher, having once torn a Mutant Tiger Beast alive.”
“That’s incredible, to be able to tear apart a Level 5 Mutant Tiger.”
Super Second Generation: “Haha… Mr. Ryan found some good people. With two high-level experts from the mid to late Fifth Layer Heaven taking action, that guy is definitely going to die this time.”
Tyrion Luther: “Right, beat him up badly, let him lie in the hospital for a month.”
Looking at the two Fifth Layer Heaven experts, Glenn Clark’s face showed concern, reassuring himself, “It’s fine, I’ve already sent a message to my brother.”
“These guys actually want to ambush my brother, wait until the law enforcement team catches all of you.”
In this world, it wasn’t that cultivators could do whatever they wanted; those who dared to break the law would still be arrested, as for the punishment, it depended on the local laws.
At this point, Napoleon continued, “Next, Little Brother Kasa and 1 are going to scout a location and observe Mathilda Ward’s convoy defense from a distance.”
“We Gunaer people always handle things meticulously, and by the way, we’ll continue to live stream to show everyone our sincerity.”
“Just wait, I’ll go get the car out first.” Saying this, Napoleon turned off the camera.
Suddenly, the towering Kasa, who had been standing quietly, withdrew his daunting aura and hesitated, “Old Brother Napoleon, are you really planning to fight that bodyguard?”
The previously solemn and proud Napoleon chuckled, “Of course not. That celebrity is unfathomably deep; I wouldn’t dare get involved in these muddy waters.”
“Besides, one of us is at the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, and the other is at the mid-stage of Fourth Layer Heaven. Together we wouldn’t be a match for that bodyguard; trying to trouble him would be suicide.”
Indeed, this Kasa was not a Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven Great Master but a mid-stage Fourth Layer Heaven. As for the so-called tearing apart of a Mutant Tiger, it was just a Level 2 Unique Beast he had killed.
Even Napoleon Knowles himself was only at the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven.
Kasa was startled, “Is that bodyguard that strong? Didn’t you estimate him to be at the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven?”
“The Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven was just a random guess. Who knows if he’s really at the Initial Stage or the Late-Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven.”
“Moreover, these military geniuses are terrifyingly strong, and we can’t judge by realm alone. Even if we were at the same realm, they could easily defeat us.”
Speaking of this, fear flashed in Napoleon’s eyes.
That was because, more than ten years ago, he had encountered a military expert. The opponent was at the Fourth Layer Heaven realm just like them, but just one blow had heavily injured three of his companions.
If he hadn’t played dead back then, he would have died.
“Let’s go, Little Brother Kasa. We’ll just put on an act and scout the place, then figure out how to swindle the remaining 1.5 million ein.”
“Those Eastern Summer people are too stupid, actually believing in this international ringer nonsense, and they believe whatever I say.”
“Don’t they think, with tens of thousands of kilometers between us, what could they do if 1 took the money and didn’t do anything? Would they really go to the Federal Court to complain about me?”
“Haha… these guys are indeed too stupid, but they’re so rich.”
Jokingly, the two walked out of the dilapidated martial arts hall, where outside on the training ground, a dozen young men were practicing cultivation.
Most of these martial arts hall disciples were new entrants at the First Layer Heaven, with only two individuals exuding the aura of the Second Layer Heaven.
Tyrant Blade Slashes, who had a high status in the martial arts hall, was amidst the crowd at the First Layer Heaven, diligently tempering his body, preparing for the upcoming fusion with the Alien Beast Gene.
Soon, an old van rumbled out of the martial arts hall.
Elsewhere in an abandoned warehouse, dozens of mercenaries were fully armed, each draped in chains of ammunition, holding powerful sniper cannons, machine guns, and heavy machine guns.
In addition to this, there were single soldier rocket launchers and single soldier small laser missiles on the backs of over ten people, along with other heavy weaponry.
The two Rocket Launcher Vehicles had also been driven outside, with rocket mounts slightly elevated, adjusting the general angle.
As soon as the on-site parameters were sent, they would immediately launch a rocket bombardment.
A volley of twenty or so rockets could cover a large area and obliterate everything.
And for the sake of safety, a black sunshade film was used to build a frame over the Rocket Launcher Vehicles to prevent satellite detection, a sign of extreme caution.
At the same time, all data were offline, not fearing detection by the Intelligence Department of the alliance.
At this moment, the more than ten Followers of the Demon God Sect stood in front, in front of more than ten open boxes filled with red Federation Currency.
Kerr, leading them with a cold gaze, said solemnly, “Our Demon Sky Company always honors promises; the remaining money is placed here.”
Looking at the piles of red cash amounting to over ten million, greed flared in the eyes of all the mercenaries.
With over ten million Federation Currency, each of them could pocket two hundred thousand, and the mission was to unleash the ammunition they held and annihilate a convoy..

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 230 Ambushing Jack Clark, International Live Broadcast, The Bastard in the Car_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 230 Ambushing Jack Clark, International Live Broadcast, The Bastard in the Car_3
Translator: 549690339
Greedy as they were, the mercenaries never considered double-crossing.
Because they knew how terrifying these people were, each one bulletproof and immensely strong, almost more monstrous than the Mutated Beasts themselves.
If it hadn’t been for the fact that the people from Demon Sky Company couldn’t show their faces this time, to avoid revealing their identities and being targeted by the Federation, these mercenaries wouldn’t have had their turn.
Of course, any sane person would have their doubts about this reason.
After all, with such strength, the people from Demon Sky Company could simply clean up after themselves and not worry about being discovered.
Yet, at this moment, in Kerr’s pocket, a red stone was emitting invisible fluctuations, stirring the mercenaries’ greed to its utmost limits.
Under the amplification of insatiable greed, the mercenaries’ awareness was shrouded by the potential profits.
Just as the mercenaries entered the underground pathway and moved into the forest several kilometers away, a satellite in space captured some images.
Hum!
The ground shook as a massive airplane, arriving later than expected, descended from the sky and finally came to a slow stop on the designated runway.
On the runway, a queue of more than ten people and ten black business cars were waiting for them.
Though they wore ordinary suits, the sharpness in their eyes, their upright stances, and the oppressive aura they emitted all pointed to their extraordinary nature.
Some had fine scale patterns on their cheeks, others had unnaturally thick arms, and some even had eyes like those of beasts.
When Jack Clark and his party descended from the airplane, a middle-aged man wearing glasses stepped forward from the group and smiled, “Miss Ward, Ms. Boyce, 1 am Senator Dels of Mason.”
“Mr. Dels, hello. We’re sorry for the trouble we’ve brought on this visit.”
“Please, Ms. Boyce, no need for such words. We are all striving for the Federation’s stability and hope to root out more traitors this time.”
As he spoke, Dels introduced a man in his thirties with scale patterns on his face, “This is Mr. Laird, responsible for the military operation.”
After greetings were exchanged and a brief rundown of the situation, along with the delegation of tasks and what to do in case of an ambush, was discussed.
Soon, a convoy of more than ten business cars drove out of the airport.
No sooner had they hit the highway than Jack Clark noticed the scarcity of other vehicles, a clear sign that checkpoints had been set up ahead and behind them.
As the convoy made its way toward Mason, on the edge of the hillside forest in the middle of the route, Napoleon Knowles lay on the ground with a video camera aimed at the road below and explained.
“Friends from Eastern Summer, this is the must-pass road from the airport to
Mason, and Miss Ilisa’s convoy will pass through here shortly.”
“I’ve had Kasa set up by the roadside with a large stone ready.”
“As soon as I spot Miss Ilisa’s convoy from a distance, I’ll signal Kasa to push the stone onto the highway, blocking the convoy, with the aim of making the bodyguards get out of the cars.”
“When that ‘Hegemon’ bodyguard steps out, I will be able to precisely determine his true realm through a Secret Skill, facilitating our next move.”
In the Live Broadcast Room, the Super Second Generation was very satisfied, “Seeing Mr. Knowles so well-prepared, I’m even more confident in you guys.” “That’s professionalism.”
“1 didn’t expect advanced cultivators to be so cautious. 1 thought you’d rush in and take them down, hit and run—I find that exhilarating.”
“Uh… what is upstairs thinking? Do you think it’s just a street brawl, hit and run?”
At this moment, several hundred people were watching in the Live Broadcast Room, each of them extremely excited.
Meanwhile, in the forest across the highway a few hundred meters away, mercenaries wielding heavy weaponry were crouching behind bushes, checking their weapons.
Several mercenaries lay at the edge of the hillside, their heads adorned with camouflaged leaves, peering through binoculars toward the distance, one of them even spotting Knowles.
Beyond that, a dozen Followers of the Demon God Cult were scattered even further away, like cicadas being stalked by a mantis lying in wait.
Soon, as everyone waited, a convoy of more than ten business cars appeared at the end of the highway in the distance, but what was the deal with the person standing on top of one of the cars?

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 231: In Terms of Pretentiousness, I Admire You, A Punch to Ascend to Godhood, Dark Demon Eye (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 231: In Terms of Pretentiousness, I Admire You, A Punch to Ascend to Godhood, Dark Demon Eye (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Still dressed in a black suit and wearing sunglasses, Jack Clark stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his expression stern as he stood atop the first business car.
At that moment, with the vehicle speeding along, the roaring wind blew, causing his hair to wildly dance and the edge of his coat to rustle loudly.
It was then that a voice filled with suffering sounded through Jack’s earpiece, “Brother Callum, didn’t you say you’d let me handle it this time? What are you doing up on the roof of the car?”
Jack responded indifferently, “Of course, it’s to attract gunfire. Don’t forget what my perceptibility is like.”
…Faced with this question, the voice in his earpiece belonged to Damon Lopes, who felt even more troubled.
Alright, that guy was truly the only one he acknowledged, always showing off so effortlessly and naturally. Damon couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
At this moment, the convoy took a turn, and the view opened up.
Suddenly, the mercenaries, Demon Cultists, and the likes of Napoleon Knowles who were in ambush saw the convoy, including Jack standing on top of the car.
The ambush was set in this stretch.
Sensing those eyes fixed on him, Jack pressed a finger to his ear and connected to the convoy’s public channel, cautioning, “Attention, there are ambushes on both sides of the hillside ahead.”
“There are more than a dozen on the left, nine on the right.”
In an instant, everyone in the convoy turned solemn. From inside the car at Jack’s feet, Les spoke in a deep voice, “Proceed as planned, keep the convoy moving and be ready to stop at any moment.”
“Mr. Callum, Mr. Lopez, you’re the backup, so don’t make a move yet. Special Warfare Team members, be ready to strike, and eliminate all attackers without mercy.”
“Once we’ve finished them off, we can slowly investigate their identities. Mr. Lionel Lopez and the other ordinary bodyguards, be prepared to handle the fallout of the fight at close range.”
As the convoy drew closer, the atmosphere in the air inexplicably grew heavier, causing Napoleon to frown, sensing something was amiss.
As an expert at the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven and a practitioner of Genetic Martial Arts, his perceptibility was far more sensitive than that of ordinary cultivators.
However, compared to Napoleon, who felt something was off, the viewers in the Live Broadcast Room were taken aback.
Watching the convoy zooming closer in the video, along with that arrogant bodyguard standing above, one couldn’t help but criticize, “This guy really shows off every single moment, doesn’t he?”
“Yeah, he’s actually standing on top of the car. Does he think the northwest wind tastes good?”
Super Second Generation: “Flaha… this guy is a talent, I like him. Remember to hit him harder later, Mr. Napoleon.”
“Uh… why hit him harder if you like him?” someone asked in confusion.
Super Second Generation: “Because he looks too arrogant, which annoys me.
But 1 like the way he operates because I want to do the same.”
“Bro, you’re a real talent. Remember to add me as a friend later so I can reject you.”
As the Live Broadcast Room was swept up in hot discussion, suddenly dozens of figures emerged on the opposite hillside, and then firelight brightened. Bang bang bang bang!!
Five machine guns and four heavy machine guns spewed out endless firelight, while five sniper cannons also took aim at the leading business cars, triggering the shots in an instant.
At the same time, two single soldier rocket launchers blazed with fire, shooting out two rockets that screeched piercingly through the air.
At the very instant the mercenaries burst from the forest, the convoy of more than a dozen business cars came to a sudden stop.
Bang bang!! All car doors opened, and more than a dozen military experts leaped out.
A young man in his twenties, with Blue True Power erupting from his body and exuding the aura of Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, watched as two rockets shot towards him and waved his right claw.
In an instant, five blue claw marks, each extending 3 meters, tore through the sky.
Boom boom!
Under the sharp and powerful blue claw marks, two rockets exploded mid-air, twenty meters away.
At the same time, two military personnel flipped over their hands, pulling out two thick rhombus shields, which they planted into the ground. The shields unfolded instantly, forming an iron wall 2 meters high and 3 meters wide.
Soon after, black real power burst forth, and in a flash, black radiance shone on the shields, forming a colossal True Power shield wall five meters high and five meters wide.
Connected by two Transcendent shield walls, a black iron barrier spanning ten meters in front and five meters in height was formed, radiating an unshakable solidity.
Bang bang bang!!
In the blink of an eye, hundreds of bullets, capable of penetrating concrete walls, struck the True Power Energy Wall, and its powerful Kinetic Energy caused the wall to rumble continuously while the radiance exploded.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Then, the blasting bombs that were stuck to the True Power Energy Wall detonated violently, sending firelight flashing through the sky and causing the Qi Blood of the two military experts behind to boil.
But it was only their Qi Blood that boiled.
As experts of the Fifth Layer Heaven, with their True Strength converted to defense and bolstered by the Extraordinary Battle Shield, ordinary heavy firearms couldn’t breach their defenses.
This scene left not only Napoleon who was streaming for the International Proxy Group, but also Kasa a few dozen meters ahead, and those watching the remote live stream in the Live Broadcast Room utterly stunned.
What just happened?
At that moment, more mercenaries charged out of the forest on the hillside, wielding large-caliber mortars, single soldier cannons, and large-caliber thundering armor-piercing assault rifles.
“The heavy firearms bullets are potent and designed to target cultivators; be mindful of True Power Protection,” came the instruction over the channel.
“Life infrared detection counts seventy-five individuals, no strong fluctuations on them—they’re all ordinary people. Be wary of hidden cultists in the surroundings.”
“Numbers four and five, divide with me on the left. Numbers six through ten, rush over from the right. Don’t give them a chance to pour out ammunition, to avoid damaging the vehicles,” the voice commanded.
“The rest should guard the surroundings and be alert for hidden enemies.”
In just that instant, Les, the one in charge on behalf of the military, issued his commands, and figures exuding the aura of the Fifth, even Sixth Layer Heaven erupted..

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 231: Discussing boasting, I only respect you, one punch seals the god, dark demon eye (asking for monthly tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 231: Discussing boasting, I only respect you, one punch seals the god, dark demon eye (asking for monthly tickets)_2
For a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator, a distance of over a hundred meters could be crossed in a second. In an instant, Les, enveloped in white True Strength, charged up the hillside and struck with a palm.
Bang!
Palm prints spanning five meters collapsed the earth within tens of meters, causing an instant explosion that sent the machine gun and heavy machine gun-wielding mercenaries flying in all directions, flesh and blood splattering everywhere.
At the same time, a five-meter-long sword light swept across, forming a semi-circular dark glow.
Wherever it passed, the bodies of mercenaries were minced, trees collapsed, and a tens-of-meters-long Destruction Tunnel formed, causing chaos on the battlefield.
“Retreat! Retreat!”
-We’ve been deceived! There are Senior Cultivators, and lots of them!”
“It’s an ambush…”
“Spare us, we made a mistake!”
Bang!
From the ordinary mercenaries’ attack to the blink of an eye being crushed, it was only two to three seconds. Many people did not even have time to react before they were blown up.
Immediately, many of the remaining people frantically rushed into the depths of the forest, but they didn’t get far before they were smashed by the raging True Strength behind them, their corpses strewn everywhere.
However, these ordinary people were not meant to be the main force but rather to serve as the first wave of probing, drawing out the defensive forces around Mathilda Ward.
When the military experts took action, in the shadowy depths of the surrounding forest, a dozen dispersed Demon God Sect brutes watched coldly.
With a deep voice, Kula, carrying a certain low humming, said, “My God, twelve Five-Layer Heavens cultivators and one Sixth Heaven Middle Stage military expert have appeared.”
“Apart from that, according to the original information, the convoy’s defensive power is strong with two geniuses in the Early and Middle Stages of the Sixth Layer Heaven. We may not be able to breakthrough.”
A black strange rune flashed on the necks of all the Demon God Sect followers, and a deep, thick voice echoed in their ears: “Continue as planned.”
Chronological List Of Popes 1,”Believe in me and you will live forever. Today is your chance to cast off your weak human shell; go and embrace immortality. “Embrace immortality.” In that incantation-like low chant, the eyes of all the Demon God Sect followers turned red, filled with zealous faith.
“For my God, for eternity.”
“Today we dedicate ourselves, burning our flesh and souls. After death, we shall be reborn in the hell controlled by the great Demon God Kautorus!” “Burn everything, and we shall be reborn by the side of the great Kautorus!” Accompanied by the demon god sect followers’ shouts from all directions, black demonic qi erupted from their bodies at the Fourth and Fifth Layers, and even from the two Early Sixth Layer Heavens cultivators, burning them like fire
Under The Demonic Flames from the burning souls and flesh, the bodies of these Demon God Sect followers swelled rapidly, growing three to four meters tall in the blink of an eye, covered in grotesque, black-scale monsters.
Their auras explosively increased by several times under the magical transformation, emitting powerful auras. The black demonic qi shot up into the sky, forming plumes of black smoke.
A four-meter-tall Demon God Sect follower grabbed a massive boulder with a diameter of several meters and hurled it at the convoy over two hundred meters away.
White shockwaves appeared on the surface of the boulder, creating a rumbling sound as the air tore.
Bang! A Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven soldier jetted out in front of the convoy, wielding a combat knife that burst with Sword Qi, blasting the boulder in mid-air.
immediately, the whole person transformed into a red light that shot out, confronting the approaching Demon God Sect followers.
At the same time, the ground shook as seventeen burly monster-like figures with torrential demonic qi emanating from all directions charged like tanks.
Some jumped tens of meters high, and as they landed, the ground thundered and collapsed, with countless shattered rocks exploding in a horrifying manner.
One of the monsters even leaped over Napoleon Knowles’ head, emitting an invisible dark and violent aura that sent shivers down his spine.
On the side of the highway, Kasa lay on the ground with a pale face, staring at the frenzied, terrifying demons and asking, “What are those monsters?”
“Fool, be quiet!” Napoleon Knowles growled.
These monsters were too terrifying. Just one of them would be enough to kill them.
In the forest, Les, who had killed the mercenaries, focused his gaze on the Demon God Sect followers, his eyes filled with pure demonic qi, sensing a problem.
“Don’t let them get close to the convoy! Defense with full strength!
As the military personnel wore their battle armor, their size increased to three or even five meters. Their palms became thick and sharp like claws, and some even grew horns and scale armor.
At the same time, weapons like combat knives, long swords, and warhammers appeared in their hands, emitting powerful auras as the circular lights swirled around them.
Facing these frenzied demons, the Special Forces soldiers did not dare to be careless, as the True Strength on their bodies pulsated, resembling two groups of Unique Beasts colliding with each other.
Bang, bang, bang! In an instant, more than twenty advanced cultivators collided with each other.
A powerful shockwave erupted in a split second, causing the ground to shatter, trees to break, and smoke and dust to rise into the sky.
The rumbling vibrations echoed through Heaven and Earth, shaking the ground to the point where even the distant convoy could feel it. Dirt and rocks filled the air, an utterly terrifying scene.
As team leader, Les intercepted the two six-meter-tall demons who had become devil-like beings at the peak of the Sixth Heaven level by burning their flesh and souls.
Roar!
Around the demonified Kula, two black Demon Dragons, each over twenty meters long, swirled. Their arms waved, shattering the air and unleashing terrifying power that could topple mountains and rivers.
As disciples who had received the power of the War Demon Tribe, Kula and the others did not like to use weapons and had no need for them.
Under their magical transformation, their strength became boundless and unyielding, and their physical bodies became unbreakable, themselves becoming the most powerful weapons..

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 231 When It Comes to Showing Off, I Only Admire You, One Punch Ascends to Godhood, Dark Demon Eye (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 231 When It Comes to Showing Off, I Only Admire You, One Punch Ascends to Godhood, Dark Demon Eye (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
Boom! A six-meter-long white Sword Qi split into eight, illuminating Heaven and Earth, and in an instant, it tore through the black Demon Dragon and struck Kerr’s fists and arms.
The sharp Sword Qi tore through the demonic light, leaving trails of
Bloodstains. The powerful impact of the True Strength sent Kerr, at the peak of the Sixth Heavens, flying -an astonishing display of combat ability.
Roar! Just then, another Demon from the Sixth Heaven appeared behind Les. His thick arms clenched into fists, and with Black Demonic Qi swirling around them, a Chaos Demon Hammer descended from the sky.
Boom! With one strike, a twenty-meter radius of the Earth collapsed, and
countless pieces of dirt and rock burst apart.
Meanwhile, Kerr quickly got up from the ground as if nothing had happened, his arm and fist wounds already healed under the burning demonic gas.
Meanwhile, battles elsewhere were equally intense.
Special Warfare Teams, strong and well-equipped, and the Demons, more numerous and bursting with Qi Blood and soul, fought fiercely to a deadlock.
For a time, except for the two soldiers circling the convoy with their shields, battles erupted in all directions, the wild energy shaking Heaven and Earth.
Such a fearsome force deeply concerned Lionel Lopez and the others.
Some of the bodyguards, merely at the Triplex Realm, turned pale and trembled under the dark and evil Black Demonic Qi.
As the demonic individual’s Qi Blood and souls burned continuously, their auras grew stronger. Coupled with their numerical advantage, some even began to suppress the military soldiers.
Especially Kerr who had grown to six and a half meters tall, every movement emitted violent Black Demonic Qi. As his huge double claws waved, the air trembled with force, causing explosions in the Void.
Boom! Caught off-guard by the simultaneous attack of two peak Sixth Heaven Demons, Les was sent flying with a blast, skidding tens of meters away when he hit the ground.
Looking towards the convoy a hundred meters away, Kerr, who had sent Les flying, revealed a ferocious expression: “For my god, kill!”
Along with his mighty roar, Kerr waved his hand, and instantly, dozens of massive explosive packages hurtled toward the convoy, each loaded with tens of kilograms of high explosives.
One explosion was enough to decimate half of the convoy.
Simultaneously, a four-meter-tall Demon broke through the Special Forces’ blockade, its silhouette trailing a series of afterimages as it lunged toward the convoy, its expression savage and frenzied.
Suddenly, streaks of purple lightning roared, turning into snaking Light Beams tens of meters long, flashing across Heaven and Earth, instantly detonating the explosive packages mid-air.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Several fiery orbs, each spanning tens of meters in diameter, exploded in the sky, shaking Heaven and Earth, and the resultant scorching firelight and shockwaves formed a raging wind that swept across hundreds of meters.
Under the powerful pressure wave, the business car dozens of meters away vibrated continuously; some were even lifted halfway, their bulletproof glass shattered one after another.
“Miss Joseline, be careful.”
Lionel Lopez roared, “Block the shockwave with your body.”
Next to him, Damon Lopes was surrounded by an intense purple Thunder Light, his hair wildly flying, his eyes transformed into the shape of lightning, with sparks dancing around.
The formidable and terrifying Thunder enveloped a radius of tens of meters. Damon Lopes, wrapped in the Thunder Light, looked like a deity wielding lightning, emanating a terrifying Aura.
This was the true posture of an Innate Awakened One.
Amidst the encircling lightning and the howling raging wind, the thunderously powerful Damon Lopes slowly turned his head, looking towards Jack in the business car, and said in a deep voice, “Brother Callum, I leave this place to you.”
Jack nodded calmly, “Go, end the battle quickly.”
This time, the elite of the Demon God Sect had all launched an offensive, and Les and the others were starting to be overwhelmed by burning everything.
Boom! Surrounded by Thunder, Damon Lopes slowly rose off the ground and headed toward a distant location, his Daoist robe fluttering, much to the shock of Marla Fiore inside the car.
Lionel Lopez and the others were also gaping in amazement- Damon Lopes
was flying.
Jack just shook his head slightly.
An Eighth Layer Expert could briefly walk on air, a Nine Layers Expert could stand high in the sky and glide far with the aid of a force field, and a Ninth Heaven Expert could fly and burrow through Heaven and Earth with their domain.
But Damon Lopes, still within the Six Heavens, couldn’t fly-instead, he used the power of Thunder to create an electromagnetic field to offset gravity and floated up.
This maneuver was something even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast could accomplish, but the slight buoyancy was nowhere near enough to lift the massive and terrifying beast off the ground.
Damon Lopes stretched out his hand, and in an instant, a thigh-thick bolt of Thunder roared out, turning into a several-meters-long light, enveloping the charging Demon.
Boom!
Under the power of the Innate Purple Thunder, the Demon, exuding the strength of the Fifth Layer Heaven, let out a piercing scream as its solid and formidable Demon Body burst into pieces with a blast.
That was the terrifying power of Innate Thunder, possessing an unrivaled Instantaneous Explosion and destructive capability.
Boom, boom, boom!!
With Damon Lopes joining the battlefield, his hands summoned thundering strikes, roaring like a dragon as he slaughtered the demons as if they were mere chickens, displaying unrivaled domination and an unparalleled aura. Meanwhile, as the battle raged on, one of the followers of the Demon God Cult didn’t transform but instead coldly watched the convoy, holding a walkie-talkie in hand.
“Launch.”
With the command of the Demon Cultist, miles away from the warehouse outside, mercenaries inside two rocket launcher vehicles that had already adjusted their firing angles, pressed the launch buttons.
Pfft!
A rocket on the launch pad ignited, followed by a scorching blast that shot out with a whoosh, the sharp, piercing sound echoing between heaven and earth, immediately after came the second, third, and fourth rockets… In the blink of an eye, the sky was flooded with white trails.
Two dozen rockets, each more than six meters long and nearly forty centimeters in diameter, packed with 200 kilograms of solid high explosives, roared through the sky.
And almost as soon as the rockets were launched, the Command Center reacted.
However, for rockets accelerating to twice the supersonic speed in a blink of an eye from an initial velocity of several dozen meters per second, it was only a matter of seconds over a distance of several miles.
“Be careful, there are twenty-four conventional rockets heading your way.”
“Everyone take cover.”
Compared to a man-portable launcher, these conventional rockets were far more terrifying; even a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator would suffer heavy injuries if they were hit head-on.
It goes without saying for ordinary people; dozens of rockets raining down would scatter thousands of explosive rounds, enough to cover a vast area and obliterate everything in the resulting explosive shockwaves.
“Rockets, of all things,” Jack Clark said with some surprise as he looked at the distant sky, his eyes filled with curiosity as he watched the missiles speeding toward them.
This was his first close encounter with missile-level heavy firepower.
However, just as the twenty-odd rockets closed to within hundreds of meters of the convoy, the two soldiers who had been holding shields suddenly threw them aside and somehow produced a special firearm.
Biubiubiu!!
Boom! Boom! Boom! Under the assault of instantaneous black light beams, the rockets in the sky exploded one by one, turning into giant sparks.
At the same time, more than a dozen slashes of Sword Qi soared into the sky from below.
But… the Sword Qi began to dissipate just twenty meters up, leaving the two Special Forces Soldiers who had released the Sword Qi looking somewhat embarrassed.
“Watch out!”
“Get out of the way quickly!”
The faces of many in the convoy paled as they saw the remaining rockets looming overhead, and the Special Forces soldiers in the distance also showed panic.
This is bad, there are too many, and the laser weapons can’t intercept them all. At this moment, only Mathilda Ward, Crystal Boyce, and Damon Lopes far away remained composed because they knew they would be safe.
Jack Clark’s presence burst forth with an earth-shaking, terrifying force, lhe Void Ferocious Dragon roared, and as he clenched his right fist, an indescribable power gathered, launching a forceful punch.
Boom!
In an instant, everyone’s senses were rattled, they went deaf, and it felt as though the entire heaven and earth were rumbling and shaking.
Under Jack Clark’s terrifying punch, the air within dozens of meters in the high sky congealed, compressed into a transparent, solid fist print by an overwhelming force.
With that overbearing punch, the rockets were obliterated in an instant, followed by an earth-shaking, violent explosion.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The fiery explosions lit up the sky, and the searing blast waves swept through heaven and earth. Amid the howling winds, Jack Clark stood at the top of the vehicle, his invisible, dominating aura permeating everything around him. This scene was captured by Napoleon Knowles, and like him, everyone in the live broadcast room gaped in disbelief at the spectacle.
A single punch had obliterated a dozen rockets—what kind of terrifying power was that!!
The International Proxy Group was instantly in turmoil, and even journalists lurking in the group started editing clips, overwhelmed with excitement.
They knew they were going to make headlines, as the video would certainly go viral once released.
And after his punch obliterated a dozen rockets, amid the raging storm, Jack Clark’s gaze turned coldly to a point far in the distance, where nothing was visible.
But through his Heart’s Eye, he saw a pair of terrifying Demon Eyes quietly observing everything from afar, even making eye contact with his Heart’s Eye. The Demon God Sect, the demon king, has finally appeared. Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly..

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - 232 Glenn Clark: Mom, my brother is too awesome. Chasing after the demon king.
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Chapter 232 Glenn Clark: Mom, my brother is too awesome. Chasing after the demon king.
Just as those two rocket launcher vehicles had finished launching their rockets, a shrill whistling sound filled the air as several missiles descended from the sky.
Boom, boom!!
Dazzling firelight exploded, instantly destroying the two rocket launcher vehicles.
Shortly after, several more missiles rained down, enveloping the abandoned warehouse. Boom, boom!! The violent explosions instantly killed two mercenaries.
In the midst of the fiery blaze that burned fiercely, several figures sprinted over from the distance. After a search, they said solemnly, “Report, we only found two mercenaries’ corpses and some counterfeit money here.”
Hundreds of kilometers away in the Military Base, the large screen displayed the convoy’s high-definition satellite imagery; the furious aftermath of the combat had turned the surroundings into ruins.
The hillside collapsed, the forest was burned to ashes.
And on the highway several kilometers away, law enforcement teams had established checkpoints, not allowing any vehicles to pass through.
“A Sixth Layer Heaven, five in the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and eight in the late period of the Fourth Layer Heaven… The Demon God Sect actually hid so many Advanced Cultivators.”
“That’s normal; the main forces that Koroya exterminated last time were from the Blood God Sect and the Giant God Sect.”
“Although the main forces of the Demon God Sect, Shadow God Sect, and Black Horned God Sect were suppressed, some of their external members were scattered in different locations and thus escape the calamity.”
“But this time, the remaining forces of the Demon God Sect should have all been drawn out. The remaining small fry can’t stir up any trouble; just track them down and we’ll be able to exterminate them.”
As he spoke, the eagle-browed middle-aged man turned to one side and said in a deep voice, “Have you detected any high-frequency divine soul fluctuations?”
The staff member below shouted loudly, “Report, the Soul Crystals carried by Les and the others have not reacted, and no king-level divine soul fluctuations have been detected within ten kilometers of the battlefield.”
A Colonel below furrowed his brow slightly, “Was this just a probe?”
“No, not just a probe, but a combination of feints and real attacks.”
The glasses-wearing strategist shook his head, “The signal we tracked a few days ago originates from Pulo Town, over 700 kilometers away, combined with the communications content we retrieved at the time.”
“We can be certain that Kautorus is nearby, but he’s hiding very deeply.”
“These guys are cunning. Knowing that we are waiting for them, they will be extremely cautious and won’t make a move without a sure win.”
The eagle-browed middle-aged man said solemnly, “No matter how cautious they are, Akunus will definitely make a move before Mathilda Ward enters hibernation. We just need to wait patiently.”
“Otherwise, if she dies from soul exhaustion, the dragon will also disappear, and Akunus will never allow it.”
“It has been waiting for this day for over a decade. If it weren’t for the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s disappearance, he wouldn’t dare to show up, let alone carve out a soul avatar to sneak back to Blue Star.”
“As for Kautorus, it is different from Akunus. The dying Ilisa doesn’t hold as much attraction for it.”
“To make it take the risk, we must up the ante, so much so that it feels it’s worth it, even if it loses this soul avatar.”
The strategist below narrowed his eyes, “Are you suggesting… Innate Awakened Ones?”
The eagle-browed middle-aged man nodded, “Didn’t we intentionally let two ‘mice’ into the combat zone this time? Eastern Summer probably has the same idea.”
“Through their hands, we indirectly released the news about Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One, especially emphasizing how strong Innate Awakened Ones are and their potential, as touted by Gunardo.”
“At that point, I don’t believe Kautorus will be able to resist. An Innate Awakened One at merely Sixth Layer Heaven could almost be equivalent to killing a Half-step King.”
“As for Damon Lopes’ safety, don’t worry. Preparations have been made well in advance. Revealing his identity is actually part of the plan.”
“Just wait and see, the game has just begun.”
“Two soul avatars are not worth our grand gestures; our target is their True Bodies…”
“Holy, holy, holy!! I’m fired up.”
“What did I just see? So many missiles blown up with a single punch!!”
“Epic, I think I’m gonna be a fan; that was so cool.”
As Jack Clark punched and exploded the sky full of missiles, the International Proxy Group’s Live Broadcast Room erupted in excitement. University students, office workers, homebodies, all holding their mobile phones, were dumbfounded.
Even Glenn Clark had his mouth wide open, disbelieving as he watched the figure standing on top of the vehicle, whose overbearing and unparalleled aura was shocking.
So powerful, so much so that Glenn couldn’t help but doubt if he had gotten it wrong.
Wasn’t his brother just at Fourth Layer Heaven? Could a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator be so strong? Or had his brother’s strength undergone an even more exaggerated breakthrough in the past two months?
While everyone was shocked and surprised, the battle quickly subsided.
In the hands of the bodyguard in the Daoist robe wielding Thunder, those creatures surrounded by black aura, looking like demons, were blown up one by one with a single strike.
Even creatures seven meters tall and moving so fast they were almost invisible were blown up by the descending Purple Thunder Dragon, leaving a massive crater on the ground.
The strength of the two sides was not on the same level at all.
“Is this the strength of an advanced cultivator? So powerful, not at all like those martial arts hall strongmen.”
“Definitely, those martial arts hall cultivators are all for show. They’ve never seen blood. Look, this is what a real battlefield is like, everything blown away with a single strike.”
The Super Second Generation were also somewhat shocked, “No wonder that bodyguard was so cocky, blowing up a sky full of rockets with a single punch. His cultivation must start at least from the Sixth Layer Heaven.”

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 232 Glenn Clark: Mom, my brother is too awesome. Chasing after the demon king_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Chapter 232 Glenn Clark: Mom, my brother is too awesome. Chasing after the demon king_2
Tyrion Luther: “The strength of the Sixth-level Heaven isn’t this formidable, this guy is at least a Seventh Layer high-order powerhouse.”
“How do you know that?”
The official undercover agent Tyrion Luther chuckled: “1 got lucky and witnessed a Seventh Layer powerhouse take action, so 1 have a bit of understanding regarding the strength of high-order cultivators.”
“Hiss! A Seventh Layer high-order powerhouse, 1 think someone mentioned last time that he’s not even twenty years old.”
“Not even twenty and at the Seventh Layer, what kind of monster is he!?”
“Such a Monster Genius actually became a bodyguard for Mathilda Ward, isn’t her background too exaggerated? What does her family do?”
“I heard that Mathilda Ward’s family has a significant military background…”
Tyrion Luther reminded: “Did you guys notice the young man in the Daoist robe holding the lightning? I feel that he is even stronger than Darren Callum.”
“That guy does look really strong, but he’s not handsome enough, not interesting, I still think that punch from Darren Callum was cooler.”
“Are you guys getting the focus wrong? No matter how strong this guy is, it has nothing to do with us, the question now is whether Mr. Napoleon Knowles can beat him?”
In an instant, the chat group fell silent, and Denny Knowles, holding the video camera, tightened his butt.
Old man, brothers, let’s not talk about this topic, okay? I’m just an Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven cultivator, going head-on against a Seventh Layer high-order powerhouse.
Luckily, no one is paying attention to him now. Those in the Live Broadcast Room have already started releasing their excitement on their social circles.
Soon, with these people sharing and spreading, videos and screenshots quickly spread online, even making their way to some online forums swiftly.
And the images for covers or screenshots all highlighted the Overbearing scene where Damon Lopes, encircled by lightning, stood in the air, wielding a thunderous strike that shattered a demon.
As for the scene where Jack Clark stood on the car roof and blasted away dozens of rockets with a punch, it also spread, but it couldn’t compare to Damon Lopes in terms of popularity.
Especially when terms like Innate Awakened Ones and “guaranteed to become king-level within ten years” were intermixed, they were particularly eye-catching.
It was already six o’clock, and when Doris Clark came home from work and saw Glenn Clark’s shoes at the entrance, she called out: “Jim, you’ve come back so early today?”
“Mom, bro was so badass, at the Seventh Layer, Seventh Layer Heaven!”
“…What are you talking about?” Doris Clark was somewhat baffled as she looked at the excited and thrilled Glenn Clark upstairs.
The battlefield was filled with smoke, and flames burned.
Jack Clark stood coldly on the car roof, his gaze set in the distance.
Then, with a flash of lightning, Damon Lopes appeared at the side of the car, his demeanor free and easy: “Brother Callum, all the enemies have been killed, come down.”
On the car roof, Jack Clark indifferently said: “No rush, I’ll stand here a little longer.”
“You’re really something,” admiration showed on Damon Lopes’s face.
The fight was over, yet he still wanted to stand on the car roof to show off for a while—this thick-skinned approach was so impressive that even I have to admire the king of cool, but this time, definitely without my occasion to shine.
Ha ha… Thinking of this, Damon Lopes felt a sense of relief.
Without minding Damon Lopes, Jack Clark’s gaze grew more serious because those Demon Eyes were still there, watching them continuously through someone else’s eyes.
And the enemy was even stronger than Tyler Lance and the others had estimated. The imperceptible gaze even made him feel ‘a bit’ of danger now.
True to a Demon King Level Strong one.
And besides strength, their methods were also very peculiar.
Because it was ‘refracting’ through another person’s eyes, Jack Clark couldn’t pinpoint its position through vision, only able to vaguely sense the general direction of the other party.
And the other party was very far from him, probably more than ten kilometers away.
However, if he could find and eliminate this King’s Avatar lurking nearby…
Jack Clark’s eyes flickered, and suddenly he said: “Mr. Lopes, take good care of Miss Ward and the others, I need to leave for a bit.”
Damon Lopes’s eyes condensed: “Found something?”
Jack Clark spoke softly: “I have some vague sensations, but can’t lock onto the location. 1 want to see if I can draw it out.”
“We can’t both leave. One must stay to protect Miss Ward, to prevent a possible lurking Akunus. I don’t trust anyone else to do it,” he added solemnly.
Damon Lopes spoke gravely: “Are you confident?”
“As long as 1 want to leave, it can’t hold me,” said Jack Clark, his tone calm, exuding strong confidence.
He didn’t mention killing or suppressing that King’s Avatar; after all, that was a King-level existence, and even if it was just an Avatar, it wouldn’t be that simple.
Who knew what Secret Skills or demonic arts the other party had mastered since defeat and killing were two different concepts.
When there’s only a slight difference of one or two lesser realms in the strength between two sides, the weaker one can escape with injuries if they are willing to flee, unless they choose to fight to the death.
Jack Clark continued: “Don’t worry, 1 won’t be reckless. Even if I lock onto its position, I’ll only tie it down and wait for the high-ranking powerhouses to arrive.”
In order to prevent the enemy from fearing to show up, the military did station Eighth Layer Experts at each base, but they typically remained a hundred kilometers away.
A distance of over a hundred kilometers was merely a few minutes’ journey for an Eighth Layer Expert.
“Be careful.”
Damon Lopes said no more, for he knew that Jack Clark’s strength was not inferior to his, and holding off the King’s Avatar for several minutes was not a problem at all.
As the imposing figure of Les approached, Jack couldn’t help but point in the direction of Napoleon Knowles and his companion: “Major Les, there are two more over there.”
“Don’t, don’t kill us.”
“We surrender, we were just passing by.”
“Yes, just passing by…”
No sooner had Jack spoken than Napoleon Knowles at the edge of the forest on the hillside and Kasa a few dozen meters away lying behind some weeds stood up in a panic.
Both men held their hands high in a gesture of surrender.
Helpless, for these guys were too fearsome, they worried that if they surrendered too late, they’d be straightaway blasted by the enemy as attackers.
Looking at the two men, Jack’s feet thundered beneath him.
Boom! Jack leaped hundreds of meters into the air, his silhouette traced an arc and smashed into the forest three hundred meters away, the dirt exploded beneath his feet, and the ground trembled.
In an instant, a Demon Cultist lying on the ground twenty-odd meters away, who was concealing his aura and retreating, was taken aback.
Boom!
With a punch from Jack, the terrifying pressure of the fist exploded instantaneously, the air in front directly compressed by the horrifying strength into a ten-meter diameter golden fist imprint.
Boom!
Under the unrivaled domination of the golden fist imprint, the Earth collapsed, dirt flew, and trees within tens of meters range were violently snapped under the fierce energy, with raging winds howling.
And that Demon Cultist was directly obliterated, leaving not even a trace of flesh and blood, including the high-definition video camera he carried.
In the midst of the raging wind wave, Jack stood quietly and steadfast.
“Those eyes are gone, but I still have a slight feeling.” Jack looked into the distance, his hand by his ear, pressing lightly.
“This is Darren Callum, and I’ve vaguely sensed some traces of that demon king; I’m preparing to make a move myself to see if 1 can draw it out.”
“What!”
Everyone at the rear base stood up, they hadn’t expected Jack to actually detect Kautorus’s traces.
The middle-aged man with eagle-like eyebrows spoke gravely, “Tell him to prioritize his own safety. If he really encounters the enemy, just hold on; support will arrive very shortly.”
“Notify General Lake immediately, send Darren’s coordinates to him, and have him maintain a distance of fifty kilometers.”
For a Demon King’s Avatar, the threat posed by an Eighth Layer Expert was too great; they couldn’t get too close, or else they would be detected by the King’s Divine Soul’s subtle senses.
Jack’s figure moved, instantly turning into a dark shadow that shot out, vanishing from the forest in the blink of an eye.
At the same time, the powerful’ aura of a Sixth Heaven Middle Stage burst forth unrestrained.
And as Jack, emitting his aura, approached the small town over ten kilometers away, a fleeting aura blinked far in the distance, more than ten kilometers away from him.
Whoosh!!
Jack’s figure burst into the small town ahead, the heavy steps on the asphalt cracked it, and the winds he brought with him caused many screams of terror.
In just a few breaths, Jack crossed the small town with a trail of afterimages.
At that moment, that seemingly nonexistent aura blinked again, ten kilometers away.
“Luring me over, are you.”
Jack’s eyes flashed, not hesitating; he crushed the ground beneath him and shot out at a balanced and constant speed with the other, while his voice resounded in his earpiece.
“The enemy is leading me there, towards Mason City.”
A serious voice came through Jack’s earpiece, “Watch out, try not to engage in the city.”
“1 understand.”
With the combat power of Jack and a Demon King’s Avatar above the Seventh Layer, engaging in a battle within the city would cause tremendous destruction, and the fallout would result in countless deaths and injuries.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!!
On another road, Jack’s figure appeared, sprinting at high speed and overtaking car after car, causing the drivers to cry out in shock.
In just over a few minutes, Jack, with a normal speed of two hundred meters per second, had crossed over thirty kilometers and entered the bustling Mason City.
But because of the distant, Jack could still only vaguely sense and could not pinpoint the exact location of the other party without being seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - 233: The Battle of Gods and Demons, Emperor Dragon Form, King’s Fall (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Chapter 233: The Battle of Gods and Demons, Emperor Dragon Form, King’s Fall (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
On the constantly moving street filled with vehicles, a figure swiftly weaved through the traffic.
Squeal, squeal, squeal!!
On the road, a luxury sports car darted through the traffic, causing the drivers on both sides to swear continuously, while the two young men in the car cheered.
“You fools, if you’re not convinced, try to chase after the old man?
“Haha, Kors, how could those junk cars possibly catch up with us? They’re just
eating our dust.”
Boom!
Suddenly, with a kick, the luxury sports car swerved sideways for over a dozen meters and smashed violently against the curb, the side of the car crumpled.
Jack Clark, who kicked the car aside, disappeared in a flash, leaving behind a crowd of onlookers gasping in shock.
Suddenly, as he reached the City Center, Jack slowed his pace.
in the distance at the crossroads, a towering figure over 2 meters tall, resembling a small giant, stood silently waiting for him.
“NO, fool, move away!” A truck, with the driver shouting, couldn’t stop in time and crashed towards Kautorus.
Thud!
The truck collapsed, shattered, and countless shards of glass exploded, while the towering figure remained immobile, even grabbing the front of the truck and flinging it with a great heave.
Boom!
The several-ton truck flew through the air like a toy, crashing heavily into shops in the distance, with walls collapsing and smoke and dust filling the air as the truck exploded.
This was accompanied by the wails and terrified screams of many people around.
Jack, standing dozens of meters away, watched this scene with an indifferent gaze and whispered into his earpiece, “The target has appeared, but stopped in the City Center.”
“We can’t fight in the City Center, General Lake, project your aura to drive it out of the city, Darren Callum, keep it from escaping.”
“Notify the Mason Law Enforcement Team to urgently evacuate people ahead in the direction of Darren Callum’s advance.”
Along with the dreadful aura that burst in the sky, the menacing might that contained the pressure of Heaven and Earth approached at a shocking speed.
Kautorus frowned suddenly, his voice thundering, “1 had intended to see the strength of this so-called Human Clan Genius, but it seems I will have to burst your head next time.”
Whoosh!
Kautorus instantly turned into a dark shadow and disappeared, moving like a blink of an eye, appearing hundreds of meters away in a few flashes with astonishing speed.
Boom!
The ground within a one-yard radius around Jack collapsed, golden flames burning on his body as he burst forth with supersonic speed in chase.
Behind him, a long trail of white waves roared, shattering the windows of sedans as the sonic boom reverberated, whipping up a raging wind.
Compared to the soundless Kautorus moving at supersonic speeds, Jack, relying on his formidable physical strength to reach supersonic speed, presented even more shock and destructive power.
And he was even faster.
With an agility exceeding 1700 points, Jack’s full-strength burst allowed him to reach a terrifying speed of 700 meters per second, almost double that of supersonic.
Therefore, in just a few seconds, he had closed the distance to Kautorus.
Such a terrifying burst of speed even startled Kautorus.
As a King-level strong man, its movement speed even exceeded ten times the speed of sound, but that was under peak conditions.
Currently, while hosting a body, it relied on Demon Clan Secret Skills to reach 400 meters per second, but the moving speed of this Human Clan Genius was so much faster than its own!?
Seeing this, Kautorus grabbed a sedan with one arm amidst the screams of the occupants and hurled it backwards at Jack, who was following, creating a thunderous wind and an explosive wave.
Seeing the sedan appearing before him in an instant, Jack was about to reach out to catch the sedan and save the driver inside but instinctively dodged to the side.
Boom!!
The sedan hit the ground and instantly erupted in firelight, followed by a violent explosion. Simultaneously, a strange black radiance exploded, corroding and breaking the ground in a ten-meter radius.
Corrosion power. Jack frowned slightly, then within an instant flashed forward in pursuit once again.
Whoo! At that moment, an emergency shelter alarm sounded over Mason City, causing everyone to pause before a wave of panic ensued on the streets.
“What’s happened?”
“Don’t know, let’s find shelter first.”
“Be careful, there’s a monster in the distance…”
Boom boom boom!!
On the road, sedans, trucks, vans were continuously grabbed by Kautorus, turned into giant cannonballs under that terrible strength and hurled at Jack.
For a time, two streets were submerged in firelight, cries, and screams, forcing Jack to maintain a distance of over a hundred meters, not daring to get too close.
In front, Kautorus’s eyes showed a cold and cruel light, flickering with a sinister glow.
However, it seemed wary of Jack recklessly attacking and entangling it, so Kautorus stopped the senseless killing and even deliberately avoided some ordinary people.
Seeing this, Jack’s icy gaze flickered, and he chose not to strike immediately.
Soon, the two chased across a large part of the city. Occasionally, a car blocking the way was blown up, and amidst a sky lit with flames, two figures swiftly passed, one chasing the other.
But as they approached the suburbs, Kautorus came to a sudden halt and turned around abruptly, a pair of pitch-dark Demon Eyes opening on his cheeks.
As those pitch-dark Demon Eyes fixed on Jack, in Jack’s vision Heaven and Earth shattered, turning into a dark Void. From it, a towering figure tens of thousands of feet tall slammed down with a hand, causing Heaven and Earth to crumble.
Soul attack!
Roar! A Dragon Roar Elephant Roar emerged from behind Jack, a colossal figure covered in scale armor and sharp spikes resembling a mix between a dragon and an elephant appeared.
At the brow of the Dragon Elephant, a rune, neither sword nor knife-like, shone, turning into a giant blade that cleaved through Heaven and Earth, it was the rarely used Blade of Void Cutting Rune, which annihilated all nothingness power..

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 233: Battle of God Demons, Emperor Dragon Form, King’s Fall (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: Chapter 233: Battle of God Demons, Emperor Dragon Form, King’s Fall (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
Boom!
The void blade struck the sky-covering demon’s palm, resulting in a slight standoff. Then with a thunderous crash, the heavens and the earth seemed to split, and the endless darkness shattered under the strike.
It was actually the power of illusory runes that had transformed into a knife, blocking my Destruction God’s Demon Eye.
No, that rune blade, though sharp, was of low completeness. It wasn’t enough to shatter my Shadow of the Demon Eye. What really destroyed the shadow was his soul strength.
To unleash such formidable power with a low-grade rune, his soul strength must be at least ten times that of a life with Six Path Devil Marks!
With that thought, Kautorus’s terrifying intent to kill erupted, and he stared at Jack Clark with a murderous rage as if they were sworn enemies who couldn’t share the same sky.
At that moment, an immensely evil aura of a blood sea emerged from another direction outside the city, getting even closer to that Eighth Layer Expert.
Instantly, the aura of the Eighth Layer Expert faltered.
As that wicked, bloody aura appeared, Kautorus held nothing back.
Boom!
An endless surge of black demonic qi erupted, and in an instant, a terrifying demonic power soared to the skies, changing the color of heaven and earth. The entire sky was shrouded by the overwhelming demonic qi.
In a world darkened as if by dusk, a monstrous shadow projection towering over thirty meters tail-adorned with black scale armor and sporting a dragon tail—emerged, as if it were the Hell Demon King himself.
Or perhaps, it truly was a demon king from hell.
Crackle, Crackle!!
Under the manifestation of the King’s Intent, space itself seemed unable to bear the strain, sounding like shattering glass, while the surrounding streets cracked and sank continuously.
“No good, high-ranking powerhouses are battling, run for it!
“Run fast!”
Some knowledgeable individuals on the streets paled at the sight of the towering monstrous shadow, running frantically under its oppressive aura.
Fortunately, this area was close to the suburbs, with less dense construction, and thanks to the earlier emergency warnings, there weren’t many people on the streets.
Towering under the demon king’s shadow, surrounded by dark demonic qi, Kautorus’s figure swelled to five meters tall, his dark red eyes revealing a low, rumbling voice.
“Originally, I could not be bothered with you, but unfortunately, you’re asking for death.”
“What’s most important is that you possess such an abundant soul power; by the mandate of the Great Heaven Demon God, any Human Tribe’s genius soul exceeding the standard by five times must be slain!”
In the information given to it by Akunus, this Human Clan Genius was very perceptive, but his combat power was estimated to be only at the initial stage of Seven Path Demon Marks,
Even if that expert with Eight Path Demon Marks came over with all his strength, it would take a few minutes; more than enough time for it to deal with this Human Clan Genius.
Boom!
With a slash of Kautorus’s demon blade, a black blade light over ten meters long swept across two meters above the ground, covering a range of dozens of meters.
The terrifying Sword Qi contained indescribable powers of destruction, causing the street to collapse, vehicles to shatter, and ordinary people who couldn’t escape in time to burst into a mist of blood.
At the same time, the monstrous shadow of the demon king thirty meters tall performed the same action. A sword phantom tens of meters long slashed through the sky, creating a tear, as if splitting heaven and hell.
Just as the blade struck, Jack Clark’s figure plummeted. Locked by the King’s Intent, he could neither dodge nor escape.
Boom!
Countless golden lights burst forth from Jack Clark, forming roaring flames.
His ferocious and overbearing intent surged to the heavens as if an exceptional ferocious beast had been awoken.
Boom!
A War Halberd radiating golden halberd skill spun through the air, the violent wind wave it dragged shattered the sweeping Sword Qi, blocking the heavens with a furious roar of energy.
Boom!
The tens of meters long demon blade illusory image struck the War Halberd, and immediately the earth collapsed within a twenty-something meter radius around Jack Clark, leaving a crack spanning twenty-something meters behind him.
Everything in its path was destroyed, including a ten-story building some dozen meters away. Concrete exploded, directly demolished by the aftershock of that slash.
This was the power of the true martial arts phantom-no, it should be said to be the Demon King’s shadow, forcefully condensed by the King’s Intent, gathering Heavenly Energy to erupt with dozens of times more destructive force.
Such tremendous power was beyond the ability of any ordinary Seventh Layer Heaven Cultivator to withstand.
Yet at that moment, under the tens of meters long Demon Blade Illusory Image, the War Halberd shining with golden halberd radiance stood immovable.
Seeing Jack Clark, calm and composed, his hands merged with the demonic shadow, pressing down hard on the War Halberd, Kautorus’s expression turned even more ferocious as it bellowed in a deep voice.
Damned fool, to think you’ve deceived me.
At this moment, Kautorus was full of anger, feeling tricked by Akunus; this perceptive Human Tribe Genius’s combat power was far from the initial stage of Seven Demon Marks.
With the demonic shadow manifestation empowered by the Demon King’s Will, its strength had surged thirty-something times, reaching the mid period of Seven Demon Marks.
On top of that, with the boost from its demonic power, a cultivator at the initial stage of Seven Demon Marks would be heavily injured by a single blade strike, yet…
At that moment, an indescribable terrifying power exploded from Jack Clark, causing his arms to tremble with the shockwave.
Boom!
Kautorus was blasted away like a cannonball, and the Demon King shadow retreated several steps with an explosive noise, its phantom-long knife shattered by the fearsome True Dragon Power.
As Kautorus was being knocked back, fragments flew from Jack Clark’s wrist, instantly transforming into a golden red gorgeous battle armor that covered his entire body.
Behind his head, four gears of varying sizes floated, slowly rotating with blue lightning jumping between them and golden flames burning.
Simultaneously, the bloodstain on Jack Clark’s brow emerged, unleashing an endless blood light that expanded from him, forming a sea of blood and a blood river hell spanning thirty meters in diameter..

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 233: Battle of God Demons, Emperor Dragon Form, King’s Fall (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 233: Battle of God Demons, Emperor Dragon Form, King’s Fall (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
Facing the crazed murderous intent of Kautorus, Jack Clark dared not take it lightly.
The street, instantly turned to ruins, filled on one side with boundless demon gas towering to 30 meters, the phantom of the demon king standing tall; on the other side, a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, the fierce Dragon Might omnipresent.
In contrast to Kautorus, whose demon power filled the sky in the distance, Jack Clark seemed like a Hell Suppressing Light King who dominated hell itself.
“What a formidable aura, your Life Mark Wheel only has seventeen marks, yet you have grown… No, as your Human Race says, cultivated.”
“Cultivating to the intermediate stage of the Six-Stage Demon Marks at such an age, with powerful combat strength, and with that tenfold soul strength, your potential is no less than the descendants of our clan’s Demon Gods.”
“Compared to your value, the daughter of the Mysterious Martial King is no longer worth mentioning. Today, you must die, you must die.”
The more monstrous the talent Jack Clark demonstrated, the stronger Kautorus’s killing intent surged, and with a roar, the phantom behind him lunged towards him.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In an instant, boundless black Demonic Flames surged to the sky, and Kautorus’s form began to shrink, condensing to 2 meters amidst a cacophony of cracks.
Yet, his aura was now incredibly terrifying. The black demonic gas around him solidified, covering more than ten meters, and his aura had increased tenfold.
Under that oppressively terrifying presence, the surrounding space emitted sounds of being unable to bear the load, and the ground below cracked and shattered continuously, an utterly shocking sight.
“Madman!” Jack Clark’s expression grew solemn.
Kautorus’s move was similar to the Mysterious Martial King’s phantom entering the body in the Eight Layer Heaven, gathering the power of Heaven and Earth and divine powers, possessing unparalleled terrifying power.
But the body he possessed was only at the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, incapable of carrying the vast Power of Heaven and Earth, and within minutes this body would collapse.
And yet, the two had only exchanged two moves, almost as if they had unleashed their powerful attacks from the start, the kind where if the enemy didn’t die, they themselves would perish first, the suicidal technique of the demon race.
Just like those madmen from the Blood God Sect.
Suddenly, Kautorus disappeared, and Jack Clark’s expression changed slightly as he swept his halberd to the left.
Boom!
Under the annihilating black blade light, the red domain was torn apart, and Jack Clark was knocked back with a loud crash, transforming into a shadow that collapsed a building 20 some meters away.
Kautorus appeared where Jack Clark had just stood, and then with a flash of teleportation, he was dozens of meters above the ruins.
Boom, boom, boom!! Kautorus conjured blade Qi from the sky with his hands, each measuring fifteen meters long and intertwined with black demon gas, slashing down in an overwhelming barrage from above.
Under the sharp and terrifying blade Qi, the earth trembled, the heavens roared, and everything within a hundred-meter radius was destroyed by the explosive black blade Qi.
Many ordinary people hiding in their homes or behind buildings were instantly shredded by the stray destructive demon gas, and the area was immediately littered with bodies as piercing cries and screams echoed through heaven and earth.
Roar!
A ferocious dragon roar bellowed, and amidst the billowing smoke and dust, an indescribable terrifying aura erupted, shaking heaven and earth, and the spreading smoke and dust blasted away with a bang.
Boom! A golden, dazzling War Halberd soared through the air, dispersing the demonic gas around Kautorus, who was then sent flying a hundred meters away by an unrivaled, domineering force, slamming forcefully into the street.
In a crater tens of meters in diameter, a figure emitting a dazzling radiance appeared.
The two and a half meter tall figure, formidable and well-built, had battle armor that had turned into black-red scaled armor, akin to fierce, thick dragon scales covering Jack Clark’s body.
With the burning of True Strength and Blood Qi, twentyfold increase in strength and defense, and the enhancement of Godly Dragon Elephant and Emperor Dragon Strength, Jack Clark’s aura was even more terrifying than Kautorus’s.
Behind him, the vague phantoms of two giant beasts loomed.
Due to an overwhelming surge of power, a real golden-red radiance burst forth from his core, distorting the magnetic field, causing countless tiny pebbles to lose gravity and float upwards.
With radiance bursting and stones revolving, gears turning behind him, Jack Clark in that moment resembled an enraged Light King.
Such a fearsome presence made even Kautorus, who originally thought he held the winning hand, let out an involuntarily fierce roar and questioning bellow: “How is this possible? You too can enter a Rune Pattern Form.”
“Enjoyed that, did you? Now it’s my turn.”
Roar, roar!! Phantoms of void beasts roared as if the sky itself was collapsing.
With unparalleled speed, Jack Clark instantly appeared above Kautorus. The war halberd, radiating dazzling golden light, descended from the sky, collapsing the Void, and shattering everything.
Boom!
The black and golden light collided, and with Kautorus as the center, the earth shattered within a radius of dozens of meters; countless fragments of rocks and bricks were thrown into the air as the violent shockwave swept through everything.
Empowered by the Emperor Dragon Strength and the Divine Dragon Elephant Power, even Kautorus, with a true martial arts phantom within his body, couldn’t withstand that overbearing and invincible strength and nearly knelt under its force.
“To think of making me kneel, courting death.”
Kautorus let out a monstrous roar of rage; it was an existence at the king-level, and yet an enemy at the Six-Stage Demon Marks realm had almost forced it to kneel.
Unforgivable…
At that moment, Jack’s arm muscles swelled, and an even more terrifying power burst forth, with even the Void around him resonating with the praise of strength.
Boom! Kautorus’s knees sunk, and with a thunderous impact, it knelt on the ground, causing the surrounding earth to collapse once again and forming an even deeper meteoric crater.
Immediately, Heaven and Earth fell silent.
Right after, Kautorus’s eyes turned blood red, and blood even began to flow from them, as an endless, mad, and destructive aura erupted from its body.
“Die, die, die, I will crush you into pieces…”
Boom!
But before it could burst forth, Jack swung his war halberd.
Boom!
Kautorus’s chest collapsed, its figure cutting across the sky, turning into a black light that pierced through Heaven and Earth for several kilometers and fell outside the city. At the same time, Jack’s figure flashed, stepping over the broken earth to pursue.
In a life-and-death battle, of course, one should strike when the enemy is sick and claim his life. However, it would still be better to keep the battlefield outside the city.
Roar!
Kautorus, having smashed a meteor crater dozens of meters deep into the earth, had bloody eyes and let out an incredibly raging roar. Endless black demonic qi erupted from its body.
In the towering demon qi, a demon king over 20 meters tall appeared, its aura shaking the heavens and earth, and around the 30-meter-long combat knife in its hands, black cracks, swirling, indicated the rending of the Void by Divine Soul Intent.
Under the humiliation of being forced to kneel by Jack’s strike, cracks appeared all over Kautorus’s body, and all its Divine Soul strength burst forth recklessly, unleashing its strongest and last strike.
Unforgivable, die.
Boom boom boom boom!!
The long black blade light that extended dozens of meters tore through Heaven and Earth, leaving behind long black blade marks in the Void wherever it passed. The whole world seemed to shake, emitting the thunderous roar of wind and thunder.
The terrifying slash was still far away when it was unleashed, but in an instant, it appeared over Jack, who had caught up, and without a sound, a hundred-meter crack split open in the earth even before it descended.
Roar roar!!
Surrounded by two giant shadows, Jack’s aura exploded, and a thirty-meter-long Golden War Halberd soared into the sky, with the Sea of Blood roaring inside, as if it sealed away a corner of Hell.
Boom!
The sky trembled, the earth collapsed, and a destructive sphere, akin to a nuclear explosion, slowly rose, its endless golden black light outshining even the sun’s glare.
Meanwhile, above the Firmament outside Mason City, a damaged Blood Moon appeared, then to the astonishment of many, it fell outside the city.
This scene was witnessed by many in Mason City.
In an instant, advanced cultivators exclaimed in shock, “A king has fallen, a king outside the city has fallen.”
“That is the Blood Moon, not the moon of our Human Race; the fallen king is from a different race.”
At this moment, the entire cultivation world of Mason City was in turmoil, disbelievingly turning their eyes towards the city outskirts..

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 234: God Slayer Darren Callum, Global Shock, The Return of the Demon King
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Chapter 234: God Slayer Darren Callum, Global Shock, The Return of the Demon King
Under the full-force strike of two beings equivalent to the peak of the Seventh Tier, the suburban area was directly blown into a crater over 40 meters in diameter.
Dirt within a hundred meters around the pit was blasted away, leaving sharp cracks everywhere; trees were snapped, and roads crumbled.
This is the destructive power of a Seventh Layer High-Rank cultivator, akin to a rapidly-moving personal missile launcher, with those of the Eighth and Ninth Heavens being even more terrifying.
Not to mention those king-level beings who are comparable to deities.
Merely the arrival of a soul avatar, possessing an Early Sixth Heaven Evil God Sect Cultist, had forced Jack Clark to bring out all his strength.
And today’s battle had caught everyone offguard.
Whether it was Demon King Ciautorus, Blood God Acunus, or the Federal Military, even Jack Clark himself.
After slaying the ‘eye’ that Demon Cultist, Jack’s intention was to see if he could find any trace of Ciautorus.
But unexpectedly, his opponent harbored the intent to kill him.
Sensing that he was alone and emitting a subtle aura, he was lured all the way to Mason City.
According to the ‘information’ from Blood God Acunus, Jack’s cultivation realm was pegged at the Early Sixth Heaven, with combat power at the stronger end of the early Seventh Layer.
Confident he could finish a ‘small fry’ of such strength in an instant, or a few seconds, Ciautorus believed the battle would be a quick resolution.
Not to mention his usual combat power reaching the mid-stage of the seventh realm, the Dark Demon Eye alone, which consumes Divine Soul power to directly attack the soul, could suppress an ordinary cultivator at the Early Seventh Layer.
The reason for luring Jack to Mason City before killing him was naturally to shake off the pursuit of Human Experts that would follow.
It was well aware of its predicament, knowing that once its whereabouts were revealed, it would be besieged by Human Experts, and in such a scenario, a city with complex terrain was naturally the best cover.
For a king-level being like it, as long as it escaped visual lock-on, changing its identity and aura would make it impossible to be found in a city with a population of over a million.
That’s also why Jack, upon encountering it in the city center, even with its threats, kept a distance of a hundred meters, daring not let it out of his sight.
As for the ordinary people who died along the way, Jack could only attribute it to bad luck.
Facing an existence like Ciautorus, even he couldn’t attend to those ordinary people, only trying to restrain himself until they were out of the city. Unfortunately, as the two reached the city’s edge, Blood God Acunus suddenly appeared drawing the Eighth Layer Expert away, and Ciautorus finally couldn’t hold back and made its move.
If not for Jack’s possession of the Blade of Void Cutting Rune and his terrifyingly strong soul, that strike from the Dark Demon Eye would have either killed him or left him gravely injured.
The subsequent battle, naturally, left little to be discussed, with Ciautorus, having misjudged Jack’s strength, eventually dying from exhaustion.
That’s right, exhaustion. After releasing the remnants of its Divine Soul power in one strike, Ciautorus’ will collapsed, and the body of the possessed Demon Cultist shattered.
From their first encounter in the city center to the ensuing cross-city chase to the city’s edge, and until the end of the battle, the whole sequence lasted no more than four minutes.
