And the thought of unleashing all one’s power in an instant and entering Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form to obliterate an opponent is something only a child would conceive.
High-Ranking Powerhouses beginning a battle with their most powerful moves is tantamount to seeking death, because if a Limit Breakthrough fails to kill the opponent, all that awaits is death.
Ciautorus is a prime example of this.
Upon discovering Jack’s high-level combat strength at such a young age, coupled with a soul ten times more potent than that of an average Sixth Heaven cultivator, it became overwhelmed with the urge to kill him.
The urge was so fervent that even as the soul avatar disintegrated, it was bent on taking Jack down with it.
It even entered a state of Demon King’s realm of thought possession from the get-go to ensure a quick and decisive battle, with an all-or-nothing stance. The outcome is self-explanatory.
Due to the Limit Breakthrough, upon Jack revealing his final form, Ciautorus was unable to escape, and its final burst of resistance was the last of its defiance as a demon king.
If Jack had entered the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form from the start, displaying an aura comparable to the pinnacle of the Seventh Layer of Heaven, Ciautorus would have turned tail and fled, using a Blood-Burning Secret Skill if necessary, and never reappeared as long as Jack stayed close to Mathilda
Ward.
Just like that, the demon king died?
Looking at the over 2-meter-taIl figure in the distance, which was dried up and cracked even without a sign of life, still standing erect with a sword, Jack’s eyes revealed a faint hint of doubt.
At this moment, Jack’s face was also pale, his breath weak, and the golden flame on his body had vanished.
Maintaining the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form for just a minute, he felt as exhausted as if he had fought for ten days and nights, though this fatigue stemmed from the spiritual level.
With his physical strength at the time, simply burning Blood Qi could sustain him for over half an hour, but True Strength infused with the Power of Will could not.
No wonder the attribute page had a special note that the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form consumed too much of the current willpower and was to be used with caution.
Jack estimated he could sustain the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Form for a maximum of three minutes before needing to stop; beyond five minutes, the Power of Will would deplete, causing significant damage to the Spiritual Will.
This was a final resort, meant to decide the outcome or to escape.
Compared to the burst of Limit Divine Might, the Tyrant Elephant and Emperor Dragon Forms could be sustained for longer, but neither stage of transformation could suppress Ciautorus.
Ahead of Jack and the Demon King avatar’s pursuit, over seventy kilometers away, a middle-aged man with tiger-striped markings on his face maintained an oppressive demeanor, unhurried and dispassionate..

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 234: God Slayer Darren Callum, Global Shock, The Return of the Demon King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Chapter 234: God Slayer Darren Callum, Global Shock, The Return of the Demon King_2
At that moment, from another direction in the sky, a sinister and bloody aura burst forth, its terrifying presence even causing a vision of a raging sea of blood in the firmament.
“Akunus.”
Boom! Accompanied by a low growl, the air exploded, and the middle-aged man instantly transformed into a beam of white light that streaked across heaven and earth.
His abrupt action immediately caught the attention of the base to his rear, and the voice of a middle-aged man with hawk-like brows came through the headset: “General Lake, you’ve deviated from the tracking direction.”
The middle-aged man said in a deep voice, “I’ve sensed Akunus’s presence in another direction.”
“Akunus, what a coincidence?”
The middle-aged man with the hawk-like brows spoke gravely, “Never mind Akunus; it’s not like the Demon King Ciautorus. Its appearance this time is likely meant to draw you away.”
“Continue tracking Ciautorus. As long as Darren Callum can entangle it for a few minutes, we’ll have a chance to capture it.”
“Also, as a genius who possessed the strength of the Seventh Layer Heaven in the late stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, Darren Callum is more important than the soul avatars of the two kings.”
“I understand,” the middle-aged man with the tiger-striped complexion paused slightly, then turned and dashed towards Mason City once more.
He no longer paid heed to the tempting aura of the Blood God far away.
However, just as he had turned because of Akunus’s delay, the headset rang out urging again, “Darren Callum has engaged Ciautorus on the outskirts of the city. Hurry and support.”
Boom!
A white light shone on the middle-aged man as he nearly took flight off the ground, shooting out amidst the thunderous sonic booms, crossing nearly a hundred kilometers in three minutes at more than twice the speed of sound. Just as he burst into Mason, a blood moon fell from the sky, causing even the middle-aged man with tiger-stripes to be startled.
“King’s Fall, how is this possible!”
Swish!
The middle-aged man quickly passed through Mason City and appeared outside the city, his gaze sweeping over the ‘weakened’ Jack Clark, then settling on the corpse of Ciautorus.
“Dead?”
Jack Clark nodded slowly, “Dead, and the phenomenon of King’s Fall even appeared.”
As beings who controlled the laws and condensed the strength of both the Divine and Demon Realms into a King-level existence, there would be a resonance between heaven and earth at the time of their death, resulting in phenomena associated with the king.
Even though it was just an avatar of the demon king that was subdued-no, dragged to death by Jack—the dissipation of the king’s soul still triggered some phenomena.
Regardless, both Jack and Lake inexplicably felt that something was amiss.
That avatar of the king died too… easily.
Yet the phenomena of King’s Fall couldn’t possibly be faked.
“Dead!”
Back at the base, as Lake confirmed the fall of Ciautorus, many were stunned.
Lake’s voice came through the comm. He said gravely, “Indeed, dead.” “Ciautorus realized that Darren’s potential was no less than that of the Innate Awakened Ones and wanted to kill him. It used its will to project a shadow of the demon icing and forcibly entered the body, raising its strength to the late seventh layer, close to the pinnacle.”
“This state only lasted for a minute before Darren dragged it to death, its physical body collapsing and the divine soul dissipating.”
And Darren… unscathed, just a little weak in aura.”
In an instant, the entire base fell silent.
A colonel couldn’t help but say, “If I remember correctly, we just updated Darren Callum’s cultivation information a few days ago, right? Middle stage of Sixth Heaven, but already has the strength of the pinnacle of the Seventh Layer Heaven?”
Jack had been assessed as a freak of nature with exceptional talent when his combat power was estimated to be in the early to mid-stages of the Seventh Heaven at the early stage of the Sixth Heaven.
Yet now, his actual combat power had reached the pinnacle of the Seventh Heaven, surpassing five minor realms. It was unimaginable how he achieved this.
Keep in mind that every cultivator who has reached the Sixth Heaven has mastered Advanced Skills to the sixth level—Great Realm, fully mastered Combat Techniques, and possesses several Secret Skills.
This was what made it all so incomprehensible.
Realm is realm, and strength is strength.
When Jack showed strength reaching the late Seventh Heaven and even the pinnacle, it meant that some aspect of his true strength had already reached the pinnacle of the Seventh Heaven.
Then a staff officer slowly said, “Since the Triplex Heaven, it is said that Darren’s physique has been extremely terrifying, and he has even cultivated low-level martial arts to the extent of the True Martial Divine Rhyme.” “When he swept through the Southern Battlefield of Eastern Summer, his cultivation was only in the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven, but he had already cultivated Advanced Skills to an exquisite degree, and his battle body was fully developed.”
It s suspected that he awakened some incredibly powerful innate physical talent and possessed a terrifying aptitude for understanding cultivation methods, which should be the reason for his extraordinary strength.” “Eastern Summer has turned out a monster this time.”
“Indeed,” those high-ranking military officers at the base couldn’t help but marvel.
“I suggest recalling Darren Callum and send someone else. With talent like that, if there’s no accident, he is bound to ascend to the throne within five years, and he might even have a chance to reach the level of Heavenly King.” “Indeed, compared to Mathilda Ward, Darren Callum is more important to the Federation.”
“Now that he has revealed his strength, he will surely attract the full-force assassination attempts from the Purgatory Demon Race.”
“I concur.”
“I agree as well.”
At the head of the table, the hawk-browed middle-aged man, who had been silent all this while, spoke gravely, “Darren Callum’s importance is beyond doubt, I will send the suggestion for his relocation to headquarters.”
Having said that, the hawk-browed middle-aged man slightly narrowed his eyes and looked toward Berlin, his eyes pensive.
“That fool is dead?”
On a hillside in another direction outside Mason City, a seductive woman watched the distant phenomenon of the fall and couldn’t help but show a look of shock on her face.
Although she didn’t want to get involved in this baiting operation, Akunus still descended in spirit, taking possession of an intermediate Blood Emissary body that had long been lurking here.
Earlier, sensing Ciautorus’s intent to kill Darren, she revealed this pawn without hesitation to distract the Eighth Layer Expert standing by..

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 234: God Slayer Darren Callum, Global Tremors, The Return of the Demon King 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 234: God Slayer Darren Callum, Global Tremors, The Return of the Demon King 3
But unexpectedly, only a few minutes had passed before Kautorus had fallen. Who killed it? That human clan genius named Darren Callum, or was it other powerhouses lurking within Mason City?
As she pondered, the enchanting woman’s face dripped with blood from her mouth, ears, eyes, and nose. She couldn’t help but touch her cheek, her gaze turning cold: “Can’t bear it anymore, huh.”
As she spoke, the enchanting woman burst into innumerable pieces of flesh and blood, scattering all over the ground.
It could project its will across tens of thousands of kilometers to occupy this body because the body had something to do with its Cultivation Methods, and the Blood Envoy was essentially one of its ‘Avatars.’
These Blood Envoys imbibed Blood Seeds, like seeds containing its blood strength, spiritual will, and Skill Information.
But carrying the willpower of a king is no easy feat, let alone the fact that it had even stimulated its willpower earlier to lead away that Eighth Layer Expert.
So, after only a few minutes, this Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy’s flesh and blood body couldn’t bear it and disintegrated.
While everyone was shocked by the death of Kautorus, Mason City became restless, with ambulances and fire engines sounding their alarms.
In addition, many ordinary cultivators and military soldiers were converging toward the West City.
Even though the battle was brief, the destruction it caused was severe, affecting several blocks, and one street was completely devastated.
The aftermath of the battle resulted in several hundred deaths and one or two thousand injuries.
This casualty figure might sound exaggerated, but to the military, it was still acceptable.
Under normal conditions, a Seventh Layer Heaven powerhouse, if driven mad, could slaughter an entire city within half a day, with no one to stop them without an equal powerhouse’s intervention.
As a demon king from a different race, if Kautorus had not had greater ambitions, it would have started a killing spree to create chaos in the human rear lines long ago.
Though it would have been suppressed quickly, it still would have caused significant impact.
Just like earlier when Mysterious Martial Sky King and others joined forces to slaughter massively in the rear line of The Purgatory Family, even killing a descendant of the Demon God at the peak of the Ninth Heavens.
The impact was such that The Purgatory Family was shaken to its core, with Supreme Experts pursuing the culprits, and kings of demon clans joining forces to counterattack the human rear lines.
Therefore, considering so few died in this battle, it could be considered fortunate.
While the whole city supported the disaster area, the director of the Law Enforcement Bureau arrived outside the city with his subordinates, looking at Jack Clark with a wry smile: “Mr. Callum, I didn’t expect we would meet under these circumstances.”
“Sorry, I wasn’t able to minimize the losses this time.” Jack Clark replied apologetically.
The director of the law enforcement bureau shook his head: “It’s an unfortunate blessing. The opponent was after all an Avatar of demon king level, with terrifying power. If the battle had erupted in the city center, the casualties would have been far worse.”
“Mr. Callum, let my people take you back to the hotel,” he offered.
“…Alright,” Jack Clark hesitated for a moment before getting into the car of the law enforcement bureau.
As for Lake, after confirming Kautorus’s death, he took its corpse and left.
And as for the spoils of the battle, there was nothing at all. Besides the Transcendent Weapon that was destroyed, there was nothing on this guy. This was the part that made Jack Clark feel uneasy.
As Jack Clark rode in the law enforcement bureau’s car headed for the hotel, the entire Gunardo Country erupted in uproar, followed by a massive shake in the global cultivation world.
Because a king-level figure had fallen at Mason City in Gunardo.
Someone had also managed to capture long-distance photographs of Jack Clark standing face to face with Demon King Kautorus without his battle armor, and with his battle armor on, halo spinning behind him.
The person who took the pictures was lucky enough not to be killed by the battle’s shockwaves, and after the battle ended, they were crying and excitedly posting the photos to their social media.
The reason for crying was that his girlfriend of just two days had died in the aftermath of the battle.
[King’s Fall in Mason City]
[Evil God descends with the Demon God Sect, slain by military powerhouses on the outskirts of Mason City]
[Unbelievable, Mathilda Ward’s bodyguard actually slays a king-level figure] [This is why that bodyguard was so arrogant. The God Slayer, Darren Callum!! ] [Everyone, don’t get it wrong. That wasn’t a true king, just a soul avatar of a king of a different tribe, its cultivation was only at the Sixth Layer Heaven.] In no time, information about the fall of a king was everywhere on the internet. There wasn’t much choice, as the Blue Star World had been at peace for decades.
Plus, with the Federation’s strict control over Martial Arts information and laws.
Moreover, a major portion of advanced cultivators and high-ranking powerhouses had gone to the mythical world for various reasons, so the Blue Star World had not seen a battle above the high-order for a long time.
Even if there were any, they were just about killing mutant beasts in the ocean, a type of exceptional battle that ordinary people couldn’t witness, let alone the fall of a king-level entity.
As for the previous incidents involving high-level cultivator battles with Koroya, the information didn’t spread widely at the time due to a blockade. Soon, this information spread from the cultivation world to the ordinary people.
But ordinary people focused on different things.
They noticed the streets turned into ruins after the battle, the collapsing buildings, those cracks extending tens of meters, the huge pits with diameters of tens of meters, and the vehicles that had been shattered into pieces.
“Is that bodyguard a madman, actually fighting that monster in the city?” “Right, a lot of people died because of him; he should be sentenced, captured, and put on trial.”
“It’s too tragic, how could they attack ordinary people, they should take their battles outside the city.”
“Exactly, they killed so many people, they’re inhumane, we strongly demand that the Federation arrest and try them.”
“Are the people upstairs stupid? Do you know what the Evil God represents?
And you’re actually talking about arresting Darren Callum, arrest your freaking selves.”
“Morons, what does Darren Callum have to do with this? Every Evil God Sect Cultist deserves to be executed; what he did, slaying an Evil God Clone that had infiltrated, should count as a great merit instead.”
While the internet was abuzz with this battle, Jack Clark arrived at the hotel in the city center, and Mathilda Ward and others had just gotten off the car. Suddenly, Damon Lopes looked at Jack with a look of grievance, causing him to pause:”… Mr. Lopes, why are you looking at me like that?”
Mathilda Ward couldn’t help but laugh:”… It’s because his moment in the spotlight was stolen by you again.”
In the previous attack on the convoy, Damon Lopes was like a deity wielding Thunder, killing every invading demon with an invincible might.
He thought he would make a big impression this time and shock the world.
But just as the online discussion about his Innate Awakening was heating up, it was suppressed by the news of Jack’s fight with the Demon King and even the news of his slaying.
This made Damon Lopes wonder if his nature clashed with Jack’s, if he was somehow being restrained by that guy; otherwise, why could he never make the headlines?
After lightening the atmosphere a bit, Mathilda Ward asked in surprise, “We all saw the phenomenon of the Blood Moon falling earlier; was that Demon King clone really slain?”
Jack nodded, “Yes, dead, but something feels odd to me.”
Jack then detailed the battle.
Damon Lopes pondered, “That means it recognized your potential and, despite its crumbling shell, decided to burst out with full strength to suppress you.” “That makes sense,” he said.
“But as a Demon King-level being that has existed for hundreds of years and survived countless battles, its behavior does seem somewhat reckless and impulsive.”
Jack nodded, “That’s what I feel too.”
However, doubts aside, the strength Jack displayed in this battle shocked countless people.
Ordinary people could understand that the bodyguard named Darren Callum was very powerful, who had chopped down an Evil God Clone of the Evil God Sect.
Only cultivators understood how terrifying the talent he displayed was.
Even Damon Lopes wouldn’t dare to claim he could kill a king-level avatar; he was only confident he could contend and entangle with one.
Thinking of this, Damon Lopes curiously asked, “How about it, Brother Callum, how did it feel to exchange blows with that King’s avatar?”
Jack spoke solemnly, “Very strong, even stronger than we previously imagined.”
Although the battle started quickly and ended just as fast, Ciautorus’s use and control of strength reached an apex.
If it weren’t for his reaction speed and attack speed being terrifyingly fast, the same destructive force might not necessarily overpower his opponent.
It seemed like just a few simple moves, but each time as they neared, Ciautorus’s Sword Skill would change hundreds of times in an instant, with overbearing strength that contained dozens of hidden energies.
Pulling, spinning, continuous rebound, his Martial Skills already reached a profound level.
Unfortunately, all these so-called techniques are nothing before absolute speed and strength; no matter how many variations you have, I will break them all with sheer force.
At the same time, thousands of kilometers away in Berlin, within a secret underground research facility.
In a white sealed room with transparent Cultivation Pods bubbling with nourishing fluid, a bald youth suddenly sat up.
“Welcome back, Demon King..”

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 235: Ninth Heaven Expert, Beast King’s Roar, Hunting a Level 9 Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 235: Ninth Heaven Expert, Beast King’s Roar, Hunting a Level 9 Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Votes)
In a pure white room, a handsome young man in his twenties with shining golden hair smiled as he congratulated the bald youth sitting up from the cultivation pod.
“Welcome back, Demon King.”
However, the bald youth paid him no attention, instead beginning to move his arms, then stood up, his face gradually breaking into a wild laugh.
“Hahaha… Not bad, not bad at all, this body is as weak as an insect, but I can feel its endless potential.”
Feeling the new body that was in complete harmony with his soul, Kautorus’s smile grew even more proud.
Neither the humans nor that fellow Akunus from the Demon Clan would probably think it had perished, especially since it had sacrificed its Divine Soul, triggering the phenomenon of falling stars.
Who would have thought it had been prepared all along, having arranged a Reincarnation Ceremony for this body in advance?
As long as its Divine Soul collapsed, the remaining wisp of Soul Source would use the ceremony to be reborn through this body, and become a true ‘human.’ Indeed, at this moment, it had become a bona fide human.
As long as this wisp of Soul Source fully merged with this soulless body, not even a Human King would be able to see through its guise.
Only, this body was too weak, devoid of any strength; it would need to recommence its cultivation to enhance its power.
But that was also a blessing in disguise, allowing it to infiltrate the human inner circle and obtain various vital pieces of information while learning to study their system of strength.
It was unfortunate that it hadn’t managed to kill Darren Callum in the end.
The human’s talent was too terrifying, with his Soul Strength more than ten times that of his peers, and he possessed an Innate Divine Rune Transformation, just like their demon pattern battle forms.
To say nothing of his cultivation talent, just the seventeen moments of his Life Mark Wheel had reached the Six-Stage Demon Marks Intermediate Stage, Reverse Defeating the Seven Demon Marks Peak.
This kind of potential had to be erased, otherwise, once he grew up, the human race would have another Grand Demon King Level Strong.
However, he was very weak now, and the only thing to do was to pass this information on, and let another demon king take over.
This “death” of its was actually an accident; at that time, it hadn’t fully decided whether to “die” or not, as the cost was too great. With its avatar’s Divine Soul perished, and the original body heavily injured, there was only a slim trace of Soul Source and memory imprints left to reincarnate, and the success rate was only thirty percent.
But at that point, to kill that terrifyingly talented human, it simply went with the flow.
As Kautorus pondered, the golden-haired young man smiled, “Lord Kautorus, how do you find this body? Is it to your liking?”
Kautorus came back to his senses, his look haughty, he nodded slightly, “Not bad, although a little weak. Have you prepared the Human Cultivation Method and the resources I asked you for?”
The golden-haired young man nodded, “Please rest assured, Lord, I have prepared for you all the resources necessary to cultivate up to the Sixth-level Heaven, enough for you to regain some strength in a short time.”
Kautorus nodded in satisfaction, “Very good. Once my strength has recovered to the strength of Six Path Devil Marks, I will be able to contact the main body. By that time, I will reciprocate your requests.”
The golden-haired young man bowed slightly, “It’s my honor to serve the Demon King.”
“Demon King, we’ll need your cooperation for some examinations next, just to check the integration. If there are any problems, we ll adjust them timely to avoid affecting your strength recovery.”
“Agreeable,” Kautorus nodded without refusal.
Kautorus trusted this human quite a bit.
This person was from one of the Berlin Empire’s Top Ten Conglomerates, the fifth in line to inherit the Buredora Group, named Brudos.
Because of his origins, Brudos had always been ostracized by family members; he lacked cultivation talent and had mediocre strength, immersing himself in biological research.
His goal was to transform his own genes to become stronger, and due to his childhood experiences, he harbored deep hatred for both his family and the human race.
Over the years, he had cooperated with the Demon God Sect, repeatedly helping its cultists escape Federation pursuits, gradually expanding from a few to hundreds of believers.
The strongest among them, a bishop, even reached the level of Seven Demon Marks thanks to the resources provided by him over the years.
Originally, that individual was the target Kautorus intended for its possession.
But unexpectedly, that bishop went on the invitation of the Blood God Sect to join a rebellion in Koroya organized by the Evil God Sect Alliance, where he met his end, including the main forces of the Demon God Sect which had developed over the years.
As for Brudos, his purpose in helping the Demon God Sect was to obtain the Essence Blood of a Demon King Level Strong to alter his own genetic bloodline into that of the Purgatory Demon Race.
As for this request, Kautorus naturally would not refuse, but it would wait until after infiltrating the human race.
Of course, Kautorus wasn’t so easily trusting of humans.
Agreeing to collaborate with Brudos on the reincarnation plan was also after years of testing his trustworthiness.
“Life indicators are normal.”
“Function of the five viscera and six bowels is normal.”
“Marking brainwave values, blood purity unaltered, biological tissue examination…”
In the laboratory, Kautorus underwent more than twenty different tests with Brudos.
When all the data was in, Brudos furrowed his brow.
Kautorus’s gaze turned cold as he asked in a deep voice, “Is there a problem?”
Regret appeared on Brudos’s face, “Aside from cell division and repair, there are no issues; life characteristics are stable and good.”
“Cell division and repair, what’s that?” Kautorus frowned..

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 235: Ninth Heaven Expert, Beast King’s Roar, Hunting a Level 9 Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Votes) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 235: Ninth Heaven Expert, Beast King’s Roar, Hunting a Level 9 Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Votes) _2
The Purgatory Family is a pure cultivation civilization; there is no concept of technology there, so even as the Demon King, it had never heard of these things.
Brudos explained, ’’Cells are the foundation of human body composition. They
are constantly dividing, repairing, and completing metabolism.”
“However, the tests just now revealed that the division speed of your body, Demon King, is more than ten times faster than that of an ordinary human, and it lacks the ability for self-repair.”
“Given the current rate of division, this cloned body of yours, Demon King, will only have a lifespan of three years, at which point the genes will collapse and disintegrate.”
“Three years, didn’t you guarantee that there would be absolutely no problems?” Kautorus’s gaze suddenly turned extremely cold.
“I apologize, Demon King.”
“It’s my fault,” Brudos said with regret. “Although I have adjusted this body to its limits in every aspect, it seems that I still have not broken the taboo of life. “Originally, 1 thought the limitation in previous research was due to the soul. Unexpectedly, even after integrating a king-level soul, the lifespan of the clone only increased from one year to three years.”
“If so, you are of no value, Demon King.”
“Uncle Kai, you can take this experimental body away.”
As Brudos’s voice fell, before Kautorus, who had become an ordinary person, could react, the space behind it suddenly distorted.
A middle-aged man wearing a military uniform, emanating a terrifying aura, appeared treading the void.
In the evening, Jack Clark received the official’s additional reward.
Slaying a king’s avatar, equivalent to killing a Level 7 Alien Beast, granted him
2,000 Contribution Points, although no materials were obtained.
Therefore, after deducting the more than one thousand he owed the officials, he still had 214 Contribution Points left in his hands.
Jack was somewhat surprised by this reward, because the officials had already paid for this mission earlier, two top-tier secret manuals valued at twenty thousand points.
The value of the head of a king’s soul avatar was therefore ten thousand points.
After dinner, standing on the balcony of Mathilda Ward’s suite, Jack gazed down at the bustling city with a different style than Eastern Summer.
The Demon King’s avatar ‘fell’, but there was another more cunning figure, the Blood God Acunus, lurking in the shadows.
As an Evil God born from humanity, this being had a deeper understanding of human civilization and habits.
Moreover, this battle exposed his and Damon Lopes’s entire strength, as well as the existence of Eighth Layer experts in the rear, compounded by Kautorus’s demise.
In the following days, Acunus would be even more cautious.
Actually, the more cautious Acunus became, the more favorable it was for Jack. Because he was improving every moment, and the longer time dragged on, the better it was for him. By the time Acunus made his move, Jack might already be able to battle Eighth Layer experts.
Or rather, without even needing to break through the Seventh Layer, once the Thunderflame Emperor Beast grew to Level 9, the enhanced physique it provided could potentially enable him to match an Eight Layer opponent.
At that point, he would truly be able to overpower with strength!
As he thought of this, Jack’s consciousness sunk into the deep sea below. There, the Silver Giant Dragon slowly opened its eyes, only to see the fierce black-red colossal beast staring at it, causing it to instinctively back away two steps.
“Roar! Hegemon, why are you looking at me like that?”
With a cruel smile, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, “Nothing.”
“Really?” The Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat vigilant.
It was very familiar with the expression that the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had on its face; it was the same when it had shown interest in seeing its innate space runes. Clearly, it had its sights on something else this time.
With that thought, the Silver Giant Dragon instinctively covered the reverse scale under its neck and growled, “There’s only a little left of Scythia’s food; I can’t give it to you.”
As a noble and sacred giant dragon, it had little interest in the flesh of mutated creatures and preferred to eat the riches of nature contained in Heaven and
Earth treasures.
Because it had sneaked away, it did not bring much with it, only enough to maintain its regular dragon consumption.
“Roar! Do I look like a dragon that would deceive you for good things?” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast said somewhat speechlessly.
To be misunderstood by the noble beast gentleman it was!
Low growling, the Silver Giant Dragon demanded, “Then why are you looking at me like that?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled back, “It’s not a big deal; lately, I’ve been interested in the power of the wind element, and I wanted to take a look at your Original Hurricane Force.”
“Original Hurricane Force, that… it’s exhausting, and anyway you won’t be able to see anything special, will you?” the Silver Giant Dragon was a bit conflicted.
Like a bloodline talent and unlike reflecting the innate space runes with soul power, activating the talent’s origin would consume the power of the bloodline.
Moreover, the original runes activated were different from the innate space runes, representing only the form of the original hurricane force.
Under such circumstances, it’s basically impossible to comprehend anything— like observing a natural hurricane, only more specific.
This was also why Jane Aiken’s ability to comprehend her talents was enviable. Ordinary cultivators needed to break through the Seventh Layer Heaven, resonate with heaven and earth to condense a true martial arts phantom before they could attempt to comprehend the traces of the natural forces of heaven and earth.
But she could comprehend space-related Sword Intent directly from the Space Cracks after breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, which was truly monstrous.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, “Don’t worry, I just want to have a look. Plus, I’m not trying to comprehend your origin; I’m just interested in the wind attribute.”
In fact, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was well aware of Scythia’s concerns and simply wanted to give it a try. Who knows, perhaps its beast body had a great talent for comprehension.
Compared to the invisible roaring hurricanes and shattered Earth, the wind talent of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Earth talent origin of the Dragon Turtle were easier to study..

chapters.title: Chapter 475  Chapter 235: Ninth Heaven Expert, Beast King's Roar, Hunting Level 9 Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 475  - 235: Ninth Heaven Expert, Beast King's Roar, Hunting Level 9 Giant Beast (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Indeed, Jack Clark intended to supplement the attribute wheels of the true martial arts phantom with the powers of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, thereby creating four external 'worlds.'
In the early stages, these four foundational spaces merely stored some powers of corresponding attributes, bestowing some attribute damage during combat, but everything would change upon reaching the Ninth Heavens.
At that time, the integration of the four major attribute worlds into his domain could potentially lead to the creation of miniature worlds. By the time he became a king, he might take the step to create a world.
By then, his combat powers, augmented by the power of the worlds, would become extremely terrifying.
This was Jack Clark's envisioned Combat Divine Body; his ambition was vast, and he was already preparing for his eventual ascension to the throne.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, "Don't worry, Great Sethia, once Joe wakes up, I'll go gather some resources to replenish you."
Activating bloodline powers and triggering the realm of thought's origin was very draining, but as long as there were enough supplements, it wasn't a big problem—moreover, it needed to replenish its Qi Blood essence as well.
"Really?" the light in Sethia's dragon eyes brightened.
If there were good things to make up for the expenditure, showing the Thunderflame Emperor Beast its origin talent might be possible—though it would have to eat more at that time.
Roar! "Okay, you'll see."
With that, the bloodline strength within the Silver Giant Dragon was activated, and in an instant, dragon roars echoed, forming a projection of a green dragon created by the hurricane behind it.
An hour later… the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's golden vertical pupils, which had been glaring for an hour, showed regret.
Roar! "Sethia is exhausted." The Silver Giant Dragon panted and wearily retracted its talent origin projection with a thought.
Because it had been glaring at the hurricane for an hour and didn't comprehend anything, indeed, whether in its original form or beast body, it didn't have any insight into its talent.
Alas!
With a sigh, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, "Sethia, that's enough."
Roar! "Sethia is exhausted." The Silver Giant Dragon panted and wearily retracted its talent origin projection with a thought.
Roar!
At this moment, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had been hibernating for a few days, roared. Instantly, a yellow halo expanded around it, forming a domain with a range of two hundred meters in the blink of an eye.
Within the domain, the seawater became almost motionless under the yellow light, resembling an Invisible Stone Mountain radiating a sense of solidity and heaviness.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!! Just as the Earth Domain formed, a terrifying vibration force burst forth, shattering everything within the range of the Crushing Domain, including the seawater.
Instantly, the sea exploded, boiled, and wildly destroyed everything.
With the combination of the Earth Domain and the Vibration Domain, the destructive power of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle suddenly became very formidable.
Standing in the midst of the Destruction Domain, the Dragon Turtle grew to sixty-four meters in height, towering over forty meters, like a moving mountain peak, emanating a fearsome aura.
The presence of its dragon bloodline became stronger on its body, and it was clear that after the breakthrough to Level 8 and the condensation of talent into runes, not only had its strength surged, but its bloodline had also become purer.
Mutated beasts are classified into five levels according to their talents, but their potential is not fixed.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast could strengthen its talent and break through to Monarch level, and other Mutated Creatures might also have the possibility of their bloodlines reverting to their ancestors', suddenly awakening king-level bloodlines to become Lord-level.
Bloodlines are a mystical thing. Some are due to genetic mutations in the creature itself, some change through external forces like Heavenly Earthly Treasures, and others evolve through effort and growth.
Perhaps stimulated by the aura of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish hundreds of meters away also suddenly opened its eyes, issuing a high-pitched, whistle-like call.
Woo!
Boom! With the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish as the center, black and white radiance burst forth, covering a two hundred meter radius, instantly splitting the area half white, half black.
Hovering between black and white, the Tiger Kingfish emitted an aura of ancient desolation, vast and boundless, like a young Kun emerging from the primordial wilderness.
Each gentle flap of its massive fins caused the black and white light around it to shift, making the figure of the Tiger Kingfish flash in and out of sight within the aura.
When the domain turned white, its strength skyrocketed tenfold, and when it was covered in black, it disappeared without a trace—quite mysterious. The Thunderflame Emperor Beast was a bit astonished by this sight.
Compared to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle's integration of Earth and Crushing, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish's outward display of black and white powers seemed even more mysterious, or rather, more overbearing.
Under the oppressive force of the overbearing black and white power, even the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish's Devouring Vortex couldn't unfold and form a domain.
Ying ying ying!! Thunder, I seem to have become very powerful.
The sixty-some-meter-long Single-horned Tiger Kingfish excitedly slapped its double fins, each strike setting off towering sea waves.
Roar roar!! "I'm also very powerful now," the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle standing within the Crushing Domain said excitedly. "This time, I'd like to see who dares come close to me."
It felt as if entering Level 8 was like stepping into a new world, where it had suddenly become incredibly strong.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon, coiled like a small hill, was also disturbed, its nine ferocious heads shaking as it emitted a chaotic roar: "Roar roar roar!! You, you've become so strong."
This compliment was based on when the Nine-headed Flood Dragon had just broken through to Level 8.
Although it had become much stronger after entering Level 8, compared to the current aura of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, it seemed a bit weaker.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled approvingly: "Not bad, it seems you've gained a lot this time."
Compared to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, which had been in hibernation for more than ten days, the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle's hibernation time was much shorter, which had to do with the difference in talent level and number between them.
"Roar, you've awoken at just the right time. Let the Monarch say a few words."
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast stood up on its hind legs and growled: "Currently, our Dragon Palace has a large territory, 'people' count has reached nine, and we've secured several Resource Points."
"Next, let's discuss resource allocation, territory development, and the subjugation of more Giant Beasts above Level 7, as well as recruiting potential intermediate Extraordinary Creatures to join our cause."
"Oh, I almost forgot, Sesi, as the King of the Dragon Palace, do you have anything to say about these plans?"
At this point, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast remembered the Silver Giant Dragon was the 'Big Dragon King' and glanced towards it.
The Silver Giant Dragon looked somewhat confused, since it had never considered such issues or had any experience with them.
But as the Great King of the Dragon Palace, it definitely couldn't show it. The Silver Giant Dragon's face looked serious as it growled: "Hegemon, the Great Scythia thinks what you said was good. Continue."
"Alright."
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast didn't expose it and looked towards the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Female Tiger Whale and the Three-headed Small Tiger Whale that swam over.
"Roar! The Dragon Palace now has five reaching Dragon King level, that is, Eighth Level Extraordinary Creatures, and we are now strong enough to clash with regular Level 9 Giant Beasts."
"Next, I plan to allocate most of the resources like the Growth Crystals and Life Crystal Particles to Horned Lady and Tiger One, Tiger Two..."
Horned Lady was the name the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had given the Female Tiger Whale, and Tiger One, Two, and Three were, of course, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish's three sons.
Then amidst the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's roaring, new tasks were allocated.
The five Eighth Level Beasts would work together to expand the territory, while the Female Tiger Whale would patrol the domain with the Three-headed Small Tiger Whales, gathering and guarding the Resource Points.
At the same time, while patrolling the domain, their task was to hunt Mutated Creatures below Level 7 to obtain Life Crystals.
Furthermore, if they encountered Extraordinary Creatures with high intelligence capable of communication, they could attempt to subdue them, forming an intelligent and vital force.
This was the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's division of tasks for the Dragon Palace going forward, simple and rough, mainly to allocate the task of collecting Life Crystals.
It also meant a reasoned allocation of resources that were somewhat useful—but not greatly— to the four Tiger Whales.
"Roar! Alright, that's what the Monarch has to say. Does anyone have opinions or anything to add?"
Whining!! "No, Thunderflame, what you said was very good." The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was the first to express support.
Roar roar!! "Thunderflame, you're the smartest. What you say goes." The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle naturally had no objections, and the Silver Giant Dragon and Nine-headed Flood Dragon felt much the same.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon, though it clamored for building a Beast Empire, only envisioned an empire where it reigned supreme over a mountain; it had no clue about territory management.
Seeing that everyone agreed, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast nodded satisfactorily: "Roar! To celebrate everyone's breakthrough, let's go hunt a Level 9 Giant Beast to liven things up."
The Silver Giant Dragon and the others were all startled by this idea of celebration.
"Alright, what I mean is Joe has found a high-level Resource Point up ahead, but it's guarded by a Level 9 Giant Beast. Let's take it down."
Roar roar!! "Take down, kill, eat, charge!"
Hearing they were going to seize resources, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was the first to let out an excited roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 236: Water and Fire Otherworld,
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 236: Water and Fire Otherworld,
Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Body
Below the deep sea, a massive beast with five hideous heads swam swiftly, its invisible terrifying aura causing countless mutated creatures in the sea to flee in panic.
Those unaware of the situation might have thought that some great disaster had occurred.
Among the five giant beasts, Kidora, the nine-headed dragon, had the largest body, measuring up to one hundred and forty-something meters, almost the same length as some Level 9 Giant Beasts.
Of course, that was just the length.
As Dragon Python creatures, their bodies were more elongated compared to Giant Beasts of the same level, making their overall volume about the same as that of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which was sixty-four meters long.
In terms of body length, next to Kidora was the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Compared to the seventy-six-meter Silver Giant Dragon, the seventy-nine-meter Thunderflame looked more formidable, fierce, and sinister.
This made the Silver Giant Dragon quite frustrated.
Because at the beginning, it was clearly over ten meters longer than the fifty-nine-meter Thunderflame Emperor Beast, which had not yet broken through to level eight, making it more majestic in size.
Who knew that it would be surpassed so quickly? That creature was growing as fast as if it had consumed some super growth potion.
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon turned its head and looked at the Black-red Colossal Beast emanating intense heatwaves from its back, growling, “Hegemon, are you sure you can handle it?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled in response, “Don’t worry, I’ll confront it head-on when the time comes. You just assist from the side when you see the opportunity.”
This time their target was a Level 9 Giant Beast, but the specific realm of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was unclear; it had merely sensed the aura of the Giant Beast from a distance and steered clear.
However, compared to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which sensed three other Level 9 Giant Beasts wandering around behind it, this one had the ‘weakest’ aura, so it became the target of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
That was because, in the perception of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, there were ‘very good things’ inside the other’s territory.
Yet, only the Silver Giant Dragon had actually encountered and even witnessed the power of a Level 9 Giant Beast, which was the reason for its apprehension.
Compared to Level 8 Extraordinary Creatures, the talents of Level 9
Extraordinary Creatures were unified, not only was their domain suppression stronger, but the combination of two or even three talents also made their power more terrifying.
Like the fusion of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s Super Regeneration and swift movement, allowing it to burst continuously and achieve short-distance instant movement.
Or the fusion of toxin and Golden Flame, increasing its potency by several folds, these are all traits of Level 9 Giant Beasts.
Roar roar!! Fear not, when the time comes, Domination will take the front, and
I am now invincible.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle swimming beside them roared confidently, its eyes full of assurance.
After its breakthrough to level eight and acquiring the Earth domain, this creature finally felt somewhat at ease and moved through the sea as a normal marine life would.
Roar roar roar!! I am even more formidable, just wait and see how I’ll slash it with my Black and White Domain when the time comes.
Roar roar!! Joe, you can’t do it, your soft double fins can’t even cut through my domain.
Roar roar roar!! Why don’t you give it a try?
Roar roar!! Domination fears nothing.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon glanced at the two bickering beasts, all nine dragon heads shaking in dismay.
Too weak, it thought, if they can’t even defeat me, how can they dream of challenging a Level 9 Giant Beast? In the end, it’s up to the mighty Kidora, the strongest aide of Abbott.
While the Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle did become stronger than an average Level 8 Giant Beast after their breakthroughs, they could not mask the disadvantage of being at the Early Stage of Level 8.
At that level, their strength was at most on par with the middle to late stage creatures, still far from Level 9 Giant Beasts.
More than three hours later, the five giant beasts arrived at the edge of the territory of the Level 9 Giant Beast, sensing from afar a majestic, overbearing, and fierce terrifying aura.
This type of aura was imperceptible to beings below Level 7, and thus it had no impact on the normal ecology of the sea area.
But Giant Beasts above Level 7 not only sensed this aura, they even felt such strong bloodline suppression under this overwhelming pressure that they fled in terror.
“Roar! Very strong.” The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled as it felt the powerful aura, with battle intent shining in its eyes.
Since becoming a pseudo-Monarch level, its strength had become so great that it could crush any Peak-level eight Giant Beast, with only Level 9 Giant Beasts posing a challenge.
However, from sensing the aura to approaching the target, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had swum for hundreds of kilometers. Such was the terror of a Level 9 Giant Beast; its invisible aura enveloped everything.
In the dark sea over four thousand meters deep, at the base of a mountain peak severed by an unknown force, ring after ring of silver ripples continuously spread out, covering a range of hundreds of meters.
Yet, opposite those silver ripples wasn’t the dark sea, but a turbulent underwater small world.
Reefs rose several to dozens of meters above the water, surrounding a small island with a diameter of several kilometers at the center. At the edge of the island, a volcano erupted, casting a red glow illuminating the small world.
On that barren island, measuring several kilometers in diameter, a beast over one hundred and seventy meters long, resembling a dragon but with a tiger’s head and back, was hibernating.
The beast had four claws on its belly and its entire body was covered with black and white patterned scale armor, adorned with blue spots.
The huge, terrifying tiger head caused raging winds with every breath, and the invisible aura it emitted was so oppressive that even the space around it distorted, horribly frightening.
This was an Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon that had awakened an ancient creature’s bloodline.
And just as the gaze of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and the others fell upon that Tiger Flood Dragon Beast, even though they were over ten kilometers apart, the Giant Beast abruptly awoke.
Roar!
As the Tiger Flood Dragon rose to its feet, an enraged roar that shook the ■world’ erupted. Under the violent sonic waves, the entire small world’s sea water churned and winds howled..

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 236: The Water-Fire Different World, Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Form_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 236: The Water-Fire Different World, Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Form_2
“Roar! Charge!”
Seeing the Tiger Flood Dragon on alert ahead, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast let out a roar and its massive body smashed through the spatial portal, entering the small world.
Immediately after, endless golden flames erupted from its body, and the surrounding seawater instantly evaporated under the energy of the flames exceeding tens of thousands of degrees Celsius. The sea water in the distance also suddenly boiled.
Boom boom boom!!
In the rolling steam, blue thunderbolts roared and exploded, forming a 300-meter range Thunderflame Domain in the blink of an eye, emitting an aura of destruction.
Roar!
At this moment, accompanied by a dragon’s roar, the Silver Giant Dragon spread its wings and soared into the sky, surrounded by a hurricane of blue cutting everything and carrying the frost that could freeze anything.
Following closely behind was the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, with flames and ice forming a 300-meter range domain around it. Within the domain, the nine ferocious dragon heads twisted and writhed, giving off an astonishing aura.
Then came the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle with the Earth and Vibration Domains enveloping it, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish with its overlapping Black and White Domains.
The five giant beasts with their domains unleashed caused the Heavenly Energy to go berserk, emitting a destructive aura and intense light that covered half of the small world’s sky, demonstrating an overwhelming momentum. Roar roar roar!! The Tiger Flood Dragon roared in anger.
It was unforgivable that these lower-level extraordinary creatures dared to challenge it; they must be killed. Today, it would tear all these Level 8 creatures to pieces.
Boom!
As the Level 9 Giant Beast’s true aura exploded, the entire small world trembled slightly. A circle of blue radiance, with the beast at its center, expanded for five hundred meters.
Inside the domain, waves of blue light rippled, seeming like water but not quite water, giving off a dangerous aura even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast could sense.
Roar! With golden flames and thunderbolts circling around him, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast crushed numerous rocks weighing thousands of tons, causing huge sea waves to surge towards the island.
Boom!
The moment the Thunderflame Emperor Beast set foot on the island, the entire island quivered slightly. Large swathes of rock shattered, and countless fragments exploded and melted into magma under the intense heat. Successive waves of destructive heat spread in circles.
At this point, endless blue water light swept up a hundred-meter tsunami, covering the sky and rushing towards the Thunderflame Emperor Beast. The Tiger Flood Dragon launched its attack first.
Boom!
Blue tsunami waves crashed into the Thunderflame domain, causing the infinite powers of fire and lightning to shatter and explode. Meanwhile, a huge shadow in the tsunami lunged at the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Boom boom!!
Double claws of two giant beasts, each one twice the size of the other, intersected, and a circle of destructive shockwaves blasted open. In an instant, the earth collapsed over a range of several hundred meters, and scorching magma splattered everywhere.
At the same time, the Blue Domain and the Golden Blaze Thunder Domain surrounding the two giant beasts continuously collided and squeezed, forming waves of energy shockwaves that kept exploding.
This single strike seemed to be a pure contest of physical strength without a clear winner!
Boom! One large and one small ferocious skull collided.
Or it could be said that the Tiger Flood Dragon, standing eighty meters tall and even larger in size, opened its mouth to bite the Thunderflame Emperor Beast. However, it was skillfully dodged, and the Thunderflame Emperor Beast viciously struck its chin.
Roar!
Accompanied by the fierce roar, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s internal power exploded. Infinite power was released, causing the surrounding space to distort, fire to deform, and thunderbolts to annihilate.
Boom!
Under a hundred-fold power, the larger Tiger Flood Dragon was thrown out by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast with a bang. The huge body exploded in the air and crashed heavily into the Reef Group more than a thousand meters away.
In an instant, numerous reefs exploded, sea water roared, and it looked like a deep-sea nuclear bomb detonating, with countless sea water gushing hundreds of meters into the air.
Woo!
As the Single-homed Tiger Kingfish’s white domain enveloped it, the aura suddenly increased tenfold, emitting a horn-like hum while charging. At the same time, a hundred-meter long giant horn appeared on its head.
However, just as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish approached the raging sea water, a huge tail emerged from the water, slashing through the sky and striking it heavily.
Boom! The single horn formed by the Gifted Power instantly shattered, and the domain exploded.
The bulky, sixty-meter-long body of the Tiger Kingfish was swept into the air by the terrifying power, soaring hundreds of meters high before crashing into the sea thousands of meters away, splashing seawater into the sky.
In front of this Level 9 Giant Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had no chance to fight back.
Roar roar!! Dare to attack the Joe, and face death.
The ancient Tiger Flood Dragon, which had just sent the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flying, regained its footing and charged at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, enveloped in its Crushing Domain with a ferocious momentum.
Boom! Yellow Crushing Domain and the blue domain collided, creating waves of blue and yellow shockwaves that covered a range of several hundred meters.
Within that range, the domain that could freeze and shatter anything was constantly being neutralized by waves of freezing, heavy, corrosive, and tearing forces, unable to get any closer.
Then the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was left embarrassed.
Staring at the cold-eyed ancient Tiger Flood Dragon two hundred meters away, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle subconsciously crouched down on the seabed.
Boom! Composed of blue power and covering a hundred-meter range, a gigantic claw descended from the sky, heavy as a mountain, and slammed heavily onto the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Under this terrifying power, the yellow domain shrank suddenly to just a few meters. The earth collapsed within a range of several hundred meters from the impact, with sea water exploding, and the thunderous sound shaking Heaven and Earth.
Under such a frightening force, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was directly hammered down to a depth of one hundred meters.
After casually dealing with the two lower-ranking creatures, the ancient Tiger Flood Dragon finally focused on the faraway Black-red Colossal Beast.
Over there, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast stood on the central island, surrounded by fire and lightning, with a lava lake taking shape beneath its feet within a range of several hundred meters, looking like an apocalyptic giant beast.
Roar!
Staring at the Thunderflame Emperor Beast in a posture of waiting for its move, the ancient Tiger Flood Dragon let out an even angrier roar, its aura that shook the mini-world exploded, with endless blue light shining..

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - 236: The Water-Fire Different World, Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Form_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Chapter 236: The Water-Fire Different World, Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Form_3
In an instant, the seawater in the entire small world began to tremble.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! Along with the endless roar of seawater, more than twenty water pillars, several tens of meters thick and hundreds of meters tall, spun and rose up, connecting the sky and the earth, their terrifying aura palpable.
Though made of seawater, these spinning water pillars emitted a sharp aura, swirling at an astonishing speed towards the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and the Silver Giant Dragon.
Roar!!
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a roar, its dragon mouth wide open, as a white ice flame shot through the void, striking one of the water pillars with a boom.
Crack, crack!!
Under the freezing and absolute cold of the dragon flame’s breath, the surface of the water pillar in its path was continuously frozen, exploded, and countless shards of ice splashed everywhere, before continuing towards the Silver Giant Dragon.
Endless seawater, unless the Silver Giant Dragon instantly froze and shattered the dozens of meters thick water pillars, otherwise, under the power of the Tiger Flood Dragon, the water pillar would continue to stir.
Whoosh!
With a flap of its wings, the Silver Giant Dragon weaved through the water pillars. This time, however, its breath didn’t target the water pillars but landed beneath them instead.
Immediately, an ice layer several meters to more than a dozen meters thick emerged on the sea surface, freezing large swaths of seawater.
Thump, thump, thump!!
As the water supply below was frozen, the chasing water pillars pursuing the Silver Giant Dragon crumbled one by one, turning into a sky full of water splashes that landed on the ice surface with a rumble.
As the Silver Giant Dragon froze the ocean, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, facing more than a dozen water pillars sweeping over it, had its mouth wide open, and the dorsal fins on its back lit up one by one.
However, this time the power of the thunderbolt did not form a thunder ring but rather fused with the golden flame and a green toxin energy. Instantly, a terrifying aura permeated the air.
Long-range attack, I can do it too.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Beast gathered energy in preparation for its eruption, sensing the destructive aura emanating from its mouth, the Tiger Flood Dragon was startled and instinctively tried to dodge.
But… boom! Behind it, the seawater exploded, and the domain of flame and frost that had converged once again opened up, colliding violently with the blue domain.
At the same time, nine ferocious dragon heads roared out, especially the three robust dragon heads adorned with black horns, which tore through the blue domain to viciously bite the Tiger Flood Dragon’s tail, back, and hind legs.
Caught off guard by the sudden ambush, the Tiger Flood Dragon had focused all its attention on the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Especially since the three dragon heads of this Nine-Headed Flood Dragon had penetrated its Talent Unity domain of heavy water.
Roar!
In surprise and anger, the Tiger Flood Dragon turned its head back, its enormous right claw shimmering with black and blue power, exploding heavy water and distorting the space before ruthlessly landing on one of the black dragon heads.
Bang!
Under the impact of a Level 9 Giant Beast, one of the nine dragon heads of the Nine-Headed Flood Dragon exploded instantly. Aside from the two dragon heads still biting the Tiger Flood Dragon, the other six dragon heads let out a painful roar.
And at the exact moment when the Nine-Headed Flood Dragon bit the Tiger Flood Dragon, a gold and blue beam of light bellowed from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s mouth, emanating a terrifying aura of destruction.
Boom, boom, boom!!!
The ever-expanding breath pierced through the water pillars, which directly collapsed under the terrifying impact and scorching destructive power, transforming into countless drops of seawater falling down.
In just an instant, the Destructive Breath had expanded more than a dozen meters thick, landing on the blue domain.
Roar!
In the face of terrifying energy impacts, the blue domain was blown away in a series of booming explosions. Amidst the fierce roar, the Tiger Flood Dragon was engulfed and let out a brutal roar that echoed throughout the world.
Roar!
Under the force of the Thunderflame Breath, the blue Tiger Flood Dragon grew enormously, expanding in the blink of an eye into a terrifying behemoth hundreds of meters long, with its more than 100-meter-tall shoulder height. The invisible explosive power directly sent the Nine-Headed Flood Dragon flying.
Within the substance-like blue Tiger Flood Dragon, the body of the Tiger Flood Dragon had large pieces of its scale armor shattered, its enormous eyes revealing a fierce, ruthless gaze.
Roar, roar, roar!!
As a hundreds of meters long behemoth, the Tiger Flood Dragon, faced the Thunderflame Breath, charged towards the Thunderflame Emperor Beast amidst a series of booms and emanated an extremely overbearing aura.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s head shook slightly, and the gold and blue breath, with a diameter of more than a dozen meters, instantly fell like a beam of destruction onto the distant reef rock.
Roar!
The reef rock, with a diameter of a hundred meters, tens of meters above the sea surface, and as large as a small hill, exploded under the force of the Golden Flame Breath, with the melted magma spewing all around.
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s fiery glare disappeared from its mouth, and it stared coldly at the incoming colossal blue behemoth.
Clearly, it was not that the power of its fusion of the three major talents’ breath was lacking, but that the blue ‘true body’ had absolute defense against energy attacks.
Want to compete with me in close combat?
Roar!
With a ferocious roar, the Black Power covering the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s hideous body converged, and the dark red glow circulated around its body.
The explosion of top-tier defensive and offensive talents emitted an invisible aura of terror, causing the surrounding space to become somewhat distorted and the figure blurred.
Boom!!
Fifty meters tall, the hideous giant beast collided with the hundreds of meters long, more than 100-meters tall blue Tiger Flood Dragon.
In an instant, the entire island shook with a thunderous crash. The destructive impact created a category 10+ typhoon, which swept across thousands of meters, stripping away layers of the entire land surface in its path.
However, as a result of the collision, it was the larger blue behemoth that retreated a step, clearly overmatched by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s unparalleled power.
This infuriated the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon.
Roar!
With a thundering sound, an enormous claw smashed down onto the ground, instantly causing the earth to explode within a radius of hundreds of meters, with countless boulders and dirt flying in all directions.
Dodging the Tiger Flood Dragon’s claw, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast appeared at its side in an instant, its golden sun-infused claw slamming into the beast’s abdomen..

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 236: The Water-Fire Different World, Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Form_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 236: The Water-Fire Different World, Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Domain True Form_4
Boom!
Under the burst of a hundred-fold power and more than ten times compressed Golden Flame energy, half of the Blue Tiger Flood Dragon’s abdomen collapsed and exploded, causing the overpowering force to shake the inner Flood Dragon and make it let out an angry roar.
Boom!
The 200-meter-long tail pierced through the void, appearing out of nowhere behind the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, and the terrifying force knocked the Thunderflame Emperor Beast more than a thousand meters away with a single strike.
Boom! The hundred-meter-tall hillside collapsed, and countless shattered stones exploded.
At the moment when the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was knocked away, the Blue Tiger Flood Dragon’s body squirmed, and the collapsed part on its side instantly recovered. However, the aura of the inner Flood Dragon weakened a bit.
At this time, the collapsed hillside in the distance exploded, followed by the Blue Tiger Flood Dragon’s angry roar. Its huge body was once again smashed by the instantly appearing Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the frenzied collision of the two terrifying Giant Beasts, waves of destructive shockwaves continued to erupt. The ground crumbled and the hillsides collapsed wherever they went.
Moreover, both Giant Beasts had extremely terrifying speed, despite their enormous size. They swung their double claws, whipped their tails, and even caused sonic booms with their roars.
Especially when the Thunderflame Emperor Beast burst out with its swift movements, it seemed as if it was teleporting, and it could even do so continuously.
The terrifying battle power even suppressed the Blue Tiger Flood Dragon, even though its body is now only one-tenth of the opponent’s size.
At the same time, the Silver Giant Dragon had frozen the surrounding sea water and floated somewhat weakly in the air, gasping for breath.
To freeze such a large area of sea water in one breath, restraining the control of water power of the Flood Dragon was a bit of a stretch for it.
Crack, bang! The ice, tens of meters thick, cracked, revealing eight heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon. They stared at the distant battle, growling in confusion and anger, “Abbott, so strong.”
“Roar! Indeed, very strong.” Watching the battle in the distance, the Silver Giant Dragon showed a complicated expression in its eyes.
When it first met the Thunderflame Giant Beast, they were evenly matched during the fierce battle, and their strength was on par with each other.
But to their surprise, in just a month or two, this fellow had grown to a point where it could directly suppress a Level 9 Giant Beast, and its formidable power stood toe-to-toe with the domain true self without being at a disadvantage.
As a descendant of Mythical Giant Beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon had seen this kind of ability before.
Infusing all its talents into its domain, taking itself as the foundation to form a huge Giant Beast, true self gestures possessed the pure power to destroy heaven and earth.
This kind of Giant Beast’s true self is quite difficult to deal with as long as its bloodline power does not run out, and its talent domain true self will not perish.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a low growl, “Kidora, we must help Hegemon restrain that fellow.”
“As long as we can restrain it for a moment and not give it time to recover, Hegemon’s instantaneous burst of power will be enough to kill it.”
“Roar! Roar! Roar! No, problem, how, do, we, cooperate?”
“Wait for the right timing, and then unleash your full breath attack to help me seal it.”
“Roar! Roar! Roar! No, problem.”
Roar! Accompanied by a lofty dragon chant, the Silver Giant Dragon’s dragon wings spread. In a flash, the frozen sea around it began to tremble violently.
At the same time, on the pair of white dragon horns on its head, dazzling light shone in circles, forming a gigantic dragon phantom behind it.
The towering figure was as huge as a mountain, exuding a divine and noble aura that transcended billions of living beings, like a deity standing between heaven and earth.
Crack! Crack!
As the terrifying phantom appeared, countless ice crystals formed around the Silver Giant Dragon in the void, instantly transforming the area of more than 300 meters into an all-encompassing Frozen World.
At the same time, between its wings, countless pure white broken ice encircled, forming fine Space Cracks, which emitted an aura of total destruction.
The Silver Giant Dragon had used this move once in its battle with the Thunderflame Giant Beast, and its power was extremely formidable.
Meanwhile, not far away, endless energy converged on the body of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon. The mouths of the six dragon heads were wide open, each emanating fluctuations of fire, ice, and gravity.
The two powerful energy auras attracted the attention of the Flood Dragon that was fighting fiercely in the distance.
However, being suppressed by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, it had no power to interrupt, and could only let out angry roars while preparing to dodge at any moment.
Although breath attacks were of great power at a distance, as long as the range was far enough, dodging was actually quite easy – at least for the Flood Dragon..

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 237: Monarch-Level Life, Bloodline Evolution, One Man Destroys a Civilization? (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 237: Monarch-Level Life, Bloodline Evolution, One Man Destroys a Civilization? (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon were gathering their strength in an instant, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast let out a roar.
Boom!
The void exploded, and a tail wrapped in golden flames and thunder pierced through the void with a bang, tearing through the distracted Tiger Flood Dragon’s chest, shattering a large area of blue shards.
This strike was only a few meters away from reaching the Tiger Flood Dragon’s true body. The sharp aura invisibly emanating from the tail tip made the Tiger Flood Dragon feel an intense danger.
Roar! The Blue Tiger Flood Dragon bellowed. In the moment when the Thunderflame Emperor Beast paused its attack, double claws bearing an overwhelming, terrifying might descended from the sky, blocking out the sun.
Boom!
Under that one strike, the phantom image of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast shattered, and within a range of hundreds of meters, the Earth exploded, sending countless shards of rock flying like burning meteors in all directions.
“Roar! Kill.”
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a roar, its double wings flapping, and the long-gathered energy of destruction transformed into a black cold stream mixed with frost, destroying and freezing everything in its path.
At the same time, six of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s heads roared, unleashing six beams of black, blue, and red light that pierced Heaven and Earth, crossing more than a thousand meters to cover the Blue Tiger Flood Dragon.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Under the bombardment of the six breaths nearly as powerful as a Level 9 Giant Beast, the energy-highly defensive Blue Tiger Flood Dragon’s body slightly trembled, its massive form remaining imposing and immobile while its gaze coldly surveyed the raging energy shock waves around it.
And just as the Nine-headed Flood Dragon spewed out its breaths, the innate rune on the Silver Giant Dragon’s brow flashed with dazzling silver brilliance.
The space gave way to an unseen distortion, and the black cold stream that was a hundred meters away vanished, instantly crossing more than a thousand meters and appearing behind the Blue Tiger Flood Dragon who was resisting the breaths of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon.
Under the terrifying cold stream that even froze space itself, leaving cracks, the Blue Flood Dragon stiffened with a layer of white ice crystals forming on its body, freezing everything, including its Gifted Power.
But almost immediately, an indescribable strength burst forth from the Tiger Flood Dragon’s body.
Roar!
The enraged bellow shattered the Crystal Turtle, and with a thunderous explosion broke apart, the strong Power Explosion even bending the six breaths from the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, sending them scattering in all directions.
But just as the power that froze everything fractured, a strong scent of death enveloped the Tiger Flood Dragon’s true body.
A Dragon Claw covered in pure golden light appeared out of nothingness, followed by the ferocious and massive body of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and the long light tail trailing behind it.
The Dragon Claw, concentrated and compressed to fifty times its strength, emanated a high temperature of two hundred thousand Celsius due to the Golden Flame power, and a claw strike that gathered the strength of the whole body and unleashed a Hundred-fold Power.
Everything in front of the Dragon Claw was annihilated by this pure destructive force.
In the moment that death descended, the Tiger Flood Dragon’s consciousness entered a realm where time slowed, watching the golden Dragon Claw shatter its Talent Domain and its head.
Roar! At the moment of its demise, the Tiger Flood Dragon let out a desperate roar.
In an instant, the rare blue spots on its body shone, shooting out beams of blue light that pierced through everything they touched.
Even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s terrifyingly hard scale armor surface broke under dozens of Light Beams, the impact force creating one or two meter ‘big’ pits.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
The terrifying destructive Light Beams obliterate everything, the Earth exploded, the hillsides were pierced, and the barriers of the small world’s space above were relentlessly shaken.
The Silver Giant Dragon in the sky let out an angry roar, for its Dragon Wings had been pierced with several one-meter diameter Hollows, but luckily its body was unharmed.
On the contrary, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon lying on the ground had narrowly escaped this catastrophe.
On the island covered in flowing magma, the corpse of the Tiger Flood Dragon, with its head shattered, lay quietly, with large amounts of blue blood spurting from the broken wound.
In just a blink of an eye, a small blue lake had formed around it.
In the distance, the Silver Giant Dragon and Ghidorah heaved with big breaths.
Also, the Single-horned Tiger Whale emerging from breaking through the Ice Layer and the slightly weakened Deep Sea Dragon Turtle crawling from underground both sighed with relief upon seeing the Tiger Flood Dragon’s corpse.
A Level 9 Giant Beast was just too powerful.
This battle had almost blown up half of the small world, and the island with a diameter of several kilometers had collapsed by half. Even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s breath that destroyed everything had been blocked.
Under that terrifying strength, the previously confident Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle were almost blown to pieces with a single strike and still felt the chills afterward.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon and Ghidorah, when facing a Level 9 Giant Beast, found themselves outmatched and struggled to contend with it.
This time, had not been for the Thunderflame Emperor Beast head-on resist and battle that Giant Beast, engaging in an even and even suppressing encounter, the Dragon Palace might have been destroyed today.
Too strong.
Thinking of this, the several Giant Beasts couldn’t help but look towards the distance.
There stood a Black-red Colossal Beast, its some shattered scale armor visibly recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye, its whole body emanating an extreme and terrifying Aura.
“Roar! Hegemon, you are too strong!” The Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but reveal its astonishment.
To resist and battle a near Mid Level 9 Giant Beast at the Level 8 Early Stage, such a heavens-defying combat strength was something even its mother could not achieve at Level 8, otherwise, she would have already boasted about it to him.
Or rather, this was beyond the cognition of Extraordinary Giant Beasts.
Comparable to humans who could fight above their tier at low levels, but found it difficult to cross even a minor boundary after reaching high-order levels.
After the Seventh Tier, Giant Beasts all possess a king-level bloodline, it’s just that some Giant Beasts have such weak bloodlines that they don’t manifest and let alone form powerful Talent Abilities.
But the strength of these Giant Beasts is still formidable.
And there’s no need to say more about Level 9 Giant Beasts; the blood strength in their bodies has already retrograded to where most of their form is ancestral, their bloodline Talents are extremely powerful, and their combat strength is terrifying..

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 237: Monarch-Level Life, Bloodline Evolution, One person destroys a civilization? (Seeking monthly ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 237: Monarch-Level Life, Bloodline Evolution, One person destroys a civilization? (Seeking monthly ticket)_2
By this point, everyone is a “genius,” a “super genius.”
If you are strong, so is your opponent, and this is also why it becomes more difficult to surpass levels at higher orders.
Just like this Level 9 Tiger Flood Dragon, whether it’s its talent abilities, its formidable physique, or its sturdy and heavy Blue Domain, it completely dominates the Silver Giant Dragon in all aspects.
At that moment, the distant Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, “Is everyone okay? If there’s nothing wrong, let’s head over there to see what good things are there, making that creature so desperate.”
Roar roar roar! My back is broken, I need to lie down for a while.
Roar roar! My head hurts a little, let me recover for a bit.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s eight still bleeding and fierce dragon heads shook, “Roar roar roar! Kido, la, fearless, no pain, let’s look over there.”
