At that moment, next to Kidora’s eight heads, the neck of the dragon head that was blown up is regrowing flesh and blood. According to this speed, a new dragon head could grow back in about a day.
As an Eighth Level Beast, it has an extremely strong vitality. As long as the Life Origin is not damaged, even the most severe wounds can be healed given time.
Especially for creatures like Kidora that have multiple heads, they typically possess regenerative abilities or the ability to regrow limbs.
Huff!
The Silver Giant Dragon, with slightly tattered double wings, fluttered and glided from the shattered reef rocks, landing gracefully beside the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, enveloped in a flurry of turquoise raging wind.
Lifting its head proudly, the Silver Giant Dragon proclaimed, “How could such common combat possibly hurt the Great Scythia?”
“Roar! If that’s the case, Overlord Joe, you two recover here. We’ll go ahead and take a look.”
Roar roar roar! Wait for me, my injuries are much better, it doesn’t hurt anymore.
Roar roar! Overlord, my head isn’t dizzy anymore.
Seeing they were about to be left behind, the Tiger Whale and the Dragon Turtle were immediately anxious.
Under the heavy steps of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, rocks within a tens of meters range shattered and cracked with each step, the ground shook, and deep footprints were left behind.
Following it were the wandering Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the crawling Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Silver Giant Dragon flying in the air with unfurled wings -all presenting a magnificent and imposing march.
As for the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish… It could only swim at the edge of the water near the Reef Island.
Soon, the five Giant Beasts arrived at the edge of this small world, where the reef islands were fractured: below, magma churned, forming a lake several kilometers wide.
At the end of the Lava Lake stood a volcano mouth, over a hundred meters high, sporadically spewing Scorching Magma and rolling clouds of black smoke and poisonous gas, in stark contrast to this side.
At that moment, in the Lava Lake not far away, an “egg” could be seen floating, 0.5 meters in size, its surface covered with purple Dragon Scales, with strands of solidified purple light encircling it.
When the four Giant Beasts approached within hundreds of meters range of the purple Dragon Egg.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s ferocious aura Burst out, ancient, desolate, while the Dragon Bloodline within it was agitated by an invisible and terrifying Dragon Might spreading around.
Under this sacred, even terrifying Dragon Might, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, also possessing Dragon Bloodline, felt its limbs go weak and with a thunderous noise, collapsed to the ground.
Roar roar roar!!
The Silver Giant Dragon’s Dragon Might Burst forth, forcefully resisting the pressure from the depths of its bloodline, and its fierce mouth emitted an enraged roar.
It was the Great Sethia, how could it possibly kneel before an ‘egg’? Impossible.
In this situation, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, not having Dragon Bloodline, was less affected -it merely felt a powerful suppression from a higher level of life.
As for the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, frantically slapping its fins in the water but unable to come over, it had no trouble whatsoever.
Staring at the tiny egg, shock filled the Thunderflame Emperor Beast s eyes as it growled, “It’s the Dragon Egg of the offspring of an Emperor-level Mythical Creature.”
True, the life level contained within this Dragon Egg was Emperor level.
After all, only the aura of a Monarch-Level Life could make it feel even the slightest suppression now.
Of course, it was just a slight suppression in terms of aura. In terms of strength, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was confident that it could smash the egg with a single claw strike, turning it into debris.
Wonder what effect eating this egg would have?
Could it allow it to evolve?
As the Thunderflame Emperor Beast gazed at the egg, contemplating whether eating it could bring about some changes.
The Dragon Turtle, lying on the ground, Burst forth with powerful aura, creating tangible shockwave surges that swept across hundreds of meters range, emitting an angry roar.
Roar roar!! Overlord, fearless, invincible with me, stand up, roar roar…
Accompanied by a series of angry roars, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, trembling in its limbs, slowly stood up.
“Roar! Well done, overcoming the suppression of the bloodline with willpower to stand up, that’s how an Eighth Level Beast should be,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast praised Overlord Joe the Dragon Turtle for its performance. Approaching Monarch-Level, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast understood more and more the terror of Monarch-Level lives. It represented an all-around transcendence in strength, talent, and life hierarchy.
Or rather, Monarch-Level beings and those below were not on the same level at all.
At this moment, shock appeared in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon as it growled, “Overlord, this is the offspring of a being above Mythical-level.” “Roar! I guessed as much,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast nodded.
Just the oppressive aura of an egg was this frightening; offspring of ordinary Mythical Creatures couldn’t achieve this.
And most ordinary Mythical Creatures have Lord-level bloodlines. Creatures like the Silver Giant Dragon with a King-level bloodline and Monarch-level status are only a few.
Beyond that, the Dragon Egg actually had a problem.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast keenly sensed that the life aura of the purple Dragon Egg was weakening, and it was continuously dissipating, forming the surroundings of solidified purple substance..

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 237: Monarch-Level Life, Bloodline Evolution, One person destroys a civilization? (Seeking monthly ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 482  - 237: Monarch-Level Life, Bloodline Evolution, One person destroys a civilization? (Seeking monthly ticket)_3
Those substances emitted an impulse that made extraordinary creatures instinctively want to devour them.
"Those must be the good stuff Joe was talking about."
As he spoke, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast extended its huge dragon claw, a powerful suction burst forth, absorbing one-tenth of the purple substance surrounding the dragon egg.
Looking at the basin-sized, crystal-clear purple substance that had gathered in its claw, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast sucked it down in one gulp.
As for devouring... this bit of substance was too little compared to the now Thunderflame Emperor Beast, not even moistening its throat.
Hu!
The ball of purple liquid entered the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and instantly dissipated into invisible life energy, slightly heating the bloodline belonging to the Fake Emperor Dragon as it passed.
Then... there was no more.
No, it's not that there was no change, for instance, the head of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast underwent some subtle adjustments, appearing more in line with the charm of the Eastern Divine Dragon.
But overall, it didn't help much with strength because its life level was already approaching that of a Monarch.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared lowly, "These substances are the concentrated life aura of the dragon egg, which can stimulate the evolution of your bloodlines, including Scythia."
Roar roar roar!! Bloodline evolution, I want to evolve.
Hearing it was a beneficial substance that could stimulate bloodline evolution, the distant Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was very excited, its huge double fins beating the sea and raising large waves.
The other Giant Beasts also reacted similarly, including the Silver Giant Dragon, whose eyes reddened, as its bloodline was too difficult to advance.
"These liquids containing True Dragon Power are useless to me; you all can have them. However, the flesh and blood of that Level 9 Giant Beast are mine."
Kidora's eight dragon heads emitted a chaotic roar: "Roar roar roar!! I, no objection, meat, Abbott, eat."
Roar roar!! Domination, I don't like meat, Thunderflame, you eat it.
The Avatars of Unique Beasts had no objections.
After all, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was the main force in killing the Level 9 Giant Beast, so it was only natural for it to take the lion's share.
This haul turned out to be a win-win; the purple liquid was useless to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, but the life factors and vast energy contained in the flesh and blood of the Level 9 Giant Beast could accelerate its growth.
And for the other few Giant Beasts, since they did not possess the Evolution Talent, the effects were not as strong as for it.
Under the distribution by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the purple substances were divided into four portions—Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon got a bit more, while the Dragon Turtle and the Tiger Whale got slightly less.
This distribution was based on the effort exerted in the battle: those who contributed more received more resources, which was fair.
And just as the four Giant Beasts swallowed that 'bit' of purple substance, their bloodline aura burst out instantly and they collapsed on the ground, falling into hibernation.
Stimulated by the Monarch-Level Life force, their bloodlines became very active internally, and when they awoke, they should achieve some growth.
Good, it was just some growth, not an upgrade in bloodline level, because those life substances were too few.
Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast looked at that purple dragon egg.
A Monarch-Level Life dragon egg—if it could be hatched, one wonders how strong the newly born life would be, stepping straight into king-level?
It probably wouldn't be that terrifying.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast shook its head, dismissing the exaggerated thought from its mind.
High-level life tiers only mean a high starting point, not being strong right after birth; otherwise, there would be no talk of growth, but Mythical Giant Beasts birthing litters of Mythical Giant Beasts.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast stepped into the lake, and immediately the surrounding lava exploded, forming a sea of flames and rushing waves in all directions.
But when those Scorching Magma Flames approached the purple dragon egg, they were blocked by an invisible force field, creating a three-meter fire-free zone.
However, when the Thunderflame Emperor Beast extended its claw towards that invisible barrier, it felt only a slight resistance before grabbing the tiny egg in its claw.
Weak life force, huh. After some thought, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's realm of thought prompted a movement, instantly mobilizing the energy deep within its flesh and blood, condensing it into a stream of pure life energy that enveloped the dragon egg.
It wanted to see if it could save this dragon egg.
After all, it was the first Monarch-Level Life it had encountered, and it held significant research value.
Hum! Just as the life energy gathered in the claw of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast enveloped the dragon egg, after a pause of several seconds, the purple dragon egg began to respond.
Hum!
The purple dragon egg vibrated slightly, emanating a powerful suction from within, gulping down the life energy around it like milk, greedily absorbing it.
Soon, the life aura of the dragon egg strengthened a bit.
But at that moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast dispersed the gathered life energy, and its colossal body even swayed slightly, exhaling a breath of weakness.
"Roar! You eat too much," the Thunderflame Emperor Beast couldn't help but growl lowly.
Hum! The Dragon Egg vibrated slightly, conveying a vague desire for more.
It was clear that a nascent form of life had already been born within the egg, but for some reason, its Life Energy continued to slip away, preventing it from fully emerging and breaking free of its shell.
"Roar! No more, let's talk after I recover," it growled.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast didn't pay it any more attention, as the egg had almost absorbed one-fiftieth of its Life Energy in just a short time.
This was almost equivalent to condensing a portion of its Essence Blood.
Considering the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was already struggling to recover, it naturally wouldn't foolishly continue to provide; the egg would have to wait until the beast recovered.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast put the purple Dragon Egg back into the lake and with a thunderous sound, stepped back onto land.
On its body, the scorching Magma Flames flowed unceasingly through the cracks in its scale armor, sparking a large shower of sparks as they fell to the ground.
Having returned to the corpse of the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast grabbed the enormous body and bit down fiercely, shattering two meters of scale armor in an instant.
Following that came the rich scent of flesh and blood, which filled its taste buds; after chewing vigorously a couple of times, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast wolfed down the meat.
Boom!
An enormous surge of biological energy erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's stomach and was greedily absorbed by its cells, transforming into nutrients for its body's growth.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Beast continued to devour the flesh and blood, its massive and fierce body could be seen growing at a visible speed.
Worthy of being the flesh and blood of a Level 9 Giant Beast.
Even more terrifying, however, was the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's energy conversion rate and the speed of its physical growth and Evolution, which seemed to defy the natural rules of biological growth.
Boom!
When the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's body length surpassed eighty meters, an even more powerful and horrifying aura burst forth, its formidable pressure causing the ground around it to shatter and the sea waves to churn.
Level 8 Mid Stage.
By that time, only one-tenth of the Level 9 Tiger Flood Dragon's flesh and blood had been consumed. The Thunderflame Emperor Beast continued to tear and devour in huge bites, each bite emitting a crunching metallic tearing noise.
At Level 9, even the deceased flesh of a Giant Beast is strong and terrifying, immune to knives and spears and containing dreadful power. Eating such a Unique Beast is no different than eating alloy.
Ordinary people or low-level cultivators would burst from the destructive energy within if they consumed even a bit, let alone digest it.
Of course, the toughness is only a metaphor. If the Thunderflame Emperor Beast really ate alloy, aside from dissolving into a pile of 'poop', it would get no nutrients.
Jack Clark stood quietly at the edge of the balcony, his expression calm as he watched the now tranquil city, his invisible aura growing increasingly formidable.
Soon, as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast kept feeding, its body continued to grow: eighty-one meters, eighty-two meters... and at the same time, its Evolution value soared.
Hotel, night.
Jack Clark stood quietly at the edge of the balcony, his expression calm as he watched the now tranquil city, his invisible aura growing increasingly formidable.
Since reaching level eight, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast's growth fed Jack Clark more Evolution Energy each time.
This Evolution Energy streamed continuously through the Soul Channel, madly splitting, compressing, and evolving every cell in Jack Clark's body.
On the attribute page, his strength, physique, agility, and Spiritual Attribute were all leaping continuously; in just an hour, they had skyrocketed by over a hundred points.
An invisible force enveloped Jack, causing the air to burst and create gusts of wind that blew in all directions.
As his body grew stronger, the Hidden Deity Glyphs could not be entirely concealed, and only after the body's strengthening ended would his aura return to normal.
All this happened silently and unnoticed.
No one could imagine that Jack Clark's cultivation realm and strength could still advance at a frightening pace.
That was Jack's advantage; time was on his side. Whether against the Evil God Sect Cultist, the Evil God, or the Purgatory Demon Race, it was the same.
The longer the time dragged on, the stronger Jack would become.
His increasingly powerful body, coupled with the cultivation of the extraordinary True Martial, erupted in terrifying power when combined.
Simply put, Jack was like a humanoid Giant Beast that could also cultivate, walking both the paths of physical Evolution and the rule of law.
This was why the Thunderflame Emperor Beast Avatar progressed so quickly and was already so powerful, and still, Jack continued to cultivate so diligently.
He was eager to see what heights he could reach with these two great advantages.
Would he become so strong after breaking through the Emperor level that he could obliterate kings with one punch, defeat Heavenly Kings?
Or perhaps once he broke through to a realm above Heavenly Kings, he could destroy The Purgatory Family and annihilate a civilization with his strength alone?

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 238: The Will of Heaven is Like a Knife
chapters.content:
Chapter 483  - 238: The Will of Heaven is Like a Knife
"Caught it!"
The next morning, when Jack Clark arrived at Mathilda Ward's room, he received a piece of surprising news.
At that moment, there were only four people in the living room: Mathilda Ward, Damon Lopes, Crystal Boyce, and Jack Clark.
As for Marla Fiore, Crystal Boyce's assistant, and her foster daughter, who was an ordinary person, she was not there as some matters were inconvenient for her to know.
Mathilda Ward nodded, "This morning, the Federation informed us that after your battle, the demon king avatar named Kautorus didn't completely fall."
"At that time, it depleted its divine soul's power not only to try killing you but also to escape from the Human Race's surveillance and tracking like a cicada shedding its skin."
"At the same time, Kautorus and Acunus weren't aligned in their thoughts; they were wary of each other during their cooperation, and Acunus had no idea about this plan."
"We managed to capture and seal a trace of Kautorus's soul, mainly thanks to Brudos."
"This individual is the fifth in line of succession of the Buredora Group, achieving astounding accomplishments in both genetics and cultivation, and is also a very patient fellow."
"To obtain 'experimental material,' he started engaging with the Demon God Sect and gradually gained the trust of The Purgatory Family, spending roughly seven years on this scheme."
"He was only thirteen at that time."
"Over the years, Brudos has been selling 'useful' intelligence to the Demon God Sect while acquiring copious resources from the mythical world through The Purgatory Family."
"With those resources and the Group's research assets, he has transformed his genetic war body to an extreme, stepping into the Seventh Layer and proclaimed to be peerless within the same rank."
"However, he usually moves around in a clone body, with his consciousness connected through a chip implanted in the clone's brain, creating the illusion that he's just an ordinary person."
"This is also why he has earned the trust of the Demon God Sect."
"A second son of a top-tier family, lacking cultivation talent, ostracized by his family from a young age, desiring to change his bloodline—the image suits the persona of a traitor perfectly."
"Currently, Kautorus's clone body has been sealed and transported to the entrance of the world passageways, where king-level strong ones have long been waiting."
"Next step is to lock onto the true body through the soul source positioning."
"The Purgatory Family is divided into many races, with a collective power that's actually stronger than the Human Race, but rife with internal strife. The War Demon tribe, to which Kautorus belongs, and another rival, the Kurole Devil Clan, are mortal enemies and sometimes even fight among themselves during major battles."
"The true body of Kautorus, now in a heavily injured state due to the downfall of its soul avatar, definitely wouldn't dare let the 'King of the Kurole Devil Clan' know, nor dare stay on the frontline, giving us a chance to eliminate its true body."
"So that's how it is." After Mathilda Ward finished explaining, Jack Clark slowly nodded.
No wonder he felt something was amiss due to his instincts at that time. Even in a possessed state, a king-level being had died too easily.
At the same time, he hadn't expected the Federation to have such a widespread network, with hidden hands in all areas, just waiting for it to emerge.
A grinning Damon Lopes said, "With this demon king Kautorus taken care of, only Blood God Acunus remains."
"A mere Early Sixth Heaven attached body, as long as it dares to come out, either of us can suppress it with ease."
The strength of these king-level soul embodied beings cannot be enhanced, so their threat is not as significant as initially thought.
Otherwise, the Federation would have mobilized a large number of high-ranking powerhouses to turn the entire world upside down, rather than send two top-notch geniuses to cooperate with Mathilda Ward in a fishing operation.
At eleven in the morning, the bustling Commercial Street of Mason was crowded, showing no signs of the small 'catastrophe' that had happened the day before.
As one of the most bustling cities in Gunaer, Mason boasts a population of over a million residents. Due to cultural differences, the architecture and customs here seem rougher and more open.
For instance, beauties in short skirts that show off their long legs can be seen everywhere on the main street.
Especially those women, with voluptuous figures, dressed in off-shoulder dresses or tight-fitting bodysuits, fair-skinned, and with distinct facial features, exuding a unique charm.
Besides, one can occasionally see some Genetic Martial Cultivators. These individuals exude a wild aura, with robust physiques and sharp eyes.
Some even display mutant features, such as an arm covered in scales like a Kirin's or a head sprouting small horns.
Far from being scorned or feared, many onlookers reveal a look of envy.
Because this signifies that one's Genetic Martial Arts have reached at least the Triplex realm.
Damon Lopes's eyes swept over a beauty with impressive curves, and he excitedly said, "Brother Callum, I've found I quite like this city."
Jack Clark gave him a weird look, "You mean you like how you can add lots of Beautiful Female Friends? Just be careful you don't run out of red envelopes to give out."
Today, both Jack Clark and Damon Lopes were made to dress in leisure suits by the forceful request of Mathilda Ward, forgoing their usual bodyguard or Daoist robe attire.
In addition, because they've been overexposed, they not only wore sunglasses but also donned a Duckbill Cap.
Compared to their low-key dressing, Marla Fiore and Mathilda Ward, who went out for shopping, were much more exquisite.
Take Marla Fiore, for instance. She wore a pink bodysuit with a white lacy collar and cuffs, paired with a white hip-hugging mini skirt.
Beneath the skirt, she flaunted long legs wrapped in white stockings, and silver high heels added to her sexy and bright appearance.
Mathilda Ward, on the other hand, was in a pair of slim-fit jeans, with a simple white bodysuit on top featuring a crystal-studded rabbit pattern in the middle, quirky yet fashionable.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 238: The Will of Heaven is Like a Knife_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Chapter 238: The Will of Heaven is Like a Knife_2
However, to avoid being recognized, Mathilda Ward also wore a duckbill cap and sunglasses on her head.
Eager to take a stroll on the streets for a change, Mathilda Ward and Marla Fiore were exhilarated, looking around with great interest and holding specialty snacks from Mason City in their hands.
While shopping, they could occasionally hear the conversations of genetic warriors, discussing the devastating battle that had occurred the day before. Besides lamenting the death toll from yesterday, they regretted not witnessing the battle themselves, as it was an opportunity to see a being close to King-level in action.
At that moment, Damon Lopes suddenly said, “Brother Callum, let’s discuss something.”
“What’s up?”
Damon Lopes said cheerfully, “You gotta let me have Akunus if it shows up later, I want to experience what it feels like to slay a god.” “Isn’t that your mission?” Jack Clark asked, looking puzzled.
Their division of labor had always been for Damon Lopes to confront the enemy while he was responsible for detecting the enemy and close-protection of Mathilda Ward—like the demon that attacked earlier, which had been handed over to him.
Akunus was an exception.
Damon Lopes was somewhat worried: “I’m just confirming with you to avoid you blasting Akunus by reflex later on.”
They didn’t have much choice; only one monster remained.
“Don’t worry, I definitely won’t make a move unless it poses a threat to Miss Ward’s safety,” Jack Clark assured him.
At this time, the four of them arrived at Mason’s largest mall, which was crowded, and suddenly someone excitedly shouted, “Mathilda Ward, it’s Mathilda Ward!”
Suddenly, many eyes turned towards the group, especially towards Jack Clark, who was wearing sunglasses.
“It really is Mathilda Ward; 1 recognize that bodyguard, his incredibly handsome profile is too distinctive.”
“It’s definitely him.”
“Ilisa, may I have your autograph?”
“Darren Callum, I’m a fan of yours!”
Suddenly the crowd stirred, and many young men and women rushed over in excitement.
Burst! Just as the people approached, an intense aura exploded from Jack Clark’s body, pressurizing the surrounding air into gusts of raging winds that made it difficult for many to keep their eyes open.
In an instant, the surroundings quieted down, and everyone was paralyzed by the terrifying brutal pressure, their faces turning white, with many trembling and showing expressions of terror.
Only then did they remember that this man had slain gods, and that just the aftermath of his battles had caused thousands of casualties.
Not until then did Jack Clark say coldly, “Stop, don’t come any closer, and asking for autographs requires Miss Ward’s consent.”
As Jack Clark slowly withdrew his aura, sighs of relief rippled through the crowd.
At this point, Mathilda Ward smiled and said, “Thank you all for your support and love. Meeting you here is also a kind of fate. Those who want autographs, please come one by one.”
After Mathilda Ward finished speaking, there was a slight pause before a nervous young man raised his hand.
“I want one, I want an autograph.”
“Me too, I’m also a fan of yours, Ilisa…”
With someone leading, many followed suit and began to queue up conscientiously. Spotting this, the mall’s person in charge hurriedly brought over a table and paper and pens.
The shopping trip turned into a signing event, and when news spread that Mathilda Ward was there and giving autographs, people flocked to the scene.
But as they were signing autographs, suddenly a girl who had just received an autograph on her notebook approached Jack Clark, stammeringly asking, “Excuse me, Mr. Callum, could you please give me your autograph too?” Jack Clark, wearing sunglasses, coldly refused, “Sorry, I’m just a bodyguard.” Immediately, the girl’s face showed disappointment, and Damon Lopes really wanted to say if he won’t sign, 1’11 do it for you.
But at this moment, a gasp arose from the crowd; Mathilda Ward, who was sitting at the table smiling while signing autographs, turned pale and suddenly fell backward.
“Not good!” Jack Clark caught Mathilda Ward in an instant.
Soon, the news that Mathilda Ward had fainted in the mall spread across the internet.
In Mason City’s largest and foremost hospital, Jack Clark stood calmly by the window in the special ward, with Crystal Boyce and military zone doctors, who radiated a high-order aura, rushing to her side.
I he reason for Mathilda Ward’s fainting was simple—soul weakening, and the intensity of this weakening was stronger than ever, causing her to lose consciousness.
As for when she would wake up, that would depend on her.
Such is life; accidents always come unexpectedly, and no arrangement or plan can keep up with changes.
With a slight sigh in his heart, Jack Clark’s attention turned to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
After feasting for a day, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had finally finished off the Tiger Flood Dragon, crunching most of the bones, leaving only some residue and the crystallized, huge spine.
The one hundred and seventy meters long ice-blue spine connected to the half-shattered skull, exuded an oppressive aura that could terrify ordinary people.
This is a Level 9 Giant Beast, and even the leftover bones are too formidable for ordinary life to approach or disrespect.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast had grown to eighty-nine meters, its form more massive and ferocious, emanating the overwhelming presence of a gigantic creature.
It s a pity the Spatial Channel is too small; otherwise, just this spine bone alone would be worth thousands of Contribution Points, enough to create sky weapons or high-level mechas.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast looked at the Tiger Flood Dragon’s spine with some regret before turning its gaze to its surroundings, pondering in its eyes.
It was considering whether to make this location its Headquarters for the Dragon Palace.
Compared to the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace on a nearby desert island, this location in the Outer Sea, four thousand meters deep and over four thousand kilometers away, was more suitable as a base..

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 238: The Will of Heaven is Like a Knife_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Chapter 238: The Will of Heaven is Like a Knife_3
Especially since this place was truly a small world within itself, where the energy of Heaven and Earth was rich, with both land and water areas, and in the distance, there stood an active volcano dispelling the darkness.
Roar!
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon, which had been in hibernation for a day, let out a low growl, suddenly stood up, its Dragon Wings flared angrily behind it, and an even more powerful burst of Dragon Might erupted from its body.
Boom!
Under the pressure of its substantial authority, the Earth cracked, the surrounding air trembled, and white airwaves surged in all directions like a tsunami, with the sound of flying sand and rolling stones creating an astonishing momentum.
This time, the King-class Silver Dragon’s bloodline had received a certain improvement, even its body shape had undergone some adjustments, with a broader dragon head and a more harmonious figure.
Even the Dragon Scales on its body seemed a bit more lustrous and translucent, and from a distance, it looked like a Giant Dragon cast from silver crystal, somewhat elegant in appearance.
Roar! What am I thinking, elegant my ass. Thunderflame Emperor Beast shook its head.
It couldn’t believe it found an eighty-meter-long, ferocious and fierce Giant Dragon associating with the word “elegant”—utter nonsense.
Seeing the Thunderflame Emperor Beast shaking its head, the Silver Giant Dragon showed a puzzled look in its eyes, “Roar! Hegemon, is there a problem?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast changed the subject, growling, “No problem, by the way, Sethia, what do you think about this place as our new Headquarters for the Dragon Palace?”
“Moving?” The Silver Giant Dragon was taken aback.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast shook its head: “It’s not really moving. We Transcendent Giant Beasts don’t have much stuff anyway, it’s just about building the Ice Crystal Palace here from scratch.”
Just like that? Why don’t you build it, don’t you know that it’s very tiring for dragons? The Silver Giant Dragon complained inwardly.
“Of course, if you, Sethia, think rebuilding the Ice Crystal Palace is too tiring, everybody can just lie down on the ground for meetings as well.”
“Roar! How can that be acceptable.”
Imagine a bunch of Giant Beasts lying sprawled across ruins on an island, roaring and whining—the Silver Giant Dragon shuddered at the thought, it was too disgraceful for a dragon.
The Great Sethia was a Giant Dragon that aimed to establish a Beast Empire.
If its mother were to see that the Headquarters of the Beast Empire it established was a desolate island, wouldn’t she be mocked by her mother for ten years?
“By the way, Ghidorah also has ice abilities, though not as good as yours, Sethia, but how about giving this task to it?”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared, “A mere Ice Crystal Palace, leave it to the Great Sethia to handle.”
Whether it was for face or as the responsibility of the Dragon Palace Dragon King, constructing the new Ice Crystal Palace was its sole duty, and no one else could take it.
Seeing this, the corners of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s mouth curled up slightly, looking quite menacing.
Being the boss wasn’t so easy; when there’s work, you had to get it done, and when there’s blame, you had to take it.
Then, under the ‘guidance’ of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon burst forth with its full strength, and waves of tsunamis began the new construction of the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace.
First, it had to flatten the whole island’s ruins, and then cover it with a ten-meter-thick layer of ice crystal as ’tiles’.
In the design of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the new Dragon Palace would cover the entire island, sprawling over dozens of Reef Islands to form a massive palace complex encompassing land and water.
In it, creatures like the Tiger Whale that currently could not go onshore would live in the underwater palaces, and at the same time, half of the Dragon Palace’s main hall would be built in the sea to facilitate future meetings among the Giant Beasts.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was building halfway through the palace, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah just happened to wake up.
“Roar! Ghidorah, you awakened just in time. Hurry, go help Sethia build the new Dragon Palace; this is going to be our new Headquarters from now on.” Hearing the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had work for it, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon immediately filled with passion, its nine heads let out chaotic roars, “No, problem, leave it to Ghidorah.”
To this, the already panting Silver Giant Dragon pretended not to see.
But even with Ghidorah’s participation, covering a two-kilometer-diameter island with a layer of solid ice, and more than ten palaces each rising three hundred meters high and two hundred meters wide, took over half a day.
With the addition of auxiliary halls stretching across dozens of reef rocks, a whole day had passed by the time they were finished.
“Roar! Sethia, can’t do it anymore, so tired.”
The Silver Giant Dragon lay sprawled on the ice, its Dragon Wings drooping, its eyes rolling back, looking utterly spent.
On the other side, Ghidorah wasn’t faring much better, its massive body sprawled on the ice, with its nine heads scattered and tongues lolling, gasping for air.
This time they had practically rebuilt half the small world; even Eighth Level Beasts couldn’t withstand such massive consumption.
Off in the distance, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast stood on a hundred-meter-high Call-up Ice Platform, overlooking the magnificent and vast Ice Crystal architectural complex in all directions, nodding in satisfaction. “Roar! Not bad, this is the Dragon Palace I had imagined.”
Right now, in front of the small world was the Ice Crystal Palace complex covering half the small world, behind was the fiery Lava Lake, along with the active volcano at the end spewing black poison smoke.
The reflection of fire-red light beneath it created an image reminiscent of an ancient relic from the end of days, appearing very magnificent and spectacular.
Looking at the two exhausted Giant Beasts sprawled on the ground, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, “You rest here, I’m going to patrol the vicinity and look for some food.”
Although it had consumed the flesh and blood of a Level 9 Giant Beast, most of the energy had transformed into physical growth and Evolution value.
Therefore, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, with two doses of its Essence Blood and the vitality deficit from feeding the Purple Dragon Egg, still hadn’t fully recovered. It needed to eat much more meat’.
The Silver Giant Dragon lay weakly on the ground, limbs spread out, Dragon Wings flapping gently, and growled, “Go ahead, the Great Sethia needs a good rest..”

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 239: Dragon Series Law (Request for Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Chapter 239: Dragon Series Law (Request for Monthly Pass)
Mathilda Ward’s soul exhaustion burst was even more severe than anyone had imagined, she had been in a coma for two days without any signs of awakening, which was worrying.
“What did the doctor say?”
“They say they haven’t found the cause of the coma yet.
“Isn’t this hospital the best in Mason? How come they can’t find the problem when the person is in a coma, can’t detect any cause?”
“1 don’t know; now we can only hope that Ilisa is okay. She’s such a kind person, how could she suddenly fall into a coma?
“Do you think Ilisa could have been poisoned?”
“That can’t be, right? If it were poison, how could the doctor not detect it?
“It’s hard to say; there are so many Mutated Creatures nowadays, all with various strange powers, and naturally, the venom from those highly poisonous creatures would mutate as well.”
“Now that Ilisa has been in a coma for two days and they can t find the problem, do you think it could be a nerve-affecting poison?”
“Moreover, Ilisa fell into a coma just when she was taking photos and signing autographs with fans at the mall; it might have been someone there. I think we should catch all those people and interrogate them.”
“Now that you mention it, it does seem possible.”
In the corridor, members of the music team and dance group, who had already arrived, gathered outside the ward, all showing worry and unease for Mathilda
Ward.
As an international Star, Mathilda Ward has a good personality and no airs, so she is well-liked by the people in the company team.
They were also worried about their own careers.
If something really happened to Mathilda Ward, where would they find such easy, high-paying jobs?
At this moment, not just the company staff, but the media and fans from the outside world were also paying close attention to Mathilda Ward’s coma, especially after the recent news about Mason’s King’s Fall and Innate
Awakened Ones.
It could be said the internet was very lively lately.
Previously, those who followed Mathilda Ward were only in the entertainment industry and her fans, but now, due to the Evil God and a series of attacks, many more people had become curious about her.
Curious about what kind of background she had that could attract the pursuit of an Evil God, and also have the protection of the military’s Monster Genius and Innate Awakened Ones.
in the ward, Crystal Boyce and Marla Fiore stood by the bedside with somber expressions.
Damon Lopes had his arms crossed, leaning against the wall, while Jack Clark stood by the window, looking outside with a calm demeanor.
At that moment, Crystal Boyce’s handbag vibrated. After confirming the connection, Tyler Lance’s projection appeared on the wall, his face resolute, looking at them and speaking in a deep voice.
“Have you used the soul resources sent from Berlin for Misss Joseline?”
“No.”
Crystal Boyce gave a wry smile, “Misss Joseline has developed resistance to soul-type resources. As soon as we fed her the Soul Tempering Liquid, it dissipated into pure soul energy.”
“At the moment, there are still no signs of Misss Joseline waking up, and her soul is clearly getting weaker. If she doesn’t wake within five days, she may never wake up again.”
As she spoke, a faint sadness appeared on Crystal Boyce’s face.
Tyler Lance fell silent for a moment, then said in a deep voice, “Misss Joseline’s soul exhaustion outbreak happened earlier than we expected, let’s wait another day.”
“Tomorrow, whether she has awakened or not, bring her back to Eastern
Summer.”
“The follow-up plan to lure the enemy with a bait is canceled. Just an Avatar of Akunus isn’t going to stir up much trouble; there’s no need to put everything on one young girl.”
“As for the Federation, I’ll explain when the time comes.”
“Okay,” nodded Crystal Boyce.
After finishing, Tyler Lance looked at Damon Lopes and Jack Clark, and said solemnly, “You two have made great efforts this time. Thanks to your work, our race has once again succeeded in slaying a Purgatory Demon King.”
“We’ve found that demon Icing’s True Form so quickly?” Both Jack Clark and Damon Lopes showed surprise.
Tyler Lance nodded, “Three days ago, after sending that strand of Soul Source from the sealed Kautorus, the True Martial Heavenly King took action personally to locate and lock the position.”
“This time, the Frontline Battlefield secretly dispatched five King-level beings who, with the force of Thunder, struck down Kautorus lurking a million kilometers away and healing from wounds.”
“Afterward, they even clashed with four demon kings and a Great Demon King who came to support, sparking a King-level battle that only ended yesterday afternoon.”
“This time, not only did we slay one of their demon kings, but the Great Demon King who came in support was also wounded by the True Martial Heavenly King and won’t recover for five years.”
“However, two of our kings were also seriously injured and have been pulled back to the rear of the battlefield.”
Hearing Tyler Lance’s words, Jack Clark felt his blood boiling. A battle of ten King-level beings, including the True Martial Heavenly King who started the Body Casting Skill.
Such a high-level battle lasted two days, one could imagine how intense it was at that time.
Damon Lopes was also somewhat excited, “Kings, eh? 1 wonder when we will be able to make our breakthrough.” At that moment, he suddenly felt that chatting with beauties wasn’t as appealing.
Chatting wasn’t as fun as cultivation.
Afterward, Tyler Lance briefly instructed them on a few matters before ending the call.
However, in the afternoon, amid everyone’s concerns, Mathilda Ward slowly woke up. At that time in the ward, only Jack Clark was sitting beside her, quietly reading a ‘book’.
When Jack Clark sensed the change in Mathilda Ward’s breathing, he withdrew his attention from the Secret Book and smiled, “You’re awake, Miss Ward. How do you feel now?”
Mathilda Ward’s face was a bit pale as she gave a weak smile and said weakly, “I’m okay, not going to die.”
Seeing the weakened Mathilda Ward, Jack Clark was puzzled, “After your last soul exhaustion, didn’t you recover quickly? Why are you so weak now?”

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 239: Dragon Series Law (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Chapter 239: Dragon Series Law (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
Last time, he also witnessed the sight of Mathilda Ward’s weak soul, but after that wave of exhaustion passed, her eyes blinked, and she was restored as before.
“It doesn’t have the strength anymore,”
“It?” Jack Clark’s gaze paused slightly.
Without concealment, Mathilda spoke weakly, “It is Akunus s dragon, or rather, it carries half of its divine soul and the origin of the Dragon’s Law.” “As a strong man well-known since the Dark Age, called the Nine-headed Blood Dragon, Akunus possessed the laws of blood and dragon, with strength nearing that of the Heavenly King Level.”
“Back then, it ambushed and heavily injured my mother. Though my father tried various methods and used up countless resources at that time, my mother still gave birth to me and passed away six months later.”
“Driven by anger and sorrow, my father pursued Akunus for millions of miles into the mythical world, exhausting every place in heaven and earth.”
“Although in the end it escaped with the help of the Great Demon King from The Purgatory Family, it was severely wounded by my father, who cut off the dragon and half of its divine soul.”
“The fact that I have survived until now is mainly because 1 have been relying on the origin of that dragon’s laws, along with other soul-type resources.” “But that dragon is like duckweed without roots, its power diminishes with every use, and after all these years, the origin of its laws is almost depleted.’ “And with the divine soul being cut and laws stripped away, Akunus also fell from the strength of someone close to Heavenly King Level to that of ordinary kings who have just made a breakthrough.”
“Moreover, it didn’t dare show its face for over a decade, hiding in the territory of The Purgatory Family and stirring trouble by establishing the Blood God
Sect.”
“This time, with my father’s disappearance and Akunus sneaking back to Blue Star, it intends to take back its dragon.”
“As long as it completes its own divine soul and laws, it can quickly return to its peak.”
“That’s also why we were certain it would come for me.’
“Because once I die, the origin of the Dragon’s Law, without a soul to support it, will also dissipate, and it will no longer have the chance to recover its peak strength.”
Jack Clark slowly said, “I see.”
Although he had felt that there was more to the recent round-up, he hadn’t expected the core of it to lie with Mathilda Ward.
In that case, following the calculated sealing of Demon King Ciautorus, all they needed to do was wait for Akunus to come to them.
No matter how many schemes and tricks you have, I stand tall and immovable.
At that moment, Jack Clark said, “However, General Tyler Lance mentioned earlier that whether you wake up tomorrow or not, we will take an airplane back to Eastern Summer, and the plan to draw out the snake is canceled.”
Mathilda Ward’s brows furrowed immediately, “No, Akunus must die.”
She had a deep-seated hatred towards Akunus, not only for her mother’s death but also because it had a hand in her second brother s demise, so she had to take revenge.
“Brother Callum, could you please call Aunt Boyce for me? 1 need to talk to her about this,” she said.
Facing Mathilda’s determined gaze, Jack Clark nodded and took out his mobile phone to inform Crystal Boyce.
Soon after, Crystal Boyce held a press conference, announcing that due to health reasons, Mathilda Ward was canceling the upcoming international tour.
The concert in Mason City would be the last stop of her tour.
However, it would be postponed until Mathilda Ward’s recovery, and the exact time of the concert would be notified in advance.
The fans from Simon and other countries of Berlin released cries of dismay. Jack Clark paid no mind to these reactions. Once he confirmed that Mathilda, weakened, was discharged from the hospital, he returned to the hotel for her to recuperate.
In the hotel.
Watching over Lionel Lopez and other bodyguards, Jack Clark calmly ordered, “Starting now, no one is allowed to come above the eighteenth floor of the hotel other than Miss Fiore and Boss Boyce.”
“This includes other personnel from the entertainment company, hotel staff, and Mason’s official personnel as well. Even in the case of urgent matters, they must be verified by me or Brother Lopes before being allowed up.”
“I do not wish for any accidents to occur before her recovery, understood?” Lionel Lopez’s expression was solemn as he loudly declared, “Rest assured, Mr. Callum, we will take turns guarding each entry point, not even a fly will be allowed to get through.”
The rest of the bodyguards also shouted, “Don’t worry, Mr. Callum, even at the cost of our lives, we won’t let anyone breach our defense.”
The battle from the earlier attack and Jack Clark’s achievement of slaying a Wicked God King had massively bolstered his image in the eyes of these bodyguards.
Even if that Wicked God King was just an avatar, he was equivalent to a king-level figure.
After arranging affairs below, Jack Clark returned to the lounge on the twentieth floor.
There, Damon Lopes was sitting on the sofa, playing with his mobile phone, his fingers rapidly tapping the screen, as an involuntarily smug smile crossed his face.
The thought that chatting with beauties seemed less interesting upon hearing about the battles between kings and demon lungs that morning had long been forgotten.
Recently, Damon Lopes added a few beauties from the hotel and nearby areas. As a recently well-known Innate Awakened One, he doesn’t even have to speak now for those beauties to proactively add him as a friend.
Nor does he need to send red envelopes anymore.
These days, over a hundred beauties in his mobile phone have been proactively chatting with him daily, sending him sexy private photos, with continuous suggestive temptations.
Some of the content was even explicit, directly asking when they could book a room, eager to taste the flavor of an Innate Awakened One and see how big it was.
Even Jack Clark was rendered speechless by some of the brazen content he glanced at.
Jack Clark reminded him, “Be careful, Brother Lopes, and pay attention to those beauties you’ve recently added.”
Damon Lopes replied with ease, “Don’t worry, Brother Callum, I just enjoy chatting with them, looking at pictures, and I won’t tell them anything else..”

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 239: Dragon Series Law (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Chapter 239: Dragon Series Law (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3
Damon Lopes knew what Jack Clark meant.
Seeing this, Jack Clark didn’t say anything more and nodded, “I’ll go up and watch. The rest is up to you.”
Although they felt some regret about Mathilda Ward’s ‘injury,’ neither Jack Clark nor Damon Lopes felt particularly sentimental, as they had been aware of this before arriving.
To them, death and slaughter were experiences they had undergone many times; they had long become indifferent to them.
The girls inside the room lay quietly in hibernation.
Outside on the balcony, Jack Clark sat in the sunlight, holding a ‘book’ in his hands.
His Secret Book had only constructed the foundations of the Seventh Layer thus far, and the next step was to solve the conflict of talents to achieve the fusion of various gifted powers.
Although these forces originated from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, they were just the core Talent Runes, not the complete chain covering the entire body of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
After all, the difference between a human’s body and that of a Giant Beast was too great, whether in terms of size or structure.
In the void of white space standing at an impressive thirty meters tall was a figure with three faces and six arms, dressed in black-red scale armor, with four rings of light slowly rotating behind its head.
Through successive optimizations, the Three-headed Six-armed form had evolved into a Three-faced Six-armed one.
Currently, the most powerful set of arms had fused with the torso, and next were the four arms that wielded Thunder and Golden Flame.
After the failure of the evolution world, the talents of regeneration and toxin had been discarded by Jack Clark, retaining only those talent abilities that amplified his combat strength, aiming for purity.
Although Mathilda Ward was too weak to go out, Jack Clark was still busy. In addition to constructing the Secret Book, he had to pay attention to the deep sea.
He needed to enhance the other five talents to Top Tier before the Thunderflame Emperor Beast reached the Late Stage 9.
He even wanted to see if it was possible to strengthen one or two of those top-tier talents, including his own Soul Talent, to a higher level.
Two hundred meters below the sea surface, the fearsome black-red colossal beast slumped its claws on protruding reef rocks on the seabed, its cold gaze from golden vertical pupils staring ahead.
Two days had passed, and after killing and consuming some Level 7 creatures, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had grown to ninety-two meters in size, its aura increasingly terrifying.
The deficit of life energy within its body had finally been replenished.
At this moment, hundreds of meters away, a blue giant beast with a body length exceeding thirty meters and six thick legs spanning over forty meters wide, with a pair of colossal pincers, gazed in terror at it.
Under the near-Monarch level terrifying pressure of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, this Level 7 Colossus had no will to fight and trembled in fear, lying there not daring to move.
This was a rare crab-like Giant Beast. The Thunderflame Emperor Beast had roamed the oceans for some time (half a year) and had never encountered a crab Unique Beast that had grown to Level 7.
This was also why it did not immediately kill it.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s massive maw opened slightly, emitting a low growl, “I am the King of Thunderflame from the Dragon Palace, Brock Abbott. You seem quite suitable for gate-keeping.”
“Now, I give you two choices, join the Dragon Palace as a gatekeeper, or be devoured by me.”
Feeling the terrifying killing intent emitting from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the blue giant crab trembled violently, emitting a mass of bubbles from its mouth and projecting blurry Mental Fluctuations.
Gurgle gurgle!! Join, join, Great, King, please don’t eat, me.
Compared to highly intelligent Unique Beasts like the Mutated Tiger Whale, this blue giant crab had some intelligence, but not much. Fortunately, it was still capable of communication.
Of course, more importantly, it had ‘clear’ consciousness, without the savagery and brutality that other Level 7 colossal beasts possessed.
“Roar! Good, follow me,” said the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, turning its massive body. Jets of searing vapors blasted from the sharp horns on its shoulders as it plunged into the dark sea.
Seeing this, the blue giant crab hurriedly followed, its six legs sliding swiftly across the seabed to catch up, its mouth emitting a large quantity of bubbles. Gurgle gurgle!! Great, Great King, wait for me.
“Roar! Hurry up, you’re even slower than Domination, that fellow,” barked the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great, Great King, what is Domination?
“Roar! Shut up, we’ll talk when we get back,” growled the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, silencing the inquiries of the blue giant crab.
These Giant Beast ‘Type Creatures usually had little interaction with others, leading solitary lives. Therefore, when they encountered a ‘fellow’ like the Thunderflame Emperor Beast with whom they could communicate, they exhibited a strong desire to engage in conversation.
This could be observed from the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had turned into a constant chatterbox, questioning non-stop all the way.
Similarly, this blue giant crab, which had just recently thought its demise was certain, felt almost the same way.
Finding that not only was it not going to die, but it also followed a very powerful king with whom it could ‘talk’, that excited and eager desire to communicate surged forth.
And then it was promptly suppressed by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
It had had enough of their nagging and wouldn’t hesitate to slap them dead and devour them viciously.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast made a realization: the Dragon Palace it had established did indeed seem to bear some resemblance to the mythological dragon palaces.
The Tortoise Prime Minister, Tiger Fish Grand General, Crab General—should it specifically look for a Level 7 shrimp-like Giant Beast next to form a Shrimp Soldier and Crab General combo?

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 240: Void Summoning
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Chapter 240: Void Summoning
Seabed, Water and Fire World.
In front of the towering Ice Crystal Palace, which is 500 meters high and 800 meters wide, stands a silver giant dragon with a body length of 80 meters and shoulder height of more than 40 meters on the stairs.
Under the slightly upturned ferocious dragon head, a pair of spiral dragon horns slant straight into the firmament, while its dragon eyes are indifferent and its body exudes an aura of dignity and majesty.
With a body length of 150 meters, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon rises halfway, its nine black dragon heads covering the sky and the peak of the eighth level aura emanating from it, pressing the air in a radius of 100 meters to explode.
After the bloodline activation and awakening this time, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah not only grew a section but also reached the peak of the eighth level in realm.
As long as its major talents are integrated next, it can break through to the ninth level and become a pinnacle creature standing under the myth.
Aside from that, there is a Deep Sea Dragon Turtle with a body length of 70 meters and a height of more than 4.0 meters lying on the side of the silver giant dragon, as well as a Single-horned Tiger Whale sinking and floating in the water, resembling a small island.
Under the watchful eyes of the four powerful eighth Level Beasts, the Blue Giant Crab, with its six legs weakened in the shallow water over 10 meters deep, shivered with its pincers click-click-clicking.
The Blue Giant Crab didn’t expect the Dragon Palace to be so terrifying.
Aside from the terrifying giant beast, there were four powerful extraordinary giant beasts, and the pressure each one emanated made it instinctively feel fear and awe.
At this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, standing on the Ice Crystal steps, roared low, extending its claw and pointing to the Silver Giant Dragon as it introduced, “This is the King of Storms and Frost in the Dragon Palace, Dragon Palace Dragon King, Scythia.”
Glug glug!! Greetings, great Sethia King.
The Crab General released some bubbles from his mouth, feeling a bit nervous.
The silver giant dragon nodded proudly, “Roar! As an ordinary transcendent species, it’s an honor for you to join the Dragon Palace, although I don’t know what Hegemon saw in you.”
Glug glug!! I am also very grateful to King Thunferflame for taking a fancy to me.
Glug! From now on, I will keep an eye on the front door and guard the Dragon Palace, and not let the mighty and strong King Thunferflame down…
Just then, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared in a low groan, changing the “person” it was introducing, “Roar! Alright, this is the Nine-Headed Dragon King Ghidorah.”
Immediately, the endless flattery from the Blue Giant Crab was interrupted, and then it looked up at the Nine-headed Black Dragon, showing respect with bubbles.
Glug glug!! Greetings, Ghidorah, Great King, you look so mighty, so strong, just your aura makes my six legs go weak, so powerful, worthy of being the Great Dragon King of the Dragon Palace…
The nine black flood dragon heads rolled and roared in confusion, “Roar roar roar!! You, very, good, know the trends, welcome, join the Dragon Palace.” After a round of praise, Ghidorah was in a good mood and immediately looked at the newcomer more favorably.
Glug glug!! Thank you, Ghidorah, Great King, you are really…
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared to interrupt it, “This is the King of Earth and Destruction, Domination.”
After the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle broke through to the eighth level, it also became a King-class giant beast of the Dragon Palace, and was given the name King of Earth and Destruction by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
There’s no way around it, the Dragon Palace only has the Thunderflame Emperor Beast with a little “culture”, so it’s the only one who can handle the naming process.
Glug glug!! Greetings, King of Domination, you look so mighty and strong, just the aura you’re emitting makes my six legs tremble.
The Blue Giant Crab unleashed repetitive praises from its mouth.
There’s no other way, it only knows how to say these things, which it summed up on its way back by constantly flattering the Thunderflame Emperor Beast. Although every time it spoke, it would be rudely interrupted by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast after a few words, and once it even flew several hundred meters when it couldn’t stand the chattering and slapped it with a claw.
But the repeated compliments pleased the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, who roared, “Roar roar!! Kid, you’re not bad, just follow your uncle Domination from now on, and I guarantee you’ll eat well and drinkwell.”
Glug glug!! Thank you, King of Domination, you are so mighty…
“Roar! Finally, this is the King of Black and White, Jerry Jones,” Thunderflame Emperor Beast held back the impulse to give the Blue Giant Crab a slap and finally introduced the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
When choosing the name earlier, the Single-horned Tiger Whale felt that its Joe name wasn’t domineering enough, so it asked the Thunderflame Emperor Beast to give it a new domineering name.
But even though its name had been changed to Jerry Jones, everyone was still used to calling it Joe.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale in the water was slapping its tail.
Ying ying ying!! Little guy, congratulations on joining the Dragon Palace. Stick with us, and you’ll eat three meals a day, plunder, eat, and kill all the other guys.
Glug glug!! Kill all, eat all, eat three meals a day, Jerry Jones King, you’re so mighty, so powerful, just your aura…
In the face of innate violence from mutated creatures, the blue giant crab’s eyes lit up when it heard the Single-horned Tiger Whale mention plundering and killing.
It’s just that the praise heard by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast made its head even bigger, and it couldn’t help but growl, “Roar! Crab General, shut up and let me deal with important matters.”
Immediately, the silver giant dragon and several giant beasts turned their eyes solemnly.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared low, “Since we have chosen this place as our Headquarters, we must ensure absolute control over our surroundings.” “From now on, all ‘people’ set off, at intervals of 20 kilometers, to join forces and clear the surrounding 1,000-kilometer radius of Level 7 or higher mutated creatures, and collect resources.”
“If you come across difficult eighth-level mutated giant beasts, notify people from both sides to join forces and kill them, or submit them to the Dragon Palace.”
“By the way, if you encounter Level 4. or higher mutated creatures at the peak, kill them too, as 1 need the Life Crystals in their bodies..”

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 240 Void Summoning !
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 240 Void Summoning !
As an Ocean Overlord, a Level 9 Giant Beast ensured that within a thousand kilometers, there would not be another Level 9 Giant Beast, and within a hundred kilometers, no mutated creatures above Level 7 would appear.
In this three-dimensional sea area, not only were there countless marine life forms and many resources, but also Life Crystals. Naturally, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast would not let these slip by.
Especially those Life Crystals, they were the key to its transformation into a Monarch-Level Life.
ROAR ROAR ROAR!!
RUSH RUSH RUSH!!
Under the leadership of the black-red ferocious giant beast, followed closely by the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, five behemoths thunderously stirred up violent waves as they burst out of the Dragon Palace.
This spectacle made the Blue Giant Crab’s blood boil; the Dragon Palace was simply too powerful, these Dragon Kings too fierce. Merely the aura they emitted made its six legs go weak…
On the Overseas Island.
In the dimly lit cave where flames burned on the mountain walls, a long-haired youth sat quietly on a throne constructed from the skeletons of various Unique Beasts, his gaze cold as he looked down.
Below him stood dozens of Blood God Cultists; the strongest among them had an aura that had reached the early phase of the Seventh Layer, while a few weaker ones were only at the Triplex. Most were between the Fifth and the Seventh Layers.
These were most of Akunus’ forces lurking within Blue Star.
Developing over the span of more than a decade, the Blood God Sect had actually amassed quite a large influence in secret on Blue Star, with several individuals stronger than Seventh Layer Heaven. However, they had all been depleted in the battle against Koroya.
Now only several tens of lesser cats were left, scarcely capable of being put to use.
At this moment, the only Seventh Heaven bishop took a step forward and respectfully said, “My god, as per your instructions, the Blood Pool below has been filled with the blood of mutated creatures.”
Akunus nodded slightly: “Well done.”
Instantly, fanaticism appeared on the faces of the dozens of Blood God Cultists. Although it was just a simple phrase, it signified that their efforts had been recognized by the deities they worshipped.
To fulfill Akunus’ task, these cultists had spent a month and nearly wiped out all mutated creatures of Level 6 and below within hundreds of kilometers.”
For this, they had exhausted a great deal of Lure God Liquid—a substance with strong attraction to mutated creatures from the mythical world.
Then Akunus spoke in a deep voice, “Besides filling the Blood Pool, have all the runes been inscribed?”
The bishop bowed, head lowered, and respectfully said, “Reporting to my god, following the blueprint you provided, the sacrificial runes have been fully carved around the Blood Pool on the mountain walls.”
“Good, come with me.”
“Yes.”
Quickly, under the lead of Akunus, a group journeyed underground.
This was a vast underground space.
At its center, a huge pit filled with the corpses of Marine Life emanated blood that filled the pit and gave off a strong smell. The blood, having originated from Mutated Creatures and containing energy, didn’t dry up easily and emitted a red glow that illuminated the entire cave like Blood Hell.
Evil runes that looked like demons bearing fangs and claws covered the ground and mountain walls, spreading a sinister and eerie Aura that was a bit chilling.
“Everyone, take your places at the nodes.”
“Yes.”
On Akunus’ command, those fanatically devoted followers of his did not hesitate, spreading out around the Blood Pool, right above the nodes of the Rune Array.
“Never thought the thing I left behind years ago would have another day of use. After decades, this blood river should almost be ripe for succession.”
As Akunus spoke, a cold glint appeared in his eyes, and around him burst forth a Terrifying Aura. Infinite blood light shone and transformed into a huge phantom of a Nine-headed Blood Python.
“I’m no fool like Kautorus, whom sets out unprepared.”
ROAR ROAR ROAR!!
With the howling of the Nine-headed Blood Python behind Akunus, a malevolent Will erupted. Under its overwhelming power, the eyes of all the Blood God Cultists turned red.
With faces full of fanaticism, they yelled, “For our god!”
A spurting sound followed as dozens of people simultaneously cut their wrists, the blood gushing onto the runes beneath them.
“I am Akunus, the supreme Blood God, and now I call by the true name, return to me, o vanished blood river; merge again into one with me…”
Accompanied by the eerie chant, with the runes absorbing the Essence Blood of the frenzied cultists, the ones scattered throughout the cave began to light up one by one.
HUM!
The runes flickered, red light spilled, and a ferocious devil’s blood face formed within the Blood Pool. It smiled wickedly at Akunus and opened its mouth.
BOOM! The entire Blood Pool erupted, and as its blood boiled, the numerous corpses of Marine Life began dissolving. The blood, like a living entity, surged into the gaping maw of the demon’s face.
Dozens of Blood God Cultists sacrificed their Essence Blood and even souls, forming a demonic face that seemed to connect to an unknown Void.
The blood flowed into it, forming a winding red path that continued to extend.
As the bloody path spread deep into the Void, along with Akunus’ chanting spell, a force in the pitch-black Void seemed to be drawn forth.
THUNDEROUS RUMBLES!!
The Void trembled, the blood river roared, and in an instant, a vast and mighty blood-colored river emerged from deep within the Void, filled with countless crying and struggling figures.
Seeing this scene, a hint of smile appeared on Akunus’ face.
BOOM! Accompanying the roaring of the blood river, the surreal river burst forth from the Void and rushed towards Akunus, boundless and unending, blending the countless writhing shadows into his body.
Finally, at his brow, layer upon layer of red wave-like patterns formed.
Decades ago, Akunus created the Blood Sea Secret Scripture and spread the Blood Seed throughout the world. Refining millions of people’s blood, he surged to the Ninth Heaven Peak in a short time and touched upon the Law of Blood..

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 240: Void Summoning_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 240: Void Summoning_3
Countless cultivators and Blood Envoys have died in its hands under such circumstances.
The fragmented souls of Blood Envoys and cultivators with cultivation above the Fourth Layer Heaven were all collected by it, gathering countless blood energy to refine an Endless Blood River.
That was a type of domain equipment, prepared to carry its Law of Blood.
However, under the siege of other human powerhouses, the refinement of this domain equipment was interrupted halfway, and it was forced to leave Blue Star World and escape to the mythical world.
After arriving in the mythical world, it obtained some opportunities and killed a Level 9 Peak Three-headed Golden Dragon.
Devouring the Essence Blood of the Three-headed Golden Dragon, refining its flesh and blood, and fusing it with the Law of Blood, not only did it break through to the King Level in one fell swoop, but it also condensed the Nine-headed Blood Dragon Law containing the Blood Law and the Dragon’s Law.
Under such circumstances, the Blood River that had once fallen into the void in the Blue Star World was naturally forgotten by Akunus.
Unexpectedly, when it returned this time, there was a day when the domain equipment that was refined halfway back then could be restarted.
Moreover, after decades had passed, it had already been completed within itself; it was just… sensing the Blood River domain integrated into his body, Akunus’ brows furrowed slightly.
Because of the reason that it had fallen into the void while refining halfway back then, the power of this Blood Sea Field was greatly reduced.
Not to mention suppressing and killing Ninth Heaven Experts, the spatial intensity of the Blood River Domain could not even suppress the Eight Layer cultivators, and it could shatter the domain by just bursting into the Mid-eighth level.
“Mid-eighth level, it’s enough.” Akunus’s gaze was calm.
Those two Human Clan geniuses guarding Mathilda Ward were strong, but their realm was only Sixth Layer Heaven; it didn’t believe that they could burst out the destructive power of the Mid-eighth level with a Sixth Layer Heaven realm.
Such a possibility simply did not exist; even a Heavenly King Level powerhouse could not burst out the power of the Eighth Layer Heaven with a Sixth Layer Heaven realm.
Moreover, its Blood River was not just for trapping people; it contained hundreds of thousands of Blood Demons formed by the ‘rebirth’ of the soul-wills of advanced cultivators.
These monsters used blood as their strength, and as long as the Blood River did not dry up, they would not perish, and there were Blood Demons with Sixth Layer Heaven strength among them.
As long as they could not break the Blood River Domain, even a strong man in the Eighth Layer Early Phase would be trapped in the Blood River Domain and eventually die of exhaustion; after all, human strength had its limits.
Moreover, in the Blood River Domain, there is no Heavenly Energy for them to recover. Using a little True Strength will consume a little.
As for the high-level cultivators’ soul-wills that were beyond the Sixth Layer Heaven, they could not be bound due to the incompleteness of the Blood River, and they had long since escaped and disappeared into the depths of the Void.
Just as Akunus was recalling the Blood River.
More than 4,000 kilometers away from Gunaer Country, in the Deep Mountain forest, a nimble woman was running fast, crossing mountains and ridges.
Soon the woman crossed the forest and traversed more than a dozen mountain peaks to reach a valley.
The valley was filled with green vegetation, and the waterfall splashed water into the sky.
On the edge of a 100-meter waterfall, a thin young man with a beard covered face was sitting cross-legged.
Seeing the young man, the woman smiled and spoke from dozens of meters away, “Clyd…”
Before she could finish speaking, the young man sitting cross-legged suddenly opened his eyes, his gaze as sharp as nails, causing pain to anyone who met his gaze. He clenched his right hand into a fist and threw a punch.
Boom!
In an instant, an overbearing and destructive will filled Heaven and Earth. The woman hadn’t even finished speaking when she exploded under the terrifying punch pressure.
Glancing at the woman’s corpse blown to pieces, the bearded young man slowly closed his eyes and continued to immerse himself in cultivation.
However, two hours later, another Fourth Layer Heaven young man appeared and shouted from afar, “Clyde, don’t do it first. 1 have a deal with you …”
Boom!
As soon as he stepped within 50 meters of the bearded young man, before he could finish his sentence, with a terrifying, overbearing punch containing a dreadful intent, the young man exploded again.
Glancing at the two pools of flesh and blood in the distance, the bearded young man’s eyes showed coldness, his voice hoarse, “My mother said, if you meet someone with evil intentions in the mountains, kill them with one punch.”
After saying that, the bearded young man slowly closed his eyes and continued to immerse himself in cultivation.
But more than two hours later, another woman appeared at the Valley Entrance, standing even farther away this time, shouting loudly, “Clyde, I can save your mother.”
The bearded young man suddenly opened his eyes, his figure disappearing in an instant with a terrifying speed, followed by a sonic boom echoing through the valley.
With the sonic boom, the bearded young man grabbed the woman’s neck with one hand, his voice low and full of killing intent, “What did you just say?”
The woman with her neck grasped had a flushed face, but her eyes were very calm, and she spoke with difficulty, “I just said, I can save your mother.”
“But before saving your mother, you need to challenge someone first and defeat him..”

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 241 Swallowing the Power of Heaven and Earth (Request for Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 241 Swallowing the Power of Heaven and Earth (Request for Monthly Pass)
Rolling dark clouds envelop the city, like a massive black curtain engulfing Mason.
Between heaven and earth, raging winds howl while thunder booms within the clouds, the sound magnificent and powerful.
Five days had passed since Mathilda Ward woke up, and the weather forecast had warned that there would be thunderstorms and typhoons today.
At the edge of the rooftop on the 24th floor of the hotel, Damon Lopes stood with his hands behind his back, clad in a Daoist robe. His long hair danced wildly in the raging wind, giving him an air of casual transcendence.
Just then, a dazzling light shone from within the clouds, and thousands of meters long purple thunder light descended like a thunder dragon exuding a destructive aura.
Boom!
Only then did the thunderous explosion that shook heaven and earth reverberate.
The lightning that struck Damon Lopes exploded thereafter, crackling into countless serpentine arcs across the ground, and a burnt stench filled the air within a tens of meters range where the ‘air’ had been pierced through.
Under the striking force of this natural thunder, Damon’s aura surged powerfully, his entire being emitting a dazzling light, as if he were a giant light bulb.
“Comfortable, ah! It’s been so long since I’ve encountered weather powerful enough to ‘feed’ me,” he said.
As he spoke, Damon Lopes stretched out his hand towards the sky, and instantly the dark clouds trembled. Another even more ferocious bolt of lightning descended and struck him, followed by a third…
Boom Boom Boom!!
Terrifying bolts of lightning continued to fall, and the dazzling light they emitted lit up the surrounding area of the hotel.
The deafening roars drew the attention of the hotel staff and members of the concert group, who all ran to the windows to look out.
In addition, hidden’ journalists around the hotel also picked up their video cameras and began snapping pictures of the rooftop continuously.
Noticing this, Damon Lopes’ gaze shifted slightly. Suddenly, the thunder light around him intensified, and he began to float up slowly, appearing tens of meters above the rooftop.
Boom! At that moment, another bolt of lightning descended from the sky, fiercely striking Damon, followed by yet another…
Under the rampant thunder, Damon Lopes, in this moment, resembled a Taoist immortal undergoing tribulation from the oriental legends, exciting the reporters to no end.
“Is this the power of an Innate Awakened One? It’s incredible!”
“Yes, I had only heard that Innate Awakened Ones were terrifying and powerful from the internet, but I never expected it to be this exaggerated.”
“To command thunder, and directly manipulate the thunder of nature, no less.” “It’s said that Innate Awakened Ones are reserves for the king, with their exaggerated combat power and fast cultivation speed, they can smoothly cultivate up to the Nine Heavens.”
“Once these awakened ones reach the Nine Heavens, if they put in a little effort, they might ascend to the throne someday, which is truly enviable.” “Doesn’t that mean his talent is even higher than Darren Callum’s?”
“You could say that. Although Darren Callum slew an Evil God Clone earlier and displayed great strength, in essence, he only killed a sixth heaven demonic disciple.”
“Compared to Darren Callum, Damon Lopes has a greater advantage. As an Innate Awakened One, he can directly enter the Seventh Layer once he reaches the peak of the Six Heavens.”
“Darren, on the other hand, needs to cultivate top-level skills in order to make a breakthrough.”
“Most of the Cultivation Methods in the Federation are deductions made by high-level cultivators after they’ve broken through to the Eight or Nine Layers, combining their own experiences.”
“These methods are most suitable for the pioneers who created them, and for others who follow, it becomes harder and harder to cultivate, let alone break through to king-level. It doesn’t fit them.”
“If Darren wants to break through after the Seventh Layer, his strength and cultivation speed would have to be comparable to that of an Innate Awakened One like Damon Lopes, which would require him to create his own Secret Manual.”
“But for Darren to create a Secret Manual at the Sixth Layer stage, even with his monstrous talent, would take at least a year or two at the fastest.”
“In a year or two, Damon Lopes, as an Innate Awakened One, might already be at the Nine Heavens.”
Some nodded thoughtfully: “In that case, Darren really can’t compare to Damon.”
As the two insightful journalists’ discussed these secrets, some media journalists nearby had their eyes flicker and quickly took out their mobile phones to take note of this information.
Secret Manuals, high-ranking powerhouses, Innate Awakened Ones – these detailed pieces of information were usually beyond the reach of ordinary journalists.
They never expected to be so lucky today.
When they get back, if they spice up this content a bit, tomorrow’s hot topic might be theirs.
Lately, an Invisible Power on the internet was erasing the feats of Jack Clark slaying the Evil God Clone, elevating Damon Lopes’ status as an Innate Awakened One.
Moreover, there were comments downplaying the strength of that Evil God Clone.
