In this context, just a week had passed, and the phrase ‘Darren Callum’ started to cool down online. Perhaps in another half a month, it would be largely forgotten by most people.
This time, Damon Lopes’ tribulation… no, his cultivation lasted for almost half an hour.
It only stopped after the electric charge in the clouds had been mostly depleted.
Surrounded by lightning, Damon Lopes gazed calmly at the journalists below and then slowly drifted back to the rooftop, appearing more ethereal and detached than ever.
After landing on the rooftop, he looked at Jack Clark not far away, who had been observing his cultivation, and Damon slowly said, “Brother Callum, I’ve realized something.”
“Realized what?” Jack was somewhat puzzled.
Damon nodded and said, “I’ve finally understood the essence of your invisible swagger. There’s no need to actively pander just naturally do your own ‘thing’ and that’s enough.”
…Jack was suddenly speechless.
He had thought Damon Lopes had gained some insight into the realm of cultivation, but it turned out to be this.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 241 Swallowing the Power of Heaven and Earth (Request for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 241 Swallowing the Power of Heaven and Earth (Request for Monthly Ticket)_2
The problem was, he had never thought about showing off.
Then Jack Clark expressed his envy, saying, “Mr. Lopes, do all Innate Awakened Ones cultivate by absorbing the Power of Heaven and Earth like this? That s just insane.”
No wonder those guys cultivated so quickly, actually directly absorbing the power of the lightning within Heaven and Earth.
Upon hearing Jack call him insane, Damon Lopes disagreed, “Brother Callum, does your conscience not hurt when you say that? Who can out-do you in being insane?”
After all, he was an Innate Awakened One. Wasn’t it quite normal for him to cultivate faster and in an exaggerated way?
On the contrary, you started off with a below-average talent and surpassed the school genius in just six months, dominated one side, and even Reverse Defeated and killed a King’s Avatar.
You’re the true freak, alright.
After the teasing, Damon Lopes explained, “Not all Innate Awakened Ones can cultivate by absorbing Heavenly Energy, you need to reverse the controlled power back to its Innate state to do that.”
“Reverse to Innate,” Jack’s eyes revealed a questioning look.
Damon Lopes explained, “Although we have awakened a certain ability, it was initially just an enhanced special function from the past.”
“And there are also levels among the awakened ones, such as those controlling natural elements like thunder, fire, ice, or even gravity and space.”
“These are considered the first echelon, followed by physical awakenings like Innate Divine Strength, body hardening, telekinesis, speed, double eye mutations; these are all considered awakenings too.”
“But due to the ‘strength’ factor, only the first echelon is called Innate Awakened Ones, the rest are merely Talent Holders.”
“And this so-called Innate Power is about understanding the power you control
to the extreme and touching the Law’s Aura.”
“For instance, I have touched a wisp of the Lightning Law Aura, which is why I can directly absorb the natural power of thunder and lightning for cultivation and battle,” he said.
“This is also why after we break through to the Ninth Heavens, as long as we don’t fall, we can swiftly touch the King’s Threshold because we have already touched the Law.”
“I see,” Jack had not expected that there were ranks among the awakened ones. Just then, Damon Lopes asked curiously, “Brother Callum, to what extent have you progressed with the Secret Book?”
Jack thought for a moment, “Soon, I expect to complete the Seventh Layer within ten days.”
With a week of full focused deducing, the progress in the foundational compendium of the Secret Book was fast, having already completed the integration of the four-armed Talent Rune chains.
Next, as long as the remaining two arms were resolved, he could begin cultivation.
As for the external contraption at the back of his head and the like, he would leave that for after breaking through to the Seventh Layer; before reaching the Ninth Heavens, the contraption space would have no impact on his combat power.
Although he could not derive the wind and earth Gifted Powers from the corpses of the Silver Giant Dragon and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, this problem was actually easy to solve.
That was to exchange for top-tier resources containing the ‘strength’ of wind and earth properties.
However, these resources that contained a trace of Law Power were very precious and rare, requiring thousands of merit points to exchange — nearly equivalent to killing an Eighth Level Beast.
When Jack and the other returned downstairs, they heard a somewhat unexpected piece of news.
“Challenging me?”
In the living room, a frail Ilisa sat on the sofa, slowly sipping a cup of fruit milk tea with both hands.
Next to Ilisa, Marla Fiore held a tablet and said, “Yes, challenging you. This news has already spread throughout Banan Country.”
“Upon hearing this news, I went to check the details of this so-called Clyde, and the guy is a monster.”
“Oh? How so?” Jack settled down on the sofa opposite.
Marla began to explain, “This person was born in a martial arts hall, the illegitimate son of a small city martial hall owner in Banan Country. When he was five, the Triplex heaven owner died under someone else’s hand during a friendly spar.”
“As an illegitimate child, after the owner’s death, Clyde and his mother were kicked out of the martial arts hall and struggled to survive.”
“After turning sixteen, Clyde entered the local school to start cultivation for free, but his cultivation talent was mediocre, and it took him three years just to barely breakthrough the Second Layer Heaven.”
“It was that year his mother fell gravely ill, and Clyde, like a madman, carried his mother’s corpse into the dangerous mountain ranges filled with Mutated Creatures.”
“When he re-emerged two months later, he had already broken through to the Fourth Layer and fused with high-level alien beast genes, cultivated I rue Martial Divine Rhyme, and comprehended Fist Intent.”
“With the strength of the Fourth Layer Heaven, he swept through all cultivators in the city, experts of the martial halls, and the Fifth Layer Heaven teachers of the school.”
“After defeating everyone, he disappeared once more, and three months later, he returned with the power of the Fifth Layer Heaven, overthrowing the province’s three major martial halls; no one could withstand even a single move from him.”
“That included the four mid-period experts of the Sixth Layer Heaven who were stationed in the martial halls.”
“Later, this person went back into Deep Mountain, and when he emerged three months later, he had broken through to the Sixth Layer, defeating two peak Sixth Layer Heaven martial hall strongmen with a single move.” “And just an hour ago, after more than four months, he appeared again with the cultivation at the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, challenging the strongest man in Banan’s First Martial Hall.”
“That was Banan Country’s only civilian expert in the early stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, but he was still defeated by a single punch from Clyde, shocking the entire Banan.
“With this battle, this man rose to the rank of number one among the younger generation in Banan Country, earning the unofficial title ‘Destruction Fist Demon’.”
“Following this, he plans to cross two countries, challenging the experts along the way, coming to Mason to challenge Mr. Callum. The world speculates that he wishes to have a peak Sixth Layer Heaven duel against you, using you as a stepping-stone to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven..”

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 241 Swallowing the Power of Heaven and Earth (Request for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 241 Swallowing the Power of Heaven and Earth (Request for Monthly Ticket)_3
After Jessica finished speaking, Damon Lopes expressed his interest, “Apeak Sixth-layer Heaven at twenty years old, defeating an early Seventh Layer Heaven strong man with a single move, this person is indeed very strong.
“However, such a monster should be recruited by the officials.”
Jessica nodded, “The officials of Banan Country did try to recruit him, but he refused, saying he wanted to stay in the mountains to accompany his mother.” “Brother Callum, what do you think?” Damon Lopes looked at Jack Clark.
“Of course, we just sit back and watch.”
… Damon Lopes was speechless for a moment, thinking we could even watch while lying down.
Pfft!
llisa, holding a fruit milk tea, laughed out loud and said softly, “Sister Jessica, don’t worry too much. Unless that person makes a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, he poses no threat to Brother Callum.”
“Indeed.” Damon Lopes also agreed with a nod.
After working together for so long, the strength Jack Clark displayed made him feel it was unfathomable and mysterious.
At that moment, Jack Clark suddenly asked, “Jessica, are there any combat video materials of that person?”
Although Jack didn’t feel this person could threaten him, especially since his physical body had grown stronger just a few days ago, his cautious nature still prepared him to learn more about the opponent.
“Yes.” Jessica nodded.
“When he challenged that early Seventh Layer Heaven strong man, the largest television station in Banan broadcast it live, so there’s a video of that battle on the internet.”
As she spoke, Jessica flipped through her phone and then connected it to the
LCD projection on the wall.
However, when Jack Clark and Damon Lopes saw the man with a full beard, a robust figure, and a weathered face on the big screen, both were taken aback.
“Miss Fiore, are you sure he’s twenty, not forty?”
“This person looks a bit old.”
“Alright.” Jack nodded with a curious expression.
In the video, Clyde stood tall on the hundred-foot Martial Arts Arena, opposite him was a ‘monster’ towering ten meters tall, covered in red Dragon Scales, with a Dragon Tail.
The ‘monster’ was also wearing a set of thick battle armor that covered most of its body, surrounded by solidified red radiance, emitting an overbearing aura that seemed to burst the Void.
This was the Seventh Layer Heaven Alien Beast Battlefield form of Genetic Martial Arts.
Unlike True Martial Practitioners who condensed a true martial arts phantom and controlled the Power of Heaven and Earth, Genetic Martial Arts practitioners at the Seventh Layer fully transformed into an Avatar Body that was a blend of human and Unique Beast.
In this form, they wielded the strength and some of the talents of a Unique Beast, as well as the ability to use Transcendent Weapons and extraordinary battle armor, along with Combat Techniques that brought out the full power of the Unique Beast.
This was somewhat similar to the approach Jack would take when constructing his own combat form after reaching the Eight Layer Heaven.
But in comparison to them, who only had the Unique Beast’s strength and talents, Jack could also control the Power of Heaven and Earth, assembling the power multiplied dozens or hundreds of times over.
Facing the martial arts hall strong man who had demonstrated the Alien Beast form, Clyde’s body underwent a transformation too- his entire right arm covered with a layer of black Armor resembling that of a beetle.
Then…
Boom! Accompanied by Clyde’s punch, the sky shattered, and the Martial Arts Arena collapsed.
Under the Terrifying Power, the air froze and broke apart within a range of dozens of meters, including the early Seventh Layer Heaven martial arts hall strong man who was sent flying backward, his chest caved in as he spat blood, unable to react in time.
Damon Lopes suddenly sat up straight, looking at Clyde in the video with a black monster phantom looming behind him, and said solemnly, “He has mastered Rare Grand Fist Intent; such an overbearing strength.”
Fist Intent, like Sword Intent, is a special Power of Intent that can greatly enhance a cultivator’s combat power. It’s monstrous for someone below the Seventh Layer Heaven to grasp the Power of Intent.
Such occurrences are rare, let alone mastering Fist Intent to a grand accomplishment.
This stage is just one step away from materializing Intent, and once that happens, he will wield power comparable to a true martial arts phantom.
Just as ‘llisa Zabel’ once arrived at the Cloud Mist Mountain Range, her Intent shining like the sun and moon, effortlessly annihilating a sixth level Peak Unique Beast.
Furthermore, the Fist Intent that Clyde had mastered was filled with a sense of destruction, which highly complemented his Cultivation Methods. When combined, it enabled the Instantaneous Explosion of Terrifying Power.
Damon Lopes couldn’t help but exclaim, “No wonder this man dares to challenge Brother Callum; he does have some confidence, but I still favor Brother Callum more.”
After speaking, Damon Lopes looked at Jack Clark with a chuckle, knowing this guy was even more abnormal.
“This person is indeed very strong,” Jack Clark nodded slightly.
“Based on his trajectory, he is expected to arrive at Mason in about half a month. Mr. Callum, will you accept the challenge then?” Jessica was a little curious.
“We’ll see how it goes,” Jack responded noncommittally.
Having swept through the Southern Exotic Beast Battlefield and slain a king s Avatar, he no longer needed to prove anything.
Although he was somewhat interested in this man’s Genetic Martial Arts, he also had the duty to protect llisa, which was clearly more important.
If he was preoccupied at the time, naturally, he would ignore the challenge.
As he spoke, Jack looked at llisa and asked, “Miss Ward, how have you been feeling these past few days?”
Pale-faced llisa replied softly, “I’ve improved a lot. I feel like I’ll recover in another half a month, and then I’ll hold the final concert.”
“Half a month,” Jack paused for a moment and exchanged a glance with llisa.
In half a month, Clyde would probably come to challenge him, and in just over half a month, llisa was likely to recover and hold her final concert.
llisa whispered, “It’s probably just a coincidence.”
“Let’s hope so,” Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
A coincidence?
The ‘dragon’ within llisa originated from Akunus, and being of the same origin, that man might sense it somehow, like… sensing her condition.
What if on the night Ilisa’s concert begins, Clyde, carrying the momentum of public opinion, also issues a challenge to him?

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 242: Ten Thousand Attributes
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 242: Ten Thousand Attributes
Although Jack Clark felt that Clyde might be a problem, he wasn’t very concerned.
No matter how monstrous you are, as long as your strength hasn’t crossed the threshold of Eight Layer Heaven, I’ll blow you away with one halberd strike, even if your combat power is freakishly high and reaches the Late Seventh Layer Heaven.
The rare Rare Grand Fist Intent, endowed with a Destruction Intent, is highly compatible with the Genetic True Martial he cultivated; its destructive power is significantly enhanced in both directions.
But in front of Jack at the moment, even a strong monster would just mean a few more halberd strikes.
However, due to Clyde’s challenge, the online popularity of ‘Darren Callum’ that had been suppressed by the officials was stirred up once again.
A monster who had slain an Evil God Clone, another who had swept through the Martial Arts world of a nation, and both were under twenty years old.
This peak confrontation between the younger generation immediately attracted countless people’s attention, and many forums across different countries were discussing who was stronger.
Suddenly, because of the ‘Tribulation’, Damon Lopes, who had become famous for standing high in the sky surrounded by thunder, saw his popularity in Gunaer Country suppressed once again.
This left Damon somewhat speechless.
He had just grasped the essence of invisible swagger, only to be overshadowed by Jack Clark again.
Could it be that his fortune was truly at odds with Jack’s?
Afternoon!
The sunlight shone brightly on the sea surface, but a thousand meters below in the pitch-black and silent deep sea, a black-red Colossal Beast that stood more than 50 meters tall and was 98 meters long was on the move.
Faint golden flames jumped on its body, illuminating the surroundings, and each of its heavy footsteps shook the seabed, shattering the ground and leaving huge claw marks.
This was still the case despite the buoyancy of the sea.
As its size approached a hundred meters, its body’s density grew even more terrifying, and the self-weight of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast became incredibly exaggerated, about ten to twenty times that of other Eighth Level Beasts of similar volume.
Due to its strong density, an invisible, heavy Aura constantly emanated from its body, solidifying the surrounding sea water and stirring up Tsunamis with each of its movements.
At this time, in the right claw of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, it was holding a corpse of a Giant Beast that was more than 50 meters long, at Late Level 7, and resembled a plesiosaur.
The head of this Giant Beast had already been blown up by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast. Holding it in its claw, it occasionally tore off a large chunk of flesh and blood, snacking on it as if it were a treat.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Beast walked, all Marine Life within a kilometer range frantically fled, even shellfish the size of a palm scurried in panic, opening and closing.
Although these lower-level Marine Creatures lacked intelligence, their instinctual fear still prompted them to flee.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast moved quickly on the seabed, easily traversing twenty kilometers in just a while.
Off in the distance, a Silver Giant Dragon that had retracted its Dragon Might and grew double wings was shuttling through a school of tens of thousands of three- to four-meter long blue ‘small fish.’
Each time the Silver Giant Dragon rushed in, the blue cod surrounding it would disperse, creating a massive Hollow, making it look like countless blue stars revolving around a moon.
Roar roar roar!!
The Silver Giant Dragon was having a great time, shuttling back and forth within the spherical school of fish like a child, expressing its excitement with low roars.
Each flap of its two hundred-meter wide Dragon Wings would create massive Tornados, sweeping up countless cod and sending them flying far away.
“Roar! Sethia, what are you doing?” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast curiously looked at it.
Upon hearing the thunderous roar of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast from afar, the Silver Giant Dragon stiffened, and then its frightening Dragon Might burst forth.
Roar!
Accompanying the roar of the Giant Dragon, infused with Dragon Might, the surrounding tens of thousands of cod scattered.
Only then did the Silver Giant Dragon retract its Dragon Wings and spoke in its fierce dragon face naturally, “Nothing, Great Sethia was just hunting, trying to taste how these small fish are.”
“Roar! I see, I’ve cleared the area on my side, we can call Joe and the others to head back,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared lowly, not exposing it.
Centering around the Water and Fire Dragon Palace, all Mutated Creatures within a radius of over a thousand kilometers had been suppressed and cleared by the quintet of Giant Beasts, with their Dragon Might spreading through this sea area.
Under normal conditions, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast could cross a distance of a thousand kilometers in two or three hours.
But diameter and scope are not the same, not to mention the three-dimensional ocean. Even if the five Giant Beasts spread out and swept across in a hundred-kilometer straight line, it still took days.
Of course, most of the time was spent hunting those Mutated Creatures at the ‘peak’ of their realm and collecting Life Crystals.
Within this scope, all Giant Beasts above Level 7 had either been killed or driven away.
Or rather, Level 7 creatures that encountered Giant Beasts like the Tiger Whale were considered lucky. Those that came across the Thunderflame Emperor Beast were mostly blasted and devoured.
And these locations where the Giant Beasts resided either had abundant Heavenly Energy or were Heaven and Earth Treasures’ resource spots.
However, most of these resources had been consumed by those Mutated Creatures, with only a few Resource Points regenerative, serving as future cash crops for the Dragon Palace.
Soon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon each joined together.
Days passed, and not only had the Thunderflame Emperor Beast grown, but the other four Great Beasts had also significantly enhanced their Auras and grown larger after eating a vast amount of resources.
I he Silver Giant Dragon, in particular, had grown from eighty to eighty-seven meters, second only to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast in terms of growth.
The reason, of course, was its King-level bloodline.
That’s the advantage of having a high bloodline potential; aside from having more and powerful talents, it also has stronger absorption and conversion of resources than other creatures of the same level..

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 242: Ten Thousand Attributes _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 242: Ten Thousand Attributes _2
It’s similar to the difference between a genius and a mediocre person among humans.
Of course, mainly because the Thunderflame Emperor Beast ate most of the Unique Beast’s flesh and blood, and they collected Life Crystals for it, so the resources were given to them.
After all, beasts can’t eat alone, otherwise the team would fall apart.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle dragged a Level 7 Giant Beast corpse with a body length of over 40 meters, and proudly approached the Thunderflame Emperor Beast: Roar! Thunderflame, I’m invincible now!
“Roar! Not bad, now you look more and more like a Giant Beast. The Thunderflame Emperor Beast nodded approvingly, stretching out its left claw to grab the corpse of the Giant Beast.
With the growth in strength, and following their battles together, the originally timid Deep Sea Dragon Turtle became more and more fierce, gaining rich combat experience.
Roar! There’s more, crystals. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle then used its control over water to make two Level 5 Life Crystals flow out from the gaps in its shell.
Looking at the two pale golden crystals, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s eyes brightened, and it set down the Giant Beast corpse to cautiously grab the crystals. Then, it reached under its neck with its right claw.
Suddenly, a flat grey pouch the size of a water tank was pulled out. Opening the rough opening, it carefully placed the crystals inside.
This grey pouch was pure sharkskin, from a Level 7 Mutated Giant Teeth Shark.
Due to its natural ability, this mutated beast’s skin was highly resistant to flames. After a little polishing, it was used as a temporary bag by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
There was no other choice, as even the pouch wedged between its scale armor couldn’t withstand the flames from the multiple burst attacks of the Golden Flame.
After putting the sharkskin pouch back, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast grabbed the corpse of the Giant Beast once more and growled contentedly: “Roar! Thanks for your hard work, Domination.”
Roar! It’s not hard work. As long as I can help Thunderflame, it’s fine.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was very happy to be praised by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, and scampered along behind it.
Chirp! Chirp! Chirp!
The Single-horned Tiger Whale, with a body length of 76 meters and covered in heavy armor, looked disdainful and somewhat displeased with the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s bootlicking manner.
However, after showing disdain, the Single-horned Tiger Whale flapped its fins and followed behind, staying on the left and right of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast alongside the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Upon seeing this, the colossal body of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon wriggled and swam above their two heads, its 150-meter long body full of oppressive presence.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon, with its wings spread, gliding across the seabed, turned its head and growled: “Hegemon, what shall we do next?
“Roar! Next, naturally, is cultivation.”
As it spoke, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast bit into the corpse of the Giant Beast, breaking its scale armor and tearing off a large piece of flesh and blood. The scorching hot blood immediately gushed out like a fountain, staining the surrounding sea water red.
Cultivate?
Confusion appeared in the eyes of the other Giant Beasts.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast was somewhat speechless, growling: “The runes I taught you earlier, don’t underestimate the power of those basic runes.” Roar! Runes are so difficult. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle made a bitter face.
After learning the Spout Rune from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle tried to condense it in its throat, but after practicing for a day, it still hadn’t been successful.
As for what happened next, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast accelerated its Evolution. After successfully evolving, it used its Emperor Beast talent to help them break through to Level 8, causing them to fall into a deep sleep for several days.
Then, they woke up, battled Level 9 Giant Beasts, and began sweeping the surrounding sea areas.
Compared to cultivating runes, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle preferred fighting or just lying down and sleeping.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled: “You have to practice even if it’s difficult. To become stronger than other Giant Beasts of the same level, you have to find a shortcut.”
“And rune power is your shortcut. Although a single basic rune is not powerful, if you condense dozens, hundreds, or even thousands of them, their combined power will be terrifying.”
“When you have enough basic runes condensed and engraved later on, they can even form new talents.”
“So go back and cultivate. Don’t leave the Dragon Palace unless you’ve condensed at least 20 basic runes.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast assigned them a task.
Chirp! Chirp! Chirp! Work hard to cultivate, charge and charge! The Single-horned Tiger Whale flapped its fins, its voice full of energy.
Now it was the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s turn to look down on it.
Because at the time, this guy was also complaining about how hard it was to cultivate the Slash Rune, and how much it wanted to play with the Little liger Whales.
No, it should be helping its wife Haward Jones share the burden of watching over their child.
Just as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was disdainful of the Single-horned Tiger Whale’s flattery, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon above their heads let out a confused roar: “Roar! Cultivate, I, like.”
immediately, both creatures looked up at the same time and contemptuously gazed at this Nine-headed creature, which lacked the dignity of a Giant Beast. The Silver Giant Dragon gliding through the sea with its wings spread growled: “Hegemon is right, we should all try to cultivate. I agree with the retreat.” There was nothing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Tiger Whale could do, as both the Dragon King and the Second King had spoken. As their subordinates, what could they do?
The five colossal beasts moved forward, and all creatures avoided them. A few hours later, they returned to the Dragon Palace.
From a distance, the imposing figures of the five Giant Beasts were seen approaching, and at the ‘gate’ entrance, the Blue Giant Crab quickly stood up, waving its huge pincers.
Glug! Glug! Greetings to the Great King, Second King, Third King, Fourth King, and Fifth King.
Glug! Glug! Your figures are so majestic and strong, I feel weak in my legs just looking at you from afar…
“Roar! Shut up, every day your legs become weak, what the hell are you talking about? People who don’t know might think you’re female..”

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 242: Ten Thousand Attributes_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 242: Ten Thousand Attributes_3
“Nope, even if it’s a motherly’ thing, you can’t go soft, the species are different, what are you putting your head down for?” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared and complained in a string, interrupting the Blue Giant Crab.
Otherwise, if this guy continued, he could blabber on endlessly, repeating that same piece of flattery hundreds of times.
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon growled lowly, looking at the Blue Giant Crab curiously, “Crab General, why do you only have six legs? All those of your kind I encountered on my outing had eight legs.”
The Blue Giant Crab spat out a stream of bubbles respectfully, saying, “Glub glub!! When I was young, and didn’t know better, 1 lost them in a fight.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast was also somewhat puzzled, “Don’t the legs of you crabs grow back after they’re broken?”
The Blue Giant Crab spat out bubbles blankly.
Glub glub!! I don’t know either, after winning the fight, 1 ate it and then took a nap. When I woke up, I had gotten bigger and my legs stopped growing.
Okay, an evolutionary problem.
The Giant Beast with five heads passed through the Spatial Barrier, entering the World of Water and Fire.
With a burst of water droplets erupting into the sky, each of the massive beasts stepped onto the Ice Crystal Palace.
“Roar roar roar!! Work hard, cultivate, charge charge charge,” the Nine-headed Flood Dragon let out a chaotic bellow as it swam into its Nine-Headed Dragon King Palace with high spirits.
Then came the Silver Giant Dragon followed by the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Last, under the gaze of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish showed a ‘honest’ smile in its eyes and obediently swam into the Black and White Dragon Palace.
After driving these guys back to cultivation, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast also headed for its Sea of Fire Dragon Palace.
It was behind the volcano mouth at the edge of the Lava Lake.
Actually, compared to in the sea water, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast felt more comfortable in fiery environments like magma, but it wasn’t yet time to roar at Heaven and Earth.
At the fiery volcano mouth, most of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body was soaked in the magma.
Its huge claw gingerly pinched the sharkskin pouch nestled between the scales on its neck and pulled it out, then with a sound of rustling, dumped dozens of crystals onto the ground.
Looking at the small pile made of Level 4, 6, and 7 Life Crystals, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s face revealed a ferocious smile.
It had calculated on the way back that these crystals could almost be converted into more than ten thousand attribute points, enough to enhance an advanced talent to top-tier.
However, it wasn’t dark yet, and it wasn’t convenient at Jack Clark’s side, so it needed to wait a bit longer.
Night came! Past eight o’clock.
In the living room of the suite, Jack Clark glanced at the time and stood up, “Miss Ward, it’s about time 1 headed back to my room. You should rest early.”
On the sofa, Mathilda Ward, who was watching a sci-fi idol war movie, nodded her head and smiled, “Brother Callum, you should rest early too.”
Back in his room, Jack Clark closed the door and windows, then came to the center of the room, took his coat off, and stretched out his right arm, activating the True Dragon Power within him.
Hum! Accompanied by a flicker of golden-red brilliance, strong Spatial Fluctuations spread out.
While Jack Clark activated his Space Power, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast also locked onto the coordinates on its side, with a Silver Vortex slowly emerging in the roaring crown of fire.
Just as Jack Clark opened the Spatial Channel, llisa, in the next suite’s living room, turned her head with a flicker in her gaze, her eyes showing surprise as she looked over.
“What a strong Spatial Fluctuation and it’s the second time, what Cultivation Methods is Brother Callum practicing?”
Because of that dragon, Ilisa’s perception was actually very sharp, especially towards high-end powers such as space.
However, since she had seen Jack engrave space runes on his arm before, she didn’t think much of it, assuming Jack was just practicing that special Secret Skill again.
Pop pop pop!! A series of Life Crystals passed through the Spatial Channel and Jack Clark caught them deftly.
When the last crystal came through the channel, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast hurriedly closed the channel, then lay at the volcano mouth, breathing heavily for a moment.
Phew! Jack Clark exhaled a breath, took a short rest, and then excitedly picked up a Level 6 life crystal.
“Attribute points conversion.”
“You converted a High-Purity Life Crystal, gaining 315 attribute points.”
“You converted a High-Purity Life Crystal, gaining 1023 attribute points…”
As each crystal turned to powder and vanished, the points on the transparent page in front of Jack Clark skyrocketed madly—five thousand, seven thousand, soon breaking the ten-thousand mark.
It finally stopped at 11320. Instantly, Jack Clark’s face broke into a smile, not bad for the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and the Dragon Palace Beasts’ hard work over so many days.
That’s the advantage of having power.
Although the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle, two giant beasts, couldn’t help much in high-end battles, they were very useful for these time-consuming trivial tasks.
Otherwise, if the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had to do it ‘alone,’ it would take at least a month to collect so many crystals.
After all, the ocean is too vast, and looking for a suitable target takes a lot of time, not to mention scouring the entire sea.
With enough attribute points, what comes next is enhancement.
Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s three talents of Thunder, Golden Flame, and Swift, and he pondered for a moment, wondering which one to strengthen first?

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 243: Road to Becoming a God (Request for Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 243: Road to Becoming a God (Request for Monthly Pass)
After a moment’s hesitation, Jack Clark’s eyes fell on the swift talent.
Currently, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s strongest aspect is its physical body, which has a body density that far exceeds that of an Eighth Level Beast by twenty or thirty times, combined with top-tier defense and Strength Talent, it is invincible in close combat.
If the Agility Talent were to be enhanced to the top-tier as well, even when facing stronger beasts in close combat, it would still have absolute domination.
With this thought, Jack Clark’s voice resonated in his mind.
“Consume ten thousand attribute points to enhance the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body talent – swift.”
As Jack’s thought was decided, instantly, a magnificent strengthening energy emerged along the Soul Connection inside the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body and exploded tumultuously.
Deep within its flesh and blood, strands of special power converged, akin to intricate trails of rune markings, forming an invisible net that spread throughout its entire body, inside and out.
This was the manifestation of the Agility Talent, and at this moment, these runes were constantly evolving, becoming more and more complex, emanating an aura of profound mystery.
The evolution happened so rapidly that even Jack, with all his concentration, couldn’t see clearly what was happening.
Roar roar roar!!
At the mouth of a volcano spewing magma, the black-red Colossal Beast standing erect let out a deep roar, its terrifying aura surged to the heavens, shaking Heaven and Earth.
The entire small world quaked under the influence of the aura that was now even closer to that of a Monarch; the sea water in the distance turned into a raging Tsunami Hitting Palace.
Such a formidable presence instantaneously disturbed the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, all of whom had been cultivating in the palace for half a day.
Roar roar roar!! Thunderflame has become even stronger.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish showed envy in its eyes, wishing it could grow in size and strength as quickly as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, and if it could grow while lying down and sleeping, that would be even better.
Witnessing the awe-inspiring aura of the fierce behemoth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out an excited roar: Roar roar!! Domination wants to grow stronger, cultivate, keep cultivating.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle believed that the reason for the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s immense power and continuous progress was related to the rune power it cultivated, which is why it felt so motivated all of a sudden.
Setting a small goal for itself, today it must condense its first Energy Conversion Rune.
Indeed, this fellow hadn’t even condensed a single Basic Rune yet.
In contrast to these two who were already used to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s freakishness, the Silver Giant Dragon was more shocked, with its Dragon Eyes widened in disbelief.
It felt that the bloodline pressure of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had grown even stronger, nearly indistinguishable from that of the purple Dragon Egg, almost comparable to a Monarch.
But how could this be! Its bloodline had just been enhanced not long ago!
Compared to the size growth of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon was even more astonished and shocked by the speed of its bloodline evolution.
Because strength and realm could grow over time and always improve, but bloodline was different, representing not only the upper limit but also the combat power.
This guy must have some secret method to enhance its bloodline; 1 need to figure out a way to trick it out of him.
Watching the imposing behemoth from afar, with the aura enveloping the world and shaking Heaven and Earth, the Silver Giant Dragon, born from Myth, had a gleam in its eyes, sensing that it might have found a loophole.
The Silver Giant Dragon and creatures like the Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle were different; it had broader experiences, just fewer of them and more simple-minded doesn’t mean it was stupid.
But how to trick it into revealing the secret of its bloodline evolution? Maybe 1 could share some of the delicious things I keep in my Reverse Scale?
No, that won’t work. This creature is even smarter than the Great Scythia, not so easily fooled.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was wondering how to ‘trick’ the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon peeked out its head, and then withdrew to shrink back to the palace and continue to sleep…
No, it went back to cultivating.
Having nine heads allows the Nine-headed Flood Dragon to multitask.
Usually, one head is on duty while the other eight sleep, including now, with one head earnestly condensing Solid Runes while the rest sleep soundly.
As for Abbott’s constant increase in power, isn’t he always freakishly strong? Normal.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King is so formidable, so strong, so mighty.
At the small world’s gate, the Crab General’s eyes rolled about excitedly, filled with an indescribable admiration for the ferocious Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
That’s its idol, a presence that dominates one side of the world, shaking Heaven and Earth. If it could be that powerful, female crabs would line up to seek it out.
When all the Giant Beasts were shocked by its aura, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast slowly opened its eyes, its golden vertical pupils burning with flames, glittering with Thunder, exuding a terrifying majesty.
Feeling the special power within its body, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast revealed a look of astonishment, “I didn’t expect this kind of change after being enhanced to the top-tier.”
By now, the Agility Talent had integrated into its entire flesh and blood, creating a lightweight force enveloping its whole body, forming an invisible repulsion field around the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Under this special field, it felt as light as a feather.
Boom!
The colossal Thunderflame Emperor Beast took a step forward, its heavy footing shaking the volcanic rock only slightly, no longer causing a ten-meter radius to crumble as before.
Of course, the enhancement to top-tier agility was not just about the Thunderflame Emperor Beast controlling its own weight; the overall coordination and agility of its huge body also experienced a drastic change.
In addition, its outward appearance had been fine-tuned, looking more coordinated yet fiercer, such as its spiky horns becoming even sharper.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast vanished on the spot, followed by a sonic boom, a white wave roaring through thousands of meters, turning into a raging wind sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
Boom boom boom!!
The nearly hundred-meter-long Thunderflame Emperor Beast, like teleportation, kept flashing around the entire Water and Fire World, appearing thousands of meters away with each flicker..

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 243: Road to Becoming a God (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 243: Road to Becoming a God (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
The earth shattered under rapid movement, the ice layer exploded, and the actualized air waves formed a white typhoon, causing the Ice Crystal Palaces to tremble incessantly.
And that was just the air wave caused by its swift movement.
After nine consecutive ‘teleportations,1 the Thunderflame Emperor Beast appeared again at the volcano mouth, its aura emitting a terrifying pressure that seemed to collapse the Void and burst the atmosphere.
Strengthened to top-tier, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast could perform nine flashes in one go, moving at speed almost beyond conscious reaction, making it so that other giant beasts of the same level would nearly explode with one swipe of its claw.
Such a remarkable enhancement filled the Thunderflame Emperor Beast with anticipation for what was to come next with Golden Flame, Thunder.
However, after testing out the strength of its top-tier swiftness, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast did not go out but instead charged into the volcano mouth with a boom, splashing magma sky-high.
It was planning to spend a few days perfecting the binding force field of its double claws, condensing dozens of Basic Runes, to see if it could achieve a fiftyfold compression of energy.
Then, combined with swift teleportation and strength, grasping something like a ‘sun,1 it might be possible to even obliterate a Level 9 Early Stage Giant Beast in one hit.
By then, it could casually kill a few Level 9 Giant Beasts and evolve to Level 9 itself, which would be much faster than seeking out and hunting those Level 7 or Level 8 Giant Beasts.
The next morning was sunny, and there was nothing to do.
“Brother Callum, Brother Callum…”
“…What’s up?” Jack Clark shifted his attention away from the Secret Book.
Watching Jack, who had sat down and started ‘cultivating,’ Damon Lopes couldn’t help but shake his head, “Brother Callum, I think you’re pushing yourself too hard. It might be better to relax a bit.”
“As the saying goes, water overflows when too full, and the moon wanes when too full. A bowstring that’s always taut will snap one day.”
“The same is true for the path of cultivation,” he added earnestly.
“In fact, with our current achievements, we are already at the forefront of our era’s Younger Generation,” said Damon Lopes sincerely.
“At this stage, what is needed is self-perfection, because only by doing so will we be able to step out more easily when we reach the Ninth Heaven Peak.”
“That’s a crucial step, and many Ninth Heaven Peak powers have been stuck there for years, unable to make a breakthrough.”
Damon’s sudden solemnity made Jack a bit uncomfortable.
After he finished speaking, Jack nodded, “Thanks for the reminder, Mr. Lopes. Don’t worry, I know what I am doing. But the step you mentioned, what is it specifically?”
“Ahem! That, well, I’m not sure either,” Damon Lopes coughed awkwardly.
“Anyway, that’s what the old man told me. He said not to spend all day sitting under thunderclouds cultivating, so now I’m passing the message to you.”
“But really, the main thing is, you’ve already become such a freak, and you still work so hard it puts a lot of pressure on me,” he said with a hint of melancholy.
Just as he said, Jack was already so strong yet still so dedicated to cultivation, which made Damon feel a bit guilty every time he slacked off.
Especially after chatting with a beauty, he always felt a bit of guilt as if he was probably too useless.
Then, Damon suddenly said, “Brother Callum, have you heard about the Gods Creation Plan?”
“Gods Creation Plan?” Jack’s gaze paused, showing a questioning look.
“You haven’t heard… that makes sense, your rise has been too quick, unlike us.”
Damon Lopes reflected for a moment, “With your talent and strength, you’re sure to be designated as a potential god, and you should be notified by the Southern Military District after this matter is settled.”
“In the next two to three months, there will be an incredible opportunity known as the Road to Becoming a God, where one can almost guarantee to break through to the king-level if they can step on it,” he said.
“Mr. Lopes, please explain in detail,” Jack immediately became serious.
“King-level is a chasm,” Damon Lopes said slowly.
“Whether it’s us, human cultivators, or Mutated Creatures, once reaching the Ninth Heavens, breaking through to King-level requires a special power,” he continued.
“It is named the Origin of the World.”
“Only the mythical world has this Origin Power.”
“Under normal conditions, when cultivators reach the Ninth Heaven Peak, they not only need to perfect their own rules but also have to go to the mythical world.”
“Only there can they absorb the Power of Heaven and Earth, and from it, Temper the World Origin, ultimately solidifying their rules, transcending both soul and flesh.”
“But this Road to Becoming a God offers a chance to obtain Origin Power in advance—the greater the potential, the more Origin rewards one receives,” explained Damon.
“Potential is measured by comprehension, soul, and combat power, among other aspects.”
“Besides, that path contains not just Origin Energy but also other fortunes like innate runes, Law Fragments, God-level Resources, and more.”
“The great empires have already begun finalizing the list of potential gods, and now we are just waiting for that place to descend again.”
Jack asked instinctively, “Mr. Lopes, what place is that?”
“It’s an ancient ruins relic,” he replied.
“Several decades ago, the sudden emergence of so many king-level beings within our Human Race was because of the wealth of inheritances and resources gained from entering that relic,” he added.
“That includes the few Supreme Experts of the Human Race, it’s rumored that their breakthroughs to Supreme were also connected to their experiences in the relic.”
“And now, several decades later, our Supreme Experts have predicted that these ruins are about to return, consequently beginning the selection process for entry half a year ago,” Damon concluded.
“There’s an age restriction for that place, and no one over twenty years old can enter, and it’s the soul that’s being restricted.”

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 243: Road to Becoming a God (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 243: Road to Becoming a God (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
“So that’s how it is, thank you Mr. Lopes for clearing up my confusion,” Jack Clark slowly nodded.
“You’re welcome, you’re welcome,” Damon Lopes said with a smile, pleased that today he had finally regained some footing, managing to shock this abnormal guy a little.
Ha ha…
While Damon Lopes was in good spirits, Jack Clark also experienced a rare ripple in his emotions.
It was an opportunity related to the Supreme; such a thing must be contested.
Not to mention the innate runes, Law Fragments, God-level Resources, and an Origin Energy similar to the aura from ancient times.
Especially the Power of World Origin, which was the special energy the Thunderflame Emperor Beast needed to break through to the Mythical-level, clearly of extreme value.
Although reaching the Ninth Heaven Peak and going to the mythical world allowed one to Temper and extract from between heaven and earth.
But with a bit of thought, Jack Clark understood that such a painstaking method of Tempering and extracting was definitely slow, frustratingly slow, otherwise there wouldn’t be so many experts stuck at the Ninth Heaven Peak.
There was also the Level 9 Giant Beast that had fiercely pursued the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, becoming incredibly insane over that ancient Aura.
However, these matters were still far off, and soon, Jack Clark continued his studies and deducing from the Secret Book, making Damon Lopes on the opposite side feel somewhat distressed.
Hey, didn’t my words just now go to waste, brother? You make it awkward for me to even slack off now.
“Brother Callum, I’m going to take a walk,” said Damon Lopes as he stood up, eager to get away, or else he too would feel the urge to cultivate.
As Jack Clark was immersed in his cultivation, in Mist River City.
In the evening, after visiting a classmate’s home after school, Glenn Clark didn’t return home until it was almost 6 o’clock.
“Mom, I’m back,” a loudly shouting Glenn Clark pushed open the courtyard gate and saw his mom chatting with a woman in her thirties across the yard.
The woman glanced at Glenn Clark, then cheerfully said, “Sister Clark, we’ll talk another time, I need to go cook dinner now.”
“Hmm hmm, you go ahead.”
Since Jack Clark became the top individual at South Sky Martial Height, Doris Clark had been promoted to a middle management position within the company, with very little to do every day.
After working regular hours, she was usually the one making dinner in the evening.
Walking into the room, Glenn Clark was curious, “Mom, wasn’t that Mr. Rice next door? Who was that woman?”
Doris Clark replied offhandedly, “Mr. Rice and his family have sold their house. They’ve moved to another part of the city; their son lives there, and they went to help take care of their grandson.”
“The one just now was Ms. Davis, our new neighbor, and also a colleague of mine. She’s a very nice person.”
“Oh,” Glenn Clark nodded.
Soon after dinner, Glenn Clark rushed out the door with his fishing rod and basket, shouting, “Mom, I’m heading to the riverside to fish.”
From inside, Doris Clark’s voice came, “Come back early, don’t always fish till midnight.”
“Got it.”
Ever since he had started making money from fishing and even cooking the fish himself, Glenn Clark developed a keen interest in fishing, going to the riverside every day to sit.
Moreover, with nationwide personnel Mobilization, in recent times, fish over 1.5 meters with signs of mutation were almost all fished out of the river.
Glenn Clark had heard that someone even caught a fish more than 3 meters long, practically at the level of a Mutated Beast, which they could not haul up; the person was dragged into the water instead.
The next day, in the morning.
Clyde appeared in Banan Border City, a thousand kilometers away, challenging the local martial arts hall. He defeated the three Sixth Heavenly Layer Experts of the martial arts hall in a single move, sweeping them invincibly.
And all of this was broadcast live by Banan Country’s top Television Station, causing an even greater stir online.
“He’s too strong.”
“Yeah, that Overbearing punch shattered the atmosphere within tens of meters, like a heavy-yield thermobaric bomb with terrifying power, simply invincible.”
“But I think Darren Callum is stronger.”
“I think so too, that’s the man who slew a god.”
“Do you think Darren Callum will accept Clyde’s challenge when the time comes?”
“He should, they’re both young men in their twenties, who would be afraid of whom.”
“Indeed, just go for it if you’re a real man.”
While the heat online was fermenting and the discussion growing hotter, in a hotel room, gazing at the big screen, Mathilda Ward contemplated, “He’s drumming up support, making it impossible for you to refuse.”
Jack Clark said indifferently, “It doesn’t matter.”

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 244: Fighting the Level 9 Demon Ape
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 244: Fighting the Level 9 Demon Ape
On May 4th, Clyde entered the small country of Elbia and challenged the Second-tier Martial High of the capital.
In this battle, he successively defeated five Sixth Heavenly Layer experts and the fully beast-transformed head instructor at the early stage of the Seventh Layer. Not a single person could withstand one move under the might of the Destruction Fist Intent.
On May 6th, Clyde traveled through Elbia to enter Gunardo and challenged the First Martial Hall of the border city, which was also Gunardo’s largest martial arts hall headquarters.
This battle was broadcasted live by the local television station.
In one fight, none of the late period Sixth Layer and peak masters could withstand a single punch, and the mid-stage Seventh Layer hall master was defeated in three moves, increasing Clyde’s momentum considerably.
May 8th.
In a temporary recording studio on the tenth floor of the hotel, Mathilda Ward had recovered quite a bit and was recording a new song. Outside, the bald middle-aged recording engineer and the assistant were busy.
Next to them, Jack Clark, as always, wore a black suit and a white shirt, his face hidden behind sunglasses, sitting on a single sofa, quietly reading a ‘book’.
Inside the void of the secret space, a thirty-meter-tall figure stood tall. At this moment, the Combat Divine Body was almost in its complete form, wearing black-red Dragon Scales battle armor, holding a halberd in both hands, with four arms positioned behind its back, fingers knotted in seals. Additionally, with four slowly revolving halos behind its head, it looked like a Combat Light King, arms knotted in seals as if holding up an entire world, majestic and sacred.
The battle body now felt different from the earlier illusory sensation, filled with a sense of ‘reality,’ as if it were an actual ‘person’ in existence.
At present, the battle body only had some minor conflicts among the runes inside the body. Jack felt that after probably another hundred or so more deductions, he could resolve it in about two or three days.
As for the seals formed by those four extra arms, they were deliberately posed by Jack for aesthetic purposes; he felt it made the True Martial phantom look better when making an appearance.
With this step, his creation of the True Martial Secret Canon was almost complete.
Although he had only deduced up to the Seventh Layer, the foundation and outline were robust, so once he made a breakthrough into the Seventh Layer, deducing the Eighth Layer would be swift.
At that time, making a breakthrough through one layer per month should be no problem.
Possibly by August of this year, he could break through to the Ninth Heavens, and in total, his cultivation time would be less than a year, slightly faster than Jonathan Walker’s one year to the Ninth Heavens.
Thinking of this, the corners of Jack’s mouth couldn’t help but curve upwards slightly.
This scene suddenly made the little assistant stare in awe.
It couldn’t be helped, he was just too handsome.
Plus, with the title of God Slayer, all the women in these entertainment groups looked at Jack as if he had an aura about him, shining brightly in their eyes.
That’s why Jack seldom went downstairs during this time. Every time he did, the gazes of the female backup dancers and secretaries from the concert teams were as if they wanted to devour him.
This kind of situation always made Damon Lopes very envious.
Even he, an Innate Awakened One, didn’t receive such treatment. Those women only wanted to sleep with him, to taste the flavor of an Innate Awakened One, not because they ‘liked him’.
At this moment, the bald recording engineer said sourly, “Miss Jodie, stop looking. Even if you keep staring, he won’t fancy you. He’s a man who has slain a ‘god’.”
lhe beautiful assistant chuckled, “I know, so I’m taking advantage of this opportunity to look more while I can, otherwise, I won’t have the chance later.” After saying this, the pretty assistant continued to gaze at Jack with a twinkling, unabashed desire in her eyes.
At the same time, as Mathilda Ward’s body recovered, Crystal Boyce announced to the outer world that the final concert in Mason will be on May 20th.
In the Water and Fire World, at the mouth of the volcano, scorching magma roiled.
Boom!
The magma suddenly exploded, and a gigantic, ferocious black-red dragon head emerged, the dark red magma burning with flames, trickling down through the gaps in the scale armor.
On either side of the dragon head, three pairs of red feather horns studded with sharp spikes burned with flames, forming a golden crown, making the Thunderflame Emperor Beast appear both majestic and domineering.
Taking heavy steps, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast stood up with a thunderous noise, large amounts of magma pouring off its body, forming cascades of fiery waterfalls.
After a week of ‘Closed-door Cultivation,’ where it focused on condensing force field runes, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast also absorbed a massive amount of the volcano’s intense energy, making its aura even more oppressively heavy. At this time, its right claw was engraved with a hundred force field constraint runes. With over a hundred Basic Runes layered together, the power to bind the force field had almost doubled compared to before.
As for how much it could compress and how much intensity of the Golden Flame and Thunder energy it could condense, only battle would tell.
Boom! The stones around the volcano mouth shattered as a nearly hundred-meter-long black-red Colossal Beast leaped hundreds of meters into the air and ferociously smashed into the Lava Lake below.
Immediately, millions of tons of Scorching Magma were tossed in all directions, forming a meteoric fire rain that covered a thousand-meter range, causing the Lava Lake to keep churning tumultuously.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast stood up on its hind legs, half-submerged in magma, and came in front of the Purple Dragon Egg.
As soon as the black-red Beast gently clasped the Purple Dragon Egg within its claw, the egg trembled slightly, emitting a faint sense of joy and anticipation. “Roar! This time I can give you a little.” With a low growl, Life Energy from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s depths gathered in its claw, enveloping the Purple Dragon Egg.
Suddenly, a powerful suction emanated from within the egg, like a parched desert voraciously absorbing life force of a comparable level.
However, after the Purple Dragon Egg absorbed roughly the equivalent of half a portion of Essence Blood, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast dispersed its Life Energy.
But the Purple Dragon Egg clearly wasn’t satisfied yet, sending out a strong and persistent desire to want more.
“Roar! No, you can’t eat too much at once. That’s enough for today,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast refused resolutely..

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 244: Battling the Level 9 Demon Ape_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 244: Battling the Level 9 Demon Ape_2
It had estimated that if it only consumed half a portion of the Life Energy from its Essence Blood, there would be no impact to its foundation or strength, and eating two Level 7 Colossuses would allow for recovery.
But if the consumption was too great, exceeding one portion of Essence Blood, even it would feel weak.
These were the experiences it had summed up during this period; there was no helping it, as that feeling of weakness deep inside, that empty sensation, was too uncomfortable.
As for creatures like the Silver Giant Dragon, they had also tried condensing Life Energy to feed the Purple Dragon Egg, hoping to encourage the generation of more Imperial-grade Life Essence.
But it disdained from absorbing any of it, as if this ‘little’ one disapproved of their Life Energy.
“Roar! Alright, I’m off to eat something to replenish myself, I’ll ‘charge’ you up next time,” Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled lowly, putting the Purple Dragon Egg, whose Aura of Life had been strengthened by a fraction, back in the lake.
The scorching magma, like a warm bed, provided some help to its hatching. Normally, the dragon egg also absorbed the fiery energy to strengthen itself.
Only, compared to the little energy it absorbed, more Life Energy was passing by with time.
Then, the condensed matter made of that Life Energy was devoured by the Tiger Flood Dragon, which was also the reason why that Ferocious Beast was able to grow to Level 9 and fully return to its ancestral form.
That Giant Beast was very clever, choosing not to directly devour this Dragon Egg-
Since it didn’t possess the ability to absorb genetic material and bloodline, swallowing the dragon egg would only be equivalent to consuming a nutrient-rich ‘resource’.
After all, it was just an egg, yet to even form a complete life form; it was so fearsome only because it contained an Inheritance of ‘rule’ power within.
Therefore, it was better to continually absorb Life Essence, enhancing its own bloodline until one day it could deplete the Dragon Egg of all its Life Energy.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast walked heavily past the side of the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace, an enormous dragon head emerged from the Earth Dragon King Hall, roaring excitedly.
Roar, Roar!! Thunderflame, are you going out?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes revealed intense anticipation, as it had already been confined in the palace for several days, bored to the point of going moldy.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast glanced at it and roared lowly, “How many Energy Conversion Runes have you condensed?”
Roar, Roar!! Twenty… no, nineteen… Roar! It seems like fifteen.
Under the watchful gaze of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which originally wanted to say it had condensed twenty runes, skimped down its claim, eventually retreating sheepishly back into its shell.
In a bit more than a week, condensing fifteen runes wasn’t actually slow, especially since they, unlike the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, didn’t systematically learn or have experiences.
And slow was only at the beginning; condensing their first rune might have taken them two or three days, but then it would get faster and faster.
“Roar! The task quantity remains unchanged; you’re not allowed to leave the Dragon Palace until you’ve condensed twenty runes,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which had poked its head out of the water, also withdrew guiltily.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, they didn’t require supervision from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
One was striving to catch up with the Thunderflame Emperor Beast and diligently cultivating, while the other had its eight heads taking turns to sleep, sleeping soundly.
Amidst the explosion of sea spray, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast burst out of the underwater Dragon Palace, watched by four Mutated Tiger Whales and amid the bootlicking of the Blue Giant Crab.
Upon leaving the Dragon Palace, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon briefly discerned the direction and immediately, with golden flames erupting behind it, vanished beneath the deep sea.
While the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish roamed the sea, according to the demands of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, it remembered several locations where it sensed the Aura of the Level 9 Giant Beasts.
At the moment, the direction the Thunderflame Emperor Beast swam towards was one where a Level 9 Giant Beast resided.
According to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s previous sensing, the Aura that the Giant Beast carelessly emitted was slightly stronger than the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon, but not excessively so.
The pitch-black deep sea was deathly still, when suddenly dazzling golden Radiance exploded below the water. Immediately after, the scorching shock of waves and thunderous reverberations echoed through.
Clenching a Level 7 Colossus that looked like a Dragon in its claw, recently killed, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast trailed fiery waves behind him, devouring while on the move.
By now, encountering Level 7 Colossuses that used to prompt the Thunderflame Emperor Beast to be on full alert was no different than encountering chicks; nearly every encounter resulted in an instant kill.
About three hours later, having traversed over a thousand kilometers, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast arrived near its target and sensed the powerful Aura of the Level 9 Giant Beast from afar.
The intangible Aura spread out over a hundred kilometers, fitting the presence of a Level 9 Giant Beast—domineering and gratifying. “I like it,” the Thunderflame Emperor Beast said with a slight upward curl of its mouth, appearing quite ferocious.
An Aura like this was good, allowing it to discover and estimate its chances beforehand.
If it encountered an Early Stage Level 9 Giant Beast that it could defeat, it would attack; if it sensed a Peak Level 9 Aura that it couldn’t defeat, it would run.
Actually, the practice ingrained in the genes of Level 9 Giant Beasts to release their Aura is quite normal; under the intimidation of the Aura, other Giant Beasts of the same level would normally leave automatically upon sensing it.
Unless it was for an territorial dispute, they would not approach upon sensing an Aura of the same level.
After all, an Aura is an Aura, and combat power is combat power. Without full confidence, Level 9 Giant Beasts wouldn’t generally engage in fights to avoid injuries that could affect their growth.
Especially since most battles are not worth the bloodshed if winning wouldn’t bring much gain.
As for resources, anything edible would have already been consumed by the Giant Beasts that occupied the area, with just the Territory’s Heavenly Energy being a bit richer.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast was an exception in this regard.
Soon, following the Aura, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast arrived at the Territory where the Level 9 Giant Beast was entrenched. It was an area enveloped in mist that covered tens of kilometers of sea surface..

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 244: Combat with the Ninth-level Demonic Ape - 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 244: Combat with the Ninth-level Demonic Ape – 3
“It’s actually on the sea surface.” On the raging sea, the head of Thunderflame Emperor Beast emerged, looking at the vast fog in the distance with some surprise.
After thinking for a while, Thunderflame Emperor Beast disappeared from the sea surface and rushed into the misty area under the hundred-meter-deep sea. Without facing any danger along the way, Thunderflame Emperor Beast quickly approached the central area of the mist, which was a vast island with a diameter of tens of kilometers.
There was fog in the sky, and the island was filled with not only birdsong but also the fragrances of flowers.
Waterfalls hung between several small mountain peaks, winding streams flowed, and every now and then, a 3 or 5-meter-tall creature would flash within the forest, full of vitality.
At this moment, the sea surface in the distance bulged rapidly, and with a loud “bang”, a black-red ferocious giant beast appeared, with seawater pouring down like a waterfall.
Boom!
The terrifying aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast burst forth, with golden flames burning fiercely, releasing high temperatures that evaporated everything in the surroundings.
Roar! From deep within the island, a ferocious and oppressive roar echoed through heaven and earth.
Immediately afterward, the ground shook as an enormous figure burst forth from afar, blinking into a shadow that descended from the sky, smashing down a kilometer away.
Boom!
Dirt and rocks soared into the sky, and a six-armed demon ape, standing over a hundred meters tall, covered in black scales, stood between heaven and earth.
In front of this colossal beast, the surrounding trees, over a dozen or twenty meters high, looked as small as weeds, emitting a ferocious aura that shook the heaven and earth.
Under that terrifying aura, the surrounding air formed circles of white waves, rolling around with howling winds, creating an astonishing momentum.
Roar!
Looking at the black-red colossal beast standing by the sea, the six-armed demon ape didn’t immediately attack, but instead let out a ferocious roar, showing some hesitation.
Although the Thunderflame Emperor Beast standing was only about fifty meters tall, half the size of the demon ape and having an aura just at Level 8 Mid Stage.
However, the instincts of a Level 9 lifeform told it that this ferocious monster was very dangerous, very dangerous.
But this time, the target of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was to kill a ‘human’.
Boom! The earth collapsed, the sea water exploded, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast vanished instantly from its original position, followed by a sonic boom that swept across heaven and earth.
Roar!
The six-armed demon ape hadn’t even reacted before its massive body was knocked away with a loud “bang”, sending up waves that caused it to slide out a grand canyon-width trench on the ground, crashing into the mountain peak in the distance.
Boom! The small hill, hundreds of meters high, collapsed with a thunderous rumble, countless rocks exploding and scattering, smoke and dust rolling, and half of the island was shaking.
Roar! A furious roar echoed, shaking heaven and earth.
The six-armed demon ape, with its broken chest scales, stood up from the ground, and a shocking force erupted from it, covering a range of five hundred meters.
Under the terrifying shaking power, even space cracked into tiny black cracks.
The surrounding collapsing rocks were directly crushed into powder by the shaking force, annihilated, and formed an asteroid crater with a diameter of several hundred meters.
The demon ape was incredibly furious, its eyes red, and staring fixedly at the black-red giant beast in the distance.
It had actually been ambushed and injured by a mutant giant beast that was one level lower than it, and it hadn’t even reacted to deploying its domain.
Defensive Talent and shockwave domain.
Looking at the demon ape with only its chest scales broken, a touch of surprise flashed in the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
The claw it had just used was nearly ten times faster than supersonic speed and had an explosive power exerting a hundred-fold force of its talent which could collapse even a mountain peak.
However, this Level 9 giant beast had a very strong and solid flesh, combined with at least a senior level of Defensive Talent, so it only received a light injury.
As expected of a Level 9 giant beast, it wasn’t so easy to kill.
Roar! The six-armed demon ape let out a furious roar, and its massive body burst forth, with the Oscillation Domain surrounding it, appearing instantly in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The collision of the Golden Blaze Thunder Domain and the Oscillation Domain erupted into circles of Destructive Shockwaves, shattering the earth and thundering wherever they passed.
Within the combined domains, the larger demon ape brandished its six arms that were enveloped in dark red power, exuding a terrifying aura of destruction, and viciously smashed down.
As that fist wrapped in the force of its talent fell, the space was twisted by the terrifying power, and black traces lingered in the air.
Roar! The Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s double claws swelled with muscle, surrounded by an even more overbearing and powerful dark red force, slamming out at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
Because the attack was so fast, it appeared as if the six dragon claws struck the fist of the demon ape simultaneously.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Under the absolutely overbearing force, the impact exploded, and the shattered earth underneath the two giant beasts collapsed again, creating a deep pit tens of meters deep and extending thousands of meters.
Upon this strike, the six-armed demon ape, with its larger body, let out an astonished angry roar, retreating a step while its upper body was lifted due to the monstrous power of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Just at this moment, a black-red sword tail burst forth from behind the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, wrapped in flames and thunderstorms, penetrating the domain, and emitting circles of explosive thunderous roars.
Boom!
The demon ape’s six palms merged and instantly blocked in front of it, tightly gripping the sword tail.
However, even though it had stopped this strike, the force carried by it caused the demon ape to retreat several steps, crushing the ground beneath it, forming several large pits.
As the demon ape burst out with full strength to block the sword tail strike, the right claw of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast gathered wild flames condensed an eye-catching golden light sphere.
Boom! The Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s one claw fell like lightning on the demon ape s chest, instantly releasing an endless amount of scorching energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 244: Battling a Level 9 Demon Ape_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 244: Battling a Level 9 Demon Ape_4
From afar, it looked like a small nuclear explosion rising, followed by a earth- shattering roar that shook the heavens and the earth.
Under the destructive explosion of the golden flame, the earth within hundreds of meters crumbled, and the dirt turned into scorching magma, thrown in all directions.
Within a kilometer range, the vegetation in front was turned into ash instantly when the golden light wave swept past, and the broken trees burned, terrifying and awe-inspiring.
Roar!
The demon ape, engulfed in flames, flew out and slid hundreds of meters while screaming in pain.
Under the strike of the Golden Flame Core Explosion, one of the six-armed demon ape’s arms was blown off, its chest scale armor shattered, and the flesh and blood on the front were burnt off a layer, leaving it weak.
If it didn’t have the High-Level Defense Talent, it would have already been killed by this attack containing 20% of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s internal Golden Flame energy, compressed 50 times.
However, it was heavily injured even if it did not die.
Although the power of this move was formidable, it also placed a great burden on the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Under the indiscriminate explosion, even the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was forced to retreat several steps, its whole body scales scorched red, radiating intense heat.
Roar Roar Roar!!
The five-armed demon ape struggled to get up from the ground, staring at the distant and terrifying Thunderflame Emperor Beast, its eyes blood-red, filled with madness and intense killing intent.
Since evolving to its current state, this was the first time it had been so severely injured, and it was injured by a being one major realm lower than itself.
No matter if it was the dignity of a Level 9 Giant Beast or the stimulation of death, both drove it mad and furious.
With endless anger, a force deep within the demon ape was activated, instantly causing the beast to enter a berserk state, its five arms merged into one, and its external domain converged.
Boom!
With its three arms on each side and two arms merging, the demon ape’s body rapidly expanded, transforming in the blink of an eye into a 200-meter tall colossal demon ape.
At this moment, the demon ape’s aura soared tenfold, the terrifying power it radiated causing the surrounding space to crack under pressure.
Everything was twisted and deformed as the earth within a few hundred meters range could no longer bear the weight, forming a deep crater several hundred meters wide.
This astonishing change even caused the Thunderflame Emperor Beast to pause briefly.
Boom!
With a sonic boom, the 200-meter tall demon ape broke through the air, instantly appearing in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, its merged arms swinging down like a world-ending heavy hammer.
Boom!
The ground within a thousand meters crumbled, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s afterimage shattered, countless dirt was thrown about, and the entire island shook under the demon ape’s massive attack, with the seaside waves roaring.
The pure force explosion caused a violent wind that swept through ten thousand meters, creating a shocking and earth-shattering sound.
Roar!
At this moment, the demon ape’s screams echoed once again from the center of the explosion, its colossal body crushing the smoke and dust as it flew out, followed by the appearance of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast by its side.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
In an instant, after eight consecutive flashes, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast chased and attacked the demon ape at a faster speed, causing its entire body scales to rupture and blood and flesh to fly everywhere while continuously tumbling.
The final blow landed on its chest, with eight consecutive supersonic bursts of power, directly sent the demon ape flying once again, crashing hard into the mountain wall two kilometers away.
Boom!
The intense impact caused the island’s highest small hill to collapse, and the explosion sent countless giant rocks flying to cover half of the island, with the deafening rumble echoing endlessly.
Among all martial arts, only speed is invincible.
This was the power of enhanced top-tier swiftness.
Buzz! Just as the demon ape crashed into the mountain peak, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s dorsal fin shone with a flashing blue radiance.
Boom! Endless thunder transformed into a spherical thunder net, covering a range of three hundred meters, then suddenly contracted, forming four dazzling thunder rings in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
At the same time, brilliant golden light gathered in its mouth, emitting terrifying energy fluctuations.
Buzz!
With only a slight build-up, the scorching golden breath burst out of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s mouth, shining through the heaven and earth.
At the moment the Golden Flame Breath passed through the four thunder rings, it compressed, accelerated, and turned into a one-meter wide golden light beam, exuding the aura of destroying everything, piercing through heaven and earth.
Where the light beam passed, everything was annihilated, its dazzling glow causing the heaven and earth to lose color, and making the demon ape with shattered scales and bloodied body surface panic-stricken.
Roar!
The demon ape’s internal power erupted, and black power surrounded its arms, blocking in front of it.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
The golden light beam landed on the ten-meter-thick layer of black defense energy in front of the demon ape, and in an instant, a circle of dazzling halos exploded, creating an earth-shattering roar.
But only slightly obstructed, the golden light beam with extreme heat and impact penetration pierced through the black energy layer and the demon ape’s arms.
Finally, under its desperate gaze, it penetrated its skull.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast suddenly raised its head, and the golden light beam shot straight into the sky, like a sword cutting through the heavens and earth, piercing through the clouds at thousands of meters high, and exploding loudly.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 245: The Monarch Lurking in the Darkness (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 245: The Monarch Lurking in the Darkness (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
In order to monitor sea Mutated Creatures, the Federation had not only set up photonic energy detectors in coastal cities but also many base satellites in the
ocean.
