As a result, with the destructive breath dispersing the cloud mist that blocked electromagnetic signals on the island, a hollow with a diameter of more than a thousand meters was formed.
The breath beam that reached Level 9 energy fluctuation and traveled through Heaven and Earth, soaring thousands of meters high before disintegrating, was instantly captured by the satellites in orbit.
With the image locked, the black-red Colossal Beast standing in the flames and thunder, as well as the hundred-meter long corpse of the demon ape that lay on the ground, were both photographed.
“Report, a strong Mutated Creature energy fluctuation has been detected. Image analysis, the form is 70% similar to the Codename Thunderflame Mutant Beast, but…”
“But what?”
“This strength fluctuation has reached mid-Level 9, with the Mutant Beast’s body size close to a hundred meters.”
“The Codename Thunderflame Beast had a record of only more than 50 meters in length two months ago, and there is a certain difference in appearance between them and this Mutant Creature, so it cannot be judged to be the same creature.”
Looking at the giant beast model projected on the big screen, the on-duty colonel’s expression was solemn: “There’s no need to doubt, this is the Codename Thunderflame Mutant Beast.”
Suddenly, there was an uproar below.
“It is indeed that Mutant Creature, both in form and aura, giving an indescribably fierce feeling.”
“It is that Mutant Creature, the red feather horns on both sides of its head are very distinctive.”
“This creature’s growth rate is horrifying. It was only twenty meters when it was first detected, but ten days later, during the second discovery, it had grown to thirty or forty meters.”
“During the third sighting with the Silver Giant Dragon, its size had skyrocketed to sixty meters. Now, after so long, it is reasonable for its size to be close to a hundred meters.”
“Reasonable, my ass. This Mutant Creature is a monster, its growth rate is too terrifying, completely violating the rules of biological growth.”
“Indeed, it’s so terrifying. Among the data records of these years, the fastest Monarch-level Mutant Creature took almost eleven years to grow from Level 7 to Level 9-”
” Hiss! Eleven years and just a few months!”
“Look, the Mutant Creature is moving.”
“It’s devouring the Level 9 Giant Beast of the ape.’
“So scary…”
Watching the high-definition satellite imaging, many people couldn’t help but shiver because it was too brutal.
On the ruined island, the black-red Colossal Beast, which had gathered its Gold Flame Thunderbolt, was gripping the huge corpse of the demon ape. Its huge grotesque mouth cracked the thick and hard scale armor with a crisp sound. Every bite tore off a large piece of flesh and blood, and the bright red blood spewed out like a waterfall, forming ponds on the ground.
This blood contained rich energy. If normal Level 1-2 Demonic Beasts ate it, they would burst, and for Level 3-4 Demonic Beasts, it would be an extremely nourishing meal.
However, the blood that flowed out was only a small part, most of it was locked by the demon ape’s flesh, and it was eaten together as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast ripped and devoured it.
At this moment, it seemed to sense the ‘gaze’ of the satellite. The black-red Colossal Beast that was eating suddenly raised its head and looked up to the sky with a fierce roar.
Roar! In an instant, Heaven and Earth trembled, and a raging wind howled. The fanged teeth in the large mouth, the grotesque body stained with blood.
Even through the big screen, countless people felt an indescribable fierce aura coming straight at them.
Such a brutal scene made many people in the coastal base surveillance room subconsciously swallow, their faces turning pale.
Due to their positions, these staff members had rarely been to the frontline, let alone seen blood.
At this point, the island’s mist surged, gradually restoring and covering the hollow. Suddenly, the big screen lost the trace of the black-red Colossal Beast.
“Huff! Huff! This giant beast is too terrifying.”
“It’s like a demon.”
“Yes, it feels like with its growth rate, it won’t be long before it reaches the Mythical-level and becomes an even more terrifying Mythical Giant Beast.” “What should we do? Should we apply for the First Sequence Energy Orbital Satellite to launch an attack?”
The colonel at the command table shookhis head: “It’s no use. This Codename Thunderflame Mutant Creature has already become a climate. Without a locator, there is no way to lock onto it.”
“Besides, this Mutant Creature possesses at least five talents: speed, strength, defense, and lightning and flame.”
“Especially speed, defense, and strength, which make it even more terrifying than ordinary Level 9 Giant Beasts. Its survivability is very strong.” “Unless a king-level creature arrives, current technology is useless against it.” “Furthermore, its location is the ocean. If it escapes to hide in the deep sea below several thousand meters, humanity will have to face a terrifying ‘enemy’ in the future.”
“Therefore, the best approach is to wait and see.”
“From the positions observed each time, this demon-like Mutant Creature is moving towards those ocean channels. It is expected to leave soon.” “Compared to the Blue Star World with a lack of World Origin, the mythical world is the destination of these Giant Beasts, including king-level beings.” The colonel’s analysis made many people breathe a sigh of relief.
At present, it seems that is the case. The monster-like creature has been moving toward the deep sea, with no direct conflict of interest with humans. Moreover, once the Mutant Beasts leave the Blue Star, they will basically never return.”
Because the mythical world is the paradise for transcendent creatures. However, these were just the thoughts of the colonel, and soon today’s information would be brought together at the fastest speed and sent to the base headquarters.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 245 The King Lurking in the Dark (Seeking Monthly Tickets) 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 245 The King Lurking in the Dark (Seeking Monthly Tickets) 2
What happens next, whether a king is summoned or not, is no longer his concern.
On Mist Island, Thunderflame Emperor Beast raises its head and looks at the sky that is veiled by clouds and mist. It wonders if it has been discovered by the satellite again.
It s unclear if its sharp perception is due to the influence of the Heart’s Eye or the growth after reaching Level 8.
Within less than a minute of the satellite’s ‘gaze’ falling on it, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast inexplicably sensed that there were ’beings’ watching it from above.
However, it doesn’t matter if it’s been noticed. After being swiftly enhanced to the top-tier, even a Level 9 peak strong man would not be able to stop it if it wished to leave.
As for the king-level beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast is more cautious in evaluating them as it has never encountered them and does not know how powerful they are.
Pushing this concern to the back of its mind, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast continued to tear and feast on the demon ape’s flesh and blood.
In fact, this Level 9 demon ape was quite powerful. Its raw destructive power was even stronger than that of the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon.
With a similar Oscillation Domain to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Advanced Strength, Advanced Defense, and many other advanced talents such as fury and gigantification, it was extremely formidable when combined.
However, it was unfortunate to have met the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, which was stronger than it in all aspects.
It was not as powerful, couldn’t withstand its defense, and was completely overrun by the terrifyingly fast movement and attack speed of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Its domain that shakes and destroys everything was weakened under the Golden Blaze Thunder Domain, and it could not shake the terrifying dense flesh of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
It eventually died in despair.
At this moment, as the flesh of the Level 9 creature was consumed, the immense biological energy exploded within the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body. Every cell that it passed was furiously absorbing, dividing, and compressing.
Compared to a Level 7 or even Level 8 Beast, the energy and Life Factors contained in the flesh and blood of a Level 9 Beast were completely on a different level.
Under the influx of dense energy, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body that was close to too meters long grew visibly. Its full-body scales armor was being expanded with a cracking sound.
Boom!
When the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body size exceeded 100 meters, all the flesh and energy in its body underwent minor transformations, and a more terrifying aura erupted in an instant.
Huff! Huff!
Under the heavy and terrifying pressure, countless cracks sprouted out with the Thunderflame Emperor Beast at center, spreading hundreds of meters away, with a raging wind howling all around.
Level 8 Late Stage.
After sensing the subtle changes after the breakthrough, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast continued to lower its head and eat. Splattering the flesh and blood with its ferocious big mouth was a terrifying sight.
About half a day later, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast finally finished eating the six-armed demon ape, with its body suddenly growing to a length of 105 meters.
After breaking the 100-meter mark, as its body becomes increasingly massive and its flesh density increases, the energy required for each meter of growth is now much larger.
Additionally, part of the absorbed life essence was stored as Evolution Energy, hence it needed more food.
However, this time the Thunderflame Emperor Beast did not eat everything. It left the skeleton of the six-armed demon ape behind.
Looking at the giant Beast’s skeleton in front of it, almost 20 meters high when laid flat on the ground, forged with what seemed to be a Black Gold alloy, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast took a deep breath and then pooled the energy in its body.
Boom!
Infinite golden flames roared out of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s mouth, covering all over the six-armed demon ape’s skeleton.
However, this time the golden flames emitted was not a condensed breath but was just pure fire that had been compressed twice.
Under tens of thousands of degrees Celsius, the ground was visibly melting, and the air as well as tiny particles were evaporating, forming a lava lake covering a range of hundreds of meters.
Under the continuous tempering of the golden flames, the demon ape’s skeleton began to emit a black gold light, with some rune trails vaguely appearing on the surface.
The Mutated Creatures that choose the physical evolutionary path would have their talent abilities coalescing and crystallizing into runes when they break through to Level 8, which would then be integrated into their body including the flesh and bones.
Therefore, after their death, these creatures’ scale armor, bones, horns, and other remains would have more or less rune trails left, especially the core spine.
And through tempering the Beast’s skeleton, humans consolidate the power of these rune trails to form Incomplete Runes that contain the Beast’s talents for observation, comprehension, and learning.
This is the origin of the core power of most ‘Beast’-type secret books.
At this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast is doing something similar. It has taken an interest in the gigantification talent of the six-armed demon ape and wants to see if it can be used.
For the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, which relies on physical advantages, if it could acquire the ability of gigantification through rune marking, its power would become even more terrifying as its body size exponentially increases.
This tempering took half a day and one night.
There stands a black-red colossal beast over 100 meters long in the middle of the fire sea. The flames coming out of its massive, ferocious mouth seem dimmer.
Suspended above the fire sea is a golden spine about twenty meters long and over three meters wide, with the segment appearance of bamboo and countless rune trails all over it.
Phew Phew!! The Thunderflame Emperor Beast sat down heavily in exhaustion, causing the fire sea to explode and spew out scorching magma far and wide.
After half a day and a whole night of pouring out water… pouring out fire, even it was starting to feel the strain.
This was due to the talent enhancement and reaching the late stage of Level 8.
Otherwise, with its initial endurance of only three minutes when it had just broken through to Level 7, it would have been already drained and lying down.
After resting for a while, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast grabbed the twenty-meter-long Rune Spine and strolled out of the Magma Fire Sea, disappearing into the sea amidst crash of seawater.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 245: The Monarch Lurking in the Dark (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 245: The Monarch Lurking in the Dark (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
An hour after the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had almost disappeared, the sea surface on the other side suddenly arched up.
Immediately afterwards, a gigantic beast over eighty meters in length emerged.
This giant beast’s body resembled that of a python, covered in blue scales armor, with a pair of sharp claws on its upper body like a human.
But the beast’s head was fiendishly demonic, encased in a pair of large, curved horns, giving off a somewhat peculiar and terrifying presence, filled with oppression.
After appearing, the Eighth Level Beast looked around cautiously and then carefully approached the coast, quickly reaching the center of the island after the great battle.
Looking at the magma fire sea that was still burning and boiling, the shattered mountain peaks, the cracked earth, the Demon Python Beast sniffed the air.
Soon, a look of horror appeared on its face, and its massive body turned to swim back to the sea, quickly departing in another direction.
Deep beneath the pitch-black seabed, a pair of golden vertical pupils slowly opened.
Watching the direction in which the Demon Python Beast had departed, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast pondered for a moment, then its tail moved silently, following behind.
Even as its massive body moved, it didn’t cause much disturbance in the sea water, as most of the kinetic energy was dissipated by the invisible force field formed by its Agility Talent.
Earlier, when the Thunderflame Emperor Beast entered the sea, it habitually unleashed electromagnetic waves, which vaguely detected the presence of the Demon Python Beast.
This was a rare mutated creature capable of hiding its aura.
If it weren’t for the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s perception, which involved sensing water flow with its feather horn, scanning with electromagnetic dorsal fin waves, and a biological instinct for sensing the aura of strength, it might not have noticed it.
Following behind the giant beast, and keeping a distance of two kilometers, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast swam for nearly a thousand kilometers before abruptly stopping.
Because ahead, it sensed a powerful and terrifying aura, far surpassing that of the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon and the Six-Armed Demon Ape; it should belong to a Mid Level 9 Giant Beast.
And this giant beast had a very high bloodline level, giving the Thunderflame Emperor Beast a sense that it was no less than the Silver Giant Dragon.
This was a King-level ninth-tier in mid-phase beast with a king-level bloodline, and although it had not approached, the invisibly emanated aura still felt slightly dangerous to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Most importantly, did this giant beast seem to have its sights set on it?
And it seemed to have gathered some mutated creatures to form a giant beast power, the Eighth Level Demon Python likely being a scout, or it had just happened to encounter it hunting the Six-Armed Demon Ape.
Regardless of the situation, it was going to have an inevitable battle with both the Dragon Palace and this giant beast.
After looking deeply in the direction of the Level 9 Giant Beast’s aura, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast silently turned and left.
With its current strength, it could easily crush any Early Stage Level 9 Giant Beast, and killing those Mid Level 9 Giant Beasts with a Lord-level bloodline wouldn’t be a problem either.
However, facing a King-level giant beast with top-tier talents and at mid-phase Level 9, it was better to be cautious.
Having three top-tier talents itself, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was well aware of the might of such talents, each one almost touching the edge of the rules, extremely terrifying.
However, as long as it could breakthrough to Level 9, or further enhance one talent to top-tier, fully stepping into the Monarch level of life, killing this giant beast should not be an issue.
A few hours later, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast returned to the Dragon Palace, around one in the afternoon.
The territory of that King-level Giant Beast, the Dragon Palace, and the demon ape’s territory roughly formed an isosceles triangle, with the straight-line distance to the Dragon Palace being about fifteen hundred kilometers.
Looking at the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, now even more intimidating and massive in stature, the guardian Blue Giant Crab moved sideways and eagerly approached
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, you have returned, Great King, you have become even more mighty and strong, Great King, you are too formidable, truly worthy of being the Great King-
After a stream of flattery, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast felt annoyed and growled to interrupt: “Roar! Enough, keep a proper watch on the gate.”
After that, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled again, “Be vigilant of the surroundings recently. If you detect any unfamiliar lifeforms above Level 7 appearing, report it immediately.”
Gurgle gurgle!! Yes, Great King, I will always be watching the surroundings, and I won’t disappoint you, Great King, you look so inighty…
Boom! The Thunderflame Emperor Beast swung its claw and the terrifying strength exploded the sea water, forming a powerful vacuum shockwave that sent the Blue Giant Crab flying hundreds of meters.
Only then did it turn around and swim into the Dragon Palace World.
This guy has been told so many times, cut the crap, doesn’t he realize his flattery is too low-level? Repeating it over and over, my ears have grown tired of it.
Bang!
On the Worshipping Platform outside the Thunderflame Dragon King Palace, the ice crystals shattered as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast impaled the golden spine, shaped like a bamboo joint, erect as if it were a stele.
Together with the surrounding spine bones of the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon, the prestige of the Thunderflame Dragon Palace suddenly became even more majestic and magnificent.
Hearing the commotion, the Tiger Whale, the Dragon Turtle, the Silver Giant Dragon, and Ghidorah all subconsciously extended their heads.
Seeing that rune-engraved spine and feeling the powerful aura emanating from it, they all narrowed their eyes, clearly understanding that the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had killed another Level 9 Giant Beast on its trip.
“Roar! Hegemon, you’ve killed another Level 9 Extraordinary Creature?” the Silver Giant Dragon asked, opening its mouth wide in surprise.
The attitude of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was casual, as it bellowed, “I felt a bit hungry after emerging from my closed-door cultivation, so I went and killed a Level 9 Giant Beast to eat.”
“Roar! This skeleton contains part of the Giant Beast’s Talent Runes. You all can try to comprehend it if you like, and see if you can gain anything from it.” Suddenly, none of the Giant Beasts knew what to say.
They were all Eighth Level Extraordinary Lifeforms. Did you have to be such a freak, killing a Level 9 Giant Beast as easily as squishing a common creature?
Just as the Giant Beasts were doubting their beastly lives, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast suddenly stood upright and roared.
“Roar! Scythia, Ghidorah, Joe, and Domination, come out, all of you! Let’s gather Life Crystals, we need Level 3 and 4 as well.”
“This time, spread out in all directions. Clean sweep the territory controlled by the Dragon Palace once more, and return here in three days.”
The sudden roar of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast caught the Silver Giant Dragon and the others off guard.
But they were immediately followed by the excited roaring of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle: Roar roar!! Let’s charge, it’s the perfect opportunity to test my new abilities.
Yingyingying!! Finally, I can go play… no, I mean collect things for Thunderflame.
Compared to the monotony of cultivation, the two Giant Beasts, who had been cooped up for over a week, were extremely excited, fearing that the Thunderflame Emperor Beast would change its mind, rushed out in haste.
Then came Ghidorah, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, its nine dragon heads roared chaotically: “Roar roar roar!! Get it, help Abbott, get it, I’m the best, at it.”
Boom! Amidst a sky full of splashing water, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon surged forward.
As brothers, when the call is sounded, without a second thought, they charged out—such candor and straightforwardness.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon stepped forward with elegance.
Curse it, damn elegance. The Thunderflame Emperor Beast shook its head fiercely.
“Roar! In three days, Great Scythia will bring you many crystals, look forward to it.”
As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon held its head high, proudly pushed off with all four legs, and with a boom, dove into the water, causing a massive splash.
After the four Giant Beasts had left, the recently-returned Thunderflame Emperor Beast also left the Dragon Palace.
But the direction it chose was the territory of an unfamiliar Level 9 Giant Beast.
It still had a distance to go before reaching Level 9, and the only way to significantly increase its battle power in a short time was to become an Emperor-level gigantic beast.
Then, with its four top-tier talents, even if its growth level was only Level 8 Late Stage, it wouldn’t have a problem fighting and clashing with a Level 9 Mid-phase King-level Giant Beast.
But the Dragon Palace and the sea area in the rear had both been scoured by them once already; it was uncertain whether they could gather enough Life Crystals in a few days.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 246: Destiny Template, Will True Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 246: Destiny Template, Will True Body
May 11, in the afternoon, the sunlight was bright.
The golden rays pierced through the glass and transparent curtains, bright and gentle, the spreading warmth made one’s mood light up involuntarily. On the bed, the girl slowly opened her eyes.
Her eyes were bright and clear like the stars, her complexion like white jade, and her features were dignified and noble. At this moment, under the light laziness of the afternoon, she appeared exceptionally stunning.
Lying on the bed, Mathilda Ward gazed out of the bright window in a daze, seemingly still not fully awake.
After a while, a smile suddenly appeared on Mathilda Ward’s face, “Keep going, it’s almost there, it’s almost over,” the girl said, sitting up from the bed.
Soon, dressed in a blue outfit with a purple lace long skirt, Mathilda Ward walked out of the room, her gaze subconsciously glancing towards the sofa. There, Jack Clark sat quietly in a black suit, holding a white book that was transformed from a Secret Book; his eyes contained countless rune illusions spinning, mysterious and unfathomable.
At this moment, sensing Mathilda Ward’s emergence, Jack Clark slowly retracted his focus from the Secret Book.
“Brother Callum, how far have you progressed with the Secret Book?” Mathilda Ward’s eyes revealed a touch of curiosity.
Since knowing Jack Clark, he spent almost all his time during the day pondering over the Secret Book, never missing a moment whenever he had the chance.
Even Mathilda Ward was somewhat amazed by such persistent resolve. Years earlier, she had accompanied her father and seen many geniuses. There were monsters like Brudos, who, at the age of twenty, had made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven and followed an unconventional path in the cultivation of Genetic Martial Arts, or the young talents of the mech-type.
Besides them, she had also seen several Descendants of the King and Innate Awakened Ones.
But there were few like Jack Clark, who, after achieving such young success, remained unflustered and cultivated with an even more arduous and steady approach.
After all, young people all have the nature of youth, and their mindset often changes after a phase of surpassing all their peers.
Faced with Mathilda Ward’s inquiry, Jack Clark thought for a moment, “It’s almost complete.”
There was nothing about this progress that needed to be hidden.
Instantly, Mathilda Ward was taken aback, then said with some astonishment, “…what, you’ve already created your Secret Book? How is that possible?” Jack Clark shook his head, “Not all of it, just the seventh layer.”
Even so, Mathilda Ward’s face showed shock.
Just the seventh layer, but it also represented that the overall outline, foundation, core rune structure, etc., had been completely deduced, which was virtually no different from having created the entire Secret Book.
The contents of the eighth and ninth layers would extend step by step from the structure of the seventh layer.
What shocked Mathilda Ward was that it had only been a month since Jack Clark started creating the Secret Book, and he had already managed to invent a Top-tier Secret Manual from nothing.
This… even she didn’t know what to say.
Knowing that even those high-ranking powerhouses of the Ninth Heavens took years to create a common Secret Manual based on themselves, one could understand how astounding it was for Jack Clark to accomplish this in a month. Especially considering he was creating and deducing from the state of the Sixth Layer Heaven, rather than reverse engineering after having reached the end of the path.
Mathilda Ward’s eyes flickered with admiration, “I feel the Federation’s assessment of your talent might be a bit too low. Even the so-called Unparalleled Genius is not as exaggerated as you.”
“Even Jonathan Walker, more than a decade ago, took three months to create his Secret Manual between the Sixth and Seventh Layer Heaven.”
In response to Mathilda Ward’s praise, Jack Clark shook his head, “The reason the Secret Manual could be perfected so quickly probably has to do with the fact that I condensed the Godly Dragon Elephant runes.”
‘Creating something based on the same origin is much simpler than creating something from nothing.”
Of course, Jack Clark was being modest; by now the Secret Manual had already diverged greatly from the Godly Dragon Elephant, and he attributed this as an acceptable reason for everyone else.
His rapid progress related to his contemplation of Innate Space Runes, as well as possessing the Void Double Pupils that allowed him to glimpse at reality, solving the biggest issue.
The body wrapped in Innate Space Runes was capable of bearing all, coupled with his comprehensive mastery of the attributes of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, his progress was naturally swift.
This period of time, it would be more accurate to say he was modifying rather than creating. Therefore, he did not consider himself to be particularly remarkable.
After all, his rapid achievement was due to other reasons, and not because he had truly created a Secret Manual from nothing in a month.
At this moment, a knock came from outside, and Crystal Boyce walked in. Mathilda Ward asked curiously, “Aunt Boyce, weren’t you at the Training Institute?”
“Somethingcame up, so I came back,” she replied.
Upon saying that, Crystal Boyce looked toward Jack Clark, hesitating before saying, “Mr. Callum, a king-level strong man would like to meet with you.” “A king-level, wants to see me?” Jack Clark expressed surprise, for he did not recall knowing any King-level strong man.
Crystal Boyce nodded, “Yes, please hold on a moment.”
As she spoke, Crystal Boyce took out a metal disc and operated it; snowflakes danced on the large screen hanging on the wall, and the image of a man in his sixties appeared.
The man had gray at his temples, and just by standing there, an invisible pressure spread through the screen, giving off a sense of loftiness, as if he was a ‘god’ looking down on all creation.
Crystal Boyce spoke politely, “Hello, Alcos Throne.”
Despite the imposing aura, the elder’s gaze was very gentle, and his voice was old, “Ms. Boyce, Miss Ward, and this young Mr. Clark, I apologize for the disturbance.”
Mathilda Ward hurriedly responded politely, “Alcos Throne, you are a senior;
it’s the younger generation who should greet you first.”
Jack Clark also greeted respectfully, “Greetings to you, Alcos Throne.”
For a King-level figure to be so courteous was quite a surprise for Jack Clark, and he felt a certain respect for that. This was the breadth of mind and manner befitting a true powerhouse.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 246: The Mandate of Heaven Template, Will’s True Body_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Chapter 246: The Mandate of Heaven Template, Will’s True Body_2
As Jack Clark reflected, Alex let out a small sigh, “This time, I’ve made cross-realm contact with you all because of Clyde.”
“Clyde, that person is related to Senior?” Jack Clark’s brows furrowed slightly.
What he disliked most was having enemies connected with people from his own camp, because it made his job very difficult to carry out without restrictions.
Even Mathilda Ward’s gaze flickered with surprise at the news.
Alex nodded slightly, “That’s correct.”
Jack Clark said slowly, “Then, what does Senior mean by finding me this time? Do you hope that I will go easy on him when the time comes, or simply refuse Clyde’s challenge outright?”
Alex shook his head, “There’s no need to go easy on him, just make sure not to kill him. Injuries, even if severe, don’t matter.”
Instantly, all three of them were taken aback, including Crystal Boyce, who knew some inside information.
“Would this simple request be something you could do, Little Brother Clark?”
Jack Clark nodded slowly, “No problem, I will ensure not to deliver a killing blow when the time comes, but if he were to succumb to his injuries because they were too severe to treat in time…”
“Don’t worry, there will be someone to clean up afterwards.”
“I did not expect that Akunus would go after him. The latter definitely didn’t anticipate that Clyde was related to me,” Alex said as he looked toward Mathilda Ward, reminding her.
“Akunus is cunning and insidious. Clyde is likely just a decoy on the surface; it definitely has other means to deal with or bind Little Brother Clark and the others.”
“This creature is determined to claim the Dragon Power within you, even The Purgatory Family is cooperating with it this time.”
“Currently, due to Kautorus’s situation, The Purgatory Family has launched a strong counterattack. The Frontline Battlefield is tense; King-level and higher beings cannot be spared.”
“Although Tyler Lance and his people claim to be well-prepared, you must still be very cautious not to let it succeed.”
Mathilda Ward politely responded, “Thank you for the warning, Senior. We will certainly be careful.”
After saying goodbye to everyone, Alex disappeared, obviously very busy.
As the large screen dimmed, Jack Clark turned to Crystal Boyce, his eyes conveying a question; he was surprised that Clyde was actually related to a king-level being.
“After Alex from the Alcos Throne contacted me, I asked the old man Tyler, but there isn’t much that’s known…” Crystal Boyce started to explain the relationship between Clyde and Alex.
Simply put, it was a story of a wealthy and beautiful woman being eloped with by a young man.
The woman was naturally Clyde’s mother.
Over two decades ago, when the war between the Human Race and The Purgatory Demon Race erupted, Alex, as a king-level being, had a critical role and was almost constantly stationed in the mythical world.
At that time, the war had just started, and the families of the top strong men of both sides had not been involved, so Clyde’s mother was still living in Banan Country.
However, due to special reasons, only a few people in Banan Country knew that Clyde’s mother was the daughter of a king-level being.
With Alex focusing all his energy on the mythical world and unable to give attention elsewhere, Clyde’s mother fell in love with the heir to a small martial arts hall who had gone to the capital for schooling.
By the time Alex found out, his daughter was already cohabiting with Clyde’s father, and was even pregnant.
This enraged Alex.
Because the small martial arts hall heir had already married before he went to the capital, Alex felt it was a disgrace to the family. After all, he was a King- level strong man.
His daughter may not have had cultivation talent, but her status in Banan Country was as distinguished as that of a princess.
And his daughter, whom he had cherished from a young age, ended up being someone’s mistress. This filled him with immense rage, and he even planned to kill the martial arts hall heir.
But at that time, since Alex was stationed at the Frontline Battlefield, he could not return and could only forcefully order his daughter to break off the relationship and have someone secretly take out that man.
That was met with fierce resistance.
His daughter eloped back to the small city with the small gypsum owner, even using death to threaten him not to trouble the martial arts hall heir.
This almost caused Alex to cough up blood in anger. He severed relations with Clyde’s mother on the spot, and only a few high-ranking individuals in Banan Country knew about this.
Including the small owner who eloped with Clyde’s mother, he had no idea he was taking away the daughter of a king-level strong man.
All he knew was that she came from a scholarly family of high standing.
Later, the small owner died in a martial contest, and Clyde and his mother struggled to survive on the streets, as she had never done any rough work since she was young.
Years later, when his anger had largely subsided, Alex learned of the death of the young man and personally returned to Blue Star, to find his daughter and her child.
Then, nobody knows what happened, but Alex never came back again, even after Clyde’s mother passed away.
“That’s pretty much it,” Crystal Boyce concluded.
“It kind of feels like Alex from the Alcos Throne got the short end of the stick,” said Jack Clark with a peculiar look in his eyes.
Mathilda Ward nodded slightly, “Indeed, it’s a bit pitiful. I didn’t expect his daughter to be so foolish, breaking off relations with her own father for the sake of an ordinary person.”
“Such a woman, to say she did it for love, might be better described as selfish and utterly foolish.”
“Indeed,” JackClarkagreed.
If Alex had been unkind to his daughter, neglecting or mistreating her since a young age, then Clyde’s mother’s actions could be understood.
But judging by Alex’s demeanor towards his daughter, it seemed he cared for her deeply. And yet, under such circumstances, she would betray her own family, give up everything to be a mistress, all for a young man with blond hair?
Put politely, it’s chasing love and freedom, but to put it harshly, it’s being selfish and foolish to the extreme.
And this time, it was clear that Alex had intervened to save Clyde’s life.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 246: The Mandate of Heaven Template, Will’s True Body_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Chapter 246: The Mandate of Heaven Template, Will’s True Body_3
Clyde didn’t know the person he was collaborating with was Blood God Acunus, but when he chose to challenge Jack Clark and got involved in this incident, he was branded.
By that time, no matter how much of a genius this person was, Jack Clark was prepared to slay and shatter him.
However, now with Alex intervening, Clyde’s identity shifted from a ‘Person’ collaborating with an Evil God Sect Cultist to an ‘informer’ cooperating with the Federation to execute their plan.
As for the heavy injuries and disabilities, they are but minor issues to a king- level figure.
Perhaps he harbored the thought of using Jack Clark’s hand to teach his ‘grandson’ a lesson.
However, this guy named Clyde, born into a King’s Family with a mistress as his mother and himself an illegitimate child, initially had average talent until it burst forth after his mother’s ‘death’.
He fused with genes from an unknown high-level alien beast, grasped the grand accomplishment of the Destruction Fist Intent, his realm improved rapidly, and his combat power leaped across a Major Realm.
This time, getting involved in the conflict between the Federation and the Blood God, with the watchful eyes of a king behind him, hiss! This completely fits the template of Heaven’s Chosen Protagonist.
Thinking this through, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Night!
In the room, Jack Clark sat cross-legged, calmly observing the attribute page’s Cultivation Methods section, which showed no change in the Emperor Dragon God Overlord Body.
The Combat Divine Body and the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife he had cultivated before were similar; before touching the ‘Heart’s Eye’ realm, the Cultivation Methods could not be recorded and consequently could not be strengthened.
To break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, cultivators need to condense a complete Rune Illusions in the Sea of Consciousness, while simultaneously having True Strength reach the peak light of the Sixth Layer Heaven.
The light form requires cultivators to unite spirit, Qi, and spirit; only by turning their True Strength into light and fusing it with the Rune Illusions, can one condense the true martial arts phantom.
Otherwise, without the light-fused Rune Illusions, it is merely a mass of Power of Will and not the ‘True Martial’ that contains the essence of the cultivator.
Therefore, if Jack Clark wants to use Attribute points to strengthen, he needs to fully manifest the ‘shell’ of the Combat Divine Body in the Sea of Consciousness, so that the attribute page can record the Cultivation Methods before strengthening.
He estimates that this process will take about four to five days to complete.
Condensing these Rune Illusions is different from the secret space where the realm of thought instantly manifests illusions; it requires the Spiritual Will to materialize them gradually.
And the Seventh Layer Combat Divine Body involves tens of thousands of rune chains with incredibly complex structures; typical cultivators need at least two to three years to consolidate them.
This is also why people like Lori Parma, who was once a ‘genius’, got stuck at the peak of the Sixth Heavens for several years until Koroya Reverse Defeating the Seventh Heaven Church and unifying spirit, Qi, and spirit to make a breakthrough.
After the steps of cultivating the Combat Divine Body flashed through his mind, Jack Clark’s thought moved, and instantly, the Divine Imperial Dragon Rune rotating slowly at the center of his dantian vibrated.
Under Jack Clark’s powerful Power of Will, the complete rune penetrated ‘Heaven and Earth’, entered the Sea of Consciousness, and then crashed directly into the mutated Dragon Elephant Phantom.
Boom!
Under the impact of the Divine Imperial Dragon Rune, the Dragon Elephant Phantom made of Spiritual Will dissolved.
This dissolved Will turned into a cloud of silver, encircling the rune under Jack Clark’s mental command, beginning to condense from nothingness little by little.
Soon, a thirty-meter-tall translucent phantom emerged.
Of course, this is just a phantom made purely of the Power of Will; next, it had to be ‘drawn’ out bit by bit.
No sooner had this phantom appeared than the Blade of Void Cutting Rune, which had been integrated into the eyebrow of the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Shadow, reappeared, imprinting on the eyebrow of the Combat Divine Body phantom.
It resembled an additional black eye shaped like a knife or a rune.
Instantly, Jack Clark couldn’t help but be startled.
Why does this rune, which is condensed by the power of mental strength, seem to favor the position between the brows?
However, this ‘eye’ merged very naturally with the War Body Phantom, and after perceiving no conflict, Jack no longer paid it any mind.
There was no other way, as he too was groping his way across the river in creating this Secret Book.
The next morning, Jack slowly opened his eyes, a heavy sense of oppression spreading through his body.
As Rune Illusions began to consolidate, the Combat Divine Body’s influence on him had already started, although it was only on the level of spiritual will for now.
But when Jack arrived at the dining room, Damon Lopes spat out the milk in his mouth and exclaimed in shock, “Holy shit, Brother Callum, you, you’ve made another breakthrough?”
In Damon’s Innate Eye, Jack, who originally resembled an aggressive dragon beast, naturally attracted and accumulated the surrounding Heavenly Energy as he walked.
Jack replied calmly, “I have deduced the seventh layer of my Secret Book; I practiced a bit last night, so there’s some gain.”
“…Monster,” Damon swallowed.
Creating a top-tier Secret Book in a month, that was even more freakish than him, an Innate Awakened One, not to mention this guy’s monstrous cultivation speed…
Suddenly, chatting with beauties seemed less appealing to Damon.
While he chatted up beauties, they were hard at work cultivating, progressing faster and faster, to the extent that he felt he could hardly keep up.
No, I must commit to cultivation; otherwise, if this guy surpasses me by a lot, it would be too embarrassing. After all, I am an Innate Awakened One, the future Damon Lopes, the Heavenly King.
Having made his resolution, Damon began to eat his breakfast with dedication.
But at that moment, Damon’s mobile phone on the table rang – – someone sent him a message. Lopes then subconsciously opened his phone.
His eyes lit up.
Sitting down for breakfast, Jack’s glance swept away momentarily, and he naturally diverted his eyes from those nearly nude pictures.
Just then, Jack’s gaze froze, and most of his attention shifted to the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Below the dark sea, a black-red fearsome Giant Beast stood upright, its body enwreathed in golden flames which illuminated hundreds of meters of the seabed with light and heat.
In the distance, a hundred and ten meters long beast, akin to a Western Dragon but without wings, stood on all fours, its back covered in sharp spikes, emitting the terrifying pressure of a peak of the eighth level.
But now, the eighth level Beast with Dragon Bloodline was staring intently at the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, as if facing a formidable foe.
Observing the dragon creature, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast let out a deep roar: “Although the king here predicted that ‘person’ would come to investigate, I did not expect to actually run into one.”
“Since you’ve come, then die.”
Boom!
The earth shook, and dazzling golden light burst forth, making the surrounding sea water boil and form raging hot shockwaves that swept for thousands of meters.
Within the muddy and violent currents, the menacing figure of the black-red Giant Beast emerged, its right claw clutching the remains of a dragon corpse, exuding an extremely vicious aura.
In front of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast at this moment, the Level 8 Mutated Creatures were almost no match.
Even with its Dragon Bloodline, under the strike of swift and Strength Talent combined with the Golden Flame Core Explosion, its domain instantly collapsed, its head exploded.
Now, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was in a good mood because in the new sharkskin pouch tucked in the crevices of its neck scales, there was one more Level 8 Life Crystal.

chapters.title: Chapter 511: 247: Breakthrough Monarch Giant
chapters.content:
Beast, Taking Control of the Storm Thunder (Seeking Monthly Pass)
Several hours later, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast returned to the Dragon
Palace. As for the Eighth-Level Giant Dragon, it had been devoured on the way, providing it with some Evolution value and energy.
Gurgle, gurgle!! Great King, you’re back, Great King-
Boom!
With a swipe of its claw, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast blasted the seawater, creating a powerful vacuum shock that sent the Blue Giant Crab flying, interrupting its ‘bootlicking1 that was about to begin.
This thing repeats the same phrase day in and day out, no novelty at all; my ears are tired of hearing it.
Atop the Ice Crystal Palace, the Silver Giant Dragon, watching the
Thunderflame Emperor Beast emerging from the sea, roared excitedly:
“Hegemon, you’ve finally returned.”
Roar, roar! Thunderflame, crystals are hard to find.
Roar, roar!! Even Joe didn’t catch many this time.
Watching the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle felt somewhat embarrassed, as they had only about twenty Life Crystals to show in front of it.
And these crystals were mainly Third and Fourth Level, with only a few of the
Fifth Level.
There was no choice; the original territory had already been scoured twice, and the area surrounding the Water and FireWorld over a thousand kilometers in radius had also been plowed through a few days ago.
In such circumstances, managing to get so many crystals in three days was already a great effort.
Kidora, with an aura of bloodlust, stirred its nine dragon heads and growled incoherently: “Roar, roar, roar!! Kido, smart, went further, caught two back.”
As it spoke, all nine dragon heads of the Black Dragon displayed a proud expression.
Lying beneath its ice platform were the corpses of two Giant Beasts at the Peak of Level 7, although the bodies were badly mangled from battle.
On the Ice Platform, the Silver Giant Dragon slightly lifted its head, roaring with pride.
” Roar! You two fools, Overlord Joe, only know how to catch one by one, not realizing you can herd a large number of ordinary Extraordinary Creatures together, then pick them off slowly.”
In front of the Silver Giant Dragon lay a small pile of Life Crystals, and although most of them were Third Level and some Second Level, the quantity added up to over seventy.
“Roar! Everyone has worked hard, crystals are hard to find this time, it s not your fault.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast roared in satisfaction: “Now that we have these crystals, I should be able to push one Talent to its limit, maybe even breakthrough the bloodline constraints.”
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up, and it roared excitedly: “Abbott, so that is why your bloodline has been enhancing so rapidly.
It had always been curious about the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s rapid improvement of its bloodline, and surprisingly, it was because of these Life Crystals.
No wonder the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had asked them to collect a large number of crystals beforehand.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast gave it a peculiar look, fully aware of what the Silver Giant Dragon was thinking, and roared: “Indeed, the bloodline Evolution I’ve been going through recently is related to these crystals.”
“Or rather, it’s related to my Talent.”
“I possess a Talent that can burn the Life Energy contained in these crystals, converting it to ‘enlightenment,1 helping me quickly comprehend the mysteries of my own power.”
“For example, the runes I taught you before came from my ‘contemplation’.”
“As entering this state is very draining of one’s Life Energy every time, I need a large number of Life Crystals to replenish it, or else I would be significantly weakened.”
Now that it came up today, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast just went with the flow and attributed its bloodline Evolution to its Talent.
Especially the reason for its massive need for Life Crystals was also attributed to this explanation, so that it wouldn’t need to look for reasons to explain later.
After all, these Giant Beasts are simple but not stupid.
Every time it obtained a large number of Life Crystals, its strength and bloodline would surge dramatically; a few more times and even a pig would know that its changes were related to the crystals.
Roar, roar, roar!! Such an awesome Talent, Joe wants it too. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes showed intense envy, and it stirred up massive sea waves with a slap of its tail in the water.
Roar, roar!! Joe, don’t dream about it, that’s Thunderflame’s Talent, do you understand what Talent is?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle disdainfully looked at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with an expression that screamed, how can you be so dumb.
“Roar! To think it’s your Talent, Hegemon.” The Silver Giant Dragon felt somewhat disappointed; it had been pondering how to trick (seduce) the Thunderflame Emperor Beast earlier.
But turns out it was an innate Talent Ability.
The crystals are sufficient, now it’s just a matter of waiting for nightfall on Jack Clark’s side.
The busy day quickly passed.
No matter the turmoil outside, shortly after eight o’clockin the evening, when Mathilda Ward went back to rest, Jack Clark also returned to his room.
He closed the door, drew the curtains, and shed his outer garment.
Then, Jack Clark took a deep breath, the True Dragon Power within him circulated, activating the golden red space rune on his arm.
Whirr! Accompanied by the flashing of golden red Radiance, strong Spatial Fluctuations spread out, quickly being located by the distant end.
At the mouth of the volcano, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s head with its feather horns shone bright with silver light, the Firelight igniting to form a majestic and sacred Flame Crown.
In the center of the crown, a Silver Vortex appeared, connecting both places.
Roar!
With a low roar, the Life Crystals under the Thunderflame Emperor Beast were lifted by an Invisible Power, like a string of glittering pearls swiftly passing through the pathway and disappearing.
Once all the Life Crystals had vanished, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast slowly closed the connection.
Compared to the weakness at the beginning of the pathway’s creation, the Giant Beast, now at the Late Stage of Level 8, merely gasped slightly, then its eyes showed anticipation.
In the room, after a short rest, Jack Clark picked up a head-sized crystal radiating boundless Life Energy and an inner voice reverberated in his mind.
“Attribute points conversion.”
Silently, the Life Energy within the crystal rapidly ebbed away, transforming in the blink of an eye into another form of energy that disappeared into Jack Clark’s body.
“You have converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal and obtained 4021 attribute points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 512: 247: Breakthrough Monarch Giant Beast, Taking Control of the Storm Thunder (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
So many, eyeing the soaring attribute points on the attribute page, Jack Clark’s eyes flashed with excitement as he picked up a level 5 crystal.
However, there were only three high-level crystals this time, the majority were level 3 and 4, a portion were level 2, and there were eight level 5s.
After all the Life Crystals were transformed into attributes, plus the over 1,000 points he had left over, the page showed a total of 12,103 attribute points.
Ever since the pathway between the Giant Beast Avatar and his original body was opened, life crystals, which used to be precious to Jack Clark, began to be harvested in piles.
Every transformation meant tens of thousands of attribute points, making him feel somewhat unreal.
Hu!
Jack Clark exhaled, looked at the attribute page where the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s Golden Flame and Thunder Talents were located, and considered which one to strengthen first this time?
This time his goal was to reach Monarch-Level life potential, to kill that mid­phase King-level ninth-tier giant beast, so he should prioritize enhancing the talent that would most significantly increase combat power.
Compared to Golden Flame, thunder actually has greater power in water.
It’s just that the Thunder talent awakened by the Thunderflame Emperor Beast is more like a domain, so the damage doesn’t seem very exaggerated.
However, whether it’s Thunder or Golden Flame, next time both will be enhanced to top-tier, so after a brief consideration, Jack Clark’s gazed landed on the Thunder Talent.
“Consume 10,000 attribute points to enhance Thunder.”
Accompanying Jack Clark’s command, a flood-like surge of enhancement energy traveled through the Soul Channel and into the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body.
In an instant the three rows of Dorsal Fins on the back of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast lit up, blue radiance stretched from the back of the head to the tail tip, crackling with lightning bolts.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Thick blue lightning boomed, shaking the earth, exploding magma, forming a Thunderstorm Domain covering a 300-meter radius centered on the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Roar!
A deep and majestic roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, and in an instant, an aura that was ancient, desolate, godly yet extremely vicious rose to the sky.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The entire small-world’s Boundary Wall vibrated under the terrifying aura of the Monarch-Level life presence, with air waves tumbling, forming typhoons that swept across Heaven and Earth.
Even the earth itself was shaking, and the volcano behind the Thunderflame Emperor Beast erupted thunderously, a fiery Magma Fire Pillar shooting hundreds of meters into the high altitude.
Immediately after, it turned into countless fiery rains falling from the sky, accompanied by rolling black smoke, as if Doomsday had arrived.
Such a terrifying commotion instantly alarmed the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Beyond that, far away in the water where the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was playfully smacking the Little Tiger Whales into the air with its fins, it too widened its eyes in disbelief towards the distance.
Even the Blue Giant Crab guarding the gate swam over, popping its eyes above the sea surface to look towards the rear of the Ice Crystal Palace.
Ying ying ying!! Thunderflame, has become stronger again.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame’s aura is so perverted, it’s scaring Hegemon here into trembling legs.
The Dragon Turtle stretched its dragon head, looking at the lightning connecting Heaven and Earth in the distance, and the terrifying Monarch-Level pressure, it kept repeating ‘perverted, perverted’ in shock.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, so mighty, so strong.
Under the increasingly strong Monarch pressure, the Blue Giant Crab’s eyes revealed fervent worship, its legs went soft, drifting weakly on the water’s surface, emitting large bubbles from its mouth.
Outside the Dragon Palace Ice Palace, the Silver Giant Dragon showed a look of horror: “Roar! The aura of the Hegemon, something’s not right, this bloodline presence is so strong.”
“Roar! So envious, if only the Great Scythia had that kind of ‘enlightenment’ talent as well.”
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon’s wings trembled, all four limbs, including its tail, softened under the overwhelming Monarch pressure, and it slumped weakly onto the ice.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott, so strong, so exciting.” The Nine-headed Flood Dragon excitedly rolled on the ground, its nine dragon heads emitting chaotic and excited roars.
As for the three Little Mutated Tiger Whales, they were yelping incessantly in the water, shivering under the terrifying Monarch presence, their gazes fearful yet admiring.
Surely, he was the uncle who took their father to fights every day. So powerful.
Among the varied reactions of the Dragon Palace Beasts, the aura on the Thunderflame Emperor Beast became stronger and stronger.
At that moment, a world-shaking change was taking place within its body­bloodline Evolution, gene rearrangement, body shape optimization, scales on its head cracked and even sprouted pairs of horns.
The power of Thunder was also changing, the Talent Rune growing increasingly complex and powerful, resembling a dazzling bolt of lightning.
Moreover, with the life-level leap, other talents had also undergone optimizations and adjustments.
Hum hum hum!!
Feeling the pure Monarch-Level aura from the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the Purple Dragon Egg in the Lava Lake vibrated intensely, sending out faint feelings of joy and affection.
The life transition of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast this time lasted about half a day.
When the dazzling lightning turned blue-purple, and the domain reached 500 meters, the sky full of lightning suddenly paused, then retracting overwhelmingly.
Roar!
An earth-shaking roar exploded as a pair of dragon wings formed entirely from blue-purple lightning, spanning 300 meters, unfolded behind the Thunderflame Emperor Beast. Then, its figure soared into the sky.
Boom!
Under the Thunderbolt Wings, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast plunged down from the sky into the sea, causing a hundred-meter tsunami that flung apart the four Tiger Whales, the Blue Giant Crab, and the Tiger Kingfish.
“Roar! Follow it.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared out, its wings beating as it too thundered into the sea, followed by the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Tiger Kingfish family.
Including the Blue Giant Crab that had reacted, it also burst out of the small world, chasing along the dissipating aura towards the sea surface.

chapters.title: Chapter 513: 247: Breakthrough Monarch Giant Beast, Wielding the Storm Thunder (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Above the sea, dark clouds rolled furiously, and the typhoon howled, raising tsunamis tens to hundreds of meters high that slapped against everything, with resounding lightning flashes sparkling within the dark clouds.
Boom!
The sea surface exploded, and amidst a sky full of water splashes, a ferocious black-red colossal beast surged into the sky with thunderbolt wings forming behind it, stirring up a destructive current of air.
Roar!
Thousands of meters up, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast spread its wings angrily, radiating light that dazzled heaven and earth. Then, it exploded with a bang, forming a ring of electromagnetic shockwaves that swept across the land and sky.
In an instant, the dark clouds turned turbulent, as dazzling bolts of thunder descended from heaven, striking the Thunderflame Emperor Beast frenziedly, as dense as the wrath of Heaven, bringing down the calamity of thunder.
Under the relentless pounding of the thunderstorm, the aura of the
Thunderflame Emperor Beast soared even more terrifyingly, its entire body emitting blinding thunderbolt radiance.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast, surrounded by endless lightning, let out a roar. With a flap of its light wings and sharp horns on its back shooting out blazing streams, it charged into the depths of the dark clouds.
In an instant, the dark clouds churned, and endless charges formed thunderbolts that surged from all directions towards the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, creating a massive thunderstorm cloud in the clouds.
Indistinctly within the thunderstorm cloud, flashes of a dragon’s scales and claws could be seen-resembling the True Dragon of legend that soared through the clouds.
At this moment, beneath the water exploded open, revealing one after another massive silhouettes of colossal beasts that, against the raging wind and storm, all looked upwards towards the sky in awe.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame is so sick, it’s flying, it’s actually flying. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle exclaimed incoherently with excitement.
Roar roar roar!! Abbott is amazing, Kidora wants to fly too.
Amidst the raging storm, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon churned ceaselessly in the sea, its nine dragon heads excitedly raising enormous sea waves as if playfully causing trouble, like a mischievous dragon.
Roar! With a spread of its silver wings, the Silver Giant Dragon lifted out of the waves and soared into the sky.
However, it didn’t rush into the clouds, only circling continuously below the dark clouds, emitting excited roars, “Roar! Hegemon, hurry, come out so we can see.”
Roar!
The dark clouds blasted apart as a 115-meter long, covered in black-red scales, with blue-purple dorsal fins, a ferocious colossal beast roared out, surrounded by streaks of blue-purple thunder light.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, no, it should be called the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, appeared majestic and imposing.
After attaining Emperor level, the form of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast underwent great changes. Its body transformed from originally muscle-bound fierceness to a more harmonious figure, somewhat resembling the Eastern
Divine Dragon.
But starting from part of the body, it still looked strong and powerful. It had a thick neck with four dragon horns, short in front and long at the back, slanting majestically into the firmament. Two red feather horns at its sides made it appear all the more divine.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head, looking down at the Silver Giant Dragon, Tiger Whale, and other colossal beasts below: “Roar! All beasts follow me, let’s take down that group of colossal beasts eyeing the
Dragon Palace.”
In its roar, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast spread its thunderbolt wings and the sharp horns on its back spewed out hot streams as it rode the storm towards the Outer Sea, like the legendary Divine Dragon.
“Roar roar roar!! Kill them all, rob them all, eat them all.”
Roar roar roar!! Follow Thunderflame, kill them.
This time, everyone in the Dragon Palace was on the move, including the Blue Giant Crab which had grown to 29 meters, drawing near Level 7, the three ‘little’ Tiger Whales, and the Female Tiger Whale that was more than 50 meters long.
And just as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was leading a large group of colossal beasts to start a major battle of giant beast power, in the room, Jack slowly opened his eyes.
At this moment, the gold on the edge of his black pupils occupied more space, and the inner layer of black gold vertical pupils exuded the majesty of a True Dragon, solidifying the space at a glance.
At this time, the aura on Jack also became extremely terrifying.
This leap of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast to the Emperor level brought substantial feedback to the main body as well.
This feedback wasn’t just an increase in attributes but also included some miraculous changes that occurred in the True Dragon Blood that had merged into the flesh as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon became Emperor level.
Feeling the power in his body that could blast everything apart, Jack called out the attribute page with a thought.
Realm: Sixth-layer Heaven [Mid Period]
Physique: 2632—2810
Strength: 2955—3107
Agility: 2138—2295
Spirit: 2050—2186
Talent: Soul Split + [Top-tier, Emperor Protection, the special ability derived from body-based soul evolution upon receiving soul-based attacks activates Emperor Divine Might and shatters the enemy]
Void Double Pupils* [Senior]
Cultivation Methods: Sacred Emperor Dragon Tyrant Body [Limit Break, Traits: True Strength materialization, True Dragon Shatter, Divine Might Entwining, Emperor Dragon Physique] Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd [Limit Break] Runes: Blood Sea Purgatory [Complete] Hidden Deity [Complete] Divine Might Emperor Dragon [Complete] Cut through the Void [Incomplete] Realm of thought: Prison Blood Battle Intent [Bathed in blood, reflecting hell]
Attribute points: 2103
Equipment: Dragon Blood Battle Armor-
Avatar Body: Ancient Thunderflame Emperor Dragon
Level: Ancient Beast [An Emperor-level gigantic beast with four top-tier talents and three advanced talents]
Physique talent: Strength* [Top-tier] Defense* [Top-tier] Agility* [Top-tier] Regeneration* [Senior] Toxin* [Senior]
Transcendent Talent: Golden Flame* [Senior] Annihilation True Thunder* [Top Tier, evolved to the pinnacle of Thunderbolt Power, capable of forming a destructive Thunderstorm Domain upon bursting]
Ability: The Thunderstorm Domain, when dispersed, can form a 15-kilometer range electromagnetic field of lightning, controlling the atmosphere and influencing storms, commanding the wind and rain.
Ability: Destructive Thunder Rings, nine talent-infused thunder rings formed outside the body, absorb personal lightning and heavenly thunder power to transform into destructive light beams, annihilating everything.
Note, the potency of the destructive light beam will be significantly enhanced when infused with other forces.
Ability: When the Thunderstorm Domain is deployed, it can form a powerful magnetic levitation field or transform into Thunderbolt Wings for flight, controlling the magnetic field]
Evolution value: 25100/30000
“…So strong.” After reading the note behind the top-tier Thunder Talent, Jack Clark exhaled slowly and suppressed the excitement in his heart.
Compared with the top-tier talents for the physique, the elemental talents of the natural class demonstrate mythical levels of power when enhanced to the
top tier.
Creating an electromagnetic field to manipulate storms and mists or transforming into Thunder Wings to soar into the sky turns mythical legend into reality.
Besides, the power of the Thunderstorm Domain formed by the single Thunder Power is comparable to the domains of Level 9 Giant Beasts, capable of crushing and annihilating everything.
This is the reason conventional weapons are ineffective against Level 9 Giant Beasts.
How does it matter if you have numerous missiles? They explode due to the beasts’ power as soon as they enter the domain.
In such scenarios except for nuclear bombs, even large-caliber missile explosions a few hundred meters away cannot shake the terrifyingly tough bodies of the beasts.
The first Furious Ape that appeared decades ago, a Level 9 Giant Beast, wreaked havoc on the East Capital.
Eventually, after many rounds of missile and fighter aircraft bombardment, coupled with the lack of heavenly energy on Blue Star to recover, the beast’s energy was vastly depleted. Only then was it finished off with a massive nuclear bomb.
But now, as the heavenly energy of Blue Star thickens, this method of dealing with Level 9 Giant Beasts has become ineffective, necessitating high-end individual destruction weapons.
However powerful the beasts may be, human technology is becoming increasingly stronger, especially some weapons with extreme destructive power.
After reviewing the data for Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark felt eager about the upcoming enhancement of the Avatar’s Golden Flame Talent.
Unexpectedly, this type of elemental talent undergoes such significant changes when it reaches top tier.
And about his Void Double Pupils, it’s unknown what will happen after the enhancement to the top tier-could it be tearing the Void with a glance or banishing enemies with a look?
Lost in thought, jack Clark’s gaze fell upon the attribute changes above.
His four major attributes surged by about 150 points, with his strongest strength breaking through 3000. The Cultivation Methods changed under the influence of Dragon Power, and even the notes have become more detailed.
Beyond that, there was a new note about the Emperor Dragon Physique. “Emperor Dragon Physique.” With a thoughtful look, Jack stretched out his right hand and, with a thought, activated the Dragon Power inside his body. Instantly, a layer of black-red Dragon Scales surfaced on his arm.
This scene was similar to Clyde when he entered half-beast form. However, the black-red Dragon Scales on Jack’s body were made of energy and could layer with battle armor.
With the True Dragon Power’s external amplification, Jack’s defense would reach a terrifying level, making him nearly impenetrable to same-level cultivators standing there.

chapters.title: Chapter 514: 248: The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, A Destructive Strike That Pierces Through Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Chapter 248: The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, A Destructive Strike That Pierces Through Heaven and Earth
The storm roared over the dark sea, raising waves more than dozens of meters high that battered everything.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon unfolded its thunderstorm magnetic field to control the eye of the storm, like a divine dragon that summons wind and rain, driving the typhoon covering hundreds of kilometers at high speed.
Below, on the sea surface, a nine-headed flood dragon stretched over one hundred and fifty meters long, a massive black and white Tiger Whale, and a brown Dragon Turtle the size of a small hill.
All three giant beasts had unleashed their domains, with ice and fire swirling, black and white alternating, and yellow shockwaves shattering the sea waves ahead with formidable aura.
Following behind the three giants were a Blue Giant Crab, three Little Tiger Whales nearly thirty meters in length, and a Female Tiger Whale more than 50 meters long, a mighty procession.
In the torrential rain a kilometer high in the sky, a Silver Giant Dragon with a wingspan of two hundred meters circled, occasionally diving into the clouds above and emitting excited, high-pitched roars.
“Roar!! This is the Beast Empire that Great Scythia imagined.”
“Roar Roar!! That fool Torsafi, wait until Great Scythia brings the mighty beast army back, I must beat it up and break its horns.”
“Charge! For Great Scythia to smash those enemies.”
“Roar Roar Roar!! Great Scythia is here.”
The Silver Giant Dragon was extremely excited, agitated, as happy as a child.
Below the clouds, the giant beast covered in black-red scaled armor and sharp spikes had thunderbolt wings shimmering behind it, its sharp horns emitting hot air waves, looking fierce and emanating a commanding and domineering presence.
But when it saw the Silver Giant Dragon flying chaotically below, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon always felt that this guy spoiled the mood.
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings and flew excitedly to the side of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, growling low, “Roar! Hegemon, you must help Scythia beat up Torsafi when the time comes, thrash it hard.”
Within the clouds, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head and roared low, “Who is this Torsafi? What strength does it have?”
“Torsafi is a descendant of another Mythical Creature and grew up with Great Scythia.”
“Though it is somewhat annoying, it has always liked to bully Great Scythia since we were kids, snatch Scythia’s nice things, and even want to be Scythia’s big sister.”
“That guy was actually born six months later than Scythia. Great Scythia is the big sister, but that one is cunning and always wins when Scythia fights it.”
” When Great Scythia said she wanted to leave her territory to venture into the outer world, it even mocked Scythia as a fool. Unforgivable.”
“…Roar! Let’s talk about this later.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was speechless; after all this time, it was just a matter between two little girls. It thought Torsafi was some Level 9 ferocious Giant Beast.
And just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was controlling the storm’s movement, energy detection satellites in space orbit sounded an alarm.
“Report, more than four thousand kilometers off the East Coast, a storm cloud is moving rapidly, with detected biological energy fluctuations exceeding Level 9-”
“More than four thousand kilometers off the East Coast, that sea area has recorded only four Level 9 lifeforms. Could it be ‘that one’?”
“Report, multiple signals of Level 8 Giant Beast energy fluctuations are also detected under the storm, all moving rapidly towards the area inhabited by the Level 9 Giant Beast code-named Mysterious Martial.”
Suddenly a staff member exclaimed in surprise, “That Giant Beast code-named Mysterious Martial is King-level, with the ability to subdue other Unique Beasts.”
“Several observations of that Giant Beast have shown several Senior Beasts surrounding it, forming a basic ‘social’ structure.”
“Could it be a clash between two giant beast powers?” someone said excitedly.
The Colonel on duty commanded gravely, “Keep close watch on the storm movement direction.”
“Yes.”
Due to the slow movement speed of the typhoon, it took until dawn the next day for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, despite its control, to approach the target.
It was an area made up of over a hundred reef rocks and islands, where the sea water churned fiercely, undertows surged, and rich energy permeated between heaven and earth.
The surroundings also had intense spatial fluctuations, with distorted magnetic fields obscuring signals, making that area appear blurred in satellite surveillance.
At that time, at the island center, a Mysterious Martial Giant Beast over two hundred meters long and standing a hundred meters tall even while lying down, took a stand.
Its brown shell was as rough as a small hill, its four claws covered in black­brown scaled armor, its turtle-like head full of scales, and its fanged mouth surrounded by keratin.
Below its jaw hung some ‘whisker’ -like materials, and on its back grew six blue serpent heads, surrounded by substantial black streams, exuding a terrifying aura.
Around the island chains, more than a dozen other beasts occupied the territory, including eleven Level 7 Colossi and three exuding the aura of level eight, among them the Evil Demon Green Python.
And, including the peak of the eighth-level dragon creature that the Thunderflame Emperor Beast had encountered and killed earlier.
This was a rare and very powerful giant beast power, ruled by the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast with a bloodline of ancient creatures.
However, compared to the regal and magnificent palaces of the Dragon Palace, this Mysterious Martial force seemed rather shabby, simply lying in the shallow water or perched on rocks.
They were outdoors with no ‘style’ at all.
But as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast drove the storm within a hundred kilometers of range, that Mysterious Martial Giant Beast suddenly rose and let out a deep, ferocious roar.
Roar!
Under the Monarch’s majestic roar, the other beasts also became alert and stood up, looking at the dark clouds rolling in as if facing a formidable enemy, and they growled low.
As the dark clouds drew nearer, a Monarch-level oppressive force swept over them like a vast sky-covering blanket.

chapters.title: Chapter 515: 248: The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, A Destructive Strike That Pierces Heaven and Earth_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 515: Chapter 248: The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, A Destructive Strike That Pierces Heaven and Earth_2
Even at a distance of over a hundred kilometers, that terrifying aura pressed down on them, instinctively frightening and daunting them, giving them an impulse to kneel and worship.
At this moment, not only the eighth level and seventh level giant beasts, but also the mid-Level 9 Monarch Level Mysterious Martial felt the powerful suppression of a higher bloodline hierarchy.
This was still because the level of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast was only at the late stage of Level 8, approaching the peak of the eighth level.
Otherwise, this Mysterious Martial wouldn’t even be able to harbor thoughts of resistance when facing a peer.
This was the terror of a Monarch-Level Life, a realm that most Mythical Giant Beasts’ bloodlines couldn’t compare with.
Roar!
Watching the rapidly approaching storm clouds, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast let out a series of deep and soaring roars, sending out strong warnings to the creature controlling the storm.
But it had already set its sights on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon; how could it possibly leave, especially when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was coming to kill it?
Watching the vast, dark clouds that showed no sign of departing, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast’s eyes revealed a fierce color, and an overbearing and terrifying aura burst forth from its body.
Boom!
The power explosion of a mid Level 9 Monarch-Level strength caused heaven and earth to change color; the cold wind howled, forming substantial black currents that swept across heaven and earth.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the bursting black currents, the temperature between heaven and earth plummeted; a layer of blue hard ice appeared on the reef rock beneath, followed by frost emerging on the sea surface a kilometer away, freezing it still.
By then, the dark clouds covering hundreds of kilometers had also submerged the reef islands, darkening the sky and earth, with the raging wind howling and the sea waves towering, as if doomsday had descended.
High above in the sky a few kilometers up, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked coldly at the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast tens of kilometers away, with sections of blue radiance lighting up on its back.
Boom! Endless Blue Thunder exploded, with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at the center, forming a hemispherical Thunder Pool with a radius of five hundred meters, where roaring thunderbolts as thick as thighs flashed and snarled.
Hum! Just then, the lightning retracted and converged in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, forming nine thunder rings with diameters ranging from more than a hundred to over two hundred meters, emanating radiance that shone across heaven and earth.
From a distance, the nine consecutive thunder rings connected in front and behind appeared like a complex Rune Matrix.
Boom Boom Boom!!
With the appearance of the thunder rings, the dark clouds roared, lightning flashed, and thunderbolts split down from the depths of the clouds, instantly causing the aura of each thunder ring to surge.
At the same time, flames burned on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body as energy from the Golden Flame converged crazily inside its mouth, spreading a terrifying aura of destruction that frightened all living creatures.
Including the nine-headed Flood Dragons and other giant beasts on the sea surface below, they all felt fear under the terrifying power about to burst forth.
Not to mention the far-off Mysterious Martial Giant Beast and those eighth level and seventh level creatures, all of which let out roars of shock and anger as three eighth level beasts’ domains burst forth with all their might.
At that moment, the largest of the nine thunder rings had already swelled to over three hundred meters, vibrating constantly, with lightning flashing.
After absorbing most of the electric charge energy from the raging storm clouds, the might of the nine thunder rings surged several times, creating a dreadful thunderous fluctuation that even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon struggled to control.
Suddenly, golden light shone from its mouth as the Golden Flame Breath, compressed tenfold, erupted, turning into a scorching Light Beam that shot out, passing through the nine thunder rings.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
With each thunder ring the Golden Flame Breath passed through, its might doubled and expanded further; when it pierced through all nine rings, it had turned into a twenty-meter-thick column of gold and blue Radiance.
In an instant, the world darkened, leaving only the golden light column piercing through heaven and earth, annihilating everything in its path and creating an absolute dark area around it.
At this moment, day and night alternated, with the light column shining amidst rings of energy halos encircling it.
Simultaneously, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast also let out angry roars, the breath from the python heads on its back disappeared, blue radiance flashed, and the sea within several kilometers shook violently.
In front of it on the sea surface, columns of water rose to the sky, forming a curtain of water blocking out the sun and sky.
