A barrier of water, a kilometer high and hundreds of meters thick, froze under the black currents in the blink of an eye, becoming a colossal black and blue ice wall spanning several hundred meters.
Like the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon, this Mysterious Martial’s Top-Tier Talent and other talents were all related to water and ice, dominating the Mysterious Hell.
Or rather, this was the common mutation direction for normal marine life, where most talent abilities related to water, whereas Thunderflame Emperor Dragons that channeled either thunder or flame were the oddities.
Boom!
The destructive beam, over twenty meters thick, fell upon the Mysterious Hell ice mountain, instantly shattering the ice mountain made of alloy-strength materials and emitting freezing cold, into a rumbling explosion.
Under the brilliant golden blue Destructive Glow, the ice mountain exploded with a bang, and the light column pierced through everything, enveloping the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast in the absolute dark domain.
Boom! An earth-shattering explosion reverberated through heaven and earth amidst the roaring thunder.
A destructive Light sphere like a nuclear explosion rose from the sea surface, illuminating everything around with boundless light and heat.
The invisible shockwave from the explosion instantly dispersed the dark clouds above the reef island, forming a cloudless Hollow spanning tens of kilometers, encircled by rings of white waves.

chapters.title: Chapter 516: 248: The Mysterious Martial Giant
chapters.content:
Chapter 516: Chapter 248: The Mysterious Martial Giant
Beast, A Destructive Strike That Pierces Heaven and Earth_3
The terrifying explosion even flattened the fluctuations in the space magnetic field, and this scene was immediately captured by closely monitored satellite shooting.
Witnessing the collapse of the reef islands under that apocalyptic explosion, stones thrown into the air, many dissolved into magma from the intense heat before they even landed.
A few Level 7 Colossi that couldn’t evade in time let out roars of terror, then directly had their scales shattered and bodies charred and disintegrated under the blast.
The sea surface also raised a hundred-meter-high tsunami that surged in all directions, with Level 8 and Level 7 Giant Beasts howling in panic within the waves.
Tens of kilometers away on the sea surface, watching that nearly world-ending strike that destroyed the Reef Island Group, Giants Beasts like the Single­horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle all widened their eyes.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame, so perverted.
Roar roar roar!! Just like eating a Super Jingle, so powerful.
Roar roar!! What’s a Super Jingle?
Roar roar roar!! It’s a good thing from Scythia, they say it makes you fierce after eating.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon, excited, rolled wildly in the sea, its nine dragon heads howling in chaos, venting its excited emotions: “Roar roar roar! Ghidorah also wants to become stronger, evolve, Level 9.”
As for the Giant Crab and the Female Tiger Whale and her Little Tiger Whale, they had already been stunned into disbelief by the breath of destruction, just staring agape at the distance.
The Silver Giant Dragon, flying in the sky, was ecstatic, roaring excitedly as it flew not far from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon: “Hegemon, you’re so fierce, do it again, do it again!”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, surrounded by lightning, glanced at the excited Silver Giant Dragon and growled speechlessly: “Roar! No more, I can’t take another hit.”
This strike was terrifying in power, but it consumed half of its thunder and Golden Flame energy, along with almost all the electric charge within a radius of several kilometers.
That was also why it had ridden the storm here, a natural power bank.
At that moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep roar that resonated through Heaven and Earth: “Roar! Leave that Mysterious Martial Giant Beast to me, and kill off the rest of those minions, especially those two Mutated Creatures at the peak of Level 7, leave their Life Crystals.”
With a roar, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast unfurled thunder-wings behind it, and burst forth with searing golden aura, shooting into the Reef Island Group still affected by the explosion’s aftermath, leaving a long trail of light.
Roar roar roar!! Kill them all, take everything, charge!
The excited Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, slapping its double fins, took the lead and charged. Surrounded by the Black and White Domain, its body clad in black and white armor, crashed through the waves explosively.
Roar roar!! Charge, Old man Dominance wants to fight ten of them. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also charged excitedly.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon rode the wind and waves, its nine dragon heads stirring up a chaotic howl: “Roar roar roar!! Ghidorah, with so many heads, wants to fight nine.”
Gurgle gurgle!!
Roar roar roar!!
The Blue Giant Crab and the four Mutated Tiger Whales also followed behind the Giant Beasts, each one incredibly excited, for it was their first time participating in such a grand battle of Giants Beasts.
“Roar! Ghidorah, Dominance, Joe, leave those three level eight Mutated Creatures to you. Great Sethia, with your faster speed, take care of eliminating those level seven Extraordinary Species.”
As the Dragon Palace Dragon King, in this moment the Silver Giant Dragon was spirited, soaring at high altitude and assigning tasks to the charging Extraordinary Giant Beasts below.
After finishing his roar, the Silver Giant Dragon lit up with silver radiance, twisting space in an instant, traversing over ten kilometers from the sky and with a boom plunged into the sea.
Hundreds of meters below the sea surface, a 50-meter-long beast resembling a Dunkleosteus was frantically fleeing.
In the face of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s apocalyptic strike and the invisible aura of emperor-level terror, these giants took advantage of the explosive force of the tsunami to escape.
They simply found it impossible to contend with the colossal beast that harnessed the storm and thunder, feeling even a king would lose in battle, so they chose to flee out of respect.
But just then, the water exploded, and a silver figure appeared above the Dunkleosteus at a terrifying speed, a silver dragon claw surrounded by a storm of ice descending from the sky.
Boom!
Beneath the silver dragon claw, the sea water vanished, the protective energy outside the Dunkleosteus collapsed, scales shattered, the skull caved in, and it was instantly killed.
Suddenly, scorching blood surged out, mixing with the violent sea water, spreading for hundreds of meters, painting the surroundings blood-red, emanating a rich scent of blood.
Faced with the mid-level eight Silver Giant Dragon, this mid-level seven Mutant Beast had no power to fight back.
Although the Silver Giant Dragon seemed average at times, that was only when compared to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
As a mid-level eight creature with a king-level bloodline, the Silver Giant Dragon’s combat power was terrifying, thoroughly dominating others of its level in both talent and physical strength.
Only the monstrous Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could fight it to a standstill at the late period of level seven and the early stage of level eight.
After obliterating the Mutant Beast with a single strike, the Silver Giant Dragon soared into the sky, flapping its wings and in the blink of an eye, it burst forth from the sea surface and flew swiftly into the distance.
Meanwhile, the Nine-headed Ghidorah confronted the Evil Demon Green Python; being at the peak of the eighth level, it dominated its opponent in both size and level, as well as talent.
In their clashing domains, the three sturdy black dragon heads let out ferocious roars, tearing through the domain and pouncing on the Evil Demon Green Python with a brutal aura.
Accompanied by the roars of the beasts, a fierce battle erupted, with sea waves reaching the sky.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish confronted a beast that was over 80 meters long, resembling a giant crocodile with a fish tail in its latter half: Old man, Old man, Old man! I recognize you, you were once chased away by the Great Sethia.
Gazing at the somewhat familiar eighth level Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was somewhat surprised.
Roar! In response to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was an angry roar; the surrounding sea surface collapsed around the Beast, forming a vortex imbued with tearing strength and lunging at the Tiger Kingfish.
Boom! Boom! The sea surface exploded under the collision of domains.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s opponent was a 100-meter-long beast with tentacles making up 60 meters and covered in horned sharp spikes, the Abyssal Demon Inscription.
Beneath the domain of Earth and a Crushing Domain, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle charged straight ahead, completely disregarding the overwhelming tentacles raining down from above.
Roar! Roar! Domination—there are ten of you, and your tentacles are just enough in number.
The Blue Giant Crab also took on a level seven early-stage Giant Beast, charging forward with its giant claws, appearing very brave.
Its domineering aura was a stark contrast to its usual sycophantic demeanor.
The Female Tiger Whale, along with three level six ‘Little’ Tiger Whales, circled a massive Beast with a large tentacle on its head.
But before the three Little Tiger Whales could act, the Female Tiger Whale opened its mouth wide, disregarding the energy attack launched from the opponent’s head and bit down ferociously.
Boom! Under the combined talents of Crushing and Devouring Vortex, the mouth of the Female Tiger Whale became like a black hole destroying everything.
It bit through the protective energy field two meters beyond the Beast’s body, shattered scale armor, devoured flesh and blood from half its body, creating a horrific bloody hole where the internal organs wriggled.

chapters.title: Chapter 517: 249: King of Giant Beasts, Level 9 Slumber (Request for Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 517: Chapter 249: King of Giant Beasts, Level 9 Slumber (Request for Monthly Tickets)
Under that strike that penetrated Heaven and Earth, the central island with a diameter of two kilometers collapsed directly, vanishing and forming a massive circular gravel pit, with turbid seawater pouring in.
In the pit with a diameter of a kilometer and a depth of tens of meters, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, wrapped in black ribbon-like air currents, stood somewhat awkwardly.
Half of its small hill-like carapace had cracked, exposing the black crystalline flesh underneath, which was growing and recovering at a visible speed.
Three out of the six, one hundred-meter-long serpents on its back had disappeared, leaving behind only half of their mangled corpses dangling on its back.
Under that blow, which gathered the power of two talents and the energy of Heaven and Earth’s Thunder, even this Mysterious Martial Giant Beast could not withstand it and was severely injured.
However, as a Level 9 Giant Beast, it possessed an extremely terrifying vitality, and this injury only made it even more ferocious and brutal, fixedly staring at the incoming Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Roar!
The enraged Mysterious Martial Giant Beast let out an angry roar, shaking its body, and suddenly the ocean around it surged and water columns soared into the sky.
The seawater turned into hundreds of black ice dragons, each reaching a hundred meters in length, as they silently roared and rushed towards the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in a mighty torrent.
Boom boom boom! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body is covered in black energy, as it smashed tens of black ice dragons into pieces without dodging, looking extremely fierce.
Boom!
At this moment, centered around the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, the sea surface around it erected massive, sharp, black icicles, vibrating Heaven and Earth, like the jaws of a colossal beast clenching shut.
Whoosh! As the Ice Hell closed, with a one-kilometer range, the extreme cold power burst forth, freezing everything inside the range, including space itself, into black air currents.
In that nearly still Frost World, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stood up, with golden flames burning within a range of tens of meters around it, continuously colliding and bursting with the extreme cold domain.
The top-tier talent this Mysterious Martial Giant Beast possessed was quite terrifying, freezing everything, even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Golden Flame Domain was squeezed to one-tenth of its size.
Seeing its domain being continuously suppressed, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast revealed a cruel and frigid look in its eyes, as the black energy gathered in the mouths of the remaining three serpents on its back.
Immediately, the golden flames on the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s body shrank, followed by the eruption of endless blue-violet Thunder.
Boom, boom, boom! The Destruction Thunderstorm Domain and the surrounding extreme cold power that had frozen the “time-space” around it repeatedly detonated and shattered, as endless lightning exploded in all directions.
In the midst of the annihilating lightning, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s silhouette suddenly disappeared.
At the instant the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon disappeared, three Extreme Cold Breaths froze the afterimage, falling onto the sea’s surface more than a thousand meters away, instantly creating three circular areas with a diameter of over a hundred meters and covered in black matter.
Everything in that area was frozen and shattered.
At that moment, a sonic boom echoed as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon reappeared above the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast like teleportation, its right claw clutching a blue spiral light sphere with a diameter of five meters, and it slammed down.
Boom! Under the Hundred-fold Power Claw, the black domain collapsed, and then the compressed Destruction Thunderbolt exploded. Boom! A huge serpent head had only managed to let out a miserable scream before it turned into a rain of flesh and blood.
Roar, roar! Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Beast blew up the serpent’s head, the two serpent heads on the left and right angrily opened their wide mouths and crossed over to bite, instantly crushing its afterimage and colliding with each other.
Bang! The shockwave of pure power exploded, and the two serpent heads screeched in agony as they collided.
Roar!
The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, which had once again lost a serpent head, let out a brutal roar, its eyes becoming almost blood-red, filled with violence, and dazzling blue light radiating from its body.
Boom boom boom!!
The sea roared within a range of several kilometers while columns of water surged up to hundreds of meters, forming a black land and sharp icicles in the blink of an eye.
Thunk, thunk, thunk! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Thunderbolt Wings shone behind it as it broke through more than a dozen black ice pillars and soared into the sky, standing a kilometer high and overlooking the land below.
The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast below was surrounded by countless black icicles varying in length from tens to hundreds of meters, transforming the area around it into the world of ice pillars.
This Mysterious Martial Giant Beast adapted quickly, and upon seeing the terrifying speed of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it directly unleashed its talent to freeze the land and ocean.
Using stillness to respond to all changes, you want to limit my speed and force me into close combat, huh?
Looking at the increasingly thick Frost World below, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes were cold and ferocious.
Roar!
With a roar that shook Heaven and Earth, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spread its wings, emitting a dazzling light, and thunderbolts roared from the dark clouds above, engulfing it.
Boom! Amidst the flickering lightning, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon transformed into a beam of light, descending from the sky.
Boom! Ice crystals within a range of hundreds of meters shattered.
Immediately after that, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast roared, the ground collapsed, and the black domain clashed and collided with the Thunderflame Domain, releasing waves of destructive energy shockwaves.
Boom!
Heaven and Earth trembled, and the pure shockwave of destruction exploded, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon broke thousands of ice crystals, leaving behind a passageway with a hundred-meter diameter that pierced through the Frozen World and slammed into the sea’s surface.
At a distance, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, which had been sent flying by that strike, did not fare well either, as another serpent head on its back was blown up.
Bang! The sea surface exploded, and the thunderstorm-wrapped giant beast once again charged into the frozen zone.
Boom! The Mysterious Martial Giant Beast weighing more than a million tons fell backward, its massive body bringing a mountain tsunami-like wave, as it slammed violently onto the reef island hundreds of meters away.
Instantly, the island collapsed, and debris and seawater exploded everywhere.
Standing in the center of the frozen zone, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils were filled with an icy, fierce, and overbearing terrifying aura.
It was naive to think that these ice crystals could limit its speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 518: 249: King of the Beasts, Level Nine Slumber (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 518: Chapter 249: King of the Beasts, Level Nine Slumber (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_2
Roar!
With an even angrier roar, the sea in the distance fiercely churns, forming a tsunami hundreds of meters high. Standing atop it is the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, its shell even more battered.
Seeing that the ice could not restrain the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this colossal beast is preparing to unleash a tsunami to engulf everything.
Boom! A tsunami as high as a mountain wall collapses, flooding the entire Reef Island Group, followed by an even fiercer battle breaking out.
The ocean freezes, shattering, the ice dragon roars, and thunderbolts continue to fall from the sky, causing the sea to explode continuously, with electric arcs leaping around like a thunder pool.
Boom!
The tsunami surrounding the Reef Island Group suddenly collapses, retreating in all directions with countless small hills of hard ice, revealing the shattered island group, the enormous body of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon radiating a terrifying aura next to it.
Huff Huff!! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exhales hot waves of air, taking a few breaths, recovering from the exhaustion of this battle.
This Mysterious Martial Giant Beast is very strong.
With a thought, it can trigger a tsunami covering a range of more than ten kilometers, freeze an absolute zero degree range within one kilometer, and possess various other talents such as its powerful domain.
This kind of strength stands over the sea, even the Ninth Heaven Peak power of humans can do nothing against it, even lasting in a battle would result in
exhaustion to death.
But facing the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, which possesses four top-tier talents, this colossal beast still could not hold on for long before its skull was blasted and it died.
At this time, other battles have not yet ended; they are still fighting.
Because of their huge size, abundant energy, and strong vitality, even if there is a certain gap in strength in battles of the same level, it takes a long time to determine a winner.
Ending a fight as quickly as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is extremely
rare.
Speed, strength, defense, and the ultimate destructive thunder, in this situation, a monstrous beast that is not as strong as it can’t withstand the onslaught of the storm.
As for the terrifyingly colossal beast that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon can’t defeat, it won’t bother to fight, it will turn around and sprint out tens of kilometers in a flash.
This kind of instantaneous speed would be hard for even a mythical colossal beast to catch up with, unless it’s a fast-moving colossal beast like the mythical
Roc.
Roar!
The first one to finish the battle is the Silver Giant Dragon, its wings flapping fiercely, its double claws clutching a battered Level 7 colossal beast, and throwing it onto the reef island with a thud.
Then the second, third…
Soon, the Silver Giant Dragon brought back the corpses of six Level 7 colossal beasts and stacked them together. It stood proudly on top of the small hill of corpses and roared arrogantly.
“Roar! Hegemon, the Great Sethia is powerful, isn’t she? None of these guys
got away.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared deeply: “Well done, Sethia, you are still as strong as ever, worthy of a strong creature that once fought with me without losing advantage.”
“Roar! Sethia has always been so powerful.” At the praised from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon was so pleased its chin was almost pointing up to the sky.
Indeed, it was the mighty dragon that once fought on par with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Dragon Palace Dragon King.
Today, under its guidance, the Dragon Palace completely annihilated a colossal beast ’empire’. If it tells this to Telsafiwhen it returns, Telsafi would definitely be insanely envious.
After more than half an hour, all the battles ended.
At the same time, without the control of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the violent typhoon moved towards the distance, but there was still a fierce wind on the sea, stirring up waves tens of meters high.
Dragging the corpse of the Level 8 Giant Squid Monster in its mouth, accompanied by the ground shaking, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle climbed onto the reef island. Large amounts of seawater spilled from its body.
Thud! The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle put down the behemoth corpse, roaring excitedly: roar roar!! Thunderflame, I killed one.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at the Giant Squid Monster, which was only left with a bald body, and nodded its ferocious dragon head: “Roar! Not bad, but next time it’d be even better if you can leave some tentacles.”
The tentacles of the squid-type creatures account for half of the body. This guy fought a bit crazily and nearly tore off all the tentacles of this squid.
But this guy wasn’t injured either. Many scales on its four feet and even neck were scratched off by the suckers, exposing the flesh and blood underneath, which was slowly recovering now.
At this time, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also swam over, carrying the corpse of that Level 8 behemoth in its mouth.
Yeay yeay yeay!! I killed one too. They dared to provoke us; they asked for it.
“Roar! Good.”
Then Kido arrived. That Evil Demon Green Python was very cunning. As soon as it felt it was losing, it turned around and ran. Kido chased it a long way before killing that monster.
Kido, with two black dragon heads biting the beast corpse, and seven other heads stirring and making chaotic roars: “Roaar Roaar Roaar!! Kido, invincible, Abbott, you eat.”
Yeay yeay yeay!! King, there’s also this one. The Female Tiger Whale, alongside the three Small Tiger Whales, pushed the corpse of that Level 7 behemoth onto the Reef Island with great effort.
But looking at that monster, which only had a little body left, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was speechless. If it’s like this, you might as well eat it all, why keep a head?
Gurgle Gurgle!! Crab General, mighty.
The Blue Giant Crab, holding the broken behemoth corpse in one large claw, crawled over.
However, compared to other beasts, this guy looked a bit sorry for himself, having lost two legs and one big claw. Clearly, the previous combat was quite fierce.
From the high altitude perspective at this moment, with the beast crowd gathering in the center of the Reef Island Group, corpses scattered all over, the spilled blood tarnishing the surrounding sea red.
With the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Dragon Turtle, the Hawk Kingfish, and other colossal beasts surrounding it, the Black- red Colossal Beast standing upright looks like the King of Beasts, radiating a terrifying oppression.
The battle’s over, and naturally, dividing the spoils of war is up next.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon sprayed a hot wave from its nostrils and mouth, roared deeply: “Everyone did a good job this time, especially with Sethia leading, not a single enemy escaped.”

chapters.title: Chapter 519: 249: The King of the Beasts, Level 9 Hibernation (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 519: Chapter 249: The King of the Beasts, Level 9 Hibernation (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Perched atop a pile of Level 7 Colossus corpses that resembled a small hill, the Silver Giant Dragon lifted its head proudly, eyes gleaming with self­satisfaction, “Roar! The Great Sethia has always been formidable.”
Ignoring the evidently self-contented Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to roar.
“This Level 9 Behemoth has undergone ancestral regression, already possessing the traits of most ancient creatures, its flesh and blood rich with bloodline Life Factors.”
“This Level 9 Behemoth shall be divided according to your ‘contribution’; half will be split into nine parts. Eating it can stimulate your growth and bloodline Evolution.”
“As for the other Giant Beasts’ flesh and blood and the Life Crystal, they belong to this king. Any objections?”
This time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not intend to monopolize the carcass of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast but planned to share half of it with the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragons to strengthen them.
As a Monarch-Level Life form that had evolved, King-level Mysterious Martial Giant Beasts were merely richer flesh and Life Energy for it.
And the three Eighth Level Beasts, the eight Level Seven Beasts, along with half of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast’s flesh were sufficient for it to reach the Peak of the eighth level.
After the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished speaking, all the Giant Beasts paused, stunned.
Roar! Eat, I want to eat meat.
Roar! I want to eat ten.
“Roar! Ten, your head. Go kill ten King-level ninth-tier beasts for me to see,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared as he swung out a claw.
Boom! In an instant, the air exploded, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle shuddered, its massive body directly blasted away by a swipe of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast’s claw.
Bang! Hundreds of meters away, the sea surface exploded.
Lately, this guy’s speech has become more and more nonsensical, wildly using words, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had long been itching to slap it.
Soon enough, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle scurried up from the sea, showing a face full of grievance.
Roar! Thunderflame, you hit me again.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t bother with it and directly moved to the corpse of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast. A dazzling golden light gathered on its right claw, emitting a terrifyingly high temperature.
Sizzle!
Under the brutal tearing of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the massive, hill-sized corpse of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast was split into ten parts, with half for itself and the other half made into nine parts.
Four of these occupied half the flesh and blood, with the remaining five being larger and smaller pieces.
Even the smallest piece measured about ten meters in diameter.
All the other Giant Beasts watched with excitement as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon divided the flesh, even the Silver Giant Dragon appeared somewhat thrilled.
Flesh of a Mid Level 9 King-level Behemoth was helpful even to it; consuming it could significantly enhance and purify certain bloodlines.
Gulugu! “Thank you, Great King, you are so mighty, your glory is invincible across the world, you…” the Blue Giant Crab got excited and jumbled in its speech.
“Roar! Enough,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon interrupted, feeling somewhat headache-inducing.
Roar! I always said it, hanging with Thunderflame guarantees three meals a day. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flapped its Double Fins excitedly, creating rolling sea waves.
Its excitement wasn’t for itself but for its three sons.
Approaching Level 7, if they ate the flesh of this Giant Beast, and considering they were influenced by The Majesty of the Emperor, they might have a great chance of awakening a King-level bloodline.
Then, the three little ones would also become powerful Giant Beasts with some respectable strength.
Roar! The Female Tiger Whales also understood this and nodded repeatedly to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in a slightly excited manner to express gratitude.
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon grabbed a large chunk of flesh and blood and tore into it ferociously, the spurting blood staining half of its body red, making it look all the more fierce.
The other Giant Beasts that received pieces did pretty much the same, devouring their shares with voracious gusto, including the family of Haward Jones by the Seaside.
However, compared to the four Eighth Level Beasts and the Female Tiger Whale, the Blue Giant Crab and the Three-headed Small Tiger Whale struggled a bit with their share, needing to Burst with full strength just to tear off some flesh and blood.
While the other Giant Beasts were consuming the flesh of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grabbed the corpses of two Level 7 Colossus with both claws and began to Devour them heartily.
It wasn’t long before the flesh of six Level Seven Beasts was gone, followed by the three Level Eights, and then the remaining half of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast carcass.
As vast amounts of Giant Beast flesh and blood filled its belly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had already grown to a length of one hundred fifteen meters, began to grow once more. Its muscles swelled, and its scale armor expanded.
When its body length reached one hundred twenty meters, the growth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon halted, though there was still a small half left of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast flesh.
As the Black-red Colossal Beast continued to Devour, its stomach ferociously digesting, waves upon waves of immense biological energy spread within it, absorbed and stored by its cells.
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished eating the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast’s flesh and blood, an intense drowsiness surged forth, similar to the sensation of a previous breakthrough to level eight.
It was about to breakthrough to Level 9.
“Roar! Let’s go, sleep.”
Boom! Boom! Boom!
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon led the way, the sea water exploded. One after another, the Giant Beasts plunged into the ocean and swiftly departed, leaving behind a devastated Reef Group turned into ruins.
As for the island, it had vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 520: 250: Mythical Titan Level, Flood Dragon Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 520: Chapter 250: Mythical Titan Level, Flood Dragon Breakthrough
“It really is that mutated creature, code-named Thunderflame, it’s starting a war with the giant beast power code-named Mysterious Martial.”
Looking at the high-definition photo captured by the fleeting satellite, many faces at the Surveillance Base turned solemn.
Light beams that penetrate Heaven and Earth, pure destructive radiance more powerful than a nuclear explosion, and the black-red ferocious giant beast that stood tall against the firmament at the end.
In addition, the silhouettes of several giant beasts faintly emerging on the sea surface beneath, including a Silver Giant Dragon flying in the sky.
The Colonel on duty looked at the image on the big screen and said with a grave expression, “This mutant beast, code-named Thunderflame, is the most terrifying mutated creature I have seen in these years.”
“Or rather, it is considered the most terrifying mutated creature in the Federation’s records.”
“Its growth from Level 7 to near Level 9 in just three or four months, the terrifying power it had at Level 8 to kill several Level 9 Giant Beasts, its potential is too frightening.”
“Luckily, this mutant beast has never shown any hostility towards humans, and it’s moving towards the Outer Sea, even killing the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast we were hesitating whether or not to clean up.”
“Otherwise, I can’t help but want to apply to the higher-ups, requesting that the energy side Sky Base Satellite and Top Strong collaborate to try to nip it in the bud.”
“Yes, too terrifying.”
“I have a premonition that once this giant beast breaks through to Level 9, it might proceed to the mythical world even before it reaches Level 9 Peak.”
Someone exclaimed in amazement, “With the potential of this Thunderflame creature, its growth speed might become even more terrifying in the mythical world, maybe even reaching Mythical Titan level.”
“Commander, do you think we can send someone to talk to it, like forming an alliance?”
“It’s pointless, the world passageways that mutated creatures pass through are too far from the passageways controlled by the Human Race, or rather, not in the same area at all.”
“A king-level explorer traveled more than three million kilometers, and didn’t find any traces of Level 9 or Mythical-level Giant Beasts that had left.”
Hiss! Suddenly, a staff member sucked in a breath of cold air.
More than three million kilometers, that’s already equivalent to circling Blue Star dozens of times.
From leading the ‘mighty army’ of Giant Beasts to the end of the great battle after a full meal, the line of Giant Beasts returned to the Dragon Palace by evening.
The Great Sun was setting in the west of the sky, the sea surface painted orange-yellow, the sea churned with waves bursting as Nine-headed Flood Dragons, Tiger Fish Dragon Turtles, and three other Giant Beasts flipped the ocean upside down.
Following behind were a ‘small’ Tiger Whale that was thirty meters long, a Female Tiger Whale nearly sixty meters long, and a Blue Giant Crab excitedly waving its giant claws.
At a high altitude, a black-red colossal beast with a length of one hundred and twenty meters flew rapidly, its back releasing hot airwaves as double wings condensed with Thunder glinted.
Surrounding the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a Silver Giant Dragon with a wingspan of two hundred meters circled, occasionally emitting high-pitched roars.
“Roar! Charge, crush everything ahead.”
“Roar! No one can stop the steps of the Great Sethia, Dragon Palace is destined to rise under the leadership of the Great Sethia, to dominate the ocean.”
This time ‘leading’ the Dragon Palace, the Silver Giant Dragon was filled with a sense of achievement, excited all the way till now.
Although in the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this was merely a scuffle between two villages; a ‘Empire’ level conflict was still far off.
In the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a beast power that constituted a giant beast empire should be dominated by Mythical Giant Beasts, with Level 9 Giant Beasts as generals, and Level 7 Colossi as soldiers, numbering over a hundred thousand to be considered Empire-level strength.
Roar! Sethia, great, awesome, frickin’ epic.
Roar!! Sethia is the best, we eat once every three days following you.
Roar! You’re wrong, it should be four meals in three days, one meal every three days is too hungry, that can’t show off Sethia’s awesomeness.
Then the Nine-headed Flood Dragon came over, curiously looking at the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle with its nine massive heads and confusedly growling, “Roar!! What do you mean, awesome, frickin’ epic?”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle boasted with a low roar, “Roar! Awesome, frickin’ epic, is a description, Thunderflame used to say it, it means very impressive and powerful.”
“Roar!! So that’s it, awesome, frickin’ epic.” The Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook its nine heads excitedly, as it learned two new words.
Gurgle gurgle!! Means very impressive, powerful, huh? The Blue Giant Crab behind pondered with a thoughtful look in its eyes.
Hearing the roaring dialogue of the several Giant Beasts below, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon enjoying the flight above maintained a ‘calm’ demeanor, as menacing as ever.
They’re all wild Mutant Beasts with no culture, so swearing and such is quite normal, no need to mind.
As for whether such a big show might be detected by human satellites, it no longer cared.
As its life level reached Monarch level and was about to break through to Level 9, the world of Blue Star posed little threat to it, and even if a human king-level arrived, it could instantly dive into the deep sea and escape.
Moreover, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon believed given the current cautious strategy of humans, they would not initiate an attack on it unless it showed hostility towards humans.
“Roar! We’ve arrived.”
After affirming its home location through magnetic field navigation in its mind, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, its wings folding in as it descended like a crashing fighter jet from the sky.
Boom!
Under the supersonic bombardment of the Silver Giant Dragon, the sea surface instantly exploded, sea water splashing hundreds of meters high, then falling back down like a waterfall.
Then, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fell even faster, turning into a ray of light.
Boom! The sea surface exploded once again, this time even more magnificent and alarming, and the burst’s shockwave upset the stomachs of countless ordinary marine creatures within a kilometer radius.

chapters.title: Chapter 521: 250 Mythical Titan Level, Flood Dragon Breakthrough_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 521: Chapter 250 Mythical Titan Level, Flood Dragon Breakthrough_2
This is how you fry fish.
In a rapid dive, a group of colossal beasts soon submerged into the silent, pitch-black depths over four thousand meters below the sea surface.
Bang! With a torrent of water cascading from the gaps in their scale armor like waterfalls, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stood upon the ice crystal ground. The earth itself trembled under its heavy footsteps.
However, because the swift force field could control its own weight, it did not shatter the earth.
Standing sixty-plus meters tall, the imposing beast loomed before the great hall, its sixty-meter-long sword tail swaying slightly behind, exuding a sense of oppression.
Especially as it was on the verge of hibernating for a breakthrough, a terrifying aura emanated from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, distorting the surrounding void.
Besides the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the other giants also gained a lot from this great battle.
After consuming a large amount of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast’s flesh and blood, the Silver Giant Dragon’s size exploded by several meters, reaching an impressive ninety-two meters, approaching the late stage of level eight.
And the energy fluctuations on its body were intense; most of the ‘nutrition’ it had consumed had not yet been transformed.
There was no helping it; the flesh and blood of a King-level ninth-tier in mid­phase beast contained an exceedingly rich energy.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had similar expansions, their sizes increasing dramatically by a few meters, their bodies emanating intense energy vibrations, as they were set to enter a brief period of growth.
They were not like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, able to rapidly transform the flesh and blood of a giant beast into biological energy, absorb it, and grow.
The already Peak of the eighth level Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s aura was even more volatile and chaotic, letting out a disordered roar, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, Kidora, must sleep, going to sleep.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep, resonant growl, “Roar! Go ahead, when you awaken this time, you’ll be a Level 9 Giant Beast.”
In addition to the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the three sons of the Single­horned Tiger Kingfish, close to the Level 6 Peak, also reaped immense benefits from this battle, poised for a breakthrough after consuming the flesh and blood of the Mysterious Martial.
The already Late Level 7 Female Tiger Whale Kitty Jones should come close to the Level 7 Peak once she digests the flesh and blood energy.
Even the Blue Giant Crab gained significantly, expected to grow to its late period soon.
It just looked somewhat comical, with one half-grown pair of small legs and tiny claws.
Sweeping his gaze over all the beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled deeply, “I will also hibernate for a while; if there’s anything, seek Great Sethia.”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish excitedly patted its double fins, chirping, “Yingyingying!! Go ahead Thunderflame, become stronger after awakening, and lead us to more good things.”
Roar roar!! Domination also needs cultivation, to become very strong. I want to fight ten at a time.”
Watching the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle stretching its neck and roaring about fighting ten, the other giant beasts looked on, bemused.
You struggled so much to fight a single mid-Phase Level 8 Giant Beast, battling for half an hour before defeating it, and now you have the gall to fight ten?
The Silver Giant Dragon stepped forward ‘elegantly’, two steps forward, standing on the steps, and roared at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, “You go ahead; the Dragon Palace is under the watchful eye of the Great Sethia.”
But after speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon had a sense that something was amiss.
The Great Sethia was supposed to be the Big Dragon King, so why did it feel like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was the one in charge, while it seemed merely like a steward?
While the Silver Giant Dragon was questioning itself, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled deeply, “I’ve had another evolution of my bloodline this time, and I can help stimulate your bloodlines once more.”
Roar roar!! Thunderflame, awesome, I want, I want. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle immediately let out an excited roar.
It was well aware of the benefits of bloodline stimulation. The last time the
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stimulated their bloodlines, they had a breakthrough to level eight, soaring in strength.
Now having comprehended deeper layers of bloodline power, their perception of their own innate abilities had deepened, allowing them to unleash even more powerful might.
It wasn’t just the Dragon Turtle; the Tiger Kingfish and others were also ecstatic, including the Silver Giant Dragon, whose eyes were full of anticipation.
The Thunderflame Emperor Beast growled low, “This is the last chance. I hope you use it when breaking through levels, as the effect will be best then.”
“Only Kidora, Tiger One, Tiger Two, Tiger Three have reached the breakthrough threshold this time; the rest of you should wait.”
Yingyingying!! Listen to Thunderflame, it’s smarter.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at Kidora, then turned to the excitedly thrashing three-headed ‘small’ Tiger Whales in the water, each thirty meters long.
Boom!
With the formidable might of the Emperor Dragon erupting completely, a boundless oppressive force descended from the heavens, the sea surface caved in, and the consciousness of the three-headed small Tiger Whales roared as their bloodlines boiled.
Woo woo woo!! Amid the deafening blare resembling a steam whistle, with the bloodline power drawn by the might of the Emperor Dragon, the three-headed small Tiger Whales slowly sank to the seabed.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon on the other side also let out fierce and terrifying roars, an ancient aura being stirred within it, causing terrorizing shadows to fleetingly pass behind it.
Nine dragon heads blotted out the sky, and its massive body coiled majestically like mountains, fearsome and astonishing.
After letting out a series of roars, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon settled into a coiled position, all nine heads closing their eyes and falling into slumber, their auras becoming obscure and oppressive.
Yingyingying!! Thank you, thank you, Great King. The Female Tiger Whale nodded repeatedly in gratitude.
Having already been stimulated once before, and now having consumed a substantial amount of blood from a monarch Level 9 beast, plus the recent impelling by the might of the Emperor Dragon.
Under such circumstances, it was almost certain to awaken a king-level bloodline, undergo a throwback, and awaken stronger innate talents.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was also somewhat excited, sidling up to the Female Tiger Whale and patting its back with its fin-like wings, emitting triumphant chirps.
Ying ying ying!! This is what brothers do, sharing the good stuff, wiping out and plundering together.

chapters.title: Chapter 522: 250: Flood Dragon Breakthrough - Mythical Titan Level_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 522: Chapter 250: Flood Dragon Breakthrough – Mythical Titan Level_3
…Why has this fellow become more and more like a bandit?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook its head, “Roar! All right, I’m going into hibernation.”
But there is one more thing to do before hibernation.
With heavy steps, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon crossed the palace to the Lava Lake behind it, its massive body stirring up rolling waves of scorching magma to come before the purple Dragon Egg.
Because it was stuck at the peak of the eighth level, it had accumulated a lot of ‘energy’ in its body, enough to share a portion of Essence Blood with the Dragon Egg without affecting its upcoming breakthrough.
Buzz! The moment the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gently held the Dragon Egg in its hand, the egg vibrated with a humming sound, conveying a faint sense of joy and happiness.
“Roar! Eat,” it growled.
The low growl coincided with the gathering of pure Life Energy from within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, greedily absorbed by the purple Dragon Egg. Under the influence of the pure Emperor Dragon Life Force, the life aura of the purple Dragon Egg kept increasing, the effect far surpassing previous attempts. As the life aura thrived, wisps of purple emanated from the Dragon Egg, forming pure purple Source of Life which made the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon pause slightly.
For it had just realized that these surges of Source of Life might not be an issue with the purple Dragon Egg, but could actually be its ‘Gifted Power.’
Compared to the combat-enhancing talents of the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, the abilities possessed by the Monarch-Level Life nurtured by this egg seemed more like Creation.
Bestowing Creation upon other lives.
But this talent was beyond its control; each instinctual circulation would consume its life force, which should be the real reason for the egg’s continuous weakness.
After thinking it over, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon put down the egg, which was emitting an emotion of joyful attachment, “Roar! I am going into hibernation now; you stay here and behave.”
As it spoke, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s claw exerted a suction force, gathering the Source of Life that had congregated around the purple Dragon Egg into its claw.
Back at the mouth of the volcano, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, fighting off drowsiness, waited another two hours, then the silver runes on its feather horns shone.
At the same time, in the hotel room where Jack Clark had been waiting, a golden red light emerged on his arm.
Buzz!
As a Spatial Channel opened, a small black bottle appeared at the mouth of the volcano. Under the force of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s will, the purple substance was sealed inside it.
Once the bottle containing the Emperor-Level Dragon Life Origin Substance disappeared, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon closed the pathway, its aura remaining strong and majestic, without the slightest impact.
At this point, it was more than capable of sustaining such a vast Spatial Channel.
It wasn’t until all matters were settled that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared and plunged into the volcano’s mouth, instantly causing the magma to explode and the flames to burn wildly.
In the searing magma, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to dive deeper, five hundred meters, one thousand meters, three thousand meters…
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon went deeper, the surrounding magma grew hotter, especially the invisible, immense pressure from the Earth, which was dozens of times greater than that of sea water.
When it reached nearly ten thousand meters deep into the volcano, the magma around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had turned into a dazzling golden color, tumultuously boiling and emitting fiery high temperatures.
In fact, the temperature of the magma here was only around two thousand degrees Celsius, not much higher than what erupted on the surface.
But because of venturing deep underground, what’s even more terrifying here is the horrifying pressure that can transform substances into diamonds, squeezing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon from all directions.
“Roar! Comfortable.”
Showing a human-like expression of comfort on its face, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly closed its eyes, its massive body sprawled over an outcropping of black-gold rock and fell into hibernation.
A Giant Beast’s breakthrough to Level 9 is different from breaking through to Level 8. Level 8 is the process of the manifestation and consolidation of innate talent.
Whereas Level 9 involves the fusion of flesh, spirit, will, domain, and talent into one, everything integrating into a small world.
In such a case, the Giant Beast’s physical body would undergo a transformative growth, making both its body and innate powers even stronger.
For example, the Mysterious Martial Giant Tortoise, when it unleashes its talent at full strength, can affect an area of several kilometers, freezing everything, its strength as vast and endless as the ocean.
And all of this is in preparation for the breakthrough to Mythical-level, readying the talent for the promotion of rules.
Huff huff!! As it slumbered, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exuded a strong suction force, with the scorching energy contained in the surrounding magma crazily flowing towards it.
Its terrifying physical body, comparable to dozens of its peers at the Eighth Level, was like a black hole, devouring all the energy around it.
While the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was in hibernation, Jack Clark also felt some effects, as half of his consciousness became somewhat groggy, on the brink of sleepiness.
Jack Clark, holding a blackbottle, shook his head to suppress the intense sleepiness and then focused his gaze on the Source of Life within his grasp.
He wondered if he could absorb the Life Energy of an Emperor-Level Dragon species.
With that thought in mind, Jack Clark slowly opened the bottle, and immediately a terrifying and oppressive aura of life filled the air.
Jack Clark hurriedly unleashed his Spiritual Will to seal the surroundings, enveloping the life aura within.
“Such a strong scent of life energy, but it’s a pity I can’t convert it into Attribute points.” Looking at the bottle full of purple substance and the unresponsive attribute page, Jack Clark felt regretful.
Then after a brief contemplation, he poured a few drops into his mouth.
Boom! Those few drops of life substance exploded within Jack Clark’s body, turning into a wild rush of Life Energy.
The Emperor Dragon Essence Blood within Jack Clark was also activated, transforming into black-red Scaled Armor that covered his entire body, emitting a heavy and fierce aura.
Only when the boiling Qi Blood within him settled down did Jack Clark slowly exhale a breath, a look of regret in his eyes, because such a thing could not be consumed recklessly by ‘humans’.
As an Origin Substance that can promote the bloodline evolution of Extraordinary Creatures above Level 7, the Life Energy contained within the Origin Substance was secondary; the core was the power to incite the evolution of the bloodline.
Humans and Giant Beasts are two different ‘forms of life,’ and consuming such substance is not only ineffective for humans but also a ‘poison.’ Ordinary cultivators would explode and perish immediately upon ingestion.
Jack Clark was unharmed after drinking it because his physique had long undergone a quality transformation, possessing half ‘dragon’ and a faint ‘elephant’ attribute, and the level of his dragon blood had also reached Monarch.
Moreover, precisely because the level of his dragon blood was so high, the Source of Life he had just ingested only made him full of energy and his physical body infused with an even stronger vitality.
And then nothing more.
However, Jack Clark had been mentally prepared for this point, and he did not intend the Source of Life for his own use.

chapters.title: Chapter 523: 251: Condensing the Combat Divine Body, Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough to the Seventh Layer (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 523: Chapter 251: Condensing the Combat Divine Body, Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough to the Seventh Layer (Seeking Monthly Votes)
The next morning.
In the living room, Mathilda Ward looked at the black bottle on the coffee table with a questioning gaze turned towards Jack Clark.
Jack Clark, wearing sunglasses, said calmly, “Back on the Southern Battlefield, I killed a Purgatory Demon named Mikus and seized a storage bag from him.” “Inside were many various things, useful or not, such as Magic Crystals that only the Purgatory Demon Race can use, some High-Order Extraordinary Materials, and the like.”
“I used the useful Transcendent Materials to forge my Battle Armor and weapons, some were exchanged with the school, and aside from those, there was also a piece of jade.”
“The jade was quite peculiar, extremely hard, and even I couldn’t destroy it. It didn’t seem like a Transcendent mineral, yet it emitted a subtle aura, so I kept it.”
“Last night, for some unknown reason, several cracks appeared on the surface of the jade, making it extremely fragile, as if some kind of seal had broken.” “After I shattered the jade, I obtained some special Source of Life, these substances contained very pure Dragon species Life Aura.”
“So, I thought it might be useful for you, considering you possess the ‘Dragon’ Laws’ Origin.”
“…Thank you,” Mathilda Ward’s eyes flashed with emotion.
Jack shook his head, “MissWard, no need for politeness. Whether for personal reasons or in view of the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s contributions to the Human Race, I wish for you to survive.”
Over the past month, Jack Clark had formed a very favorable impression of Mathilda Ward.
This impression was not the affection between a man and a woman, but one of personal admiration.
In the face of her ever-approaching death, nineteen-year-old Mathilda Ward remained calm and composed, even using her own schemes to assist the Federation in luring and killing two Monarchs.
Such breadth of mind and spirit, and such vision, even Jack Clark had profound respect for.
The origin of this Source of Life, as he said, was all attributed to Mikus—after all, many people knew he had obtained a storage bag at that time.
Lately, he had also produced some special Extraordinary Materials for examination, including the Ward Off Evil Crystal Horn, which repels the Demon Clan’s identity.
Under such circumstances, it seemed reasonable for more strange things to emerge from the storage bag, as only Jack Clark knew exactly what was inside.
Of course, whether others believed this reason was their business, but Jack Clark himself believed it.
Overcome with emotion, Mathilda Ward opened the black bottle, and then a pure and terrifying Life Aura spread out, even making her reveal a look of shock.
“Such a pure Dragon species Life Origin Substance.”
In her perception, the Life Aura emitted by this Origin Substance was even ‘purer’ than that of some Mythical Dragons’ Life Energy.
To save her, the Mysterious Martial Sky King had once killed a Mythical Dragon-tvpe Giant Beast and refined its Essence of Life, hence Mathilda Ward was particularly sensitive to this aspect.
Also, there was a stirring from the depths of her soul.
But immediately after, Mathilda Ward sighed lightly and showed regret, “Unfortunately, my injury stems from the soul, and this material that enhances life potential has a negligible effect on me.”
Jack Clark’s brows slightly furrowed, he had not expected that even the Emperor level Dragon species Life Origin Substance would be ineffective for Mathilda Ward’s injuries.
At that moment, her eyes brightened, as if she saw a glimmer of hope, “However, with this Dragon species Life Origin Substance, my chances of revival have increased by ten percent.”
“Revival, ten percent,” Jack Clark’s gaze shifted slightly.
Mathilda Ward nodded lightly, “Given my inevitable demise, my father and some uncles have researched for over a decade and finally came up with a method: Life Transmutation.”
“Since my human soul is fractured, we decided to completely give up on it and use the ‘Dragon’ as the core to reshape the soul form, with the body undergoing transformation in sync.”
“This is akin to how cultivators begin to transform their physique in the early stages of cultivation and slowly influence and change the soul after reaching the Ninth Heavens, only in reverse order.”
“However, the soul is too mysterious, even King-level strong men cannot claim to exhaust its mysteries, let alone my soul, which is already weak.”
“Including the body’s synchronous change and the need to be in sync with the soul’s transformation, the difficulty is high and involves biology, genetics, and even laws.”
“Therefore, even with my father’s decade-plus of preparation and the assistance of some uncles, the current chance of success is only twenty percent.”
“And in academic terms, a twenty percent chance of success is practically indistinguishable from failure.”
“Also, the Life Reversal Ceremony can only be conducted when my soul has weakened to its limit, so my chances of reviving are very low, with a high likelihood of eternal hibernation.”
“But with this Source of Life, I feel the success rate has increased by ten percent, because the level of life contained within this Origin Substance is too high.”
“So high that even the Dragon Divine Soul Source inside me is actively seeking to merge with it.”
Having been involved in the research of her own lifesaving ritual over the years, Mathilda Ward thoroughly understood every required step and necessity.
She was also exceedingly shocked by the level of this Life Origin Substance.
Although there was only a small amount of Origin Substance, it did not matter to her; she had as much life-related resources as she needed. What she lacked was this precious ‘catalyst.’
I thought as much, how could a Heavenly King Level existence not have a backup plan prepared?
In a contemplative mood, Jack Clark’s face showed a faint smile, “If this thing is useful to you, Miss Ward, that’s great. Perhaps you might even achieve rebirth successfully.”
“Brother Callum, this Origin Substance is very important to me, so I will accept it without being polite,” she said.
“I won’t say too much in thanks, but I will prepare a big gift for you as a token of my appreciation later on.”

chapters.title: Chapter 524: 251: Condensing the Combat Divine Body, Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough to the Seventh Layer (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Chapter 251: Condensing the Combat Divine Body, Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough to the Seventh Layer (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
Because her hope for survival had increased a little, Mathilda Ward’s face revealed a smile, and she seemed more relaxed overall.
“…the idea of a payoff doesn’t matter to me.” Jack Clark was not particularly concerned.
After the pathway between the Avatar and the main body opened up, Jack had felt less strained for resources than before, and he had not presented the Dragon Egg Origin Substance in exchange for repayment.
Mathilda Ward shook her head: “I knowyou, Brother Callum, haven’t thought about these things, but it’s different whether I care or not.”
“However, I haven’t yet decided something to give you as a gift, I’ll think about
it later.”
May fifteenth.
On the third day of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s hibernation, during the darkest moment before dawn, Jack Clark, who had cultivated all night, slowly opened his eyes, and within them the illusion of the Three-faced Six­armed figure slowly rotated.
Days of effort had finally paid off, as he completed the superficial construction of the Secret Book, and the Cultivation Methods got recorded in the attribute page.
At this moment, on the attribute page, the Emperor Dragon God Overlord Body had already transformed into the Combat Divine Body, with a’ +’ option also appearing behind it.
“Finally, I can make a breakthrough.”
Jack Clark took a deep breath, his figure flashed leaving the room, and after a few blinks, he was on the hotel rooftop. He found a relatively clean spot and sat down cross-legged.
Then, his gaze lingered on the area behind the Combat Divine Body Skill, and with a single thought: “Use 2,000 Attribute points to strengthen the Combat Divine Body Seventh Layer.”
In comparison to the 300 points for strengthening the Sixth Layer Dragon Elephant Overlord Body and the 800 points for Limit Break, the requirement to strengthen the Seventh Layer Skill had reached a staggering 2,000 points.
That was already equivalent to enhancing an intermediate talent to a Senior level.
And as Jack Clark’s thoughts resonated in his Sea of Consciousness, a row of transparent text materialized before his eyes.
“Traces of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd’s Will detected, would you like to expend 100 Attribute points to integrate the Cultivation Methods?” The Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill could also be integrated! Jack Clark paused for a moment before selecting confirm.
“Integrate.”
As Jack Clark confirmed, the 2,000-plus Attribute points on the Attribute page instantly dropped to 3, and an immense energy forcefully emerged out of nowhere, rushing into his Sea of Consciousness.
Boom! In an instant, consciousness thundered, and countless pieces of information flooded into his mind, plunging Jack instantly into an epiphany state.
in the Sea of Consciousness, as the energy from the attribute conversion surged in, countless rune chains within the Illusions began to coalesce at a pace hundreds, if not thousands, of times faster than Jack’s regular cultivation.
Just then, the Sea of Consciousness shook, and the vision of a Sea of Blood atop a mountain of bodies emerged, reminiscent of Jack’s past insights into the grand accomplishment of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd.
Under the influence of the attribute energy, these will forces transformed into several Rune Sequence Chains and merged into the true martial arts phantom. As the will of the Eight Desolate was integrated, gradually, in the hands of the three-faced six-armed Combat Shadow, a war halberd illusion, several meters long and wrapped in blood, appeared.
The shadow, holding a halberd, stood firm, with four halos rotating behind it, standing amidst the mountains of bodies and sea of blood, like a true War King bound to suppress Hell, majestic and holy.
Meanwhile, the True Dragon Power within Jack’s body was also circulating on its own amidst the epiphany state, swelling rapidly and soon approaching the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage.
Boom!
In a hotel room on the other side of Mathilda Ward’s suite, as he slept, Damon Lopes suddenly sat up from bed.
“Late Sixth Heavenly Stage!!”
Damon Lopes looked towards the rooftop, sensing that familiar yet much more potent heavy aura; his face showed uncontrollable shock.
“How did this guy break through to the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage so quickly!!
A pained expression crossed Damon’s face.
Thinking back to when he first met Jack at the train station, the latter had just broken through to the Early Sixth Heaven, even a small realm lower than him.
It was unexpected that in no time at all, that guy had silently broken through the mid stage and now even advanced to the late stage, surpassing even him, an Innate Awakened One.
After more than a month of cultivation, Damon Lopes felt that he still needed over ten days to break through to the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage.
Unless there was thunderstorm weather in the coming days, the absorption of a vast amount of Power of Thunder from Heaven and Earth could accelerate his cultivation growth.
“The old man misled me, all that nonsense about ‘waxing strong loses, moderation brings gain,’ all lies to fool people.”
“Look at him, he cultivates more diligently than me every single day, his cultivation speed is even skyrocketing, where’s the loss of foundation stability in him?”
“Had I known, I would’ve stayed in the Northern Battlefield breathing in Thunderbolt Power every day, and by now I might’ve already broken through to the late stage or even nearing the peak.”
The more Damon thought about it, the more frustrated he felt.
Just as Damon contemplated whether he should double his efforts, the mobile phone beside his pillow suddenly vibrated – messages were coming despite it being before dawn.
YaYa: Good morning, Bro Damon, muah (kiss)
(Sexy beauty picture in a slinky camisole)
(Bathroom selfie beauty picture)
(Changing clothes beauty picture…)
As each increasingly nosebleed-inducing sexy (hardly clothed) beauty picture came through, Damon became more excited and couldn’t help but send several red envelopes in response.
As for diligent cultivation? What’s that?
Breaking through to the late stage is just that, a breakthrough, that guy has always been a monster, no need to worry about it.
But just then, an even more tremendous aura erupted from the rooftop, and under its mighty presence, Heavenly Energy from hundreds of meters around swirled and rushed towards the rooftop.
Damon, who was having a blast scrolling through beauty pictures, suddenly froze, disbelievingly looking up: “Heavenly Energy is converging… a true martial arts phantom!?”
“No, wrong, the might of the true martial arts phantom is greater, it feels like it’s just one step away from a breakthrough – has that guy formed the Rune Illusions ahead of time?”
At that moment, not only Damon Lopes, but Crystal Boyce on the same floor, also looked up in surprise towards the rooftop.

chapters.title: Chapter 525: 251: Condensing the Combat Divine Body, Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough to the Seventh Layer (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Chapter 251: Condensing the Combat Divine Body, Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough to the Seventh Layer (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
As the energy from heaven and earth converged, a raging wind howled across the rooftop, and behind Jack Clark, a thirty-meter-tall phantom wielding a War Halberd and surrounded by rotating halos of light, loomed faintly.
With the phantom’s emergence, the energy from heaven and earth gathered and swirled around, whipping up winds that howled with an awe-inspiring force.
However, unlike the solid-seeming true martial arts phantoms of Vernon Lowe and Hannah Gail, the phantom behind Jack appeared rather ethereal, for it was merely a projection of will.
The reason was a lack of cultivation, missing just one step.
Feeling the Combat Shadow standing firm between heaven and earth in his Sea of Consciousness, and the True Dragon Power within his body that had thickened several times over, reaching the late stages of the Sixth Heavenly Stage, Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
With the Rune Illusions in his Sea of Consciousness successfully condensed, the only thing left was for his cultivation realm to reach the peak of the Sixth Heavens, for his True Strength to form a flame that burned brightly, and for his spirit, qi, and essence to unify and step out the final stride.
Jack had been mentally prepared for this outcome.
That’s because the core of the Seventh Layer Cultivation Method is the True Martial Phantom, mainly focusing on using the Power of Will to condense the True Body, without any specific techniques for cultivating True Strength.
Or to put it another way, the path of True Strength cultivation ends at the Sixth Heavens.
The path of cultivation after the Seventh Layer Heaven is to condense the True Martial Phantom, turn the intangible into tangible, gather the Power of Heaven and Earth into the body, and ultimately break through to the Eight Layer, reshaping the physical body.
Therefore, the energy from this attribute enhancement was almost entirely consumed on the Rune Illusions, and the advancement in cultivation realm was incidentally accompanied, as it happened due to enlightenment.
Similar to when Jane Aiken condensed her Sword Intent and experienced a surge in cultivation as she came to an epiphany.
Leveraging this enhancement and enlightenment, Jack’s cultivation realm took a huge leap forward to the late period of the Sixth Heavenly Stage and was exceedingly close to the peak.
Furthermore, since he had already condensed the Rune Illusions, in the situation where he was gathering a large amount of energy from heaven and earth, Jack’s cultivation speed was actually not much different from a Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator.
He estimated that in no more than ten days, he would be able to reach the peak of the Sixth Heavens.
In addition, while Jack had not stepped into the Seventh Layer in one go this time, he already possessed some of the mystical abilities of a high-rank Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator.
Under the manifestation of the will projection, he could still gather the Power of Heaven and Earth to bolster his True Dragon Power, enhancing its destructive power by several times.
Given the considerable strength of Jack’s condensed Combat Divine Body, once he steps into the Seventh Layer, the True Martial Phantom would at least enhance the basic amplification of True Dragon Power by more than a dozen times.
That is far beyond the standard five-fold increase of the True Martial Phantom for ordinary Seven Layer Heaven Cultivators.
Thinking this, Jack’s thoughts moved and he summoned the attribute page, his gaze falling on the remark behind the cultivation method.
Cultivation Method: Combat Divine Body: Halberd [Seventh Layer, True Martial Phantom (incomplete), external projection can gather energy from heaven and earth, and can increase the power of True Dragon Power five times]
When the breakthrough aura subsided, daylight had already brightened the sky. Jack reined in his aura and walked calmly down from the rooftop, washed up a bit, and then went to the private dining room on the nineteenth floor.
Then he saw Damon Lopes looking at him with eyes one might use to behold a monster.
“Uh… Mr. Lopes, why are you looking at me like that? Aren’t you chatting with your beautiful female friends today?”
Every morning at breakfast, Damon Lopes was always chatting animatedly with his beauties while eating, a habit to which Jack and Mathilda Ward and the others had become accustomed.
After Jack spoke, Damon Lopes replied with a sigh, “No more chatting, it’s meaningless. Now, in my eyes, beauties are but skeletons in makeup, a pile of bones and flesh, all is illusion.”
“You’ve had another epiphany?” Jack asked, his gaze odd.
Damon Lopes nodded with a transcendent air: “Indeed, I have had an epiphany.”
“You deserve praise, Mr. Lopes, for having yet another epiphany,” Jack admired.
As for what exactly Damon Lopes realized, only he knew. Anyway, Jack did not believe he would give up on those beautiful female friends.
At this moment, the large screen on the wall nearby was broadcasting the morning news from Mason City. The scene switched to a martial arts arena.
A bearded young man stood on the arena, fielding inquiries from numerous reporters.
Behind him lay a shattered arena and a heavily injured middle-aged man.
“Hello, everyone, I am the host, Xiao Xi.”
I am currently over three hundred kilometers away from Mason City, right behind me is the arena of the Blood Tiger Martial Arts Hall.”
“Just now, early in the morning, Mr. Clyde once again updated his record of victory by defeating the main strong man of the second largest martial arts hall in Gunaer with a single move.”
It is said that this strong man named Dennings has almost reached the middle stage of the seventh realm, who once turned into a full beast and blasted a hundred-meter building with a single punch, quite terrifying.”
Yet such a strong man couldn’t even take one strike from Mr. Clyde, who is of the Sixth Layer cultivation. It’s incredibly fearsome.”
“With such monstrous talent, even in the three major empires, it is very rare.
Next, he plans to challenge Darren Callum in Mason City, and no one knows which of the two Sixth Layer fighters is stronger.”
“I’m sure everyone in front of the TV has the same question. You can text us or log on to the television station’s live platform to leave a comment below and discuss this topic with me.”
At this moment, a reporter called out to Clyde from behind the host.
“Mr. Clyde, are you planning to head straight to Mason to challenge Darren next?”
The bearded young man, his gaze sharp, coldly said, “No, something occurred to me during the last fight, so I will enter closed-door cultivation for a few days to make a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer.”
Immediately, the scene was abuzz.
“A breakthrough to the Seventh Layer!”
“My God, he’s not even twenty years old yet, and he’s already on the verge of breaking through to the Seventh Layer.”
“Such terrifying talent, if he breaks through to the Seventh Layer this time, will Darren still be a match for him?”
Suddenly, the reporters on the scene were greatly excited, for they now had a fresh scoop to report.

chapters.title: Chapter 526: 252: Demon-Slaying Puppet, Seventh Layer Battle Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Chapter 252: Demon-Slaying Puppet, Seventh Layer Battle Body
Looking at the news on the big screen, Damon Lopes raised an eyebrow, “He’s actually preparing for closed-door cultivation to breakthrough to Seventh Layer Heaven? Has he already reached this step?”
Regardless of which path of cultivation one chooses, reaching the peak of Sixth-level Heaven does not guarantee a breakthrough to the Seventh.
That is a barrier, obstructing many cultivators.
Spirit Qi and body in unity—it sounds simple, but many advanced cultivators are stuck here, unable to progress for years, their True Strength flame unable to merge with Rune Illusions.
Jack Clark said calmly, “His path is somewhat similar to the Invincible Path I once took, punching through two countries, sweeping through all local cultivators below the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“In such circumstances, his Spiritual Will might achieve a certain sublimation, gathering aura, he might already have touched upon the realm of unity between spirit, Qi, and body.”
The Invincible Path is actually a tempering of the Spiritual Will.
When a cultivator keeps on fighting, defeating cultivators of the same rank time after time, their will becomes ever more resolute, engendering a conviction of being invincible, leading to an active and transparent mind.
In this state, many cultivation-related doubts could be enlightened upon with a mere thought, and many minor cultivation barriers could be shattered with a single charge.
However, a normal Invincible Path generally takes a long time to tread, and the selection of opponents is also strategic.
For instance, one wouldn’t choose an opponent beyond their own strength because if the Road of Invincibility gets disrupted, one’s morale would plummet, making it impossible to enter an invincible state of mind again.
But a situation like Jack Clark’s where he struck down two thousand kilometers in half a day, tearing through a battlefield, defeating five to six hundred same-rank cultivators within a single day is almost impossible to replicate.
Especially since all the opponents were defeated with a single move, demonstrating terrifying stamina and endurance.
Damon Lopes became a bit more serious, “If this person is already strong and manages to breakthrough to Seventh Layer Heaven, we might have some trouble.”
“By then, if Clyde distracts and binds you, while Akunus takes me on, Sister Ilisa’s side will then have a defensive vacuum.”
“Isn’t that just right?”
Mathilda Ward softly said from across, “With Akunus’s insight, after a few probes, he likely would’ve guessed that Brother Callum’s sense of danger comes from sight, or even intuition.”
“This is the significance of Clyde’s appearance; it wants to use the tide of public opinion to force Brother Callum to leave my side, even if just for a short while.”
“So during the showdown between Brother Callum and Clyde, Akunus, who has been lurking, is very likely to strike, including having prepared means to restrain you, Damon.”
Damon Lopes straightened his posture, his brow slightly furrowed, “In that case, should we make some preparations in advance? For example, having Eighth Layer Experts lie in ambush beforehand?”
Mathilda Ward shook her head, “That won’t do. A king’s Divine Soul possesses spontaneous perception; it senses when strong threats are nearby.”
“This is also the reason why after reaching King-level, not only is the power terrifying, but they’re also difficult to eliminate, unless they’re encircled and taken down with the swiftness of lightning.”
“Don’t worry, when the time comes, just focus on the fight and don’t concern yourselves with me.”
“In Aunt Boyce’s hands, there still lies an ace that can protect me, something my father specifically prepared for Akunus.”
Hearing this, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted subtly, exchanging glances with Damon Lopes.
They had actually guessed this already; after all, she is the only daughter of the Mysterious Martial Sky King—how could she not possess a powerful one-time-use secret treasure?
Yet such treasures must come with conditions for their use, which is why it was placed in Crystal Boyce’s hands.
After breakfast, the group went downstairs.
With five days left until the concert, Mathilda Ward’s preparations intensify.
And Crystal Boyce, the person in charge of the concert, was even busier—overseeing the stage design, sound equipment, lighting, and even ensuring perfection in the costumes.
Because this would be Mathilda Ward’s final farewell, she wanted the ‘entire world’ to remember this girl, to remember that she once existed.
Although after Jack Clark gave her that Source of Life, Mathilda Ward felt her success rate had increased to thirty percent.
But is there really a difference between thirty percent and twenty percent?
Their party had just stepped out of the Hotel Lobby when a throng of reporters excitedly surrounded them, only to be held at a distance by Lionel Lopez and other bodyguards, shouting out.
“Mr. Darren Callum, will you accept Clyde’s challenge?”
“Mr. Callum, if Clyde breaks through to Seventh Layer Heaven, will you still be confident in defeating him?”
“Miss Ward, you’ve been attacked by the Evil God Sect before, and now with the concert about to start, could Clyde be plotting something by preparing to challenge you at this timing?”
These reporters weren’t only targeting Jack Clark; they also sought to extract some news from Mathilda Ward’s responses.
Looking at those enthusiastic reporters, Jack Clark and Mathilda Ward exchanged glances and then spoke indifferently, “Since everyone is so concerned, I will keep my answer brief.”
“As a ‘professional’ bodyguard, my primary duty is to ensure Miss Ward’s safety.”
“If Clyde’s challenge interferes with Miss Ward’s safety, I will decisively reject it because it’s not as if he can challenge whenever he likes.”
“So please pass the message on: I have no problem with a challenge, but the timing needs to be right, such as the day before Miss Ward’s concert starts, or after it ends.”
