“Otherwise, just roll back to wherever you came from.”
Suddenly, the reporters buzzed with excitement, capturing Jack Clark’s audacious statement.
So arrogant, indeed the man who slew a god.
At this moment, Mathilda Ward smiled and said, “Alright, your questions have been answered. Now please disperse, as we need to proceed to the concert site for the dress rehearsal.”
…
[That bodyguard is as arrogant as ever]

chapters.title: Chapter 527: 252: Demon-Slaying Puppet, Seventh Layer Battle Body_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Chapter 252: Demon-Slaying Puppet, Seventh Layer Battle Body_2
[The man who slew a god is just that overbearingly confident!]
[Darren Callum: What even is Clyde?]
When Jack followed Mathilda Ward to the sports stadium, several headlines quickly surged into the trending searches, sparking significant discussions on the internet of other countries as well.
Among them were some ‘experts’ coming out to comment.
However, these had no impact on Jack.
In the sports stadium that could accommodate tens of thousands of people, Mathilda and the dozen or so gorgeous men and women backup dancers were gesturing on the stage, and many staff members were bustling about the venue.
Standing below the stage, Jack, wearing sunglasses, watched the surroundings with sharp eyes and a stern expression.
After this concert, Mathilda would return to Eastern Summer to ‘hibernate,’ so these few days were Akunus’s last chance and it could strike at any time.
They speculated that the most likely time for it to launch an attack would be when Clyde’s challenge distracted Jack.
But they couldn’t afford to be careless at any time; what if the enemy was using Clyde’s challenge to create a false expectation that it wouldn’t act for the time being?
According to Mathilda, Akunus had only two ways to retrieve the ‘dragon’: one was to control her and use a soul power of the same origin to draw out the ‘dragon.’
The other was for her to die and, in the moment before the ‘dragon’ dissipated without a host, burst forth with soul power at close range to reabsorb the dragon.
Both methods had distance limitations, so Jack just needed to ensure there were no issues with the people around Mathilda.
Or to put it another way, it would be fine as long as there were ‘no strangers’ around Mathilda when an attack happened.
At that time, except for Damon Lopes and Crystal Boyce, whom he could absolutely trust, anyone daring to step within a ten-meter radius would have to die, regardless of gender.
He would rather kill the wrong person than let a single one go.
Without the dragon, Akunus was just an average king-level being, but once it acquired the dragon to complete itself, its strength would be comparable to that of a Heavenly King-level existence, making it extremely tricky to deal with.
Moreover, being also from the Human Race and better understanding various aspects of the Federation, its threat was stronger than that of the Purgatory Demon Race’s Great Demon King.
Just then, two people and a fox entered the stadium entrance. Spotting Mathilda from afar, they excitedly shouted, “Sister Ilisa!”
“Moon?”
Looking at the excitedly running ultra-fierce girl, surprise showed in Mathilda’s eyes, and then her whole person was fiercely hugged, deforming from the squeeze.
“Heehee! Sister Ilisa, I’ve missed you so much.” The fox-eared girl hugged Mathilda and rubbed against her back and forth, utterly delighted.
Finding herself in the embrace, Mathilda was somewhat puzzled, “Moon, why did you come to Gunardo? Didn’t you go back with your brother?”
Gwen Gail grinned cheerfully, “I did go back with brother, but my uncle said it wasn’t stable enough here, Sister Ilisa, and he asked me to bring Maureen over to help.”
With that, Gwen Gail turned excitedly to Jack, “Brother Callum, you’re so amazing. You even defeated a demon king’s avatar.”
Jack responded indifferently, “Mainly because the enemy’s realm was too low, only at the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, they couldn’t bring out their true strength.”
Even though he had directly defeated Kautorus’s avatar, Jack did not underestimate the enemy, believing that the king-level strength was just that.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s level grew higher, Jack felt the gap between each Major Realm even more keenly, with each being a vast canyon.
This was evident between level eight and Level 9 Giant Beasts, and even more so for the beings above them in the mythic category.
As beings considered equal to Mythical Giant Beasts, the true strength of king-level and demon king beings was naturally terrifying.
It was just that the smuggled-in soul avatars, not containing the Laws’ Origin and hosting only at Sixth Layer Heaven, didn’t appear very strong.
And this “not very strong” still managed to unleash Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven strength from a Sixth Heaven Middle Stage host body, which was way more powerful than what Tyler Lance had originally told him.
Of course, Tyler hadn’t anticipated that Jack would directly clash with Kautorus.
What they had in mind was that if the demon king or Akunus showed up, Damon would step in to restrain one while Jack escaped with Mathilda, leaving the others ready to take over.
For the Federation, the trouble was that they hid and wouldn’t show themselves.
But once they revealed themselves and burst forth with Divine Soul power, there would be plenty of methods to track and lock onto them.
“Brother Callum, you are still so modest. After you sparred with my brother, he said you still had something up your sleeve and didn’t show all your strength.”
Jack replied dispassionately, “Mr. Gail is overestimating me. I had already burst forth with all my strength at that time, even entering Super Transformation One.”
The girl wasn’t so easily deceived, blinking her big eyes, “If there’s a first stage, then that means there must be a second and third stage, right?”
“Do you think this is an anime or something? With Super Transformation One, Super Transformation Two.” Jack shook his head, even though he did indeed have a second transformation.
“Oh, right! Let me introduce everyone.”
Saying this, Gwen Gail turned around and hugged the neck of the White Fox behind her, standing over 1 meter tall at the shoulder, more than 3 meters in body length, and having six tails, each over 2 meters long.
“This is Maureen, my good friend who grew up with me since we were little.”
“Come on, Maureen, say hello. This is my favorite Sister Ilisa, and this is Brother Callum, who even a Sixth Layer Heaven couldn’t defeat.”
Looking at Jack and the others, the White Fox’s face showed a humanized calmness. With a low growl through its breaths, it conveyed spiritual thoughts: Murr!! Hello, you two, I am, Renee.
Suddenly, surprise appeared in Mathilda’s eyes, “Thought vocalization, high intelligence in this Mutated Fox Demon, Moon, can I pet it?”
“Heehee, of course you can, Sister Ilisa.”

chapters.title: Chapter 528: 252: Demon-Slaying Puppet, Seventh Layer Battle Body_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: Chapter 252: Demon-Slaying Puppet, Seventh Layer Battle Body_3
When Mathilda Ward eagerly approached and joined Gwen Gail in hugging and caressing the White Fox, Jack Clark’s eyes also revealed a touch of surprise.
Because this fox creature was strong.
In his perception, this fox creature that concealed its aura should be at about Level 6 Peak, but there was a faintly discernible and terrifying strength within it.
That strength was so formidable that Jack felt it would take two halberd strikes to blast through it.
This fox creature must possess a King-level bloodline, and it was very likely a descendant of the Mythical Giant Beast, the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox, with strong bloodline evolution and regression.
But as formidable as it was, why did it make a whimpering sound? You’re not a Mutated Tiger Whale.
While Jack was sizing it up, the Six-Tailed White Fox also glanced at him with its faintly charming eyes, a hint of wariness and astonishment flashing within.
Because it felt a faint bloodline suppression emanating from this human.
But how could that be, isn’t he a human?
As they interacted, the backup-dancing beauties around the stage and some staff members in the distance curiously watched the Six-Tailed Fox Creature.
For these ordinary people, opportunities to come into close contact with powerful mutated creatures were rare.
“Such a beautiful fox.”
“Your fox is bigger than a Water Buffalo; it’s a Unique Beast, very ferocious—one bite could swallow a person whole.”
In the distance at the edge of the stage, the assistant helping the sound engineer adjust the equipment also lit up with excitement: “That fox is so pretty, I really want to touch it.”
The bald middle-aged team sound engineer scoffed, “Forget it, Miss Jodie, that’s a pure high-level mutant beast. If you try to touch it without its approval, be careful; it might bite you.”
Hiss!
Imagining herself being bitten by that large mouth, the pretty assistant involuntarily gasped, and her adorable expression made the nearby staff burst into laughter.
…
It’s still the deep underground of that island.
Now, the blood and Mutated Creature corpses have disappeared from the Blood Pool at the center of the cave, revealing a pitch-black hollow of unknown depth.
Surrounding the hollow, the sacrificial runes etched on the mountain wall and ground that resembled dancing demons with bared fangs still flickered with a faint red glow, emitting a strong evil aura.
As for the Blood God Sect cultists, they had turned to ash after sacrificing their flesh and souls.
At the edge of the hollow, the long-haired youth with red ripples on his forehead looked ahead, his gaze profound as if observing a distant place.
Not far behind the youth, a diamond-shaped Black Crystal floated, rotating slowly and continuously emitting black light spots reminiscent of runes, which were gathering more and more.
Suddenly, those black light spots unfolded, forming a Rune Array with a diameter of about 1 meter in midair.
Hum! Centered on the Black Crystal, the Rune Array vibrated, and in an instant, it collapsed like a Black Hole, forming a dark area several meters in diameter around it.
The diamond-shaped Black Crystal glittered in the center of the darkness, unleashing bursts of dark energy that pierced through space, as if a coordinate had disappeared into the depths of the Void.
Because the Rune Array covered it, all the energy fluctuations emitted by the Black Crystal were absorbed and devoured, causing no impact on the surroundings.
In such a situation, it would naturally go undetected by the energy detection satellites in the sky.
As the Black Crystal continuously sent out energy signals, half an hour later, suddenly the light from the crystal surged, illuminating an indistinct image in the depths of the darkness.
In the image, ancient palaces stood erect amidst swirling black mist, and a towering figure sat high on the throne, its gaze piercing through infinite spacetime towards the long-haired youth.
A deep, resonant voice, full of an indescribable oppressive feeling, came from the other side: “Akunus, you have activated the Boundary Breaking Nether Crystal after all.”
The long-haired youth said indifferently, “The defense within Blue Star is even tighter than we estimated. With the strength of my avatar at present, the hope of retrieving the dragon is low.”
“As for that fool Kautorus, he was too impatient to make a move after only a couple of probes and then got slain by a genius of the Sixth-level Heaven from the Federation.”
“Otherwise, at the critical moment, I could have thrown it out to distract. With that distraction, I’m confident I would have a 60% chance of retrieving the dragon.”
A deep and resonant voice came from the other side, wary, “Kautorus has already been slain by those people from the Federation in the Hundred Dragon Wasteland some time ago.”
“I am aware of this news too, I need your help, Grayson.”
“As long as I can retrieve the dragon, I can recover to full strength within a year. Then, the two of us working together would have a greater chance of success when we raid that place.”
On the other side, Giant God Sect’s Evil God Grayson fell slightly silent, then spoke deeply, “The Inner World of the human race is too dangerous, I can’t possibly slice off an avatar to come in.”
“However, I can send you a Demon-Slaying Puppet. I will extract the Law Power within the puppet and only retain the pure combat body and an activation magic crystal.”
“This way, it should be able to pass through the fragile plane temporarily formed by the Nether Crystal and fold space-time to transmit over.”
The long-haired youth revealed a smile on his face, “With this Demon-Slaying Puppet, I’m even more confident in the arrangements to come.”
“The Federation people want to lure me out by maintaining strength around that little girl at the Sixth Layer, fearing I’d be too wary to make a move.”
“And the person they prepare to tackle me is an Eight Layer cultivator—and to avoid triggering my Divine Soul Alert, that person usually stays a hundred kilometers away.”
“Now, with this puppet devoid of Law Power but retaining a combat body and still possessing early stage Eighth Layer strength…”
“Coupled with the Unavoidable Demon Blade that can slice even through Ninth Heaven Cultivator domains, it should be enough to hold off the pressure from that Eight Layer Heaven for a while before the magic crystal energy runs out.”
“And that time should be enough for me to retrieve the dragon.”
As for why not use the Demon-Slaying Puppet to suppress everything, naturally, the aura of the puppet could not escape Darren Callum’s senses, likely startling them away.
“It’s good that you are confident.” Accompanied by the deep voice, in an instant, terrifying power burst forth from the imposing figure, vibrating Heaven and Earth.
Hum! The crystal at the center of the dark hollow vibrated, and within it, a ‘world’ faintly emerged, giving off intense Spatial Fluctuations.
At that moment, the diamond-shaped crystal exploded, the ‘world’ expanded forming a silent and void transparent space that connected two Boundarys.
“Now is the time.” Boom! A black ‘corpse,’ 3 meters tall with arms like blades was thrown by the imposing figure into the silent world.
In an instant, intense Spatial Fluctuations erupted, setting off waves of strong tremors that endlessly quaked, but were absorbed and devoured by the black rune array.
Under the powerful force of the opposing Evil God, the transparent space laid out in the Void began to slowly rotate. With each bit of rotation, there emerged the sound of crackle crackle, as if it was at its breaking point.
Just when the space was full of cracks and about to collapse, it finally reversed on one side.
Boom! With the fall of the black puppet, the silent space already full of cracks also collapsed with a loud noise, immediately followed by the collapse of the void pathway.
However, this time it wasn’t creating a passage that pierces through two Boundarys, but only a projection, so the impact of the collapse was really weak, turning into a typhoon of 10+ category that swept through the cave.
Looking down at the black Demon-Slaying Puppet lying quietly on the ground, Akinus’s eyes revealed a trace of pain.
Because the Nether Crystal that had just shattered was very precious, over ten times more valuable than the puppet, which after the infusion of a Law Power, had the combat power comparable to Ninth Heaven.
It would not have bothered bringing in this boundary-crossing Nether Crystal if it weren’t for the dragon.
Such a Divine Object containing a part of the ‘Netherworld,’ capable of forming a complete small plane temporarily, piercing through two Boundarys—even it only had one of them.
It was meant for the exploration of that dangerous place.
But as long as it could retrieve the dragon, it was all worthwhile. At that time, I will make you all pay the price.
Thinking this, the young man’s gaze grew very cold and ruthless.

chapters.title: Chapter 529: 253: Blood Reincarnation Heaven, The Decisive Battle Begins (Request for Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Chapter 253: Blood Reincarnation Heaven, The Decisive Battle Begins (Request for Monthly Pass)
As the ‘concert’ approached, both sides were preparing.
May 17th, early morning.
Deep in the mountain forest tens of kilometers outside Mason City, a young man with a full beard was sitting cross-legged, with an increasingly strong aura of destruction emitting from his body.
Under the terrifying aura, a raging wind howled around him, shaking the trees several meters away, whisking up gravel and fallen leaves, forming a tornado centered on Clyde.
Suddenly, Clyde’s aura fluctuated, and the tornado-like winds around him exploded with a burst and dispersed.
“No, it’s still lacking a bit,” Clyde opened his eyes, showing a hint of disappointment on his face.
After two days of closed-door cultivation, although he had sensed the barrier to breakthrough, he was always just a bit short and unable to break the shackles to step into the Seventh Layer Heaven.
At that moment, the forest in the distance shook, and a middle-aged man with an expressionless face appeared, calmly looking at Clyde who was sitting cross-legged in the distance.
“Genetic Martial Arts follows the path of merging with the Alien Beast Gene, ultimately evolving into another more perfect form of life. Therefore, each realm involves altering one’s physique, sublimating one’s life.”
“You are stuck at the Seventh Layer because you still consider yourself a ‘Person.’ Your spiritual will has not reached unity with the genetic information within your body.”
“Similar to the unity of Spirit Qi with the True Martial Way, when your subconscious resists ‘it,’ you naturally cannot fully beastize.”
The words of the middle-aged man left Clyde silent for a moment before he coldly replied, “I already know what you’ve said, but the problem is, how do I give up ‘myself’?”
To abandon oneself in the Seventh Layer of Genetic Martial Arts wasn’t something that could be accomplished simply by stating ‘I’ll stop being human.’ It required a deep understanding of one’s genes and the fusion of will.
To ultimately become a completely new humanoid Unique Beast.
The middle-aged man shook his head, “This is a long-term process of self-realization, self-suggestion, and self-change. There is no way to achieve it overnight.”
“However, if you want to defeat Darren Callum with your current strength, which barely compares to that of the Late Sevenfold Sky, it is insufficient. You might not even be able to take a single move from him.”
“Is that Darren Callum really that strong?” Clyde asked with an emotionless gaze.
“You were able to defeat Dennings, who had just broken through to the mid-period of the Seventh Layer, because of your Grand Destruction Fist Intent and the tenfold burst of Genetic Power in your punch.”
“But such a move, you can only use it for a maximum of three consecutive bursts. If you can’t defeat your enemy in three moves, you’ll be drained of strength.”
“Conveniently, Darren is strong enough to take three moves without injury. You are no match for him now unless you break through the Seventh Layer and evolve your bloodline.”
“Although I can’t help you break through, I have a bottle of Chaotic God Essence Blood here. Once consumed, it can stimulate your bloodline to its limit, temporarily allowing you to step into the Seventh Layer.”
Looking at the middle-aged man, Clyde didn’t ask whether to take it or not, but instead demanded in a deep voice, “Which Evil God are you from the Evil God Sect?”
In the time he had traveled between two countries, Clyde had also looked into online information about Darren.
Like how Darren had slain an Evil God Clone and how the girl named Ilisa he was protecting had been attacked by a Demon from the Demon God Sect.
The middle-aged man calmly said, “What is a god, but merely a group of powerful cultivators.”
“In the past, it was only because I had a disagreement with the Federation folk. They expelled me from the Blue Star World and banished me to the mythical world for decades.”
“My return this time is only to retrieve an item that belongs to me from that girl named Ilisa.”
“While you have frozen your mother, preserving her body in a near-death state, death has already enshrouded her. As soon as the frozen state is lifted, she will die within a few breaths.”
“Only after I retrieve that item can I perform the Blood Reincarnation Technique, using the power that involves time to reverse your mother’s body and soul, restoring them to several years ago.”
“Only then will she not die.”
Clyde remained silent at the man’s words, then said solemnly, “Where’s the blood?”
At once, the middle-aged man showed a hint of a smile, taking out a red bottle, “This bottle of Chaotic God Essence Blood, once consumed, will become a pseudo ‘bloodline’ power that integrates into your body.”
“When you fully unleash that bloodline power, you will possess the strength of a Seventh Layer beastified powerhouse, until the power of the bloodline is exhausted and your realm falls.”
Under the middle-aged man’s gaze, Clyde drank the Chaotic God Essence Blood in one gulp, and instantly a terrifying aura erupted from him.
Boom!
Heavenly Energy from hundreds of meters around converged, and Overbearing Destruction Fist Intent soared into the sky.
Unmasked, the aura of a ‘breakthrough’ to the Seventh Layer Heaven, even if tens of kilometers away, was sensed by both Jack Clark and Damon Lopes.
Whoosh, whoosh!
In a flash, two figures appeared on the rooftop. Jack Clark and Damon Lopes, who were having breakfast, arrived on the rooftop, looking towards the distance.
Though their realms were still at the Sixth Layer Heaven, their true strength had long since reached the late period of the Seventh Layer, or even the pinnacle, making them akin to unorthodox high-ranking powerhouses.
Feeling the soaring Fist Intent, Damon Lopes raised an eyebrow, “That Destruction Will has a sense of obliteration. It’s that Clyde, has he actually broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven?”
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “That aura seems a bit unstable. It must be a forced breakthrough.”
Damon Lopes was puzzled, “Why is this guy cooperating with Akunus? Even willing to risk foundational damage to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven forcefully?”
Jack had told Damon about Clyde’s situation afterwards.
Jack replied calmly, “There’s no need to worry about that question. As long as we confirm he’s an enemy, knocking him out is enough. Knowing too much only adds to our troubles.”
Damon nodded slightly, “You are right, but now that this guy has broken through to the Seventh Layer, are you sure you can handle him when the time comes?”

chapters.title: Chapter 530: 253: Blood Reincarnation Heaven, The Decisive Battle Begins (Request for Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Chapter 253: Blood Reincarnation Heaven, The Decisive Battle Begins (Request for Monthly Pass)_2
Jack Clark said indifferently, “It doesn’t matter to me whether this person is in the Seventh or at the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven. It’s just a matter of a few more or fewer halberd swings.”
“This time he seems to have broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, but the improvement isn’t as big as you’d imagine. His fist intent is still at a grand accomplishment level; the only difference is that he can now enter a complete beast transformation state.”
Genetic Martial Arts is different from True Martial, because it doesn’t condense a true martial arts phantom. After breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, the heavenly energy boost obtained is only two or three times higher.
What makes them stronger is the physique in their beast transformation state, possessing a part of the Unique Beast’s talent and strength comparable to a Level 7 Alien Beast, with speed and True Strength amplification.
Very strong, but that’s all they are—very strong.
To the current Jack Clark, the combat power of a late stage Seventh Layer Heaven or someone close to the peak just isn’t enough.”
In this period, his physical body has undergone several major enhancements, and upon his cultivation breakthrough in the late Sixth Heavenly Stage, he condensed a will rune shadow.
In his normal state, his combat power has reached the pinnacle of the Seventh Layer Heaven.
That is to say, Jack Clark, without entering his rune transformation state, could now rival the burst of full strength from Kautorus when he had burned his divine soul.
With such terrifying strength, only a few halberd swings could explode everything.
Forget about Sixth Layer Heaven; there are very few Seventh Layer Heaven cultivators who could take even a few hits from him.
Once he enters the Divine Might Emperor Dragon From, a twenty-fold increase in strength and defense makes it possible to cross the threshold of the Eight Layer Heaven, making him unimaginably powerful.
After all, his realm is still just at the late stages of the Sixth Heavenly Stage.
In fact, given the overall strength of the Human Race, king-level fighters would be blown up head-on in the battlefield.
This time he’s so concerned about Akunus’s avatar mainly because he wants to seal its soul source and locate and kill its true body.
Federation top-level strong men have long been disgusted by this monster that has devoured tens of millions of cultivators, but they’ve never been able to catch its true body.
Meanwhile, in Mason, some experts also sensed that breakthrough aura, especially the one filled with destructive intent which was highly distinctive.
Soon, the news that Clyde had broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven began to spread online, and many people were shaken.
“Damn! That guy is just shy of twenty, right? He really broke through to the Seventh Layer Heaven. What does that make me, a ‘genius’ who graduated from the Third Layer Heaven?”
“Seventh Layer Heaven, eh? The upcoming fight might be a loss for Darren Callum.”
“Yeah, when that guy was at the peak of the Sixth Layer, he could defeat mid-stage Seventh Layer Heaven strong men with one move, not to mention now that he’s broken through.”
Online, the tide of opinion quickly turned, and many people felt that Darren Callum might not be a match for Clyde anymore.
In the minds of most cultivators, after undergoing a second transformation in Seventh Layer Heaven, it’s on a different level from the Sixth Layer Heaven, let alone Clyde, who has cross-realm battle capabilities.
Once he breaks through, he will become even stronger and more terrifying.
…
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Deep under the sea of the Water and Fire World, the three-headed ‘little’ Tiger Whales that had been sleeping for several days erupted with a powerful aura.
Two of them, Tiger One and Tiger Two, who had eaten Blood Crystals to change their physiques and later devoured Lava Fire Fruits, grew to 35 meters with thick armor covered in red patterns.
Besides, a 3-meter-long red single horn grew on their heads.
With flames burning on their bodies, they seemed fierce and overbearing. An atmosphere belonging to king-level bloodline spread out, shaking the ocean.
As marine life, evolving to have abilities of flames seemed odd no matter how you looked at it.
Relative to those two Tiger Whales, Tiger Three, who consumed fewer resources, was much more normal, also growing to 34 meters in this breakthrough.
Its body was covered in black armor, with huge double fins and a big mouth full of fearsome fanged teeth. When slightly opened, it resembled a black hole—very sinister.
It too radiated an aura of a king-level bloodline, subtler and more restrained than the other two Tiger Whales, somehow giving off an even more dangerous feeling.
Rooooar!!
The three awakened Tiger Whales were incredibly excited. Their massive bodies churned up violent currents, bursting out of the water, instantly causing an explosion on the surface. This commotion woke up the Female Tiger Whale and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish inside the palace.
Rooooar!! Haha, not bad, not bad, all awake, and even awakened powerful bloodline strength.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, more than 80 meters long, was very pleased. Its wing-like double fins beat the water, and with a roar, it sent the newly awakened Tiger One flying.
The other two small Tiger Whales quickly dodged, frightened.
Roooar!! Mom, Dad hit me again. Tiger One, engulfed in flames, swam over to the Female Tiger Whale and made a grievance-filled roar.
In response, the Female Tiger Whale just silently watched the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which involuntarily shrank its ‘neck’, showing a sheepish look.
Roooar!! I just got a little excited, a little excited, happy for their awakening powerful bloodlines, yes, happy.
Faced with the Female Tiger Whale’s direct gaze, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish nervously explained.
Luckily, the Horned Lady did not fuss over this. Looking at the three small Tiger Whales that had broken through and awakened: Roooar!! Now that you all have broken through, come out and work with me.
Roooar!! Mom, what are we going to do?
Roooar!! Collect Life Crystals for the Great King. He has helped us a lot. We must work hard to repay the Great King.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale’s eyes lit up, its fins flapping excitedly: Roooar!! Yes, to help Thunderflame collect Life Crystals. This can enhance his enlightenment. I will go too.
But as soon as it finished speaking, the Horned Lady looked at it.
Roooar!! You continue to cultivate, striving to condense a hundred slash runes as soon as possible, to increase your strength. Collecting crystals can be done by myself and Tiger One.

chapters.title: Chapter 531: 253: Blood Reincarnation Heaven, The Decisive Battle Begins (Request for Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Chapter 253: Blood Reincarnation Heaven, The Decisive Battle Begins (Request for Monthly Pass)_3
Roar, roar, roar! No, honey, the more of us there are, the stronger we are.
But just after the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had finished speaking, the Female Tiger Whale’s eyes became stern: Roar, roar, roar! No more nonsense, go back to cultivation, or in a little while, you won’t even be able to see the king’s shadow.
Under the Female Tiger Whale’s stern gaze, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish eventually obediently swam back to the Ice Crystal Palace.
Seeing this, the Female Tiger Whale turned around contentedly, leading the three ‘small’ Tiger Whales out of the Water and Fire World to help the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon collect Life Crystals.
The next two days passed peacefully.
May 19th, five o’clock in the afternoon.
Clyde, who had consolidated his strength for two days, appeared a few kilometers outside Mason City, in the old town district that had been abandoned for over a decade.
This area was run-down, mainly consisting of three to four-story buildings, except for some old ten to twenty-story buildings in the central area and the two tallest Hundred-meter Buildings in the middle.
Having received word of Clyde’s appearance, the local Television Station, along with many online New Media Journalists, flocked to the scene and made a laborious climb to the rooftop more than thirty stories high.
Looking at the bearded young man standing with his hands behind his back at the edge of the rooftop, the journalists caught their breath and excitedly asked.
“Mr. Clyde, are you here to challenge Darren Callum?”
“Correct, I am here to challenge him,” Clyde said indifferently, with a cold gaze. “Didn’t he say his job is a bodyguard and told me not to disturb the Mathilda Ward concert when I challenge him?”
“Please inform everyone about him, I’m waiting for him here.”
“No problem, Mr. Clyde. We’re good at spreading the news,” they responded.
“Hello, everyone. We interrupt our broadcast with breaking news: the destroyer and boxer Clyde, who’s been missing for several days, has shown up to challenge the God Slayer, Darren Callum.”
“Mr. Clyde is currently located in the old town area, four kilometers West City, waiting for the arrival of Darren Callum. It’s uncertain whether Callum dares to accept the challenge…”
In the hotel, when the news of Clyde’s challenge to Jack Clark got around, many people’s expressions immediately turned solemn.
On the twentieth floor, Jack Clark watched the news on the big screen, his expression calm: “I thought he would choose to act tomorrow during the daytime, but it seems he has chosen this time instead.”
With that, Jack Clark looked towards Mathilda Ward and Damon Lopes: “Let’s go together to avoid any diversionary tactics. At that time, Mr. Lopes and Moon, please ensure Miss Ward’s safety.”
Damon Lopes looked solemn, “Rest assured, we will be careful.”
Today’s battle could very well be the final showdown. It was highly likely that Akunus would strike during the battle between Jack Clark and Clyde.
And given the lesson from Kautorus’s previous actions, when it chose to act, it would definitely be fully prepared, considering every aspect.
Only when confident of success would this cunning Evil God reveal its True Body.
However, as everyone took the elevator down to the lobby, many from the entertainment groups also followed, their faces filled with curiosity and excitement.
“Sister Ilisa, can we come with you to watch?”
“Boss Boyce, we want to go see too,” they said.
After all, it was a duel between the God Slayer Darren Callum and the monster that had swept across the Martial Arts circles of two countries. Being able to witness the battle from afar would give them something to boast about later.
Facing those expectant gazes, Crystal Boyce and Jack Clark exchanged glances with Damon Lopes, then nodded slightly: “If you want to go, then go. But remember, the fallout from a battle between high-ranking powerhouses is terrifying. Think it over carefully.”
“We know, we’ll stay back at a safe distance,” they replied.
“Thank you, Boss Boyce,” they gratefully said.
“Hee hee hee!”
Soon, a convoy of a dozen sedans departed from the hotel, heading towards the outskirts of the city.
Not only Jack Clark’s group but many people from Mason City were also heading towards the abandoned suburban area, all wanting to witness the duel between the two high-ranking combatants.
But when they approached West City, every junction had already been blocked by the law enforcement team, who continually announced through loudspeakers,
“The aftermath of a high-ranking combatants’ duel is extremely dangerous. Have you all forgotten the battle south of the city? Go back! Don’t come for the thrill.”
“Don’t worry, our city’s Television Station will broadcast the entire duel live. We have drones-shooting from every angle, you can see the high-definition fighting scenes from home.”
“Go back, go back,” they insisted.
With the law enforcement team out in full force, most of the ordinary people who had come to see the action were turned away.
But it was just the ordinary people who were blocked; the officials didn’t bother with the ordinary cultivators who rushed over.
So, from the high altitude perspective of helicopters, many figures could be seen dashing swiftly below, rushing toward the old town area of West City.
Not just Mason City, with an hour’s forewarning, many people around the globe received the news and prepared their mobile phones, or settled in front of their computers and televisions to watch the live broadcast.
Including Mist River City, where Glenn Clark had just finished school and rushed home.
In the Research Institute Building, Freya Louise also gripped her tablet, her nerves taut, for Jack Clark was facing a ‘Seventh Layer’ high-order strong man this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 532: 254: Villain Jack Clark, Forcing a Higher Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Chapter 254: Villain Jack Clark, Forcing a Higher Realm
Outside the abandoned old city district, the arrival of a line of more than ten sedans stirred the already waiting television stations, live-streaming websites, and new media journalists into excitement.
“They’re here, they’re here.”
“Quick, grab the video camera and follow me.”
But as soon as the cars stopped, the doors of the four sedans at the front and back slammed open, and more than a dozen bodyguards dressed in black suits quickly got out, forming a human wall to block the reporters.
Lionel Lopez said in a deep voice, “Don’t crowd, everyone. If you want to interview, wait for Miss Ward to get out of the car.”
The reporter holding the microphone shouted excitedly, “We’re not here to interview Mathilda Ward; we want to interview Darren Callum.”
“Yes, interview Darren Callum.”
“Darren Callum is getting out.”
Seeing Jack Clark getting out of the car, the reporters were instantly ecstatic.
“Darren Callum, we’ve heard that Clyde has made a breakthrough into the Seventh Layer Heaven. Do you still have the confidence to win against him?”
“Rare Grand Fist Intent, plus a complete beast transformation of the Seventh Layer Heaven. Some speculate that Clyde’s strength could be comparable to that of a late-period Seventh Layer Heaven powerhouse. How long do you think you can fight before defeating him?”
Jack Clark, wearing sunglasses, looked at the excited reporters with an indifferent expression and said calmly, “To me, it makes no difference whether or not he has made a breakthrough.”
“As for the outcome, you will soon see for yourselves. Maybe he won’t even be able to take a single one of my moves.”
“It’s him, that familiar flavor, overbearing and arrogant.”
The reporters were excited, one after another, and the video cameras behind them kept crackling, live broadcasting his words.
At this moment, Mathilda Ward and Gwen Gail also got out of the car from behind, followed by Damon Lopes, who was clad in a suave Daoist robe.
At the same time, the Six-Tailed White Fox appeared silently behind Gwen Gail.
As a precaution against possible combat, Ilisa had changed into a set of black women’s suits today, with a white shirt inside and slim-fit trousers, looking dashing and handsome.
Gwen Gail was similarly dressed, wearing a white hooded tee, slim-fit trousers and sneakers, and from the moment she got out of the car, the white fox ears on her head kept twitching.
Then came Crystal Boyce, Marla Fiore, and a dozen other Group employees who followed over to join the excitement.
Jack Clark looked back at the two and said calmly, “Mr. Lopes, Gwen, I leave it in your hands.”
Damon Lopes nodded solemnly, “Rest assured.”
The fox-eared girl giggled, “With Gwen here, no one can harm Sister Ilisa.”
Although she had not yet started her cultivation, as someone who had awakened a king-level bloodline, her strength was already formidable, and when she activated her bloodline power, she was equal to a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator.
After giving his instructions, an invisible and heavy aura spread from Jack Clark, and instinctively the reporters in front of him cleared a path.
Just a hundred meters ahead was the old town, equivalent to the area of several residential complexes.
As Jack Clark strode forward, streams of red light flew out from the Sumeru Bracelet, crackling as they formed a suit of battle armor that covered his whole body while he walked.
The battle armor was primarily gold and red in color, with an elaborate and imposing design, and its surface was covered with gold and black strange patterns that looked like wandering Dragon Pythons.
These sinister patterns, under the reflection of the battle armor’s rings of golden and red radiance, exuded an invisible, ferocious, and grisly intent that was soul-shaking.
In addition, behind Jack Clark’s head, there were four white-gold gears slowly rotating, with the largest one having a diameter of more than eighty centimeters and the smallest one thirty centimeters.
Such elaborate and mystical battle armor immediately excited the reporters watching.
“This is the armor of the Light King he wore when he slayed a god.”
“Four layers of halo surround it, indicating that this suit of battle armor has reached the level of Top-tier Extraordinary Equipment. It’s said that normally only Eight Layer Heaven high-order powerhouses can forge such items.”
“It seems Darren Callum is not only fast in his cultivation but also has a terrifying talent in forging Extraordinary Equipment.”
Some of the cultivators watching from the distance recognized the forging level of the battle armor after Jack Clark put it on.
But such knowledgeable individuals were few, and the low-level cultivators one by one shouted with envy.
“So cool.”
“Damn, I didn’t know you could wear battle armor like this. I wish I had one too.”
“Dream on, brother. Do you know how difficult it is to forge a suit of battle armor that can split and combine, and merge itself automatically with a thought?”
“How difficult is it?”
“As high as a three-story building.”
It wasn’t just the people on site, but also the many watching the live stream around the world were exclaiming and shouting.
Just when everyone thought it was already impressive, the ground at Jack Clark’s feet suddenly shattered, and, with a crater with a diameter of a rod, he shot into the sky with a boom.
Upon leaping more than two hundred meters high, Jack Clark unfurled two pairs of three-meter-tall light wings above and a pair of shorter ones below that were formed of tangible flames.
Boom! The hot blast from the wings sent Jack Clark flying toward the center of the small city with a long trail of light.
“Wow! So cool.”
“Awesome, he’s got wings!”
“Totally epic.”
The audience in the live broadcast room witnessing this scene were all thrilled, shouting and exclaiming.
Damon Lopes was even more astonished, disbelieving, “I thought I had understood it, but I didn’t realize that Brother Callum’s realm was even higher than I had imagined.”
“I’ve had another epiphany.”
Gwen Gail was a bit curious, “Mr. Lopes, what did you realize?”
Damon Lopes said slowly, “I used to think that being subtly boastful was the essence, but I didn’t realize that within such boasting, there is a higher realm, a sequence of continuous boasts.”
“First, when Brother Callum got out of the car, he indifferently said it wouldn’t matter to him whether that guy made a breakthrough or not, that was the first boast.”
“Then, as everyone was shocked by his arrogance, he put on a splendid show with his battle armor, just when everyone thought that was boastful enough, he unfolded his wings.”

chapters.title: Chapter 533: 254: Villain Jack Clark, Pushing to a Higher Realm_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Chapter 254: Villain Jack Clark, Pushing to a Higher Realm_2
“To pull off a triple combo all at once, that really shook the audience to their core.”
Mathilda Ward covered her mouth and giggled lightly, “I thought you’d had a breakthrough in your cultivation, but it turns out it was this. I don’t think Brother Callum had ever thought about such things.”
Damon Lopes exclaimed in admiration, “That’s why I say Brother Callum’s realm is profound—showing off has become a habit for him, invisible yet natural.”
“Giggle giggle giggle! Brother Lopes, you are so funny. Although I also think Brother Callum was very handsome just now, he probably didn’t think about it that much.”
“Let’s go watch from the hillside over there.”
“The aftermath of a battle between high-ranking powerhouses is terrifying; even if they control the area during the fight.”
Soon, Mathilda Ward and the others arrived at a hillside over two hundred meters above the ground not far away.
The old town of Mason City was surrounded by hills; later, it was moved to the plains a few kilometers away under planned development, taking advantage of the mouth of the Three Rivers to prosper.
Now, these hills surrounding the old city served as perfect vantage points for watching the battle, with many ordinary cultivators standing on various small hills looking on.
Mathilda Ward’s group found a hill with fewer people to watch from.
But Lionel Lopez and the others were very vigilant, forming a human wall to separate Mathilda Ward, Damon Lopes, Gwen Gail, Crystal Boyce, and Marla Fiore from the rest.
Ordinary staff were also prohibited from coming close, by Jack Clark’s orders.
Apart from these cultivators observing the battle, there were also many drones floating around the old town area and a television station helicopter on the edge giving a live broadcast.
Bang!
A burst of radiance shot forth as Jack Clark descended from the sky, landing on the rooftop of a thirty-plus-story building. The ground trembled and cracked under his heavy steps.
Standing tall on the edge of the rooftop of a hundred-meter-high building, Jack Clark faced a bearded young man also standing on the rooftop of the building more than forty meters away, with an indifferent gaze.
Compared to Jack Clark dressed in his dazzling and imposing battle armor, Clyde, in his gray training attire and full beard, looked like a poor boy from the countryside.
This “poor” boy, seeking to save his mother, was about to challenge the God Slayer, whose name echoed around the world.
If he beat this ‘person’, he would stand a chance to resurrect his mother; if he lost… no, he absolutely could not afford to lose, nor would he allow it. With this determination, Clyde’s gaze turned incredibly firm.
“Darren Callum, today I will definitely defeat you.”
Looking at Clyde in his humble and simple attire, facing those eyes filled with a conviction of victory, Jack Clark felt oddly as if he were the villain.
Jack Clark said indifferently, “Many people have said that to me, but in the end, none could withstand even a single move from me.”
With that, radiance flickered, and the awe-inspiring and exaggerated Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, measuring 3.8 meters, appeared in Jack Clark’s hand. The weighty aura it emitted without form distorted the air around him.
Seeing that exaggeratedly huge weapon emanating a halo of light, the internet instantly erupted in amazement.
“He was so cocky just now, wasn’t he? Now he’s even taken out a weapon, while Clyde is unarmed. Even if he wins, his victory will not be honorable.”
“The guy above must be an idiot, Darren Callum follows the True Martial Way, his strength consists of the True Martial Arts, battle armor, and weapons.”
“As for Clyde, his cultivation is based on fist techniques, with his own body following the Genetic Martial Arts, focusing on physical strength, ultimately transforming into Unique Beasts and battling Giant Beasts.”
“Haha, there are so many newbies nowadays, actually saying Darren is dishonorable for using a weapon. Him using a weapon is the highest respect he can show to Clyde.”
Boom!
Tens of meters away, Clyde’s body exuded a Fist Intent full of destructive intent, rocketing skyward, conjuring a sinister shadow of a black monster behind him.
As the intent manifested into shadow, the free energy between heaven and earth crazily converged towards him, pouring into his body in an overwhelming stream and instantly bursting forth with terrifying Qi Blood.
The raging influx of Heavenly Energy caused Clyde’s muscles to swell, his veins bulged, and with a ripping sound, the upper part of his attire burst open.
In an instant, the aura of a Seventh Layer High-Rank shook heaven and earth. With the floors below him collapsing, Clyde turned into a black shadow and instantly appeared high in the sky, a hundred meters up.
His right fist clenched, he hurled a punch straight at Jack Clark.
Boom!
In that instant, the sky shook, the atmosphere within tens of meters shattered, forming a black fist print with a diameter of tens of meters.
Before the terrifying fist print could fall, the invisible Fist Intent had already crushed the half of the rooftop behind Jack Clark, collapsing several floors, with concrete exploding and smoke and dust billowing.
The literal storm that followed blew the flame-patterned ribbon at the back of Jack Clark’s neck into a frenzy.
And at that moment, an even more ferocious and overbearing aura burst forth from Jack Clark.
Roar!
In the void, there was even the roar of a dragon, and under the explosion of that terrifying aura, the air burst around him, creating circles of white real qi waves sweeping a range of tens of meters with Jack Clark at the center.
The invisible Fist Intent upon him was shattered by the unrivaled dominating aura.
Boom!
The eight-ton halberd swept across heaven and earth at several times the speed of sound. The extreme velocity and strength caused the air to explode, forming a gold and red fan-shaped radiance.
That was the plasma light formed by the pulverization and explosion of matter.
Boom! As the War Halberd swept across, the descending black fist imprint instantly disintegrated, exploded, creating a tangible shockwave that blasted open in the air.
In the ferocious blast, Clyde’s expression drastically changed, his arms folded in front of him; black real power burst from his body, forming a twenty-centimeter-thick armored shield.
Boom!
With the terrifying and heavy War Halberd materializing in an instant, Clyde became a blur as he was hurled backward, accompanied by a sonic boom wave, crashing into a four-story building hundreds of meters away.
Boom! Under the mighty impact, the small building collapsed, concrete exploded, and smoke and dust rolled.

chapters.title: Chapter 534: 254: Villain Jack Clark, Pushing to a Higher Realm_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Chapter 254: Villain Jack Clark, Pushing to a Higher Realm_3
“Was that Clyde just now?!”
In an instant, whether it was the cultivators on the nearby hills or the audience watching the live broadcast, everyone’s face revealed shock.
They had not expected the previously undefeated and monstrous Clyde to be sent flying by Jack Clark with a single hit, as easily as if swatting a fly.
But Clyde, at the peak of the Sixth-level Heaven, had previously defeated a mid-stage Seventh Layer Heaven powerhouse with just one move, and now he had achieved a breakthrough into the Seventh Layer Heaven, his strength undergoing a second qualitative change.
This
Not just the ordinary people but even Clyde himself, lying in the ruins of a large pit, couldn’t accept it.
He had actually been sent flying by the opponent with one hit?
His grand accomplishment of the Destruction Intent, which condensed his fist’s pressure and burst forth with ten-fold amplified Essence Blood strength, shattered to pieces under the heavy and overbearing War Halberd.
Roar! In a fury, Clyde let out an inhuman roar.
Boom!
The cement and rubble exploded, revealing a drastically transformed Clyde within the billowing smoke and dust.
At that moment, his entire body was covered with a shell-like black scale armor, transforming in the blink of an eye into a ten-meter-tall monster with a ferocious head and limbs with barbs at the joints.
After being sent flying by the total strength of his normal state with one punch, Clyde had directly entered into his Complete Beast Transformation.
In this form, Clyde was terrifying. His breath stirred up raging winds, and the overbearing strength that radiated from his body pressed down on the Earth beneath him, causing the surrounding air to whirl and stones to scatter.
Looking at the splendid figure standing tall on the rooftop of a hundred-meter building, under the influence of the Chaotic God Essence Blood, intense jealousy and brutality flashed in Clyde’s eyes.
He detested Darren Callum very much, or rather, he hated these geniuses surrounded by countless halos. Why should their lives be so splendid and spectacular,
while he had nothing, nothing at all.
Boom!
The Earth collapsed, forming a meteor crater tens of meters wide. Under the recoil of the tremendous force, Clyde disappeared instantly, teleporting to appear right above Jack Clark.
In the air, Clyde’s right fist was clenched, gathering indescribable Terrifying Power within, so much so that it even formed black streams that swirled around his arm.
In his beast form, all of Clyde’s strength was focused inward, and with a black fist, he launched a punch that detonated the air, creating Supersonic Speed shockwaves in front of his fist.
Boom!
A hundred-meter building collapsed thunderously, countless pieces of cement and rubble exploding and thrown hundreds of meters away, the rising smoke and dust almost engulfing half the city district.
As the smoke and dust slowly cleared, a circular pit dozens of meters in diameter was revealed, with Jack Clark inside, halberd held horizontally, blocking the huge fist above his head.
Comparatively, Jack appeared somewhat tiny standing next to the ten-meter-tall giant that was Clyde.
But no matter how fiercely Clyde raged and how much strength he exploded with, he could not shake Jack in the slightest. That tall and straight figure was unmoving, like a spear, unshakable.
This scene further infuriated Clyde, for Jack had not even burst forth with True Strength. He had only used an even more terrifying physical strength to catch Clyde’s beast form punch.
“Roar! Die.” In a rage, Clyde threw a punch with his left fist, determined to blast the despicable person in front of him into oblivion.
Just then, Jack’s right arm burst forth with power, his wrist shook, fending off the fist above his head, and his right foot rocketed skywards, kicking the air-blasted black fist on its descent.
Boom!
The moment the fist and foot met, the Earth shook, and the ground within a ten-meter radius once again crumbled, with rubble flying in all directions.
In the midst of the airborne dust, Claude was sent smashing through it, his massive form tossed dozens of meters into the air, then falling with a crash that collapsed a three-story building.
Hiss! Many people took a sharp intake of breath.
Because the fully beast-transformed Clyde was still no match for Jack Clark, casually sent flying twice in succession.
Moreover, at this point, Jack had not even exerted his full strength, not having burst forth with True Strength, but was simply dominating Clyde with a more terrifying physical power.
“Isn’t he a True Martial Practitioner? Why is his physical body so terrifying?”
“Yes, why does it seem like he’s the real beast in human form?”
At that moment, the War Halberd in Jack’s hand spat out ten meters of golden Radiance, swinging it casually.
Boom!
A vertical, golden War Halberd skill, dozens of meters tall and resembling a crescent moon, shot forth, splitting the Earth where it passed, cleaving buildings in half, and creating a Destruction Tunnel several dozen meters long.
Roar! Seeing the Halberd Skill suddenly appearing before him, Clyde let out a low roar and bellowed, punching out with a fist wrapped in swirling black currents.
The instant the Halberd Skill and fist connected, an endless burst of golden light erupted.
Boom!
With a terrifying explosion that could shatter the heavens and the Earth, the scorching air wave and dust storm shot out a hundred meters. Several drones that were a bit too close exploded instantly.
This sent the drones farther away into a frenzy, hastily flying far and high. The Television Station helicopter at the edge of the small city also quickly soared higher and farther, not daring to come too close.
It was too terrifying. The released Halberd Skill was almost as powerful as a High-Powered Missile, its impact covering a range of tens of meters.
This scene left many people in shock. Some of them had seen Seventh-level high-order powerhouses releasing True Strength, but the power was at least two levels lower than Darren’s strike.
“That’s too horrifying, isn’t it? He’s like a Human Missile Launcher.”
“Yes, he’s only at the Sixth Layer Heaven, so why does he seem scarier than a Seventh Layer late-stage high-ranking powerhouse?”

chapters.title: Chapter 535: 255: The Blood River Domain Shakes the World (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Chapter 255: The Blood River Domain Shakes the World (Seeking Monthly Pass)
“Eight high-definition surveillance satellites, two energy detection satellites have reached their designated positions, with a core monitoring range of twenty kilometers and a vague surveillance range of one hundred kilometers.”
“Field support personnel have arrived at the designated site”
“Report, the four Soul Crystals are temporarily unresponsive.”
“Monitor closely, Akunus is definitely lurking nearby, perhaps mingling among those crowds watching the excitement.”
“As a Veteran Evil God, Akunus has many tricks up his sleeve, including concealing the aura of his Divine Soul. It’s normal that the Soul Crystals can’t detect it before its power is activated.”
“Clyde challenging Darren Callum has drawn away Mathilda Ward’s strongest ‘Perception’ defense. Akunus surely won’t miss this opportunity.”
“Has General Lake arrived?”
“General Lake has reached the designated location, fifteen kilometers from Battle Central, within the range of the secret device. Both his aura and presence have been erased, and it won’t trigger Akunus’ God Soul Alert.”
“Tell General Lake that unless Akunus ‘truly’ emerges, he must not reveal himself regardless of the chaos outside, to avoid startling the quarry.”
“Given the strength displayed by Darren Callum and Damon Lopes, unless an Eighth Layer Expert appears, they should be able to handle any emergencies together.”
“Remember, our goal is to seal its Soul Source, lock down its True Body in the mythical world, and completely eliminate it.”
“Understood.”
At this moment, in the center of the explosion, where the missile-like Halberd Skill had detonated and the smoke and dust had dissipated, a towering figure covered in black shell scale armor, standing ten meters tall, appeared.
On Clyde’s shell-armored body, a number of small cracks of varying lengths were visibly healing at a rate detectable to the naked eye.
The explosive activation of the Overbearing True Dragon Power tore through his body’s protective True Strength as well as the alloy-like sturdy shell scale armor.
However, the mere explosion of the Halberd Skill had only caused him some barely noticeable minor injuries, which were healed in an instant as Earthly Energy surged into them.
Standing atop the Ruined Building, Jack Clark looked distantly at Clyde with a cold gaze and said indifferently, “Aren’t you going to admit defeat? You should know that you’re no match for me.”
While speaking, Jack’s gaze flickered subtly as he swept it in all directions. He extended his spiritual senses to the maximum, carefully distinguishing every gaze that fell on him.
Nothing?
Huff, huff! Clyde was breathing heavily, glaring at Jack in the distance, his voice a low rumble, “That was just a warm-up. The battle has only just begun.”
Boom!
As he spoke, a power within Clyde activated, igniting, and at that moment, a wildly tremendous aura erupted, forming raging flames.
Bang! The ground shattered, and Clyde vanished in an instant.
Boom!
Jack turned around and swept his halberd, the golden light shimmering as he instantly blocked the fist that had appeared behind him, followed by Clyde being blasted away with one hit.
Boom! A small building a hundred meters away collapsed, its sturdy concrete floors and brick walls all blown apart, turning into countless fragments that covered a radius of dozens of meters with a crackling noise.
Amid the violent wind and smoke, Clyde let out an angry roar and lifted the three-story building behind him.
The building partially collapsed as he lifted it off the ground and launched it at Jack with terrifying power, whipping up a violent wind wave.
In the instant the building was thrown, Clyde shattered the ground beneath him as he chased after it.
Boom! The half of the building exploded under the ring of light from Jack’s golden-enshrouded War Halberd. The dust and raging wind swept through, and every place the halberd passed, everything was destroyed.
Bang!
In the wind and dust, Clyde’s chest collapsed, he spat out blood, and his entire body was blasted over two hundred meters into the air, landing on the other side of the city district and collapsing a small building.
Immediately, the wind surged and the earth trembled.
Roar!
Letting out an angry roar, Clyde stood up again from the ruins, the blood-colored flames on his body burning even more intensely, his aura wild, shaking Heaven and Earth.
As he looked at the halberd-holding figure in the distance, Clyde, panting heavily with blood-red eyes, began to transform, his arms elongating with a crackling sound.
Whoosh!
This time Clyde didn’t shatter the earth beneath him but disappeared at a faster, more agile speed, turning into an afterimage weaving through the buildings, encircling Jack and looking for an opportunity to strike.
“What is he doing?”
“Looking for a chance to attack, probably.”
“No, I mean, Clyde is clearly no match for Darren, why doesn’t he just give up?”
“A martial artist’s battle is not only about strength and realm but also about combat awareness and martial skills, willpower, and endurance. Sometimes, a single moment of negligence can decide the victors.”
“And now that Clyde can still fight and has not used the shapeshifting talent he gained after the Seventh Layer breakthrough, why should he admit defeat?”
“Fair enough.”
Suddenly, a sharp, piercing howl resounded as Clyde rapidly swung his double claws, sending dozens of black energy blades, each over ten meters long, slashing at Jack from all directions.
Boom!
Centered around Jack, a six-meter-tall, ring-shaped golden wave of sharp Halberd Skill burst forth, shredding all the black energy blades.
As the golden ring of energy expanded to its ten-meter limit, Boom! The ground shook violently as the dazzling golden radiance exploded, destroying everything, with the wind howling.
In the midst of the wind and waves, Jack’s figure suddenly moved. With a sonic boom resonating through Heaven and Earth, Clyde was startled a hundred meters away as he moved rapidly, instinctively raising his arm to block.
Boom!
He was immediately sent flying by the suddenly appearing War Halberd, his massive body crashing through a dozen or so small buildings before coming to a halt, with dust filling the air.
Speed, not only you have it.

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 255: The Blood River Domain Shakes the World (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Chapter 255: The Blood River Domain Shakes the World (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
“`
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew to the peak of level eight, and even began breaking through to level nine, the feedback on Jack Clark’s physical body became increasingly terrifying, both in strength and speed.
Together with the Eight Desolute Battle Halberd, which weighed eight tons, the power that could be unleashed at close range, swinging at several times the speed of sound, was indescribably formidable.
Even Clyde, in his fully beast-transformed state, had no power to fight back in front of him.
This crushing situation left the audience, who expected a ferocious battle, somewhat disappointed, even wondering if Clyde had been overly hyped.
Were all those tales of a peerless prodigy, slaughtering through two countries, undefeatable in a single move, just false—were the martial arts hall’s strong men simply playing along with him?
Yet, as they looked at the nearly half-destroyed old town, people felt that perhaps Clyde was indeed strong; at the very least, he hadn’t been killed yet.
Roar!
An angry roar echoed between heaven and earth, and from afar, Clyde rose again, snapping his blown-off arm back into place with a crack, his face showing immense fury.
The opponent was too strong, so strong that it drove him to despair, but he couldn’t give up—he would never give up.
In an instant, Clyde’s already powerful aura of destruction burst forth, forming a twelve-meter-tall black shadow behind him that grew increasingly solid.
Under the pressure of despair brought on by Jack Clark, his Destruction Fist Intent took another step forward.
But it still wasn’t enough.
Under the pull of his strong will, an influx of Heavenly Energy rushed in, vibrating the air; the shadow forcibly absorbed this energy in a frenzy.
Argh!
Clyde let out a painful scream as his body expanded again to fifteen meters, and the red flames burning on him turned into a blinding eruption of light.
Boom!
A tremendous aura burst from the monster-like Clyde, his presence nearly increasing tenfold under the force of the Destruction Intent drawing in Heavenly Energy.
“Has he gone mad?”
“Forcibly compressing unrefined Heavenly Energy into one’s body can damage the foundation.”
As everyone watched the monstrous Clyde in a daze, a terrifying aura erupted among a group of more than a dozen people standing dozens of meters away from Mathilda Ward.
Boom!
An infinite sea of blood light engulfed everything, and the surrounding ordinary practitioners of the Second and Third Layers had no chance even to scream before they were dissolved by the blood light.
Roar, roar, roar!!
In the sky, a vision of a Sea of Blood emerged and, on the earth, a nine-headed blood python measuring dozens of meters in length roared into existence, hurtling toward Mathilda Ward with a devastating might that seemed capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Behind Mathilda Ward, the dancers and company employees let out terrified shrieks; some even sat on the ground with a warm flow of liquid running down beneath them.
Under the terrifying aura of an Evil God who had slaughtered millions, these ordinary people felt a fear as if they were facing heaven and earth themselves, immobile with despair and collapsed to the ground.
“In the name of the Daoist Master, halt!” Damon Lopes exploded with a destructive aura even more overbearing than Clyde’s.
Boom! Surrounding Damon Lopes, bolts of purple lightning as thick as arms twisted around him, and a two-meter-long, five-centimeter-wide purple thin sword appeared in his hand, with all the lightning converging on the blade.
Whistle! A piercing sound echoed between heaven and earth as the purple sword light, infused with boundless Thunder, burst forth, forming a spinning purple sword wheel fifteen meters in diameter that annihilated everything in its path.
Boom! The void exploded, lightning flashed.
Under the purple sword wheel, the nine-headed blood python disintegrated into a sky filled with blood light, revealing the long-haired youth within, engulfed by the blood light and exuding a terrifying aura.
Damon Lopes slowly said, “Akunus, you finally show yourself.”
The long-haired youth looked at them coldly, his gaze settling on Mathilda Ward behind him, speaking in a low voice, “I said I would personally reclaim everything.”
Damon Lopes sneered, “Do you think you can get past me, Daoist Master?”
“Maureen, take Sister Ilisa and the others away first.”
“Okay.” The Fox-eared girl’s expression was solemn.
“Maureen, take everyone away.”
Ying ying!!
The Six-Tailed White Fox guarding them, with tails swelling like pythons, scooped up Mathilda Ward, Marla Fiore, and the other ordinary people, rushing down the hillside.
But as the Snow Fox’s tails swirled, they created a ten-meter gap between the ordinary people and Mathilda Ward.
“We must hurry to keep up and ensure Miss Ward’s safety,” said Lionel Lopez and the other bodyguards, their expressions turning anxious as they quickly followed.
“Leave her to me.”
Akunus’s gaze turned icy as endless blood light transformed into roaring blood pythons behind him.
“You face me today, and it’s finally Daoist Master’s turn to slay a god,” Damon Lopes shouted excitedly as even more dazzling Thunder erupted from him.
Boom, boom! Several bolts of Thunder flashed down, exploding the blood pythons into filth, their Blood Fiend energy purified by the lightning and emitting a foul, burnt stench.
Immediately after, electricity enveloped Damon Lopes, and he shot out like a bolt of lightning, his purple long sword becoming a pure radiance in his hand.
“You think you can obstruct my path.”
With a cold growl, Akunus shattered a red blood vial in his hand, and an essence blood emitting a Level Nine terrifying aura was absorbed in an instant.
Boom!
Akunus’s presence skyrocketed; his body’s realm, initially at the Early Sixth Heaven, surged to the peak of the Six Heavens under the drive of the Level Nine Essence Blood, unleashing a fearsome aura.
Across two hundred meters, his Blood River Domain shimmered with blood light, dozens of meters-long blood pythons roaring, madly charging at the Thunder light that Damon Lopes had become.
In a moment, the hillside exploded, lightning flashed, blood pythons roared, and the ferocity of the combat was no less than that within the city.
Roar! The moment Akunus appeared, Clyde, in the old city, let out an angry roar, and with a loud bang, charged through the air at Jack Clark.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 255: The Blood River Domain, Global Shock (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Chapter 255: The Blood River Domain, Global Shock (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
“Seeking death.”
As Akunus made his appearance, Jack Clark, no longer interested in entangling himself with him, erupted with a terrifying and fierce aura, shaking heaven and earth in an instant.
In the shocked gazes of many, a phantom towering thirty meters high, with three faces and six arms, clad in sinister black and red scale armor, emerged behind Jack Clark.
His dual arms held halberds, while his four arms formed seals, supporting four rotating light wheels behind him.
Around the phantom, the atmosphere vibrated, and the energy of Heaven and Earth converged to form billowing air waves, appearing sacred and majestic, like the descent of a Light King.
“What is that?”
“True Martial Arts Phantom… No, that phantom, although it automatically gathers the energy of Heaven and Earth, is not cohesive enough. It’s not a true martial arts phantom; it’s a Rune Illusion.”
“I didn’t expect Darren Callum to have already taken half a step into the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“What a monster.”
“And there’s the battle on that hillside over there.”
“Everything’s in chaos.”
All of this happened in the blink of an eye, and under the sudden change, whether it was the onlooking cultivators from the other directions or those watching the live broadcast, everyone was a bit stunned.
“Take this move of mine, Eight Desolate Refining Hell.”
Boom!
Under the enhancement of the Combat Shadow, golden light shone from Jack Clark’s body, his aura skyrocketed, and three golden War Halberds, each over twenty meters long, engulfed Clyde in an instant.
Boom, boom, boom!! The three halberd shadows, like three intercontinental missiles, erupted instantly, creating an explosion that destroyed everything.
Under the terrifying golden shockwave, houses collapsed, roads broke apart, and a typhoon-like air wave swept up smoke and dust over ten meters high, blasting hundreds of meters away.
Such a ferocious strike left everyone in horrified awe.
Including Gwen Gail, who had already rushed down the hillside, and Crystal Boyce, who was also slightly stunned.
And just then, the tuning assistant Iris, being swept away by the fox’s tail, changed her expression, and threw out a disc engraved with a blood river pattern.
Boom!
With the Blood River Domain erupting with Miss Jodie at its center, endless blood light exploded, blanketing everything, swallowing up all present in the blink of an eye.
The sudden turn of events left many stunned. Hadn’t Akunus appeared?
“Seeking death.”
Within the blood-colored world, Lionel Lopez was the first to react, his Fourth Layer True Strength bursting forth, he struck towards Miss Jodie who was released by the Snow Fox with a palm strike.
Boom!
Under Lionel’s thick and Overbearing palm, the assistant named Jodie instantly exploded, her body blasted apart, and her flesh and blood sprayed in all directions.
Such a gory scene terrified the surrounding Group employees, turning their faces pale, some even vomited.
“Ordinary people?”
Lionel, Gwen Gail, Marla Fiore, and others all hesitated.
Mathilda Ward, looking at the bloodied remains on the ground, said gravely, “This is one of Akunus’s external divided spirits, similar to a Blood Seed, but it acts on the soul.”
“This type of external divided spirit will lurk within the bodies of those it has eroded, like a pre-set program. Normally, it goes unnoticed and emits no danger signals.”
“Because she is still herself, just that her soul has been eroded and contaminated deep within, and on the surface, everything seems as it was before, unless that thought is activated.”
“In such circumstances, even Brother Callum’s visual perception is useless. And because she was too weak, weak to the extent where Brother Callum couldn’t perceive even a hint of danger or abnormality.”
As Mathilda and the others wore grave expressions, the Blood River Domain had fully unfolded, blanketing half of the abandoned urban area and several nearby hillsides.
Inside, everything turned a dark red, as if Doomsday had come.
And from a high-altitude view of the Outer World, it looked like a ten-kilometer wide, red inverted bowl appeared on the Earth, ethereal and transparent, as if it were the projection of another world.
In this dark red world, the Earth cracked open constantly, thick blood flowing out of the cracks, emanating a strong scent of blood.
This terrifying scene made those Group members who had followed to see the action tremble with fear, especially the bald tuner, who was pale and frightened.
He’d never imagined that the pretty assistant he had been training for almost two months had a problem and had thrown such a terrifying thing that enveloped them all.
He could never have guessed that such a pretty assistant would be instantly blown apart by Lionel’s palm.
Whoosh!
At that moment, the powerful aura of the three-meter-long Snow Fox burst forth, and in a blink, it transformed into a Mutated Beast twenty meters long, with a tail nearly forty meters long.
Then, powerful waves of air surged, separating Mathilda, Gwen Gail, Crystal, and Marla from the rest with the strong gusts.
The assistant’s sudden mutation had filled them with wariness toward these ordinary people, unsure if they had any more ‘spies’ among them.
At that time, the far-off Earth that had cracked open had turned into a blood river, with blood waves roaring, and countless sinister figures struggling and wailing inside, like malevolent spirits.
Seeing the still-living Mathilda and others afar, those red blood shadows in the river of blood boiled furiously, struggling wildly to climb out.
“Wuuu!!”
These lifelike blood shadows shed blood as they fell, emitting a foul smell, screaming in agony, with terrifying blood-stained faces charging madly at the people.
Thump, thump, thump!!
With six white halos of light tracing along them, six tails exploded with power, each over a hundred meters long. The Blood Demons, exuding auras of Third and Fourth Layers, burst into pieces the moment they were hit, clearing the vicinity in a blink.
Roar!
Suddenly, the Snow Fox let out a ferocious roar. The powerful vibrations shattered the Earth in front of it, and the blood shadows merging with the ground were vibrated into smithereens.
As a Level 6 Peak Monarch-level Mythical Beast, this Six-Tailed White Fox was immensely powerful—enough to blow apart contenders of the same level with one strike, let alone these Third and Fourth Layers Blood Demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 538: 255: Blood River Domain, Global Tremors (Seeking Monthly Pass)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Chapter 255: Blood River Domain, Global Tremors (Seeking Monthly Pass)_4
It had just finished killing those Blood Demons when even more Blood Demons surged out of the blood river in the distance, numbering in the hundreds.
And behind them, from the river, even more Blood Demons emerged, swarming densely and rushing madly towards Mathilda Ward and the others in the distance, with a terrifying momentum.
Outside the city.
Watching the blood-red transparent world that engulfed everything in the distance, all the cultivators observing the battle from another direction outside the city were shocked and frightened, especially by the countless fierce Blood Demons.
“Quick, aim two cameras over there.”
“Big news, this challenge of Clyde against Darren Callum was a conspiracy; the Evil God Sect, who had attacked Mathilda Ward before, has made a move again.”
“This time, they used Clyde to draw away Darren Callum and had another strong man from the Evil God Sect divert Damon Lopes, leaving Mathilda Ward’s defenses severely weakened.”
The reporters went crazy, with one even risking his life to rush to the edge of the Blood River Domain, his camera clicking furiously as he photographed the inside.
Audiences around the globe watching this battle were stunned, not anticipating so many unforeseen developments in the challenge.
And these changes happened in the blink of an eye, right as the smoke and dust from Jack Clark’s devastating strike slowly began to clear.
In the distance, the ground shattered, forming a meteoric crater over forty meters in diameter, with all the buildings within a hundred meters collapsing due to the blast’s aftershocks, clearing out an open space.
In the center of the crater, Clyde, who had reverted to human form, was in tattered clothes, barely breathing, with almost every bone in his body shattered, hanging by a thin thread of life.
This was still under the circumstances of Jack Clark showing restraint; otherwise, the full strength burst of the Eight Desolate Refining Hell’s Nine Halberds merging into one would have instantly blown him into untraceable fragments.
Jack Clark glanced indifferently at Clyde and then, with a flicker of his figure, appeared in the blink of an eye on the rooftop of a damaged tall building a hundred meters away, looking towards the distant blood river.
He had not expected that assistant to be problematic.
Sure enough, it was a King-level existence. After confirming that his perceptual methods were vision and spirit sensing, the assistant managed to completely shield himself to the point of concealing all danger.
However, Jack Clark and Mathilda Ward had actually had some premonitions about this situation; otherwise, they would not have allowed those people to follow them when they set off.
He had long suspected that someone inside the company might have issues.
After all, if Akunus couldn’t mount a direct offensive or couldn’t match their opponent head-on, the only thing left to do was to take a stealthy approach to get close to Mathilda Ward through other means.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s earpiece transmitted sound from the base.
“Darren Callum, that blood river was refined by Akunus during his peak at the Nine-fold level, but before it was completed, he was seriously injured by the True Martial Heavenly King and fled to the mythical world.”
“And that Blood River Domain was also cast into the Void, disappearing from sight.”
“Unexpectedly, he has managed to summon back this domain weapon, and by the looks of it, the weapon’s level has dropped.”
“However, the special properties of the Blood River still exist; inside are innumerable Blood Demons formed from the incomplete souls of those Akunus has killed, gathered by blood and possessing one-tenth of the strength the souls had in life.”
“Since the souls are bound by the Blood River, the Blood Demons will not perish as long as the Blood River doesn’t dry up. Moreover, the Heavenly Energy inside is depleted, with True Strength lessening by the moment, making it extremely challenging.”
“We must find a way to break the Blood River Domain with external forces and rescue Mathilda Ward and the others; otherwise, the Six-Tailed White Fox will not last long under the siege of innumerable Blood Demons.”
