“But at the moment, Akunus’s ‘True Body’ has yet to appear, and the one fighting Damon Lopes only has a Divine Soul-like spirit power but lacks the fluctuations that would indicate the Soul Source.”
“Because of the Blood God Demonic Tome, Akunus has the ‘talent’ to separate different thoughts and even the Soul Source, making him even more difficult to deal with than demon kings like Kautorus.”
“Without locating its Soul Source, General Lake cannot reveal himself; otherwise, startling it now might result in Akunus abandoning the ‘dragon.’
In his desire for the dragon, Akunus would certainly choose to abandon it if faced with the risk of his Soul Source being sealed and his True Body being locked in and falling. Without the dragon, his only loss would be a decline in strength, but if his Soul Source were sealed by the Human Race, he could only hide behind The Purgatory Family for a lifetime as a shrinking turtle.”
And The Purgatory Family was not to be messed with.
If they discovered he had no value to them, who knows? Maybe one of the Great Demon Kings would capture him and directly use him to create a demonic weapon.
Therefore, Akunus would be extremely cautious, not revealing his ‘True Body’ even under these circumstances.
Jack Clark looked at the battlefield in the distance, where thunder and lightning exploded continuously, with a grave expression, “To be able to hold back from appearing at this time, how cautious.”
“But the Blood River does not run dry, and the Blood Demons do not perish?”
Looking at the flowing blood-colored world in the distance, Jack Clark crouched slightly, then boom! The floors collapsed, and his entire being turned into a golden radiance soaring into the sky.
As Jack Clark, leaping hundreds of meters high, neared the phantom of the Blood River, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils emerged in the depths of his eyes, and a powerful pupil force erupted.
Hum!
Under the power of the Void Double Pupils, the blood-colored ‘space’ in front was suddenly frozen.
Boom!
The Blood River Domain, which Akunus was confident could only be broken by Mid-eighth level power, crumbled like a mirror under the impact of a Golden Glittering Battle Halberd.
In the Blood River World, the sky roared and shattered, as cracks spread for hundreds of meters, and from the dark hollow above, a golden figure descended from the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 539: 256: Killing Hundreds of Thousands, The Emperor Dragon Transforms
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Chapter 256: Killing Hundreds of Thousands, The Emperor Dragon Transforms
Boom!
Upon the shattered ‘Firmament,’ Jack Clark descended from the sky in golden red gorgeous battle armor, with gears spinning and ribbons of flame dancing behind him.
As he swung his War Halberd in his hands, tens of meters of golden halberd blades shot out like lasers, tearing through the atmosphere and producing thunderous roars akin to wind and thunder.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Under the terrifying might of the Halberd Skill, the earth shattered, the halberd’s might crushing everything in its surroundings to bits, instantly blasting dense swarms of Blood Demons into the sky as a mist of dirty blood, creating a hundred-meter radius no-man’s-zone.
The explosion whipped up a violent energy that turned into a raging wind, blasting out hundreds of meters; the Six-Tailed White Fox used its six tails to circle around and shield against the shockwave that came rushing over.
“It’s Darren Callum.”
“We are saved.”
Seeing that figure who crushed the earth and stood before them holding a halberd, those beautiful and sexy accompanying girls and staff members let out cries of surprise and joy.
As a man who had once slain gods, Jack Clark was, in the eyes of these ordinary people, synonymous with power and invincibility.
Looking at that solid and towering figure, they suddenly felt a strong sense of security.
As he faced the countless Blood Demons rushing towards them like a tide, Jack Clark said in a deep voice, “Gwen Gail, you take Maureen and protect Miss Ward… and everyone else. Leave these Blood Demons to me.”
“Yeah, yeah!! Don’t worry, Brother Callum. I’m really powerful.” The girl excitedly nodded her head.
As she spoke, a divine aura burst forth from the girl’s body, and her black hair whooshed and turned snow-white, her brow revealing a mark resembling eight tails with no wind around her.
Immediately, Gwen Gail reached out and pressed her hand on the Six-Tailed White Fox Maureen’s calf.
Boom!
With Gwen Gail’s bloodline strength reinforcing her, the aura around the Six-Tailed White Fox surged, but this time it was not strength that bloated but rather recovery.
The energy spent obliterating thousands of Blood Demons in a short amount of time was replenished at a terrifying speed, and in the blink of an eye, the aura returned to its peak condition.
This was one of Gwen Gail’s bloodline abilities, allowing her to rapidly heal and restore the energy of fox-type exotic beasts.
She had intended to reserve it for a critical moment later on, but now, with Jack Clark’s arrival, she no longer held back and allowed the Six-Tailed White Fox to remain in peak condition at all times.
Thud, thud, thud, thud!!
The six hugely inflated hundred-meter-long fox tails, like white lightning, blasted all approaching Blood Demons nearby, forming an unshakable fortress.
Wail, wail, wail!!
As the saying goes, “When people exceed ten thousand, there are no bounds,” and when over ten thousand Blood Demons clambered out from the Blood River and furiously rushed toward them, the sight was indeed terrifying.
Especially since the weakest of these Blood Demons all exhibited Triplex auras, many at the Fourth, Fifth, or Sixth Layer, with speeds of several tens of meters per second, like streaks of red light sprinting towards them.
Boom!
Jack Clark burst through the air, turning into a golden radiance plunging into the red ocean, and in an instant, countless Blood Demons exploded.
In the face of the Halberd wielded at Supersonic Speed, everything was obliterated, regardless of the Blood Demons emitting an aura from the Triplex to the Sixth Layer or how powerful their burst of attacks were.
Under the golden light circulating around the halberd, everything was shattered.
Even because the matter was too dense and the speed too fast, the rapid swings formed long blue light trails, with the vacuum pressure of the slashes covering an area of tens of meters.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
With hundreds of Blood Demons exploding every second and dirty blood scattering, even the sky began to rain with bloody rain, painting a scene of terror and fear.
It was then that Jack Clark erupted with a terrifying killing intent, surrounded by blood light.
Bathed in blood, reflecting Hell.
Boom! In the glow of the blood light, a vision of a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood appeared around Jack Clark, actually a hallucinatory domain formed by the explosion of Battle Intent.
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s eyes slowly turned bloody red, and the surrounding blood light solidified into tangible red Killing Intent, even with strands of Blood Evil Qi wafting around the halberd.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
As the Battle Intent surged, every Blood Demon Jack Clark blasted apart contributed a strand of red blood fiend to the Hell around him, and the blood light swirling about him grew stronger.
Passive Battle Intent, Thirst for Killing: During battle, slaying enemies absorbs the formless Blood Fiend to boost the power of Battle Intent, the more life taken, the stronger the Intent grows.
Suddenly, within that ocean of swarms of Blood Demons, a figure surrounded by blood light shone, sweeping through everything, unstoppable and unblockable.
In just a few minutes, he terrorized and slaughtered tens of thousands of Blood Demons, with tangible streams of blood-colored energy swirling all around him, his presence growing ever more formidable.
In that moment, Jack Clark was like the God of Death descending into Hell.
Even Crystal Boyce, who had seen much of the world, wore a shocked expression at the terrifying Killing Intent emanating from his body.
But as long as the Blood River did not dry up, the Blood Demons would not perish.
Just as Jack Clark paused for a brief rest, countless Blood Demons that had died in the Blood River rose up again, albeit weaker this time.
Boom! As countless Blood Demons surged forward, the battle erupted once more.
Right then, Jack Clark’s body was shielded by only a layer of True Power Protection, wrapped around the halberd, not deploying powerful Combat Techniques, relying solely on brute strength and extreme speed.
In such a situation, even if he fought non-stop for three days and nights, he wouldn’t tire.
Under this mad slaughter, Jack Clark’s Battle Intent grew stronger and stronger, edging closer to minor completion, with the surrounding blood light becoming increasingly horrifying, godly, and demonic.
All of this was live-streamed by a helicopter hovering in the distance, witnessed by countless people around the globe.
Someone swallowed nervously, “His movement speed must have reached at least twice the speed of sound, seven hundred meters a second. It’s too terrifying, and he hasn’t even made the Seventh Layer breakthrough yet.”
“Do you see? Every swing of the halberd in his hand produces a dark blue light, that is the phenomenon of matter being instantly pulverized and burned.”

chapters.title: Chapter 540: 256: Killing Hundreds of Thousands, The Emperor Dragon Transforms_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Chapter 256: Killing Hundreds of Thousands, The Emperor Dragon Transforms_2
“It’s too terrifying.”
“So scary, he’s killed tens of thousands of ‘people’ in just a moment, hasn’t he?”
“It feels like ordinary people are no different from ants in front of these high-level cultivators.”
“Yeah…”
“Don’t panic, everyone. As a Sixth Heaven cultivator, he must have used some kind of Secret Skill for instantaneous speed burst, otherwise, he couldn’t achieve such a terrifying speed.”
“But in the face of those undying monsters, isn’t he afraid of exhausting his strength and getting torn to pieces?”
At this moment, not only were the cultivators watching from a distance holding their breath in shock, but also the tens of millions of people watching the live broadcast.
They were shocked by the terrifying combat power Jack Clark had displayed, and by the insignificance of ordinary people in the face of high-level powerhouses.
Facing a high-ranking powerhouse with a speed surpassing that of sound, a strong body, True Power Protection, and a casual strike comparable to a missile explosion, ordinary people had no strength to resist.
This impact from the slaughter of tens of thousands of ‘cultivators’ could not be compared to the past videos of martial arts hall strong men.
In front of the TV, a teenage girl asked in confusion, “Dad, aren’t you also a Seventh Layer High-Rank powerhouse? Why do I feel like Darren Callum is even stronger than you?”
“Didn’t the internet say his cultivation is only at the Sixth Heaven?”
“It’s different, that guy is a monster, although his cultivation is only at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, his True Strength is limitless.”
“Especially that destructive power he burst out instantly, it even surpasses the Late Seventh Layer Heaven.”
At this moment, except for the officials who already knew about Jack’s terrifying endurance, the sight of him slaughtering at least ‘a hundred thousand’ had everyone in complete shock.
That included Damon Lopes and Akunus, who were fighting in the distance.
They were also seeing such a monster for the first time, slaughtering cultivators one or two realms lower as if they were chopping chickens.
Though these Blood Demons only had instincts, no battle armor, weapons, or even combat techniques to speak of, it still demonstrated how terrifying Jack was.
Boom!
As the number of slain surpassed a hundred thousand and the battle raged, Jack’s realm of thought condensed, his Battle Intent achieved a minor breakthrough, and an even stronger intent burst forth instantly.
The Blood Sea Hell that surrounded him grew even more realistic and terrifying as it surged from thirty to forty meters by absorbing a massive amount of Blood Evil Qi.
And with each successive kill by Jack, the actual number of Blood Demons, which was only in the tens of thousands, weakened exponentially.
Those Blood Demons were actually one of the foundations of the Blood River Domain, a key part of Akunus’s plan. Sensing the change in his domain, it let out an angry roar.
“Darren Callum, you must die.”
Boom!
A Terrifying Aura exploded from Akunus, and in his hand, blood light swirled, forming a rune similar to an ouroboros, whose Aura caused Damon Lopes’s expression to change slightly.
“Lawful Seal!”
“Go to hell.”
As Akunus slammed his palm down, the Lawful Seal, which consumed thirty percent of his Divine Soul’s power, exploded, transforming into a blood python phantasm hundreds of meters long.
Boom! At the strike of the blood python phantasm, an entire hillock exploded, collapsed, with the earth-shattering sounds and echoing explosions that followed.
The shockwave raised a cloud of smoke and dust that shot out hundreds of meters, mixing with countless shattered stones pitter-pattering in the distance and destroying several drones in high altitude.
The sudden burst of action drew the attention of many.
With one strike, Akunus not only forced Damon Lopes back but also transformed into a blood light that shot towards the Blood River Domain in the distance.
“Daoist Master stays behind, your opponent is me.”
“Heaven and Earth without limit, Sky and Heaven Thunder!” Instantly, a terrifying aura exploded from Damon Lopes.
Boom!
The clouds above ten thousand meters roared, thunder flashed, and the weak charge contained within the clouds was forcibly drawn out, turning into dazzling thunderbolts that descended from the sky.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Dozens of thunderbolts, as thick as thighs and filled with a destructive aura, descended from the sky and in an instant engulfed Akunus, causing its body to explode with blood light and leaving huge craters on the Earth.
However, after taking more than a dozen thunderous blows from Damon Lopes, Akunus’s Aura plummeted as he turned into a blood light and rushed into the Blood River World, diving into the Blood River.
At that moment, the entire Blood River Domain erupted.
Simultaneously, alarms sounded at the Military Base.
“Soul Source fluctuation detected.”
“Akunus’s True Body is in the Blood River Domain.”
“General Lake, it’s time to make a move.”
As the voice fell, a Late Eighth Layer aura exploded fifteen kilometers away, shaking Heaven and Earth, and then rapidly approached.
But just then, a ferocious Demon Power exploded on another side.
Ten kilometers away from the battlefield, a giant black creature appeared, its aura locking onto the quickly approaching Lake.
“Demon-Slaying Puppet!”
In front of that puppet, which was imbued with the power of the law yet had a flesh body comparable to the Eighth Layer, even Lake’s expression changed slightly.
Because the most terrifying thing about the Demon-Slaying Puppet was its dreadful speed and the indestructible cutting blades of its arms, a horrifying weapon capable of tearing through the domains of the Ninth Heavens.
An intense battle erupted instantly.
“General Lake has been entangled by a Demon-Slaying Puppet. General Brian Rainly, please hurry to offer support,” came the urgent call.
Instantaneously, over two hundred kilometers away, an aura that also reached the Late Eighth Layer burst forth, and it approached at an astonishing speed.
Meanwhile, Damon Lopes, who was chasing after Akunus, maneuvered the Purple Thunder Light; his hand-held sword gleamed, drawing down thunderbolts from the sky and striking the Blood River Domain.
“Damn it, come out, your opponent is Daoist Master here!”
The thunderous Sword Light shook the Blood River Domain, but without the ‘pure strength’ of a Mid-Eighth Level, it simply couldn’t disturb the Boundary Wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 541: 256: Killing Hundreds of Thousands, The Emperor Dragon Transforms_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: Chapter 256: Killing Hundreds of Thousands, The Emperor Dragon Transforms_3
Boom!
Just then, the Blood River shook with endless Blood Qi converging. The Blood River Domain disappeared, and a nine-headed Blood Python, a hundred meters long, emerged upon the Earth.
Around the half-erect, several dozen meters tall nine-headed Blood Python, a mist-like blood light whirled, emitting the terrifying aura of the initial stage of Eight Layer Heaven.
Boom! The Void exploded, blood light flashed, and a thick tail thirty meters long and five meters in diameter penetrated the void, instantly appearing in front of Damon Lopes.
Boom!
The lightning around Damon Lopes, who was evenly matched with Akunus moments ago, collapsed, and he was blasted hundreds of meters away to crash violently against the hillside.
Half of the hillside collapsed with thunder flickering amidst the billowing smoke and dust.
Instantly, the faces of many turned pale.
Damon Lopes was a strong man not weaker than Jack Clark, yet he couldn’t even withstand a single move from Akunus in this form.
Jack Clark’s expression also tightened as he looked at Akunus, who was forming the true body of the Blood Python with the Blood River Domain from afar. Even he felt immense pressure.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Under the powerful aura of Eight Layer Heaven, Heaven and Earth shook, the wind howled, like a creature from the apocalypse, the nine-headed Blood Python raised a flood of blood light and pounced toward Mathilda Ward in the distance.
The nine python heads opened their massive jaws, unleashing powerful Devouring force enough to swallow the heavens and the earth.
“Return my dragon.”
“Be careful.” Crystal Boyce erupted with the peak aura of Fifth Layer Heaven, True Strength flashing as she positioned herself in front of Mathilda Ward.
Simultaneously, White Fox Thea’s white tails exploded in size, turning into hoops that wound around her under the White Light, forming a circle to protect everyone behind her from the Blood Python’s Devouring force.
The Eighth Level Beasts that the Thunderflame Emperor Beast encountered didn’t seem very strong from their performance.
But when ordinary people or advanced cultivators face an Eighth Level Beast, it’s almost complete despair; just the inherent breathing suction force alone could swallow Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
Just then, a thirty-meter-long Golden War Halberd containing a Blood Hell within tore through the blood-colored Cloud Mist, striking the middle of the nine-headed Blood Python.
A terrifying explosion ensued.
Boom!
The Infernal Purgatory, now exponentially more powerful by sealing the Sea of Blood, exploded like an intercontinental missile, its power devastating, instantly destroying three of Akunus’s python heads.
The destructive golden shockwave flipped Akunus’s massive body over and blasted it dozens of meters away.
However, given the massive size of Akunus’s blood python form, being blasted dozens of meters was akin to rolling over on the ground, which made him, who was so confident moments ago, appear rather disheveled.
“Roar! Darren Callum, you’re courting death.”
Angered by the sight of the golden figure holding a halberd, Akunus sent out a furious roar.
Perhaps it was the fusion with the Blood River Domain that made Akunus lose his usual calm and sly demeanor; he seemed much more irritable in this state.
Watching the Blood Python regain its nine heads in the blink of an eye, Jack Clark slowly said, “Your opponent is me.”
With that, Jack Clark activated the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Rune merged with his Sea of Consciousness and shadow of will, instantly igniting the True Dragon Power and Blood Qi within his body.
Boom!
With a burst of fierce and overwhelming terrifying aura, Jack Clark’s figure swelled, his body released endless power, the sky trembled, and the Earth cracked.
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark had grown to 2.5 meters tall, his body covered in black and red Dragon Scales, with golden red flames burning around him and blue arcs leaping about.
Such horrific power even affected the magnetic field around him, causing the debris within a range of tens of meters to jitter and subsequently levitate and rotate around Jack Clark as the center.
This astounding spectacle left Lionel Lopez and others hundreds of meters behind him dumbstruck.
It was also captured by the few drones that remained at a distance.
As for the Television Station’s helicopters, they didn’t dare approach within a one-mile radius, and even the host urged them to fly further away.
Such abnormally destructive power in battle was terrifying, with a one-mile range effectively becoming negligible.
While she loved chasing hot news stories, she didn’t wish to one day become the news herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 542: 257 Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Chapter 257 Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Pass)
“Roar! Divine Rune Transformation, no wonder the Kautorus Demon King phantom entering your body didn’t kill you.”
Watching Jack Clark, who stepped into the Eight Layer Heaven enveloped in dragon aura, resembling an unrivalled ferocious dragon, Akunus showed a grave look in all nine of his eyes.
Jack’s voice, terrifying and resounding, boomed, “It’s not just that, today you too will be slain by my halberd.”
As he spoke, the golden light from the war halberd in his hands shone brightly, and in an instant, it swelled to eight meters long, with the shaft as thick as a thigh, and the double-bladed war blade reaching a width of 1.5 meters.
Such a crude and huge weapon once again made countless people widen their eyes and open their mouths in shock.
Especially Glenn Clark watching the live broadcast upstairs couldn’t help but shout, “Mom, come up and see, Bro’s weapon has gotten so big all of a sudden.”
Downstairs Doris Clark, who had just returned from work and was about to cook, looked up with surprise, “What got so big?”
“It’s the weapon that is big, Mom, come and see quickly, bro has become so fierce, he’s going to fight the monster.”
While Glenn was excitedly watching the live broadcast, an explosion occurred at the collapsed hillside in the distance, and Damon Lopes emerged, dust-covered and disheveled.
Catching sight of the massive Nine-headed Blood Python, he grimaced and called out to Jack, who was transformed, “Brother Callum, I’ll leave that one to you, I’m in charge of looking after Sister Ilisa and the others.”
Jack’s voice reverberated deeply, “Okay.”
As soon as he spoke, blue lightning danced around Jack, the ground within a ten-meter radius collapsed, and with a bang, he disappeared from the spot.
Roar!
The Nine-headed Blood Python let out an angry roar, as the blood-colored domain, spreading a hundred meters and filled with corroding blood mist to its left, instantly collapsed under the Golden War Halberd.
Boom boom boom!!
Jack, burning with golden-red Blood Flame and exhibiting unrivaled domination, continued to smash the domain powers pressing in from all directions with absolute strength, appearing thunderously beneath the Nine-headed Blood Python.
Roar roar roar!!
The furious Blood Python roared, its nine massive heads sweeping toward Jack like Flood Dragons emerging from the sea, creating turbulent waves of raging wind.
Boom boom!! Jack swept his war halberd horizontally, blasting the air and sweeping up storms of wind and thunder, exploding two gigantic python heads with invincible might.
Immediately after, he vanished from the spot.
Boom boom boom!! Three massive python heads came crashing down from the sky, instantly exploding into blood light, and the ground within a hundred-meter radius collapsed, the shockwave sending raging wind sweeping across hundreds of meters.
At the same time, the other four python heads that lost their target opened their mouths angrily, and blood-colored light beams erupted, chasing after Jack and bombarding him.
Wherever the blood-colored light beams passed by, the ground exploded.
“Be careful!”
Damon Lopes, standing in front of Ilisa and the others, swung his long sword, creating two sword wheels of thunder crossing in front of him, the Sword Qi distorting the void, deflecting a blood-colored light beam.
Boom! As the beam swept by, rows of small buildings a hundred meters away exploded one after another.
This move, a special technique developed by humans against the Breath of Giant Beasts, could deviate the course of the Breath if the difference in power was not insurmountable.
The other two Beams of Breath aimed at Jack were also dodged by him with a flash.
The blood-colored beams swept across the earth, leaving two grand canyons in their wake before exploding onto a hillock thousands of meters away.
“Run quickly.”
“Be careful.” In an instant, the faces of dozens of ordinary cultivators watching the excitement on the hill changed dramatically.
Boom boom!!
With a violent explosion, half of the hillside collapsed.
Just then, the Golden War Halberd enveloped with blood Qi surged into the sky, flashing like lightning, and the four python heads it passed exploded immediately.
Roar!
Akunus, left with only two python heads, let out an angry roar, and dashed lightning-fast at Jack in the air. The python heads reached Supersonic Speed in an instant.
Jack, with wings of light unfolding behind him in midair, blasted out air waves to flip and dodge the interlocking bites of the two python heads.
But at that moment, the void twisted, and the Blood Python’s thick tail pierced through the void to appear right below Jack, with the white waves at supersonic speed roaring down, exploding everything.
Jack, unable to dodge in time, held the halberd across to block.
Thud!
Under the blow from the Blood Python’s tail, powerful enough to collapse a hillock, Jack shot into the sky like a cannonball, reaching an altitude of over a thousand meters in the blink of an eye.
Boom!
The colors of heaven and earth changed.
Jack’s body shimmered with red light, transforming into a fifty-meter wide Blood Hell. Behind him, the phantom of a Three-faced Six-armed Will appeared again, swirling with Heavenly Energy.
Besides, two blurry giant shadow phantoms emerged from the void.
One majestic presence, resembling an elephant with some dragon characteristics, covered in scale armor, radiating a suppressive, overbearing, and terrifying holy grandeur.
The other phantom seemed much fuzzier and smaller than the Divine Might Dragon Elephant Shadow, but the intangible fierce aura it emitted was even more terrifying.
Roar roar!!
Enveloped in Divine Might, with the strength of the Emperor Dragon and the projection of his Blood Sea Field, Jack turned into a dazzling red beam of light that descended from the sky, with thunder exploding between heaven and earth.
Roar roar roar!! Seeing the terrifying light falling from the sky and unable to dodge, being locked by Will, Akunus let out an angry roar.
The nine regenerated python heads intertwined, surrounded by a blood mist, appearing like a Blood Dragon ascending to heaven amidst a tribulation.
Boom!
With ghostly wails and divine howls, the python heads exploded one by one, and then the giant body of Akunus was also penetrated and exploded, turning into a sky of splattered blood.
The halberd that had pierced through the Blood Python continued unabated, becoming a golden-red light beam that slashed into the earth.
Boom! The earth trembled and shattered.
In an instant, everyone present lost their hearing, only feeling the world shaking.
Damon Lopes and the Six-tailed Snow Fox changed color dramatically, unleashing all their power in an explosion.

chapters.title: Chapter 543: 257: Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of the Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Chapter 257: Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of the Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
Under the terrifying strike, the Earth hundreds of meters away roared like boiling sea waves, countless chunks of dirt were thrown in all directions, sweeping across the area like cannonballs.
The powerful shockwave kicked up winds of up to grade fourteen, sweeping away everything in its path, lifting rocks and sand into the air, a frightening force to behold.
Spectators, including the television reporters who had escaped several kilometers away and were standing in a helicopter hundreds of meters high, were left stunned by such a terrifying strike.
As were the viewers watching the live broadcast.
Roar roar roar!!
Just then, amid the intense center of the explosion, a blood light shone fiercely, and the terrifying roars of ferocious python heads coalesced from the light, unleashing brutal cries.
As long as the blood river does not dry, the Blood Demon will not perish, and so it was with Akunus, now merged with the blood river.
However, at this moment, its strength had weakened immensely, having fallen from the early phase of the Eighth Layer to the pinnacle of the Seventh Layer of Heaven’s realm, its body also shrinking to just over eighty meters.
Boom! Amidst the raging smoke and dust, an eight-meter-long War Halberd appeared out of nowhere, and under the invisible heavy pressure it exerted, a python head exploded in an instant.
“Roar! Darren Callum.”
Bang bang bang bang!!
Under the flash of golden red light, the nine freshly reformed python heads of Akunus instantly collapsed, followed by its massive body exploding spectacularly under the slash of the War Halberd.
Boom!
Wrapped in the halberd’s skill, a strike of over twenty meters in length created a deep pit, carving out a crack hundreds of meters long and several meters wide.
Roar!
At that moment, the blood light shone again, with the enormous blood python reforming, its nine newly-reduced heads about to unleash an angry roar…
Boom boom boom boom!!
The body of Akunus kept exploding, the ground collapsing, and smoke and dust billowed as countless pieces of dirt and rocks were propelled hundreds to thousands of meters away under the Destructive Impact.
Under this terrifying power, the ground within a range of dozens of kilometers trembled slightly, leaving everyone’s face in shock, staring blankly at the dust-covered region in the distance.
No one knew how intense the fight was inside.
Almost three and a half minutes later, the earth-shattering tremors and explosions suddenly ceased.
Lionel Lopez swallowed hard, “Is it over?”
Feeling the dissipating scent of blood in the distance, Damon Lopes spoke slowly, “It’s over, Blood God Acunus has been slain by Brother Callum.”
“Phew! We finally won.” Gwen Gail heaved a sigh of relief.
Including Mathilda Ward, Crystal Boyce, and Marla Fiore, everyone’s faces lit up with smiles, having finally lured and slain Acunus after so much planning.
It was just unfortunate that, as Acunus was merged with the Blood River Domain, as the true body of the blood python was utterly destroyed, its soul source was obliterated by Jack Clark.
By this time, the smoke and dust in the distance had begun to disperse, revealing a crater with a diameter of a hundred meters, with the Earth for hundreds of meters around the crater turned over, marked with cracks hundreds of meters long.
At the edge of the pit, Jack Clark, having returned to his normal form, stood leaning on his halberd. Though he appeared extremely weak, his upright stature was as straight as a spear, exuding an invincible aura.
This time, the Divine Emperor Dragon Form that lasted for more than three minutes was almost too much for Jack to handle, even though he had gained significant strength recently.
His body was drained of True Dragon Power and Blood Qi, making him feel more exhausted than if he had been battling for ten days and nights straight.
After catching his breath, Jack looked down.
The pedestal that the Blood River Domain had relied on deep in the crater was shattered, the blood river that had flowed upon it was gone, leaving only a trickle of blood flowing out.
There’s no such thing as undying or unkillable—it’s merely a matter of not being powerful enough.
Under hundreds of slashes from Jack, even Akunus eventually exhausted the power of the blood river, unable to regroup its body any longer, and in the end, its soul power dissipated into oblivion.
But… looking at the broken pieces of the disc, Jack’s brow furrowed slightly.
For he still sensed a faintly dangerous aura emanating from them.
Suddenly, the largest fragment flashed with a blood light.
In an instant, the blood light surged, transforming into a hundred-meter-tall blood shadow that lunged towards Jack. Its soul form moved with an indescribable speed, and as it did, the roar of Akunus rang in everyone’s ears.
“Darren Callum, become one with me.”
Boom! As Akunus’s soul shadow merged with Jack, Damon Lopes, Mathilda Ward, and the others watching from afar turned pale with horror.
“No good, it’s not dead. It’s trying to take over Darren Callum’s body.”
Roar! At that instant, a terrifying Dragon Roar exploded within Jack, and even Heaven and Earth seemed to tremble under the sound. Akunus’s voice followed, filled with terror.
“No!”
Thump!
Jack’s body released vast Soul Power, causing winds to howl around him. Akunus, who had tried to possess his body with king-level soul strength, now faced an emerging Blood Moon in the sky.
The sudden turn of events left everyone stunned.
Was it over like this?
Only at this moment did Jack speak coldly, “You actually tried soul possession? Didn’t you know that even Kautorus’s Dark Demon Eye couldn’t harm me?”
Damon Lopes expressed his admiration, “I didn’t expect Brother Callum to have a way to deal with soul attacks.”
“We’ve finally won this time, right?” Marla Fiore asked uncertainly.
Watching the fading Blood Moon in the sky, Mathilda Ward nodded slightly, “The scattering of the soul source signifies that Acunus’s soul avatar that invaded this time has been utterly annihilated. We’ve won.”
All at once, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. The staff who had been guarded all this time collapsed on the ground, with faces showing the joy of having survived a calamity.
The Six-Tailed White Fox also, under Gwen Gail’s signal, slowly contracted its tail and body, shrinking to just over three meters in length.
Looking at the ravaged land, the ruins of the old town, everyone’s faces showed relaxed smiles.

chapters.title: Chapter 544: 257: Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of the Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Chapter 257: Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of the Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3
“`
Because the battle had finally come to an end.
Suddenly, an unexpected change occurred.
Among those employees sitting on the ground, the bald sound engineer burst into an endless blood light, transforming into a blood-colored phantom that pounced toward Mathilda Ward a dozen meters away.
The sudden turn of events caught everyone off guard.
“Stop!” Damon Lopes’s face changed dramatically as he shouted, turning into a bolt of lightning shooting forth, trying to intercept the sudden appearance of Akunus’ soul shadow.
Even Mathilda Ward’s face showed shock as she looked at the blood shadow that had appeared before her in an instant, her gaze following its hand as it clutched her neck.
But just as Akunus was about to succeed, the pendant always worn by Crystal Boyce around her neck emitted a glow from the white gem.
The white light transcended time and space, enveloping everything within a ten-meter radius amid the terrified roars of Akunus, bringing time within that area to a standstill.
Hum! At that moment, the white light contracted, pulling in the astonished shadow of Akunus into the gem.
After sealing Akunus’s soul source, the white gem turned blood-red, dripping with color, and emitted a mysterious glow.
It was only then that the long sword crackling with lightning appeared in front of Mathilda Ward, the leaping bolts piercing the air, but the sword could no longer fall.
Damon Lopes put away his long sword nonchalantly, saying easily, “So this was your preparation, Sister Ilisa.”
Crystal Boyce nodded slowly, “Correct, this is the Soul Sealing Treasure Jade that can seal any soul and has integrated the power of the Time Laws, specially prepared for Akunus.”
“As long as it shows its soul form trying to touch Misss Joseline and retrieve Dragon Time, I will instantly activate the treasure jade to seal it.”
“I thought it would no longer be necessary, but who would have known that Akunus had still hidden a soul avatar within Daiku, nearly succeeding in its scheme.”
“Strange, it only split out one soul source this time? If it had split two, its main body would have suffered heavy injury and fallen in realm long ago.”
“This one must be the ‘true body’ of Akunus that entered this time.”
Mathilda Ward mused, “As for the Akunus that fought with Brother Callum, it must have been the soul power merged into the Blood River Domain when it was being refined.”
“As the domain ‘artifact’ it had prepared to carry the Divine Might of the Blood God, it had to integrate soul and Law Power during the smelting process.”
Gwen Gail realized, “So that’s it. I was wondering how it could appear again when it was already dead.”
The Fox-eared girl laughed triumphantly, “But in the end, we were one step ahead, and caught this evil creature.”
“Now that we’ve sealed one of its soul sources, let’s see where it can run to now. This vile creature is doomed.”
Mathilda Ward’s gaze also turned cold, revealing a hint of vindication, “Indeed, the physical entity of Akunus in the mythical world is doomed this time.”
Just then, an evil and frenzied shout echoed between heaven and earth, “Why, why? Why must you all hinder me? I will not accept this.”
“I will refine the world, I will destroy the world; die, all of you, die!”
Ten kilometers away, while still entangled with Lake, the Demon-Slaying Puppet suddenly stiffened, followed by a stream of coordinate information piercing through the Void.
Boom!
In an instant, the sky shattered!
With each thunderous roar shaking heaven and earth, the space above Mason City crumbled under terrifying power, forming massive black cracks.
An endless flow of blood light pierced through the black cracks, spreading across the sky, virtually painting the entire hundred-kilometer perimeter around Mason City in a harrowing blood-red hue.
Especially within that endless blood light, countless figures could be seen struggling, wailing, and screaming, as if Hell itself was about to descend.
Boom, boom, boom!!
With the tremors from the depths of the Void, a terrifying pressure came from the opposite side, causing over a million residents in Mason to shake uncontrollably, their faces stricken with terror.
Even the cultivators were trembling under the king-level terrifying pressure,
The dreadful aura even caused otherworldly phenomena; dark clouds suddenly formed out of nowhere, swirling to cover the sky, winds howled, and the earth trembled.
Even the river water in the distance began to flow backward.
Looking up at the sky, Damon Lopes’s face turned stark white, “It’s the true body of Blood God Akunus; it’s actually tearing through the world’s boundaries trying to invade.”
The winds howled fiercely, blowing Mathilda Ward’s long hair into a wild dance, but she remained composed, looking up towards the ever-enlarging cracks in the sky and stating calmly.
“It’s not an invasion. As a king that stepped out of Blue Star, this is a return.”
“If a king-level Purgatory Demon sought entry, or forced the creation of world passageways, it would face a fierce backlash from the rules of Blue Star World.”
“But they won’t be hindered, Blue Star World won’t stop their return.”
“However, even so, it would need coordinates to tear through the world’s Boundary Wall to return, and the massive commotion it causes would attract the attention of Human Experts immediately.”
Roar, roar, roar!
As the sky continued to crumble, at its center formed a hollow several miles in diameter, surrounded by dark clouds.
One could now see across the black portal, countless flashes of blood light transforming into a world-destroying blood python hundreds of meters long with nine serpent heads, exuding a terrifying pressure.
After a sliver of its soul source was sealed, Akunus could no longer hold back and revealed its true body.
At this moment, countless people trembled under the king’s Divine Might; as for television and live broadcasts, they all went offline under the electromagnetic disturbances caused by the king’s arrival.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 545: 257: Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of the Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Chapter 257: Invincible Jack Clark, Arrival of the Kings, The True God Demon Great War (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_4
The last image seen by those watching the live stream was the sky above Mason City shattering.
Jack Clark also lifted his head and gazed at the giant shadow in the sky separated by a world, the invisible aura it emitted alone made him feel intense danger, and excitement shone in his eyes.
“Is this the aura of a king? So powerful, I really want to slay it.”
In the distance, Damon Lopes also nodded excitedly.
“That’s right, only by killing such strong men does one feel a sense of achievement. Once Daoist Master reaches the throne, I will definitely slay a demon king or an Evil God with a sacrificial sword.”
Crystal Boyce marveled inwardly, truly a top-tier genius.
While other people trembled in fear under the oppressive might of a king, what they thought was not of fear, but of slaying the adversary.
Roar!
Heaven and Earth shook again as the Nine-headed Blood Python began to forcefully cross between worlds. A more terrifying pressure descended from the sky in an instant, overwhelming, making it difficult for everyone to breathe.
Yet before this horrifying scene, Jack Clark and his companions weren’t afraid.
Because he didn’t believe the Federation would be unprepared for a king-level being crossing into their world.
Watching Jack Clark on the ground, unafraid of its arrival, Akunus, who had rushed into the world passageways, let out a cold roar: “Darren Callum, I told you, I’m going to suppress and kill you.”
Facing this Federal Genius who repeatedly challenged its kingly dignity, Akunus was filled with intense murderous intent.
Without waiting to fully cross over, endless blood light transformed into an immense, boundless palm under the power of the Law, falling from the sky and covering miles.
The invisible might hadn’t even touched down before the Earth shook, stirring up rings of white waves spreading for miles, grand and overwhelming, enough to destroy Heaven and Earth.
“Akunus, I’ve been waiting for you for a long time,” a cold voice said.
In Mason, over a hundred miles away, General ‘Brian Rainly,’ who had been traveling for a long time, suddenly erupted with overwhelming pressure.
Boom!
A majestic projection appeared far away, standing between Heaven and Earth with grandeur, with a dazzling Divine Wheel shining behind it, emanating a might stronger than Akunus.’
“King’s Projection!”
Boom!
The sovereign projection made a sword strike across space, annihilating the blood palm in the sky with a single slash, creating a grand blood-red shockwave that swept over ten miles of the sky.
Then the figure wielding the long sword took a step forward, crossing a hundred miles to appear above the Firmament, emitting a terrifying aura as it surged into the cracks.
At the same moment, a powerful pulling force came from the heavens.
Feeling the strength and aura coming from the Human King, Crystal Boyce tore off the Soul Sealing Treasure Jade from her neck and threw it up into the sky.
Soon after, a terrifying battle erupted within the passageway, accompanied by earth-shaking roars from Akunus.
“Derick Ramsey, you’ve actually returned to the Inner World of Blue Star. I knew you were waiting for me.”
“But even with you here today, I will take back the dragon. Brethren, isn’t it time you took action?”
“Hahahaha… Akunus, how nice it would have been if you had appeared earlier to open the passageway.”
“Come on, we shall shatter the Human Race World today.”
“A mere Fringe Small Clan dares to contend with our Great Purgatory Clan; today, we will make you understand what despair is.”
“Akunus, quickly unleash all your Divine Soul power and stabilize the passageway,” came another voice.
Alongside these indecipherable but understandable booming voices, at the far end of the passageway behind the Nine-headed Blood Python, a series of terrifying auras exploded.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
Five Demon King level pressures shook Heaven and Earth, one of which far exceeded Akunus by more than tenfold, causing the entire world to tremble in an instant.
Under the terrifying aura of the Demon God of World-Destroying that overshadowed kings, tens of thousands of ordinary people trembled and fell to the ground, weak and unable to stand.
The despair and fear emanating from the depths of their souls made it impossible for them to stand.
“This isn’t good. Akunus has collaborated with the Purgatory Demon Clan. There are five demon kings opposite us, including one of Grand Demon King Level horror.”
At that moment, everyone’s complexion changed.
But just then, from deep within the passageway, Derick Ramsey’s indifferent voice was heard: “Akunus, today I will completely annihilate you, the traitor.”
“Roar! Derick Ramsey, you should be more concerned about your own safety today,” Akunus roared back.
“Is that so?”
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
Right then, even further beyond in the passageway, the auras of King-level strong men erupted, outnumbering the ambushed Demon King level strong men.
“Bad news, the Human Race has set an ambush.”
“Denny Kaye, your injuries are healed!!”
“Although my injuries aren’t healed, taking out trash like you is not a problem.”
“Mysterious Martial, you, you were being hunted down by the Great Honor.”
“Hmph! To bait you all, this king even abandoned the Avatar of the Heavenly Peng. Die!”
Boom, boom, boom!! A fierce battle erupted on the other side, and the terrifying strength caused the world passageways to hold on for only a few moments before crashing down with a bang. The sky howled with a raging wind, sweeping across the Earth.
On the shattered Earth, Jack Clark quietly looked up at the sky, pressing down the shock in his heart.
The series of unexpected events today left everyone somewhat dumbfounded.
Including Jack Clark, who did not expect the Federation’s aim to involve not only the Blood God Acunus but also the Purgatory Demon King it was in collusion with.
And the Mysterious Martial Sky King, who was rumored to have disappeared, also showed up.
Mathilda Ward said softly, “After Acunus made his breakthrough to the king-level by merging with the Three-headed Golden Dragon and evolving into the Nine-headed Blood Dragon, it gained nine consciousnesses.”
“These consciousnesses represent its persistence, madness, cunning, greed, rationality, and hate.”
“In such a situation, once it senses that its Soul Source is sealed, facing the prospect of having its True Body targeted and hunted down by Human Experts, madness will overpower rationality.”
“At that time, it will definitely tear through the pathway and descend at all costs, even willing to lead the Purgatory Demon Clan’s demon kings into our world.”
“In fact, the demon kings of the Purgatory Demon Clan have always wanted to invade the Inner World of the Human Race, but if they create passageways to come through, they will suffer oppressive rule power, causing their strength to plummet.”
“Under such circumstances, coming through is no different from courting death.”
“But if there are law-surrounded King’s Divine Soul aura masks native to Blue Star, the suppression they face upon descent will be significantly reduced.”
“It’s just that even Acunus was reluctant to do this in the past because tearing a Trans-boundary Channel big enough for a king would immediately alert Human Experts, leading to encirclement and eradication.”
“But this time, for the sake of the dragon and its own safety, it will definitely do whatever it takes.”
“In its and the Purgatory Demon Clan’s estimates, the Human frontline battle is strained. Even if there were ambushes in their Inner World, they wouldn’t be able to spare one or two kings.”
“It’s just that they had not accounted for my father and those who had gone to the rear to heal their injuries, nor for the several strong men who had returned from exploring the depths of the mythical world.”
Whoosh! At that moment, a figure swiftly flashed over from a distance, who turned out to be Lake, the Eight Layer Expert who had been ‘entangled’ by the Demon-Slaying Puppet for quite a while.
The middle-aged man glanced over Jack Clark and the others, saying solemnly, “Sorry, I’m late.”
Jack Clark looked oddly at him, “It’s okay, not too late.”
By now, he didn’t believe for a second that this guy was always just conveniently late.
Lake nodded slightly, his voice deep, “Thank you all for your hard work this time. Due to Lord Alex, I’ll be taking Clyde away.”
At this, Jack Clark hesitated for a moment, “His injuries might be a bit serious. After I forcibly shattered his Limit Break beast form, his foundation is almost ruined.”
“It doesn’t matter.”
Lake’s expression was calm, “Someone who could collaborate with an Evil God for the sake of a once traitorous dead person and betray the Human Race, even if he isn’t ruined by you today, he will betray the Human Race one day.”
“Considering Lord Alex’s stance, let him live the rest of his life as a cripple.”
“A genius is someone the Federation spends a lot of resources on and who is willing to fight for their race. Otherwise, for the Federation, it doesn’t matter whether such a person exists or not.”
“That’s a direct quote from Lord Alex, so Little Brother Callum, don’t worry about this matter.”
“Then that’s fine,” Jack Clark nodded slightly.
Although he was confident that with his ‘potential,’ reaching king-level was inevitable and he would quickly become a king, it was still better not to antagonize an established Veteran King.
After all, such trouble was completely unnecessary.
Moreover, he originally thought this was an internal affair of the King’s Family. Even if the fight was fierce and unforgivable, Alex would later use top-tier resources to heal Clyde’s injuries.
But unexpectedly, the king had long given up on his grandson, just leaving him alive as a cripple.
And listening to Lake, it seemed that Clyde’s mother had also betrayed the Human Race before. Could it be that his father from the small martial arts hall had issues back then?
Too brain-burning, forget it, not going to think about it.
“Let’s go, let’s go back.”
“This is finally over, right?” a bodyguard asked hesitantly.
“It’s definitely over. Didn’t you see how many kings have come down?”
“Speaking of which, this is the first time I’ve seen a king. They are so powerful, so terrifying, practically no different from the gods in mythical legends.”

chapters.title: Chapter 546: 258: Monsters from Various Countries, One Layer Heaven per Month
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Chapter 258: Monsters from Various Countries, One Layer Heaven per Month
Just as the Blood God descended and the world’s magnetic field caused chaotic information interruption during the livestream.
In Mist River City, in Jack Clark’s room, Doris Clark was somewhat nervous, “Jim, what was that thing in the sky just now? Your brother won’t be in any trouble, right?”
The overwhelming blood light, even through the network, instinctively made Doris Clark, an ordinary person, panic and fearful.
Glenn Clark reassured her, “Mom, don’t worry, I’m sure brother is fine.”
“Have you forgotten how fierce he was earlier? He took out that massive Blood Python Beast with his weapon in just two strikes,” Glenn remarked, his excitement rising at the memory.
“And before you came up, bro charged into those red monsters, boom, boom, boom, he killed tens of thousands ‘people’ in just a while, terrifyingly fast.”
“So even if there was really some danger in the sky just now, with brother’s speed, running away would definitely not be a problem, so mom, don’t worry.”
With Glenn’s reassurance, the panic in Doris Clark’s heart eased a little.
Yes, her son has become so powerful, he must be alright.
At that moment, Glenn scratched the back of his head, “But mom, how did brother become so fierce all of a sudden? He had just broken through the Four Layer Heaven when he went to the Alien Beast Battlefield three months ago.”
“Could it be that cultivation is very simple?” Glenn formed this theory.
After all, Jack Clark had started cultivation just over half a year ago, transforming directly from a sickly youth into a terrifying strong man who could move mountains and split the earth.
Soon, with the restoration of communications, the entire world learned of the final anomaly in the battle at Mason City, which was the descent of the true body of the Evil God.
Mathilda Ward, who safely returned, also announced the process of this battle to the public.
The genius Clyde, who swept across the cultivation circles of two countries, was executed on the spot by Darren Callum for colluding with the Evil God Sect and betraying the Human Race—his crimes, unforgivable.
As for the descent of the Evil God’s true body, it was repelled by the king-level defenders in the human inner world and even pursued through the world passageways.
The entire web erupted in frenzy.
Compared to the previous Evil God Clone in Mason, this time the true body of the Evil God himself had descended.
“It must have been Darren Callum’s consecutive killings of the Evil God Clone that ultimately provoked the Blood God Sect’s Blood God into a rage, causing his true body to descend and attempt to kill him.”
“I think so too, Darren is just too strong.”
“According to an authoritative expert from Eastern Summer, the last Nine-headed Blood Python that appeared was at least at the Eighth Layer Early Phase, but even so, it was defeated by Darren.”
“Hiss! It’s actually the Eight Layer; no wonder it looked so terrifying at the time.”
“But Darren is even more terrifying.”
“With his late Sixth Layer Heaven strength, he crossed over two major realms to kill his enemy; such heaven-defying combat power, I feel like there is no second person in the entire Federation.”
“Also, Darren killed hundreds of thousands of ‘monsters’; this battle has made him a legend. Everyone agrees that he’s the number one among the younger generation of the Human Race, right?”
“No objections, he’s definitely an aberration.”
“Yeah, I’ve never seen such a strong Sixth Heaven cultivator.”
“Err… guys upstairs, the more you talk, the more exaggerated it becomes. I admit Darren is strong, but calling him the first person of the new generation of the Human Race is probably too much for him.”
“There have been countless geniuses in the Federation over the years, like Berlin’s Bear Beast Balderas, who broke through to full beast transformation at the age of nineteen with a peerless talent.”
“And in his early Seventh Layer Heaven phase, Balderas tore apart an Eighth Level Beast that was destroying fishing boats, showing terrifying combat power.”
“Then there’s Gabriella from the Simoon Cathedral Academy, who reached the peak of the Sixth Heaven at seventeen years old and personally designed high-order mechanical armament.”
“Not to mention Eastern Summer, which is frequently producing geniuses. I heard the military’s secret weapon, Eddy Keller, is even more monstrous than Innate Awakened Ones.”
“These are just some of the more well-known geniuses. There are many more talents rising in each empire and other countries, or quietly cultivating.”
“As far as I know, in the Southern Battlefield of Eastern Summer, a high school junior named Jane Aiken has made terrifying progress after breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, almost a realm per month.”
“Even that would be fine, but this girl also possesses a horrifying comprehension talent and has already mastered four Sword Intents, unparalleled in offense.”
“Really? Four types of Sword Intent is too fake, right? And brother, how do you know all this?”
“Because I am Eddy Keller, the strongest genius of Eastern Summer.”
“Damn! All this buildup just for that sentence, right? It’s clearly a scam, I freaking still consider myself Berlin’s number one, Balderas’s brother.”
In an apartment in Berlin, Balderas was indignant, furiously typing out a long message on his computer.
“Disperse, disperse.”
“I knew that guy was bluffing all along, a realm a month, I’ll ascend to the throne in a year myself.”
The impact of the battle outside Mason City was even more significant than Jack Clark and the others had imagined.
Soon the web was flooded with various short videos.
There were clips of Jack Clark obliterating Clyde with an overwhelming force, the moments he manifested his Combat Shadow, as well as an edit of him bombing tens of thousands of Blood Demons.
But the video with the highest clicks and views was that of him transforming into the Divine Might Emperor Dragon form, bursting the Nine-headed Blood Python.
Apart from this, the network also featured scenes of Damon Lopes wielding Thunder, holding a battle sword to summon lightning.
However, compared to Jack’s trending moments, those watching Damon were significantly fewer.
But despite the high interest, no one thought of digging deeper into Jack’s identity data.
Investigating the personal details of someone with official backing, such as this monstrous talent, was no different from seeking death; one might as well invite special service personnel to their door just by searching…
“Mom, you don’t have to worry now, Brother is fine.”
As Doris Clark looked at the constantly refreshing information on the computer, she let out a sigh of relief, “As long as he’s fine.”
“Hmph! That so-called Evil God actually tried to kill my brother. Just wait, once I can start cultivation, within a year I’ll beat the crap out of it.”
“Jim, don’t swear, you’re only fourteen.”
But after saying that, looking at her second son who was already over one meter ninety tall and immensely muscular, she didn’t quite know what to say.
Ever since Glenn Clark had eaten the Mutated Beast Meat that Jack Clark brought back, his physique had become more and more imposing, his arms almost as thick as someone else’s waist.
And he digested it so quickly, feeling hungry every day and never full. Therefore, while fishing Glenn Clark would directly carry a barbecue grill, grilling while fishing at the same time.
However, although Glenn Clark looked formidable and intimidating, he seemed to be quite popular at school, having good relationships with several classmates, especially with a girl named Teresa Wilson.
“Phew! Good thing everything’s fine.”
In the research building, a delicate and pretty girl let out a sigh of relief.
Freya Louise’s transcendent and innate aura was becoming more apparent, and her energy had reached the peak of the Triplex Heaven.
This level of cultivation was already quite good for a First Grader, but it seemed a bit slow compared to her talent, which was not weaker than that of Justin Welan and the others.
Suddenly, energy within Freya Louise’s body started to fluctuate wildly and her True Strength became more active. The surrounding Heavenly Energy naturally gathered towards her, a sign that she was about to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven.
But quickly, she suppressed the urge for the breakthrough back down.
The girl, having calmed the surging True Strength within her, slowly exhaled and whispered softly, “I can’t breakthrough just yet, I need to wait a bit longer.”
…
Returning to the hotel, both Damon Lopes and Jack Clark felt a lot lighter.
The True Body of Kautorus was slain, the Blood God Acunus Avatar sealed, and with the real body drawn out and those demon kings on top of it, the battle was essentially over.
Compared to Jack Clark and his companions, the dancers and employees who had followed to watch the excitement, as well as guards like Lionel Lopez, were still struggling to come to grips with what had happened.
It was night-time already, and after having dinner and a brief rest, everyone returned to their rooms.
Both Jack Clark and Damon Lopes were greatly depleted by this event.
Especially the latter, who had even triggered his Innate Thunderbolt to stop Acunus.
Night!
Jack Clark sat cross-legged on his bed, Heavenly Energy from within a hundred meters radius converged around him, creating an invisible wind that blew through his hair as if it were moving on its own.
Compared to Eastern Summer, as a medium-sized country, Gunaer’s energy density was several times lower.
And that was after these countries followed the example of the three major empires, setting up rudimentary Enchantments around the core areas of their major cities to gather and constrain Heavenly Energy.
After the battle that day, Jack Clark felt fluctuations in his energy. Under such circumstances, his cultivation speed would be faster than usual.
After meditating intensively for three hours, Jack Clark finally slowly opened his eyes.
Glancing at the clock on the wall which showed eleven o’clock, and feeling the sense of hibernation deep within his consciousness, Jack Clark thought for a moment, then took out a black iron-like object from the Sumeru Bracelet.
It was the Mystical Disc containing the Gail Family’s Space-Time Summoning Technique.
With the seventh layer of the Secret Book successfully constructed, he had more free time before breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, and he could take some time to study this summoning technique.
As for the eighth layer of the Secret Book, it required him to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven before he could continue.
Reaching the eighth layer was the process of merging the true martial arts phantom with the true body, not just a matter of enveloping oneself with Heavenly Energy.
Thus, after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, not only would Jack Clark need to convert Heavenly Energy from void to reality, he would also need to continuously adjust and optimize the structure of his true martial arts phantom according to his own situation.
The more in sync the true martial arts phantom was with himself, the faster his Eighth Layer Heaven cultivation speed would be.
After witnessing the kings whose mere aura could collapse the Void today, Jack Clark felt a strong sense of crisis and unease.
Although he was extremely powerful at full strength, already touching the threshold of the Eight Layer Heaven, he still was utterly defenseless against a king-level strong man.
He was still three major realms away from reaching that level of a king. Before then, he must find a way to acquire a trump card that could allow him to either combat a king-level strong man or escape from one.
For instance, mastering this Space-Time Summoning Technique.
With the strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, who had grown to level nine and substantially increased in power, when he would also strengthen his Golden Flame Talent to top-tier,
under the Five Top-level Talents, a level nine early stage Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could surely hold its own even against a Top-level Colossal Beast that had grasped Law Power at the level nine peak.
Whether he could defeat the opponent was another matter, only to be discovered through actual combat.
After all, life-and-death battles are not simply a comparison of data; having higher data doesn’t guarantee victory.
Once the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to grow for some time, reaching mid-level nine, and with one more Top Tier Talent enhanced to an even higher level, its strength would be truly terrifying.
Besides this, he needs to find a way to enhance his Void Double Pupils to top-tier.
Jack Clark had a feeling that once the Void Double Pupils are enhanced to top-tier levels, there will be an astonishing transformation. Moreover, it was time to prioritize the strengthening of his Soul Talent.
Thinking about this, Jack Clark suddenly felt he had a lot to do, and that he was incredibly busy.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s consciousness once again entered the Secret Disc Space, immersing in the mysteries of space and time contained within the secret arts.

chapters.title: Chapter 547: 259: It's Effort I Rely On, The End of Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Chapter 259: It’s Effort I Rely On, The End of Everything
The next morning, after a night of cultivation, Jack Clark opened his eyes, which were deep and profound, with a pair of black gold vertical pupils in their depths exuding a sense of mystery.
Whew!
Jack exhaled and showed a satisfied smile on his face, “Space is no longer an issue, it’s just the time rune altar that I still don’t fully understand.”
He had made significant progress in his understanding overnight and felt confident that he would learn the secret skill before running out of the three opportunities given to him.
Then he could get down to cultivating and condensing the Summoning Altar.
“Good morning, Brother Callum.”
No sooner had Jack opened the door than he ran into a fox-eared girl hopping along the corridor, followed by the dignified and charming Six-Tailed White Fox, restored to her 3-meter stature.
The girl blinked her large eyes and looked at Jack, who wasn’t wearing glasses this morning, and exclaimed in surprise, “You look so handsome without the sunglasses, Brother Callum.”
Feeling relaxed, Jack smiled slightly, “Even so, I’m not as handsome as your brother, Mr. Gail.”
The girl giggled, “It’s different. My brother looks prettier than a woman, that’s called being handsome. Brother Callum, you have a kind of heroic handsomeness.”
“It’s just a bit scary when you fight,” she added, sticking out her little tongue, looking somewhat adorable.
She was reminded of the sight of Jack yesterday, surrounded by hellish auras and slaughtering countless blood demons with overwhelming Killing Intent. Just thinking about it made her heart palpitate even now.
Too scary.
But as Jack, with hands clasped behind his back, followed the hopping Gwen Gail and White Fox into the dining hall, he was greeted by a disconsolate Damon Lopes.
“Brother Callum, I feel like our destinies just don’t mesh. It seems I’m born to be overshadowed by you,” lamented Damon.
“Er… why would you say that?” Jack was a bit perplexed.
Mathilda Ward, who was eating breakfast across the table, couldn’t help but laugh out loud and explained, “Damon has been online since last night and then realized that most of the discussion topics are related to you.”
“Many people have even given you some titles, like ‘God Slayer’ and ‘Blood Demon of the Hell’.”
Okay, so that was the reason.
Jack shook his head, “You can’t blame me for that. The Akunus Avatar merged with the Blood River Domain was too strong; you couldn’t withstand it, and I didn’t actually want to steal your spotlight.”
Damon looked frustrated, “I know it’s not your fault, that’s why I’m saying we might be incompatible.”
“I thought that coming out of the Northern Battlefield this time, as the Daoist Master, I could make a name for myself by beheading the heads of Evil God followers with my Thunder Sword and shake the world.”
“But starting from this mission, I ended up contributing nothing, making me, an Innate Awakened One, feel like I completely lack presence or sense of achievement.”
Damon’s words kept Mathilda Ward and Gwen Gail laughing uncontrollably.
With the dark clouds dispersed, everyone’s mood was quite relaxed.
Then came the busyness, for Mathilda Ward’s last tour stop was tonight at 7 pm.
As twilight deepened, this city, having weathered storms, became noisy with life, many flocking towards the Cadet Sports Center.
These included ‘local’ people from Mason and Gunardo, as well as ‘elites’ from other countries.
At this stage, anyone who could fly in on an international flight was extraordinary, initially coming to see Mathilda Ward’s concert, only to witness the phenomenon of a king-level figure’s arrival.
Meanwhile, most of the Television Stations around the world were live broadcasting the event; many were sitting in front of the TV or with mobile phones in hand, computers on, paying close attention.
There was no helping it; too many significant events had happened recently due to Mathilda Ward’s ‘concert.’
Attacks by the Evil God Sect, missile bombings, the battle against a god, the fall of the genius named Clyde, and the confrontation between the king and the True Body of the Evil God.
Each event was sensational enough on its own, let alone the fact that they all revolved around the star Mathilda Ward.
“Hello everyone, I’m Coco, and behind me is the backstage area of the concert.”
“Please follow our camera lens as we go see what Mathilda Ward is up to before the concert starts, and what sets her apart from ordinary people like us.”
“Look quick, that’s Mathilda Ward’s personal bodyguard, Darren Callum. Let’s go and interview him first.”
Saying this, the attractive and eloquent host approached Jack, a bit nervous as she said,
“Mr. Callum, it’s said that you’re only eighteen years old, but you’ve already reached the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, surpassing many of the older generations of cultivators.”
“Besides, your power is formidable, with records of slaying an Evil God Clone of the Eighth Layer Heaven.”
“Could you share how you’ve achieved this? For example, how can one have battle strength far beyond their realm, just like you?”
Amidst the host’s nervous anticipation, Jack, wearing sunglasses, answered indifferently, “My achievements today stem from my diligent cultivation.”
“The reason my combat power is so formidable is that I’ve cultivated various Cultivation Methods to the pinnacle, surpassing my predecessors and reaching a transcendent level of mastery.”
“And when you bring any one thing to its pinnacle, you become very powerful, like me right now.”
With that, Jack said cooly, “That’s all I have to say.”
“Th-thank you, Mr. Callum, for your cooperation,” the female host was a bit excited.
She hadn’t expected Darren Callum to seriously answer her questions since past attempts to interview him had resulted in being straight-up dismissed.
Turning back, somewhat thrilled, she spoke to the camera, “Did everyone hear that? Mr. Callum has just shared with us the reason for his immense strength.”
“Persistent cultivation, unwavering effort, and masterfully refining either Cultivation Methods or Combat Techniques to their limit can make one as powerful as him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 548: 259: It's Effort I Rely On, The End of Everything_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Chapter 259: It’s Effort I Rely On, The End of Everything_2
“And we’ve also found that Mr. Callum is so strong not just because he has a high talent, but also because of his relentless cultivation efforts.”
“For a young man who’s only eighteen years old, this is extremely commendable and admirable.”
“All right, now let’s go interview Miss Mathilda Ward.”
This time, Jack Clark did not stop the female host as she walked into the backstage makeup room.
Of course, although the Akunus Avatar had already been eradicated, Jack Clark was still on his guard. He had just carefully perceived those people and found no issues.
And this time, it wasn’t just a mental perception; Jack Clark also blatantly used Spirit Power scanning, capable of a kind of x-ray vision.
The aim was to prevent the situation with the bald tuner from occurring again.
While the female host went in to interview Mathilda Ward, who was getting her makeup done, the internet started buzzing about Jack Clark’s earlier behavior.
“Wow! Darren was so gentle just now, patiently answering Coco’s questions.”
“Yeah, so handsome, sob, how great would it be to be his girlfriend?”
“You crazed fans, aren’t you focusing on the wrong thing? Earlier you all said he was only so strong because of his talent, now you know, our brother is all about hard work.”
“That’s right, our brother relies on his own efforts. It’s step by step hard work that got him where he is today, surpassing all his peers.”
“Damn! I’m fired up now, starting today I’ll also cultivate diligently. I hope to break through the Second Layer Heaven by the end of First Grade.”
“Upstairs, aren’t your goals a little small? Shouldn’t you be aiming to break through the Fourth Layer Heaven by the end of First Grade?”
“Break through your hammer, I’ve barely managed to establish my foundation after half a year of cultivation. Am I supposed to use my head to break through?”
“Shit! Half a year and just establishing foundation, you’re such a waste, why even bother cultivating at all? Better switch paths early, don’t waste your time and resources.”
“Don’t look down on me. Although I haven’t broken through the First Layer Heaven yet, someday I will become a powerful high-order cultivator, and then you’ll know what ‘thirty years on the east bank of the river’ means.”
“Haha, that’s hilarious, who still talks about ‘thirty years on the east bank, thirty years on the west bank’ these days? Are you going to come up with ‘don’t mistreat the youth for being poor, don’t mistreat the middle-aged for being poor’ next?”
While the online community was abuzz, the time reached 7:30 pm.
Click!
The lights in the venue dimmed, followed by a faint radiance spilling from the top of the hall, gradually revealing the towering figure on stage.
The over 200-meter tall form, majestic as mountains, with three heads and eight arms, sitting cross-legged covering the entire stage, with a circle of slowly rotating aura behind, emitting a holy halo.
This was the image of the creation deity from the mythical legends of Gunaer Country.
At this moment, ethereal and distant music began to play.
On stage, in front of the dignified and sacred ‘deities,’ the four sets of hands opened gently, revealing Mathilda Ward, with her long hair lightly coiled at the back of her head, adorned with blue butterflies and floral ornaments.
For tonight’s opening act, the girl wore a shoulder-baring blue dress, standing in the palm of the deity, as if she were a goddess descended from ancient times, regal and graceful.
With Mathilda Ward’s appearance, golden petals rained down from the sky, and under the music, the atmosphere turned mystical, making her shine even brighter.
“Wow! Sister Ilisa is so beautiful today.” Gwen Gail’s eyes sparkled with envy as she watched the stage from the front row.
In that moment, not just her, the entire venue was stunned by the spectacle, followed by a roar that shook the mountains and seas.
“Ilisa, Ilisa!!”
“Ilisa, I love you!”
However, compared to those on the site, the eyes of the global live-stream audience quickly shifted away from Mathilda Ward, searching around.
“I see him, Darren Callum is on the deity’s shoulder.”
“Wow! The Hegemon is so cool.”
“He really didn’t abandon the goddess, always protecting her from behind as ever, it’s so touching.”
“Touching your hammer, his job is a bodyguard, okay?”
At that moment, the stage burst into endless radiance, the deity exploded with a boom, turning into a sky full of light and vanishing, officially starting the concert.
As the last farewell concert, whether it was the songs, dances, costumes, props, or lighting, everything was perfected.
Even each song was accompanied by 3D projections of environments.
Snowy mountains, oceans, forests, skies, alien worlds, Giant Beasts…
This level of big-budget production was not only unmatched by a star’s concert but even those claiming to be billion-dollar movies could not compare, thrilling the audience both on-site and online.
But during such an amazing concert, many viewers couldn’t shake off a vague feeling that something was missing.
Right, it was that figure that used to block the camera lens, that arrogant bodyguard who, oddly enough, wasn’t intentionally standing in front of Mathilda Ward this time, seeming almost too normal.
At the edge of the stage, Jack Clark was quietly enjoying the visual feast before him.
Down below, beside the stage, Damon Lopes commented somewhat sentimentally, “Brother Callum, do you think we’ll ever have the chance to see Sister Ilisa’s concerts in the future?”
After this concert, in about ten more days, it would be Mathilda Ward’s deadline, and whether she would live or die depended on the Life Reversal Ceremony.
But with only a thirty percent chance of success… it was highly unlikely.
“We will have opportunities.”
Jack Callum said calmly, “After all, the Mysterious Martial Sky King has returned. He will surely find a way to keep her alive because she is his only family now.”
“Right, Sister Ilisa will definitely make it,” Damon Lopes nodded.
As they watched, the concert went on smoothly.
Even during the later part of the concert when Mathilda Ward went downstage to interact with the fans, shaking hands, Jack Clark just followed along the sidelines, without interference.

chapters.title: Chapter 549: 259: It's Effort I Rely On, The End of Everything_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Chapter 259: It’s Effort I Rely On, The End of Everything_3
The concert soon reached its end.
On the stage, Ilisa, having sung the last song, looked at the densely packed audience waving their glow sticks like a star-filled sky and suddenly fell silent.
But quickly, she revealed a brilliant smile and spoke into the microphone, “Thank you, everyone, for joining me tonight. With this, today’s concert has almost come to a perfect close.”
“Due to health reasons, I must say a temporary goodbye to the entertainment industry, and I may not sing anymore.”
“I want to thank everyone for your companionship and support along the way, my friends who have helped me, and the team members at my company. You all have worked so hard.”
“I particularly want to express my gratitude to Boss Boyce from the Cloud Heaven Group, who is also my aunt. It’s because of her that I have been able to realize my dreams of becoming an international star.”
“Besides that, I must thank the company president’s assistant, Sister Jessica, for your company during the tough times that allowed me to get through them.”
“And in the last phase of my singing career, I had the fortune to meet a few good friends.”
“The adorable Sister Moon, the dependable Damon Lopes, and the ‘Hegemon,’ Darren Callum, who everybody loves to hate—you all have worked so hard during this time.”
As she said this, Ilisa gave a deep bow in their direction.
Then, raising her head with the microphone in hand, she looked at the countless audience members before her, “Alright, I’ve said my thanks. Now, for everyone’s safety, please, I ask that those sitting in the back rows leave your seats in an orderly fashion.”
“Don’t rush, I will stand on stage and watch until the last audience member has left.”
“Ilisa, we don’t want to let you go.”
“Right, can’t you just not leave the entertainment industry?”
“Come back after you get better; we’ll wait for you.”
“Ilisa, we’ll wait for you…”
The chorus of tens of thousands shouting together was so loud that it seemed even the roof of the stadium was vibrating. The many pairs of eyes filled with reluctance brought a slight redness to Ilisa’s gaze.
Almost everyone who had come to the concert was a faithful fan of hers.
