Their pleas for her to stay also signified that she had left her mark in this world. Even if she were to fall into an eternal sleep with no return, there would still be those who remembered her.
Remembered there was once a girl named Ilisa, who had shined brightly.
Suppressing the thoughts in her heart, Ilisa revealed a radiant smile and bowed deeply to the crowd, “Thank you, everyone. Thank you for your support.”
Although her words kept repeating thanks, she made no promise of a return after her recovery.
Good upbringing and manners taught her never to make promises she couldn’t keep.
Half an hour later, as the final person left the stadium, the previously noisy venue quickly fell quiet and deserted, leaving behind only the lone figure still standing on stage.
At that moment, Gwen Gail climbed onto the stage and came up beside Ilisa, whispering softly, “Sister Ilisa, it’s time to go.”
“Yes, it’s time to head back,” Ilisa snapped back to reality, giving a slight smile to Jack and the others.
Cyrstal Boyce and Marla Fiore, among others, also emerged from behind the stage. Watching the girl who still had a smile as beautiful as flowers on her face, they sighed inwardly.
Crystal Boyce took Ilisa’s hand, “Misss Joseline, let’s go.”
“Let’s go.”
As the group departed, one by one, the lights went out, and darkness swallowed the stadium.
It seemed to be foreshadowing something.
Following behind Ilisa, as Jack stepped out of the stadium gate, his pace faltered, and his mind was flooded with all that had happened during this time.
From the moment he stepped out of the Alien Beast Battlefield, filled with curiosity and innocence, to now, having slain the Evil God and become renowned across the world, it felt like a long time had passed.
With the conclusion of today’s concert, everything also came to an end.
From below, Damon Lopes shouted, “Brother Callum, let’s go.”
“Coming.”

chapters.title: Chapter 550: 260: No.1 Mech Driver, Return to Eastern Summer
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Chapter 260: No.1 Mech Driver, Return to Eastern Summer
Although the concert had ended, the internet buzzed even more due to Mathilda Ward announcing her decision to recuperate and leave the entertainment industry.
In addition, there were also many topics surrounding Jack Clark.
Mist River City.
Freya Louise, dressed in a white pleated long dress, sat on the sofa, holding a tablet and tirelessly scrolling through videos and discussions about ‘Darren Callum’ online, watching with great interest.
Sometimes she even laughed out loud at the funny comments.
Upstairs, a woman bearing some resemblance to Freya was holding a mobile phone, her tone calm, “It’s so late, what do you want to call me about?”
A man’s low voice came through from the other end, “…I want to ask, has Miss Flora broken through to the Fourth Layer?”
Emma Louise replied calmly, “Not yet, Third Layer Peak.”
“She hasn’t broken through yet?”
The man on the other end paused slightly, his tone tinged with confusion, “Strange, theoretically, after ‘reflection of the heart’, Miss Flora’s cultivation progress should become faster, right?”
Emma Louise said indifferently, “That Cultivation Method has never been successfully practiced by anyone before, and no one can guide Miss Flora on her path; her success is a result of her own slow exploration.”
“It’s normal for her progress in cultivation to be slow under these circumstances.”
“That’s true.”
Then the man on the other end suddenly said, “By the way, sister, I have already finished adjusting No.1 Mech here and plan on coming over to pick up Miss Flora the day after tomorrow.”
Emma Louise frowned instantly, “You’ve already finished adjusting No.1 Mech? Didn’t you say it would take another month just recently?”
The man on the other end explained, “It was supposed to take that long, but I made a discovery on the body of Kautorus’ demon king that sped up the adjustment of No.1 Mech.”
“Compared to our world, the rules of Abyss Hell of The Purgatory Family are more refined, and they have grown strong enough to affect the inner life imprints, which hold great value for reference.”
“I will organize this data and send it to you in a bit.”
“Alright, send me the information later so I can have a look.”
But after saying this, Emma Louise calmly said, “However, I still have a problem here that hasn’t been resolved. Let’s wait another half-month; then you can come and pick up Miss Flora.”
“…Didn’t you say that your side was ready before?” the man on the other side sounded puzzled.
“I had indeed finished, but in the past few days, when I recalculated multiple times using the sky-based computer, I found some problems with the energy conversion of the eternal power reactor.”
“Is that so, well then, I’ll come over in half a month.”
Just then, Emma Louise suddenly said, “Can Miss Flora stop practicing that Cultivation Method?”
The man paused, his tone filled with confusion, “Why stop? You also agreed to let Miss Flora practice it before, didn’t you?”
Looking at the sincere smile on the girl’s face downstairs, Emma Louise fell into a brief silence, “I regret it, and I also never imagined that she would successfully practice it.”
The man on the other side fell silent for a while before finally saying slowly, “Right now, Miss Flora is the most fitting driver for No.1 Mech.”
“And the translated version of the Primitive Secrets taken from the relic, no one has been able to practice it for decades, but she succeeded, which shows that she’s the chosen one of this era.”
“She carries her destiny, and we have our responsibilities to bear.”
“You also noticed the situation with Akunus; the Blue Star World Barrier is growing weaker.”
“We don’t have much time left; the Second Mythical Impact is about to Burst, and every country is trying to find a solution. We can’t give up on even the slightest possibility.”
“Moreover, Miss Flora’s existence is just an alternative; perhaps the situation will change before she can grow, the figure in Eastern Summer may take the final step.”
“Besides, the True King from Berlin seems to have reached the threshold of the Primordial, and Simon’s Sky-based God King is also preparing for the union step.”
“So you don’t need to worry too much; think of Miss Flora as a cultivator who’s taking a special route to blaze a new trail.”
Emma Louise looked at the girl below and fell into silence again, stating faintly, “I will complete the energy conversion of the eternal power reactor as soon as possible, and then I’ll inform you to come over.”
“Alright.”
…
The morning of May 22nd.
At Mason Airport, on the runway, a Fox-eared girl, standing tall with a Six-Tailed White Fox behind her, cheerfully waved at everyone, “Brother Callum, Brother Lee, good-bye, Sister Jessica, good-bye.”
Then she fist-bumped Mathilda Ward, “Sister Ilisa, keep it up, you will definitely get better, and then I will come to Eastern Summer to visit you.”
To this, Mathilda Ward just smiled and waved back.
As everyone saw Gwen Gail off, she and her Six-Tailed White Fox boarded a special plane bound for the Hundred Foxes Nation.
Gwen Gail’s official reason for coming was to assist with her King-level bloodline as a Sixth-level White Fox, but in reality, she was providing cover for the King-level strong man Derick Ramsey.
As they watched Gwen Gail’s plane start to ascend, Jack Clark and others also stepped on a large airplane bound for Eastern Summer.
“We’re finally going back.”
“Yes.”
Inside the economy cabin, the employees all felt a sense of relief.
They originally thought that going abroad to perform with Mathilda Ward would be an excellent journey, but they never expected it to be filled with such dangerous surprises, with even Evil God’s True Body descending in the end.
Besides, none of them had anticipated both the sound engineer and the assistant to be traitors.
According to Crystal Boyce’s explanation, South City’s official defenses were tight; not only were Evil God Sect Cultists unable to approach easily, but even Akunus’ Avatar couldn’t get near.
Let alone corrupting their souls.
The attempt to corrupt the sound engineer and the assistant could only have been successful if they had ‘willingly’ accepted it.
Otherwise, if they showed even the slightest resistance during the corruption, triggering a weak fluctuation in Akunus’ Divine Soul, it would have been instantly detected by the Soul Crystals deployed in South Sky City.

chapters.title: Chapter 551: 260: No.1 Mech Driver, Return to Eastern Summer_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Chapter 260: No.1 Mech Driver, Return to Eastern Summer_2
First Class, Damon Lopes said seriously, “This time when I go back, I plan to cultivate to the peak of the Sixth Heavens. No, even better, to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“Otherwise, Brother Callum, you will steal the spotlight again.”
“This time, the Gods Creation Plan will gather the most monstrous geniuses of the Federation, like Eddy Keller from Myth Academy, who is a monster that even I have to steer clear of.”
“But that guy’s realm is very low, he always forcefully shows off, nowhere near as good as you, Brother Callum.”
Crystal Boyce said kindly, “Actually, Mr. Lopes, you did quite well this time too, showing the strength of an Innate Awakened One.”
Damon Lopes sighed, “But Brother Callum has stolen all the limelight.”
Jack Clark just smiled at this.
In fact, he had never thought about showing off purposely, but there was no helping it, who made it so that Damon Lopes couldn’t defeat Akunus’s Avatar after fighting for so long.
At the same time, Jack Clark was also looking forward to the Road to Becoming a God.
When the time came, he would not only acquire the World Origin and Law Fragments but also Innate Runes. Besides, he would also have the opportunity to observe other young geniuses of the Human Race.
Compared to Jack Clark, who has been cultivating for less than a year, those people not only have astounding talents but have also been cultivating for longer periods. They should not be underestimated.
Only, after he breaks through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, he wonders if those geniuses can withstand even one strike from his halberd?
Thinking of this, Jack Clark’s mouth couldn’t help but curve slightly upwards.
“By the way, Brother Callum, do you have any plans for what’s next? Will you join the Military Main Battle Corps or the Special Warfare Division, or perhaps the Expedition Division?”
Jack Clark shook his head slightly: “I haven’t decided yet.”
The Military Main Battle Corps is composed of the main forces from various alien beast battlefields and the frontline of the mythical world. They possess the greatest numbers and military power.
The Special Warfare Division, similar to special forces, is responsible for suppressing and clearing out the Giant Beasts that pose threats to humans.
Meanwhile, in the mythical world, they carry out surgical strikes against top-level experts of the Purgatory Demon Race and are the main force for confrontations beyond the battlefield, hosting many King-level strong men.
On the other hand, the Expedition Division is a little special. It’s not responsible for military affairs but rather for exploring the surrounding mythical world in preparation for the military’s expeditions.
The members of this department are filled with a spirit of adventure and exploration.
However, while the mythical world contains endless resources, it is also perilously dangerous. Many special dangerous places can even cause kings to fall.
These hazardous areas have naturally formed special environments, as well as terrifying Mythical Giant Beasts, or other lifeforms and semi-civilized beings.
Semi-civilized beings refer to social creatures with a certain structure and inheritance, albeit with a ‘culture’ that is not highly developed.
But with development over who knows how many years, each of these groups has at least one being on par with a king-level strong man or possesses strange and mighty capabilities.
After graduating from the third grade of Martial Arts School, the top-notch geniuses typically have a cultivation of the Fifth Layer, the next best have the Fourth Layer, and even the weakest have reached the Triplex.
By this stage, most people join one of the three military departments to further their skills, while those whose performance is lacking may choose to develop their careers in other departments of the Federation.
Going deeper implies that these geniuses will be nurtured into the high-end strength of the Human Race.
Many among them can grow to surpass the Seventh Layer, and even to the Eighth or Ninth Heavens.
As for becoming a king, the difficulty is enormous; in the past decades, the total number of kings in the Human Federation is not high. Some have fallen, and others have defected to form the Divine Sect Alliance.
Even for an Innate Awakened One like Damon Lopes, who theoretically could advance directly to the Nine Layers, it is still incredibly difficult to break through and become a king.
As for Jack Clark, a first-grader who is about to break into the Seventh Layer, the school can no longer offer any assistance, nor is there anything left to teach him.
With his talent, which is even more monstrous than that of an Innate Awakened One, his current status within the Federation is almost equivalent to that of a half-king.
This is also why Alex was so polite earlier.
Whether in ancient times or in the modern civilized era, the human world has always placed ‘strength above all.’
At this moment, Jack Clark took out a Secret Book from the Sumeru Space.
The airplane trip back would take over nine hours, and such a long time naturally should not be wasted.
After wholeheartedly studying the Mystical Disc twice, Jack Clark had grasped most of the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
Especially the space aspect, which was very simple for him. The troubling part was the structure that involved time.
In addition, after learning the space aspect of this Summoning Secret Skill, Jack Clark had a bold idea: Summoning Strikes.
Apart from summoning the projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, he could try to establish a stable pathway, a channel not through matter but through energy.
If, at that time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon released its Breath on the other side and he opened a pathway here, it would be like summoning a Sky Base Satellite to conduct long-range strikes.
At this, Damon Lopes couldn’t help but wonder: “Brother Callum, didn’t you already create your own Secret Book?”
“I’m planning to use the Secret Book’s capability to materialize in space to verify and extrapolate the Summoning Secret Skill of the Gail Family.”
“You are such a hard worker, it makes me feel a bit embarrassed to even have a chat,” said Damon Lopes with a touch of frustration, reluctantly putting away his mobile phone.
He had been planning on browsing through the beauty (risqué) images he had saved on his phone to pass the time.
But there Jack Clark was, working hard, hard enough to make him wonder if he was becoming too useless?
The problem was that he had been cultivating diligently himself. He had almost been wrapped up so much that he didn’t sleep at night, working harder than even when he was in the Alien Beast Battlefield.
It was only during the day when he protected Mathilda Ward that he took some time to chat with beauties.

chapters.title: Chapter 552: 260: No.1 Mech Driver, Returning to Eastern Summer_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Chapter 260: No.1 Mech Driver, Returning to Eastern Summer_3
Forget it, I’ll put in some effort as well.
Damon Lopes sighed and a secret book also appeared in his hands.
However, his secret book was different from Jack Clark’s, being ‘blank’.
With his efforts during this period, he had finally broken through to the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage and could begin constructing the foundation rune structure of the true martial arts phantom.
Seeing this, Mathilda Ward and Marla Fiore among others couldn’t help but laugh.
Meanwhile, as Jack was immersed in comprehension, within the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace beneath the deep sea, the Silver Giant Dragon slowly opened its eyes.
Several days had passed, and after absorbing the nutrients from the flesh and blood of the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast and some ‘fruit’ from his Storage Space, its body had grown to ninety-five meters in length.
A ninety-five-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon was truly worthy of the name Giant Dragon, with two hundred meters wide wings unfolded, even larger than those large airliners.
At the same time, during this period of effort, the force field runes in its claws had reached a total of fifty, making the restraining force field extremely astonishing.
Not just the humans, but also the Giant Beasts under the lead of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had started rolling up their sleeves to increase their strength.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon looked down at its right claw, where a five-meter diameter azure whirlwind had condensed, containing white frost that could freeze and shatter everything inside.
It looked like a bomb compressed with terrifying power.
Feeling the destructive power contained in its claw, the Silver Giant Dragon showed a fierce and happy smile, “Roar! Now the Great Sethia also has a close-range Power Explosion move.”
Previously, relying on its formidable dragon body, it had been nearly invincible against opponents of the same tier in close combat, always proud of its own strength.
But after encountering the Thunderflame Emperor Beast, it realized how violent and dangerous close combat could be between Giant Beasts.
The Power Explosion that could instantly kill a Giant Beast of the same tier was too brutal, either exploding half of the body or collapsing the head.
Such horrific close combat power made Sethia, as a descendant of the Mythical Dragon, feel somewhat less confident.
After testing the combined power, which equated to that of a regular talent and was specifically for close combat Burst, the Silver Giant Dragon stood up contentedly.
It was time to stretch its legs.
Having been cooped up in the palace for days, it was incredibly bored.
With this thought, the Silver Giant Dragon suddenly rose, trudging with heavy steps out of the Storm and Frost Dragon King Hall.
Outside, it was still the same dark red hue, and the Ice Crystal flashed multicolored light, reflecting throughout half the ‘world’ under the glow of the Volcanic magma.
In the distance, in the sea water, an eighty-meter-long, mountainous Single-horned Tiger Kingfish with a solid build was lazily hitting the water surface with its tail, fervently cultivating.
Seeing this, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a deep roar, “Joe, how many Slash Runes have you condensed?”
As the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, Sethia felt that it should take an interest in the cultivation progress of its underlings and encourage them.
Roar! Just a little more and I’ll condense the fortieth rune.
As it spoke, the enormous Double Fin of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish emerged from the water.
One could see that at the front of those huge fins covered in black scales, they turned gold and black, emanating a sharp and solid aura, like two massive slash blades.
“Roar! Not bad, keep working hard here and strive to condense the fortieth rune. The Great Sethia is going to check on Domination.”
“If it has progressed well in cultivation, we’ll go out and move around a bit.”
“Roar! I’ve been lying in the palace for several days; the Great Sethia wants to see rivers of blood and incidentally help Hegemon collect some High-level Crystals.”
Roar! Let’s go out and kill, loot, eat everything, and get stuff for Thunderflame.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, unable to bear confinement anymore, became excited.
If not for his wife pushing him to cultivate, with his unrestrained and free-spirited nature, he would have long been carrying his horn roaming the streets… no, roaming the seas.
With graceful steps, the Silver Giant Dragon approached the nearby Ice Crystal Palace, poking its head in and finding the mountainous Deep Sea Dragon Turtle actually lying there, sleeping.
With a fierce look in its eyes, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a roar, “Roar! Domination, what are you doing?”
Immediately the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle got startled, jumping to its feet and opening its eyes wide, “Roar! Cultivating, diligently cultivating, pressing on.”
“Roar! Press on your head, the Great Sethia has already seen you slacking off and sleeping. Wait until Hegemon wakes up, and I will tell it, so it can give you a beating.”
Roar! No, Great Sethia, I’ve only napped for a moment, just a moment.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle quickly excused itself, not wanting to be on the receiving end of the ferocious claws of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon – if it didn’t control its power, it could be fatal.
Boom!
Right then, a terrifying aura burst forth in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 553: 261: Nine-heads Monarch, Keep Going Youth (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Chapter 261: Nine-heads Monarch, Keep Going Youth (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Boom!
A terrifying aura that shook the mini-world burst forth.
Amidst the eruption of flames mixed with red solid ice, the majestic palace, three hundred meters high and over two hundred meters wide, collapsed in an instant, shaking Heaven and Earth.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Surrounded by flames and frost, one after another, ferocious black dragon heads shot up into the sky, bellowing heavenward, and immediately, bursts of substantial sound waves exploded.
After slumbering for about ten days, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon finally made its breakthrough to Level 9, and its body length surged to over one hundred and eighty meters, with some changes in its form as well.
The nine dragon heads looked more dragon-like, with stout bodies radiating an imposing might.
Though the heads looked like those of dragons, the aura it emitted didn’t carry Dragon Might, but another ancient and savage aura not inferior to that of dragon species.
Just as the Nine-headed Flood Dragon broke through,
In the volcanic magma 10,000 meters below, a black-red Colossal Beast with a body length that had swelled to one hundred and thirty meters and an even more menacing and terrifying form slowly opened its eyes.
Black-blue lightning danced upon its dorsal fin, forming an invisible electromagnetic wave that enveloped the entire Ice and Fire mini-world.
“King-level, huh? Not bad.”
Amidst the low growling and intense sleepiness, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon closed its eyes once again.
As a beast that had awakened four Advanced Talents and approached King-level in bloodline, Kidora had finally reached King-level under the influence of the Majesty of the Emperor invoked by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon on two occasions.
During its Evolution, the fusion of two Advanced Talents gave birth to a top tier talent similar to Blood Fire Ice Flame, both antagonistic and harmonious, filled with a destructive force.
This was also why the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was disturbed.
A Ninth Level Giant Beast possessing top tier talent and having reached King-level was extremely formidable.
For instance, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast could trigger tsunamis that drowned tens of kilometers with a Power Explosion, freeze the sea, more terrifying than those mythical sea monsters.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Having broken through to Level 9 and with its bloodline evolved to King-level, Kidora was extremely excited. Its nine dragon heads twisted, letting out exultant roars that shook the Dragon Palace continuously.
At that moment, in the distance, the Silver Giant Dragon surrounded by raging winds and mingled with frost roared at Kidora, “Kidora, quickly retract your domain, you’ve damaged the Dragon Palace.”
“When Hegemon wakes up and sees the damage to the Dragon Palace, he is sure to be furious.”
Hearing the name of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, Kidora, which had been recklessly bursting its power and scorching its surroundings, stiffened all nine heads and meekly withdrew its domain.
“Roar Roar Roar!! The palace, I will repair, don’t, tell, Abbott.”
“Roar! Agreed, but you need to thoroughly rebuild and expand the entire Dragon Palace. The current palace feels somewhat confining to Great Scythia.”
Kidora did not refuse this.
For two beasts measuring ninety and over one hundred and eighty meters in length, a palace three hundred meters high and over two hundred meters wide was too small.
It would feel more comfortable at least expanded to five hundred meters high and one thousand meters wide.
But by doing so, the five Dragon King palaces plus the main hall of the Dragon Palace would occupy nearly half the mini-world, including the need to freeze and fill in the sea surface area.
Thump!
The sea surface burst open, revealing the massive forms of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, both of which showed envy in their eyes upon seeing the Nine-headed Flood Dragon.
Roar Roar!! Kidora, you’ve become so fierce.
Kidora’s nine dragon heads shook, emitting a proud and chaotic roar, “Roar Roar Roar!! That’s right, Kidora, now, super fierce, awesome, freaking amazing.”
Roar Roar Roar!! You’re freaking amazing now, quick, take us to Eating and Drinking Well.
“Roar! The Great Scythia wants to see a river of blood. Kidora, don’t bother repairing the palace for now, let’s stir things up… no, let’s go fight.”
“A few days ago, Horned Lady came back from collecting crystals and mentioned that she felt the presence of a Ninth Level Extraordinary Lifeform in the southern sea area, with an aura as strong as the skeleton outside Hegemon’s palace.”
“Let’s defeat that Ninth Level Extraordinary Lifeform, seize its Territory, and gather Life Crystals.”
“When Hegemon awakens and breaks through to Level 9, it can ‘consume’ some crystals, become stronger, and lead us to more treasures.”
The more the Silver Giant Dragon spoke, the more excited it became, feeling its Dragon Blood boil within.
Approaching Level 8 Late Stage, it was no longer the same creature as before. With its talent and dragon bloodline, it could even venture a fight with a Level 9 Early Stage Lord Giant Beast.
Instantly, Kidora’s nine pairs of eyes lit up, letting out excited and chaotic roars, “Roar Roar Roar!! Go, get crystals for Abbott, charge!”
Having just advanced to Level 9, it too longed for a grand battle.
Roar Roar!! Charge, kill and plunder! The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle became excited; after repressing its urge for so many days, it was finally allowed to cause havoc outside.
Roar Roar Roar!! Wait up, let me call my wife and the others.
Soon, led by the Silver Giant Dragon, one Level 9 Giant Beast, three Level 8 Middle Phase Giant Beasts, and four Level 7 Mutated Tiger Whales, a total of eight giant beasts swam out of the Dragon Palace.
As they swam out, the Blue Giant Crab guarding the gate quickly blew bubbles.
Blurp blurp, Lord Scythia, are you going out?
Roar Roar Roar!! We’re going out for a bloodbath, ha-ha carnage. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flapped its Double Fins excitedly, this time it would slay ten Giant Beasts.
Blurp blurp, My Lord, you’re so mighty, so strong, you’re simply the epitome of awesome, each one of you is freaking amazing, may I join you?
After flattering them, the Blue Giant Crab added another line.
As a Mutant Beast, though it belonged to the crab species, it still inherently thrived on brutality and cruelty which it hid in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon behind a facade of obedience.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared, “Roar! If you follow, who’ll guard the gate? Hegemon is still breaking through in his sleep; make sure that no other beast disturbs him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 554: 261: Nine-heads Monarch, Go For It Youth (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Chapter 261: Nine-heads Monarch, Go For It Youth (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
Gurgle, gurgle! Yes, I will definitely keep a good watch on the gate and guard the great King Thunderflame.
In the regretful gaze of the Blue Giant Crab, the eight-headed Giant Beast disappeared in the dark sea.
…
After flying for over nine hours and with the raging wind wave, the airplane landed at South City Airport.
The departure time for everyone was in the morning, but due to the time difference, it was only in the afternoon when they arrived here.
After getting off the plane, Damon Lopes bid goodbye stylishly to Jack Clark and the others, “Sister Ilisa, Boss Boyce, I’ll take my leave first. Brother Callum, I’ll see you on the Road to Godhood.”
Having said that, Damon Lopes turned around suavely and walked towards a black military vehicle parked not far away.
At this moment, a woman in her twenties dressed in a military uniform approached, and she said politely to Jack Clark, “Hello, Student Clark. I am Cicely Rodgers, from South Base.”
“Commander Valentine Leach asks that you stop by, he has something to discuss with you.”
The day after the concert ended, Tyler Lance had called Jack Clark, informing him that the military would be looking for him once he arrived in South.
As the ‘Pride of the South’ on the Southern Battlefield, the Genius Federation would invest heavily in the cultivation of a genius like Jack Clark, and he would be provided with ample resources at every level of the heavens.
It’s just that Jack Clark’s breakthrough speed was so fast it caught many people off guard, and they had to overturn their plans time and time again.
Jack Clark looked back at Mathilda Ward and the others, “Miss Ward, Boss Boyce, Miss Fiore, we will have the chance to meet again in the future.”
Crystal Boyce smiled and said, “Misss Joseline has been under your care for some time. I said I would host a dinner for you once we are back, but it seems that will have to wait until next time.”
“Goodbye, Mr. Callum.”
Mathilda Ward smiled and waved her hand, “Go on, Brother Callum, your matters are important, but remember to let me know when you leave South City.”
“I still owe you a gift, and I’ve already thought of what to give you.”
“Alright, I will definitely notify you when I leave South,” Jack Clark waved back at them.
With his ‘bodyguard’ mission completed, he was ready to return home for a visit and to also see Freya Louise.
With the intrigued gazes of Mathilda Ward, Crystal Boyce, Marla Fiore, and the employees of the distant Group, Jack Clark, standing tall, boarded the military vehicle and left.
“Mr. Callum really does come from the military, he even has a military vehicle waiting for him right after getting off the plane.”
“Do you think we will have the chance to see Mr. Callum again?”
“Stop dreaming; we’re just ordinary people. It’s only because of Ilisa that we got a chance to see a genius like him up close this time.”
“Indeed, he is not from the same world as us.”
As the beautiful backup dancers whispered among themselves, Marla Fiore called out from a distance, “Everyone, come over here, get on the bus, we’re heading back to the company.”
More than an hour later, outside the gates of South City, at the Military Base.
Under the guidance of Cicely Rodgers, Jack Clark arrived at the base’s command office, where a scholarly middle-aged man in his forties was already waiting for him.
Seeing Jack Clark enter, the middle-aged man’s face lit up with a smile, “Student Clark has arrived, come, sit and let’s talk.”
“Greetings to General Leach,” Jack Clark politely greeted, then took a seat opposite him.
Inside the Federation, every Military Base has strong men stationed at it, and they are divided according to the base’s level.
For instance, Level 1 bases like the Southern Battlefield are garrisoned by Level 9 Peak strong men who might step into the King level at any moment.
Whereas a second-tier base such as South Base has a garrison commander like Valentine Leach who is at the Eighth Layer Peak.
As for the Military Base hundreds of kilometers away from Gunardo, its stationed strong man is at the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven,
These strong men, said to be stationed, actually spend more time consolidating, slowly polishing their cultivation realms, waiting for the moment to breakthrough and head to the Frontline Battlefield,
like Vernon Lowe and Lori Parma.
Beyond that, there are Fortress-level Bases guarding the world passageways, garrisoned by king-level powerhouses, equipped with many cutting-edge high-powered weapons.
After Jack Clark sat down, Barry Leonard smiled and said, “Here, on behalf of the Federation and the Human Race, I want to thank you and Damon Lopes for your exceptional performance.”
“With your actions, we fulfilled our plan, slaying the True Body of Kautorus and sealing one of Akunus’ soul sources.”
“Especially Akunus, even if we couldn’t slay it, this time we were able to destroy its Rule True Body, preventing it from recovering for a hundred years.”
“Akunus isn’t dead?” Jack Clark paused briefly.
Barry Leonard shook his head. “The outcome of the great battle over there hasn’t been reported back. Both sides should still be fighting; I’m just making a prediction based on the current situation.”
“As a high-end power, a king’s every move can have a profound impact.”
“So, despite the many king-level beings taking action this time, catching Akunus and the others by surprise, it’s hard to keep all of them.”
“After the outbreak of the great battle, high-end strong men from both sides will rush to support, and I expect that we can slay at most two demon kings this time as the limit.”
“As for Akunus, when I started my cultivation, this being was already making waves in the mythical world, surviving multiple pursuits by human strong men without dying.”
“The reason lies in the blood rule it master, which is very tricky; I’m sure you’ve felt this as well, Student Clark.”
“Indeed,” Jack Clark nodded.
Compared to Kautorus, which was destroyed in two hits, Akunus’ tactics were far more sinister and tricky; it could even separate its soul source from its Divine Soul

chapters.title: Chapter 555: 261 Nine-Heads Monarch, You Can Do It, Youth (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: Chapter 261 Nine-Heads Monarch, You Can Do It, Youth (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
“However, Student Clark, your performance was so outstanding this time that we suggest you use the alias from this mission as your main identity when you enter the mythical world in the future.”
Jack Clark’s gaze flickered slightly, “Continue using the name Darren Callum.”
Valentine Leach nodded, “Yes, currently the civilization war between the Human Race and The Purgatory Family is becoming more intense, including the assassination operations targeting the new generation of geniuses.”
“In addition, the Federal Logistics Department has included your family members in the protection list, including an upgrade in the security level of Mist River City by one level.”
“Next, you just focus on your cultivation without worrying about the safety of your family, and strive to achieve a breakthrough to the king-level as soon as possible.”
Having finished discussing this matter, Valentine Leach asked, “Student Clark, you are aware of the Three Major Military Institutions of the Federation, aren’t you? I wonder which one you are inclined to join?”
“Rest assured that the military actually won’t impose too many restrictions on geniuses. After joining, it’s mainly about determining your growth path.”
“No matter which department you join, you will receive 1000 points of Merit Points every month, and the Federation will be responsible for supplying the subsequent cultivation resources.”
“However, for some special top-tier resources, they still need to be exchanged with Merit Points.”
After the Seventh Layer, each step is another Layer of Heaven, and the cultivation speed slows even more. Normally, a genius would take at least ten years to progress through one layer, and due to certain flaws, some might be stuck at the Eight Layer or Nine Layers unable to advance an inch.
At this time, top-tier resources from the mythical world become extremely precious.
Those Heaven and Earth Treasures can speed up the materialization of true martial arts phantoms, strengthen Eighth Layer Battle Bodies, and help those at the Nine Layers to comprehend the rules and contemplate Heaven and Earth.
With the help of those top-tier resources, cultivators can quickly surpass the accumulation of cultivation levels and merely need to work hard on improving their realm.
But these resources from the mythical world are very precious, and even Jack Clark, a top-tier monster like him, needs to use Merit Points to exchange for them.
As for the issue with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, although it has dominated a large sea area during this period, it has not found any top-tier Heaven and Earth Treasure, only ordinary resources.
Jack Clark thought for a moment, “I’m planning to join the Special Warfare Division.”
Compared with the Corps Department, which conducts group army operations, Jack Clark felt he was more suited to the vanguard combat of the Special Warfare Division and expeditions, but expeditions would have to wait until after the war ends.
As for the idea of not joining the military and focusing entirely on cultivation, Jack Clark had never considered it.
Although he is always cautious, he never lacks the spirit of ambition, and the overall situation does not allow him to slowly develop his strength; he needs to become stronger at a faster pace.
Whether it is on the side of the Giant Beast Avatar or his original self.
As long as he still cares about Doris Clark, cares about Glenn Clark and those friends, and does not want Blue Star to become Hell, then only one side can survive between him and The Purgatory Family.
Valentine Leach’s face turned solemn, “Authorized by the headquarters, I now represent the Special Warfare Division and the Federation in conferring upon you, Comrade Jack Clark, the Lieutenant Colonel rank.”
Saying that, Valentine Leach stood up, took an envelope from the drawer, and handed it over to Jack Clark with both hands.
Jack Clark also stood up, receiving the commissioning letter with both hands, a serious expression on his face.
This time, the rank of Lieutenant Colonel was different from the previous Second Lieutenant rank. As a member of the Military Affairs Office, he had actual power at his rank and could mobilize resources below the academy level from various places.
After the simple commissioning ceremony, Valentine Leach’s face once again showed a smile, “Seeing such achievements from you at such a young age, Jack Clark, is like seeing the future of the Human Race.”
Jack Clark politely said, “General Leach flatters me, it’s all due to the Federation’s nurturing.”
Had it not been for entering school for cultivation, although he could have relied on Avatar Evolution to strengthen his body, he would only be equivalent to an ordinary Level 7 ‘Mutated Beast’ at most.
And that would be the kind without extraordinary talent or powers.”
After exchanging a few pleasantries, Valentine Leach once again got down to business.
“You have already condensed Rune Illusions; next, you just need your cultivation level to reach the peak of the Six Heavens, and with the unity of Spirit Qi, you can break into the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“Before you returned, I had already applied for five top-tier flame crystals for you.”
“These crystals contain flame energy not only can significantly enhance the richness of True Strength, expand the dantian but also have a slight Quality Change Effect.”
“At that time, combined with the tempering of will by the Soul-suppressing Monument containing the Mental Pressure of a Monarch, you can reach the peak of the Six Heavens within a week, with a stable foundation.”
“The Road to Becoming a God is about to open, and if you can break through to the Seventh Layer in one go, entering the relic with the cultivation of the Seventh Layer will increase the probability of obtaining the Origin.”
“And it’s not just you; geniuses from various countries selected for the list have also received a massive tilt in resources.”
“This opportunity is monumental for both you and the Federation, and I can’t help but be excited at the thought of the Human Race’s high-end strongmen bursting forth once more.”
“So keep it up, youth.”

chapters.title: Chapter 556: 262 Closed-door Breakthrough, Scythia Takes Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Chapter 262 Closed-door Breakthrough, Scythia Takes Off
After receiving five flame crystals about the size of a palm, sealed with the King’s Will Jade, Jack Clark pondered.
He felt that the incident involving Koroya and the second cleanup of the Evil God Sect Cultists were all preparations for the Gods Creation Plan.
To prevent these guys from causing trouble when the time comes.
However, after obtaining the resources, Jack didn’t immediately go into closed-door cultivation; instead, he took out his mobile phone, flipped through it, and dialed Doris Clark’s number.
Now that the mission was completed, there was no need for secrecy.
Soon, Doris’s voice came from the other end, somewhat surprised, “Jack, have you finished your business?”
A smile appeared on Jack’s face as he spoke in a gentle tone, “Yes, it’s finished. Mom, how have you and Jim been at home?”
“Nothing much at home. Oh right, Jack, I got another promotion, my salary has gone up to twenty-eight thousand, and the work isn’t as busy as before.”
“Haha, that’s great. It seems your company boss really knows talent.”
“Mom, Glenn’s phone?”
“Right.”
“Give it to me, give it to me.”
Today was Sunday, Glenn Clark wasn’t at school, and he hadn’t gone out fishing because it was too hot during the afternoon – he usually only went out at night.
Then, Glenn’s excited voice came through, “Big bro, when are you coming back?”
Still so brash, a warm smile crossed Jack’s face as he replied, “In a few days, I need to make a breakthrough in my cultivation.”
“Bro, you’re breaking through again!?” Glenn’s astonished voice came from the other end.
“Pretty much.”
“Haha, as expected of my brother. When I saw you blow up that Nine-headed Blood Python with one punch, I got so excited that I almost smashed my computer.”
“Uh… Take it easy. Have you been getting stronger lately?” Jack asked.
As for him being recognized by them, Jack had anticipated it; after all, he hadn’t completely changed his appearance, only made minor adjustments to his facial features.
Glenn replied, “I don’t know if it’s because I’ve been eating more lately, but my strength has grown a lot. Oh, by the way, we’re almost out of the Alien Beast Meat you sent back.”
Indeed, his brother was about to awaken.
Jack thought inwardly and casually said, “Someone will deliver more Alien Beast Meat later; don’t worry about it.”
When he first entered the Alien Beast Battlefield, Jack had already notified the school’s Logistics Department to regularly send a batch of regular Alien Beast Meat with gentle energy back home.
The expenses would be deducted from his Contribution Points.
At that time, Jack was the number one Freshman in the school, so naturally, the Logistics Department wouldn’t refuse such a small favor, and he wasn’t the only one doing this.
The two brothers continued to chat for a while – or rather, Glenn bombarded Jack with questions about combat – before finally hanging up the phone.
Next, Jack dialed Freya Louise’s number.
Freya suddenly leaving had caught Jack by surprise.
But since it was Freya’s aunt who personally came to take her away, Jack wasn’t worried, just a bit puzzled.
Now that he was free, he naturally wanted to say hello; after all, they were very good friends with a close relationship.
However, when Jack tried to call her, he got, “Sorry, the number you have dialed is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.”
“In cultivation, I guess.” Jack sent a message that he would look for her in a few days.
Afterward, he pondered for a bit and, finding nothing else needing attention, entered the Cultivation Room.
With the heavy door closing behind him, the one hundred square meter cultivation room fell into silence, illuminated only by a faint white light flickering in the center.
Jack sat down cross-legged in the middle of the room and took out two fist-sized golden crystals containing leaping golden flames, emitting astonishing energy fluctuations.
As energy resources two levels higher than Blue Crystals, when Jack activated his True Dragon Power, streams of scorching energy burst into his body like a mountain torrent.
Whooosh!
As the scorching energy surged in, his True Dragon Power, already nearing the peak of the Sixth-level Heaven, swelled with each circulation, expanding his Dantian.
Meanwhile, the jade bearing a strand of King’s Will activated instantly, unleashing a terrifying pressure explosion.
Boom! Under the solid manifestation of King’s Intent, the entire Cultivation Room vibrated faintly, and Jack’s consciousness was struck with a thunderous impact.
Roar!
At that moment, a fierce dragon’s roar echoed from the depths of Jack’s consciousness, followed by an outburst of Dragon Might not inferior to that of a King-level.
Boom! As the two substantial pressures collided, the void around Jack exploded, creating concentric circles of transparent shockwaves.
As his will condensed and his aura grew heavier under the collision of the two pressures, his breathing created gusts of raging wind, as if a Giant Beast was awakening.
Meanwhile, as Jack was in closed-door cultivation.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
Five thousand meters down in the deep sea, a great battle was about to erupt.
On the left was the power of the Dragon Palace led by the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by a domain of green hurricanes and frost, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon with its Red Ice Flame Domain unfurled.
On the right was a Level 9 Giant Beast that resembled a Sea Dragon, over 160 meters long, covered in Blue Scales, and sporting a pair of Dragon Claws on its underside.
Within five hundred meters of this Giant Beast, countless blue stars swirled around like a galaxy, emitting an aura so dangerous even the Silver Giant Dragon felt threatened.
They had never seen such a peculiar domain before.
Besides, surrounding this Level 9 Giant Beast were two more of the same type, seventy to eighty meters long, and a dozen others ranging from thirty to more than 50 meters.
While the bloodline of this Level 9 Giant Beast had not reached the Monarch level and was only of a ‘common’ Lord, the homologous bloodline still formed a giant beast power.

chapters.title: Chapter 557: 262: Secluded Breakthrough, Cestia Takes Off_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Chapter 262: Secluded Breakthrough, Cestia Takes Off_2
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon arrogantly stepped forward, raised its dragon head, and roared, “Roar! You despicable transcendent creatures, kneel before the great Scythia!”
Kneel??
Looking at the powerful aura emanating from the Silver Giant Dragon a thousand meters away, a string of question marks appeared on the head of the enormous Level 9 Sea Dragon.
What is kneeling?
At this time, a fierce aura burst out from the Star-Studded Giant Beast. Its huge mouth slightly opened, and it let out a low roar: Roar! Get out, of, my, territory.
Meow meow meow! This guy actually told us to get lost? Kill it. A fierce color appeared in the eyes of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, and the edges of its huge fins shimmered with black gold light.
Roar roar! Brothers, grab your weapons, beat it, today Domination wants to defeat ten of them.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared excitedly, not waiting for the most ferocious Nine-headed Flood Dragon to speak. It rushed out surrounded by the Crushing Domain.
The nine heads of the Black Flood Dragon shook continuously, letting out an urgent, chaotic roar: “Roar roar roar! Kidora, hasn’t, spoken, yet, give me, come back.”
With Kidora’s roar, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle ran even faster, roaring excitedly: Roar roar! I’ll lead the charge, brothers, charge, kill them!
“Roar! Today, the great Scythia wants to see rivers of blood flow.”
Seeing that the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had already started, the Silver Giant Dragon also roared, spreading its wings, and in an instant, turned into a white and green light and flew out.
As it passed by, the sea water froze and shattered, forming a frozen slag pathway more than two hundred meters wide under the sea. In the blink of an eye, it hurtled past the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and threw itself at the Star-Studded Giant Beast.
Roar!
Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon, which was more than ninety meters long and a whole major realm lower in level than it, the Star-Studded Giant Beast roared with fury.
Boom!
A blue radiance shone on the body of this giant beast, and the meter-wide crystals like stardust in the Domain shot out, resembling blue meteorites.
In an instant, those blue meteorites appeared in front of the Silver Giant Dragon, followed by an overwhelming sense of danger that enveloped it.
With the intense feeling of danger, the Silver Giant Dragon’s third eye shimmered with silver light as it instinctively twisted space to teleport and disappear, while those blue meteorites radiated dazzling light.
Boom boom boom! Those stardusts exploded like high-purity explosives, releasing a terrifying destructive force in an instant and forming dazzling blue lights.
In the violent explosion, the seabed collapsed within a range of several hundred meters, and the sea water formed an ever-expanding white light sphere under the wild shockwaves.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had just rushed to the front, was the first to be hit. Its enormous body continued to retreat under the shock of the earth and the Crushing Domain with the impact of the white light waves.
Roar!
The Silver Giant Dragon appeared above the Star-Studded Giant Beast. Storm and Frost Domain collided with the Blue Domain, neutralizing each other and creating waves of energy impact.
In the right claw of the Silver Giant Dragon, a blue hurricane with a diameter of five meters and countless tiny, hard ice pieces inside rotated rapidly, emitting a destructive aura.
However, just as the Silver Giant Dragon’s claw was about to fall, the Star-Studded Giant Beast below suddenly flipped over, and an even larger dragon claw surrounded by blue light rushed up towards the sky.
At the same time, the ‘stars’ around it shone, striking towards the Silver Giant Dragon like meteorites.
Boom!
The moment the two dragon claws, one large and one small, clashed, a violent impact erupted, and the Silver Giant Dragon was directly blasted away by the Star-Studded Giant Beast under the explosive force of destruction.
The huge body blasted through the water and smashed into the underwater slope a thousand meters away, immediately followed by dozens of blue meteorites engulfing it.
In an instant, half of the hillside collapsed, and in the dazzling blue light, a violent explosion set off a wild shockwave, turning the sea water within hundreds of meters range murky.
Compared to the bulky and 150-meter-long Sea Dragon, the 90-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon was overall half its size.
Not to mention the qualitative change that came with the level difference.
Even though the Silver Giant Dragon had a king-level bloodline, it couldn’t shake the Level 9 Giant Beast when it was at Level 8 Mid Stage, after all, it wasn’t the monstrous Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Seeing such a ferocious scene, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, who had rushed up with raging momentum, both stared with wide eyes.
Meow meow meow! This guy is too fierce. Let’s leave it to Kidora.
Roar roar! Domination wants to defeat ten monsters today.
In their roars, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle changed direction and charged towards the Level 7 Sea Dragon Giant Beasts in the distance, while the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish went after another Level 8 Sea Dragon.
“Roar roar roar! The great, Kidora, is super fierce, watch me, obliterate it.”
Boom!
An endless power burst from within the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, causing its body to expand wildly. In the blink of an eye, it transformed into a Black Red Flood Dragon more than 600 meters long with three heads.
A terrifying aura emanated from its invisible body, squeezing the surrounding sea water and forming a thousand-meter-wide vacuum under the sea. Its aura was terrifying and frightening.
Like the Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon, after breaking through to Level 9, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon also gained the ability to integrate all its innate talents into a Domain to form a Domain True Body.
However, unlike the Tiger Flood Dragon’s Giant Beast True Body condensed from heavy water, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s True Body was mainly composed of red ice flames and supplemented by black power.
With no nonsense, a fierce battle broke out in an instant.
Roar roar roar!
Surrounded by a terrifying aura, the three-headed Black Flood Dragon ferociously pounced on the Star-Studded Giant Beast.
Facing the star-studded meteors, which were as powerful as missiles, it directly ignored them and fiercely slammed into the Blue Domain amidst the deafening explosions.
Boom!
Under the impact of the three black dragons, the Blue Domain collapsed directly.
In an instant, the two giant beasts engaged in a fierce battle, and the violent force caused the entire ten-kilometer sea area to become turbid and violent.
But it was more like a fierce battle, with the three-headed Kidora suppressing and beating the Star-Studded Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 558: 262: Seclusion Breakthrough, Scythia Takes Off_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Chapter 262: Seclusion Breakthrough, Scythia Takes Off_3
With their overwhelmingly large bodies, the three dragon heads with the gift of strength were frighteningly powerful, tearing and biting frenzically. domains shattered under their ferocious maws, and their scale armor cracked.
As for the star-dust beasts’ star-like, orbiting explosions, they were directly ignored by their domain true forms, which had high defenses against energy attacks.
Only those giant dragon claws posed some threat to them, tearing apart their black dragon scales each time, causing them to explode, and then recover instantly under the power of their domain.
“Roar! Kidora, kill it!” The silver giant dragon flapped its wings, circling the battlefield in flight and emitting piercing roars.
Suddenly, the right claw of the silver beast waved, puncturing through space in a flurry of silver distortions and appeared unexpectedly above the head of a Level 8 Sea Dragon which was lunging towards the deep sea dragon turtle.
Boom! The claw, carrying the power of a dragon, exploded the domain, with the blue hurricane black crystal gripped within it detonating.
Crack! Under the explosive power of the frigid shredding, the head of this early-stage Level 8 Sea Dragon exploded, instantly killed by the surprise attack of the silver giant dragon.
This brutal attack left the deep-sea dragon turtle staring in shock: Roar Roar!! Sethia, when did you become so fierce?
“Roar! The great Sethia has always been fierce!” The silver giant dragon raised its head haughtily, revealing a hint of disdain in its eyes towards them.
It couldn’t defeat the Level 9 giant beast, but it was easy to instantly kill a normal early-stage Level 8 beast.
However, Brock Abbott’s skill of compressing strength tenfold, combined with his talent for space, seemed somewhat formidable. The silver giant dragon’s eyes flickered.
Although the silver giant dragon possessed a top-tier space talent due to its innate space rune, this talent was mainly manifested in teleportation and creating pathways.
As for ripping dimensions and spatial banishments, these powerful spatial abilities, it didn’t have any.
Therefore, as a king-level dragon, its strength was not as formidable as imagined, only capable of bullying other same-level life forms.
This was the reason it always lost to Telsafi in the past.
But now, “Roar Roar!! The great Sethia, flew, after I go back, I will form a hundred, no, five hundred force field binding runes.”
Roar roar roar!! The silver giant dragon excitedly circled under the sea, occasionally swinging a claw, instantly blowing up the head of a Level 7 Sea Dragon several miles away.
Sethia, save some for me, save some for me, roared.
Seeing one after another Level 7 Sea Dragons continuously being killed, the deep-sea dragon turtle, which was chasing behind them, suddenly felt anxious.
At this moment, a shadow suddenly rushed out from the seabed.
Bang!
Under the gaping mouth like a black hole, the scales of the Level 7 Sea Dragon broke, half of its body disappeared, leaving only half a corpse spewing out hot blood and turning the seawater red.
It was the female tiger whale that had followed later and had no sense of existence.
After swallowing a Level 7 Sea Dragon in one gulp, the female tiger whale concealed the breath of its body, its massive body silently disappearing into the dark sea water.
Roar roar!! Leave two for Domination.
Boom!
With a roar, a yellow beam jetted out from the mouth of the deep-sea dragon turtle, pierced through the sea water, and ruthlessly bombarded a Level 7 giant beast hundreds of meters away.
Boom!
A yellow halo erupted around the body of the 40 metre Sea Dragon, the sea water exploded, and then it was immediately blown dozens of meters away by the energy shock wave, and then… disappeared.
Due to being lazy and only forming more than twenty energy conversion runes, the breath of dragon turtle was quite ordinary.
Ying Ying Ying!! I’ll bite its head.
Ying Ying Ying!! I’ll bite its tail.
In the darkness, three small tiger whales, each about thirty meters long, rushed up. Two tiger whales, with flames burning on them, each bit onto the Sea Dragon’s tail and fin respectively.
The third-ranked tiger whale held its mouth open wide, viciously biting down onto its head.
Bang! With the terrifying biting strength and talent for demolishing, half of this Sea Dragon’s head was bitten and cracked, and then swallowed into its body by the talent of devouring.
This breakthrough to Level 7, with a little bit of a king-level bloodline waking up, the real freak was this third-ranked one.
Meanwhile, the single-horned tiger kingfish over there was also suppressing and fighting the Level 8 Sea Dragon.
As its surrounding domain turned into white aura, its vitality surged tenfold, and its fins, like large slashing blades, tore through the opposing domain, leaving massive wounds on the body of the eighty-metre-long Sea Dragon.
When the Sea Dragon launched an attack, the surrounding domain of the single-horned tiger kingfish would turn black, disappearing, directly ignoring all kinds of attacks.
It wasn’t until nearly half an hour later that the battle ended.
In the sea water dyed red with blood, the massive body of the nine-headed flood dragon slowly shrank, quickly restoring to its one hundred and eighty meters appearance with nine heads, all of which were panting lightly.
Huge consumption.
As it had just broken through, it was somewhat strenuous for it to kill a colossus of the same level.
If it weren’t for its domain true body with high immunity to energy, which just happened to counter the opponent’s talent, killing the Star Dust Beast would have at least exacted a price.
Such as two heads or something.
At this time, the deep-sea dragon turtle came over, looked at the giant beast carcass torn into two parts, and roared excitedly.
Roar roar!! Kidora, you’re awesome, to have disposed of this guy so quickly.
The single-horned tiger kingfish that had already killed the Level 8 giant beast earlier also swam over, expressing its envy: Ying Ying Ying!! Indeed, awesome, explosively cool.
“Roar roar roar!! Not bad, better than…Brock, just a bit.” The nine-headed flood dragon shook its nine heads, showing a gloating expression on each of their faces.
The silver giant dragon, that had flown back from elsewhere, raised its head at this moment, “Roar! Kidora, once the great Sethia breaks through to Level 9, it’s certainly going to be tougher than you.”
Without waiting for Kidora to rebut, the silver giant dragon continued roaring: “The corpse of this Level 9 Transcendent creature is your responsibility to bring back to Hegemon.”
“Among those extraordinary creatures just now, there is one that reached the peak of Level 7, there should be a Life Crystal, don’t miss it.”
“As for us, we’ll stay to clean up this sea area, kill all those Transcendent beasts that are Level 4 or higher, at their peak level, collect crystals, and help Hegemon take off.”
Roar roar!! Sethia, why am I the one bringing the corpse back? Domination also wants to flow rivers of blood.
The silver giant dragon raised its head proudly: “Roar! Because you’re so stupid, in this war of extermination, you didn’t even kill a Level 7 Transcendent Lifeform.”

chapters.title: Chapter 559: 263: The Battle Emperor Dragon, Eternal Hibernation (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Chapter 263: The Battle Emperor Dragon, Eternal Hibernation (Seeking Monthly Votes)
While the Dragon Palace Giant Beasts were preparing crystals for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the ferocious behemoth beneath the volcano was still in hibernation, while Jack Clark continued his closed-door cultivation.
This session of closed-door cultivation lasted even longer than Jack Clark had anticipated.
Originally, while condensing the Rune Illusions, Jack Clark estimated that it would take him just over ten days to cultivate to the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, and then attempt a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer.
But unexpectedly, the closer he got to the peak of the Sixth Layer Heaven, the slower the condensation of the True Dragon Power became, as if an invisible force was suppressing his breakthrough.
And this force came from Heaven and Earth.
Under these circumstances, each step forward became harder, and at the same time, the True Dragon Power under the heavy pressure of Heaven and Earth became more concentrated and pure, ultimately reaching its peak.
Boom!
As the Golden True Dragon Power in his dantian condensed to the utmost limit, golden light erupted from Jack Clark’s body, turning him into a beacon of light, emitting a terrifyingly heavy aura.
With Jack Clark as the center, the ground as hard as iron slightly sunk, and web-like cracks spread in all directions, as if it couldn’t support him.
But this still wasn’t enough.
Just as the True Dragon Power transformed into a flame and erupted, Jack Clark, who had long reached the Seventh Layer Heaven in his realm of thought, made a move.
Boom!
Above the Cultivation Room, a colossal shadow slowly emerged, wielding a War Halberd, surrounded by light wheels, instantly causing the Heavenly Energy within a radius of more than a thousand meters to go berserk.
Endless Heavenly Energy rapidly converged, creating a raging wind that shook the trees on the base and blew sand and rocks throughout the area.
The sudden change immediately caught the attention of countless people on the base, many of whom looked up in the direction of the Cultivation Room with shocked expressions on their faces.
They saw a thirty-meter-tall figure standing in the distance, surrounded by white mist, with lightning flashing within it, and golden flames burning.
“Someone’s breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven!”
“Hiss! Such mighty force, are you sure this is a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, not the Eighth?”
“Yeah, when Major Timothy Lance broke through to the Seventh Layer, the true martial arts phantom he condensed was only ten meters tall, and the Heavenly Energy he influenced was only within a three-hundred-meter radius.”
“Who is the person breaking through, why are they so monstrous?”
From the base’s tower, Valentine Leach stood by the window with his hands behind his back, admiring the shadow surrounded by lightning and fire in the distance: “Worthy of one who created his own Secret Manual in the Sixth Layer Heaven and possesses the king-level attitude of a prodigy.”
“Just having condensed it, the true martial arts phantom has already reached the size limit of a Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator. In such a case, the amplification from the Power of Heaven and Earth will not be less than ten times.”
“Moreover, with the anomalies that surround him, his true martial arts phantom has integrated two complete Elemental Talent Runes.”
“But to materialize such an immense true martial arts phantom from illusion, it will require more than ten times the Power of Heaven and Earth compared to other cultivators, can he withstand it?”
Valentine Leach’s eyes rapidly filled with amazement as he saw the distant phantom solidify at a speed visible to the naked eye, growing faster and faster.
“Incredible, the young people of today,” Valentine Leach exclaimed in admiration.
In the room, the light from Jack Clark’s body, formed by his spirit qi, burst forth and burned, refining the converging Power of Heaven and Earth into Heavenly Energy infused with ‘creation’.
However, this kind of burning consumed a great deal, similar to Jack Clark entering a state of rune transformation.
That is why, when cultivators break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, the true martial arts phantom they condense is usually maintained at around ten meters before they gradually strengthen and refine it later.
But for Jack Clark, with his robust physique, vast true strength, and vast spirit, none of these were problems.
The flames burned, Heavenly Energy howled, and a large amount of Heavenly Energy merging below turned the originally rune-condensed phantom from illusion to reality, and the speed kept accelerating.
Under the watchful eyes of many people at the Military Base, the true martial arts phantom quickly completed its materialization.
And just at the moment when the Combat Shadow was fully condensed, the surrounding Thunderflame shook violently and rushed toward the light wheel at the back, merging into the two light wheels.
Hum!
On the third light wheel behind the Combat Shadow, flames burned, while the inner first light wheel turned into a form of lightning, with arcs sparkling around it in a manner both sacred and majestic.
At the same time, in the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark also had lightning jumping on his body, surrounded by bands of golden flame, radiating intense heat.
Moreover, the power from the Combat Shadow bolstered Jack Clark, and in an instant, his aura surged, the flame erupted, and the entire Cultivation Room vibrated violently.
Feeling the even more powerful True Dragon Power within him after the second qualitative change, and the invisible bolstered power, Jack Clark willed his attribute page to appear.
Realm: Seventh Layer Heaven [Early Stage]
Physique: 3180
Strength: 3407
Agility: 2535
Spirit: 2349
Talent: Soul Split+ [Top-tier, Passive, Emperor Protection] Void Double Pupils+ [Senior]
Cultivation Methods: Combat Divine Body: Halberd [Seventh Layer, Combat Shadow 10%: When externalized, it gathers Heavenly Energy, a twelve-fold amplification of the external release of True Dragon Power.
Obtain the Elemental Powers of Thunder and Golden Flame.
Obtain a five-fold increase in strength, five-fold Defense, and twice the speed.
Obtain Emperor Dragon Strength, with Divine Might Entwining.
Obtain Combat Transformation: Activate the Combat Divine Runes, use Dragon Blood Battle Armor as the carrier, absorb Heavenly Energy, and enter the Combat Emperor Dragon Colossal Transformation.
In this state, strength is amplified thirty times, Defense thirty times, the external release of True Strength amplification is raised to twenty times, speed is reduced, and transformation ends when contained Heavenly Energy is exhausted.
Note: The higher the completeness of the Combat Shadow, the stronger all-round enhancements.]
Runes: Blood Sea Purgatory [Complete] Hidden Deity [Complete] Cut through the Void [Incomplete]
Realm of thought: Prison Blood War Intent [Minor Achievement: Gather Heavenly Energy, increase the might of the external release of True Strength by twofold]

chapters.title: Chapter 560: 263: The Battle Emperor Dragon, Eternal Hibernation (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Chapter 263: The Battle Emperor Dragon, Eternal Hibernation (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
“`
Attribute points: 3
Equipment: Dragon Blood Battle Armor [Top-tier Transcendent], Eight Desolate Battle Halberd [Senior Transcendent]
Avatar Body: Ancient Thunderflame Emperor Dragon…
His gaze swept across the data changes following the breakthrough, particularly the notes behind the Combat Divine Body, and Jack Clark revealed a satisfied smile on his face.
The base twelvefold amplification of True Strength outburst, far exceeded that of those at the Early Sevenfold Sky’s fivefold.
Although it is only a difference of seven times, at a high-order level, even a ten percent difference in burst strength is significant, let alone seven times.
Furthermore, the natural forces of Thunder and Golden Flame came as no surprise, while the additional strength, Defense, and speed essentially turned the Emperor Dragon Form into a normal state.
And this is just the foundation; as the concentration of the Combat Shadow increases later on, the empowering forces coming from rune talents will also grow.
There’s also the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form, which provides even greater amplification than the Divine Emperor Dragon Form, and its consumption has changed from burning True Strength Qi Blood to Heavenly Energy.
With this change, Jack Clark would no longer be a three-minute man.
However, after the breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, Jack Clark didn’t immediately go out, instead, he consolidated his strength for two more days.
The closed-door cultivation lasted ten days in total, and when he emerged, it was already June 1st.
As the heavy doors of the Cultivation Room slowly opened, Cicely Rodgers, who had been waiting outside for a long time, only felt a terrifying Aura approaching.
The ground even trembled slightly under those heavy footsteps, as if what was approaching her wasn’t a person but a ferocious beast from ancient times.
However, noticing the shock on her face, Jack Clark thought for a moment and activated the Hidden Deity Glyphs, concealing the invisible oppressive Aura radiating from him.
Instantly, his whole demeanor changed, and he looked like a handsome and gentle college student.
Looking at Cicely Rodgers outside the door, Jack Clark asked, “Major Rodgers, do you have something for me, waiting here?”
Feeling the invisible Aura dissipate, Cicely Rodgers sighed with relief and then nodded: “Yes, Major Clark, I came to inform you that the arrival time of the ancient relics has been confirmed.”
Jack Clark raised an eyebrow: “When is it?”
“June 9th, and at that time, we will send a private jet to take you to the rendezvous point.”
“Please try to keep your communication open during the following period, Major Clark, so we can get in touch with you,” Cicely Rodgers added as a reminder.
She knew that once cultivators like him obtained Space Equipment such as the Sumeru Bracelet, they tended to store items inside, including their mobile phones that couldn’t receive messages once put away.
June 9th, huh? Still have time for a trip back home. Jack Clark thought.
“Right, Major Clark, Miss Ward sent a box over two days ago as a gift for you, but you were in closed-door cultivation,”
As she spoke, Cicely Rodgers handed over to Jack Clark an ordinary-looking wooden box that was thirty centimeters long and wide.
“Besides, Miss Ward also said that if you emerge before twelve o’clock on the first, she wanted to know if you would be willing to accompany her to the North District Creation Research Base.”
The Reincarnation Ceremony must be starting soon.
Before twelve o’clock, North District Creation Research Base. Jack Clark glanced at the sun nearing its zenith and his figure instantly turned into a blur as he dashed out of the Military Base.
Although they had met because of a mission, over a month of interaction had seen their relationship improve considerably, and they had become friends who could talk quite amicably.
In such a case, Jack Clark felt compelled to see her off no matter what.
The Military Base where Jack Clark was located was several dozen kilometers from the city district. Additionally, crossing from the south to the north of the city amounted to roughly seventy kilometers in total.
But for Jack Clark, this distance was nothing at supersonic speed, which he covered in just a few minutes without causing any sonic booms due to the envelopment of Heavenly Energy.
As he passed through the city district, however, many people were nearly knocked down by the raging wind.
Whoosh!
Appearing out of nowhere at the gates of the sprawling Creation Research Base, Jack Clark’s arrival caught the attention of two soldiers in the guardroom, who said solemnly, “Hello, you must register to enter the base.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly and swiped a black magnetic card on the machine outside.
Immediately, the screen inside the guardroom changed to display information about Jack Clark, with his full-body photo on the left, and on the right…
Name: Jack Clark
Rank: Major
“`
“`
Access Level: 9
The information was simple, but that Level 9 access immediately sobered the two soldiers, who snapped to attention with a salute and politely said, “Major Clark, please enter.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Thank you for the trouble.”
However, the security level here was very high,
After passing through four identity verification checkpoints, Jack Clark finally reached the heart of the research base: the central building. Inside the lobby, a few people were in conversation.
Ilisa Ward, Jessica, Crystal Boyce, and two middle-aged men whose auras were ordinary but who inexplicably exuded an indescribable nobility.
Today, Jack Clark was dressed in a grey leisure suit and wasn’t wearing sunglasses; even his facial features had reverted to their original state after using the Shapeshifting Liquid for the second time.
As a result, both Crystal Boyce and Jessica failed to recognize him at first glance.
But Ilisa Ward’s face lit up with a radiant smile, “Brother Callum, I thought you weren’t going to come.”
Jack Clark replied with a hint of regret, “I’m sorry, Miss Ward, my closed-door cultivation took a bit longer than expected. I’ve just emerged, but thankfully, I’m still in time.”
Surprised, Jessica next to him said, “Mr. Callum, no, Mr. Clark, so this is your true appearance. I almost didn’t recognize you just now.”
Jack Clark smiled lightly, “Previously, the mission required me to alter my appearance a bit.”
At that moment, Ilisa led over a burly, bearded middle-aged man and introduced him, “Dad, let me introduce you, this is Jack Clark, also known as Darren – the one who was previously disguised to protect me.”
“Brother Callum, this is my father, and this is Uncle Yeager, whose title is Denny Kaye.”
To Jack Clark’s surprise, he was actually meeting the Sky King Denny Kaye, whereas the presence of Mysterious Martial Sky King was within his expectations.
In the presence of two Heavenly King level individuals, Jack Clark politely said, “I’ve seen the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye.”
Mysterious Martial Sky King was hearty in nature. He clapped Jack Clark on the shoulder and laughed heartily, “Young man Jack, you did a good job protecting Miss Joseline before.”
“I’ve reviewed the mission data, and you performed very well, truly worthy of being one of the most monstrous geniuses of the new generation. You possess a bit of the flair I had in my younger years.”
The dapper-looking Sky King Denny Kaye, who resembled a scholar, spoke with an odd look in his eyes, “Mr. Winston, are you sure you were this outstanding at seventeen?”
“If I remember correctly, you started to make a name for yourself at twenty-something, and by that time, I was already at the Nine Layers.”
The smile on Mysterious Martial Sky King’s face stiffened as he coughed awkwardly, “Close enough, close enough.”
Further conversation was cut off as the elevator in the distance opened.
A young man with dazzling golden short hair emerged, “Ladies and gentlemen, the Reincarnation Cabin and the accompanying ceremony are all prepared; we should soon begin.”
The atmosphere suddenly quieted.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King, previously all smiles, became somber in an instant, clenching his fists slightly. A faint Terrifying Aura even began to emanate from him.
Clearly, even this peak-level strong man was somewhat distressed when it came to the life and death of his youngest daughter.
Ilisa Ward, holding back her father’s hand with a smile, said reassuringly, “Dad, don’t worry, the success rate has now reached 30%, which is quite high, isn’t it?”
“Maybe I’ll awaken after a while.”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King, with a deep and firm voice, believed, “I trust that you will awaken.”
“Yes, I will awaken.” Saying this, Ilisa Ward turned to Jack Clark with a bright smile, her gaze as bright as ever, showing no trace of fear or dread at the prospect of death.
Taking the elevator, the group descended hundreds of meters below the base.
They arrived at a vast white hall, in the center of which stood a silver hibernation chamber, five meters long, three meters wide, with an overall design full of sci-fi aesthetics.
Inside the hibernation chamber, where someone would lie, flowed the Purple Life Essence that Jack Clark had once provided, following certain runes and forming a purple ‘dragon’ shape.
Beyond that, Jack Clark sensed many other strong ‘materials’ inside it.
The floor, three walls, and ceiling of the vast white hall were also inscribed with countless patterns, resembling ‘angels’, ‘Dragon Men’, and many other strange races and creatures.
All these creatures faced forward, kneeling in prayer, while at the end of the room lay pitch darkness, like a Void Rift that devoured everything.
It was both sacred and mysterious.
At that moment, the girl turned and said with a bright smile, “Goodbye everyone, I’m going to sleep.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 561: 264: Void Burial, Jack Clark's Way of Opening the Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Chapter 264: Void Burial, Jack Clark’s Way of Opening the Heavens
Except for Marla Fiore, everyone present had seen many battles and was accustomed to life and death, so they did not exhibit a strong sense of sorrow from parting or loss.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone, the girl slowly lay down inside the Reincarnation Cabin.
Click!
As the cabin lid closed, runic patterns on the surface of the Reincarnation Cabin lit up one after another. An invisible chill permeated the cabin, beginning to freeze everything within.
Under the influence of this freezing power, the girl slowly closed her eyes.
Whiz! The young man with blond hair flicked up a light screen with his hand and began to deftly manipulate it while speaking rapidly.
“In two minutes and twenty-seven seconds, Ilisa’s soul will reach its limit. At that moment, Senior Denny Kaye, you’ll need to act at the instant her soul vanishes and merge it with the Dragon Origin.”
“Neither a moment sooner nor later will do.”
Sky King Denny Kaye said indifferently, “Leave it to me when the time comes.”
“This ceremony is divided into three steps: the physical body’s lifeform transformation, soul reshaping, and finally, the merger of the new soul and body.”
“With the experimental data from Kautorus, I can guarantee the change of Ilisa’s genes and life form.”
“But the subsequent soul reshaping and the eventual fusion with a brand new body and soul all touch upon the rules of life and death, so we can only rely on preparations made by Mysterious Martial Predecessor.”
