As he spoke, the projection in front of Brudos flickered with red light, and he suddenly exclaimed, “Now is the moment!”
Hum!
Without an earth-shattering tremor, as Sky King Denny Kaye made his move, Jack Clark felt as if the whole world had fallen into stasis, with colors stripped away leaving only black and white.
Then a huge black claw emerged from the Void.
Beneath that immense black claw, the color-drained silhouette of the girl appeared in the Reincarnation Cabin, followed by the figure of a blood dragon hundreds of meters long.
At this moment, the girl’s ephemeral shadow was riddled with cracks, and the “eyes” of the Blood Dragon were lifeless, as if it were nothing but a shell.
The enormous black claw, spanning a hundred meters and covering the entire basement, gently pressed down. The already fracturing shadow of the girl was pushed into the Blood Dragon’s forehead.
Immediately after, a giant purple Lotus Stand of the twelfth grade materialized out of nowhere in the black and white world, slowly unfolding and enveloping the Blood Dragon that the girl’s soul had merged with.
At this moment, Jack’s consciousness seemed to slow, as if he were watching a silent animated short film.
Watching the massive Lotus Stand slowly contract, turning into a fist-sized purple bud and shooting into the Reincarnation Cabin.
However, the purple bud didn’t merge into the girl’s body; instead, it hovered over her forehead, gently rotating, casting flickers of purple light that illuminated her brow.
As the immense black claw slowly retracted back into the Void, the surrounding world suddenly returned to normal, vibrant with color once again.
Meanwhile, Brudos’ hands flew over the projection, with countless data refreshing wildly.
“Activate gene compilation information.”
“Activate the Wheel of Reincarnation Rune Matrix.”
“Activate Lifeform Conversion Matrix!”
“Activate the integration of the Source of Life…”
Runic patterns inside the Reincarnation Cabin lit up, resembling a complex machine starting up, with resources exuding top-tier and even god-level strength beginning to be released.
“Mysterious Martial Predecessor, hurry and send the Reincarnation Cabin into a Void burial, so she can be declared ‘dead’.”
“I understand.” With a deep voice, the Mysterious Martial Sky King appeared instantaneously in front of the black wall, his hands tearing fiercely.
Boom!
The pitch-black wall was directly torn open, revealing a dark crack leading to the unknown depths of the Void, where a section of black ‘land’ a hundred meters in size hovered.
“Go!”
Without hesitation, the Reincarnation Cabin rushed into the Void under the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s command.
Boom boom boom!
The runes on the surface of the Reincarnation Cabin flashed, forming a white shield one meter thick. As the Spatial Storms surged from all directions, the cabin weathered the onslaught with thunderous vibrations.
Observing this scene, Jack’s eyes revealed a hint of surprise.
Because this Reincarnation Cabin was constructed entirely of Level 9 materials, no, it must have been made from the skeleton of Mythical Creatures.
Only the skeleton of a Mythical Creature, coupled with the rune shield, could withstand the impact of Spatial Storms that even Ninth Heaven Experts could be injured by.
Amid the roaring impact of the Void Storms, the Reincarnation Cabin, like a small boat, eventually arrived on the black land due to a pulling force.
When the Reincarnation Cabin landed on the black land, an Invisible Power spread, separating the surrounding Spatial Storms.
Whew!
Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Brudos smiled, “The Void Burial has been successfully completed, and the Life Transition Ceremony has begun, with the soul now being reshaped.”
“Boss Boyce, is the online prayer ceremony ready?”
Crystal Boyce nodded, “It has already started. If we time it, the first wave of faith power should be about to be transmitted over here.”
With all aspects of the plan going smoothly, Brudos couldn’t help but smile.
“Although these are just ordinary thoughts and not faith, combined with the conversion of belief instruments in various places, they can still achieve a degree of relentless remembrance and response.”
Online, the Cloud Heaven Group’s official website was launching a campaign that Mathilda Ward’s condition had worsened, and she had entered the intensive care unit, initiating a thirty-day prayer for her life.
They called on all fans of Mathilda to come every day to check in, light a candle, and pray for her peace and safety.
Meanwhile, in the megacities with numerous Mathilda Ward fans, a device was pulsing, linked with several satellites above, forming a massive matrix.
And at the heart of this formation was the underground chamber of the Creation Research Institute.
At that moment, as a force from the Void reached them, the figures engraved on the floor, ceiling, and three walls, appearing as if in kneeling prayer, began to open their lips slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 562: 264: Void Burial, Jack Clark's Way of Opening the Heavens_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Chapter 264: Void Burial, Jack Clark’s Way of Opening the Heavens_2
This scene appeared both eerie and somewhat holy, which surprised Jack Clark.
He hadn’t expected the Life Transformation Ceremony to be so complex, a chain of interlocked steps. In order to save his daughter, Mysterious Martial Sky King seemed to have given his all.
At this moment, Brudos looked at Mysterious Martial Sky King and politely said, “Mysterious Martial Predecessor, the matter you entrusted to me has been completed. I have other matters to attend to, so I will take my leave.”
Mysterious Martial Sky King slowly nodded, his gaze fixed on the black land floating in the Void and the Reincarnation Cabin, his expression solemn and silent.
If successful, his daughter would be revived and emerge anew.
If it failed, that floating piece of land in the Void would be her burial ground, and the Reincarnation Cabin would turn into an icy coffin.
As Brudos left, he politely greeted Sky King Denny Kaye, then gave Jack Clark a meaningful smile before turning to leave first.
After a long time, Mysterious Martial Sky King exhaled deeply and, looking at the spatial cracks he had torn open, said in a heavy voice, “Let’s go up as well.”
“Brother Yan…” Crystal Boyce hesitated as she looked at Mysterious Martial Sky King, who remained calm.
With a forced smile, Mysterious Martial Sky King said, “I’m fine. Haven’t I been through this before? When the first and second bosses left, didn’t I manage just fine too?”
“Besides, little Joseline is just in hibernation, not dead.”
Although he said this, the atmosphere among the group was still somewhat silent.
Having returned to the lobby above, an impatient Jack Clark couldn’t help but ask out of curiosity, “Senior Kaye, how did the surprise attack against those demon kings turn out?”
Sky King Denny Kaye cracked a slight smile, “The outcome was not bad, though it is a pity we didn’t manage to annihilate them all.”
“Though we ambushed them, the battle site was only a little over one hundred thousand kilometers from the frontline battlefield, so reinforcements came quickly.”
“Thus, we only managed to suppress two demon kings; the others heavily injured, made their escape, and even Great Demon King Barus fled hurt.”
“As for Akunus, I directly shattered its Rule True Body and the essence of the Law of Blood, but in the end, it used a Blood Demon Avatar to escape with a remnant of its soul.”
“However, it’s no longer a threat now. With shattered Laws and a damaged soul, even a slightly more powerful Ninth Heaven Cultivator could exterminate it.”
“King-level is that hard to kill, huh.” Jack Clark was somewhat amazed.
Under the leadership of the two Heavenly Kings with seven king-level cultivators, they fought six against nine, with the opposition having only one Great Demon King, and still only managed to kill two.
Sky King Denny Kaye shook his head with a wry smile, “Kid, do you think king-level cultivators are as common as cabbages?”
“King-level cultivators undergo a transformation of the soul, their Divine Souls handle the power of Laws, and their bodies also evolve under the transformation of Laws into bodies of Laws. Under normal conditions, it’s very difficult to track them if they decide to flee.”
Having learned the information he wanted, Jack Clark bid farewell to everyone, “Boss Boyce, Secretary Xu, goodbye.”
“Mysterious Martial Predecessor, Senior Kaye, I must take my leave due to other matters.”
As they watched Jack Clark’s departing figure, Sky King Denny Kaye standing on the steps suddenly said, “This young fellow is quite remarkable. Not only is his talent incredibly high, but he also values loyalty and righteousness.”
“Mysterious Martial, what do you think about having him as your son-in-law?”
“…”
The bearded Mysterious Martial Sky King said speechlessly, “Old Yang, can you read the room? Didn’t you notice I’m still immersed in the sorrow of my daughter’s hibernation?”
“Hahaha… why be so pessimistic? It’s not like little Joseline is really dead,” Denny Kaye laughed.
“Besides, with a lifespan of over a thousand years, if you really can’t stand it, you could regenerate a few dozen more.”
“Do you think king-level cultivators are pigs? Just breed whenever you want? After I made my breakthrough to become a king, Joseline has been my only direct descendant. The first and the second were born before my breakthrough.”
However, with Sky King Denny Kaye’s interjection, Mysterious Martial Sky King felt somewhat heartened, and with a softer gaze, turned to Crystal Boyce, “I leave this place in your care. Old Yang and I need to rush back to the frontline to stand guard.”
Crystal Boyce nodded, “Go. If little Joseline wakes up, I’ll inform you immediately.”
…
Upon returning to South Base, Jack Clark went to the Logistics Department to collect thirty Sky Element Stones, each worth three hundred Merit Points, and ten bottles of Enrichment Elixir.
These were the cultivation resources provided by the Federation to Jack Clark as a genius at his level, speeding up the materialization of his Combat Shadow.
Theoretically, these resources could save him several years of effort, allowing him to reach the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven within six months.
However, that’s only in theory, because cultivation at Seventh Layer Heaven isn’t just simply materializing the true martial arts phantom. It also involves continuously adjusting and optimizing the rune structure to align with one’s body.
At this stage, it either takes painstaking effort over time to incrementally improve and adjust the true martial arts phantom, or it requires a great leap through profound enlightenment.
And enlightenment has always been a weak point for Jack Clark.
Due to the splitting of his soul, his ‘sensitivity’ toward Heaven and Earth was reduced, and his talent in this aspect could only be considered above average.
However, after his breakthrough to Seventh Layer Heaven, his strength had undergone a second transformation, leading to an ‘evolution’ of his attribute page, which acquired new functions.
This precisely addressed that issue.
Having greeted Barry Leonard, Jack Clark booked a high-speed train ticket back to Mist River City and was ready to head back home.
Since entering the Alien Beast Battlefield in mid-February, he had spent around three months outside, his strength skyrocketing from the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven to Seventh Layer Heaven.
“Ladies and gentlemen, the Sky 055 Train you are boarding has now departed. This train is completely smoke-free, and cultivators are prohibited from moving around…”
As the train set off, within the solitude of a First Class Cabin, Jack Clark sat on the sofa, summoned a wooden box from his Sumeru Bracelet with a thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 563: 264: Void Burial, Jack Clark's Way of Opening the Heavens_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Chapter 264: Void Burial, Jack Clark’s Way of Opening the Heavens_3
This was the gift that Mathilda Ward had given him before going into hibernation, but he hadn’t had time to open it until now, after coming out of retreat.
At this moment, as Jack Clark opened the box, a thick, sealed aura spread out, the surrounding air condensed, and the entire front of the high-speed train dipped slightly.
Inside the wooden box lay a fist-sized stone that emitted a faint yellow light.
Upon seeing the stone, Jack couldn’t help but feel as if he were looking at towering mountains and vast lands, it was heavy and rich.
In addition to the stone, there was a small note and a piece of letter paper in the box. The note’s delicate and graceful script read, “This is a Mysterious Yellow Stone bearing a complete Earth Divine Charm from the mythical world. It’s a reciprocation for that Source of Life you gave.”
After writing this, the girl sketched a smile and added, “How about it, Brother Callum, are you satisfied with this gift?”
As a Daughter of the Heavenly King, the girl’s gifts were extraordinary, offering directly a God-level resource.
Of course, what is meant by God-level resources is that the strength and charm it contains have reached the mythological level, not that it is comparable to the power of a King-level strong man.
Putting away the note, Jack unfolded the letter paper beneath it.
“During your battle, I noticed that the four gears behind your battle armor were marked with traces of space, two of which were engraved with Thunder and Fire Talent Runes.”
“Plus, during your later battle, the Rune Illusions appeared behind your head, also reflecting four great light wheels. I guess you’re planning to walk the Way of Opening for Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, right?”
“However, walking the Way of Opening is difficult, and the Four Major Attributes’ Gifted Powers must be balanced.”
“This Mysterious Yellow Stone contains a complete Earth Divine Charm, and with your talent, you should soon be able to comprehend a complete Top-tier Earth Rune, approaching Innateness.”
“When that time comes, combining the Earth Rune with the Power of Space as the foundation for opening up, the structure of your world will be very solid.”
“Unfortunately, my father doesn’t have any Wind-related God-level resources, or else I would have asked him for them to help you complete the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder set.”
“Speaking of which, I have to admire your boldness, Brother Callum, for attempting to use external construction to condense the Four Major Attributes and form four united Illusory Worlds to touch upon the Way of Opening.”
“This path is strong, but it is also difficult. The external spaces constructed purely of Talent Runes are illusory and cannot bear a real ‘world’.”
“Thus, if you want the four ‘worlds’ to unite at the Ninth Heaven Peak and open up a Plane, you’ll need to find a way to smelt the four Illusory Worlds with a vast amount of Heaven and Earth essence.”
“Only when the world is solid enough can it support the Opening the Heavens’ power without shattering.”
“I have a set of World Construction Secret Skills. It details the steps for constructing a micro-world from illusion to reality. When the time comes for you…”
About two hours later, Jack finally finished reading the more than ten pages of notes, exhaled deeply, and with a complex gaze, closed the box.
He had not expected that during this period, Mathilda Ward had been helping him figure out the path of the union of the four wheels.
Initially, when he started forming the light wheels, he was simply planning to borrow some ideas from Simon’s Secret Skills to use as an external construction, like power banks for storing strength in the four Illusory Worlds.
However, as he refined his approach, he indeed considered the path of uniting Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder to open a world and control a powerful Top-tier Law.
Because after cultivators break through to King-level, their power is comprised of three parts: the number of Laws mastered, the depth of understanding of those Laws, and the strength of those Laws.
For instance, Akunus, who controls the Law of Blood, is no match in sheer destructive power compared to a king who masters the Law of Fire and would be outright crushed in a direct battle.
Of course, there are no uniform standards for measuring strength. Laws are just a representation of the hardware’s lower limit – how strong someone is still comes down to the cultivator.
5:30 PM.
As the high-speed train slowly entered the station, Jack soon joined the outflow of passengers and noticed a burly yet young-faced guy excitedly waving towards him.
“Bro, over here, over here,” he called out.
Seeing Glenn and Doris Clark coming to pick him up, Jack showed a hint of a smile, “Didn’t I say there was no need for you to come?”

chapters.title: Chapter 564: 265: The Unshakable Number One, The Emperor Dragon Awakens (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Chapter 265: The Unshakable Number One, The Emperor Dragon Awakens (Seeking Monthly Votes)
As Jack Clark returned home, deep within the Cloud Mist Mountain Range of the Southern Variant Beast Battlefield.
Roar!
A Unique Beast, 24 meters in length, resembling a mix of a giant bear and a sloth, covered in gray scale armor, let out a ferocious roar.
The massive Unique Beast moved swift as the wind, its claws enveloped in gray radiance; with each strike, heavy as a mountain, the ground shattered, and stones exploded.
Its opponent was Howard Lambert, standing 3.5 meters tall, clad in ferocious battle armor.
At this moment, Howard’s body blurred with a mist of blood, behind which a ferocious blood-red phantom faintly materialized.
In his hands, he carried a 5-meter long, as thick as a woman’s waist, red iron column; each swing created a massive white wave, the sound of thunder, impressive and arresting.
In the two months since Jack had left, Howard had gone through nine near-death heavy injuries. Nine physical reconstitutions, along with official cultivation resources, had allowed him to break through to the mid-stage of Fifth Layer Heaven.
Moreover, as his cultivation soared, the strength of his Bull Devil Battle Body grew increasingly powerful; even achieving the threshold of Battle Intent after countless desperate battles on the brink of madness.
At this time, with the power of his king-level bloodline and Bull Devil Battle Body activated, Howard was matching a Unique Beast at the mid-stage of Sixth Heaven without falling behind.
Of course, this wasn’t a head-on confrontation.
Instead, he moved like a red demon shadow around the Unique Beast, continuously attacking its underbelly, limbs, and eyes – its weak points.
After all, he wasn’t the monster that Jack was; facing a Mutated Beast meant actually holding a War Halberd and striking head-on, blasting more massive, higher-level beasts with Unrivaled Domineering Power.
Now, with the attribute of annihilating Bull Demon True Strength, the external energy defense of the Mutated Beast kept collapsing, forcing it to depend on its tough physique to withstand the attacks.
And the Unique Beast’s attacks were also terrifying; an occasional strike on Howard would send him reeling from the horrifying power, shaking his True Strength and tearing his muscles.
However, the more Howard got injured, the more frenzied and fierce his aura became, and his strength grew even stronger.
The battle lasted about an hour, almost leveling half of the mountainside before the Unique Beast, unable to find an intact spot on its body, let out a mournful cry and collapsed with a thud.
Huff, huff, huff, huff!!
Howard leaned on the Steel Pillar, gasping for air, as a thick mist of blood-red blood enveloped him; his body and armor shrunk back down, slowly recovering to just over 2 meters.
It wasn’t until then that Jane Aiken, standing on a tree trunk with her long hair cascading over her shoulders and an aura of exceptionality, said indifferently, “At this rate, you’re bound to die on the road one day.”
Time and again, challenging stronger Mutated Creatures, leveraging battles of life and death to breakthrough limits for rapid growth.
It sounds cool and fierce, but it actually goes against the principle of moderation in cultivation, too rigid to sustain, and one might just die to a stronger Unique Beast one day.
“Without madness, how can one reach the summit?” Looking at the exceptional girl standing atop the tree, Howard’s eyes were resolute, yet tinged with madness.
One Jack Clark was enough, but this girl was incredibly abnormal as well.
Since her breakthrough into Fourth Layer Heaven, her cultivation had soared like a rocket, comprehending the Four Great Sword Intentions and breaking into the early stages of Sixth Heaven.
Under the epiphany state, as the Heavenly Energy gathered, her cultivation speed became ten or dozens of times faster than usual, almost reaching one Layer Heaven each month — truly monstrous.
Her combat strength was even more exaggerated: with the combined Four Sword Intentions, she annihilated everything, unmatched in offense.
The one previously second on the Achievement List, Jasper Forbes, who had just broken through into the early stages of Sixth Heaven, conceded after taking a single light injury from her strike, shocking the entire Southern Battlefield.
With this battle, Jane Aiken directly became the second on the Achievement List, only below the abnormal Jack.
Meanwhile, on another branch, Justin Welan wielded a battle shield, with True Strength emanating from his body, responding to the Extraordinary Battle Shield and forming a Mysterious Martial Phantom of a tortoise, 3 meters tall and 4 meters wide.
Surrounded by five Level 5 Alien Beasts and over a dozen Level 4 alien beasts, which continued to roar and launch frenzied attacks, the Mysterious Martial Phantom shook violently.
But these beasts’ onslaughts couldn’t shake Justin, who, embodying the Mysterious Martial and connected with the Earth’s Aura, was unyielding in defense.
And with the continuous attacks of these beasts, his Aura grew stronger, the Mysterious Martial Phantom became clearer, and its surface began forming a Third Layer of armor.
This was the cultivation path laid out for him: changing his physique with Mysterious Yellow Earth Essence, a second transformation in Fourth Layer Heaven, combined with Defense Cultivation Methods and exclusive resources – an invincible defense route.
The stronger the attacks he received, the greater the counterforce, the faster his cultivation speed.
This approach was somewhat similar to Howard’s Bull Devil Battle Body but more secure, with survival as the top priority.
During this period of absorbing various high-level resources and enduring continuous attacks in harsh cultivation, Justin had also broken through to the peak of Fourth Layer Heaven, gradually nearing Fifth Layer Heaven.
“Not enough, still not enough. I need to reach at least Fifth Layer Heaven to go there. Keep pushing!”
Roar! Following Justin’s furious roar, the Mysterious Martial Phantom, originally just for defense, burst with radiance, and several illusory black python heads roared mightily.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Three Level 4 alien beasts had their heads instantly blasted by the encircling serpents, and the intense stench of blood stirred the other beasts into greater frenzy.
Under the intangible pressure brought by the monstrous Jack, the atmosphere for cultivation at South Sky Martial Academy, and even through the entire Southern Battlefield, had gone mad.
However, as time passed, the gap between the top talents of South Sky Martial became ever wider.
Take Jane Aiken for instance, who from the beginning had left others in the dust. After finding her own “path” through Ilisa Zabel’s guidance, she showed off a crushing dominance.
And Howard, relying on his talent for Innate Divine Strength and absorbing king-level Essence Blood again and again, strengthening his Bull Devil Battle Body and making death-defying breakthroughs, was barely keeping up just behind her.

chapters.title: Chapter 565: 265: The Unshakable Number One, The Awakening of the Emperor Dragon (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Chapter 265: The Unshakable Number One, The Awakening of the Emperor Dragon (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
Then there was Justin Welan, whose talent was already formidable and who had a high-order brother to provide him with resources and a planned cultivation route; he was also furiously catching up.
In addition to them, the Lewis sisters were also chasing hard, led by third-year senior Betty Leinster and supported by the resources given by their parents.
As for individuals like White Veil Flynt Lance, they slowly fell behind by a great distance, which could be seen just from the fact that Justin Welan was cultivating on his own.
But no matter how quickly they improved, they felt no sense of achievement and continued to cultivate with even more diligence.
There was just no helping it—the figure in front of them was even more monstrous, and his mere silhouette was enough to leave everyone else breathless.
That guy was already at the early stage of the Sixth Heaven before he left, and now after two months, with his speed of cultivation, he might have already reached the peak of the Sixth Heaven and started to condense his true martial arts phantom.
…
“Eh! Isn’t that Jack Clark? Weren’t you off to some place for advanced study?”
“Jack’s on vacation soon, so he came back for a visit.”
“Jenny, your son Jack is home, huh? I haven’t seen him for a few months, and he’s looking even more spirited.”
“Haha… it’s thanks to martial arts practice; he’s indeed much stronger than before.”
On the Clarks’ way home, many neighbors greeted Doris Clark warmly, including those with whom they used to have poor relations or little conflicts.
As Jack’s performance grew more and more impressive, the people around them became friendlier and more enthusiastic.
Glenn Clark, following behind, scratched the back of his head: “Strange, bro, why didn’t Mom let the car drop us right at the door and had us get off at the street corner instead?”
Jack, smiling, nodded at the neighbors who greeted them and casually said, “Maybe Mom gets a bit car sick.”
As they spoke, the three of them walked through the street and returned to their courtyard. At that moment, Jack’s gaze swept over the neighbor next door and he nodded slightly at the woman who was collecting laundry.
Jack’s return made both Doris Clark and Glenn Clark very happy.
At 7 pm, as the sky gradually darkened,
After washing the dishes, Glenn Clark called out from downstairs: “Bro, wanna go fishing tonight? I’ve discovered a new fishing method recently, and it’s very effective.”
“A new fishing method?” Inside the room, Jack Clark put down his mobile phone and walked out.
“Jim, your brother still has to practice cultivation, don’t disturb him.”
Jack smiled: “Mom, it’s okay, I can still cultivate when I come back later, and I am a bit curious about Jim’s new trick, too.”
Since he was back for a rare visit, Jack planned to make time to accompany them.
After he went to the ancient relics in a few days, he didn’t know when he would be able to come back again.
Just as they stepped outside, Jack looked at Glenn with a puzzled expression.
He saw his big brother pushing out a “motorcycle” from the cluttered storeroom next door, most notably with a huge barbecue grill attached to the back.
“Aren’t we going fishing?”
Glenn chuckled, “Yeah, bro, we’re going fishing, but when we catch the fish, we’re going to grill them on the spot—freshly killed and eaten. I’ve been doing this recently.”
“… Genius,” Jack uttered two words.
Once on the bike, Glenn called out, “Bro, come on up.”
Jack shook his head: “You ride, I’ll walk.”
Considering Glenn’s hefty size, once he sat down, he basically took up most of the motorcycle’s space, not to mention the giant barbecue grill hanging on the back.
Where was he supposed to sit? Squat on the grill?
Then, by the riverside in the evening, one could see a hefty figure riding a motorcycle, laughing heartily while riding: “Haha… Bro, you run so fast.”
“In a couple of years, once I can cultivate, I want to become as strong as you.”
Jack, who moved like a shadow beside him, flashing ten meters at a time, felt a bit speechless; he always felt that his brother had gotten a bit sillier with time.
About ten minutes later, the pair arrived at the bridge where Tiger One had once ‘released’ worms.
Glenn, with one hand, lifted the two-meter-wide barbecue grill, reinforced with steel bars and weighing over a hundred pounds, set up the charcoal fire under the bridge, and started arranging various seasonings.
His skilled moves were enough to pain anyone watching; Jack couldn’t help but feel awkward, “Jim, doesn’t Mom feed you every day?”
Glenn said cheerfully, “Of course, I eat at home, but I always feel hungry quickly, and I didn’t want to worry Mom, so at night I come here to eat ‘a little’ supper before going back.”
Then Glenn proudly said: “Bro, just wait and see my fishing skills.”
He then extended the fishing rod, using some Alien Beast Meat from home as bait.
There was something unusual about his fishhooks—composed of a large string of big hooks and sinkers. After attaching a small piece of Mutated Beast Meat, he cast it about thirty meters out with force.
After casting, he swiftly began to reel it in, segment by segment.
Okay, it looked like a kind of fishing called Anchor Fishing.
“Here we go, bro.”
Suddenly, Glenn’s eyes lit up, and with a burst of strength in his arms, he gave a fierce pull. The river surface exploded instantly, and a nearly two-meter-long big fish leaped out of the water, only to crash down hard.
“Haha… Bro, caught a big fish.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
The big fish, which already bore some signs of mutation, struggled frantically, stirring up a large spray on the river surface and displaying ‘great strength’.
But under the steel wire-like toughness of the Fishing Line, the fishing rod, and Glenn’s arms, capable of a Power Explosion exceeding a thousand kilograms, the fish seemed like a wronged little wife being forcibly dragged over.
Thump!
The big fish was forcefully dragged onto the shore and, before it could struggle much, Glenn punched its head to mush.
Then he whipped out his tools, swiftly scaled and gutted the fish, and in no time handled the hundred-pound behemoth.
Skilfully he made cross-cuts, smeared on the barbecue seasoning, and placed it on the huge grill to cook, giving off the vibe of a professional who had been barbecuing for twenty years.

chapters.title: Chapter 566: 265: The Unshakable Number One, Emperor Dragon Awakens (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Chapter 265: The Unshakable Number One, Emperor Dragon Awakens (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
“Bro, keep an eye on the fire and flip the fish every few minutes, I’ll go catch a couple more.”
Jack Clark also became interested, smiled and nodded, “Okay, I’ll handle the barbecue, you take care of the fishing.”
Although with his strength, a single punch was enough to shock all the fish within a ten-meter radius to death, it wasn’t necessary.
Just as Jack Clark was flipping the grilled fish, a terrifying pressure involuntarily spread from his body, and black gold vertical pupils appeared in his eyes.
……
Water and Fire World.
Huge swathes of the sea surface were lifted into the air and then frozen by icy energy, instantly a red Ice Crystal Palace condensed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“Roar! Kidora, add some Cloud Mist patterns on that pillar, it will look more magnificent that way.”
“Roar! And on the outer walls of the palace, carve the image of Great Scythia soaring through the sky, yes, just like that, make those wings larger.”
As the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was busy solidifying and constructing the Ice Crystal Palace, a Silver Giant Dragon lay upon an ice platform hundreds of meters high, concentrating on giving directions.
At its feet, lay over a hundred Life Crystals of various sizes, shimmering blue and gold.
It had been five days since they broke through the ‘Stardust Giant Beast’ realm, sweeping through that sea area and collecting a large number of Life Crystals.
The first thing after returning was to have Kidora rebuild the palace that had been damaged during its breakthrough, as well as expanding other palaces.
After a day of hustle, the new Dragon Palace structure was on the verge of completion.
At this time, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle looked up from the ice below, issuing a bewildered roar.
Roar Roar!! Scythia, isn’t this my Palace of Earth and Destruction? Why are you engraving your image on the ice pillars and exterior walls?
“Roar! Don’t you think the image of Great Scythia is majestic and domineering?”
Saying this, on top of the ice platform, a green vortex suddenly appeared in the Silver Giant Dragon’s claw, within which black ice shards spiraled, tearing open slender Black Cracks.
Feeling that destructive aura from the compressed force, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s neck shrank, quickly giving a low growling roar.
Roar Roar!! Domineering, majestic, your image, Scythia, is freaking awesome.
The Silver Giant Dragon proudly raised its head, “Roar! You should feel honored and celebrate that the image of Great Scythia could be engraved on your palace’s exterior walls.”
Roar Roar!! Domination, I’m very happy, very excited.
While roaring about his excitement, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s neck almost retracted into its shell.
Ever since Scythia learned that head-bursting move, it had become even more violent, and its roar had also gotten much louder.
So inconsiderate of beastly conduct.
At that moment, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon let out an excited roar.
“Roar Roar Roar!! Finally, at last, we’re done, huff huff.” Saying that, its nine heads collapsed on the ice, tongues lolling out, gasping for air.
Even as a Level 9 Giant Beast, it was near exhaustion from concentrating to conjure an Ice Crystal Palace that covered half a small world.
Had it known, it would have never agreed to Scythia’s demand; it would have been better to get clawed by the newly awakened Abbott, maybe just getting one head blown off and recovering in half a day.
Just then, from the Scorching Magma 10,000 meters below the volcano, a pair of vertical pupils burning with golden flames slowly opened, and immediately an endless expanse of golden flames burst forth.
Bang!
Under the terrifying pressure, the entire small world trembled violently.
The distant volcano erupted thunderously, infinite golden magma shot into the sky, forming a column hundreds of meters wide and over a thousand meters high.
Bang! The Magma Fire Pillar smashed into the small world’s space barrier, exploding on impact, covering half of the small world with its molten explosion.
Bang Bang Bang!!
With the power of Golden Flames, like meteors crashing down, the magma shattered the Ice Crystal Land, which was over tens of meters thick, collapsing palace after palace.
The raging flames burned, as if Doomsday had arrived.
Seeing the majority of palaces collapse in an instant, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s nine pairs of eyes widened in shock.
Roar!
Thunderous roars shook the Void, and a ferocious behemoth wrapped in endless flame thunder, over 140 meters long, emerged from the volcano.
In an instant, whether it was the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, or other Giant Beasts like the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, all involuntarily bowed their heads.
Welcoming the king’s arrival.

chapters.title: Chapter 567: 266 Quasi-Mythical Creature, Innate Awakening
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Chapter 266 Quasi-Mythical Creature, Innate Awakening
The ferocious Giant Beast stood at the volcano mouth, its body erupting with scorching Golden Flames, while black and blue Thunder shimmered, emanating endless light and heat.
The oppressive aura of the Level 9 Emperor Beast filled the entire ‘Heaven and Earth,’ causing the air to vibrate and forming rings of airwaves that rushed out for hundreds of meters. The whole small world trembled.
The surrounding volcanic rocks, within a hundreds of meters range, melted once again, becoming winding flows of magma, like rivers of burning flames.
Such terrifying might made the distant Single-horned Tiger Whale and other Giant Beasts unconsciously hold their breath.
However, when Mutated Creatures break through from level eight to Level 9, the main change is the fusion of strength with their domain and integration with their body, becoming more complete and powerful.
So the overall form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon hadn’t changed much, instead growing from one hundred and twenty meters to one hundred forty-three meters, still covered in black-red Scaled Armor, fierce and ferocious.
Bang!!
Steps burning with flames landed heavily in the Void, leaving behind a fiery massive footprint in midair.
The Level 9 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon no longer needed to unfurl its Thunderbolt Wings to stand upon the void, surrounded by an Invisible Power field that subtly touched the power of space.
However, whether cultivator or Mutated Creature, one must reach the peak of Level 9 and touch the Law Power before truly engaging with space.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon walked over the Lava Lake, the Purple Dragon Egg below suddenly vibrated with a humming sound.
At this time, the life fluctuation of the Dragon Egg had become much stronger than before, and a narrow black shadow was wriggling within, already beginning to nurture a life form.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head. Suddenly it extended its gigantic Dragon Claw, and at once, an Invisible Power lifted the Dragon Egg below and flew it into the fierce black-red Dragon Claw.
The 0.5 meters egg in the claw of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon appeared as tiny as a small pellet.
The Black-red Colossal Beast carefully pinched the Dragon Egg between two claws, placing it between the two sharp horns resembling manes on its head, where it stuck in place.
Under the burning golden flames that contained the power of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Dragon Egg emitted a feeling of comfort and pleasure, seeming to like this position very much.
“Roar! Come out early, or you might get roasted for my meal one of these days.”
Immediately a feeling of fear came from inside the Dragon Egg.
Seeing this, the corner of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth lifted slightly, looking very ferocious.
When it arrived at the Ice Crystal Square, the Golden Flame and Thunder on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had already receded, and the surrounding Giant Beasts like the Silver Giant Dragon all exhaled deeply.
Phew! The Silver Giant Dragon stretched its wings, generating a raging wind as it flew over, circling the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with excited roars.
“Hegemon, you look so strong now, I feel like even the quasi-mythical level creatures would be killed by you.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exhaled a torrent of hot air through its nostrils, its voice deep and resonant, “Quasi-mythical level is still a little out of reach, but once I make a ‘breakthrough’ with another talent, I should be almost there.”
With that, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon landed on an Ice Platform not far away, a hint of surprise flashing in its eyes.
Unexpectedly, during its hibernation, these fellows had collected so many Life Crystals for it, it felt like there were over ten thousand points worth just by looking.
All that effort to establish a force was worth it.
As for the quasi-mythical level, it refers to those Beasts that have reached the peak of Level 9, have touched upon the rules, and may break through to the Mythical level at any moment.
Beasts at this Boundary actually belong to another level, lying between Level 9 Giant Beasts and the Mythical.
Based on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s estimate of its own combat power, it was confident of suppressing late-stage Level 9 Beasts, but those that had touched upon the rules at the peak level would be more challenging.
A Mutated Creature that has reached the late-stage of Level 9 is beyond ordinary, the weakest are Lord-level with an awakened king-level bloodline, and the blood talent in the Lord-level is very strong.
And the power of rules goes without saying; it is a mighty power that dominates above Transcendent strength.
Unless it enhanced its Golden Flame Talent to the top-tier, merging the top-tier Thunder with top-tier Golden Flame to form the ultimate destructive Thunderflame might it contend with the Rule Power.
As for the Top-tier talents of strength, Defense, and swiftness, they are related to physical prowess, fundamentally different from Thunder and Golden Flame, and are unable to merge.
Of course, all three physical talents are very strong as well.
The fusion of strength and Defense allows the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to unleash power unrestrainedly without worrying about recoil, while the extreme speed and strength combined can blast everything apart.
This is the confidence that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon has in killing late-stage Level 9 Beasts, using absolute power to shatter the domains and bodies of those Beasts.
Even against a Level 9 Peak Giant Beast in close combat, it wouldn’t fear at this time.
And once the next enhancement of Golden Flame reaches top-tier, melding with Thunder and in combination with the three physical talents, even at the early-stage Level 9, it would confidently be invincible below Mythical level.
As for those above Mythical level, it likely would not be able to defeat them just yet.
Only when it grew to the mid-stage of Level 9 or when it enhanced one talent above top-tier could it contend with the Mythical.
The Mythical level is a chasm, just like the Ninth Heavens and the king, distinguishing gods from the mundane. Even the most contrary monster with an incredible talent finds it very hard to fight across levels at this point.
Each being that can contend with a Mythical King at the Ninth Heavens has an invincible form.
For example, the Demon God Descendant killed by the Mysterious Martial Sky King had abilities in his late Nine Demonic Marks that were comparable to an ordinary demon king, such talent prompted them to exterminate him even at the risk of exposing his identity.
At this moment, the Single-horned Tiger Whale excitedly slapped its Double Fins, raising huge sea waves.
Roar! Thunderflame, you are so badass now; you look incredible; come on, take us to fight; I am also super strong now.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 266 Quasi-Mythical Creature, Innate Awakening_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Chapter 266 Quasi-Mythical Creature, Innate Awakening_2
When Double Fin possessed the slashing power, combined with the tenfold amplification during the Daytime Domain, and his Defensive Talent, Single-horned Tiger Whale’s battle prowess surged to an inch close to Monarch-level.
That’s why lately it’s become more daring, a bit more warlike, even daring to talk back to the Silver Giant Dragon sometimes.
Roar, Roar!! Domination wants to rampage, and this time Domination will take on ten.
Excited roars from the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, thrilled beyond belief, leading big brother Thunderflame post-awakening has become fiercer, ready to go on a killing spree again.
Roar, roar, roar!! Uncle, so fierce.
Roar, roar, roar!! King, you’re a freak, damn cool.
Roar!! Awesome, awesome.
The three-headed Small Tiger Whale in the water kept leaping excitedly out of the water, then with a huge splash, they crashed down, creating massive sea waves, drenching Single-horned Tiger Whale completely.
Gurgle, gurgle!! Great King, you’re so mighty, so damn cool, your awesome is the most badass, everything pales in comparison to your strong form, all six of my legs are going weak.
Above the water, the Blue Giant Crab bubbled with excitement, its six trembling legs shaking with thrill, the sight making Thunderflame Emperor Dragon facepalm.
“Roar! You, shut your mouth if you can’t describe properly, don’t just spout nonsense.”
In a roaring shockwave of sound waves, a mighty wind compressed the sea surface, and the Blue Giant Crab was instantly blasted down to the seabed.
Boom! Splashes erupted everywhere, making the Dragon Turtle and Tiger Whale instinctively retreat their necks.
Post-Level 9, Thunderflame’s ferocity and terror were unspeakable, his mere roars were insane.
Thank goodness, compared to these out-of-tune guys, the Female Tiger Whale Horned Lady was quite calm, swimming beside Single-horned Tiger Whale and nodding respectfully to Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
As for Nine-headed monster Ghidorah.
Only then did Thunderflame Emperor Dragon notice that the Black Dragon looked at him with intense resentment in all nine pairs of dragoneyes, making him take a step back unconsciously.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled menacingly, “Ghidorah, why are you looking at me like that?”
“Roar, roar!! Abbott, the palace, destroyed, Ghidorah, one day, one day, ahh.” The Nine-headed monster roared chaotically, each head sounding more aggrieved than the last.
It was tragic, the laborious rebuilding of the palace it had just finished after an exhausting day was destroyed by the sudden burst of power when Thunderflame Emperor Dragon awoke.
Whimper.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at the palace complex mostly turned into a Magma Fire Sea and growled indifferently, “Roar! If the palace is ruined, we’ll rebuild it, it’s no big deal.”
“You and Great Sethia can join forces later, it’ll be fixed quickly.”
Immediately the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened, hold on, what does this have to do with it?
Nope. The Silver Giant Dragon stretched out its claw, pointing at a distant, frozen stardust behemoth corpse, and let out a series of low growls.
“Roar! Hegemon, while you were hibernating, Great Sethia led the Dragon Palace army to annihilate a Giant Beast’s small nation, harvesting a large number of Life Crystals.”
“Besides that, we’ve also brought back the corpse of that Ninth Level Extraordinary Creature, eat up, then take us out for a fight, Great Sethia wants to see rivers of blood.”
Err… hold on, why do I feel like I’ve just emerged as a super villain with grand accomplishments?
Looking at the ferocious behemoths around him screaming excitedly for him to lead them in a bloodbath, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt awkward.
Forget it, these guys aren’t human, it’s normal for their thoughts to be out there.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook his head, tossing aside the strange thoughts, and roared with satisfaction, “Roar! No problem, once I’m full and have another ‘comprehension,’ we’ll cause some chaos.”
Although his strength had greatly increased after the breakthrough to Level 9, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s responsibilities had grown as well.
Collecting more Life Crystals to strengthen his talent, hunting more Level 8 and Level 9 Giant Beasts for devouring, accelerating growth to reach Level 9 Peak as soon as possible and make the mythical breakthrough.
With the Earth shaking beneath him, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon approached the frozen corpse of the stardust behemoth, grabbed the Giant Beast’s body, and took a bite.
Under the Sharp Fangs, the ice and scale armor crackled and shattered.
Then there was the tough flesh and blood, sounding like the tearing of alloy, making one’s scalp tingle. It made an even louder rumble as Thunderflame Emperor Dragon chewed with force.
It didn’t sound like he was eating meat but gnawing on alloy ore.
Between those giant Sharp Fangs, with each chewing motion, there were countless bits of flesh mixed with blood spattering out, a horrifying sight.
After just a few bites, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swallowed the flesh and blood.
Boom!
Centered around Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s stomach, a tidal wave of biological energy exploded, and his cells crazily absorbed the energy, dividing, compressing and growing.
…
As Thunderflame Emperor Dragon awoke, with the feedback of growing to Level 9, a heavy and terrifying aura burst forth from Jack Clark by the riverside.
Boom!
The heavy, terrifying aura exploded the air, forming a circular white sonic boom wave around Jack Clark, whipping up a raging wind sweeping tens of meters around.
The sudden windstorm almost blew Glenn Clark off his feet, the barbecue grill he was using to cook a big fish was sent flying, the river water boiled, with countless fish and shrimp going crazy, surging out of the water.
Caught off guard by the shock, Glenn quickly turned around and was then shocked to see the air waves rolling around Jack, the ground beneath him cracking and sinking.
Under the weight of that invisible aura, even at a distance of tens of meters, Glenn felt a heaviness fall upon him, his bones crackling, his feet sinking a foot into the riverside.
Feeling the might of a High-Ranking Powerhouse up close for the first time, Glenn was utterly shocked, swallowing hard.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 266 Quasi-Mythical Creature, Innate Awakening_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Chapter 266 Quasi-Mythical Creature, Innate Awakening_3
“Brother is terrifying.”
This time, the breakthrough of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was a one-off Burst, and the energy feedback drove Jack Clark’s physical strength to surge at an alarming rate, with the numbers on the attribute page jumping.
The highest strength attribute even soared from 3482 to 4520, while the other three attributes also skyrocketed by 1000 points.
Under such a dramatic surge, even Jack Clark couldn’t control the aura of his strength as the terrifying power caused the surrounding Void to subtly distort.
At his current point, a single point of attribute increase was almost equivalent to the initial increase tenfold.
At this moment, Jack Clark felt that even if a Level 7 Colossus appeared in front of him, he could blast it with his pure physical strength alone.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew stronger, the advantage Jack Clark had over other cultivators became increasingly significant.
With his True Martial cultivation stronger than cultivators of the same tier and a physique more powerful than a Giant Beast of the same level, the combination of these two was like a chemical reaction.
This was the reason why Jack Clark’s fighting prowess could cross a Major Realm even after reaching a high-order level.
At the same level, Jack Clark’s fighting prowess was now on par with the Thunderflame Beheamoth he initially faced, able to Suppress ordinary opponents at the early phase of the Eighth Layer with a flip of his hand.
After the feedback energy subsided, Jack Clark finally managed to contain his Aura.
Instantly, the terrifying aura that seemed to crush the Void and burst everything disappeared.
“Brother, you suddenly became so scary just now,” Glenn Clark said, still in shock.
Jack Clark replied with a smile, “I had an epiphany while barbecuing, leading to a breakthrough in my cultivation, which caused the release of Aura. I hope I didn’t scare you.”
“No way, you are my brother, how could I be scared?”
Glenn Clark answered with a look of awe, “But Brother, achieving a breakthrough like that is just too exaggerating.”
Glenn’s words also filled him with anticipation for cultivation, feeling that it seemed very simple, especially since his brother could have a breakthrough even while barbecuing.
At this moment, Jack Clark suddenly said, “Jim, your body is extraordinarily robust, and I feel you must be awakening some physical talent.”
Glenn Clark chuckled and said, “I’ve actually felt it too.”
Glenn Clark was no fool; he had long noticed changes in his body.
Before Jack Clark brought home the Mutated Beast Meat, Glenn appeared just a bit overly strong and mighty, but still within the range of normal humans overall.
However, since eating the Mutated Beast Meat and undergoing further physical development, his body grew larger, muscles exploded, strength continued to increase, and his appetite also grew.
These changes were similar to those signs of awakening talents mentioned online.
Furthermore, the school teacher had recently talked to him, telling him not to feel inferior because of his size, saying it was a good thing.
“By the way, Jim, I once read about a Secret Skill in a book that can induce the awakening of talents ahead of time. Do you want to give it a try?”
The Emperor’s Gift of Awe could induce the activity of the Giant Beast bloodline, promoting Evolution, and Jack Clark felt this technique should also be effective on humans.
Of course, those without a bloodline talent or those not yet awakening shouldn’t even dream of it. Without a talent, what’s there to induce?
Immediately, Glenn’s eyes lit up with excitement, nodding emphatically, “Yes, I definitely want to.”
“Then let’s go, pack up and head back.”
He also needed to be back in his room to properly receive the Life Crystal.
There wasn’t much to pack, anyway; the barbecue grill had been overturned by the burst of Jack Clark’s aura, and the half-cooked fish meat had fallen to the ground and was inedible.
Fortunately, the river in this area was too rapid for fishing, so few people fished here.
Only someone as strong as Glenn Clark would choose to catch Anchor Fish here, and since it was already past eight at night, the incident hadn’t caused any commotion.
About ten minutes later, Glenn was puttering along on his motorcycle, following behind Jack Clark as they returned home.
“You’re back so early?” Doris Clark, who was watching TV on the sofa, was surprised since Glenn Clark usually didn’t return home till midnight.
Jack Clark casually said, “Jim here seems to be on the brink of awakening some kind of physical talent. I just so happen to have mastered a Secret Skill that might help him awaken sooner.”
“Awakening a talent,” Doris said, astounded.
But Jack Clark didn’t explain further and just instructed Glenn to stand relaxed and ready.
Amidst the expectant gaze of Glenn and Doris, Jack Clark’s golden vertical pupils appeared in his eyes. His aura transformed drastically as a terrifying Dragon Might burst from the depths of his soul.
Boom! Jack Clark’s palm landed, and in an instant, Glenn’s consciousness thundered,
In Glenn’s eyes, a gigantic shadow appeared, blocking out the skies. With the Giant Beast’s world-shaking roar, a force within was stirred.
Boom!
An extremely fierce strength exploded from within Glenn, turning into Black Gold radiance that covered his whole body, instantly making him seem as though he was made of steel, emanating a heavy and imposing Aura.
This strength was incredibly Overbearing, even shaking Jack Clark’s palm open during the moment of awakening.
And as this strength awakened, the explosively muscular physique of Glenn slowly contracted, becoming more solidified, and Jack Clark’s eyes revealed amazement.
“Such an Overbearing power.”
Of course, this level of power was nothing to him. He was amazed because the nature of this power was almost identical to Divine Tyrant Body, just as fierce and unmatched.
Because Glenn’s talent was induced early by Jack, it was more active than a talent that awakened normally and was in a ‘developmental phase.’
As Glenn continued to grow and consumed high-energy Alien Beast Meat, absorbing a great deal of energy and nutrients, his talent would become even stronger.
Once he entered High School Cultivation two years later, he would skyrocket.

chapters.title: Chapter 570: 267 Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Great Sun Star (Request for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Chapter 267 Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Great Sun Star (Request for Monthly Votes)
“Bro, I’ve succeeded, I’ve really awakened my Gifted Power.”
In the room, Glenn Clark excitedly swung his fists, as big as sand pots, with such powerful strength that each punch would explode the air, producing a dull booming sound.
After his excitement had ebbed away, Jack Clark smiled and said, “The talent you’ve awakened, although it belongs to the physical type, has potential no less than that of an Innate Awakened One.”
“Let’s call it ‘Innate Overlord Body’.”
Then Jack Clark warned him, “However, Jim, don’t let others know about your awakening yet. Let’s wait for another two years.”
“Because I forcibly induced it, your talent only has the potential equal to an Innate one for now and is not yet comparable to a real Innate Awakened One. It still needs to grow.”
“So, keep a low profile in the meantime, and stay out of the firing line, got it?”
As he continued to make realm breakthroughs and his talent grew stronger, Jack Clark had attracted the attention of not only the Federal Top Level but also the Evil God Cult of Alien Races.
Although he had taken some measures to protect Mathilda Ward, those were just superficial.
For cultivators, confirming someone’s identity is simple; weapons and Cultivation Methods are impossible to hide in a life-or-death battle.
Therefore, at that time, Jack Clark had only slightly altered some facial details to obscure the Evil God Sect’s vision.
Faced with Jack Clark’s reminder, Glenn Clark chuckled and said, “Bro, I get what you mean by ‘wealth should not be exposed.’ Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone about my awakening.”
Meanwhile, Doris Clark on the side felt somewhat excited.
Her eldest son, with monstrous cultivation talent, was famous across the nation, and now her second son had also awakened his talent early with his brother’s help, and it seemed to be something impressive like an Innate Awakened One.
At this moment, Doris Clark suddenly felt her life was complete.
“All right, Jim, you continue to get familiar with your strength downstairs, and be careful not to tear down the house.”
With that, Jack Clark greeted Doris Clark, “Mom, I’m going upstairs to cultivate. You should rest early.”
“Mm, go ahead, Jack.”
After taking care of Glenn Clark’s business, Jack Clark returned to his room upstairs and sat cross-legged.
As Jack Clark waited, about two hours later, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished devouring the star-dust Giant Beast of over 150 meters, leaving only a huge skeleton behind.
This complete Level 9 Giant Beast skeleton was intentionally left by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In the line of Illusory World construction that Mathilda Ward helped him deduce, the Four Illusory Attribute Worlds needed to integrate a large amount of Heaven and Earth essence to evolve and solidify the worlds.
The end goal was to transform the illusory into reality, strong enough to bear a new world, and what else could be more suitable than the skeleton and scale armor of a Level 9 Giant Beast?
However, integrating Heaven and Earth essence into the Illusory Worlds required reaching Eight Layer Heaven, so this task was still in the distant future.
At this time, after devouring the corpse of the star-dust Giant Beast and absorbing its vast biological energy, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew from 143 meters to 150 meters in size.
Every time it just made a breakthrough level, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body would grow rapidly for a period due to active cells and reviving genes.
Thus, the flesh and blood of this Level 9 Giant Beast enabled it to grow a whole seven meters at once, making its stature appear even more impressive.
However, once it reached the Late Stage 9, this growth rate would slow down. Each meter of growth would require more biological energy, and most of that energy would be stored as Evolution value.
Roar! Thunderflame is still so monstrous; it grows upon eating.
Roar! Yeah, and it makes Joe so envious. How great it would be if I could grow simply by eating.
From afar, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the Dragon Turtle, and the Silver Giant Dragon, along with the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, looked at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s massive size with envy in their eyes.
Despite being accustomed to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s ‘talent’ of rapid growth by eating, these Giant Beasts couldn’t help but feel envious and yearning.
It can’t be helped; it’s too monstrous.
Especially the Silver Giant Dragon, who was smaller than the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon when they first met, but now the latter was half as large again as itself.
Looking at the overall picture, the 150-meter Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had become the largest beast in the Dragon Palace.
As for the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, although it measured over 180 meters, its serpentine length made it appear less formidable than the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at this moment.
Having eaten its fill, it was time for serious business. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned and roared, “I’m going to ‘cultivate’ a bit, and once I make a breakthrough, we’ll stir up trouble.”
“Scythia, Kidora, I’ll leave the task of repairing the palace to you guys, okay?”
“Roar! No problem, Kido is now super strong and awesome.”
Although previously resentful about the destruction of the palace, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was still full of energy when asked for help by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
“…Roar! Fine then.”
Seeing that Kidora had eagerly agreed, the Silver Giant Dragon reluctantly nodded its head.
Then the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned to look at the Single-horned Tiger Whale in the sea and roared, “Joe, how many Slash Runes have you condensed so far?”
Roar! I have condensed fifty-seven already.
With that, the Single-horned Tiger Whale proudly stretched its fin-like wings as the edges shimmered with Black Gold Radiance, exuding an aura of solidity and sharpness.
After tasting the effectiveness of combining Slash Runes and domain in the last ‘nation-destroying’ battle, the Single-horned Tiger Whale had been diligently cultivating ever since.
“Roar! That’s good.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction, then turned to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and roared, “And you, Joe, how about you?”
Faced with this question, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle looked sheepish, growling, “Roar! Joe is not so good at learning, only having condensed twenty-nine Transformation Runes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 571: 267: Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Great Sun Star (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Chapter 267: Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Great Sun Star (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Boom!
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had just finished speaking when its massive body, eighty-nine meters long and over fifty meters tall like a small hill, swept up a white wave and erupted with the sound of wind and thunder, fiercely slamming down onto the sea surface a kilometer away.
Instantly, the distant sea surface exploded like a nuclear blast, kicking up a veil of sea water mist hundreds of meters high, followed by tidal waves more than ten meters tall sweeping across.
It took over ten minutes for the sea waves to calm down.
At that moment, the sea surface bulged upward, and with a loud bang, the enormous body of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle burst out from the depths, with the sea water cascading down like a waterfall across its carapace.
On the thick, dark brown shell of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, there emerged a colossal claw imprint over two meters deep, with the surrounding armor cracked, slowly healing.
The sight made all the giant beasts subconsciously shrink their heads, for the Level 9 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was too brutal; a casual swipe was more than any beast could withstand.
On the Ice Crystal Land by the shore, the black-red colossal beast stood up, its golden vertical pupils cold and filled with terrifying domineering presence, while it let out a deep and thunderous roar.
“Roar! Have you grown too complacent lately and forgotten the cruelty among Mutated Creatures?”
“For us Mutated Creatures, no one can be sure whether the next opponent is strong or weak—every fight is a life and death separation.”
“Your Talent Defense is strong, along with your Shock Power, no beast can get close, but your weaknesses are still obvious: ‘slow’ speed, lacking powerful long-range offensive capabilities.”
“If one day you encounter a flying enemy, or an opponent with strong long-range attacks and swift agility, all that awaits you is a slow death from attrition.”
As he said this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared fiercely, “Or do you, fool, want to end up just like that skeleton over there, eaten clean of flesh and blood one day?”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared back loudly: Roar roar!! Domination does not wish for that.
“Roar! If you don’t want that, then work hard on your cultivation. Don’t look at those Energy Conversion Runes as weak on their own, but once you’ve condensed hundreds or thousands of them, they will be formidably terrifying, got it?”
At this moment, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also knew the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon meant well and showed gratitude in its eyes, roaring loudly: Roar roar!! I know, I will definitely work hard on my cultivation.
That’s more like it.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded slowly, “Roar! Starting today, you will go into Closed-door Cultivation for me. Don’t come out until you have condensed one hundred Transformation Runes.”
Immediately, the eyes of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle widened in anxiety, it quickly said: Roar roar!! Thunderflame, aren’t we about to stir up trouble?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon bellowed: “You don’t have to go this time.”
After saying that, he grabbed all the Life Crystals behind him with one claw, and his figure vanished from the spot in an instant, followed by a sonic boom and a white wave thousands of meters long roaring through the air.
Watching the figure of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon disappear into the volcano mouth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale showed a look of relief in its eyes.
Thankfully, it had listened to its wife and worked hard on its cultivation, or it too would have been punished by Thunderflame just now.
With this thought, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish turned towards the nearby Female Tiger Whale, communicating in the unique language of Tiger Whales: Roar roar roar!! Wife, thankfully I have you.
The Female Tiger Whale looked at him gently and nodded slightly: Roar roar roar!! Work hard on your cultivation and aim to condense two hundred Slash Runes as soon as possible.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale’s eyes widened at this.
Meanwhile, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was busy working hard nearby, its nine heads letting out chaotic roars, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, good, once the palace is restored, Kidora will also have to cultivate hard.”
The Silver Giant Dragon gracefully spread its wings, raising its chin, looking at the puzzled-faced Deep Sea Dragon Turtle: “Roar! I told you to cultivate hard before. Now do you realize how serious it is?”
Roar roar!! When Domination comes out, I will beat ten of them.
Knowing he couldn’t change the decision of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out a roar and dove back into the seabed with a loud splash, ready to enter into Closed-door Cultivation.
…
For these two Mutant Beasts that had followed him from the very beginning, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon still felt a bit of fondness, not wishing for these fellows to suddenly die one day.
Therefore, he had been trying to find ways to enhance their strength recently.
But it’s hard for beasts to face their nature and lie there every day, using up their spirit and Qi Blood to condense runes in a boring way time after time.
This sort of rune, containing certain powers, requires very delicate manipulation when condensing. A slight disturbance can cause a rune that has almost completely condensed to collapse.
This was also the reason why the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle couldn’t stand the tedium later on.
It could endure loneliness because it was always sleeping; under such circumstances, ten days or half a month would naturally pass by in a flash.
Hopefully, this beating would wake it up, otherwise next time it would be two slaps.
At the volcano mouth, as the silver runes on each of the three feather horns lit up one by one, a powerful spatial force burst forth, forming a silver vortex in the middle of the fiery crown.
After reaching Level 9, creating small spatial pathways posed no pressure to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In the room, Jack Clark’s right arm flickered with golden red light, and Life Crystals continuously flew out from the silver vortex, which he swiftly caught.
After all the Life Crystals were transferred, the spatial pathway closed, and Jack Clark let out just a light breath before picking up a Level 7 Life Crystal.
“You have transformed high purity life force, gaining 1035 Attribute points.”
“You have transformed high purity life force, gaining 381 Attribute points…”
As one Life Crystal after another was transformed by Jack Clark, the Attribute points on the transparent page in front of him escalated wildly, quickly surging past ten thousand.
Then to twelve thousand, thirteen thousand… finally stopping at 15682.
The Female Tiger Whale, together with the Three-headed Small Tiger Whale, hunted fourth and fifth grades Alien Beasts, and together with Scythia leading the ‘mighty army’ to obliterate nations, this time they accumulated the most Life Crystals.

chapters.title: Chapter 572: 267: Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Great Sun Star (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Chapter 267: Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Great Sun Star (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
“`
“Over fifteen thousand attribute points,” Jack said with a smile upon seeing the number on the attribute page, and so did the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon far away in the Water and Fire World.
But one smile was handsome and charming, and the other was fierce and terrifying.
Without hesitation, a thought resonated in Jack’s mind.
“Consume ten thousand attribute points to strengthen the Golden Flame Talent.”
Compared to enhancing his own Void Double Pupils, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which was about to embark on a massive hunt of Level 9 Giant Beasts, needed the power boost more urgently.
His own environment was stable enough to wait a little longer.
As Jack’s voice faded, ten thousand points worth of energy transformed through the Soul Channel, crossing the vast distance and thundering into the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
In an instant, a more terrifying Monarch’s pressure burst forth from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, shaking Heaven and Earth.
Roar! With a roar, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned into a golden light soaring up into the sky, reaching the Thousand Meter High Small World Barrier in the blink of an eye.
Boom!
Endless golden flames erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, spreading and covering the entire ‘sky’ of the small world in a breath.
With the boundless Flame Power stirring, the volcanoes that had been quiet up until now trembled once more, erupting with intense Magma Fire Pillars.
Together with the overwhelming golden flames burning, the temperature of the entire small world soared rapidly, the sea surface distorted, and masses of sea water evaporated into mist.
But before these mists could rise into the high altitude, they were annihilated by the even more scorching high temperatures above.
Under the searing heat of the Gold Flame sea, the remaining half of the Ice Crystal Palace began to dissolve and collapse, including the two that had just been repaired.
However, at this moment, both the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon had no time to lament, as they instinctively looked skyward.
This included the five Tiger Whale Tiger Skates in the sea and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had just started its closed-door cultivation, and the Blue Giant Crab that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had roared into the seabed.
All the Giant Beasts showed shocked expressions in their eyes.
They saw a round sun slowly forming amidst the fiercely burning golden sea of flames, with the shadow of a ferocious behemoth vaguely emerging within the dazzling sun.
As the sea of flames in the sky burned, amid all the behemoths’ shock and excitement, the aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew stronger and stronger.
In the center of the endless golden sea of flames, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body began a new phase of growth, or rather, an Evolution of bloodline.
Each Top Tier Talent represents an Evolution of ‘bloodline’ power to the extreme; a Giant Beast possessing one Top Tier Talent is equivalent to Monarch-level.
Having four would trigger a life level transition, stepping into the realm of Monarchs.
But the Monarch level is not the final point of Giant Beast Evolution. As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s fifth talent reached Top Tier, its form changed once more under the influence of its bloodline.
On the scale armor covering its entire body, countless golden flame-like patterns emerged, and fire-shaped Scale Horns condensed at the joints of its limbs.
“`
In addition, the sides of the back bulged, appearing broader, and the dual rows of over a dozen backward-extending dark red scale horns grew longer, thicker, and more pointed.
This time, the breakthrough took less time than the previous enhancement of the Thunder Talent, completing the talent enhancement in just over an hour.
Within the endless sea of fire, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly opened its eyes.
At the same time, Jack Clark summoned the attribute page in his room, his gaze falling upon the strengthened talent.
Transcendent Talent: Heaven Burning Golden Flame+ [Top Tier, the flame evolved to its limit, its burst can form an intense domain that burns everything to ashes.
Ability: Extreme Flame Explosion, the ultimate compression forms a destructive explosion, can be miniaturized and used in conjunction with the right claw’s binding force field for more flexible combat.
Ability: Becoming a Star, instantly releasing all Heaven Burning Golden Flames, merging with the domain to form an indiscriminate Destructive Great Sun, annihilating everything within range, even capable of burning through the Void.
Ability: Flame Flow Light, contracting the domain, gathering intense flames to erupt and bring strong kinetic energy, possessing a flight speed like that of streaming light]
As the sea level in the Water and Fire Mini World dropped by more than ten meters, the reef rocks and islands all began to burn, about to melt into magma, the sea of fire in the sky suddenly shrank.
In just the blink of an eye, the endless flames converged in the air, forming a golden fireball with a diameter of two hundred meters.
The surface of the golden fireball, with its substantial golden flames rolling, radiated intensely like a star, along with even more formidable Monarch Dragon Might.
Just as all the Giant Beasts were being suffocated by that terrifying dragon might, the oppressive force slowly receded, followed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s low roar from the sky.
“Roar! Joe, do you know where to find a strong Level 9 Giant Beast?”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes lit up, and it nodded excitedly.
Roar, roar, roar! Yes, yes, yes! If you swim northward for over two thousand kilometers, just below the deep sea near the Marine Forbidden Area, there’s a really fierce Level 9 Giant Beast.
Roar, roar, roar! Besides that very fierce Level 9 Giant Beast, there are also some slightly weaker Mutant Beasts that have taken up residence there; one of them chased me for quite a distance in the past.
As a street wanderer of the ocean, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish liked to roam the seas looking for treasure and had visited many places before encountering the Sword Armor Beast.
From above, the radiance of the star blazed brilliantly, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s roar echoed: “Roar! They actually bullied Joe; except for Domination, all beasts will follow this king into battle, kill that group of creatures.”
In the midst of the roar, the star above disappeared, and lightning transformed into double wings, while the scales on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s shoulder that resembled wing feathers emitted dazzling golden light.
Boom! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon instantly accelerated to several times the speed of sound, turned into a streak of light, and disappeared into the sea in a massive explosion of sea water.
“Roar! Great Sethia wants to see a river of blood; all beasts, follow and kill them!”
The Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, and spread its wings, it turned into a cyan-silver light and gave chase; in the blink of an eye, it plunged into the sea and passed through the Dragon Palace Gate.
Roar, roar, roar! Charge, brothers, kill them all, loot everything, eat everything. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish made an excited chirping and followed by flapping its double fins.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Kidora, invincible, charge, kill, utterly destroy them.”
As each Giant Beast departed, the ruins like the Dragon Palace were left with only the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle floating on the surface, looking somewhat lonely and pitiable.
Roar, roar! Domination also wants to fight ten!

chapters.title: Chapter 573: 268: The Battle to Destroy the 'Nation', The Terrifying Emperor Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Chapter 268: The Battle to Destroy the ‘Nation’, The Terrifying Emperor Dragon
Under the leadership of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the beasts from the Dragon Palace went all out once again except for the Dragon Turtle Domination.
However, their target was in the deep sea this time, so the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not gather storm clouds to ride on. Instead, it spread its Thunder Wings and sped away like a flash of fire.
As it moved at supersonic speeds, the seawater exploded behind the black-red Colossal Beast, leaving a white wave of hundreds of meters wide that grew continuously on both sides with a magnificent momentum.
But soon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon made an arc and returned to the rear, its body burning with golden flames. It roared angrily, “You are too slow, hurry up!”
Yi-yi-yi! It’s not that we’re slow, it’s that you’re too fast, Thunderflame!
Deep beneath the sea, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish struggled to swim, its enormous body shooting forward for several kilometers under the influence of its domain power.
Behind it, the four mutated Tiger Whales followed closely like huge torpedoes rapidly swimming in the depths of the sea, their massive bodies measuring at least forty-one meters each.
The slowest was the Blue Giant Crab, excitedly scuttling forward with its six long legs, its blue energy erupting continuously to accelerate to nearly 300 kilometers per hour.
Ahead of them, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon with its Red Ice Flame Domain and the Silver Giant Dragon with its green storm and unfolded dragon wings were even faster, disappearing several kilometers away in the blink of an eye.
But in the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, they were still too slow.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared, “Roar! Don’t resist, you guys.”
Boom!
Fiery sparks and thunder exploded in the depths of the sea, creating a huge, illusory black-red Colossal Beast shadow that enveloped the four mutated Tiger Whales and the Blue Giant Crab.
“Roar! Keep up at full speed!”
With a single sweep of its thunderbolt wings, the giant shadow instantly exploded the seawater under the influence of its domain power, reaching supersonic speeds in the deep sea.
Seeing the giant shadow take away its wife and children within its domain, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes shone brightly: Yi-yi-yi! Thunderflame, take me too!
From the depths of the sea ahead, the roar of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was heard: “Roll, burst all your power to keep up with me.”
