“Roar! Charge, the Great Sethia is going to slaughter today.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared as the green storm around it erupted, transforming into a green flash of light and chasing after them.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Kidora, you’re awesome.” The Nine-headed Flood Dragon roared as it retracted its domain and chased after them, its whole body burning with red ice flames.
Yi-yi-yi! Wait for me.
Watching the disappearing behemoths one after another, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was in a hurry. Its surrounding domain suddenly turned black, vanishing like a shadow giant beast deep into the ocean.
With their domains, eighth-level behemoths would be neither clumsy due to water resistance nor body size. Instead, they moved even faster and became more powerful.
However, the cost was immense, like the difference between a person walking normally and sprinting at their limits.
Boom, boom, boom!
Under the supersonic movement, the two ninth-level and two eighth-level behemoths created four destructive impact waves in the depths of the sea. Their powerful auras exploded without restraint.
As for why they brought the ‘slow’ female Tiger Whales and other behemoths with them, apart from their show of force with greater numbers, it was also a chance to cultivate them.
In the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, these creatures were future ‘workers’ for producing ‘Life Crystals’, so of course, he had to cultivate them.
With a stronger Mutated Tiger Whale Group, they could speed up collecting Life Crystals. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon even planned to expand its army, making them ‘captains.’
As for the soldiers, it would be the other mutated Tiger Whales in the ocean.
With these beasts’ high intelligence and following the leadership of a few Tiger Whale behemoths, organizing a mutated creature army could be feasible.
By then, these Unique Beasts would be responsible for ‘harvesting’ Life Crystals within their territories, killing all, whether first- or second-level mutated creatures, so long as they reached the peak level.
With a continuous supply of Life Crystals, all their talents would soon be strengthened to the highest level, including its own Void Double Pupils and Soul Split.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was thinking about future planning, two hours later, a powerful aura from a late Stage 9 behemoth suddenly reached them from the front.
So powerful was the aura that even though it was hundreds of kilometers away, the Silver Giant Dragon’s gaze turned sharp, and it roared lowly, “Hegemon, that transcendent creature is a Late Stage 9 giant beast.”
A late Stage 9 beast, be it body or talent, was almost at the peak of a transcendent creature, far beyond the comparison of mid Stage 9 beasts.
Therefore, not only the Silver Giant Dragon but also all nine heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon grew solemn.
That was because the auras of two ninth-level giant beasts were emanating from that distant place – one late Stage 9 giant beast and one early Stage 9 giant beast.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze turned cold, emitting a deep and powerful roar, “Fear not, kill them all.”
With its five talents reaching the peak, only the quasi-mythical peak giant beasts could pose a little threat to it. Other ninth-level giant beasts were nothing.
…
More than 9,000 meters beneath the sea, a massive canyon tore through the earth. The blue radiance blinked in the trench, dispelling the surrounding darkness and bringing some light.
This was a micro-world similar to the Fire Water Small World, with the entrance connected to the sea trench and housing nearly 10 kilometers of deep blue seawater.
At the bottom of the small world’s ocean floor, a nearly 300-meter-long beast resembling an Eastern Divine Dragon lay. Its entire body was covered in black-blue scale armor.
This giant beast had four claws on its belly, no horns on its dragon head, but small fin-like horns on both sides of its head, like a real Flood Dragon emerging from mythology.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the others approached closer within a hundred kilometers of the small world, the Flood Dragon behemoth suddenly opened its eyes under the influence of the invisible aura emitted by the giant beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 574: 268: The War to Destroy 'Nation', The Terrifying Emperor Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Chapter 268: The War to Destroy ‘Nation’, The Terrifying Emperor Dragon_2
Roar!
With the explosion of sound waves, the aura of the Flood Dragon behemoth erupted, and under the powerful pressure close to the peak of Level 9, the entire Blue Little World trembled violently.
The roaring of the Flood Dragon behemoth awoke another Level 9 Giant Beast.
This was a giant beast resembling a blue whale mixed with a Kingfish, more than 190 meters long, covered in thick blue scales, with massive fins.
However, unlike the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish which also evolved signs of Kingfish, this giant beast grew many long tentacles like whiskers from its lower jaw and fins.
Moreover, with its Monarch-level bloodline aura unconsciously spreading an imposing presence, it was only slightly weaker than the late-stage Level 9 Flood Dragon behemoth.
Roar roar roar!!
Roar roar!!
The two giant beasts briefly communicated with roars, then stirred up violent currents as they burst out of the small world, followed by a deep roar from the Monarch-level Blue Mustache Mackerel.
Roar!
With the invisible sound wave roaring, the sea area within tens of kilometers vibrated as several Level 7 giants gathered, lying on the seabed or coiled on small hills.
Soon, under the glow of the blue light on the seabed, the power led by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon of the Dragon Palace appeared, confronting them at a distance of two kilometers.
On the left, leading with a nearly 300-meter-long Flood Dragon behemoth, black thunder gleamed around its wrist, forming a domain that covered 600 meters, and under the destructive black thunder, the sea water boiled and exploded.
The invisible force of thunder spread for kilometers, and under the overbearing power of the thunder, many ordinary marine creatures didn’t even react before their bodies stiffened and they died instantly.
As the Flood Dragon behemoth erupted and expanded its domain, the Blue Mustache Mackerel, a kilometer away, also erupted with its domain, turning the surrounding 600 meters into a black vortex.
The Blue Giant Kingfish stood within the black vortex as if it were a destructive giant beast stirring the ocean, with a terrifying presence.
Within a few kilometers around these two Level 9 giants, five giants who reached Level 8 also burst forth with their power, surrounding their domains and confronting the distant Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and other behemoths.
Apart from these, there were fourteen Level 7 giants with body lengths ranging from over 30 to more than 50 meters coiled around.
Compared with this giant beast force, the Dragon Palace faction was at a disadvantage in both the number and size of the beasts.
But upon seeing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon up close and feeling the terrifying pressure of its Emperor-level life, both the Flood Dragon behemoth and the Blue Mustache Mackerel showed serious expressions in their eyes.
The Level 8 and Level 7 giants were trembling and inadvertently letting out fearful roars, and even two of the Level 7 giants retreated slightly, seeking to flee.
This was the absolute suppression from the difference in bloodline levels.
Even the late-stage Level 9 giant Flood Dragon behemoth had difficulty circulating its internal energy under the suppression of an even stronger Emperor-level dragon bloodline.
At this point, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish became excited, slapping the waves with its tail and its fins waving.
Yiyiyiyi! Thunderflame, that guy, and that one too, it once chased us, let’s get it, kill it dead.
“Roar! I see it,”
With a low growl, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze fell on the Blue Mustache Mackerel; in its cold golden vertical pupils gleamed surprise and a hint of killing intent.
It didn’t expect to encounter this Level 9 giant beast again.
Time was when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had just broken through to Level 7, barely 30 meters long, when it ventured out with the Single-horned Tiger Whale and found two drops of blood from ancient creatures.
While the Thunderflame Behemoth killed the guardians and waited for the magical barrier to dissipate, many Mutant Beasts were attracted by the scent of the blood.
In the end, even a Level 9 Giant Beast came after them, seeking to devour the drop of blood containing the essence of ancient times.
But even that Level 9 giant couldn’t catch up with the Thunderflame Behemoth thanks to its Agility Talent.
Since the Thunderflame Behemoth lured away the Level 9 giant and allowed the Single-horned Tiger Whale to escape easily, both behemoths had a lasting impression of the chase.
However, while they remembered the incident, the Blue Mustache Mackerel did not recognize them.
Its brain couldn’t fathom that in less than three months, the beast that was barely 30 meters and hardly enough for one bite had grown so significantly.
Including the Single-horned Tiger Whale growing from 29 meters to nearly 90 meters, its form had evolved from a whale into a Kingfish.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by the domain of Storming Frost, took two steps forward. Its crystal-like dragon head slightly raised as if to roar.
But at that moment, a ferocious roar came from the opposing side: Roar! Leave, our, territory.
The Silver Giant Dragon let out an angry roar, “Roar! You lowly extraordinary creature, how dare you interrupt the Great Scythia’s speech. Today, the Great Scythia will make you bleed rivers.”
The Flood Dragon behemoth’s eyes were cold as it let out a thunderous roar: Roar! Move away now, or I will kill you all.
The Silver Giant Dragon radiated a bright cyan light, stirring up towering waves, and roared out loud, “Why are you roaring so loudly? Just wait, the Great Scythia is about to smash your head in.”
Faced with the threat of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Flood Dragon behemoth had only one response: roar! Get off our territory.
Without waiting for them to continue roaring and bickering, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes turned cold, and its thunderous roar exploded under the sea.
“Roar! I’ll take the Late Stage 9 Flood Dragon. Kidora, you kill that Mustache Mackerel, Sethia and Joe, you two take down those Level 8 Beasts.”
“Roar! Kill.” The vibration shook the seabed as the soundwave exploded. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body flashed with firelight, and in a blink, it disappeared from its spot with an unimaginable speed.
Roar!
At the instant that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon vanished, the Blue Mustache Mackerel let out an enraged roar.
As its mouth, black hole-like and filled with sharp teeth, angrily opened, a dark vortex comprised of countless tiny Space Cracks suddenly appeared in front.
The vortex spanned a three hundred meter area, sweeping everything within it.
This move had been seen by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon before, but this time, turning into a golden blue Radiance, it collided directly with the vortex.
Boom!
Under that absolutely Overbearing strength, the devouring vortex filled with space-shattering power instantly collapsed, and the wild force caused the sea water within a kilometer range to become murky and tremble.
By then, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had already appeared above the Mustache Mackerel’s head.
Boom!
A Golden Blaze Thunder Domain stretching across eight hundred meters, like a destruction sphere, collided with the Black Vortex Domain covering six hundred meters around the Blue Mustache Mackerel. Rings of dazzling energy halo exploded.
But it only held for an instant before the domain around the Blue Mustache Mackerel was crushed by the Thunderflame Domain. The endless, scorching Golden Flames and destructive thunders engulfed the Blue Mustache Mackerel.
Within the blazing Golden Flames, a giant claw holding a ‘Star’ descended.
Boom!
Under the giant claw, the Blue Mustache Mackerel’s Domain, which had shrunk to twenty meters, collapsed once again, followed by an endless burst of scorching golden light.
Boom!
Under the strike of the Extreme Yang Golden Flame, comparable to a mini nuclear explosion, the Void exploded, the Blue Mustache Mackerel let out a miserable scream, half of its body’s Scale Armor shattered, and its flesh and blood were scorched to black charcoal.
Triggered by the smell of blood, the ferocity of the Blue Mustache Mackerel was spurred, its giant mouth opening in rage. Instantly, a force from the tearing of space landed on the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
In the scorching firelight, a seventy-meter-long tail covered in black and red sharp spikes shot through the Void, shattering the Scale Armor, piercing the Mustache Mackerel’s chin.
The Blue Mustache Mackerel was even blasted away with a boom due to the impact force carried by the tail.
All of this happened in an instant, and all the beasts were slightly stunned, including the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon.
Wait, Abbott, didn’t you just say you were going to take on the Flood Dragon behemoth?
While they were stunned, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t stop.
In the instant it struck and severely injured the Mustache Mackerel, the seabed beneath the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exploded, and it burst forward through the sea water at Supersonic Speed toward the Blue Flood Dragon.
As for the Blue Mustache Mackerel, it had already used the power of the tail strike to escape hundreds of meters away.
Boom!
Because of the extreme speed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swung its left claw as it passed by an Eighth Level Beast, instantly smashing its head to pieces.
Overbearing and brutal.
“Roar roar roar!! Kido, invincible, awesome, kill!”
In an excited roar, the aura of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon exploded outward, directly revealing its six hundred meter long, three-headed Black Dragon True Body, pouncing towards the severely injured Mustache Mackerel afar.
“Roar! Great Sethia shall create rivers of blood.”
The nearly hundred meter Silver Giant Dragon roared, its claw compressing the destruction storm’s frost, piercing through space, and appearing instantaneously over a thousand meters away.
Boom! Under the Silver Giant Dragon’s claw, the head of the Early Stage 8 Beast shattered, only managing to emit a scream before being brutally killed, appearing incredibly ferocious.
Ying ying ying!! Charge, kill them all, don’t let any escape.
Gurgle gurgle!! Today, I, Crab General, will also go on a killing spree. I’m aiming for twenty kills.
As the intense battle erupted, the Female Tiger Whale silently disappeared into the dark sea.
And the three ‘small’ Level 7 Tiger Whales, also excited, teamed up and pounced towards those fleeing Level 7 Colossi at the rear of the battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 575: 269: Destruction of the World by Thunderflame, The True Collapse of the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Chapter 269: Destruction of the World by Thunderflame, The True Collapse of the World
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon burst through an Eighth Level Beast.
The Flood Dragon behemoth in the distance opened its huge mouth angrily, and a black light gathered in its mouth. In an instant, a breath of ten meters thick, formed from endless black Thunder, shot out.
Bang!
Everything under the black breath was shattered, obliterated, and a Destruction Tunnel pierced through the deep sea. The seawater roared on both sides, forming powerful spiral impact waves.
Moreover, due to the condensation of lightning, the speed of the breath was terrifying, instantly penetrating a kilometer and piercing through the afterimage of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had become a flame of fire.
Woo!
The Level 7 Colossus, which looked like a fleeing Giant King Squid, let out a miserable scream, and was instantly obliterated by the lightning breath, immediately falling on the seabed more than two kilometers away on a small hill.
Bang!
Black Thunder burst out, and the dazzling black mushroom cloud rose from the seabed, expanding to several hundred meters in the blink of an eye, surrounded by circles of black and red halos.
Immediately afterwards, the sea waves of destruction erupted, sweeping across a range of several kilometers, where flying sand and rolling stones made the sea water turbid.
As a late-stage Level 9 behemoth, the full-force breath of the black-blue Flood Dragon was even more terrifying in terms of its instantaneous destructive power than a small Nuclear Bomb.
In the turbulent sea, the golden flames that burned Heaven and Earth erupted on a large scale, combined with a series of black and blue snakes, fiercely hitting the Black Thunder Domain.
Bang!
Two domains with diameters of six hundred and eight hundred meters collided like two destructive light spheres, and circles of destructive impacts erupted, breaking the surrounding ground and causing explosions in the sea.
As a Ninth Level Domain fused with various talents, it was not only filled with powerful energy but also gained a bit of spatial property.
At this time, under the neutralization of the two domains colliding, a series of destrucive black Thunder exploded on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, but failed to make the slightest tremor.
At the same time, the Golden Flames and blue Thunder were engulfing the Flood Dragon behemoth.
A series of more dominating and destructive Annihilation True Thunder exploded on its protective energy, and under the burning of the blazing Golden Flames, its internal energy was rapidly consumed.
In front of the destructive forces of the two top-tier talents, the Flood Dragon with higher level was suppressed as soon as it came into contact.
If it hadn’t already grown to the late stage of Level 9, his strength would have been even more condensed and thick, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could burn it to ashes just by relying on its domain.
Roar!
The Flood Dragon behemoth roared in shock and anger, and a Dragon Claw below its abdomen swelled to a hundred meters, turning into a huge golden Dragon Claw, with a terrifying breath emanating from the black Thunder entwined around it.
Bang!
The Flood Dragon beast twisted its body, appeared like lightning in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and struck out with a claw. The golden dragon claw caused space to distort, producing black cracks filled with powerful strength.
Apparently, this Flood Dragon had also awakened its “strength” type talent, and the power of the giant golden dragon claw was even more terrifying.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stood upright, its ferocious right claw muscles swelling, with defensive black and dark red power entwining around it, it counterattacked with an even faster speed.
Bang! The surrounding space of the two Dragon Claws vibrated, cracking with pitch-black fractures.
Immediately afterwards, an indescribable terrifying force exploded, the surrounding seabed that had melted into magma collapsed, exploded, and countless debris flew
in the terrifying pure power of collision.
In the midst of the destructive explosion, a huge black-blue figure burst out, smashing the seawater and ruthlessly crashing into a hill on the seabed more than a thousand meters away.
Bang! Half of the more than a thousand-meter-high mountain peak collapsed, and numerous huge rocks rolled down, and the sea water became turbid.
In the middle of the chaotic and violent seabed pit, the black-red ferocious giant beast stood tall, surrounded by burning golden flames and thunder roaring all around, radiating an extremely fierce and heavy aura.
Looking at the turbid and dim area in the distance, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze was cold.
It was simply courting death to try to compete with it, a melee invincible of the same level, in terms of strength.
Roar!
The Flood Dragon behemoth buried by the debris exploded out, its left claw under its abdomen shattered, and it was visibly regenerating and growing at a visible speed.
Roar!!!
The huge-figured Flood Dragon behemoth was surrounded by black Thunder, and an explosive burst of strength from the roar caused the ocean to riot in an instant within a range of several kilometers.
Bang bang bang! Nine water dragons formed by endless seawater, up to a thousand meters long, mixed with black Thunder appeared at the bottom of the sea, encircling and traversing between Heaven and Earth.
As water dragons condense, the seawater inside is constantly destroyed by the black Thunder, exploded, and formed a terrifying impact force, which is then bound by the powerful Heavenly Talent.
In the blink of an eye, the nine water dragons transformed into black color, radiating a depressing destructive aura from within, just like a silent, ready-to-erupt volcano, swooping towards the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In an instant, a water dragon collided with the Thunderflame Domain.
Boom boom boom!
The water dragons were like high-pressure water guns mixed with destructive power, continuously washing the Gold Flame Thunderbolt Domain without an end.
Immediately after the second, third… nine water dragons surrounded all sides, and under the unceasing surge, even the Thunderflame Domain continued to tremble.
As the destructive water flow and Gold Flame Thunderbolt collided, circles of destructive impacts erupted, and the sea area within a range of several kilometers became turbulent, chaotic, and violent.
Under the endless seawater washing, the domain that surrounded the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was constantly compressed, shrinking, and finally reduced to a range of two hundred meters.
Bang!
The Thunderflame Domain exploded to the right side, with a golden Dragon Claw with a diameter of a hundred meters descending from the sky, and under its domineering power, the space was almost squeezed together.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly turned around, its right claw muscles swelling, and as it burst with a Hundred-fold Power, its Dragon Claw clenched like a human hand and punched out with ten times the Supersonic Speed.
Boom!
Under this Dragon Fist, the huge golden Dragon Claw was instantly shattered, and the terrifying force was undiminished, blasting the water dragon that was a kilometer long from the sky above.

chapters.title: Chapter 576: 269: Thunderflame Destroys the World, Real. Shatter the World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Chapter 269: Thunderflame Destroys the World, Real. Shatter the World_2
Roar! A flood dragon behemoth inside the water dragon let out a pained shriek, its scales on the abdomen shattered, and its flesh and blood flew around.
In the midst of shrieking, the flood dragon behemoth rushed into another water dragon, its gifted power burst forth, and in the blink of an eye, the nine water dragons, each a kilometer long, restored to their original state.
Roar Roar Roar! The enormous black thunder water dragons roared, stirring up tumultuous sea waves at the bottom of the sea as they crazily attacked the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, intending to wear it down.
This flood dragon is worthy of being a Level 9 Giant Beast, displaying astonishing strength and was not subdued or severely injured by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon after a few encounters.
At the same time when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the flood dragon behemoth were clashing, other battles at distance also got exceedingly fierce.
The most wild and brutal battle was from Kidora; its actual body, which constituted a six-hundred-meter dominion, transformed into three black dragons, fiercely fighting against the Blue Mustache Mackerel.
After being severely injured by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Blue Mustache Mackerel, which belonged to the King-level, emitted a weak aura and was being suppressed by the nine-headed flood dragon.
The three enormous dragon heads continuously tore off the tentacles of the Mustache Mackerel one by one, shattering its scale armor while completely disregarding its energy immunity of dominion and the squeeze of the space tearing dominion.
However, the Blue Mustache Mackerel was not weak either; its huge mouth hell-bent on devouring created tens of meters long black holes on Kidora with every roar
The rippling power from these space tearing attacks was terrifying, and difficult to defend against.
Nevertheless, the nine-headed flood dragon under the form of the domain was not afraid of injury. It consumed strength to swiftly refill its actual shape in the blink of an eye, and only experienced a slight decline in its aura.
On the other side, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was fiercely confronting a Late Stage Eighth Rank Beast of just over a hundred meters in length.
When the black and white dominions collided with the ice dominion, within the tenfold effect of the white domain, the two huge fins of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish were like tens of meters long battle blades.
Each time the fins swept across, shards of ice splintered and ice mountains collapsed.
Whenever the giant beast burst forth with the white light beam that could freeze everything, the dominion surrounding the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish would turn black, transforming into intangible shadow matter.
With its powerful gifted dominion and the slash rune, the Mid Stage Level 8 Single-horned Tiger Kingfish fiercely clashed against the Late Stage giant beast, not being defeated, and even gradually suppressing it.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, it had already slain another Mid Stage Level 8 giant beast, and was pursuing another one, which was also the last Late Stage Level 8 giant beast.
The Dragon Palace was suppressing the opposition on both the high-end battlefield and the mid-tier battlefield, but the battle between the Level 7 beasts was a bit lacking.
The Blue Giant Crab was holding back two Level 7 beasts that wanted to flee, but outnumbered, it lost two legs in just a while.
However, this beast was extremely fierce and it got even crazier after getting injured. Spewing bubbles, it swung its two large pincers, severely wounding those two Level 7 giants.
Further away, the three ‘small’ Tiger Whales were intermingled, burning in flames, chasing the Level 7 giant beasts that were fleeing into the black sea area.
Under the terrifying oppression of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, as soon as the battle broke out, these Level 7 giant beasts disintegrated, having no intention to resist at all.
In the darkness, the Female Tiger Whale swung its tail, its huge body shuttling through the sea, making not the slightest water flow or energy aura, keeping its energy aura concealed and retracted.
A layer of black radiance circled around it, eliminating any water disturbance brought up by its motion while also restraining, energy fluctuations, making it look strange and aggressive.
In the sea water behind it, a Level 7 behemoth’s corpse with only half its body left was gushing blood and slowly falling onto the seabed.
At this moment, amidst the roars and battle of one beast after another, the sea water in a sea area spanning tens of kilometers boiled and turned turbid with the explosion of various gifted powers, causing the ocean to shudder.
Of course, the place where the battle was most intense would naturally be where the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was present.
Staring at the surrounding nine black thunder water dragons that were continuously attacking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a cold light. Do they think this can tie me down?
Roar!
With a roar, the boundless golden flames erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. These flames gathered under the pressure of the dominion, and an instantly formed a golden star appeared on the seabed.
With a diameter of two hundred meters, the burning flames on the surface of a massive and tangible light sphere seemed to roll like magma, exuding an indescribable terrifying high temperature.
Under the golden light sphere, the seabed mud and stone, the surrounding sea water, everything melted and disintegrated under the horrifying high temperature, forming a three-hundred-meter in diameter black area.
Boom, boom, boom!!
One black thunder water dragon after another roared, causing rumbling vibrations as they exploded the moment they approached the black area, continuously melting and disappearing before they could be close to the golden light sphere.
Just then, the golden light sphere expanded, just like a Red Giant entering the evolutionary phase, obliterating everything in its path.
When the golden sun expanded to eight hundred meters, the boundless light and devastating thermal energy exploded. A figure glowing with dazzling light shot out from the thermal explosion.
At that instant, the flood dragon behemoth almost lost its soul, letting out a cry of surprise and anger. The endless black thunder roared inside its body, forming a destructive domain out of hundreds of meters thick layers around its body.
Boom!
Under the dazzling dragon claw, the black thunder domain outside the body of the flood dragon behemoth collapsed instantly.
At the same moment the dragon claw caused the domain to explode, the body of the flood dragon behemoth coiled up like a python, protecting its head inside the coils of its body.
Boom!
Under the golden-blue radiant claw, the rear half of the flood dragon behemoth exploded with a bang, flesh and blood flew around, a section of the body a hundred meters long was blown apart.
Blood gushed out like a high-pressure fountain from the wound twenty some meters wide, immediately turning the muddy sea water within a hundred-meter radius red in the blink of an eye.
Roar!

chapters.title: Chapter 577: 269: Thunderflame Destroys the World, Real. Shatter the World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Chapter 269: Thunderflame Destroys the World, Real. Shatter the World_3
The Flood Dragon behemoth let out a miserable scream, and the remaining body transformed into a dark lightning, bursting into a terrifying speed and diving into the deep-sea trench a few kilometers away, then entering the Blue Little World.
Before the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could chase after it, the Blue Little World under the sea trench shook violently, and a powerful spatial fluctuation erupted, closing the entrance slowly.
They actually chose to merge their domain with this little world.
Standing at the edge of the sea trench, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze was icy as it watched the closed Little World below.
Golden flames burned on its body, and thunder leaped, evaporating the turbid sea water around it, forming a circle of white waves rushing in all directions.
After Late Stage 9, there are multiple paths for Giant Beasts to try and touch the laws. For example, they can dig deeper into their Gifted Power, push a particular talent to the limit, and then comprehend the laws.
In this situation, evolving a talent into a law would lead to the upgrade of bloodlines and the transformation of the body, becoming a quasi-mythical behemoth.
However, only a few of these Giant Beasts actively comprehend the ‘Law’ Power.
Most mutant beasts break through Level 9 to reach Level 9 Peak, and touch the laws with their ‘bodies’, which is an evolutionary breakthrough.
After these behemoths reach Level 9 Late Stage, they eat, sleep, and absorb Heavenly Energy to allow their bodies to grow naturally. Whether they can become Level 9 Peak Giant Beasts depends on their luck.
However, there is another special route, which is to merge their domain with a complete small space, and use this special ‘Small Space’ to advance to a quasi-mythical behemoth.
But Level 9 Giant Beasts who choose this path, basically have no hope of breaking through to the Mythical-level.
Because when they merge their domain with this kind of ‘Hollow’ small space, they also lock themselves up, making it impossible for their power to increase and their bodies to change.
Of course, there are gains and losses.
Once a Late Stage 9 Giant Beast refines a ‘Small World’, not only will its physical domain become very strong, but it will also have a stable rear.
When they close the Small World, unless the power is strong enough to destroy the “World”, no beast can kill them.
For example, the Flood Dragon behemoth, part of its domain has already merged with this Little World, and it can now control the closing of the spatial entrance.
But did they really think they could avoid death this way?
Hums! The dorsal fin of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon lit up in sections, and lightning leaped while the scorching energy from within the body converged towards its throat.
Under the endless energy gathering, the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon emitted extremely dazzling radiance, and an invisible terrifying destructive atmosphere spread in the deep sea.
The frightening energy fluctuations had not yet burst, but the fighting behemoths in the distance instinctively felt terror, fear, and subconsciously looked over.
The Silver Giant Dragon even showed a look of shock and roared involuntarily, “Rule Power! No, it’s not like a rule, but it’s just as terrifying.”
Boom!
The golden blue radiance in the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon sparkled, and a terrifying beam made from Heaven Burning Golden Flame and Annihilation True Thunder erupted, causing a horrifying tremor.
The golden-blue beam that possessed the ultimate high temperature and Destructive Impact kept expanding, and everything in its path turned into nothingness. In an instant, it fell on the Small World Barrier below.
Boom!
Under the horrifying shockwave of the Thunderflame Breath, which was comparable to the power of law, the Blue Little World shook violently.
Under the terrifying force, the interior space of the Little World, which was over ten kilometers in diameter, roared and shook like the end of the world, and the Flood Dragon behemoth’s eyes were filled with astonished and angry roars.
How is that possible? The black-red Colossal Beast was only at Level 9 Early Stage. How could it break through the spatial barrier?
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the impact of the golden-blue beam that destroyed everything, the sky and earth trembled, and black cracks gradually appeared in the sky. The scorching golden-blue radiance penetrated in.
In the desperate gaze of the Flood Dragon behemoth, the sky shattered, and the golden-blue beam of destruction came down from the sky.
Boom!
Under the destructive beam comparable to the power of Law, the small space of the Little World was penetrated, collapsed, and the sea and earth shattered in an instant, and the sea water boiled.
In the violent explosion of the Little World, the black-red ferocious giant beast stood towering in the Void, looking like a world-destroying behemoth, emitting an extremely fierce aura.
A single strike, destroying the world!

chapters.title: Chapter 578: 270: The Azure-White Mythical Giant Dragon, Let's Kill It Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Chapter 270: The Azure-White Mythical Giant Dragon, Let’s Kill It Together
Several decades ago, a series of cracks penetrated both realms under the collision of two worlds.
Not only did the Heavenly Energy surge in and the Giant Beasts appear in these circumstances, but also some peculiar locations were born, resembling small ‘bubble’ worlds.
These small worlds were upgraded versions of the twisted space zones of the Alien Beast Battlefield, with a more complete spatial structure, forming a boundary wall that enveloped a part of the real-world substances.
In addition, because of their completeness, these small worlds would actively absorb the Heavenly Energy from the outside, making the energy more pure and rich.
Therefore, such places generally had powerful Giant Beasts entrenched in them.
At this moment, under the combined strike of Annihilation True Thunder and Heaven Burning Golden Flame, the Blue Little World’s spatial boundary wall shattered, causing an explosion, leaving everything in oblivion afterwards.
The destructive power of the explosion penetrated the surface space, tunneled through the deep void, and swallowed endless seawater before forming a deep pit on the seabed that stretched for more than ten kilometers.
However… looking at the Flood Dragon behemoth’s corpse that disappeared along with it, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, standing in the raging currents, felt a hint of regret in its eyes.
It was too preoccupied with testing the power of the fused forces.
Nevertheless, the power of the top-tier talent fusion was indeed terrifying, reaching the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s expectations, which was comparable to the Law Power, annihilating a small world with one strike.
Only the consumption was somewhat significant, as almost 50% of the Thunder and Golden Flame energy was used up with one strike, meaning it could only do this two more times before exhausting its energy.
So, this kind of breath burst attack should not be used indiscriminately in the future, especially when facing quasi-mythical beasts.
The most suitable approach should be close combat, using 10% of the fusion power for nuclear explosions in its claws. Combined with a hundred-fold instantaneous burst of power, it should be enough to destroy everything.
While the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon started restoring its consumed energy and contemplating the gains of the battle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, stimulated by the fight, let out a furious roar from its nine dragon heads.
“Roar roar roar!! Ghidorah, Invincible!”
Boom boom!!
In the roar, two black dragon heads tore through the domain, firmly biting the head and tail of the Blue Mustache Mackerel, not caring about the black and red true body being torn apart by the huge wounds from the Space Cracks.
This Mustache Mackerel’s most potent talent was the same as the Silver Giant Dragon’s, both of them related to space.
However, the Mustache Mackerel’s spatial talent was combined with the domain, forming fissures that tear apart the surface space, shattering everything within the domain, and making it impossible for ordinary Level 9 Giant Beasts to get close.
Only a monster like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could ignore those Space Cracks and smash the domain with a more overbearing and fierce force.
Roar!
The Mustache Mackerel, whose head and tail were bitten by dozens of meter-wide dragon heads, let out a furious roar, struggling violently while its colossal body unleashed a horrifying power like overturning a river.
At the same time, its power exploded inside its body, covering a domain of several hundred meters with several black cracks appearing and nearly tearing the three black dragons in half.
Roar roar roar!!
At the moment, Ghidorah’s third black dragon head, which is the Domain True Body, roared in anger, revealing its true body with six dragon heads, each with blue, red, and purple horns, gathering terrifying energies in their mouths.
Instantly, a strong aura of death enveloped the Mustache Mackerel, which struggled even more frantically under the threat of death, creating a crack of over forty meters in length.
Splat!
The huge black dragon head biting the Mustache Mackerel’s neck was torn apart, along with the central true body’s dragon head, as scorching blood gushed out from the severed wound.
Roar!
The Mustache Mackerel, whose head had broken free, roared furiously, its fierce mouth open to nearly one hundred meters wide, attempting to bite Ghidorah’s six true dragon heads.
In the Mustache Mackerel’s enormous mouth, countless black cracks spread, emitting a terrifying aura.
If this bite succeeds, tearing apart the six true dragon heads, even if Ghidorah doesn’t die, it would suffer a heavy injury.
Roar roar roar!!
Two black dragon heads, which were about to release gravity breath, roared and shot out while simultaneously, the huge black dragon head biting the tail of the Mustache Mackerel loosened its grip.
Boom!
With one bite, the Mustache Mackerel swallowed and broke the two dragon heads, but at the same time, it was knocked down by the attacking massive black dragon head, causing the seabed to collapse instantly.
Boom!
At the instant the Mustache Mackerel was knocked down, the other four dragon heads, containing ice and fire, released a combined breath, forming a more than ten-meter-wide red ice flame beam that bombarded its head.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the fusion of ice and fire energy, a powerful destructive explosion force was created. Amid the shocked and furious roar of the Mustache Mackerel, it gradually penetrated its five-meter-thick black energy shield, creating dazzling halos.
Boom!
Due to the mixed attributes of the ice and fire breath, the scale armor on the Mustache Mackerel’s head shattered, its flesh and blood turned to ash, and even its sturdy skull was forcibly penetrated, causing its enormous body to lose its struggle.
Three transcendental talents, plus six dragon heads capable of releasing breath, forming a Domain True Body with the top-tier talent, Red Ice Flame, as the core.
After breaking through to Level 9, Ghidorah’s combat prowess had become terrifying in an instant.
“Roar roar roar!! Ghidorah, F*cking Awesome!”
In the murky raging waters, Ghidorah, with only six dragon heads left, let out chaotic and brutal roars, appearing incomparably fierce with the corpses of the Void Beasts as a backdrop.
As for the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, well, it was still fighting the Level 8 Late Stage Beast.
This whale-like, shark-like beast covered in sharp scale armor was powerful, possessed two advanced talents, and also had a Lord-level bloodline.
Therefore, even though the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was powerful and capable of fighting the late-period at the Level 8 Mid Stage, it only managed to inflict light injuries on the beast after fighting for so long.
After all, it had only been a few minutes since the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon launched its attack and killed the Flood Dragon behemoth.
Under normal conditions, for robust-bodied, domain-surrounding, regenerative, and energetic Level 8 Giant Beasts, a same-level battle would typically take half a day to determine the winner.

chapters.title: Chapter 579: 270: Cyan Mythical Giant Dragon, Let's Kill it Together_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Chapter 270: Cyan Mythical Giant Dragon, Let’s Kill it Together_2
However, at this point, the Level 8 Giant Beast had already lost its will to fight, frantically rushing towards the dark sea while being entangled with the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, just wanting to escape quickly.
That black-red Colossal Beast was too terrifying.
Not only did it heavily injure their two leaders in an instant, but it also swiftly killed their big leader, even destroying the small world the leader was holed up in.
If it dragged on any longer, once that terrifying Colossal Beast came over, it might be instantly blown up.
“Roar! Joe, you’re so useless, you still haven’t killed it after all this time.” Accompanied by a roar, a Silver Giant Dragon surrounded by a storm appeared in the darkness from afar.
Ying ying ying!! This guy is thick-skinned and won’t die.
“Roar! Joe, hold it down, the Great Sethia will finish it off with one blow.”
Roar! Amidst the roaring, the Silver Giant Dragon’s wings were furiously spread, and the sharp white dragon horns on its head emitted a series of dazzling lights, illuminating the dark seabed.
In the light, an enormous phantom as majestic as a mountain range emerged, invisibly radiating a divine, noble, and terrifying aura that made countless creatures want to worship.
The Silver Giant Dragon had used this move twice before.
The first time it was blocked by the Thunderflame Beheamoth’s mixture of flame and thunder breath, and the second time it froze the true form of the Level 9 Ancient Tiger Flood Dragon for a moment.
And now, as it grew stronger, the phantom dragon became more solid, and a Cyan Mythical Giant Dragon could faintly be seen.
*crack crack!!*
As the bloodline power was activated, a terrible chill arrived, turning a range of hundreds of meters into a frozen world in the blink of an eye.
Between the wings of the Silver Giant Dragon, countless tiny white ice crystals and black cracks like Space Cracks appeared, emitting a terrifying aura.
Woo! Go to hell.
At this moment, the white domain light surrounding the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish increased tenfold, and a giant black Tiger Kingfish over a hundred meters long emerged.
Bang bang bang bang!!
Ignoring the sharp ice crystals that covered the sky, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with its Spawn Shield, fiercely collided with the Giant Beast, exerting a strong force to push the beast towards the Silver Giant Dragon.
Boom!
The Silver Giant Dragon’s wings beat, and the destructive frost between the wings surged out, forming a black cold current mixed with frost. Everything in its path was frozen and shattered.
Just as the Giant Beast was about to be engulfed by the black cold current, the domain around the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish turned black and the phantom of intangible substance rushed upwards.
*exhale!*
Under the devastating cold current, the domain was instantly frozen, followed by the struggling shark whale Giant Beast. Then, as the black hurricane tore through space, it shattered.
Approaching Level 8 Late Stage and having its bloodline purified once, the Silver Giant Dragon’s attack was even more potent, albeit with a longer charging time.
This time it directly killed a Level 8 Late Stage Giant Beast, leaving the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish in awe and chirping at the weakened Silver Giant Dragon in the distance.
Ying ying ying!! Sethia, you almost killed me too!
The Silver Giant Dragon slowly retracted its wings: “Roar! Don’t worry, I know your dark domain can become intangible, so even being affected by the attack would only result in serious injuries, not death.”
At this point, the battle was basically over.
The two Level 9 Giant Beasts were killed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and Kidora, while the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon killed one of the five Level 8 Giant Beasts and the Silver Giant Dragon killed the remaining four.
As for those Level 7 Giant Beasts, they began to flee in all directions as the battle broke out, and since they were of low value, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon simply didn’t bother with them.
However, the Giant Crab and Female Tiger Whale chased after them, probably killing a few.
More than half an hour later, the Blue Giant Crab slowly crawled back from the darkness in the distance.
At this time, its shell had many broken parts, and only three of its six legs remained, looking somewhat uncoordinated with some blue blood flowing from the broken areas.
But this time, its large pincers were intact, each clamping the broken corpses of two Level 7 Giant Beasts, struggling to drag the corpses to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Bang bang!! The Blue Giant Crab threw down the corpses, looked at the terrifying Thunderflame Emperor Dragon standing at the edge of the abyss, and excitedly spat out a large string of bubbles.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, I was so awesome this time, totally badass, I killed two enemies.
Looking at the battered Blue Giant Crab, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded slightly: “Roar! Not bad, worthy of being a member of my Dragon Palace, able to win against two opponents by yourself.”
“But remember to be cautious in such situations in the future, you do not have absolute suppression power against opponents of the same level now, so just hold down and kill one.”
The Crab General, initially captured out of a whim as a doorkeeper for the Dragon Palace, gained some value over time. In the face of battles, it became ferocious and fierce but was just a bit weaker in strength.
Though it had awakened a trace of a king-level creature’s bloodline, the power of that bloodline was too weak, and it was only equivalent to an ordinary elite Mutated Beast.
If it weren’t for eating the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast’s flesh and blood last time, which improved its body and talent, it might have been beaten to death by the two same-level Giant Beasts this time.
In response to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s teachings, the Blue Giant Crab’s three legs trembled excitedly, spitting out bubbles.
Gurgle gurgle!! Alright, Great King, next time I won’t fight two, but twenty, I won’t weaken our Dragon Palace’s prestige.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, you’re so powerful, so amazing. Those enormous terrifying Beasts were all wiped out by you.
At first, this guy spoke normally, but later on, it became increasingly nonsensical. Hearing this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had a dark expression on its face, strongly resisting the urge to slap it to death and growling to interrupt it.

chapters.title: Chapter 580: 270 Cyan Mythical Giant Dragon, Let's Kill It Together_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Chapter 270 Cyan Mythical Giant Dragon, Let’s Kill It Together_3
“Roar! That’s enough, shut up, and go recover to the side.”
Grrr, grrr!! Yes, Great King, I will recover quickly and strive to guard the gates of the Dragon Palace well.
After sending the excited Giant Crab to one side, it wasn’t long before a Female Tiger Whale, emitting a strong scent of blood, appeared, leading three ‘small’ Tiger Whales back from the darkness.
In the mouth of the Female Tiger Whale was the corpse of a beast with most of its head destroyed—a Level 7 Peak Colossus.
Meanwhile, the three Little Tiger Whales were also dragging three half-bodies, their midsections cleaved in a way that clearly pointed to the Female Tiger Whale’s doing.
The Female Tiger Whale placed the Giant Beast’s corpse in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and let out a respectful roar: Roar, roar, roar!! King, there is a Life Crystal inside this one.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled into a slight, fierce grin: “Roar! Well done, Horned Lady. You’re much more reliable than that Joe.”
This Female Tiger Whale usually kept a low profile but dealt with matters steadily and calmly, taking comprehensive factors into consideration, showing high intelligence.
In contrast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was somewhat careless and brash. No wonder it was chased out to ‘make money’ and support the family every day by its wife.
If it were up to it to care for the three Little Tiger Whales, perhaps they would have already been dead, not one left.
At that moment, the three Little Tiger Whales also swam over, circling the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon excitedly with the half-corpses.
Tiger One, roar, roar, roar!! Uncle, I’m also super fierce.
Tiger Two, roar, roar, roar!! Awesome, totally awesome.
Roar!! I’m, super fierce.
“Roar! You three are also good, not bad, already looking a bit like proper beasts.” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon praised, and immediately the three Little Tiger Whales became even more excited.
Just then, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish swam over, but it seemed a bit gloomy.
Roar, roar, roar!! This time I’m going to condense two hundred, no, five hundred Slash Runes, refine all the scale armor on my Double Fins, and the next time, I’ll chop down ten.
In this Great Beast Battle, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had the worst performance, not managing to kill even one Giant Beast.
As an Eighth Level Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish possessed the Transcendent heavy water vortex, Spawn Shield, Crystal Horn Beam, and the flesh’s Defense and Strength, along with the strongest black and white alternating domain.
But all these talents lacked decisive Burst.
The heavy water vortex had an average effect against Eighth Level Beasts with domains, not to mention the shield, and the Crystal Horn Beam was even more useless, including only intermediate Defense and Strength.
If it weren’t for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon teaching it the Slash Rune and enhancing its Double Fins to release some of the Spawn’s physical Strength, this time it wouldn’t just be about suppressing that Late Stage Eighth Rank Beast—it would be good not to get suppressed in return.
This is why it gets increasingly difficult to surpass one’s limits at higher orders; if you have powerful talents and formidable strength, so does your opponent. None that grow to the late stages of level eight are weak.
Not to mention level nine.
From this viewpoint, one can see how outrageous the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is; a Monarch-class Silver Dragon with Five Top-level Talents is invincible even at level nine among its peers.
Compared to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, his wife Horned Lady may have fewer talents, and the strongest of them are only two intermediate ones—Devouring and Crushing—but combined, they provide terrifying single-target damage.
Similar to that Mustache Mackerel’s Space Cracks Devouring.
At this time, the Silver Giant Dragon flew over in the water, its dragon head slightly raised, showing a hint of pride: “Roar! This time, the Great Sethia has slain four Eighth Level Extraordinary Lifeforms.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon generously praised: “Roar! Sethia, you are indeed the Dragon Palace Dragon King, peerless within the same rank; with a flick of your claw, you suppressed those Giant Beasts. That’s very impressive.”
“Roar! The Great Sethia has always been very impressive.” Saying so, the pleased Silver Giant Dragon not only raised its head but even its tail rose slightly.
Clearly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s affirmation made it very happy.
However, just as the Silver Giant Dragon was feeling proud, four heads of the six-headed Flood Dragon dragged over a Mustache Mackerel corpse nearly two hundred meters in length, struggling somewhat with the effort.
The two free black dragon heads looked at the Silver Giant Dragon and issued excited roars, “Kido, invincible, freaking awesome, kill, Level 9 Giant Beast.”
“Roar! Kido, you did quite well this time too,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued praising. After all, flattery costs nothing.
The Silver Giant Dragon, however, was somewhat disdainful and growled contemptuously, “Roar! This Level 9 guy was already heavily injured by Hegemon, you just picked up an easy bargain, Kido.”
But the six-headed Flood Dragon paid it no mind, as four heads lifted the giant corpse up high, and the remaining two heads roared proudly, “Kido, freaking awesome, invincible.”
Killing a peer Monarch Giant Beast excited the six-headed Flood Dragon. As for whether there were additional factors playing a role, it didn’t matter anymore. What mattered was that it had done the deed.
It didn’t come without a cost, though. Even though the Mustache Mackerel was heavily wounded by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it managed to blow up three of its dragon heads before dying, and now it would take at least three days to recover.
The battle was over, and it was time to distribute the spoils.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gave the Flood Dragon behemoth’s tail to the Giant Crab and the Female Tiger Whale.
After they consumed flesh and blood equivalent to one-third of a Late Stage 9 Giant Beast and digested it for a while, they would both nearly reach Level 7 Peak and enter hibernation.
As for the Monarch-level Mustache Mackerel, most of it was given to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Silver Giant Dragon.
As flesh and blood of a Monarch-level Ninth Level Beast, it was still very beneficial to them. Even the Monarch-level Silver Giant Dragon would gain from it.
There’s no need to mention the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish; with its Homologous Bloodline, its growth could be accelerated, its blood purged, and its strength significantly improved.
Beyond that, the Three-headed Small Tiger Whales, including the Female Tiger Whale, also had their share of the Mustache Mackerel flesh and blood.
It was believed that after digesting this, their strength would all see a significant increase.
This was the advantage of following a leader; they could casually consume the flesh and blood of Monarch-level gigantic beasts that were a couple of Major Realms higher, growing far faster than before.
As for the six-headed Flood Dragon, it obtained the flesh and blood of two Late Mid-stage Eighth Rank Beasts to recover from its injuries.
Lastly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon kept the remaining three corpses of Level 8 Early and Mid-stage Beasts, as well as several Level 7 Colossus flesh and blood, for itself, seemingly ending up with the least spoils.
This allocation caused the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and a few other beasts to hesitate, with the Silver Giant Dragon feeling that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was selling itself short and couldn’t help but growl.
“Hegemon, according to the rule of whoever contributes most gets the lion’s share of the spoils, all this Ninth Level Extraordinary Lifeforms’ flesh and blood should belong to you.”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish nodded its head in agreement.
Roar roar roar!! Right, Thunderflame, you should eat it; you’ll grow faster if you do.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled, “Roar! We’ll do it according to my way of distribution. This Ninth Level flesh and blood is merely energy to me, but it’s very important to you.”
“Consuming this flesh and blood will accelerate your growth, purify your bloodline. Otherwise, with your too weak strength, you won’t be able to keep pace with me.”
“As companions who have grown together up until now, I hope that when I set foot into the Endless World, you will still be by my side, so we can go forth and conquer the world together.”
Instantly, all Giant Beasts were deeply moved. They hadn’t imagained the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had thought so far ahead, especially the Blue Giant Crab, who idolized it as a super icon, and now was emotionally collapsed on the ground.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was so excited that it was slapping its fins.
Roar roar roar!! Go forth together, eat everything, take everything.
The six-headed Flood Dragon was even more moved, writhing wildly on the ground, with all six dragon heads uttering chaotic, excited roars, “Roar roar roar!! Together, charge in, freaking awesome, kill.”
However, what these deeply moved Giant Beasts didn’t know was that the real target of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was the Life Crystal; it needed more Attribute points to strengthen its talents.

chapters.title: Chapter 581: 271: Enlightenment Genius Jack Clark, Things Have Changed (Request for Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Chapter 271: Enlightenment Genius Jack Clark, Things Have Changed (Request for Monthly Votes)
When the grand battle at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s side ended.
Late at night, in the room, Jack Clark looked down at his palm.
In his hand, streaks of blue arcs circled, constantly leaping, converging, gradually condensing into a strand of blue-black lightning that emitted a destructive aura.
Boom!
The forcefully condensed blue-black Thunder exploded, instantly brightening the room, with arcs of electricity spreading out, piercing through the air, emitting a fizzing noise and the smell of scorching.
Jack Clark frowned slightly, “As expected, it’s not that easy.”
The core runes of his Combat Divine Body were all inherited from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, with strength passed down in the same vein.
Therefore, when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s major talents were strengthened to top-tier, it was theoretically possible for the talents fused with the Combat Shadow to ascend to top-tier as well.
Especially since Jack Clark was the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon himself, his grasp over the power of the Five Top-level Talents was intuitive.
Just like with Cultivation Methods, although many people cultivate the same True Martial, slight differences exist in each person’s practice after success.
Not to mention the difference between humans and Giant Beasts, aside from the Core Runes, the overall structure of the sequence chains that composed the forces were worlds apart, and the number of Talent Sequence Chains covering the entire body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon were counted by the tens of millions.
Just now, Jack Clark had ‘contemplated’ for several hours and only managed to obtain a semblance of the Annihilation True Thunder, which exploded as soon as it was condensed due to unstable energy.
If this problem had arisen before, Jack Clark would have already given up, given that he had never been good at ‘comprehension’.
Nor did he have that much time to waste.
But now… With a thought, Jack Clark called up the attribute page, his gaze falling on the remaining 5682 Attribute points, and immediately, a row of transparent text emerged before his eyes.
“Burning Attribute points can enter an epiphany state, greatly enhancing your cognitive understanding of all things and forces in the world.”
“Each epiphany initiation requires the consumption of 1000 points, until the Attribute Energy is completely burned out, or the user chooses to exit the state of enlightenment.”
This was the change to the attribute page after breaking through to the Seventh Layer of Heaven, using the burning of Attribute points as the price to enter the enlightenment state, compensating for Jack Clark’s weakness in comprehension.
In fact, after reaching the Seventh Layer of Heaven, the feature of strengthening Cultivation Methods with Attribute points had already become useless to Jack Clark.
Because the cultivation at the Seventh Layer of Heaven was about gradually mirroring oneself, adjusting and optimizing the structure of the Combat Shadow, and simultaneously turning the intangible into tangible.
When Jack Clark cultivated to the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven, and the Combat Shadow and his body achieved a perfect fit, he would naturally be able to merge and break through to the Eight Layer Heaven.
The same applied to the Ninth Heavens: in the Eight Layer Heaven, the body would be remodeled, with the ‘Innate’ talents that were born, to construct domains and step into the Nine Layers.
So after reaching high-order, the specific concept of ‘Cultivation Methods’ was already obsolete, which is why there is no university for Martial Cultivation, since there is nothing left to teach.
And the so-called Top-tier Secret Manuals are just the paths that predecessors have written, for the later generations to follow.
Therefore, after reaching the high-order, talents become even more important, and those with ordinary qualifications might barely break through to the Early Sevenfold Sky with the help of Secret Books but will find the way forward extremely difficult.
Not to mention after becoming King-level Strong Ones.
In that realm, everyone is perfecting their own rules, valuing talent even more, or to put it differently, those with inadequate talent could not climb to be kings.
It’s just that the price of this new enlightenment function is a bit steep, costing 1000 points every time.
As for the option to save Attribute points and not use them, instead keeping them to strengthen the Soul Talent and see if it could improve enlightenment, Jack Clark actually held no hope for it.
Because as long as his soul was split into two, this problem would never be resolved.
Even if he were to enhance his Soul Talent to above top-tier in the future, Jack Clark felt it might only serve to strengthen the connection between the body and the Avatar or provide a stronger feedback.
With these thoughts in mind, Jack Clark’s voice echoed in his mind: “Burn 1000 Attribute points to initiate the epiphany state.”
Boom!
As 1000 Attribute points burned away, a mysterious power enveloped Jack Clark, his consciousness thundered, and his thinking became incredibly lucid and sensitive in an instant.
With a single thought, tens of thousands of ideas flashed by, and many issues that he couldn’t understand before became clear in an instant.
In the state of epiphany, not only was Jack Clark’s thinking frighteningly fast, but he also possessed a special sort of insight that connected one thing to another, with ramifications that extended tenfold—and this was the most important part.
The astonishing effectiveness left Jack Clark somewhat surprised.
Not wanting to waste time, the Combat Divine Body’s shadow emerged in Jack Clark’s mind, magnified rapidly, and transformed into tens of thousands of Rune Sequence Chains.
These Rune Sequence Chains then divided further, revealing the core structures of Strength, Defense, Swiftness, Thunder, and the Golden Flame Talent.
Jack Clark’s gaze first settled on Thunder.
Under the frightening speed of thought, following that flicker of inspiration in the depths of the mind, the core rune of Thunder evolved at a terrifying pace, becoming more complex and powerful.
The astonishing efficiency left Jack Clark somewhat in awe.
Of course, the extraordinary effect was related to Jack Clark’s early ‘mastery’ of the Annihilation True Thunder. It was more about decoding and reshaping the information of the already known and mastered power than about comprehension.
After all, enlightenment does not come from imagination.
For instance, if you witness a heavy rain falling, you cannot gain insight into the power of flames, nor can you comprehend the intent of the spear from practicing the sword.
Even for Jane Aiken, who naturally possessed the talent for comprehension, she needed to observe the Space Cracks to understand the Space-tearing Sword Intent that could rend everything.
While Jack Clark was immersed in the state of comprehension, the Heavenly Energy within a kilometer radius became turbulent, swarmed over, and formed an energy vortex above the roof, pouring down in reverse.
Boom!
Golden flame erupted from Jack Clark, cultivating at a startling speed, and streams of the Power of Heaven and Earth condensed and merged into the Rune Illusions in the Sea of Consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 582: 271 - Enlightenment Genius Jack Clark, Things Have Changed (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Chapter 271 – Enlightenment Genius Jack Clark, Things Have Changed (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
Such a commotion immediately attracted the attention of some people nearby.
Startled awake from her sleep, the woman with the surname Davis from next door exclaimed in astonishment, “Is this what a top-tier monster is like? Just the disturbances from cultivation are this exaggerated.”
In her perception, it was as if there was a black hole in Jack Clark’s house next door, crazily devouring Heavenly Energy at a speed far surpassing that of ordinary Seven Layer Heaven Cultivators by more than tenfold.
…
The next morning, Jack Clark, who had been cultivating all night, slowly opened his eyes.
In his eyes, blue thunder leaped, and golden flames burned, incinerating Heaven and Earth.
However, these visions quickly dissipated, and a trace of astonishment appeared in Jack’s eyes, “Such a terrifying pace of cultivation, no wonder Jane Aiken was so exaggerated after reaching Late Fourth Layer Heaven.”
Just in one night, he had completed the reconstruction of Annihilation True Thunder, Heaven Burning Golden Flame, and the Strength Talent runes. One more time and he would complete the sublimation of five top-tier talents.
Of course, this time it was only the core rune structure that changed, which wouldn’t bring about a qualitative change to the Combat Shadow.
Because at the moment of breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, the true martial arts phantom took shape in resonance with Heaven and Earth, and subsequent optimizations and modifications could no longer gain ‘Heaven and Earth’ recognition.
As for why Jack Clark was so insistent on sublimating the core runes, sparing no effort to spend 1000 Points Attribute for enlightenment, it was to prepare for the Eight Layer Heaven.
In the Eight Layer Heaven, the body is reshaped. These core runes are the seeds of talent. By that time, Jack will possess five kinds of strengths comparable to Innate Awakening all at once.
Combined with his strong physique, his strength will become extremely terrifying, such as using the Eighth Layer Boundary to suppress a Ninth Heaven top-level powerhouse.
In addition, with the enlightenment function, he now had a hundred percent assurance in his subsequent comprehension of the time aspect of the Space-Time Altar.
Due to his lack of understanding of Time Power, he had been saving his last chance to comprehend the Space-Time Altar, for a failure would result in heavy losses.
But now… a faint smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
At that moment, Glenn Clark’s voice came from downstairs, “Bro, come down for breakfast.”
“Coming.”
Jack Clark, who hadn’t slept all night, restrained his aura and went downstairs.
He then saw Glenn already sitting at the dining table waiting for him, with more than twenty large meat buns, several cups of soy milk, and more than ten fried dough sticks on the table.
Ever since Doris Clark got a promotion and raise, and there was no financial pressure, she and Glenn seldom made breakfast at home.
There was no helping it; Glenn’s appetite was too big. To truly satisfy him, Doris would be busy all morning, so recently they have mostly been buying breakfast outside.
“Bro, hurry up, I’m starving,” Glenn urged.
“If you’re hungry, then eat. You don’t need to wait for me,” said Jack Clark as he sat down at the dining table.
“Heh, how can I do that,” Glenn grabbed a large bun that would satisfy a normal person with just two bites, devouring one in just two bites.
“Mmm, delicious!”
Unable to articulate clearly, Glenn continued to polish off another large bun in two bites, then gulped down a cup of soy milk and directly stuffed a fried dough stick into his mouth.
A few chews of the fried dough stick and it was gone, followed by several more bites to finish off two more large meat buns.
Not only did the guy have a large appetite, but he also ate quickly. Jack hadn’t even had two buns yet, and Glenn had nearly finished the soy milk, fried dough sticks, and most of the meat buns on the table.
“Burp! I’m full,” Glenn belched contentedly.
Jack shook his head, “These ordinary foods are no longer enough for your daily consumption. I’ll arrange for someone to send you some high-energy Alien Beast Jerky.”
Glenn hadn’t begun cultivation and couldn’t independently absorb Heavenly Energy to maintain consumption and bodily growth, hence his enormous appetite in the past, let alone now that he had awakened.
“Heh heh!” Glenn chuckled, not feeling embarrassed at all.
At this moment, Glenn’s mobile phone on the table vibrated slightly, indicating a message had been received. When Glenn opened the voice message, a girl’s voice rang out.
“Glenn, May and I have already left the house. We’ll wait for you at the Three-way Intersection as usual. Hurry up.”
“Okay, I’ll head out right now,” Glenn quickly replied, then stood up and said, “Bro, I’m heading to school.”
“Go ahead.”
Ten minutes later, Jack Clark, dressed in a white T-shirt, black casual pants, and flat shoes, walked out of the courtyard.
He too was heading to school.
The road was bustling with traffic. There were old men walking dogs by the roadside, women shopping for groceries, students rushing to school, the calls of breakfast vendors, and shops gradually opening up.
Walking on the Pedestrian Walkway, Jack Clark felt a strong surge of the breath of life coming towards him.
Unique Beasts, the Evil God Sect, Purgatory Demon Race—it all suddenly seemed so distant.
A few decades after the great changes, the fact that society could remain so stable, ordinary people living and working in peace, and far removed from war and the invasion of Mutated Creatures, was something even Jack Clark had to admire.
Normally, in an era where High Martial skills emerged and creatures mutated, social order would either be post-apocalyptic or based on the law of the jungle.
The outside world should be fraught with danger, not the peace and stability that prevailed now.
Just as Jack was about to enter the school gate, a surprised voice came from behind, “Jack Clark, is that really you? When did you come back from the Alien Beast Battlefield?”
Jack turned around, revealing a smile, “I came back yesterday,” he said as he greeted Sawyer Levin, who was standing next to Teresa Wilson.
“Good morning, Levin, long time no see.”
Levin nodded, his tone somewhat constrained, “Long time no see, Jack Clark.”
While talking, the three of them walked into the school together, and Teresa curiously asked, “Jack, why are you back early? Don’t you usually return at the end of a semester?”
Jack casually replied, “I had to come out early because of something. I’ll be leaving again in a few days.”

chapters.title: Chapter 583: 271: Genius Enlightenment Jack Clark, Things Have Changed (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Chapter 271: Genius Enlightenment Jack Clark, Things Have Changed (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Speaking of which, Jack Clark changed the subject, “Both of your auras seem a bit unstable, you must have broken through the Triplex, right? Why haven’t you applied to go to the Alien Beast Battlefield?”
“We just had our breakthrough a few days ago and are planning to consolidate it.”
“Moreover, this semester is about to end, so Sawyer and I discussed it and decided to wait until the next semester starts to go with the other classmates.”
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s true, having more people is reassuring.”
Actually, this is the norm for Martial Arts School students.
After the second grade, most would have broken through the Second Layer Heaven, and a small portion with decent talent would break through to the Third Layer and even reach the late period, making them eligible to enter the Alien Beast Battlefield for experience.”
As for someone like Jack Clark who broke through the Third and Fourth Layer within one semester and entered the Alien Beast Battlefield ahead of time, he was an exception.
Curiosity got the better of Sawyer Levin, and he couldn’t help but ask, “Jack, what realm is your cultivation now? With your talent, you must have broken through the Fifth Layer Heaven by now.”
Upon hearing this, Teresa Wilson also turned her head curiously to look over.
In their minds, considering Jack Clark’s talent, three months should have been enough for him to break through from the early stages of Fourth Layer Heaven to the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark smiled slightly and nodded, “Yeah, I broke through to the Fifth Layer Heaven a while ago.”
As for when exactly he broke through and what his current exact realm was, he didn’t say because there was no need.
Even so, Teresa Wilson and Sawyer Levin showed admiration in their eyes.
“As expected, that’s amazing.”
“A Fifth Layer Heaven in first grade!”
In their minds, only a few of the most talented students in the third grade had reached the Fifth Layer Heaven, yet Jack Clark had already broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven before even finishing first grade.
The speed of such cultivation progress was terrifying.
Jack Clark smiled modestly, “It’s alright, mainly because there are many powerful Unique Beasts inside. The battles there have sharpened my skills and, coupled with the exchange for many high-order resources, my progress has been somewhat quicker.”
Teresa Wilson giggled, “Jack, you’re still so humble. Don’t worry, we all know you have monstrous talents and won’t feel discouraged by the huge gap.”
To this, Jack Clark simply smiled.
The two then curiously asked about some matters related to the Alien Beast Battlefield. Jack Clark casually mentioned some things they should be aware of when entering the mountain ranges.
“Jack Clark, you’re back!”
“Jack Clark, it really is you! When did you get back?”
As a celebrity at South Sky Martial Arts School, after walking into the school, many students warmly greeted him all along the way. These included humanities classmates from his own class as well as martial cultivation students from other classes.
Jack Clark responded with a smile to each one.
When they reached Building C, Sawyer Levin paused, “Jack, May and I are heading to the Advanced Cultivation Chamber to train, are you coming?”
Jack Clark shook his head, “I’m planning to go to the reading room.”
“Okay then, see you.”
“Goodbye.” Jack Clark smiled, waved to Sawyer Levin and Teresa Wilson, then turned and walked towards Building C, a hint of reflection in his eyes.
As his cultivation speed grew faster and he began to surpass others, the former classmates he was familiar with had gradually become strangers because they couldn’t keep up with his pace.
For instance, Sawyer Levin, who had been his equal at the First Layer Heaven, had now become almost improbably distant after some months.
While the other had been working hard for so long to just break through to the Triplex, Jack had already entered into the Seventh Layer High Order.
Because of the vast differences in all aspects, Sawyer Levin seemed somewhat constrained and unfamiliar when he spoke to Jack earlier.
However, watching Jack’s retreating figure, Teresa Wilson showed a look of puzzlement and turned to Sawyer, “Sawyer, don’t you feel that Jack looks somewhat familiar?”
“Familiar? Haven’t you known him for a while?” Sawyer was somewhat confused.
Teresa shook her head, “Not that, what I mean is he resembles someone. Look.”
As she spoke, Teresa Wilson took out her mobile phone, scrolled through it, and then flipped to an image of a cool young man in a black suit and white shirt, wearing sunglasses on his face.
“Don’t you think Jack and Darren Callum look somewhat alike?”
Sawyer Levin looked carefully then shook his head.
“They do look slightly similar, but Jack surely isn’t Darren Callum. See how Darren’s profile looks colder and more angular.”
“Besides that, their temperaments don’t match either. Although Jack is very strong, he remains as gentle and approachable as when we first met.”
“But you know how Darren is: cold, overbearing, and imperious. Their characters and temperaments are too different.”
Teresa nodded hesitantly, “It seems so.”
Reflecting on Jack’s warm and jade-like qualities as compared to the man in the video who ruthlessly bulldozed through everything with a tyrannical presence, Teresa became uncertain again.
After all, despite the similarities, there were both differences in appearance and temperament between them. It appeared she might have been overthinking it.
After all, although Darren Callum was only at the Sixth Layer Heaven in terms of realm, he had a terrifying combat strength and could even obliterate a Nine-headed Blood Python at the Eight Layer Early Phase, a true monstrous genius; whereas Jack surely wasn’t that strong.
After all, he had just broken through to the Fourth Layer Heaven three months prior.
Just as Teresa Wilson was letting go of her doubts, Jack Clark had already reached the thirty-third floor reading room in Building C.
There, a girl sat by the window, quietly reading a book of Taoist Scriptures in her hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 584: 272: God Machine Armament (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Chapter 272: God Machine Armament (Seeking Monthly Pass)
“`
Months had passed, and the previously bustling Reading Room had become much quieter, with only a few students reading.
Just as Jack Clark stepped out of the elevator, as if he had a premonition, the girl by the distant window lifted her head slightly, and a smile appeared in her drifting eyes upon seeing him.
Jack also couldn’t help but smile and sat down opposite her.
Today, Freya Louise wore a pink, patterned short-sleeved T-shirt and slim jeans, looking neat and tidy.
Her jet-black hair was still secured at the back of her head with a white butterfly knot, and the hanging white ribbon intertwined with her hair, giving off a refreshing and beautiful aura.
