Although they had not seen each other for over two months, there was no sense of estrangement between them. After sitting down, Jack curiously asked, “Freya, what have you been doing these two months since you’ve been back?”
The girl smiled, holding the scripture in her hand, “I’ve been reading books. Recently, I’ve read through all 36 volumes of the esteemed Taoist Scriptures and the Thirteen Taoist Scriptures.”
“Besides that, the Thirteen Buddhist Scriptures and the 72 volumes of Mahayana Buddhism, though much of the content was profound and not entirely clear, I’ve also gained quite a bit.”
“Impressive,” Jack Clark murmured in admiration.
Having lived with the battle intent of a Unique Beast in half his consciousness, the desire for slaughter and destruction in Jack’s heart had grown stronger, so he also thought about using these scriptures to cleanse his mind.
But unfortunately, he couldn’t get into them, or rather, he didn’t understand these profoundly mystical scriptures.
It wasn’t until he later went to the Alien Beast Battlefield that a night of battles under the Blood Moon, culminating in sweeping through the battlefield and condensing Battle Intent, allowed him to slay the extreme desires for slaughter and destruction in his heart.
In Jack’s understanding, the Prison Blood War Intent was actually the expression of his own intent of slaughter.
At this moment, Jack spoke with some confusion, “Strange, although I can’t sense your exact realm, Freya, you haven’t broken through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, have you?”
Freya’s cultivation method was always different from others, simply reading the Taoist and Buddhist scriptures could help her enter a serene state, where her cultivation speed was very fast under special conditions.
She initially displayed a talent similar to Jack’s, having reached Foundation Establishment within half a month.
However, as she practiced that special Cultivation Method and read every day, her cultivation speed began to surpass that of geniuses like Justin Welan, not inferior to Crystal Lewis and others.
When she left the Unique Beast Battlefield over two months ago, she was already at the late stage of the Third Layer Heaven, so she should have broken through to the Four Layer Heaven long ago.
Faced with Jack’s confusion, the girl blinked, “Not yet, I seem to have hit a bottleneck recently, and I’ve been stuck at the peak of the Triplex Heaven.”
“But I feel like I’m about to break through.” Just as she finished speaking, an uncontrollable powerful aura erupted from within her.
Boom!
The Heavenly Energy within hundreds of meters range suddenly surged around Freya, turning into an invisible raging wind that encircled her, causing Jack’s hair to flutter.
The sudden change drew the attention of many, and in C Building, numerous Martial Cultivation students instinctively looked up at the ceiling, their eyes filled with envy.
“Such a strong aura.”
“Someone is breaking through from the Third Layer, no, it should be the Fourth Layer; the aura of the Third Layer isn’t that powerful.”
“Which genius is breaking through?”
“Stop with the geniuses. Our First Grade geniuses have already broken through the Third Layer and entered the Alien Beast Battlefield. The person likely breaking through now should be Freya Louise from Class 3.”
“Class 3’s Freya Louise? Wasn’t it said that she couldn’t withstand the high-pressure environment of the Alien Beast Battlefield and came out after only a month?”
“You believe that?”
“Brother, you’re underestimating Freya too much. At the beginning of the year during the cleaning mission, she followed Jack, that freak, deep into the mountains every day, hunting many Mutated Beasts.”
“Moreover, the final Level 4 Task, the Dragon Armor Beast that has Dragon Bloodline, was slain by her spear—do you think she can’t withstand the high-pressure environment of the Alien Beast Battlefield?”
“So you’re saying her departure from the Alien Beast Battlefield was for some other reason?”
“Obviously,” was the reply.
As many students downstairs discussed enviously, up in the Reading Room, as the True Power began to undergo a Quality Change, the aura emanating from Freya became increasingly powerful.
Yet, compared to the heavy and oppressive sensation when Jack broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, Freya’s breakthrough felt light and ethereal, giving a clear and elusive impression.
She was right there in front of him, but Jack felt as if she stood outside of the world, immeasurably distant from him.
He had experienced this strange feeling once a few months ago and thought it was just an illusion, but now it seemed that it was likely the attribute of Freya’s Cultivation Method.
Huu huu!!
The raging wind continued, with the dense Heavenly Energy swirling around the girl, her aura rising rapidly until, in just a moment, she completed the Quality Change and entered the Fourth Layer.
But it didn’t stop there.
Freya’s aura kept climbing, drawing in more and more Heavenly Energy, which she absorbed rapidly as if she didn’t need to refine it at all.
Even Jack was somewhat stunned by the speed of this conversion, as if the Heavenly Energy was her True Strength all along.
Boom!
In Jack’s astonished gaze, Freya’s aura surged, propelling her into the mid-stage of the Fourth Layer Heaven, and only then did the surrounding Heavenly Energy slowly dissipate.
What followed was a wait of over half an hour.
Only after her True Strength had fully settled did the girl across from him slowly open her eyes, revealing bright pupils that had turned sky blue, like a cloudless sky.
Her aura was distant, tranquil, and carried an indifferent overlook of all beings, without a trace of emotion.
However, the girl quickly blinked, and the cold and emotionless sensation vanished, with liveliness and a smile appearing in her sky-blue eyes.
But Jack’s expression became somewhat solemn as he looked at her and slowly said, “Freya, have you been suppressing your realm all along?”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 585: 272: God Machine Armament (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Chapter 272: God Machine Armament (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
The girl nodded gently: “Mm.”
“Why?”
Freya Louise whispered, “Because I’m about to make my breakthrough and leave.”
Jack Clark paused: “…Back to Simon?”
“Right.” The girl nodded.
Well, he thought there might be some conspiracy, but it turned out she just didn’t want to go back to Simon so soon. As for why she had been suppressing her realm…
Before Jack could ponder further, the girl changed the subject: “Jack, do you remember I told you that once I break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, I can load real weapons?”
“I remember.”
When Jack was breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, the girl had said that her sniper cannon was only a weapon for use before the Fourth Layer Heaven. She had claimed that her power would leap forward after breaking through to the Fourth Layer.
At that time, shortcomings like insufficient Cultivation Methods power or ineffectiveness in close combat would no longer be a problem.
A sparkle danced in Freya’s eyes, a smile within them: “What do you think, Jack? Want to see the God Machine Armament my aunt prepared for me?”
…
In the Northern suburbs, Jack followed Freya Louise back to the vast research base.
The Identity Verification was as rigorous as ever; even Freya, who frequently visited, underwent iris, fingerprint, and mental fluctuation checks, and was only allowed entry after being confirmed as accurate.
However, while previously Jack’s registered identity was Second Lieutenant, this time the display on the computer in the guardroom showed ??? — three question marks.
Additionally, it noted “No authority to inquire” following the question marks.
The expression of the two guards immediately turned solemn. They didn’t stop him, as this denoted that the individual’s identity rank and confidentiality were very high, beyond their clearance level to know.
After Jack entered, the two guards sent the information to the research base’s central building.
The two swiftly passed through several research buildings and arrived at the central research tower that stood over a hundred meters tall; however, they saw hardly anyone inside.
As soon as they stepped into the tower, Jack felt a dozen ‘gazes’ and some invisible light sweep over him.
The security here was even more strict.
Standing at the entrance, Freya shouted: “Aunt, I’ve broken through to the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
A calm woman’s voice came from the side wall: “I’m in the 15th floor, Room 03. I’m working on research—come up first.”
As she spoke, the invisible surveillance disappeared.
Freya turned back to explain: “Let’s go. Those Death Line weapons have been deactivated. This is my aunt’s Core Research Institute; the defenses are extremely strict.”
“Without her approval, even high-level cultivators can’t go up, or they would be heavily injured or even killed by the Death Line weapons scattered across every corner and the outer walls.”
“Death Line weapons,” Jack said, somewhat surprised.
Cultivators in the Seventh Layer Heaven could move at speeds exceeding double the speed of sound and their protective radiance could not be penetrated by ordinary missiles, essentially making them immune to most heavy artillery.
And yet, this Death Line weapon posed a threat even to cultivators of the Seventh or Eighth Layer Heaven.
“It’s a weapon that uses rays containing Death energy. Its core is an Eye of Death, crystallized from a Level 9 Giant Beast, which possesses extremely high penetrating and dispersing abilities against Extraordinary energy.”
“Once penetrated by this ray, the protective True Strength of high-level cultivators fails, causing their flesh to rot and sustain injuries.”
Okay, a heavily modified technological weapon.
While conversing, the two took the elevator to the 15th floor.
This level is all laboratories, filled with various instruments and devices that Jack Clark couldn’t recognize. In the distance, a woman wearing a white lab coat stood in front of a piece of equipment.
At this moment, the energy device operated at full power, emitting countless fine purple light beams that struck a metal piece, radiating circles of halos.
Freya Louise and Jack Clark stood in the distance, not approaching to disturb the other party.
However, they didn’t wait long before the metal piece suddenly emitted a dazzling light, releasing intense and unstable energy fluctuations from within.
Boom! The explosion of the metal shook the equipment continuously, and the explosive impact was blocked by a layer of transparent glass.
Emma Louise, looking at the flickering data on the monitor, frowned slightly, “The limit for micro-engraved inscriptions within tear-gold is only one hundred and seventy-three layers?”
At this point, Freya Louise walked over and introduced with a smile, “Aunt, this is Jack Clark, whom I’ve told you about.”
Jack Clark said politely, “General Louise.”
Jack admired this woman who was quite legendary in Eastern Summer, lacking cultivation talent but had acquired a general’s rank through her outstanding military technology contributions.
Emma Louise gave Jack Clark a look, nodded at him, and in the calm tone characteristic of a researcher, said, “I’ve read your file, very impressive.”
“Adding to that, reaching Seventh Layer Heaven after nine months of Foundation Establishment cultivation, creating your own Secret Manual, and defeating an Avatar of the Blood God in the late period of Sixth Heavenly Stage from Eighth Layer Early Phase.”
“These achievements, even in the glorious era of several decades ago, would be considered awe-inspiring and unparalleled.”
Being praised so directly, even Jack Clark felt somewhat embarrassed and coughed, “General Louise is being too kind. My accomplishments are also thanks to the groundwork laid by predecessors.”
After the greeting, Emma Louise turned to Freya Louise and said calmly, “Since you have broken through to Fourth Layer, go and assimilate that set of armament.”
Under the guidance of Emma Louise, the three took the elevator down a hundred meters beneath the base. As the heavy metal doors opened, a humanoid mecha appeared before them.
The mecha was just over four meters tall, mainly white and gold with some blue embellishments, and had something akin to wing modules behind its shoulders, overall looking very exquisite and luxurious.
And on the rack behind the mecha, there hung several gigantic weapons and pieces of equipment.
For instance, there was a sniper cannon whose barrel was seven meters long, a six-meter-long silver battle sword, and several weapon modules resembling missile launchers and energy cannons filled with sci-fi elements.
But calling that piece of armament a mecha was a bit of a stretch. It was more like a slightly larger suit of battle armor—how could something less than ten meters tall be considered a mecha?
Shouldn’t a standard mecha be at least fifty meters tall, starting as large as a hundred meters with no upper limit?
While Freya Louise went to an adjacent room to change clothes, Emma Louise introduced the equipment with her usual calm, “This is a God Machine Armament I designed for Miss Flora, which can fully integrate with the pilot.”
“The primary materials are sourced from Mutant Beasts, with the internals composed of Rune Sequence Chain Functional Circuits, and at the core is an eternal power furnace capable of energy conversion.”
“This armament is actually a set of Transcendent Weapons integrated with high technology, divided into multiple modules, including firepower systems, cultivation aids, flight capabilities, and more.”
“Aside from the core humanoid chassis, it can be equipped with multiple complementary external weapon modules, enabling solo suppression or comprehensive firepower coverage.”
As Emma Louise was giving the introduction, the door to the changing room opened, and out walked a young woman in a silver pilot suit, looking striking and awe-inspiring.
Jack couldn’t help but be amazed.
There was no helping it; the girl in the pilot suit… looked very good.
Emma Louise said calmly, “Miss Flora, first activate the armament and complete the preliminary assimilation.”
“Okay,” the girl responded with anticipation as she moved behind the platinum mecha, leapt slightly to stand on the ‘wings,’ and placed her palm on the back of the mecha’s neck.
“Beep! Fingerprint verification passed.”
“Mental Fluctuation fits.”
“Biogenetic detection matches.”

chapters.title: Chapter 586: 273: The Primordial Plan, Power Beyond Myth (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Chapter 273: The Primordial Plan, Power Beyond Myth (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
“`
Crack!
The gorgeous mecha’s back slowly split open, revealing a cockpit just large enough for one person to sit. After Freya jumped down, the mecha closed up slowly.
Jack couldn’t see what was going on inside, but after roughly ten minutes,
Hum!
As if the face of the mecha was something cold and unearthly, its eyes lit up, and a powerful surge of energy waved from inside, prompting the massive figure to move with a boom.
Thump! Beneath the heavy footsteps of the mecha, the alloy ground trembled slightly.
Watching the mecha that was slowly getting into action, Emma stated calmly, “You have now completed the initial pirefining process. Next, you must familiarize yourself with the controls and fully pirefine the eternal power furnace.”
“I have programmed multiple forms into the core system of this mecha. However, as you are only a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator, your True Strength can only support the normal form.”
“Alright, go to the training field and familiarize yourselves with this God Machine Armament. I still have experiments to complete,” she said.
Emma was busy, so after speaking, she left, leaving behind Freya and Jack in the warehouse, getting used to the mecha’s controls.
After Freya was nearly capable of performing basic operations, Jack curiously walked over to her. “How is it, Freya? What does it feel like to operate a mecha?” he asked.
From inside the four-meter-tall gorgeous mecha, Freya’s voice came out somewhat excitedly, “It feels like I have an extra body; the nerve system link makes control smooth.”
“Is that so? Let me see.” As Jack said this, his hand landed on the thigh of the mecha, and the strength in his palm erupted.
Then the four-meter-tall, hundred-ton mecha was single-handedly lifted by Jack, who even swung it curiously a couple of times as if it were a large toy.
“Ah! Jack, slow down, slow down,” Freya said, a bit panicked as Jack lifted her up and swung her around in the air.
“Sorry, this is my first encounter with a mecha, purely curious,” Jack said with a smile, and gently set the ‘massive’ mecha back down.
“But this God Machine Armament is indeed impressive. It’s powerful.”
When he lifted the mecha, Jack was not only curious about its weight but also sensed the internal structure of the mecha; however, his Spiritual Will was blocked by a strong and tenacious force.
Inside the mecha, he vaguely sensed a ‘meridians’ network similar to a human’s and the power reactor in its chest suppressing a terrifying amount of energy.
At that moment, Freya said excitedly, “Jack, let’s go up and test the strength of this armament.”
Jack nodded indifferently.
With that, Freya picked up the 7-meter-long sniper cannon and shouldered the huge sword.
At the same time, the platinum mecha extended its arms, and mechanical arms from the wall extended out, snapping two small missile boxes and two science fiction-styled energy weapon modules onto it.
In the blink of an eye, Freya had completed the preliminary weapon equipment.
Then, the wall at the back of the warehouse slowly opened up, revealing a larger ‘elevator’ that transported the two and the mecha to the surface.
It was the same weapon testing field as before; the mecha, now holding a seven-meter-long sniper cannon with a diameter of twenty centimeters, slightly squatted to take a shooting stance.
Hum! A powerful energy gathered at the cannon’s barrel, and the sniper cannon’s runes flickered with light.
Boom!
With the trigger pulled, a blast and a flash of fire startled the mecha, and a half hillside over a thousand meters away instantly collapsed, blown apart by boiling firelight.
Looking at the collapsed hillside in the distance and the crater over ten meters in diameter amidst the smoke and dust, Jack was a bit surprised, “That shot is already comparable to a blow from a typical Sixth Layer Heaven cultivator.”
Such is the power of modern technological weapons. With the right weapon equipment, even an ordinary cultivator can possess destructive power akin to that of senior or even high-level cultivators.
However, it’s just the destructive force, and also this mecha is so expensive it can’t be equipped on a large scale.
Equipment typically used for ‘human wave’ tactics tends to be more ‘economical.’
At this moment, the mecha slightly turned its head to look at Jack while Freya’s voice came from inside. “This kind of target practice is pointless, Jack. How about we spar?”
Suddenly, Jack’s gaze turned curious, “Are you sure?”
Under Freya’s control, the mecha gave a definitive nod, oozing confidence, “Sure.”
“Okay then.”
Jack’s figure flickered, and he appeared hundreds of meters away in the field, and with a flick of his hand, he drew a 3.8-meter-long Eight Desolations Battle Halberd.
In an instant, a heavy and mighty aura emanated from him.
However, Jack only pulled out his weapon, not wearing battle armor, and looking at the distant Freya, his lips quirked upwards, “Come on, let’s see how strong you are now.”
“I’m super strong right now.”
Inside the cockpit, Freya, somewhat excited, commanded the mecha to draw the battle sword from its back. At the same time, the chest began emitting a dazzling blue radiance, with energy runes flickering all over the body.
Whoosh!
The mecha’s back wings spurted forth a searing light, and with the burst of air waves, it broke the sound barrier with a bang, stirring up a raging wind wave and a surge of smoke and dust.
At supersonic speed, the mecha swung the battle sword, slicing through the air like a silver refining streak and in an instant hovering above Jack’s head, its energy radiance extending the blade light over ten meters.
Boom! The earth shattered within tens of meters range, and countless rocks and dirt mixed with the shockwave swept over dozens of meters.
In the dust-filled crater, Jack stood with golden flame erupting from his body, holding the halberd with one arm across his body, firmly catching Freya’s supersonic sword strike.
Right at that moment, Jack’s arm muscles surged with power, sweeping his arm sideways.
Boom!
The four-meter-tall mecha was blasted off like a cannonball, sent flying a hundred meters before it landed, sliding another dozen meters and stopping after leaving two deep grooves in the ground.
Looking at the far off Jack holding the halberd, calm and collected, a look of amazement appeared in Freya’s eyes. This guy has gotten even stronger after his breakthrough into the Seventh Layer Heaven.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 587: 273: The Primordial Plan, Power Beyond Myth (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: Chapter 273: The Primordial Plan, Power Beyond Myth (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
However, she had long known about Jack Clark’s strength, so she was not surprised.
At that moment, the missile pods on the shoulders of the mecha opened, and over twenty missiles emitting blue radiance burst out, screeching piercingly as they enveloped Jack Clark from all directions.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
In the midst of violent explosions, Freya Louise unspread her wings behind her, rose up into the sky hundreds of meters high amid the powerful blast of energy, and pointed her battle sword downward.
Energy weapons unfolded on the dual arms atop the mecha’s shoulders: “Dual structure disengage…”
Whoosh! The smoke and dust below suddenly dispersed, and a golden halberd radiance twenty-some meters long pierced through heaven and earth, appearing instantly in front of the mecha like a laser beam.
Boom!
An explosion more powerful than the energy missiles erupted, dazzling golden light flashed in the sky, and the intense shock of the explosion slightly shook all the buildings in the base.
Many people subconsciously looked towards the Weapon Testing Ground, wondering what kind of weapon Emma Louise was testing that could have such tremendous power.
Thump!
The mecha, trailing some black smoke, fell from the sky and landed on one knee upon the Earth with a thud, causing the ground to shatter and dust to fill the air.
The mecha’s surface, amidst somewhat chaotic energy fluctuations, flickered with a faint layer of blue energy shield, which blocked the casual strike from Jack Clark controlling his power.
At this point, the energy on the surface of the mecha converged, its eyes went dark, and then the hatch on its back opened. Freya Louise, whose spirit appeared somewhat weak, jumped out and stood on the mecha’s shoulder.
Looking at Jack Clark in the distance, the girl waved her hand and shouted, “No more fighting.”
“Huh… That’s it, no more fighting?” Jack Clark paused, still wanting to see if this armed unit could take one more strike from his halberd.
Jack Clark flashed forward to appear before Freya Louise, looked up at the very ‘pretty’ girl on the mecha, and asked with some confusion, “Why is your exhaustion so great?”
Overall, when equipped with the God Machine Armament, Freya Louise’s close combat reached the late-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and with those high-power weapons, her destructive power reached the Sixth Layer Heaven.
But having piloted it for just a short while, Freya Louise had already exhausted almost sixty percent of her True Strength. The endurance was too weak.
And doesn’t the mecha have a power reactor?
Freya Louise shook her head: “It’s different. This suit of armor is not a pure mecha, and I haven’t fully tempered it yet, so I can’t mobilize the energy of the eternal power furnace.”
As she spoke, the girl jumped down from the mecha, and after landing, she placed the silver-blue bracelet she wore on her wrist against the mecha. Accompanied by spatial fluctuations, the mecha instantly disappeared.
The girl who stowed away the mecha turned her head, looked at Jack Clark and suddenly pursed her lips into a smile, “You must have quite a few questions right now.”
Jack Clark nodded: “A few.”
After being away from Eastern Summer for ten years, he suddenly transferred back to Mist River City from Simon in his senior year at school, and began cultivating a ‘special’ cultivation method that seemed not to have much ‘power’.
Moreover, with subsequent events, he was not foolish.
Ferya Louise whispered: “I actually came to South Sky Martial Height to cultivate this Primitive Secret Book, a translated version brought from the relics decades ago.”
“This cultivation method can bring my Spirit Will into a special realm called ‘Reflect Heart Upon Heaven,’ preparing to pilot the No.1 Mech.”
“No.1 Mech?” Jack Clark’s eyes showed inquiry.
“With your current Federation access, you would be able to find out about these soon, so telling you doesn’t count as a violation of the rules,” she said.
Ferya Louise whispered an explanation: “My father is a top-tier biological and mecha scientist in Simon, heading the Simon’s Primordial Project.”
“The Primordial Project is a super lifeform cultivated by humans using a heart from ancient relics, which is estimated to surpass even Mythical-level Life, called the No.1 Mech.”
“The No.1 Mech is massive in size, equipped with the most advanced human mecha armaments of today, and possesses terrifying combat strength, once having destroyed a Mythical Giant Beast with a head-on blow.”
“But this Biological Mecha has form without spirit, lacking autonomous consciousness and thought, akin to a vegetative state, so it requires a driver to activate it.”
“At the same time, as a lifeform, the No.1 Mech has a strong instinctual repulsion to life, and only those whose Soul Fluctuation matches it can pilot it.”
“Over the decades, only two people have qualified, and one of them is me.”
“Because the No.1 Mech itself is a lifeform, piloting it will result in heavy mental pollution, which is why I came here to practice this cultivation method.”
“Of course, this Cultivation Method isn’t the only option. If I hadn’t succeeded in my cultivation, there were several others to choose from.”
“Next, once I return to Simon and complete the driving training for the No. 1 Mech, I should enter the mythical world before you do,” she said.
The girl’s delicate little face revealed a proud expression as she spoke, like a girl showing off to a friend, “How about that? Aren’t I impressive?”
But watching the girl show off her ‘toy,’ Jack Clark frowned slightly, “It can’t be that simple, can it? Your cultivation is only at the Fourth Layer Heaven. Are you sure you can control a Mecha that’s comparable to a Mythical-level creature?”
With his current level of cultivation and his Level 9 Giant Beast Avatar – even having touched on powers that could be compared to the rules – he couldn’t believe it was that simple.
“Alright, I knew I couldn’t hide it from you,” the girl said playfully, sticking out her tongue.
“Indeed, piloting the Primordial Mecha carries high risks, including mental contamination and the possibility of the body being assimilated by the Primordial Mecha’s power.”
“More than ten years ago, the driver of the first generation No. 1 Mech was assimilated and vanished, which is one of the reasons I came here.”
“The God Machine Armament is the ‘defensive suit’ my aunt prepared for me; with the eternal power furnace at its core turning into energy form, it can withstand the assimilation by the No. 1 Mech.”
“Additionally, the Primitive Secrets I’ve been cultivating offer protection against spiritual contamination, reducing the dangers to a minimum.”
“And as my cultivation level increases, so does my spirit. Meanwhile, as ‘Extraordinary Equipment,’ the God Machine Armament will also grow stronger through Tempering.”
“My father and aunt calculated that there’s a high probability of refining the No. 1 Mech into something like an external avatar once I reach the Nine Layers Heaven.”
“If I can make the leap to king-level and enter into a twin soul resonance, I might even activate the heart power of that Primordial Creature and possess power beyond the Heavenly King’s limit,” she added.
I knew it wasn’t that simple. At the same time, Jack Clark felt a sense of awe inside.
He hadn’t expected Freya Louise to be so well-connected.
No wonder on the day the Evil God Sect invaded the Alien Beast Battlefield, Emma Louise had quickly entered the battlefield to take her away – her identity was too special.
A driver of a Mecha derived from the heart of a creature superior to Mythical Life itself and currently the only driver.
Moreover, she must have many life-saving items in her possession, like the secret treasure that enabled her to withstand the attacks of a Late Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy when she was only at the initial stage of the Third Layer Heaven.
However, as powerful as life-saving trump cards are, they’re not one hundred percent risk-free.
After all, the user is human – otherwise, she wouldn’t have been injured at that time.
The fact that she’s the driver of the No.1 Mech is likely unknown to most people at school; otherwise, they would not have let her go to the Koroya Trial, where she got hurt.
But still, something doesn’t add up, and Jack couldn’t help but feel puzzled, “Given the importance of your identity, didn’t your aunt try to stop you from going to Koroya? Wasn’t she afraid something might happen to you?”
Freya Louise nodded, “My aunt did oppose it initially, but I managed to convince her later.”
“What reason did you give?” Jack was curious.
The girl blinked, “A young girl’s secret.”
…Well, alright then.
“By the way, Jack, you’re free this afternoon, right?” the girl suddenly asked.
“I am.”
“You see, I’ll be heading back to Simon in a few days, and as a good friend, shouldn’t you take me around Mist River City so that I can create some beautiful memories of this place?” she finished, looking at him expectantly.
“No problem,” Jack naturally wouldn’t refuse her request.
Just as she said, she would be going back to Simon in a few days, and Jack would make time to accompany her, no matter what, as their relationship was… somewhat complicated.
However, Jack was well aware that today was the only day he could relax.
The ancient relics would be arriving in one week’s time.
During this period, he had many preparations to make, such as finishing the adjustments to the Eighth Layer of the Combat Divine Body and consolidating the Time-Space Summoning Altar.

chapters.title: Chapter 588: 274: Quasi-Mythical Descent, Past and Present
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: Chapter 274: Quasi-Mythical Descent, Past and Present
10,000 meters below the deep sea was pitch-black, where the pressure was extremely terrifying, reaching a ton per square centimeter.
But in such a high-pressure deep sea, there existed a one-kilometer diameter waterless zone.
There, a several hundred meters high red whirlpool slowly rotated, emitting strong spatial fluctuations, with an invisible realm of thought forming a powerful energy field around it.
Under the force connecting two worlds, the sea water roared fiercely, forming a vast vortex covering tens of kilometers, piercing through the sky and the earth, swirling endless sea water.
Boom!
On one side of the vortex, the sea water exploded, and a two-hundred-meter-long Black Python covered in black scales and exuding Mid Level 9 power surged out.
Surrounding the ferocious python, bands of black power roamed, crumbling the rocks below as it slowly approached the world passageways.
In front of the rotating red whirlpool stood an enormous piece of black scale armor, over ten meters tall and several meters thick, from an unknown creature.
The mere presence of the scale, planted in the rock, emitted such a terrifying aura that the Dark Python felt awe, submission, and instinctively lowered its ferocious head.
At that moment, a powerful spiritual will burst from the Dark Python and struck the scale.
“Roar! My king, the Mustache Mackerel you had me watch is dead.”
Boom! Instantly, the black scale vibrated; as a medium, a terrifying power pierced through the world passageways and descended.
Accompanying that superior power spreading across the heavens, the high altitude distorted, like a mirage of the sea market projecting an image from another place.
There, the Earth cracked, with hot magma burning between the cracks, resembling a tumbling sea of magma fire as if from Hell, and a huge, ferocious head emerged.
Atop the dragon-like Black Colossus’s head, three pairs of spiral horns pierced obliquely into the Firmament, with purple-red flames burning on them, distorting the Void with terrifying power.
The ferocious behemoth slightly lowered its head, its gaze penetrating the Void and falling on the Dark Python, as an overbearing and majestic will vibrated the Void, letting out a resonant roar.
“Dead! The Mustache Mackerel was not weak, and there was also that Blue Flood Dragon. Did they provoke the humans on land?”
The Dark Python respectfully growled, “King, it was not the humans on land, but a few other Extraordinary Giant Beasts.”
“A subordinate of the escapees that I interrogated said it seems that the Mustache Mackerel bore a grudge against that group of Extraordinary Giant Beasts, having chased and killed one of their members.”
“Upon learning of the Mustache Mackerel’s death, I dispatched a particularly reared subordinate, adept in speed underwater, to gather information.”
“According to my subordinate’s findings, this is a new Transcendent Giant Beast power that has been expanding its territory aggressively towards the east.”
“This nascent power’s creatures are extremely fierce, slaughtering every beast in sight, and each time they conquer new territory, they stage a bloody celebration.”
“Judging by their current rate of advance, I’m concerned that it won’t be long before this group of vicious creatures invades the territory around the passageway, affecting your arrangements, my king.”
Unlike those ‘wild’ beasts, this Dark Python’s language and information conveyance were very precise, resembling a ‘cultured’ intellectual.
Moreover, it didn’t possess the unbridled brutality common to other giant beasts but was calm, or rather, had the characteristic coldness of serpents.
After delivering its report, the Dark Python respectfully lowered its head and waited for the command of the fearsome giant beast.
Within the seething magma, the will of a mythical-level terrifying beast pierced through the Void, turning into a deep roar that echoed across the seabed.
“These Transcendent creatures managed to kill the Mustache Mackerel with quasi-mythical potential and that Blue Flood Dragon; their strength is commendable and worthy of becoming my subordinates.”
“Roar! Troy, take my ‘strength’ and go to subdue them. If these Transcendent creatures are unwilling to submit, then kill them all.”
After issuing the command, that will spanning worlds departed, and the high sky projection of the mirage slowly disappeared.
However, the Dark Python did not leave but quietly waited in front of the pathway.
Almost half an hour later, the rotating red vortex shook violently, and the aura of a quasi-mythical beast seeped through from the other side.
…
The weather in June had already become hot, and the street was filled with beauties wearing cool clothing, some of which were quite impressive.
But Jack Clark was not Damon Lopes. Generally, when encountering beautiful girls, he would just glance and move on without approaching to add them as friends or send red envelopes.
Old town.
Walking under the lush tree shade on the Pedestrian Walkway, Freya Louise displayed a sense of nostalgia and said softly, “I loved this street when I was a child, because it had many delicious and fun things.”
“Back when my aunt was still in high school, she would bring me here every vacation.”
Jack Clark was curious, “What made you go to Simon later on, was it because your father worked there?”
“Mhm.”
Freya nodded and then her eyes lit up as she caught sight of an old snack shop on the corner of the street, somewhat surprised, “That store is still there.”
“Jack, let’s go take a look,” said the girl cheerfully, trotting over happily.
Ten minutes later, the two emerged from the store carrying a bunch of snacks, the girl’s face bright with a smile, snacking and speaking with her mouth full, “How about it, lots of good stuff inside, right?”
Jack chuckled and nodded, “Indeed, it’s quite good.”
The store they had just visited specialized in old-fashioned snacks.
Of course, ‘old-fashioned’ referred to ten or twenty years ago, not several decades or centuries, as the owner wouldn’t have been able to source those even if he wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 589: 274 Quasi-Mythical Descent, Past and Present_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Chapter 274 Quasi-Mythical Descent, Past and Present_2
And this type of store generally sells nostalgia; business should be good most of the time.
“Jack Clark, I’m taking you to a good place.”
After wandering around in the old town, Freya Louise suddenly turned and led Jack Clark through the winding streets to the small hill behind.
This was the side of the boundary between the old town and the New City District. Standing at the peak, one could overlook the prosperity on the left and the old and worn on the right.
The girls had a hint of a smile in their eyes, proudly saying, “How about that, isn’t there a strong sense of impact between the old and new eras, like standing in the middle of history?”
Jack Clark exclaimed, “Indeed, I didn’t expect that just by changing the perspective, the view would look completely different, it’s quite shocking.”
Freya Louise said reflectively, “I stumbled upon this perfect spot last year. Whenever I stand here, I feel incredibly insignificant.”
“To Blue Star, which has existed for God knows how many billions of years, our human existence is like ephemeral plankton, perhaps one day to vanish entirely.”
Freya Louise suddenly asked, “Jack Clark, do you think humans will have a day when they disappear?”
“Why would you suddenly ask this question?”
Jack Clark looked at her curiously and then thought, “If you had asked this fifty years ago, I probably would have said that there might come such a day.”
“Back then, with human technology, it only would have taken an asteroid capable of destroying the surface of the earth to erase the entire civilization of humanity.”
“But now it’s different; we have mastered the path to bring great power into our own hands.”
“As long as we keep getting stronger, strong enough to destroy the world (the planet), travel across the stars, even if the world is destroyed, humans will still exist.”
“And my current cultivation goal is to one day become strong enough for eternal existence, to reign above time itself.”
When talking about eternal existence, Jack Clark’s tone was very calm, as if he truly could achieve it—full of confidence. In that moment, against the backdrop of prosperity and aging behind him, he gave Freya Louise a powerful sense of impact.
Freya Louise’s gaze twinkled, and she suddenly said, “Jack Clark, let me paint a picture for you.”
Uh… weren’t we just talking about life a moment ago? How did it suddenly turn to painting?
“Sure.” Although a bit baffled, Jack Clark nodded in agreement.
Then he watched as Freya Louise took out easels, paper, and brushes from another Sumeru Bracelet, setting them up along with a small stool to perch on, as she began to find the right angle.
“Jack Clark, move a little to the left.”
“Right, just slightly turn your back to me and look ahead…”
The painting session lasted for hours. Freya Louise had a pile of discarded paper at her feet, but she was still unable to capture that fleeting moment of shock.
As the sunset was about to dip below the horizon and Jack Clark, who had been standing pose for hours, couldn’t help but speak up, “…Freya Louise, I think maybe next time we could continue the painting?”
“Just wait a bit more; it’s almost finished.” Freya Louise’s hands moved slowly.
In her work, one half depicted time-worn, quasi-mythical relics, and the other half the bustling modern human city, with Jack Clark standing between them, hands folded behind him, giving the impression that he stood at the strange juncture of the present and the past.
Once the final details were done, Freya Louise let out a long breath, her face breaking into a smile: “Jack Clark, it’s done.”
“Finally finished.” Jack Clark breathed a sigh of relief; even for him, holding a pose for hours was a bit awkward.
However, he was somewhat surprised when he saw the painting. He had thought that, like the last time, it would be a realistic scene, but it was actually an abstract painting.
After she packed up the easel and brushes, Freya Louise winked at him but didn’t give him the painting. It seemed she planned to keep it for herself.
Well, if it’s not for him, it’s not for him. At that moment, Jack Clark glanced at the darkening sky and suddenly said, “Freya Louise, do you feel like having some grilled fish?”
“Grilled fish?”
“Yes, grilled fish, and this fish is a bit special.” Jack Clark said with a smile, and took out his mobile phone to send a message to Glenn Clark, asking him to bring his equipment to wait for him under the bridge at the edge of town.
The old town wasn’t far from the riverside; just a few miles downhill, about ten minutes’ walk at a strolling speed.
As they chatted on their way to the town’s edge, Glenn Clark was already waiting for them by the road with his motorcycle and the barbecue grill attached to it.
Seeing the delicate girl walking with Jack Clark, Glenn Clark was surprised: “Sister Freya Louise, you’re here too.”
Although Freya Louise had been back for more than two months, most of her time was either spent at school reading or at home and not wandering around Jack Clark’s place.
After all, Jack Clark wasn’t there.
“Long time no see, Tiger.” Freya Louise greeted with a smiling voice, only she was somewhat surprised to see the youth who had become twice as imposing as he was three months ago.
Jack Clark said smilingly, “Jim, make sure you bring out the twenty years of professional grilling skills you’ve developed today to properly honor your Sister Freya Louise.”
“Alright, watch me, bro!” Excitedly, Glenn Clark carried the grill and his fishing gear toward the riverside under the bridge.
As Glenn Clark ran down, Freya Louise couldn’t help but smirk: “Your ‘professional grilling for twenty years’ is a bit of an exaggeration, isn’t it? Tiger is clearly only fourteen.”
Jack Clark laughed: “Don’t let his age fool you, this fellow has gotten quite a talent for fishing and grilling over time, his grilling skill has reached a state of perfection.”
“Though I only smelled it yesterday, I felt the flavor was no worse than those professional grill masters.”
The girl’s eyes showed skepticism: “So you mean you haven’t actually tasted it?”
“Cough! There was a bit of an issue yesterday, so I didn’t get to eat, but today we can try it together.”

chapters.title: Chapter 590: 274 Quasi-Mythical Descent, Past and Present_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Chapter 274 Quasi-Mythical Descent, Past and Present_3
“I feel like you dragged me here just to be your guinea pig.”
“Delusion, definitely a delusion.”
Amidst the banter, the pair arrived at the riverside.
It was the same skilled fire-starting and grill-setting routine; after lighting the charcoal, Glenn took out a small piece of Alien Beast Meat, hooked it on, and flung it over twenty meters with a slight effort.
Attracted by the Alien Beast Meat, there was soon movement in the river.
“Here it comes.” Glenn, excited, gave a strong tug and in an instant, the river surface burst open, and a 1.5-meter-long big fish jumped out of the water, thrashing wildly and bending the fishing rod into a crescent shape.
But under the immense strength of Glenn’s arms, that big bass was still forcibly dragged to the riverside, splashing water everywhere.
Bang! A punch as big as a casserole pot came down, and in an instant, the head of the bass collapsed, its blood staining the riverside red, looking incredibly fierce and violent, leaving Freya at a loss for words.
Is this a fourteen-year-old junior high school student?
Under Freya’s watch, Glenn skillfully descaled and gutted the fish, cleaned it, made cross-cuts, brushed on some oil, applied barbecue seasoning, and then tied it to the barbecue grill.
“Tiger, let me grill it.” Freya expressed her interest at that moment.
“No need, Sister Freya Louise, I promised my brother I’d show off my skills.” Glenn refused.
After yesterday’s performance flopped because his brother’s breakthrough, today could not be another failure; otherwise, his long-researched method for making invincible super delicious barbecue would have been for nothing.
Only half an hour later…
“Brother, Sister Freya Louise, does it taste good?” Glenn looked at them expectantly.
“…It’s okay, not bad,” Freya hesitated before responding.
“Yeah, the taste is… tolerable.”
Jack slowly put down his chopsticks and then suddenly asked, “Jim, has anyone else tried this barbecue?”
Glenn chuckled and said, “Yes, May has, and she said it was delicious too, so I wanted to grill some for you guys to try.”
Jack nodded, “…I see, Jim, since you and she are good friends, let her eat more next time.”
“Yeah, okay, brother!” Glenn nodded enthusiastically.
Following that, Glenn looked at them curiously, “Brother, Sister Freya Louise, why aren’t you eating anymore?”
Jack said calmly, “Don’t worry about us, you go ahead and eat. We’ve already had dinner earlier, and we called you out mainly to have Freya try your grilled fish.”
Freya also smiled and nodded, “Yes, we’ve already had dinner.”
“Then I won’t hold back.” Glenn thought nothing of it and began to devour the whole grilled fish, savoring it earnestly as Jack and Freya Louis exchanged glances.
Actually, Glenn’s grilled fish was not hard to eat, but one couldn’t exactly call it delicious, either, because he had prepared too many spices. It smelled great while grilling, but it tasted somewhat odd.
This was also why Jack had a setback today.
As for why Glenn found the taste delightful, it must have something to do with personal preference. It’s like durian; some people can’t stand its smell, comparing it to feces, while others relish it, despite its exorbitant price.
However, before Glenn could finish eating, Freya received a call from Emma Louise.
On the roadside, Jack waved to her, “Remember to call me on the day you leave; I’ll come to see you off.”
“Okay.” The girl waved back at them and walked briskly in another direction. As for safety… she was a Fourth Layer Heaven expert.
The kind that could demolish a wall with a single punch.
As the girl’s figure disappeared around the corner, Jack looked back, “Jim, let’s head back as well.”
“Alright, brother.”
Soon, with the puttering sounds of a motorbike, the two brothers, one riding and the other running, also vanished into the night.
After spending a day relaxing with Freya Louise, it was time to get back to business.
Night!
Jack sat cross-legged on the bed, looking at the attribute page with over four thousand attribute points, his mind moved:
“Burn 1000 points to enter the enlightenment state.”
Boom!
As 1000 points of attribute disappeared, that same mystical force once again enveloped Jack. His entire consciousness thundered, and his train of thought became extremely clear and sharp.
At the same time, in Jack’s Sea of Consciousness, the Three-faced Six-armed fighting war rune phantom rapidly expanded, beginning today’s cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 591: 275 Surpassing Jack Clark, The Giant Beast Attacks (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: Chapter 275 Surpassing Jack Clark, The Giant Beast Attacks (Seeking Monthly Pass)
“`
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Deep within the Berlin Battlefield, dazzling thunderbolts fell from the sky, crashing crazily onto Damon Lopes’s body, with stray lightning that roared and shattered the surrounding rocks into powder.
Under the baptism of the heavenly thunder, Damon’s aura grew stronger, and the lightning swirling around him gradually formed a phantom over twenty meters tall behind him.
Boom! The moment that phantom solidified, the dark clouds above raged, and even more purple thunderbolts fell like a deluge, then were absorbed and devoured by the phantom.
Enveloped in the lightning from all around, the phantom, radiating blinding light, looked like a deity wielding thunderbolts, holy and majestic.
When his mission to protect Mathilda Ward ended, after more than a month of dedicated cultivation, Damon finally made a breakthrough from the mid period of Sixth-layer Heaven to the late period.
After returning to the Northern Battlefield, Damon had been in closed-door cultivation under the Thunder Cloud Storm, practicing the ‘Blank’ Secret Book.
Today, he finally took half a step into the Seventh Layer, successfully evolving the basic rune illusions of the Innate Thunderbolt.
Damon slowly opened his eyes, with lightning flickering in them, “It’s still not enough. After so much time, that freakish guy must have already broken through to Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“No, I need to keep cultivating hard,” he thought, and once again closed his eyes, continuing to practice by absorbing and swallowing the power of the heavenly thunder.
As a dignified Innate Awakened One, it was unforgivable to be surpassed in cultivation speed by a genius.
Now, with the opening of the ancient relics imminent, he had to step into the Seventh Layer before it began.
Because the True Martial Arts Phantom was a natural evolution of his Innate Thunderbolt and perfectly in tune with him, he didn’t need any adjustments or optimizations after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
By then, as long as he had enough Sky Element Stones, with a rate of refining one every three days, he was confident that he could break through to the Eighth Layer Heaven in three months.
As for Jack Clark, that guy had created his own Secret Manual, and after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, he still needed bit by bit reflections of himself, adjusting the rune structure of the True Martial Arts Phantom.
That would be his greatest opportunity to surpass him.
If he was lucky enough to obtain the Thunderbolt Law Fragments within the ancient relics, he might even break through to the Eighth Layer faster and leave that guy far behind.
By then, hmph, he would be the one showing off in front of that guy.
As for chatting with beauties, since the Berlin Battlefield had no network and could not communicate with the outside world, it served to help him kick this ‘hobby.’
…
“Jack, come down for breakfast.”
“Coming.”
In the room, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, showing a trace of relief.
After a night of ‘cultivation,’ he had finally completed the ‘upgrade’ of the core runes of his five top-level talents, but in the last moment, the Combat Shadow showed an unstable fluctuation.
The Five Top-level Talents were so powerful that even a single core talent rune, when stacked, would require a tremendous carrying capacity.
Fortunately, he used the Innate Space Runes as the body structure for the Combat Shadow; otherwise, this time might have been somewhat dangerous.
After eating breakfast, and once Doris Clark had gone to work and Glenn Clark to school, Jack sat down on the wooden corridor in the backyard, ready to continue his cultivation.
With the core runes upgrade completed, what followed was the cultivation of the ‘Eighth Layer’ of the Combat Divine Body.
Thinking of this, Jack focused his thoughts and once again consumed 1000 attribute points to enter the enlightenment state.
Simultaneously, the attribute points on the page became 2682.
This time, in addition to the Combat Shadow, his brain also manifested a virtual shadow of flesh, completely simulated from his body data by the Qi Blood.
Under normal circumstances, a Seven-Layer Heaven Cultivator would practice while slowly integrating and adjusting bit by bit.
But in the state of enlightenment, Jack’s brain was like a supercomputer pushed to its limits, capable of simulating the complete physical data within the Sea of Consciousness using tremendous computational power.
Bang! Right when the two shadows approached and almost merged, three rune sequence chains at the location of Jack’s right arm conflicted with the meridians and exploded violently.
Then in the blink of an eye, Jack’s brain came up with seventeen optimization schemes.
In the state of enlightenment, the qi blood-visualized shadow and the Combat Shadow repeatedly overlapped, collapsed, exploded, and then instantly reverted to normal and continued.
And with each collapse of the shadows, Jack’s spirit strength and a portion of Qi Blood were consumed.
However, his physical body was so robust and horrifying that it didn’t care about this Qi Blood consumption, driving the Cultivation Methods to progress rapidly with his robust constitution.
This session of ‘closed-door cultivation’ continued until the evening before it gradually concluded.
Jack opened his eyes, a trace of fatigue showing in them.
A full day and night of continuous closed-door cultivation with two entries into the state of enlightenment, even his strength was somewhat overstretched, needing a brief rest to recover.
This overwhelm wasn’t due to consumption of his cultivation, but spiritual will – after all, even a supercomputer overclocked for a long run would need to stop and cool down.
But the day’s efforts were substantially rewarding.
Jack estimated that after two more enlightenment sessions, he would be able to finish the extrapolation to the Eighth Layer of the Warrior God Body.
In other words, excluding the 2000 points for further sublimating the top-tier core talent runes, reaching the Eighth Layer of the Warrior God Body would only require 3000 points.
Calculating this, it was almost equivalent to directly strengthening the Eighth Layer Cultivation Methods, as strengthening the Seventh Layer had already consumed 2000 points.
After that, Jack only had to absorb the energy of the Sky Element Stones to solidify the True Martial Arts Phantom, and he could break through to the Eighth Layer Heaven, estimated to take about a month.
Of course, he could also make the breakthrough without using the Sky Element Stones, but simply absorbing the energy between heaven and earth would be much slower.
However, he only had just over 2000 points left, just enough to finish the extrapolation of the Combat Divine Body. There was still a slight shortfall for the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 592: 275: Surpassing Jack Clark, Giant Beast Attacks (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: Chapter 275: Surpassing Jack Clark, Giant Beast Attacks (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2
At that thought, Jack Clark felt that after reaching a high order, the consumption of Attribute points was immense, just a touch would cost thousands, not to mention the top-tier talent enhancement that he estimated would start at tens of thousands at least.
Although the consumption was substantial, his strength grew at a speed beyond everyone’s imagination.
Thinking about this, Jack, who was resting, moved his realm of thought and arrived beneath the deep sea.
In the pitch-black deep sea, a black-red ferocious giant beast stood 152 meters tall with golden flames leaping on its body, dispelling the darkness with its emitted light and heat.
Looking at the beasts in the distance, nestled and digesting, each exuding a powerful aura, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
After two days, these fellows had almost finished digesting their recent gains.
For example, the Silver Giant Dragon, having devoured the flesh of a Level 9 King-level Mustache Mackerel, along with the ‘private savings’ from its small storage space, had grown to 105 meters in size, reaching Late Level 8.
And stimulated by the King-level Flesh and Blood Factors, its bloodline had purified further, making its physique even more commanding and domineering.
Compared to the ‘privately fed’ Silver Giant Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s size had increased to 94 meters, still at Mid Level 8.
But having consumed the flesh of another Kingfish category beast, which is of the Level 9 King level, it gained significant growth and a substantial change in appearance.
Its entire body was armored with even thicker pitch-black scales, and rows of triangular dorsal fins extending to its tail from its back became sharper and more menacing.
Even the single horn on its head became thicker and sharper, filled with a sense of power, while its formidable jaws, when slightly opened, revealed a swirling vortex within.
This bloodline purification triggered an ‘evolution’ of its innate gravity vortex talent, finally starting to resemble the maw of a Kingfish capable of swallowing the sky and devouring the earth.
However, the bloodline of the Kingfish species within this family seemed rather active.
For instance, the Female Tiger Whale awakened talents like devouring and crushing, and the Little Tiger Whale Third Brother inherited these talents too.
Apart from the Silver Giant Dragon and Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the biggest gainers were the Blue Giant Crab, which had grown its third leg, and the Female Tiger Whale.
Under the nourishment and stimulus of the flesh and energy from a Late Stage 9 Giant Beast, both creatures, which were already at Late Level 7 or even near the peak, reached the brink of breaking through to Level 8.
On them, their bloodline aura was boiling, and with just a slight impetus from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, they could fall into hibernation.
The Female Tiger Whale, in particular, showed signs of Kingfish transformation after consuming the Mustache Mackerel flesh, and when it breaks through, if the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon intervenes to guide its bloodline, it could certainly break free from its shackles.
As for the Three-headed Small Tiger Whale, it also reached Level 7 Mid Stage with the help of the flesh from a Level 9 Giant Beast.
Among these creatures, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was most optimistic about the Silver Giant Dragon.
Being a Monarch-level creature, she had consumed the flesh of a Level 9 Monarch Mysterious Martial and a Level 9 King-level Mustache Mackerel and had once been stimulated by the might of a Fake Emperor Dragon from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, activating her bloodline.
When it later breaks through Level 9, if the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon induces another bloodline stimulation for her, she would almost certainly awaken a second Top-tier Talent.
By then, with two Top-tier Talents, the Silver Giant Dragon’s strength would leap forward, reaching the previous state of the Thunderflame Giant Beast.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was contemplating, the Silver Giant Dragon that it had been watching intently subconsciously covered its neck and showed wariness in her eyes as she roared lowly.
“Roar! Hegemon, the Great Sethia has no more delicacies.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon came back to his senses, with a trace of speechlessness in its golden vertical pupils—did it really look like a ‘bad uncle’ tricking little girls out of treats?
At this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon curiously roared, “But Sethia, is your Reverse Scale Space innate?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had always been envious of the Silver Giant Dragon’s storage space – it was so convenient, unlike itself, constantly making real leather bags.
Speaking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon slightly raised his head, letting out a proud growl, “Reverse Scale Space was crafted by myself, it’s really big, and can hold a lot of stuff.”
“Roar! Great Sethia, you’re amazing to be able to craft a Storage Space on your own.” Thunderflame Emperor Dragon praised.
In an instant, the tail of the Silver Giant Dragon perked up, just like a little girl receiving compliments, happily bellowing, “The Great Sethia has always been amazing.”
“Roar! Sethia, can you teach me how to craft a Storage Space, or let me study the structure of that Reverse Scale of yours?”
Having comprehended Innate Space Runes and being able to enter the epiphany state, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was confident that with some study, it too could create a Storage Space in a Reverse Scale.
But the moment the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished speaking, wariness appeared in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon, which took two steps back, “Roar! I can teach you, but the Reverse Scale, I cannot show you.”
Sethia knew that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had always been interested in its ‘little treasury’.
If the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon were to study the Reverse Scale and discover the many delicious things inside its little space, with its cleverness, it would surely find a way to trick them away.
Moreover, that was its Reverse Scale; Mother had said it wasn’t to be touched by other dragons casually.
“Roar! Don’t worry, I won’t touch your Reverse Scale,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled with a flicker in its gaze.
This guy sure seems to have plenty of good stuff in his pocket.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked towards the other Giant Beasts and issued a roar, “Roar! Next up, we follow the same pattern as last time, spread out with a distance of ten kilometers and sweep through, collecting Life Crystals.”
“Any creature that has reached the peak of its same level must be taken down.”
“As for the harvested resources, you all can divide them yourselves; this king only needs the flesh and blood of Extraordinary Beasts and Life Crystals.”
After being busy for two days on top of a big battle, it was finally time for the harvest. The other Giant Beasts were also spirited, each letting out excited roars.
Ying ying ying!! Kill all those guys, get crystals for Thunderflame.
Gurgle gurgle!! For the Great King, kill everything, rob everything, awesome, do it.
At this moment, all the Giant Beasts were filled with vigor, radiating a murderous intent; they were geared up to earn money…no, to collect crystals to give back to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
The Eight-headed Flood Dragon also let out excited, chaotic roars, “Roar roar roar!! For Abbott, kill everything, explode awesomely.”
However, just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and its subordinates were preparing to sweep through this sea area, a terrifying aura came from afar, causing Giant Beasts like the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish to show a look of alarm in their eyes.
The Silver Giant Dragon stood up abruptly, its Dragon Wings flared out in rage, powerful aura bursting forth as it roared, “Roar! Hegemon, it’s the power of Law; the opponent is a quasi-mythical level Giant Beast.”
Golden flames of intense heat engulfed the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon as thunder leaped about, letting out a deep bellow, “I know, when we engage, you all stay back a bit.”
“Kidora, you handle the regular Level 9 Giant Beast.”
“Roar roar roar!! Kidora, no, probl, em, explode that thing,” the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s eight heads wiggled, with all eight pairs of dragon eyes revealing strong confidence.
It had killed a Level 9 King-level Giant Beast, a mighty beast indeed.
Two waves of aura approached from a distance, one with a powerful yet somehow ‘diluted’ sense of Law, the other a concealed aura of Mid Level 9.
For the current Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, as long as it wasn’t a Mythical Giant Beast, even a peak Giant Beast that has touched Law Power wasn’t a concern, and it could retreat safely even if it couldn’t kill the opponent.
Under the watchful gaze of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and other beasts, a Dark Giant Python of more than two hundred meters in length emerged from the darkness in the distance, followed by an even more gigantic shadow.
It was nearly three hundred meters long, covered by Golden Scale Armor, resembling a Giant Dragon but lacking wings on its back, its body festooned with sharp bone spurs—a Sword Dragon Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 593: 276: Black Oblivion King, True Dragon King Scythia
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Chapter 276: Black Oblivion King, True Dragon King Scythia
As quasi-mythical beasts that have touched upon the rules, with the blessing of the rules, they can instantly unleash a destructive power that is more than ten times that of late stage Level 9.
However, the activation of the rule power consumes a great deal of the giant beasts’ innate talents, and they will quickly become weak after a short period of time, so they will not use it easily under normal conditions.
Just like the dual talent power fusion of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, there’s some limitation to the ‘quantity’.
But because their bodies have been tempered for a long time by the power of the rules, their bodies are stronger than those of late-stage Level 9 giant beasts.
Once their bodies are entirely recast by the power of the rules, with the help of the power of the origin—the power of ancient breath—they can step into the realm of mythical beasts in one stride.
By then, both their powerful bodies and the power of their talents will be blessed by the power of the rules, making them incredibly strong in every move.
This is also the reason why the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is not afraid of quasi-mythical giant beasts.
Its body is originally strong, and under the power of the three top-tier physical talents, it is no less than a quasi-mythical giant beast that has been tempered by the rules.
The transcendent power of the fusion of Annihilation True Thunder and Heaven Burning Golden Flame, or the physical power burst of the fusion of ‘Strength’ and ‘Swiftness’ is also no less than the blessing of the rules.
Since the ‘basic’ attributes of everyone have been leveled, the next battle will be a test of the strengths and weaknesses of the talents and the combat experience.
Beneath the deep sea, two giant beast forces were confronting each other at a distance of over two thousand meters. Various colored domain lights were shining and illuminating the seabed.
Under the gaze of that giant sword dragon beast, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and other giant beasts instinctively felt a hint of awe and fear due to the difference between a grown man and a small child.
That was the pressure from their bloodlines and levels.
In contrast, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, who also have king-level bloodlines, are somewhat better off, but they just felt an invisible mountain weighing down on them.
This is the might of a quasi-mythical giant beast. The mere invisible pressure emitted makes it difficult for these level eight giant beasts to bear.
But when the sword dragon giant beast looked at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the seriousness gradually appeared in its cold purple dragon eyes because it actually had a faint feeling of blood suppression.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was thinking whether it should launch a Thunderflame Core Explosion directly to take the initiative, the ferocious sword dragon suddenly let out a heavy growl.
“I am the Mythical King Beast, King of Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, King of Black Oblivion Kaltos Esmond… and under the command of Juron, Sword Dragon Tarr Christopher… Bates.”
With the sword dragon giant beast announcing a series of names, even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon paused, and the likes of Kidora, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, and other giant beasts looked confused.
What did that guy say? What do all those names strung together mean?
After the sword dragon giant beast solemnly finished reading all the names, it let out a ferocious roar: “Roar! Defeat the rising force of the Mustache Mackerel, and report your names to speak with me.”
Bang! The roar of the Level 9 Peak giant beast shook the ocean.
An explosive surge of Dragon Might instantly erupted from the surrounding seawater, forming a series of violent circular white tsunamis that swept across a range of more than a thousand meters.
At this moment, the sword dragon giant beast surrounded by endless white waves appeared mighty, and its cold dragon eyes looked at the distant Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, waiting for its response.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon just gave it a cold glance, then turned its head to look at the Silver Giant Dragon not far away.
The other side reported their names and also the name of the Giant Beast Empire, a solemn manner of diplomatic talks with them, it was naturally the responsibility of the Dragon Palace Dragon King.
They saw the elegant Silver Giant Dragon, with a length of over a hundred meters, proudly stepping forward, raising its head and roaring: “Roar! I am the king of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire, the Great Scythia Dianna… Gatalos.”
“Extraordinary beast named Tarr, tell the Great Sethia your purpose for seeking us out?”
After a roaring exchange, the Silver Giant Dragon noticed the surprised look in the eyes of the two giant beasts opposite, and a smug expression flashed in its eyes.
Heh heh!!
Did you think you were the only cultured dragon? Unfortunately, the Great Sethia is also cultured, with inheritance from the mighty Mythical King Beast Empire.
What the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t know was that the astonishment on the other side was because it was actually the ‘Dragon King’ of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Forces, then who was the giant beast surrounded by flames and lightning?
The sword dragon giant beast couldn’t help but let out a heavy roar, “Roar! You’re so weak, how could you possibly be the king of the Dragon Palace giant beasts? What is that creature that’s surrounded by flames?”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s head was slightly raised, and it roared arrogantly, “It is also the Thunderflame King of the Dragon Palace giant beasts, but the Great Scythia is the Big Dragon King.”
…What’s going on? One giant beast empire has two kings? The sword dragon giant beast Tarr was confused.
In the Endless World, a giant beast empire that has established a giant beast power has always had only one king, which is the strongest Mythical King Beast.
At least that is the case in the exotic power circles in the territories around them.
As for the situation where there are two mythical beasts in a single giant beast empire, that would be impossible. Mythical giant beasts, who wield the power of a ruler’s laws, would not allow a giant beast equal in rank to share their domain.
Even the rarer cases where a mythical beast has offspring, once it grows into a mythical-level beast, the offspring will be driven away.
Just as the Sword Dragon was puzzled, the Eight-headed Flood Dragon Kidora let out a confused and excited roar: “Roar, roar, roar!! And me, Kidora, the Nine-headed Dragon King!”
Chirp, chirp, chirp!! I am the King of Black and White.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale was unwilling to show weakness, flapping its fins and letting out an excited call.

chapters.title: Chapter 594: 276: The True Dragon King Sesidya, Black Oblivion King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Chapter 276: The True Dragon King Sesidya, Black Oblivion King_2
“`
The feeling of grandeur today is palpable. We face a quasi-mythical behemoth from the Mythical Giant Beast power, and Jerry Jones also holds the status of engaging in formal dialogue.
But the anger of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast erupted in an instant, “Roar! Are you playing games with me? Let the burning Extraordinary Giant Beast come to converse with the mighty Troy.”
Just forget about that nine-heads Extraordinary Creature at the early stage of Level 9.
What does this guy, with a bloodline level inferior to Mustache Mackerel and who is only at the Level 8 Mid Stage, count as? He’s even considered a king within this so-called Dragon Palace power. Are they kidding me?
It was only at this moment that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spoke up softly, with a deep and resonant voice, “Roar! Speak, what is it that you want? You, the Beast Empire Envoy called Troy.”
The Sword Dragon Giant Beast roared, “Mustache Mackerel is an Extraordinary Creature monitored by my king, and upon reaching the Late Stage 9, it will travel through the world passageways and join the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire.”
“As a creature with quasi-mythical potential, you managed to kill it despite being at the same level, proving your strength has been recognized by my king.”
“Now, the Extraordinary Creature named Thunder lacks two choices, submit to the Great King of Black Oblivion Kaltos or be annihilated by me completely.”
As he spoke of annihilation, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s eyes were filled with ruthless and cold-blooded ferocity.
Although the aura of the Black-red Colossal Beast is strong, the disparity in their levels is too vast.
The opponent is just an Extraordinary Giant Beast that has barely made a breakthrough to the early stages of Level 9, whereas it has already grasped the Power of Law, standing as a quasi-mythical creature at the pinnacle of giants.
Aside from the Black-red Colossal Beast that gave it a sense of danger, the other Extraordinary Creatures are not worth mentioning. Troy was confident that he could obliterate them within a few breaths.
Just as the Sword Dragon Giant Beast had finished speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an angry roar, “Roar! It is impossible for the Great Scythia to submit to anyone.”
Uh… I didn’t say you had to submit, did I? The Sword Dragon Giant Beast was a bit bewildered.
Boom!
Suddenly, dazzling golden flames erupted from the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. Thunder roared, and in an instant, it transformed into a Thunderflame Domain covering an area of eight hundred meters.
Two top-tier gifts of power forming a domain, coupled with the terrifying pressure of a Monarch-Level Life, caused the Earth to collapse and the sea water to rage instantly.
Particularly, the Monarch-Level pressure that was unreservedly unleashed left both the Sword Dragon Giant Beast and the Dark Giant Python in shock and horror.
“Roar! Lord Troy, its bloodline level, its bloodline level is purer and more powerful than that of a king,” the Dark Giant Python uttered a terrified bellow.
What does it mean to have a bloodline level higher than that of a Mythical Giant Beast? It signifies that the strength of the Black-red Colossal Beast will be immensely terrifying.
While an Extraordinary Giant Beast’s bloodline and level are not directly correlated, under normal conditions a low bloodline level equates to weakness, and every Giant Beast with a high bloodline level is quite powerful.
In that instant of power eruption, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon bellowed, “Scythia, Kidora, join forces to take down that Dark Giant Python. Leave the Sword Dragon to me.”
Roar!!
At the moment when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon erupted with power and roared, a cascade of sparkling golden light surrounded the distant Sword Dragon Giant Beast. Countless fine metal-like substances converged around it.
Then they spun fiercely.
Boom! When more than a million fine metal particles spun violently, creating a domain that covered eight hundred meters, everything in the surroundings was pulverized in an instant.
Including the sea water, which under the kinetic energy carried by the supersonic spinning of the fine metal and the sharp power flowing over it, exploded and was destroyed, forming an Area of Destruction nearly a kilometer in size.
This Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s talent for domain is quite special, combining both physical substance and elemental powers.
The moment the Sword Dragon Giant Beast deployed its domain, the Dark Giant Python, well aware of its terror, burst forth with Black Power, turning into a shadow to dodge to the side.
Boom!
A kilometer-radius around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon collapsed, with the seabed material melting into magma and being hurled away in a ring, while the terrifying recoil force made its form vanish in an instant.
Even with sea water acting as an impediment, the Agility Talent, once enhanced to top-tier, could still launch it twenty times its own body length in a second on the seabed.
Right, it’s twenty times the body length per second, not twenty times the speed.
That is to say, within a single second, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could instantly traverse a distance of three kilometers, nearly equivalent to nine times the speed of sound, already comparable to the movement speed of king-level creatures.
What is most crucial is the body size and weight of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. At such a terrifying burst of speed, the kinetic energy unleashed is ineffable, especially when fused with a hundredfold strength.
Boom!
Before it could react, the Dark Giant Python miles away saw its surrounding Dark Domain instantly collapse under the sheer force that almost shattered space.
Roar!
Concealed at the edge of the domain, the Dark Giant Python, lying in wait like a shadow on the seabed, let out a panic-stricken roar as endless dark forces erupted within.
Boom!
The black Dragon Claw, a fusion of two top-tier talents comparable to a Law Power strike, collided with the ground. Over a thousand meters collapsed, the cosmos inverted. Under the horrendous force of impact, the surface space fractured, compressed the sea water, and generated a black Destructive Shockwave.
From afar, a vast bubble emerged on the seabed, its insides dark and all-consuming while the shattered sea water outside formed white sea waves.
Such a terrifying strike merely took an instant to slay the Dark Giant Python at the Mid Level 9 Lord-level; its life force extinguished.
Because the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon moved so quickly, all of this happened in the blink of an eye, and even the Sword Dragon Giant Beast had no time to save the Dark Giant Python.
Most importantly, this ‘simple’ Giant Beast did not anticipate that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had been roaring to fight with it, actually had the Dark Giant Python as its target, catching it completely off guard.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 595: 276: The Black Oblivion King, True Dragon King Scythia_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: Chapter 276: The Black Oblivion King, True Dragon King Scythia_3
But in the instant the Sword Dragon Giant Beast froze, the other giant beasts that had already witnessed the scheming (cunning and treacherous) Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t hesitate.
“Roar roar roar!! Ghidorah, fuck yeah, kill.”
Roar roar roar!! Slaughter them.
In a roar, the Nine-headed Dragon Ghidorah burst with Power Explosion, directly displaying its six hundred meter true body in its domain, transforming into a massive three-headed Black Dragon and pouncing toward the Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
Although the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had said there was no need for them to act, as good brothers of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, how could they let it fight alone?
What of a quasi-mythical beast?
Ghidorah didn’t believe that, being a Level 9 Giant Beast and a Monarch-level creature itself, it couldn’t even distract the opponent for a moment.
As for the Single-horned Tiger Whale, accustomed to charging alongside the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it didn’t even think before its blood boiled, and it thrust forward, revealing its Black and White Domain.
Roar!
