The moment the three-headed Black Dragon leaped into action, a ferocious roar from the distant Sword Dragon Giant Beast was heard and the sea exploded in front of the three-headed dragon, revealing a golden Dragon Claw covering a hundred meters.
Boom!
Under the strike of that terrifying golden Dragon Claw, the six-hundred-meter long Black Dragon, which had extremely high defense against energy, instantly collapsed, and everything within a kilometer radius was blown up, the seabed shattered.
In the turbulent, murky seawater, the nine-headed Flood Dragon emerged covered in blood, with only five heads remaining. It crashed with a bang onto a mountain peak kilometers away, causing the mountain to split and the earth to shatter.
Just as the collapsing mountain peak was about to bury Ghidorah, the terrifying golden Dragon Claw appeared again, descending from the sky with a force that could destroy Heaven and Earth.
Under the formidable power contained in the golden Dragon Claw, the seawater exploded, forming successive rings of white shockwaves that spread out, the spectacle terrifying.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon intervened in an instant and killed the Dark Giant Python, and the Sword Dragon Giant Beast was also ready to blast and kill an opponent to vent its fury.
But just as the destructive Dragon Claw was about to land, Ghidorah, buried under countless fragments of rock, flashed with silver light and vanished in an instant.
Boom!
The thousand-meter-high mountain peak collapsed, the force of its fall almost compressing the water into a solid mass, making the seawater for dozens of kilometers around turbulent and murky.
Such is the power of quasi-mythical beasts: a single strike that topples mountains and instantly kills a Nine-headed Flood Dragon at the early stages of Level 9 Monarch-level beasts.
Faced with such terrifying strength, the Single-horned Tiger Whale that had just rushed out several hundred meters bulged its eyes, then its tail swung fiercely, and it turned its head and ran back.
Roar roar roar!! That creature is too terrifying, it can’t be defeated, let Thunderflame handle it.
Meanwhile, in front of the Silver Giant Dragon, space distorted and the heavily injured, bloodied Five-Headed Flood Dragon crashed onto the seabed with a bang, stirring up the murky sand and mud.
Looking at the weakened and heavily injured Ghidorah on the ground, the Silver Giant Dragon shook its head slightly. Challenging a quasi-mythical beast was simply a death wish.
As a Descendant of Mythical Beasts, it was all too aware of the strength of these beasts that had begun to touch the laws.
Roar!
Several kilometers away, in the heart of the dark devastation, a dazzling golden-blue light flashed by, instantly creating a hundred-meter-wide pitch-black pathway on the seabed.
Boom, boom!!
The eight-hundred-meter golden domain clashed with the Thunderflame Domain, like two colliding light spheres.
Golden flames burned the Void, blue-black Thunder decimated everything, and sharp golden Radiance emitted from finely fragmented metal rotating at speeds multiple times faster than sound. Their collision unleashed a series of Destructive Impacts that shook the ocean.
In the midst of the two domain powers colliding, a golden dragon tail covered in spiky barbs burst forth like lightning, appearing above the head of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Under the terrifying strength, space itself was sliced into fine cracks by the sharp force, forming a pitch-black pathway several hundred meters long.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swayed slightly to dodge the tail’s strike, and the moment a kilometer-long fissure was slashed into the shattered earth by the dragon tail, the black defense on its body erupted and burst through the domain.
Roar!
Watching as the black dragon claw appeared before its eyes, tearing through the domain amidst countless fine metal bombardments, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast let out a savage roar, claw meeting claw head-on.
Boom!
In an instant, the large and small dragon claws collided, unleashing an indescribable Power Explosion, the absolute collision of strength from the bodies of two quasi-mythical dragons.
Instantly the entire seabed trembled under the invisible impact, the seabed crumbling, countless rubble and sediment mixed with sea water being thrown into the air, shaking Heaven and Earth.
Yet, this strike did not best the other.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, half the size of its opponent, stood erect in the broken land, surrounded by swirling flames and thunder, its aura fierce and terrifying.
In contrast to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s composure, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast was enraged. How could the body of this black and red colossal beast be so strong! Kill, it must kill it.
In this moment, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s desire for savage destruction erupted, its massive mouth agape.
Boom! A golden beam-like Breath fired out, shattering the afterimage of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and landing in the distance, instantly raising a mushroom cloud from the seabed.
Thud! The scales on the Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s lower jaw shattered, pierced by the black and red sword tail that had suddenly appeared, the powerful force it carried causing its mouth to snap shut, its dragon head lifting proudly.
However, this strike had only managed to break a few scales on its lower jaw; the flesh of the quasi-mythical beast, tempered by the power of the laws, was too strong.
Boom!
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s side strike with its tail sword sent the Sword Dragon Giant Beast tilting upwards, a golden dragon claw descended from the sky, piercing through the void overhead.
Boom!
Fused with Agility Talent and strength, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon struck with a claw, bursting the nine-headed Flood Dragon’s claw that had heavily injured with one blow, then ferociously pounced towards the Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
Boom boom boom boom!!
An underwater battle erupted, the two giant beasts engaged in fierce close-quarters combat within their surrounding domains, each blow erupting with earth-shattering force, terrifyingly fast.
In just the blink of an eye, the seabed within a ten-plus mile radius was destroyed, sea water exploded, and the ripples of the ongoing fight forced the Silver Giant Dragon and the others to keep retreating further away.
Suddenly, in the midst of the battle, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon surged towards the sky, with the Sword Dragon Giant Beast letting out a savage roar as it closely pursued.
Above the sea surface, the raging wind howled, waves surged majestically, and torrential rain poured down.
Boom! The sea surface suddenly burst open, followed immediately by a golden blue Radiance shooting into the sky, and in the blink of an eye, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon appeared at an altitude of several thousand meters.
Boom!
Behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a pair of dragon wings clad in dazzling radiance, spanning over three hundred meters, unfurled, and instantly dark clouds surged, and hundreds of blue thunderbolts descended from the heavens.
Boom boom boom!!

chapters.title: Chapter 596: 277: The World-Ending Battle, The Descent of Myth (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Chapter 277: The World-Ending Battle, The Descent of Myth (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
At the moment when the two giant beasts burst out of the sea and engaged in a devastating battle in the storm, the Ocean Monitoring Control Center was filled with shrill alarms and red lights.
“Report, to the east of Berlin, 2,300 kilometers away from the coast in the deep sea typhoon, two Level 9 Peak energy fluctuations detected.”
“Report, based on the traces of movement and numerous energy explosions, the two giant beasts are engaged in an intense battle.”
“Level 9 Peak, quasi-mythical level!”
There was a sudden uproar in the intelligence center.
It’s inevitable because, even though the ocean is home to countless mutated creatures, only a few of them can ultimately reach Level 9, let alone the quasi-mythical behemoths residing at the Level 9 Peak.
These beings, just one step away from becoming a mythical creature, were extremely powerful and terrifying, making them a half-moving catastrophe.
The person in charge that day was a middle-aged brigadier general, who solemnly said, “Closely monitor the trajectory of those two giant beasts.”
It’s normal for a quasi-mythical behemoth to appear occasionally in the Outer Sea. The Federation generally does not interfere as long as there is no conflict with humans.
For example, after the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon went out to sea, it had been moving towards the Outer Sea, establishing the Dragon Palace power that was more than 4,000 kilometers away from the coast of Eastern Summer.
Moreover, the pursuit of 2,000 kilometers to kill giant beasts like Mustache Mackerel is on the other side of the Blue Star Ocean, close to the Berlin Empire and their power radiation area.
Suddenly, the detector operator shouted with a heavy tone.
“Report, the typhoon is deviating from the predicted track and is rapidly approaching the nearest Mordro Coast at a speed of over 600 kilometers per hour, estimated to make landfall in two hours.”
“The two energy fluctuations inside the typhoon are also moving, and the deviation is likely related to the quasi-mythical behemoths fighting inside.”
“Report, the typhoon’s movement track has changed again, heading towards the southeast coast of Tarudos Country, estimated to make landfall in an hour and a half…”
“No, the typhoon track is deviating again…”
Monitored by satellite, the vortex cloud layer under the atmosphere moved irregularly, sometimes leaning eastward and sometimes northward.
And this part of the sea was only a little over a thousand kilometers from the nearest land.
With the speed of those two Level 9 Peak Behemoths, they could land at any time, and the aftermath of the battle would cause devastating casualties.
“Alert General Agatha at the largest military base on the eastern coast of the Berlin Empire and General Maurice Yates at the Federation’s 16th Base.”
“Request them to go to the nearby sea to exert deterrence and expel the two quasi-mythical behemoths, not allowing them to approach the human coast within 300 kilometers.”
“At the same time, alert several coastal lines and towns closest to the typhoon to evacuate from the seaside and immediately prepare for the tsunami impact.”
The power of such behemoth’s full-strength attack is no less than nuclear weapons. Therefore, even if it is fighting in the sea, the resulting tsunami will affect a wide range.
At this time, a newly joined member of the Ocean Monitoring Control Center asked confusedly, “General Aaron, why don’t the residing King-level strong men kill those two giant beasts?”
The middle-aged brigadier general glanced at the new genius and said indifferently, “Each King-level strong man has important responsibilities and cannot be disturbed easily.”
“Moreover, most of the mutated creatures that have grown to the quasi-mythical level in the deep sea are backed by a mythical giant beast power.”
“Our human kings and the several mythical giant beasts occupying the passage in the deep sea have agreed on a treaty of sorts, with terms like not attacking each other and not influencing each other.”
“Although a few mythical giant beasts are not a big deal for the Human Race, they could be eliminated if we are willing to pay a certain price, but killing one would result in more mythical creatures.”
“And if we fail to kill it and let a mythical creature escape, it will be troublesome.”
“At that time, we may need to allocate King-level power for defense, or even deploy several kings to guard the deep sea, which would be a loss instead.”
“Of course, most importantly, the current human forces are not sufficient to support two-front combat.”
As that general explained the secrets to the newly arrived genius and some other staff, an aura of the Ninth Heaven Peak erupted in the largest military base along the coast of the Berlin Empire.
Boom!
A sonic boom echoed, and a figure soared into the sky with a white wave. In the blink of an eye, it appeared above the stratosphere at an altitude of 10,000 meters, flying at several times the supersonic speed towards the coast.
This was a silver-haired woman with silver scales on her face. A pair of dragon wings spread out behind her, tearing through the boundless clouds below and creating a pathway.
At the same time, thousands of kilometers away from another military base, another figure with a Nine Layers Peak aura penetrated the Heaven and Earth.
Surrounded by the middle-aged man in blue ice crystal armor, blue sword shadows whirl around, controlling the blue light towards the coast thousands of kilometers away.
Meanwhile, many beaches and tourist spots to which notifications were sent started buzzing with urgent alarms, and many people sunbathing and playing on the beach froze in confusion.
“Attention everyone, we have received information from higher-ups that a strong tidal wave caused by the typhoon will hit our coast in an hour. Please immediately move away from the beach.”
“Everyone, please evacuate the beach, as the tsunami is approaching.”
“Please gather your valuables, take your children and family members and evacuate.”
“Everyone, don’t panic; the tsunami is not fully formed yet, and there is still enough time to escape. Give priority to the elderly and children, and law enforcement officers maintain traffic order…”
“Mom!”
“Wah…”
Many beaches and tourist spots became chaotic, with people tumbling over one another. Towns near the coast started organizing evacuations, and fishing boats along the coast turned back to the docks.

chapters.title: Chapter 597: 277: The War that Destroys the World, The Arrival of Mythology (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Chapter 277: The War that Destroys the World, The Arrival of Mythology (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
This is the true portrayal of ordinary people in the Transcendent Era.
Just two level 9 Peak, or beasts with level 9 Peak strength battling a thousand to two kilometers away, the aftermath of their battles already puts people thousands of miles away on edge.
Boom boom boom!!
The storm roared above the dark and chaotic sea surface. Thunder boomed, and two terrifying giant beasts were crazily fighting in the sky.
Behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the sky, thunderbolt wings were shining. Each flap would cause hundreds of lightning bolts to fall from the sky, exploding on the sea surface and scattering electric sparks.
At the same time, behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, golden light erupted from feathered horns, like a supersonic jet spinning in the sky, trailing a long tail of gold and blue light.
However, this ‘fighter jet’ was too large, and the sonic boom caused by its several times supersonic speed flight trembled the heavens and the earth, echoing continuously.
Compared to the rapidly spinning Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the sky, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast seemed as immobile as a mountain, with strands of golden light swirling around it.
These strands of light were incredibly sharp, formed by countless tiny metals. Wherever they passed, even space tore with several small black cracks.
Simultaneously, from the mouth of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, laser-like breaths roared out continuously, piercing the heavens and earth, chasing the black-red beast surrounded by Thunderflame.
These energy breaths occasionally created hollows with a diameter of a hundred meters in the sky, and when they hit the sea surface, violent explosions occurred.
Roar!
Suddenly, the roar thundered, and the giant body of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast crashed down from the sky, smashed into the sea surface along with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which hit it. Instantly, sea waves hundreds of meters high shot up into the sky.
Under the swift strike of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a large piece of scale armor on the chest of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast shattered, revealing the pale gold flesh and blood underneath the several meters thick scale armor.
Boom! The robust golden dragon tail swept across, and the black light on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon trembled, just like a cannonball exploding out of the sea, being smacked away with one blow.
At this time, a massive golden dragon paw appeared in the sky, with the overbearing power to suppress and explode everything, it descended from the sky, heavily slamming onto the… sword tail of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
The golden dragon paw, formed by the power of talent, collapsed, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned into a blue-gold light beam, appearing under the dark clouds at an altitude of ten thousand meters, with wings spread wide, overlooking below.
Roar!
The nearly three-hundred-meter-long Sword Dragon Giant Beast stood tall above the ocean. Looking up at the sky, it roared at the black-red beast, causing soundwave explosions with its fierce momentum.
Whoosh whoosh!!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon snorted out hot breath, coldly looking at the roaring Sword Dragon Giant Beast below, with a trace of seriousness in his eyes.
This beast was indeed a giant dragon of the quasi-mythical level, very powerful.
It demonstrated the high-level capabilities of dragon-type creatures in battle, top-tier defense, in addition to the golden dragon claw of spatial attribute, and various capabilities of the tiny metal domain.
Especially the top-tier defense, even with the close-quarters attack of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it could only shatter scales and cause minor injuries each time.
And this level of injury, for a level 9 Peak Giant Beast, could quickly be recovered by using energy.
However, while the defense was also top-tier, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s defensive structure and power differed significantly from its opponent. The opponent’s defense mainly relied on ‘dragon scales’.
Nevertheless, up to now in the battle, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had not used the power of talent integration, as such a killing move needs to be used cautiously.
Otherwise, once the opponent is unscathed and dodges, exhausting too much power would put oneself at a disadvantage.
Not only the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, but the same goes for the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, which has grown to level 9 Peak through constant fighting and killing. This creature’s combat experience is very seasoned.
After all, unsophisticated giant beasts would have died early on their growth journey.
Roar!
Suddenly, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast roared violently below. A dazzling golden light shone on its body, and in an instant, a terrifying force exploded. The golden light converged in front of it.
Under the golden light, sea water hung upside down around the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, forming a sea curtain that continued to spread upward, creating a horrifying sight.
Feeling the destructive aura below, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon lit up with a similarly explosive thunder light. Nine dazzling thunder rings of various sizes formed in front of it, looking like a complex thunder pattern matrix.
Boom! The appearance of the thunder rings caused upheaval in the dark clouds in the sky, with threads of lightning stretching out by thousands and tens of thousands of meters, gathering endlessly towards the thunder rings.
Under this natural thunderbolt power, the nine thunder rings boomed and swelled suddenly, expanding from a diameter of more than two hundred meters to more than five hundred meters in the blink of an eye, emitting a terrifying aura.
Buzz!
Segments of the dorsal fin behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon lit up, and at the same time, its entire body emitted a dazzling golden firelight, with endless hot energy converging towards its mouth.
In an instant, a terrifying aura of destruction that caused all life to fear spread out, giving off a terrifying vibe.
On the sea surface twenty-odd kilometers away, a silver giant dragon was circling in the sky, letting out an exalted dragon chant: “Hegemon, kill it, it dared to make Great Sethia submit.”
All over its body were wounds. However, it was no longer bleeding; the Five-Headed Flood Dragon, having experienced the familiar nine thunder rings in the sky, was excitedly twisting and rolling on the sea surface.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott, awesome, kill it, kill.”
Whine whine whine!! Kidora, stop twisting, your splashing sea water is blocking us. Thunderflame is about to unleash a big move, kill that guy.
On the sea surface, where huge waves tens of meters high were surging, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Female Tiger Whale, and others were all shocked and excitedly watching the flashing light in the distant sky.
They had witnessed this move of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon before, piercing the heavens and earth, destroying an island spanning several kilometers and severely injuring the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 598: 277: The War that Destroys the World, The Arrival of Mythology (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Chapter 277: The War that Destroys the World, The Arrival of Mythology (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is now stronger, and this move is definitely more horrifying.
Just then, a golden radiance surged in front of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast below. In an instant, an infinite golden waterfall, composed of tiny fragments of metal, roared into the sky.
Under the terrifying enhancement of Law Power, these metal fragments completely ripped apart the surface space, forming a black passageway from bottom to top.
Boom!
The golden-blue breath exploded from the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the high altitude. It turned into a scorching destructive beam, with each passing through a thunder ring doubling in power.
When the golden-blue destructive breath pierced through the nine thunder rings, it had expanded to thirty meters in radius. The world darkened, only leaving the golden-blue radiance descending from the sky.
At this moment, the alternating phenomenon between day and night appeared again. Everything was annihilated under the golden-blue radiance, be it matter or surface space.
This moment, the power that both sides unleashed exceeded the category of Extraordinary Giant Beasts. Moreover, the speed of the golden waterfall and the golden-blue light beam attack had reached the extreme.
But to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Silver Giant Dragon, and other giant creatures in the distance, and Agatha, who rushed over from tens of kilometers away, it seemed as if time had halted at this moment.
Boom!
The Extreme Gold Crushing Waterfall and Thunderflame Breath collided in mid-air. In an instant, a nuclear explosion light equivalent to millions of kilotons burst open in the high sky, illuminating the whole world.
Following that was the destructive shockwave. The invisible impact swept across a range of tens of kilometers instantly, followed by a deep pit with a diameter of several kilometers appearing in the sea below.
The thick dark clouds at an altitude of ten thousand meters were also dispersed, forming a void in the dark clouds with a diameter of more than ten kilometers.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
The golden-blue light beam and the Extreme Gold Crushing Waterfall were continuously counteracting and exploding. The surrounding space shattered under the collision of Law Power, forming a violent destruction area filled with energy.
Above the altitude of ten thousand meters, the dorsal fin on the back of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shone to its limits, operating at full capacity for the first time, emanating a dazzling blue radiance.
The endless flame energy contained within his flesh and blood erupted, converging towards his mouth, fusing to form continuous bursts of Destructive Impact breath.
This was the first time the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fully mobilized its power to this extent. All its black-red scale armor turned dark red under the endless flames, radiating a terrifying high temperature.
Roar! Suddenly, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast issued a cry of surprise and anger below. Its aura weakened for a moment, causing the Extreme Gold Crushing Waterfall to collapse.
In an instant, the earth-shattering blue-gold light beam fell onto the sea, submerging the place where the Sword Dragon Giant Beast was.
Boom!
The earth shook and the sea exploded under the spots of dazzling light. A ring-shaped tsunami hundreds of meters high swept across heaven and earth, merging the endless sea water and surging in all directions.
“Not good!”
Boom!
The dark clouds were torn apart, and a figure surrounded by white light and icy cold airflow, stood fifty meters tall, and with spread wings descended amidst the sparkling white radiance.
Agatha was covered with silver dragon scales all over her body, but her body and facial features resembled a human’s. Silver hair, twenty or so meters long, danced wildly in the wind, and a pair of dragon horns emerged.
Sharpness emanated from the eighty-meter-long battleship sword in her hands. A sword light, two hundred meters long, descended from the sky and slashed onto the tsunami below.
Boom!
The silver sword light cut a deep crevice, over a thousand meters long, in the sea. At the same time, it split the tsunami rushing towards the coast, causing it to surge diagonally towards both sides.
Human Experts of the Grand Accomplishment of Genetic Martial Arts.
Above the altitude of ten thousand meters, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had stopped its breath, focused its gaze. The somewhat transparent thunderbolt wings behind it flapped as it was slightly weak.
The extreme Destructive Breath it unleashed earlier, although it defeated the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, also consumed ninety percent of the Annihilation True Thunder and Heaven Burning Golden Flame energy in its body.
Moreover, it only defeated it in ‘waves’. The moment the Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s Law Power dispersed, it used the sea surface to escape, avoiding the destructive breath’s frontal explosion.
Looking at the monster….no
Agatha’s gaze fell on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which was only about one hundred and fifty meters in length and its level aura was only at the early stage of Level 9. A touch of astonishment flashed in her eyes.
This giant beast is just in the early stage of Level 9? How is that possible!
Boom!
The raging sea surface below burst open, revealing the similarly weakened Sword Dragon Giant Beast. Much of its body scales were broken with broken spikes.
Roar! As it looked up at the black-red Colossal Beast in the sky, the seriously injured Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s eyes filled with brutal and ferocious killing intent.
You are not going to leave, then I will kill you today.
When it saw the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, which was defeated directly by it earlier, didn’t run away, a cold light flashed in the golden vertical pupils of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
However, just as the two giant beasts were about to break out into a big fight again, Agatha’s voice, filled with her spirit and will, echoed through the sky.
“Unique Beast, ahead is the human near sea. As per the forbidden area agreement, giant beasts exceeding Level 9 are forbidden within three hundred kilometers from the coast. Leave this sea area immediately.”
It’s just that the Sword Dragon Giant Beast already had blood in its eyes. With its ferocity thoroughly provoked, it glanced at Agatha and let out a ferocious roar: “Roar! Humans, don’t disturb our fight.”
Having said that, it looked up at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the sky, the look in its eyes revealing a cruel color: “Dragon Palace Thunderflame, your strength is indeed very strong. But today, you must die. No beast can disobey my order.”
Roar!
In a low roar, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast spit out a black scale that was over ten meters long and four meters thick, and suddenly a terrifying aura spread out.
Agatha’s face changed slightly: “A Law Scale of a mythical giant beast.”
Boom!
As the Sword Dragon Giant Beast activated its spiritual will, a supreme Law Power that surpassed all living beings burst from inside the black scale, forming a terrifying giant shadow of a black beast in the air.
Meanwhile, a terrifying will descended upon them as if the black scale was the coordinates, piercing through the void.
“Roar! Hegemon, be careful, that’s a scale that carries the Law Power of a mythical giant beast.”
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon saw the opponent still had a trump card and prepared to evade, the Silver Giant Dragon flew over swiftly from the sky, roaring as it came: “Roar! The Power of the Giant Beasts of Myth, Great Sethia also has it.”
They saw that a huge Green-White Dragon Scale popped up from underneath the reverse scale of the Silver Giant Dragon’s neck.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 599: 278: One-Year-Old Monarch, Catastrophe Giant Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Chapter 278: One-Year-Old Monarch, Catastrophe Giant Beast
As the two Law Scales of the Mythical Giant Beasts were activated, the sea area shook instantly.
Above the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, centered around the black scale, endless black and purple flames erupted, forming a colossal beast over a thousand meters long and as massive as the mountains.
This Black Colossus bore some features of Western dragons, but was even more ferocious and powerful than the Giant Dragons, with its entire body covered in thick scale armor, bristling with sharp horns.
The moment this terrifying creature with its purple flames appeared, its invisible aura made the raging sea roar even louder, but what surged were no longer sea waters, but flames.
The sea ablaze with purple flames, as if the whole world had turned into a fiery hell.
Of course, it was not merely a Law Power that could be so terrifying; these burning purple flames were but the projection of the Law Power of that Mythical Giant Beast.
At the same time, with the roar of the distant Silver Giant Dragon, as the Reverse Scale under its neck shimmered, a Green-White Dragon Scale, about twenty-plus meters in diameter and two yards thick, appeared.
Roar! A majestic Dragon Roar that shook the Void echoed through it.
Centered around the Green-White Dragon Scale, endless blue and white powers were released, forming a massive Blue-White Giant Dragon made of blizzards and raging winds.
Its huge wings like raging winds covered the sky and the sun, its terrible oppression even more fearsome than that of the Black Colossus.
No sooner had the shadow of this blue-white stormy Giant Dragon appeared than streaks of blue tornadoes coalesced in between heaven and earth, while countless ice crystal snowflakes fell over the sea.
Above the sea, purple flames burned fiercely, the Black Mythical Giant Beast stood firm, and ice and snow howled in the sky, with blue hurricanes that pierced the heavens twirling around the Blue-White Giant Dragon.
Such terrifying might shook all the Giant Beasts, especially those like the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish tens of kilometers away, each gaping in awe.
Agatha, standing beneath the dark clouds tens of kilometers away, also had a solemn expression, never expecting that what was meant to be a mere show of force against two battling Level 9 Giant Beasts would turn into the descent of Mythical Giant Beasts’ projections.
At an altitude of ten thousand meters above, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon too was somewhat shocked as he gazed down, for it was also the first time he had witnessed the might of a Mythical Giant Beast.
Compared to the domains of Level 9 Giant Beasts, the powers of Mythical Giant Beasts had already “spread” throughout the world, starting to influence the surrounding environment.
It’s no wonder Mythical Giant Beasts were called mobile catastrophes.
“Roar! Mom, kill that guy, it actually dares to demand the Great Scythia to submit to it,” roared the excited Silver Giant Dragon circling near the terrifying Blue-White Giant Dragon’s head, “Roar! The Great Scythia is invincible, friggin’ awesome, badass.”
Down below the sea surface, only a head visible, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast looked up at the sky in shock, at the shadow appearing more formidable than a king.
It had not anticipated that the Silver Giant Dragon it had dismissed would also possess a Mythical Creature’s Scale of Laws.
And from its roar, it seemed to be the descendant of that fearsome Mythical Monarch Beast’s bloodline, no wonder it could be the Dragon King of something called the Dragon Palace.
But I never said that you should submit, did I?
Without communication or dialogue, the Blue-White Giant Dragon merely looked down from above, opening its mouth toward the Black Oblivion King, engulfed in endless purple flames.
Huff!
A breath mixed with blue and fine ice crystals exploded, turning into a devastating cold stream that blasted forth, freezing and shattering everything into a black waterfall bisecting the world.
The Silver Giant Dragon had used this move several times before, but its power had now increased innumerable fold.
Confronted with this strike, the Black Colossus that had its will descended and aimed to kill the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that refused to submit, let out an oppressive roar as endless purple flames erupted within.
Boom!
Purple flames formed a Flame World, and a massive black dragon head emerged slowly, lunging toward the black waterfall pouring down from above, biting fiercely.
Bang!
With a sound like shattering glass, the space fractured, as the black dragon head tore out a vast Black Hole, erasing all matter and energy.
Yet almost immediately, the dragon head from another Void was submerged by the infinite destructive cold stream.
Under extreme destruction, the black and purple dragon head was instantly frozen, disintegrating, followed by the collapse of the shadow of the Black Colossus behind it, its scales shattering.
Crackle Crackle!
Having destroyed the Giant Beast’s shadow, the destructive cold stream continued unabated onto the sea, instantly freezing over ten kilometers of the surface, breaking it into countless small pieces of ice debris.
Around these shattered ice pieces, the sea water solidified, forming a massive Ice Crystal Island, showing no signs of melting.
After destroying the projection of the Black Colossus, the shadow of the Blue-White Giant Dragon gradually faded away too, as such Scales of Laws only possessed the power for one strike.
However, in the moment of its dispersal, a glint of Divine Light flashed through the eyes of this seemingly mindless Giant Dragon.
In another world, the Earth sprawled endlessly with mountains undulating, and on it Giant Beasts hundreds of meters high roamed.
Atop a mountain range encased in ice for miles, a Blue-White Giant Dragon stretching three thousand meters, almost like a small mountain range, slowly opened its eyes, confused.
“That one staying with Scythia, whose bloodline has reached Monarch level, its Life Mark Wheel seems to have only one mark, one year old?”
Confused, the Blue-White Giant Dragon slowly closed its eyes, drifting back into hibernation.
With each breath, endless cold streams poured forth, freezing everything, and its invisible aura spread out, enveloping this world with a raging wind and blizzard.
…
From the appearance to the disappearance of the projections of the two Mythical Giant Beasts, it was but a few breaths.
As the Green-White scale disintegrated, the tornadoes that formed crumbled, the ice and snow vanished, leaving behind only the shattered Ice Crystal Island, frozen over ten kilometers of the sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 278: The One-Year-Old Monarch, Catastrophe Giant Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Chapter 278: The One-Year-Old Monarch, Catastrophe Giant Beast_2
Beneath the sea surface, only the dragon head of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast emerged as it deeply eyed the black-red colossal beast in the sky before disappearing beneath the waves, its aura swiftly receding.
Watching the Sword Dragon Giant Beast vanish, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not attempt to stop it.
Its current strength was only enough to suppress and defeat the opponent, but to kill a quasi-mythical beast, it still lacked something, at least until it reached the mid-stage of Level 9.
After reaching Level 9, the growth span of a giant beast would become increasingly significant, each small increase in level enhancing its natural talent power and physical strength dramatically.
That was also the reason why a Level 9 Early Stage Nine-headed Flood Dragon at the same monarch level would be nearly killed by a couple of slaps from the Sword Dragon Giant Beast—the gap was too vast.
This was also why the Mid Level 9 Mysterious Martial and the Late Stage 9 Flood Dragon behemoth didn’t flee immediately and chose to fight when facing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Because they couldn’t imagine that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, at the peak of the eighth level and just breaking through to the early stage of Level 9, could pose a lethal threat to them.
“Roar! This time it’s Sethia’s turn to rock their world.”
In high altitude, the Silver Giant Dragon flew in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, spiraling excitedly and roaring, “Roar! Hegemon, isn’t Great Sethia amazing?”
Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon, who appeared like an excited little girl, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared in approval, “Amazing, I didn’t expect you, Sethia, to have this trick up your sleeve.”
Receiving praise from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon spun and danced in the air, letting out a proud roar, “Roar! Great Sethia is invincible, Sethia will dominate the world.”
But just as the Silver Giant Dragon had flown a circle, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly growled low, “Sethia, do you still have those kinds of Dragon Scales?”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon’s figure halted, a look of wariness in its eyes as it covered its neck with double claws and shook its head roaring, “Roar! No, there are hardly any left.”
Then, as if afraid that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wouldn’t believe it, the Silver Giant Beast explained with a low growl, “These dragon scales are forged by the Law Power of Mythical Giant Beasts and infused with the Law Power itself, consuming a great deal.”
“When the Great Sethia secretly left, worried about the dangers outside, Sethia could only find one in mother’s palace.”
“However, on the way out of the Ice Palace on the ice mountain, Sethia found some more, likely disposed of carelessly by mother after her crafting.”
“Roar roar!! Great Sethia has always been lucky; every time I snuck out to play, I would find lots of good stuff to eat on the road.”
Er… Watching Sethia, who was happily smug, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was speechless.
If such Law Scales are so precious, do you think it’s possible that you would find some on the road?
And those Heaven and Earth Treasures you picked up along the way were probably intentionally dropped by your mother, weren’t they?
Nevertheless, this fellow’s mother truly is powerful; the Black Oblivion King, also a Mythical-level beast, was directly crushed and destroyed, without any chance to resist.
Actually, when the Sword Dragon Giant Beast brought out that scale earlier on, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was ready to burst with speed and dash away.
The strength of a Mythical-level beast is too strong; it might have withstood a hit from the opponent in its heyday, but weakened from the great battle with the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, there was no need to take the risk.
“Roar! Sethia, let’s go.” With a low growl, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spread its Thunderbolt Wings behind it, inducing thunder and blasting off surrounded by a sky full of lightning.
“Roar! Wait for Great Sethia.”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s wings vibrated, turning into a blue radiance surrounded by the raging wind as it chased after him.
Soon, both beasts appeared twenty-some kilometers away where the sea surface single-horned tiger turtle explosively leaped a hundred meters out of the water and then crashed back down violently.
Roar roar roar!! Sethia, you’re too awesome, too badass, actually summoning such a formidable projection of a Mythical Giant Beast.
The single-horned tiger turtle excitedly slapped its fins in the sea.
Other giant beasts did something similar, with the Three-headed Small Tiger Whale jumping in the sea next to the single-horned tiger turtle, causing waves to splash about as if the sea was sizzling with fish.
The Blue Giant Crab was so excited that its eyes turned bloodshot. Its six legs sprawled weakly on the sea surface as it waved its double claws, excitedly blowing bubbles.
Gurgle gurgle! Lord Scythia, so fierce, so strong, your awesomeness has made all six of my legs go weak, it’s simply awesome beyond everything.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s summoned stormy snow dragon’s figure, with its sky-darkening size and terrifying oppressiveness, left these creatures utterly shocked.
“Roar! The Great Scythia has always been so powerful,” the silver giant dragon said proudly, lifting its head high, its tail wagging happily.
However, compared to these creatures, the Female Tiger Whale remained much calmer, gently watching over the excited excitable Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and Little Tiger Whale.
As for the Five-Headed Flood Dragon, this creature was already heavily injured and dying. Earlier it had excitedly thrashed and twisted on the sea surface, but now was listlessly floating there.
The five fierce and ferocious dragon heads drooped listlessly, blowing bubbles.
Once the Silver Giant Dragon had enjoyed the adulation enough, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly spoke up with a deep and low growl, “Kidora is badly injured, you don’t need to participate in the following missions.”
“Let’s go!”
With a low growl, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon smashed into the ocean with a bang, splashing sea water high into the air, followed closely by the Silver Giant Dragon.
As the two giant beasts plunged into the sea, soon the figures of numerous giant beasts, tens to hundreds of meters long, vanished from the sea surface, leaving only the howling winds and torrential rain.
Today’s business is not over yet.
Mythical Giant Beasts are very powerful.
But once it grows to the Level 9 Peak and strengthens more than two talents to tops over top-tier, it’ll show the Black Oblivion King what strength really is.
Also, with the Scales of Laws from Scythia’s hand, it would be somewhat easier to deal with those Mythical Giant Beast powers in the future.
As long as it’s not facing the True Bodies of those Mythical Giant Beasts, it can fight whenever it wants, and retreat whenever it chooses.
Under the dark clouds, Agatha watched the group of vanishing giant beasts with a solemn gaze, “Such strong Mutated Creatures, a Level 9 Early Stage actually suppressing a quasi-mythical level.”
With a deep look in the direction where the group of giant beasts disappeared, Agatha spread her wings and shot through the dark clouds toward the Berlin Coast with a roar.
The news of the Black-red Colossal Beast had to be taken back to the Intelligence Department for close monitoring; it was far too terrifying.
And as that battle ended, the sea water near several coasts suddenly receded, quickly followed by towering tsunamis over tens of meters high, roaring towards the shore.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Fishing boats and cruise ships were flipped over near the coast, trees snapped, some coastal buildings and seaside villas were submerged, and the rough waves, covering the skies, swallowed everything.
Fortunately, due to early evacuation, there were no casualties, except for a few who, fearless of death, wanted to watch the tsunamis or take pictures.
“It’s that giant beast code-named Thunderflame.”
“So powerful, it has already broken through to Level 9 in just one month, and it can even defeat quasi-mythical beasts.”
“That Silver Giant Dragon truly must be a descendant of Mythical Beasts. The power contained within the Scales of Laws it brought out is terrifying; its true body must be at least a Title Mythical Giant Beast.”
When Agatha uploaded the details of that battle and information about the giant beasts’ appearances and powers, the Ocean Monitoring Center immediately locked onto the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
There was no choice; this beast had already been listed as a priority by the Federal Top Level.
Especially after the battle where it killed the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, it was directly listed as the ocean’s primary monitoring target.
They were to track its movements and potential dangers.

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 279: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Ultimate True Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Chapter 279: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Ultimate True Body (Seeking Monthly Pass)
In the corridor behind the courtyard, it wasn’t until after the great battle ended that Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, and the terrifying ferocity and majesty that lurked within them slowly receded.
Even he did not dare to be careless in the battle with a quasi-mythical beast, putting all his attention on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Jacks Clark narrowed his eyes and murmured softly, “It seems I need to be a bit more restrained when acting in the ocean from now on.”
The surprise encounter made him realize that prestigious powers actually divided the Deep Ocean, centralizing around the passageways to the mythical world.
These Mythical Giant Beasts occupied the passageway entrances, subduing those Level 9 Giant Beasts with high potential, though their purpose was not yet clear.
It could be for the expansion of the established Beast Empire Forces, or possibly for ‘devouring’.
“Bro, dinner’s ready.”
“I’m coming.” Jack Clark returned to his senses and stood up.
At the dinner table, Doris Clark asked, “Jack, how many days can you stay this time when you come back?”
Jack Clark thought for a moment, “I should be leaving on the 8th. Next, the Federation is going to organize some of the geniuses to go to a place. My cultivation should surge again there.”
Instantly, Glenn Clark’s eyes lit up, “Bro, you are already at the Seventh Layer Heaven. If you surge again, does that mean you are making a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven?”
“Pretty much,” Jack Clark smiled.
Even if he didn’t enter the ancient relics, it would only be about a month before he could break through to the Eight Layer Heaven with the pace he was going.
However, upon entering the ancient relics, his primary goal was World Origin. As for anything else like innate runes or Law Fragments, all those were secondary.
Glenn Clark got excited, “Bro, you haven’t even finished the next semester and you’re breaking through to Eight Layer Heaven already. Doesn’t that mean there’s a chance you’ll break through to the Ninth Heavens within a year?”
Jack Clark smiled, “There is that possibility.”
In front of his family, Jack Clark’s mood was relaxed, and he spoke without the ‘humility’ he exhibited outside.
Glenn Clark exclaimed in awe, “If it’s really Ninth Heavens in a year, bro, you’ll be insanely amazing.”
Doris Clark frowned in mild annoyance, “Jim, watch your language, be civilized. You’re a junior high school student, how come your manners degrade the more you study?”
Glenn Clark chuckled sheepishly.
While the family dined, the news broadcast on the nearby television switched scenes.
“Next is international news. Due to the influence of the typhoon, the Berlin East Coast, southeast coast of Tarudoos Country and Mordro Coast all suffered tsunami attacks of varying intensities.”
“This tsunami affected three countries, displacing millions of people and causing property damage exceeding ten billion.”
“However, because the tsunami was predicted well in advance and evacuation was organized before the tsunami hit, there were no significant casualties.”
“Currently, a search has begun for some curious individuals who went missing. We hope they are safe and well. Next is the news from Simon country…”
Doris Clark couldn’t help but sigh, “Faced with such natural disasters, we humans are still very insignificant.”
“Yeah,” Glenn Clark nodded in agreement.
However, both were unaware that one source of it all was seated right in front of them.
Jack Clark glanced at the news, unconcerned. In a battle of that magnitude, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon surely could not hold back, and there was nothing it could do about the tsunamis caused by the residual battles.
After all, it had already moved far from the shore.
Once dinner was finished, Jack Clark helped clean up the dishes and utensils in the kitchen, then excused himself, “Mom, I’m going upstairs to cultivate.”
“Go ahead.”
As soon as Jack Clark went upstairs, Glenn Clark excitedly grabbed his fishing backpack and called out, “Mom, I’m going fishing too.”
But just as Glenn was about to step out, Doris Clark suddenly said in a low voice, “Jim, when you go out and interact with others, don’t talk too much about your brother, understand?”
“Huh?” Glenn Clark looked puzzled.
Doris Clark spoke softly, “The better talents your brother shows, the more we need to keep a low profile and not to cause trouble for him or draw envy from those around us.”
“Right now, Jack needs to cultivate quietly, understand?”
Although Jack Clark spoke of reaching the Ninth Heavens within a year at the dinner table in a joking manner,
even reaching the Eight Layer in a year, with Jack Clark’s talent, there’s hope for a breakthrough to the Nine Layers, and even attaining king-level strength—a height that stands atop the Federation.
Under these circumstances, as family, their role was to stay discreet, to not drag down his progress, as they were ordinary people after all.
And this is a sentiment shared by most parents across the world.
They feel happy and proud of their children’s achievements but do not care about how much their children repay them; instead, they worry about not causing any trouble.
Faced with Doris Clark’s admonition, Glenn Clark grinned and said, “Don’t worry, Mom, I get it. No need to be the one shot at when sneaking into the village. Once bro becomes a king-level strong man, our family will be awesome.”
Finally, Doris Clark couldn’t hold back and reached up to tap Glenn’s head gently, “Where did you learn these words? Be civilized, you hear me?”
…
Upstairs.
In his room, Jack Clark was seated cross-legged, his keen hearing naturally catching the subdued conversation below, a gentle warmth showing in his eyes.
Then Jack Clark refocused his attention, looking at the 2000 Points Attribute on the transparent page before him, a thought echoed in the realm of thought, “Burn 1000 points, enter the epiphany state.”
Boom!
Jack Clark’s consciousness roared, his thinking became clear and sensitive once more, everything between heaven and earth felt simple.
Many questions in cultivation seemed to be understood instantly with just a little thought.
At the same time, the Heavenly Energy was once again drawn, swarming in to form an energy vortex above the small courtyard, being devoured by the black hole-like presence of Jack Clark below.

chapters.title: Chapter 602: 279: Space-Time Summoning, Arrival of the True Body at its Limit (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Chapter 279: Space-Time Summoning, Arrival of the True Body at its Limit (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
“The genius from the Clark family has started cultivation again.”
“So strong.”
“Have you guys noticed that the Heavenly Energy around here has been a bit weaker lately?”
“That’s normal. Energy is limited. When there’s an advanced cultivator cultivating nearby, it will be rapidly consumed, but it will slowly recover after they leave.”
A few ordinary cultivators were chatting in a group, and the topic was almost entirely about the cultivation genius of the Clark family, Jack Clark.
The next morning.
“Jack, come down for breakfast.”
Jack’s voice came from upstairs, “Mom, I’m at a critical juncture in my cultivation. Don’t wait for me, you guys go ahead and eat.”
“Alright, but don’t tire yourself out too much.”
In his room, Jack looked at the remaining one thousand plus Attribute points. With a thought, he chose to burn them again and continued his epiphany to perfect the true martial arts phantom.
While Jack was cultivating, Freya Louise was also busy integrating the God Machine Armament and learning some specialized knowledge in preparation for her return to Simon.
Although she was the designated sole pilot, when it came to the power of a ‘king-level’, many things were not so simple.
As everyone busied themselves, time flew by swiftly.
Past five o’clock in the afternoon, Glenn Clark, a burly and powerful-looking man came home with his ‘school bag.’ As soon as he entered the door, he shouted, “Mom, is big bro still cultivating upstairs?”
In the kitchen, Doris Clark nodded, “He’s still cultivating, don’t go up and disturb him.”
Glenn Clark expressed his amazement, “No wonder bro’s cultivation level is improving so quickly, he’s been working so hard. I’ve decided, from now on, I will also cultivate with the same effort.”
In the three or four days since he came back, apart from visiting Sister Freya Louise at school in the first two days, he had been cultivating almost all the time, neglecting sleep and forgetting about meals, regardless of day or night.
This level of focus and persistent attitude towards cultivation greatly impressed Glenn Clark. He resolved to learn from his brother and push himself to cultivate hard after entering high school in a couple of years.
Upstairs, in the room, massive amounts of Heavenly Energy converged to form a raging wind that caused the curtains to flap wildly and the wardrobe to shake.
Behind Jack, a phantom as tall as he was, with three faces and six arms, materialized and slowly overlapped with him.
Although the fusion of the Combat Shadow and his body was slow, there were no obstacles.
The moment the Combat Shadow completely overlapped with Jack, boom! A heavy and overbearing aura burst forth from his body, causing the entire building to tremble slightly.
At this moment, Jack’s aura was incredibly formidable.
His whole body was covered with black-red scaled armor, with two blurry faces appearing on both sides and four arms emerging from behind him, each holding a slowly rotating halo of light in their grasp.
However, that godlike and demonic presence was fleeting, and soon the three-faced six-armed apparition and the black-red scaled armor on Jack’s body began to dissipate slowly.
Phew!
Jack exhaled deeply and opened his eyes, his face breaking into a smile.
After spending three thousand Attribute points and three epiphanies, he finally completed the adjustments to the Combat Shadow up to the Eight Layer Heaven and achieved nearly perfect assimilation.
Next, he only needed to transform the true martial arts phantom from illusion into reality, reaching the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven, and he could merge it with his physical body and take a step into the Eight Layer Heaven.
“Next up is the Space-Time Summoning Technique.”
As he spoke, Jack’s gaze fell on the remaining 682 Attribute points. With the continuous consumption, these points were no longer enough to initiate the epiphany state.
“I’ll rest for a while and open the Spatial Channel tonight,” said Jack as he got up, ready to go downstairs for dinner.
After a day and a night of continuous epiphany cultivation, he needed a break to rest.
Deep in the dark sea, a fierce black-red Colossal Beast with golden flames burning over its body was boiling the surrounding seawater, illuminating the surroundings with radiant light.
In the double claws of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was a ninety-plus meter long beast that resembled an octopus, each bite producing a crackle as it devoured a strip of snack.
Soon, a Level 8 Early Stage Giant Beast was devoured by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. Its fierce body grew slightly, and its length increased by a few centimeters.
After reaching Level 9, the flesh and blood energy of Level 8 beasts was no longer enough to support its rapid growth, similar to when it was at Level 2 and eating ordinary Level 1 Mutated Fish.
After eating its fill, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon carefully pulled a real leather bag from the slits between the scales under its neck, being careful not to exert too much force and tear it.
This was a bag made from the skin of a Female Tiger Whale at the Late Stage of Eighth Rank, with the main attribute of water, about a few meters in diameter, capable of barely resisting the invisible golden flames emitted from the body of the beast.
Of course, it could only withstand a few days at most before being burned to ashes.
Glancing at the dozen or so High-level Life Crystals in the bag, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes showed satisfaction. These were the results of its day-long hunt.
This sea area, dominated by the Flood Dragon behemoth and extending into the Outer Sea, had rich Heavenly Energy in the deep sea, and therefore, resources such as Mutated Beasts were also more abundant.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon waited on the seabed. Only when Jack had finished dinner and was ready to return to his room did it activate the space runes on its feather horn.
Boom!
With the blazing golden flames burning fiercely, forming a Flame Crown, a powerful space force slowly created a Silver Vortex.
Subsequently, over a dozen High-level Life Crystals, including the Life Crystal from the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven Beast that the Female Tiger Whale had once defeated, passed through the pathway one by one.
Once all the Life Crystals had passed through, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon closed the Spatial Channel with a thought, flicked its tail, and vanished into the dark sea in an instant.
In the room, Jack held a Life Crystal in his hand.
“You have transformed a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 985 Attribute points.”
“You have transformed a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 321 Attribute points…”

chapters.title: Chapter 603: 279: Space-Time Summoning, The Ultimate True Body Descends (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Chapter 279: Space-Time Summoning, The Ultimate True Body Descends (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Six fifth-grade crystals, two sixth-grade, and one seventh-grade, along with the original six hundred-plus Points Attribute, brought the attribute page back up to 3241 points.
Jack Clark’s eyes sparkled with anticipation as he took out the Mystical Disc that bore the Space-Time Summoning Technique from his Sumeru Bracelet, then burned 1000 points to enter an epiphany state.
Boom! Jack’s consciousness plunged into the secret disc space.
But this time, what he saw was no longer a vast Heaven and Earth, nor was there the figure with its back turned. Instead, it was an altar composed of countless runes of space, time, and bloodline, intertwined in a complex and ever-rotating sequence.
These rune sequence chains twisted together, intricate and complex, slowly rotating, revealing to Jack the mysteries of the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
Clearly, this was the true nature of the information the mystical disc held.
Only in the past, Jack’s talent was not sufficient, unable to see through at a glance, he could only learn slowly by referring to the demonstration of that shadow of will.
In the state of enlightenment, Jack learned the runes related to ‘time’ at a terrifying pace. As for the parts about space and bloodline, he had mastered that long ago.
Time became indiscernible, and as a complete Time-Space Altar emerged in Jack’s mind, the Mystical Disc in his hand suddenly turned to powder and dissipated.
“Finally learned it,” Jack slowly opened his eyes, filled with emotion.
It had been almost two months since he obtained the Gail Family’s Summoning Secret Skill, and only now had he thoroughly comprehended this secret skill.
What came next was cultivation.
He needed to first cultivate a ‘shell,’ and once the Time-Space Summoning Technique was recorded on the attribute page, he could directly enhance it with Attribute points.
Sensing that only half of the Attribute Energy had been burned, Jack’s consciousness deepened, and he commenced his cultivation.
Under the epiphany state, not only did Jack’s comprehension skills greatly increase but also the speed of cultivating and solidifying these rune techniques was terrifying, equivalent to a supercharged cultivation accelerator.
However, it was somewhat wasteful to burn 1000 Attribute points in an overnight accelerated cultivation session.
Using Qi Blood as the ink and his Spirit Will as the pen, simple rune sequence chains kept solidifying, and soon, a gloomy blue rune emerged on the back of Jack’s left hand.
At the same time, a note on the Secret Skill column appeared on the attribute page. When Jack’s attention landed on the plus sign (+),
“Do you want to spend 2000 points to strengthen the Space-Time Summoning Technique?”
Two thousand points, the same requirement as the earlier breakthrough to Seventh Layer Heaven, was less than Jack had anticipated, so he selected confirm without hesitation.
Boom!
The two thousand points disappeared, and simultaneously, Jack’s vast Qi Blood surged as his Spiritual Will was pulled by a strong force.
In addition to that, the power of the Emperor Dragon in his body was also drawn out.
Hum!
Suddenly, from the center of the rune on the back of Jack’s left hand, countless intricate Rune Sequence Chains took shape at a visible rate, dispersing widely, and gradually enveloping the entire room.
Tens of thousands of rune sequence chains slowly rotated and converged, like a mysterious altar twinkling with gloomy blue light, bridging space and time.
At the very moment the Time-Space Summoning Altar fully solidified, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, surrounded by blood beneath the deep sea, stepping on the corpse of a Giant Beast, sensed something.
It sharply raised its head to look in Jack’s direction.
A Blue Giant Crab, missing two legs and a large pincer, sat somewhat bedraggled on the ground, casting a puzzled bubble chain toward the suddenly still Black-red Colossal Beast.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, what’s wrong?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep roar: “Nothing, Crab General, you are severely injured. From now on, follow this king.”
This fellow was clearing out peak Level 7 Unique Beasts in the sea area and encountered an Eighth Level Beast that had just made a breakthrough.
As a Level 7 Peak Unique Beast that had participated in many “national extermination” battles alongside Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and other Giant Beasts, the boastful Blue Giant Crab didn’t hesitate to engage even when facing an Eighth Level Beast.
It was then quickly disabled, and if not for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon sensing the energy fluctuation here and rapidly arriving, the crab might have already been critically injured and downed.
After all, there is too vast a gap between a Level 7 Peak and level eight, one that not even the prideful Blue Giant Crab with no Advanced Talent could bridge.
“Let’s go,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon said, picking up the sixty-plus meter long corpse of the Giant Beast beneath its feet, its steps heavy, continuing to feast with every bite tearing off large chunks of flesh and blood.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, wait for me, Great King, you’re incredibly awesome, crushing an Eighth Level Beast with a single step.
The Blue Giant Crab scuttled excitedly after him.
“Is this the Summoning Altar?”
In the room, Jack looked around at the colossal runes of the surrounding altar, his eyes showing satisfaction.
At that moment, he felt that with just a thought to activate the altar, he could summon a fragment of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s power in a form of projection.
However, this wasn’t the right place for experiments, so Jack forcibly suppressed the urge to try it out and with a thought, retracted the rune altar.
Instantly, light flickered in the room, converged, and eventually formed a seven-tiered altar rune on the back of Jack’s left hand, which then faded away.
Sensing the hidden special power in his left hand, Jack summoned the attribute page.
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Technique [Minor Accomplishment: Activating it forms a Space-Time Altar, using the body infused with Emperor Dragon Essence Blood as ‘coordinates’, resonating with similar-sourced soul power to summon a projection.
Alert: Summoning consumes a substantial amount of Qi Blood and True Strength; the longer the projection exists, the greater the consumption.
Note: Upon maximizing the strength of this secret skill, it can invert the current space-time to summon the true body of the colossal beast known as Thunderflame Emperor Dragon]
And just as Jack successfully cultivated the Summoning Altar, an international flight landed at Mist River Airport.

chapters.title: Chapter 604: 280 Human Race Great Era, Incomplete Inheritance
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Chapter 280 Human Race Great Era, Incomplete Inheritance
June 5th, weather: overcast.
Today, the sky over Mist River City was gloomy and dark, with Level 5 winds howling.
At the airport, by the runway exclusively used for international airplanes, stood a middle-aged man with glasses, exuding a strict aura, and Freya Louise.
At that moment, the middle-aged man glanced at the time and reminded her, “Miss Flora, it’s getting late. Your aunt and I should be departing soon.”
“There’s an important energy conversion experiment going on that I have to rush back to oversee.”
Freya Louise replied calmly, “Wait a bit longer.”
“…Is there something else?” Elvis Louise asked somewhat puzzled.
Freya Louise looked towards a girl not far off and spoke faintly, “A classmate of Miss Flora’s is rushing here to see her off; he is also her only ‘friend’ here.”
Since he is Miss Flora’s only friend here, we can wait a bit longer.
Within Mist River City, a figure sped through at a speed invisible to the naked eye, crossing a street in the blink of an eye, weaving through the passing sedans.
Under the influence of supersonic speed, the winds blared, causing the windows of those sedans to buzz.
At the same time that Jack Clark was moving through the city at supersonic speeds, at the South Sky Martial Height which guarded Mist River, an energy wave detection device flickered to life.
“High-order energy burst detected, in rapid motion. The emission of spiritual will waves is being detected… Identity confirmed, safe.”
Under the cover of supersonic speeds, Jack Clark crossed tens of kilometers in just a few minutes and reached the airport, his figure flashing as he leapt onto the runway from the side.
Suddenly, Jack Clark stopped and, looking at the girl in the white dress standing in the distance, a smile appeared on his face: “It seems I haven’t arrived too late.”
The raging wind whipped around, causing the girl’s hair to dance wildly. Upon hearing his words, she pursed her lips into a smile, “You didn’t have to rush, you know. I said I would wait.”
Jack Clark smiled, “For me now, running a few tens of kilometers is no different than taking a stroll, so there’s no such thing as rushing.”
“Remember to call me when you get there, and you can message me if there’s anything. We’ll meet in the mythical world.”
“And be careful when you pilot the No.1 Mech.”
“If you can’t ward off the mental contamination, choose to abandon it. For the Human Race right now, having one more or one less King-level strong man doesn’t make a big difference.”
“Once I break through to king-level, any demon king or Great Demon King will be blasted apart with one halberd strike. I’ll take care of your part as well, so don’t feel too much pressure.”
Although that No.1 Mech sounds mighty, capable of blasting apart Mythical Giant Beasts with a single strike, it has significant flaws, including mental contamination and bodily assimilation.
Faced with Jack Clark’s caution, the girl nodded lightly, “I’ll be careful.”
While Jack Clark and Freya Louise said their goodbyes, Elvis Louise glanced at the distinguished youth, then down at his wrist where the number 7 flickered faintly, and couldn’t help but murmur.
“Miss Flora, this youth is the classmate you mentioned?”
Freya Louise nodded, her tone cool, “Yes, they’re classmates.”
“At this age, to have reached the Seventh Layer of True Martial…” Even for a top-tier Simon Mecha expert like Elvis Louise, it was a shock.
Since when did True Martial in Eastern Summer develop to this point where a Senior One freshman has a Seventh Layer Heaven cultivation? Or is this guy an exceptionally monstrous exception?
As Elvis Louise stood astonished, Jack Clark and Freya Louise had finished talking and walked over. She introduced him, “Jack Clark, this is my father, Elvis Louise.”
“Dad, this is my classmate, Jack Clark.”
Jack Clark said politely, “Hello, Uncle.”
Elvis Louise also nodded slightly, “Hello.”
After the greetings, Elvis Louise couldn’t help but take another look at Jack Clark, as if trying to discern something from the elegant youth.
Freya Louise hugged Freya Louise a bit reluctantly: “Aunt, I’m leaving. I’ll come back to see you when I have the time.”
Freya Louise’s gaze was warm as she said, “Go ahead.”
Freya Louise turned to Jack Clark, “Goodbye.”
She waved to Jack Clark, then turned and followed her father onto the airplane.
As the modified airplane took off, a touch of sentimentality appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes. With Freya Louise’s departure, there was no telling when the two of them would meet again.
After all, even within the mythical world, the bases guarded by Simon and Eastern Summer were not together.
He was only slightly sentimental after all; it was not a life-or-death farewell.
It was then that Freya Louise suddenly said, “With the descending of ancient relics, the Second Great Era for the Human Race is about to arrive.”
“The Second Great Era?” Jack Clark asked with a look of inquiry.
“The First Great Era was when the Giant Beasts descended, sparking an upheaval in the mythical world. This led to the first descent of ancient relics as the two realms’ forces intertwined.”
“It was also the first generation of Innate Awakened Ones who gained immensely within the relics that allowed the Human Race to rise swiftly, suppress internal strife, and firmly establish itself in the mythical world.”
“Now, after decades, we have more geniuses in the alliance, with more people meeting the under-twenty requirement. Over the next ten years, there will be a surge in Human Experts.”
“With your talent, as long as you step onto the Road to Becoming a God, you will quickly break through to king-level.”
“However, before the Path of the Gods emerges, don’t seek resources for advancing your cultivation. Those are no longer important to you. What you need to do is find a way to obtain more incomplete Inheritances.”
Jack Clark slowly said, “General Louise, are you referring to Inheritances in the form of ‘books’?”
“Not just ‘books’, it could also be incomplete statues, a mundane broken sword on the ground, or even a few characters inscribed on a wall.”
“These Inheritances are in fact the fragmentary insights of some powerful beings before the destruction of the previous human civilization, some of which even pertain to laws or even higher realms of information.”

chapters.title: Chapter 605: 280 Human Race Great Era, Incomplete Inheritance_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Chapter 280 Human Race Great Era, Incomplete Inheritance_2
“When the time comes, gather any items that seem to have an obscure artistic conception, or contemplate them. You might gain something unexpected from them.”
“Strive on, youth. The coming era will be splendid but also fraught with peril. The Purgatory Family will not sit idly by and watch the Human Race grow stronger.”
…
After Freya Louise left, Jack Clark continued to immerse himself in cultivation, striving to refine the Power of Heaven and Earth.
Normally, it would take several days for someone in the Seventh Layer to refine a single Sky Element Stone, but he was using one a day, with his Combat Shadow improving by nearly three percent daily.
June 8th, morning.
In the backyard corridor, Jack Clark sat cross-legged with the Heavenly Energy swirling around him. He absorbed and refined the power of Heaven and Earth from the Sky Element Stone he held in his hand.
However, at that moment his mobile phone lit up, vibrating and ringing.
Jack Clark slowly stopped his cultivation and opened his eyes.
“Major Jack, this is Cicely Rodgers. The shadow of the relic has become clear, and it’s expected to fully descend by tomorrow afternoon.”
“At 7 am tomorrow, a base car will pick you up to go to the airport. You’ll be heading to the First Passage Entrance via military Special Warfare Aircraft. Please ensure your communication remains unobstructed.”
“Understood.”
After saying this, Jack Clark put down his mobile phone, his eyes revealing anticipation, “So it’s finally appearing.”
Then Jack Clark thought for a moment, and with a motion of his mind, he summoned the attribute page.
Combat Divine Body: Halberd[Seventh Layer, Combat Shadow 21%]
It had only been a little more than a week since his breakthrough, and with several enlightenments and the absorption of a few Sky Element Stones, his cultivation had progressed at an astonishing speed.
Once the reality of the Combat Shadow reached thirty percent, he would be at the mid-stage of the seventh realm.
Glancing at the progress of his Cultivation Methods, Jack Clark’s gaze then swept over the Four Major Attributes, talent, runes, Secret Skills, Battle Intent, and equipment, his eyes showing contemplation.
At present, he had reached the limit of the Seventh Layer in all aspects. To significantly increase his power in a short time, the only option left was to enhance his talent.
Fortunately, the slaughter by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was almost over.
Over the past few days, the group of Giant Beasts had killed ‘beasts’ wherever they found them, collecting a large number of Life Crystals, enough to strengthen the Void Double Pupils.
Some two hundred meters below the sea surface, a group of nine Giant Beasts converged. Apart from the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Blue Giant Crab, each creature exuded a thick aura of blood and Killing Intent.
Roar! Thunder, thunder, we’ve got a lot of crystals this time.
As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish said this, it manipulated the water flow to unwind the blue fish skin bag hanging from its horn, which seemed to be filled with crystals.
To the side of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Female Tiger Whale floated quietly, while the three nearly fifty-meter-long Little Tiger Whales swam excitedly, churning up violent currents.
Big Tiger, roar! Uncle, we’ve eaten so much this time.
Tiger Two, roar! Caught a lot, small alien beasts, eat.
Tiger Three, roar! One bite each.
The Tiger Whale family had been allocated to a separate territory by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, covering a length of fifty kilometers. Over these few days, they had killed quite a number of high-level alien beasts.
Especially since these Tiger Whales coordinated well, they would herd together large groups of Level 3-4 Demonic Beast fish and then focus on killing those that had reached the pinnacle of their level.
“Roar! Well done.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon extended a giant claw and grabbed the fish skin bag, a slight curl at the corner of its mouth, immediately making its huge dragon face appear all the more ferocious.
To the left, the Silver Giant Dragon held its head up proudly and roared with satisfaction, “Roar! The Great Scythia is even more powerful, one claw each, and also killed plenty.”
With that, the Reverse Scale under its neck shimmered and spat out a string of Life Crystals level four or higher, easily dozens of them.
After gaining strength, this creature became even more adept at opening temporary Spatial Channels, and with the force field runes compressing the Talent Energy, its ability to Burst instantaneously became quite astounding.
Any Mutated Beast below level eight that got within a kilometer of it faced certain death, unable to withstand its sudden and stealthy claw attack.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not skimp on the praise, roaring, “Scythia, you’re more and more like the King of the Dragon Palace, worthy of becoming the King of the Beasts.”
“Roar! Not bad, the Great Scythia aims to be the King of the Beasts.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared triumphantly, crossing its claws over its chest, spreading its double wings to maintain balance underwater, and lifting its tail high up, nearly reaching heaven.
At that moment, having grown back four dragon heads and regaining its nine-heads appearance, Kidora seemed a bit embarrassed, “Roar, roar, roar!! Kido, Ra, this time, didn’t do well.”
This creature had spent the past few days recovering, devouring the flesh and blood of numerous hunted Giant Beasts of levels 7 and 8, as well as part of the ordinary resources it had obtained.
Even so, it only managed to heal its exterior wounds; its Aura was still slightly weak, considering it had nearly been slapped to death before.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon bellowed, “Roar! No worries, just get back into action next time—no, I mean display the might of your Nine-headed Dragon in our next battle.”
These guys kept talking about being badass and whatnot, almost roping it into their manner of speech as well.
After the first batch of ‘chives’ were harvested, and after making sure that the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish remembered several Regenerative Resource Points, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon led the group of Giant Beasts away.
By the time they returned to the Water and Fire World, several hours had passed. As a group of Giant Beasts passed through the Spatial Channel, they were greeted by the resentful gaze of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
These brothers were too inconsiderate, leaving it alone at home for several days, not to mention coming back all greased up from their feasts.
Look at that guy, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish; it had grown from over eighty meters to ninety-five, not only larger in size but also its Aura nearing the late period of level eight.
Aside from this guy, the size and Aura of the other beasts had also skyrocketed. Scythia, who had been just over ninety meters before departure, was now nearly a hundred and ten meters long.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 280 Human Race Great Era, Incomplete Inheritance_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Chapter 280 Human Race Great Era, Incomplete Inheritance_3
Horned Lady and the Giant Crab, their bloodline aura surging, were at any moment ready to enter hibernation and make the breakthrough to Level 8.
How much good stuff did these guys eat on their outing this time?
Thinking this, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle almost let its envious drool flow out.
Just as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was filled with envy, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish added fuel to the fire. Its massive body swam over, flapping its double fins and trumpeting proudly.
Roar, roar, roar! Dominator, you really missed out by not joining the great battle this time. We not only took down a Late Stage 9 Giant Beast, but we also took on Mythical Giant Beasts afterward.
Roar, roar! What, Mythical Giant Beasts? You must be joking.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes widened in surprise.
Roar, roar, roar! I, Joe, always speak truthfully. How could I possibly deceive you? In the end, we really did destroy the projection of a Mythical Giant Beast.
