As he spoke, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out a series of roars, recounting the ‘nation-destroying’ battle experience to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which was left shouting and crying out in excitement.
Especially when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon overwhelmed quasi-mythical beasts and even had two Mythical Giant Beast projections descend, it was absolutely astounding.
While the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle were ‘communicating’, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned towards the Blue Giant Crab and the Female Tiger Whale, growling thunderously.
“The transition from Level 7 to Level 8 is a major hurdle; your talents will manifest from nothing into runes. This process will reveal the true nature of your Gifted Powers.”
“Remember not to fall asleep during that time. Make sure to memorize the entire process; comprehend as much as you can.”
The Female Tiger Whale already knew this, so in reality, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was speaking for the benefit of the Blue Giant Crab.
The Blue Giant Crab, bubbling with excitement: Gurgle, gurgle! Yes, Great King, I definitely won’t fall asleep. Once I make my breakthrough to Level 8, I vow to take on twenty opponents.
Boom! Accompanied by the terrifying burst of The Majesty of the Emperor, the entire small world shook violently in an instant, the ocean roared, and the Lava Lake boiled.
Enveloped by the power of the Monarch’s Gifted Strength, the Blue Giant Crab and the Female Tiger Whale experienced a powerful surge in their profound bloodline strength, followed immediately by an intense wave of drowsiness.
After looking at the two Giant Beasts sinking into the seabed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gazed at the Three-headed Small Tiger Whales and growled fiercely, “Big Tiger, henceforth I appoint the three of you as Cavalry Generals of the Dragon Palace.”
“Next, go out and gather all the Tiger Whales within our Territory that have reached Level 4 or higher. Look for the smarter Unique Beasts to form the first Mutated Beast army of the Dragon Palace.”
“Once Joe takes command of all forces, each of you will lead one military unit, patrol the oceans, and maintain the dignity of my Dragon Palace.”
Instantly, the three Tiger Whales’ eyes lit up, excitedly tumbling around in the water.
Roar, roar, roar! No problem, uncle.
Roar, roar! We are generals now. Charge!
Roar, roar, roar! Let’s impress dad, we want to become Great Generals.
The three Three-headed Small Tiger Whales, having been appointed as generals by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, were very excited. Although they didn’t know what ‘generals’ meant, the title itself sounded awesome.
When the Three-headed Small Tiger Whales darted out of the Dragon Palace, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly remembered something and turned to look at the Silver Giant Dragon lying in front of the Ice Crystal Palace.
“Roar! Oh right, Scythia, do you have any objections to the responsibilities I just assigned to Big Tiger and the others?”
The Silver Giant Dragon, idly playing with its tail, paused, then sat up solemnly, growling earnestly, “Hegemon, your arrangements are excellent. The Great Scythia has no objections.”
“As a force of the Beast Empire, it is indeed necessary to have a Unique Beast army patrolling the territory, deterring other Mutated Creatures. Very good, Scythia had also considered this issue earlier.”
“Roar! Right, Hegemon, Scythia needs to sleep too.”
“Mother once gave Scythia a Big Fruit, telling me to consume it when I grow to Late Stage 8, so that after just one sleep, I can become a Level 9 Giant Dragon.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded, “Roar! Go ahead, I look forward to the moment you awaken.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wasn’t surprised that the Silver Giant Dragon had good items in its possession.
After all, its mother was a Mythical Giant Beast that ruled over a vast territory in the mythical world and was one of the strong ones. The resources it could access were beyond comparison to the impoverished Blue Star.
The Silver Giant Dragon entered hibernation, and Kidora also returned to its palace to sleep and recover, while also striving hard in its cultivation; it planned to inscribe runes on all of its scales.
The recent heavy injury made it realize the importance of physical defense.
So its plan now was to have one dragon head sleep while the other eight work, in an effort to become stronger.
When tens of thousands of Solid Runes layered together, it would be invincible, able to stand still and let enemies strike without being able to bite through it.
“Roar! Stop boasting, you two. Go work hard on your cultivation. Once you gather a hundred runes, harvest all those resources, and aim for a breakthrough to Level 9 as soon as possible.”
After assigning tasks to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon went into its palace and poured out more than two hundred Life Crystals.
Of course, most of these crystals were Level 3 and Level 4, coming from the ordinary Mutated Fish that had been surrounded and killed by the Tiger Whales; this was the advantage of having strength in numbers.
Sigh!
Hot breath emanated from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s nostrils, instantly igniting golden flames on its three pairs of red feather horns, forming a regal fiery crown.
In the scorching light, a Silver Vortex slowly emerged.
At the same time, the Purple Dragon Egg nestled between the scales on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head pulsed comfortably, absorbing the fervent energy under the burning golden flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 281: Void Exile, the Entire World Converges
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Chapter 281: Void Exile, the Entire World Converges
One o’clock in the morning!
“You have converted a high purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 951 Attribute points.”
“You have converted a high purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 127 Attribute points…”
As Jack Clark crushed one Life Crystal after another in his hand into powder, the Attribute points on the page soared at a terrifying speed—three thousand, five thousand, ten thousand…
By the time that large pile of Life Crystals had vanished, the Attribute points on the page had accumulated to 15,420.
If he added the two thousand plus points from the past few days, after killing the Flood Dragon behemoth and sweeping that sea area, he had gained nearly eighteen thousand Attribute points—an astonishing amount.
It was the biggest harvest recently.
“Over fifteen thousand Attribute points,” Jack Clark said with a smile on his face, his gaze landing on the talent of the Void Heavy Pupil with some anticipation.
Even though it was a Talent Ability, his pair of special eyes hadn’t yet felt very powerful up to this point, somewhat unworthy of the Advanced Talent level.
“Use ten thousand Attribute points to enhance the Void Heavy Pupil.”
Boom!
Colossal enhancement energy erupted inside Jack Clark’s body, crazily flowing into his eyes. In an instant, his vision darkened, falling into absolute blackness.
In an unknown pitch-black Void, a pair of dark gold vertical pupils that obscured the sky and sun slowly opened, with black runes within them burning like flames.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the direct gaze of those terrifying eyes, the pitch-black Void, which should have been empty, began to break apart layer by layer, like continuously shattering and revealing a transparent state.
Unlike the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Annihilation True Thunder and Heaven Burning Golden Flame, there were no Destroy Heaven and Earth phenomena when the Void Heavy Pupil was enhanced to Top-tier, and there were no intense energy fluctuations.
There was only an invisible force spreading out and enveloping the surroundings in darkness, silent and unnoticed, not even stirring Lena Davis next door.
Two hours later, as the darkness engulfing the surroundings faded, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes.
Within his clearly defined black and white eyeballs, a pair of dark gold vertical pupils that veiled the Void appeared, cold and overlooking, like an exalted deity.
Then Jack Clark closed his eyes and reopened them, the double-pupil phenomenon disappearing. Next, with a thought, he called out the attribute page.
Talent: Void Heavy Pupil [Top-tier: Eyes containing the power of the Void. When the double pupils are revealed, the space in the line of sight halts, sees through all falsehoods, and directly views the essence of all things.
Ability: Dark Curtain, uses Void power to form a Dark Curtain covering a certain range when the double pupils are deployed, with the range depending on the current realm.
Ability: Space Shatter, crushes a space locked in gaze, the greater the consumption the more powerful the effect; works even better in combination with Dark Curtain.
Ability: Void Banishment, tears open a crack through the Void, banishing enemies into the endless Void]
After being enhanced to Top-tier, the capabilities of the Void Heavy Pupil finally underwent a transformation, becoming extremely terrifying, with two abilities touching upon the space that only Ninth Heaven Experts could touch.
Whoosh!
The second-floor window pushed open, and a shadow rushed out, disappearing from the rooftops after a few jumps.
Under the cover of night, Jack Clark, now a streaking shadow, quickly arrived outside the city, about ten kilometers away, at the valley where the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd was strengthened.
Months had passed here, and the scarred earth was now covered in weeds. Standing on a few-meter-high piece of rubble, Jack Clark’s second layer of pupils emerged in his eyes.
Boom!
A flourishing black radiance burst from Jack Clark’s eyes, and in an instant, endless darkness erupted from him as the center, turning a hundred and fifty-meter radius into an absolute dark area.
From a distance, it looked as if a semicircular black curtain had appeared on the ground.
Only Jack Clark could ‘see’ in the darkness, as a pair of huge black gold vertical pupils slowly opened, and in an instant, a power capable of shattering the Void burst forth.
Thud!
Within the Dark Curtain, the space around ten meters in front of Jack Clark shattered like a mirror, with a web of black cracks interweaving.
In front of those black cracks, all matter was sliced, shattered, devouring everything, leaving a hole that spanned tens of meters across the Earth.
It looked as if the Earth had been bitten.
Soon, those cracks disappeared as space naturally repaired itself, and the encompassing Dark Curtain faded away, revealing Jack Clark covering his eyes.
“The consumption is a bit too much,” he commented.
The attack that shattered space just now had used up almost sixty percent of the Void Energy within the double pupils.
But the power was indeed strong.
The effect of that move might have seemed to have a destruction area of just over ten meters, but because it was a ‘space’ that had shattered, even an average Eighth Layer Heaven cultivator would not be able to withstand it.
That was the force of space being crushed.
Only those who had reached the Nine Layers and possessed a domain, or High-Ranking Powerhouses with space power, could counter that move, and that was because Jack’s realm was merely at the Seventh Layer.
As Jack Clark’s cultivation improved, the strike would become even more powerful; perhaps one day a look could collapse a hundred-meter radius of space.
Feeling the double pupils slowly recovering as they drew power from the deep Void, Jack Clark suppressed the urge to test Void Banishment and flashed back to get some sleep.
As for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the deep sea, it sat under the Ice Platform, thoughtfully looking at the twenty-meter-long spinal column.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was considering whether to spend Attribute points to enter an epiphany state to comprehend the Giantification Talent Rune smelted into that spine.
…
“Mom, I’m leaving.”
In the morning, at the gate, Jack Clark said goodbye to Doris Clark.
Watching Jack, who had only been back for a few days, leave again, Doris Clark nodded and advised warmly, “Don’t overwork yourself with cultivation after you get there, and be careful.”

chapters.title: Chapter 608: 281: Void Exile, the Entire World Converges_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Chapter 281: Void Exile, the Entire World Converges_2
“`
“Uh-huh, I know.”
“`
Speaking of which, Jack Clark looked at the mighty youth beside him, “Jim, after I leave, keep an eye on our home. If anyone dares to cause trouble or bully you, don’t hold back.”
“Now that I’ve joined the Federation military, holding the rank of Major, along with some other identities, even the political leaders of Mist River would have to give me face.”
Glenn Clark nodded fiercely, “I know, brother. I won’t go looking for trouble, but I won’t be afraid of it either. If anyone dares to bully our family, I’ll punch them to death.”
“Uh… try not to kill anyone unless it’s a mortal enemy.”
With the strength this guy gained after awakening his Innate Overlord Body, even a slight lack of control could bring down a wall, not to mention a person.
As they talked, a black military vehicle drove up and stopped in front of Jack Clark’s house. Then, a soldier exited the vehicle, approached Jack Clark, and saluted him respectfully.
“Major Clark, I am ordered to take you to the 5th Military Airport.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Thank you.”
Then he waved at Doris Clark and the two of them, “Mom, Jim, I’m leaving.”
Bang! The car door shut, and under the watchful eyes of Doris Clark and her companion, the black military vehicle quickly disappeared into the streets.
Many neighbors out and about early in the morning witnessed this scene.
A middle-aged woman they knew well approached with curiosity, “Jenny, is your son Jack leaving again?”
Doris Clark nodded with a smile, “Yes, it seems the Federation is organizing a special training for geniuses.”
The middle-aged woman’s enthusiasm instantly piqued, “I heard that your son Jack broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven and became the top student in his first year at South Sky Martial Arts School.”
“Now he’s been officially selected by the Federation for special training, and by the time he’s out, he might have broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven. Your son Jack is amazing.”
Doris Clark responded with a vague smile, “If he can break through, that would be great, but it’s hard to say right now.”
At that moment, a woman who was about to go shopping across the street joined the conversation, surprised, “Jenny, was that a military vehicle just now? It seemed like they called your son Major!”
“Yes, Jack had participated in some missions before and made achievements, so he was granted a military rank.”
“Hiss! Such a young Major, Jenny, your family is going to thrive,” the woman said, her eyes lighting up.
“Oh come on, Jack’s Major rank is just an honorary title, an honorary title.”
Watching Doris Clark getting surrounded by neighbors, all taking turns to offer congratulations, Glenn Clark shouted, “Mom, I’m off to school.”
Doris Clark, all smiles, replied, “Go ahead, and buy some ‘buns’ to eat if you get hungry on the way.”
“I know.”
Glenn Clark glanced at the neighbors who often gossiped behind their backs when he was younger, and he hummed to himself in his heart, “What Fifth Layer Heaven, my brother is already a Seventh Layer High-Ranking Powerhouse.”
Riding in the military vehicle, Jack Clark quickly arrived at the same Military Base he had gone to for Koroya.
There, a fighter aircraft full of sci-fi allure was already waiting on the runway. The pilot saluted him, “Major Clark, hello. I’m Henry Webb, and I will take you to the First Passage Entrance.”
“Appreciate your effort.”
“It’s not trouble; it’s my responsibility. Please board the aircraft, Major Clark.”
As Jack Clark was flying to the meeting point in the special fighter aircraft, fighter jets and large transport airplanes from all over the world were already heading towards Eastern Summer.
Some of these international flights had departed the previous evening and had already entered Eastern Summer airspace.
Additionally, in Eastern Summer’s three major Alien Beast Battlefields, as well as the military Martial Arts Schools, many qualified geniuses had gathered, taking the Misty Train toward the Relic Landing Point.
This time, the ancient relics event was not limited to Eastern Summer but involved geniuses selected from the entire Federation.
It also included those under twenty years old, so it was not only the Martial School Geniuses who were still studying but also many monsters who had already graduated and joined various departments of the Federation.
Inside the train compartment, Justin Welan, who had just made a breakthrough to the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven and whose aura was somewhat unstable, was both nervous and excited.
The Southern Variant Beast Battlefield was full of talent, with dozens of Martial Arts High Schools, but only a few dozen were selected to go to the ancient relics this time.
Half of them were third-graders with geniuses like Jasper Forbes and Dion Casady, who had fought with Jack Clark before and had already made a breakthrough to the Early Sixth Heaven.
Apart from them, there were new rising stars like Betty Leinster and Denny Rhodes who had reached the Early Sixth Heaven, while Henric Logan, once considered the second genius of the third grade at South Sky Martial, was not on the list.
This time, South Sky Martial’s third-graders were only represented by Betty Leinster, the second grade by Carol Koch, but the first grade had quite a few representatives.
In addition to Justin Welan who had completed the Secondary Physique Transformation, breaking through to the Initial Fifth Layer Heaven, and Howard Lambert in the Mid-stage Fifth Layer Heaven, along with the astonishing Jane Aiken, the Lewis twins were also present.
Indeed, these two stunning twins, who had a low presence after entering the Alien Beast Battlefield, had broken through to the Initial Fifth Layer Heaven months later.
However, like Justin Welan, their auras were somewhat unstable, which indicated a barely successful breakthrough.
At this moment, Crystal Lewis, with her purple hair now tinged with red and her body emanating a scorching aura, looked as sharp as a blaze.
Beside her, Mandy Lewis had also transformed. Originally, only the tips of her hair were blue, but now her whole head was gloomy blue, giving off a chilly aura.
It was obvious that both sisters had awakened a Special Talent, or rather, their innate talents had awakened.
Aside from South Sky Martial, other schools’ first years also had a few who advanced to the Fifth Layer, such as Freddy Nelson, previously top on the genius list, and Ian Carter from River Martial Height.
Compared to the majority of the third-year ‘geniuses’ who had yet to break through to the Sixth Layer Heaven, the potential of these first-year students who had broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven was even higher.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 609: 281: Void Exile, the Entire World Converges_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Chapter 281: Void Exile, the Entire World Converges_3
“`
However, across nearly sixty Martial Arts Schools on the Southern Battlefield, there are only about twenty top-tier geniuses with Fifth Layer Heaven’s power unearthed per year, most of whom come from First-class Martial Schools.
Most Second-Class Martial Schools don’t have any.
Looking at Howard Lambert, who is exuding a wild, bloody aura opposite him, Justin Welan couldn’t help but say, “Howard, take it easy, I heard you’ve been heavily injured more than a dozen times recently.”
Howard Lambert’s voice boomed, “Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing.”
Alright.
Justin Welan looked back at the Lewis sisters on the other side and couldn’t help but express his admiration, “Class Leader, I didn’t expect you two to be so secretive, awakening Elemental Talent.”
Compared to them, cultivators who have undergone a Secondary Physique Transformation and possess Physical Talent, those with Elemental Talent augmented by True Martial have even greater power.
Crystal Lewis responded indifferently, “Don’t be envious. Neither Mandy nor I are Natural Awakened Ones; we are only Innate due to the Mythical Resources that changed our physiques.”
A few years ago, the father of Crystal Lewis was lucky enough to obtain Mythical Resources in the mythical world that could alter human physiques.
However, whether it was because they were too young or too weak at the time, after absorbing the Mythical Resources, their talents only awakened halfway, remaining in a semi-dormant state.
This was also the reason for their unusual hair color.
But even so, such Mythical Resources are enviable, regretfully being too precious and rare.
Justin Welan then looked at Jane Aiken, whose demeanor was calm and collected. Never mind, that monster wasn’t worth mentioning; no one could suppress her except for that freak, Jack.
Suddenly, Mandy Lewis said softly, “Do you think Jack Clark will come this time?”
Jane Aiken’s voice remained even, “He definitely will.”
Justin Welan also nodded in agreement, “Jack will certainly come. With his talent, even if he doesn’t want to, the Federation will bind him and throw him in.”
As everyone was anxious and full of anticipation, the Endless Mist outside dissipated, and the train burst through the fog wall that obscured the sky and arrived at a boundless, vast plain.
At the end of the plain, a kilometer-tall Silver Vortex slowly rotated, emitting dense energy so thick that it nearly turned into a white mist, spraying out like smoke.
Around the Silver Vortex stood a huge and strict Military Base. Above the base floated dozens of celestial objects resembling satellites or Sky Base weapons.
However, the train did not approach the First Channel Base but stopped at a Military Base situated tens of kilometers away.
In front of the Earth, ahead, the world seemed to have suddenly split open, forming a pitch-black Sky Curtain.
At the end of the limitless Void, a massive landmass was approaching, so close that one could see the mountains and rivers on it, along with some broken buildings.
“We have arrived at the Forward Base of Channel One. Please, Special Forces Soldiers, take your personal belongings and disembark in an orderly fashion. The train will stop for fifteen minutes…”
Following the continuous announcements, the train doors, forged from the corpse of a Level 8 Behemoth, opened one after another. Soon, over two hundred geniuses carrying weapons or wearing battle armor stepped off the train, one after another.
These individuals came from the Southern, Northern, and West Mountain battlefields, as well as from over ten First-class Martial Academies of the military, gathering almost all the top-notch talents of Eastern Summer.
“Those guys are from the Northern Battlefield. Do you see that guy in the middle wearing a Daoist robe? His name is Damon Lopes, an Innate Awakened One,” someone pointed out.
“That guy is actually an Innate Awakened One! The kind who are said to directly reach the Ninth Heavens with a thirty percent chance of breaking through to king-level?”
“Correct.”
Suddenly, many people from the Southern Battlefield looked at Damon Lopes with envy, including Howard Lambert and Justin Welan.
Amid the crowd, Damon Lopes, sensing envious glances from afar, stood with his hands behind his back, his demeanor calm and undisturbed, appearing effortlessly ethereal.
“Deservedly an Innate Awakened One, he has an extraordinary aura — with his talent, he must have broken through to the Sixth-layer Heaven by now, right?”
“Not just that. I heard he invoked Heavenly Thunder for body forging a few days ago and broke through to the Seventh Layer Heaven in one go, and he’s only eighteen, a sophomore in the Seventh Layer.”
“Hiss! That’s terrifying.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 610: 282 Jack Clark Arrives, Shocking the Entire Audience (Request for Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Chapter 282 Jack Clark Arrives, Shocking the Entire Audience (Request for Monthly Pass)
Ha ha ha ha…
Upon hearing the hushed sounds of people gasping in the distance, Damon Lopes couldn’t help but burst into laughter in his heart.
Finally, finally it was his turn.
However, Damon remembered the way of the intangible, so on the surface, he still appeared as light as a breeze and as carefree as a cloud, standing with his hands behind his back, his aura merging with Heaven and Earth, emanating a refined detachment.
Of course, those who could come here were top-notch geniuses in their respective schools. Therefore, even though they were surprised by Damon’s status as an Innate Awakened One, they behaved rather reservedly.
At least they didn’t show any exaggerated expressions on their faces.
But before Damon could keep up his act for long, a burly young man with needle-like short hair, dressed in military uniform, walked over from the group of young men and women.
When Damon saw this guy approaching, he subtly turned his head away, pretending not to see him. The people from the Northern Battlefield also showed odd expressions.
Because this burly youth was wearing a set of a White Robe, trying to exude a floating white-clothed aura, but the problem was your temperament just doesn’t fit, man.
The burly youth wasn’t even close yet when he let out a booming laugh, “Ha ha ha ha… Damon Lopes, I heard you’ve broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“Indeed, being able to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven in sophomore year like me, it’s deserving for an Innate Awakened One.”
“But when it comes down to it, you’re still a month later than me, can’t compare to me, ha ha ha ha.” The white-robed burly youth’s voice was so loud that it could be heard within a few hundred meters.
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes flashed with surprise.
They could understand the perversion of an Innate Awakened One, as they were known to be sure inclusions into the Nine Layers, with a very good chance of rising to the king-level.
But this guy seemed not to be an Innate Awakened One, yet he had broken through the Seventh Layer in sophomore year. Such a monster was even more exaggerated than Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One.
Howard couldn’t help but ask out loud, “Who is that guy? So monstrous!”
Denny Rhodes replied seriously, “That should be Eddy Keller from the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy, a monster even more abnormal than an Innate Awakened One.”
“It’s said that he had broken through to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven when he was just in First Grade, and at that time, with his Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivation, he fought and killed a sixth-level king blood Unique Beast; his combat power is terrifying.”
“Right, he’s also Carney Turner’s cousin.”
“Senior Kelller’s cousin.”
Justin Welan looked surprised and couldn’t help but glance toward the handsome, mild-mannered young man nearby, curiously asking, “Senior Kelller, why don’t you go over and say hello to him?”
Carney Turner glanced over at Eddy Keller, who was forcibly showing off in the distance, and couldn’t help but turn his head away, “Sorry, I don’t know him.”
Mandy Lewis, with her long purple hair draped over her shoulders, lamented, “I thought our talents were already pretty good, but it wasn’t until coming here that I realized geniuses are everywhere.”
Among the two to three hundred people here, the freshmen started at the Fifth Layer Heaven while the third graders had all reached Sixth Layer Heaven and above, with the sophomores ranging from Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven to peak.
Not to mention those two sophomore monsters who had already broken through to the Seventh Layer.
Besides them, top-tier geniuses from other countries were also arriving.
Crystal Lewis smiled, “Sis, this is like getting into the country’s top school from high school and then suddenly finding out that everyone around you is a genius, all scoring 700, and feeling like geniuses are a dime a dozen, monsters abound.”
Justin also grinned, “Class Leader, don’t panic, our South Sky Martial Height isn’t without its monsters, look, Student Aiken is not inferior to them either.”
“Or rather, Student Aiken’s talent might even be stronger than theirs.”
Indeed, many people involuntarily turned to look at the cool girl with her long ponytail tied back.
That Innate Awakened One and Eddy Keller were strong, but their Southern Battlefield was not weak either, boasting a freshman at the Sixth Layer Heaven, who had also comprehended the Four Great Sword Intentions. In terms of being a monster, it was even more exaggerated.
“And don’t forget about Jack, when he left the Southern Battlefield, he was already at the Sixth Layer Heaven. With his cultivation speed, he might now be at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage or even at its peak.”
“Right, there’s also that monster, Jack Clark. Given his talent, he must be terrifyingly strong now.”
“However, Jack Clark has been away on some mission for several months with no word, and he hasn’t arrived yet either.”
Reminded by Justin, everybody else also perked up, their confidence bolstered.
They from the Southern Region likewise had monstrous geniuses, not any less imposing than those from the Northern Battlefield or the Myth Academy from the military.
At this moment, Damon couldn’t help but speak up, “Eddy Keller, don’t bring up the fact that you broke through to the Seventh Layer in sophomore every time we meet; I’m sick of hearing it.”
“A year has passed and you still haven’t broken through to the Eighth Layer, what’s there to show off.”
Eddy Keller laughed loudly, “Because I’ve spent the last half year not cultivating, but working on the Recast Secret Manual.”
“Being able to recast a Top-tier Secret Manual after reaching the Seventh Layer, there are only a few like me in the entire Federation, right everyone, ha ha ha ha…”
Watching Eddy Keller laughing alone, people from the Northern Battlefield couldn’t help but turn their heads away.
His act was too forced.
Even the geniuses from the Myth Academy of the military had embarrassed looks on their faces, subtly stepping a bit further away.
Damon felt a bit uncomfortable and couldn’t help but say, “Eddy Keller, your talent is indeed strong, but don’t always keep harping on it, for you should know that there is always someone better, and there is sky beyond the sky.”
“For example, I know one guy, who’s at the Seventh Layer in the First Grade and has created his own Top-tier Secret Manual. Faced with that kind of monster, can you still be so confident?”
After saying this, Damon Lopes looked at Eddy Keller with a smile as if saying, ‘When I play this card, how will you respond?’
Eddy Keller’s eyes widened, “How is that possible!?”

chapters.title: Chapter 611: 282 Jack Clark Arrives, Shocking the Entire Audience (Request for Monthly Pass) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Chapter 282 Jack Clark Arrives, Shocking the Entire Audience (Request for Monthly Pass) _2
He could accept a First Grade student reaching the Seventh Layer Heaven, but the part about creating a Self-created Secret Manual was simply impossible.
The one who had recast his own Secret Manual knew all too well how difficult it was to create one.
Last year, because he was in perfect harmony with True Martial and his Top-tier Secret Manuals were also passed down in the same line, he chose not to create his own.
But after his breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, he still felt some constraints from the framework and ended up spending more than half a year recasting the Secret Manual.
Given his talent, it took him more than half a year just to recast on his previous foundation, let alone creating a Top-tier Secret Manual from scratch at the Sixth Layer Heaven, which would take at least a few years.
Even that monster who reached the Ninth Heavens in his first year got stuck at the Sixth Layer Heaven for three months before he managed to create a Top-tier Secret Manual.
Suddenly, Eddy Keller expressed his astonishment, “Damon Lopes, are you talking about that guy who teamed up with you?”
He thought of that monster who had teamed up with Damon Lopes for a mission, the Nine-headed Blood Python that, in the late stage of the Sixth Heavenly Layer, could defy the odds and slash through an opponent in the early stages of the Eight Layer Heaven.
Damon Lopes nonchalantly nodded: “Yes, that’s him. Weren’t you asking about cultivation talent comparison? Brother Callum, who created his own Secret Manual and has already broken through to the Seventh Layer, is leagues ahead of you.”
“Isn’t that guy’s profile saying he’s eighteen years old?” This was Eddy Keller’s last bit of defiance.
Damon Lopes stood with his hands behind his back, smiling casually, “The age is naturally false, a deception to mislead our enemies.”
Hiss, hiss!!
This time, a mass intake of breath could be heard nearby.
A First Grade student already at Seventh Layer Heaven, and who had created his own Secret Manual while at the Sixth Layer Heaven, was a level of terrifying talent that shocked and disbelieved everyone around.
Including those Third Grade students.
Being geniuses themselves made them even more aware of how difficult cultivation was. After the late Fourth Layer Heaven, each step became a hurdle, and they had almost exhausted their full strength to break through to the Sixth Layer within three years, but that was almost their limit.
After reaching the Sixth Layer Heaven, they felt their progress increasingly slowing, unsure of how long it would take to break through to the Seventh Layer.
Including those geniuses from the Northern Battlefield around Damon Lopes, who also wore looks of astonishment, because they too were hearing for the first time about such a monster, just like the geniuses from the Myth Academy on the other side.
In a place like the Alien Beast Battlefield, only an anomaly like Eddy Keller would qualify to surf the net at any time and access many hidden pieces of information.
At this moment, a Third Grade genius from the Northern Battlefield couldn’t help but speak out, “…Lopes, why haven’t you mentioned this genius with the surname Callum before?”
Damon Lopes glanced at him, replying indifferently, “We are cultivators, not entertainment gossip journalists. Our main focus is on cultivation. Why would I mention Brother Callum for no reason?”
Indeed. Caleb Robinson nodded.
Yet looking around at all those shocked and questioning faces, Damon Lopes felt somewhat exasperated.
Damn it, he had barely managed to show off effortlessly, only for Eddy Keller, the fool, to interrupt, forcing him to play his trump card of Darren Callum to turn the tables.
Gurgle!
Denny Rhodes swallowed with difficulty, “The First Grade isn’t even over yet, and he’s already at the Seventh Layer, and he’s even created a Top-tier Secret Manual. What kind of monster is this!?”
Jane Aiken also raised her eyebrows in surprise, while the faces of Crystal Lewis and her sisters and Betty Leinster also showed admiration.
“Damn, such a monster exists. He seems even more ferocious than Jack. Or could it be…?” Justin Welan was skeptical amidst his shock.
Could that guy they were talking about, Brother Callum, actually be Jack?
“Calling Heavenly Central Control Tower, Green Hell No.1 Machine requesting to pass through the Enclosed Heaven Barrier.”
“Control Tower received, permission granted to enter Channel One sealed space…”
“Calling Heavenly Central Control Tower, X50 Kaeo Machine requesting to pass through the Circular Barrier…”
The plain sky slowly ‘cracked’ open, then a number of special fighter aircraft and massive international airplanes flew in, circling the base with a humming sound.
“The geniuses from other countries have arrived.”
“The cultivation system from Berlin incorporates Alien Beast Genes into their special Martial Arts, allowing transformation into a Beast-Human form. You’re about to witness something quite spectacular.”
A female student cleared her throat, “Senior Keller, what they have is integration with beasts, not beast-men.”
“It’s pretty much the same,” Eddy Keller dismissed indifferently.
“Compared to Berlin, those from Simon have an even greater difference from us. Those who pilot Mechas possess even more fierce firepower than us cultivators.”
“But these guys are like Mages; their Cultivation Methods require the use of mechas to exert their greatest strength, unlike us who are more versatile.”
“The downside to relying too much on mechas is once they run out of ammunition, their strength plummets.”
Under the curious gazes of the Eastern Summer geniuses, many people emerged from the nearby Base Airport.
Eddy Keller crossed his arms, gesturing with his chin towards the first group to emerge. “See that? The ones with scale and horn traces on their body are the geniuses from Berlin.”
A female student asked, puzzled, “Senior Keller, how do you know they’re from Berlin and not from some other medium-level country that practices Genetic Martial Arts?”
“Because I’ve seen pictures of the guy leading them, the Berlin King Beast Bardas, a nineteen-year-old monster at late Seventh Layer Heaven, with combat power comparable to the Eight Layer Heaven.”
“Truly a monster!”
Watching the towering young man who stood 2 meters tall, with white tiger stripes on his cheeks and emanating an imposing aura, everyone’s eyes were filled with astonishment.
And while those from Eastern Summer were sizing them up, the Berlin Genetic Martial Cultivators stopped not too far away, gazing ahead at the Dark Rift, and their attention fell on the approaching Ruins Continent.
“So that’s the ancient relics.”
“It’s actually an entire continent—that’s way too exaggerated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 612: 282 Jack Clark Arrives, Shocking the Entire Audience (Request for Monthly Pass) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Chapter 282 Jack Clark Arrives, Shocking the Entire Audience (Request for Monthly Pass) _3
Eddy Keller was feeling rather annoyed, “These guys are truly beasts, no manners at all. Don’t they know to come over and greet the host?”
Damon Lopes couldn’t stand his posturing, “Indeed very impolite, why don’t you go over and beat them up?”
Eddy Keller looked at him strangely, “Damon Lopes, do you think I look stupid?”
Then Eddy Keller stroked his chin, his gaze carefully sweeping over the more than two hundred people from Berlin, “Odd, that Brudos guy isn’t here?”
“Or is it that his true body is here but nobody knows what he really looks like?”
“Someone else is coming out, must be Simon’s people. They all look so neatly organized.”
In the distance, a large group of people emerged from the airport, each of them solemn, regardless of gender, all uniformly dressed in smart clothing with a white base and blue trim.
“Why aren’t they deploying their mechas?”
“Deploying mechas requires energy, and since it’s not a battle right now, they surely have them stored in subspace equipment. That kind of space equipment is relatively cheap and convenient, but it’s fragile.”
At this moment, Eddy Keller, with arms crossed, spoke again, “Did everyone see that woman in the silver military uniform? She’s Gabriella, the monster of this year’s batch from Simoon Cathedral Academy.”
“A sophomore, seventeen years old, at the peak of the Sixth Heaven, and she personally designed and completed high-order mech weapons. She killed a Level 7 late-stage behemoth by the seaside.”
Looking at the girl in the silver military uniform with golden long hair and a stunningly beautiful face, many eyes showed astonishment and admiration.
So beautiful.
Damon Lopes looked at the blonde girl in the distance and the many exotic beauties from the Simon Camp, suppressing the impulse in his heart to add them as friends.
Everyone here is a genius, and he needed to maintain his image as an ‘Innate Awakened One.’
As the personnel from Berlin and Simon arrived, several countries from the surrounding area of Eastern Summer also had some participants come, including Qingqiu and Cross Mountain.
These geniuses were divided into three major camps based on their cultivation systems and further into small groups by country and school, all waiting at a short distance from each other.
Besides, there appeared some ‘senior’ geniuses who looked a bit older, under twenty years of age, each with a pressuring aura.
The weakest among them was starting from the mid-stage of the Sixth Heaven.
These ‘senior’ students, who had graduated one or two years ago and were few in number, either had their arms crossed or a cold expression, stood in the distance, waiting for the complete descent of the relic.
Looking at the nearly a thousand ‘geniuses’ around him, Denny Rhodes couldn’t help but exclaim, “Almost all of the top geniuses under the age of twenty from the Federation are gathered here.”
Betty Leinster nodded, “Pretty much, if something happened to everyone here, the Human Race would definitely suffer a significant blow.”
“Ugh… Senior Betty, we’re here to brave the relic. Can we not put up any flags? What if something really happens?” said Justin Welan, feeling a bit puzzled.
“Strange, why hasn’t Jack arrived yet?”
At that moment, another special fighter aircraft passed through the cracks, circled around, and landed on the cleared runway of the base.
As the fighter aircraft came to a standstill and the rear hatch opened, the last to arrive, Jack Clark, stepped down.
At the same time, smart wristwatches and communication devices of everyone went off with a cold electronic voice.
“Attention all, there is just over an hour left before the arrival of the relic. Currently, everyone is free to move around but engaging in combat is not permitted.”
“More than an hour left, huh.” Jack Clark, stepping out of the base, looked towards the distant fault in the void and the slowly approaching continental blocks, rather shocked.
“It’s Jack Clark.”
“Jack, you finally arrived.” Justin Welan shouted excitedly.
When Jack Clark’s figure appeared, the spirits of the more than two hundred people on the Southern Battlefield were immediately lifted, feeling as if their pillar had arrived.
And most of these people had once been blasted away by a single strike of Jack’s halberd.
However, that was not important. What mattered was that a monster had come to the Southern Variant Beast Battlefield.
Although Jane Aiken was strong, being only at the early stage of Sixth Heaven, she couldn’t suppress the situation today and was no match for Jack Clark, who had once rampaged through the Southern Battlefield in one day.
That overbearing presence of being invincible, sweeping away everything, still made everyone’s blood boil when they recalled it.
“His cultivation level…” Surprise flickered in Jane Aiken’s eyes.
In her eyes, every move Jack Clark made as he walked over resonated with the Heavenly Energy around them, achieving unity with heaven and man.
At the same time, the four Sword Intents within her felt an intense pressure, as if what was approaching was not a man but an Ancient Beast moving with a majestic aura.
Seventh Layer!
“Junior Clark, you’ve finally arrived.”
“Mr. Willard, Howard Lambert, Student Aiken, and Class Leader, Mandy Lewis, everyone’s here.”
“Senior Richards, Senior Sister Betty Leinster, hello everyone, and Junior Forbes, Junior Cosmo, and Senior Carney Turner.” The approaching Jack Clark greeted everyone with a smile, one by one.
Before Jack Clark and Justin Welan could catch up on old times, the geniuses from South Sky Martial Height spontaneously gathered around him enthusiastically, saying, “Junior Clark, you’re here.”
“Junior Clark, we haven’t seen you for two months, and you seem even more impressive than before.”
“Who is that guy?”
Many around, including the geniuses from Berlin and Simon Camp in the distance, looked curiously at the youth who was the center of attention.
After all, geniuses are quite arrogant, seldom admiring others, let alone being warmly surrounded by so many geniuses.
And among those who had seen Mathilda Ward’s concert, some found Jack Clark’s figure somewhat familiar.
“I know; that person is Jack Clark, the monstrous genius of this batch of first years from the Southern Battlefield.”
“More than three months ago, he broke through to the Fifth Layer Heaven, and within one day he pierced through the entire Southern Battlefield, charging over thousand kilometers, sweeping hundreds of peers, with nobody able to withstand a single move from him.”
“That strong?” Many showed surprised expressions in an instant.
What shocked them was not Jack Clark’s cultivation level from more than three months ago, but the fact that he could pierce through a Variant Beast Battlefield and sweep through hundreds of peers in one day.
His stamina was terrifying.
Just then, Damon Lopes came over and looking at Jack Clark, he commented with admiration, “Brother Callum, you are truly worthy of respect.”
What is a realm? This is a realm; he hadn’t expected this move.
If he had known earlier, he would have stayed on the train until the last moment, letting others discuss his identity as an Innate Awakened One first, allowing it to ferment, and then when he appeared, he would attract everyone’s attention.
“Brother Callum!”
Seeing Damon Lopes approaching and hearing him address Brother Callum, sisters Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis were both agape, staring at Jack Clark in disbelief.
Howard Lambert was even more shocked: “Jack Clark, you’re that first-grade genius at Seventh Layer Heaven who created his own Top-tier Secret Manual?”
Because of the shock, Howard Lambert’s voice was rather loud. Suddenly, everyone from Simon Camp and Berlin Camp involuntarily looked over, their faces revealing astonishment.
First-grade Seventh Layer Heaven, self-created Secret Manual!!

chapters.title: Chapter 613: 283: Relic Rule, Doomsday Continent
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Chapter 283: Relic Rule, Doomsday Continent
When Howard Lambert exclaimed “First Grade, Seventh Layer Heaven, Self-created Secret Manual” in a lost voice, the entire venue fell silent. Thousands of ‘Top-notch Geniuses’ all turned to look at Jack Clark in astonishment.
Inclusive of Baldas of Berlin and Gabriella from the Simon Cathedral Academy, who also showed surprise in their gazes as they looked over. After all, this achievement was indeed shocking.
However, Jack was slightly suspicious at that moment; he felt that the guy deliberately shouted so loud, after all, there was a precedent.
Back when he was at the Fourth Layer Heaven, having slain the Blood Armored Beast King with the combat power of a late-stage Level 5, his feat had spread throughout the South Sky Martial Height Base not long after his return.
Because the news spread so quickly, Jack had suspected that someone was targeting him.
“It really is you, Jack Clark.” Crystal Lewis said with a bitter smile.
She had subconsciously thought of Jack when she heard the words ‘Brother Callum’ from Damon Lopes earlier, but she dared not to confirm or believe it.
After all, creating a secret manual in two months and breaking through from the early Sixth Heaven to the Seventh was too exaggerated and had already refreshed the cultivation history records for the human race at this stage.
Betty Leinster gave a wry smile: “Indeed, still such a monster.”
Facing the astonished gazes of everyone, Jack replied with a smile, “You all don’t have to look at me like that. For us, cultivation is a long road, and I’m just walking a bit faster than you all at the moment.”
“Who knows, maybe I’ll get stuck at the Ninth Heavens for years or a decade down the line, and then you’ll catch up and surpass me.”
He made a fair point.
Hearing Jack’s words, the geniuses from Berlin Simon in the distance nodded slightly. The path of cultivation is about persistence, and only by taking one step at a time can one reach the peak.
For them, as long as they cultivate diligently, breaking through to higher realms is definitely achievable. Reaching the Eight Layer Heaven is within sight, and even the Ninth Heavens are not impossible.
Therefore, there’s no need to vie for short-term gains. Winning or losing doesn’t carry much significance.
At the same time, these individuals’ impressions of Jack suddenly became quite favorable. Although he was a genius with incredible talent, he seemed very humble and mild-mannered, without a trace of arrogance or conceit.
Compared to that, the individuals from the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy looked at Eddy Keller, then at Jack, and shook their heads in unison, sighing at the vast difference.
As opposed to those ‘outsiders’, Justin Welan, Howard Lambert, and the Lewis sisters, who had watched Jack’s rise all along, were internally scoffing.
That spiel about him just temporarily walking a bit faster than everyone else, was utterly unbelievable.
In just half a year’s time, with his ‘ordinary’ talent, he had surpassed them by two major realms, and they were both among the top geniuses from First-class Universities.
As for people like Sawyer Levin, who initially had similar talents to Jack, they couldn’t even see his taillights now.
Standing in front of Jack, Justin Welan shared in the glory and said with a proud smile, “Worthy of Jack, always astounding everyone and shocking those foreigners.”
“Actually, I didn’t intend to shock anyone,” Jack said, looking somewhat bemusedly at Damon Lopes. This guy must have been boasting about him for those reactions to be so intense.
But since his identity had been revealed today, he might as well let it be. In the human inner circle, it was impossible to hide anything anyway.
As soon as he brought out his Combat Shadow and weapon, even if he changed his face, people would recognize him at first glance.
If it weren’t for the Alien Beast Battlefield being cut off from the outside world, Justin and the gang would have recognized him a long time ago, given that his weapon was his calling card.
Originally, Cicely Rodgers allowed him to continue using the name Darren Callum, but it was for use in the mythical world in order to confuse the Evil God Sect and The Purgatory Family.
With the reach of The Purgatory Family and the Evil God Sect cut off and them being unfamiliar with the human inner circle, at the very least, it would buy him six months’ time.
And for a genius like him, six months was enough time for a drastic transformation. By the time the different races caught on, he might already be at the Ninth Heavens.
Of course, that was the view of the higher-ups like Tyler Lance. In Jack’s opinion, in six months, he might already have ascended to king-level.
After all, he would be nearly breaking through to the Eight Layer after the relic ended, and once he entered the mythical world, his strength might increase even faster.
Damon Lopes said with a laugh, “Brother Callum, I can’t be blamed for this. That guy forced his swagger onto me, and I could only use you to suppress him.”
“Come, let me introduce you to some of the geniuses present.”
With that, Damon Lopes pushed Justin Welan aside, enthusiastically put his arm around Jack’s shoulder, and pointed to a formidable young man in white robes floating in the distance.
“That guy is Eddy Keller, whom I was talking about. Numero uno when it comes to forced swagger, a bandit who always fancies himself as a refined scholar.”
“That one over there is Gabriella from the Simon Cathedral Academy. Pretty, huh? Want to go over and add her as a friend?”
“Oh, and that one over there is…”
Behind Jack, Justin Welan was a bit bewildered. What was going on? How come this Innate Awakened One seemed to be on better terms with Jack than he was?
Under the introductions of Damon Lopes, Jack had gained a bit of an impression of the rather famous geniuses present, including some from foreign nations.
Then came the wait.
Standing at the edge of the continental rift, the top-tier geniuses from the three great empires of the federation and over a dozen countries were all stunned as they stared at the Void Rift before them.
They saw a continental block with a width of over a thousand kilometers hurtling towards them, almost obscuring the Void due to its proximity, enveloping everything like a blanket.
Even Jack couldn’t help but have his breath catch at the sight.
Compared to this continental block of ancient times with a diameter of several thousand kilometers, those Giant Beasts hundreds and thousands of meters in size didn’t seem worth mentioning.
If it weren’t for the Void acting as a barrier, the sheer size and invisible gravity field emanating from this massive expanse of ancient relics would have caused a doomsday disaster on Blue Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 283: Relic Rule, Doomsday Continent_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Chapter 283: Relic Rule, Doomsday Continent_2
“`
Just imagine the scene of the moon approaching the atmosphere: gravity tearing, gravitational collapse causing sea water to fly skyward, volcano eruptions, crustal movement.
Justin Welan swallowed hard, “Jack, do you think we could be smashed to death?”
Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “…Don’t worry about it, if it was going to hit, it would have happened decades ago.”
Looking at the Ruins Continent, which would only border the void’s Boundary Wall in a little over an hour, Jack couldn’t help but sink his consciousness, arriving in the Water and Fire World.
At the edge of the Ice Crystal Platform, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the spine of the six-armed demon ape, “Indeed, to comprehend the Talent Runes from the remains of a giant beast is too difficult.”
A day passed, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon saw many incomplete Rune Trails on this spine, related to various talents of the six-armed demon ape.
But these Rune Sequence Chains were not only incomplete but also required discernment on which sequences were related to the Giantification Talent, and then combining them to induce the Talent Rune.
This task was colossal; it felt that under normal conditions, it would take at least several months to complete, but what it lacked was time.
So, in the end, it still had to resort to abnormal methods.
With that thought, both the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and Jack saw a transparent page appear in their view, their gaze sweeping over the Attribute points and settling on the data at the bottom.
Evolution value: 28020/30000
More than three months had passed since the Thunderflame Behemoth’s Fourth Evolution. In that time, it had consumed the flesh and blood of more than twenty level eight beasts, over a hundred Level 7 Alien Beasts, and two Level 9 Giants.
As for the several Level 9 Giants it hunted later, they were all given to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and others, helping them evolve and purify their bloodlines.
Under normal circumstances, the thirty thousand points of Evolution Energy should have been accumulated by now.
But this was based on the premise that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s size did not grow, always remaining more than 50 meters.
When it was Level 7, about one-tenth of the biological energy gained from consumption converted into Evolution Value, and that was when the accumulation of Evolution Energy was fastest.
It quickly broke through the ten thousand point mark.
However, after breaking through to Level 8 and growing over sixty meters, the speed of accumulating Evolution Value plummeted, with most of the biological energy being converted into energy for physical growth.
After reaching Level 9, the energy required for each meter of growth became even more terrifying, as it wasn’t just the tail growing but the entire body enlarging.
This meant that for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, now over one hundred and fifty meters long, every extra meter of growth was almost equivalent to growing more than ten meters back when it was Level 7 and over thirty meters long.
Further, its physical density was higher and its strength greater, so the energy converted from the flesh and blood of a Level 8 Giant Beast was only enough for it to grow about ten centimeters.
In such a situation, only the biological energy and Life Factors contained in fellow Level 9 Giants could allow it to grow faster.
However, Level 9 Giants, even amidst the myriad of Mutated Creatures in the ocean, were not plentiful. For example, within several thousand kilometers around the Water and Fire Dragon Palace, there were only about five.
It was during the slaying of these Level 9 Giants that it drew out a Mythical Giant Beast to act.
Hence, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon planned to hunt Level 7 and Level 8 Giants on a large scale, firstly growing to Mid Level 9, while simultaneously collecting crystals to boost one particular talent above the top tier.
When that time came, even if a Mythical Giant Beast descended, it would be able to come and go as it pleased.
Next, it would nurture strength through battle, devouring the Level 9 Giant Beast, quasi-mythical beasts of that Mythical Giant Beast power on the periphery, and finally, killing the Black Oblivion King.
At that thought, a cold light flashed in the golden vertical pupils of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
But before that, it needed to further strengthen its power, learn the Giantification Talent Rune of the six-armed demon ape, and bring its physical strength to the limit.
“Use 1000 Attribute points to activate the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s enlightenment state.”
As Jack’s realm of thought resonated in his mind, instantly 1000 Attribute points vanished, transforming into a special energy that passed through the Soul Channel and enveloped the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Under the Mysterious enlightenment of comprehension, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s consciousness became incredibly agile, its brilliance flashing, and everything between Heaven and Earth seemed simpler in its eyes.
Even the spine it was refining appeared infinitely magnified in its view.
Before it, the incomplete Rune Sequence Chains encircled, spun, and interwove, with each incomplete chain containing faint powers of Gigantification, Vibration, Defense, and Strength.
In the state of enlightenment, with terrifying speed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon weeded out and combined the sequences representing Giantification, gradually forming a Rune from nothing.
Burning Attribute Energy to enter enlightenment doesn’t enhance the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s thought process but the ‘enlightenment’ mindset formed by that Attribute Energy.
When that mindset’s power faded, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s consciousness would revert to normal.
Because of sharing the same master consciousness, Jack also had to control his own thought process not to overthink and consume the ‘comprehension energy.’
In such a state, the bored Jack turned his attention back to the matter of Avatar Evolution.
In fact, Giant Beast Avatar Evolution followed a complete pattern, such as the first evolution breaking through the biological limits of the Six-legged Salamander.
The second broke through the transcendent boundary, becoming a low-level exotic beast.
The third evolution broke through Level 4, transforming from a low-level extraordinary creature to an intermediate exotic beast, and then the fourth evolution broke through Level 7, becoming a high-level alien beast.
The next, the Fifth Evolution, is the Level 9 Peak, breaking through from a high-level extraordinary creature to a Mythical-level Giant Beast.
As Jack’s half-consciousness delved into the state of enlightenment, two powerful auras from the Base of Channel One surged into the sky, appearing over the heads of the people in a blink of an eye.
Boom! Boom!
The atmosphere vibrated, winds howled, clouds swirled, forming a vortex covering more than a dozen kilometers.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 283: Relic Rule, Doomsday Continent_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Chapter 283: Relic Rule, Doomsday Continent_3
In the center of that massive vortex hollow, two figures slowly emerged.
An instant of a king-level’s terrifying pressure descended from the sky, making everyone’s breath catch. They couldn’t help but become solemn and said respectfully,
“We’ve seen the two Great Kings.”
Among the two kings, one looked like a man in his twenties, his expression cold, standing with his hands behind his back.
The other, a middle-aged man, had a warm expression and smiled. “You don’t need to be so formal. The ruins are about to descend, and next, I’ll briefly explain the rules for this exploration.”
“Firstly, killing and looting is forbidden in this exploration of the ruins. You are all geniuses of the Human Race; your blades should be directed at foreign races, not used for internal slaughter.”
“Therefore, no matter who it is, if anyone commits the act of killing their kin, I will strike them dead on the spot the moment they come out.”
As the middle-aged man spoke, a terrifyingly cold killing intent flashed across him, and everyone felt a chill rising from their spines.
As kings who had walked over mountains of corpses and seas of blood, each one of them was decisive in his killings.
Having retracted his killing intent, the middle-aged man continued, “Secondly, the resources, inheritances, and even World Origin obtained within the ruins belong to individuals; the Federation will not interfere.”
“However, any inscriptions, Basic Runes, and books that are well-preserved and contain special powers must be imprinted with a copy to help the Federation in its research on the Ancient Civilization.”
“All right, having stated the rules, let me give you a brief introduction to the ruins.”
“This relic is a continental block that was forcibly uprooted by an ancient powerhouse and thrown into the Void with the purpose of preserving inheritance and the seeds of civilization.”
“But the enemy that destroyed the Ancient Civilization was very powerful, even pursuing them into the Void Continent and inciting a great war that destroyed everything.”
As the middle-aged man finished speaking, a genius from Berlin couldn’t help but exclaim in shock, “To uproot a whole continental block and throw it into the Void, the powerhouses of the Ancient Civilization were terrifying!”
Surprise could be seen on the faces of others as well—it was a whole continental plate, after all.
The middle-aged man smiled slightly. “Don’t be astonished; it is only about casting a continental plate into flight. The top few councilors can do it.”
“Let’s get back to the main issue. As a place of inheritance, the rules of the Void Continent are still operational, coming close to Blue Star once every few decades.”
“However, most areas have been eroded by the Void, becoming extremely dangerous. Only the central area within a range of 1,000 kilometers is considered a Safe Zone.”
“We call the central region ‘Oasis.’ It’s similar to the Outer World and quite safe, with some remnants of ancient architecture and relics preserved by their strength.”
“Outside the ‘Oasis,’ in the Ruin Area, many monsters reside.”
“These monsters come from the ‘People’ of the Ancient Civilization, the Extraordinary Creatures that once lived there, as well as enemies that were transformed by the erosion of Void Energy.”
“These Void Creatures vary in strength; some are strong, some weak, but even the weakest have the strength of the Fifth Layer Heaven. The deeper you go into the ruins, the more creatures you encounter, the stronger they are.”
“Now that I’ve given you an overview of the ruins, let’s talk about how to open the Road to Becoming a God.”
“Whether due to that war or not, the inheritance rules of the ruins have also changed. One needs to kill a large number of Void Creatures, absorbing a certain energy before the Road to Godhood will appear.”
“For every Void Creature you kill, you’ll be enveloped by a strand of special ‘Purple Killing Energy,’ which serves as the credential to enter the Road to Godhood.”
“The more Purple Killing Energy a person is entangled with, the more forward their starting point on the Road to Godhood will be when it appears, and they might even receive a share of the Origin as a reward immediately upon entry.”
“And every portion of Origin is invaluable; just ten portions are enough for one to step beyond the king-level at the Ninth Heaven Peak.”
Suddenly, many people couldn’t help but catch their breath.
Such a direct opportunity to gain a large amount of World Origin was extremely rare.
Knowing that many peak Ninth Heavens powers have reached all the requirements for a breakthrough, yet because they lack sufficient Origin, they have been stuck at the peak realm for years without advancing.
Noticing the fervent gaze from the crowd below, the middle-aged man smiled slightly, “Let me remind you that you need to accumulate a certain amount of Purple Killing Energy to enter the Road to Godhood.”
A young man from Simon’s camp politely asked, “May I ask the Great King, how much Purple Killing Energy is needed to enter the Road to Godhood? How can it be calculated?”
“Don’t worry, we’re prepared. This is a special secret treasure from the ruins, the Eye of Heaven Observation.”
“Next, each of you will channel a wisp of your Aura into it, and the Eye of Heaven Observation will split off a phantom Sub-eye. With the Sub-eye, you will be able to precisely determine the amount of Purple Killing Energy.”
“In addition, under the Eye of Heaven Observation’s main body conversion, once you enter the ruins, you will be able to contact others and share information through the Sub-eye, just like in the Outer World.”
As he spoke, a ten-meter diameter eye, predominantly white with golden pupils, slowly emerged before the middle-aged man and floated down from the sky with him.
“Alright, come one by one,” he said.
“I’ll go first,” said Eddy Keller, dressed in a White Robe, as he excitedly stepped forward, pressing his hand on the giant glass-like eyeball and sending True Strength into it.
Without sound or fanfare, a fist-sized Sub-eye detached itself and hovered in front of Eddy Keller.
“This is the Sub-eye,” Eddy Keller said curiously as he reached out to catch it.
“The Sub-eye is formed from your True Strength and is a part of you; therefore, it can attach to your smart wristwatch, to be Summoned when needed.”
“Next,” he added.
Soon it was the turn of those from the Southern Battlefield—Justin Welan, Howard Lambert…
When it came to Jack Clark, he too channeled True Strength, promptly splitting off a Sub-eye, and he immediately felt a faint connection to the eye.
It was quite normal to have a connection, as after reaching the Late Fourth Layer Heaven, cultivators merge their Will into True Strength, and by the time True Strength turns to flame in the Sixth Layer, the Will and True Strength are nearly one, with each portion of True Strength containing the cultivator’s Spiritual Will.
After everyone had been assigned a Sub-eye, Marcellus Larry slowly said, “Remember, when the sky whitens and a long river appears, that means the Road to Godhood is about to open.”
“However, whether you can obtain World Origin or how much you achieve depends on whether you can pass the trials inside the Road to Godhood.”
“The trials of the Road to Godhood are of three types: personal comprehension ability, outstanding combat power that spans Boundaries, and the most special of all, the soul.”
Blonde girl Gabriella from Simon Camp asked in confusion, “May I ask the Great King, how is the soul tested?”
In the face of this question, Marcellus Larry shook his head, “I don’t know either because only the First Councilor reached the depth of testing the soul back then.”
“You don’t need to worry about this question. There aren’t many here who can reach the depth of testing the soul. When the time comes, you will naturally find out.”
“Alright, you have ten minutes to prepare. After that, King Napoleon and I will jointly tear open the pathway and send you in.”

chapters.title: Chapter 616: 284: Infinite Stacking Q, Reversing the Rules of Life (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Chapter 284: Infinite Stacking Q, Reversing the Rules of Life (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
The so-called preparation naturally meant donning battle armor.
In Jack Clark’s Sumeru Bracelet, pieces of golden-red battle armor flew out, crackling as they transformed into a magnificent and fierce Dragon Blood Battle Armor that enveloped him.
Behind his head, four white-gold gears slowly rotated, with two emitting blue and golden radiance, mysteriously sanctified by the halo of the armor.
Howard Lambert still wore that black armor, studded with various spikes, and his shoulders bore two pairs of massive Unique Beast horns, giving off an aura of an ancient warrior’s roughness.
The battle armor of the Lewis sisters suited feminine aesthetics more, with red and blue crystalline armors that were both gorgeous and cool, while Jane Aiken’s green armor was quite stylish.
But…
Looking at Justin Welan’s predominantly yellow, thick armor full of cracks resembling a turtle shell, Jack Clark couldn’t help but remark, “Mr. Willard, isn’t there something a bit… off about your armor?”
“What’s wrong with it? It’s great,”
Justin Welan proudly claimed, “This is the Earth armor I forged, incorporating the Transcendent Materials essence of the tortoiseshell of a giant land turtle that my brother sent me.”
“Due to the same attribute as my cultivation methods, it can maximize the defense of the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth, and with my re-forged Giant Turtle Shield, my protection is even stronger.
“Um… I didn’t mean the defense; I’m talking about the design of your armor… Isn’t it a bit unique?”
Howard Lambert said solemnly, “What Jack means is, you look like a turtle.”
Snort! Mandy Lewis, who had been holding back, couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
At that moment, from afar someone exclaimed, “Damn, that’s a cool mecha.”
From a distance at Simon Camp, mech suits ranging from ten to twenty meters tall continually appeared, with most in humanoid form and a few shaped like Unique Beasts.
And the most formidable was a heavily built mecha interlaced in black and white, towering over forty meters with beast-like double claws and massive shoulders soaring meters high, like the Scale Horns of a Black Colossus.
Most importantly, standing in front of that formidable and domineering mecha was Gabriella with her brilliant, golden locks and a three-dimensional face of absolute beauty.
The contrast between the beauty and the beastly mecha was striking.
Compared to Eastern Summer and Berlin, Simon’s side seemed more imposing as they released one giant mecha after another from the Space Buckle’s subspace.
Their storage space for mechas differed from Jack Clark’s Sumeru Bracelet; they utilized a Folding Subspace, allowing them to store massive mecha suits.
However, apart from the corresponding mechas and ammunition, they could not fit other items due to a special metal forged into the hull of the mechas and ammunition, which produced a unique frequency that matched the Folding Subspace.
On Berlin’s side, a young man with fine black scales on his cheeks said indifferently, “Don’t mind those brutes. Once their ammunition is spent, they’re just oversized machines.”
“Indeed, once they run out of ammunition inside the relic, they can only rely on the kinetic energy of the mecha itself, and their strength will plummet.”
The three cultivation pathways of the Human Federation each had their own strengths and minor flaws.
At that time, Jack Clark inquired, “By the way, you all got your energy crystals and stuff, right?”
“Yes, they’re all inside the Sumeru Bracelet.”
As top-notch geniuses about to enter the relic, Jack Clark and the others had received resources from the Federation during their journey.
Energy crystals to restore True Strength, Spirit Marrow Liquid for rapid recovery of internal and external injuries, and energy bombs equivalent to the strike of a Sixth Heaven cultivator, among others.
“Get ready.”
As the time arrived, Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner uttered a low shout. Two rings of purple and white light surged skyward from them, transforming into two colossal figures over a hundred meters tall.
Boom!
No sooner had the terrifying Rule True Bodies appeared than the Heavenly Energy around them erupted within a ten-kilometer radius, causing a raging wind that enveloped them in solid white mist.
Under the wrap of formidable Law Power, the two king-level True Bodies reached out with a palm, immediately shattering the Dark Void ahead and tearing open a huge crack.
“Don’t resist.”
With that shout, a tremendous force pulled everyone into the pathway.
Delivered by the two kings, thousands of people turned into streaks of light, plunging into the Void Continent; they descended, scattering in all directions with the central Oasis as a midpoint.
…
The vast plain stretched out with a meandering small river, the grass vibrant green, and a gentle breeze blowing, like a wonderland in a painting.
Yet neither the plains nor the river showed any sign of life, no animals, insects, nor any fish or aquatic creatures.
Just then, sharp buzzing exploded in the sky as meteor-like streaks fell from the heavens.
At ten thousand meters altitude, watching the rapidly enlarging Earth below, Jack Clark unfolded his Flame Light Wings behind him, spewing hot airwaves that shattered the external forces enveloping him.
Whoosh! Jack Clark broke away from the group first.
Following that, Crystal Lewis’s flames burned, transforming into a pair of fiery wings, while Mandy Lewis’s gloomy blue glow flowed, dragging them as they chased after Jack Clark.
Having awakened their Elemental Talents, they were not only much stronger but also possessed some special abilities.
With wings spread, Jack Clark maneuvered the Heavenly Energy to spiral in the air before landing on a small hill, with the Lewis sisters following him.
In such strange surroundings, it was only natural to follow closer to a familiar and strong acquaintance for a sense of safety.
Apart from Jack Clark, Betty Leinster, Denny Rhodes, and Carney Koch, geniuses with more accumulated experience also had gliding skills, their armor sparkling in various colors as they separated from the main group.
Without the ability to fly, Justin Welan and Howard Lambert continued to fall, protected by their strength, until they eventually crashed onto the distant Earth with a thud.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: 284 Infinite Stack Q, Reverse Life Rule (Request for Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Chapter 284 Infinite Stack Q, Reverse Life Rule (Request for Monthly Pass)_2
Boom boom boom!! The ground shattered and smoke and dust rolled.
“Cough cough!! I thought we’d be teleported in instantly, not fall from the sky.” Wearing battle armor, Justin Welan crawled out of a ten-meter-wide crater looking somewhat disheveled.
Not far away, Howard Lambert and Freddy Nelson, among others, were much the same, all covered in dust.
However, protected by King’s Power, although everyone fell from a great height, they suffered no harm apart from their Qi Blood boiling a bit.
On the hillside, Jack Clark looked around and noticed that everyone who landed here belonged to the Southern Battlefield, including more than a dozen ‘old’ geniuses who had already graduated.
Clearly, the official arrangement was to divide people based on their affiliations to avoid conflicts when coming across opportunities and to explore a wider range.
Soon, Howard Lambert, Justin Welan, and Jane Aiken gathered together.
Because she was only interested in cultivation and too lazy to earn Contribution Points, Jane Aiken’s battle armor was just ordinary extraordinary battle armor without added features like gliding.
“Jack, what do you plan to do next?” Justin Welan asked.
“I… will probably head over there,” Jack said, looking behind him at the edge of the land a dozen kilometers away, where heaven and earth were dim, filled with the ominous aura of Doomsday.
Rather than entering the Oasis in hopes of lucking into relics, Jack believed more in his own strength.
Though the Oasis spanned 1,000 kilometers in diameter, comparable to several provinces, it had already been explored by the first batch of Innate Awakened Ones decades ago.
Crystal Lewis shook her head slightly, “I won’t head to the ruins with Miss Karen; we’re planning to explore the Oasis.”
Justin Welan nodded as well, “Jack, I’m also planning to explore the Oasis and try my luck. The ruins are still a bit too dangerous for me and the Class Leader.”
They had just broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven and hadn’t even had time to consolidate their strength. Heading into the Doomsday Ruins, where the minimum requirement was at least Fifth Layer Heaven, was basically courting death.
As geniuses, they were aware of their limitations. Their purpose for entering was to look for possible inheritance opportunities.
Jack Clark smiled slightly, “It’s good that you think this way. Safety first, no need to rush.”
“This relic is an opportunity, but just one opportunity. Even without any gains, it doesn’t mean you can’t break through to the Nine Layers Heaven or even become a king in the future.”
With that, Jack’s gaze fell on Howard Lambert.
Howard Lambert declared in a booming voice, “Don’t worry, I’ll be more cautious.”
Seeing this, Jack said no more. Everyone who came in was a genius with their own ideas and goals; he wasn’t a nanny and didn’t have the energy to look after them.
As for Jane Aiken, her gains this time should be astounding.
With four Sword Intents and her cultivation at the Early Sixth Heaven, her strength was at least at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage or even at its peak, capable of slaying numerous Void Creatures and entering the Road to Becoming a God.
With her enlightenment, she was sure to go far eventually.
But it seemed he wasn’t far behind either. Thinking this, the corners of Jack’s mouth rose slightly.
“Everyone, be careful in this relic, safety first, see you on the Road to Godhood.”
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
As he spoke, figures like Betty Leinster and Denny Rhodes burst forth with the Aura of the Early Sixth Layer Heaven, turning into streaks of Radiance heading towards the distant Doomsday Ruins.
Besides them, those old ‘geniuses’ who remained silent after appearing also burst forth with the strength of the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, and even the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, shooting out.
Though these people hadn’t broken through to the Sixth Layer while in school, most of them graduated at the peak or late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven. A year or two had passed, and their strength was much more profound than that of people like Betty Leinster.
However, compared to a freak like Jack, who reached the Seventh Layer Heaven in First Grade, even these former geniuses seemed a little lackluster.
Justin Welan and the Lewis sisters also said farewell to the group, along with some Fifth Layer Heaven First and Second Grade students as they ran towards the distant Oasis mountain ranges.
Aside from Jack’s trio among the First Grade, Ian Carter—who had once had a brief encounter with Jack—and Freddy Nelson, who was once ranked first, both had their sights set on the relic ruins as well.
But they merely greeted each other before dashing towards different directions.
The entire relic was too vast, with the central Oasis spanning thousands of kilometers—let alone the ruins of Doomsday that exceeded millions of square kilometers.
In such conditions, a thousand people thrown in would virtually disappear in the blink of an eye.
Soon, Jack’s trio reached the edge of the ruins and the Oasis, which was a world apart.
The sky was gloomy and oppressive, the ground cracked and dry—let alone life, not even a single weed could be seen, echoing with the atmosphere of a desolate Doomsday.
