As the three passed through that invisible barrier, they felt as if they had entered another world in an instant, where Heavenly Energy was scarce, mixed with the destructive and dark power of annihilation.
Jack said in a stern voice, “Be careful. The potency of True Strength when released externally will be reduced here, and recovery will also be suppressed by the Void Energy—we can only rely on the Energy Crystal Body.”
Jane Aiken nodded slightly, “In such places, the Mech Martial Practitioners from Berlin, with their strong bodies, and less reliance on True Strength, are better suited.”
“And as for the Martial Arts Cultivators from Simon, despite their strong firepower, they depend even more on ammunition.”
“Same old rule, safety first, let’s all be extra careful.”
After speaking, the three split up and dashed towards three different directions at an angle, with no immediate plan to work together.
Moving at Supersonic Speed with the sound of sonic booms, Jack traversed over a hundred kilometers in just a moment, kicking up a raging wind and smoke and dust as he stopped on a small hill a kilometer high.
“This is Void Energy? It’s somewhat similar to the power of the Void Double Pupils.”
After crossing a hundred kilometers, Jack noticed that the world’s destructive and violent energy grew denser, and the Heavenly Energy was no longer perceptible.

chapters.title: Chapter 618: 284 Infinite Stack Q, Reverse Life Rule (Request for Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: Chapter 284 Infinite Stack Q, Reverse Life Rule (Request for Monthly Pass)_3
And the Void Energy was somewhat similar to the power contained within his Void Double Pupils, but it seemed to be of a lower grade, more mixed and chaotic.
Whoo-whoo-whoo!!
Shattered, worn, the ruins resembling an ancient small town had most of their structures rotted away, leaving only some wooden stakes and foundation walls standing proud.
Amidst the ruins of the small town, dozens of eerie shadows roamed.
These ‘people’ were 2 meters tall, covered in purple scale armor, with tendrils of black-purple smoke-like energy swirling around them, exuding an oppressive aura comparable to the Fifth Layer Heaven.
Among these figures were two ancient soldiers wearing broken black armor, towering over 3 meters tall, holding spears tarnished with rust.
The coercive presence emanating from those two soldiers was even stronger, with large swathes of purple-black fog enveloping them, patrolling and guarding the small town following the obsessions of their former lives.
“Are these the monsters mutated by Void Energy? How strange, they’re entirely different from Mutated Beasts and Giant Beasts,”
Beneath the collapsed city wall in the distance, there was a dark area with a 10-meter radius, where Jack Clark, hidden in the darkness, restrained his aura and observed the monsters in the distance.
With the concealment of the Dark Curtain and the reduced presence provided by the Hidden God Method, Jack Clark completely vanished, undetectable even tens of meters away by those Void Creatures.
Of course, this trick wouldn’t work under the sun.
Watching the two armored ancient soldiers in the distance, Jack Clark’s eyes, with their black gold vertical pupils, slowly emerged, followed by a burst of Void Energy.
Bang!!
Accompanied by a sound like a mirror shattering, a 5-meter radius space around the ancient soldier fractured, and countless black cracks spread out, slicing and tearing everything apart.
Including the ancient soldier with the aura of the Sixth Heaven, whose tough and formidable body instantly shattered into dozens of pieces scattered on the ground.
The sudden turn of events startled the monsters, which then fiercely turned towards the source of the disturbance, where the darkness dissipated to reveal Jack Clark clothed in magnificent gold armor.
Looking at the distant shattered corpse, Jack Clark pondered after testing his Void Double Pupils, “The minimum consumption requires 10% of my Void Energy, huh.”
Roar-roar!!
The violent aura on those Void Creatures burst forth, transforming into streaks of black shadow that shot explosively towards Jack Clark, collapsing walls and fracturing the ground in their wake, their momentum staggering.
As he watched the approaching Void Creatures, Jack Clark slowly clenched his fists, the muscles throughout his body unleashing their strength, and instantly, a terrifying power that could shake Heaven and Earth permeated the air.
Simultaneously, a figure covered in black-red armor, rising 30 meters tall, slowly emerged, and in an instant, Jack Clark’s aura soared.
Boom!
Under the augmentation of the Combat Shadow, the already terrifying strength and defense of Jack Clark increased fivefold, his body wrapped in flashing thunder and burning golden flames.
The tremendous force caused the surrounding air to explode, creating a gust of raging wind that fanned out from Jack Clark at the center, flinging dust and stones while the ground trembled.
Jack Clark’s right hand seemed to clench into a fist and form a seal, as an endless roar of power surged within him. The lightning and flames encircling him converged on his right hand.
At the same time, the Combat Shadow behind Jack Clark also formed the same fist and seal with its right hand, instantly drawing the sparse Heavenly Energy within a hundred meters towards it, swarming in.
“Divine Might, Destruction.”
Boom!
A punch wrapped in Thunderflame caused the ground to collapse, matter to disintegrate, and even the air to condense into liquid, creating a Destructive Shockwave that burst forth explosively in every direction.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The shockwave, comparable to a 10+ category typhoon, brought down hundred-meter stretch of walls, sending debris flying in all directions and shrouding the area in smoke and dust. The earth-shattering roar and tremors echoed without end.
When the smoke and dust finally dispersed, the street ahead and the broken buildings in ruins had vanished, leaving only a large crater radiating dozens of meters forward.
As for those dozens of creatures from the Initial and Mid stages of the Fifth Layer Heaven and the Sixth Layer Heaven, all were obliterated under Jack Clark’s punch, leaving no remains or bones behind.
The Giant Beast Avatar’s breakthrough to Level 9, in return, made Jack’s physical body even more terrifying. Coupled with the 12-fold True Strength amplification from the Combat Shadow, the enhancement from all the gifted powers, and the True Dragon Power,
with all these advantages combined, Jack at the Early Stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven in his normal state already rivaled an expert at the Early Phase of the Eighth Layer Heaven, directly leapfrogging an entire level.
His every move was comparable to an Eighth Layer expert, destroying an entire street with a single punch.
Should he also wield the Eight Desolate War Halberd and stimulate his Battle Intent, his strength would be even greater, not to mention his trump card, the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form.
At this moment, streams of black-purple fog appeared ahead, drifting towards Jack, transforming into streams of purple energy about 0.5 meters in length and as thick as a thumb, swirling around him.
Simultaneously, the number 93 appeared in the Heavenly Eye attached to his smart wristwatch.
Glancing at the surrounding killing intent embodied as purple fog, Jack’s gaze settled on the number 93, and he pondered for a moment.
The creatures just now numbered forty-five, two of which were at the Early and Mid stages of the Sixth Layer Heaven, while the rest were all at the Initial Stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven, with a few having auras in the Mid and Late periods.
Based on the amount of Purple Killing Energy obtained, he estimated that each Fifth Layer Heaven creature was worth about 1-3 points, while those at the early stage of the Sixth Layer might be worth around 10 to 30.
The king-level figure had once stated during the division of the Heavenly Eye that the minimum requirement to step onto the path of myth was 1000 points of Purple Killing Energy.
Calculating this, Jack’s face immediately showed a faint smile because this requirement was hardly a challenge for him; killing a few Level 7 Void Creatures would be enough to accumulate the needed amount.
In a good mood, Jack’s attention returned to those swirling streams of purple-black fog, his curiosity leading him to reach out, “What is this Purple Killing Energy?”
Hmm!
As Jack’s hand came into contact with the purple-black fog, a suction force emanated from his eyes. A special energy flowed up his arm and into his eyes, absorbed by the Void Double Pupils.
Surprise flashed across Jack’s eyes, “My eyes, they seem to have gotten stronger!”
He could clearly sense that after absorbing the special energy carried by the purple-black fog, the power of his Void Double Pupils had increased slightly.
This enhancement was unique; it wasn’t an increase in the level of his talent nor a surge in Void Energy but rather a special kind of augmentation.
Thinking this, Jack couldn’t help but summon the attribute page with a thought.
Talent: Void Double Pupils+45 [Top-tier: Eyes containing Void Power, passively activated: Void Devouring, a special Rule Power belonging to the Void.
For every Void Unique Creature killed and for each stream of Void Energy absorbed, gain one point of Void augmentation that defies the regular rules of life.
Each point of augmentation increases damage by a thousandth of a percent, with no upper limit.
Note: Only those Void Unique Creatures killed by the owner of the Void Double Pupils can absorb power and earn augmentation.]
Reading the newly refreshed note behind his talent, even Jack couldn’t help but be shocked.
An augmentation of a thousandth of a percent per point might not sound very strong, but the problem is there’s no limit.
This is even more exaggerated than stacking Q; with every Void creature he kills, he could add another layer.
Without any upper limit, just imagine if he were to kill tens of thousands of Void Creatures, wouldn’t the might of his Void Double Pupils increase by dozens of times?

chapters.title: Chapter 619: 285: Massacre and Sweeping through the Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Chapter 285: Massacre and Sweeping through the Ruins
Jack Clark put away the attribute page and slowly said, “It seems I’m being forced to go on a killing spree.”
Top-tier talent is strong, as one can see from the terrifying battle strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
But no matter how strong the talent, one also needs a strong foundation. For example, when the Level 4 Sword Armor Beast had top-tier strength and defense, it didn’t look that exaggerated.
In the same vein, now limited by his Seventh Layer Heaven cultivation, with full strength burst of the Void Double Pupils, Jack could cross a Major Realm to kill those in the early stages of Eight Layer Heaven.
A cultivator at the mid-period of Eight Layer Heaven, if prepared, would at most be injured.
Normally, the power of the Void Double Pupils capable of crossing a Major Realm is strong. For top-notch geniuses like Howard Lambert who awakened it, it is enough to become their ultimate secret move.
But for Jack, who has a Normal Battle Strength almost comparable to the early stage of Eight Layer Heaven at the early phase of Seventh Layer, it becomes somewhat superfluous, simply adding another method to his combat arsenal.
However, now that the passive activation of the Void Double Pupils seems to hold the promise of becoming Jack’s third ace.
This percentage boost characteristic from the Void Rules counts as additional damage, not increasing his consumption or hindering his growth.
That is to say, even if he breaks through to the Ninth Heavens, as the foundational power of the Void Double Pupils skyrockets tenfold or more, the boost from the Void Law remains just as strong.
Under these circumstances, the priority for relic exploration wanes in favor of slaughter.
It would be best to massacre a hundred thousand Void Creatures, intensifying the boost of the Void Double Pupils to a hundredfold. By then, his Level 9 Peak self could instantly kill a king-level being with just a glance.
Boom!
Golden flames shone around Jack, his aura erupting unrestrained, and with a flash of his figure breaking through the air, he began sweeping around the oasis.
The deeper one goes into the ruins, the stronger the Void Creatures become.
And yet, the Void Devouring power is based on ‘life’ as a unit, meaning killing a Fifth Layer or Eight Layer beast still only yields an increase of 1 point.
Under such conditions, it’s most efficient to stack layers by killing the weaker soldiers, although these soldiers are at least of the Fifth Layer.
Amidst sonic booms, Jack quickly dashed tens of kilometers, approaching a rift in the earth that formed a dark crevasse more than 200 meters wide and extending over ten kilometers, akin to an abyss.
Boom!
A radius of several meters in the ground collapsed and with the intense rebound, Jack shot forward like a bullet, turning into a beam of golden light about to cross the rift.
Roar! Accompanied by a furious and brutish roar, a massive shadow unfolded its wings from below, hurtling up to meet him.
This was a Pollution Beast, shaped like a Pterosaur, with wings spanning over 30 meters, a body length of more than 20 meters, covered in decaying black scale armor, bristling with bone spurs.
Boom!
The heavy War Halberd, emanating golden light, swept across at Supersonic Speed, obliterating the air in front of it and forming a pitch-black vacuum of immense pressure stretching over ten meters.
Before the Level 6 polluted monster could react, its fierce head and half of its body exploded into the air, scattering black and purple flesh and blood everywhere, with its enormous corpse accompanied by black smoke falling downward.
However, this obstruction from the polluted monster caused Jack’s figure to pause midair, and with Flame Light Wings unfurling behind him, he shot fiery gusts of air and landed on the opposite bank.
Below the rift surged a great swath of purple-black fog. Jack reached out with one hand, absorbing the Void power within it.
On the deathly still Earth reminiscent of Doomsday, a golden light streaked across the land, attracting the attention of numerous Void polluted monsters with his unmasked aura.
Whoo! Whoo!
Three humanoid creatures over 2 meters tall, covered in black and purple scales, wailed piteously and rushed out from the shadows of giant boulders, turning into three black figures.
On the claws of these Fifth Layer beasts glinted more than a meter-long black Radiance, emanating a sharp Aura that left dark, long streaks in the air.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Before the three polluted monsters could get within ten meters of the golden light, they hadn’t even reacted before being blown to bits under the heavy and Overbearing swing of the War Halberd, reduced to nothingness.
The mighty force continued unabated, shattering the Earth and sending dirt and rocks flying into the air in a turbulent gust, forming a crater over twenty meters wide.
After annihilating three polluted monsters, Jack stopped in his tracks, his expression cold as he stood holding a halberd, watching as clumps of purple-black fog gathered in front of him.
Soon, under the influence of the Ruins Continent rules, the purple Killing Energy headed for Jack, blending into the swirling purple-black fog encircling him as it passed through his palm.
Deep within the ruins, more than sixty kilometers out, Howard Lambert, whose battle armor expanded and standing over 3 meters tall, fought wildly while carrying a Steel Pillar like one might carry a simple pillar.
He was up against roughly twenty humanoid creatures of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and a three-meter-tall Armored Soldier wielding a massive combat knife and exuding the Aura of an Early Sixth Heaven.
In a nearby crater with a diameter of over ten meters, one of the knife-wielding Armored Monsters had already been smashed to pieces by Howard.
Suddenly, a beam of golden light appeared, which, upon noticing the battle here, veered and shot over at high speed.
“Howard, I’ll help you,” Jack called out, accompanied by a sonic boom, as the golden light instantly surged into the swarm of monsters, shattering the ground where it passed and instantly blasting each monster to pieces with swings of the War Halberd.
Before Howard could even react, the monsters that had given him such trouble were gone.
Amidst the remains of the monsters, Jack Clark, clad in Golden Red Battle Armor and holding the halberd, stood and gave a slight smile to the stunned Howard. “We’re classmates, there’s no need to thank me. See you.”
Jack swept his hand through the converging purple-black Killing Intent, his body shimmered with golden light, and with a roar amidst the sonic boom, he shot off once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 620: 285: Massacre and Sweeping Through the Ruins_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Chapter 285: Massacre and Sweeping Through the Ruins_2
Howard Lambert, transformed into the Bull Devil Battle Body and holding a pillar, stood in place somewhat confused, “No, why should I thank you? I need to kill these Void Creatures to accumulate Purple Killing Energy.”
In reality, being besieged by so many monsters did put some pressure on Howard Lambert, and if it wasn’t for Jack Clark’s appearance, he might have suffered a heavy injury once again by the end.
Soon after, Jack Clark traveled tens of kilometers and encountered Ian Carter from River Martial Height.
As a monster genius who had comprehended Sword Intent back in the Triplex Heaven, Ian had not been seen in half a year. His cultivation level had already made a breakthrough to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, with Sword Qi flowing around his body as he looked at a distant collapsed stone temple.
Atop that ruin of a stone temple, there coiled a grey-white python, approximately thirty meters in length, with four deformed heads and a row of twisted bone spurs on its back.
This was a Mid-Stage Sixth-level Mutant Monster with formidable strength, but Ian Carter, with Netherworld Sword Intent already at grand accomplishment, was confident he could slay it.
Just as Ian’s body was coursing with Sword Qi, preparing to kill the monster and explore the stone temple… Boom!
From afar, a sonic boom roared, and a streak of golden light rapidly approached. Against the furious and raging Polluted Giant Python, a golden War Halberd Radiance flashed, extending over twenty meters in length.
Boom!
With one strike of Infernal Purgatory, the temple ruins collapsed, and the four-headed python that was hissing wildly was directly blown up, soon followed by a huge golden mushroom cloud rising slowly into the air.
The land trembled under the destructive power, and the shockwave sent a violent wind wave hundreds of meters out, with loose stones clattering against the protective True Strength around Ian.
When the smoke and dust had cleared, Ian, seeing only the head and tail left of the giant python corpse and a crater tens of meters wide that had destroyed the stone temple as well, was somewhat flabbergasted.
What, where’s my monster?
Quickly, Jack Clark passed through the deployment area of the Southern Battlefield and entered the vicinity where Simon’s students were located.
The twenty-one-meter-tall silver Mecha, wielding a huge sword with energy radiance flickering on the blade, continuously slashed down one Pollution Beast after another, each over ten to twenty meters in length.
Boom!
A Polluted Giant Lizard, spanning over twenty meters, pounced onto the Mecha. Its sharp claws shined with a black radiance as they tore through the energy shield of the Mecha’s surface, leaving several deep gashes on the hard exterior.
The massive strength carried by its enormous body forced the Mecha to stagger back several steps.
Just then, the Mecha’s arms shot out scorching radiance, the powerful engine thrust shaking off the Polluted Giant Lizard as Sword Qi, several meters long, shimmered on the battle sword.
Boom!
Accompanied by the sword blade, the earth tore apart as if bisected by a thirty-meter-long giant sword. The scale armor of the Polluted Giant Lizard shattered, and it howled as a wound over ten meters long was slashed across its back.
Howl! Howl!!
Two Level 5 Pollution Beasts lunged in from the sides, but the Mecha, which had been about to finish off the wounded Giant Lizard, swung its battle sword in a sweep, cleaving both Pollution Beasts in half.
To conserve ammunition for possibly stronger monsters later, Carlos did not activate the Mecha’s full power function, saving the energy cannon and crystal missiles.
Even so, Carlos, at the Early Sixth Heaven stage estimated it would take over ten minutes to kill all these monsters, though the energy consumption might be high, and the unending attacks from the beasts would inflict some damage on the Mecha.
Everyone who could reach this place had strong combat capabilities, almost all capable of surpassing three minor levels below the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Or to put it another way, if one couldn’t surpass three minor levels, they didn’t deserve to be called a top-notch genius and had no right to be selected by the Federation to enter the relic.
Just as Carlos was fighting the monsters and occasionally slaying one to accumulate Purple Killing Energy, a golden radiance burst into the battlefield from a distance.
Thump, thump, thump!!
The golden halberd enveloped in radiant light whirled around, exploding everything in its path.
In the blink of an eye, the remaining dozen or so Level 5 Pollution Beasts, along with the Level 6 Exotic Beast that Carlos had heavily injured, all had their heads explode, spraying copious amounts of black blood.
Standing atop the corpse of a Level 6 Giant Lizard, Jack Clark wielded his War Halberd and waved his left hand at Carlos, who was controlling the Mecha, “Brother, that was a bit dangerous earlier. Lucky I arrived just in time.”
“No need to thank me, see you.”
As Jack spoke, wisps of purple-black fog gathered from the corpses, with most of it flying toward him.
“No, I…” Before Carlos could finish, Jack had already burst through the air, turning into a golden radiance and shooting towards the distance.
“Damn it, this guy stole my monster.” Carlos realized only then, but by that time Jack had already vanished beyond the Dark Earth’s horizon.
Atop a small hill hundreds of meters high, a genius of Simon’s gazed at the streak of golden light that crossed the distance in surprise, “Has that guy gone mad? Bursting at supersonic speed in a place like this, isn’t he afraid of exhausting his True Strength?”
Roar!
Standing over twenty meters tall, Balderas, who resembled a Human-shaped White Tiger, was enveloped by a terrifying strength that distorted the Void around him due to its intensity.
His opponent was a Polluted Giant Beast, forty meters in length, resembling a small hill with a dark purple mist swirling around it like clouds, emitting a mid-stage Level 7 heavy Aura.
This area, deep into the ruins for hundreds of kilometers, was predominantly occupied by Void Creatures of Level 6, with many monsters reaching Level 7.
Roar! Roar!!
The two massive creatures roared as they trampled the Earth, thundering toward each other.
As they neared collision, Balderas’s right claw shone with a sharp, blinding White Light, transcending space and, being later but arriving first, struck down upon the head of the Polluted Giant Beast.
Boom!
Under Balderas’s claw strike, the beast’s meter-thick protective energy shield instantly shattered, its head collapsed, and its enormous body crashed to the ground with a thunderous impact, raising billowing dust and smoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 621: 285: Massacre and Sweeping Through the Ruins_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: Chapter 285: Massacre and Sweeping Through the Ruins_3
Standing in front of the corpse of the polluted giant beast, Balderas, who was like a humanoid giant beast, emitted a terrifying aura, ferocious and brutally violent.
At that moment, black-purple fog billowed from the body of the void creature, turning into swathes of Purple Killing Energy that coiled around Balderas, making him appear even more fierce.
With heavy steps crushing the earth, Balderas marched towards the depths of the ruins like a real giant beast. All the monsters he encountered along the way were slapped to death by his palm.
In such a place where the energy of Heaven and Earth was so thin that it could not be stirred, manifesting the Beast King battle body and moving purely through physical action became more convenient for them.
Meanwhile, in another place, Eddy Keller stood proudly atop a hundred-meter-tall tree, only its dead trunk remaining, overlooking his surroundings and arrogantly saying.
“You void creatures polluted by the void, still daring to roar at the sight of this genius, you truly do not know whether to live or die.”
“Now kneel down and beg for mercy. If this genius is in a good mood, perhaps I might spare your lives.”
In this forest of bare black tree trunks, a pack of void creatures resembling wolves, with shoulders about a dozen meters high and bodies around twenty meters long, covered in bone spurs, encircled him.
As Eddy Keller spoke, the response was a series of violent roars. Following that, powerful strength burst forth from these void creatures, their mouths flickering with light.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A meter-thick black Breath tore through the forest, destroying everything. Tree trunks several meters thick and more than ten meters long exploded, submerging Eddy Keller a hundred meters away in the blink of an eye.
“To think you dare attack this genius, you’re courting death.”
Within the black explosion of firelight, a beam of white brilliance shone, turning into a white Divine Dragon over forty meters long that lightning-fast pierced through all the polluted bone wolves.
In the face of the white Divine Dragon that Eddy Keller’s true martial arts phantom had become, the sixth-level polluted bone wolves’ heads exploded one by one, killed off in the blink of an eye, as easily as crushing dry weeds and smashing rotten wood.
Roar! The Divine Dragon roared, and its brilliance flickered, revealing Eddy Keller’s figure.
Standing atop the largest corpse of the polluted bone wolves, Eddy Keller stood with his hands behind his back, his white clothes fluttering, vainly praising himself: “It’s no wonder I am who I am, so powerful, life really is as lonely as snow.”
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
The shoulders of the Mecha, standing over forty meters tall, opened up, launching high-explosive energy missiles that covered the stone architecture ahead in their range, the intense explosions nearly lighting up the sky, the ground shaking.
With just one volley, the buildings and ruins ahead were leveled, including the dozens of polluted monsters lurking inside.
Inside the Mecha, Gabriella sat in the cockpit wearing a red combat suit, looking at the slowly dispersing smoke and dust and the gathering black and purple killing energy in front with a cold gaze.
Elsewhere, over a hundred kilometers deep into the ruins, Jane Aiken clad in Green Armor moved between the ruins of what resembled a small ancient town.
Around her, four battle swords, two meters long, danced in the air, their red, black, blue, and purple sword lights breathing in and out, surrounded by sharp Sword Intent.
Under the four nearly fully realized Sword Intents, the four battle swords intertwined like flying swords, forming a sword net that minced all oncoming humanoid monsters.
Even two Late Sixth Heavenly Stage warriors in bronze armor were no match for the sweeping sword lights and were slain in moments along with all other polluted monsters.
Standing amidst the small town ruins, the girl enveloped in swirling sword lights, cut a figure akin to the legendary Sword Immortals who wielded flying swords—unrestrained and powerful.
This was the ultimate move that Jane Aiken had cultivated after her breakthrough to the Sixth Heavenly Stage and the blazing of her True Power into flames.
The Transcendent Battleswords carried Sword Intent, enhancing their power and lethality. Powered by True Power infused with Spiritual Will, they created a twenty-meter radius domain of flying swords.
Within this domain, the four flying swords moved unimpeded, as swift as lightning, their power truly astonishing.
At this moment, battles erupted all over the Void Continent. The geniuses of the Human Clan, using the Oasis as a center, ventured into the Doomsday Ruins in all directions.
In front of these geniuses, whose battle strength far exceeded their realms, hordes of polluted monsters were being continuously slain, and at the same time… there were also human deaths.
Boom!
Under the claw of a Giant Beast resembling a Western Dragon, over 40 meters in length with black gold scales, the energy defense of the 20-meter-tall Mecha shattered, and its structure exploded.
“No!”
…
Outside, at the edge of the Void Rift, two king-level figures stood tall in the sky, in front of them a ten-meter-wide Eye of Heaven slowly rotated, continuously reflecting the silhouettes of various individuals.
Marcellus Larry looked at two broken bubbles and sighed lightly, “Two dead so quickly.”
Lori Joyner, with her hands clasped behind her back, responded indifferently, “That’s normal; they were entering the ruins for exploration, not for leisure. Casualties are to be expected.”
“Besides, the danger in the ruins is quite low now. Think back to when we first entered—the Innate Awakened Ones had over a dozen casualties.”
“True,” Marcellus Larry said, his eyes filled with sentiment.
In the Dark Age, nearly all of the first capable of cultivation were geniuses of extraordinary talent, and there were dozens of Innate Awakened Ones, each of them powerful figures in their own right.
After the emergence of the ancient relics, most of the strong individuals under the age of twenty rushed in.
There were no ‘kings’, no Eye of Heaven; everyone who entered appeared in the Ruin Area, teeming with countless monsters, and many died unexpectedly.
It wasn’t until the First Councilor led everyone out of the ruins and into the Oasis that they began to reap rewards, and by the end of the relics, the high-end power of mankind burst forth.
At this moment, with a grave expression, Lori Joyner suddenly said, “Mr. Whitlock, pull up the Purple Killing Energy rankings and take a look.”
“They’ve only been in there for just over two hours; the rankings shouldn’t have changed much.”
As Marcellus Larry said this, he clicked on the Eye of Heaven. A ray of light shot from the eye, materializing into a ranking list encompassing everyone in the sky.
Numbers were jumping beside the names at the top of the list, while those like Justin Welan who had entered the Oasis were marked with a zero behind their names.
At that moment, the first place on the list was Gabriella, with 892 in Purple Killing Energy, and second place was Eddy Keller, with 815.
“That Jack Clark is only in the eighties with 412 points?” Lori Joyner was somewhat surprised.
Marcellus Larry was also somewhat surprised, “Indeed, that lad, with his strength and talent, should be in the top five on this list. He shouldn’t have so few points.”
As he spoke, Marcellus Larry clicked again on the massive eyeball, causing numerous tiny scenes to swirl about, bringing into view Jack Clark from a high-altitude perspective.
With Sub-eye Positioning, using this relic core from the Inheritance Continent, they could see from the outside what was happening on the inside.
However, the rules of the Inheritance Continent only allow geniuses under the age of twenty to enter. If a king tried to forcibly descend, it would trigger a Void tide that would prematurely push away the Inheritance Continent.
The moment Jack Clark’s figure appeared, both Lori Joyner and Marcellus Larry were taken aback.
“What is he doing?”
In the great eye above, a streak of golden light moved across the land, circling the edge of the ruins centered around the Oasis, blasting one ‘ordinary’ polluted monster after another.
Lori Joyner was a bit puzzled, “Doesn’t this Jack Clark realize that the higher the level of the Void creatures he kills, the thicker the Purple Killing Energy he’ll receive?”
“…Perhaps,” Marcellus Larry was also unsure.
In the following hours, under the watchful gazes of the two kings, Jack Clark blazed like a golden ray across thousands of kilometers, making a full circuit around the Oasis before finally stopping.
At this time, the light in the sky also dimmed down.

chapters.title: Chapter 622: 286: Plundering Talent, Madly Sweeping Up (Vote for Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Chapter 286: Plundering Talent, Madly Sweeping Up (Vote for Monthly Tickets)
Despite being in the endless Void, the Void Continent, shrouded by an invisible power, still has a distinction between day and night under the influence of powerful ruling forces.
As night fell, the continent was shrouded in darkness, and the Void Energy pervading the Doomsday Ruins became even more violent.
This Void Energy, like the Heavenly Energy, also possesses the capability to alter the life forms of living beings.
However, compared to the more gentle and Evolutionary Heavenly Energy, the Void Energy has a stronger erosive nature, more violent, and the direction of mutation is also more distorted and bizarre.
As a result, many people would retreat from the ruins before nightfall to return to the Oasis to recover and repair, expelling the Void Energy that had contaminated their bodies, including Jack Clark.
Standing on a hillside several hundred meters high and lush with vegetation, Jack looked out into the pitch-dark world that even his night vision could barely make clear and expressed his amazement.
“Is this the power that surpasses myths? Despite being dead for who knows how many years, the rules left behind still affect the operation of this continent.”
As he spoke, Jack exhaled and focused on himself, calling up the attribute page with a thought and checking the results of the day.
Talent: Void Double Pupils +1352
This was the fruit of Jack’s half-day’s labor, spanning over three thousand kilometers, slaying over a thousand Fifth Layer Heaven and more than a hundred Sixth Layer polluted monsters.
It might sound a bit meager, but in reality, it was already a lot, considering that these Void Creatures were scattered throughout the ruins, not queuing up for him to kill.
In Jack’s relentless run, he spared no Void Creatures he encountered, and after each kill, he had to stop and wait for the Purple Killing Energy to condense.
This was the reason it took only half a day to cover more than three thousand kilometers.
At this moment, over a thousand layers of Void Energy condensed at the edge of his Black Gold vertical pupils, forming a circle of black Rune Sequence Chains that revolved slowly, enhancing the might of the Void Double Pupils.
Although he hadn’t tested them, Jack could clearly sense that his Void Double Pupils had grown stronger, a faint smile appearing on his face, not having expected such a gain from this relic expedition.
…
Inside a cave, firelight burned as Crystal Lewis, clad in battle armor, took out Alien Beast Jerky, energy-infused mineral water, and a small iron pot from her Sumeru Bracelet and slowly began to cook.
Sitting across from her on a stone was Mandy, whose smart wristwatch, enhanced by the Heavenly Eye, projected a chat interface filled with many people sharing their day’s gains and information.
These messages all bore a country and name as a header.
Cross Mountain Country. Charlie Klein: “The Void Monsters in the ruins are so strong, I only went thirty kilometers in today and almost died at the hands of a monster.”
Eastern Summer. Justin Welan: “Haha, that’s so rough for you. Good thing I didn’t enter the ruins and chose to chance upon opportunities in the Oasis. Luck was on my side, and I picked up a shattered stele inscribed with runes.”
Eastern Summer. Howard Lambert: “Damn, Mr. Willard, you actually found good stuff so quickly?”
Hundred Foxes. Rowan Trevino: “I found something good too, but I won’t tell you what it is.”
Simon. Carls: “Today, my luck wasn’t bad either. Someone stole my kill, but I found a half-broken battle sword containing a special realm of thought over in the distant ruins.”
Simon. Taras: “Hey! Brother, you got your kill stolen too? Was it that Jack Clark from Eastern Summer?”
Gunardo. Brock Raven: “I encountered Jack too. That guy is too overpowered; in the blink of an eye, he blew up a dozen Fifth and Sixth Layer monsters. His dominance is unrivaled.”
“But he didn’t steal my kill. Or rather, if it weren’t for him showing up, I would’ve already died at the hands of those monsters.”
Ralrudo. Carter: “Damn it, he stole my kill too. Wait, the areas where you guys are should be quite far from us, right…?”
Suddenly, a flood of messages refreshed the chat interface, with many people saying they had their kills stolen by Jack or that Jack came to their aid, or that they had seen him.
“Is that guy a monster? He’s managed to encircle the Oasis and kill in one round. And he hasn’t exhausted his True Strength entering Supersonic Speed for half a day?”
“Strange, with his strength, going deeper into the ruins to slay those higher-order monsters should be more profitable, right?”
This question was not only on their minds but had also puzzled the two king-level figures outside the relic for half a day.
Lori Joyner mused, “Mr. Whitlock, should we just hang the rankings to give these youngsters a bit more competitiveness?”
“Sure, and we can also release the converted data for the Purple Killing Energy.”
Marcellus Larry smiled and tapped a few times on the Eye of Heaven Observation, opening the ranking permissions for all Sub-eyes.
Suddenly, everyone who was looking at the chat noticed the change on their projection screen; Mandy’s eyes lit up, “Sis, there’s a new ranking feature.”
“First place goes to Simon’s Gabriella, so strong, she’s accumulated over four thousand three hundred points of Purple Killing Energy in just half a day.”
“The second place is Eddy Keller with four thousand two hundred plus points, just a hundred less than Gabriella. That’s amazing.”
“Third place is Beast King Baldro with four thousand two hundred plus, and the fourth place is actually someone called Brudos, who’s quietly risen to fourth.”
Mandy then saw the name of the Innate Awakened One, Damon Lopes, at fifth place, with nearly three thousand nine hundred points of Purple Killing Energy.
She continued to scroll down until she came across Jack’s name at thirty-fourth place, somewhat surprised, “Jack is only in thirty-fourth place, with two thousand eight hundred plus points?”
“Thirty-fourth place.” Crystal also seemed a bit surprised.
In their view, with Jack’s strength, even if not in the top three, he should at least be in the top five, not expecting him to be outside the top thirty.

chapters.title: Chapter 623: 286: Plundering Talent, Rolling Up Madly (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Chapter 286: Plundering Talent, Rolling Up Madly (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
Simon Carls: “Hahaha… Jack Clark of Eastern Summer is only ranked in the thirties, with just over two thousand points. This guy is stealing our monsters.”
“Normal, the ones he kills are Level 5 Void Creatures, each only worth one or two points. Naturally, he can’t compare to those like Gabriella who kill high-order creatures.”
“But this guy truly is a monster. He has accumulated nearly three thousand Purple Killing Energy today. He’s slain over a thousand Void Creatures, hasn’t he?”
Hiss! Many people gasped in astonishment.
They were also beginning to realize this.
Right, according to the conversion table under the list, killing an early stage Level 5 creature is worth one point, mid period two points, late period five points.
Creatures from the Sixth Layer Heaven are between ten to fifty points, while those from the Seventh Layer are one hundred points at the early stage and three hundred in the late stage. The higher the level, the more Purple Killing Energy obtained.
This means that Jack Clark, a monstrous figure, has today slain, no, massacred over a thousand Void Creatures from the Fifth and Sixth Layer Heaven to accumulate this much Purple Killing Energy.
While people discussed fervently, Jack Clark was also sitting cross-legged on the hillside, munching on high-level exotic beast jerky while smilingly watching people chat.
Guess all you want, guess to your heart’s content.
More than ten minutes later, after finishing his dinner, Jack Clark took a deep breath, holding a Sky Element Stone in hand, drank a bottle of Enrichment Elixir to replenish his active spirit, and then began cultivation.
Whoosh!
Heavenly Energy within a range of hundreds of meters was drawn toward Jack Clark, forming a raging wind that made the surrounding grass and trees sway.
After entering the cultivation state, Jack Clark’s consciousness sank, and he allocated a portion of his mind to the deep sea below.
In a world illuminated by a Dark Red Glow of water and fire, after half a day had passed, and with the Attribute Energy all but consumed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exited the epiphany state.
In its golden vertical pupils, a complex and complete Talent Rune was slowly rotating, specifically the Giantification Talent Rune that belonged to the six-armed demon ape.
This type of Talent Rune, reformed from broken Rune Sequence Chains, was different from basic runes, more complex and complete, signifying an ability.
Furthermore, the embedding location was not the scale armor, but within all the muscles and bones, requiring the entire rune sequence chain to aggregate, covering the entire body to form a whole and to enter the Gigantification state.
Before beginning cultivation, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also needed to adjust the core rune structure according to its own form.
Since the core form of this rune was a six-armed demon ape, some of the rune sequence chains involving the six arms and tail were different.
For adjusting the structure of Talent Runes and body forms, Jack Clark, who had his self-created Secret Manual and Rune Illusions for adjustments, was experienced.
Once successful, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had a high chance of obtaining a new ability, the Talent for Gigantification.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a touch of excitement at once.
If successful this time, that would mean it would have another route to gaining talent, not requiring evolution to steal the abilities of giant beasts it desired.
In fact, this was the rudimentary form of the True Martial Arts. High-order Human Cultivation Methods also involved the aggregation of giant beast Talent Runes, with talent born from the reforging of the body in the Eighth Layer Heaven.
However, due to the completeness of the human Cultivation System, the path of humans and the evolution of giant beasts was still quite different.
Thinking of this, Jack’s firm voice resounded in his mind, “Consume 1000 Attribute points, initiate the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s state of epiphany.”
Instantly, the Attribute points on the page became 3420 points. The energy converted from the Attribute points traveled through the Soul Channel and enshrouded the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon once more.
And this time, Jack’s consciousness was almost entirely immersed in that world, ready to complete the Adjustment of Rune Structure in one go.
Considering the situation where the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon directly obtained a Gigantification Talent, he didn’t even save Attribute points, or rather, he didn’t need to save them, as long as he reserved 1000 points.
Since the time to open the Road to Becoming a God was short, burning 1000 points of Attribute, equivalent to eight hours of epiphany state, was enough to charge forward unhindered.
In the state of enlightenment, the blood Qi shadow that was a complete replica of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body data emerged in its mind, followed by the Giantification Talent Rune.
The Giantification Talent Rune expanded, transforming into a rune over a hundred meters large, decomposing into sections of Rune Sequence Chains that covered the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s shadow.
Boom, boom, boom!
The moment those Rune Sequence Chains touched the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, hundreds of them collapsed violently due to conflicts with other talents’ forces, causing the giant shadow to dissipate as well.
Let’s try again.
Quickly, with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Qi Blood reconsolidating, the shadow based on its own data reappeared.
And within such a short period, Jack had already finished reorganizing those hundred plus Rune Sequence Chains, optimized and adjusted them, and proceeded to fuse them again… Bang!
The Qi Blood shadow collapsed once more.
In front of the Ice Crystal Palace, each time the Qi Blood shadow dissipated, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body would erupt with a terrifying force that exploded the air and shattered ice crystals.
The powerful fluctuations alarmed the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Single-horned Tiger Whale cultivating within the distant palace, causing each of them to stick out their heads.
Roar, roar, roar! Thunderflame is so diligent in its cultivation.
Hiss, hiss! It’s freakish, so powerful yet still working so hard. Thunderflame is indeed a freak.
“Roar, roar, roar! Must work hard, cultivate, can’t fall behind, all nine heads, let’s do this together.”
Amidst the chaotic roar, eight dragon heads bellowed in confusion, one black dragon head violently bumped into the black-horned dragon head that was sleeping.
Bang! The significant impact caused an explosion in the air, and the actual sleeping dragon head suddenly became confused and growled, “Roar! Isn’t it my turn to sleep?”
When one dragon head spoke, Kidora’s language was relatively smooth.

chapters.title: Chapter 624: 286: Plundering Talent, Rolling Up Madly (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Chapter 286: Plundering Talent, Rolling Up Madly (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
Eight dragon heads emitted a chaotic growl, “Roar Roar!! Quick, get up, cultivate, Kido, pull, get it up.”
Stimulated by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the other Giant Beasts put in even more effort, and a frenzied cultivation atmosphere stirred them all into action.
Meanwhile, under the cover of night, on the sea surface, three Mutated Tiger Whales nearly fifty meters in length were confronting a group of Unique Beasts.
Two of the Mutated Tiger Whales had flames burning on their bodies, with scale armor covered in Flame Patterns, while the other Tiger Whale was pitch black, lurking under the water.
Not far off on the sea surface, over a dozen Mutated Tiger Whales with body lengths of ten to twenty-something meters and ranging from level four to level six slapped the sea water with their black and white scale armor.
Yet, these were normal Tiger Whale Groups, the kind consisting of just a few individuals like the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish family were rare.
Roar Roar Roar!! My family, I am Tiger One, the Cavalry General of the Dragon Palace. The Dragon Palace is currently recruiting soldiers; do you want to join the Dragon Palace?
The male Mutated Tiger Whale, nearly thirty meters long and in the late phase of level six, hesitated and then let out a low voice, “The Dragon Palace, what is that?”
Tiger One: Roar Roar Roar!! The Dragon Palace is the overlord of this sea area, a Beast Empire formed by jointly by nine and eight level Giant Beasts, possessing unparalleled strength.
Tiger Three: Roar Roar!! Our father is one of the five Dragon Kings, bearing the title King of Black and White, super awesome. One day, I will defeat him and become the Great General.
Tiger Whale Second Brother: Roar Roar!! My family, by joining the Dragon Palace you can live the good life with us, eating and drinking well every three days.
As they were of the same species, these Tiger Whales had a natural affinity for Tiger One and his kin.
Upon hearing how powerful the Dragon Palace was and that one of their own was among the Dragon Kings, they hesitated a little before the male Tiger Whale decided to agree.
Of course, what was most important was that they’d heard that there was a group of terrifying creatures in these waters recently, killing at sight, which was quite dreadful.
And within this Dragon Palace force, their Tiger Whale tribe had its own Giant Beast Dragon King, which sounded impressive. It seemed like a good idea to join them.
Having recruited the first group of subordinates, Tiger One was extremely excited: Roar Roar Roar!! Let’s go, my family, let’s continue recruiting beasts.
Soon, over a dozen Mutated Tiger Whales burst through the sea water, swimming towards another area inhabited by a Tiger Whale Group.
This night, everyone was busy.
At the edge of the ruins, Damon Lopes’ body was streaked in lightning as he held two Energy Crystal Bodies, restoring his depleted energy.
In another direction, standing over forty meters tall, a Mecha faced the blonde girl who pulled up the left sleeve of her Combat Suit, revealing several Subspace Bracelet Equipments on her arm.
Gabriella leaped onto the shoulder of the Mecha, loading one-meter-long, thirty-centimeter-diameter Rune High-explosive Missiles into it.
Next were the twenty-centimeter caliber Armor-piercing Incendiary Bullet Chains (cannonballs), and the Miniature Power Furnaces at the back and joint limbs of the Mecha were replaced with new Energy Crystals.
Once all the ammunition was loaded, standing on the shoulder of the Mecha several tens of meters high, the blonde girl’s face broke into a subtle smile.
Indeed, a Mech Martial Practitioner’s combat strength would drop by one level once their ammunition ran out, and they could only rely on piloting the Mecha to turn into a large-size martial artist for close combat.
But what if she had enough Subspace Equipment prepared, and enough ammunition loaded?
Soon a night passed, the relic sky slowly brightened without the sun.
Suddenly, figures that had rested and repaired themselves all night once again charged into the ruins; however, the goals of most people had changed today.
With their tickets already secured, these geniuses consciously searched the ruins, hoping to chance upon some sort of opportunity or inheritance.
And among these people, right as dawn broke, Eddy Keller in a White Robe morphed into a Divine Dragon and plunged into the Ruin Area.
“Today, this genius will slay mightily to become the number one under the heavens.”
Last night, upon learning about the existence of a leaderboard, Eddy Keller became excited.
Meanwhile, after resting for a night in the Oasis, Justin Welan and others, as well as the sisters Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis, got ready to begin their second day of exploration.
Especially the Lewis sisters, who with a clear goal, soared toward a mountain peak tens of kilometers away.
Yesterday, before darkness fell, while using a drone that could be remote-controlled from a kilometer away for high-altitude observation of their surroundings, they spotted traces of dilapidated buildings on a distant mountainside.
The buildings were covered in vines and moss, almost impossible to discern without close inspection, and were only detected due to automatic image comparison by their smart search devices.
While everyone started working hard on a new day, Jack Clark, who had made a spectacular killing the day before, did not make a move; all his attention was on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
He wanted to see if the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could acquire new abilities in this way.
Even though Gigantification Talent, even if successfully acquired, would not compare to the six-armed demon ape due to the innate imperfection of the runes, for Jack Clark it was sufficient if the talent could take form.

chapters.title: Chapter 625: 287: The Civilization Inheritor, Three Hundred-Fold Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Chapter 287: The Civilization Inheritor, Three Hundred-Fold Power
As those geniuses explored the Oasis or delved into the ruins, after a night of effort, the adjustments to the Giantization Rune and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had reached their final step.
Of course, their quick compatibility with these Rune Sequence Chains was related to the Giant Beasts.
If this rune were to fuse with a person, at least a small portion of the sequence chains would have to be removed, and the others compressed and adjusted without affecting the giantization effect.
This is also why humans usually draw inspiration from Giant Beasts’ Talent Runes, rather than using them directly.
Within his Sea of Knowledge, as the blood shadow of the Black-red Colossal Beast slowly approached and overlapped with the rune-formed Red Beast, the night-long enlightenment finally ended.
Phew! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exhaled a scorching breath from its mouth and nose, a hint of satisfaction in its golden vertical pupils.
The Giantification Talent Rune had been adjusted, and next, just like with a Cultivation Method, the basic Rune Sequence Chains shell would be condensed for the attribute page to record.
Then naturally, it would be directly enhanced with Attribute points, achieving it in one step.
On the hillside, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the transparent page before him, contemplating the remaining three thousand plus Attribute points.
“Let’s rest for a bit,” he said.
Consecutive enlightenment sessions were exhausting, and in such a state, Jack needed to rest and recover.
It was only then that he noticed the Sky Element Stone in his hand had turned to powder at some point, and the real-time progress of the Combat Shadow had risen to twenty-four percent.
After cultivating for two more days, he should be able to make a breakthrough to the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Outside the Void Rift, Marcellus Larry looked at the ever-increasing Purple Killing Energy values of geniuses on the leaderboard, but Jack’s remained still, which was a bit unexpected.
“What’s with that kid?” he muttered.
Saying so, Marcellus Larry clicked on Jack’s Sub-eye Positioning, and suddenly the massive Eye of Heaven Observation displayed a high-altitude overview; in the image, Jack was sitting cross-legged on the hillside, cultivating.
Immediately, the two king-level figures paused, Marcellus Larry somewhat puzzled, “Why is he still cultivating at this time?”
Shouldn’t these geniuses who have just entered the Ruins be striving to explore or slay polluted monsters to prepare themselves for the Road to Becoming a God?
Lori Joyner shook her head, “I don’t know, but this kid has always been mysterious.”
“If it weren’t for the guy Derick Ramsey using his Break Through the Void Eye to see his soul fully integrated with his body, some might even suspect he had been possessed.”
During Mathilda Ward’s last concert, Gwen Gail’s attendance was not only to provide camouflage for the Heavenly King Derick Ramsey but also to check on Jack Clark.
There was no helping it; Jack’s rise was too steep, almost shooting up in a straight line, and without a trace.
Normally, top-notch geniuses registered with the alliance have detailed records.
Some manifested abilities from a young age or had bodies with strong activation suitable for Gene Fusion, while others were naturally nimble-minded and clever, suited for the path of Mecha martial arts.
Furthermore, these top-notch geniuses also displayed exceptional talent right from their first contact with cultivation.
For example, Jane Aiken, whose cultivation talent overshadowed South Sky Martial Height from the beginning, and after reaching the Third Layer Heaven, her talent for enlightenment soared to new heights.
Or geniuses like Howard Lambert who had Innate Divine Strength enhanced by later Cultivation Methods for a secondary qualitative change.
Including Beast King Baldro, the hidden monster Brudos, or Mecha Genius Jennifer Jefferson and Eddy Keller, all of them have well-documented paths to rise.
It’s not that there are no geniuses who have amassed silently and then suddenly shone, but those take years to accumulate and achieve enlightenment overnight.
Like the Mysterious Martial Sky King who made his mark in his twenties.
Jack’s case, where he started with average talent and then his progression speed accelerated, surpassing everyone else within half a year, was too extraordinary.
Even those Innate Awakened Ones of the past couldn’t compete with him.
Of course, it wasn’t the Federation targeting Jack specifically, but such a high level of talent had to be handled with caution because it involved the Path of the Gods.
If such high-level talent had issues and something went wrong, the resulting damage would be more severe than what happened with Jonathan Walker.
Jonathan at least had not received the inheritance of Ancient Civilization.
Fortunately, although Jack’s rise was extraordinary, Derick Ramsey confirmed that there were no problems.
And according to Derick Ramsey’s assessment, Jack’s physical talent was comparable to Innate Awakening. His mere brute strength could overpower other cultivators at the same level, fierce and unmatched.
Combined with a terrifying cultivation talent, reaching the Seventh Layer Heaven in just over half a year, and the horrifying enlightenment to create his own Secret Manual in a month, he had been listed as a Federation civilization inheritor.
This status was quite special, regarded as the next hope for civilization.
Therefore, as long as he was within the range of a king-level figure, regardless of how critical their own tasks were, they had to prioritize his safety, ensuring his protection until he ascended to king-level.
Including this time in the Ruins.
If Jack were indeed to encounter danger later on, Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner would intervene directly, even if it meant triggering a premature Void Tide and pushing the Ruins Continent away.
Compared to the mostly explored Oasis and the World Origin that could also be condensed in the mythical world, the visible future of the Human Race in Jack and his generation was more important.
That was also why the two of them kept an eye on Jack consistently.
However, Jack was unaware of all this, and the Federation wouldn’t tell them.
They wanted to prevent these geniuses from becoming too arrogant due to the Federation’s high regard for them, losing their awe of the strong, and potentially acting more recklessly and aggressively when encountering dangerous situations or strong men in the future.
In such cases, they could die on the Path to the Mythical World any day.
In this dangerous era, even king-level figures did not dare to claim invincibility; they all faced the risk of falling, let alone these geniuses who had yet to grow.

chapters.title: Chapter 626: 287: Civilization Inheritor, Three Hundred-Fold Power_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Chapter 287: Civilization Inheritor, Three Hundred-Fold Power_2
“`
Under the watchful eyes of two king-level beasts, Jack Clark quickly took out another Sky Element Stone, drawing energy from hundreds of meters around and entering a state of cultivation.
“I don’t understand.”
Marcellus Larry shook his head and then shifted the Eye of Heaven Observation’s view to Damon Lopes and the others.
This relic exploration was actually an opportunity for this batch of top-notch geniuses to come into contact with Void-polluted monsters, explore inheritances, and acquire a vast amount of origin energy.
“Consume 1,000 attribute points to enter the enlightenment state of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.”
Boom!
As he entered the state of enlightenment again, the Qi Blood of the world within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body surged, and its majestic and ferocious Spiritual Will burst forth.
The terrifying extent of the Level 9 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Qi Blood could be described as infinite.
In the state of enlightenment, not minding the consumption, he frantically condensed Rune Sequence Chains that materialized out of nothingness, merging with the muscles and bones of his entire body.
As the new Talent Sequence Chain integrated, the Seven Talents that had merged with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s physical body were stimulated, unleashing terrifying fluctuations of power.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Blue-black thunder roared, shattering the surrounding ice crystals, and the scorching Heaven Burning Golden Flame burned, melting the Ice Crystals within a mile radius in the intense heat.
The Black-red Scaled Armor on the surface of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was intertwined with Defense and strength, distorting the space around under the spread of Terrifying Power.
This was the might comparable to that of a quasi-mythical behemoth, with just the invisible dispersal of power aura being so terrifying.
The astonishing events once again alarmed the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, each poking their heads out to look over.
Under the watchful gaze of the eleven eyes of the three giant beasts, the aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew stronger, and red patterns even emerged on the Black-red Scale Armor of its body.
As those red patterns slowly covered its entire body, the figure of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to swell, crackling as it expanded from more than 150 meters to nearly 160 meters.
With a surge in size by several meters, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s emitted aura of power became even stronger.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fiercely opened its eyes and let out a deep roar: “Roar! Not enough.”
Far away in the Oasis of the relic, Jack Clark also opened his eyes, his gaze filled with ferocity, focusing on the new Talent displayed on the transparent page.
Talent: Gigantification [Level: Common, special class talent. It consumes the biological energy contained in cells, causing the body to grow by 0.05, while strength and Defense are moderately increased.]
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon condensed a Talent Rune of an ability, bringing it from non-existence to existence, it did indeed acquire a new talent ability.
However, this talent was somewhat weak because the Talent Rune was incomplete, having been reforged from the bones of a six-armed demon ape.
The most core aspect of its essence had disappeared along with the death of the six-armed demon ape.
Another reason was that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had only condensed the foundation of the rune, similarly to how Jack Clark had initially cultivated the Combat Divine Body Skill, capturing only the superficial aspects.
Jack Clark’s eyes flickered as a thought resounded in his mind: “Consume attribute points, strengthen the Gigantification Talent to low level.”
Silently, 200 attribute points vanished, and a surge of attribute strength exploded within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, condensing the remaining Rune Sequence Chains even faster.
Soon, the complete Gigantification Talent that was previously deduced successfully condensed.
Roar!
With a tyrannical roar, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon unleashed an even more powerful burst of strength, and its size grew rapidly, expanding to more than 180 meters with crackling sounds.
Huff huff!! The powerful size brought an astonishing increase in strength, shaking the small world even more, with sea waves roaring and magma churning.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle in the distance all widened their eyes in shock.
Roar roar!! How did Thunderflame suddenly grow so much?
“Roar! Still not enough.” Along with the earth-shaking roar, the intent of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark resonated simultaneously in their minds.
“Continue to consume attribute points, strengthen the Gigantification talent.”
In an instant, 2,220 attribute points dropped to 1,320 points, and an even more robust energizing power appeared within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Under this grand surge of strengthening power, the runes that had covered the entire body transformed, evolving and ‘growing’ additional branches.
Boom!
As the Gigantification Talent was strengthened to intermediate level, a moment of more ferocious power burst forth, and red lightning flashed on the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon as its figure surged again.
Amidst the dumbstruck gazes of the three giant beasts, a Black-red Colossal Beast measuring two hundred and thirty meters in length appeared, with immense strength erupting in an instant.
Boom Boom!!
Under the weighty aura of terror, the earth within hundreds of meters range beneath the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon collapsed, the surrounding space distorted and shattered, forming a series of Black Cracks.
The air within a kilometer range was compressed by the oppressive force, creating rings of tangible white wave, stirring up sea waves tens of meters high.
Roar roar roar!!
Standing upright, a Black-red Colossal Beast towering over 130 meters tall stood amidst the darkness, red lightning flashing across its body, surrounded by a formidable atmosphere, as if it were a world-destroying ferocious beast descended from ancient times.
Just by standing there, the destructive waves it emitted destroyed everything within a kilometer radius, and the Ice Crystal Palaces within several kilometers continuously crumbled.
The hibernating Silver Giant Dragon hadn’t reacted yet when it was buried under a deluge of ice chunks, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle met the same fate.
As ice crystals rained down upon their heads with a crash, several giant beasts widened their eyes in shock, staring at the terrifying beast standing in the distance.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott, the more you come, the more awesome you are.”
Feeling the world-ending might of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook its nine heads, rolling around excitedly among the ruins of ice crystals.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 627: 287: Civilization Inheritor, Three Hundred-Fold Power_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Chapter 287: Civilization Inheritor, Three Hundred-Fold Power_3
“`
Truly deserving of being its idol, its power was constantly enhancing at a terrifying rate. As for the destroyed Ice Crystal Palace, a trivial matter—it would just take a bit of effort to rebuild.
Roar! The aura of Thunderflame is so strong, it has grown stronger again.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle almost showed tangible envy in their eyes.
To condense a rune and improve their strength by a little bit, they’ve toiled so long, and up until now, only the Silver Giant Dragon and Single-horned Tiger Whale have achieved greater combat power.
But Thunderflame, this fellow, boosts its strength by leaps and bounds every other day, even more exaggerated than the super gold Lala the Silver Giant Dragon talks about getting stronger by just eating.
And while the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was unscrupulously unleashing its power, Jack’s gaze fell onto the attribute page.
Talent: Gigantification[Intermediate, Special Class Talent, consumes cell biological energy to enter gigantification form, body size increases by 0.5 times, base strength, and Defense gain a threefold boost, agility slightly decreases.
Note: When this talent is strengthened to the limit, it will possess extreme destructive power]
“Base strength and Defense are tripled,” Jack smiled.
Tripled, it sounds weak.
But one has to know that the strongest aspect of giant beast type creatures is their bodies; the foundation of all their talent abilities are built on the robust Giant Beast Body.
With the strength that Thunderflame Emperor Dragon has now, what does it mean to have the base strength and Defense increased by three times in its gigantified state? It means the Top Tier Talent strength boosts from a hundredfold to three hundredfold.
Or to put it another way, the Top Tier Talent’s hundredfold becomes three hundredfold.
With a three hundredfold Power Explosion, if the Sword Dragon Giant Beast were to appear before the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon again, it could suppress and even heavily injure it with absolute strength.
There’d be no need to unleash the Golden Flame Thunderbolt’s power akin to rules.
If the opponent fought to the death and didn’t retreat, it could even kill that quasi-mythical beast without injury—its Defense was just too strong, it could simply hug the opponent and tear it apart.
Just as Jack was getting somewhat excited, another line of transparent text appeared before his eyes.
“Notice! The number of talents this giant beast has reached the genetic threshold of biological capabilities. Unable to fuse with new talents until evolution breaks the genetic shackles.”
…The genetic limit of biology, what a pity. Jack’s eyes showed a tinge of regret.
The successful condensation of the Gigantification Talent gave Jack the idea of hunting down those giant beasts with special abilities, smelting, and stripping their talents.
If he could acquire a few more such Special Talents, with mutual reinforcement, wouldn’t the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon explode with power?
But it seems he was thinking too much.
In the Water and Fire World, upon the red lightning slowly fading from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the shining red patterns on its body dimming down, its massive body began to shrink.
Transforming for just a few minutes, about one percent of the energy contained within its cells was consumed, meaning the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in this form could continue battling for several hours.
Not bad, the power was not only strong, but it wasn’t a three-minute beast either.
Looking at the still shocked three-headed beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared, “Roar! Thanks to those Life Crystals, this time I’ve gained the power of Gigantification from the spine of that six-armed demon ape.”
“I just tested the power of the Giantization Rune, it’s pretty good and helps a lot with my strength enhancement.”
Roar! Thunderflame, I want to learn, I want to get big, super big.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale got excited instantly.
Crushing the Ice Crystals on its body, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle followed with an excited roar, “Roar! Domination wants to be awesome too, Thunderflame, Domination wants to learn as well.”
“Roar! And there’s, Kido, La, learn, be awesome.” The nine-headed Flood Dragon’s nine dragon heads tangled, emitting an excited and chaotic roar.
Seeing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body grow several dozen meters in length, expanding its overall size by a factor of two with Gigantification Talent, the three-headed beast was quite enamored and envious.
“Roar! This talent isn’t the same as Basic Runes; you can’t learn it right now; your precision control is too poor to condense a complete rune in one go.”
“Don’t be disheartened, though. Keep practicing condensing Basic Runes and refine your precision control.”
“Whoever condenses five hundred Basic Runes first, I’ll pass on the Gigantification Talent to them. Alright, carry on with your cultivation; I’m off to find food.”
“I’m so hungry.”
Boom!
The sea water exploded, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s enormous form disappeared from the sea surface, rapidly rushing out of the Water and Fire World underwater, ready to start devouring seven or eight-level giant beasts.
This time, it’s going to grow to Mid Level 9 in one go.
“Roar! Work hard, nine heads, do it.”
Roar! I’m gonna be awesome, let’s push hard.
Roar! Cultivation, cultivation; once I condense five hundred runes, I’ll learn the power of Gigantification, then Domination will fight thirty at once.
Under the enticing vision painted by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the three giant beasts suddenly filled with motivation and passion for cultivation, ready to practice with even more frenzied vigor.
But what they didn’t know was that even if they learned the Giantization Runes, they would be just ordinary talents, not nearly as strong as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s talent, which was already strengthened to the intermediate level.
Not to mention that later, if there were enough crystals, Jack planned to prioritize strengthening Gigantification to Top-tier.
“Phew! Time flies so quickly.” Jack exhaled, looking at the sky that had darkened without him realizing, sitting on the hillside, too lazy to move.
This time the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon obtained the Gigantification Talent, having spent a total of four thousand one hundred attribute points.
Three consecutive comprehensions of the Giantization Rune, adjustments to structure, serial condensation, to the later strengthening to low-level talent for two hundred points, to a threefold nine hundred for intermediate.
Compared to the Golden Flame and Thunder Talent abilities, the special class Gigantification Talent had a higher strengthening requirement, almost three times as much.
But the Giantization Rune was powerful, and Jack decided he would later strengthen this talent to Top-tier and see if he could integrate it into his Combat Divine Body.
When he broke through to king-level, with a Rule True Body on the outside and Law Heavenly Phenomenon on the inside, dual amplification would make him more powerful than those other king-level rulers.
In the far-off darkness under the Sky Curtain, a green figure rushed out and upon noticing Jack on the hillside in the distance, the figure changed direction.
Whoosh!
The raging wind howled as the girl wearing Green Armor appeared in front of Jack in just a few breaths.
“Student Aiken.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 628: 288: The Seven Great Emperors, the Soaring Rankings (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: Chapter 288: The Seven Great Emperors, the Soaring Rankings (Seeking Monthly Pass)
“`
Night!
Firelight illuminated the hillside.
Across from Jack Clark, the girl in the blue armor took out a large stone slab, a stone stool, and a set of stone-grilled sauce from her Sumeru Bracelet.
Next came a hundred-pound slab of fresh Mutated Beast meat and a sharpened, ‘Transcendent’ small knife that had been tempered.
And that set of stone was the same one that Glenn Clark had Jane Aiken slice by the cliffside back then.
Of course, that was not the point, the point was that in such a tense space like the Sumeru Bracelet, she actually used it to store these ordinary things that could be had or not.
Jack Clark couldn’t help but pause, “…Student Aiken, is this all you have in your Sumeru Bracelet?”
Looking at him curiously from across the way, Jane Aiken asked, “Isn’t the Sumeru Space meant to put things in?”
“What I mean is, shouldn’t the remaining space in the Sumeru Bracelet, aside from battle swords, battle armor, and some life supplies, be used to put other precious items?”
“I don’t have any precious items. Currently, I only have battle armor and a battle sword. The rest of the space is just enough for these barbecue stones and a few hundred kilograms of Alien Beast Meat.”
Okay, I forgot that this guy is devoted to cultivation, has not gone out to hunt Unique Beasts to exchange for Contribution Points, to exchange for resources.
Or rather, she doesn’t need those regular cultivation resources.
Jane Aiken said enthusiastically, “Jack Clark, I’ll treat you to barbecue today. I’ve specifically researched stone tablet barbecue lately; the sauces are all carefully prepared by me, and they taste pretty good.”
Jack Clark smiled, “Sure, today I’ll taste Student Aiken’s culinary skills.”
Under Jack Clark’s gaze, the girl skillfully cut slices of meat of varying thickness, brushed on oil, sprinkled salt, and then spread some barbecue scallions, cumin, and pepper powder.
Accompanied by the sizzle of high heat, the slices of meat began to emit a rich fragrance.
Then came Jane Aiken’s secret sauce, pepper powder, and chili powder.
Just when Jack Clark thought it was about done, the girl took out freshly washed and still moist scallions from the Sumeru Space and chopped them up to sprinkle on top.
Whoosh! The rich barbecue scent wafted over, making Jack Clark swallow his saliva involuntarily.
Compared to Glenn Clark’s grilled fish, which involved haphazardly tossing on any spices and sauces that smelled good but tasted a bit odd, Jane Aiken was clearly more professional.
But isn’t it a bit strange to use the pause function of the Sumeru Bracelet space like this?
Jane Aiken divided the stone-grilled meat into two portions and pushed half of it towards Jack Clark with a small shovel, “Jack Clark, come on, give it a try.”
The girl was somewhat expectant.
Ever since she had Jack Clark’s stone-grilled meat, she had thought about returning the favor one day.
Under Jane Aiken’s watchful eye, Jack Clark picked up a large piece of grilled meat, and after chewing it twice, his eyes lit up, and he gave a thumbs up to the girl across from him.
“You’re indeed a fast learner, Student Aiken. This grilled meat is fantastic,” Jack Clark wasn’t lying; it truly was delicious.
The meat was rich, the fat and lean perfectly flavorful, and though grilled, it retained some moisture inside. Combined with the fresh, spicy, and numb taste, it was the best barbecue he had ever eaten.
Immediately, a satisfied smile appeared on Jane Aiken’s face.
After eating over ten pounds, Jack Clark stopped and watched the girl opposite him, who continued to grill and eat, her mouth slick with grease.
Feeling Jack Clark’s gaze, Jane Aiken showed confusion, “Jack Clark, you’re not eating anymore?”
“I’ve almost had enough,” he said.
Then, Jack Clark’s tone shifted, his curiosity piqued, “Student Aiken, how did you manage to condense four types of Sword Intent?”
Jack Clark knew all too well how difficult it was to harness the power of the realm of thought; he had almost slain his way through the Southern Battlefield, sweeping across hundreds of genius peers to find the opportunity to condense it.
Yet the girl before him had already condensed four types, she truly was a monster.
Beyond Jane Aiken, although Jack Clark had encountered many geniuses who had condensed Sword Intent or Fist Intent, these individuals only possessed one type of the power of intent.
When confronted with Jack Clark’s question, Jane Aiken pondered, “I don’t know myself. I just felt that the power was very special, very strong, and then I just condensed it into Sword Intent.”
“…That sounds strangely familiar,” Jack Clark paused, because he seemed to have said something similar to Howard Lambert and others.
Howard Lambert and the others had once asked Jack Clark why his cultivation speed was so fast.
And his answer was that he did not know either; somehow he just became strong as he practiced.
Of course, Jack Clark was very clear about why he had become so strong, but Jane Aiken was different; she might truly think it was simple, thinking to condense Sword Intent whenever she wanted.
“But I think that four types of Sword Intent is probably my limit,” she said.
“Limit,” Jack Clark’s eyes inquired further.
“Yes, limit,” Jane Aiken confirmed, nodding.
“After I grasped the fourth type, the Soul-slashing Sword Intent, I had several more experiences of Heaven and Earth Resonance, but ultimately I failed to condense a new Sword Intent.”
“It seems my soul can’t bear any more Sword Intents. Each time I try to condense a new one, I feel a strong tearing sensation deep within my body.”
Several more experiences of Heaven and Earth Resonance. Jack Clark was a bit shocked.
