This girl’s talent for enlightenment was too terrifying, even more abnormal than his own state of epiphany.
At that moment, a radiance flickered on the wrists of both of them.
“The channel for the Heavenly Eye’s Sub-eye is open.”
“Finally, let’s check the rankings,” they said.
To prevent distraction among the people, Marcellus Larry had shut down the communication function of the Heavenly Eye during the day. As it was turned on now, almost a thousand people clicked in.
There was no helping it, the relic was too vast. With thousands of people scattered inside, you could go an entire day without seeing a single person, let alone sharing what they had learned.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 629: 288: Seven Great Emperors, Soaring Rankings (Vote for Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Chapter 288: Seven Great Emperors, Soaring Rankings (Vote for Monthly Tickets)_2
Eastern Summer.Eddy Keller: “Hahaha… I truly am number one.”
Standing atop a stone peak a hundred meters high, with a burly figure yet clad in a white robe, Eddy Keller let out a proud laugh.
Because in today’s Purple Killing Energy rankings, he scored 9512 points, placing him in first, over two thousand points ahead of the second place Gabriella, which excited him tremendously.
However, delving too deep into the ruins today, he encountered a terrifying Eighth Layer Void Monster. Even Eddy Keller suffered a light injury, leaving his aura somewhat weak at the moment.
But these were minor issues.
“Life truly is as lonely as snow,” he said, standing with hands clasped behind his back on the stone peak, overlooking the dark expanse of land that spread in all directions, before adding proudly,
“What Gabriella, what Beast King Balderas, in just one day they’ve been suppressed by my genius.”
“And that First Grade Seven Layer Heaven monster, no matter how high his talent, he can’t even see the tail lights of my car now, hahaha…”
Hundred Foxes.Ian Rankin: “That’s impressive, the Purple Killing Energy has nearly reached ten thousand points. I’ve killed over a hundred polluted monsters these past two days, and I’ve only accumulated just over four hundred points.”
Simon Frank: “Eastern Summer indeed has hidden dragons and crouching tigers.”
Regarding Eddy Keller becoming first, no one was surprised; after all, he was only a hundred points behind Gabriella yesterday, and killing a few more Level 6 Void Monsters would suffice.
Everyone entering the relic is a top-notch genius from their respective nations, and while they are proud, they are not conceited. They all sent messages of sincere praise upon seeing Eddy Keller ascend to the top.
And those flattering messages made Eddy Keller feel even more elated, hahaha, indeed, he was the strongest.
But just then, a message popped up that Eddy Keller found displeasing.
Eastern Summer.Damon Lopes: “Fool, you’ve got it all backwards. Is killing monsters our goal in coming here?”
On the plains, Damon Lopes looked disdainfully at the ranking projection that displayed Eddy Keller’s name. Just as he said, that guy was a fool.
Hasn’t he realized that the Purple Killing Energy points of others haven’t increased much since yesterday?
Take Brudos, in fourth place for example, who only went from four thousand points to just over six thousand. It’s clear he didn’t focus on hunting polluted monsters today.
Besides that, the Purple Killing Energy growth of everyone else in the top thirty was also around fifty percent today.
The reason, of course, was that they were all searching for relics.
In the Ruin Area, many buildings of Ancient Civilizations had been destroyed, and in these relics, one might be lucky enough to find the inheritance left by some powerful entity or pick up an object containing intelligence.
For some geniuses, such an inheritance can be even more precious than World Origin, as not everyone possesses the King’s Attitude.
Without any hope of achieving a breakthrough to Monarch, having World Origin makes no difference, so for them, an ancient inheritance that leads directly to the Nine Layers is more precious.
Even though today’s Cultivation System differs from that of ancient times, the core is the same, and can still point the way.
Only a fool like Eddy Keller would waste his time killing Void Creatures. The Doomsday Ruin spans over ten million square kilometers, filled with countless monsters. How many can you kill?
If you’re not careful and encounter a late-period Eighth Layer Monster, you wouldn’t even have time to run away.
That must be what Jack Clark is thinking too. With this in mind, Damon Lopes’ gaze fell on Jack Clark’s name, which had slid to beyond seventieth in the rankings.
A day had passed, and that guy’s Purple Killing Energy points were the same as yesterday. Obviously, he spent the whole day searching for relics, without bothering to kill any monsters.
“It seems everyone is working hard,” Damon Lopes mused, looking at the compass-like object floating in front of him.
In the compass core, a dazzling bolt of lightning was flickering, emitting circles of invisible electromagnetic waves under the powerful undulations of Thunder.
“Hmph! Eddy Keller, that fool. Wait until Daoist Master finds the Thunderbolt Law Fragments, then I’ll show you all the might of an Innate Awakening,” he sneered.
Damon Lopes was so well-prepared this time, not without reason, having studied Ancient Civilizations after learning of the Road to Becoming a God.
The old man who raised him, moreover, the Federation commander from the Northern Battlefield, had also entered these relics decades ago and acquired some ‘books’.
Among these was the mention that on this Inheritance Continent, there were the inheritances of thirty-six Monarchs and seven Great Emperors, one of whom was known as the Lord of Thunder.
As an Innate Thunder awakened one, if he could acquire a Thunderbolt Law Fragment to strengthen his Innate Thunderbolt, he stood a good chance of inheriting the Thunder Monarch’s legacy once he embarked on the Road to Becoming a God.
According to inheritances documented by the Federation, the thirty-six Monarchs and seven Great Emperors were the strongest group of individuals during the peak of Ancient Civilization.
Yet, no one knows what happened for the seven Great Emperors, the thirty-six Monarchs, and all the King-level strong men to tear through space-time and set off on an expedition.
Before leaving, these powerful individuals each left an inheritance behind, such as several Monarchs and one of the Great Emperors on this Void Continent.
The information recorded that one year after these strong figures left, the sky suddenly broke open one day, unleashing endless monsters.
How many tens of thousands of years have passed since Ancient Civilization and where those creatures went afterward remain unclear.
After all, too much time has passed, and only limited information has survived.
In a valley littered with debris, a huge pit over a hundred meters in diameter had been dug out, and at the bottom lay a shattered Dragon Turtle statue, several meters into the ground and over a hundred meters in diameter.
Sitting atop this Dragon Turtle statue, with a broken stele on its back and dirt all over him, Justin Welan smiled as he flipped through chat logs.

chapters.title: Chapter 630: 288: Seven Great Emperors, Soaring Rankings (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: Chapter 288: Seven Great Emperors, Soaring Rankings (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3
“`
“Hehe, this guy got happy too soon, it’s just getting started.”
Having an understanding of Jack Clark, Justin Welan knew he must be busy with other things today, and that he was no match once he got involved.
In the ancient stone palace covered by vines and moss, hidden within the mountain, Crystal Lewis swept her high beam flashlight across the stone walls engraved with ordinary patterns, feeling somewhat disappointed.
“Mandy, we’ve been searching here all day, and besides those blurry engravings on the stone wall, we’ve found nothing. It must have been taken away by our seniors.”
Mandy Lewis shook her head slightly, “Don’t worry, sis. This structure was built inside the mountain and has not collapsed for who knows how many tens of thousands of years; it must have something special.
“We haven’t found it now just because we haven’t discovered it yet.”
Compared to the decisive Crystal Lewis, the gentler Mandy Lewis had better patience and calmly said, “With our current level of cultivation, we don’t have a chance to enter the Road to Becoming a God this time.”
“Under these circumstances, the only harvest we could get is from this oasis area, so we can’t miss any possibility.”
After Eddy Keller topped the leaderboard, causing a stir for a while, the subsequent chat channel calmed down, as everyone checked the leaderboard and then went into silent cultivation or recovery.
Suddenly someone sent a message.
Eastern Summer Hugo Lee: “Today, the leaderboard is down by three.”
Bellin Baldaz: “Only two days in and five people have died already; in the days to come, everyone had better be cautious and not rush in, risking their lives.”
“Larry Throne previously said that the Road to Becoming a God will appear at the earliest half a month from now. This time is enough for everyone to accumulate 1000 points of Purple Evil.”
Simon Gabriaphina: “Baldaz is right; although this opportunity is very important, all is lost if a person dies.”
“Also, everyone pay attention, once you go deeper than 300 kilometers into the ruins, most of the monsters are primarily Sixth Layer Heaven, and there are some Seventh Layer Heaven monsters too.”
“Besides, I found some strange areas, like those shrouded in darkness, or bottomless abyss pits. It’s best not to approach these when you encounter them.”
Berlin Bruce also came forward: “Right, today I encountered a peculiar type of Void Creature, an intangible entity that looked like a black snake and could slip into the Void.”
“This kind of creature can only be hurt with True Force Flame or Sword Intent type power, so everyone should be careful.”
Under the lead of a few leaderboard giants, everyone proceeded to share their discoveries from the past two days, discussing which areas were dangerous and which monsters to be wary of.
Jack Clark and Jane Aiken kept all this information in sight, not missing anything, until late at night when everyone finally closed their Sub-eye and returned to meditative cultivation.
The next day at dawn, Jack Clark, who was sitting in meditation all night, opened his eyes, the vision of the three-faced six-armed Combat Shadow slowly disappearing from his gaze.
In his hand, a Sky Element Stone turned to dust, and with it, the progress of manifesting his Combat Shadow reached 27 percent.
“After meditating quietly for a day, it’s time to get moving,” Jack Clark said as he stood up. A heavy aura of Killing Intent spread from his body, raising a strong wind.
With the matter of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon settled, his next step was to continue slaughtering Void Creatures to stack his passive ability, boosting the enhancement of his Void Double Pupils to tenfold or even dozens of times greater.
“Student Aiken, I’m heading out first.” After a greeting, Jack’s body erupted with golden flame, and in an instant, he turned into a burst of light and shot out.
Boom!
At Supersonic Speed, Jack was like a golden streak leaving behind a 3 meters wide path of shattered vegetation as he shot into the ruins.
On the hillside, Jane Aiken watched Jack’s figure disappear into the ruins, somewhat surprised, “Such heavy Killing Intent, is he going on a killing spree again?”
As she spoke, Jane Aiken also turned into a sword light and rushed into the ruins, but in a different direction from Jack.
Bang Bang Bang!
Under the heavy sweeps of his War Halberd, the Earth tore open, and shockwaves rolled out. Several 5th Level Pollution Beasts, each tens of meters long, hadn’t even reacted before their huge bodies exploded into mass of flesh and blood.
Then, the golden light enveloped around, collecting Purple Evil before continuing deeper into the ruins.
Still centered around the oasis, he swept through, exterminating everything.
However, due to the day of inactivity the day before, many monsters within a 200 kilometer radius had been killed, so today Jack’s target was the area around 300 kilometers.
And with enough time for the day, he planned not to move in a straight line but to sweep back and forth across many miles in a zigzag pattern.
Roar Roar!
“`
On the hillside, two ferocious monsters, thirty-odd meters long, covered with bone spurs, eyed the golden light streaking towards them from a distance and emitted raging howls.
The most important thing was that the golden figure radiated an aura of fresh life that they instinctively loathed and desired to tear apart.
Roar!
The two Level 7 monsters burst with power, shattering the ground within a dozen-meter radius beneath a swirling black-purple fog, and they plunged downwards with a thunderous rumble.
Boom!!
Golden radiance pierced Heaven and Earth, and before one polluted monster could react, its hard, thick scales shattered, and a penetrating bloody hole several meters in diameter exploded in its chest.
Bang!
The golden halberd radiance, flickering as the halberd reversed, swept across the sky, tracing a semi-circular golden light over ten meters long and shattering the approaching claws of the other polluted monster, bursting its head.
Boom, boom!!
The colossal corpses of the two Polluted Giant Beasts smashed to the ground, and black-purple blood gushed out like fountains, staining the surrounding Earth, emitting an unpleasant stench of blood.
Gleaming in golden-red battle armor, Jack Clark, with four gear rings rotating behind his head, stood holding a halberd, his gaze cold and detached as he observed the massive purple aura of Killing Intent coalescing.
Due to the characteristics of the Divine Tyrant Body, Jack’s normal attacks were at his peak strength, basic attacks as ultimate moves, meaning anyone weaker than the Eight Layer Heaven was no match for him.
In front of him, there was no difference between a Level 7 Pollution Beast and a Level 5, both alike were slaughtered as easily as butchering dogs.
Huff, huff! A large swath of purple-black Killing Intent gathered, merging into the Purple Killing Energy swirling around Jack.
Jack’s hand passed through the Purple Evil, absorbing two strands of Void power before bursting through the air again, like a golden light drawing a zigzag across the Earth.
As long as he drew near the polluted monsters within a mile, sensing his aura, they would instinctively issue a violent roar, then be directly blown apart.
Meanwhile, Jack extended his perception to its limit, sensing the aura of polluted monsters in the distance, including the hostile gazes lurking in the darkness.
Boom, boom, boom! One after another, Level 6 monsters were continuously blasted apart under the heavy halberd, their slaughter too swift to describe.
On the leaderboard, the numbers behind Jack rose at a terrifying speed, jumping by dozens and hundreds with every leap. In just one hour, he surged over 7,000 points and broke into the top ten.
This meant that within an hour, he had slaughtered at least two hundred Level 6 and above Void Creatures.
This drastic climb even startled Marcellus Larry who watched the golden light reflected in the Eye of Heaven Observation: “Has this guy gone mad? Isn’t he afraid of exhausting himself?”
“He should be fine; that kid’s stamina is terrifying.” Following that, Lori Joyner expressed confusion in her eyes.
If it was about accumulating Purple Killing Energy, it would be more efficient for Jack to kill Level 6 and 7 polluted monsters on the first day, yet this guy chose to kill those at the Fifth Layer Heaven surrounding the Oasis.
And just when everyone thought he would continue his massacre on the second day, he cultivated in tranquility for a whole day.
Then today, when most people’s attention was on exploring the relic, he once again started a frenetic slaughter.
Centered around the Oasis, he swept around, eradicating all polluted monsters as if clearing the map, as though intending to exterminate all the polluted beings on the entire Inheritance land.
Under these circumstances, the Purple Evil numbers behind Jack soared at an astonishing speed, quickly reaching 10,000 points, 11,000, and easily surpassing Eddy Keller.
Only, at this moment, Eddy Keller wasn’t aware of it.
The Eye of Heaven Observation reflected the invincible figure of Jack Clark, marveling at the sight of Level 6 and 7 Void Creatures, Pollution Beasts bursting and shattering under the oppressive War Halberd, prompting Marcellus to exclaim.
“What terrifying dominance over those in the same realm.”
“With just the early stages of the Seventh Layer Heaven cultivation, but even those at the peak of Level 7 Pollution Beasts couldn’t withstand a single move. If he can maintain this crushing force upon ascending to the throne…”
Marcellus paused here.
“It shouldn’t be possible, should it?” Lori hesitated.
In higher orders, the gap between each small realm becomes larger, especially upon reaching the Ninth Heavens. At that stage, everyone is a top-notch genius with incredible strength; overcoming even a minor realm is difficult, let alone king-level.
However, given the terrifying level of realm dominance Jack currently displayed, even Lori spoke with a hint of doubt, not quite certain.
After all, this kid’s physical body, cultivation speed, and enlightenment were all top-tier, a complete monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 631: 289: Across Thousands of Miles, Dark Angel
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Chapter 289: Across Thousands of Miles, Dark Angel
While Jack Clark was on a killing spree, others were also busy continuing their exploration of the Oasis and delving deeper into the ruins to slay polluted monsters and search for relics.
A desolate Earth roared with thunder, bursting forth dazzling rays of radiance.
Surrounded by Damon Lopes were countless Purple Thunder Dragons that weaved through the air, forming a lightning domain spanning twenty meters, obliterating any Level 6 Void Creatures that came close and forcing back the Level 7 ones.
After those several-meter-long Purple Thunder Dragons exploded, they would transform into streaks of electricity and rejoin the lightning domain, reducing consumption.
Under the continuous bombardment of the Thunder Dragons, three Void Creatures adorned in battle armor and towering at a height of four meters, wielding war spears, were soon blasted into charred pieces.
Glancing at the scattered corpses of the monsters, Damon Lopes’s body gradually toned down the lightning and took out the Lightning Compass once again.
This place used to be a thriving ancient city, with neatly extending foundations of buildings spanning several kilometers, but now only ruins with broken walls and remnants remained.
“So far, I’ve delved over five hundred kilometers in this direction. According to that mountain with the singular peak in the distance, this should be Cover City.”
“According to the ancient texts, the Lord of Thunder’s residence was near Cover City.”
“As a strong man who surpassed the Heavenly King level and had touched upon the Rule, the terrifying force invoked during cultivation by the Lightning Law could destroy everything in the surroundings.”
“But surely, as a dwelling of such a strong man, it would be extremely solid and protected by special defense prohibitions, and under these circumstances, the unleashed thunder would form Law Fragments.”
“It’s just unknown whether the Thunder Law power that merged into the Cultivation Room’s structure has dissipated over the years, or if the Law’s residence has already vanished.”
Holding the compass in hand, Damon Lopes started to search around the city ruins and the surrounding barren hills.
Meanwhile, at another section of the ruins, Gabriella was maneuvering a Mecha across the land, with the double shoulder-mounted Energy Beams firing occasionally, blasting away a dozen or so Void Creatures in the vicinity.
The Late Level 6 Void Creatures moved rapidly, their explosive bursts nearly reaching Supersonic Speed, turning into shadows hopping around.
The Mecha, however, equipped with a Supercomputer-assisted firepower system and terrifying computational ability, locked onto each creature, with the Laser Cannon trailing behind and continuously bombarding them.
Wherever it went, the Earth exploded, stones flew all around, and soon, one after another, the Void Creatures were blasted to death, leaving behind several fire pits more than ten meters across.
For a Mech Martial Practitioner, as long as the power reactor’s energy was sufficient and there was enough ammunition, one could dominate a small-scale war all alone.
Roar!
At that moment, the distant Earth crumbled, surrounded by rampant Black-purple Fog, as a Pollution Beast, forty meters in length, emerged and let out a brutal roar.
Boom!
The air exploded with a roar, creating a billowing wave. The Pollution Beast, resembling a fusion of tiger and lion, covered in grey scale armor, with its body full of bone spurs, crossed hundreds of meters in an instant and appeared to the left of the Mecha.
In the moment the Pollution Beast appeared, a gargantuan sword over forty meters long and several meters wide in the Mecha’s hand, whose tip resembled the head of an axe, swept sideways. Its blade, pulsating with light, clashed against the double claws of the Pollution Beast.
Boom!
The mighty and horrifying strength of the Pollution Beast’s double claws caused the Earth to shatter for tens of meters around the Black and White Mecha, creating a powerful impact.
At the same time, the Pollution Beast was sent flying by the sword, its claws’ scales shattered and a stench of blood flowing.
Whistle Whistle Whistle!!
From the launch ports on both shoulders of the Mecha, dozens of High-explosive Crystal Missiles erupted with fiery blaze, swiftly engulfing the tumbling Pollution Beast.
Boom Boom Boom!! The intense explosion lit up the heavens and Earth, and at the same time, the Mecha’s chest power reactor gathered energy.
Boom!
A two-meter diameter white-hot Energy Cannon roared, piercing through the head of the Pollution Beast amidst the center of the explosion, and then ploughing a thousand-meter-long, ten-meter-wide Destruction Tunnel into the ground behind it.
Observing the enormous Pollution Beast corpse lying in the distance, Gabriella, at the peak of the Sixth Layer, remained calm in her pilot seat.
“All dangerous targets have been eliminated. Auxiliary systems activated. Begin Lightwave Scanning, Image Scanning, and Energy Wave Tracking Radar initiated…”
“Beep Beep! Special energy fluctuation detected, target locked.”
Under the auxiliary system’s scan, the Mecha detected weak energy fluctuations several hundred meters away beneath the ruins, immediately rousing Gabriella’s spirit.
With heavy steps, the Black and White Mecha knocked down several walls more than ten meters high, arriving at the remains of what must have once been a luxurious mansion, now only a trace of its former glory.
The weak energy fluctuation was emitting from a Stone Tower, most of which was buried in the dirt, revealing only a corner on the surface.
With a thud, under the enormous palm of the Mecha, a ten-meter-high Stone Tower with a three-meter diameter base was forcefully uprooted, and as the dirt separated, some blurred runes became visible on the surface.
Inside the Mecha, Gabriella’s face broke into a smile: “Finally found something useful, but I wonder what purpose this Stone Tower serves.”
Elsewhere in the ruins, the four limbs of a thirty-plus-meter Pollution Creature had been severed, and its body was nailed to the Earth with more than a dozen black pillars, each over ten meters long and half a meter thick, unable to move.
Beside it, a bespectacled blonde young man was holding a one-meter-long knife, emanating red radiance, and dissecting the creature’s body.
With a fervent expression, Brudos mused, “Such an unusual life form; despite being alive, its essence feels dead.”
“And their body’s Genetic Sequence has completely collapsed yet hasn’t turned into a pool of proteinaceous rotting meat, but rather grows in a bizarrely mutated manner…”

chapters.title: Chapter 632: 289: Across Thousands of Miles, Dark Angel_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Chapter 289: Across Thousands of Miles, Dark Angel_2
As they delved deeper into the ruins, many geniuses gradually found their rewards, some picking up special items, and others discovering stone slabs carved with mysterious text.
As for Jack Clark, he was engaged in a frenzy of slaughter.
Boom!
A sonic boom resounded as a streak of golden light flashed across the earth, creating ripples that stirred up raging winds and shattered the surrounding ground into dust clouds.
Watching the figure disappear into the horizon in the blink of an eye, a Bellin cultivator standing atop a collapsed city wall, ten meters tall and covered with scales, was somewhat surprised.
“Holy shit, it’s that freak Jack Clark. He’s traveling at supersonic speed again. Is his True Strength really limitless!?”
That day, many geniuses who had ventured hundreds of kilometers into the ruins once again encountered Jack Clark.
However, this time Jack didn’t take their creatures. These monsters above sixth-level and the Level 5 ones worth only 1 point of Purple Killing Energy were a bit too much to snatch away.
Even when several geniuses at the Early Sixth Heaven encountered several Level 7 Early Phase monsters chasing them down, Jack conveniently saved them as he passed by.
In particular, Simon’s Silver Mech, radiating energy fluctuations at Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, was besieged by more than a dozen Late Sixth Heavenly Stage monsters, and several Level 7 Pollution Beasts.
If it weren’t for Jack’s timely intervention, that mech would have been either torn to shreds or severely injured.
Despite how effortlessly Jack seemed to roam the Doomsday Ruins, the place was actually very dangerous.
The sparse Heavenly Energy meant that the power of True Strength projected outside was greatly weakened, which equated to a reduction of about twenty percent in strength for True Martial cultivators.
Add to this the Void Energy that eroded everything constantly and the polluted monsters that inhabited the ruins, starting from the Fifth Layer Heaven.
In such circumstances, a moment’s inattention could lead to a group attack by several, or even a dozen, same-level monsters – an extremely perilous situation that was far from a one-on-one fight.
As the number of slaughtered polluted monsters grew, the purple-black Killing Intent around Jack’s body became denser, eventually almost submerging him completely.
Within the purple-black Killing Intent akin to the Blood Fiend aura, Jack’s eyes turned blood-red as he was enveloped by the terrifying illusion of Blood Sea Hell.
Although these Pollution Beasts were of no value due to their mutated flesh and blood, and the peak Sixth and seventh level monsters didn’t contain Life Crystals, slaying them still gathered Blood Fiend energy, strengthening the Prison Blood War Intent and Blood Sea Hell.
A single Level 6 Pollution Monster contained Qi Blood a thousand times that of an ordinary person.
By now, half the day had passed, and Jack had slain more than two thousand monsters of the Sixth and seventh levels. The accumulated Blood Evil Qi was almost equivalent to millions of Blood Fiends, a horrifying sight to behold.
With such a terrifying boost from the Blood Evil Qi, the illusory Blood Sea Hell had expanded its range from thirty meters to forty meters, filled with countless monsters howling and struggling in a sea of blood.
Even the purple-black Killing Intent swirling around Jack seemed to be merging into the Blood Sea Field high above, forming a purple-black Sky Curtain.
Just as Jack circled the Oasis again, the sky gradually began to darken.
Thump!
The solid rock burst, and Jack’s figure came to a sudden halt, his gaze sharp as he looked towards the far end of the sky where a mountain peak thousands of meters tall rose from the ground.
Amidst the black mist enveloping the summit, a towering figure appeared, casting a gaze full of malicious intent towards Jack from a distance that spanned tens of kilometers.
Even separated by such a distance, Jack felt a wave of danger approaching; the creature was powerful.
With Jack’s current abilities, any being capable of inducing a sense of danger in him had to be at least Eighth Layer or higher.
But wasn’t it said that Void Creatures of the Eighth Layer wouldn’t be encountered until one penetrated eight hundred kilometers into the ruins?
War spear in hand, Jack peered into the distance. His gaze leapt across tens of kilometers to rest upon the summit, finding traces of structures behind the formidable figure.
“Relics!” Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
In the two days of encircling the Oasis and racing through almost ten thousand kilometers in the Ruin Area, this was the first time he had seen such intact architecture.
“It should be killable.”
Feeling the malice directed at him and the creeping sense of danger, Jack believed he should be able to kill that creature.
Boom! The ground collapsed, and Jack burst forth, transforming into a golden beam heading towards the mountain peak at the end of the earth.
Such a rarely preserved relic must contain valuable items, and feeling he could handle the creature, Jack naturally wouldn’t let it go.
Over the cracked and undulating ground, the golden light moved at supersonic speed. In just two or three minutes, he crossed tens of kilometers, shattering everything in his path to arrive at the foot of the mountain.
Bang, bang!!
With a swing of the War Halberd, two humanoid Level 6 Void Monsters exploded before they could react.
The golden light briefly circled around, collecting the Purple Killing Energy before dashing up the mountain’s foot, resembling a golden beam shooting skyward from afar.
Hush!
The black mist dispersed, and amidst the howling wind, Jack appeared at the peak, his eyes keenly scanning ahead.
A figure eight meters tall, clad in tattered black armor with two sets of broken black wings behind him, stood in the black mist-filled area.
Clutching a bronze War Spear, the figure radiated a terrible Eighth Layer Early Phase aura amidst the swirling mists, akin to a Dark Angel of slaughter reaching down from the heavens.
As soon as Jack appeared, a terrifying burst of strength from the Dark Angel sent a huge surge of air that scattered the surrounding black mist, revealing its ghastly face—a rotting visage with exposed bone.
With blood-red eyes on that grotesque face, the Dark Angel showed intense murderous intent, and from its fanged maw erupted a cruel roar: “Human, die.”

chapters.title: Chapter 633: 289: Across Thousands of Miles, Dark Angel_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Chapter 289: Across Thousands of Miles, Dark Angel_3
Boom!
The heavy, overbearing bronze war spear pierced through the void, as if it had teleported instantly above Jack Clark’s head, smashing down with the force of a mountainous tsunami.
Because the power was too terrifying, the space around the bronze war spear was distorting.
Boom! A golden light-encircled halberd parried horizontally.
In an instant, the ground beneath Jack Clark and the Dark Angel shattered, with waves of energy rolling out, and a powerful surge of black and golden shockwaves burst in the air, scattering the dark mist that covered half of the sky.
In comparison to the eight-meter-tall Dark Angel, the ten-meter-long and significantly thicker Bronze War Spear made the less than two-meter-tall Jack Clark look like a three-year-old child in its presence.
But at this moment, with a war halberd in hand, Jack Clark stood tall and unshakable like a mountain.
“Roar! Human, die,”
With a persistent roar filled with murderous intent, the Dark Angel’s body erupted with black light, almost rendering the heavens and earth behind it black, as its aura increased several folds.
In an instant, mysterious black runes on the war spear flashed, and the transmitted power surged by more than tenfold.
Boom! Under the eruption of terrifying power, huge cracks spread out from beneath Jack’s feet, and soon after, half the mountaintop collapsed under this force.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Amidst the sky filled with falling boulders, two figures, one gold and one black, collided at supersonic speeds, fighting, their destructive impacts pulverizing all the surrounding rubble.
Boom!
A burst of destructive power soared in midair, and the explosive force sent the two figures flying apart.
Thump!
Jack Clark descended from the sky, the heavy battle boots smashing the ground to create a deep crater of several meters in diameter; then, with a solemn expression, he looked towards the dark figure hundreds of meters away.
The aura of this void creature was at the early phase of the Eighth Layer, yet the horrifying power displayed during the dozens of exchanges, as well as its almost instinctual combat skills, were incredibly powerful.
All of a sudden, Jack’s blood boiled, for it had been a long time since he had encountered an opponent worthy of a fight.
Just then, behind the Dark Angel, two pairs of broken wings unfolded, revealing four huge eyeballs. Soon after, the eyeballs lit up, and four beams of black light shot out.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The beams, emanating a destructive aura, crisscrossed along the mountainside, chasing the golden radiance, and wherever they passed, the ground exploded, digging out huge canyons.
Suddenly, a 40-meter-long Golden War Halberd emerged from thin air, vaguely sealing inside it a Blood Sea Hell, generating rings of white waves as it appeared before the Dark Angel.
Boom!
In a flash, blinding golden light erupted, and a hundred-meter diameter golden light sphere on the mountainside rapidly expanded, rising slowly followed by a violent explosion.
For a moment, the heavens shook and the earth quaked as the entire mountainside trembled under the strike of the Infernal Purgatory, with a raging wind howling and billowing waves of energy rushing out hundreds of meters.
Roar! From the center of the explosion, a mangled figure shot out, which was the Dark Angel.
Under Jack Clark’s full-force strike with the Infernal Purgatory in his normal state, the Dark Angel’s battle armor was even more damaged, and the eyes on the back of its wings were shattered.
But at this moment, the aura of this Dark Angel became even more violent, and an endless surge of Black Power erupted behind it, forming a gigantic dark phantom with double wings that was tens of meters tall.
In the hands of that enormous dark phantom, there was also a Bronze War Spear phantom, surrounded by cloud-like Black Power, as if a Demon God had descended.
This scene caused Jack Clark’s gaze to pause, as he had not expected this monster, already eroded by the Void and left with only instinct, to still be capable of deploying a force projection similar to the True Martial arts phantom.
But I can do that move too.
Boom! Behind Jack Clark, a thirty-meter-tall figure with three faces and six arms emerged, clad in black-red scale armor, wielding a 40-meter-long war halberd.
Add to that the four arms that were forming seals to support the Light sphere, surrounded by Blue Thunder while Golden Flames burned, it looked like a True God wielding the power of thunder and fire.
Boosted by the true martial arts phantom, Jack Clark’s aura surged by several times, in strength, defense, agility, and also the Thunder and Golden Flame wrapping around him.
Without any further words, the two figures transformed into streaks of light and shot out.
Boom!!
The War Halberd wrapped in Thunderflame clashed with the War Spear encased in darkness, and behind each combatant, the True Martial arts phantom and the dark phantom collided, unleashing an even more terrifying impact in an instant.
Within a hundred-meter radius, the earth shattered, countless pieces of rock and dirt were thrown hundreds of meters high, creating an awe-inspiring sound.
And once again, the strike was evenly matched.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Jack Clark and the Dark Angel went at it again, with Thunder circling about and flames burning as every exchange of blows caused terrifying shockwaves.
Behind them, the True Martial arts phantom and the Dark Shadow looked as if they were real entities engaged in battle, appearing like two God Demons fighting from a distance.
The dreadful aftermath of the battle caused mountains to crumble and the earth to split open, explosions hurled countless pieces of rock and dirt into the air, smoke and dust billowed, and the earth-shaking roars echoed endlessly.
At this moment, Jack Clark had unleashed almost all his power, except for the Void Double Pupils and Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form, contending against a Dark Angel close to the mid period of the Eighth Layer with the cultivation of the early stage of the Seventh Layer.
Such an exaggerated span of combat power made Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner, watching from outside the relics, somewhat astonished.
Lori Joyner exclaimed, “This young fellow’s combat power is somewhat heaven-defying; after reaching a high order, he can still cross a major realm, far stronger than the likes of Balderas.”
Marcellus Larry slowly nodded, “Indeed, Balderas and Eddy Keller are the highest in realm, and at full strength in the late period of the Seventh Layer, they can barely contend with someone from the mid period of the Eighth Layer.”
“But what’s different about Jack Clark is that their cross-realm Power Explosion can’t last, while Jack looks like a true Eighth Layer cultivator at this moment.”
“Besides, he hasn’t even used his most powerful Divine Rune Transformation.”
In the last battle in front of Mathilda Ward, Jack Clark had used the Divine Might Emperor Dragon Transformation in front of everyone, blowing apart the Akunus Nine-headed Blood Python’s avatar.
Therefore, this trump card was no secret among the Federal Top Level.
“It’s just that I didn’t expect the Dark Hell Tribe to show up in this area. These different races, although mutated by the Void’s contamination, still harbor intense hostility towards humans.”
“Plus, they have retained their battle consciousness and some racial abilities from before, making them very strong.”
“However, this contaminated beast is only from the Four-winged Dark Hell Tribe, not the six-winged; as long as Jack uses his Divine Rune Transformation, he should be able to kill it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 634: 290: Illusion Meditation Scripture, Eddy Keller: He's Cheating
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Chapter 290: Illusion Meditation Scripture, Eddy Keller: He’s Cheating
“`
In the ruins, two streaks of golden black light, exceeding the speed of sound by twice, were locked in relentless battle, twisting around each other as they descended from the half-destroyed mountainside to the foot of the mountain.
Each strike carried the explosive force of an Eight Layer Power Explosion, resulting in shockwaves that nearly obliterated everything in the vicinity, leaving behind hundred-meter cracks and pits tens of meters deep in the ground.
The True Dragon Power on the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd that exploded upon contact was like the blast of an intercontinental missile, forcefully shaking the aura of the Dark Angel.
As the fight between the two became increasingly frenetic, suddenly an endless dark burst centered around Jack Clark engulfed a two hundred meter radius in absolute darkness in the blink of an eye.
With the enhanced capabilities of the Void Double Pupils, the scope of the Dark Curtain also surged, eliminating auras, and blocking all five senses.
Even the Dark Angel could neither see nor sense anything under the absolute darkness of the Sky Curtain, but its reaction was swift, shattering the ground to leap up high instantly.
At that moment, an eight-meter-long War Halberd appeared in the sky, its condensed, oppressive aura nearly collapsing the Void, charged with an indescribable terrifying power.
Boom!
Under the assault of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, the Dark Angel, attempting to escape the Dark Curtain, was suppressed with a resounding crash, shattering the ground within a hundred-meter radius as it landed.
Simultaneously, a pair of sky-obscuring black gold vertical pupils emerged in the darkness, their gaze focusing, and solidifying the space within a twenty-meter radius instantly.
Boom!!
Within the confines of the Void Double Pupils’ lock, the space shattered like a broken mirror, countless pitch-black cracks spreading in all directions, slicing all matter within to dust.
The Dark Angel let out a violent roar as the dark power inside it burst forth in an attempt to counteract, but under the collapsing force of the massive space, it only paused briefly before disintegrating into hundreds of pieces.
With the aura of the Dark Angel gone, the Sky Curtain covering the two hundred meter area dissipated, revealing Jack Clark in his golden red gorgeous battle armor, standing with his halberd.
Behind him stood the three-faced six-armed Combat Shadow, surrounded by a Sea of Blood Hell, resembling a Prison-suppressing Divinity that suppressed darkness, with a terrifying aura.
Amplified by Void Rules by over three times, and with eighty percent of the Void Energy consumed, the space-shattering strike instantly annihilated the Dark Angel, who was almost at the mid-eighth level.
Just then, rich purple mist emanated from the Dark Angel’s corpse, swiftly enveloping Jack Clark, merging through his palm with the surrounding Killing Intent.
“These monsters are not to be underestimated,” Jack Clark said, his expression solemn as he glanced over the Dark Angel’s corpse before heading towards the half-collapsed mountain peak.
With the battle concluded, it was naturally time to harvest the rewards.
“What was that sudden outburst of darkness?”
Outside the relic, Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner looked at the devastated land where the Dark Angel’s corpse had suddenly turned into rubble, falling into a silent contemplation.
Due to the obfuscation of the Dark Curtain, they had not seen the darkness-shrouded eyes in the Void.
“It must be some powerful Cultivation Methods or abilities he has newly mastered,” Lori Joyner said slowly.
“Compared to Elemental Awakenings, Flesh Awakenings are even more mystical. In the late period of cultivation, the body might even evolve powerful innate talents on its own.”
“This young one, always full of surprises.”
Driven by astonishment, Jack Clark made his way to the half-shattered Mountain Peak.
Within the black mist, a structure resembling a Taoist Temple stood intact, sprawling hundreds of meters, surrounded by an Invisible Power, remarkably well-preserved.
Boom!
With the War Halberd wrapped in Golden Halberd Radiance, he struck, the earth trembled within a radius of dozens of meters, and a raging wind wave roared, yet the invisible force field remained unmoved.
Conversely, Jack Clark was knocked back several steps from the powerful rebound.
The scene resembled the one in the deep sea, where the Thunderflame Beheamoth and Single-horned Tiger Whale discovered that drop of ancient blood, also shielded by an invisible force field.
“Law Prohibition,” Jack Clark frowned slightly, finding it somewhat tricky as, with his current strength, he still could not shake the Law Prohibition that involved the rules.
Observing the well-preserved structure, he hesitated.
Summoning the projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could likely break the prohibition, but exposing that trump card for an uncertain relic seemed imprudent.
While Marcellus Larry had not mentioned it, Jack Clark had felt for some days as though he was being watched, likely due to the Eye of Heaven Observation originating from the relic.
After all, the Sub-eye alone enabled them to communicate within the relic.
Summoning the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was Jack Clark’s greatest card that he could not reveal lightly—the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s presence was already on record with the Federal Top Level.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had often sensed surveillance from satellites, evidence that they had long noticed its existence.
Of course, should danger arise, Jack Clark would not hesitate.
As for the explanation, he had already thought of a plausible excuse; however, it wasn’t yet time for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to interact with humans in its beast form.
Just as Jack Clark was pondering whether to give up, a residual realm of thought within the Taoist Temple was awakened by the fluctuations of True Strength, turning into an invisible wave that swept over Jack Clark.
“At last, has a ‘Person’ come…”
This realm of thought functioned like a pre-set mechanism, which upon sweeping over Jack Clark and confirming his ‘human’ status, the force field covering the Taoist Temple collapsed and disappeared.
Consequently, the sealed flow of time within also burst free.
To Jack Clark’s astonishment, the Taoist Temple, possibly centuries old, crumbled into dust, leaving behind a twenty-centimeter, square black seal floating in the air.
In an instant, Jack Clark crossed dozens of meters and grasped the seal in his hand, immediately feeling a weight upon him.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 635: 290: Illusion Meditation Scripture, Eddy Keller: He's Cheating_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Chapter 290: Illusion Meditation Scripture, Eddy Keller: He’s Cheating_2
This heaviness referred not to the body, but to the spiritual will, and even the soul, which was oppressed by the invisible weight emitted by the seal, making it difficult to operate.
By now, the sky had completely darkened, and the Void Energy permeating between heaven and earth grew more rampant, eroding the True Dragon Power covering Jack Clark’s body.
After storing the seal in the Sumeru Bracelet, Jack Clark’s figure jumped down directly from a mountain peak thousands of meters high, spreading light wings behind him and emitting scorching waves of air as he glided towards the distance.
Outside the ruins, Marcus Larry marveled, “Judging from the preservation of the ruins, that seal should represent a complete inheritance. It’s no surprise that he’s the son of destiny from this generation.”
It wasn’t just Jack Clark; many others also had gains today.
This time, the Federation gathered top-notch geniuses from various countries not only because of their talent but also because of their fortune as top-tier geniuses, or rather, their Luck.
Luck is something ethereal and elusive, with no one certain of its existence.
Yet, whenever a civilization or race is in dire straits, there always seem to be some exceptional beings who step forward to turn the tide, cut through the thorns, and pave a road of light.
Each of these individuals possesses great Luck, with a swift advancement in cultivation, turning misfortune into fortune, and encountering opportunities at the right times.
For instance, the current top three Speakers of the Human Race.
If they hadn’t soared through myths at an indescribable speed to stand among the supremely strong decades ago, the Human Race would have already been breached by The Purgatory Family.
Facing those Demon God Level Powerhouses, only those of the same level could withstand them. Ordinary king-level fighters were no match, not even Heavenly Kings.
Of course, these individuals didn’t rise because of Luck, but because they were inherently exceptional and defied the heavens.
Or rather, it was their strength that allowed them to rise and accumulate Luck, sweeping through all directions. They weren’t strong because they were lucky.
Just like Jack Clark, it was because he was inherently powerful that he could participate in the Koroya Trial, enter the Southern Battlefield ahead of time, and take on Mathilda Ward’s protection mission.
Following that, he earned three top-tier Secret Manuals from the mission, rapidly creating his own Secret Manual.
Hence, the Federal Top Level believed that the geniuses of this generation, one after another, were blessed with strong Luck, making them more suitable for exploring the ruins than those ‘older’ geniuses who had graduated a year or two ago.
The continuous gains of Jack Clark, Gabriella, and Jane Aiken today seemed to confirm this hypothesis.
Even those little guys exploring the Oasis have had some gains, more or less.
…
When Jack Clark entered the Oasis from the ruins, he only felt a lightness on his body, and the air around him suddenly became fresh, feeling comfort all over under the Heavenly Energy.
On the hillside, a fire danced as Jane Aiken cut slices of Alien Beast Meat.
At that moment, a terrible Killing Intent approached from afar. As Jack Clark walked out of the darkness, the restrained invisible Killing Intent he carried still made the flames seem dim.
Jane Aiken was a bit surprised, “Jack Clark, how many Void Creatures did you kill today?”
“Probably around two thousand,” said Jack Clark as he sat opposite her, and with a thought, he summoned his attribute page, his gaze falling behind the talent section for the Void Double Pupils.
Talent: Void Double Pupils+3461[Top-tier, eyes containing the power of the Void]
In a single day, moving in a zigzag pattern, he covered a larger area, almost crisscrossing tens of thousands of kilometers, and the number of creatures he killed exceeded two thousand.
Most of these creatures were of the Sixth Layer Heaven, few were Level 5, a little over a hundred were Level 7, and the strongest was a Dark Angel Monster from the early phase of Eight Layer Heaven.
“…I feel you’re becoming more and more monstrous,” Jane Aiken exclaimed in astonishment.
Jack Clark’s combat strength was very strong; Jane Aiken was well aware of this. What astonished her was his terrifying stamina, which seemed as if his True Strength was endless.
At that moment, a flickering light on both their wrists indicated that Sub-eye communication was now available.
Cangyun. Wuhong: “Damn! 57,000? Am I sure I’m not seeing the numbers wrong?” On the edge of the Oasis, a young man’s eyes widened incredulously as he stared at the leaderboard.
Today, when the Sub-eye channel opened, it wasn’t as lively as the past two days; instead, there was a deathly silence as everyone gaped or was shocked at the first name on the leaderboard.
Behind the name Jack Clark, the number 59240 left everyone stunned.
Especially Eddy Keller, who was standing expectantly on top of a Hundred-meter Stone Peak, his right hand already positioned behind his back ready to burst into victorious laughter, his eyes widened in shock.
Glancing at his own Purple Kill points tally of over fifteen thousand, then back at Jack Clark, whose points had soared from just over two thousand to nearly sixty thousand in one day, Eddy Keller couldn’t help but shout.
“I won’t accept this, this guy must be cheating,” he bellowed.
At this point, many people subconsciously harbored the thought that this guy was cheating.
It couldn’t be helped; it was too terrifying.
An increase of over fifty thousand points in a day—if they were Level 5 creatures, he would have had to slaughter thirty to forty thousand of them, and for Level 6 creatures, it would have been over two thousand.
What did it mean to kill over two thousand creatures of the Sixth Layer Heaven and above?
It meant that among all the Federal Geniuses who had entered, aside from a few monstrous ones who had stepped into the Seventh Layer Heaven, the rest wouldn’t have enough to even come close.
Wouldn’t this guy’s True Strength run out?
After all, even a Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator would need to burst out with power to kill a Level 6 creature, consuming a lot of True Strength, and after killing just dozens, they would need to recover due to exhaustion.
And that’s if they weren’t surrounded and attacked.
If dozens of Level 6 creatures were to attack, even a regular Seventh Layer Heaven strong man wouldn’t be able to withstand it, let alone someone like Jack Clark, who was slaying thousands.
As for the day before yesterday, the creatures he had slain were almost all Level 5. With Seventh Layer Heaven cultivation, killing over a thousand Level 5 creatures in succession was something people could barely accept.

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 290 Illusion Meditation Scripture, Eddy Keller: He’s Cheating_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Chapter 290 Illusion Meditation Scripture, Eddy Keller: He’s Cheating_3
Accept a ghost my foot.
Simon Frank, “It’s terrifying, this guy. Today, I saw him running past at supersonic speed from a distance, and I knew the rankings would change.”
Ralrudo Carter, “I ventured 300 kilometers deep into the ruins today and saw Jack Clark too. Did this guy circle around the Oasis killing again?”
Hundred Foxes Rowan Trevino, “It’s clear he killed another round today, with such terrifying stamina, I’d call him the strongest.”
Simon Gabriaphina, “I’d also call him the strongest, feels like this guy is even more durable than a Mecha, actually killing so many monsters while circling thousands of kilometers in one day.”
Eastern Summer Justin Welan, “Hahahaha… I knew it, Jack never disappoints when it comes to shocking people.”
At this moment, Jack Clark chimed in.
Eastern Summer Jack Clark, “No need for surprise, everyone. It was just killing some Void Creatures, but today I encountered an eight-level monster within the 400 kilometers range.”
Bellin Baldaz, “An Early Stage Level 8 polluted monster appeared within a 400 kilometers range?”
Eastern Summer Jack Clark, “Correct, so everyone be careful. Not all monsters follow the rule that they get stronger the deeper you go into the ruins.”
Jack’s words sent a chill through those who delved deep into the ruins.
Since an Early Stage Level 8 monster could appear within the 400 kilometers range, who dared to guarantee that Late Stage Level 8 monsters wouldn’t appear within the 500 kilometers range?
If they were to encounter one, they’d only have one way to go with their strength—death.
Because of this news, everyone momentarily forgot to continue marveling at Jack’s heaven-defying battle achievements, pondering whether they should be more cautious when entering the ruins tomorrow.
Jane Aiken looked gravely, “It seems the ruins are more dangerous than we imagined.”
Jack Clark slowly said, “Rather, it’s extremely dangerous.”
Don’t look at him being invincible these past two days; that’s because he’s still on the outer edges of the ruins. If he were to delve into the territories where the Eight Layer Heaven beings are entrenched, even he wouldn’t dare say he could come out unscathed.
Let alone the possible existence of Level 9 monsters deep within.
At this moment, Jack scrolled through the ranking list and noticed that, aside from himself, the top five, Eddy Keller, Gabriaphina, Balderas, Brudos, all had surpassed ten thousand points.
Following them was Damon Lopes with over nine thousand points in sixth place, and seventh place belonged to a person named Kevin Yates, with over eight thousand points. Jack barely recognized the names of the remaining thirty names.
These were the older geniuses, with cultivation levels at Mid-Stage Sixth Heaven and above, with points generally above three thousand.
The ranking list steadily declined, and by the 120th position, the Purple Killing Energy had dropped below one thousand points, and after the 300th position, it even dropped below three hundred points.
This meant that in the three days that had passed, only one hundred and twenty geniuses had obtained the entry ticket. In the next ten days or so, a few dozen to a hundred might still be able to squeeze in.
And even stepping onto the Road to Becoming a God doesn’t ensure gains; one must pass through the trials on the Path of Inheritance to receive the Origin rewards.
One thousand Purple Evil was just the entry ticket.
And this was under normal conditions.
Among the almost one thousand top-notch geniuses who came in this time, about five hundred and above were under twenty years old and had achieved a breakthrough to Sixth Layer Heaven. The majority were at the Early Sixth Heaven.
Then there were geniuses like Justin who achieved a First-grade breakthrough to Fivefold Heaven, with most in the initial and mid-stages, with about two hundred people in total from various countries.
The rest were geniuses at the Late-Stage Fifth Heaven to the peak, and a few second graders who had achieved a breakthrough to the Sixth Layer Heaven, with roughly two hundred plus people in total.
Out of these, those below the Sixth Layer Heaven, aside from a few who relied on their powerful strength, mostly chose to venture into the Oasis like Crystal Lewis and the others.
So approximately six hundred plus people went into the ruins, battling monsters or seeking relics.
But these people were not Jack Clark. As Sixth Heaven cultivators, they could battle monsters at the same sixth level and even fight across two or three smaller levels.
However, unlike Jack, who forcibly dominated through his physical strength, their battles consumed a lot of True Strength.
Even Eddy Keller, in his Late Sevenfold Sky stage, had to rest and recover after a hard struggle against a Late Sevenfold Sky monster of the same level.
So after three days, not many could continue killing dozens of Level 6 monsters.
Today, Jane Aiken was still ‘in charge of the kitchen.’ After a good meal, Jack saw Jane take out a palm-sized golden sword from the opposite side.
Feeling the ancient aura coming from the small sword, a smile appeared on Jack’s face, “Seems like Student Aiken has had some good luck today.”
“You’re not doing too bad either,” said Jane as she glanced towards the black seal in Jack’s hands.
They exchanged a smile and then began to ponder over the relics in their hands.
When Jane Aiken was in a collapsed building today, her four Sword Intents swirled, cutting down several Level 6 polluted monsters, and the sword buried underground was activated by the Sword Intent emanating from her.
She was so fortunate that even Marcellus Larry, who saw this scene, was somewhat surprised.
Soon, Jane’s body was enveloped in an aura of enlightenment, and a sharp essence spread out from the small sword, causing her hair to flutter without wind.
Seeing this, Jack looked at the black seal in his hands, cautiously extending a bit of his spirit power to touch it.
Hum!
Jack’s consciousness sunk in an instant, and he arrived in a dark Heaven and Earth, with an ancient scripture composed of thousands of ancient characters floating in the ‘Firmament.’
Illusion Meditation Scripture.
When Jack saw those words, even though he didn’t recognize the ancient script, the name of the cultivation method subconsciously surfaced in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 291: Soul Monarch, Seal of the Suppressed Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Chapter 291: Soul Monarch, Seal of the Suppressed Soul
“Soul Formless, Born of the Emperor…”
The ancient voice resounded in Jack Clark’s heart like the great tolling of a bell, and the floating text in the sky began to spin, then with a boom, it rushed into his Sea of Consciousness.
Instantly, a surge of information exploded within Jack Clark’s Sea of Consciousness.
This was an inheritance of a Soul Cultivation Method, envisioning one’s own soul as sovereign.
Under normal conditions, a cultivator would only be able to touch upon the soul after reaching the Ninth Heavens; the stronger the soul, the greater the understanding of and the power over rules.
But there are distinctions in strength as well.
A soul of equivalent strength, before any cultivation, is like a 300-pound obese man, with flaccid fat all over his body, while a soul that has practiced a Soul Cultivation Method is like a martial artist, robust and formidable.
Beyond that, Cultivation Methods of this level are inherited through the will of the soul, not mere text, therefore they can be understood and learned even by civilizations with different languages.
However, the difficulty of reaching the soul before the Nine Layers is high, and even Cultivation Methods from ancient inheritances would require an object that Suppresses the Soul to be cultivated.
Such as the black seal in Jack Clark’s hand.
In ancient times, every disciple of the Illusion Gate would receive an Ethereal Soul Device made of special materials to bridge their physical bodies and souls during cultivation.
Such a Soul Device is an Initial Soul Treasure; it holds no significant power of its own, but it can become unfathomably terrifying as it carries rules and the soul undergoes Tempering.
Under the night, bathed in the glow of firelight, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, revealing a look of astonishment.
He had not expected that the inheritance he had obtained this time involved a Soul Cultivation Method, something that felt somewhat similar to Sky King Denny Kaye’s Level 9 Divine Lotus.
At that moment, with a thought from Jack Clark, a transparent page appeared before his eyes.
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [First Layer, not yet entered.]
Tip: The current method is of the Soul category; Attribute points converted from Life Energy are ineffective on it, and Soul Points from Soul-type energy conversion are needed for strengthening.]
Attribute points can’t enhance? Jack Clark’s gaze landed on the footnote, and his eyes narrowed slightly.
Attribute points come from Life Energy and can be transformed to enhance talents or Cultivation Methods, all of which indeed involve the body.
Although Attribute points cannot directly be used for enhancement, Jack Clark could still enter the threshold of the method because of his Inheritance; but his progress in cultivation afterwards would definitely not be as rapid as enhancement.
Moreover, he did not have many Attribute points left in his hands; for the final sprint on the Road to Becoming a God, he could not use them even if he was able to enhance now.
Thoughtful, Jack Clark activated the inheritance seals formed by the characters in his Sea of Consciousness with a thought.
Boom! The inheritance seals once again exploded into countless characters, and instantly an invisible Soul Power was drawn out, enshrouding the Soul Suppressing Seal in Jack Clark’s hand.
Under the deluge of boundless Soul Power, the originally solid black seal slowly became ethereal and then merged into Jack Clark’s chest, sinking deeper and deeper.
In the dark, void, soul ‘world’ undetectable by the senses, a hand large enough to cover the sky reached out from the darkness as soon as the Soul Suppressing Seal appeared, lightly gripping the Seal.
With the Soul Suppressing Seal as a bridge, for the first time, Jack Clark clearly sensed the existence of his own soul.
Vague, yet immeasurably vast.
Under the repeated Evolution feedback from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Four Major Attributes representing all aspects of Jack Clark’s body were also growing in sync, becoming more and more powerful.
Including the soul, which was also becoming stronger under the plentiful nourishment of Spirit Qi.
It was only with a strengthening soul that Jack Clark could maintain his link with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had reached Level 9, always remaining in sync.
It was only because of the Giant Beast Avatar that Jack Clark’s soul had been suppressing the Soul Channel in some unknown depth all this time.
Today was the first time he had touched his own soul; the only descriptors for it were immense, vast, and also ‘ethereal,’ lacking concentration.
Boom! As the Illusion Meditation Scripture ‘circulated,’ a terrifying soul fluctuation burst forth from the depths of the darkness.
Immediately, Jack Clark felt the ‘connection’ with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon become a bit tighter, and the bidirectional control of consciousness became more flexible and independent.
Just as Jack Clark began to cultivate the Illusion Meditation Scripture, under the influence of the soul fluctuations, the three-faced, six-armed Combat Shadow in his Sea of Consciousness vibrated at its brow.
The Incomplete Rune of Cut through the Void, which had originally formed under the Limit Enhancement in the Third Layer Heaven by the combination of his will and the power of the Cultivation Methods, now trembled slightly upon feeling the Soul Power.
Hum! The Blade of Void Cutting Rune emitted a suction force, absorbing strands of Soul Energy that were being released during the cultivation of the Illusion Meditation Scripture.
This change took Jack Clark by surprise and also filled him with anticipation, wondering what would happen after the special rune absorbed Soul Energy.
Would it evolve into a complete rune, or would it give rise to new abilities?
Because of the Inheritance, Jack Clark spent that night practicing the Illusion Meditation Scripture, finally achieving an entry level by dawn.
In the Ruins Continent, seated in meditation throughout the night, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, his gaze profound and carrying with it an intense pressure, the pressure that comes from the soul.
After practicing the Illusion Meditation Scripture, Jack Clark’s vast Soul Power had become much more focused and condensed.
What followed was continuous cultivation, ultimately leading to the grand accomplishment of the method, and the soul becoming ‘Monarch’; at that time, the fusion of the Monarchical Soul with the Rule True Body would be terrifyingly powerful.
This path had been very special even in ancient times, because the Illusion Meditation Scripture was incredibly difficult to cultivate, requiring an Innate foundation where the soul was more than five times stronger than peers at the same level.
And because of Jack Clark’s strong soul, once he cultivated this method to a grand accomplishment, he would be stronger than the historical kings of the Illusion Gate.
Sensing the imposing and invisible pressure emanating from Jack Clark, Jane Aiken, opposite him, expressed her amazement, “Such significant change in just one night, could it be that the inheritance you’ve obtained is a complete Cultivation Method?”

chapters.title: Chapter 638: 291: Soul Monarch, Seal of the Suppressed Soul_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Chapter 291: Soul Monarch, Seal of the Suppressed Soul_2
Jack Clark cracked a slight smile, “Indeed, an inheritance of a cultivation method called the Illusion Meditation Scripture, which involves soul cultivation.”
Concerning the matter of cultivation methods, Jack Clark did not conceal anything, for there was no need to.
The cultivation methods, texts, and rune-related inheritances they obtained from the ruins needed to be translated and copied for the Federation upon their return, just like those strong men of former times had done.
If it had not been for their collation and continuous refinement of these inheritances, the True Martial Cultivation System would not have been able to develop so rapidly and produce so many powerful individuals.
Although a copy would be disseminated, without the inheritance mark and the matching soul instrument, it would be very difficult for the later generations to learn the Illusion Meditation Scripture.
Add to that the basic threshold of soul cultivation at five times that of peers at the same stage, there would likely be few individuals below the Ninth Heavens in the entire Federation capable of practicing it, let alone mastering it.
“To think it’s a cultivation method involving the soul.” Even Jane Aiken couldn’t help revealing a look of surprise in her eyes, for such cultivation methods were exceedingly rare.
Jack Clark, now interested as he looked at Jane Aiken, whose aura of sharpness enveloped her, queried, “Student Aiken, what’s inside that little sword you obtained?”
Jane Aiken replied softly, “A Sword Array Inheritance.”
“The core is to gather the Power of Heaven and Earth with Sword Intent to form a Sword Array that seals all directions. The more Sword Intents one comprehends and the stronger the Sword Intent, the more formidable the Sword Array’s might becomes.”
“…It’s actually a Sword Array, and why do I feel like it fits you so well?” Jack Clark paused.
Jane Aiken appeared not at all surprised, “This is a place of an Ancient Civilization’s Inheritance. If it’s about inheritance, it’s natural that the right person obtains the right cultivation method.”
“It’s what’s called fate.”
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s true.”
His soul was innately strong, and he happened to receive the Illusion Meditation Scripture, which required such a strong innate soul for cultivation. Now that he thought about it, it did seem quite a coincidence.
As the conversation reached this point, Jack Clark couldn’t help but ask out of curiosity, “Student Aiken, may I ask what are the characteristics of the four types of Sword Intent you have condensed?”
After some thought, Jane Aiken responded, “The four types of Sword Intent I have named are Life and Death Illusion, Space Tear, Wind Spirit Instant Slash, and Soul Slaying and Spirit Destruction.”
“They involve Illusion, Space, Wind Speed, and Spiritual Will, respectively.”
“Quite comprehensive. It seems that you, Student Aiken, had a goal when you condensed the Sword Intent. Coupled with the Sword Array you obtained this time, once the Four Great Sword Intentions reach grand accomplishment…”
Jack Clark himself paused as he spoke.
With grand accomplishment of Sword Intent, not only does the amplification of gathering Heavenly Energy reach fivefold, but it also turns the intangible into tangible, enabling one to utilize the properties of Sword Intent to their utmost limits.
Although the Four Great Sword Intentions all belong to the realm of thought, and the amplification of gathered Power of Heaven and Earth does not stack, even when they overlap, they can still reach more than tenfold.
Combined with the special attributes contained in the four types of Sword Intent, coupled with the Sword Array she obtained this time, her strength will become extremely formidable.”
Considering this, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be impressed.
Deservedly the top genius of South Sky Martial Height, her talent became increasingly terrifying the further she progressed.
Moreover, it could be seen from her condensation of attribute Sword Intent that, even without the Sword Array inheritance, Jane Aiken’s cultivation direction would likely involve Sword Arrays like Jack’s.
In the face of Jack Clark’s amazement, Jane Aiken shook her head, “Reaching the grand accomplishment of Sword Intent is not that simple, as comprehending too many Sword Intents makes my breakthrough quite challenging.”
“Indeed, reaching grand accomplishment in the realm of thought is extremely difficult,” Jack Clark acknowledged with a nod of understanding.
It took him almost three months to condense Prison Blood War Intent, and it was only recently that he achieved minor accomplishment by using the Endless Blood River in Akunus to slay ‘millions’ of Blood Demons.
Now, he was unsure how long it would take for him to achieve grand accomplishment.
The girl opposite him sighed and nodded, “Yes, it’s indeed difficult. I estimate that for my Four Great Sword Intentions to reach grand accomplishment, it will take at least another month.”
…Suddenly, Jack Clark paused, finding himself not wanting to speak with this person anymore.
However, the girl didn’t notice Jack Clark’s expression and continued, “Once the Sword Intent reaches grand accomplishment, I need to create my own Secret Manual. I wonder how long it will take me to break through to the Seventh Layer.”
Given Jane Aiken’s talent, she naturally would not follow the path of others. In the late stage of the Sixth Heavenly Stage, she would choose to create her own Secret Manual, just like Jack Clark.
Jack Clark smiled and said, “With your strong comprehension talent, Student Aiken, there’s definitely no problem in creating your own Secret Manual. Perhaps it can be completed in a month or two.”
“Moreover, this Ruins Continent is full of inheritances. Perhaps with a bit of luck, you’ll directly come across a Sword Scripture Inheritance that leads straight to a monarch-level.”
“I hope so,” she said.
With that, both of them laughed.
Having exchanged pleasantries, it was time to handle serious matters. Jack Clark was very satisfied with the might of the Void Double Pupils’ attack from the day before, which had instantly killed the Dark Angel.
Therefore, he needed to slay more Void Creatures to continue stacking the passive enhancement of the Void Double Pupils.
Besides, he intended to pay more attention to the ruins’ buildings.
The strength of the Illusion Meditation Scripture made it somewhat of a surprise for him, indicating that the inheritances within contained many treasures.
No wonder Emma Louise told him not to worry about cultivation resources but to pay more attention to these objects imbued with the essence of antiquity. There might well be inheritances or insights of a past strong man among them.
Whoosh, whoosh! Jack Clark and Jane Aiken leaped down from the sky.
In midair, Jack Clark burst through the air, transforming into a streak of golden light that shot out, causing the shockwaves to pulverize all the vegetation in its path.
Compared to Jack Clark, at this moment Jane Aiken was enveloped in swirling Sword Intent, moving in complete silence at Subsonic Speed like a streak of azure light.
Truthfully, Jack Clark could also move silently at Supersonic Speed, but such a mode of travel lacked forcefulness.
Where there was no need for stealth or concealment, there was no need to use True Strength unnecessarily. After all, his “strength” was endless and could be used at will.

chapters.title: Chapter 639: 291: Soul Monarch, Seal of the Suppressed Soul_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Chapter 291: Soul Monarch, Seal of the Suppressed Soul_3
And he loved this grandiose way of moving, the thunderous, rapid sprint felt like an exhilarating crash through everything.
When Jack Clark and Jane Aiken set off, many geniuses also entered the ruins from all directions around the edge of the Oasis.
However, today everyone was much more cautious, including Balderas and his group.
Knowing that creatures at the early stage of level eight had appeared within a 400-kilometer range, even Eddy Keller dared not be careless and entered the ruins with extra caution.
As for the first place on the leaderboard, what was that?
Meanwhile, under the turbulent sea surface, over twenty Mutated Tiger Whales, ranging from ten to thirty meters in length, gathered and floated in the water, not daring to move an inch.
In front of these Tiger Whales stood a formidable Black-red Colossal Beast, one hundred and sixty meters long and ferocious in shape. Its invisible, fierce pressure froze the Tiger Whales with fear.
In front of an Emperor-level gigantic beast, the Mutated Tiger Whales instinctively felt terror.
However, the three “Little” Tiger Whales had long grown accustomed to the terrifying might of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and swam excitedly towards it upon sight.
Elder Tiger, Tiger One, let out a happy roar, “Roar roar roar!! Uncle, I’ve recruited many of our kind, and they’re very happy to join the Dragon Palace.”
Tiger Two: “Roar roar roar!! And me, and me, I’m also working hard, Uncle.”
Tiger Three: “Roar roar!! Uncle, we’re super cool.”
The three Little Tiger Whales were like kids showing off their achievements, circling the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon happily and occasionally splashing giant waves when leaping out of the water.
This scene widened the eyes of those other Mutated Tiger Whales.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at those twenty or so Mutated Tiger Whales and nodded in satisfaction, letting out a deep growl, “Not bad, aim to gather hundreds of them, and form an Alien Beast Army.”
“Alright, keep it up, I’m going to continue looking for some food to eat.”
After speaking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at those Level 6 Peak Tiger Whales, and the cold light piercing through its golden vertical pupils chilled them to the bone.
Boom!
Blazing air waves burst out from the scale horns on its shoulders, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon disappeared into the darkness like a massive torpedo, and only then did the Mutated Tiger Whales finally breathe a sigh of relief.
That moment, one of the Level 6 Mutated Tiger Whales moved forward slightly, hesitantly asking, “Roar! Esteemed leaders, who was that just now?”
Tiger One let out a proud cry: “Roar roar roar!! That was Uncle Brock Abbott, one of the Five Great Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace, the Thunderflame Dragon King Tim Abbott.”
Tiger Two also boasted proudly: “Roar roar!! Uncle Thunderflame is so badass, he led us earlier to obliterate a Beast Empire, killing multiple Level 9 Giant Beasts and even defeated quasi-mythical beasts.”
Tiger Three: “Roar roar!! At that time, even Mythical Giant Beasts descended, but they were defeated by the King of Storm and Frost, the Great Scythia Dragon King from our Dragon Palace, who is also super cool.”
Hiss hiss hiss!! Instantly, the Mutated Tiger Whales all widened their eyes and drew in a cold breath, their powerful inhaling creating vortices in the water.
Over the past few days, through the education of the three Mutated “Little” Tiger Whales, these wild, countryside Tiger Whales had gained some understanding of the levels of Extraordinary Creatures.
For example, they knew they were Level 4 and Level 5, and the levels of their three leaders were Level 7.
Above them lay the even stronger level eight, the terrifying level nine, and above level nine, the earth-shattering quasi-mythical and Mythical-level.
That terrifying Black-red Colossal Beast from just before had actually killed Level 9 Giant Beasts and even defeated quasi-mythical beasts, no wonder its mere presence was so horrifying.
Moreover, another Storm Frost Dragon King from their Dragon Palace could even defeat Mythical Giant Beasts; they were immensely powerful.
At this thought, the Mutated Tiger Whales were all boiling with enthusiasm.
Because they too had joined such a terrifying giant beast power, the future seemed full of hope.
Especially since one of the Five Great Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace was the King of Black and White, a Tiger Whale just like them; as one of the Dragon Kings, it must also be exceedingly powerful.
At this moment, Tiger One let out a cry: “Let’s move, family, and continue summoning companions to join the Dragon Palace.”
Tiger Two: “Roar roar roar!! Right, let’s gather more, and if they don’t listen, we’ll beat them to death.”
Tiger Three: “Roar roar!! Gather the mighty army, go back and defeat dad, I also want to be a Dragon King.”

chapters.title: Chapter 640: 292: From Death to Life, Gabriella: Jack Clark Saved Me (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 640: Chapter 292: From Death to Life, Gabriella: Jack Clark Saved Me (Seeking Monthly Votes)
In the super-large pit over 300 meters in diameter and dozens of meters deep, Justin Welan was gasping for breath as he dug around the Dragon Turtle statue, drenched in sweat.
Even though he was a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator, digging such a huge pit for two days also left him somewhat exhausted.
“Phew! Take a break.”
Leaning on his makeshift ‘shovel,’ Justin wiped the sweat from his forehead and hesitated as he looked at the half-exposed stone carving: “That said, I hope I haven’t been busy for days for nothing.”
From the initial surprise of discovering the damaged stele to the confusion after studying the inscriptions on the stele and discerning nothing, Justin also felt some doubt at this point.
