“Forget it; if I can’t understand it, I will dig out the stone carvings first. Jack always said, when you encounter inscriptions or statues that you can’t decipher, just dig them all out first.”
“Many special stone carvings require their integrity to receive some kind of enlightenment.”
“Work hard today to finish early so I can continue to watch Jack show off tonight, heh heh.”
Witnessing his good brother’s rapid rise and the talents that became ever more impressive, shocking everyone again and again, filled Justin with excitement.
Although he wasn’t that amazing himself, it was enough that his brother was.
Having such an amazing brother meant that he was amazing as well, right?
The logic was flawless.
“Sis, do you see, could these glyphs be saying something?”
Inside the mountain belly, Crystal Lewis and her sister Mandy had cleaned the walls of the stone palace that were over thirty meters high and spanned a hundred meters for the past two days.
As the moss and dust were removed, the relief carvings on the walls became much clearer. Though color paint had long since fallen off due to age, they remained lifelike.
These reliefs, from left to right, seemed to depict the life of a woman.
From her early years entering the sect to embark on cultivation, growing up with fellow disciples, venturing down the mountain with a man by her side, and entering another world to “vanquish demons and slay monsters.”
The last of the reliefs depicted the sky covered by flames and the earth submerged by deep blue sea water; the sun and moon fell from the sky, ending on a doomsday scene.
Looking at the flames that scorched the sky in the final scene, Crystal slowly said, “Mandy, I feel like those flames seem… ‘alive.'”
“Alive?” Mandy was slightly startled, her gaze unconsciously falling on the Tsunami below…
While everyone else made some gains, Howard Lambert encountered danger when he entered the ruins today.
Roar!
Along with a roar, a pile of broken stones from a building that had collapsed an unknown number of years ago suddenly exploded.
Amid the smoke and dust, a Void Creature appeared, five meters tall, donning relatively intact heavy armor and wielding a massive warhammer, radiating the presence of Level 6 Intermediate.
The Void Creature’s steps shattered the Earth, and in the blink of an eye, it charged at Howard, its warhammer sweeping across the air, creating explosive sonic booms.
Boom!
Caught off guard, Howard managed only to block the attack with a Steel Pillar in front of him, followed by a terrifying force that came like a mountainous Tsunami, causing his True Power to collapse.
Boom!
Under the immense force, the Steel Pillar smashed into Howard’s body, causing his extraordinary battle armor to collapse, and he himself was blasted away at supersonic speed, crashing heavily against a ruined City Wall a hundred meters away.
Bang! A section of the City Wall, tens of meters high and two zhang thick, instantly exploded and collapsed, its stones rolling down and burying Howard. But in the blink of an eye, the stone mill burst open.
Huff, huff!!
Howard’s breath was heavy, and blood flowed through the crevices of his battle armor. Looking at the distant Void Creature shrouded in black-purple fog, his eyes narrowed with seriousness.
This creature, which retained its fighting consciousness, was very strong—overwhelmingly strong and overbearing with power that contained the special attribute to burst through everything.
Besides, with the realm suppression, it almost injured him severely with just one move.
Roar! Seeing that Howard was not smashed to death by its hammer, the creature let out a furious roar and charged forward again, shattering the Earth with its heavy warhammer as it shot forward with thunderous momentum.
The sheer force of the creature was like a destructive tank; everything in its path, all foundations and ruins, was annihilated.
“Kill!”
Wounded, Howard became even more frenzied, his eyes blood-red, filled with endless demonic madness.
Boom!
With the Bull Devil Battle Body erupting, Howard swelled to nearly four meters, his body enveloped in red mist as he grabbed the five-meter-long Steel Pillar and roared as he charged forward.
Thump!
The Steel Pillar and the heavy warhammer collided, and an instant burst of pure strength erupted, shattering the Earth over tens of meters around them, sending a raging wind sweeping a hundred meters away.
With Red True Power shimmering on the half-meter thick Steel Pillar, it blocked the Black Power-encircled warhammer. Holding the Steel Pillar tight, Howard stared at the opposing creature as the ground beneath his feet crumbled continuously.
I must hold on; I’m Howard Lambert, with my Innate Divine Strength, invincible.
Under a strong resolve, Howard’s king-level bloodline further activated within him, and golden scales emerged on his skin. A more violent force erupted from within him.
Roar! Amid inhuman roars, Howard’s arms erupted with power, with a burst throwing the heavy hammer above his head away. Immediately after, the creature collided with him again.
Boom, boom, boom!! As the two battled wildly, the shockwaves from their fight utterly destroyed the surrounding buildings, fractured the Earth, and the wind howled.
Roar! A Level 6 Early Stage Creature was attracted by the life aura emitted by Howard and charged toward him with a furious roar, becoming a shadowy figure.
However, just as the creature got close, it was swiped by Howard, wielding the Steel Pillar shining with red power. The brutal force shattered the upper body of the creature with a single strike.
But the distraction caused by this Void Creature caused the Black Power-encircled heavy hammer to shoot forward with three afterimages like teleportation, appearing instantly before Howard’s chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 641: 292: Embracing Death, Birth of Life, Gabriella: Jack Clark Save Me (Request for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 641: Chapter 292: Embracing Death, Birth of Life, Gabriella: Jack Clark Save Me (Request for Monthly Ticket)_2
“`
Boom! Howard Lambert was once again sent flying like a cannonball, crashing through over a dozen foundation walls before finally rolling over a dozen times upon hitting the ground with a loud thud.
“`
“`
At this moment, Howard’s body was covered in blood, with multiple muscles burst and his battle armor shattered.
“`
“`
But with a slight push of his palm against the ground, Howard stood up again, his body shrouded in a thick fog of blood, his face smeared in it, looking like a monster driven mad by frenzy.
“`
“`
“It’s not enough, not yet. I still have one more battle to fight with him; how could I possibly die here today?”
“`
“`
Thinking of Jack Clark’s increasingly distant back, and the battle he had promised with that guy, Howard felt overwhelmed by a strong will to survive and an unwillingness to give up.
“`
“`
How could he die here?
“`
“`
He was Howard Lambert, the man destined to be invincible, who had promised a battle with that fellow destined to become a god.
“`
“`
Under the powerful obsession of self-suggestion, the King-level bloodline power, which had already become one with Howard and strengthened numerous times, was stimulated even more thoroughly.
“`
“`
Roar! An even more savage and demon-like aura burst from Howard, with a mist of blood spreading around him, forming the ghostly shape of a creature resembling both a Furious Ape and a Bull Demon behind him.
“`
“`
At the same time, Howard, who was close to breaking into the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, experienced a surge in aura and successfully broke through to the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven.
“`
“`
Boom! With his Cultivation Methods advancing further, Howard roared, swinging a Steel Pillar thick as a column, and blasted forward to battle with the mighty Hammer-wielding War General.
“`
“`
Boom, boom, boom!! After more than ten minutes, accompanied by the explosion of the War General’s head, his massive body fell to the ground with a loud thud.
“`
“`
Next to the monster’s corpse, the 4-meter-tall Howard was shrouded in a red mist of blood, his battle armor in tatters, carrying a 5-meter-long Steel Pillar, emanating a woeful aura.
“`
“`
“This guy fights by putting himself in mortal danger and then survives by breaking past his body’s limits; it’s a wicked path. One day he could be killed by some minor creature, and no one would even know.”
“`
“`
Saying this, Jack Clark made a grasping motion with his right hand, and from several meters away, he grabbed the head of a Level 6 Void Monster and gently squeezed.
“`
“`
Bang! The monster’s head exploded, and its body fell to the ground with a loud thud, its stinking blood gushing out onto the ground, where the purple-black fog began to condense.
“`
“`
From a high-altitude vantage point, one could see the bodies of over a dozen monsters lying within a range of several kilometers.
“`
“`
At this time, Howard, who was at a distance, spurted out a large amount of blood, his size rapidly shrinking back to 2.5 meters before he collapsed to the ground with a thump.
“`
“`
Simultaneously, his extraordinary battle armor, no longer activated by True Strength, also shrank.
“`
“`
After falling to the ground, the gravely weakened Howard gathered the last of his strength to conceal his aura, gasping for breath and carefully sensing his surroundings.
“`
“`
He was in a state of weakness, so frail that any monster could have killed him.
“`
“`
However, if he could just survive the time it took for his Bull Devil Battle Body’s regenerative power to kick in, his injuries would rapidly heal, and his body would reconstitute itself to recover 30% of his strength.
“`
“`
Fortunately, in the half-hour of Howard’s tense waiting, the surroundings remained eerily quiet, with not a single Polluted Monster in sight.
“`
“`
Phew! In Howard’s body, a surge of powerful Life Energy erupted, under which his shattered muscles and fractured bones healed at an astonishing speed.
“`
“`
In just over ten minutes, Howard’s external injuries had almost completely healed, although his vital energy had been severely drained.
“`
“`
Boom! Suddenly, a sonic boom roared from the distance, immediately causing Howard to startle, roll over, and stand up, bracing the heavy Steel Pillar as he scanned his surroundings.
“`
“`
Once Howard had regained some strength, Jack Clark resumed his own brand of frenzied slaughter.
“`
“`
Today, he was still within a 400 kilometers range of the ruins, venturing only a few dozen kilometers deeper than yesterday.
“`
“`
Within this range, the Polluted Monsters were mainly Level 6, with a minority of Level 7 creatures, which Jack found as easy to kill as whack-a-mole, one halberd strike each.
“`
“`
Venturing deeper into the 500-600 kilometers range, where he might encounter Level 8 Polluted Creatures, just wasn’t worth it.
“`
“`
Today, whenever Jack came across any ruinous structures, he would pause, extend his senses, and pay attention for any items emitting special fluctuations.
“`
“`
Whether it was because of practicing the Illusion Meditation Scripture, or because the Blade of Void Cutting Rune had absorbed more soul energy and become more potent, Jack found his perception even keener today.
“`
“`
This intuitive sensing allowed him to detect Polluted Monsters within a certain range the moment they appeared.
“`
“`
Roar! From the deep fissures in the Earth, a forty-meter-long Scaleless Black Python with a pair of deformed wings and the aura of a Level 7 Early Stage Creature emerged roaring.
“`
“`
But just as the head of this Level 7 Pollution Beast burst through the fissure, a ten-meter-long Golden Halberd Radiance appeared above its head, and upon contact, a dazzling light exploded.
“`
“`
Boom! On the Earth’s surface, a golden firelight with a diameter of several tens of meters exploded, causing half of the cliff to collapse under the Destructive Impact, while the upper body of the Polluted Beast was directly blasted into fragments.
“`
“`
Soon after, amid the spreading smoke and dust of the fissure, the Purple Killing Energy converged into a purple-black snake rushing towards Jack, passing through his palm, and blending with the swirling Killing Intent.
“`
“`
“That guy is on a killing spree again today.”
“`
“`
Witnessing the sonic booms and streaks of light crossing the Earth from afar, Simon the Genius inside the 20-meter-tall Mecha looked on in amazement.
“`
“`
Anyone venturing 300 to 400 kilometers into this area was generally a Top-notch Genius of the Sixth Layer Heaven.
“`
“`
Even so, these individuals were extremely cautious, dodging one perilous creature after another, focusing on exploring relics rather than fighting.
“`
“`
There was no help for it; once here, the monsters were at least sixth level or higher, with many at level seven, and an unlucky encounter with a creature mid-stage of the seventh realm or above could mean death.
“`
“`
With their power, they might be able to take down one or two Level 7 Early Stage Creatures by expending all their trump cards, but what then?
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 642: 292: Embracing Life from the Jaws of Death, Gabriella: Jack Clark Save Me (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Chapter 292: Embracing Life from the Jaws of Death, Gabriella: Jack Clark Save Me (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
Therefore, seeing Jack Clark dash across this landscape at Supersonic Speed, so wild and arrogant without any restraint, even the geniuses couldn’t help but feel envious and admiring.
…
Roar!
Under the dim sky, a Polluted Giant Beast with over eighty meters of wingspan, more than sixty meters long, covered in bone spurs and black scale armor, let out a brutal roar.
From the maw of this beast, reminiscent of a Western Dragon with a lion-like head, streaks of laser-like black Breath continuously burst forth.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast’s Destructive Breath, the Earth below kept exploding, chasing after the Black and White Mecha piloted by Gabriella.
At that moment, the Mecha, over forty meters high with arms outspread like wings, slightly transformed as fiery blasts spewed from engines on either side, maneuvering through Low altitude with various complex moves.
While flying at Supersonic Speed, the Black and White Mecha continuously used the complex terrain of the surroundings to dodge attacks and rushed toward the direction of the Oasis.
Roar!
The speed of the Giant Beast in the sky was astonishing, tirelessly pursuing its prey. A vast gray eye on its belly was locked onto the Black and White Mecha, with terrifying energy converging within.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!! At that moment, more than a dozen Crystalline High-Explosive Missiles shot out at Supersonic Speed from below, engulfing the Polluted Giant Beast at several hundred meters in the air, interrupting its attack.
The explosion of the missiles burst into Firelight in the sky, and amidst the billowing flames, the Polluted Giant Beast emerged unscathed, black mist swirling around it, wings flapping as it continued its pursuit of Gabriella.
Both sides launched attacks while moving at Supersonic Speed; streaks of Breath, Laser Cannon fire, and missiles fired in unison, shaking the sky and blasting the Earth.
The thunderous noise attracted the attention of many Void Creatures, but before they could roar and catch up, the two shadows had already disappeared into the end of the sky.
“We’re close, just hold on for another twenty minutes, and we’ll break out.”
Inside the cockpit of the Black and White Mecha, Gabriella calmly looked at the rapidly depleting energy gauge, the flickering of various data projections on either side, and the flashing red alarms.
She hadn’t expected such caution today would still result in being targeted by a Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast.
Moreover, this was a flying beast, which left many of her tactics unusable, unable to shake it off, her only option was to try and escape back to the Oasis.
Fortunately, the moment she was discovered by the Polluted Giant Beast, she chose to flee; otherwise, things might have been troublesome today.
With her Fortification strength combined with the Mecha, she was barely able to handle Late Level 7 creatures; a Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast was beyond her capabilities.
“Alert, a high-intensity energy strike detected…”
“The attack is bursting too fast, unable to dodge, unable to dodge, driver please prepare for impact.”
“Not good,” Gabriella’s face shifted.
Boom!
Hundreds of gray Light Beams rained from the sky, densely covering the Black and White Mecha and the Earth around it, and a chorus of explosions echoed between Heaven and Earth in an instant.
Engulfed by the Light Beams, the Energy Shield of the Black and White Mecha vibrated wildly, and under the force of the energetic explosions, it smashed to the ground, rolling tumultuously for several hundred meters.
“… What’s up with today? In the morning, it’s a hero saving a tough guy, and in the afternoon, am I expected to save the Mecha as a hero?”
Several kilometers away, Jack stood on a hundred-meter-high hillside, looking at the roaring Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast in the distance and the Mecha engulfed in smoke and dust, somewhat surprised.
However, as Gabriella still had the strength to fight, Jack decided not to intervene.
But just as Jack prepared to enjoy the spectacle a bit longer, Gabriella’s loud shouting came from the smoke and dust: “Jack Clark, I’ve discovered a well-preserved relic.”

chapters.title: Chapter 643: 293: The Eight True Demons, Tyrant Joshua Welan (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: Chapter 293: The Eight True Demons, Tyrant Joshua Welan (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Dark clouds pervaded the sky, casting an ominous shadow over the earth.
Standing on the hillside holding a halberd, Jack Clark’s golden red battle armor shimmered with radiance, surrounded by the phantasmal images of the Blood Sea Hell, his expression cold as he watched the distance.
There, the ground shattered, smoke and dust billowed, and a polluted giant beast with nearly 100 meters wide wingspan roared in the sky, its oppressive might vibrating heaven and earth amid swirling black purple devil gas.
But with a shout, “Jack Clark, I’ve found a perfectly preserved relic,” directed at him, Jack, who had originally planned to watch the excitement, shifted his gaze slightly.
“Dare to harm the genius of the Human Race, seeking death.”
With a long howl from Jack, the hillside crumbled beneath him, and with the force of the counter-shock, he soared into the sky, like a golden light beam that pierced the heavens and the earth.
Roar!
Watching Jack, who darted into the high altitude at a slant, the polluted giant beast let out a savage roar as a black radiance gathered in its mouth, emitting powerful energy fluctuations.
Just like those high-order Void Creatures that retained their battle instincts after being eroded, these high-level polluted monsters still possessed their instinct for combat.
For instance, this particular polluted giant beast knew its advantage lay in flight, thus it consistently employed air-to-ground tactics, using various breaths and energy attacks to remotely suppress its enemies.
Boom!
The polluted giant beast’s mouth, three meters wide, unleashed a roaring black Breath suffused with a destructive aura, stirring up rings of scorching white waves.
Meanwhile, as Jack neared the polluted giant beast, the world behind him changed colors, and endless red blood light exploded, forming the image of a colossal hellish demon that unfurled.
Boom, boom, boom!!
From within the deity image, nine, over thirty-meter-long, Golden War Halberds, sealing a piece of Blood Sea Hell, spiraled out like nine golden missiles engulfing the polluted creature.
Boom!!
A hundred-meter diameter golden spirit face-like light sphere exploded in the high sky, from whence terrifying blasts spread out rings of white waves hundreds of meters wide, mixed with the screams of the polluted giant beast.
And at the instant, the nine halberds overwhelmed the beast, the Breath of Destruction that the polluted giant beast exhale appeared before Jack, shattering his afterimage.
Behind Jack in the distance, with light wings spread, he shattered the ‘air’ condensed by the energy of heaven and earth, using it as leverage for a Burst of speed that shot him into the heart of the firelight.
Roar!
In an instant, an even more pitiful roar resounded through the sky.
The mangled corpse of the polluted giant beast, billowing black smoke, plummeted like a massive airliner from the sky, crashing onto the earth with a thud, kicking up billowing clouds of dust.
Atop the massive beast’s carcass, Jack stood holding his halberd, emanating a terrifying might amidst the surrounding Blood Hell.
The In-Eight Desolate Refining Hell, equivalent to a combination of nine Infernal Purgatories, unleashed an instantaneous Burst of formidable power that heavily injured the beast, which excelled at long-range attacks.
And before the beast could even escape the blast radius, Jack had already appeared atop of it, and with a single strike of his halberd, he collapsed half of its head.
“So powerful.”
Inside the Black and White Mecha, with sparks at several spots, Gabriella looked at the carcass of the polluted giant beast fallen in the distance, her eyes showing astonishment.
The Eighth Level Beast that had forced her into an embarrassed retreat had been simply obliterated by a single strike from Jack, giving the impression that his cultivation had reached the peak of the Eighth Layer Heaven.
Normally, between two beings with early-stage level eight strength, even with some gaps, they would have to battle half a day to determine the victor.
That’s because both parties, whether in terms of endurance or vitality, and recovery abilities, are extremely formidable.
Only those at the peak of the same level, who had touched the power of the next realm, could possess the potential to utterly crush those in the early stage.
Such was the case with the quasi-mythical level giant beast that fought the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah.
Of course, this is assuming that both parties’ strengths are at ‘standard’ levels, not that each one is a battle-strength defying genius.
But however exaggerated the battle strength, Jack’s realm was only at the Early Sevenfold Sky, and his highest battle record had only been the slaying of a Nine-headed Blood Python at the Eighth Layer Early Phase.
This had always been the most puzzling aspect of Jack.
Any opponent weaker than him would usually be finished in one move, and only those of a similar strength could put up a fight for a while.
The reason was that Jack’s attacks are always at their peak as his normal state. He doesn’t rely on fancy tricks; every strike carries his full strength, and those who can’t block it are dead.
Moreover, besides every strike being a peak Burst, his speed, defense, and reflexes had all been pushed to the limit.
With nearly all aspects maximized, his real battle strength was actually stronger than the power unleashed during his peak Burst, leaving opponents weaker than him without even a chance to struggle.
Splat!
As the cockpit hatch below the nape opened and steam hissed out, a blonde girl in a red tight-fitting driving suit jumped out, standing on the shoulders of the Mecha.
Standing nearly six feet tall in her battle boots, her perfect figure accentuated by the tight-fitting Combat Suit and a face no less beautiful than Crystal Lewis’ was revealed.
However, unlike Crystal’s Eastern delicate beauty, Gabriella’s features were of the deeply chiseled, sharp Western type, her complexion fair and smooth.
Such an unparalleled beauty, even Jack paused slightly with admiration in his heart.
Standing on the Mecha several tens of meters high, Gabriella called out, “Jack Clark, wait for me to repair the Mecha, refill the ammunition and energy blocks, and I’ll take you there.”
Jack’s faceplate split open, retracting to form a row of feather horn ornaments behind his neck, and he nodded slightly, “No rush, Gabriella, go ahead with your tasks.”
“OK.”
Gabriella hadn’t engaged the polluted giant beast head-on this time, so the overall damage to the Mecha wasn’t severe, only some exoskeleton armor was damaged.
However, many of the energy emitters, which contained rune-powered force fields within the Black and White Mecha, had overloaded and exploded due to the bombardment of energy beams unleashed by the polluted giant beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 293: The Eight True Demons, Tyrant Joshua Welan (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: Chapter 293: The Eight True Demons, Tyrant Joshua Welan (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
But Gabriella was quick in repairing her Mecha.
She pulled open her right arm’s Combat Suit to reveal an arm full of subspace bracelets, from one of which she released an over ten-meter-tall Eight-clawed Soft Robot.
Then from another subspace bracelet, she released various parts, and under the control of the Mecha Maintenance System, the eight-clawed robot began to quickly dismantle and exchange components.
While the maintenance robot was busy, Gabriella pulled open her left arm’s Combat Suit to reveal another pale arm full of subspace bracelets.
Following that, the blonde girl, like a hardworking little bee, hopped all over the forty-something-meter-tall Mecha, refilling ammunition and changing new energy blocks for the eight engines.
For mech-type Martial Practitioners, their Mecha is an exoskeleton Super Battle Armor, equipped with a Supercomputer and various written Combat and Auxiliary Systems.
Besides, because of the power reactors, as long as the energy is uninterrupted, they burst with greater endurance and more fierce firepower coverage than same level True Martial Practitioners.
Of course, the weakness is that once the energy and ammunition are exhausted, most of their combat strength is lost.
After all, the enemy won’t give you a chance to change energy and ammunition in the middle of a fight.
The drivers like Gabriella are the core power reactors, depending on nerve connections through runes and technological equipment, they can control the Mecha as easily as controlling their own bodies.
Therefore, mech-type has two paths, one like Gabriella’s, focusing on super high Mecha performance, firepower coverage, and energy burst.
The other is similar to Genetic Martial Arts, completely refining the Mecha into a Mechanical Combat Body, integrating as one and pushing the advantages of technology and Mecha to the extreme.
While Gabriella was busy, she suddenly felt the entire Mecha vibrate, and soon after, the forty-something-meter-tall Mecha tilted sharply, rocking.
“Jack, what are you doing!?”
Gabriella, gripping a corner of the Mecha, looked down in surprise.
Beneath her, Jack was holding the Mecha’s ankle with both hands, directly hoisting the enormous Mecha.
“Haha… nothing much, just a bit curious,” said Jack as he waved the giant Mecha a couple more times, whipping up a raging wind before he let go with both hands.
This scene was somewhat similar to the one where Freya donned her God Machine Armament.
The reason, of course, was curiosity; after all, no man could resist such a big ‘toy,’ and he couldn’t help wanting to play with it.
Bang!
The Mecha landed with heavy steps, the ground trembling slightly.
After releasing the Mecha, Jack pulled his legs out from half a meter deep in the ground, and with a light leap, he jumped tens of meters high to land on the broad shoulders of the Mecha.
Looking at the blonde girl in front of him, dressed in a tight Combat Suit, Jack was somewhat puzzled, “Gabriella, why does your Mecha feel so light?”
“Light?”
Gabriella was speechless, “My Black Demon White King Armor is forty-three meters tall and weighs over two thousand six hundred tons; it’s already considered heavyweight among Mechas of the same volume.”
“Besides, even though we Mech Martial Practitioners walk the path of integrating with technology, we’re still cultivators, and strength isn’t just a matter of comparing size and weight.”
“Otherwise, if you built a gigantic Mecha weighing billions of tons and towering ten thousand meters, couldn’t you become invincible in the entire world?”
Then Gabriella looked at Jack in awe, “Speaking of which, you seem more like a monster, being able to lift my Mecha with your bare hands.”
“It’s all right, I’ve always been quite strong,” Jack chuckled.
His current strength attribute had already broken through five thousand points, and since he had never been precisely tested, he didn’t know how many tons his basic arm strength had reached.
But just now when he lifted the Mecha, he felt he still had some strength to spare.
Of course, calculating his current strength was complicated; beyond the base arm strength, there was also a multiple amplification from his Cultivation Methods.
The initial Dragon Elephant Power’s sixfold amplification, the ‘true’ dragon attribute gained from breaking through to the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, and the further improved Divine Tyrant Body and current Combat Divine Body all stacked up.
Therefore, unless tested by professional machinery, not even Jack had a concrete number for his own ‘strength.’
Soon, with Gabriella’s Mecha repair completed and all the items retracted into the subspace, the two set off.
On the Earth, Jack still transformed into a beam of golden light at Supersonic Speed, causing piercing sonic booms as he ran.
At his side, the Black and White Mecha carried a giant battle sword on its back, arms spread out like wings, with intense heat waves jetting from the power engines on both arms, back, and beneath its feet.
In addition, there was the anti-gravity magnetic field in the front that countered the Earth’s gravity, enabling the over two thousand ton Mecha to also achieve supersonic low altitude flight.
However, under normal conditions, Gabriella wouldn’t do this, as it was too loud and consumed a lot of energy.
“That relic is located deep within the ruins, a thousand kilometers in, inside a collapsed mountain peak. My Mecha’s image system detected architectural traces there,” said Gabriella through the wireless earphones, explaining the situation of the relic to Jack.
“On top of that, my Mecha’s energy detection system also detected special rule fluctuations inside.”
“I just didn’t expect that Polluted Giant Beast to have mimetic abilities, lying dormant at the entrance of the relic, and I startled it just by approaching.”
As Gabriella was briefing Jack on the relic, shapes of monsters exuding sixth and seventh level Auras appeared in the distance.
These monsters were attracted by Gabriella’s previous fight with the Polluted Giant Beast, and now they were returning, coincidentally meeting them.
“Leave these polluted monsters to me; you conserve your ammunition and energy,” said Jack.
As he spoke, the ring-shaped sonic boom clouds behind him burst open, and he instantly reached twice the speed of sound, transforming into a golden streak tearing through the air and whipping up a roaring tempest.

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 293: The Eight True Demons, Tyrant Joshua Welan (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Chapter 293: The Eight True Demons, Tyrant Joshua Welan (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
“`
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Before the weaving golden beams of light, over twenty Void Creatures hadn’t even reacted when their bodies burst into fragments under the terrifyingly heavy War Halberd.
The efficiency of the slaughter was so intense that Gabriella watched with a grave expression, “This guy from Eastern Summer is too abnormal. No wonder he can kill one to two thousand Senior contaminated creatures in a day.”
“It’s just that the True Strength he consumes during battle is incredibly low, only about one-thousandth. It seems like he’s relying purely on his physical strength to Burst…”
The Mecha’s piloting projection displayed various detected information from the Mecha systems, analyzing Jack Clark’s movement speed, Power Explosion intensity, and the total amount of True Strength contained within his body, among other things.
Each of these values astonished Gabriella.
As the killing continued, the agglomerated Purple Killing Energy beneath stirred, and the Black Purple Devil Gas swirling around Jack Clark almost formed into a massive cloud of fog, engulfing him.
Not only Gabriella, but Marcellus Larry outside the ruins was also expressing his amazement, “Although I’ve seen this a few times, I still can’t help but marvel at the sight.”
“If he ascends to being a king and is able to maintain such a terrifying dominion over his peers, as long as the Speaker and others hold back the Purgatory Demon Gods, and the Heavenly King deals with those Great Demon Kings…”
“Under such circumstances, it’s not impossible that he alone could slay the dozens of demon kings and high-order members of the Demon Clan on the frontline.”
Lori Joyner shook her head, “It can’t be that simple. The Purgatory Demon Race has existed for tens of thousands of years and possesses countless demon skills and bloodline talents. They might very well have a countermeasure.”
“This is a truly fearsome tribe. We have been at war for over twenty years, and we have only just managed to barely hold back their offensive.”
“Most importantly, this isn’t even the true strength of the Purgatory Demon Race.”
“Denny Kaye and the others ventured deep into the rear of the Purgatory Demon Race and discovered that they are also at war with two other powerful civilizations, which has supposedly lasted many years.”
“Currently, Mysterious Martial and Denny Kaye are making another deep incursion into the mythical world, planning to bypass the territory of The Purgatory Family and make contact with those two civilizations, looking to possibly form an alliance.”
At this point, both of their expressions were very serious.
This was a piece of news that could lead to despair, which is why only the Human Race king-level and above knew about it.
No one had expected that the Purgatory Demon Clan currently fighting against the Human Race were just two branches of the eight True Demon Races, while the other six were at war with those two civilizations.
Engaged in battle with three civilizations at once, one could imagine how fearsome the overall strength of the other side was, and this was the true might of a civilization that had stood for tens of thousands of years.
At that moment, Marcellus Larry slowly said, “I feel there’s no need to worry too much. Although the Purgatory Demon Clan as a whole is strong, the eight True Demons act independently of each other, and even harbor deadly grudges amongst themselves.”
“Just like the ancient countries that waged wars against each other. They venture out to conquer solely because they all originated from the Purgatory World, and would not join forces.”
“Moreover, the two civilizations that have been at war with The Purgatory Family for so many years must be strong.”
“When the time comes, as long as the three of us can unify our front, we may not even talk of counter-attacking, but at the very least, we could secure more development time for each other.”
“Considering the current growth rate of our Human Race, as long as we wait for the newer generations to grow up, and another dozen king-level strong men emerge, the high-end combat power on the Frontline Battlefield will be in our favor.”
“Let’s hope so. After all, it is not only the threat of the Purgatory Demon Clan, but also the impact of the Secondary Mythical World.” Mentioning this, Lori Joyner couldn’t help but reveal a wry smile on her face.
Because the situation for the Human Race was quite difficult at the moment.
“Don’t worry, Old Lori. It’ll definitely be alright,” Marcellus Larry said confidently.
“I’ve calculated a bit. Currently, among our older generation, Tyler Lance and a few others are already on the verge of a breakthrough, ready to step into the King Realm at any moment.”
“Apart from that, out of the geniuses from ten years ago, three have reached the verge of breakthrough. Their rules are complete; they just lack enough Origin for Tempering to make the leap.”
“In the past ten years, there are also quite a few seeds with the potential for King’s Attitude among the younger generation. From that batch of geniuses, already over thirty have broken through to the Ninth Heavens.”
“The youngest is that Joshua Welan from South Sky Martial Arts School. Last week, he made a breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens in the Heavenly Abyss secret realm within the Mythical World. His talent is astonishing.”
“In addition to these unearthed geniuses, there are also several descendants of the King’s Family who have shown talent not inferior to that of their parents, with the hope of a breakthrough.”
“Not to mention the six Innate Awakened Ones we have brought to the Mythical World in recent years, they too have already broken through to the Nine Layers. Perhaps it will also yield two king-level strong men.”
During the casual conversation between the two king-levels, the Eye of Heaven Observation showed Jack Clark sweeping through and slaying a large number of creatures, ultimately reaching the outskirts of the collapsed mountain ranges.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 646: 294: The Earth Magma Core, Black Wind Crystal (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: Chapter 294: The Earth Magma Core, Black Wind Crystal (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
Under the sky of the post-apocalyptic ruins, a mountain range spanning tens of kilometers was severed in the middle, forming a giant crack that was over ten kilometers long and a kilometer wide.
Below the abyss-like fracture, the hot magma churned, radiating intense heat and a dark red glow, rolling up thick black smoke.
The black and red poisonous gas spreading above the crack eroded the True Strength outside Jack Clark’s body, making a sizzling sound.
Whoosh! The black and white Mecha belched out scorching air waves from behind, carrying Jack Clark on its shoulders as they flew towards the opposite side of the fracture.
As soon as the two entered the range of the black fog and poisonous gas from the Void, the corrosion surged, and Jack’s body’s golden flame erupted to counter the Void Energy, creating a booming sound.
Gabriella’s Mecha’s energy shield consumed even more rapidly, with the eight fully loaded energy slots visibly dropping at a speed discernible to the naked eye.
In the middle of the cliff shrouded by the poisonous gas, there was a cave entrance a hundred meters high and several dozen meters wide. An almost category 10+ typhoon howled here, forming a vortex.
Bang! The heavy Mecha shattered the vortex, resisting the raging wind and rushing into the cave for a few hundred meters before stopping.
“According to the radar wave detection and image synthesis, there are two main pathways detected, one going up and one going down. Should we split up or stick together?”
Jack Clark said in a deep voice, “Let’s explore separately, it’s getting dark, and we don’t have much time. Also be careful, we’ve delved deep into the ruins.”
“I know,” the two said as they separated.
Fighting against the 10+ category typhoon, Jack Clark charged upwards towards the pathway a hundred meters high, his heavy battle boots shattering rocks with every step he took.
This truly was a relic, with traces of past buildings everywhere, but these structures were almost entirely weathered and destroyed due to the constant erosion of the strong winds over the years.
Thus, Jack Clark found nothing on his way up and quickly came upon a huge stone platform at the top of the spiral cave.
In the midst of the raging wind, Jack Clark picked up a black iron block from a corner, and with just a slight effort, the once solid steel cracked like brittle stone.
“There’s something wrong with these winds,” Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly as he looked up.
In the center of the cave’s top was a black hole about twenty meters in diameter, pitch black, from which substantial winds roared out, a mighty force to be reckoned with.
In these winds, Jack felt a special power that was somewhat similar to the ‘wind’ controlled by Scythia.
Bang! The stone platform collapsed, and under the strong rebound, Jack turned into a streak of golden light and rushed into the wind tunnel, immediately followed by a terrifying impact.
Boom! Jack’s dazzling golden radiance erupted, clashing hard against the almost substantial black tornado, resulting in explosive booms and blasting out rings of gold and black radiance.
Squeezed and concentrated by the cave, these winds were terrifyingly powerful, almost comparable to an attack from a Sixth Heaven cultivator, and they were relentless and endless.
Even Jack had to unleash all his True Strength in this situation, his radiance erupting and forming a thick half-meter golden red scale armor shield under the amplification of his Dragon Blood Battle Armor.
Amidst the booming explosive impacts, Jack resisted the black raging wind, climbing upwards at an astonishing speed, much like a gecko scaling a wall.
Having rushed upwards nearly a thousand meters, he suddenly came upon a peculiar internal part of the mountain.
It resembled a honeycomb, with black rocks hanging down sturdier than alloy, forming a circular staircase with wind holes one to two meters wide around it.
In the center of these holes, a person-sized spiral crystal slowly rotated, with waves of law emanating from it, drawing the violent winds from between heaven and earth.
“Indeed, it’s a wind-based resource, and it contains the charm of laws,” Jack murmured.
Though he had anticipated that there would be a wind-based resource here, he hadn’t expected it to be a God-level resource not inferior to the Mysterious Yellow Stone. Even Jack was somewhat surprised and delighted by this discovery.
It was just what he needed to complete the last attribute of his ‘world’s’ four elements.
In comparison with the Soul Suppressing Seal he had obtained by slaying the Dark Angel just yesterday, today’s exploration of the ruins was almost effortless, without the slightest hindrance of restrictions.
No, actually, today he also had eliminated an eight-level creature, the Polluted Giant Beast that Gabriella had lured away.
And as Jack stored the wind-based Divine Crystal, Gabriella stood on the edge of a man-made circular Magma Pool deep in the caves.
“Judging from the detected high-energy fluctuations, the item should be in that Magma Pool,” Gabriella said.
With that, she pulled out the huge sword from behind her Mecha, activated the energy, and formed an energy blade about five meters long along the edge, whipping up a wild wind and slashing fiercely at the edge of the Magma Pool.
Boom! With a powerful strike, the thick ten-plus-meter black rock wall at the edge of the Magma Pool shattered, creating a ten-meter-wide, hundred-meter-deep crack.
Immediately, the churning magma inside roared down, gushing out through the cracks, quickly turning the entire cave into a sea of fire and magma, emitting intense heat.
Standing in the sea of fire, Gabriella excitedly looked at the center of the Magma Pool. There, a 1-meter diameter core akin to the core of a planet emitted rings of radiance.
“The Earth Magma Core is still intact,” Gabriella said with a radiant smile.
Just like Damon Lopes’s purposeful search for the residence of the Lord of Thunder, Gabriella braved the dangers to delve thousands of kilometers into the ruins with a goal in mind.
On the Ruins Continent, there once existed a special sect that forged extraordinary weapons and armor. The sect was located at the center of the Longhuan Mountain Range, within Sharp Mountain, where the forging energy originated from an eternally burning Earth Magma Core that possessed endless scorching power.
This type of elemental core was a treasure for Mech Martial Practitioners and could theoretically act as an eternal power furnace. Once incorporated into her Mecha, Gabriella would no longer be lacking in energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 647: 294: Earth Magma Core, Black Wind Crystal (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Chapter 294: Earth Magma Core, Black Wind Crystal (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Since the Federation began developing the mythical world, only four Earth Magma Cores had been found, each used by one of Simon’s top strong men.
Before entering this time, the dean of the academy had given her this location, saying it was highly likely that a Magma Core existed here, but whether she could find it depended on her luck.
After all, countless years had passed, and even if she found the relic, these things might have already been destroyed over time.
However, it seemed her luck was good, as these special Divine Objects had formed a system of their own and ultimately remained without being destroyed.
When Gabriella piloted the Mecha, gripping the blazing Magma Core, and arrived at their meeting spot, Jack Clark had already been waiting for her there.
By then, the howling winds inside the cave had died down, and the murky red fog outside had begun to drift in endlessly, making the space even gloomier.
“With the raging wind gone, it looks like you’ve already got the Black Wind Crystal, Jack Clark.”
Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the red fireball in the hand of the Mecha, thoughtful, “Already got it? Gabriella ‘classmate,’ it seems you know the situation here?”
“I know a bit, but not much…” Gabriella did not hide anything, telling Jack Clark some information she knew, including her purpose for this trip.
Besides the Magma Core, there was also the Black Wind Crystal at the mountain top, also one of the energy sources used by that sect for weapon refining.
Originally, Gabriella’s goal was to make the Magma Core into an eternal power furnace for the Mecha, and the Black Wind Crystal would be integrated into the Mecha to become the Sky Plundering Wings and harness the ferocious winds.
But since Jack Clark had assisted her on this trip and they had explored the ruins together, the harvest was naturally split between them.
Jack Clark nodded, “No wonder.”
He thought that Simon the Genius was not a fool; why else would he insist on delving so far into the dangerous ruins if not because he already had a ‘map’?
“Let’s go, night is falling, and this place will become very dangerous.”
Watching the darkening sky, neither dared to delay. Their Mechas’ engines blasting, they shot out from the cracks and quickly returned to the foot of the mountain along the mountain ranges.
The deeper they went into the ruins, the more violent the Void Energy became, and likewise, the monsters that lurked became stronger.
And these dark Void Creatures, following the instinctual cycle of day and night, became more active and aggressive during the ferocious night.
Roar!
Just as they flew down from the mountain ranges, a roar that shook Heaven and Earth burst forth from afar, scattering the black clouds in the sky to form a huge Hollow.
Even tens of kilometers away, the terrifying might of the Peak of the Eighth Level made both of them grimace, and their Mechas’ engines suddenly expelled even more powerful thrust.
With the wind howling, they flew at supersonic speed at low altitude, and half an hour later, they returned to the place where they had first met.
Jack Clark leaped down from the shoulder of the Mecha and landed on the ground, calling out, “Gabriella, I haven’t finished my task for today, so I’ll take my leave first.”
“Task goal?” Gabriella’s puzzled voice came from inside the Mecha.
Jack Clark nodded, “Yes, to enhance my strength and hone my combat techniques, I’ve set a task goal for myself to slay two thousand Void Creatures every day.”
… Is this a normal person’s goal? Gabriella was momentarily flustered.
However, Jack Clark didn’t care about her reaction. After speaking, he exploded into the air with a bang, continuing his slaughter along the original route.
As Jack Clark, with Gabriella’s watchful eyes on him, swept through and harvested another batch of Void Creatures, he burst from the pitch-black ruins.
It was the same hillside by the Oasis, where the flickering firelight dispelled the surrounding darkness.
Just as Jane Aiken concentrated on slicing slices of Alien Beast Meat, ready to start grilling dinner upon Jack Clark’s return, the ground from afar began to quake.
In the darkness, a colossal Mecha strode forward, kicking up a storm, crushing the Earth beneath its feet, and thunderously approached midway up the hillside.
“It’s Simon’s Gabriella.” Jane Aiken naturally recognized the Mecha and couldn’t help but look up at Jack Clark with surprise, a questioning look in her eyes.
“Earlier, she was being chased by a Level 8 Pollution Beast, and I just happened to pass by and lent a hand. Then I went with her to explore a relic…”
While Jack Clark and Jane Aiken explained the situation, the driving cockpit at the back of the Mecha’s neck opened, and the blonde girl in a red tight-fitting combat suit climbed out.
Jumping down from the Mecha’s shoulder to land on the hillside, Gabriella smiled and said, “Hello, I remember you, you are Jane Aiken from South Sky Martial Arts School.”
Jane Aiken nodded in response, “Hello, Gabriella, senior sister.”
This year, being a sophomore, Gabriella was indeed a senior sister to them both.
After exchanging greetings, Gabriella looked at the slices of Alien Beast Meat on the stone slab, her sapphire-like eyes showing curiosity, “Do you eat this every night?”
Jane Aiken nodded calmly, “Would you like to try some?”
“Sure.” Gabriella didn’t put on airs and, instead, approached Jane Aiken with enthusiasm, getting so close that the girl felt somewhat uncomfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 648: 294: Earth Magma Core, Black Wind Crystal (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Chapter 294: Earth Magma Core, Black Wind Crystal (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
Under the watchful gaze of the blonde girl, Jane Aiken busied herself, skillfully wielding a small shovel in one hand and chopsticks in the other, moving them constantly.
Soon, the rich and spicy aroma of barbecued meat filled the air. The blonde girl’s eyes brightened, “That smells amazing, Junior Aiken, you are so talented. I can’t believe you can do this as well.”
“…It’s nothing much, just simple stone slab barbecue.” Jane Aiken said calmly.
“No, you really are amazing. At least I can’t do it, and it seems like so much fun.” The blonde girl’s eyes sparkled as she spoke, “Junior Aiken, can I give it a try?”
Jane Aiken hesitated for a moment before nodding, “Sure.”
“By the way, I brought some tasty treats with me on this trip, too. Please have some.”
As she spoke, Gabriella rolled up her wrist, revealing the Sumeru Bracelet and took out a small table, stools, and then more than a dozen exquisitely made pastries.
There was also steaming black tea.
These snacks had been put into the Sumeru Bracelet as soon as they were made, so when they were taken out, a sweet fragrance filled the air along with the escaping heat.
…Wait a second, isn’t this place supposed to be the perilous Doomsday Ruins? Are you sure you’re not out here for a picnic?
Amidst the delicately prepared tea snacks on the table and the two beautiful girls eagerly learning how to barbecue on the stone slab, Jack Clark was somewhat dazed.
“Yum! This is delicious; you’re so skilled, Junior Aiken. Right, is it time to brush on the oil now?”
“Yes, we brush on oil to avoid charring, then add sauce to flavor it…”
While the girls were around the fire barbecue, Jack didn’t hesitate to help himself to a piece of barbecue and sat down at the table, at the same time calling up his attribute page.
Talent: Void Double Pupils +5487
Due to a couple of delays, today Jack had barely managed to achieve his goal of slaying two thousand Void Creatures, and the amplification of the Void Double Pupils reached five times.
Around the edge of the black gold vertical pupils deep in Jack’s eyes, five rings made of black runes were spinning, invisibly exerting a terrifying pressure.
At that moment, the sub-eye on his wristwatch flashed, signaling that the group chat channel had opened.
“One hundred thousand, this monster has indeed broken one hundred thousand today.” Eddy Keller stood with his hands behind his back at the edge of the Hundred-meter Stone Peak, feeling somewhat melancholic.
Pierced by the realization that in front of that ‘monster’, he could no longer show off.
Today, Jack’s Purple Killing Energy value had reached 103,460 points, a jump of over forty-five thousand, putting an eighty thousand point gap between him and the second place Eddy Keller, who had just over nineteen thousand points.
Currently, the top ten on the leaderboard all surpassed ten thousand, and the top thirty were over five thousand.
Damn it, hold back; don’t let that guy show off anymore. Damon Lopes sat cross-legged on the ground, his eyelids twitching as he stared at that hundred thousand figure, thinking the guy was too abnormal.
It wasn’t just Damon Lopes; at that moment, many geniuses were holding back their desire to complain, not giving that guy a chance to show off because it was too demoralizing.
“Haha… Those guys seem to have taken quite the hit from Jack.” Sitting atop a giant Dragon Turtle Statue, an unkempt Justin Welan gnawed on dried meat, laughing heartily.
After a moment of silence, the chat channel finally received its first message.
Eastern Summer Hugo Lee: “Thanks, Jack Clark.”
As Howard Lambert was recovering and about to leave, he had noticed several headless creature corpses on the road, followed by the sound of a sonic boom ringing out.
Although Jack hadn’t appeared in person, Howard had guessed it was him responsible; after all, he was the only one bold enough to race through the ruins at supersonic speed without a care in the world.
Eastern Summer Jack Clark: “We’re classmates, no need to be polite.”
With these two starting the conversation, the chat channel quickly became lively again.
Everyone was sharing their experiences in the ruins that day, especially regarding the monsters they encountered. Consolidating information and analyzing intelligence, they seemed very united.
However, these geniuses intentionally or unintentionally avoided mentioning a certain individual in their discussions.
Seeing this, Jack just smiled.
Thanks to Gabriella’s arrival, the evening on the small hill became more lively than usual, especially since the two girls seemed to get on better as they chatted.
“I don’t get it.”
Looking at the two girls across from him, their mouths greasy from eating, Jack shook his head and, after having eaten his fill, moved to one side to sit down and took out a Sky Element Stone.
If he refined another Sky Element Stone tonight, the cohesion degree of the fighting war rune phantom would reach about thirty percent, breaking through to the mid-stage of the Seventh Realm.
At that point, his strength would advance even further.
As for the Mysterious Yellow Stone and the Black Wind Crystal, he didn’t have the time to delve into them now. He’d focus on perfecting the four great light wheels after leaving the relics.

chapters.title: Chapter 649: 295: Invincible Below Myth, Mid-Stage of the Seventh Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Chapter 295: Invincible Below Myth, Mid-Stage of the Seventh Heaven
“`
Night!
Under the glow of firelight, as Jack Clark began his cultivation, energy from hundreds of meters around surged towards him, transforming into a fierce wind that surrounded the area and bent the greenwood low.
From the moment he set foot on the path of cultivation to the present, Jack had spent almost all his time either cultivating or in battle, and it had been a long time since he had ‘slept.’
Although he was much stronger than he had been a few months ago, strong enough to shatter the Earth with a wave of his hand and cut rivers in two,
it still wasn’t enough.
As his strength grew, so did his contact with the Federation’s many secrets, and the sense of urgency within Jack’s heart only intensified.
An intense unease.
The Human Race’s top strong men were all stationed in the mythical world, the military’s main forces were in the mythical world, and large amounts of ammunition, weapons, and various resources produced every year were all sent to the mythical world.
Even most of the research power of various countries was invested in the research of military weapons, creating a gap of decades between military and civilian uses.
Is it that the officials don’t care about the people’s livelihood? No, they simply can’t afford to.
Using a straw to glimpse the big picture, although Jack hadn’t yet entered the mythical world, he vaguely felt that the situation there was very serious, and not as optimistic as one might imagine.
It was only to maintain stability in the rear, to secure weapons, ammunition, and fresh blood for the cultivators, that the society of Blue Star seemed peaceful right now.
There’s no choice, it couldn’t be otherwise, as ordinary people are too vulnerable before Transcendants.
Just one high-level cultivator could slaughter a million, indifferent to most heavy weaponry, and under such circumstances, strategies of overwhelming numbers were utterly useless.
Bringing that pressure ‘back home’ would only lead to global panic and chaos in the rear.
Therefore, Jack needed to make himself grow stronger quickly. Only with absolute strength could he face all crises—this was probably his last period of ‘calm.’
Whether it was his initial encounter with Koroya, or the Alien Beast Battlefield, or later joining the mission to hunt down the King’s Avatar, the level of danger was within the control of the officials.
The high-level threats had all been blocked by the Federal Top Level.
Including this expedition to the relic, any possible interference from the Evil God Sect or the Purgatory Demon Race had been suppressed cleanly in several previous clearings.
After eliminating the disturbances from the Outer World, the geniuses entering the relics only needed to gauge their own strength, with little danger otherwise.
For instance, if one’s strength was insufficient, they should explore the Oasis, or if average, just hang around the fringes of the ruins. The few who died had ventured deeper than their strength allowed.
While Jack’s true body worked hard, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was doing the same.
With raging winds screaming above the sea surface and turbulent waves rolling, the black-red Colossal Beast standing on the reef rock, now grown to 165 meters, looked terrifying.
Sea waves clashing against its tail—over eighty meters long and several stories high when laid out flat, covered in scale armor and sharp spikes—were like waves smashing against the reef, sending up huge sprays of water.
Standing on the reef, the fearsome beast, like a ‘poet’ gazing into the distance, expressed contemplation in its eyes, “It seems it’s time to check out another sea area.”
In three days, it had nearly circled the territory conquered by Dragon Palace, devouring over a hundred Mutated Creatures of Level 6 and above, and more than a dozen of Level 7.
Under these conditions, its body had only grown by ten meters.
Because of several previous collective sweeps, the sea area ruled by Dragon Palace had actually been cleared of most marine life of Level 7 and 8.
As for those resources that had allowed it to grow quickly before, they were only effective until Level 8. Past Level 9, only a vast quantity could suffice.
For example, the Life Green Crystals found in the sea trench after slaying the Crustacean Giant Beasts accumulated over a month were not even enough to fill its teeth gaps, let alone be converted to Evolution value.
Thus it had to venture further out to sea, hunting Level 8 and 9 Giant Beasts to accelerate its growth.
Currently, with its strength unmatched under the mythical level, it did not fear any quasi-mythical beasts.
Even if it encountered those Level 9 Peak Giant Beasts with heaven-defying combat power on par with mythical creatures, under the Agility Talent it could leave whenever it wished.
However, before leaving, there were some matters to which it needed to attend back home.
…
Roar! Wife, you’ve become so beautiful.
In the Water and Fire World, within the sea, a Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, now over ninety meters in length and comparable to a warship in size, was visibly excited, its Double Fins slapping the water and generating waves over ten meters high.
Before the Tiger Whale, a Female Tiger Whale of over sixty meters in length floated calmly, its tranquil large eyes revealing a touch of excitement, for its breakthrough to level eight had brought significant improvement.
With assistance from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the female, which already possessed a trace of king-level bloodline, had fully activated its lineage and awakened Advanced Talent, causing its strength to surge.
Beyond that, its body had also undergone significant changes; its black scales were smooth and shining, while the white scales on its belly floated like clouds, epitomizing elegance and beauty.
The blunt head had become broader, and the dorsal and ventral fins as well as the tail had grown several times larger, endowed with a semblance of the majesty of a kūn.
Clearly, the bloodline awakened by the Female Tiger Whale was still evolving towards a kūn.
This new form of the Female Tiger Whale excited the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, as it felt its wife had become beautiful and pretty post-evolution.
As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish circled around its wife, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle inside the Ice Crystal Palace, stirred by the commotion, stuck out its head and cast a disdainful glance.
Lacking ambition, is a wife really worth all this fuss?
And in its opinion, the evolved Female Tiger Whale didn’t seem that much prettier. It didn’t have a single turtle shell, and its head couldn’t retract, which made it look rather ugly.
In the distance by the shore, the Blue Giant Crab, also awakened, had grown significantly larger, its carapace appearing even more solid and bristling with dense blue sharp spikes.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 650: 295: Invincible under Myths, Middle Phase of Seventh Heaven _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Chapter 295: Invincible under Myths, Middle Phase of Seventh Heaven _2
When its body length reached 63 meters, the Blue Giant Crab’s huge pincers stretched out more than 80 meters, and the enormous pincer was as big as a small house, terrifyingly hideous.
Feeling the powerful strength within its body, the eyes of the Blue Giant Crab were filled with excitement because it was eager to show its strength.
This time, it would be mind-blowing.
Boom!
Far away, the sea surface exploded, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with golden flames erupting from its back soared into the sky like a fighter jet. It flew up to several hundred meters before slamming onto the shore with a loud bang.
Crash!
In an instant, the ground within a 200-meter radius shattered, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon reformed, and the 20-meter-thick ice crystal ground exploded, forming a massive crater.
Ying ying ying!! Thunderflame, you’re back.
Seeing the still-invisible and terrifyingly oppressive Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, all the giant beasts were instantly invigorated, feeling as if they saw their backbone.
With the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon leading them to continuously sweep through the Beast Empire, defeating fierce giant beasts one after another, it had accumulated an indescribable prestige in the hearts of the Single-horned Tiger Whale and other giant beasts.
It felt like as long as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was there, they wouldn’t blink an eye even if they were asked to take on a Mythical Giant Beast.
Standing on the broken shore, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the Female Tiger Whale and the Blue Giant Crab, sensing their strong aura, and nodded in satisfaction.
“Roar! Lady Haward, what’s your new talent and domain?”
The Female Tiger Whale respectfully bowed her head and whined: My king, my new talent is the formation of Internal Swallowing Subspace within my body, allowing me to devour my enemies and slowly digest them.
At the same time, black power spread noiselessly from the Female Tiger Whale, covering the surrounding 200 meters and forming a dark area.
At the edge of the darkness, a huge mouth opened and silently bit a 50-meter hole in the sea surface, causing everything in that range to disappear.
Hiss!
Instantly, the Blue Giant Crab, Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Kidora the Nine-headed Dragon, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish all took a cold breath, unconsciously shrinking back.
Too… terrifying.
Unlike the awe-inspiring and earth-shattering power they displayed after their domain expanded, the Female Tiger Whale’s domain could erase her power and aura, the movement of sea water, and conceal her figure.
Combined with that enormous mouth that could devour everything in an instant, many Mutated Creatures might not even know how they lost their rear half by the time she’s done. It’s way too frightening.
While other giant beasts felt chills down their spines, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
Indeed, this Female Tiger Whale hadn’t disappointed him and had truly awakened her devouring talent.
The talent abilities of Mutated Creatures actually have a trace to follow. When it first showcased its devouring and crushing intermediate talents, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had some expectations for it.
Of course, talent abilities were not absolutely powerful; their strength still depended on the individual beast.
Just like cultivators, the same cultivation methods and talents can produce different power levels in different individuals.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned its head to look at the Blue Giant Crab, which had grown eight legs, and roared: Crab General, you’ve reached level eight and awakened new talents. What are they?
Seeing that it’s finally its turn, the Blue Giant Crab excitedly waved its giant pincers.
Gurgle! My king, I’ve become incredibly powerful this time, super awesome, mind-blowingly powerful.
As it spoke, the Blue Giant Crab’s giant pincers, nearly 20 meters long and more than 10 meters wide, opened up. Blue and white light flowed on them, and they abruptly slammed together at a terrifying speed.
Boom!
Under the terrifying tearing force, two dark cracks tens of meters long appeared and slowly healed under the self-repairing power of space before disappearing.
Ying ying ying!! How is this possible? Crab General, you even managed to tear up space.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish stared wide-eyed, unbelieving, because under this attack, the defense of an ordinary eighth-level giant beast simply couldn’t withstand it.
Gurgle! I’m incredibly powerful now.
Feeling proud, the Blue Giant Crab’s blue and white light burst out, forming a blue domain covering a two hundred meter radius, centered around it and creating a vortex with the swirling sea water.Compared to its double pincers that could tear apart even the outer space, the heavy water vortex domain obtained at Level 8 is just ordinary. Coupled with other common talents, its strength is not bad.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
The talents of both the giant beasts that evolved this time are pretty good, making their strength among the strongest in their respective levels.
Together with the two late-stage Level 8 Tiger Fish Dragon Turtles, the Level 9 Kidora, and the soon to be Level 9 Silver Giant Dragon, they now possess sufficient power to dominate a domain.
As long as the upcoming plan goes smoothly, once it possesses the combat power of a Mythical Giant Beast, it can switch to the warfare development mode.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned its head to the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the others, growling: “Joe, Domination, how many runes have you two accumulated?”
Roar! One hundred and twenty-three.
Facing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s homework inspection, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle carefully roared, hoping that its more than one hundred and twenty runes would be enough to avoid being punished.
Meow meow meow! I have more than Domination! I’ve already accumulated 161 runes!
As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish spoke, it lifted its fins, revealing its huge fins on either side, more than 50 meters long, with most of its scales turning golden.
With over a hundred stacked Slash Runes, the invisible sharpness turned the wings-like fins into two giant ship-slicing blades, emanating a sharp aura.
But just when the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was feeling smug, nine ferocious dragon heads emerged from the Ice Crystal Palace, bellowing in confusion: “Roar, roar, roar! Kidora, two hundred and fifty-nine.”
Meow meow meow! Impossible, how do you have so many, Kidora?
Roar! Right, we all cultivated at the same time, so how did you manage to accumulate so many?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish both stared unbelievingly.
“Roar roar roar! Because, Kidora, I’m awesome. With more heads, I’m better at concentrating.”
While the Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook its nine proud dragon heads, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction: “Roar! Not bad, you’ve all reached the standard line, especially Kidora, who has made significant progress.”
“Next, Kidora, you continue to work hard. First, you need to accumulate a thousand Solid Runes all over your body. The overlapping effect will be enough to increase your defense by one level.”
“Horned Kitty, you go find Tiger One and the others, and have them each lead a group of more than ten Tiger Whales to hunt in the ocean while continuing to gather more Unique Beasts.”
“Kill all the Mutated Creatures above Level 2 that have reached the peak of their levels. I need enough Life Crystals to continue boosting my strength.”
With his subordinates making progress, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was ready to begin reaping the benefits.
Meow meow meow! Understood, my king.
“Roar! Joe, Domination, you two go harvest the resources from our territory, striving to reach the late stage of Level 8 as soon as possible.”
After arranging the upcoming tasks, the Thunderflame Emperor Beast let out a deep growl: “This time, I plan to go further away to hunt Level 9 Giant Beasts to enhance my strength.”
“By the time I return, I will lead the Dragon Palace army to destroy the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire and kill the Mythical Giant Beast known as the Black Oblivion King.”
Hearing about killing the Mythical Giant Beast, the group of Mutated Beasts was not only unafraid but also excited and thrilled.
Meow meow meow! Kill those guys, plunder everything!
Roar! The Mythical Giant Beast must have a lot of good stuff, take it all!
Roar roar roar! Kidora, when the time comes, you’ll have to face all nine of them.
Amid the excited roars of the Mutated Beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon blinked and burst out of the Water and Fire World.
Thousands of meters deep in the sea, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s limbs were tucked beside its body, while black feather horns on its back, resembling wings, spewed golden firelight.
With the propulsion of more than twenty flame engines on its back, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s speed increased rapidly, creating powerful shockwaves that formed white waves stretching a thousand meters behind it.
Because of the four world passageways and the blockages of the four Mythical Giant Beast forces, this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s target was on the other side of Blue Star.
When it returns more than ten days later after growing over two hundred meters in size, the Tiger Whale Army should have collected tens of thousands of Attribute points.
By that time, as long as it can increase Gigantification to the top-tier, even without the power of top-tier talents, its combat strength should be comparable to that of ordinary Mythical Giant Beasts.
Then, declare war on a Mythical Giant Beast power; under the warfare development mode, its growth would be even faster…

chapters.title: Chapter 651: 296: Battle Emperor Dragon, Thunder Guardian
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Chapter 296: Battle Emperor Dragon, Thunder Guardian
Morning.
As the Sky Element Stone in Jack Clark’s hand turned to powder, his cultivation smoothly broke through to the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, his aura instantly surging dramatically.
Under the suddenly escalating formidable pressure, the surrounding air exploded, forming a ring-shaped white wave that set off a raging wind that shot out more than ten meters away.
The noise from the breakthrough startled Jane Aiken, who had been seated with legs crossed in the distance. She opened her eyes, which were swirling with Sword Intent, and looked towards Jack Clark with a touch of surprise in her gaze.
“Seventh Layer, mid-period!”
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which contained a faintly ferocious Dragon Might and an oppressing look. He gave a slight nod upon hearing her, “Mhm, I’ve broken through.”
“So strong!” Jane Aiken exclaimed in admiration.
She had asked Jack before and knew that he broke through to the Seventh Layer on June 1st. That is to say, in less than half a month, he had already advanced to the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Even in the higher echelons, such a horrifying pace of improvement exerted a lot of pressure, even on Jane Aiken.
Because she could enter the epiphany state at any time, her cultivation speed was ten to twenty times faster than that of other cultivators, and when faced with bottlenecks, she could also use Sword Intent to break through.
But even she wasn’t confident about advancing a minor realm every half month after reaching the Seventh Heaven.
At this time, Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the transparent page in front of him.
Cultivation Method: Combat Divine Body: Halberd [Seventh Layer, Combat Shadow 30%: When externally manifested, it gathers Heavenly Energy and releases True Dragon Power with a fourteen-fold amplification.
Grants even more powerful Thunder and is augmented by the element of Golden Flame.
Receives a sevenfold increase in strength, sevenfold defense, and triples the enhancement of speed.]
With the Combat Shadow materializing to thirty percent and following the breakthrough to the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, the Talent Rune gave Jack Clark an even greater boost in all aspects.
At his current level of strength, any increase was astonishing, let alone a doubling of his power.
At this time, the door of the distant Mecha pod opened, and Gabriella, clad in a white silk nightgown, crawled out, yawned, and said lazily, “Good morning, you two.”>
Noticing the nightgown she was wearing, even Jack Clark’s eyes revealed surprise… To think she was wearing a nightgown to sleep in this place, was she that particular?
And then, considering the delicate pastries she took out from the Sumeru Bracelet yesterday, Jack Clark couldn’t shake the feeling that she wasn’t exploring ruins, but rather that a noble girl was out on a picnic.
Fortunately, nothing strange happened next.
After the three of them quickly finished the pastry breakfast Gabriella prepared, the girl entered the Mecha and changed into a set of blue maintenance worker clothes.
“I’m not going into the ruins today. I plan to upgrade the Mecha and make a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
The girl with her high ponytail blinked her eyes curiously, “Upgrade the Mecha, how do you upgrade it?”
Gabriella adjusted the blue hat on her head and explained, “Actually, our breakthrough process as martial machine cultivators is not much different from yours; the core is the same.”
“The only difference is that our true martial arts phantom is engraved on the Mecha in a matrix pattern, which can normally be disassembled into panels for recombination.”
“And with each realm breakthrough, it’s a chance to add new weapons and templates, an occasion for upgrading.”
“However, everyone has different carrying capacities, the Cultivation Methods and Mechas are different too, so there is a limit to the weapons and talent functions that can ultimately be loaded.”
With Gabriella’s introduction, Jane Aiken gained some understanding of the martial machine cultivator’s high-order breakthrough process.
Jane Aiken looked towards Jack Clark, “My Purple Kill Value has long been sufficient, so today I plan to roam around within a 300-kilometer range to see if I can find anything else of value.”
“If there’s still nothing, I’ll prepare for closed-door cultivation until the Road to Becoming a God appears.”
Jack Clark slowly said, “I plan to slay some more polluted monsters to hone my Combat Techniques.”
However, neither Jane Aiken nor Gabriella entirely believed his words. Hone Combat Techniques by slaying a thousand or two thousand senior or high-order monsters in one day?
After the two left, Gabriella released octopus robots, a couple of engineering robots, and many colossal weapon parts from the subspace bracelets on her right arm.
A martial machine cultivator’s breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven is a sublimation, and during the Heaven and Earth Resonance, the incomplete Talent Runes in the material melted from the Giant Beast’s skeleton will be activated.
These Talent Abilities had been determined when melded into the Mecha, forming a part of a massive matrix puzzle. While breaking through to the Seventh Layer, they would integrate into one whole.
Gabriella had completed the design of the true martial matrix before entering the relic, including the Mecha and weapon modules which were pushed to the limit; only the Magma Core was needed for the breakthrough of the eternal power furnace.
Not just Gabriella and Jack Clark, but as the fifth day in the relic rolled on, many others also gained a lot.
For instance, Justin Welan finally dug out the huge Dragon Turtle Statue, which carried the broken stele on its back and measured over two hundred meters in length, over a hundred meters in width, and over a hundred meters in height, from the ground.
But standing on the edge of the big pit, Justin, covered in filth, looked at the massive statue somewhat bewilderingly.
Because it seemed that he… didn’t discover anything noteworthy.
Leaning on a shovel in his left hand, Justin scratched the back of his head, “Can it be? Grandpa Walton’s luck can’t be this bad, can it? Dig such a huge hole and find nothing at all?”
…
Under the dim sky, Jack Clark soared at supersonic speed straight into the 400-kilometer depths of the ruins before coming to a stop, his gaze turning towards the distance.
On a hundred-meter-high hillside, a humanoid monster, five meters tall, clad in armor and wielding a battle sword, sat cross-legged, surrounded by dense purple-black fog.
This Level 7 Peak Void Creature, upon seeing Jack Clark, did not roar and charge at him as other creatures did, but simply watched him quietly.

chapters.title: Chapter 652: 296: Battle Emperor Dragon, Thunder Guardian_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Chapter 296: Battle Emperor Dragon, Thunder Guardian_2
In those dark red eyes, there was a mix of brutality and a cold sharpness, like a swordsman who had reached the pinnacle of martial arts cultivation, composed and powerful.
But monsters will always be monsters, and as its disdain for living creatures fueled its brutality, the monster began to emit the aura of a Level 7 Peak beast.
The sharp and oppressive aura made Jack Clark’s eyes focus.
This monster was incredibly strong; it definitely possessed the combat power of an early stage Level 8 warrior, even under the classification of Level 7 Peak, and Jack knew he would need to be serious in facing it.
Roar!
