With a roar, the monster bolted up, and a terrifying Sword Intent surged up from its body, the rusty battle sword in its hand vibrating with a buzzing resonance.
Suddenly, black gold vertical pupils appeared in Jack’s eyes, with five rings of black runes forming a chain of light that slowly rotated at the edges, emitting a Terrifying Aura that struck fear into all living beings.
Centered on that Void creature, the space within a 15-meter radius around it cracked like a mirror with a snap and then shattered with a boom, including the Void creature itself.
After being amplified five times, the might of the Void Double Pupils was even more fearsome. Even a mere ten percent burst of Void Energy was enough to instantly kill this powerful monster.
By now, it was almost true that Jack could merely look at someone, and they would explode.
However, just as Jack had darted more than a hundred kilometers horizontally today, he stopped once again; a figure surrounded by thunder was waiting for him on a mountain in the distance.
“Brother Callum, I knew I’d see you if I stood on the mountain.”
In a flash, Jack’s figure appeared before Damon Lopes, looking at him curiously, “…Mr. Lopes, do you need something from me?”
“I found the residence of the Thunder Lord,” Damon said with a hint of excitement in his voice.
“The Thunder Lord,” Jack raised an eyebrow.
“The Thunder Lord was one of the top strong men of the Ancient Civilization. I’ve been searching for a few days and have finally discovered the entrance to his mansion here.”
Jack looked puzzled: “Then what?”
“I can’t defeat the puppet war general guarding the gate,” Damon confessed earnestly.
I should have known this guy wouldn’t be suddenly so noble, waiting here for him after finding something valuable, only to get stuck because he couldn’t get past the guardian.
Jack asked, “What is the strength of that puppet?”
“Late Eighth Layer,” Damon responded.
“What, late Eighth Layer? Are you sure I can handle it?” Jack was incredulous.
After Jack’s breakthrough to the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, he estimated that his combat power had just barely entered the mid-eighth level without using the Void Double Pupils or the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form.
With that power, he could possibly hold his own against some mid-eighth level monsters, but if he wanted to slay them, he would still need to play his trump card.
As one approached the later stages of higher orders, the gap between each small realm grew significantly, and Jack felt that even in his Emperor Dragon Form, he could at most contend with the late stages of the Eighth Layer.
Not to mention defeating that puppet.
Damon said with confidence, “Brother Callum, I believe in your strength. You can do it. Let’s give it a try, and if it doesn’t work out, we’ll leave it be.”
Jack was speechless, “I’m just afraid that giving it a ‘try’ might end up meaning death.” After hearing that the gate guardian puppet was at the late Eighth Layer stage, he didn’t want to risk it.
That was the late Eighth Layer, not the late Seventh Layer. A moment’s inattention could mean complete obliteration.
Still, Damon persisted, “Brother Callum, the battle puppet isn’t like those monsters. As long as we step out of its defense range, it will stop pursuing.”
“The mansion of the Thunder House is very well preserved, and I’m certain there are Thunderbolt Law Fragments inside, and maybe even the inheritance of the Thunder Lord himself.”
“One of the thirty-six Monarchs, an inheritance from a being comparable to a Heavenly King or even stronger—aren’t you tempted, Brother Callum?”
Upon hearing that there were Thunderbolt Law Fragments that could resonate with his true martial arts phantom, and there might also be an inheritance from the Thunder Lord, Jack immediately looked serious.
“Let’s do it.”
Whoosh whoosh!!
In the barren and silent mountain range, Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One of Thunder, maintained a speed beyond Supersonic Speed, accompanying Jack Clark in their side-by-side sprint across the mountain peaks.
As an Innate Awakened One with control over thunder, Damon’s speed was also swift, and after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, his regular movement speed had reached supersonic levels.
And once he unleashed his Limit Breakthrough in the Thunder Movement, his speed would become even more terrifying.
Under Damon’s guidance, the two crossed over a hundred kilometers in just over ten minutes, traversing mountains to reach the peak of a mountain in the heart of the range.
Atop the mountain peak, aside from the cracked rocks, there was only a ten-meter-tall stele wrapped in thunder patterns, vaguely inscribed with the ancient characters ‘Thunder House.’
“The mansion is located in a stable small world, which is why it’s been preserved so intact. However, it requires the power of the Innate Thunderbolt to open it,” Damon explained as he placed his hand on the stele, with bursts of purple lightning dancing about.
As the stele absorbed the Thunderbolt Power, its surface glowed with thunder patterns. At the top, a silver-blue bolt of lightning exploded, striking a side of the Void.
Instantly, a crack formed in the Void, slowly widening into a ‘door’ three meters tall and two meters wide, appearing before them.
On the other side of the door was a spacious square with a diameter of hundreds of meters, at the far end stood an imposing complex of buildings, where the sky within glimmered with lightning and roared without pause.
Following Damon, the two stepped into the gateway of the small world.
“Brother Callum, that platform is the battle puppet’s line of alertness. Stepping on it will invoke an attack from the battle puppet, but if we step out of the platform’s range, it will cease,” Damon stated, still eager to venture inside the Thunder House but warning, “That battle puppet is very fast. If it’s too much for us, we’ll just give up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 653: 296 Battle Emperor Dragon, Thunder Guardian_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Chapter 296 Battle Emperor Dragon, Thunder Guardian_3
“I know.”
Jack Clark nodded and looked towards the six-meter-tall figure in the distance, the battle puppet entirely covered in blue-purple armor, wielding an exaggerated battle axe.
Because it hadn’t been activated yet, it looked just like a statue standing rigid in front of the gate, deathly still, silent.
Stepping in his heavy battle boots, Jack held the War Halberd and walked slowly towards the square, a terrifying strength revived within him, transforming into a dazzling golden flame that burst forth.
Boom!
A thirty-meter tall figure emerged behind Jack, and instantly the dense Heavenly Energy within a range of hundreds of meters surged tumultuously towards him, converging into a white mist that enveloped him.
At this moment, the true martial arts phantom seemed tangible, like a giant in black-red scaled armor with three faces and six arms, behind which four rings with a diameter of several meters rotated slowly.
That face, identical to Jack’s, was cold in expression. A mark that was like a knife or an eye at the center of the brow exuded a sacred and commanding presence.
“Holy shit, mid-stage of the seventh realm!” Damon Lopes’ face showed astonishment.
Hum!
The moment Jack stepped onto the stairs of the square, radiance sparked in the distant battle puppet’s eyes, and in an instant, endless lightning erupted from its center, followed by a world-shaking aura.
Boom!
The dazzling lightning filled heaven and earth, winding like dragons, and in an instant appeared before Jack, the battle axe in its hands wrapped in silver-blue lightning, slashing down with indescribable speed.
The terrifying strike tore a black crack in the space beneath the axe blade, emitting an alarming aura of destruction.
This all happened too fast, so fast that even Damon Lopes felt his vision blur for a moment, and then he saw Jack erupting with thunder and flames, the War Halberd sweeping across the sky.
Boom!
The ground within a hundred meters shattered, the solid rock exploding like sea water, the wild destructive force triggering a Destructive Impact, annihilating everything.
Damon Lopes’ brain trembled with fear from afar, his body releasing bursts of thunder to block the horrific impact and the accompanying flying debris.
Thump!
The ground beside Damon Lopes exploded, forming a crater over ten meters in diameter, at the bottom of which, surprisingly, stood the figure of Jack holding a halberd.
After having blasted Jack out of the range of the steps, the puppet flashed with electricity and returned to its original place.
Jack, still trembling in his arms, showed a look of admiration: “So strong.”
That movement speed exceeding six times supersonic, and the instant burst of destruction, even he nearly got injured by the strike – it was too strong.
Suddenly, Jack’s blood boiled, his eyes filled with intense Battle Intent, and a blood-colored rune emerged on his forehead, radiating endless Radiance.
Boom!
To kill, to slaughter everything, the insane Battle Intent erupted with Jack as the center, turning a range of fifty meters into a Blood Sea Hell.
But that wasn’t enough.
Jack’s body was enveloped in dazzling golden flames, his figure suddenly swelling in size — no, it was his Dragon Blood Battle Armor that was rapidly expanding.
At the same time, those distorted runes on the surface of the Dragon Blood Battle Armor emitted a blood light, continuously expanding and overlapping with the Combat Shadow.
In the instant that the battle armor overlapped with the true martial arts phantom, an indescribable and terrifying aura burst forth.
Boom!
Under the outpouring of endless golden red flames, a giant figure standing eighty meters tall, clad in Golden Red Battle Armor, appeared amidst the flames. Surrounded by thick tendrils of lightning and burning with golden flames of thousands of degrees Celsius, it wielded the Shadow of the War Halberd, like a True God descending to earth.
At this time, just standing there, the Battle Emperor Dragon’s invisible, terrifying presence shook the small world, and the thunder in the sky roared and exploded continuously.
Damon Lopes’ eyes widened.
“Holy shit!”

chapters.title: Chapter 654: 297: Inheritance of Thunder Prison, The Great Sun Falls
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Chapter 297: Inheritance of Thunder Prison, The Great Sun Falls
Just as Jack Clark transformed into the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form, Damon Lopes felt a sudden heaviness, and the ground beneath his feet began to crackle and split.
“Damn! How is this possible?”
Staring at the three-faced six-armed ‘giant’ towering at eighty meters, enveloped in terrifying flames and lightning, Damon’s eyes nearly popped out.
He knew that Jack’s strength would be stronger than before once he had made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, but this was too much, wasn’t it? Was this the kind of strength one from Seventh Layer Heaven could possess?
At this moment, Damon felt a mix of excitement and annoyance.
The excitement came from the hope that today he might have a great chance to enter the Lord of Thunder Mansion. The irritation stemmed from the realization that there were so many monsters in this generation.
It made him, an Innate Awakened One, feel as though he had no presence at all, even though he was known as a once-in-a-millennium genius of the T0 version.
So, chatting with beauties and such obviously hindered his path, even when he had been ahead of Jack Clark by a small realm.
Thinking this, Damon contemplated whether he should delete all his Beautiful Female Friends from his mobile phone to focus more on cultivation in the future?
While Damon was struggling with whether to firm up his resolve, Jack Clark, safely experiencing the Fighting War Emperor Dragon State for the first time, was getting accustomed to his skyrocketing strength.
Strength and Defense increased thirtyfold, with an additional Heavenly Energy boost that tenfold enhanced his already terrifying power beyond description.
Huff, puff!
The temperature in a hundreds of meters range around him instantly soared to over a hundred Celsius as golden flames, exceeding ten thousand degrees Celsius, erupted and scorched the air.
If this were a mountain forest area, such high temperatures would quickly wither the vegetation, turning hundreds of meters into a sea of fire.
In this form, Jack had gained an aura of being a walking natural disaster.
After getting a bit of familiarity with his new gigantic form, with a thought, Jack guided the eighty-meter-tall Fighting War Emperor Dragon to move explosively and step into the shattered stairway area.
Boom!
The ground cracked in a tens of meters range under his heavy footsteps, and the rocks, hard as iron, turned dark red and began to melt under the heat of the intense flames.
Whoom!
The eyes of the Thunder Battle Puppet shone again as it unleashed a terrible explosion of Thunder energy, spreading endlessly and forming a thunder domain enveloping more than a hundred meters.
As a puppet, it was not a human cultivator. Driven by its energy core and at the Eight Layer Heaven, it could also project a domain.
Only before, since Jack had not shown enough strength, this battle puppet didn’t switch to its strongest mode, with the sky-filling silver-blue lightning appearing above Jack’s head.
Boom!
A battle axe, ten meters long and as large as a small room, wrapped in lightning, turned into a massive axe of several tens of meters, tearing a pitch-black crack dozens of meters long in space.
A giant War Halberd, more than a hundred meters long, surged into the sky, wrapped in lightning and Golden Flame. Terrifying strength filled the Space Cracks, and, like lightning, it struck the Thunder Battle Axe.
Boom! The ‘world’ shook as the dazzling rays of lightning and fire burst forth, creating shockwaves that compressed the air and formed a ring of dark red halos, spreading out for hundreds of meters.
Followed by the mountain-heavy War Halberd, the unstoppable strength Instantaneously Exploded and struck the Thunder Battle Puppet with a Destructive Impact.
Boom!
The battle puppet that had previously sent Jack flying was now blown away, turned into a bolt of lightning that smashed into the invisible barrier in front of the mansion, causing transparent ripples.
Under the thirtyfold Overbearing Strength of the Fighting War Emperor Dragon, even the strength of this puppet could not resist.
Bang! In the distance, lightning abruptly condensed around the battle puppet.
Roar, roar, roar! Nine Thunder Dragons, each a hundred meters long and completely made from silver-blue lightning, roared in the air, weaving toward Jack Clark.
As the nine Thunder Dragons lunged at Jack, the battle puppet, wielding a Battle Axe, turned into a bolt of lightning and, in an instant, burst forth at six times the Supersonic Speed, appearing by his side.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s War Halberd swept across, unraveling a curtain of endless lightning and flames, creating a circular barrier three hundred meters high and one hundred and fifty meters in diameter, centered around him.
Sweeping the Eight Wastes
Boom, boom, boom!!!
The expanding barrier of interwoven Thunderflame and the nine Thunder Dragons collided instantly, setting off an explosion that was as destructive as nine intercontinental missiles detonating in brilliance.
The horrific explosion unleashed a Destructive Impact like a Tsunami of lightning and flames, sweeping all directions, causing Damon’s face to drastically change.
“I’m just here to watch!”
Yelling, Damon’s body flashed with lightning as he produced a long and narrow battle sword, with lightning coiling around it, and with a slash toward the oncoming wave, cut through the impact.
Crackle! A sharp ray of thunderous light, about thirty meters long, split through the oncoming impact, which rushed past Damon and slammed into the Boundary Wall.
Boom, boom, boom!! The small world shook wildly under the impact, giving the sensation that it might explode at any moment, the noise astonishing.
Thump, thump, thump!!
In the distance, the Thunder Battle Puppet completely turned into an electric light tens of meters long, encircling Jack at nearly nine times the speed of Supersonic Speed, nearly three thousand meters per second.
With that horrific speed, even the mere Kinetic Energy created black Cracks in front of the Battle Axe, raining down heaven-splitting blows toward Jack Clark.
Such is the terror of the Thunder attribute, granting cultivators ultimate speed and Instantaneous destructive bursts, allowing them to dominate their peers with formidable combat prowess.
Facing such rapid attacks, Jack Clark, even slowed down in his Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form, stood unflinching as he swung his War Halberd at multiple the speed of sound, parrying attacks from all directions.
With each swing of the giant War Halberd, the terrifying strength stirred space itself, creating a tidal wave of destruction that obliterated everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 655: 297: Inheritance of Thunder Prison, The Fall of the Great Sun_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Chapter 297: Inheritance of Thunder Prison, The Fall of the Great Sun_2
Meanwhile, Jack Clark controlled the golden flames with the two arms behind him, constantly compressing, forming ten golden suns around the four rings of light that surrounded his head.
The intense heat of the compressed Golden Flame energy emitted a terrifyingly destructive aura that even made Damon Lopes’s heart pound.
The other two arms of Jack Clark controlled the blue-black Thunder, intertwining a net of lightning with the Thunder Battle Puppet’s domain.
This was the complete form of the Combat Divine Body.
With both arms wielding the halberd to sweep all directions, and the four arms commanding fire and thunder to destroy everything, he resembled a deity stepped straight out of myths, suppressing the Thunder Devils of the lower worlds.
However, facing the Thunder Battle Puppet, which was nearly converting into lightning, Jack Clark in his Battle Emperor Dragon Form struggled to keep up with the speed and was occasionally struck by a space-tearing Battle Axe.
But these attacks couldn’t breach his defenses.
With the thirty-fold defense gained from burning Heavenly Energy to activate the core Defense Talent Rune, Jack Clark’s body formed a layer of one-meter thick transparent black scale armor.
Each time the space-tearing attacks of the Thunder Battle Puppet collided with the black scales, they would burst with a terrifying impact, leaving behind wounds over ten meters long and 0.5 meters deep.
Then, the scale armor, formed by the Gifted Power, would heal in the blink of an eye, unshakeable.
Under the clash of the two, a square with hundreds of meters in diameter quickly shattered into ruins, including more than a hundred meters of the area leading to the square.
Rocks and dirt melted into magma beneath the Golden Flame, then were thrown into the air by repeated impacts, forming a rain of magma-fire that covered a thousand meters.
Above and below, streaks of blue-black and silver-blue lightning flashed, each strike creating craters several to tens of meters wide upon the ground.
This was the power of the late stage of Eight Layer Heaven, stirring Heaven and Earth with every move, swiftly destroying everything.
Yet in the distance, the mansion buildings were surrounded by an Invisible Power, blocking the shockwaves of the battle.
All of a sudden, Jack Clark let out a long howl, “Got you.”
Boom! With the War Halberd in his hands, he clove the air as if splitting Mount Hua at a speed several times supersonic, appearing above the battle puppet with a might capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
Beneath, the battle puppet was bound by four substantial chains of Thunder, its rapidly moving form suddenly paused, and then an endless lightning around it began to contract.
Boom!
As the Thunderstorm Domain was absorbed into its body, the battle puppet nearly transformed into pure, dazzling Thunder, emitting endless Radiance that illuminated the world and shattered the chains on its body.
However, because of the entanglement of the Thunder chains, it couldn’t evade this strike in time.
Boom!
Under the full strength of Jack Clark’s halberd, Heaven and Earth seemed to reverse as the ground plummeted like a sea surface and then shattered, with countless chunks of dirt and rocks soaring into the sky.
But it didn’t end there. The moment the halberd struck, the ten Great Suns hanging behind Jack Clark’s head showered down scorching Radiance like a barrage of meteors.
Boom, boom, boom, boom! A nuclear explosion with a two-hundred-meter diameter rose from the Earth, unleashing endless golden light, annihilating everything.
Under the blazing onslaught, the Earth quickly melted into magma, which then, under the impacts, formed a magma tsunami that cleaved through the air, heralding the arrival of a world-ending Doomsday.
Faced with such terrifying might, Damon Lopes’s eyes bulged as he exclaimed, “Damn!” After which, in shock and fear, he urgently unleashed his power to block the Destructive Impact.
Boom, boom, boom!
Beneath the storm of scorching destructive impacts, Damon Lopes’s shield, fused with the power of Thunder True Strength, shook violently, giving the sensation of a lone boat in an angry sea.
The terrifying scorching onslaught lasted for about a minute before gradually subsiding.
By then, the entire small world had been transformed.
The land, including the square in front of the mansion and spreading over a mile in diameter, was gone, now a pit a hundred and fifty meters wide and dozens of meters deep.
The bottom of the pit was a vitreous body formed from crystallized material, surrounded by still-hot magma.
From the center of the pit radiated outward, the topsoil had been stripped away layer by layer, with all the dirt and rocks turned into black magma mass under high temperatures, still emitting heat.
At the edge of the pit, the eighty-meter-tall Battle Emperor Dragon stood with halberd in hand, like an ancient War God exuding a heavy oppressive aura.
However, at this moment, the War God’s flames had already gone out, and only a few arcs of lightning were left jumping about, his aura weak, as if he had been drained by thirty continuous strikes.
At that time, the Fighting War Emperor Dragon’s body spewed out waves of scorching air, and then began to shrink as if deflating, returning to 1.9 meters in the blink of an eye, revealing Jack Clark with his halberd in hand.
A flash of electricity, and Damon Lopes appeared excitedly in front of Jack Clark, somewhat incoherently, “Brother Callum, you’re too fierce, damn.”
“That was a Thunder Battle Puppet from the late stages of Eight Layer Heaven, and you just blew it up.”
Jack Clark exhaled, “It’s okay, because it’s a puppet, it’s a bit lacking in endurance and adaptability compared to a real cultivator from the Eight Layer Heaven.”
Even though he had destroyed the Thunder Battle Puppet from the late stages of Eight Layer Heaven, Jack Clark was not complacent or arrogant—he was well aware of the difference between them.
Moreover, this battle had allowed him to almost reach his own limit of combat strength.
The Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form allowed him to withstand a late-stage Eight Layer opponent, and with the help of the Void Double Pupils, he even had the chance to kill him.
However, that was his limit in combat strength, meaning that after slaying one late-stage Eight Layer opponent, he would be exhausted, unlike his peak combat strength that would remain after blowing up an early-stage Eight Layer opponent.
“Let’s go, let’s see what’s inside.”
Saying this, the two crossed the broken land, and in a few flashes, they appeared in front of a mansion ensconced in Law Prohibition.
“I’ll do it.” Saying this, Damon Lopes gathered purple lightning in his hand, turning it into a long spear that fiercely struck the Law Prohibition.
Boom! The lightning burst forth but failed to shake the prohibition in the slightest.
However, under the bombardment of the unfamiliar Innate Thunderbolt energy, a powerful will from the depths of the mansion awoke, turning into an invisible surge that swept across the entire small world.
“To defeat the Thunder Battle Puppet at seventeen or eighteen years old is not bad. You two are worthy to obtain some minor things I’ve left inside,” a cold voice resounded, and the barrier of prohibition in front of them silently disappeared. Then, the mansion doors that were ten meters wide and fifteen meters high slowly opened.
What was revealed was a scene filled with birdsong and fragrant flowers.
But before the two could step in and survey the residence of this strong man, as time resumed its flow, the grand mansion crumbled like sand and turned into flying ash.
This scene was much like the one with the previous dojo.
This is the power of time; nothing can last forever. Everything will turn to ash, the seas may shift to mulberry fields, all things wither, even stars will eventually collapse.
At that moment, Jack Clark vaguely grasped something.
Then, Damon Lopes’s eyes lit up, “Brother Callum, quick, look over there.”
At the end of the dispersing mansion, a high platform, twenty meters tall, stood upright, surrounded by five pillars, each ten meters thick and stretching into the thunderclouds above.
Looking at the five stone pillars, excitement was evident on Damon Lopes’s face, “I felt the presence of the Lightning Law from up there. Brother Callum, let’s go have a look.”
Whoosh whoosh!!
In two leaps, spanning several hundred meters, they appeared at the edge of the high platform, and Damon Lopes immediately placed his hand on one of the stone pillars, his body’s purple lightning exploding and enveloping the pillar.
Boom boom boom!!
Instantly, thunderclouds in the sky became tumultuous, a succession of lightning bolts descending from the heavens striking the pillar. Under the bombardment of lightning, a pure silver-blue thunderbolt emerged from the markings.
As that thunderbolt emerged, Jack Clark felt as if he were seeing endless falling lightning, witnessing a world formed from thunderbolts, emitting an aura of mystery and destruction.
Stimulated by the energy of the Thunderbolt Law Fragments, the other four pillars also flickered with intense lightning, and four similar silver-blue bolts emerged from the markings.
Immediately, the markings on the five pillars separated and converged in mid-air, rotating and forming a thirty-meter-tall phantom completely made of electrified patterns.
“Thunder Prison True Body.”
As that patterned phantom appeared, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes’s Spiritual Wills received some information.
This was the inheritance left by the Lord of Thunder in this place. However, this set of information only contained his methods of cultivation prior to reaching the king-level, including Nine-fold Peak laws.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 298: The Alternation of Day and Night, the Mythical Candle Dragon (Requesting Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Chapter 298: The Alternation of Day and Night, the Mythical Candle Dragon (Requesting Monthly Votes)
Looking at the five fragments of the Thunder Law and the phantom of thunder patterns in the sky, Jack Clark thought for a moment.
“Mr. Lopes, I’ll take four of the Thunder Law fragments, and you’ll take one fragment along with the inheritance. No objections, right?”
The inheritance of the Thunder Prison True Body was very extreme; for Jack to cultivate it, he would have to give up the Combat Divine Body and reshape the True Martial Phantom, which was obviously not possible.
It was just the inheritance of a strong man who was slightly more powerful than the Heavenly King; he didn’t need the inheritance, as he could carve out an even stronger path on his own.
In comparison, Damon Lopes, an Innate Thunder awakenened one, was actually more suitable.
“Thank you, Brother Clark. I will remember this favor,” Damon Lopes accepted without any refusal.
Jack Clark smiled: “We’re brothers who have shared life-and-death experiences. You don’t have to be polite. Next time something good like this comes up, remember to include me.”
Although the inheritance he had obtained this time was not suitable for him, Jack Clark was not at a loss.
Every one of the Thunder Law fragments, formed by the dissipation of Law Power during the cultivation of the Lord of Thunder, could unleash the peak power of the Eight Layer Heaven once activated.
Beyond that, aside from being used as one-time consumables, these Law Fragments also contained some Mysteries of the Law.
If someone cultivating Thunder attribute Cultivation Methods obtained a Thunder Fragment, the Cultivation Methods and Talent Runes that were practiced under the influence of the Law Power would slowly evolve.
As for Innate Thunder awakeners like Damon Lopes, it goes without saying.
Having obtained the Thunder Prison inheritance and then absorbing the Thunder Law Fragments, his innate thunder would undergo a secondary qualitative change, and his combat power would surge greatly.
“Mr. Lopes, be careful. I’m going to collect the fragments,” Jack warned.
As he spoke, the Combat Shadow appeared behind Jack Clark once again. The thirty meter-high True Martial Phantom reached out with four arms towards the four Thunder Law Fragments.
Boom!
The moment the Combat Shadow’s four arms grasped the Law Fragments, powerful destructive lightning erupted from the fragments, causing the surroundings to shake violently with an alarming momentum.
This was the power involving Law; even just fragments were not something ordinary people could handle or possess.
About ten minutes later, the raging thunder finally subsided, revealing the panting figure of Jack Clark, and the Combat Shadow which now appeared somewhat transparent.
At this time, the four Thunder Law Fragments had turned into silver-blue thunder patterns, twined around the four arms of the Combat Shadow, invisibly emitting a Destructive Aura.
Damon Lopes was somewhat envious: “With the addition of four Law Fragments, Brother Clark, your strength will become even more monstrous.”
“You’re not too shabby yourself, Mr. Lopes.”
“That’s right,” Damon Lopes laughed with a hehe.
With his new four cards in hand, Jack Clark bid farewell: “Mr. Lopes, I have to continue slaying polluted monsters and hone my Combat Techniques, so I won’t keep you company here.”
…to hone Combat Techniques.
Although suspicious, Damon Lopes did not speak out and merely nodded: “Go ahead, Brother Clark. Although you are very strong, still try to be as careful as possible.”
“Yeah, I will be careful.”
Leaving Damon Lopes to closed-door cultivation in the small world unaffected by Void Energy, Jack Clark transformed into a golden light and rushed out of the relic, continuing to accumulate passive skills.
“What did they gain in there?”
Outside the relic, watching the golden silhouette burst out of the relic, Marcellus Larry was somewhat curious.
Due to the barrier between the inner and outer small worlds, the Eye of Heaven Observation could not see the situation inside, and thus did not witness the scene where Jack Clark transformed into the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form and exploded the Thunder Battle Puppet.
Lori Joyner slowly said, “When Damon Lopes opened the small world earlier, there was lightning flashing on the stele, so there’s a good chance it’s the inheritance of that Lord of Thunder.”
“Lord of Thunder, wasn’t his inheritance on the Road to Godhood?”
…
Beep, beep, beep!!
“Alert, a Level 9 lifeform’s energy fluctuation has entered the Kurole Strait.”
“Alert, energy fluctuation steady at Late Stage 9, the creature is moving rapidly, with a speed of 400 meters per second, forming a tsunami on the sea surface.”
“Warning, coastal research teams, please evacuate the Seaside immediately, please evacuate…”
In a cold region, at the entrance of a strait just ten kilometers wide, the Northern Ice Ocean Mutated Creatures Research Station was situated, and at this moment, a rapid alert was being broadcast.
On the coast, hearing the alert, the faces of the dozen or so staff members changed dramatically as the middle-aged leader shouted: “Everyone drop your tools, retreat, retreat.”
Just as these researchers, with strength around the Third and Fourth Layers, burst out at full strength towards the nearby hillside, loud rumbling sounds quickly came from the distance.
Out in the middle of the strait, the ice covering the surface was constantly being shattered, and the sea water was bulging tens of meters high, forming a fierce tsunami engulfing everything.
Amid the breaking ice and rising tsunami, a black-red dorsal fin surfaced, resembling a series of rugged and sharp reef rocks.
Watched by the researchers on the hillside, the huge dark shadow passed through the strait in the blink of an eye, rushed into the North Ice Sea Area, and soon disappeared into the Deep Ocean.
“Such a terrifying Mutated Creature. Just its passing creates such frightening aftershocks. Thank goodness this place is deserted, otherwise the consequences would be unimaginable.”
“Yes, compared to us humans, these Mutated Creatures are truly blessed.”
“Stop chatting, hurry and see if the equipment is still there. I hope it hasn’t been swept away by the tsunami…”
While those human researchers scrambled down the hillside, nearly ten thousand kilometers away, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that rushed into the North Ice Sea felt a sudden sharp drop in temperature around it.
Then, creatures from the cold waters appeared before the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
In the deep sea area at 500 meters, a mutated walrus more than 20 meters long and covered in gray scales didn’t have time to react before it was bitten in half by the passing Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
This mid-level sixth creature was devoured by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in just two bites, leaving only crimson blood and floating remnants of flesh and blood as evidence that the creature had existed.
At this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was like a great white shark that had entered a river, – its electromagnetic wave sensing capable of detecting everything within a few kilometers range, as it moved through the water at subsonic speeds.
Under these circumstances, numerous sixth and seventh level Mutated Unique Beasts hadn’t even reacted before they were savagely devoured by the gaping maw that suddenly appeared from the darkness with a resounding boom.
However, the target of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was those eighth and ninth level Giant Beasts. Therefore, after entering the North Ice Sea Area, it consciously headed towards the deeper sea.
There, the heavenly energy was denser, hence stronger Mutated Creatures preferred the deep-sea environment.
Beneath the pitch-black deep sea, more than 3000 meters below, lay a Late Stage eighth level Giant Beast, 110 meters long, sleeping among a silver coral reef that stretched for over a kilometer.
The sprawling coral reef, like a forest beneath the sea, emitted an ice-cold aura, keeping the surrounding sea water at a freezing yet unfrozen temperature.
As the whale-like Mutated Giant Beast slept, it breathed in harmony with the corals, inhaling and exhaling the cold energies.
Suddenly, the eighth level Beast opened its eyes wide, followed immediately by a terrified roar.
Roar!
With the eighth level white whale Giant Beast at its center, bursts of white icy light beams erupted, freezing everything in sight and instantly forming an ice mountain hundreds of meters wide.
Boom!
Above the ice mountain, a black-red giant claw wrapped in golden flames and entwined with thunder appeared.
Boom!
A terrifying Dragon Claw strike shattered the hundreds of meters wide ice mountain, the seabed collapsed, and along with it, the skull of the eighth level Giant Beast was obliterated.
In the raging sea water dyed red with blood, the massive figure of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly descended, its icy gaze fixed on the corpse of the white whale Giant Beast on the seabed.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grabbed the corpse of the Giant Beast with its double claws, and while continuing to search for its next target, it began devouring with large bites, tearing off tens of tons of flesh and blood with each mouthful.
As this flesh and blood was consumed, the rich biological energy radiated from the stomach of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, greedily absorbed by its cells which then began to split and compress.
Under the surge of energy, the size of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon visibly grew, making a crackling sound as the scales expanded, swelling in a matter of moments.
While the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew, Jack Clark’s already formidable body also enhanced bit by bit, endlessly increasing in strength.
The continuous hunting and devouring, and the abundance of ‘resources,’ allowed the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to grow rapidly, reaching a length of 165 meters in just half a day.
By this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had nearly reached the deepest part of the North Ice.
Compared to the sea area it first entered, this place was much smaller. However, due to the lack of ‘predatory creatures’ like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the ‘crops’ here were thriving.
But as it swam, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon noticed that the seventh level and above Mutated Creatures were thinning out, causing its ice-cold golden vertical pupils to suddenly light up.
Such a signal indicated a high probability of a nearby Level 9 Giant Beast.
Only a creature standing at the pinnacle of transcendence could radiate an aura capable of driving away the Giant Beasts above level seven within a certain range, forbidding them from plundering the heavenly energy.
Though the ocean is vast, the heavenly energy is still limited.
If too many Giant Beasts inhabited an area, the energy density of that area would diminish over the long term due to their constant absorption and plundering, affecting the improvement of their strength.
As for the Dragon Palace established by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this issue had not yet surfaced given the short time it had been set up.
Or rather, there was no chance for this problem to surface, as the Single-horned Tiger Whale and others absorbed heavenly energy at a rate far slower than it expanded its territory and plundered resources.
Following its path further ahead, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swam less than 300 kilometers when it sensed a powerful aura. The immense pressure was even felt by itself, inducing a slight sense of oppression.
Instantly, its eyes gleamed with excitement. This Level 9 Giant Beast was mighty indeed.
If the current strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could feel a hint of intangible pressure, it meant this Giant Beast was at least at Late Stage 9, and its bloodline had reached Monarch level.
A Late Stage 9 Monarch level Giant Beast, nearly 300 meters in length, with flesh and blood rich in energy and life factors – devouring it would at least cause its own size to swell by twenty meters.
Boom!
Hot golden flames erupted behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon as it shot through the deep sea like a submerged fighter aircraft, disappearing into the dark depths in the blink of an eye.
Deep down at 5000 meters, a mountain range stretched for a hundred kilometers and rose from the seabed, reaching a height of a kilometer.
Amidst the peaks of this underwater mountain range lay a beast over 300 meters long, resembling an Eastern Divine Dragon with a body covered in red scales, deep in slumber.
Unlike the legendary Eastern Divine Dragons, this beast’s tail nearly made up two-thirds of its body, sprawling across the mountains like a wall.
It seemed to sense something, and the Red Giant Beast suddenly opened its eyes, illuminating the dark sea in an instant.
Endless radiance of unknown origin turned ten kilometers of the deep sea into daylight, allowing a clear view of the marine life floating in the waters.
On the edge of this daylight zone stood a black-red ferocious behemoth, its body coursing with Hidden Deity Glyphs allowing it to approach silently.
In contrast to the 300-meter-long Red Giant Beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, at a mere 160 meters, appeared to be a younger brother who could seemingly be suppressed with a single claw.
Yet the eyes of the Red Giant beast immediately displayed vigilance, as if facing a grave threat, its colossal body ‘slowly’ rising, emitting a deep, slow growl.
“Intruder…”

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 299: The Three Thousand Meter Giant Beast, Invincible Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Chapter 299: The Three Thousand Meter Giant Beast, Invincible Form
“`
Watching the Red Beast nestled between the mountain peaks, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t waste words, the terrifying pressure of its Monarch-level instantly burst forth.
Boom!
In an instant, the Heaven-Burning Golden Flame erupted, expanding rapidly to cover an 800-meter radius, forming a white-hot impact around it as the sea water exploded open like a deep-sea nuclear explosion.
Within the expanding semi-circle explosion water vapor wave, streaks of half a meter thick blue-black thunderlight leaped out, annihilating everything in their path, while dazzling electric arcs spread thousands of meters through the water.
The moment the domain burst, the seabed within a 0.5-kilometer radius under the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon collapsed.
Under the terrifying backlash, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon vanished on the spot, bursting forth with incredible speed and creating a pitch-black, straight Destruction Tunnel on the seabed.
Roar!
The Red Beast let out an angry roar; its eyes closed, and in an instant, the previously bright as day deep sea entered a dark night, pitch black, save for the dazzling firelight emitted around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
The mountain peaks where the Red Beast was nested collapsed, countless rocks shattering under the dragon claw wrapped in thunder and flames, melted by the Golden Flame into magma that mixed with the sea water and spewed forward.
Instantly, in the pitch-black deep sea, a circle of circular fire chain appeared, extending thousands of meters and spectacular to behold.
But just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shattered the mountain peak, a terrifying tail as long as two thousand meters descended like a mountain peak, enveloped in black cold air.
Boom!
The horrific strike covered the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and as it fell, the domain of interwoven thunder and flames instantly exploded, completely breaking the mountain range in two.
In an instant, the entire seabed shook under the terrifying power, the ice layer on the sea surface shattered, and the sea water exploded.
Roar!
Suddenly, a fierce roar resonated, and endless golden flames and thunder shone under the intense heat impact, causing the surrounding sea water to explode, forming circles of white waves.
From the depths of the shattered mountain range, the silhouette of the Black-red Colossal Beast standing in the center of the Thunderflame Domain was revealed.
Standing on the magma melted seabed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body was circled with black radiance, exuding an immovable solidity, golden vertical pupils coldly looking into the distance.
In that endless darkness, a Red Beast over three thousand meters long and surrounded by a black cold stream lay coiled, exuding a terrifying aura of oppression.
Under the dark ‘domain,’ the Red Beast’s size had exploded by ten times, its massive form even causing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to be taken aback for a moment.
Its size might have grown tenfold, but it seemed… not very strong, at least to him.
Roar!
From the darkness, a brutal roar was heard, and instantly, a huge red dragon claw came out, surrounded by black airflow. Before even landing, a dreadful pressure covered the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Domain covering eight hundred meters sank violently, with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at its center, the top layer of the seabed, already melted into magma, sank by several tens of meters more.
Roar!
Amid the roars, the Golden Flame Domain revolving around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon contracted, transforming into golden energy that converged on its right claw, forming a golden sun of a dozen meters in diameter.
The light sphere emitted a high temperature of tens of thousands of degrees Celsius, and even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon found it hard to endure as the scales on its right claw turned bright red in the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, the dragon claw that spanned two hundred meters had already appeared above him. Clutching the sun, he struck out with his claw.
Boom!
In an instant, endless golden light shone from the seabed fissure; the golden fireball, like an expanding red giant star, released a destructive intense heat.
At that moment, everything shook and boiled over.
The Red Beast let out a scream, its dragon scales shattered, and its giant, charred claw drawn back into the darkness under the impact of the Extreme Flame Explosion.
Just then, from the heart of the intense explosion below, a long spear, formed entirely of blackish-blue thunder, turned into a streak of electric light and rushed into the darkness.
Boom!
The thunder spear exploded in the darkness, forming a web of electricity hundreds of meters wide, its radiance dispelling the darkness around, revealing the vague silhouette of the distant Red Beast.
I’ve found you.
The moment the thunder spear exploded, the ground beneath the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s feet shattered, and with the swiftness bestowed by its Agility Talent, his massive body instantly disappeared.
Boom! In the darkness, a colossal red Dragon Tail swept across, and in an instant, a terrifying explosion resonated in the sea, blasting open a circle of golden-blue shock waves.
Among the burst of light, the Dragon Tail, tens of meters across, could be seen with broken scales, the flesh underneath exploded and searing blood spraying.
However, under the terrifying power of the two-thousand-meter dragon tail sweep, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also burst forth with a boom, knocked back at supersonic speeds, crashing heavily into a mountain peak thousands of meters away.
Boom! With the terrifying impact, a kilometer-high mountain crumbled like gravel, countless debris mixed with sand and mud blasted out for several kilometers, the noise deafening.
Thump!
The destructive impact of the Gold Flame Thunderbolt burst forth, countless pieces of debris shattered and melted into magma, the intense heat flames alternating with the sea water forming a series of violent waves.
Enveloped by flames and thunder, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly walked out, stepping on the magma, its golden vertical pupils coldly looking into the darkness, its body emitting an indescribable pressure of destruction.
What a strange talent, an absolute dark environment that even shields its electromagnetic sensation, and an increase in size by a factor of ten.
But after increasing its size tenfold, it seemed unable to use other gifted powers, relying only on its Monarch-level sturdy flesh to fight.
That’s not right.
In an instant, the seabed lit up as bright as daylight, and a beast over three hundred meters long, composed entirely of white flames, appeared in the distance, its mouth shining with dazzling radiance.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 658: 299: 3,000-meter Giant Beast, Invincible Form_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Chapter 299: 3,000-meter Giant Beast, Invincible Form_2
Boom!
The white breath formed by the endless intense flames pierced through the deep sea, instantly annihilating the sea water in its path and forming destructive waves under its strong impact.
At the moment the white flame breath erupted, the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also shone with golden light, a golden flame breath spewed out.
Two golden and white light beam breaths penetrated thousands of meters, colliding with each other in an instant.
Boom! Dazzling light shone on the seabed, the endless scorching energy clashed and exploded, forming a circle of destructive halos, and the deep sea roared wildly.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the terrifying release of scorching energy, the surrounding seawater exploded and expanded, with the ice layers collapsing and forming a several-kilometer-wide water mountain on the sea surface thousands of meters above.
The breath of giant beasts is formed by compressing and condensing their internal energy into an attribute-carrying impact light beam, which has terrifying power and continuous impact.
Although the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is only at the early stage of Level 9, its Heaven Burning Golden Flame is a top-tier talented power that is close to the law, so it is not at a disadvantage when fighting against the breath of a Late Stage 9 Giant Beast.
Even if this Red Beast, under the ‘Domain’ in the daytime, had its breath power increased tenfold and was comparable to an ordinary breath of a quasi-mythical giant beast, it was the same.
As both sides were at a stalemate, the dorsal fins of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon lit up one after another, with the Thunder leaping and gathering endlessly in its throat.
Boom! The golden breath instantly turned into gold and blue, and the combined power of the dual top-tier talents caused the power to soar in an instant.
From a distance, the gold and blue radiance in the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon covered the golden breath, swelling dozens of meters in thickness, and engulfing the white light beam breath as it pushed horizontally.
Roar! At the moment when the gold and blue integrated breath appeared in front of them, the world alternated between black and white, and everything around them slowed down in an instant.
In the super slow-motion scene, the giant beast transformed into a white flame slowly moves away to the side and rear, rubbing shoulders with the exploding gold and blue breath light, eventually landing on the mountain peak behind.
Boom! A nuclear explosion-like light mushroomed at the bottom of the sea, as the terrifying explosion comparable to the power of the law instantly shattered the ‘domain’ where the time was slowed down.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the impact of the breath that had once blasted a small world, the entire seabed was in chaos, and the mountain range in this area collapsed directly.
Under the destructive explosion, the water mountain that bulged on the sea surface burst open, and mixed with the broken ice, formed a tsunami that rushed in all directions, submerging everything.
In the raging seawater, red lightning appeared all over the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body, releasing endless power and causing its size to increase madly.
Boom! A terrifying aura that made the Red Beast terrified burst out.
Deep in the sea, a ferocious behemoth, 250 meters long and over 160 meters tall, wrapped in red lightning appeared, radiating a horrifying aura that seemed to crush the void.
Even its power was so immense that the invisible pressure pushed the surrounding raging seawater away, causing a 500-meter-diameter waterless vacuum area to form.
Facing the Red Beast, which possessed a bizarrely powerful talent that was comparable to a quasi-mythical battle strength, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon directly entered its giant invincible form.
Roar! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared to the sky, shaking the heavens and the earth, with even more terrifying flames and thunder erupting from its body, and then disappeared from its original position.
Roar! Under the terrifying aura of death, the Red Beast roared in horror, and its eyes closed as the world plunged into darkness.
Boom!
In the darkness, the 3,000-meter-long giant beast screamed as its more than 2,000-meter-long, 300-meter-diameter large tail, with half of its scales and flesh, was blasted away.
At this moment, the black and white alternated between heaven and earth, and the power of slowed time came once again, as the red giant beast transformed into the white flame form, elongating to entangle the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The extreme sun scorching white flame collided with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Gold Flame Thunderbolt, causing continuous explosions but unable to approach the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body.
At this time, that slow time realm disappeared, and the cold eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swelled its dual claws’ muscles and suddenly pushed.
Boom!
The surrounding entangled white giant beast exploded instantly, turning into a sky full of white flames and reassembling in the distance, but as soon as it condensed, a massive dragon claw appeared.
Boom! With a terrifying claw, space shattered, forming extensive black cracks that spread in all directions, and the White Flame Giant Beast exploded in an instant.
The blasted giant beast turned into a flame and reassembled in the distance once again, but its consecutive explosions had made its aura weaker, and the world suddenly plunged into darkness.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
In front of the Giant Invincible Form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Red Beast, which had been able to fight against it just a moment ago, was instantly overwhelmed and could only rely on the alternating power of day and night to slow it down and drag the battle on.
For a time, the battle between the two giant beasts resulted in the seabed collapsing, the mountain ranges shattering, and the seawater within a hundred kilometers becoming turbid and violent, with tsunamis rolling on the sea surface.
Just as the two giant beasts’ devastating battle nearly destroyed the mountain range within a hundred kilometers, suddenly the battlefield fell silent.
In the collapsed depths of the sea floor, the 300-meter-long Red Beast was covered with broken scale armor all over its body, and its body was almost torn apart in the middle, revealing its wriggling organs.
One of its majestic dragon horns on its head was also broken by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, half of its cheek was torn, and the scorching red blood flowed continuously from the injury.
Under normal conditions, Level 9 Giant Beasts have their blood and energy united throughout their body, and even if heavily injured, their blood will not flow out but remain locked within their body.
However, this Red Beast was on its last breath, its internal talented power was temporarily shattered, leaving it without the strength to restrain itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 659: 299: The Three Thousand Meter Giant Beast, Invincible Form_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Chapter 299: The Three Thousand Meter Giant Beast, Invincible Form_3
The seabed trembled slightly.
Heavy footsteps crushed the Earth, a ferocious behemoth, two hundred and fifty meters in length, shrouded in red lightning, advanced slowly, exuding an extremely ferocious and terrifying aura.
A heavy and terrifying pressure emanated from its body, pushing the sea water aside to form a vacuum area hundreds of meters in range.
Observing the feeble Red Beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils glinted coldly, as firelight burst forth from its mouth and nostrils alongside a deep roar.
“I am the Thunderflame Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, Tim Abbott, Brock Abbott.”
“From the battle just now, the strength you’ve shown has gained my acknowledgment. Now you have two choices, join the Dragon Palace, or be killed by me.”
This Red Beast was very strong, at the Late Stage 9, and under the influence of two Top Tier Talents, its combat power had reached the quasi-mythical level, no less than the previously encountered Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
Of course, that was when the Sword Dragon Giant Beast had not used its Law Power.
But even so, it was already supremely powerful, nearly a leap across realms, particularly with the peculiar Black and White Neck Ring Ability, stronger than Haward Jones’s Day and Night Alternation.
When its eyes opened, daylight emerged, and it transformed into a white beast of blazing fire, elemental in nature, immune to most physical damage. When its eyes closed, night fell, and its body size increased tenfold, its flesh and blood immensely staunch.
Beyond that, there was also the slow Time Power involved during the transition of day to night.
Both of these formidable talents somewhat tempted the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
At this point, its Evolution value had accumulated over twenty-eight thousand, nearing its Fifth Evolution, but it had not yet decided what to absorb for its fifth talent.
Given the Red Beast’s special and powerful talents, it planned to keep it for the time being, in case no suitable targets were found…
As these thoughts churned in the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mind, waiting for death to descend upon it, the Red Beast’s gaze flickered in disbelief, struggling to comprehend.
Not… going… to… die?
It… seems… to… invite… me… to… join… something… called… the… Dragon Palace.
What… is… the… Dragon Palace?
And… what… is… the… Beast… Empire?
Why… beat… me… up?
For a moment, the Red Beast was dumbfounded on the spot.
Observing the Red Beast that did not react for a long while, the gaze of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew increasingly chilly. Does this creature want to die? Or were my words not clear enough?
Or perhaps it has a problem with its brain, preferring death over submission and joining the Dragon Palace?
With this thought, a terrifying intent to kill spread from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, about to obliterate the Giant Beast’s head with one blow. It was then that the Giant Beast let out a slow, low growl.
“Roar! I… am… willing… to… join.”
Of course, the Red Beast did not want to die if it could live, and submitting to this terrifying Black-red Colossal Beast didn’t feel like losing face; this creature was too perverse.
Just at Level 9 Early Stage, and yet in a situation with such huge gaps in every aspect, it could still overpower it. It was even more monstrous than the beast itself.
…Watching the Red Beast finally catch up after a while, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon found its gaze becoming odd; why did it always feel like this creature was a bit slow-witted?
Nevertheless, since it chose to join, keep it alive for now.
In contemplation, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s red lightning slowly faded, and its colossal form shrank, in the blink of an eye, back to one hundred and sixty meters.
Having subdued a Level 9 Giant Beast, and one that matched the strength of a quasi-mythical level beast in the late stage of Level 9, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled its customary address.
“Roar! Welcome to the Dragon Palace family, from now on we are family, good brothers, we fight together, we eat meat together.”
“By the way, do you have a name?”
Facing a series of inquiries from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Red Beast stared blankly at it, it took a while to come back to its senses, and then it slowly growled, “Roar! I, don’t, have, a, name.”
Why was this fellow’s reaction so delayed, could it be an idiot? Were there also idiots among Mutated Creatures? The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was somewhat baffled.
No, if it were stupid, how could this fellow grow to be a Late Stage 9?
Regaining its senses, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep roar, “In that case, this king will give you one.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was quite confident in naming, after all, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the like had their domineering names bestowed by it.
Looking at the Red Beast’s massive body that resembled the Eastern Divine Dragon, along with its special talent that made it seem like dawn when its eyes opened and night when they closed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled lowly.
“From today on, you shall be called ‘Candle Dragon,’ in charge of the alternation of day and night.”
After saying that, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction, very pleased with the name it had chosen.
“Alright, I went a bit hard earlier, you should recover from your injuries first, and meanwhile, this king needs to rest a while.”
After transforming into the gigantified state for more than ten minutes, even with the terrifying vitality of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the toll was significant, and it felt somewhat weak, in need of rest like after an exerting feat.
This guy’s Talent Ability was too bizarre, even for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it took over a dozen blasts to exhaust the Origin of his Talent Ability.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned around and lay down on a raised hundred-meter boulder to rest, the Red Beast in the distance suddenly let out an excited roar.
“Roar! I, Candle Dragon, now, have, a, name.”
Watching the Red Beast take several minutes to react, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes reflected deep thought.
Indeed, there was something off about this fellow, was it due to his Talent Ability?
About half an hour later, as the Red Beast had regained some of its strength, it closed and opened its eyes, and instantly, day and night alternated within a ten-kilometer radius underwater, as the power related to time descended once more.
Under the effect of that special power, the blood flowing from the Red Beast’s body reversed course, and the terrifying wounds on its body began to regenerate at an increasing speed.
This was the terrifying vitality of a Level 9 Giant Beast.
For a Level 9 Giant Beast, as long as the injury was not fatal, even severed limbs could regenerate in a short time, much like the Nine-headed Dragon Kidora.
However, while the external injuries on the Red Beast healed, the damage sustained in the battle remained; it would take at least ten days to half a month to fully recover its energies.
As the Red Beast regained its ability to move, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stood up in the distance.
“Roar! Candle Dragon, do you know of any other Level 9 Giant Beasts in the nearby sea area?”
Facing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s inquiry, the Red Beast paused for about a minute before it came back to its senses and let out a muffled low growl, “Roar! Know, one, quite, far, away.”
This guy, does it stay within that special Time Power even when not in combat form?
Noticing the abnormality of the Red Beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thoughtfully growled, “Lead the way, let’s go eat it.”
“…Okay.”
Guided by the Red Beast, the two Giant Beasts disappeared in a blink into the dark sea beneath, leaving behind mountain ranges turned to ruins and countless Marine Life corpses killed by the aftershocks.

chapters.title: Chapter 660: 300: Ancient Emperor's Inheritance, Great Achievement in Battle Intent (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Chapter 300: Ancient Emperor’s Inheritance, Great Achievement in Battle Intent (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Under the gloomy sky, the earth was cracked, filled with the desolate and lifeless aura of doomsday.
Jack Clark sat on the edge of a cliff hundreds of meters high, his legs dangling in the air, holding a cup of milk tea in his left hand and eating a piece of honey flower pastry in his right.
Behind him, a rugged and domineering War Halberd was planted in the ground, a full meter into the rock, standing like a flag.
The pastries and milk tea in Jack’s hands came from Gabriella.
That wealthy girl used a Sumeru Bracelet, strengthened to +10, its space, reaching tens of cubic meters, was filled with various foods.
And all these foods were made by top-tier chefs, not only exquisite and beautiful, but also sweet and not greasy, even Jack wanted to eat more after tasting them.
Then Gabriella directly gifted him a bunch, filling the remaining space in the Sumeru Bracelet.
However, eating cake and drinking milk tea in such an apocalyptic atmosphere might seem a bit discordant, like the Polluted Giant Beast in the sky, which seemed rather angry.
Roar!
Under the rolling dark clouds, a Level 7 Polluted Giant Beast with wings spanning tens of meters, its body covered in twisted bone spurs and scale armor and resembling a lion with an eagle’s head, let out a violent roar.
Grey currents swirled around its body, exuding a withering, poisonous aura; with a flap of its wings, it stirred up rolling poisonous clouds, diving down from the sky at supersonic speed.
In an instant, the sonic boom of a fighter aircraft thundered across the sky, casting a massive shadow over Jack Clark.
Jack raised his eyebrows, finished the milk tea in one gulp, casually threw the empty cup over the cliff, and with a flash, he pulled out the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd from behind him.
Boom!
A Golden War Halberd, over thirty meters long, shot up into the sky from the cliff, the immense strength causing an explosive burst in the air, forming a series of concentric shock waves behind it.
Chii!
Facing the grand War Halberd bursting toward it, the lion-eagle Giant Beast shook its wings slightly, dodging the strike from Infernal Purgatory by deftly twisting its body while plummeting at supersonic speed.
But at the moment when it passed by the War Halberd, the Golden War Halberd suddenly released a golden light.
Boom!
A violent explosion formed a golden ghost face with a diameter of a hundred meters in the sky, the dazzling light illuminating this world and creating rings of white waves.
In the howling of the raging wind, a broken corpse of the Polluted Giant Beast with only half of its body intact fell from the sky, the gusts of wind lifting the still-descending milk tea cup into the air.
Bang! The earth beneath the cliff shattered, raising clouds of smoke and dust.
At that moment, a stream of purple-black fog snaked upwards from below, tugging at the Purple Killing Energy that Jack had kept concealed.
In an instant, the surging Black-purple Fog erupted, engulfing an area of over twenty meters in the blink of an eye, the terrifying Killing Intent even causing an abrupt temperature drop of several degrees in the surroundings.
Amidst the swirling Black Purple Devil Gas, Jack appeared like a devil from Hell, somewhat intimidating.
In the past few days, Jack had slain too many high-level and high-order polluted monsters, and in terms of ordinary people, his Blood Fiend had almost exceeded ten million, which is why it was so horrifying.
Normally, although slaying high-order Unique Beasts does form Blood Fiend, most of it naturally dissipates and does not cling to the slayer.
Only after the massacre of thousands or tens of thousands of Unique Beasts does the intense bloodthirsty Killing Intent and the strong resentment of the Mutated Creatures before death combine to form Blood Fiend that envelops the slayer.
For instance, on the night of the Blood Moon, Jack had slain thousands of low-level and a few higher-level Mutated Creatures in one go, touching the realm of thought as his Halberd skill reached the ultimate sublimation with the Blood Fiend absorbed.
Or for those who practice skills that condense Blood Fiend, Blood Fiend will appear on their bodies after killing a large number of high-level mutated organisms.
However, the rules of the Ruins Continent are special, the Blood Fiend automatically condenses after slaying Void Creatures, which is why Jack’s aura is so fearsome.
Otherwise, those experts from the Ninth Heavens and King-level strong men from the Outer World would have long been submerged by a sea of Blood Fiend, considering the greater number of bones beneath their feet.
And although this Purple Killing Energy seems somewhat frightening, it’s actually an opportunity, especially for someone like Jack who has condensed something akin to Slaughter War Intent.
Eyeing the stirred Purple Killing Energy, Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly, “If I can integrate this Killing Intent into my Blood Sea Hell, absorb and refine it, perhaps it could push my Battle Intent to the Great Realm completion.”
“No, simply absorbing Killing Intent shouldn’t be enough, comprehension of slaughter is also necessary,” Jack mused with a thoughtful expression in his eyes.
With the Great Realm of thought, more Heavenly Energy can be gathered, and with the boost of thought, the True Strength’s power can be amplified by five times.
At that time, combined with the fourteen-fold boost of the Combat Shadow, a casual strike from Jack with the War Halberd would reach nineteen times the terrifying degree of power, sweeping up even more Heavenly Energy.
Under normal conditions, with Jack’s ‘comprehension’ aptitude, if he does not use Attribute points, reaching a Great Accomplishment in Battle Intent would take a long time, but now he has a shortcut to rapid success.
This opportunity to enhance combat power cannot be missed.
His strength can crossover several small boundaries, normally at mid-stage of the Seventh Layer realm, he could compare to mid-eighth level, an advantage accumulated bit by bit in all areas.
With these thoughts, a red mark emerged on Jack’s forehead, resembling both an eye and a symbol, and boundless blood light erupted from his center.
Boom! The winds surged, and the ground shook.
Enveloped by the unfolding Blood Hell and surrounded by Purple Killing Energy, Jack’s eyes gradually turned blood-red, emitting terrifying murderous intent as he burst through the air, charging into the deep ruins.
Across the apocalyptic Earth, a trail of golden light pierced through everything, blasting apart one contaminated creature after another, overwhelmingly invincible.
Soon, he had reached nearly a thousand kilometers deep into the ruins.

chapters.title: Chapter 661: 300 Ancient Emperor's Inheritance, Great Achievement in Battle Intent (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Chapter 300 Ancient Emperor’s Inheritance, Great Achievement in Battle Intent (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
Roar!
On a small hill hundreds of meters high, where a Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast had been lying, it suddenly stood up. Its dark red eyes, looking towards the end of the Earth, were filled with violence and a will to destroy.
A golden light was shooting towards it at Supersonic Speed, emitting a distant sonic boom.
Roar! Accompanied by a violent roar, the beast, which resembled a giant tiger and was covered in sharp spikes, was surrounded by a black wind that extended over a 200-meter radius, forming its domain.
Under that black wind domain, which was like countless blades, the earth shattered. The Polluted Giant Beast instantly burst forth at Supersonic Speed, charging towards Jack Clark in the distance.
From afar, the golden light and the black storm collided in the blink of an eye.
Boom! An instant, intense explosion erupted, fracturing the Earth. Following that, the black wind mixed with the golden glint of the Halberd Skill unleashed a Destructive Impact, whipping up raging winds over a kilometer.
In the midst of the violent explosion, the sixty-meter-long Eighth Level Beast was blown backwards, heavily crashing into a small hill in the distance amidst the swirling black wind.
Boom! The hill crumbled, and stones tumbled down.
Standing on the edge of the distant shattered pit, Jack held his halberd, behind him stood a thirty-meter-tall Combat Shadow, Three-faced and Six-armed, with four halos slowly revolving behind its head.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to grow and provide feedback, Jack’s physical strength became increasingly terrifying. With the True Dragon Power’s blessing, he could now directly send an Early Stage Eighth Level Beast flying.
Roar!
In the distance, where the mountains had exploded, the black wind circled around the angry roaring Polluted Giant Beast. Then, before its eyes, nine thirty-meter-long Golden War Halberds appeared.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!! The violent explosions shook Heaven and Earth, and a nuclear explosion’s radiance slowly rose from the ground.
In just over half a year, Jack, who had once looked up to high-order fighters of the Seventh Layer Heaven, could now fell an Early Stage Eighth Level Beast in just two or three moves.
Such a terrifying Instantaneous Explosion, witnessed several times before, still made Marcellus Larry and his companion twitch at the corners of their eyes.
At that moment, rich, purple-black fog converged from the center of the distant explosion and then rushed towards Jack Clark, instantly increasing the Purple Killing Energy surrounding him by a circle.
Boom!
Jack transformed into a streak of golden light and moved sideways to leave, planning to fight a few Mid Stage Level 8 Void Creatures and, at the same time, slay more Level 6 and 7 Void Creatures to hone his Battle Intent.
After acquiring four Thunderbolt Law Fragments and having a trump card for combating Peak of the eighth level creatures, Jack expanded his hunting grounds to a 1,000 kilometers range.
Originally, he had set a limit for himself at 800 kilometers.
Because under normal conditions, going beyond 800 kilometers meant encountering creatures above Level 8, even Late Stage Level 8 or Peak Level 8 creatures, which even he would find difficult to deal with.
Facing those monsters nearing the pinnacle of Transcendence, if he couldn’t escape immediately, it would be extremely dangerous.
After all, this was not a game. These creatures wouldn’t stop chasing fresh life once their aggro was lost; they would hunt it down until death.
These creatures lingered deep within the ruins because the Void Energy here was richer, and they preferred the environment, not because they were confined to the depths.
And as Jack ventured 1,000 kilometers into the ruins, successively killing two Level 8 Polluted Creatures,
Outside the Void Relic Continent, Marcellus Larry watched the Purple Kill Value behind the first place on the leaderboard skyrocket.
“His destructive power has increased a notch with every move compared to before; he must have broken through to the mid period, in less than half a month.”
“With a mid-stage cultivation of the seventh realm, he’s able to roam the territories dominated by Level 8 creatures and suppress a Level 8 Early Stage contaminated creature in a few moves.”
“This man, whether in cultivation talent or actual combat strength, is somewhat exceptional. If he doesn’t fall within ten years, he must become a Heavenly King.”
Lori Joyner shook her head slightly, “I feel that’s not all. If his soul is strong enough, he may have a chance to obtain that Monarch’s Inheritance on the Road to Becoming a God this time. Then…”
At this point, excitement flashed in their eyes.
But Marcellus Larry soon wore a wry smile and said, “It’s going to be difficult. Even the First Councilor barely missed it. According to the threshold he set, it’s almost impossible for anyone to meet the requirements.”
“Moreover, the rate at which Jack Clark is killing Void Creatures is too fast. Once the Purple Kill Value reaches the requirement, the Road to Becoming a God will appear ahead of time.”
“…In that case, our gains from this relic may be less than we expected.”
Looking at the leaderboard, where the number behind Jack Clark’s name had increased twice as fast as the previous two days, the two of them didn’t know what to say.
Who could have expected that this time the relic would produce such a variable as Jack Clark, whose speed and number of kills of Void Creatures surpassed that of hundreds of top-notch geniuses.
Night!
Firelight danced on the hillside, where Gabriella, still dressed in blue workers’ clothes, sat in front of a fire, enthusiastically barbecuing Alien Beast Meat.
Next to her, Jane Aiken was eating pastries while giving instructions.
“Fina, don’t brush the sauce on so fast. The meat isn’t evenly heated yet. If you cook the sauce for too long, it will taste bitter.”
“This is the time when you should be brushing on some oil.”
“That side is burnt, flip it quickly… wait, you’ve added too much pepper…”
While Gabriella was excitedly and clumsily barbecuing the Alien Beast Meat, Jack Clark slowly walked out of the darkness. His eyes still held traces of dark red, and there was a terrifying killing intent swirling around him.
The most important thing was the Killing Intent emanating from his body, which, even though restrained, startled both girls.
Jane Aiken was surprised, “Jack Clark, how many creatures did you kill today?”
Suppressing the boiling killing intent within him, Jack Clark slowly said, “Not too many, about a thousand or so.”
Because he had slain high-order contaminated creatures today, and there were quite a few Level 8 ones, so the number was much fewer than the previous days.
As a result, the passive skills of his Void Double Pupils were still slightly short of 7,000.
It seemed like a loss, but it didn’t matter.
Because in the next few days, Jack Clark’s direction of killing would be retracting towards the Oasis, slowly clearing the map. Those creatures in the range of 300 to 800 kilometers were just delayed by a day or two.
As for deeper areas, there was no need to take the risk.
However, today Jack Clark didn’t sit next to the fire but stayed away from the two girls.
Looking at Jack Clark in the distance, Gabriella found it odd, “Jack Clark, why are you sitting so far away? Do you want to try the stone slab barbecue I made?”
Jack Clark politely declined, “Thank you, but I’d like to have a vegetarian meal today, just to change the taste. Of course, the main reason is that the pastries you gave me taste very good.”
“I see, okay then,” Gabriella felt a bit disappointed.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s wristband flickered, signaling to everyone that today’s Heavenly Eye channel had opened, allowing them to chat or share information.
As usual, though, everyone’s first reaction was to look at the Purple Kill leaderboard.
“Pfft! Cough! Cough!! One hundred and ninety-eight thousand…”
Eddy Keller, who was drinking water atop a hundred-meter-high stone peak, almost choked, incredulously staring at the data displayed behind the rankings, wondering if his eyes were deceiving him.
First place, Jack Clark: One hundred and ninety-eight thousand six hundred.
Second place, Eddy Keller: Nineteen thousand three hundred…
This can’t be real, can it?

chapters.title: Chapter 662: 301: The Giant Turtle Roars to the Sky, Battle Demon God
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Chapter 301: The Giant Turtle Roars to the Sky, Battle Demon God
“`
“Jack, this guy… your sudden change into such a freak is a bit too much for me to handle.”
Sitting atop the gigantic statue of the stone turtle, Justin Welan watched as Jack Clark’s Purple Killing Energy surged by 90,000 in one day, and even he, accustomed to such scenes, was somewhat shocked.
Over 90,000 Purple Killing Energy, this signifies that he has slain tens of thousands of Level 5 Polluted Monsters in one day.
Tens of thousands of Level 5, the entire students of martial cultivation from all three grades at Eastern Summer can’t even add up to ten thousand cultivators above Fifth Layer Heaven.
Of course, as the Void Creatures at the periphery were almost completely cleared out, there weren’t many of Level 5 left.
The Void Creatures Jack Clark must have slain today were all above sixth level, with a large number being Level 7, which is why his Purple Killing Energy could soar so much in such a short time.
“Ah! The gap is getting bigger and bigger,” Justin Welan felt a bit weary at heart.
While it’s not to the point of being afraid of his brother’s suffering or jealous of his brother’s Range Rover, watching the brother who was once slower at Foundation Establishment become increasingly dazzling, anyone normal would feel a deficit.
