After all, Justin Welan is a genius himself, a ‘monster’ who reached Fifth Layer Heaven in less than an academic year, peerless in defense within the same rank.
Suddenly, Justin Welan sat up straight, pumping himself up, “No, what’s the use of envying Jack? I need to take action, to become stronger and even more powerful.”
With that, Justin Welan looked at the stone turtle statue underneath his butt.
He wasn’t sure if it was because of practicing the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth Skill or due to the second qualitative change in his physique from absorbing the Essence Blood of a turtle-type Giant Beast, but he always felt there was something extraordinary about this stone turtle.
Yet several days had passed without any discoveries.
“Strange, where exactly is the secret of this thing?” Justin Welan scratched his head, when suddenly his gaze fell upon the stone turtle statue’s head, which seemed to be howling at the moon.
Whoosh!
In an instant, Justin Welan’s figure flashed, crossing tens of meters to reach the dragon head of the stone turtle that resembled a platform.
Looking down at the dark expanse of Earth around him, Justin Welan felt an inexplicable sense of openness in his chest, and couldn’t help but let out a long howl, his voice growing louder and more prolonged… and then…
Roar!
From beneath his feet, the Dragon Turtle’s mouth let out a silent roar, throwing Justin Welan’s consciousness into disarray.
Thinking he was in danger, his True Strength involuntarily exploded from within, forming a yellow Giant Turtle phantom several meters high and covering a five-meter radius around him.
From a distance, the hundreds of meters tall stone turtle statue now sported a ‘little’ Mysterious Martial atop its head, both howling at the moon, a striking resemblance in their expressions.
Boom!
In an instant, the huge stone turtle statue trembled slightly, the runes on the fragmented stele on its back sparkled, and a special force within was triggered.
Just as Justin Welan finally activated the power contained within the stone turtle, the burly Howard Lambert sat in front of a bonfire, flipping to his own name on the leaderboard.
Ranked one hundred thirty-two, with a Purple Kill Value of 5143.
These were his Purple Killing Energy points amassed from slaying over three hundred Level 5, more than twenty early-stage Level 6, a dozen mid-stage Level 6, and a few late-stage monsters in the past few days.
For him, in the mid-period of Fifth Layer Heaven and just breaking through to the late period, this achievement was already quite strong.
Although those monsters have been polluted and only retained their instincts, unable to use their Combat Techniques and Talent Abilities, making them slightly weaker than other creatures and cultivators of the same level.
Yet, his achievements didn’t even compare to Jack Clark’s over 190,000 Purple Killing Energy.
“It seems I’m still not strong enough,” Howard Lambert’s eyes revealed an even more resolute and crazed look.
If he wanted to catch up to that monster and fulfill their agreed battle, he needed more intense fights, to push himself to the brink of death to break through his genetic limitations.
Standing next to a monster’s corpse that had been dissected into little pieces, the blonde young man licked his lips, his eyes revealing a pathological excitement as he looked at the top name on the leaderboard.
“I really want to dissect his body to see what kind of structure allows him to emit such immense strength.”
That night, nobody felt like chatting. After seeing the leaderboard, Balderas and the others silently found a place to start cultivating.
For these top-tier geniuses from various nations, the blow was too great, leaving them with no desire to speak.
As for the information, they had mostly exchanged what they needed in the previous few days.
By the bonfire, Gabriella, who had been barbecuing, glanced at Jack Clark in the distance and murmured in low astonishment, “Junior Aiken, that guy is a monster, right?”
“Yes, he’s a monster,” Jane Aiken nodded in agreement.
Jack Clark’s cultivation rate surpassed even hers, a genius with ‘top-tier’ cultivation talent and ‘top-tier’ enlightenment. He was indeed a monster.
Not to mention his absolute dominance, peerless within the same rank, to which even her mastery of the Four Great Sword Intentions paled in comparison.
As the two girls murmured quietly, a formidable surge of power suddenly burst forth from Jack Clark, who was enjoying his dinner at a distance.
Bang!
The overpowering strength caused the air around him to explode instantaneously, generating gusts of raging wind that blew in all directions, causing Jane Aiken’s and Fina’s hair to fly about wildly.
The firelight of the bonfire was also scattered by the wind, flickering chaotically.
After a few minutes, the surging aura around Jack Clark gradually subsided. Gabriella couldn’t help but wonder, “Jack Clark, did you just have another breakthrough?”
Jack Clark nodded slowly, “Yes, just now I had a flash of insight, a minor breakthrough in my Cultivation Methods, while simultaneously strengthening my body.”
Gabriella and Jane Aiken exchanged a glance, he truly was a monster, achieving a breakthrough even during a meal.
Of course, the reality was that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, led by the Red Beast, had killed that Level 9 Early Stage Giant Beast and was reacting to feasting on its flesh and blood.
Only, based on the normal pace of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it should have slain that Level 9 Giant Beast that afternoon.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 663: 301: The Giant Turtle Roars to the Sky, Battle Demon God_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Chapter 301: The Giant Turtle Roars to the Sky, Battle Demon God_2
“`
But the Candle Dragon Giant Beast leading the way was a liability; while swimming through the sea, it tended to abruptly stop and zone out, as if its thoughts had suffered a system crash.
Even if the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gave it a swipe that sent it flying, it would need a moment to gather its wits again.
Facing this situation, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had pretty much abandoned the idea of “eating” the talents of the Red Beast during its fifth evolution.
It certainly didn’t want to develop dementia at the young age of “one.”
In fact, when this giant beast chose to join the Dragon Palace, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had no intention of eating it, or to put it more precisely, it never planned to absorb its talent.
Although the beast’s abilities were strong, its defects were substantial.
It could only use its Elemental Talent abilities during the day and its physical body strength at night. Though both were increased by more than a dozen folds, they were too one-dimensional.
Compared to the Candle Dragon’s talent, the potential for Gigantification—which could stack with other talent abilities—was much stronger.
……
In the morning, as darkness receded, Jack Clark, who had been cultivating in a seated position all night, slowly opened his eyes, the Sky Element Stone in his hand now turned to dust and scattered.
After a night of cultivation, the realness of the Combat Shadow had increased by +3%.
On the side, Jane Aiken was sitting cross-legged under a small tree at the edge of the hillside, still cultivating. Sharp Sword Intent swirled around her, her clothes and long black hair fluttering without wind.
In the distance down the hillside, Gabriella had already risen and stood atop the enormous arm of her Mecha, clad in blue worker’s clothes, busily hammering and tinkering.
Looking at the Black and White Mecha loaded with many heavy firepower modules, Jack Clark was somewhat puzzled, “Gabriella, is your Mecha not yet upgraded?”
The busy blonde girl stood up and shook her head, “It will take another two days. There are some matrix conflicts when combining the modules, which need to be adjusted.”
“I see,” Jack Clark said as he stood up.
Glancing at Jane Aiken, who was still cultivating, Jack Clark nodded to Gabriella and then, in a flash, transformed into a streak of golden light and charged toward the distant ruins.
Watching Jack Clark rush into the dim ruins, Gabriella felt worried, “The Killing Intent he’s emanating today is so intense. It looks like he’s going to go on another killing spree.”
Although Martial Arts were offensive powers, most cultivators used them as protective means, to cut down enemies or foes of the Human Race.
Jack Clark’s frenzied slaughtering of monsters was rare.
While it’s true that the greater the accumulation of Purple Killing Energy, the deeper one’s starting position on the Road to Godhood and one might even receive an Origin reward directly, the risks were substantial, too.
Therefore, after accumulating a substantial amount of Purple Kill Value, most people chose to explore the relics with caution and prudence.
In the ruins, nine hundred kilometers deep, as the halberd wrapped with golden radiance swept across, a Late Level 7 monster that lunged at supersonic speed was directly smashed to pieces by a single strike.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s eyes were blood-red, and the Blood Sea Purgatory Rune on his brow, resembling an eye, emitted a red glow, the surrounding Killing Intent growing heavier and heavier.
As Jack Clark immersed himself in the slaughter, his heart and actions as one, high-order monsters were obliterated one after another, the Blood Fiend converging, and the Prison Blood War Intent progressively moving toward grand accomplishment.
Meanwhile, on the leaderboard, Jack Clark’s name was followed by a Purple Kill Value that was increasing at a terrifying rate, watched by the king-level Marcellus Larry, who was used to it by now.
A Late Level 7 was worth 300 points, a Level 8 Early Stage worth 1000 points.
On the seventh day, because most of the monsters were Level 7 with a few Level 8 Early Stages, Jack Clark was even more efficient, tallying a kill count of just over two thousand.
In such a scenario, his Purple Kill Value shot up directly to three hundred and forty-three thousand, with almost a hundred and fifty thousand gained in one day’s time.
This fearsome increase left everyone numb.
When Jack Clark appeared on the small hill that evening, his blood-red eyes radiated a terrifying ferocity, causing palpitations in anyone who saw him.
The Black Purple Devil Gas swirling around him had not been retracted and intertwined with the seventy-meter-wide display of the Sea of Blood illusion, the Killing Intent whirling and sky-reaching.
The terrifying Killing Intent even startled Jane Aiken from her day of Closed-door Cultivation.
“Jack Clark, are you alright?” she asked.
Through the rolling Black Purple Devil Gas, Jack Clark’s deep voice emerged, “I’m fine. I’m just immersed in a state of slaughter, seeing if I can push my Battle Intent toward grand accomplishment.”
Jane Aiken and Gabriella exchanged a glance, then said no more.
As soon as day broke the next morning, the cloud of black-purple Killing Intent covering a hundred meters burst forth towards the distance, the billowing smoke a terrifying sight.
On the eighth day, Jack Clark’s killing range was confined to the seven hundred to six hundred kilometer range. He went rampant across the ruins of the earth, invincible without a match.
“Is that guy the reincarnation of a War Demon?”
Standing atop a segment of City Wall in ruins, the Human-shaped White Tiger Balderas, towering over twenty meters tall, gazed at the streak of golden light flashing by in the distance, utterly astonished.
Of course, what amazed him wasn’t Jack Clark’s move at supersonic speed, but the torrential Killing Intent emanating from him.
The dense black-purple Killing Intent blanketing over a hundred meters, with blood light soaring to the skies and so thick it blocked out sunlight, even faint phantom images seemed to emerge from within.
He would believe it if told that such a fearsome Killing Intent came from someone who had slaughtered tens of millions, an absolute War Demon.
Wariness flickered in Balderas’s eyes, “This monster from Eastern Summer, best not provoke him if you can avoid it. His bloodlust is just too terrifying.”
When the day passed, Jack Clark’s accumulated Purple Killing Energy had broken through five hundred thousand.
He was far ahead of the second-place Eddy Keller’s twenty-seven thousand and third-place Balderas’s twenty-five thousand, by ten or twenty times more.
Not to mention those ranked after a hundred with five or six thousand, or even one or two thousand points. None of them could compare to even a fraction of his.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 664: 301: The Giant Turtle Roars to the Sky, Battle Demon God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Chapter 301: The Giant Turtle Roars to the Sky, Battle Demon God_3
Such an exaggerated gap left even Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner, who were outside the ruins, at a loss for words. Then, with a slightly tight expression, Marcellus said, “There’s something off about his condition.”
Lori pondered, “His records show that when he swept through the Southern Battlefield before, he had comprehended a special Battle Intent imbued with Blood Fiend, and it seems he is trying to use it to make a breakthrough.”
“Battle Intents and Cultivation Methods of the Blood Fiend type generally mean that the more one kills, and the stronger the enemies one slays, the more powerful one becomes.”
Under the watchful eyes of two king-level individuals, Jack Clark continued to slaughter even more frenziedly in the following two days, and the range of the monsters he butchered gradually shrank back to an area of four to five hundred kilometers.
By this point, having ventured a thousand kilometers deep into the ruins, surrounded by oases, the polluted monsters on the surface had almost all been slaughtered by Jack Clark with astonishing efficiency.
However, the ruins were vast, so the polluted monsters that Jack Clark had killed only made up about half.
And as he circled around the ruins every day, covering tens of thousands of kilometers, nearly every genius from various countries entering the ruins had encountered him.
Whenever that happened, those genius cultivators who were at the early stages of Sixth Heaven or late stages of Fifth Layer Heaven would show a look of horror on their faces.
Because by that time, the Killing Intent accumulated on Jack Clark’s body had become too terrifying.
Boom!
Purple-red Killing Intent swirled about as the thirty-meter-long Golden War Halberd pierced through Heaven and Earth; upon striking, the Earth shattered, forming a massive crack over a hundred meters long.
In the violent explosion and the sharpness of the War Halberd’s skill, the head of a Polluted Giant Beast over fifty meters long instantly shattered, and countless bits of flesh and blood exploded, scattering over a range of a hundred meters.
Whoosh!
A dense black purple smoke gathered on the corpse of the Polluted Giant Beast, then transformed into a smoke serpent that surged towards Jack, passing through the palm of his hand before merging into the swirling Killing Intent that surrounded him.
At this moment, the black purple Killing Intent that was swirling around Jack’s body covered a range of 150 meters; it was so dense that it obscured the view and his silhouette was not visible.
Beyond that, the Blood Sea Hell, amplified by endless slaughter, had expanded to a range of a hundred meters. The hellish mirage had nearly turned from illusion to reality, vaguely possessing the might of a domain.
Under the coverage of the Blood Sea Hell, the air distorted, rivers of blood flowed, and monstrous beings and Giant Beasts struggled in the Sea of Blood, screaming in agony.
And at the center of the Sea of Blood, a Shadow of Combat stood tall on a mountain of corpses assembled from countless monster and Giant Beast bodies, towering thirty meters high, with three faces and six arms.
The dense Killing Intent formed red and black purple bands of light around the Shadow, so pervasive that even flames and thunder turned red.
Combined with the slowly spinning four rings of blood-colored light behind its head, the Combat Shadow, no, it should be called the War Demon Shadow, looked like a Hell Demon God.
Below the figure of the Demon God, Jack’s eyes were blood-red, filled with a terrifying malevolent killing aura.
These past few days, he had been engulfed by the Prison Blood War Intent. As he killed more and more monsters and the gathering Killing Intent became increasingly formidable, his consciousness also became crazed and bloodthirsty.
Under such conditions, if it wasn’t for the synchronized consciousness with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon maintaining a sliver of clarity, he might have completely fallen into the path of a slaughter daemon.
This was the price to be paid for wanting to quickly bridge the gap from the initial accomplishment to the grand accomplishment of Slaughter War Intent—one must embrace madness to grasp understanding, to make a breakthrough.
Barely maintaining a sliver of clarity, Jack looked at the transparent page before him.
Talent: Void Double Pupils +15624
After several days of frenzied slaughter, the increase to the Void Double Pupils had reached a fifteen-fold gain, with fifteen rings of rune-enshrouded chains forming at the edge of the Black Gold vertical pupils.
Jack’s voice was deep as he said, “It’s still a bit short.”

chapters.title: Chapter 665: 302: The Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Heavily Injured
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: Chapter 302: The Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Heavily Injured
Thirst for Killing
In battle, when slaughtering enemies, one can temporarily enhance their Battle Intent by absorbing the invisible Blood Fiend. The more lives they take, the stronger they become, and the more Blood Fiend they absorb, the greater the augmentation to their Battle Intent.
This was a special ability of the Prison Blood War Intent that Jack Clark had initially condensed.
This Battle Intent could stack infinitely but was temporary; once the Battle Intent subsided, the invisible aura of Killing Intent that had accumulated would dissipate.
Therefore, over the past few days, Jack Clark remained in an activated state of Battle Intent, amassing the strength of endless Blood Fiend and increasing the amplification from the base of two-fold to a terrifying thirty-one-fold.
As for the surrounding Blood Sea Hell illusory domain, it came from the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd Limit Enhancement obtained rune ‘Blood Sea Refining Hell’.
Likewise belonging to the Slaughter-Class, it could absorb and consolidate Blood Fiend to become stronger and stack with the Prison Blood War Intent.
Besides, these past few days, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had also been frantically hunting the Mutant Beasts of the North Ice Sea Area, growing rapidly. In just a few days, its body length had surged to one hundred and ninety meters.
As a result, Jack Clark’s four basic attributes all increased by more than one thousand five hundred points, with strength breaking through to the astonishing mark of more than six thousand five hundred.
At this moment, Jack Clark had reached a peak state in all aspects, vaguely touching the threshold of War Intent Completion.
But, like when he first condensed the Prison Blood War Intent, he always felt that he was one step away from opening that door.
And this one step was crucial; once the encircling Blood Fiend dissipated, who knew when he could next gather a Sea of Blood-like aura of Killing Intent.
With this thought, the Earth within a ten-meter radius under Jack Clark’s feet shattered, and he burst toward the deep recesses of the ruins.
He needed an evenly matched, life-or-death extreme battle to elevate his Spirit Qi to its peak and break free from his shackles.
Of course, his target wasn’t Level 9 polluted monsters; that was a boundary beyond the reach of someone with Seventh Layer Heaven cultivation.
His aim was to face a Peak Eight Layer Void Creature, and for this battle, he would not use the Void Double Pupils or the Thunderbolt Law Fragments but was ready to unleash the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form.
The twenty-fourfold True Strength enhancement of the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form combined with the current thirty-onefold amplification of the Power of Heaven and Earth from the Prison Blood War Intent, would allow him to go all-out even against a Peak Level 8 Void Creature.
However, the Heavenly Energy in the deep recesses of the ruins was sparse; the fifty-five times amplification of the Power of Heaven and Earth might only reach twenty or thirty times, but that would be sufficient.
“What does he want to do?”
Outside the relic, Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner watched the golden light, which had swiftly penetrated more than a thousand kilometers into the ruins at Supersonic Speed, their expressions growing grave.
“He has been accumulating Blood Fiend for the past few days. He might be seeking to make a limit breakthrough. Pay attention, if there’s any danger, don’t hesitate to act immediately and pull him out.”
“This young man cannot have an accident.”
“Don’t worry, I understand.”
“However, as long as he doesn’t seek out those Level 9 contaminated creatures lurking at the edges, with his current strength, he should be able to escape unscathed even from a Peak Level 8 encounter.”
As the two wore grave expressions,
On the vast screen of the Eye of Heaven Observation, behind Jack Clark, a War Demon Shadow wielding a halberd swept up the Heavenly Energy to form a purple-red Battle Halberd over a hundred meters long.
With one strike from the Seal that had created an illusory Sea of Blood and Hell, it directly exploded an early Stage Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast, its shockwaves shattering the Earth, demonstrating Overbearing power.
Surrounded by rolling Killing Intent, Jack Clark, who had charged more than 1400 kilometers deep, suddenly halted. His blood-red demonic eyes focused on something ahead, showing traces of astonishment.
On the dim, dead land ahead, there appeared a forest resembling peach blossoms, the trees’ “petals” in full bloom, creating vast seas of flowers.
At the center of the flower sea, a small hill of several dozen meters in height rose from the ground, and atop it stood a palace built of white stone, similar to a Western Medieval style, standing tall.
Before the palace steps, a four-meter-tall figure clad in a white, luxuriant robe stood with hands behind its back, enjoying the splendid sight of the seas of flowers.
This ‘Person’s’ form resembled a human, with red scales covering the face, eyes both white in sclera and pupil looking like those of a serpent, and an additional pair of eyes shut above the brows.
Besides that, a tail similar to that of a lizard swayed slightly behind it, informing Jack Clark of its alien race identity.
Whoosh!
As Jack Clark approached, the purple-black aura of Death caused the surrounding blooming petals to wither one by one, and the trees to decay, creating a Death passage two hundred meters wide.
When Jack Clark arrived at the base of the hill, stirred by his aura, the alien in the white robe turned slightly, his eyes meeting Jack’s, as if peering through vast Space-Time.
Then slowly, a voice filled with alien Spirit Qi began to speak.
“At the third mark of every star cycle year, my homeland would be covered with red velvet flowers, an endless sea of flowers, stunning and mesmerizing.”
“Sadly, before the vengeance army comprised of the Nine Tribes Elites set out, my homeland was destroyed by your Monarch. Never again will I see the sight of red velvet flowers in full bloom.”
“Damn the Human Race, how dare you cause the Great Calamity in the Void, stranding us here forever. All humans must die, you doom your own kind and drag us down with you…”
“I long to return, to see the red velvet flowers once more. I had promised it that after this war ended, I would return to get married…”
“Hahaha… kill, kill all humans, all humans must die.”
“Home, I can never return.”
“Not good, be careful, it’s the Void, they have triggered the Great Calamity, we can’t escape, no, it’s still waiting for me at home; I can’t die…”
Watching the alien on the hillside switching between nostalgia and ferocity as if with a split Psyche, Jack Clark forcibly suppressed the urge within him to destroy, listening quietly to the alien’s monologue.

chapters.title: Chapter 666: 302: The Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Heavily Injured_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Chapter 302: The Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Heavily Injured_2
Meanwhile, within the depths of Jack Clark’s blood-red eyes, a pair of black gold vertical pupils emerged.
In the eyes of the creature with the Void Double Pupils, there was neither a boundless flower sea nor any extravagant architecture of different races.
The land ahead was still dry and lifeless, and on the hillside, there were only ruins of a building and a ferocious figure standing among them, clad in black armor.
Everything in sight was merely the stubborn obsession left by a dying foreign monster, whose intense obsession even manifested into the phantom of a flower sea around it.
From this, one could imagine how powerful it must have been before death.
The Void Great Calamity, the elite of Nine Tribes, the destroyed homeland (world)—looking at the incoherent obsession shadow, Jack Clark pondered thoughtfully.
This must be part of the truth behind the Ancient Civilization.
When top-tier experts of the Ancient Human Race went on expeditions, destroying other racial civilizations’ worlds, they too were met with elite sneak attacks as revenge, targeting the Human Race’s rear.
In the absence of their strongest warriors, the residual strength of the Ancient Civilization failed to defend against the so-called Void Great Calamity which destroyed everything, leading to mutual annihilation with their enemies.
However, the Human Race still managed to preserve a seed of their kind, which later on propagated anew, forming the various countries and federations that exist today.
Between ancient and modern civilizations, there is a historical gap in records, with missing civilizations and lost inheritances.
It wasn’t until the emergence of the Modern Mythical World and the descent of Void Relics that it was revealed an Ancient Civilization existed tens of thousands of years ago.
Or perhaps the break was not complete—for instance, certain ancient myths and forgotten deities who traversed heavens and earth might have some connection to the Ancient Civilization.
Due to the lack of Heavenly Energy, those cultivators in ancient times who had received some form of ‘Inheritance’ were unable to break through the limits of life.
And as for those initial Human Experts who embarked on an expedition, whether they all perished in battle or were lost in unknown space-time, they never returned.
Of course, these were Jack Clark’s guesses based on the information available to him.
Besides repeatedly murmuring those words, that obsession did not have much useful information left. Reflecting on this, Jack Clark’s Killing Intent burst forth completely.
Boom!
An endless blood light erupted, creating a raging wind from the impact, and under the terrifying illumination of the blood light, the surrounding Flower Sea Phantom and the figure yearning to return home collapsed.
As the obsession dissipated, on the hillside, the Void Creature that had stood there for untold years slowly opened its eyes, which were white and filled with boundless savagery.
Boom!
The infinite Black Power burst forth, accompanied by the powerful aura of an Eighth Layer Peak expert. In an instant, this World shook, and the atmosphere exploded.
The terrifying pressure soared into the sky, scattering the thick black clouds above thousands of meters and forming a circular hollow more than a thousand meters in diameter.
Behind the massive circular hollow lay the boundless Dark Void—inscrutable, pitch-black, like an Abyss ready to Devour everything, instinctively striking fear into one’s heart.
Crackle Crackle!! The foreign monster slowly moved a few times and then reached out to grab the six-meter-long rusted Black War Sword lodged in the ground next to it.
Very strong! Jack Clark’s blood-red eyes revealed an intense desire for destruction.
“Human, die!”
With a savage roar, the foreign monster’s battle sword swung down, unleashing a hundred-meter-long Black Sword Light that tore Heaven and Earth apart, appearing instantaneously above Jack Clark’s head at a deceptively slow but fast speed.
Before the terrifying sword light even struck, the high altitude was invisibly torn apart, creating a longitudinal black void of several hundred meters, looking from afar like a massive sword looming over Heaven and Earth.
At the moment the sword struck down, the Sea of Blood Hell swirling around Jack Clark receded, merging into the War Halberd in the hands of the Combat Shadow, instantly attracting the Heavenly Energy within a kilometer radius.
Boom!
The Blood Colored Battle Spear, spanning more than 150 meters and sealing away a phantasmal Hellish World, soared into the sky amid sweeping blood-colored light and purple radiance, with a magnificent aura.
In the blink of an eye, the sword light and battle halberd collided, but the Black Sword Light shattered the halberd in just an instant, followed by an explosion of bright golden blood-colored light.
Boom!
Under the terrible explosion of the True Dragon Power, Heaven and Earth shook, Black Sword Light crumbled, but the residual Sword Shadow still carved a crack more than 300 meters long on Earth.
The shattered Earth kicked up billowing smoke and dust, countless dirt and rocks flew in all directions, including Jack Clark, who with a bang was hurled out, smacking into a hillside thousands of meters away at a speed surpassing sound.
In an instant, the small hill collapsed.
Facing a Top Strong man who had already begun to unify all his strength, even with the Combat Shadow’s fourteenfold boost and the Prison Blood War Intent’s thirty-one-fold limit enhancement, Jack Clark could not withstand a single move.
Although the multiple boosts had allowed his combat power to barely reach the Late Eighth Layer phase,
of course, it was also related to the extremely sparse Heavenly Energy in this area; gathering Heavenly Energy from a kilometer around him resulted in only about a twentyfold increase.
Otherwise, with his current extreme combat power, he would have been able to contend somewhat.
Just as Jack Clark hit the collapsing small hill, the foreign monster took a step out, appearing with terrifying speed above the small hill, and the battle sword descended once again.
Instantaneously, a hundred-meter-long Black Sword Light tore through Heaven and Earth, leaving a half-moon-shaped black trail in the air as it struck the collapsing small hill.
Boom! With the fearsome sword light, the small hill crumbled, Earth shattered, and the raging force combined with the Destructive Sword Qi to unleash a Destructive Shockwave, sweeping a radius of a thousand meters.
For a time, the Earth trembled, and the raining debris resounded like cannonballs exploding, shaking the World.
Although this creature had been corrupted, its powerful battle instincts still persisted, leaving no room for a straightforward exchange of blows.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: 302: The Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Suffers Heavy Injury_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Chapter 302: The Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Suffers Heavy Injury_3
Whoosh! Amidst billowing smoke and dust, a streak of golden light smashed through the air, soaring at five times the speed of sound, and in the blink of an eye, it appeared several kilometers away—it was unmistakably Jack Clark.
However, he was in a rather sorry state at the moment.
His Golden Red Battle Armor was diagonally slashed open from the middle, revealing an appalling wound underneath that was 0.5 meters long from which one could see his ribs and even his organs.
Amid the parted flesh and blood on both sides, Black Sword Qi was pervasive, and the dark, crazed will it contained prevented the wound from healing, causing continuous damage.
This could be said to be the first time Jack had sustained such a severe injury since he started his cultivation.
This was precisely why he had refrained from entering dangerous zones before. After reaching the high-order levels, a slight difference in level meant the difference between heaven and earth for cultivators.
Especially when it came to peak-level monsters of the same rank.
Even though Jack’s strength was terrifying with the various enhancements, his Seventh Layer mid-period normal battle strength was comparable to an Eighth Layer mid-period, but that was just with a burst of strength, other aspects including defense were still at the Seventh Layer.
That was also why, when facing a peak Eighth Layer polluted monster at this moment, the opponent was able to seriously injure him with just two sword strikes—his defense simply couldn’t hold up.
Yet, facing such a serious injury, Jack had an intense excitement on his face, not even using the True Dragon Power to expel the dark Sword Qi and heal the wounds.
Prison Blood War Intent trait, Death Invincibility.
When one is injured in battle or when Qi Blood drops significantly, Invincible Intent is activated. The greater the injury and the more Qi Blood is depleted, the stronger the boost to Battle Intent.
Boom! As a will brimming with invincible belief erupted from Jack’s body, his armor rapidly expanded and overlaid with the War Demon Shadow behind him.
In an instant, the earth collapsed, and a roaring violent wind wave surged. A towering figure of 80 meters with three faces and six arms, enveloped in blood-colored flames and wrapped in thunder, appeared.
Four halos of blood-red Radiance spun behind his head, surrounded by the rolling purple-black fog, like an ancient Demon God exuding a fearsome presence no less than that of the foreign monster.
Thirty times the strength, Defense, Golden Flame, Thunder, and the ultimate boost of Battle Intent, augmented by the two passive skills and the Blood Prison domain, Jack had reached a level comparable to the Eight Layer Peak.
This scene, observed by Marcus Larry and Lori Joyner from outside the Void, came as somewhat of a surprise to both of them.
Seeing Jack severely injured and about to take action, Lori Joyner exclaimed in dismay, “What kind of ability is this Gigantification form? It’s actually boosted his aura to the Eighth Layer Peak in an instant.”
Marcellus Larry reflected thoughtfully, “It should be his Divine Rune Transformation ability, only after the breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, it has been transferred to the true martial arts phantom, using the specially refined battle armor as a carrier.”
“And his body has now become the energy core of the Gigantification form, the Heavenly Energy within him appears to be burning, serving as Kinetic Energy. Such a peculiar use of runes.”
With the insight of both their eyes, they quickly penetrated the changes in Jack’s battle form.
Of course, they only discerned the method of application of this move. The core rune talent and structure remained inscrutable unless Jack allowed them to study it.
Deep within the Ruins, as Jack entered the Fighting Demon Dragon Form, sensing the formidable pressure emanating from him, the solemnity of the foreign monster intensified.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Even more formidable strength erupted from the foreign monster, with a sky full of black radiance converging, forming hundreds of sword Qi, each tens of meters long, swirling around it.
Immediately following a slash from the foreign monster, the sword Qi rapidly expanded and turned into hundreds of meters of black sword light that blanketed the sky and shot explosively towards Jack.
Boom!
The War Halberd in the hands of the Fighting Demon Dragon, which sealed a part of the Blood Sea Hell, swelled massively, transforming into a 300-meter-long Purple-red weapon, and swept across the Eight Wastes.
Centered around the Fighting Demon Dragon, a 300-meter-tall ring-shaped purple-black light screen burst forth and expanded rapidly. Everything it passed was shattered, including scraping off ten meters from the ground.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
The ring-shaped light screen collided with the black sword Qi, resulting in a violent explosion. When the shattering light screen expanded to its 500-meter limit, it exploded thunderously.
In an instant, Heaven and Earth shook, and the land sank.
In the midst of the terrifying explosion, nine 200-meter-long Purple-red War Halberds shot out, like nine devastating Demon Dragons, spiraling and creating a raging wind wave as they appeared before the foreign monster.
At this moment, black sword Qi, each a hundred meters long, erupted centered around the polluted monster, blooming like a black lotus.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
The nine Purple-red War Halberds crashed into the black sword lotus, immediately exploding, and a dazzling purple-red mushroom cloud rose slowly from the Earth.
The intense explosion shattered the ground for hundreds of meters, and the invisible impact created by the explosion formed an increasingly expanding transparent air wall, blasting more than a thousand meters outwards.
Whoosh! Just then, two spots within the smoke and dust stirred up by the explosion suddenly cleared, with Purple Killing Energy raging around the Fighting Demon Dragon as he shattered the ground and burst forth.
In the distance, the foreign monster transformed into a streak of black pirefining, appearing before Jack at six times Supersonic Speed, splitting into eight and surrounding him from all directions.
Eight black sword Qi tore through the atmosphere, penetrating the Earth and vanishing around the Fighting Demon Dragon. Then, Jack felt an oppressive volcanic force erupting beneath his feet.
Boom! In an instant, the ground within hundreds of meters crumbled, countless black sword Qi soared into the sky, forming an even larger black sword lotus amidst the billowing smoke and dust.
Whoosh! Suddenly, under the pressure of an invisible, mighty force, the rolling dust dispersed, revealing a 300-meter-wide crater and the unscathed Fighting Demon Dragon at the bottom.
With the Defense Core Rune of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon invoked for Thirty Times Defense, nearly no ‘Person’ at the same level could break the Fighting Demon Dragon’s defense.

chapters.title: Chapter 668: 302 Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Suffers Heavy Injury_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Chapter 302 Void Great Calamity, Jack Clark Suffers Heavy Injury_4
Unless the opponent possessed strength from a major realm above.
“Roar! Human, die.” The foreign monster in the distance let out a savage roar, infinite strength burst forth from its body, splitting into three and transforming into three black sword dragons that shot towards him.
“Scram!”
In a fierce low growl, the Fighting Demon Dragon swept its Thunderflame-wrapped War Halberd horizontally, the powerful force directly shattered the three black sword dragons, and with one strike sent the foreign monster flying.
At the same time, its two arms behind it grasped Thunder, unleashing a series of half-meter thick blue-red lightning bolts, but they were slashed to pieces by the black Sword Qi surrounding the foreign monster.
The remaining two arms then once again gathered the golden-red blood flame power, forming ten blood-colored suns around the halo, readying for the final strike.
Boom!
The blasted foreign monster hit the ground and instantly turned into a hundred-meter-long black Sword Light that soared upward, dodging the bombardment of blood thunder and cleaving through the Earth towards the Fighting Demon Dragon.
Boom! Black Sword Qi collided with the purple-red War Halberd, and once again, hundreds of meters of land collapsed.
Under the unparalleled power, the Sword Qi shattered, and the foreign monster was once again sent flying by Jack Clark with one strike, turning into a black radiance and smashing into a mountain peak thousands of meters away.
Half of the mountain peak collapsed.
At that moment, a three-hundred-meter-long, world-shattering purple-red War Halberd penetrated Heaven and Earth, falling at speeds multiple times faster than sound.
Boom!
Within the sealed Illusory World of a sea of blood, the equivalent of the Peak of the Eight Layer’s strength, compressed and released in an instant, the entire mountain collapsed, endless dirt and rocks were thrown into the sky, forming concentric Destructive Shockwaves that shook the Earth.
This was the terrifying destructive power of the Peak of the eighth level.
Compared to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s underwater battle with the Giant Beast, without the resistance of sea water, the power exhibited on the surface was even more exaggerated.
Whoosh! Amidst the smoke and dust of destruction, a black Sword Light shot up into the sky, appearing at a high altitude of a thousand meters.
Below on the ground, at the edge of the collapsed mountain peak, a meteor-like crater hundreds of meters in diameter, the surrounding Earth cracked as if it were a shattered world.
The foreign monster that had taken the hit directly wasn’t faring well either, its battle armor shattered, but its aura grew even more crazed and brutal, turning into a black Sword Light as it charged at Jack Clark again.
Boom, boom, boom!
An earth-shattering battle erupted deep within the ruins.
The contaminated foreign monster, not fearing death and devoid of pain, driven only by the brutal instinct of destruction and the obsession to exterminate humans, attacked the Fighting Demon Dragon with frenzy.
And Jack Clark, still bleeding, was equally insane. As the blood flowed from his chest, the amplified Battle Intent from his Death Invincibility made his fighting strength grow even stronger, even gradually overpowering the opponent.
Under the blazing Heavenly Energy, his aura grew fiercer with each moment, repeatedly sending the polluted monster flying.
As for the wounds inflicted by the opponent’s Sword Light, they were outright ignored. As long as they couldn’t breach the Fighting Demon Dragon’s defense, the Giant State couldn’t be broken.
As the battle continued, the land was almost completely leveled, mountains collapsed, canyons were filled, followed by the emergence of new cracks and deep gorges.
Every collision and resulting shockwave compressed the air, creating tangible waves that whipped up typhoons of more than 10 categories sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
But as time passed, the compressed burning Heavenly Energy within the Fighting Demon Dragon’s body also slowly dwindled, until at last… Roar!
With a roar, in the face of the descending black Sword Qi, the Fighting Demon Dragon did not flinch or dodge but reached out with thunder-wrapped arms to grab the foreign monster.
Boom!
Under the foreign monster’s full-force strike, the defense atop the Fighting Demon Dragon’s head shattered along with the Sword Qi, and the internal Black War Sword plunged directly onto the helmet.
Thud! Under the close-range strike of a Peak of the Eight Layer sword, the Fighting Demon Dragon’s head exploded, pieces of the Gigantified helmet flying apart.
Seizing the moment the contaminated monster hesitated, the thunder-wrapped palms exploded with a roar and captured it in one motion, the powerful impact of their clapping shattered space into cracks.
Boom! The immense power in the palms burst forth, a series of black Sword Qi tore through the Fighting Demon Dragon’s palms.
Just as the contaminated monster was about to break out of the palms, the ten Blood-coloured Giant Suns that had been gathering behind the Fighting Demon Dragon plummeted down, crashing onto the hands with the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Boom! A massive, shining golden-red sun rose from the ground, with the force of a nuclear explosion the Earth shattered, dirt and rocks instantly melted into hot magma, and the forceful impact catapulted them thousands of meters high in all directions.
The shockwave squeezed the air, forming dense, concentric white waves that spread for thousands of meters, a horrifying sight to behold.

chapters.title: Chapter 669: 303 Demon God Battle Body, The Path of the Gods Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Chapter 303 Demon God Battle Body, The Path of the Gods Descends
Under the Ten Days Solar Burst, amplified by dozens of times the Heavenly Energy, the destructive power released in an instant had exceeded the limit of the Eight Layer Heaven, destroying everything.
When the explosion subsided, there appeared a huge meteor crater with a diameter of 300 meters on the Earth, more powerful than the one that obliterated the Thunder Battle Puppet a few days ago.
Centered on the crater, the surface within a range of hundreds of meters was scraped away by several meters, all the soil and stones turned into black magma radiating outward under the high temperature.
Standing at the bottom of the pit, where high temperatures had melted it into a crystalline state, was Jack Clark, leaning on his halberd, his blood-red eyes filled with madness and a desire for destruction and slaughter.
Despite his heavy injury, the undefeatable war intent emanating from his body was almost tangible, swirling around him, shaking the Void.
At this moment, Jack looked somewhat disheveled. His golden red battle armor had long been shattered, his clothes torn, leaving only half a pair of trousers, revealing large patches of charred skin.
The wound across his chest in particular, slanting down half a meter and nearly revealing his internal organs, was especially ghastly to behold.
Even Jack had not anticipated being so severely wounded this time.
However, these wounds were now healing at a speed visible to the naked eye; the charred layer was falling off, including the wound on his chest, which was rapidly regenerating flesh and blood.
Soon, new skin and flesh had grown over all of Jack’s wounds, his recovery ability was astonishing.
With his physique breakthrough to six thousand points, Jack’s flesh contained various resistances, endurance, and recovery that had become extraordinarily fearsome.
It was only because of his cautious nature that the enemies and dangers he had encountered in the past were within his ability to cope with, and his recovery power had never fully manifested.
This was also the reason he had previously removed the Regeneration Talent from his Combat Divine Body—his own vitality was on par with the Regeneration Talent; there was no need to redundantly increase the burden on his battle body.
With a breath, as his external injuries healed, Jack slowly exhaled, his blood-red eyes looking forward.
A hundred meters ahead, the foreign monster now consisted of nothing but a scorched skeleton, still standing tall, exuding a strong oppressive aura.
This foreign monster was very strong.
With only a trace of its combat instincts remaining, it had the strength of the peak of the Eight Layer Heaven. If it had not been eroded by pollution, its power would have definitely been able to fight in the Ninth Heavens.
Such strength made it one of the few elite strong men within its race—no wonder it could join the expeditionary revenge army.
Facing this level of monster, Jack’s successful kill was somewhat fortuitous.
In the last moment when the energy of the Fighting Demon Dragon Body was exhausted, relying on the ‘Undying’ quality of the Fighting Demon Dragon, he resorted to a do-or-die method, blowing up both parties to smithereens.
Otherwise, he would have had to activate a Thunderbolt Law Fragment or use the Void Double Pupils.
After all, he was trying to achieve a grand accomplishment in Battle Intent, not to die. If it came to the worst, he would simply forego this opportunity.
Even without the grand accomplishment in Battle Intent, his cultivation was still formidable, invincible at his level.
However, this battle overall did meet his expectations. Through a life-and-death fight with this peak monster, his Spirit Qi was sublimated, and he had touched upon the great achievement in Battle Intent.
From entering the Ruins Continent to now, after slaughtering more than ten thousand senior high-order polluted monsters, and finally a desperate battle, he had reached the grand accomplishment in Battle Intent.
In comparison to Jane Aiken, who only needed to meditate and enlighten for a month to cultivate the Four Great Sword Intentions to grand accomplishment, Jack seemed somewhat ‘wasteful’.
But the fact is, people who can enter the realm of thought for enlightenment at any time exist only in her case.
Such a terrifying talent for enlightenment, even Jack felt a bit envious.
A furious roar suddenly came from the sky!
Raging winds howled, the black clouds dispersed, and a Level 8 Mid-Term Polluted Giant Beast, with a body length of over ninety meters and a wingspan of one hundred and fifty meters, appeared in the sky.
This Polluted Giant Beast resembled a black eagle, with vicious bone spurs growing between feathers as hard as fine iron. Just appearing in the sky, countless bone spurs on its body lit up with black radiance.
Courting death.
Jack suddenly looked up from below; within his blood-red eyes, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils emerged, surrounded by fifteen layers of Void runes forming a chain of light rings.
The gaze of the Black Gold vertical pupils was cold, like a devouring Void, and the space around the Eighth Level Beast that was gazed upon by these eyes suddenly solidified.
Boom!
With a fifteen-fold amplification, consuming fifty percent of Void Energy in one strike, the space around the Polluted Giant Beast shattered as if it were glass.
The large-scale collapse of space sent out long, narrow black cracks that spread all around, faintly forming the shape of a giant Void eyeball in the sky.
Inside the Void eyeball, the Eighth Level Polluted Giant Beast was torn into countless pieces by the Space Cracks, mixed with copious foul-smelling black blood, thudding as it rained down to the ground.
On those chunks of monster flesh and blood, several meters in size, purple-black fog gathered, surging massively towards Jack, merging into the Purple Killing Energy roiling around him.
After instantly killing that Level 8 Polluted Giant Beast, Jack’s attention returned to his imminent breakthrough in Battle Intent.
As the slaughter, brutality, and destructive desire in Jack’s heart collapsed, his realm of thought transformed into a vortex, devouring the massive amount of Blood Fiend converging around him.
As the Prison Blood War Intent broke through, the rolling purple-black Killing Intent and the hellish visions surrounding Jack also began to merge slowly.
As he absorbed Purple Killing Energy nearly equal to the Qi Blood of tens of millions of people, a red light flickered at Jack’s brow, and the Blood Sea Purgatory Rune began to self-evolve and upgrade.
Just as Jack was making his breakthrough, above the center of the Ruins Continent sky, attracted by some force, a white ribbon spanning tens of kilometers slowly emerged.
“Indeed, under the crazy slaughter of this young man, the Road to Becoming a God has appeared several days earlier than expected,” Marcellus Larry said somewhat emotionally.

chapters.title: Chapter 670: 303: Demon God Battle Body, The Path of the Gods Descends_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Chapter 303: Demon God Battle Body, The Path of the Gods Descends_2
It’s hard to say whether it was a bargain or a loss.
With the Path to Becoming a God appearing ahead of schedule, everyone had less time to explore the relics, and many lost the chance to obtain the opportunities or inheritances they otherwise could have.
But at the same time, because of Jack Clark’s slaughter, the danger level of the ruins within a 1,000-kilometer radius of the Oasis greatly decreased.
After noticing this situation, many went deeper into the ruins in search of relics, and, with fewer monsters, most had some gains to various degrees.
At this moment, Lori Joyner slowly said, “I didn’t expect this little guy to have such powerful pupil abilities, it seems that the Dark Prison Clan creature died under this move back then.”
“Normal, compared to those geniuses in the conventional sense, these monstrous geniuses with fortunate coincidences, all have some extra powerful trump cards.”
As he spoke, Marcellus Larry placed his finger on the Eye of Heaven Observation, and immediately the Sub-eye on everyone’s wrist lit up.
“Attention everyone, the total Purple Kill Value has now met the requirements, the Path to Godhood has been triggered and is expected to descend completely by tomorrow morning.”
“The entry point is at Sky Inspection Mount in the center of the Oasis, at that time anyone with a Purple Kill Value of 1,000 points can step onto the Divine Road and enter the Origin Space.”
Following Marcellus Larry’s reminder, faces all around showed a mix of excitement, agitation, and astonishment.
The excitement came from the long wait finally paying off, with the path that could grant a great amount of Origin now appearing, while some were astonished by the mention of a cumulative Purple Kill Value.
Total value? It’s probably that monster that accounts for most of it.
In the ruins, Betty Leinster stood atop a collapsed building, holding a blue-violet feather in her hand, relieved, “Thank goodness, this time I finally gained something.”
Balderas, who had transformed into a white tiger giant, stood in front of a Polluted Giant Beast corpse with some regret, “Over fifty thousand Purple Killing Energy points, I wonder how many Origins I can get.”
While everyone in the ruins was calculating whether they could obtain Origin on the Road to Godhood or how many Origins they might get,
Inside the Oasis, in the stone palace, Crystal Lewis, surrounded by red flames dancing on her body; Mandy Lewis, surrounded by a halo of blue radiance; and Justin Welan, meditating on the head of a huge statue, and others.
At this moment, everyone’s gaze pierced through infinite distances to see that ‘path’ in the sky.
Hundreds of meters deep into underground cracks, with muscles cracked all over his body and heavily injured,Howard Lambert leaned against a rock, somewhat weak, “So it has finally appeared, the Path to Becoming a God.”
He had just fought to the death with a Pollution Beast in the Late Level 6, and when he finally killed the beast, he was slapped away by a claw and fell into this several hundred meters deep underground fissure.
And this was precisely what he wanted, for only by reaching the limits of near death could he break through his genetic shackles time and again.
However, today he was a bit smarter. After discovering the formidable Pollution Beast, he cleared several polluted monsters within a ten-kilometer range in advance.
There would be no repeat of being heavily injured and dying, only for another creature to pick up his kill.
After recovering a bit, Howard Lambert looked towards the dark area ahead, with a hint of excitement in his eyes.
In the darkness ahead, a 3-meter-high bronze statue with a ferocious appearance stood tall. Like a demon, its horned head was emitting a strange red light.
Those red lights originated from the blood sprayed from Howard Lambert’s wounds as he rolled down.
Now, as the statue absorbed his blood, its eyes gradually reddened, emanating an aura of madness and destruction, like an ancient demon god.
After fighting and searching for so long among the ruins and relics, he, Howard Lambert, finally had a discovery to show for it.
…
Below the meteorite crater, the writhing, rolling purple and black Killing Intent gradually vanished, leaving only a 150-meter radius of dark red Doomsday Hell.
Dark clouds churned in the sky above Hell, while the Sea of Blood roared below, with countless Void Creatures and Polluted Giant Beasts struggling and wailing in it—the scene was terrifying.
At the center, Jack Clark stood on a mountain of corpses, made from countless bodies, with the red light shining on his brow, holding a halberd, behind him a 20-meter-tall blood phantom emerged.
That blood phantom was the materialization of the War Intent upon reaching grand accomplishment, the “Demon Shadow” formed from the endless slaughter, cruelty, and destructive desires in Jack Clark’s heart.
As the shadow of the Demon God appeared, the entire Doomsday Hell roared and shuddered, celebrating its descent.
Whoosh! At that moment, with just a thought from Jack Clark, the Doomsday Hell around him began to converge towards his brow, and the shadow of the Demon God behind him slowly vanished.
At the same time, the blood color in Jack’s eyes gradually faded, returning to clarity. His distinct black and white eyes now shone like stars, as profound and mysterious as an untainted starry sky.
Feeling the changes in Battle Intent, Jack’s gaze swept over the transparent page at the bottom of his eye, coming to rest on the Prison Blood War Intent and the changing runes below.
Prison Blood War Intent [Grand Accomplishment: A Special War Intent Power that bathes in blood, manifesting the Demon God.
When activating Battle Intent, a shadow of the Demon God formed from slaughter and destruction is condensed, drawing in the Power of Heaven and Earth, and all attacks’ destructive power is increased by five times.
Thirst for Killing: When slaying enemies in battle, the shadow of the Demon God will absorb Blood Fiend permanently enhancing its might. The more lives slain, the stronger the shadow becomes.
Death Invincibility: When heavily injured in battle causing a significant drop in Qi Blood, Invincible Intent is activated. The more severe the injury and the greater the Qi Blood loss, the stronger the Battle Intent becomes.
Demon God’s Possession: The shadow of the Demon God, materialized by Will, gathers the Power of Heaven and Earth to merge and enter a state of Demonization, temporarily increasing combat strength and causing an explosive burst.
Note: When the shadow of the Demon God merges with the true martial arts phantom, it will create a cumulative enhancement, evolving into the Demon God Battle Body, significantly strengthening all aspects.]
Rune: Doomsday Purgatory [Covers a 150-meter radius Hell Domain; when deployed, it disturbs reality, causing mental oppression and Void erosion to enemies.
Demon God’s Descent: When the Demon God Battle Body enters the domain, it receives the amplification of the Power of Hell; each strike carries the power of a phantom hell’s impact.]
This breakthrough has increased the base augmentation of the fully accomplished Battle Intent to the Power of Heaven and Earth to five times, which is a standard increase within grand accomplishment Intent.
Following that, the passive ability, Thirst for Killing’s absorption of Blood Fiend has been upgraded from temporary to permanent enhancement of the shadow of the Demon God. The more lives killed, the stronger the increase in Battle Intent.
This ability has Jack quite excited.
Besides, the Battle Intent has now acquired a new ability, Demon God’s Possession, which is similar to the Demon King Ciautorus’s possession of the Demon King’s phantom.
When gathering a vast amount of Heavenly Energy into his body, Jack in a state of Demonization will experience a surge in physical ability, but this also places a considerable strain on his body.
However, he can choose to merge the shadow of the Demon God with the true martial arts phantom, although the amplification may not be as strong as in a state of Demonization.
Otherwise, the note on the attribute page wouldn’t rank Demonization first and the Demon God Battle Body second.
In addition, under the influence of Battle Intent, Blood Sea Purgatory has also evolved by merging with the purple-black Killing Intent, advancing to become the Doomsday Domain.
Although it’s because it’s a phantom domain and not very oppressive to enemies, it has allowed Jack to touch the power of the domain before reaching the Ninth Heavens.
This type of domain is different from the Destruction Domain formed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Heaven Burning Golden Flame, and Annihilation True Thunder; it belongs to a special domain and seems to communicate with the real Hell Plane.
Overall, this fight for survival yielded significant rewards for Jack.
“So the Road to Becoming a God will fully arrive tomorrow,” Jack said, looking at the sky. There were probably two or three hours left before dark. It should just be enough time.
Boom! After a short rest to regain strength, Jack burst out of the meteorite crater and sped toward the distance.
After the Road to Becoming a God, everyone will be expelled from the relic, and the current score of Void Double Pupils passive is over 15,000; he only lacks around six hundred ‘heads’ to reach a sixteenfold increase.
Whether it’s to gain that extra multiple increase or just due to obsessive-compulsion, Jack is determined to make up the number before the darkness settles.
Meanwhile, under the deep sea, the Water and Fire World suddenly trembled.
Roar!
Alongside the dragon’s roar, a terrifying Level 9 Dragon Might burst forth, instantly shattering the Ice Crystal Palace, which had only been rebuilt for a few days, as a surge of Black Power rose into the sky.
Formed from shards of ice crystals and black raging winds, the Destruction storm swelled, forming a 700-meter-wide Tornado Column crashing against the Boundary Wall of the Water and Fire World, with formidable momentum.

chapters.title: Chapter 671: 304: Twin Top-tier Monarchs, the Monster of that Year (Jack Clark)
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: Chapter 304: Twin Top-tier Monarchs, the Monster of that Year (Jack Clark)
“`
The devastating storm that pierced through the heavens and earth startled Kidora, the Blue Giant Crab guarding the gate, and its nine dragon heads diligently fortified with Solid Runes.
In the midst of that all-destroying storm, a deep dragon roar emanated: “Roar, roar, roar! The Great Scythia announces, I am invincible.”
Roaring, the Silver Giant Dragon, with a body length of 140 meters and wings spanning over 200 meters, burst out of the storm and slammed down onto the Ice Crystal Ground in front of the Dragon Palace Great Hall with a thunderous crash.
In an instant, the ground shattered within a radius of hundreds of meters, countless ice crystal fragments were flung forward, exploding like cannon shots upon the sea’s surface.
The Silver Giant Dragon, having achieved a breakthrough to Level 9, underwent significant changes in appearance; it looked even more imposing than it did at Level 8, with two rows of black bone spurs-like dorsal fins stretching from the back of its neck to its tail.
The spiral dragon horns on its head became sharper and sturdier, their black and silver patterns intertwined, piercing the sky.
Its entire body was covered with thick Dragon Scales that shimmered silver, almost like translucent crystals, which reflected its solidity and made it look extremely magnificent and beautiful.
Most importantly, after the breakthrough to Level 9, the Silver Giant Dragon’s presence overwhelmed that of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon at the early stage of Level 9.
Clearly, the Silver Giant Dragon had become stronger than the Nine-headed Dragon Kidora following its breakthrough.
Looking at the mighty Silver Giant Dragon standing in the square, a sixty-some-meter-long Blue Giant Crab burst out of the water, excitedly blowing bubbles.
Gurgle, gurgle! My king, congratulations on your breakthrough. You look even more awesome and badass than before. The sheer power you radiate makes even my eight legs weak with excitement – absolutely sky-high awesome.
These words were newly imagined flattery concocted by the Blue Giant Crab after having been hit by King Thunderflame, which left the Silver Giant Dragon feeling quite satisfied.
The Silver Giant Dragon lifted its head slightly and roared with authority: “Not bad. This time, the Great Scythia has just awakened a new Top Tier Talent, still a bit short compared to Tim Abott.”
Though it said so, the dragon’s upwards-curling tail revealed its inner pride.
With its two top-tier talents, the dragon was rare even among Mythical Giant Beasts; its bloodline was more powerful than the average Monarch-level life, making its combat power naturally stronger, too.
From a distance, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s nine heads shook, emitting envious chaotic roars: “Roar, roar, roar! Awesome, Sesi, fly high.”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes held even more pride, and its raised tail swayed slightly.
Just then, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon continued to growl lowly: “Roar, roar, roar! However, as for the ground and the palace, you fix; Abbott told me to cultivate, I’m busy.”
In an instant, the pride in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon stiffened. It looked at the Dragon Palace and ice crystal ground nearly destroyed by its Power Explosion and immediately felt some regret.
If it had known, it wouldn’t have vented its power just earlier.
Kidora was also of the Dragon King tier, and they were equals in status; only someone like Tim Abbott could command it.
Thinking this, the Silver Giant Dragon looked around the empty Water and Fire World and lowly roared with a question: “Roar! Where are Tim Abott and Joe?”
The Blue Giant Crab waved its pincers and blew bubbles.
Gurgle, gurgle! In accordance with the orders of King Thunderflame, King Joe and the King of Domination have gone to patrol the territory, collecting resources at the Resource Points to increase their strength.
Gurgle! General Kitty Jones is leading the Tiger Whale Army to collect Life Crystals for King Thunderflame.
King Thunderflame has been gone for several days, and before he left, he said he was going to a faraway place, and when he returns, he will bring us to destroy the Mythological Beast Empire.
So they’re not here. The Silver Giant Dragon suddenly felt somewhat listless.
“Roar! The Great Scythia will go back to sleep, call me when Tim Abott is back.” Saying this, the Silver Giant Dragon’s body erupted with white icy power, starting to repair the ground and the palace, and then it slept.
Previously, when it sneaked out, it had found several Dragon Vein Heavenly Fruits (mythological resources) along the way, but they could only be consumed after breaking through to Level 9.
Because at Level 8, if it ate them, it wouldn’t digest properly and would waste most of the fruits’ energy – Scythia couldn’t bear that.
After all, it had brought so little with it when it ran away; the supplies weren’t enough to satisfy its voracious appetite for long.
Meanwhile, as Scythia awoke, in the far reaches beneath the Northern Ice Ocean, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was swimming rapidly.
At this time, its body had already grown to 195 meters and was on the verge of breaking through the mid period of Level 9, with its huge size bringing even greater strength.
Pushing harder for a little longer, once it broke through to the mid period of Level 9, it could return to fight.
The reason why Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was growing so quickly was, naturally, thanks to the Red Beast, who led the way.
As a top-tier Colossal Beast of the Northern Ice Ocean, the Red Beast seldom moved, but it roughly knew where other giant beasts lingered in the sea area.
Under its guidance, most of the Level 8 Beasts and two Level 9 Giant Beasts in the not so vast Northern Ice Ocean had been slain by Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In killing a large number of Giant Beasts, it had also collected two Level 7 and one Level 8 Life Crystals, a quite satisfactory harvest.
But just as the two Giant Beasts were swimming along, suddenly, the three-hundred-meter-long Red Beast slowed its pace, then like a system crash, it stopped in place.
Damn, not this again.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, exasperated, then skillfully lashed out with a claw. Terrifying Power exploded instantly in the deep sea, sending shockwaves that landed on the head of the Red Beast.
Boom!
With that fearsome claw strike, the mountainous Red Beast thundered to the seabed, causing it to rumble as billowing mud and violent waves surged out thousands of meters.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 672: 304: The Two Top-tier Monarchs, That Monster from the Past (Jack Clark) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 672: Chapter 304: The Two Top-tier Monarchs, That Monster from the Past (Jack Clark) _2
“`
After waiting two minutes, the Red Beast slowly emerged from the murky seawater, revealing a perplexed growl in its eyes, “Monarch, why, why, did you hit me?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s voice, deep and booming, roared, “It’s nothing, I just noticed you were a bit distracted, just a little something to perk you up.”
After about a minute, the Red Beast slowly responded with an ‘oh’.
As for the ‘slowness’ of this guy in a non-combat state, even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t do anything about it, or maybe this was the price of touching upon the flow of time prematurely under the laws of myth.
This was different from when he encountered the Deep Sea Giant Python, where the ‘slowness of time’ was actually an effect of the discrepancy in perception caused by their toxin energy.
This was why the Sword Armor Beast, when it burst forth with Agility Talent, wasn’t affected then.
The power that the Red Beast Candle Dragon possesses is of true slowness of time where even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s breath, comparable to Law Power, would be affected in that state.
…
Night!
When Jack Clark, having completed the passive stacking of 16,000 targets, burst out from beneath the pitch-black night sky from the ruins, what he saw were two women fighting.
No, it was more like they had finished fighting and were now in a standoff.
The once flat prairie had become a field of ruins, crisscrossed with trenches swept by Energy Beams and filled with large craters from missile explosions, many still smoldering with black smoke.
In the middle of the ruins stood a black and white Mecha, nearly 40 meters tall, with its power reactor on its chest radiating intense red light, and a massive battle sword tens of meters long in its hand.
Around the Mecha, three triangular heavy shields, 15 meters high and 8 meters wide, flashed with runes, hovering and revolving, forming an iron wall of defense.
Only, each of these heavy shields bore several gashes over 10 meters long and nearly 0.5 meters deep, as if slashed by a gigantic blade.
The missile launchers on the hefty double shoulders had been emptied, and the laser cannons stationed behind the shoulders were still in a semi-red, high-temperature state and had yet to cool down.
There was also the blackened muzzle of a half-meter diameter machine gun on the left shoulder, its thousand-round belt emptied, aimed at a dark-haired girl over a hundred meters away.
Around Jane Aiken, four 2-meter long battle swords revolved, imbued with nearly fully mature Sword Intent and emitting various colors of light.
Pink fantasy, black destruction, blue whirlwind, and gray gloom.
Seeing this scene, Jack Clark couldn’t help but pause, “… Are you guys having a fight?”
Jane Aiken shook her head, calmly saying, “Earlier when I was using the Sword Array to breakthrough to the mid stage of the Sixth Heaven, Fina suggested a friendly spar.”
“I see.”
“By the way, who won?” Jack Clark asked curiously.
Jane Aiken thought for a moment, “Fina was a bit stronger. Although I have mastered the Sword Array, the gap in our realms is not something that can be made up for on one front alone.”
Both were at the mid stage of the Sixth Layer Heaven and the early stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven respectively, and both were top-tier monsters, capable of surpassing several small boundaries in combat strength.
In this case, the pressure of the upper level becomes more apparent, so it seemed normal that Jane Aiken was no match for Gabriella.
Of course, this might have something to do with her Four Great Sword Intentions not yet fully matured; otherwise, with the combined Four Great Sword Intentions and the amplification of an ancient Sword Array inheritance…
At this point, the Mecha approached with heavy steps, and then from a spot just above the power reactor on the Mecha’s chest, a two-meter tall diamond-shaped crystal emitted a Light Beam that hit the ground.
Subsequently, Gabriella, clad in a tight red combat suit, flew out from the crystal’s light, following the beam down to the ground.
This performance made Jack Clark startle, “Gabriella, don’t you usually climb out of the back of the neck of the Mecha?”
The blonde girl shook her hair with style and pride, “This is one of the matrix talents I designed, based on a spatial short-range Teleportation Crystal from an Eighth Level Beast.”
“With that crystal as a beacon, as long as I’m within 100 meters of the Black Demon White King Armor, I can fly into the Mecha using the Gravitational Beam, it’s very convenient.”
“… Impressive,” Jack Clark remarked. Indeed, whether one is a True Martial Practitioner or a Mech Martial Practitioner, crossing into the Seventh Layer Heaven is a transformative leap.
Yet this move seemed familiar to him, as an image of a youth shouting “Divine Dragon Fighter” involuntarily surfaced in his mind.
At this moment, Jane Aiken looked curious, “Jack Clark, have you had a breakthrough in your Battle Intent?”
This morning, when he had left, Jack Clark had looked like a god of slaughter with terrifying Purple Killing Energy swirling around him, but now he seemed to have returned to calm.
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Yeah, my Battle Intent has reached grand accomplishment.”
Suddenly, Jane Aiken and Gabriella paused; while they had expected it, they were at a loss for words.
Jack Clark was already terrifyingly powerful, and now that his Battle Intent, previously a weak spot, had also reached grand accomplishment, he was nearly unchallenged in all aspects, more monstrous than a monster.
Is this what the dean meant by ‘There’s always someone better out there, and a higher sky above’? The blonde girl sighed inwardly, then curiosity got the better of her, “Jack Clark, how much Killing Intent have you accumulated?”
Since the announcement of the Path of the Gods, Marcellus Larry had shut down the Sub-eye channel, so no one but the individual knew the status of others.
“Over 725,000,” Jack Clark responded without concealment, as there was no need to hide.
In ten days, the most significant increase came from the two days he pushed back from the 1,000-kilometer range since most of the slain were high-order monsters, and then it decreased in sequence.
Jane Aiken exclaimed in admiration, “Over 725,000, I wonder if you will get the ten Origin rewards directly when you set foot on the Road to Becoming a God tomorrow.”
Compared to her little over 10,000 points, and the highest of Balderas and a few others with forty to fifty thousand, the gap between them and Jack Clark was massive.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 673: 304: Twin Top-tier Monarchs, That Monster from the Past (Jack Clark)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 673: Chapter 304: Twin Top-tier Monarchs, That Monster from the Past (Jack Clark)_3
Jack shook his head, “It shouldn’t be that simple.”
“On the path to becoming a god, the trials in the early stages mainly focus on enlightenment and battle strength. To obtain Origin Rewards, the primary core should be the trials, and the Origin obtained from Purple Killing Energy should have certain limitations.”
“It’s just that, what exactly are these so-called trials?”
“I heard that once everyone enters the Inheritance Space, what appears on the Outer World is just a projection, while the True Body is in a separate subspace…”
While they were talking, the three of them returned to the hillside.
Since they were leaving tomorrow, Gabriella did not go back to practice barbecue, and after eating a simple meal, the three of them went to quietly cultivate.
That night, everyone was quietly cultivating, conserving energy and nourishing their spirits.
Quickly, the night passed, and the sky of the relic gradually brightened.
At the same time, the silver river in the sky had completely descended, winding and stretching like a long road spanning the entire oasis in the sky.
Whoosh! Jack slowly opened his eyes, and the Sky Element Stone, which he had refined, had turned to flying ash and dispersed in his hand.
After his diligent cultivation during the night, the Combat Shadow’s realness had reached 45%, and in another ten days or so, he would reach the late stages of the Seventh Layer Heaven with eighty percent.
With the sixteen-fold amplification of Void Law from his Void Double Pupils, grand accomplishment in Battle Intent, entry into the Demon God Form, the Fighting War Emperor Dragon Form, the Fighting War Demon God Form, and four Thunderbolt Law Fragments.
He also could burn 1000 Attribute Points anytime to enter an enlightenment state.
With so many trump cards, he wondered how far he could go today. At the thought, Jack’s eyes showed anticipation.
In the distance, Jane called out, “Jack, ready to depart.”
“Coming,” Jack stood up.
In the distance, Gabriella was already standing below her Mecha, clad in a tight red Combat Suit, her blonde hair tied into a high ponytail like Jane’s, looking smart and valiant.
As the two approached, the blonde girl greeted them. She then flew into the Mecha under the guidance of a Light Beam, and shortly after, the eyes of the Black and White Mecha lit up.
Whoosh whoosh!! Jack and Jane landed on the double shoulders of the Black and White Mecha.
“Dear passengers, welcome aboard. The Black-White Demon King Mech is about to depart for the Heaven Inspection Mountain Peak. Please hold on tight.”
Accompanied by Gabriella’s somewhat playful voice, the Mecha’s arms opened like wings, while two engines below, four at the back, and two at the feet each emitted Firelight.
Boom!
Under the powerful thrust, the Mecha weighing over two thousand tons blasted off, speeding up ever faster, soon reaching Supersonic Speed, stirring up thunderous roars and powerful shockwaves.
“It’s time to leave.” On the giant dragon head of the stone carving, Justin stood up with some anticipation. He was going to watch Jack show off.
“Sister, hurry up. If we’re late, we’ll miss the excitement.”
“Hahahaha… Today, I, Damon, will suppress all geniuses. No matter Eddy Keller or Balderas, they’re no match for my Thunder Prison True Body.”
From deep within the ruins several hundred kilometers away, amid peals of laughter, a silhouette burst forth from the small world, surrounded by rumbling Thunder, transforming into a lightning bolt that sped away at several times the speed of sound.
From high altitude, one could see countless figures departing from all directions of the oasis, converging toward the central mountain peak that stood ten thousand meters tall.
Among these people, probably only about two hundred had obtained the ticket of one thousand Purple Evil.
The others, of course, were there for the spectacle, a path to godhood that opened only once in decades.
Even without the qualifications to enter, just witnessing it was worthwhile, while also accumulated some bragging rights.
For instance, there was a monster who had once single-handedly slaughtered most of the polluted monsters in the Doomsday Ruins; the Killing Intent swirling around him nearly obscured the sky.
Beneath his Overbearing War Halberd, none within the same realm could withstand a single blow, and even Polluted Giant Beasts one Major Realm higher could be burst with one strike – and that person was one of the Human Race’s Heavenly Kings, Overlord Callum.
