After Jack showed his overwhelming and terrifying strength, as well as his monstrous cultivation of Seventh Layer in less than First Grade, everyone had a feeling.
If this child did not die, he would surely become a Heavenly King within ten years.

chapters.title: Chapter 674: 305 Monarch Inheritance, Damon Lopes: You go in first
chapters.content:
Chapter 674: Chapter 305 Monarch Inheritance, Damon Lopes: You go in first
The earth undulated as the raging wind howled and a sonic boom resounded.
A mecha, tens of meters tall, flew at supersonic speed just above ground level, crossing hundreds of kilometers in just over twenty minutes, nearing the main peak of the Heaven Inspection Mountains.
This mountain stretched for hundreds of kilometers, spanning half of the Oasis.
By now, the figures of other geniuses began to appear on the road, their bodies flashing with True Power, racing through the mountains at three to four hundred meters per second.
In short bursts without considering the consumption of True Strength, Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivators could already reach Subsonic Speed, and the Sixth-level Heaven could generally enter Supersonic Speed.
Some cultivators who had Cultivation Methods related to movement or who had cultivated speed Secret Skills were even faster during these bursts.
Of course, their kind of burst-consuming True Strength significantly differed from Jack, who could maintain a steady Supersonic Speed with a light jog.
Beyond that, some geniuses had traces of Unique Beasts on their bodies or entered a semi-Unique Beast state to run on the earth.
Under these circumstances, Simon and others who piloted Mechas had it somewhat easier, those with flight-capable Mechas transformed directly into fighter aircraft that tore through the sky.
So by the time Jack and the other two rushed to the mountain peak where the temperature fell below zero and ice began to form on the mountainside, many had already arrived before them.
The mountain peak’s square, with a diameter of over a thousand meters, had been flattened by a sword strike. As the mecha landed with a bang, the earth trembled within a tens of meters range around it.
Immediately, someone looked over in surprise. “That’s Gabriella,” they said. “How is Jack standing on her mecha’s shoulder?”
“Indeed strange, how did they get mixed up together?”
As for Gabriella, the first among Simon’s Younger Generation, she attracted much attention when she first appeared, especially from Simon’s higher-ups.
After all, she was not only a dazzling genius but also a rare beauty, which held great allure for many men.
As for Jane Aiken on the other shoulder of the mecha, dressed in Green Armor, although beautiful, was ignored due to her lesser fame.
“Is that the Road to Godhood?” Jane Aiken’s eyes showed curiosity.
Standing on the mecha’s shoulder, Jack looked towards the cliffside, where a road seemingly made of white clouds stretched a hundred meters wide, extending towards the horizon.
It gave the illusion of a pathway leading to the Heavenly Court in the mythical Immortal World.
Just then, in the depths of Jack’s eyes, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils appeared, with sixteen circles of black rune Sequence Chains slowly rotating at the edges.
Suddenly, the scene in Jack’s eyes changed, where he saw not a road of white clouds but a pathway bound by rules and extending deep into space.
The layers of the pathway were filled with various interstitial spaces, akin to countless small worlds squeezed together, slowly approaching the surface world.
What a grand endeavor, what strong power, to compress micro worlds together, forming a path, Jack thought in admiration.
A roar echoed from below the mountain as a white Divine Dragon, over forty meters in length, soared skyward from the mountainside. After surpassing the peak by a hundred meters, it turned and descended from the heavens.
Boom!
The earth trembled, the Ice Layer fractured, and amidst the flurry of snow, a man in a white robe, Eddy Keller, stood with his hands behind his back, surveying everyone.
But when Eddy’s eyes, full of the solitude of an expert, swept over the distant figure on the mecha’s shoulder, his smug expression stiffened.
How did this guy get here so fast?
Noticing Eddy’s gaze, Jack nodded slightly at him, acknowledging his presence, causing Eddy’s hands, which were behind his back, to drop stiffly.
As the appearance of the Road to Becoming a God was imminent, no one felt the urge to chat, silently watching the front and waiting.
Soon, more people arrived, including Justin Welan in his Turtle Thorn Armor.
Having run for hundreds of kilometers, he caught his breath and then excitedly shouted towards the distant Jack, “Jack, I’ve come to see you show off—no, wait, to see everyone walk the Road to Godhood.”
This guy.
Jack shook his head speechlessly but still leaped down from the mecha.
“Mr. Willard, your aura…?” As he drew close to Justin, Jack noticed his True Power Aura was a little different from before.
With a hee-hee, Justin said, “I found an ancient stone carving of a Mountain-Suppressing Dragon Turtle and got an Inheritance called the Mountain Suppressing God Seal, which changed my Cultivation Methods somewhat.”
“Not bad.” Hearing his good friend had received an Inheritance, Jack couldn’t help but smile.
This trek through the ruins provided everyone a chance, and although the gains varied in size, all would see an improvement in strength after departure.
By then, the gap between them and other geniuses of their age would further widen.
Soon, Crystal Lewis, with her Wings of Flame ablaze, and Mandy Lewis, surrounded by gloomy blue light ribbons, also rushed to the mountain peak, quickly approaching upon seeing the two of them.
“Class Leader, Miss Karen,” Jack greeted them, then sharply noticed that the fire and Mysterious Cold aura around the two sisters seemed quite strong.
Noticing Jack’s gaze, Crystal smiled. “This time, Miss Karen and I were rather lucky, receiving an ancient strong woman’s Inheritance known as the Empress of Mysterious Flame.”
“However, this Inheritance wasn’t a Cultivation Method but a ‘Secret Skill’ about how to refine fire talent and Mysterious Cold Talent.”
Justin chuckled. “Congratulations to the Class Leader and Miss Karen for obtaining Secret Skills that match your talents.”
“By the way, Jack, you’ve been rampaging through the ruins lately, did you find any good stuff?”
“I heard some relics might contain Law Fragments, innate runes, and other God-level resources.”
Hearing this, the Lewis sisters looked at Jack with curiosity.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: 305 Monarch Inheritance, Damon Lopes: You go in first_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: Chapter 305 Monarch Inheritance, Damon Lopes: You go in first_2
Facing the gazes of the others, Jack Clark thought for a moment and said, “This time I was quite lucky. I obtained a Soul Cultivation Method inheritance in the ruins.”
“In addition, I also found a Crystal Stone that contains Wind Law Charm and Thunderbolt Law Fragments.”
If one were to carefully count, excluding the unexpected gains amplified by the Void Double Pupils, Jack Clark’s haul from the ten days spent in the relic was astonishing.
Apart from the aforementioned items, his cultivation had also broken through to the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer, his Battle Intent achieved grand accomplishment, and the Blood Sea Purgatory Rune had also become stronger due to the advancement of the Purple Killing Energy.
“Damn.”
No sooner had Jack finished speaking than Justin Welan’s eyes widened in astonishment, “Soul Cultivation Method, Wind Law Charm Crystal Stone, Thunderbolt Law Fragments, Jack, your luck is too good.”
Saying this, Justin Welan’s face was full of envy.
However, it was just envy, because these were things that Jack had fought for.
The gentle Mandy Lewis also exclaimed with amazement, “It’s not just these things. With Jack’s strength, his Road to Becoming a God will definitely bring great harvests.”
“By the time the relic is over and you’ve digested these gains, Jack, your strength should quickly ascend to the Eight Layer Heaven…” Mandy’s voice paused as she spoke, her tone stalled.
Because it’s only June 20th now, and there are still more than two months left until their September admission last year. Was this guy going to reach the Ninth Heavens within one year?
Although cultivation became more difficult at the high-order and progress was hard, that was for ordinary geniuses. Jack was an anomaly and did not fall into that category.
Especially since he broke through the Triplex Realm, Jack’s cultivation speed had become more and more exaggerated, virtually advancing one realm each month, only held back for an extra month by the creation of his Top-tier Secret Manual.
Just then, Howard Lambert, exuding a crazed and dire aura, came striding forward, carrying the Steel Pillar, his determined eyes faintly glowing red.
Justin Welan immediately waved to him, “Howard, this way.”
When Howard approached, Justin remarked in surprise, “You’ve also broken through to the late period of the Fifth Layer Heaven!?”
Howard’s voice was deep as he responded, “I encountered a very strong beast in the mid stage of the Sixth Heaven earlier, it almost ambushed me. Later, I broke through during the desperate fight against it.”
“You’re getting crazier,” Justin shook his head.
Everyone admired the path Howard was taking. It was literally success or death.
Soon, geniuses from various nations gathered once again, including Betty Leinster, Denny Rhodes, Carol Koch from the Southern Battlefield, still divided into three main camps according to regions.
Just that there were over a dozen fewer people now.
In the first two days after entering, five died. Over the following week or so, another dozen geniuses lost their lives to Polluted Giant Beasts and Void Creatures.
This was still under the circumstance where Jack was on a killing spree, having slain the majority of the obvious powerful monsters. Otherwise, the casualties would have been even higher.
Suddenly, a rumble came from the distance, a dazzling bolt of purple lightning zigzagged across the mountain stream, and in the blink of an eye, Damon Lopes, surrounded by lightning, charged up the ten thousand meter mountain.
At that moment, Damon was radiating a strong Destructive Aura, filled with oppression.
His cultivation was still at the early stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, but he seemed to have grown several or even ten times stronger than before entering the relic, causing a tingling pain as if electrified even from a great distance.
Clearly, after absorbing the Thunderbolt Law Fragments, his Innate Thunderbolt had undergone a qualitative change. Coupled with cultivating the Thunder Prison True Body, his strength had notably increased.
Even Balderas and Eddy Keller were showing solemn expressions at this time.
Among the top-notch geniuses from the Federation’s major empires present, only a few could capture their serious attention, like Damon, an Innate Awakened One.
Although Eddy was confident of being more of a genius than the Innate Awakened Ones and might have even reached the Eighth Layer had he not spent half a year recasting his Secret Manual, he still did not dare underestimate Damon.
Because Innate Awakened Ones had no bottlenecks before the Ninth Heavens, unlike them, once they reached the high-order, every step they took was massive, and any day they might be overridden.
For example, now, Damon had seemingly obtained some fortuitous opportunity that even made Eddy feel a strong threat.
Indeed, these Innate Awakened Ones were not ordinary people.
At the edge of the Mountain Peak, Damon surveyed the crowd, quite satisfied with everyone’s solemnity and astonishment, and only then did he contain the Purple Extreme True Thunder energy radiating from his body.
Damon materialized beside Jack with a flash and warmly greeted everyone, “Folks, long time no see. Looking at everyone’s Spirit Qi, it seems your harvests are not bad, huh?”
Uh… since when were we so close? Justin and Howard were somewhat baffled.
Mandy smiled gently and modestly replied, “I had some harvest, but it’s probably nothing compared to Senior Damon.”
“Speaking of which, I have to thank Jack, otherwise I would have missed this opportunity,” Damon said, patting Jack on the shoulder.
“If you need anything in the future, just let me know, brother. I wouldn’t even blink an eye if I had to run through fire and flames or even delete those friends,” Damon added.
Facing Damon’s fiery gaze, Jack instinctively stepped back and coughed dryly, “… Why would I ask you to delete friends? And there’s no need to be polite, Mr. Lopes; my own gains weren’t small either.”
Damon shook his head, “It’s not the same.”
It was only after obtaining the inheritance of Thunder Prison that Damon realized just how significant his gains were.
He now greatly believed that he would receive the inheritance of the Lord of Thunder on the Road to Godhood, which would allow him to break free from the shackles of being an Innate Awakened One and stand among the strongest of monarchs.
Hence, he was filled with gratitude towards Jack.

chapters.title: Chapter 676: 305 Monarch Inheritance, Damon Lopes: You Go First_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Chapter 305 Monarch Inheritance, Damon Lopes: You Go First_3
“`
Hum!
At this moment, everyone’s wrists vibrated slightly, and the Eye of Heaven Observation attached to them emerged, transforming into a shadow of an eye that flew into the air and merged into a ten-meter-diameter phantom of an eyeball.
From the Eye of Heaven Observation projection, Marcellus Larry’s voice came through.
“The Road to Becoming a God is about to appear, and this path of inheritance will not only provide a great deal of Origin, but also the Monarch Inheritance of twelve Sovereigns of Ancient Civilization.”
“After stepping on the path of inheritance, everyone will enter different Inheritance Spaces, and the challenges they encounter will be different, but they will generally be divided into four stages.”
“The first stage is relatively simple, walking out a thousand meters is considered passing, and at the same time, it represents the potential of the Ninth Heavens, entitling one to a reward of Origin.”
“The second stage, spanning three thousand meters, tests enlightenment and combat strength. Once you break through, you are deemed to have king-level potential and will receive a great amount of Origin as a reward.”
“This stage is hard; the enemy I encountered back then was a projection of a king of the same realm, and each one possessed the strength to cross a Major Realm.”
A genius from Berlin exclaimed in astonishment, “The second stage is actually fighting against a king’s projection of the same realm, how can one fight that?”
From the Eye of Heaven Observation projection, Marcellus Larry’s indifferent voice continued, “It’s not just fighting against a king of the same realm; the projections I faced were also covered in sealing runes.”
“Challengers need to comprehend the sealing runes within half an hour; otherwise, those runes will integrate into the king’s projection, each rune doubling its strength.”
Hiss!
Many people instantly took in a cold breath.
The king’s projection was already terrifying in combat strength, yet one had to decipher and understand what sealing runes within half an hour; otherwise, its power would double.
While everyone was solemn or chuckling bitterly, Marcellus Larry’s indifferent voice continued.
“Since it is the Road to Becoming a God, naturally it tests the geniuses who can ascend to king-level. Otherwise, wouldn’t it be a waste to give precious Origin to those with insufficient talent?”
“However, don’t panic, everyone, because the challenges each of you will face are different, and not just based on strength; factors like enlightenment are also considered. Alright, back to the main point.”
“The third stage tests comprehension and combat strength as well as the soul. Passing the third stage signifies the potential of the Heavenly King Level.”
“At that time, not only will one obtain a great deal of Origin, but there’s also a chance to gain the Monarch Inheritance.”
“You should know that even the weakest Monarch of Ancient Civilization could be compared to a Heavenly King, and the top ten are entities even beyond Heavenly Kings, extremely powerful.”
“As for the fourth stage, it is said that the sole test involves the soul. As for the specifics, you’ll have to experience it for yourselves, because back then, I only made it through the second stage.”
“For many, this is an opportunity to defy the heavens and change their fate, to break through their limits and become Mythical Powerhouses. So give it your all and fight your way out.”
Marcellus Larry’s words left many in silence.
Fight their way out, of course they wanted to; it’s the heritage that points directly to the Heavenly King. Even acquiring ancient methods would be enough for them to ascend to king-level.
Currently, there are eleven Heavenly King Level powerhouses in the Human Race, seven of whom emerged from the chaotic era fifty years ago. It is evident that all of them are related to this heritage of ruins.
Boom!
In the distance, the clouds-like Road to Becoming a God bordered with the real world, causing intense spatial vibrations, followed by a gradual calm.
“The path of inheritance is now open; you may enter.”
But just at this moment, Thunder flickered and Damon Lopes appeared at the edge of the Road to Becoming a God, smiling and suggesting.
“I think we should let Brother Callum go first. I’m sure everyone is curious to see how far he can go in one step with his tens of thousands of Purple Killing Energy, aren’t they?”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 677: 306: A Lone Rider Blows Away the King-Level Competition
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Chapter 306: A Lone Rider Blows Away the King-Level Competition
Damon Lopes’s statement stunned the crowd.
Immediately thereafter, Balderas spoke in a deep voice, “I have no objections.”
“…Neither do I,” Eddy Keller said with some frustration. This monster with hundreds of thousands of Purple Kill Value was simply too formidable to provoke.
Justin Welan chuckled, “Jack, I also think you should be the first to go up.” Of course, showing off first is always the most shocking.
As for the others, naturally, they had no objections either; it was a good opportunity to assess the situation.
“Go for it, Jack Clark.” Crystal Lewis clenched her fists.
Seeing that everyone was looking at him, Jack Clark smiled and said, “Alright then, I’ll go in first.” He also wanted to see how much reward he could get for the over 700,000 Purple Killing Energy.
Jack Clark walked towards the cliffside, and from his Sumeru Bracelet, streams of golden light flew out, crackle crackle, transforming into the gold and red Dragon Blood Battle Armor that covered him.
However, at this moment, the Dragon Blood Battle Armor appeared somewhat battered, with many areas dented and damaged, missing pieces here and there.
Especially the crack at the chest that almost cleaved a person in half diagonally, it shocked and astonished many people, including Crystal Lewis and those like Jane Aiken who were unaware of the situation.
With Jack Clark’s strength, the fact that a monster could injure him and cause such severe damage to his battle armor indicated how fierce the battle must have been.
Despite the thirtyfold increase in defense under the Extreme Solar Explosion and Jack actively separating the battle armor at the last moment, it still sustained numerous damages.
However, the top-tier transcendent battle armor all possessed self-repairing energy; it only required some time and True Strength for nurturing.
Wearing his battle armor, Jack Clark stood before the Road to Becoming a God, under the watchful eyes of all.
Damon Lopes smiled and said cheerily, “Go on, Brother Jack. Show everyone what a true Unparalleled Genius looks like.”
What’s this guy up to? Jack Clark looked at Damon Lopes dubiously, then stepped onto the white cloud pathway. In an instant, an invisible force descended upon him.
Boom!
The condensed Purple Killing Energy at Jack Clark’s brow suddenly erupted, unfurling into a Doomsday Hell covering a range of 150 meters, the Killing Intent overwhelming, with a Ghost Wailing Divine Howl.
Under the dense Blood Fiend’s illumination, the entire sky and Earth turned a bloody red, and the terror of the Killing Intent made many instinctively step back, their faces shocked.
Although everyone knew that Jack Clark had slaughtered countless polluted monsters, seeing just the number and facing this overwhelming Killing Intent were entirely different concepts.
At that moment, Jack’s figure disappeared in an instant, reappearing more than 2,300 meters away.
Boom!
The Void above the Road to Godhood quivered, and a strand of pure White Light gradually emerged, like the first light in between heaven and earth, emitting a Mysterious Aura that made life quiver.
Under everyone’s gaze, that strand of Origin silently merged into Jack Clark’s body.
But it wasn’t over there; then, two more strands of Origin, emitting Primordial Radiance, emerged and slowly descended onto Jack, disappearing into him.
“Just three strands…” everyone was astonished.
It wasn’t surprising that Jack Clark received the Origin rewards as his Purple Kill Value was terrifying, but three strands… it wasn’t exactly a lot, yet it also seemed to fall short of a shocking amount.
At that moment, from the silhouette of the Eye of Heaven Observation, Marcellus Larry’s indifferent voice came through, “These Origins are the reward for reaching the second phase in one step; they’re not related to the Purple Kill Value.”
“According to the rules of the Inheritance, anyone with a Purple Kill Value over twenty thousand can receive an additional Origin reward, and the threshold for a second one is one hundred thousand.”
“Furthermore, those with a cumulative Purple Kill Value over fifty thousand can directly skip the first phase of the challenge.”
As Marcellus Larry finished speaking, five more Origins appeared in the Void, one by one descending and merging into Jack Clark’s body, instantly enveloping him in a Mysterious Aura.
“Eight Origins!!” All faces were filled with envy; just stepping on the path of the Inheritance’s power, he had already acquired eight World Origins, just two short of the nine needed for a Nine-fold Peak to break through to king-level.
Indeed, this guy was a monster.
“Ha ha… Well done, Jack,” Justin chuckled happily.
While everyone was shocked, anticipation gleamed in the eyes of both Eddy Keller and Balderas. According to Marcellus Larry, they would each get at least two Origins.
Just as everyone was preparing to enter the Road to Godhood, Damon Lopes suddenly addressed them all, leisurely stating, “Everyone, no need to rush, because rushing won’t do any good. The Inheritance of this Divine Road is destined to be mine, Damon Lopes.”
“Of course, I know you all won’t be convinced, such as a certain someone with the surname Keller, but your disbelief is irrelevant because I am now invincibly strong, ha ha ha ha…”
Er… Everyone was at a loss for words, unsure why Damon had suddenly gone mad, turning so arrogant all of a sudden.
Yet, after declaring his ‘invincibility,’ before they could retort, Damon Lopes had already turned and stepped onto the Road to Godhood, with his powerful Purple Killing Energy erupting, instantly appearing six hundred meters away.
Damon himself was startled; he had forgotten that because of his Closed-door Cultivation in the small world, he had accumulated just over twenty thousand Purple Killing Energy.
Looking at the single strand of basic reward Origin slowly descending from the Void, everyone was stunned.
“Is this guy here to be funny?” Justin Welan looked on with a peculiar gaze.
“Ha ha ha ha… I’m dying laughing. Is this your confidence, Damon Lopes? Even an Innate Awakened One is nothing special,” Eddy Keller burst into laughter.
Saying this, his body shimmered with White Light, and with a roar, he transformed into a Divine Dragon and rushed into the Road to Godhood. Suddenly, his more than fifty thousand Purple Killing Energy erupted, swirling around him as thick purple-black smoke.
Drawn by the power of the rules, Eddy Keller instantly appeared over eleven hundred meters away.

chapters.title: Chapter 678: 306: A Lone Rider Leaves All Behind, Explosively Defeats the King-Level Competitor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Chapter 306: A Lone Rider Leaves All Behind, Explosively Defeats the King-Level Competitor_2
Two sources of white light slowly descended above his head, one from passing the first stage of the trial, and the other was feedback from exceeding a Purple Kill Value of 20,000.
Boom!
White fierce winds howled around Balderas as his form rapidly expanded and transformed into a twenty-meter-tall Human-shaped White Tiger, with a powerful aura spreading all around him.
The white battle armor he wore also expanded correspondingly, including the Transcendent leather made from Giant Beast hides underneath it, which also grew immensely.
Expanding training attire that could stretch and enlarge was quite popular in Berlin; almost every cultivator above the Fourth Layer Heaven had at least one set.
Otherwise, these genetic warriors would have to bust out of their clothes every time they went through a half-beast transformation.
In his full Beast Transformation form, Balderas charged into the Road to Godhood with his Purple Kill Value also exceeding 50,000, appearing 1,100 meters away, side by side with Eddy Keller.
Above his head, two streams of Origin also descended slowly.
After the two stepped onto the Inheritance Path, dozens of figures exuding mid and late-stage Sixth Layer auras moved, transforming into streaks of light that surged forward.
Each released a Purple Kill Value over 20,000, and upon entering the Road to Godhood, they appeared between 700 and 1,000 meters away, drawing down a stream of Origin upon them.
These were the ‘veteran’ geniuses who entered the relics with a low profile, having graduated one or two years earlier.
As high-level experts who joined the military for one or two years of training, compared to geniuses still in school, they had trained longer and achieved higher cultivation levels.
With advantages in Secret Skills, battle armor, and Transcendent Weapons, upon entering the relics they basically occupied most of the spots in the Top 50 of the Purple Kill leaderboard.
Only some monsters could surpass them, such as Jack Clark who stepped into the Seventh Layer, Balderas, Damon Lopes, and others.
No, beside Balderas stood a blonde young man, Bruce from Berlin, who maintained a low presence after entering the relics, but his Purple Kill Value had always been in the top five.
Above his head, two streams of Origin also descended.
“Junior Aiken, let’s go in too.”
“Okay.”
Gabriella, piloting her Mecha, and Jane Aiken also stepped onto the Road to Becoming a God. Their Purple Killing Energy was triggered, appearing at 700 and over 800 meters respectively.
Because they went into closed-door cultivation and upgraded their Mechas shortly after entering the relics, Jane Aiken’s Purple Kill Value was only a little over 22,000, and Gabriella, formerly number one, had just barely reached 30,000.
Soon, one figure after another rushed into the Road to Godhood, including Howard Lambert and the low-key genius, Carol Koch.
Especially Carol Koch appeared over 500 meters away, and the Purple Killing Energy gathering around him fell just short of earning an Origin reward, which was a pity.
Compared to Carney Turner, the top Second Grade talent from the Southern Battlefield, Howard Lambert with the Steel Pillar was only at just over 200 meters.
Suddenly, Mandy Lewis exclaimed, “Look, Jane Aiken is moving, so fast!”
After everyone stepped onto the Road to Godhood, all that the outside world saw were projections, standing motionless atop clouds that seemed to coalesce from white mist.
Just then, Jane Aiken’s figure suddenly moved, flashing to over 800 meters away in a few blinks of an eye.
At the same time, projections of Eddy Keller, Balderas, and others also began to change.
The sky was enveloped by dark clouds, the earth cracked, magma flowed, and in this Doomsday World, Jack Clark stood on a hillside, feeling the Origin that had disappeared inside his body.
This power was very special; after entering his body, it merged with his soul.
Because of his cultivation of the Illusion Meditation Scripture, Jack could vaguely sense that the eight streams of Origin were now ‘lurking’ deep within his soul.
However, this Origin power was on too high a level, currently beyond his reach.
What’s more important was that this Origin seemed to involve the soul, unlike the ancient aura that merged deep within the body and carried an ancient and desolate essence which the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon acquired.
“One involves the soul’s Transformation, and the other involves the body’s ancestral return, right?” Jack pondered.
Initially, when he heard that the World Origin was a special power necessary for humans to break through to king-level and could only be condensed in the mythical world, Jack had always thought that Origin was just the ancient aura.
After all, both human experts and giant beasts needed these special powers for evolution.
It turned out they weren’t the same.
Regardless, obtaining eight streams of Origin right from the start could be considered a great kick-off; now all that was left was to charge through everything.
With this in mind, Jack couldn’t help but look forward.
There in the distance stood a three-meter-tall middle-aged man dressed in grey training attire, wielding a five-meter-long combat knife and standing firm above the Scorching Magma, with an invisible but heavy Aura emanating from him.
This middle-aged man was a projection of a king-level expert, and currently, the cultivation aura he was emitting was also at the mid-stage of the seventh realm, just like Jack’s.
Between the two floated three one-meter-tall red runes, with tens of thousands of Rune Sequence Chains slowly revolving within them, seemingly revealing some cosmic truth to Jack.
“My Inheritance challenge is of the fighting kind, isn’t it?” Jack said slowly, his gaze fixed on the three sealing runes.
According to what Marcellus Larry said, one must comprehend these sealing runes within half an hour, or they will merge into the King’s Projection, each amplifying its strength by double.
But after only a few glances, Jack shook his head with a sigh, “As expected, comprehension and I are not meant to be; let’s just fight our way through.”
Those three runes enlarged, effectively laying their mysteries bare before Jack, who was confident that with half a day’s time, he could comprehend them with his talent for rune understanding.
The problem was, the challenge required it to be done in half an hour.
As for entering an epiphany state to quickly understand them, Jack thought it over and then gave up.
These three runes were just ordinary fire talent class, not worth burning attribute points on right now. Quality steel must be used on the edge of the blade, like in the third stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 679: 306 A Lone Rider Blasts Past the King_Level 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Chapter 306 A Lone Rider Blasts Past the King_Level 3
Boom!
Jack Clark’s brow shone with a red light, as a boundless blood light burst forth from him, covering an area of one hundred and fifty meters. The Doomsday Hell descended in an instant.
At the same time, Jack Clark’s will, shaking Heaven and Earth, soared into the sky, transforming into a twenty-meter high Blood-colored Demon Shadow exuding a ferocious and terrifying aura of destruction.
As the Demon Shadow emerged, the entire Doomsday Hell erupted into chaos, the Sea of Blood roared, and a power belonging to ‘Hell’ descended ominously.
But it wasn’t over.
With a thought from Jack Clark, a thirty-meter high Combat Shadow clad in black-red Scaled Armor materialized behind him, with three faces and six arms, the Halo rotating.
As soon as the Combat Shadow appeared, the War Intent Condensation of the Demon Shadow pounced onto it.
Boom!
In an instant, Heaven and Earth shook, the Void rang with a destructive roar, and as the crimson blood light flashed, the Combat Shadow underwent a transformation.
The golden flames surrounding the Combat Shadow turned blood red, the blue Thunder morphed into Blood Thunderclap, and the four slowly rotating rings of light behind its head were also dyed red.
Beyond that, the black-red Scaled Armor turned blood red, and sharp spikes grew from the shoulders, arm joints, and knee joints, looking fiercely menacing.
The previously vague face on the left became concentrated, still bearing the likeness of Jack Clark, with red Scales covering the face, and eyes burning with Black Flames, filled with cold and destruction.
Battle Demon God.
Facing the projection of a king of the same realm, about to be tripled in strength, Jack Clark immediately unleashed his peak battle power.
Boom!
Drawn by Jack Clark’s bursting energy, the middle-aged man in the distance suddenly opened his eyes as a terrifyingly scorching Blade Intent shot into the sky, boiling the seas and scorching the heavens.
At the same time, the three runes also glowed with red light, turning into three streaks of red that surged into the middle-aged man’s body.
In an instant, the middle-aged man’s aura tripled. From his position, an endless burst of firelight erupted, and the magma on the river surface exploded, with pillars of fire soaring into the sky.
“Kill!” The middle-aged man transformed into a red streak of light soaring into the sky, and with the grand accomplishment of the Sky-burning Sword Intent, he gathered the power of Heaven and Earth Flame and magma to form ten Flaming War Blades a hundred meters long each.
Boom boom boom!!
The scorching Flaming War Blades swept through the raging wind wave, and the invisible sharpness of the blades even melted the Void, slashing towards Jack Clark with earth-shattering momentum.
That is the power of a King’s Projection, even when the realm is suppressed at the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven.
At the moment when the Flaming War Blades descended, Jack Clark let out a long howl, and a Purple-red War Halberd one hundred and fifty meters long pierced the sky.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Under the Power of Hell, the Purple-red War Halberd was invincible, sweeping away all the Flaming War Blades in one strike and charging straight towards the middle-aged man.
Boom!
At the moment of the halberd and blade’s collision, the Purple-red War Halberd turned into a dazzling sun, exploding hundreds of meters in the high altitude, sending out ring after ring of splendid Energy Halos.
The terrifying explosion shook the entire world; under the formless impact, the Earth crumbled, magma and rocks flew, destroying everything.
Including the middle-aged man wielding the blade, who was shattered under this strike, imbued with the Power of Hell and True Dragon Power, instantly killed.
Amidst the violent Destructive Impact, Jack Clark stood holding his halberd, his gaze cold, unfazed by the outcome.
He had slain King Level projections or Avatars before, each possessing battle power far beyond their realm, but they still couldn’t withstand a single strike against the invincible him within the same level.
Meanwhile, on the Divine Road outside, the Void above Jack Clark shook as two Origin sources emitting White Light slowly descended, merging into his body.
His figure reappeared over two thousand five hundred meters away.
“Look, Jack’s moved, and he’s gained two more Origin sources,” Justin Welan exclaimed excitedly, as others also noticed the changes in Jack Clark.
“Ten Origin sources, he’s gotten ten Origin sources.”
“That’s just insane. The Divine Road has just begun, and he’s already got ten Origin sources, enough to break through to the king level when he reaches the Nine-fold Peak.”
At the mountain peak, the over seven hundred geniuses from various countries who were not qualified to enter all exhibited envy in their eyes.
Looking at the figure riding off alone, Crystal Lewis’s eyes flickered, “This guy’s future achievements will probably surpass everyone’s imagination.”
Mandy Lewis slowly nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 680: 307: Tiger Whale Traitor, Emperor Creation Era
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Chapter 307: Tiger Whale Traitor, Emperor Creation Era
As Jack Clark shattered the Knife-wielding King Projection with a halberd strike, two streams of Origin Power emerged from the Void amidst the raging wind of the violent explosion, slowly merging into his body.
Before Jack Clark had a chance to feel it thoroughly, suddenly, a strong sense of danger surged in his mind.
Heaven and Earth cracked open, as countless pitch-black cracks, stretching thousands of meters, tore through the Void, spreading like a spider’s web across the entire “world”.
Boom!
The power of the explosion in the small space was terrifying. Under the collapsing heavens and fissured Earth, rocks and magma were instantly shredded by the violent Spatial Storm, vanishing into the depths of the dark Void.
This scene was almost identical to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s breath fusion strike that destroyed the small world beneath the sea, the magnitude was horrifying.
However, protected by a Rule Power, Jack Clark stood tall in the Void, ignoring the Void Storm that destroyed everything around him, his figure constantly falling.
After falling through the Void for a few breaths, Jack Clark keenly felt that he had passed through something, and as the light brightened before his eyes, he appeared in another world.
This “world” had a sky that was a clear blue, and the Earth was vast, with hillsides covered in white flowers that resembled roses.
In the distance, the land rose, and a mountain range snaked across the horizon, its upper slopes covered in white snow, creating a stunningly beautiful scene.
In a sea of flowers a hundred meters away, a woman in a lavish gold and blue gown stood with her back to Jack Clark, seemingly admiring the stunning view of the blooming flowers before her.
Ahead, five white flowers, each a meter in diameter, hovered in the air, shining with red, blue, yellow, green, and golden light, invisibly emanating mysterious and harmonious vibrations.
As Jack Clark appeared, the time in this world, frozen under the rule of a Rule Power, began to flow again.
A gentle breeze swept through, swaying the sea of flowers, followed by a soft voice.
“The activation of this Will Projection suggests that my Human Race still couldn’t escape the Great Calamity. Youngster, could you tell me how many years have passed?”
As she spoke, the woman turned around, revealing her beautiful and dignified face. Her hair was tied in a phoenix bun, and a white lotus crown made her appear ethereally beautiful.
In contrast, standing amidst the Doomsday Purgatory and behind the towering figure of the Battle Demon God, Jack Clark looked like an invading demon from beyond the heavens, with a sky full of blood light around him.
He hadn’t expected this projection to have its own consciousness.
Jack Clark paused and slowly replied, “…I do not know how much time has passed. As for the ancient civilization, this era has no detailed records of it.”
The woman was slightly startled, then sighed deeply, “Was the destruction so complete? It seems that the emperor’s plan to open the Creation Era also failed.”
Creation Era. Jack Clark’s gaze flickered, “I am Jack Clark, born in the Eastern Summer Empire of the Human Federation. May I ask how to address you, Senior?”
“Young one, we are both of the Human Race, you needn’t be so formal with me.”
The dignified woman’s tone was gentle, “My name is too ancient, I barely remember it. All I know is that they called me the Empress of Mysterious Flame.”
“Seeing you reach the mid-period of the Seventh Layer at less than twenty years old, it seems that after the Great Calamity, our Human Race rose again.” The woman’s eyes showed relief as she spoke.
Jack Clark suddenly said, “Senior, I feel that there’s no need for us to fight this battle. How about I take you out to see the current civilization of the Human Race?”
“Compared to the peak progress and cultivation of the ancient times, modern civilization has also developed technology; it is splendid and certainly will not disappoint you, Senior.”
To Jack Clark, this woman was a living fossil, even more valuable than the so-called Monarch Inheritance.
As a King-level Strong One, her knowledge of that era, a complete cultivation system, and the various inheritances about runes were invaluable.
If he could obtain her assistance, humans’ cultivation systems might take another leap forward and become more perfected, enhancing the potential of the Human Race as a whole.
Having reached his current realm, Jack Clark was very aware that his destiny was now tied to the Human Race, hence his way of thinking had gradually begun to change.
Instead of focusing solely on his immediate surroundings, he had developed a broader perspective.
After all, there are no survivors under a fallen nest. If the Human Race were to lose the war against The Purgatory Family, and the world came to an end, all he could do was wander alone as a Giant Beast.
The Empress of Mysterious Flame smiled faintly, “I know what you’re thinking, but unfortunately, my existence is bound by the rules of Inheritance, and once you proceed, I will dissipate.”
“Also, when my original body cast this Law Power projection, the emperor had stripped it of other information.”
“The emperor once said that our inheritances are only meant to keep the flame of the Human Race alive. The new era has its own path and should not be shackled by the old one.”
“If we failed, it simply means that our civilizational path was not complete, not strong enough.”
“That’s why not only this path of Inheritance but also the entire Ruins Continent contains only the inheritance of ‘strength’. The rest of the civilization information has been wiped out by the emperor.”
Such magnanimity was indeed worthy of an Ancient Civilization Emperor. Jack Clark marveled inwardly.
At that moment, the Empress of Mysterious Flame said kindly, “There isn’t much time left. You should start comprehending the Five Elements Dao Scriptures, otherwise once the time of two incense sticks passes, my strength, augmented by the Five Elements, will become very strong.”
“Should you fail then, you will miss the chance to comprehend the World’s Power once more.”
“It’s a pity that I cannot hold back due to the rules. Otherwise, letting you proceed wouldn’t be an issue.” Facing Jack Clark, a descendant of the Human Race, the woman known as the Empress of Mysterious Flame was very affable.
Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “The matter of runes isn’t urgent, Senior. Who were your enemies back in the day? Why did they seek to annihilate the Human Race?”

chapters.title: Chapter 681: 307 Tiger Whale Traitor, Emperor Creation Era_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Chapter 307 Tiger Whale Traitor, Emperor Creation Era_2
Jack Clark was curious about the Ancient Civilization, seeing this rare opportunity, he wondered if he could extract more information.
As for the issue of the other party’s strength increase, as long as she was still at the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven in her cultivation, Jack had nothing to fear.
“Our enemy isn’t the Outer World, it’s our own world that’s having issues. The Heavenly Energy is drying up continuously, and the path of cultivation has been cut off,” she explained.
“Under such circumstances, the Seven Great Emperors devised two plans: to open a new Great Era world to transfer the Human Race and to plunder the World Origins of other worlds to delay the arrival of the end of law,” she revealed.
“From what I see, the second plan must have succeeded, otherwise, you wouldn’t have been able to resume cultivation,” he surmised.
No, Senior, both plans failed, and now we can cultivate because of the connection to the mythical world.
However, Jack didn’t say this and continued curiously, “Senior, how is the level of cultivation divided in the Ancient Civilization, is it also through the Nine Heavens?”
“Are you asking about how the realms are divided?” asked the Empress of Mysterious Flame, pondering.
“We divide the realms into twelve levels, comprising four major realms: Innate Body Forging, Blood Exchange and Marrow Cutting, Dao Fusion of Law, and Mythic King, these are collectively called the Twelve Realms of Primordial Confusion.”
“Above Primordial Confusion is the Emperor’s realm, where one controls the Rules, existing eternally and undying,” she explained.
At this point, the Empress of Mysterious Flame sighed slightly, “But in this world, who can truly be eternal and undying? At least the Emperors haven’t returned.”
While the two were conversing, the world around them gradually began to change, flames flickering in the sky and the sea of flowers on the ground starting to wither, releasing a chill.
In an instant, the Empress of Mysterious Flame’s expression turned serious: “The Rules are in motion. Quickly, younger generation, grasp the opportunity to comprehend the Dao scriptures.”
“No need, Senior. Since I started cultivation, my performance in cultural class hasn’t been very good. It’s simpler to get down to action directly,” he responded.
As he spoke, an extremely ferocious aura burst forth from Jack Clark, instantly shaking the Doomsday Hell that surrounded him, bright blood light flashing and dyeing Heaven and Earth in a sanguine hue.
A heavy and terrifying aura diffused, with the Earth cracking and shaking in all directions around Jack as its focal point, and small pebbles slowly lifting off the ground.
Behind him, the thirty-meter-tall Battle Demon Illusion roared towards the sky, with a Blood Moon illusion faintly visible behind it, which looked terrifying enveloped in blood light.
Since the Empress couldn’t take this Ancient King’s realm of thought out, Jack held nothing back, nor could he afford to.
After all, he had to defeat her to get through.
Witnessing Jack as if a Demon God had descended, an expression of awe appeared on the Empress of Mysterious Flame’s face: “Such a frightening aura, no wonder you don’t care about the Five Elements Dao Scriptures.”
As she spoke, the five white petals rotated rapidly, transforming into bands of five-colored light surrounding the Empress of Mysterious Flame, and her aura increased nearly ten-fold under the protection of the Five Elements.
The combined amplification of the five sealing runes was not simply additive; it became stronger as they overlapped.
Roar Roar!!
Flames burned in the sky, with fire dragons hundreds of meters long descending from above, and on Earth, countless ice crystal petals danced, turning into ice dragons of equal length.
Dozens of fire and ice dragons circled around, emitting a terrifying aura that vibrated the Void, making the Empress of Mysterious Flame look like a Goddess controlling Divine Dragons, a myth come to life.
“Is this the strength of an Ancient strong man?” Jack felt a bit more serious as he sensed the Empress of Mysterious Flame’s pressure, which was comparable to the Late Eighth Layer.
Moreover, the power system she displayed seemed to be quite different from theirs.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Dozens of flame and ice dragons let out ferocious roars, conjuring cold gales and scorching waves as they pounced towards Jack, their momentum wild as if they were real Eighth Level Beasts.
Facing such an onslaught, the radiance emitted from the Purple-red War Halberd in Jack’s hand swept across, and simultaneously, the Fighting War Demon Illusion behind him wielded a hundred-meter-long War Halberd sweeping as well.
Boom! With a surge of blood light, a hundred-meter-tall ring of light rapidly expanded, colliding with each of the oncoming ice and fire dragons.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The all-encompassing light ring shattered everything in its path, and when it reached its limit, it exploded violently, spewing infinite sharp halberd skills, annihilating everything around it.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Just then, in the heavens and the Earth, dozens of flame and ice dragons once again coalesced, and under the Empress of Mysterious Flame’s command, they began to intertwine and merge.
Within the blink of an eye, nine destructive dragons, each over one hundred and fifty meters long, formed by the fusion of ice and fire and radiating an even more fearsome aura, appeared.
These nine dragons of destruction twined through the air, leaving behind trails of black scars, piercing through the Void with their menacing presence.
Amidst the turbulent waves of energy, the Empress of Mysterious Flame looked towards Jack in the distance and slowly said, “Junior, be careful. This is my final move, Nine Dragons Annihilation.”
Roar! As the Empress of Mysterious Flame finished speaking, the nine dragons of destruction roared fiercely, soaring into the sky with overwhelming might above Jack Clark’s head.
Boom!
A ring of fire, covering a three-hundred-meter radius, descended from the sky; within the fire dome, Ice Flames emitting a Destructive Aura spun.
Before it even touched the ground, the invisible force of distortion crushed the Earth below, spinning it into a massive gravitational tornado that sucked countless shattered stones into the fire dome to be destroyed.
At that moment, below, a blood light flooded the sky as a two-hundred-meter-long, Purple-red War Halberd, sealing the Doomsday Hell on one side, soared into the sky, carrying the power of a shattered world as it charged towards the nine dragon fire dome.
In the satisfied gaze of the Empress of Mysterious Flame, the Halberd collapsed the Void and destroyed everything in its path. A violent explosion appeared in the sky in an instant, like a nuclear explosion at high altitude.
Boom!
In this ‘world’ where Heavenly Energy was rich, Jack Clark’s strength could be fully unleashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 682: 307: Tiger Whale Traitor, Emperor Creation Era_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Chapter 307: Tiger Whale Traitor, Emperor Creation Era_3
The Combat Shadow’s fourteenfold and Prison Blood War Intent’s fivefold True Strength amplification stacked together.
Additionally, with the augmentation of Power of Hell and the second amplification resulting from the fusion of Combat Shadow and Demon Shadow, Jack’s full-force strike had already exceeded a normal late Eight Layer level.
However, there was still a small gap from the peak of the Eight Layer unless he entered the Fighting War Demon God Form.
After his last battle’s limit breakthrough, Jack’s normal full-force strength was already on par with the late Eight Layer, and when entering his strongest form, he was no less than the Eight Layer peak.
As the Empress of Mysterious Flame’s shadow slowly dissipated, Jack’s figure in the Void overhead shone once more, with four Origins slowly descending, directly placing him three thousand meters away.
Justin Welan’s eyes instantly brightened, somewhat excited, “Four Origins, three thousand meters away, Jack has already passed the King’s Road.”
“He’s so strong; he must have obtained fourteen Origins by now, right?”
“This guy is too powerful, managing to pass the second phase in such a short time.”
“Isn’t that obvious? Passing the second phase only represents King-level potential; this guy will surely reach the Heavenly King level and may cross the third phase very soon.”
Looking at the indistinct figure now standing three kilometers away, many people on the mountain peak platform were filled with astonishment and envy.
While Jack was crossing two stages and directly leaped over the King’s Road, the others were also making progress.
For instance, Balderas and Eddy Keller also reached more than one thousand five hundred meters away, with Brudos closely following behind.
And ahead of them, Damon Lopes, who had declared everyone else “garbage,” had walked the Peak Road at a remarkable speed, appearing one thousand meters away.
Suddenly, an Origin emerged above Damon Lopes, slowly descending onto him.
Seeing this scene, Justin Welan felt somewhat envious, “That guy deserves to be an Innate Awakened One; he’s crossed the first phase so quickly.”
Apart from him, several other individuals also showed astonishing speed.
For example, Jane Aiken was also approaching one thousand meters, on the verge of passing the Peak Road, and familiar faces like Carol Koch and Betty Leinster were also making steady progress.
Most of this group who had slain Void Creatures and accumulated one thousand Purple Evil to step on the Road to Becoming a God, have potential for the Nine Layers; the first phase poses hardly any significant difficulty to them.
The challenging part is the second phase of the King’s Projection.
For instance, Eddy Keller, who was now watching intently ahead, saw a white-clothed young man standing relaxedly with arms behind his back, exuding the aura of a late Seventh Layer level.
The opponents he faced were all at the late Seventh Layer level; under the same realm, almost all these king’s projections possessed the strength to cross a Major Realm.
For example, the one he had defeated earlier had the combat power of a Mid-eighth level; if he hadn’t comprehended the runes within half an hour, defeating the opponent would have been extremely difficult.
And the aura of this new Projection was similar to the last one, but with two sealing runes revolving between them.
If Eddy Keller couldn’t understand the runes within half an hour and gain a double amplification, these sealing runes would enhance the opponent’s strength, making things troublesome.
This was why the likes of Joshua Welan, who at around twenty years old already had Eight or even Nine Layer cultivation, didn’t come. It becomes much harder to battle across realms after reaching the Eight or Nine Layers, especially since everyone is a top-notch genius with rich intrinsic foundations, not to mention king-level projections.
In this case, it’s the talents with a lower realm, like the Sixth or early Seventh Layer, who have a greater advantage.
Because the lower the power realm, the less difficult it is to fight across realms.
Outside the relic, Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner both showed anticipation in their eyes.
“Jack has already entered the third phase of the Road of Heavenly Kings, starting to comprehend the world; let’s hope he succeeds within one day, as this is a rare opportunity.”
Lori Joyner spoke slowly, “If he could create a Top-tier Secret Manual within a month, his enlightenment shouldn’t be low, and he likely stands a chance.”
Having the potential of a Heavenly King doesn’t guarantee becoming one, including many geniuses with King-level potential from the past, many of whom perished mid-way or fell from grace.
The third phase of the Road to Becoming a God was an opportunity to touch the Heavenly King Realm.
Although it was just one evolution, as long as one passed this test, it was essentially like obtaining a seed, a Heavenly King seed that would sprout at the peak of the king’s power.
…
The raging wind howled, and the waves surged on the sea surface as a dozen or so Mutated Tiger Whales, ranging from ten to forty meters in length, constantly breached the water, surrounding a school of Mutated Fish.
With selective hunting by these Mutated Tiger Whales, Mutated Fish at the peak of Level 2 and Level 3 were continuously killed.
However, after killing the Mutated Fish, these Mutated Tiger Whales did not eat them but collected them and brought them to a fifty-one-meter-long Black Tiger Whale nearby.
Soon, this sea area was dyed red with blood.
As around twenty or so peak-level Mutated Fish were killed, the Tiger Whales opened up the encirclement, allowing thousands of lower-level Mutated Fish, mainly Level 1, to flee.
Roar! Three Generals, there are not many Mutated Fish that have reached the peak.
The leader, a Mutated Tiger Whale in the Late Level 6 phase, approached Tiger Whale Third Brother with a reverent low moan.
The Black Mutated Tiger Whale swung its tail, Roar! No matter, we have lots of time, everyone rest for a while, and then we’ll find the next school of fish.
Just as Mutated Tiger Whale Third Brother was looking at the twenty or so low-level Mutated Fish corpses with satisfaction, preparing to tear and collect the crystals, a terrifying pressure enveloped all the Tiger Whales.
From the dark sea below, a Level 9 Giant Beast, over two hundred meters in length, resembling an ancient Sea Dragon and covered in Blue Scales, slowly emerged.
Under the bloodline pressure of the Mid Level 9 beast, approaching that of a Monarch, every Mutated Tiger Whale trembled, not daring to move, including Tiger Whale Third Brother.
Of course, Tiger Whale Third Brother feigned his shivering, for it was a giant beast that had been baptized by the Emperor level pressure of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
The Sea Dragon giant beast gazed coldly at the group of Tiger Whales, then its gaze fell on Tiger Whale Third Brother and it let out a deep roar, “You, are you the leader of these Mutated Creatures?”
Tiger Whale Third Brother ‘trembled’ and replied in a low voice, Roar! Yes, may I ask what you would like from me, great one?
The Sea Dragon giant beast was quite pleased with its fear and growled slowly, “In the sea area ahead, is there a Behemoth Empire Forces known as Dragon Palace?”
Tiger Whale Third Brother nodded quickly.
Roar! Yes, there is a giant beast power, and those guys are really brutal, often carrying out massacres on the surrounding creatures, very terrifying.
The Sea Dragon giant beast’s cold gaze persisted as it continued to roar, “If those Giant Beasts are so brutal, why are you still in this sea area?”
Roar! I am currently leading my group to migrate away.
This place was already on the edge of the Dragon Palace territory, a good two thousand kilometers from the Water and Fire World of the Dragon Palace, so it did indeed seem like they were truly migrating.
At that moment, Tiger Whale Third Brother filled with murderous intent, spoke fiercely.
Roar! Those detestable Giant Beasts killed my father, when I grow up, I will definitely lead my group to come back for revenge.
“Roar! Those Giant Beasts killed your father,” the Sea Dragon giant beast’s gaze shifted slightly.
Tiger Whale Third Brother nodded fiercely, Roar! Yes, they killed my father, I must take revenge, I must defeat that Black and White Dragon King.
Roar! That guy is also a Tiger Whale giant beast, I will definitely defeat it and become the only Overlord of the Tiger Whales in the ocean.
Looking at the Black little Tiger Whale before him and hearing about the Black and White Dragon King from its mouth, the Sea Dragon glanced at the group of ordinary Mutated Tiger Whales at the fourth and fifth grades, then suddenly roared.
“Roar! Do you want to become stronger, do you want power?”
Tiger Whale Third Brother’s eyes lit up, nodding quickly, Roar! Yes, I want to become stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 683: 308: Taking Charge of the World, Law Heaven and Phenomenon Earth (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Chapter 308: Taking Charge of the World, Law Heaven and Phenomenon Earth (Seeking Monthly Votes)
“`
Deep beneath the sea, Tiger Whale Third Brother gazed at the stream carrying a 1-meter diameter black-red fruit. Saliva unconsciously dripped from his mouth.
The Sea Dragon Giant Beast slowly growled, “Roar! This is a Divine Object from the Vast World. Consuming it will enable you to grow rapidly and significantly enhance your strength.”
“As long as you join the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire and complete the task of collecting information on the Dragon Palace, you can come to me to claim a Divine Fruit every ten days.”
Roar! I’ll join, I want to join the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, I want to grow stronger, I want to smash the King of Black and White.
Without a second thought, Tiger Whale Third Brother nodded excitedly.
As for the other ordinary Mutated Tiger Whales, they were shaking in fear under the pressure of the Level 9 Giant Beast, their eyes filled with terror.
The Sea Dragon Giant Beast nodded in satisfaction, “Very good, go ahead and eat.”
With that, the currents sent that fruit from the mythical world floating toward Tiger Whale Third Brother.
Feeling the seductive aura of that black-red fruit, along with a devouring impulse from his biological instincts, Tiger Whale Third Brother didn’t think twice before swallowing it whole.
As for poison, after breaking through to Level 7, awakening a king-level bloodline, and acquiring the Advanced Talent of Swallowing Stomach, he could digest all matter and energy.
Boom! A fierce and vast energy exploded in the Swallowing Stomach of Tiger Whale Third Brother, instantly making the black Tiger Whale’s aura of a ferocious and tyrannical Giant Beast spread all around.
This leader of the Mutated Tiger Whale Group seems to have quite a talent.
Feeling the king-level bloodline aura emanating from the black Tiger Whale, along with its special and dangerous ability, the Sea Dragon showed a hint of surprise in its eyes.
Once this mission is over and I return, I should consider introducing it to His Majesty, the Sea Dragon Giant Beast mused.
After the battle with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, due to the Scale of Laws of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire mistakenly believed that a Mythical Giant Beast was supporting the Dragon Palace from behind.
Therefore, the Black Oblivion King did not come down directly, as it was not yet willing to start a war with another Mythical Giant Beast, especially when it felt the opponent might be stronger than itself.
Furthermore, with the Black-red Colossal Beast that had defeated the quasi-mythical Sword Dragon Giant Beast present, the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire has temporarily taken no action.
However, the two sides have already become enemies, so the Black Oblivion King sent over the relatively weaker Sea Dragon Giant Beast to monitor the movements of the Dragon Palace.
To avoid alarming the enemy, the Black Oblivion King had the Sea Dragon Giant Beast subdue some ‘lower-level’ Mutated Beasts as spies, which was safer.
And then it encountered this group of Mutated Tiger Whales on the periphery of the Dragon Palace.
According to Sword Dragon Giant Beast’s description, the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire had four Dragon Kings, namely the Nine-Headed Dragon King and the Thunderflame Dragon King, two Giant Beasts at the beginning stage of Level 9.
However, the King of the Dragon Palace was a Silver Giant Dragon with a Myth bloodline at the late period of Growth Level 8.
In addition, there was another Level 8 Giant Spawn Fish known as the King of Black and White, with four Level 7 Tiger Whale creatures and one Level 7 Crab creature under its command.
This was all the information the Sea Dragon Giant Beast had.
This group of Tiger Whales only had one that reached Level 7, and the rest were even weaker ordinary Mutated Creatures, ruling out the possibility of them being from the Dragon Palace.
Moreover, the Sea Dragon could sense that when the Unique Beast Tiger Whale roared about defeating the King of Black and White, there was a strong and genuine persistence in its heart.
This was why it believed the other party, and it happened to need a spy.
Over half an hour later, with most of the energy absorbed, Tiger Whale Third Brother grew to a size of fifty-five meters, emanating an even more powerful aura.
“Roar! Off you go, to that sea area to collect more detailed information on the Dragon Palace, including what those Giant Beasts are usually doing and which regions they occupy.”
“The more information you gather, the more Divine Objects you can get from me to increase your strength.”
Feeling the power within him that was now much stronger than the boss’s, Tiger Whale Third Brother excitedly nodded: Roar! Let’s do this, I’m going to defeat the King of Black and White, charge.
Saying that, Tiger Whale Third Brother led the group of Mutated Tiger Whales towards the Dragon Palace, full of momentum and without a trace of fear.
The Sea Dragon Giant Beast watched this scene with great satisfaction.
It valued this quality.
Although the black Tiger Whale was somewhat flustered beneath its formidable aura, the indomitable spirit hidden in its eyes was keenly noticed by the Sea Dragon Giant Beast.
It was a ferocious and wild Level 7 Mutant Creature, which, even when facing Level 9 lifeforms, held a rebellious heart – it had great potential and was well-suited to be a spy.
…
The Earth was crisscrossed with mountain ranges, and volcanoes erupted, sending towering black smoke pillars into the sky, turning into clouds of poisonous gas that obscured the Firmament.
Between these volcanoes, hot magma flowed, converging into fire dragons spreading across the Earth.
This was a volcano-infested Doomsday World – oppressive, scorching, silent.
At that moment, the clouds in the sky suddenly dispersed, forming a hollow surrounded by dark clouds, as a streak of golden Radiance descended from the sky.
Boom!
The volcano mouth hundreds of meters tall collapsed, and amid billowing smoke and dust, Jack’s figure emerged, with the Doomsday Hell of glowing blood enveloping him, dispelling the rolling black smoke.
As Jack looked around, feeling the intensifying reality of the heavens and earth, a stream of golden light appeared and gently floated down into his palm.
Instantly, a rush of information flooded into his mind.
It told him that within one day of the Path of the Gods descending, he must comprehend the World of Incinerating Silence, take control of the world’s power, and slay the Boundary Guardian Lifeform that had been sealed.
Boundary Guardian Lifeform.
Jack looked into the distance, where a volcano thousands of meters tall stood, but instead of spewing magma from its mouth, it was plugged by a Colossal Beast.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 684: 308: Taking Charge of the World, Law Heavenly Phenomenon (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: Chapter 308: Taking Charge of the World, Law Heavenly Phenomenon (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
That was a monstrous beast surrounded by black flames, resembling a black phoenix, massive in size, slumbering beneath a seal.
“It’s actually a Level 9 Giant Beast,” Jack Clark’s expression suddenly became solemn.
With his current strength, he was far from Level 9, unless he summoned the projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Hum! At this moment, a mysterious power from between heaven and earth descended and materialized around Jack, forming an illusory flame world with a diameter of several hundred meters.
Within this area, the years of the world changed, from nothingness to the birth of matter, followed by the convergence of scorching energy beneath the earth, ultimately leading to a volcanic eruption.
This was the core origin of ‘the world,’ with every point of matter’s birth imbued with the mysteriousness of heaven and earth.
Next, as long as Jack could comprehend even a bit and invoke the resonance of this slice of heaven and earth with his spiritual will, he could receive the law’s blessing from this world.
Only with the law’s blessing might someone who has entered this inheritance have a hope of defeating the Black Flame Phoenix Monstrosity that has had its strength sealed to Level 9, despite being two major realms higher.
“Is this the opportunity to comprehend the world she mentioned?” Excitement flickered in Jack’s eyes.
Although what he sensed this time was only the origin projection of a small world, the chance to genuinely touch the laws, especially complete laws, was extremely precious.
And this challenge still depended on enlightenment and fighting prowess, as well as the soul’s capacity to bear the load.
The higher one’s enlightenment, the more profound the comprehension of the heavenly earthly laws they could invoke, and the stronger the blessing received.
The stronger the soul, the more potent law power it could withstand; otherwise, even if they fully understood the origin of the world before them, their strength would not increase much due to their inability to bear it.
Of course, if the enlightenment is inadequate and the soul is not robust, but one’s absolute fighting power could cross two major realms, they could still smash the guardian beast.
But such a monster capable of crossing boundaries and fighting after high-order levels is almost impossible to exist.
That kind of terrifying cross-realm fighting ability only exists below high-order levels.
For example, when Jack Clark was at the late stages of the Sixth Heavenly Stage, he managed to blast the Akunus Avatar, which had transformed into the Nine-headed Blood Python, by crossing two major realms, but it was also somewhat fortunate that he won at that time.
Because the opponent was not a complete early stage of the Eight Layer, and Jack’s limit burst had a time constraint then.
Now, after breaking through to the Seventh Layer, the thought of fighting across two major realms is nearly as impossible as ascending to heaven, unless he waits until his cultivation reaches the peak of the Seventh Layer, where there might be a glimpse of hope.
And that’s only for clashing with a ‘normal’ early stage of Nine Layers.
There’s no way around it, the gap between the Eighth Layer and the Ninth is too vast, with various abilities fused and unified, and level 9 lifeforms with stronger domains almost crushing in all aspects.
With this in mind, Jack’s voice echoed in his mind: “Burn 1000 points attribute, enter the state of enlightenment.”
Boom!
Under the state of epiphany, Jack’s thought process and comprehension ability became extremely exaggerated in an instant, especially those flashes of insight that occasionally crossed his mind, which accelerated his understanding tremendously.
Outside, just as Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner thought Jack would slow down his pace and temporarily stop at the 3000 meters spot, suddenly Jack took a step forward, striding ahead.
“He has comprehended the ‘world’ so quickly!” Marcellus Larry was astonished.
The distance of the projection manifested in the outside world indicated the progress of Jack’s comprehension of the World’s Power, thereby surprising both Marcellus Larry and Lori Joyner even more.
That was comprehending a whole world, after all.
Although it’s just a small world, isn’t your Seven Layer Heaven cultivation level a bit too showy, a little guy like you, given the realm difference?
If it were a Ninth Heaven Expert with this speed of comprehension, they could still reluctantly accept it.
While Jack moved forward, other participants were progressing continuously.
Within an hour, more than twenty people had crossed the first stage of The Peak Road, indicating that these geniuses had at least the potential of the Nine Layers.
And the top-tier talents at this event didn’t disappoint, such as Simon’s Gabriella, who continued to advance at a rapid pace after rushing into the Second Stage Road of Kings.
“Matrix data analysis in motion, consciousness link, supercomputer operation initiated…”
In front of a forty-meter tall ancient golden battle puppet emanating the aura of the early stages of the Seven Layer, a complex three-dimensional figure in the likeness of a human slowly rotated in mid-air.
Not far away, Gabriella, piloting her black and white Mecha, stood tall with scanning light beams of various colors emanating from its eyes, covering and analyzing the three-dimensional figure.
After linking her consciousness with a supercomputer, Gabriella’s computational abilities became terrifyingly potent.
Coupled with the data computation matrix, image scanning, and lightwave scanning systems she herself invented, she nearly perfectly duplicated the puppet formation in front of her.
Perhaps a Mech Martial Practitioner, compared to the True Martial Way, lags slightly behind in ethereal comprehension of heavenly and earthly phenomena, but they certainly have an absolute advantage in terms of computational ability.
Less than ten minutes in, Gabriella completed the analysis of this set of puppet rune formations, and her spiritual will spread to the core point of the formation ahead.
Hum!
The slowly rotating formation vibrated, rapidly expanding, transforming into a massive network of light that enveloped the black-white Demon King Mech, instantly doubling the energy fluctuation emitted by the Mecha.
This was the correct way of The King’s Road. By successfully comprehending the runes, the inheritor would receive double the power of the rune force to pass the challenge with stronger strength.
Of course, if they failed, it would be the opponent that became stronger. Only the likes of Jack, who just smashed through everything without a care… were too few.
Boom! The giant Mecha and ancient battle puppet erupted into a fierce battle…
While Gabriella advanced swiftly, Jane Aiken, with her terrifying talent and enlightenment, remained stationary at the 1000 meters threshold upon entering the King’s Road.
At the center of the Bamboo Sea, a figure exuding the aura of the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage sat with its back to them, emitting an almost imperceptible yet sharp Sword Intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 685: 308: Taking Control of the World, As If By Divine Law and Earthly Phenomenon (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Chapter 308: Taking Control of the World, As If By Divine Law and Earthly Phenomenon (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
Between the king-level projection and Jane Aiken, a 3-meter-tall, sword-shaped red rune floated, with rune sequence chains slowly rotating inside.
Watching the floating blood-colored sword mark, Jane Aiken’s eyes flickered with light, and after just a few minutes, her face revealed a mix of surprise and delight.
Because this Blood Refining Sword Mark was quite special, it could be inscribed into a sword through blood refinement, giving the battle sword a feature similar to a “Flying Sword”.
With this thought, Jane Aiken’s Sumeru Bracelet shimmered, and four intermediate-grade Transcendent Battleswords, each 2 meters long, appeared.
Jane Aiken was poor; when Jack Clark originally left the Southern Battlefield, she only had a low-grade ordinary Transcendent battle sword in her hand.
Latter, as the Road to Becoming a God was about to open and the list was decided, everyone received a certain tilt of resources, like these four intermediate-grade Transcendent battle swords.
Jane Aiken gripped a battle sword by the hilt, her fingers lightly brushing the blade, allowing crimson blood to flow out.
Using blood as the guide, Sword Intent as the brush, and True Strength as the ink, Jane Aiken quickly drew a complete Blood Refining Sword Mark on the blade, then surged True Strength into it.
Hu!
The battle sword’s blood shone brightly, igniting into blood-colored flames that blazed…
And this was precisely the objective of the Path of Inheritance, to bestow relevant inheritances while testing those who dared to venture.
For example, the first opponent Jack Clark encountered contained flame runes, as well as subsequent elemental runes, which somewhat matched his attributes.
It was just that his attributes were too complex, possessing an unrivaled bodily strength combined with Divine Might, strength, Defense, thunder, flames, and various talents.
“Why has Jane Aiken been standing there for so long?” Justin Welan was somewhat puzzled.
Crystal Lewis also frowned slightly, “Indeed, with Jane Aiken’s enlightenment talent, she shouldn’t be stopping there, right? Gabriella has already reached 1,900 meters.”
Suddenly, a scream resounded from the Road to Godhood; at the 900-meter mark, a Berlin Genius who had transformed into a 10-meter-tall Unique Beast vomited blood.
Then, the clouds at his feet dissipated, and he plummeted and disappeared from sight.
The sudden change startled everyone: “This isn’t good.”
“Carney Turner is dead?!”
The transparent Eye of Void in the sky conveyed Marcellus Larry’s calm voice: “Don’t panic, everyone. He just failed the trial and was ejected from the Void Relics.”
As Marcellus Larry spoke, the Earth below twisted in space, and the Berlin Genius landed on the ground with a thud, his pale face showing bitterness.
Because he hadn’t even made it through The Peak Road.
As time passed, everyone continued to press forward; soon enough, more than two hours went by, revealing the growing gap between the participants.
The fastest, Eddy Keller, Damon Lopes, and Balderas had already reached 2,300 meters.
This was Jack Clark’s starting point; they only had two more challenges to overcome to complete the King’s Road.
The second group comprised Gabriella, who had just obtained another Origin, Brudos, and two other older geniuses, all positioned at 2,000 meters.
Whereas, the area between 1,000 to 1,500 meters was more crowded, with more than forty people, including Betty Leinster, Carol Koch, who all crossed The Peak Road within one hour.
As for Jane Aiken, she was still hovering around 1,600 meters.
As the trials progressed, individuals periodically failed The Peak Road and King’s Road, with their clouds collapsing beneath them.
While these contestants endeavored, Jack Clark had already reached over 5,000 meters, his figure almost obscured by the clouds and mist at high altitude, appearing very blurry.
“What’s called suppressing an era, this is it, hahaha… After this relic event, Jack will rightfully become the Federation’s new number one of the younger generation.”
Watching Jack Clark, who raced ahead, becoming more distant, Justin Welan was very excited, taking pride in Jack’s achievements.
After all, this was his best friend, and with Jack’s terrifying rate of progress, it wouldn’t be long before Justin Welan could cling to a powerful ‘big leg’ once more.
Thinking of this made Justin Welan even happier.
Clutching onto two such ‘big legs’, combined with his own genius, it seemed unlikely for him to not become a king in his life.
While Justin Welan joyfully envisioned a glorious future, Mandy Lewis felt somewhat emotional, “Who would have thought, in just over half a year, he would grow to this extent.”
As she spoke, the image of a young man in a white t-shirt, with a sunny and gentle smile by Moon Lake, flashed in her mind.
That was the first time she met Jack Clark, before which, she had only heard about him from her sister, Crystal Lewis.
More than three hours later, Jack Clark had reached 6,800 meters.
Beneath his feet, the white cloud path delved into the Void, surrounded by swirling mists, visible only to Marcellus Larry, Lori Joyner, and those ejected from the relics.
“This guy is too monstrous,” Jasper Forbes said with a complex gaze.
He had only managed to reach the second challenge on the King’s Road, while this youth, two grades his junior, was advancing farther and farther on the Road of Heavenly Kings.
In the Doomsday World, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, with a scorching Lava World slowly revolving in his gaze.
Jack Clark turned his head slightly, looking towards the Giant Beast perched atop the volcano mouth in the distance, his eyes filled with intense Battle Intent, “Crossing two major realms, is it?”
Boom!
Jack Clark suddenly stood up, a terrifying will bursting forth from him, as his Spiritual Will materialized behind him, shaping into an illusory Scorching Lava World.
