In an instant, the world trembled, resonating with Heaven and Earth, as the Law Power representing this world descended.
Zhui!
Amidst the trembling world, the Black Flame Phoenix slumbering in the distance awakened. Its double wings furiously unfurled, an endless tide of Black Flames erupted, giving off an earth-shaking phoenix cry.
As the endless Law Power descended, Jack Clark’s War Demon Illusion behind him swelled up, transforming into a hundred-meter-tall spiritual image in a blink.
“Not enough!” Feeling the ‘pressure’ from his soul, Jack Clark let out a long howl and lunged into the Devil God Illusion behind him.
Boom!
As even more magnificent Law Power descended, the Fight Demon God, as the external manifestation of Jack Clark’s soul, continued to expand, two hundred meters, three hundred meters…

chapters.title: Chapter 686: 309 Nether Heavenly King, True Demon God
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Chapter 309 Nether Heavenly King, True Demon God
“`
In the world of lava, with the addition of the world’s laws, the materialized Battle Demon God inflated like a balloon, quickly surpassing three hundred meters.
And it didn’t stop there. Under Jack Clark’s continuous guidance of the Law Power, the Battle Demon God soon exceeded four hundred meters, five hundred meters…
Moreover, as its form expanded, the aura emitted by the Battle Demon God also surged violently, charging up to the Late Eighth Layer, then with a booming noise crossed into the Ninth Layer.
In an instant, streams of blood-colored thunder roared in the firmament, and within a kilometer range of Doomsday Hell, blood-colored flames burned, rendering half of the heaven and earth a crimson red.
At this moment, the Battle Demon God standing in Doomsday Hell truly possessed a bit of a Demonic God’s Might, its terrifying pressure bursting the surrounding air and forming layers of white waves.
However, when the Battle Demon God’s expanding body reached over five hundred meters, the growth slowed down and eventually stopped at close to six hundred meters.
Because there was no Law Power left.
No, I haven’t reached my limit yet, how can you be out? The six-hundred-meter-tall Battle Demon God that was Jack Clark was a bit dumbfounded.
He had wanted to see where the limit of his soul was, but the Law Power of this small world had already been exhausted, barely amplifying him to the Late Stages of Nine Layers.
Because of the influence of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark was particularly sensitive to the intensity of strength and could have a rough sense of his current power.
It’s just that the Battle Demon God at this moment was like a blown-up balloon, looking six hundred meters tall and imposing, but in reality, it was somewhat empty.
And Jack Clark’s realm was still Seventh Layer Heaven, including all kinds of talents and True Dragon Power, except that under the Law amplification, the might of even his casual movements had reached the stage of Late Period Nine Layers.
After feeling the strength for a while, Jack Clark then shifted his attention to the laws wrapped around his soul.
Sensing the ‘pressure’ from the intangible soul, Jack Clark thoughtfully said, “This Law Power, the carrying pressure it brings is probably about ten times.”
Based on this, Jack Clark did some calculations, approximately five times the base soul strength was needed to take advantage of Law amplification and raise the cultivation from mid period of Seventh Layer to around Early Stage Nine Layers.
By then, his victory was essentially assured when battling a behemoth sealed to Early Stage 9.
After all, every genius who had come this far had the ability to fight beyond their level, even at Nine Layers able to cross over a small boundary.
“No wonder that demon king named Kautorus wanted to kill me desperately after sensing that my soul strength exceeded five times,” he murmured.
Chiu!
Just as Jack Clark was basking in his soaring power, far away in the sky covered by endless black flames, a Black Flame Phoenix with a wingspan over four hundred meters let out a fierce cry from within the sea of fire.
Boom!
Riding the sky full of black flames, the Black Flame Phoenix flapped its wings, and its nearly three-hundred-meter-long body lunged at supersonic speed toward the figure of the Demon God standing atop the volcano.
Before getting close, the black fireballs coalescing in the sky began to fall like meteors, each fireball a hundred meters in diameter, obscuring the sky.
But as soon as these Black Flame fireballs got near Jack Clark, they were blasted apart by the blood-colored thunder permeating the space between heaven and earth, appearing from afar like hundreds of meters wide black fireworks.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Layers of circular white impacts exploded outwards, the destruction they caused rivaling high-yield missiles, but even before they could get close, they were blocked by the Hell Domain spanning a kilometer.
Boom!
Two giant claws engulfed in black flames descended from the sky, tearing through the domain to appear above the Battle Demon God, their flames covering the sky.
For Creatures of Level 9, the strongest asset was still their formidable bodies.
Especially flying-type behemoths which had lightning-fast speed, not to mention one with the bloodline of a phoenix, which could almost reach the state of instantaneous teleportation with the help of the pervasive Black Flames.
But as the massive double claws fell, they were met by an eight-hundred-meter long Purple-red War Halberd wrapped in blood-colored flames and thunder.
Boom!
Under the might of the War Halberd, nearly as massive as a mountain, the domain of Black Flames surrounding the Phoenix was shattered, its seemingly indestructible feathers bursting, accompanied by a pained screech.
The enormous body of the behemoth was then sent flying backward by an Unrivaled Domineering Power, crashing into a volcano thousands of meters away amidst a trail of firelight.
Instantly the volcano collapsed, magma mixed with black flames erupted high into the air, and the Earth shook with the magnitude of the collapse.
Observing the rolling smoke and dust in the distance, the Battle Demon God holding a halberd stood enclosed by Hell, having an icy expression on both faces, feeling no surprise whatsoever.
Because this Late Stage 9 behemoth had its strength suppressed to the level of an Early Stage by the rules, after all, its opponent was a “Seventh Layer Heaven” Trial Taker.
But Jack Clark was just too abnormal
With his strength nearly at a Late Stage 9 level, it was far too normal for him to easily overpower an Early Stage.
As for the issue of losing control due to the immense clash of powers, that was impossible for Jack Clark, because his ‘true’ strength was at the Peak of Level 9.
Although the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon on the other side relied entirely on his beast body and the physical talents for strength, the experience in controlling strength from that was still useful for Jack Clark.
If not for choosing the path of the world’s laws as a human, even without the Attribute Panel, Jack Clark’s cultivation speed would be astonishing just by leveraging the comparison of dual forces.
Just then, the distant collapsing volcano suddenly exploded, and the myriad of debris that hadn’t yet scattered was burned to ash by the black flames.
Chiu! The Black Flame Phoenix let out an enraged roar and with a flap of its wings, stirred up a sky of flames and once again lunged at Jack Clark.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 687: 309 Nether Heavenly King, True. Demon God_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Chapter 309 Nether Heavenly King, True. Demon God_2
However, this time it didn’t charge directly at him, but appeared above the ten thousand meters altitude, with infinite black flames revolving around it as the center, forming a vortex of dark clouds.
Standing at the center of the Black Flame Vortex, the Black Flame Phoenix, with mouth full of sharp teeth, roared furiously; in an instant, dazzling black radiance gathered.
Boom!
A ten-meter-diameter beam of black energy burst forth, rapidly expanding as it absorbed the endless black flames in its path, turning into a hundred-meter-thick pillar of fire that pierced through heaven and earth.
But just as the black smoky fire pillar was about to descend, the figure of the Battle Demon God suddenly vanished with terrifying speed.
Boom!
The volcano erupted, instantaneously crumbling under the violent eruption of black flames, while even the scorching magma turned into black dust and dissipated under the smoke.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Black Flame Breath fire pillar swept across the earth under the turning gaze of the Black Flame Phoenix, pursuing the fleeting shadow of the Demon God, shattering the ground and collapsing volcanoes wherever it passed.
With the Agility Talent from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon amplified to a Nine-layer Late Period, the Battle Demon God moved with a speed indescribable, shattering the earth and appearing beneath the Black Flame Phoenix after just a few steps.
Boom!
The ground within a kilometer radius collapsed instantaneously, and as the Battle Demon God’s figure turned into a blood-colored light soaring into the sky, surrounded by thunderous blood-colored flames.
Just as he leaped into the air reaching several thousand meters altitude, from the Blood Hell, nine purple-red War Halberds, each kilometer-long, spiraled out explosively.
Whew!
The Black Flame Phoenix’s fiery breath extinguished, its wings flapped, and enveloped in surrounding black flames, transformed into a pair of giant flame wings a kilometer in diameter.
Boom!!
The nine purple-red War Halberds exploded at ten thousand meters altitude, with the dazzling glow of a nuclear explosion illuminating heaven and earth, shaking the world.
Under the unrestrained release of destructive energy, the air itself was compressed into a solid form, creating concentric rings of Red Impact that dispersed the black smoky clouds, forming a hollow several kilometers in diameter.
But at that moment, the center of the explosion erupted with black flames once again.
Following that, a fierce and barbarous phoenix cry echoed through heaven and earth, and amidst the blazing flames, the figure of the Black Flame Phoenix was revealed.
Under the Full-Force Strike of Infernal Purgatory at a Nine-layer Late Period by Jack Clark, large areas of the Black Flame Phoenix’s feathers were shattered, and most parts of its wings were blurred flesh and blood.
Although its strength had been suppressed to Level 9 Early Stage, its physique was still at a Late Stage 9, and under normal conditions, killing it would require at least a tough battle.
Whew!
Wounded, the Black Flame Phoenix’s ferocity was completely unleashed, its wings folded and its massive body dived down like a fighter the size of an aircraft carrier, stirring up a long trail of violent air waves.
Just as the Black Flame Phoenix appeared above the head of the Battle Demon God, his figure split into nine, transforming into nine black Great Suns that shined brightly.
Boom! But before it could launch an attack, the purple-red War Halberd in the hands of the Battle Demon God swept across the sky with a thunderous crash, exhaling hundreds of meters of Halberd Skill that annihilated the black Great Suns.
Immediately after, infinite Blood Thunderclap exploded, spreading and striking the true body of the Black Flame Phoenix that was far away.
“Found you,” Jack roared, as the surrounding Doomsday Hell swiftly contracted, merging with the faint projection of the Lava World appearing behind him into the Eight Desolate War Halberd in his hand.
Boom! A kilometer-long War Halberd, truly carrying the power of a Lava World, emitted Destructive Glow and appeared before the Black Flame Phoenix, crossing space.
Under indescribable Terrifying Power, the domain around the Black Flame Phoenix shattered, and the War Halberd tore through its chest, piercing it directly, followed by a burst of blood-red radiance.
Boom!
Under the extreme force of a violent energy explosion, the Black Flame Phoenix let out an unwilling shriek, half of its body shattered in the strike.
In the terrifying explosion, the ground within a kilometer range cracked, countless pieces of dirt and stone soared into the sky, and under the scorching high temperatures, melted into a curtain of lava that flew in all directions.
With intense tremors, large cracks spread for kilometers around the Battle Demon God, making the landscape appear like a shattered world from a high altitude.
Following this explosive strike, the Law Power enhancing Jack’s body was also exhausted, his huge form rapidly deflated like a balloon, shrinking in the blink of an eye back to thirty meters.
Suddenly, Jack felt a strong sense of emptiness inside him, as if his strength had plummeted.
After all, just a moment ago he was overwhelmingly powerful, his every motion comparable to a peak strong man at a Nine-layer Late Period, but in the blink of an eye, his strength plummeted by a hundredfold, leaving him unable to adapt for a moment.
Standing on the ravaged earth, and before Jack could reflect on the gains of this battle, white beams of light emerged from the Void above, transforming into ten Origins that descended.
Boom!
The ground beneath Jack’s feet cracked open, forming a deep pit leading into the Void, and his whole body plummeted swiftly, reappearing in the raging Depths of the Void in the blink of an eye.
There, it was pitch-black all around, with a white path leading into the depths of the Void emerging in the distance.
As Jack landed on that white path, instantly a powerful, invisible pressure overtook him, weighing him down and causing his soul to tremble.
Stimulated, Jack’s Soul Power manifested, and behind him a vague silhouette formed, while the Illusion Meditation Scripture automatically operated.
Under the Soul pressure coming from all directions, right then, the cultivation speed of the Illusion Meditation Scripture was astonishingly fast, dozens of times faster than Jack’s nightly cultivation over the past few days.
Feeling the invisible oppression on his body, Jack’s expression became slightly grave, “Equivalent to five times the basic soul pressure, huh?”
“Or to say, the basic requirement to step onto this path is to have a soul that is five times stronger.”
Saying this, Jack took a step, and instantly the Void under his foot vibrated, and the Soul pressure transmitted through his body grew stronger, accelerating the cultivation speed of the Illusion Meditation Scripture even more.

chapters.title: Chapter 688: 309 Nether Heavenly King, True. Demon God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Chapter 309 Nether Heavenly King, True. Demon God_3
“This road seems to be a good place for me to practice Soul Cultivation Methods.”
Feeling the ‘slight’ pressure and the increasingly fast processing speed of the Illusion Meditation Scripture, Jack Clark’s face revealed a surprised expression.
Jack Clark took a step forward, slowly proceeding ahead, cultivating the Illusion Meditation Scripture with the help of soul oppression from all directions.
Outside the Void Continent, when ten sources of Origin merged into Jack Clark’s body from the void, all those who had emerged showed shocked expressions on their faces.
“Twenty-four sources, he has already obtained twenty-four sources of Origin, enough for two Ninefold Peak powerhouses to make a breakthrough to king-level.”
“A monster has emerged from Eastern Summer, could it be that the True Martial Way is the strongest?”
“This guy, he really has the posture of a Heavenly King.”
At this moment, watching the figure on the Road to Becoming a God through the Eye of Heaven Observation, many geniuses from Berlin Simon began to doubt themselves.
Because the performance of Eastern Summer this time was too shocking.
Even Marcellus Larry couldn’t help but exclaim in amazement, “In less than half a day, he has walked both the King’s Road and the Road of Heavenly Kings.”
“With such talent, even during that era full of monsters and numerous Innate Awakened Ones, only a few could compare.”
Lori Joyner gravely said, “Originally, I thought it would be good if he could break through to the power of a Heavenly King before nightfall, but this is too fast.”
“And did you notice? After completing the Road of Heavenly Kings, he continued to move forward, which means either he hasn’t received a Monarch-level inheritance or…”
“The Soul’s Road.”
Marcellus Larry’s tone became a bit excited, “He must have stepped onto the Soul’s Road, that fourth segment of the inheritance path that can only be set foot on after the foundation of the soul has been increased by more than tenfold.”
“No, this information must be reported immediately. Please have the Nether Heavenly King come back to lock down the news.”
Lori Joyner nodded gravely, “Even if he doesn’t gain that Monarch’s Inheritance in the end, news about this relic trip must be locked down.”
“With the talent he has shown now, ten years, no, in at most five years, he could possibly aspire to the Heavenly King level, especially if he could receive that inheritance…”
At this point, both kings showed a flash of excitement in their eyes.
Before stepping onto the Road to Godhood, although they felt that Jack Clark had the potential of a Heavenly King, it was only a feeling.
Now, Jack Clark had already obtained more than twenty sources of Origin, completed the Road of Heavenly Kings, and by fortune comprehended the complete Origin of the World’s power in a small world.
Next, even without gaining that Monarch’s Inheritance, as long as no accidents happen, he will soon ascend the throne under the protection of Human Experts, aspiring to the Heavenly King level.
In the face of such a genius, representing the intrinsic strength of a race, news about him must be sealed, eliminating all information concerning Jack Clark completing the Road of Heavenly Kings.
Otherwise, once the Evil God Sect, especially The Purgatory Family, learn of it, as soon as Jack Clark enters the mythical world, even a Great Demon King might personally come down to attack and kill.
After all, ambushing and slaying a genius who might aspire to the Heavenly King level and suppressing a Heavenly King Level strong man are two entirely different concepts in terms of the cost involved.
Lori Joyner looked at the figure of Jack Clark, who had already reached over six thousand meters, and his gaze swept over those geniuses about to complete the King’s Road as he commanded in a deep voice.
“Mr. Whitlock, you watch here; I will go over to the other side.”
Marcellus Larry nodded slightly, “Go ahead.”
Lori Joyner turned into a white ray of light that burst out, appearing tens of kilometers away in just a few breaths at ten times the speed of sound, due to the short distance, not bothering to twist space for a jump.
Base No.1.
“Alert, detection of King-level high energy response rapidly approaching.”
“Aura identification… identification passed, welcome King Napoleon.”
At the edge of a kilometer-diameter Silver Vortex, Lori Joyner stood in the void, saying gravely, “Roger, close the pathway lockdown line, I have important matters to enter the mythical world.”
“Please wait a moment, King Napoleon.”
As the voice sounded, dozens of celestial bodies resembling satellites or Sky Base weapons above slightly trembled, and the radiance flowing beneath them dimmed immediately.
At the same time, the firepower system of the energy annihilation guns surrounding the base went off alert.
As the most important channel for Eastern Summer, Base No.1 not only has a king-level powerhouse stationed year-round but also the top technological firepower defense.
Whether moving from inside to out or coming from the other side, any unauthorized passage would immediately be met with a devastating attack.
Even a king-level could not withstand the tilted burst of annihilating energy that came in that instant.
Now, as the defense system deactivated, Lori Joyner turned into a ray of light rushing into the silver pathway, causing the whole massive channel to tremble slightly at the moment.
As king-level existences, even though they appeared to be just over a meter tall on the outside, their true essence was ‘vast,’ and thus they caused strong vibrations when passing through world passageways.
Ordinary Spatial Channels and World Rifts can’t support king-level crossings.
And just as Jack Clark stepped onto the Soul’s Road, finally, someone completed the King’s Road.
Boosted by the power of four Thunder Runes, Damon Lopes’s strength skyrocketed eightfold, transforming into a thunder giant over fifty meters tall with endless purple lightning at his command.
His opponent was a king-level projection wielding a Thunder long spear, bolstered by one Thunder Rune.
The battle was intense, especially since Damon Lopes’s Thunder Prison True Body almost ignored the opponent’s thunder strikes. Coupled with the rune amplification and a willingness to trade injury for injury, he quickly suppressed his adversary.
Boom!
As the king-level projection collapsed, four sources of Origin gently fell from the void, and along with the one from The Peak Road and the Purple Kill Reward, Damon Lopes also reached ten sources in his hand.
Like Jack Clark, after passing the King’s Road, the subspace world around Damon Lopes shattered and his figure fell endlessly, appearing in a world where the Thunder roared.
“This is it, I sense the inheritance of the Lord of Thunder here,” Damon Lopes said excitedly.
But when a strand of golden light landed in his hand, his smile froze.
Because to receive the inheritance of the Lord of Thunder, one must comprehend the world by walking the Road of Heavenly Kings, otherwise one isn’t qualified for that Monarch’s Inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 689: 310: Flying Swords Across the Sky, Soul Projection (Requesting Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Chapter 310: Flying Swords Across the Sky, Soul Projection (Requesting Monthly Votes)
Over the sea, a dozen or so massive Mutated Tiger Whales burst out of the water, each time splashing the sky with waves.
Soon, this Tiger Whale Group spotted a school of Mutated Fish at a depth of three hundred meters, mostly composed of Level 2, with a few Level 3 and several Level 4.
In an instant, the eyes of the Tiger Whale Third Brother lit up.
Roar!! Big head, you take three to the left to drive them away, little head, you go right to release your aura to block that side.
Roar! Round head, you and your wife go up top, and sharp spikes, you guys wait for the right moment to take out those at the same level peak for me.
Under the command of Tiger Whale Third Brother, more than ten Mutated Tiger Whales suddenly dispersed and burst into action, driving the school of Mutated Fish that were six to seven meters to just over ten meters in length.
In an instant, this sea area boiled over.
Amidst the confining hunt of the Mutated Tiger Whale Group, the Mutated Fish attempted to break out on both sides, and only after they left behind more than twenty Level 2 and Level 3 peak corpses did they manage to escape.
Watching the Black Tiger Whales joyfully tearing at the corpses of the Mutated Fish, and collecting one white crystal after another, a Mutated Tiger Whale named Big head, twenty-some meters long and at Late Level 6, couldn’t help but express his confusion.
Roar!! Three Generals, weren’t we supposed to investigate information about our Dragon Palace?
Tiger Whale Third Brother looked at the Mutated Tiger Whale with some surprise: Roar! What information do we need to investigate? Do we still need to inquire about those things?
Suddenly, confusion and bewilderment appeared in the eyes of the other Tiger Whales.
Isn’t it true, General, that you rebelled? You promised to help that terrifying Level 9 Giant Beast spy on Dragon Palace information.
Back then you shouted loudly that you wanted to defeat the King of Black and White in the Dragon Palace, was all that just a sham?
This group of Mutated Tiger Whales were subdued later and had neither seen the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nor been to the Water and Fire World, so they actually didn’t have much of a sense of belonging to the Dragon Palace.
Currently, they only recognized this powerful Black Tiger Whale as their leader.
Therefore, when Tiger Whale Third Brother previously agreed to join the opposing Beast Empire, betray the Dragon Palace, and even help the other side collect information, they didn’t have much of a reaction.
At this moment, the Mutated Tiger Whale named Big head also realized the situation and cautiously asked: Roar!! Three Generals, are you still going to find that Giant Beast in ten days?
The Black Tiger Whale nodded: Roar!! Of course, I’ll go and ask that guy for some good food, and just give him some fake information.
Roar! But before that, I need to go find Mom.
As he spoke, Tiger Whale Third Brother glanced at his Tiger Whale subordinates, planning to hand them over to his mother, Horned Lady, to watch over; that way, he could continue to deceive that fool into providing food and drink.
And there’s no need to wait ten days; in another two days he could go and scrounge for a fruit to eat.
Just say that he’s discovered that the Blue Giant Crab, known as Crab General in Dragon Palace forces, has achieved a breakthrough to level eight.
That guy’s just a gatekeeper, so his information shouldn’t count as a leak, right? Later he would have Mom go back and notify Dad and the others.
The Black Tiger Whale’s eyes sparkled with shrewdness, leading the group of Mutated Tiger Whales towards the sea area his mother was responsible for.
Unfortunately, the flames pattern on Boss and the others was too conspicuous, it was probably already exposed during the last fight, otherwise he could have brought them along to freeload.
It still wouldn’t work, even without the flames pattern, Boss and Second Brother were too dumb and would easily be discovered.
So, it’s better not to bring them along. Third Brother should eat them all by himself.
Hehe, I’m so clever; Mom will definitely praise me.
Triumphant, Tiger Whale Third Brother carefully controlled the current and wrapped the Life Crystals they had obtained around the Dorsal Fin of a Level 4 Tiger Whale, where a pouch made from a mutated fish stomach pouch was hanging.
Roar!! Miss Keller, take good care of this pouch.
In response to the Black Tiger Whale’s order, the Tiger Whale which was considered ‘delicately attractive’ in Tiger Whale aesthetics, let out an endearing cry.
Roar!! Okay, leader.
…
Deep in the Void, as Jack Clark continued forward, the pressure from his soul became stronger and stronger, ultimately bearing down on him like a mountain.
Under the profound external soul pressure, Jack’s Soul Power gradually exteriorized, forming a towering, vague figure behind him that emanated a sense of oppression.
Behind that indistinct human figure, an even more colossal and mountainous, terrifying figure could indistinctly be seen looming in the depths of the Void.
Indeed, Jack Clark and his Avatar had two separate souls.
Under his Soul Split talent, the souls’ Origin between Jack and his Giant Beast Avatar were one, but each was a ‘complete’ soul on its own.
And this was the strength of a Top-tier Soul Talent.
Whether it’s Extraordinary Beasts or human cultivators, once the soul is damaged, breaking through the Seventh Layer or Level 7 with the resonance of Heaven and Earth becomes impossible, not to mention the ability to comprehend Heaven and Earth and control Gifted Power.
Of course, even though Soul Split is a division, the souls of Jack and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, being of one Origin, are like two sides of the same coin, Suppressing deep in another dimension to maintain their connection.
This peculiar existence was only discovered by Jack after he practiced the Illusion Meditation Scripture and touched upon his own soul.
An hour had passed since Jack stepped onto the Soul’s Road on his Path of the Gods, and his projection on the Road to Becoming a God had reached over seven thousand meters.
The soul pressure here had exceeded ten times the normal, but Jack still felt ‘it’s okay’.
At the Mountain Peak, Justin Welan looked up at Crystal Lewis, who was floating a hundred meters in the air with her flame wings spread and shouted, “Class Leader, can you see how far Jack has gone?”
“The fog is too thick, I can’t see.” At this point, Jack had walked seven kilometers away, and even Crystal Lewis, an advanced cultivator, couldn’t see through the mist shrouding the path.

chapters.title: Chapter 690: 310 Flying Swords Everywhere, Soul Projection (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Chapter 310 Flying Swords Everywhere, Soul Projection (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
As she spoke, Crystal Lewis’s flaming double wings folded behind her, and she descended from the sky.
Mandy Lewis smiled gently, “Not being able to see is actually a good thing; it means that Jack Clark is getting further and further ahead.”
Justin Welan’s face flushed with excitement, somewhat agitated, “Jack is amazing. It’s said that after passing the third segment of the Road of Heavenly Kings, one will attain the posture of a Heavenly King.”
“He will definitely make it through,” Crystal Lewis said with conviction.
After all, passing the Road of Heavenly Kings is not the same as becoming a Heavenly King right away. Given the terrifying talent that Jack Clark has displayed, as well as his dominance after entering the relic, there’s no doubt he’ll make it.
Just then, Betty Leinster who had reached 2,500 meters in the distance suddenly saw the clouds at her feet dissipate, and in an instant, she fell off the skyway, disappearing from sight.
Mandy Lewis, who had been paying close attention, felt a bit of regret: “Senior Sister Betty Leinster also fell off. It’s a pity, she was only two steps away from the end.”
Crystal Lewis sighed, “It is indeed a pity. After Senior Sister Betty Leinster fell, only Jane Aiken and Jack Clark are left in the Southern Battlefield.”
By now, those who should have fallen off the Road to Godhood have mostly done so.
Out of nearly two hundred people, more than thirty have not passed The Peak Road, and most of the remaining hundred-plus have stepped onto the second stage.
But the King’s Road is a watershed, with five checkpoints of the king, each one eliminating a group of people, and because of a half-hour limit, no one can delay.
So after four hours, only about twenty people remain scattered along the Road to Godhood, while more people are watching from the mountain peaks above.
Justin Welan shook his head, “After all, that is the road that tests the potential of kings. Of the geniuses who went up this time, I feel that only a few can make the complete journey.”
“We won’t mention Damon Lopes, who has already stepped into the third stage. Besides him, Eddy Keller and Balderas should have no problem.”
“To break through to the Late Sevenfold Sky in senior year, this kind of cultivation talent is rare among Eastern Summer’s generation. Next is that mysterious Brudos.”
“That guy from Berlin, I always feel he’s not easy to deal with, even more dangerous than Balderas.”
“As for Gabriella, it’s hard to say. It’s said that Mech Martial Practitioners are generally not good at understanding, and compared to them, I’m more optimistic about Jane Aiken.”
Speaking of Jane Aiken, the three of them turned their gaze toward the girl who was more than 2,300 meters away.
Compared to Gabriella and others who had been stuck at 2,700 meters for nearly half an hour, Jane Aiken was moving slower, stopping for half an hour at almost every checkpoint.
But for some reason, everyone felt that she was actually moving with ease.
On the Road to Godhood, within the small world, peaks rising tens or hundreds of meters high like straight swords sprouted from the ground.
Sitting cross-legged on a peak over two hundred meters high, Jane Aiken was surrounded by four light bands formed by flying swords, with sword qi crisscrossing amidst the interweaving.
By this time, each battle sword had shrunk from 2 meters in length to 1.2 meters, becoming more slender and sharp, with a significant change in shape.
For example, the flying sword infused with Illusion Extinguishing Sword Intent was crystal red all over, with a dim red radiance flowing on it like a dream, leaving behind a trail of red light as it flew.
The flying sword carrying Space-tearing sword intent, on the other hand, was entirely black, with blades on one side and serrations on the other, giving off a sense of extreme danger.
The flying sword merged with Wind Spirit Instant Slash Sword Intent was wholly green, tracing a green light shadow in the air, moving so fast that it left behind a series of complete afterimages.
As for the flying sword merged with Soul Punishing Spirit Extinguishing Sword Intent, it appeared dim and dark, seemingly inconspicuous under the reflection of the other three swords.
But every time this flying sword flashed by, it gave off a sensation of pain to the spirit and even the soul.
After continuously comprehending the Blood Refining Sword Mark, the Spirit Medium Sword Mark, the Flying Spirit Sword Mark, and the Fusion Rune, Jane Aiken had turned her four battle swords almost into the flying swords of mythical legend.
Once the Sword Intent and flying swords were fused, with a mere thought, the four flying swords moved with incredible speed, wreaking havoc within a hundred-meter radius.
Meanwhile, as she engaged in combat with the projections of three kings practicing swordsmanship, her Sword Intent, which was close to grand accomplishment, was only one step away from reaching it.
At that moment, Jane Aiken slowly opened her eyes, looking at the three runes floating in the distance and the projection standing with hands behind its back atop a sword peak.
Hum!
As Jane Aiken focused her spiritual thought on a point at the core of the three Sword Marks, instantly the three runes turned into three rays and fell upon her, her aura surging exponentially.
At the moment the runes were activated, barring a distance of two hundred meters away, the figure who stood with hands behind his back burst forth with the mid-stage aura of the Sixth Heaven, followed by a sharp and unparalleled Sword Intent.
Boom! As grand accomplishment Sword Intent manifested, over thirty meters of Golden Sword Light emerged, sweeping up Heavenly Energy as if it were a golden sash slashing towards Jane Aiken.
Thump!
As the Golden Sword Qi neared within a hundred meters of Jane Aiken, the sword light dispersed, turning into numerous slender golden threads spreading in all directions, forming a golden sword net.
The moment, a protruding peak below was shredded by the sword threads, a frightening sight to behold.
“Sword Qi turned into threads!”
Jane Aiken’s expression became stern, and the aura of the four flying swords revolving around her soared, evolving into four twenty-meter-long colored sword lights hanging in all directions, bursting forth with Sword Qi to seal off every angle.
Thud thud thud!! As the golden sword threads swept past, the Sword Array trembled continuously, and the colliding sword energies annihilated each other, exploding with strong sharp impacts.
After withstanding the strike of Sword Qi turned to threads, the surrounding sword lights of Jane Aiken flashed brilliantly, as the four twenty-meter-long Sword Qi blasted off like supersonic missiles.
As sword lights swept past, the stone peaks collapsed in an instant, and amidst the explosion of the scattering rocks, four sword lights circled and rose into the sky, spinning towards the distant King’s Projection.

chapters.title: Chapter 691: 310 Flying Swords Everywhere, Soul Projection (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Chapter 310 Flying Swords Everywhere, Soul Projection (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
Boom! Boom! Boom!
With triple rune enhancement and the mastering of Four Great Sword Intentions, the flying sword cut through the sky, its light sweeping across the land as it shattered peak after peak, gradually suppressing the King’s Projection at the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage.
Boom!
Minutes later, as the King’s Projection was shredded by the Sword Qi, Jane Aiken landed on a spire holding a black long sword, with a hint of regret in her eyes, “Just a bit short.”
As she spoke, two streams of Origin fell upon Jane Aiken, and at the same time, her figure appeared two thousand six hundred meters away in the outside world.
Right when Jane Aiken’s figure shifted, four streams of Origin descended upon the head of Eddy Keller, who had been halted at the final challenge of the King’s Road for over half an hour.
Looking at Eddy Keller, who appeared three thousand meters away, the students from the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy shouted excitedly, “Eddy Keller has passed the King’s Road! That fool… that guy really does have a king’s attitude.”
A classmate commented dryly beside them, “Wilson Jennings, you meant to say ‘fool,’ didn’t you?”
“Ha… Haha, of course not. That guy is the top-notch genius of our academy, how could I dare to call him a fool for liking to show off?”
Meanwhile, the Berlin Camp on the other side erupted in cheers: “Balderas has also broken through. He has passed the King’s Road too…”
As time passed, several of the most dazzling geniuses from this group successively crossed the final threshold and entered the third segment.
At the same time, among the remaining twenty or so individuals, suddenly nine found the clouds beneath their feet dissipating, plunging them down to vanish into the Void Continent.
The Road to Becoming a God was left with just over ten figures, making it seem rather desolate.
“Nine more have failed, what a pity,” someone remarked.
“Yeah, becoming a king is too difficult. Only a few can get past even this trial that tests potential for kingship,” many said with wry smiles on their faces.
Although these individuals were top-tier geniuses in their own schools, none dared claim they had hope of ascending to the throne—let alone being sure they could break through to the Ninth Heavens.
It’s impressive they reached the Fifth or Sixth Layer Heaven in just three years of high school, but breaking through to the Seventh Layer before graduation was not a certainty.
Not to mention the later stages of integrating with the True Martial Mirage, re-forging the body to break through Level Eight, and mastering the Nine-layered Heaven Realm.
As they cultivated other people’s Top-tier Secret Manuals, the further they went, the harder it became, because that path did not align with them, unless they created their own Secret Manuals.
Suddenly, the Simon Camp erupted in excited shouts, “Origin, Gabriella has gained four streams of Origin, she has passed the King’s Road too!”
On the Cloud Mist road, the girl piloting a gigantic Mecha also appeared three thousand meters away.
However, compared to Eddy Keller and the others, the King of Black and White’s Mecha Projection’s left arm suddenly broke off, riddled with severe wounds all over, looking quite gruesome.
Clearly, her break through the last challenge had been somewhat difficult.
And with Gabriella crossing the King’s Road, there were abruptly only six left on the second stage of the path.
“No, when did that guy pass the King’s Road?” Justin Welan suddenly realized, looking at the back of Brudos three thousand meters away with some astonishment.
Mandy Lewis whispered, “The moment Gabriella finished, he also happened to break through.”
Justin Welan had a moment of clarity, “I see. Now, including Jack, there are already six people who have walked the King’s Road. Next, it seems only Jane Aiken has a chance.”
At this moment, only seven remained on the Road to Godhood, and among them, Jane Aiken had already reached the final challenge.
As for the others, the closest one had been stuck at two thousand three hundred meters for almost half an hour.
Under everyone’s gaze, the cloud layers under the remaining few began to dissolve one after another, leaving only Jane Aiken in her green armor.
Under the watchful eyes of many, Jane Aiken, who had been silent for half an hour, suddenly burst into radiance above her head.
“Hahaha… Our South Sky Martial high school really outdid itself this time, with two people passing the King’s Road, and Jack might have even passed the Road of Heavenly Kings already.”
Looking at Jane Aiken, who had appeared three thousand meters away, Justin Welan was thrilled beyond words.
Crystal and Mandy Lewis also showed smiles on their faces. Although they were not the ones walking the King’s Road, as classmates, they felt honored by association.
Outside the Void Continent, Marcellus Larry also had a smile on his face. “This generation actually has seven students with the potential of kings, two more than the last one. Not bad.”
“Especially that little guy.”
The so-called generation Marcellus Larry was referring to didn’t mean this particular relic, nor did it mean a specific year or a standard two-to-three-year period. It was distinguished by the time span of some special major events.
It could be five years, ten years, or possibly a generation could be defined within just two years.
However, at this moment on the third stage of the Road of Heavenly Kings, Damon Lopes who first stepped on it had only walked past three thousand six hundred meters after two hours.
As for Balderas, it took him almost an hour to reach three thousand two hundred meters, which means he only managed to walk two hundred meters in one hour.
This distance meant that their comprehension of the World’s Power was progressing very slowly, of course, this ‘slow’ is relative to Jack Clark, after all, that guy seemed to have it too easy at the time.
“As expected, without comparison there is no harm, these guys are far worse than Jack,” said Justin Welan, his face revealing a smug expression.
“…Justin Welan, that’s because Jack Clark is amazing. Why are you so proud?” Crystal couldn’t help but retort.
Justin Welan looked at Crystal somewhat puzzled. “Class Leader, Jack and I are good brothers. Isn’t his greatness the same as mine?”
“After a few years, when Jack becomes a king or even a Heavenly King, if I just say that Heavenly King Jack Clark is my brother, do you think anyone would dare to bully me?”
Suddenly Mandy said, “Yes, the Purgatory Demon Race will kill you.”
Immediately, Justin’s face stiffened.
Meanwhile, Crystal couldn’t help but laugh.
As most people were eliminated from the relic, everyone was watching the few that remained with some nervousness, focusing on the top-notch geniuses belonging to their own camp.
But as time went on, people noticed that Balderas was slowing down, gradually being overtaken by Brudos and Gabriella, catching up to Eddy Keller.
Besides, Jane Aiken, who was the last to step onto the third segment, moved increasingly faster, quickly surpassing Balderas, and then, under the astonished gazes of many, overtook Gabriella, Keller, and several others.
When more than seven hours had passed, and Jane Aiken was about to overtake Damon Lopes, someone finally couldn’t help but shout, “How is this possible? How can that Eastern Summer genius move so fast?”
Justin Welan said proudly, “Because Jane Aiken’s talent is monstrous. Although she’s only a first grader, she’s the top person in the Southern Battlefield, apart from Jack.”
Not far away, a young man from the Northern Battlefield couldn’t help but express envy. “Your Southern Battlefield is way too fearsome this time, producing two monsters.”
“Heh heh!! Your Northern Battlefield isn’t bad either. That Innate Awakened One is truly formidable.”
Just as Justin Welan and the person from the Northern Battlefield were praising each other.
Outside, watching Jane Aiken who had reached around three thousand seven hundred meters, Marcellus Larry sighed slightly, “Pity, she lingered too long on the King’s Road.”
The Road to Becoming a God was open for one day, and that one day was based on the time within the relic, with darkness as the limit, which is around ten hours or so.
And now more than seven hours had passed, and with only a little more than two hours left before the Road to Godhood would close, all would be ejected from the relic by the rule’s power.
With a little more than two hours left, Jane Aiken, who had caught up from behind, basically had no hope of completing the last stretch, not to mention her facing the task of defeating the guardian creatures.
As for Damon Lopes, he was expected to reach about five thousand meters at most, and Balderas and the others might max out at around four thousand meters.
However, that wasn’t important. Thinking this, Marcellus Larry’s gaze penetrated through the Eye of Heaven Observation and fell on Jack Clark with an excited, yet restrained, tone.
“Already at over eight thousand meters, more than eight thousand…”
In that moment, even Marcellus Larry, a king himself, couldn’t help feeling excited and shocked.
Because back then, the First Councilor only reached eight thousand meters and then could go no further, missing his chance at the legendary Emperor Inheritance by a hair’s breadth.
Yet now, Jack Clark seemed to have a glimmer of hope to gain this inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 692: 311 Sealing Heaven and Locking Earth, The Heavenly King Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Chapter 311 Sealing Heaven and Locking Earth, The Heavenly King Descends
On the Path of Godhood, when Jack Clark passed eight thousand meters, it seemed he touched upon something, and the phantom of a black gate hundreds of meters high emerged at the end.
The gate was like a mirage of the sea market, ethereal and hazy, standing in the void ahead.
“What is that gate?” Jasper Forbes was astonished.
Over a hundred geniuses who had failed the trial and were ejected early were all looking at the anomaly emerging in the Empty Sky-Watching Eye with surprise and suspicion.
Watching that lone figure walking on the white cloud path, Howard Lambert slowly said, “It must be related to Jack Clark; he has gone too far now.”
Compared to those who had only reached a little over three thousand meters, still at the front end of the Road of Heavenly Kings, Jack Clark was almost at the end of the Divine Road.
The gap between them was too vast, especially for those who had only made it through The Peak Road; the gap with the current Jack Clark was even larger.
Thinking of this, Howard’s eyes filled with a hint of admiration.
Who would have thought, half a year ago at South Sky Martial Height’s freshman competition, this guy was only a common genius ranked forty-ninth?
Until he went to Koroya, and whether he gained something from the Slaughter Battlefield that tempered him, he skyrocketed uncontrollably from there.
He directly overwhelmed everyone, becoming the school’s first genius to break through the Four Layer Heaven; after entering the Alien Beast Battlefield, he lay low for a month and then swept through the South invincibly.
Thinking of this, even Howard could not help but complain, “Damn, I always feel like this guy must be cheating.”
Carol Koch, standing nearby, gave a faint smile at these words, “Junior Lambert, have an open mind. Everyone has their own path; we don’t need to compare ourselves with Junior Clark.”
With a rugged face and a physique as large as a giant, Howard sighed deeply, “Senior Keller, I’m not envious of Jack Clark’s achievements, but there are some things you won’t understand.”
Thinking of the battle he and Jack Clark had agreed upon, Howard felt a headache coming on. How was he to fight…?
Forget it, let’s postpone this battle, he thought. He’d wait until he broke through to king-level.
But by then, that guy might have already achieved a breakthrough to Heavenly King. I, as a king-level, should be able to withstand two moves from that monster… right?
Although he had only reached a little over fifteen hundred meters on the Road to Becoming a God, Howard was still full of confidence in himself.
He was a genius who had faced death twenty-nine times, breaking limits time and again, endowed with Innate Divine Strength, destined in this life to ascend the throne.
Moreover, he had gained much this time, two strands of World Origin, plus that Demon Bronze Statue from Ancient Civilization.
As long as he could cultivate the Heavenly Evil Demon Manual to forge the Devil’s Battle Body and achieve the third physique transformation breakthrough to the Seventh Layer, king-level was not hopeless.
While everyone’s attention was focused on the Eye of Heaven Observation, in the distance, towards the First Channel Base, a terrifying aura erupted.
A raging wind howled, Thunder boomed, and a Silver Vortex a kilometer high shook as if a colossal creature was squeezing through from the other side.
The sudden change drew everyone’s attention; they turned to look, only to see the horizon being engulfed by boundless darkness, turning into rolling dark clouds surging this way.
In the blink of an eye, the black cloud surged over like a tidal wave, blotting out the sky and sun.
Soon after, a terrifying pressure, one that surpassed that of king-level, descended.
Boom! The Earth shook in an instant, and cracks spread across the ground; everyone involuntarily radiated a defiant aura to resist.
But under that dreadful pressure, these geniuses who hadn’t even achieved a high-order breakthrough were powerless to contend; the will and aura they had gathered instantly dispersed.
Just as everyone was shocked and about to be pressed to the ground by the overwhelming force, that oppressive aura suddenly vanished.
The dark clouds in the sky churned and spun, forming a hundred-meter Hollow, and a beam of golden sunlight pierced through it, with two figures appearing within the beam.
One of them was Lori Joyner, the king-level who had left earlier, and the other was a middle-aged man in his forties or fifties, his temples streaked with white, exuding a sense of vicissitudes.
Looking down at the puzzled crowd below, Lori stated, “No need to be alarmed; this is the Nether Heavenly King. He heard that our Human Race had several king-level genius appearances, so he came to have a look.”
Great, you show up and unleash such a terrifying force, acting like you’re about to Destroy Heaven and Earth, and we’re supposed to stay calm?
Of course, that was just an internal gripe. Outwardly, they all showed respectful faces, “We’ve seen the great Nether Heavenly King.”
Looking down upon them, the middle-aged man’s voice held the weight of ages, “Don’t be constrained, everyone. Proceed as if I am not here.”
As the Nether Heavenly King and Lori approached the Eye of Heaven Observation, Marcellus Larry spoke with some excitement, “Brother Chen, the Emperor’s Gate has appeared.”
“Is that the Emperor’s Gate?” The Nether Heavenly King looked at the black gate phantom in the Eye of Heaven Observation.
Marcellus nodded, “Yes, when that youngster reached over eight thousand meters, it triggered the Emperor’s Gate.”
“He has actually reached over eight thousand meters already.” The Nether Heavenly King’s figure flashed, appearing before the Eye of Heaven Observation, his gaze falling on Jack Clark’s advancing silhouette.
After a long while, the Nether Heavenly King spoke with amazement, “Indeed, there is someone who can surpass twenty times the base Soul Strength before the Nine Layers Heaven.”
As one of those who had entered the relic in the past, walked the Road to Godhood, and received the Inheritance, the Nether Heavenly King and others were actually not unfamiliar with this Ruins Continent.
Including the legendary gate standing at the end of the Divine Road, a gate upon opening which one could become a Monarch.
Because inside, there was the Monarch Inheritance of the Ancient Civilization.
Unfortunately, obtaining the Monarch Inheritance was extremely difficult; just to step onto the Soul’s Road required a base soul strength of five times.

chapters.title: Chapter 693: 311 Seal the Heavens and Lock the Earth, the Heavenly King Descends_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: Chapter 311 Seal the Heavens and Lock the Earth, the Heavenly King Descends_2
And this was just the basic requirement to set out on the journey.
Next, as one traversed the four-thousand-meter pathway, the pressure on the soul would intensify with each step, reaching tenfold at eight thousand meters.
According to the First Councilor who had stopped at eight thousand meters, one needed a base soul strength of at least twentyfold to reach the end of the path.
The Nether Heavenly King turned to Marcellus Larry, “Mr. Whitlock, how long has the Road to Becoming a God been open now?”
“Seven and a half hours.”
“Seven and a half, huh? It seems there’s really hope this time,” the Nether Heavenly King said solemnly, his gaze sweeping over the geniuses below as he sent forth a thought.
Boom!
The dark clouds that shrouded the firmament trembled and rolled, slowly descending like a curtain that sealed the heavens and earth, isolating the surrounding area for several kilometers.
Instantly, the world plunged into darkness, with only the Eye of Heaven Observation in the sky radiating white light, its golden pupil reflecting the scenes from the Road to Becoming a God.
Everything within this range was isolated.
The sudden change caused some unrest among the geniuses below, who didn’t understand why the Heavenly King had decided to seal off the surroundings.
The three kings had sealed their voices during the conversation, so no one knew what they discussed, but… it was probably because of him, right?
The crowd turned their gaze toward the Eye of Heaven Observation, focusing on Jack Clark’s silhouette in the distance. It was highly likely that the arrival of the Heavenly King and the sealing of heaven and earth were because of him.
After all, although the other six who had walked the King’s Road were monstrously talented, they only had the potential to become kings and did not merit the descent of a Heavenly King Level powerhouse.
It was only this individual nearing the end of the Divine Road who warranted the attention of a Heavenly King Level strong man.
Unaware of the changes in the outside world, Justin Welan and others within the Relic World were also ignorant of the occurrence. At this moment, the group from South Sky Martial Height was somewhat excitedly looking into the distance.
Because Jane Aiken had now surpassed Damon Lopes.
However, for Jane Aiken to reach this step was not surprising to Justin Welan and the others, as this girl had been a monster right from the start.
After enrolling, she surged ahead and became even more formidable after reaching the Triplex Heaven.
It was only because of Jack Clark that Jane Aiken’s radiance had been somewhat overshadowed. But anyone who knew her was aware of how terrifying her talent was.
Top-tier cultivation aptitude and top-tier comprehension talent, both talents present in one person – it was just too frightening.
In Simon Camp’s distance, a female student exclaimed, “Isn’t Eastern Summer too terrifying? Four of the seven geniuses who have walked the King’s Road are from Eastern Summer.”
Justin Welan replied with a smile, “This beauty, you’re not entirely correct. Whether it’s Eastern Summer or Simon Northern Frost, we all belong to the Human Race.”
“We should feel happy for any genius that comes from our Human Race, no matter which country they are from.”
“Once they break through to king-level in the future and begin to expand the Mythical World Region to battle the Purgatory Demon Race, it will benefit the entire Federation, not just any single country.”
This guy had a point. The several hundreds of people present nodded in agreement.
Under the anxious gazes of those inside and outside, time rapidly slipped away.
But aside from Jane Aiken, the other people on the Road of Heavenly Kings moved slower and slower, including the mysterious Brudos as well.
As the clock reached eight hours, the furthest along, Jane Aiken, had already reached more than four thousand and six hundred meters, with the second place, Damon Lopes, at over four thousand one hundred meters.
Next was Brudos at over three thousand seven hundred meters, Gabriella and Eddy Keller at over three thousand five hundred meters, and Balderas at over three thousand three hundred meters.
This premier individual of the Northern Frost generation was the weakest in terms of comprehension talent, which might have to do with the Cultivation Methods he practiced.
After all, Genetic Martial Arts was not a path of enlightenment but a tempering of the physical body, purification of genetic bloodlines, walking the evolutionary path of unity between human and beast.
As for Jack Clark, under the excited gaze of the three king-level watchers, he had reached over nine thousand meters.
With him approaching, the black ancient gate at the limit of heaven and earth became clearer and clearer; one could see the mountain and river patterns, the celestial constellations engraved upon it, exuding an aura of simplicity and desolation.
And even though he had reached this point, Jack’s speed had not slowed down; he maintained an even pace as he continued to approach.
It seemed that after another half hour, he would reach the end of the Divine Road.
Marcellus Larry’s voice trembled slightly, “His foundational soul is too terrifying, as if he had an innate awakening of Soul Talent, and moreover, it’s the kind that continually grows.”
Lori Joyner pondered, “Perhaps he really did awaken his Soul Talent. Observing his growth trajectory, it started to burst forth after he encountered True Martial Cultivation.”
“This situation can only be explained by an innate transformation of the soul, because it’s very difficult for the soul to affect the body unless one embarks on the Transcendent Path through cultivation.”
As beings who had cultivated to king-level, their experiences and insights stood at the pinnacle of the Human Race.
Through various signs and conjectures, they had almost reached the truth, of course, only a part of it.
“After the Eighth Layer Heaven, one’s body is reforged and talents are born; we can test the strength of the soul. When the time comes, we’ll see just how strong his foundational soul is.”
The Nether Heavenly King slowly shook his head, “There’s no need, once he has received the Emperor Inheritance, nothing else will matter, or rather, all information regarding him should be sealed.”
“Although there is some difference between ancient and modern methods, he who obtains the inheritance will certainly become a Heavenly King, and there’s a great chance he will ascend to the Supreme level.”
“As for that higher realm…” the Nether Heavenly King paused here.
Because that wasn’t a realm that could be achieved simply through inheritance, otherwise the Ancient Civilization would not have had Seven Emperors, but rather seventy, or even seven hundred.”
Marcellus and Lori both nodded slowly.
Indeed, once Jack Clark received the Emperor Inheritance, nothing else would matter. He would become the next great hope for the Human Race’s ascension to Supreme strength.
The Soul’s Road, which Jack Clark had already progressed over nine thousand meters on, had also brought him in sight of a door.
However, unlike the projection in the outside world, the door Jack saw delved into the Void, with intangible rule forces suppressing everything around it.
At this moment, the oppressive weight coming from all directions grew increasingly intense, rapidly approaching the limit of thirty times the foundational soul’s strength, but Jack felt ‘it’s still manageable’.
At this moment Jack was a bit surprised but deemed it natural.
His soul, in fact, could already be seen just by looking at his Four Major Attributes; the spirit attribute, which represents the soul, was only a few hundred points behind the 6,000+ physique.
Compared to the physical body’s strength, one could imagine how formidable his foundational soul was.
In the outside world’s oppressive forces, Jack’s soul was externalized, and with the cultivation of the Illusion Meditation Scripture becoming more condensed, a nearly one hundred meter tall figure gradually materialized behind him.
But at this time, the soul projection was still somewhat blurred, continuously refining as the Illusion Meditation Scripture operated, and slowly shrinking.
Because when it comes to the soul, ‘larger’ isn’t necessarily better.
Enduring the ‘terrifying’ pressure that almost burst his soul from the surrounding Void, Jack kept moving forward, drawing closer and closer to the black gate, gradually reaching the ten-thousand-meter limit.
Yet, at this moment, only nine hours had passed, and excitement flickered in the eyes of Marcellus and the other two watching from outside.
Those below witnessing the scene were also each showing a face of shock.
“He succeeded, he’s actually completed the Road to Becoming a God.”
Once defeated by Jack Clark, Jasper Forbes was astonished, “Jack Clark’s talent is too horrifying, I feel he might break through the Ninth Heavens before the end of Senior One.”
“I have that feeling too,” Betty Leinster said with a wry smile.
One-Year Ninth Heavens. Hearing these words, Howard Lambert remained calm, you are underestimating him too much; One-Year King would be more like it.
This fellow’s cultivation speed hasn’t slowed down even after reaching the high-order stages; he’s already broken through to the mid period of the Seventh Layer, and on top of that, he’s about to receive an Ancient Inheritance.
This gate standing at the end of the Road of Heavenly Kings, using your heads from below, you’d know that the inheritance inside is important, very likely to be the ancient Monarch mentioned by that king.
Emperor level, ah, transcending the Heavenly King and even Supreme Experts’ inheritance, once Jack Clark gets it…! Thinking about this, Howard Lambert couldn’t help but take a sharp breath.
And then he felt frustrated.
Because Howard felt that when he broke through to king-level after many years, he might not be able to withstand even one strike from Jack.
“Why has he stopped?”
Looking at Jack, who had reached the end of the Divine Road and then stopped not far from the gate, everyone outside the Void Rift was taken aback.

chapters.title: Chapter 694: 312 Who is the Peak at the End of Divine Road, End of Relics
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: Chapter 312 Who is the Peak at the End of Divine Road, End of Relics
“`
Standing over ten meters away from the Emperor’s Gate, Jack Clark felt a pressure on his spirit that almost “burst” it, a smile appearing on his face.
Because under the endless, immense pressure, his spirit was continuously compressed, which, in combination with the practice of the Illusion Meditation Scripture, accelerated his progress to a terrifying extent.
He felt that one day of cultivation here was almost equivalent to several years in the outer world.
Of course, he definitely didn’t have time to cultivate here for a whole day, but even an hour would be enough.
Along the way, after several continuous hours of cultivation under intense pressure, Jack Clark felt that he was on the verge of breaking through the First Layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark came to a halt.
“No, it’s still not enough.”
On the desolate ancient land, Balderas, in his fully beast-transformed state, looked around at the surrounding ‘world’ with impatience and discomfort in his eyes.
His biological clock told him that the time allocated for the Road to Becoming a God was nearly over.
But whenever he concentrated to observe the projections of the world around him, he would be overwhelmed by the influx of profound information, making his head swell and feel like it was about to burst.
In such a state, he couldn’t calm his mind to enlighten.
This was the reason why Balderas was the slowest to progress, as ‘simple-minded’ Unique Beasts naturally had poor enlightenment talent.
In contrast, Eddy Keller was much stronger in this aspect.
On the wild land beside the Giant Beast skeleton, Eddy Keller sat cross-legged with a white Divine Dragon over forty meters long coiling slowly behind him, emitting dragon-shaped fluctuations.
Under the influence of these dragon-shaped fluctuations, Eddy Keller’s thought process and grasp of Heaven and Earth and the Cultivation Methods improved to a level that multiplied his usual understanding.
This was the True Martial ‘attribute’ he obtained when he had his breakthrough, a dragon pattern blessing that allowed him to elevate his enlightenment by one level by expending Spirit Power.
This was also the reason why Eddy Keller had such strong talent.
However, on the Road of Heavenly Kings, his dragon pattern blessing was no longer sufficient for his rapid advancement, and the more he delved into the information of the world, the greater the spiritual pressure he faced.
A broken Mech stood tall upon the black earth, its eyes flashing red as it scanned the surrounding projections of the World Origin.
“Warning, the current computational capacity is already overclocked, continuing to increase the computation frequency will cause irreversible damage to the driver’s spirit.”
At the driver’s seat, Gabriella’s eyes were tightly shut, her consciousness linked to the Supercomputer of the Black-White Demon King Mech, desperately processing and deciphering the information of the world projection.
Around her, countless data streams dashed like waterfalls, and red warning lights blinked urgently.
But Gabriella, in her current state, disregarded this and continued to raise the computation frequency, striving to decipher and understand more of the ‘world’ information.
She was well aware of how rare this opportunity was. Even if she couldn’t complete the Road of Heavenly Kings, the gains from this experience would become the intrinsic foundation for her rapid ascent to the throne.
Although she took the path of Mecha-Martial Arts, all paths led to the same destination.
If she could perfect the force field of her Mech into a ‘world’, her close-range Defense would reach a terrifying level.
In the swampy region with rolling Poisonous gas, Brudos stood at the center of the world projection, sighing softly, “Let me analyze Giant Beasts or the Demon Clan, that’s doable, but making me analyze the world itself is simply too tough.”
“There’s not much time left, forget it, it’s time to activate that eye. I should be able to last for an hour.”
With that said, Brudos pulled open his shirt, revealing a solid chest and a fist-sized ghost eye with pale white sclera and pupil, looking somewhat eerie as if it came from Hell.
As the eye was revealed, Brudos’s own eyes slowly closed and a pair of pupils appeared in the ghastly white eye on his chest, reflecting the world around.
Suddenly, in the outer world, Brudos’s progress quickened.
“I am the Thunder, and Thunder is me, all beings are shapeless, Heaven and Earth are also shapeless, the Thunder moves invisibly…”
Immursed in the projection of the Thunder world, Damon Lopes recalled the main principles of the Thunder Prison True Body, as the Inherent Law Fragments of Thunder shone within him.
Boom!!
Suddenly, Damon Lopes exploded into a sky full of Purple Thunder Light, merging with the surrounding projections of the Thunder world – at this moment, he became the ‘world’.
As Damon Lopes’s pace in the outer world was slowing down, it suddenly picked up pace again, catching up to Jane Aiken who was nearly five thousand meters ahead.
While the others struggled mightily, Jane Aiken felt like a fish in water, immersed in her understanding of the world.
Within the small world filled with countless broken and incomplete swords, Jane Aiken sat cross-legged. Four Flying Swords transformed into massive Sword Qi, hanging in all directions and forming a Sword Array.
As she continued to delve deeper, the encircling Sword Array also began to change, becoming more complete and sharp, creating an illusion of a Sword World.
Of course, with her current Cultivation, she wasn’t capable of evolving a world with swords.
Time passed, and the sky began to darken as the sky over the Ruins Continent visibly turned black, heralding the approaching Void.
With the strong impact of the Void, the Road to Becoming a God formed by the white mist also began to sway.
At the same time, an Invisible Power enveloped the people like Justin Welan and Crystal Lewis atop the Mountain Peak, and under the expulsion of the rules, they were ejected from this world in an instant.
Meanwhile, on the Road to Becoming a God within the small world, the six people who were engrossed in understanding the world were startled awake, as the projections surrounding them began to fade away.
Simultaneously, Origin emerged above the heads of the six, with one, two, three, four, and five Law Fragments of worlds slowly appearing.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 695: 312 Who Peaks at the End of Divine Road, Relics End_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Chapter 312 Who Peaks at the End of Divine Road, Relics End_2
As an origin power merged into his body, Balderas vanished in an instant.
Eddy Keller looked at the three streams of origin power falling overhead and smiled, “Three streams of origin power, it seems this genius has come a long way in this trial, my achievements must be among the top three.”
Since he couldn’t see anyone else after entering the trial, Eddy Keller also didn’t know the progress of people like Damon Lopes and others.
However, based on his self-assessment, his performance on the Divine Road this time was either second or third.
As for why he wasn’t first, that was, of course, because of Jack Clark.
Although he prided himself on having unparalleled talent, after repeated setbacks, Eddy Keller thought he should be a bit more ‘humble’.
When the invisible power enveloped Eddy Keller, he knew he was about to exit. A serene smile appeared on his face as he stood with his hands behind his back, ready to receive everyone’s astonished gazes with this posture.
Gabriella smiled weakly, controlling her mecha with a severed left arm, “Two streams, plus the original ten, that should be enough.”
“Three streams, huh? Not bad; this solves my problem with the king-level origin power,” Brudos said with a satisfied smile before disappearing as well.
“Is it time already?” Endless lightning gathered and reformed into the figure of Damon Lopes, who regretfully looked toward the palace amid the thunderstorm in the sky.
For within the palace lay the inheritance of the Lord of Thunder, but to obtain it, one needed to complete the Road of Heavenly Kings and defeat the level nine Thunder Giant Beast that lay outside the palace.
It was a pity; as an Innate Awakened One, he still fell short.
As four streams of origin power merged into his body, the invisible teleporting power also enveloped Damon Lopes.
Just as Damon Lopes was about to be teleported out, suddenly the lightning in the palace within the storm thundered and flashed across heaven and earth, causing the invisible rule power to hesitate for an instant.
Following that, a golden thunderbolt that pierced through heaven and earth flashed across the sky and rushed into Damon Lopes’s body in an instant.
Damon Lopes’s face immediately showed surprise, but it slowly turned to regret because the lightning was not the inheritance of the Lord of Thunder, but rather another type of thunder origin power.
However, with this Golden Thunder Origin, once he ascended to king, he could break free from the limitations of Innate Awakening, making the trip worthwhile.
…
At the edge of the Void Rift, with the appearance of around eight hundred people, the place suddenly bustled.
“Eh! Is the outside and the Void Relics synchronized in time, is it night as well?” someone asked curiously, looking around at the pitch-black surroundings.
“Junior, don’t ask about this problem; let’s talk about something else, like how I passed The Peak Road this time and obtained a stream of origin power.”
“Senior, don’t make me envious now, I wasn’t even qualified to go on the Road to Becoming a God.”
Justin Welan approached Howard Lambert with a chuckle, “Howard Lambert, you’re quite something, making it more than a thousand meters down the King’s Road.”
Without waiting for Howard Lambert to be modest, Justin Welan said with pride, “But you still can’t beat me because I’m sure to have a king’s attitude.”
Even Howard Lambert couldn’t help but curse, “Damn, you didn’t even make it onto the Road to Becoming a God; where do you get the confidence to claim you have a king’s attitude?”
“Because I’ve got big backers,” Justin Welan said matter-of-factly. “Before entering the relic, my brother told me he was heading to some mythical relic, where he should quickly breakthrough to the Nine Layers.”
“Mind you, my brother is not yet twenty years old. The thought of him being under twenty and already at the Ninth Heavens, does that scare you?”
“And besides my brother, my best friend Jack Clark is even more monstrous.”
“Haha… When the time comes, with my brother on the left and Jack on the right, clinging to these two golden thighs, wouldn’t it be normal for Grandpa Walton to become a king?”
Looking at the proud Justin Welan, the people from the Southern Battlefield all looked a bit surprised.
Nobody expected that this unremarkable guy’s brother was so monstrous – not yet twenty years old and already at the Nine Layers of Heaven, such a genius had a good chance of becoming a king within ten years.
Dion Casady expressed his doubts, “Under twenty and already at the Nine Layers… a last name of Walton, could this guy’s brother be the King Walton who suppressed the Southern Battlefield for half a year a few years ago?”
Denny Rhodes nodded slightly, “You’re right, it is King Walton, but relative to his brother, Justin Welan’s talent is much less impressive.”
After Justin Welan entered the Southern Battlefield, he had disclosed his identity to some third-grade senior students of South Sky Martial Height, infiltrating those elders to gather information.
Dion Casady was speechless, “He reached the Fifth Layer Heaven in less than a year, and that’s slow? Any faster and we’d have another freshman monster at the Sixth Layer Heaven.”
Suddenly, people from the Berlin Camp shouted excitedly in the distance, “Balderas has come out.”
Having reverted to human form, Balderas, looking like a burly young man, appeared on Berlin’s side.
Then the earth shook, and a dilapidated Mecha, dozens of meters tall, emerged before everyone, its crushed left arm and scarred armor emitting a harrowing aura.
“Gabriella has also come out.”
Before the crowd could exclaim, Eddy Keller, Brudos, and Damon Lopes appeared one after another, with Jane Aiken last, surrounded by Sword Intent.
When the girl wearing green Armor, her long hair tied into a ponytail, and with a delicate, beautiful face, appeared, the whole place fell silent and everyone couldn’t help but look at her.
Because this freshman of South Sky Martial Height, who was only at the Sixth-level Heaven, displayed the most dazzling performance on the Road of Heavenly Kings, even Damon Lopes, an Innate Awakened One, was suppressed by her.
While everyone else was surprised, Justin Welan excitedly waved his hand, “Jane Aiken, over here.”
When Jane Aiken approached, Crystal Lewis expressed her regret, “What a pity. If there had been enough time, Jane, you might have also made it through the Road of Heavenly Kings.”
“Yeah, just over six hundred meters to go.” Mandy Lewis also said with a face full of regret.
Confronted with her classmates’ regrets, Jane Aiken just shook her head, “Actually, even if there had been enough time, I wouldn’t have been able to pass that stage, not at the moment, at least.”
The others were taken aback, and Crystal Lewis asked in confusion, “…why?”
From the perspective of those on the outside, as soon as Jane Aiken took to the Road of Heavenly Kings, her progress seemed even faster and smoother than on the king-level road, and if she had another hour, perhaps she would have completed it.
Jane Aiken calmly stated, “Because my foundation is not strong enough.”
Through her understanding of Sword Intent, Jane Aiken vaguely sensed the limit of her soul, knowing that even if she fully grasped the world projection of the small world, she wouldn’t be able to pass the test.
Her base soul strength was approximately twice that of her peers.
In such a situation, even if she were to bear the rules, her cultivation could only be boosted to the peak of the Sixth-Level Heaven, not enough to defeat the guardian sword puppet whose strength has been sealed at the Level 8 Early Stage.
There was no helping it, for although the strength of this sword puppet was sealed to Level 8 Early Stage, its body material was on par with Level 9, making it indestructible by her, who was at the Sixth-Level Heaven.
Isn’t anyone asking about me? Eddy Keller, standing with his hands behind him on the edge of the crowd, felt somewhat lost, wondering why those guys were all paying attention to that girl.
As for Damon Lopes, after coming out, he sat down cross-legged, working hard to assimilate another ‘Innate Thunderbolt’ within his body.
It was then that Justin Welan looked around and wondered, “Why hasn’t Jack come out yet?”
A look of perplexity also came over the eyes of Crystal Lewis and the others. Right, wasn’t the Road to Godhood over?
Suddenly, someone exclaimed, “Look, up in the Eye of Heaven Observation.”
Everyone couldn’t help but look up.
They saw the clouds in the Eye of Heaven Observation dissipate, revealing a towering black gate standing in the Void, its edges radiating circles of white light.
In front of that huge black gate stood a tiny figure.
“It’s Jack Clark.”
“How is he still inside?”
“How is that possible, he has actually reached the end of Divine Road!”
In an instant, the whole scene was abuzz, with everyone who came out from the relic, including Eddy Keller, staring wide-eyed in disbelief at the figure at the end of Divine Road.
Especially Eddy Keller and the others, who had traversed the Road of Heavenly Kings, knew all too well how difficult it was.
Not to mention grasping the world projection, but even after completing the first step, one had to be capable of bearing the enhancement of rules to defeat guardian beasts two Major Realms higher.
To say nothing of the even longer fourth phase after crossing the Road of Heavenly Kings.
“How did he walk so fast?” Eddy Keller couldn’t help but ask.
A genius from the Northern Battlefield who came out quite early consoled, “Old Eddy, don’t get agitated, don’t get agitated. This guy is a monster, don’t compare yourself to him.”
“This guy broke through the king-level road while you were still struggling with the first stage, and then he completed the Road of Heavenly Kings in three hours and stepped onto the fourth phase.”
“Actually, he reached the end of Divine Road a while ago and has been standing there for almost an hour now.”
“…Shit!”

chapters.title: Chapter 696: 313: Primordial Rule, Innate Hibernation (Congratulations to Warm Sun Boss)
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Chapter 313: Primordial Rule, Innate Hibernation (Congratulations to Warm Sun Boss)
Deep in the Void, Jack Clark stood quietly in front of the gate.
Behind him stood a fifty-meter-tall soul projection that looked just like him, with a black Imperial Crown on its head and dressed in a black Imperial Robe.
In the hands of this Soul Emperor, a black Seal was held, emitting a heavy oppressive feeling.
