With the aid of this Soul’s Road, the Illusion Meditation Scripture had finally broken through the First Layer. His soul kept compressing and condensing, taking on the form of an emperor.
Of course, it was only similar in appearance. To reach the state of soul becoming an emperor and eternally indestructible as depicted in the Illusion Meditation Scripture, there was still a long way to go.
However, because it was deep in the void, no one could see this scene.
Feeling the path behind him collapsing continuously, Jack suddenly looked back, his gaze seemed to penetrate infinite spacetime as if seeing something, then he turned without hesitation and pushed the gate.
At the same time, the soul projection behind Jack also reached out its right hand.
Boom!
Under Jack’s burst of strength, the black gate, which could only be touched by souls, vibrated. As it slowly cracked open, a hint of white light flickered from within.
Without hesitation, Jack stepped in, and soon after, the black gate closed slowly amidst the tremors.
Outer World.
After Jack entered the black gate, the phantom in the sky disappeared, and the Ruins Continent, which was about to return to the depths of the void, was held in place by an Invisible Power.
“Jack has gone in, he’s entered that door.”
“What’s inside?”
“Nonsense, it must be an inheritance higher than that of Heavenly Kings, that’s the end of Divine Road.”
“… Jack’s hit the jackpot this time, my super golden thigh.” Seeing Jack enter that majestic gate, Justin Welan’s face turned red with excitement.
Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis, and those from the Southern Battlefield who knew Jack were also all shocked.
After all, that was the end of Divine Road.
Marcellus Larry had once said that there are twelve Monarch Inheritances on the Road to Becoming a God that are comparable to Heavenly Kings, including Monarch Inheritance above the Monarchs.
Brudos looked up at the now-empty Eye of Heaven Observation, a hint of excitement showed in his eyes: “This guy, he’s more terrifying than I imagined.”
“I really want to slice open his muscles to see what kind of structure is inside.”
Hearing this, Eddy Keller, standing beside him, looked at Brudos with a bizarrely twisted gaze: “I think you’d be flattened by his halberd before you could slice open his muscles.”
“He’s gone in…” At this moment, not just the geniuses below, but also the three Heavenly Kings in the sky were somewhat excited.
However, as kings, they still kept a calm demeanor on the surface.
The Nether Heavenly King turned around, looked down at everyone below, and said in a calm voice, “This trip to the relic is almost over, and everyone has gained more or less.”
“This time, everyone performed quite well on the Road to Godhood, especially with seven individuals showing the attitude of kings, which is quite satisfying to me.”
“However, cultivation is a long and arduous journey. I hope you all remain neither arrogant nor rash and continue with a courageous and diligent heart, carefully as if walking on thin ice, to ascend to the throne one day.”
The crowd immediately said respectfully, “We will heed the Heavenly King’s teachings.”
Despite the gentle demeanor of the Nether Heavenly King, he was a Heavenly King Level powerhouse stronger than the deities of Mythical Legend.
If this were ancient times, he would be a Main God-level existence. Whether in terms of status or the power he wielded, they had to respect him.
Otherwise, losing respect for the strong was tantamount to self-destruction.
At this time, the Nether Heavenly King continued to console, “Those who have not set foot on the Road to Becoming a God, or have not walked on the King’s Road, should not be discouraged either.”
“The so-called Road to Becoming a God is just a test of your current strength; it represents only the present, not the future.”
“We, True Martial Practitioners, are originally defying the heavens. Talent and potential will evolve as we continue our cultivation and our physiques transform.”
“Especially those who have received Inheritance this time, as long as you cultivate diligently and digest the gains from the relic, your strength and intrinsic qualities will step up to a new level.”
“However, before you retreat for Closed-door Cultivation, you need to go to that base and imprint a copy of the Cultivation Methods, runes, and upload them to the Federal Core Arsenal.”
“Besides, there is another matter to be handled.”
As he spoke, the Nether Heavenly King brought forth a black and white moon behind him, emanating a mysterious Radiance. It rose slowly, casting light that brightened the entire dark canopy.
Under the interwoven light of black and white, the black moon continued to expand, gradually occupying everyone’s field of vision…
At this moment, under the Netherworld Law controlled by the Nether Heavenly King, everyone’s memory of Jack was altered.
From originally walking to the End of Divine Road to receive the Emperor Inheritance, the memory changed to Jack overpowering the Road to Godhood but ultimately stopping in the later stages of the King’s Road.
Besides, Jane Aiken’s information also changed, to stopping in the midpoint of the King’s Road.
Such acts of altering the memories of advanced cultivators was something even ordinary Heavenly Kings could not do, hence Lori Joyner specially requested the presence of the Nether Heavenly King from across the mythical world.
As a Heavenly King Level powerhouse involved with soul laws like Sky King Denny Kaye but with a different focus, only he could alter the memories of nearly a thousand advanced cultivators at once.
However, these altered memories only involved recent information. While earlier memories could also be modified, the person would quickly notice something was amiss and then break the seal.
After all, every high-level Martial Arts Cultivator has a firm conviction, and their Spiritual Will is unwavering, especially those like Jane Aiken who have developed Sword Intent.
Therefore, the changes in the altered memories could not be too vast, or they would create logical inconsistencies.

chapters.title: Chapter 697: 313 Primordial Rule, Innate Hibernation (Congratulations to Warm Sun Boss)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 697: Chapter 313 Primordial Rule, Innate Hibernation (Congratulations to Warm Sun Boss)_2
For instance, Eddy Keller, who’s clearly a ‘first-class’ genius, has never even set foot on the King’s Road. Isn’t that ridiculous?
Not to mention, Jack Clark hadn’t embarked on the Road to Becoming a God, and he alone killed countless polluted monsters, accumulating more than 700,000 Purple Killing values of strength.
Glancing at the crowd still under the influence of soul suggestion, the Nether Heavenly King turned to Marcellus Larry, “Mr. Whitlock, you take charge here. I’ll take them to the base.”
“Alright, leave it to me.”
Boom!
As the Nether Heavenly King harnessed the darkness, the endless power of darkness surged, carrying everyone to the nearby forward base.
Bang bang!!
Once everyone touched down, Justin Welan and others felt a burst of brightness as the darkness receded, revealing the brightly lit base buildings and lobby.
At the base building’s staircase, several staff members who were already waiting politely called out, “Fellow students, please come this way to register.”
“We’re here.”
“There are quite a few people, so let’s proceed one at a time. Those who have obtained inheritance of Skill Types, please come this way. We have consciousness information transmission sensors linked to the Heavenly Think Tank.”
“Those who have obtained runes, text types, please go over there. We have specialized energy scanners, image scanners, and special energy analysis equipment.”
However, due to the large number of people, they eventually split into different factions to queue up, starting with Berlin, followed by Simon and other countries’ representatives, with Eastern Summer as the host going last.
While waiting, Crystal Lewis looked around and then said in confusion, “Strange, why don’t I see Jack Clark?”
Justin pointed towards the distance, “I saw him, along with Jane Aiken, Eddy Keller and several other geniuses who’ve walked the King’s Road, all following that Nether Heavenly King to that building over there.”
Suddenly, many people nearby showed envy in their eyes.
If in the past, calling a genius ‘king-level’ only meant that the person had extraordinary potential and a slim hope of breaking through to become a king, 90 percent failed to do so.
Just like in the Federation, where every three to five years, a generation would produce several or a dozen monstrous talents with the attitude of a king.
However, in the end, it was considered good if two out of ten with the king’s attitude could break through to become a king. Sometimes, an entire generation failed to produce a single king.
Despite this, with decades of accumulation, especially with the explosive increase in the number of cultivators over the last decade, the number of human kings had still accumulated to several dozen.
But this time, Eddy Keller and the others were different from past geniuses.
Having faced the test of the King’s Road and contemplated the secrets of the Road of Heavenly Kings, they were almost certain to cultivate to the late or even peak stages of the Ninth Heavens.
By that time, leveraging the ten or more Origin attributes they had acquired, they were almost bound to ascend to the throne, of course, assuming they did not die prematurely.
Next to her, Carol Koch regretted, “Too bad, no one completed the Road of Heavenly Kings this time, not even Jack Clark, who stopped at just over 5,000 meters. Is becoming a Heavenly King really that hard?”
Justin sarcastically replied, “Of course becoming a Heavenly King is hard. Just think about how few Heavenly Kings have emerged from the human race in decades, and you’ll understand the difficulty.”
As everyone chatted, it took almost an hour to complete the imprinting of the Skills or runes, and that was only because just a portion of the people had obtained inheritances.
After uploading the inherited Cultivation Methods, some discovered Basic Runes, and the runes contemplated on the Road to Becoming a God to the Federation, talents from various countries began to depart one after another.
By the runway of the base, aircraft filled with sci-fi elements, large transcontinental airplanes, began to queue in orderly fashion on the runway, preparing for takeoff.
“Calling the Heavenly Central Control Tower, requesting permission for Thunderbolt No. 5 to pass through the Circular Barrier and depart.”
“Control Tower received, permission granted to depart…”
“Calling the Central Control Tower, requesting Green Hell No.1 Machine to pass through the Circular Barrier and return…”
Under the night sky, the heavens slowly ‘cracked open,’ and then one by one, the fighter aircraft that were ready for takeoff soared vertically, and the transcontinental planes began to glide, emitting the humming of their engines.
As aircraft after aircraft streaked across the sky, passing through the cracks of the Enchantment, it also marked the end of this expedition to the relic.
These people from Simon Northern Frost and other countries appeared out of nowhere when they came, and left just as cleanly and decisively.
Standing on the base steps, watching the airplanes disappear, Justin Welan couldn’t help feeling sentimental, “Suddenly, it feels like a lot of time has passed all at once.”
Howard Lambert said in a deep voice, “It’s okay, it’s only been over ten days.”
“Howard, what will you do next?”
“Of course, closed-door cultivation. The Heavenly Evil Demon Manual I acquired this time is very compatible with me. After successful cultivation, I will obtain the Demon Immortal Characteristics; the more severe the injury, the stronger the power.”
“In addition, every time the Devil’s Battle Body shatters and reassembles, my strength will significantly increase.”
Howard Lambert did not hide his plans regarding the cultivation method, as there was no need to; the Federal Core Arsenal had already recorded this Skill.
Of course, just like the Illusion Meditation Scripture that Jack Clark obtained, it will be very difficult to cultivate the Heavenly Evil Demon Manual without the Inheritance, which is why the Federation Think Tank will attempt to modify and simplify these Skills.
The so-called think tank is composed of many cultivators whose cultivation talent is average and who have cultivated for twenty or thirty years, yet have only reached the Fifth Layer Heaven with little hope of further advancement.
Although these people may not have great cultivation talents, their understanding of cultivation and theoretical research has almost reached a master level.
Their usual work involves using supercomputers to simulate various Skills, optimize them, improve efficiency, and reduce difficulty.
The widespread low-level martial arts in various countries are often simplified from advanced ones by these individuals.
Including some advanced Skills, which will also be optimized and adjusted, making cultivation easier and more powerful for cultivators, similar to textbook editing, only what they’re editing are True Martial Arts.
And the highest person in charge of the core think tank is the True Martial Heavenly King who created the Body Casting Skill, which caused a boom in the number of Federation cultivators in the past decade.
While Justin Welan and others were in closed-door cultivation at the base.
In the dark, void, yet with a sense of reality, Void, Chen Chu slowly opened his eyes after absorbing the information and looked towards the distance.
There, a grey cloud with a diameter of hundreds of meters slowly rotated, emanating a Mysterious Aura, and this grey cloud was the “Emperor Inheritance.”
The Primordial Rule left by an Ancient Civilization Emperor known as Henry.
In fact, there is no such thing as the Emperor Inheritance in the world, and Monarch level strong men could not possibly be cultivated through learning, otherwise the Ancient Civilization wouldn’t just have seven Emperors.
Whether it is ancient or modern methods, cultivators begin to perfect their own path after breaking through high-orders and eventually elevate it to a rule, breaking through to the king-level.
Emperors are no different, each Monarch’s rules only fit themselves, and their path extending to rules is unique to them.
And that ball of Primordial Rule known as the rule is actually a blank seed of law.
When Jack reaches the level of a Heavenly King in his cultivation later, he will be able to use this blank Primordial Law to nurture his own rules and quickly step into the ranks of the Supreme.
The precondition for bearing this Primordial Rule is that the foundational soul reaches thirty times, which is why the requirements to unlock the Soul’s Road are so high.
This reward might not sound very extravagant and not fitting for an Emperor Inheritance, but in fact, the Inheritance began the moment Jack and others set foot on the Road to Becoming a God.
Or rather, the entire Road to Becoming a God is part of the Emperor Inheritance.
Normally, after completing the King’s Road and the Road of Heavenly Kings that fits with one’s own attributes, obtaining those runes, Origin, and comprehending a small world, one can basically cultivate to the level of a Heavenly King.
Plus a powerful soul that meets the requirements and the Primordial Rule, once breaking through to the Heavenly King, one can advance quickly to the Supreme.
At this point, whether one can step into the Emperor level depends on one’s own Creation.
“Who would have thought that the Emperor Inheritance had already begun.”
Amid his musings, Jack Clark approached the grey halo. Subsequently, his soul projection wearing the Imperial Crown and Imperial Robe and holding the Soul Suppressing Seal appeared once again.
Boom! As soon as Jack’s soul touched the Primordial Rule, the grey cloud vibrated suddenly burst in size and engulfed Jack, forming a gigantic cloud several thousand meters in diameter.
Within the grey cloud, resembling a miniature cosmos, a massive figure could vaguely be seen hibernating, emitting a Terrifying Aura, as if nurturing an Innate deity.

chapters.title: Chapter 698: 314 Rule-based Creatures, the Speaker Makes a Move (Requesting Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 698: Chapter 314 Rule-based Creatures, the Speaker Makes a Move (Requesting Monthly Votes)
Icy deep sea below, the sea water murky, mountain peaks collapsing.
The black-red colossal beast, one hundred and ninety-eight meters in length, stood upright, with burning golden flames on its body, destructive thunder leaping between the dorsal fins, exuding a terrifying might.
On the seabed two kilometers away, lay the corpse of a Level 9 Giant Beast, over one hundred and fifty meters long, its lethal wound a burnt black hollow five meters in diameter that penetrated through the skull.
This beast was the last Level 9 Giant Beast in the North Ice Sea Area, extremely cautious by nature.
Upon noticing that something was off in the North Ice Sea Area recently, it hid its presence and stayed concealed; the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon searched for almost two days before finding it.
In the midst of its escape, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon caught up and unleashed a pulse breath enhanced by nine rings of thunder, piercing through the deep sea to blast the giant beast from behind.
At that time, in the dark waters behind, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, over three hundred meters long, appeared, and gazing at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon who had been standing motionless for a long time, it let out a slow growl.
“King, what’s, wrong, with, you?”
The golden vertical pupils of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon flickered slightly, and coming back to its senses, it let out a low growl, “Nothing, I was just pondering the beastly life.”
Pondering the beastly life?? A string of question marks slowly emerged in the Red Beast’s mind.
With his soul carrying the primordial rule, Jack Clark’s main consciousness had fallen into a deep hibernation, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, being one with his soul source, was also affected.
This time, the carrying of the rule wasn’t as simple as the world origin merging into the soul, but rather a transformation of Jack Clark’s soul.
Those above Heavenly Kings, the Supreme Experts, were beings that had carved out their own path of rules and wielded control over them, and a step further, the Mythical Emperors, had become rule-based creatures.
The two were fundamentally different.
Of course, whether it’s laws or rules, they are the strength of Transcendent Giant Beasts and cultivators themselves, the sublimation of their own paths, where mighty power returns to the self – not about controlling some law of the Blue Star World or the mythical world.
However, there are those who follow a path of fusing with Heaven and Earth, aligning their own laws with some law of the mythical world, and becoming a ‘True God’ who commands a part of the universe.
In the Divine Gods Alliance of the mythical world, some neutral king-level beings who call themselves deities have intertwined and merged their own laws with the heavenly earth laws, forming a Divine Nation.
Within their Divine Nation, these kings are much more powerful, and every action they take is backed by the strength of a part of the universe; at the same time, the laws of their Divine Nation suppress their opponents.
But this path also has significant drawbacks, for once they leave their Divine Nation, their strength can plummet dramatically.
But all of this was still somewhat distant for Jack Clark.
At the moment, under the power of the rule left by Monarch Henry, the blank primordial rule had turned into a primordial cosmos, slowly transforming his soul.
Of course, this transformation was only to imbue Jack Clark’s soul with a touch of the rule’s aura, carrying the primordial essence, not a transformation of the soul into a rule-based creature.
Even Monarchs wouldn’t be capable of such a direct transformation to nurture a rule-based creature.
“Roar! Candle Dragon, I need to sleep for a few days, don’t disturb me,” said the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. With a flick of its tail, in a few breaths, it reached a nearby underwater mountain peak.
As for the flesh and blood of that Level 9 Giant Beast, it could wait until it woke.
Looking at the black-red ferocious behemoth coiled upon a distant mountain, hibernating, the Red Beast waited a while before reacting, its fearsome maw slightly agape.
“Oh.”
Two days later
At the edge of the Void Rift, Marcellus Larry sat cross-legged, quietly cultivating.
At that moment, the space far away twisted and folded, and the Nether Heavenly King appeared out of nowhere, speaking calmly, “Mr. Whitlock, is there anything unusual inside?”
Marcellus Larry opened his eyes and shook his head, “Nothing unusual.”
No anomalies meant that everything was going smoothly, and the Nether Heavenly King nodded in satisfaction, “That’s good. However, the situation at the Frontline Battlefield is volatile, and I can’t stay long.”
“Once this youngster comes out, discuss with him about his future cultivation,” he said.
“Originally, I thought to let him continue cultivating in the Blue Star World, with us providing enough resources until he makes his breakthrough to king-level. Only then would he go to the mythical world.”
“But at the emergency meeting called yesterday with the three Speakers, the First Councilor rejected this proposal.”
Marcellus Larry was slightly startled, “Why?”
Jack had traversed the King’s Road and the Road of Heavenly Kings and gained the Emperor Inheritance; he had enough depth to break through to king-level all the way.
What he should have done next was to calmly make his breakthrough, continuing to cultivate until reaching king-level before venturing out – otherwise, any unexpected mishap could result in great loss.
Although the Nether Heavenly King had sealed the news, altering everyone’s memories about this relic, it didn’t mean that Jack was out of danger.
In the previous mission where he collaborated with Ilisa Ward to assassinate the demon king, his displayed strength and talent were too formidable, landing him on the assassination list of geniuses for both the Evil God Sect and The Purgatory Family.
If he goes to the mythical world later and is discovered, it’s certain that The Purgatory Family would have demon kings assail him.
This was also why the Nether Heavenly King didn’t alter the information too drastically, retaining his ‘achievement’ of having a king’s attitude.
In fact, in the initial mission to lure and kill the Blood God and demon king, Jack was merely a collaborator; the real bait was Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One.
Together with Ilisa Ward, they were enough to draw out Kautorus, the demon king.
But who could have expected that Jack’s breakthrough pace would be so astonishing, growing from the early Sixth Layer to the late stage in just one month, with combat power that defied the heavens.
However, this perfectly executed the assassination plan, causing The Purgatory Demon Race to lose more than three demon kings at once and destroying the Rule True Body of the Blood God.
The Nether Heavenly King slowly said, “The First Councilor’s reason was that the King’s Road is forged in blood and fire; looking across our Human Race’s several dozen King-level strong men, which one of them did not fight their way through?”

chapters.title: Chapter 699: 314 Rule-based Creatures, the Speaker Makes a Move (Requesting Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Chapter 314 Rule-based Creatures, the Speaker Makes a Move (Requesting Monthly Votes)_2
“But this child has risen like a rainbow since his rise, breaking through all shackles; if we interfere forcibly, we might break his momentum.”
“Of course, the Speaker doesn’t mean to let things slide; both Speakers will refine two trump cards for him.”
“In addition, if he wants to go to the mythical world later, it is recommended that he goes to the Expedition Division to explore and temper himself in the mysterious and vast mythical world.”
“As for the frontline battlefield, he should at least make a breakthrough to the Nine Layers before going. By then, even if faced with a demon king’s sneak attack, he won’t be caught off guard.”
“We’ll discuss these matters with him after he comes out, especially the situation concerning the mythical world; we can’t be careless.”
“I understand.”
…
In the darkness, a gray hazy light orb with a diameter of several kilometers, like a nascent universe, slowly rotated, with a massive shadow vaguely emerging inside.
Wrapped in primordial power, Jack Clark felt a peace he had never experienced before.
Ever since entering Koroya, Jack Clark rarely slept; he fought during the day and cultivated at night while half of his consciousness took the form of a Giant Beast to evolve through combat in the deep sea.
Even during the week back at Mist River, the nights were almost entirely spent in cultivation.
Thus, this time he slept very comfortably, so comfortably that he didn’t even know when the primordial rules had dissipated within him.
In the darkness, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which still carried the befuddlement of ordinary people upon waking, and it took a long while before he regained his senses and sighed softly.
“It’s been a long time since I’ve felt this relaxed.”
However, after his moment of sentimentality, Jack Clark turned his attention inward, focusing on the Soul Suppressing Seal in the hand of the great emperor illusion formed by his soul.
In the Soul Suppressing Seal, a micro gray universe slowly rotated, emitting an intangible fluctuation.
Every time that fluctuation from the Primordial Rule swept over Jack Clark’s soul, the automatically operating Illusion Meditation Scripture, after his breakthrough to the second layer, would speed up a little more.
Even his soul was slowly transforming under the wave of Primordial Rule.
During his earlier hibernation, Jack Clark subconsciously chose the Soul Suppressing Seal, which had merged with his soul, as the point of bearing.
This situation not only helped alleviate the pressure on his own soul but also allowed the Primordial Law to constantly temper the soul’s secret treasure, enhancing its quality and power.
But now, the Soul Suppressing Seal should probably be renamed Soul Suppression Emperor Seal—it sounds more imposing that way.
After sensing the changes within him, Jack Clark summoned the attribute page with a thought.
Realm: Seventh Layer Heaven [Mid Period]
Physique: 6484
Strength: 6823
Agility: 5935
Spirit: 5901
Talent: Soul Split+ [Top-tier: Emperor Protection, Rule Wrapping, Soul Essence Undergoing Initial Transformation, Contains a Trace of Rule Aura]
Void Double Pupils+16014 [Top-tier: Eyes Containing the Power to Destroy the Void]
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Second Layer, Emperor Shadow, Condensing an Almost Material Soul, Innate Emperor, Can Exist for Ten Days Even if the Body Shatters]
Combat Divine Body: Halberd [Seventh Layer, Combat Shadow 46%]
Runes: Doomsday Purgatory [Complete] Hidden Deity [Complete] Cut through the Void [Incomplete]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Technique [Grand Accomplishment]
Realm of Thought: Prison Blood War Intent [Grand Accomplishment]
Attribute Points: 41
Equipment: …
This expedition to the ruins had brought great gains for Jack Clark in all aspects.
In terms of cultivation inheritance, there was the Illusion Meditation Scripture, and among physical treasures, there were four Thunderbolt Law Fragments and the Black Wind Crystal imbued with the Wind Law Charm.
Moreover, his cultivation had smoothly made a breakthrough to the mid period of the Seventh Layer, and his normal battle strength had reached the late period of the Eight Layer, a cross-realm combat power that even king-level figures found astonishing.
But the greatest gain was naturally the Primordial Law, equivalent to an Emperor’s Ticket, followed by the complete world projection he comprehended on the Road of Heavenly Kings.
Though not apparent on the attribute page, its value far exceeded that of the four Thunderbolt Law Fragments.
This was Martial Arts intrinsic value, immeasurable in worth.
For example, before this, Jack Clark had only a vague concept of the four external constructed worlds behind the Combat Divine Body, intending to refine and perfect them while cultivating.
But after comprehending a complete small world, Jack Clark now knew how to condense and perfect them, and finally, unite the Four Great Worlds and Open Heaven and Earth.
Also, the eighth layer and ninth level of the Combat Divine Body’s cultivation had almost no difficulty for him now; they were clear in his mind.
It could be said that after this, Jack Clark only needed to cultivate steadily, and he could smoothly advance to the Ninth Heavens after breaking through the Eighth Layer, with a clear path ahead.
Of course, this ‘quickly’ certainly isn’t a matter of a few days.
Pensively, Jack Clark slowly stood up, and as the inheritance mechanism was triggered, a surge of rule power enveloped him, and he vanished in an instant.
As Jack Clark departed, the ‘world’ that existed deep within the Void suddenly collapsed.
At the same time, the Ruins Continent floating in the Void also shook thunderously.
Boom, boom, boom!! Under the push of the fierce Void tides that destroyed everything, the Ruins Continent trembled and then shot off into the depths at a speed far exceeding its arrival.
At the Edge of the Void Rift, Jack Clark’s figure appeared out of nowhere. Seeing Marcellus Larry seated cross-legged not far away in the sky, he politely said, “I have seen the Larry Throne.”
Marcellus Larry opened his eyes, stood up, and floated over to Jack Clark, saying with admiration, “Jack, your performance on the Road to Godhood has almost shocked all of us old fellows. I didn’t expect that you would not only complete the Heavenly King Road but even reach the End of Divine Road and obtain the Emperor Inheritance.”
Jack Clark humbly replied, “You flatter me, Throne. I’m only standing on the shoulders of giants. Without you all having fathomed the rules of the Ruins, I wouldn’t have been able to advance so swiftly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 700: 314 Rule-based Creatures, the Speaker Makes a Move (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: Chapter 314 Rule-based Creatures, the Speaker Makes a Move (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
“Hahaha… you really are as modest as the records indicate, excessively modest,” Marcellus Larry couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
After laughing, Marcellus Larry spoke gently, “Your classmates are all in closed-door cultivation at the forward base over there, digesting the gains from this relic expedition. You must be planning to go into seclusion as well, right?”
Jack Clark nodded, “Yes, I plan to enter closed-door cultivation for a while to see if I can make a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven in one go.”
“That’s good. The heavenly energy is rich at the forward base, and the environment is quiet, which is very suitable for closed-door cultivation. However, before that, there are some matters I need to discuss with you,” Marcellus said.
“Let’s take our time walking over.”
“Alright.”
With that, Marcellus led the way, and Jack Clark followed half a step behind as they walked toward the distant forward base.
Although he had received the Emperor’s Inheritance, Jack Clark was well aware that he was still a Seven Layer Heaven cultivator, not a king, and he needed to maintain the proper reverence he owed.
“You must be very clear about how precious the inheritance you’ve obtained is. For your safety, the Nether Heavenly King himself has rushed over from the mythical world.”
“As one of the Eleven Heavenly Kings, the Nether Heavenly King excels in soul-type Law Powers and can invisibly alter others’ memories through the Nether Moon Law.”
“At the end of this relic expedition, the Nether Heavenly King already altered everyone’s information about you, making it seem you ended your journey on the Road of Heavenly Kings, possessing a King’s Attitude.”
“Although the geniuses who entered the relic this time have been thoroughly tested in both identity and character, you should understand that the human heart is unpredictable.”
“Thank you for the throne’s consideration, you all are indeed thorough,” said Jack.
Marcellus gave a slight smile, “Don’t mention it. You are now our Federation’s number one person from the younger generation. It’s our responsibility to protect you and ensure you grow up successfully.”
At this point, Marcellus changed the subject, “By the way, what are your thoughts after making a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven?”
Jack Clark pondered for a moment, “Before entering the relic, I joined the Military’s Special Warfare Department, so after breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven, I plan to enter the mythical world and fulfill my duties.”
The so-called duties actually mean taking on one’s own responsibilities.
From the time Jack Clark began his cultivation at the Martial Arts School until now, cultivation methods, essence blood given at a low price, resources, and secret books all came from Eastern Summer, from official channels.
Now that he had broken through to a high level and was even on the cusp of breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven, at that time, he could have a strength burst rivaling that of a level-9 early stage.
With such strength if he were still to remain on the Blue Star, he himself would feel somewhat ashamed. After all, Lori Parma and others had actively applied to the frontline battlefield after breaking through the Seventh Layer. Were they not afraid of death?
Of course, they were afraid, but they were very clear about their responsibilities. If everyone feared death and dared not go to the frontline, then who would withstand the Purgatory Demon Race that was closing in step by step?
Feeling the firmness in Jack Clark’s tone, Marcellus went momentarily silent, then his face revealed a relieved smile, “Actually, before this, I had a chat about you with the Nether Heavenly King…”
Marcellus told Jack everything about his conversation with the Nether Heavenly King the day before, including how three Speakers would craft two life-saving trump cards for him.
The trump cards crafted by the Speakers were certainly not for defending against Demon King Level Strong, but rather the Great Demon King.
As for the Purgatory Demon Race’s Demon God Level Powerhouses, there was no need to take action yet, since according to the “information,” Jack’s talent was only that of a King’s Attitude, with the potential to be a Heavenly King.
As for Cartholus, who knew that his foundational soul exceeded “five times,” he died before he could spread the news.
In the end, Marcellus Larry suggested, “If after your breakthrough to the Eight Layer, you still decide to go to the mythical world, I suggest you first visit the Expedition Division.”
“The Expedition Division.”
Jack Clark hesitated slightly; he wanted to go to the frontline battlefield and wreak havoc, to blast a member of the Eight Layer Purgatory Demon Race with a single halberd, showing them what it meant to be peerless within the same rank.
Besides, he needed to slay more high-level enemies to absorb the Blood Fiend and enhance the Demon Shadow.
Marcellus smiled faintly, “Actually, whether it’s the frontline battlefield, the Expedition Division, or the Special Warfare Division, it’s all about fighting for the future of the Human Race.”
“But your situation is special, or let’s say very important to the Human Race. We all do not wish for any mishaps to occur before you breakthrough to King-level.”
“Moreover, you are indeed well-suited for the Expedition Division. Cultivating the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, with your Heart’s Eye, you can detect dangers in advance when exploring unfamiliar areas and avoid attacks.”
“Conversely, the frontline battlefield, due to the opponents being the Purgatory Demon Race, is actually more dangerous for you.”
“As a strong race with tens of thousands of years of inheritance, the Purgatory Demon Race has numerous methods, including countless Secret Magic Skills to shield perception and killing intent. It’s difficult to guard against them.”
After Marcellus finished speaking, Jack Clark sincerely thanked him, “Thank you for your concern, sovereign. I will seriously consider your advice.”

chapters.title: Chapter 701: 315 Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough, The Monarch Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: Chapter 315 Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough, The Monarch Returns
From Marcellus Larry’s words, Jack Clark sensed the Federal Top Level’s high regard for him.
The reason was naturally his increasingly frightening talent and the inheritance he had gained this time. It seemed somewhat ‘opportunistic’, but Jack felt it was quite normal.
As top strong men of the Human Race, their attention focused on how to fight against different races, how to slay the other side’s top strong men, without the time and energy to pay attention to those below.
Therefore, only when a genius rose to prominence would they be noticed by the Federal Top Level.
Moreover, the attention these strong men paid to Jack and the slanted allocation of resources they offered, was merely to enhance the overall racial strength and expand their own high-end combat power.
Of course, that the overall environment for the Human Race was so positive was actually related to external pressure.
Otherwise, in the normal development of a ‘Transcendent’ society, these individual human-shaped nuclear bomb launchers of king-level strong men would have established Divine Nations and divided worlds long ago.
And to consolidate their own positions, those ‘gods’ would also join hands to block pathways, disallowing other geniuses from rising and suppress everything.
This was also the reason why Jack had been cautious at the start, fearing he might encounter such a scenario.
Only later, upon learning of the Federation’s emphasis on geniuses and confirming that the cultivation environment of this world was a positive structure, did he cease hiding his ability to sweep through everything.
As they almost reached the Forward Base, Marcellus Larry said, “The logistics of the base on the other side are already gathering resources to prepare God-level resources for your swift breakthrough to Nine-fold Peak after Eight Layer Heaven.”
“Like a Blood Abyss Dragon Pattern Fruit that could transform an Eight Layer flesh body in one try or a Grade 9 Mysterious Lotus Seed that greatly enhances domain and talent fusion after Nine Layers.”
“Besides that, do you have any specific resources you need?”
In response to Marcellus Larry’s question, Jack thought for a moment, “Life Crystals, a large amount of Life Crystals.”
“My physique has a very low resistance to Life Crystals, with a higher conversion rate, and absorbing the energy of Life Crystals can significantly enhance the overall strength of my body.”
“Combined with the attribute of the Cultivation Methods I obtained from breaking through the Four Layer Heaven, it can enable me to burst out with even stronger combat power.”
At Jack’s current status, some ‘secrets’ could already be disclosed, such as the fact that Life Crystals could enhance his strength.
Of course, the excuse naturally fell on the made-up physique talent.
In fact, this secret was no longer a secret long ago.
The official had noticed this issue when they retrieved Jack’s past exchange records.
They found that Jack had exchanged most of his Contribution Points for crystals before the Sixth Layer Heaven, and the only things left were Tyrant Elephant and dragon essence blood, essential for Cultivation Methods.
This was also the reason for the note in the record that he had awakened his flesh and blood talent.
Because only having awakened flesh and blood talent could explain his rapid absorption of crystal energy without resistance and why his flesh and blood was so powerful.
Marcellus Larry smiled slightly, “No problem, the crystals will be gathered in a few days.”
After talking with Jack, Marcellus Larry flew towards the First Channel Base in the distance; his duty was to guard the pathway and he couldn’t leave for long.
In the base’s Office Building, Jack uploaded the Illusion Meditation Scripture, noted the Black Wind Crystal, and applied for a Cultivation Room.
With increased strength and a transformed soul, Jack absorbed the Sky Element Stones even faster.
Next, he planned to cultivate day and night, to see if he could achieve breakthrough to Eight Layer within ten days.
And after the breakthrough, he had many tasks, such as contemplating the wind attribute Law Charm of the Black Wind Crystal, the Earth Law charm of the Mysterious Yellow Stone, completing the final step of the Combat Divine Body.
At that time, by fusing with the Level 9 Giant Beast skeleton and acquiring the essence of Heaven and Earth to construct his world, growing to a certain extent, he would gain extra power from four Illusory Worlds.
Although it wouldn’t be as strong as the Law Power of the previous small world in the early stages, it would further enhance his strength.
And when later the four worlds transitioned from illusory to reality, by then…
Meanwhile, as Jack went into Closed-door Cultivation to break through the Eight Layer Heaven, beneath the North Ice Sea, the awakened Black-red Colossal Beast was feasting heartily.
Under the sharp, huge fangs of its upper and lower jaws, the thick and hard scale armor of the Level 9 Giant Beast shattered, and the muscles, tens of times tougher than alloy even after death, ruptured with the ear-piercing sound of fracturing metal.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon chewed, the fangs crushing the flesh and blood and scale armor resounded explosively, with high-energy blood diffusing into the sea water, appearing ferocious and frightening.
Devouring a Level 9 Giant Beast was almost equal to consuming a metal mine, except this mine was made of flesh and blood and contained abundant biological energy.
These pieces of flesh and scale armor, smashed into several meter ‘small’ chunks, entered the furnace-like stomach of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, where they were quickly digested into scorching biological energy.
This scorching biological energy was voraciously absorbed by the cells of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body, then divided and compressed.
Under the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s perception, its muscle cells had shrunk by hundreds of times from the original size, and their shape no longer resembled ordinary biological cells, turning into thirty-six sided polyhedra.
And the surfaces of these cell walls, like crystals, radiated golden black light, while their interiors pulsed with strong energy fluctuations.
These cells represent the ‘strength’ talent and the ‘Golden Flame’ energy source.
With an abundance of biological energy, the figure of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon crackled, its bones and fascia growing, muscles expanding, and scale armor stretching to grow in sync.
From afar, it appeared as if it was enlarging in overall proportion, a sight that slowly revealed shock in the eyes of the distant red-colored giant beast.
During this period, it had led the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to kill many level eight and Level 9 Giant Beasts, witnessing its size grow rapidly from over one hundred and sixty meters to its current size.

chapters.title: Chapter 702: 315 Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough, The Monarch Returns_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Chapter 315 Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough, The Monarch Returns_2
This monster’s ordinary growth rate was something the Giant Beast Candle Dragon had never seen before in all its years.
Under normal conditions, shouldn’t everyone just eat a little, sleep, then eat a little more, and continue sleeping, gradually growing as they slowly absorb the energy of Heaven and Earth?
Boom!
As Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body length broke through 200 meters, an even more ferocious and terrifying pressure burst forth from its body, shaking the deep sea and forming concentric circles of white water explosions.
Breaking through to the mid period of Level 9, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed to have undergone a minor Evolution, breaking one of its limits, as its entire flesh, blood, and bones underwent changes, becoming even more powerful.
At the same time, all eight of its talents were enhanced as its body grew, the destructive high temperatures emitted by the Heaven Burning Golden Flame rose sharply, spreading scorching shockwaves in all directions.
Between the three rows of coral reef-like dorsal fins on its back, the leaping blue and black Thunder became thicker, resembling a tangled mass of lightning serpents.
With the explosion of Annihilation True Thunder, large swathes of blue lightning spread in all directions, turning several kilometers into a zone of death, becoming even more terrifying.
Meanwhile, in the Closed-door cultivation room, Jack Clark, who was sitting cross-legged, also emitted a terrifying aura, the constant strengthening of his power causing the entire Cultivation Room to vibrate slightly.
Finally, mid Level 9, huh.
Standing amidst golden flames and the roaring Thunder, feeling the stronger power within, the corners of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth lifted slightly, looking incredibly ferocious.
In fact, it had been just over half a month since it broke through to Level 9. For many Giant Beasts, this amount of time might have passed just in their sleep.
Just like human cultivators, most Giant Beasts’ growth speeds also became very slow after breaking through to Level 7, occasionally eating or hibernating to slowly absorb energy and evolve.
Only a small portion of those who occupied Resource Points, or those Giant Beasts with better talents, grew quickly, such as those that had awakened King-level and Monarch-level bloodlines.
Even then, for these Giant Beasts to grow by one level would take years as a unit of time, unless they encountered a great fortuity.
For example, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, because they followed Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, enjoyed the supply of resources equivalent to the territories of several Level 9 Giant Beasts combined.
And by consuming the flesh and blood of the King-level giants of Level 9 Early and Mid Stage and replenishing evolutionary biological factors, they were able to grow at a remarkable speed.
Even so, two months had passed and they still hadn’t grown to the peak of level eight.
After breaking through to the mid period of Level 9, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to feed, taking just over two hours to completely devour the Level 9 Giant Beast, leaving behind only a massive skeleton.
By this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had grown to 205 meters, and the might it radiated became even more formidable.
After eating its fill, it was time to get down to serious business.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked towards the enormous Red Beast laying on the seabed in the distance, issuing a deep roar, “Roar! Candle Dragon, take these bones with me, back to the Dragon Palace.”
More than ten days had passed, and Whale Giant Beast Kitty Jones and the others should have collected quite a few Life Crystals. Soon after their Giantification Talent was fortified to Top-tier, its combat strength would be enough to enter the realm of Myth.
Although it was only comparable to an Ordinary Mythical-level, it would not be completely powerless against that Mythical Giant Beast.
Moreover, its goal was to fight and grow through combat, first slaughtering the fringe forces of that Beast Empire in this region, and it wouldn’t immediately clash with that Mythical Giant Beast.
Once it had devoured a few more Level 9 mid period and above Giants, and its strength had increased again, along with the crystal fortification Jack was going to receive for the Top Tier Talent… at that time…
Boom!
With a burst of golden flames behind it, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon took off like a massive submarine fighter aircraft towards the distance, creating violent surges in its wake under the sea.
The Red Beast, which was over 300 meters long, closely followed behind, each of its three claws holding the skeletons of three Level 9 Giant Beasts that were over a hundred meters long.
The skeletons of these Level 9 Giant Beasts were top-tier resources, not to be wasted; they were the essence materials Jack intended to smelt into the Four Great Worlds.
It was the same strait, and more than ten days had passed, with the sea surface once again covered by two or three meters of solid ice, looking like a cold, white continent exuding a chill.
Near the coast, about a hundred meters onto the ice, a few staff engaged in the observation and study of mutated creatures in the sea were busy, cutting out a ten-meter ice hole and placing underwater detectors.
Just then, the alarm system of the research station suddenly went off with a piercing red light.
“Alert, a strong Level 9 biological energy fluctuation detected, originating from the direction of the iced sea, currently approaching the Kurole Strait at Subsonic Speed.”
“Warning, the target creature is likely to cross the strait, by which time it will destroy the ice layer, generating a Tsunami. Please, the coastal survey team must immediately evacuate from the Seaside, evacuate immediately…”
“Damn, another Level 9 Giant Beast has appeared, run!”
This time, the few staff reacted swiftly, dropping everything and using their movement techniques to rush towards the distant hillside.
Just as they had reached the hillside, the distant sea suddenly rose tens of meters high, with towering, black and red coral-like dorsal fins emerging from the raging waves.
“It’s the Giant Beast from over ten days ago, be careful.”
Boom, boom, boom! The ice over the strait, only a few hundred meters deep, shattered, and immediately following the swift passage of the Giant Beast, a Tsunami a hundred meters high was generated.
The spectacle was magnificent.
Just as the people heaved a sigh of relief, someone suddenly cried out in terror, “Look out, there’s another Giant Beast, and that one is even larger.”
Boom! As the even larger Red Beast plunged into the strait, it caused even more raging waves, creating two massive curtains of sea water that surged to either side.

chapters.title: Chapter 703: 315 Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough, The Monarch Returns_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Chapter 315 Closed-door Cultivation Breakthrough, The Monarch Returns_3
In the raging sea water, a row of sharp dorsal fins, which looked like red armor and stretched for dozens of meters, sliced rapidly through the water, extending for hundreds of meters, terrifyingly formidable.
“The Giant Beast that just passed by is so terrifying.”
“Yeah, it feels even stronger than the Black Colossus. Merely the invisible aura it emitted as it passed by made my legs go weak, I almost peed myself.”
“Dude, it’s not almost, you’re already wet down there.”
After the two Giant Beasts had passed, the coasts on both sides were in complete disarray, with several kilometers of area turned into a marshland under the Tsunami, and countless ordinary Mutated Fish stranded on land, jumping continuously as the sea water receded.
However, this area was part of the Desolate Polar Region, uninhabited except for a few research investigators, so the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t have to worry about injuring any innocents.
It slowed to subsonic speed on entering the strait, giving them time to dodge before it couldn’t be bothered to care anymore.
At the same time, the Ocean Monitoring Center detected the energy fluctuations of two Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts entering the Pacific Ocean Area and mobilized satellites to monitor the surroundings.
……
Two thousand kilometers away from the Water and Fire World, a Black Tiger Whale, over fifty meters long, soared high into the air, a hundred meters above the sea surface, before crashing down thunderously.
Bang! The colossal body of the Level 7 late-stage behemoth fell, instantly causing the sea water to explode, shooting up water sprays hundreds of meters high.
Excitedly circling the area and finding nothing, Tiger Whale Third Brother let out a cry: roar! My Lord, my Lord, I have gathered some information.
Boom! Far below in the deep sea, an aura of a Level 9 Giant Beast burst forth, and soon after, a Sea Dragon giant beast emerged from the darkness, its body over two hundred meters long.
The enormous creature emanated an oppressive presence, slowly approaching the Black Tiger Whale, and the Sea Dragon giant beast let out a low growl, “You gathered the information so quickly?”
Looking around at the Single-horned Tiger Whale Third Brother’s surroundings, its eyes showed both confusion and caution: roar! “Where are your horde of subordinates?”
Tiger Whale Third Brother did not change his expression, respectfully saying, roar! I had them wait further away; these guys are too timid, they can’t even speak in your presence, my Lord.
Is that so?
The Sea Dragon giant beast growled lowly, “What information have you gathered about the Dragon Palace?”
Tiger Whale Third Brother ‘excitedly’ flapped its Double Fins, roar! I have found out that the Blue Giant Crab from the Dragon Palace has made a breakthrough to Level 8, becoming incredibly fierce and awesome.
…Level 8. The Sea Dragon giant beast was speechless.
It had thought it was some important information, but it turned out to be just a lackey of the Dragon Palace breaking through to Level 8; a Level 8 Early Stage creature wasn’t even enough for a single bite for it.
Nevertheless, the Sea Dragon giant beast still encouraged it: roar! “I see, you did well this time, keep it up, and I will recommend you to the Lord of the Black Abyss.”
“You must know that the Lord of the Black Abyss is a Mythical-level Giant Beast and is very powerful amongst the Mythical Giant Beasts, it would be a great honor for you to be favored by it.”
The Black Tiger Whale suddenly felt deeply ‘grateful,’ thrashing its Double Fins, roar! Thank you, thank you for your support, my Lord.
“Roar! Is there anything else?” Seeing the Black Tiger Whale floating in the water without leaving, the Sea Dragon giant beast showed a puzzling look in its eye.
The Black Tiger Whale blinked its large eyes, ‘innocently’ looking at the Sea Dragon giant beast: roar! My Lord, didn’t you say that if I brought useful news, you would give me something tasty?
…To think that for such trashy news it would actually ask for a Divine Fruit. The Sea Dragon giant beast almost let out a ferocious roar, but eventually suppressed it.
After a moment’s thought, the Sea Dragon giant beast still controlled the current to unwrap a 1-meter diameter, black-red fruit from behind its scale armor that the Black Tiger Whale had once eaten.
The eyes of the Black Tiger Whale instantly brightened, showing excitement.
The Sea Dragon giant beast growled lowly: roar! “The information you brought today is just so-so, but seeing as you’re working so hard, I’ve decided to reward you with a Dark Melting God Fruit.”
Roar! Thank you, Master—I will do my utmost to serve you diligently.
“Roar! Remember, the main thing is to scout out the situation with those Dragon Kings at the Dragon Palace, especially the sea areas they occupy; whether they are usually in hibernation or up to something else.”
Roar! Little one remembers, I’ll be sure to find out everything, even what they eat and what positions they sleep in.
Saying this, the Black Tiger Whale excitedly opened its ferocious maw and swallowed the Dark Melting God Fruit from the mythical world.
Boom! The intense, overwhelming energy burst open in its stomach once again, and with the stimulation from the energy of the mythical world’s resources, the Black Tiger Whale erupted with an even more vicious aura.
Black energy swirled, covering hundreds of meters, making it appear like a devouring giant beast lurking in the abyss, exuding a fierce and dangerous atmosphere.
This time, although the Divine Fruit’s energy was still immense, it had a much weaker effect on the Black Tiger Whale’s growth than before, allowing it to grow from fifty-five to fifty-eight meters.
Feeling disappointed as the growth ended, the Black Tiger Whale let out a sad cry: Roar! Why haven’t I reached the Peak Level 7 yet?
The Sea Dragon Giant Beast growled lowly, “This is normal. Each Extraordinary God Item’s contained energy factors are most effective the first time; their effects diminish with the second use.”
“After four or five times, these Divine Objects will no longer have an effect on Extraordinary Creatures; they can only replenish energy, and one must switch to a different God-level resource for rapid growth again.”
So lousy, yet it’s supposed to be a Divine Object from the mythical world, and its effects have weakened so much after just the second time.
The Black Tiger Whale muttered to itself internally while its eyes showed joy and gratitude: Roar! So that’s how it is, thank you, Master. I’ll go scout out the other Dragon Kings at the Dragon Palace for you right away.
Roar! Once I find anything, I’ll come back and report to you immediately.
The Sea Dragon Giant Beast hurriedly roared back: “Roar! No rush. After you have thoroughly scouted all the Dragon Kings, come back and report to me all at once.”
It was somewhat afraid this creature would come to it with any bit of news it found; it didn’t have that many Dark Melting God Fruits to hand out as rewards.
Sword Dragon Tarr had only given it three this time, and it wanted to keep one to taste, even though it had eaten them before.
The Black Tiger Whale’s eyes shifted, then it nodded respectfully: Roar! Alright, Master; goodbye, Master. I will return soon, wait for me.
Ha ha… fooled it into giving me another fruit to eat. The Black Tiger Whale swam away, elated.
But Mom had said that these fruits aren’t easy to trick, and after eating this one, I can’t come back for more, or it will be dangerous.
Soon, the Black Tiger Whale met up with the ten plus Mutated Tiger Whales that had been waiting a few kilometers away.
This batch of Tiger Whales was different from the last, but since Tiger Whales all looked roughly the same, it wasn’t obvious, except for the Female Tiger Whale with the mutated fish stomach pouch hung on her dorsal fin.
Returning to the group, the Black Tiger Whale, filled with spirit, let out a loud call: Roar! Follow me, this time our target is the Dragon Palace Headquarters.
Roar! The leader is mighty.
Roar! Leader, you worked hard.
Roar! With the leader leading the charge, eat once every three days…
As the group of Mutated Tiger Whales called out excitedly, they charged towards the direction of the Water and Fire World, their momentum fierce and fearless.
After all the Tiger Whales left, the Sea Dragon Giant Beast slowly emerged from the deep sea, nodding in satisfaction; it was very pleased with the Black Tiger Whale’s enthusiasm.
Of course, it was not so easily fooled, as this was the Dragon Palace Territory, and it quietly followed, cloaked by its domain.
However, it seemed that the Tiger Whale hadn’t deceived it, indeed sending those underlings to stay far away, and the Sea Dragon Giant Beast had some impression of the Little Tiger Whale with something hanging on its dorsal fin.

chapters.title: Chapter 704: 316 The Silver Dragon Father, Pause in Time (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 704: Chapter 316 The Silver Dragon Father, Pause in Time (Vote for Monthly Ticket)
In the icy depths of the deep sea, where mountain peaks cracked, at the foot of a mountain a series of silver halos spread hundreds of meters, connecting to the vista of another world.
At the edge of the Spatial Channel, a sixty-odd-meter long Blue Giant Crab was busily at work.
Under its house-sized pincers, hard rocks were crackling and crumbling, revealing a statue of a Giant Beast, hundreds of meters tall, standing erect.
The Blue Giant Crab bustled around the statue, excitedly blowing bubbles.
Gurgle gurgle!! Crab General, I’m so clever.
Gurgle gurgle!! When King Thunderflame returns and sees his majestic and awesome statue standing outside the Dragon Palace Gate, he will surely be delighted and praise Crab General.
This was a new idea Crab General had come up with while bored and lounging at the entrance.
In its mind, King Thunderflame was tall and mighty, invincible in strength, and should stand at the entrance, commanding all Giant Beasts of the Dragon Palace to look up to him each time they passed.
At that moment, in the distance, two powerful auras approached in the dark sea, causing the sea water to explode and waves to thrash violently, as a fearsome Black-red Colossal Beast emerged from the darkness.
Following behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was an even larger Red Dragon-type Giant Beast, emanating a late Stage 9 aura of terror, pressing down so heavily that the Blue Giant Crab sank a little in stature.
As it gazed at the mountainous Red Beast, the Blue Giant Crab blew a string of bubbles, a bit curious.
As for the oppressive aura, it was simply ignored. To a creature accustomed to withstanding the Monarch’s pressure from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this was just a late Stage 9 aura.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, you’re back, Great King, you look much more awe-inspiring than when you left, so strong and ferocious.
Excitedly blowing bubbles, the Blue Giant Crab bombarded him with a string of flattery.
Not bad, this round of flattery was without those random and messy words. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction, then turned its gaze to the statue.
“Roar! Crab General, what is that?”
Hearing Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s inquiry, the eyes of the Blue Giant Crab lit up.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, this is a statue I made for you, doesn’t it resemble you? Just as valiant, tall, and robust.
Immediately, the corner of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched uncontrollably, suppressing the urge to swat the fool with its claw.
The hell does it look like this for?
One claw larger than the other, the legs below entangled together, what is that protrusion in the middle? And why is the tail tied in a knot?
Even that could have been overlooked, but the abstract head that was actually larger than the body… are you a Big Head Beast?
Watching the Blue Giant Crab waiting expectantly for its praise, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon emitted a low roar: “Forget the statues, it won’t be long before I am larger than any statue.”
“However, you could try making one for Scythia, Kidora, or Joe. They might like it.”
With that, the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon opened slightly, and a blazing Golden Flame erupted from it.
Boom! In an instant, the surrounding sea water exploded, engulfed by the Heaven Burning Golden Flame’s fiery blast wave in all directions, and the rock statue melted into magma and burst before one could blink.
Having wiped away the statue that insulted its image, standing amidst the raging waves, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep roar: “Crab General, go and bring back Horned Lady and the others. Tell them I have returned.”
The Blue Giant Crab looked regretfully at the cooled magma on the ground, then obediently bubbled its reply.
Gurgle gurgle!! Yes, Great King.
After sending the Blue Giant Crab on its way, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, its tail with sharp-spiked Dorsal Fin swishing, swam towards the Water and Fire World.
The Red Beast followed behind, entering as well and glancing at where the statue had been, an intrigued expression in its eyes.
It felt that the Giant Crab creature was somewhat interesting. The statue it had crafted had an artistic vibe, and it decided to get one made of the Great Candle Dragon when it had the time.
Just as Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had entered the Water and Fire World and its presence was sensed, a proud roar emanated from the Frost Dragon Palace amidst the storm.
Roar!
As the roar echoed, the palace trembled, and a Silver Giant Dragon, 148 meters in length, flew out with spread wings, circled in the sky before impacting the ground with a thunderous crash.
Instantly, the Earth of the Ice Crystal Square, over ten meters thick, shattered, and the winds howled.
Meanwhile, up ahead, the sea surface burst open and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon rose from the sea, countless droplets of sea water cascading down the crevices of its thick black-red Scaled Armor, forming waterfalls.
Gazing at the even more valiant Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon roared with joy: “Roar! Tim Abbott, you’ve returned.”
“Mhm, I have.” In a low growl, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze swept over the Silver Giant Dragon’s even lovelier form – no, damn it, lovely my tail.
Feeling the Silver Giant Dragon’s aura, far stronger than that of an Early Stage 9 Beast, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared low: “Scythia, you’ve awakened a new talent, haven’t you?”
The Silver Giant Dragon lifted its head slightly, roaring proudly: “Yes, I have awakened the Destroyer Ice Wind of my mother, and with space control, the Great Scythia now possesses two Top Tier Talents.”
Two Top Tier Talents, not bad, almost like me a few months ago.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon praised: “Scythia, you’re getting more and more formidable.”
“Roar! The Great Scythia was always formidable, now I’ve just become even more so,” the Silver Giant Dragon said, its tail swaying proudly, visibly delighted.
At that moment, from the Nine-Headed Dragon King Palace in the distance, nine dragon heads emerged, roaring cacophonously: “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, you’ve made a breakthrough, mid period, awesome.”
“Not bad, ate quite a number of Giant Beasts in the North Ice Sea Area.” As it spoke, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze landed on the other, noting the many runes etched onto its scale armor.

chapters.title: Chapter 705: 316: The Silver Dragon's Father, Time is Suspended (Subscription Requested)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: Chapter 316: The Silver Dragon’s Father, Time is Suspended (Subscription Requested)_2
“Roar! Kidora, how many runes have you gathered now?”
With nine mutated dragon heads, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon roared excitedly, “Roar, roar!! Seven-hundred and thirty, fifteen more, and then with a little effort, it will be one thousand.”
As the Nine-headed Flood Dragon has become more proficient in gathering solidity runes, along with its nine dragon heads working around the clock, its efficiency has increased by more than ten times.
“Not bad, with over 700 runes stacked together, your defense is at least twice as strong as before.” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled contentedly.
Since nearly being killed by the Sword Dragon Giant Beast in two blows last time, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon has become more diligent.
Bang!
The seawater behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exploded, and a red beast resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon emerged. Its terrifying dragon’s head was dozens of meters in diameter, exuding an awe-inspiring domineering aura.
When the Water and Fire World was entered earlier, the Red Beast suddenly went offline, and it took a while for it to react.
As the red beast resembling a mountain ridge appeared, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s gazes both sharpened due to its fierce presence.
This Red Beast was powerful.
In front of the Eastern Divine Dragon-like beast, the 190-meter-long Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the 140-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon were like little brothers.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled, “This is the Candle Dragon. We encountered it before entering the North Ice Sea Area, and it proved itself strong after a battle.”
“So I invited it to join Dragon Palace as the Sixth Dragon King, titled King of Day and Night Spacetime.” Thunderflame Emperor Dragon casually named it and introduced it to the others.
“Candle Dragon, this is the Dragon Palace’s Great Dragon King Sethia, King of Storm and Frost.”
“This is Kidora, the Nine-Headed Dragon King. In addition to them, there are some other members of the Dragon Palace, but they are currently away. We will introduce them to you later.”
Hearing that it was the new younger brother taken in by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon and Kidora became more friendly in their looks.
The Silver Giant Dragon, standing on the shore, nodded slightly and growled majestically, “Roar! King of Day and Night Spacetime, welcome to the Dragon Palace. From now on, we are all family.”
With its nine dragon heads swaying, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon roared excitedly, “Roar, roar!! Welcome, join, kill together, rob together, eat together.”
However, after the two giant beasts finished speaking, they found the red beast staring blankly at them, making them a bit confused.
Could it be that there was something wrong with what they had just said?
After nearly two minutes of silence, the red beast finally reacted and slowly uttered, “Se-thi-a, Ki-do-ra, hel-lo.”
?? The silver giant dragon, along with Kidora’s nine heads, all sprouted question marks. What was going on? Was this Level 9 Late Stage giant beast a fool?
Confused, the two giant beasts looked at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spoke in a deep voice, “The Candle Dragon’s talent involves time, making it a little slow in response when not in battle and occasionally going offline.”
“Roar, roar!! So that’s it.” Kidora’s nine dragon heads shook.
“Roar! Time Talent.” Comparing to the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s sudden realization, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened in disbelief at the Red Beast.
This seemingly foolish guy actually possessed a talent related to time.
Looking at the shocked Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was puzzled, “Roar! Sethia, it’s just a talent related to time, why are you so shocked?”
Was the Red Beast’s talent strong? Very strong, but it was not a big deal to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
After all, when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was in Gigantification state, it could easily heavily injure this Red Beast if it wasn’t for it turning into an elemental form.
Surrounded by excitement, the Silver Giant Dragon roared, “Roar! Time talent is very powerful. Those giant beasts that have this talent are basically peerless within the same rank, like my father.”
Immediately, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was surprised, “Roar, roar!! Sethia, you have a father?”
Black lines burst out on the heads of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled speechless, “Kidora, aren’t you just stating the obvious? Of course, Sethia has a father. Otherwise, would it have jumped out of a rock?”
But then, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also curiously looked at the Silver Giant Dragon, “Roar! Sethia, is your father a mythical giant beast with a time-related talent?”
Sethia’s tail lifted proudly, and she arrogantly replied, “Roar! Yes, my father possesses the Time Stop talent, which is very strong.”
“However, he later quarreled with my mother and was chased away by her, so I never saw what he looked like.”
“Roar! Sethia, your mom … is very powerful.” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was surprised.
Sethia’s mother was really powerful, given that she managed to chase away a dragon-type giant beast that wielded the Time Stop power and was peerless in its rank.
At that time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked around, “Roar! As a Dragon Palace’s Dragon King, Candle Dragon needs a palace to symbolize its identity. Kidora, please build one over there.”
“Roar, roar!! No problem, I’ll handle it.” Facing the request of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, Kidora readily agreed and swam towards the far ice with enthusiasm.
This scene left the Silver Giant Dragon speechless.
Before, Kidora had managed to hide away after destroying the palace and the ice layer without getting reprimanded for it.
While Kidora was building the palace for the Red Beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to work as well, grabbing three Level 9 Giant Beast skeletons and bringing them to the Lava Lake behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 706: 316: The Silver Dragon's Father, Time is Suspended (Subscription Requested)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 706: Chapter 316: The Silver Dragon’s Father, Time is Suspended (Subscription Requested)_3
Boom! Boom! Boom! Three skeletons, over a hundred meters long, with relatively well-preserved backbones, fell into the magma, splashing lava rain into the sky.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon took a deep breath, whipped up a raging wind, and then spewed scorching golden flames from its mouth, enveloping a Level 9 Giant Beast’s skeleton and melting it down.
The so-called essence of Heaven and Earth is a kind of semi-energy material that contains special energies and can be integrated into the Illusory World as the foundation of the world.
As a Giant Beast that has evolved to the peak of transcendence, its Level 9 skeleton is strong and sturdy, possessing elemental energy properties just like its flesh and blood.
Under the smelting of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the spine of the Giant Beast quickly melted, decomposed, and turned into a semi-material, semi-energy, jade-like substance.
It looked like some kind of special ore, with no trace of the beast’s bones visible.
“Roar! Tim Abott, what are you melting these bones for?” The Silver Giant Dragon squatting nearby was curious.
Eating it would only replenish the strength of the bones and scale armor. It had eaten a lot when it was young, crispy to chew, but it was not really digestible after too many.
Moreover, the energy contained in it wasn’t very much, so it stopped eating after reaching Level 7.
“Roar! Melt it down and see if anything can be researched.” Thunderflame Emperor Dragon casually found an excuse.
Really?
The Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat suspicious, feeling that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was coaxing it. This guy had always been mysterious, surely it had discovered something good.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes flickered and landed on the other two Giant Beast skeletons. Subconsciously grinding its teeth, it wondered if it should seize an opportunity to take a bite or two.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to spew fire, a few hours quickly passed. A ten-meter-long, 0.5 meters thick, blue jade emerged from the scorching golden flames.
This “jade” was not quite stone, but emitted a circle of blue halo. There were runes faintly flowing inside, and it radiated strong energy fluctuations.
This time, the melting was even more thorough than when the six-armed demon ape’s skeleton had been smelted. The hundred-meter Giant Beast’s skeleton had been finally reduced to this little bit, with most of the material turned to ash and scattered.
It seems that re-engraving the Spatial Channel Rune, strengthening, and expanding the channel is necessary. Looking at the “huge” essence of the jade, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed thoughtful.
Following this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to be busy until it had almost finished tempering the other two Giant Beast skeletons.
Boom! The distant sea surface exploded, revealing sharp dorsal fins and a huge black body amidst the sky full of seawater. It was the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish that had rushed back.
Ying ying ying!! Thunderflame, I heard that you were back. Are we going to a battle?
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, now 110 meters long, thrashed in the sea, its wings-like massive fins stirring up a curtain of water as it appeared to be very excited.
During this time, after devouring the resources accumulated in its territory filled with dozens of Resource Points for more than a month, this Giant Beast, which had followed the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon earlier, had also approached the peak of the eighth level.
Of course, the rapid growth was due to its own strong talent, as well as already being close to a breakthrough in the late stage of Level 8.
Bang! The sea exploded again, revealing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle with its thick, ferocious shell as large as a small hill. Its dragon head also emerged and let out an excited roar.
Roar Roar! Thunderflame, I am super strong now. I want to defeat ten, no, I want to defeat twenty in this upcoming battle.
… With that small size of yours, thinking of defeating twenty is a bit much, isn’t it? The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had grown to more than 110 meters long.
“Not bad, you two didn’t slack off this time,” said the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon as it walked out of the Lava Lake, its heavy footsteps crushing the ground and leaving behind a trail of magma footprints as it approached the shore.
Suddenly, the sea surface started to boil. A 70-meter-long Female Tiger Whale rushed out of the sea, followed by more than 20 Mutated Tiger Whale subordinates.
Ying ying! Wife, you’re back. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes lit up as it happily swam over.
The black and white Female Tiger Whale glanced at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, ignored it, and turned its head to gaze at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the distance, giving a respectful, low hum.
Ying ying! Congratulations to you, king, on breaking through to Mid Level 9.
As the Female Tiger Whale returned, the Tiger Whale Biggest Brother and Little Brother soon returned along with a group of Mutated Tiger Whales ranging from Levels 4 to 6.
Under the gathering of dozens of massive Mutated Tiger Whales, the sea surface of the Water and Fire World boiled, creating an impressive spectacle.
However, looking at the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Red Beast, and the Black-red Colossal Beast standing on the shore, the Mutated Tiger Whales all showed shock in their eyes.
Their leader had not deceived them; the Dragon Palace was indeed mighty. Each of the Dragon Kings was a powerful Giant Beast above Level 9, especially the Black-red Colossal Beast.
The intangible pressure it emitted at this time was enough to instill instinctive fear and reverence in them.

chapters.title: Chapter 707: 317: Mythical Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Crimson Thunder
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: Chapter 317: Mythical Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Crimson Thunder
Yiing yiing! Miss Keller, hang in there, we’re almost there.
Yiing yiing yiing! Okay, leader, Miss Keller will try her hardest.
The pressure in the deep sea, thousands of meters down, is intense, and it’s many times greater after it has absorbed Heavenly Energy, making it impossible for ordinary Mutated Creatures to reach this place.
At this moment, a dozen or so Mutated Tiger Whales struggled to swim behind a Black Tiger Whale.
Among them was the ‘beautiful’ Level 4 Female Tiger Whale tightly following behind the Black Tiger Whale, relying on the strength emitted from its body to resist the pressure.
Soon, under the Black Tiger Whale’s lead, a group of Unique Beasts arrived outside the Water and Fire World and, filled with apprehension, followed it fish after fish into the area.
Boom, boom, boom! The sea surface exploded as the dozen Mutated Tiger Whales burst forth from the water, and they were all instantly stunned by the sight before them.
The vast sea was completely occupied by Tiger Whale-like Unique Beasts, and not far from the sea surface were a pair of Spawn Whales and Dragon Turtles over a hundred meters long, radiating formidable might.
