By the shoreline, there was a Silver Giant Dragon surrounded by a Green Storm, a Nine-headed Flood Dragon with blood-colored flames burning, and a Red Beast lying horizontally like a mountain ridge.
In front of those three Giant Beasts stood the Black-red Colossal Beast, which, merely by standing there, was exuding an invisible, terrifying might that almost collapsed the Void.
While the Mutated Tiger Whales were shocked, Tiger Whale Third Brother had already excitedly swum ahead, roaring: Yiing yiing yiing! Uncle, Uncle, I have something to report, I’ve found an enemy.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked toward the Black ‘Little’ Tiger Whale with a deep and resonant voice, “Roar! What enemy?”
Yiing yiing yiing! It’s a big dummy from the Beast Empire that fought with Uncle, a Level 9 Giant Beast.
At this point, the Black Tiger Whale proudly said: The fool didn’t know I am the Dragon Palace Brave General, it even asked me to help spy for it, and I tricked it into giving me two tasty things.
The Black Tiger Whale excitedly slapped its flippers, recounting in detail how it had encountered the Sea Dragon giant beast and how it managed to gain its trust without showing any panic.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish felt extremely proud upon hearing this; its son had always been smart since childhood, truly a chip off the old block.
It’s just that the child had always been yelling about overthrowing it, which it found rather speechless; their home wasn’t that big, what would it do if it won against its father, didn’t it know that its mother was in charge?
The Silver Giant Dragon was also surprised by the Black Tiger Whale, not having expected Joe’s younger brother to be so clever as to trick a Level 9 Giant Beast into giving away treasures.
It couldn’t do that itself, always being tricked by Telsafi into giving away tasty food and being unable to win in a fight, making it feel pissed every time.
But Telsafi was in trouble now. Once it took Tim Abott back later, it would definitely have Tim beat up Telsafi thoroughly for stealing Sesi’s precious things since they were little.
At this moment, in that group of Mutated Tiger Whales, Miss Keller, the Level 4 Female Tiger Whale, was even more starry-eyed toward the Black Tiger Whale.
The leader is so brave, not fearing at all in the presence of so many terrifying Giant Beasts.
After the Black Tiger Whale finished speaking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly nodded its head, giving a profound low roar, “Roar! Tiger Three, you did well this time; later, this king will provide you with an extra reward.”
The Black Tiger Whale’s eyes sparkled with excitement, rolling in the water, Yiing yiing yiing! Thank you, Uncle.
It knew how generous this uncle was; the resources on its territory allowed its father and Uncle Turtle Shell to eat as they wished, even stuffing themselves with the flesh and blood of Level 9 Monarch Beasts.
Now that Uncle had promised an extra reward, it would surely grow faster after eating and then defeat its father to become the Dragon King Great General, haha.
As the Black Tiger Whale rolled excitedly in the water, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze was cold and serene.
It had anticipated this situation long ago; after all, the other party was a real ’empire’ led by a Mythical Giant Beast and not just a local Mutated Beast from the Blue Star World.
After the hostility between them, there would definitely be further probes and conflicts, just as it also planned to wipe out the enemy.
It had been more than ten days since the end of the great battle between them, and now the other side had already sent its subordinate to scout; after gathering detailed information about the Dragon Palace, they would likely launch an attack.
Naturally, their target would be it, a ‘monster’ of Level 9 early stage that could defeat Sword Dragon Giant Beasts.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, being of Mythic descent, they probably wouldn’t kill it outright, otherwise provoking the Mythical Giant Beast behind Scythia could become very problematic for them.
Unfortunately, they could not even imagine how rapid its growth rate was.
Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled into a sinister smile, looking towards the Female Tiger Whale in the distance, “Roar! Horned Lady, how goes your crystal collection this time?”
Yiing yiing yiing! My king, most of the crystals we collected this time are Level 2 and Level 3, and the quantity is decent.
With that, the Female Tiger Whale’s mouth opened slightly, expelling a Fish Bubble Bag 3 meters in size from its subspace stomach, rolling it toward the shore under the flow of the water.
Tiger One, yiing yiing! Uncle, we have also collected a lot.
Tiger Two, yiing yiing yiing! And me, and me, this time it was super cool.
The two Tiger Whales with Flame Patterns on their bodies hurried over, lifting up the Mutant Fish Bubble Bag on their dorsal fins and sending it to the shore.
Yiing yiing yiing! Miss Keller, Miss Keller, come over quickly.
At the call of the Black Tiger Whale, the ‘beautiful’ Level 4 Tiger Whale swam over cautiously, allowing Tiger Three to remove the stomach pouch bag from its back.
Is this little one coming into heat? The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon eyed the Little Tiger Whale and then Tiger Three, revealing a hint of amusement in its golden vertical pupils.
This was because there was a huge size disparity between them; that Little Tiger Whale called Miss Keller was only about twenty meters long and at the peak of Level 4, whereas Tiger Three was closing in on sixty meters.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 317: Mythical Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Crimson Thunder_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Chapter 317: Mythical Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Crimson Thunder_2
“`
This isn’t just three times bigger in size; it’s several times larger, like comparing a strong man to an eight-year-old child.
Damn! Thinking of this, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but curse, quite the player.
Moving his gaze away from the two Tiger Whales, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stretched out his right claw and gently picked up a ‘small’ purse, pouring out the crystal mixed with seawater inside.
The crystals from five ‘bags’ were close to two thousand pieces, shining brightly as they piled up, a mix of white and blue, making the Silver Giant Dragon somewhat eager to move.
Since it had always enjoyed shiny things since childhood, its palace at home was filled with various glittering gemstones and energy crystals.
Looking at the Life Crystals that could convert at least thirty thousand points of attributes, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction, “Roar! Not bad.”
Ten days’ time to gather so many proved that these Tiger Whales had been very hard-working under the leadership of Horned Lady, and it also showed the wisdom and divine might of its decision to form the Tiger Whale Army from the outset.
With them leading teams of Tiger Whales separately, they were basically harvesting about three thousand points attribute daily. By this account, it would be a hundred thousand in a month.
Of course, that’s just wishful thinking; after all, once chives were harvested, you had to wait for them to grow back.
As for creating a gap in the hierarchy of high-end oceanic Mutated Beasts, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not care at all because even without a gap, it would nearly destroy the hierarchy by eating them.
At that moment, the Red Beast standing on four legs in the distance showed confusion in its eyes and roared softly, “Roar! Thunder, Flame, these, seem, use, less, right?”
At their level, having nearly evolved to the pinnacle of transcendence, the energy crystal bodies inside these lower creatures were merely candy to them.
Eating a bunch of them would only make their life energy slightly more abundant; it wouldn’t contribute much to enhancement.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly, “Candle Dragon, Tim Abott differs from us. His talent allows him to absorb Crystal Energy to enhance his enlightenment and talent ability, becoming stronger.”
However, after the Silver Giant Dragon finished speaking, the Red Beast did not respond, and stood there as if dazed.
Or rather, its earlier speech had already been buffering for a while.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the Silver Giant Dragon, “Scythia, today the titans gather, and there are many new faces. As the King of the Dragon Palace, it’s your responsibility to bring them up to speed on the Dragon Palace’s situation.”
“As for this king, I will go make a breakthrough and then take out those enemies.”
“Roar! No problem, go on, Tim Abott, leave this to the great Scythia,” replied the Silver Giant Dragon happily.
As for being the Dragon Palace Dragon King himself, was it important? It was all roughly the same anyway.
After Thunderflame Emperor Dragon left with all the crystals, the Silver Giant Dragon stepped forward, looking at the ordinary Mutated Tiger Whales on the sea surface, and proudly lifted its head.
“Roar! I am the great and noble Scythia, King of the Dragon Palace, the future Ocean Overlord.”
“Today, you ordinary extraordinary creatures joining the Dragon Palace should feel honored, rejoice to become subjects of the great Scythia.”
Just then, the Red Beast suddenly came to its senses, eyes widening in surprise, “Roar! How, is, this, possi, ble?”
…Instantly, there was silence at the scene.
The interrupted Silver Giant Dragon roared softly, “This is the new King of Day and Night, Candle Dragon.”
“This one is the Nine-Headed Dragon King, Kidora, and over there with the shell on its back is the King of Earth and Destruction, Domination.”
The moment the Silver Giant Dragon introduced them, Kidora and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle Giant Beasts subconsciously puffed out their chests, looking down on those ordinary Unique Beasts.
“Roar! That over there is Jerry Jones, the King of Black and White, and next to him is the Tiger Whale Great General, Horned Lady.”
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon finished speaking, all the Mutated Tiger Whales were stunned as they looked at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfisher at the sea’s surface, radiating Level 8 Late Stage aura and diagonally aiming a horn toward the heavens.
What? He’s the legendary powerful being ranked among the Five Great Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace, the Top Strong of their Tiger Whale tribe, the King of Black and White??
Isn’t the gap too big? At that moment, all the Mutated Tiger Whales were a bit dumbfounded.
Because the anticipation and the letdown were too great, the place fell silent once again.
Suddenly, Tiger Three began to roll in the sea, calling out loudly: roar, roar, roar! Living well under the rule of the mighty Scythia Dragon King, eating and drinking well, feasting once every three days.
Roar, roar, roar! Scythia Dragon King is mighty.
Roar! Great Dragon King, awesome.
Led by the three Tiger Whales, the other Mutated Tiger Whales quickly caught on and respectfully saluted the Dragon Kings; well, they slapped their tails.
While the Dragon Ice Crystal Palace side was becoming lively, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had also reached the volcanic mouth, where the magma churned and poison smoke billowed, to avoid being seen entering the Spatial Channel.
Meanwhile, in the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, a Sky Element Stone turning to dust and scattering from his hand.
With a day of cultivation, his aura became even more imposing, and his eyes, dark and as bright as stars, showed a cold indifference carrying a terrifying authority.
Hum!
As the golden red light shone on Jack Clark’s right arm, the three pairs of silver runes on Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head also lit up around the crimson feather horns.
Golden flames blazed fiercely, forming a Flame Crown above his head, with a silver vortex in the middle, connecting the two realms.
Under Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s control, the Life Crystals in its giant claw flew up, passing through the space and appearing in the Cultivation Room, falling like rain in a dense flurry.
And in the blink of an eye, nearly two thousand crystals piled up into a small hill in front of Jack Clark.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 317: Mythical Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Deep Red Thunder_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: Chapter 317: Mythical Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Deep Red Thunder_3
Phew! As the Spatial Channel connecting the two locations closed, Jack Clark let out a breath, and a smile spread across his face as he looked at the crystal radiating a rich life aura before him.
With the increase in his strength, it became easier to acquire resources, especially after the pathway between his body and Avatar was opened, enabling resource sharing.
“You have converted a High-Purity Life Crystal, gaining 3870 Attribute Points.”
“You have converted a High-Purity Life Crystal, gaining 951 Attribute Points…”
Among this batch of crystals, apart from one Level 8 and one Level 7 acquired by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the North Ice Sea, the rest were Level 2, Level 3, with a few Level 4.
By the time nearly two thousand Life Crystals had been converted, half an hour had passed, and the Attribute Points on the page had skyrocketed to 38804.
Nearly forty thousand Attribute Points—Jack couldn’t help but feel a bit excited, but unfortunately, it was still short of fifty thousand; otherwise, he could have directly enhanced a Top-tier Talent.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack’s gaze fell upon the Gigantification Talent.
The Attribute Points he had gained this time were enough to enhance the Gigantification Talent to Top-tier, and the increase in combat power should not be less than what an enhancement of a Talent to Top-tier would provide.
Moreover, in a few days, the official organization would send him many Life Crystals, which Jack estimated to be worth at least tens of thousands of Contribution Points.
After all, this was Marcellus Larry, a Monarch, mobilizing resources. If it were too little, not to mention whether Jack had any complaints, even this Monarch would feel like he had lost face.
Taking a deep breath, Jack thought to himself, “Spend six thousand Attribute Points to enhance the Gigantification Talent to Senior Level.”
As a Special Talent, the requirement to enhance the Gigantification Talent was three times that of other talents.
In an instant, six thousand Attribute Points turned into a torrent of enhancement energy, passing through the Soul Channel and appearing within the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom! Instantly, an aura that shook the ‘world’ with terrifying intensity burst forth.
Red lightning flashed over the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, as within it, millions of Rune Sequence Chains making up the Talent Rune proliferated, advancing in rank, and its body steadily swelled.
Soon, a fearsome Giant Beast, four hundred and ten meters in length, coated in red lightning, appeared.
Under the terrible heavy aura, hundreds of meters high volcanoes collapsed, magma exploded, and even the surrounding Void was distorted, forming black cracks.
The invisible force of destruction even burst the atmosphere, creating rings of white waves that roared and swept across Heaven and Earth like a 10+ category typhoon.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Feeling the invincible power within its body, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but roared skywards, its entire mini-world trembling as if an ancient, unrivaled Ferocious Beast had descended.
Such terrifying might left all nearby Giant Beasts shock-struck, all incredulously watching the massive creature roaring at the volcano mouth in the distance.
But before they could react, as thirty thousand Attribute Points disappeared, an even more explosive enhancement energy emerged within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
Waves of red lightning that could shatter the Void erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, blanketing nearly half of the Water and Fire Mini World, causing the Void to constantly shatter.
In the dazzling black-red lightning, the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swelled again, expanding until a Giant Beast over eight hundred meters long and radiating a deep crimson light appeared.
In that moment, a terrifying aura that transcended Extraordinary Creatures and dominated all beings erupted.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Heaven and Earth shook, and within a radius of more than a thousand meters around the Crimson Giant Beast, the ground collapsed. The raging magma beneath the volcano was suppressed by the terrifying heavy force, rolling wildly beneath it.
The entire mini-world quaked as if it could not support its existence.
Further away, the ground lost its gravity, fracturing and turning into countless rubble mixed with magma from the Lava Lake, floating and slowly rotating, with Red Lightning weaving through the center.
Even because the aura was so terrifying, the sea waves five kilometers away also rose into a hundred-meter tsunami, rolling the Mutated Tiger Whales into panicked howls.
At that moment, all creatures fell silent.
Under the terrifying oppression, no Giant Beast could stand, all were pressed to the ground by the Mythical Sovereign’s Majesty, unable to move a muscle.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon collapsed weakly to the ground, its bloodline instinctively transmitting awe, fear, and submission.
Struggling to lift its head, the Silver Giant Dragon stared at the Destroy the World Beast standing in the pitch-black area, surrounded by black-red lightning, with a might that seemed to destroy heaven and earth, and its eyes widened.
“Roar! The aura of myth, how is it possible, didn’t Tim Abbott just reach mid-Level 9? How did it grow so big all of a sudden!!”
Even the Silver Giant Dragon was shaken beyond belief at this moment.
Because the aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was too frightening, it felt even more terrifying than the average Mythical Giant Beast.
At the side, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon rubbed its nine dragon heads on the ground, excitedly crazed: “Roar Roar Roar!! Gigantification, Abbott, the Gigantification Talent, understood.”
In the surging sea waves, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also excitedly trembled its tail, issuing excited cries.
Roar Roar Roar!! While you were hibernating in Scythia, Thunderflame comprehended the Gigantification Talent from that spine of the six-armed demon ape, but at that time it could only grow a little bigger.
Roar Roar!! Thunderflame is too perverted, so fierce, I like it so much. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle floated on the water surface, all four limbs trembling uncontrollably in excitement, its eyes blood-red.
In the raging seawater, the Female Tiger Whale surrounded by darkness watched the Destroy the World Beast in the distance with awe, and three ‘small’ Tiger Whales instinctively gathered around it, frantically leaping in the water.
As for the ordinary Mutated Tiger Whales, they all passed out under that terrifying pressure, being rolled by the sea water and colliding continuously, just like large corpses.
No, there was also the returning Blue Giant Crab, which now floated weakly on the sea surface with its eight legs limp, its eyes were turning white, excitedly blowing bubbles from its mouth.
While all the Giant Beasts were shocked beyond measure, the Crimson Giant Beast standing at the center of destruction slightly bowed its head, and its viewpoint, along with Jack Clark’s, displayed a transparent page.
Talent: Gigantification [Top Tier, Special Class Talent, consumes internal energy to enter Gigantified state, increasing body size threefold, transforming into the Crimson Giant Beast.
In the Crimson state, base strength and base defense are increased ninefold, agility significantly decreases.
Deep Red Thunder: The ultimate power formed by the fusion of the internal gifted power, the ultimate heat, and destruction, capable of shattering the Void, comparable to the rules.
Note: The stronger the strength, the stronger the talent when in the Crimson state for proportional increases, including Deep Red Thunder.]
……
Roar Roar Roar!! My lord, my lord.
On the tumultuous sea surface, a Black Tiger Whale nearly sixty meters in length burst from the sea, raising a sky-high splash, while excitedly shouting.
Soon, in the deep sea not far away, the Sea Dragon giant beast emerged, over two hundred meters in length, breaking the surface and looking irritably at the nearby splashing Black Tiger Whale.
“Roar! How come you’ve come back so quickly?”
Immediately, the Black Tiger Whale’s eyes lit up, but this time it didn’t approach, instead calling out happily from afar: Roar Roar Roar!! My lord, I’ve brought the information from the Dragon Palace.
“Roar! So quickly?” The Sea Dragon was startled, somewhat unable to react.
The Black Tiger Whale happily nodded: Roar Roar!! Yes, I’ve brought all the information.
As it spoke, a vast darkness emerged behind the Black Tiger Whale at the sea surface, covering nearly a thousand meters in range. This was the Dark Domain jointly unfolded by the Horned Lady and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
Then the darkness slowly dissipated, revealing the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, a Silver Giant Dragon over 140 meters, a Nine-headed Flood Dragon almost 200 meters, and an even larger Red Beast.
In front of these Giant Beasts, there was the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wrapped in dark crimson lines, its golden vertical pupils cold and indifferent, quietly watching the Sea Dragon giant beast in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 710: 318: Catastrophe Surrounds, King of Giant Beasts (Seeking Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Chapter 318: Catastrophe Surrounds, King of Giant Beasts (Seeking Monthly Ticket)
When the darkness receded, revealing the figures of Level 9 Giant Beasts, each emanating the king-level bloodline’s pressure, the Sea Dragon Giant Beast’s eyes nearly popped out.
How is it possible? How can there be so many Level 9 Giant Beasts with king-level bloodlines!?
But after the shock came fear.
However, before the Sea Dragon Giant Beast could react, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep, muffled voice, “Roar! Leave one alive for interrogation.”
Unlike hunting outside, it couldn’t be bothered to take action against this ‘ordinary’ Level 9 mid-stage giant beast, otherwise, it wouldn’t have brought so many minions with it when venturing out.
Of course, this is only ordinary in comparison to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. The Sea Dragon Giant Beast not only awakened a king-level bloodline but was also one of the stronger ones.
As soon as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes shone brightly, and with a roar, it spread its wings and flew up into the sky, “Roar! Despicable extraordinary creature, I am the great Sethia, King of the Dragon Palace… ”
But at that moment, the heavens and earth suddenly darkened, and the surroundings were plunged into absolute darkness. All the Giant Beasts within the range lost their sense of sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch, even their sense of touch in the seawater.
From a bird’s eye view in the high altitude, one could see a dark area the shape of an upside-down semi-circle with a radius of ten kilometers appearing on the sea surface.
Within the darkness, a terrifying tail over two thousand meters long and two hundred meters in diameter at its thinnest part stretched across the heavens and earth like a small mountain range descending from the sky.
Boom! The black airflow wrapped around the tail, causing the air to explode as space was compressed, forming layers of transparent ripples, shattering everything in its path.
Due to the absolute darkness talent, the Sea Dragon Giant Beast’s biological senses disappeared, but its soul’s intense danger warning was still alerting it of the extreme danger.
Roar! In its startled state, the Sea Dragon Giant Beast’s domain burst… Boom!
The just-expanded domain was directly smashed by the descending tail. In an instant, the domain collapsed, the sea was split in half, forming a chasm several kilometers long.
The chasm reached a depth of a thousand meters below the seabed, and the terror induced by the explosion caused the sea water to rise in walls hundreds of meters high on both sides, rushing towards the distance.
At the same time, as the split seabed closed, billions of tons of sea water collided, causing waves hundreds of meters high to rise, the rumbling sound echoing in the heavens and earth, lingering around.
At that moment, the darkness dispersed, and it was bright once again.
But be it the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish family, the Blue Giant Crab, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, or the Silver Giant Dragon, all stared wide-eyed at what lay before them.
There, a four hundred meters long Red Beast was rapidly shrinking in size, returning to its original size of just over three hundred meters in a blink of an eye.
As the darkness vanished in that instant, they all had a blurry glimpse of the over-three-thousand-meter-long Black Colossus. It was this creature, for sure.
Over three thousand meters long, its presence alone generated a terrifying, oppressive sensation that horrified the beasts.
The Silver Giant Dragon in the air couldn’t help but growl, ” Tim Abott, isn’t the talent called Time for the Candle Dragon?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded slightly and growled, “Time is just one of the talents of the Candle Dragon. It also has a top-tier talent called Day and Night.”
“In its Night state, its size increases tenfold, possessing quasi-mythical-level physical strength, while in its Day state, it transforms into an elemental giant beast, undying and indestructible.”
Of course, the so-called undying and indestructible simply means it can be destroyed after being hit multiple times, and the increased size only allows it to perform physical attacks.
Moreover, both states can only be maintained for three minutes, requiring alternating states, and it cannot maintain the giant Night state or the Day flame state indefinitely.
Despite that, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes nearly popped out.
Damn!
Roar!! Joe, the Candle Dragon’s talent is way stronger than yours; your darkness is only transformational, and the White Domain only enhances your physical strength tenfold.
Whimper!! Unfair, I want to become that strong too. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes were filled with envy.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon Kidora was also somewhat surprised. No wonder Abbott invited it to join the Dragon Palace; it’s terrifying, a Level 9 late-stage beast with two top-tier talents.
With such talent, its combat power should be able to reach the quasi-mythical level, right!!
However, compared to the Candle Dragon, the Thunderflame guy is even more monstrous. Back then, the Candle Dragon must have been severely beaten by it.
Regarding the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s method of inviting giant beasts to join the Dragon Palace, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon had a profound understanding, as it had also been beaten half-dead by this guy.
Actually, before the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s arrival, the Candle Dragon was an uncrowned king in the North Ice Ocean.
It just didn’t have the ambition to dominate; it merely occupied the area in the North Ice Ocean with the highest concentration of Heavenly Energy to sleep, grow stronger, until the appearance of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Amidst the raging seawater, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled, “Domination, go and bring that guy up.”
Roar!! Alright.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle cheerfully dashed out, and its massive body disappeared in the blink of an eye beneath the sea surface, diving all the way down to the turbulent, murky seabed.
But at this time, the seabed had changed, with a long trench stretching several kilometers carved out. At the bottom of the trench laid the severely wounded Sea Dragon Giant Beast.
The thick blue scale armor on the back of the giant beast shattered, its flesh and blood erupted, revealing the blue spine and faintly wriggling organs underneath, a tragic sight.
Such a heavy injury from just one hit – that’s the gap between a quasi-mythical level combat power and a standard Level 9 mid-stage beast.
That was too cruel, it’s a good thing I followed the Thunderflame.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle came to the Sea Dragon Giant Beast above, grabbed its bloody double shoulders, and wrapped them in domain power, dragging the beast that was twice its size towards the sea surface.
Bang! The water exploded, and the Dragon Turtle appeared, dragging the Sea Dragon Giant Beast.
Seeing the miserable state of the Sea Dragon Giant Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and other giant beasts instinctively shrank back, but wait, they didn’t have necks.

chapters.title: Chapter 711: 318: Surrounded by Catastrophes, the King of the Beasts (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: Chapter 318: Surrounded by Catastrophes, the King of the Beasts (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze was icy as it roared in a low voice, “Do you wish to die today, or do you want to live?”
Faced with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s question, the Sea Dragon seemed to be heavily injured, its consciousness still in a state of chaos, temporarily unable to respond.
Seeing this, the Black Tiger Whale approached from behind: roar, roar, roar!! Uncle is asking you a question, do you want to die or not?
Looking at the Black Tiger Whale that appeared before its eyes, the Sea Dragon giant beast’s scattered pupils refocused, regaining a bit of lucidity, then showing grief and indignation.
“It’s you, it’s you! We have no grudges or grievances, and I even gave you two Divine Fruits to eat. Why did you bring so many Giant Beasts to attack me?”
If it weren’t for the many Giant Beasts surrounding them, the Sea Dragon giant beast certainly wouldn’t have been able to resist tearing apart this Black Tiger Whale, gradually crunching its bones.
“Wish to, to live.” The Sea Dragon giant beast weakly roared, its voice imbued with the realm of thought.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly nodded.
“Roar! Very good, now tell me everything you know: the number of Giant Beasts in the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, their strength, Territory, structure.”
No sooner had the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished speaking than the Black Tiger Whale eagerly trilled: roar, roar, roar!! Speak quickly, and if you dare to lie to us, we’ll bite you to death.
Suddenly, a few black lines appeared on the foreheads of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
This third child of the Tiger Whale family, since making a breakthrough to a Level 7 Awakened King-level Bloodline, became enlightened and turned as shameless as its father.
At this moment, not to mention the Silver Giant Dragon and the others, even the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was a bit confused. No way, third child, when did you take over my position as the boss?
Compared to that, the first and second are indeed a bit more behaved.
But just as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was thinking this, Tiger One and Tiger Two, the two Tiger Whales beside Whale Shark Kitty Jones, which were the Fire Pattern Eldest and Fire Pattern Elder, had already charged out, excitedly trilling.
Tiger One: roar, roar, roar!! Speak quickly, if you don’t, we’ll bite your butt.
Tiger Two: roar, roar!! I want to bite your belly, bite your tail.
Roar, roar, roar!! Elder brother, second brother, don’t mess around, I’m helping Uncle ask questions.
Watching the suddenly chaotic scene, even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was a bit speechless and couldn’t help but roar, “…You three little rascals go play over there.”
Roar, roar, roar!! Okay, Uncle.
The three ‘little’ Tiger Whales obediently dispersed.
Under the cold, black-and-red gaze, the Sea Dragon hesitated for a moment and then weakly spoke, “Roar! I don’t know much because our forces are on the periphery.”
Just then, a distant Red Beast let out a low growl, “Little, Tiger, Whale, quite, interesting.”
…Interrupted, the Sea Dragon giant beast felt a bit bewildered. What did ‘interesting’ have to do with its knowledge about the Little Tiger Whale?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon coldly growled, “Ignore it, you continue.”
The Sea Dragon giant beast respectfully roared, “Aside from the Black Oblivion King, I only know there are at least two quasi-mythical level lords in the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire…”
From the mouth of the Sea Dragon giant beast, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gradually gained some understanding of that Giant Beast Empire.
The Mythical Giant Beast had occupied a large Territory in the opposite world. Aside from Giant Beast subordinates, it seemed other races also managed the resources within the territory.
Those Giant Beasts above Level 9 were treated as totems by that race, and the Black Oblivion King was regarded as the god of the beasts, an invincible presence.
However, those Top-tier Giant Beasts usually wouldn’t come here since they found the environment on this side too poor.
Among the peripheral forces here, all had awakened king-level bloodlines and were Transcendent creatures with talent amongst the strongest in king-level bloodlines.
In addition to the Sea Dragon giant beast, there was one Late Stage 9, two Early Stage 9, and seven Level 8 Mid to Late Stage Giant Beasts ruling over a territory of 1,000 kilometers at the center of the pathway.
While they were affiliated with the Mythical Giant Beasts, their dominated territories were not very large, as it was unnecessary.
Due to their proximity to the pathway, that sea area had rich Heavenly Energy deep under the sea and occasional space cracks would appear, creating high-end resources.
All these resources belonged to the Sea Dragon giant beasts and their allies.
These Transcendent Peripheral forces typically had to grow to Late Stage 9 before they were eligible to pass through the pathway into the vast opposite world.
As for the current Ninth-level Late-stage Beast, it was sent over to take up the Dark Giant Python’s place after its death by the Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
Besides this, these peripheral Giant Beasts hadn’t seen the Black Oblivion King; only those with a Monarch bloodline could stir the Mythical Giant Beast.
Normally commands came from the quasi-mythical beasts guarding the other side of the pathway.
The way to contact them was through a scale armor from the Black Oblivion King, which bore Mythical Giant Beast Law Power, allowing cross-boundary communication with another piece of scale armor on the opposite side of the pathway.
Only significant events could disturb the Black Oblivion King, such as the death of a favored King-level Giant Beast or the emergence of a new Giant Beast with good talent.
If a new Monarch Bloodline Giant Beast was discovered in the nearby sea area, the Black Oblivion King would send a quasi-mythical beast to descend.
The other party could either submit and join the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, being injected with and controlled by the Black Oblivion King’s Essence Blood, or it would be slain.
Moreover, it was difficult to contact the Black Oblivion King directly; it required consuming the Law Power imbued within the scale armor. After the Dark Giant Python exhausted its Law Power, there had not been time to replenish it.
However, the Sea Dragon giant beast had heard that under the deep sea, there were three passageways leading to the vast opposite world; one of them was occupied by a Mythical-level Giant Beast, but the occupant didn’t restrict passage.
Therefore, many Level 9 Giant Beasts, after growing to the Mid or Late Stage, would leave through that passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 712: 318: Surrounded by Catastrophe, King of the Beasts (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Chapter 318: Surrounded by Catastrophe, King of the Beasts (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
“`
Three Level 9s and seven Level 8 Beasts, and a quasi-mythical creature guarding the channel on the other side. After the Sea Dragon giant beast finished speaking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed contemplative.
And it looks like that mythical giant beast should be far from the channel, subordinates, resources within the territory.
While the Sea Dragon giant beast was anxious, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly nodded: “Good, you’re honest. I can feel you’re not lying, so….”
Boom!
In an instant, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon appeared above the head of the Sea Dragon giant beast, as a golden ‘sun’ with a diameter of five meters sparkled in the black-red giant claw, radiating a scorching destructive aura.
Boom!
The sea water exploded, the golden light sphere erupted and all was annihilated by the released high temperature; the scorching shockwave sent up a hundred-meter-high sea wave and steam in all directions.
The sudden change stunned all the beasts, and the Silver Giant Dragon roared in confusion, “Tim Abott, didn’t you say you’d let it go after it finished speaking?”
In front of the shattered head of the Sea Dragon giant beast corpse, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned back, seemingly puzzled: “Roar! Scythia, when did I ever say I’d let it go?”
“What I said earlier was to let it choose death or life. It chose life, but the problem is I didn’t promise to let it go after it finished talking.”
“It chose life, what does that have to do with me?”
Immediately, several of the beasts were dumbfounded.
It seems, indeed, that was the case. The Sea Dragon giant beast chose life, but that was its choice. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon never said it would let it go.
Compared to the slightly confused three-headed Level 9 giant beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle were not surprised; they had long understood what kind of character Thunderflame was.
This Sea Dragon giant beast was the enemy, a giant beast that came to scout their Dragon Palace’s intelligence. How could they possibly let it go?
And next to the Female Tiger Whale, the black Tiger Whale’s eyes shone. Roar! So this is also possible, I’ve learned something new.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled, “Candle Dragon, you will deal with that Late Stage 9 Beast, but do not kill it. Put pressure on it to lure the quasi-mythical beast over.”
“As for the other Extraordinary Giant Beasts, leave them to you. If you can kill, kill; if not, wait for Scythia or Kidora to be free to deal with them.”
After speaking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grabbed the corpse of the Sea Dragon giant beast and let out a deep roar.
Boom!
The black-red colossal beast shattered the air, and in the blink of an eye, appeared at an altitude of ten thousand meters, with dazzling lightning shining behind it, forming a pair of Thunderbolt Wings spreading over five hundred meters.
Boom boom boom!!
The sky full of blue-black Thunderflame exploded, turning into an invisible field of thunder electricity, pulling the atmosphere within a twenty-kilometer radius. In an instant, the wind surged and the cloud layers converged.
“Roar! Scythia, bring up the water.”
“Roar roar!! No problem.”
The Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, and with a flap of its wings, it also rushed towards the sky. Around it, the raging wind howled, forming over twenty green tornadoes.
Boom boom boom!!
The dozens of meters thick green tornadoes reached from the sky to the ground, sucking up the sea water like a dragon and sending it up to an altitude of ten thousand meters. The raging wind tore apart the sea water in the sky, turning it into a mist that dispersed.
As the amount of water vapor in the clouds increased, and electric charge gathered to form thunder, in the blink of an eye, a rotating hurricane vortex covering tens of kilometers had formed.
And as the hurricane vortex swirled, the dark clouds coming from afar also converged. The Thunder Cloud Storm vortex grew larger and larger, gradually covering tens to hundreds of kilometers.
Suddenly, it was dark as night; thunderbolts continuously struck the sea surface, blasting sea water high into the air.
Together with those two dozen heaven-reaching cyan tornadoes, it looked like the arrival of Doomsday.
Under the combined efforts of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon, they had directly created a ‘beastly’ Catastrophe.
The Silver Giant Dragon in the sky was extremely excited; it remembered the scene where the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had controlled the storm to kill the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast, and it couldn’t help but roar excitedly.
Infectious with the atmosphere, the Red Beast, resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon, spiraled up following a Tornado Storm, appearing below the dark clouds, letting out a long, high-pitched dragon roar that echoed through Heaven and Earth.
“Roar! Candle, Dragon, unbeatable.”
“Roar roar roar!! Kidora can fly too.”
The excited Nine-headed Flood Dragon in the sea also got excited, with its red Flame Domain covering a six-hundred-meter radius unfolding, it rose into the sky and took flight.
“`
Watching the three-headed giant beast unfolding its domain to fly in the sky, and the black-red silhouette flickering in the dark clouds, the sea surface single-horned Tiger Whale couldn’t help feeling envious.
With its double fins outstretched, the single-horned Tiger Whale excitedly slapped the sea water and cried out, “Roar, roar, roar!! I want to fly too, I must fly.”
The Black Tiger Whale was also excited, leaping in the sea, “Roar, roar, roar!! Uncle is so awesome, Scythia Dragon King is so powerful, dad is really useless, he can’t fly at all.”
Bam!
The female Tiger Whale’s massive fins below her belly fanned out once, and the powerful force instantly knocked the Black Tiger Whale below the sea surface, causing an explosion in the sea water that scared Tiger One and Tiger Two to step back.
Mom is so fierce.
At this moment, the female Tiger Whale spoke in a gentle voice, “Roar, roar!! Third child, you shouldn’t speak of your dad like that, he’s trying very hard.”
Roar, roar, roar!! Wives are the best.
In an instant, the single-horned Tiger Whale felt so moved, eagerly trying to approach and seek a rub, but as soon as he got near, he stopped shamefaced under the calm gaze of the female Tiger Whale.
It was then that the female Tiger Whale spoke gently, “Roar, roar!! This time, perform well.”
The single-horned Tiger Whale nodded confidently, “Roar, roar, roar!! Don’t worry, wife, this time I’m going to beat ten, no, twenty, I’m super cool now.”
While the Tiger Whale couple was showing off their affection, the Blue Giant Crab, with its eight legs swinging, floated on the sea surface, excitedly blowing bubbles.
Gurgle gurgle!! King, king is so cool, so cool.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Thunder exploded in the sky, and the bloodied, ferocious dragon head emerged from the dark clouds to look down upon all the Giant Beasts below and roar, “Depart, kill all those guys.”
The Silver Giant Dragon also let out an excited roar, “Roar! All beasts from the Dragon Palace, charge, Great Scythia is launching the third war of annihilation, kill all enemies.”
Roar, roar, roar!!
High up in the sky, three Giant Beasts with bodies ranging from one hundred to three hundred meters in length circled, while seven Giant Beasts on the sea surface tumbled and broke waves with an imposing momentum.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon controlled the raging storm, and while consuming the flesh and blood of the Giant Beasts, it raced towards the deep sea tunnel, the atmosphere in the Ocean Monitoring Center was tense.
“Report, the recent energy detection showed two peaks of Level 9 energy fluctuations, two Level 9 early stage energies, and several obscure Level 8 fluctuations.”
The attending Colonel’s expression was grave, “That creature code-named Thunderflame is growing stronger, there’s an additional Level 9 peak lifeform.”
“Judging by their direction, it seems to be Channel Three Deep Sea.”
“It should be related to the quasi-mythical beast that appeared last time. This creature code-named Thunderflame is probably planning to take revenge.”
“Channel 3 is located in the deep sea, the battle’s aftermath won’t affect the surrounding coastlines, so let’s hope that the creature code-named Thunderflame can kill some Level 9 lifeforms.”
One of the operators down below asked with some confusion, “Commander, why do we hope that the creature code-named Thunderflame kills more Level 9 lifeforms, rather than both of them suffering mutual losses?”
“Because it’s beneficial for us if the creature code-named Thunderflame stays alive.”
“Recently, the Intelligence Department discovered that a large number of mutated creature corpses have appeared on the territory’s sea surface belonging to code-named Thunderflame, their bodies all bitten in two.”
“Besides, within thousands of kilometers around this code-named Thunderflame creature, no traces of high-level mutated organisms have been detected for a long time.”
“The Intelligence Department speculated that this code-named Thunderflame creature has a heavy killing nature.”
“After dominating a territory, aside from those mutated creatures that submit to it, it kills all the creatures within the territory of Level 6 and above, and even some lower-level ones are not spared.”
Hiss!
Looking at the ferocious black-red Colossal Beast model on the big screen, everyone in the Monitoring Center gasped.
“This Beast is so vicious!”
“That’s terrifying.”
“Such a scary killing nature.”
“Alright, just continue monitoring, it doesn’t matter how heavy its killing nature is, as long as its movement direction is the Deep Sea Tunnel, we don’t need to bother with it.”
“If it can take over Channel 3, there will eventually be king-level creatures that will sign a pact with it, and by the way, warn it not to step onto land and harm humans.”

chapters.title: Chapter 713: 319: Tearing apart the Semi-Divine, The Invincible Thunderflame Giant Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Chapter 319: Tearing apart the Semi-Divine, The Invincible Thunderflame Giant Beast
At the edge of the Dragon Palace’s territory which was a little over a thousand kilometers away from the passage vortex controlled by the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, it was once a cause of concern for the Dark Giant Python.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon manipulated the stormy vortex to move quickly, the Thunderstorm soon approached the location of the passage.
Under the power that penetrates the two realms, a vortex with a diameter of tens of kilometers forms on the sea surface, connecting heaven and earth, with the center of the vortex being a waterless vacuum zone with a diameter of hundreds of meters.
Looking down from a high altitude, one could see the bottom of the ten-thousand-meter deep ocean directly from the sky, like a devouring abyss.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Thunderstorm surged and covered the surroundings for hundreds of kilometers. Within the center of the storm, more than twenty tornadoes connected the sky to the sea, with thunder surrounding them and creating an astonishing momentum.
A silver giant dragon with a wingspan of over two hundred meters hovered in the sky, while a Nine-headed Flood Dragon controlled red flames, and a red Eastern Divine Dragon over three hundred meters long looked even more divine.
The pressure of their presence as Level 9 Giant Beasts disturbed the giant beasts lurking beneath the sea.
Boom!
An explosion occurred on the sea surface, revealing a giant beast resembling an octopus, covered in blue scale armor, and with a body height of a hundred meters, while each of its sixteen tentacles were over two hundred meters long.
Seawater flowed down through the gaps in its scale armor, creating a cascade that sprayed water mist into the air.
This late-stage Level 9 Blue Giant Beast was strong, and its tentacles stirred up the sea water, raising waves while glaring at the three Level 9 Giant Beasts hovering in the sky, and let out a furious roar.
“Roar! This is the territory of the King of Myth, the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire. Strange extraordinary creatures, get out of this area immediately.”
Although the aura of the red beast over three hundred meters long was terrifying, the Blue Giant Beast did not care much because it had the backing of the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire.
Boom, boom, boom!! The sea surface exploded within a range of tens of kilometers, revealing the enormous figures of two Level 9 Early-stage Beasts, and then seven Level Eight Beasts.
Looking at the three Level 9 Giant Beasts in the sky, and the several Level 8 creatures emerging on the distant sea surface, these beasts had a grand atmosphere surrounding their domains.
Roar!!
A Level 9 Giant Beast, resembling an ancient giant crocodile clad in heavy scale armor, let out a vicious roar: “Strange extraordinary creatures, leave immediately, or we will kill you.”
As subordinates of the Mythical Giant Beasts, these peripheral beasts of the Base Dragon Empire had a natural sense of superiority, and felt that they were more noble than these wild beasts from the countryside.
Thus, their tone of communication was full of a condescending feeling, even though the aura of that late-stage Level 9 Red Beast was terrifying.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was hidden in the thunderclouds of the storm, with thunder roaring, and its terrifying aura was masked by the giant beasts down below so it went unnoticed.
The silver giant dragon hovered in the sky and let out a dignified roar: “Roar! How dare you tell the Great Sethia to scram? Kill them!”
Boom!
In an instant, the sky darkened, covering an area of ten kilometers, and within the darkness, a terrifying beast with a body length of more than three thousand meters appeared, its huge tail falling from the sky.
Boom!
The Blue Giant Beast roared furiously, and with an intense sense of danger, it unleashed its power. The sea within a kilometer radius of its surroundings exploded, creating a mist of water that spread in all directions.
With the help of the blue water mist that spread for several kilometers, the Blue Giant Beast sensed the terrifying colossal creature in the darkness and revealed a shocked expression.
Boom! As its domain surrounded it, a giant beast made of deep blue seawater emerged, accompanied by tentacles that were thousands of meters long.
Boom, boom, boom!! These seawater tentacles rose into the sky, wrapping themselves around the giant tail that had the power of destruction.
Boom, boom, boom!! As soon as these seawater tentacles were wrapped around the red beast’s tail, they were shattered by the incredibly overbearing force, and then fell down.
Boom! Under the terrifying impact, the sea water surged, and the abyss on the sea surface reappeared. The Blue Giant Beast’s body of blue sea domain was blasted apart by the impact, turning into sea water that sprayed everywhere.
However, thanks to the protection of several hundred meters of seawater, the Blue Giant Beast was merely knocked into the depths of the sea several kilometers away, with its blood boiling but not injured.
While in the sea, it used its three advanced talents related to water to dissipate most of the damage through the seawater.
Only that single blow that shattered its domain left it slightly furious and surprised, especially since it had arrogantly told the other party to scram beforehand.
Just as the darkness retreated, and day broke, a divine dragon burning with intense white flames appeared in the sky, with a dazzling glow in its mouth.
Boom! A ten-meter diameter beam of light penetrated heaven and earth, annihilating matter in its blazing hot energy, while the light beam’s surroundings formed circular white shockwaves that fell into the sea.
Boom, boom, boom!! The sea water exploded as the Blazing Flame burned.
At the moment when the Blue Giant Beast dodged the breath, the Red Beast’s mouth moved. The beam of light instantly became a sword that slashed across the sea surface, sweeping through the earth and sky.
Roar! The Blue Giant Beast let out a scream. Unable to evade, the domain around its two enormous tentacles collapsed, and were directly cut off by the breath.
Boom!
As the furious Blue Giant Beast’s blue energy erupted, the sea water within several kilometers surged immediately. More than a dozen vortices appeared, with a center that formed several water columns tens of meters thick that shot into the sky.
These water columns were like blue tentacles that tried to pull down the fiery giant beast in the sky.
At the same time, the severed tentacles of the Blue Giant Beast reattached under the swirl of seawater, losing their flesh and blood, connections were made, and quickly recovered as new tissue grew.
Just as the two late-stage Level 9 Beasts were entangled, the silver giant dragon had already appeared above the head of a giant crocodile wearing scale armor, wrapped in a black-and-silver light with the domain surrounding it.

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 319: Tearing Apart the Semi-Divine, The Invincible Thunderflame Giant Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: Chapter 319: Tearing Apart the Semi-Divine, The Invincible Thunderflame Giant Beast_2
Boom! The terrifying black storm formed from the top-tier talent, mixed with ice crystals, shattered the scale-armored giant crocodile’s domain upon collision.
The rotating ice crystals at several times the speed of sound were even more terrifying, causing them to explode upon striking the energy shield of the giant crocodile, forming a freezing black energy that shattered everything.
In just the blink of an eye, the several meters-thick energy layer outside the scaly giant crocodile was melted, and then large pits with diameters of 0.5 meters to 1 meter appeared on its thick scales.
From a distance, it looked like the entire beast was melting under the destroyer ice wind.
Roar!
Such a terrifying scene made the scale-armored giant crocodile extremely frightened, its internal power burst out crazily, and at the same time, its 30-meter-long crocodile mouth opened wide to bite at the silver giant dragon.
Boom!
With a single strike of the dragon claw holding the compressed black ice whirlwind, half of the scale-armored giant crocodile’s head was shattered, its flesh and blood turned to mush, and it let out a earth-shattering scream.
The top-tier talents not only made their talent power stronger, but also made the silver giant dragon’s flesh and blood even more formidable under the tempering of the top-tier talents power.
In front of the dual-talent kings, this early-stage level 9 giant beast barely had a chance to fight back.
Just like those giant beasts of the same level facing Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the past, the silver giant dragon instantly overpowered it, causing heavy injuries within a few moves and showing incredible power.
At this time, the silver giant dragon truly resembled the king of a giant beast power, possessing a strong dominating force against giant beasts of the same level.
“Roar, roar, roar! Kidora, go for two!”
At the moment of the outbreak of the battle, the nine-headed flood dragon also pounced on an early-stage level 9 giant beast and instantly transformed into a 600-meter-long red three-headed flood dragon under the fusion of its domain.
On the red three-headed flood dragon’s body, over 700 solid runes emitted black light, which overlapped and amplified each other, forming a layer of solid black shield on its body.
Bang, bang, bang!!
Ignoring the attacks on its body, the three-headed flood dragon tore apart the yellow domain of a giant beast resembling a gray whale, and three giant dragon heads directly attacked it.
With high energy defense of the true domain and the high physical defense after the overlap of runes, the battle of the nine-headed flood dragon seemed even more overbearing and crazy.
Woo! In the battle state, the single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out a steam whistle-like long whistle, with the black and white domain surrounding it, it rushed towards the nearest Level 8 giant beast.
In the dark domain surrounding the single-horned Tiger Kingfish, illusions were formed that ignored the opponent’s breath attacks. When they got closer, the domain turned white, and their aura increased tenfold in an instant.
Boom!
With a single edge reaching up to 50 meters, the huge fish fin with its black gold-colored sharp edges emitted a dazzling light, as if it were an indestructible giant ship-cutting knife, tearing through the domain with one strike.
Roar!
At the moment when the giant beast was filled with astonishment and anger, a huge mouth appeared in the darkness behind it, taking advantage of the shattered domain to bite down in an instant.
Bang! Under the terrifying bite, the rear half of the giant beast was instantly devoured and severed by the female Tiger Whale, with its scorching blood spraying out like a high-pressure water jet…
Chirp, chirp, chirp! Look at my Celestial Double Slash.
At the moment when the Level 8 giant beast was heavily injured, the single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s double fins slashed down with ten times the power, tearing through the sea and leaving two huge slash marks.
Boom! Under the double crossing of the blades, the energy shield outside the giant beast collapsed, scales exploded, and both flesh and bone failed to withstand the sharpness of the more than 400 runes overlapping.
As the single-horned Tiger Kingfish slashed off half of the giant beast’s skull, the female Whale Shark Kitty Jones disappeared into the raging sea, and the single-horned Tiger Kingfish had already pounced on another Level 8 giant beast.
Top-tier king-level bloodline, power close to the peak of the eighth level, plus ten times the amplified physical power and defense of the white domain, as well as the ten-meter-thick Spawn Shield.
At this time, the power of the single-horned Tiger Kingfish was very terrifying, enduring the attacks of one Level 8 giant beast after another, and its double fins were soon stained red with beast blood as it fought in close combat.
As the subordinates of the empire, these giant beasts, upon finding the single-horned Tiger Kingfish to be too ferocious, prepared to join forces to besiege and kill it.
Roar!
On the sea surface, a deep-sea dragon turtle roared like a small hill, with light flickering in its mouth, and an instant later, a yellow energy ray five meters thick burst out.
The powerful yellow energy beam pierced the sea surface, like a high-pressure water cannon, and in the blink of an eye, it struck the Level 8 giant beast and slammed more than two thousand meters away from the single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
Boom!
With more than 400 energy conversion runes overlapping and transforming, the power of the earth and vibration merged to form a powerful shattering light beam, causing a violent energy explosion halo to instantly explode when it hit the giant beast’s domain.
Boom! The vibration shattered the energy beam layer by layer, finally slamming into the Level 8 giant beast, and the powerful energy impact sent it flying.
However, after being weakened by layers of the domain, this ray only caused a slight injury to the giant beast but also prevented it from participating in the encirclement.
Boom, boom, boom! At this time, the deep-sea dragon turtle was like a mobile artillery platform, constantly bombarding one Level 8 giant beast after another, restraining them from joining forces.
Gurgle, gurgle! Crab General is super brave and super powerful. I’m going to fight ten.
As the battle broke out, the blue giant crab also rushed up, found a Level 8 middle-phase giant beast several kilometers away, and started fighting without any hesitation.
As for the three-headed small Tiger Whale, under the lead of Tiger Three, they followed closely behind the single-horned Tiger Kingfish, their eyes fixed on the giant beasts that were being slashed and heavily injured by it.
Amidst the battle between more than twenty giant beasts, the sea area became extremely chaotic.
Dark clouds swirled in the sky, and thunder roared down on the sea from time to time, mingling with the angry roars of giant beasts, screams, and the vibrations caused by the impact of the domain powers.

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 319: Tearing Apart the Quasi-Mythical, The Invincible Thunderflame Behemoth_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: Chapter 319: Tearing Apart the Quasi-Mythical, The Invincible Thunderflame Behemoth_3
The chaotic and intense energy fluctuations set off alarms in the energy detection satellites above, yet the specific scene could not be seen due to the dark clouds that shrouded it.
However, humans wouldn’t intervene in the slaughter among these extraordinary creatures, and they might even take pleasure in it.
As the battle on the sea surface grew increasingly brutal, an eighth-level Giant Beast, its belly mostly gone and heavily wounded, fled in panic, rushing to the seabed.
A side of the seabed vortex exploded with sea water as the Giant Beast rolled on the ground a few times before weakly arriving in front of that huge piece of black scale, its spiritual will colliding with the scale.
In an instant, a wave of energy from within the scale was stirred, creating an unseen fluctuation that pierced through the pathway.
Above the mist-shrouded mountain peaks, a several hundred meters high red vortex slowly rotated.
A few kilometers away, a grand and rugged structure stood, supported by only a few huge pillars.
Coiled in the center of the structure was a beast nearly three hundred meters in length, nearly two hundred meters high, with its lower body like a horse sheathed in dark blue heavy armor, and its upper body akin to a demon, possessing a pair of hundred meter-long combat knives.
As the heavily injured Giant Beast’s will collided with the scale, a black scale armor also emitted a will fluctuation on the edge of the structure, and the beast slowly opened its eyes.
In those dark red eyes was a sharpness unparalleled, and just a glance was enough to cause tiny black cracks to appear before it — a terrifying sight.
The Giant Beast growled, “What’s going on?”
From within the scale armor came the anxious thoughts of the two-headed behemoth shark.
“Lord, a group of formidable Giant Beasts are attacking us, and even Lord Blue is no match for them, we cannot hold them back, we cannot hold them back anymore…”
The Blade Giant Beast’s gaze turned ice cold as it spoke in a deep voice, “Those indigenous dare to attack the Base Dragon Empire, or is it a power from another pathway?”
“The number of enemies, their levels?”
Facing the Blade Giant Beast’s inquiry, the two-headed behemoth shark replied weakly, “The enemy is led by a Ninth-level Late-stage Beast, accompanied by two Early Stage Level 9s, and six or seven eighth-level transcendent creatures.”
“Useless creatures.”
Only the Dark Giant Python and the Blade Giant Beast knew of the matter when the Sword Dragon Giant Beast was repelled after being attacked, and after the demise of the Dark Giant Python, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast had sent Lord Blue to take charge.
Therefore, this eighth-level Giant Beast had no idea it was being attacked by the Dragon Palace’s forces, and even the Blade Giant Beast did not consider the Dragon Palace’s forces, given the huge disparity between them.
At that moment, it presumed it was a power from another pathway.
Hearing that its subordinates were defeated by another group of Giant Beasts not greatly different in number or level, a surge of rage and brutality rose within its heart.
“A bunch of useless things.” As it roared lowly, the Blade Giant Beast slowly stood up, a terrifying aura of murderous intent spreading from its body, causing the very mountains to tremble under its oppressive aura.
Some Giant Beast power dared invade the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, seeking death; regardless of which power they were, it would make them understand the fear of death.
And as for these useless wastes, keeping them was just a squandering of resources.
Boom!
The ground shattered as the Blade Giant Beast instantly appeared before the distant pathway, its massive body squeezing in, causing the red vortex to shiver, as a powerful repulsion force came forth.
This world’s pathway was several times smaller than Humanity’s Channel One, and weaker in both strength and stability. Thus, when a quasi-mythical level Giant Beast entered, it triggered a strong repulsion shock.
At the center of the seabed vortex, the rotating red vortex suddenly shook violently, as the aura of a quasi-mythical level Giant Beast permeated from the other side.
Quickly, a huge silhouette emerged amid the terrifying aura.
The two-headed behemoth shark lying on the ground revealed a glimpse of joy in its eyes and respectfully lowered its head, “Greetings, Lord.”
Bang! The colossal hooves of the Blade Giant Beast, like pillars of a mountain, landed, crushing the two-headed behemoth shark’s head in an instant, as flesh and blood scattered over a range of hundreds of meters.
After casually crushing the two-headed behemoth shark to death, the Blade Giant Beast lifted its head towards the sky, its gaze piercing through the ten-thousand-meter vortex channel and falling upon the roaring Fire Giant Beast in the sky.
At the same time, it sensed a strong presence in the clouds, from which a subtle sense of oppressive danger faintly emanated.
A cold intent to kill flashed in the eyes of the Blade Giant Beast, “Daring to attack the Base Dragon Empire, there must be an ambush. But I’m not the useless one like Troy.”
Boom!
With a low roar, a terrifying aura of pressure burst from the Blade Giant Beast, causing the entire ocean to tremble, and the surrounding whirlpools to roar furiously.
Under the sharp and terrifying quasi-mythical aura, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon and other beasts in the vicinity all revealed grave expressions.
At the same time, the remaining two eighth-level beasts that were already heavily injured fighting against the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Blue Chapter Behemoth whose most tentacles had been cut off, all showed relief in their eyes.
“It’s Lord Kol! You invaders, you are doomed,” rejoiced a voice.
At that moment, the hooves of the Blade Giant Beast below the deep sea pounded the ground, and its enormous body traversed ten thousand meters, appearing high above the whirlpool sea surface in an instant.
Suddenly, the aura of the quasi-mythical level Giant Beast filled Heaven and Earth, and the roaring sea surface calmed abruptly under the might far greater than that of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
The Giant Beast Candle Dragon’s eyes also held a solemn look.
Though it was comparable to a quasi-mythical level in strength, it was not a quasi-mythical being and felt a strong sense of danger from the beast that emitted a sharpness without equal.
Boom! Twin blades tore through space, creating two hundred-meter-long black cracks that appeared as if by teleportation above the head of the White Flame Behemoth.
At the same time, a force that distorted and inverted space descended, making it impossible for the Candle Dragon Giant Beast to dodge or hide, leaving it no choice but to bellow out a Destructive Breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 716: 319 Tearing Apart the Quasi-Mythical, The Invincible Thunderflame Behemoth_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: Chapter 319 Tearing Apart the Quasi-Mythical, The Invincible Thunderflame Behemoth_4
“`
Boom! Black cracks crisscrossed the sky, shredding breaths and falling upon the Fire Giant Beast, breaking it down with unstoppable force.
Roar! In an instant, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast was bisected by double blades, half its body dissolving into a white flame explosion. Such might caused all the Silver Giant Dragons below to shrink their pupils.
So powerful!
At that moment, the white flames gathered again in the distance, reforming the Candle Dragon Giant Beast. Then, heaven and earth darkened as a massive tail swept across the Void.
In the darkness, the Blade Giant Beast’s gaze was icy cold. Suddenly, it crossed its double blades overlaid with black energy that shimmered into a combat knife hundreds of meters long, held in front of it.
Boom! The huge tail, imbued with explosive power that could obliterate everything, made even the Blade Giant Beast’s form sink slightly, its hooves cracking the void beneath it layer by layer.
The Destructive Impact created by that strike caused the atmosphere upfront to explode with a thunderous roar that shook heaven and earth, raising hundred-meter-tall waves on the sea surface below.
Roar! The Blade Giant Beast roared in fury, and an even more terrifying Power Explosion burst forth from its body. The luminescence on its blade arms flickered as they crossed and horizontally slashed, tearing the space apart, cutting through everything.
Roar! The Candle Dragon let out another miserable cry as its thick, reinforced tail was sliced open by two deep hundred-meter-long wounds.
Comparable to semi-mythical level, but not quite semi-mythical after all, its body lacked the Tempering of laws possessed by quasi-mythical behemoths, making it less formidable. However, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast was not without the strength to fight back.
As the Candle Dragon opened its eyes, darkness and daylight interchanged between heaven and earth, and time suddenly slowed down.
Boom!
Suddenly, amidst the Thunder Cloud Storm, Thunder erupted uncontrollably, the endless Crimson red lightning bringing forth an immense pressure, supreme and overwhelming all beings.
Beneath this terrifying pressure, the dark clouds above dissipated, forming a hollow over ten kilometers wide, out of which emerged an 800-meter-long Deep Red Giant Beast.
“Roar! Mythical-level!” The Blade Giant Beast immediately let out a roar of shocked fury.
But before the Blade Giant Beast could react, the terrifying Deep Red Giant Beast appeared before it with indescribable speed.
As inexhaustible red lightning exploded on the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, engulfing thousands of kilometers, the splintered Void sent tremors that prevented the Blade Giant Beast from teleporting through space.
Meanwhile, the giant claws wrapped in Deep Red Thunder descended, crushing the dark giant blades swung at it. The Blade Giant Beast tried to dodge in terror, but one claw caught its shoulder in an instant.
In that moment, the Blade Giant Beast’s protective body energy shattered, its shoulder’s scale armor cracked, and the terrifying force rendered half its body powerless to resist.
“Roar! No!”
In terror, the Blade Giant Beast’s left arm brandished its slash blade, tearing space, and in an instant, it unleashed hundreds of slashes on the Deep Red Giant Beast, but to no avail.
Ignoring the Blade Giant Beast’s attack, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon caught its body in its double claws, then Power Explosion ensued.
Boom!
With a hundredfold strength amplification, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon tore the quasi-mythical behemoth in half. Blood rained down from the sky, a display of extreme ferocity.
Yet, the vitality of a quasi-mythical behemoth was terrifying, and even in such circumstances, the Blade Giant Beast was not yet dead.
As it swung its combat knife, trying to slice off the remaining half of its body to escape the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s giant claws, a sharp and fierce crimson tail penetrated the Void.
Boom!
The Crimson Blade Tail pierced the head in an instant, and as the encircling red lightning exploded, the Blade Giant Beast gradually lost its life force, its eyes dimming, and was decisively suppressed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Looking at the sky where half a quasi-mythical behemoth’s corpse was hanging from a tail, with half a corpse grasped in its hands, and radiating a ferocious and terrifying aura, there was silence between heaven and earth.
This was the terrifying combat power of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon now.
After its Giantification Talent was enhanced to Top Tier status, its Five Top-level Talents fused within the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, making it in its Crimson Form even more terrifyingly invincible.
In reality, the normal Giantification Talent was not so exaggerated. Even if enhanced to Top Tier with a ninefold base amplification, it would only enable a Level 9 Giant Beast to fight across two minor levels.
But when applied to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it was different. With the base amplification, all its Top-tier Talents were horrifically enhanced.
Above all, with Hundredfold Power, Hundredfold Defense, swiftness, Annihilation True Thunder, Heaven Burning Golden Flame, these fusions were even more formidable than ordinary laws.
And this fusion was not a one-time effect, but a constant state.
This is what made Monarch-Level Life so terrifying.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, possessing two additional Top-tier Talents above regular Monarch-Level Life, every increment of its power was not isolated but an overall enhancement.
Even at Mythical-level, with Six Top-level Talents, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would remain peerless within its rank.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 717: 320: Guarding the World Pathway, Body Size Surges (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: Chapter 320: Guarding the World Pathway, Body Size Surges (Seeking Monthly Tickets)
The Blade Giant Beast was actually very powerful, especially those space-tearing blades and the Voidstep talent that could twist space and shorten distance in an instant.
With these two talents combined, it was nearly invincible in close quarters combat, having wounded the Giant Beast Candle Dragon with just a few moves.
This was without using its other talent abilities, including its strongest law power.
Within a minute of its appearance, the terrifying power displayed by the Blade Giant Beast had shocked all the Giant Beasts, especially the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish causing havoc in the sea.
If that terrifying blade hit it, it would be cleaved in two instantly.
However, before the heavily injured Blue Giant Beast and others could let out excited roars, the appearance of the Deep Red Giant Beast in the sky told them what despair was.
The “invincible” Blade Giant Beast was instantly killed, gruesomely torn in two, in a terrifying and bloody scene.
With half a corpse hanging from the tail of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and half a Giant Beast’s corpse gripped in its claw while it hovered in the high sky, the mythical terror of its power suppressed heaven and earth.
Through a ten-kilometer diameter hole in the cloud layer, the satellite of the Ocean Monitoring Center captured the ferocious figure of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
But because the power fluctuations emanating from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon were so strong that they twisted the surrounding space and magnetic field, the satellite image only showed endless red lightning.
In the center of the dazzling lightning was a massive light source, emitting Mythical-level energy fluctuations. Immediately, the entire monitoring center flashed with piercing red alarm lights.
“Alert, Mythical-level energy fluctuation detected. This energy fluctuation spectrum is unfamiliar, not in known database, belonging to an unfamiliar mythical creature.”
“A new Mythical Giant Beast has emerged from the sea!” Shock was written all over the faces of everyone in the Monitoring Center.
This is because Mythical-level already belonged to high-end combat power, enough to determine the direction of a transcendent battle.
Even though humans have a large population and reserve power, occupying a wide territory in the mythical world, only a few kings have emerged in recent years.
In contrast to the Human Race with cultivation inheritance and systematic education, it is more difficult for Unique Beasts to advance and grow. In the past few decades, only a few Mythical Giant Beasts have emerged from the sea.
And those few were from the initial stage when the Heavenly anomalies had just begun and the deep sea tunnels were not occupied by the Mythical Giant Beasts from the other side.
Later, as the three deep sea tunnels were occupied by the Mythical Giant Beasts from the other world, for many years no Mythical-level creatures had appeared because of the lack of special power needed for breakthroughs.
Therefore, once the sea monsters grew to Level 9 mid-to-late stage, they would leave the Blue Star through the tunnel. This is why humans later became more and more indifferent to the sea.
They hadn’t expected that after decades, a new Mythical Giant Beast would appear in the sea again.
At that moment, the Colonel who was in charge today said somberly: “Could this unfamiliar Mythical energy fluctuation… Could it be that creature code-named Thunderflame?”
“How could that be? Based on the size we observed earlier, it should only be at… the mid-Stage of Level 9…” The team leader of the monitoring group paused in his speech.
The Colonel nodded solemnly, “Correct, it’s already at the midpoint of Level 9. You should know that half a month ago it was only at the early stage of Level 9, and it had defeated a quasi-mythical beast head-on.”
Hissing sounds filled the Monitoring Center as everyone drew in a sharp breath. This was terrifying.
Within half a month, it had grown from the early stage of Level 9 to the middle stage, and its combat power had reached the Mythical level.
This terrifying leap in combat power was even more terrifying than human monsters with the potential of Heavenly Kings and Supremes.
The Colonel on duty looked serious: “No wonder Thunderflame dares to seek revenge. Its strength has increased substantially.”
“We need to inform the higher-ups immediately and request a King-level strong man to take action.”
“Although Channel 3 belongs to another Mythical Giant Beast, judging from the strength displayed by the Thunderflame Giant Beast, it may really be able to take over.”
…….
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re so awesome.”
“Roar! The great Scythia is too powerful. Under my leadership, the Dragon Palace has annihilated an outer force of a Mythical Giant Beast. That’s awesome.”
“Roar! When the great Scythia returns, Tim Abott, remember to help me catch Telsafi. I want to ride on it and bully it. Ha ha…”
The silver dragon, with wings spanning over 200 meters, circling around the deep red beast which was more than 800 meters long, seemed very excited.
But its words left the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at a loss for words. What kind of hobby was riding on another Giant Beast? Plus, it is a female dragon, right?
At this time, the battle below was also coming to an end.
With the injured Giant Beast Candle Dragon getting furious and finally unleashing its full power, time slowed down under the Day and Night Alternation. In the darkness, the huge double claws of the Black Colossus, over 3000 meters in size, grabbed the body of the Blue Giant Beast.
Roar!
As the muscles in the double claws of the Candle Dragon, transformed into the Black Colossus, expanded, a terrifying power burst forth. The Blue Giant Beast let out a ‘slow’ scream, and its tough and powerful body made a creaking sound like metal being torn.
Boom!
With a resonating roar, countless blue blood splashed out. The Blue Giant Beast at the late stage of Level 9 was torn apart by the Candle Dragon, appearing incredibly ferocious.
Roar! With the darkness fading and it returning to its normal size, the Red Beast mimicked the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, grabbed the corpse of the Blue Giant Beast in its claws, and let out a roar of tyranny.
At this time, the silver dragon in the sky curiously asked, “Roar! Candle Dragon, how come you didn’t drop out when you were fighting?”
