It was hard to have a conversation with it earlier because of its delayed reactions. You never knew which sentence it would respond to when it suddenly caught on.

chapters.title: Chapter 718: 320: Guarding the World Pathway, Body Size Surges (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Chapter 320: Guarding the World Pathway, Body Size Surges (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2
But as soon as the battle began, this guy became fierce and overbearing.
When faced with this question, the Red Beast growled, “Because in non-combat state, I am under the influence of the power of slow time, feeling the changes of time.”
“Roar! You want to gather Time Laws.” The Silver Giant Dragon immediately showed envy in its eyes.
The Red Beast on the sea surface nodded gently.
At Late Stage 9, it has grown to the peak of extraordinary creatures. Next, it needs to comprehend the laws, touch the laws, and temper its body with Law Power.
When its body is mostly tempered, it will need to go the Vast World to refine the ancient breath and carry the laws with the ancient power as a medium to advance to the Mythical Giant Beast.
However, the laws of time are not so easy to touch, and even now, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast has no clue.
Meanwhile, as the two giant creatures conversed, the battle was almost over.
Now the whole sea area had become murky, and the corpses of countless ordinary mutated creatures that were killed by the shockwaves from the battle floated on the sea surface, along with the sinking and floating corpses of Giant Beasts.
The red lightning on Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the sky slowly disappeared, and then its body shrank at a visible speed, returning to its normal size of a little over 200 meters.
Immediately, a feeling of weakness came from its body.
Compared to the intermediate Gigantification form, although the top-tier Gigantification has a more terrifying increase, it also consumes more cellular biochemical energy.
It estimated that it would be exhausted after a maximum of one hour of battle in the deep red form, and this is when its physical strength was dozens of times that of the other Giant Beasts of the same level.
If it were a Level 9 Giant Beast like the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, even with top-tier Gigantification, it could only maintain an extreme burst for a few minutes at most.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that caught the corpse of the Blade Giant Beast fell down, and the sea surface exploded instantly. Seas water splashed hundreds of meters high, turning into a torrential rain covering a range of kilometers.
However, surrounded by domain power, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not sink into the sea but stood on the sea surface.
At this time, the single-horned Tiger Whale with broken scale armor in many places and blood on its fins that even the sea water could not wash away swam over, emitting an excited cry.
Chirp, chirp, chirp! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, I killed four, four, and heavily injured two!
In this battle, Single-horned Tiger Whale made its name for the first time. Although it was not weak in fighting against the same level in the past, it had some difficulties in killing the opponent.
Because it lacked the decisive killing method.
But this time, the Single-horned Tiger Whale killed four Level 8 Late Stage beasts in a short time, heavily injuring two, and these Giant Beasts had strong bloodlines even among the royal bloodlines.
At this time, the sea surface bulged, and the sea water exploded, revealing the figure of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which could not bear to see the self-righteous Single-Horned Tiger Whale.
Roar! Joe, you are too shameless. If it weren’t for Domination and me blocking the siege for you and Haward Jones helping you, you would have been bitten to death long ago.
Under normal conditions, even if the Single-horned Tiger Whale could kill those Giant Beasts when facing the attack of several same-level Giant Beasts, it would also be severely injured and dying. After all, it was not the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale didn’t care, waved its fins proudly: Chirp, chirp, chirp! Although you helped, they were all killed by me.
Chirp, chirp, chirp! Also, just now, I saw that when the quasi-mythical Giant Beast appeared, Domination, you hid directly under the deep sea.
Saying this, the Single-horned Tiger Whale showed disdain in its eyes.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle stretched its neck, emitting an unyielding growl: Roar! Don’t talk about me, Joe, didn’t you also rush into the vortex and hide at that time?
As the two giant creatures quarreled, from behind the Single-Horned Tiger Whale, a black-and-white female Tiger Whale with crystal clear scales surfaced slowly.
Angle Haward first cast a gentle gaze at the Single-horned Tiger Whale, and then respectfully sang to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon: Chirp, chirp! My king, all enemies are killed.
The voice of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was deep and thick.
“Roar! You all did a good job this time, and Big Joe Domination, it was the right choice to hide from powerful enemies during the battle. You don’t have to be embarrassed.”
In front of the Blade Giant Beast, it’s not just the two Level 8 Giant Beasts of Single-Horned Tiger Whale, even the Nine-headed Monster Ghidorah and the Silver Giant Dragon hid away temporarily to avoid the sharp edge.
This was not an issue of courage, but the difference in strength between the two sides was too large. It was completely courting death for them to be foolishly rushing up at this time.
Even for the Silver Giant Dragon, at its Level 9 Early Stage, it couldn’t say that it could withstand the Blade Giant Beast’s strike.
If the opponent rushed towards it at that time, it could only use the Scale of Laws to resist, and with that Giant Beast’s strength, it might need two Scales of Laws to kill it.
At this time, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which was not injured overall, swam over, and two black dragon heads were biting the corpse of the Level 9 Giant Beast.
Looking at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, its seven dragon heads twisted, emitting an excited and chaotic roar: Roar, roar, roar!! Kidora, super awesome, no injuries, killed the same level.
“Roar! Not bad, choosing to teach you Solid Rune was indeed the right choice.” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
Compared to killing the same level Giant Beasts in the past, either three or four heads had to be blown up, this time the Nine-headed Flood Dragon performed well, killing an Early-stage Level 9 Beast without injury.
Chirp, chirp, chirp! Uncle Uncle, we’re super strong too.
Chirp, chirp! Yes, we killed a Level 8 too.
Chirp, chirp, chirp! I’m the best, I bit off half its head.
The three ‘small’ Tiger Whales rushed out of the water, and the youngest dragged a more than 70-meter-long, lost its back half of a Level 8 Middle Phase Giant Beast’s corpse.
Looking at the broken wound at the back, it was obviously Angle Haward’s doing, coupled with the huge ‘knife’ wounds on its body, okay, the little guys went after their parents’ windfall.

chapters.title: Chapter 719: 320 Guarding the World Passageways, Sudden Increase in Size (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: Chapter 320 Guarding the World Passageways, Sudden Increase in Size (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3
“Not bad,” Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in approval, at least they dared to charge at an Eighth Level Beast,
Of course, it was a heavily injured and dying Eighth Level Beast.
Otherwise, in a head-on situation, only the third one, whose talent is no less than that of Horned Lady and nearly at the peak of Level 7, could hold on for a while.
Roar Roar Roar! The three-headed small Tiger Whale, having received praise from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, rolled happily in the water.
Then, after the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon waited a few more minutes, the distant sea surface suddenly exploded, revealing the Blue Giant Crab and the corpse of a Mid Stage Level 8 Behemoth clamped within its pincers.
At this moment, the Blue Giant Crab had a tragic aura about it.
In this battle, it had lost three legs again, and many parts of its sharp and heavy carapace were caved in. Its eyes were blood-red, clearly indicating that the previous fight had been fierce.
The Blue Giant Crab came before the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, holding the body of a behemoth, even larger than itself, excitedly blowing bubbles.
Gurgle Gurgle!! King, king, I’ve also killed one.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded and growled lowly, “Good, Crab General, you performed very well this time. Keep striving in the next one.”
Instantly, the Blue Giant Crab was exceedingly thrilled: Gurgle Gurgle!! I definitely will not let the king down, next time I will fight ten and clip their tails off.
The battle was over; now it was the division of the spoils.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s tail moved slightly, rolling the upper half of the Blade Giant Beast’s corpse that was hanging behind it to the front, its fierce claws tearing through the chest, and immediately, blood containing astonishing energy spilled out.
Soon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon carefully extracted a basin-sized life crystal that emitted pure golden radiance.
Compared to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s massive Dragon Claw, the 0.5 meter diameter crystal appeared like a small stone, but the pure golden radiance it emitted at this moment was pulsating with startling waves of Life Energy.
Even the Red Beast couldn’t help wanting to instinctively devour the intense waves of life.
A Level 9 Peak life crystal, not only containing more Life Energy than Level 8, but also the ‘essence’ within was extremely terrifying.
That was the energy that, when combined with ancient breath, could evolve a Giant Beast into a Mythical Giant Beast.
It’s just a pity, Jack Clark’s transformed Attribute points did not concern the ‘quality’ of Life Energy, only the quantity mattered.
At this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “The three Level 9 Giant Beasts, those dismantled Level 8 Behemoths, and half of the Level 9 Peak Giant Beast’s flesh and blood belong to this king.”
“The remaining half of the Level 9 Peak Giant Beast’s flesh and blood will be divided equally among you according to your strength contribution, any objections?”
The Silver Giant Dragon growled lowly, “Roar! No problem, this time Tim Abott you contributed the most, it’s natural that you receive the majority of the spoils, and then the Candle Dragon.”
Roar Roar Roar! No objections.
Regarding the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s division of the spoils, none of the Giant Beasts had any objections, or rather, they had made a huge profit, after all, that was the flesh and blood of a King-level quasi-mythical creature.
Under the Tempering of rules, the flesh and blood of such Giant Beasts contained stronger Life Factors, which could grant Giant Beasts like the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle at level eight surpassing growth.
It was even of certain help to the Late Stage 9 Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
Even devouring the flesh and blood of king-level creatures like the Silver Giant Dragon and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon provided a certain enhancement, roughly equivalent to a piece of God-level resources.
Under the watchful eyes of a group of Giant Beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon divided the back half of the Blade Giant Beast’s flesh and blood into ten portions,
The Giant Beast Candle Dragon received the largest share, followed by the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, and then the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, who received slightly more than the Horned Lady and the Blue Giant Crab.
Finally, the Three-headed Small Tiger Whales each received a small piece (tens of thousands of tons).
10,000 meters below, at the center of the vortex in the hundreds of meters wide Waterless Zone.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze fell upon the red vortex, pondering slightly.
Since it had instantly killed that Blade Giant Beast, communication was cut off, and that Mythical Giant Beast probably had no idea about the events transpiring here.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wasn’t ready to head over just yet.
With its current combat power, it could only confront an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast head-on, and there were some difficulties in defeating, let alone killing, the Black Oblivion King.
But after it finished consuming the flesh of those few Level 9 Giant Beasts and grew in size, its strength would increase significantly.
Apart from that, there were the resources and Life Crystals that King Quentin Torres had gathered, plus the Level 9 Crystals it had obtained, which should be more than enough for it to strengthen a Top Tier Talent to its peak and perhaps even beyond.
Once a Top Tier Talent had been further enhanced, it should equate to the power of rules, or a power comparable to rules.
Only then would it officially step into the Mythical-level combat power, where every move it made would be akin to that of a Mythical Giant Beast, and not rely on the temporary (one hour) burst of Gigantification.
But there was another problem: what if the Black Oblivion King reacted before it could enhance its talent and came to kill it.
With this thought in mind, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned to look at the Silver Giant Dragon, which was lying on the ground nearby, happily gnawing on the flesh of a Level 9 Peak Giant Beast.
“Roar! Seth, we’ll guard here for a while, and if that Mythical Giant Beast shows up, I will Burst out my power and drive it back.”
“But if I can’t hold it off, you use the Scale of Laws.”
The Silver Giant Dragon raised its head proudly, “Roar! No problem, Tim Abbott, when the time comes, the Great Sethia will surely let it know the wrath of a dragon.”
“That bastard’s subordinate dared to have the Great Sethia submit to him; it’s seeking death.”
“If it weren’t for the fact that mother isn’t here, I would have called her to kill it already.”
Looking at the still indignant Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon paused for a moment because it didn’t recall the Sword Dragon Giant Beast asking the Silver Giant Dragon to submit, did it?
Forget it, it’s hard to make sense of its thought process.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook its head and grabbed the corpse of the Blue Giant Beast, devouring it in large bites, each one tearing off thousands of tons of flesh and blood.
Next to it, the corpses of several Level 9 Giant Beasts and the broken bodies of seven Level 8 Giant Beasts piled up like mountains. The mere trickle of blood that flowed out formed a pool on the ground, emitting strong energy fluctuations.
As it Devoured the flesh and blood of Level 9 Giant Beasts, under the abundant supply of biological energy, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body size began to grow at a rate visible to the naked eye.
Two hundred and eight meters, two hundred and ten meters, two hundred and fifteen meters…

chapters.title: Chapter 720: 321: The Monster that Devours Flesh, Blood, and Soul, The Battle True Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Chapter 321: The Monster that Devours Flesh, Blood, and Soul, The Battle True Body
In the cultivation room, as the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon rapidly swelled, streams of robust Evolution Energy appeared within Jack Clark’s body through the soul channel.
Especially when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to devour the Blade Giant Beast, the energy contained in the Law Factors became even more overbearing and violent, bringing forth a surge of even more robust strengthening energy.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
An explosive, muffled roar emanated from within Jack Clark’s body; under the influence of these strengthening energies, his cells wildly divided, compressed, evolved, and became increasingly terrifying.
This all-round enhancement of strength, speed, physique, resistance, endurance, recovery ability, and spirit became more and more terrifying as it progressed.
On the attribute page, all four of Jack Clark’s major attributes were rising at an astonishing rate, with his strength quickly surpassing 7200, 7500…
As the strength and density of his physical form continued to improve, a heavy aura emanated from Jack, compressing everything around him as if he were a truly expanding giant beast.
The terrifying heavy aura filled the surrounding space, and the entire cultivation room vibrated slightly. Even the floor, harder than alloy, began to sink slowly beneath him.
At this moment, Jack Clark was like a terrifying giant beast, exceedingly alarming.
In addition, as two Sky Element Stones were being refined each day, the progress of the Combat Shadow becoming materialized from void was also accelerating rapidly.
Meanwhile, as time went by during Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation, those top-notch geniuses who returned to their countries began to spread the information about this trip to the relic through their higher-ups.
Naturally, the people who knew about this trip to the relic were no ordinary individuals.
Simon, Sky Element No.1 Base.
“The seventh test of Number One is about to begin.”
“Energy checks complete.”
“Soul Sync Rate is normal.”
“The driver’s mental state is stable, with no signs of corruption.”
“Physical condition is normal across the board, with no detected signs of assimilation.”
“Release the safety controller.”
“Please direct the driver to move Number One to the center of the testing area.”
“In ten minutes, we’ll begin charging the Annihilation Beam to test the strength of Number One’s Spatial Barrier, the activity level of Super God Energy, and the maximum force release threshold…”
As the controllers in front of him slowly unlocked, the Mech standing 150 meters tall, covered in thick black and red armor, and exuding a terrifying might, lit up its eyes.
Under the gaze of those eyes emitting blue-white radiance, many staff members in the distance felt a fear rising from the depths of their souls, causing their knees to weaken.
At the same time, the giant black door, 200 meters tall and 10 meters thick, slowly slid open to the sides.
Boom!
The black-red Mech lurched into motion, slowly moving toward the outside. With each step, the earth trembled and even the entire research base quivered slightly with its movement.
As the gigantic Mech walked out of the base, Gabriella and a silver-haired woman stood together on the roof of the building a kilometer away.
Looking at the ferocious Mech that was moving, Gabriella revealed a look of curiosity, “Teacher, is that the legendary Number One?”
“I heard its driver was a classmate of Jack Clark.” The blonde girl said, her eyes flickering slightly.
“Correct, it is Number One,” the woman nodded, looking at the terrifying ‘creature’ that had been restarted after more than a decade, her gaze somewhat complex.
Gabriella curiously asked, “Teacher, I’ve heard that the Mech contains a God-level creature inside and requires a driver with a soul contract for control.”
“But since it’s a God-level creature, neither its essence of life nor its soul is the same as ours, how is it possible for there to be a soul sync?”
The silver-haired woman slowly explained, “Under normal circumstances, soul synchronization couldn’t be achieved, which is why when Number One was first cultivated, it just…”
“Forget it, there’s no use in you knowing these things. Now that your essence and Mech have broken through the Seventh Layer, after stabilizing the gains from the relic, you will enter the mythical world with Number One.”
“Once there, Fina, your mission is to protect Number One’s driver well and avoid any accidents during her separation from Number One.”
“Remember, Number One is very important to the Human Race, even more so than a Heavenly King Level powerhouse. It must not come to harm.”
Gabriella was somewhat puzzled, “Teacher, if Number One is so important to the Human Race, why go to the mythical world? Isn’t it safer to stay here?”
The silver-haired woman sighed slightly, “Because it needs energy, it needs to devour the flesh and souls of countless high-order and even Mythical-level beings to grow to the level we want.”
“What!”
……
“A few more days and I’ll break through to the Eighth Layer, but I still lack thunder and flames.”
Deep beneath the sea, amidst the Spatial Vortex Center Space.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon finished devouring the flesh of the Blade Giant Beast and ate a Heavenly Dragon Fruit, comfortably laying on the ground to sleep, suddenly in the distance, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stood up.
By now, a day had passed since the battle, and after consuming all the flesh of the Giant Beasts, the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had grown to over 250 meters.
The colossal body, equivalent to densities tens of times that of its peers, merely standing there caused the surrounding space to distort and the ground to sink under the sheer invisible pressure.
In addition, the Evolution value had increased significantly, approaching 30,000.
Feeling the vibration of the ground, the Silver Giant Dragon opened its eyes only to see the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turn its head and, with a thunderous explosion of air, unleash a terrifying force with its right claw upon its own Dorsal Fin.
Boom! Instantly, the space vibrated, and the force exploded; spikes each as thick as five meters, more than seven meters in length, resembling coral of a black and blue hue, smashed heavily onto the ground.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened, “Roar! Tim Abott, why are you hitting yourself?”
The voice of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon came low and deep, “I want to run an experiment.”
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked over its own body, it then realized that unlike the Annihilation True Thunder, the Golden Flame was carried within its flesh and blood and could not be used as material.
At the thought, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils turned towards the Silver Giant Dragon, immediately frightening the Silver Giant Dragon to stand erect and take two steps back, covering its dorsal fin with both claws.
“Roar! You can’t hit me, it hurts.”
…You don’t have fire talent, why would I hit you?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shifted his gaze from the Silver Giant Dragon to the Red Beast sleeping in the distance, pausing briefly before looking at Kidora, all nine heads diligently cultivating.
After devouring the flesh of the quasi-mythical beast, these giants were all sleeping off their meal.
After all, they weren’t like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, able to digest anything right away, not even the Horned Lady, who had just swallowed their food into her stomach.
Of course, because of her talent, the Horned Lady’s devouring speed was stronger than that of other giant beasts.
Given time, as her power improved and her talent grew stronger, she might evolve into a monster that devoured everything, a true kun capable of swallowing the sky and earth.
Watching the Nine-headed Flood Dragon earnestly cultivating, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes flickered slightly before he stepped forward with heavy footsteps.
A large shadow suddenly loomed overhead, and Kidora’s nine heads looked up in confusion: “Roar roar roar! Abbott, what… is… it?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze fell on the dragon head with a red horn on Kidora: “Kidora, may I borrow something from you?”
“Roar roar roar! Sure.”
Kidora agreed without a second thought, then saw the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grab one of his dragon heads with a claw, clasp the other with its claws, and Kidora’s tail straightened out painfully at the intense agony.
“Roar roar roar! Abbott, pain, pain.”
“Roar, no worries, it’ll only hurt a bit.”
The horn on the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s head was not just a symbol but a vital confluence of its bloodline power and talent, as well as being top-tier material.
Each time one of its heads was blown away, it took a day to regenerate a new one, with the horn consuming the most.
Boom! Under the terrifying power of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a five-meter-long, three-meter-thick base red dragon horn was snapped off instantly, generating explosive thunder.
This brutal act made the Silver Giant Dragon and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, awakened from afar, widen their eyes in shock.
Especially the Red Beast, which after a few seconds of stalling, swiftly turned and burrowed into the whirlpool of seawater, completely without its usual clumsiness and delay.
Seeing this, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes bulged once more: “Roar! So this guy had been feigning stupidity all this time.”
With its left claw grasping its dorsal fin and its right holding the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s flame horn, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction and walked over to the back of the pathway.
Boom!
A burst of golden flames erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, engulfing the coral fin, causing the temperature to rise rapidly, melting the ground into magma.
Under the continuous golden flame by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a human-head-sized black-blue crystalline substance gradually formed, with faint flashes of thunder inside.
Then the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon tossed down Kidora’s flame horn, continuing the busy work and infusing some strands of the Golden Flame’s origin during the smelting process.
Soon, a golden-red, palm-thick, over 40-centimeter-long crystalline little horn emerged from the flames.
“Scythia, I’ll be out for a while, watch the channel,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled before diving into the water and vanishing in the blink of an eye.
Inside the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, the golden-red runes on his right arm flickering, and a human-head-sized spatial vortex emerged in front of him amidst powerful spatial fluctuations.
Boom!
A surge of power came from the opposite side, causing the silver vortex to expand several times in size, followed by a giant golden crystal, a golden-red small horn, and a blue-black crystal.
After the transfer through the vortex was complete, it vanished instantly.
Even for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, forcing open the spatial channel like this was a struggle, showing the need for more construction of Spatial Channel Runes.
In contemplation, Jack Clark tucked away the two materials from various parts of the Level 9 Giant Beast’s body and then put his hand on the Level 9 Life Crystal.
Feeling the astonishing Life Energy fluctuations within, Jack got excited, his thoughts moved: “Convert this Life Crystal into Attribute points.”
Boom! Endless Life Energy surged into Jack’s body and got converted into another type of energy the instant it entered him, vanishing.
This was the first time Jack experienced the transformation into Attribute points.
Meanwhile, on the transparent page before his eyes, the remaining 8,804 Attribute points surged at an alarming rate, breaking past ten thousand in a blink.
When the golden crystal transformed completely, the points on the page skyrocketed to 25,130, meaning the Level 9 Life Crystal had translated into more than sixteen thousand points.
“What a pity, Attribute points consider quantity, not quality. Otherwise, the total value of this Level 9 Peak life crystal would be over ten times that of a level eight one.”
After sighing, Jack resumed his closed-eye cultivation.
The following days were uneventful, both under the deep sea and in the human world.
As each Sky Element Stone got absorbed and refined, Jack’s aura crept closer to the late period of the Seventh Layer of Heaven, successfully breaking through after four days.
But there was no stopping there; with continuous refinement, the Combat Shadow became more condensed, transitioning from ethereal to solid, and gradually reached ninety-nine percent.
At this point, Jack’s cultivation reached the Pinnacle of the Seventh Layer of Heaven.
Whoosh whoosh!!
Inside the Hundred-meter Cultivation Room made of gray-black rock, thirty meters tall, Jack stood with an equally tall figure behind him.
The Combat Shadow was, no, should now be referred to as the True Body.
The nearly-solidified True Body was engulfed in golden flames and jumping thunder, with four halos of light slowly revolving behind its head like a deity from ancient times.
“This is what a ‘True Body’ truly is.”
With that sentiment, Jack and the True Body behind him opened their eyes simultaneously, both sets of eyes cold and devoid of any emotion.

chapters.title: Chapter 721: 322 True Martial Unity, Supreme Above and Below Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Chapter 322 True Martial Unity, Supreme Above and Below Heaven and Earth
“`
The True Martial Arts Phantom became 99% real, at the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven, reaching this step, what comes next is the convergence and breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven with Spirit, Qi, and Mind.
Under normal conditions, many high-level cultivators would struggle at this stage for a long time, especially those who practice top-tier secret manuals of predecessors.
Because it is not completely compatible with one’s own path, many conflicts will arise here that need to be resolved one by one.
But for Jack Clark, who created his own secret manual and perfectly fit the True Martial Arts Phantom, these aren’t problems.
However, he stopped here because there were still unresolved issues.
Wooosh!
As Heavenly Energy surged, the three-faced six-armed giant standing behind Jack began to shrink, vanishing into a state of nothingness in an instant, disappearing inside his body.
Then, Jack took out a Mysterious Yellow Stone from the Sumeru Bracelet.
Jack’s original plan was to slowly perfect the four external world constructions after his breakthrough to the Eight Layer.
But on the Road of Heavenly Kings, after comprehending a complete small world’s origin, he already understood what ‘world’ meant, hence he prepared to finish it in advance.
At that time, uniting with True Martial, under the Heaven-human Interlink, the four illusory spaces would gain the ‘world’ characteristic.
Of course, at that time they would just be illusory mini-worlds, the initial buff won’t be too exaggerated, and like cultivation, it will need continuous improvement and expansion to enhance the world’s strength.
“Consume 1000 points of attribute to enter the Enlightening State.”
As Jack’s will echoed in his mind, an instant 1000 points of attribute vanished, igniting and transforming into a mysterious understanding state that enveloped him.
Under the influence of this state of enlightenment, Jack’s thinking and comprehension ability skyrocketed by dozens of times, and suddenly he became an enlightenment genius as flashes of insight flickered continuously.
Boom!
Jack’s consciousness entered the Mysterious Yellow Stone, and instantly, an unending compressive force struck from all directions as if he were being suppressed under ten thousand meters of earth.
What is earth? Earth is the mountains, it is the dirt, it is the rock, and at the same time, it is the bearing of everything—bearing the weight of all things…
Under the state of enlightenment, combined with his True Martial foundation, Jack’s progress in comprehending the Earth Divine Charm of the Mysterious Yellow Stone was swift.
However, the charmed version of the Earth Law inscribed on this Mysterious Yellow Stone wasn’t complete; otherwise… well, there is no otherwise.
If it truly contained a complete Earth Law, then even Mathilda Ward could not freely give it away because it is a divine object that could create a king-level being.
This kind of divine object is also rare in the mythical world, comparable to the innate runes on the brow of the Silver Giant Dragon.
After about four hours, Jack slowly withdrew his consciousness from the Mysterious Yellow Stone, with a faint yellow Earth Illusion emerging in his eyes.
“The profound heaviness of earth, huh.”
After a brief silence, Jack put down the Mysterious Yellow Stone, and took out a Black Wind Crystal from the Sumeru Bracelet, creating a stifling sensation in the entire Cultivation Room.
Compared to the understated charm of the Mysterious Yellow Stone, the charm of the Black Wind Crystal was manifest externally.
When it was not collected by Jack earlier, it was always inducing a black wind that eroded a relic.
Boom! Jack’s consciousness entered the Black Wind Crystal, and a burst of wild, sharp storm assailed him…
In the Blue Star World, wind is a natural phenomenon caused by the horizontal movement of air resulting from the collision of expanding surface air rising and the cold high altitude air descending.
But in the Transcendent Era, wind is an external manifestation of some force of Heaven and Earth.
As time passed, strands of tangible Black Wind appeared around Jack, revolving around him as the center, gradually forming a black tornado.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In the sealed environment, the black tornado stirred the air in the Cultivation Room, creating thunderous vibrations and tearing fine cracks in the ground.
Nevertheless, the surrounding Cultivation Room was fortified with basic runes for solidity and soundproofing, so these vibrating phenomena were blocked off.
After a few hours, suddenly, Jack opened his eyes, and a terrifying, heavy pressure erupted from him.
Boom!
Under the dreadful pressure, the surrounding air instantly exploded, forming a white semi-circular shockwave that scattered the encircling black wind tornado.
At the same time, as the Attribute points were completely burned out, the Epiphanic Intent Realm around Jack gradually dissipated.
Looking at the Black Wind Crystal in his hand, Jack murmured, “1000 points of attribute, saving a month’s time, that should probably not be considered a loss.”
If it weren’t for the points, Jack estimated it would take him a month to comprehend both the Mysterious Yellow Stone and the Black Wind Crystal; now he had leapfrogged over this period.
After a short rest, Jack once again consumed 1000 points of attribute to enter the state of enlightenment.
Having comprehended the rune charms of two laws, what came next was to condense runes on the halo behind the Combat Shadow, completing the preliminary World Construction.
This was simple for Jack.
In the depths of the Sea of Consciousness, the Combat Shadow holding a halberd stood tall with the Halo Rotation behind its brain. As Jack’s spirit concentrated, strands of yellow rune sequence chains appeared on the outermost halo.
When the halo was completely taken over by yellow runes, and the last sequence chain connection was completed, the halo vibrated intensely, and a dense aura emanated from the halo.
Next was the wind-related halo.
Under Jack’s vast, uncalculating Spiritual Will, black runes forming sequence chains appeared and started to coat the surface.
When the rune sequence chains of the wind system were also fully formed, the four major halos behind the Combat Shadow thundered vibrantly, emitting a faintly harmonious and stable aura.
“Finally finished.”
Jack opened his eyes and a touch of reflections appeared in his gaze.
From the moment of condensing the True Martial Arts Phantom, his Combat Divine Body, which integrated a part of the Genetic Martial Arts and the external construction concepts of Mecha, had always been in an incomplete state.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 322 True Martial Union, I Alone Am Supreme Above and Below Heaven_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Chapter 322 True Martial Union, I Alone Am Supreme Above and Below Heaven_2
“`
Only now had he finally completed the rune construction of the Four Great External Constructed Worlds.
…But since his breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, it seemed like only about a month had passed.
Not bad, one Layer Heaven per month.
Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction, then reached out and took off the earth gear from the outermost part of his battle armor at the back of his head, while at the same time picking up the Mysterious Yellow Stone, comparable to God-level Resources.
“Consume Attribute points, strengthen the earth gear.”
The Combat Shadow’s four rings of light condensed the Four Major Attributes, inscribing Basic Space Rune, with the gear solidified by the dragon horns of the Eighth Level Beast as the carrier.
The final step was to enhance the gear to God-level, allowing it to integrate with the corresponding halo in its true attribute state and become an Illusory World.
It was complicated, and extremely difficult.
This was also why few cultivators had dealt with ‘worlds’ before reaching king-level; even Simon’s side used external construction modules as batteries as a substitute.
As Jack thought in his mind, the page displayed a drop from 23130 Points Attribute to 22630 in an instant, followed by a spread of pure white light from the palm of his hand.
Under the white light, the Mysterious Yellow Stone quickly dissolved into a transparent liquid state, covering the earth gear, which was then set ablaze with white flames.
Under the strengthening flames, many yellow Rune Sequence Chains appeared on the surface of the earth gear, which was the Earth Divine Charm, and gradually turned into a semi-transparent energy state.
Boom! Behind Jack, a thirty-meter-tall Combat Shadow appeared once again, slowly bent down, and stretched out its huge hands to grasp the now semi-transparent yellow gear.
Hum!
As the Combat Shadow’s large hands pretended to clasp, the earth gear kept expanding, turning into several meters in size in the blink of an eye and was slowly placed behind the Shadow’s head.
Boom!
As the earth light wheel slowly overlapped and fused with the earth gear, the entire Cultivation Room shook slightly, and inexplicably became heavier.
At that moment, the Earth World was fully formed, turning into a huge light wheel rotating slowly behind the Combat Shadow, giving the sense of a real presence.
After the earth came the fire wheel, consuming five hundred attribute points to strengthen and fuse the golden-red Crystal Corner, smelted from the single horn of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, with the light ring at last.
In an instant, the Cultivation Room became hot and dry, with the surrounding temperature rapidly climbing to hundreds of degrees Celsius, the air turned fiery and dry.
After fire came wind, integrating the Black Wind Crystal, and lastly thunder, integrating the blue-black Crystal of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon…
Boom! With the fusion of the four light wheels, the light behind the Combat Shadow suddenly intensified.
Amid the halos of yellow, gold, black, and blue light behind its head, it looked like an ancient True God from myth and legend, more divine and majestic.
“Finally, it’s perfected,” Jack spoke, his eyes showing anticipation as he slowly closed them, and the Combat Shadow standing behind him dove towards him in an instant.
Boom!
Just as the Combat Shadow merged with Jack, every cell in his body exploded violently, and an indescribable vast life force erupted from deep within him.
……
At the Forward Base, tens of kilometers away from Base No.1.
But to call this place a base is somewhat of a misnomer; it’s better described as a small city sprawling against the mountains.
Besides the airport on the edge of the base, other areas are divided into living areas, Cultivation Areas, Closed Areas, and convalescence zones, inhabited by many cultivators.
Some of these people are soldiers from the military department who have stepped down from the frontline, and others are High-level cultivators who have suffered injuries to their foundation and need to retreat to the rear for recovery.
The Closed Area where Jack’s group of geniuses was located is surrounded by mountains, made of gray-black boulders, resembling a row of uniform gray cottages, solid and strong.
At the time when Jack commenced his breakthrough, twelve days had passed since the end of the relics.
During this time, the geniuses from Eastern Summer started to come out one after another, digesting the gains from the relics, and each of them had made significant progress.
Several hundred meters away from the Closed Area in the yard of a detached small building, Howard Lambert was sitting under a tree, cultivating, with a wild aura of Killing Intent emanating from him.
“Hahaha… Howard, what do I look like now?” At this moment, Justin Welan appeared on the nearby path, seeming very happy.
After being in retreat for around ten days, with the help of Inheritance and some resources, Justin had broken through to the mid-period of the Fifth Layer Heaven, emanating an aura as heavy as a mountain.
Howard, who was sitting with his legs crossed, opened his eyes, glanced at Justin, and suddenly said, “You look like a turtle.”
“Hey, what turtle, it’s the Suppression Mountain Mysterious Martial.” Justin instantly became a bit annoyed.
“The Mountain Suppressing God Seal I’m cultivating has merged with the Mysterious Martial Thick Earth True Ability, and my Cultivation Methods have transformed into Suppression Mountain Mysterious Martial, making my strength and Defense even stronger.”
Talking about this, Justin sounded somewhat proud: “What about you, Howard? I heard you came out a day earlier than me, so you must have completed your cultivation method conversion, right?”
Howard Lambert replied indifferently, “Correct, I have completed the conversion of the Heavenly Evil Demon Manual.”
“By the way, My realm has already broken through to the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven. I just need one opportunity to break through to the Sixth Layer and form the Devil’s Battle Body, completing the third transformation of my physique.”
Suddenly, Justin’s face stiffened, as Howard had surpassed him by two minor realms.
Boom! Far away, a Closed-door cultivation room shook, followed by a terrifying aura that soared into the sky, causing the Heavenly Energy within a five-kilometer radius to erupt violently.
“This aura! Someone is breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven!”
Howard and Justin turned their heads in shock towards the distance, both wearing expressions of astonishment.
Above a Closed-door cultivation room far away, a white vortex formed by the convergence of Heaven and Earth Energy appeared, covering hundreds of meters in its vast majesty.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 322 True Martial Union, I Alone Am Supreme Above and Below Heaven_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Chapter 322 True Martial Union, I Alone Am Supreme Above and Below Heaven_3
At this moment, it wasn’t just Howard Lambert and the other person—many in the Frontline Small Town were alerted and instinctively looked towards the Closed Area.
Then, in just a few breaths, hundreds of figures appeared from all directions, some standing on branches, others on rooftops, gazing at the huge vortex in the distance.
These people included young men in their twenties as well as middle-aged men in their thirties and forties with a calm aura, each emitting an invisible aura of iron and killing intent.
A middle-aged man with a scar on his cheek said in a deep voice, “I remember that direction is where those newborn geniuses from the relic are in closed-door cultivation, right?”
A young man below nodded, “Yes, all these freshmen are there digesting in closed-door cultivation. Larry Throne had previously instructed us to watch over the surroundings.”
Immediately, many nearby showed expressions of amazement, “Incredible, breaking through to the Eighth Layer Heaven before graduation, they’re truly monsters.”
“Yeah, it’s been nearly ten years since I graduated, and I’m only at mid-stage of the Seventh Layer, then I got my vital energy wounded by that damned Purgatory Demon Race.”
“One and a half years ago, that kid named Joshua Welan graduated at Seventh Layer Heaven, and at that time, we were already astounded. But this generation’s freshmen are even more exaggerated.”
“Haha… Heaven blesses our Human Race, the new generation is stronger than the last.”
While those retired ‘elders’ from the frontline were shocked and in awe, Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis, and Betty Leinster who had emerged from closed-door cultivation two days ago also appeared in a flash.
Looking at the far distance where the raging wind howled and the clouds formed by Heavenly Energy were gathering above the closed-door cultivation room, Crystal Lewis was also somewhat shocked, “Who is breaking through to the Eighth Layer!”
Justin Welan stroked his chin, “Among the students here, only Jack, Eddy Keller, and Damon Lopes are above Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“But Jack had just broken through to the mid-stage of Seventh Layer Heaven, and it’s only been ten days; it can’t be him. And Damon Lopes’s aura seemed to be just close to the mid-stage of Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“So clearly, the one breaking through is Eddy Keller.”
“A third-grade student reaching Eighth Layer Heaven, this guy truly lives up to his reputation as a monster with talent said to surpass even the Innate Awakened Ones.” The people looked on with amazement in their eyes.
However, Eddy Keller was a monster who had traversed the King’s Road, and with other gains for sure in the relic, it wasn’t unacceptable for someone to reach the Eighth Layer Heaven in the third grade.
At that moment, Jane Aiken also appeared in a flash, standing on a tree about a dozen meters tall nearby, with sharp Sword Intent swirling around her.
Just then, amidst the distant white clouds, a hundred-meter-long white Divine Dragon Shadow emerged, moving vividly through the clouds and spiraling, emitting high-pitched dragon roars.
Along with the dragon’s roaring cries, an Invisible Power between heaven and earth was drawn out, turning into golden specks that slowly fell down, absorbed by that Divine Dragon Shadow.
“Indeed, it’s Eddy Keller.”
Upon seeing that Divine Dragon Shadow, everyone was already certain that the person breaking through was Eddy Keller.
Boom!
The thick roof of the closed-door cultivation room burst open, and amid the billowing smoke and dust, a white Divine Dragon dozens of meters long soared into the sky, entering the clouds to merge with the Divine Dragon Shadow.
Just as the white Divine Dragon that Eddy Keller had transformed into merged with the Heavenly Dragon shadow, thunder burst on a clear day, and Blue Thunderbolts fell from the sky, pounding on the body of the Divine Dragon.
The serpentine lightning exploded, causing the Divine Dragon Shadow to continuously tremble, and with the blue electric arcs wrapping around him, Eddy Keller’s aura didn’t diminish but instead swelled wildly, soaring even more.
Suddenly, the middle-aged man with the scar exclaimed, “The Divine Dragon takes shape, transcends tribulation to ascend, and breaking through has triggered an absorption of Heavenly Energy within a five-kilometer radius; this child, once he breaks through, will at least be as powerful as a mid-stage Eighth Layer Expert.”
Another middle-aged man with a weak aura said with envy, “When I broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven five years ago, I only triggered a one-kilometer radius of Heavenly Energy, not to mention a wonder between heaven and earth.”
After reaching high-order, each step represents a new layer of heaven, and the range of Heavenly Energy influenced during a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven is another means to measure potential and talent.
Especially in circumstances where such celestial phenomena manifest, it signifies that some aspect of the individual’s talent has reached its peak, earning a resonance with Heaven and Earth, which blesses them with additional support upon their breakthrough.
Amidst the shocked and envious gazes of the onlookers, the dragon within the clouds swiftly merged with the divine dragon apparition, its form expanding to over seventy meters, its aura growing even more terrifying.
Roar!
The roar shook the heavens as the seventy-meter-long white Divine Dragon descended from the sky, and when it landed on the shattered roof of the Closed-door Cultivation Room, the radiance faded to reveal Eddy Keller’s figure.
At that moment, he was still dressed in his white Daoist robe, surrounded by the imposing aura of an Eighth Layer Expert, his eyes cold and indifferent, exuding a sense of divine majesty.
While Eddy Keller stood with his hands behind his back, his expression indifferent, inside he was laughing heartily, relishing the shock, amazement, and envy in the eyes of those around him.
Boom boom boom!!
The sky roared with a raging wind, as clouds gathered rapidly, forming a bank of dark clouds that spanned several kilometers, with bolts of purple lightning thundering within.
Boom!
Just a few hundred meters away, another Closed-door Cultivation Room’s roof exploded. An instant later, a figure wreathed in lightning shot into the sky, like a thunderbolt piercing the dark clouds.
In an instant, the dark clouds churned wildly as endless bolts of lightning coalesced into an imposing fifty-meter-tall purple figure, entirely formed of Heavenly Thunder.
In front of this dazzling Thunder Prison True Body, Damon Lopes, dressed in his Daoist robe, pointed a finger to the heavens and another to the earth, his arms entwined with purple and golden lightning.
Then, the Thunder Prison True Body behind Damon Lopes began to speak slowly, and immediately, its resonant, booming voice echoed between heaven and earth: “Above and below the heavens, I alone am honored.”
Instantly, everyone below revealed expressions of disbelief, including Howard Lambert and Justin Welan.
Justin Welan felt somewhat envious, “Although this guy hasn’t broken through to the Eight Layer, his display, his aura, are even more impressive than Eddy Keller’s.”
At that time, Damon Lopes’s strength was only at the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, but after integrating the Second Original Thunder, the power he emanated was no less than that of an Eighth Layer Heaven.
It could be said that this expedition to the relic had made these genius strong men even stronger.
“Damn, this guy is even more pretentious than me,” Eddy Keller looked up, somewhat annoyed at the sight of Damon Lopes above.
Meanwhile, the expressionless Damon Lopes in the sky showed a hint of triumph in his eyes.
Originally, while integrating the Second Original Thunder, he had planned to continue solidifying his power for another two days, but sensing Eddy Keller’s breakthrough, he chose to emerge from his Closed-door Cultivation.
Eddy Keller had forced a show of strength in front of him several times in the past, but at that time, due to the consolidation of the Innate Thunderbolt, he couldn’t do anything about it.
Finally, he had his sweet revenge.
Just as Damon Lopes was feeling content and the crowd below thought the events of the day were coming to an end,
Boom!
In the distance, at the edge, from a Cultivation Room a more terrifying aura burst forth, causing the Heavenly Energy within a radius of several kilometers to go into a frenzy.
At the same moment, a shadow of a world shrouded in Yellow Earth emerged in the sky, causing an even larger area of Heavenly Energy to erupt and gather…

chapters.title: Chapter 724: 323: Rune God Seed, The Terrifying Jack Clark (Seeking Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: Chapter 323: Rune God Seed, The Terrifying Jack Clark (Seeking Monthly Ticket)
After reaching high-order levels, every breakthrough of a heaven layer would trigger a heaven-human interlink.
The so-called heaven and earth resonance is a kind of ‘creation’; at the seventh layer, heaven and earth bestow the true martial arts phantom with ‘reality’, while the eighth layer grants the body ‘vitality reshaping’.
And the first breakthrough at the Seventh Layer Heaven is of utmost importance, for there can’t be a continuation without a beginning.
At this moment, under the influence of heaven and earth resonance, the vitality deep within Jack Clark’s body was fully stimulated. Influenced by the merging true martial arts phantom, his flesh and blood began to be remodeled and underwent transformation.
This rebirth through flesh and blood transformation is to re-align the human body, originally incompatible with Heavenly Energy, back to an innate state, so that eventually every breath resonates with this energy.
In addition, the four great external constructed worlds slowly rotating behind Jack Clark’s head were also transforming into real worlds under this ‘creation’.
The four great constructed worlds are based on innate space runes, with four major attribute runes bestowing properties, and half-energy material of god-level as the carrier.
Even so, they still belonged to fantasy, merely a special energy space.
And it is only by taking advantage of this opportunity that they could truly acquire the characteristics of ‘worlds’.
This was also the reason why Jack Clark delayed his breakthrough by a day. Normally, this step would have been taken only at the breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens, but the opportunity from the Road of Heavenly Kings allowed him to advance sooner.
“The Eight Layer Heaven, someone is making a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer again!”
In the outer world, everyone looked toward the direction where the aura of breakthrough was coming from, as well as towards the slowly descending Earth World Illusion that covered tens of kilometers in the sky.
“Don’t tell me the one breaking through is Jack,” Justin Welan said with his mouth wide open, looking incredulously in the distance.
Although he had grown used to being shocked by Jack Clark time and time again, the idea of advancing from the mid-stage of the seventh realm to breaking through the eighth in just over ten days still made Justin feel hesitant.
Standing on a tree, Jane Aiken spoke lightly, “Among those here in closed-door cultivation, only three have cultivation realms above seven. With Eddy Keller making his breakthrough and Damon Lopes just leaving seclusion, who else but him could it be?”
Mandy Lewis marveled, “Indeed, he deserves to be someone who has reached the end of the Road of Heavenly Kings; he has broken through to the Eighth Layer so quickly.”
After the Nether Heavenly King altered their memories, everyone remembered Jack Clark as someone who had almost completed the Road of Heavenly Kings, not someone who had reached the end of the Road to Becoming a God.
Crystal Lewis wryly smiled, “It feels like ever since this guy came back from Koroya, breaking through realms has been as simple as drinking water.”
“This guy, he’s become even stronger,” Howard Lambert said with a heavy look.
While those old classmates below were all shocked by Jack Clark’s breakthrough to the Eighth-level Heaven, Damon Lopes, who was trying to show off in the sky, suddenly widened his eyes.
Staring at the slowly descending Yellow Earth World Illusion, Damon Lopes’ mouth fell open, “Don’t tell me that’s a world, that guy established a world inside his body at the Seventh Layer Heaven!?”
Thinking about this, Damon Lopes felt a bit annoyed, subconsciously retracting the Thunder Prison True Body behind him.
In front of Jack Clark’s Earth World projection, which covered a range of tens of kilometers, his Double Innate Thunderbolt True Body suddenly seemed quite ordinary.
Indeed, I can’t put on airs whenever this guy is around. No, I must keep my distance from him when entering the mythical world next; otherwise, he’ll steal all the limelight.
Thinking this, Damon Lopes turned into a streak of lightning that fell from the sky landing not far from Justin Welan and the others.
Meanwhile, Eddy Keller, standing atop a cultivation room’s walls that were dozens of meters tall and with a destroyed roof, also twitched the corner of his mouth and instinctively let his hands fall from behind his back.
Damn it, that monster actually managed to break through to the Eighth Layer Heaven so quickly and even created a miniature world inside his body; what is left for the rest of us?
Scary Middle-aged Man looked shocked, “That person breaking through over there is also one of those freshmen, right?”
A middle-aged man standing on the side of the roof wryly nodded, “It should be. I remember that closed area was all allocated to those freshmen.”
A thirty-something-year-old young man, in the late stage of the Sixth Heavenly Stage, said with excitement on his face, “Has our Human Race become this powerful? To have two geniuses in a row who break through to the Eighth Layer Heaven even before graduation.”
Scary Middle-aged Man spoke gravely, “This breakthrough genius is even more exaggerated, have you not felt it? The range of the Heavenly Energy he attracted during his breakthrough reached tens of kilometers.”
Hiss! Tens of kilometers range.
As everyone was shocked by the phenomenon in the sky, suddenly an endless sea of golden flames appeared above the Earth World, transforming into a Flame World Illusion.
Boom! With the appearance of the second world, the Heavenly Energy within an area of twenty kilometers was stirred, converging and causing a raging wind.
Such a terrifying display shocked everyone to the core.
“What Cultivation Methods is he practicing, to have, to have created two world embryos in the Seventh Layer Heaven, no, there’s more…”
Boom!
Black Wind converged above the Flame World Illusion, forming another world illusion filled with black tornadoes. Instantly, a twenty-five kilometers range of Heavenly Energy went into an uproar.
This terrifying show of might alerted the high-ranking powerhouses defending Base No.1. They appeared, one after another, on the turrets that stood dozens of meters tall and the defensive buildings a hundred meters in height.
“What’s going on over there?”
“From the aura, it seems like someone is breaking through to the Eighth Layer Heaven.”
“A breakthrough to the Eighth Layer Heaven? You’re telling me that’s the might of a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer Heaven? Triplex world projection, Heavenly Energy aroused over tens of kilometers range, even the typical Nine Layers breakthrough isn’t that exaggerated.”
Woosh!
Space distorted in the sky, and Marcellus Larry appeared instantly, his profound gaze directed towards the distance, a look of surprise in his eyes.
“Starting to congeal world embryos upon breaking through to the Eighth Layer, not afraid that the Heavenly Energy drawn during the breakthrough won’t be enough to remodel the body, to congeal worlds?”

chapters.title: Chapter 725: 323: Rune God Seed, The Terrifying Jack Clark (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Chapter 323: Rune God Seed, The Terrifying Jack Clark (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_2
Just like when Jack Clark broke through to the Seventh Layer Heaven and Valentine Leach worried Jack Clark’s True Martial arts phantom was too strong for his spirit and Qi Blood to refine enough Power of Heaven and Earth,
one needs the resonance of Heaven and Earth to let the illusory energy space gain world features. Apart from the wonders bestowed by Heaven and Earth, one must absorb a massive amount of Heavenly Energy all at once.
A single illusory world already requires a massive amount of energy, not to mention that Jack Clark now displays the third world projection.
Moreover, all of the Heavenly Energy gathering has been absorbed by the world. What does he have left to ignite the True Martial arts phantom and initiate physical reconstruction?
Just as the triplex world projections overlapped above and below, leaving everyone utterly shocked, blue-black Thunder boomed above the Black Wind World, and a world filled with endless Thunder emerged.
Bang!
With the appearance of the Fourth Layer World, the Heavenly Energy within a thirty-plus kilometer radius became turbulent, and an endless surge was devoured by the four illusory worlds.
Because the gathering energy was so rich, it formed a foggy ring. From afar, it looked like Four Layer Heavens had emerged among the clouds with the Earth solid and vast, flames burning, black winds howling, and Thunder clapping.
“Four worlds? He is actually projecting a Four-fold world? Has he gone mad?” a Seven Layer Heaven strong man exclaimed in shock, his aura somewhat weak.
Jane Aiken also had a serious expression, “The four halos behind his True Martial arts phantom are actually Four Layer Worlds. What a grand display.”
Even Jane Aiken was somewhat shocked at that moment.
Compared to the Sword Art Secret she was preparing to create next, and the Eighth Layer Consolidation of the Sword World she was getting ready for, Jack Clark’s Four Layer Worlds were more terrifying and of a much higher difficulty.
At that time, hundreds of meters above the Fourth Layer Heaven, a three-faced six-armed phantom slowly stood up.
The Combat Shadow stood tall in the high altitude, with four halos behind its head rotating, surrounded by the Sea of Blood and Hell, holding a War Halberd, resembling an ancient War God descending through spacetime.
“Another vision?!” At that moment, everyone was numb.
A mere breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven, the Eight Layer Heaven—such terrifying visions indicated the profound intrinsic strength of the person breaking through, so much so that they could potentially reverse slaughtering their way to the Ninth Heavens!!
Marcellus Larry spoke with a grave tone, “The rudimentary Four Layer World, Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder. He plans to merge the four worlds during his king-level breakthrough, Opening Heaven and Earth, and grasp a Supreme Law!”
Opening Heaven and Earth is a special cultivation path that involves practicing a blank ‘world’ Secret Book after the Seventh Layer Heaven, and during the Eighth and Ninth Layers, one continues to stack and practice more illusory worlds.
Upon reaching the peak of the Ninth Heavens, when breaking through to king-level, several major worlds merge, Opening Heaven and Earth, and grasping a Supreme Law.
The combinations of worlds for this Opening Heaven and Earth can vary, like sequences of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Earth, Water, Wind, Fire, Earth, Fire, Wind, Thunder, Earth, Water, Wind, Thunder, etc.
Each newly birthed world will differ after opening, and the acquired Opening Heaven Law also differs, such as the Sky-shattering Divine Thunder, the Scarlet Heaven World-ending Flame, Void Annihilation, etc.
Of course, all these opened worlds are single Planes, filled with wild destructive energy, and are not complete vast worlds that can cultivate life.
But for cultivators, it doesn’t matter; they have no interest in being creators. The purpose of opening Planes is just to command a Supreme Law.
Such Opening Heaven Laws greatly surpass ordinary laws, allowing one to crush others of the same level upon reaching king-level.
It sounds powerful, but this path is incredibly difficult because of the early-stage weakness from practicing the blank Secret Book after the Seventh Layer, resulting in the weakest combat capabilities among peers.
Moreover, this weakness persists all the way to the Nine Layers until the rudimentary illusory worlds within become stronger and begin to materialize, after which things start to improve.
Besides, the resources and energy consumed are massive, often tens or hundreds of times more than cultivators of the same level.
And even if you can endure the early-stage weakness and have enough massive resources, you also need astonishing talent to slowly comprehend and perfect worlds, step by step.
Over the years, only one strong man from the Human Race has broken through to king-level with the power of Opening Heaven and eventually became a Heavenly King—highlighting the difficulty of this path.
Opportunity, great ambition, unwavering will, and talent are all indispensable.
Therefore, at this moment, even Marcellus Larry was startled by Jack Clark’s boldness and talent.
Ruling power over a Major Realm after the Seventh Layer Heaven, creating a Top-tier Secret Manual within a month, comprehending the rudimentary forms of the four major worlds.
And that cultivation speed of breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven in less than a year, and a spiritual foundation more than twenty times stronger.
This kind of talent can no longer be described as a monster or an Unparalleled Genius; it’s as if the luck of the entire Human Race of this generation has converged on him.
If before Marcellus Larry only felt that Jack Clark had no problem becoming a Heavenly King and had hope for becoming the Supreme, now he was one hundred percent certain that this child could step onto the Supreme path.
He even had the hope to take that step and become a Civilization Emperor.
“No, two life-saving trump cards are not enough. It should be at least three or more.” Marcellus Larry took a deep look at the vision in the distant sky and with a flash, appeared in the Core Area of the Base several hundred meters underground.
Passing through several security doors, Marcellus Larry entered a spacious room where a dark golden crystal the size of a human head was slowly rotating at the center.
Marcellus Larry spoke solemnly, “Roger, help me contact the First Councilor, I need to speak with him urgently, the priority level is the first sequence.”
“Authorization confirmed.”
“You have three opportunities to initiate requests at the first sequence level, your request has been approved.”
Along with the cold electronic voice, a virtual image of a red-haired girl materialized, bowing slightly to Marcellus Larry, “Monarch Marcellus, please wait a moment. Roger will immediately contact the First Councilor for you.”
Hum!

chapters.title: Chapter 726: 323: Rune God Seed, The Terrifying Jack Clark (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Chapter 323: Rune God Seed, The Terrifying Jack Clark (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_3
The distant dark golden crystal trembled slowly, and a terrifying power within was activated. In an instant, the entire room’s space solidified, and time stopped.
Under the power of the rules, a vague figure appeared from afar, as if crossing the limitless spacetime to arrive here.
That figure gradually became clear, and soon the image of a middle-aged man with half white, half black hair appeared. His profound gaze pierced through spacetime, focusing on Marcellus Larry with a gentle voice.
“Mr. Whitlock, what important matter has happened on your end that requires the consumption of the power of the rules to contact me?”
Marcellus Larry’s face showed a wry smile, “Mr. Garcetti, this time I’m contacting you because of Jack Clark.”
The middle-aged man looked somewhat surprised, “Jack Clark, the youngster who received the inheritance of the Monarch ‘Henry’, what about him?”
“He just broke through to the Eighth Layer Heaven.”
The middle-aged man nodded, “Not bad, he enrolled last September, and in less than a year he’s reached the Eighth Layer Heaven, and there are still two months left. Perhaps this youngster might also reach the Ninth Heavens within a year.”
“We have already held a meeting regarding this youngster’s matter. Now that you have suddenly contacted me, is there a problem with his breakthrough this time?”
Marcellus Larry nodded and exclaimed in astonishment, “Yes, when he broke through to the Eighth Layer Heaven, he consequently condensed the Fourfold Illusionary World, including the Four Major Attributes of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder.”
“Opening the Heavens and Earth, Supreme Law.” The man on the other side paused for a moment.
“Indeed, Supreme Law. This child’s talent is even more exaggerated than we estimated. I even feel that in a few decades, he may have hope to take that step.”
The middle-aged man nodded slowly, “I understand what you mean. In that case, just crafting two forbidden weapons containing the power of the rules is not enough.”
“Have him wait at Base No.1 after his breakthrough, I need to make a trip out.”
“Also, when he enters the mythical world, have him go to the Expedition Division. As for the frontline battlefield, let him come after he reaches the Ninth Heavens, but I estimate it shouldn’t take too long.”
Originally, their intention was to respect Jack Clark’s choice, merely offering advice. But now, they were preparing to send him straight to the Expedition Division first.
They wanted him to hone his skills there and adapt to the mythical world, meanwhile consolidating his gains in the relics to break through to the Ninth Heavens.
Given Jack Clark’s talent, by that time, he might even be able to wrestle with king-level figures, enhancing his safety.
On the frontline battlefield of the Human Race, high-end strong men confront each other, and king-level combatants restrain any demon kings that appear. Those who go too deep may even be surrounded and killed.
With his same-level domination, Jack Clark would be powerful enough to roam the battlefield freely.
…
In the sky, as the Fourfold World and Battle Demon Illusion became clearer, the roof of the Cultivation Room below exploded thunderously, a dazzling light piercing the heavens.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Accompanied by Jack Clark piercing into the clouds, both the Fourfold World illusion and the Battle Demon Illusion crumbled, converging into an endless stream of the Power of Heaven and Earth surging into his body.
Boom!
In an instant, a power that shattered the heavens and exceeded the Eighth Layer Heaven burst out, obliterating everything around it and forming a series of white ring-shaped shockwaves that surged in all directions.
“How strong!”
Witnessing the figure standing quietly thousands of meters high in the sky, everyone’s faces revealed gravity and shock, especially Justin Welan, who was extremely excited.
“Damn, damn, Jack is freaking awesome now, hahaha….”
As Justin Welan danced with excitement, Crystal Lewis was somewhat speechless. It’s not like you’re the one who broke through to the Eighth Layer Heaven; why are you so excited?
But that guy, Jack Clark, is really terrifying.
Standing thousands of meters high, Jack Clark’s face was covered with dark golden dragon scales, and the black-gold double pupils in his eyes were cold and majestic, like a humanoid Demon Dragon.
Barely containing the ‘Destroy Heaven and Earth’ terrifying power within him, Jack Clark exhaled softly, and the scales on his face and the black-gold double pupils slowly disappeared.
Then, with a thought, a transparent page that only he could see emerged before his eyes.
Realm: Eighth Layer Heaven [Early Stage]
Physique: 8880
Strength: 8943
Agility: 7835
Spirit: 7901
Talent: Soul Split+ [Top-tier] Void Double Pupils+ [Top-tier, Void Law with Sixteen-fold Amplification]
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Second Layer]Combat Divine Body – Halberd – Fourth Layer Heaven [eighth layer, life reshaping 10%, True Dragon Battle Body, thirty-fold power amplification of Heaven and Earth.
Core Rune – Strength: Formed by the top-tier talent core rune, reshaping the physical body to give birth to the strength god seed, acquiring twenty-fold strength boost.
Core Rune – Defense: Acquiring a twenty-fold defense boost.
Core Rune – Swift: Acquiring a ten-fold agility boost.
Core Rune – True Thunder: Mastering the True Thunder of Heaven and Earth.
Core Rune – Heavenly Flame: Mastering the blaze that scorches the heavens.
Divine Might Entwining: Originating from a special talent of the mythical Dragon Elephant, fused multiple times with the True Dragon Battle Body, your normal battle strength is at its peak.
Combat Divine Body: Consuming True Strength to enter the Three-faced Six-armed form, gaining a hundred-fold increase in strength, defense, agility, True Thunder, and Golden Flame. Under the augmentation of the Fourth Layer Heaven, the power of Heaven and Earth is amplified to fifty times.
Combat Divine Body – Dragon: Consuming Essence Blood to enter the Combat Divine Body – Dragon form, merging all the major talent powers to have the ultimate destructive power.
Note: Consuming Essence Blood will slow down the progress of physical reshaping, please use with caution.
Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder: A newly born fledgling world, when manifested, will gain strengthened Earth defense, speed, Thunder, and Heavenly Flame attributes.
Note: When the Four-fold Plane World matures and is completed, it will gain the amplification of the World’s Power and the Power of Law, the stronger the world, the stronger the amplification.]
Rune: Doomsday Purgatory [Complete]Hidden Deity [Complete]Cut through the Void [Incomplete]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Technique+ [Minor Accomplishment]
Realm of Thought: Prison Blood War Intent [Grand Accomplishment]
Attribute Points: 21130
Equipment: …
This breakthrough had given Jack Clark somewhat a surprise while being within reasonable expectations, given that he had prepared far too much for the Eighth Layer Heaven.
Whether it was the five top-tier core runes from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, or the extensive utilization of the four great external constructed worlds, or the perfectly deduced Combat Shadow.
And the outcome was almost as he had anticipated.
Upon breaking through to the Eighth Layer, his body began reshaping, and the five major talent core runes fused with him completely, birthing the talent god seed and perfectly inheriting the power of his talents.
In his normal state, his strength would receive a twenty-fold increase, as well as a boost to defense by twenty times, holding the thunder and flame powers transformed from his top-tier talents.
Once he enters the Combat Divine Body’s battle mode, these talent god seed powers are fully activated, and the amplification of his strength and other attributes directly reaches a hundred times.
It could be said that Jack Clark, pursuing both physical evolution and True Martial Cultivation, is stronger than a Level 8 Early Stage Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at the Eighth Layer Heaven.
As for the subsequent Combat – Dragon form, it relates to the time when Jack Clark first fused with the Genetic Martial Arts concepts merging Emperor Dragon Essence Blood, the third time his physique underwent a quality transformation.
“Now, I should be considered high-end combat strength, right?” Feeling the terrifying power within him, Jack Clark showed a faint smile on his face, then his figure flashed as he flew towards the ground below.
After reaching the Eighth Layer Heaven and achieving unity with True Martial, capable of resisting gravity and walking in the air, in harmony with the heavens,
however, compared to the Ninth Heavens’ ability to fly and escape through the earth, it still falls short.

chapters.title: Chapter 727: 324: Millions of Contribution Points, Instructions Before Departure (Seeking Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: Chapter 324: Millions of Contribution Points, Instructions Before Departure (Seeking Monthly Pass)
“`
What a peculiar feeling.
As Jack Clark slowly descended from thousands of meters in the sky, he felt like a fish in water, as if he was born to ‘fly’.
This sense of fulfillment is one of the hallmarks of the Eighth Layer Heaven.
It’s the Heavenly Energy that cultivators spirit Qi and Martial Arts converge to bestow a ‘real’ true martial arts phantom during the breakthrough of Seventh Layer Heaven—it’s actually another kind of spirit of Heaven and Earth.
Bestowed by Heaven and Earth, innate in harmony with Heaven and Earth, it can mobilize the energy of Heaven and Earth to multiple or even more than ten times enhance the cultivator’s strength.
In such a case, as the cultivator breaks through to the Eight Layer, their body fuses with the true martial arts phantom, naturally possessing the characteristics of an Innate Spirit.
Watching Jack descending from the sky and landing not far away, Eddy Keller, a tall and resolute man in white, couldn’t help but exclaim, “Junior Clark’s talent… impressive.”
Even Eddy Keller, who faced a First Grade of the Eighth Layer Heaven with a condensed four-layer embryonic world of talent like Jack, felt inferior.
Although each time he showed off, this guy would cut him off, the latter’s talent was something he had only seen once in his lifetime, even more exaggerated than those Descendant of the Kings who were Innate Awakened Ones.
Jack politely said, “Senior Keller, you’re not too shabby yourself. Breaking through to the Eighth Layer before graduation, such a talent a decade ago would be hard to find in the entire Eastern Summer.”
Jack was not overestimating; when he encountered Hannah Gail, a Descendant of the King who had awakened her bloodline powers, she was only in the Late Seventh Sky at the age of twenty.
And this time, during the relic expedition, almost all the young geniuses of the whole Federation were gathered, yet only five or six had broken through the Seventh Layer.
Besides, Gabriella had her breakthrough after entering the relic.
However, Jack felt that next year someone would reach the Ninth Heavens.
The girl who was innately a monster gained the Sword Array Inheritance in the relic and walked the King’s Road; she was also nearing the end of the Road of Heavenly Kings.
With such talent, if it were not for Jack, she would have been the undisputed number one, even slightly surpassing Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One.
Thinking of this, Jack’s gaze shifted to the distance where Jane Aiken, Justin Welan, and others were looking in his direction.
Justin Welan shouted, “Jack, stop giving each other compliments over there.”
Jack just smiled, took a step, and instantly appeared over a hundred meters away, took another step and flashed another hundred meters, reaching the edge of the residential area in the blink of an eye.
With the Rune God Seed, ten times swifter, Jack’s speed became even more astonishing.
Actually, this tenfold is just a conceptual conversion, with the Core Rune condensing into a God Seed, transforming into a power similar to Divine Power.
Just like when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon broke through level eight, the talent that was originally just a muscle Power Explosion condensed into a Rune Sequence Chains.
Now, enveloped in this power, Jack not only could take steps of over a hundred meters but also did not cause any air explosion or rapidly generated shock waves.
The Rune God Seed power and Defense, too, weren’t just simple enhancements but formed an invisible Divine Power constantly blessing him.
Jack had complete control over this innate-like Divine Power, it wasn’t something that would make chopsticks crumble into dust during a meal.
Betty Leinster, standing next to Crystal Lewis, was the first to speak, her face full of smiles, “Junior Clark, congratulations on reaching the Eight Layer Heaven.”
Jack smiled, “This time I’m just a step ahead. Senior sisters like Crystal, your gains aren’t small either, it might not take ‘long’ for you to catch up.”
“Jack, don’t be so modest. Do you think we don’t want to catch up?” Howard Lambert said helplessly.
In just a few months, he had been left behind by three major realms—realms that top-notch geniuses took years, or even decades to cross.
Though he was endowed with Innate Divine Strength, and was considered the second genius at South Sky Martial Height with a chance to surpass Jane Aiken, now he had dropped to third place. Who was he to complain to?
Faced with Howard’s grumble, Jack just smiled.
He couldn’t very well say his talent was peerless and that a breakthrough was hardly worth mentioning, that would be even more disheartening, would it not?
Then Justin came over with a chuckle, “Jack, the faster your cultivation progresses, the better. I feel like by next year I can go around boasting that king-level Jack Clark is my brother.”
“Next year might not work,” Jack said hesitantly, for he felt that he might break through to king-level this year.
