Actually, his original goal before entering the relic was to reach the Nine-fold Peak in a year; becoming a king within a year seemed a bit more challenging because the rule of the Nine-fold Peak was a barrier difficult to overcome.
That chasm had stopped too many monstrous talents and blocked many old strong men in the late period of Nine Layers.
But now, with the resources of the Federation leaning towards him, his foundation in Martial Arts and realm were already sufficient, a one-year king was not impossible.
Unaware of these details, Justin encouraged Jack, “Jack, you can definitely do it. I’m already preparing to show off next year.”
“Alright, I’ll make an effort. Class Leader, classmate Crystal,” Jack said with a smile, greeting Crystal and the others, then turned to Damon Lopes not far away.
“Mr. Lopes, I felt there was a powerful and unfamiliar force within your Thunder earlier; it seems you’ve broken free from your innate limits. Congratulations.”
“It’s alright, it’s okay,” Damon Lopes replied modestly, just wanting to keep a low profile at the moment. He hoped everyone would overlook him as if the phrase ‘I alone am honored between Heaven and Earth’ had never been said.
Before the others could exchange pleasantries, the Scary Middle-aged man appeared with a flash, laughing heartily, “Today, our Human Race has gained two more strong men of the Eight Layer Heaven, joyous and commendable.”
Seeing this, Justin quickly introduced, “Jack, this is the person in charge of the Forward Base, Major General Bland.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 728: 324: Millions of Contribution Points, Instructions Before Departure (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Chapter 324: Millions of Contribution Points, Instructions Before Departure (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2
Uh… you, my friend, always manage to fit in wherever you go.” Jack Clark glanced at Justin Welan, then a smile spread across his face, “I’ve seen General Bland.”
Sheehan Bland laughed heartily, “Student Clark, no need to be so formal. Earlier, when you had your breakthrough, Marcellus Larry sent me a message, inviting you to visit Base No.1. He said that the item you requested is ready.”
“Ready?” Jack’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Clearly, his Life Crystal had arrived.
“Everyone, I’m heading off to Base No.1 for a bit.”
After saying goodbye to everyone, Jack’s figure flashed and he instantly vanished from the spot. As soon as he left the Frontline Small Town, a sonic boom roared.
Compared to the silent and transcendent movement, Jack preferred this overbearing feeling of charging through the air, shattering everything in his path.
Soon, Jack arrived outside Base No.1 and from afar, he could see the huge Silver Vortex rising a kilometer high, sending out invisible ripples.
Within Jack’s slowly emerging golden vertical pupils, intense Spatial Fluctuations filled the area for tens of kilometers around the entire pathway.
In contrast to the seabed pathway controlled by the Base Dragon Giant Beast Empire, the Eastern Summer’s pathway was larger, more stable, and had a greater carrying capacity.
During the days of his Closed-door Cultivation, nothing unusual had happened beneath the sea.
It seemed that the Black Oblivion King, that Mythical Giant Beast, still hadn’t noticed the changes here.
But that was to be expected. These Mythical Giant Beasts once in Hibernation could sleep for several months, half a year, or even a decade at a time. To them, the concept of time was very slow.
And that was the norm.
Because for these beasts, hibernation was cultivation.
As their size increased, the consumption of an Extraordinary Creature like a Giant Beast during its regular activities was also quite exaggerated, requiring a substantial amount of biological energy.
And this energy came from the Heavenly Energy they absorbed.
Therefore, reducing activities could lower daily consumption, effectively enhancing their cultivation growth rate.
As for the hunting and devouring of other Giant Beasts, significant improvements generally came from hunting those of the same rank due to the difference in quality and quantity.
After transcending to level eight as an Extraordinary Creature, with each level raised, the disparity in the body size of the beasts became several to more than a dozen times larger, and the energy contained in their flesh and blood was even more disparate.
Thus, an Eighth Level Beast devouring a Level 7 Colossus wouldn’t see a significant improvement unless it was continuously devouring in large quantities.
As for hunting and Devouring peers, very few beasts did this.
Because no beast could ensure a guaranteed win against the other. Without fighting, no beast would know how strong the other’s talent was, and what if it got killed and devoured in the fight instead?
Therefore, after reaching level nine, the beasts would only fight if there was a visible benefit. Otherwise, even if there was a conflict, it’d usually just involve a show of dominance and then stop it there.
They’d rather spend the time sleeping than fighting, absorbing more Heavenly Energy to increase their strength.
As for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that hunted peers as if they were nothing and dared to attack those a Major Realm higher, such a monster had only appeared once in many years in the sea.
However, after reaching level nine, the growth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had also slowed down.
The immense physique, tens of times stronger than its peers, gave it the power to Suppress beasts of the same rank, and with several Top Tier Talents, it became invincible within its rank.
But due to its overwhelmingly powerful body, every meter of growth consumed a massive amount of energy.
This explained why, after hunting several early-stage Level 9 Beasts and heading to the North Ice Sea Area to devour a large number of Level 7 and 8 beasts, and three Early-stage Level 9 Beasts, it only managed to break through to Mid Level 9.
In such circumstances, there wasn’t enough energy to maintain rapid body growth, let alone accumulating Evolution value.
And as it progressed from Mid Level 9 to the late period and then to Level 9 Peak, its needs became even greater; it felt like it might need to devour a Mythical Giant Beast to achieve that.
For example… the Black Oblivion King.
Musing, Jack passed through several security checks and quickly arrived at the central Office Building of the base.
Indeed, the center of Base No.1 was a hundred-meter-tall Office Building, and Marcellus Larry’s office was on the top of the thirty-third floor.
Strange, why do they all like thirty-three floors?
Intrigued, Jack passed two more Identity Verification processes before taking the elevator up to the top floor, which opened directly into a spacious office.
At that moment, Marcellus Larry was sitting behind a large desk, looking down at a document in his hand.
Marcellus Larry looked up and, upon seeing Jack enter, smiled and said, “Jack, you’ve arrived at the perfect time. Take a look at this, it’s the resource allocation list for your upcoming cultivation.”
As he spoke, Marcellus Larry pushed the document and a Space Bracelet across the table, adding, “Our Human Race has always placed great emphasis on nurturing the new generation, especially those with outstanding talents, who receive even more resource allocation.”
“The reason is simple: only geniuses can turn those resources into strength in a short amount of time and achieve the greatest effect.”
“As for those with average talents, even if they obtained the same resources, they could only absorb them slowly, achieving only two or three tenths of the effect.”
“As the most talented of the new generation, you will not be an exception here. These resources should be enough for your cultivation up to the Nine-layer Late Period.”
Marcellus Larry knew that Jack’s talent was average at first, barely achieving Foundation Establishment after half a month. Therefore, in the beginning, he only practiced low-level Cultivation Methods, and his resources couldn’t compare to those of other geniuses of the same period.
Telling him this now was to prevent any lingering resentment or dissatisfaction in his mind from those days.
Jack also picked up on the implication of his words and replied with a smile, “I understand what you’re saying, king. With the Federation’s limited resources right now, it’s impossible to take care of everyone.”

chapters.title: Chapter 729: 324 Millions of Contribution Points, Instructions Before Departure (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Chapter 324 Millions of Contribution Points, Instructions Before Departure (Seeking Monthly Votes)_3
“`
As he spoke, Jack Clark sat down opposite Marcellus Larry, taking the list of resources politely with both hands before showing a look of astonishment in his eyes.
One hundred Ethereal Crystal Stones to strengthen and expand his Storage Space.
Fifteen Grade 9 Blood Lotus Seeds, each worth two thousand Merit Value points, capable of enhancing the Qi Blood of an eighth Layer Expert and accelerating the transformation of flesh and blood.
Nine portions of Mythical Giant Beast Essence Blood-turned Cast Body God Fluid, each portion valued at two thousand Merit Value points, and twenty Dragon Pattern Blood Crystals, each worth sixteen hundred Merit Value points.
These two god-level resources were to be used after resistance to the effects of the Grade 9 Blood Lotus Seeds appeared.
According to the effects listed in the data sheet, it would take at most two months, or even just over one month if quicker, to let Jack Clark cross the Eighth Layer’s flesh regeneration phase.
In addition, there were the Star Crystal Sand, Void Pure Water, and Spirit Realm Fruit that would enhance the domain powers of his Divine Abilities after his breakthrough to the Nine Layers, their value being more than a dozen times that of eighth Layer resources.
Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but breathe slightly faster upon seeing these resources, as their value had reached several million Contribution Points.
Noticing the slight changes in Jack Clark’s expression, Marcellus Larry said slowly, “These god-level resources can only save you some accumulation time. Once you reach the peak of the eighth Layer, it will be up to you.”
“The same goes for the Nine Heavens. These resources can only help you reach the late Ninth Layer more quickly, but the peak of the Ninth Layer is a hurdle that no one can cross quickly.”
“So if you find yourself stuck at the peak of the eighth Layer or you abruptly stop progressing after swiftly cultivating to the late Ninth Layer, remember to stay humble and patient, maintaining a stable mindset.”
Jack Clark expressed his gratitude, “Thank you for the guidance, Your Majesty. I will certainly bear it in mind.”
He was thankful for these well-intentioned reminders, whether or not they were useful or fitting for him.
At this moment, Marcellus Larry continued, “Besides these, I’ve also temporarily applied for some god-level resources to strengthen your nascent worlds, including Heavenly Wood Branches and Earth Essence Soil.”
“When the time comes, they should be sufficient to solidify the foundations of your four nascent worlds.” As he spoke, Marcellus Larry took out a Space Ring.
“This ring contains Life Crystals that I transferred from the Seventh Corps: 32 of Level 7, 7 of level eight, and one Level 9 Life Crystal.”
“Currently, the Federation’s crystal sources are divided into three main parts. The most abundant are the low-level crystals, coming from various Mutated Beast breeding grounds across the globe, supplied to freshmen and ordinary soldiers of the military for initial cultivation phases.”
“However, after reaching fourth and fifth grades, the number of crystals drastically reduces. Most are from the Alien Beast Battlefields of various countries, and their output is exchanged at low prices by geniuses and Special Forces Soldiers.”
“The Federation’s philosophy is not to stockpile resources. All useful resources, upon acquisition, are distributed downstream or exchanged at low prices to those in need, in order to enhance the overall strength.”
“Under these circumstances, high-order Life Crystals from the mythical world become even more scarce. One reason is the lack of stockpile, and the other is the difficulty in obtaining them.”
“Over the years, the surrounding high-level alien beasts and Giant Beasts have basically all been killed, so even I can only gather this number of high-order Life Crystals in the short term,” Marcellus Larry said with some regret.
“It’s a pity that your cultivation level has already reached the Eighth Layer, making anything below level seven useless to you. And those low-level crystals are allocated to the Martial Arts School for the new semester and cannot be intercepted.”
“Thank you, Your Majesty.” Jack Clark took the Space Bracelet and the Space Ring.
With these resources, not only could he make rapid progress in the next two layers, but he would also be able to enhance the strength of the Giant Beast.
Having finished discussing the resources, Marcellus Larry continued, “By the way, Jack, don’t be in a hurry to enter the mythical world just yet. It will take a few more days for the forbidden weapon that the Speaker has prepared for you.”
“A so-called forbidden weapon is a special secret treasure that contains the power of Supreme Experts’ rules and will shatter after one use, but it is very powerful.”
“You are now being targeted by The Purgatory Family and the Evil God Alliance. If your movements are exposed there, there’s a high chance you will be attacked by king-level figures.”
“Over the years, in our Civilization War against The Purgatory Family, both sides have been infiltrating each other’s ranks, so safety is paramount. It’s best to wait for the forbidden weapon before heading there.”
“No problem, I was actually planning to go into Closed-door Cultivation for a few days.”
Even if Marcellus Larry hadn’t mentioned it, Jack Clark had been planning to take some time to consolidate before going to the mythical world, as there were many things he needed to prepare.
Such as deducing Advanced Combat Skills after reaching a higher cultivation level.
After obtaining the seeds of five types of Innate Divine Abilities and consolidating his Combat Divine Body, both his strength attribute and way of fighting had changed significantly.
Simple Advanced Combat Skills, even the Eight Desolate Refining Hell Halberd, were no longer sufficient to bring out his full potential.
In fact, even when Jack Clark had reached the Seventh Layer Heaven, he had already encountered the problem of his Combat Techniques not being powerful enough. But because his cultivation breakthroughs had come so fast, he had barely had time to adjust before reaching the Eighth Layer Heaven.
“`
So he needed to enter closed-door cultivation again, to enter enlightenment with his burning attribute, and to forge Martial Arts techniques that could unleash all his advantages in a destructive combat skill.
Besides, with enough Life Crystals on hand now, it was time to reinforce his Space-Time Summoning until it reached grand accomplishment, perhaps even to its ultimate limit.
When the time came to venture into the mythical world, summoning the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would be his trump card.
Although the Speaker was going to forge a forbidden weapon for him, such top-tier life-saving trump cards should not be used lightly because each time one was used, one less remained.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark conversed with Marcellus Larry, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, deep under the sea, was also busy.
The surrounding towering vortices of sea water swirled, emitting a thunderous rumbling noise, with a few hundred meters at the center completely devoid of water, the air scorching hot, distorting the view.
In the smoldering Heaven Burning Golden Flame exhaled by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the skeleton of the Blade Giant Beast was continuously being melted down. Most of its material turned to ash, leaving only the purest essence.
After three days of continuous flaming by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the hardened earth around the pathway had long been liquefied into scorching magma that rolled incessantly.
The previous battle had yielded the skeletons of three Level 9 Giant Beasts, two at the early stages of Level 9 and one quasi-mythical beast at Level 9 Peak.
As for the Blue Giant Beast in the late stages of Level 9, since it belonged to a soft-bodied species, it strangely had no skeleton despite having mutated, only scale armor on its body surface.
Under the relentless scorching and destructive smelting of the Golden Flame, the half-skeleton of the Blade Giant Beast gradually turned into a dark gold crystalline substance that was five meters long and three meters in diameter.
Only then did the flames in the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly die out.
Phew! Finally done.
Even with its strength, continuously breathing fire for three days had taken its toll, feeling as if it had unleashed more than a dozen bursts in a row, its legs had started to feel slightly weak.
At that moment, the water from the distant vortex exploded, and the Silver Giant Dragon’s head carefully peeked in, growling in a low roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, have you finished burning?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded and growled back, “Finished. You can come in now.”
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’ve finally finished burning.”
With those words the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly opened its mouth wide, exhaling a powerful blast of cold air that instantly froze and cooled the rolling magma land it passed over.
Bang!
The Silver Giant Dragon, more than 150 meters in length, burst out of the vortex, and its heavy footsteps fell on the ground, causing it to shatter instantly.
The Silver Giant Dragon approached the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, extending its head curiously to look at the crystal-like essence that had been burned down to a remnant, not understanding the purpose of burning these bones.
Then the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Scythia, have Big Joe and the others not reached their peak yet?”
The Silver Giant Dragon shook its head, “The day before yesterday, Horned Lady came back once, saying they were both just a bit short of accumulation, and they have been guarding those Resource Points recently.”
“Just a bit short, huh.” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded slowly.
From the previous battle, besides the flesh and blood of more than a dozen Level 8 and Level 9 Giant Beasts, there were also the high-level Regenerative Resources Territories where these Giant Beasts dwelled.
These resources and Green Life Crystals, akin to the Growth Crystals found on the islands where the Ancient Giant Crocodile resided, were even higher-grade and had all been distributed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to its subordinate beasts.
The Candle Dragon had taken over the territory where the Blue Giant Beast had dwelled, which was only a little over ten kilometers away from the pathway.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon had also claimed one and with the Heaven and Earth Treasures produced by the remaining resource points temporarily supplied to the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
After consuming parts of the flesh of the Blade Giant Beast, stimulated by the quasi-mythical flesh and blood factors, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Single-horned Tiger Whale at the late stage of level eight had both grown significantly.
And with the abundant supply of resource energy, they were already nearing the Peak of the eighth level.
But this pace is still a bit slow.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon sighed slightly and then roared, “Roar! Scythia, I’m going to check out the other side, you’ll take over here.”
“Having waited so long, those guys over there haven’t come over, so I’ll just have to go find them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 325 Myth of the World-Devouring, Three Suns (Thanks to Pot Sun and Moon Master)
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Chapter 325 Myth of the World-Devouring, Three Suns (Thanks to Pot Sun and Moon Master)
“`
Upon hearing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon mention going to the opposite world, the Silver Giant Dragon was momentarily startled, then a rare seriousness appeared in those beautiful silver-blue vertical pupils.
The Silver Giant Dragon raised its head and lowly growled at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, “Roar! Tim Abott, that Mythical Giant Beast is very powerful, it would be very dangerous if you suddenly went there.”
As a descendant of the mythical, the Silver Giant Dragon’s judgement of the ‘strength’ of Mythical Creatures was more accurate.
Based on the force of the Scale of Laws that the Sword Dragon Giant Beast had previously produced, it felt that the opponent might already be in the late period of Mythical Creatures.
Such Mythical Giant Beasts far surpassed those that had just made a breakthrough in strength.
This kind of power wasn’t something the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, who had the Giantification Talent and temporarily possessed strength comparable to a Mythical Giant Beast, could match.
Therefore, during this period, the Silver Giant Dragon had been ready at all times, prepared to pull out the Scale of Laws the moment the Black Oblivion King tried to cross the pathway.
It was also ready to borrow the power of its bloodline to Summon the Will of its mother and give that despicable guy a sound thrashing.
However, after speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon noticed that the black-red Colossal Beast in front of it was looking at it with a strange expression.
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon instinctively took two steps back, its double wings guarding behind it as it warily roared, “Roar! Tim Abott, why are you looking at Great Sethia like that?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was somewhat surprised and roared back in a deep voice, “Nothing much, I’m just amazed that Sethia, you seem not so dumb… simple.”
“Roar! Tim Abott, I heard that, you just called me dumb, you actually called Great Sethia dumb.”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes suddenly widened, and it roared loudly, now somewhat angry.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook its head, “Roar! Sethia, you must have heard wrong, I said you’re innocent, naively cheerful, lively and adorable.”
“Is that so?” The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes showed doubt, wondering if it had heard wrong.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded affirmatively, “Roar! Of course, the Dragon Palace under your leadership, Sethia, has already dominated a large sea area and wiped out several Giant Beast ’empires’.”
“And you also handle the affairs within the Dragon Palace extremely well, having constructed palaces that are magnificent and imposing. How could you, so powerful and intelligent, be a fool?”
“Roar! Exactly, the Great Sethia has always been very formidable.”
After being praised by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon like this, Sethia immediately nodded in pride, its silver-blue dragon eyes slightly narrowed, and its tail lifted in contentment, showing some happiness.
After flattering the Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued to growl lowly, “Don’t worry, I know it’s dangerous there, so I’m not going now, but prepare to raise my strength a bit first.”
“Take a look here, Sethia, I’m going to cultivate.”
With that, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stepped heavily, causing the ground to tremble slightly as it lay down by the edge of the vortex, assuming the posture of one hibernating and cultivating.
This… The Silver Giant Dragon looked baffled, is strength really something you can just increase as you say?
No, that’s not right, Tim Abott actually seems to truly increase his strength as he says.
Recalling the times when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s strength had suddenly surged, stunning them every few days, envy appeared in the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes.
It also wished its strength could rapidly increase. That way, it wouldn’t need the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s help, and it could go back and ride on Torsa, bullying it.
…
After speaking with Marcellus Larry and receiving several million points of contribution resources, Jack Clark did not leave but went through some materials about the mythical world at Base No.1.
His Giant Beast Avatar was about to go there soon, and he himself would follow shortly, so naturally, he had to understand as much as possible.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, it had limited knowledge.
It only knew that it was born in the Icebound Mountain Range, surrounded by the Boundless Forest, and that flying south for two days would take it beyond its mother’s Territory.
The Barron Beast King living nearby was very powerful and had a good personality, and it was through a pathway in the Terrioty of that Mythical Giant Beast that it entered the Blue Star.
And that was it.
When Jack Clark left Base No.1, it was already evening, and he was surprised to find the Frontline Small Town buzzing with activity.
On both sides of the street, stretching across three districts and eight meters wide, tables were set up, and hundreds of people were joyously devouring meat and gulping down drinks.
Among these people, one-third were the geniuses from Eastern Summer who had stayed here for Closed-door Cultivation, and the rest were frontline soldiers recovering from injuries.
At the same time, near the small town, around a dozen temporary stoves were manned by people bustling about.
While some were stir-frying dishes, others were boiling soup, and at this moment, a stocky middle-aged chef yelled, “The braised Black Corner Beef is ready; someone come and carry it away.”
“Coming, coming.”
“Jack, over here.” In the middle of the festive street feast, Justin Welan, with greasy mouth, waved at Jack Clark while holding a 0.5-meter-long leg bone to gnaw on.
Joining Justin Welan’s table were the classmates from South Sky Martial Height, class leader Sherry Lesser and her sisters, Jane Aiken, Howard Lambert, Betty Leinster, Denny Rhodes, and Carol Koch.
What’s going on?
Jack Clark was puzzled when the soldiers dining on both sides enthusiastically waved at him, “Student Clark, you’re back, come on, let’s have a couple of drinks.”
“Hahahaha, student Clark is back, we’ve been waiting for you.”
“Student Clark, I can’t believe you haven’t even finished First Grade yet, awesome, a Senior One Eight Layer Heaven freshman, your talent is too exaggerated.”
“Haha… Do I even need to say it, Student Clark is a genius who walked the King’s Road, maybe in ten years, you’ll be the next Heavenly King of our Human Race.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 325 Myth of the World-Devouring, Three Suns (Thanks to the Great Sun and Moon in the Pot)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Chapter 325 Myth of the World-Devouring, Three Suns (Thanks to the Great Sun and Moon in the Pot)_2
“Student Clark, tonight, you must not return until you’re drunk.”
Facing the enthusiastic greetings from these people, Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile, nodding continuously and responding modestly.
At the same time, he noticed that Eddy Keller and Damon Lopes were surrounded by a large group of people offering toasts, shouting continuously to have a drink with the Federal Genius.
Soon, Jack Clark took a seat at Justin Welan’s table.
As Jack Clark sat down, Jane Aiken, who was sitting to his right, pushed her bowl and chopsticks in front of him.
“Thank you,” Jack Clark said politely as he took them.
“No need to be polite, they were saved for you,” Jane Aiken continued eating intently, as the food tasted very good today and she was eating non-stop, getting oil all around her mouth.
Justin Welan explained, “After you left earlier, General Bland said to celebrate your breakthrough to the Eight Layer by organizing this street banquet for everyone.”
Eh… Are you sure it’s to celebrate our breakthrough to the Eight Layer? Jack Clark looked around at the soldiers who were loudly calling for toasts and eating meat, feeling somewhat skeptical.
It seemed to him like these folks were just looking for an excuse to have a good time; otherwise, they had started feasting even in the absence of the genius himself.
Just as Jack Clark was about to start eating, Justin Welan suddenly asked, “Jack, you’re about to enter the mythical world, right? Do you have any idea where you’re going?”
Instantly, several others at the table turned to look at him curiously.
Jack Clark shook his head, “Not so soon. I need to go into closed-door cultivation for a few days to sort out my Martial Arts, then I’ll prepare to report to the Expedition Division of the Seventh Corps.”
“Expedition Division? I thought you would go to the Frontline Battlefield,” Carol Koch said, surprised from across the table.
Denny Rhodes nodded, “Indeed, I also thought Jack Clark would go directly to the Frontline Battlefield.”
In the relic, Jack Clark already demonstrated his dominant fighting power, slaughtering peers like slaughtering dogs. His breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven was even more impressive, with continuous extraordinary phenomena.
With his current strength, he might be invincible among the Eight Layer Heaven, even though he is only at the early stage of Eight Layer.
Such strength makes him a strong man on the Frontline Battlefield, capable of dominating a local small battlefield.
Jack Clark shook his head, “I was planning to go to the Frontline Battlefield as well, but Larry Throne and the others suggested I go to the Expedition Division first to gain experience and get used to the mythical world.”
“Then, after I break through to the Ninth Heavens, I’ll go there.”
“Actually, that’s the correct approach.”
From across the table, Mandy Lewis said with a gentle tone, “Jack, your talent is exceptional, and your cultivation level will continue to rise rapidly. There’s no need to rush to the Frontline Battlefield so soon.”
“That place is full of uncertainties, and you might even get ambushed by a Demon King Level Strong man.”
To speak ill, a genius who dies is no longer a genius, and no one will remember how monstrous you once were.”
Betty Leinster nodded, “Miss Karen is right.”
Mildly, Crystal Lewis added, “I’ve heard that the Expedition Division is not without danger. Though it may not seem as fierce as the Frontline Battlefield, many pioneers go missing there every year.”
Howard Lambert commented in a grave tone, “That’s normal as it’s the mythical world after all; with infinite resources, dangers lurk everywhere.”
Justin Welan showed a look of regret, “What a pity, my brother told me to wait until I break through to Sixth-level Heaven before entering. I can’t go with you, Jack.”
Suddenly, Howard Lambert said, “I’m planning to head there in a couple of days, to join the Expedition Division, but I’ll be going to the Eighth Army Corps. I’ve heard that the surroundings there are somewhat more stable.”
Justin Welan was immediately surprised, “…You’re worried about danger too, Howard?”
Howard Lambert retorted, “Of course. The Cultivation Methods I practice are about growing through combat, not seeking death.”
After some thought, Jane Aiken said, “I’m planning to continue my closed-door cultivation here, refining my Martial Arts and my Self-created Secret Manual, aiming to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven sooner.”
“My father also told us not to rush and to enter after we break through to Sixth-level Heaven,” Crystal Lewis remarked.
“I’m planning to take the train the day after tomorrow, entering the mythical world alongside Denny Rhodes.”
“The day after tomorrow? Senior sister, aren’t you going back for the school’s graduation ceremony?” Jack Clark asked, somewhat surprised.
“No, I want to join the army as soon as possible to gain experience. I aim to break through to the Seventh Layer before the end of the year. Otherwise, by the time Junior Clark breaks through to king level, I might still be in the Sixth-level Heaven.”
Jack Clark laughed, “Senior sister is joking. I don’t think I’ll break through that quickly.”
At this moment, from a few tables away, Eddy Keller stood up, laughing heartily as he looked over, “Haha… Carney, come on, come over for a drink.”
The handsome Carney Turner twitched the corner of his mouth, “…No need.”
He didn’t want to be seen with someone who liked to show off forcibly, otherwise people might think they were both fools.
Then, Sheehan Bland with a scar on his cheek came over, speaking frankly, “Student Clark, taking advantage of today, I definitely want to have a few good drinks with you.”
“Otherwise, by the next time we meet, you might already be a King-level strong man.”
Smiling, Jack Clark stood up, “General Bland is too generous. It ought to be me toasting everyone. If it weren’t for you fighting on the frontlines, us students wouldn’t be able to cultivate peacefully in the rear.”
“Jack is right.”
Justin Welan, chuckling, stood up, and even stood on the stool to shout, “Come on, classmates, let’s all toast to everyone.”
“Thank you for your sacrifices on the frontline. Without your blood-soaked battles, those scums from the Purgatory Demon Race might have invaded us long ago.”
“Hahaha… Yes, they are all scums.”
“These guys come from territories that are incredibly far from our Human Race, but ever since they discovered us over twenty years ago, they’ve been provoking us and even waging wars.”

chapters.title: Chapter 732: 325: The Myth of Devouring the World, Three Suns (Thanks to the Great Sun and Moon in the Pot)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Chapter 325: The Myth of Devouring the World, Three Suns (Thanks to the Great Sun and Moon in the Pot)_3
“Ha… Right before I came back, I luckily chopped off a hundred heads of the Purgatory Demon Race, it was exhilarating.”
“Mr. Jerrold, you’re not cutting it. I remember you saying you’ve been on the frontline for five years, and you’ve only chopped off a hundred demons.”
“It’s different, Brother Lee, my troop was directly facing those vassal race armies. It’s already lucky to encounter so many demon commanders.”
“Alright, let’s not talk about that. Brothers, let’s drink to this.”
“Cheers.”
“Let’s toast with this drink today to student Clark, student Keller, Sinclair Larson, and everyone for prosperous military fortunes and to quickly ascend the throne.”
In the distance, Eddy Keller was a bit annoyed: “General Bland, just call me Keller.”
Sheehan Bland laughed heartily: “Haha, no problem, student Keller, come on, everyone, cheers.”
In the warm atmosphere, a few hundred people on the street downed their drinks.
After finishing the drink, Sheehan Bland came to Carol Koch, smiling and said: “Miss Koch, come on, let’s have a drink.”
“I heard that you’re the top Second Grade person in the Southern Battlefield, you must have one.”
While Sheehan Bland was pulling Carol Koch to drink, the short and stocky middle-aged man who was in charge of cooking also came over.
Justin Welan took the initiative to introduce: “Jack, this is Senior Ledger, the Third Army Corps Logistics Department Chief, he’s here recuperating due to an injury.”
“The Logistics Department isn’t safe either?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
The stocky middle-aged man gave a bitter smile: “It’s a battlefield, how could there be a completely safe place? We have short-range targeted missiles, fighter aircraft, and mountain-crushing cannons; those guys also have long-range attacks.”
“Especially some of the powerful demon kings, they can even distort space, launch destruction strikes from hundreds of kilometers away; it’s unpredictable.”
“At that moment, I was just leading people to cook, and then a terrifying strike pierced through the base’s defense shield. In an instant, our Logistics Department vanished, and only I barely survived with heavy injuries.”
With that, Jack Clark and this middle-aged man named Simon Ledger, whose cultivation was at the late stage of Sixth Heavenly Layer, had a drink together.
At this moment, Denny Rhodes was a bit curious: “Senior Ledger, can you tell us more about the details of the mythical world?”
“The details over there, huh.”
Simon Ledger thought for a while: “I suppose you could say it’s a terrifying world.”
“Terrifying?” The group was taken aback.
Simon Ledger nodded: “Yes, terrifying. For instance, there are three suns in the sky, two moons, one day and night is forty earthly days, with daytime lasting about thirty days and nighttime ten days.”
“Three stars orbiting?” Betty Leinster and others showed a look of surprise upon hearing this for the first time.
“Those suns are different from the stars in our world. For example, when the Golden Sun sits at high noon, it gives a comfortable, warm, and vibrant feeling.”
“But when the Golden Sun sets and the Red Sun takes over, the whole world becomes hot and drying; everyone becomes irritable.”
“And when the Blue Sun finally appears, it brings an inexplicable chill and discomfort, even seeming to make one’s mood gloomy.”
Hiss! How bizarre. Everyone took in a cold breath.
Continuing, Simon Ledger said: “And while the night is said to have two moons, normally only one bright moon hangs. The Blood Moon appears less often,”
“But if you go out during the Blood Moon, you must find a place to hide, because under its influence, the Giant Beasts become bloodthirsty and aggressive.”
With the introduction from Simon Ledger, a veteran from the frontline, Jane Aiken and others began to have a more detailed understanding of the mythical world.
As for Jack Clark, he had already seen these materials at Base No.1 before and knew even more than Simon Ledger.
For instance, the mythical world is vast beyond measure, and this vastness comes from it devouring other worlds.
Indeed, the mythical world is absorbing other worlds, merging them into its own.
This terrifying world seems to have an instinct, always devouring and absorbing other worlds, growing and expanding itself, hence the numerous environmental disparities in various regions.
For example, you might travel tens of thousands of kilometers where one second you see green mountains and clear waters, and the next step could be into a frozen Earth or a fragmented Void of dead space.
Moreover, the density of Heavenly Energy over there is several times that of the Alien Beast Battlefield, and dozens of times more than Eastern Summer.
But this Heavenly Energy is corrosive. Under its erosion, living beings can mutate to a certain extent, far more extreme than any reactions on Blue Star.
Basically, anyone with a physique below Fourth Layer Heaven who travels there soon mutates and is unable to withstand the energy erosion, becoming a non-human monster.
And it’s not just humans or living beings affected, technology products and equipment also suffer.
For example, various components age quickly, metal fatigue accelerates, wireless signals, even wired transmission of information, all get disturbed.
As for the reason, it’s because many of the fundamental rules there are different from the ‘universe’ rules of Blue Star; many physical and chemical reactions cannot occur there.
Therefore, Blue Star essentially acts as a Logistics Factory, continuously producing various types of ammunition, equipment, or researching and sending over advanced weapons integrated with runes.
At the same time, refined minerals, Giant Beast materials, and plant and animal materials are transported back for processing or production.
The meal lasted till about ten o’clock at night when everyone had their fill and dispersed. Jack Clark, led by a soldier, collected keys to a two-story small building.
After getting familiar with the environment of the small building, Jack Clark sat down in the living room and took out several dozen High-level Life Crystals from the Sumeru Ring.
Looking at the colorful crystals on the table, all radiating rich life fluctuations, Jack Clark’s face showed a smile as he placed his hand on the largest Level 9 Crystal.
“You have converted high-purity Life Energy, gaining 14,870 Attribute Points.”
“You have converted high-purity Life Energy, gaining 3,670 Attribute Points…”
As one High-level Life Crystal after another was converted, the Attribute points on the transparent page surged at an astonishing speed, rocketing from just over twenty thousand to over forty thousand in the blink of an eye.
When all the Life Crystals were finished being converted, the Points Attribute on the transparent page had reached 93,104.

chapters.title: Chapter 733: 326: Heavenly Tier Monarch Giant Beast, Top-tier Rule - Destruction (Thanks to the sun and moon tycoon in the jar)
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: Chapter 326: Heavenly Tier Monarch Giant Beast, Top-tier Rule – Destruction (Thanks to the sun and moon tycoon in the jar)
“`
Looking at the attribute page with over ninety thousand attribute points, Jack Clark slowly exhaled a breath.
Over ninety thousand attribute points were enough to enhance any talent beyond the top level, such as the soul.
However, Jack’s gaze only briefly paused on the Soul Talent before moving away to ponder over the other talents of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Since the direction of the Soul Talent wasn’t destruction and devastation, strengthening it was unlikely to significantly enhance battle power, which wasn’t a current priority.
“Strength or Defense?” His eyes fell on the first two top-tier talents the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had acquired.
Actually, these two talents weren’t top-tier at the beginning.
When the Six-legged Salamander first evolved and became the Hexagonal Power Lycophyte, the Hundred-fold Strength Talent it gained could only manifest tenfold due to the weakness of its physical body.
And this burst-depended on the physical strength of the Hexagonal Power Lycophyte; a swipe of its claw could only smash an egg, devoid of the might befitting a top-tier talent.
Also, during the second evolution into the Hexagonal Armored Beast, the acquired Defensive Talent merely entailed steel-hardened carapace and defense akin to a hundredfold increased body weight.
Steel hardness, a hundredfold own weight in pressure, that level of defense would now not withstand even a breath from a Level 9 Giant Beast.
The ultimate strength of these two talents was related to successive evolutions, with each evolution of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon being a life leap, breaking the species limit.
In such cases, the power of the initial talents also increased.
This was why the thunder and fire talents acquired during the Fourth Evolution into the Thunderflame Beheamoth were only intermediate, while swiftness was listed as senior.
This was due to the later absorbed talents missing two or even three opportunities for synchronous evolution.
So the very first ‘Strength’ talent acquired by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was its strongest.
With this in mind, Jack’s attention settled on the Strength Talent, and his voice resonated in his mind: “Consume fifty thousand attribute points to Limit Enhance the Strength Talent.”
As Jack’s voice fell, the attribute points on the page instantly became 43104.
Simultaneously within him, an overwhelmingly vast enhancing energy emerged, passing grandiosely through the Soul Channel and vanishing out of sight.
Beneath the deep sea, the Silver Giant Dragon lay lazily on the ground, watching the distant standstill of the red vortex, idly sweeping its tail behind.
But at that moment, an alarming aura burst forth from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had been lying dormant in the corner for half the day.
Boom!
In an instant, the whole world seemed to shake, and the ground beneath the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shattered and exploded like building blocks, with countless pieces of dirt and stone rising into the sky, forming concentric shockwaves.
Bang!
The Silver Giant Dragon, more than 150 meters long, hadn’t yet reacted when it, mixed with countless pieces of stone and dirt like swept trash, was swept more than 200 meters into the sea water by the shockwave.
Boom, boom, boom!! Numerous supersonic cannonballs-like boulders hit the vortex, instantly causing the entire seabed to vibrate, with the sound of explosions echoing endlessly.
In the raging sea water, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened in disbelief: “Roar! It really got stronger, Tim Abott really got stronger!”
Roar!
The aura around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon became increasingly terrifying as it soared into the sky with a boom, transforming into a black ray of light that pierced through the pathway and appeared above ten thousand meters altitude within a blink of an eye.
Boom!
An even more terrifying aura erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the powerful unmatched force creating transparent shockwaves that spread around for kilometers.
Above, the clouds within tens of kilometers instantly dispersed, forming a hollow in the atmosphere, as if a colossal azure pupil had appeared atop the sea.
Bang!
In the distance, the sea surface exploded, and a 300-meter-long Red Beast emerged from the sea, looking somewhat astonished at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the sky that was unleashing a terrifying might.
What’s going on, why did the king’s aura suddenly become so terrible?
Roar, roar, roar!!
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Blue Giant Crab, and the Horned Lady, these underlings, all appeared within a hundred kilometers, all shocked as they looked up at the sky.
Roar, roar!! Thunderflame has become fierce once again; how did it get fierce again! At this moment, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was embittered with envy; as for shock, how could it still be shocked?
They’ve long become used to this freak’s abnormal growth; every day, it is on the path of getting strong or super-strong.
If there ever came a day when it stopped getting stronger, that would be the real surprise.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Abbott, so awesome, it’s gotten stronger again.” Feeling the continuously rising terrifying aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon excitedly rolled around on the sea surface.
The nine dragon heads acted like a super spiral machine, furiously stirring until they became entangled, eyeing each other in puzzlement.
Gurgle, gurgle!! Great King, that’s… Bang!
On the sea surface, the Blue Giant Crab was so excited that its eight legs went weak. Just as it was about to make an impassioned speech, the sea beneath it blew up, and it was launched a hundred meters away by the waves.
Well, it just turned over.
Among the splashing water, the Silver Giant Dragon spread its double wings and soared into the sky, accompanied by sonic booms, reaching ten thousand meters altitude in the blink of an eye. Circling excitedly around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it let out a series of high, majestic Dragon Roars.
“Roar! Invincible, take off, Tim Abott, keep getting stronger so that you can help me go back to fight. The Great Scythia is destined to dominate the vast world.”
“Roar! Scythia will become the ruler of the skies, the monarch of the Earth, the sovereign of the seas.”
As the Silver Giant Dragon continued its excited flight around the ten-thousand-meter altitude, the power aura emanating from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew increasingly terrifying, gradually forming black lightning.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 734: 326: Heavenly Tier Monarch Giant Beast, Top-tier Rule - Destruction (Thanks to the sun and moon tycoon in the jar)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 734: Chapter 326: Heavenly Tier Monarch Giant Beast, Top-tier Rule – Destruction (Thanks to the sun and moon tycoon in the jar)_2
As these black bolts of lightning appeared, an even fiercer and more violent aura permeated the air.
Boom, boom, boom! The sky shook, and the sea roared.
Around the black lightning, space shattered, forming pitch-black cracks with teeth and claws that were as formidable as the Deep Red Thunder in its Gigantified state.
At the same time, the form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also began to change, its muscles, including those on its limbs, bulged even more, becoming more formidable, more fierce.
Simultaneously, the muscles and bones inside its body underwent a transformation under the ‘strength,’ with its golden-red flesh and blood gradually turning black gold, akin to a super-strong black gold alloy.
Including its blood and internal organs, everything was strengthened and tempered under this terrifying power, becoming even more powerful and containing more horrific destructive forces.
As its strength continued to grow to the extreme, everything around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon twisted, even the light was devoured, forming a distorted dark area.
This terrible might instantly triggered a reaction from the satellites monitoring above, and a shrill alarm sounded in the Ocean Monitoring Center.
…
The breakthrough of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had nearly lasted an hour.
Soon, as the black lightning swirling around its body disappeared, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly opened its eyes, its golden vertical pupils cold, without a single fluctuation, only destruction.
Feeling the terrifying power within its body that could destroy the ‘world,’ the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark saw a transparent page appear in their view, their eyes falling on the change in talents below.
Physical Talent: Strength.Destruction[Deification: Strength Talent enhanced to the utmost limit, possessing the might to destroy all matter, energy, even space, comparable to a supreme law.
Destructive Body: Under the strength of destruction enhanced to the extreme, the body is constantly being tempered, becoming more powerful and containing a terrifying explosive potential.
Note: This talent now possesses destructive characteristics and will advance to become one of the top-tier laws upon breakthrough in Myth.]
Jack Clark slowly said, “As expected, it’s only comparable to a law, not directly transforming from a Top Tier Talent into a law.”
Jack had actually anticipated that advancing a Top Tier Talent further, even after strengthening, might not become a law.
The reason is that among the Mythical Giant Beasts, there are many with king-level bloodlines, whose talents before their breakthrough are merely Senior-level.
From this, Jack could determine that talents are talents, and laws are laws.
Now that the strength was enhanced to the Deification stage, it indeed confirmed his speculation.
The level of talent represents the bloodline potential of the Extraordinary Giant Beasts, and the strength of the awakened talent also represents their power.
For example, a Giant Beast awakening a king-level bloodline and possessing Advanced Talent would be just a common Mythical Giant Beast after breaking through to Myth, with a not very strong law.
An Extraordinary Giant Beast with one Top Tier Talent, upon breaking through to Myth and fusing its talent with a law, would command a much more powerful law, becoming a Monarch-level Mythical Giant Beast.
As for a Giant Beast with four top-tier talents, upon breaking through to Myth, it would master four powerful laws, becoming an invincible Monarch among myths with Absolute Domination.
And now, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, as a mid-Level 9 Giant Beast, had prematurely acquired a Deification Talent with might comparable to a law, gaining destructive characteristics.
At this moment, to some extent, it was already a quasi-mythical life form.
And this ‘quasi-mythical’ Giant Beast, because its talent pertained to its physical body, had an endless ‘law’ power, even more potent than other quasi-mythical beasts.
However, what surprised Jack was that after the talent evolved to Deification, it actually obtained destructive characteristics, and once the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon broke through to Mythical-level, it would control the Law of Destruction.
Thinking this, both Jack Clark and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s breaths became rapid in unison, because it still had six Top-level Talents and two Advanced ones.
If the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could evolve all its talents to Deification before reaching the peak of the Ninth Heavens, wouldn’t it tackle eight top-tier laws upon its breakthrough, and how fearsome would that be?
Beyond that is Jack’s own body that possesses the Void Double Pupils.
Could it be that just by strengthening to the Deification Realm, he would also be able to control a top-tier law immediately upon breaking through to the Monarch tier?
Add to that the possibility of mastering the Supreme Law through Opening the Heavens, and his power would grow even stronger.
And because the talent evolved to Deification, being comparable to a law, he could also directly step over the threshold from the late period of the Nine Layers to the peak without pause.
But by such calculations…
Jack, who was stronger than the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at the same higher tier, seems to be outstripped by the Giant Beast Avatar once stepping into the mythical domain.
Ah! Jack suppressed the excitement in his heart, his eyes falling on the ‘Regeneration’ and ‘Toxin,’ the two Advanced Talents.
With more than 40,000 attribute points remaining, it was enough to enhance the two talents to Top Tier.
And each enhancement of a Top-tier Talent would transform the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body and life, an evolutionary strength increase without waste.
Above the great sea, numerous beasts watched as the ferocious Giant Beast, which stood high up in the sky and still exuded a terrifying pressure even after gathering the black lightning, thought everything had come to an end.
Boom!
Once again, a vast pressure burst forth from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, with qi blood so robust it was indescribable piercing the cloud sky, and its whole body radiated light, dyeing heaven and earth crimson.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was like a blazing Great Sun, radiating with boundless vitality.
Under that vigorous life force and lively qi blood, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body began the third growth phase after Level 9.
Just then, the aura on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon surged again, with purple radiance spreading into rings of halos.

chapters.title: Chapter 735: 326: The Heavenly Tier Monarch Giant Beast, Top-tier Rule - Destruction (Thanks to the Great sun and moon in the Pot)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 735: Chapter 326: The Heavenly Tier Monarch Giant Beast, Top-tier Rule – Destruction (Thanks to the Great sun and moon in the Pot)_3
Boom!
In an instant, the world trembled as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exuded a barbaric pressure, erupting with a terrifying aura as if the king of ancient ferocious beasts had descended.
Under that stupendously fierce pressure, the surrounding space emitted sounds of being overwhelmed, as if the world would be destroyed the next moment.
The pressure was so terrifying that even the domain vortex spinning below showed signs of stopping. On the ocean, tumultuous waves surged, sending hundred-meter tsunamis in all directions, as though some horror was about to emerge.
All the giant beasts instinctively bowed their heads under the might that seemed to shatter Heaven and Earth, filled with awe.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon that had been flying excitedly in the sky reflexively landed on the sea surface, waiting for the terrifying monarch beast to complete its transformation.
With regeneration and toxin strengthened to top-tier talents, the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to evolve and grow, becoming even more fierce and ferocious.
For instance, the double claws on its forearms grew sharper and longer, resembling an umbrella that had only partly opened.
Especially on its tail, the two rows of blade-like sharp spikes gradually came together, looking like a long, narrow black and red slash blade composed of successive segments.
It appeared as a flexible whip slash blade over a hundred meters long, invisibly radiating terrifying sharpness, as if a slightest flick could sever everything, incredibly savage.
In its current form, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was exceedingly ferocious and ghastly, surrounded by endless black lightning and purple halos, looking immensely fearsome.
With seven top-tier talents and one deification talent, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s strength and very essence of life were continuously transforming, reaching beyond the level of monarchs.
While the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon quietly sensed the changes within its body, Jack Clark’s gaze was fixed on the constantly changing, reorganizing information on the attribute page.
Avatar Body: Ancient Heavenly Thunderflame Emperor Dragon
Level: Ancient Heavenly Emperor-level Beast [Possessing one God Transformation level talent, seven top-tier talents of a Pseudo-heavenly tier life]
Innate Physical Talent: Strength.Destruction [Deification], Defense+ [Top-tier], Agility+ [Top-tier], Regeneration+ [Top-tier, vitality so vigorous it’s at its peak.
Flesh and Blood Derivation: Under the intensely vigorous vitality, even if the heart is torn apart, it can rapidly grow back in a very short time, limbs can regenerate, and flesh and blood reassemble.
Note: When this talent is enhanced beyond top-tier, it will possess the power to reverse life and death.]
Transcendent Talent: Burn Sky Golden Flame+ [Top-tier], Annihilation True Thunder+ [Top-tier], Purple Void Poison+ [Top-tier, surpasses ordinary toxins in power, strong enough to corrode the Void.
Void-Nether Fusion: Can seamlessly merge with other transcendent talents, possessing even greater might.
Purple Void Catastrophe: The power spreads formlessly, forming a Catastrophe Domain within ten kilometers, corroding and destroying everything, with everything it passes withering away as if struck by catastrophe.
Note: When this talent is enhanced beyond top-tier, it is sufficient to annihilate the Divine Soul and corrode the rule.]
Special Talent: Gigantification+ [Top-tier]
A Pseudo-heavenly tier life form beyond the level of monarchs, how much more potent must such a form of life be? Jack Clark’s eyes fell on the note behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, somewhat astonished.
One God Transformation level talent, seven top-tier talents; the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon touched the edge of that ‘Heaven’ only after its life essence leaped bounds and bounds.
What is this ‘Heaven’? The Heavenly Dao? Or is it a form of life on the same level as the Heavenly Dao?
Countless thoughts flashed through Jack Clark’s mind at this moment, and he pondered many things.
However, unlike last time when he became a Pseudo-monarch level life form and automatically received some inheritance information, this time the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not receive related information.
Perhaps it’s due to insufficient information, or maybe that so-called ‘Heaven’ level is so high that not a single bit of information has been passed down.
Hum!
At that moment, a vibration came from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, the source being the Purple Dragon Egg stuck between its horns.
Compared to the 250-meters long Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the one-meter-sized Purple Dragon Egg was like a speck of sand, almost always ignored by it.
But now, a strong feeling of excitement and agitation was emanating from within the Purple Dragon Egg.
At the same time, a powerful suction emerged from the egg, excitedly absorbing the invisible life aura emitted by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon during its life transformation.
As it absorbed the ‘Heaven’ aura, the life fluctuations inside the Dragon Egg became more intense, stronger and stronger, with faint sounds of a heartbeat becoming audible.
“This little fellow finally has a complete form of life born within it,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled, and out of its nostrils burst forth scorching Golden Flames, while from its slightly open mouth streamed gold-purple radiance, emitting the breath of destruction.
At this point, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s very essence of life was so potent it was indescribable, its insides like a world-destroying furnace, anything swallowed would be annihilated into ash.
Therefore it was impossible for the mythical tales to come true where due to the dragon’s immense size, enemies could become tiny, fly inside it, and wreak havoc.
Including its vast body surface, if a human strong man dared to land between those scales, they would immediately be incinerated and destroyed by the endlessly erupting Heaven Burning Golden Flame and Purple Void Poison.
Slowly retracting most of its aura, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked down at all the giant beasts below, its deep and authoritative roar echoing between heaven and earth.
“Earlier, I pondered and researched my own talents and made a slight breakthrough; a few of my talents transformed, and my strength increased a bit,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon declared.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared enviously, “Roar! Tim Abbott, I’ll give you my Innate Space Rune if you share your talent understanding with me, okay?”
“The Great Sethia also wishes to reach Mythical-level before maturing, with a life essence comparable to the Mythical,” the Silver Giant Dragon mused to itself, drooling with envy at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s talent for understanding. If it were not aware that talents could not be learned or exchanged, it would have already tried to swindle one for itself.
Forget the Innate Space Rune, trash, it doesn’t compare to even one of Tim Abbott’s talents.
Without paying attention to the Silver Giant Dragon that was salivating, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze turned to the enormous vortex deep within the sea, feeling that it now might be able to do battle with that Mythical Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 736: 327: Entering the Mythical World, Black Oblivion King's Altar (Requesting Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 736: Chapter 327: Entering the Mythical World, Black Oblivion King’s Altar (Requesting Monthly Votes)
“`
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon underwent a metamorphosis of life, Jack Clark’s physical strength also continuously increased under the feedback, instantly spreading a heavy and terrifying aura.
Boom!
The fierce, overbearing, and oppressive presence caused the small building to tremble slightly, a presence so formidable that not even the Hidden Deity Glyphs could conceal it.
Suddenly, the ‘geniuses’ around who were also cultivating or preparing to rest all turned their shocked faces in its direction.
Facing the terror of the aura that was getting stronger not far away, Howard Lambert, who was sitting cross-legged, fell silent for a moment, “Forget it, let’s leave tomorrow and enter the mythical world earlier.”
This monster only broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven today, and its cultivation level improved significantly at night; does it even let others live?
On the sofa, Eddy Keller, who had drunk a lot and hadn’t fully sobered up yet, was a bit dazed, “Isn’t that guy only broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven this afternoon!?”
“His cultivation feels like it has no bottleneck, always getting stronger any time and any place, sister, do you still want to compete with him?”
Dressed in a blue silk nightgown, with her gloomy blue hair still somewhat damp, Mandy Lewis stood by the window, gazing at the small building dozens of meters away that was emitting a terrifying aura, with some astonishment.
Behind her, Crystal Lewis, who was lazily reclining on the sofa in a red nightgown, revealing a pair of long, white-jade legs, rolled her eyes in response, “How do I compare, with my head?”
During the Koroya Trial, when Jack first started showing his talent and surpassed them by a small realm, Crystal Lewis did indeed feel somewhat unconvinced.
After all, she was the Class Leader, the top talent of Class 3, and among the top ten of the freshman genius list for the whole school; and yet, she was overtaken by Jack Clark, who was seen as a ‘little shrimp’ in class.
But unfortunately, since returning from Koroya, Jack Clark had rocketed forward as if on a rocket, crossing two major realms in the Alien Beast Battlefield in one month.
With such a terrifying speed of improvement, Crystal Lewis chose to give up, as there was no beating that freak; better to stop competing.
On the rooftop of the small building, Jane Aiken slowly opened her eyes, within which a faint image of a world seemed to be rotating, a world somewhat similar to the Sword World she contemplated on her Heavenly King Road.
After sensing the aura from Jack Clark that was still intensifying in the distance for a while, Jane Aiken slowly closed her eyes again.
After receiving an ’empty’ Secret Book from Quentin Torres yesterday, the girl, whose cultivation was already approaching the late period of Sixth Layer, was now comprehending her Self-created Secret Manual.
Thanks to the Sword Array Inheritance obtained from the relic and the sword imprints from the King’s Road, Jane Aiken didn’t need to refer to others’ secret books; she could carve her own path.
While the geniuses around were being shaken by Jack Clark once again, the enhancing effects on his body slowly faded.
“Around 1000 points in attributes, huh.” Looking at the changes on the attribute page, Jack Clark’s gaze remained calm.
The strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had increased substantially this time, but rather than a ‘growth’ in level, it was a metamorphosis of life. Therefore, the feedback of Evolution Energy was actually not much.
The Four Major Attributes had increased by around 1000 points, with the highest strength attribute nearing ten thousand, making Jack Clark’s strength even more domineering and terrifying.
And though this time the increase seemed to be only by a thousand, given Jack Clark’s current physical strength, the enhancement from each point of attribute increase was quite extravagant.
After briefly feeling the changes within his body, Jack Clark then directed all his attention to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was about to enter the mythical world, even Jack Clark couldn’t afford to be distracted.
Under the deep sea.
The seabed around the original vortex had been obliterated over a hundred meters by the destructive impact burst during the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s breakthrough, leaving a giant pit.
Standing a hundred meters above the ground in front of the red vortex, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s power converged, ready to enter.
Jack Clark, or rather the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, had been very curious about the mythical world; curious about the actual situation there.
Although he understood through data, word of mouth from others, including the depiction of the environment the Silver Giant Dragon once lived in, these were entirely different from experiencing it firsthand.
Now, with the normal battle strength reaching the level of an ordinary Myth, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was no longer so cautious and was ready to go find some food.
Compared to the barren Blue Star, the mythical world is said to have endless resources.
Plus, those Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts under the Black Oblivion King should allow it to quickly grow to Peak Level 9, ready for its fifth evolution.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was about to step in, it suddenly turned its head.
It saw the Silver Giant Dragon sneakily following behind, wings folded and looking like a child trying to slip out with an adult unnoticed.
“Roar! Scythia, why are you following me?”
Realizing it had been spotted, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately stood up and roared excitedly, “Roar! I’m going to watch you take down that Black Oblivion King; it dared to demand subservience from the great Scythia, unforgivable.”
“When Tim Abott you beat it half to death, the great Scythia wants to stand on its head and show it the consequences it brings upon itself for daring to subjugate Scythia.”
…The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was immediately speechless; this guy sure could hold a grudge.
At that moment, the vortex of sea water exploded behind it, and with a surge of sea water, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s massive head peered out, issuing a reminder.
Roar! Scythia, it seems like that big guy didn’t actually say it wanted you to submit, its target was Thunderflame, to make Thunderflame submit.
But as soon as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had finished calling out, the tail of the Female Tiger Whale beside it swung fiercely, smashing heavily onto its head.
Boom!
The seventy-meter long beast, now awakened with Tiger Whale bloodline, was smacked with one mighty tail, instantly exploding the sea water within a hundred meters as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was sent flying away.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 737: 327: Entering the Mythical World, Black Oblivion King's Altar (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: Chapter 327: Entering the Mythical World, Black Oblivion King’s Altar (Request for Monthly Tickets)_2
In the furious sea water, the Single-horned Tiger Whale was a bit bewildered: Chirp, chirp, chirp! Wife, why are you hitting me?
The Female Tiger Whale just looked at it quietly, not saying a word.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon looked back at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and other beasts in the distance, hesitating a bit, “Roar! Didn’t that giant beast named Troy say that the great Scythia would submit to him?”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle shook its head blankly: Roar! I don’t know. I wasn’t there at the time.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook its nine dragon heads, thought about it, and let out a confusing roar, “Roar! Roar! Roar! It seems that it didn’t.”
Immediately, anger flashed in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon, and it let out a furious roar, “Roar! Damn it, how dare they disregard the greatness of Scythia, unforgivable!”
“Roar! The great Scythia is going to annihilate them, how dare they underestimate the greatness of Scythia!”
Seeing the even angrier Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook its head speechlessly, and its ferocious mouth opened slightly, “Roar! If you want to follow, then follow, but stay far away during the fight.”
This guy may only be at the early stage of level 9, but he has quite a few good things in his pocket.
Every day he says there is nothing good to eat, but the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon often sees him take out god-level resources from his Reverse Scale. This is also the reason why the Silver Giant Dragon grows so fast.
There are also those Scales of Laws he “found” on the palace road when he left, which should be at least ten or more.
Each of these Scales of Laws contains the force of a single strike from a powerful mythical giant beast. If used consecutively, the Silver Giant Dragon might even be able to blow up the Black Oblivion King.
Of course, on the condition that the Black Oblivion King doesn’t run away.
Boom!
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon entered the pathway, the entire pathway shook violently. From all directions, the force of space tearing powerful enough to rip ordinary Level Eight Beasts could be felt.
But this level of power could not shake the Thunderflame Emperor Beast.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon took a step, and with each step, the pathway shook. Surrounding it, the light flowed, space twisted, and the strange and bizarre atmosphere was filled with a dangerous aura.
Instinct told it not to leave the boundaries of the pathway, or even with its strength, it would face danger because the surrounding area was filled with the world-colliding force that could destroy everything.
In the pathway filled with powerful tearing forces, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt like it had only taken a few steps when it suddenly saw a bright light.
Boom!
With the appearance of the black-red ferocious giant beast, the ground cracked, and spider web-like cracks spread across the entire mountain peak. Half of the mountain peak trembled slightly.
“What a rich Heavenly Energy.”
Standing on the mountain peak, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked around and found itself on a peak several thousand meters high, surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland.
At the same time, it also saw a few stone pillar buildings not far away, including the black scale armor at the edge, and the undulating ground below the mountain. In the dense forest, there were occasional glimpses of huge creatures flashing by.
At this moment, a huge blue sun was setting in the sky, about to fall. It invisibly emitted a cold and dark aura, making the whole world somewhat dim.
At the eastern edge of the world, as the sun was about to set, everything had become pitch-black, like a dark tidal wave that would swallow the heavens and the earth.
This was the mythical world.
Just coming here, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon immediately noticed the difference in the heavenly energies. The rich Heavenly Energy flowed with its breathing and gathered around it, forming a raging wind.
The Heavenly Energy was too rich.
If the Heavenly Energy in Eastern Summer was this rich, the number of people with cultivation talent would be at least a hundred times higher, and the chances of producing strong men would be even higher.
Of course, there would also be more mutated creatures and stronger ones.
However, although everything in the mythical world is flourishing, and there are hundreds to thousands of different mutated creatures and powerful species hiding in the trees, humans have discovered that most of the creatures in this world are not as strong as they thought.
There are many mutated creatures, but the breakthroughs to Level 9 or mythical-level giant beasts are still very rare, not as ubiquitous as expected.
Sometimes, only one mythical giant beast occupies a range of thousands or tens of thousands of kilometers.
After many studies, humans found that these mutated creatures had long adapted to this environment, which led to their slow growth and evolution.
It’s just like the humans and other animals and plants on the Blue Star that have already adapted to the Blue Star’s environment and gravity, and their bodies will not undergo rapid mutations.
Under such circumstances, it is the mutated creatures of Blue Star that grow faster and have a greater probability of becoming more powerful.
For decades, in order to survive, both humans and animals have been struggling to adapt to new environments, evolve, and grow.
Apart from this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also noticed that the space in the mythical world is more stable and powerful, and the difficulty of tearing space here is dozens of times that of the Blue Star.
Of course, this only means that the space here has a greater capacity for support, and it does not suppress their strength. In terms of destructive power, they will be even stronger.
Because they can draw more Heavenly Energy.
Roar!
At this time, an excited roar came from behind, and then the Silver Giant Dragon soared into the sky with a shake of its wings and blinked to an altitude of 10,000 meters, letting out high-pitched roars.
Back in the familiar environment, Scythia was very excited, flying back and forth through the clouds, tearing channels thousands to tens of thousands of meters long.
Crack!
At this moment, between the dorsal fins of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon behind it, blue-black thunderbolt flashed and instantly turned into a pair of thunderbolt wings covering 500 meters amidst the roaring sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 327: Entering the Mythical World, Black Oblivion King’s Altar (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: Chapter 327: Entering the Mythical World, Black Oblivion King’s Altar (Requesting Monthly Votes)_3
“`
Boom!
With a flap of its Thunderbolt Wings, the air within a kilometer range exploded in an instant, forming a ring of tangible shockwaves.
In the roaring gale, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon rocketed into the sky in an instant, piercing the clouds and soaring ever higher like a straight beam of dark blue radiance.
With sonic booms surrounding the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, layer upon layer of shockwaves formed, tearing through cloud after cloud, quickly reaching an altitude of tens of thousands of meters, hundreds of thousands of meters…
Roar! Surrounded by thunder, the higher the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon flew, the more it couldn’t help but let out an excited roar.
As a ‘Emperor Dragon’ Giant Beast, it had the ability to fly long ago, but to avoid conflicts with humans, it mostly coiled itself within the deep sea.
Upon arriving in this vast and limitless world, it finally had no more concerns and could soar through heaven and earth without restraint.
“Roar! Tim Abott, wait for the Great Sethia.”
Watching the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon disappear into the sky in the blink of an eye, the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by a black cyan storm, burst forth with a terrifying speed and chased after it.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s figure pierced through layer after layer of cloud mist, aiming to fly ‘beyond’ the sky of the mythical world and oversee the Earth below, suddenly a heavy oppressive sensation came over it.
And as it flew higher, reaching over a thousand kilometers in altitude, that invisible, heavy compressive force surged hundreds of times, preventing it from flying any higher.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In the thin air and freezing temperatures at one thousand kilometers altitude, where alloy-tearing fierce winds howled, they exploded upon hitting the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with a resounding boom.
Amidst the howling fierce winds, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked up at the ‘sky’ still a great distance away, its gaze somewhat solemn, “Is this the limit, then?”
In a reflective mood, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked down and saw the endless cloud mist and the faintly visible mountain ranges on the distant horizon.
Most importantly, from a thousand kilometers high, the undulating mountain ranges didn’t have the curvature of a planet; they looked like a boundless, flat expanse of Earth.
Indeed, this was the vast and endless mythical world.
At this moment, dusk was approaching, and seeing this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suppressed the urge to continue exploring the mythical world, turning its gaze to the distance.
There, the horizon was a foreboding dark red, and ominous black clouds lingered, emitting an ominous aura.
Boom! With a spread of its wings, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon descended from the heavens with sonic booms, quickly locating the Silver Giant Dragon at seven hundred kilometers altitude.
“Roar! Sethia, let’s go check that out.”
Inside the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, contemplative, “It seems the mythical world isn’t as ‘terrifying’ as I imagined, but it’s certainly full of mystery.”
Since it was temporarily safe over there, and there was no combat, Jack’s gaze shifted to the page where he still had over twenty thousand Attribute Points remaining.
“Burn 1000 Attribute Points to enter an epiphany state.”
Hum! As the Epiphanic Intent Realm enveloped him, Jack couldn’t help but recall countless memories from when he initially started Cultivating Inner Eye.
“`
Next came the insights from the Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill, along with the battles he had experienced along the way.
In his mind, these memories transformed into dozens of ‘Jack Clarks,’ practicing sword skills and halberd skills, as well as the routes of power circulation for those techniques within his body.
Combining his own True Dragon True Force, the power of the Five Great Rune God Seeds, the Prison Blood War Intent, the Doomsday Purgatory Rune, etc., he began to forge his own high-order combat techniques.
…
