Under the pitch-black night, the Earth split open, and the scorching magma flowed through the cracks, emitting a dark red glow as it burned.
By the side of the blazing magma river, there were over a thousand stone houses made of gray rock, standing 10-20 meters tall. These formed a rough-style small town.
At this moment, thousands of different races gathered at the edge of the town, engaged in a grand ceremony.
Most of these ‘different races’ were over 3 meters tall, resembling dinosaurs standing upright, covered with red scales and donned in black armor or beast hides, both male and female.
In front of these beings, there was an altar made of stone, with a foundation 500 meters wide and 300 meters tall. The altar was carved with dark red runes all around, and at the very top stood a 50-meter-tall statue of a Black Colossus.
The Black Colossus had some Western Dragon characteristics, but appeared even more ferocious and menacing than the dragons, covered in thick scale armor with sharp horns crowning its head, unmistakably the King of Obsidian Destruction.
On the left side of the altar, each 10-meter-wide step was filled with the flesh and blood of Unique Beasts. The blood flowed down the altar, emanating a strong stench of iron and decay.
On the right side, the steps were lined with an assortment of neatly arranged Unique Beast bones. Some creatures were over 10 meters in length, others over 20 meters.
At the back of the altar, the steps held the skins and furs of Mutated Creatures, also arranged very neatly, appearing quite eerie.
As for the front of the altar, there were thousands of small creatures kneeling on the steps in a praying position. However, they had all been eviscerated, long dead, with faces covered in fine green scales filled with horror and despair.
From afar, the altar resembled a mountain of corpses made from countless Mutated Beasts and smaller creatures.
And the statue of the King of Obsidian Destruction standing atop the altar looked like a Demon God from Hell, with dark red runes flickering faintly beneath it, emitting a fierce and terrifying aura.
At this time below the altar, an Elder of the different races, adorned with colorful feathers, raised both hands high, uttering a string of foreign language, seeming to be praying, singing, and shouting all at once.
Behind him, all the beings of the different races looked toward the statue on the altar with frantic and frenzied eyes, their faces looking somewhat savage as they also continually shouted loudly.
Under the prayers of these beings, the red glow from the dark red runes on the altar grew brighter and brighter. Reflected by the light, the bones and flesh began to dissolve into a strange energy that seeped through the cracks of the altar and into the ground beneath.
Boom! A terrifying power within the statue was triggered. Amidst the trembling of the Earth, endless dark purple flames burned, spreading outward from the statue, consuming everything in its path.
The ground became dry and cracked wherever the flames passed, grass and trees withered to ash, and in the increasingly crumbling rifts of the ground, dark red magma surged out as flames burned.
Meanwhile, as the bones dissolved, blue and green crystals appeared between the rune nodes, rich in Life Energy, which the altar absorbed. These crystals merged with the bones and flesh, transforming into dark purple Hellfire with a sinister attribute, corroding the surrounding Earth and polluting everything.
Instantly, the different races became even more fanatical, their eyes brimming with bloodlust and madness. Under the burning of the purple flame, not only were they unharmed, but their Level 4 and Level 5 auras were rapidly strengthening.
On a hillside several kilometers away, as those crystals emerged, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, who had been watching this scene in confusion, had its eyes light up with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 328 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon: I am the Catastrophe
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Chapter 328 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon: I am the Catastrophe
Gazing at the foreign race’s town more than ten kilometers away, as well as the purple flames that continued to spread from the altar at the center of the town, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep growl.
“Those subordinates of the Black Oblivion King are polluting the land.”
The Silver Giant Dragon, lying beside it, nodded its head. It looked at the dark red magma swallowing the ground in the distance, its eyes slightly solemn, letting out a low growl.
“Roar! Yes, they are drawing the rule of the Black Oblivion King to erode this Heaven and Earth, and they have been eroding it for a long time. No wonder it feels so powerful to me.”
“These subordinate creatures are just like its power tentacles. The Heaven and Earth that have been eroded are equivalent to the extension of its domain, and it can speed up the evolution and strengthen its body.”
“At the same time, as the range of the domain assimilation becomes larger and larger, the power of its rules will also be amplified, and even transcend levels to compare with Mythical Titan-level creatures.”
“However, it is difficult to deeply assimilate a Heaven and Earth, and the progress of such erosion will be slow because it is essentially changing the rules of Heaven and Earth.”
As a mythical creature, the Silver Giant Dragon seemed foolish every day, but it knew more about this aspect than the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, more in detail.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spoke in a low voice: “It’s only more than a thousand kilometers away from the pathway, no wonder this Mythical Giant Beast hasn’t come for so long.”
The Black Oblivion King should have already discovered the situation there.
But the Blade Giant Beast was so powerful, and under such circumstances, it was dead. The enemy that killed it was likely to be a Mythical-level Giant Beast.
So it did not send its subordinates to continue to die, and planned to wait for the hell range to spread before taking action.
As for the time, there is no meaning for these creatures. One year is just a hibernation. By then, they will let the enemy who provoked them know the consequences.
However, this Mythical Giant Beast is very powerful, but the rule power induced by the altar statue still belongs to the Mythical-level, so…
“Roar! These evil creatures dare to pollute the world. As an upright, brave, and kind-hearted Giant Beast, we must stop them.”
Boom! The golden flames on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly burned, emitting a blazing high temperature and dazzling light, dispelling the darkness.
That terrifying Level 9 Giant Beast aura instantly shook Heaven and Earth. Under the invisible oppression, the foreign races more than ten kilometers away were suddenly in turmoil.
“It’s a strange Giant Beast aura.”
“Chieftain, a strange Giant Beast has been attracted by our sacrifice.”
The foreigner with colorful feathers on his head shouted: “We cannot let that Giant Beast interrupt the sacrificial ceremony. All warriors, take up your weapons and follow me.”
Boom!
This foreigner exploded with a sixth-level aura, and under the burning of purple flames, he rushed out with a roar, his eyes fanatical and fearless.
Among the other foreigners, thousands of them burst out with Level 4 and Level 5 power fluctuations. The strongest one, with a red pattern on his face, even reached the Level 6 Peak.
But just as these foreigners were sweeping out with their five-meter-long spears, their figures came to an abrupt halt.
The ground trembled as a Giant Beast more than two hundred meters long, almost a hundred meters tall when walking, slowly approached, its invisible aura filling the air with a heavy oppressive feeling.
The golden flames burned on its body, and with each step, the ground would instantly melt, forming a lava river hundreds of meters wide, its momentum terrifying and horrifying.
In addition to the terrifying black-red Colossal Beast, there was also a Silver Giant Dragon behind it.
Although this Silver Giant Dragon was smaller in size, it still had a shoulder height of more than sixty meters, resembling a moving small hill.
At this moment, under the illumination of the golden flames, the semi-transparent crystal-like silver scale armor on the silver giant dragon’s body shone brightly, appearing very beautiful and majestic.
Under the pressure of the two Level 9 Giant Beasts, even the fanatically devoted foreigners felt their bodies heavy and were heavily pressed to the ground, their faces full of horror.
At this moment, only that foreigner with gorgeous feathers on his head had a special force emanating from his body, so he could barely stand. He hurriedly made a series of gurgling noises as if trying to communicate with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the others.
During the conversation, he also made threatening gestures, pointing with difficulty at the Statue of the King of Obsidian Destruction in the distance, burning with purple flames.
As the leader of the foreigners shouted fanatically, the black-red Colossal Beast stopped a few hundred meters away, and all the foreigners thought this terrifying Giant Beast was frightened by the name of the Black Oblivion King.
But at this moment, the mouth of the black-red Colossal Beast in the distance opened slightly, and the golden light flashed inside. A heaven-burning, ocean-boiling golden flame erupted.
Boom!
The Heaven Burning Golden Flame destroyed everything. When it fell on the ground, dirt and rocks melted into magma, and hundreds of foreigners that were covered instantly vanished into nothingness.
Boom boom boom!!
The scorching energy set off explosions, with the scorching shock wave sweeping through a range of thousands of meters. In an instant, the foreign race’s protective energy collapsed, and they were directly burned into ashes with screams.
In just the blink of an eye, the range of a kilometer in front of them had turned into Lava Ruins under the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s casual breath, and more than a thousand foreigners who were Level 4 or higher were annihilated.
This is the horror of Mythical-level combat power.
In front of creatures of this level, the number has no meaning. Only the power of the same level can fight against it.
After casually annihilating these subordinates of the Black Oblivion King, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stepped heavily and quickly entered the range of purple flames together with the magma.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, the purple flames that had eroded the earth within a few kilometers range blazed, and the Heaven Burning Golden Flame on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon erupted and exploded.

chapters.title: Chapter 740: 328 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon: I am the Calamity_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Chapter 328 Thunderflame Emperor Dragon: I am the Calamity_2
However, the faint regulation that generates the purple flame was not yet enough to shake the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared from behind: “Roar! Tim Abott, destroy the altar and the statue bearing faith, and the Hellfire they invoke will disappear.”
“Stop him.”
“We cannot let him destroy the sacrificial ceremony.”
“For the Great King of Black Annihilation, the Supreme God.”
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon approached the altar amidst the explosive impact of the purple flame, those common creatures of different races, who had initially retreated to the safety of the buildings, rushed out, shouting words that could not be understood.
Whip-whip-whip~!
From the hands of these level 3 and rare level 4 beings of different races, black spears that were four to five meters long burst out with sharp, piercing sounds, as if they were cannonballs.
Puff, puff, puff~!
These long spears, which could penetrate armored cars, turned into ashes when they were just a few dozen meters away from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, directly hit by the high-temperature radiation dissipated by the invisible golden flames.
“I, am destruction.” Along with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s roar, the dazzling golden flames and purple halo on its body blasted out.
Bang!
With the devastating explosion of the golden flame, lands within a kilometer radius shattered, cracked, and melted into magma, forming circles of fire barriers flying around, covering the sky.
Everywhere it passed, buildings collapsed, countless creatures of different races were annihilated without even a chance to react, far away it looked like a continuously expanding circular light sphere has appeared on the earth.
Simultaneously, under the explosion of the purple halo, the air within a ten-kilometer radius sizzled with corrosion, vegetation withered and formed a dead zone within a ten-kilometer radius.
Within the blink of an eye, this town of different races with a population of several thousand disappeared without a trace under the domain explosion of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Even the earth was scraped off a layer, forming a magma fire sea within a radius of more than a thousand meters, and the scorching high temperature raised the temperature by hundreds of degrees Celsius in an area of several kilometers.
In addition, the Purple Void Poison that turned a ten-kilometer radius into a dead zone, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at this moment was like a real disaster beast.
After casually erasing the insects around, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned its head towards the altar.
Under its domain, a rule power on the statute of the King of Black Annihilation transformed into a purple halo, blocking off the flame domain around the altar.
A rule barrier, huh.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the statue of the King of Black Annihilation and the altar surrounded by the halo, with a golden purple flame that was equal to the power of the rule jumping on its right claw.
Boom! Under the claw of the Heaven Burning Golden Flame and the Purple Void Poison, the purple halo only slightly hindered it before it exploded and shattered, and the statue and the altar collapsed.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned its head: “Roar! Scythia, come extinguish the fire with a breath of chill.”
Whoosh!
Instantly, a gust of white chill fell from the sky. The flame around the shattered altar was extinguished one by one, and the magma was frozen, covered with a layer of frost in the blink of an eye.
Boom! The Silver Giant Dragon retracted its wings and fell from the sky, slamming hard onto the frozen layer of magma. In an instant, the earth shattered and a violent wind howled.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon did not pay it any mind, as it was joyfully stretching out its huge claw excitedly, turning over the altar debris in search of the Life Crystal.
One, two, three…
Soon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had turned over the rubble from the altar and collected nearly a hundred level 4 and level 5, and a few level 6 Life Crystals.Even it can’t help but sneer with satisfaction at that moment.
Looking at those crystals, the Silver Giant Dragon also roared excitedly, “Roar! Tim Abott, these subordinates of the King of Black Annihilation have gathered many Life Crystals.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled in agreement, “Roar! This bounty is a pleasant surprise.”
Its original target when it came here was to first kill all the subordinates of the King of Black Annihilation, devouring them to enhance its strength, then eradicate the king himself.
But to his surprise, he had already gathered nearly a hundred high-level crystals just after entering.
Although the life energy in the crystals had dissipated a lot due to the sacrificial ritual, the full conversion should still result in a few thousand attribute points.
And this is just a small town belonging to a subordinate of the King of Black Annihilation.
“Roar! These minions of the King of Black Annihilation polluted the earth, transformed everything into the Death Forbidden Area, we must prevent these evil creatures from destroying the world.”
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded excitedly, “Roar! We must stop these evil creatures from destroying the world, the Great Sethia wants to see rivers of blood.”
At the moment when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon destroyed the altar and wiped out the different races,
The fiery sea that looked like molten magma exploded with a loud bang and a fierce head, as large as a mountain, emerged. Hot magma flowed down the gaps of its scale armor like a waterfall.
The head of the non-dragon-like Black Colossus had three pairs of spiral horns slanting towards the sky, surrounded by purplish-red flames, distorting the void and exuding a terrifying aura.
Kaltos, the awakened King of Black Annihilation, felt a slight sense, then turned his head to look into the distance.
A few kilometers away, a beast more than 280 meters long, exuding the aura of a Late Stage 9 creature, was in hibernation.
As this creature slept, each inhalation and exhalation created a hot raging wind, absorbing the rich energy with a faint aura of law around it.
Kaltos opened his mouth slightly and let out a low growl that shook the space, “Turel, at the edge of Hell expanding in the southeast, one of my Law Imprints has been destroyed.”
“Other than that, I’ve lost the sense of two fanatics in that group of subordinates. They’re probably dead. Go check it out.”
The giant beast, resembling a Western Dragon and covered in blue-green scales, with three large python heads, opened its eyes and slowly rose.
“Yes, My King.”
Over the years, while the subordinates of the King of Black Annihilation were polluting the earth and expanding their domains, they were often attacked by extraordinary creatures, sometimes even attracting level eight or level nine Giant Beasts.
But just as that Giant Beast was about to leave, Kaltos suddenly growled, “Wait, I remember that area is close to one of the indigenous world passageways.”
“Turel, be careful when you go there. I’ve contacted Kol earlier and got no response from there. Something must have happened.”
“Yes, My King.” The giant beast respectfully nodded its head, then the surrounding bluish-green flames burst, transforming into a domain surrounding it and rocketed upwards.
After the three-headed Python Dragon Beast disappeared, the Black Colossus with cold eyes and low voice said, “Is it the rebellion of the Giant Beasts whose lands were invaded, or that Mythical Creature who destroyed My Law Projection has come?”
After saying this, Kaltos already had the answer in his heart.
Kol, the Blade Giant Beast, lost contact earlier, then an incident happened at the edge of the Hell Domain which was expanding in the same direction, a faith statue containing Law Imprints was destroyed.
“Roar! Looking for death, I haven’t gotten around to causing you trouble yet, but dare to come.”
Boom! In an instant, the entire Magma Fire Sea exploded, and a horrifying creature over a thousand meters long, as huge as a mountain, slowly rose.
Boom boom boom! Countless magmas fell from its body, forming a series of waterfalls several hundred meters high, which was an awe-inspiring sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 741: 329: Ancient Creature, Sword Master Lei Yan
chapters.content:
Chapter 741: Chapter 329: Ancient Creature, Sword Master Lei Yan
In the dark night, a huge moon as big as the sun slowly rises.
The mythical world is vast and boundless, but when the moon rises, it seems as if space and time have twisted.
Apart from places obscured by cloud mist and sky-touching trees, all parts of the mythical world can see the moon in the sky, and its silver light penetrates layers of clouds, bringing some brightness to the dark earth.
In the center of the earth shrouded in black clouds, there is a black mountain range stretching for thousands of miles, with a volcano over 5,000 meters high at the end of the range.
Above the mountainside of the volcano, black clouds formed by volcanic toxic smoke surround it. The massive volcano mouth swirls with magma, and the blazing red light it emits lights up the sky.
Roar!
From the volcano mouth, with a roar, a giant beast nearly 300 meters long, resembling a giant dragon without wings, and with three huge python heads, soars into the sky.
Blue-green flames surround it, forming a domain covering a range of 800 meters. The invisible Late Stage 9 aura it emits vibrates the sky, creating a sonic boom.
Such power instantly attracts the attention of countless different races below.
At the foot of the mountain, countless gray stone houses have been built on the dry land, stretching for tens of miles and forming a rough and massive city.
This city can accommodate millions of different races. However, due to environmental reasons, the degree of civilization is quite low.
But because of Kaltos’s favor, these different races, apart from the young ones, mostly have the physique of Level 4 cultivators and some bestowed talents.
The powerful ones are even comparable to Level 5, Level 6, and even Level 7, and when gathered together, they are quite astonishing.
However, at this time, only tens of thousands of people are in the city. As the Three-headed Python Dragon Giant Beast roars into the sky, many different races look up subconsciously, their faces showing devotion and fanaticism.
“It’s Turel The Divine Envoy.”
“The Divine Envoy seems to be flying to the southeast. There’s trouble at the boundary.”
“It might be those damn giant beasts. They have been preventing us from disseminating our God’s glory and turning the land into a scorching place.”
Boom!
A huge claw, burning with purple flames, falls on the edge of the volcano mouth. In an instant, mountain rocks collapse, the air explodes, and numerous fragments of rocks melt into the magma river and flow down along the mountainside.
The black colossus is hundreds of meters high with only half of its body exposed, and its purple flames burn in an instant. A mythical aura bursts forth, surpassing all living beings.
Boom!
Panic spreads under the terrifying pressure causing the black clouds to dissipate and form rings of cloud rings that burst out for tens of miles. In an instant, all the Level 5 different races in the city fall to their knees, their faces fanatical.
“We greet our God.”
However, Kaltos does not pay attention to the subordinates below. His gaze follows the direction of the Three-headed Python Dragon’s flight, waiting for feedback from that side.
Although he suspects that the mythical creature behind the force called Dragon Palace in the indigenous world has come over, it is, after all, just a guess.
So he sent the Three-headed Python Dragon to take a look.
If it really is the arrival of that mythical giant beast, its death doesn’t matter. He can see the exact appearance of the giant beast through the mark left on the Three-headed Python Dragon earlier.
Back then, when he descended into the indigenous world with a wisp of will and transformed into a projection using the Scale of Laws, he was destroyed by the opponent’s manifested rule projection.
Obviously, the opponent’s strength is above his.
But he doesn’t have a clear concept of whether the realm of that silver giant dragon is late-stage mythical, mythical peak, or even stronger. So he can’t go there rashly.
In the Hell Divine Territory’s center, his strength is the strongest. As long as no Titan-level creatures descend, he fears no other mythical giant beasts.
Even if the mythical giant beast is slightly stronger than him, he is confident that he can wear it down in a fight to the death.
Boom boom boom!
Under the domain’s guidance, the Three-headed Python Dragon travels twice the speed of sound at an altitude of ten thousand meters, creating sonic booms around it and rapidly retreating the ground below.
As a land giant beast, the Three-headed Python Dragon is not good at flying, and it is already going all out to reach twice the speed of sound.
It dares not defy the orders of the Black Oblivion King. If it angers the brutal mythical giant beast, it might be eaten whole.
Such a thing had happened before, so no giant beasts usually like to linger around the Black Oblivion King.
In the energy infused with the aura of the laws, their strength would improve faster, and they would have a greater chance to enter the quasi-mythical level.
Boom! The Three-headed Python Dragon’s body sinks as it rushes out of the black clouds, exposing the apocalypse-like earth below in an instant.
The rolling mountains are dry and broken, with no trace of green vegetation or life. In the cracks, the blazing magma burns and flows like veins.
At the same time, on the rapidly retreating land, you can occasionally see some town buildings.
However, as the different races driving the hell magma leave, these towns are abandoned.

chapters.title: Chapter 742: 329: Ancient Creature, Sword Master Thunderflame_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 742: Chapter 329: Ancient Creature, Sword Master Thunderflame_2
From a high altitude, this area looked like a black scar on the earth.
Boom!
The Three-headed Python Dragon descended from the sky, instantly shattering the cooled ground, scattering countless pieces of dirt and rocks mixed with the shockwave that spread out for miles.
The three huge python heads looked around, their gaze sweeping over the broken altar, sensing the scorching, destructive aura lingering in the air, and a look of seriousness appeared in their eyes.
The enemy that destroyed this place was powerful; just the lingering power in the air made it instinctively feel somewhat dangerous.
But…
The Three-headed Python Dragon stared at the enormous but smaller footprints of the two Giant Beasts on the ground in the distance, puzzled.
“The enemy that destroyed this place is very powerful, and there are two of them. The strongest one should be above quasi-mythical, otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to break the Law Imprints on the statue.”
“But why are their footprints so small?”
While the three python heads of the Three-headed Python Dragon were looking around and sensing all kinds of information with their snake tongues out.
Behind a mountain peak more than ten kilometers away, two ferocious giant dragon heads slowly emerged, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon with their energy fluctuations converged.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled softly, “We’ve been waiting for almost three hours, and finally, some beasts have come. As expected, after the statue containing Law Power was destroyed, the other party will have some perception.”
The Silver Giant Dragon imitated the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s posture, lying on the ground, and stuck its head out sneakily from behind the mountain peak, letting out a low, excited growl.
“Roar! Tim Abott, it’s just an ‘ordinary’ Level 9 Late-stage Extraordinary Giant Beast. Let the Great Sethia take care of it.”
As a King-level Giant Beast with dual top-tier talents, the Silver Giant Dragon was only at the Level 9 Early Stage but was not afraid of the Level 9 Late Stage Giant Beast, even looking eager to try at the moment.
It also wanted to experience the feeling of fighting across levels, brutally defeating those Giant Beasts that were higher in level and larger in size than itself.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook its head slightly and growled, “I’ll do it. This is the territory of the Black Oblivion King; we need a quick and decisive battle to avoid problems over time.”
With that, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s enormous body slowly stood up, and an astonishing pressure burst forth in an instant.
Boom! The ground shook, and the mountain peaks collapsed.
In an instant, the Three-headed Python Dragon, which was more than ten kilometers away, let out a roar of surprise and anger, the surrounding blue-green flames erupted, forming a domain around it, and the three python heads’ mouths were shining with light.
Boom!
A claw wrapped in golden-blue flames fell from the sky onto the breath, causing a dazzling explosion in the air, forming a series of blue and green halos that exploded outwards.
But as the most potent attack method of the Giant Beast, the breath of the Three-headed Python Dragon was suppressed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and its terrifyingly powerful right claw descended from the sky amidst the violent energy explosion halos.
Boom!
Under a strike equivalent to a rule, the Three-headed Python Dragon’s domain collapsed, forming a circle of scorching, corrosive shock fire rings that exploded outwards.
In the instant the domain was blasted, a series of bluish-black thunders exuding an aura of destruction flashed, enveloping the entire Three-headed Python Dragon.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the bombardment of hundreds of Annihilation True Thunder in an instant, the Three-headed Python Dragon roared in fear and anger, the external energy shield constantly trembled, and the invisible burst of impact force caused it to keep retreating.
At this moment, a tail with black and red sharp blades formed by scale armor tore through the air, leaving a pitch-black crack wherever it passed, even tearing a rift in the space of the mythical world.
Plop plop!!
Under the terrifying Tail Blade that cut through the Void, two of the Three-headed Python Dragon’s heads were instantly severed, and the scorching hot blood sprayed out like a flood, shooting up hundreds of meters high.
Then, without waiting for the Three-headed Python Dragon to react, the horrifying black and red Tail Blade traced past its body, cutting off its double claws and legs at lightning speed.
In just an instant, this Level 9 Late-stage Giant Beast hadn’t even reacted before it was dismembered by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and its enormous body violently slammed into the ground with a thud.
The scorching hot blood gushing from those wounds instantly dyed the ground red at this moment.
Only then did the remaining python head of the Three-headed Python Dragon let out a scream, lying on the ground and watching the ferocious behemoth standing in front of it like a demon, especially the terrifying Tail Blade swaying slightly behind it.
At this moment, not to mention the Three-headed Python Dragon, even the Silver Giant Dragon, who was also witnessing for the first time the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s terrifying ‘Sword Skill’, couldn’t believe its eyes.
With the strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it was possible to suppress or even annihilate this Giant Beast instantaneously.
However, the fact that it had instantly dismembered the opponent with such agility was somewhat unexpected, or perhaps a little discordant.
After all, the Silver Giant Dragon had become accustomed to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s overbearing fighting style.
With streaks of golden fire burning on its body, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked down at the Giant Python Beast with cold, ruthless eyes and a deep growl in its voice, “Do you want to die, or do you want to live?”
Immediately, the remaining python head of the Three-headed Python Dragon hurriedly hissed, “Roar! Live, I want to live.”
As a Giant Beast standing at the transcendent top, the Three-headed Python Dragon naturally didn’t want to die if it didn’t have to. As for betrayal, there was no such thing as loyalty for Giant Beasts.
They merely submitted to the Black Oblivion King’s power and some benefits.
“Roar! How many Level 9 Giant Beasts are there under the Black Oblivion King? What does it usually do? How strong is it? And is there any controlling power inside you?”
Instantly, hope appeared in the Three-headed Python Dragon’s eyes as it nodded hurriedly, “Yes, there is the King’s imprint in our hearts, and if I die, it will react at the first moment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 743: 329: Ancient Creature, Sword Master Thunderflame_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 743: Chapter 329: Ancient Creature, Sword Master Thunderflame_3
Tim Abbott’s voice was low, “Continue, what is the realm of the Black Oblivion King’s strength at?”
“Don’t hesitate, this King can sense if you’re lying. If you dare to conceal…” As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spoke, the Tail Blade behind it slightly swayed, tearing the air and making a tearing sound.
Under the threat of death, the Giant Beast shakily revealed everything it knew.
For example, the Black Oblivion King’s body size is over 1,100 meters, in the Mid-Mythical Stage, close to the Late Stage, but it is not afraid even of the Late Stage of the mythical world.
The so-called Core Range is an area that has been absolutely polluted and eroded, covering approximately 2,000 kilometers in diameter, according to the three-headed Python Dragon.
Next is the Middle Layer Region, with a range of three to four thousand kilometers. Many parts of the land have been eroded by hell magma and the ‘strength’ that fills the Heaven and Earth has been polluted.
In this range, the Black Oblivion King can still mobilize the thick power of Heaven and Earth to create multiple times its combat power, making his strength quite terrifying.
In their current location, they are at the outer edge, where the Black Oblivion King’s strength does not have much amplification.
Under the Black Oblivion King are two quasi-mythical beasts, eight Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts, and millions of scaled fire alien race subordinates.
These scaled fire alien races are divided into four major tribes, driving the hell magma to spread around, drawing the power of the Black Oblivion King to erode the earth and expand hell.
In this area of more than ten thousand kilometers, it all belongs to the Black Oblivion King’s territory, but the north and south directions need to be heavily guarded.
To the north is the Black Mist Sea with ferocious giant beasts appearing from time to time, hunting those alien race subordinates. It is guarded by the quasi-mythical Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
On the west side is the Void Rift, filled with danger, thus not daring to enter it. To the south is the Endless Mist Area, where creepy and terrifying creatures emerge from time to time.
Even the Black Oblivion King once entered it and quickly retreated.
Usually, there are six Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts scattered at the southern boundary, guarding the alien subordinates drawing the hell magma.
About half a month ago, an ancient being appeared, devouring three Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts and more than ten million alien race subordinates, drawing a vast portion of the Hell Domain for itself.
Facing this terrifying ancient being, even the Black Oblivion King did not dare to provoke it. They could only wait for it to leave before sending their subordinates to continue eroding the misty area.
This is the mythical world, where even mythical giant beasts cannot claim absolute safety.
Compared to the three dangerous directions, this side is relatively safe.
The pathway leading to the aboriginal world is guarded by a more powerful Blade Giant Beast. All the creatures above level eight in the surrounding area have been killed by it out of boredom, making it easy for the subordinates to advance the hell magma.
When the Python Dragon Giant Beast finished speaking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon appeared lost in thought.
A territory of more than ten thousand kilometers, initially with eight, but now only four Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts remain, one quasi-mythical, and a million cannon fodder subordinates.
Of course, these cannon fodder are in the context of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Relative to these subordinates, the strength of the Black Oblivion King is still within the range of response, or, if there was no Hell Domain to support it, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would have the confidence to suppress and kill it.
But it is a bit troublesome in the Domain’s Core Range. The Late-Mythical Stage power, combined with an unknown rule ability, makes even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon not dare to underestimate it.
With one Deification Talent and seven Top-tier talents, its strength at the Mid Level 9 stage has surpassed the late period, reached the quasi-mythical level, and approached the Early Mythical Stage.
At full strength, in its deep red form, its power can cross into the Mid-Mythical Stage and is even considered very strong in that stage.
It can’t be helped; it has too many talents.
As for Late Mythical Stage, since it has never fought against mythical giant beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon does not know if it can compete. It might lose, but it might also tear its opponent apart.
Besides, those aliens not only help the Black Oblivion King herd hell magma but also have the task of eroding the Heaven and Earth and planting Black Melting Divine Fruits.
This is a divine fruit that grows by absorbing the essence of Heaven and Earth, similar to divine objects and treasures. This is also the reason why everything is destroyed where the Hell Domain passes.
The Divine Fruits, condensed to their fullest extent, can provide growth and promotion even to the Black Oblivion King.
At this thought, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes showed a trace of excitement; there was such a good thing available.
Just then, the Python Dragon Giant Beast raised its head, looking at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and carefully roared, “Roar! I, I’ve finished telling you everything, I didn’t lie to you.”
“Roar! I know.” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, and then the purple flame wound around its black and red Tail Blade.
“Roar! No, you said…”
In the midst of the horrified roar, the huge head of the Python Dragon Giant Beast was instantly beheaded, and the soul will was exterminated by the fusion power entwining the Tail Blade.
Looking at the Python Dragon Giant Beast with its eyes still wide open in death, the Silver Giant Dragon proudly let out a low growl: “Roar! Fool, Tim Abbott only allowed you to choose between life and death; he never said he would spare you.”
Boom!
Just at the moment of the Python Dragon Giant Beast’s death, a surge of black and purple power burst from its chest, soaring into the sky. In an instant, an aura of mythical dominion descended.
Only to see the black and purple power condense in the sky, forming a huge black head… Puff!
The Tail Blade entwined with golden blue flames comparable to the power of rules swept across, instantly annihilating the mark projection that the Black Shadow King was about to condense.
Roar! Amidst the angry roar of the void, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed to gain an understanding of the Black Oblivion King’s true power and made its terrifying plans accordingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 744: 330 Attributes 'Dragon', Mythical Train (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: Chapter 330 Attributes ‘Dragon’, Mythical Train (Requesting Monthly Tickets)
“Tim Abott, why didn’t you wait for it to gather, to see what it wanted to say?”
The silver giant dragon looked at the law power being shattered in an instant by the tail blade of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and then slowly dispersing, a confused look in its eyes.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon replied without looking back: “Scythia, do you think this is some kind of anime where we wait for the villain to show up, wait for it to finish spouting threats before taking action?”
Of course, its intention to avoid unnecessary talk was to buy a little more time, to confuse the Black Oblivion King with asymmetric information, and to gather more crystals.
It also wanted to see if it could break into the Middle Layer Region, steal the Black Melting Divine Fruit that only a few large tribes of subordinates could ‘cultivate’, and kill the ninth-level late-stage beast guarding it.
Then increase its own strength before dealing with the mythical giant beast.
“Tim Abott, what’s anime?” the silver giant dragon roared, looking confused.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon muttered in response: “Anime is a type of projection in the human world, displayed through virtual images, similar to the stories your mother told you when you were a cub.”
“Tim Abott, you know so much? You even know about the humans of that primitive world.”
The silver giant dragon then expressed more confusion: “Tim Abott, you said that those humans on land are very scary, how do you know all of this?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spoke in a low voice: “Because I once communicated with a human, who I consider a friend, so I know some things about the human world.”
“So that’s how, Tim Abott, is that human very powerful?” the silver giant dragon roared curiously.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thought for a moment: “That human wasn’t very strong at the beginning, I was only Level 5 then, but he is a genius, not inferior to me.”
“Now, a few months have passed, his strength has also become very strong, although, he is at the early stage of level eight, but even Kidora may not be his opponent.”
“Roar! How is that possible!”
The silver giant dragon roared loudly, its eyes wide: “Kidora is a Level 9 Beast of the King’s bloodline, and he is not even an opponent for a human in the early stages of Level 8?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded, his voice low: “Exactly, that human is very powerful, he killed an early stage Level 8 enemy when he was in the late stage of Level 6.”
“And after he broke through to the mid-stage of Level 7, he even killed an early-stage Level 9 Black Flame Phoenix Monstrosity, very terrifying.”
Hiss!
The silver giant dragon took a deep breath, causing a gust of wind, and a shock in his eyes: “Roar! Are humans this terrible, a mid-stage Level 7 has killed an early-stage Level 9 Beast?”
Just as the silver dragon was shocked by the strength of the humans, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared: “Scythia, help me carry this food, we don’t have much time, let’s go get a big one.”
With that, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon reached out with its claws to grab the giant python’s body, its wings of thunder shining behind it, and with a loud rush, it soared into the sky.
“Wait for me, Tim Abott.”
The silver giant dragon returned to its senses, grabbed the limbs of the giant beast, severed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and with a swing of its wings, it transformed into a silver ray of light and chased after it.
As for the three python heads, it didn’t care about them because its claws weren’t enough.
High up in the sky, tens of thousands of meters above, boundless dark clouds are tumbling, like a world-obliterating black carpet, illuminated by the silver moonlight, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was eating while flying.
Under those sharp and massive teeth, the scale armor of the giant python beast was crushed, its flesh and blood ripped apart, and then devoured and ground up in the loud rumbling chewing.
The flesh and blood of a late-stage Level 9 beast had just been swallowed and was quickly digested by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s stomach that was like a world-exterminating furnace.
With sufficient biological energy, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body grew visibly faster, enlarging in the blink of an eye.
The silver giant dragon couldn’t resist coming closer, its wings fluttering behind it, and roared curiously: “Tim Abott, why are you growing so fast?”
“Well, of course, I grow after eating, right?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked back at it curiously and roared: “If we didn’t grow after eating, what else would we eat?”
It makes so much sense, but something feels off.
“No, what I mean is, why are you growing so quickly?” the silver giant dragon reacted.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thought about it: “It should be because I have a strong digestive ability, anyway, I’ve been growing fast since I was a cub, after eating and eating, I became this big.”
“Why do all these great talents belong to you? The Great Sethia also wants to grow big after eating.” In envy, the silver giant dragon was about to drool again.
The ability to grow after eating, the innate ability to increase power at will, Tim Abott is too abnormal, why isn’t the Great Sethia abnormal?
While the silver giant dragon was envious, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was circling around the edge of the Hell Domain, locating its target while eating the beast’s flesh and blood.
As it tore and chewed with big bites, hot blood occasionally sprayed out from the sky, making it appear very brutal and terrifying.
As its strength increased, the speed at which the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon ate and digested also became faster. The over 280-meter-long beast was finished in just over an hour.
A late-stage Level 9 beast not only was nearly twice as long as the early-stage Level 9 beasts and several times larger overall, but the power contained in its flesh and blood was also more vigorous.
With enough biological energy, the size of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exploded by more than ten meters, reaching a length of 270 meters.
Feeling the stronger power within its body, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had murderous intent in its golden vertical pupils. Sure enough, the ‘resources’ in the mythical world were more abundant.
At this time, below on the ground, an altar burning with purple flames and the surrounding Scale Fire Alien Tribe devoutly offering sacrifices came into the view of the two beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 745: 330 Attribute 'Dragon', Mythical Train (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: Chapter 330 Attribute ‘Dragon’, Mythical Train (Requesting Monthly Pass)_2
“`
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes suddenly lit up, as another Life Crystal had been harvested.
Boom!
Golden flames burned on the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and in an instant, it blasted through the air, descending from the sky at several times supersonic speed, like a comet hundreds of meters in size.
“Roar! The Great Sethia wants to see rivers of blood,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly.
On the Earth below, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon transformed into a world-ending meteor piercing through the thick, dark clouds, a golden light sparkled. Oblivious to what was about to happen, the alien tribes instinctively looked up.
“No!”
“Everyone, run!”
“Be careful.”
Boom!
Before the different races could react, the golden meteor struck the small town with the oppressive might of a Level 9 Giant Beast, instantly causing heaven and earth to turn upside down, and the land to sink.
The terrifying impact shattered the Earth in a radius of over a thousand meters in an instant, with dazzling light bursting forth upon the land.
Endless scorching magma and golden flames erupted, and a destructive impact obliterated everything in the vicinity.
In an instant, all buildings and houses melted and collapsed, while those Level 4 and Level 5, and a few Level 6 beings from different races were reduced to ashes in the first wave of the high-temperature assault.
…
Meanwhile, inside the small building, Jack Clark, who had been cultivating all night, slowly opened his eyes, revealing contemplation.
He stretched out his hand, and instantly the air in the room was suppressed and solidified by an invisible power, to the point where just a slight effort from Jack would cause the entire living room to collapse.
However, in the end, Jack didn’t press down; after all, he could test his strength outside.
“This power, is this what ‘dragon’ is?” he said.
With a thought, Jack summoned the attribute page.
Realm: Eight Layer Heaven [Early Stage]
Dragon. Physique: 1.0120 [10120 points, having transcended limits of physical form to acquire Dragon attributes, surpassing transcendent species in defense, strength, recovery, resistance, and endurance]
Dragon. Strength: 1.0423 [10423 points, gained the Dragon attribute ‘Constant’, with every 1 point attribute increase, basic strength will receive a constant boost]
Dragon. Agility: 0.9235 [9235 points, under the influence of the Dragon attribute, your speed will no longer be hindered by heaven and earth]
Spirit: 9301
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon devoured the Python Giant Beast earlier, as a feedback effect, Jack’s body had also undergone a significant enhancement, with both physique and strength breaking through the 10,000 point mark.
And the moment physique and strength broke through 10,000 points, the Emperor Dragon Essence Blood that had merged with and altered Jack’s genetic physique experienced some sort of sublimation.
This change reflected on the attribute panel as the so-called ‘Dragon.’
With a human body comparable to a Dragon-type Giant Beast, possessing physical strength not inferior to equivalent Dragon-type Giant Beasts, and moreover, equipped with the cultivation of the True Martial Practitioner’s rule of law.
One could say that at this moment, Jack has achieved the most perfect form that Genetic Martial Arts has always strived for.
A perfect fusion of True Martial power and the Beast’s strength.
Yet although his body has become a dragon in human form, his soul remained unchanged. This likely had to do with the strength of his soul; it was so strong that even a dragon couldn’t affect its essence.
Wuu wuu wuu!!
“`
At that moment, a deep whistle of a train came from the distance.
With the locomotive’s long whistle, a rumbling sound traveled from the direction of Base No.1.
From a high altitude, one could see a white train over thirty meters thick bursting out of a silver vortex and thundering down the track into the distance.
The train was three kilometers long, and as it passed through the forward base, the mythical breath it emitted left Justin Welan and the others utterly shocked.
Only after watching the train charge into the wall of mist ahead did everyone on the platform let out a sigh of relief.
Justin Welan forced a smile and said, “I can’t believe I just got scared by a train.”
Next to him, Sheehan Bland burst into laughter, “It’s normal, don’t underestimate that world train, it was forged from the corpse of a Mythical Dragon Python giant beast slain by the True Martial Heavenly King.”
“This Mythical Giant Beast possessed space talent, and after being refined into a train, its interior contained vast space, capable of holding mountain-like supplies without causing any vibrations when passing through the pathway.”
“Mythical Giant Beast!”
Those hearing about it for the first time immediately showed looks of astonishment on their faces.
Sheehan Bland was quite pleased with the shock on the students’ faces, as he had a similar reaction when he first heard about it.
“That’s right, and not just one, the Federation currently controls three pathways with world trains made from the corpses of Mythical Giant Beasts coming and going, mainly responsible for the transportation of personnel and supplies.”
While everyone was still in shock, out of the distant mist, a similarly huge blue train appeared, thundering with terrifying pressure as it approached the forward station before gradually coming to a stop.
“Sky Way Train has arrived, please, Special Forces Soldiers applying to enter the mythical world proceed in an orderly fashion into Carriage No. 103. No noise is permitted on board.”
Watching the giant doors slowly open, Howard Lambert took a deep breath and turned to Jack Clark and the others, “Jack, Student Aiken, and Mr. Willard, I’m going to head over now.”
Justin Welan waved his hand with a cheery smile, “Go ahead, just be careful over there, and don’t kick the bucket before I get in.”
Damn! Howard Lambert flipped him the bird.
Jack Clark smiled faintly and said, “Good luck, Howard. I hope by the next time we meet, you’ve broken through to the Eighth Layer Heaven.”
Howard’s talent was already good, and this time in the relic, he obtained an inheritance from an ancient civilization comparable to a King-level War General, becoming a Ninth Heaven Expert was only a matter of time.
Of course, the premise is that he would survive.
At this moment, Damon Lopes also came over, chuckling, “Brother Callum, come in early, I’m waiting for the day you dominate on the frontline battlefield.”
Jack Clark smiled, “It shouldn’t take too long.”
This time it wasn’t just Howard Lambert; Damon Lopes, Betty Leinster, Denny Rhodes, Eddy Keller, and other geniuses above the Sixth Layer Heaven had all applied to enter the mythical world.
After exchanging greetings, as the doors of the Sky Way Train slowly closed, the giant train thundered towards Base No.1 and plunged into the pathway.
This train was not only taking Howard Lambert and the others into the mythical world, but it was also loaded with countless high-yield missiles and even ‘enhanced’ supplies like Nuclear Bombs and Hydrogen Bombs to replenish the consumables on the Frontline Battlefield.
As the shaking in the distant pathway gradually subsided, Jack Clark turned to Justin Welan and Crystal Lewis, encouraging them, “Mr. Willard, Class Leader, keep working hard on your cultivation, break through to the Sixth Layer as soon as possible.”
“Once you get to the mythical world, you’ll realize that is where everything truly begins.”
As for Jane Aiken, she could go in at any time and didn’t need Jack’s encouragement.
Justin immediately retorted, “… Jack, you talk as if you’ve already been to the mythical world.”
Jack Clark smiled, “Though I haven’t gone yet, I will probably be there in a few days. There’s no difference. You all get busy, I am heading over there for a bit.”
Saying that, Jack waved to everyone and in a flash, he headed towards the edge of the Void Rift a dozen kilometers away.
He was prepared to test a new combat technique he had contemplated last night and to see what changes had occurred to his physique and strength after acquiring the ‘dragon’.

chapters.title: Chapter 746: 331: Legendary Weapon, Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: Chapter 331: Legendary Weapon, Secret Technique
[Brothers, I adjusted the attribute page from the last chapter a bit. I was in too much of a rush yesterday and some of the data wasn’t rigorous enough.]
At the edge of the Void Rift, space was sealed off by the powerful power of the boundary wall, forming a rectangular dark fissure thousands of kilometers high and ten thousand meters wide, an awe-inspiring sight.
Jack Clark stood on the edge of the rift, gradually releasing the restraint on his body. In an instant, an aura that seemed to crush the void and the earth spread out.
Even the surrounding air expanded under the pressure of such overbearing force, erupting in white shockwaves that radiated outwards for dozens of meters centered around him.
Underneath his feet, web-like cracks spread rapidly, followed by a thunderous collapse, forming a meteor crater over three meters deep and spanning more than ten meters, unable to bear the load.
Now, Jack’s pure physical physique could be compared to that of an initial stage of the eighth level dragon beast, and it was like compressing a beast over sixty meters long into two meters.
The extreme compression resulted in an even more powerful qualitative change, even gaining the true characteristics of a “dragon.”
Huff, huff!!
As the power of his flesh was fully unleashed, a terrifying aura burst forth. Jack, standing three meters “above” the ground, was surrounded by a raging wind, with dust and stones swirling around him, his presence incredibly imposing.
Seeing such a terrifying display from a distance, onlookers like Justin Welan and the others were shockingly moved,
Justin exclaimed in amazement, “Jack, this guy, ever since his physical talent awakened, his body has become stronger and stronger. I feel that the level of his physical talent is no less than that of an Innate Awakening.”
Next to him, Jane Aiken, with her arms crossed and a calm gaze watching the scene unfold from afar, indifferently said, “It’s not that it’s not lower, but rather that the physical talent he awakened is of the Innate level.”
“So, does that mean that in our class, Jack’s talent is actually the best?” Crystal Lewis pondered thoughtfully.
Mandy Lewis gently shook her head, “Sister, it’s not just his talent; his effort can’t be ignored either.”
Justin Welan nodded with some emotion. “That’s right, not only does Jack have stronger talents than us, he even works harder than us. That’s what I admire the most about him.”
Crystal also nodded in wholehearted agreement.
Indeed, if not for the ‘pressure’ brought by Jack, Justin and Crystal, with their good talents, would also be among the top ten in the First-class Martial Arts School.
But under normal conditions, it would be their limit to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven after one semester, and this was considering that the cultivation environment was now better.
Because humans are a complex species, when surrounded by a circle of excellent people, they instinctively aspire to be like those who are more outstanding and become more diligent.
While Justin and the others were expressing their astonishment from afar, Jack was carefully feeling the changes within himself.
For example, his vitality had become more exuberant, making him feel like as long as there was life force, he wouldn’t ‘die’. His cells could divide and replicate without limits.
Besides that, it seemed… there wasn’t any other significant feature, at least not a clear surge in strength.
This time, the ‘dragon’ traits he acquired could be seen as an overall optimization of his previous fusion with the Emperor Dragon Essence Blood, an upgrade in his level of life.
“Level of life, like a Monarch?”
Thinking about it but unable to come up with anything, Jack finally shook his head and decided to try out the combat technique he had deduced the previous night, one that was uniquely his.
As a high-stage cultivator of the Eight Layer Heaven, Jack’s True Martial cultivation was also nearing the peak of Transcendence.
He could convert his physical power into ‘real’ dragon attributes, the True Dragon Power that could withstand missile explosions without harm, and the True Dragon Battle Body with dozens of times the power of Heaven and Earth.
With a base twenty times enhanced defense, twenty times strength, ten times agility, mastering Thunder and Heavenly Flame—the five Great Rune God Seed Species.
These boosts, combined with his terrifying physique, made his Power Explosion reach a terrifying level.
Added to that, the Transcendent enhancement and with heavy weapons striking at several to more than ten times supersonic speed, even an aircraft carrier would be sunk by a single strike from Jack, to say nothing of the Three-faced Six-armed Divine Combat Body.
Huff!! With a flip of his hand, Jack grasped the War Halberd. Taking a deep breath, suddenly the Heavenly Energy within hundreds of meters range went berserk, flowing towards him endlessly.
Boom! The Golden Halberd Radiance on the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd flickered, and with a thirty-fold boost from the power of Heaven and Earth, it instantly transformed into an eighty-meter-long Colossal War Halberd.
In an instant, a heavy and terrifying force spread out, and the eighty-meter-long Halberd Skill, surrounded by airwaves, radiated a presence that nearly reached the peak of the Eighth Layer Heaven.
The invisible sharpness emitted tore the surrounding air and the ground cracked with multiple crevices several to ten meters wide, terrifying and shocking.
But that wasn’t enough.
Suddenly, Jack’s brow flashed red light, and the Doomsday Purgatory Rune opened slowly like an eye being unsealed.
Instantly, Jack’s eyes turned blood-red, filled with ferocity and slaughter. The Prison Blood War Intent merged with the Doomsday Hell Runes, unfolding into a Blood Sea Field covering two hundred meters.
Boom!
Infinite red light flickered as the Heavenly Energy within a thousand-meter radius was drawn in. Under the fivefold increase from the Battle Intent and tenfold from the Doomsday Domain, the Golden War Halberd once again surged to a length of one hundred twenty meters.
And the Sea of Blood Hell contracted and converged, dyeing the Golden War Halberd a purplish-red, with countless grotesque polluted monsters howling and roaring faintly inside.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Amidst the convergence of powerful energy, the surrounding air exploded, creating raging winds and tearing the Earth apart, turning the several hundred-meter area into a scene of flying debris and darkness.
Hiss! Watching this scene, Crystal and the other spectators once again drew a sharp breath. This was too strong—a power that shouldn’t belong to someone of the Eighth Layer Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 747: 331: Legendary Weapon, Secret Technique_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Chapter 331: Legendary Weapon, Secret Technique_2
“It’s still not enough.”
Boom!
Accompanied by Jack Clark’s low shout, dazzling lightning burst forth from his body, a series of brilliant thunderbolts exploded, forming nine blue thunder rings encircling the War Halberd.
Under the intense pressure of the constraints, the hundred and twenty meter long purple-red War Halberd compressed, gradually shrinking to ten meters, emitting a dazzling radiance.
From a distance, it looked as if he was holding a +999 artifact in his hands.
At the same time, golden flames climbed up Jack Clark’s palms, merging into the halberd, continuously gathering and compressing at the edge of the blade, forming a dazzling golden-black radiance.
That was the phenomenon of exceedingly concentrated fervent energy eradicating everything material and energetic around it.
Only then did Jack Clark let out a fierce long howl, as the War Halberd in his hand, brimming with dazzling purple-red light, swept across, instantly shooting out a golden halberd radiance tens of meters long.
The half-moon-shaped beam attracted the energy of Heaven and Earth, swelling in the blink of an eye to over a hundred meters, spinning into a searing raging tornado that slashed onto a hillock a kilometer away.
Boom!
The two hundred meter high hillock was instantly bisected by the halberd’s radiance, its core turned to magma under the intense heat, while half the hillock was blown away.
Boom! The halberd’s radiance exploded, countless golden flames erupting, forming a sun with a diameter of over three hundred meters, surrounded by golden dragons of fire, covering hundreds of meters.
The terrifying heat and sharp energy shattered and melted everything around, including the hillock.
Before Justin Welan and others could react, Jack Clark slashed with his halberd again, instantly, a dazzling blue beam of radiance flashed across the sky, as if a vertical blue laser had suddenly appeared a kilometer away.
Boom!
The thundering blade laden with a destructive aura exploded, instantly creating a long ‘fine’ crack over five hundred meters long and about ten meters wide on the Earth, with the surrounding dirt charred black.
Compared to the intense heat of the Heavenly Flame Rift, the True Thunder Rift was faster and more piercing.
However, it was somewhat weaker in terms of instant wide-range destruction.
Unlike the colossal beasts which after breaking through to levels eight and nine, cause widespread destruction in battles due to their size, humans at higher levels have more extremely concentrated and powerful attacks on a single front.
After all, the disparity in size and total contained energy between humans and giant beasts is there.
Pondering, Jack Clark began to wildly wave the halberd, and in an instant, a flurry of golden and blue halberd radiances flew out wildly, constantly gathering and amplifying the energy of Heaven and Earth.
Boom boom boom!!
At this moment, Jack Clark was like a missile launcher, with explosive roars reverberating across the land and the radiance lighting up the sky.
At the forward base some ten kilometers away, everyone was startled, each leaping onto rooftops or structures, staring in shock at the dazzling light and the terrible energy fluctuations in the distance.
“What a formidable destructive impact, it’s comparable to the pinnacle of the Eighth Layer, right?”
“Not just that, looking at the extent of destruction and the energy emitted, it’s already comparable to the early stage of the Ninth Layer.”
“Hiss! Student Clark just broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven!”
Sheehan Bland slowly said, “After all, this is a legendary monster who condensed the Fourfold World during the breakthrough to the Eight Layer; it’s quite normal for his strength to span a major realm.”
Normal my foot.
They had been on the frontline battlefield for so many years, they had seen the Human Race’s prodigies and the demon king descendants of the Purgatory Demon Race.
But they had never seen a monster whose combat power was comparable to the early stage of the Ninth Layer while at the early stage of the Eighth Layer, and whose True Strength was abnormally dense and terrifying, capable of continuously erupting.
This sort of sustained destructive bombardment, even an expert of the early Ninth Heaven couldn’t withstand it.
The explosive Heavenly Flame Rift unleashed by the Great Sun Fire Dragon, the lightning-fast and incomparably sharp True Thunder Rift; these were the gains from Jack Clark’s enlightenment overnight.
The fusion of True Martial and Heavenly Flame abilities with the explosive power of the True Dragon, the scorching Golden Flame, the sharpness of the halberd, and the swift thunderous remote attack.
Each individual destructive attack reached the early stage of the Ninth Layer, and they could be released consecutively.
As for close combat, with his halberd mastery at a peak state, and terrifying reflexes and speed, even an opponent a major level higher couldn’t suppress him in close combat.
Boom!
Suddenly, centered around Jack Clark, an endless Sea of Blood unfolded, covering an area of hundreds of meters. The towering blood light glittered like the face of a ghostly deity, grim and terrifying.
A purple-black War Halberd, three hundred meters long and entwined with Thunderflame, shot up into the sky, swooshing down like a gigantic missile over a thousand meters away.
Boom!
In an instant, the heavens shattered and the Earth quaked as dazzling golden-blue and purple-red light swiftly expanded, transforming into a destructive Light Sphere with a five-hundred-meter radius in the blink of an eye.
Just as Justin Welan and the others thought the attack would explode like a Nuclear Bomb and had prepared to withstand the shockwave, the Light Sphere suddenly collapsed.
Inside the destructive energy, a vortex appeared and kept collapsing until the space itself broke apart with a roaring crash, leaving a pitch-black spot in the center that devoured everything.
In just the blink of an eye, that vortex, filled with terrifying energy, disappeared, annihilating everything.
Looking at the smoke and dust hovering over the shattered Earth’s center, and the five-hundred-meter-wide crater that seemed to have disappeared out of thin air, everyone’s eyes were filled with shock.
It’s actually not too difficult to withstand the release of explosive force; you just need to endure the impact of the instantaneous explosion.
But this kind of instant collapse, where all destructive forces are concentrated, is extremely terrifying; the core destructive force is dozens of times that of an expansive release.
Surrounded by the glow of blood, Jack Clark slowly exhaled and then nodded in satisfaction, “The power of this ‘Endless Destruction’ is not bad, but the Eight Desolation Heavy Halberd is a bit too light.”
As his body continued to strengthen, for Jack Clark, an eight-ton War Halberd had started to feel unbefitting, much like an adult wielding a foam weapon.
And next, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would soon make a breakthrough to late stage level nine. After slaying the Black Oblivion King, it should meet the requirement for the Fifth Evolution and break through to the Myth realm.
As a result, his body would also become more terrifying.
Therefore, it would be best to enhance the War Halberd’s weight to several thousands or even tens of thousands of tons, and its level needs to be upgraded to legendary, which is the weapon used by the Top-tier experts of the Nine Layers.
Weapons for cultivators below The Third Layer Heaven are made of alloy; it is only after breaking through the Fourth Layer that one learns the Weapon Casting Secret Skill and can forge their own Transcendent Weapons.
And after the Fourth Layer, the cultivators use low-order, or intermediate Transcendent Weapons; only after breaking through to the Seventh Layer Heaven and gathering Heavenly Energy can they forge Senior Transcendent Weapons.
Because the level of the weapon, the cultivator’s cultivation, and the Weapon Casting Secret Skill are directly related.
For instance, weapons belonging to experts in the Ninth Heaven, when being tempered with Top-tier Transcendent Materials, will also have their domain power fused into them, bestowing them with legendary attributes.
Weapons containing domain power have surpassed the common limits of Transcendent, becoming extremely powerful.
As for the weapons of king-level experts, they belong to the Law Level; entwined with their own laws, these can unleash even more potent combat capabilities.
In contemplation, Jack Clark stowed away his War Halberd, activated the Hidden Deity Glyphs to conceal his aura, and in an instant, he transformed from a humanoid Destruction Beast into a mild-mannered young man.
Watching the handsome young man who could cross a kilometer in a step, appearing right in front of them in the blink of an eye, Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, and Mandy Lewis couldn’t help but feel a strong sense of dissonance.
Jane Aiken exclaimed admiringly, “To have such strength after the Eight Layer Heaven and even cross a Major Realm, you truly are remarkable. It seems I need to put in more effort.”
Crystal Lewis sighed, “It’s bad enough that you’re so strong, but you’re also enduring.”
Recalling how Jack Clark could consecutively unleash hundreds of Full-Force Strikes with his Halberd Skill, Justin Welan and Mandy Lewis nodded in agreement, indeed very enduring.
Jack Clark smiled slightly, “It’s okay. After the Eight Layer Heaven, one can draw more energy from Heaven and Earth, so actually, the consumption of True Strength isn’t as great as imagined.”
Everyone was accustomed to Jack Clark’s modesty and had long since been numbed by shock, so after a brief exchange, the group returned to the Frontline Small Town.
Jane Aiken went back to contemplate her Top-tier Secret Manual, while Justin Welan and the others directly applied for a Cultivation Room to enter Closed-door Cultivation.
They were still at the Fifth Layer Heaven when Jack Clark broke through to the Eight Layer, and his combat power was already otherworldly, almost on par with a Ninth Heaven Expert. If they didn’t put in extra effort, the gap would only grow wider.
However, some gaps cannot be closed by effort alone.
Moving forward, Jack Clark planned to continue his Closed-door Cultivation for another day, refining his Slayer Demon Seven Cuts, especially the third move, Endless Destruction, which still had some flaws in power integration.
The so-called Slayer Demon Seven Cuts is a Combat Technique uniquely deduced from his own Martial Arts, and he has now deduced up to the third cut.
The first style is the Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial, the second style is True Thunder Instant Slash, and the third is Endless Destruction.
These three styles are just the foundation. Next, Jack Clark intends to combine the Combat Divine Body with the Dragon Form as well as the Fourfold World to create a sublime ultimate move.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: 332: Ancient Titan Creature, Breakthrough Late Stage 9 (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Chapter 332: Ancient Titan Creature, Breakthrough Late Stage 9 (Seeking Monthly Votes)
Dark clouds shrouded the skies, lava flowed across the obscured land, and red flames burned.
At the edge of a massive pit of destruction, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was rummaging through trash, carefully picking up fist-sized crystals from piles of rocks.
However, given its colossal size of two hundred and seventy meters, the scene seemed oddly discordant.
Only after turning the rubble piles twice and using its domain power to crush each piece of rock did the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nod in satisfaction.
This was the fourth Scalefire Alien Town it had destroyed. Having demolished four altars in a row, it had collected almost three hundred crystals.
Even though the crystals’ energy from levels four to six had severely depleted due to the sacrifices, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon anticipated that the converted attribute points would still exceed ten thousand.
Even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was somewhat excited by this haul.
After all, it didn’t need to spend time hunting peak-level Unique Beasts. Simply falling from the sky was enough to harvest crystals.
If only such good fortune could continue indefinitely.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned its head to look behind where a Silver Giant Dragon was curiously playing with what remained of the Black Oblivion King’s statue with its huge claw.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “Scythia, help me store these crystals.”
“Roar! No problem, Tim Abott.”
The Silver Giant Dragon immediately approached with delight, extending its dragon claw to catch the ‘small’ crystals the size of fists and human heads, then happily stored them in the Reverse Scale Space.
Not having Space Equipment is a hassle. It seems it is time to find a moment to create a Storage Space.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thought contemplatively.
In fact, Jack Clark had a special piece of Space Equipment, a gift from Purgatory Demon Race Max, sturdy enough to withstand Unstable Space Channels.
However, that storage bag’s space was too small, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body would erupt in Heaven Burning Golden Flame during combat.
Under the terrifying high-temperature flames infused with its Top-tier fire talent, no Space Equipment could endure and would quickly be damaged and break.
As for making a big ‘leather bag’ out of a Level 9 Giant Beast Skin… the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thought of the image of carrying a big bag and instinctively shook its head.
“Scythia, it’s time to go.”
With a low growl, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spread its Thunderbolt Wings behind it, breaking up the earth for hundreds of meters around as the rebounding force from its mighty legs caused a raging wind that shot into the skies.
“Roar! Wait for me, Tim Abott.” The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings and hurriedly followed.
While the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continued along the fringe of the Hell Domain in search of the next foreign race’s town to drive out the hell magma…
At the towering volcano crater’s edge, a huge Black Colossus watched the distant skies with a cold gaze, its eyes burning with a purple flame, its voice deep and resonant.
“Roar! Three more fanatics have disappeared, along with destroyed Law Imprints. Is that Mythical Creature aiming for my followers and subordinates?”
As it spoke, flames surged in Kaltos’ eyes, and an instant, invisible fluctuation pierced the Void.
Boom, boom, boom!! Instantly, statues in over a hundred foreign race’s towns shook along the edge of the Hell Domain spanning more than ten thousand kilometers in diameter.
At once, all members of the different races knelt down in fervent worship, especially the Priests, who were fanatics with their Spiritual Will connected to the statues, listening to the divine commandments.
Soon, all the Priests stood up and turned around, shouting loudly, “The great God of Black Oblivion commands that all ‘Persons’ immediately retreat from the border area and return to the Divine City.”
Under the command of the Black Oblivion King, the small tribes of the foreign races at the edge of the Hell Domain began to gather their belongings and retreat in a massive exodus.
Without knowing the strength of the opponent, or whether it was the Mythical Giant Beast from behind the Dragon Palace making an appearance, the Black Oblivion King would not rashly step out of the Hell Domain.
However, from the current situation, it seemed that the opponent was not very strong; otherwise, it would have already rushed into Hell to battle with the king, rather than just destroying its mark statues around the edge.
Boom!
Above the volcano, a massive black pupil appeared in the air, blazing with a purple flame, surveilling in all directions.
This Eye of Prison was linked with the Hell Domain, and if any Mythical-level Giant Beasts entered the domain, they would be detected immediately by the Black Oblivion King.
Then it would be known exactly ‘who’ the intruder was.
…
Boom!
A colossal beast with sparkling Thunderbolt Wings descended from the sky. In an instant, the ground shattered for kilometers around, firelight exploded, and the ensuing Destructive Impact destroyed all nearby buildings.
Looking around at the small town where nothing remained but extinguished altars and moved statues, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt a bit regretful.
The Silver Giant Dragon hovered in the air, growling lowly, “Tim Abott, nothing is left here either.”
“That guy must have caught on,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled lowly.
It had anticipated this reaction; after all, the Black Oblivion King was connected to the mark on the statues and could sense their movements.
In fact, the sweeping behavior of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had already exposed its approximate location and purpose.
If the other party wished, they could be waiting for it ahead at any time.
Too bad, the cautious Mythical Giant Beast hadn’t strayed from the center of the Hell Domain but had chosen to evacuate all the edge-dwelling different races instead.
However, since the other party wasn’t coming out, it was time to make a big move.
As for those Life Crystals, after killing all the different races and the Black Oblivion King, they too would naturally belong to it: “Roar! Scythia, let’s go make a substantial strike.”
“Tim Abott, are you finally ready to let the blood flow like rivers?” Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up with excitement, roaring jubilantly as it followed and shot into the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 749: 332: Ancient Titan Creature, Breaking through Level 9 Late Stage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Chapter 332: Ancient Titan Creature, Breaking through Level 9 Late Stage (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_2
Hell Domain spans over 3,000 kilometers.
Here, the mountains and rivers have already been eroded, the rivers dried up, turning into scorching hot magma. Trees that once stood hundreds of meters tall have been reduced to blackened stumps, with flames still dancing on them.
On the plains where two small mountain ranges intersect, there stands a gray-brown stone city spanning several kilometers built, inhabited by more than 200,000 Scaled Fire Alien Tribe members.
Two hundred meters wide lava river twists and turns outside the city, emitting intense light and heat. In the middle, a 300 meters tall Black Giant Beast Statue stands, with purple flames dancing and burning on it.
On both sides of the riverbank, there are trees that are several to dozens of meters high. Their trunks are winding like dragons, and their bark is like scales but without leaves.
These trees bear black and red fruits, ranging from 0.5 to 1 meter in size, with dark red glows flowing inside, releasing waves of scorching energy.
In addition, more than ten Black Dragon Trees over 100 meters tall are planted in the middle of the lava river, with fruits at the top reaching 3 meters in size.
Not far from the statue, the largest Black Dragon Tree stands over 300 meters tall, and several divine fruits with a diameter of 5 meters emit ring after ring of halo on it.
