At the same time, under these Black Dragon Trees, there are red vines coiled around, and many fist-sized red fruits are growing on them.
At this moment, many aliens are working among those trees, driving the hell magma to irrigate, picking red fruits for food, replenishing energy, and enhancing their strength.
Besides, there are some giant Unique Beasts that are more than 20 meters long, nearly 20 meters high, covered in black scale armor like cattle, carrying many corpses of mutated creatures back.
Nearly ten kilometers away, on a 3,000 meters tall “small” mountain, a Ninth-level Late-stage Beast is standing.
This giant beast is nearly 290 meters long, almost 100 meters tall at the shoulder, covered in brown scales, and looks like a bloated giant lizard, exuding a terrifying aura.
Standing on the “small hill”, the giant beast gazes with satisfaction at the aliens who are herding lava and the lush Black Melting Divine Fruit trees in the plains below.
These fruits are the divine products of hellfire eroding the earth and absorbing the essence of the surrounding Heaven and Earth, containing pure and vast energy and heavenly essence.
Especially, those 3 meters large divine fruits can significantly enhance the strength and speed up the growth of these Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts when consumed.
These fruits are the reason why these Unique Beasts are willingly following the Black Oblivion King. If it were only for high pressure and forceful subjugation, they would not put in much effort.
However, these divine fruits take very long to consolidate. A batch takes “ten years” to mature, after which the trees wither and a new site must be found.
Roar! Suddenly, the Ninth-level Late-stage Beast emits an angry roar and stares fiercely behind it.
In the distant sky, nine bright blue-black thunder rings shine among the clouds. A 10-meter thick golden-purple light beam pierces Heaven and Earth, and the skies dim in an instant.
All alien tribes instinctively look into the distance, seeing the scattered dark clouds, the towering black-red Colossal Beast, and the Destructive Breath it spews.
Rings of energy halo surround the golden-purple beam piercing Heaven and Earth. Everything that comes in contact with the light beam is annihilated within the absolute dark area.
Under the strong contrast of intense light and extreme darkness, the aliens feel as though time and space have slowed down, even though the light beam moves at a rapid speed.
The Beast with the fastest reaction only has time to burst out its talent. In an instant, the ground shakes within an 800-meter radius, forming substantial Yellow Earth Domain.
Boom!
Heaven and Earth shake, and the destructive mushroom cloud erupts on the mountain range.
Under the influencer of Heaven Burning Golden Flame and Purple Void Poison, nine thunder rings collapse the mountain range, and shattered rocks are thrown into the sky, melting into scorching hot material that sprays in all directions.
The terrifying destructive shockwaves sweep across a dozen kilometers. The ground melts as the scorching wind raises 100 meters high black and red smoke and dust, engulfing the alien city on the plains.
Under the scorching high-temperature shockwaves, many Level 4 aliens are burnt into charcoals before they have time to react, and the entire city is engulfed in flames.
“Run, run!”
“Oh, Supreme God of Black Destruction, please protect your people.”
“Don’t run! Protect the Black Melting Divine Fruit…”
At this moment, the whole alien city is in chaos – terrified, desperate, and screaming, as if the end of the world has come.
Watching this scene, in the collapsing dark clouds, the Silver Giant Dragon encircles the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, roaring with excitement.
“Roar! The great Sethia is the natural disaster, the destruction. She bestows death upon you evil aliens. Tim Abott, the great Sethia wants to see a river of blood.”
Suddenly, the corner of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitches. Amidst the silver dragon’s roar, it feels like it is a super villain.
However, in the eyes of those aliens, it indeed seems to be a monster that brings destruction.
Roar!
Surrounded by golden flames and blue-black thunder, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon transforms into a meteor of destruction, falling from the sky and crashing into the city center at several times the speed of sound.
Boom!
In an instant, the ground within a kilometer radius is shattered and exploded, and the destructive impact instantly wipes out half of the city, killing tens of thousands of aliens.
Boom, boom, boom! Under the terrifying high-temperature radiation, the ground within several kilometers is burned and melted, while black-blue thunders continue to fall from the sky.
At the same time, a circle of purple halo explodes, instantly radiating across a range of 10 kilometers. Countless aliens in the city that escaped destruction become paralyzed all at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 750: 332: Ancient Titan Creature, Breaking Through Late Stage 9 (Asking for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: Chapter 332: Ancient Titan Creature, Breaking Through Late Stage 9 (Asking for Monthly Ticket)_3
Puff! Puff!
Under the terrifying toxic energy, the bodies of all different races disintegrated, and in the blink of an eye, only a little black ash was left behind, leaving behind their decaying weapons and armor.
In just a few breaths, more than 200,000 Level 4 or higher Scaled Fire Alien Tribe were annihilated by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and their tribal cities were burned down, turning into a lava hell.
The Silver Giant Dragon was thrilled at this sight, constantly circling in the thunderous sky, and then roaring with brutal ferocity.
Under this apocalyptic scene, with the flames burning on the ground, the black-red ferocious giant beast standing tall, and the Silver Giant Dragon roaring in the sky, the scene was… quite picturesque.
At the moment when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon unleashed a power comparable to myths, annihilating the Late Stage 9 Beast, and destroying the different races city in an instant, the Black Oblivion King also reacted immediately.
Boom!
The black statue on the riverside of the Lava River trembled. Under the powerful eruption of Law Power, the magma river went wild, forming a Lava Fire Giant Beast over a thousand meters long.
Roar! With an earth-shattering roar, the will of the Black Oblivion King descended, and then paused for a moment.
He looked at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon standing in the distance amidst the flames, only 270 meters long with a Mid Level 9 aura, and the Silver Giant Dragon circling in the sky, only over a hundred meters long.
“Roar! It’s you guys!” The Black Oblivion King recognized the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the others.
It remembered the extraordinary giant beast that possessed quasi-mythical prowess at Level 9 Early Stage and the mythical descendant, the Silver Giant Dragon with the Scale of Laws.
Boom!
Meeting the roar of the Black Oblivion King was a golden-purple breath. It pierced through Heaven and Earth, instantly destroying the Lava Giant Beast that could unleash quasi-mythical power.
The beam then crossed thousands of kilometers and fell on the mountain ranges on the other side of the river bank. The thousands of meters high mountain peaks collapsed, and countless scorching magma material erupted.
The fusion trait of the top-tier talent Purple Void Poison can combine with Heaven Burning Golden Flame or Annihilation True Thunder at any time, unleashing power comparable to the Laws.
The consumption was not as large as the previous explosion of the Heaven Burning Golden Flame and Annihilation True Thunder. It allowed the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to easily unleash mythical-level battle prowess with every move.
This is the horror of multiple top-tier talents.
Bang!
At the moment when the projection of the will was destroyed, purple flames exploded in the sky and turned into an invisible shockwave that radiated hundreds of kilometers before dissipating.
“There’s no trace of other mythical creatures, only the auras of those two extraordinary creatures.”
Far away, thousands of miles away at the mouth of a volcano, the huge mountain-like Black Colossus revealed a terrifying murderous intent in its eyes: “Roar! Seeking death, two extraordinary giant beasts dared to invade the territory of This King.”
Just now, when its will projection exploded, it attracted the surrounding domain power to sweep over hundreds of kilometers without finding any mythical creature hiding.
That is to say, the enemy that had made it cautious for so long was actually just the two extraordinary giant beasts in that native world. This infuriated Kaltos.
With both the anger of being provoked by creatures below the myths and the embarrassment of guessing wrong, it wanted to tear those two giant beasts apart.
Boom!
At that instant, volcanoes erupted, and dark red magma fire pillars hundreds of meters thick soared into the sky. At the same time, the diameter of Hell Domain, which exceeded 10,000 kilometers, trembled, and several Lava Rivers roared.
“We follow our God.”
All the different races under the volcano knelt down and looked fanatically at the endless purple flame that spread to the sky. A huge shadow, like a mountain range, was hidden in the hellish fire.
The Black Oblivion King, who controlled the Hellfire, was very fast. Under seven times the supersonic speed, it covered thousands of kilometers in less than half an hour.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon had already left, taking away all the Black Melting Divine Fruit and even the corpse of the Late Stage 9 Beast that had been killed.
Roar! A furious, brutal roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, and the Lava River raged.
…
After flying more than 5,000 kilometers away from the Hell Domain, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and Silver Giant Dragon flew another 1,000 kilometers before they finally stopped.
Boom!
The mountain ridge collapsed, and rumbling rocks fell. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon threw the headless giant beast corpse on the ground and looked ahead.
Under the bright moonlight at this time, an endless mist shrouded the area in front, with fog walls towering into the clouds, stretching left and right, somewhat similar to the fog walls that separated the world passageways of the Human Race.
Unexpectedly, they had flown thousands of kilometers around and had arrived at the misty area mentioned by that huge serpent beast.
Thinking of this, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon turned his head and looked at the Silver Giant Dragon, growling: “Scythia, do you know what that ancient creature is?”
“Ancient beings.”
The Silver Giant Dragon tilted its head, pondered: “Roar! It seems that my mother once said that they are ancient beings that turned to stone after failing to break through to higher realms.”
“These ancient beings were all Ancient Titan level during their lives. After death, their bodies petrified and became as big as mountains, the smallest of which are tens of thousands of meters or more.”
“Moreover, due to the lingering and collapsing of rules, the mountains composing their bodies are incredibly hard. Ordinary mythical giant beasts can’t destroy them.”
“At the same time, under the power of rules, the surrounding environment is also affected. For example, those mists should be caused by the rule power of that ancient being.”
“However, these creatures usually don’t move. They may wake up once in thousands or tens of thousands of years, instinctively move for a while and then fall back into sleep.”
“These ancient beings are also divided into ancient early stage, ancient middle stage, and ancient late stage. The late stage ones have the largest bodies, but they are also the most fragile.”
“Almost all the rule power in their bodies has dissipated and they will not wake up again. Once the last trace of rule power is gone, they will completely turn into a mountain range.”

chapters.title: Chapter 751: 332 Ancient Titan Creature, Breakthrough Late Stage 9 (Seeking Monthly Pass)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 751: Chapter 332 Ancient Titan Creature, Breakthrough Late Stage 9 (Seeking Monthly Pass)_4
After the Silver Giant Dragon finished speaking, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t help revealing a touch of shock in its eyes.
It had not expected that such a horrific creature existed near the Territory of the Black Oblivion King.
According to the divisions among the Mythical Beasts (King), the Mythical Titan Beasts (Heavenly King), and Ancient Titan Beasts, that ancient being was comparable to the Supreme Experts of the human race.
No wonder that when the horrific creature emerged from the mist and devoured three Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts and over a hundred thousand members of the Scaled Fire Alien Tribe, the Black Oblivion King didn’t dare to let out even a fart.
Such beings, even in death, were not entities that ordinary Mythical Beasts could provoke.
Since the Human Race in the vicinity did not have, or had not encountered such ancient beings, Jack had not found any records of these creatures in the material about the mythical world he had seen.
“Worthy of the mythical world,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon said as it looked towards the Silver Giant Dragon, “Scythia, take out all those Black Melting Divine Fruits.”
“Roar! Okay,” the Silver Giant Dragon obediently took out one dark red fruit after another from its Reverse Scale.
There were three fruits the size of 5 meters, sixteen that were 3 meters, dozens that were 1 meter, and in addition, many 1-meter sized fruits were destroyed in the explosion of the Black Oblivion King’s projection.
But those ‘ordinary’ fruits were destroyed, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t mind.
“Roar! Scythia, I will take two of the large ones, you can have one; of these 3-meter sized fruits, I’ll take five, you take five, and the rest we will save for Joe and the others,” it said.
“As for those 1-meter ones, we will give them to Big Tiger and his group.”
Although the operation was mostly the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s own effort, since Scythia was the Dragon Palace King and also served as the security bodyguard for this trip into the mythical world, it could not be shortchanged.
The Silver Giant Dragon always said it wanted to see how the Black Oblivion King would dare to ignore it, but the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon knew that the real purpose of the Silver Giant Dragon was to fear for its safety.
After all, its enemies this time were the Mythical Beasts, and very strong ones at that.
“Roar! No problem,” the Silver Giant Dragon agreed to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s distribution without any objections or politeness, joyfully gazing at the treasures in front of it.
The 3-meter sized Black Melting Divine Fruits were about the same as those Heavenly Dragon Fruits it used to eat.
And that 5-meter diameter fruit, radiating a glow, was a Divine Object that even Mythical Beasts could eat to enhance their strength—a something even its mother would not usually indulge in giving it.
“Roar! After eating these goodies, Scythia will be able to enhance its strength again,” the Silver Giant Dragon happily stored away the fruits.
It wasn’t like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which would grow upon eating; after consuming these treasures, it typically needed to sleep for several days.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gazed at the seven enormous ‘fruits’ in its claw, the vast invisible energy naturally emanating from them inciting a primal urge to devour, and it carefully pinched up one.
Compared to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s giant claw that spread out over thirty meters, a 3-meter diameter Black Melting fruit seemed just like a grape, which it gently placed into its mouth and then swallowed.
Boom!
Instantly, a blazing energy filled with destruction and fury exploded within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, its cells frantically dividing and compressing as its body swelled under the colossal energy.
In an instant, a terrifying and oppressive sensation spread, raging winds howled, and the ground shook.
Huh!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, now swollen to a size of 273 meters, exhaled a scorching breath and looked at the remaining Black Melting Divine Fruits in its claw with fervent eyes, and directly stuffed a clawful into its mouth.
With the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swallowing them in one gulp, an explosion erupted within its body, an endless black-red firelight erupting from its being, sending up dozens of meters of flames towards the sky.
Roar! The ferocious Black-red Colossal Beast roared towards the heavens, its sonic booms causing violent wind waves.
Amid the burning flames, the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew at an astonishing rate, swelling rapidly and soon reaching 280 meters as it broke through to the Late Stage 9.
Boom!
Black lightning flashed across the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body, and in an instant, a terrifying aura that made Heaven and Earth tremble spread throughout, mountains collapsed, and the Earth shattered.
Around it formed concentric circles of white cloud-like waves, spanning a thousand meters.

chapters.title: Chapter 752: 333 Revival of the Mountain Ranges, The Arrival of Deep Red Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Chapter 333 Revival of the Mountain Ranges, The Arrival of Deep Red Destruction
“`
Under the endless energy released by those seven divine fruits, each cell in the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon underwent infinite division, compression, and proliferation. Its scale armor swelled, expanding continuously.
Finally, it stopped growing after it ballooned to two hundred ninety-one meters.
With the massive increase in size and the foundational enhancements that came with the breakthrough to late Stage 9, the aura emitted by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon became even more terrifying, overwhelming everything in its vicinity.
Especially the black lightning that flashed across its body, exploding and causing the surrounding void to shudder, leaving the Silver Giant Dragon with the illusion that Heaven and Earth were shaking.
Moreover, the oppressive might that surpassed even that of a Monarch’s life form spurred a bloodline-derived urge to submit within the Silver Giant Dragon. Its four claws trembled uncontrollably, and it roared with excitement.
“Roar, roar!! Tim Abott, so strong, hurry, let’s go kill the Black Oblivion King. Great Scythia wants to stand fiercely on its head and humiliate it.”
“Roar! Not in a hurry, I’ll eat another couple bites of meat first.”
Huff, huff!!
The Black-red Colossal Beast exhaled fire with each breath, and its enormous form slammed into the ground below with a crash, causing rocks to shatter and the raging wind to howl.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon broke through and its power was unleashed without restraint, the destructive black lightning bombarded the land, shattering the mountain peaks and breaking the Earth asunder.
The Black-red Colossal Beast’s double claws turned over rocks, pulling out the broken corpse of that ancient Giant Lizard from beneath. Its sinister maw took a ferocious bite, tearing apart the scales and flesh and blood.
And just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon devoured the flesh, the Purple Dragon Egg wedged between the two black Scale Horns on its head vibrated slightly, drawing in a sucking force that absorbed the life aura emanating from the breakthrough of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Instantly, the vitality fluctuating within the egg grew stronger, and a slender shadow could be vaguely seen swimming inside, occasionally producing sounds of knocking against the shell.
Clearly, after repeatedly absorbing the life aura released by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the development of this Dragon Egg had reached the point where it was on the verge of hatching.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon approached, looking at the purple spot on the head of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with curiosity in its eyes: “Roar! Tim Abott, that egg is about to crack.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded its head; it also felt it.
However, the hatching of such a high-level creature could mean ‘soon’ is several months or a year. Considering this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but growl.
“Scythia, how many years have you been in the egg?”
Scythia, a Mythical Creature Dragon descendant, was also hatched from an egg.
As it growled through its snout, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon noisily chewed the beast’s flesh and blood, and dark red remnants dribbled down from the corners of its mouth, making it appear extremely ferocious and fierce.
“In the egg.”
The Silver Giant Dragon stood on the rock beside, thought for a moment, then growled back: “Roar! Scythia can’t remember, but mother said I was in the egg for over a thousand Sun Wheels.”
Sun Wheels represent the time-keeping system of these colossal beasts in the mythical world. One alternation of day and night equals one Sun Wheel, which is equivalent to a little more than a month on Blue Star.
Over a thousand day and night alternations meant that the Silver Giant Dragon had been in the egg for over a hundred years.
Sure enough, even in the hatching of eggs, mythical creatures measure time in centuries.
And while the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was breaking through and releasing its power unrestrained, in the boundless depths of the mist, a mountain range stretching over forty kilometers suddenly began to tremble.
The foremost peak of the mountain range shook, and amidst falling rocks and dust, a gigantic crack slowly appeared, soon followed by vague and terrifying roars.
“Roar! Heaven…”
Amidst the trembling of Heaven and Earth, the mountain range, which spanned over forty kilometers, slowly began to rise, instantly causing the atmosphere to churn with roaring winds and seas, while the fog around trembled.
Boom!
As the mountain beast moved, countless rocks and dirt fell from its body, the Earth crumbled, and debris blasted thousands of meters into the sky, the impact earth-shattering.
In the rolling mist, this ancient being that had only just begun to move headed toward the edge of the mist with ‘slow’ steps.
Meanwhile, in the skies above the Hell Domain, the Black Oblivion King, wreathed in purple flame, circled thousands of miles without spotting the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and its company.
Roar! Kaltos let out a brutally tyrannical roar, with a voice imbued with the aura of the Law, piercing through the endless Void.
In an instant, in another direction tens of thousands of kilometers away, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, along with two other Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts’ black scales, vibrated.
“The king is calling.”
With a low growl, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, which was covered with sharp black bone spurs and had once fought with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, rose to its feet, its domain unfolded, and flew towards the central region.
……
In a room, Jack Clark, who was immersed in the state of enlightenment, felt the heavy and terrifying aura on his body spread uncontrollably as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon made its breakthrough.
Roar, roar, roar!!
As Jack Clark’s flesh began to strengthen significantly once again, a Dragon Roar echoed faintly in the Void, causing the entire small building to shake under the oppressive might that filled Heaven and Earth.
Immediately, Jane Aiken, who was across half a street comprehending the Secret Book, slowly opened her eyes and turned to look in the direction of Jack Clark’s small building, her eyes reflecting surprise.
Last night, Jack Clark’s aura had soared by a significant amount, and in the morning, he exhibited strength at a normal Level 9 Early Stage.
Now, just half a day later, his aura was surging again?
Such a terrifying rate of improvement, even for Jane Aiken who prided herself on her exceptional talent, was somewhat shocking.
Jane Aiken said subconsciously, “This guy feels even more astonishing than Jonathan Walker, who challenged the Ninth Heavens in a year, and he also cultivated the Heart’s Eye Bright Knife.”
But after saying this, Jane Aiken paused slightly and softly muttered, “Jonathan Walker.”
That once brilliant genius who shook the entire Cultivation World over a decade ago. He was the one her mother had instructed her to kill before her death—the person at odds with her family, with a blood feud to settle.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 753: 333: The Mountain Range Revives, Deep Red Destruction Comes_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Chapter 333: The Mountain Range Revives, Deep Red Destruction Comes_2
With these thoughts, Jane Aiken’s gaze calmed, and her black hair fluttered without the wind. Closing her eyes, she sank into a state of epiphany once more.
Surrounding her, four flying swords were suspended, with numerous pink, black, green, and grey Sword Qi threads intertwined, covering the entire room, like a miniature Sword World.
These sharp sword threads, capable of cutting through alloy, did not affect the interior furniture like the sofa or coffee table as they moved, demonstrating frightening control.
The mythical world.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon took almost half an hour before it finished consuming the half-remaining body of the Level 9 Giant Beast, growing to a size of 294 meters.
Its power increased after reaching the Late Stage 9, but simultaneously, it required even more biological energy. Otherwise, it could only rely on slow growth by absorbing Heavenly Energy.
Compared to the speed at which ordinary Level 9 Giant Beasts only grew a little over several years or decades, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which was accustomed to skyrocketing growth, couldn’t bear it.
With this thought, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly turned its head and looked at the distant horizon, its icy gaze from the golden vertical pupils: “Roar! Great Sethia, let’s kill that Mythical Giant Beast.”
Roar!
With the roar echoing, the Thunderbolt Wings of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which covered more than 600 meters, spread out, and sharp feather horns spouted golden flames.
Kaboom!
The air exploded instantly, and the nearly 300 meters long Giant Beast soared into the sky at several times the supersonic speed, leaving behind a gold and blue light tail over one thousand meters long.
“Roar! Under the leadership of the great Scythia, the Dragon Palace is going to destroy another Beast Empire today, or even a Mythological Beast Empire.”
“Roar! When I go back and tell Telsafi, it will definitely be shocked. Then let’s see if it dares to call the Great Sethia stupid when I’m obviously so smart.”
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a series of excited roars, surrounded by a green storm. Instantly, its speed skyrocketed, and in the blink of an eye, it turned into a silvery-green streak of light and rushed up.
As a dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon was naturally adept at flying, and coupled with its Wind Talent, its speed was even faster than the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon accelerated by the Golden Flame.
Soon, the two Giant Beasts rushed into the edge of the Hell Realm shrouded by black clouds.
Kaboom!
Endless golden flames erupted from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, giving off a terrifying high temperature of nearly 100,000 degrees Celsius, forming a golden sun with a diameter of one kilometer.
In an instant, this world was illuminated by the blazing flames.
At the same time, a bluish-black thunder echoed between the coral-like dorsal fins, forming hundreds of Thunder Dragons wrap around the domain, with thunderous explosions destroying everything in the surroundings.
Although its size had surged to nearly 300 meters, and its strength had increased from the initial Level 9 Early Stage to the late period, the domain of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon only expanded to one kilometer.
One kilometer was just a few steps away for it.
However, a domain is not about distance, but about absolute control of the surrounding space, absolute compression of strength, and the external suppression formed when the two sides collide in close combat.
Compared to Level 9 Giant Beasts, the domain of Mythical Giant Beasts has already merged with the surrounding heaven and earth. Every move can burst out terrifying power, even affecting the surrounding environment.
Kaboom! Kaboom! Kaboom!!
Just when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon delved into the range of four thousand kilometers into the Hell Domain, a conflict erupted between the domain that its body was shrouded in and the pervasive invisible power between heaven and earth.
In the explosion of light, a foreign race’s town appeared in the eyes of the two Giant Beasts below.
At the same time, those in the foreign race who hadn’t received the order to evacuate looked up and also saw the shining Thunderflame Great Sun in the sky, followed by dazzling light before their eyes.
They saw a beam of blue-purple light piercing heaven and earth, and in an instant, it fell on the foreign race’s town with terrifying speed.
Kaboom!
The town exploded in an instant under the hit of True Thunder blended with Purple Void Poison, resembling a laser cannon. Magma erupted, and a Destructive Impact infused with thunderbolts swept across several kilometers.
Everything in its path was destroyed and melted. In the blink of an eye, the foreign race’s town with a population of thousands was wiped out.
Roar! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a ferocious roar.
Whether it was the Giant Beasts’ inherent desire for slaughter or its fate to be a world-ending behemoth, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed to enjoy this feeling of destruction at the moment.
After destroying the town with a single blast of flame, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon flapped its wings behind it, changed direction, and flew off towards another side.
The Silver Giant Dragon trailing behind was immediately confused: “Roar! Tim Abott, isn’t the Black Oblivion King deep in the Hell Domain?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the domain turned its head back and roared lowly.
“I know that, but this time, I’m not only going to kill it, but I’m also going to destroy this civilized race. Today, I am destruction, I am disaster.”
Immediately, the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon lightened up, and it became excited: “Roar! Right, for the peace of the Vast World, the great Sethia will destroy this evil race of followers today.”
Kaboom! Kaboom! Kaboom!!
In the Hell’s Middle Layer Region, which spans a diameter of more than ten thousand kilometers, the two Giant Beasts began their destructive rampage.
Under the blue-purple laser pulse flame, the golden fiery explosion, and the Silver Giant Dragon’s icy fiery flame breath, the foreign race’s towns that hadn’t been evacuated were destroyed one after another.
Every explosion of breath wiped out tens of thousands of the Scaled Fire Alien Tribe, their savagery reached the heavens.
Of course, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wasn’t killing for the sake of killing, but these foreign races that were invaded and evolved by the power of the Black Oblivion King, becoming its subordinates, had to die.
For such Mythical Giant Beasts that take a path similar to faith and condense Divine Nations, each fanatic follower also forms part of its power.
Killing these foreign races is actually equivalent to weakening its power, and thus reducing the potential lethality of the Hell Domain.
However, just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon had invaded more than three thousand kilometers, stepping into the Middle Layer Region of Hell Domain, they were ‘seen’ by the Hell’s Eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 754: 333: Revival of the Mountain Ranges, Deep Red Destruction Descends_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 754: Chapter 333: Revival of the Mountain Ranges, Deep Red Destruction Descends_3
Once it was confirmed that the two invading enemies were Level 9 Extraordinary Giant Beasts, Kaltos, who had already returned to the center of the Hell, adjusted the perception limits of Hell’s Eye.
Upon seeing the two giant beasts slaughtering its followers, Kaltos had a strong killing intent in its eyes.
At the same time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had grown to nearly 300 meters, and each of its attacks were comparable to the breath of an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast, also surprised Kaltos.
The growth rate of this extraordinary creature was too terrifying. The first time it encountered it, it was only about 140 meters long. In less than a day, it had grown to the late stage Level 9.
Furthermore, its combat power was comparable to an ordinary Mythical-level creature. It had to be killed, or once it grew into a Mythical Giant Beast…
Boom!
The hell magma in the volcano mouth erupted, turning into a magma fire pillar hundreds of meters thick. After rising tens of thousands of meters, it exploded and formed into a vast field of purple flames spreading endlessly.
“Roar! Tal, Kayle, Bruce, follow me! Let’s kill those two extraordinary creatures who dared to provoke the Warehouse Dragon Empire.”
The black giant beast, as vast as a mountain ridge, soared into the sky with a terrifying roar. Its power, comparable to a late-stage Mythical-level creature, stirred heaven and earth. The raging wind howled, and the world trembled.
At the same time, the returned Sword Dragon Giant Beast and two late-stage Level 9 Giant Beasts also opened their domains to follow, forming an extremely powerful force.
Below on the ground, more than two hundred thousand members of different races, who had already returned, gathered in the city center where a black giant beast statue stood a kilometer tall on the ground.
At the front of the crowd, a humanoid black dinosaur-like creature raised its hands high, chanting praises to the supreme deity of Black Oblivion while leading all the foreign races in prayer.
Under the fervent faith, the purple flames that filled the sky burned even more vigorously.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon followed the lava rivers that covered the ground like blood vessels, devastating seven foreign race’s towns in a row, a tsunami of rolling purple flames swept in from the distant horizon.
At the same time, accompanied by the terrifying pressure of a Mythical Giant Beast, an invisible force descended from heaven and earth, forming a heavy suppression that could crush ordinary Level 9 Giant Beasts.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes instantly sharpened as it growled, “Scythia, keep your distance.”
“Roar! Go Tim Abott! Kill that big black one! The great Scythia wants to stomp on its head!”
Facing the imminent arrival of a Mythical Giant Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon showed no fear at all. It was extremely excited, flapping its wings and flying more than 20 kilometers away, ready to watch the excitement.
Boom!
A light emerged from the distant sky; a black-gold breath attack, more than 50 meters in diameter, tore through the heavens and earth. In an instant, space trembled, and the atmosphere exploded, parting the clouds to appear before the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
At the same time, the invisible pressure around the Thunderflame Domain surged several times. Under the tangible suppression, the golden-blue domain shrank continuously.
Roar! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon unleashed a pressure comparable to that of a Mythical Creature, with a purple halo flashing.
Boom! Under the power of the Purple Void Poison, the Thunderflame Domain shone brightly, its strength surged, and a terrifying power instantly shattered the surrounding Hell Domain’s suppression.
Boom! The black-gold breath attack pierced through the sky, carrying a world-ending might as it landed on the distant mountains, causing a nuclear explosion.
The mountain peaks collapsed, and the earth exploded, with a force so great that even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt some apprehension.
As expected, it was a terrifying creature comparable to the late stage of the Mythical level. Its strength was very powerful.
At this time, the distant sky filled with purple flames spun into a vortex, and the Black Oblivion King descended slowly from the vortex’s center. Instantly, an even more terrifying pressure spread out.
With a length of more than 1,100 meters and a shoulder height of several hundred meters, it was almost equivalent to a small mountain range, and its heavy presence crushed the Void.
With its power too overwhelming, the surrounding air was almost compressed into a liquid, forming white shockwaves that emanated in all directions, reaching several kilometers away.
In comparison to the Black Oblivion King’s enormous size, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast and the three other giant beasts following behind looked like three children.
Meanwhile, on the ground below, the magma rivers covering hundreds of kilometers erupted, forming magma fire pillars soaring into the sky and merging with the hellish flame clouds.
Immediately, the flames turned purple-red, and countless magma rained down from the sea of fire, creating an incredible sight.
With the sky ablaze with purple flames and meteor-like fire rain falling, the black giant beast looked at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and let out a roar that shook the heavens and the earth.
“Roar! Thunderflame, the extraordinary creature, today this king will crush you bit by bit to make you realize that the majesty of Mythical Creatures must not be provoked.”
“Roar! Crush me? With just you?” The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s low growl was filled with powerful majesty, and its body released an endless surge of power.
Boom!
Red lightning bolts exploded on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body as it activated its Gigantification Talent and entered a deep red state. Amidst the dazzling red lightning, its body wildly expanded.
Four hundred meters, five hundred meters, seven hundred meters…
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s size grew larger and larger, its boundless physical strength was released, and an indescribable power surged out, combined with its seven Top-tier Talents.
In the blink of an eye, a deep red giant beast more than 1,100 meters long, no less than the Black Oblivion King, appeared. Surrounded by black and red lightning, the Hell Domain’s suppression instantly shattered, and space broke apart.
At that moment, a sense of looming danger spread throughout heaven and earth, causing the distant Black Oblivion King to feel its heart beating rapidly.
It felt as if a deep red creature that shouldn’t exist in this world had just appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 755: 334: Crushing the Myth, the Invincible Thunderflame Emperor Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Chapter 334: Crushing the Myth, the Invincible Thunderflame Emperor Dragon
“Roar! How is this possible, this power…!!”
Looking at the distant deep red giant beast, whose size and pressure were no less than that of the Black Oblivion King and even more terrifying, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast let out an incredulous roar.
Just half a day ago, that extraordinary giant beast was only on par with it, but now it had suddenly become so terrifying without even having a chance to wake up.
It didn’t know if this world was too crazy or if it was just hallucinating.
At this moment, not only the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, but also the Black Oblivion King’s eyes showed solemnity. It felt a strong sense of danger from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in this state.
As for the two late Stage 9 Giant Beasts, they instinctively felt fear under the deep red destructive breath, their limbs softened, and their eyes trembled, showing no sign of the might of a Level 9 Giant Beast.
Standing in the shattered dark area of destruction, the giant beast wrapped in black-red lightning breathed out scorching hot air, and its golden-red vertical pupils were filled with endless ferocity and destruction.
“I am the Deep Red Destruction.”
Boom! The space beneath the deep red giant beast’s feet shattered on a large scale, forming black cracks spreading across the sky, and in an instant, the distant Black Oblivion King roared.
Roar!
The Black Oblivion King roared in fury, and the purple flames on its body surged, turning into a black dragon head that blocked the sky as space silently disappeared within the black dragon’s mouth.
Compared to when it initially appeared on the sea surface, the Hell Devouring cast by the Law projection was more terrifying than what the Black Oblivion King’s true body was capable of now.
However, the deep red giant beast’s target was not it at all.
While the deep red form would be somewhat affected by its agility, the talent for swiftness could still be used. In an instant, the deep red giant beast appeared in front of the three Level 9 Giant Beasts with a movement speed 30 times its size.
Bang! Bang!!
With two black-red lightning-wrapped claws, two late Stage 9 Giant Beasts were blown up before they could even react, their flesh and blood exploding as half of their broken bodies fell from the sky.
Immediately after, the black-red lightning-wrapped tail blade, spanning over 500 meters, slashed through the void, and instantly appeared in front of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, which was 300 meters long.
Roar!
An intense aura of death enveloped the Sword Dragon Giant Beast, and it roared furiously as dazzling golden light shone on its body, with countless fine metal pieces gathering.
Boom!
The deep red tail blade ripped through space, shattered the thin gold Law waterfall, tore the domain apart, and left a black scar several kilometers long in the sky above the Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
In an instant, the once evenly-matched giant beast stiffened, and then the red lightning exploded, spraying countless blood, and its two halves of the corpse fell to the ground.
Boom!
A dragon claw burning with hellfire descended from the sky, distorting the space under its claws, and fiercely struck the back of the deep red giant beast with an indescribable terror and power.
With that terrifying claw, the black-red lightning wrapped around the deep red giant beast’s body dispersed. The pure black power burst forth under the impact, and the deep red scale armor vibrated, but then… it disappeared.
With the basic nine-fold amplification, six top-level talents, and one deification talent fusion, the deep red giant beast’s defense conceptually surged to 900 times.
Such a terrifying defense would be unshakable even by a Mythical Giant Beast.
As the hellfire and black-red lightning exploded and expanded, it unleashed a series of violent energy halos, leaving the deep red giant beast standing in the high altitude and slowly turning its head, looking at the black giant beast with a deep voice.
“Your power is not enough.”
Spurt! The black-red lightning-wrapped tail blade slashed through the void, tearing through the power of the Hell Domain constructed by hellfire, carrying a terrifying might and striking at the Black Oblivion King’s chest.
Boom!
A meteor burning with purple flames descended from the sky, smashing into the ground with a bang. In an instant, the earth shook within a range of tens of kilometers. Countless mud and rocks melted into magma, which shot up into the sky, turning into a magma tsunami, drowning everything around.
“Roar! Great Sethia, I’ll deal with this guy; you go and kill its subordinates from the different races.”
Now that the giant beasts under the Black Oblivion King had been killed, there was no power in the vast Hell Domain that could threaten the Silver Giant Dragon.
“Roar! No problem, Tim Abott. Great Sethia likes destruction the most.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, spreading its wings and turning into a stream of cyan-silver light, exploding towards the distance.
Roar! Die.
On the earth below, standing in the magma fire sea, the Black Oblivion King’s eyes showed a ferocious color, the light in its mouth flickered, and a black-gold breath erupted, traversing the sky.
Boom! High in the sky, the deep red giant beast directly blocked the hellish breath.
Suddenly, an earth-shattering explosion erupted in the sky, like a nuclear explosion with black-red radiance illuminating Heaven and Earth. The explosive red circular shockwave scattered the dark clouds in the sky, forming a circular hole with a diameter of more than ten kilometers, piercing through several kilometers of thick dark clouds.
In an instant, a silver moonlight pillar poured down, penetrating Heaven and Earth.
When the violent whirlwind subsided and the explosion disappeared, the deep red giant beast emerged from the raging whirlwind, surrounded by terrifying black-red lightning and unharmed.
Seeing this scene, the Silver Giant Dragon, which had already flown tens of kilometers away, roared excitedly: “Roar! Tim Abott, invincible, kill it!”
Roaring, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, and the surrounding domain turned into a destructive black ice destruction storm, rushing towards the depths of the domain.
On the ground below, the Black Oblivion King’s eyes also revealed a serious look.
The opponent’s defense was too terrifying; ordinary attacks simply couldn’t break through it.
Roar!
Ferocious roars filled Heaven and Earth, and as the whole sky was surrounded by purple flames, the earth shattered and the black giant beast soared to the sky, colliding violently with the deep red giant beast descending from the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 756: 334: Crushing the Myth, the Invincible Thunderflame Emperor Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 756: Chapter 334: Crushing the Myth, the Invincible Thunderflame Emperor Dragon_2
Boom!
The two terrifying behemoths collided in midair like two mountain ranges, instantly turning the world upside down.
Under the impact of the unrivaled domineering power, cracks appeared in the surrounding space.
At the same time, the hellfire and deep red lightning on the two behemoths’ bodies intertwined and collided, constantly exploding and forming a dazzling energy halo.
With the kinetic advantage of the deep red giant beast, it pressed down on the Black Oblivion King as they descended from the sky, both behemoths wreathed in purple-red light as they landed on the ground.
Boom!
In an instant, the magma fire sea below exploded, the earth shook for tens of kilometers, and countless scorching magma was thrown in all directions, mixed with the raging wind waves.
Amidst the violent energy turbulence, the lightning-wrapped tail blade tore through the void and collided with the black tail as thick as a mountain peak, instantly causing a terrifying explosion of energy.
Boom! A blaze exploded on the thick black scale armor, and the lightning-wrapped sharp tail blade carved a crack more than a hundred meters long and several meters deep.
However, this damage was not even considered an injury to the black behemoth with its more than ten meters of thick scale armor. With the hellfire burning, it healed in the blink of an eye.
The crack on its chest caused by the tail blade had already been healed before.
Roar Roar!!
The two ferocious dragon heads collided, instantly causing a void explosion. The two ferocious behemoths stared at each other, their eyes filled with ferocity and brutality.
At this moment, the deep red giant beast retreated half a step, and the black behemoth, whose strength had exploded, involuntarily leaned forward as a pair of huge claws already wrapped around its neck.
Boom!
An indescribable terror erupted, and the black giant beast, more than a thousand meters long, was directly flung away and crashed into the mountain peak tens of kilometers away.
Instantly, the mountain collapsed, the earth shattered, and thick smoke billowed.
Roar!
The red behemoth stood in the magma fire sea, roaring uproariously, its body exuding an extremely brutal and destructive aura.
Boom!
Mountains burst in the distance, and purple flames burned across the sky, forming a hellfire sea that spread for thousands of kilometers. The enraged black behemoth emerged from the flowing magma.
This place was a middle-layer region of the domain, and its power increased several times under the blessing of hell. However, it was at a disadvantage against the deep red giant beast with its seven talents combined.
This made the Black Oblivion King extremely furious, as the deep red giant beast was actually just a late Stage 9 extraordinary creature.
Today, it was pressed down and beaten by a transcendant creature, which was unforgivable.
Roar! A terrifying force burst from the Black Oblivion King’s body, as the endless purple flames fell from the sky and were absorbed by it. Soon, dark purple lines emerged on the surface of its body.
Crack Crack!!
One by one, dangerous purple spikes burst out, and in the blink of an eye, the Black Oblivion King’s appearance became even more ferocious and fierce.
Boom!
In this form, the speed of the Black Oblivion King was even faster, and with the rumblings of a raging wind, it pounced towards the Deep Red Giant Beast, tearing through space with its ferocious double claws.
At the same time, the deep red giant beast made the earth shatter and vanished in an instant with terrifying speed under the Agility Talent, creating a pitch-black pathway hundreds of meters long.
Boom!
The indescribable destructive kinetic energy shattered the right claw of the ferocious black behemoth in an instant. The surrounding hellfire exploded, and the scale armor on its chest collapsed.
The huge body was blasted away, crashing tens of kilometers across the land. Mountain peaks shattered, and a trail of destruction formed as smoke and dust billowed.
Finally, the Red Behemoth stopped only after collapsing a mountain peak, and the raging wind wave it set off covered more than ten kilometers, flooding different races’ towns on the remote plains.
The sudden change alarmed tens of thousands of different race inhabitants.
Looking at the ferocious black behemoth that slowly stood up amidst the broken mountains and smoke, along with the terrifying and oppressive aura, all members of the different races knelt instinctively.
“It’s our god.”
“We pay homage to our god.”
“The supreme ruler who controls magma and flames, your arrival…”
Boom!
As all the different race members worshiped fervently in the distance, the ground shook, and a deep red giant beast more than six hundred meters tall appeared upright.
The body was entwined with black and red lightning, emitting a terrifying aura that made Heaven and Earth tremble.
Roar Roar!!
Without any further ado, the two behemoths stomped on the ground and rushed towards each other with hellfire and deep red lightning swirling, setting off rolling wind waves and raging wind howls.
Boom!
Even in a state of explosive eruption, the Black Oblivion King was no match for the fearsome and absolute power of the deep red giant beast, and its massive body was once again blasted away.
“No.”
“How could my god be defeated!”
As they stared at the black behemoth traveling at a terrifying speed, with airwaves constantly expanding around it, all peoples of the different races were filled with fear and disbelief as their faith crumbled.
Boom!
Under the terrifying impact, the city of the different races exploded, the earth shattered within tens of kilometers, and scorching magma that destroyed everything erupted, annihilating everything around.
Especially those purple flames, they emitted a terrifying power that obliterated souls, instantly wiping out any trace of the souls of all the different races.
In fact, the Black Oblivion King’s hellfire was terrifying, not only capable of burning through the void but also burning souls.
Unfortunately, the black and red lightning entwined around the Deep Red Giant Beast was too terrifying, annihilating everything, making these hellfire flames unable to come close.

chapters.title: Chapter 757: 334: Crushing the Myth, the Invincible Thunder Flame Emperor Dragon_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 757: Chapter 334: Crushing the Myth, the Invincible Thunder Flame Emperor Dragon_3
Buzz!
At this moment, a dazzling light flashed from the mouth of the Deep Red Giant Beast. In an instant, a red-blue beam several tens of meters thick burst out, hitting the mountain range in the distance as the Black Oblivion King dodged.
Boom! The mountains collapsed, and a nuclear explosion lit up the sky.
In the brief moment when the Deep Red Giant Beast stopped its breath attack, the Black Colossus in its fierce form swept through the hellfire and pounced from the side.
Boom!
The two giant beasts collided again. However, this time, the Deep Red Giant Beast completely ignored the opponent’s claws falling on its chest and embraced the neck of the Black Oblivion King with its double claws.
Roar! Aiming at the back of the Black Oblivion King, the Deep Red Giant Beast bit down along with the hellfire that burned souls.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the terrifying bite force of the Deep Red Giant Beast, the thick scale armor on the back of the Black Oblivion King shattered continuously, followed by a huge chunk of flesh and blood being torn out viciously.
Roar!
The Black Oblivion King let out a scream, a nearly hundred-meter-wide bloody hole torn in its back. Its eyes were filled with violence and cruelty. A piece of scale armor on its forehead cracked, exposing a pitch-black Hell’s Eye.
In an instant, the Deep Red Giant Beast sensed a strong aura of danger approaching. From the Hell’s Eye in the brow of the Black Oblivion King, a black light beam shot out.
Puchi! Under the beam that annihilated everything, the lightning on the Deep Red Giant Beast’s body dissipated, and the thick deep red scale armor on its chest shattered, directly being pierced by a blood hole with a diameter of more than ten meters, going through from front to back.
Even with 900-fold defense, the Deep Red Giant Beast was unable to resist the close-range Rule Magic of the Black Oblivion King.
Such terrifying power made the Deep Red Giant Beast, which had the upper hand in strength, defense, speed, and Deep Red Thunder, feel a little flustered. Its defense was actually penetrated.
Boom!
The two giant beasts’ powers exploded, and under the rebounding force, they were shaken apart by more than ten kilometers. They gasped heavily, swallowing and exhaling the scorching gale.
Inhaling and exhaling, purple flame leaped on the Black Oblivion King, and a surge of faith power gushed out, flesh and blood regenerating on its back, and the wounds healed in the blink of an eye.
Trying to outlast in the Hell Domain, you’re courting death.
As a Mythical Giant Beast, the body of the Black Oblivion King had long been tempered with rule, making it incredibly powerful.
Moreover, with the power of tens of thousands of kilometers of Hell Domain blessing it, its strength was endless, not afraid of trading injury for injury at all.
However, just as the cold gaze of the Black Oblivion King emerged, it saw the wounds on the distant Deep Red Giant Beast had also healed, including the pierced heart.
Such a terrible regeneration made the Black Oblivion King’s eyes tighten.
But as Transcendent Giant Beasts, they both had strong regeneration abilities. As long as they consumed energy, their injuries would heal quickly, unless it was a fatal injury.
Roar! I don’t believe your Life Energy is endless.
Boom! The two giant beasts pounced at each other once more, and the battle instantly erupted again.
This time, the two giant beasts seemed even crazier. Amidst exchanging injuries, scales shattered, god’s blood flowed, and the earth cracked and collapsed wherever they went.
From time to time, they would fly up into the sky and continue their attacks, with breath attacks comparable to nuclear explosions sweeping across Heaven and Earth, and the aftershocks destroying everything within a thousand-kilometer range.
Boom!
Suddenly, a purple-red light fell from the sky, and in an instant, a thousand-meter-high mountain peak below collapsed, and a hundreds of meters wide Lava River below the mountain was directly cut off.
Roar!
On the broken earth stood the Black Colossus, its body covered with broken scales in many places, watching the giant beast in the sky flashing with black-red lightning and roaring with brutality.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, within a range of hundreds of kilometers, columns of magma, each hundreds of meters thick, surged up to the sky, shaking the world in deafening explosions, turning the sky and land into a Hellish World in the blink of an eye.
Enveloped in substantial purple flames and rules swirling around the Black Oblivion King, a real hell formed in the surroundings, its aura soaring, exuding a terrifying and horrifying pressure.
Under the conscious control of the Black Oblivion King, they had entered the two-thousand-kilometer core range of the Hell Domain.
And as the two ‘Mythical’ Giant Beasts confronted each other, a terrifying creature, more than forty kilometers long and resembling a mountain range, also stepped into the Hell Domain.
On its body were rolling mountains, falling waterfalls, winding rivers with green grass and trees, and huge sky-touching trees that were tens or even hundreds of meters tall, teeming with animals.
At the front of the mountain range, a mouth resembling an abyss cracked open and let out a terrifying roar of unknown meaning.
“Eat, Heaven…”

chapters.title: Chapter 758: 335: Tearing the Lava Lord Apart, the Battle Ends
chapters.content:
Chapter 758: Chapter 335: Tearing the Lava Lord Apart, the Battle Ends
On the dim earth, dark red rivers of burning magma flowed like the earth’s veins, bringing light and warmth to the Dark Hell.
In the plains where these magma rivers crossed, rough-styled settlements of foreign races were built, but those near the core area were abandoned.
At this moment, on the edge of the middle layer of the domain, these aliens gathered in front of the altar, looking fanatically at the statue on the altar that was burning with purple flames.
In front of the aliens, the priest continuously chanted titles such as the great Black Oblivion King, the Magma Master, and the Hell Master.
Under the guidance of the priest, a strong faith power spread from these aliens, which was transformed by the law imprints inside the statue, amplifying the power of the Hell Domain.
In fact, under normal conditions, mythical giant beasts follow their own evolution and integrate with law. It’s quite rare for a giant beast like this to follow the path of a faith-based Divine Nation.
“Roar! Destruction, descend!”
Accompanied by an excited roar, a silver giant dragon emerged from the rolling black storm, surrounded by black mixing with ice crystal storm.
From its mouth, a dazzling silver light flickered, followed by a roar of icy flame breath that was as thick as ten meters, like a silver light beam falling from the sky.
Boom!
Under the terrifying icy flame energy breath, the center of the wide foreign race’s town instantly exploded, and countless dirt flew, followed by a constantly spreading cold shockwave.
Whoosh!
With the sweeping of the breath, everything was frozen under the cold shock of the outbreak; whether it was aliens or buildings, they were all covered in a layer of silvery-blue ice crystals.
“Roar! The great Sethia is destruction.”
Like a fighter dropping from the sky, the silver giant dragon landed with a bang, immediately all the frozen materials around it shattered into a ground of ice crystals.
The fallen silver giant dragon turned its head, looking at the altar ahead burning with purple flames protected by law power, and more than twenty crystals on the altar steps whose energy had not entirely faded.
“Roar! There are only these few Life Crystals, these subordinates are really useless.”
In a low roar, on the spiral horns of the silver giant dragon’s head, a terrifying energy was triggered, revealing a black power even more frightening than the black storm surrounding it.
Boom!
Under the impact of the dragon horns wrapped in terrifying power of the silver giant dragon, the power shield that required quasi-mythical level power to break instantly shattered around the altar.
At the same time, as the law imprints were destroyed, cracks appeared on the black statue above the altar, and the flames were extinguished.
Looking at the broken black statue, the silver giant dragon roared triumphantly, then happily picked up the Life Crystals.
Although the patchy energy contained in these crystals was useless to it, Tim Abott, after eating, could become stronger, which would mean it also became stronger.
After all, it’s the Big Dragon King of the Dragon Palace. Doesn’t the overall strength increase of the Dragon Palace equals its strength increase.
This logic was unquestionable. Thinking of this, the silver giant dragon, who had finished collecting the crystals, delightedly spread its wings and soared into the sky with a strong flap that stirred a raging wind.
Following the magma river, the silver giant dragon flew at a terrifying speed in the high altitude, sweeping through small towns of aliens, like a dragon of destruction.
Facing the Level 9 Giant Beast with dual top-tier talents, these aliens who were mainly level four or five had no chance to fight back at all. One breath could wipe out the majority.
Moreover, due to the reason of faith prayers, these aliens all gathered together, which actually facilitated the silver giant dragon.
If these aliens scattered in all directions, even if the silver giant dragon killed a thousand, it would take one or two days, not as it is now, killing hundreds to thousands with one breath.
After all, those with a physique of Level 4 or higher run very fast. It’s tough to kill in a large area when they can run one or two hundred meters per second.
Soon, without any hindrance, the silver giant dragon encircled the Hell Domain, making its way to a big city where more than a hundred thousand alien tribes resided.
“Be careful, an evil giant beast is attacking.”
“Block it.”
“We cannot let it disrupt the prayer ceremony…”
Boom boom boom!!
On the vast land, four level sevens and one level eight of the aliens burst into dazzling purple flames, echoing the magma in the nearby magma river.
In an instant, the hot magma river exploded, turning into more than twenty hell magma dragons ranging from tens to hundreds of meters in length, roaring and trying to block the descending Destructive Ice Crystal Breath.
Boom!
Under the Destructive Breath mixed with black ice, the roaring hell magma dragons in the sky were instantly frozen and shattered, followed by the priests and aliens below.
“Run quickly.”
“We can’t hold it back, this Level 9 Giant Beast is too strong.”
“Quick, summon Lord Kayle.”
“Lord Kayle is not responding.”
“We can’t let it desecrate our god statue…”
Roar roar roar!!
Under the brutal roar of a dragon, destruction breaths fell from the sky. The city was in chaos, some aliens wanted to resist, some turned to flee.
This scene made the silver giant dragon even more excited, releasing one mouthful after another of icy flames and Destructive Breath, destroying everything.
Compared to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s breakthrough to level seven, when one breath could only maintain energy for one minute, the energy contained within a Level 9 Giant Beast is vast and endless.
A few minutes later, after the silver giant dragon had swept around the city twice, most of the aliens and buildings were wiped out and demolished by its breath.
However, after delving into this place, there weren’t many Life Crystals on these altars, because the mutated creatures in the vicinity had been long slaughtered and sacrificed by these aliens.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 759: 335: Tearing the Lava Lord Apart, the Battle Ends -2
chapters.content:
Chapter 759: Chapter 335: Tearing the Lava Lord Apart, the Battle Ends -2
The Silver Giant Dragon descended from the sky, its massive body crashing onto the riverside of magma with a loud bang. Amid the scattering rocks, it stared at the Black Dragon Trees by the river, its eyes glowing with excitement.
On these black trees, there were plenty of top-tier Divine Fruits with diameters of one meter, three meters, and even one with a diameter of five meters.
“Roar! Great Sethia loves collecting good things.”
With a roar, the Silver Giant Dragon happily picked off the Black Melting Divine Fruits one by one and stored them into its Reverse Scale Space. Then, it flew towards the next alien tribe.
Meanwhile, as the Silver Giant Dragon was circling the Middle Layer Region and destroying one alien tribe after another.
The Deep Red Giant Beast stood tall in the firmament, its ferocious dragon head flanked by three pairs of red feather horns slanting toward the sky. Red lightning flickered and intertwined above it, forming a lightning crown between its dragon horns, like a Deep Red Master.
On the ground below, pillars of magma hundreds of meters thick rose into the sky, merging into the purple sea of fire above. Countless magma fell like fiery rain.
In between Heaven and Earth, the terrifying Hell Rules entwined, raging flames burned, forming a real magma hell both above and below, horrifying and appalling.
Under the suppression of the powerful Hell Rules, the space around the Deep Red Giant Beast was nearly solidified, making it hard to move, and the Heavenly Energy was isolated, making it impossible to absorb and recover.
This was the might of a Divine Nation – rule suppression, energy isolation, and a greater amplification for the Lord of the Divine Domain.
For instance, at this moment, the size of the Black Colossus on the ground had increased a bit, reaching over 1,300 meters. It appeared even more robust and ferocious, and its aura had surged to the late period of the Mythical Giant Beast.
“Roar! Today, this king will tear you apart.”
Boom!
Following the roar, an enormous, boundless black dragon head appeared in the sky, devouring Heaven and Earth as it swallowed the ‘immovable’ Deep Red Giant Beast in one bite.
Or to say that this entire world was in its mouth, making it impossible to dodge or escape.
Boom! The Dragon of Hell bit down, and the void collapsed in an instant. The entire world sank into darkness, and deep within the void, a more terrifying hell emerged faintly.
However, just as the Dragon of Hell was about to swallow the Deep Red Giant Beast and drag it into the Hell Plane.
Boom!
Endless black-red thunderbolts exploded in the mouth of the Hell Dragon, illuminating Heaven and Earth. Under the terrifying power of annihilation, the Dragon of Hell exploded violently.
Roar! In an instant, from the depths of the void, an enraged roar echoed.
Raging turbulence surged as the Deep Red Giant Beast, over a thousand meters long, stood tall. Electric light flickered around its body and an invisible aura of destruction filled the world, unparalleled.
It held in its claws a lightning long spear over 2,000 meters long, made entirely of black-red lightning. The spear had a terrifying energy that twisted the surrounding space.
Roar!
With a heaven-shattering and earth-shattering ferocious roar, the Deep Red Giant Beast made a thunderous move, breaking through the sealing of the space from the sky. The lightning long spear penetrated Heaven and Earth, destroying everything in its path.
Roar!
The Black Oblivion King, whose power had surged, let out a tyrannical roar and braced itself to face the challenge. All around it, columns of hell magma shot up into the sky, covering the entire area.
Boom! In an instant, the Mythical Great Battle erupted.
The lightning long spear in the hand of the Deep Red Giant Beast swept across, destroying everything and shattering columns of magma fire before sweeping the Black Oblivion King off its feet.
The compressed and deep red thunder exploded and scattered the surrounding Hellfire Rules entwined around it.
Boom!
The two terrifying giant beasts clashed again, their horrifying impact destroyed everything around them.
Roar! In the instant of the clash, the strength of the entire body of the Deep Red Giant Beast converged into one, and an even more terrifying power erupted in an instant. With a backhand claw, it grabbed the Black Colossus’ double claws and threw it over its shoulder.
Boom!
Its massive body, over a thousand meters long, smashed into the ground, instantly causing the earth to shake for tens of kilometers. Mountains collapsed, and magma surged up into the sky like a tsunami.
The sudden change left the Black Colossus somewhat bewildered.
It had already suppressed its opponent using Hell Rules and sealed off this world. At the same time, it had become even more powerful with the entwining of the rules. So why was it still losing?
Roar!
The Black Colossus let out an even more brutal roar, wrapped in rules, and an endless eruption of Hellfire, powerful enough to burn an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast to death, spread out and consumed everything.
In the terrifying Hellfire tsunami, the Deep Red Giant Beast stood as unshakable as a mountain, going upstream against the flow with a terrifying momentum and rushing towards the Black Colossus.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Terrifying battles erupted once more.
At this moment, the Deep Red Giant Beast was like a Martial Arts Grandmaster. Its Double Claws, which contained the power to destroy mountains, were as swift as lightning. The Tail Blade, wrapped in destructive lightning, shone like water, tearing through the void.
Suddenly, under the blessing of the Core Hell Domain, the more potent Kaltos was being pressed down by the Deep Red Giant Beast, causing the Hell Rules between Heaven and Earth to tremble.
Boom! The terrifying Tail Blade struck the ground, and the land filled with flowing magma shattered in an instant, forming a chasm that stretched for kilometers.
Whoosh!
The all-annihilating Hell’s Eye Light Beam burst out, barely dodged by the close-ranged Deep Red Giant Beast. It pierced through one mountain peak after another, creating a straight, ten-meter-wide hollow in the air.
Roar! Amidst the roar, the Deep Red Giant Beast retreated a step, dodging the Black Colossus’ strike that swept up a sky full of fire. Its double claws landed a lightning-fast strike on its head and shoulders.
Boom! The ground beneath the Black Colossus crumbled, and the terrifying Destructive Impact exploded.
At this moment, the Deep Red Giant Beast flipped its body and swung its Tail Blade that tore through the void. With Kinetic Blessing, it slashed its blade toward the neck of the Black Colossus on the ground.
Boom!
As the Black Colossus rolled, the horrifying blade struck its back, cleaving a massive wound over 300 meters long and several meters deep.
The terrible wound revealed its bone, and the super-alloy-like purple flesh on both sides was torn apart, exposing a black-gold hard backbone.

chapters.title: Chapter 760: 335: Tearing the Lava Lord Alive, The Great Battle Ends_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 760: Chapter 335: Tearing the Lava Lord Alive, The Great Battle Ends_3
But as the Black Colossus was wounded by a strike, the Deep Red Giant Beast also retreated over a dozen steps under the opponent’s sweeping tail attack, its scale armor cracking.
Huff huff! The Black Colossus stood up from the ground, breathing heavily, its eyes filled with brutality and destruction, looked solemnly at the ferocious Deep Red Giant Beast.
On its back, the huge wound was rapidly healing with the supplement of Law Power and domain power.
The gaze of the Deep Red Giant Beast was cold towards this situation, without a hint of faltering.
In this world, there is no such thing as undying, even for those Supreme beings that have become rule-based creatures, they too have a day of falling, let alone this Mythical Giant Beast.
Roar roar!! With a fierce roar, the two Mythical Giant Beasts once again clashed in battle.
Today, neither beast had a way out, it was either the Black Colossus dragging the battle until the Deep Red Giant Beast exhausted its strength and killing it, or the Deep Red Giant Beast destroying its Law Body and tearing the Black Colossus apart.
Boom boom boom! Everything in the path of the two giant beasts was destroyed, and under the aftermath, mountain peaks collapsed, and lava rivers reversed flow.
If this battle had occurred in the Blue Star World, just the aftermath alone would have turned a continental block into ruins.
Roar roar roar! The ferocious and brutal roars echoed between heaven and earth.
In the midst of the frenzied slaughter, the Deep Red Giant Beast used its Martial Arts advantage to forcefully suppress the Black Colossus.
Even exchanging light injuries for heavy injuries time and again, it drove Deep Red Thunders mixed with Destructive Lightning into the body of the Black Oblivion King, and its Tail Blade slashed out huge wounds.
After repeated heavy injuries, recoveries, and more heavy injuries, the aura of the Black Colossus gradually began to slide.
At the same time, the Deep Red Giant Beast noticed that the pervasive faith power between heaven and earth was weakening, causing the surrounding Law Domains suppressing it to weaken as well.
However, the Deep Red Giant Beast wasn’t unharmed; under the suppression of speed in the Hell Domain, it was occasionally pierced through by beams from Hell’s Eye.
But as long as its head was avoided, these wounds would heal in the blink of an eye with Top-tier regeneration, and the expended Life Energy was of no concern.
The flesh and blood strength of the Deep Red Giant Beast, comparable to tens of times that of its peers, was not just about strength, Defense.
Just like Jack Clark’s body, resistance, recovery, endurance, all maxed out, and the biological energy contained within was unimaginable in magnitude.
Therefore, even without the ability to absorb Heavenly Energy for recovery, its combat power remained undiminished.
Soon, the two Terrifying Giant Beasts fought their way to the center of the Hell Domain, where the Hell Rules that twined around the Black Colossus became even stronger.
But the Deep Red Giant Beast, with its Terror Defense, still forcefully clashed with the opponent.
“It is my god.”
“The great Black Oblivion King is battling the invading Evil God.”
Below the volcano, in the Divine City where many of the different races had retreated, the twenty-some thousand Scaled Fire Alien Tribe watched the terrifying battle in the distant sky, each with fervent expressions.
“For the great Hell Master, the Black Oblivion King, all faith soldiers, follow me and charge.”
Under the lead of a high priest exuding the aura of Level 9 Early Stage, over a hundred thousand level four and above Aliens formed a mighty army, with purple flames leaping on their bodies, surged out of the Divine City in a grand manner.
Boom! Just at that moment, a deep red beam of light pierced through heaven and earth, and as it blasted the Black Colossus away, it swept across the earth, cutting through the alien army.
In an instant, dazzling bursts of explosive firelight erupted on the ground, wiping out tens of thousands of the alien forces in a single stroke.
Before the terrified aliens could react, a terrifying pressure that collapsed the void and pressed down the firmament burst forth, forcing all aliens below the 8th level to collapse to the ground with a thunderous crash.
Roar! Having been blasted away and weakened, the Black Colossus’ eyes revealed madness as a law power centered on it burst forth with a roar.
Boom! A volcano more than five thousand meters away suddenly collapsed, endless hell magma spewed forth, submerging everything, the Divine City, and all the aliens.
In the sudden apocalypse, the remaining aliens had no time to react before they were engulfed.
Boom!
Having devoured the flesh and souls of hundreds of thousands of its subordinates, the might of the Black Oblivion King immediately recovered by a large margin, its body size even swelling further, wrapped in terrifying purple flames.
Roar! Just then, the ground beneath the Deep Red Giant Beast shattered, a sea of magma exploded, and in a moment, the Black Colossus was struck by a terrifying force and sent flying.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Two giant beasts entangled madly ten thousand meters above the ground, and when they hit the earth, they smashed a crater of more than ten kilometers across, with the Black Colossus being firmly held down by the Deep Red Giant Beast.
As the Black Colossus struggled frantically and its claws inflicted massive wounds on itself, the eyes of the Deep Red Giant Beast overflowed with endless destruction and cruelty, biting down on the back of the Black Colossus’ neck.
Under the terrifying bite force, the Black Colossus’s thick scale armor shattered, its flesh and blood torn apart, followed by the incredibly tough cervical vertebrae which emitted terrifying crackling sounds.
Roar, roar, roar!! In an instant, the Black Colossus felt the danger of death for the first time, struggling more frantically as endless hellfire erupted within it.
The terrifying hellfire scorched the Deep Red Giant Beast’s soul, causing piercing pain and driving it even more mad, its golden vertical pupils turning blood red as a terrifying power burst from its jaws.
Boom! In an instant, flesh and blood splattered everywhere as the Deep Red Giant Beast instantly bit off the Black Colossus’s head.
Roar! The head of the Black Colossus being bitten off let out a scream of agony.
At that moment, dazzling black-red lightning burst from the mouth of the Deep Red Giant Beast, thunderously engulfing the head of the Black Colossus, frantically eroding the soul consciousness of the Black Colossus.
This is what makes Mythical Creatures so difficult to deal with, their Law Bodies immensely strong and their Soul Wills extremely hard to kill.
Unlike cultivators who have transformed their souls into Divine Souls and condensed Law Bodies, giant beasts follow a route of physical evolution, with the soul and body becoming one after breaking through to the mythic level.
However, the soul of a Mythical-level Giant Beast is not yet fully merged with its body, like this Black Oblivion King, where the degree of fusion is still in its head and upper body.
When the soul will of a Mythical Giant Beast fully merges with the body, law, flesh, and soul as one, that is when it breaks through to a Mythical Titan.
Under the relentless eruption of deep red annihilation lightning, the soul of the Black Oblivion King was obliterated, its head gradually disintegrated, turning to ash and vanishing.
Roar!
Standing tall on the earth, the Deep Red Giant Beast that had slain a Mythical Creature let out a sky-shaking roar, its form fierce and savage, exuding a terrifying aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 761: 336: The Unshakable Monster, Returning to Blue Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 761: Chapter 336: The Unshakable Monster, Returning to Blue Star
With the fall of the Black Oblivion King, the Hell Rules it controlled collapsed, and the dark clouds formed by its hellish powers began to disperse.
Suddenly, strands of silver moonlight spilled through the gaps in the collapsing black clouds, like silver sword lights piercing through heaven and earth. It was an awe-inspiring sight.
As the Deep Red Giant Beast stood tall in the boundless Magma Fire Sea, enjoying the lingering victory, a roar from the Silver Giant Dragon could be heard in the distance.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you defeated that guy, so awesome!” The Silver Giant Dragon soared down from the sky, circling excitedly around the Deep Red Giant Beast.
At this time, the Silver Giant Dragon glanced at the decapitated Titan Beast corpse, and looked around: “Roar! Tim Abott, where is the head of the Black Oblivion King?”
The Deep Red Giant Beast spoke in a deep voice: “It was destroyed when I crushed its soul.”
“Roar! It’s gone, oh well.”
