With a roar, the Silver Giant Dragon retracted its wings, and with a bang, the hundred-meter-long dragon landed on the Black Titan Beast Corpse, stepping on the corpse and roaring proudly.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Damn Black Oblivion King, this is what happens when you dare to ignore the Great Sethia.”
“In front of the Great Sethia, your Kol Empire is nothing! Roar, roar, roar!!” The Silver Giant Dragon spread its wings and proudly let out a series of roars.
Seeing this scene, the corner of the Deep Red Giant Beast’s mouth twitched involuntarily.
This guy had been joking around the whole time, but now he was really roaring on top of the Black Oblivion King’s corpse, holding a grudge like a child.
Whoosh!
The Deep Red Giant Beast exhaled a scorching wind, and the lightning wrapped around its body gradually disappeared. Its size also shrank as it returned from its Giant State to about 290 meters.
Suddenly, a strong sense of weakness came from within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body, and its massive body swayed involuntarily.
This battle could be said to be the fiercest and most brutal since the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon evolved, with the fight lasting for more than half an hour and spanning thousands of kilometers.
“Roar! Tim Abott, eat something good to replenish yourself.”
Noticing the weak aura emanating from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon took out a Black Melting Divine Fruit with a diameter of five meters from the Reverse Scale Space.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t hesitate, swallowing the top-tier Divine Fruit in one bite. Instantly, the explosive and vigorous energy within its body erupted, its cells greedily absorbing it.
As the Divine Fruit that could even enhance the strength of Mythical Giant Beasts was consumed, the biological energy within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon quickly recovered.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s energy was mostly restored, the earth trembled in the distance. An imposing mountain range emerged, surrounded by mist.
It was a terrifying creature over forty kilometers long and more than twenty kilometers tall, equivalent to over twenty thousand meters – taller than two Himalayas, with half of its body reaching into the clouds.
With each step the terrifying creature took, the earth exploded, countless dirt and rocks flew thousands of meters, and tsunami-like waves of air rolled around, shaking heaven and earth.
In front of this terrifying lifeform, the few hundred or thousand-meter-tall mountain peaks crumbled like sand dunes, unstoppable.
“Ancient creatures.”
Looking at the colossal creature in the distance, which moved slowly and took a long time to take each step, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes showed a serious expression.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes filled with curiosity: “Roar! It should be the ancient creature from the Misty Area, but didn’t it just move recently?”
“Sethia, be careful, I have a feeling that it’s up to no good.” Growling, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon moved to the side of the Black Titan Beast Corpse, ready to pick it up and run if something went wrong.
The flesh and blood of this Black Titan Beast was the ‘food’ that allowed it to quickly grow to Level 9 Peak and start its Fifth Evolution.
Seeing that the ancient being was moving slowly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but growl, “Sethia, did you find anything good when you destroyed those minions from different races?”
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon nodded happily, and excitedly growled, “Yes, the Great Sethia found many Life Crystals, and that Black Melting Divine Fruit.”
“Not bad.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction, then asked with curiosity, “Sethia, how big is your Reverse Scale Space?”
“Roar! It’s huge; Mom helped me create it. It’s big enough to fit a Sethia.” The Silver Giant Dragon said with some pride.
It knew that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon didn’t have Storage Space, and used to carry small bags to store things. Comparing the two, the Great Sethia was indeed more powerful.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but envy: “I didn’t expect your Reverse Scale Space to be so big, Sethia. You must have a lot of good stuff in there, right?”
“Not much, just some Heavenly Dragon Fruits, a few hundred Gold Light God Fruits that Torfinna stuffed me with when I left, Star Crystals, and many more that I picked up along the way…”
At this point, the Silver Giant Dragon suddenly backed away two steps, its eyes becoming vigilant: “Roar! Nothing, all the good stuff was eaten by Sethia.”
…Eaten my head, do you think I’m as easy to fool as you are?
A few dark lines emerged on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head.
Of course, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wouldn’t stoop so low as to deceive a child, so it feigned belief and nodded: “Roar! I know you ate it all, otherwise with your generosity, Sethia, you would have already shared some with everyone.”
“Roar! That’s right, the Great Sethia has always been generous.” The Silver Giant Dragon nodded proudly, its tail curling up with pride.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon was considering whether to take out some good things when it got home, so that everyone would say how generous the Great Sethia was, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 762: 336: Unshakable Monster, Return to the Blue Star_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 762: Chapter 336: Unshakable Monster, Return to the Blue Star_2
As the two giant beasts were communicating, that terrifying ancient creature had already taken a few steps forward, and the majestic mountains stretched tens of kilometers away in the distance.
Boom!
The dark clouds that had not yet dissipated rolled, and a vast, mountain-like skull slowly protruded from the clouds. The gray, petrified eyes glared.
Or more precisely, it was staring at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Then the mountain peak split open in the middle, revealing a huge crack and countless petrified teeth like small hills, emitting a heaven-shaking roar.
“Heaven…”
“No, not heaven…”
What did they mean by ‘heaven’ and ‘not heaven’? The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon showed confusion and seriousness in its eyes.
At this moment, another vague roar came from the mouth of that terrifying creature.
“Eat…”
Boom! A horrifying suction force suddenly burst out, shaking heaven and earth, with raging winds howling and the earth collapsing within a range of more than ten kilometers. Countless magma mixed with dirt soared into the sky.
Darkness covered the sky, and the sand and stones were flying. Under the terrifying suction force, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared: “Roar! Scythia, get away quickly!”
In its roar, the Thunderbolt Wings behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spread out. Emitting a golden light from its Scale Horns, the dragon seized the tail of the Black Colossus, measuring a thousand meters, and flew against the wind.
But the suction force was not only capable of causing a world-ending hurricane but also harbored a terrifying power that even swallowed the space itself, making the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly retreat.
Boom! On the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Golden Flame Domain, integrated with the Purple Void Poison, unfolded but did not cover a thousand meters, only a hundred meters.
The power comparable to the mythic domain, terrifying destructive high temperature, and obliteration annihilated everything around, whether it was hurricanes or those falling rocks and swallowing force.
Immediately the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt lighter.
However, the Silver Giant Dragon nearby was struggling to resist it. The destructive black wind domain surrounded the surroundings, and the wings flapped frantically, as it was forced to fly backwards step by step.
“Roar! The great Scythia does not want to be eaten!” In its roar, the Silver Giant Dragon’s Reverse Scale under its neck flashed, and a huge dragon scale appeared in its claws.
“Scythia, don’t waste it!”
Amidst the roars, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grabbed the tail of the Silver Giant Dragon while holding the nearly thousand-meter-long tail of the Black Colossus with one claw. With its strength bursting, it shattered countless pieces of dirt and rocks.
Under the full power of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the two giant beasts escaped the swallowing area and instantly felt lighter, letting out a long breath together.
The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings nervously, looking back, and said, “Roar! Damn thing, once the great Scythia becomes stronger, I will ask Tim Abott to smash your head.”
Uh…what does you getting stronger have to do with me smashing its head?
Unable to understand the Silver Giant Dragon’s thoughts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked back at the terrifying ancient creature that consumed heaven and earth, revealing a fierce light in its eyes. It dared to think about eating it.
“Roar! Scythia, you take this and hide farther away.” Saying this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s arms burst with strength and threw the corpse of the Black Oblivion King to the Silver Giant Dragon.
Boom! The Silver Giant Dragon stretched out its double claws and quickly caught the Black Colossus’ mountain-like massive corpse. Then, with a loud bang, it fell to the ground together.
“Roar! Tim Abott, it’s so heavy!”
On the ground, the Silver Giant Dragon struggled to flap its wings, while the storm domain around it covered a range of seven hundred meters, dragging the Black Colossus’ tail and flying slowly towards the distance.
After handing the giant beast’s corpse to the Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Thunderbolt wings vibrated, and it rushed towards the sky above, appearing tens of kilometers away from that terrifying ancient creature.
Boom! In the cloud layer, countless thunderbolts exploded, rushing towards the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Amidst the roaring thunders, nine dark blue thunder rings with a diameter of eight hundred meters shone, just like an Innate Thunder Matrix, emitting a terrifying aura.
At the same time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s entire body ignited with blazing golden flames, and the three rows of coral reef-like dorsal fins lit up one by one.
Hum!
Golden and purple light shone in the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and in an instant, a light beam several dozen meters thick roared out. As the light beam passed through each thunder ring, it swelled continuously.
Boom!
The heavens and the earth alternated between black and white, leaving only the destructive beam a hundred meters in diameter, emitting gold, blue and purple light, piercing the world with dazzling energy halos surrounding it.
And at this moment, that frightening ancient creature slowly reacted, and the swallowing force in its mouth disappeared.
In front of it, the ground within a range of more than ten kilometers disappeared, turning into a huge pit. By consuming countless dirt and rocks, it grew visibly larger.
Just at that moment, the destructive breath fused with three top-tier talents struck the head of the ancient creature.
Boom!
An earth-shattering explosion echoed in the heavens and the earth, like a high-yield hydrogen bomb explosion’s light engulfing the ancient creature’s skull, shining upon the heaven and earth with light and heat.
The hot wave caused by the explosion dispersed clouds in a range of tens of kilometers, and when it moved over the backs of living creatures on the mountain, countless rocks melted, grass and trees burned, and small rivers dried up.
Those creatures living on the back of the ancient creature roared in terror, burning and dissolving into ashes under the terrifying high temperature.
More than ten minutes later, as the aftermath of the explosion dissipated, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon standing in the high altitude showed an even more serious look.
Under the moonlight in the distance, half of the rocky surface on the towering ancient creature’s head had turned black due to the rock’s melting and cooling. An enormous crater several hundred meters wide had been blasted into its head.
However, it was only the external rock layer that had melted slightly.
Including the ‘large’ pit on the ancient creature’s head, its massive body was equivalent to losing a piece of scalp – the kind it didn’t care about at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 763: 336 The Unshakeable Monster, Returning to Blue Star_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 763: Chapter 336 The Unshakeable Monster, Returning to Blue Star_3
Woosh!
Although he had long known that such ‘deceased’ ancient creatures were terrifying, the fearsome defense still made the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exhale a hot breath.
After a deep look at the ancient creature, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spread its Thunderbolt Wings and promptly chased after the Silver Giant Dragon in the distance, taking the Black Titan Beast Corpse from its claws.
“Eat…”
With a leisurely roar, the ancient creature that had just been bombarded took a step forward, causing an upheaval that rippled like a tsunami, moving in the direction where the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had disappeared.
By this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon had already charged hundreds of kilometers away.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked back at the rolling clouds under the moonlight in the sky, its eyes condensed: “Roar! Scythia, let’s circle back to Blue Star.”
After circling around and flying more than 10,000 kilometers in over three hours, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon saw the mountain peak and the channel they had come from.
The hundred-meter-tall red channel stood proudly on the mountain peak, slowly revolving. The invisible spatial fluctuations it emitted stirred Heaven and Earth.
At this time, under the double claws of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Sword Dragon Giant Beast was being dragged with effort. It had been split into two by a powerful strike under the Tail Blade.
As a quasi-mythical behemoth, the rule factors and biological energy contained in the flesh and blood would naturally be a waste to discard them, so they picked them up while circling around.
Boom!
The mountain peak trembled, the earth cracked, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that was dragging the Black Titan Beast Corpse stood on the ground, looked back at the rolling clouds in the sky, and roared lowly.
“Scythia, you go first.”
Don’t look at the slow movement of that ancient creature, but when this slowness is a step of more than ten kilometers, it will be very scary.
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded and rushed into the channel while dragging the corpse of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast.
Under the deep sea, all kinds of giant beasts were lying around the center of the gigantic oceanic vortex. Suddenly, the distant red channel vibrated, drawing the attention of all the giant beasts.
Within the vibrating channel, a level 9 aura permeated, followed by the appearance of the Silver Giant Dragon, as well as the quasi-mythical behemoth it was dragging in its claws.
Immediately, joy appeared in the eyes of the Red Candle Dragon, the Nine-headed Monster Ghidorah, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and more.
The half-submerged Tiger Whale screamed in excitement: “Chirp Chirp Chirp!! Scythia, you’re back, how about Thunderflame, is it alright?”
“Roar! Tim Abott is behind.” As soon as the Silver Giant Dragon finished talking, the channel behind them started shaking madly, as if a terrifying creature was squeezing through it.
Immediately after, a sense of fear that all creatures dreaded spread out.
In the frantically spinning black channel, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed slightly strained as it squeezed in from the other side, followed by the colossal Black Titan Beast Corpse it was dragging, which almost filled up the channel.
Boom!
Accompanied by the long, thousand-meter-long, Giant Beast Corpse landing on the ground, the horrifying mythical aura spread instantly.
As a Mythical Giant Beast, and a beast that has reached the Mid-Mythical Stage at that, even in death, the invisible rule pressure it emitted was enough to instill fear in all the giant beasts.
As for the Black-red Colossal Beast standing next to the corpse, its figure covered in black spikes seemed even more terrifying.
Just as all the huge beasts stared wide-eyed, shocked that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had really killed a Mythical Giant Beast.
Boom!
Intense vibrations came from the other side of the channel, with the terrifying force even making the channel become unstable, constantly distorting and shaking, as if it would collapse in the next moment.
It was obvious that it was the ancient creature that was chasing after them.
Just that this channel was not enough for the ancient creature with its terrifying size to pass through. Therefore, after vibrating for a while, the red vortex that was about to collapse suddenly calmed down.

chapters.title: Chapter 764: 337: Ambushing Darren Callum, The Ocean Roars
chapters.content:
Chapter 764: Chapter 337: Ambushing Darren Callum, The Ocean Roars
In the dark void space, eight indistinct silhouettes stood tall, enveloped by substantial black demonic qi that roiled around them, emitting a terrifying aura.
Then, a voice that vibrated the space slowly rose, “Today is the Seven-day Rotation Duty Day, Deviana, do you have any new target information recently?”
On the left side, obscured by the demonic qi with a hint of a slender tail visible, a demon king spoke up with a hoarse voice.
“During this period on two great battlefields bordering the Human Race and our clan, we’ve discovered five human geniuses with Demon King potential, and one with Great Demon King potential.”
“But those humans are very cautious; they almost all operate within the range of the Human Base and never step out of the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, hence we can only seek opportunities to eliminate them on the frontlines.”
“In addition, recently there has been an influx of new blood into the Vast World from the Human Race, and I am currently devising ways to obtain precise information from that side.”
Demonic qi churned around another demon king opposite, and a cold voice followed, “The war potential of the Human Race is too strong; just twenty Sun Wheels have passed, and there’s already new aristocratic-level blood entering the battlefield.”
“We must find a way to curb the growth of the Human Race; otherwise, it might not take long before we can no longer suppress them in terms of mid-level combat power.”
Another demon king with an indifferent voice said, “From the start of the war until now, less than three hundred Sun Wheels in, the comprehensive strength of the Human Race has increased over threefold compared to the beginning.”
“Although there hasn’t been a significant change in the top-end combat power, the number of mid-high-end elites and strong men has been on the rise, growing at a rate far faster than our clan.”
At the primary position, Great Demon King Barus’s voice was deep, “This is normal. According to the time estimation, the world of the Human Race is about to collapse, to be devoured by the Vast World.”
“Under such circumstances, those worlds will commence ‘self-rescue,’ bursting with potential, and at the last moment, many with astonishing talent will emerge.”
“Therefore, we should be glad, for once the world behind the Human Race is drawn into the Vast World, under its impact, the majority of weak humans will die or mutate instantaneously.”
“At that time, whether it’s logistic supplies or the chance of genius births, both will decline substantially, thereby affecting the war potential.”
“Especially the Human Race’s technology; after research at the rear, it has been noted that under the influence of the rules of the Vast World, reactions of electronic components and many other elements are ineffective.”
“This means that we only need to wait a while longer and the Human Race will defeat itself.”
“During this time, our task is to kill those with the potential of Demon King and Great Demon King, ensuring no new high-end forces arise within the Human Race.”
“And on the other side, the civilization war with the Heavenly Feather Divine Sect has reached the late period, with the three major empires having committed all their strength, including four Demon God strong men.”
“According to the plan and progress from their side, a victor should soon emerge.”
“So we just need to wait a bit longer, the destruction of the Human Race is merely a matter of time.”
At this point, Barus turned his gaze to the lower left, his voice deepening, “Deviana, have you found any information on that Darren Callum?”
The demon king to the lower left whose tail barely stirred in the void replied in a hoarse voice, “Not yet.”
“Not yet?” A trace of displeasure was evident in Barus’s tone.
Demon King Deviana gave a bitter smile, “After the previous plan to disrupt the Human Race’s rear failed, all of our clan’s infiltrated forces have been pulled out, currently, only one dark line remains.”
“Wait, why is there one dark line left after all the infiltrated forces have been removed?” A demon king opposite asked, vigilant.
“That dark line is an illegitimate child from a large family group in the Human Clan’s Berlin Empire, with a high status and cautious enough not to be discovered.”
“Rest assured, Kletor, that human has been cooperating with me and Kautorus for nearly a hundred Sun Wheels, trading many useful pieces of information.”
“Due to the circumstances encountered since childhood, this human has no sense of belonging to the human race, and has always wanted to transform his human body into one of our True Demon Race.”
“After a long period of observation, trade, and testing, it can be confirmed that this human is trustworthy.”
“Given that our clan’s infiltrated forces have been cut off from the Human Race’s rear, I’m contemplating asking for a portion of the Blood of the Demon God to transform him into a high-ranking noble.”
“At that time, with him coordinating behind the Human Race, our True Demon Race’s strength will soon re-infiltrate.”
“Unfortunately, if it weren’t for Akunus the fool, Kautorus wouldn’t have been exposed so quickly, leading to the sealing of his Soul Source and the downfall of his True Body.”
“At the same time, causing the failure of this mission, pulling out all our infiltrated forces, including most tentacles from the Divine Sect Alliance.”
With that, the meeting lapsed into silence.
The disruption plan had been fully calculated from every aspect, with the initial goal only being for Kautorus to lie dormant and expand the Demon God Sect.
But due to Akunus’s persuasion, it ended up with the downfall of three Demon Kings, which can be described as a heavy loss.
Barus suddenly said, “Deviana, given that dark line has such a high status, can’t he obtain information about Darren Callum through his hands? Including his relatives and such?”
“After the last plan failed, that dark line sent a final message explaining the situation, then for his own safety, he has since severed contact with me, temporarily unreachable.”
A demon king opposite spoke in a low voice, “Indeed very cautious.”
“Is that so.”
Barus said gravely, “The talent of that Darren Callum is terrifying, with the cultivation of Six Path Demon Marks, yet he defeated Akunus’s Sea of Blood body, which is comparable to the Eight Path Demon Marks.”

chapters.title: Chapter 765: 337: Ambushing Darren Callum, The Ocean Roars_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 765: Chapter 337: Ambushing Darren Callum, The Ocean Roars_2
“If we let him continue to grow, our clan might end up with another formidable enemy in the future, like the Human Race’s Mysterious Martial and True Martial.”
“However, with his strength and talent, he will soon enter the Vast World, because only there can he grow quickly.”
“Or rather, he is among the new blood that came from the Human Race.”
Barus said gravely, “Devianna, mobilize all the spies we have among the Human Race, and try to collect detailed information about Darren Callum.”
Devianna spoke hesitantly, “Those spies belong to the previous generation of cultivators. They were excluded from the core high-level due to their souls not being recorded by the intrinsic weapon, the True Martial Stele, of the Human Race.”
“If we force them to investigate, they might be exposed.”
“It doesn’t matter. I have been sustaining them with our resources precisely so they can act at critical moments.”
“The failure of the last operation and the fall of the Three Demon Kings have already greatly displeased Lewus Demon God. We must achieve some results as soon as possible.”
…
Below the deep sea, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the slowly calming pathway, his golden vertical pupils gleaming with a cold light.
These pathways between two worlds have significant restrictions, such as this one that can only barely allow Mythical Creatures to pass through.
It had already felt somewhat strenuous when it, being at Mid Level 9, passed through earlier, let alone this being which essentially compares to an Ancient Titan.
At this moment, covered in a flow of yellow light that fused with the Earth, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle cautiously stuck its head out from underground where most of its body had shrunk.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame, what was that thing on the other side just now? It frightened the beast.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared lowly, warning these creatures, “On the other side lies a terrifying creature above Mythical-level. This pathway cannot be used until it has left.”
Roar roar roar!! Above Mythical-level! No wonder the aura that was spreading through the world passageways was that terrifying.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish poked its head out of the vortex of sea water, its thick, crystalline blue horn piercing the Firmament, and fear flickered in its eyes as it gazed at the pathway.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook its nine dragon heads, emitting a chaotic growl, “Roar roar roar!! Not scared, wait for Abbott, kill it, and eat it.”
The Silver Giant Dragon echoed with a roar, “Roar! Kidora is right. Eventually, Great Scythia will stand on its head and let it know how severe the consequences of pursuing Great Scythia can be.”
Because they met the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at different times, these Giant Beasts had different names for it. For instance, the Tiger Whale and Dragon Turtle, which met it first, always call it Thunderflame, while the Silver Giant Dragon remembered the name Tim Abott when it first met him.
After the two beasts teamed up and beat the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, it only remembered the name Abbott, when its full name is Brock Abbott.
The conversation among the beasts made the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon twitch his mouth corner, wondering if these creatures were a bit too confident in him.
That was an Ancient Titan-level being with a body as massive as a mountain range, incredibly powerful under the influence of the rules—likely something even a Mythical Titan couldn’t shake.
Not to mention itself, a Level 9 Giant Beast that hadn’t even broken through Mythical-level.
Shaking its head, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon ignored them and grabbed the tail of the Black Oblivion King with a thud of its double claws, its leg muscles swelling slightly as it executed a Power Explosion.
Boom!
In an instant, the entire seabed shattered, and the explosive force blew so violently that each Giant Beast instinctively burst into its domain to block the flying chunks of rock and dirt.
By that time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had already shot through the air, its massive body dragging the corpse of the Black Oblivion King through the seabed vortex and flying tens of thousands of meters into the air.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was engulfed in burning golden flames, surrounded by thunder, mixed with black lightning as powerful as the rule and a Mythical-level Terrifying Aura.
Roar roar roar!! Towering high in the air, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out ferocious roars that shook Heaven and Earth.
Under its fearsome presence, the atmosphere vibrated, and its unrestrained strength gathered at an altitude of over a hundred thousand meters, vaguely forming a colossal and ferocious black-red Colossal Beast’s shadow.
In the midst of its terrifying suppression, the Aura of the Black Oblivion King blended in, instantly causing the ocean to tremble.
Such is the terror of a Mythical-level, stirring the heavens, suppressing everything around.
Feeling the pressure from this newly ascended Mythical Giant Beast, and the Aura of the now-deceased Black Oblivion King, suddenly far beneath the deep sea, three terrible Auras burst forth.
Boom boom boom!!
Suddenly, the region of the deep sea howled with a raging wind, thunder rumbled, and the auras of four Mythical Giant Beasts intermingled in the sky, shaking the atmosphere to the extent that satellites outside the Earth’s atmosphere were disturbed.
Far away in space, on that immense man-made celestial body, a hundred-meter-tall Mecha’s eyes suddenly lit up, but then they dimmed again, and its voice echoed in the soundless void of space.
“Has there been another incident in the ocean?”
Waves surged tumultuously on the ocean, typhoons howled in the realm of the four terrifying Mythical-level pressures, countless Mutated Creatures scurried away in fright and upset.
Fortunately, the four Mythical Auras subsided after bursting forth, including that of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon who held the corpse of the Black Oblivion King.
It would soon enter its Fifth Evolution and hibernate at a Mythical level, so it had to warn the surrounding forces.
It declared this sea area its territory, including the Mythical Giant Beast that had occupied the pathway being killed by it, deterring all beings.
Concealing its flames and Thunder, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon returned to the seabed vortex with the corpse of the Black Oblivion King.

chapters.title: Chapter 766: 337: Ambushing Darren Callum, The Ocean Roars_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 766: Chapter 337: Ambushing Darren Callum, The Ocean Roars_3
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon landed, it was greeted by the excited gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon: “Roar! Tim Abbott, our Dragon Palace is now considered a hegemon.”
“Keep it up, hurry and eat this Black Oblivion King, quickly grow stronger to defeat those three, Great Sethia will dominate the ocean.”
“But when the time comes to fight the Balon Beast King, be gentler. It has a good temperament; it even let the Great Sethia pass through its pathway.”
Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon spinning around excitedly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared lowly: “Ruling the ocean is not urgent, let us first distribute the spoils from this time.”
“Roar! No problem.”
Although it was reluctant to part with its own treasures, the Silver Giant Dragon was quite generous with the spoils of war, rolling out a bunch of Life Crystals of Level 4 or higher from its Reverse Scale.
Next were several dozen Black Melting Divine Fruits.
Suddenly, Tiger Whale Third Brother poked its head out from within the vortex: “Roar! Uncle, I’ve eaten that fruit before; it’s delicious, and eating it will make you very powerful.”
“Roar! Isn’t that obvious, Third? Those treasures contain powerful energy fluctuations; one glance and you know they’re good stuff.”
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon stirred with its nine dragon heads, letting out a chaotic disdainful roar: “Roar roar roar! Joe, that’s, even more, nonsense.”
Just then, the Red Beast coiled in a corner suddenly spoke up, looking towards the swirling vortex in the distance, and slowly growled: “Good, so, scary!”
The scene instantly went silent.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at the Candle Dragon Giant Beast and then began distributing the loot.
Over seven hundred Life Crystals, two top-grade Black Melting Divine Fruits with a diameter of five meters, and the corpse of the Black Oblivion King – these all belonged to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
The two five-meter diameter Top-grade Divine Fruits belonged to the Silver Giant Dragon.
The remaining sixteen three-meter sized Senior Black Melting Divine Fruits were divided by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, after consulting with the Silver Giant Dragon, with three each given to the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Tiger Fish Dragon Turtle respectively.
The Candle Dragon Giant Beast had reached Late Stage 9 for a long time, spending a prolonged period in slowed time, perceiving the Time Laws.
With its talent, once it enters the quasi-mythical level and touches upon the Time, one of the Supreme Laws, its strength will be comparable to Ordinary Mythical Giant Beasts.
However, the Time Laws are too powerful, and under normal conditions, it has almost no hope.
But with these three Senior Black Melting Divine Fruits and the near-heavenly tier life’s Monarch Talent of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to stimulate its bloodline, it should have a certain chance.
As for the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, after consuming three Senior Divine Fruits, its strength could at least breakthrough to Mid Level 9, with combat power comparable to late period.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, after consuming some quasi-mythical behemoth flesh and blood, would almost be ready to enter Hibernation.
Next, before they hibernated, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would stimulate their bloodline one last time using the Monarch Talent opportunity, which should have hope in awakening a Top Tier Talent.
After that, by consuming three more Senior Divine Fruits, their strength could quickly grow to break through to Late Stage 9, and they would also possess decent combat power in the mythical world.
Indeed, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon planned to take them to the mythical world as well.
The breakthrough Candle Dragon would serve as the first striker, with the Nine-headed Flood Dragon as the second, working with the Dragon Turtle to hunt down powerful Giant Beasts and collect Life Crystals on his behalf over there.
As for the Single-horned Tiger Whale, its role would be even greater.
Through multiple evolutions, its unique horn’s treasure hunting talent had grown stronger, and by Level 8 later, it could filter air and detect the faint energy fluctuations emitted by Heaven and Earth Treasures.
Once in the mythical world, if it could locate some Top-level Divine Items, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt it would grow faster than if it were devouring the flesh and blood of Mythical Giant Beasts.
This is the advantage of having many subordinates.
As for Horned Lady and the Blue Giant Crab, they were given two Senior Black Melting Divine Fruits to refine slowly, which should directly take them to Level 8 Late Stage or even Peak.
After that, consuming the flesh and blood of quasi-mythical behemoths would allow them to grow faster and break through to Level 9 sooner to oversee this place and help him continue to harvest Life Crystals.
Next, he intended to strengthen all his talents to the Deification level, which required a massive amount of Attribute points, so naturally, the more Life Crystals, the better.
The remaining ordinary Black Melting Divine Fruits roughly the size of one meter were given to the Three-headed Small Tiger Whale to help them quickly grow to Level 7 Peak and break through to level eight.
The rest were bestowed upon the Mutated Tiger Whales that performed well in the life crystal hunting.
After distributing the loot, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon ignored the roaring excited Giant Beasts and approached the Black Oblivion King’s corpse, putting strength into his double claws.
Amid the screeching sounds, a massive scale over ten meters thick and several tens of meters in diameter was torn off, followed by the second, the third…
These were God-level Extraordinary Material and could not be wasted.

chapters.title: Chapter 767: 338 Jack Clark: That Thunderflame is so strong, I must see it for myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 767: Chapter 338 Jack Clark: That Thunderflame is so strong, I must see it for myself
Beneath the deep sea whirlpool.
Grasping a Black Melting Divine Fruit with a diameter of five meters in its claw, the Silver Giant Dragon looked at the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon pulling off scale armor on the other side and asked with some curiosity, “Roar! Tim Abott, what are you doing?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon casually growled back, “These scales are too thick, biting them hurts the teeth.”
…You’re actually worried about hurting your teeth? The Silver Giant Dragon glanced at the sharp giant teeth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had devoured and torn countless Giant Beasts, feeling somewhat bewildered.
In its bewilderment, the Silver Giant Dragon swallowed the Black Melting Divine Fruit in one gulp, and in an instant, the explosive energy within its body burst forth, creating towering red flames tens of meters high across its body.
While the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and others diligently devoured the flesh and blood of the Sword Dragon Giant Beast and the Silver Giant Dragon began digesting the energy of the Divine Fruit, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was still painstakingly stripping the Giant Beast’s scale armor.
Soon, those black scales piled up into a small hill, and only then did the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon take a big bite.
Boom!
Under the terrifying bite force, the tough and fearsome muscles of the Mythical Giant Beast vibrated thunderously as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fiercely tore off a large chunk.
Compared to the flesh of quasi-mythical beasts, the flesh of a Mythical Giant Beast that has undergone the Tempering of laws contains a more terrifying energy and is also more difficult to digest.
Such a powerful body couldn’t be bitten into by ordinary Level 9 Giant Beasts, let alone eaten, not even on the same level; the situation where one whale falling brings forth life for everything else didn’t exist.
Under normal conditions, a deceased Mythical Creature would either be devoured by its peers or, over time, the laws contained in its flesh and blood would dissipate, returning to Heaven and Earth.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon chewed and swallowed, a dreadful biological energy exploded within its body, and it started growing at a visible rate, expanding.
Two hundred ninety-five, two hundred ninety-seven, gradually reaching the three hundred meter limit of an Extraordinary Creature.
Unlike the Candle Dragon Giant Beast and Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the normal limit for a Level 9 Extraordinary Creature is three hundred meters, even if they break through to Level 9 Peak.
Because Level 9 Peak is only touching upon the laws, it’s not a transformation in the life stage, growth, including the previous Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, couldn’t break this limit.
For example, at sixth level the body length is stuck at thirty meters, at Level 7 the body length is stuck at sixty meters.
But this time after reaching three hundred meters, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body growth didn’t stop, but instead broke through that limit, slowly reaching three hundred and one meters.
Boom!
In an instant, the aura on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon surged, the terrifying sway below caused the seabed whirlpool to tremble, and distant Giant Beasts like the Single-horned Tiger Whale all turned their gaze in this direction.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon, which had just eaten the Divine Fruit and fallen into hibernation, was awakened by the disturbance.
Boom!
The red Spatial Channel in the distance shook, seemingly sensing the explosive aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, that Horrific Creature began to ram the pathway again.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, having made a breakthrough past Level 9 Peak, turned its head slightly, eyes cold as it watched the shaking vortex of the pathway.
Next time, I will definitely tear you apart. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon withdrew its gaze and continued to devour heartily.
After the breakthrough to Level 9 Peak, it didn’t need to understand any laws itself, as its Strength Talent, which had been augmented to goddess-like, began to transform, touching an ancient and terrifying power deep within Heaven and Earth.
It was the power of Destruction.
As the Power of Destruction Law was drawn into its body under the influence of its talent, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s entire body underwent a terrifying transformation at breakneck speed, becoming incredibly powerful.
Meanwhile, on the attribute page, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Avatar’s Evolution value finally reached thirty thousand points, ready to begin its Fifth Evolution at any time.
When the time comes, trigger the ancient aura deep within, and break through to Mythical-level in one step.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could clearly feel that the energy within wasn’t enough, what was stored was still insufficient; if it forced its Evolution now, it might need a long hibernation.
So it continued to eat.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon kept on devouring the flesh and blood of Mythical Giant Beasts, its body, which was breaking past the limit of life, continued to grow slowly, its aura becoming even more terrifying.
Under the indescribable horrific sway, even the Giant Beast Candle Dragon couldn’t resist and drilled into the sea water, retreating from the core area.
Meanwhile, at the forward base.
Under the night sky, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon broke through to Level 9 Peak and grew in response, Jack Clark, who had been in closed-door cultivation for a day, once again burst forth with an aura.
Boom!! Just the invisible emanation of the aura caused the surrounding ground to vibrate, a raging wind to howl, and under the sway, everyone in the small town was awoken.
“As expected of the prodigy who forged Fourfold World after breaking through the Eight Layer and invoked visions of ancient deities.”
“Too terrifying. Since his breakthrough yesterday, his strength has been soaring at a terrifying rate, as if there’s no bottleneck.”
“This talent…”
The faces of those recovering in the town all showed expressions of amazement, shock, and envy; over the past two days, they had been somewhat numbed by Jack Clark’s performance.
“Impressive.”
Startled awake, Jane Aiken sighed softly and then closed her eyes again, falling into an epiphany state, with the Sword World that swirled around her vaguely taking on a more complete sense.
Having comprehended the complete origin of the Sword World, Jane Aiken’s progress on her self-created Secret Manual advanced at an extraordinary pace as she was always able to enter the state of enlightenment.
In the room, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon entered the phase of physical Transformation, the ‘breakthrough’ aura on Jack Clark gradually subsided.
However, under his repeated aura eruptions, the sofa and floor beneath him had already collapsed and crumbled, turning into a pit about ten meters deep.
This was with him containing his aura; otherwise, the entire small building would have collapsed.
Feeling the terrifying power within that had surged continuously over the past two days, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the transparent page before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 768: 338 Jack Clark: That Thunderflame is so strong, I must see it for myself_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 768: Chapter 338 Jack Clark: That Thunderflame is so strong, I must see it for myself_2
Dragon. Physique: 1.4314 [A special life form that has broken through the Transcendent limit, the body, under the influence of dragon characteristics, has transformed into an everlasting kind.]
Dragon. Strength: 1.5218
Dragon. Agility: 1.1542
Spirit: 12378
The next morning, after his breakthrough to Late Stage 9, his physique and strength surged by over three thousand points, while this entry into Level 9 Peak only increased by less than two thousand.
The reason is that the quasi-mythical level does not belong to evolutionary growth, but rather to the transformation of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body and Gifted Power. The feedback on Jack Clark was not as significant as imagined.
Even so, with his basic physical body strengthened consecutively over these two days, Jack Clark’s foundational strength has skyrocketed several times over, becoming increasingly terrifying.
And the feedback from the upcoming fifth Evolution will be extremely horrific.
After all, it signifies the growth from an Extraordinary Creature to a Mythical-level Creature.
Feeling the Evolution Energy in his body slowly strengthening his physical body as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon feeds, passing through the Soul Channel, Jack Clark revealed a pondering look in his eyes.
He was contemplating the fifth Evolution of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
So far, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had devoured several hundreds of Giant Beasts above Level 7, but none possessed a Talent Ability that met his satisfaction.
Most of those Giant Beasts’ talents were related to water, followed by ice, bodily strengthening, with very few of the illusionary type, and even rarer were those of the conceptual type.
And according to the Avatar’s evolutionary pattern, the sixth Evolution is very likely to directly transcend the Mythical Titan, the Ancient Titan, becoming a Rule-above Creature.
Therefore, breaking through the Mythical level and securing a talent during the fifth Evolution is very important; it relates to its combat power for a long period thereafter.
Originally, Jack Clark’s first target involved the Special Talents of time, space, or causality.
But after the battle with the Black Oblivion King, he abandoned these choices.
The current Thunderflame Emperor Dragon excels in close combat with ‘strength’ ‘defense’ ‘agility’ ‘regeneration’ maxed out, and possesses the Extraordinary elements ‘Golden Flame’ ‘Thunder’ ‘Nether Poison’.
And it has Gigantification, which can merge with the Gifted Power for burst strength, making it perfect in all aspects; additional time or space talents would just make it slightly stronger.
But in this world, there is no perfect ‘life’; the world is full of countless Living Beings, and all sorts of horrifying talents or rules emerge endlessly, with interactions of mutual promotion and restraint.
For the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which pursues the ultimate power and the route of destruction, it needs a power that is impervious to all rules.
This power would allow the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to disregard all laws of time, space, concepts, or even the suppression of soul-burning special rules, employing absolute destructive power to obliterate everything.
Besides, there is also the issue of disguising or changing the ‘Pseudo-Heaven Tier’ life Aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which needs to be addressed.
He never expected that killing that Mythical Giant Beast would attract an ancient creature, just because of the life Aura emanating from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
After several enhancements and transformations through its talent, the life stratum of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Avatar has reached a terrifying extent, even provoking the devouring impulse of higher-level Giant Beasts.
The Ancient Being’s unclear words in the moment, about the sky yet not the sky, were clearly referring to the Pseudo-Heaven Tier Emperor Dragon’s life.
If not for the separation caused by the world passageways, escaping the pursuit of that ancient creature would have been troublesome, or to put it another way, they would have been chased continuously.
Now that the pathway has been blocked, and although there are three other passageways connecting to the mythical world in the deep sea, who knows if there are more ancient creatures near those pathways?
If the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon continues to grow and evolve, releasing its Aura again, it might attract an even stronger creature.
Therefore, the issue must be solved at the source, such as concealing or changing the life Aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to avoid attracting the attention of those horrific creatures.
While Jack Clark was pondering the evolution of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a message from the Outer World reached Base No.1.
In the central building of the base, a thirty-something scholarly-looking middle-aged man’s projection appeared, speaking politely to Marcellus Larry behind the desk.
“Elder Brother Larry, sorry to disturb you.”
Marcellus Larry looked up and replied warmly, “What’s the matter, Ralph?”
The middle-aged man gave a wry smile, “Brother Larry, there’s been a change in the deep sea, a new Mythical-level powerful Giant Beast has appeared, and we might need you to go and deter it.”
“Deep sea, isn’t that where you are guarding?” Marcellus Larry was a bit surprised.
Ralph Vickery sighed, “Mainly because I only broke through to king-level a few years ago, and I’m afraid my strength isn’t enough to suppress that Mutated Creature.”
“`
“That Mythical Giant Beast is so strong,” Marcellus Larry’s eyebrows raised.
“Very strong,” Ralph Vickery nodded, eyes showing admiration.
“To be precise, it’s a Ninth-Level Extraordinary Giant Beast, but its combat power is extremely terrifying. It had previously defeated a quasi-mythical beast at the Early Stage Level 9.”
“Now that it has grown to the Late Stage Level 9, even without breaking through to the mythical, it has slain the Mythical Creature that was lurking on the other side of Channel 3.”
“That Mythical Creature was registered in the data as being at the Mid-Mythical Stage, but now it has been killed by a Level 9 Late Stage Extraordinary Giant Beast.”
“Such a terrifying combat power…” At this moment, even Marcellus Larry’s expression turned serious.
To overcome the Mid-Mythical Stage while only at the Late Stage Level 9 was a greater leap in battle power than an Early Stage Level 8 slaying a Mid Level 9, yet this has occurred in a Giant Beast.
Marcellus Larry had not anticipated that within just a few years of not paying attention to the outer world, such a terrifying creature would appear.
“Young Wang, send me the detailed data.”
As the guardian of Base No.1, Marcellus Larry usually didn’t concern himself with external affairs, unless a situation arose requiring his involvement, just like this one.
And since Base No.1, as the core guardian of the Heavenly Think Tank, possessed defensive forces not inferior to king-level, him leaving temporarily for a day or two posed no problem.
As for the security of the other side of the pathway, there was even less to worry about, as there were even stronger strong men standing guard.
……
The next morning.
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, and within them, the reflection of a three-faced six-armed figure could be seen, holding up a shadow of a Great Era world in the six hands of the Combat Divine Body.
Since beginning his closed-door cultivation the previous afternoon and through the night, in an epiphany state, he had not only perfected the first three moves but also created the fourth style of Slaying Demons.
Great Thousand Burial!
This was despite being interrupted several times from his enlightenment and focusing all his attention on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s battle against the Mythical Giant Beast and the ancient creature.
However, now he had to put aside the fusion of Martial Arts Skills because the matter with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was more pressing.
He needed to go to Base No.1 and link up with the core of the Heavenly Think Tank to find some information, searching the Federation’s database for all recorded information on Senior-level and above Mutated Creatures.
Especially recent research on marine Mutated Creatures.
Whoosh! Under the morning sunlight, a figure dashed rapidly across the Earth, appearing a kilometer away in the blink of an eye. Soon, Jack Clark arrived at Base No.1.
Seeing Marcellus Larry walking out from the center building of the base, Jack Clark involuntarily paused his steps, politely greeting him: “Larry Throne, good morning.”
Marcellus Larry was somewhat surprised, nodding with a slight smile: “Morning, Jack, you’re here for a reason?”
“Yes, I’m preparing to link up with the core of the Heavenly Think Tank to look up some information.”
“I see, but you’ve come at just the right time. I was about to step out for a bit, to go to the deep sea to intimidate a Giant Beast with Mythical-level power. Are you interested in witnessing it?”
“A newly-ascended Mythical Giant Beast from the deep sea,” Jack Clark’s gaze paused.
Marcellus Larry nodded: “Yes, it’s a very fearsome Mutated Creature, code-named Thunderflame…”
Immediately, as Jack Clark glanced peculiarly, Marcellus Larry recounted the information he had read the night before to Jack Clark.
After hearing it, Jack Clark couldn’t help but show an expression of ‘shock’: “It grew from Level 7 to Late Stage Level 9 in just a few months, battling a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast, that’s too terrifying.”
Marcellus Larry commented with emotion: “This Mutated Creature has almost shattered humans’ decades of understanding the ocean, its horrific potential beyond anyone’s imagination.”
“Therefore, I need to see it, to find out if it can communicate. If it holds no hostility towards the human race, we’ll sign a non-aggression treaty with it, and go our separate ways.”
“But if it shows strong hostility towards the Human Race, then it will have to be dealt with.”
As he spoke, a cold light flashed in Marcellus Larry’s eyes.
As the monarch standing guard over Channel One, Marcellus Larry’s cultivation had not only reached the late period of king-level, but he also wielded an extremely powerful weapon.
Jack Clark decisively chose to go: “Throne, please ensure you take me to witness this terrifying Mutated Creature.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 769: 339: Reunion with the Giant Beast, Witness to History
chapters.content:
Chapter 769: Chapter 339: Reunion with the Giant Beast, Witness to History
“`
“Calling the Heavenly Central Control Tower, Hell King No. 1 setting out for a mission. Please open the Circular Barrier.”
“Control Tower received. The pathway will open in ten seconds. Please pass through within the allocated time…”
As the control system made the call, a diamond-shaped fighter aircraft over 50 meters wide and over 60 meters long, constructed entirely of silver unknown metal and exuding a sci-fi style, slowly lifted off the ground.
Simultaneously, far away in the sky, the gray mist that shrouded Heaven and Earth split open, revealing a crack.
Boom!
The silver fighter aircraft burst through the air, and with the energy engine’s blast, it accelerated to supersonic speed in an instant, leaving a long blue tail and dashing out of the confined space.
Inside the aircraft, Jack Clark sitting in his seat marveled at the endless misty pathway receding outside and the folding spaces he passed through, amazement shone in his eyes.
“Throne, the thickness of this mist wall exceeds a hundred kilometers, right?”
Marcellus Larry gave a faint smile: “The sealing barrier uses the mist infused with the mythical world’s Law Power as a medium to isolate the interior from the exterior, forming a semi-inner world.”
“So it looks quite thick, but in reality, it only occupies one kilometer’s thickness of the outer world.”
As they conversed, light appeared in front of them, and in an instant, the fighter broke out of the passageway, and the undulating expanse of Earth came into view before Jack’s eyes, with cities emerging at the far end of the land.
Just then, the fighter’s engine hummed, and its speed surged from once to six times the speed of sound, tearing a pathway through the sea of clouds under the terrifying velocity.
Even under such swift acceleration, Jack felt not the slightest weightlessness; had it not been for the countless clouds flashing past outside, one might not have felt any change at all.
Marcellus Larry smiled as he introduced: “This is my personal fighter, forged from the materials of a Mythical-level creature I once defeated, equipped with the most advanced energy weapons.”
“The interior space is expanded to over ten times what it appears to be from the outside; apart from this comfortable living space, other areas are loaded with a large cache of ammunition.”
“The control system is assisted by AI, primarily linked to a human’s Spiritual Will, with a single thought able to control it at will—starting at the speed of sound, and the maximum cruising velocity can break through ten times that.”
“The fighter’s Kinetic Energy is split into two modes: Energy Crystal Body and nuclear power. In the mythical world, where Heavenly Energy is rich, it can absorb Heaven and Earth energy for sustained flight.”
“If it enters outer space where there’s no Heavenly Energy, our world, it can switch to nuclear power, capable of soaring through space for decades without worrying about energy.”
“It’s just a pity that the current nuclear fusion technology is one step away; otherwise, our explorations here could have reached beyond the star system, offering us an extra way out.”
“In the future, once you, Jack, make a breakthrough to King-level, you can provide the materials yourself, and the Federation will craft a fighter for you that contains the highest level of technology.”
Suddenly, Jack felt somewhat intrigued.
This top-tier fighter that integrated travel, comfort, and attack capabilities indeed seemed impressive.
After all, when one becomes a king, heading out or traveling somewhere should rely on more than just one’s legs or simply flying there; otherwise, it just seems a bit lackluster.
Of course, the situation during battle is an exception.
Marcellus Larry had a quite gentle attitude towards Jack.
It wasn’t just the potential of him being the ‘hope of the Human Race’, but also his diligence and his composed and low-profile character; all of these qualities were greatly appreciated by Marcellus Larry.
Otherwise, no matter how talented someone was, at most he would only provide some protection.
Upon reaching the King-level realm, one had in fact transcended racial constraints.
Even if the Human Race was wiped out, as long-lived and powerfully King-level beings, they could still wander in the mythical world, living for a millennium undying.
They were working so hard at present merely out of loyalty to their race’s cause and because the rise of the Human Race had been so brief.
In the years to come, once the Transcendent Era has passed by a hundred or several hundred years, with the passage of time, many lone kings might leave, seeking higher realms or exploring Heaven and Earth.
Take, for instance, those neutral kings who formed the Divine Gods Alliance and self-proclaimed themselves as deities.
At six times the speed of sound, the fighter soon plunged into the ocean and, under satellite positioning, crossed over five thousand kilometers in under an hour to arrive in the deep sea region.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A vortex spanning tens of kilometers rotated above the sea, churning up tremendous sea waves, the vast vortex at its center forming a pitch-black Hollow that pierced Heaven and Earth.
Whir! The fighter hovered above the vortex, the side hatch opened, and both Marcellus Larry and Jack flew out.
Standing high in the sky, Marcellus Larry with silver halos materializing behind him, forming a circle hundreds of meters in diameter. Law Power stirred Heaven and Earth, and instantly a King-level pressure erupted.
Boom!
The clouds vibrated, forming rings of howling hurricanes in the sky, and under the terrifying pressure, the vortex churning for tens of kilometers became even more violent, raising Hundred-meter Tsunamis that howled between Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
From beneath the vortex, a King-level aura of a mythically fierce Giant Beast erupted, filled with destruction.
The substantial aura of fierceness soared to the skies, colliding with Marcellus Larry’s presence tens of kilometers away, shaking Heaven and Earth and forming transparent shock waves in the air.
Below the deep sea, a Giant Beast, a kilometer long and mostly devoured, lay beside the corpse. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, now measuring three hundred and ten meters, slowly raised its head.
Suddenly, the Mythical-level pressure exploded, startling the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Silver Giant Dragon, and other Giant Beasts in the swirling sea water. Then, the earth at the center of the vortex shattered, and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shot skyward.
Roar! Roar! Brothers, an enemy approaches, grab your weapons.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, 120 meters long and grown to the peak of the eighth level, roared, its massive body shattering the sea waves as it rushed upwards.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 770: 339 Reunion with the Giant Beast and the Witness of History_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 770: Chapter 339 Reunion with the Giant Beast and the Witness of History_2
At this moment, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s aura was ferocious, its terrifying dragon head roaring repeatedly, making the uninformed believe it was about to tear apart a king-level being.
“Roar, roar, roar! Brothers, charge, kill those who dare to provoke our Dragon Palace.”
“Roar, roar, roar!! Kidora, invincible, we need to fight, ten of them.” The excitable Nine-headed Flood Dragon also rushed forward.
The Silver Giant Dragon, ablaze with red flames, spread its double wings wide: “Roar! The Great Scythia is furious, daring to disturb Scythia’s sleep.”
Although the ‘enemy’ that appeared this time was terrifying and belonged to the Mythical Creatures, they were not afraid with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that could tear apart Mythical Giant Beasts among them.
In the deep sea, the Red Candle Dragon, over three hundred meters long, had rushed forward at the first opportunity.
This fellow normally reacted slowly, but once it encountered battle, it would enter into battle mode instantly.
As for the Female Tiger Whale Horned Lady and the Blue Giant Crab, they were absent because they were leading the Tiger Whale Army to sweep through the surrounding sea area, collecting Life Crystals for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
“It’s coming.”
Marcellus Larry looked down and saw a huge Black-red Colossal Beast rising from the depths of the vortex.
Its dragon head was more domineering than that of an Eastern Divine Dragon, and it had a long tail, a body more robust than a Western Dragon, and three rows of coral-like dorsal fins and sharp scale horns on its back.
Its ferocious demeanor and the intangible aura of fierce destruction even made Marcellus Larry’s eyes narrow.
This Giant Beast was terrifying, seemingly stronger than what the records described.
Although its body was just over three hundred meters long, the oppressive and brutal aura it radiated was more horrifying than some kilometer-long Giant Beasts Marcellus had seen. It was incredibly powerful.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, the red beast resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon that followed behind the Black-red Giant Beast, Marcellus dismissed them entirely.
They did not possess king-level strength and were not worthy of his attention.
Meanwhile, as the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts that had flown up looked towards the ring of light, Marcellus, who emanated a terrifying aura as a late-stage king-level being, appeared godlike.
“Roar! It’s a human, a human mythical powerhouse.” The Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat excited, for it was the first time it had seen a human, especially a powerful one.
However, just as the two powers met for the first time, posturing at a thousand meters apart, both Jack Clark and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon simultaneously revealed ‘astonished’ expressions on their ‘faces’.
Jack Clark was ‘shocked’: “It’s you.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also issued a roar: “Roar! Darren Callum.”
Suddenly, the entire scene quieted down, and surprise and disbelief showed on the faces of both the Giant Beasts and Marcellus.
The Silver Giant Dragon peeked out from behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, curiously looked at Jack Clark, and gave a surprised growl: “Roar! Tim Abott, do you know that human?”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, hot firelight spewing from its nostrils: “Roar! I know him, he’s the powerful human I told you about.”
“Roar! It’s him.”
The Silver Giant Dragon widened its eyes in shock, looking at Jack Clark and wondering how such a small human could manage to slay a Level 9 Giant Beast when at Level 7?
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon also curiously moved closer, its nine dragon heads chaotically shaking as they roared: “Roar, roar, roar!! Scythia, you, you know, human?”
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded, pointing a claw in the direction of Jack Clark in the distance: “Roar! Yes, I know him. See that human over there, Tim Abott says he’s very strong, a monster not inferior to Tim Abott.”
“Roar, roar, roar!! Abbott, the same, strong.” The Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s nine pairs of eyes glared in disbelief at the human who had the aura of an early-stage Level 8 being in the distance.
In the eyes of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had torn apart Mythical Giant Beasts at Level 9, was an invincible being.
And that tiny little bug turned out to be a monster as powerful as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, how was that possible?
At this moment, not just the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, but also the Red Beast circling behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to show curiosity.
Across from them, Marcellus was also somewhat confused and incredulously looked at Jack Clark: “Jack, you know this Giant Beast?”
Jack Clark nodded, his face full of amazement: “I do. I never expected the mutant creature from the throne you spoke of to actually be it.”
“Half a year ago, when I returned from the Kelaya Battlefield, my cultivation was on the verge of breaking through the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven, but it was just a little short, and I could not break through. I was a bit agitated.”
“One day after school, on a whim, I took a spontaneous trip by high-speed train to the seaside of the neighboring city, wanting to relax a bit.”
“By the time I got there, it was already evening. While I was at the seaside contemplating the sky and the ocean, I felt a breakthrough and advanced to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven, and then I encountered a Level 4 Mutated Beast.”
“Although I was only in the late-stage Third Layer Heaven at the time, typical Level 4 creatures were no match for me.”
“Just as I was preparing to drive away or kill the Unique Beast to prevent it from charging into the town, the beast took the initiative to give me a Blood Crystal and communicated with astonishing intelligence.”
“Back then, the Mutated Beast was only about ten meters long and looked very different from now, not as ferocious or imposing.”
“But the three pairs of feather horns on either side of its head were very distinctive, which is why I recognized it at a glance.”
“Out of curiosity about the human world, I shared some insights into humanity’s ‘strength’ and taught it some basic combat moves from True Martial.”
“In return, it gave me a Reverse Scale twined with its thunder and fire core talents, and a drop of powerful Essence Blood that could enhance my physique.”
“The Combat Divine Body I later created was inspired by its thunder and fire talents, and the Summoning Secret Skill I cultivated from the Gail Family was targeted at it.”
“However, even though I have its scales and Essence Blood as a connection, I’m still one step away from achieving a spiritual resonance to open the Summoning Altar with space-time magic.”
With Jack’s explanation, Marcellus suddenly nodded in realization, “I see.”
Marcellus had seen Jack’s detailed information, which indeed included a story about his seaside enlightenment and his breakthrough to the late-stage Third Layer Heaven where he found a Blood Crystal.
However, he hadn’t expected that the Blood Crystal hadn’t been found by Jack, but was a gift from a Level 4 Unique Beast curious about the human world.
Looking at the elegant young man standing in the sky and the ferocious beast not far away,
One was a genius of the Human Race who was expected to become Supreme, and the other was a Late Stage 9 Mutant Beast capable of Reverse Defeating Mid-Mythical Stage powerhouses.
At this moment, human and beast were meeting again after several months, and Marcellus felt like he was witnessing a historic moment.
He felt like he was witnessing the second meeting in history between the future’s strongest human and a Monarch of the Giant Beasts.
Furthermore, since Jack knew this terrifying Unique Beast and it seemed to be quite friendly toward humans, the following matters seemed easier to handle.
With this thought, Marcellus smiled and said warmly to the ferocious behemoth in the distance, “Hello, Monarch of the Giant Beasts, I am a Human King, Marcellus.”
The distant Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded, its low roar imbued with the vibrations of a realm of thought, “Roar! Hello, I am the King of Dragon Palace Thunderflame, surname Abbott, given name Tim, styled Hegemon.”
Abbott Hegemon. Marcellus’s eyes immediately revealed an amused expression.
Jack’s alias was Darren Hegemon, and this Giant Beast was actually called Abbott Hegemon—clearly, this Giant Beast was more than just a little curious about the human world.
Just then, Jack suddenly said, “Throne, I will go and discuss the pact with it now.”
“…Yes,” Marcellus hesitated for a moment before nodding in agreement.
Given the attitude of the Giant Beast since its appearance, as well as its name being similar to Jack’s, it was obvious that the two had a friendly relationship, making him the better candidate for communication.
Of course, Marcellus didn’t let down his guard completely; he formed a silver ring of light in the void that enveloped Jack with a flick of his palm.
Whoosh!
Jack stepped into the air and flew toward the Giant Beast, which also shifted its gaze and stretched out its vast and ferocious right claw to form a platform for Jack to land.
Standing on the huge Dragon Claw, Jack looked at the building-sized dragon head before him and showed a ‘smile,’ “Long time no see.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon exhaled a hot breath, its mouth slightly lifting in a particularly ferocious way, “Indeed, it has been a long time.”
Meanwhile, the high-definition satellites in the sky also witnessed the scene of Jack talking with the Giant Beast while standing on its claw, leaving everyone somewhat baffled.
In the watchful eyes of both ‘forces,’ Jack split his consciousness in two, having a reunion chat with himself, as both sides talked cheerfully.
Jack introduced the purpose of their visit to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, who expressed its respect for humans in return.
With a mutual desire for friendship, both sides reached an agreement that Dragon Palace would not harass humans, nor would it come ashore, and outlined the palace’s major policy of entering the mythical world.
On behalf of humans, Jack also assured that as long as Dragon Palace did not disturb the Human Race and nearby ships, humans would not harm them, and both sides would develop amicably.

chapters.title: Chapter 771: 340 The Terrifying Human, Reincarnation Failure (Vote for Monthly Pass)
chapters.content:
Chapter 771: Chapter 340 The Terrifying Human, Reincarnation Failure (Vote for Monthly Pass)
Over the sea, surrounded by blood-colored flames, the nine-headed Flood Dragon, nearly two hundred meters in length, looked at the little creature in the claw of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with hesitation in its eyes.
The nine heads of the Flood Dragon swayed, roaring uncertainly, “Roar Roar Roar!! Sesi, ah, that human, really, very strong?”
The Silver Giant Dragon, more than one hundred and sixty meters long and lying on the back of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, looked back with some hesitation, “Roar! He should be strong, Tim Abbott never deceives dragons.”
That said, even the Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat unsure at that moment.
After all, Jack Clark currently exuded only the aura of the early stage of Level 8 and appeared mild-mannered on the surface, without a trace of the ‘fierceness’ that one would associate with someone capable of killing a Level 9 Giant Beast across a major realm.
Both Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with its golden vertical pupils and Jack Clark looked incredulous regarding the conversations between the two giant beasts.
You two, isn’t your ‘whispering’ a bit too loud, or did you think I don’t understand the language of beasts?
Glancing at those two ‘fools’, Jack Clark, having completed the diplomacy, flew back and said, “Throne, I have made arrangements with Thunderflame, the matter of signing the contract will trouble you.”
Marcellus Larry naturally heard the conversation between the man and the beast, and a smile couldn’t help but appear on his face, “You’ve worked hard, Little Jack.”
He hadn’t expected the mission to be accomplished so easily, originally just wanting to show him the rise of new Mythical Creatures in the sea.
In his moment of reflection, Marcellus Larry reached into the void with one hand, and Law Power of silver instantly converged in the air, forming a circular rune over ten meters in diameter that emitted a mysterious aura.
Marcellus Larry explained to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the distance, “Thunderflame Dragon King, this is a Contract Rune from an Ancient Civilization, its sole function is to bear witness.”
Due to the ‘intelligence’ issues of the Mythical Giant Beasts, the contracts signed between the Human Race and these Deep-Sea Mythical Beasts had almost no constraints; they were merely pure agreements.
And as the stronger dominating force, humans weren’t afraid these Mythical Beasts would dare to breach the agreements because they couldn’t bear the consequences.
Those Deep-Sea Mythical Beasts who were aware of the terrifying nature of the Human Race naturally wouldn’t provoke them on their own initiative.
“Roar! No problem,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon responded.
Upon carefully inspecting the Contract Rune and finding no issues, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon extended its massive claw, grabbing a strand of black Destruction Law and infusing it.
Hum!
The Contract Rune shimmered instantly; then, with a booming explosion, it vanished between heaven and earth.
With the task at hand finished, neither humans nor giant beasts had much to talk about. After a brief greeting, Jack Clark followed Marcellus Larry and flew towards the high-altitude fighter aircraft.
However, just as Jack Clark was about to step into the fighter aircraft, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly roared, “Roar! Darren Callum, give Ghidorah a big one.”
Ten thousand meters altitude, Jack Clark turned his head to look down at the giant beasts below, a faint smile on his face. Then an aura far beyond the Eight Layer Heaven burst forth from him, and within the dazzling golden light, a hefty War Halberd emerged.
Boom! The surrounding Heavenly Energy grew turbulent.
Centered around Jack Clark, a Blood Sea World unfolded over a range of hundreds of meters, with surging blood light flashing like the fierce visage of a malevolent deity.
Boom! Out of the blood light, a three-hundred-meter-long Purple-red War Halberd wrapped in Thunderflame burst forth, spanning across heaven and earth, surrounded by rings of energy radiance and waves.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Feeling the terrifying aura emanating from the War Halberd, Ghidorah roared, with the surrounding blood-colored flames growing brighter and condensing into a Red Three-Headed Dragon more than seven hundred meters long.
Moreover, on the surface of the manifest domain True Body of the Red Three-Headed Dragon, nearly a thousand interlocking Solid Runes radiated black light, roaring as it soared skyward.
Boom!
In an instant, heaven and earth seemed to split apart, the sea roared, and the dazzling tricolor light of gold, blue, and red rapidly expanded in mid-air, forming a massive destructive Light Sphere.
Then, the Light Sphere burst with a thunderous collapse, and a keening roar from Ghidorah echoed instantly from within.
Boom!
The boundless blood-colored flames exploded, forming a red halo that surged out for thousands of meters, and amidst the explosive light, a massive figure dropped from the sky.
Thud!
Under the Endless Destruction, with its scales shattered and blood streaming from its nine dragon heads, Ghidorah crashed into the sea with a bang, instantly blasting hundreds of meters of sea water into the sky with towering waves.
Ying Ying Ying!! Ghidorah, that’s so tragic for you.
In the sea, the Single-horned Tiger Whale swam over, somewhat reveling in Ghidorah’s misfortune.
Roar Roar!! Indeed quite tragic, thankfully Darren can’t fly, so I didn’t go up. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle felt a bit of relief.
If it could have flown, it would have doubtlessly questioned the human’s strength like Ghidorah and perhaps met an even worse fate.
After all, even Ghidorah, who was in the early stages of Level 9, couldn’t withstand the opponent’s single strike.
The Silver Giant Dragon on the back of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon opened its mouth wide in shock, roaring, “Roar! That human is so strong, Tim Abbott indeed did not deceive dragons.”
This is the consequence of daring to question your boss. Thunderflame Emperor Dragon hummed to itself internally.
Of course, its main purpose in doing this was to deter its subordinates, to prevent them from provoking humans in the future and to avoid trouble for itself.
As Thunderflame Emperor Dragon killed Mythical Giant Beasts and helped its subordinates rapidly increase in strength, they began growing more and more restless.
For instance, this time, sensing an unfamiliar Mythical-level presence, they weren’t frightened but rather friskily followed behind to watch the excitement.
They seemed brave and fearless, but when a person or beast loses their reverence for the strong, death isn’t far off.
In fact, under normal conditions, beasts like the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle grew very slowly in strength after breaking through Level 7, including Ghidorah.

chapters.title: Chapter 772: 340 The Terrifying Human, Reincarnation Failure (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 772: Chapter 340 The Terrifying Human, Reincarnation Failure (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_2
It was only because the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had helped them that they mixed with a lot of top resources, along with the Level 9 King’s Bloodline, and even the flesh and blood of quasi-mythical beasts.
Add to that the monarch-tier talent of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon acting as a catalyst, these Giant Beast bloodlines were purified and strengthened time and time again, growing at a speed far surpassing other Giant Beasts.
In the sky, the sudden unfolding also made Marcellus Larry pause, not knowing what had gotten into that Giant Beast, letting Jack Clark attack its subordinates.
At the same time, the power of Jack Clark’s move also surprised Marcellus Larry, as he, being in the early phase of Eight Layer Heaven, destroyed the true body of the realm of an early-stage Level 9 Beast with just one strike.
While injuring and killing are two different concepts, it’s worth noting that Jack Clark had not yet unleashed his full strength in combat form.
“Roar! Darren Callum, thank you, continue,” the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon below roared, its bellow echoing between heaven and earth.
Then a black-red Scale half a meter in size was spat out from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth, entangled with black and red lightning, and with a soul aura flowing around it.
