Immediately, Jack Clark’s ‘eyes’ lit up, catching the heavy Scale.
Marcellus Larry’s gaze also shifted slightly because Jack Clark had previously mentioned that his Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill lacked soul resonance and was missing one last step for successful cultivation.
But now…
Whoosh! The Silver Warplane sped away towards the land.
Meanwhile, the Warplane’s smart system synced up and uploaded the content of this exchange, lifting the Federation’s monitoring and alert status on the beast code-named Thunderflame.
And because of the ‘friendly’ relationship with Jack Clark, as witnessed by Marcellus Larry, the Dragon Palace was marked as an entity close to human forces.
At Jack Clark’s dictation, other creatures from the Dragon Palace were also registered, ensuring that human Battleships would not initiate attacks when encountering them at sea.
This outcome can be said to have surprised and astonished everyone paying attention to this meeting.
Their thoughts hadn’t gone to the idea that the Giant Beast had already been in contact with humans and knew the Human Race’s latest rising Genius, could there be a mutual appreciation between humans and Giant Beasts?
……
Watching the Silver Warplane disappear into the horizon, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also flew down.
Even though its true body and the Giant Beasts were one, this was also an opportunity to get closer to humans, but Jack Clark’s interaction was brief and he did not expose too much information.
Although the Human Race as a whole is united against outsiders, and the Federal Top Level is inclined to protect geniuses with resources and support, one cannot be too careful.
After all, the Human Race had its fair share of traitors.
Leaving aside those in the Blue Star World who joined the Evil God Sect, just in the mythical world, there are many cultivators who choose to defect each year due to threats or enticements.
This is also why the Purgatory Demon Race and the Evil God Sect are able to infiltrate.
Not everyone holds a sense of the bigger picture, a spirit dedicated to sacrifice, and a responsibility towards their species.
Especially those cultivators who seek the pinnacle of strength and are innately selfish.
When the cultivation is stuck at the peak of the Sixth Layer of Heaven, the peak of Seventh Layer Heaven, or at Eight Layer Heaven for years without progress, those who lose hope for advancement and yet yearn for power will be tempted by the Purgatory Demon Race.
As long as they can make a breakthrough, these people wouldn’t mind selling their souls, and they may even be willing to stop being human.
So, for Jack Clark, it’s safest to have an Avatar whose existence is known only to him – after all, the Avatar doesn’t need anyone else’s help to grow.
As for the Life Crystals, with the expanding territory under the control of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and with the Mutated Tiger Whale Army continuing to grow, there would be more to reap in the future.
Furthermore, the path walked by the Avatar Giant Beast is different from that of the Human Race, so there is no need for too much entanglement for the time being.
The copper-colored Silver Giant Dragon with flames burning on its body circled over the sea surface, “Roar! Tim Abott, those two humans are strong, but I feel you could have killed them.”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle stirred up massive sea waves and shook its head.
Roar roar!! Thunderflame is the strongest, smash humans, invincible.
Roar roar roar!! Let’s do this.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which had its true body destroyed by Jack Clark with one strike and had suffered some light injuries, also joined in, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, it hurts, revenge, fight humans.”
These remarks left the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon speechless, “Roar! Revenge, revenge what, didn’t you hear that it was me who asked Darren to hit you?”
Suddenly, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was taken aback, realizing what happened, its nine dragon heads twisting somewhat aggrievedly, “Roar roar roar!! Right, Abbott, why hit me?”
“Roar! Because I wanted to show you just how strong humans are.”
“Apart from Darren Callum, there are many geniuses in the Human Race, and many people can grow from Level 1 to Level 9 in just one year, each with strength far beyond their realm.”
“Moreover, that Mythical-level human strong man just then is only one of the Top Strong of the humans.”
“According to Darren Callum, the Human Race has several dozen above Mythical Tier forces, Mythical Titan Level strong men are eleven, and there’s even an Ancient Titan Supreme Presence.”
Hiss! All the Giant Beasts sucked in a breath of cold air.
They had not expected the Human Race to be so terrifying! To grow from Level 1 to Level 9 in just one year, and to have a ‘genius’ like Thunderflame in abundance was astounding.
All as powerful as Darren, with Level 8 strength defeating Level 9.
As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and other Giant Beasts were shocked, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened suddenly because its mother was just a Mythical Titan Level Giant Beast.
Its confidence to stand among Mythical Giant Beasts and Monarch-level humans came from the more than ten Scales of Laws it held, each containing the strength of a Mythical Titan Level Giant Beast.
Throwing down ten Scales of Laws could be enough to kill a Mythical Creature.
But it had not considered that there would be so many humans as powerful as its mother, and even beings comparable to Ancient Titans.

chapters.title: Chapter 773: 340 The Terrifying Human, Reincarnation Failure (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 773: Chapter 340 The Terrifying Human, Reincarnation Failure (Vote for Monthly Ticket)_3
“`
No wonder human beings can dominate the lands of this world, making even a monster like Thunderflame stay hidden beneath the seas, too terrified to emerge. It’s horrifying.
In shock, a group of Giant Beasts followed the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon back to the seabed.
At this moment, the Black Colossus had only a little flesh and blood left, with half of its enormous black gold-colored skeleton exposed on the ground and the other half submerged in the sea’s vortex, towering hundreds of meters high.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at the nearly consumed flesh and blood of the Giant Beast, and the energy within him was so abundant it felt like an explosion, a strong sense of Evolution coming over him.
However, it wasn’t the right time for evolution yet; the target of the Devouring talent had not been determined, nor had the talent enhancement issue been addressed.
With that thought, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swept his gaze across the pile of Life Crystals on the ground and turned back to look at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which were also fighting off sleep and had not entered Hibernation.
“Roar! Joe, Domination, bring back Horned Lady, I need the crystals,” Thunderflame Emperor Dragon ordered.
Just as Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished speaking, the Red Candle Dragon suddenly let out a slow, low growl, “Humans, are, so, frightening, better, not, provoke.”
…
On their way back in the fighter aircraft, having completed their mission, Jack Clark and Marcellus Larry sat at the table, sipping tea.
Marcellus Larry commented, “Who would have thought, Jack, that you actually knew that terrifying Mutated Creature.”
Jack Clark replied modestly, “Honestly, I was also surprised. I didn’t expect that in just a few months, that Mutated Creature would have grown to such a state.”
“Your growth rate isn’t slow either, Jack.”
Marcellus Larry said with a smile, “The first time you two met, one was at Triplex Heaven, the other at Level 4. Today, during your second encounter, one is at Eight Layer, the other at Level 9.”
As he said this, Marcellus Larry had a sudden premonition of a Great Calamity about to come, as if destiny was predetermined.
Guided by fate, only these two geniuses with frightening talents among the Human Race and Unique Beasts, unprecedented in history, could meet at such an insignificant time.
Then the fighter aircraft pierced through the clouds. The Earth lay ahead, and Jack Clark suddenly said, “Throne, can we stop in South City? I’d like to visit a friend.”
“Visiting a friend.”
Jack Clark nodded, “Yes, Mysterious Martial Heavenly King’s daughter, Miss Mathilda Ward. She’s in Hibernation in South City, and a month has passed now. I don’t know if she has woken up.”
Miss Mathilda Ward’s time in Hibernation began on June 1st, and today was July 5th.
“Miss Mathilda Ward, that girl,” Marcellus Larry said, his eyes filled with complex emotions.
Noticing Marcellus Larry’s tone, Jack Clark hesitated before asking softly, “Could it be that Miss Mathilda Ward has failed?”
Marcellus Larry took a sip of his tea, then sighed, “Not exactly a failure, at least the life transformation ceremony is still ongoing. It’s just that she hasn’t woken up within the expected month.”
As one of the kings safeguarding the Inner World, Marcellus Larry had been keeping an eye on the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King’s daughter’s movements.
That’s because the life or death of Mathilda Ward not only concerned her but also the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King and the Federation.
For the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King, who had lost his wife, brother, and son, Mathilda Ward was his only solace. No one dares to imagine what would happen if she were to die.
The Mysterious Martial Heavenly King might either fall into despair, or he might enter a frenzy and attack deep into the Evil God Alliance and The Purgatory Family’s rear, or he might disappear without a trace into the depths of the mythical world.
Of course, as one of the top strong men of the Human Race who had gone through countless life-and-death battles, it was more likely that the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King would suppress his sorrow and continue to strive for the greater good of his race.
But no one dared to disregard the former possibilities.
Therefore, during Mathilda Ward’s Reincarnation Ceremony, the Federation provided full support, offering unlimited supplies of the most valuable resources related to the soul, but the outcome…
She hasn’t woken up, Jack Clark thought somberly.
A 30% chance is still too low, Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel a pang of pity for the dignified and beautiful girl with great ambition and a broad mind.
The rest of the journey passed in silence. Soon, the Silver Warplane arrived over South City, hovering over the high altitude of North District’s Creation Research Base.
This immediately triggered an alert at the research base.
However, once the base’s radar scanned the aircraft and identified its identity, they quickly lifted the alert.
Then, amid the curious gazes of many staff and guards, the warplane’s hatch, flying at an altitude of a kilometer, opened and a figure plunged from the sky.
Fly!
In an instant, everyone’s gaze sharpened, for this indicated that the individual must be at least an Eighth Layer Expert, as only someone stronger than the Eighth Layer Heavens could walk on air.
And an Eighth Layer expert, in the Outer World, was already someone who could be in charge of a territory.
For instance, Barry Leonard Major General, the person in charge of the Military Base outside South City, was an Eighth Layer Peak expert responsible for the safety around South City.
But when that figure landed, many people were stunned.
“How is that possible?”
“He’s so young.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 341 Unspeakable Terror, Void Exile
chapters.content:
Chapter 774 - 341 Unspeakable Terror, Void Exile
Jack Clark's arrival caused some disturbance among those nearby.
However, since he descended from a king's exclusive fighter aircraft, and under the unseen prestige of a Senior Eight Layer expert, no guards came to question him for the time being.
Glancing at the curious staff in the distance, Jack Clark took out his mobile phone from his Storage Space and dialed Crystal Boyce's number.
Crystal Boyce hurried out of the building quickly, and seeing Jack Clark, a forced smile appeared on her somewhat tired face, "Mr. Clark, long time no see."
Jack Clark replied with a slight smile, "I've disturbed you, Boss Boyce. I happened to be passing by South this time on a mission and thought to stop by. How's Miss Mathilda Ward doing now?"
Crystal Boyce showed a bitter smile, "It's not very ideal."
"May I go down and take a look?"
"Please."
Under Crystal Boyce's lead, the two passed through several checkpoints and took a private elevator straight down to the research facility a hundred meters below.
The initial white walls of the laboratory, the ceiling, and the floor were all engraved with countless biological prayer patterns, tirelessly praying for Mathilda Ward's return under the transformation of faith power.
However, now that a month of prayer activities had ended and the global faith power transformed through the ritual had vanished, those biological patterns were left eerily silent.
Yet the wall ahead, torn and leading straight into the Void, was still maintained under the power of the Mysterious Martial Sky King.
In the endless darkness, one could see a small island about a hundred meters in size floating in the depth, with the Reincarnation Cabin on it flickering with inscription light, bringing a bit of brightness to the pitch-black Void.
Gazing at the Reincarnation Cabin in the depths of the Void, Crystal Boyce sighed lightly, "The reincarnation ceremony actually went very smoothly this time, more smoothly than we initially thought."
"With the genetic technology from Brudos, those God-level resources, and the Source of Life you provided, Miss Joseline's body has successfully completed the initial transformation of life essence and genetics."
"Additionally, under the power of Sky King Denny Kaye, her soul has also fused with the Origin of Dragon's Law, becoming a special existence."
As she spoke, the reincarnation disc in Crystal Boyce's hand flickered with light, forming two purple and silver 'dragon' shaped Rune Illusions in the air, revolving clearly defined as they spun slowly.
"The current problem is that Ilisa's soul can't merge with her body, there isn't even a slight reaction."
"Right now, her nascent soul is showing signs of weakness due to the lack of a physical body to rely on, and her body's vitality can only be maintained by running the ceremony."
"According to the current rate of weakening, in at most three months, Ilisa's soul will dissipate in this world, and her Soul Source will completely vanish in death."
As she said this, Crystal Boyce's eyes dimmed.
As an advanced cultivator, she too was at a loss in the face of such a situation.
Moreover, a few days ago, a king-level figure with the surname King also visited and was helpless in the face of Ilisa buried in the Void.
This kind of ritual, where both the body and soul are transformed into another form of life and then fused back together through a Void ceremony from death to rebirth, is too complicated.
"The soul and body can't merge!" Jack Clark slowly approached the pitch-black entrance, looking into the Void ahead, and a pair of world-obscuring black gold vertical pupils slowly emerged in his eyes.
In an instant, Jack Clark's vision was filled with endless black Void Energy, with countless tiny spatial fragments converging into a storm, obliterating everything.
When Jack Clark's gaze fell upon the plot of ground where Mathilda Ward was buried, he saw wisps of gray power circulating around it, keeping the Void Storm at bay.
It was obvious that these gray powers were the reason why Mathilda Ward could be declared dead.
As Jack Clark's gaze concentrated, those gray powers began to change in his eyes, and everything surrounding the Void seemed to become an illusion, leaving only the traces of gray power.
Hum!
Under the direct gaze imbued with the power of Void Rules, those gray powers slowly changed, forming a towering figure a kilometer tall, with three heads and nine arms, casting a non-human shadow.
However, at this moment, only the upper half of the gray shadow remained, with the other half annihilated by an unknown power, appearing somewhat eerie and terrifying.
And when Jack Clark saw that majestic gray shadow, an intense aura of death rushed towards him, as if he were facing death itself.
Suddenly, Jack Clark instinctually felt a strong sense of despair and fear, but this strange emotion had just emerged when it was suppressed by the fierceness in Jack Clark's eyes.
Boom!
Just as Jack Clark was suppressing his inner fear and despair, the incomplete shadow manifested by the power of death was drawn into action.
A gigantic gray claw spanned the boundless Void and swept towards him, radiating a terrifying Aura of withering all things and annihilating all beings, it was unbearable to look at or explore.
Jack Clark, not expecting that a mere glance would result in an attack on the soul level, narrowed his eyes.
Boom! The world of the soul trembled.
In the darkness emerged a figure in an Imperial Robe, wearing an Imperial Crown, holding a black Seal in hand, slowly confronting the incoming gray claw.
One claw and one seal collided at a seemingly leisurely, yet instantaneous speed, creating an explosive impact.
Boom! A wave of Terrifying Power erupted on the plane of the soul, so intense that it interfered with reality, causing a raging wind to blow inside the white research room.
Crackle Crackle!! Jack Clark's eyes flashed like lightning, his figure suddenly sinking, the alloy-cast ground beneath his feet cracked slightly, exuding a fearsome heavy aura.
The sudden turn of events left Crystal Boyce's face subtly changing, unsure of what existence Jack Clark was contending against.
In terms of pure mass, the gray claw from the depths of the Void was stronger, but in the quantity of the soul, Jack Clark's soul was even more terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 775: 341 Unspeakable Terror, Void Exile_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 775: Chapter 341 Unspeakable Terror, Void Exile_2
Plus, with the Soul-Imperial Seal Bearing the Primordial Rules, the showdown was only brief; the Void claw then collapsed with a boom.
Boom!
An intense soul impact burst out in an instant, raising an even more powerful invisible impact within the room. The Earth trembled, and Crystal Boyce couldn’t help but step back more than ten steps involuntarily.
A black jade command token on her flickered, forming an invisible shield; otherwise, even the aftermath would’ve been enough to injure Crystal Boyce’s soul.
At this moment, the golden vertical pupils in Jack Clark’s eyes slowly vanished, and he turned back with a solemn look to Crystal Boyce, “Boss Boyce, do you know the origin of that piece of Void Burial Ground?”
Realizing that Jack Clark must have seen something, an excited Crystal Boyce quickly answered, “Over the years, the Federation has been battling The Purgatory Family while also exploring other regions, hence discovering some relics of past civilizations.”
“This piece of Void Burial Ground is the ancestral land of a tribe called the Prado Alien Race. It was a special civilization, their cultivation tied to the powers of the Void and Death.”
“Upon translating the relic’s information and discovering this burial ground in the depths of the Void that could segregate life and death, it was designated as part of the ritual.”
“But unexpectedly, while all previous stages of the ceremony had gone smoothly, in the end…”
“In that case, I believe I might know the reason,” Jack said slowly.
Jack continued, “Being buried in the land of death, one would be judged as dead by the forces surrounding the burial ground. Since it’s death we’re dealing with, how could Miss Mathilda Ward transition from death to rebirth?”
“A ‘deceased’ body naturally cannot host a soul.”
Crystal Boyce gave a bitter smile, “A king said the same thing a few days ago, but the burial ground belongs to the depths of the Void and involves death and the Void; even he was powerless.”
“Or rather, among the current kings of the Federation, none delve into the Death Law.”
Jack Clark fell into a slight contemplation, then his eyes took on a serious look as he said gravely, “Boss Boyce, in a moment, you will power up the ceremony to its maximum, and I’ll give it a try.”
Thinking of the terrifying soul impact that suddenly burst from Jack Clark, Crystal Boyce suppressed her excitement and nodded firmly.
Whoosh! Jack Clark took a deep breath, the golden vertical pupils in his eyes emerging once again. He looked toward the death deep within the Void, invisible unless imbued with the power of the Void Rules.
Boom!
Void Energy erupted from the black gold pupils, and with a sixteen-fold amplification, the Void Double Pupils’ Full-Force Strike unleashed a terrifying power that pierced through the Void and landed on the edge of the burial ground.
Boom!! The invisible and formidable force tore through the pitch-black Void layer by layer, forming a crack that rifted the dimension.
It was unmistakably one of the abilities of the Void Double Pupils, Void Exile.
The Death force was too frightening; even in a damaged state, it was not something Jack Clark could shake. Thus, he thought of exile and targeted just a point.
Unlike Space Shattering, Void Exile was akin to leveraging a smaller force against a larger one. The true force of exile came from the Void Rules pried by the Void Double Pupils.
Boom boom boom!!
Beneath the dimensional tear, a grey force that made up the terrifying specter was gradually pulled into the crack by the Void Rules, tearing a 3-meter-long rift.
And because that part of the force was permanently exiled, it could not be restored.
At the instant the Death force was exiled, Jack Clark suddenly closed his eyes and sealed the dimensional crack.
Compared to the remnant shadow towering a kilometer high, the 3-meter-long rift was akin to a minute speck on a human body, almost insignificant.
But due to the incompleteness, the force enshrouding the burial ground underwent subtle changes, and immediately the dragon shadows of purple and silver on the ritual disk in Crystal Boyce’s hand began to move closer together slowly.
Crystal Boyce’s face revealed a look of surprise; there was now a reaction between Ilisa’s body and soul.
But at that moment, Jack Clark suddenly grabbed his eyes, hissing!
The dimension of Void Exile connected to his eyes and at this moment, the expelled force was reversing along the connection, eroding his Void Double Pupils.
Indeed, it was a terrifying power associated with Death.
Yet as a Top-tier Talent, Jack Clark was not entirely defenseless in such circumstances; he simply had to sever the connection to erase the erosion.
But then, a row of transparent text emerged before Jack Clark.
“The Void Double Pupils are undergoing erosion by Death. By spending ten thousand Attribute points, you can seal that wisp of Death Law and fuse it with the Double Pupils, gaining the power of Death.”
Catching unexpected gains, Jack Clark paused slightly and then chose to confirm.
Boom!
As ten thousand Attribute points disappeared, a surge of strength emerged from within Jack Clark’s body out of nowhere, pouring into his Void Double Pupils in torrents.
In front of that attribute energy permeating the Void, the death energy that eroded in reverse was instantly sealed, pulled back into the double pupils, forming a gray Light sphere.
Boom! With the Death Law Power entering, the Void Double Pupils trembled.
Within the endless Void inside the double pupils, resembling a planet, the gray Light sphere slowly rotated, exuding strands of thread merging slowly with the surrounding Void.
Hiss! A more intense pain from deep within Jack’s soul hit him all at once, causing even him to reel, covering his eyes, his face pale.
Crystal Boyce, who was pleasantly surprised at the changes occurring in the ritual, exclaimed, “Mr. Clark, are you alright?”
Jack Clark managed a weak wave of his hand, “No, no problem. I just used my pupil power to damage the Burial Ground and was struck by a backlash from the death energy, but I’ve survived it.”
Fortunately, the pain that was unbearable even for him was momentary. Now that his double pupils were adapting to the death energy, only a slight throbbing pain remained.
“That’s a relief, thank you, thank you for your help, Mr. Clark,” Crystal said with a face full of gratitude.
Previously, Jack Clark’s protection of Mathilda Ward could be said to be due to the mission, but this time, risking the backlash of death energy to shatter that invisible force was purely a personal initiative.
“Boss Boyce, there’s no need for formalities. Miss Mathilda Ward and I are friends, plus the contributions of the Mysterious Martial Sky King to the Human Race make it my duty to help, both emotionally and logically,” he said.
“Of course, that’s provided I can be of assistance.”
While they were talking, a row of transparent text appeared before Jack.
Talent: Void Double Pupils+[Top Tier, +16, Eyes containing Void Power that will transform into the Eyes of Void and Death when the fusion with the Death Law is complete]
After a short rest, Jack Clark excused himself, “Boss Boyce, Marcellus Larry is waiting for me outside, so I won’t stay long. Please let me know once Miss Ward wakes up.”
“Yes, definitely,” Crystal nodded excitedly.
Crystal Boyce escorted Jack out of the base building, then saw him soar into the sky and fly into a warplane hovering above.
“A King’s escort, truly fitting of a genius praised even by Mathilda’s brother,” Crystal exclaimed in astonishment.
She was no stranger to the King’s Exclusive Fighter, as the Mysterious Martial Sky King owned one made from the materials of a Mythical Peak Giant Beast. When its firepower was fully unleashed, it was capable of executing mythical-level destructive attacks.
Yet in just one month’s time, the genius who had just made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer had not only advanced to the Eighth Layer but has reached the status where he was being picked up by a king.
Such potential in youth was indeed fearsome.
Lost in her thoughts, Crystal watched as Jack and Marcellus quickly returned to Base No.1.
Whoosh! Accompanied by a raging wind, the Silver Warplane slowly landed on the open ground, its hatch opened, and Marcellus and Jack emerged one after the other.
Marcellus looked back at Jack, “Weren’t you going to check some reference materials earlier?”
Jack nodded, “I plan to look into Secret Skills for concealing aura, even simulating life fluctuations, in preparation for entering the mythical world.”
Marcellus not only didn’t find Jack’s cautious approach overly careful, but he also nodded in approval, “Good, it’s very good that you think this way.”
“Before you possess the power to face any danger, caution can take you further and keep you alive longer.”
At that moment, Jack’s tone shifted, “Apart from the Secret Skill I’m looking for, the Thunderflame Behemoth also asked me to help it look up some information on Marine Mutated Creatures,”
“On the scale containing the aura of its soul, there’s also a Law Power that, when activated, allows for one contact with it.”
Marcellus nodded, “Just some information on marine life, there’s no harm in telling it…”
Marcellus didn’t give much thought to Jack’s rationale because that’s the normal way relationships work in this world – there’s no such thing as a free lunch.
If the other party offered something to Jack without seeking anything in return, that would be somewhat odd.
On the contrary, the Giant Beast’s request for Jack to look up certain Marine Mutated Beasts information after teaching it some basic True Martial Human techniques during their first encounter, and providing him with Essence Blood and a Blood Crystal, was quite normal.
Following Marcellus to the base building, Jack entered the complex.
However, one directly distorted space to return to the office, while the other took the elevator to the underground, to the core of the Heavenly Think Tank.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 342 Deification Defense, The Last Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 776 - 342 Deification Defense, The Last Talent
The center of the underground space, covering hundreds of square meters and over twenty meters high, is dominated by a circular white crystal pillar with a diameter of more than ten meters.
On the surface of the white crystal pillar, light flows, and at every moment countless waterfalls seem to sweep over it, instantly processing information exceeding a hundred trillion times, a terrifyingly astounding feat.
Standing in front of the crystal pillar, Jack Clark said, "Roger, I want to look up Secret Skills for concealing life energy, even those that can change the essence of life's aura."
"Identity Verification complete, searching..."
As the voice of a little girl rang out, the display around Jack Clark's crystal pillar changed, and the names of dozens of Secret Skills appeared.
"Current search has found forty-six related Secret Skills: twenty-one common skills, seventeen Advanced Skills, and eight Top-level Skills."
As the current 'number one' genius of the Human Race, Jack Clark's privileges in certain areas are almost equal to those of the king-level, and his search and query range has expanded to the entire Federation.
Soon, Jack Clark's gaze settled on a Secret Skill named Sea Illusion Demon.
Top-level Skill, Sea Illusion Demon, originated from a relic in the mythical world and was translated and practiced by a king-level being before being added to the Heavenly Think Tank.
After cultivating the Sea Illusion Demon Secret Skill, one can completely change their life energy by simulating and sealing another creature's life pulse.
Of course, this change is only in terms of life energy.
Because this Secret Skill involves rules, the difficulty of cultivation is high, and it does not significantly boost strength, making it seem somewhat superfluous.
But to Jack Clark's delight, it was exactly what he needed—indeed, the core database of the Federation contains an incredible variety of whatever Secret Skills one could wish for.
Having decided on the Secret Skill, Jack Clark then requested, "Roger, search for all known Mutated Creatures with special abilities of Level 3 and above in the Blue Star Ocean."
"Exclude the abilities of physical mutation and elemental nature during the search."
As per Jack Clark's instructions, the data waterfall on the display swept across, and rows upon rows of dense text and Unique Beast avatars appeared.
"There are three hundred and fifty-nine marine Mutated Creatures that meet the criteria, including one hundred and thirty-one Level 4, seventy-four Level 5, and sixty Level 6..."
Decades into the New Era, particularly the number of oceanic Mutated Creatures is vast, which has resulted in a terrifying array of innate talents.
Under human surveillance, Mutated Beasts on land have been almost entirely suppressed, while research on the sea and monitoring the diversity of those creatures continues.
Thousands of research stations across the ocean, manned by Senior and even high-order cultivators, have built a substantial database over the decades.
As Jack Clark tapped on various Unique Beast avatars, various data popped up and, before long, the entire screen was cleared, leaving only four Unique Beasts.
The Single-Horned Silver Scale Fish, a Level 5 Alien Beast; the Green-eyed Spike Bone Squid, a Level 7 Colossus; the Blue-scaled Reverse Trident Whale, a Level 6 Mutant Beast; and the Deep Sea Black-striped Beast.
Especially the introduction to the Deep Sea Black-striped Beast caused Jack Clark's eyes to flicker with interest.
This creature, which has evolved into a new species of oceanic Mutated Creatures, is weakest at Level 1 and can grow to Level 6. It was discovered in the South Sea Thousand Meters Deep Ocean.
After reaching Level 4, these Black-striped Beasts can project a highly penetrative Light Beam from the single eye on their forehead, and their unique feature is their Full-body Scale Armor.
Researchers found that this Unique Beast has an extreme immunity to various forms of energy, whether underwater or rolling in magma.
Moreover, during extended observation, monitors once saw a Level 5 Black-striped Beast surviving a Space Crack without dying.
The reason lies in the special patterns on the scale armor, which form a Peculiar Force Field on its surface, capable of neutralizing and immunizing against all forms of energy-based attacks.
Of course, there is a limited extent to this neutralization, but it still astounded the researchers.
These researchers, by Dissecting the Black-striped Beast and analyzing the runes on its scales over the years, have made significant discoveries, and some applications have even been implemented in the current field of technology.
...
Boom!
An explosion erupts above the whirlpool sea surface, as three massive Giant Beasts burst forth amidst the cascade of water.
The leading Thunderflame Emperor Dragon has thunderbolt wings that shimmer behind it, resembling miniature wings; its Black Feather Horns emit Golden Firelight, as it zooms into the clouds at several times Supersonic Speed.
On the left behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is a Red Beast resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon, spiraling through the clouds and emitting mist as if a True Dragon descends.
To the right, a Silver Giant Dragon spreads its double wings, surrounded by a Green Storm, with the flames from the Top-grade Divine Fruits of Black Melting still burning atop it.
Continuously absorbing the energy from the Top-grade Divine Fruits, the Silver Giant Dragon's body length has grown to more than one hundred and sixty meters, becoming more colossal and majestic.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, with its two Dragon King subordinates, flew towards the South Sea area thousands of kilometers away, they were detected by a satellite immediately outside the atmosphere.
"Alert, detection of Mythical-level biological energy fluctuations, identification confirmed, Code-named Thunderflame, alert dismissed..."
Traveling at several times Supersonic Speed, it didn't take long for the three Giant Beasts to cover thousands of kilometers and arrive at the South Sea area, searching for coordinates from a high altitude.
After circling the sea surface for half an hour, Three Triangular Forming Islands appeared in the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
"Roar! Found it."
Boom!
With a sonic boom, the three massive Giant Beasts tore through the cloud layer and plummeted from the sky, each with trailing rings of vapor, diving into the sea seen by the researchers on the islands several kilometers away.
Boom! In an instant, a thousand-meter-radius of the sea surface exploded, sending up a stunning spray of water.
```
```

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 342 Deification Defense, The Last Kind of Talent_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 777 - 342 Deification Defense, The Last Kind of Talent_2
The three giant beasts that had burst into the sea reached the seabed a kilometer deep in the blink of an eye, causing the sea water within several kilometers to boil instantly as countless Mutated Creatures frantically fled under that invisible pressure.
"Roar! Tim Abott, is what you're looking for here?" Standing on the murky seabed, the Silver Giant Dragon looked around, confusion in its eyes.
Having been abruptly awakened by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and flown thousands of kilometers, it was still somewhat baffled.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, its breath spraying out intense waves of water; then, arcs of electricity jumped between its dorsal fins, exploding into electromagnetic waves covering a range of ten kilometers.
In an instant, a blurry three-dimensional image surfaced in the mind of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with countless dense specks scattering and swimming in different sizes.
"Great Sethia, Candle Dragon, contain your auras." With a low roar, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly moved, its tail stirring up violent currents as it swam to the left.
In the dark depths of the sea, the three giant beasts quickly swam out several kilometers, then a creature over twenty meters long with a round and pitch-black body, resembling both a python and an eel, appeared ahead.
In the darkness, that Black-striped Mutated Beast did not realize that three terrifying giant beasts were staring at it from several hundred meters away, its 'vast' body slowly moving forward.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, the sea water boiled over and a golden fire dragon appeared, roaring and swallowing the Black-striped Mutated Beast in one fiery gulp.
Roar!
Under the burning flames, the Black-striped Mutated Beast let out a cry of terror as it unleashed its strength in a burst, and in just an instant, its scales turned a dark red, almost roasted alive.
Of course, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had controlled the intensity of the flames. Otherwise, it could have turned that Unique Beast to ash in an instant.
After all, having a special talent does not mean being invincible; any attack whose intensity surpasses the defensive limit can break through. However, the specialty the Unique Beast had just displayed also caused the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon's gaze to flicker with interest.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled lowly, "Candle Dragon, use your Time Power to manipulate it."
The Red Beast nodded slowly, and with one eye opening and the other closing, instantly this world was alternating between black and white, a power involving the slowness of time descending.
Under the slow passage of time, the Mutated Beast, only level five, saw its speed greatly reduced while a layer of patterned scales on its body emitted a gray light.
Under the influence of those lights, the slow passage of time around it was subtly affected.
Once the surrounding Black and White Power disappeared and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast withdrew its power, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled again, "Great Sethia, tear it apart with space."
"Roar! No problem, the Great Sethia loves destruction the most."
The Silver Giant Dragon proudly raised its head as the silvery light flickered on the scale on its forehead. Instantly, spatial fluctuations shimmered, engulfing the Black-striped Mutated Beast several hundred meters away.
Crack!
Under the powerful spatial distortion, the body of the level five Black-striped Mutated Beast twisted and instantly ripped apart into two pieces, blood spewing from the not yet completely deceased body as it struggled.
Immediately, the corners of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon's mouth curved slightly upward because during the spatial distortion the patterns on the Unique Beast's body had reacted as well.
However, this natural talent and the Beast's own strength were both too weak to withstand the tearing of space.
But to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, that was no issue. As long as the natural attributes matched, it could absorb and integrate them, strengthening all the way to the top-tier, even achieving deification.
This was also the purpose behind the Red Beast and the Silver Giant Dragon accompanying it.
In regard to the talent absorbed for its fifth evolution, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was very cautious. It had to ensure the innate abilities of these creatures met the requirements.
Otherwise, once absorbed, there would be immense regret as there was no way to revert the integration.
Boom!
Beneath the deep sea, endless blue Thunderspark jumped as terrifying Annihilation True Thunder permeated, causing the sea to explode and countless Marine Life to flip over, their bellies up, within a range of several kilometers.
Beneath the feet of the three giant beasts, a pitch-black cave twenty meters in diameter leading straight to the Earth's core, and the corpses of several Deep Sea Black-striped Beasts began to slowly rise to the surface caught in the current.
The largest one was up to thirty meters long, reaching Level 6 Peak.
Bang, bang, bang!!
The sea surfaces littered with corpses of Mutated Fish exploded as water fell around the three Level 9 Giant Beasts like a waterfall, with raging wind swooshing up around them.
In just the blink of an eye, the three giant beasts appeared in the cloud sea at an altitude of ten thousand meters, flying towards Channel Three Deep Sea at a terrifying speed.
This scene was directly captured by satellite.
Including the Deep Sea Black-striped Beast clutched in the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon's claw, it was soon identified and linked to the information Jack Clark was researching. These data were then forwarded to the rear.
After confirming there were no anomalies, the data was immediately stored by the Heavenly Intelligent Core, requiring king-level clearance to view.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Roar, roar!!
Around Channel 3, Mutated Tiger Whales circled the vortex in the water, playfully excited.
At the edge of the vortex, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Female Tiger Whale Kitty Jones, Tiger One, Tiger Two, and Tiger Three were waiting, with the Blue Giant Crab and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle lying at the edge of the open space.
As for the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, its light injuries had already recovered, and it was now crouching in a corner, its nine dragon heads striving to condense Solid Runes, diligently cultivating.
It had actually been defeated by a human, moreover, by a Level 8 Early Stage human. This made the arrogant monarch-bloodline Nine-headed Flood Dragon quite unconvinced.
The next time they met, it was determined to let that human named Darren Callum know that Monarchs couldn't be insulted.
Boom!
Just then, the gigantic and fierce Thunderflame Emperor Dragon descended from the sky. In an instant, the Earth more than two hundred meters below the center of the vortex shattered, rocks bursting upward like a Tsunami in all directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 778: 342 Deification Defense, The Last Kind of Talent_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 778: Chapter 342 Deification Defense, The Last Kind of Talent_3
Under the violent impact, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon engrossed in cultivation, along with the bored Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and Blue Giant Crab lying around like trash, were swept into the Deep Sea Whirlpool mixed with rubble.
Boom boom boom!! The sea water exploded, and the nine dragon heads that were startled awake floated in the water, somewhat dazed: “Roar roar roar!! What, has, happened?”
In the muddy and furious sea whirlpool, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish jeered with delight: roar!! Thunderflame has fallen, you’ve been thrown out.
Bang!
No sooner had the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish finished speaking than the nearby Female Tiger Whale, which had grown to over eighty meters after digesting two Senior Black Melting Divine Fruits, gave it a smack with her tail.
In an instant, the sea water exploded, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish rolled over several times.
Roar!! Wife, why have you hit me again? The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish sounded somewhat aggrieved.
The Female Tiger Whale looked at it calmly: Roar!! We shouldn’t ridicule our companions indiscriminately.
As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was being hit by its wife again, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon also passed through the Whirlpool Channel and slowly landed behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Tiger One: Roar roar roar!! Uncle, you’re back.
Tiger Two: Roar!! Uncle, we’ve got lots of crystals this time.
Tiger Three: Roar roar roar!! Uncle, I got the most this time, Miss Keller, hurry, bring the bag over.
With the return of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Three-headed Mutated Tiger Whale excitedly called out, displaying even more enthusiasm than when seeing their own father, leaving the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish somewhat stunned.
At the eager calling of Tiger Whale Third Brother, who had grown to the Peak of Level 7, the Female Tiger Whale Kitty, who had just broken through to Level 5, obediently swam over.
She was carrying a new Mutant Fish Bubble Bag on her back.
While occupying Channel 3 in the front, waiting for the Black Oblivion King to “come over” for about ten days, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had ordered the Mutated Tiger Whale Group to rush over for work.
In ten days, the ‘mighty army’ of Mutated Tiger Whales, now over a hundred strong, had swept through a thousand kilometers and collected a large number of Low-level Life Crystals.
In addition, there was the Horned Lady leading three ‘little’ Tiger Whales, hunting some Level 6 and 7 Unique Beasts at their peak levels around the vicinity.
Boom boom boom!!
As one Mutant Fish Bubble Bag after another was opened, a large number of Life Crystals mixed with sea water tumbled out, satisfying the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to no end.
All these Low-level crystals combined should be able to be converted into around thirty thousand Attribute Points.
With the addition of those Level 4 or higher crystals brought back from the mythical world, this time I could convert several tens of thousands of Attribute Points.
Next, if I strengthen the Defensive Talent to ‘Deification’ level and devour this Deep Sea Black-striped Beast, I can begin an Evolution and break through to Mythical-level.
Under normal conditions, a Giant Beast, upon reaching quasi-mythical level, begins to grasp its deepest, most powerful talent and start touching upon the rule, tempering its body until it finally fuses its talent with the rule during the breakthrough to Mythical-level.
And all eight of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s talents have reached Top-tier, and with just a little more time, it’s almost certain to touch the corresponding Higher-order Laws.
This is the terror of Top Tier Talents.
Just by awakening one Top Tier Talent, the bloodline of an Extraordinary Giant Beast can break through to Monarch-level, considered a rare and powerful life among Mythical Giant Beasts.
Therefore, in the upcoming Fifth Evolution and breakthrough, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon plans to only let the strength and defense talents merge with their corresponding Higher-order Laws.
The other six talents that have not yet been strengthened to ‘Deification’ level will temporarily be suppressed, otherwise upon Transformation, the rules it touches may be merely Lower-order or Mid-order.
It would then be a loss not worth the gain because upon breaking through to Myth, touching and merging with the rule by the talent, it would be exceedingly difficult to upgrade the corresponding tier later on.

chapters.title: Chapter 779: 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal
chapters.content:
Chapter 779: Chapter 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal
Surrounded by the temperature-controlled golden flames, the sea water evaporated, and nearly two thousand white and blue Life Crystals flickered with enchanting radiance.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Everyone has worked hard. Scythia, give those Black Melting Divine Fruits to Tiger Three and the others, reward those Mutated Tiger Whales that performed well this time.”
These Black Melting Divine Fruits, each one could boost the strength of a Unique Beast below Level 7 by a notch when consumed.
However, the effect of the fruits diminished with each one eaten, so after several were fed to the three ‘Little Tiger Whales,’ there were still dozens left.
In particular, Tiger Whale Third Brother had already swindled two from the Sea Dragon giant beast before, so he ended up eating the fewest this time.
But these Divine Fruits didn’t go to waste, as he shared three with the Female Tiger Whale Kitty, and after eating just one, she made a breakthrough to Level 5.
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded in satisfaction, “Roar! Indeed, you all did well in getting so many Life Crystals for Tim Abott.”
As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon, like a butler, took out dozens of Black Melting Divine Fruits from its Reverse Scale, enveloping them in a cyan vortex and sweeping them into the sea water.
Roar! Leader, I tried really hard this time, give me one please.
Roar! Second General, I worked the hardest at driving the fish ahead, I want, I want…
Roar! Leader, I, I…
As the Tiger Whale Group boiled with excitement, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and said, “Next, I want to boost my power a bit, then I’ll stimulate your bloodlines for you.”
The Single-horned Tiger Whale slapped its Double Fins together, nodding and calling out, “Roar, Roar, Roar! Thunderflame, it’s more important for you to get stronger. Go on, become more of a freak.”
Roar, Roar! Thunderflame is going to become awesome again. Envy glinted in the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes.
Not only those two, but envy also shone in the eyes of Kidora and the other Giant Beasts; they, too, wished they could boost their power like the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at will.
The nonsensical remarks of these two fools rendered the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon speechless, as it fought the urge to slap them with its claw.
If you can’t speak sensibly, then speak less. What in the world does ‘become more of a freak’ mean?
These two, ever since they got tangled up that one time, have become more and more nonsensical with their words; to those unaware, one would think they had grown up in the gangster society.
Boom! Under the gaze of these Giant Beasts, golden flames sprang up around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, forming a circular Vacuum Flame Domain that obstructed visibility.
Hum!
Flames burned on the three pairs of red feather horns on either side of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, with silver runes flickering, converging into silver in the middle of a crown formed by the golden flames.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! Thousands of Life Crystals were swept up by the domain power, passing densely through the Spatial Channel, and falling onto the damaged room’s floor with a clatter.
Only when the Life Crystals piled up around Jack Clark’s feet and the gold-red rune radiance on his arm slowly dimmed, closing the Spatial Channel, did he stop.
“What a pity,” Jack lamented as he looked at the several hundred Level 4 or higher Life Crystals before him.
These Life Crystals brought back from the mythical world were significantly depleted of Life Energy due to the sacrifice.
Otherwise, with so many Level 4 or higher crystals, along with those lower-ranked crystals collected by the Tiger Whales, he could have converted them into more than a hundred thousand attribute points this time.
However, his main purpose in entering the mythical world was to kill that Mythical Giant Beast, to use as fodder for accelerating the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s rapid breakthrough to Level 9 Peak.
So all in all, he didn’t consider it a loss, after all, it was an unexpected gain.
After consoling himself, Jack Clark grabbed two fist-sized pale golden crystals in each hand and a thought resonated in his mind, “Convert to Attribute points.”
“You converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, obtaining 621 Attribute points.”
“You converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, obtaining 521 Attribute points…”
As Jack incessantly converted them, the attribute points originally remaining over eleven thousand on the attribute page surged, quickly surpassing thirty thousand, forty thousand…
Once Jack had converted more than a thousand Level 2 crystals, over seven hundred Level 3 crystals, several hundred Level 4 and Level 5 crystals, and one Level 9 crystal, the page displayed a total of 89,304 attribute points.
“Over eighty thousand attribute points.” Jack’s face lit up with a smile as his gaze settled on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Defensive Talent.
For the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which evolved through physical strength, formidable power was followed naturally by defense, to become invincible in close combat, capable of exploding everything.
“Spend 50,000 Attribute points to enhance Defensive Talent.”
In an instant, the vast enhancement energy traveled through the Soul Channel, emerging within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
At that moment, a terrifying suppressive force shook Heaven and Earth, exploding the Vacuum Flame Domain, and a radius of kilometers on the seabed crumbled under the sudden burst, with countless rocks being hurled in all directions with the shockwave.
All the Giant Beasts’ realms of thought thundered, feeling as if the whole world was trembling.
Encircling an area of tens of kilometers, the Deep Sea Whirlpool, formed from the collision of forces of two worlds, thrashed wildly, causing hundreds of meters of towering Tsunami on the sea surface.
Boom!
The air exploded, a black-red radiance shot into the sky, piercing through the ten-thousand-meter Deep Sea Whirlpool in a blink, and appearing above tens of kilometers at high altitude.
Roar!
The ferocious behemoth standing in the Firmament, shrouded in black light, roared to the heavens, its dreadfully fierce presence changing the color of the skies as dark clouds spontaneously gathered, forming a whirlpool spanning tens of kilometers.
Roar, Roar, Roar! The hurricanes howled above the sea surface, the waves surged, and blue thunder roared from the dark clouds, occasionally striking the sea and causing water to spray everywhere.
Bang, Bang, Bang! Giant Beasts excitedly looked up at the spectacle above the sea.
“Roar, Roar, Roar! Awesome, freaking awesome, Abbott has become stronger again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 780: 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 780: Chapter 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal_2
The raging seas surged as a Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which had broken through two hundred meters in length, twisted frantically, its nine dragon heads flailing as if they were pendulums, showing boundless excitement.
This scene scared a few Heavy Armored Beasts, including the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which quickly retreated, fearing they would catch its frenzy.
Frightened to death, it’s okay to be excited, but there’s no need to be so exaggerated.
“Roar! Go, Tim Abott, after your breakthrough, tear apart that ancient creature. The Great Scythia must stand fiercely atop its head and roar.”
The Silver Giant Dragon spread its double wings and circled in the air, emitting an excited Dragon Roar as it watched the increasingly horrific aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with exhilaration.
Because as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon grew stronger, it meant the Dragon Palace and by extension, it was getting stronger.
At the same time, energy detection satellites beyond the atmosphere also emitted urgent alarms.
“Alert, Mythical-level energy fluctuations detected above Deep Sea No.3 Channel, code-named Thunderflame; the energy fluctuations are continuously intensifying, continuously intensifying…”
“Hiss! That Mutant Beast has grown stronger again!”
“The speed of its strength improvement is too terrifying.”
The Monitoring Center staff were all utterly shocked.
In just over half a month, they had practically witnessed the Mutant Beast advance from the early stage of Level 9 to the late stage, and then to the killing of a Mythical Giant Beast.
Not even two days had passed, and this being, with combat power comparable to a Mythical Giant Beast, was experiencing another explosive increase in strength.
The terror of its talent was now not inferior to those Supreme Experts of the Human Race that had risen during the Dark Age.
Amidst the excited roars of the giant beasts, the aura around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the sky grew stronger and its form underwent another change.
Its entire body’s thick scale armor and skin began to merge, various soft tissues intermingled with the underlying muscles, forming a horrific whole, reminiscent of its original state upon gaining its Defensive Talent.
However, in contrast to its earlier evolution into the Hexagonal Armored Beast with thick, unified Thousand-layered Scale Armor covering its body, now the entire body’s structure was changing.
Beyond that, golden patterns emerged on the Black-red Scaled Armor covering the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, exuding the spirit of the indestructible Vajra.
For Extraordinary Giant Beasts, each breakthrough in talent would push their bloodlines to evolve and level up.
Right then, under the influence of its two Deification Talents, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s life stage was undergoing a Transformation, having reached the pseudo-Heavenly Monarch-level aura that became even more terrifying.
Above the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Purple Dragon Egg emitted a strong emotion of joy, excitedly absorbing the invisible Life Energy emanating from the dragon.
Consequently, the regal pressure radiating from the Purple Dragon Egg also began to slowly grow stronger.
This Dragon Egg had managed to retain a Monarch-Level Life stage after countless years of the erosion of its Source of Life, indicating that its inherent life level might be stronger than imagined.
After all, the Origin Substance flowing from it contained the power of Creation, capable of causing the bloodlines of other Mutant Beasts to undergo a Transformation.
Ever since it followed the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and absorbed its Monarch-Level Life Energy, replenishing its Life Origin, it no longer leaked out.
In the mythical world, a Horrific Creature stretching for tens of kilometers, standing over twenty kilometers tall at the shoulder and bearing mountains and rivers on its back, emitted a horrifying roar.
Feeling the even more potent ‘Heavenly’ Monarch-level life aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon opposite, the ancient being became even more crazed, wanting to charge over and devour it.
Boom!
Under the impact of the terrifying ancient creature, the space around the world passageways, where the powers of two worlds entwined, vibrated, showing signs of unstable collapse.
The several hundred-meter-sized pathways were too small for the enormous ancient creature, insignificant to the point of ignorable.
If it weren’t for the creature operating on pure instinct at the moment, unable to harness ‘rule’ powers, a casual strike would be enough to destroy this ordinary world pathway.
About an hour or so passed, and as the Heavenly Monarch-level life aura from the other side disappeared, this massive creature abruptly halted, standing somewhat bewildered on the Earth.
And the mountain peak where the pathway was located had long since crumbled, with mountain ranges within hundreds of kilometers turned to ruins.
…
Above the altitude of ten thousand meters, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had completed its talent upgrade, shimmered with Black Gold Radiance, emanating an aura of Vajra indestructibility, unbreakably solid.
Due to its incredibly powerful body, the invisible force it emitted even twisted its surroundings, creating a field reminiscent of a Black Hole, compelling in its might.
And as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon savored the changes in its talents within, Jack Clark’s gaze fell upon the transparent page before him.
Defense. Vajra [Deification: The Defensive Talent strengthened to the utmost limit, possessing an unbeatable absolute defense, and a uniform structure capable of withstanding terrorizing pressures far beyond limits.
Vajra Invincibility: Under the influence of talents that have been pushed to their limits, the Vajra rule is invoked for Tempering the entire body, making muscles, bones, and scale armor all even more solid.
Remark: This talent already possesses the characteristics of Vajra; upon breaking through to Mythical, it can directly touch upon the rule, advancing to one of the Superior Higher-order Laws, the Vajra Law.]
As expected, another Superior Top-tier Law.
Seeing the remark behind the Defensive Talent, both Jack Clark and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had the corners of their mouths curl up slightly, one looking resplendent and radiant, the other terrifyingly ferocious.
Now that the talent has completed the intensification, next comes the fifth Evolution.
Upon breaking through to Myth, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon will directly control two kinds of Superior Top-tier Laws, and together with its formidable physical body, its combat power will become extremely terrifying.
Including the other six talents, their power will also become stronger after it breaks through to the Mythical level, because the foundation has become much more solid.

chapters.title: Chapter 781: 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 781: Chapter 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal_3
And once entering the Gigantification State, when talents merged, even mythical peak Giant Beasts could be torn apart alive.
However, before evolving into hibernation, there was still one thing left unfinished. Thinking of this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head to look towards those Giant Beast subordinates on the sea surface.
Boom!
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s giant claw reached out, in an instant, a terrifying pressure as if the sky were falling and the earth collapsing enveloped the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Candle Dragon, the three-headed Giant Beasts.
Under the pull of the Heavenly Emperor Level bloodline, the bloodline power within the three Giant Beasts boiled up, becoming incredibly active.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had long reached the peak of the eighth level and was always waiting for this moment, felt a strong sense of drowsiness emanating from the depths of its body and slowly sank into the seabed.
Meanwhile, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon slightly suppressed the bloodline power within its body and swallowed three Senior Black Melting Divine Fruits in one gulp.
Boom! Day and night alternated on the body of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, but this time its Gifted Power covered only a one-kilometer radius, as if it had entered another temporal layer.
After assisting the three Giant Beasts in stimulating their bloodline powers, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep growl filled with majestic pressure, “Great Sethia, Kidora, I will be entering hibernation next. The safety issue will be left to you.”
The Silver Giant Dragon circling in the sky raised its head and let out a confident roar, “Roar! With the Great Sethia here, no beast shall disturb Tim Abott during your hibernation.”
Nodding slightly at the Silver Giant Dragon, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon then returned to the vortex on the seabed, which had sunk another hundred meters or more.
With a body length of more than three hundred and twenty meters and an even more ferocious appearance, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon approached the skeleton of the Black Colossus and grabbed the corpse of the Deep Sea Black-striped Beast and swallowed it in one bite.
At the same time, Jack Clark’s voice echoed in his mind.
“Initiate the Fifth Evolution.”
Boom! Inside the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the life energy that had been accumulating for months burst out instantly, causing the mountains and seas to shake, immensely impressive.
Simultaneously, deep within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, an aura from ancient times was also activated, immediately spreading a desolate and ancient aura.
Boom! The consciousness of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon vibrated, accompanied by intense drowsiness, as vague information flooded into its mind.
In the fragmented visions, the Earth shattered, and the sky was burning.
A terrifyingly huge beast outside the world, of an indeterminable length spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, opened its gaping maw, gradually devouring Heaven and Earth…
Whoosh whoosh! The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, causing a raging wind to descend next to the hibernating Black-red Colossal Beast, and the Reverse Scale radiated with light, giant pieces of Silver Scale Armor emerged.
These scales, each exceeding twenty meters in diameter and more than ten meters thick after tempering, were intertwined with extremely powerful Law Power.
“Roar roar roar! Sesi, ah, those, scare beasts.” Under the pressure of the dozen or more Scales of Laws, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon hurriedly backed away, shaking its dragon heads.
“Roar! Horned Lady, you continue to lead the Tiger Whale Army on patrol, hunting those Suitable Mutated Creatures to collect Life Crystals,” bellowed the Silver Giant Dragon with authority.
“Kidora, you will continue with your secret method practice with six heads, while the other three heads patrol the surrounding sea area, prohibiting any Mutated Creatures above level seven from approaching within a hundred kilometers.”
“Crab General, you do the same, patrolling the surroundings with Kidora,” commanded the Silver Giant Dragon as it resumed its majestic phttps://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago_Manual_of_Styleosture as the Dragon Palace Dragon King after the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fell asleep.
The Female Tiger Whale let out a calm whine, “Mmm mmm mmm! Yes, Great King Sethia.”
Although the Silver Giant Dragon seemed like a child in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, when it got serious, all the Giant Beasts dared not defy its orders.
Even Kidora, who had once defeated the Silver Giant Dragon at level eight, did not dare to utter another word under the deterrence of those Scales of Laws.
After sending all the Giant Beasts away, the Silver Giant Dragon lay down next to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and its tail gently waved to disperse light breezes, keeping watch over the surroundings.
So sleepy.
Jack Clark rubbed his eyebrows, suppressing the intense drowsiness coming from his other half’s consciousness.
Since it directly skipped the quasi-mythical step of Law Body Refinement, this evolution of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would be a long hibernation before it could complete the transformation from an Extraordinary Body to a Law Body.
Now that the Giant Beast Avatar was in hibernation, it was time for Jack Clark to focus on his own matters.
With this thought, Jack Clark’s gaze fell upon the more than thirty thousand Attribute points remaining on the transparent page.
Most of the Attribute points gained during this period had been added to strengthen the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, resulting in a slightly slower increase in his own strength.
For instance, Soul Split, Void Double Pupils, and other talents remained at the Top-tier, and the Space-Time Summoning Technique was only moderately accomplished.
Even though the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was already hibernating, it was still possible to summon its Power Projection through the Space-Time Altar. The potency of the summoning depended on the practice level of the secret method and the bond between the two parties.
Being two sides of the same coin, the bond between Jack Clark and the Giant Beast was nearly one hundred percent, so the limiting factor for the summoning’s power was the progress of the secret method practice.
With this in mind, Jack Clark’s gaze landed on the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
“Would you like to spend ten thousand Attribute points to strengthen the Space-Time Secret Skill?”
The modestly accomplished Space-Time Secret Skill’s strengthening was two thousand, but now the major accomplishment required ten thousand because the higher the level of power involved, the greater the demands for enhancement.
“Strengthen.”
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, instantly, his left hand’s back shone with a Gloomy blue Radiance, within which countless Rune Sequence Chains unfurled, forming a Mysterious altar that enveloped the room.
Under the strengthening power, these Gloomy blue Rune Sequence Chains continuously evolved, becoming more and more numerous while the altar kept expanding, gradually covering the entire small building.
“Rune manifestation.”
“Hiss! What Cultivation Method is student Clark practicing? It’s terrifying!”

chapters.title: Chapter 782: 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 782: Chapter 343 Fifth Evolution, Vajra, Immortal_4
Evening. As the altar with twinkling gloomy blue light appeared, it instantly attracted the glances of many people in the small town, each of them shocked.
No one knew what Secret Skill Jack Clark was cultivating, as the runes manifested covered an entire small building.
Under the astonished eyes of Sheehan Bland and others, countless blue Rune Sequence Chains kept converging, gradually forming a shadow of an altar twenty meters high with five layers of steps.
Only then did Jack Clark slowly open his eyes, and with a thought, the altar that loomed over the small building collapsed as if collapsing, and it converged grandly onto the back of his hand, forming a blue altar imprint.
At the same time, the annotation for the Secret Skill on the attribute page also changed.
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Technique [Grand Accomplishment: When activated, forms a Space-Time Altar, bloodline resonance, soul harmony, summoning a projection possessing thirty percent of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s strength to descend.]
Hint: Summoning will greatly consume Qi Blood and True Strength, the longer the projection exists, the greater the consumption will be.
Note: When the Secret Skill is strengthened to the limit, it can reverse the space-time of its location, summoning the True Body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon—once the summoning ends, space-time reverses, and the Giant Beast departs.]
Jack Clark slowly spoke, “A projection with thirty percent of its strength, huh.”
With the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s incredible combat power, once it broke through to Mythical-level, a projection with thirty percent of its strength would be enough to tear through and suppress a common king-level opponent.
Thinking this, Jack Clark nodded satisfactorily. The battle he had fought with Hannah Gail was for this very moment.
However, to summon the Giant Beast’s True Body, he would need to strengthen the Secret Skill to its limit; otherwise, it’s like carrying a super hitter with him, ready to summon the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to kill anyone displeasing his eye at any moment.
Of course, such a thought was just that—a thought.
Because even using one’s toes to think, it would be known that the consumption of manifesting the true form of a Summoned Giant Beast would be incredibly terrifying, since it reverses time itself.
Under the principle of mass-energy conversion leverage, the instant consumption might just cause Jack Clark to collapse, only to be used as a trump card.
“Limit Break Space-Time Summoning Technique requires 50,000 attribute points, current points insufficient, unable to enhance.”
50,000. Jack Clark withdrew his gaze, once again feeling a shortage of attribute points.
It seems he would have to find a way into the mythical world himself to get them.
Actually, with the entire Federation’s power, the speed of collecting Life Crystals would be incredibly fast, especially as countless large Mutated Creatures inhabit the mythical world.
However, after decades, most of the Unique Beasts surrounding the human territories have been nearly wiped out, and the military’s main forces are deployed at the two Frontline Battlefields.
That’s why currently, only the Exploration Department’s people venture deeper into the mythical world.
But the issue is that those explorers focus on exploration and don’t intentionally kill Mutated Creatures because combat inevitably leads to casualties.
At that time, it’s possible for either the Giant Beast or the cultivators to die.
So, in the end, Jack Clark would have to take action himself unless one day he became one of the Federal Top Level and could mobilize some forces to serve his needs.
As for the batch of Life Crystals that Marcellus Larry helped him to collect previously, that was an extra request, and doing it once would be about the limit.
Otherwise, it would give off a sense of insatiable greed.
After all, Jack Clark has received protection from the Federation and the Human Race while developing his Cultivation, without giving back much in return.
His Cultivation has now broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven, already higher than most cultivators who enter the mythical world with only the Fourth or Fifth Layer Heaven.
But he will need to wait another two days for the forbidden weapon from the Speaker and for the Mystical Disc of the Sea Illusion Demon Skill and the divine-grade materials for crafting the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd to arrive.
So, continue cultivating. With that thought, Jack Clark turned over his hand, bringing out a Grade 9 Blood Lotus Seed exuding dense energy from the Sumeru Space.
Boom! As Jack Clark swallowed the seed, an immense surge of blood energy exploded within his body.
With the supply of this pure blood energy, Jack Clark’s flesh and blood were reconstructed, rapidly transforming towards a higher level of life.
Although his focus was on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon during these two days, Jack Clark had not neglected his cultivation, with his newly broken through Eight Layer Heaven Cultivation progressing at an astonishing speed.
After all, his goal was the Ninth Heavens within a year, or even to become a One-Year King.

chapters.title: Chapter 783: 344: Carrying the Weight of the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World
chapters.content:
Chapter 783: Chapter 344: Carrying the Weight of the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World
Simon Empire
At the No.2 Channel Base, a blue vortex slowly rotated thousands of meters above the ground.
In the distance, a hideous mecha covered in thick black-red armor stood tall, exuding an instinctively terrifying aura that incited fear in those nearby.
At this moment, several staff members were conducting inspections. As scanning beams swept over the mecha, massive data cables were connected in the back.
“Number One’s biostatus is stable.”
“Nuclear Fusion Engine fuel is sufficient, and the energy storage is full.”
“All sixteen subspace compartments on the external mecha are stable, and ammunition has been loaded.”
“Inspection complete, no abnormalities detected…”
A human-sized mecha stood near the enormous mecha’s feet.
Observing the girl next to the God Machine Armament, Elvis Louise fell silent for a moment before speaking, “The frontline battlefield is much more dangerous than the training ground. Be extra cautious when you go there.”
“With Number One’s power level, chances are high that a demon king will take action if it appears on the battlefield. Those monsters who manage to grow into demon kings have a brutal internal environment, and there are no weaklings among them.”
“If you encounter a life-threatening danger and cannot retreat, make sure to decisively remove the biological mecha restrictions on Number One and let it show its true power.”
“However, don’t resort to such measures unless it’s absolutely necessary. When in complete form, Number One is too powerful and may contaminate your spirit or even assimilate you.”
“Although you have the God Machine Armament created by your aunt and possess the eternal power furnace, such protection against assimilation only exists in theory.”
“Also, even if you’re resting at the base, try not to stay too far away from Number One. As a suitable driver, Number One will instinctively protect you when you’re in danger.”
At this moment, an attractive woman with long silver hair in her thirties walked over and smiled. “Don’t worry, Professor Louise. Freya Louise’s safety will be in good hands.”
“Once on the frontline, we’ll have Gabriel King’s watchful eyes on the battlefield, and my student Gabriella will provide close protection at the base. She will undoubtedly be safe.”
After Helena finished speaking, Gabriella, who was standing nearby, smiled and greeted Freya Louise: “Junior Louise, nice to see you again.”
Freya replied courteously, “Senior Gabri, I’ll be relying on you from now on.”
Although they had only met once before, no one dared to underestimate Simon Holy Light Academy’s newest prodigy. This included Freya Louise herself.
However, her reliance on Number One made her dependent on external factors. In comparison to Gabriella, who broke through the Seventh Layer Heaven as a sophomore and eventually constructed high-level mechas herself, the gap was significant.
But this gap was only temporary.
As a biological mecha comparable to a mythical creature, Number One was also a living entity. Freya Louise could use it to cultivate her powers in the meantime.
Under the guidance of a mythical being, Freya’s cultivation speed was terrifying. Within a month, she had already broken through the Early Stage of Fourth Layer Heaven to the Mid-stage of Fifth Layer Heaven.
Focused primarily on the mastery of Number One as an external mecha, she didn’t need to refine her body or condense her True Strength too much. She only needed to reach the right realm.
Including the next breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven, she didn’t need to cultivate any Secret Books because Number One is her external mecha, and her progress relies on ‘refining’ it.
At this moment, an electronic voice echoed from the sky: “Attention, the channel will temporarily disarm defenses in one minute. Please prepare.”
“Teacher, I’m leaving.”
“Go on, take good care of Freya.”
“Dad, I’m going first.” Excitement flickered across Freya’s face.
She had been curious about the mythical world for a long time, and with his talent, that guy must have already gone there.
Humm!
As Freya entered the God Machine Armament, the majestic white-gold mecha, more than four meters tall, quickly spread its wings and soared into the sky amidst a scorching whirlwind.
At the same time, the blue-white rhombus-shaped crystal on Number One’s chest lit up, allowing the God Machine Armament to pass through and enter Number One’s interior.
In an instant, the mecha’s eyes shone with a blue-white light, giving off a terrifying presence as if a fearsome creature had awakened.
Boom!
The mecha stepped forward, and the ground around it shook violently, the sheer force causing even the surrounding space to tremble.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone around, Number One slowly approached the channel and stepped in.
Boom!
As soon as Number One entered the channel, the blue vortex trembled wildly, its terrifying power appearing as if resisting the passage of a lifeform comparable to a king.
At this moment, a blue-haired young man appeared beside Elvis Louise, his face filled with astonishment: “As expected of the evolved remnants of an ancient being, the power contained within is incredibly vast.”
Elvis Louise’s eyes flashed with fervor: “Number One is the most perfect lifeform I’ve ever witnessed. As long as it continues to grow, it’s sure to complete the Sky-pillar Plan and carry the world.”
“Let’s hope so.”
The blue-haired young man sighed, “Berlin’s True King conducted his first Genesis Fusion recently, but he failed and damaged the Titan’s Body. He has already retreated to the Exploration Department for healing.”
“The current situation on the Sky-based God King’s battlefield is still stable as he is confronting the Demon God of the Purgatory Family in the sky above the Abyss. The situation is still stable.”
————-
The second day after the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon went into hibernation, July 7th, in the morning
Sheehan Bland came over with a black box slung over his shoulder.
Thud! The one-meter-sized box was placed on the ground, causing the area within a ten-meter radius to tremble slightly and kick up a cloud of smoke and dust.
Sheehan Bland was puzzled as he rubbed his arms, “Student Clark, what kind of material did you request this time? Even with the protection of a Space Isolation Box, it’s still so heavy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 784: 344 Bearing the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 784: Chapter 344 Bearing the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World_2
