Opening the door, Jack Clark smiled faintly and casually said, “It’s just some materials for reforging weapons and battle armor.”
Sheehan Bland nodded, “Indeed, now that you’ve broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven, you really do need to reforge your weapon, otherwise you won’t be able to unleash your full strength.”
After a brief exchange, Sheehan Bland, who had other matters to attend to, took his leave.
After seeing off Sheehan Bland, Jack Clark grabbed the black box with one arm and felt an instant weight in his hand. He then carried the nearly thousand-ton box toward the distant Closed Area.
Boom!
As the heavy stone gate closed, the light inside the large Cultivation Room, a hundred meters in width and height, dimmed, leaving only the faint glow from the crystals embedded in the ceiling.
Arriving at the center of the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark entered the required password and fingerprint onto the box as instructed.
Click! As the verification passed, the box slowly opened, revealing a space several times larger than its exterior and the items inside.
A human-head-sized mineral emitting a black luster, a red substance flowing slowly like magma, a golden feather burning with flames…
This time, Jack Clark had requested four kinds of God-level Extraordinary Materials: Celestial Meteorite Ore, Mysterious Steel God Crystal, Melt Blood Ore, and Golden Phoenix Feather, in addition to two ordinary divine-grade materials, Illusory Crystal God Stone.
The Celestial Meteorite Ore, from the mythical world and outer space, consisted of star matter that had fallen to Earth, with a single human-head-sized piece weighing over five thousand tons.
It is actually the residual matter of celestial bodies that had burned upon entering the Earth’s atmosphere.
However, unlike the meteorites of Blue Star, these meteorites from the mythical world not only have a high density but also possess high energy conductivity.
Of course, this density is still far less than that of neutron star matter, which weighs a hundred million tons per cubic centimeter.
The Mysterious Steel God Crystal is known for its hardness, and when integrated into a weapon during casting, it grants an attribute of unmatched solidity, making the weapon indestructible.
As for the Illusory Crystal God Stone, it is an upgraded version of the Pleasure Crystal Stone, where just one piece can give a weapon the flexibility to expand to over a hundred meters in length.
Originally, Jack Clark’s goal was to strengthen the War Halberd to more than ten thousand tons, so it would be more suitable to use.
But then, he reconsidered.
For a normal cultivator, the body is only the foundation; the truly powerful force is the Transcendent strength they control, the True Martial that harmonizes with Heaven and Earth, even the rule itself.
Even Jack Clark, whose body was as fearsome as a Giant Beast’s, would be merely an ‘ordinary’ level eight ‘Giant Beast’ without the augmentation of the Combat Divine Body.
However, when a formidable body is combined with peerless True Martial forces of the same rank, Jack Clark’s combat power reaches an exaggerated level.
Therefore, it is not enough for a weapon to be merely ‘heavy’; it must be compatible with True Martial to exert its greatest power. Otherwise, carrying a mountain peak a kilometer tall and weighing billions of tons would be invincible, wouldn’t it?
But in front of Mythical Giant Beasts, a mountain peak a kilometer tall is just like building blocks, which their massive bodies can smash with one blow and their breath can destroy.
So, utilizing the Heavenly Core Database, Jack Clark referred to the database’s hundred thousand plus weapon Rune Matrices to rederive the structure of the legendary Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
With the attributes of heaviness, solidity, True Strength amplification, and an Overbearing and sharp Halberd Skill, it could combine the power of a domain, even the World’s Power, to infinitely increase its weight.
As a monster who possessed the Doomsday Hell Domain and had opened the Fourfold Illusionary World, holding the infinitely heavy Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, Jack Clark’s power would become even more fearsome.
Thinking this, Jack Clark took a deep breath, somewhat excitedly took out the Eight Desolation Heavy Halberd, and placed it alongside the three kinds of God-level materials, including the Celestial Meteorite Ore.
Placing his hand on the War Halberd, the thought in Jack Clark’s mind arose: “Consume Attribute points to strengthen the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.”
In an instant, the attribute page’s 29,304 Attribute points became 27,304, and two thousand points worth of strengthening energy converted into White Light, enveloping the War Halberd and the materials.
Whoosh!
Under the strengthening energy, the Illusory Crystal God Stone was the first to shatter, followed by the Celestial Meteorite Ore, and Mysterious Steel God Crystal; the three materials slowly merged with the War Halberd amidst the burning white flame.
At the same time, the rune in Jack Clark’s forehead that resembled an eye slowly surfaced, and the Doomsday Hell Domain emitting dazzling blood light unfolded within the Cultivation Room.
Boom! Four circles of real and illusionary light appeared behind Jack Clark’s head, representing Yellow Earth, golden flames, black hurricanes, and blue-black thunder.
As the light circles of the Fourfold World turned slowly, the energy between heaven and earth surged violently, converging inexhaustibly.
Boom!
As the Domain Power, the power of the Fourfold Illusionary World, and the True Dragon Power began to construct the Rune Matrix, the White Light burning on the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd grew even more intense.
Once one becomes a cultivator and breaks through the Fourth Layer Heaven, it is common to forge a Transcendent Weapon.
But unlike them, who spend time practicing Weapon Casting Secret Skills, Jack Clark, who directly strengthens with attribute points, skips the intermediate process altogether.
Even though it might take an early Nine Layers Heaven strong man ten days to half a month to forge a legendary-level weapon and there is no guarantee that the materials will fuse perfectly, Jack Clark completed the enhancement in just half an hour.
As the White Light slowly dispersed, a three meters nine long, pitch-black War Halberd with gold-red Dragon Scales wrapped around its body and a fierce-looking blade appeared in Jack Clark’s hands.
Instantly, a terrifyingly heavy aura spread out, almost solidifying and distorting the air around it.
At the same time, several rows of transparent text appeared before Jack Clark’s eyes.
Weapon: Eight Desolate Battle Sky Halberd [Legendary-level Transcendent Weapon, possessing the attributes of heaviness and solidity, base weight 5,100 tons, Halberd Skill amplified by two times.
Active Function: Ward Off Evil Golden Light
Active Function: As you wish, when entering the Combat Divine Body form, it can consume True Strength to enlarge, and the base weight of the weapon will double under increased body size.

chapters.title: Chapter 785: 344 Bearing the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 785: Chapter 344 Bearing the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World_3
Infinite Pressure: Under the blessing of the domain and the power of the world, a heavy gravitational field is formed, with the weight infinitely increasing until the weapon reaches its limit.
This overall enhancement of the War Halberd marks an upgrade, with its level reaching legendary and gaining the characteristic of infinite pressure. The gigantification, which previously could only double in size, has also been enhanced.
With a single arm holding the 5,000-ton heavy weapon, Jack Clark’s right arm muscle slightly expanded as he casually swung it.
Boom! In an instant, a sonic explosion resounded in the Cultivation Room, and a black vacuum blade, several meters long, roared out, tearing through everything.
Boom!
Instantly, the wall of the Cultivation Room a hundred meters away shook, and a crack over 50 meters long appeared on the wall, which was incredibly tough and reinforced with runes.
This strike did not include True Strength or the power of Heaven and Earth; it was purely the high-pressure blade formed by the mere compression of the air.
“Not bad, this weight is quite suitable,” Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction. He then stored the Eight Desolate War Halberd and took out the somewhat damaged Dragon Blood Battle Armor.
During the previous battle in the ruins of the relic, Jack Clark’s Dragon Blood Battle Armor was seriously damaged and had been in a broken state until now.
He had no choice; he had been too busy recently to temper the battle armor, and it was a good time to repair it during this enhancement.
For cultivators, having a set of strong and durable battle armor equated to an extra layer of protection, reducing the consumption of True Strength and offering some auxiliary functions.
In the early stages of cultivation, humans below the Fourth Layer were at a disadvantage compared to Mutated Beasts. After the Fourth Layer, with Transcendent Weapons and extraordinary battle armor, humans could compete equally.
After reaching high-order, condensing the true martial arts phantom, restructuring the combat body, and coupled with the advantages of weapons and battle armor, humans were a bit stronger than the Giant Beasts of the same level.
However, after stepping into the Mythical-level, the increasingly massive and terrifying Giant Beasts would regain the advantage.
The energy contained within their colossal bodies, which were tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands times larger than humans, was as vast as the ocean. A slight move could shake mountains and destroy everything.
Moreover, these Mythical Giant Beasts’ flesh bodies have been tempered by rules, extremely tough and durable, and their solid and thick black-red Scaled Armor could withstand ordinary nuclear bombs without injury, much like the kilometer-long python when the New Era began.
However, human cultivators also have their advantages. After breaking through to king-level, their souls transform into Divine Souls, they condense Law Bodies, wield rules, and possess tremendous might with every action they take.
Unlike Giant Beasts, which rely on instinctual Evolution to grow stronger, human cultivators have a stronger grasp and understanding of rules.
Especially those powerful king-level beings who master multiple rules and can achieve rule fusion, they could even be stronger than ordinary Mythical Giant Beasts.
Overall, the Giant Beast route is similar to Infinite Evolution, integrating all strength into the body to prove the Dao and achieve sanctity in the flesh.
Humans, on the other hand, pursue the sublimation of life, wielding, integrating, and merging rules and laws to become higher-dimensional life forms.
Quickly, after fusing with Melt Blood Ore, Golden Phoenix Feather, and another piece of the Illusory Crystal God Stone, the battle armor completion was strengthened.
The battle armor, which seemed to be crafted from heavy black-red Dragon Scales, adorned with Golden Patterns, hovered in the air, surrounded by raging red flames, looking incredibly lavish and commanding.
Dragon Scales and Phoenix Feathers Battle Armor: “A legendary level Transcendent Battle Armor with features such as durability, Phoenix Flame Purification, as desired, and fusion separation, increasing the True Strength shield by double.
Active Functions: Blood Flame Phoenix Wings, consuming True Strength to unfold the Blood Flame Phoenix Wings for traceless flight.
Active Functions: Flame Phoenix Ring Explosion, when an attack reaches its limit, it will cause an explosion similar to the furious spread of a Phoenix’s double wings, causing indiscriminate attacks on surrounding enemies.
Compared to the Eight Desolate War Halberd, Jack Clark’s requirements for the battle armor weren’t very high; his standards were just that of a typical legendary battle armor, solid with standard True Strength amplification.
However, in order to complement the Combat Divine Body form, he further strengthened the gigantification function of the battle armor.
After completing the reforging of both weapon and battle armor, Jack Clark continued his closed-door cultivation, familiarizing himself with the weapon until the next day when he received a notification from Marcellus Larry.
At Base No.1, in the top-floor office of the main control center building.
On Marcellus Larry’s desk, there were four black jade boxes and a palm-sized white object that looked like tree bark or jade.
Pointing to the object that resembled tree bark, Marcellus Larry introduced, “This Soul Sealing Jade contains the Sea Illusion Demon Skill you requested.”
“Although this skill is somewhat niche in its functionality, because it involves rules, ordinary objects cannot bear it.”
Then, Marcellus Larry became more solemn, opened the first box, and revealed a wrist-sized object glowing with white light, speaking gravely.
“This is the Heavenly Star Ring, crafted by the Second Councilor, sealing one of his Rule powers, capable of blocking a Supreme-level attack once.”
Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a sharp breath at that.
It was a defensive forbidden weapon capable of withstanding a Rule-level attack; with this Star Ring, even if Jack faced a Supreme Expert, he could survive an extra blow before death.
As Jack admired the power of the Star Ring, Marcellus Larry opened the second box, revealing a fist-sized Red Crystal Stone.
Inside the stone, which seemed like a world in itself, a vague shadow struggled and roared.
“This is a Rebirth Soul Crystal, crafted by the First Councilor after venturing into a dangerous area in the mythical world and slaying a special life at the early Myth level, using its Divine Soul and bones.”
“As for its effect, it acts as a life substitute once.”
“A life substitute once!” This time, even Jack Clark was somewhat shocked.
Marcellus Larry nodded, “That’s right, the moment you are slain by an enemy, in a reversal of rules, the soul crystal bound to your life will suffer death in your stead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 786: 344 Bearing the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 786: Chapter 344 Bearing the Heavens, Entering the Mythical World_4
“However, this life substitute effect is only effective for those below the King level.”
“Being effective below king-level is already good enough.” Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a hint of excitement. With this Soul Crystal, he was essentially gaining an additional life and another trump card.
Marcellus Larry continued, “This is the Heaven Divine Shadow Talisman, a teleportation-class forbidden weapon. Once used, it can reverse space-time and instantly transport you back to the Sky Curtain Fortress.”
“This is to prevent you from being trapped in some kind of inescapable deadly situation after you enter the mythical world.”
“Of course, this teleportation also has a limit; the strength of the place you’re trapped in cannot exceed the rule power contained in the Heaven Divine Shadow Talisman, otherwise, you can only wait for rescue.”
“Lastly, this is the True King Beast Seal, from that True King of Berlin. It can defend against all kinds of curses, and unless a Demon God-level being strikes, nothing can harm you.”
Looking at the four forbidden artifacts in the box, bestowed by Supreme Experts, Jack Clark’s expression turned very serious.
This was the Federation’s recognition of his status as the ‘number one genius’ of this generation, the forbidden artifacts created by the strongest three experts, encompassing offense, curses, teleportation, and life substitution.
Especially the Rebirth Soul Crystal, which even came from a Mythical Giant Beast.
If Jack Clark still fell before reaching king-level with such preparations, one could only say that his fate was sealed.
Seeing Jack Clark lost in thought, Marcellus Larry was pleased with his reaction and then smiled, “Next, you’re about to enter the mythical world, right?”
“Right.” Jack Clark nodded.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is in hibernation, and upon awakening, it will become a Mythical Giant Beast.
But the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon also has six… no, seven talents that need to be enhanced to the God Transformation Level, plus his own two talents, which require a massive amount of attribute points.
Therefore, he needed to enter the mythical world soon to hunt those Unique Beasts above Level 7 and obtain Life Crystals.
Although the Tiger Whale Army led by the Horned Lady was also collecting crystals in the ocean, there are actually not as many high-level mutant beasts in the Blue Star Ocean as one might imagine.
And relying solely on hunting ordinary Mutated Creatures for low-level life crystals would take a lot of time, and could only be a backup plan.
After all, even leeks need time to grow, and there are not many in the Tiger Whale Army.
Sensing the determination in Jack Clark’s eyes, Marcellus Larry did not attempt to dissuade him but simply reminded, “Remember, only a living genius is a genius.”
…
The next morning.
At the train station platform by the Frontline Small Town, Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis, and Jane Aiken, who had been in closed-door cultivation for several days, appeared to see off Jack Clark.
Justin Welan slapped Jack Clark on the shoulder and chuckled, “Jack, be careful when you go there. I’m counting on you to become a king so I can ride on your coattails.”
Jack Clark smiled, “Don’t worry, soon you will be able to proudly tell others that the latest king-level strong man to ascend to the throne is your brother.”
Just then, Justin Welan suddenly said, “Oh right, Jack, if you have time, remember to come back for the opening ceremony of the new semester on September 3rd.”
“…Why would I come back for the opening ceremony?” Jack Clark paused.
September 3rd, by that time, he would be at least at Nine Layers, or perhaps even have made a breakthrough to king-level. What would he still be doing at school by then?
To return in glory?
Justin Welan said proudly, “Of course, to show off. By then, I’m sure I will have broken through to Sixth Layer. Right after attending the freshmen’s ceremony, I’ll enter the mythical world.”
“At that time, my first-year Sixth Layer cultivation will surely shock everyone, including Teacher James Crane. Haha, just thinking about it feels great.”
At that moment, Crystal Lewis interjected softly, “First-year Sixth Layer is indeed impressive, but if Jack Clark returns, do you think anyone will still notice you?”
Suddenly, the smile on Justin Welan’s face stiffened.
Right, why did he ask Jack Clark to come back? With that guy around, no one could show off.
While Justin Welan appeared regretful, Mandy Lewis said gently with a smile, “Jack Clark, be careful when you go there. We are all waiting to witness the day you ascend to the throne.”
Jack Clark nodded, his tone confident, “That day will come, and it will come soon.”
Jane Aiken looked at Jack Clark and said calmly, “I should be entering the mythical world in about half a month, joining the Frontier Section 30th Legion.”
“…30th Army Group, are the people you’re going to kill within the Divine Gods Alliance territory?” Jack Clark paused for a moment.
The Frontier Section has a long line of defense, with four Corps guarding in four different directions, and the 30th Army Group faces those king-level powers that have left the Human Race to establish the Divine Gods Alliance.
Among them, there are several Evil God Sects established by the Evil Gods.
Jane Aiken nodded, “It should be there.”
Jack Clark considered and then said, “If you need help at the time, let me know.”
Jane Aiken once said her cultivation goal was to kill a person; clearly, since the target is hiding in the Divine Gods Alliance, they are not up to any good.
As such, being classmates and friends, Jack Clark wouldn’t hesitate to lend a hand if needed.
The girl’s face revealed a faint smile as she nodded slightly.
Woo woo woo!!
At that moment, a deep train horn sounded in the distance, followed by a booming vibration coming from Base No.1. A white train burst out of the Silver Vortex.
Meanwhile, on the other side, amidst the endless grey fog, a blue train spanning several kilometers appeared, arriving before Jack Clark and the others with a terrifying might, as it rumbled into place.
“The Sky Way Train has arrived at the station, please proceed to Carriage No.1 for any Special Forces Soldiers who have applied to enter the mythical world. No talking is allowed on board.”
Standing before the slowly opening huge door, Jack Clark turned and waved to Justin Welan and the others, “Mr. Willard, Class Leader, Mandy Lewis, and Student Aiken, I’ll see you in the mythical world.”
Having said that, Jack Clark turned and boarded the train.
As he crossed the threshold, an invisible wave of light swept over him.
“Name, Jack Clark, True Power Fluctuation, Mental Fluctuation, verification complete…” Accompanying the electronic voice was the gradual closing of the door.
Simultaneously, on the opposite side, the streets and rooftops of the small town were filled with people, watching the train slowly start to accelerate, bidding farewell to Jack Clark.
Before long, the blue train carrying Jack Clark and countless ammunitions supplies rushed into the Silver Vortex like a giant dragon stretching thousands of kilometers, with a thunderous roar.
Looking at the shimmering Silver Vortex in the distant sky, Justin Welan and the others inexplicably felt like Jack Clark’s departure was akin to a dragon taking to the sea or a tiger embarking on a high mountain.
Standing above the base, Marcellus Larry stood with his hands behind his back, anticipation flickering in his eyes.
This genius, who had shocked everyone and impressed the Supreme Experts, was heading into the mythical world. It was unknown what kind of radiance he would display there.

chapters.title: Chapter 787: 345 The Beginning of Myth, The Monster in Hibernation
chapters.content:
Chapter 787: Chapter 345 The Beginning of Myth, The Monster in Hibernation
Right as the train entered the vortex, Jack Clark felt a powerful compressive force.
However, compared to the Deep Sea Tunnel, the pressure of this vortex was much lighter and very stable, as if the train were shuttling through a tunnel of flowing light.
The train quickly shot out of the world passageway, instantly changing the view outside the window.
The train, resembling a blue dragon, glowed as it stirred up a raging wind, hanging 2 meters above the ground and speeding along as base buildings on either side receded into the distance.
It was still night in the mythical world, but under the silver moon and the streetlights between buildings, one could see many mechanical pieces of equipment in operation, producing.
At the same time, in the distance above, fighter aircraft brimming with a sci-fi style kept taking off and landing, with some transporters even having wingspans over a hundred meters.
These transporters, bearing runes on their surfaces during takeoff, had anti-air weapons mounted on their wings and bellies, and were accompanied by flying giant beasts with wingspans over a hundred meters as well.
A top these flying giant beasts stood cultivators clad in battle armor, providing an escort.
In the distant darkness, mountain ranges undulated, with colossal ancient trees standing like mountain peaks, hundreds or even thousands of meters tall.
Within these towering forests, one could vaguely make out Giant Beasts over fifty meters long covered in grey scale armor, resembling massive rhinos, and making their homes there.
Meanwhile, inside the train carriage, Jack Clark felt an ancient and desolate Heavenly Energy wash over him, its concentration dozens or even hundreds of times that of Mist River City.
Although his Giant Beast Avatar had previously entered the mythical world, in comparison to the Doomsday-like Black Oblivion Territory, the Human Race’s Territory was brimming with vitality and the aura of civilization.
As Jack Clark curiously surveyed the outside world, the train thundered through tens of kilometers and finally came to a slow stop at the station on the other side of the passageway city.
“We have arrived at Mythical City No.1. Please, those passengers needing to disembark should do so in an orderly manner. The train’s next stop will be at Sky Curtain Battlefield, departing in ten minutes.”
Following the electronic announcement, the doors of over ten carriages at the front of the train opened, and hundreds of young and middle-aged individuals disembarked, each emanating the aura of advanced cultivators.
Clearly, Jack Clark was not the only one taking this train.
After these people left the train, more than a dozen 5-meter-long flying cars with glowing yellow runes underneath appeared in the distance, with people on the cars shouting loudly.
“Those heading to Assembly Department of Fourth District, get on the car, and hurry up.”
“Over here, those who applied for Missile Inscription Engineering.”
“This way to the Beast Material Smelting Department…”
Just as Jack Clark watched this scene curiously, a diamond-shaped white fighter with a wingspan of more than twenty meters, bearing the Crossed Double Swords Emblem, descended from the sky and landed at the temporary airport in the distance.
Whoosh! The canopy of the fighter opened, and down stepped a handsome young man more beautiful than a woman, who blinked several times to the platform and greeted with a slight smile.
“Brother Callum, long time no see.”
“Mr. Gail,” Jack Clark replied with some surprise, not expecting Hannah Gail to be the one to meet him.
At this moment, Hannah Gail’s aura was even stronger, and Heavenly Energy naturally gathered around him, vaguely forming several indistinct white fox tails.
In just over two months, with a Bloodline Awakening, he who just needed a step to break through to Seventh Layer Peak had already made a breakthrough to Eight Layer Heaven.
Hannah Gail smiled and said, “Brother Callum, let’s hop onto the fighter aircraft. The Exploration Department is a few hours away from here.”
“Alright,” Jack Clark nodded.
Unlike Marcellus Larry’s spacious interior of the King’s Exclusive Fighter, Hannah Gail’s fighter belonged to the standard Energy Warplane.
Half of the interior space was used to load weapons and ammunition, and the narrow living area had only several seats separated from the cockpit by a small distance.
Vroom! Accompanied by the hot blast from the engines below and the powerful anti-gravity thrust, the fighter aircraft soared into the sky and quickly climbed to an altitude of tens of thousands of meters.
Above the clouds, transporters blinking with signal lights were occasionally overtaken by the fighter.
Hannah Gail, who was sitting in the pilot’s seat and had set the cruiser for a programmed flight, asked, “Brother Callum, you must have looked over the information about the mythical world before coming here, right?”
Jack Clark, sitting in the co-pilot seat, nodded, “I’ve seen the basic introduction material.”
“That’s good. Then there’s no need for me to elaborate,” Hannah Gail said with a smile.
The current territory of the three major empires, along with over a dozen medium-sized countries that control world passageways, all fall under Federation control.
This territory overall resembled a horn-shaped cylinder, around twenty thousand kilometers in length and fifteen thousand kilometers at its widest, riddled with various danger zones.
At the same time, this region was a natural perilous terrain. The Boundaries on either side were World Fragmented Regions that even Heavenly Kings found difficult to cross, blocking the Human Race while keeping the enemies out as well.
The Frontline Battlefield facing the Purgatory Family spanned over ten thousand kilometers, with its center separated by many places where king-level experts might perish.
The Exploration Department was situated at the rear of the horn-shaped cylinder, where the stride was also several thousand kilometers long.
This area was scattered with various danger zones. Only four relatively stable entrances were used by the Expedition Division’s four armys’ bases to slowly probe and explore the regions.
Currently, the space between the Frontline Battlefield and the Expedition Division spanning a range similar to the size of Blue Star had been mostly explored by the Federation, including the relics and resources.
Moreover, the dangerous high-rank Behemoths, even Mythical Giant Beasts, had been swept by joint efforts of Human Experts, ensuring that the rear area was relatively safe.
Of course, this ‘safe’ is a relative term that applies to High-Ranking Powerhouses.
Due to the Mutated Beasts reproducing too quickly, the rear area currently had only specific train routes and flying transportation routes that were considered safe zones.

chapters.title: Chapter 788: 345 The Beginning of Myth, The Monster in Hibernation_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 788: Chapter 345 The Beginning of Myth, The Monster in Hibernation_2
Once an ordinary senior cultivator stepped beyond the designated area, they might be devoured by mutated beasts lurking in the vast forest.
At that moment, the fighter aircraft suddenly slowed down, as boundless black clouds spread out in front, and a look of solemnity crossed Hannah Gail’s face.
“That stretch of black clouds covers an area of more than 1,000 kilometers, it’s a dangerous zone of space distortion, the black fog can shield both spirit perception and sight, very mysterious,”
“Apart from the king-level individuals who initially explored and emerged from it, curious cultivators, as well as those mutated beasts, have never returned once they entered,”
Instantly, Jack Clark’s expression grew tense.
This was the horror of the mythical world, filled with all kinds of perilous places, where curiosity or a misstep could mean never returning.
Soon, the fighter aircraft passed the edge of that black fog area and arrived above an endless forest, with sky-touching trees standing tall.
Roar, roar, roar!! Ferocious roars were heard intermittently from the forest.
Whoosh! Just then, a flock of mutated birds with wingspans of over thirty meters appeared in the high altitude, and upon seeing the fighter aircraft, they issued sharp cries and shot towards it.
“Seeking death,” Sinclair Moore’s gaze was cold.
Hannah Gail had no need to control the fighter aircraft as its automatic defense firepower activated, energy weapons on its wings instantly shooting beams of light that pierced through the night sky.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!!
Under the powerful laser weapons, those Level 4 and Level 5 mutated birds were killed in the blink of an eye, their smashed corpses falling from the sky.
In the mythical world where heavenly energy was dense, these technology and rune-infused fighter aircraft and weapons were even more powerful.
The fighter aircraft quickly passed the forest, and up ahead were mountain peaks towering tens of thousands of meters high, piercing through the clouds and resembling islands drifting in the cloud sea under the moonlight.
Boom! Raging wind suddenly howled from the left side of the aircraft as a thousand-meter-long dragon statue, made entirely of rock, spiraled through the high altitude.
“This mountain range is an ancient relic, but that civilization has been extinct for tens of thousands of years, leaving only some weathered fragments.”
“What just flew past is a giant stone statue with special power, very strong, it’s a guardian of that now dissipated relic,”
“However, as long as we don’t enter the central area of the mountain ranges, these giant statues won’t react unless attacked,”
Speaking of this, Hannah Gail became somewhat sentimental, “The mythical world is boundless, not only teeming with giant beasts and the Demon Clan but also filled with many forbidden areas and relics, both dangerous and mysterious,”
“Our human knowledge of the area is just a tiny fraction of this vast expanse, that’s why I chose to join the Exploration Department, to uncover its mysteries bit by bit,”
However, as he spoke, Hannah Gail’s eyes rested on Jack Clark with a puzzled look.
“Mr. Gail, why are you looking at me like that?” Jack was somewhat puzzled.
Hannah Gail hesitantly said, “Strange, I feel as though in just this short period of time, Brother Callum, you seem to have become a lot stronger.”
In Hannah Gail’s bloodline perception, the dangerous aura emanating from Jack was getting stronger, as if his strength was constantly growing.
Jack smiled, “Mr. Gail, you must be mistaken, I’m just sitting here not cultivating, how could I possibly get stronger?”
“Then it must be my mistake,” nodded Hannah Gail, but his eyes betrayed a hint of suspicion.
On the way here, Hannah Gail had seen Jack’s file and knew that he had broken through to the Eighth Layer Early Phase.
But when they first met, the oppressive feeling Jack gave off was clearly not as strong as it was now.
In fact, Hannah Gail’s intuition was not wrong. In the time he was talking with Jack, Jack’s physique had indeed strengthened significantly, becoming increasingly terrifying.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon underwent its evolutionary transformation, Jack’s physical body was also growing stronger every moment.
Three days had passed, with the strongest force having soared from 1.5218 to 1.8454, which is more than 18,000 points, almost like gaining over 1,000 points every day.
Under such a frightening rate of increase, Jack’s strength was growing drastically by the moment, causing some of his aura to leak out.
Meanwhile, as Jack flew towards the Exploration Department.
Beneath the deep sea, the hibernating Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had evolved its Gifted Power into a rule, continuously tempering itself, which resulted in its physique growing from over 320 meters to more than 350 meters.
The enormous body lay horizontally on the ground, and with the height of its dorsal fin nearly reaching 100 meters, its long and sharp tail looked like a city wall entrenched, exuding a sense of oppression.
Besides, wrapped around the black and red colossal beast was black lightning that emitted a terrifying destructive aura, each leap leaving behind dark traces in the air.
Amidst those thick black and red scales, there was a faint flow of golden light, exuding an aura of indestructibility and invincibility.
Following the Fifth Evolution and transformation, life undergoing a leap, with a breakthrough in level, the aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon became more and more terrifying, as though it were a doomsday beast in slumber.
In front of the present Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a silver giant dragon that was less than 170 meters in length looked completely like a child.
Red flames formed by consuming a top-tier Black Melting Divine Fruit blazed on the body of the silver giant dragon.
Around it, more than a dozen huge blue and white scales floated, radiating a dreadful oppression that deterred all directions.
“Roar! So boring, Great Scythia wants to see rivers of blood,” complained the giant dragon currently absorbing the energy of the Divine Fruit, as it lazed on the ground, sweeping its tail back and forth.
Meanwhile, several kilometers away on the pitch-black seabed, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, both engulfed in hibernation, were undergoing transformation, their auras growing stronger.
At the same time on the sea surface, that black and white alternating area covering a kilometer seemed to freeze time itself, with waves several meters high remaining static in midair.
While the main forces of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Force were in the midst of hibernation and breakthrough,
the ocean surface, over two thousand kilometers away, surged with waves as a 60-meter-long, pitch-black mutated Tiger Whale swam beneath the surface.
At the side of the black Tiger Whale, a ‘small’ Tiger Whale, almost thirty meters in length, followed closely. Its sleek, black and white patterned form was exceptionally beautiful.
A look of confusion appeared in the eyes of the female Tiger Whale Kitty: Roar! Boss, didn’t we need to prepare crystals for the king? Why have we come here?
Pride shone in Tiger Whale Third Brother’s eyes.
Roar! This is the territory of another Mythological Giant Beast. We’ve come here first to scout out some information. Once Uncle wakes up, we’ll kill them.
Roar! Boss, how do you know that Thunderflame Dragon King will attack this Mythological Giant Beast power?
The female Tiger Whale looked confused, unaware of why their leader was so certain that Thunderflame Dragon King would wage war against another Mythological Beast Empire.
After all, there was a powerful and boundless Mythical Giant Beast in residence there.
The black Tiger Whale’s fins fluttered slightly, emitting a complacent cry.
Roar! Because Scythia Dragon King wants to unite the ocean, so Uncle will definitely take action, for Uncle is very fond of Scythia Dragon King.
Roar! You came late, Little Kitty, so you don’t know that the Black Oblivion King’s Mythical Giant Beast died because its messenger scorned Scythia Dragon King.
That quasi-mythical beast called Troy had no foresight, merely telling Uncle to submit, without mentioning Scythia Dragon King, which angered it greatly.
How dare they scorn the Great Scythia Dragon King! It’s unforgivable. After Uncle’s strength had a breakthrough, he went straight over and killed it.
That battle saw not only the Mythical Giant Beast slain but also Scythia Dragon King destroying its subordinates’ civilization, rivers running with blood, and the whole world becoming a doomsday scene.
Roar! Wow! Thunderflame Dragon King is so indulgent with Scythia! The eyes of the female Tiger Whale immediately showed envy.
The huge fin of the black Tiger Whale patted the female Tiger Whale: Roar! Don’t worry, Little Kitty, I dote on you too. If anyone dares to bully you, I’ll bite them to death.
Roar!
As the female Tiger Whale nestled up to his side, the black Tiger Whale’s eyes showed a look of pride.
Hum! What’s the use of being a hard worker like Big Brother and Second Brother? As a whale, one must learn to use their brains or else spend their life toiling away.
At that moment, the shadow of a beast more than 50 meters in length loomed ahead, instantly sparking interest in the eyes of Tiger Whale Third Brother, who flicked his tail and swam up to greet it.
Roar! Brother, brother, hello, can we be friends?

chapters.title: Chapter 789: 346: Jack Hegemon, Blood of Demon God
chapters.content:
Chapter 789: Chapter 346: Jack Hegemon, Blood of Demon God
Under the dim night, a black castle stood tall upon the land.
In the castle, a figure over five meters tall sat on the throne, surrounded by roiling black demonic qi, exuding the terrifying pressure of a Demon King level.
Flanking either side were more than a dozen burly figures clad in dark red battle armor, sporting curved, ferocious horns and pitch-black, sharp tails, very much resembling Mikus from before.
At the main seat, Demon King Devianna’s deep voice rang out, “Half of the Silent Night has passed. Is there any news about the Human Race’s Darren Callum?”
On the left below, a Purgatory True Demon that appeared small among the many Nine-layered Demon Clans bowed slightly, respectfully saying, “Reporting to Demon King, there is still no news received as of now.”
Devianna’s eyebrows twitched slightly, “Still no news? Could it be that Darren has not entered the Vast World but is hiding and growing behind the Human Race’s lines?”
The slight Purgatory True Demon pondered for a moment, “That shouldn’t be the case. The nurturing methods of the Human Race are different from ours. Their Aristocratic Level fresh blood quickly enters the Vast World.”
“To those from the primordial worlds, plagued by scarcity, it’s only within the resource-abundant, stable Heavenly Earth Rules of the Vast World that they can grow faster.”
“If there is no news at the moment, it’s likely that those humans who have come into contact with our clan are not of high enough rank, or due to their location at the periphery, these people find it difficult to obtain important intelligence in a timely manner.”
“Of course, there’s also a possibility that the conditions our clan offered are not enticing enough for them to take the risk.”
“Those humans are extremely greedy and crafty, always cautious when dealing with our clan, desiring precious resources yet afraid of exposure.”
At this point, a cold smile appeared on the face of the slender demon, “Unfortunately, they don’t realize that once they take our clan’s resources, there’s no turning back.”
Devianna pondered for a moment before saying in a deep voice, “Tell them that whoever can provide accurate intelligence on Darren Callum will receive a portion of the Blood of the Demon God.”
“The Blood of the Demon God, my lord, won’t this be too cheap for those humans?” All the True Demons below showed shaken expressions, their eyes filled with longing.
The Blood of the Demon God, although named after the Demon God, is actually a divine object of life evolution concocted by the Purgatory Demon Race using countless Giant Beasts and other lives as materials.
Beings other than the Demon Clan that absorb it can transform into Purgatory True Demons, purify their bloodlines, obtain a leap in life hierarchy, and become top-tier Nobles with the potential of a demon king.
Even those of them with Nine Demonic Marks can make use of it.
However, the creation of the Blood of the Demon God is extremely difficult; even the Dark Demon Empire can only concoct it once every hundred Day and Night Alternations, and there’s so little that ordinary demon clan powerhouses simply aren’t eligible to partake.
“Not only Darren, but tell those humans that if they provide useful intelligence on human geniuses and king-level descendents, the reward will be tripled.”
Devianna refused to believe that with such high rewards, those greedy humans could resist the temptation.
…
After passing through many hazardous areas and flying for over four hours, Jack Clark finally arrived at the Seventh Legion’s garrison of the Development Department.
Under the dark night, a divine tree tens of kilometers high stood erect, reaching into the clouds with its layered crown stretching over tens of kilometers, blotting out the sun and moon.
But at this time, this Sky-touching Tree radiated silver brilliance, with leaves that seemed to gather moonlight from above, converging into a halo that illuminated the surrounding heaven and earth.
Even Jack couldn’t help but marvel at this sight, “It is said that this Moonlight Divine Tree is comparable to a King-level strong man.”
Gwen Gail smiled and nodded, “That’s right, Lord Silverglow is a special lifeform, neither tree nor something else, possessing tremendous power within the scope of its silver glow.”
While talking, the fighter aircraft approached rapidly, and upon entering the range illuminated by the silver brilliance, an invisible fluctuation swept over the aircraft.
Whoosh! The aircraft darted through massive branches and finally landed gently in a ‘square’ made of silver leaves in the middle of the tree.
Around them, fighter aircraft were constantly landing or taking off, showing a buzz of activity.
At the same time, a special ‘city’ built around the tree’s midsection came into Jack’s view.
“Hahaha… come and chase me, little one.”
“Wait for me, Dog Egg…”
Walking on a road built on the trunk of the tree, wide enough for several tens of meters with traffic coming and going in the middle and super soldiers wearing battle armor and carrying weapons on the pedestrian walkways on both sides.
Jack’s gaze swept over those special ‘vehicles’ and the ‘elevators’ continuously moving up and down in the distance, feeling somewhat puzzled, “Mr. Gail, isn’t it said that technological products suffer serious erosion here?”
Although Jack had reviewed information about the mythical world before coming, that data mainly described the customs and culture of the mythical world in a general sense.
For example, the Seventh Legion of the Development Department was simply introduced as established within a divine tree comparable to a Mythical King.
Faced with Jack’s confusion, Hannah Gail explained, “Pure technological electronics do indeed suffer severe erosion under the rich heavenly energy, but that doesn’t mean they cannot be used.”
“After decades of research, we have achieved a preliminary combination of technology and inscriptions. By adding special runes and talents to those mechanical devices, we can reduce the erosion intensity.”
“However, many precision instruments and electronic components still need to be manufactured first in the Blue Star World, endowed with a protective layer of runes, before they can be brought here.”
“Besides, in this situation, our demand for energy-conductive minerals and materials increases every day, to perfect the civilizational construction of each base.”
“However, while developing vigorously, population has become the biggest constraint at present.”

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 346 The Arrogance of Darren Callum, Blood of Demon God_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 790 - 346 The Arrogance of Darren Callum, Blood of Demon God_2
Jack Clark pondered, "Population, you mean we don't have enough cultivators."
Hannah Gail nodded, "Exactly. Although the method for body casting has become widespread, resulting in an explosion in the base number of cultivators in the last decade, we've expanded to more than ten million overall."
"Over ten million cultivators, but only just over three million are recorded as having reached or surpassed the Foundation Establishment stage, and that includes those in the military who cultivate only their Qi Blood for operating firepower equipment, standard soldiers."
"Besides, three million might sound like a lot, but excluding a portion stationed within Blue Star's Inner World maintaining order, only about three million enter the mythical world."
"Out of these three millions, a part is allocated for logistics maintenance, production, mineral and resource excavation, so only about two million are actually on the front lines."
"These soldiers are then divided among thirty-one army corps, where each one can barely muster seventy thousand, and most of them are Senior ordinary soldiers."
"However, don't look down on our Human Race army because of the numbers; in combination with the Mecha Corps, short-range drones, unmanned fortresses, and long-range firepower strikes as a multi-faceted approach, we fear not even the mighty Purgatory Demon Race on the battlefield."
"The strain on logistics is considerable due to these measures, so there's continuous heavy mining for minerals and resources, requiring many to work in production and management."
Jack nodded, his gaze falling on some kids playing in the distance, "So those are part of the Federation's population program?"
Hannah affirmed, "Exactly, those children are called new humans, descendants of cultivators who have been stationed here for long periods. They are born, grow up, and learn in the mythical world."
"Just that..."
At this point, Hannah showed a bitter smile, "Whether it's the World Rules or something about the mythical world itself, these children have very stable talents, just like the creatures from the mythical world."
"Their physiques at birth already meet the standards for Foundation Establishment. After the age of five, they are comparable to First Layer Heaven, and every one of them can perform True Martial Cultivation. Initially, under the rich Heavenly Energy, they progress quickly."
"But as soon as they break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven, their cultivation progression slows down tremendously, infuriatingly slow."
Jack raised an eyebrow, "Is it because of issues related to the Spiritual Will?"
After the Fourth Layer Heaven, cultivators have to not only absorb Heavenly Energy and transform it into True Strength but also temper their will, merging spirit and True Strength to gradually comprehend Heaven and Earth.
"Precisely."
Hannah nodded, "Those born in the mythical world have very stable spiritual wills, as unwieldy as those Mutated Creatures, difficult to mobilize."
"Despite decades of trials, the strongest among the new humans has barely made a breakthrough to the high-order Eight Layer Heaven, let alone reached the Ninth Heavens or become a King-level strong man."
"However, these new humans do have their advantages. They have a significant edge when it comes to Body Refinement, with basic adult physiques reaching Fifth Layer or even Sixth Layer Heaven."
"But because it's only Body Refinement, merely having the physique, they are far outclassed in strength compared to peers who are Martial Arts Cultivators of the same level, so they mostly work in logistics, production, and management."
"However, since cultivators face difficulties in reproducing, after years of development, there are approximately more than five million new humans here in the mythical world."
"Nevertheless, the official research on the reproduction issue has continuously made some progress, and recently I've heard that there has been a breakthrough, which should accelerate the growth in numbers of new humans."
While they talked, the kids playing nearby cast curious glances at them.
Then the two came to a hollow formed by tree branches, and Hannah's surroundings were enveloped in a silver radiance as they surged toward the sky.
Whoosh Whoosh!!
They flew all the way up and soon arrived at the ten-thousand-meter-high clouds, where many office buildings were constructed between tree trunks tougher than alloy.
Among these buildings, Cloud Mist swirled around, and the radiance from the tree leaves glittered, akin to a fairyland.
Hannah introduced, "This is the office area of the Seventh Corps."
"The Exploration Department is divided into the inner and outer circles. Our Seventh Corps' inner circle extends over five thousand kilometers, encompassing areas that have been explored and are relatively safe."
"Regular soldiers from the army are responsible for clearing out the Mutant Beasts around Resource Points and mining sites to ensure the safety of transportation routes."
"And us, high-level cultivators, form pioneering teams responsible for exploring deeper into the outer circle, expanding the Human Territory."
As they spoke, Hannah led Jack around and eventually brought him to the top floor office, where a silver-haired youth was behind a desk, reviewing documents.
Hannah respectfully said, "Uncle, I've brought the person back."
Jack also greeted politely, "I've seen King Cyril."
The silver-haired youth put down the documents, gave a slight nod to Hannah, "You've worked hard, Hannah."
"Not at all, it's my duty."
The silver-haired youth looked at Jack, smiling, "Mr. Jack, no, around here you're just Jack. Elder Brother Larry has already briefed me, if you need anything while here just let me know."
The attitude of the silver-haired youth towards Jack made even Hannah envy.
Despite being a 'genius' who broke through to Eight Layer Heaven by his early twenties and awakening the bloodline of a Descendant of the King, he still did not dare to be negligent in front of these king-level strong men.
Below king-level and being a king are completely different concepts; unless one becomes a king, they do not have the right to be on equal footing with them.
As for geniuses, every year the Human Alliance produces heaps of cultivators who reach the Eight and Nine Layers Heaven, but almost none of them break through to king-level.

chapters.title: Chapter 791: 346: The Proud Hegemon Darren Callum, Blood of Demon God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 791: Chapter 346: The Proud Hegemon Darren Callum, Blood of Demon God_3
“`
Grasping a domain, comprehending and controlling rules is too difficult; it’s like a chasm in the sky.
The silver-haired youth asked in a gentle tone, “Jack, has Sinclair Moore already briefed you on the situation here? Are you planning to hone your skills in the inner circle or join the pioneering team?”
Jack Clark replied politely, “My goal this time is to temper myself and make an early breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens, so I plan to go deep into the outer circle to expand the territory for the Human Race.”
“However, Your Throne, I have always been accustomed to acting alone. Is it possible for me not to join a team?”
Due to safety reasons, the senior mutated organisms surrounding the Human Race had almost all been wiped out, so Jack Clark needed to venture deep into the mythical world to hunt down Giant Beasts above Level 7 extensively.
“With your strength, it is not impossible to act alone.”
The silver-haired youth thought for a moment: “But the mythical world is not the same as Blue Star. Since you just arrived, I think you could get to know the situation first before acting alone.”
“Just in time, the Spiritual Crystal Mine Point at the edge of the Imperial Capital Mountain Range has sent out a distress signal. Some mountain giants need to be dealt with after traces of them were discovered near the mountain ranges.”
“How about you first accompany Sinclair Moore’s team on a mission to familiarize yourself with the habits and combat of the mutated creatures here?”
Jack Clark did not refuse the silver-haired youth’s kindness and nodded politely, “No problem, I will follow Your Throne’s arrangements.”
Seeing that Jack Clark was willing to take advice, the silver-haired youth’s face involuntarily broke into a smile. His greatest fear was dealing with an untamed genius monster, which would have been more troublesome.
So far, he seemed no different from what the files described—humble, steady, good.
After getting information about the mission from the silver-haired youth, Hannah Gail led Jack Clark out of the Office Building.
“The mythical world under the night is very dangerous, akin to a long night of ten days where accidents could happen at any time, especially when a Blood Moon could appear anytime.”
“Normally, we would not act at night unless there’s an emergency, like this one.”
“For communication, we use rune signal towers established at key points to transmit information over short distances.”
“Because of the suppression in the sky, satellites can’t be sent up. If they’re too low, they might be destroyed by mutated birds, so more convenient satellite transmission is not feasible.”
“But the ground signal towers are also often destroyed by Unique Beasts, requiring regular maintenance to keep in communication with the Resource Points at all times, ready to provide reinforcement.”
While talking, the two reached the other side of the platform, where many rooms had been built, and high-level cultivators emanating the Aura of the Seventh Layer could often be seen coming and going.
Inside the office point with the ’19th group’ sign, four men and women exuding the presence of High-Ranking Powerhouses and wearing battle armor were talking.
At that moment, Hannah Gail entered with Jack Clark.
Looking at Jack Clark behind Hannah Gail, a red-haired youth curiously asked, “Vice-Captain, is this little brother the person you went to pick up?”
“Yes.”
Hannah Gail nodded and continued, “I just received a mission from King Cyril to deal with mountain giants that have appeared on the edge of the Imperial Capital Mountain Range.”
At once, their expressions changed ever so slightly. A mature, woman with curly long hair asked, “Sinclair, what’s the strength of these mountain giants and how many are there?”
“The data says there are three at level eight and nine at level seven, but we need to investigate further for more detailed information,” Hannah Gail answered conservatively.
“Three at level eight should be manageable.”
Excitement appeared on their faces because successfully completing such a cleanup mission meant a substantial amount of Merit Value.
Hannah Gail smiled and said, “By the way, before we set off, let me introduce everyone.”
“Brother Callum, the guy over there with red hair and fine scales on his face is Reginald Vinson. He comes from Berlin—crest of the Seventh Layer of Heaven, proficient in stealth tracking.”
“The carefree one over there is Gentry Levin, mid-stage of the seventh realm, and only twenty-three years old. He is a genius expected to break through to the Ninth Heavens.”
The silver-haired youth said with a grin, “Thanks for the praise, Vice-Captain. But my goal is to be a king-level.”
“That’s a good ambition.”
Hannah Gail laughed and continued, “This gorgeous beauty is Cathie Lawson, twenty-nine years old, a high-order practitioner of the Eight Layer realm, and also the captain of Group 19.”
The mature woman with curly hair trailing down her back spoke playfully, “Little Brother Callum, don’t listen to Sinclair’s nonsense, I just turned twenty this year.”
Uh… Twenty plus over a hundred months, perhaps? Jack Clark looked bemused.
“The quiet one is Sibyl Millan, mid-stage of the Seventh Layer realm, awakened with spatial talents and abilities, very strong.”
After introducing everyone, Hannah Gail patted Jack Clark on the shoulder, “This is Darren Callum, Brother Callum.
“Pfft! Darren Callum, am I sure I heard that right?” Gentry Levin almost choked on his saliva, and the other three also showed odd looks.
Because that name… was too unique.
Just then, Hannah Gail suddenly said, “I almost forgot to tell you all that although he’s only eighteen years old, Brother Callum’s cultivation has already reached the early stage of Eight Layer.”
As he continued to use the name Darren Callum, Jack Clark outwardly appeared to still be eighteen years old.
Even so, this revelation startled them, and Gentry Levin even jumped up from his chair, exclaiming, “What, eighteen years old!”
Reginald Vinson swallowed hard, incredulous: “An Eight Layer at eighteen years of age—is this some kind of joke?!”
“Ha ha… Are you all shocked? Don’t say you guys, even I was taken aback when I first heard it,” Hannah Gail laughed.
He was not kidding. Before heading to the pathway city to pick up Jack Clark, Hannah Gail had also been shocked upon receiving the youth’s latest information.
After all, when he had met Jack Clark two months ago, he was only at the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage—breaking through to the Eight Layer in just two months was simply monstrous.
Jack Clark cleared his throat and modestly said, “You all don’t need to be shocked. I just cultivate a little faster than most, but in other respects, I can’t compare to you who have been battling in the mythical world for a long time.”
“So, it’s just that you cultivate a bit faster,” the four of them nodded, pretending to understand.
Understand my foot. Back when they were at school, they were considered some of the top-tier geniuses, but what were their realms when they were eighteen?
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 792: 347: Your Gaze Is Off, Give Them a Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 792: Chapter 347: Your Gaze Is Off, Give Them a Shock
“The Imperial Capital Mountain Range is an energy vein discovered three years ago, containing abundant energy crystals, which is why the Seventh Corps established a mining site there.”
“The site manager is at the pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven in cultivation, and the deputy manager is in the late period of the Seventh Layer; they both belong to the older generation of cultivators, aged over fifty.”
“These seniors have spent many years in the mythical world and possess a wealth of experience, but at the same time, they’ve lost the fervor of the past, so many have chosen to guard Resource Points.”
“And the exploration team that discovered the energy crystal mine a few years ago continues to receive a significant amount of Merit Value each month.”
In the dark of night, fighter aircraft flew at ten thousand meters altitude, with Hannah Gail inside the aircraft briefing Jack Clark on the information about the mountain ranges for this mission.
When talking about the monthly gains of that exploration team, Gentry Levin showed envy, “If we’re lucky enough to find an energy vein, that would be great.”
“Then we would have a steady stream of Merit Value and wouldn’t need to venture deep into the mythical world for adventures.”
Reginald Vinson said cheerfully, “I’m not asking for much; I’d be content if we could find a regenerating God-level Resource Point.”
“Damn, Vinson, you’re even greedier than me,” Gentry Levin flipped him off.
However, both of them weren’t entirely joking, because this is the mythical world, where resources are limitless.
Maybe the next time they delve into the mythical world, they’ll come across a treasure, like a Divine Object containing laws that can enable them to breakthrough a realm just by acquiring it.
Over the years, many cultivators with average talents who never thought they could break through to the Eight Layer Heaven or Nine Layers have ascended against all odds because they stumbled upon a Divine Object.
Besides that, uncovering relics, bringing back information from different race civilizations, or expanding new maps—there are rewards for all of these things from the Federation.
That includes, but is not limited to, discovering Resource Points and extraordinary energy mines. This is also the allure of the Exploration Department, attracting many high-level cultivators with adventuring spirits to continuously forge ahead into the future.
This exploration is not just for the Human Race but also for themselves.
At this moment, everyone was fully armed. Hannah Gail wore silver and white gorgeous armor, and the other members were similarly clad, including Jack Clark who was covered in Black-red armor.
However, the flames on the armor had receded.
Then, a delicate fragrance wafted over, and mature and charming Cathie Lawson suddenly leaned in, gazing curiously at Jack Clark’s handsome profile, she whispered,
“Brother Callum, can you tell Sister Cathie how you managed to break through the Eight Layer Heaven at eighteen?”
Suddenly, everyone except Sinclair Moore turned their curious gazes to him.
Seeing this, Jack Clark pondered for a moment, “Actually, my cultivation talent was average at first. It took me half a month to reach Foundation Establishment, and I was only practicing low-level martial arts.”
“What, Brother Callum, you started with low-level martial arts when you first began cultivation at school?” Reginald Vinson was a bit stunned.
Jack Clark nodded, “Yes, but after I began cultivating True Martial Arts at Foundation Establishment, I felt that my cultivation speeds increased. And then, I just broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven.”
“…I can’t believe it, Mr. Jack actually started with low-level martial arts,” Cathie Lawson’s eyes flickered with amazement.
“Impressive,” the small-framed, quiet woman Sibyl Millan also said.
They had assumed that Jack Clark must have had extraordinary talents from the start, the kind of prodigy who receives substantial resources upon enrollment for cultivation.
It turned out he started with low-level martial arts.
They were also aware of the current Federal School’s training system: the higher the talent, the more resources one gets upon enrollment.
With Jack Clark taking half a month to reach Foundation Establishment and only able to cultivate low-level martial arts, he had far fewer resources than the top-notch geniuses, putting him at a significant disadvantage from the start.
The fact that he managed to reach the Eight Layer Heaven before graduation is almost unimaginable; it’s as if he’s been defying the odds step by step.
While Cathie Lawson and the others appeared impressed and shocked, Sinclair Moore felt these words seemed familiar.
That’s right, this guy claimed to have fought ‘to a standstill’ with him during their match in the Hundred Foxes Nation and mentioned something similar over dinner that night.
While everyone was still in shock, Jack Clark modestly said, “Actually, breaking through the Eight Layer Heaven at eighteen isn’t as extraordinary as you all think. For example, Eddy Keller from the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy broke through the Eight Layer just a week ago.”
“In addition, there’s an Innate Awakened One on the Northern Battlefield who’s only a sophomore and has already reached the mid-stage of the seventh realm. Because of some special reasons, that guy might break through to the Eight Layer in another two months.”
“There’s also this guy Balderas from Berlin, who I met last month—he was already in the late period of Seventh Layer, close to the pinnacle, and will probably break through the Eight Layer soon.”
There’s actually another one, Brudos, this mysterious and low-key guy has also started on the Road of Heavenly Kings. After a big gain in the relic, he should be able to break through to the Eighth Layer Heaven soon.
But Jack Clark didn’t mention this person, as after the relic event, the Nether Heavenly King tampered with everyone’s memories, erasing all information about Brudos in the process.
After all, that guy’s identity was special too.
Even so, Reginald Vinson and the others were once again baffled, feeling a mixture of shock and bewilderment.
What’s going on, have they, the ‘older’ crowd, become obsolete? Is it now standard for students to break through to the Eight Layer before graduation?
Otherwise, where did all these freaks come from?
As everyone was absorbed in their surprise, the fighter aircraft flew over several dangerous zones, and after roughly two hours, it arrived at a mountain range rich in Heavenly Energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 793: 347 Your Gaze Is Off, Give Them a Shock_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 793: Chapter 347 Your Gaze Is Off, Give Them a Shock_2
Flying among the sky-touching trees and undulating mountain ranges, the fighter aircraft plunged down after crossing several ten-thousand-meter peaks, passing through an invisible barrier and instantly becoming enveloped in brilliant light.
Below, the valley was brightly lit, and amidst the thunderous vibrations, more than a dozen machines resembling crusher machines, several tens of meters in size, operated continuously, breaking apart rocks and carving through mountains.
In front of the massive rotating gears of those crusher machines, hard rocks were continually shattered, almost leveling an entire mountain range to the ground amid billowing smoke and dust.
Meanwhile, in the nearby mineral processing factory, many staff were busy separating the rich energy crystals from the ore and collecting them.
Beyond that, within a ten-kilometer radius of the valley, numerous defense facilities had been constructed, including thick, black gun barrels, missile launchers, and firepower bunkers.
Surrounding these defenses, Special Forces Soldiers exuding auras of the Fifth Layer Heaven and Sixth Layer Heaven patrolled armed with weapons, guarding against any potential Mutated Creatures.
On their backs, they carried heavy cold weapons, and in their hands, they held guns several meters long, with gun barrels twenty centimeters in diameter, inscribed with glowing runes.
In the rich mythical world of Heaven and Earth, these gun technologies infused with inscriptions wielded even greater power, equipped with specialized armor-piercing and incendiary bullets capable of instantly killing Unique Beasts of the fifth and sixth levels.
After all, even the strongest of transcendental powers had limits. As long as the charge was large enough and the caliber big enough, technological weapons could still inflict damage and even kill.
As for energy weapons, due to the vast amounts of energy they consumed with each strike, they were not suitable for mass distribution.
Hoo hoo!!
With a blast of scorching air, the fighter aircraft slowly stopped on the designated airport space, and then the hatch opened, with Jack Clark following Hannah Gail and others down.
Approaching from not far away, a burly man with a rough face walked over to two people and said gravely, “Captain Lawson, we’re troubling you with this matter.”
Hannah Gail directly asked, “How is the situation, Mine Owner Neal, have those mountain giants shown any unusual movements?”
“Currently, there is no sign of movement, but we dare not approach too closely due to our insufficient strength.”
“Do you have any video footage?”
“Yes, please follow me.”
As they spoke, the group walked towards a small building located far off, quickly arriving at the surveillance department where the walls were adorned with four large display screens flickering with over thirty screens.
“Within tens of kilometers surrounding the energy mine, we have placed dozens of Surveillance Cameras as relay points for information transformation; nine hours ago, we detected the appearance of those mountain giants…”
With the operation by the burly man, one of the display screens transitioned its image to reveal over a dozen creatures, each standing over forty meters tall, the tallest surpassing a hundred meters, resembling giants.
These creatures were covered in grey rock, heavy-bodied, with the ground trembling with each step they took, causing the covertly hidden Surveillance Cameras to shake.
“Through energy detection and size measurement, the two strongest mountain giants are in the mid stage of Level 8, one in the early stage of Level 8, and the rest are all Level 7.”
“We have also scanned the surrounding images, and we have not found any traces of other mountain giants, but we cannot rule out the possibility of stronger beings.”
“Since we have not made contact, we know nothing about the abilities or strengths of these mountain giants, so Captain Lawson, please be extra careful when the time comes.”
Cathie Lawson nodded slightly, “Thank you for the reminder, Mine Owner Neal.”
While conversing, Jack Clark was also observing the burly man and another middle-aged man who, with a solemn expression and a clean-cut appearance, looked like a teacher.
The burly man was the person in charge of this energy mine, the mine owner Neal Welch, while the silent middle-aged man was the deputy mine owner, Charles Klein.
After reviewing the surveillance footage, the group left the surveillance room and stepped outside. Cathie Lawson looked around at everyone and asked, “Does anyone have anything to say?”
Gentry Levin said with a grin, “I think it’s not a big problem. With Brother Darren Callum joining our group, we now have exactly three strong men with Eighth Layer Cultivation.”
“Brother Darren Callum and the deputy team leader can each hold off one of the Level 8 Beasts, while you, Captain, swiftly kill another, quickly dealing with the rest.”
“As for those Level 7 fellows, just leave them to us.” As he spoke, Gentry Levin’s eyes revealed a strong confidence.
As strong men who delved deep into the mythical world to chart the map, they were not only advanced in rank at a young age, but their combat strength was also formidable, each capable of surpassing one small level at the least.
Including the strongest among them, Captain Cathie Lawson, who had a record of killing Eighth Layer peak beasts.
As for the deputy team leader Neal Welch, who had recently returned from Blue Star, he had even stronger combat abilities with his king-level bloodline, especially when using his bloodline’s Summoning secret technique.
But just as Gentry Levin finished speaking, the deputy mine owner Charles Klein’s eyes flashed with surprise, and he couldn’t help but take another look at Jack Clark.
Hmm?
Feeling Charles Klein’s gaze, Jack Clark also looked at him because the deputy mine owner’s look was a bit strange, filled with surprise and a hint of shock.
Jack Clark suddenly asked, “Mine Owner Klein, do you recognize me?”
Caught off guard by Jack Clark’s sudden question, Charles Klein was startled, then shook his head, “…No, I don’t. This is my first time meeting you today, Little Brother.”
Jack Clark smiled, “I thought you recognized me, or else why would you look at me with a surprised expression.”
Charles Klein explained, “There was a report back at the base mentioning that The 19th Team would come to handle the mountain giant incident, including brief information about several members including Captain Lawson.”
“It just did not include Little Brother, so I was surprised when I heard your name just now. Don’t take it personally, Little Brother.”

chapters.title: Chapter 794: 347 Your Gaze Is Off, Give Them a Shock_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 794: Chapter 347 Your Gaze Is Off, Give Them a Shock_3
Cathie Lawson nodded and said, “Mr. Jack’s name is indeed a bit special. Well, let’s not delay any further and go check out the situation.”
Charles Klein cautioned, “Everyone, be careful of the domains of those Eighth Level Beasts.”
“Understood, mine owner Klein, we won’t be careless,” they responded.
After exchanging greetings, the party of six reined in the radiance of their battle armor and cloaked their figures, quickly rushing out of the range of the shielding matrix and vanishing into the darkness.
Standing on the hillside and looking at the pitch-black forest in the distance, Charles Klein suddenly said, “Mine owner, I’ll go out and patrol the perimeter again. I have a feeling that the appearance of those mountain giants is a bit strange.”
Neal Welch nodded gravely, “I have the same feeling; there might be new god-level resources emerging nearby. Be extra careful when you go out.”
As the owner and deputy mine owner of the crystal mining quarry, and also the two individuals with the highest level of cultivation, they were not there to enjoy themselves but also responsible for the safety of the surrounding area.
Besides the surveillance cameras scattered over tens of kilometers, they also needed to personally patrol even more remote regions from time to time to ensure the mine’s safety.
In the previous two years, he and Charles Klein had alternated going out on patrols, killing many special Level 6 Exotic Beasts and Level 7 Colossi.
There had also been instances of Level 8 and even Level 9 Giant Beasts appearing, but those beasts were just passing through and left quickly.
This was the first time they encountered a group of Eighth Level Beasts that settled in the vicinity and didn’t leave, making Neal Welch vigilant and feeling that something might have changed in the surroundings.
He immediately sought aid from the Seventh Corps.
Whoosh! Charles Klein’s figure flashed as he dashed out of the Rune Matrix Enchantment, disappearing into the night in the blink of an eye.
After Charles Klein ventured deep into the forest, several kilometers away, on a towering tree hundreds of meters tall, a patch of darkness within the lush branches gradually faded, and six figures appeared.
Looking at Jack, who had retracted the Dark Curtain, Hannah Gail said with a serious expression, “Brother Callum, are you sure this man is trouble?”
Surprise flashed in the eyes of the other four people as well.
Just as they had dashed out a few kilometers, Jack suddenly stated that there was something wrong with Charles Klein from the mine.
Staring into the dark night ahead, Jack replied with a calm demeanor, “He can’t fool my intuition. Although he masked his facial expressions well, the shock and delight in his eyes were quite evident.”
“Why would he feel surprise and shock upon seeing me, especially when we have never met or known each other before?”
Cathie Lawson was silent for a moment before saying, “In recent years, many geniuses from the Exploration Department have been ambushed by the Purgatory Demon Race and the Evil God Sect while they were out, suffering many casualties.”
Reginald Vinson nodded solemnly, “A few months ago, they even caught a traitor in the Thirty-first Corps.”
“These damned people, actually colluding with different races to betray the Federation,” Gentry Levin’s eyes flashed with intense murderous intent.
Hannah Gail said slowly, “It’s normal, given that the civilization war between our Human Clan and the Purgatory Demon Race is intensifying. Both parties are going to extreme lengths.”
“While they assassinate our Human Clan geniuses, we also have strong men who make their way to the Purgatory Demon rear and assassinate their geniuses and even encircle and kill demon kings.”
“For example, more than two months ago, Brother Callum participated in a mission to lure and kill a demon king.”
“That mission resulted in the fall of three of the Purgatory Race’s demon kings, and even the True Body of Blood God Akunus was destroyed, causing his strength to drop from the Ninth Heavens.”
Hiss!
Instantly, the other four faces once again showed shock, looking unbelievably at the young man who was not even twenty years old.
Surrounding and killing demon kings, with three falling and an Evil God’s True Body destroyed—could it be real?
Uh… wait, weren’t we discussing the matter of the traitor? Mr. Gail, why did you bring this up?
Jack was also somewhat confused, not knowing why Hannah Gail had shifted the topic there.
Swallowing hard and with widened eyes, Gentry Levin looked at Jack and asked, “Brother Callum, did you really participate in a mission to encircle and kill demon kings? And killed three demon kings?”
“…How could I, a cultivator of the Eight Layer Heaven, possibly kill three demon kings? I was just responsible for cooperating with our race’s strong men in a ruse,” Jack explained.
“Ha…haha… My mistake, my mistake, indeed, how could you possibly slay demon kings,” Gentry Levin said, somewhat embarrassed.
Out of the blue, Hannah Gail stated, “Although Brother Callum didn’t slay a demon king at that time, with his Late Sixth Heavenly Stage cultivation, he did slay a demon king soul avatar and an Evil God Soul Split.”
“Especially the Evil God Clone, whose strength had reached the early phase of the Eighth Layer Heaven.”
Ever silent Sibyl Millan said in astonishment, “…Deputy commander, are you saying that Mr. Jack, at that time with Sixth Layer cultivation, slew an Eighth Layer Evil God Clone?”
Hannah Gail nodded, still calm, “Indeed.”
The four individuals were so shocked they could hardly speak, looking at Jack not knowing what to say.
They had initially thought that Jack merely cultivated quickly and that his combat power shouldn’t be so exaggerated because with his dedication to cultivation, he surely wouldn’t have enough time to refine his Combat Techniques or cultivate Secret Skills.
To their surprise, this always modest young man was such a freak, terrifying enough with his speed of cultivation, but actually a monster who had once slain an Eighth Layer Evil God Clone while only at the Sixth Layer.
As the group stood in shock, Hannah Gail looked on nonchalantly.
It was time to give these people a bit of a shock since he shouldn’t be the only one dumbfounded.
Ever since the separation from the Hundred Foxes Nation, Hannah Gail had kept an eye on the subsequent events of Mathilda Ward’s journey, only to be repeatedly shocked by Jack.
Particularly during the last battle, when he, in the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, reverse defeated a Blood God Clone of the Eight Layer, even he, a Descendant of the King, was stunned for a long time.
Also, because he had just turned twenty a week before the relic’s arrival, he missed the chance to embark on the Road to Becoming a God.
Initially, he met all the criteria to enter at the forefront of the internal tests, including soul strength that was not weak—evidenced by his ability to Summon the power of the Mythical Eight-tails Beast.
With his talent and innate gifts, had he entered the relic, he would have definitely achieved a considerable harvest, perhaps gaining enough intrinsic to challenge for the kingship.
