chapters.title: Chapter 795: 348: Blood Sacrifice Array, The Demon King Descends (Seeking Monthly Votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 795: Chapter 348: Blood Sacrifice Array, The Demon King Descends (Seeking Monthly Votes)
After the shock had dissipated, Cathie Lawson slowly exhaled and looked at Jack Clark with fiery eyes, “I didn’t expect that little brother Jack once had such astonishing battle achievements.”
Jack Clark shook his head, “Actually, I was also somewhat lucky to win at that time. If the Akunus Avatar had persisted for a little while longer, I might not have been able to hold on and would have burst out and lost first.”
Jack Clark was indeed not being modest. His Emperor Dragon Form at the time was powerful, but it could only burst for a few minutes.
However, no one believed in his modesty anymore, as Cathie Lawson and the others had been shocked several times already that half a day.
This guy was a monster.
At that moment, Cathie Lawson became very serious, “It’s obvious that little brother Jack, with his unequaled talent, has already been targeted by the Purgatory Demon Race, and it’s of the highest bounty kind.”
“Under such circumstances, the reaction of Charles Klein to the name ‘Darren Callum’ being somewhat abnormal is indeed suspicious.”
“Of course, as older generation cultivators, we cannot ignore their past contributions, and we cannot jump to conclusions without evidence.”
Jack Clark nodded, “Naturally, I also just feel that his reaction was a bit odd.”
“Whether it’s a human or a ghost, if we follow up and see, we’ll know. If he truly has a problem, he will certainly be unable to wait to pass the message on.”
“Otherwise, if we deal with those mountain giants and leave, it will be even harder to grasp Brother Callum’s exact movements.”
“However, if Charles Klein does have a problem, Neal Welch cannot be excluded from suspicion either, so we need to split our forces in two directions.”
“Captain, you four take one path, pretend to go and investigate the situation of the mountain giants, and in places with cameras, one or two of you can expose yourselves to stabilize Neal Welch.”
“As for Brother Callum and me, we will follow up to avoid any mistakes.”
“Okay, just be careful when the time comes. High-Ranking Powerhouses’ Spirit Qi resonates with Heaven and Earth, and they have keen perception, so it’s best to maintain a distance of more than one kilometer.”
After briefly discussing the situation, the group vanished into the night in two separate teams.
Among them, Jack Clark and Hannah Gail were enveloped under the Dark Curtain, blending into the darkness of the forest, moving without a sound.
This special ability from the Void Double Pupils might not enhance combat strength, but it was extremely convenient in this kind of situation.
Within the range of Jack Clark’s control, he concealed his presence, erased fluctuations, and at the same time, increased the density of darkness in front of him, forming a layer of black veil that prevented their vision from penetrating.
In that situation, unless it was someone like Jack Clark, who had cultivated Heart’s Eye and was sensitive to vision, even high-level cultivators like Charles Klein would not detect anything unusual.
To be honest, Jack Clark was also somewhat surprised by today’s discovery.
His original plan was to familiarize himself with the situation and, after finishing this ‘small task,’ activate the Sea Illusion Demon Skill to transform his life aura and change his appearance to explore deeper into the mythical world.
Little did he know he would catch a big fish upon his arrival.
Actually, when he was on the fighter aircraft and heard Hannah Gail mention that the person in charge of this mine was an older cultivator, Jack Clark became suspicious.
It was because during his time at Base No.1, he had specifically looked at some information on traitors.
Those documents mentioned that in recent years, the majority of traitors were older generation cultivators who saw no progress in their advancements, with their cultivation stagnating for a long time.
Since the start of the New Era, with the development of the era, except for a few exceptional geniuses, the aptitude for cultivation among each generation has been getting better and better with the changes of the times.
This phenomenon is akin to biological Evolution, as under the increasingly dense Heavenly Energy, each new generation’s genes are more in tune with cultivation than the previous one.
This is also why the number of people with cultivation talent has been increasing over the years.
Many of those who had cultivation talent in the past actually had just about the same talent level as the ordinary geniuses at the school now, like Sawyer Levin and Vera Wada.
Therefore, after spending twenty to thirty years in arduous cultivation to reach the high-order, their strength would hardly improve anymore.
The mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven, the late period of that realm, something Jack Clark could cross at will, would take them years to break through.
And for the Major Realm breakthrough from the Seventh Layer Heaven to the Eight Layer Heaven, due to an incompatible true martial arts phantom, they could get stuck for a decade, or even for life.
Although they were putting in a lot of effort into cultivation, and the Heavenly Energy in the mythical world was incredibly dense, the path of cultivation is not simply about piling up energy but the transformation of a person into a god-like being.
Each realm represents a metamorphosis, a qualitative leap, and a change in the structure of one’s power.
So, when the pace of cultivation slowed down drastically or even stalled, many high-level cultivators would become desperate, unable to accept it.
Accustomed to powerful strength and having witnessed the higher level of power where a king could destroy Heaven and Earth with a simple gesture, anyone would yearn for such power.
Under these circumstances, the more selfish and extreme individuals may choose betrayal, enticed by the Evil God Sect or the Purgatory Demon Race.
All they needed to do was to trade some seemingly trivial information to receive resources far beyond their current realms, forcing their cultivation to advance once more.
In fact, the Human Federation also has some of these top-tier, God-level, even rule resources, but they are limited in number and need to be provided to those with better talent and greater contributions to the Federation.
Of course, this is not to say all older generation cultivators are untrustworthy. Over the years, there have also been many talented individuals who have betrayed after entering the battlefield; it’s just that the proportion of such cases is much smaller.
After all, in a big forest, you’ll find all kinds of birds.
…
Once out of the mine, Charles Klein swept past the areas with cameras as if patrolling around them, and slowly made his way deep into the pitch-black forest of the mountains.

chapters.title: Chapter 796: 348: Blood Sacrifice Array, The Demon King Descends (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 796: Chapter 348: Blood Sacrifice Array, The Demon King Descends (Seeking Monthly Votes)_2
And after moving out of the surveillance range of the mining area, Charles Klein carefully pretended to be patrolling the surroundings, occasionally standing atop huge trees hundreds of meters tall to look around.
During this time, he killed more than a dozen fierce creatures of fourth and fifth grades, which were ten to twenty meters in size, behaving very normally.
It wasn’t until he slowly arrived at a forest one hundred kilometers away, reeking of decay, that Charles Klein’s face revealed a hint of excitement. He dug out a grey stone plate from beneath a dead tree.
Then, from the trunk above, he took out something like a black diamond and carefully placed it in the center of the stone plate.
In an instant, a force of darkness spread out, and strange runes on the stone plate flickered, casting the shape of an eerie black figure in the air.
An ominous shadow over 2 meters tall made a cackling laugh, followed by a crude sounding of the Federation language, “Charles Klein, what business do you have with me?”
Gazing at the eerie shadow floating in the air, Charles Klein was silent for a moment, then suddenly said, “Does your word still stand from before?”
The shadow floated in the air, letting out a chilling cackle as it spoke coldly, “Which words?”
Charles Klein spoke firmly, “Providing the precise whereabouts and clues to Darren Callum in exchange for the Blood of Demon God.”
The very instant he spoke, the black shadow tensed, no longer drifting, and its voice grew anxious, “What, have you located Darren Callum? Where is he?”
“I cannot tell you his exact location right now.”
The shadow fell silent for a moment, then said in a cold voice, “How can I be sure your information is accurate?”
Charles Klein said solemnly, “I have no need to lie to you, I can be certain that the person is Darren Callum, and only such a monster could have made a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven before the age of twenty.”
“What, he’s already made a breakthrough to Eight Layer Heaven, Eight Demonic Marks Realm?” The shadow was taken aback, for the information it had received indicated the human was only at the late period of the Sixth Heavenly Stage.
However, it seemed normal for a monster of such calibre, which even the Great Demon King Barus, head of the Assassination Department, regarded highly, to breakthrough to the Eight Demonic Marks Realm in a short time.
With this thought, a wave of intense excitement radiated from the shadow’s being.
Charles Klein then said in a deep voice, “For the next half an hour, I can precisely pinpoint his location, but before that, I need you to fulfill your promise—I want the Blood of Demon God.”
Charles Klein was confident because he had deliberately lured those mountain giants.
Initially, his plan was to draw two geniuses and then sell the information to a Purgatory Demon expert hidden here by the Purgatory Demon Race, but unexpectedly he ended up hooking the big fish that was Darren Callum.
The black shadow spoke with solemnity, “Since this involves Darren Callum and the Blood of Demon God, it is of great importance. I need to report to the Demon King.”
“However, be assured, if the information this time is accurate, you will not be short of the Blood of Demon God. I guarantee it on the honor of the Purgatory True Demon Clan.”
“You go back now and stabilize the situation there, keep an eye on Darren Callum’s movements. In one Star Hour (three hours), come back here and meet with me.”
Having assured Charles Klein, the shadow instantly vanished.
At the same time, deep within the mythical world, over ten thousand kilometers away, beneath a cliff engulfed in black mist, figures exuding dark power came and went.
Inside a room in the mountain, a Purgatory True Demon, who was just over ‘2 meters’ tall and had a slight build, displayed restrained excitement and eagerness. He approached an altar not far away.
Buzz!
As the energy crystals lit up one by one, Purgatory Demon Patterns glimmered, and in an instant, an invisible force pierced through the Void, establishing contact with a remote other end.
Soon, the black demonic Qi filled the sky, converging to form a vast and indistinct figure.
Instantly, Karto bowed his head respectfully, “Your Majesty the Demon King, your subordinate has important matters to report.”
Devianna’s voice was deep and indifferent, “Speak.”
Karto said excitedly, “Darren Callum, Darren Callum has appeared near the Development Department Seventh Legion of the Human Clan, one of my undercover agents has located him.”
Boom! At that instant, a mighty aura burst forth from the shadowy figure, whipping the air and causing the entire mountain wall to shake.
“Are you certain it is him?”
“It’s definitely him.”
Under the pressure of the demon king, Karto bowed even more reverently, “This Human was an undercover agent I cultivated recently. Two years ago, he provided a piece of information that enabled me to successfully assassinate a Human Clan genius, a human with Seven Demon Marks.”
“Just because of this, this particular human is past the point of no return; it’s impossible for him to cooperate with the Human Clan to set an ambush for us.”
While the Purgatory Demon Race was assassinating Human Clan geniuses, the Human Clan also retaliated, and these cunning humans often planned counter-ambushes as well, killing many of the elite of our Demon Clan.
Especially after the failed invasion of Blue Star and the incident involving the fall of Three Demon Kings, the humans have shown remarkable cunning.
Therefore, the Purgatory Demon Race engaged in assassination activities have become even more cautious during this period, even Devianna dare not be careless.
After confirming the information was reliable, Devianna’s voice revealed a strong intent to kill, “Finally, we have located this human.”
Respectfully, Karto said, “My Lord the Demon King, currently he is within the power radiation range of the Human Clan, and it is said that this Darren Callum has already made the breakthrough to the Eight Demonic Marks Realm. Hence, I’m not a hundred percent certain.”
“There’s no need for you to take action this time, I will come personally.”
Devianna’s voice was cold, “Within the area of Human Clan influence, due to positioning reasons, the king-level support from the opposition comes very quickly. We must annihilate him instantly with overwhelming force.”
“Karto, prepare the Blood Sacrifice Array for the descent of two Demon Kings.”
“To kill that Darren Callum, two Demon Kings are needed!?” Shock appeared on Karto’s face.
In past assassination missions, only Human Clan top-notch geniuses who bore the King’s Attitude or very important Descendant of the King merited the personal attention of a Demon King.
It was unexpected that for the sake of killing Darren Callum, the Assassination Department would actually be preparing for the deployment of two Demon Kings.
Devianna’s voice was low, “This human possesses the potential of a Great Demon King, and because of him, our clan has lost Three Demon Kings.”
“Whether because of his potential, or to avenge Kautorus and the others, this human must die.”
“Go and make the preparations. I will find Augusta and have them join the effort as well. The Blood Sacrifice Array will be activated in a quarter of an hour (half an hour).”
“Yes, my Lord,” Karto bowed his head respectfully.
For the Purgatory Family, which has developed for over a hundred thousand years, although they lack technology, they have achieved the pinnacle in the research of cultivation inheritance and transcendent powers.
Such as invoking a blood sacrifice to twist space-time, tearing open a stable pathway for the descent of Demon King Level Strong Ones.
Over the years, if the Human Race had not received the Heritage of Ruins, had a burst of high-end strength, and had not begun the preliminary integration of technology with rune power, they simply could not contend with the Purgatory Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 797: 349: Void Demon Eye, Blood Moon in the Sky
chapters.content:
Chapter 797: Chapter 349: Void Demon Eye, Blood Moon in the Sky
“`
Night.
As Charles Klein merged into the shadows of the trees and left, the darkness between the large trees on the mountainside a kilometer away slowly dissipated, revealing Jack Clark and Hannah Gail.
Watching Charles Klein’s figure disappear in the distance in the blink of an eye, a strong murderous intent appeared in Hannah Gail’s eyes, “Brother Callum, why not take him down?”
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “It would startle the snake by hitting the grass.”
In fact, Charles Klein had been very cautious, as the rotting forest where he had just been had a special force field that could shield the demon gas leakage caused by activating the Stone Disk.
But this time, he had been targeted by Jack Clark.
With his terrifying physique, Jack Clark’s strength was not only unrivaled—his hearing, sense of smell, and vision had also become incredibly sharp.
Especially after his physique and strength broke through ten thousand and he acquired the ‘dragon’ attribute, his five senses seemed almost supernatural, his hearing letting no wind pass unheard.
Therefore, even though they were separated by a kilometer, he clearly heard the conversation between Charles Klein and the dark shadow.
But at the same time, the roars, howls, crawling, fighting, and some panting sounds of countless Unique Beasts within a ten-kilometer radius also made Jack Clark’s brain swell slightly.
No help for it, there was too much information to process in an instant.
Jack Clark reined in his perception and exhaled softly, “Let’s go, Mr. Gail. First, we find a place with a signal to shake people up. After all, that is a demon king.”
As he spoke, Jack’s palm slowly pressed down, and immediately the air below vibrated.
Under the branch beneath the feet of the two, a Giant Beast, forty meters in body length and over twenty meters in height, covered in gray scale armor and shaped like a giant elephant, showed terror in its eyes.
Boom!
Under Jack Clark’s unrivaled domineering power, the Giant Beast, suppressed by the Power of Heaven and Earth, couldn’t even let out a roar before its head suddenly collapsed and exploded with a bang.
In an instant, countless blood and pieces of meat exploded, along with some white substances scattering within a hundred-meter radius, creating a terrifying scene.
Boom!
The giant body of the beast fell to the ground, causing plants to shake and the ground to tremble with the impact.
Meanwhile, Jack Clark and Hannah Gail had already vanished in a flash, quickly arriving at a small hill not far from the mine, “We have signal here.”
The smart wristwatch on Hannah Gail’s wrist flickered, indicating a received signal.
However, in this location, the smart wristwatch couldn’t communicate, so Hannah Gail took out a palm-sized golden item, similar to a mobile phone, from his Storage Space and dialed King Cyril’s number on it.
Alright, it’s a mythical version of a mobile phone.
Accompanied by the flashing golden light on the golden mobile phone, the half-figure of a silver-haired youth was projected in front of the two, looking at Hannah Gail with a slightly solemn expression.
“Sinclair, is there trouble on your end?”
Hannah Gail solemnly replied, “King Cyril, the deputy mine owner Charles Klein at the Sky Mine is a traitor. Just now, Brother Callum and I witnessed him making contact with the Purgatory Demon Race.”
The silver-haired youth’s eyes sharpened, “Jack’s whereabouts have been exposed.”
Hannah Gail nodded, “Yes.”
The silver-haired youth looked at Jack Clark, “Mr. Jack, what do you think?”
Jack Clark revealed a smile, “The Purgatory Demon Race told Charles Klein to come back after one star hour for a rendezvous to lead the way; it looks like they are waiting for an important person to arrive.”
“At that time, we’ll turn their plan against them and wipe them all out.” As he said this, Jack’s gaze turned cold.
It’s very likely that they will send a demon king to assassinate him, but what of that? He has killed mythical creatures before and even erased an entire average civilization.
Actually, Jack could have taken down Charles Klein earlier and then set up an ambush at the meeting point.
But what if the arriving demon king doesn’t show up immediately and instead sends subordinates to meet with Charles Klein, then senses something is wrong and doesn’t show up?
This is an opportunity to lure and kill a demon king after all. Once the merit is distributed, the Merit Value gained will be astonishing, probably enough for him to exchange for a batch of High-level Life Crystals surpassing 50,000 attribute points.
Moreover, this method of exchanging Merit Value for Life Crystals allows direct access to the surrounding Outer Development Department base inventories.
If the inventory of Life Crystals is insufficient, the Federation will also dispatch strong men to hunt for him.
And after all, it’s a demon king. Killing one might yield even greater rewards from the body search—it’s essentially a walking super experience cache.
The silver-haired youth pondered slightly, then looked at Hannah Gail, “One star hour, three hours is enough for us to set up. It’s just that doing this might put you two at some risk.”
When facing a Demon King Level Strong, cultivators of the Seventh Layer Heaven and Eight Layer Heaven can hardly withstand a single blow and can be killed instantly, except for Jack Clark who possesses forbidden weapons as his trump card.
Hannah Gail’s eyes revealed a trace of excitement, “If we were afraid of danger, we wouldn’t have joined the Outer Development Department. This is a chance to ambush a demon king; we can’t miss it.”
The silver-haired youth nodded gravely, “If that’s the case…”
The three briefly discussed the next steps, then King Cyril ended the call and contacted the Outer Development Department Headquarters in the rear with his king-level authority.
The office wall flickered with light, and then an image of a rugged Elder appeared, sitting weakly behind an office desk, looking at the silver-haired youth.
“King Cyril, contacting me directly, is there a problem on your end?”
King Cyril nodded, “Yes, there’s a bit of a situation. Darren Callum just arrived at the Seventh Corps, and his whereabouts have been leaked, targeted by the Assassination Department of The Purgatory Family.”
The Elder frowned, “Are there so many traitors within our human inner circle?”
“It’s not that there are too many traitors, but that the enemy is unlucky to have run into him,” King Cyril said with a smile in his eyes. “I don’t know if the Third Councilor has seen his files, but this young fellow has cultivated the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife to an unprecedented realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 798: 349: Void Demon Eye, Blood Moon in the Sky_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 798: Chapter 349: Void Demon Eye, Blood Moon in the Sky_2
“I could keenly perceive the other party’s subtle emotional fluctuations through my vision, so I immediately noticed the abnormality of the deputy mine owner of Sky Mine.”
“This guy has hidden himself very deeply. A few years ago, a pioneer team died under mysterious circumstances while out; he must have been the one who leaked the information.”
“At that time, I continued the investigation for half a year but didn’t find anything unusual among everyone under surveillance, including changes in cultivation level; even Charles Klein was under suspicion.”
“This time, he has made contact with the Purgatory Demon Clan and scheduled a meeting three hours from now. I anticipate that they will send a demon king to assassinate Mr. Jack.”
To keep it absolutely confidential, once the news that Jack Clark had traversed the Road to Godhood was sealed, only Marcellus Larry, Lori Joyner, the Nether Heavenly King, and the three Speakers knew.
Even King Cyril, as a king-level individual, only saw data that highlighted Jack Clark’s exceptional talent, describing him as having the stature of a ‘king’, which the Purgatory Family was also led to believe.
Therefore, King Cyril couldn’t possibly imagine that the enemy would send two Demon Kings this time.
The Elder revealed a touch of emotion on his face, “It seems this young fellow truly is intertwined with luck, attracting a demon king as soon as he entered the mythical world.”
Then the Elder became solemn, “I will coordinate in a moment and quickly get the Shepherd Army and Leo Hart to come and support you.”
Currently, the Human Race is short on personnel, especially concerning the mobilization of king-level individuals in charge of guarding a territory—it must be done cautiously to prevent enemies from exploiting any opening, thus coordination is required.
Now, with three king-level individuals taking action, it is more than enough to encircle and kill a demon king.
…
“That means we’ve become bait.”
Under the cover of night, Jack Clark, Hannah Gail, and Cathie Lawson, along with the other three, stood on a mountain ridge thousands of meters high and gazed at the vast forest below with solemn expressions.
Hannah Gail slowly said, “This operation is dangerous. I suggest that you, captain, might consider retreating first. Brother Callum and I can handle the acting here.”
Cathie Lawson frowned, “Hannah, do you think we’re afraid of dying?”
“We’re talking about hunting a demon king here, how could I miss out on that?” excitement shone on Gentry Levin’s face.
As pioneers, Cathie Lawson and the others not only possessed a spirit of adventure but had also grown accustomed to walking with danger, as every venture into the mythical world was a voyage through death’s shadow.
The ever-silent Sibyl Millan said calmly, “Deputy team leader, please tell us what we should do next. We’re all teammates, and no one will leave when it matters.”
“Exactly,” Reginald Vinson nodded.
Noticing the determination on his teammates’ faces, Hannah Gail gave a wry smile and did not persist; he had already anticipated this outcome.
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “The next task is simple: find that group of mountain giants and wait for them to come knocking.”
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Under the bright moonlight, bizarre Unique Beasts roamed between the verdant mountain forests, where figures swiftly dashed through the treetops hundreds of meters tall.
After reaching the Seventh Layer Heaven in cultivation, a cultivator can manifest a true martial arts phantom, resonating with Heaven and Earth. Although unable to fly, harnessing the Power of Heaven and Earth for brief gliding was not a problem.
Together with their movement techniques and leveraging the giant treetops, the six individuals quickly covered tens of kilometers and found the group of mountain giants in the middle of the mountain ranges.
Between two ten-thousand-meter-high mountain peaks where they intersected, a hundred-meter-wide river roared, with Mutated Fish occasionally leaping up, causing water to splash into the sky.
In the valley several kilometers wide, twelve Giant Beasts, forty-odd meters in size with the largest around a hundred and ten meters and looking like grey rock giants, roamed in search.
These mountain giants seemed to be looking for something, constantly growling, their vast palms smashing one large tree after another, appearing extremely irate.
Observing the group of beasts, Cathie Lawson’s face was grave, “Three Eighth Level Beasts; each of us takes one. Sibyl, you and the others deal with the Level 7 Colossi quickly to support us.”
“Understood,” the petite Sibyl Millan nodded in agreement.
With years of cooperation, the team had long since developed a tacit understanding, boasting extensive combat experience against such herds of giants.
But just as they were about to make a move and quickly eliminate these giants, Jack Clark calmly said, “I’ll take care of it.”
Initially, Jack Clark did not plan on drawing attention; he was content with blending in quietly. Yet, with the expectation of a visit from a demon king, it made sense to fight a fast and decisive battle.
As he spoke, a rough and domineering Black-gold battle halberd, three-point-nine meters long, appeared in his hand, instantly releasing a dreadfully heavy aura.
So oppressively heavy was it that the air around the Black Gold halberd, which glowed with a black-gold radiance, exploded, twisted, and presented a terrifying sight.
If even the weapon was this formidable, what about the man?
As this thought surfaced in the minds of Gentry Levin and the others, they saw Jack Clark let out a long howl. Golden flames erupted from his body, and red flames that seemed like blood blazed on his battle armor.
Boom!
Tree trunks several meters thick exploded, and Jack Clark turned into a golden-red streak as he soared into the sky. The earth shook, and the formidable aura of the Eight Layer Heaven burst forth.
High in the air, the atmosphere vibrated around Jack Clark, causing white waves to surge out hundreds of meters.
With his War Halberd sweeping across, dazzling blue halberd radiance, each hundred meters long, shot out like lightning, the ear-piercing boom echoing across Heaven and Earth.
Boom, boom, boom!
Upon the impact of the True Thunder Instant Slash, the valley trembled violently as the ground shattered. Before the seventh and eighth level mountain giants could react, their immense bodies were cleaved into pieces by the halberd’s radiance.
Empowered by a manifold increase from the Power of Heaven and Earth, the dreadful halberd radiance even cleaved the earth, leaving hundreds of meters long, ten-meter-wide dark cracks along the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 799: 349 Void Demon Eye, Blood Moon in the Sky_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Chapter 349 Void Demon Eye, Blood Moon in the Sky_3
“`
The dirt at the edge of the crack was scorched black, with blue electrical arcs crackling and leaping.
Even the river was severed under the two strikes of True Thunder Halberd Skill, the waters reversing their flow as countless fish thrashed wildly under the bombardment of thunder, creating a terrifying uproar.
“Damn!”
“So strong.”
Watching Jack Clark instantly kill over a dozen behemoths and destroy half of the ‘valley’ with his terrifying power, shock was written on everyone’s faces.
Even Hannah Gail felt the same. After just over two months, Jack Clark had become this powerful, capable of instant kills even against behemoths of the same level eight rank.
It was too abnormal.
Roar!
Amid the raging wind and smoke, a behemoth roughly one hundred and ten meters tall—like a small hill—let out an angry roar as a circle of yellow power erupted from its body.
Boom!
The explosion of power caused the earth to tremble within a two hundred-meter radius; the air condensed and the land turned into hard rock, sinking several meters, revealing it to be a special realm of petrification and pressure.
“Now it’s showtime,” Jack Clark said slowly, descending from the sky and landing on the broken land below.
Roar!
In the face of the little one shining with golden red light in the distance, the mountain giant’s eyes filled with bloodthirsty brutality. Its huge body moved with a boom, shattering the earth as it exploded forward.
The hundred-meter-tall figure resembled a towering skyscraper that, in the blink of an eye, brought a mountains and seas shaking petrification aura right in front of Jack Clark, immediately enveloping him with a heavy force that weighed down upon him.
Boom!
The behemoth’s fist, heavy as tens of thousands of tons of boulders, fell from the sky, blasted the atmosphere, and smashed down subsonically with rings of white waves.
Boom!
Under that terrifying power, over one hundred meters of petrified heavy land shattered, with countless rubble flying like waves, the shockwave kicking up a rolling cloud of dust that barreled out a kilometer.
Whoosh! The raging dust scattered suddenly under a crushing pressure.
In a circular pit with a diameter of a hundred meters, Jack Clark stood calm, his body enshrouded in red flames, holding a halberd in one arm to block the shadowing fist overhead.
At that moment, between him and the behemoth, the Golden Dragon Power clashed and collided with the pressure of the behemoth’s yellow domain, creating dazzling halos of light.
Sibyl Millan cried out, “He actually chose to take it head-on and blocked that behemoth’s full-force strike. How can his strength be so immense?”
“He’s the real behemoth.”
As seasoned experts of the Seventh and Eighth Layer, Gentry Levin and others had experienced countless battles, but this was their first time seeing someone withstand a high-rank behemoth head-on.
Even Cathie Lawson, who had slain Peak of the eighth level behemoths, would not dare to resist such a creature with her human body, as a single swipe from it could crush her into a pulp.
Right then, an aura that sent shivers down the spine erupted from Jack Clark, as if some terrifying power were awakening, and the sound of Dragon Roar echoed faintly in the Void.
Boom!
With a shake of his arm, Jack Clark’s halberd burst into endless golden radiance, and under the terrifying power, the domain around the mountain giant was instantly torn apart, and its fist shattered.
Roar!
With a single blow from the Halberd Skill’s outburst, the mountain giant let out a pained howl, its huge body retreating two steps from the explosive force.
In the ferocious blast of the explosion, the ground beneath Jack Clark crumbled, and under the force of the rebound, he turned into a ray of light that shot into the sky, then stomped down.
Boom!
“`
The mountain giant’s chest, harder than alloy, cracked and shattered under the terrifying power, and its huge body was blown out, slamming into the hillside a thousand meters away with rings of shockwaves.
The mountain forest collapsed, countless trees broke, and the dreadful vibrations could be felt even dozens of miles away.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The Earth shook as three blazing golden halberd blades shot out while Jack swung his war halberd, piercing through Heaven and Earth, continually gathering and amplifying the energy of the world.
In just a blink, three Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial attacks, carrying the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth, slashed down around the Giant Beast, causing mountains to collapse and the great sun to flash brilliantly.
Three fireballs, each hundreds of meters in diameter, were surrounded by golden flame dragons that melted everything.
The terrifying explosion, along with the Earth’s tremors, made Cathie Lawson and her four companions feel like the entire world was shaking, and the sky was lit up with a fraction of bright light.
“They’ve started fighting.”
“As expected of the members from the expansion group, The 19th Team is so strong.”
At the edge of the mine, Neal Welch, Charles Klein, and hundreds of soldiers from the Seventh Corps were looking at the distant light illuminating the sky, the tremors, and the fierce roars of the Giant Beast with shocked expressions on their faces.
So strong, truly Eighth Layer Experts, the commotion of the battle alone is this exaggerated.
Especially Charles Klein, who was watching the distance with rapidly breathing and fiery eyes.
So impressive, but it’ll be soon. Once I get the Blood of the Demon God, I too can become an Eighth or even Ninth Heaven Expert.
Meanwhile, as Jack casually suppressed the Eighth Level Beast, creating intense battle noises,
More than ten thousand kilometers away, the sky was covered with blood-red clouds, and the Earth was strewn with hundreds of sixth and seventh level, and even many eighth level Giant Beasts lying across it.
These Giant Beasts were all torn apart, and their flesh was turned inside out with searing blood flowing over them, pooling together. Under the eerie control of rune magic, two blood altars covering hundreds of meters were formed.
From afar, the two blood altars looked like giant eyes embedded in the Earth, emitting a shocking bloodthirst that stared directly into the Firmament.
As the blood sacrifice began, a strength formed from the blood and souls of the Giant Beasts penetrated the Void, creating intense coordinates, resonating with a distant place.
In the mythical world tens of thousands of kilometers away, behind the Purgatory Demon Clan Army, eighteen stone pillars, thick hundreds of meters and tall thousands of meters, stood imposingly.
Most of these pillars were in a dormant state, but currently, only two were vibrating, their surfaces flowing with strange demon patterns, forming layers of demon gas that spiraled up to the sky and down into the Earth.
At the tops of the two vibrating stone pillars, two black rune arrays inscribed there flickered like black eerie eyes, emitting a heart-palpitatingly terrible aura.
At this moment, at the top of the arrays between the two stone pillars, stood two menacing figures, one over five meters tall and the other over ten meters.
With the resonance of the Blood Sacrifice Array, the invisible power of the blood sacrifice poured in, and the two black Eyes of Void slowly turned red, the terrifying power growing stronger and stronger.
Boom! Boom! The pillars trembled, and within the towering columns of demon gas, two figures wrapped in blood-colored light soared into the sky, piercing through Heaven and Earth and disappearing into the Void in an instant.
The mythical world was boundless and filled with dangerous forbidden lands that interfered with space and even time.
In such circumstances, even Purgatory Demon Clan’s powerful entities needed to rely on the Blood Sacrifice Array for location positioning, coupled with the tearing of the Void Demon Eye for teleportation.
As the two blood lights soared into the sky, soldiers from the Purgatory Demon Clan Army and the Vassal Races’ legions stationed within tens of thousands of miles radius all showed an expression of awe.
“The Eyes of Void have been activated again, and this time two Demon Kings have left. I wonder who has provoked the great Purgatory True Demon Clan this time.”
“Who else could it be but those humans in front?”
“Roar! Roar! The Demon King is invincible, exterminate all humans.”
And as the two Demon Kings tore through the Void to depart, high above the boundless sky of the mythical world, where the bright moon shone, a faint red glow emitted from behind it, and as some gazed at it with solemn eyes, a Blood Moon slowly emerged.
Under the illumination of the red Blood Moon, the world began to change.

chapters.title: Chapter 800: 350 God Demon Great War, Heaven Suppressing War King
chapters.content:
Chapter 800: Chapter 350 God Demon Great War, Heaven Suppressing War King
Cut off from the world by forbidden lands, a vast plain hundreds of kilometers in extent formed in the sky, where blood-colored light shimmered, and two huge spatial cracks slowly opened.
In the depths of the dark void, one could vaguely see two blood-colored lights approaching at a seemingly slow yet terrifyingly fast speed.
Soon, the two figures surrounded by blood light pierced through the void, and an indescribable terrifying demon power descended.
Boom! Boom! Heaven and Earth changed color.
On the Earth, at the edge of the Blood Sacrifice Array, dozens of members of the Purgatory Demon Race, exuding Seventh Layer, Eighth Layer, and Ninth Heavens auras, all knelt on one knee, bowing respectfully.
“We welcome the Demon King’s descent.”
……
“The battle has been raging for over an hour; it’s so intense over there.”
At the edge of the mine, watching the dazzling light blasts from time to time deep within the mountain ranges, Neal Welch and others looked somber, as the battle was extremely fierce.
Especially the golden halberd radiance that streaked out every now and then, crossing a kilometer to land on a mountain, instantly demolishing a mountain peak as magma flowed beneath the intense flames.
The dazzling light, visible even tens of kilometers away, together with the powerful energy fluctuations and vibrations, was causing the surrounding Unique Beasts to become restless, roaring continuously.
Moreover, as the Blood Moon gradually eclipsed the moon, the entire world was slowly enveloped in blood light, and the eyes of the Mutated Creatures also began to turn red.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
Amidst the brutal roars, some Unique Beasts could no longer restrain themselves and rushed towards the central part of the mountain ranges, where the great tremors originated, causing many areas of the mountain forest to shake.
Neal Welch’s face changed drastically, “Not good, some Unique Beasts have been drawn by the commotion caused by Captain Lawson and the others.”
In such a situation, if a beast roar were to form, then it wouldn’t matter whether it was the Eight Layer Heaven or Ninth Heavens, they would be dragged down by countless Mutant Beasts.
Of course, that assumes they would stand there and not move.
Charles Klein’s expression became grave, “Starting line, you keep an eye on the base here. I’ll go inform them, otherwise, if a beast roar forms, the consequences are unimaginable.”
Neal Welch spoke in a deep voice, “Old Charles, the Unique Beasts outside have already started to get restless, it’s very dangerous. You stay here in command, and I’ll go inform them.”
Charles Klein shook his head, “Starting line, your cultivation methods are grand and not suitable for this situation. I have cultivated the Dark Serpent Obscuring Sky Secret Method and will be safer.”
“Besides, this place needs you in command to hold the fort. Otherwise, if a Level 7 or above Giant Beast mistakenly enters the Enchantment, these soldier comrades may not be able to hold it off.”
Neal Welch hesitated for a moment before slowly nodding.
Whoosh!
With a determined look on his face, Charles Klein dashed out of the Enchantment amidst the admiring gaze of many soldiers, speeding towards the direction of the intense battle.
But in just a few minutes, the soldier in charge in the surveillance room turned pale.
Under the disturbances of the restless Unique Beasts and the explosive strength, signal relay towers were destroyed one after another, and soon, surveillance in the southwest direction was lost.
Immediately, the soldier rushed out of the room, shouting towards the distance, “Report to Colonel Welch, all the cameras and signal points in the southwest direction have been destroyed.”
“Not good, there must be a large-scale beast horde gathering over there.”
Neal Welch’s face tightened, “All defensive weapon fire systems, activate. Set the attack range to the edge of the matrix periphery, and once any Mutated Creature breaks into the Enchantment, kill it immediately and clean up the bloodstains.”
After destroying the surveillance cameras and several signal relay points toward the southwest direction, Charles Klein charged directly toward the meeting point, a hundred or so kilometers away.
On the way, Charles Klein concealed his aura, using his movement techniques to move quickly through the darkness, avoiding any Giant Beasts above Level 7, and effortlessly slaying the ordinary ones.
Around him, more than a dozen black pythons, each over 10 meters long, entwined themselves, blending into the darkness. Whenever an ordinary Unique Beast appeared ahead, a black python would silently pounce.
With the black python’s corrosive protective energy surging through their nostrils, large Unique Beasts would succumb to poison and die in the blink of an eye, displaying a sinister and ruthless battle method.
Charles Klein soon arrived at the meeting point.
“Who’s there?”
As he approached the rotting forest, Charles Klein sensed an intense danger. In his heightened state of alertness, a figure over 2 meters tall emerged from the darkness.
Compared to his thinner brethren, yet hulking when compared to Charles Klein, the figure was covered in black armor, his face spread with red scales, and his dark red eyes held an icy stare.
Above its head, a single horn pointed straight towards the Firmament, and a tail, like a venomous snake, swayed slightly behind it. Enveloped by black demonic qi, it looked like a demon straight from Hell.
No sooner had this figure appeared than a heart-palpitating terrifying aura unfolded, causing an instinctive fear in Charles Klein, his legs trembling.
This was the difference in life stages, as Purgatory Demons, they were just too powerful, overwhelming even.
Watching Karto emerge, Charles Klein’s eyes showed fervent admiration.
Because as long as he consumed the Blood of the Demon God, he could also become such a perfectly powerful being and soon make a breakthrough to the Eight Layer, possessing the potential to become a Demon King.
Charles Klein’s fervent gaze made Karto uncomfortable, and with a slightly cold look in his eyes, he spoke in a low voice in the rough Federation language, “Charles Klein, bring us to Darren Callum.”
“…Just you alone, Lord Karto?” Charles Klein looked around the empty surroundings, slightly startled.
Karto’s voice was deep, “What, you think I, as a Nine Demonic Marks strong man, am not enough to suppress Darren of the Eight Layer Heaven?”
Charles Klein quickly shook his head, “That’s not what I meant. But that is a Federation pioneering team, very strong. If they fight to the death, Darren might escape.”

chapters.title: Chapter 801: 350 God Demon Great War, Heaven Suppressing War King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 801: Chapter 350 God Demon Great War, Heaven Suppressing War King_2
Karto coldly said, “Rest assured, Darren Callum is going to die today, and not even the Human Kings can save him.”
In the face of the descent of two Demon Kings, even if the Human King of the Seventh Corps behind them reacts and comes to support promptly, they won’t be able to save Darren Callum today.
It might even be possible for the counterattack and ambush of another demonic creature to heavily injure, or even to slay, a Human King.
Noticing the strong confidence in Karto’s tone, Charles Klein’s gaze flickered, vaguely guessing that there might be even stronger members of the Demon Clan hidden behind him.
However, seeing Charles Klein standing there hesitating and not moving, Karto grew somewhat displeased, “Why aren’t you leaving?”
Charles Klein said earnestly, “My lord, I haven’t received the Blood of Demon God yet.”
Karto’s voice was low, “Don’t worry, the Blood of Demon God will be given to you in due time.”
“I believe you, my lord, but you said you would give me the Blood of Demon God.” Although he spoke of trust, Charles Klein stood there without any intention to lead the way.
“Are you blackmailing me?” Karto’s gaze grew gradually colder, and a dangerous aura began to spread around him.
“No, it was promised to me.” At this moment, Charles Klein was very determined, even as the aura of a strong killing intent emanated from the Purgatory Demon in front of him.
Having chosen to betray the Human Race for power, would he still fear death?
Just then, a cold voice came from the Void, carrying an overpowering will that almost brought Charles Klein to his knees.
“Karto, give it to him.”
Karto immediately bowed respectfully, “Yes, my lord.”
As he spoke, Karto took out a square, red jade box, its surface sealed with demon patterns, from his Storage Equipment and threw it over reluctantly.
“Take it; my True Demon Race always keeps its word.”
“Thank you, thank you, my lord.”
The previously fearless Charles Klein instantly caught the jade box with an excited face, feeling the suppressed Horrific Life Energy fluctuations inside, and his face lit up with excitement.
“My lord, I will lead you there right away.”
“Wait.” A low voice arose from the Void, the invisible brutal aura almost making Charles Klein’s legs go weak.
Then, at a few hundred meters in the air, a red halo exploded and disappeared, and instantly an aura that agitated life spread out at an astonishing speed.
Roar, roar, roar!! Within a range of ten kilometers, the violent roars of Unique Beasts arose, and from afar, intense tremors were coming, Sky-touching Trees swaying.
From the Void, the cold voice carried a hint of surprise, “Augusta, why are you releasing the god attractor?”
The brutal voice replied with a deep tone, “Of course, it’s to give the Human Race a welcoming gift, and after we kill that Human Clan Genius, the resulting Beast roars will conveniently destroy everything around us.”
“Lead the way, Karta.”
“Yes, Demon King.”
Whoosh, whoosh!!
Under the night sky, two figures dashed swiftly, crossing mountains and rivers, with the ground shaking behind them and the raging wind howling in the sky, while a dense pack of Mutant Beasts was converging.
Even in front of them, many Mutated Creatures were being drawn in.
In an instant, black blade beams hundreds of meters long tore through the atmosphere, shattering Unique Beasts ahead, unstoppable, and with an Overbearing aura.
In front of a mid period Level 9 Purgatory True Demon with Nine Demonic Marks, those ordinary Unique Beasts stood no chance, not even qualifying to delay him for a moment.
Before long, the two had crossed over a hundred kilometers and reached the outskirts of the mountain ranges, then Karto suddenly stopped, looking deep into the mountains.
Even separate by tens of kilometers, he could keenly sense the powerful fluctuations coming from within, where every attack nearing the Early Stage of Level 9 stirred the immense strength of Heaven and Earth.
Karto said in a heavy voice, “Are they over there?”
Charles Klein nodded respectfully, “Yes, I led a group of mountain giants there, their mission was to kill that group of giants.”
“Well done,” Karto said, with a ferocious smile on his face.
However, he didn’t kill Charles Klein to save a share of the Blood of Demon God even though he wanted to — Devianna didn’t allow it.
This time, Devianna planned to use the feat of killing Darren Callum and the tale of turning Charles Klein into a Top-tier noble with a share of the Blood of Demon God for promotion.
To promote the strength and generosity of the Purgatory True Demon Clan, which would be enough to sway many humans who were hesitant about whether to betray the Human Race.
Karto revealed a ferocious smile, “Let’s go, we’ll give those humans some surprises.”
Saying this, the two shot off again, with a multitude of Unique Beasts already gathering behind them, even including some giants over a hundred meters tall.
In the tens of thousands, giants over ten meters tall gathered in droves, carrying out a vast momentum, and causing the ground to crack, ancient trees to fall, and even half the mountain range to shake.
Guided by Charles Klein, Karto soon arrived between two ten thousand meter mountains.
There, a few kilometers wide ‘canyon’ had become ruins, the Earth was crisscrossed with cracks, rivers stopped flowing, and mountain peaks collapsed.
In some of the pits over a hundred meters wide, fiery flames burned, and magma flowed.
On the broken land, a mountain giant whose limbs had been severed and who lay on the ground over ten meters tall was emitting pitiful roars.
Above that giant’s head, Jack Clark, clad in black and red Ferocious War Armor and holding a halberd, stood resolute.
In the distance, Cathie Lawson and her four companions were spread out, relentlessly unleashing powerful Combat Techniques at the sky or around them, causing the Earth to vibrate and smoke and dust to billow.

chapters.title: Chapter 802: 350 God Demon Great War, Heaven Suppressing War King_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Chapter 350 God Demon Great War, Heaven Suppressing War King_3
Meanwhile, there were many corpses of Mutated Beasts of Level 4 or higher around.
Seeing this scene, Charlie Klein and Karto’s expressions changed dramatically in an instant, “Not good, it’s a trap, the Human Race has set an ambush.”
“Darren Callum!”
Boom! Accompanied by an ice-cold voice echoing between heaven and earth, a terrifying Demon King’s oppressive might burst forth, instantly changing the color of the sky and land.
Endless demon gas erupted, obscuring heaven and earth, forming a rapidly spinning demon gas vortex in the center of which a massive demon claw with a one-mile diameter descended from the sky, blocking out the sun.
Under the terrifying strike, the entire world seemed to instantly solidify, with the air for tens of kilometers around being compressed into substance, as if the whole of heaven and earth bore down upon them.
The terrifying might of such fearsomeness changed Cathie Lawson and others’ expressions completely, their faces turning pale, as they faced the horrific might of a Demon King level for the first time.
Compared to them, as Jack Clark looked up at the sky above, was unmoved, his expression calm.
Compared to the ferocious might of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at full strength, which shook heaven and earth, this Demon King’s Demon Power was just that, enough to frighten children.
“To actually run rampant within the territory of my Human Race, do you really think the Human Race has no one?”
Within the indifferent voice, a razor-sharp Sword Intent surged into the sky, instantly turning into a thousand-meter long Golden Sword Light.
Boom!
Under that terrifying Golden Sword Qi that crossed space, the demon claw was instantly shredded, and the Demon Clouds covering the sky were torn apart, followed by a muffled groan from the Void.
“Sky-splitting Golden Sword, King Cyril, it is indeed the despicable Human Race, using a genius human as bait. Aren’t you afraid something will happen to him?”
Accompanied by a sinister voice full of discord, a figure more than five meters tall, covered in black crystal battle armor emerged from a layer in the Void, revealing a slightly delicate feminine face covered with red fine scales.
Behind this demonic figure, red hair as dense as a carpet with no wind autonomously spread, and a black tail like a venomous snake subtly moved, intermittently probing into the Void.
Meanwhile, on a mountain peak several kilometers behind Jack and the others, countless mirror-like runes shattered, and a silver-haired youth appeared, surrounded by a fearsome Sword Intent that pierced the heavens and the earth.
“Void Demon King, Devianna, now that you’ve come, don’t even think of leaving.”
In a hoarse voice, on another mountainside tens of kilometers away, space distorted and a man in his thirties with eyebrows sharp as blades emerged.
As he appeared, the temperature between heaven and earth dropped several degrees. Cold and sharp, the very air they breathed seemed to carry the edge of a blade.
The invisible oppressive might emanating from him caused the roaring Unique Beasts in the distance to falter in their cries.
“Sky Knife King, Leo Hart,” Devianna’s pupils shrank upon seeing the two ambushing Human Kings, followed by a cold smile on her face.
“But do you really think you can keep me here today?”
Whoosh!
Black Flames burned in the Void, and as the endless flames spread, a member of the Purgatory Demon Race appeared, ten meters tall with bulging muscles covered in a fierce blood-colored battle armor.
That towering presence was full of oppression, making the Void itself groan under the unbearable strain.
“War Demon King, Augusta.” King Cyril and Leo Hart both frowned slightly, not expecting the assassination attempt on Jack Clark to involve two Demon Kings.
The Demon Clan was being too cautious this time.
A cold smile appeared on Devianna’s face, “It’s a good thing I was cautious. Now it’s two against two; do you really think you can keep me here?”
While speaking, Devianna felt relieved inside. It was fortunate she had called upon Augusta; otherwise, being ganged up on by two Human Kings of equivalent Demon King mid-phase strength, today might indeed have been dangerous.
Although the Purgatory True Demon Clan claimed to be peerless within the same rank, which of those who had broken through to king-level didn’t have exceptional talent? Their racial advantages were already leveled.
“I think we can give it a try.” A deep voice full of terrifying Battle Intent suddenly rang out above in the clouds tens of thousands of meters high, where the figure of a towering presence slowly emerged.
The instant he appeared, a Battle Intent capable of fighting against Heaven and Earth, suppressing the universe, exploded, and heaven and earth trembled under this figure, with the atmosphere gathering and forming a hollow tens of kilometers wide.
The might was so terrifying that it surpassed King Cyril, the middle-aged king, and the two Demon Kings.
“Heaven Suppressing War King, Leo Hart, weren’t you trapped in some relic for over a hundred Sun Wheels (more than ten years)?” In an instant, Devianna and Augusta’s expressions changed slightly.
But the figure in the sky didn’t answer their questions, instead giving a long howl, “Let’s do it.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
The terrifying Sword Qi and Blade Intent around the silver-haired youth and the middle-aged man with sharp brows erupted, tearing apart heaven and earth, and the Heavenly Energy within tens of kilometers roared into motion.
Immediately, a battle between gods and demons broke out.

chapters.title: Chapter 803: 351 Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Long Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 803: Chapter 351 Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Long Chapter)
Boom!
The Human King and the Purgatory Demon King didn’t waste words; the grand battle erupted directly.
The silver-haired youth transformed into a sky-piercing and earth-shattering golden sword light in an instant, dazzling Heaven and Earth, with terrifying Sword Intent turning into a sword light galaxy coursing through the sky.
Countless horrifying sword lights exploded in the Void, shattering everything, with an awe-inspiring momentum.
The Sky Knife King, Joel Moore, crossed several kilometers in one step, emanating a grand aura that surged, and the combat knife in his hand intensified into a blade light hundreds of meters long, resembling bright jade.
Enveloped in substantial Blades Intent and Law Power, wherever he passed, space was torn asunder, forming a pitch-black plane that relentlessly stretched forth, slicing through everything.
In contrast to the silver-haired youth’s river of sword light, the Sky Knife King conveyed a more terrifying feeling.
Facing the siege of two Mid-Mythical Stage kings, War Demon King Augusta stood amidst endless black flames, his expression cold, and his eyes revealing a ferocious light.
Boom!
Boundless demon gas burst forth, and Augusta’s figure swelled rapidly, revealing in a blink of an eye a more than two hundred meter tall form, enshrouded in black Demonic Flames—the Demon King’s True Form.
On his ghastly arms, two Hell Demon Dragons formed from the Hell Demon Flame Laws coiled around, burning through the Void, commanding the dragons.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Instantly, countless golden sword lights bombarded the demon domain, made of over a thousand meters of endless hellish Demonic Flames; the two types of Law Power clashed, intertwining to form devastating impacts.
In the continuous canceling out, the vast golden Sword Qi suddenly changed, surrounding all directions, turning the sky into a golden Sword World.
Numerous golden sword lights whirled around, tearing apart the Demonic Flames of Hell, pulverizing everything, wearing down Augusta’s Law Power, forming suppression.
Surrounding Knife King Joel Moore was Blade Intent comparable to the Laws, thrusting into the demon domain, clashing head-on with War Demon King Augusta with each slash of his blade light as fast as lightning, every strike shaking Heaven and Earth.
The clashes of Law Power stirred up explosive shockwaves that swept over ten kilometers, with the momentum that could shake heaven and earth.
Occasionally, a burst of blade light or sword qi would fall to the ground, and the Earth would collapse instantly, forming several hundred-meter-long abyssal cracks, grinding over a hundred Mutated Creatures into flesh and blood fragments.
In that range of battle, space itself became extremely unstable under several types of extremely powerful Law Forces, constantly trembling.
With the joint efforts of the two kings, the seemingly dangerous Demon King Augusta was immediately suppressed.
From a distance, it looked as though Hell made of Demonic Flames had formed in the sky, surrounded and sealed by the golden Sword World, unable to break free.
The tactics of the silver-haired youth and Knife King Joel Moore were simple, merging the ultimate Sword Intent and Blade Intent with the True Martial Law. Although straightforward, their power was immensely strong, unmatched in offense.
In contrast to the Human King, Augusta, who mastered two types of Laws, was also very strong; facing the siege of the two Human Kings, he was only suppressed momentarily.
Just when the two kings were jointly besieging the powerful Demon King Augusta, Leo Hart, a figure even the two Demon Kings regarded with solemnity, also brazenly took action.
Boom!
The utmost terrifying strength released from Leo Hart, in an instant space around him distorted, even the red moonlight was drawn by the horrendous power, like a black hole.
Boom! With a majestic stature and an aura that filled Heaven and Earth, Leo Hart punched out, and instantly the Void roared, and Heaven and Earth trembled.
Under that fearsome punch, it seemed as though the entire world was crumbling, perishing, forming a broken shadow of the world descending from the sky, containing the ultimate destructive force of obliteration.
Devianna, who was locked onto by this punch and unable to evade, changed in color: “Fist of Heavenly Destruction!”
“But with this, you think you can kill me, the king? Impossible.”
Bang!!
Behind Devianna, the Void twisted and shattered, and hundreds of meters tall white bone claws emerged from the depths, wrapped in black Law Power, soaring into the air.
Boom!
At that moment, Leo Hart punched out once again, and immediately the space below condensed together, the sky shook, the Earth swayed, and under the unstoppable power, the white bone claws continuously crumbled.
Boom!
Under the Unrivaled Domination, space shattered, Devianna exploded, and ten thousand meter-high mountains kilometers behind her also collapsed thunderously, directly severed by the punch.
The halves of the mountains thousands of meters tall toppled, their rumbling shockwaves vibrating Heaven and Earth, with dust billowing and countless rocks shattering as if it was the Day of Judgment.
Just then, Leo Hart, standing high in the sky tens of thousands of meters up, delivered another punch, and instantly a two-hundred-meter-tall figure of the Void Demon King emerged in the distant Void.
Boom!
A fist full of absolute strength exploded everything, turning over a thousand meters of high-altitude space directly into Chaos, including Devianna who had just revealed her Demon King’s True Form.
There were no intricate and dazzling Laws, only the power of Unrivaled Domination.
However, Devianna bore the title of Void Demon King, mastered the Void Law, and her soul and body merged with Void, so despite being hit and ‘exploded’ twice consecutively, she was only weakened a bit in her aura.
But Devianna’s various mysterious Void techniques were inherently suppressed by Leo Hart’s “Only Me, Only Fist.”
With the addition of the gap in the late Mythical Stage, Devianna was suppressed in a one-sided fight and her aura weakened significantly after just a few exchanges.
Mythical-level Powerhouses command Laws and temper their souls and divine bodies with the power of Laws, making them extremely hard to kill in a short period.
Unless the gap between them is staggeringly enormous.
At this moment, under the clash of the five Mythical-level Powerhouses, Law Power stirred Heaven and Earth; within a hundred kilometers, raging winds howled, the Earth trembled, and the Heavenly Energy became incredibly turbulent.

chapters.title: Chapter 804: 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 804: Chapter 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_2
And after the engagement, the three human kings intentionally divided the battlefield, moving away from Jack Clark and others below.
Even so, the invisible aura that leaked out still pressed down on everyone below, leaving them all with shocked expressions.
Such formidable strength filled Hannah Gail and the others with boiling blood, while their True Strength erupted to resist the king-level pressure from all directions.
Under the terrifying might, the beast tide sweeping in from afar became restless under the Blood Moon, and a hint of awe could be seen in their eyes, filled with brutality and a lust for slaughter.
These Mutated Creatures were merely influenced by the Blood Moon, unleashing their more ferocious beast nature when attracted by the god attractor, but that did not mean they were completely mad and without reason.
Meanwhile, Purgatory Demon Karto’s expression grew solemn. It had not expected its plan to ambush Darren Callum to be met with a human ambush.
Three human kings and, with such strong kings joining hands, the two Demon Kings were suppressed from the outset, and there was a possibility that a demon king might fall today.
This thought made Karto’s face turn exceedingly ugly.
Because if it was due to its inaccurate information that led to the fall of a demon king today, it would be held accountable and possibly face trial by the empire’s upper echelons, even if it didn’t die.
As for Charles Klein, his face was now pale, his legs trembling because he knew he was finished.
Just then, Devianna’s cold voice came from the sky, somewhat urgent, “Karto, quick, kill those humans.”
Although they had fallen into a disadvantage as soon as the fight began, the two Demon Kings did not immediately flee, as the three human kings were tied down while they were being suppressed.
This meant that there was still hope of killing that Human Clan Genius.
Therefore, just as Devianna’s voice faded, on the other side within the Demon Flame Hell surrounded by the Gold Sword World, a huge black dragon head exploded.
Boom!
The terrifying power of the explosion tore a crack in the Gold Sword World, and red droplets like specks fell from the sky, emitting the scent that attracted beasts within hundreds of kms.
ROAR ROAR ROAR!!
In an instant, at the entrance of the mountain ranges, the countless Mutated Beasts deterred by the Mythical-level battle’s pressure roared even more frantically, thundering towards the valley.
The overwhelming force was astonishing, and in the sky, tens of thousands of flying exotic beasts roared madly, their wings spanning tens of meters, stirring up raging winds.
“Be careful.”
As Jack spoke, his War Halberd shone, sweeping out a blast of gold and red Pirefining that stretched hundreds of meters. In the sky, each Mutated Beast that came in contact with it was shredded and exploded.
Immediately afterward, four hundred-meter-long Golden Halberd Radiance shot out, resembling half-moons that continued to expand, finally exploding in the midst of the mutated birds flock in the sky.
BANG BANG BANG BANG!!
Four huge suns enveloped in golden flames appeared high in the sky, instantly turning flying beasts within hundreds of meters into ash with their extreme heat.
In just the blink of an eye, the thousands of mutated birds that had swooped down were annihilated, and their corpses fell from the impact of the explosion, sending smoke and dust flying everywhere.
But in the instant when Jack was tied down by the beast tide, at the entrance of the distant valley, Karto erupted with the powerful demon gas of the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven and swelled in size.
In the blink of an eye, a Purgatory True Demon standing over 50 meters tall with two heads and four arms appeared, with demon gas rolling over a 600-meter radius around it, forming a domain that interfered with space.
Suddenly, the terrifying demonic aura of the Purgatory True Demon Clan spread, and with the invisible suppression of their life hierarchy, Cathie Lawson and the other three changed colors.
With the Human Kings restrained, no one among them, who were at the beginning or mid-period of the Eight Layer Boundary, could hold back a Purgatory Demon of the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven.
The two Demon Kings, Devianna included, thought the same, given the vast gap between their realms.
But the Human Kings suppressing them were in no hurry because the records showed that Jack Clark had previously displayed strength comparable to the Nine Heavens during moves testing at the Forward Base.
Thus, even if he couldn’t win, he would be able to hold on for a while, long enough for them to kill the two Demon Kings.
“ROAR! Human, die.”
Boom!
The Earth shattered and, in a flash, Karto crossed several kilometers in a few steps, stirring up a torrent of demon gas that engulfed Jack Clark, powerful compressive forces coming from all directions.
The intense domain suppression scattered the Heavenly Energy around Jack, and at the same time, streaks of Dark Demon Air converged, forming a more than a hundred-meter-long Demon Dragon War Spear in Kato’s hands.
Boom!
The fearsome Dark War Spear pierced through space, creating a black pathway and sweeping countless Dark Demon Air to form a destructive Tornado, like a Demon Dragon emerging from the sea.
And in the moment when Karto’s domain suppression occurred, a red rune resembling an eye shone on Jack’s forehead, and blood light flooded the sky as the Doomsday Purgatory Domain unfolded.
BANG BANG BANG!!
The collision of the two domain powers created powerful shockwaves, flickering black and red Radiance, and blood light forcibly maintained a hundred-meter area within the demon gas domain.
Standing amidst the Blood Sea Hell, Jack was like a god or a demon, surrounded by blood light, his War Halberd glowed purple-red, transforming into a hundred-meter-long Purple-red War Halberd.
Boom!
The Thunderflame Halberd, entwined with Thunderflame, collided with the Demon Dragon War Spear, and a powerful shockwave exploded, shattering the Earth within hundreds of meters, and countless bits of dirt and stone soared into the sky.
With the intense impact of heat, destruction, and darkness, a black and red light ball that kept expanding blasted both domains apart.
In the tumultuous vortex’s center, within a crater over two hundred meters wide, Jack, with Thunder around him and golden flames burning, stood holding his halberd, blocking the Demon Dragon War Spear above him.

chapters.title: Chapter 805: 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 805: Chapter 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_3
From a distance, Charles Klein’s eyes widened in shock as he blurted out, “How is that possible!”
In his eyes, Darren was peerless within his rank. Merely the aura of the Ninth Heaven Purgatory True Demon, which struck terror and despair into people’s hearts, couldn’t suppress Jack Clark, who was at the Eight Layer Early Phase.
At that moment, not just Charles Klein, but Cathie Lawson and others showed stunned expressions on their faces.
At the early stage of the Eighth Layer, Jack Clark clashed with the True Demon of the Ninth Heaven in its true form without falling too far behind, which couldn’t help but be terrifyingly powerful.
Staring at the demon gas-enshrouded, two-headed four-armed True Demon towering more than 50 meters high, Jack Clark slowly said, “You, are very strong. Now, I will get serious.”
“Roar! Human, seeking death.”
Jack’s words made Karto feel insulted. It, a demon that had just reached the Early Stage Eight Path Demon Marks, commended by a human?
Karto’s arms behind its back reached for the Black Dragon War Spear. An even more powerful strength erupted, and the entire Dark Domain ferociously pressed down on Jack.
Boom!
Jack felt a weight descend upon him as the Purple-red War Halberd, composed of his domain and True Dragon Power, became unstable, constantly shaking as the Earth sank ten meters in a radius of a hundred meters around him.
But still, it couldn’t completely crush Jack.
Previously, when he was in the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer, Jack’s normal battle strength had reached the late stage of the Eight Layer. With a limit breakthrough into the Battle Emperor Dragon State, he was nearly on par with the peak of the Eighth Layer.
After crossing the Late Sevenfold Sky and breaking through to the Eighth Layer, opening the Fourfold Illusionary World, and condensing the True Dragon Battle Body, his normal peak was the early stage of the Ninth Heaven with the blessings of five King-level talents.
Jumping from the early stages of the Eight Layer to the early stages of the Ninth Heaven, his battle strength crossed an entire Major Realm, horrifying and shocking.
Then, after the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon broke through to the late stages of Level 9, he reached quasi-mythical status, and with the start of its fifth evolution, he began to surpass the Mythical Giant Beast, providing feedback that made Jack’s physical body even more terrifying.
As his foundation grew stronger, so did his power become ever more dreadful.
Especially with the twenty-fold increase in strength and defense granted by his King-level talents, his physical body’s power surge became even more exaggerated.
Now, clashing head-on with Karto at close range, Jack felt that his normal peak battle power was already comparable to a mid-stage Ninth Heaven.
With such a huge leap in strength, even Jack was surprised and excited.
Because initially, when the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was at the early level eight, it could only just clash with normal early-stage Level 9 beasts until its talent was enhanced, and its bloodline reached Emperor level, allowing it to kill mid-stage Level 9 beasts.
However, with his current strength, easily killing this True Demon in two strikes would be challenging.
Boom!
Jack’s body radiated brilliantly, his inner energy bursting with masculine and unyielding Qi Blood, forming a blood-colored vapor that pierced the Cloud Sky.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the boundless eruption of Qi Blood, black-red scaled armor emerged on Jack’s body, and his form rapidly expanded. In the blink of an eye, he displayed a True Dragon Battle Body over forty meters tall and with three faces and six arms.
Behind him, blue-black Thunder and golden flames converged, solidifying into two pairs of arms wielding Thunder and flames.
Four coronas of yellow, gold, black, and blue appeared behind his head, slowly spinning. They faintly formed four Illusory Fourfold Worlds.
The face in the middle looked imposing. The third eye on his forehead shone with blood-colored light, the left side bore the indifferent face of a Demon God, and the right side remained a blurry mystery.
As Jack displayed his True Dragon Battle Body and held a hundred-meter-long Black-gold battle halberd, a ferociously dominant aura emanated from him, instilling fear in all living things in an instant.
Under the terrifying and heavy breath, the Earth collapsed again, the magnetic field in a kilometer radius became chaotic, losing gravity, numerous shards of rock and dirt quivered and hovered, creating an ambiance as if an ancient War God had descended.
As Jack brandished the War Halberd, heavy enough to twist space and reinforced by his domain and the Fourfold Illusionary World, he swept horizontally.
Boom!
Space itself shattered, cracking open fissures. Before Karto could react, the surrounding domain crumbled, and it was blasted away by an indescribable force.
Boom! Karto transformed into a black streak of light and crashed heavily onto a mountain ridge thousands of kilometers away, causing the mountains to collapse and the ancient trees to break, with billowing clouds of smoke and dust spreading far and wide.
Immediately, shock appeared on everyone’s faces as they watched the casual strike that sent Karto flying; everyone was in disbelief.
Is this the power that an Eight Layer Early Stage cultivator is supposed to possess!!??
At that moment, Charles Klein began for the first time to doubt his choices, questioning whether his betrayal of the Human Race to join the Purgatory Demon Clan was a mistake given such human strength.
Too dominant.
There was no flashy show of power, just extreme dominance blasting everything away.
At the foot of the distant mountain, Gentry Levin couldn’t help but lick his lips with frenzied excitement, shouting, “Darren Callum, brother, kill it. Finish off those despicable beings.”
Such staggering might shocked everyone in the high altitude battle, including Monarchs and demon kings.
“The Eight Demonic Marks Realm, and yet he possesses such might. Kill him. We must kill him today no matter what,” Devianna, merged with the Void, cried out frantically.
Roaring ferociously, Augusta, oppressed by two Monarchs and standing amidst the Demon Flame World, shouted, “Karto, burn your bloodline and kill him. When you return, this Monarch will grant you True God’s blood.”
That human was only at the early Eighth Layer, yet the might of his limit breakthrough was already comparable to the late stage of the Ninth Heaven. This terrifying leap in power was too dreadful.
If such a monster entered the realm of Monarchs, he would be invincible among his peers, slaying demon kings as if they were slaughtering dogs.

chapters.title: Chapter 806: 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 806: Chapter 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_4
At this moment, the two demon kings even entertained the thought that they would sacrifice their lives just to slay that monster, this member of the Human Race must die, must die.
“Go back, do you think you still have any hope of returning?”
Boom, boom, boom!! In an instant, the silver-haired youth, Knife King Joel Moore, and War King Elmore Hall wielded even more powerful rule energy in their hands, shaking Heaven and Earth.
“I am the True Devil King, a mere Human Race thinks to kill us, then come fill the gap with your lives.”
Boom, boom!!
Instantly, Devianna and Augusta erupted with endless demon gas, their bloodline strength ignited, and their aura surged several times over in a formidable counterattack.
To create an opportunity for Kato, the two demon kings who still had some reserve strength now burst forth, burning their bloodline strength, ready to engage in a damaging struggle with the three human kings.
This is the strength of the Purgatory True Demon Clan.
Integrating their power system into a bloodline inheritance, all newborn Purgatory True Demons are able to cultivate, awakening martial arts suited to themselves among countless bloodline factors and controlling powerful rules.
In addition, Purgatory True Demons can burn their bloodline strength in a fight to the death, greatly enhancing their foundational power and amping up their demonic Divine Powers to slay their enemies.
Although they would fall into weakness after burning their bloodline and need to consume numerous Heaven and Earth Treasures and time to recover, this also equates to having an additional Divine Secret Skill, making the Purgatory True Demon Clan stronger among their peers.
Suddenly, the mythic battle in the skies entered a heated phase, exceedingly brutal, and the three silver-haired youths, who were originally planning to slowly grind their enemies down, also went all out.
In the collapsing mountain ridge ruins, after hearing Augusta’s promise to give it a drop of True God’s blood, coupled with the humiliation of being casually blown away by a human with a single strike, Karto’s eyes turned red.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Human, I will kill you, Lord Karto will kill you.”
In a frenzy, even Karto’s soul began to burn, forming a layer of blood-colored flames that fiercely enveloped his body, his aura instantaneously increasing tenfold.
Boom!
Surrounded by an endless dark demon air, Karto’s size swelled once more to over sixty meters, a bulge formed on his neck, and another pair of arms grew out from under his armpits.
At the same time, a pair of bat-like Black Wings unfolded behind Karto, stirring up the sky full of dark demon air and soaring into the heavens.
Watching Karto, enveloped in dark demon air, Jack Clark’s gaze was cold, the Fourfold World Halo behind his head shimmered instantly, and the War Halberd in his hand sank once more.
