Boom! The Power of Heaven and Earth was amplified fiftyfold, and the aura of Battle Intent fused with the domain to increase by fifteenfold. The Heavenly Energy within a range of tens of kilometers surged wildly towards him.
Furthermore, with scorching golden flames and Thunderflame compressed and fused, Jack’s War Halberd instantly emitted a dazzling Radiance, like a +9999 ultimate artifact.
“Roar! Hundred Souls Lock Heaven.”
Accompanying Karto’s roar, as he neared Jack and descended from the sky, the Black Dragon War Spear, converging endless demon gas in his hand, pierced the Earth.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Instantly, the Earth around Jack within a kilometer radius shattered, and dozens of chains, thick as tens of meters and burning with Black Flames, rose into the sky, like Demon Dragons shooting towards him.
Bang, bang, bang!!
The War Halberd, emitting dazzling Radiance, swept across all directions, obliterating everything within hundreds of meters instantly, including those Black Chains that resembled poisonous dragons.
The Overbearing strength was unmatched, immovable.
“Roar! Hell Devours Heaven.” Karto spread his six arms wide, his body covered in numerous bizarre demon patterns that shimmered.
Boom!
A Hell Demon’s colossal head, hundreds of meters in size, emerged above Jack, its invisible Aura affecting even Hannah Gail, who felt her Spiritual Will strongly suppressed.
This move, designed to suppress the soul and attack the Spiritual Will, couldn’t shake Jack at all. With the Illusion Meditation Scripture in operation, a black hand emerged from the Void, holding the Emperor Seal.
Boom! Under the strike of the Soul Emperor, the Hell Demon’s head shattered instantly, and the backlash left Karto’s Aura in disarray.
Comparatively, Karto, who was burning his bloodline at this time, was more like a Mage, casting extremely potent True Devil Battle Skills.
After two consecutive attacks were effortlessly crushed by Jack, madness gleamed in Karto’s eyes as it bit off one of its own arms, blood spraying.
“Roar! In my name, with my blood as sacrifice, open the gates of Hell, summon…”
Boom!
Just then, Jack’s War Halberd cleaved through the air, instantly unleashing an arc of purplish-blue Halberd Skill spanning over three hundred meters, bursting forth like a crescent moon.
Cracking the Earth in its path, a colossal rift-spanning over a thousand meters formed, like a laser beam suddenly appearing in front of Karto, tearing through the domain.
The keenness and destructive Aura of the True Thunder Instant Slash startled Karto, who crossed his five arms in front of him, gathering endless Dark Demon Air to form a ten-meter-thick Magic Crystal wall.
Boom!
Under the supremely sharp strike, the Magic Crystal wall shattered, Karto’s scale armor on its arms exploded, its mouth spouting blood, and its huge body was sent flying with a thunderous impact.
Boom! Karto crashed into the mountain ridge over two thousand meters away, smoke and dust billowing.
And just as Karto was blasted away with a single blow, Jack’s figure surged up into the sky, appearing above the ruined mountain ridge.
Behind him, Thunderflame four-armed seals, the Fourfold Void World Halo brightly shining, both arms raised high with the halberd, the surroundings exploded with endless blood light, forming a Doomsday Domain spanning a kilometer.
Amidst the surging Sea of Blood, a dark red world with a diameter of hundreds of meters descended from the sky, like a star plummeting to the Earth, emitting terrifying fluctuations capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 807: 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 807: Chapter 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_5
Slayer Demon Seven Cuts fourth move, Great Thousand Burial.
Destroying everything with the power of a ‘world’ shattering.
Boom!
The moment the dark red world hit the ground, Heaven and Earth shook, and a gigantic nuclear explosion of light rose slowly above the mountain ridge; half of the mountain collapsed under this strike.
Under the ultimate destructive power, the Earth shattered, and surrounding the rapidly expanding dark red destructive Light sphere, countless fragments of rock erupted in all directions like a Hundred-meter Tsunami.
In the terrifying ‘world’ explosion, the scorching energy impact compressed the atmosphere, creating rings of white waves surging thousands of meters across.
Then came the scorching raging wind, snapping large trees tens of meters high and causing hundreds of meters tall trees to turn yellow and burn, instantly transforming into towering torches.
Mutant Beasts, under the scorching sharp explosion impact, had their scale armor blasted apart, flesh and blood charred black, forming a vast area of death that spread over thousands of kilometers.
In the center of the violent explosive energy, flames burned, and within the huge ring-shaped crater lay a 60-plus meter high corpse, now only a pile of broken skeletons, silently resting.
On what remained of Karto’s ferocious face, a look of intense horror and unwillingness was apparent; he stared fixedly at the sky.
There, surrounded by lightning and flames, Jack Clark was like an ancient War God, with a Halo rotating behind him, holding a halberd, standing amidst the Blood Sea Hell.
After a cold glance at Karto’s corpse, Jack Clark slightly turned and, surrounded by swirling waves of air, stepping on empty air he moved a few steps above Charles Klein with terrifying might.
“I’m not reconciled!” Despair in his eyes, Charles Klein watched as numerous black venomous snakes converged behind him, forming a longsword True Martial arts phantom of several tens of meters.
Bang!
Under Jack Clark’s casual palm strike, Charles Klein’s True Martial arts phantom was instantly shattered by the terrifying Power of Heaven and Earth, blood spewing from his mouth, then he was caught in the palm of a hand.
Crack!!
Under the slightly stronger grip of Jack Clark’s hand, Charles Klein’s entire body’s bones shattered, his True Strength dissipating as he was gravely injured and dying.
But Jack Clark did not kill him. It was too easy to just kill him like this. First, capture him to extract the soul and all secrets; only after confessing everything could he die.
“Mr. Gail, keep an eye on him.”
Jack Clark tossed Charles Klein towards Hannah Gail in the distance and then looked towards the restless tide of beasts, with madness and killing intent surfacing in his slightly red eyes under the influence of Battle Intent.
……
Boom!
In the distance, Leo Hart punched, splitting Heaven and Earth, and massive dark cracks spread in all directions. Under the terrifying destructive force, Devianna fell from the sky, blood spewing from her mouth.
Boom!
The plains collapsed instantly, forming a gigantic crater of a thousand meters in diameter, destruction waves kicked up, sweeping a radius of several kilometers.
Facing the Overbearing Unrivaled Domination of late-stage Myth Leo Hart, Devianna, even at full power, could only hold on for a moment before being heavily injured.
Boom Boom Boom!!
On another battlefield, King Cyril and Knife King Joel Moore joined forces, tearing apart Demon Flame Hell, furiously battling Augusta who was burning with bloodline power, starting to exchange blow for blow.
Under the Bright Jade War Sword that severed everything and the Golden Sword that tore the sky, Augusta’s Demon King’s True Form had large wounds slashed open; above, Sword Intent and Blade Intent flowed, eroding Vitality.
After a short period of attrition, the two king-level characters began to press even harder against the War Demon King, trapping him.
Next, they just had to wait for Leo Hart to defeat Devianna, and then it would be its turn.
The two Demon Kings were very aware of their predicament, their eyes filled with seriousness. Now their injuries were not severe yet, and they had hope to escape with grave injuries after using their trump cards.
But…
Seeing the Human Race who had killed Karto in the distance, Augusta revealed a ferocious killing intent and roared, “Devianna, stop holding back.”
Surrounded by Demon Flame Hell, Augusta’s Demon Power burst forth, with two thousand-meter-long dragons roaring around him, his claw covered in blood-colored scale armor clashing hard against the Blade Light.
Boom Boom!! Under the terrifying power explosion, the silver-haired youth and Knife King were repelled.
Then Augusta spread his palms, and behind him, a more majestic phantom emerged from Hell’s Demonic Flames, his six arms gesturing, chanting incomprehensible spells.
“(unknown runes)”
Boom!
In an instant, Augusta’s aura soared, and a corner of a transparent long river emerged behind him, on which a two-hundred-meter-tall Augusta, clad in blood-red battle armor, stepped out.
Boom!
With two Demon Kings from different times existing simultaneously, a strong rejection force from the present burst forth in an instant but was blocked by the majestic phantom behind Augusta.
“Augusta, you’ve gone mad,” Devianna’s complexion drastically changed at the sight, her mouth bleeding.
Both Augustas spoke simultaneously, their voices deep and brutal, “Today, we must kill that human, for the consequences are unthinkable if he were to grow stronger.”
In the high altitude, the middle-aged man’s expression grew solemn: “It’s the Time Rule of Devil God Emperor Eros. This Demon King is sacrificing his own Demon God bloodline, Summoning the past to descend.”
“Hold it back, its past Demon King form can’t last long. Cutting down its past will allow us to kill it completely.”
Saying this, Knife King Joel Moore roared, unleashing an even greater Blade Intent that pierced the heavens, forming Blade Lights that could shake the stars from the sky.
At the same time, the silver-haired youth’s eyes revealed a pure gold long sword, an endless outpouring of golden light erupting from him as the center, turning the entire sky into a Gold Sword World.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Both Augustas made their move, whipping up tempestuous Demon Power; an even more horrifying power burst forth instantly, tearing apart the silver-haired youth’s gold sword world formed by the rule of Sword Intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 808: 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 808: Chapter 351: Space-Time Summoning, The Arrival of the Thunderflame Behemoth (Large Chapter)_6
“Roar! Get out of my way,” Augusta roared, flames of blood burning on his body and endless demon gas bursting, shaking Heaven and Earth and desperately blocking King Cyril and Knife King Joel Moore despite his injuries.
Meanwhile, the avatar of the past, only at the early stages of mythology, took advantage of the moment when the Sword World was torn apart, turned into a beam of black radiance, and shot out toward Jack Clark, who was tens of kilometers away.
Knife King Joel Moore and the silver-haired youth’s expressions changed slightly, “Not good, stop him.”
Boom! Leo Hart, standing above the Firmament, clenched his right fist, and in an instant, a vast Fist Intent gathered around him.
But just as Leo Hart was about to make his move, Devianna plunged her hand into her chest, and a fountain of demon king blood erupted.
Under the sacrifice of the demon king’s blood, the Void behind Devianna collapsed, and from the pitch-black depths, a creature that was a hybrid of bones and king’s crown, towering a kilometer high, emerged.
Boom! A huge white bone claw stretched out from the Void, under which all matter, space, and laws crumbled to dust before the claw’s terrifying might.
“Hmph! You think that sacrificing the essence blood of a demon king and summoning an Abyss Bone Demon can stop me?”
With a cold snort, Leo Hart’s fist shone with dazzling golden light, and a Fist Intent that could suppress all exploded forth, bursting everything apart, shattering the sky and eradicating all things with one strike.
Including that Abyss Bone Claw.
Roar! From the depths of the Void, the Abyss Bone Demon let out a fierce roar, struggling to climb out of the Void.
Just as the silver-haired youth was preparing to risk injury to stop Augusta, Jack Clark suddenly shouted, “Dear thrones, leave this mere ordinary mythical avatar to me.”
Suddenly everyone paused.
The three kings were somewhat reassured, thinking Jack Clark was ready to rely on the forbidden weapon in his hand, but Hannah Gail and the others were a bit stunned.
Brother, that’s a demon king! Its strength can shatter Heaven and Earth with the power of the Law. It’s not like those of the Ninth Heaven Purgatory Demon Clan that you just slaughtered.
“Human, I will cast your soul into the flames of Hell and burn it for a thousand years,” the slighted Augusta roared in rage, and from a dozen kilometers away, he reached out a claw that instantly covered the entire sky above Jack Clark with black Demonic Flames.
Endless Demonic Flames gathered and spun, forming a Hell that descended from the sky to destroy all, with laws locking space, leaving no escape or avoidance.
Facing this strike, Jack Clark shrank in size, returning to normal stature in the blink of an eye; in his hand appeared a 0.5-meter scale wrapped in black-red lightning.
Boom! As Jack Clark planted the black-red scale into the ground, his left hand emitted dazzling gloomy blue light, and endless streams of Rune Sequence Chains burst forth.
In an instant, those runes formed a blue altar with a diameter of 300 meters around Jack Clark as its center.
The moment the altar was formed, it connected with a horrific creature in a distant region, and a world-shaking, ferocious roar echoed through Heaven and Earth.
Roar!
In the midst of the roar, the altar sparkled with light, and a giant black-red colossal paw thunderously reached out, followed by a fearsome black-red dragon head.
Under everyone’s shocked gaze, a black-red Colossal Beast, over 360 meters long, rose up from behind Jack Clark.
Wrapped in black lightning, the ferocious behemoth’s shadow emitted an aura of complete destruction, with strands of golden light moving across its body, conveying unbreakable strength.
In an instant, an aura of primordial savagery and ripping myths apart spread, and under its Terrifying Aura, everyone instinctively trembled in fear and awe.
Even figures like Augusta, at the level of mythology, instinctively felt palpitations, a fear born from a difference in the essence of life.
Roar! The black-red beast roared towards the sky.
Boom! Under the colossal paw wrapped in black lightning, the Demonic Flames that covered the sky and locked space were torn apart.
With a slight shift of its immense body, the beast moved with a terrifying speed that surpassed sensory perception, bursting through the Void to appear right before Augusta.
Boom!
Under the colossal paw wrapped in black Destructive Lightning, the Demon Flame Hell revolving around Augusta instantly shattered, and the demon king’s true form collapsed in his chest, falling as a streak of light from the sky.
Boom!
The Earth collapsed, and the endless Demonic Flames dispersed in an explosion, forming a wave of black Destructive Impact that swept across dozens of kilometers, burning everything on the Earth to ash.
In an instant, Cathie Lawson and the others were rendered speechless.
The three kings fighting in the distance were also a bit shocked; they hadn’t expected that the giant shadow summoned by Jack Clark would be so powerful that it shattered the true form of a mythically early stage demon king with a single strike.
Knife King Joel Moore was also a bit stunned, “That youngster can actually summon such a terrifying colossal beast projection!?”
“Looks like the altar resembles that space-time summoning secret skill of the person from the Green Hills,” one of them observed.
As the three king-level beings felt shocked, the Demonic Flames of Hell burning on the distant ground suddenly converged, reconstituting the body of the demon king Augusta.
This is the difficulty of dealing with Mythical-level creatures, with laws that are undying, making them very hard to kill.
However, being difficult to kill doesn’t mean they can’t be killed, it simply means killing them multiple times.
“This king doesn’t believe you can hold on much longer,” Augusta’s eyes revealed a frenzy as he stirred up the Demonic Flames of Hell toward the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, preparing to wear out Jack Clark.
He had seen such summoning methods before—they seemed strong, but the stronger the force projection of the summoned creature, the greater the consumption for the summoner.
As a cultivator marked with eight Path Demon Marks, he did not believe that this human called Darren Callum could last very long.
It was like the time he had summoned and descended, only that in his case, the cost of summoning was borne by the rule power of the Demon God bloodline, so it could last significantly longer.
Boom!
Surrounded by demon dragons, the formidable body of the demon king Augusta struck the projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with a claw, but couldn’t even shake it; the projection, emitting a faint golden light, stood unyielding amid the burning Demonic Flames.
Such formidable defense made even Augusta pause momentarily.
Boom! A Tail Blade that sliced through the void swept across, and with a strike entwined with Destructive Lightning, it severed Augusta in half at the waist instantaneously.
At the same time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s double claws reached out, grabbed the upper body with three heads and six arms of Augusta, and with a Power Explosion, tore him in two amid his screams.
As Augusta’s true body disintegrated into Demonic Flames of Hell, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s double claws burst with black lightning, booming and causing the surrounding Demonic Flames to shake continuously.
Under the bombardment of powerful strength, the earth within thousands of meters fractured, and Heaven and Earth seemed to split apart.
The grand accomplishment realm of space-time summoning secret skill could summon a projection of three-tenths the strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
But apart from strength, there were also the transformed Higher-order Laws of Destruction and Vajra, and with the empowerment of Rule Power, its combat strength was enough to overpower an ordinary demon king.
Whew! The Demonic Flames of Hell gathered in the distance, and Augusta appeared again, only this time his aura was much weaker.
Just then, the ferocious behemoth, moving almost beyond the temporal limits with its Agility Talent and wrapped in black lightning, had already appeared behind him.
Boom! The ferocious giant claw crushed the Void, and with a thunderous noise, Augusta was slammed onto the ground, shattering the earth within a kilometer range instantly.
“Roar! How is it possible, Higher-order Laws!” the stunned Augusta exclaimed from under the giant claw, because his true form could not escape into the Demonic Flames of Hell under the suppression of the Supreme Destruction Law.
Hum!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, pinning down Augusta with a single claw, gathered terrifying energy in its mouth as endless black lightning converged, like a black hole, emitting a Terrifying Aura capable of destroying everything.
Boom!
A breath of pure Destructive Law Power erupted from the mouth of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, turning into a black beam that struck Augusta with a crash.
Endless Black Flames erupted from Augusta’s body.
Boom, boom, boom! The world shook and quaked under the terrifying pummeling of the Power of Destruction Law.
Facing the pure Power of the Destruction Law, Augusta could not resist. His body was ripped apart piece by piece by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, incessantly melting away under the black Destructive Lightning.
“No!”
Augusta, who was being restrained by two kings in the distance, let out a roar of unwillingness.
If the past falls, naturally, there will be no present.
Boom!
A force from the past descended, enveloping Augusta in the present.
“How can I die, I am a descendant of the Demon God, it’s impossible for me to die!” the present Augusta burst out with Terrifying Power, attempting to resist the erasure of the Time Rule.
But under the unwavering might of Time, Augusta’s true form of the demon king still slowly disintegrated and eventually disappeared along with the past demon king under the breath of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In an instant, Heaven and Earth fell silent; no one expected Augusta to fall so quickly.
In the distance, the three-hundred-meter blue summoning altar shone brightly. In the middle of the altar, Jack Clark stood firm, with an indescribable Terrifying Aura emanating from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 809: 352 Blood Flows Into Rivers, Slaughter Demon God
chapters.content:
Chapter 809: Chapter 352 Blood Flows Into Rivers, Slaughter Demon God
With the fall of Demon King Augusta, its laws dispersed and manifested, forming a Blood Moon in the high sky.
Roar!
On the shattered Earth, a ferocious behemoth surrounded by black lightning lifted its head and roared into the sky. Under the backdrop of the falling Blood Moon, it appeared incredibly fierce, its terrible presence shaking Heaven and Earth, intangible yet palpable.
In the distance, countless Mutated Beasts trembled, daring not to move an inch.
In that moment, the Black-red Colossal Beast that tore apart a demon king stood like a Monarch among beasts, its aura overwhelming. It had cold, golden vertical pupils as it slowly turned, surveying all directions from above.
Wherever its gaze fell, every Mutated Beast instinctively knelt, not daring to meet its eyes, until the terrifying beast let out a low roar, “Demon King, how weak.”
In the faint roar, the terrifying beast disappeared from sight.
Whoosh! Immediately, the oppressive atmosphere between heaven and earth loosened, and everyone was surprised that the War Demon King Augusta could be annihilated so suddenly.
Even Augusta itself, until its death, couldn’t believe it was worn down so quickly in the early phase of Eighth Layer Heaven by a human.
Above the vast sky, the silver-haired youth who suddenly lost his opponent looked down with a solemn expression, “That is a Higher-order Law that contains the power of destruction!”
Shepherd Army nodded slowly, “And it’s not just one type.”
“That Giant Beast’s body ignoring Augusta’s attack, that golden strength, it must also be a type of Higher-order Law, otherwise, its defense couldn’t be so terrifying.”
“Two Higher-order Laws, this Mythical Giant Beast is very strong, no, that beast hasn’t reached Mythical-level yet.”
“From the Power Projection, its body length is only over three hundred meters, breaking the limit of an Extraordinary Creature, but it has not yet reached the standard of a Mythical Giant Beast.”
“Which means… ”
Hiss! Even the silver-haired youth and Knife King Joel Moore showed shock in their eyes.
A Horrific Creature on the cusp of quasi-mythical yet not entirely transformed into a Mythical Giant Beast had, through projection alone, suppressed an Early Myth demon king.
Just a projection, and it possessed such terrifying strength! How strong must the physical body be?
As the two Monarchs were shocked by their own conjectures, Hannah Gail was also flabbergasted.
“Brother Callum actually cultivated the Summoning Secret Skill to grand accomplishment and formed a contract with such a terrifying beast!”
As a direct descendant of the Gail Family, after years of practice, he had only cultivated the Summoning Secret Skill to minor achievement, capable of Summoning one-tenth of the Power Projection of the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox.
But Jack had only been practicing the Space-Time Summoning Technique for two or three months, right? This guy is too abnormal, even his Secret Method practice speed is exaggerated.
Roar roar roar!!
Just then, as the vicious aura of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon dissipated, those beasts gathered because of the god attractor became restless again, their blood-red eyes filled with brutality and bloodthirstiness.
Meanwhile, under the light of the distant Blood Moon, a beast measuring over one hundred and ninety meters in body length and a hundred meters at the shoulder, covered in dark scale armor, appeared.
This Level 9 Giant Beast resembled a black Kirin from the legends. Its fierce dragon-like head emitted a terrifying King-level bloodline aura, which made countless Giant Beasts instinctively prostrate themselves.
Upon its arrival, the behemoth glanced hesitantly at the high altitude tens of kilometers away, where two Mythical-level beings were still engaged in fierce combat.
At Level 9, even the power of the Blood Moon could only make this Giant Beast somewhat restless, without completely affecting its mind.
However, the Divine Object Aura emitted from the valley in the distance made even this Level 9 Giant Beast somewhat impatient.
The red fluid that Augusta threw out, the ‘impurities’ refined from the Blood of Demon God, contained a frenzied strength so extreme that normal life could not absorb it without being burst apart.
But for Mutated Creatures, those impurities, refined from the Essence Blood of countless lifeforms, are supreme Divine Objects. The extremely frenzied Blood Qi could stimulate their bloodlines to evolve, and the effect was substantial even for Level 9 Giant Beasts.
After sensing the dangerous but seemingly ‘weak’ creature in the distance, as well as a few ordinary life Auras, the Giant Beast let out a ferocious roar.
Roar! Under the roar of the Level 9 Giant Beast, countless Mutated Beasts became agitated once again; then with a thunderous noise, they rushed toward the valley where a ten thousand meter mountain peak had collapsed.
With tens of thousands of Mutated Beasts converging, another beast tide was formed, its terrifying presence causing Cathie Lawson and the others to pale.
Standing at a high altitude, overseeing the scene below, the silver-haired youth spoke with a grave voice, “It’s just an ordinary beast tide. Kill that Level 9 lifeform and smash the mountain ranges to separate and dispel the Unique Beasts.”
The two Monarchs were unconcerned; it was just a normal beast tide, not a Mythical Giant Beast causing a deluge that could engulf millions of kilometers during a Red Moon apocalypse.
However, as they were about to take action with the contraction of the Space-Time Altar, Jack shouted weakly, “No need to disperse the beast tide, Your Honors.”
“Why?” The silver-haired youth paused in the sky.
Jack’s lips curved upwards, and his eyes revealed a bloodthirsty red gleam, “Because they can enhance my strength.” With that, a Death Invincibility Battle Intent erupted from him.
Boom!
In an instant, a blood light burst forth from Jack, covering hundreds of meters around him, endless Killing Intent solidifying behind him into a twenty-meter tall blood-colored Illusion.
As the Demon God Illusion materialized from the War Intent Condensation, countless monstrous creatures in the surrounding Doomsday Hell struggled and roared, celebrating its arrival.
Suddenly to Hannah Gail and the others’ perception, Jack, despite looking extremely Blood Qi depleted, radiated an inexplicably powerful aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 810: 352 Blood Flows Into Rivers, Slaughter Demon God_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 810: Chapter 352 Blood Flows Into Rivers, Slaughter Demon God_2
Prison Blood War Intent [Grand Accomplishment: A special force of battle intent, bathed in blood, the Demon God manifests.
When the battle intent is activated, a Demon Shadow formed from slaughter and destruction is condensed, drawing upon the energy of Heaven and Earth, drastically enhancing the destructive power of all attacks.
Thirst for Killing: During battle, when enemies are slain, the Demon Shadow will absorb Blood Fiend to permanently increase its might, the more lives it takes, the stronger the Demon Shadow becomes.
Death Invincibility: When severely wounded in combat causing a significant drop in Qi Blood, the Invincible Intent is activated. The more severe the injury and the greater the consumption of Qi Blood, the stronger the battle intent.
For Jack Clark, who possessed the battle intent of Thirst for Killing, weren’t these beast tides drawn forth by the Blood Moon and the red liquid the best nutrition for the Demon Shadow?
It was just right; he had overexerted himself while summoning the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon earlier, with his Blood Qi dropping to less than ten percent, directly entering the state of Death Battle Intent.
Under normal conditions, given Jack’s terrifying physique and the integration of his soul and body, it would have been enough to support the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon Projection in battle for a long time.
However, in order to quickly kill Augusta’s past form, he had unleashed the Breath of Destruction Law, using pure Law Power to erode the opponent’s Undying Demonic Body.
In such circumstances, the consumption on Jack was also extremely terrifying, with massive amounts of Qi Blood disappearing every second like a landslide, transformed into the power of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon Projection under the calling of the rule.
This was also the reason Augusta could not die contented.
It never imagined that Jack could hold on for so long, long enough to erode a Mythical True Body.
Boom!
Within a hundred-meter radius, the Earth shattered, and surrounded by Doomsday Hell, Jack held the Eight Desolate War Heaven. Halberd, charging into the endless beast tide like a red Light Beam.
Just as he plunged into the beast tide, the Blood Colored Battle Spear in Jack’s hand swept across, creating a hundred-meter-long arc of blood light around him.
Bang Bang Bang!! With a sweep of the halberd, all the Level 4 and Level 5 mutated beasts within a hundred-meter radius kept exploding, their tough scales shattering, flesh and blood flying.
Roar!
A Level 8 Violent Dragon Beast, standing more than 50 meters tall and measuring over 90 meters in length, roared a kilometer away, with intense energy gathering in its mouth, emitting a red Radiance…
But even before the Eighth Level Beast could unleash its Breath, a hundred-meter-long Blood Colored Battle Spear swept across the sky, bringing down a red tornado.
Boom! The beast’s head exploded, its neck, blurred with flesh and blood, spouting blood like a high-pressure water gun, a horrific scene.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
Beneath the Blood Moon, the whole world turned a crimson red, as countless exotic beasts from the sky and the ground surged toward the valley like a tide, the Earth shaking and the air roaring with their charges.
In front of these beasts, Jack was like a barrier, turning into a red radiance slashing back and forth, sweeping away everything in his path, with countless Giant Beasts exploding, flesh and blood flying around him.
Under the Doomsday Purgatory Domain, with the weight of over 5000 tons and with the support of four rotating halos behind his head, Jack’s War Halberd became extremely heavy, and no beast could stand in his way.
At that moment, Jack, aside from occasionally using a burst of True Strength to bombard powerful distant beasts, was entirely relying on his pure and overbearing physical strength in battle.
Moving at six times the speed of sound, every swing of the War Halberd caused everything around him to explode, with the vacuum pressure from his immense strength destroying everything within a hundred-meter radius.
Whether it was flying exotic beasts swooping down from the sky or enormous beasts with formidable defenses on the ground, all were blasted to pieces.
Under such a terrifying slaughter, the mutated beasts and Giant Beasts were not intimidated but became even more frenzied under the influence of the Blood Moon and the intense smell of blood.
Roar Roar Roar!! Various exotic beasts with long-range capabilities unleashed their Power Explosions, blanketing Jack, now a blood light, in attack, shattering the Earth with thunderous blasts.
However, most of these wide-range attacks were blocked by the large beasts, and the few that weren’t were dodged by the terrifyingly fast Jack.
Only some lock-on attacks that couldn’t be evaded managed to hit Jack, causing just a shake to the surrounding Doomsday Hell and making the golden red protective True Strength around him shine even brighter.
And while Jack was rampaging across the land, annihilating countless exotic beasts, the silver-haired youth and Knife King Joel Moore, seeing he was unharmed, pounced towards the Void Demon King Devianna.
In an instant, a more ferocious battle erupted around Devianna.
Already suppressed by the powerfully strong Leo Hart, it suffered heavy injuries after just a short exchange, having its Demon King’s True Form blasted apart multiple times by his overbearing Fist Intent.
Now with two Human Kings who were no less powerful than it joining the fray, it completely lost the power to fight back.
“Even if I die today, I will take a Human King down with me,” Devianna went completely mad, knowing that there was no escape.
The response to its declaration was an even more overbearing punch from Leo Hart.
Boom! In an instant, the sky was filled with cracks.
…
“Does Brother Darren have an endless supply of True Strength and physical power?”
Standing on the mountain ridge, Reginald Vinson and others watched Jack’s frenzied slaughter in the valley below, all too shocked to say anything.
For the first time, they realized that a high-ranking powerhouse could be this powerful.
He was capable of cutting down a Mid-term of Ninth Heaven Purgatory Demon Race in the Eighth Layer Early Phase, even summons unknown ferocious behemoths to tear apart a Mythical Demon King.
Such a terrifying achievement could truly be said to be unheard of; once word got out, it would shake the entire world of cultivation.
This was still the Eighth Layer; if he were to break through to the Ninth Heavens next, with his overpowering battle strength, he possibly wouldn’t even need to summon that Giant Beast Projection to kill a Demon King alone!
Considering this, all five people felt a mix of excitement and anxiety because as long as Jack didn’t die, with his talent, another terrifyingly powerful individual would rise among the Human Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 811: 352 Blood Flows Into Rivers, Slaughter Demon God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 811: Chapter 352 Blood Flows Into Rivers, Slaughter Demon God_3
Particularly, Hannah Gail revealed a sense of emotion in his eyes.
“Who would have thought that the somewhat green ‘Star Bodyguard’ from a few months ago has made it this far?”
Back then, Jack Clark was only at the Sixth Heaven Middle Stage, and he could barely fight against him when he had sealed most of his strength, but today he has just brutally torn apart a Purgatory Demon King.
This kind of achievement is something many king-level cultivators can’t accomplish.
Bang! Bang! Bang! One after another, the Mutated Creatures exploded under the bloodlight-wrapped War Halberd.
As Jack Clark killed countless enemies, the Doomsday Hell surrounding him became even more terrifying. The endless bloodlight, like tangible blood, flowed, and countless monsters struggled and roared.
The Standing Shadow of the Demon God behind him became even more fearsome, a reflection of the endless slaughter, ferocity, and destructive desires in Jack’s heart, now clearer than ever.
It shared Jack’s visage, with blood-colored fine scales on the edges of its cheeks, a crown upon its head, and its whole body covered in blood-colored battle armor, surrounded by a bloodlight that seemed to hail from the truest depths of Hell.
As it absorbed Bloodthirsty Spirits, the Demon Shadow grew stronger, and the support it drew from the Power of Hell strengthened Jack Clark immensely.
Under that bloodlight-entwined halberd, no one could stand as his equal.
When the Deamon Shadow behind him reached a height of thirty meters, a reluctant roar echoed across the distant horizon, followed by another Blood Moon slowly falling from the sky.
This Void Demon King from the Assassination Department of the Purgatory Demon Race, responsible for intelligence, had fallen.
In the high sky, the silver-haired youth’s left arm was enveloped by black abyssal demonic auras, emitting sizzling sounds of corrosion, and his aura seemed somewhat weakened.
The chest of Knife King Joel Moore was also marked by four half-meter-long wounds, around which Abyssal Law wound, clashing with the Slaughter Rule, causing intense, eruptive conflicts.
Above them, in the higher sky, Leo Hart stood firm with a resolute face, radiating a terrible oppression that seemed to suppress Heaven and Earth, his aura still immensely powerful.
The silver-haired youth, King Cyril, smiled wryly, “These demon kings are just too difficult to kill.”
Joel Moore spoke in a deep voice, “Today is already not bad. We managed to suppress that demon king by only suffering some damage to the origin of our laws.”
As a Demon King who was at the Mid-Mythical Stage and legendary in status, whether it was his combat experience, mastery of laws, secret skills, or burst techniques, all were at the pinnacle of perfection.
Moreover, due to the nature of the Rule True Body, merely severing limbs or slashing the body could only cause certain consumption; a complete kill required the erasure of the True Body.
Therefore, even if one holds an absolute advantage in a battle among those at the myth level, killing the opponent would take time and a hefty price.
Initially, both men had been prepared to sacrifice half of their Origin, teaming up with Leo Hart, who emerged stronger from his Closed-door Cultivation in the relic, ready to obliterate two demon kings.
Only, they hadn’t expected an accident to occur.
Thinking of this, the three turned their gaze toward the distance, where on the plains below, a blood-colored figure was moving swiftly in all directions, plunging the surroundings into darkness, with innumerable Mutant Beasts’ blood flowing together to form a river.
It was a literal river of blood.
Immediately, Joel Moore’s eye twitched, “This kid’s thirst for blood is great!”
Leo Hart appeared before them, his voice low, “His Battle Intent belongs to the way of slaughter; it’s normal for it to be strong. Or rather, those whose thirst for blood is insufficient could never condense such Battle Intent.”
“Currently, he’s only at the Eight Layer realm, but his Battle Intent has already condensed a Demon Shadow, linked to the Supreme Hell Plane, and he’s killed too many high-order lives to count.”
“Once he breaks through to king-level, he might be able to condense a Higher-order Slaughter Law directly.”
“Besides, his True Martial Arts are very powerful, and the battle body it condenses can erupt with strength far exceeding that of one Major Realm once it reaches the high stages.”
“Moreover, I sensed a power from that battle body that is no less than that of Four Kinds of Divine Seed, and once he breaks through to the Nine Layers and forms Divine Powers, the final fusion of Laws will definitely be terrifying.”
“Also, the four Divine Wheels behind his head when he manifested the True Martial Battle Body must be the Fourfold Illusionary World he opened when breaking through to the Eight Layer. Once he begins Opening the Heavens and Earth…”
At this point, amazement appeared on the faces of all three kings.
As a result, Jack Clark’s grasp on these several powers would become highly fearsome once he reached king-level status, and they could confirm that he possessed at least Slaughter and Opening the Heavens, both of which were Higher-order and Supreme Laws.
Add to that his cultivation talent that allowed him to reach the Eight Layer realm in less than a year, and the kid’s talent was terrifying, far from any king-level qualification.
Realizing this, the three exchanged glances.
Clearly, there had been reservations in the information available to them about Jack Clark; they wondered if he possessed not just one, but several forbidden weapons crafted by the Speaker.
The silver-haired youth felt somewhat annoyed, “Elder Brother Larry did not tell me the whole truth.”
Joel Moore smiled lightly, “It’s normal. Given such monstrous talent, news about him should naturally be under wraps, but those few kids…”
As he spoke, Moore glanced towards Hannah Gail and others.
The silver-haired youth, understanding what he meant, pondered for a moment, “Hannah and Cathie Lawson have already broken through the Eighth Layer and achieved True Martial Unity; altering their memories would be a bit troublesome. Let’s compensate with some resources and have them undergo Closed-door Cultivation at the Seventh Legion Garrison for half a year.”
“In half a year’s time, given Jack Clark’s talent, he might have already broken through king-level.”
“Hmm.”
Moore and Leo Hart nodded slightly.
Then, observed by the three kings, the roars of Mutant Beasts on the plains grew weaker and weaker, for they were being slaughtered to the point of extinction, including the escape-attempting dark Kirin Beast.
Standing on the Earth formed of accumulated corpses of countless Giant Beasts, Jack Clark, holding a halberd, was enveloped by a dense bloodlight almost turned material.
Especially the Standing Shadow of the Demon God behind him. By now, it couldn’t be described as a mere shadow; it had fully transformed into a thirty-meter-tall Demon of Slaughter, emanating an aura that made hearts race.
Under its suppression, the boundless Doomsday Blood Sea Hell behind it hinted at materializing from illusion into reality, becoming ever more terrifying.
By this time, the Blood Moon in the sky had set, its light dimmed, while at the edge of the horizon to the east, streaks of golden radiance began to emerge.
Day, had broken.

chapters.title: Chapter 812: 353 Hell Master, King's Battle Machine
chapters.content:
Chapter 812: Chapter 353 Hell Master, King’s Battle Machine
Standing amidst a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, Jack Clark slowly exhaled after a “night” of slaughter, feeling the power that wrapped around him, his gaze flickering slightly.
Suddenly, in front of him, a transparent page appeared.
Prison Blood War Intent[Grand accomplishment: The Demon Shadow formed from slaughter and destruction gains a significant boost, and the base increase of Heavenly Energy is elevated to eleven times.
Lord of Hell: When standing in the Doomsday Purgatory Domain, the Demon Shadow will transform into the Lord of Hell, obtaining the blessing of the Law Power of the Supreme Hell Plane, greatly enhancing the might of the domain.
Note: When the Battle Intent rises to the limit, attracting the Hell Rules to merge with the body, one will become a Demon God, holding sway over Doomsday Hell and becoming a true master of Hell]
Lord of Hell. Jack Clark slowly moved his gaze to harvest on the attribute page.
In this episode of frenzied slaughter, not only had the boost of the Demon Shadow condensed by Battle Intent risen from five times to eleven, but it had also undergone a special transformation.
Beyond that, the domain manifested by the Doomsday Purgatory Rune had also become stronger amid the slaughter.
He felt that a few more rounds of such widespread slaughter could almost lead to a qualitative breakthrough for both the Battle Intent and the rune domain, amidst the convergence of endless Blood Fiend energy.
However, circumstances like the beast tide were somewhat special; they weren’t something one could stumble upon unless it was a frontline battlefield where two civilizations were at war with countless Senior strong men.
Moreover, his gains weren’t limited to Battle Intent and domain but also included the Life Crystal.
At that moment, a ray of golden sunlight broke through the sky. Jack Clark’s thoughts moved instantly, retracting the Sea of Blood domain and the War Halberd, and called out to the five people on the distant mountain ridge.
“Mr. Gail, Captain Lawson, and everyone else, don’t just stand there, come down and help. The materials and Life Crystals from those Giant Beasts are all valuable goods.”
However, as the five people rushed down from the mountain, they saw the scattered Unique Beast corpses everywhere. Hannah Gail said with a wry smile, “Brother Callum, with so many Mutated Beasts, it’s going to be tough for our small team to deal with them all quickly.”
That seemed to be the case. Jack Clark paused.
He didn’t know how many Mutated Beasts he had killed this time; unavoidably, he had blown most of them to pieces, making it difficult to distinguish their levels.
In this situation, each one had to be checked for Life Crystals, a task that could take days to complete.
Then, space distorted, and the silver-haired youth and two others appeared, immediately releasing a heavy oppressive force.
Hannah Gail and the others hurriedly greeted them with respect, “We greet the three Throned Ones.”
“No need for formalities.”
The silver-haired youth nodded slightly at them, then looked at Jack Clark with a small smile, “Let others handle this place. Everyone has been fighting for a night and must be tired.”
“Alright.” Jack Clark did not refuse.
Soon, under the orders of King Cyril, the person in charge of the Seventh Legion Garrison, the people from the nearby Sky Mine were the first to arrive.
But as they saw the collapsing mountain ranges, the broken land, and the enormous pits hundreds to thousands of meters wide on Earth, they were all thoroughly astounded.
Especially the sight of Unique Beast bodies that spread over the central part of the mountain range, with countless streams of blood flowing down and converging into a horrifying spectacle of a blood river at the base of the mountains, they were stunned for a long time.
“Last night’s battle was too terrifying, almost demolishing this mountain range.”
“There were also two Blood Moons that fell, indicating the death of two Purgatory Demon Kings, showing how powerful our Human Race is.”
“Indeed, but I never expected that Deputy Chief Klein would turn out to be a traitor.”
“That detestable fellow, to think he would try to betray our Human Clan Genius…”
…
As the dark night receded and the golden Great Sun rose, the mythical world would next enter a period of daylight lasting a month.
The colossal Moonlight Divine Tree, comparable to a mountain, stood between heaven and earth. Its silver leaves, which radiated silver brilliance at night, now looked like White Jade under the sunlight, reflecting shimmering golden light.
From a distance, it resembled a towering golden mountain peak, sacred and vast.
Among the treetops more than ten thousand meters high, endless streams of silver radiance converged, forming a tangible energy vortex that spun slowly, emitting terrifying energy fluctuations.
The silver-haired youth stood amidst the sea of radiance, with darkness on his left arm enveloped by Abyssal Law fading away as he healed the injuries from last night’s battle.
Jack Clark, who had taken off his battle armor and was wearing a grey leisure suit, stood on a small ‘leaf’ about ten meters in diameter and 0.5 meters thick, overlooking the endless sea of clouds below and feeling refreshed and uplifted.
It had already been half a day since everyone returned.
With the help of the Moonlight Divine Tree, a being equivalent to Mythical Creatures, the last trace of darkness on the silver-haired youth’s arm dissipated, and the surrounding energy vortex slowly vanished.
King Cyril, whose injuries were restored, opened his eyes and sighed in relief, “I’m grateful for your help Moonlight, or else it would have taken me several months to drive out and recover from these injuries.”
Instantly, the surrounding branches rustled gently, and a kind realm of thought transmitted, signaling the silver-haired youth not to worry.
This scene caught Jack Clark’s attention.
In this world, there were numerous geniuses and beings with astonishing destiny, not just him with good luck.
For instance, King Cyril, who was astonishingly talented two decades ago. Not only did he have immense cultivation talent, but his luck was also enviably good.
Back when he was only in the Eighth Layer Heaven, he entered the mythical world, joined the Exploration Department, and managed to avoid all sorts of dangers. He delved into the Vast World and discovered the Moonlight Divine Tree.
Then, after some unknown experiences between them, he established a pact with the Moonlight Divine Tree, rapidly broke through to king-level and opened up this territory for the Human Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 813: 353 Hell Master, King's Battle Machine_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 813: Chapter 353 Hell Master, King’s Battle Machine_2
As a Divine Tree Contractor, King Cyril was not only at the Mid-King Level in his cultivation, but when he was within the domain similar to a divine realm of the Divine Tree, his strength became incredibly formidable.
Endowed with endless energy and the law power of the divine realm, even ordinary Heavenly Kings would fail to breach the defenses, especially under the Superconducting Electromagnetic Destruction Cannon that the humans crafted using the Divine Tree as power.
Add to this the presence of the strong men stationed not far at the rear in the Outer Development Department Headquarters, and one could say the defenses were as solid as a rock.
At that moment, the silver-haired youth flashed into existence in front of Jack Clark and smiled, “How about it, Jack Clark? Have you recovered from last night’s exertions?”
Jack Clark nodded politely, “Mostly recovered.”
The silver-haired youth spoke gently, “Last night’s incident has been dealt with, and your news will not be leaked out.”
“In the battle last night, you slayed the War Demon King Augusta and made outstanding contributions to the Human Federation. I’ve already recorded these merits into the Federation’s Merit Database.”
“However, as many of your files currently require secrecy, for the time being, this achievement will not be publicized and will not appear on the Human Race’s Merit Monument.”
The Merit Monument is a Divine Stele standing in the frontlines of battlefields, within the squares of the colleges of the three major empires of Blue Star. It showcases the names of those who have made significant contributions to the Human Race.
And Jack Clark, who had slain a Mid-Mythical Stage demon king, certainly deserved recognition for his extraordinary contribution to the human race.
Nevertheless, only Jack Clark was aware of the extent of his battle achievement, so he felt a bit embarrassed, “Your Majesty, would it be inappropriate to attribute this merit solely to me?”
“Moreover, had you not suppressed the true body of that demon king last night, I wouldn’t have been able to kill it. Or to put it another way, I’m not a match for it on my own.”
The silver-haired youth laughed, “Don’t be embarrassed; a kill is a kill; we only look at the results.”
“In light of the merit for slaying the demon king, the Federation will customize a King’s Battle Machine for you, valued at three million Merit Points, capable of traversing space.”
“Apart from possessing the quasi-mythical combat strength of a Peak-Ninth Layer, this fighter aircraft also embodies the pinnacle of the current Federation’s technology, such as the ability to absorb light energy, thermal energy, and cosmic radiation, converting them into Kinetic Energy.”
“Should we fail in the civilization war against the Purgatory Demon Race and our ‘world’ is destroyed, we could still retreat into the cosmic void, flying for thousands of years in search of a new habitat.”
“Of course, this is the worst-case scenario.”
“In addition, while interrogating Charles Klein, we found a lot of useful information and confiscated a portion of the Blood of Demon God from him.”
“However, the Blood of Demon God isn’t of much use to us human cultivators. But it is crucial for a confidential project of the Special Warfare Division.”
At this point, the silver-haired youth’s tone became suggestive as he asked, “Jack Clark, would it be possible for you to ‘sell’ the Blood of Demon God to the Federation and exchange it for equivalent resources you might need?”
Jack Clark spoke earnestly, “Your Majesty, there’s no need for such formality. If the Federation needs it, just take the Blood of Demon God.”
He honestly didn’t care. After all, the resources that Elder Brother Larry had applied for on his behalf were already worth several million Contribution Points, and would allow him to rapidly advance his cultivation to the late stage of the Ninth Heavens.
The silver-haired youth shook his head with a smile, “It’s not the same. What’s yours is yours, the Federation never shortchanges those who have served the human race well, let alone a junior like you.”
With that, the silver-haired youth took out a Sumeru Bracelet, “Inside here are some resources that can strengthen the foundations of the Illusory World and accelerate its transformation from virtual to reality.”
“In addition to the Heavenly Wood Branch and Earth Essence Soil that Elder Brother Larry had already applied for you, there are also four World Star Core Fragments from King Hawk’s throne, which can serve as The Heart of your World.”
“World Star Core Fragments!” Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a sharp breath, he had read about such resources in the core database of Cloud Sky.
As the name implies, these come from a fragmented star core of a shattered world, value comparable to innate runes and other law resources, capable of significantly enhancing a world’s power.
When merged into the essence of Giant Beasts, this would make conversion faster and might even allow for earlier refinement of essences derived from the skeletons of quasi-mythical and even Mythical Giant Beasts.
The silver-haired youth smiled slightly, “These World Star Core Fragments come from a relic, and they are of no use to King Hawk himself, so consider them additional compensation for the Blood of Demon God.”
Jack Clark expressed his gratitude, “Thank you, King Hawk, as well as the generous gifts from all the seniors.”
Such a divine item, worth as much as the Blood of Demon God for just one fragment, was not so much a compensation as it was a direct gift to him.
After discussing Jack Clark’s Merit Value settlement issues, the silver-haired youth glanced at the time, “Jack, wait here for a bit, the Life Crystals should be brought back soon.”
“No rush.”
The two then stood atop the tree canopy, chatting casually like any ordinary friends would.
However, most of the conversation was led by the silver-haired youth, who introduced some forbidden areas of the mythical world to Jack and what to pay attention to when encountering these dangerous zones.
After a period of rest, Jack was set to delve deeper into the mythical world for exploration.
With Jack’s current combat power comparable to the Ninth Heavens, the Giant Beast projections he could summon comparable to ordinary king-level warriors, the Star Ring that could withstand a hit from a Heavenly King or even a rule, and a forbidden weapon that could instantaneously transport him back to the Human Federation headquarters, he was, in all aspects, armed to the teeth—adequate to roam freely around the Human Federation’s areas adjacent to the mythical world. Therefore, the silver-haired youth did not dissuade him from adventuring.
In this era, each rising strong man has his fortunes, like him.
For these strong men with great destiny, forceful interference could backfire, potentially causing the loss of opportunities to ascend to higher levels.
Of course, opportunity and risk coexist; there is no absolute in such matters. Even king-level warriors can fall unexpectedly in some dangerous forbidden areas.
As they spoke, a thunderous noise soon came from below, an ‘elevator’ soared along the trunk of the Moonlight Divine Tree, swiftly reaching the top.
Then the elevator doors opened, and two girls in white tracksuits, with delicate features and probably only seventeen or eighteen years old, stepped out carrying a hefty box.
Both girls, with a Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven physique and agile figures, hopped through the branches, reaching the two men in a few breaths, and respectfully said,
“Your Highness, the Life Crystal has been delivered.”
The silver-haired youth smiled gently and nodded, “Thank you for your hard work.”
The two girls quickly shook their heads, “It’s not hard. It’s our duty.”
After looking at Jack with curiosity—having been at the divine tree base for so many years, it was the first time they had seen someone standing shoulder to shoulder with the silver-haired youth—
“You may go back to your duties.”
“Yes, Your Highness.”
The girls nodded respectfully, then leapt away through the branches.
“We only had time to collect the crystals; the Unique Beast materials need to be slowly dissected and evaluated. Once that’s done, we’ll settle them into your account.”
When Jack and the others returned, the Seventh Legion Garrison had dispatched a logistical spacecraft troop to clean up those Unique Beast corpses.
But thus far, they had only managed to collect the Life Crystals from the Mutated Beast corpses. As for the flesh, scale armor, and other materials, they required meticulous separation, processing, and transport.
Under normal conditions, once the Mutated Beasts were dealt with completely, thirty percent of the total value would be credited to Jack’s income.
The reason it’s only thirty percent, of course, is that multiple stages such as separation, transport, preservation, and refinement all incur enormous labor and material costs; it wasn’t feasible to offer a full reimbursement.
Unless you transport them back by yourself.
The silver-haired youth, giving Jack an appraising glance with a slight smile, said, “Take it and go practice. I know your talent can convert the energy of High-level Life Crystals.”
“I am very much looking forward to the day you break through to the Mythical King stage. By then, our Human Race will have gained another supreme strong man capable of reigning over the battlefield.”
This time, Jack didn’t reply modestly but smiled, “Actually, I’m somewhat looking forward to it as well.”
With that, Jack said his goodbyes, grabbed the ‘heavy’ box, and leaped down, descending straight from the sky to the base of the divine tree where many Closed-door cultivation rooms were established.
Under the respectful gaze of the administrator, Jack casually applied for a cultivation room, entered carrying the box with its compressed internal space, and prepared to convert Attribute points.

chapters.title: Chapter 814: 354 Strengthen Soul Talent, The World Wall of the Fourfold World
chapters.content:
Chapter 814: Chapter 354 Strengthen Soul Talent, The World Wall of the Fourfold World
Crack!
The box opened, revealing a dense mass of blue crystals and pale gold crystals that caught Jack Clark’s eye, along with a rich surge of life energy that spread out.
Last night’s battle, due to distance and timing, actually covered a relatively small area, roughly a radius of 1,000 kilometers.
Moreover, the farther away it was, the weaker the effect of the god attractor, where over 500 kilometers away only a few strong beasts caught the signal.
In Jack’s rough estimate, he had slain about 100,000 Unique Beasts.
Even the smallest of these creatures was larger than an elephant, averaging twenty meters in length and several meters in height, and together they created an imposing beast horde.
Specifically, some Giant Beasts were tens to hundreds of meters long, like moving hills, and when Jack finished them off, the entire plains valley was piled with corpses, resembling Hell.
In terms of level, these Unique Beasts were primarily second and third-level juveniles, followed by fourth and fifth grades adults, with fewer at levels seven and eight Colossi.
Inside Blue Star, creatures undergoing mutation and evolution are known as Mutated Beasts, with those breaking through to level seven and beyond classified as Giant Beasts.
As for the mythical world, these genetically stable creatures are termed large Unique Beasts, with those above level seven also categorized as Giant Beast Level.
Because their genetics have stabilized, these massive animals are born as Level 1 Beasts, then grow from juvenile to adult.
There are also differences among Unique Beasts, like cows, sheep, and mice on a vast prairie. The limits of weak Unique Beasts are at fourth level, while stronger ones can grow to fifth, sixth, and even seventh-level Giant Beasts.
Everything depends on lineage.
Of course, genetic stability does not mean limits cannot be broken.
With abundant Heavenly Energy and various Heaven and Earth Treasure resources, there are numerous cases of these creatures breaking the limits of their species and becoming Giant Beasts or even stronger beings.
Or there would be a mutation awakening a royal bloodline within a Unique Beast, leading the creatures of their group to evolve en masse into a more powerful beast horde.
However, since this growth from juvenile to adulthood is a natural progression, these Unique Beasts don’t condense Life Crystals in their bodies before they reach the pinnacle of their species level because there’s no need to break through species limits.
This is why Life Crystals are rare in the mythical world, and even if they exist, they start at Level 4.
Including the Life Crystals Jack garnered this time, they were predominantly Level 4 crystals, and not a single lower-level two or three was found.
Even so, this haul was still astonishing.
Whoosh! Jack poured all the crystals from the box onto the floor, and hundreds of crystals rolled out, instantly making the Cultivation Room sparkle.
A smile spread across Jack’s face as he grabbed two crystals and started converting them. “You have converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal and gained 78 Attribute points.”
“You have converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal and gained 74 Attribute points…”
As he converted one Level 4 Life Crystal after another, the number of Attribute points on the attribute page skyrocketed, quickly rising from the initial 20,000 to 30,000, 40,000…
When the Life Crystals in the Cultivation Room disappeared, Jack’s Attribute points surged again, reaching a total of 89,508, nearly ninety thousand points.
“This is like striking it rich from murder and arson,” Jack mused.
If one were to accumulate Merit Value through normal means to exchange for this many Life Crystals and top-level Divine Items, it’s uncertain how many missions would need to be completed.
The same was true for the Giant Beast Avatar.
If the Giant Beast Avatar had to painstakingly hunt Mutated Beasts to accumulate crystals on its own, even a thousand low-level crystals would take a significant amount of time.
After musing for a while, Jack’s gaze landed on his attribute page.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was in Hibernation, breaking through to the Mythical-level, so Jack decided to strengthen both the Soul Talent and the Void Double Pupils to the God Transformation Level in preparation for the upcoming Nine-fold Peak.
But which one to enhance first?
Jack’s eyes hesitated between Soul Split and Void Double Pupils, then settled on Soul Split.
His intuition told him that because of the unique characteristic of Soul Split, enhancing it was very likely not to directly increase combat power, which is why he had been reinforcing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon before.
But as a Top Tier Talent he held from the beginning, enhancing it to God Transformation Level would surely bring about astonishing changes, especially since it pertained to the soul.
As for the Void Double Pupils, with almost forty thousand Attribute points remaining after strengthening the Soul Talent, he would just need to delve into the mythical world and kill three Peak of the eighth level Colossi to suffice.
It all came down to being just a few days later, so it didn’t matter.
With this thought, Jack’s intention echoed in his mind, “Use 50,000 Attribute points to enhance the Soul Talent.”
Boom!
The energy of 50,000 points worth of attributes conversion erupted within Jack’s body, rushing into an unknown area deep within him with great momentum.
Boom!
In an instant, Jack’s consciousness roared, and he vaguely but sharply sensed the existence of his Soul Source for the first time, as well as countless black Rune Sequence Chains deep within him.
Attribute Energy, based on Vitality Conversion, cannot directly strengthen the soul or enhance soul-related Cultivation Methods, but only talents and Cultivation Methods related to the physical body.
Although Soul Talent affects the soul, it is still based on the body, involving the Soul Source.
At this moment, as the Soul Talent Sequence Chain vibrated, it started to manifest and advance from the void deep within, Jack clearly sensed the existence of the Soul Source for the first time.
In that void dimension where nothing else existed, a hundred-meter-tall figure of the Soul Emperor in a black Imperial Robe emerged, wielding the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal.
Simultaneously, on the other side of the Soul Emperor, a Giant Beast hundreds of meters in length slowly became visible as it lay prostrate.

chapters.title: Chapter 815: 354 Strengthening the Soul Talent, The Fourfold World Wall_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 815: Chapter 354 Strengthening the Soul Talent, The Fourfold World Wall_2
“`
Between the two seemingly independent and complete souls, there was a soul black hole that distorted dimensions, existing at a higher level, spanning endless space-time.
At this moment, countless black rune sequence chains probed out from the depths of Jack Clark’s body, densely linking his body, soul source, and two souls—forming a unity of four.
These black rune sequence chains were extremely mysterious, as if their very existence was a kind of “way” involving the great path of the soul.
However, when he clearly perceived his soul source, Jack Clark’s somewhat confused consciousness suddenly became stupefied.
My soul source is a hole?
…
This time the enhancement involved the soul source, and it took almost a day for Jack Clark to slowly awaken.
Then, he felt as if the entire heaven and earth had changed, a very clear feeling, as if a thin veil that used to cover him had been lifted.
At this moment, Jack Clark keenly sensed the breathing of heaven and earth, the slight trembling of the earth, and that all things each had their own trajectory, containing special tracks.
It seemed that he could touch heaven and earth, touch the rules, with a mere extension of his hand.
With the enhancement of his soul talent, the separation between Jack Clark and heaven and earth that had always existed due to his soul split, which made it difficult for him to comprehend things, had disappeared.
Just this change alone greatly lifted Jack Clark’s spirits because he was finally no longer a ‘brute’.
After feeling the passive changes, Jack Clark thoughtfully summoned the attribute page.
Talent: Soul Split [Deification, a soul-class special talent enhanced to the extreme, capable of splitting one soul into two complete and independent soul entities, sharing the same origin and unity.
Soul Synchronization: Links two souls, a special pathway at a higher dimensional level that synchronizes and balances the disparity between the two souls to prevent imbalance.
Deification Unity: A unique special ability, when used, both souls and body will undergo a deification reaction, merging body, soul, strength, and talent into one.
Under the Deification Form, the life level will be completed and become a higher-level complete life entity, breaking through the current level.
Tip one, when choosing the human body as the main form during Deification Form, everything from the Giant Beast Body will serve as the Deification Energy to complete the human body, and vice versa.
Tip two, during the selection for deification, the stronger the strength between the main body and the Giant Beast Avatar, the greater the enhancement of life level and strength level obtained.
Note: Once entering Deification Fusion, it will not be possible to split into two individual entities again unless the origin of creation is touched.]
“As expected, strengthening the Soul Talent doesn’t directly increase my combat power,” Jack Clark slowly exhaled, not surprised by this outcome.
However, although there was no direct increase in combat power, the newly gained talent ability was somewhat terrifying.
The first goes without saying; it was a detailed supplement to his past reinforcement feedback from the Giant Beast Avatar to the main body.
No wonder every time the Giant Beast Avatar grew, evolutionary energy would appear inside him—the reason was the Synchronous Strengthening of the soul to prevent imbalance.
The enhancement of the body turned out to be incidental, a reason that surprised Jack Clark.
And the second soul ability was somewhat terrifying, allowing his soul to re-fuse from the split into one.
But this fusion was not a simple sum of one plus one; instead, it became a frightening Deification Form, enabling Jack Clark to directly break through the current realm, and the higher the cultivation levels of the main body and Avatar, the greater the upgrade.
In simple terms, if the main body is at the Heavenly King level and the Avatar is at the Mythical Titan Level, once he chooses to merge, he will directly break through to become a Supreme Level strong man.
If both the main body and Avatar reach the Supreme level of the twelve-fold heaven, or the Ancient Titan Level of the Giant Beast, he can leap to become a higher level of life in one step.
If choosing the human as the main form during fusion, the breakthrough will be as a Civilization Emperor.
If the Giant Beast Body is chosen as the main, then the human main body will disappear, and Jack Clark will become a True Spirit Level Giant Beast, an incarnation of rules, above the Ancient Titan.
This Deification ability is very strong, very terrifying, but its limitations are also great. In time, he must give up one identity, so for now, it can only serve as his strongest trump card.
After feeling a stronger connection between his main body and Avatar, Jack Clark took out the Sumeru Bracelet given to him by King Cyril.
This closed-door cultivation session was not only to strengthen his talents but also to enhance the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Four Realms.
Although the four worlds had already been opened, because they were still illusory worlds, their boost to Jack Clark’s strength wasn’t significant.
Boom!
“`
Before Jack Clark, a 3-meter diameter yellow light sphere phantom slowly unfolded, which looked like a 3D projection, but emitted an aura as heavy as mountains.
At the same time, a half-meter diameter, irregular object that resembled a dark iron block appeared in Jack’s hands.
Boom! The space around him shook in an instant, and the object in Jack’s hand sank even more, almost slipping from his grasp.
“So heavy!”
Jack’s arm muscles swelled as he struggled to ‘open’ the Earth World with an explosive burst of terrifying strength and tossed the World Star Core Fragment into it.
As the World Star Core Fragment entered, the Earth World trembled continually, and an invisible force of the world pulled the fragment towards its depths.
Boom! The entire world shook. In Jack’s perception, the originally one-kilometer diameter illusory space expanded rapidly, ballooning to a five-kilometer range in an instant.
At the same time, at the edge of the Earth World’s void, a layer of invisible yet tangibly existing crystal boundary wall materialized from nothing, covering the entire world.
At the moment the invisible crystal boundary appeared, the illusory Earth World suddenly became stable.
Meanwhile, the World Star Core Fragment merged with the Earth World, becoming a complete miniature star core in the depths of the world, and the entire world seemed to come to life at once.
The crystal wall swelled slightly, then contracted, breathing slowly as it drew ‘strength’ from the depths of the void to grow.
Instantly, in the center of the dull yellow Earth World, a speck of yellow substance began to appear, condense, and gradually morphed into the first handful of real dirt and rock.
This was the preciousness of the World Star Core Fragment. As the core piece of a once ‘world,’ it innately possessed the world’s complete attributes.
As the fragment merged with this nascent illusory world, it instantly elevated the illusory world over a major level, turning it into a complete miniature plane world.
But it was not enough.
Looking at the ‘world’ that contained only a little dirt, Jack took out a box from the Sumeru Space and poured the sandy yellow soil inside into it.
Hum!
The Earth Essence Soil, upon contact with the dull yellow ‘strength’ contained in the Earth World, kept expanding and evolving, transforming in the blink of an eye into a layer of ‘land’ one-kilometer in diameter and several tens of meters thick.
The entire Earth World shook once more, becoming even more stable and weighty, and even the invisible crystal wall that enclosed the world grew thicker.
At the same time, a row of transparent text emerged before Jack’s eyes.
Earth Plane: First Order [A miniature plane with a single attribute. World’s Power: When externalized, it can mobilize a strand of strength to merge with the defense, forming a boundary wall defense layer around the body.]
“Boundary Wall.” Jack murmured thoughtfully, then summoned the Second Layer Heaven with a thought.
Boom! A 3-meter diameter light sphere filled with golden flames appeared in front of Jack, radiating dazzling light and scorching heat.
Another World Star Core Fragment was thrown in, and immediately the firelight surged. Amidst the shaking, the space expanded and swelled, turning into an enormous ‘vast’ world with a five-kilometer diameter.
And as the crystal wall of the Heavenly Flame World was born, Jack tossed in a piece of material burning with flames.
Boom!
The whole Heavenly Flame World shook. Under the fusion of its world’s power, the flaming material gathered endless flames to form a hanging golden-white Great Sun.
Heavenly Flame Plane: First Order [A miniature plane containing the single attribute of fire. World’s Power: When externalized, it can mobilize a strand of strength to merge with the defense, forming a boundary wall defense layer around the body.]
Still forming a layer of boundary wall defense. Seeing this, Jack pondered for a moment and then sequentially integrated World Star Core Fragments into the Strong Wind World and the Thunder Prison World.
Besides that, there were the god-level wind and thunder resources given by the Federation.
Boom Boom Boom Boom!!
As four worlds – heavy as earth, burning as a Great Sun, howling with black tornados, and thunder roaring around Jack – coalesced, the invisible force of the planes filled the air, and the Cultivation Room shook.
Surrounded by four worlds, Jack, sitting cross-legged, seemed like a creator of the universe, controlling Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, and his body inexplicably emitted an unspeakable aura of terrifying majesty.
“Fourfold World.”
After a moment of insight into the changes of the four planes, Jack slowly opened his eyes, and with a thought, the four worlds turned into streams of light and converged behind him once again.
As the four layers of light wheels slowly rotated, the four strands of the world’s power blessed Jack, forming four layers of invisible boundaries, exuding an unquestionable, indestructible presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 816: 355 Blue-White Giant Dragon: Am I Confused from Sleep?
chapters.content:
Chapter 816: Chapter 355 Blue-White Giant Dragon: Am I Confused from Sleep?
This time, Jack Clark had been in closed-door cultivation for almost two days.
As the heavy door of the Cultivation Room slowly opened, a suffocating and oppressive aura filled the air, its invisible might causing many ‘locals’ in the distance to tense up.
These cultivation rooms were constructed around the divine tree’s mountainous roots, robust and thick, also protected by the divine tree so there was no worry of being disturbed.
About a mile away from the Cultivation Room was a modern city built against the ‘mountain,’ inhabited by hundreds of thousands of locals, including women and children.
As for the elderly, none had yet appeared among these new humans who had only been proliferating for a few decades.
Even from a mile away, those people wore expressions of awe, gazing with reverence at the black-haired young man who was slowly emerging from the Cultivation Room.
Glancing at the ‘ordinary people’ in the distance, Jack Clark’s figure suddenly shot up into the sky, piercing through layers of clouds to reach an area over ten thousand meters high.
After several rounds of Identity Verification in the office area, Jack Clark arrived at the silver-haired youth’s office.
King Cyril was somewhat surprised, “Are you sure you don’t want an Energy Warplane for transportation?”
Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “No need, the warplanes are too big and not convenient for moving around.”
Previously, Jack Clark had spent three thousand Points Attribute, using the Ethereal Crystal Stones to enhance his Sumeru Bracelet, which after a hundred expansions in all directions, had made his Storage Space quite large.
His Sumeru Bracelet was now large enough to contain an Energy Warplane dozens of meters in length and more than twenty meters wide.
But the problem was, once the warplane was stored inside, there was no remaining space to store other items.
His target this time was to delve deep into the mythical world, to hunt down large Giant Beasts to obtain crystals, and incidentally, to see if he could find some Top-tier Divine Items or large crystal mines.
With an ongoing ‘share’ of resources at his disposal, besides his own needs, he could also benefit his family, giving Glenn Clark some family wealth to boast about.
This is also why so many High-level cultivators join the Outer Development Department.
In this world, not everyone is without concerns. Some fight not only for themselves but also for their children and siblings, much like Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis’s parents, or Justin Welan’s brother.
Jack Clark is no different; he too has things he wishes to protect and guard.
Especially since Glenn Clark was not like him, always a bit lacking in ‘talent.’
King Cyril nodded at Jack Clark’s choice, then opened a drawer and took out a box or two.
“This is your smart wristwatch, which has been upgraded, and now includes the most detailed map data of the Human Federation in the mythical world,” he said.
“It includes dangerous forbidden areas, territories of Mythical Creatures, some plant and biological information, and most importantly, the Moonstone positioning function to prevent getting lost in the Endless World.”
“Also, here is the god attractor you requested, just transferred from the frontline, but there’s only one portion, from a Purgatory Demon strong man we took down.”
As he mentioned this, King Cyril’s expression turned solemn, reminding him, “However, this item is quite special, and even a demon king of The Purgatory Family wouldn’t dare to use it casually out in the open.”
“The mythical world has devoured many worlds over countless millennia, so it’s very dangerous and complex, inhabited not just by our humans, but also Unique Beasts and the Purgatory Demon Clan.”
