“So before you use the god attractor, it’d be best to scout around a one to two thousand kilometers range to avoid attracting some special and terrifying beings, otherwise, it could be quite troublesome.”
Jack Clark nodded solemnly, “Rest assured, Your Majesty, I’ll be careful when using it.”
After the silver-haired youth advised him about a few more things to be cautious of, and with Jack fully prepared, he took his leave and burst through the air into the boundless sea of clouds.
In the blink of an eye, he vanished into the layers of clouds.
Trailing a long wake of air behind him at Supersonic Speed, Jack Clark swiftly left the Seventh Legion Garrison, covering a distance of over a thousand kilometers within an hour.
Bang! Far away, the sea of clouds churned as a Giant Beast with a hundred-meter wingspan emerged, stirring a violent wind wave and catching sight of Jack Clark, it let out a sharp, long cry.
Seeking death.
Jack Clark’s gaze turned icy, and a pair of black gold vertical pupils flashed in his eyes.
Bang! A thousand meters away, the space around the Level 7 late-stage behemoth suddenly solidified, and under the terrifying force of the Void, it shattered with a thunderous crack, creating pitch-dark fissures.
In an instant, the previously ferocious and violent Giant Beast was turned into dozens of chunks of flesh and blood, mingling with the blood that fell from the sky.
But just as Jack Clark had instantly killed the Level 7 Colossus, a heaven-reaching tornado appeared in the sky and earth ahead, stirring the atmosphere for hundreds of kilometers, annihilating everything in its path.
Seeing this, Jack Clark’s expression stiffened, and he decisively plunged from the sky.
…
Deep under the sea of Blue Star.
Woo!
Accompanied by a deep and melodious sound like a steam whistle, the deep sea trembled; a colossal Black Colossus burst forth from the raging currents.
Boom!
The sea surface exploded, and the sea water fell from the gaps in its thick black scales, like cascades of waterfalls.
Woo! Another sonorous and deep call echoed between heaven and earth.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, covered in thick black scale armor, hovered hundreds of meters in the air, its belly supported by two massive fins each over two hundred meters long and covered in black scales.
With this breakthrough to Level 9, the Tiger Whale saw some changes in its figure.
Besides its fins becoming even more massive, like a pair of wings that could shield the sky, the triangle-shaped Dorsal Fin which extended backward from its back became even more robust and fierce.
At the same time, its already broad and massive mouth became more fearsome, lined with rows of sharp teeth capable of swallowing similarly sized Giant Beasts in one gulp.
And the blue horn on its head became thicker and sharper, nearly piercing the Firmament, giving the Tiger Whale an appearance of supreme might and savageness, reminiscent of an ancient Giant Spawn Fish descending upon the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 817: 355: Blue-White Colossal Dragon: Am I Sleep-Confused?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 817: Chapter 355: Blue-White Colossal Dragon: Am I Sleep-Confused?_2
Ying ying ying!! I can fly now, I can fly now.
At this moment, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was very excited, soaring and flying in the air with the Black and White Domain surrounding it, stirring up waves of air.
As the first Giant Beast to follow the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Whale reaped the most benefits.
For example, the half-drop of blood from the ancient creature allowed it to possess the form of a Whale and the ancient breath needed to break through to the mythical level.
Now that it’s flying high in the sky after breaking through to Level 9, it was extremely exciting for this Marine Life creature; no wonder the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon liked to fly into the fight every time since it could fly.
But just as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was excitedly flying in the sky, the sea water below exploded with a sudden bang.
Boom!
A destructive golden-yellow beam shot through the sea, rushing towards the sky. After penetrating the clouds at an altitude of ten thousand meters, it exploded, forming a series of shockwave halos.
The golden-yellow light beam contained a great amount of power, alarming the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and making it sense some sort of danger.
Bang!
The sea surface exploded in the distance, and a dark brown small hill emerged from the water, stirring up huge waves. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which had grown to over 140 meters in size, surfaced.
At this moment, it seemed even more massive and fierce, with black spikes covering its thick back armor and scale armor surrounding its stout limbs like mountain pillars.
Ying ying ying!! Domination, why are you spitting water all over the place? Do you want to fight?
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was a little angry after almost being hit by the breath attack, and its fins were flickering with Black Gold light, emitting a sharp aura.
But the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle wasn’t afraid of it. The fierce and dignified dragon head emerged, looking at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish in the sky with excitement and roaring, “Roar! Today, I will defeat ten of you.”
Just as the two Level 9 Giant Beasts, who had awakened their Top Tier Talent, were about to fight, a storm howled in the center of the whirlpool in the distance. The Silver Giant Dragon, which had grown to over 170 meters in length, soared into the sky.
The storm-surrounded Silver Giant Dragon let out an angry roar.
Roar! If you two want to fight, go away from here. If you wake up Tim Abott, believe it or not, the Great Sethia will smash your heads with one claw.”
As it spoke, a black Ice Crystal storm of several meters in diameter converged in the right claw of the Silver Giant Dragon, exuding a terrifying aura of destruction under the invisible compression.
Suddenly, the necks of the two Level 9 Giant Beasts that had been brutally beaten by the Silver Giant Dragon before retracted.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish quickly flapped its wings and abruptly turned around to flee, “Ying ying ying!! I suddenly miss my wife, flash, flash.”
Roar! Joe, wait for me, Domination wants to find your wife too. The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared as it shattered the sea waves, moving like a small island at great speed.
Ying ying ying!! Go away, what do you want with my wife?
Roar! I misspoke, I’m going to find the Crab General, who promised to carve me a fierce and powerful statue.”
As they watched the two Giant Beasts retreat, the Silver Giant Dragon flew back to the seabed with satisfaction.
At this moment, in the center of the deep sea whirlpool, the Black-red Colossal Beast had grown to over 410 meters in length, looking even more ferocious than before. The waves of destruction it emitted invisibly were almost unbearable for the surrounding space.
At this point, there was no black destructive lightning visible on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon. All Law Power was being tempered inside its body to complete the transformation of its Mythical Body as soon as possible.
Looking at the increasingly huge Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, envy was visible in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon, “Roar! I wonder how long it will take for Sethia to grow to the Mythical level.”
As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon elegantly lay down beside the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, closing its eyes comfortably.
The higher level life energy that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon invisibly exuded when it broke through made the Silver Giant Dragon feel very comfortable, allowing its bloodline power to become very active.
However, most Beasts couldn’t enjoy this kind of fortune.
For example, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, these guys couldn’t bear the invisible bloodline pressure emitted by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon during its breakthrough and hid far away.
Meanwhile, on the head of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Purple Dragon Egg was happily absorbing the life energy, its life fluctuations getting stronger and stronger.
And at the top of the Purple Dragon Egg, faint cracks began to appear, indicating that the life inside was about to break out of its shell.
As the Silver Giant Dragon lay comfortably next to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and dozed off,
Mythical World.
Between the towering, ice-shrouded mountain ranges, a massive, thousand-and-three-hundred-meter-long, several-hundred-meter-tall colossal beast was walking with large strides.
This beast resembled a bulky, wingless black Western Dragon covered in heavy black scale armor. It bore some similarities to the Black Oblivion King that had been torn apart by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
However, compared to the brutal and ferocious Black Oblivion King, this colossal beast felt more solid, steady, and had…a simple-minded vibe.
At this moment, the huge beast was walking through the mountain ranges, and with its heavy footsteps, every step shook the ground beneath and caused avalanches of snow and ice to slide down.
Soon, this colossal beast reached the peak at the edge of the mountain range.
There, a Blue-White Giant Dragon, measuring three thousand meters in length, lay dormant, its black cold air freezing and shattering the surrounding space with each breath.
In front of this massive Blue-White Giant Dragon, the colossal beast, which had originally seemed huge and terrifying, suddenly seemed like a smaller brother.
After climbing to the peak, the somewhat simple-minded-looking colossal beast let out a respectful growl, “King, that Transcendent creature you told me to keep an eye on, the one living with Sethia, is now breaking through to the Mythical level.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon slowly opened its eyes, with pure destruction in its enormous pupils, barely revealing a terrifying aura, as if it itself was destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 818: 355 Blue-White Giant Dragon: Am I Confused from Sleep?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 818: Chapter 355 Blue-White Giant Dragon: Am I Confused from Sleep?_3
The blue-white Giant Dragon slowly regained its senses upon opening its eyes, then it took a moment to react. Its fierce and enormous dragon mouth opened slightly, emitting a slow, earth-shaking low roar.
“How long has it been?”
The Black Colossus let out a respectful low growl, “One Sun Wheel.”
The blue-white Giant Dragon nodded slowly, “It has been one Sun Wheel already… Roar! Wait, how long did you say it’s been?”
The blue-white Giant Dragon suddenly came to its senses, and its body, as vast as mountain ranges, thunderously stood up. In an instant, the sky darkened, the Earth shook, and layers of transparent shockwaves ripped through the surrounding space.
The Black Colossus bowed respectfully, “King, it has been just one Sun Wheel since you last instructed me to pay attention to Scythia and that Giant Beast Creature.”
“Roar! Are you saying that in just one Sun Wheel, that young one whose life span in its world is only one year, grew from the Level 9 Early Stage to Mythical-level?”
At this moment, the blue-white Giant Dragon wondered if it was still groggy from sleep?
The Black Colossus respectfully answered, “No, king, the little one named Thunderflame has not fully achieved a Mythical-level breakthrough. It is currently in a Transformation Sleep State.”
Is there a difference?
The blue-white Giant Dragon took a moment to collect itself, allowing its slow thought process to become more active. Then, a terrifying pressure filled its eyes as it let out a deep growl.
“Now, how long has it been since Scythia entered that world, what has she done, and how did she come across that youngster?”
The Giant Beast humbly bowed its head, “Five Sun Wheels ago, Scythia had just entered that Indigenous World through the pathway from my Territory when she encountered that creature named Thunderflame.”
“At that time, the Transcendent Creature named Thunderflame was only Level 7, but it held its own against Level 8 Scythia in battle, resulting in a draw.”
“Because I was concerned about Scythia, I kept my distance and observed the battle through the Deep Sea Eye.”
“Afterward, Scythia made peace with that Thunderflame creature, and they established a deep sea power called Dragon Palace, aiming to unite the seas of that Indigenous World.”
“Not long after, under the leadership of the Big Dragon King Scythia, the Dragon Palace expanded its Territory. In just three Sun Wheels, they ruled over a vast sea area.”
“At that time, Scythia was only Level 8, but under her leadership, Dragon Palace slaughtered several Level 9 lifeforms, including one Mid-Level 9 Giant Beast that had awakened a King-level bloodline.”
“Roar! Wait, you’re saying Scythia at Level 8 took down a Mid Level 9 Extraordinary Giant Beast that possessed a King-level bloodline?”
Again, the blue-white Giant Dragon was flabbergasted. Its daughter, who had always been a bit ditsy, was that fierce?
“… That battle’s main force was that Thunderflame creature.” The Giant Beast, which had nearly overstated Scythia’s contributions, shrank its neck a little.
I knew it, my fool of a daughter couldn’t be that formidable. The blue-white Giant Dragon nodded slowly, signaling the Black Colossus to continue.
“Just when you, king, had gone into Hibernation for half a Sun Wheel, that little one named Thunderflame had already slain another Mythical Giant Beast through a different pathway.”
“However, since that youngster’s strength increased rapidly afterward, I didn’t dare to monitor using the Deep Sea Eye, so I’m not clear on the specifics.”
“Now, that little one is in Hibernation undergoing a breakthrough to Mythical-level, with Scythia guarding it in the vicinity, while the other creatures of Dragon Palace are patrolling the periphery.”
The blue-white Giant Dragon nodded slowly and let out a deep roar, “When that one called Thunderflame awakens, have Scythia bring the little one here and tell it the king is looking for it.”
“Yes, king.”

chapters.title: Chapter 819: 356: The Rampaging Giant, Super Electromagnetic Gun
chapters.content:
Chapter 819: Chapter 356: The Rampaging Giant, Super Electromagnetic Gun
Mists layered the heavens, while mountain ranges that spanned tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand kilometers undulated across the Earth. Between these mountain plains, rivers of over ten to hundreds of kilometers crisscrossed.
Along these rivers’ edges, massive hordes of Unique Beasts could occasionally be seen sprinting, emitting lofty and robust roars that filled the air with a wild and desolate aura.
At the foot of a ten thousand meter mountain peak, colossal trees hundreds of meters tall stood erect, with rough, sturdy bark as tough as steel and lush foliage interwoven to obscure the sky.
Within these forests, ape-like creatures standing over ten meters tall with horns atop their heads made their homes, their joyous leaps spanning dozens to hundreds of meters, their mouths emitting fierce cries.
Laden upon these towering trees were fruits the size of one meter, the primary sustenance of these black Scaled-Horn Apes.
Yet just as these Scaled-Horn Apes were frolicking, a fifty-plus meter long python cloaked in greyish-black scale-covered silently approached from the shadowy forest.
However, the very moment the horned python closed in, a vigilant old ape suddenly began beating its chest, issuing a piercing howl.
Roar, roar, roar!
In an instant, the entire forest shook as one ape after another rushed to the treetops, roaring furiously at the hissing python coiled around a distant tree.
Dozens of mature Scaled-Horn Apes grasped grey fruits, black energy swirling around their claws, which transformed the fruits into dark, steel-like objects in the blink of an eye.
Boom, boom, boom! Enraged, these muscular-armed apes hurled dozens of steel fruit cannonballs, blasting through the air and pelting the giant python.
Hiss, hiss! The python’s body shimmered with grey energy, instantly dodging like a shadowy apparition, like a grey light streaking past tree trunks.
All at once, every enormous tree trembled as the black iron fruit bombs exploded against them, shattering bark and making an astonishing racket.
Woo!
Horrific screams echoed from a large tree hundreds of meters away; an upper half of a Scaled-Horn Ape was crushed by the giant python’s bite, blood splattered wildly, and it was dragged away into the dark crisscrossing branches in an instant.
Roar, roar, roar! The eyes of the Scaled-Horn Apes reddened with fright and rage as countless steel fruits crazily smashed toward that area.
The tumultuous battle in the woods resonated far, causing agitation among the large Unique Beasts dwelling outside the forest.
On the vast plains outside the fruit tree forest, a common weed stood over ten meters tall, swaying in the wind with broad, fleshy leaves bursting with verdancy.
At the edge, dozens of Unique Beasts resembling cattle, about twenty meters long and over ten meters tall, covered in thick scales, lowered their heads to graze.
Nourished by the abundant Heavenly Energy, these common weeds were rich in nutrients, enough to sustain the day-to-day needs of these large beasts.
Amidst this forest-like expanse of lush weeds, there occasionally passed serpents of over ten to twenty meters in length, rustling with a susurrus sound.
Suddenly, the distant weeds shuddered wildly, followed by a howl of agony that quickly subsided, leaving only the faint scent of blood in the air.
Whoo!
A giant shadow descended from the sky, carried by howling winds, and the Unique Beasts peacefully feeding below roared, recoiling their massive bodies.
A forceful energy burst from the beasts, mutually amplifying to immediately sink the earth within a radius of hundreds of meters, solidifying the air, creating a gravity zone.
But their speed was still too slow. An eighty-meter wing-spanned Unique Beast plummeted from the sky at several times supersonic speed and snatched a ten-meter long Armored Beast, soaring into the heavens.
Thud!
Between the powerful double claws of this Level 7 Alien Beast, the Level 4 Armored Beast let out a scream, its body torn in two, as its blood rained down from above.
Roar!
On a hillside a thousand meters away, a sixty-meter long Level 7 Colossus bellowed, emitting a beam of golden light from its mouth towards the sky.
Peew!
The flying Giant Beast shrieked sharply, its wings flickering like lightning to dodge the breath weapon, vanishing into the depths of the clouds, leaving the Colossus to roar continuously.
For the Giant Beast had invaded its territory.
A few kilometers away, atop a small mountain only a couple of thousand meters high, Jack Clark watched the scene with an unperturbed gaze.
Such is the mythical world where everything appears immense, and over long cycles of proliferation, has developed a stable ecosystem—primitive and bloody.
Like on Blue Star, the ordinary Unique Beasts here are prey for those giants; only those Level 7 Alien Beasts have the right to claim a portion of the territory.
However, both these giants are merely in the latter stages of Level 7, lacking Life Crystals within them which prompted Jack Clark to divert his attention toward a spot twenty-odd kilometers away.
On the other side of the mountain ranges, a hundred and twenty meters long Giant Lizard, which had awakened a trace of the Dragon Bloodline, lay in hibernation on the mountainside.
This Colossus was covered in black and blue intermingled scale armor, its presence exuding the formidable aura of a Level 8 Peak Giant Beast, deterring those around it.
This was the second Level 8 Peak Giant Beast Jack Clark had encountered.
After departing from the Seventh Legion Garrison and traveling five thousand kilometers beyond the outer circle, he flew another six thousand kilometers southward, avoiding several dangerous areas.
So far, though, he had encountered only two Level 8 Peak Giant Beasts.
As for Level 9 Peak beings that have touched the threshold of myth, even in the mythical world, they are scarce, especially in this region, previously scoured by Human Experts.
Moreover, Jack Clark had merely been flying in a straight line, not conducting a carpet-style search covering a few hundred to a thousand kilometers in breadth.
Observing the immense beast, Jack Clark’s nearly four-meter long Eight Desolate Battle Halberd hovered in front of him. Blue Thunder streaked between his hands, swirling around and emitting a terrifying aura of destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 820: 356 The Rampaging Giant, Super Electromagnetic Gun_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 820: Chapter 356 The Rampaging Giant, Super Electromagnetic Gun_2
The distance of over twenty kilometers had already exceeded Jack Clark’s attack range. Currently, his halberd could only strike within an area of a little over one thousand meters; beyond this range, the halberd’s might would weaken progressively.
However, in the past two days, Jack had an epiphany and was preparing to test a new remote attack, the “True Thunder Electromagnetic Cannon.”
At this moment, between his hands, thunder had already converged to form a massive magnetic storm vortex, covering an area of over ten meters, while the glowing deity of the Thunder Prison World behind his head shone brightly, amplifying the thunder’s power.
Meanwhile, in his mind, the knowledge of electromagnetic physics he had learned surfaced, as his powerful Spiritual Will began to adjust the surrounding electromagnetic field continuously.
Crackle, crackle, crackle! Amidst the startling gathering of thunderous power, electric arcs spread over dozens of meters, turning Jack into a dazzling blue radiance.
The terrifying thunder-magnetic ring-shaped energy kept compressing and condensing until the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in the middle emitted a blazing red light, a phenomenon indicative of being heated to the extreme.
The intense energy fluctuations startled the Level 7 Giant Beast afar, causing the Unique Beasts in the surrounding mountain forest to grow restless and let out a series of roars as they dashed off into the distance.
The Level 8 Giant Beast on the other side of the mountain ranges also sensed something, suddenly rising to its feet.
Boom! A distant roar echoed through heaven and earth, as a blue and red beam, exceeding ten times the speed of sound, flashed between heaven and earth, and in an instant, the Giant Beast let out an outraged roar.
The Lizard Dragon Beast’s black and blue domain erupted, forming a hemispherical domain covering an area of over two hundred meters. Then, without waiting for it to make any other move, a flash of light shone from afar.
Boom!
An earth-shattering explosion shimmered, the earth split open in an instant, countless fragments of rock and dirt shot up into the sky, and a light akin to a nuclear blast rose steadily.
The terrifying explosion unleashed a Destructive Impact that swept across several kilometers. Everywhere it touched, large trees snapped, and grass and vegetation burned to ashes due to the scorching high temperatures, forming a massive area of destruction.
Under the scorching impact, the domain around the Lizard Dragon Beast vibrated continuously, bursting with rings of energy halos.
This strike was potent. The sheer force of using the Eight Desolate War Halberd as a cannonball for Instantaneous Explosion equaled the might of a small nuclear bomb, comparable to a Ninth Heaven Expert using full strength.
However, the crater was over seven hundred meters from the Level 8 Giant Beast, missing by about one kilometer.
Jack pondered, “If I were to compress high-heat Heavenly Flame energy inside the halberd, the explosive power could double, not to mention the extremely long range of the attack.”
“But the angle of such a long-range attack needs adjustment, and the overall lethality actually falls short. Moreover, the compression of the thunder magnetic field energy is insufficient.”
Upon comparing, Jack abandoned his plan to continue researching this technique.
Although the power he wielded with this technique was ordinary, it could work wonders when used on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Using the sharp spikes on the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon as cannonballs and gathering the Nine Layers of Thunder Ring to compress and form an electromagnetic railgun field, perhaps a single shot from a super electromagnetic gun could obliterate a Mythical Giant Beast.
Moreover, this attack could reach hundreds to thousands of kilometers, instantly destroying an area of several kilometers.
But then, how could he lock onto the target?
Or should he consider using himself as coordinates to open a large Spatial Channel that could instantly allow passage of the electromagnetic railgun, similar to a Sky-based Strike akin to a Summoning Breath?
At this thought, Jack’s eyes brightened slightly.
Because summoning a Thunderflame Behemoth’s projection to descend in true form, or a continuous breath strike, all required a long time to maintain either the pathway or Summoning Altar.
But if he were to summon something like a cannon-based Sky-Based Electromagnetic Railgun Strike, he would only need to lock on to the distant target and maintain the Spatial Channel for an instant, which would consume very little energy.
Furthermore, with the recovered strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a Full-Force Strike from the electromagnetic cannon would be terrifying. The Burst of destructive power was enough to slay Mid-Mythical Stage or even later period Giant Beasts instantly.
All things considered, it was more cost-effective than merely summoning a projection to descend.
As Jack was contemplating how to perfect this technique, the Level 8 Giant Beast far away had spotted him. At this point, the beast was incredibly incensed.
Roar! Amidst its outraged roar, the Giant Beast whipped up a raging wind, crushed the earth under its feet with thunderous strides, breaking trees as it shot toward Jack Clark, twenty kilometers away.
It wanted to tear that annoying insect to shreds; it aimed to incinerate that bug with a single breath; it… The beast had only covered a dozen kilometers when Jack’s eyes shimmered with a pair of black gold vertical pupils.
Instantly, the power of the Void descended.
Bang! The space around the Lizard Dragon Beast shattered abruptly, with pitch-black fissures crackling and covering an area of over one hundred meters.
Under the Space Shattering Strike, the domain of the Level 8 Peak Giant Beast collapsed and its strongly fortified body instantly fractured, crashing to the ground with a booming sound, spurting countless scorching jets of blood.
In front of Jack at this moment, there was no difference between a Level 8 Peak Giant Beast and an ordinary eighth-level creature. He didn’t even need to lift a finger; a single glance was enough to kill.
“It consumed one-tenth of the Void Energy,” Jack mused, feeling the depletion of a portion of the Void Energy as he approached the Beast’s corpse.
Soon, Jack dug out a human head-sized brilliant crystal, “What a pity, I can’t take these things with me.”
Looking at the thick scale armor in front of him and holding the Life Crystal, a hint of regret appeared in Jack’s eyes.
If this were on Blue Star, the total value of a Level 8 Giant Beast would be staggeringly immense, not just for its flesh and blood but also its scale armor and bones, which were top-tier materials for energy conduction.
After a moment of reflection, Jack’s thoughts echoed in his mind: “Attribute points conversion.”

chapters.title: Chapter 821: 356 The Rampaging Giant, Super Electromagnetic Gun_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 821: Chapter 356 The Rampaging Giant, Super Electromagnetic Gun_3
“After transforming the High Purity Life Energy Crystal, you have gained 3810 Attribute Points.”
As the numbers surged, the Attribute Points on the page jumped from 43501 to 47311, only a little over two thousand points away from the fifty-thousand mark needed for strengthening.
Instantly, a satisfied smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
Having spent three days in the mythical world, besides the two he had in closed-door cultivation, it had only been a little over a day, yet he had harvested several tens of thousands of Attribute Points.
Indeed, the vast mythical world was worthy of its name.
In good spirits, Jack Clark went to retrieve his War Halberd from the hundreds of meters wide crater, blasted by the weapon fifteen kilometers away, at the bottom of the pit, where the surrounding dirt had crystallized under high temperatures.
Roar!
Just then, the mountain forest behind him shook, accompanied by a brutal roar, and a terrifyingly fierce aura approached.
A giant, over one hundred fifty meters tall, covered in purple scaled armor, with a green face and fanged teeth, emerged from the forest, knocking down trees as it approached the heap of Lizard Dragon Beast corpses.
Crack!
Grabbing a large chunk of a Giant Beast’s hind leg, the giant bit off a piece. Its scales shattered instantly, and gobs of flesh and blood dribbled down the corners of its mouth, making it look particularly ferocious.
Watching the early-stage Level 9 giant in the distance, Jack Clark had no intention of taking action.
Because this giant was actually a human who had transformed.
Unlike various Mutated Beasts that grew larger and larger after mutation, humans, usually constrained by self-awareness, rarely experienced gigantification under normal conditions.
Even if evolution occurred, it would be the awakening of cultivation physiques and various Talent Abilities, with only a few people becoming slightly bulkier.
But there were exceptions to every rule.
Over the years, millions of cultivators and tens of millions of ordinary people during the Dark Age were dragged into the mythical world by the Evil Gods.
In such cases, due to some unknown reasons, a few humans underwent consciousness loss and aberrant transformations.
Under these conditions, these humans would continually enlarge and swell, losing the constraints of the human form to become giant beings, with their consciousness also submerged by bestiality.
Regarding these out-of-control human-like Giants, the Human Federation generally expels them to fend for themselves rather than killing them, as long as they haven’t caused too great a harm to their own kind.
Meanwhile, studies on these rampaging giants, as well as Genetic Martial Arts and Giantification Talents from the remains of Giant Beasts, have allowed humanity to refine the Cultivation System for the Eighth Layer Battle Body.
For instance, the gigantification aspect of Jack Clark’s Combat Divine Body’s True Dragon Form shares some similarities with these rampaging giants.
After casting a deep look at the Rampaging Giant, Jack Clark’s figure flashed as he soared into the clouds, ascending tens of thousands of meters in the blink of an eye, and continued to fly deeper with his aura concealed.
Compared to the perilous Earth below, covered with sky-touching trees, the sky in the mythical world was somewhat safer.
However, in the next few hours, apart from encountering more than a dozen groups of Flying Exotic Beasts, Jack Clark hadn’t seen a single Giant Beast at the peak of the seventh or eighth level.
That’s right, seen—not sensed by aura.
The mythical world was different from Blue Star. With rich energy, powerful beings were everywhere, so even Level 9 Giant Beasts dare not release their aura casually.
As in the Blue Star World’s deep sea, a Level 9 Giant Beast spreading its aura for hundreds of kilometers was seeking death—it could be killed with a single swipe by a passing Mythical Giant Beast.
What right did a creature that wasn’t even mythological have to declare Territory?
The golden sunlight dimmed suddenly ahead, as the space crumbled to reveal the pitch-black Void, forming a ‘wall’ that seemed to stretch up endlessly and extend far to both sides.
“Have I finally arrived?”
Standing atop the sea of clouds tens of thousands of meters high and looking at the dark expanse cutting across the horizon, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel a touch of shock.
Since leaving the Seventh Legion Garrison, Jack Clark had flown approximately fifteen thousand and several hundred kilometers, avoiding over a dozen dangerous areas thanks to the map, making the mythical world seem rather uneventful.
But here, his map was no longer useful.
Because just a thousand or so more kilometers ahead lay the Death Forbidden Area, a section stretching tens of thousands of kilometers across, with a width exceeding a hundred thousand kilometers.Update by n0vgo. co
This area was the remnant of a world swallowed and shattered, where space was twisted and the Void raged with all manners of destructive threats. Even kings risked death here.
At the same time, this area contained many opportunities—due to the collapse, rules manifested, condensing into various Law Divine Artifacts and countless Heaven and Earth Treasures.
This area also happened to be an Alien Civilization Territory; during the world integration and collision event, its collapse led to the civilization’s extinction.
Given these circumstances, the area was riddled with valuable relics, as well as powerful and even Mythical Giant Beasts, drawing many exploration teams deep inside.
Leo Hart also ventured deep into this area and got trapped by a relic of a different race for more than a decade, only emerging recently.
However, Jack Clark only glanced in the direction of the forbidden area before turning to fly in another direction.
His current goal was to hunt Giant Beasts to obtain crystals and enhance his strength, not to explore forbidden areas. Right now, he no longer needed any opportunities.
Why approach this place? Naturally, due to environmental factors, there were more High-rank Behemoths here, and the god attractor would be more effective.
Soon, by luring hundreds or even thousands of Giant Beasts above Level 7, he could engage in a monumental slaughter, gaining a massive amount of Life Crystals, perhaps enough to transform tens of thousands of Attribute Points directly.
Whoosh!
Soon after circling in the sky, Jack Clark descended from the heavens and landed on a small hill several thousand meters high, surrounded by mist threading through the mountain peaks.
“This will do.”
Saying so, Jack Clark took out a Dark Red Bottle from his Sumeru Bracelet, carefully opened it, where blood-colored runes flickered at the bottle’s mouth, and a potent stench of blood spread out.
Under the power of the rune, this special blood scent invisibly surged toward all directions at an astonishing pace.
Roar! Instantly, a terrifying roar of a Giant Beast echoed from afar.

chapters.title: Chapter 822: 357 Deification of the Void Double Pupils, Crimson King
chapters.content:
Chapter 822: Chapter 357 Deification of the Void Double Pupils, Crimson King
Under the attraction of the god attractor, a disturbance broke out among the surrounding mountain ranges.
Unique Beasts suddenly raised their heads to look at the mountain peak where Jack Clark was, their eyes slowly turning red, appearing somewhat frenzied. Driven by instinct, they thunderously stampeded off.
Atop the mountain peak, Jack Clark was entirely covered in sinister black-red armor, holding a halberd while standing tall. Four circles of light were slowly rotating behind him, making him resemble an ancient War God.
Just as Jack Clark was preparing to embark on another massacre, two ferocious roars came from afar.
Roar! Roar!!
Under the terrifying and feral Level 8 and Level 9 aura of those two roars, the restless Unique Beasts all paused, then stopped somewhat reverently.
Accompanied by the roars, two Giant Beasts, one measuring 120 meters and the other over 190 meters tall, appeared in the distance, causing the ground to collapse and the forest to sway wherever they passed.
These two Giant Beasts resembled Furious Apes, covered with white fur over their bodies, with scale armor underneath, but their claws and feet were blood-red—one reminiscent of the Ferocious Beasts named Irvin Watkins from mythical legends.
The aura emanating from the two Giant Beasts was also tremendously fearsome, more powerful than the average Level 8 and Level 9 Giant Beast, and filled with a sense of oppression.
At that moment, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but take the situation seriously.
Because that Level 9 Beast was very strong. Although it was just in the early stages of Level 9, its bloodline had reached the Monarch level due to the awakening of an ancient bloodline, possessing top-tier talents.
With such strength, even he dared not underestimate it.
Roar! Roar! Roar!!
At that moment, several more earth-shaking roars echoed from afar, followed by the burst of three Level 8 and one Level 9 Giant Beasts’ auras, thunderously charging towards them.
“Huff! Can’t delay, need a quick battle and quick resolution.” Having said that, Jack Clark instantly sealed the bottle and collected the god attractor.
Roar! With the disappearance of that enticing force, the Giant Beasts that had been attracted began to grow restless.
Especially the two Irvin Watkins Beasts under the mountain range a dozen kilometers away, they stared darkly at Jack Clark atop the mountain, their blood-red eyes filled with insane bloodlust.
“Seeking death.”
Boom!
Jack Clark’s forehead, with a red rune that resembled an eye, lit up, slowly unfolding as if it was connected to a Sea of Blood Hell—an infinite surge of blood light erupted in an instant.
The mountain peak shattered, and amidst the tumbling rocks, Jack Clark turned into a streak of blood light and shot into the sky, appearing above the two Irvin Watkins Beasts, swinging the halberd with both hands.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Within a range of several dozen kilometers, the Heavenly Energy raged, dozens of golden and blue Halberd Radiance a hundred meters long descended from the heavens, engulfing the skies with a terrifying power that signaled destruction.
Under those Halberd Skill strikes, comparable to a mid-stage Level 9, the two Irvin Watkins Beasts let out roars of alarm and anger, with their domains unfolding and two beams of light that could obliterate space shooting into the heavens from their eyes.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! In an instant, a horrendous explosion shook the heavens and the earth.
The scorching Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial burned everything, and the True Thunder Instant Slash, sharp beyond compare and filled with speedy destruction, devastated an area several kilometers wide, causing the ground to shatter and flames to burn.
The ghastly energy shockwave set off a scorching blast, sweeping across the surroundings as vegetation ignited, trees withered, and a massive fire raged upwards, its power stunning.
Under that rapidly spreading mountain fire that spanned a dozen kilometers, the many Unique Beasts that had been attracted fled in panic.
Crack! In the center of the violent explosion, a space within a few hundred meters suddenly fractured, as massive, pitch-black cracks spread out, exuding a sense of peril.
Roar! With a fierce, unwilling roar, the body of the early-stage Level 9 Beast with Irvin Watkins bloodline split apart, its blood gushing out as it collapsed to the ground thunderously.
Only half of its ferocious skull remained under the spatial cutting, looking up at the sky, dead eyes fixed on Jack Clark standing above the Firmament, as if accusing him of being despicable.
Those dozens of powerful Halberd Skill strikes were just a feint; the real killer move was the full-strength strike from the Void Double Pupils.
As for the Peak of the eighth-level Irvin Watkins Beast, it was torn apart by two True Thunder Instant Slashes at the outset, its domain ripped to shreds and its body fatally split.
Above the Firmament, Jack Clark looked down coldly at the mangled corpses of the Giant Beasts below, then with a thought, he collected the Sea of Blood Hell surrounding him, turning into a beam of light that descended from the sky.
Squeak! Squeak! Squeak! Amidst the swirling Golden Halberd Radiance of the War Halberd, the Giant Beast’s chest was ripped open, its bones shattered, revealing a gold crystal.
Compared to the more than one hundred meters long body of the Irvin Watkins Beast, this human-head-sized gold crystal seemed like a tiny grain of sand, akin to the heart’s condensed impurity.
And this grain of impurity was the life Evolution crystallization of that Giant Beast. It was the seed of its Evolution breakthrough to Level 9.
But just as Jack Clark was about to collect that Life Crystal, a horrendous pressure erupted from a forbidden area a thousand kilometers behind him, followed by an earth-shattering roar.
Roar!
Under the roar of the Mythical Giant Beast, the sky changed color in an instant. Suddenly, dark clouds billowed, and amidst the thunder, torrential rain plummeted down, rapidly spreading in their direction.
“Mid-Mythical Stage!” Jack Clark’s complexion turned solemn.
Boom!
Breaking the sound barrier, Jack Clark, bolstered by his terrifying physique and the swift enhancement of his Rune God Seed, burst forth at a fearsome speed ten times the speed of sound, disappearing into the mountain forest.
Just as he dashed out tens of kilometers in the blink of an eye, the aura on Jack Clark’s body suddenly vanished.
The raging wind howled, and the dark clouds churned, with the heavy rain blanketing everything, quickly drowning the location of the recent battle.
Roar! From the thick dark clouds, without sensing the scent of blood, the Giant Beast let out a terrifying roar, a massive claw descending from the sky, grabbing the corpses of the two Irvin Watkins Beasts.
Thump! Thump! Thump! Remnants of limbs mixed with rainfall fell from the sky, extinguishing the wildfire that had spread for several dozen kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 823: 357 Deification of the Void Double Pupils, Crimson King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 823: Chapter 357 Deification of the Void Double Pupils, Crimson King_2
In a cave thousands of kilometers away, a clump of golden flames burned on the ground, dispelling the darkness.
Jack Clark sat cross-legged, his expression calm as he took out the Level 8 Life Crystal, not at all concerned about the chase from the Mythical Giant Beast just now.
For him, who possessed the Hidden Deity Glyphs to conceal his aura, temporarily erase his presence, use the Dark Curtain to shroud his form, and employ the Sea Illusion Mystique to alter his life aura, even mythical beings couldn’t find him once he was out of sight.
“You have transformed a High Purity Life Energy Crystal, obtaining 4120 attribute points.”
With the appearance of the translucent text, the attribute points on the page surged to over fifty-one thousand, enough to enhance the Void Double Pupils.
In fact, the Void Double Pupils could be said to be one of Jack’s most powerful methods; as a Top Tier Talent, its full-force burst could instantly kill beings of the same realm.
During the earlier excursion to the relics, he had slain over ten thousand Void Creatures above Level 5, absorbing Void Power and amplifying its strength by sixteenfold.
Under the boost of Void Rules, Jack at the Eighth Layer Early Phase unleashing a full-force strike with the Void Double Pupils was sufficient to suppress Ninth Layer Mid-Stage Beings, bridging a Major Realm.
This kind of power could already be considered defying the heavens, akin to a Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at Level 8 Early Stage tearing apart a Level 9 mid-stage giant beast.
Moreover, the power of the Void Double Pupils would grow as Jack’s cultivation improved, and it would become even more terrifying when he broke through to the Ninth Heavens, especially with the sixteenfold increase from the Void Rules.
If Jack could enhance the Void Double Pupils to the God Transformation Level, comparable to a rule, its might would become even more terrifying, far surpassing the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon when it was at level eight.
After all, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s various Top Tier Talents at that time were just top-tier.
Thinking this, even Jack couldn’t help but anticipate, and a thought echoed in his mind.
“Expend 50,000 attribute points to enhance the Void Double Pupils.”
Instantly, fifty thousand attribute points disappeared from the page, transforming into a torrent of enhancement energy that burst within Jack’s body, rushing towards his eyes.
Buzz!
In the Void, where nothing existed, a pair of black gold vertical pupils appeared, overwhelming, with a globe of grey energy that resembled a ‘planet’ slowly revolving within.
Just as the enhancement energy emerged, the grey planet associated with the Death Law exploded, merging with the advancing Void Double Pupils, the power bursting.
Hiss!
Jack clutched his eyes. The intense pain he had experienced before returned, and even he found it difficult to bear the soul-piercing agony.
At the same time, a powerful death aura spread from Jack, his eyes which only contained Void Power undergoing special changes.
As Jack’s eyes began to transform, in Blue Star’s deep sea, changes were also afoot.
In the dim light of the thousand-meter-deep sea, a Flood Dragon behemoth, three hundred and forty meters long, covered in red thick armor with sharp horns protruding from its back, coiled itself.
In front of this quasi-mythical behemoth, over twenty giant beasts, each about fifty to sixty meters long, a few reaching over a hundred meters, lay prostrate respectfully, each of a different appearance.
Beside these beasts were two Ninth Level Giants over two hundred meters long, both respectfully floating in the water.
At this moment, the Red Flood Dragon slowly growled, “I am the Great General under the great, the Mythical Creature Crimson King of the Red Dragon Beast Empire, Red Mane.”
“Now you are lucky, for you have a chance to join the great Red Dragon Beast Empire and become a member of this world’s peripheral forces.”
After the Red Flood Dragon finished growling, its pair of gold-red vertical pupils calmly watched the ordinary giant beasts in front of it.
Then those beasts one by one lay in awe at the seabed, not daring to move, as if they did not understand or know what it meant.
This left the Red Flood Dragon a bit disappointed; it knew that these lower extraordinary creatures had very low intelligence and didn’t understand why the king wanted it to form such a low-level force of extraordinary creatures.
Just as the Red Flood Dragon felt some disappointment, from amongst the Level 7 extraordinary creatures, a pitch-black Mutated Tiger Whale raised its head and roared, “Roar! I want to join, I want to shed blood for the great Red Dragon Beast Empire.”
Next, the Black Tiger Whale looked toward the other beasts, making sounds to urge them on.
Roar! Don’t you hurry up and thank the great General Red Mane. Being favored by the great Crimson King is our supreme honor.
As soon as the Black Tiger Whale finished speaking, the only Level 5 Tiger Whale among the group also nodded quickly.
Roar! Join, join, for the great Crimson King, we must shed our last drop of blood, beasts shall be slaughtered, gods shall be killed.
Only then did those Level 7 and 8 Giants react, emitting various low roars and cries, stirring up the turbid sea water, the scene becoming quite chaotic.
The Red Flood Dragon, however, was slightly taken aback, its gaze turning icy as it looked at the two Ninth Level Giants, “Roar! How can such a weak extraordinary creature come in? Didn’t I say it had to be above Level 7?”
Before the two Early-stage Level 9 Beasts could reply, the Black Tiger Whale hurriedly cried out.
Roar! Sir, this one is my wife. After hearing that the great Crimson King wished to recruit beasts, I brought my wife and brother Baldie to join.
The Black Tiger Whale’s words caused the Red Flood Dragon to pause once more; it had never encountered such a ‘clever’ extraordinary creature, one that even came forward to pledge allegiance.
Being a bit clever was good, the Red Flood Dragon nodded slightly, issuing a deep growl, “You did well. Do you have a name?”

chapters.title: Chapter 824: 357: Deification of Void Double Pupils, The Crimson King_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 824: Chapter 357: Deification of Void Double Pupils, The Crimson King_3
Black Tiger Whale quickly nodded: Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Yes, Sir, I have a name, my name is Haward Jones.
“Oh, you already have a name.”
The Red Flood Dragon felt a bit of a pity, as it originally planned to give this highly intelligent Extraordinary Creature a nice name like ‘Black Stone’.
Compared to Haward Jones, Black Stone sounded much better.
However, names were minor matters. The Red Flood Dragon nodded satisfied: “Roar! From now on, this general appoints you as the Sea Patrol Commander, responsible for commanding these Extraordinary Beast Armies.”
Immediately, the Black Tiger Whale’s eyes lit up, and it excitedly slapped its tail: Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Thank you, Lord Redmane, I will definitely serve the Red Dragon Empire with utmost devotion, even willing to work myself to death.
The Red Flood Dragon growled low: “You don’t need to drain all your blood for it, your mission is to patrol the edge of the sea area’s pathway, paying attention to the movements of the newly risen Giant Beast Empire Forces.”
At once, the Black Tiger Whale’s gaze flickered, and then it flapped its flippers and respectfully made a sound.
Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Yes, Sir, I will definitely keep an eye on the Dragon Palace Forces, gather intelligence, and prepare for the great Crimson King’s attack.
The Red Flood Dragon was suddenly startled and quickly growled: “Roar! We are not going to attack, we are just observing, observing the movements of the other side.”
Attacking the other side would be suicide, as the king of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire had already killed a Mythical Giant Beast.
Yiiing Yiiing Yiiing!! So we’re not attacking. The Black Tiger Whale’s eyes suddenly filled with disappointment.
Suddenly, the Red Flood Dragon responded: “Roar! Wait, Haward Jones, how do you know that the Giant Beast Empire Forces are called the Dragon Palace?”
In the Red Flood Dragon’s eyes, there was suddenly a hint of suspicion. It had heard that the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire had a Mutated Tiger Whale Army, and one of their Dragon Kings was also a Whale-like Mutated Beast.
Facing the Red Flood Dragon’s majestic gaze, the Black Tiger Whale kept a straight face, its eyes bright and full of sincerity: Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! It’s because my wife came from there.
Yiiing yiiing!! The Giant Beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire were very ferocious and blood-thirsty; whenever encountering a school of fish while those Giant Beasts were on their way, they would rush in and massacre them.
Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Furthermore, those Giant Beasts were trying to subdue all the Mutated Tiger Whale groups everywhere they went. Whoever dared not to submit would not only be killed, but even their scales would be plucked off.
Hiss hiss!!
All the surrounding Level 7 and Level 8 Giant Beasts gasped, and were taken aback. The Beasts of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Forces were just too brutal.
At this time, the Black Tiger Whale continued its call.
Yiiing yiiing!! Since my wife’s group was unwilling to be restrained, it was slaughtered on the spot by the Dragon Palace Giant Beasts, and she was the only whale that escaped and was met by me.
Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Sir, don’t worry, as a whale that has grown up in the mighty Red Dragon Empire, I have no disloyalty to the Red Dragon Beast Empire.
Just ask my brother Baldie here. Saying so, the Black Tiger Whale patted the Level 7 Mutant Beast that resembled a sea turtle beside it.
Brother? The giant sea turtle beast was somewhat confused. When did it have such a Tiger Whale brother? Didn’t they just meet on the road?
Not waiting for the Sea Turtle Giant Beast to snap out of it, the Black Tiger Whale continued to make sounds.
Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Sir, to show my loyalty, I can represent the Red Dragon Empire and declare war on the wicked Giant Beast Forces. I want to avenge my wife. I want to defeat the Black and White Dragon King of the Dragon Palace.
Yiiing yiiing!! That guy is also a Tiger Whale-like Giant Beast, yet he leads his subordinates to bully his own kind. I will surely defeat it and become the king of Tiger Whales in the whole sea.
Yiiing yiiing!! Boss, keep going, you can do it, you are the strongest. The Female Tiger Whale beside him immediately cheered the Black Tiger Whale on.
Feeling the strong obsession in the Black Tiger Whale’s eyes to defeat the Black and White Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, the Red Flood Dragon slowly nodded, dispelling a bit of doubt in its heart.Upd@te by novg0.co
However, the doubt was dispelled, but the matter of starting a war should be dropped.
Red Flood Dragon slowly growled: “Forget about declaring war, our Red Dragon Empire is a peace-loving Giant Beast power, advocating peaceful development. You are not allowed to provoke them until they show hostility towards us.”
“Alright, you are now at Level 7 Peak, this is a Dragon Blood Fruit. Eating it will help you directly break through to Level 8. Each beast only has one chance.”
Having said that, the Red Giant Dragon took another look at the Female Tiger Whale, thought for a moment, and rolled out a smaller Divine Fruit from behind it: “Roar, this one is for your wife.”
Looking at the divine fruit emitting a strong energy in front of him, the Black Tiger Whale’s eyes lit up. It was so exciting to have delicious things to eat again.
Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Thank you, Sir. Your servant will surely work until the last drop of blood for the great Red Dragon Empire. By the way, Sir, can I save it for when I break through to Level 9 to eat?
“Roar! This divine fruit is only effective for Extraordinary Creatures below Level 9 and cannot be used to directly break through to Level 9.”
Yiiing yiiing!! I see.
Garbage. The Black Tiger Whale thought in disdain. Yet, its eyes showed excitement and eagerness: Yiiing yiiing yiiing!! Thank you, Sir, in that case, I won’t be polite.
Boom!
As the Black Tiger Whale opened its huge mouth and swallowed the divine fruit in one gulp, a surge of energy containing the true dragon’s breath exploded within its body, activating its bloodline power.
As the various talents were condensed inside its body, the Black Tiger Whale strongly suppressed the drowsiness, sensing the process of these talents condensing from nothingness into runes.
It had once heard Uncle Thunderflame say that breaking through from Level 7 to Level 8 was a very important checkpoint for Extraordinary Creatures.
If they could comprehend the process of talents condensing into runes, it would make them even stronger and help them tap into their bloodline power.
Looking at the Black Tiger Whale, who had fallen into a breakthrough hibernation, the surrounding giant beasts all showed envious expressions.
This scene made the Red Flood Dragon very satisfied. This was the effect it wanted, and without hesitation, it growled: “You don’t have to be envious as long as you accomplish something for the Red Dragon Empire, you will also be rewarded.”
“Alright, protect your leader. After he wakes up, go patrol the territory.”
Having said that, the Red Flood Dragon’s body slightly swayed and disappeared into the dark sea. This world was too impoverished, and it didn’t want to stay a moment longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 825: 358 Defining Death, Blood God Akunus
chapters.content:
Chapter 825: Chapter 358 Defining Death, Blood God Akunus
“`
The mythical world.
Inside the cave, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which were pitch black like ink, deep and ice-cold like the endless Void, devoid of any emotional fluctuations.
Jack’s cold and indifferent gaze fell upon the transparent page before him.
Talent: Eyes of Void and Death [Deification: Eyes enhanced to the extreme, suspending space in the gaze when the double pupils are unfolded, seeing through all nothingness and the essence of the world.
Void Descent: Forms a Dark Curtain covering a certain area, blending oneself into the Void, depriving enemies of physical and spiritual perception, with intensity and scope dependent on the user’s strength.
Ability: Void Annihilation, expending Void strength to crumble the space locked by the gaze, crushing all matter and life into the Void, the greater the expenditure the more powerful the force.
Ability: Dimensional Exile, tearing open a rift spanning the endless Void, banishing the enemy into a distorted dimension deep within the Void, never to return.
Ability: Death Stare, defining death for those undying beings, or causing a part of a powerful enemy’s body to die completely, resulting in irrecoverable injuries.
Note: Current cultivation is low; Eyes of Void and Death ability is too strong and places a great burden on the body when used, please use with caution.
Remark one: Endowed with Void Rules, obtaining an additional +16 times power amplification.
Remark two: This talent already possesses Void and Death attributes, it will upgrade to Dual Higher-order Law of Void and Death when breaking through to king level]
Compared to the Soul Talent that merely gained a ‘Deification’ fused ability, the Void Double Pupils have greater strength after being enhanced.
Besides the original three abilities becoming more powerful, there is now the additional Death Stare, defining death for living beings.
This is a very terrifying ability.
Whether it’s cultivators or Unique Beasts, after breaking through the Seventh Layer Heaven, it’s not only strength that grows stronger but also a change in the nature of life, and an increase in lifespan.
When a being reaches Level 9, their lifespan is at least hundreds to thousands of years, and after breaking through to king level, it’s over a thousand years, capable of regenerating limbs and recovering from bodily disintegration.
All these reflect the immense vitality of Mythical-level beings.
As for how long a King-level strong man can live, humans have yet to witness a king-level grow old and die.
Those Purgatory Demon Kings and Mythical Giant Beasts encountered over the years have not been seen in their twilight years.
Once, a human king-level examined his own body’s vitality and calculated that the lifespan of a king is at least ten thousand years.
This is also why King-level strong men are compared to deities, as their prolonged lifespans surpass the known history of humanity spanning several thousand years.
But now, Jack’s eyes could define death for those kings, for those Mythical Creatures.
Of course, with his current cultivation level, he isn’t yet capable of eradicating those demon kings, but what about once he breaks through to king level?
By then, a mere glance could erase a demon king, slaying until the Purgatory Demon Race’s Blood Moon falls in succession and not a single Demon King Level Strong dares to stand before him.
Even Jack himself couldn’t help but marvel at that moment, “My double pupils are so powerful.”
From the beginning, his talent was a medium-level ability that could barely interfere with Spatial Fluctuations, it strengthened all the way to senior, top-tier, and now with Deification, it finally displayed the truly invincible power of double pupils.
Moreover, in this Transformation of talent, as the powers of Void and Death fused, Jack could clearly sense that his physique had also undergone a transformation.
After carefully experiencing the changes of this talent, Jack looked toward the outside of the cave.
The edges of his Black Gold vertical pupils were encircled by sixteen chains of black runes slowly rotating, and at the center of his pupil, a grey vertical line connected to Death, exuding majesty and cold indifference.
As Jack looked outside the cave, the entire world faded to black and white within his view.
In this monochrome world, streaks of red, blue, or gold would sometimes flash across the sky, leaving long-lasting trails.
Simultaneously, the invisible space also appeared before Jack as a three-dimensional transparent structure.
However, unlike Blue Star World’s multi-layered spaces, the mythical world had only ‘one layer’; beyond the mighty space lay endless darkness.
No, in that boundless void of darkness, Jack could still vaguely see the existence of space.
Or perhaps it’s more accurate to say that space is omnipresent, carrying all matter and non-matter, inherently indefinable, with living beings typically only perceiving its manifestations.
Boom! Instantly, countless pieces of information exploded in Jack’s brain.
These pieces of information were chaotic, complex, mysterious, and infinite, rushing into Jack’s brain through those Black Gold vertical pupils.
Even Jack felt a splitting headache at that moment, struggling to bear the massive influx of information.
Most importantly, much of this information was useless, with the rest being inscrutable mysteries of heaven and earth, residual traces of Law Power in action.
Enduring the throbbing pain, Jack began to regulate, removing and shielding against useless information, retaining and organizing what was useful, and gradually acclimating to it.
Time passed unknowingly, and as Jack’s brain subconsciously filtered out the useless information, he felt much more relaxed and breathed a sigh of relief.
“Sometimes, seeing too much, knowing too much is not a good thing,” Jack massaged his temples.
If it had been an ordinary Eighth Layer Expert in his place, their brain might have burst instantly from the endless data of heaven and earth, causing mental chaos and loss of control.
That feeling was too terrifying.
Just then, as Jack looked out from the mouth of the cave, he raised his eyes to the distant horizon.
There, standing between heaven and earth was the Black Forbidden Zone, formed by the devouring and disintegration of a world in the Void Death Pupil’s vision, it looked like a crystal riddled with countless cracks, radiating a dangerous aura.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 826: 358 Defining Death, Blood God Akunus_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 826: Chapter 358 Defining Death, Blood God Akunus_2
But suddenly, at the far end of the sky, a white streak of light flashed past the cracked ‘crystal’ edge, invisibly exuding the aura of ‘origin,’ causing Jack Clark to be slightly startled.
Because that thing was very familiar to him, it was the World Origin Energy, and it was a condensed strand of World Origin Energy at that.
As someone who had once completed the Road to Becoming a God, Jack Clark had obtained twenty-four paths of World Origin Energy, which would allow him to break through to king-level with just one step as soon as he reached the Level 9 Peak.
The role of the World Origin Energy was actually to connect cultivators with ‘Heaven and Earth,’ transforming the laws.
The laws grasped by each cultivator originate from the transformation of their own strength as it comes in contact with the operating laws of Heaven and Earth.
Under normal conditions, whether human, Unique Beast, or The Purgatory Family, they all belong to life forms created later and cannot touch the elusive yet real laws between heaven and earth.
Therefore, it is necessary to refine the Heavenly Energy that contains absorption of Origin Energy, as a bridge.
And ten paths of World Origin Energy can allow a kind of strength cultivated to its extreme to complete a law transformation in a short time, tempering the True Body, and the soul’s sublime ascension.
As for the few with astonishing talent, who grasp two or three kinds of rules when breaking through to king-level, more Origin Energy is needed during the breakthrough.
Of course, if there is not enough Origin Energy, one can first transform one type of rule.
This is also why many King-level strong men either focus on one Law Path or experience very slow progress in their cultivation after a breakthrough.
That is to say, when Jack Clark breaks through to king-level, the World Origin Energy inside his body can only allow him to quickly complete the transformation of two Higher-order Laws, the rest he needs to work hard for gradually.
Just then, in the black area of the sky, another strand of white light equivalent to one-tenth of a path of Origin flashed by, converging toward a certain place.
Immediately, Jack Clark narrowed his eyes.
“Is this what they call a stroke of fate?”
His Eyes of Void and Death had just made a breakthrough, and he had encountered the abnormal convergence of World Origin Energy, as if something was attracting him from the darkness.
Regarding World Origin Energy, Jack Clark, who had originally no plans to enter the forbidden area temporarily, pondered slightly.
Boom! The cave collapsed, the Earth shattered, and with a roar, Jack Clark turned into a beam of light that shot into the sky; in the blink of an eye, he flew to an altitude of tens of thousands of meters above the clouds.
That space shattered, distorted, and filled with the pervasive power of the Void, which might be very dangerous for cultivators—it might lead to their downfall at any moment.
But for Jack Clark, who possessed the Eyes of Void and Death and could directly see the essence of the world, it had no effect on him.
The distance of nearly a thousand kilometers was quickly traversed, and as a beam of light, Jack Clark directly charged into the Black Forbidden Zone, and instantly, a turbulent and rich Heavenly Energy rushed at him.
Compared to the Outer World, Heavenly Energy in this forbidden area was richer and also contained some of the turbulence of Void Energy.
The edges of his Black Gold vertical pupils were surrounded by sixteen circles of black runes spinning, as Jack Clark slowly surveyed the forbidden area, his gaze sweeping over the sky full of dense cracks that were hard to get through, his figure slowly descending.
Thump! His heavy footsteps landed on the ground, causing the Earth to tremble slightly.
From the outside, the forbidden area looks black, but upon entering, it’s much like the outside world, with birds chirping and fragrant flowers.
But when Jack Clark passed through the edge of the cracks he saw from several kilometers away, the scene in front instantly changed; the sky became dark and oppressive, with raging winds howling and the Earth desolate.
Roar!
The Level 9 mid-stage giant beast, over two hundred meters long and coiled at the center of this desolate land, suddenly got up, followed by a darkness that enveloped all.
Boom! Red lightning flashed on the body of the Giant Beast, the Thunderstorm Domain exploded, tearing through the darkness, and the surrounding dirt and rocks exploded continuously.
But once the darkness disappeared, within the tens of kilometers range of the dim area, there was nothing left but the Level 9 Giant Beast standing at the foot of the hillside, issuing a ferocious roar.
Following those ‘spatial cracks,’ Jack Clark concealed his aura, chasing the white light that occasionally flashed in the sky as he moved deeper into the forbidden zone.
As a ‘world’ that had shattered, the Heavenly Earth Laws here were chaotic; one moment it might be sunny and bright, and the next second one might find themselves in a land of ice and snow.
There were also some Chaotic Zones spanning tens to hundreds of kilometers, emitting terrifying suction, where once entered, one would be bound by space and unable to leave.
And these were only the natural dangers. In some areas with extremely rich Heavenly Energy, many strong Level 9 Giant Beasts and even Mythical-level ones dwelt.
So when Jack Clark had only traveled a bit more than two thousand kilometers, his expression grew solemn, he fully activated the Hidden Deity Glyphs to erase his aura and presence, and quietly stood in the corner of a shadow.
Under the dim sky, the Earth was cracked, and magma flowed. A dark red beast with a length of over seven hundred meters laid prone, beneath it golden magma tumbled, emitting scorching heat.
Roar! Suddenly, the Mythical Giant Beast that was hibernating snapped open its eyes, its huge eyes looking around vigilantly, with a hint of bewilderment and ferocity in its gaze.
Because it felt as though it had just sensed a dangerous presence.
But at this moment, its surroundings were desolate, without any abnormalities, and no other creatures had appeared.
Boom!
The Lava Lake exploded, and the massive Giant Beast roared as it soared into the sky to a height of ten thousand meters, with the hot magma falling from between its scales.
But still, it discovered nothing.
While the Mythical-level Giant Beast was bewildered and had given up on taking action against it, Jack Clark, who had planned to kill it, had already concealed his aura and flew into the deep area, following a shadow on the Earth tens of kilometers away.
His target was the converging World Origin Energy.
…
While Jack Clark delved deeper into the forbidden zone, in another direction of the Black Forbidden Zone that connects to the Divine Gods Alliance, a group of over ten people was also moving deeper.
These individuals wore black robes, and the weakest among them radiated the aura of the Eight Layer Heaven, yet they all moved with extreme caution within the forbidden zone.

chapters.title: Chapter 827: 358 Defining Death, Blood God Akunus_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 827: Chapter 358 Defining Death, Blood God Akunus_3
Suddenly, the leading elder halted abruptly, his voice raspy as he said, “Be careful, something is off about our surroundings; I sense a strong smell of blood.”
No sooner had the leader’s voice fallen than the hillside a kilometer away burst open, and out roared a giant python that was over two hundred and forty meters long, its body covered in gray scale armor.
Roar!
The mouth of the gray python yawned wide, and with a fierce inhalation, a gray tornado engulfed an area of hundreds of meters in an instant, unleashing a fearsome devouring power.
Boom boom boom! Beneath the gray tornado, the earth shattered, and countless fragments of rock and dirt continued to swirl and fly toward the gaping mouth of the python, creating a terrifying scene as if it were devouring the heavens and earth.
As the devouring suction enveloped them, a red blood light burst forth from the bodies of the people inside, forming a thick barrier spanning dozens of meters when merged with True Strength and Blood Flame, blocking the devouring power.
Just then, the long-haired young man in the middle, protected by the crowd, sharpened his gaze toward the distant gray python and said with an icy voice, “Seeking death, Karola, go all out and kill that giant beast.”
The elder known as Karola bowed respectfully, “As you command, my god.”
“Protect our god well.”
The other thirteen people also bowed respectfully, “As you command, Archbishop.”
Boom!
Endless blood light erupted from the body of the elder, transforming into a Nine-headed Blood Python nearly three hundred meters long, and in an instant, an overwhelming pressure of a Nine-layer Late Period burst forth.
Roar! Witnessing the sudden transformation into a Late Stage 9 ‘giant beast’, the Nine-headed Blood Python, the gray python revealed a hint of solemnity in its eyes, and the raging wind it emitted dissipated.
Without exchanging words, the two Level 9 ‘giant beasts’ ferociously lunged at each other, clashing instantly as the Sea of Blood Field and the Gray Field collided, setting off a massive wave of energy.
Thereafter, the two beasts commenced a bloody melee fight.
Boom boom boom!!
As the two closely-matched beasts fought, the sky trembled, the earth fractured, and the strong impacts of their energies forced the group of people in the distance to continuously retreat.
Compared to Jack Clark’s overwhelming victory and instant kill against peers, the elder named Karola, who was at a Late Stage 9, took almost half an hour to kill this Mid Level 9 giant beast.
Boom!
With six of its heads biting and tearing, the corpse of the Gray Python whose neck was broken collapsed to the ground with a crash, thrashing wildly as blood sprayed from the wound.
“Karola, don’t let that blood go to waste.”
“As you command, my god.”
Boom!
The fiefdom of the Blood Python, now left with only six heads, burst forth, causing the land to tremble and forcibly suppressing the still struggling corpse of the Gray Python, rendering it immobile.
The long-haired youth’s face showed displeasure, “You’ve regressed in strength, Karola, taking so long to kill a Mid Level 9 beast.”
The elder resumed his human form, looking somewhat pale as he bowed respectfully, “I am of no use, please quell your anger, my god.”
At this moment, the long-haired youth’s expression softened once more, “It’s not your fault. With my True Body shattered, your strengths have also been greatly affected.”
These followers disregarded the young man’s capricious mood entirely, their eyes filled with fanaticism as they respectfully bowed, “It is all because we are inadequate.”
The long-haired youth waved his hand and approached the torn neck of the beast, placing his hand on its flesh and blood; in an instant, a rich blood light spread from him as the center.
Gurgle gurgle! The body of the giant beast shook, and countless blood mixed with essence surged towards the long-haired youth, absorbed by him continuously and without end.
The long-haired youth was like a black hole, quickly draining all the blood from the Level 9 giant beast, his entire being enveloped by a rich, blood-colored light, emitting a terrifying aura.
The long-haired youth slowly opened his eyes, which faintly showed the outlines of a battered Nine-headed Python, his gaze cold.
“It’s still not enough, owing to the incompleteness of my Soul Source and the shattering of my Rule True Body, my strength stops increasing after recovering to the Nine-layer Late Period.”
At this, a fierce hatred flashed in the young man’s eyes, “Mysterious Martial, Denny Kaye, the day I find The Heart of the World to reshape my soul and return to the realm of myths will be the doomsday for your kin.”
After venting the hatred in his heart, the long-haired young man’s demeanor changed again, his eyes becoming calm as he turned to look at his followers and spoke lightly.
“The Heart of the World has surfaced, located in the central region of the forbidden area. Once there, with the World Fragments’ guidance, I will quickly find the entrance.”
“Upon completing myself, the remaining World Origin that has been gathered will be rewarded to you.”
The more than ten followers immediately knelt on one knee, their expressions filled with fervor as they shouted, “Thank you for your grace, my god. You shall surely ascend the throne once more and once again become a being of myth.”
Akunus nodded in satisfaction, then continued forward with his subordinates.

chapters.title: Chapter 828: 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons
chapters.content:
Chapter 828: Chapter 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons
In the depths of the forbidden area, over ten thousand kilometers deep, a Void Storm rages, affecting thousands of kilometers. Countless black Void Storms surge from the heavens to the earth, sweeping away numerous fragments of space.
In this region, even Ninth Heaven Experts need to be cautious when they are caught in the storms, or they will fall, extremely dangerous.
That’s why very few pioneer teams venture this deep; they generally explore the edges and outer areas of the forbidden zone, extending outward in search of stability.
After all, they are full of the spirit of adventure, not a death wish.
Yet at this moment, in this terrifying area of the Void Storm, Jack Clark was as comfortable as a fish in water. He soared low over the broken land, even passing directly through two intertwining black storms.
Occasionally, when a black storm’s limb swept over him, it would instantly dissolve, shaking the surrounding space and causing shockwaves to explode.
Under the impact of these remnants of the Void Storms, a barrier of yellow, golden, black, and blue swirled around Jack, emanating an aura of unassailability and immovability.
The barrier formed by the power of the Fourfold World compensated for Jack’s defensive weaknesses, elevating his defense at the Eighth Layer Early Phase to be comparable to that of the Ninth Heavens.
Suddenly, having penetrated deep into the center of the storm area, Jack’s gaze shifted slightly as he looked into the distance.
Under the scrutiny of his black gold vertical pupils, several tens of kilometers away in the high altitude, strands of black energy converged to form a black sphere suspended in the air, surrounded by black storms hundreds to thousands of kilometers thick.
What caught Jack’s attention was the innate aura emanating from that sphere of light.
“It contains Void power in the form of innate runes, a pity, though, it’s somewhat incomplete,” Jack reflected with a hint of regret.
This was the first resource he had discovered in the mythical world, and it was a special power type of innate rune. Even if incomplete, it was sufficient to propel a cultivator directly into the Ninth Heavens.
However, that area was very dangerous. To retrieve it, he would have to summon the Thunderflame
Emperor Dragon Projection and use absolute power to scatter the surrounding Void Storms.
But given the scale of the storm that stirred heaven and earth, unleashing Mythical-level power here could potentially trigger a chain reaction.
Therefore, Jack glanced at the howling storms around him and then looked up at the white light flashing past tens of thousands of meters above, his figure swiftly continuing deeper into the region.
Compared to the continuously converging World Origin deep within the forbidden zone, there was no need to waste time on this incomplete innate rune. He would reconsider it on his way back.
With the ability of the Eyes of Void and Death to see through the essence of the world, Jack
swiftly traversed the area of destruction formed by the Void Storms.
Roar!
No sooner had Jack crossed the Void Storm region than the earth and sky trembled. A Mythical-level terrifying energy fluctuation spread through the air, accompanied by an awful roar.
Observing the sudden tremors followed by dead silence ahead, Jack’s expression grew somber.
Through another layer of Void Double Pupils, he saw a slowly twisting vortex stretching across the heaven and earth, an invisible substance stirring the space.
At the same time, a black rune, resembling a knife yet not a knife, surfaced on Jack’s forehead.
This rune, long silent, pulsed steadily. His innermost instincts warned Jack not to take another step forward, or something would go wrong. Ahead lay a region dangerous even for Mythical Creatures.
“It looks like I’ll have to take a detour,” Jack uttered, his figure flashing as he sketched an arc, traveling several thousand extra kilometers to bypass the range of that vortex.
Following white lights that occasionally flashed across the sky, over the next few days Jack avoided various perilous zones, and after killing two Level 9 Giant Beasts, he arrived at a place more than fifty thousand kilometers deep.
Above the torn earth, mountain ranges rose and fell, and standing on the edge of a cliff of a mountain that reached tens of thousands of feet into the sky was Jack, clad in black-red armor.
Surrounding him were tangible gusts of green wind, imbued with a terrifying power strong enough to tear apart Eight Layer Heaven cultivators, the wind bursting on Jack with deafening roars.
Standing firm in the raging wind, Jack’s expression was serious as he looked ahead.
