There, where heaven and earth were shattered, lay a region of spatial chaos, a special area where the laws of heaven and earth collapsed and the earth had lost its gravity, with countless mountain-sized ‘islands’ floating about.
And the strands of World Origin light that Jack had been pursuing all along were all streaming towards the deep chaos of this area.
Boom!
In the distance, an ‘island’ thousands of kilometers tall crumbled; the space in that region suddenly collapsed, forming a black hole that devoured everything.
The instantaneous Burst of destructive power made even Jack’s eyes twitch.
“Time to be careful,” he reminded himself.
Now within this region, Jack naturally would not give up. His Void Double Pupils swirled as he remained vigilant in every direction, following the white light that periodically dashed through the sky and plunging straight into it.
Boom, boom, boom!! In the Death Forbidden Zone, where space continually collapsed, Jack was like a small ship sailing through raging winds and a tsunami.
At that moment, even Jack felt he was a bit mad to have ventured so deep into such a dangerous forbidden zone. If not for the Eyes of Void and Death that could see through the true nature of the world, he would have perished on the way.
Of course, he wouldn’t have come if he weren’t confident.
After cautiously navigating nearly several thousand kilometers, Jack’s form gradually landed on a meteor hundreds of meters high as he looked towards the Void in front of him.
There was a formless World Rift spanning ten thousand meters, which eyes could not see, and through which a strand of World Origin had just flown.
“Finally found it,” a smile appeared on Jack’s face.
After trekking through tens of thousands of kilometers into the forbidden zone and bypassing numerous dangers, the time had finally come to reap the rewards.
And although the invisible crack stretched across the sky and earth, it had no impact on the outer world; Jack’s spiritual sense detected no danger.
So after just a moment of hesitation, Jack flew straight towards it, rushing headlong into the crack.

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 829: Chapter 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons_2
In an instant, Jack Clark’s field of vision shifted, and he found himself on a desolate land floating deep in the Void, spanning only dozens of kilometers.
Boom!
As soon as Jack landed, his body suddenly sank, the ground beneath him, hard beyond measure, cracked, and with the sound of crackling, crevices spread out for hundreds of meters.
“So heavy!” Jack’s face showed seriousness.
This place was like the interior of a planet; between Heaven and Earth was filled with a heavy, terrifying gravity, a force so powerful it could instantly crush an Eighth Layer Expert and compress an aircraft carrier into a slab of steel.
This crushing force filled the World, an intangible material pressing on every muscle, bone, organ, and even cell in the body, making even Jack feel uncomfortable.
No wonder the ‘Earth’ here is so flat.
Jack, straining, lifted his head to look toward the ends of the Earth, where there was a Mysterious Light Group enveloping a range of hundreds of meters, emitting an aura that drove people mad.
The moment Jack’s gaze fell on that Mysterious Yellow halo, he instinctively felt a strong desire.
Within the deep reaches of that Mysterious Yellow glow, flows of complete World Origin converged, the number surpassing ten,
and ‘above’ occasionally, a strand of white light like fine hair penetrated the Void, falling from the skies, ceaselessly merging into that Mysterious Yellow glow.
I’ve struck it rich! Even Jack couldn’t help but breathe faster, his face revealing excitement.
Boom!
Jack took a step forward, and instantly the ground shook and subsided, but there was no air or shockwaves thrown up, because everything was suppressed by the pervasive heavy force between Heaven and Earth.
Stepping heavily and crushing the Earth, it took Jack more than half an hour to traverse one kilometer, then he stopped.
Because the closer he got to that Mysterious Yellow halo, the more terrifying the oppressive force between Heaven and Earth became. At this point, Jack was under a force almost ten times greater than when he first came.
Jack opened his mouth with difficulty, his teeth making a crackling sound, “It seems, I can’t… hold back anymore.”
Boom! In an instant, the boundless Qi Blood within Jack exploded, its robust and terrifying spirit akin to a plume of smoke piercing the Cloud Sky, shaking the ‘World’.
Crackle crackle!! Entering into the Combat Divine Body, Jack’s silhouette rapidly swelled, revealing in a blink an eye a True Dragon Battle Body over forty meters high with three-faced six-armed.
Behind him, thunder and flames condensed on four arms that were forming hand seals, each arm vaguely holding up a Divine Wheel of about ten meters in diameter, radiating yellow, golden, black, and blue hues.
As the four light wheels slowly rotated, a fourfold illusory World projection emerged behind Jack, as if he were a Creation God surrounded by Worlds, radiating terrifying suppressive power.
Boom boom boom!!
Thunder roared and flames blazed around Jack, the splendor of the Fourfold World barrier colliding with the heavy gravity filling the World, releasing terrible force impacts.
Under the Combat Divine Body, Jack’s strength, Defense, and all other aspects of his power surged, braving the gravity to move forward, rapidly approaching that Mysterious Yellow halo as he crushed the earth with heavy steps.
But when Jack had traveled ten kilometers, the oppressive force coming from all directions soared by more than ten times.
Boom!
Under the dreadful pressure, the Fourfold World barrier fused with Jack’s Defense suddenly shattered, his figure sank, and his stature was compressed to thirty meters with the sound of crackling.
“Roar! Open for me.”
Jack, like an ancient War God, let out a roar. The Radiance of blood gleamed from his third eye as he unfolded the Doomsday Domain, creating a Sea of Blood Field covering hundreds of meters range.
Boom boom boom!!
Under that crushing force, as soon as the Sea of Blood Domain unfolded, it instantly shrank, compressing to only around Jack in a range of tens of meters, the blood light becoming almost substantial.
Roar! At that moment, within the blood light, the figure of a Demon God emerged, spreading its arms wide. With a boom, it pounced on Jack, and his aura surged again instantly.
Boom!
With an endless tide of bloodlight infiltrating, Jack’s whole body in Demon God Battle Body changed into Red Scaled Armor, with sharp spines growing from the Black-red Scaled Armor on his body.
Under the form of Fighting Demon God Battle Body, Jack once again moved forward with a thunderous step that caused the ground to collapse beneath him, cracking the Earth and spreading fissures for hundreds of meters.
However, the heavy pressure of this World still had some kind of a limit. When Jack was ready to burst all of his power and enter the Fighting War Demon God Form of the dragon, the pervasive gravity between heaven and earth did not increase indefinitely.
As his stature shrank step by step, almost being compressed to five meters tall by the heavy gravity, Jack in the form of the Fighting War Demon God eventually reached that Mysterious Yellow halo and stepped into it.
The moment Jack entered the Mysterious Yellow glow, his body ‘exploded’. Every muscle, bone, and even cell, parched like a desert, madly absorbed the surrounding Mysterious ‘energy’.
Under this special power, Jack keenly sensed his ‘potential’ infinitely increasing, his physique and the very nature of his life beginning to undergo a transformation.
“I am returning to the Innate!”
Shock appeared in Jack’s eyes. As he absorbed the Mysterious Yellow energy, his body and even his soul underwent a transformation, feeling as though he was regressing from the acquired to the Innate state.
At this time, a strong wave of fatigue hit Jack.
Fighting the drowsiness, Jack settled in the middle of the Mysterious Yellow glow cross-legged, opened the Sumeru Bracelet, and took out all the remaining Blood Lotus Seeds, casting god fluid, and dragon pattern blood crystals.
After swallowing all the Blood Lotus Seeds and casting god fluid in one go, Jack held two dragon pattern blood crystals and closed his eyes to begin cultivation, exuding an even stronger suction force.
Under the pull of this forceful attraction, the ten flows of the World Origin circulating nearby were absorbed by Jack, disappearing into his body.
Boom! As soon as Jack began to cultivate cross-legged, the aura on his body soared several times over, and the cultivation he had accumulated for a long time smoothly made a breakthrough to the Mid-eighth level.

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 830: Chapter 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons_3
However, at this moment, Jack Clark’s consciousness had already fallen into hibernation, his entire being shrouded in Mysterious Yellow energy as if he were a Demon God nurtured at the dawn of creation, centering around him, a terrifying oppressive force spread out.
As Jack Clark’s body, soul, and Soul Source began their transformation, under the Soul Synchronizing ability of his Soul Talent, some energy appeared in the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon through the Soul Channel.
Suddenly, beneath the deep sea, a special transformation was also occurring on the hibernating black-red Colossal Beast.
However, compared to Jack Clark, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body was too massive, and the impact of the incoming Mysterious Yellow energy was weak, only granting it a touch of innate quality.
Meanwhile, on the other side of the forbidden area, more than twenty thousand kilometers deep into the forbidden zone, and diagonally sixty thousand kilometers from where Jack Clark was in hibernation, a group from the Blood God Sect was approaching.
However, compared to their number upon entering, this squad now only had nine left, with some fanatics from the Eight and Nine Layers showing signs of weakened aura.
Unlike Jack Clark, who could sense danger and see the various invisible forbidden zones to move quickly forward, Akunus and his group were in much more of a sorry state, moving slowly.
After all, this was a deep forbidden area where even king-level figures could fall.
If it weren’t for Akunus leading the team, able to split into blood pythons to scout the way, this squad would have been decimated long ago in a deadly forbidden land.
…
As Jack Clark entered closed-door cultivation and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slept, the world continued to spin, and the march of progress wouldn’t stop for anyone’s presence or demise.
The Sky Curtain Battlefield, the Frontline Battlefield appeared desolate and quiet when the Civilization Great War had not erupted.
Deep in the battlefield, more than ten thousand kilometers away from the Human Base, the Earth’s mountain ranges rose and fell, and lingering mists among heaven and earth obscured vision.
At this moment, a ten-person squad was shuttling through the mountain forest; each member was clad in battle armor, holding weapons, and had concealed their energy fluctuations and the glow of their armor.
Soon, this squad, with the weakest at Seventh Layer, arrived at the edge of a mountain ridge over seven thousand meters high and concealed themselves under weeds, cautiously looking forward.
Across the cloud-enveloped mountain ranges, they could vaguely see structures unlike those of the Human Race, towers erected as part of a base.
Within this squad, the weakest cultivator at the initial phase of the Seventh Layer Heaven had eyes completely turned silver, his gaze spanning tens of kilometers to take in the base.
Soon, the thirty-something year-old cultivator’s face lit up with excitement, “Captain, it’s the Kata Clan army, a subsidiary of The Purgatory Family.”
“And this army has just stationed here; many of their defense fortifications are still incomplete. We’ve struck gold.”
“Indeed, we’ve struck gold.”
The middle-aged captain licked his lips, also revealing a look of joy, for if they could destroy that subsidiary army, everyone in the squad would gain a considerable amount of merit.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, the middle-aged man solemnly gave the order, “Cyril, link to the nearest base, start simulating the coordinates and directions, and transfer the information back.”
“Yes, boss.”
As he spoke, the youthful-looking member of the team with a shimmering wrist emitted a twinkle, and a device more than ten meters tall with a long antenna above it landed on the ground.
Whirr!
With the activation of the energy source, the youth’s hands moved like phantoms on the ‘computer,’ connecting with a distant counterpart thousands of miles away, as a multitude of information cascaded across the screen.
The middle-aged man looked at the other members and spoke with a heavy voice, “Everyone split into groups of three and spread out; if you encounter Kata Clan’s patrol teams, eliminate them all.”
“Next, it will take some time for the missiles to reach the designated bombardment spot, during which Cyril needs to continue transmitting signals to correct the flight trajectory.”
As he said this, the middle-aged man turned to the new member of the team, “Li Dao Yi, remember not to hold back when the time comes to prevent the alien legion from discovering the anomalies here and disrupting the signal guidance.”
Damon Lopes replied with a solemn expression, “Rest assured, Captain, I understand.”
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!! The nine-person team scattered to safeguard the upcoming coordinate adjustments.
In the mountain forest, Damon Lopes’s body burst with faint electric arcs, scanning a range of several kilometers like a radar, his expression as calm and steady as a mountain.
But in his heart, he was incredibly excited at this moment; sure enough, this Daoist Master is indeed the chosen one—having only recently arrived at the frontline and he was about to achieve a great feat, ha ha…
In the next half hour, Damon Lopes and his team were quite lucky, not encountering any alien patrol soldiers or experiencing any accidents.
Soon, as the information positioning continued, streaks of light appeared in the sky, and the alien base tens of kilometers away sounded a piercing alarm.
“No good, it’s Human Race missiles.”
“Careful, hide.”
“Quick, activate the energy shield…”
Boom!
An imposing figure exuding a Nine Layers aura shot up from the base, surrounded by Blue Radiance, trying to intercept the missiles that had reached nearly ten times the speed of sound in the sky.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the attack of the Nine Layers alien strong man, several missiles were instantly detonated, brilliant explosions blooming across ten thousand meters altitude, illuminating heaven and earth.
In the intense aftermath of the ordinary nuclear explosion, even that alien strong man spat blood and his complexion drastically changed.
Meanwhile, more supersonic missiles carrying large warheads exploded in the air, with countless miniature nuclear bomb heads falling from the sky enveloped in firelight.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, half of the mountain ranges trembled, and as the Earth splintered and sky shattered, small mushroom clouds rose serenely, a huge protective barrier that had just formed shattered under the blasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 831: Chapter 359 The Awakening of the Mythical Giant Beast, Innate Gods and Demons_4
Under the terrifyingly intense blast of heat, countless alien races turned to flying ash. Only those strong alien races and “people” who hid in the underground works survived this disaster.
The light and heat emitted by the explosion of hundreds of miniature nuclear warheads almost lit up the sky, shining even brighter than the sun above.
And it wasn’t over yet. Just as the Ninth Heaven Expert of the alien race above turned pale and grim, a missile tens of meters long pierced the clouds and fell from the sky.
Due to its high speed, it even formed a scorching shockwave at the front, and the captain on the distant mountain ridge was so shocked that he shouted, “It’s a high-yield Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb, everyone get down, use True Power Protection, and close your eyes!”
Just as the captain’s voice fell, the missile that appeared a kilometer above the base exploded in an instant, turning into a ‘star’ that shone in the sky, visible for thousands of kilometers around.
Boom!
In the release of the devastating energy, everyone went deaf, lying on the ground they couldn’t hear a sound, only feeling the whole world shaking.
The power of the hydrogen bomb was immense; its core could instantly generate temperatures of tens of millions to a hundred million Celsius, creating a scorching shockwave that radiated in all directions, annihilating everything in its path.
But this high temperature only lasted for a short time, and the further away from the center of the explosion, the less lethal it was, especially to extraordinary creatures with protective strength, including some defensive structures.
However, the hydrogen bomb integrated with extraordinary Crystal Energy released several times the temperature of original hydrogen bombs in an instant. The energy release of hydrogen and uranium elements was even more thorough, making the power even more terrifying.
Even standard king-level beings would not dare to resist such a weapon head-on.
But the demon kings could move at speeds over ten times the speed of sound, plus they could twist space for short-range jumps, making these cumbersome weapons hardly a threat to them.
Yet for those below the king-level, the ‘Hydrogen Bombs’ of the Human Federation were very terrifying, a dreadful weapon used by the Human Race to massively destroy the armies of the Purgatory Demon Clan and Affiliated Race Corps.
About ten minutes later, the impact of the explosion finally completely dissipated, Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Everyone returned to the bare mountain ridge and looked towards the distance.
By then, the fog filling the heavens and earth around had dissipated, and the alien base in the distance was gone, mountains collapsed, turning into a giant crater two kilometers in diameter.
Around the crater, the earth for twenty or so kilometers was devastated by the high temperatures, leaving nothing but ash. Surrounding fires burned, forming a deathly sea of flames over tens of kilometers.
Under the flame’s burning, the vegetation and leaves on this mountain range shook and released a large amount of water vapor, forming mists that converged and soared into the sky.
Soon, the entire mountain range was covered with thick fog, and a light rain began to fall, suppressing the great fire.
Big Beard Captain’s face lit up with excitement, “Let’s go, the mission is completed, if we don’t leave now, the strong ones of the Purgatory Demon Race will come.”
Having been in conflict for many years, both sides knew each other well, and soon Damon Lopes and the others disappeared from the region.
Meanwhile, on another frontline battlefield, missiles and cannonballs roared across the sky, fighter aircraft howled overhead, and a black-red colored Mecha standing 150 meters tall towered on the land.
……
When Jack Clark entered The Heart of the World for closed-door cultivation, in the Blue Star World above the tumultuous sea, two mighty armies of giant beasts faced off against each other.
To the left was the sea patrol army of giant beasts from the Red Dragon Beast Empire, led by a Black Tiger Whale that had already made a breakthrough to level eight, followed by several Level 8 Beasts and more than twenty Level 7 Colossi.
Opposite them was the Mutated Tiger Whale Army of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire; hovering quietly in front of more than a hundred mutated tiger whales on the sea surface was a Single-horned Tiger Kingfish that measured more than 140 meters in length.
Also on the nearby sea surfaced a Sea Turtle Giant Beast like a dark brown small hill, exuding a terrifying pressure.
Facing the numerically superior Dragon Palace army, led by two king-level bloodline Ninth Level Giant Beasts, all the beasts of the Red Dragon Empire were so scared that they didn’t dare to move.
It’s terrifying, worthy of the Beast Empire that even Lord Red Mane fears. Just the patrolling Alien Beast Army is many times the number of the Red Dragon Empire’s.
Especially the two leading Level 9 Giant Beasts, although they were also at Level 9, their aura was much stronger and more terrifying than Lord Shark and the others.
Just as the makeshift assembly of beasts were panic-stricken, pondering whether to take the opportunity to flee and leave the Red Dragon Empire, their leader, the Black Tiger Whale, had already launched a provocation.
The Black Tiger Whale swam to the forefront, looking at those two terrifying Level 9 Giant Beasts, and let out a deep and sonorous roar.
Roar! You despicable Dragon Palace beasts, do not step into the great Red Dragon Empire’s territory, or don’t blame us for being rude.
Roar! If you dare to advance even one step further, it’s a declaration of war against our Red Dragon Empire, and don’t blame Lord Red Mane for taking action against you.
Immediately, all the beasts behind it were startled and their eyes widened.
No, leader, if you want to find death, don’t drag us with you.
The Sea Turtle Giant Beast next to the Black Tiger Whale was even more so paralyzed, not daring to move a muscle, for fear of provoking a misunderstanding and being devoured in one bite.
At this moment, not only were the beasts of the Red Dragon Empire bewildered, but the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish opposite them was also confused.
Since when did its third sibling become a member of the Red Dragon Empire? And so arrogant, too.
The bewildered Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was just about to speak up when the sea below it exploded; a huge Mutated Tiger Whale raised its tail, churning up furious waves that landed beside the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 359 Mythical Giant Beast Awakens, Innate God-Demon_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 832: Chapter 359 Mythical Giant Beast Awakens, Innate God-Demon_5
With a powerful blow, the sea water exploded all around, the unprepared and perhaps unwilling-to-defend Single-horned Tiger Whale was directly struck by a tail and smashed into the sea.
The sudden change left both sides stunned.
Bang! The sea surface burst open, and the Single-horned Tiger Whale looked dumbfounded: Wailing! Why did you hit me, my love?
In the distance, under the turbulent sea surface, darkness covered a range of hundreds of meters, with the gentle chirping of the Female Tiger Whale coming from within.
Wailing!
Since it did not contain any thought fluctuations and was only the language of the Tiger Whales, the Red Dragon Empire’s giant beasts on the other side didn’t know what it said.
After the Female Tiger Whale spoke, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle glanced at each other, seemingly regaining their senses, then an intense terrorizing pressure burst from the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s body.
Boom!
In an instant, the sea surface exploded, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle emanated a frightening king-level dragon might with its deep and muffled roar resounding in the sea.
Roar! I am one of the Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace, the King of Earth and Destruction, and you, the Black Tiger Whale, have quite the courage to speak to me like this.
Roar! Are you interested in joining the Dragon Palace? I, as the king, will give you the position of Cavalry General, commanding a Tiger Whale army?
Blinking its eyes, the Black Tiger Whale righteously declined: Wailing! I’m not interested. I am loyal to the Red Dragon Empire and will not join your Dragon Palace.
Wailing! I warn you again, don’t intrude into the Red Dragon Empire’s territory, brothers, let’s go.
After saying this, the Black Tiger Whale led the way and swam away, and the other giant beasts hurriedly followed, fearing that they would be eaten by those ferocious beasts of the Dragon Palace if they were just a bit late.
When they had swam tens of kilometers away and felt no danger coming from behind, all the giant beasts breathed a sigh of relief, then looked at the Black Tiger Whale with admiration.
The Sea Turtle Giant Beast swam over, somewhat flattering: Hoot! Leader, you were so fierce just now, daring to roar loudly at the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace.
The Black Tiger Whale slapped its fins, proudly raising its head.
Wailing! Of course, I, your leader, have always been very fierce. What if the opponent is the Dragon King? If I don’t bow, I’ll fight. At most, I’ll get beaten up if I lose.
At this time, where had the little Female Tiger Whale been? Little Kitty caught up.
The Black Tiger Whale asked: Wailing! Miss Kitty, after we left, they didn’t enter our great Red Dragon Beast Empire’s territory, right?
The little Kitty, who had disappeared and communicated with Miss Keller in the dark domain under the deep sea, obediently chirped: Wailing! No, leader.
The Black Tiger Whale was satisfied: Wailing! Not bad, at least those giant beasts of the Dragon Palace know better.
Immediately, all the younger brothers around admired the leader even more. He was indeed their leader, very brave and unyielding, and genuinely unafraid of death.
Meanwhile, on the other side of the deep sea, far away from the Tiger Whale Army, three giant beasts were swimming ahead.
The Female Tiger Whale whispered: The Beast Empire over there is called Red Dragon. The mythical-level Red Beast guards the entrance to the channel.
Apart from that, their outer forces are made up of two Early-stage Level 9 Beasts, with more than a dozen level eight beasts distributed around the vicinity of the channel.
Old Three said that this Beast Empire is weak and can be attacked as soon as the King wakes up.
At that time, he could cooperate with the King to lure the quasi-mythical beast guarding the channel over and kill it. However, he had never seen the mythical King of that Empire himself, so he didn’t know how powerful it was.
Wailing! Is that Beast Empire so weak?
Both the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle were somewhat surprised.
Roar! Too weak, wait for Thunderflame to wake up and destroy them all.
The Female Tiger Whale murmured: Wailing! Old Three doesn’t care about it. I suggest that we split into three teams and continue to collect Life Crystals for the King.
After all this time, there should be some Mutated Fish in the Dragon Palace’s rear territory that have reached their level limits.
As time passed, ten days went by in a blink of an eye.
Under the deep sea whirlpool.
The Black-red Colossal Beast had now grown to 500 meters in length, appearing even more ferocious and enormous. Its overall appearance had undergone a significant change.
Suddenly, the hibernating Black-red Colossal Beast slowly opened its eyes. Its gigantic vertical pupils were like pure gold, with endless black lightning flashing within, emanating a destructive aura.
Roar! A world-shaking roar echoed through heaven and earth.
As the Black-red Colossal Beast got up, a terrifying aura that shook heaven and earth burst forth in an instant, causing the earth to collapse and the deep sea whirlpool that spanned tens of kilometers to erupt explosively.
The Silver Giant Dragon, which had been sleeping beside it, was suddenly swept away like garbage by the sudden blast, mixing with countless broken stones and dirt, and smashed into the raging sea.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you blew up the great Sethia again, you made the great Sethia fly again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 360: Thunder Flame. Destruction of the Heavenly Dragon, Arrival of the Blood God.
chapters.content:
Chapter 833: Chapter 360: Thunder Flame. Destruction of the Heavenly Dragon, Arrival of the Blood God.
The whirlpool on the sea surface collapses, a horrifying figure in black and red erupts skyward amongst the exploded seawater.
Boom!
At an altitude of ten thousand meters, countless black lightning bursts from the body of the gargantuan beast in black and red, causing the heavens and the earth to tremble under its destructive force. Thunderous dark clouds gather, obscuring a hundred kilometers range.
In an instant, it becomes dark as night over the sea. A hurricane of over ten levels gives rise to hundred-meter-high tsunamis. Thunderbolts fall from the sky, causing the seawater to boom and electric arcs to dance.
Roar!
The gargantuan beast in black and red cries out to the sky, its body emanating formidable mythical pressure, the vibrating waves filled with terrifying dragon power.
All marine creatures in the range of thousands of kilometers instantly stiffen, even the common mutant seabirds in flight, also fall onto the sea surface, trembling uncontrollably.
Hundred kilometers away, the nine-headed hydras and giant blue crabs patrolling the nearby ocean, all reveal joy in their eyes upon sensing the shaking mythical power.
Under the blood-pressing pressure, which instilled reverence in their blood instinctively, the nine heads of the hydra sway wildly, causing a chaotic roar in the sea.
Roar, roar, roar! Tim Abott, woke up, so powerful, crazy.
Gurgle, gurgle! King, becoming more and more explosive. The blue giant crab, too, shakes its eight legs in excitement, its whole body weakly floating on the sea surface.
The stronger the king, the better the life for its subjects.
This is apparent from its rapid increase in strength and consumption of many divine items, including the flesh of quasi-mythical beasts, which it had not dared to dream of before.
However, the blue giant crab’s way of expressing its excitement seems a bit off. Whenever it gets excited, it becomes weak, its eyes go white, and it starts blowing bubbles like a balancing doll.
Booming, booming, booming!!
In the heavy rolling dark clouds, thunder roars. As the illumination flickers across the sky, it only makes the figure standing in the air appear even more terrifying.
The fifth evolution is completed. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that was just over three hundred meters long has skyrocketed to around five hundred and ten meters, looking more robust and majestic.
Its heavy black and red scales are densely entwined with numerous black patterns. A touch of golden light flows through the gaps of the scales, radiating an indestructible aura.
On its back, the three rows of back fins, originally resembling rough coral reefs, have become sharper and more pointed, making the overall look more harmonious.
Its tail, occupying half the length of its body, is still slender, flexible, and sharp, looking like a terrifying blade over two hundred meters long with a sharp spike at the end.
It seems like an Eastern Dragon, but its head is wider and more brutish. The three pairs of black dragon horns rise in order, piercing the sky, appearing very domineering under the backdrop of countless sharp and pointed scales that resemble manes.
On both sides of the head, three pairs of red feathered horns extend backward, on top of which is a burning golden flame forming a flame crown, giving the black and red beast a touch of sacredness.
Boom! At this moment, the roaring sea beneath explodes, and a massive silver giant dragon rises to the sky amid the surrounding storm.
The silver giant dragon has already absorbed the energy of two top-level Black Melt Divine Fruits and under the stimulation of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s life essence, has grown to more than two hundred and twenty meters.
But the silver giant dragon is very angry at the moment because it has been guarding the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with great effort, but this guy just woke up and blew it away again.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you blew me away again. The great Scythia is angry, so angry.”
Roaring, the silver giant dragon lunges straight in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, ignoring the black lightning around it, and bites down on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s sturdy left claw.
Boom!
Under the fearsome bite force of the silver giant dragon, sparks fly off the left arm of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, a terrifying collision causing a roaring sound between the dragon’s teeth and the black and red scales.
“Roar! Pain.”
With a single bite, the sharp and large teeth of the silver giant dragon are immediately pained by the black and red scales, instantly making it even angrier.
Looking at the silver giant dragon that was gnashing its teeth against its left arm, viciously intending to take another bite, yet fearing the pain but reluctant to accept defeat, the black and red giant beast is somewhat speechless.
The black and red giant beast slightly opens its mouth, and the burning firelight emits a vibrating growl: “Roar! Scythia, it was an accident before, it was an instinctive burst of energy in me that caused it.”
In reality, with its current defense, had it not withdrawn the destructive lightning and the diamond rule power surrounding it just now, the rebound alone would have been enough to injure the silver giant dragon.
“Roar! Really?” The silver giant dragon shows uncertainty in its eyes.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly nods: “Of course. When have I ever lied to you?”
“Roar! Fine, the great Scythia has forgiven you.”
With a low growl, the silver giant dragon lets go of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s left claw, then unfurls its wings and soars around the black and red giant beast, sending excited roars from its mouth.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re so fierce now. Let’s go and kill that stinking stone. The great Scythia wants to stand on its head and shame it.”
“Roar! It dares to chase after the great Scythia. Unforgivable. We must kill it.”
Watching the excited silver giant dragon circling around, the black and red giant beast growls lowly: “Scythia, I just broke through the mythical level this time, not becoming an ancient behemoth.”
At this point, the Thunder Flame Emperor Dragon felt very powerful, so powerful it could tear apart ordinary mythical creatures with ease.
But that’s all it was, slaying mythical creatures.
The ancient life form on the other side of the passage has an ancient titan in front of it, an existent nightmare that has reached the peak of the ancient titans. Even if it’s petrified, it’s not something the current beast can budge.

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 360 Thunderflame. Destroy the Heavenly Dragon, Arrival of the Blood God_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 834: Chapter 360 Thunderflame. Destroy the Heavenly Dragon, Arrival of the Blood God_2
Or put another way, without a similarly tiered power of rules, it is very difficult to shake those terrifying entities that are tens of kilometers in size.
In fact, this sort of failure in breakthrough, where the power of rules disperses and merges with the Earth, petrifying in the process, is a means of self-protection for these ancient creatures, guarding their hibernating selves for thousands or even tens of thousands of years from being “drilled through”.
And just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon awoke, in the mythical world, Jack Clark, who had been in closed-door cultivation for about ten days, was slowly opening his eyes.
At this moment, Jack still maintained the shape of the Demon God Form with the Shadow of the Three-faced Six-armed Demon God, with blood light swirling around him, his eyes pitch black and ice-cold, appearing godlike and demonic.
Or perhaps due to the nurturing power of the Mysterious Yellow Air, there was virtually no difference between him and a God Demon on the level of life.
It’s just that the insufficiency of Mysterious Yellow Air in this place only allowed for a reversal to provisional Innate condition for his body and soul and could not match those Innate Gods and Demons from the legends who wielded various laws and rules.
Even so, with the evolution feedback from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon during this period, and the body strength and cultivation nearly breaking through to the late period of the Eighth Layer, Jack’s current aura was extremely terrifying.
Moreover, since most of the Mysterious Yellow Energy had been absorbed, and it could only cover a hundred meters around him, the gravity enveloping this ‘continent’ in the Void had weakened by more than ten times.
After feeling the changes in his body during this time, Jack’s realm of thought stirred, and he summoned the attribute page, his gaze landing on the changes in his Avatar’s data.
Avatar Body: Thunder Flame.Destruction.Heavenly Dragon
Level: Ancient Mythical-level Giant Beast [A pseudo-heavenly tier colossus possessing two higher-order laws, six top-level talents, and one advanced talent]
Rules: Strength.Destruction [Higher-order, fusion evolution 5%], Defense.Vajra [Higher-order, fusion evolution 5%]
Physical Talent: Agility+ [Top-tier], Regeneration+ [Top-tier] Chaos Black Pattern+ [Advanced, innate pattern covering full-body scales armor, containing faint Chaotic power.
When activated, this ability forms a Chaotic Force Field on the body’s surface, which possesses high resistance against all non-physical attacks.
Note: When this talent is enhanced to the limit, it can touch Chaos, possessing absolute defense against all laws, neutralizing all non-physical power within Chaos, unassailable by myriad methods]
Special Talent: Gigantification+ [Top-tier]
Transcendent Talent: Burn Sky Golden Flame+ [Top-tier], Annihilation True Thunder+ [Top-tier], Purple Void Poison+ [Top-tier]
Evolution Value: 0/2000000
“Chaos Black Pattern!” Jack’s gaze fell upon the new talent, and he couldn’t help but curl his lips slightly upward.
Before its hibernation and evolution, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had swallowed the Black-striped Mutated Beast and acquired its special talent to resist transcendent powers like time, space, thunder, and flames.
Moreover, because the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was breaking through to mythical status, a talent that would normally be considered moderate had also become stronger through evolution, rising to advanced level, granting high resistance against all transcendent powers.
This high level of resistance was relative to the strength of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon; the stronger it became, the stronger the Chaos Black Pattern’s defense – in effect, a special talent with demon immunity.
This ability, combined with the solid scale armor of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, made its defense even more formidable, and this was the absolute defense Jack had hoped for.
Whether it was wielding the Time Talent or powers like spatial manipulation or burning the soul, none could affect it anymore; one would only have the option of engaging the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon in close combat.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack’s gaze passed over the powers of defense and strength, which had been promoted to higher-order laws.
Human cultivators, even after breaking through to the King’s Realm, still have early, mid, and late stages, with the distinctions based on the progression of grasped laws.
To break through to king means that the acquired strength has reached the law level, but this law is still incomplete, just at the introductory level, and requires continuous evolution and derivation.
To put it simply, it’s like a sapling growing into a Sky-touching Tree.
The process of comprehending and perfecting one’s own laws is not just a quantitative growth but also a qualitative improvement; there is a significant gap at each minor realm.
The ultimate goal of a cultivator is to exist independently of Heaven and Earth, to become a complete world unto oneself, commanding a set of complete personal laws.
For Mythical Giant Beasts that focus on bodily evolution, it’s about fusing their Titan Level bodies, which have completed law Tempering, with the laws, evolving on their own to drive the self-evolution of those laws.
It might sound simpler and more effortless than what human cultivators do, but the trade-off is the pace—it’s very slow.
Many Mythical Giant Beasts might take decades or even centuries to grow from early to mid-mythic status, while human kings might cross that divide in just a few years or over a decade.
This is the difference between passive evolution and active cultivation exploration.
Of course, such comparisons are not absolute. The mythical world is boundless and limitless, and there are also Mythical Giant Beasts with powerful talents that grow rapidly.
Beyond that, there are also beings with strong bloodline inheritances or those possessing terrifying talents for ‘evolution’ similar to the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon.
Moreover, some giant beasts with originally ordinary talents might, through luck and opportunity, consume some sort of Law Divine Artifact, taking one step to become a top-tier Mythical Giant Beast.
After carefully reviewing the data changes of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, Jack’s gaze fell on the two million evolution value requirement for the sixth evolution and was not surprised.
Following the pattern of the first five evolutions of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, the sixth evolution would likely cross the threshold of mythical status and Mythical Titan, reaching the peak of the Ancient Titan level.
Given such a significant leap, a requirement of only two million evolution value was quite a bargain.
Especially for those failed ancient beings who became stone, reaching the peak of the Ancient Titan level – let alone two million evolution value, even two billion would excite them.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 360 Thunderflame. The Destruction of the Heavenly Dragon, Arrival of the Blood God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 835: Chapter 360 Thunderflame. The Destruction of the Heavenly Dragon, Arrival of the Blood God_3
Even Jack Clark let out a small sigh of relief.
Because he could still evolve, it represented that the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon could continue to break through after reaching the peak of the Ancient Titan and eventually become an existence beyond the ancient.
Boom! The space above the ocean trembled, and a powerful repulsion force came from the depths of the Void, causing the flames on the three pairs of feather horns of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon to flicker.
“As expected, after being separated by an entire world, the pathway between the original body and the Avatar cannot be opened.” As the silver runes on the feather horns gradually dimmed, a trace of regret appeared in the eyes of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon.
Because if the Spatial Channel could not be opened, it could not send the Life Crystal through, which meant it couldn’t strengthen its Chaos Black Pattern talent immediately.
Besides, the Skeleton Essence of the Level 9 Giant Beasts and the Black Oblivion King couldn’t be directly delivered into the hands of the original body, Jack Clark.
To tackle this problem, either Jack Clark had to level up again, strengthen the space runes, and make the power of the opened channel sufficient to tear through the barriers between the two worlds, or the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had to enter the mythical world.
Bang bang!!
Just as the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was contemplating, the sea surface below burst apart as the Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Blue Giant Crab appeared.
Excited chaos roared from the nine dragon heads of the Flood Dragon looking at the terrifying Giant Beast standing in the sky, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, you’re awake, you’re so freakishly strong now.”
The Blue Giant Crab also bubbled with excitement: Glug glug!! Great King, you’re too formidable, so awesome that even my eight legs feel weak from excitement.
Damn! The words of the two Giant Beasts made several black lines appear on the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s head.
Especially the Blue Giant Crab, even if Kidora says you’re powerful and freakish, what’s with your weak legs?
Suppressing the urge to destroy them with a single claw, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon let out a slow, low growl that shook Heaven and Earth, “You two, go call back Joe and the others.”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon circling in the sky brightened and roared excitedly, “Roar!! Tim Abbott, are you assembling a mighty army to start a war to unify the ocean?”
“Something like that,” the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon slowly nodded to the persistent gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon, though it just wanted to see how many crystals Horned Lady and the others had gathered.
“Roar! Kidora, Crab General, move out quickly, call back Joe and the others.”
Urged by the Silver Giant Dragon, the two Giant Beasts quickly vanished from the sea surface.
Watching the two Giant Beasts leave, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon then turned to look into the distance, where a kilometer radius of the sea surface was enveloped by darkness and daylight, with time almost coming to a halt within.
Over half a month had passed, and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon had yet to make a breakthrough into the quasi-mythical.
Below on the sea surface, the vortex scattered by the awakening of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was once again forming under the intersection of powers from the two worlds, becoming a vortex that pierced through heaven and earth.
However, at this time, beneath the spinning red vortex, the seabed had sunk a kilometer due to the repeated destruction caused by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, aren’t we going to fight?” Seeing the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon once again lying on the seabed, the Silver Giant Dragon who had been excited for a long time was a bit lost.
After all, every time the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon made a breakthrough in strength, it would go out and fight.
The Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon let out a slow roar: “No rush, once Joe and the others return to the sea surface, I’ll just take the opportunity to create a Storage Space in my Reverse Scale.”
The Silver Giant Dragon had long informed the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon through its Spiritual Will on how to create a Storage Space in the Reverse Scale, but it never had the time.
After unifying the ocean, it planned to enter the mythical world, and by then, it would need a Storage Space to carry the Life Crystal and the Skeleton Essence of the Giant Beasts.
Hearing that the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was about to create a Storage Space, the Silver Giant Dragon blinked: “Roar! Tim Abbott, it’s very difficult to create a Storage Space. My mother helped me create mine.”
“Actually, Great Sethia’s Storage Space is very large; I can help you store your items. It wouldn’t be so much trouble.”
“It’s okay, I’ll be quick.”
For the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, which had broken through to the Mythical-level and had high comprehension and control over space, it was simple to create a Storage Space within the Reverse Scale.
Especially since its Reverse Scale was already of the highest Top-tier, divine-grade material, capable of housing a vast space.
Boom!
Under the control of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s Spiritual Will, a singularity connected to the Void was forcibly opened in the thick Reverse Scale under its neck.
In the moment that the black hole-like spatial singularity appeared, a powerful Spiritual Will descended, suppressing and anchoring it in the center of the Reverse Scale.
Under the powerful Spiritual Will of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, space runes formed around the spatial singularity, inscribing around the Reverse Scale…
As the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon focused on creating the Storage Space and Jack Clark was preparing to continue his closed-door hibernation, several figures surrounded by blood light appeared outside the World Rift.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 361: The True God Slayer Jack Clark, Sentenced to Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 836: Chapter 361: The True God Slayer Jack Clark, Sentenced to Death
The Heavenly Earth Law was chaotic, and in the Chaotic Zone where the Earth had lost gravity, four beams of blood light flashed by, transforming into four silhouettes that landed on the meteorite where Jack Clark had once stayed.
“… Finally found The Heart of the World.”
Akunus watched intently at the space ahead, within his perception there was an invisible crack, and at the same time, a palm-sized transparent fragment in his hand vibrated, as if eager to fly out.
That intense fluctuation informed Akunus that right in front of him was the entrance to The Heart of the World.
The next step was to enter and absorb the Mysterious Yellow Air that remained after the world shattered. Not only could he restore himself, but he might also have the opportunity to return to being Innate and become a legendary Innate Life.
Then, after several years of secluded cultivation within the forbidden area, he would not only return to his peak but potentially even make a breakthrough to the Heavenly King Level.
Such is the horror of Innate Living Beings.
As life forms born before Heaven and Earth, they naturally meld with the ‘world’ and with the Dao. Mere cultivation would allow them to become powerful deities.
This was also why Akunus hadn’t sought help from ‘friends.’
If the other kings of the Evil God Alliance knew that Mysterious Yellow Air existed within the nearby forbidden area spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers, they would have flocked in frenzied droves.
In the face of further advancement, even strong relationships would be useless, not to mention that there were no real friendships, only interests among these Evil Gods.
The reason Akunus was aware of all this was due to personal fate.
After he had ambushed the wife of the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King, he was chased by the Heavenly King for hundreds of thousands of kilometers and had once delved deep into this forbidden area to evade pursuit.
While crossing the forbidden area, by a stroke of luck, he acquired a fragment formed from the shattered World Core.
The Heart of the World, as the name implies, is the Origin Core of a world, similar to a planet’s core, located in another dimension of space-time.
Inside the World Origin Core, the laws of Heaven and Earth interweave, Origin flows, containing Innate Creation.
Under normal conditions, as the world collapses, the Origin Core of this world should have also collapsed and merged into the mythical world.
However, for some unknown reason, this Heart of the World which had shattered for who knows how many tens of thousands of years, was still merely damaged and continued to exist in the depths of unknown space-time.
Just over half a month ago, Akunus, who was originally hiding and healing in a hidden location of the Blood God Sect, suddenly awoke.
Through the tremors and fluctuations of this World Fragment, he learned that The Heart of the World had surfaced from the depths of space-time and immediately rushed over with the strong men of the Blood God Sect.
At this moment, Archbishop Karola spoke respectfully, “My god, the situation inside is unknown, and there might be danger. How about letting your subordinate explore first?”
Akunus shook his head, “No need, this world has already been devoured by the mythical world, its World Core shattered. At most, there’s only a bit of Mysterious Yellow Air left; there won’t be any danger.”
The Mysterious Yellow Air exclusive to The Heart of the World is precious, but to the vast and boundless mythical world, such things have appeared many times before, it’s just a matter of quantity.
After all, the mythical world has devoured too many worlds.
Although these cultists are absolutely loyal to him – their consciousness having been tainted, making it impossible for them to betray – when it comes to Mysterious Yellow Air, caution is still necessary.
After all, returning to the Innate realm, who knows whether the power and Spiritual Will within these cultists might be refined and his means of control eradicated.
“Let’s go.”
“Yes.”
Using the World Fragment to orient themselves, the four transformed into several streaks of blood light and rushed into the cracks. As soon as they entered, they felt a weight upon them, a powerful pressure coming from all directions.
Bang!
The weakest among them, a Late Eighth Layer bishop, suddenly felt his weight increase and was pressed to kneel on one knee by the powerful gravity, many parts of his muscles cracking open.
Although the Mysterious Yellow Air had been mostly absorbed by Jack Clark, weakening the gravity, it was still not something an ordinary Eight Layer could withstand.
The other initial stage Nine Layers, and the late stage Nine Layers Akunus and Archbishop Karola, found it much easier.
And as soon as they landed, Akunus’s face showed surprise because the amount of Mysterious Yellow Air was substantial, enveloping a hundred-meter radius. But then his face showed bewilderment.
Looking at the three-faced six-armed silhouette sitting cross-legged in the middle of the Mysterious Light Group, who seemed somewhat blurred, Akunus gasped in shock: “How is this possible, how could there be an Innate Demon God inside this shattered World Core?”
The other three cultists were also shocked.
It couldn’t be helped, the aura involuntarily emanating from Jack Clark was too terrifying; even being ten or so kilometers apart made the few of them shockingly uneasy.
In his Fighting War Demon God Form, Jack had three faces and six arms, with four Divine Wheels circling behind him, his aura wrapped in Innateness, almost indistinguishable from the legendary Innate Deities.
At that moment, the Mysterious Yellow Air surged, and the august figure slowly stood up. Amidst the solemn expressions of the four onlookers, he walked out from the Mysterious Yellow Air.
Gazing at Akunus, Jack’s eyes flashed with surprise, and in a deep voice, he slowly said, “Akunus, it’s actually you.”
“You recognize me, no…”
Looking at the face surrounded by blood light, Akunus felt it seemed familiar, then his expression turned to shock again: “It’s you, Darren Callum.”
In an instant, blood light burst from Akunus, radiating a sky-high Killing Intent, his eyes locked onto Jack with intense murderous intent.
This so-called Innate Demon God turned out to be the same Federal Genius who had ruined his plans and stopped him from retrieving the dragon.
If it hadn’t been for this Federation genius, how would he have been ambushed by Mysterious Martial and others, resulting in his Rule True Body being destroyed and his realm falling to that of a Mythical King?

chapters.title: Chapter 837: 361 True. God Slayer Jack Clark, Sentenced to Death_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 837: Chapter 361 True. God Slayer Jack Clark, Sentenced to Death_2
“`
Damn this human, damn him, today he must be killed, his soul cast into the blood river to suffer eternal torment, never to be reborn.
Akunus’s voice was cold and deep, almost gnashing his teeth as he said, “Kill him.”
“Yes, my god,” Karola and the other two replied with a sharp look in their eyes, their auras belonging to the experts of Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Layers Heaven exploding, surrounded by blood light, ready to strike.
Jack Clark suddenly spoke up, “Wait.”
“What else do you want to say?” Akunus asked coldly, thinking he was begging for mercy.
Jack’s expression was calm as he replied lightly, “Wait for me to make a breakthrough.”
Boom!
The aura around Jack surged violently, breaking through to the Late Eighth Layer Heaven, with rings of white waves rolling around him, forming a raging wind howling in all directions.
With his cultivation skyrocketing, Jack’s figure expanded, transforming into a fifty-meter-tall Demon God Form in an instant amidst the flashing thunder and burning flames, and even more terrifying pressure burst forth, shaking the entire Heart of the World.
The substantive pressure, like a mountain, weighed down on Karola and the three Blood God bishops, making their figures sink and cry out in shock, “How is this possible!”
They were not shocked by Jack’s strength at the ‘Late Eighth Layer Heaven’ but by his ability to breakthrough immediately upon saying so.
Of course, it was not possible for Jack to breakthrough just because he said so; he had reached the critical point of breaking through to the Late Eighth Layer Heaven long ago and had just gone with the flow.
Following the breakthrough to the Late Eighth Layer, Jack’s aura became even more terrifying.
At the Late Eighth Layer, not only had his Combat Divine Body become stronger, but the Five Great Rune Seed Species also began to evolve into Divine Powers, with the augmentation increasing from thirty times at the mid period to forty.
Boom!
The earth within hundreds of meters range shattered, and Jack took a step to appear kilometers away, his hand shining with light, holding a hundred-meter-long black-gold battle halberd.
Boom, boom, boom! With his battle halberd sweeping through the air, Jack sent out four hundred-meter-long golden red halberd skills tearing through the atmosphere, causing mountains to collapse and the earth to crack, creating a terrifying momentum.
“Be careful.”
“Despicable…”
Two Blood God bishops burst with blood light, transforming into two hundred-meter-long Nine-headed Blood Pythons, roaring and rolling up the sky with blood light, trying to block the attack.
Karola, a late-stage ninth heaven expert, stood in front of Akunus, his Blood Sea Field unfolding across hundreds of meters, with a huge blood python coiling and roaring around it.
Boom, boom, boom!
Heaven and Earth shook, and four huge golden firelights rose from the ground in a massive explosion, radiating endless hot, destructive glow.
Under the explosion of Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial, the two hundred-meter-long Nine-headed Blood Pythons were torn apart instantly, exploding into countless blood particles containing their Spiritual Will.
But before they could regroup using their blood magic, those blood particles were evaporated and annihilated by the relentless high-temperature shockwaves, wiping them out instantly.
Boom, boom, boom! The Blood Sea Field surrounding Karola kept trembling, shrinking, and the strong impact force made his internal blood strength tremble, filled with horror.
What kind of monster is this? His strength was so terrifying that he could instantly kill Ninth Heaven Expert with the cultivation of Late Eighth Layer Heaven, making his blood in the late-stage ninth heaven boil.
Behind Karola, Akunus’s expression was also very gloomy.
He had not expected that in just two months, this Federal Genius had already broken through to the Late Eighth Layer Heaven, and his combat power had become so terrifying.
Although this genius had once burst his Eight Layer Early Phase Avatar with his strength at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage, crossing two Major Realms, that was the Eight Layer Heaven, not the Nine Layers.
After reaching the high-order stages, the gap between each minor realm was immense, not to mention the difference between the Major Realms.
The combat power of this genius named Darren Callum was likely related to his absorption of a great amount of Mysterious Yellow Air. The nature of an Innate Demon God had caused his strength to skyrocket.
Thinking of this, the killing intent in Akunus’s eyes intensified; this man had actually dared to absorb his Mysterious Yellow Air, he must be killed today.
As the raging explosive waves rolled around, obscuring the line of sight, Akunus said in a low voice, “Karola, I need your sacrifice.”
“It is the highest honor to be sacrificed for my god,” the Elder’s eyes suddenly showed fanaticism, and without hesitation, he exploded.
Boom! Accompanied by the sacrifice of a late-stage ninth heaven expert, a terrifying Power Explosion burst forth.
From afar, Jack saw the edge of the land flashing with blood light, turning into a phantom Blood Sea World unfolding in the air, with countless Blood God Cultists kneeling and praying within the blood light.
As a late-stage ninth heaven expert, Karola’s strength was incredibly formidable.
As an extension of the will of Blood God Acunus, Karola did not need to cultivate or break through; his strength would increase as Akunus’s strength improved.
When Akunus was still a Mythical King, his cultivation was at the quasi-mythical level.
If Akunus could break through to the Heavenly King Level, with the feedback from faith, he too could step into the Mythical level and become a deity’s subordinate god.
However, as Akunus’s cultivation fell from the mythical level, his strength also plummeted.
And now, it was time for him to sacrifice himself for his god.
In the instant that Jack could not prevent, the Void Descended, and endless blood light pierced through the Void, and the moment the Blood Sea World unfolded below Akunus, his aura surged violently.
Boom! An aura of quasi-mythical level, touching the rule of the Ninth Heaven Peak, burst forth from Akunus.
The dense blood light, as if tangible, spread out from him, the Earth shook, space twisted, and behind him, a three-hundred-meter-long Nine-headed Blood Python condensed.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 838: 361 True. God Slayer Jack Clark, Sentenced to Death_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 838: Chapter 361 True. God Slayer Jack Clark, Sentenced to Death_3
Roar roar roar!! The Nine-headed Blood Python, formed by the Law of Blood, roared to the sky, its powerful pressure creating rings of tangible shockwaves that swept across kilometers.
This was the purpose of Akunus bringing these elite bishops of the Blood God Sect into this world: once they encountered dangers or enemies that couldn’t be resisted, they would sacrifice themselves.
“Roar roar roar!! Darren Callum, today I will tear you apart.”
Akunus, transformed into a quasi-mythical Nine-headed Blood Python, let out an enraged roar, unleashing a tsunami-like surge of blood light towards Jack Clark with an overwhelming momentum.
Having returned to the Legendary Realm, even as a quasi-mythical being, Akunus was filled with confidence.
With his strength close to the peak of a Heavenly King, wielding quasi-mythical cultivation, his power was far stronger than that of an average quasi-mythical.
Although the quasi-mythical level is said to be the peak of the Ninth Heavens, it was already in a different realm from the Nine Layers, known as a Demigod, half deity, with incredibly powerful Law Power.
He couldn’t believe this Federal Genius could use Eight Layer Heaven cultivation…
Boom! Jack Clark was enshrouded by Thunder, compressing flames, and his halberd, glowing like a +9999 artifact, descended from the sky like a strike that opened heaven and earth.
Boom!
In that moment, an indescribable force of destruction was unleashed, transforming into a golden red halberd skill over five hundred meters high, shaped like a crescent, tearing the sky and shattering the earth,
Under the terrifying strike, the Earth completely collapsed, creating a chasm tens of kilometers long and hundreds of meters deep, while the approaching blood waves of the tsunami were instantly demolished.
Boom!
Enveloped by Law Power, the quasi-mythical Nine-headed Blood Python exploded, and under the terrible force, the entire “world” trembled, stars shook.
Roar roar roar!! How is this possible.
The sky of blood converged in the distance, reforming into the Nine-headed Blood Python, each of its heads looking at Jack Clark with disbelief.
Its body, ensnared by law, had exploded with one strike, and the opponent’s power had reached the level of Law Power. How was that possible!!
At that moment, Akunus even had the surreal feeling that this world had gone mad.
Why are king-level strong men considered to be ants below Mythicals? Because they rely on the Law Power they control, a terrifying force that can only be countered by powers of the same level.
And now, this Federal Genius, with only an Eight Layer Heaven cultivation, had actually mastered strength comparable to Law Power!!
Under various emotions such as jealousy, envy, and madness, Akunus went completely insane: “Roar roar roar!! Blood Sea sacrifices to the heavens, I will bury you.”
Boom!
As the Nine-headed Blood Python burned its essence of Qi Blood to use its Law Talent, a real Sea of Blood world descended from above, exuding a Terrifying Power that could crush the Void and the world.
Looking at the slowly falling Sea of Blood world above, Jack Clark stood with a cold gaze, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils that obscured the sun and sky emerging in his eyes.
Boom!
Behind Jack Clark, four arms wrapped in Thunderflame formed seals, with the Fourfold Void World, blended with World Star Core Fragments, emerging behind him. Infinite blood light unfolded around him, forming a Doomsday Domain that covered kilometers.
Amidst the towering Sea of Blood, a pair of Black Gold eyes appeared, and the power of Void Double Pupils, equivalent to Law Power, swirled around, causing a dark red world with a kilometer diameter to surge towards the heavens.
From a distance, it looked like two worlds closing in, colliding.
Boom! Just as the two worlds made contact, a dazzling light erupted. In an instant, heaven and earth shook, and an area of Earth several tens of kilometers in diameter shattered thunderously.
Under the apocalyptic explosion, the Heart of the World reversed, and the Chaotic Destruction Flow swept through everything with earth-shattering momentum.
Under such a terrifying explosion, even Jack Clark could not maintain control. The Boundary Walls of the Fourfold World around him shattered layer by layer, and then a pair of blazing Phoenix Wings unfolded outside his body.
Boom! Encompassing Jack Clark as the epicenter, a ring of firelight unfolded, which was then shattered by an even more powerful world explosion.
In the devastating blast, not only did Jack Clark sustain damage, but Akunus’ Nine-headed Blood Python True Body exploded again, and his roars filled with rage echoed through the sky of spreading blood light.
“Roar roar roar!! As long as the Sea of Blood is not dry, I will not die. Today I refuse to believe that I can’t wear you down to death.”
He refused to believe he couldn’t wear down Darren Callum, whose cultivation was only in the Late Eighth Layer Heaven; it couldn’t be possible to keep releasing such powerful strength, not even with the body of an Innate Demon God.
But just then, amongst the wild chaos, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils appeared, opening a gray slit in the skies, and in an instant, Death descended.
“Death! How is it possible.”
Boom! Under the illumination of endless Gray Light, the blood sea in the explosion’s chaotic flow suddenly solidified.
“No, no, no! How can I die if the Sea of Blood does not dry up!!”
A huge face emerged from the Sea of Blood, expressing terror, rising in despairing roars, bursting with blood light, trying to stop Death.
But even as the Sea of Blood churned under the power of the Death Law, it could not prevent Death’s arrival, and countless streams of blood began to exude the smell of rotting flesh as vitality faded.
It was like blood that had gone bad for several months.
Thump! As the Sea of Blood collapsed, amidst the raging chaotic explosion, a blood rain began to fall, turning into numerous foul-smelling streams of dead blood floating in the Void.
At the same time, a Blood Moon emerged in the high sky, slowly falling.
Amidst the blood rain, standing fifty meters tall with three faces and six arms, surrounded by Thunderflame and holding a halberd, Jack Clark emitted a Terrifying Aura.
“Such a weak god.”

chapters.title: Chapter 839: 362 Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, A Separate and Complete Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 839: Chapter 362 Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, A Separate and Complete Heaven and Earth
Under the intense barrage of both Jack Clark’s full firepower and Akunus’s full-strength Law Talent, tens of kilometers of the Earth’s surface shattered, turning into countless rocks floating in the Void.
At this moment, golden flames spread out in the Void, forming several kilometer-long golden fire dragons that covered the territory. The intense heat melted countless fragments of dirt and stone into magma and vaporized the foul-smelling blood into nothingness.
Jack was finishing up.
Although the appearance of the blood moon falling—an anomaly created by the convergence of laws—confirmed Akunus’s complete demise, Jack remained cautious.
After all, even with his realm plummeting to the late stages of the Ninth Heaven, Akunus was still, in essence, a Mythical-level existence with the tremendous vitality and immortality of a myth.
Had it not been for the Eyes of Void and Death, which could define death and forcibly erase his soul will that had merged with the Sea of Blood, today’s battle could have dragged on for days, requiring hundreds or even thousands of kills to thoroughly vanquish him.
This was the headache the Federation had with Akunus in the past.
Accumulated over decades, this fiend’s Sea of Blood had gathered countless living beings’ blood, including that of humans he had absorbed, as well as numerous Giant Beasts hunted in the mythical world.
Especially the blood of a few Early Myth Giant Beasts, which had greatly increased his vitality to a terrifying extent.
Of course, Akunus’s horror is relative to cultivators of the same realm. As long as one is stronger than him, even Heavenly King Level higher force could still suppress and annihilate him.
For example, the Mysterious Martial Sky King simply blew up his Blood God True Body, severing most of his ‘life’.
Even so, the fallen Akunus was still very strong. With the sacrifice of devotees, even Ninth Heaven Peak powers would have to avoid his sharpness or be drained to death.
But unfortunately for him, he met Jack Clark.
Having returned to an Innate state and becoming an Innate Living Being after absorbing the Mysterious Yellow Air, Jack’s realm seemed not to have increased by much, but overall he became quite terrifying.
His body’s agility, carrying capacity, and potential had been expanded to a fearsome degree.
Under normal conditions, everyone actually has a limit, which represents how much energy your body can contain and how many talents and laws your soul can bear.
For instance, in the First Layer Heaven, a cultivator’s baseline arm strength limit is only 300 kilograms, and no amount of cultivation will make you much stronger once you reach this point.
That includes the limit of 800 kilograms in the Second Layer Heaven and the fundamental arm strength limit of 2000 kilograms in the Third Layer Heaven.
Cultivation is about defying the heavens and changing fate, breaking biological limits with each realm breakthrough.
And beyond the Fourth Layer Heaven, although cultivators no longer measure realm by physical strength, the True Strength and intensity contained within still have limits.
This is also why Giant Beast Type Creatures are typically massive.
A colossal size indicates a strong physique, without which they could not sustain their huge bodies’ activities while also containing more and stronger energy to bear more powerful laws and rules.
Humans, instead, have chosen to comprehend laws and become high-dimensional life forms that wield the Power of Heaven and Earth.
Like Jack Clark now, embodying the higher-level life form that those cultivators aspire to.
Having returned to Innate, his inner being gradually formed a complete ‘Heaven and Earth’, independent of the external world, possessing the characteristic of self-‘creation’.
To put it simply, Jack before was like a ‘large machine’, constantly consuming energy, all of which came from the outside world.
Including the most basic Qi Blood, even during bodily self-recovery after significant depletion of Qi Blood, it still absorbs the transformation of the external Heavenly Energy and requires a vast amount.
This is also why in the Blue Star World, high-ranking powerhouses and king-level figures are rare—the stronger the cultivator, the greater the environmental demands.
If the environment’s Heavenly Energy is scarce, forget about increasing one’s cultivation strength; just being able to maintain daily consumption through absorbing and refining Heavenly Energy would be good enough.
But now, Jack can extract energy from the depths of the Void and ‘produce’ the necessary Blood Qi, energy, and quick recovery of Spiritual Will from nothingness.
As a result, even if he were in a cosmic vacuum or an energy-insulated location devoid of Heavenly Energy, he wouldn’t ‘starve’ but continue to grow stronger.
Of course, this detachment from externality doesn’t mean that the outside world’s Heavenly Energy, resources, and Divine Objects are useless; it just means that their dependency has significantly weakened.
Consuming massive amounts of Heavenly Energy and resources from the mythical world can accelerate his cultivation progress.
And right now, Jack can only be considered a half-innate being, still needing to continue absorbing Mysterious Yellow Air to complete his final transformation.
However, even so, he could maintain the Fighting War Demon God Form indefinitely, sustaining absolute peak combat strength; without the Death Law, he could still explode Akunus.
If he couldn’t kill him in one go, then he would have to explode him hundreds or thousands of times.
Under Jack’s cold gaze, soon all the blood scattered in the Void evaporated, thoroughly erasing Akunus’s existence.
Clutching the only Space Ring Akunus left behind, Jack returned to the center of the Void among the Mysterious Yellow Air, sat cross-legged, and cast his eyes on the red ring in his hand.
“This guy, being a god, should have quite a few good things on hand,” Jack mused with a faint expectation, his Spiritual Will enveloping the Space Ring.
Boom!
Just as a strand of Jack’s Spiritual Will attempted to enter the Space Ring, it was dispersed by the Spiritual Imprint Akunus had left behind, and in the distance, a Nine-headed Blood Python seemed to be hissing.
“How strong!” Jack’s gaze remained calm, not surprised at all, given that the Spiritual Imprint left in the Space Ring belonged to a king.

chapters.title: Chapter 840: 362 Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, A Standalone Complete Heaven and Earth_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 840: Chapter 362 Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, A Standalone Complete Heaven and Earth_2
After pondering briefly, Jack Clark didn’t use the Blade of the Void Cutting Rune to shatter the Spiritual Will; instead, he gathered a glob of golden flames to engulf the ring, burning it.
He intended to refine the spiritual imprint inside little by little, leaving no hope for Akunus to be resurrected.
Whoosh! A basin-sized ball of golden flames burned in the air, enveloping the Space Ring, and Jack Clark fell into hibernation once again.
Shrouded by the Mysterious Yellow Air, Jack Clark, now more than 50 meters tall and with three faces and six arms, resembled a true Innate God Demon, his breath stirring up rolling waves of air.
Simultaneously, as his life form transformed, the originally vague features on the right side of his face gradually became clearer.
By the time he woke up next, he would have absorbed all the Mysterious Yellow Air, fully becoming an Innate God Demon and making a breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens.
At that time, his strength in all aspects would undergo a qualitative change.
…
At the frontline, on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
As the golden Great Sun began to set and the red sun moved slowly to the zenith, the great war that had lasted “for more than a week” came to an end.
The battlefield, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, was fractured, riddled with cracks hundreds or even thousands of meters wide, and littered with countless pits dozens or hundred meters deep, with smoke lingering everywhere.
Exhausted of ammunition and energy, fighter aircraft filled the skies, heading to the rear to rest and resupply.
On the ground, tens of thousands of small flying machines shuttled back and forth, detectors for life and energy scanners operating, searching for wounded soldiers hidden in fortifications.
At the same time, countless members of the Purgatory Demon Race and Vassal Races were withdrawing, treating their wounded, and in the skies, tens of thousands of Flying Giant Beasts circled overhead.
Meanwhile, tens of thousands of kilometers away at the center of the battlefield, more than a dozen Human Kings stood tall in the high altitude, with a terrifying force of the Rule Power surrounding them, forming various dreadful visions.
At the same altitude, more than a dozen demon kings from the Demon Clan stood opposite the human kings, surrounded by rolling Black Demonic Qi that covered vast swathes of the sky.
However, at this moment, many among both the Human Kings and the opposing demon kings appeared somewhat weak, evidently suffering from serious injuries.
On the Earth below, a hundred and sixty meters tall Ferocious Mecha, covered in black-red armor, stood erect, emitting a Terrifying Aura that struck fear into all creatures.
At that moment, surrounded by swirling bands of black-red Radiance around Number One, a dead silence spread over hundreds of kilometers, strewn with countless corpses of the demonized beasts, The Purgatory Family, and Vassal Races.
However, these corpses, which seemed relatively normal, gave off an eerie feeling of emptiness.
It was as if their bodies, flesh and blood, and souls had all vanished, devoured, which was horrifying, and such Death Forbidden Areas were plentiful across the battlefield.
Several kilometers opposite Number One, a late period Mythical Demon King stood firm, with surging demon gas around him, his cold gaze towards Number One carrying a hint of wariness.
At this time, tens of thousands of meters above these mighty beings, two figures stood, exuding an even more formidable pressure.
Within a dozen kilometers radius around them, Space Distortion occurred, with Heaven and Earth energy furiously spinning and transforming into a vortex of Divine Light and Black Demonic Qi, standing off against each other like two separate worlds.
As the Heavenly King and the Great Demon King faced off below, the human soldiers and warriors of the Vassal Races on the battlefield, although their eyes blazed with killing intent, made no move to fight but quietly tended to the wounded.
This was the tacit understanding reached after years of battle between the two sides: each would clean up their respective sides of the battlefield after fighting.
In the midst of rolling demon gas, an imposing figure looked down at the Earth below and slowly said, “I did not expect that your Human Race had researched a war weapon comparable to the demon king level.”
Although Number One had once entered the mythical world, it did not go to the Frontline Battlefield, and after it killed a Mythical Giant Beast, it went out of control and was sent back to be sealed.
Therefore, the Purgatory Demon Race had not seen it, lacking information about this “weapon.”
Amidst the endless Divine Light opposite, a grand Mecha, ten meters tall with six pairs of silver wings, stood tall, its Golden Halo slowly rotating behind it, exuding both sanctity and majesty.
The Mecha’s eyes emitted a golden light, quietly observing the opposite side, not showing any intent to speak, causing the inquisitive Great Demon King Yababel to frown slightly.
These humans were overly cautious.
