While the kings and demon kings held their standoff in the sky, a Ferocious Mecha, more than 50 meters tall and pockmarked with damage, flew in from the rear.
Thud! The Mecha’s feet landed on the ground with a dull thud.
“Code Name: King of Black and White, requests communication.”
“Link established.”
In the pitch-black, empty Void, a platform ten meters across floated in mid-air, upon which Freya Louise stood, clad in God Machine Armament.
At this moment, in front of and to both sides of Freya Louise, three arc-shaped transparent screens floated, allowing her to clearly see the scenes outside.
Crrrr!
With the link established, the screen on the left blurred for a moment, then revealed Gabriella, dressed in a silver tight-fitting combat suit with long blonde hair.
The blonde girl looked fatigued from the prolonged combat and inquired, “Freya Louise, how are you holding up over there?”
Freya Louise nodded slightly, her voice emanating from the God Machine Armament, “Not bad. Currently, the Nuclear Fusion Engine’s fuel reserves are at thirty percent, and I have plenty of energy.”
“It’s just that the ammunition consumption has been a bit high. The sixteen subspace ammunition compartments on the external structure are depleted, and I need to return to refuel.”
At this, Freya Louise’s tone became slightly excited and agitated; it was her first time participating in such a large-scale war, practically fighting until the sky and the Earth darkened.

chapters.title: Chapter 841: 362: Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, An Independent and Complete World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 841: Chapter 362: Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, An Independent and Complete World_3
In this fierce battle, apart from the high-end battlefield tens of kilometers above the ground where dozens of kings and demon kings fought, the number of soldiers gathered on the front line was like an ocean.
For example, by mobilizing 13 legions of the Human Race, the number of soldiers exceeded one million, while the Purgatory Demon Race deployed over four million soldiers with dozens of legions.
Moreover, each of these “people” had a strength above the Fourth Layer Heaven, with countless high-ranking powerhouses.
Aside from that, there were also many Giant Beast Level demonic beasts on the opposite side, their power terrifying.
If it weren’t for the thousands of super-caliber artillery positions built by humans, as well as hundreds of thousands of drones, energy bombers, and various missiles carrying nuclear and hydrogen warheads at their disposal, they might not be able to hold off the enemy’s advance.
In addition, under the command of the human soldiers, they formed elite squads, attacking each other’s positions and causing chaos.
In such a battlefield, even high-ranking powerhouses could not guarantee their survival, especially when the aftershocks of battles between Mythical-level powerhouses occasionally fell from the sky.
Moreover, the Purgatory Demon Race also had various long-range attack methods, such as imitated super-caliber artillery from the human race and modified magical weapons from their vassal races.
As a result, not only did the enemy suffer heavy casualties, but the losses on the human side were also significant.
Under the strong interference of celestial forces, the wireless communication in the Mythical World was unstable, requiring the establishment of electronic bases for connection.
The enemy also understood this, so both sides often engaged in offensive and defensive battles around these electronic bases, destroying, repairing, and attacking.
However, it is challenging to defeat the enemy in a war of this scale entirely unless you hold an absolute advantage.
As the Purgatory family who controlled a large territory, rich in resources, and enslaved more than a dozen vassal race civilizations, their current strategy was to exhaust the Human Race through logistics.
As two Heavenly King Level powerhouses and dozens of Mythical-level powerhouses stood off, the cleanup of the battlefield only finished a day later; the two sides’ powerhouses slowly retreated as the main troops evacuated.
Including Freya Louise, who piloted Number One, they entered the gigantic mech through the main gate of the base, the rear city, attracting many curious eyes.
Tianyuan Base, which guarded the front line, was not so much a base as an immense, technologically advanced super-city that could accommodate tens of millions of people.
In addition to the more than one million soldiers from the three human empires stationed here and other countries’ regular army legions, there were also more than two million postnatal-born New Human Race members.
These humans were born here, learned, grew, worked, married, and became part of the city.
“That’s Number One. I heard that in this Civilizational War, it held off an attack from a demon king and destroyed five Demon Race legions, killing more than 100,000 demons.”
“Wow! So powerful! Dad, has our human mech research become this strong?”
“Of course, our Human Race is the most powerful race. But I don’t know when this kind of mech can be mass-produced. I wish I could drive one.”
“What are you daydreaming about? The driving requirements for such a high-level war weapon must be very high. You barely scored more than 200 points in the college entrance examination, so don’t dream about it.”
“By the way, I’ve already spoken to Old Wang. Tomorrow you go to the missile assembly factory with me, stop studying. There’s no future in it.”
At the logistics department’s core base, as the blue and white light in Number One’s eyes gradually dimmed, a beam of light shot out from the android’s chest crystal and Freya Louise flew out from within.
With a bang, the God Machine Armament landed on the ground, its back cracked open, and the young woman jumped out.
A group of soldiers immediately gathered around to check the data on the two special mechas and prepare for logistics replenishment.
At that moment, a female soldier walked over and saluted, “Colonel Freya Louise, the Gabriel Throne has returned. Please go over.”
“Also, the person you inquired about before has entered the Mythical World.”
“He finally entered, huh.” Freya Louise pursed her lips, revealing a faint smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 842: 363: The Overlord Who Unites the Seas, the Dragon of Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 842: Chapter 363: The Overlord Who Unites the Seas, the Dragon of Time
Soaring into the heavens, a majestic building thousands of meters tall stood at its peak, where a woman with golden hair radiated faintly with white light as she stood before a window, overlooking the world beneath her.
At that moment, a respectful voice came from outside the distant office door.
“Reporting to the throne, Colonel Freya Louise has arrived.”
The golden-haired woman turned her head and said indifferently, “Let her come in.”
“Yes.”
As the door opened, Freya entered and respectfully said, “I have seen the Gabriel Throne.”
In the presence of this Heavenly King powerhouse, named after the archangel and seraph from mythical legends, Freya did not dare to be negligent and was very polite and courteous.
Although her special Mecha possessed mythical-level combat capabilities, she was essentially still an advanced cultivator.
Gabriel’s golden eyes were filled with peace and tenderness, like a god who loved all life in the world, and upon seeing the black-haired girl, a light smile appeared on her face.
“You’ve arrived, Louise.”
“Your maiden performance piloting the Number One in battle was quite impressive, exceeding our expectations. However, the machine’s shortcomings were also quite obvious. How are you feeling, any issues with your body or spirit?”
Freya nodded politely, “I’m currently feeling fine, I haven’t sensed any corrosion of my spirit or body.”
“That’s good to hear.”
Gabriel nodded slightly, “By the way, the person you asked about earlier has entered the mythical world, two days after you and Gabriella.”
Freya blinked in curiosity, “Your Majesty, what realm has Jack Clark reached now?”
Gabriel’s eyes flickered slightly, “Eighth Layer Early Phase.”
“Already at the Eighth Layer, that was fast,” Freya admired. After all, when she and Jack parted over half a month ago, that man had only just achieved a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
But Freya had long been accustomed to Jack’s terrifying cultivation speed, so she wasn’t all that shocked.
Just then, Gabriel suddenly said, “The records show that this young man named Jack Clark, over ten days ago, slew a demon king.”
Freya was taken aback and asked without thinking, “Lady Gabriel, are you certain I heard that correctly?”
Gabriel slowly nodded, “You heard correctly. He indeed slayed a demon king with his cultivation at the Eighth Layer Early Phase, and it was War Demon King Augusta, a Mid-Mythical Stage demon king no less.”
Suddenly, Freya’s mouth fell open in astonishment.
Slain a Mid-Mythical Stage demon king while at the Eighth Layer Early Phase? Such an exaggerated combat achievement, even the numbed-to-surprises Freya was profoundly shocked.
Gabriel was quite satisfied with Freya’s reaction.
When she first came back and saw this message, she almost doubted if she had read it wrongly or if King Cyril had made a mistake.
Slain a Mythical Demon King while at the Eighth Layer Early Phase was a feat capable of shaking the cultivation world, something even the top three Speakers of the past couldn’t achieve.
As Freya was shocked by the news that Jack had slain a demon king, in the Blue Star World, under the deep sea, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon slowly opened its eyes.
Seeing its awakening, the nearby Silver Giant Dragon cautiously roared, “Roar! Tim Abott, have you succeeded in creating a Storage Space?”
The Black-red Colossal Beast, standing on all four claws with a shoulder height of over 150 meters and a body length of more than 500 meters, nodded slowly, producing a low rumble.
“I have succeeded.”
The Silver Giant Dragon blinked its large eyes, “How big is it?”
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon looked at the Silver Giant Dragon, “It could fit two of you, I guess.”
“Roar! How can it be that large!” The silver dragon’s clear eyes widened with naive astonishment.
“It’s decent,” the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon said, its mouth corners lifting slightly into a fierce, satisfied smile.
Because of the tempering from Higher-order Destruction and Supreme Vajra Law, the body of Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon was exceptionally strong, and its thick scale armor was comparable to divine-grade materials.
Especially the inverse scale, which was both a vulnerability and the strongest part of its body, was immensely solid and could sustain a vast space fragment to stabilize it as a Storage Space.
Suddenly, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s gaze shifted, looking ahead.
Boom! The swirling vortex of sea water exploded violently, revealing the massive and hefty Single-horned Tiger Kingfish soaring out, shrieking with excitement.
Roar roar roar!! Thunderflame, you’re awake, look, I can fly now! The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish exclaimed excitedly, spiraling around the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, its wing-like fins flapping.
But relative to the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with a body length of just over 150 meters, seemed like a child next to it, creating an oddly mismatched image.
At that moment, the whirlpool in the deep water kept exploding and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah, the Dragon Turtle Hegemony, and the Blue Giant Crab all rushed out excitedly towards the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon.
Following behind them in the whirling waters of the vortex, the massive Female Tiger Whales and the Red Beast marked with red stripes, alongside the Mutated Tiger Whale Army, appeared.
After greeting his subordinates with a slight nod, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon looked towards the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, “Your breakthrough to Level 9 must have awakened a Top Tier Talent, didn’t it?”
In its perception, the bloodline level of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had now reached that of an ordinary monarch.
Roar roar roar!! Yes, my new talent is Chaos Hole.
Boom!
A terrible aura burst forth from the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, as a domain of black and white covered a 600-meter range flared wildly, merging into a turbid haze that resembled a chaos hole.
Whoo! A long foghorn sound came from within the chaos hole, as a monstrous mouth hundreds of meters wide suddenly lunged from within, biting down voraciously.
Boom!
With a terrifying strike, space shattered, and a pitch-black Void hundreds of meters in size appeared, instantly sending violent fluctuations through the void, and from which a horrific suction force began to emanate.

chapters.title: Chapter 843: 363 The Overlord of the Unified Ocean, Time Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 843: Chapter 363 The Overlord of the Unified Ocean, Time Dragon_2
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
As the black hole devoured the sea, the earth shattered, countless rocks mixed with seawater were swallowed by the void, and the terrifying suction force made the mutant killer whales panic and retreat.
Boom! At this moment, a huge claw wrapped in black lightning fell from the sky and exploded the ‘black hole’ that devoured everything with a single strike.
The terrifying blow shattered a large area of space and shook the seabed.
With the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s attack breaking the balance of the chaotic hole, the space in that area collapsed on a large scale and was instantly restored to its original state under the self-repair of space.
In the Blue Star World, the invisible substances in the space permeate the void layer by layer, so the superficial breaking and shattering caused by Joe and Leiyan Tianlong.
Even so, the nine-headed dragon-like creatures gasped in shock, their powerful breathing causing strong current vortices on the seabed.
ROAR! Joe, how is your new talent so powerful!
The deep-sea dragon turtle was somewhat astonished.
Although they had been awake for several days, this was the first time it had learned that Joe’s new talent was so terrifying and scary.
Whine! I have always been strong; it’s just that this time I am even stronger. Joe proudly flapped his fins.
As a creature that had once absorbed ancient blood, Joe’s potential was actually enormous. With each breakthrough and growth, his form became more and more similar to the legendary whale.
As a transcendent creature, the more similar their form to those mythical creatures, the stronger their potential and strength.
ccording to the research of the Human Federation, those creatures of myth and legend should have reached a level above the ancient titans, embodying rules with their existence leaving traces between heaven and earth.
Now, extraordinary beasts in the process of evolution will instinctively evolve towards the form of those ancient creatures under the influence of the rules, because this is a ‘path’ that has already been successfully traversed.
Therefore, the closer their form and size to those ancient legendary creatures, the stronger their strength and the more thorough their evolution.
At that level of existence, there is no need for lineage reproduction; they themselves are a kind of rule and a race civilization.
Joe’s new talent is actually a fusion of the black and white domain and the Devouring Vortex Talent, which is more like an upgrade of his original talent.
Thoughtfully, Leiyan Tianlong looked at the deep-sea dragon turtle and growled, “Baxia, what is your new talent?”
Seeing that Leiyan Tianlong finally remembered it, the deep-sea dragon turtle became somewhat excited and let out a deep roar: Roar!! Leiyan, my new talent is Exhalation.
Exhalation? What kind of talent is that? Leiyan Tianlong paused for a moment.
“Roar! Baxia, give me a taste of it.”
Roar! Leiyan, are you sure you want me to exhale on you? My Exhalation talent is very strong and can perfectly integrate my earth and vibration powers.
“Just do it. Your abilities are not strong enough to hurt me.” Leiyan Tianlong remained unconcerned.
Seeing this, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle took a deep breath, and the dazzling light shone in its mouth.
Boom! In an instant, a ten-meter-thick pure golden beam of light roared out, piercing through the sea, shining with a destructive fluctuation that even the silver dragon was slightly alarmed.
BOOM!
The golden Exhalation hit Leiyan Tianlong’s chest, instantly exploding with terrifying energy vibrations. Under the impact of the golden energy shockwave, the deep-sea earth within a kilometer radius shattered.
Countless broken rocks melted and flew around, as explosions and vortex riots caused several large creatures to quickly explode their domain to block them.
After exhaling for almost a minute, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s Exhalation slowly disappeared, its sturdy limbs standing on the broken ground, exuding a powerful aura.
At this time, a terrifying aura spread from the explosion in the distance, and the smoke instantly dissipated, revealing the figure of Leiyan Tianlong, whose scales had become slightly brighter.
So strong! So powerful! Leiyan, you’re too strong!
Seeing the black and red giant beast unscathed after taking a terrifying Exhalation strike from the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the blue giant crab’s eyes revealed fanatic admiration, and its eight legs shook even more violently.
Gazing at the soft-legged blue giant crab on the ground, Leiyan Tianlong couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth before slowly nodding, “The power is decent.”
Because of the fusion of high-level talents, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s just attack was even stronger than a mid-level Ninth Stage giant beast’s outbreak, and it has sustained power.
This talent’s potential is also huge, similar to its Annihilation True Thunder and Heaven Burning Golden Flames’ fusion. The stronger the talent, the stronger the fusion’s power.
Once the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle breaks through to the late Ninth Stage, the power of the fusion Exhalation will be comparable to ordinary rule power, on par with quasi-mythical creatures.
After checking his work, or rather, after checking the changes in the strengths of his two subordinates, Leiyan Tianlong looked at the female killer whale hovering in the vortex of seawater and growled.
“Horned Lady, how’s the harvest this time?”
The female killer whale respectfully whined: Whine! Whine! Whine! King, there are many gains this time.
As she spoke, the female killer whale opened her mouth slightly and spat out a massive white mutant fish bubble, which, under the influence of domain power, reached the empty ground in the center of the vortex.
Splash!
As the seawater flowed out, a dense pile of life crystals rolled on the ground.
For more than half a month, the female killer whale had led several groups of mutated killer whales and killed a large number of second and third-stage creatures and a small number of fourth and fifth-stage peak-level mutant creatures.
It couldn’t be helped that within the territory ruled by the Dragon Palace Regulation, those advanced mutant creatures that reached the peak of their level had nearly been killed, leaving only a small number of lower-level mutant fish remaining.
Leiyan Tianlong’s mental fluctuations swept over the pile of crystals and nodded with satisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 844: 363 The Overlord Who Unites the Seas, The Dragon of Time_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 844: Chapter 363 The Overlord Who Unites the Seas, The Dragon of Time_3
“`
The Female Tiger Whales had collected nearly four thousand low-level crystals this time, which could be converted into over sixty thousand Attribute points at the least, not bad.
Under the eager gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon expelled a breath of hot air, evaporating the sea water around the crystals before sweeping them into the Reverse Scale Space with a surge of strength.
At the moment, the Female Tiger Whale called out respectfully.
Roar! King, while you were in hibernation, the third one has already infiltrated the force known as the Red Dragon Beast Empire, through the neighboring Fourth World Channel.
Roar! According to the third one’s investigation, that force is currently led by a Mythical Giant Beast and a quasi-mythical beast guarding the channel…
After the Female Tiger Whale finished reporting, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but look at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flying in the sky, giving it a peculiar gaze that confused it.
Roar! Thunder Flame, why are you looking at me like that? The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was somewhat baffled.
“Roar! Nothing much.” the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon shook its head slightly.
It was just wondering how such a naive Single-horned Tiger Kingfish could have produced such a clever, or rather, a sly son. This little guy was really good at stirring up trouble.
Whether the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had information or not didn’t really matter at this point, but it still took an extra look at the young Tiger Whale.
Such a highly intelligent and smart Mutant Beast was rare indeed, worthy of being well-educated and nurtured.
Boom! A terrifying pressure burst forth from the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon as it let out a roar that shook Heaven and Earth: “Roar! All beasts follow me, for a unification of the ocean.”
Boom!
As it roared, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon soared into the sky, and in an instant, the sky and earth changed color, raging winds howled above the sea surface, and dark clouds rolled, forming a storm vortex that covered tens of kilometers.
“Roar! To unify the ocean, the Great Sethia will be its overlord.”
Under the dark clouds, the Silver Giant Dragon spiraled excitedly in the sky, unleashing a series of exhilarated roars.
Finally, the day had come. It had been so long since it came to this world… Wait, it hadn’t been that long, it realized—just five or six Sun Wheels.
Ha-ha, the Great Sethia truly is a genius, having dominated the ocean and about to rule the world ‘within days’ of arriving in this Indigenous World.
As the Silver Giant Dragon was excitedly spiraling, a string of colossal beasts surged upward from the Whirlpool Channel below.
The Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, wrapped in blood-colored flames, with Double Fins like massive wings, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish with a blue giant horn atop its head, and the Red Divine Dragon, a gigantic beast spanning more than three hundred meters long.
Hey!
The Silver Giant Dragon then realized something as it looked up at the ascending Red Beast dispersing a Terrifying Aura: “Roar! Candle Dragon, when did you wake up?”
The slender Red Divine Dragon in the sky turned its eyes towards the Silver Giant Dragon as if it existed in another time, its eyes revealing confusion.
At that moment, a fierce dragon head emerged from the rolling dark clouds above: “The Candle Dragon has just awakened, do not mind it, it is still under the influence of Time Laws.”
In the perception of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, the Red Beast was shrouded in a layer of Time Power—strong, yet strange.
Moreover, although the Giant Beast Candle Dragon had broken through to the quasi-mythical level and touched upon Time Laws, the problem of it ‘logging off’ still persisted.
“Roar! All beasts come with me, today I will unify the ocean.”
Boom! An even more terrifying pressure erupted from the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, as the clouds converged, steering a thunderstorm covering a hundred kilometers radius towards the deep sea.
Roar! This time, Domination plans to bag twenty.
The Giant Dragon Turtle, like a small hill, burst through the sea waves with an excited roar.
“`
The three-headed giant beast circling in the high altitude also let out excited roars.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Kidora, invincible, will take on thirty.”
Roar, roar!! Kidora, you don’t have that many heads, how can you possibly take on thirty?
“Roar! Great Scythia, invincible, Great Scythia will make the sea run red with blood today.” The Silver Giant Dragon circled beneath the dark clouds, bellowing triumphantly.
On the surface of the sea, the Blue Giant Crab excitedly waved its huge claws: Gurgle, gurgle!! The Crab General will clamp them to death, this time I will clamp down on eight.
The ferocious female Tiger Whale had disappeared from the sea surface, turning into a dark presence lurking below, while Tiger One and Tiger Two leapt excitedly in the water.
Roar, roar, roar!! Kill, kill.
Roa-a-ar!! Brothers, keep up, follow Uncle into battle, we will eat once every three days.
The mutated Tiger Whales, whose levels were above Level 4 and up to sixth level, were witnessing such a grand spectacle for the first time and were immediately overwhelmed with excitement.
At that moment, the sea surface churned as the entire Dragon Palace Giant Beast Force mobilized in an impressive display.
And the energy detection satellites in the sky emitted piercing alarms almost instantly.
“Report, strong Mythical Giant Beast fluctuations have been detected in the Channel 3 area, along with one quasi-mythical and four intense Level 9 fluctuations.”
“Report, Dragon Palace Giant Beast Force is rapidly moving, heading towards Deep Sea Fourth Channel.”
“What does it want to do?”
“Unify the ocean?”
“Weird, what’s the use of these behemoths unifying the ocean?”
“Yeah, after breaking through to Mythical-level, their only option for rapid advancement is in the mythical world; staying in Blue Star is pretty much marking time.”
“Keep a close eye on them.”
“Yes…”
Under the close watch of the Military Ocean Monitoring Department, the storm clouds engulfed everything, quickly reaching the maritime border of the Red Dragon Beast Empire.
Seawaves towering tens of meters high rolled, and over twenty Level 7 and level eight Giant Beasts were drifting with the waves, all looking at the approaching dark clouds in horror.
Especially that terrifying mythical Aura that made them feel fear-stricken.
Whoo-whoo!! Leader, let’s get out of here, the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire is coming for us.
Roa-a-ar!! What’s there to fear, it’s just the Dragon Palace Empire coming for us. As soldiers of the Red Dragon Beast Empire, we must face all enemies without fear.
At this, the other Giant Beasts looked at the Black Tiger Whale as if it had lost its mind.
It was one thing to stand firm against the Dragon Palace’s patrol army a few days ago since it was led by just two Level 9 Giant Beasts, but this time it was Mythical, Mythical, for God’s sake.
The mere aura they emitted was enough to instill fear, despair, and paralysis in them.
Now, these beasts could see the shadows of the circling giant beasts in the sky and the terrifying shape looming within the dark clouds.
Suddenly, the Black Tiger Whale let out a high-pitched cry.
Roa-a-ar!! Uncle, you’ve finally arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 845: 364 Harmony is Precious, Myth Destruction Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 845: Chapter 364 Harmony is Precious, Myth Destruction Form
Dark heavens and earth, raging winds howl, lifting waves tens of meters high. The terrifying presence of Mythical Giant Beasts spreads between heaven and earth, causing countless Mutated Creatures in the sea to flee in panic.
Meanwhile, on the sea surface, dozens of beasts from the Red Dragon Beast Empire were dumbfounded in place.
They saw a Black Tiger Whale, more than 60 meters long, leaping hundreds of meters into the air before crashing back into the sea with a thunderous splash, sending water spraying everywhere as it merrily swam forward.
And as it swam, it called out.
Roar! Uncle, you’ve finally come. I’ve already scouted out the strength distribution of the Red Dragon Empire.
Roar! Uncle, I know where the two Level 9 Giant Beasts of the Red Dragon Empire are hiding; let’s take them down first.
Behind the Black Tiger Whale, a Female Tiger Whale nearly thirty meters long would also occasionally leap from the sea, emitting a polite call.
Even the dumbest of beasts could tell something was amiss with this scene.
Clearly, their leader had betrayed them—or rather, their leader had been a spy, a creature of the Dragon Palace from the start.
No wonder it was so reckless, constantly shouting about defeating the King of Black and White from the Dragon Palace, fearless even in the face of a group of Level 9 Giant Beasts from the Dragon Palace, ready for a fight at first sight.
Suddenly, a Sea Turtle Giant Beast, which had always been mixed with the Black Tiger Whale, came to its senses. Fighting against its bloodline’s innate fear, it paddled its limbs, stirring up sea waves as it rushed over.
The Sea Turtle Giant Beast burst through the waves while emitting a whistle-like low growl.
Whoo! Leader, Leader! You can’t abandon us.
Roar! Right, we’re all creatures of your kind, don’t kill us, we’re willing to follow the leader and submit to the Dragon Palace…
Suddenly, the sea exploded as one beast after the other scrambled to follow, roaring nonstop, begging to surrender along with the Black Tiger Whale, fearing they would be devoured if they were even a step too slow.
This scene caused a few Giant Beasts circling at high altitude to pause slightly.
Especially the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah, which at the moment had red and blue gleaming horns on its six dragon heads, ready to release its Radiant Breath to wipe out these beasts.
Then, the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by storms, swooped down from the skies, hovering hundreds of meters above the sea. It watched the Black Tiger Whale below and nodded its head with satisfaction, roaring.
Roar! You’ve done very well, Tiger Three.
Seeing the Silver Giant Dragon, the Black Tiger Whale immediately cried out respectfully.
Roar! I have seen the Great Scythia Dragon King. After more than ten days, you have become stronger, almost as strong as Uncle.
Roar! That’s right, the Great Scythia is getting stronger every day.
The Silver Giant Dragon lifted its head proudly, then looked at the Seventh and Eighth Level Beasts following the Black Tiger Whale in awe, and roared authoritatively: Roar! I am the Great Scythia, the Dragon Palace King.
Suddenly, these beasts paused again. Wasn’t the king of the Dragon Palace that terrifying Mythical Giant Beast in the sky? How could it be this Level 9 Giant Beast?
These Mutant Beasts suddenly felt like their brains weren’t quite working today.
Roar! What are you dazing for? Hurry up and greet Lord Scythia.
At the reminder of the Black Tiger Whale, the common beasts snapped out of it. They didn’t care who the real Dragon King was; surviving was what mattered today. Instantly, each one roared respectfully in turn.
Whoo! I have seen the Dragon King.
Roar! I greet the Great Scythia Dragon King…
Ever since they had joined the Black Tiger Whale, these Giant Beasts hadn’t done much, but their intelligence had increased slightly, and they reacted much faster than when they had first joined the Red Dragon Empire.
The Silver Giant Dragon immensely enjoyed the spectacle of being flattered by many beasts. It wasn’t until these beasts below had roared themselves hoarse that it finally nodded in satisfaction.
Roar! Seeing that you are creatures under Tiger Three, I permit you ordinary bloodline beings to join the Dragon Palace. From now on, continue to follow Tiger Three.
As ordinary Transcendent bloodline beings, join the Dragon Palace that will soon unify the oceans; this is an unparalleled honor for you. Celebrate it.
Whoo! Thank you, thank you, Great Scythia Dragon King.
Suddenly, the beasts became ecstatic, nodding continuously, causing the sea surface to boil with rolling waves.
Finally, they were not going to die.
In the past, the Silver Giant Dragon had high demands for its subordinates, requiring the awakening of a king-level bloodline, and only those with traces of ancient creatures could qualify.
However, as the Dragon Palace grew, and after the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had taken in a bunch of ordinary Tiger Whales as a mighty army, its requirements gradually lowered.
Just then, the Giant Red Beast circling above like the Eastern Divine Dragon suddenly roared: Roar! I… just… woke up.
Suddenly, the Tiger Whales, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Silver Giant Dragon below all paused; this fellow, having made its breakthrough to quasi-mythical, had become even more off kilter—it took this long to realize what was going on after flying for so long.
Through the clouds, enormous beast shadows flashed, followed by a deep roar shaking heaven and earth, filled with an indescribable, terrifying pressure.
Roar! Tiger Three, lead the way.
The Black Tiger Whale on the sea surface immediately brightened up, excitedly calling out: Roar! Alright, Uncle, charge, brothers! Let’s overthrow the Red Dragon Beast Empire.
The Black Tiger Whale, once a sea patrol general of the Red Dragon Beast Empire, crashed through the water with a fierce aura, heading toward Channel Four, hundreds of kilometers away.
Instantly, the sea surface boiled again, with nearly two hundred Giant Beasts of various sizes charging through the waves. In the sky, four massive beasts were circling and soaring, radiating a terrifying pressure.
Meanwhile, among the raging waves, the Level 7 Sea Turtle Giant Beast cautiously approached the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, more than 150 meters long, loomed like a small hill. Its dark brown carapace, just the part above the water surface, was a hundred meters high; the Dragon Turtle poked out its head, looking at the Sea Turtle Giant Beast beside it with puzzled low roars.

chapters.title: Chapter 846: 364: Cherishing Harmony, The Demise of the Mythical Form_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 846: Chapter 364: Cherishing Harmony, The Demise of the Mythical Form_2
Roar!! Why are you following me?
The Sea Turtle Giant Beast blinked its eyes and cautiously growled: Whoo!! Big brother, we have somewhat similar appearances; do you think we might be related?
A few black lines suddenly popped up on the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s head.
Roar!! I am a dragon turtle, and you are a sea turtle. There is no relation between us. Get lost.
With a roar, a powerful force burst from the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, causing a hundred-meter-high tsunami that rolled the Sea Turtle Giant Beast and slammed it hard under the sea surface.
This guy, he dared call himself a sea turtle, asking for a beating.
Under the control of Leiyan Tianlong’s thunderstorm, half an hour later, the mighty Dragon Palace giant beast army arrived at the Fourth Channel.
A silver whirlpool several hundred meters high slowly rotated a kilometer below the sea surface, surrounded by powerful boundary forces stirring the seawater, forming a giant vortex.
A red flood dragon more than three hundred meters long lay on the rotating sea surface, followed by the armored shark colossus and a Level 9 Giant Beast resembling a blue whale.
At this moment, these three giant beasts were all watching the dark clouds rolling in from the sky with solemn expressions, especially the terrifying pressure from the clouds that frightened the beasts.
Before long, the thunderstorm clouds obscured the sky and earth. One by one, giant beasts emerged in the sky and on the sea surface, accompanied by deafening roars.
Included among them were the ‘soldiers’ of their Red Dragon Beast Empire on patrol, such as the intelligent Black Tiger Whale.
Apparently, facing powerful enemies, these subordinates had turned against them.
The Red Flood Dragon was not surprised by this situation, considering the terrifying strength of the other party.
Suddenly, the Red Flood Dragon let out a roar, sounding very polite: “Greetings, strong ones from the other side; I am General Red Mane, a mythical Colossus King of Deep Red, under the Crimson King of the Red Dragon Beast Empire.”
The politeness of the other party made the Silver Giant Dragon pause, then it fluttered its wings to the front, raised its head proudly, and let out a spirited roar: “Roar! This king is the King of the Dragon Palace, the Great Scythia Dragon King.”
The Red Flood Dragon was stunned. This Silver Giant Dragon, which was only at the intermediate stage of Level 9, was actually the King of the Dragon Palace! Then what was that giant beast hovering in the clouds?
Helpless. The Dragon Palace’s structure was simply too unnatural.
These giant beasts could not understand why a powerful mythical giant beast would be willing to follow a Level 9 giant beast, completely turning the hierarchy upside down.
As the Red Flood Dragon was stunned, the Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly: “Today, the Dragon Palace will unite the ocean, and nobody can stop the great Scythia’s footsteps.”
“Now, you of the Red Dragon Beast Empire have two choices: engage in a life-or-death battle with the Dragon Palace led by this king or surrender and admit defeat.”
Suppressing his doubts, the Red Flood Dragon courteously growled: “Roar! Scythia Dragon King, I think there can be a third option.”
Roar! What is the third option?”, asked the Silver Giant Dragon with a puzzled look in its eyes.
The Red Flood Dragon courteously said: “Our king has always advocated peace and carried the principle of friendly development. We are prepared to give this world’s ‘territory’ to you and withdraw from this world henceforth.”
This outcome stunned all the giant beasts who were ready for a fierce battle.
Even Leiyan Tianlong, who was hovering among the clouds, had never encountered a mythical giant beast that admitted defeat before the battle even began.
Wrong.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon realized something, and the clear eyes showed a flash of wisdom as it growled: “Wrong! For such an important matter, why hasn’t your king come over here?”
The Red Flood Dragon explained: “The channel of this world is too small and can only be passed through by ordinary mythical giant beasts. My king’s strength is too strong to descend here.”
The Silver Giant Dragon became serious, because the mythical giant beast of the Red Dragon Empire was rather strong.
At that moment, Leiyan Tianlong’s deep, powerful voice came from the clouds: “Unexpectedly, the Crimson King also shares my love of peace.”
“Since you are so sincere, this king grants the Red Dragon Empire an alliance with the Dragon Palace, free of interference from now on.”
This world’s channel had an upper limit for bearing weight; surpassing this limit would cause powerful life to be repelled by the two worlds and unable to enter.
Now that the opposite party couldn’t come over, essentially, Leiyan Tianlong, whose strength was comparable to the mythical pinnacle, couldn’t go over either.
Of course, if one was confident in their strength, they could forcibly tear open the channel, but doing so would result in backlash from certain world rules.
With Leiyan Tianlong speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon naturally had no objections: “Roar! Since Tim Abott has no objection, the great Scythia also agrees.”
But the Red Flood Dragon was confused again and hesitated to growl: “Great Scythia Dragon King, didn’t you just say you were the King of the Dragon Palace? Who was that just now?”
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded: “Roar! That’s right, this king is the King of the Dragon Palace. The one who just spoke was my Dragon Palace’s Leiyan Dragon King, Tim Abott. In addition, my Dragon Palace has several other Dragon Kings.”
Single-horned Tiger Kingfish fluttered its fins and a powerful pressure erupted from its body, releasing a deep whistle like a steam whistle: Woo! I am the King of Black and White in the Dragon Palace, Jerry Jones.”
Boom!
The nine-headed Flood Dragon was surrounded by surging blood-colored flames, and, under the outburst of aura, nine dragon heads shook and emitted chaotic roars: “Roar Grumble Roar!! I am, Nine-headed Dragon King, Kidora.”
Bang! Far away, the sea surface exploded, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle with glowing yellow lights on its body roared deeply.
Roar!! King of Earth and Destruction, Domination.
Boom! At this moment, a pressure comparable to that of an ordinary mythical giant beast erupted in the sky, and the usually offline Red Candle Dragon roared, shaking the heavens and the earth,

chapters.title: Chapter 847: 364: Cherishing Harmony, The Demise of the Mythical Form_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 847: Chapter 364: Cherishing Harmony, The Demise of the Mythical Form_3
“Roar! I am the King of Day and Night Spacetime, Candle Dragon!”
As they saw one after another mighty giant beast emerging, the Red Flood Dragon opened its mouth wide, the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire seemed to have more than one king.
Finally, in awe, confusion, and chaos, the Red Flood Dragon left with two giant beasts, disappearing into the Undersea Rotating Silver Vortex.
In the rolling clouds, Thunderflame Dragon King’s terrifying roar echoed: “Roar! All beasts follow me and trample over the remaining two world passageways!”
“Roar roar roar!! Slay, trample, crush, today, screw them up!”
Roar roar!! Trample the ocean, dominate the world. The deep-sea dragon turtle was ecstatic, surrounded by roaring giant beasts, their morale soaring.
Their Dragon Palace strength was too great, subduing a mythical giant beast empire even before the battle began.
At this moment, a silver dragon appeared in the sky, tens of thousands of meters high, looking at the circling red giant beast with doubt in its eyes: “Roar! Candle Dragon, be honest, do you pretend to be foolish most of the time?”
As the silver dragon’s scrutinizing gaze met the giant beast Candle Dragon, it revealed bafflement, not responding for a long time.
As the Thunderflame Dragon King rode the storm towards the second passageway, the Red Flood Dragon, with its two subordinates, crossed the world passageway and arrived at the mythical world.
Clouds and mists encircled the boundless forest edge with towering trees reaching hundreds or even thousands of meters. The three giant beasts emerged from the vortex.
The Red Flood Dragon turned back and growled, “From now on, you don’t need to worry about what’s happening on the other side. Patrol the forest edge regularly and expel any invasive giant beast creatures.”
“Every ten Sun Wheels, you will be rewarded with a Deep Red Blood Crystal by the King. If you encounter any unusual situations, you can report to the General at the Central Mountain Range at any time.”
Roar! Sir, rest assured, we will watch over this place.
Both giant beasts floating a hundred meters above the ground nodded excitedly. Compared to the barren Blue Star World, the energy of the Vast World was much richer.
Here, they felt as if they were lying in an Energy Ocean, their inner power constantly rising.
Leaving the two subordinates to patrol the forest, the Red Flood Dragon roared as it soared into the sky, surrounded by red light, forming a red mist covering several kilometers.
As the Red Flood Dragon flew through the sky above the forest, several different races looked up in reverence, resembling human girls with a pair of swan wings on their backs.
These beautiful beings had fair skin and wore ‘clothing’ made of leaves that covered their key areas.
After flying more than four thousand kilometers over the forest, the Red Flood Dragon arrived at the edge of a mountain range stretching across thousands of kilometers.
A high peak extended tens of thousands of meters at the front of the mountain range, with a clear-water lake at the top, surrounded by clouds and mist.
At this moment, countless shining red, white, and blue crystals were scattered across the shallow water lake, over several kilometers in area and dozens of meters deep.
Each crystal emitted a dense aura of energy.
The giant beast with a body length of more than one thousand four hundred meters, covered in white scales, and sporting a pair of red dragon horns on its head was lying on the central crystal mountain.
This creature resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon was in deep sleep, swallowing clouds and exhaling fog, enveloping the peak in a cloud of white mist several kilometers wide.
Bam! The ground shook slightly as the Red Flood Dragon landed by the lake.
Upon landing, the Red Flood Dragon looked carefully at its foreclaws. Relieved that it didn’t touch the water, it let out a sigh before respectfully lowering its head.
“King, I have returned.”
The white giant beast in the distance opened its silvery-gold vertical pupils, displaying a lazy expression as it said: “Are things done?”
“Yes, King. Through my tireless efforts, I have formed a friendly alliance with the forces of the Dragon Palace, reaching a non-aggression agreement.”
“Roar! Not bad.” The white giant beast nodded in satisfaction, sounding lazy.
“I can’t ignore that passageway anymore, otherwise, level-nine creatures keep coming from the other side to harass Kara and the others. Now that the Dragon Palace is in control, it should be peaceful.”
“By the way, what about the Dragon Palace?”
Suddenly, the Red Flood Dragon hesitated, “King, are you asking about the king of the Dragon Palace Empire or the mythical giant beast from the Dragon Palace forces?”
The white giant beast looked puzzled, “Is there a difference?”
The Red Flood Dragon responded with a bitter smile, respectfully saying, “King, there is a big difference. The king of the Dragon Palace is just a mid-level-nine dragon-type giant beast.”
“The mythical beast that killed the Black Oblivion King with a single burst is another giant beast from the Dragon Palace, the Thunderflame Dragon King, called Tim Abbott and Brock Abbott.”
“Besides, there are four other Dragon Kings in the Dragon Palace, being a quasi-mythical level, a mid-level nine, and two early-stage level nine giant beasts.”
The white giant beast paused for a moment before regaining its composure: “…This Dragon Palace is so chaotic!”
The Red Flood Dragon respectfully nodded, “Yes, I also think that the Dragon Palace is chaotic. The most powerful mythical giant beast is not even the Dragon King.”
“Nevermind, let’s not worry about it.”
The white giant beast shook its head slightly and yawned with its mouth slightly open, “I’m so sleepy, I want to go back to sleep. Redmane, you’re in charge of our territory.”
“Yes, my King.”
The Red Flood Dragon carefully retreated two steps before slowly turning around.
However, just as the Red Flood Dragon turned, its sturdy tail accidentally swept a bit of the lake’s surface, and instantly, a thunderous roar shook the heavens and the earth.
“Roar! Redmane, you’ve dirtied my water.”

chapters.title: Chapter 848: 365 Myth Destruction Form, Purple Dragon Egg Hatching
chapters.content:
Chapter 848: Chapter 365 Myth Destruction Form, Purple Dragon Egg Hatching
Unlike channels three and four located beneath the deep sea, Channel Two in the ocean’s depths is situated within a volcano mouth that rises above the sea surface.
Surrounding it are over twenty islands of varying sizes, all of which are volcanoes spewing scorching magma and belching billowing black smoke.
Beyond that, beneath the surrounding sea surface, other volcanoes are erupting, boiling and churning the nearby seawater with the heat and magma released.
The toxic black smoke from these volcanic eruptions, still in infinite turmoil, gathers high in the sky, covering an area of tens of kilometers. Under the glare of the volcanic firelight, it looks like the onset of doomsday.
Inside the central volcano mouth, a red vortex over four hundred meters tall spins atop the roiling magma, stirring the flames and forming a gigantic ring of fire spanning a kilometer.
At that moment, rolling dark clouds appear in the distant sky, followed by the spread of a terrible aura.
Suddenly, the volcano mouth shakes—or rather, it’s not a volcano mouth at all but a giant beast that lays coiled within it.
Boom! Accompanied by a rain of shattered rocks, the magma churns.
In the midst of the earth-shattering upheaval, a beast over a thousand meters tall stands up. Its body is covered with grey scales resembling rocks and its back bristles with rows of sharp reef bone spurs.
Roar!
The Ground Dragon-like giant beast looks toward the swirling dark clouds in the sky and lets out a brutal roar. The terrifying soundwave vibrates the air, its deafening roar echoing endlessly between heaven and earth.
Bang! Bang! Bang!! The sea surface within tens of kilometers around the volcanic islands explodes.
Under the roar of that Mythical Giant Beast, seven beasts exuding Level 9 aura and more than ten Eighth Level Beasts emerge from the sea surface, also roaring viciously at the distant dark clouds.
Powerful domain powers burst forth from around these beasts, churning heaven and earth, shaking the air, and forming gigantic vortexes on the sea surface.
Compared to the Red Dragon Beast Empire, the beasts here seem even more brutal and fierce, including the leading Mythical Giant Beast.
This is the bloodthirstiness befitting Transcendent Giant Beast Creatures.
Just like two giant beasts of similar size battling for territory, neither will back down before the fight commences, and a bloody skirmish is inevitable.
Watching the dark clouds that keep drawing closer, the Mountain Magma Giant Beast’s eyes reveal a ruthless light as the scales on its body emit a scorching firelight, with flames billowing from its form.
Within the flames, the grey rock-like scales on the giant beast’s body turn red, as if forged from magma, radiating an even more terrifying aura.
Roar! The Lava Giant Beast lets out another ferocious roar, along with the Burst of a rule’s power.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
In an instant, the surrounding volcanoes shake, and dozens to hundreds of columns of magma fire skyward, converging with the rolling toxic black smoke above to form a magma hell.
This scene somewhat resembles the former Black Oblivion King.
However, unlike the Black Oblivion King, whose rule fused with heaven and earth to form the Hell Domain, this Mid-Mythical Stage beast triggers volcanic eruptions directly with its powerful strength.
At the same time, the thundercloud storm carrying raging winds and tsunami collides with the volcanic domain. Instantly, the sky and earth are ablaze, and thunder roars, striking the sea surface and scattering the seawater.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The substantial pressure of the two Mythical Giant Beasts collides across tens of kilometers, shaking the sky and earth. Circles of white waves explode in the sky, forming several expanding rings that shoot out over ten kilometers.
Gazing at the vast shape looming within the distant dark clouds, the Mountain Magma Giant Beast roars fiercely, “Roar! Get out of my territory, king.”
From beneath the dark clouds, the Silver Giant Dragon spreads its wings and roars menacingly.
“Roar! The nerve to ask the Great Scythia to roll out. Today, you will be slain, and the Great Scythia will have your blood flow like a river.”
“Tim Abbott, kill that thing.”
The Silver Giant Dragon seems excited, for this one had spirit and a fiery temper, unlike the soft creatures that wouldn’t dare fight upon seeing him.
As the Silver Giant Dragon roars, the dark clouds in the sky spin, transforming into a thundercloud storm vortex that covers a hundred kilometers. Within the vortex’s center, a Black-red Colossal Beast over five hundred meters long emerges.
Compared to the thousand-meter-long Lava Giant Beast, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, at only over five hundred meters in length, seems several times smaller. But as soon as it appears, all the beasts on the sea surface feel an instinctual trepidation.
This Black-red Colossal Beast is enveloped in a terrifying pressure, the sort that stands supreme over countless lives — the Monarch’s pressure. Even the Lava Giant Beast’s eyes reveal a grave seriousness.
Boom! In an instant, an even more terrifying force Bursts from the Lava Giant Beast, shaking the world passageways behind it, drawing forth a powerful force.
Immediately, an intense seriousness flashes in the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s eyes.
For this Mid-Mythical Stage Beast was formidable. Besides wielding the Law Power to trigger volcanic eruptions, it was also enveloped in another aura of rule, connected to the world passageways behind it, covering the entire Volcano Cluster. This unseen domain of warped space made it comparable to a Late-Mythical Stage in strength.
But no matter how formidable it was, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon let out a vicious roar.
“Roar! Kill them.”
Roar! Roar!! For battle, brothers.
Raaa! Slaughter them, devour them all.
As the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon roars, instantly the four Ninth-level Beasts circling high in the sky, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles churning on the sea surface, and all the rest charge forth.
The speediest one, the often unresponsive Candle Dragon, turns into a red dragon shadow that flashes across the sky and appears atop two Ninth-level Late-stage Beasts over ten kilometers away.
Boom!
Within a dark area covering ten kilometers, a colossal tail over two thousand meters long falls from the heavens, annihilating everything below. The erupting volcano beneath erupts explosively in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 849: 365: The Mythical Destruction Form, The Purple Dragon Egg Hatches_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 849: Chapter 365: The Mythical Destruction Form, The Purple Dragon Egg Hatches_2
Roar!
Two ninth-level late-stage beasts let out an angry roar, and one of them had its surrounding domain collapse instantly. Its massive body was directly hit by the tail of the Candle Dragon and crashed into the seabed.
Boom! The explosion blew a hole in the kilometer-deep ocean, creating a seawater abyss that stretched for more than ten kilometers, exposing the shattered and exploded seabed below.
As Candle Dragon fought with both of the ninth-level late-stage beasts, the one-horned tiger whale, backed by the Black and White Domain, attacked a ninth-level mid-stage beast.
With a body length of over 250 meters, and already having surpassed the ninth-level mid-stage, the nine-headed Jiao Dragon swelled to a size of more than 700 meters, transforming into a black and red three-headed Jiao Dragon.
“Roar roar roar! Kidora is invincible, must fight, fifty!” The nine-headed Jiao Dragon, now revealing its domain true form, roared as it rushed towards another ninth-level late-stage beast.
Surrounded by a black storm mixed with ice crystals, a silver dragon more than 200 meters long and also at the ninth-level mid-stage roared, “Roar! Blood will flow like a river in Scythia today.”
Just as this silver dragon pounced on a ninth-level early-stage beast, a silver ripple spread from the head of another ninth-level early-stage beast several kilometers away in the sea.
A dragon claw holding a black ice storm descended from the sky, and bang! This ninth-level beast hadn’t reacted yet when its surrounding domain had already been shattered.
Boom!
A terrifying attack caused the kilometer-deep seabed to explode. Countless seawaters rushed into the sky, and amidst the raging waves, the scales of the ninth-level early-stage beast were shattered, and its flesh exploded.
The massive body was slammed into the seabed with a scream from the silver dragon’s surprise attack.
As the silver dragon engaged two beasts at once and severely wounded a ninth-level early-stage beast, the deep-sea dragon turtle also broke through the waves to pounce on a ninth-level mid-stage beast.
Suddenly, the sea surface exploded, and immense energy was released in the fierce battle between the ninth-level beasts, causing chaos in the world.
At the edge of the battlefield, covering tens of kilometers, female orca Angelfish led the mutated orca army towards the eighth-level beasts.
In an instant, the entire ocean began to boil, and all beasts fought ferociously under the roaring commands of both kings, with no fear of death.
Gurgle gurgle!! Crab General is invincible today, I will pinch you to death.
On the turbulent sea surface, the blue giant crab also waved its space-tearing pincers excitedly, pouncing on three eighth-level beasts, and declaring it would fight eight today.
In the midst of the fierce battle between the two sides, the Leiyan Tianlong stood in the sky, confronting the magma beast at the heart of the volcanic island group. Both beasts’ eyes were filled with ferocity and brutality.
As a creature mastering two powerful laws and at the mythological mid-stage, the magma beast showed no fear despite Leiyan Tianlong’s terrifying aura.
As long as the opponent dared enter its power range, the magma beast would instantly unleash all its strength to tear it apart, letting it know what level suppression meant.
Standing proudly in the volcanic group, the Leiyan Tianlong’s eyes turned even colder.
In fact, when it first saw this mythological creature earlier, Leiyan Tianlong recognized it.
When it had just broken through the fourth level and entered the sea, it ventured towards the deep sea territory and hunted down mutated creatures, eventually coming close to this deep sea forbidden zone.
It happened to witness the awakening of this mythological creature, which was stirring up waves in the sea with its released power.
At that time, still a sword-armored creature, it was instantly intimidated by the horror emanating from this mythological beast, merely taking a brief glance before turning away.
Unexpectedly, only a few months later, it finally met this mythological creature again.
Moreover, according to official federal records, this mythological creature was the only one in Blue Star World that hadn’t entered the mythological world, choosing instead to remain inside the planet.
The reason seemed to be related to its gift.
This mythological creature could absorb the spatial energy released when the two worlds collided, which contained a trace of weak world power.
By absorbing this weak world power, it made the body of this mythical creature incredibly strong.
However, the mythological beast merely hovered near the entrance of the channel, never venturing far from it or approaching the human mainland, so people ignored its presence.
But today…
Boom! Endless black and red lightning surged around Leiyan Tianlong’s body, and in that instant, a terrifying aura that was beyond description soared into the sky, shaking heaven and earth.
Amidst this black and red lightning that flashed across the sky, a terrifying beast covered with red scales, more than 1500 meters long, emerged.
Boom, boom, boom! Under the impact of this terrifying tangible force, the clouds in the sky dispersed with Leiyan Tianlong at the center, forming a void dozens of kilometers wide.
Even the surrounding space couldn’t withstand its existence, constantly collapsing and repairing itself, creating a dark area several kilometers wide filled with a destructive aura.
Its power was so overwhelming that the pressure of its invisible force pushed the seawater below, exposing the kilometer-deep seabed and forming a huge waterless area.
Standing in the dark area, wrapped in black and red lightning, the deep red beast appeared like a world-ending evil creature, emitting a terrifying aura that eclipsed everything.
At this frightening display of power, all the beasts facing them tensed up in an instant, giving the savage roaring silver dragon the chance to land a killing blow on a ninth-level early-stage beast with one attack.
Roar roar roar! The bloody battle erupted again in an instant.
Roar! How is this possible!
Watching the black and red lightning on the beast’s body, feeling the horrifying aura that brought despair to the creatures, the previously confident magma beast’s eyes flashed with shock and anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 850: 365: The Mythical Destruction Form, The Purple Dragon Egg Hatches_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 850: Chapter 365: The Mythical Destruction Form, The Purple Dragon Egg Hatches_3
Boom! Space shattered, and the crimson behemoth transformed into a red bolt of lightning, charging into the spatial region with earth-shattering might, spanning tens of kilometers.
Bang bang bang! In front of the domineering crimson behemoth, the invisible spatial domain covering tens of kilometers collapsed, creating a straight black path through it.
Roar!
Faced with the threat of death, the magma behemoth roared angrily, unleashing all its power within its body. The burning flames almost ignited the sky and earth, while its two claws, wrapped in the energy of laws, lunged towards the crimson behemoth.
The two massive creatures collided in an instant.
Boom! A circle of red destruction exploded, causing the Volcanic Island to shatter instantaneously. Lava and rocks mixed with seawater filled the sky for tens of kilometers, creating an appalling sight.
...
Roar! At this moment, a scream rang out.
Amidst the sea of flames, the magma behemoth’s claws were directly broken by the crimson behemoth’s attack, and its massive body was sent flying by an unstoppable force.
However, at the instant the magma behemoth was sent flying, a giant claw emerged from the collapsing darkness of space, grabbing the magma behemoth and smashing it fiercely into the ground.
Boom! The instant the kilometer-long behemoth hit the ground, the earth sank within a range of ten kilometers, causing the sky and earth to turn upside down. The destructive impact created a scorching halo that swept through everything in its path.
Flames burned in a pit tens of kilometers in diameter and over a thousand meters deep, with violent airwaves raging within.
Before the magma behemoth could react, a tail blade as long as eight hundred meters, wrapped in black-red lightning, cleaved the heavens and earth, slashing through space and ferociously falling.
Boom! Roar!
The magma behemoth let out a miserable scream as it was bisected on one side of its body by the tail blade wrapped in destruction and diamond laws, leaving a terrifying wound several hundred meters long.
Hot blood containing terrifying energy gushed out in an instant, melting the nearby shattered earth into molten lava.
In front of the crimson behemoth in its destruction form, Flame Emperor Dragon, the mythical-mid-level behemoth had no power to retaliate. In just a moment, its claws were blown off, and half of its body was cleaved.
Nonetheless, as a mythical-level creature, such injuries could not kill it.
Roar roar roar!!
The magma behemoth roared ferociously, unleashing circles of silver-red destruction that overwhelmed the area, melting and shattering space to create rings of black destruction.
Instantly Underneath Earth’s Material, where it passed, was annihilated, forming a zone of destruction.
Facing death, the magma behemoth directly erupted its original force of laws, burned its soul, and prepared to repel the Flame Emperor Dragon and escape.
Boom boom boom!!
The silvery-red impact that could melt space fell upon the Flame Emperor Dragon’s body, creating intense vibrations but failing to move the crimson behemoth even slightly.
On the red scales on the Flame Emperor Dragon’s body, golden and black patterns intertwined, exuding an unshakable and indestructible aura, powerful enough to make its enemies despair.
Boom! Unfazed by the impact of the original force of laws, the Flame Emperor Dragon’s claws reached out, grabbing the magma behemoth’s thick shoulders as dazzling black and red light shone from its mouth.
Roar! No!
Boom! The crimson behemoth roared and gushed out a black and gold breath formed from the fusion of destruction and diamond laws, immediately enveloping the magma behemoth.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the horrifying force of law and destruction, the indestructible body of the magma behemoth was slowly eroded away. Its scales shattered, and then its extremely hard skull followed.
At this moment, the unable-to-resist magma behemoth revealed despair and madness in its eyes, and a force containing the power of the world within its body connected with a distant passage.
Dazzling light bloomed within the Flame Emperor Dragon’s claws, accompanied by a mythical creature’s self-destruction and the collapse of a not-too-distant world passage. In an instant, the sky and earth crumbled.
Boom!!
In an instant, all the massive creatures were deafened, and the sky turned dark.
Within the sight of all behemoths remained only the expanding and blooming destructive light sphere in the distance. Everything in its path was destroyed, volcanoes erupted, and countless seawater evaporated.
Under the horrifying destructive impact, the surrounding air was compressed into a solid mass, creating layers of white shockwaves that swept through everything, causing tsunamis hundreds of meters high to cover hundreds of kilometers.
Amidst the powerful impact, massive creatures mixed with seawater were blown away, forming a destruction zone spanning more than twenty kilometers where nothing remained.</ authDomain

chapters.title: Chapter 851: 366 Creation Origin, Thunderflame: I'm Not Your Parent
chapters.content:
Chapter 851: Chapter 366 Creation Origin, Thunderflame: I’m Not Your Parent
The self-destructive prowess of a Mythical Giant Beast is terrifying, especially when it drags the world passageways down with it.
In the instant of the explosion, the destructive force annihilated everything around it, followed by a dreadful shockwave that formed a devastating typhoon, raising tsunamis hundreds of meters high that surged towards the surroundings.
The energy released immediately triggered a reaction from the Ocean Monitoring Center, with blinding red lights flickering.
“Report, the energy fluctuations from the Mythical Giant Beast at Channel Two have disappeared, it is determined to be dead.”
“The spatial fluctuations at Channel Two have also vanished, and under the detection of the Space Wave Satellite, that area has become completely muddled.”
“Alert, a strong energy surge has been detected, a super typhoon over level twenty has formed, carrying tsunamis over a hundred meters high towards nearby coasts.”
...
“Because it is caused by a powerful energy outburst, this tsunami is of a rising form, estimated to reach the coast of the Hundred Foxes Nation over a thousand kilometers away in just over an hour.”
“Due to the declining potential energy, the tsunami is expected to fall back to a height of fifty meters, but it will still cause catastrophic disaster, it is advised to immediately issue a disaster warning.”
“In addition, the coasts of Qatar Country and Kurdos Country, respectively 1,500 kilometers and 2,300 kilometers southwest and northwest, will also be affected by the tsunami.”
After the staff members’ rapid report finished, the Major General presiding over the center today looked solemn and said in a deep voice, “Immediately notify the local officials of the three nations to evacuate coastal residents, to avoid significant casualties.”
“Also, please engage the Ninth Heaven Expert from the nearby Hundred Foxes Nation to disperse the first wave of the strongest impact of the tsunami two hundred kilometers off the coast.”
“Yes.”
Only after the Major General’s orders were delivered did shock become visible on the faces of many in the Monitoring Center.
“That Thunderflame Beheamoth became even more terrifying after its breakthrough into the Mythical-level.”
“Indeed, it reached Channel Two just a few minutes ago, but it killed the Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast that was occupying the passageway, it was a complete crushing.”
“Keep track of that Giant Beast’s movement route, its next target should be Channel One.”
“That passageway is closer to the coastal areas of the Berlin Empire, if the conflict esculates to the late Mythical stage or above, the residual shockwaves could cause even stronger tsunamis.”
“Also, report this anomaly here to the higher-ups…”
…
The sea water at the edge of the twenty-kilometer diameter destruction roared and tumbled but was blocked by the Law Power that leaked from the Lava Giant Beast’s self-destruction, forming a thousand-meter-tall wall of the sea.
In the center of the explosion, everything was destroyed, leaving behind a vast crater over ten kilometers wide and more than two thousand meters deep.
At the bottom of the pit, the fiercely hot dark red magma roiled, unable to burst forth, suppressed by a Terrifying Power underneath.
At that moment, the Deep Red Giant Beast, with a height of a kilometer and a body length of over one and a half kilometers, stood imposingly, its body wrapped in black-red Destructive Lightning, exuding an aura that could Destroy Heaven and Earth.
However, this terrifying scene was interrupted by a series of naive cries.
Upon the dragon head of the Deep Red Giant Beast, whose diameter exceeded a hundred meters and was covered with a thick armor, a Purple little dragon, just over a meter long, climbed out of its shell.
This was a hatchling identical to those depicted in Mythical Legends, slender and handsome, its body covered in semi-transparent crystal-like purple scales.
Atop its head were a pair of small, forked purple-red horns resembling deer antlers, surrounded by wispy purple mane that moved without wind, with tiny ox-like ears peeking out from within the hair, twitching from time to time endearingly.
At this moment, the Purple little dragon was standing on top of the thick Red Scale Armor, opening its large, rabbit-like purple-gold eyes wide, curiously observing its surroundings.
As for the black-red Destructive Lightning that leapt around, emitting a Terrifying Aura, each time it approached within a meter of it, the lightning would disappear.
Moreover, as the Purple little dragon hatched, an Aura that only belonged to those above Monarchs spread out.
Suddenly, the Purple little dragon moved, appearing like a purple radiance before the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s eyes.
Yiyayiya!
Clutching what seemed to be a ‘lash’ as thick as a tree trunk from the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, the Purple little dragon radiated a joyous mood, cooing at the Golden-Red Vertical Pupils.
Because it had just been born, its ability to express itself was somewhat vague.
But having absorbed life energy from the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon and being connected through life fluctuations, it could vaguely sense what the Purple little dragon was saying.
This little one… was calling it Mom.
Whoosh!
The gargantuan maw of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon opened slightly, stirring up a raging wind, followed by a terrible low growl that shook the surrounding space: “Little one, I’m not your mother.”
Yiya!? The little dragon cocked its head, its large watery eyes revealing confusion before it joyfully cooed again.
Yiyayiya!!
The Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was at a loss for words and growled again: “I’m not your father either.”
Yiya??
The Purple little dragon became even more puzzled, turning into a streak of purple radiance and landing on the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s nose, which was as vast as a square, stretching out a little claw towards the ‘mountain peak’ where the Dragon Egg lay.
Yiyayiya!! Yiyayiya??
The Purple little dragon gesticulated excitedly with its small claw, indicating that it had been brought to life out of an egg on the head of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon.
Moreover, since it had emerged from the egg with a faint consciousness, it always felt the life Aura of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, certain not to mistake it.
“Roar! I’m really not your parent,” the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon lowly growled in frustration.
How old was it?
If calculated like the souls of humans, it was only seventeen years old, and not even a year old if counted as the body of a Giant Beast; it certainly did not wish to become a parent that soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 852: 366 Creation Origin, Thunderflame: I'm Not Your Parents_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 852: Chapter 366 Creation Origin, Thunderflame: I’m Not Your Parents_2
“I found you in a small world back then; you were about to die, and only after absorbing some of my Life Energy did you stop the ebb of your life.”
“However, little one, you absorbed a lot of my Life Energy, and now that you’ve hatched, consider me your brother.”
Yiya!? The little guy blinked his large eyes in confusion, seemingly asking what a brother is.
The Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon growled softly, “A brother is the closest dragon to you besides your parents. From now on, follow me around until you grow up.”
After the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon finished speaking, the little guy tilted his head to think and, seemingly understanding what a brother was, nodded happily with his eyes shining.
Yiya, yiya!! The purple little dragon turned into a streak of purple radiance, joyfully circling the grand and rugged ‘forest’ of Scale Horns on top of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s head.
...
As he flew, the little guy vanished in an instant as if teleporting, crossing several kilometers to appear below a deep pit.
The purple little dragon stared with big, curious eyes at the rolling magma below, suppressed by the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s might, then couldn’t help but cautiously extend a claw to touch it.
Boom! Instantly, the rolling magma below erupted, and a vast stream of intense energy surged through its tiny claw, infinite and ceaseless.
But after absorbing for just a moment, the purple little dragon withdrew its claw, displaying a hint of disdain in its eyes.
Yiya, yiya!!
The purple little dragon vanished in an instant, reappearing at the edge of a sea wall ten kilometers away, curiously touching the ocean with its right claw.
Boom! Instantly, that sea area erupted, just like the magma before, as endless blue energy turned into streams of light, rushing toward its right claw.
But again, after absorbing only a moment, the purple little dragon withdrew its claw, seemingly disdaining the low level of these energies.
This scene gave the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon something to ponder.
The realm of the purple little dragon was very peculiar; the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon couldn’t sense a specific level on it, it seemed quite weak.
Yet this little guy could ignore the Rule Power entwined around it and could freely fly and blink, appearing quite mystical, as if it were born a ‘god’.
Or rather, it was innately divine.
For Mutated Creatures, only by awakening a hint of a king-level bloodline is there hope to breakthrough Level 7 and become a Giant Beast, with the potential to break through Level 9.
And bloodline is, in fact, equivalent to the talent of a Mutated Creature, and it also represents strength.
For instance, even the lowest Mythical Giant Beasts have king-level bloodlines; Mythical Titans have at least Monarch-level bloodlines because, as their strength increases, the purity of their bloodlines continues to advance.
That means a high bloodline level does not necessarily mean great strength, but the bloodline level of a powerful Giant Beast is definitely high.
And the purple little dragon, when first found, had almost imperceptible life fluctuations, but still exuded a terrifying aura belonging to Monarch-Level Life.
Later, after absorbing the Life Energy of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it stopped the Life Energy from waning, and then bit by bit, it absorbed and purified the bloodline, reaching hatching from a Pseudo-heavenly tier Life Energy level.
This is a being whose life grade is at least at the Pseudo-heavenly Emperor level.
Moreover, the purple little dragon and beings like the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon who evolve step by step are different; it has an innate Pseudo-heavenly Emperor bloodline.
Such a being, like the offspring of those top-tier divine beasts in legends, is born a ‘god’.
As the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was deep in thought, the black-red lightning that entwined around its body disappeared and its size rapidly shrank, recovering to over five hundred meters quickly.
Immediately, a strong sense of weakness spread from within, following the aftermath of using a Burst Type talent.
Even Mythical Creatures must adhere to a certain ‘energy conservation’ rule.
When the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon entered the Giant State in an instant, merging its many talents and Law Power within, it exploded with the combat strength of a Mythical Peak. The energy expended every second was enormous.
Of course, the short period spent overwhelming and bursting the Lava Giant Beast wasn’t enough to leave it weakened; it only needed to rest for a while to regain its full strength.
At the same time, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon felt a bit disappointed, not anticipating the Lava Giant Beast being so brutal that it would choose self-destruction to attempt mutual annihilation without leaving any trace or sustenance for it.
And the explosion of a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast, possessing two ordinary laws, is genuinely terrifying.
If it hadn’t been for the ‘Demon immunity’ Chaos Black Pattern talent and its Deep Red Form, even if it had the Vajra Law, it would still have sustained injuries.
Just then, as the purple little dragon, frolicking around, sensed the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s aura of weakness, it appeared before it instantly, showing a humanized expression of concern.
Yiya, yiya!?
The Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s mouth corners curled up into a ferocious grin as it growled, “I’m fine, just consumed a bit too much fighting that guy earlier.”
Seeing the somewhat weakened Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, the purple little dragon tilted its head, then suddenly moved to face the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s gigantic eye closely, opening its mouth wide in front of the eye.
Ao! Along with its childlike ‘roar’, a spout of pure purple energy erupted from its mouth, merging into the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s eye.
In comparison to the enormous golden vertical pupils, the energy from the purple little dragon’s breath was almost negligible.
But the moment this energy merged into the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s body, the whole body ‘exploded,’ an invisible surge swept through the entirety, and the dragon suddenly perked up.
At the same time, Jack Clark, who had just started his closed-door cultivation in the mythical world for half a day, was abruptly awoken again.
In front of him, a row of transparent text appeared.
“Giant Beast Body has received a strand of Creation origin’s baptism, leading to a slight Transformation of life form.”

chapters.title: Chapter 853: 366 Creation Origin, Thunderflame: I'm Not Your Parents_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 853: Chapter 366 Creation Origin, Thunderflame: I’m Not Your Parents_3
“`
“Hint: When enough creation origin is accumulated, and the giant beast body reaches the peak of an ancient titan, meeting the requirements for evolution, it can directly advance to a breakthrough.”
“Creation origin!” Jack Clark’s eyes revealed astonishment.
He hadn’t expected that the breath from the purple little dragon was actually infused with the power of creation’s origin and that this power was the origin force needed for an ancient titan’s breakthrough.
And the soul enhancement to the ‘deific’ level, with the gained deific ability after merging with the Avatar, required touching the creation origin to separate again.
“So is it fate that dictates every sip and bite?” Jack Clark’s mouth curled slightly upward.
...
Initially, when the Thunderflame Beheamoth found the dragon egg, it chose not to devour it due to the rarity of emperor-level life, instead, expending life energy to heal it.
Now, with the emergence of the purple little dragon from its shell, a breath of creation origin was its reward.
This breath of creation origin was clearly one of its talents, which could be inferred from the origin substance formed from the life energy it previously lost, which also contained the power of creation.
