However, compared to the current complete creation origin, the creation energy contained in those life’s origin substances seemed very faint.
As a talent, the purple little dragon will definitely be able to continually produce creation origin in the future, enough for the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon to accumulate and meet the requirements for a breakthrough above the ancient titan.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack Clark slowly closed his eyes and once again fell into a deep sleep, absorbing the Mysterious Yellow Air around him.
Blue Star World.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon looked at the purple little dragon in front of it, which seemed a bit languid after exhaling a breath, and roared softly, “Are you alright after releasing that breath of creation energy?”
Yi ya yi ya!! Ya ya ya ya!!
The purple little dragon’s spirit rallied, with its double claws on its hips and its head raised, calling out to indicate that it was just a single breath, a minor issue, and that rest would lead to recovery.
However, after speaking, the purple little dragon turned into a streak of light and appeared atop the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s head, clutching its purple eggshell and munching down on it with a crunch.
With each bite of the eggshell, the aura of the purple little dragon visibly recovered a bit, and seeing this, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon shifted its attention away from it.
While the purple little dragon was busily munching on the eggshell, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon was also silently sensing the changes within its body.
Then it found that aside from restoring its ‘strength’, that breath of creation origin seemed not to bring about any additional changes, unsure if it was due to its insufficiency or some other reason.
Even though it had recovered, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon still stood within the Area of Destruction, not going to aid his subordinates.
Previously, it had assessed the strengths of both sides, and excluding the peak combat powers of itself and the Lava Giant Beast, the power of the giants from Level 9 down to Level 8 still favored the side of Dragon Palace.
Though the enemy had greater numbers, particularly the seventeen Level 8 Giant Beasts.
But all of Dragon Palace’s Level 9 beasts had reached king-level bloodlines, possessing a top-tier talent, with strength enough to overcome at least one minor level.
This overcoming means the ability to defeat the opposition, even if the opponent was also a Level 9 giant beast that had awakened a king-level bloodline and had two or three advanced talents.
There’s no help for it, top-tier talent brings dominance, and this can be seen with the previous Thunderflame Beheamoth—merely with its defense and strength as top-tier talents, it could blast through those of the same rank.
Unless the opponent also possessed a top-tier talent or if two or three advanced talents could combine to become even stronger and thus compete.
Soon, in less than half an hour, the beasts that were blasted away for hundreds of kilometers by the explosion began to return one by one.
The first to return was Kidora, with only six dragon heads remaining, carrying the corpse of a giant beast in the mouths of its two black heads, and upon seeing the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, its four heads let out excited and chaotic roars.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott, Kido, ra, unbeatable, took one down.”
Today it managed to kill a Late Stage 9 beast while only being at Mid Level 9, and it only suffered minor injuries.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon nodded with satisfaction: “Roar! Not bad, Kidora, you’re getting stronger and stronger.”
Soon, a red aura enveloped a figure in the distance, the Red Candle Dragon, unscathed, clutching the corpses of two Late Stage 9 beasts.
“`
As a quasi-mythical-level behemoth that had touched upon the Time Laws, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon completely crushed the two Late Stage 9 beasts in combat.
If it hadn’t been for the earlier explosion impact, which sent all the beasts flying, it would’ve killed its opponents long ago.
Sometime later, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, still bloody around its double fins and mouth, flew back, radiating a ferocious aura, clearly having killed its Mid Level 9 opponent.
And it seemed that the corpse of that behemoth had already been devoured by its Chaos Hole talent.
However, when the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle came back later, its mood seemed somewhat downcast.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon looked at it curiously, “Roar! Domination, what happened? Were you beaten up by that Mid Level 9 Giant Beast?”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle shook its head: Roar roar! No, I heavily injured it with a single breath of fusion breath, but that guy was too cunning and got away before I could catch up.
“Roar! Never mind not catching up; after all, it’s just a Mid Level 9 creature.” The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon casually roared lowly.
After breaking through to the Mythical-level, the biological energy it needed for every bit of growth was massive. Eating anything below Mythical-level wasn’t much help anymore, unless it devoured dozens or hundreds of Level 9 Giant Beasts in one go.
There was no helping it; the energy difference between a deified body tempered by Laws and Level 9 was just too great.
Boom! Far away, the sea water exploded, and the Blue Giant Crab, missing two legs and having many areas of broken scale armor, excitedly climbed out, crossing the broken ground laterally.
Gurgle gurgle, Great King, I’ve snipped two to death this time, and another got away.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon nodded with satisfaction, “Crab General, you’ve done well, just try not to break your legs in battle next time.”.
This guy was reckless in every fight, either breaking legs or claws. If crab legs couldn’t regenerate, he’d have been worn out by now.
Compared to the Crab General, the Female Tiger Whale, who had also consumed the Divine Fruit and quasi-mythical beasts’ flesh and blood to reach the Late Stage Level 8, seemed much more composed, calling softly from the distant sea water.
Ying ying! King, I’ve devoured two Level 8s.
Bang bang! Far away, the sea surface boiled as two Mutated Tiger Whales with red patterns on their bodies leaped out of the water, joyfully calling.
Ying ying ying! Uncle, uncle, my second and I teamed up and also bit one to death.
Ying ying! Uncle, don’t listen to them; Mr. Loore and the others just took advantage of Mom’s work. I’m the more impressive one; I bit six enemies to death.
Ying ying ying! Third, you lying beast, I saw it; you only bit two to death. The other four were killed by your subordinates’ joint attack.
While the little Tiger Whales were arguing, the Silver Giant Dragon had also flown back, clutching two corpses of Peak Level 8 Beasts in its claws: “Roar! Tim Abott, this guy has crystals inside.”
Instantly, the corners of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s mouth lifted slightly. Not bad, Scythia is reliable.
After tossing the two corpses of the Eighth Level Beasts at the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s feet, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an exuberant roar, “Roar! Great Sethia is invincible; today, another Mythical Beast Empire has been destroyed.”
Roar roar! Sethia is invincible, awesome.
Ying ying ying! Sethia is a freak, explodingly cool.
The other beasts chimed in with their roars as well, looking extremely excited.
Immediately, even the mutant beast soldiers in the distant sea let out various roars, thrilled and excited, all of them reeking of the blood of battle they had joined in.
This battle had destroyed an entire Mythical Giant Beast power, except for one Mid Level 9 and one Late Stage Level 8 beast that escaped because of the tsunami from the explosion.
When their roaring had somewhat subsided, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon spoke slowly, “Now there’s only one pathway left. Defeat the Mythical Giant Beast, and our Dragon Palace will unify the ocean.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared happily, “Roar! Tim Abott, the Balon Beast King has a good nature; when you fight it, be a little gentle, just inflict a heavy injury will do.”
“…No problem,” replied the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, nodding with a strange look in its eyes.
Hey! Just then, the Silver Giant Dragon’s gaze fell upon the head of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 367 Scythia, your mom is calling you to come home for dinner.
chapters.content:
Chapter 854: Chapter 367 Scythia, your mom is calling you to come home for dinner.
Looking at the purple baby dragon gnawing at the eggshell on Leiyan Tianlong’s head, the silver giant dragon flying in the sky was curious: “Roar! Ao Tian, has that egg hatched?”
Leiyan Tianlong growled lowly: “Yes.”
Immediately the silver giant dragon flapped its wings and approached, nearly sticking its head by Leiyan Tianlong’s side.
“Roar! Ao Tian, your child looks so cute. Can the great Scythia touch it?”
It’s not my child…
Leiyan Tianlong, speechless: “Scythia, don’t talk nonsense; we picked up this dragon egg. Also, don’t try to touch it with those huge claws; what if you crush it to death?”
...
Compared to the silver giant dragon, which was already over two hundred meters long, and a single claw larger than a pillar, the purple baby dragon, only a meter long, was truly tiny.
“Roar! So I can’t touch it?” The silver giant dragon reluctantly put down its right claw.
It actually wanted to stroke Leiyan Tianlong’s head with its claw.
At this time, the narwhal also swam over, gazing curiously at the purple baby dragon on Leiyan Tianlong’s head: *squeal squeal squeal*! Leiyan, your egg hatched?
Bang! A long, black and red tail swept across the sky, exploding the atmosphere, sending ripples of visible white ripples to the narwhal’s side.
The sudden terrifying impact shattered the surrounding space, sending the enormous narwhal flying like a cannonball across several kilometers.
Bang! The sea erupted in the distance, splashing thousands of meters high, ferocious waves lifted the surrounding behemoths, with an amazing momentum.
This frightening scene caused the necks of the surrounding behemoths, who also wanted to open their mouths, to shrink.
Too terrifying. Leiyan is still so brutal.
Then, the deep-sea dragon turtle started gloating: Serves you right, idiot! How dare you say that the egg is Leiyan’s in front of Scythia!
“Roar! I already said, it’s not my egg, not my child.” Leiyan Emperor Dragon snorted fiercely, and the slightly swaying tail in the back radiated a terrifying breath.
Of course, Leiyan Tianlong had used the side of its tail earlier and controlled its power; otherwise, the narwhal would not have been blown away but would have been cut in half.
At this time, the purple baby dragon, which had gnawed through half its eggshell, had had its fill. It put down the eggshell and looked curiously at the surrounding behemoths.
Eh ya eh ya?!
Facing its inquiry, Leiyan Emperor Dragon gently growled: “Roar! They are all my friends and subordinates.”
“Right, it seems like I haven’t named you yet.” At this moment, Leiyan Tianlong also realized that he hadn’t named the purple baby dragon yet, even though it had been born for some time.
The silver giant dragon’s eyes lit up, roaring enthusiastically: “Roar! Leiyan, let the great Scythia give it a name!”
“Roar! No need, I’ll do it. I don’t want it to have a Western name.”
Leiyan Tianlong muttered: “You’ve been babbling all day. I’ll call you Little Yi. Follow my surname: Ao Yiyi.”
Eh ya?!
The purple baby dragon tilted its head and then nodded happily. It turned into a stream of light, flying around Leiyan Tianlong’s head, constantly babbling.
At this time, the narwhal that had been slapped away returned, its flippers flapping: *squeal squeal squeal*! Leiyan, is Little Yi male or female?
Suddenly, the other behemoths’ eyes all showed curiosity.
“Roar! It’s just been born, don’t you think that question is a bit too much?” Leiyan Tianlong didn’t know whether the purple baby dragon was male or female.
Because it also didn’t know how to discern the gender of dragons. Look at its private parts?
But the purple baby dragon’s backside was all smooth. How could they tell?
For even the silver giant dragon, Leiyan Tianlong had observed it, wanting to know if it was male or female. But nothing was behind its rear end, causing the giant dragon to be puzzled for a while.
It wasn’t until later that Leiyan Tianlong asked, and the silver giant dragon itself said that it was female.
As for how dragons eliminate their waste without a rear end, don’t think about it. These creatures digest everything they eat into energy and don’t need to eliminate waste at all.
……
The raging wind howled above the sea, darkening the skies, causing waves tens of meters high.
A ferocious black and red monster, over five hundred meters long, hovered in the clouds. Surrounding it were swirling blue thunderbolts. Its enormous body occasionally burst through the dark clouds, looking like a divine dragon from the legends that could ride on clouds and mists.
Compared to the legendary Eastern divine dragon, this monster seemed even more imposing and powerful.
However, at this moment, the meter-long purple baby dragon on the ferocious monster’s head was grabbing onto a sharp, robust black horn, shouting excitedly.
Eh ya eh ya!!!
The purple baby dragon was thrilled at this moment, looking at the massive beasts circling around and the sea creatures riding the wind and breaking waves below. It couldn’t help but stretch out a small claw, pointing forward.
Eh ya eh ya! Ya ya ya!!!
The silver giant dragon created a gust of wind with its wings as it came to Leiyan Tianlong’s side, looking puzzled at the purple baby dragon on its head: “Roar! Ao Tian, what is Little Yi saying?”
Leiyan Tianlong casually growled: “It says to charge forward, it wants to dominate the world.”
Roar! The silver giant dragon’s eyes widened, letting out a roar.
What, this little guy hasn’t even been weaned and already wants to conquer the world? The great Scythia only wanted to rule the ocean.
Also, why is it always lying on Ao Tian’s head, while telling Ao Tian to charge forward?
Looking at the little creature clinging to Leiyan Tianlong’s dragon horn, the silver giant dragon suddenly growled: “Roar! Little Yi, do you want to go play in the sea with the great Scythia?”

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 367 Scythia, your mom is calling you to come home for dinner_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 855: Chapter 367 Scythia, your mom is calling you to come home for dinner_2
The purple little dragon turned and looked at the Silver Giant Dragon, thought for a moment, and then shook its head: Yi ya yi ya!!
?Unable to understand the infant-like speech, the Silver Giant Dragon looked at Leiyan Tianlong.
Leiyan Tianlong’s eyes revealed a strange look and let out a faint growl, “Xiao Yi said you are lying to it, it won’t play with you.”
“Roar! The great Sessitya never lies to dragons, really, I just wanted to take you down to experience leading a giant beast army, and commanding the seas.”
While the Silver Giant Dragon circled in the sky attempting to coax the purple little dragon down from Leiyan Tianlong’s head.
On the surface of the sea, the level-seven sea turtle giant beast approached the Deep Sea Turtle again, making a low growl in favor: Woo woo! ! ! Your Majesty, can I follow you?
...
The Deep-Sea Turtle glanced at the sea turtle giant beast and nodded slightly.
Roar! ! You, you’re fine, follow behind me.
During a fierce battle between the previous two giant beast forces, this level-seven sea turtle charged fiercely behind the black killer whale.
A group of three-headed early stage level-eight and more than twenty level-seven giant beasts followed the black killer whale and killed the other six level-eight beasts, eventually defeating their opponents.
Among them, the black killer whale bit and killed two beasts, and the rest were besieged and killed by these giant beasts.
Especially this level-seven sea turtle, who fought ferociously without fear of death, showcasing the turtles’ race’s bloody temperament.
Channel One and Channel Two were quite far apart. Under Leiyan Tianlong’s command of the thunderstorm, it took nearly three hours to approach the channel.
Of course, the main reason was that the giant beasts under its command were too slow.
For the sake of making an impressive entrance, Leiyan Tianlong could only endure the delay.
Three thousand meters deep into the sea, a blue vortex more than 600 meters high rotated slowly, emanating an invisible surge of powerful boundary force waves.
The invisible force of the dual realms squeezed and displaced the surrounding seawater, forming a three-kilometer-wide waterless void.
Boom boom boom! ! Thundering clouds rolled across the sky, quickly covering the airspace above the channel. Thunder roared above while the underwater world resounded with the roars of giant beasts.
However, after only two roars, all the giant beasts stopped because there seemed to be no beasts in the surrounding area.
Uh…
The Silver Giant Dragon suddenly realized, “Roar! I forgot, the Balon Beast King has never managed this channel. It has been sleeping on the other side, so there are no beasts lurking around.”
“As long as the level-nine giant beasts passing through the channel don’t bother it, it won’t care and allows level nine lifeforms to come and go freely.”
Immediately, Leiyan Tianlong, cloaked in the aura of myth, was at a loss for words. Had they known this earlier, they wouldn’t have wasted their time preparing to make an entrance.
As Leiyan Tianlong pondered whether to catch and beat the mythical giant beast or not.
On the other side of the channel, the black giant beast, resting near the border, opened its eyes due to Leiyan Tianlong’s reckless and awe-inspiring aura.
“Roar! This presence, is it that little fellow named Leiyan? Has he already broken through to become a myth so fast?” The black giant beast’s eyes revealed surprise.
In a vast world, a normal giant beast advancing to a mythical stage usually takes at least ten to several dozen Sun Wheel cycles, slowly integrating laws and tempering the giant beast’s body.
Unexpectedly, this little fellow awoke within half a Sun Wheel cycle.
However, it also took this dreadful ‘genius’ only a few Sun Wheel cycles to grow from level seven to a mythical level, so maybe being abnormally fast was normal for it.
With this thought, the black giant beast, over 1,300 meters long, slowly stood up, its massive body stirring up waves and an astonishing momentum as it stepped into the channel.
Boom!
The moment the black giant beast entered the channel, the entire blue vortex went into a mad vibration.
In the Blue Star World, as the channel trembled, a terrifying aura spread out. Even within Leiyan Tianlong’s eyes, a solemn color couldn’t help but emerge.
This was a mythical giant beast in its late stage, and its breath felt terrifying, making Leiyan Tianlong feel a hint of danger. It was certainly no ordinary mythical giant beast.
Boom!
Under the heavy gazes of all the giant beasts, the black giant beast over a thousand meters long stepped out, and a dreadful, heavy dragon might immediately enveloped the area, causing the nine-headed python and other giant beasts to gasp for breath.
Mythical giant beasts with king-level bloodlines, along with their domain suppression, made it somewhat unbearable for the nine-headed python and other giant beasts who also possess king-level bloodlines.
The female killer whale and other level-eight and level-seven giant beasts were even more severely affected by the terrifying pressure, being slammed to the sea floor, unable to move.
At this moment, only the Silver Giant Dragon and the Candle Dragon Beast were slightly better off, while Leiyan Tianlong and the purple little dragon seemed indifferent due to their exceptionally high bloodline ranks.
Roar!
At this time, at an altitude of 10,000 meters above Leiyan Tianlong, an explosion of terrifying might erupted, forming a spherical ring that caused a shockwave across the world.
Boom boom boom! ! !
As the pressure from the two mythical giant beasts containing the power of law collided, the entire sea shook. Waves rose to the sky with a devastating force.
Thunderclouds in the sky were torn apart even more fiercely, forming a ring-shaped gap of more than a dozen miles, surrounded by astonishingly swirling clouds.
Next to Leiyan Tianlong, the Silver Giant Dragon became excited, letting out a high-pitched roar: “Roar! Tim Abott, onwards, beat it fiercely! The great Sessitya wants to rule the seas.”
Although this black giant beast didn’t intervene in matters, the Silver Giant Dragon still felt that defeating it was essential for securing its dominance over the ocean.
Sharing similar feelings, Leiyan Tianlong nodded slowly, the red light flickering in its golden vertical pupils, and black and red lightning flashed around its body.

chapters.title: Chapter 856: 367 Scythia, your mom is calling you back for dinner_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 856: Chapter 367 Scythia, your mom is calling you back for dinner_3
In an instant, a terrifying aura enveloped the heavens and the earth.
The Black Colossus, which was looking up at it, was taken aback—it could actually sense a dangerous aura from the newly mythological-based Leiyan Tianlong, a strong sense of danger.
The opponent was terrifying, even posing a threat to its life.
“Roar! Stop, don’t fight, don’t fight.”
The Black Colossus hurriedly let out a roar: “Scythia, Queen Adrianna told me to tell you that you have been out playing for several Sun Wheels, and it’s time to go back.”
“Oh, by the way, the Queen said to bring your friends back with you as guests.”
...
The excited Leiyan Tianlong instantly paused its attack.
The roaring Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat confused, looking down curiously: “Roar! Balon Beast King, do you know the great Scythia’s mother?”
“Of course I do.”
The Black Colossus growled, “I am the great Titan King, serving under Queen Adrianna, the Storm and Frost Destruction Lord, King Barron, Barron Kurodo.”
As it spoke, the terrifying mythological pressure on the Black Colossus gradually faded, and all the dumbfounded giant beasts sighed in relief, especially the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, whose eyes widened.
Whimpering!! So they’re all family!
Roar!! Scythia is awesome, truly amazing.
At this moment, all the giant beasts were taken aback, looking at the silver dragon hovering in the sky and the terrifying mythological beast on the ground.
Even Leiyan Tianlong hadn’t expected this outcome, that the Beast King named Balon was actually a subordinate of the Silver Dragon’s mother.
And with the title of Titan King, it was clearly a mythical Titan Giant Beast comparable to a human Heavenly King.
No wonder the Scale of Laws in the hands of the Silver Giant Dragon was so powerful, casually destroying the projected avatar of the Black Oblivion King’s will.
Just then, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, hovering not far away, suddenly roared: “Roar! Misss Joseline’s name sounds nice!”
… ? ?
Two question marks appeared in the Black Colossus’s eyes below; what did it being a subordinate of the Silver Dragon’s mother have to do with Misss Joseline’s name?
And who is Misss Joseline?
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a deep, powerful roar: “Roar! Since we’re all family, we don’t need to be so formal.”
As it spoke, dazzling black lightning erupted on Leiyan Tianlong’s body, and a golden glow emanated from the spaces between its scales.
Boom! The Supreme Destruction and the Upper position Vajra rule powers completely erupted, causing the entire world to tremble under the terrifying aura. The dark clouds in the sky suddenly dispersed, and the air swirled.
Roar roar roar!! Surrounded by the Laws, Leiyan Tianlong let out a series of fierce and majestic roars to the sky.
With the four mythical giant beasts dominating the world channels being suppressed, there were hardly any forces in the vast ocean that could compete with the Dragon Palace.
By now, Leiyan Tianlong could declare the Dragon Palace’s supreme hegemony in the sea.
And as Leiyan Tianlong roared, a small purple dragon, about a meter-long, clung to its huge horns, opening its mouth wide and happily roaring along.
Yiyaya!!
“Roar! The great Scythia is invincible, Scythia is the Ocean Overlord, roar roar roar.” The Silver Giant Dragon excitedly circled around Leiyan Tianlong, letting out high-pitched roars.
Including the airborne Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Nine-headed Flood Dragon, Red Candle Dragon, and the beasts that emerged back to the surface, they all roared excitedly, shaking the heavens.
After about ten minutes or so, the roaring in the world gradually subsided.
After venting their emotions, it was time to leave.
Channel 3 was blocked by an ancient creature. Although Leiyan Tianlong had learned the Sea Illusion Demon Skill, it hadn’t had time to collect the other life auras needed for cultivation.
Besides, even if it did successfully cultivate the Sea Illusion Demon Skill, it didn’t plan to go through Channel 3. What if that ancient creature was waiting with its mouth open on the other side?
And Channel Four was too small and Channel Two had collapsed, so even without the invitation of the Mythical Titan Giant Beast, it would choose to go through Channel One next.

chapters.title: Chapter 857: 368: Sweeping the Globe, The Targeted Number One Machine
chapters.content:
Chapter 857: Chapter 368: Sweeping the Globe, The Targeted Number One Machine
Deep in the ocean, a world of water and fire.
Inside the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace Hall, which had reassembled after being destroyed by Leiyan Tianlong’s claw and stood a kilometer high and over two thousand meters wide, the Silver Giant Dragon lay on the highest ice seat.
Next to the Silver Giant Dragon was a black and red beast of similar height but even more massive and imposing.
The ice platform extended to both sides, centering on the two dragon kings, upon which lay the Candle Dragon, Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, Floating Unicorn Tiger Kun, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Underneath the hall, the waters churned with over two hundred mutated whale sharks and sea turtles led by the female Whale Shark Kitty Jones and the Blue Giant Crab, all respectfully floating on the surface.
These creatures were all enormously large, their gathering an awe-inspiring sight.
...
The fierce black and red beast slightly turned its head and let out a trembling growl, “Scythia, do you have any plans for Dragon Palace’s future?”
A trace of confusion flickered in the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes before it solemnly growled, “Roar! The great Scythia has some thoughts, but Tim Abott, you go ahead and say your plans first. The great Scythia will add to them afterward.”
Leiyan Tianlong looked at the Silver Giant Dragon with a strange expression, as this fellow seemed to have become a bit smarter recently. It actually knew to let him speak first and then add his own thoughts afterward.
With a stern gaze in its golden vertical pupils, Leiyan Tianlong slowly swept over all the giant beasts below before growling.
“The mythical world is full of dangers. I plan to take Candle Dragon and Floating Unicorn Tiger Kun with me first to establish a foothold and secure new territory. Then the others can join us.”
“Although we’ve defeated the four god-level beast empires, it doesn’t mean there aren’t any other rank-nine beasts in the deep sea.”
“Therefore, in the next few days, Candle Dragon, Ghidorah, and Scythia, you will each set off in three different directions, sweeping through the other five smaller sea regions.”
“All rank-nine and above beasts must either submit or be driven into the mythical world. Those who resist shall be slain on the spot.”
“During the journey, eliminate all rank-seven and above beasts that have reached the peak of their respective ranks. I need more Life Crystals to continue comprehending my abilities and purifying my bloodline.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly, “Roar! Tim Abott, don’t worry, the great Scythia will definitely kill all the beasts he encounters. The great Scythia loves nothing more than rivers of blood.”
Although this fellow appeared shiny silver and gorgeous in form, it actually remained a ferocious dragon creature. The talk of rivers of blood was not just a joke.
Leiyan Tianlong continued to growl.
“After we leave, Ghidorah and Telsafi will suppress the Dragon Palace with Kitty Jones in charge of commanding the army. You are allowed to continue expanding the mutant beast army.”
“However, the Dragon Palace’s creatures are only allowed to be active in the deep sea area, three hundred kilometers away from the coast, and must not harass human fishing boats and warships.”
“By the way, when the time comes, establish an independent mutant beast army to be led by the Floating Unicorn Tiger Kun.”
“Furthermore, the resources produced from those ocean resource points will be distributed by Telsafi and Ghidorah, with Kitty Jones responsible for-management.”
“Aside from routine patrols in the sea territories, Kitty Jones, you must continue to lead the army in collecting Life Crystals for me. I will find a way to retrieve them later.”
Meow! Meow! Meow! Yes, my king.
The female whale in the waters below respectfully nodded.
Leiyan Tianlong looked at the giant beasts below, “All of you must remember to cultivate diligently. When the time comes for me to take you to the mythical world, you must all be rank-nine or above.”
“This is because only when you reach rank-nine can you fly.”
“This includes both Floating Unicorn and Telsafi, who has also nearly solidified your rank-nine breakthroughs. Eat those two Black Melting God Fruits and enhance your strength as soon as possible.”
As soon as Leiyan Tianlong finished speaking, the purple dragon lying on his head waved its right claw at the Floating Unicorn Tiger Kun and the others, exuding an imposing, triumphant air: Yiiiiyyyyyiiiii!
This time, when entering the mythical world, Leiyan Tianlong naturally would not bring all of his giant beast subordinates along.
As everything there was unfamiliar, those without mythical-level combat power wouldn’t be of much help and might become a burden instead.
Thus, he only brought the Candle Dragon and Floating Unicorn Tiger Kun with him.
The former was powerful, while the latter’s unique unicorn treasure-seeking ability would play a crucial role in the mythical world.
After entering the mythical world, Leiyan Tianlong would need even more energy to grow. It was not realistic to rely solely on eating mythical-level beasts since this level of lifeform was also scarce in the mythical world.
So, its next objective was god-level heaven-and-earth treasures that contained abundant energy, including energy-rich crystal mines.
After evolving its bloodline and increasing its rank in multiple instances, the Floating Unicorn Tiger Kun’s unicorn treasure-seeking ability had become even more powerful, capable of sensing high-energy reactions within a certain range and even detecting valuable objects by filtering the air.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon straightened itself, a solemn look in its eyes as it let out a domineering roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, now that you’ve finished speaking, it’s time for the great Scythia to summarize.”
“When we return, the great Scythia will show off… Uh, I mean, share feelings and experiences with Telsafi before beginning our journey to conquer the Vast World.”
“Our goal is to make the Dragon Palace the overlord of the Vast World, defeating all beasts and civilizations so that they all submit to the great Scythia.”
“Roar! Alright, the great Scythia’s summary is over.” After finishing speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon proudly raised its tail.
As expected of the great Scythia, only it could have such grand aspirations.
However, as the Silver Giant Dragon proudly raised its tail, the surrounding giant beasts all revealed strange looks in their eyes, as if they were watching a fool.

chapters.title: Chapter 858: 368: Sweeping the Globe, Number One Under Scrutiny_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 858: Chapter 368: Sweeping the Globe, Number One Under Scrutiny_2
“`
Ruling over a world filled with mythical creatures?
“Roar! Scythia, there is no rush to dominate the mythical world. We’ll discuss it later,” the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, regarding the Silver Giant Dragon’s goal… felt it was okay, not entirely without hope.
“All right, meeting adjourned, I’m off to undertake closed-door cultivation.”
Boom! As the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon got up, the entire palace trembled slightly.
Before entering the mythical world, there were many things the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon needed to prepare, the most important being the Sea Illusion Demon Skill.
...
Otherwise, once it continued its Deification and completely reached the ‘Heavenly Tier’ in its life phase, its erupting aura during battle would surely attract the gaze of countless Giant Beasts.
By then, it won’t just be those ancient beings eying it, but also those who have reached the peak of the Ancient Titan and are on the verge of embodying the Rule itself.
It certainly did not wish to witness a scene where it was being hunted by countless Supreme Level beings.
Compared to it, the Purple little dragon had no such concerns.
Being innately divine, it had a hidden aura. Apart from the life force it exuded when it just hatched, it didn’t even possess the Monarch-level presence at this moment.
In contemplation, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon stepped heavily as it moved to the rear of the Water and Fire World.
The volcano had already collapsed during its last breakthrough, fusing with the surrounding Lava Lake to form an even larger volcano mouth.
Bang! Just as the Black-red Colossal Beast stirred up the sky-high magma and plunged into the volcano mouth, Jack Clark within the heart of the forbidden world opened his eyes again.
“Consume 1,000 attribute points to initiate the Flame Thunder Avatar into an epiphany state.”
Since the Attribute Panel was located in the main body, even though the main body and the Giant Beast Avatar shared one consciousness and moved in unison, it still required commands from Jack Clark’s side to react.
As the voice of Jack Clark’s intent fell, the remaining 1,431 Points Attribute on the attribute page instantly dropped to 431.
At the same time, the energy transformed from the Attribute points passed through the Soul Channel, turning into Epiphanic Intent Realm that enshrouded the Giant Beast deep in the magma.
It didn’t take long for the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon to fall into an epiphany state, rapidly cultivating the Sea Illusion Demon Skill, using the Purple little dragon as a reference to simulate its obscure aura and fell into hibernation.
Squeak squeak!!
The Purple little dragon on top of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s head showed curiosity in its eyes, subconsciously reaching out with its little claw to touch its surroundings, but this time it touched nothing.
The Purple little dragon looked around and finally, out of boredom, continued gnawing on the remaining eggshells.
As it consumed the eggshells containing special patterns, a terrifying aura fleetingly crossed the little dragon’s body, which also underwent a slight change in size.
…
In the midst of dark void space, thrones stood tall with six vague figures seated atop them. Solid black demonic qi churned around them, exuding a heavy and terrifying aura.
At this moment, a voice that shook the space slowly rose: “Tarotkar, half a Sun Wheel has passed, have you found detailed information about Augusta’s fall?”
From the third throne on the left where demonic qi swirled, a chilling voice responded: “It can be confirmed that they were ambushed.”
“Half a Sun Wheel ago, the office point in charge reported back a message from Makatoto, stating they had spotted Darren’s whereabouts on the edge of the Human army’s encampment.”
“`
“The message was sent by a traitor of the Human Race, who once passed on information that allowed Karto to assassinate a genius squad of humans.”
“For that reason, Devianna chose to believe the message but still cautiously brought Augusta along, ready to suppress Darren Callum with overwhelming force.”
“Unexpectedly, they were still ambushed by the cunning humans.”
“According to the re-established secret lines there, six Mythical-level power fluctuations appeared in the direction of the Sky Ripple Crystal Mine at that time.”
“Besides Devianna and his ilk, the Human Race deployed four king-level beings to participate in the encirclement and kill, and at least all were Mid-Mythical Stage or above.”
“Otherwise, with the Dark Laws of the Void mastered by Devianna and Augusta’s Demon God bloodline, even if they were to escape heavily injured, four Human Kings couldn’t retain them.”
After the demon king from Tarokar finished speaking, a deep voice came from the opposite side, “But currently, all the known kings of the Human Race are under our clan’s surveillance, so how come the military’s Intelligence Department had no reaction when four kings were mobilized?”
Tarokar’s voice was cold, “That’s why I said they were ambushed.”
“Among the four Human Kings mobilized this time, one was the Sky-splitting Golden Sword of the Seventh Corps and another was the Knife King Joel Moore from the 30th Army Group of the Human Race, and the remaining two should be from within the Blue Star itself.”
“It is only the kings within the Blue Star World that our clan cannot monitor, especially after those underlings in the Demon God Sect were removed.”
On the throne, Great Demon King Barus slowly said, “That Darren Callum must have already entered the mythical world and appeared at the Outer Development Department’s side, using him as bait to lure Devianna and the others there.”
“Otherwise, with the caution of Devianna, he would not have been deceived, including that Human Race traitor, who must have been a bait laid down long ago.”
Suddenly, the Void shook, and a demon king’s voice was ferocious, “Indeed, the treacherous Human Race, actually willing to use a genius with the Great Demon King Talent as bait.”
“Even before this, to gain Karto’s trust, they deliberately sacrificed several ‘geniuses,’ just for this opportunity to lure Devianna and the others into the trap.”
For a moment, all these demon kings were shocked by the ruthlessness of the Human Race, feeling that these humans are the true demons—cold-blooded, cruel, sinister, and cunning.
In a brief silence, Barus’s voice was cold, “Tarokar, find a way to clear up Darren’s movements, and also notify the Evil God Alliance, it’s time for them to contribute.”
“Next, we will shift our focus to the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield. A new type of Biological Mecha weapon has appeared on the battlefield there, with combat power reaching the Demon King level, and it can devour life, flesh, blood, and souls to grow.”
“Our task is to find a way to control the driver of that Biological Mecha, have her bring the Mecha out of the Human Base, or destroy it.”
“Otherwise, once the Human Race can mass-produce this type of Biological Weapon, it will be very troublesome.”
“The higher-ups have only given us a Sun Wheel’s time, if we have not succeeded by the dawn of the next Sun Wheel, the task will be taken over by the demon kings of the empire.”
“They already have a detailed plan and are ready to trigger a more extensive Civilization War to lure the Biological Weapon out of the base.”
“At that time, allied with the demon king powerhouses from the rear, and even Lewus Demon God himself will take action personally to completely destroy that Biological Weapon.”
“However, this plan might cause significant losses, so it’s temporarily suppressed, handled by our Assassination Department.”
While the Purgatory Demon Race was devising new plans against Jack Clark and the famously emerged Number One from the Frontline Battlefield.
July 22nd, Eastern Summer, South City.
Below the center of the research base, the white walls of the laboratory were flickering with countless runes, maintaining a ritual that had been running quietly for nearly two months.
Just then, in the center of a burial ground floating deep in the void, the surface of a Reincarnation Cabin that had been silent for nearly two months suddenly burst into bright light.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 369: The Unity of Man and Dragon, Expedition to the Mythical World
chapters.content:
Chapter 859: Chapter 369: The Unity of Man and Dragon, Expedition to the Mythical World
Boom!
Along with the explosion of the Reincarnation Cabin, a figure emerged, surrounded by white Divine Light and exuding a powerful aura.
In an instant, it was as though the light from the runes of an altar ceremony brightened dramatically, with countless rune powers converging to form a white pathway linking the Void Burial Ground and the research lab.
“Miss Joseline, we succeeded!”
Inside the lab, Crystal Boyce, who had been keeping watch, revealed a look of surprise and excitement. Her eyes reddened as she watched that figure step onto the white pathway.
...
After over a decade of planning by the Mysterious Martial Sky King, along with some unforeseen factors, the girl finally underwent a phoenix-like rebirth amidst fire and ashes.
In Crystal Boyce’s excited gaze, the figure treaded through the void, with each step flashing at a seemingly slow yet actually astonishing speed, approaching the real world.
And as she fully stepped out of the void and her feet touched the ground, the entire research lab trembled slightly. A terrifying presence spread out immediately after.
Under that dreadful pressure, the solid and mighty research facility cracked open with fissures, while Crystal Boyce, a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator, felt a heavy weight on her, unable to stand.
However, this terrifying pressure was fleeting and was quickly retracted by the figure. As the surrounding white Divine Light dissipated, Mathilda Ward’s figure emerged.
At that moment, the girl’s long hair had turned silvery white, and nestled amongst it were a pair of crystal-clear white dragon horns, while her dignified and beautiful face remained flawless.
On the backs of her hands and neck where they were exposed, faint white Dragon Scales could be seen; standing there, she seemed like a dragon maiden who had stepped out of myth and legend, noble and majestic.
Crystal Boyce asked with some excitement, “Ilisa, how do you feel now?”
The silver-haired girl smiled tenderly, “Aunt Boyce, I feel very good now. Not only has my soul been made whole, but my cultivation has also reached the predicted Nine-fold Peak.”
Indeed, Mathilda Ward had now become an expert akin to being at the peak quasi-mythical level.
With her soul fused with a complete ‘Dragon’ Law, her soul transformation had been completed.
Her body, too, had absorbed many Top-Level Divine Resources during the Reincarnation Ceremony and had undergone a physical rebirth, with a strength comparable to a Ninth Heaven Expert, also possessing the attributes of a dragon.
The Origin Substance of the purple little dragon given by Jack especially had greatly enhanced her life potential and the level of her dragonhood, which was why she now possessed such formidable power.
In essence, Mathilda Ward could be considered a perfect humanoid-dragon being.
She was truly a dragon by nature but also maintained a human form.
Of course, she had only reached the Nine-fold Peak in level and realm; she still needed to consolidate her cultivation and become familiar with her newly acquired dragon powers.
Besides, Ilisa’s path could not be replicated.
Her soul had been innately incomplete, ultimately exhausting to the limit, coupled with a similarly exhausted to the limit Dragon Series Law Origin.
Moreover, it took resources capable of rapidly advancing a talented genius to the Ninth Heavens, or even quasi-mythical level, to create her current state.
While Ilisa was waking up, Jack was still in Closed-door Cultivation, in hibernation.
As he continuously absorbed and transformed, transitioning towards an Innate Demon God, the surrounding Mysterious Yellow Air around Jack became increasingly scarce, while the aura on him grew more and more ferocious.
Under that dreadful pressure, the surrounding Void itself trembled slightly, as if an Ancient God Demon was being nurtured within.
Meanwhile, in the Blue Star World, the Dragon Palace continued to unify the oceanic powers relentlessly.
In the face of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, all at the high-end combat power of Late Stage 9, the Giant Beasts of other sea areas simply couldn’t stand against them.
The Three-headed Giant Beasts swept through the remaining sea areas, separating into three directions. Just their release of Level 9 presence as they charged through was enough to provoke other Level 9 Giant Beasts to emerge.
Then these Level 9 Giant Beasts were either blasted to pieces, subjugated, or driven out of Blue Star.
Facing the actions of the Dragon Palace, the alliance simply watched in silence.
That’s because the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon had already sent its representative, Tiger Three, to communicate with the Human Race Naval Base, informing humans that once the Dragon Palace had unified the deep sea area, all mid- to high-end Level 9 Giant Beasts would leave.
The vast ocean would then only have a few Level 9 mid-tier or lower Giant Beasts of the Dragon Palace left.
Additionally, with the slaying of some Level 7 and Peak of the eighth level Giant Beasts this time, it could be said that the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon has nearly ‘slashed’ the levels of the oceanic ecosystem.
All Mythical Giant Beasts had been killed off or promised not to step into Blue Star again, all Level 9 Giant Beasts were either driven away or slain, and the remaining Level 7 and 8 Giant Beasts had also been swept clean.
This situation had instead stabilized the oceanic powers, ensuring that no powerful Giant Beasts would attack the coasts, at least in the short term.
This outcome was beyond everyone’s expectations.
July 27th.
In the Water and Fire World, beneath several thousand meters of volcanic magma, the Black-red Colossal Beast slowly opened its eyes, revealing a pair of golden vertical pupils filled with a terrifying pressure and the intent of destruction.
By then, its aura had completed the transformation and became somewhat similar to the purple little dragon’s; subtle and faint, exuding the majesty of a Monarch at or around the quasi-mythical level.
Yiyaya!? Sensing the changes in the aura of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, the Purple little dragon blinked its watery, large eyes curiously, looking somewhat puzzled.
At the same time, it felt an even closer connection to the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon now, with the sensation that they were indeed siblings, sharing an identical aura.
Boom! The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon slowly rose, causing the entire volcano to tremble at once.
It was time to leave.
Behind the Water and Fire World, the center of a Lava Lake spanning several kilometers in radius began to expand rapidly. The scorching dark red magma rose like a Tsunami.
Boom!
With a sky-fillling explosion of magma, a terrifying Giant Beast measuring over five hundred meters long emerged, with hot magma flowing down through the fissures in its scale armor, forming a series of flame waterfalls.

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 369: Human-Dragon Unity, Expedition to the Mythical World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 860: Chapter 369: Human-Dragon Unity, Expedition to the Mythical World_2
On top of the ferocious and gigantic dragon head, a two-meter-long purple dragon clung to a stout spiral horn, its right claw pointing forward and yelling.
Yi ya yi ya!!
Leiyan Tianlong was speechless, slightly opening its mouth, spraying out scorching waves, and letting out a rumbling roar: “Annihilate you? This is our own palace!”
The purple dragon had meant ‘Brother, rush and destroy everything ahead.’
The little fellow seemed to have a tendency to destroy and attack, possibly due to experiencing ‘a great battle’ right after hatching.
It seemed that they needed to correct its thoughts later, educate it, and make it a well-behaved city dragon (citizen), not wanting to fight all day long.
...
With heavy footsteps causing the ground to shake, Leiyan Tianlong walked towards the Dragon Palace in the midst of raging gales. Then, from a distance, they saw a group of giant creatures gathered by the sea.
There, a hundred-meter-long, late eighth-stage Blue Giant Crab waved its massive claws, busily carving a boulder it had carried from outside.
The statue, a dragon-shaped one over three hundred meters tall and eight hundred meters long, stood beside the Candle Dragon, a gigantic red creature laying quietly, completely still.
In the seawater behind the Blue Giant Crab, a group of giant creatures was watching, such as the unicornered fish, who was waving its fins, stirring up gales of wind and airwaves as it called out.
Ying ying ying!! Crab General, I think that claw could be bigger, so it looks more formidable.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also poked out its head, swaying and saying: Roar!! I think so too, and the tail isn’t long enough, it doesn’t show off Candle Dragon’s full length.
After several days, the two giant creatures had grown to over 220 meters after digesting two Black Melting Divine Fruits, reaching the mid-ninth stage.
However, unlike Leiyan Tianlong, who could perfectly absorb and transform energy, their breakthroughs were aided by resources, so while they reached the mid-ninth stage, they still felt somewhat unstable and shallow in presence.
Gurgle gurgle!! Should I make it bigger then? The Blue Giant Crab was a little hesitant.
The nine dragon heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon nearby swayed, nodding and letting out a chaotic roar: “Roar roar roar!! Bigger, longer, like this, it’ll look good.”
Gurgle gurgle!! Okay, I’ll make it bigger. Seeing everyone saying so, the Blue Giant Crab instantly nodded in response.
Crack, crack!!
Underneath the massive sharp claws, the already huge dragon claw was erased entirely and smoothly, the whole body carving went into the inner part of the stone, the speed was very fast.
As countless pieces of gravel fell, the huge claw grew even larger.
By the time Leiyan Tianlong arrived amidst the raging wind, the Blue Giant Crab had already finished its carving, and all the giant creatures enthusiastically shouted.
Ying ying ying!! Leiyan, you’re out! Look at the statue that the Crab General carved for Candle Dragon, it looks so mighty.
Roar!! Yeah, I didn’t expect Crab General to have this kind of skill, later on, we should have one in Domination too, and put it at the entrance of the Dragon Palace so that other giant creatures can worship it every day.
Leiyan Tianlong couldn’t help but twitch at the corners of its mouth.
Because the statue was too abstract.
The tail, which occupied most of the body, was wildly coiled around the back, making three knots. Two rear-facing dragon claws were bent backward, while one had no legs, only claws attached to the body.
The front two dragon claws were very different; one was very small, while the other was almost twice the size of the head. The big and small claws seemed to make the larger dragon claw look even bigger and more powerful.
As for the head of the Candle Dragon, it was carved so horrendously that its mouth appeared torn to its ears, and the eyes seemed popped out; if nobody told you, you’d think its eyeballs grew on the outside.
Overall, it seemed like an attempt to make the giant creature Candle Dragon look more fierce and vicious, but what the hell was up with the abstract aesthetics?
Luckily, Leiyan Tianlong had sternly refused to let the creature carve another statue for it, feeling very relieved.
At this moment, the excited Blue Giant Crab looked at the Candle Dragon on the side, bubbling: Gurgle gurgle!! Lord Candle Dragon, your statue is finished. What do you think?
After lying in its pose for half the day, the Candle Dragon slowly moved, looked at the statue, and nodded approvingly, letting out a satisfied roar: “Roar! Alright, it looks good.”
The unicornered fish also kept nodding: Ying ying ying!! I think it’s very formidable too.
Roar roar roar!! Super cool, Kidora wants one too.
Gurgle gurgle!! No problem, King Kidora. I’ll go and get a small mountain later.
… Leiyan Tianlong felt even more speechless.
At this moment, it almost doubted whether its aesthetics was off or if these giant creatures simply had strange taste.
Leiyan Tianlong shook its head and roared: “Roar! Candle Dragon, Great Horn, get ready to leave tomorrow. Oh right, where is Scythia?”
At this point, Leiyan Tianlong realized that they hadn’t seen the figure of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Ying ying ying!! Scythia went to declare its territory.
Declare territory? Leiyan Tianlong was stunned. What else was there to declare now?
At this time, on the sea surface, a silver giant dragon with wings spanning over five hundred meters flew at subsonic speeds, surrounded by a blue storm, soaring in the high altitude, and letting out majestic roars.
“Roar roar!! The great Scythia is the king of the Dragon Palace, the lord of the ocean.”
“Rejoice! You mere mundane creatures, rejoice that you can experience the noble breath of the great Scythia…”
Under the terrifying pressure of the top king, countless ordinary mutated fish on the sea surface desperately tried to escape, all along the flight path of the Silver Giant Dragon, extending thousands of miles.
Seeing the boiling scene on the sea surface below, the Silver Giant Dragon became even more excited, issuing even more majestic roars.

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 369: The Unity of Man and Dragon, Expedition to the Mythical World_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 861: Chapter 369: The Unity of Man and Dragon, Expedition to the Mythical World_3
“Roar! Domination, go call Scythia back.”
RoarRoar!! Okay, Thunderflame.
After the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle had left, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon approached the edge of the magma lake at the rear, where a black gold skeleton more than a thousand meters long was lying across.
As a skeletal remnant of a Mythical Giant Beast, the black gold skeleton spanning a kilometer was incredibly heavy and also a precious source of divine-grade materials, previously transported back by the Candle Dragon.
Huff! The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon took a deep breath, and instantly a raging wind howled, followed by the converging of a dazzling light in its mouth.
After breaking through to Mythical-level, Annihilation True Thunder and Heaven Burning Golden Flame, though not evolved into rules, became even more powerful when fused together because their foundation had become stronger.
...
Boom! Golden blue flames burst forth, enveloping the skeleton and scales, the intense energy of the flames incinerating space itself, creating a pitch-black chaos realm.
Suddenly, the temperature in the entire Water and Fire World soared; the distant sea water boiled, countless steam columns rose to the sky, forming billowing mists and towering smoke plumes.
Under the might of the golden blue flames, stronger even than ordinary rules, the black gold skeleton slowly melted away. This burning lasted a day, while a horde of Giant Beasts watched in reverence.
The skeleton, over a thousand meters long, was eventually reduced to a hundred-meter-long black gold substance.
Atop the black gold substance, which appeared jade-like, burned purple Hellfire, radiant like glaze and emitting terrifying surges of rule energy.
By then, the entire Water and Fire Mini World had turned into a sea of fire. The Ice Crystal Palace dissolved, vast amounts of materials were vaporized by the flames comparable to rules, magma churned, and sizzled as it met sea water.
Around the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, even space distorted under the high temperature, and the Silver Giant Dragon, long since returned, circled overhead.
At that moment, the flames in the mouth of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon disappeared, and looking at the fiery golden magma around him, it raised its head and roared, “Scythia, a breath to extinguish the flames.”
“Roar! Leave it to the Great Scythia.”
Roar!
As the roar echoed between Heaven and Earth, a white column of air descended from the sky, rapidly freezing the land below; soon, half of the ‘world’ with its boiling magma was encased in ice.
In the midst of the icy world, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon stretched out its vast double claws and with a thunderous sound, grabbed the extremely heavy essence of the Mythical Giant Beast and stored it in its Storage Space.
This material was precious for Jack Clark to strengthen the Fourfold World.
Crash! The ice crystal ground shattered, the Silver Giant Dragon landed beside the Black-red Colossal Beast, and roared in inquiry, “Roar! Tim Abott, do we set out now?”
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon nodded slightly, “It’s about time to go.”
Having unified the ocean and transformed the life essence, and also having refined and stored the essences of several Level 9 Giant Beast Skeletons and Mythical Giant Beast essences into the Storage Space.
By now, he had handled all the matters that needed to be addressed in the vast Blue Star World.
With this thought, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon looked at the now-erased Dragon Palace Ice Palace.
“Roar! The original Ice Palace was too small to accommodate our entrance and exit; tearing it down just now was perfect. Later on, I will trouble you, Kidora, to rebuild it according to a tenfold scale.”
“RoarRoarRoar!! No problem, Abbott, Kido, Ra, I am the best at building,” Kidora nodded excitedly, not the least bit troubled.
Although a palace on a tenfold scale might take a long time to build, it was a task Abbott had entrusted to it.
As he spoke, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s gaze swept over the Blue Giant Crab, then suddenly he roared, “Crab General, keep an eye out for any mutated Giant Crabs above Level 7 in the sea.”
“If there are any, you can subdue one to join the Dragon Palace and assemble a shrimp soldiers and crab generals team with you to patrol the Dragon Palace’s sea territory.”
Instantly, the eyes of the Blue Giant Crab lit up, and it quickly bubbled excitedly.
GurgleGurgle!! Yes, Great King, I will definitely catch a shrimp class Giant Beast and bring it back.
WhooWhoo!! The Great King finally remembered him; he was no longer just a door watcher; Crab General could now lead a mighty army of Unique Beasts, he was so crab-excited.
No, after the king leaves, he must carve a magnificent statue in honor of the king to show his reverence.
Feeling that everything was mostly arranged, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon let out a roar.
“Roar! Depart, expedition to the Vast World.”
“Roar! Charge, Tim Abott, the Great Sethia aims to become the Overlord of the Vast World.”
Under the watchful eyes of all the Giant Beasts, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, with the Purple little dragon, Silver Giant Dragon, Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, and Candle Dragon Giant Beast atop its head, soared into the sky.
BoomBoomBoom!! The sea surface exploded with water, as the four Giant Beasts, with body lengths of over five hundred meters, three hundred meters, and two hundred meters respectively, shot into the heavens.
In the midst of sonic booms, the four Giant Beasts quickly reached the airspace above Channel One.
“Roar! Let’s go.”
In the midst of roaring, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon charged into the blue vortex, and instantly the pathway vibrated wildly, the terrifying presence seemingly not fitting for an early Mythical Giant Beast entering.

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 370: The Holy Son, the Mythical Titan’s Peak Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 862: Chapter 370: The Holy Son, the Mythical Titan’s Peak Beast
In the mythical world, the setting red sun emits scorching rays, causing all creatures to instinctively feel a bit irritable under its glare.
Roar!
In the grassland several meters high, two Level 7 Colossuses, both over forty meters long and over twenty meters tall, are roaring, fighting, and competing for mating rights.
Not far away, dozens of mammoth-like giant creatures, covered in gray scales, are leisurely grazing on the grass.
Akilometers away, a hundred meters wide ‘small river’ meanders. On the riverbanks, a six-hundred-meter-high blue vortex spins, stirring the heavens and the earth.
After notifying the Silver Giant Dragon to return home, the black giant beast left the area.
...
Otherwise, with its terrifying pressure in the late stage fantasy creature, there wouldn’t be a single large mythical creature daring to approach within a radius of several dozen kilometers.
Boom!
In the distance, the blue vortex shakes violently. A hideous black and red giant beast emerges from the vortex, instantly filling the air with a tyrannical and terrifying aura.
The ‘hill’ under its feet shakes, cracks, and the surrounding air is blasted by the pervasive power emanating from the giant beast, generating concentric circles of white energy that sweep across the vicinity.
The rolling energy waves make the branches and leaves within several kilometers sway wildly, while the shrubs and grass are forced to bow. It’s an awe-inspiring scene.
Sitting on the top of the Leiyan Tianlong, a two-meter-long purple dragon looks around at the unfamiliar environment and the enriching energy, appears somewhat excited, and points its claw towards the Level 7 Colossuses on the other side of the river.
Gurgling sounds!!
The Leiyan Tianlong roars slowly: “Those colossuses don’t even reach the peak level, it’s a waste of time, let’s leave them.”
This little fellow has a somewhat severe aggressive tendency. As soon as it arrives, it calls on Leiyan Tianlong to kill the grazing colossuses on the other side of the river. Too brutal.
At this point, the vortex behind vibrates, and the Silver Giant Dragon rushes out. With a flap of its wings, it soars into the high sky and lets out an exhilarating dragon chant: “Roar, the Great Scythia is back!”
Roaring, a white light gathers in the Silver Giant Dragon’s mouth.
Boom!
A white ice flame descends from the sky, landing on the rushing ‘small river’. A terrifying chill instantly explodes, freezing the hundred-meter-wide river in the blink of an eye.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Under the sweeping breath of the Silver Giant Dragon, which is like a bomber, the river’s ice crystals explode and the violent white frost freezes everything around.
Even the mammoth colossuses on the opposite side who are were grazing and vying for mating rights let out terrified roars and are instantly frozen. Immediately after, their bodies shatter and explode when the dragon’s breath sweeps over them.
Gurgling sounds!!
Watching this scene, the Purple dragon suddenly lets out an excited call and ‘whoosh’, it turns into a purple light, appearing next to the Silver Giant Dragon in the high sky.
Gurgling sounds! Yayayaya!!
The Purple dragon is excitedly calling out, pointing its paw at the lush forest in the distance.
The Silver Giant Dragon, seeming a bit confused, lowers its head and asks: “Roar! Tim Abott, what is Misss Joseline saying?”
Leiyan Tianlong slowly roars: “She’s asking you to freeze and destroy that forest as well.”
… The Silver Giant Dragon looks at the broad, lush forest ahead, filled with hundreds of meters tall giant trees, blinks: “Roar! Misss Joseline, Great Scythia has a bit of a stomachache today, I won’t be spewing anymore.”
While the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, a Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and Red Candle Dragon also passed through the passageway, curiously looking around the mythical world.
Whining noises!! Is this the vast world? There’s so much energy, I feel like I can’t eat it all.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish seems a bit excited.
The Red Candle Dragon next to it also slowly roars, somewhat excitedly: “Roar! Eating, can’t, finish.”
Leiyan Tianlong raises its head and roars: “Scythia, lead the way. After meeting your mother, we’ll go and claim some new territory.”
This time, Leiyan Tianlong agreed to follow the Silver Giant Dragon to meet its mother, mainly to familiarize itself with the surrounding environment and find suitable places for expansion.
As for this region, forget about it.
A mythical titan, and presumably not the ordinary kind that just broke through, with its current strength it’s still not a match for this kind of creature.
Moreover, the creature is Scythia’s mother. It would be rather inappropriate to seize her territory, so it’s better to consider the surrounding areas instead.
Anyway, the mythical world is boundless. It doesn’t lack a few dozen square kilometers of territory.
At this time, Leiyan Tianlong suddenly remembers something and roars again: “Scythia, where are the high-level gems you’ve collected?”
During its slumber, the three giant beasts each led teams to sweep through several ocean territories. Although they did not specifically hunt those level 7 and 8 peak giant beasts, they still managed to acquire some high-level life crystals.
But when they came back a few days ago and found Leiyan Tianlong still asleep under the magma of the volcano, they handed the crystals over to Scythia for safekeeping, as it was the only one with storage space.
The Silver Giant Dragon in the sky blinks, letting out a high-pitched dragon chant: “Roar! Tim Abott, your crystals will be kept for now with Great Scythia. I’ll give them to you when you need them.”
“Roar! I must return home, the Great Scythia wants to show off to Telsafi, the Great Scythia is now a level 9 mid-stage giant beast.”
… This guy.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The three giant beasts rise into the sky, chasing after the Silver Giant Dragon, flying toward the horizon.
However, compared with the Silver Giant Dragon, which has the natural ability to fly, the speed of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which commands its domain for flight, is only at the speed of sound.
In the sky tens of thousands of meters high, where the clouds are dense and the wind howls, the Silver Giant Dragon, over two hundred and forty meters in length with wings almost five hundred meters long, flutters its wings while roaring softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 370 The Holy Son, Mythical Titan Peak Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 863: Chapter 370 The Holy Son, Mythical Titan Peak Beast_2
“We have to go through the Balon Beast King’s territory to get back. Given Joe’s speed, it will take about half a day’s flight in the Blue Star World.”
“After entering my mother’s territory, we will traverse a boundless range of mountain ranges, then fly past the Kaleb Clan Royal City. It should take about two days in total to reach the Icebound Mountain Range.”
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon nodded thoughtfully.
Based on the sound-speed flight of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the diameter of the Balon Beast King’s territory already exceeded 10,000 kilometers, and the territory of Scythia’s mother was even larger.
Simply crossing the radius of the territory, which took two days of flight, meant that the diameter of the territory exceeded 100,000 kilometers.
Hiss! By such calculations, even the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but be astonished.
...
A territory with a diameter exceeding 100,000 kilometers, just the perimeter’s diameter was more than twice that of Blue Star. If translated, how many square kilometers would that be?
It is known that Blue Star, which fostered the Human Race, has a diameter of just over 12,000 kilometers and a surface circumference of over 40,000 kilometers.
Amid the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s amazement, the several Giant Beasts quickly crossed over 3,000 kilometers.
Through the journey, towering mountain peaks rose and fell, broad rivers surged through the dense forests, the rushing waters roared, and herds of immense creatures nestled, emitting desolate cries.
Whenever that happened, the Silver Giant Dragon would let out a lofty Dragon Roar, like a fighter jet diving down, emitting the pressure of a Mid Level 9 while flying at a low altitude of a kilometer.
This immediately caused the Giant Beasts below to flee in panic.
At such times, even the Purple little dragon would join in, standing on the head of the Silver Giant Dragon and emitting excited sounds, as cheerful as two children.
But they seemed to be indeed still children.
Suddenly, a mountain range with rich Heavenly Energy appeared ahead, and on a ‘small hill’ over 10,000 meters high, a Black Colossus over 1,000 meters long was coiled.
Accompanied by the inhale and exhale of the Black Colossus, the surrounding mountains also trembled slightly, inherently emitting a terrifying might.
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon folded its wings, penetrating the clouds and flying past: “Roar! Balon Beast King, the Great Scythia is returning.”
The Black Colossus, which had already sensed their Aura, lifted its head and nodded slightly, uttering a deep roar.
And as the Four Great Beasts flew overhead, the gaze of the Black Colossus fell on the Black-red Colossal Beast over 500 meters long, a hint of astonishment flashing in its eyes.
Because this little guy, who came from a world on the brink of collapse, was terrifying, having merged two Higher-order Laws right after a breakthrough to the Mythical-level, no wonder its combat power was so immense.
While the Black Colossus marveled at the power of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, the excited Single-horned Tiger Kingfish suddenly exclaimed: roar! Thunderflame, I’ve sensed something great, the really good kind.
“Roar! Where is it?”
The Colossus, entirely covered in ferocious black armor with fins like massive wings, pointed towards the left: roar! It’s over there, not too far.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up and drew close: “Roar! Joe, lead the way. The Great Scythia loves to pick up good things the most.”
At that moment, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon gave a weird look, thinking that it was only a few hundred kilometers away from the mountain peak where the Black Colossus settled. How could there be ‘wild’ God-level Resources there?
Roar! Follow me.
Under the excited lead of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Four Great Beasts soon arrived two hundred kilometers away.
Below, on Earth, three small hills thousands of meters tall stood, encircling a deep pool about one kilometer in diameter, with crystal clear waters in a triangular formation.
In the heart of the deep pool, three Golden Lotuses, two exceeding 2 meters and the other over 3 meters in diameter, blossomed, exuding a rich fragrance and a subtle Mysterious Aura.
Especially that invisible energy fluctuation, even at a distance of 10,000 meters, made all the Giant Beasts instinctively want to devour it.
Include the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon whose eyes gleamed because those two Golden Lotuses over 3 meters in diameter were Top-level Divine Items, consuming them would bring numerous benefits.
In the Human Federation, resource levels were divided into Ordinary Resources (suitable for First to Third Layer Heaven), Senior Resources (Fourth to Sixth-level Heaven), followed by Top-tier Resources suitable for High-level cultivators.
This division of resources included Heaven and Earth Treasures that enhanced cultivation, minerals or special materials that strengthened weapons and battle armor.
Above the Top-tier were God-level Resources, these Resources were entwined with a whiff of the Heavenly Earth Law Charm and contained astonishing energy, which is why they were referred to as God-level.
Similar to the Black Wind Crystal which Jack Clark had acquired before and the Mysterious Yellow Crystal Stone given to him by Mathilda Ward.
God-level Resources were further divided into Ordinary, Senior, and Top-tier based on the completeness of the Law Charm and energy strength. Above God-level Resources were Law Level items that even a Heavenly King would covet.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon gave a low warning growl: “These resources should be under the care of the Balon Beast King, which is why no Unique Beast dares to approach. We should just look and leave.”
It followed mainly to see how far the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish could sense good things.
However, while the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon was ready to leave, the Silver Giant Dragon seemed unconcerned: “Roar! No problem, the Balon Beast King is under my mother’s command, which means these good things are essentially hers, and therefore, they’re also the Great Scythia’s.”
That logic… can’t fault it.
“Roar! The Great Scythia and Tim Abbott will eat the biggest ones; the rest leaves one for each of you. Go for it.”
Cheering, the Silver Giant Dragon spiraled and dove down, its enormous body skimmed over the pool, and with its maw agape, it devoured the largest Golden Lotus along with tens of tons of lake water.
Boom! The Earth shook, and as the mud and debris crumbled, the Silver Giant Dragon landed contentedly at the edge of the pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 370 The Holy Son, Mythical Titan Peak Beast_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 864: Chapter 370 The Holy Son, Mythical Titan Peak Beast_3
“Roar! Then, feast.”
The Silver Giant Dragon didn’t care, so naturally, the Leiyan Tianlong didn’t either. Standing above the pool, its mouth slightly open, using a powerful suction to swallow the Golden Lotus.
Boom! The moment it swallowed the divine fruit, which had a diameter comparable to the five-meter Black Magma Godfruit, Leiyan Tianlong’s stomach exploded in a blistering heat, the energy washing through its entire body.
Its body, already unbelievably strong due to the law refinement, crackled as it expanded, visibly growing nearly 10 meters longer and considerably bulkier.
With a body length of 520 meters, the Leiyan Tianlong seemed even more savage and ferocious.
Mewling!!
...
The Purple dragon also happily flew over the pool, and then its adorable head suddenly swelled, turning into a monstrous purple dragon head with a diameter of 10 meters.
Bang! Under the astonished gaze of the four giant beasts, the Purple dragon swallowed the Golden Lotus in one bite, then quickly shrunk its head back to its original size.
Mewling!! Exuding a rich energy aura, the Purple dragon happily flew back, comfortably lying on the scale armor of the Leiyan Tianlong.
“Roar! Tim, Misss Joseline just got bigger.” Only then did the Silver Giant Dragon, who was far away digesting the Golden Lotus’s energy, react, somewhat surprised.
The Leiyan Tianlong slowly nodded and roared, “I saw it. It must be due to its inherent ability.”
At this point, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Red Candle Dragon each swallowed the remaining two Golden Lotus, their bodies permeated with a rich energy aura, rejuvenating them.
They never thought that they would ‘pick up’ such treasures just upon entering the mythological world.
When the five giant beasts, both big and small, departed, the Black Beast atop the distance mountain peak closed its eyes in pain.
Those Golden Lotus, it had been taking care of them for over twenty days, planning to feast upon them after they had completely matured, only for them to be plundered by the Silver Giant Dragon.
Oh well, consider it a homecoming gift to the Silver Dragon.
After that, the group of giant beasts flew across two ordinary dangerous areas, leaving the territory of the Balon Beast King, and entering the ‘home’ of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Roar! Under the roar filled with Level 9 Dragon Might, a group of airborne exotic beasts with wingspans over fifty meters scattered in fear, not daring to block the way.
At this moment, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flying among the clouds asked, puzzled, “Mewling mewling mewling!! Scythia, didn’t you say the vast world is dangerous? Why haven’t we encountered any powerful giant beasts?”
The Silver Giant Dragon whirled around, “Roar! My mother’s territory does not permit beasts above Level 9 to reside. Those creatures who grow to Level 9 will be driven away.”
How overbearing. No, perhaps it was for its safety. Leiyan Tianlong swept its eyes over the Silver Giant Dragon, lost in contemplation.
The Silver Giant Dragon had once mentioned that what it appreciated most in the past was flying around its territory, or going to the neighboring territory to ‘play’ with a dragon named Telsafi.
Since this territory was very secure, nothing happened for the next day and a half.
Furthermore, Scythia’s territory had a distinct character, different from the area where the humans lived. Here, the heavens and the earth were stable, there were few danger zones, and it seemed very serene and peaceful.
At this moment, a city spread over more than ten kilometers, filled with an exotic aura, appeared on the landscape. Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar.
“Roar! The great Scythia returns.”
“It’s the great Seckther, the Godson of Scythia.” Seeing the Silver Giant Dragon circling overhead, the many exotic beings below all revealed respectful expressions and bowed.
These creatures had human-like upper bodies, about three meters tall, with long snake-like tails. They wore coarse clothes, roughly akin to medieval civilization.
After enjoying the reverence of the beings below, the Silver Giant Dragon was finally satisfied. With a shake of its wings, it led the Leiyan Tianlong and the others to continue flying.
After half a day of flying, a mountain range stretching to the ends of the earth, with the upper half cloaked in ice, appeared before them.
Atop a peak of the mountain range that was tens of thousands meters high, a Blue-White Giant Beast as humongous as a small mountain range lay. Hearing it, even the tall mountain seemed to shrink.
Suddenly, a startling pressure wave greeted them.
The breath of the rules, Mythical Titan peak!! Leiyan Tianlong’s expression immediately became serious.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 371 The Mother-in-Law Dragon’s Gift, Chaotic Turbulent Region
chapters.content:
Chapter 865: Chapter 371 The Mother-in-Law Dragon’s Gift, Chaotic Turbulent Region
It turns out to be the peak of Mythical Titans, Scythia has some serious backing.
Even the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but be surprised when it sensed the invisible power of Law spreading before it, permeating heaven and earth with a strong suppressive force.
At this moment, in its eyes, the entire Icebound Mountain Range seemed to pulsate slowly with the breath of the blue-white Giant Dragon; under the diffusion of the rules, heaven and earth became one.
It was clear that this Beast had completed its Transformation and was just a step away from joining the ranks of Ancient Titans, which could be considered Supreme.
This backer is even more solid than Mathilda Ward.
However, as the Four Great Beasts approached the Icebound Mountain Range, the Silver Giant Dragon’s speed slowed down significantly, and eventually, it even stopped at an altitude of tens of thousands of meters, dozens of kilometers away.
...
Roar! Scythia, why have you stopped? The Single-horned Tiger Whale beside it asked with some confusion.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon growled slowly, “Joe, don’t ask anymore, Scythia is clearly afraid that it’ll get its butt whooped if it goes any further.”
“Roar! The Great Sethia isn’t afraid, just now its wings were a bit stiff and couldn’t fly,” the Silver Giant Dragon retorted.
Whoosh!
Just then, a powerful raging wind howled around the Beasts, and under the tangible force, the three large-bodied Beasts involuntarily drifted swiftly into the distance.
