As for the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, the Law Power of the wind element dissipated for the most part when it came near, neutralized by an Invisible Power on its body surface. The remaining power couldn’t so much as shake the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon.
Eh! From a distance, atop the mountain ranges, the blue-white Giant Dragon slowly opened its huge eyes, revealing a hint of surprise.
At this time, the Silver Giant Dragon was also blown by the storm to the mountaintop, its ferocious dragon face suddenly showing a flattering expression.
Fortunately, the blue-white Giant Dragon only gave it one glance, without any reprimand, and the enormous dragon mouth slightly opened to let out a low roar that shook Heaven and Earth, “Did you enjoy playing outside?”
Speaking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately showed a smug expression on its face, “Roar! This time, the Great Scythia didn’t go out to play, but to fight for Territory.”
“The Great Scythia is invincible. In that Indigenous World, it has established a Beast Empire named the Dragon Palace, unified the oceans, and became a Hegemon.”
“Besides that, the Great Scythia has also annihilated two Mythological Beast Empires, eradicated a civilized race, killing until blood flowed like rivers, roar!”
By the end, the Silver Giant Dragon’s roars of pride grew louder, flapping its Dragon Wings as if it were a little girl bragging before an adult.
Motionless, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast lay nearby with heavy and anxious looks in their eyes.
They had no choice; the Beast was too terrifying, not just because of its enormous size, but also because of its dreadfully oppressive Aura, as if it could make the sky fall and the earth collapse.
Just the Invisible Power it exuded spontaneously was enough to instill an instinctual fear and awe in them, even in the Candle Dragon Giant Beast which had touched upon the Time Laws.
Watching the Silver Giant Dragon standing there, proudly showing off its accomplishments with its tail cocked, the blue-white Giant Dragon suddenly growled, “When did your bloodline improve?”
In the perception of the blue-white Giant Dragon, only a few Sun Wheels had passed by, yet the blood Aura of the Silver Giant Dragon had become more authentic, evolving from an ordinary Monarch Bloodline to a Top-tier Monarch.
And in the Vast World, the birth of offspring by Mythical-level beings is actually a transmission of power, with these descendants inheriting part of their blood and strength.
Thus, it’s very difficult for Mythical beings to give birth to offspring; it might not happen for several hundred or even a thousand years.
Moreover, because these mythological descendants inherit incomplete power, their bloodline will drop a level; it’s impossible for the offspring to be Monarchs if the parents are Kings.
As a Titan Dragon with a Monarch Bloodline, the Silver Giant Dragon born to the blue-white Giant Dragon initially had only a peak King-level bloodline.
However, later it obtained a Spatial Innate Rune, which allowed Scythia to ‘pick up’ the ability to control space and hence its bloodline rose to the Monarch level.
But unexpectedly, this little guy went to the Indigenous World for a few Sun Wheels, not only growing from level eight to Mid Level 9, but also purifying and upgrading its bloodline.
With this in mind, the blue-white Giant Dragon couldn’t help but turn its gaze to the Black-red Colossal Beast that was flying over.
Now that the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon had broken through to Mythical-level, the blue-white Giant Dragon could no longer see through its ‘Life Mark Wheel’, but even so, it felt a bit of a shock.
It sensed the fluctuations of two Higher-order Laws, and a blood Aura that even made it feel slightly suppressed, Emperor level!!
And that little one on its head…
The blue-white Giant Dragon’s mouth opened slightly, and its deep voice shook Heaven and Earth, “Hello, little one, I am Adriana Christine Di, the ruler of this World.”
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon roared politely in response, “Hello, Master of Frost and Destruction, I am Thunderflame Dragon King Tim Abott of the Dragon Palace. Brock Abbott, just call me Tim.”
The voice of the blue-white Giant Dragon bore a terrifying oppressiveness, yet its tone was gentle, “You don’t have to be so polite, little one. Just think of me as an ordinary elder. I invited you here to thank you for taking care of Scythia.”
The blue-white Giant Dragon naturally knew the state of its daughter; had it not been for this Beast known as Thunderflame Aro, she would have been sold off by someone long ago.
“Not at all, Scythia is very capable and has been a big help.” The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon was also very polite, taking the chance to praise the Silver Giant Dragon.
Instantly, the tail of the Silver Giant Dragon nearby cocked up in delight, as it growled proudly, “Roar! Mom, you see, Aro said the Great Scythia is very impressive.”
The blue-white Giant Dragon glanced at the Silver Giant Dragon and couldn’t be bothered with it, slowly growling, “I’ve invited you over as a guest this time mainly to thank you for taking care of Scythia.”

chapters.title: Chapter 866: 371 - Mother Dragon's Gift, Chaotic Turbulent Region_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 866: Chapter 371 – Mother Dragon’s Gift, Chaotic Turbulent Region_2
As it spoke, the Blue-White Giant Dragon thought for a moment, soon after shaking its massive body, a huge dragon claw stretched out towards the far and lightly clasped it.
Boom! The icy peak kilometers away trembled, followed by the collapse of the kilometer-high ice crystal mountaintop, shattering the surrounding space as well.
Under the terrifying rule power, the space and the kilometer-high mountaintop were infinitely compressed, eventually forming a black ice crystal with a diameter of one meter.
Inside the ice crystal, countless tiny ice crystals rotated under the black storm, each emitting a mysterious aura, displaying a certain power.
And when the Dujiaohu, the Red Candle Dragon, curiously looked at the black storm, their consciousness roared, their minds swelled, almost fainting on the spot.
“Inside it, a complete process of rule evolution is sealed. Although my rules are different from the power you possess, by the time you grow to the late Mythical Titan stage, it can still serve as a catalyst, prompting the already perfect law of evolution that belongs to your rules,” it explained.
...
Although Leiyan Tianlong is currently only at the early Mythical stage, the Blue-White Giant Dragon felt that with its terrifying talent, it wouldn’t take long for it to break through to the Titan stage.
For Scythia, an indigenous creature of the Vast World, the time frame of ten solar cycles was akin to just ten days for the people of the blue planet, a horrifying concept.
“This… is too precious,” Leiyan Tianlong said, but its claws had already reached out, collecting the black ice crystal containing the rule power into its storage space.
This was a treasure comparable to the level of laws and resources; how could Leiyan Tianlong refuse?
When a creature reaches the late Mythical Titan stage, the laws that it has mastered have long since become perfect and integrated. The next step is to evolve a set of rules unique to it.
Many gifted Mythical Titan beasts, Purgatory Demon Kings, and even a few peak human kings have been caught up in this step for years on end.
Of course, the black ice crystal given by the Blue-White Giant Dragon was a mere catalyst and couldn’t allow Leiyan Tianlong to immediately master the rules. Meanwhile, its own loss should have been not insignificant.
From the moment the ice crystal formed, the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s breath weakened slightly, which was evident.
Gathering its breath, the Blue-White Giant Dragon looked at the Silver Giant Dragon and let out a soft growl: “Scythia, what are your plans next? Will you stay in your territory?”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared with pride: “Not staying. It is boring at home. The great Scythia will go out and dominate the Vast World.”
I knew it… The Blue-White Giant Dragon rolled its eyes, suddenly too lazy to pay attention to the Silver Giant Dragon, instead turning its gaze to the Leiyan Tianlong.
The black and red giant beast thought for a moment and said in a low growl, “This is Adriana’s territory, it is not convenient for us to stay here. It would be better to fight for our own territory.”
“Adriana, do you know which direction around this land has no strong mythical creatures and is also rich in resources?”
Faced with Leiyan Tianlong’s inquiry, the Blue-White Giant Dragon thought for a moment and let out a slow growl.
“The Vast World is large, but the surrounding areas with rich resources have already been occupied. Currently, my territory, besides the central area, has three mythical subordinates suppressing it from three directions.”
“Heading south is Caotiona’s territory, a late-Mythical Titan beast, with four mythical beasts under its command and occupying a vast area.”
“To the east of my territory, across the Dark Long River, is a mid-Mythical Titan beast’s territory, which is beyond your current strength to challenge.”
“At the end of the north side, the area is shrouded in mist, inhabited by a prehistoric creature.”
“These creatures are very dangerous. When they wake up, they will devour a large amount of life to replenish their sleep. It is hard to harm them without the ancient Titan-level power.”
Leiyan Tianlong’s eyes flickered slightly at the news.
Obviously, the northern end’s mist was the territory of that prehistoric creature, and beyond that would be the territory of the Black Oblivion King.
Although the four passages on the Blue Planet were only one to two thousand kilometers apart, they were tens to hundreds of million kilometers apart in the Mythical World.
At this moment, the Blue-White Giant Dragon continued, “Thus, I suggest you go to the west side, pass through Caotiona’s territory from the southwest, and enter the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
“Chaotic Turbulent Region?” Leiyan Tianlong’s eyes showed a hint of curiosity.”There is an incredibly vast and chaotic region formed after a huge world was devoured by the Vast World, where the laws and rules of heaven and earth are confused.”
“Because the shattered world was so vast, its destruction pierced through the endless void, attracting the power of chaos. Thus, it is extremely dangerous there, but it also contains countless heavenly treasures.”
“For example, Scythia’s innate space runes were obtained by me inside.”
“Roar! Didn’t I find my innate space runes by myself?” The Silver Giant Dragon said, somewhat confused.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon glanced at her foolish daughter and continued, “When the time comes, I will greet Caotiona and ask her to give you a territory at the edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
“You can use that territory as a core to gradually explore deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, expand your territory, and the abundant resources within it will be enough for you to rapidly enhance your strength.”
“However, many mythical creatures reside in that region, as well as Mythical Titans and powerful civilizations, so you must be careful.”
“If you encounter an enemy that you cannot resist, you can ask Caotiona for help, and she will help you then.”
After the Blue-White Giant Dragon finished speaking, Leiyan Tianlong looked towards the west, lost in thought.
A broken chaotic region similar to the Black Forbidden Zone but much larger, huh? It seems that the human territory also lies in that direction, although it’s quite far away.
Through the connection with his main body, Leiyan Tianlong couldn’t determine the exact distance but was able to confirm the direction- after crossing the chaotic turbulent region, they would arrive at the human territory.
“We’ll head to the Chaotic Turbulent Region next.” Leiyan Tianlong made the decision.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, “Roar! No problem, we’ll go there. The great Scythia shall dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
As for the One-Horned Tiger Shark and the Red Candle Dragon, they naturally had no objections, and the little purple dragon had been very quiet since arriving at the mountain peak.
It hid in the gap between Leiyan Tianlong’s scales on his head, poking out a small head curiously watching the Blue-White Giant Dragon.
Because it was so small, it was almost impossible to notice its head without looking closely.
At this time, the Blue-White Giant Dragon slowly growled, “But before going, I need to help Scythia enhance her strength a little bit. A mere ninth-level intermediate is too weak for her.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon had long prepared top-tier treasures and Law-level resources for her foolish daughter to quickly advance her through each stage.
Compared to the surrounding dangerous areas and the more numerous humans, the Blue-White Giant Dragon, who occupied a territory several times larger than that of the human’s, had even more good stuff.
Together with the proximity to the Chaotic Turbulent Region which had even more resources, it had accumulated countless treasures over the years.
“We’ll wait a little longer before we go.”
Leiyan Tianlong nodded, not objecting. He too had to find the time to transfer the Life Crystal and the Beast Essence to his main body to enhance his strength.
With the Life Crystals he currently held, at least one more talent could be awakened, and then mastering one more high-order Law would make his strength even more powerful.
“Scythia, you take them to the Ice Crystal Palace, I have opened the treasury. All the beasts may choose a gift, including that little one.”
Yiyi yiyi! The little purple dragon on Leiyan Tianlong’s head pointed at itself.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon, who had been paying attention to it, nodded slightly, “Yes, you as well.”
Yiyi yiyi!! The little purple dragon happily crawled out of the gap between the scales and turned into a streak of purple light in the air, hovering around.
The Silver Giant Dragon also became excited, knowing how many treasures were in her mother’s treasury. This time, she had to take away a few more treasures.
“Roar! Tim Abott, let’s go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 867: 372: Emptying the Treasury, Drastic Increase in Size
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: Chapter 372: Emptying the Treasury, Drastic Increase in Size
Across a hundred kilometers of mountain ranges from the mountain peak where the blue-white giant dragon roosted, a majestic group of ice palaces towering tens of thousands of meters high and spanning several dozen kilometers in length and width stood erect.
Built from silver-blue hard ice, these palaces resembled mountain ranges themselves, supported by ice pillars that wove through the clouds and mist, appearing both gorgeous and sacred.
And beneath these Ice Crystal Divine Palaces, some Kaleb Clan priestesses with the upper bodies of beautiful girls and serpentine lower halves were active.
When the Silver Giant Dragon took the lead in appearing, all those priestess girls bent over, bowing respectfully and jabbering in a different races’ language.
“Greetings to the Divine Child, Great Sethia,” a lofty dragon roar responded to them.
As the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon flew over from the sky, it couldn’t help but curiously glance at these girls.
...
It couldn’t help it, this was its first encounter with such pretty beings from a different race.
The priestess girls were roughly about 2 meters tall, each of them beautiful by human standards, with fair skin and well-defined facial features.
Most importantly, aside from their lower halves covered in silver scale armor, their upper bodies were clad in semi-transparent ice crystal soft armor that left little to the imagination.
However, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon merely took a curious glance, as its current aesthetics naturally did not take an interest in these humanoid creatures.
As the several Giant Beasts passed through the ice columns several hundred meters thick and disappeared into the depths of the cloud-shrouded Divine temple, a beautiful girl priestess curiously said,
“Have you noticed, in the past few Sun Wheels, Divine Child Sethia has grown a lot larger.”
“Divine Child Sethia must be in its growth period, that’s why it’s growing so fast.”
“But compared to the changes in Divine Child Sethia’s size, have you noticed that black-red Colossal Beast following behind His Highness?”
“That Beast God is very strong!”
“I noticed too, that Beast God merely flew over us from above, and the invisible pressure scared me to the point my tail went limp, and I almost laid flat on the ground.”
In the midst of the different races’ priestesses whispering to one another, the several Giant Beasts made their way to the depths of the Ice Crystal Main Palace.
“Roar! Over there,” the Silver Giant Dragon, familiar with the path, passed through the ice columns and finally stopped atop a gigantic platform built from Ice Crystal steps, standing over five thousand meters high.
A transparent gateway standing a kilometer tall loomed there.
“Roar! The Great Sethia has arrived,” the Silver Giant Dragon let out a cheer, spreading its double wings and dashed inside.
And the moment the Silver Giant Dragon touched the transparent gateway, the door rippled slightly as if recognizing it.
Behind it, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish excitedly flapped its Double Fins and was equally thrilled, roaring, “Roar! Thunderflame, I can sense so many good items, so many.”
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon let out a low growl, “No kidding, this is Sethia’s mother’s treasure trove, let’s go.” Saying that, the Black-red Colossal Beast also flew into the transparent gate.
It too was curious about the treasury accumulated by a creature at the peak of Titans.
As soon as it entered, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon felt an overwhelming and terrifying surge of energy hit it in the face, and these energies carried fluctuations of the Power of Heaven and Earth.
In that white space, Heaven and Earth Treasures emanating rich energy fluctuations were enveloped by White Light, floating mid-air, starting at the level of God-level Resources at the lowest.
These resources looked like several meters large red rocks, some were gloomy blue flowers, others were blue Crystal Sand, or green bamboo standing ten meters tall.
But under the envelopment of the White Light, the divine essence and energy contained within these Heaven and Earth Treasures were evaporating, turning into countless white light spots that soared into the sky and merged into a terrifyingly energetic river that disappeared into the Void above.
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s gaze flickered for a moment.
This Blue-White Giant Dragon was using the divine essence of countless Heaven and Earth Treasures to refine Heaven and Earth, accelerating its own rule evolution, and even integrating a piece of Heaven and Earth into its body.
No wonder Sethia said its mother had been motionless for a long time.
The Silver Giant Dragon ahead turned its head back and let out a roaring urge, “Roar! Tim Abott, stop looking, all those items have been burned through by mom, the good stuff is further inside.”
Squeak, squeak! The Purple little dragon on its head also urged the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon to hurry up, as it wanted to eat the good stuff.
“Roar! I’m coming,” the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, followed by two equally astonished Giant Beasts, caught up.
Soon, the Four Great Beasts crossed that ‘ocean’ of ordinary Top-level Divine Items and arrived at the central section of the treasury.
Here, many Heaven and Earth Treasures were still enveloped by White Light, floating in space, reaching Top-tier levels and radiating even more intense energy.
And this collection of over a thousand Top-level Divine Items divided into ten layers, the top five layers were continuously dissipating their essence under some power, turning into white light spots and flying upwards.
Boom!
Just then, a strong shock vibrated from the front, followed by the sight of the Silver Giant Dragon crashing into an invisible barrier, and its colossal body was repelled back.
“Roar! Ouch.” The Silver Giant Dragon clutched its head, dazed from the impact, and looked ahead where several orbs were slowly rotating, emitting colorful Divine Light and the wave of rules.
Dozens of resources equivalent to innate runes of Law Level.
Even the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon felt its eyes heat up with the realization; Sethia’s mother was indeed wealthy beyond measure.
At that moment, those dozens of light orbs vibrated slightly, and then under a force’s pull, three of them flew out.
Two of them approached Sethia, and one came in front of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon; in addition, from those Top-level Divine Items, three more light orbs flew out toward the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, and the Purple little dragon.
In front of Sethia, one of the two light orbs was a several meters in diameter sphere containing countless blue stars, a Divine Object from beyond the stars called the Starlight Mysterious Liquid.

chapters.title: Chapter 868: 372 Emptying the Treasury, Explosive Growth in Size_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: Chapter 372 Emptying the Treasury, Explosive Growth in Size_2
This divine object functions like Mysterious Yellow Air, and the Law Power contained within it can temper a cultivator’s physique after absorption, giving them a constitution that is akin to that of myth.
However, unlike Mysterious Yellow Air, which transforms the body and soul innately, this Starlight Mysterious Liquid has an overbearing energy that can only be absorbed by cultivators in the late period of Nine Layers and only tempers the body.
As a Giant Dragon, Great Sethia, in the mid period of Level 9 with two top-tier talents, possessed incredibly formidable flesh.
The other object, a one-meter diameter sphere emitting black divine light like a ‘Divine Pill’, was unrecognizable to the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon; it did not know its effects.
But judging from the powerful strength contained within, it should be a Law Divine Artifact that could allow the Silver Giant Dragon to leap into myth or, at the very least, achieve the quasi-mythical level in one step.
This is the advantage of having a powerful backer; as long as one’s cultivation is sufficient, they can cross many stages of accumulation in a short time.
...
Jack Clark was the same; the Federation had directly provided him with sufficient resources to quickly traverse from the Eight Layer to the Nine Layers, all the way to the late period of the Nine Layers in one go.
While lost in thought, the eyes of Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon fell in front of itself.
What the Blue-White Giant Dragon had given it was a cluster of pure white flame, burning vigorously yet without any heat. The moment Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon approached, it felt its soul become much more lively.
This was a cluster of Law Fire that could strengthen the soul.
In the eyes of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s evolution and growth rate was astonishing, but at only one year old, its soul certainly wasn’t strong enough; after all, it takes time for the body to nourish and strengthen the soul.
Therefore, it provided this Law Divine Artifact that could enhance and strengthen the soul.
“Roar! Only two for the great Sethia, mom is too stingy,” lamented the Silver Giant Dragon upon eying the Law Divine Artifacts deep in the treasuries with some regret.
With that, the Silver Giant Dragon adeptly collected the two Law Divine Artifacts before it.
It then turned its head toward the countless top-level divine items behind it. Flying to a several meters large orb radiating with a golden jade light, its eyes sparkled with anticipation.
“Roar! Mom, this smells so good, Great Sethia wants to eat it.”
Suddenly, the brightness from the golden jade orb’s surface fluctuated slightly, as if hesitating, but eventually, it dissipated, revealing the wrapped top-level divine item inside.
Roar!
The Silver Giant Dragon roared with joy, grabbing the golden jade divine object and stuffing it into its Reverse Scale, then spread its double wings and flew to a fruit that exuded a rich Life Energy.
Then, the Silver Giant Dragon let out another low roar and said, “Roar! Mom, Tim Abott likes this great item very much. It will grow bigger after eating it, really.”
Away on the mountaintop, the Blue-White Giant Dragon, just about to sleep, twitched at the corner of its mouth but hesitated only briefly before dissipating the rule force covering that Divine Fruit.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared with excitement, grabbing the Divine Fruit full of Life Energy and flying over to Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, batting its large eyes at it.
“Roar! Tim Abott, quick, eat it.”
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon naturally did not hesitate. Opening its mouth, it unleashed a powerful suction force enveloping the Divine Fruit and swallowed it in one gulp.
Boom! The rich Life Energy exploded within Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s body.
Compared to the Golden Lotus it had consumed earlier, this fruit full of pure Life Energy had an even better effect on Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon. As infinite energy filled it, its body began to expand.
Crackle Crackle!!
Its muscles swelled, its bones stretched, and its scale armor enlarged. Soon, the size of the Black-red Colossal Beast grew from five hundred twenty meters to five hundred forty-one meters.
This growth was not limited to body length but was holistic; in an instant, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon appeared even more majestic and fierce.
Such astonishing growth and energy absorption and conversion rates surprised even the Blue-White Giant Dragon on the other side of the mountain, revealing a hint of shock in its eyes.
“Could this little fellow have an Evolution Talent?”
The bodies of Mythical Giant Beasts, tempered by Law Power, are exceedingly formidable, but their growth is considerably challenging and not something that can simply be achieved by piling on energy.
At the Mythical level, every little growth in a Giant Beast’s body requires not only the consumption of vast amounts of energy but also the evolution and purification of parts of laws bonded with the body and bloodline.
Therefore, at Mythical-level, body growth and strength increase is a prolonged process. Many Giant Beasts choose to occupy a territory and grow slowly, devouring Heaven and Earth Treasure within their territory to temper their bodies.
But this little one…
“Roar! Mom, this thing smells so good, Great Scythia wants to eat,”
“Roar! Mom, this great item contains such intense energy, Tim Abott will surely grow a lot after eating it,”
“Roar! Mom, Tim Abott will surely be very happy after eating this good item,”
“Roar! The energy emitted by this item matches well with Joe…”
In the treasury that followed, the Silver Giant Dragon roared every time it set its eyes on something good, shouting that it wanted to eat or that the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon could enhance its strength by eating it.
Every time this happened, the white divine light on the surface of those divine items would dissipate, and then, gleefully, the Silver Giant Dragon would collect them into the Reverse Scale Space or toss them to the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon.
Following behind the Silver Giant Dragon, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon happily accepted everything; this was not the time to be polite, otherwise, it would be itself at a loss.
With each top-level divine item devoured, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon grew increasingly larger, and in a crackle crackle, its body length quickly exceeded six hundred meters, six hundred and thirty meters.
And as the two giant beasts swept through, the divine items and resources in the treasury became increasingly scarce.
When the size of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon grew to seven hundred and ten meters, suddenly, a powerful force arrived, tossing all five giant beasts out of the treasury.
Boom! Accompanied by the quaking of the space, the ice platform’s silver gate slowly vanished.
“Roar! Mom, Great Scythia hasn’t finished collecting yet,” grumbled the Silver Giant Dragon standing on the ice platform, regretful that it had only collected a small portion.
“Scythia, that’s enough, if you keep going, your mom’s treasury will be empty,” the now even more terrifying Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon said as it shook its head.
It had eaten too many good items just now, and the energy hadn’t been completely digested in time, leaving it slightly inebriated.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also swayed unsteadily, its body grown by over twenty meters, with the intense energy enveloping it yet to be digested.
This time, by following Scythia, it too had scooped up a lot of great items.
Including the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, this behemoth was also emitting strong energy fluctuations, its aura nearing mythical level, and its oppressive presence growing ever stronger.
As a quasi-mythical Giant Beast, the Red Beast’s strength was already at its peak; what it needed were creatures that could accelerate the tempering of its body by the laws.
The Purple little dragon also acquired a sort of pure golden liquid, which could speed up its “growth and development.”
But at the moment, the little one was resting on the head of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, with a silly grin on its face, slightly dazed—not by milk, but by energy, having eaten too much and suffering indigestion.
“Roar! Scythia, give me those Life Crystals, you all need to digest those divine items and hibernate, and it just so happens that I need to make a breakthrough,” the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon said.
Hearing the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon mentioning making a breakthrough, envy appeared in the eyes of the giant beasts.
They envied its ability to breakthrough whenever it said it would.
Just then, the Candle Dragon floating nearby suddenly growled lowly, “Roar! Seth, i, a, mother, is, so, powerful.”
This one…?? Puzzlement appeared in Scythia’s eyes.
The Red Candle Dragon had been snapping up the goodies without missing a beat, but only now, under the pressure of seeing its mother, did it react??
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon pondered, “Its consciousness must be in different time phases, only temporarily leaving them in the face of danger or when there’s a benefit.”
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon shuddered and growled lowly, “Time Power is too terrifying; luckily, Great Scythia doesn’t have this kind of power.”
That’s hard to say. The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon looked amused.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s mother was a dragon that mastered the Destruction Ice Crystal Storm, and its father a dragon that harnessed the power of Time Laws. As their offspring, it was impossible to awaken just one type of power.
As the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon contemplated, the Silver Giant Dragon took out several high-order crystals it had collected earlier, and then the giant beasts each found a separate hall to hibernate in, digesting.
Especially Scythia, which would be hibernating for a while to digest those two Law Level Divine Artifacts.

chapters.title: Chapter 869: 373: Armored Overlord Dragon, Demon God Awakens
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: Chapter 373: Armored Overlord Dragon, Demon God Awakens
Boom! The land forged from ice crystals trembled.
The already tens of kilometers high, and over ten thousand meters wide Ice Crystal Division Palace centered around the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon. A domain unfolded and enveloped all directions as Thunderflame and purple energy merged.
After the domain energy filled the space, blocking out any potential prying from the surroundings and sealing the space, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon took a deep breath with some anticipation.
Hum!
On either side, the three pairs of feather horns which had been reconstructed with silver runes, now ten times more complex during the days of closed-door cultivation, began to light up one by one, with fierce golden purple flames burning on top.
The space in the mythical world was stable and strong, naturally making it harder to carve a temporary pathway through vast distances.
...
However, the strength of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon now rivaled, or even surpassed, the pinnacle of mythology, and with the more perfected space runes, a silver vortex with a diameter of one meter soon emerged slowly amidst the flames.
In the heart of the forbidden world, an eighty meters tall incarnation with three faces and six arms, resembling an ancient Demon God, Jack slowly opened his eyes, radiating golden red light on his right arm.
Hum! As space vibrated, a vortex of similar one meter diameter appeared in front of Jack.
Atop the head of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, the perplexed purple little dragon curiously watched the life crystals disappear into the vortex, stretching out a tiny claw: Yiyaya?
The Black-red Colossal Beast opened its mouth slightly, its voice deep: “I am making a sacrifice.”
Yiyaya? The purple little dragon grew even more puzzled, not understanding why the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was sacrificing those shiny objects, and to whom?
Soon, thousands of crystals passed through the pathway, and the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon let out a roar. A Terrifying Power burst forth from its body, and in an instant, the silver vortex above its head violently expanded to several meters in diameter.
In the moment the spatial channel expanded, a powerful backlash force burst forth, causing the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon’s body to sink, with cracks forming on its hard scale armor.
At the same time, chunks of Giant Beast essence appeared between the double claws of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon, especially the black-red essence refined from the skeleton of the Black Oblivion King.
Bang bang bang! Bracing against the backlash of space, the muscles of the Thunder Flame Beast’s double claws swelled, and under the Terrifying Power, it forcibly broke the essence of the Black Oblivion King into four pieces and threw them into the pathway.
Boom!
Right as all the Giant Beast essences passed through the channel, the space pathway collapsed violently without the support of force, causing the entire Ice Crystal Division Palace to tremble under the powerful shock.
Huff huff huff huff! Jack gasped for breath—the backlash from forcibly expanding the spatial channel was too strong, even though the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had borne most of the spatial backlash.
However, seeing the thousands of low-level life crystals floating in the void and the Giant Beast essences emitting strong energy fluctuations, a smile still appeared on Jack’s face.
Taking a moment to recover, Jack then gathered the essences into the Sumeru Bracelet and began converting the life crystals.
“You converted high-purity life crystals, gaining 892 attribute points.”
“You converted high-purity life crystals, gaining 3915 attribute points.”
“You converted high-purity life crystals, gaining 35 attribute points…”
As life crystal after life crystal was converted, the transparent page before Jack’s eyes quickly showed surging attribute points, rushing past thirty thousand, forty thousand, and finally stopping at 84,321.
Out of the eighty thousand plus attribute points gained this time, about sixty thousand were collected by the Female Tiger Whale leading the Mutated Tiger Whale Army.
The remaining twenty thousand or so were from the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast that swept across the oceans, killing those Level 7 and Level 8 Giants they encountered en route.
After converting the attribute points, it was time to enhance the talents.
At this thought, Jack’s gaze fell on the talents beneath his avatar, considering which one to strengthen first.
To enhance the swift regeneration of his physical body, or perhaps the senior Chaos Black Pattern talent? Or the Transcendent Talents like Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Annihilation True Thunder, and Purple Void Poison?
As for the Gigantification Talent, with its triple enhancement requirement, it would have to be considered later.
In comparison to Giants of the same level, the advantage of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon lay in its exaggeratedly powerful physical body, honed by repeated Top Tier and Deification Talent enhancements.
With dozens of “enhancements” to its talent and constant micro evolution, the physical body of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had become incredibly powerful, overpowering Giants of the same level in strength, defense, and burst capacity.
Add to this nine powerful talents related to the body, transcendent abilities, and special classes, making it nearly invincible within its rank. It had barely entered the early myth and was already comparable to the Peak of Mythology.
This was with only two of its nine talents being enhanced to God Transformation Level, advancing to superior higher-order laws.
If later on all nine laws were enhanced to deification and advanced to higher-order laws, the purification of the nine higher-order laws would become incredibly terrifying.
Bear in mind that even among the Human Race, few of the monstrous talents who reached the status of king possessed superior higher-order laws.
Including members of The Purgatory Family and the demon kings, most wielded only ordinary Lower Laws, with a minority holding intermediate ones.
Bearing a single higher-order law usually signified a potential step into Heavenly King Level, not only more powerful but also more complete and closer to the World Origin Rules.
In such a case, to enhance their strength, many kings choose to comprehend a second or third Law, combining them for stronger combat power.
However, each life has a limit to comprehending and containing laws, and currently, among the Human Kings, the one with the most control over laws only wields four lower and one intermediate law.
This is a king with an innately powerful soul capable of bearing more Law Origins.
Besides, some kings choose a single path, enhancing the power of their laws with Sword Intent and Knife Intent, aiming for unity of body and mind to reach higher realms.

chapters.title: Chapter 870: 373 Re-equipped Overlord Dragon, Demon God Awakening_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: Chapter 373 Re-equipped Overlord Dragon, Demon God Awakening_2
“`
Compared to the passive evolution of Giant Beasts, humans undergoing an ascension of life levels made faster progress after breaking through king-level, especially some talented monsters who at the breakthrough comprehended the Heaven Opening Supreme Law.
This is a power that goes beyond Higher-order Law, a more formidable force, with a terrifying potency.
Of course, even the Heaven Opening Supreme Law has limitations. In terms of sheer power, it could compare to the fusion power of three Higher-order Laws, or perhaps two.
From this, one can perceive the horror of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, master of nine talents that could advance to Higher-order Laws. Once it breaks through to the Titan Level, it will be strong enough to fiercely confront ancient Titans.
And if the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon could later achieve a fusion of nine Higher-order Laws… Hiss! Even Jack Clark took a deep breath thinking about this.
...
In fact, as a soul avatar, the innate “talent” of the Six-legged Salamander was only average, equivalent to an Innate Awakened One of the Human Race, except its innate ability was evolution.
This ability allowed the Six-legged Salamander to evolve rapidly and grow. In less than a year, it had become a Mythical Creature.
The current monstrosity of the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s combat strength, atop the talents gained during its evolution and breaking limits, were also pushing past their limits with Jack Clark’s repeated enhancements.
The combination of various advantages culminated in the monstrous Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon among the Giant Beasts, and similarly, the feedback from the Avatar Giant Beast also made Jack Clark a monster among humans.
One could say they complemented each other.
Without the repeated evolutionary feedback from the Avatar Giant Beast, Jack Clark’s physical body couldn’t possibly be so strong; without a solid foundation, he would merely be a genius with slightly faster cultivation.
And without the attribute enhancement from Jack Clark himself, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon would also just be an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast with two Top Tier Talents and several intermediate talents.
Phew! No rush, take it step by step.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack Clark’s gaze finally landed on the Advanced Talent called Chaos Black Pattern.
Compared to talents like Annihilation True Thunder, Heaven Burning Golden Flame, or Swift, the most urgent priority for the present Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon was to strengthen its defense.
Once in its Crimson Form with an invincible defense, wielding the power of three Higher-order Laws, the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon will be capable of directly challenging Titan Beasts, even ripping apart ordinary Titans.
After all, the strength of ordinary Titan Beasts still belonged to the Law, only with a fuller realization of the Law, they are more powerful and larger in size.
Moreover, being invincible in defense when entering the Chaotic Domain is safer, considering it’s not only home to Mythical Giant Beasts but also various perilous deathtraps.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark’s mental voice resonated in his mind: “Expend ten thousand attribute points to enhance the Chaos Black Pattern talent.”
Boom!
Inside the Division Palace, a Terrifying Aura burst forth from the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, shaking Heaven and Earth. The entire Ice Crystal Divine Palace shuddered under the oppressive force that filled the air.
Within the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon countless Rune Sequence Chains appeared, evolved, becoming even more intricate, while its genes and bloodline also evolved and strengthened under the intertwining of Talent Runes.
Every enhancement of a talent to the top-tier signified a new level of bodily and life evolution for the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon, even though it had already broken through to Mythical-level.
The sudden transformation startled the Purple little dragon perched on the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon’s head.
Yiyiyi!?
Compared to the astonished Purple little dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Whale and Giant Beast Candle Dragon in the other three massive Division Palaces, which were still digesting, had long grown accustomed to this.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, which had already eaten two Law Divine Artifacts and fallen into Hibernation, it let out an unconscious roar, “Roar! Tim Abott has grown stronger again. The Great Scythia also needs to make an effort.”
While they had grown accustomed, the priests of different races within the Ice Crystal Divine Palace were shivering with fear under the terrible pressure.
Meanwhile, hundreds of kilometers away, on the other side of the mountain ranges, where a Blue-White Giant Dragon had just relaxed and prepared to enter hibernation, was also startled awake by the sudden surge in aura.
“How has this little guy’s strength increased again! And this time it isn’t just a simple growth in size?”
“Worthy of being a ‘monster’ who grew to God-level with just ten Sun Wheels.” With admiration, the Blue-White Giant Dragon closed its eyes again, ready to return to hibernation.
It still had some time before completing its final Transformation, when the entire dragon would step into a new World.
In that Ice Crystal Division Palace endowed with immense solidity and containing a hint of Rule force, a domain of Thunderflame Law spread across several kilometers.
The Giant Beast, even more fearful at the center of the domain, stood tall with dark black patterns converging on the scale armor covering its entire body, resembling a fierce totem.
Huff, huff!!
The Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon breathed out hot breaths, and through a synchronized perspective with Jack Clark, gazed at the transparent page that now showed the Chaos Black Pattern Talent enhanced to top-tier.
“Roar! It’s still not enough, I must grow stronger.”
As the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon roared, fifty thousand Attribute points vanished from the attribute page in an instant, transforming into a torrent of more powerful enhancement energy that burst inside its body through the Soul Channel.
Boom!
A vicious aura beyond description erupted in an instant; the entire Ice Crystal Divine Palace shuddered, and high above at ten thousand meters altitude, the sky changed as dark clouds gathered.
The ascent of the Chaos Black Pattern Talent to Deification was truly a fearsome sight.
Under the dreadful might, the surrounding World trembled; mountains shook, rousing the other Giant Beasts, including the slumbering Silver Giant Dragon, which couldn’t help but defy its drowsiness and open its eyes wide.
“Roar! Tim Abott has become abnormal again!”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon atop the distant Mountain Peak also gaped in astonishment, unable to resist sitting up a bit to turn and look toward the direction of the Ice Crystal Divine Palace.
Even if the Thunderflame Heavenly Dragon had already altered its life aura, the bloodline aura of the third Talent becoming Divine still exuded a terrifying presence.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 871: 373 Re-equipped Overlord Dragon, Awakening of the Demon God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: Chapter 373 Re-equipped Overlord Dragon, Awakening of the Demon God_3
And those alien priests in the divine temples all knelt to the ground, trembling violently.
At the same time, on the head of the black-red colossal beast shrouded in black smoke, the purple little dragon’s eyes widened in shock.
Yi ya yi ya!?
Suddenly, the purple little dragon remembered the roar of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon before its strength surged, “Not enough, I must become even stronger,” and immediately, the purple little dragon became excited.
Yi ya yi ya!! The purple little dragon let out a series of naive shouts, but despite shouting for a long time, it noticed no response, which made it visibly puzzled.
The purple little dragon wondered if it got the posture wrong?
...
Thinking of this, the purple little dragon imitated the roaring posture of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon from before. Its slender body stood upright as it clasped its double claws and roared towards the sky.
Yi ya yi ya!! Not enough, the great May must become even stronger.
…
Under the terrifying pressure of the Black-red Colossal Beast’s breakthrough, the red sun in the sky gradually set, while the blue sun in the east had already risen, casting a cold blue radiance.
Compared to the Blue Star World, a day and night transition equates to forty days in the mythical world, which has a much larger span of time.
As half a day passed, chaotic black fog churned within the Ice Crystal Division Palace, filled with cracks. Standing at its center was a ferocious behemoth that was over seven hundred meters in length.
By now, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon had undergone some changes; its originally sleek scale armor had once again become thicker, appearing as if it was clad in heavy armor, and exuding a strong sense of oppression.
Especially its pair of black-red double claws had turned pitch-black and fierce, with the sharp tips exuding a terrifying aura, seemingly tearing through space with their movements.
Moreover, the original pure golden vertical pupils now had black lines at their centers, with black lightning coiling around the edges, emitting a terrifying pressure.
In this form, the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was not only more fearsome, but the invisible might spreading from its body also became more formidable, pressing the surrounding space to emit cracking sounds, creating black cracks that were continuously healing.
This was just the external change; the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon could clearly feel that its giant beast body had become much more powerful overall.
The muscles had become tougher, capable of unleashing greater foundational strength, including better scale armor defense, recovery abilities, and the energies of its various top-tier talents had also become more profound.
As the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon was sensing the changes from the breakthrough, a flash of purple radiance appeared before him, and the purple little dragon manifested in front of its black gold vertical pupils.
Yi ya yi ya!?
The little fellow was asking the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon why, after shouting about getting stronger for so long and making its throat dry, there was still no response on its body.
The Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but find it a little amusing. Its fearsome mouth cracked open slightly, “I became stronger because I sacrificed and burned those life crystals and giant beast essences.”
Yi ya yi ya!? Confusion appeared in the purple little dragon’s eyes, curious about whom the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon sacrificed those things to.
The Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon growled lowly, “I don’t know. This is my talent. Sacrificing allows me to temporarily enhance my enlightenment, and improve my talents and purify bloodline powers.”
Since the little one had always followed him, it was impossible to hide the transportation of items through the Spatial Channel from it, thus the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon further refined the excuse, adding a layer of sacrifice.
Yi ya yi ya!! The purple little dragon’s eyes lit up. So that was it – next time it would also sacrifice, and it also wanted to get stronger.
As the little fellow was pondering what to sacrifice next time, both Jack Clark and Thunder Flame Dragon were looking at the attribute page.
Avatar Body: Thunder Flame. Destruction. Armored Overlord Dragon
Level: Mythical Giant Beast [An ancient beast possessing two higher-order laws, one deification talent, and six top-tier talents, its life level is nearly on par with the legendary Heavenly Tier.]
Innate Physique Talent: Chaos Black Pattern [Deified, covered all over the body, containing chaotic power of innate divine runes, immune to all types of law power, unless the limit is broken.
Chaotic Dark Body: The innate divine runes, strengthened to the extreme, continuously temper the body with Chaotic Dark Power, the muscles and bones will gradually gain immunity characteristics.
Remark: This talent has already acquired chaotic characteristics, ready to be upgraded to higher-order law of Chaotic Dark Power at any time, invincible to all laws.]
Because all three deification talents were related to the body, the form and name of the avatar giant beast changed once again through continuous enhancement, becoming the Armored Overlord Dragon.
“Chaotic Dark Power Law.” Both Jack Clark and the Overlord Dragon couldn’t help but slightly curl the corners of their mouths, revealing two sinister smiles.
Inside the Ice Crystal Division Palace, the Overlord Dragon took out the ball of white flame, swallowed it in one gulp, and at the same time, invoked the Chaos Black Pattern talent to touch the Law.
Boom! In the depths of the Void, a terrifying law power was drawn forth. Instantly, the Overlord Dragon’s body became laden with flourishing black radiance, and gradually it fell into hibernation.
When a talent rises to the status of a law, it will draw law power to temper the body. The Overlord Dragon will likely sleep for several days to complete this process.
As the avatar giant beast fell into hibernation, Jack Clark also shifted his attention to himself.
At this moment, he stood eighty meters tall, with three-faces and six-arms, and behind him four rings of yellow, golden, black, and blue Divine Wheels slowly rotated, looking like a Demon God from ancient times.
The left side of his face was covered in fine red scales, his eyes filled with endless blood light, imposing and terrifying as if he was the Lord of Hell.
The right side of his face, however, was identical to Jack’s, although his eyes were tightly shut, with terrifying power gathering beneath the eyelids, as if opening them would Destroy Heaven and Earth.
And the original Jack’s face in front no longer had the eye-like red rune on his forehead, which turned into a black mark reminiscent of a blade, looking imposing and compelling.
The four arms behind him were made of Heavenly Flame and Thunder, while the faces on the left and right were manifestations of power, semi-transparent and ethereal, so they did not look too terrifying or fierce.
All the surrounding Mysterious Yellow Air had disappeared, absorbed by Jack, and his entire being exuded an innate sacred breath.
After more than half a month in closed-door cultivation, not only had he completed the transformation from his physique and soul to the Innate Demon God, but his cultivation had also broken through to the Ninth Heavens.
Moreover, having absorbed the Mysterious Yellow Air, as he broke through to the Nine Layers, his body and cultivation methods underwent an earth-shattering transformation.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: Chapter 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)
In the void, after feeling the changes in his body, Jack Clark’s realm of thought moved, and his massive figure began to shrink instantly, quickly returning to his normal size.
His figure was tall and straight, covered in gorgeous black-red armor, with long pitch-black hair flowing down his back like a waterfall, and his gaze was icily indifferent, exuding an invisible, terrible pressure.
After his body was reshaped, both Jack Clark’s physique and appearance had undergone subtle adjustments, almost reaching the perfect state of human genetics.
However, although he had become more handsome and his hair draped over his shoulders, there was not a hint of effeminacy about him at this moment.
Having felt the new God Demon body, Jack Clark’s gaze then fell on the transparent page in front of him.
Realm: Ninth Heavens [Early Stage]
...
Dragon Physique: 10.5314 [Innate birthright, known as the immortal breed of Innate Gods and Demons]
Dragon Strength: 10.7218
Dragon Agility: 9.2542
Spirit: 92378
Battle Demon God Body: Re-cast with a massive amount of Mysterious Yellow Air, resonating with Heaven and Earth, capable of mobilizing a vast range of Heavenly Energy to increase might a hundredfold.
Cultivation Methods Feature: Halberd, when you wield a halberd-type weapon, the Halberd Skill will become unmatched in sharpness, slashing through everything before you.
Fleshly Divine Power: Supreme Vacuum, after re-casting the True Demon God Body, the Talent Rune power evolved into Divine Power, powerful and unmatched, shattering the vacuum.
Fleshly Divine Power: Absolute Barrier, after re-casting the True Demon God Body, the Talent Rune Defense evolved into Divine Power surrounding the body, unbreakable.
Fleshly Divine Power: Heaven-walking Divine Steps, after re-casting the True Demon God Body, the Talent Rune Agility evolved into Divine Power surrounding the body, stepping over Heaven, ignoring obstacles.
Talent: Hundred Tribulations True Thunder, amalgamating four Thunderbolt Law Fragments innately to cast True Thunder, evolving into Higher-order Law, Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder upon breaking through the mythical realm.
Talent: Positive Pole Heavenly Flame, containing explosive characteristics and extremely high temperatures of Flame Power, evolving into Higher-order Law, Great Sun Heaven Flame upon breaking through the mythical realm.
Hidden Deity Power: Upon reshaping the God Demon body, the power of the Hidden Deity rune is integrated, usually concealing the Aura and Divine Might, temporarily erasing the sense of existence when used.
Void-Striking Heart Eye: Merged into the True Demon God Body, can suddenly sense danger and prying, and at its ultimate cultivation, it will be able to see the future.
Divine Might Entwining: Your strength will be fixed at its peak, never declining until exhaustion or the depletion of vitality.
Four Domains Power: Blessed by the force of the Fourth Layer miniature planes, combined with the Defense Divine Power to form the Fourfold Boundary Wall, fourfold overlay, immovable.
Demon God’s True Body: Enter the Three-faced Six-armed Demon God’s True Body form, unleashing all strength and divine powers, opening the Doomsday Domain to overlap with the Fourth Layer Heaven realm.
In the Demon God’s True Body form, the Lord of Purgatory controls the Doomsday Layer Domain, drawing forth the power of Hell to descend, making Heaven and Earth like Hell.
In the Demon God’s True Body form, the Lord of Void controls the Void and Death; when the eyes are opened, sixteen times the power of the Void Rules is obtained to shatter the void and judge death.
Battle Demon God. Dragon: Consuming the innate Demon God Origin, merging and containing all powers to enter the form of the Demon God Dragon, with the ultimate power of destruction.
Note: Consuming the Demon God Origin will slow down the growth of the divine body, use it with caution.]
Deification Talent: Soul Split, Void Double Pupils
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Third Layer, Emperor of the Soul]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Technique + [Grand Accomplishment]
Equipment: Eight Desolate Battle Sky Halberd [Legendary Level], Dragon Scales and Phoenix Feathers Battle Armor [Legendary Level]
Attribute points: 24321
This evolution of Jack Clark was nearly earth-shattering, as his self-created Cultivation Methods, Talent Runes, Cultivation Method Runes, all powers merged with the divine body into a new force.
For example, the three innate fleshly talents from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon were originally supposed to evolve into similar abilities when Jack Clark broke through to the Ninth Heavens; they had now directly transformed into Divine Powers.
Divine Powers differ from Laws; they are like laws but even more special powers.
They don’t require enlightenment and cultivation; the Divine Powers grow stronger as one’s strength grows, extremely overbearing.
However, Jack Clark had complete Cultivation Methods and Talents, unlike the legendary Innate Gods and Demons that were born a blank slate, so his realm was still referenced against the current power system.
Moreover, the Four Major Attributes also skyrocketed to over one hundred thousand after absorbing the Mysterious Yellow Air and breaking through to the Mythical-level during the Fifth Evolution of the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon.
When converted, it was as if the strength of ten Dragon-type Giant Beasts was compressed into human size, making Jack Clark’s body terrifyingly powerful.
At this moment, Jack Clark felt unprecedentedly powerful, feeling that he could even battle against mythical beings.
With an early stage Ninth Heaven’s cultivation base, he might hard-fight and even suppress a mythological being… Boom! Boom! Boom! Suddenly, the entire Heart of the World shook, massive pitch-black cracks tearing the world apart.
“This is collapsing!”
Jack Clark’s expression tensed, and without hesitation, his figure flashed, turning into a streak of residual light and shooting out, reaching the shaking entrance in a few breaths and bursting through it.
But just after coming out of the Heart of the World, Jack Clark’s face changed slightly, as the entire Heaven and Earth were collapsing.
Space Tear, the Earth collapsing, abyssal cracks extending for thousands of kilometers in the sky continuously spread, devouring everything.
With the disappearance of the Mysterious Yellow Air and the collapse of the Heart of the World, the last bit of balance that this world had struggled to maintain was broken, everything shattered, and, eventually, it would completely merge with the mythical world.
Under the advent of Doomsday, at this moment, all the Level 9 Giant Beasts and Mythical Giant Beasts lurking within the Black Forbidden Zone let out frightened roars, bursting with power as they rushed towards the outer peripheries.
And with the imminent ‘total destruction’ of the world, Jack Clark did not dare to delay, his Void-Striking Heart Eye opened to sense the dangers in the unknown depths, transforming into a streaming light soaring out.

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: Chapter 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)_2
Under the Divine Power of God-like Speed, Jack’s velocity was extremely terrifying, covering kilometers in nearly a single step.
Boom! A meteorite with a diameter of a kilometer, resembling a small hill, exploded in front of him, and in the midst of the sky filling with smoke and dust, Jack transformed into a ray of black-gold light piercing through everything.
Whoosh!! Sensing danger with his mind, Jack instantly flashed through three massive cracks that suddenly opened, but just then, a vast distortion appeared in the space ahead.
Thud! Surrounded by the Defense of the Fourfold Boundary Wall infused with Space Power, Jack directly passed through that distorted space, creating a black pathway.
Boom!
At the moment Jack disappeared, the space within several kilometers violently collapsed, forming a Destruction Black Hole that devoured everything, cutting through the Void.
...
This Great Destruction began at the center of the forbidden area, so many Giant Beasts that felt the shaking of Heaven and Earth and some Human Race pioneering teams on the edges had time to escape.
Only those on the outermost edges could flee, while many Giant Beasts and powerful beings nested in the center and Middle Layer Region had no way out.
Roar!
As the sky fell and the earth sunk, a Giant Beast over six hundred meters in length emitting the oppressive aura of the Early Myth, was swept into the Spatial Storm and disappeared in the blink of an eye into the chaotic depths of the Void.
This scene caused a passerby in the distance, upon catching sight from Jack’s perspective, to tense up, followed by a slight change in expression.
“Not good!”
Ahead of Jack, the space within thousands of kilometers abruptly shattered, the Earth tore apart, and billions of tons of rock and dirt were swallowed by the violent Space Turbulence.
Including Jack.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In the midst of the Void Turbulence, the Space Storm roared around Jack, violently colliding with the encircling Fourfold Boundary Wall and emitting rings of silver Energy Halos.
“This is quite troublesome,” Jack said, his expression tense.
What concerned him was not the roaring storms around him, as with his current strength, these storms, which could heavily injure Ninth Heaven Experts, were simply unable to shake his Defense.
Moreover, because his Void Death Pupil had been enhanced to the point of Deification, he was almost immune to the erosion of the Void, or rather, he himself could be considered half a Void Creature.
What made Jack feel troublesome was that the Void was boundless, and once lost in it, returning to the Material World would be very difficult.
However, this area belonged to the collapsing region of the world, where cracks leading to the Material World were everywhere, and he just needed to find one to break through.
Suddenly, Jack sensed something, and a Black-gold battle halberd appeared in his hand.
In the pitch-black depths of the Void teeming with violent turbulence, a thousand-meter-long, purple-golden War Halberd soared across the Void, bursting through everything, and struck a crack that passed by in a flash.
Boom!
……
The Earth was filled with undulating mountain ranges, but on the barren land where no green vegetation could be seen for thousands of kilometers, three figures flashed by at several times the speed of sound.
Two of the figures shone with blue and red light, emanating the powerful aura of Late Eighth Layer and the peak, trailing behind them rolling pillars of smoke and dust as they swept over the ground at Supersonic Speed.
A hundred meters above the two figures, a seventy-meter-long White Divine Dragon circled. Although its aura indicated Mid-eighth level, its Speed was no less than the two below.
Behind them, over a dozen kilometers away, more than ten figures were in pursuit. Each of these beings stood over ten meters tall, their bodies covered in black Scale Armor, with cruel and fierce eyes.
The aura of at least Eighth Layer emanated from each of them, with the strongest being two beings over fifteen meters tall, Ninth Heaven Experts in the mid period.
The two pursuers shone with black light; with every stride that shattered the Earth, they crossed a hundred meters and rapidly closed in on the three fugitives.
At the forefront, a burly man with a full beard, Billy Jarvis, frowned, “No good, the strength of the Giant God Sect’s Archbishop is too formidable. If we continue like this, we will be caught. We must split up.”
Another, a woman in her thirties with a high ponytail, nodded, “I’ll do it. I have the Green Light Shuttle. We’ll meet up at the prearranged location.”
“Alright.”
Billy Jarvis nodded and then looked up, shouting, “Miss Keller, we’re going to split up. Remember, no matter what happens, don’t look back.”
At this moment, one of the fifteen-meter-tall Archbishop from the Giant God Sect, emanating the might of Mid-term of Ninth Heaven, was closing in rapidly, his expression fierce and roaring.
“Federation curs, today this Archbishop will tear you to shreds.”
Boom! The giant covered in black Scales swelled in size, unleashing an earth-shattering Terrifying Power. With an outstretched hand, a hundred-meter-tall black hillock appeared.
As soon as the Black Seal, resembling a small hill, emerged, the Earth within a radius of one mile sank, collapsing and depressing ten meters under a terrifying heavy force.
Roar! The White Divine Dragon circling in the sky let out a Dragon Roar, bursting with powerful Strength that caused Billy Jarvis, running at the forefront, to change complexion drastically.
“Miss Keller, that’s the Giant God Sect’s Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal, an Overbearing force that crushes everything. It cannot be met head-on.”
But clearly, their concern was unwarranted, as amid the roars, the White Divine Dragon shone with a dazzling White Light, its Speed surged instantly, shooting out like a white beam.
At the same time, one of the pursuers manifested a pair of blue wing shadows on his back, and the other’s feet flickered with yellow light; under the burst of their Secret Skill, their Speeds shot up sharply.
As strong men assigned to special tasks, each of them possessed at least one speed-boosting Secret Skill.
It’s just that such Skills were highly consuming and couldn’t be used recklessly under normal circumstances.
Boom!
Just as the three of them surged in Speed, that Black Seal descended from the sky, layer upon layer of transparent space vibrating around it, bringing down a Mountains and Seas shaking tumult from the heavens.
In an instant, the Earth within hundreds of meters crumbled, and the surrounding rock and dirt were flung like a Tsunami, the land for a kilometer around buckling and rolling under the impact.

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
:i>Dsipgex "1?&8Chapter 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)_3The invisible sonic wave that burst forth from that strike instantly swept across a range of several kilometers, causing Eddy Keller and the other two, who were in the midst of their escape, to halt in their tracks.
“Roar! Stay where you are.” Another Ninth Heaven Mid-term giant erupted with a savage aura; his leg muscles swelled to twice their size, and a terrifying power burst forth.
Boom!
A hundred-meter radius collapsed, and with a powerful recoil aided by a secret skill, this Ninth Heaven giant shot into the sky like a tenfold supersonic cannonball.
Due to their cultivation methods, these Giant God Sect’s Ninth Heaven strong men could fly, but they were very slow.
However, they had their own set of countermeasures against these agile cultivators.
...
Sensing the rapidly approaching powerful pressure from behind, Liz Mason’s face dramatically changed, “We can’t wait any longer, I’ll lead them away, you all go first…”
Boom!
Just at that moment, the void hundreds of meters above the heads of Liz Mason, Billy Jarvis, and Eddy Keller suddenly shattered, forming a pitch-black crack that stretched for a hundred meters.
From within the dark fissure emerged a figure exuding a divine and demonic terrifying pressure.
However, just as Jack Clark emerged from the depths of the void, a figure enveloped by the aura of the Ninth Heaven Early Phase and surrounded by swirling black waves lunged towards him.
On his massive shoulders, he carried a black mound a hundred meters high, emanating a heavy and fearsome presence.
Seeing the emergence of Jack Clark, tearing through the void and radiating the pressure of a Ninth Heaven Early Phase figure, especially with the pure aura of the Human Race, Talor’s face twisted into a ferocious snarl.
“Another Federation lackey has come, die!”
Boom! The black mountain that Talor carried on his shoulders smashed down with a thunderous impact, the surrounding void exploded, and the shockwaves roared as if a meteor had descended from the heavens.
“Giant God Evil Sect.”
Jack Clark’s eyebrows raised slightly as the nearly four-meter long War Halberd in his hand shimmered, and he waved it effortlessly.
Boom!
Instantly, a purple-golden shadow of the War Halberd hundreds of meters long emerged, slashing through the air and solidifying space before it shattered, creating a kilometer-wide black vacuum.
Under that terrifying strike, the black mountain, smelted from a Black Gold Ore Mountain and immensely heavy, crumbled to pieces, and immediately following it was Talor’s fifteen-meter-tall, robust and unwavering Giant God’s Body.
Boom!
The dazzling purple-golden radiance exploded in the high sky, the violent shockwave whipped up waves of white mist that swept across a ten-kilometer area, with the wind howling and the sand and stones flying.
In an instant, everything quieted down, whether it was the trio of Eddy Keller fleeing in front or the pursuing Giant God Sect apostles, all subconsciously stopped in their tracks.
Looking at the towering figure in the sky, everyone’s expressions were grave and filled with disbelief.
“This guy, he’s already reached the Ninth Heavens!” Recognizing Jack Clark’s formidable presence at a glance, Eddy Keller’s face revealed astonishment.
As someone who had repeatedly been shocked by Jack Clark’s exploits, Eddy Keller was just a bit surprised, but even more so delighted.
The delight was naturally because Jack Clark’s combat prowess was still as terrifying as ever, butchering his peers as if they were mere dogs.
With him here today, not a single one of these pursuing Giant God Sect Cultists would get away.
Thinking this, Eddy Keller yelled, “Junior Clark, don’t let any of those Giant God Evil Sect cultists escape!”
Equally bewildered, Jack Clark looked indifferent, nodding slightly, his gaze settling on another Ninth Heaven Mid-term Giant God Sect Cultist in the distance.
Boom!
Jack Clark took a step forward, appearing instantly, just like teleporting, in front of that Ninth Heaven Mid-term giant several kilometers away, moving so fast it surpassed their ability to react.
Bang!
Before that Ninth Heaven strong man could react, half of his body was blown to bits by the heavy War Halberd, with countless remnants of flesh and blood mixed with violent energy spraying across hundreds of meters.
Such a terrifying show of force instantly caused the Evil God Sect Cultists of the Eight Layer to change color, including a Late Eighth Layer bishop who shouted sternly.
“That Federation strong man is too powerful, we can’t hold him back, everyone, scatter and run, take the message back.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
Those massive cultists erupted with power, the surrounding ground shattered under their formidable strength, and they burst forth in all directions at an extreme speed.
But just as these people accelerated, a pair of black gold vertical pupils that could eclipse the sun appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes, and a terrifying force of the Void descended instantly.
Thud, thud, thud!!
Space shattered several kilometers distant, forming over a dozen black holes that covered a range of more than ten meters each, devouring everything around them, including the torn bodies of the thirteen Giant God Sect apostles.
“So strong!”
Watching the various black holes devour everything before dissolving slowly as space repaired itself, Billy Jarvis swallowed hard, his expression one of shock.
Not even a minute had passed since Jack Clark’s appearance, and he had obliterated two Ninth Heaven strong men and over a dozen Eighth Layer bishops, his combat strength was truly terrifying.
Looking at the figure standing proudly in the distant air, Liz Mason let out a slow breath and turned slightly to the side, “Miss Keller, do you know that person?”
Eddy Keller’s eyes were also complex, nodding, “I reckon I do, Junior Clark broke through to the Eighth Layer with me at the Forward Base just a month ago.”
“What! Miss Keller, you mean to say he was just at the Eighth Layer Early Phase a month ago!” The two of them were once again shocked.
Breaking through from the Eighth Layer Early Phase to the Ninth Heaven in just one month, what sort of monstrous cultivation speed was this?
Looking at the two shocked faces, Eddy Keller spoke gloomily, “It’s not just a layer a month, it seems he hasn’t even graduated from Senior One yet.”
Cough, cough!! The burly figure choked on his own saliva, his face turning red as he coughed violently, an almost impossible feat for an Eight Layer strong man.

chapters.title: Chapter 875: 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: Chapter 374 The True Innate Demon God, Heading to the Frontline Battlefield (Major Chapter)_4
Liz Mason was also taken aback, hardly believing what she was hearing: “Miss Keller, are you sure you’re not joking?”
Senior One hasn’t even graduated yet, which means that terrifying black-haired young man reached the Ninth Heavens within a year!!
“Sister Liz, do you think I would joke about something like this? Also, can you please call me Eddy Keller, not ‘Miss Keller?'” Eddy Keller was a bit annoyed.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s figure flickered in the distance, closing a mile with each step, and in the blink of an eye, he appeared before everyone.
Looking at Eddy Keller, tall and dressed in white as snow, Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile and greeted, “Senior Keller, long time no see.”
Eddy Keller replied with some annoyance, “Actually, it hasn’t been that long, just a month, but Junior Clark, you are still such a freak, having already made a breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens.”
...
Jack Clark chuckled, “It’s alright, I came across some opportunities during this trip, so my cultivation advanced a bit faster.”
“But you’re not far behind, Senior Keller, having already broken through to the Mid-eighth level. Truly worthy of a genius comparable to an Innate Awakened One,” Jack Clark said admiringly.
Compared to him, Eddy Keller was the real monster.
Even though at the moment, Eddy Keller’s aura seemed a bit unstable, and his breakthrough to the Mid-eighth level was somewhat forced, requiring more time to progress to the later stages, it was still quite extraordinary.
After all, even after the Eight Layer, he was still advancing a minor realm each month.
From Jack Clark’s sincere tone, Eddy Keller could tell there was no mockery intended, but it was still somewhat vexing, prompting him to change the subject.
“Junior Clark, let’s not talk about that. Thank you for lending a hand today. Otherwise, we would have had to pay a heavy price to shake off those guys,” he said.
“It’s nothing, we all belong to the Federation, and naturally, I couldn’t stand by in such a situation,” Jack replied.
After the pleasantries, Eddy Keller briefly introduced the group.
The bearded giant man named Billy Jarvis, Liz Mason, and Eddy Keller themselves were all currently affiliated with the 30th Army Group’s Outer Development Department and were on a mission.
They had been pursued by the strong men of the Giant God Sect because they had stumbled upon important information about the Evil God Grayson.
However, Jack Clark did not inquire about the specifics of that information.
Meanwhile, Eddy Keller and the others were heading to Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain, more than a thousand kilometers away. It was the Territory of a Human Race King-level powerhouse and was neutral.
After Eddy Keller finished speaking, Jack Clark’s face showed a hint of surprise: “So the area ahead is the Immortal Domain of Jewell True Immortal, have I already reached the Divine Gods Alliance?”
The Divine Gods Alliance was a vast alliance located tens of thousands of kilometers from the Federation’s 30th Army Group’s station, holding a wide range of power.
This alliance included seven King-level powerhouses from the Human Race, Blood God Acunus, and other Evil God defectors from the Evil God Sect, as well as over twenty Mythical Powerhouse from different races.
In an alliance of nearly forty Mythical Powerhouses, the strongest was a Supreme Expert from a different race, followed by three Heavenly Kings.
Among those Human Kings who joined the Divine Gods Alliance, one who hailed from Berlin self-proclaimed as Beast God, Simon claimed himself as True God, and those from Eastern Summer called themselves Immortals.
The territory they had their cultivation bases in were known as Beast God Realm, Divine Realm, and Immortal Realm respectively.
The aforementioned Jewell True Immortal was a late period King-level powerhouse standing tall in the Immortal Realm; even ordinary Heavenly Kings struggled against him.
But in some confidential information Jack Clark had seen, it was subtly mentioned that some ‘neutral’ Human Experts were not as simple as they appeared.
The information hinted that if he faced danger in the future whilst deep within the Divine Gods Alliance, he could seek refuge in the realms of those few neutral Human Experts.
With this in mind, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted subtly.
In the midst of conversation, the group quickly approached the Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain under the sound barrier cruise.
A white translucent barrier towered into the clouds, extending to the edges of the Earth on both sides. Inside the barrier, birds chirped and flowers fragranced, with beautiful mountains and rivers as if it were a fairyland.
Outside the barrier, the land was barren and desolate.
Hum!
Eddy Keller and the other two figures passed directly through the white barrier, causing ripples to spread out, and as they did, an invisible fluctuation swept over their bodies.
Just then, as he entered the Immortal Realm, Eddy Keller looked back and mentioned, “By the way, Jack Clark, I encountered Junior Aiken three days ago. She ventured into the Divine Gods Alliance alone.”
Jack Clark was slightly startled, “Student Aiken, has she made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer already?”
“Senior Keller, did Student Aiken say where she was headed?”
Eddy Keller shook his head, “No, she only asked me for directions before she left.”
