Jack Clark nodded and, after watching Eddy Keller and the other two disappear into the depths of the Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain, he also turned to fly off in another direction.
His goal was to return to the 30th Army Group station.
As for Jane Aiken, although the girl was obsessed with martial cultivation, she wasn’t foolish, as evidenced by her performance during the Koroya Trial.
Therefore, Jack Clark wasn’t worried about her safety.
This time, her venture deep into the Divine Gods Alliance after her breakthrough to the Seventh Layer was likely to seek information about her nemesis.
And everyone has their path to follow; Jane Aiken went in search of her enemy to seek revenge, and he also had his own matters to attend to—he was headed to the Frontline Battlefield.
On the Frontline Battlefield, Human Experts and The Purgatory Family’s Mythical-level and above strong men stood against each other. In such a scenario, with his combat prowess, he could dominate the battlefield unrivaled.
Of course, this opportunity to kill indiscriminately would only come once; afterward, he would be targeted by even stronger demon kings or Great Demon Kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 876: 375: Exile Across the Void, Cloud Sky One
chapters.content:
Chapter 876: Chapter 375: Exile Across the Void, Cloud Sky One
The grand and ancient palace was shrouded in rolling black fog, with a towering figure sitting high on the throne, invisible yet emanating a terrifying aura that shook the Void.
Just when those two Mid-term Ninth Heaven archbishops were blasted to oblivion by Jack Clark, the black fog around the towering figure churned, and a deep humming sound emerged slowly.
“Talor and the others, dead.”
Seated high on the throne, the body of the mountainous Grayson was detached in his gaze.
There were few followers who had reached the Ninth Heaven even within the Giant God Sect, and they were almost transformed into Quasi-Divine Level Holy Spirits. Therefore, Grayson sensed their deaths the moment they perished.
Boom!
...
As Grayson’s enormous palm stretched out, the space in front began to shake, black Demonic Qi surged, and space shattered, revealing a broken silhouette from the depths of the Void.
Using himself as a coordinate and pulled by faith, Grayson forcibly summoned back the remnant soul of a Ninth Heaven Expert whose obsession hadn’t dissipated after being blown apart with a casual strike by Jack Clark.
The Ninth Heaven had already begun the transition from mortal to divine, with robust bodies and strong, tenacious soul wills. Even if they were slain, traces of their existence would linger for a long time.
It was similar to when King-level strong men fell and their rules manifested, turning into a Blood Moon, after which the Heavenly Energy in that area of Heaven and Earth remained concentrated, and the rules lingered for a long time.
“With the strength of Talor and the others, to kill them would require at least Ninth Heaven Peak strength. Has the Federation had Quasi-Divine experts infiltrate us already?”
In the deep humming sound, black light waves flooded around Grayson, and in an instant, the vestige of the remaining soul melted, vaguely forming a blurry picture.
In the hazy image, a figure wearing black-red armor slowly emerged.
As a Veteran Evil God, Grayson and his ilk, aside from their formidable cultivation, had mastered many methods.
Over the years, it wasn’t only the Federation that had been exploring the mythical world; they too had searched many relics of civilization, including dealings with the Alien Deities of alliances.
To those Alien Deities, those neutral Human Kings and these Evil Gods were all the same; they could trade as long as there was benefit.
This trade included part of their power systems, Secret Skills, or exchange of resources, which was also why the Divine Gods Alliance had formed.
But just as Grayson was trying to clearly see through the remnants of his followers’ souls who had killed his subordinates, suddenly from the depths of the Void, a pair of black gold vertical pupils appeared.
Boom!
The moment the black gold vertical pupils appeared, a Terrifying Power pierced through the Void. With a perception in the unseen realms, it homed in on its target and instantly tore open a black and white pathway that was a hundred meters long.
Under the terrifying power of exile, the entire palace trembled. With sixteenfold Void Rules amplifying the force, even Grayson’s expression changed slightly in the face of the powerful tearing power.
“Scram!” With a low roar, a power that was Mythical Peak and even surpassed Mythical-level Burst forth from Grayson, instantly the Demon Power was overwhelming, shaking Heaven and Earth.
Rolling Demon Power formed a shadow behind Grayson that blotted out the sun and sky. A humongous palm covered in black scales descended from above, holding a black mountain and smashing it with Destroy Heaven and Earth might onto the dimensional cracks.
Boom!
Beneath the exploding black mountain, the dimensional pathway shattered, and the horrifying strike destroyed vast portions of space, creating powerful shockwaves that annihilated everything around.
Boom boom boom!! The grand palace’s walls, covered in countless runes, shone brightly, only to collapse under the residual impacts, causing the Earth to tremble and smoke and dust to fill the air.
As a Mythical Peak expert, in the Divine Realm blessed by the might of Heaven and Earth, Grayson’s power was terrifying, destroying the dimensional rift caused by the Void Exile with a single strike.
However, looking at the main hall that had been reduced to ruins, Grayson’s face was somewhat grim.
He hadn’t expected that those supporting the Federation’s dogs and spies would be a king-level being. It seemed his plans had been compromised and he would need to abandon them for now.
…
Atop a small hill thousands of meters high, the blood-colored rune in the center of Jack Clark’s forehead, which looked like an eye, slowly dimmed, and the black gold vertical pupils in his eyes also receded gradually.
Jack Clark slowly said, “So, the Giant God, Grayson.”
Feeling an unknown scrutiny earlier and locating it with his heartfelt perception, Jack Clark had unleashed the Eyes of Void and Death. Despite the vast distance, he had crossed swords with that Evil God from seemingly nowhere.
That strike had consumed ninety percent of the energy of his double pupils and, amplified by the Void Rules, its might could even exile an ordinary Mythical King.
Facing such power involving Void Rules, unless the opponent mastered space and Void-related rules, or they destroyed the dimensional rift with absolute strength, they couldn’t counter it.
With his cultivation having Broken Through to the Nine Layers, as his life essence transformed into that of Innate Gods and Demons, Jack Clark’s power became even more mysterious, somewhat resembling the Immortal Gods from the legends.
Looking back towards the depths of the Divine Gods Alliance, Jack Clark’s voice was cold, “Next time you come, I’ll kill you.”
Roar! In the distance, the mountain forest shook, and Giant Beasts of Level 5, Level 6, and even Level 7 let out ferocious roars. They surged towards Jack Clark with brutal and fierce momentum.
Near Jack Clark, a Dark Red Bottle fluctuated in the air with blood-colored runes sparkling at its mouth. A strong scent of blood permeated the air, radiating from the god attractor within.
At this point, Jack Clark had already traveled thousands of kilometers away from the Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain. According to the map, if he continued south for ten thousand kilometers, he would step outside the territory of the Divine Gods Alliance.
Then after traveling another twenty thousand or so kilometers, avoiding seven dangerous forbidden areas and circumventing four perilous regions, he would arrive at the 30th Army Group’s stationed location.
This time, Jack Clark had been quite fortunate; after being swept into a Void Storm, he had appeared on the fringe of the Divine Gods Alliance, not too far from the Human Territory.
Thus, on his journey back, he planned to kill some Unique Beasts along the way and collect Life Crystals.

chapters.title: Chapter 877: 375: Exile Across the Void, Cloud Sky One_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 877: Chapter 375: Exile Across the Void, Cloud Sky One_2
“`
With the breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens, the fusion of Cultivation Methods, talent, and rune refining, Jack Clark’s avatar no longer had a significant need for attribute points, except that Space-Time Summoning Technique could still be enhanced.
However, while his avatar’s demand was temporarily small, his primary body still had a great need for attribute points— and a lot of them.
The remaining six top-tier talents each required 50,000 attribute points to strengthen to God Transformation Level, especially the Giantification Talent, which needed 150,000 points.
Jack Clark also had a premonition that when he made the breakthrough to the Mythical-level, his attribute page, which was his soul’s talent ability, would also undergo a transformation.
As Jack Clark mused, the surroundings had already drawn together over a thousand Unique Beasts of various sizes, with over a hundred winged exotic beasts spanning dozens of meters soaring towards him through the air.
...
And just as the fastest few flying exotic beasts approached within a kilometer, a ring of blue and white light wheel appeared behind Jack Clark’s head.
Boom, boom, boom!! In an instant, centered around the mountain peak, boundless Thunder burst forth, spreading outwards like a blue-white spherical thunderstorm in all directions.
Everywhere it passed, the earth exploded, trees snapped and burnt, and beast after beast let out pitiable and terrified roars as their hard and thick scale armor and flesh and blood exploded into pieces.
Especially those weaker Level 5 and Level 6 Exotic Beasts, which were directly blown into two or three sections under the bombardment of the blue-white Thunderbolts, each a meter thick.
The break points on those corpses were charred black, with flesh still radiating intense heat; the scene was terrifying.
In the blink of an eye, the whole mountain forest caught fire, thunder roared in the sky, and the land below was strewn with the mutilated bodies of massive beasts, as if Doomsday had arrived.
Standing atop the scorched mountain peak and surveying the scene below, Jack Clark frowned slightly.
Because the number of Unique Beasts drawn in this time was a bit small, and most of them were not of high level, with only one at level eight and a dozen or so at Level 7.
“Have all the ninth-level Giant Beasts been killed or driven away?” Jack Clark wondered.
Over the years, humans had formed a stable ‘trade route’ through transactions and good relationships with some neutral king-level figures and alien deities of the Divine Gods Alliance.
This trade route passed through several territories of neutral king-level figures from the Immortal Realm and Divine Realm, so there was no need to fear harassment from the Evil God Alliance in the other direction of the alliance.
Or rather, any cultist from the Evil God Alliance who dared to approach this area would be slaughtered by the ‘underlings’ of several Human Race deities.
As an influential neutral power, the Divine Gods Alliance has a rule that deities can have friction among themselves, but if there is an attack from an external force, all deities must act to counter it.
This is also why the few Evil God Sects have been able to go unchallenged for so long.
These sects are distant from human settlements, protected by the Divine Gods Alliance, and they have their own secret alliances with several alien deities and the demon kings of The Purgatory Family, making them no small power.
Amidst the roaring flames, Jack Clark’s figure streaked through the forest, shattering beast after beast, searching for Life Crystals.
After about an hour, having collected twelve Level 5, one Level 6, and one Level 7 crystal from over a thousand beast corpses, Jack Clark shot up into the sky.
Boom! Tens of thousands of meters up in the air, the wind howled around Jack Clark and sonic booms thundered as he, trailing a hundred-meter-long tail of light and airwaves, disappeared into the horizon in the blink of an eye.
On his journey thereafter, Jack Clark did not release any more god attractors, as the gains were too low.
This trade route had not only seen all the beasts above level eight killed or driven away, but even the blue sun in the sky was a bit off.
Under the cold light of the Blue Sun, the beasts had become lazy and calm, not nearly as easily drawn by the god attractor, significantly reducing its effectiveness.
So Jack Clark needed to either venture deeper into the mythical world from another direction, specifically hunting beasts to collect crystals, or head directly to the frontline.
As long as he killed enough of the Purgatory Demon Race, even slaying one or two of the demon kings, the feats he would earn should be enough to exchange for the crystals needed to enhance the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s talents.
Although the High-level Crystal reserves in a single army base weren’t large, what if he were to mobilize the reserves of all the major empires and army bases of the Federation?
…
Under the light of the Blue Sun, after flying for most of the day, Jack Clark finally arrived at the territory of the 30th Army Group, and then flew directly over the base city after passing Identity Verification from above.
He was heading to Base City of Channel One to collect a ‘delivery’.
Meanwhile, in the central complex of the base below, Knife King Joel Moore, who was in the midst of his cultivation, suddenly opened his eyes, and then slowly closed them again.
Following the map on the smart wristwatch and continuously matching it to the coordinates of the waypoints along the route, Jack Clark flew another 6,000-plus kilometers before finally returning to the Base City.
Above the huge and bustling sci-fi-styled city, transport and Throne Fighters constantly flew by, along with some flying giant beasts with wing spans of hundreds of meters.
Just then, the clouds in the sky dispersed to reveal a hollow, and a black figure shot down at an astonishing speed.
“Identity Verification passed, welcome Major General Callum. Please follow the signal to the Fifth Construction Base to receive your exclusive Throne Fighter,” a voice greeted.
On the rooftop of a towering building over 500 meters high, a middle-aged man in a military uniform, showing a smile, cordially said to the dark-haired young man descending from the sky, “Hello, Major General Callum. I’m Dan Lane, responsible for this fighter aircraft delivery.”
Jack Clark, calm and collected, nodded slightly, “Thank you for the trouble.”
Dan Lane hurriedly shook his head, “No trouble at all, no trouble at all.”
To Dan Lane, the young man before him was someone entitled to his own personal Throne Fighter; though Jack Clark’s aura was concealed and his tone mild, Dan Lane did not dare to treat him with anything less than the utmost respect.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 375: Exile Across the Void, Cloud Sky One_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 878: Chapter 375: Exile Across the Void, Cloud Sky One_3
Following Dan Lane, the two quickly took the elevator down to the internal warehouse of the base.
In the vast warehouse, there was a menacing-looking science fiction battleship, with more than 50 meters wingspan and almost 70 meters in length, parked inside.
The battleship’s overall color was primarily black and red, with two pairs of wings at the front and back; the front wings were wider and larger, while the back wings were much smaller.
“Major General Callum, this fighter aircraft is forged from the scale armor and skeleton of a stored Mythical-level Star Melting Giant Beast and a large amount of alloy with energy conduction properties.”
“The internal space of the fighter aircraft has been expanded, with the area being seventeen times what it appears from the outside, and it is divided into kinetic energy, defense, and attack sections.”
“The power section is further divided into a Crystal Core Power Furnace and a Nuclear Fusion Power Furnace.”
...
“The Crystal Core Power is suited for environments rich in Heavenly Energy like the mythical world; it can maintain normal flight by absorbing Heavenly Energy and only consumes energy from the Crystal Core Power Furnace during burst states.”
“If it appears in an environment devoid of Heavenly Energy, it can switch to the Nuclear Fusion Power Furnace mode. The current nuclear fuel added is enough to sustain full-speed flight for sixty years.”
“Besides, one-tenth of the fighter’s space is filled with enough nuclear fuel to sustain a thousand years of flight, so there is no need to worry about a lack of power.”
“At the same time, we’ve added a basic function that allows the fighter to absorb light, heat, and cosmic radiation and convert them into kinetic energy, which is suitable for the space environment of Blue Star.”
“The driving system of the fighter is divided into intelligent and manual operation; the attack section is further divided into conventional physical attacks and energy attacks.”
“Physical attacks are equipped with the most advanced supersonic missiles, surface-to-air missiles, surface-to-ground missiles, and drill-ground missiles, integrated with Crystal Energy and runes, each possessing immense power.”
“Furthermore, the weapons warehouse carries twenty nuclear warheads, comprising small ones of 300,000 yield, large ones of 1 million yield, and strategic-level Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs of 5 million yield.”
“As for more destructive weaponry with even greater power, those belong to the controlled category and must be applied for in order to be equipped.”
“The energy weapons are divided into four High-Energy Beam Secondary Cannons and one Particle Annihilation Main Cannon.”
“Particularly the Particle Annihilation Main Cannon, when charged at full strength, can even threaten ordinary Mythical-level beings and is equivalent to the strategic-level Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb of 5 million yield.”
“Defense is based on the Law Power carried by the Mythical Giant Beast Bones, with the Crystal Core Power Furnace as its core, forming a phase-space Energy Shield, capable of withstanding attacks from Level 9 Peak.”
“Also, for the convenience of Major General Callum’s travels, the entire aircraft, including the missiles, are compatible with subspace; normally they can be retracted into a subspace bracelet, and released when needed…”
Next, Dan Lane detailed the various parameters of the fighter aircraft to Jack Clark, and after covering most of it, he asked,
“Major General Callum, next you need to name this fighter aircraft and imprint your Spiritual Will into the control system core to activate the fighter.”
“To name it?”
Jack Clark pondered briefly, “Let’s call it Cloud Sky, Cloud Sky One.”
As Jack Clark confirmed the name, a dragon-shaped pattern with crossed swords in the middle, and the pilot cabin at the front of the fighter aircraft that resembled eyes, lit up.
Crackle Crackle!!
The doors of the warehouse slowly opened, and the dark red fighter aircraft was gradually drawn out.
Whoosh! Hot gusts of air surged down as the menacing dark red fighter aircraft ascended into the sky.
Boom!
As the sonic boom thundered, the fighter aircraft instantly accelerated to supersonic speed, getting faster and faster, soon reaching ten times the speed of sound as it flew towards the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield more than 15,000 kilometers away.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - 376 Strengthening the Boundary, Freya Louise: Where are you now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 879: Chapter 376 Strengthening the Boundary, Freya Louise: Where are you now?
Tens of thousands of meters above the ocean of clouds, a dark red fighter aircraft cuts across the skyline, appearing as if it were cruising on a boundless blue ocean under the sunlight.
With supersonic speed, sonic booms surround the aircraft, their roaring vibrations causing violent wind waves that form a misty pathway stretching for more than ten kilometers behind it.
Such commotion immediately caught the attention of some flying exotic beasts.
Roar! Seeing the red ‘creature’ that invaded their territory, a dozen beasts with wingspans of tens of meters let out piercing cries.
And as the flying exotic beasts swooped in, lights gathered beneath the double wings of the fighter aircraft.
Pew pew pew!! A series of red light beams with powerful penetrating force shot out, piercing through the heads of the exotic beasts of levels five and six in an instant.
...
Boom! Amidst a sky full of falling beast corpses, the aircraft surged forward, smashing another beast’s body into countless pieces of flesh and blood remnants, revealing its overbearing might.
At that moment, a large swath of red fog appeared ahead, forming a pillar of smoke reaching the heavens and covering a thousand kilometers, prompting the aircraft to tilt and circle around it in a wide arc.
Inside the aircraft, in the Cultivation Area, Jack Clark was sitting cross-legged.
A distance of over fifteen thousand kilometers, along with the numerous danger zones in between, meant it would take more than two hours for the aircraft to fly there; during this time, he planned to strengthen his Fourfold Plane World.
Hum! Behind Jack Clark, the luminescent wheel manifesting the four miniature plane worlds slowly emerged.
At the same time, fragments of skeleton essence from Level 9 Giant Beasts, quasi-mythical behemoths, and even Mythical Giant Beasts were taken out from the Sumeru Bracelet.
Especially, the skeleton essence refined from the remains of the Black Oblivion King caused even the aircraft to significantly shudder upon handling.
These giant beasts were massive in size, with even the smallest half-energy essence fragment from their bones measuring over ten meters in length and weighing tens of thousands of tons.
If it weren’t for the fact that this aircraft was also forged from the material of a Mythical Giant Beast and contained a space-expanding interior, even one essence fragment would be enough to disintegrate the aircraft.
Under the guidance of Jack’s thoughts, the yellow Earth World slowly unfolded in front of him, projecting a plane with a diameter of over ten meters.
Bang! Jack single-handedly grabbed a thirty-meter-long black skeleton essence from a quasi-mythical Blade Giant Beast and threw it into the projection, instantly shaking the world.
Boom! Half-energized materials containing the essence of matter were enveloped and refined by the World’s Power upon entering the Plane World.
In an instant, the whole world trembled slightly, the land stretched out, and the Boundary Wall encircling the plane became thicker and stronger as the essence burnt, with the space’s carrying capacity becoming more formidable.
Next were the Heavenly Flame World, the Black Wind World, and the Thunder World; as chunks of Giant Beast skeleton essence were thrown in, they blazed like four ‘fireballs’ burning around Jack.
In particular, the skeleton essence of the Black Smoke King entwined with a portion of a Mythical Giant Beast’s incomplete Laws’ Origin was a massive boost to the Fourfold Miniature World.
In Jack’s perception, the four worlds vibrated continuously, expanding from an area of five kilometers until they finally slowed down at nine kilometers.
As the ‘worlds’ strengthened, the Boundary Wall power surrounding Jack became even more potent, with the strength estimated to have doubled; stacked fourfold, the defense was terrifying.
Jack felt that even if he were to stand still, a cultivator in the late period of Ninth Heaven wouldn’t be able to breach his defenses.
As for the peak cultivators of Ninth Heaven, who had touched upon the laws, a single layer of the Fourfold Boundary Wall defense might not hold, and it was still necessary to stack True Strength and defensive Divine Powers to withstand them.
While Jack was discerning the changes in the Fourfold World, the aircraft crossed the skyline and soon, a sprawling city extending for thousands of kilometers appeared at the edge of the land.
As a frontline base established to halt the invasion of different races, Heavenly Abyss was built between two Destruction Forbidden Zones that not even two Heavenly Kings dared to enter.
Or rather, the Human Territory was a region formed after the collapse of a world, with Heavenly Abyss and Sky Curtain serving as two major passages; several army divisions in the Outer Development Department’s rear were several minor portals.
The vast base stretched for thousands of kilometers, divided into over fifty base districts and a bustling inner city housing millions. It was heavily defended.
Therefore, when the fighter aircraft approached within a hundred kilometers of Heavenly Abyss Battle City, an electronic voice rang out in the cockpit.
“Report, a communication request from the Heavenly Abyss Battle City control center has been received. Do you wish to connect?”
Each Throne Fighter signified a level of identity and authority, so even the control center of the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield couldn’t link up without Jack’s consent.
“Allow the connection.”
Following Jack’s confirmation, a cartoon image of a silver-haired, red-eyed girl appeared on the large screen in front of him and bowed slightly to Jack.
“Hello, Major General Jack Clark. I am the Heavenly Abyss Intelligent System, Vava. Welcome to the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield. Next, I will guide your aircraft to an emergency landing at Airport Seventeen.”
“Proceed,” Jack nodded.
“Look, it’s a Throne Fighter!”
As the dark red fighter entered the range of Heavenly Abyss Battle City, and with the dragon-shaped crossed sword and blade logo beneath it, many faces below brightened with excitement.
Because this signified the arrival of another King-level strong man at Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
Soon, as the dark red fighter descended, when it flew over the inner city at an altitude of a thousand meters, cheers erupted from the many people below.
“It’s a Throne Fighter we have never seen before.”
“The Federal Rear has sent another king-level support to Heavenly Abyss.”
“Wow! Mommy, look how cool that fighter is.”
As they watched the black and red warplane fly by above, many people on the street cheered and excitedly pointed at the passing aircraft.
Although this was the Frontline Battlefield, with the Enchantment laid down by Supreme Experts in combination with the Heavenly Abyss pathway and over a dozen King-level and Heavenly King-level figures in charge, the defense was as solid as a rock.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 376 Strengthening the Boundary, Freya Louise: Where are you now?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 880: Chapter 376 Strengthening the Boundary, Freya Louise: Where are you now?_2
Tens of kilometers from the inner city, at the 17th Base Airport, transport airplanes constantly took off and descended, while numerous vehicles and personnel carried supplies in and out.
Just then, a dark red fighter aircraft cut through the sky and descended vertically onto the vacant emergency landing platform. At once, many people turned somber, their eyes revealing awe as they gazed at the Throne Fighter.
Ssh! The tailgate of the fighter aircraft slowly opened, and Jack Clark, with his black hair draped over his shoulders, wearing a gray and white leisure suit, stepped down.
At this moment, Jack’s aura was concealed, making him appear like an ordinary person, one with extremely noble temperament, and a handsome and elegant ‘breakthrough human’.
Hum! A radiance flickered on the wristwatch worn by Jack, emitting a strong spatial power that enveloped the aircraft, turning it into a streak of white light and storing it into subspace.
“Hello, General Clark, I’m Lori Miller, assistant to Gabriel King.”
...
In the Seventh Corps, Jack was known as Darren Callum, but here, he did not conceal this pseudonym. With a mixture of truth and deception, it was easier to confuse the enemy.
Jack spoke with a gentle tone, “Thank you for your trouble, Miss Miller.”
With that, the two of them boarded something resembling a black, luxurious sports car that was a hovering vehicle, and with a whoosh, they flew towards the majestic building surrounded by cloud mist in the middle of the city.
Aboard the vehicle, Lori Miller briefed Jack on the current battle zone situation: “At present, there are seventeen kings stationed in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, along with three Heavenly Kings and the Second Councilor.”
“However, the Second Councilor usually stays in closed-door cultivation. Major affairs of the battle city are handled by Gabriel King, Divine Sky Heavenly King, and Overlord Dragon Heavenly King.”
“Among them, Gabriel King is responsible for internal affairs scheduling, Divine Sky Heavenly King is in charge of commanding the fourteen army legions, and Overlord Dragon Heavenly King is responsible for the command over the other kings.”
As she spoke, the vehicle arrived at the city center.
The towering Heavenly Abyss Building, with its middle section several thousand meters high, came to a gentle stop on a platform located one thousand meters up.
Following Lori Miller, Jack entered the bustling Service Hall, passed through several identity verification processes, and took the elevator to the top floor over four thousand meters high.
Lori Miller knocked on the door and respectfully announced, “Reporting to the Throne, Major General Callum has arrived.”
A soft voice came from inside.
“Let him in.”
“Yes.”
“General Clark, please.”
Jack gave a slight nod to Lori who opened the door, and then he walked in.
This was an office over ten meters high and spanning over a thousand square meters, filled with a soft white light. Jack’s gaze was immediately drawn to the blonde figure in the distance.
Compared to the earlier restrained presence of Mysterious Martial Sky King and Sky King Denny Kaye, the blonde woman standing amidst the light seemed like the source of all that radiance.
Incarnation of the law!
Jack’s eyes narrowed in an instant as he cordially said, “Pleased to meet you, Gabriel Throne.”
Gabriel smiled slightly, her voice gentle, “No need for formalities, have a seat and let’s talk.”
After Jack took a seat across from her, Gabriel exclaimed, “I didn’t expect you to break through to the Ninth Heavens so quickly. You truly are a genius that even the Councilor pays attention to.”
Jack modestly said, “You flatter me, King. The main reason I was able to break through so quickly was due to some opportunities I found in the forbidden area outside of the Seventh Corps.”
Gabriel laughed softly, “Many times, luck is also a form of strength; there’s no need to be modest.”
“What are your plans coming to Heavenly Abyss, are you headed to the battlefield or joining another department?” Even Gabriel could not ignore the opinions of a genius like Jack.
In the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, it wasn’t only about frontal combat; many departments involved in other matters also needed manpower, including high-end strong figures.
“My purpose here is simple, ‘to kill more’ of the Purgatory Demon Race.” Jack’s tone was very calm, yet it contained an astonishing killing intent.
Feeling the invisible aura of bloodshed radiating from Jack, Gabriel’s expression also became somewhat solemn, and she asked in a deep voice, “What is your current strength?”
Genius like Jack could not be judged by realm alone, especially since he had confronted and killed a Mid-term of Ninth Heaven Purgatory Demon while still in the Eighth Layer Early Phase, with an exaggerated combat power.
Not to mention the achievement of summoning a projection to suppress and kill a demon king in the past.
Jack Clark thought for a moment, “With my current strength, in a head-on confrontation, I should be able to clash with ordinary demon kings. If I deploy the summoning altar, I should be able to suppress a mid-stage demon king and even clash with the late-stage ones.”
As the Thunderflame Demon Dragon grew closer to the mid-mythical stage and mastered three higher-order laws, even a projection at a mere thirty percent of its power became more terrifying.
As for his own body’s combat power, Jack spoke conservatively, saying only that he could clash with ordinary demon kings, after all, he had not yet personally fought against a demon king level strong man.
Even so, this caused Gabriel to take a deep breath.
With the cultivation of the early phase of Eighth Layer Heaven, confident in clashing with demon kings, this span of strength is even more exaggerated than those known as seeds of civilization, the ‘monstrous’ Mokaya Dark Demon God seeds.
Gabriel pondered for a moment, “The recent conflict between the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield and The Purgatory Family just ended, there won’t be a major war breaking out in the short term.”
“However, the situation at the frontline is unpredictable and constantly changing. We cannot afford to be careless, as a civilization-level battle might erupt again quite soon.”
“For the next few days, get familiar with the situation here, and at the same time, try not to reveal your full strength,” she added.
“I’ll impose a media blackout on news about you. By preparing in advance, perhaps it could deal a heavy blow to the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.”
In a civilization-level war, ordinary geniuses hardly make any impact, even a king-level fighter cannot sway the tide of battle.
But Jack Clark is an exception, with the cultivation base of the early stage of Ninth Heaven, his combat power comparable to mythical beings, and even able to summon projections capable of contending with late-mythical stage Giant Beasts.
In situations where both sides’ top-end powers are restraining each other, with his strength and previous displays of ‘unlimited endurance,’ he can dominate the battlefield and tip the balance.
Just imagine, a king-level strong man with no one to counter him, whose movement speed, attack, and endurance are all maxed out, suddenly appearing on battlefields of Ninth Heaven and below—how terrifying that scenario would be.
By then, as long as Jack is given time, he alone could slaughter millions from The Purgatory Demon Race and their vassal soldiers, decimating the enemy’s core elite forces.
Hence, after Jack left, Gabriel’s figure dissolved into countless points of light that disappeared into the sky; she needed to consult with the other two Heavenly Kings.
She was also preparing to convene a King’s Conference in a few days to set a trap for The Purgatory Demon Race on the opposite side.
Under normal conditions, following the end of a Civilization Battlefield, both sides need at least one Sun Wheel cycle, over a month, before large-scale war breaks out again.
But the sudden arrival of Jack gave Gabriel a glimpse of opportunity.
Meanwhile, as Gabriel sought out the Divine Sky Heavenly King to discuss matters, massive legions of vassal alien races from the Purgatory Demon’s rear began to sweep forth on the battlefield opposite.
…
Heavenly Abyss Building, floor 1008. The vast room spanned thousands of square meters, including rest and cultivation areas.
Moreover, the building was fortified with the power of a Heavenly King. Even a Ninth Heaven Expert going all out couldn’t inflict any damage, which provided a suitable place for Jack to carry out his daily cultivation practices.
After meeting with Gabriel, access permissions on Jack’s smart wristwatch were unlocked. It was updated with most of the detailed data regarding the current state of Heavenly Abyss.
Standing in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, over four thousand meters high, looking down at the city filled with science fiction aesthetics, different from the Blue Star World, Jack couldn’t help but feel a bit dazed.
Reflecting on his experiences over the past year, sometimes even Jack wondered if he was dreaming.
When he first encountered True Martial, standing under the podium and seeing Lori Parma smash a one-meter-thick concrete slab with one punch, Jack was stunned for a long time.
He didn’t expect human flesh and blood could be so powerful that casually lifting a hand or foot could be comparable to heavy artillery, able to blast everything away.
Yet now, only half a year later, what used to be a hundred kilograms of arm strength when he first achieved Foundation Establishment and breakthrough to First Layer Heaven, his casual strikes were now comparable to a nuclear explosion.
It was a pity that Teacher Lori and the others were not on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield; otherwise, showing them the aura of Ninth Heaven would surely make for an interesting sight.
Thinking along these lines, Jack’s lips curled into a smile. He then took out his mobile phone from the Sumeru Bracelet, scrolled through and found Freya Louise’s number.
The call was quickly connected, and he was met with the girl’s surprised voice.
“Hmm! Jack Clark, you actually remembered to call me. Which base are you at now?”
“Heavenly Abyss City.”

chapters.title: Chapter 881: 377: Major General Louise's Boyfriend, Chaotic Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 881: Chapter 377: Major General Louise’s Boyfriend, Chaotic Life
Perched on the shoulder of the towering Ferocious Mecha, which stood over 160 meters tall, the girl in the silver training suit showed a look of surprise on her face: “You’ve come to Heavenly Abyss City?”
Jack Clark’s voice came through Freya Louise’s earpiece: “Yep, I just arrived earlier, called you right after meeting the Gabriel King. Where are you now?”
The girl’s face lit up with a radiant smile: “I’m at the 13th Military Base, in the B15 Research Building. Just finished my routine training for today, and I’m just waiting for the data collection from Number One to finish before I can ‘clock out’.”
Even though a day and night cycle in the mythical world spans over forty days, the Federation still adheres to a standard twenty-four-hour day to set the designated rest and activity times.
Of course, these hours only apply to ordinary civilians and workers, not those in closed-door cultivation.
“I’ll come find you.”
...
“Alright.”
Just as the girl happily ended the call, in the research monitoring center situated at the same height as the Biological Mecha, curiosity shone in the eyes of a woman in her thirties, standing with her arms crossed.
“Who is Miss Flora talking to on the phone? She looks so happy.”
The middle-aged man busy in front of the computer nodded:”Indeed, this is the first time I’ve seen Louise laugh so heartily since she’s been at the base.”
On the side, a female student in her early twenties, dressed in uniform, giggled: “I bet Young General Louise is talking to her boyfriend.”
A young man across from her in a white researcher’s coat, looking very dashing, was startled: “How can you tell she’s talking to her boyfriend?”
The girl with a few pimples on her face confidently said: “Because the smile on Young General Louise’s face is genuine, it’s obvious the person on the other end isn’t just any ordinary friend.”
“When girls are talking on the phone with their girlfriends or other ordinary friends, their eyes and expressions tend to be more casual, and when they’re talking to their parents, it comes with a hint of coquettishness.”
“Note, I’m talking about girls, not grown women like Sister Flora.”
Smack! At that moment, a hand slapped onto the shoulders of the dashing young man.
“Cecil, don’t listen to Iris’s nonsense; she’s been reading too many romance novels lately and is a bit too into it,” commented Rob.
Joyce replied with slight discontent: “Hey! Rob, I am being professional.”
The middle-aged man who had been watching the data flash across the large screen chuckled without paying much mind to Joyce’s protest and turned to the handsome young man with a smile.
“Judging by past patterns, there won’t be any conflict for the next half month. Cecil, why not ask Louise out for a meal once the data collection is over?” he suggested.
Suddenly, Jess Byron, a man in his thirties, was taken aback: “Old Rob, you’re trying to set Cecil up with Miss Flora?”
The middle-aged man smiled: “It’s not really matchmaking, just think that young people should socialize more and enjoy the beauty of youth while they can.”
“In this day and age, who knows what tomorrow holds, even we are not guaranteed safety within the base.”
Iris Witlock also spoke with enthusiasm: “I think Cecil and Young General Louise are a good match. He is the most accomplished graduate from Heavenly Abyss University in over twenty years.”
“Especially his talent in the Mecha Rune Fusion Field; the concepts and feasibility he presented in his thesis made even the university chancellor marvel.”
“Moreover, Cecil’s cultivation talent is also high, he has reached the Seventh Layer of Body Refinement. Although pure Body Refinement is much weaker than True Martial of the same stage, it still speaks volumes of his talent.”
Jess Byron shook his head: “I don’t think they’re a good fit, not that Cecil isn’t worthy of Miss Flora, but rather that Miss Flora is still young.”
Rob stroked his chin: “Age shouldn’t be an issue, though. Cecil is only 21, just four years older than Louise. In the mythical world, many people get married at 18.”
As he said this, Rob looked meaningfully at Cecil: “Louise is no ordinary person; many in the research department have been quietly inquiring about Louise’s background.”
Jess Byron’s eyes narrowed slightly: “What do they want with Miss Flora’s information?”
Rob laughed: “What else could it be? Guys naturally fall for beautiful ladies. Louise is attractive and the only driver of Number One; it’s bound to draw the attention of many young men.”
Jess Byron pondered for a moment: “I have a feeling it’s not that simple Iris, notify the security department, and have them look into those who’ve been inquiring about Miss Flora.”
“Team leader, aren’t we overreacting a bit?” Rob rubbed the back of his head.
“This is the core research area of the 13th Base, after all. Everyone is thoroughly vetted before they come in, and problematic individuals simply wouldn’t be allowed to enter.”
Jess Byron shook his head: “Old Rob, you’re a technician; you don’t get it. You just worry about your job.”
“Alright, then.”
With that said by Jess Byron, a tense atmosphere settled over the Monitoring Center, and everyone refocused on their work.
“The self-repair of the armor damage on Number One is now complete.”
“Energy levels are stable.”
“No traces of corruption detected on the driver.”
“Soul Synchronization value is 83, which is a five-point increase from when she first arrived.”
As each piece of data was transmitted and confirmed to be without issues, Jess Byron waved over to Freya Louise in the distance: “Miss Flora, you’re off for the day”
Whoosh! With the sound of rushing wind, Freya Louise leaped from a hundred meters away, landing on the balcony of the laboratory.
Jess Byron’s face broke into a smile: “You worked hard, Miss Flora.”
“Not at all, it’s not hard. Jess, I’m going to change my clothes,” said Freya Louise as she greeted the assistance crew of Number One and headed off to the changing room.
Soon after, Freya Louise emerged, having shed her battle suit and now dressed in a pink t-shirt and blue jeans, looking fresh and pretty.

chapters.title: Chapter 882: 377: Major General Louise's Boyfriend, Chaotic Life_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 882: Chapter 377: Major General Louise’s Boyfriend, Chaotic Life_2
At that moment, the staff outside were also packing up, preparing to leave work. Team Leader Jess Byron called out, “Louise, let’s go together later, I have something to discuss with you.”
Freya Louise shook her head, “Go ahead without me today, sis. A classmate is coming over, I’ll wait for him.”
“Classmate?”
Everyone who was packing up paused, surprised that the person who had been on the phone with Freya Louise was her classmate, and their eyes showed curiosity.
Rob commended, “Truly a classmate of Louise’s to arrive at the Frontline Battlefield so early. He must have high cultivation talent.”
The standard for entering the mythical world is the cultivation of the Fourth Layer Heaven, and the students who enter are basically starting from the Fifth Layer Heaven, not to mention such a genius who enters the frontline in Senior One.
...
Freya Louise chuckled lightly, “His talent is alright. The last time we met, he had already made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer, and now two months have passed, his cultivation level should be even higher.”
Hiss! A Seventh Layer Heaven First Grader. Everyone’s eyes revealed a look of shock.
At this time, footsteps and laughter came from the corridor outside, “General Clark, the testing room is just ahead, Young general Louise probably hasn’t left yet.”
As they spoke, two people walked in. One was the person in charge of the research building, and the other was a black-haired young man in a gray-white leisure suit with an upright figure.
The moment they saw the young man, everyone’s minds unconsciously sprouted various phrases like ‘face like jade, a celestial descending to the mortal world, and supreme elegance.’
Although the young man had concealed his aura and appeared to be an ordinary person, at that moment, everyone instinctively felt a sense of shame on their own.
It was as if their existence polluted the air, tainted the Heaven and Earth, and were unworthy of standing beside him.
However, as everyone was lost in thought, Freya Louise’s lips curved slightly, and a shallow smile appeared, “It seems that in the two months we haven’t seen each other, your cultivation has made another breakthrough. But what about your hair?”
Saying so, the girl blinked her eyes curiously. She remembered that two months ago, Jack Clark’s hair only covered his ears.
Jack Clark smiled, “Earlier at the Outer Development Department, I had some opportunities, and my body was reforged. With it, my hair also grew a lot longer.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark turned his head towards the distance. His gaze passed through the open space of the balcony and settled on the silently towering black and red ferocious Mecha, “That must be Number One.”
“Correct,” Freya Louise nodded.
At that moment, a pair of black gold vertical pupils slowly emerged in Jack Clark’s eyes.
With the Eyes of Void and Death came not only formidable power but also the ability to see through the essence of everything.
Instantly, in Jack Clark’s eyes, color drained from the Heaven and Earth. Everything began to fade, including the powerful armor on the surface of Number One, gradually revealing the essence within.
A giant humanoid creature enveloped in chaotic colors…
Boom! A terrifying aura suddenly burst forth from Number One, its eyes flared brightly with an alarming blue-white radiance and slowly turned its head.
In an instant, a terrifying pressure spread. Under the gaze of those blue-white eyes, everyone in the laboratory felt their legs weaken, their hearts racing with fear.
At that moment, only Freya Louise, Jack Clark, and the director managed to maintain their composure.
As the pilot of Number One, Freya Louise was accustomed to the fierce pressure from the Mecha due to her soul’s matching oscillations. At this moment, under the mental connection, her eyes revealed surprise.
“Jack Clark, just now you were looking at me, no, you were observing Number One.”
The black gold vertical pupils in the depths of Jack Clark’s eyes slowly receded, “I was a little curious, so I took a look.”
Freya Louise warned, “Number One is also a living being and doesn’t like to be spied on. It’s fortunate that your gaze just now had no hostility, or it would have attacked already.”
As she spoke and soothed Number One, the agitated giant Mecha’s eyes gradually dimmed, and the terrifying energy fluctuations that enveloped it also began to subside.
“Let’s go,” said Freya Louise, waving to the others, “See you all tomorrow.”
It wasn’t until Jack Clark, Freya Louise, and the head of the department had left that the people slowly let out a sigh of relief.
Iris Witlock patted her chest with some palpitations, “That young man named Jack Clark is really strong, he actually triggered a reaction from Number One.”
Rob thoughtfully said, “Did you guys notice that the head of the department just called that young man ‘Major General’?”
“Yes, it sounded like Major General.”
Immediately, everyone’s mouths fell wide open.
In the Federation, reaching king-level rank is a watershed moment, accessible only to those whose cultivation has surpassed the Eighth Layer Peak and who have made significant contributions to the Federation.
Including Freya Louise, who had just been promoted after controlling Number One to slaughter through several army legions, killing a large number of the Purgatory Demon Race and several Ninth Heaven Experts.
This means that the young man, who appeared to be about the same age as Freya Louise, was not just any Seventh Layer Heaven cultivator but one with a minimum cultivation of Eighth Layer Peak or above!!
“Eight Layer Heaven at seventeen years old, that’s terrifying. People like him are completely in a different world from us,” Rob said, as he patted Cecil on the shoulder.
…
Mingling with the crowd leaving the research institute, Louise gently discussed her experiences since arriving at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, her excitement evident when she talked about piloting Number One across the battlefield.
By the time Freya Louise was finished speaking, the two had reached the institute’s front gate, and from a distance, they saw a luxurious hovering sports car parked at the curb, 0.5 meters above ground.
On the roofless sports car, Gabriella, wearing sunglasses, waved to Louise, “Freya Louise, over here, huh! Jack Clark, you’re here at Heavenly Abyss too.”
The blonde girl looked at Jack Clark in surprise.
Jack Clark approached the car and smiled slightly, “Long time no see, Gabriella classmate.”
Gabriella, somewhat excited, said, “Indeed, it’s been a while, come on, get in the car, I’m treating today.”
After getting in the car and sitting in the back, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised, “By the way, how did you two start hanging out together?”
Gabriella started the sports car and said casually, “Now, I’m Freya Louise’s personal bodyguard. Aside from going to the battlefield and daily training, we are together all the time, including living together.”
As they spoke, the sports car had already entered the downtown area, with the bustling streets, tall skyscrapers, and pedestrians shopping on both sides coming into Jack Clark’s view.
It was hard to imagine that such a prosperous city could exist on the frontline battlefield, which could be destroyed at any moment, as if everyone felt not even a hint of crisis.
Louise joked, “Does this place seem unexpectedly prosperous to you?”
Jack Clark nodded, “A little, although it’s not the first time I’ve seen it.”
Gabriella, who was driving, said indifferently, “Normal, both cultivators and ordinary people need happiness and relaxation. Otherwise, long-term suppression and tension can lead to problems.”
“If people became frantic, agitated, anxious, or even fearful, many might defect to the Purgatory Demon Race on the opposite side, and the loss would outweigh the gain.”
“However, for security and to prevent infiltration, the inner city area and the major military bases are separate and divided into dozens of management districts.”
“In addition, there are Sky Base Satellites with Ninth Heaven Peak and even the skeletons of Demon King level Purgatory Demons hanging in the air above each district, so the surveillance is actually very tight.”
“Here we are, this restaurant has a great taste. The head chef is from Eastern Summer, who after more than ten years of cultivation, made a breakthrough through the Four Layer Heaven, with the goal of opening a restaurant on the frontline.”
As the sports car stopped outside the hotel, a secret meeting was taking place deep in the Heavenly Abyss Battle City, in an unknown space.
In the circular conference room, projections exuding a powerful oppressive aura sat in their seats, with a Golden Rubik’s Cube floating in the principal seat.
On either side of the Golden Rubik’s Cube sat Gabriel, a young man dressed in ancient costume, and a middle-aged man whose face was covered with golden fine scales.
Alongside the three Heavenly Kings, seventeen kings sat to their left and right, with an air of heavy gravity cloaking the meeting.

chapters.title: Chapter 883: 378: Reversing Space-Time, The Grand Battle of Shining Star Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 883: Chapter 378: Reversing Space-Time, The Grand Battle of Shining Star Rules
Sitting upon the throne, with a soft radiance emanating from his body, Gabriel slowly said, “This is an opportunity to break the balance, I think we can try it.”
At this moment, Gabriel had finished relaying information about Jack Clark.
Sitting opposite Gabriel, the Divine Sky Heavenly King wearing ancient robes nodded slightly, “I agree with Gabriel’s proposal, this time indeed presents an opportunity.”
“With the sudden intervention of Number One, the balance we’ve maintained with The Purgatory Family for years has been disrupted, plus they lost two Demon Kings in the clash at the Outer Development Department.”
“Therefore, the opposition will definitely mobilize reserve strength, including Demon King reinforcements to the frontline, and the target is very likely to be on Number One.”
“So regardless of whether Jack Clark is involved this time, we need to mobilize our rear forces to reinforce, to prevent being caught off guard.”
...
“Under such circumstances, if we have another entity at the Ninth Heavens realm on our side, with combat power comparable to that of a king-level, our chances of winning would be greater.”
“Moreover, this opportunity will only come once, as once the existence of Jack Clark is also exposed, he might even face stronger assassination forces than Number One, perhaps even that Demon God won’t be able to resist acting.”
A king-level figure below couldn’t help but smile wryly, “Indeed, that kid’s talent is too terrifying, once exposed, it will definitely attract Demon God Level killing intent.”
“To be comparable to a king-level at the early Ninth Heavens, sigh, we’ve gotten old,” another king-level figure lamented, feeling the melancholy of the new waves making way for the old, who are already stranded on the beach.
A brawny king-level figure across was somewhat speechless, “Old Zhu, what the hell are you talking about here. In terms of king-level lifespan of thousands of years, we are still very young.”
At this time, the Golden Rubik’s Cube at the principal seat began to rotate slowly, emitting a mechanical voice, “When the time comes, I will keep an eye on Diorus, and there won’t be a chance for it to make a move. Furthermore, Jack Clark has protective forces on him, so there’s no need to worry.”
The middle-aged man with golden scales on his face spoke in a weighty voice, “A Civilization-level war aiming to inflict heavy damage on the opponent in one go is somewhat unrealistic, unless holding an absolutely overwhelming advantage.”
“So for this plan, I think our goal should be to weaken the opponent’s vitality, to bury more than ten of their armies and kill some top-notch geniuses would be profitable.”
“Indeed.”
These strong men then discussed some details, ultimately concluding the meeting with the Golden Rubik’s Cube on the principal seat once again addressing them.
“Gabriel, notify the two armies at the Sky Curtain Battlefield to gather, the failure of their invasion of Blue Star and the loss of three Demon Kings has reduced their pressure somewhat.”
“Also, mobilize the reserve armies from Base City of Channels 2 and 3 to depart immediately; they must reach the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield within ten days.”
“This operation shall be initiated as a highest sequence command, conscripting all flight and transportation equipment, while also preparing enough ammunition and supplies for two great battles.”
Instantly, a hint of excitement appeared on the faces of all king-level and Heavenly King figures.
Four armies, four king-level figures, plus the return of Leo Hart who can unleash normal Heavenly King combat power after the Seal is lifted, and the king-comparable Number One, and Jack Clark lurking in the shadows.
This time might truly inflict heavy damage on the opposition, especially since they just lost two Assassination Department Demon Kings.
However, a Civilization Great War isn’t like two small countries clashing; it’s hard to crush the opposition in one go, it can only be done bit by bit, eventually leading to an overwhelming trend.
Soon, the meeting information was integrated and dispatched to the rear, causing the entire Federation to be shaken into motion.
Within Blue Star itself, countless military factory warehouses opened, various missiles, rockets, cannonballs, and even Nuclear Bombs and equipment began to be loaded onto vehicles.
Besides, one by one newly produced Large-scale Unmanned Bombers and Energy Warplanes were pulled onto transportation trains.
At the bases at the edge of Base Cities 2 and 3, a piercing alarm for assembly suddenly sounded, including the two armies from the Sky Curtain Battlefield.
Lori Parma, just returned from a mission and covered in dust, asked with some confusion, “Mr. Lester, what’s happened at Heavenly Abyss that they’re calling us for support?”
Vernon Lowe replied irritably, “Who am I supposed to ask if you’re asking me?”
“Alright, cut the chatter, you need to hurry back and assemble your team. We’ve just been informed by the higher-ups that we’re taking the first batch of transportation trains over.”
…
As sunset fell, along the small river that wound around the city and was over a hundred meters wide, after dinner, the trio walked along the Pedestrian Walkway, enjoying the gentle river breeze in a relaxed atmosphere.
Watching the Blue Sun disappear completely from the sky, Jack Clark felt some emotion, “It’s finally getting dark.”
The time difference in the mythical world was significant; a single day-to-night cycle lasted more than a month, giving the illusion that a day in the Heavens was a year on Earth.
Thinking this, Jack’s gaze shifted subtly.
Noticing the change in his expression, Freya Louise asked with a smile in her eyes, “After the sunset, the atmosphere is indeed nice, Jack, do you feel like composing a poem?”
“Compose… a poem?” Gabriella leaned in, her eyes showing curiosity.
“Uh… what are you all thinking?”
Jack Clark clarified, “I was just suddenly reminded of the chat we had at night after killing the Blood Armor Beast at the Southern Battlefield.”
At that time, they had speculated that ancient Blue Star might have had some cracks to the mythical world, creating special micro-spaces.
These micro-spaces were the legendary blessed caves, and the ‘Immortal Gods’ who could fly through the sky and escape through the ground in ancient times were very likely to be awakened ones who had accidentally entered these micro-spaces.

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 378: Reversing Space-Time, The Grand Battle of Shining Star Rules_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 884: Chapter 378: Reversing Space-Time, The Grand Battle of Shining Star Rules_2
And those celestial and divine beasts from the legends of the East and West might just be Mutated Beasts from miniature spaces, or Giant Beasts that have occasionally come over from the mythical world.
Including many of the ferocious beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Seas, references for which can be found within the mythical world.
Some awakened ones with good fortune in ancient times must have entered the mythical world and seen the rise and fall of the sun and moon once every month. Then through embellishments and alterations, legends were formed stating that a day in the heavens is a year on earth, and tales of ten suns in the sky emerged.
For safety reasons, the two women were staying in an apartment inside Simon’s 13th Legion base.
As they chatted along the way, after passing through several identity verification checkpoints, Jack Clark took the two women to their residential apartment building and then prepared to leave.
...
He had seen familiar faces, eaten his meal, and now he had some business to attend to.
However, at this moment, Gabriella suddenly exclaimed excitedly, “Freya, Jack, look, there are stars in the sky.”
Stars! Jack and Freya both paused for a moment, instinctively looking up.
In the dark night sky, where the moon had not yet appeared, three dazzling stars shone, casting a bright light that illuminated the night.
At this moment, not only the three of them, but many within the entire Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, or rather, the entire Federation, looked up in surprise.
Because in the several decades since humans entered the mythical world, they had never seen any celestial bodies at night other than the three suns during the day and two moons at night.
Not right!
Suddenly, Jack’s eyes narrowed, and his black gold vertical pupils surfaced, instantly magnifying the three distant stars in his eyes.
In an instant, a look of shock appeared on Jack’s face.
Because those were not any three stars but three luminous spheres moving at high speed like the Great Sun, colliding and entangling in the depths of the night sky.
The distance was too great, and they were even in a different space-time, so even with his Void Double Pupils, he could not see clearly what they were.
Above the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, tens of thousands of kilometers high, in another layer of space, two huge figures faced off. One radiated golden light, and the other was enveloped in surging demon gas.
However, these two massive figures were also looking up, their expressions solemn as they watched the three entangled stars deep in the night sky.
But soon, with the moon’s emergence, the three stars gradually faded under the moonlight. Seeing that he couldn’t make anything out, Jack greeted the others and took his leave.
Whoosh!
Jack’s figure flew rapidly at an altitude of 3,000 meters, with the brightly lit city receding below him.
At this altitude, besides Jack, there were several medium-sized flying vehicles and other Eighth Layer and Ninth Heaven Experts capable of flight.
As part of the inner city area, even in the mythical world, traffic control was still enforced.
Ordinary vehicles and Mechas and other machinery must use the roads and park orderly. Even small hovercraft cannot rise into the sky at will.
The standard flying altitude for large transport aircraft is 3,000 meters, and they all need to fly according to the air traffic center’s planned routes to avoid accidents.
Soon, Jack crossed over a hundred kilometers and arrived at the Logistics Department in the center of Heavenly Abyss City, entering the supplies lobby a kilometer underground through identity verification.
Everything here was very intelligent, managed by the Vava system, with countless cultivators above the Seventh Layer coming and going, the bustling activity not leading to chaos.
Jack found an unoccupied supply exchange booth and placed his hand under the screen in front of him, the light on the screen flowing immediately.
“Mental Fluctuation verification passed.”
“Pupil verification passed.”
“Password input verification passed, welcome to using the Vava No. 7 auxiliary system.”
As the electronic voice sounded, Jack’s information appeared on the screen.
Name: Jack Clark
Military Rank: Major General [Equal privileges, temporarily unappointed]
Merit Value: 25604 [Details…]
“Over twenty-five thousand merits.”
Jack’s lips curved slightly upward as he clicked on the details behind the merits, and immediately, a dense list of remarks popped up, showing that all these merits came from subsequent settlements by the Outer Development Department.
When Jack incidentally slew a large number of Unique Beasts during the pit killing of the two Demon Kings, nearly a month had passed since then, and those merits had been settled.
Under the circumstances where Jack Clark kept thirty percent, the final value of the Unique Beast corpses’ materials amounted to over seventy thousand Merit Points and around two hundred and several ten thousand Contribution Points.
In the Federation, a Level 7 Colossus corpse’s overall recovery price ranged from one thousand to two thousand Contribution Points, for Level 8 it was five thousand to ten thousand, and for Level 9, it rocketed to twenty thousand to fifty thousand.
At the time, the number of Unique Beasts Jack Clark had slain was close to one hundred thousand, with hundreds at Level 7, and dozens at Level 8, including a Mid Level 9 Giant Beast.
Calculated together, the overall value exceeded a million points in Contribution.
However, this was only the ideal calculation.
Because of an overwhelmingly powerful force, the Unique Beasts below Level 7 were all blasted into pieces by the terrifying Eight Desolate War Halberd, leaving limbs and fragments that were nearly worthless.
Only those above Level 7, and only a part of the Giant Beasts’ corpses were relatively intact, such as half a body remaining from the exploded Level 9 Giant Beast.
So the price was about right.
Jack Clark opened the resources exchange and located the Life Crystal option, immediately falling into silence.
Because the inventory displayed on the exchange list only had one Level 9, five Level 8, and fifty-seven Level 7 crystals; as for Life Crystals below Level 7, there were none.
No, that’s not right, there were.
As Jack Clark went silent, the crystal inventory display refreshed, and suddenly dozens of Level 5 Life Crystals were added.
But before Jack Clark could make a move, those crystals disappeared in the blink of an eye, as did over forty Level 7 Life Crystals, all exchanged away by others.
“Vava, I want to exchange for all the Life Crystals.”
“Resources have been locked, please wait.”
Along with the electronic voice, runes on the recessed wall flickered, revealing fourteen pure golden crystals of varying sizes; the smallest were the size of a human head, the largest with a diameter of one meter.
An intense and rich aura of life immediately permeated the area.
At the same time, Jack Clark’s account saw a deduction of 12,300 Merit Points, and that was with his benefit of a sixty percent discount.
After collecting those high-level crystals, Jack Clark asked in confusion, “Vava, why does Heavenly Abyss have so few Life Crystals in stock?”
As one of the Human Race’s two main combat cities, Heavenly Abyss had incredibly abundant supplies, mountains of high-level and top-tier resources, and countless God-level resources.
The mechanized electronic voice calmly responded, “Currently, the majority of the new generation of humans in Heavenly Abyss City are taking the Body Refinement path, consuming a significant amount of Life Crystals which can strengthen the body’s durability.”
“At the same time, front-line soldiers also need Life Crystals to enhance their strength and Qi Blood, hence Life Crystals below Level 7 are rarely in stock.”
“Including high-level Life Crystals, many Eight Layer Experts choose to absorb Life Energy to speed up their body’s reconstruction, so it’s rare for Life Crystals to accumulate.”
Body Refinement Cultivation System, I see.
Jack Clark hummed thoughtfully, “Vava, help me reserve Life Crystals worth a total of one hundred thousand Merit Points, Level 4 and above.”
A hundred thousand Merit Value, equivalent to three hundred thousand Contribution Points; with so many Life Crystals, even considering the doubling overcharge for high-level crystals, it would be enough for Jack Clark to convert into ten to twenty thousand attribute points.
As for where these Merit Points would come from, of course, it would be from the upcoming great war.
To kill an ordinary Mythical Demon King, the base battle reward was one hundred thousand Merit Points, which meant that Jack Clark only needed to slay a Demon King level strong man to exchange a large quantity of Life Crystals.
On calculation, it was even more cost-effective than the Thunder Flame Heavenly Dragon slaying Mythical Giant Beasts.
Of course, this presupposed an adequate supply of Life Crystals.
With the new human as the Body Refinement consuming group, Jack Clark could only obtain Life Crystals in advance by relying on his privileges.
After obtaining the Life Crystals, Jack Clark promptly returned to the Heavenly Abyss Building.
Sitting cross-legged in the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark took out the Life Crystal from the quasi-mythical beast, and with a thought, he chose to convert it.
“You have converted a High-Energy Life Crystal, gaining 14,840 attribute points.”
“You have converted a High-Energy Life Crystal, gaining 3,840 attribute points…”
Just a dozen or so high-level crystals contributed over forty thousand attribute points to Jack Clark, skyrocketing his attribute points from the original 24,321 to 67,024.
Jack Clark’s gaze swept over the talents from the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, eventually settling on the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill.
The Summoning Secret Skill, enhanced to its limit, could reverse space-time for a temporary summoning of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s True Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 379: The Coming of a New Demon God, The Essence of the Civilization War
chapters.content:
Chapter 885: Chapter 379: The Coming of a New Demon God, The Essence of the Civilization War
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon was in a state of hibernation, its body being tempered by Chaotic Dark Power transforming into rules, so it couldn’t enhance any new talents without interrupting its tempering state.
Moreover, with the impending Civilization Great War, Jack Clark prepared to enhance his Secret Skill first, adding an ace up his sleeve, to ensure greater safety on the battlefield.
“Consume 50,000 attribute points to enhance the Space-Time Summoning Technique.”
As soon as Jack’s voice fell, an instant surge of powerful enhancement energy exploded within him, pouring majestically into the blue mark on the back of his left hand.
Instantly, the room was filled with a surge of gloomy blue radiance, with endless Rune Sequence Chains unfolding from the mark on Jack’s hand.
Under the influence of the enhancement energy, these Rune Sequence Chains continuously evolved to become more intricate and mysterious, forming a complete altar that spanned a range of hundreds of meters.
...
Hum! As the altar became increasingly condensed, its base vibrated, with extremities of Rune Sequence Chains at their ultimate complexity reaching out, their ends vanishing into the Void.
As the base of the altar fully unfurled, deeper into the Void, more and more Rune Sequence Chains emerged, and gradually the surrounding space-time was affected by a certain power, becoming distorted and illusory.
With the bloodline as a guide and soul resonance, space-time intersected, space folded, and vaguely around Jack, the twisted phantom of an Ice Crystal Palace began to appear.
It was as if this World was overlapping with an unknown world.
Within the oppressively awe-inspiring Ice Crystal Divine Palace, a Black-red Colossal Beast over 700 meters long, covered in fierce, thick scale armor, lay sprawled.
Atop the colossal and rugged head of the beast, under the two-meter-plus Purple little dragon’s head, its tail wrapped playfully around the tip of a black dragon horn.
Yiya yiya!! The Purple little dragon swung on a swing, emitting cheerful and youthful sounds.
At that moment, centered on the Black-red Colossal Beast, space-time power spread around it, the scene distorted, and a phantom, transparent image emerged.
In the image, a young man sat cross-legged, his black hair flowing without wind behind him, surrounded by countless streams of gloomy blue light, forming an altar encompassing space-time.
Yiya yiya!? The Purple little dragon blinked in confusion, looking at Jack’s projection.
Because on that space-time intersecting figure, it felt a kinship with the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, but wasn’t the big brother under its feet?
At that moment, the young man in the projection slowly opened his eyes, his gaze piercing through distant space-time and falling on the Purple little dragon, his face revealing a faint smile.
Hush! Jack placed a finger to his lips, gesturing for silence to the Purple little dragon.
Yiya yiya!! The Purple little dragon instinctively nodded obediently.
As the fluctuation of the surrounding space-time gradually weakened, Jack’s projection and the blue altar also slowly disappeared.
Yiya yiya!? The Purple little dragon turned into a streak of light, appearing where Jack’s projection had just been, its eyes full of curiosity and doubt.
Meanwhile, on the summit of a mountain engulfed in freezing clouds, the Blue-White Giant Dragon was startled awake once more, its massive dragon head turning slightly backward, a look of bewilderment in its eyes.
“Such an intense power of space-time and a trace of a contract aura. Has that little fellow signed a similar summoning contract with other creatures?”
While the Blue-White Giant Dragon was marveling at the space-time power around the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, Jack was also surprised.
“Misss Joseline, this little one, can actually sense my soul presence merged with the altar. Truly an Innate Divine Holy being.”
Amidst his reflection, Jack’s thought moved, and instantly the altar that reached deep into the Void intensified with bluish radiance, countless Rune Sequence Chains retracting, eventually forming a five-tiered altar mark on the back of his hand.
Simultaneously, the remarks on his attribute page regarding the Secret Skill also changed.
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark [A Summoning Secret Skill enhanced to the limit. When activated, it forms a complete altar, with power spanning distant space-time.
Projected Summoning: Blood resonance, soul resonance, consuming Spirit Qi energy to summon a projection of a Giant Beast called Thunderflame, possessing a third of the summoner’s strength.
True Body Summoning: Inverting space-time, temporarily summoning the True Body of a Giant Beast known as Thunderflame, which will be pulled back by space-time power once the summoning ends.
Note: The longer the projection is present, the greater the power consumption.
Reminder: True Body Descent involves the three major rules of time, space, and causality, and therefore consumes vast amounts of soul and bloodline energy. Please use it cautiously.]
With the Limit Enhancement, the Space-Time Summoning Technique transformed into a mark, which would become a real Void Altar when unfolded, summoning the Avatar of a Giant Beast.
Besides, the ability to summon projections was still available, which could summon a strength projection of an Avatar with a third of his power, sustaining extended battle periods.
Having completed the enhancement of the Secret Skill and thus gained an additional ace, Jack, without resting, turned his gaze to the remaining 17,024 Attribute points.
“Burn 1,000 attribute points to enter an enlightenment state.”
Boom! The mysterious power around Jack spread, and he entered an epiphany state, his Spiritual Will enveloping the Space-Time Mark on his hand.
In an instant, in Jack’s consciousness, the Space-Time Mark magnified infinitely, turning into a colossal altar spanning the Void and soaring tens of thousands of meters, with countless intricate runes circulating within.
After previously deifying his Soul Talent, Jack had bridged the gap between himself and Heaven and Earth, ensuring his comprehension ability was no less than that of those Top-notch Geniuses.
As for Jane Aiken, she was a monster with an understanding talent, capable of entering an epiphany state at any time, incomparable.
Following his Transformation into an Innate Demon God, Jack’s body and soul became even more in tune with Heaven and Earth, enhancing his cultivation and comprehension abilities further.
Now, with the support of burning attribute points, the Limit Enhanced Space-Time Mark became ‘quite simple’ in Jack’s view, and in an instant, numerous insights flooded into his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 379 New Demon God’s Descent, The Essence of Civilization War_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 886: Chapter 379 New Demon God’s Descent, The Essence of Civilization War_2
Jack Clark was preparing to integrate the space runes engraved on his right arm into the space-time mark, making certain modifications to perfect the concept of using Summoning Breath and Sky-based Strikes he had initially conceived.
Because summoning a single Breath or a single Sky-based attack would consume much less energy, while also enriching his combat tactics.
For example, after breaking through to the king-level and infiltrating deep into the territory of the Purgatory Family, he could summon a Sky-based Strike with the full force of a Thunderflame Demon Dragon from hundreds or even thousands of kilometers away.
With one strike, he could destroy a huge city with king-level defense, eradicate countless members of the Purgatory Demon Race, and pose a threat even greater than the billions of tons equivalent of Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs currently possessed by the Human Race.
This was because the mythical world lacked satellite positioning around the ‘atmosphere’, which greatly affected many of the humans’ technological capabilities, rendering those long-range missiles incapable of decisive victory from millions of kilometers away.
But Jack’s situation was different. He had greater mobility and stealth, and he didn’t need positioning—if he stood more than a hundred kilometers up in the high altitude, anywhere he could see, he could attack.
...
…
Tens of kilometers away from the Heavenly Abyss Battle City, on the vast earth below, legions from the rear of the Purgatory Demon Race, including freshly conscripted vassal race armies, were setting up camp.
Some of these different races were 10 meters tall, with bodies like horses but upper halves like humans, sporting Tauren heads, and clad in thick armor flashing with runes.
Others were 3 meters tall with four arms and two heads, and a pair of bat wings sprouting from their backs, appearing extremely ferocious.
Meanwhile, in the sky, tens of thousands of Flying Giant Beasts, each with wingspans of a hundred meters and all above Level 7, circled menacingly, their roars of savagery and brutality shaking heaven and earth.
The most eye-catching was an army of Lava Monsters, of various sizes ranging from dozens to 3 meters tall, appearing as if cast from magma and rock.
Wherever this army of Lava Monsters passed, the earth would burn and melt, forming a river of lava that set the heavens and earth ablaze with a terrifying momentum.
At this moment, towering fortresses floated one hundred thousand meters above these monstrous armies, with waves of black demonic air, like tsunamis, churning darkly and blotting out the sky.
Above these Demon King Castles, in a deeper layer of space, stood a city spanning tens of kilometers wide, like an island, erect in the void.
At its center towered a magnificent palace, with massive Demon Pillars as wide as a hundred meters and a kilometer tall extending out on either side. Atop them sat over thirty figures emanating the oppressive aura of demon kings.
Beneath these Demon Pillars, the space was densely packed with Purgatory True Demons, each exuding a powerful aura. The weakest among them were above the Eight Path Demon Marks.
Those closer to the Demon Pillars were stronger, almost reaching the level of Nine Demonic Marks.
