Especially near a few Demon Pillars deep inside the hall, several Purgatory Nobles at the late stage of Nine Demonic Marks exerted aura close to that of demon kings, sending tremors of terror.
Among them stood a ‘young man’ 3 meters tall, dressed in dark golden battle armor, with nine sharp Demon Horns on his head.
This Purgatory True Demon emanated the aura of someone at the mid-level of Nine Demonic Marks, but when its gaze swept over the others, all the Purgatory Nobles instinctively bowed their heads, not daring to meet its eyes.
Even those True Demons at the late stage of Nine Demonic Marks, when looking at this ‘young man’ with the nine sharp horns, revealed a hint of dread in their eyes.
However, at this moment, whether it was the Purgatory Nobles below or the demon kings on the Demon Pillars, including the five Demon Kings at the front with the most powerful auras, they all bowed their heads reverently.
At the forefront of the Demon Palace, two vague and towering figures stood.
Around these two figures, the void collapsed, the laws of heaven and earth shattered, and even time and space twisted, creating two separate domains governed by their own rules.
Then, a deep voice that vibrated heaven and earth slowly spoke up, “Emperor Eros, is that biological Mecha from the human race really as serious as you say, requiring my personal descent?”
The voice of Devil God Emperor Eros was cold as it replied, “That biological Mecha capable of growth is only a slight future nuisance for us, not enough for you to intervene.”
“This time I have summoned you because I am preparing to deal a heavy blow to the human race.”
Carthius said slowly, “Deal a heavy blow to the human race?”
“Indeed, the war potential of this race is astonishing. Even after fighting our empire for over two hundred Sun Wheels, their strength has not declined but has, in fact, increased several-fold, especially in the mid and high-end forces.”
“From initially being suppressed in the forbidden area across from our clan and unable to move, to now being engaged in simultaneous warfare with both us and the War Demon Empire of Gretar.”
“Currently, in terms of high-end forces, the Human Race has a Demon God Level opponent facing me on both Frontline Battlefields, with three Grand Demon King Level Marshals beneath each.”
“Including the Demon King Commanders of legions, the enemy at the frontlines has only slightly fewer forces than my empire, and they are not inferior with the use of ‘technology’ weapons.”
“Therefore, we cannot allow them to continue growing. We must find a way to deal them a heavy blow and suppress the other side.”
Carthius spoke slowly, “I’ve been overseeing the rear, focusing my attention on the Heavenly Feather Clan’s battlefield all this time; I didn’t expect such a significant change in your situation.”
In contrast to the human perception of time, more than two hundred Sun Wheels, over two decades, is equivalent to just over two hundred days for these Purgatory True Demons.
“This race must be restrained. After dealing a heavy blow to the opposite side, when the war with the Heavenly Feather Clan ends, I will go and persuade Tyris.”
“Diorus, you already have a complete plan, don’t you?”
“It’s simple. Feint and mislead. I will later release news of several Demon King Commanders from dozens of vassal race legions at the frontlines, including support from a Grand Demon King, to confuse the Human Race.”
“Once the great war reaches its mid-period, and that Biological Mecha appears on the battlefield, Carthius, you will show up and eradicate it.”
“At that time, with that Demon God Level opponent restrained by me, you will continue to suppress the frontline legion-level powerhouses, weakening the Human Race’s high-end forces.”
In civilization-level wars, underhanded tricks and schemes are useless. The balance won’t tip just because you have one more or fewer kings.
Even Heavenly King Level cannot affect the balance of a Civilization War.
All the past assassinations, ambushes, and schemes to entice betrayal from the Human Race served only as a means of sideways erosion of the enemy’s fresh blood.
In the end, the decisive battle still has to take place on the frontline, where what’s ultimately compared are the foundational strength and power of the two sides.
For instance, during a Civilization Great War, tens of thousands of elite soldiers, and a dozen Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heaven Experts are killed, and then the conflict is reignited with the next Sun Wheel.
After killing tens of thousands of elite soldiers and numerous Eight Layer Heaven and several or more Ninth Heaven Experts day by day, there will eventually be a slow decline in the number of high-ranking powerhouses.
And with a fracture in medium to high-end forces, the consequence will be top strong individuals becoming fewer and fewer, as they are worn down, injured, and lost in battle.
When the enemy is worn down to a critical point, a war of extermination can be launched, gathering all forces to completely destroy the civilization.
This has been the strategy of The Purgatory Family in warfare against other civilizations over the years.
Having subjugated dozens of lower and mid-level vassal races and commanding vast territories and resources, their potential for war is tremendous, and they have no fear of attrition.
In every great battle, it is these vassal races that charge to the fore, while the true Purgatory Demons are commanders with few casualties.
However, the scale of human potential for war was unexpected, growing stronger the more they fought, to the point now where it has become a grave concern for Emperor Diorus.
At this moment, Diorus slowly turned his gaze to the front of the Demon King Pillar, settling on Great Demon King Barus who had come from the rear to support. His voice was deep.
“Barus, how is your task progressing?”
Barus responded with a wry smile, “There has been no progress so far.”
“The defense around the driver of that Biological Mecha is very tight, even within the safe inner cities of the Human Race. Usually, there is a Seven Demon Marks human following closely, with even stronger powerhouses lying in ambush.”
“Even with a high reward offered, half a Sun Wheel later, I have already lost three covert operatives. Not to mention drawing them out and bringing them under control, it’s currently difficult even to get close.”
“Indeed, in the end, we have to revert to direct confrontation on the battlefield.”
“Jimtor, reveal your presence.”
“Yes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 887: 380 Jack Clark: The teacher is coming; I need to go greet him.
chapters.content:
Chapter 887: Chapter 380 Jack Clark: The teacher is coming; I need to go greet him.
Outside the Heavenly Abyss Battle City, more than nine thousand kilometers deep into the battlefield, within a ‘small’ mountain range stretching over a thousand kilometers, a signal base, dozens of meters high, stood towering.
“Signal launched.”
“Network connection complete”
“All set, brothers, we’re ready to head back.”
Nestled among the peaks of the mountains, well-hidden at the base station below, an elite squad composed of three Seventh Layer experts and two from the Eighth Layer, was bustling about.
Once they confirmed that the signal launch was normal and the network connection with the rear Heavenly Foundation Network was established, the squad began to prepare for evacuation.
...
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!! Under the cover of night, the entire squad concealed their aura and retreated towards the rear.
But just as the squad appeared on the mountain ridge, a boundless tide of dark energy surged from afar, submerging everything in its path. Trees turned to ash, and rocks were annihilated.
Under the cataclysmic might belonging to the Great Demon King, every member of the squad wore an expression of despair on their faces.
“Courting death!”
As a cold voice sounded, a Dragon Roar thundered through the sky. A massive Dragon Claw, covering several kilometers, descended from the heavens.
The moment the golden Dragon Claw appeared, an Overbearing Law Aura filled space, suppressing everything.
Boom!
The golden Dragon Claw, like a meteor crashing into the sea, caused the earth to shatter and space to fracture in an instant. The entire mountain range quaked within a radius of tens of kilometers under the force of the impact.
The dark tide exploded under that terrifying strike, and the shockwave that swept across Heaven and Earth contained such a gentle force that it blew the elite squad hundreds of kilometers away.
“Human Race!”
Boom! The engulfing darkness on the ground surged upward, transforming into an endless black tide that rose to the sky, attempting to devour the circling Golden Divine Dragon.
Boom!
The two-thousand-meter-long Golden Divine Dragon, encircled by endless golden light, roared angrily. Its claws waved, unleashing an Unrivaled Domination of Divine Light that shattered everything.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Within the sea of golden clouds, the Golden Divine Dragon roared, shaking Heaven and Earth. Around it, the dark tide blotting out the sky turned into thousands of kilometers long black tentacles sweeping across.
As two Heavenly King Level powerhouses fought, the stable space of the mythical world became as fragile as paper, each strike shaking the heavens and rending the void, creating ferocious shockwaves that swept across hundreds of kilometers.
And just as the two Heavenly Kings displayed Earth-shattering might, another King-level battle suddenly erupted in a distant direction. Two patrolling Human Kings and two Demon Kings suddenly clashed.
Although the grand battle had ended, and both armies had withdrawn to rest, local conflicts constantly erupted outside the Heavenly Abyss city.
The Human elite squads and Purgatory True Demon strong men would engage in minor skirmishes across this battlefield, spanning over twenty thousand kilometers deep and tens of thousands of kilometers across, dotted with many dangerous forbidden areas.
The purpose of the clashes between both parties was to seize some special strategic heights.
Currently, the ten thousand kilometers outside of Heavenly Abyss city are within the radiation range of the Human Race, where many base signal towers have been established to form a network that creates an attack zone.
In this signal-covered area, missiles from the rear of Heavenly Abyss city could be launched at any time for saturation bombing, massively eliminating the opponent’s mid and low-end forces.
To secure the safety of this signal-covered area, Kings would patrol in shifts to avoid assassination by opposing Demon King Level Strong.
The sudden outbreak of combat woke Jack Clark, who had been cultivating ‘all night’, slowly opening his eyes, countless blue and silver Rune Sequence Chains flowing gently within them.
Sensing the terrifying might still disrupting Heavenly Energy tens of thousands of kilometers away in the sky, Jack showed a somber look in his eyes.
“So strong!”
As he spoke, Jack stood up. With a step, he crossed hundreds of meters instantly, his figure like a phantom passing through the reinforced glass to appear outside the Heavenly Abyss Building.
His Agility Talent, having evolved as a Divine Power, became even more enigmatic, allowing Jack to shrink distances considerably and traverse through material obstructions.
Jack soared into the sky, his figure flickering to appear tens of thousands of meters high, and his Black Gold colored eyes with golden vertical pupils emerged, looking towards the distant horizon.
Due to the ‘flat’ nature of the mythical world’s Earth, Jack’s terrifying visual acuity pierced through the void in an instant, locking onto the great battle unfolding afar.
In the Eyes of Void and Death, that wasn’t any Golden Divine Dragon or black tide, but a dragon-shaped, sprawling Dark Laws covering Heaven and Earth.
Every move was cataclysmic, affecting the nature of hundreds of kilometers.
As Jack gazed into the distance, around a thousand kilometers from his surroundings, over two hundred figures emitting the aura of the Ninth Layer stood tall at an altitude of ten thousand meters. These people, belonging to over a dozen armies and several units, were all core stalwarts of the Human Race.
Beyond them, at the edge of the battlefield, several Kings and two Heavenly Kings stood, emanating immense pressure that darkened the skies and deterred the distant foes.
However, a few of the Kings still appeared slightly weak, evidently still recovering from injuries sustained in the last major battle.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield’s sky trembled, revealing six sci-fi-styled battleships, each over ten kilometers long, at an altitude of several hundred kilometers.
At that moment, the battleship’s fore cannons slowly opened, gathering Blue Radiance, emitting a terrifying energy presence.
Meanwhile, on the ground below, several turrets housing super electromagnetic guns, each over five thousand meters tall with a ten-meter diameter muzzle and over two hundred meters in length, also began to charge.
In the far-off thirteenth base, even the previously inactive Number One’s eyes lit up, ready to strike at any Demon reinforcements that appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 888: 380 Jack Clark: The teacher is coming, I have to go and welcome them_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 888: Chapter 380 Jack Clark: The teacher is coming, I have to go and welcome them_2
This is the frontline, where battles erupt without warning.
However, both sides are currently showing restraint, with no additional Demon King level forces getting involved, just confronting each other with the pressure of their rules.
This battle continued under the watchful eyes of both sides for a bit more than an hour before it abruptly stopped.
It was at this moment that Jack Clark’s smart wristwatch vibrated slightly, and Gabriel’s calm voice came through, “Alright, the conflict ahead has ended, everyone can go back and rest now.”
Then, the luminosity of the main cannons of those six sky-based battleships in the sky extinguished, and the surrounding space distortion slowly faded away, while the electric energy flooding those super electromagnetic guns on the ground also gradually weakened.
“Heavenly King with an Incarnation of the Rules?” A strong Battle Intent flashed through Jack Clark’s eyes before he turned and left.
...
But as he flew back down, Jack Clark’s gaze swept over those powerful weapons, revealing a hint of amazement in his eyes.
As the frontline battlefield posing the greatest threat, human technology research has almost entirely contributed to this area over the years.
The minerals obtained from the mythical world over the years, along with the skeletons and scale armor from those Giant Beasts, have compensated for material constraints, allowing humans to make rapid progress in the technology of weapon destruction.
Humans have now manufactured Throne Fighters capable of navigating starry skies and sky-based battleships akin to Aerospace Aircraft Carriers, whose main cannons have a firepower comparable to Mythical Kings.
Including those super electromagnetic guns below, they are capable of executing destructive strikes across tens of thousands of kilometers, an astonishing power that serves as the main force suppressing the opposing army.
Once back in his room, Jack Clark sat cross-legged, taking out two fist-sized, transparent crystals from the Sumeru Bracelet, inside of which seemed to be a miniature world of silver.
God-level Resources of the Dark Realm’s Profound Spirit.
This kind of resource contains rich and pure energy, accompanied by the force of Boundaries, which, when absorbed and refined, can strengthen the domain and True Body of Ninth Heaven Cultivators.
When Jack Clark broke through the Eight Layer Heaven, Marcellus Larry gave him resources worth millions of contribution points, which could allow him to rapidly cultivate to the late period of the Ninth Heavens in one breath.
Only now these resources were no longer sufficient for him to cultivate to the late period of the Ninth Heavens, or rather, they were far from enough.
Being an Innate Demon God’s Body meant that Jack Clark’s strength in all aspects was unprecedentedly powerful, but at the same time, like the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, the more he improved his strength, the greater his requirements became.
For instance, a typical Ninth Heaven Expert progressing from the early to mid period under normal conditions would need to cultivate for five to ten years to comprehend their talent, strengthen their domain, and refine ten thousand units of Heavenly Energy.
If Heaven and Earth Treasures and God-level resources were used, this process could be accelerated.
But Jack Clark, due to his innate alignment with Heaven and Earth, could quickly overcome boundaries, and his absorption and refining speed of Heavenly Energy was over ten times faster, possibly only needing a few months to break through to mid period.
But the Heavenly Energy he required was tens to hundreds of millions of units.
Therefore, in the process of using God-level resources to accelerate his cultivation, his consumption of resources was also enormously higher.
But these were minor issues.
In the large-scale battles to come, slaying one more Demon King or making more contributions by slaying several Purgatory Demon Race Nobles would be enough to exchange for resources.
While Jack Clark continued his Closed-door Cultivation, also constructing the Summoning Spatial Channel, another meeting of those above king-level was once again convened within the walls of Heavenly Abyss Battle City.
Soon, a message was sent out.
In the vast void behind the Human Race, a towering, thousands of meters tall black stele stood with the two ancient characters True Martial inscribed on it, invisibly emitting a Terrifying Aura that suppressed Space-Time.
At this moment, under the stele, a middle-aged man with a solemn expression slowly opened his eyes.
…
“Attention all departments, we are about to begin the thirteenth trial run of Number One. Everyone at the test site evacuate immediately, evacuate immediately.”
“Disengage the safety controller…”
Under the bright moonlight, a black and red Ferocious Mecha stood tall on the Earth, with the 300-meter-high B15 research building looming behind it.
As the command was given, the massive mechanical arms that held Number One in place on the walls of the building slowly loosened, and simultaneously, the eyes of the mecha lit up.
“Soul Sync Rate normal, fluctuations stable.”
“Pilot’s mental state stable, physical parameters normal, no signs of erosion or assimilation.”
“OK, please have the pilot control Number One, move to the number three test site in front, and begin today’s Spatial Phase Barrier strength training.”
“Spatial Phase Barrier training complete, next up is the Super God Energy Beam attack…”
Hum! The Mecha opened its large mouth, a glow flickered, followed by a blue and white light beam, ten meters in thickness, piercing heaven and earth, and with a bang, striking a mountain peak kilometers away.
“`
Boom!
Mountain peaks collapsed, a massive blue and white light beam illuminated heaven and earth, and fragments of rock and smoke dust were thrown into the sky by the shockwave, covering a range of over ten kilometers, an awe-inspiring display of power.
“Tsk! That’s a bit too powerful.”
On the rooftop of the research building, after two days of continuous cultivation, Jack Clark, with an even stronger aura, had his arms crossed as he watched the front with interest in his eyes.
Almost three hours later, the enormous mecha, having destroyed the area for miles around and completed all of today’s training objectives, slowly emerged from the sky full of smoke and dust.
Then followed over ten minutes of data collection. And when everything was finished, a crystal stone in the chest of Number One shone, forming a light beam.
Freya Louise, clad in the God Machine Armament, flew out of the light beam. Without touching the ground, the blazing hot air from behind her erupted, propelling her up to the rooftop.
Hum! The runes on the surface of the small mecha glowed, and then it gradually became ethereal as if turning into energy and finally dispersed into countless streams of light around Freya Louise’s wrist.
Thump! Freya Louise, having landed, shook her black hair and looked up curiously, “Jack Clark, did you want to see me for something?”
Looking at the girl with a delicate face and dressed in a silver combat suit, looking dashing and valiant, Jack Clark’s face showed a smile.
“I got word that Mr. Perry’s Second Corps is about to arrive, so I came over to ask if you want to join me in welcoming them.”
Jack Clark’s ’emergence from seclusion’ wasn’t just sparked by curiosity about Freya Louise’s daily training routine, but also by news of the military reinforcement from Lori Parma’s unit.
Although at first, as a Martial Cultivation Teacher focused on his own cultivation during his Foundation Establishment period, Lori Parma seemed somewhat irresponsible, he later turned out to be quite good to his students, including Jack Clark.
Moreover, back then, Jack Clark’s talent had not yet fully manifested.
As Jack Clark gradually became more dazzling step by step, Lori Parma also offered him some help. However, all these aids seemed unnecessary due to Jack Clark’s rapid progress.
Lori Parma and Vernon Lowe even asked their friends in the Southern Battlefield to look after Jack Clark when they entered the mythical world and Jack Clark joined them on the Alien Beast Battlefield.
However, because of Jack Clark’s rapid breakthroughs, he had already swept the battlefields before the military high-ups could even take care of him.
But no matter what, Jack Clark felt obliged to acknowledge this favor.
Now that they were coming from the Sky Curtain Battlefield to provide support, upon hearing the news, Jack Clark felt the need to meet them and tell his two former teachers that he had broken through to the Ninth Heavens.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile.
“Teacher Lori Parma is coming?” Freya Louise was somewhat surprised, then seemed to think of something and, like Jack Clark, a smile appeared on her face.
At a temporary base 150 kilometers from the frontline base, huge transport planes were constantly landing and taking off.
Meanwhile, a train several kilometers long and tens of meters wide slowly stopped at the platform.
“Heavenly Abyss Battle City front station has been reached. Special Forces Soldiers, please disembark in an orderly manner.”
As the announcement played, the doors of the train carriages opened, and tens of thousands of cultivators, radiating the aura of at least the Fourth Layer Heaven, stepped out.
Soon these soldiers formed squads of a thousand and stood in formation on the Earth, numbering over sixty thousand in total.
Besides, there was a squad mainly composed of Seventh Layer Heaven with Eighth Layer Heaven leading, rapidly forming an elite battalion with over three thousand members.
Just as Lori Parma and others were assembling on the edge of their teams, someone called out to them from the distance.
“Teacher Parma, Mr. Lowe!” Lori Parma and Vernon Lowe were taken aback for a moment and turned to look.
They saw that from afar, among the Heavenly Abyss team greeting the Second Corps, Jack Clark and Freya Louise were waving at them with smiles, leaving the two men momentarily dumbfounded.
Bryan Jacobs, the captain of Lori Parma’s squad, also looked over, “Mr. Perry, are those acquaintances of yours?”
“If I’m not mistaken, they seem to be two students I taught before entering the frontline,” Lori Parma said hesitantly.
“What do you mean?” Bryan Jacobs was puzzled by Lori Parma’s uncertain tone.
“I mean, I’m not sure either.”
Looking at the two figures pulling Freya Louise over from afar, Lori Parma hesitated, “Do you guys think it’s possible for someone to break through the Eight Layer Heaven and come to the frontline when they’re still in Senior One?”
“How could that be possible, Perry, what nonsense are you thinking?”
Lori Parma’s comrades couldn’t help but laugh at the idea.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 889: 381: My Student Has the Qualities of a Heavenly King
chapters.content:
Chapter 889: Chapter 381: My Student Has the Qualities of a Heavenly King
Geniuses, there are many in this world.
But in the history of cultivation of the Human Federation, only that genius from more than a decade ago achieved the Ninth Heavens in a single year, shocking the entire Cultivation World.
Now, with perfected Cultivation Methods, abundant resources, and an increasingly better training system, graduating in the third year with Sixth-level Heaven is already considered top-notch genius.
Even such geniuses need to spend several years after graduation to achieve a breakthrough to the Seventh and even more time for the Eight Layer Heaven.
Apart from these geniuses, most cultivators graduate around the Third and Fourth Layers, with a few in the Fifth Layer Heaven, and then they join the military or other departments.
As for those who achieve a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven upon graduation, such monsters are still very few in the entire Federation, a fact that became evident during that relic expedition back then.
...
At that time, it gathered some of the most talented from the three great empires and over a dozen medium-sized countries of the Federation, yet only a few had reached the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Not to mention a First Grade breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven.
So, when Lori Parma mentioned whether anyone had broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven in their Junior year and come to the Frontline Battlefield, these high-ranking elites couldn’t help but laugh.
Captain Bryan Jacobs even said that he was talking nonsense.
But watching Jack Clark and his companion flying hundreds of meters away, Lori Parma slowly said, “Brothers, I wasn’t joking. It seems like my student really did break through to the Eight Layer Heaven.”
Vernon Lowe also slowly spoke up, “Mr. Parma is not kidding. Although they look quite different, those two flying over are indeed students from his class.”
Noticing their serious gazes and the earnest tone in their voices, the laughter on the faces around them faded, and their eyes looked skeptically into the distance.
Is it true?
Dragging Freya Louise through the Void, Jack Clark stepped and flashed rapidly, soon descending from the sky to land in front of Lori Parma and the others, a smile on his face: “Mr. Parma, Mr. Lowe, long time no see.”
“Not that long, just ‘a few days’ actually.”
As he spoke, Lori Parma took a deep breath, his voice trembling slightly, “Jack, I remember that you were only at the Fourth Layer when you entered the Southern Battlefield over five months ago. When did you break through to the Eight Layer?”
Jack shook his head. “Teacher, I’m not at the Eight Layer.”
Phew! So he wasn’t at the Eight Layer Heaven, what a relief. Everyone around him instantly relaxed, but Mr. Parma and Vernon showed shock in their eyes. Not at the Eight Layer Heaven?
It was at that moment, pausing deliberately, Jack smiled and said, “I’ve now broken through to the Nine Layers.” As he spoke, an aura befitting the Ninth Heavens burst from him.
Boom!
The Earth collapsed beneath Jack’s feet, a terrifying domain Power Explosion occurred, compressing the surrounding air and forming a strong, invisible shockwave that whipped up a raging wind and pushed people dozens of meters back.
Of course, Jack had only released a bit of his aura and domain power, but even so, it immediately petrified everyone around him, disbelief written on their faces.
“What’s happening?”
“What’s going on?”
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The sudden burst of aura from the Ninth Heavens caught the attention of several high-order squads in the distance, and hundreds of figures exuding the aura of the Seventh and Eighth Layers flashed and surrounded them.
Seeing Jack, who stood upon the Void with the power of the Ninth Heaven wrapped around him, these people had sharp eyes and their auras intertwined, almost clashing with Jack’s.
In their view, Jack’s sudden release of domain power to push back Lori Parma and his party was a challenge to their Second Elite Corps of the army.
“Everyone, calm down, that’s my student, my student,” Lori Parma, realizing what was happening, hastily explained to the brothers around him.
The leading powerhouse of the Late Eight Layer Heaven looked at him strangely: “Mr. Parma, what nonsense are you talking about?”
The others also showed confusion – one mid-stage of the seventh realm himself, claiming a young-looking Ninth Heaven Expert was his student; had he not woken up yet?
Could that be the reason for the young man’s anger?
Gasp! Bryan inhaled deeply, “Jones, Mr. Parma is not wrong; those two are indeed his students, and they’re just high school juniors.”
Cough, cough, cough, cough!! The middle-aged man nearly choked on his saliva, and the others who had gathered around were all stunned. High school juniors at the Ninth Heavens!!
Are you sure this isn’t a joke?
“Bryan, can I try hitting him?”
“Get lost.”
Under the watchful eyes of those high-ranking powerhouses, Jack’s face showed a faint smile as he withdrew the surrounding domain power and aura.
Everyone has a natural desire to show off in front of others, it’s just that Jack’s character is more reserved, and he doesn’t usually have a strong urge to show off.
It is only because he encountered acquaintances like Lori Parma and Vernon today that he thought of giving them a surprise (or shock).
As for his identity as someone who achieved Nine Layers within a year, there was no need to keep it a secret, or rather, once the upcoming battle was over, the ‘identity’ of being a one-year Ninth Heavens wouldn’t mean much.
After a pause of a few minutes, Lori Parma managed a wry smile, “Jack, today’s surprise was a bit frightening.”
Jack replied modestly, “Actually, I was also a bit surprised. At first, breaking through the Fourth Layer felt quite difficult; it almost took me two months to advance through three layers.”
“But since breaking through the Fourth Layer, I feel that my cultivation speed has gotten even faster, including the month it took to create a top-tier secret technique; and then, I just broke through to the Nine Layers.”
Is that even humanly possible?
At that moment, the mouths of the hundreds of high-ranking powerhouses around them couldn’t help but twitch.
Even Vernon felt a bit of admiration; Jack’s show-off was much smoother than when Lori Parma had broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, flaunting his aura around the school for half a day; Jack’s way was far superior.

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 381: My Student Has the Talent of a Heavenly King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 890: Chapter 381: My Student Has the Talent of a Heavenly King_2
Or rather, true to the nature of being a teacher’s student, he loved to show off.
Fortunately, his student Jane Aiken didn’t have this hobby. As the once top genius of South Sky Martial Height, she should have broken through to the Sixth-level Heaven by now, right, or perhaps even higher?
Looking at Jack Clark, who had become a Ninth Heaven Expert after not seeing him for several months, Vernon Lowe was somewhat uncertain.
Lori Parma took a deep breath and looked at the girl beside Jack Clark, who always had a smile on her lips, and slowly said, “Don’t tell me, Freya Louise, you’ve also reached Ninth Heavens?”
The girl shook her head: “Teacher Parma, my talent is not as good as Jack Clark’s. I’ve only cultivated to the Sixth-level Heaven.”
That’s good, just Sixth-level Heaven. The people around unconsciously nodded in agreement.
...
With Jack Clark, the first-grade student who was a Ninth Heavens’ monster, everyone quickly accepted this first-grade ‘genius’ of the Sixth-level Heaven—it was just the Sixth-level Heaven after all.
After the shock, what followed was catching up with old times, especially since Lori Parma and Vernon Lowe were curious about Jack Clark’s experiences after entering the Southern Battlefield, including whether he had entered the Road to Becoming a God.
Meanwhile, as several of them chatted, the soldiers in the distance had become busy under the command of their higher-ups, starting to build a temporary camp.
The sappers, taking base and fortification-building blocks out from their Subspace Equipment, quickly erected a campsite from nothing to a fully-fledged setup like assembling building blocks.
At the same time, looking down from high altitude, camps were rapidly rising in the other three directions, brightly lit, bustling, and orderly.
Boom! Just then, a pressure belonging to a Mythical-level burst out in the sky, instantly rolling the atmosphere and creating waves of air that swept across dozens of kilometers.
A Giant Beast with a body length of more than eight hundred meters, nearly three hundred meters tall at the shoulder, and covered with white scale armor through which countless white hairs sprouted in the gaps, was approaching through the air.
Behind this Giant Beast, eight white tails each a kilometer long fluttered, covering the night sky when spread out and exuding the terrifying aura of the Mythical Peak.
Also, next to this Giant Beast stood a figure surrounded by Divine Light, emitting king-level pressure.
In the distant night sky, white Radiance covered the area, turning into a winding white path hundreds of kilometers long, upon which a figure shrouded in endless light appeared.
At this moment, the night sky was illuminated by boundless light, and everyone instinctively turned to look at the vague figure in the sky with three pairs of white wings, their eyes filled with respect.
However, the instant Gabriel appeared, a white light descended from the sky, enveloping Jack Clark and Freya Louise, and to the astonishment of Lori Parma and others, pulled them up to the sky.
On the ‘carpet’ formed by the gentle light, Gabriel looked at Jack Clark and company somewhat curiously: “How did you two end up here?”
“We’ve seen Gabriel’s Throne and the Heavenly Fox Throne.” Jack Clark courteously greeted them, then explained: “My teacher is down with the Second Corps, so I came to visit him.”
“I see.”
Both Gentry Gail and Gabriel showed gentle smiles on their faces. No one would dislike such juniors who knew courtesy and gratitude.
With an incomparably handsome face and noble bearing, Gentry Gail smiled lightly, “Jack Clark, I know of you. That youngster Sinclair Moore told me you’ve also cultivated the Space-Time Summoning Technique.”
Jack Clark nodded: “Yes, Senior.”
“How is your cultivation of that Secret Skill doing? Do you have any doubts?” Since this was the first meeting and Jack Clark’s attitude impressed Gentry Gail, he was prepared to offer him guidance.
Jack Clark replied politely, “It’s going well, I have cultivated the Space-Time Summoning Technique to beyond grand accomplishment.”
“You have cultivated the Space-Time Summoning Technique to grand accomplishment!?” Gentry Gail was taken aback.
As the founder of this Secret Skill, Gentry Gail believed no one understood the Summoning Secret Skill better than him and also knew the difficulty of cultivating his own method.
It not only involved the forces of time, space, and even causality, but the summoning requirements were also very steep, needing a strong creature’s bloodline and a scale-armor-like medium.
Most importantly, the Summoned Giant Beast must recognize the summoner, and there must be a resonance between their souls for one to cultivate it to grand accomplishment.
And previously, Sinclair Moore had reported to him that only a little over three months had passed; such a pace of cultivation was even shocking to him, the creator of the Secret Skill.
“Jack Clark has indeed cultivated your Secret Skill to grand accomplishment. Earlier at the Outer Development Department, he summoned a projection of a Giant Beast and killed the past-self summoned by War Demon King Augusta with a Demon God bloodline.”
“What!?” Even Gentry Gail, a King-level strong man, was somewhat shocked.
Because Jack Clark’s information was sealed, it wasn’t widely publicized, so he was also unaware of these events while responsible for managing the battles at the Sky Curtain Battlefield.
Freya Louise blinked her eyes and looked towards Jack Clark with shining eyes.
An early Ninth Heaven Expert reversing defeat against a demon king—this achievement could be said to be unprecedented.
Jane Aiken smiled slightly, somewhat satisfied with Hannah Gail’s reaction, after all, she herself had been astonished for quite a while.
At this moment, the Eight-tailed Heavenly Fox Giant Beast slowly approached, curiously looking at Jack Clark, and let out a low growl as a greeting.
After Hannah Gail recovered from her shock, Jane Aiken spoke contentedly, “Let’s go. The others should be nearly all gathered by now, and it’s just right that you guys are here, Jack Clark.”
“Let’s go!”
As she spoke, the infinite radiance in the sky suddenly contracted, and the space distorted as Jane Aiken and her group vanished in an instant.
Looking at the night sky that had suddenly turned pitch-black, Lori Parma suddenly said, “Mr. Lester, do you think Jack Clark has a chance to break through to a Heavenly King within ten years?”
A Ninth Heaven Expert in just one year—no one would doubt Jack Clark’s potential to break through to king-level.
“Who should I ask if you ask me?”
Vernon Lowe shook his head; king-level and Heavenly King were entirely different concepts. Over the decades, the Human Race currently had only eleven Heavenly Kings, each and every one of them incredibly talented.
Bryan Jacobs excitedly patted Lori Parma’s shoulder, “Lori, you’re going to hit it big. If your student becomes a king-level or even a Heavenly King, even if he can’t make you soar, taking care of your descendants would set them up for life.”
“I’m not even married, where would I get descendants from?” Lori Parma rolled his eyes.
“So you’d better hurry to the inner city of Heavenly Abyss and find a beauty to marry. You’re only in your thirties, and you’re also a Seventh-level high-order powerhouse—plenty of beauties would be willing to marry you.”
“Get lost.”
“Alright, stop blowing smoke, all of you go move bricks. Bryan Jacobs, your group is responsible for the mountain peak coordinates at A-115, drive away the nearby Unique Beasts.”
…
Above the city of Heavenly Abyss floated a huge building at an altitude of tens of thousands of meters.
At this moment, the semicircular conference room was filled with hundreds of people, most of whom radiated the aura of Ninth Heavens with only a few whose cultivation levels were at the Eight Layer Heaven.
“Mr. Lee, I haven’t seen you make much progress in your cultivation for years, still mingling at the peak of the Ninth Heaven.”
“Nonsense, do you think it’s so easy to break through to king-level? Haven’t you been stuck at the peak realm for a decade as well?”
“You two old guys, stop mutually admiring each other here, okay? Have some consideration for our emotions, us in the late period of Ninth Heaven.”
Standing behind the solemn elder, Damon Lopes watched these old guys flattering each other and thought he should not have followed them up here.
At that moment, the elder in front turned his head and slapped Damon Lopes on the head, “What are you doing following me? This is the seat for us old folks; you should be over there.”
“Do you see? Those sitting over there are the most talented youngsters from the Federation in the last decade.”
“Even though you are an Innate Awakened One, the talents of those kids are not much weaker than yours, like the three on the very left who are also Innate Awakened Ones.”
“And there are those Descendants of the King; each one’s talent is not inferior to their predecessors. As long as they don’t die young, they have great prospects of breaking through to king-level.”
“Apart from them, the remaining nine are all geniuses under twenty-five years of age from the Nine Layers, and two of them have even broken through to the late period.”
“That strong?” Damon Lopes was somewhat surprised, but only just, as he was also an Innate Awakened One and had already advanced to the Eight Layer.
With the dual Innate Thunderbolt Origin, breaking free from the shackles of being an Innate Awakened One, he was confident he could break through to the Ninth Layer in at most half a year and reach the mid period of Ninth Heaven before graduation.
He believed his talents were unmatched across the entire Federation.
Although confident in himself, Damon Lopes thought it over and decided to head towards the group of Federal Geniuses to make himself known.

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 382 Race Background Weapon, True Martial Heavenly King
chapters.content:
Chapter 891: Chapter 382 Race Background Weapon, True Martial Heavenly King
At an independent seat on the side of the Parliament, Damon Lopes approached a young man with an imposing figure at the edge and said with a grin, “Brother, hello, let me introduce myself, my name is Damon Lopes.”
The young man with the imposing figure paused for a moment and then smiled, “Brother Lopes, hello, my name is Joshua Welan.”
But as soon as the two had exchanged greetings, the entire meeting room’s space trembled and distorted slightly.
In front of the meeting room, on the circular thrones, five figures radiating the pressure of kings appeared, immediately causing everyone below to become solemn.
The Divine Sky Heavenly King, dressed in ancient garb, glanced below and said in a gentle voice, “Everyone, please find a seat and sit down; the meeting is about to begin.”
At that moment, on the thrones in front, three more figures surrounded by the aura of rules appeared, followed by several more, and soon there were eleven kings present.
...
The rule aura invisibly emanating from the ten or so kings converged above, forming an intangible and heavy pressure in the meeting room, distorting the space itself.
“So many kings!” exclaimed Damon Lopes.
The powerfully built young man sitting beside him also nodded sentimentally, “Indeed, it’s also my first time seeing so many kings appear.”
Buzz! At that moment, a White Light burst forth from the thrones on the high platform, and then four figures appeared out of thin air, instantly spreading the pressure of Heavenly Kings and kings everywhere.
“You two, take a seat over there.”
As Gabriel’s voice fell, two thrones, each ten meters tall and conjured from Divine Light, appeared to the left of the original twenty-five.
“This…” Jack Clark hesitated.
The Divine Sky Heavenly King smiled slightly, “Sit down, you’ve already earned the right to be up here.”
When the Divine Sky Heavenly King spoke, other kings who had already seen the roster of key personnel for this great battle and knew of Jack Clark’s info also nodded to them in acknowledgement.
Although the Federation’s internal atmosphere was harmonious and most King-level strong men did not possess any air of superiority, it didn’t mean that their status could be ignored.
As strong men who had stepped into the realm of myth, they must be given the respect their status deserved.
This respect was not merely a reflection of strength, but also of their many years of contribution to the Human Race. In the Federation, the stronger a cultivator’s power, the higher their status, and likewise, the greater the responsibilities they shouldered.
This applied to Jack Clark and Freya Louise as well.
Freya Louise, the pilot of Number One, also had combat power comparable to king-level, and the enemies she would face next would surely be of the Demon King level, where the slightest negligence could result in death.
Thinking this, Jack Clark and Freya Louise nodded slightly, without declining, and took their seats on the thrones in the rear.
However, compared to the other thrones with crowns engraved on the backrests, these two looked somewhat more simple.
But even so, it represented the distinct status of Jack Clark and Freya Louise, attracting the attention of everyone present. Many who did not recognize them showed curiosity and puzzlement in their eyes.
And for Damon Lopes, his eyes widened in disbelief, “Damn, Brother Callum is actually in the Heavenly Abyss Battle City, and he’s even sitting up there.”
Joshua Welan became curious, “Brother Lopes, do you know the person sitting up there?”
“Know him? Of course, I do. His name is Jack Clark, he’s a good brother of mine.” Damon Lopes looked conflicted and somewhat wistful.
“To think that just a few months ago, I was fighting side by side with him, and during our downtime, we would discuss which beauty had bigger breasts and which one had longer legs. And now, before I knew it, he’s sitting on a throne.”
On the thrones in front, Jack Clark’s mouth twitched involuntarily. It’s not like he had ever discussed with you which beauty had bigger breasts or longer legs; you’re the one who was always looking at those risqué photos on your mobile phone.
Jack Clark and Joshua Welan both paused slightly because that name seemed familiar to him. His brother had a classmate named Jack Clark, rumored to have extraordinary talent.
Could it be…
Just then, in front of the high platform, more king-level figures began to emerge.
And when a middle-aged man with a serious expression appeared on the foremost throne, many faces showed excitement and all those below stood up.
“We pay respect to the True Martial Throne.”
The middle-aged man nodded slowly, “Please sit down, everyone; there’s no need for formality.”
The True Martial Heavenly King.
Looking at the middle-aged man, Jack Clark’s eyes also showed respect; he hadn’t expected to meet this legendary character today.
As a veteran Heavenly King Level powerhouse, not only was his cultivation powerful, but he had also made outstanding contributions to the Human Race, such as establishing the Body Casting Secret Technique for early Foundation Building.
The explosive growth of Human Race cultivators in the past decade had a significant connection with this Foundation Building Secret Technique, and thus, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel respect.
And now, the Rule Aura flowed faintly around this strong man, as if existing in a world apart, invisibly exuding an indescribable pressure.
Like Sesi’s mother, the True Martial Heavenly King was only one step away from fully entering the Supreme category.
And Jack Clark had once read on the True Martial Heavenly King’s profile that the strong man held in his hands a Race Background Weapon known as the True Martial Divine Tablet, with terrifying combat power.
Once, wielding the True Martial Divine Tablet, he faced off against a Demon God of the Purgatory Demon Race without falling short, which is how he got his name.
With the arrival of the True Martial Heavenly King, the atmosphere in the Great Hall suddenly became more solemn.
At that moment, on the main seat, a three-meter diameter Golden Rubik’s Cube slowly appeared, and then an invisible fluctuation swept over everyone, enveloping the whole meeting room.
An aged voice from within the Golden Rubik’s Cube slowly rose, “Now that everyone has arrived, we should begin soon. Divine Sky, you will preside over this war conference.”
Divine Sky Heavenly King nodded and said in a deep voice, “For this campaign, our side has assembled two primary warring legions, three reserve legions, and two hundred thousand logistical reinforcements for the Heavenly Abyss city.”

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 382 Race Background Weapon, True Martial Heavenly King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Chapter 382 Race Background Weapon, True Martial Heavenly King_2
“In addition, a large amount of ammunition, as well as Heaven and Earth Treasure for healing injuries and restoring True Strength, have been mobilized here.”
“These resources will arrive continuously over the next three days, by which time all elite personnel will be equipped with enough healing and recovery resources.”
“At present, our main combat force consists of 1.47 million soldiers, spanning eighteen legions, each of which will be stationed separately at one hundred and fifty-six battle points.”
As the Divine Sky Heavenly King began to speak, radiance emerged in the sky, forming a three-dimensional map a kilometer across that appeared before everyone.
The massive map covered the base’s outer depth of 10,000 kilometers and spanned more than 20,000 kilometers across the territory controlled by the Human Race, delineating various dangerous lands and forbidden areas.
Many of these forbidden areas within these territories were formed during the years of battles fought by the Second Councilor, the Sky-based God King, the Third Councilor, the Primordial True King, and the Purgatory Demon God.
...
The remnant forces of rules permeate within, mixed with space fragments and Void Storms, creating zones of destruction that even king-level strong men might find dangerous to enter.
Therefore, when launching long-range missiles from the rear, these forbidden areas must be avoided, else the ammunition will be directly consumed and wasted.
What’s more, the entire frontline battlefield has become a place of severe radiation and magnetic field chaos due to constant warfare, nuclear explosions, and battles between kings and Heavenly Kings.
Thus, it requires powerful signal towers to provide coverage, and once a battle breaks out, six sky-based battleships will serve as signal relay stations and enter the battlefield.”
Under the arrangement of the Divine Sky Heavenly King, the vast Frontline Battlefield was divided into eighteen battle zones.
These battle zones intersect each other and stagger front to back, ensuring that the fire coverage is sufficient to envelop the opposing Purgatory Demon Clan Army.”
At the forefront are the Thunder God Cannons that can bombard enemies hundreds of kilometers away and the high-yield rocket artillery positions with a strike range of two thousand kilometers.”
In addition to these, there are airports, ammunition supply points, and missile launch bases one thousand kilometers, three thousand kilometers, five thousand kilometers, and up to eight thousand kilometers from the front line.”
All these Military Bases need to be guarded to prevent infiltration and sabotage by elite squads from the Purgatory Demon Clan.”
After all, the depth of the battlefield is too great, and high-order Purgatory True Demons who are adept at concealing their tracks could elude even a Heavenly King at a distance of thousands of kilometers.”
Therefore, during large-scale battles, ordinary soldiers form positions and initiate attacks, while high-ranking powerhouses, led by Ninth Heaven Experts, comprise elite squads that maneuver through the battlefield.”
Some of these elite squads will remain in the middle and rear to protect, while others will infiltrate enemy positions to wreak havoc, guiding wide-area destruction strikes with Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs.”
After assigning tasks to all legions, the Divine Sky Heavenly King spoke about the key point of this plan.”
“In this war, the high-end strong men will restrain each other, with the core strategy relying on Number One as the bait, and Jack Clark in the shadows, using pinpoint strikes to gradually break the balance.”
“However, we’ve received news that the enemy has also sent reinforcements, including seventeen legions from vassal races and five elite squads of the Purgatory True Demon Army.”
“In addition, it’s currently known that there are two Demon King Level Strong and one Great Demon King reinforcing the enemy, which means that both sides are evenly matched in terms of overall strength.”
“Yet, with the True Martial Heavenly King wielding the Race Background Weapon, his combat power is comparable to the Supreme Level, and with the return of the Heaven Suppressing War King and his seals removed, he is strong enough to challenge a Great Demon King head-on, giving us the advantage in high-end combat power.”
“It’s a pity that Mysterious Martial and Denny Kaye are absent; otherwise, with the majority of high-end combatants assembled, we might have been able to completely penetrate the Demon Clan’s defense line.”
At this point, the Divine Sky Heavenly King turned to Jack Clark, “Before this war begins, Jack, do not exhibit combat power comparable to a king-level powerhouse to avoid being prematurely targeted by the enemy’s Demon King level experts.”
“Your initial mission is to roam the frontline of the battlefield and kill the Elite Demon Squad members infiltrating our positions, especially the True Demon Nobles with Nine Demonic Marks.”
“When the war reaches its mid period, and the high-end forces from both sides clash intensely, and Number One is also engaged, you can then burst with full strength to break through the enemy’s defenses.”
“At that time, the second, the eleventh, and the nineteenth legions, along with five Elite Squads, will coordinate with you to launch a powerful assault and completely tear through the enemy’s front line.”
“I understand,” Jack Clark nodded gravely.
This civilizational war was too broad and too massive in scale, and the duration of the conflict would be prolonged; it wasn’t a stage for personal heroism.
At the same time, all those who could attend this meeting were commanders of various legions and King-level strong men, so there was no need to worry about information regarding Jack Clark being leaked.
If there were issues with these individuals under the surveillance of the Supreme Experts, the Federation would have collapsed long ago.
The meeting continued with discussions of the details, assigning clearer tasks to each legion’s commander, and the war was set to begin six days later, which was three days before sunrise.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark was dutifully attending the meeting, far away, tens of thousands of kilometers behind the base of the Purgatory Demon Race, a cold voice slowly rose.
“Is this the Human Race?”
Standing tall, Alex wore dark golden battle armor, stood 3 meters tall, and on his head were nine Demon Horns of varying lengths, resembling a crown, while his face was covered in dark red fine scales.
In his hand, he held a Ninth Heaven Cultivator at the early stages, gripping his head and holding him in the air.
At that moment, this Ninth Heaven Cultivator was extremely weak, his battle armor shattered, half of his body blasted apart, suffering heavy injuries, and was nearly at his last breath.
Several hundred meters away on the shattered Earth, lay three mangled corpses of the Human Race.
This was an elite squad tasked with a deep mission behind the Purgatory Demon Race lines, only now they had all fallen in battle.
Jiang Zhe, who was being gripped by the head, was weakened but his aura not diminished, his eyes staring defiantly at the terrifying Purgatory Demon, his voice hoarse and weak.
“You garbage monsters, if it weren’t for the fact that Old Jiang had diarrhea today and felt a bit weak, you wouldn’t have been able to catch me.”
After saying so, Jiang Zhe took a breath and sneered, “Come on then, give me a swift death. It won’t be long before you mongrels will be joining old Jiang down there.”
Jiang Zhe’s tone made Alex’s eyebrows furrow slightly; he turned his head slightly to look at the Dark Giant Beast behind him, spanning a kilometer, and asked in the language of the Purgatory Demon Race.
“What is he saying?”
The Dark Giant Beast let out a cold, deep roar, “Roar! I don’t understand, but it seems like an insult to you.”
“Daring to insult the noble True Demon Nobles, seeking death.”
Boom! With that, Alex exerted a slight force in his hand, crushing Jiang Zhe’s skull and casually tossing away the human corpse.
After casually extinguishing the life of Jiang Zhe, this human powerhouse, Alex felt a bit puzzled, “These humans are so weak, yet they have been able to withstand our True Demon Race for so long?”
The Dark Giant Beast, with flames blazing over its body and nine dragon heads similar to a Western Dragon, let out a slow growl, “It’s not that these humans are weak, but rather, Alex, you are too strong.”
“As one possessing the bloodline of a Demon God, these ordinary humans are no match for you. Your targets should be the top-notch geniuses of the Human Race.”
“There are geniuses among humans?” Alex seemed surprised.
The Dark Giant Beast slowly nodded, “Yes, those so-called Innate Awakened Ones, descendants of Heavenly Kings, geniuses who reach Nine Demonic Marks within less than two hundred Sun Wheels, all possess considerable strength.”
Alex’s eyebrows rose, “Those from the Human Race can grow to Nine Demonic Marks in just over two hundred Sun Wheels?”
“Roar! Compared to True Demons of Purgatory, although these humans are relatively weaker at the same level, they grow very fast, and some exceptions are even as strong as the True Demon Nobles.”
“Is that so,” Alex licked his lips, a cruel smile spreading across his savage face.

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 383: The Eight Great Demon God Empires, The Demon Dragon Awakens
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Chapter 383: The Eight Great Demon God Empires, The Demon Dragon Awakens
Before the start of this operational meeting, the think tank and the God Machine Armament, Vava, had already conducted numerous simulations and set up dozens of possible scenarios.
For instance, our side might gain a slight advantage and expand our point of impact to greatly damage the enemy, or the enemy could suddenly have more powerful fighters—perhaps even Demon God Level Powerhouses—to face.
Compared with the exposed number of high-level powerhouses of the Human Race, the true strength of The Purgatory Family is even more terrifying.
Take the existence of Demon God Level individuals, for example—there are over a dozen of them, with each of the Eight Great Demon God Empires being guarded by at least one, and sometimes even two, Demon God Level strong men.
Not to mention the Great Demon Kings and demon kings below them, as well as the elite armies that have been fighting for who knows how many years.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Six Great Empires that are even further from the Human Race are embroiled in a war with two other civilizations, too busy to care, the Human Race would have been annihilated long ago.
...
This is why the Federation has been desperately developing lethal weapons over the years, using up stockpiled resources to cultivate practitioners.
If we cannot grow rapidly, once The Purgatory Family ends a Civilization War, the pressure the Human Race will face will become incredibly immense.
After various tasks were assigned and everyone knew what they had to do, the war meeting that lasted nearly three hours finally ended.
When Divine Sky Heavenly King finished speaking, True Martial Heavenly King slowly rose from his throne, and a dense, terrifying kill aura so strong it turned the Great Hall a shade of blood, spilled out from him.
Dominant and bloody.
True Martial Heavenly King’s gaze slowly swept over everyone before he spoke in a deep voice, “Gentlemen, the Second Mythical Impact is about to burst forth; hence, this battle is of vital importance.”
“For the Human Race.”
Every powerhouse in the meeting hall had a stern expression, radiating a strong intent to kill, including Jack Clark, whose eyes, under the influence of the atmosphere, swirled with terrifying killing aura.
The Human Race has never lacked fervor; everyone standing here has been through countless battles.
Especially those Ninth Heaven Experts among the army commanders below, most of them are relatively young, aged between thirty and fifty, with only a few who have experienced the Dark Age and are over sixty.
Sixty years old is just the start for a Ninth Heaven Expert, who can live for hundreds of years.
The reason for the scarcity of high-ranking powerhouses in this age group is that most have perished in battle.
Before high-ranking powerhouses who can move at several times the speed of sound and whose every move is comparable to a high-yield missile bombardment, only those of the same level can withstand them.
Many kings have also fallen in the successive Civilization Wars.
Since the Heaven-Earth Mutated event fifty years ago, the number of King-level strong men born to the Human Race has actually been quite substantial, enough to instill fear in The Purgatory Family.
Yet, due to the internal strife of the Dark Age and the subsequent Civilization War with The Purgatory Family, at least nineteen known kings have fallen—an extremely brutal reality.
Currently, there are over forty King-level strong men within the Human Race’s inner circle, but some are stationed at various pathways, and a few guard the Southern Star and the Outer Development Department.
Together, the kings at the two Frontline Battlefields total just over thirty.
However, despite the heavy casualties on the Human side, quite a few demon kings have also fallen, especially in the last two large battles, where five demon kings were ambushed and killed at once, shocking the insides of the Purgatory Demon Race.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! One by one, figures radiating domain light flew out of the meeting hall and scattered in all directions.
However, just as Jack Clark was about to fly out with Freya Louise, Damon Lopes turned into a burst of purple and black lightning chasing after him, followed by a burly young man.
Damon Lopes came up with a grin, “As expected from Brother Callum, not only have you broken through to the Ninth Heavens in a month, but your combat strength is also comparable to a king-level now.”
Is the gap between the early phase of the Eighth Layer and being comparable to king-level significant?
It is significant, but compared to Jack Clark’s earlier feat of killing an early-phase Eight Layer Heaven blood python in the late period of the Sixth Layer, it seems somewhat acceptable.
Moreover, this guy was like a God of Death back on the Ruins Continent, so although Damon Lopes was somewhat surprised, he quickly accepted the change.
There was no help for it, his brother had been a freak of nature all along.
Jack Clark shook his head, “We can’t be complacent. Without having truly combated a Demon King level strong man, my strength for now is just an estimate.”
Damon Lopes nodded, “Indeed, given your cautious nature, when you say your strength is comparable to an initial-phase king, there’s a good chance you would shock everyone by killing a demon king in a second on the battlefield.”
Pfft!
Freya Louise couldn’t help but laugh out loud, her eyes twinkling with amusement, “Actually, I have a similar feeling too.”
…You think demon kings are cabbages. Jack Clark shook his head and turned to the burly young man.
Before Jack Clark could speak, Justin Welan smiled slightly and introduced himself, “Junior Clark, hello, my name is Joshua Welan, Justin’s older brother.”
So it was Mr. Willard’s older brother.
A smile immediately appeared on Jack Clark’s face, “So you’re Senior Joshua. I’ve always heard Justin talk about his super-genius big brother, and today I finally meet you.”
Jack Clark was somewhat surprised to encounter Justin Welan here.
Ever since he had entered South Sky Martial Height and got to know Justin, he always heard him boast about how amazing his brother was, constantly sending him senior resources suitable for his cultivation.
But everyone had their missions, so after greeting each other in the air, they went their separate ways, including Freya Louise, who donned her God Machine Armament and flew to the 13th Legion’s base.
Compared to them, Jack Clark, who had a solo mission, would actually have a few days with nothing to do.
After thinking it over, Jack Clark’s figure exploded into motion, breaking through the air as he flew towards the Logistics Department.
It was still the lobby thousands of meters below. After entering a separate supply exchange room, Jack Clark spoke, “Vava, I have new merits that need to be calculated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 383: The Eight Great Demon God Empires, The Awakening of the Demon Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: Chapter 383: The Eight Great Demon God Empires, The Awakening of the Demon Dragon_2
The cartoon character on the screen danced around, emitting an electronic voice.
“Hello, Major General Clark, please provide the detailed account information and indicate if there are any items for verification.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Over twenty days ago, I encountered Blood God Acunus in the Black Forbidden Zone, whose strength had fallen to the Nine Layers of Heaven. Several high-level archbishops accompanied him, and in the end, including Acunus, all were slain by me.”
“This is the proof item, a storage ring carrying his spiritual will.” Saying this, Jack Clark took out the ring that had most of the spiritual imprints refined away, leaving only a trace of remnant thought sealed within.
In the Federation, there is a standardized official procedure for contribution verification. You can’t just claim to have killed someone and have it counted as a merit.
Otherwise, with Jack Clark’s strength, he would have long since activated the Void-Striking Heart Eye to erase Acunus’s spiritual imprint.
...
Although with Jack Clark’s status, simply stating that he had slain Acunus would be believed by the Federation’s top level, such belief would be based on trust in him.
But if there is ‘physical evidence,’ many things would become much simpler.
“Proof item within the ring, detecting fluctuations of Acunus’s soul breath.”
“Validating data… On July 13th, observations were made of the collapse of the Divine Realm of Acunus from the Evil God Alliance, with chaotic Heavenly Earth Law, leading to the determination of his fall.”
Information flashed across the screen.
“Acunus, the Evil God of the Blood God Sect, had his Rule True Body destroyed by the Mysterious Martial Sky King at the end of May, his soul source shattered, and his realm fell to the Nine Layers of Heaven.”
“On July 13th, he was slain by Major General Jack Clark in the depths of the Black Forbidden Zone and completely perished.”
“Thank you, Major General Jack Clark, for the outstanding contribution you have made to the Federation. Due to Acunus’s special identity, his current bounty is thirty thousand Contribution Points, equivalent to quasi-mythical level.”
“The Merit Value has been transferred to your account, please check it.”
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark’s Merit Value skyrocketed to over forty thousand, equivalent to one hundred and thirty thousand Contribution Points, allowing him to exchange for a large number of crystals.
A quasi-mythical level head is worth thirty thousand in merit, while a demon king starts at one hundred thousand.
This was also the reason why Jack Clark made his way to the Frontline Battlefield without delay.
Due to opposition, the value of slaying high-order Purgatory Demon clan and even demon kings is highly overvalued, far exceeding the hunting of giant beasts of the same level by several times.
Beyond this were the resources harvested from their slaying, like this ring.
Whoosh!
As Jack Clark ‘poured’ all the items from the storage ring onto the device, an intense aura of energy pervaded the small room in an instant, with various divine lights flickering.
“Resources are being verified, please wait.”
Sizzle!
Scanning beams passed over the twenty or so resources emitting energy fluctuations, or special waveforms, and soon data popped up on the screen.
“Innate Cold Marrow, a high-level divine object, resource category, Mysterious Light Crystal Stone, an intermediate divine object, ore category…”
Out of the twenty-three items scanned by Vava, fourteen were resource category items suitable for cultivation, seven were high-level divine objects, and seven intermediate; the rest were material category, useful for strengthening weapons and battle armor.
Additionally, there was a stone slab whose specific composition couldn’t be scanned, only detecting some kind of relic energy waveform on it.
“Indeed, a phoenix that falls to the ground is no better than a chicken.” Jack Clark shook his head and put these items away.
To a Ninth Heaven Expert, these resources were abundant, so much so that even a quasi-mythical powerhouse would be excited, but for a Mythical Powerhouse, they were far too few.
The reason being that Jack Clark had only slain an avatar of Blood God Acunus, born from a borrowed body.
As for the storage ring holding all the resources of the Blood God Sect, it likely went to the Mysterious Martial Sky King when he shattered Acunus’s Rule True Body.
After putting away these resources, Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the resource exchange list, particularly focusing on the Life Crystals.
Unfortunately, In the two or three days, Vava had only intercepted one Level 8 and two Level 7 Life Crystals. Many who obtained Life Crystals either used them themselves or conducted private trades.
After all, exchanging them with the official only yielded an eighty percent price. Furthermore, the Unique Beasts near the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield had become very scarce after being cleared out over twenty-plus years.
After contemplating briefly, Jack Clark took the three high-order Life Crystals and exchanged all his Merit Value for ordinary God-level resources.
For the next few days, he was going to cultivate with all his strength to see if he could ‘consume’ all the resources and break through to the mid-period of the Nine Layers of Heaven before the outbreak of the great war.
“You have converted a high-purity Life Energy Crystal, gaining 3720 Points Attribute.”
“You converted a High Purity Life Energy Crystal and gained 951 Attribute points…”
After converting three high-order crystals, Jack Clark now had an additional 5,600-plus Attribute points. Together with the original 16,000-plus points, he had accumulated a total of 21,870 Attribute points at his disposal.
Crackle!
Jack Clark swallowed a piece of High-level Divine Object filled with rich energy in one go. Instantly, the furious energy exploded within his body, and a heavy oppressive force spread all around him.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark entered Closed-door Cultivation, the entire Heavenly Abyss Battle City was set into motion.
Regiments that had been resting for about ten days set off one after another, advancing into the frontline battlefield, accompanied by countless missiles and cannonballs emerging from the factories and warehouses.
From the rear, the first, second, and third Base Cities, massive transport planes took off densely packed, heading towards the Heavenly Abyss frontline in a grand, imposing manner.
Across the land, trains stretching for kilometers, with their interior spaces expanded and filled with innumerable supplies and ammunition, departed…
On the third day of Jack Clark’s reclusive cultivation, in the Ice Crystal Divine Palace, a black-red Colossal Beast covered in thick scale armor slowly opened its eyes.
Boom!
As the black-red Colossal Beast rose to its feet, the solid and thick ice crystal ground trembled; the air around it exploded in concentric circles, creating rolling white waves and a frighteningly mighty sound.
Under the tempering of three Higher-order Laws, the body of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon had become even more strengthened and fearsome; now, merely standing there caused the surrounding space to subtly oscillate.
Squeak squeak!
A purple little dragon flew in front of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s massive golden vertical pupils, its little claws constantly gesturing in front of it, calling out excitedly non-stop.
The black-red Colossal Beast opened its mouth slightly, exhaling hot air and a rumbling growl.
“Don’t mind that projection. I once made a Summon contract with a ‘genius’ of the Human Race. That phenomenon is likely caused by a breakthrough in his Summoning Secret Skill,” the Colossal Beast said.
Squeak squeak?! The purple little dragon showed a look of bewilderment in its eyes.
The purple little dragon had not seen humans nor did it know what humans were, as it had hatched after the Thunderflame Demon Dragon had entered the mythical world.
Ignoring the little dragon’s bewilderment, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, with a body length of more than 700 meters, walked with heavy steps; each one shook the earth and stirred up waves as if calling the mountains and seas.
Woo!
In the sea of clouds outside the Ice Crystal Divine Temple, a Giant Whale nearly 290 meters in length, covered in black, thick scale armor, and with giant fins like wings, swam around, occasionally emitting long cries like a siren.
At the moment, the Single-horned Tiger Whale was emanating a powerful Aura of a Late Stage 9, and due to increasingly resembling its original ‘Tiger Whale’ form, its oppressive might was even stronger than a typical Ninth-level Late-stage Beast.
Meanwhile, on a small hill a dozen kilometers away, a red Beast lay coiled, with time power faintly circling around it, exuding a terror nearly akin to that of a Mythical Giant Beast.
Everyone who had visited the home of the Silver Giant Dragon had gained quite a lot of benefits.
Especially the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, whose already formidable size directly grew by 200 meters. It had consumed what was almost equivalent to several Mythical Giant Beasts of top-tier Divine Items and even Law resources.
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon glanced around and then slowly growled, “Joe, has Scythia woken up yet?”
From a distance, the Single-horned Tiger Whale flew through the clouds, excitedly roaring, “Roar! Thunderflame, you’re awake. Scythia has also woken up.”
“Where is it?”
Roar! It went to the neighboring territory of the Titan Beast to show off—no, I mean, to have a friendly exchange with a friend. It said to wait for it after you wake up.”
This guy, he actually went to that creature named Telsafi… The Thunderflame Demon Dragon hesitated slightly, having been ready to head to the Chaotic Turbulent Region as soon as it woke up.
Let it be, a few days’ wait is no bother.
Just in time, a major battle is about to erupt on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield. By then, the Summoned Giant Beast Avatar would certainly need to join the fight. Maybe it can kill a Great Demon King to signal the battle.
Now, nearing the Mid-Mythical Stage, with three Higher-order Laws and Six Top-level Talents, after Giantification Talent melded into the Deep Red Form, a typical Titan wouldn’t be its opponent.
This ‘typical’ refers to those who had just mastered one Higher-order Law and had broken through to Titan Level not long ago—not that the opponent is really ordinary.
Every king-level, Heavenly King-level powerhouse, be it a Giant Beast, human, or demon king, is a brilliant standout, perched at the pinnacle of billions of lives.
Just as there are ordinary people and geniuses among cultivators, there’s also a disparity among kings and Heavenly Kings.
The stage of early, mid, and late realm; the type and strength of the Laws they control; the number of Laws; their battle consciousness and experience; and even the weapons in their hands all make a difference.

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 384: The Invincible Tim Abott, The Great Battle Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: Chapter 384: The Invincible Tim Abott, The Great Battle Begins
In the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark, who had been in closed-door cultivation for three days, was emitting an increasingly strong aura. He slowly opened his eyes as a thought echoed in his mind.
“Burn 1000 Points Attribute to initiate the Flame Thunder Avatar into an epiphany state.”
In an instant, a surge of energy traveled through the Soul Channel and entered the body of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon in the Ice Crystal Divine Palace, enveloping it in enlightenment.
Yiyaya! Feeling the invisible intent around it, the purple little dragon’s eyes revealed a curious look as it reached out with its tiny claw to touch it.
Under the shroud of epiphanic intent, the spiritual will of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon abruptly stirred, drawing upon the Law Power to condense runes onto its double claws and Tail Blade.
Runes, representing traces of certain powers of Heaven and Earth, are still helpful to the Thunderflame Demon Dragon even though it had become a Mythical Giant Beast.
...
However, the power of a single Basic Rune is weak, but when stacked by the hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands, they exhibit astonishing strength.
This can be seen from the Slash Runes of the Single-horned Tiger Whale, which, evolving with its growth, have almost merged with its Double Fins to become a pair of huge Slash Blades.
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon had never underestimated the power of runes, but it had never had the time to cultivate and condense them because it was either in Hibernation or on the path of combat.
Now that there was a little time, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon prepared to enhance its double claws and Tail Blade.
Roar!
Under the cover of night, dragon roars resounded through Heaven and Earth.
Above the sea of clouds, a Silver Giant Dragon with a body length of 400 meters and wingspan of over 800 meters was flying at more than ten times the speed of sound, surrounded by dark storm clouds.
As a Flying Type Behemoth, dragons are known for their swift flying speed. Now, with its strength greatly increased, the Silver Giant Dragon’s speed was astonishingly fast.
Shortly, the Silver Giant Dragon, after flying for a long while, crossed its own territory and entered the domain of another Titan Giant Beast.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon entered enemy territory a few thousand kilometers in, a Mythical-level Giant Beast’s pressure burst forth, followed by an earth-shaking beastly roar.
Roar! The earth-shaking roar was filled with a warning.
Yet, no sooner had the Mythical Giant Beast roared than the Silver Giant Dragon responded with a proud dragon roar, “Roar! Move aside, the Great Sethia is going to visit Telsafi.”
Instantly, the Mythical Giant Beast at the border of its territory paused and then retracted its neck, pretending nothing had happened and closed its eyes to sleep.
“Roar! Telsafi, the Great Sethia has come for you.”
The Silver Giant Dragon, having grown to quasi-mythical level and with a body strengthened by a Law Divine Artifact to rival that of an Ordinary Myth Beast, let out a triumphant roar.
However, becoming a Myth was difficult. Even though the Blue-White Giant Dragon had prepared two Law Level Divine Artifacts for the Silver Giant Dragon, including the Innate Space Runes it had long since fused with, it still couldn’t break through to Mythical level in the short term.
Even so, the Silver Giant Dragon was very satisfied and prepared to show off to a friend.
The Great Sethia had only left for a few Sun Wheels, and had grown from level eight to quasi-mythical, and also eradicated two Mythological Beast Empires, unified the ocean of an Indigenous World, and became an Overlord of the realm.
Haha!! With this thought, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but let out a series of proud roars.
Hearing the familiar dragon roars from high altitude, some Mythical Giant Beasts and strong men from Vassal Races on the Earth, who had sensed the powerful pressure and wanted to intercept, suddenly stopped in their tracks.
It turned out to be Prince Sethia from next door, untouchable and unaffordable to provoke.
As the Silver Giant Dragon flew at full strength, the mountains and rivers below rapidly receded. It flew straight on its path until it arrived above a forest filled with birdsong and fragrant flowers.
Enriched by the Heavenly Energy, the forest was thriving, with the branches and leaves of the trees shimmering with crystal radiance, full of Vitality.
