Unique Beasts with graceful forms and a gentle Aura lived within the forest.
Furthermore, 0.5-meter sized girls resembling human girls with dragonfly wings at their backs flew through the air, sprinkling lovely specks of light as they passed.
In the center of this forest lay a clear-bottomed lake spanning tens of kilometers, with pure energy vapors condensing above the water surface, creating a scenery akin to fairyland.
At that moment, in the middle of the deep lake, lay a 300-meter long, gold-blue Giant Dragon, its body covered in Ice Crystal-like scale armor, exuding grace and beauty.
This Giant Dragon appeared as if cast from crystal, even its Dragon Wings had an Ice Crystal appearance, and the Spiral Dragon Horns on its head were transparent gold and blue.
Under the moonlight’s reflection on the lake, the half-exposed body of the Giant Dragon shimmered, exuding an extreme elegance and beauty.
Just then, a massive Silver Giant Dragon appeared in the sky, followed by an earth-shaking roar: “Roar! Telsafi, the Great Sethia has come to see you.”
Boom!
Accompanying the roar, the sky lit up brightly as a radiant white Light Beam spanning the sky, with the terrifying might capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth, aimed at the gold-blue Giant Dragon.
“Sethia, you idiot!”
The gold-blue Giant Dragon, which had been lying in the lake asleep, suddenly rose up with an angry roar. Then its semi-transparent, crystal-like double wings unfurled furiously.
Boom!
Rich multi-colored lights brightened the night sky, creating a transparent, hemispherical Edge Crystal with a diameter of a kilometer around the gold-blue Giant Dragon.
At that moment, Ice Flame as thick as ten meters shot straight through Heaven and Earth with a power to annihilate and freeze everything, striking the crystal structure and blasting forth with tremendous force.
Boom!
Miles around, the Earth trembled as the boundless white Ice Flames impacted the ground, causing explosions that froze and shattered innumerable specs of dirt and rocks, along with lake water, forming a ring-shaped blast that erupted into the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 896: 384: The Invincible Tim Abott, The Great Battle Bursts Forth_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: Chapter 384: The Invincible Tim Abott, The Great Battle Bursts Forth_2
The transparent and clear lake surrounding them erupted in layers of crystal water waves resembling tsunamis as they were struck by the energy carried by the Ice Flame.
Under the continuous breath of the Silver Giant Dragon, the space around it trembled, and the entire lake was frozen by the endless release of icy energy, forming a deadly icy zone.
The invisible white chill transformed into successive shock waves, sweeping through the large forests nearby, and many colorful elves in the air petrified like ice sculptures, shattering into pieces as they hit the ground with a crackling sound.
“Roar! Scythia, Great Telsafi will give you a severe beating today.”
With a somewhat angry roar, the surroundings shimmered as crystal spheres, a dozen meters in diameter and containing red, blue, and purple radiance, appeared.
These crystals, like missiles imbued with terrifying energy, collided with the breath of Ice Flame and exploded in an instant with terrifying bursts.
...
Boom, boom, boom! Under the horrific explosion of the crystals, the breath of Ice Flame was scattered.
At the same time, more crystals condensed in the sky, emitting a multicolored glow and destructive aura, blanketing the sky as they bombarded the distant Silver Giant Dragon in the high altitude.
“Roar! The Great Scythia is invincible.”
Boom! Centered around the Silver Giant Dragon, hundreds of meters thick black tornadoes descended from the sky, penetrating Heaven and Earth, surrounding all directions.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The black destructive Ice Crystal Tornadoes swept across Heaven and Earth, carving out hundreds of meters wide paths of destruction on the ground, crushing everything in their way and blocking all the exploding crystals.
Whenever a crystal imbued with explosive energy touched the storm, it would instantly detonate, releasing a terrifying energy shock that shook Heaven and Earth.
As a result of the shock, some exploding crystals that fell to the ground caused it to fracture, with stones and dirt shooting into the sky, sending terrifying vibrations that echoed ceaselessly.
The dreadful battle scared countless Unique Beasts in the forest into a frenzy, fleeing and roaring in panic, completely devoid of the previous peaceful fairyland-like scene.
Almost half an hour later, the energy from the explosions between Heaven and Earth slowly subsided.
At that time, the once vibrant forest had turned into ruins, with countless Sky-touching Trees broken, and the ground littered with giant meteorite craters.
The former clear lake had also disappeared, leaving only the frozen and shattered ground and crystals. In the midst of the ruins, two giant dragons were confronting each other, one above and one below.
Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon in the sky, with wings spanning over eight hundred meters and a body length surpassing the quasi-mythical limit, the golden-blue Ice Crystal Giant Dragon let out a shocked roar below.
“Scythia, you’ve actually grown to quasi-mythical level.”
The Silver Giant Dragon fluttered its wings in the air: “Roar! What nonsense, Torsa. Isn’t it a simple matter for the Great Scythia to grow to the quasi-mythical level?”
…Fool, do you think you’re the Great Telsafi?
The blue-gold Giant Dragon twitched in the corner of its eye, then let out an impatient roar: “You’ve come today and destroyed the pure lake the Great Telsafi had purified, looking for a fight, huh?”
“Roar! Telsafi, you can’t defeat the Great Scythia now.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared triumphantly in the sky, with its tail flicking.
Although they had only briefly clashed, the Silver Giant Dragon was delighted to find that it seemed it didn’t need to call Tim Abott for help—Telsafi couldn’t beat it anymore.
However, after a few Sun Wheels had passed, Telsafi had also grown from Level 9 to the quasi-mythical level, and its strength had become very formidable.
Thinking this, the Silver Giant Dragon roared: “Roar! Telsafi, the Great Scythia has come to discuss something with you today.”
With that, the Silver Giant Dragon retracted its wings, and its massive body fell like a meteor from the sky.
Boom! The broken Earth exploded, and countless stones splattered everywhere.
Amidst the rolling smoke and Ice Crystals, the Silver Giant Dragon raised its head proudly: “Roar! In light of our shared upbringing, the Great Scythia has specially come today to invite you to join the Dragon Palace.”
“The Dragon Palace, what is that?” The gold-blue Giant Dragon revealed a puzzled look in its eyes.
The Silver Giant Dragon looked up, glancing down at the gold-blue Giant Dragon with the corner of its eye, roaring with pride: “Roar! The Dragon Palace is an empire force established by the Great Scythia, having unified an entire ocean of the Indigenous World.”
“Recently, under the leadership of the Great Scythia, the Dragon Palace has annihilated two Mythological Beast Empire forces and killed two Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beasts.”
“Moreover, the Great Scythia has also eradicated a civilized race, causing blood to flow like rivers, and even battled with an ancient being.”
The blue-gold Giant Dragon looked at the Silver Giant Dragon with a look reserved for fools and let out a low growl, “Scythia, do you think Great Telsafi is as easy to deceive as you are?”
The Silver Giant Dragon growled back, “Roar! Great Sethia never lies.”
The blue-gold Giant Dragon shook its head, “Great Telsafi does not believe.”
“Roar! Great Sethia knows you wouldn’t easily believe, but that is the truth, Great Sethia is invincible,” the Silver Giant Dragon said proudly, its tail held high.
The blue-gold Giant Dragon growled casually, “Is that so? Then tell me, what did you do after you sneaked off to that Indigenous World?”
“Roar! Great Sethia was very lucky, for I had just entered that Indigenous World when I subdued a very fierce Dragon-type Giant Beast and established the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire with it.”
“A very fierce Dragon-type Giant Beast, that beast must be very strong,” the blue-gold Giant Dragon’s eyes narrowed slightly.
The Silver Giant Dragon growled with pride, “Roar! Of course, Tim Abott is strong, it’s the most formidable beast Great Sethia has ever seen.”
“When Tim Abott was at level seven, it could already fight to a draw with an level eight Sethia and could kill a Mid Level 9 Monarch Bloodline Giant Beast.”
“After making a breakthrough to Level 9, Tim Abott immediately killed a quasi-mythical beast at Level 9 Early Stage and later in Mid-Level 9, it even killed a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast.”
Unable to help itself, the Silver Giant Dragon boasted about the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s achievements in one breath, but as soon as it finished speaking, it realized it had slipped up. Done for, I’ve given myself away.
I knew it, how could you possibly have killed a Mythical Giant Beast.
Under the calm gaze of the blue-gold Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon’s face took on a sheepish human expression.
Wait, something isn’t right, the blue-gold Giant Dragon growled suspiciously, “Wait, Sethia, I remember you only ran out a few Sun Wheels ago, but you’re saying when you met that beast, it was just level seven?”
“Roar! Yes,” the Silver Giant Dragon nodded.
“In a few Sun Wheels, it grew from level seven to Mythical?” Doubt shone in the eyes of the blue-gold Giant Dragon, feeling like it was being taken for a fool.
The Silver Giant Dragon growled nonchalantly, “Roar! Tim Abott grows very quickly, even faster than Great Sethia, growing bigger and stronger every day.”
As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon shook its head, “Roar! Torsa, that guy Tim Abott is a monster, don’t compare yourself to him, or you’ll be very sad.”
Then the Silver Giant Dragon enthusiastically growled, “Roar! Great Sethia has come back this time, prepared to enter the Chaotic Turbulent Region, to become the Chaos Domain Overlord.”
“How about it, Torsa, are you interested in conquering the world with Great Sethia? If you’re willing, you could be crowned as the Crystal Dragon King.”
The blue-gold Giant Dragon was suddenly speechless, “What Crystal Dragon King?”
The Silver Giant Dragon growled as if it was only natural, “Roar! The Crystal Dragon King sounds quite nice, besides, Torsa, you’ve always been shiny since you were little. It suits your aura.”
“Get lost! Stop giving Great Torsa foolish titles, and by the way, did that beast named Tim Abott also return with you?”
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded, “Roar! Tim Abott has returned as well, though he’s with mother. Great Sethia brought many good things for Tim Abott to eat. Right now, it’s sleeping to digest it all.”
Is that so.
The blue-gold Giant Dragon thought for a moment, “Going to the Chaotic Turbulent Region isn’t a bad idea, but we’ll have to wait. Great Torsa has been guarding the Ice-Purifying Divine Fruit for a long time, and it’s almost ripe.”
“When the time comes, Great Torsa will have a second Top-Tier Talent and will merge with the Origin, no weaker than your Innate Space Rune.”
Immediately, envy appeared in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon, knowing what the purifying divine fruit was. Then it growled in inquiry, “Roar! How long will we have to wait?”
“Soon, just around daybreak.”
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon was thinking of how to trick Torsa into becoming its underling, the situation in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield was becoming increasingly tense.
On the fifth day of Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation, suddenly a Heavenly King Level Burst erupted in the sky, jolting him awake.
At the same time, the smart wristwatch on Jack’s wrist flashed red, and Gabriel’s solemn voice came through, “Jack Clark, the great battle has erupted ahead of schedule. Come quickly.”
Has it started? Jack let out a breath with a sense of complaint, and the Terrifying Aura emanating from him slowly retracted.
Whoosh! In an instant, Jack stepped out and disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 897: The 385th descent on the battlefield, a human with no future
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: The 385th descent on the battlefield, a human with no future
“Calling headquarters, the enemy’s numbers are overwhelming, and they are launching a fierce assault on our position, coordinates A-10894 require saturation firepower support.”
“Headquarters has received the message, support will arrive in 1 minute and 27 seconds.”
“Rocket Launcher Base 0-8911, immediately execute three simultaneous high-explosive rocket launches at coordinates A-10894 and quickly relocate the launch point after saturation bombing.”
“The Earth Giant army at coordinates B-9021 is too powerful, conventional firepower can’t cause damage, and close combat casualties among Special Forces Soldiers are too high, calling for strikes from the superpowered electromagnetic cannon.”
The base of the electromagnetic railgun, towering over five thousand meters, with a barrel hundreds of meters long, emitted a dazzling radiance, followed immediately by a flash of a blue plasma light beam.
Boom!
...
In an instant, concentric circles of atmospheric explosions occurred, and a light beam over ten meters thick pierced through heaven and earth, its radiance lighting up half of the night sky with a destructive aura before vanishing into the horizon.
Whoosh! Whoosh!!
Dozens of intercontinental missiles a hundred meters long, engraved with runes and carrying several nuclear warheads, erupted with intense flames and ascended into the sky behind the Heavenly Abyss City.
After integrating ‘technology’ with runes, these missiles were faster and the power of their explosive yield was even more terrifying.
In addition, the runes on the surface of the missiles, representing acceleration, reducing air resistance and isolating energy interference, flickered as they roared into the sky trailed by streaks of intense firelight.
Meanwhile, at the Military Base, large Energy Bombers equipped with various high-ranking weapons for air-to-air threats, each with energy shields and wing spans of a hundred meters, took off.
Around these Energy Bombers, Flying Giant Beasts with wingspans likewise in excess of a hundred meters and of Level 7 orbited, escorted by High-Ranking Powerhouses.
Not only were these large Energy Bombers formidable in their own right, but their internal subspace also carried a multitude of crystal energy explosives with yields comparable to nuclear bombs, specifically designed to target ground armies of the Vassal Races.
After twenty years of fighting, the Human Race and The Purgatory Family had long become familiar with each other’s tactics, hence the battle almost immediately entered into its most intense phase from the start at the frontline.
Boom! The colossal city gates, a thousand meters tall and inscribed with powerful runes forged by the Heavenly King Law, melded with the Supreme Enchantment, vibrated and slowly opened.
Saw Number One, clad in black-red armor and looking somewhat fierce, stepping out with heavy strides.
Compared to the several hundred-meter-wide city gates, Number One, at just over a hundred and sixty meters tall, seemed somewhat minuscule, yet as it moved, it exuded an indescribable sense of ‘magnitude’ that filled heaven and earth.
As Number One stepped out of the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield’s City Wall, its ‘speed’ shifted dramatically. With each step covering a kilometer, every heavy footfall shook the surrounding earth with a thunderous impact.
It was as if it weren’t just a Mecha over a hundred meters tall but an imposing mountain range.
“I didn’t expect this ‘Mecha’ to also possess Divine Power,” Jack Clark said, his eyes revealing a hint of surprise as he stood on Number One’s broad shoulders.
From beside him, Freya Louise’s voice came: “Number One is a Biological Mecha. Its core strength comes from the heart of a creature from the relic; the energy from the nuclear crystal energy reactor in its chest merely serves as a driver.”
Jack nodded, understanding Freya’s implication.
Just as the Human Race started to deploy their reserves, from the direction of The Purgatory Demon Race base, more than a dozen huge floating castles high in the sky also thunderously vibrated.
On these castles, with diameters of several kilometers, countless demon patterns shone, emitting black, purple, and red light, intertwined and shimmering, enveloping swirling Dark Demon Air as they flew toward the frontline.
Simultaneously, an icy voice, full of majesty, echoed through heaven and earth: “Exterminate the humans.”
“Charge!”
“Kill!”
“For the great Purgatory True Demons.”
From the vast lands hundreds of kilometers behind, massive armies composed of Vassal Races roared their war cries, intermixed with the bellows and hisses of Giant Beasts shaking heaven and earth.
As the armies of the Vassal Races set off, some of the Purgatory Nobles who had been impatiently waiting also transformed into beams of light shooting into the sky.
Atop a Dark Giant Beast, a thousand meters long and with nine dragon heads, Alex, with nine Demon Horns on his head like a crown, stood tall, exuding a Terrifying Aura that rivaled even a demon king.
Alex’s finely scaled face was cold as he looked into the distance with a hint of cruelty in his eyes, licking his lips: “This time, I’m going to crush a thousand skulls of Human Clan Geniuses.”
In the distance, a Purgatory Demon of the True Demon Race in the late period of the Nine Demonic Marks floated in the air, with double wings resembling those of a bat stretching over ten meters, akin to a Hell Demon. On hearing the words, he smiled slightly and spoke.
“With your strength, Alex, slaughtering those Human Clan Geniuses will certainly be as easy as butchering dogs. Let them regret opposing the True Demon Race.”
A Purgatory True Demon over ten meters tall, with giant fanged teeth and massive horns on its head, exposed a savage grin: “Mere humans, I will tear them apart one by one.”
“You are too cruel. I prefer using Hellfire to burn those humans to ashes and relish their desperate screams, hahaha…”
“Let’s go. I can hardly wait to see the despair on the faces of those humans.”
“Tonight, we’ll show those humans what it means to be peerless within the same rank.”
These Nobles from the empire’s rear radiated overwhelming oppressiveness, enveloped in rolling demon gas. The nine Demon Marks on them that represented their power oozed a horrifying aura.
These Demon Marks were similar to Talent Runes in their complexity, transforming into Demonic Circles that enveloped the Purgatory True Demons, emanating might far surpassing the Ninth Heavens.
…
The Heavenly Abyss City was tens of thousands of kilometers away from the Frontline Battlefield and separated by several forbidden areas. Even for Supersonic Fly, it would take some time.

chapters.title: Chapter 898: The 385th battlefield, human with no future_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: The 385th battlefield, human with no future_2
However, with the Number One moving at a seemingly slow but actually astonishing pace of one kilometer per step, they traversed thousands of kilometers in just over an hour.
As Jack Clark and the Number One traveled more than five thousand kilometers, they could see half a mountain peak had been leveled in the distance, forming an airport spanning dozens of square kilometers where unmanned combat aircraft continuously landed and took off.
Some of the energy warplanes were badly damaged and needed emergency repairs and ammunition resupply.
Boom boom boom!!
When the Number One had traversed seven thousand kilometers, a series of fiery rockets suddenly shot up from the mountainside far away, and within a minute, more than a thousand high-explosive rockets streaked across the sky.
For a moment, the piercing screeches resonated throughout heaven and earth, while the light reflected in the air left long rivers formed by their trails.
...
“Hurry, resupply the ammunition, the concealment enchantment needs to be redeployed.”
This scene even made Jack’s blood boil; this was the real deal, an actual large-scale battle—intense urgency and ferocity could be felt even before reaching the frontline.
At this moment, the wristwatch on Jack’s wrist suddenly flickered, emitting Vava’s mechanical voice.
“General Clark, a squad of Elite Demon Forces has penetrated 1,800 kilometers to the south-west, targeting the High Artillery Positions supporting the frontal battlefield.”
“This Elite Demon Squad is very strong, and currently, they are being contained by the 8th Legion Special Forces. Please hurry to support.”
“Roger that,” Jack nodded, then took a step and from his wristwatch, streaks of black-red radiance flew out, crackle crackle, transforming into fearsome black-red scaled armor that covered his entire body.
At the same time, a black-gold battle halberd over four meters long appeared in his hand, instantly dispersing a terrifying, heavy aura that caused the surrounding air to burst with pressure.
Boom! The air exploded, and Jack instantly turned into a streak of purple-gold light piercing through the sky.
As Jack’s figure disappeared into the distance, Freya Louise once again maneuvered the Number One to move, striding towards the front-line battlefield, her task being to attract enemy fire on the front lines.
Moreover, the Number One also needed to devour large quantities of Senior Purgatory Demon and their affiliated tribe’s corpses, flesh, and even souls to grow.
Boom boom boom!!
At the artillery position built into the side of the mountain, the frontline had already been destroyed, and thousands of soldiers wearing battle armor relied on defensive fortifications to fight against thousands of different races riding on Unique Beasts, five meters tall and over ten meters long.
“We can’t let these creatures breach and destroy the High Artillery.”
“Stop them, shift the guns, fire to the front…”
As these soldiers and the Elite different races fought at close range, with firepower interwoven and the sound of battle thundering, the mountain forest in the distance shook violently as another fierce battle erupted.
Eleven human experts wearing battle armor and at or above the Eight Layer cultivation joined forces to fight against eight Purgatory True Demons emanating the aura of Eight Path Demon Marks with two heads and four arms.
Surrounding these Human Experts were blood-colored chains linked together, forming the Blood Chain Lock Demon Array spanning thousands of meters, suppressing the Demon gas of the Purgatory True Demons.
Even so, this special forces squad of the 8th Legion was barely managing to hold their ground.
Although it was a reluctant admission, as a civilization over a hundred thousand years old, The Purgatory Family’s evolution of strength had already reached its pinnacle.
The slogan of peerless strength within the same rank of The Purgatory Family wasn’t self-proclaimed but earned through the annihilation of countless different race civilizations.
Facing these high-order True Demons, even these Human Experts who had cultivated to the Eight Layer and reforged their flesh and blood substantial struggled in one-on-one combat.
However, at this moment, under the Blood Chain Lock Demon Array created by the First Councilor specifically designed to counter The Purgatory Family, they could just about keep the balance.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the intense battle of nearly twenty Eighth Layer Experts, every blow’s aftershock would shatter the earth and collapse mountain peaks, the flames burning and encasing the land in ice, while gleaming radiance illuminated the night sky.
Boom! A sweep of over two hundred meters of black blade light cut through the hillside, forcing the Human Expert who hard-blocked the blade to flush red in the face.
“Ha! Back off!”
Boom! Suddenly, a long spear piercing through the Void transformed into hundreds of meters of golden Spear Radiance striking down on the black blade light, shattering it with a piercingly sharp blow.
“Humans, you’re too weak.”
In the middle of a cruel voice, space distorted and a concentrated black Light Beam with terrifying penetrating power flashed by, piercing straight through the chest of the middle-aged man holding the spear.
Boom!
The explosion of terror caused tiny cracks to form in the surrounding space, and Colin’s top-notch Transcendent battle armor emitted a crackle, nearing its breaking point.
“Get lost!”
Boom! A gigantic red palm swept across, smacking away the Purgatory True Demon shooting a beam from its forehead as if swatted by a giant spirit, interrupting the attack.
Boom boom boom!!
These Eighth Layer Experts exchanged dozens of blows in the blink of an eye, their destructive power astonishing as their figures flickered like lightning, coordinating and attempting to cut down their opponents.
In this kind of skirmish, no one dared to split away, for if someone or a True Demon was focused and killed in an instant, the balance would be immediately broken.
Just as both sides were engaged in frenzied combat, with the tide turning to where some began to sustain injuries, a terrifying aura came from above.
Boom! A golden War Halberd hundreds of meters long swept across the sky, twined with Thunder and golden flames, stirring up rings of white waves as it descended from above.
“Watch out.”
“Dodge.”
The unexpected attack took both sides by surprise, causing them involuntarily to repel their foes and back away.
Boom! As the War Halberd struck the ground, the entire world shook; within a kilometer radius, there was a collapse and explosion, while a blinding nuclear light slowly climbed in the Earth.
The terrifying big explosion whipped up a scorching Destructive Impact, where Thunder and flames intermixed, sweeping across a range of several kilometers, melting rocks and burning trees as it passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 899: The 385th descent on the battlefield, a human with no future_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: The 385th descent on the battlefield, a human with no future_3
Such a terrifying strike directly swept away all the Eighth Layer Experts, including Colin, and those Purgatory True Demons were also pushed back continuously under the ferocious impact.
Just then, suddenly, a late period Purgatory True Demon with Eight Path Demon Marks changed color: “No!”
Boom!
A ten-meter-long War Halberd, emitting dazzling light and resembling a +9999 purple-golden halberd, swept across at more than ten times the speed of sound, forming a pitch-black fan-shaped area that extended hundreds of meters in width.
Bang bang bang!! The Black Power on the Purgatory True Demons, strong enough to ignore the bombardment of intercontinental missiles, disintegrated, and their demon pattern battle armor shattered, followed by the instantaneous pulverization of their formidable Demon Bodies.
With just one strike, the Purgatory True Demons, capable of jointly killing early to mid Ninth Heavens cultivators, were instantly blown up, killed in one second.
...
Boom!
After slaying eight Purgatory True Demons with one strike, the power carried by the War Halberd didn’t diminish and swept across the Earth, leaving behind a chasm that was a kilometer long and tens of meters wide.
So strong!
Looking at the figure standing tall in the high sky a few kilometers away, holding the dazzling War Halberd, the faces of the Eighth Layer Experts who were swept away showed a look of shock.
Eighth Layer Experts, when facing those from the Ninth Heavens, unless it was the late period or the peak, could still take a few moves, especially these mighty Purgatory True Demons.
But unexpectedly, this Human Expert exuding the aura of the early Ninth Heavens, with just one sweeping strike, annihilated these True Demons in an instant, the combat power was too terrifying.
At this moment, Jack Clark looked toward the distant Artillery Position that was still in combat, and the Halberd Skill in his hand suddenly surged.
Boom!! Three 300-meter-long Golden Halberd Radiance streaked across the sky, traversing several kilometers and landing amidst those Vassal Races, immediately causing a flash of dazzling radiance.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial, the Earth shattered, the fierce Firelight turning into three fireballs hundreds of meters in diameter, surrounded by strips of flames, annihilating everything within a thousand-meter radius.
The terrifying high-temperature explosion caused rocks and dirt to melt into magma, Sky-touching Trees to snap and collapse, burning, forming three huge voids on the mountainside.
Within this area, thousands of Unique Beast cavalry were erased, even as they scattered to avoid the artillery bombardment.
In the roaring fire covering half of the mountain forest, the remaining aliens all showed faces of terror, and a few leaders shouted, “Lord Kaleb, they’re dead.”
“There are Human Experts, retreat.”
The remaining more than two thousand aliens scattered with a bang, directly turning around and fleeing into the mountain forest in all directions without looking back.
“Kill, we can’t let them get away.”
“Calling Team 03, Team 05, approximately a thousand Four Layer Heaven to Six Layer Heaven Back-Horn Tribe are scattering in your area, encircle them.”
“This is High Artillery Position No. 0897, we have many wounded here, request medical drone support…”
Accompanied by Jack Clark’s arrival and wiping out the Purgatory True Demons and scattering those alien Unique Beast cavalry within two moves, these soldiers and special forces squads immediately responded.
Groups of three Eighth Layer Experts attacked from several directions, pursuing the scattered alien cavalry, while the soldiers at the High Artillery Position tended to the wounded and repaired the position.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s wrist emitted a red light again, transmitting the voice of Vava.
“Jack Clark, 1,300 kilometers to your east, a special forces team has been wiped out…”
Boom! Jack Clark instantly burst through the air and, amidst a sonic boom, transformed into a purple-gold Radiance that shot into the sky, leaving behind a mountain fire that lit up the sky.
At this moment, tens of thousands of kilometers deep and more than twenty thousand kilometers across, the battlefront was torn asunder, with a sky filled with missiles, rocket artillery, cannonballs, and rune cannons bombarding each other.
In the middle of the battlefront, on a vast plain thousands of kilometers wide, five of the Human Race’s main battle legions faced off against more than a dozen alien vassal legions, with intersecting firepower.
On the ground, with Number One at the forefront and hundreds of thousands of unmanned Mecha in support, a sweeping wave of light beams instantly eradicated countless members of different races tens of kilometers away.
The terrifying explosions further whipped up scorching waves of air.
On both sides, troops armored in battle suits with Fifth Layer Heaven and Sixth Layer Heaven physiques and strengths piloted even more advanced Mechas as they frenziedly fought against the vastly larger aliens.
At the same time, elite squads of cultivators, mainly from the Sixth Layer Heaven with Seventh Layer Heaven leaders, wove through the battlefield, striking hard at the alien powerhouses and the massive war beasts.
Thousands of kilometers apart, to the left and right of the central battlefield, the Human Race also had three to four legions engaged in furious battle with more than ten alien corps.
Under their respective long-range firepower, they advanced and retreated in layers, pushed back, followed by saturation bombing from the rear, and after the bombardment, they pressed forward once more.
At the same time, around the three frontal battlefields, in the perilous mountainous regions, elite squads from both sides penetrated deep into enemy territory, searching for opportunities to destroy those firepower points.
High above the two-thousand-kilometer battlefield, tens of thousands of meters in the sky, mighty king-level figures stood tall, surrounded by the rules of Heaven and Earth.
A few hundred kilometers from these kingly figures, the sky churned with a vast expanse of demon gas that blotted out the sun.
Further above the battlefield, where fierce winds roared hundreds of kilometers in the air, three Human Sovereigns faced off against four Great Demon Kings.
Above the battlefield, even higher, the space was torn into innumerable fragments by an invisible force, creating a zone of destruction that even Heavenly Kings could scarcely tread.
In this realm, two fearsome beings stood firm.
One of them stood a hundred meters tall, with sharp horns prominent upon his head and enveloped in Black Gold battle armor, resembling a Hell Demon God seated on a majestic throne akin to mountain ranges.
To call it a throne was somewhat misleading; it was more like a beast’s skull, more than a thousand meters tall, forged from rock, bristling with mountain peak-like sharp horns, appearing ferocious and imposing.
Opposite this Demon God was a towering figure reaching ten thousand meters, with twelve pairs of wings behind it and a circle of white halos rotating behind its head, resembling the God of legend encased in an imposing Mecha.
Though called a Mecha, it was more accurate to say it was a person who had fused entirely with this transcendent ‘Mecha.’
Seated on a throne carved from the skull of an ancient creature, Diorus’s voice boomed through the Void, “Skylord, your Human Race is doomed to be annihilated. It would be better to join our Purgatory clan and assimilate into the great Purgatory Demon Gods.”
The godlike Mecha opposite slowly spoke, projecting the Sky-based God King’s age-old voice, “Your Purgatory clan assimilates all, erodes all, and will one day be devoured in turn.”
Diorus sneered coldly, “Devoured? Who would devour our clan? In this world, no civilization or race can stop the will of the Ancestors, including your Human Race.”
“You should be well aware that our clan has not yet used its full strength. The forces currently battling you are but a part of my empire; your Human Race has no hope.”
“Although your logistical war potential is currently significant, how long can you sustain it? Ten Sun Wheels, or a hundred Sun Wheels?”
“When your world is devoured by the Vast World, and the rules of Heaven and Earth shift, even your greatest logistical advantage will be exhausted.”
“At that time, without needing support from other empires, my empire alone will crush you with ease.”
The Sky-based God King spoke indifferently, “So what? When that time comes, we will take our remaining clansmen and travel far away. Do you think you can stop us from leaving?”
A sneer appeared in the Demon God’s eyes. Just as the Sky-based God King had said, a Demon God Level Powerhouse, when it wished to leave, could not be detained unless three Powerhouses of the same level banded together to encircle and kill it.
But to lose their ancestral lands would mean losing the hope of taking that crucial step forward. Would these Human Experts truly be willing to give that up?

chapters.title: Chapter 900: 386 Absolute Domination, The Expectation of True Martial Heavenly King
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Chapter 386 Absolute Domination, The Expectation of True Martial Heavenly King
The earth was undulating with mountain ranges, and hundreds to thousands of rugged mountain peaks stood towering, forming a peculiar landscape of peak forests that stretched for hundreds of kilometers.
At this moment, in the center of the peak forest, firelight illuminated high on a ‘small hill’ thousands of meters tall, as rocket after rocket, each over ten meters long and inscribed with Rune Trails on their surfaces, screeched piercingly.
Roar!
Watching the incoming rockets, a Giant Beast towering over 250 meters tall, like a beast clad in yellow rock armor, let out a ferocious roar.
Around it, yellow light burst forth, creating a substantial barrier over the ground that covered a 500-meter radius.
Boom boom boom boom!!
...
Huge firelights engulfed the Giant Beast, the light from the explosions of over a hundred high-explosive rockets almost lit up the sky, and the powerful shockwaves shook the Earth and whistled with raging wind.
Almost equivalent to the bombardment of hundreds of missiles, the domain surrounding the Demonized Beast kept trembling before suddenly collapsing.
Roar!
The ground trembled in the center of the explosion, the smoke and dust scattered explosively, and the Giant Beast, with some of its rock armor broken, stepped out with heavy footsteps, its presence terrifying.
Boom boom boom!! Mountain peaks collapsed under the impact of the Giant Beast, carrying rumbling vibrations as it charged towards a distant rocket firing position.
“Stop that Giant Beast.”
“Load the ammunition.”
“Set the energy shield to maximum power.”
“Hold on, support is on the way… ”
Amidst the shouting, another hundred rockets roared into the sky, screeching as they engulfed the rock Giant Beast, causing the surrounding rocky mountain peaks to continuously collapse.
“Stop.”
Boom! Three sword Qi strikes each over a hundred meters long swept across, merging into one as they tore through the beast’s domain in an instant, then were shattered by a swipe of the beast’s claw.
Roar!
With a brutal roar, the Giant Beast lifted a mountain peak over 700 meters high, instantly causing the complexions of the three late Eighth Layer cultivators in the distance to change.
Besides the Giant Beast charging at the missile base, a young man in his twenties with a Ninth Heaven early-stage aura was entangled in a fierce battle with a Purgatory True Demon, both sides erupting with a might that shook Heaven and Earth.
Meanwhile, tens of kilometers away in another direction, Damon Lopes manifested a 50-meter-tall Thunder Prison True Body, surrounded by purple-black thunder, unleashing a terrifying combat strength comparable to an Eighth Layer Peak.
Boom boom boom!!
Wielding Thunder, he summoned thunderbolts from the sky to bombard down, even suppressing two Purgatory True Demons with mid and late period Eight Path Demon Marks.
This was an elite squad led by an early-stage Nine Demonic Marks Purgatory True Demon, commanding a mid-stage Level 9 Giant Beast, tasked with pinpoint removal of fire support for the frontline battlefield.
Before Damon Lopes’ army squad found this invading team, they had already destroyed a rocket artillery position and annihilated an elite Eighth Layer Human Clan squad.
This is the Frontline Battlefield, where even experts from the Eighth Layer constantly fall.
At that moment, atop the head of the Level 9 Giant Beast, a hunched Purgatory True Demon, resembling an old crone, raised its bone staff, completely ignoring the three Eighth Layer experts around it and looked towards the distant rocket position with a cruel expression.
“Humans must die, kill.”
Roar!
Under the Purgatory True Demon’s fierce command, the mid-stage Level 9 Giant Beast beneath it let out a savage hiss, and its mouth gathered a dazzling yellow light.
Boom!
Instantly, a yellow Breath ten meters thick roared out, turning into a pillar of light that pierced Heaven and Earth and appeared above the position tens of kilometers away in the blink of an eye.
Boom! Yellow light exploded in the sky.
In those circles of yellow energy halos that lit up the night sky stood Jack Clark in his Black-red armor, his left hand slightly reaching out to shield the front.
In the midst of the furious destructive energy assault, several meters in front of Jack emerged four layers of crystal-like Boundary Walls, blocking the destructive breath capable of piercing mountains.
Merged with Divine Absolute Barrier, the Boundary Defense was unbreakable.
Roar roar roar!! The rock Giant Beast let out a ferocious roar, the yellow light on its body intensified, and the Breath’s power surged in an instant, becoming even larger, but it still could not shake the defense.
This scene caused a slight change in the face of the Purgatory True Demon on the beast’s head, but before it could react, a dazzling dark blue Radiance emerged, cleaving through Heaven and Earth.
Boom! A several hundred meters long, semicircular blue-black halberd skill erupted, tearing through the breath as if it was a laser beam appearing in front of the Giant Beast.
Rip! The yellow domain was torn apart.
Boom! True Thunder Instant Slash bisected the Giant Beast’s massive body right down the middle, and the Purgatory True Demon with Eight Demonic Marks on its head was instantly obliterated.
Behind the Giant Beast, the Earth was cut into a kilometer-long crack, the mountains fell apart, the Earth tremored, and rolling smoke and dust filled the air.
“So strong!” Watching the figure standing high in the sky, many of the soldiers at the rear rocket position revealed looks of shock and excitement.
They, the Human Race, were too strong.
Boom!
Just then, Jack Clark turned into a purple-golden bolt of lightning, taking a few breaths to appear above the heads of the two battling Ninth Heaven Experts weaving through the mountain ranges, clashing fiercely.
In an instant, the Purgatory True Demon entangled with the Human Clan Genius below was startled, feeling an indescribable sense of impending death rushing at him.
“Ten Directions Demon Territory.”
The Nine Demonic Marks Purgatory True Demon roared, its Nine Demonic Marks disintegrating into countless Demon Pattern Mark Chains, covering a thousand-meter radius and forming a deadly Demon Domain.
In the domain, hundreds of meters long spears, like Dark Demon Pillars, soared into the sky, covering the heavens and trapping Jack Clark within.
Boom! With a halberd radiating purple-golden light, the Heaven split apart as if it had been cleaved in two, and the dark long spears were instantly ground into dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 901: 386 Absolute Domination, the Expectation of True Martial Heavenly King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Chapter 386 Absolute Domination, the Expectation of True Martial Heavenly King_2
“`
“How is this possible!”
In the midst of the collapsing earth, the Purgatory True Demon who had originally intended to flee let out a roar of shock and fury. The dark long spear in its hand shone brightly, trying to block the strike with boundless Dark Demon Air.
Boom!
A kilometer-wide area of the Earth exploded, and countless pieces of dirt and stone formed a ring of debris hundreds of meters high, like a tsunami, being thrown in all directions.
In the crater with a diameter of several hundred meters and a depth of one hundred meters, the Purgatory True Demon, standing ten meters tall and clad in ferocious black-red armor that made it resemble a Hell Devil, was left with only half a broken head and a piece of the long spear.
...
“It’s him!”
Ben Reed looked at the youth holding a War Halberd in the distance, surrounded by blue-black Thunder and golden flames, and his face showed shock and astonishment.
Indeed, he was a monster who was recognized by the Heavenly King and claimed to possess king-level combat power in the early stages of the Ninth Heaven.
After killing the True Demon marked with Nine Demonic Marks with one strike, Jack Clark nodded slightly to the genius of the Ninth Heaven and vanished in a flash toward the last battlefield.
There, the mountain forest exploded, with thunder roaring and demon gas soaring to the sky.
Watching Jack Clark turn into a streak of purple-golden light appearing in the high sky, the two Purgatory True Demons who were engaged in combat with Damon Lopes and were struggling, their faces drastically changed.
Looking down at the intense battle below, Jack Clark spoke slowly, “Mr. Lopes, do you need my help?”
“No need, watch me take them down. I’m an Innate Awakened One.”
As he said this, Damon Lopes let out a long howl, enveloped in Thunder, then exploded with a bang, transforming into black-purple lightning that covered half of the mountain forest.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the terrifying black-purple lightning, trees shattered and rocks turned to dust, and the two members of the Purgatory Demon Race, surrounded by Thunderstorms and hugged by a hundred-meter-long black-purple Thunder Dragon, also showed drastic changes in their expressions.
Roar!
The fusion of two types of Innate Thunderbolt origins, the destructive power of the Thunder Dragon, which almost reached the peak of the Eighth Layer, roared and in just a moment pierced through the two Purgatory True Demons.
Roar Roar!! The Thunder Dragon, which burned the two Purgatory True Demons into ashes, circled and roared high in the sky, then reverted back to Damon Lopes.
Damon Lopes stood proudly in midair, with electric sparks jumping around him, a look of nonchalance on his face: “Just two Purgatory True Demons with Eight Demonic Marks, not even worth a strike.”
At this moment, Brock Raven flew over and reminded, “Mr. Lopes, he’s already gone.”
Gone.
Damon Lopes looked around and only then realized Jack Clark had already left, somewhat embarrassedly coughing, “This guy didn’t even say goodbye before leaving.”
Above ten thousand meters altitude, Jack Clark turned into a streak of purple-golden Radiance and flew rapidly, when Vava’s electronic voice came from his smart wristwatch.
“Jack Clark, just now to the Southeast, over a thousand nine hundred kilometers away from you, on the other side of the mountain ranges, the energy sensor detected an elite squad of the Dark Demon Tribe.”
“This squad is very stealthy, judging from their direction of movement, their target seems to be the Energy Warplane base located over six thousand kilometers ahead on the frontline, at coordinates D-6217.”
Boom! With a sonic boom, Jack Clark’s speed increased tenfold in an instant, almost in the blink of an eye he crossed over ten kilometers and disappeared into the night.
…
Under the night sky, a massive river several hundred meters wide surged between mountain ranges, its pitch-black waters emitting a foul stench, and within a kilometer along its banks, not a blade of grass grew—a desolate wasteland.
Originally, this river was a vibrant long river, nurturing countless Unique Beasts and fish. However, after the source was contaminated by the poison rule during the battle between two Heavenly King Level powerhouses, it had been transformed.
Now, beneath the poisonous and demon-gas filled riverbed, a shadow tens of meters long moved swiftly and silently, quickly crossing hundreds of kilometers.
The riverbed reached a fault here, creating a black waterfall with a drop of a thousand meters.
Bang bang bang!!
Next to the waterfall, the water exploded, and six figures emerged from the river, emitting the aura of the Eighth Layer and one at the mid-period of the Ninth Heaven, splashing down on the riverbank with black water.
Among the six ‘Persons’, only the leader was a Purgatory True Demon, standing ten meters tall, while the rest were covered in black scales, but their lower bodies resembled that of a fish, holding tridents.
Just then, a detached voice suddenly sounded: “You guys are too slow; you had me waiting for more than ten minutes.”
“Human!” Instantly, the face of the leading Purgatory True Demon and the Dark Fish Clan members revealed shock. Their auras burst out powerfully, shaking the Earth.
At that moment, a figure slowly emerged from the darkness below the distant mountain wall, wearing Black-red armor.
However, at this moment, Jack had no presence at all. Though visibly present, he was impossible to sense, which was very strange.
As the power of Hidden Deity began to fade, the aura of the initial stage of the Ninth Heaven emerged from Jack, prompting the Purgatory True Demon to reveal a ferocious expression.
“Is this just a human with an initial Nine Demonic Marks mark, seeking death… Do you not know that my Purgatory Family is invincible within our rank?”
“Oh, is that so? I’m afraid you won’t be able to handle even one strike of my halberd.”
Boom!
The War Halberd, wrapped in purple-golden Radiance, filled the sky, instantly shattering the ground within a kilometer radius. Under the terrifying force, the distant riverbed collapsed, with countless black waters spurting in all directions.
Within the violent shockwaves, Jack shot up into the sky.
While Jack followed the command system’s instructions, striking like a fierce bolt of lightning to annihilate invading squads of different races and elite squads of the Purgatory True Demon.
In another layer of space above the Heavenly Abyss City, True Martial Heavenly King sat cross-legged, his towering True Martial Divine Tablet standing behind him, radiating a terrifying pressure that suppressed space-time.
In front of True Martial Heavenly King, a huge map projection emerged, with the map’s center divided by a line into red and white sections.

chapters.title: Chapter 902: 386 Absolute Domination, the Expectation of True Martial Heavenly King_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Chapter 386 Absolute Domination, the Expectation of True Martial Heavenly King_3
At this moment, in the center of the straight line, a large number of red and black dots were entangled, with blue, white, and purple spots twinkling among the many mountains and rivers behind the red side.
Those entangled red and black dots were the currently fiercest battlefields, and the spots behind the red area represented high artillery, rocket launchers, missiles, and airport positions.
Besides that, on both sides of the dotted line, there were red and black dots moving, with the red dots representing some of the Human Race’s elite squads that had invaded, though there weren’t many of them.
Their main target was to locate the enemy’s long-range auxiliary armies, pinpoint coordinates, and guide Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb strikes for destructive bombardment.
Meanwhile, the black dots represented the elite of the Purgatory Family that had invaded human territory; the black dots that had infiltrated the red side were disappearing at an astonishing speed.
Hovering above the map, a projection of Vava, with silver hair and red pupils, and resembling a sixteen-year-old girl, appeared, her face showing a humanized expression of amazement.
...
“General Clark’s strength is too formidable. Despite not unleashing strength beyond the Ninth Heavens’ limit, these peer-level Nine Demonic Marks true demons are almost incapable of withstanding a single blow.”
The Ninth Heavens already stand at the pinnacle of transcendence, with reconstructed physical bodies and domain control. Under these circumstances, even an early Ninth Heaven expert could hold their own for a few moves against a late-stage Ninth Heaven expert, or even escape with injuries.
Especially those Nine Demonic Marks experts from the Purgatory True Demon Clan, possessing many Secret Skills for bursting forth, speeding up, concealing tracks, and so on, along with even stronger Lifeline Talents.
But in front of Jack Clark, who was in the early stages of the Ninth Heavens, it didn’t matter if you were at the early or mid stages, or even including a late-stage Purgatory True Demon— all were one-shot kills, absolutely overwhelming.
The True Martial Heavenly King slowly spoke, “I’ve looked carefully through this young man’s profile. His strength doesn’t come from the ability to fight across a Major Realm at a high order, but from a terrifying dominance within his own rank.”
“Since his breakthrough into the Fourth Layer Heaven, he underwent some kind of transformation. Under the Overbearing Divine Might of the Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, his strength became incredibly tyrannical and consistently at its peak.”
“In such a state, no matter how genius or monstrous another cultivator of the same realm is, none can withstand his single blow, an absolute invincible within the same rank.”
“He’s developed this dominance to a rule-like concept that retains even in the Ninth Heavens.” The True Martial Heavenly King added, his eyes showing expectation.
“Actually, what I’m most looking forward to is the day he breaks through to king-level. If he can maintain this dominance after becoming a king, then that will be the moment for the Human Race to launch a true counterattack.”
Under the watchful eyes of the True Martial Heavenly King, elite squads from the Purgatory Family that had caused headaches for the human race in past Civilization Wars kept disappearing.
As soon as these elite squads were discovered, they would be entangled by nearby army Special Warfare Teams and quickly annihilated by the arriving Jack Clark.
Thanks to Jack Clark’s presence, the casualties among these army Special Warfare Teams were minimal, and their orders were simply to hold and follow the enemy—no need to fight too hard this time.
As the great battle between the two sides intensified, high above a battlefront stretching over ten to twenty thousand kilometers, scores of king-level daemon kings stood surrounded by Law Power and roiling demon gas.
Both sides were unleashing their power to disrupt the nearby Heaven and Earth, preventing each other from sensing and scouting their situations.
Thus, the Human Race temporarily did not know the status of the squads they had sent over, and these Purgatory Demon Kings could not see the life or death of the squads that had infiltrated; both sides were quietly waiting for the moment the true great battle would erupt.
…
Over two thousand kilometers behind the Purgatory Family’s frontline, hundreds of volcanoes were erupting, with Scorching Magma flowing and merging, forming a boundless sea of fire below.
Under the volcano eruptions, rolling black smoke covered the sky, the world between heaven and earth filled with a dark red hue, as if it were Doomsday Hell.
At this time, in the magma ‘ocean,’ more than ten thousand giants stood tall, some tens or hundreds of meters high, their bodies as if cast from magma, with flames burning upon them.
In the midst of these Lava Giants was an altar over a thousand meters in diameter and thousands of meters tall, ablaze with fire, with countless streams of magma converging along the altar.
Amidst the endless confluence and compression of magma, a kilometer-wide magma fireball, radiating a golden red glow, emerged above the altar.
Roar, roar, roar!!
“For the great Purgatory True Demon.”
Atop the altar, a magma giant over a hundred meters tall, radiating the aura of the Ninth Heaven, bellowed and chanted eerie spells, and the magma giants below followed in the incantation.
Boom, boom, boom!! Volcanoes trembled, and countless red lights converged within the scorching magma fire sea, gradually causing the entire altar to emit a dazzling light.
“Exterminate the humans!”
Boom! Accompanying the roar, the altar emitted a dazzling red light, and a beam wrapped around the magma fireball soared into the sky, vanishing into the horizon.
Above the sea of clouds, the air thundered, and the magma fireball, resembling a mini star, crossed over two thousand kilometers, appearing above the frontline on the left with the momentum to destroy heaven and earth.
“Be careful, it’s the World-Destroying Magma.”
“Intercept it.”
“We can’t stop it, the World-Destroying Magma is surrounded by a Ninth Heaven Expert’s impenetrable barrier of thought, get out of the way quick…”
The kilometer-wide magma fireball, like a doomsday meteorite, fell from the sky at more than ten times the speed of sound, and the moment it hit the ground, a dazzling radiance rose from the earth.
Boom!
The heaven and earth shook, and endless scorching magma exploded and spewed out, mixed with the destructive shockwave covering a range of over ten kilometers, instantly destroying tens of thousands of unmanned mechs.
Many elite human soldiers piloting mechs were also blasted and destroyed, mountain peaks collapsed, and an area over ten kilometers became a sea of lava flames, burning and destroying everything.
But even so, this could not stop the ongoing gargantuan battle.
Meanwhile, in the volcano cluster at the rear, following the eruption of the altar, the lava giants bellowed furiously, drawing on the energy of the magma fire sea to continue amassing the World-Destroying Magma.
Twenty kilometers away at the edge of a volcano mouth spouting magma, several figures whose auras were concealed and who twisted the surrounding visual field to mimic the volcanic environment materialized.
Viewing the second World-Destroying Magma taking form, Joshua Welan and three others exchanged glances and nodded slightly.
The four spoke little, quickly deploying a small signal tower amidst the churning mouth of the volcano.
“Beep, beep, beep!! Signal link complete, network integration initiated, calculating coordinates…”
“Coordinates calculation complete, transmitting…”
“Attention, a Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb with a six million ton equivalent from the rear has been launched, estimated to reach the designated location in twenty-five minutes. Please continue to provide guidance coordinates…”
And a thousand kilometers away from Joshua Welan and the others, Alex was surrounded by an aura of killing intent, with the ground around him shattered, and several corpses strewn about.
Looking at the crushed heads of the broken corpses he had casually destroyed, Alex’s gaze was cold and cruel: “This is the Human Race’s genius? So weak.”

chapters.title: Chapter 903: 386 The Might of the Heavenly King, The Strike of the Demon God
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: Chapter 386 The Might of the Heavenly King, The Strike of the Demon God
Under the cover of night, a missile over two hundred kilometers high, measuring over a hundred meters long and more than ten meters in diameter, flew at a speed more than twenty times the speed of sound.
The gold-blue firelight erupting from the rear of the missile stretched for hundreds of meters, the powerful speed dissipating the wind, forming rings of transparent shockwaves in front of it.
Yet with such terrifying speed, the long-range missile, capable of striking over ten thousand kilometers away, did not make much noise.
Runes on the missile’s surface, designed to mute sound and reduce air resistance, flickered continuously, making it resemble a ghost streaking across the sky, tail aglow.
And as it traveled, this ghost subtly adjusted its trajectory, preemptively avoiding dangerous forbidden zones thousands of kilometers ahead.
In just over twenty minutes since its launch from Heavenly Abyss City, the hydrogen bomb drew near the Volcano Cluster. Suddenly, the missile adjusted the flames at its rear, nose-diving, and in the blink of an eye plunged through the thick dark clouds with terrifying speed.
...
As the clouds at an altitude of ten thousand meters dispersed, pierced by a hollow several hundred meters wide, the Lava Giant King on the altar reacted instantly.
In an instant, the Lava Giant King’s eyes underwent a dramatic change, revealing horror and desperation, for it had heard the Demon King Marshal describe such a destruction weapon of the Human Race.
It had thought itself safe hiding behind the frontline, gathering the Earth’s magma to launch its attacks, but now…
“Run!”
Boom! A roar erupted as the Lava Giant King’s body burst into dazzling flames, creating a scorching domain that enveloped its surroundings, sweeping up into the sky in a flurry of flames.
It intended to intercept the destruction weapon, to buy time for its tribe to escape.
Just as the Lava Giant King reached several thousand meters into the sky, punching the air and sending rings of fire toward the descending missile, the missile suddenly emitted a dazzling light.
Boom! A fireball ten kilometers in diameter appeared high in the sky.
At that moment, heaven and earth lost their color, all sound was lost, leaving only the fireball, reminiscent of a miniature star, shining brightly, releasing a wave of fusion heat and pressure that destroyed everything.
The domain around the Lava Giant King, first in line for the impact, disintegrated, and its solid form melted away at a visible rate, disintegrating and devoured by the fiery orb.
Roar, roar, roar!!
In the Magma Fire Sea, tens of thousands of Lava Giants, with strengths starting from the Sixth-level Heaven, mostly at Seventh Layer Heaven strength, roared in despair, their bodies collapsing and mixing with endless magma as they were thrown in all directions.
Volcanoes within tens of kilometers collapsed under the close-range pressure, and even those farther away shook vigorously as magma pillars erupted, driven by the nuclear explosion.
The dark cloud of volcanic ash that loomed over hundreds of kilometers in the sky dispersed instantly, the dazzling light visible within a 1,000-kilometer radius, illuminating half the sky.
The terrifying hydrogen bomb explosion formed a mushroom cloud sixty kilometers in diameter and over a hundred kilometers tall in the high altitude, while the explosive roar was earth-shattering, echoing endlessly.
At this moment, within a thousand-kilometer radius, many of the Purgatory Demon Race and Vassal Race Legions looked towards the direction of the nuclear explosion in shock.
Including Alex, who was more than eleven hundred kilometers away and clearly felt the tremors from the ground beneath his feet, his expression grave as he looked towards the distant horizon.
Thanks to the ‘flattened’ land and his terrifying vision, he too saw the giant fireball twinkling at the edge of the sky, the destructive energy fluctuation still palpable, even separated by a thousand kilometers, causing his heart to tremble.
Alex slowly spoke, “The Human Race’s destruction weapon!”
Boom! The earth within a hundred meters shattered, and Alex’s figure became a black streak of light that shot upwards into the sky.
In the air, Alex unfolded a pair of bat-like dark golden wings behind him, flapping slightly, immediately his speed skyrocketed, resembling a streak of black gold light traversing the sky.
And just as Alex flew toward the direction of the explosion, a Nine-heads Dark Giant Beast, kilometers long, also rose up from the ground tens of kilometers behind him, pursuing with a tornado-worthy blast of air.
This Mid-Mythical Stage Nine-heads Giant Beast was Alex’s bodyguard.
Being a true descendant of the Demon God, its status was exceedingly noble. It had come here to ‘experience,’ to get a feel for the atmosphere of a typical Civilization War.
“Whew! Worthy of being a hydrogen bomb fused with Crystal Energy, the power is too strong!” Standing at the mouth of a volcano, half-collapsed, spewing and flowing with Scorching Magma, Joshua Welan and his companions all showed expressions of shock.
Even entering the Mythical Era, the power of the human’s nuclear bombs remained shocking, particularly after being fused with Rune Technology and unique Crystal Energy, the hydrogen bombs’ power reached an extreme.
In the moment of detonation, they could unleash destructive force comparable to the late period of Myth, and their wide-range instant killing power far exceeded that of the Mythical Peak by more than a dozen times.
Most importantly, these hydrogen bombs were ‘very affordable’ and required only an elite squad for long-distance precision strikes within tens of thousands of kilometers.
Like this time, they had guided the hydrogen bomb to annihilate an opposing high-order Vassal Race Legion.
Additionally, these hydrogen bombs could be stored in Storage Space for close-range personal use as a last-ditch effort to perish together with the enemy.
The four of them glanced at the vast crater left by the explosion a few kilometers away, their expressions turned somber, “Let’s go, we can’t stay here.”
After battling for so long, The Purgatory Family too understood that the Human Race’s destruction weapons needed signal guidance, there must be an elite squad nearby the nuclear blast.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!! The four individuals, skilled in the Concealing Breath Secret Method, vanished in a flash, streaking towards the Human Race direction across the Frontline Battlefield, flying low to the ground at a hundred meters altitude.
This territory belonged to the Purgatory Demon Race, flying high was seeking death.

chapters.title: Chapter 904: 386 The Might of the Heavenly King, The Strike of the Demon God_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Chapter 386 The Might of the Heavenly King, The Strike of the Demon God_2
…
“Destruction Weapon.”
In the high altitude hundreds of kilometers above, the Great Demon King Kusakla slightly turned his head toward the distance, his gaze landing on a shimmering light thousands of kilometers away.
Roar!
An overbearing dragon roar echoed, shaking heaven and earth. In an instant, space shattered above Kusakla’s head as a dragon claw, radiating golden light and filled with terrifying power, crashed down fiercely.
“Overlord Dragon, you’re courting death.”
...
Boom!
Kusakla’s figure swelled, transforming into a thousand-meter-tall Eight-armed True Demon. With eight arms shaking the heavens, he grabbed a chunk of the Hellish World and hurled it at the golden Divine Dragon.
In a flash, a battle between Heavenly Kings erupted. Especially since both kings were famed for their formidable True Bodies, the entire heaven and earth trembled, roaring thunderously.
At the same time, over four thousand kilometers along this battle front, suddenly three more king-level epic battles broke out, instantly elevating the intensity of the entire battlefield by a notch.
Of course, the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King and the three kings didn’t make their moves randomly; they aimed to prevent these demon kings from sending orders and to encircle and wipe out the elite squads that infiltrated the Purgatory Family’s rear.
However, despite the intervention of kings and even a Heavenly King, orders were still conveyed. Soon, Purgatory True Demon experts within a two-thousand-kilometer radius of the nuclear explosion began to move.
Thus, having traveled just over 700 kilometers from the nuclear blast zone, Joshua Welan and the others encountered a squad composed of Purgatory True Demons and strong men from Vassal Races.
“Go all out, kill them.”
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Under the full-strength burst of Josh Welan, in the early Ninth Heavens, and Vic Vernon, along with two other strong men in the late Eighth Layer Heaven, two late Eight Path Demon Marks True Demons of Purgatory and a squad of seven ordinary Eighth Layer vassals were quickly annihilated.
“Move!”
The four who had just caught their breath didn’t dare to slack off; their figures flashed and turned into four streaks of light, entering a mountain range at the speed of several times the speed of sound.
But soon, they stopped abruptly, their expressions solemn as they looked ahead.
Atop a mountain peak several kilometers away, a three-meter-tall Purgatory Demon, somewhat shorter compared to other True Demons, quietly watched them.
The moment they saw this Purgatory True Demon, a chill rose from their spines.
Very strong, very dangerous.
Even Joshua’s pupils shrank as he said in a deep voice, “We can’t get dragged in, everyone split up and scatter!”
Boom! Boom! Boom!! With their internal power exploding, they burst the surrounding air, breaking out at full speed in four different directions.
Those who dared to operate behind enemy lines were not afraid of death; they were strong men who emerged from seas of corpses and blood, and their judgment of the situation was decisive and resolute.
“Nine-heads, stop those three over there, don’t let them escape.”
Roar! Roar! Roar!! With a roar containing the pressure of a Myth, the clouds scattered fiercely over a radius of more than ten kilometers.
In the clear moonlight, a colossal Black Colossus, a kilometer long with nine dragon heads but with a body resembling a lion and covered in black scales, appeared.
The Mythical-level pressure changed the complexions of the four once again, with the two strong men of the Eight Layer Heaven revealing bitter smiles.
With Mythical-level forces having reached the frontline standoff, the appearance of a Mythical Giant Beast in the rear was terribly unlucky for them.
Hum! Just as they separated and dashed out for about ten or so kilometers, light converged in the mouths of the nine dragon heads of the Giant Beast, and then black Light Beams swept across, shattering heaven and earth.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Under the sweeping black Light Beams, mountain peaks collapsed, earth shattered, and trees snapped. Everything was pulverized under the black beams, covering tens of kilometers.
The two late Eighth Layer and the Nine Layers human experts desperately fled in all directions under the siege of three beams, using the mountainous terrain to frantically dodge the bombardment.
While the Mythical Giant Beast casually spewed Breath, creating a siege that drove the three human experts towards the center of the mountain range, Alex turned his gaze towards Joshua.
By now, Joshua had turned into a black streak of light, darting out of the mountain range within the blink of an eye for more than twenty kilometers.
In Alex’s perception, this Human Clan Genius was very strong, with a formidable power hidden within him, strong enough to pose a slight danger even to him.
“Finally encountered a Human Clan Genius with a bit of strength. Only when crushing the heads of such humans does this king feel a bit of pleasure,” said Alex with a cold and cruel voice, as the mountain cliff beneath his feet crumbled, and the demon disappeared from the spot in an instant.
Black light swirled around Joshua, with fine black scales emerging on his cheeks and the back of his hands. He shot through the Earth like a black streak of light, his speed reaching eight times the speed of sound, no less than a Nine Layers expert releasing full power.
Travelling almost two to three kilometers in a second, Joshua crossed more than a hundred kilometers in a minute, then suddenly stopped, his expression grave as he looked ahead.
On a giant tree hundreds of meters tall ahead, Alex spread his wings behind him, his arms crossed over his chest. In his cold eyes was a faint mockery.
Trouble indeed. Joshua sighed inwardly before his eyes sharpened intensely.
Boom!
An Unrivaled Domineering Power burst from Joshua, and the air within hundreds of meters solidified, fracturing into transparent cracks, as if space itself could not bear his presence.
Boom!
Within the realm full of transparent cracks, a three-hundred-meter-long spear, covered with fine black scales, shot out, tearing space apart wherever it passed.
The spear moved like lightning, leaving behind a Destruction Tunnel over a thousand meters long and dozens of meters wide through the forest, before explosively bursting.
Roar!! As the long spear exploded, a soul-shaking roar erupted, the Void vibrated, transforming into the head of a black giant beast resembling but not resembling a dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 386 The Might of the Heavenly King, The Strike of the Demon God_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Chapter 386 The Might of the Heavenly King, The Strike of the Demon God_3
From the gaping maw of the giant shadow, a hundred-meter-long black spear, seeming to be condensed from endless strength, burst forth.
Especially the pure black edge gathered at the spear tip, even Alex felt a hint of danger.
“Myriad Demon Domain.”
In a cold roar, with Alex as the center, the whole world collapsed and twisted, forming a terrifying domain that covered a kilometer, surrounded by endless black currents.
Boom!
...
The black spear pierced through the domain, shattering the black currents and advancing toward Alex. The clash of the two forces made the world quake; trees toppled in large numbers, and smoke and dust billowed.
Watching the spear tear through the Myriad Demon Domain, Alex grabbed with his claw, pulling out a ten-meter-long fearsome spear with barbed tips from the void.
“Merely a human!”
Boom! With a sweep of Alex’s war spear, gathering the full force of the domain, the black spear that had penetrated halfway through the domain collapsed, and the giant projection vanished.
Joshua’s face changed dramatically; he was blasted back at more than ten times the speed of sound by the strike that shattered space and measured a kilometer in length.
Boom! Several kilometers away, a mountain peak collapsed, stones shot in all directions, and smoke and dust rolled.
As a genius who broke through to the Ninth Heavens by the age of twenty, Joshua’s talent was actually quite terrifying, with the power of his recent strike nearing that of the late period of the Ninth Heavens.
But this spear, in the face of Alex, who had reached the mid-term of Nine Demonic Marks with even more formidable combat strength, couldn’t withstand a single blow.
Boom! Just then, an even more powerful, even terrifying aura exploded in the distance.
Under the pressure of this fear, the smoke and dust dispersed, revealing Joshua.
But now his appearance had drastically changed, transformed into an eighty-meter-tall humanoid monster, covered in black scales with a pair of dragon horns on its head.
Previously, when the ancient relics on Blue Star had opened, Joshua had also entered a relic of the mythical world. Not only had he broken through to the Ninth Heavens inside, but he had also received an inheritance and some of the World Origin.
In his true form, Joshua’s aura suddenly surged by tens of times, approaching and even comparable to quasi-mythical figures. Such a powerful terrifying aura made Alex somewhat excited.
This was the power, this human genius indeed possessed a special inheritance of power, and it wanted to ‘eat’ him.
And while excited, Alex’s eyes revealed a strong killing intent.
This human possessed the talent of the Great Demon King, and given the growth rate of the Human Race, it might not take more than a few dozen solar periods for him to become stronger than it, a strong man comparable to the Great Demon King.
Therefore, he must kill him today.
As Joshua unleashed an aura comparable to that of a regular quasi-mythical figure, the Dark Giant Beast that had gravely injured a human Eighth Layer Expert with its breath paused momentarily, its numerous savage heads instinctively looking his way.
But it quickly lost interest, as a strength that was barely approaching that of quasi-mythical was absolutely no match for Prince Alex.
“You all quickly go.” Suddenly, a fierce shout roared from within the mountains, and the human Eighth Layer Expert opened a pair of blue wings from behind, holding a missile as wide as a rotund child ten-plus meters long, surging towards the high-altitude Dark Giant Beast.
This scene caused two Human Experts tens of kilometers away to focus their gaze, while the Dark Giant Beast paused slightly before letting out a roar of shock and anger.
Boom! The radiance of a nuclear explosion lit up the sky once more, transforming into a fireball with a diameter of several kilometers, mixed with a Destructive Shockwave sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
Roar roar roar!! Amidst the explosion of the Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs with a million-ton yield, the Dark Giant Beast’s screams and roars could be heard.
“Kill!” Sensing the nuclear explosion behind him and knowing what it represented, Joshua’s eyes turned red.
Boom!
The ground shattered, and the true form of Joshua appeared above Alex, his massive hands forming seals, carrying a force that inverted Heaven and Earth, crashing down with a roar.
Boom!
Under the Unrivaled Domineering Power, Alex’s Myriad Demon Domain collapsed, and the Earth for thousands of kilometers around exploded thunderously. Billions of tons of dirt and rubble were flung in all directions like a tsunami.
The powerful Destructive Impact swept across a range of more than ten kilometers, snapping and flinging trees as strong as iron and as high as tens to hundreds of meters. The momentum was terrifying.
In the center of the turbulent explosive airflow, under the overturning Divine Seal that annihilated everything, stood a figure thirty meters tall, with three heads and six arms, in the complete form of a Purgatory True Demon.
Endless black Demonic Flames erupted from its body, shaking Heaven and Earth, as though a terrifying demon king had walked out of the past.
At this moment, in his complete True Demon form, Alex’s imposing presence was comparable to that of an ordinary demon king. With just one arm, he easily blocked Joshua Welan’s Full-Force Strike.
Looking at Joshua, whose face showed a shocked expression, Alex’s three heads spoke simultaneously in a deep, sonorous voice, “You humans are too weak.”
Boom!
On Alex’s arm, a power comparable to the Law Power Burst, shattering the space, creating circles of black Destructive Shockwaves that directly blew Joshua away.
With a loud crash, Joshua fell a kilometer away, and instantly the Earth for hundreds of meters around crumbled.
The moment Joshua was blown away, Alex’s left central head’s brow split open, revealing a pitch-black eye, from which a beam of light burst forth.
Biu!
The 0.5-meter-thick, highly condensed dark golden light beam penetrated Heaven and Earth, slicing through the Vacuum Domain surrounding Joshua and piercing through his chest, then went on to punch a one-meter-wide hole in a mountain peak thousands of kilometers away.
With a spurt, grievously injured by the formidable Law Power, Joshua spat a mouthful of blood and then vanished from the spot in an instant.
As Joshua disappeared, at a distance, Alex brought his four arms together behind him. Instantaneously, an Invisible Power enveloped a space hundreds of meters wide.
Boom! The space within the area where Joshua stood violently Distorted and shattered.
So strong! Appearing miles away, Joshua’s face was ashen, and his eyes showed a grave expression.
In front of the complete True Demon form of Alex, he was no match. His opponent was too strong, just like Jack Clark—an existence beyond the usual caliber.
At the mid-period of the Ninth Heaven realm, he had actually crossed the quasi-mythical and stepped directly into the Mythical Domain.
Such a monster was unstoppable. It looked like today he would have to use that move. With that thought, a golden long sword suddenly appeared in Joshua’s hand.
The moment the golden long sword appeared, even Alex, who had just haughtily oppressed Joshua, and the Dark Giant Beast far away that had rushed out of the nuclear explosion’s range with some of its scales damaged, were startled.
Roar Roar Roar!!
The Nine-headed Evil Dragon let out an enraged roar but didn’t chase after the two Human Experts who had already escaped hundreds of kilometers away. Its vast body crashed through the air towards this side with a loud boom.
Meanwhile, Alex was rapidly retreating, turning into a streak of light and appearing ten kilometers away in the blink of an eye.
But it was too late.
Boom!
Joshua’s golden long sword in his hand shone with blinding Radiance, exploding continuously until it transformed into a golden long sword thousands of kilometers long, extending across Heaven and Earth.
Beneath the terrifying Heavenly King’s Sword, the Earth was torn apart, creating a crack tens of kilometers long. Alex, locked in by this strike, felt an intense sense of impending Death.
Facing a strike imbued with the perfect rule of the Heavenly King, even if it had entered the demon king’s domain, it couldn’t block it, couldn’t block it.
“Humans, I must kill you.”
Alex let out an unwilling roar. Suddenly, its blood penetrated through its body, and the flesh and blood on its left shoulder arm exploded. In an instant, a Terrifying Power surpassing the Heavenly King Bursted forth.
Boom!
