chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 388: Jack Clark Steps into the Frontline Battlefield, Blasting Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Chapter 388: Jack Clark Steps into the Frontline Battlefield, Blasting Everything
Boom!
The blood light burst forth, transforming behind Alex into an enormous, towering, three-faced six-armed illusion as imposing as the mountains.
In that moment, a terrorizing and majestic pressure that seemed to surpass Heaven and Earth enveloped everything, the invisible force even causing the surrounding Void to shatter.
The Demon God Illusion slightly raised its head, looking at the Golden Sword Light that split the Void and cleaved the Sky Curtain in two, and then its six arms behind it were raised, suddenly coming together as one.
Boom!
In an instant, including the Golden Sword Light that severed Heaven and Earth, the space within a radius of several tens of kilometers around it also violently collapsed, turning into a purely dark Area of Destruction.
...
Within this range, all matter and energy were annihilated; nothing remained intact, including the Law Power engraved by that one strike of the Heavenly King through the golden sword.
Compared to the spectacle of a Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb’s nuclear explosion, the Demon God Illusion’s attack might seem smaller in scale, yet the destructive force it possessed was even more terrifying.
Even after the space was destroyed, the remnants of Rule Power lingered and space could not heal itself, becoming a miniaturized forbidden area akin to a Black Hole.
The Demon God Illusion, having exhausted its power with that one strike that shattered the sword light, also slowly dissipated, revealing Alex, who stood high in the air above the tens of kilometers of cracks.
Looking at the Void Black Hole ahead with a diameter of several tens of kilometers, which was devouring everything with its powerful suction, Alex’s expression was extremely grim.
This was because the bloodline imprint capable of unleashing a Demon God’s strike was depleted by a Human Race genius, and that human was still not dead.
In the very moment that the human activated the golden long sword, they also used another forbidden weapon, vanishing without a trace under the force of space-time distortion.
Just like Jack Clark, Joshua Welan, as a genius destined to ascend to the throne, also possessed a life-saving forbidden weapon provided by the Federal Top Level.
The only difference was Jack’s were individually crafted by the three Supreme Experts, whereas Joshua’s were an offensive and a teleportation forbidden weapon given by two Heavenly King Level powerhouses.
Such life-saving forbidden weapons were difficult to craft and exceedingly rare, requiring the forger to slice off a whisp of perfect Law Power or even Rule Power; hence, each genius only had one chance.
However, relative to Joshua, who consumed two Heavenly King Level forbidden weapons, Alex was at an even greater loss because it had expended a Demon God Law Power.
Additionally, under the protection of Mythical Giant Beasts, it was a human genius who had exhausted the protective bloodline imprint that could withstand a strike from a Demon God.
This loss was so profound that even the denizens of Demon City felt the sting.
The Purgatory Family had numerous descendants with the Demon God bloodline. Therefore, even though Alex possessed monstrous talent, it was only given this one bloodline imprint as a means of protection.
Thinking of this, Alex roared viciously, “I must kill all these detestable humans.”
The Dark Giant Beast flew over in the sky, all nine dragon heads showing a grave expression, and growled softly, “Your Highness Alex, be careful. These humans are more troublesome than we imagined.”
As a being in the Mid-Mythical Stage, it was unimaginable that it got wounded by a level eight human, some of its scale armor damaged.
Although this was partly due to not going all out in the beginning, merely hovering in the sky and bombing at will with its Breath, it nonetheless highlighted the crazed fervor and combativeness of this race.
The humans were ferocious, decisive, and fought fearlessly unto death. Next time they must not be underestimated.
Alex looked towards the frontline direction, his expression icy cold, “Let’s go, Taros. We’re heading to the main battlefield. This time, I won’t settle for less than killing tens of thousands of humans to quell my fury.”
……
Right when Alex activated the Demon God imprint earlier, thousands of kilometers away within the depths of the spatial storm, the Sky-based God King and Devil God Emperor Diorus both shifted their gaze.
Seated on the skull of ancient beings, resembling a Hell Demon God himself, Emperor Diorus slowly spoke, “It’s Alex’s Demon God imprint. It seems it has encountered one of your Human Race geniuses.”
With a slight smirk that made him look somewhat vicious, Diorus spoke.
With both factions’ king-level demon kings at a standoff, no King-level strong man dared to venture behind the Purgatory Family’s lines, so it was naturally one of the human experts.
To force Alex, who possessed the strength of an ordinary demon king, to use the Demon God imprint, that human expert must be incredibly strong, perhaps even a monstrous genius who could reach demon king strength at the late period of the Nine Layers Demon Marks Realm.
As for the possibility of a human in the mid-period of the Nine Layers Demon Marks Realm having demon king strength—Diorus didn’t even consider it.
Because the human race simply did not possess such potential—it was only their noble True Demon Race that could transcend the quasi-mythical and reach Mythical-level during the Mid-term of the Ninth Heavens.
Nevertheless, even if that human genius exceeded all expectations, it wouldn’t matter; the imprint with the power of a Demon God’s strike could kill even a demon king, let alone just a human in the Demon Mark Realm.
The Divine King, of course, also understood this, but his gaze did not waver, surrounded by terrifying Rule Power that sealed the heavens and the earth.
The purpose of the two Demon Gods’ standoff was to prevent each other from interfering with the mid and lower tiers of the battlefield below.
Each conflict essentially served as mutual attrition for both sides, as well as a crucible for forging stronger individuals; every expert who survived the Civilization Battlefield emerged with great strength.
Both in will and cultivation.
On this battlefield where one must fight to live or die, after the battles ended many cultivators would experience a surge in their strength, and with sufficient resources, their rate of improvement would be astonishing.
Unlike the Purgatory Family that ‘slowly’ matured, the Human Race, which still possessed the original world feature and had yet to be assimilated and imprinted by the time of the mythical world, matured at an even faster rate.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 388: Jack Clark Steps into the Frontline Battlefield, Blasting Everything_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Chapter 388: Jack Clark Steps into the Frontline Battlefield, Blasting Everything_2
It only takes ten Sun Wheels, which for The Purgatory Family is the equivalent of ten days, to grow a batch of fresh blood.
With the continuous acquisition of resources from the mythical world, the number of middle and high-ranking cultivation experts in the Human Federation has been increasing over the years, and the speed of technological progress has been accelerating as well.
And as the base number increases, even the number of King-level strong men appearing is growing.
Therefore, the Sky-based God King doesn’t care about the short-term consumption; as long as these old fellows can hold on, the Human Race will rise at an astonishing speed.
Meanwhile, in a base of The Purgatory Family, more than 10,000 kilometers away in the rear, the Demon God Carthius within the subspace Demon Palace also opened his eyes.
Carthius’ gaze pierced through the subspace and looked towards the distant frontline. After sensing for a moment, he slightly closed his eyes again, quietly waiting for the opportunity to act.
...
To achieve the effect of a surprise force, even Carthius could not rashly approach the Frontline Battlefield, or he would be sensed by the Sky-based God King immediately.
At the Demon God level, with control over rules, they become a huge energy source, and their location causes the Heavenly Earth Law to collapse, forming an independent Heaven and Earth.
Hence, once they approach within a certain range, they will be discovered by same-level strong men, including the Mysterious Martial Sky King.
Boom boom!!
Behind the Frontline Battlefield of The Purgatory Family, suddenly the radiance of two Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs rose, illuminating the sky with their glow.
Immediately, the countenances of several Demon Kings standing nearby turned unsightly because this signified that two more of their armies had been wiped out.
And after fighting for so long, the firepower support from the human’s rear has not weakened much.
“Kill!”
At the instant of the Hydrogen Bomb burst, tens of kilometers in the high altitude, separated by thousands of kilometers, five king-level experts bravely made their move, instantly upgrading the intensity of the war.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the king-level battle, Thunder roared in the sky, and Law Power shook Heaven and Earth. The Heavenly Energy within a hundred kilometers was in turmoil, turning into violent wind waves that howled through Heaven and Earth.
Above the Heavenly Abyss City in subspace, a huge map projection appeared in the air, and the white-haired girl reported the current battle situation in silence.
“All forty-six of the known invading groups have been wiped out, killing over six hundred ‘people’ of different races above Seventh Layer Heaven, and more than forty at the Ninth Heavens level.”
“Most of them perished at General Clark’s hands. In nine hours, he traversed more than 40,000 kilometers, displaying astonishing endurance and a conventional speed.”
Even Vava, the spirit of the intelligence system, couldn’t help but pause slightly when mentioning this.
More than forty Ninth Heaven Experts of True Demons and several hundred high-order strong men, even if most of these high-ranking powerhouses come from Vassal Races, for The Purgatory Family, the losses were severe.
Especially those with Nine Demonic Marks, Purgatory True Demons, who were stronger than human Ninth Heaven experts in one-on-one situations. These king-level powerful entities belonged to the legion leaders among The Purgatory Family.
Vava continued with the report.
“However, of the twenty-one groups sent by our side to invade the enemy, five have lost contact, three have completed their missions, annihilating three of the enemy’s long-range strike armies.”
“Currently in the sky above the Frontline Battlefield, the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King and eleven king-level beings have engaged with one Great Demon King and fourteen Demon Kings, bringing the battle to a climax.”
“On the main battlefield, Number One has been contained by a late period Demon King since it appeared, preventing it from breaching the enemy’s position like last time.”
The True Martial Heavenly King spoke slowly, “Normal, a trump card is useful only when the opponent doesn’t know about it. Once discovered, they will be on guard.”
“Almost there, let the sky-based battleships advance into the battlefield, and at the same time, lock the super electromagnetic guns on free-target and launch continuous long-range strikes.”
“Notify Jack Clark that he can now directly engage in the Third Battlefield.”
Boom boom boom!!
Under the command of the True Martial Heavenly King, those six gargantuan battleships, each over ten kilometers long, above Heavenly Abyss City, suddenly moved, creating a shaking like mountains and seas, heading towards the frontline.
At the same time, in front of the battleships, the giant main cannons slowly opened up, and inside, ten huge Crystal Energy nuclear power reactors began to gather energy, charging up.
Hum hum hum!!
The muzzles of the dozen super electromagnetic guns, towering twice the height of the City Walls of the Heavenly Abyss City, glowed dazzlingly. Under Vava’s system collation of data, they locked onto targets tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, eight streams of Blue Radiance penetrated Heaven and Earth, forming eight slender streaks of light across the battlefield spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
But just as the two electromagnetic cannonball shells enveloped in plasma were about to hit the main battlefield, two unfamiliar auras of Demon Kings burst out in the high sky, intercepting them.
The moment the three Demon Kings appeared, the central main battlefield in the sky turned from a four-on-four mixed battle between four king-level beings and four Demon Kings, into a six-on-four clash.
Boom!
Number One, which was contained by a Demon King below, suddenly looked up. Its eyes emitted a beam of dark red Super God Energy, instantly blasting half of the True Body of an early Myth period Demon King engaged with a Human King.
After heavily injuring the Demon King with one strike, Number One once again engaged in a fierce battle with that late Myth period Demon King, the fight causing heaven-shaking, earth-shattering effects, with no alien daring to approach within tens of kilometers.
This scene filled a golden-haired young man on the edge of the rear battlefield with fiery eyes.
“If only I could get a piece of Number One’s flesh and blood to study the genetic structure of this ancient life form.”
At the Third Battlefield, more than five thousand kilometers away from the central battlefield, on both sides were danger zones that even Ninth Heaven Experts found difficult to cross—one side with raging winds, and the other with fractured Void.
Between the two danger zones was a desolate mountain range, hundreds of kilometers wide and extending over 1,000 kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 388: Jack Clark Steps into the Frontline Battlefield, Blasting Everything_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: Chapter 388: Jack Clark Steps into the Frontline Battlefield, Blasting Everything_3
At this moment, tens of kilometers above the Third Battlefield, two human kings faced off against two demon kings.
Below them, nearly thirty thousand soldiers divided into a dozen layers took up half the mountain ranges, fighting fiercely against one Purgatory True Demon’s main battle legion and nine vassal race legions.
The appearances of these vassal races under the Purgatory Family were quite peculiar and, from an overall perspective, their civilization was relatively primitive with a rather rudimentary system of strength.
However, these different races had been favored by the Purgatory Family for their respective advantages.
For example, those Unique Beasts with bull heads on human bodies, standing 6 meters tall with dark skin and crude armor, possessed immense strength, carrying shields made of fine iron and weighing several tons as they rampaged across the battlefield.
Another type covered in green scale armor, 4 meters tall and with long legs, were as quick as the wind, leaving a trail of afterimages as they ran and flew across the cliffs and cliffside with incredible speed.
...
In addition, there was a species over 20 meters tall, seemingly made of rock, with boundless strength capable of gathering the dirt into massive rocks and hurling them over a kilometer away.
When these rock cannonballs hit the ground, they exploded violently, demonstrating terrifying power.
Moreover, there was a race that could command Flying Exotic Beasts, and the number of these legions exceeded one hundred thousand each, now spread across half the mountain range, locked in an indistinguishable battle with the humans.
Although the humans were outnumbered, their firepower was much more fierce.
High-altitude Cannons, Rocket Launcher Vehicles, and Simple Rune Matrix Shields deployed from subspace formed temporary fire points, unleashing a frenzy of attacks. The roars of countless exploding bullets shook Heaven and Earth.
In the front line were 3-meter-tall unmanned robots with alloy-solid bodies, wielding large-caliber machine guns with powerful firepower, their backs mounted with ammunition boxes and Gatling Fire God Cannons.
These robots, numbering in the hundreds of thousands, were constructed from materials smelted in forges from minerals mined in the mythical world, with extremely high energy conduction and corrosion resistance properties.
They were also controlled by chips that could only be used for a month before corroding, with runes working in conjunction with circuits and hydraulics to control their movements, cheap yet durable.
However, due to the chaotic magnetic fields, these robots needed individual close-range signal base points for control and linkage; otherwise, the human race would have deployed millions of troops long ago.
Even so, relying on these fearless robots to hold the front lines, the humans had leveled the numerical advantage of the Purgatory Family.
The large-caliber bullets and cannonballs engraved with armor-piercing, high-explosive, and energy-immune runes also possessed great killing power against Extraordinary Creatures.
At this time, the Purgatory Demons of the Sixth Layer and above were constantly commanding and roaring, urging their vassal different races to launch fierce attacks while dealing with the elite experts of the human race.
This moment saw thousand-kilometer long mountain ranges erupting with explosions and war cries, the sky filled with missiles, rockets, and cannons blasting incessantly in saturation bombing.
Swift figures darted across cliffside, dense swarms of Flying Exotic Beasts, Unmanned Fighters, and fighters engaged in close combat in the sky, while Surface-to-air Missiles burst into explosions.
In this meat grinder of a battlefield, countless alien races died every moment, along with human cultivators.
Boom! A robot was smashed to pieces by a fist from a Stone Giant, but immediately after, this Fifth Layer Heaven Giant had its chest shattered by an armor-piercing high-explosive bullet.
In the distance, a Fifth Layer Heaven Human Cultivator was split in half by a Purgatory Demon, followed by a Sniper Cannon Bullet piercing the head of the Purgatory Demon, killing it instantly.
Apart from this, there were several high-ranking powerhouses dueling on the battlefield, moving at supersonic speeds, unleashing destructive shockwaves that obliterated everything around them with every move, displaying their imposing might.
Just then, a huge golden light sphere rose from tens of kilometers away, striking a ferociously armed mountain peak in the distance.
Boom!!
Under the terrifying assault, half of the mountain peak was blown apart, and dozens of human cultivators operating High-altitude Cannons and Rocket Launcher Vehicles, along with thousands of robots, were blown away.
“Kill them!”
“Get rid of that trash.”
“We need fire support here, coordinates 0-25, take out the Dark Pattern Alien Race with long-range attacks on the opposite side.”
Accompanied by the call for support, a short-range Supersonic Missile rose into the air and, traveling nearly ten times the speed of sound, hit the enemy’s rear.
Boom!
In an instant, a dazzling light burst forth, and a nuclear missile with a one-million-ton yield annihilated a mountain peak where thousands of Dark Pattern Aliens had assembled, destroying everything within kilometers.
From a high altitude vantage point overlooking the battlefield below, it seemed like a war between modern and primitive civilizations.
Only the powers possessed by both sides were somewhat great.
At that moment, a streak of purple-gold radiance appeared behind the human position, tearing through the Carney Turner and plunging into a group of Flying Exotic Beasts covering dozens of kilometers.
Boom! In an instant, endless bluish-black Thunder lit up the area, dense and pervasive, exploding every Level 4 and Level 5 Flying Exotic Beast it encountered into charred corpses falling from the sky.
Boom boom boom!!
Just then, ten golden halberd streaks hundreds of meters long swept across Heaven and Earth and, after traveling thousands of meters, exploded resoundingly into ten blazing Great Sun fireballs.
The ferocious heatwave instantly cleared the majority of flying Alien Beasts in the battlefield, with countless Unmanned Fighter engulfed in black smoke falling from the sky.
Such terrifying might instantly shocked the battlefield, and soldiers of different races and humans within tens of kilometers involuntarily faltered, looking up to the sky.
There, a figure clad in Black-red armor, wielding a War Halberd, stood in the high altitude, surrounded by fearsome bluish-black Thunder, with flames burning and covering a kilometer radius.
An aura far surpassing that of a typical Ninth Heaven figure pressed down, causing the air to explode within a kilometer distance around him, forming concentric rings of white waves, imposing and frightening.
This scene made the two Demon Kings standing dozens of kilometers above surge with murderous intent in their eyes.
The two Human Kings exchanged glances, and immediately afterward, they launched an attack. Boom boom!! The king-level battle erupted in an instant.
The Demon King entangled with the Human King roared and commanded the three under him bearing Nine Demonic Marks, “Kutaslo, join forces to kill that human.”
Meanwhile, at the rear of the alien forces, Alex appeared, followed by a Mythical-level Dark Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 389 Triple Halberd Blast, I Want to Eat Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 909: Chapter 389 Triple Halberd Blast, I Want to Eat Him
Because the front line was too long, Alex, who had just appeared behind the Third Battlefield, was still hundreds of kilometers away from the frontline.
Standing at the summit of a ten-thousand-meter mountain, Alex could vaguely see the artillery fire, explosions, and the rumbling shaking hundreds of kilometers away, and his eyes couldn’t help but reveal a strong intent to kill.
There were many humans there.
Behind Alex, nine huge dragon heads the size of small hills let out soft growls, emitting somewhat chaotic roars that shook the atmosphere with booming sound waves.
“Prince Alex, your Demon God Bloodline Mark has already been used, and for the sake of safety, I think it’s better not to go to the main battlefield,”
“There are quite a few strong men lurking outside the battlefield. I think we can hunt those geniuses, which would similarly cause damage to the humans.”
...
Alex spoke slowly, “Killing a few ordinary human geniuses alone won’t reverse this damage; I must join the battlefield otherwise when I return…”
At this point, Alex paused, then continued in a cold tone, “With my strength, do the Nine-heads think that same-tier humans can threaten me?”
The Dark Giant Beast roared lowly, “On the main battlefield, same-tier humans are definitely not a match for Your Highness, but we must guard against the assassins lurking in the dark, even the Human Kings.”
That’s why the Civilization Battlefield is called a meat grinder. Even geniuses with monstrous talents can fall.
On the vast battlefield spanning thousands of kilometers, no one can guarantee absolute safety for themselves, including the risk of kings falling.
Even some ordinary soldiers, who become stronger through combat and break the limits of life and death, become targets for assassins skilled in stealth.
There are even some assassins who have cultivated their art to the pinnacle of transcendence—who dare to attempt the assassination of demon kings.
Therefore, every time the Civilization Great War breaks out, it’s a feast for those assassins from both tribes, where they can earn enough merits.
And because of the chaos of the battlefield, they can quickly hide after a successful strike, and even king-level strong men, enraged, are helpless against them.
This was also the Dark Giant Beast’s concern.
Alex’s bloodline mark, which could unleash a Demon God strike, had been used, and it could be very dangerous if targeted by a king-level assassin skilled at stealth.
It only had the true strength of an ordinary demon king when bursting at full strength, but in essence, it was still in the mid period of the Nine Demonic Marks, a huge gap from a true demon king.
For example, the robust demon king’s body tempered through laws, the undying vitality before the origin of the rules is exhausted, a higher level of energy perception, and control, and so on.
However, regarding the Dark Giant Beast’s concerns, Alex simply responded indifferently, “If a Human King tries to assassinate, won’t I have you?”
“Moreover, I am no weakling but a descendant of a Great Demon King with the power of a demon king while still in the mid period of the Nine Demonic Marks.”
Boom! The mountain crumbled, and Alex turned into a streak of black radiance that shot into the sky.
As Alex flew towards the battlefield, ten thousand meters above, Jack Clark, who had just forcefully cleared out thousands of Flying Exotic Beasts, had also caught the attention of the Purgatory True Demon strong men on the battlefield.
Boom! Boom!!
Tens of kilometers behind the battlefield, suddenly two late period Nine Layers’ Demon Powers burst out, transforming into two black rays of light that streaked across the sky towards Jack Clark.
“Stop them.”
“Hold off those humans…”
Boom! Boom! Boom!! Within a range of hundreds of kilometers, suddenly bursts of Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Heavens’ auras exploded, with strong men from the Human Race army, as well as high-order Purgatory True Demons and different races intertwined.
Despite the entanglement, two Top-tier strong men with the Nine Demonic Marks from The Purgatory Family still crossed the sky, rushing towards Jack Clark standing in the Firmament.
At nearly ten times the speed of sound, the two Top Strong quickly approached Jack Clark.
Boom!
Infinite Dark Demon Air erupted from the two True Demons’ bodies, mingling and forming a cloud of demons that covered dozens of kilometers and shrouded Heaven and Earth.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The colliding Demon Cloud Domain clashed with the Thunderflame Domain that surrounded Jack Clark for a thousand meters, unleashing powerful energy halos that shook with thunderous roar and radiance illuminating Heaven and Earth.
Under the roiling dark clouds stood a Purgatory True Demon over a hundred meters tall, covered in thick black armor, its back bristling with sharp black bone spurs, emitting the demon power of the late period Nine Demonic Marks.
Staring at Jack Clark standing in the center of the Thunderflame Domain, the colossal Kavasto spoke slowly, his voice trembling Heaven and Earth with spiritual will.
“Human genius, remember, the one who kills you today is none other than The Purgatory True Demon Clan, the Thirty-seventh Vassal Legion Captain of the Mokaya Empire, Kavasto.”
On the other side under the Demon Cloud, another Purgatory True Body appeared, over fifty meters tall with three Dragon Tails trailing behind, a mid period Nine Demonic Marks True Demon spoke slowly, his voice cold and low.
“Human, you are too arrogant. Merely at the early stage of the Nine Heavens Realm, yet you dare to penetrate deep into the frontline. Today, with your head…”
Before the True Demon could finish, Jack Clark interjected coldly, “Too much talk.”
Boom!
Infinite Thunder and flames erupted from Jack Clark’s body, like an expanding ring of intertwined Thunderflame, spreading wildly, canceling out the demon gas.
From a distance, it looked as if a ring of light, several kilometers in diameter, had appeared in the midst of the cloud of demons that covered dozens of kilometers.
Under the collision of almost pure domain power, a series of energy halos erupted, and in the swiftly expanding hollow Thunderflame ring at its center, an infinite blood light burst forth, transforming into an illusion of a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood.
Atop the mountain made of countless skeletons within the surging sea of blood stood Jack Clark clad in battle armor and a war halberd, his hair and eyes all turned red, with a blood-colored halo slowly revolving behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 389: Triple Halberd Blast, I Want to Devour Him_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 910: Chapter 389: Triple Halberd Blast, I Want to Devour Him_2
At that moment, Jack Clark’s aura was terrifyingly intense as he summoned the Power of Hell and entered his Demon God Transformation Form, propelling his might to the pinnacle of the Ninth Heaven Peak.
Under the illumination of the blood light from the sea of blood, thunder, and flames that spread for kilometers, Jack Clark, standing high at ten thousand meters altitude, resembled a war god emerging from hell.
The exaggerated leap from the early stage to the peak of quasi-mythical Ninth Heaven left the two army-level True Demons momentarily dazed.
In the instant the two True Demons were caught off guard, Jack Clark vanished from his spot, appearing like teleportation above the head of the Three-tailed True Demon kilometers away, his halberd shining with light.
Boom!
...
Enveloped by the blood light of the Power of Hell, the halberd, measuring a kilometer long, descended with such force that it tore the earth asunder, ripping open a crack several kilometers long in the demon gas domain.
The terrifying strike compressed the surrounding space into solidity, forcing Carol to confront it head-on, with no chance to dodge or escape.
“The Purgatory True Demon Clan is invincible, kill!”
As a powerful warrior who had risen from a vassal race and obtained the Blood of Demon God to transform into a member of the Purgatory Demon Race, Carol did not despair in the face of a lethal strike but was instead ignited with a wild battle intent.
Boom!
Under a secret skill, Carol’s demonic power, physical body, and even soul ignited, surging his aura tenfold in an instant, with tremendous strength converging on the slender blade in his hand.
“Kill!”
In Carol’s roaring, a blade light nearly a kilometer long, emitting unmatched sharpness, shone through heaven and earth, cleaving upwards towards the blood-colored war halberd.
The slender and sharp blade light cut through all matter, energy, and even space itself, leaving a pitch-black line in its wake, slicing through heaven and earth.
Meanwhile, amidst the roiling demonic clouds above Jack Clark, a warhammer nearly a kilometer long with a head as large as a mountain peak fell down.
The mountain-sized warhammer, containing indescribable terrifying power, caused the air around it to explode, creating concentric circles of liquid-like transparent shockwaves that blasted in all directions.
In just an instant, the two Purgatory True Demons reacted, unleashing their full strength to form a pincer attack.
Boom! At the moment the kilometer-long blood-colored war halberd made contact with the sharp blade light, the unmatched blade light collapsed under the rule-like Power of Hell.
Then the massive blade of the halberd fell upon Carol, appearing from afar as if a kilometer-long halberd had descended from the sky, striking the earth.
Boom!
A dazzling blood-colored radiance burst from the ground, shattering the earth for kilometers around, flinging dirt and rocks in all directions under the sequential blood lights.
The powerful Destructive Impact, akin to a hurricane, swept over a range of several kilometers, raising billowing smoke and dust, and shredding countless unmanned mechs and soldiers of different races caught in the violent shockwaves.
This was the terror of top-tier strong men, where the aftermath of their battles wrought immense destruction.
Fortunately, the cultivators of the Human Race had the experience to make a prompt retreat, fleeing to the distance, as soon as they witnessed their top strong man in action.
And as Jack Clark struck down Carol with one blow, the Doomsday warhammer from above also thunderously descended upon him, bringing with it a force that caused space itself to compress and fracture.
Boom! At ten thousand meters altitude, a black-red halo exploded, sending pure shockwaves surging over several kilometers, dispersing the surrounding demonic aura domain.
There, beneath the several hundred meters large warhammer, Jack Clark was seen holding it off with a single arm raised.
In front of Jack Clark, four layers of crystal-like boundary walls manifested, vibrating with black halos as they withstood the impact of the warhammer’s terrifying power.
This scene resembled Jack Clark, with a single arm, holding off a world-ending meteorite capable of destroying a city, a striking image.
And just as Jack Clark was single-handedly fending off Kavasto’s Full-Force Strike amid the sea of blood, a shadow appeared silently behind him, merely ten or so meters away.
With no killing intent, no energy fluctuations, the shadow, as if a non-existent phantom, pounced towards Jack Clark at lightning speed.
A five-meter-long blackthorn pierced through the void in its hand, leaving a dark trace in the air as it soundlessly aimed for Jack Clark’s back heart.
But just then, Jack Clark abruptly turned around, his eyes beneath the faceplate cold and indifferent, as the halberd in his hand, surrounded by blood light, erupted with radiance.
Under the augmentation of the Doomsday Domain, the already immensely heavy Eight Desolate Battle Halberd struck like a compressed mountain range, sweeping across at speeds over ten times the speed of sound at close range.
Boom!
A semi-circular, black area spanned hundreds of meters in high altitude appeared, and in one strike, the mid-stage Nine Demonic Marks assassin was instantly blown apart.
The moment the Assassination True Demon was obliterated, a blood-colored battle spear, a kilometer long, shot into the sky, shattering the warhammer’s shadow, and with unrivaled strength, it slashed towards Kavasto.
Standing a hundred meters tall and bursting with power nearly reaching the quasi-mythical level, Kavasto let out a roar of shock and rage, surrounded by black demonic qi, with his warhammer emanating a terrifying radiance.
As the entire domain’s power converged and augmented the heavy warhammer, it twisted the surrounding space like a black hole, meeting the war halberd with a force capable of blasting everything to smithereens.
Boom!! The moment the blood-enveloped halberd intersected with the heavy hammer, the entire heaven and earth seemed to shake, followed by a massive explosion of the halberd’s skill.
In an instant, the heaven and earth were illuminated by a dazzling blood light, and Jack Clark, surrounded by a shimmering halo, appeared overhead Kavasto, holding the black-gold battle halberd.
Because of Jack’s incredible speed, surpassing the threshold of perceptual awareness, Kavasto could only instinctively burst out with power, bringing his hammer across to block his head just in time.
Boom! Compared to the colossal warhammer over two hundred meters long, with a head like a building, the black-gold battle halberd in Jack’s hands was like a toothpick gleaming with dazzling blood light.
But the moment the halberd fell, an indescribable force burst out. In the wide-eyed horror of Kavasto, the handle of his hammer shattered, and his protective domain power collapsed.
Boom!
Amidst the still-lingering explosion of blood light high in the sky, a tremendous figure fell from the heavens and struck the ruined earth with ferocity, instantly shattering the ground within a kilometer radius as dirt and rubble soared into the sky.
Amidst the tempest of smoke, dust, and turbulent air waves, Jack Clark, dressed in black-red armor, stood atop the headless corpse holding his halberd, his blood-red hair flowing freely behind him without any wind, exuding a terrifying authority.
From the moment the two Nine Demonic Marks strongmen unleashed their Demon Domain to seal the heavens and earth, to the moment one lurked to assassinate Jack, merely a few minutes had elapsed.
And most of that time was spent conversing at the beginning of the standoff as Kavasto and his two demons tried to distract Jack, with the actual battle erupting for less than a minute.
In a flash of lightning, life and death were decided between them, with three Nine Demonic Marks beings of higher realm slain in an instant by Jack, crumbling effortlessly, unable to withstand a single strike.
And from the beginning to the present, Jack had only unleashed his True Martial cultivation, conserving the even more formidable and terrifying power of his Innate God Demon physique.
Even so, the surrounding battlefield fell silent. The two Demon Kings entangled with the Human King in the sky also showed grave expressions, their eyes swirling with terrifying intent to kill.
With just the initial realm of Nine Demonic Marks, he already possessed strength comparable to quasi-mythical levels. Once he breaks through to the mid or late stage, his combat power will be even more exaggerated!
This human must die, he must indeed die, his dominion at the same stage is too frightening.
Boom boom boom!!
Above the high altitude of a hundred kilometers, the battle between the two kings and Demon Kings intensified, the pressure from their colliding rules suffocating countless people and beings of different races.
While the battle of the kings in the sky intensified, Jack Clark, standing on the corpse of Kavasto, looked towards the distance with a cold gaze.
On a small hill ten kilometers away, a three-meter-tall Purgatory True Demon clad in dark gold armor, with nine demon horns like a crown, was watching him.
From that mid-stage Nine Demonic Marks Purgatory True Demon, Jack felt a faint sense of oppression.
With his current strength, for that Purgatory True Demon to give him even a ‘slight’ sense of pressure, it was clear that the being was very strong, possibly even a descendant of a Demon God.
Thinking this, Jack’s eyes inevitably showed a touch of excitement and battle intent, curious to see how many strikes his opponent could withstand.
Similarly, Alex, who had witnessed Jack annihilate the three Nine Demonic Marks True Demons in the blink of an eye, also revealed an excited look in his eyes.
That human who was also at the initial realm of Nine Demonic Marks and possessed quasi-mythical strength seemed to give him a feeling even stronger than that of the human who had inherited the ruins.
It’s highly probable that the opponent also has a special inheritance.
If he could kill him, devour his inheritance, absorb the race luck he carries, his bloodline might become further purified, closer to his ancient Ancestor.
With that thought, Alex couldn’t help but let out a long howl, transforming into a streak of light and rushing towards Jack.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 390 True Demon God Body, Number One Goes Berserk
chapters.content:
Chapter 911: Chapter 390 True Demon God Body, Number One Goes Berserk
Just as Jack Clark instantly killed three mid-period Ninth Heavens Purgatory Demon Race strong men, the light from three Hydrogen Bombs burst forth in the distance, rising slowly behind the lines of The Purgatory Family.
At the same time, six sky-based battleships also moved to the middle of the battlefield, their main cannon’s muzzles emitting a dazzling light after a long build-up of power.
Boom! Six hundred-meter-thick Light Beams pierced through Heaven and Earth, emanating a dazzling Radiance, crossing thousands of kilometers at a terrifying speed, and appeared above the frontal middle battlefield.
Seeing those red light columns descending diagonally from the sky, eradicating countless Ruin Beasts along the way, myriad different races charging into battle showed looks of horror on their faces.
“Human Race!”
An angry roar from a demon king suddenly echoed through the Void, wondering why, at the outset of this war, the Human Race had gone mad and thrown all its strength into battle.
...
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Five unfamiliar demon king auras burst forth, rolling demon gas like a blanket covered the Firmament, and five immense Demon King True Forms emerged, surrounded by the rules of their realms as they moved to intercept the main cannons of the sky-based battleships.
Boom! An intense clash of energies erupted in the sky, the resulting dazzling Radiance lighting up the land cloaked by demon gas.
And the one remaining main cannon, uninterrupted by any ‘Person,’ penetrated Heaven and Earth, falling upon a fortress of The Purgatory Family’s frontline that stood over three thousand meters tall.
Boom! The fortress, acting as a long-range offensive, shook under the impact against its several-meter-thick energy shield, bursting into brilliant energy Radiance, and then it collapsed thunderously.
In an instant, dazzling light rose from the Earth, and a range of several kilometers was obliterated by this single cannon shot, slaying tens of thousands of different races’ creatures and one fortress.
“Attack, surround and kill the Human King.”
As their hidden forces were exposed, four of the five extra Demon Kings charged into the sky battle, forming a twelve-on-eight situation that put immense pressure on the Human Kings.
The remaining mid-Mythical-Stage demon king swooped down toward Number One, intending to double-team and suppress—even destroy—this human-made Biological Mecha.
At the same time, as the Human Race’s sky-based battleships advanced into the battlefield, the Demon King Castles of The Purgatory Family, located on the edge of the battlefield, also began to shake vehemently.
Roar!
Entangled with that late-Mythical-Stage Demon King, Number One suddenly let out a ferocious roar, its armor exploding off to reveal the purple-gold skin underneath.
“Soul Sync Rate 93%, 94%…”
“Exoskeletal control armor disengages 20%, Core Energy starts to be released, Super God Energy reaching 1,000%, 3,000%…”
“Warning! Please suppress the Soul Sync Rate, once it reaches 100% there will be an occurrence of Psychic Contamination, warning, please resist the Soul Fluctuation of Number One…”
Inside the Void of Number One, the large screen before Freya Louise was flashing with the piercing red light of alarms.
Yet at this moment, Freya Louise, adorned in God Machine Armament, had a calm, perhaps indifferent, gaze with not a flicker of emotional ripple, quietly watching ahead.
This moment, she seemed to stand beyond Heaven and Earth, infinitely distant.
Roar!
As Freya Louise unlocked a portion of Number One’s power constraints, a terrifying burst of blood light shot out from the black-red colored mech, covering tens of kilometers.
Under the cloak of the blood-colored light, every Purgatory Demon Race creature stiffened, then died, their auras of red light flying out to be devoured by Number One.
With every feed, the Aura around Number One became even more fearsome.
“Stop that monster, it’s feeding,” roared the two Demon Kings who had revealed their True Forms, towering hundreds of meters tall surrounded by Dark Demon Air, forming into kilometer-long Hell Demon Dragons.
Hum!
A barrier of invisible but substantial golden shield sparkled a hundred meters from Number One, emitting rings of diamond-shaped halos blocking all attacks from the two Demon Kings, utterly indestructible.
At that moment, Number One’s eyes emitted a blue and white light beam that caused a throbbing sensation in all living beings it gazed upon, including the two Demon Kings.
“Be careful.”
Boom!
Two blue and white light beams shot out from Number One’s eyes, their terrifying power blasting away the mid-Mythical-Stage Demon King while the late-Mythical-Stage one barely managed to withstand it.
The repelled Demon Kings watched as Number One’s form vibrated, each step shaking the Earth as it strode toward the rear of The Purgatory Family’s frontline, seeking to feed.
“Humans, this Mecha creature of yours should not exist.”
As the emotionless voice sounded, a surge of the Great Demon King’s oppressive force erupted from the sky, a massive hand descending with such powerful force that Heavenly Energy went wild, the atmosphere swirling.
“Your opponent is me.”
A deep voice full of terrifying Battle Intent rose from the human battlefield in the sky, as a majestic figure appeared at high altitude, unmistakably, it was War King Elmore Hall who once encountered Jack Clark.
At this moment, although Elmore Hall’s realm was only at Mythical Peak, his presence rivalled that of the demon king, his fearsome Battle Intent, augmented by the power of relics, even caused the world around to tremble.
Boom!
Elmore Hall’s fist struck out, instantly shattering the Void; under his terrible punch, the entire sky crumbled and exploded into fragments, forming a shattered world.
Under that extreme destructive force that almost annihilated a part of the ‘world,’ the hand descending from the sky disintegrated, revealing the terrifying figure above carrying a black sun.
“Human Race, Elmore Hall, I know of you.”
King meets king, and the two Heavenly King Level powerhouses rose into the sky, clashing at a high altitude thousands of kilometers up within moments.
“I say, let there be light.”
Amidst a soft voice, the night sky behind the Human Race lit up with endless light, against the backdrop of six ten-kilometer-long sky-based battleships, the figure with six pairs of light wings appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 390: True Demon God Body, Number One Rampage_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 912: Chapter 390: True Demon God Body, Number One Rampage_2
“Gabriel!”
Boom! An even stronger Great Demon King made his move from the opposite side.
Meanwhile, thousands of kilometers away from the central battlefield, in the secondary battlefield above, endless purple Divine Thunders roared, transforming the sky into a Thunder Pool, shaking the world even with just the aftermath of the Heavenly King Level battle.
At this moment, along the frontline stretching over twenty thousand kilometers, Human Kings and Demon Kings from The Purgatory Family clashed, rending heaven and earth apart, with the confrontation at the Heavenly King level even more terrifying.
Besides the two Demon Kings entangled with Number One, the numerically inferior Human Race had seven kings fighting two against one, and soon, weaker Human Kings started to sustain injuries.
And the six sky-based battleships exchanged fire with those Demon King castles in high altitude, with main cannons, secondary cannons, and various missiles exploding, and the energy shields of the Demon Pattern Arrays flickering.
...
Above them, in the Firmament, and even deeper into the destructive space, Diorus frowned slightly.
Sitting high on the skull of an ancient being, Diorus, with his Demon Power overwhelming, cast a cold gaze towards the opposite side and slowly said, “Sky-based, do you humans intend to decide the battle with my empire?”
“The decisive battle is not yet upon us.”
The Sky-based God King slowly spoke with an aged voice, “We have been in a standoff for so long that I have grown somewhat bored, so I decided to try a more aggressive approach.”
“However, I did not expect you, Diorus, to also summon so many Demon Kings to reinforce the frontline. Seems like you’re feeling just as bored as I am.”
“Bored.” Diorus’s gaze was icy cold. He certainly didn’t believe what the Sky-based God King said.
These cunning and deceitful human must have some conspiracy, just like he had another purpose. With this thought, Diorus’s gaze landed on the Biological Mecha below, unleashing its Divine Might.
Go, kill at will. Those vassal races and cannon fodder are yours for the taking.
Although the battle below was already shaking heaven and earth, none of the Supreme and Demon God Level Powers had made a move, choosing instead to continue the standoff.
Or rather, they had actually been competing all along. When two Supreme Level powers confronted each other, invisible Rule Forces spread across the battlefield, forming invisible domains.
All forces above the level of basic rules, and all King-level strong men with the realm of king, were forcibly pulled up into the high altitude by this layer of rules, not allowed to interfere in the Transcendent battle.
As for Number One, it was the point of conflict between two sets of rule forces.
Diorus wanted to send more Demon King Level Powers to besiege Number One while the Sky-based Divine King was forcefully suppressing the opposition, not allowing more Demon Kings to participate in the battle.
At this moment, with the strengths of both sides evenly matched and the rules interwoven, only the appearance of additional forces could break this balance and disrupt the rules of the battlefield.
To this, Diorus merely watched his opponent with an icy gaze, his expression unfazed.
With the Purgatory Family’s Demon Kings outnumbering and overpowering the humans, it would only be a matter of time before the Human Kings couldn’t hold on any longer.
Once a Human King began to fall, the advantage of the demon kings from his empire would grow even larger.
As for the lower layer of the Transcendent battlefield, there was no need to pay attention, as Alex, although only at the mid period of the Nine Demonic Marks, possessed the battle power of a Demon King level.
With this thought, Diorus’s gaze grew even colder.
While all eyes were on the central battlefield, watching Number One exuding a terrifying aura and battling against two Demon Kings, advancing toward the enemy’s position—
On the third battlefield, Jack Clark heard the low voice of Gentry Gail in his ear: “Jack Clark, the great battle in the central battlefield has erupted. You can let loose now.”
“Can I finally go on a killing spree?” Standing with his halberd atop Kavasto’s corpse, Jack Clark’s blood-red eyes were filled with endless desire for slaughter and destruction.
But just then, Alex, who was flying towards him, suddenly erupted with a pressure comparable to a Demon King Level Strong.
Boom!
Within the churning demon gas, a figure appeared, one hundred meters tall with three heads and six arms, covered in dark golden scale armor, and with a pair of bat wings spreading over seventy meters wide behind him.
The terrifying Demon Power shook the sky, compressing the air and forming rings of white waves around the encompassing Myriad Demon Domain that spanned kilometers, its imposing aura astounding.
“It’s a Demon God Descendant, a True Demon Prince with the bloodline of a Demon God has descended,” the watchers mused.
“Roar, roar! So powerful, he truly is a descendant of a Demon God.”
“That human is definitely dead.”
At this moment, as they watched Alex in the sky, his Demon Power overwhelming like a true demon king’s arrival, the high-order beings from different races ten kilometers away showed excited expressions.
As expected of the powerful race they pledged allegiance to, with countless strong men, even a single one’s presence was so terrifying.
Facing a man more talented than Joshua Welan, Alex, who had already had one experience, directly entered his strongest form, preparing to strike down his opponent with the momentum of thunder.
“Human, your strength qualifies you to know my name. Remember, I am Alex from the Teritan Empire, a Demon God Descendant.”
Boom!
With wings of dark gold spanning a hundred meters, Alex crossed the Void in a single step to appear above Jack Clark, his domain concealing the night sky for kilometers around.
In the demon gas-ridden domain, a World-destroying Long Spear eight hundred meters in length descended from the sky, with space distorting at the tip of the spear, forming a twisted vortex that engulfed a kilometer around it.
Before it even struck down, the Earth around Jack Clark for kilometers cracked invisibly, shattered, as if it were a rag being wrung out, a sight both terrifying and shocking.
To twist the space of a kilometer around with a single strike, with the spear at the center piercing through all, this was Alex’s ultimate combat technique infused with his bloodline inheritance, shattering the Void.

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 390 True Demon God Body, Number One Rampage_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 913: Chapter 390 True Demon God Body, Number One Rampage_3
But just then, a terrifying power that caused all living beings to feel fear, even making Heaven and Earth shake, erupted from below.
Boom!
A War Halberd, merely two hundred meters long, wrapped in blood light and emitting dazzling blue and golden radiance, swept across the Void, shattering space wherever it passed.
Under the dazzling light of the War Halberd, the black war spear instantly crumbled, followed by Alex’s Myriad Demon Domain, collapsing like an eggshell with a thunderous shatter.
“How is this possible!”
Boom! The legendary-level armor on Alex burst apart, his flesh and blood exploded, and his enormous body, like a swatted fly, was blasted out and violently smashed into a mountain peak over ten kilometers away.
...
Boom! The mountain collapsed, the Earth shook, and debris flew everywhere.
In that instant, the battlefield fell silent.
In the distance, the high-ranking powerhouses of the vassal alien races, the nine-headed Dark Giant Beast hovering in the sky, and even the fighting Demon Kings in the heavens instinctively pulled away from their opponents, temporarily halting.
No, you are a descendant of the Demon Gods, a monster with the talent of mid-stage Nine Demonic Marks equal to a Demon King, and with a sliver of hope to ascend to the legendary status of a Purgatory True Demon.
Just like that, you were blasted away?
All the different races, Demon Kings, and Giant Beasts turned their gaze toward the distance, thinking of this.
There, a figure stood holding a halberd, eighty meters tall with three faces and six arms, with four Divine Wheels of yellow, gold, black, and blue colors slowly rotating behind him.
The left side of his face was covered with red scales, his eyes swirling with red light, radiating a Terrifying Kill Aura, and the right side of his face was covered with black and red scales, with his upper pair of eyes tightly closed, underneath which a Terrifying Power faintly converged.
The face in front was as fair as jade, with a black, eye-like mark on its forehead, emitting an awe-inspiring authority, as if he was a Demon God from ancient times.
In contrast to Alex, who had revealed his True Demon Body, Jack at this moment seemed even more like a demon king, emitting a Terrifying Aura that frightened all beings, a gap originating from the difference in the level of life.
With the major battle erupting and all sides’ powerhouses restrained, Jack no longer needed to conceal his strength and directly revealed his True Demon God Body.
What followed was his time for slaughter.
But just at that moment, a mad roar resounded from the distance, “Nine-heads, kill him, kill that human.”
From amidst the ruins of the collapsed mountain, the bloodied and flesh-torn body of Alex, eyes bloodshot, glared deathly at Jack, who radiated a terrifying sense of oppression.
He, the great descendant of a direct Demon God bloodline, was blasted away like trash by a human of a lower realm.
That absolute Overbearing, invincible strength caused even Alex to feel fear upon recollection, followed by boundless rage and killing intent.
To think he wasn’t blasted to pieces by my halberd. Looking at Alex, whose flesh was mostly blown off to reveal half of his skeletal frame, Jack’s eyes showed a hint of surprise.
It seems this descendant of the Demon Gods is still very strong.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Behind Alex, more than ten kilometers away, the Dark Giant Beast hovering in the air let out a ferocious bellow, and light flashed from its nine dragon heads, instantly transforming into beams of black Light Beams bursting forth.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The nine terrifying beams of black light continuously merged in the air, and in the blink of an eye, formed a hundred-meter-wide Destructive Breath that shot across the sky toward Jack.
But just then, in front of Jack Clark, the void distorted and a white tail thousands of meters long appeared, interweaving into an umbrella-shaped barrier that blocked in the middle of Jack Clark.
Boom! The Eight-tailed Heavenly Fox’s white tails shone with radiance, with the rules surrounding them, fiercely clashed against the Dark Giant Beast’s terrifying strike that fused nine breaths into one.
The clash between the two Mythical Giant Beasts released a massive energy shockwave which formed concentric circles of energy halos in the high altitude, while the Earth below continuously shook and cracked under the terrifying energy impact.
Compared to humans of the same realm, the Mythical Giant Beasts possessed energy that was more vast and majestic; even the residual waves of their casual movements were more terrifying.
The sudden appearance of the Mythical Giant Beast made the nine dragon heads of the Dark Giant Beast take on a solemn expression, as the breaths from their mouths slowly dissipated.
Suddenly, a Demon King in the sky crushed a crystal and let out a roar of shock and anger, “Lord Barus, ignore the Biological Mechas on the central battlefield, a human monster has emerged here.”
“This Human has broken through the race limits, he has broken through the limits of the Human Race, this human must die.”
Boom! In the sky above the central battlefield, the might of a fifth, unfamiliar Grand Demon King erupted, startling all the Human Kings who were fiercely battling.
But this Grand Demon King did not join the battlefield; instead, it flew towards the Third Battlefield with terrifying speed.
At the Grand Demon King level, speed had lost all concept, merging with the rules to twist space for teleportation and jumping.
“The Purgatory Family still has a Grand Demon King left… Eight-tails, come with me to stop it, Jack Clark, the rest is up to you.”
Boom! Gentry Gail, who was originally prepared to cooperate with Jack Clark and join the battle, saw his expression subtly change as the pressure of someone at the Mythical Peak erupted from him.
Roar! The Eight-tailed Heavenly Fox Giant Beast, also at the Mythical Peak, let out a roar and its colossal body soared towards the heavens.
As ‘brothers’ who had grown up together since the earliest Dark Age and fought their way out together, Gentry Gail and the Eight-tailed Heavenly Fox Giant Beast had long since fused their strength and bloodlines, otherwise they couldn’t have created the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
At this moment, when the strength of one human and Unique Beast combined, their auras surged instantly, shattering limits.
Boom!! A thousand kilometers away, a grand battle erupted. The two Demon Kings and kings in the sky re-engaged, instantly plunging the entire battlefield into a state of intense combat.
The sudden turn of events also caused a pause among those below.
Looking at the distant Jack Clark with an indifferent expression, Alex, whose flesh and blood were continuously regenerating, revealed a ferocious look, “Human, let’s see who can save you this time.”
This human was very powerful, but as a Mid-Mythical Stage creature, with nine dragon heads, six types of talents, and mastery over two types of rules, the Dark Giant Beast was even more powerful.
Moreover, with its allied forces, they were certain to suppress this human today, and it would be even better to sever half of his body before he could activate his life-saving forbidden weapon.
Meanwhile, around the Dark Giant Beast, streams of invisible Rule power circulated, trying to pull it, which was unleashing Mythical power on the frontline battlefield, up into the sky.
But at the same time, another Rule power interfered and suppressed. The invisible and terrifying power that dispersed made even the Dark Giant Beast feel somewhat fearful; it truly did not want to enter this battlefield.
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “Just because you’re a Mythical Giant Beast, you think you can be invincible?”
The appearance of this Mythical Giant Beast had disrupted the current balance, and even if he transformed into his Demon God Form, he wouldn’t be able to defeat, let alone kill it, but…
Hum!
On the enormous back of Jack Clark’s left hand, gloomy blue radiance shone, and infinite runes instantly formed an altar covering hundreds of meters.
Above the Time-Space Summoning Altar, a vortex made of intertwined silver and blue rune sequence chains emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield
chapters.content:
Chapter 914: Chapter 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield
Just as Jack Clark activated the Time-Space Summoning Altar, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon that had already flown out of the Ice Crystal Divine Palace and stood atop the ten thousand meter mountain peak suddenly let out a roar.
Roar!
The terrifying roar shook heaven and earth, as sonic booms thundered and generated rolling airwaves.
Behind the giant beast covered in thick scale armor, streaks of electricity sparkled between its dark-blue Dorsal Fins, turning into invisible electro-magnetic forces that spread across a hundred kilometers.
Boom!
...
The already cold and humid mountain peak’s surroundings began to churn with clouds, as streaks of blue arcs thundered within them, and a raging wind howled, rotating around the summit of the mountain as its center.
Yi ya yi ya!?
The sudden change startled the purple little dragon on the head of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, making it think an enemy had appeared.
The half-human, half-serpent priests in the Ice Crystal Divine Palace below the mountain, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast perched on another mountain peak, and the Single-horned Tiger Whale roaming the clouds were all startled by the sudden outburst of pressure from the Thunderflame Demon Dragon.
Even the Blue-White Giant Dragon, which was at the other end of the mountain ranges and had just closed its eyes ‘not long ago,’ turned its head in surprise towards the rear, wondering what got into that little one all of a sudden.
In its perception, no invaders were detected within the rule-laden expanse of the Ice Crystal Mountain Range.
In the blink of an eye, wind and thunder converged, and the Thunderflame Demon Dragon at the center of the cloud vortex roared with endless thunder, drawing upon the power of Heaven and Earth’s natural thunder to form nine kilometer-wide Thunder Rings in front of it.
These Thunder Rings were layered one upon another, resembling an innate Rune Array that emitted a terrifying Destructive Aura.
Three pairs of feather horn-like protuberances flanked the dragon head of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, burning with golden flames, entwined with countless silver spatial runes that shimmered and resonated with Jack Clark’s Space-Time Summoning.
At the same time, from the mouth of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, a thirty-meter-wide beam of light, created from the fusion of Heaven Burning Golden Flame and Purple Void Poison, violently erupted.
Boom boom boom!! With each Thunder Ring the fused Destructive Breath passed through, its power doubled, and by the time it passed through all nine rings, it had transformed into a purple-golden-blue Light Beam that penetrated heaven and earth.
In front of the Destructive Breath, a hundred-meter-wide, spinning, gloomy blue vortex emerged, distorting space, time, and inverting cause and effect.
Boom! The purple-golden-blue beam struck the vortex, and in an instant, the vortex shook, sending out ripples of space-time that shimmered between heaven and earth.
On the Frontline Battlefield, the moment Jack Clark activated the Time-Space Summoning Altar, Alex, whose True Body was severely damaged, felt an intense threat of impending death.
This was the first time since its birth that it sensed the Aura of Death, and it couldn’t help but shout madly, “Nine-heads, stop him at once.”
Unfortunately, it was too late.
Standing eighty meters tall, with three faces and six arms, Jack Clark stood upon the altar. With a wave of his left hand toward the Dark Giant Beast several kilometers away, the spinning gloomy blue vortex above his head vibrated wildly.
Boom!
Amid the shaking of the vortex, a tens of meters-wide golden-purple-blue Light Beam carrying the aura of Destroy Heaven and Earth pierced through the realm, and in an instant, the Void shook and the earth split open.
The beam continued to expand after passing through the pathway, shattering the space it traversed. The invisible waves of destructive energy alarmed both Demon Kings and Human Kings battling in the sky.
The Dark Giant Beast, targeted and unable to evade, let out a roar of shock and anger.
Roar roar roar!!
The Dark Giant Beast’s nine dragon heads roared, discharging nine black Breaths that merged in mid-air into a hundred-meter-thick Breath that surged forward to meet the attack.
Simultaneously, around the Dark Giant Beast, a domain infused with two rules and four types of Gifted Powers expanded, forming layers of barriers that encompassed an area over a thousand meters in diameter.
Boom!
The two breaths collided a few kilometers away from the Dark Giant Beast, and in an instant, a kilometer-wide Light sphere flashed across heaven and earth, followed by a horrifying energy blast that obliterated everything.
Boom boom boom!! The mountains below crumbled, the Earth exploded, and countless bits of dirt and stone melted into magma mid-air, scattering in all directions for over ten kilometers.
In the midst of the terrifying explosion, the golden-purple-blue beam, unstoppable, suppressed the black Breath and slammed into the Dark Giant Beast’s rule domain with a thunderous energy blast.
Boom! An even more ferocious energy shock spread across heaven and earth, lighting up the night sky of the Third Battlefield. Many humans and beings of different races instinctively looked towards the commotion.
Sensing the late Myth-level, almost reaching the Mythical Peak power of the energy fluctuations, everyone’s face was filled with shock.
Even the two kings in the sky, Demon Kings, paused their fight instinctively, their gazes falling upon Jack Clark who stood atop the gloomy blue altar, his hand summoning the Destructive Breath.
However, as he continued to maintain the Summoning Altar, Jack Clark’s aura grew increasingly ‘weaker,’ evidently summoning this Destructive Breath took a great toll on him.
“Act now, break his concentration.”
“Over my dead body.”
Boom boom boom!! The four Myth-level Powerhouses in the sky resumed their fierce battle, frantically entangling and preventing each other from intervening.
“Nine-heads, hold it off.”
With the True Demon’s True Body mostly recovered below, Alex’s expression was ugly as he stared fixedly at the increasingly ‘weaker’ Jack Clark on the distant altar.
In Alex’s hands, a crystal containing space teleportation power that could tear a space crack shattered, but the transport failed due to the severe shaking of the surrounding space.
Therefore, it could only pray that the Dark Giant Beast would hold on.
Roar roar roar!!
Feeling the breath of Death, the Dark Giant Beast’s nine dragon heads roared, unleashing an endless eruption of power from its body. The practically tangible domain of rules surrounding it shone brightly.
The Dark Giant Beast’s ability, similar to the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s fusion with Innate talents and domain evolution, allowed it to integrate all its strength into the rule domain, forming an invincible Absolute Barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 915: Chapter 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield_2
In the face of its rule barriers, even an ordinary Mythical Late Stage Giant Beast couldn’t break through and injure it, which was the reason it was assigned to protect Alex.
With a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast guarding the rear, possessing combat strength comparable to an ordinary demon king, and a bloodline imprint capable of unleashing a burst or blocking a strike from a Demon God,
addition to those demon kings and Great Demon Kings from the same camp surrounding the battlefield, as long as Alex didn’t court death, this Civilizational Battlefield experience was simply a walkover.
However… Boom! Boom! Boom! Under the fusion breath of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, a black Light Sphere with a diameter of kilometers continuously shattered and dissipated until it finally revealed the astonished Black Colossus.
“I won’t accept this!”
Boom!
...
Under the shroud of the Destructive Breath’s Power Explosion, the eight layers of Defense Demon Artifacts on Alex, who was beneath the Dark Giant Beast, shattered. The demon could only let out a miserable scream before disintegrating into ash.
Roar! Roar! Roar! The Black Colossus let out a frenzy of roars, its enormous body sent flying ten kilometers by the destructive Light Beam, crashing into the ten thousand-meter mountain behind it.
Boom!
The mountain collapsed, and amid the quaking Earth, a vast mushroom cloud rose, its light and energy pulses causing Heaven and Earth to lose their color. All different races and humans within hundreds of kilometers instinctively stopped fighting.
Almost a minute later, not until the life aura of the Black Colossus vanished, did the golden purple-blue pillar of light piercing heaven and earth above Jack Clark’s head gradually fade away.
Accompanied by the death of a Mythical Giant Beast, Jack Clark, standing atop the altar with three faces and six arms, reached his peak aura, appearing like a True God descending with Divine Might as formidable as a prison.
In this moment, everything in this world went silent. Demonic kings and king-level beings in the sky, and even further away, Great Demon King Barus, who was suppressing Gentry Gail and the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox, instinctively stopped fighting.
Gentry Gail and the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox took a moment to catch their breath, facing the Great Demon King with Mythical Peak strength was a bit of a stretch after all.
But fortunately, Barus had just made a breakthrough to Great Demon King. Together, they could withstand him for a while longer. If it were a seasoned demon king, they would have been injured after a few exchanges.
But what was that kid’s Secret Skill all about? Gentry Gail turned slightly, looking towards the distant Third Battlefield, wondering when the Space-Time Summoning Technique could directly summon a Breath?
At the Early Stage of the Nine Heavens Realm, he killed a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast! In this moment, even the gazes of Demon Gods from the remote high altitudes tens of thousands of kilometers away were drawn over.
But just then, Jack Clark’s face turned pale, and his aura plummeted dramatically.
Even unable to maintain the True Demon God Body due to the ‘consumption’ of the summoning, his figure rapidly shrank and returned to a normal human form.
At the same time, the Space-Time Altar beneath him disintegrated, transforming into countless gloomy blue Rune Sequence Chains contracting, finally reforming into a Blue Altar Imprint on the back of Jack Clark’s hand.
This scene made the Purgatory Family’s High-Ranking Powerhouses over tens of kilometers away narrow their eyes, sensing a flicker of opportunity.
Suddenly, a Ninth Heaven Purgatory True Demon Legion commander bellowed, “His last move drained a lot, now is the best chance to kill him.”
Just then, the roaring command of Great Demon King Barus descended from the sky, “It’s you, Darren Callum. All True Demons and different races, heed my order. Kill that human and be rewarded with ten portions of Blood of Demon God and one complete Origin rule.”
With the four rings of light behind him, holding a War Halberd, and that distinctive Three-Faced Six-Armed True Body, the Great Demon King recognized Jack’s ‘identity’ immediately.
Then came an indescribable killing intent, for as per the information updated in the Intelligence Department one Sun Wheel ago, this human genius was only at the Eight Layer Heaven.
Now, just one Sun Wheel later, he had already grown to the Nine Layers Heaven, and his combat power was already comparable to an ordinary demon king, not to mention that terrifying summoning strength.
This monster had to die.
Following the command of Great Demon King Barus, the entire battlefield spanning over a thousand kilometers wide and several hundred kilometers in depth erupted in turmoil. Those High-Ranking True Demons and different races’ powerhouses reddened their eyes.
Birds die for food, and humans for wealth, even in the mythical world, this held true. Faced with rewards capable of transforming ten Ninth Heavens Purgatory True Demons and an Origin rule sufficient to step into the Legendary Realm, all demons went mad.
“Kill!”
“For the glory of the Purgatory True Demon Race!”
“For the Blood of the Demon God.” In an instant, countless figures exuding Eight Layer and Nine Layers auras burst forth from three directions.
Just then, the voice of the Human King came from the sky, “Everyone heed my orders, block those Purgatory powerhouses, do not let them besiege our race’s genius.”
Boom! Boom! Boom! In an instant, the entire front became chaotic, with commandants of legions under the orders of kings and Great Demon Kings on both sides entangled in furious combat.
The scene actually exceeded Jack Clark’s expectations as well.
Originally, his mission was to break through the battlefield swiftly with a burst of strength, as Number One drew all attention at the main battlefield, and in coordination with three legions, tear through the enemy’s rear defenses.
But he hadn’t expected the sudden appearance of a Demon God Descendant protected by a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast, forcing him to use the Space-Time Summoning Technique prematurely to take out the foe.
And during the summoning of Destructive Breath, he used the Sea Illusion Demon Skill at its limit, which could alter life aura, and the power of Hidden Deity to disguise himself.
Combined with the substantial Qi Blood energy consumption while continuously summoning the Breath, he reduced his strength to a tenth of its original, appearing extremely weakened and unable to fight again.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 916: Chapter 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield_3
Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel his heart leaping into his throat when he summoned the Avatar’s breath, sensing as if he was being eyed by a terrifying existence.
Apparently, he had attracted the attention of a Heavenly King-level, or even a Demon God-level being.
In a battlefield of this civilizational scale, even kings could fall at any moment, and a Heavenly King could be injured, not to mention that he was still just a ‘small shrimp’ in the realm of the Ninth Heavens.
Although he had a life-saving forbidden weapon given to him by a Supreme Expert, it was still better to keep a low profile. He didn’t want to die before achieving his goals, like that quite powerful descendant of the Demon Gods.
To survive an attack from his Demon God Form without dying, the opponent’s combat strength was almost on par with an ordinary demon king. Such talent, even among The Purgatory Family, should be among the best.
But such a genius was still annihilated under the Sky-base Breath he had summoned.
...
…
In the area of destruction thousands of kilometers above, Diorus watched Jack Clark, who was gasping for breath and standing with his War Halberd, and Number One, who was becoming increasingly formidable after devouring the flesh, blood, and souls of many high-level beings in the middle of the battlefield. Diorus showed a hint of hesitation in his eyes.
It was weighing whether to have Carthius take action now to suppress the terrifyingly talented monster of the Human Race or to continue waiting for that Biological Mecha to move deeper into the rear and step out of the rule-interwoven area to destroy it.
Roar!
On the frontline battlefield, Number One, now grown to over one hundred seventy meters tall and more terrifying in might, let out a ferocious roar, its presence increasingly horrifying to all beings.
Boom! Boom! Number One’s eyes shot out twin beams of blue and white, blasting away two demon kings in its path and then sweeping across a mountain more than ten kilometers away.
In an instant, the mountain collapsed, the earth exploded, and thousands from different races were obliterated by the beams, reminiscent of Thunder lasers, forming two death passages.
Seeing this, Diorus felt the balance in his heart tipping towards Number One.
If Jack Clark, with his initial stage of Ninth Heaven talent, had slain the Mid-Mythical Dark Giant Beast, Diorus would have immediately unleashed all its power to obliterate the Human Race monster.
But the opponent was only relying on a Summoning Secret Skill for a limit breakthrough, and the strength displayed was only comparable to an ordinary demon king. Under these circumstances, the weight of the situation was different.
The hidden Carthius had only one chance to strike. After destroying the Biological Mecha, it would only have a short time to suppress the Human Race King-level strong man before being blocked by the supporting Supreme Experts of the Human Race.
Therefore, after weighing the options, Diorus temporarily suppressed the intent to eradicate the Human Race monster.
As Diorus’s intent to kill fluctuated, the Sky-based Divine King across from him looked calm, without a single ripple in his gaze.
He already knew that Jack Clark could summon a Mythical-level Power Projection of a giant beast’s strength. This was also why Jack Clark was chosen as a secret weapon—otherwise, the strength of an ordinary demon king would not have been enough for the Federation to mobilize.
On a battlefield of this level, losing one king-level fighter couldn’t affect the balance of the war. The real deciding factors were the Heavenly Kings and the Supreme Level.
Nevertheless, the rule power that enveloped the Third Battlefield from the Sky-based Divine King became even more potent, obscuring Diorus’s perception.
On the shattered earth below, Jack Clark, standing tall with his War Halberd, suddenly breathed a sigh of relief. The heart-pounding sensation in his chest gradually disappeared.
Just then, from a distance, an early-stage Ninth-Heaven being, towering over ten meters tall and resembling a giant demon, lunged at Jack Clark, eyes filled with madness: “The Blood of Demon God is mine…”
Boom!
With a casual wave of his hand from Jack Clark, the heavy and overbearing War Halberd shimmered with purple-gold radiance, gathering terrifying power to smash the hundreds of meters long blade light with one strike.
Bang! Under the heavy and terrifying Eight Desolate War Halberd, the fragile domain surrounding the Ninth Heaven being crumbled, and it exploded in a panic roar before it could even make a sound.
Under the powerful impact force, countless pieces of flesh and blood sprayed out in a fan-shaped pattern over a distance of more than a hundred meters, painting a bloody scene.
Seeing the figure standing in the distance, holding a halberd and exploding an early-stage Ninth Heaven alien strong man with one strike, some high-order Purgatory True Demons that had closed in stopped in their tracks.
No, weren’t you very weak?
Arcs of electricity flickered weakly on Jack Clark, and faint strands of golden flames burned on his body, making him seem extremely weak, yet his aura was unrivaled in domination.
