Jack Clark stood holding the halberd, his eyes indifferent as he looked toward the approaching high-order True Demons and spoke slowly, “Even if I’ve overexerted and have only one-tenth of my strength left, with a halberd in one hand, I can still blow you trash apart.”
“Kill!” With that, the ‘weakened’ Jack Clark shouted heartily, exploding into action, transforming into a straightforward streak of blood light.
Boom!
A Purgatory True Demon at the Eight Demonic Marks Realm was blown apart by Jack Clark’s single-handed halberd strike, and the powerful force blasted a hundred-meter wide crater into the earth.
A mid-period Ninth Heaven Purgatory True Demon shouted, “Be careful, his physical strength is formidable. Use long-range attacks to wear him down. No, his speed is so fast…”
Like a destructive Violent Dragon, Jack Clark charged into a position about ten kilometers away that held thousands of beings, led by eight-meter-tall Bull Headed Aliens.
Boom!
With Jack Clark at the center, over twenty meter-long blue halberd skills bloomed like lotuses, shredding through defensive buildings and different races with peerless sharpness.
These halberd skills were several times weaker than at first, equivalent to the ordinary attacks of Ninth Heaven, yet they were still too much for these high-order beings. In the blink of an eye, everything within a three-kilometer radius was destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 917: Chapter 391 Summoning Sky-base Breath, Dominating the Battlefield_4
The earth within this area had cracked, thousands of Senior different races were pulverized, and innumerable fragments of flesh and blood were scattered around, with the gushing blood dyeing the ground scarlet.
Standing at the center of the ruins, Jack Clark was once again enveloped in a blood light, his dark red eyes filled with endless slaughter and destruction, and strands of blood light and Killing Intent converged toward him.
Immediately, Jack Clark’s Aura became noticeably ‘stronger’.
At once on the distant battlefield, a True Demon in the mid period of the Nine Demonic Marks Realm shouted, “Stop him, he has the talent to recover Spirit Qi through slaughter, join forces and kill that human genius.”
However, even though he shouted loudly, the True Demon from The Purgatory Family didn’t step forward.
Boom!
...
The ground shattered, and Jack Clark turned into a burst of blood light, altogether ignoring the chase of those high-order True Demons behind him, instead he relentlessly destroyed one Alien Corps position after another.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
With blood light swirling around him, whether it was a ten-meter-thick position fortress or different races standing dozens of meters tall, all were blasted apart by the heavy War Halberd.
‘Weakened’ Jack Clark once again displayed invincible strength, his speed terrifying as he rampaged purely with strength, destroying everything across the entire battlefield.
As for those powerful attacks from high-order True Demon strong men, they were directly blocked by the fourfold invisible Boundary Wall that surrounded him, unable to get close.
Such fearsome Defense caused all those high-order True Demons and Alien Races who had wanted to surround and kill Jack Clark to look solemn and, indeed, stay back.
Boom!
Another Alien commander at the Eighth Layer Peak was blown apart by a strike of the War Halberd, leaving only his legs as countless remnants of flesh and blood sprayed across the ground.
Amidst the frenzied slaughter, the blood light surrounding Jack Clark grew increasingly terrifying, gradually recovering from a ‘weakened’ range of a hundred meters to more than three hundred meters, while his Aura also grew stronger.
The cost, however, was the destruction of Alien positions within hundreds of kilometers, with countless streams of red, blue, and purple blood flowing over the shattered Earth.
This was what True Martial Heavenly King and others expected of Jack Clark in the face of his defense, speed, Burst, endurance, and combat strength all pushed to the limit, making him a monster to whom his peers and those below him seemed utterly hopeless.
There was no need for him to engage in higher-level battles, just slaughtering enemies of the same rank was enough—the ‘old folks’ would take care of the higher-level battles.
Unopposed, Jack Clark soon demolished various fire points and fortress positions across hundreds of kilometers, breaking the balance of the Third Battlefield.
“Hahaha… Kill them, crush those Alien Races.”
“Rocket launchers, fire everything.”
“Fourth Team, go around the side of the battlefield and stop those Aliens; don’t let them escape.”
At this moment, roars of rage came from the sky: “Krast, take action immediately and stop that human.”
On the battlefield, the most powerful member of The Purgatory Family present was Krast, the Purgatory True Demon in the late period of the Nine Demonic Marks Realm, stationed at the rear.
But upon catching sight of that figure enveloped in blood light and recovering ‘one-third’ strength with each kill, even a Purgatory True Demon like Krast couldn’t help but look very grave.
“Lord Karas, I fear I am no match for that human; I suggest we first withdraw from this battlefield, or summon a Demon King Level Strong to Suppress him.”
Rage flared in the eyes of the two Demon Kings in the sky, appalled that Krast, a True Demon strong man, could be so cowardly.
The strength of that human had now fallen to Demon King level, and he couldn’t even show his True Body. The destructive force he could exert was only at the late period of the Nine Demonic Marks Realm.
As a Top Strong in the late period of the Nine Demonic Marks Realm, he didn’t dare to take action. They were part of the Purgatory True Demon Clan, peerless within the same rank—where was his pride as a member of the True Demon Race?
Faced with the angry gaze of the Demon Kings from above, Krast could only respond with a bitter smile.
In fact, any high-order True Demon that had been to the Frontline Battlefield knew very well that the advantage of The Purgatory Family’s Inheritance was very low against humans.
These humans, who had acquired powerful and complete Inheritance from some source, could be crushed by soldiers of The Purgatory Family in the early stages between Fourfold and Six Path Devil Marks, overpowering them tenfold.
The ordinary soldiers could only contend with the Main Battle Legions with the aid of ‘technology.’
Yet once these humans broke through the Seven Demon Marks Boundary, their strength would undergo a drastic Transformation, greatly narrowing the gap in combat abilities compared to the same rank of The Purgatory Family.
And once these humans made the breakthrough to Eight Path Demon Marks, and even to the Nine Demonic Marks Realm, their strength would grow even stronger, evolving step by step into higher tiers just like the True Demon Race.
Therefore, when facing a human who, with a single strike, had dealt heavy injuries comparable to the ordinary Demon King Alex, and with another strike had slain a Mythical Giant Beast, it was no wonder Krast hesitated.
Even if the opponent seemed ‘weakened’.

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 392 Jack Clark: I feel like I could go for another round
chapters.content:
Chapter 918: Chapter 392 Jack Clark: I feel like I could go for another round
“Use the Armored Elephants to surround him, the rest of the demons retreat, retreat.”
On the frontline of the main battle legion of The Purgatory Family, tens of thousands of Unique Beasts, towering at over twenty meters at the shoulder and over forty meters in length, clad in thick scale armor, let out roaring howls.
Mounted on these immensely strong and terrifyingly defensive Unique Beasts, which were only of the sixth level, were thin yet muscular members of the Purgatory Demon Race, standing six meters tall.
The aura of these demons also contained Six Path Devil Marks, and they wielded crude, seven-meter-long bone bows, each draw firing a ten-meter-long black arrow.
These arrows had astonishing killing power, a range of five kilometers, and would explode violently upon hitting the ground. Each volley could flatten a mountain peak.
Yet, at this moment, the main battle legion was in chaos. A figure, wrapped in a swirl of blood light, rampaged through the legion’s ranks, unstoppable.
...
Boom Boom Boom!!
The War Halberd, entwined with purple-golden radiance and blood light, swept through, and within a hundred-meter radius, the Unique Beasts’ flesh and blood exploded. The elite riders were also torn apart by the swirling sharp energies, splattering blood and gore everywhere as the Unique Beasts wailed.
Just as Jack Clark cleared the surrounding Purgatory demons in an instant, hundreds of black arrows, like rockets, engulfed him.
Boom Boom Boom!! A violent explosion shook the earth, and everything around was shattered by the combined explosions of the Dark Demon Arrows, forming a miniature mushroom cloud.
Boom! The ferocious blast wave dissipated, and a figure surrounded by blood light shot out, unscathed—it was Jack Clark.
This sight filled the elite eyes of the Purgatory demons with despair.
Facing such a terrifyingly fast and unrivaled opponent, whose defense was also invincible, they were like a herd of young beasts awaiting slaughter, utterly powerless to fight back.
Under normal conditions, a rampaging human expert like this would be intercepted and even besieged by the Purgatory demons.
But their legion commander, Valas, a mid-period expert of the Ninth Heavens, had his body burst by the opponent’s halberd, and the deputy commander had already been blown up earlier while trying to surround this monster.
Watching the invincible blood-colored figure, who had traversed hundreds of kilometers from the sides of the mountain ranges to the center of the battlefield, the demon king Karas knew that if he hesitated any longer, ten subsidiary legions would be emptied, and could not help but roar with anger.
“Krast, set up the Dark Demon Blood Soul Array to trap that human, the rest of the True Demons close ranks with the Kunus Legion, and withdraw from the battlefield through Spiral Mountain.”
Boom!
As the two Demon Kings spoke, a heavy and domineering War Halberd shattered the skull of a Giant Beast resembling an ancient elephant, over two hundred meters long and a hundred meters tall at the shoulder.
With the killing of this ‘Beast King’, the remaining Armored Elephants went berserk. Influenced by this, the battle line, which was overwhelmingly suppressed by the elite of The Purgatory Family, began to collapse.
Whoosh! Standing atop the corpse of the Giant Beast, Jack Clark slowly exhaled.
With the frenzied ‘slaughter,’ the aura around him had recovered to fifty percent. The surrounding bloodthirsty Killing Intent soared skyward, like a Demon God of Hell.
However, Jack Clark continued to carefully control his ‘strength’, not allowing himself to recover to his peak, appearing still weak, primarily relying on the power of his physical body.
The Sea Illusion Mystique, strengthened to the limit, along with Hidden Deity, also boosted to the limit and upgraded to Divine Power through Innate restoration, disguised him so well that even the Great Demon Kings could not see through Jack Clark’s true state.
One changed the life aura, the other lowered the presence, even temporarily erasing it.
But if it hadn’t been for the rules of the Sky-based God King covering him, Jack Clark would have been seen through by the Demon God in the sky, as the gap between them was too large, and he was right under the eyes of his enemy.
As the orders from the two Demon Kings were given, the battle line of The Purgatory Family, spanning thousands of kilometers, began to fall apart, with the main battle legions being the first to retreat.
The commander of the Third Battlefield, Krast, hesitated only for a moment before joining two early-stage Nine Demonic Marks and seven late-stage Eight Path Demon Marks Purgatory True Demons, flying towards Jack Clark from several directions.
Under the previous battles, the High-Ranking Powerhouses of the third battlefield had been so diminished by Jack Clark that very few remained.
Boom!
Still several kilometers from Jack Clark, the Purgatory True Demons manifested their strength in the form of shimmering demon patterns, unleashing endless demon gas that erupted into columns reaching into the sky.
Instantly, demon gas billowed through the Heaven and Earth, forming a miles-wide Dark Curtain surrounding Jack Clark.
Just as the Demon Array was established, Jack Clark keenly sensed the space around him twisting and changing—he was trapped within a distorted space maze filled with Dark Demon Air.
However, the maze’s twisted spaces were quite fragile, requiring only minimal effort to break through.
Moreover, within the array, there was a wave that infected the spirit and even the soul, causing direction to be lost, consciousness to become confused, the Five Senses to blur, somewhat similar to the Dark Curtain.
Boom! Jack Clark suddenly turned around, his War Halberd flashing with blood light, transforming into a two-hundred-meter-long Blood Colored Battle Spear, shrouded in the Power of Hell that blasted everything to pieces.
Bam! The late-period Eight Layer True Demon trying to ambush Jack Clark was instantly obliterated.
Suddenly, the Demon Array weakened, and Krast, the array’s main controller, turned pale, “Bara, you fool, we only needed to trap him for a moment.”
To think he could actually kill that human, hadn’t he seen his aura had already recovered to fifty percent?
With this thought, Krast decisively abandoned the array, the entire being turned into a black radiance and flew rapidly away.

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 392 Jack Clark: I feel like I could go for another round_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 919: Chapter 392 Jack Clark: I feel like I could go for another round_2
Boom! Just
as Krast made his escape, intense golden flames and thunder burst, tearing apart the dark sky curtain, and at the same time, a Purgatory True Demon in the early stages of the Ninth Heavens was obliterated.
The remaining seven high-order Purgatory True Demons changed their expressions drastically and turned to flee without a second thought.
“Where do you think you’re going…”
“Kill them!”
“Charge!”
...
As a massive amount of high-ranking powerhouses surrounded Jack Clark, the strong men of the Human Race’s army, seeing him invincible, led their troops in an even more intense attack.
At this moment, with the Purgatory Demon Race in retreat, they charged at the forefront, their expressions excited and exhilarated.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In the sky, drones clashed with retreating Flying Exotic Beasts, while from the rear, rockets and artillery violently bombed those beasts that had broken through the positions, with unmanned Mechs armed with guns following closely in the front line.
However, the weakest of these different races all possessed the physique of a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator, running at full strength faster than one hundred meters per second, so they quickly moved out of the range of the rear artillery bombardment.
The collapse was sudden, just like that.
As the Third Battlefield collapsed with Jack Clark leading the way, killing the retreating enemy troops with an imposing manner, an invisible power spread along with the advancing soldiers.
That was the Law Power of the Sky-based God King.
As the Sky-based God King, part of his rule represented human science and technology, capable of entwining around those Mecha weapons.
At this time, his Law Power, as the front line advanced, spread and eroded Diorus’ Rule Domain, quietly altering some of the rule details of this world.
For example, the chaotic magnetic field of heaven and earth interfering with communications and the violent Heavenly Energy corroding technological electronics.
As beings who controlled a type of rule, they could influence the subtle rule changes of a part of heaven and earth and eventually even dominate the Heavenly Earth Rules.
Only this time, the surprise attack didn’t have the effect of a trump card as the Purgatory Family’s reinforcements emerged too suddenly and didn’t meet the expectations of the Sky-based God King.
And it also revealed the existence of ‘genius’ Jack Clark.
Especially with more Heavenly King-level combat power on the other side, the Sky-based God King’s gaze fluctuated slightly.
On the opposite side of the Sky-based God King, actually separated by a vast spatial distance, Diorus had a gloomy look, due to the rapid collapse of the Third Battlefield.
At this time, in the eyes of the two Demon God Level Powerhouses, the more than ten thousand kilometers outside the city of the Human Clan’s Heavenly Abyss to the same range of buffer zone belonging to the Purgatory Demon Race were filled with strands of force.
This range was bisected from the middle, with two forces of rules eroding and intertwining at all times; they had actually been in conflict for many days and nights.
And now a corner of the Frontline Battlefield was collapsing, torn open with a gap, its Rule Power also quickly eroded and dissipated.
The reason was that on the transcendent battlefield, no one could stop that Human Clan Genius.
This human must die! Diorus forcibly suppressed the idea of striking down and killing that Human Clan Genius, turning his attention to the middle battlefield.
There, the Purgatory Family had a significant advantage. Aside from the Number One deep within enemy lines, whether it was the main battlefield or the mythical battle at the higher end, the Human Race was suppressed by the Purgatory Family.
It’s close, almost there.
Watching the Biological Mecha that had penetrated three armies and reached deep into the Purgatory Family’s rear, Diorus’ gaze was icy cold, soon it would show these humans what a heavy loss meant.
Boom!
High above in the firmament, a Divine Soul of a Human King was half destroyed; the person fell from the heavens like a shooting star, violently crashing into the mountain ranges.
Boom!
The Earth shattered within a range of several kilometers, countless rocks and dirt soared into the sky, and terrible Law Power formed a destructive energy shock that swept across more than a dozen kilometers.
Boom! A terrifying energy vibration in the sky, followed by a middle-aged man’s voice, “Abel, are you alright?”
“I’m fine, it’s just a bit of consumption of the Laws’ Origin,” responded a thunderous cry, as a figure wrapped in laws rose from the raging turbulence on the Earth into the sky.
Yet, this King-level aura appeared weakened by ten percent after being sandwiched between attacks from two Demon Kings; however, it remained fearless.
It is difficult to kill Mythical-level Powerhouses unless one possesses absolute overwhelming strength, a strike that eradicates the opponent’s Divine Soul and Laws’ Origin; otherwise, it’s a slow grind to erode the True Body.
Roar!
On the Earth, the surroundings of Number One were enveloped in blood light for tens of kilometers, all in its path were devoured, displaying an invincible might as it moved forward; each step caused the ground to tremble thunderously.
In the eyes of Number One, beams of Super God Energy continuously shot out, bombarding and destroying everything around, unstoppable, even the two Demon Kings could not halt its progress.
Around Number One, yellow diamond-shaped halos flickered continuously, forming an absolute Spatial Barrier that blocked all attacks.
Boom!
In the distance, a sky-based battleship’s Energy Shield was shattered, flames erupted in many places, while on the other side, half a demon king’s castle collapsed.
In the sky, fighter aircraft trailing Firelight along with the corpses of Flying Exotic Beasts under the control of different races fell from the sky; explosions of missiles and artillery enveloped the Earth, with blasts echoing between heaven and earth.
In the grand battle stretching over a front of a thousand kilometers on either side, even with the impressive presence of Number One, it seemed rather insignificant.
Suddenly, an electronic voice rang out in the cockpit of Number One.
“Message from the General Command at the rear: all soldiers are not to pursue, not to overextend, and to rely on military positions to engage the Purgatory alien races.”
“Major General Freya Louise, there’s a change in the plan, please do not penetrate deep into the Purgatory Family’s rear positions.”

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 392 Jack Clark: I feel like I could go for another round_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 920: Chapter 392 Jack Clark: I feel like I could go for another round_3
The sudden news made Freya Louise’s emotionless eyes flicker slightly, and immediately, Number One came to a thunderous halt.
At the same time, a glaring red alert was flashing non-stop on the transparent page, showing that the synchronization rate between Freya Louise and Number One had reached ninety-eight percent.
The girl calmed her mind and then softly murmured, “It almost surpassed a hundred percent.”
Feeling Number One growing even stronger after devouring the souls and lives of tens of thousands of high-order Unique Beasts and different race members, Freya Louise fell into a brief silence before stopping in her tracks and proceeding no further.
Boom, boom!!
Number One’s eyes shot forth super god energy beams capable of annihilating everything; wherever it passed, everything was destroyed, exploded; dirt and rock melted into magma in the blink of an eye, forcefully suppressing the two Demon Kings.
...
Meanwhile, on the Third Battlefield, the Three Great Legions, who had just broken through the enemy position, also received orders from General Command and the mighty army that had been pursued for over two hundred kilometers hesitated.
This included Jack Clark, who had just wiped out a battalion of over a thousand slow-moving alien forces left to cover their retreat.
Standing on the torn corpse of a giant, surrounded by the hellish glow of blood light, Jack Clark stood with a halberd, looking up into the depths of the night sky that seemed infinitely far away: “Has there been some unexpected development?”
Because this order was different from their original battle plans.
The original plan was for the Three Great Legions to break through the Third Battlefield and, led by Jack Clark, along with two king-level powerhouses and Gentry Gail, to suppress the enemy’s demon kings and sweep sideways to envelop the central battlefield in a reverse encirclement.
For this reason, the Human Race had reinforced with four king-level powerhouses, a mythical peak Giant Beast, a strong man who had touched the strength of the Heavenly King after over a decade of closed-door cultivation in a relic, and even the True Martial Heavenly King, who was in seclusion, was alerted.
Watching the alien forces retreat into a mountain range shrouded in demon gas, Jack Clark turned around, ready to leave. In a battle of this level, he naturally would not act the hero and defy orders.
However, when Jack Clark turned around, he couldn’t help looking at the high altitude a hundred kilometers behind him, where two king-level human powerhouses were still fiercely combating two Demon Kings.
Immediately, Jack Clark’s gaze flickered slightly. He had originally not planned to intervene in a king-level battle, but now that the plan had shifted to defense, he would need to find a way to earn more merit.
Boom! Jack Clark broke through the air, turning into a streak of blood light as he flew towards the rear.
And just as Jack Clark was flying towards the rear battlefield.
Atop a mountain peak far from the Ice Crystal Divine Palace, the Red Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, circled within the lingering Thunderstorm, curiously watching what was happening in the distance.
There, the bulky and ferocious Black-red Colossal Beast extended its right claw, grabbing one of the thirty-meter-long, ten-meter-thick sharp spikes on its back with its reversed claw. Then the muscles in its right claw swelled, and the scale armor bulged high.
Boom!
Even without the support of the Law Power, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon nearly exerted all its normal strength to snap off the sharp horn of its own Black-red Dorsal Fin.
Immediately, both the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Red Beast were startled, and the Purple little dragon, even more frightened, flew up, shaking its tail and crying out in alarm.
Yiya yiya!? Roar! Thunderflame, what are you doing? Even the Single-horned Tiger Whale was a bit confused, not understanding why Thunderflame would suddenly harm itself.
The Black-red Colossal Beast’s mouth opened slightly, exhaling hot air and a low roar: “No problem, I’m just preparing to make a cannonball.”
Boom!
On the Black-red Colossal Beast’s right claw, a series of black lightning suffused with a Destructive Aura spread, its body covered in flowing golden light, blending with a stream of dim Chaotic power to envelop the sharp horn.
With the continuous infusion of Higher-order Law Power, Destruction, Vajra, and Chaotic Dark Power, the black-red sharp horn emitted terrifying energy fluctuations, like a super Nuclear Bomb ready to detonate at any moment.
At the same time, the Thunderbolt Power between heaven and earth roared back into motion.
Boom, boom, boom!! In the sea of clouds, streaks of Purple Thunder Light thundered, spreading towards the Thunderflame Demon Dragon.
Simultaneously, on the back of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, the clusters of sharp Dorsal Fins lit up one by one, with blue-black lightning exploding, creating a circle of thousands of meters around it.
Boom, boom, boom!!
An endless amount of Thunderbolt Power gathered, and the entire Mountain Peak area formed a vast Thunderstorm magnetic field, circling the Thunderflame Demon Dragon and forming multiple Thunder Light Halos in front of it.
Between these Thunder Light Halos was a thirty-meter-long black-red sharp spike containing terrifying Law Power.
As the electromagnetic field of lightning continued to compress and concentrate, the surface of the black-red sharp spike heated up rapidly, emitting dazzling red Radiance, causing the surrounding space to tremble and crack as if it could not bear the load.
And just as the Thunderflame Demon Dragon was ready, Jack Clark, traveling at ten times the speed of sound, quickly crossed hundreds of kilometers and appeared at the origin of the battlefield at an altitude of tens of thousands of meters.
Looking up at the four towering figures still entangled in combat above, Jack Clark suddenly shouted, “King Lance, I feel like I can fire another shot.”
Jack Clark’s sudden call made the kings and demon kings in the sky above pause in their fierce battle.
Especially the two Demon Kings, sensing that Jack Clark’s Aura had already recovered to sixty percent after continuous slaughter, their expressions changed drastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 393 Devouring the Demon King, The Return of the Thunderflame True Body (Major Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 921: Chapter 393 Devouring the Demon King, The Return of the Thunderflame True Body (Major Chapter)
Just as Jack Clark shouted that he could handle another round, the mark on the back of his hand blazed with light, and countless rune sequence chains flew out beneath him, forming a summoning altar hundreds of meters high.
Particularly, the hundred-meter-diameter gloomy blue halo, slowly rotating over his head, was even emitting faint hints of distortions in space-time and the reversal of cause and effect.
Above the high altitude of a hundred kilometers, Bruce Lancaster bellowed, “Moss, forget about that guy. Join hands with me to trap Karas.”
Boom!
A terrifying aura burst forth from Bruce Lancaster, as if kilometers of golden light were converging around him, transforming into two dazzling, dragon-like golden sequence chains, each extending for ten thousand meters through the Void.
“Laws’ Origin!!” the demon king Karas roared.
...
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The moment the golden chains neared Karas, they violently exploded upon contact with the blue flames burning around him. The two extreme powers, representing the pinnacle of strength, tangled and shook the Void.
Unlike the Dark-ice Demon Flame that burned all matter and energy, Bruce Lancaster’s laws contained the nature of space. The chains traveled through the Void, and in the blink of an eye, they enveloped Karas, forming a sphere several kilometers in diameter: golden on the outside and filled with endless blue flame inside.
The Laws’ Origin is the foundation of a king or demon king, the power formed by the fusion of the World Origin with the soul and one’s laws upon breakthrough to the king level.
Because each use of this origin depletes it and delays progress, requiring more time to recover, and overuse can damage the foundation and cause irreversible harm to the soul.
Therefore, this move is generally only used by kings or demon kings when they are desperate, as it can cause their Law Power to surge several times or even tenfold.
But when Jack Clark said he had another shot left, Bruce Lancaster chose to believe without reservation, immediately consuming a large amount of his origin to perform the Laws Mystery of “Seal Heaven and Earth,” trapping Karas in a temporary space.
This move was powerful, but as it was a wide-range seal, it could only hold Karas, who was also at the Mid-Mythical Stage, for a few breaths – a special combination mystery.
“Thinking of killing me? Impossible.”
Standing hundreds of meters tall, with three heads and six arms, and clad in black armor, the demon king Karas showed crazed fury in his eyes as a terrifying power burst from within him.
Boom!
Amid the unceasingly erupting blue light, Karas’s figure instantly swelled to a kilometer in height, his body sprouted sharp blue bone spurs, and his aura became even more terrifying and horrifying.
Also desperately bursting forth and entering an awakened Demon King Form, Karas clenched his six hands together, gathering the power for a strike that slammed into the golden Boundary Wall in front of him.
Boom! The entire golden space shook, and the Golden Crystal Wall before the demon mark even cracked open.
“Karas, you’re staying behind today.”
Moss Delagu, who followed the Genetic True Martial lineage of Berlin and was entangled with another demon king, roared and his body also swelled instantly, turning into a kilometer-high Black Violent Ape Giant Beast.
His brawny arms glowed with black light as he reached out toward the distant Karas, who was about to break free, and fiercely closed his hands in a clasp.
Weng! In an instant, the space in the distant void shook, the area solidified under a tremendous force, and along with Bruce Lancaster’s sealing chains, it formed a Black Gold crystal.
Spurting!
The moment Moss made his move, a black magic spear, resembling a poisonous dragon and as long as a kilometer, tore through battle armor and scale armor, impaling him from behind through the chest.
Boom!
Moss turned with a swing, his arm as huge as a mountain peak tore through a swath of space, filled with a fearsome, heavy Overbearing Power and shattering the black magic spear. The force of the blast repelled a demon king with three horns.
Huff, huff!!
Moss quickly shrank in size, reverting to his Rule True Body of 300 meters, his sturdy body enshrouded in writhing black smoke like a tangle of serpents, his aura waning.
“Humans, I will surely kill you all.”
The once again suppressed Demon King Karas was shaking with rage, surrounded by blue flames that turned into towering, earth-piercing chains, vibrating in all directions and gradually demolishing the spatial seal.
Just as Karas was trapped, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon in the storm-cloud sea gazed at the summon channel that appeared in the distance. Its already crimson right claw swiped fiercely.
The sharp spike emitting dazzling red light vanished instantly, its speed exceeding the speed of sound a hundredfold, leaving behind a long, dark scar that would not heal for a long time.
Boom! Only at this moment did the earth-shattering roar and shockwave erupt, parting the cloud sea and tossing the Single-horned Tiger Whales spiraling in the clouds.
And as the black spike pierced the channel, the vortex above Jack Clark’s head collapsed with a bang, and he turned deathly pale, weak and plummeting towards the Earth.
While Jack Clark was helplessly falling to the ground, a bolt of red light moved at a terrifying speed beyond the perception of consciousness, spanning more than a hundred kilometers to appear in front of Karas, leaving behind a straight, pitch-black scar standing between Heaven and Earth.
“No!” With the scent of impending death overwhelming him, Karas’s face changed drastically, uttering an unwilling and angry roar.
Boom! Karas’s entire Laws’ Origin burst forth; his presence exploded several times over, his entire form turning pure blue, like a magnificent blue demon.
Endless blue flames, under the might of the laws, gathered in front of him, forming thirty-six layers of distorted, transparent barriers, with his six hands forming a seal in front of him.
Thump! The sharp spike, glowing with dazzling red light, easily penetrated the outer Black Gold Crystal face, then the thirty-six transparent barriers were instantly shattered, turned into fragmented pieces of crystallized Law Fragments scattering.
In that moment, Karas felt as though the whole world had fallen silent and slowed. He watched as the thirty-meter long spike pierced through his six arms, tearing through his armor that rivaled the scale armor of a Mythical Giant Beast, impaling his chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 393 Devouring the Demon King, the True Body of Thunderflame Descends Once Again (Major Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 922: Chapter 393 Devouring the Demon King, the True Body of Thunderflame Descends Once Again (Major Chapter)_2
The moment the sharp horn penetrated the Demon King’s true form, a mark of thought left by the Thunderflame Demon Dragon within the spikes trembled, and in an instant detonated the three types of higher-order law powers contained inside.
Boom! The earth-shattering explosion echoed between heaven and earth, shaking the Void.
In the high skies, a sun several kilometers in diameter, emitting golden light and surrounded by black lightning and a ring of chaotic halos, appeared, illuminating heaven and earth with its endless radiance.
Then came the horrifying Destructive Impact, forming a ring of black shockwaves that kept expanding, a phenomenon where space itself was instantly shattered by the explosion of the three higher-order law powers.
Under the dreadful onslaught, the closest Human kings and the Purgatory Demon King were blasted tens of kilometers away, creating a terrifying spectacle.
Far away, thousands of kilometers distant, Great Demon King Barus’ face changed as he gazed solemnly in the direction of the explosion.
...
A roar of unwilling anger came from there.
“Demon God, avenge me…”
Following the intermittent bellows, the Demon King’s true form was destroyed, and Karas, whose laws’ origin and Demon Soul were both obliterated by the three higher-order law powers, perished utterly.
Just then, a Blood Moon emerged in the sky, an anomaly formed by the convergence of Karas’ scattered law powers with the heaven and earth.
The moment the Blood Moon appeared, it precipitously fell, a scene visible to all beings and races within thousands of kilometers, leaving everyone a bit stunned.
Another Demon King had perished.
This was the first Demon King to fall since the war began, and also the one to fall the quickest. How long had it been since a Mythical-level existence had perished on the front lines?
It must have been over ten sun cycles.
Suddenly, a roar imbued with terrifying majesty resounded through heaven and earth, “Carthius, do it.”
Boom!
The moment Karas fell, Diorus, seeing that Number One no longer advanced, acted boldly. In an instant, Demon God’s pressure burst forth, and at the same time, the Sky-based God King did not show weakness.
Boom!!
Under the vibration of two Demon God Level Rule Powers, the entire heaven and earth shook, and the whole sky was torn apart around the Frontline Battlefield, revealing the towering figures of two gods standing over tens of thousands of kilometers high.
And at the very moment Diorus made his move, a force of Demon God Level terror emerged from behind The Purgatory Family, like a world-destroying Demon Dragon straddling Heaven and Earth, powerfully charging into Diorus’ rule domain.
However, that supreme being’s target was Number One. From a vast distance apart, the Demon God struck boldly.
Boom! A demon claw big enough to screen the sun extended out from above the clouds, covering an area of tens of kilometers. Beneath the claw, space collapsed, laws disintegrated, shaking space-time.
Under its horrendous might, hundreds of thousands of different races covered below instantly turned into blood mist, along with tens of thousands of Mechas charging with Number One, all disintegrated into fragments.
Even the two Demon Kings entangled with Number One felt a sudden weight and their massive bodies plummeted from the sky, smashing the Earth, pinned down by the heavy and dreadful force.
The sudden turn of events shook everyone’s hearts and minds.
Especially on the Human side, those kings who knew of the True Martial Heavenly King were all shocked; they had not anticipated that The Purgatory Family still had a Demon God Level powerhouse lurking.
As for the Demon Kings of The Purgatory Family, their faces revealed ferocious delight, as the addition of a Demon God Level powerhouse on the battlefield meant crushing all opposition.
But just as those Demon Kings’ faces began to twist with malevolence, near the Human’s Heavenly Abyss City, behind them, an almost Demon God Level pressure erupted, followed immediately by a giant stele inscribed with the words ‘True Martial,’ radiating suppressive might over space-time, descending from the sky.
Boom!
The True Martial Divine Tablet collided with the Destruction Demon Claw, and under the instant burst of terrifying power, a black hole hundreds of kilometers wide appeared in the sky, with a wild Spatial Storm sweeping across high and low for hundreds of kilometers.
Everything in its path was shredded by spatial fragments, countless corpses of different races, and fragments of Mechas mixed with rock and dirt, shot into the sky, devoured by the self-repairing black hole above.
At the same time, as the two Demon God Level powers clashed, the balance of the battlefield rules maintained by Sky-based Divine King and Diorus broke down, causing disorder in the laws of Heaven and Earth, making the world quake.
After shattering the Destruction Demon Claw with a single strike, the giant tablet shrunk to ten meters high, an ancient stone stele which was then held in the left hand of a dignified middle-aged man.
Meanwhile, in the heavens, demon gas roiled, morphing into an ocean of darkness that veiled the Firmament, upon which stood an immense figure shrouded in billowing black fog, displaying only huge dark red eyes that exuded a soul-terrifying aura of terror.
With the arrival of this Demon God and the appearance of the True Martial Heavenly King, wielding an intrinsic weapon comparable to the Supreme, both sides realized their schemes had failed.
Nevertheless, failure was but failure; in the end, it was still a question of power.
Without any wasted words, in an instant, four Demon God Level powerhouses engaged in an Area of Destruction tens of thousands of kilometers above, and as the God-level Rule Powers exploded, the entire world seemed on the verge of collapse.
That invisible, terrifying force, as it dispersed, threw the laws of heaven and earth into chaos, the magnetic field into frenzy, making countless cultivators’ hearts throb with unease, and leaving Demon Kings gasping for air even from tens of thousands of kilometers away.
It’s been some time since a supreme Demon God Level battle had erupted.
In that moment, it wasn’t just the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield that was affected; on the other side, separated by the forbidden area and thousands of kilometers away at the Sky Curtain Battlefield, pairs of eyes were also turned toward this direction.
Apart from this, in the Outer Development Department, the Elder who once spoke with the silver-haired youth, King Cyril, also frowned slightly, slowly rising to his feet and looking into the distance, “Has it come to blows so soon?”

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 393 Devouring the Demon King, the True Body of Thunderflame Descends Once Again (Major Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 923: Chapter 393 Devouring the Demon King, the True Body of Thunderflame Descends Once Again (Major Chapter)_3
…
True Martial Heavenly King and Carthius’s appearance, although unexpected for both sides, allowed the balance of power to be barely restored.
However, due to the rule disturbance created by the two Demon God Level Powerhouses, the suppression by the Rules originally set by the Sky-based God King and Diorus also vanished, causing the gaze of the kings and demon kings on both sides to shift subtly.
Boom!!
Suddenly, a sword light stretching a kilometer long descended from the sky and fell tens of kilometers away behind the Purgatory Family’s position, causing the loss of tens of thousands of soldiers in an army with one stroke.
But at the same time, a Demon Dragon pierced through Heaven and Earth, collapsing a mountain peak behind the Human Race’s position, blasting numerous cannons and cultivators into the air.
...
“All regular soldiers, retreat from the front lines.”
“Retreat.” Immediately, the kings from both sides subconsciously ordered their armies to retreat.
Unrestrained King-level strong men were extremely terrifying, as powerful as the legendary deities. With a wave of their hands, mountains crumbled, and the Void shattered.
Roar! At that moment, Number One, still behind the Purgatory Family’s line, let out a ferocious roar. Most of its armor shattered, revealing its dark gold skin, as a Terrifying Aura that made all beings tremble filled the air.
“Warning, Synchronization Rate exceeds one hundred percent, reaching one hundred and one, one hundred and fifteen percent…”
“Warning, sixty percent of Number One’s binding armor has been released. Warning, Number One will enter Destruction Form…”
As most of the binding armor was shed, Number One’s size ballooned, and in the blink of an eye, it had grown to three hundred meters tall, resembling a monster that was both human and beast in dark gold.
Space itself was continuously shattering around this monster, and the Earth silently sank, forming a crater over a thousand meters in diameter, unable to support its presence.
Boom, boom!!
Light flashed in Number One’s eyes as two dazzling blue and white light beams burst forth instantaneously, leveling mountain peaks, exploding the Earth, and reducing countless retreating beings from different races into blood mist amidst their screams.
As for the two Demon Kings, at the Mid-Mythical Stage and late-Mythical Stage, they were directly blown away by the Super God Energy Beam, unable to withstand the horrid impact head-on.
At this moment, a blood light around Number One emitted a powerful suction force, devouring the blood and invisible Soul Power of numerous shattered different races along with the flesh, consuming a large part of the Purgatory Family’s army.
As it absorbed more Senior flesh and life, Number One grew bigger, and the Aura it emitted became even more terrifying.
“Stop that Biological Mecha.”
Seeing that the two Demon Kings couldn’t stop Number One, three powerful Demon Kings descended from the sky, immediately relieving the Human Kings above.
But just as the Three Demon Kings appeared, a giant dark gold hand tore through space, expanding dozens of times to grab one of the demon kings, and retracted in an instant.
The Demon King seized by Number One shrank along with the hand. The originally three hundred meters tall Demon King’s True Form also reduced to a little over ten meters, as if space itself had terrifyingly contracted.
And what was more terrifying was that the monster began to open its large jaw, revealing fanged teeth and a dark gaping mouth, biting down towards it.
“Me!”
The Demon King, sensing the smell of death, shouted in hysteria. Its Origin power burst forth, trying to enter an Awakened State and break free, but it despaired to find that it couldn’t shake the huge hand that grasped it.
Boom, boom, boom!! The Spatial Barrier around Number One vibrated, exploding into layers of golden diamond-shaped halos, blocking the assault of the Four Demon Kings, unshakable.
Crack!
With one bite from Number One, the upper half of the early-Mythical Stage Demon King was severed, its Aura halved in an instant, as if it had been completely Devoured by the other side.
This scene enraged the four Demon Kings assaulting Number One, with shock at the monster actually being able to directly devour their Demon King’s True Form, erasing the Demon Soul and Laws’ Origin.
Rage, because their great Purgatory True Demon kings had, to their disbelief, become food in someone else’s mouth, unforgivable.
Right when Number One had swallowed a Demon King in two gulps, its Aura surged and became even more fierce and terrifying, a Blood Moon emerged in the sky and crashed down fiercely.
This marked the fall of the second Demon King from the Purgatory Family on this day, causing the Four Great Demon Kings fighting at a distance to be furiously enraged.
Boom! A large section of the sky shattered, a terrifying power cutting through Heaven and Earth. In an instant, Demon God Divine Might once again filled Heaven and Earth.
Under the dreadful power, the Spatial Barrier around Number One cracked like golden glass and was directly blasted into the Earth. In an instant, heaven and earth split, and the sky filled with dirt and stones, which soared like a Tsunami.
The Earth further split into cracks stretching for tens to hundreds of kilometers, the violent impacts raising a sandstorm over a thousand meters high sweeping across hundreds of kilometers.
At the center of the violent sandstorm, an enormous handprint formed a deep crater a kilometer wide.
Just then, a roar of rage and a terrifying shake came from the sky. Carthius had struck the Earth, and at that moment, a monumental stele, towering tens of thousands of feet high, also brutally fell on it.
Under the Full-Force Strike of the True Martial Heavenly King, half of Carthius’s rule body, robust with terrifying energy, was cracked, spewing out Black Gold blood.
And this blood, just as it sprayed out, was erased by the rule power contained in the True Martial Stone Tablet.
“Human Race True Martial!” Carthius roared in pain, strength Burst forth shaking off the True Martial Stone Tablet, and once again clashed with True Martial Heavenly King.
But compared to the earlier berserk state, Carthius, having had some of its Essence Blood erased, now appeared somewhat weakened.

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 393 Devouring the Demon King, The Return of the Thunderflame True Body (Major Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 924: Chapter 393 Devouring the Demon King, The Return of the Thunderflame True Body (Major Chapter)_4
Both the True Martial Heavenly King and the Sky-based God King were well aware of the ‘strength’ of Number One, which is why they didn’t stop Carthius from taking action just now.
As Number One, burdened with the great hopes of the Simon Empire, if it couldn’t even withstand a strike from a Demon God Level Powerhouse, it wouldn’t be worth their significant attention.
As for the pilot Freya Louise, she seemed to be inside Number One, but in reality, she didn’t exist in this space at all.
Roar!
From within a kilometer-deep palm imprint, the mutilated monster let out a fierce roar, its whole body boiling with Blood Qi.
At this moment, Number One’s left arm had shattered, half of its skull was blown away, and flesh and blood were torn apart all over its body. Yet the invisible aura it exuded was even more terrifying. Besides some remaining armor on its chest and back, it was utterly unrestrained.
...
Number One lay on the ground with three limbs, staring fixedly with its remaining blue and white eye at the demon king tens of kilometers away, silently exuding a brutal intensity that even made that demon king instinctively shudder.
“Monster!”
Just as the demon king screamed in terror, the space in front of it shattered, and a broken figure burst forth, its massive right claw akin to a demon claw from Hell.
Boom! The Mid-Mythical Stage demon king’s surrounding laws disintegrated, its domain exploded, and the space around it shrank, grabbed by Number One in one motion.
Thump! Number One bit down, shattering the sealed space along with it, biting off the three heads and four arms of the demon king.
Suddenly, black and red blood imbued with the Charm of the Laws sprayed out like a high-pressure water jet, turning the upper half of Number One a dark red, making it look even more fierce and horrific.
Looking at the aura growing more ferocious and the dark golden monster’s flesh regenerating all over its body, a severe shout suddenly came from the sky.
“Something is wrong with the creature inside the Biological Mecha, Ballo and the others go down and restrain it together, wait for Prince Carthius and them to make a move.”
Boom Boom Boom!! As Number One was digesting the demon king, the Earth within a ten-kilometer radius fractured, and eight rumbling Demon Pillars rose from the ground, emitting dense auras.
As eight Demon Kings worked together to suppress Number One with the Purgatory Family’s Inheritance Demon Array, the pressure on the Human Race’s side lightened, and they even found the strength to start pushing back.
Compared to the central battlefield where the fight was earth-shattering, the pressure on the third battlefield was light, with Bruce Lancaster and the injured Moss jointly suppressing the remaining demon king, gaining the upper hand.
As for Jack Clark, he was lying in the crater he had made, “weak to the point of death”, his aura so feeble it felt like any Seventh Layer Heaven cultivator could kill him.
Of course, most of this weakness was a disguise, intended to confuse the two Demon Gods above.
Demon God Level Powerhouses were too terrifying, every move and gesture felt like they could blow up the world, beyond what he, a Ninth Heaven Cultivator, could provoke.
However, that Summoning he had performed just now did indeed consume a terrifying amount of energy.
Although the summon channel existed only briefly, the energy traversed was so powerful that, even under the balanced rules of Space-Time, it still drained one-fifth of his Spirit Qi.
This meant that Jack Clark could theoretically unleash such an attack five times in succession.
Of course, this was only hypothetical, as the Thunderflame Demon Dragon couldn’t withstand five such attacks at once either; its consumption of Law Power was staggering.
To infuse three types of Law Power into the dorsal fin spikes cost at least three times the energy loss by dispersion alone, totaling around one-fifth of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s Law Power.
Only with such an enormous amount of Law Power could it grind away a Demon King’s True Body and obliterate its Demon Soul within a short period.
This is the terrifying nature of Demon King level creatures, with formidable Vitality. Even with absolute overpowering strength, they were extremely difficult to kill, causing tremendous exhaustion.
Just as Jack Clark was lying weak on the ground, feeling the Terrifying Aura of the supreme battle above him, a commanding voice suddenly rang out once again.
“Barus, no more holding back, slay that human for me; he must die today, and there will be compensation afterward.”
Seeing that even a strike from a Demon God only severely injured Number One without killing it, and knowing there was no chance for action, Diorus set his sights on Jack Clark.
This human’s talent was monstrous; aside from his own remarkable talent, capable of battling an ordinary demon king in the early stages of his Nine Demonic Marks, he also possessed a Summoning Secret Skill capable of slaughtering a mid-stage demon king.
Today, the Mythical-level powerhouses that died by his hand had reached two, plus the two Demon Kings devoured by Number One, which enraged Diorus greatly, blaming everything on him.
Now, because of the weakness after the second summoning, it was the perfect opportunity to kill him.
Faced with Diorus’s command, Great Demon King Barus showed a hint of hesitation.
Since it did not belong to Diorus’s empire and had come only to provide support, it had been holding back to avoid getting injured.
But after a brief hesitation, Barus’s eyes turned cold; the current situation no longer allowed it to hold back, or else it would be hard to explain upon returning.
“Scatter!” With a ferocious roar, Barus’s Aura suddenly surged several times over. Dazzling purple demon light burst from its body, and its figure swelled massively.
In the blink of an eye, a horrific creature appeared, a kilometer tall with three heads and eight arms, entirely covered in purple armor, with eighteen Demon Horns forming a crown on its head.
Awakened Barus, surrounded by tangible purple light bands encompassing a ten-kilometer range, rendered everything it passed, including the space itself, purple.
Boom! With a slight movement in its Awakened State, it seemed as though the whole world shook. With a swing of its eight arms, indescribable Power erupted violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 393 Devouring the Demon King, The Return of the Thunderflame True Body (Major Chapter)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 925: Chapter 393 Devouring the Demon King, The Return of the Thunderflame True Body (Major Chapter)_5
Boom! The Gentry Gail and the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox, who had held on for so long, were sent flying by the entire space, spewing blood as they, along with the space itself, were smashed and hurled into the Void.
Even at the Mythical Peak, they were still mere myths when faced with the Great Demon King, not to mention the Great Demon King who had burst forth his Origin Power and entered an Awakened State.
Just then, an urgent voice from Gentry Gail echoed from the Void, “Eight-tails, stop him!”
Bang, bang, bang! The space shattered like a mirror, and eight thousand-meter-long white tails pierced through the Void.
“Seeking death!” Barus’s eyes flared with ferocity as he watched the white fox tails, which spanned across heaven and earth, emitting White Divine Light and churning with the Power of Heaven and Earth.
...
Boom, boom, boom! The white fox tails, existing between illusion and reality, clashed with Barus’s eight arms hundreds of times in an instant, after which a fierce expression appeared on Barus’s face.
Under the erosion of purple light, space suddenly solidified, and two huge palms slammed down, grabbing two white fox tails, “Come out for your king.”
Boom! Just as Barus attempted to pull the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox from the depths of the Void, the two white tails in his hands exploded violently. The white shockwave swept across tens of kilometers in an instant, shaking the heaven and earth.
The explosion of the two tails of a Mythical Peak Giant Beast was utterly terrifying, causing even Barus to be pushed back two steps, his surrounding purple Laws’ World trembling.
Meanwhile, some distance away where the beleaguered Gentry Gail and a weakly breathing Six-tailed Heavenly Fox reappeared, they shouted loudly towards those who were suppressing the demon king from afar, Bruce Lancaster and another.
“I will stop him; you quickly take him away.”
“Today, you will all die.”
No sooner had Gentry Gail finished speaking than the Demon King, suppressed by the Human Kings, went mad. Endless Dark Demon Air burst forth, and hundreds of meters-long Demon Dragons roared into existence.
Roar, roar, roar! In an instant, the air between heaven and earth was filled with the ferocious roars of Demon Dragons, as rolling demon gas engulfed half the sky.
Seeing Barus using his Origin Power to sweep through everything, that Demon King, disregarding the damage to his foundation, exploded with sixty percent of his Laws’ Origin, transforming into dozens of Demon Dragons to entangle Bruce Lancaster and his fellow king.
The battle today was beyond what any king or demon king had expected; none of the ‘People’ imagined it would be so harrowing, and battles to the death began so soon into the war.
Meanwhile, as Gentry Gail shouted that he would stop Barus, he transformed into a beam of white Law Radiance and lunged forward under the somewhat helpless and conflicted gaze of the Six-tailed Heavenly Fox.
Because of the speed of his movement, Jack Clark, feigning death on the ground, couldn’t even open his mouth in time.
Boom!
The moment Gentry Gail merged with the Six-tailed Heavenly Fox, an instantaneously terrifying Aura that truly rivaled that of a Heavenly King burst forth. The boundless white Divine Light illuminated heaven and earth, making even Barus’s gaze firm up.
Unlike the source of all Radiance feeling emanated by Gabriel, the white light released by Gentry Gail at that moment was filled with sharpness and an overbearing sense.
The endless White Light laid out across the Firmament, and from within its glow, a figure a thousand meters tall, with eight white fox tails—two of which were translucent—slowly emerged.
It was unmistakably Gentry Gail… no, rather, it should be said to be the Heavenly Fox.
The Heavenly Fox, emitting a Heavenly King’s Divine Might, slowly spoke, his voice low with a resonating dual tone, “Barus, let’s continue our fight.”
Upon seeing the towering Heavenly Fox before him, Barus revealed a cold light in his eyes, “Is it worth it for a genius with Nine Demonic Marks?”
“To deplete your Origin as a price for merging with your beast companion to break your limits, this state of yours consumes ten times more Origin every moment than your king. How long do you think you can last?”
Barus’s words were meant to strike at the heart and stall for time, while also revealing some genuine incomprehension.
For the Purgatory Demon Race, who revered strength above all else, only one’s own power constituted true strength.
While they did possess a collective sense of honor as Purgatory True Demons due to cultural heritage, the idea of a Great Demon King expending his own Origin for the sake of a nine demonic marks member of the demon race was utterly abhorrent to him.
Even if the latter were a descendant of a Demon God.
The Gentry Gail Heavenly Fox maintained a calm demeanor, his voice soaked with the pressure of a Heavenly King, resonating between heaven and earth, “For us humans, it’s not about whether it’s worth it. It’s about willingness. I like that boy, so I am determined to save him today.”
“If that’s the case, then go to your death.” Sensing the repressed power about to explode from the Gentry Gail Heavenly Fox, Barus too showed a ferocious and fierce expression on his face.
And just as the two strong men were about to make their move, Jack Clark’s voice suddenly came from below.
“Gail Hills Throne, hold on for a moment. I feel I can take another shot.”
Jack’s voice was not loud, but it echoed over hundreds of kilometers, and naturally, the Gentry Gail Heavenly Fox and Barus high above could hear it too. They couldn’t help but pause subconsciously.
Because the voice was full of aura, it did not seem weak at all.
Far away, the demon king who had been furiously trapping Bruce Lancaster and Moss, two human kings, was startled and involuntarily looked down.
There, on the ground, the face of the dying Jack Clark also showed a helpless expression. Come on, I was ready to lay low and wait for everyone to forget about me before making another move.
Why bother?
Boom!
Jack’s aura surged, instantly restoring him to his peak condition, while the gloomy blue runes on the back of his left hand shone, turning into a kilometer-wide blue rune array spread across the ground.
Unlike the previous two Summoning Altars for the Sky-based Strikes, this summoning altar laid flat on the earth, resembling an incredibly intricate rune.
Watching the tiny figure standing in the middle of the rune array below, Barus’s eyes were filled with cold murderous intent. This human was indeed cunning, pretending to be weak all this time.
But it didn’t matter.
Whether it was the breath close to the Mythical Peak, or the attack powered by a rule explosion comparable to the Mythical Peak, none of it mattered to him in his Awakened State.
Roar!
As the dazzling gloomy blue Radiance flickered, the space distorted, and reality inverted, a thick, massive black-red claw emerged behind Jack Clark, smashing down onto the Earth with a thunderous crash.
Under the watch of the three Human Kings, the demon king, and the Great Demon King, a black-red Colossal Beast, over seven hundred meters in length and covered in heavy, sharp scale armor, stood up behind Jack.
In an instant, a Terrifying Aura that was indescribable diffused.
Although this Mythical Giant Beast’s growth realm was not even mid-Mythical Stage, even the Great Demon King Barus felt an inexplicable palpitation.
This Mythical Giant Beast was very strong!!

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 394 Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast that Exploded the Battlefield
chapters.content:
Chapter 926: Chapter 394 Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast that Exploded the Battlefield
Just when the demon king and the king-level warriors were shocked by the fearsome aura invisibly emanating from the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, Jack Clark’s face instantly turned pale as the Giant Beast descended.
The energy and Spirit Qi in his body were instantly depleted by fifty percent, as if wiped away by some unknown rule.
At the same time, for every second the Thunderflame Demon Dragon existed in this space-time, the energy and Soul Power inside him rapidly drained away, and he could only hold on for a maximum of three minutes before he had to stop, or he would be completely drained.
He never thought that after such a long time, he would once again become a “three-minute man.”
Indeed, forcibly reversing space-time with the cultivation of the early Ninth Heavens to summon a Thunderflame Demon Dragon, whose normal battle strength was comparable to the Mythical Peak, was still too strenuous.
This was also why Jack Clark developed the Sky-based Summoning and Sky-based Strike techniques because he had a premonition early on.
...
Being able to last three minutes now is due to his terrifyingly strong physical body, having already transformed into the body of an Innate Demon God; otherwise, a normal early Ninth Heavens cultivator would be instantly drained and die.
The power involving time causality won’t show mercy; once it is triggered, a corresponding price must be paid.
As for Gentry Gail, when he originally devised this secret skill, it was just for convenience.
Being of Mythical-level himself, summoning another Mythical Giant Beast like the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox could last a very long time, and after the fight, the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox could still go back to sleep.
He never imagined that someone could perfect the secret method practice to the ultimate state at the Ninth Heavens, reaching a realm that took him, the creator, decades to achieve.
Whoosh! The fierce black-red Colossal Beast exhaled a scorching breath, its cold golden vertical pupils looking up at the sky along with Jack Clark.
The moment the gaze of the Giant Beast landed on the Triangle Demon King, that king who had expended sixty percent of his Origin and looked very formidable while suppressing two Human Kings, instinctively shrank back a little.
Fortunately, the terrifying Giant Beast only glanced at it for a moment before its vicious gaze turned toward the distant Great Demon King Barus, who was locked in combat with Gail Hills Heavenly Fox.
“The Great Demon King, huh!” Jack Clark’s eyes shone with fervent Battle Intent.
Originally, his plan for this great battle was just to sweep through the Transcendent wars, not get involved with Demon King level to avoid attracting the attention of even higher-order master of the battlefield, the Demon Gods.
But now that both sides have fought to this extent, and he’s already caught the attention of the Demon Gods, he might as well go all out.
Roar!
The black-red Colossal Beast standing within the altar let out a brutally ferocious roar, with black and red lightning illuminating its body. Instantly, an even more terrifying aura burst forth.
How is it possible for it to become even stronger? In an instant, both the Demon King and Great Demon King Barus were astonished, instinctively glancing down below.
Boom!
Amidst the dazzling display of black and red lightning, a two-thousand-meter-long Deep Red Giant Beast appeared.
A terrifying energy emanated from the Deep Red Giant Beast, shattering the stable space around it, with the Earth within hundreds of kilometers trembling as if it couldn’t support the beast’s presence.
Facing the Grand Demon King Level adversary, Jack Clark did not dare to be careless and directly entered the Giant Beast’s strongest form, the Deep Red Form.
But as the Giant Beast’s strength exploded once again, Jack Clark suddenly lay on the ground, weak and powerless. This time he was truly overwhelmed by weakness.
“So, I’ve reached my limit.” Jack gasped for air weakly, sending forth a mental command, he took out a golden jade bottle from the Sumeru Bracelet.
Through the semi-transparent bottle, one could see a pure jade-colored liquid floating inside, its internal power spreading out to form a continually rotating vortex.
This was a Divine Object, comparable to Law-level resources, the Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, capable of restoring the injuries of a King-level strong man in a short time, including those to the soul that did not endanger the Origin.
Before setting out, Gabriel had given Jack Clark two extra portions.
For those at the Nine Layers Boundary, a single drop of this invaluable Law Level Divine Object could completely heal all injuries, including those close to death. This showed how highly the Federation valued him.
If not for the dangers of this great battle, the Federation would not willingly part with such treasures, typically reserved for the powerful kings on perilous missions.
Compared to The Purgatory Family, the Human Federation lacks various resources, but at the same time, there are plenty for some individuals, since there are only so many genius talents to nurture and support.
Now, using such a precious object, which could instantly heal grave injuries, as a resource to recover physical strength is somewhat extravagant.
Boom!
As he swallowed a drop of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, an energy containing the cycles of time exploded within Jack Clark’s body. An invisible force of rotation enveloped him, and the depleted Spirit Qi Blood and even Soul Power were instantly restored to their original state.
“As expected of a Divine Artifact containing a complete Law Power.” Amidst his astonishment, Jack Clark looked back at the terrifying Giant Beast behind him that was like a mountain.
This time, using his Giantification Talent, the body of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon had only grown about twice its size, exceeding the standard Titan’s fifteen hundred meters, and its physical strength was comparable to ordinary Titan Level beasts.
But the Law Power it controlled was still at Mythical-level.
The Destruction Law, Vajra Law that he could initially merge with upon his early breakthrough into Myth were no longer plausible to combine, because the current Thunderflame Demon Dragon was too powerful.
Three Higher-order Laws, six Top-tier powers, and a Mythical True Body that was dozens of times stronger than Mythical Giant Beasts of the same level made it too mighty.
As a result, the Top Tier Talent of Gigantification could no longer merge with all the powers and achieve the ultimate Deep Red Form unless the Giantification Talent elevated to the level of a Law.
“It’s still not enough!” Jack Clark said solemnly, looking up at the fearsome Barus dominating the distant sky with his demon power.

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 394 Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast That Exploded the Battlefield_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 927: Chapter 394 Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast That Exploded the Battlefield_2
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon is barely stepping into Titan Level, capable of contending with the Great Demon King, but it’s very difficult to defeat or even kill an early-stage Great Demon King.
So…! Jack Clark took a step forward, and his figure instantly disappeared, reappearing atop the heavy red scale armor.
Since initially freeing the Heavy Armored Beast into the river, Jack had never touched his Avatar again. The moment he stood on the head of the Red Beast, a feeling of completion naturally rose within him.
His soul resonated with the soul of the Giant Beast, and his Soul Talent, already strengthened to Godlike Level, was pulsating.
They were originally one entity, belonging to a single complete existence. As long as they could fuse, they would enter a Godlike Form and become an even more terrifying life form.
Fuse, fuse… Jack’s bifurcated consciousness forcibly suppressed the impulse to merge, leading the resonance between the soul of his true body and the soul of the Giant Beast Avatar.
...
Whoosh! In the indescribable depths of the soul dimension, a towering figure clad in black Imperial Robes, holding the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, emerged.
Meanwhile, on the other side of the dimension, the soul of a Giant Beast as vast as a mountain, engulfed in white flames, also appeared, and both subconsciously reached out their right hand and right claw.
Roar! Under the resonance of their souls, a force deep within the Giant Beast and Jack began to stir, and in an instant, the body of the Red Beast radiated a dazzling red light shimmer.
Boom! A breath of utter destruction surged to the heavens, shaking Heaven and Earth, its terrifying presence even causing the four Demon God Level beings, fighting in the distant Firmament, to glance over.
The closest Triangle Demon King and Barus looked on with horror.
Amidst the endless red radiance below, a bipedal beast rose to a kilometer in height with a body spanning over two thousand four hundred meters, its entire body covered in blood-red, sharp, heavy scale armor.
Dark red mixed with dark purple lightning, akin to Chaos, wrapped around this Crimson Heavy Armored Giant Beast, shattering everything in its surroundings.
Even the strength was so overpowering that the shadow of a world filled with endless red faintly emerged behind the Deep Red Giant Beast.
Within that boundless Deep Red World, even more terrifying shadows of Deep Red Giant Beasts flitted by, causing beings like Gail Hills Heavenly Fox to shudder.
That was a world of pure destruction, those crimson shadows were the manifestations of annihilation.
At this moment, Jack’s consciousness and the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s thoughts were unified, their soul breath as one, giving them a sensation of unparalleled strength, enough to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Boom! Massive chunks of space shattered, the Earth directly formed a pit kilometers in diameter, and the Deep Red Giant Beast with its terrifying aura vanished from its original position in an instant.
Not good!
The instant the Deep Red Giant Beast disappeared, the Triangle Demon King felt an intense sense of crisis, the premonition of death overwhelmingly strong.
Boom! Far off, in a space tens of kilometers away that had collapsed, the vanished Deep Red Beast reappeared, standing atop a Space-Time Summoning Altar radiating gloomy blue light.
In just an instant, it had bridged a distance of hundreds of kilometers, its speed horrifyingly fast at this moment.
Yet the Destruction-breathed Beast paid no mind to them; its target was Barus, who was still suppressing Gail Hills Heavenly Fox hundreds of kilometers away.
But just when the Triangle Demon King was slightly relieved, a red tail wrapped in Chaotic Lightning slashed through the Void.
“It’s impossible to kill this king!” roared the Triangle Demon King.
Boom!
The Crimson Tail Blade cut through Heaven and Earth, instantly slashing across the body of the Triangle Demon King, surrounded by a hundred Demon Dragons, leaving a dark crack in the high altitude tens of kilometers long.
Thud!
With that terrible strike, the True Body of the Triangle Demon King exploded, space shattered, and the force of the blow even hurled Bruce Lancaster and Moss, two Human Kings, tens of kilometers away.
However, just then, Black Demonic Qi surged in the distance, and Law Power converged, allowing the Triangle to re-emerge after proactively blowing up his Demon King’s True Form, his aura weakened and his face looking grim.
Having previously released six-tenths of his Origin power and boosting his strength by more than tenfold to suppress the two kings, now having part of his True Body eradicated by a slash from the Deep Red Giant Beast, he retained merely a tenth of his original power.
No, I must leave, or else I might die here today. In terror, the Triangle Demon King turned and transformed into a black Light Beam, shooting explosively into the distance.
“Kudone, today, you will stay behind.”
Boom, boom!!
Golden chains roared like Divine Dragons, piercing through the Void and entangling the black demonic light, soon followed by the figure of Moss, rising to a kilometer in height, once again transforming into the Black Violent Ape King.
Both kings, of course, wouldn’t let go of this Demon King whose aura was weakened to the limit.
As Human Kings, killing a Demon King would still yield considerable benefits.
After the Tail Blade wounded the Demon King, the Deep Red Giant Beast made no further moves, continuing to shatter space as it headed towards the high-altitude battlefield, leaving the victory to the two kings.
At this moment, the surrounding space no longer appeared as a three-dimensional plane to the Deep Red Giant Beast’s senses but as a twisted, folded shape, able to emerge from any corner, appearing tens or hundreds of kilometers away.
This is the perspective of Heavenly King Level power; they have evolved to the perfection of World’s Power, able to assimilate everything around them, including affecting the surrounding space.
That’s why they can instantaneously become the rules and vanish.
They don’t disappear; they directly fold space to jump to another location.
“Roar! Barus, don’t you want to kill me? Come on then, let’s fight today until one of us perishes.”
The roar that shook the Void contained Jack’s overlapping voice, the Destruction-breathed Deep Red Heavy Armored Giant Beast appeared, boldly lunging at Barus, standing amidst the purple ‘world’, the Great Demon King Barus.

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 394: Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast that Exploded the Battlefield_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 928: Chapter 394: Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast that Exploded the Battlefield_3
Wrapped around the Deep Red Giant Beast’s double claws was Chaotic Lightning capable of destroying everything, shattering the Void, turning the purple space it crossed into ruin, unstoppable, absolutely unstoppable.
“Human, you are seeking death,” Barus roared, his arms wielding a long spear wrapped with purple Law Divine Light that converged the power of a One-side World, thrusting toward Jack Clark on the giant beast’s head.
Where the long spear passed, Heavenly Earth Law disintegrated, space vanished, terrifying to the extreme.
Facing the summoned giant beast creature, Barus naturally knew to capture the thief first, capture the king.
At the same time, Barus’s remaining six arms were forming Demon Seals, with blood-red mountain peaks wrapping around each, shaking Heaven and Earth, and Law illusions were smashing toward the Giant Beast.
“Don’t forget about me, Barus.”
...
In the cold voice, white fox tails that lay between illusion and reality, seeming to be from another Space-Time, appeared with white Divine Light entwining and shaking the Void.
Barus’s all-destructive offense was blocked by a single claw of the Deep Red Giant Beast, unable to shake that massive claw in the slightest, while the six arms forming Demon Seals were stopped by the Gail Hills Heavenly Fox.
Boom! In an instant, a terrifying energy impact exploded high in the sky, the surrounding space broke on a large scale, revealing a deep, dark, and violent Void.
Under the terrible impact force, both the Gail Hills Heavenly Fox and Barus couldn’t help but retreat, but only the formidable Deep Red Giant Beast stood tall in the Void, stately as a divine mountain that could not be shaken.
In the midst of the violent Void torrent, the Deep Red Giant Beast glanced at its right claw, unscathed except for a faint mark of a spear tip, before it slowly emitted a deep, overlapping roar.
“Is this the Great Demon King? How insignificant.”
In an instant, a look of shock and rage appeared on Barus’s face, feeling as though he had been insulted by an ant.
“Senior Gail Hills, let me handle this here.”
Boom! As the voice fell, endless golden flames gathered in the claws of the Deep Red Heavy Armor Giant Beast, forming a golden Great Sun with a diameter of 500 meters in the blink of an eye, emitting a blindingly extreme radiance.
This was the Heaven Burning Golden Flame talent ability, Extreme Flame Explosion.
But now, in the claws of the ‘Titan Level’ Deep Red Heavy Armor Giant Beast, the compressed thousands-fold power of the Heaven Burning Golden Flame astonished even the kings.
Under the extreme high temperature, everything around was annihilated, creating a twisted black Great Sun that shook the Void.
Boom! The Deep Red Giant Beast surged forward, instantly crossing tens of kilometers to appear in front of Barus, its claws holding the Chaotic Lightning-entwined golden Great Sun, slamming it down.
Boom!
An endless burst of scorching energy erupted, as if a real Great Sun appeared in the Void, mixed with terrifying Chaotic Lightning directly shattering the Law World of tens of kilometers around Barus.
Roar!
In the midst of the violent destructive explosion, a Tail Blade wrapped in Chaotic Lightning cut across the Void, severing the purple long spear and leaving behind a long, persistent Black Scar.
Boom!! At the moment the Tail Blade severed Barus’s magic spear, the Deep Red Giant Beast’s massive double claws reached out, ignoring the sharp and violent energy impact, grabbing Barus by the double shoulders.
In an instant, Barus’s face drastically changed, and as he stared at the ferocious gaping mouth biting towards him, his eyes flashed with a ruthless light, his arms emitting a blinding purple radiance.
Boom!!
The Great Demon King self-destructing part of his True Body was immensely terrifying, just like the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox exploding its two tails earlier, directly repelling the Deep Red Giant Beast several kilometers away, staggering two steps back.
And Barus, in the backlash of the explosive impact, was sent flying, appearing hundreds of kilometers away as a purple radiance.
