At this moment, his aura suddenly weakened by twenty percent, his face extremely ugly, having not expected to break both arms and get severely injured after just exchanging a few moves with the Deep Red Giant Beast.
Then, between Barus’s arms, purple Law flowed, Divine Light flickered, and his arms grew back at a visible rate to the naked eye, restored to their original state in a blink of an eye.
Seeing this scene, not only did the Gail Hills Heavenly Fox look shocked, but even distant kings’ battlefields and the top Demon God Level battlefields all glanced over.
Especially those two Demon God Level beings, who wore expressions of cold and solemn depths.
All the strong men couldn’t understand how Jack, who was only in the early stages of the Ninth Heavens, could explode with such terrifying combat power.
Even if he had cultivated the Space-Time Summoning Technique, even if he had cultivated to the extreme, he should not have been able to withstand such a strong consumption.
And that Giant Beast, clearly when summoned its realm was only close to the Mid-Mythical Stage, yet it possessed the talent to Gigantify and merge Law Power, directly crossing a major level.
Also, its terrorizing Defense, although its aura was only slightly stronger than Barus’s, relied on that defense that ignores all attacks to directly crush Barus.
However, at this moment, Jack Clark on the massive head of the Deep Red Giant Beast suddenly weakened, his entire body swayed and he nearly fell down.
Bearing such a terrifying and formidable Giant Beast, and fully Bursting with expenditure, the burden was still too great for him.
As for the power triggered by the resonance of their souls, it only helped the Thunderflame Demon Dragon break through the limit and complete the extreme Gigantification, once again transforming into the Deep Red Giant Beast.
Jack Clark’s sudden change in aura made Barus rejoice, because it was clear that Jack really couldn’t hold on anymore.
It said it didn’t feel right, how could there be a situation so against the norms of rules? Indeed, the human had reached his limit, otherwise, it would have begun to doubt the essence of demons today.
Including the other Demon Kings and Demon Gods, their eyes also revealed a trace of relief, clearly the balance rule of the Vast World still existed.
But just then, Jack Clark once again took out a golden jade bottle, bit the bottle directly, and swallowed the Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid within in one gulp.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 394: Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast That Exploded the Battlefield_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 929: Chapter 394: Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast That Exploded the Battlefield_4
Buzz!
Under the reversal of reincarnation, Jack Clark’s Spirit Qi instantly returned to its peak, and the aura from the deep red Giant Beast he was mounted on surged once again.
Barus roared in anger, “How is this possible, how is this possible, how could he possess Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid while being from the Ninth Heavens? Have you humans gone mad?”
“Hahaha… What’s so impossible about that? This is how our Human Race cultivates our younger generation.” Amidst his laughter, Gail Hills Heavenly Fox flipped his hand and took out two Vajra Jade Bottles containing Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid.
As a Mythical Peak strong man, he of course had some, and including the portion he gave to the Eight-Tailed Heavenly Fox, he personally possessed two bottles.
“Jack, catch.”
...
At this point, it was impossible to hide Jack Clark’s name. Gail Hills Heavenly Fox no longer cared about not shouting the real name, and as he spoke, a white Radiance enveloping two drops of the heavenly liquid was thrown to Jack.
Then, in the white Divine Light, Gail Hills Heavenly Fox and the Six-tailed Heavenly Fox separated, and their auras plummeted, becoming extremely weak as they stood gasping for air at a high altitude.
Mere minutes of fusion had greatly exhausted Gail Hills Heavenly Fox and the Six-tailed Heavenly Fox. They felt it would take years of cultivation to recover, or they would need to consume Top-level Divine Items.
If it had not been for the sake of saving Jack, they would never have pushed themselves to such desperate straits.
Whimper! Looking at Gentry Gail at her side, the Six-tailed Heavenly Fox showed a look of disdain in its eyes and, with a slight flicker of its figure, appeared tens of kilometers away, not wanting to be close to him.
It was utterly unbearable for a male fox Giant Beast to fuse with a man.
Boom! The Void exploded, and the Deep Red Giant Beast, emitting an aura of ultimate destruction, once again lunged at Barus, its double claws wrapped in Chaotic Lightning that could crush everything.
It (He) aimed to catch this Great Demon King and devour him.
In an instant, Barus’s complexion drastically changed, and turning around he transformed into a streak of purple Radiance that spanned the sky, flying toward the distant central battlefield with a speed akin to a fleeting light.
Barus’s sudden escape caused Heavenly Kings, demon kings, and Demon Gods, including Jack, to halt abruptly.
Roar!
A ferocious growl echoed through Heaven and Earth, as streaks of cyan Light wrapped around the Deep Red Giant Beast, which, in spite of its immense size, pursued with a terrifying speed that did not match its bulk.
…
This grand battle involved three members of the Human Race, one Heavenly King, and four demon kings, including one Great Demon King, on the second battlefield to the left.
The central battlefield was the most devastating, with two Heavenly Kings and two Great Demon Kings, sixteen Human Kings, and twenty-four demon kings fighting in a battle that turned everything upside down.
Even because of the fierceness of the battle, some kings and demon kings began to self-destruct their Laws’ Origin in their desperation.
Especially in the distance, where eight demon kings were joining forces to suppress Number One, as Number One slowly reformed its body and restored its flesh and blood, the pressure on them mounted as its aura became increasingly terrifying.
With every terrifying blue and white Light Beam, the Demon Pillar Array seal surrounding them vibrated h, and with each strike, massive amounts of Dark Laws dissipated.
Boom!
At this moment, far across the sky, a horrendous explosion erupted, devastating everything within tens of kilometers. Amidst the wild explosion, a moon slowly emerged and descended gradually.
“Old King!” In an instant, more than a dozen angry roars from Human Kings filled the sky.
Due to the small number of King-level strong men and their significant disadvantage, three demon kings from the Demon Clan cornered this king named Vince Vernon, including one late-period demon king.
Although later on, because of Number One, two of the demon kings went to Suppress Number One, that king had long been heavily injured. By self-destructing his Laws’ Origin, he inflicted a heavy injury on that late-period Mythical demon king, and he himself fell permanently.
“All humans must die,” declared the demon king, standing amidst the center of the explosion, towering a kilometer tall, with three heads and eight arms, draped in menacing black armor, his face ferocious and Overbearing.
On the brow of his central head was a Blood Colored Eye, exuding a terrifyingly fierce aura, mighty and invincible.
Boom! Just then, Heaven and Earth thundered, and a massive figure descended from the sky, instantly collapsing the lower half of the mountain ranges below, shattering the Earth, and sending tremors echoing across the sky.
A radiance more powerful than a nuclear explosion dazzled, and a fearsome shockwave swept across hundreds of kilometers, creating a tremendous impact.
In front of all the shocked demon kings and Human Kings, a massive, a kilometer-tall, and over two kilometers-long, Crimson Giant Beast appeared in the sky.
Atop the giant beast’s massive and ferocious head stood a figure as tiny as a grain of dust – a human with an icy gaze fixed on the Blood Moo Demon King.
Jack Clark! Watching Jack atop the head of the Giant Beast, all the Human Kings paused.
Roar! A dazzling, terrifying light burst from the mouth of the Crimson Giant Beast, and instantly, a red Destructive Breath exploded, connecting Heaven and Earth.
Boom boom boom!! Wherever the Light Beam passed, everything was destroyed and obliterated, with rings of red halos piercing through Heaven and Earth and spanning hundreds of kilometers, appearing right in front of that demon king.
The Overbearing demon king’s face drastically changed as the Demon Domain that spanned several kilometers crumbled around him, and he dodged to the side at the very instant his arms and shoulders began to be obliterated.
Boom!
The Destructive Breath hit the ground behind The Purgatory Family, and a terrifying Destructive Glow rose from the Earth. The terrible Destructive Impact caused countless different races and elite members of The Purgatory Demon Race, who had retreated several hundred kilometers, to scream in despair.
Boom boom boom!! The Giant Beast’s head swayed, and the Light Beam chased the late-period Mythical demon king’s figure, sweeping across Heaven and Earth, destroying everything in its path this time.
Such terrifying power startled the demon kings in the sky, who hastily backed away from the Human Kings they were fighting, seeking to avoid it.
Just then, as the red Destructive Breath swept across three ten thousand meter mountain peaks, chasing that Great Demon King with a downward strike, it fell upon the Demon Array that trapped Number One.

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 394: Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast That Exploded the Battlefield_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 930: Chapter 394: Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, The Invincible Giant Beast That Exploded the Battlefield_5
Boom! Under the terrifying explosion of breath, the Demon Pillar Array instantly collapsed, followed by a fierce, terrifying roar that echoed between heaven and earth.
“Be careful!”
“Get away from that monster.”
In an instant, the eight Demon Kings split into two groups, joining forces to block the Super God Beam shot out in rage by Number One. Otherwise, if caught by it, death was certain. At the same time, they glared at the Demon King who had fallen with eyes filled with fury.
This damned guy.
...
As the eight Demon Kings blocked the rampaging Number One, Jack Clark, who had released the breath from afar, swayed, his aura weak, his face deathly pale.
“Protect Jack Clark, he can’t withstand the space-time backlash!” Overlord Dragon Heavenly King roared, noticing Jack’s weakness.
“It’s okay, I can take another hit.”
With that, Jack took out the Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid given to him by Gentry Gail and, biting the bottle as well, instantly restored his aura to its peak.
Roar! The Deep Red Giant Beast glared at the late-period Demon King with horrific radiance in its eyes. This guy must die today for daring to kill a king of the Human Race.
Moreover, Heavenly King level beings are too hard to kill. Unless trapped, they are difficult to catch if they are solely focused on escape. Instead, it’s better to take advantage of overwhelming strength to kill several more demon kings.
“Assist me, I’ll hold off this monster,” mumbled Barus, crippled with weakness on Earth in the distance, forced to stand up under the resentful gaze of the Demon Kings.
At this moment, it was bleeding inside. Just for the little benefit of this support mission, it had bled profusely, with its Origin suffering a 40 percent loss.
For beings that had stepped into the mythical world, once the loss of Origin exceeded 60 percent, it would damage the foundation of their rules, making it difficult to recover.
Dammit, do you humans have to be so crazy?
Boom! The sky shattered, and a Black Gold Destruction Long Spear descended from the heavens, aiming straight for the Deep Red Giant Beast and emitting a power far more terrifying than that of an ordinary Heavenly King.
Roar! The Deep Red Giant Beast let out a fierce roar, its double claws covering the sky, directly reaching for the Destruction Long Spear that was over a thousand meters long and radiating terrifying power.
Boom! As the Deep Red Giant Beast’s double claws grasped the long spear, a terrifying Power Explosion occurred. Its massive form suddenly sank, and the space beneath its feet extensively shattered.
Then came a terrifying burst of impact, turning into black and red rings of light that exploded at high altitudes, shattering space, everything destroyed by the clash of the two Heavenly King level powers.
In the midst of the wild and destructive airflow, the Deep Red Giant Beast stood tall, with strange golden dark patterns flowing on its body, emitting an aura of unshakable and immovable grandeur.
Such terrifying defense. This scene made all demon kings and the Great Demon King’s pupils contract.
The Deep Red Giant Beast raised its head and gave the Demon King entangled with Gabriel in the sky a fierce look, then suddenly pounced toward the late-period Mythical Demon King in the distance.
Roar!
Boom boom boom! Relying on invincible defense, the Deep Red Giant Beast charged and slashed through the battlefield of king-level Demon Kings from high altitude, unstoppable, its Tail Blade sweeping, cleaving through two true forms of Demon Kings.
But at that moment, Jack Clark’s aura on top of the Giant Beast weakened once again, by fifty percent.
Then, a late-period king-level being held out a bottle of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid in their hand: “Jack Clark, I have a bottle of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid here.”
“Hahaha… I have one more bottle here.”
With a hearty laugh, five bottles of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid appeared in front of Jack Clark, swept up by the rules, instantly bringing a smile to his face as he grabbed them.
With these, he could hold on for even longer, enough to kill a few more demon kings.
However, in the eyes of Gentry Gail, who hurried to the rear, weakened, there was a hint of worry, because the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill was something he had obtained from a relic.
At that time, the secret technique was incomplete, and he had pondered over it for more than a decade to partially restore it to the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
Although Jack Clark was now incredibly powerful, Gentry Gail felt something was off.
Because under the complete operation of the rules in the mythical world, strength was equal, and while Space-Time Summoning ingeniously leveraged the space-time rules, there would still be a price to pay somewhere.
No, he must warn him.

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 931: Chapter 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star
The sudden appearance of the Deep Red Giant Beast shocked the entire battlefield.
What astonished these Heavenly Kings and kings wasn’t its strength, surpassing that of a regular early-stage Heavenly King, but its defense that seemed nearly invincible to all laws and powers.
Suddenly, a king-level warrior bellowed, “Brothers, if we don’t go all out now, when will we? Let’s avenge Vince Vernon.”
A female king with long hair draped over her shoulders, wearing silver-blue battle armor, had a cold gaze: “Jack Clark, leave the sky to us, go down and take out the demon kings surrounding Number One.”
“Number One’s power is special; it can devour all life, even laws. It’s the best weapon against these scoundrels.”
...
Roar!
In response to them was a roar that shook the night sky; amidst the terrifying sonic explosion, the Deep Red Giant Beast twisted its body and, demolishing the Black Blade Light that sliced from behind, plummeted towards the ground.
Boom!
The blade light, a kilometer long and wrapped in the Corrosion Law and sharp Sword Qi, shattered. The explosion kicked up a terrifying energy shockwave, but it couldn’t shake the Giant Beast in the slightest.
Or to be more precise, it only made the red scale armor, decorated with gold and black patterns, shine even brighter.
Such formidable defense caused several demon kings poised to intercept to hesitate in their movements.
Forget it, they can’t be hurt; let it go down. Let those guys drain the Giant Beast’s power.
“Kill!” The first to speak, a mythical late-period king’s aura exploded, as he ignited his Origin to Burst forth, with the other kings holding nothing back as well.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In an instant, terrifying auras shook the Void; surges of burgeoning Law Power shot into the sky, intertwining and detonating the atmosphere, creating rings of white waves that swept thousands of kilometers in every direction.
The two demon kings whose True Forms had been previously shattered by the Tail Blade of the Deep Red Giant Beast were targeted by three kings at the mid-to-late stages of Myth, who fearlessly lunged at them.
“Humans, have you lost your minds?” Roaring furiously, endless Dark Demon Air erupted from the two demon kings, choosing to ignite their Origins lest they be directly destroyed.
“Mad, this world has always been mad.”
The female king, appearing to be around twenty and at the Mythical Peak, remained indifferent. In her hand, a Strange Long Sword gleamed as she transformed it into a blade light over two thousand meters long.
On that black blade light, which appeared like Ice Crystals, twisted ice crystal chains were entwined with a kind of Terrifying Divine Might, freezing and shattering both space and demon air wherever the blade light passed.
Boom!
The demon king—who Jack had once shattered—was instantly frozen by the sword, his body encased in ice, followed immediately by a palm smashing into his back, breaking apart half of his True Body.
“Take this, Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal!”
Boom! An aura nearly at the Heavenly King level signaled its arrival as the middle-aged man at the late stage of mythical power raised a hand to the sky, summoning a giant yellow seal.
The mountain-like seal exuded a Terrifying Aura, suppressing all surrounding laws, fearsome and awe-inspiring.
“Don’t think we, the demon race, are afraid of you humans!”
The complexions of the two Mythical Peak demon kings, who were facing him, changed drastically, their eyes filled with insane murderous intent as a similarly terrifying aura burst forth within them.
Boom, boom!!
The two three-headed, ten-limbed figures, also near the level of a Heavenly King, erupted in terrifying auras. As their hands formed seals, they whirled the power of laws, fending off the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal descending from the sky like Demon Gods ruling Hell.
Boom!
The clash between the yellow seal and the eight limbs of the two demon kings set off a terrible shock wave, creating a black, destructive tidal wave that swept across a hundred kilometers.
The clashes of formidable Law Power and energy explosions shook Heaven and Earth, their rumbling echoes unending.
Each of the three powerhouses was pushed back by the force of the others’ explosion, with the Human King’s aura suppressing the universe, dominating as the two demon kings were surrounded by Dark Demon Air, their presences earth-shatteringly powerful.
In this world, not just Jack Clark was a Monster Genius. In every generation, both the Human Race and The Purgatory Family had their own dazzling Monster Geniuses emerge.
This king wielding the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal was named Bud, a formidable warrior among human kings known to be at the forefront in combat power. He grasped a Higher-order Law of Strength during his breakthrough to king-level.
Later, he acquired a section of an immensely heavy metal mountain, thousands of kilometers tall, from a relic. Combining it with his own laws, he refined the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal.
With the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal in hand and mastery over a Higher-order Law of Strength, even with his cultivation only at the late stage of myth, he could stand toe-to-toe with two Mythical Peak demon kings.
Moreover, these two Mythical Peak demon kings were among the strongest in their class, with astonishing combat abilities and Secret Skills and Lifeline Talents that were tremendously fearsome.
Otherwise, a single peak demon king could not have competed against Bud; they would have been severely injured or even suppressed by him long ago.
But Bud was strong, and The Purgatory Family was not weak. With a numerical advantage, these powerful kings all had equally formidable demon kings set on them.
After over two decades of combat on the Frontline Battlefield, the power levels and laws mastered by those human kings had all become well known to The Purgatory Family demons.
Similarly, the humans were also aware of the strengths of these demons active on the frontline; it was an evenly matched situation.
This time, however, Diorus had assembled ten demon kings, two Great Demon Kings, and one Demon God Level Powerhouse from the rear to deal a heavy blow to the human race.
The few kings who broke through to the mid or early stages of myth suffered heavy injuries, especially Vince Vernon, who had only recently broken through to king-level after decades of cultivation, was a prime target for assassination.
Standing tall amidst the raging chaos, Bud glanced at the two Peak Demon Kings, then turned and flew towards the ground.
“Bud, where are you going?”
“Your opponents are us.”
Gentry Gail and the Six-tailed Heavenly Fox lunged toward the two Peak Demon Kings. By now, their injuries had somewhat healed after consuming supplies from two Top-level Divine Items.

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 932: Chapter 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star_2
This is the Civilization Battlefield, where it isn’t just about comparing the strengths of both sides, but also the consumption of logistics.
With the arrival of Jack Clark, and the Number One that could directly devour demon kings, these king-level strong men saw hope in eliminating more demon kings and started to fight desperately.
Before this, no king-level or demon king dared to burst out recklessly, for if they became weak after a burst, they would be surrounded and attacked, risking annihilation.
“You bully demons too far,” said Bud, who descended from the sky with the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal in his hand to block him, while Barus showed anger on his face.
To think that a mere human at the late period of the Mythical-level actually tried to block it, a Great Demon King, even if it was heavily injured, it was not something a king-level could insult.
In a burst of rage, Barus’s eight arms reached into the Void and pulled out a rusty 1,200-meter-long magic spear from the depths of the Void.
Boom!
The moment he grasped the magic spear, Barus’s kilometer-high figure sank involuntarily, and the ground within kilometers around him kept cracking and shattering.
A terrifying aura that even king-level felt apprehensive wrapped around the magic spear.
“Human, take my Dark Soul-Devouring Spear,” Barus roared as he gripped the long spear with his eight arms. With great effort, as he swung it, the whole heaven and earth shook, causing terror.
Boom!
The rusty magic spear collided with the yellow mountain-like Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal, and in an instant, the sky shattered, and the Earth cracked open for tens of kilometers, with dark cracks continuously spreading overhead.
The immense opposing force from the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal caused Bud to involuntarily take two steps back, and his formidable Rule True Body vibrated, his sleeves billowing.
As expected, the existence of the Heavenly King Level was still very powerful even when weakened.
Bud’s expression became grave. Just as he was about to burn another 10 percent of his Origin to restrain the demon king and let the Crimson Giant Beast rampage across the battlefield, Barus’s three faces also turned serious.
“Such a strong human.”
Wonder appeared in all three of Barus’s Demon Eyes, followed by a roar of intense killing intent while dazzling purple Divine Light twined around his long spear, “Human, today I will kill you first.”
With a roar, Barus struggled to swing the long spear, stirring up the sky full of purple Divine Light to clash again with the Suppressing Heavenly Earth Law, striking the Suppressing Heaven Divine Seal that seemed to smash the vault of Heaven.
Boom! The terrible aftermath destroyed everything around, and both strong individuals had to take two steps back, while Bud’s eyes revealed a hint of shock.
Because he felt that Barus’s last attack, though seemingly terrifying, was much weaker than the previous one. Was the Great Demon King so heavily injured, or was it something else?
Just as a thought flashed through Bud’s mind, Barus attacked again.
Boom boom boom! In an instant, Barus and Bud’s clash began, breaking heaven and shattering earth, majestic and horrendous.
While the Mythical-level battle in the sky became ever more fierce, the unobstructed Crimson Giant Beast, like a world-ending meteor, fell from the sky, landing in the middle of the battlefield between Number One and the demon kings.
Boom!
The Earth within a range of dozens of kilometers exploded like sea water, billions of tons of dirt and rubble erupted endlessly in all directions, and the sweeping smoke and dust and shockwaves extended for tens of kilometers.
Seeing the Crimson figure standing in the center of the explosion, the nine demon kings who had teamed up to encircle Number One all changed their expressions; none of them had intercepted this monster.
Didn’t Barus say he would hold it off?
Especially the demon king who had blood-colored eyes on his forehead and whose True Body had been shattered by the Crimson Giant Beast’s Destructive Breath attack was even more unsightly.
Roar!
The dark golden monster, having broken free from most of its armor and grown to three hundred meters, roared fiercely upon sighting the fearsomely oppressive Crimson Giant Beast suddenly appearing on the battlefield.
However, facing the thousand-meter-tall Crimson Giant Beast, the three hundred-meter-tall Number One seemed somewhat diminutive, like the difference between an adult and a few-year-old child.
Perhaps influenced by Freya Louise’s consciousness, this monster, acting on instinct alone, did not attack the Crimson Giant Beast.
Standing in the middle of the battlefield, the Crimson Giant Beast glanced around at the nine demon kings who were scattered across dozens of kilometers and used long-range means to limit Number One, then suddenly moved.
Boom! Accompanied by large-scale space collapse, the Crimson Giant Beast vanished on the spot.
“Be careful!” Amid the angry roars of the eight demon kings, the Crimson Giant Beast appeared before a mythic early-stage demon king who stood over four hundred meters tall with two heads and six arms.
Boom!
Under the terrible claws, space shattered and laws solidified. In an instant, the Earth around the demon king for kilometers fractured, and he himself was suppressed by the terrible strength, unable to move.
As he gazed at the obscuring Crimson claw, the suppressed demon king’s soul panicked, and he roared in fright and anger, “Save me!”
“Stop!” Behind the Crimson Giant Beast, angry roars exploded, space burst, and a ferocious head, more than two thousand meters wide, with a gaping maw appeared amidst the rampant torrents.
Simultaneously, a pale beam of light fell from the sky, withering everything in its path, laws breaking down, aimed directly at Jack Clark atop the Crimson Giant Beast.
Beyond this, the ground around the giant beast cracked open, long dark tentacles reaching out from kilometer-long fissures, coiling with a strong sinister aura towards the Crimson Giant Beast.
Among these attacks, a dark red blade light, wrapped in blood-colored flames and over a thousand meters long, was the most terrifying, burning the invisible space red as it slashed towards the Giant Beast’s neck.
Roar! With a fierce roar, blue and white beams shot from Number One’s eyes, sweeping in all directions, instantly causing the faces of four other demon kings ready to strike to drastically change.

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 933: Chapter 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star_3
Boom!
The unstoppable claw of the Deep Red Giant Beast smashed the Demon King’s True Form along with the space within a thousand meters radius around it, in an overbearing manner.
Chaotic Lightning flashed and swirled around, enclosing and suppressing the exploded flesh and blood of the Demon King.
At the same time, a Tail Blade over a thousand meters long behind the Giant Beast flashed, wrapped in Chaotic Lightning, sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
The winding crimson Tail Blade was like a master of Sword Skill wielding a combat knife, annihilating the head of a ghoul and its Blood Flame light in an instant with a slash.
As for the white corrosive radiance falling from the sky, the Deep Red Giant Beast slightly dodged to the side, letting it fall on its shoulder, including the Dark Tentacles wrapping around its legs.
Boom!!
The white light that fell on the shoulder of the Deep Red Giant Beast burst like sea water, creating only minor cracks in the surrounding space for several kilometers but failing to shake it in the slightest.
As for those tentacles that emerged from the Earth’s Fissure, they disintegrated under the rule of the Chaotic Dark Law the moment they wrapped around the legs of the Giant Beast, too weak to make an impact.
“Die!” At that moment, a whisper that resembled a devil’s murmur rang by Jack Clark’s ears, carrying an incredibly intense malice as if adjudicating the life and death of all things.
In Jack Clark’s eyes, a pair of dark golden vertical pupils appeared, causing Heaven and Earth to fade in color the instant a stream of Law imbued with the power of Death wrapped around him from the depths of the Void.
The Laws related to Death? Watching the gray force rushing towards him, Jack’s gaze was cold and unmoved.
As the Death Laws approached within a hundred meters of Jack, they suddenly vibrated and then disintegrated under the Chaotic Dark Force Field surrounding the Giant Beast.
In comparison to the more than two thousand meters long Deep Red Giant Beast, Jack was like an ant standing on an elephant’s head, minuscule, with the shortest Sharp Horn around him being over sixty meters long.
In such circumstances, as long as the “Invulnerable to All Laws” Defense of the Deep Red Giant Beast was not broken, no attack could come close to Jack.
And all of this exchange of attacks occurred in the blink of an eye, just as the Death Laws disintegrated, a Demon King in the distance spat blood, having been injured by the backlash.
At the same time, under the right claw of the Deep Red Giant Beast, the exploded true flesh and blood of the Demon King began to converge, reshaping the true body, then getting seized by the Giant Beast that had sealed the surrounding space.
In an instant, the Demon King was soul-shocked.
“No!”
Boom! The Demon King’s eyes showed madness as it instantly burnt eight-tenths of its Origin. Its form swelled quickly, trying to enter an awakened state to pry open the right claw of the Deep Red Giant Beast.
If the Deep Red Giant Beast crushed it, at most it would have to reshape its True Body and lose a bit of its Laws’ Origin, unless the opponent recklessly sought to erode its True Body without regard for energy consumption.
But if it was caught by that terrifying creature, it would be devoured, and it would only take two bites to fall.
Boom! But within the crimson claw, an indescribable Power Explosion erupted, entwined with Chaotic Lightning, forcibly suppressing the Demon King’s expanded True Body.
Roar! Number One, like a monstrous beast on all fours, appeared in front of the Deep Red Giant Beast in an instant. Its palm enlarged and grabbed the Demon King’s True Body from the Giant Beast’s claw.
Crack!!
In the palm of Number One, infused with the Seal of Space, the Demon King, along with the space itself, shrunk to dozens of meters across, excitedly and ferociously bitten into by Number One.
Accompanied by a desperate scream, the upper half of the Demon King was bitten off by Number One in one snap. Instantly, the once complete Aura of life and soul was split in two.
Suddenly, Number One’s Aura surged, becoming even more terrifying and ferocious, its invisible presence causing the Demon Kings to feel extremely uneasy.
Jack himself couldn’t help but glance sidelong at such a terrifying devouring ability.
“Human, I must kill you, exterminate everyone related to you,” the remaining eight Demon Kings yelled out frantically as the Origins within them burnt, their Auras increasing multiple times over.
Terrifying black Demon Clouds surged into the sky, once again obscuring the night overseen by Moonlight Command, plunging this World into darkness again.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Attacks comparable to a nuclear explosion, even surpassing the destructive power of a Hydrogen Bomb due to their Laws’ infusion, landed on the Deep Red Giant Beast, shaking the entire World.
Yet, their attacks couldn’t shake the Defense that not even the Heavenly Kings could break, and in the explosion that nearly dispersed the Demon Cloud, the more brilliant figure of the Beast with its scale armor was revealed.
Such terrifying Defense, even in the eyes of those Demon Kings, couldn’t help but show a hint of despair, giving rise to thoughts of retreat.
At that moment, the majestic and indifferent voice of Diorus came from the heavens: “Spread out and besiege them. His strength will not be endless, summoning creatures far beyond the Boundary will definitely come at a great cost.”
Indeed, just as Diorus spoke, Jack, atop the head of the Giant Beast, once again took out a bottle of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid and swallowed it down, quickly restoring his almost drained Spirit Qi to its peak.
Just as Diorus had said, Jack was indeed paying the price at every moment.
The Deep Red Form of the Giant Beast was nearly invincible, an Invincible Myth. Even the Heavenly King Level could clash head-on; in a face-to-face battle, the Giant Beast could actually burst a Demon King with a single claw.
But bursting open and eradicating were not the same.
The souls of these Demon Kings had been Tempered into Demon Souls. Unless their Soul Source and Laws’ Origin were exhausted, escaping with a piece of flesh and blood would allow them to regenerate.
This was also the reason for Jack’s frustration, as eradicating a Demon King required a large consumption of Laws from the Deep Red Giant Beast, indirectly meaning he was eradicating a Demon King himself.
In this kind of energy drain, even with his Innate Demon God’s Body, Jack would not be able to withstand it. That’s why he chose to wound these Demon Kings grievously with overwhelming force, leaving it to the Human Kings to eradicate them.

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 934: Chapter 395 True. Crushing the Demon King, The Fall of a Star_4
This time, Diorus’s domineering and icy voice came from above again, “No one is allowed to retreat from today’s battle. Today, I will have a fight to the death with the Human Race. Anyone who disobeys will be executed.”
The True Martial Heavenly King laughed loudly, “Hahahaha… Diorus, do you think our Human Race is afraid of your Purgatory Family? Kill, today we’ll wipe them all out.”
“True Martial, you’re seeking death!”
Boom! The battle tens of thousands of miles above instantly grew even more intense.
At that moment, an endless radiance shone in the high sky as three pairs of white wings that stretched tens of kilometers unfurled, scattering a sky full of light feathers that illuminated Heaven and Earth, weakening the aura of each demon king beneath them.
King Gabriel also went all out directly.
Roar!
The Golden Dragon, transformed by the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King, roared as it tore apart the tentacles of the Great Demon King named Jimtor, but at the same time, it was blasted hundreds of kilometers away by a huge demon claw that reached out from the Abyss.
Far away, the battle at the second battlefield had also escalated fiercely. At this moment, both sides were almost blinded by bloodlust, and the brutality shocked even the retreating soldiers of both parties.
Because usually in great battles, although there are injuries on both sides above the Mythical Stage, these kings and demon kings rarely fight so desperately.
Although slaying a demon king or a king has its rewards, if one gets injured and consumes too much Origin, it can slow down their strength progression or even cause permanent regression to their foundation.
Therefore, in past Civilization Wars, the truly brutal battles were those on the Transcendent battlefield below, where countless ordinary soldiers from both sides would die or be wounded in every battle.
Of course, because of unmanned Mecha, the base casualties of the Human Race are far less than those of other races.
But no one expected that after the soldiers below the Transcendent Stage withdrew, the battleground above the Mythical Stage would turn into a battle of annihilation, with both sides crazily burning their Origins.
Especially on the Purgatory Family side, over five Mythical-level powerhouses had already fallen.
The Deep Red Giant Beast, bombarded by Jack’s Sky-base Breath, the Mid-Mythical Stage Dark Giant Beast killed by the Sky-based bombardment, and three Demon Kings successively devoured by Number One.
Although the Human Race also lost one king-level warrior, this damage still caused Diorus heartache, anger, and a cold killing intent.
Since the Human Race wanted to go all out today, it would also go all out, to see whether there are more Human Kings or more demon kings of the Purgatory Family.
Boom! A collision burst forth in the sky, and a demon king, whose true body had been half shattered, fell from the sky, slamming into the Earth like a meteor, creating a Destructive Impact upon impact.
Above the Firmament, the queen who wielded a Strange Long Sword also stepped down through the air, her long hair flying behind her, and her aura astonishing.
Roar!
The Crimson Giant Beast let out a savage roar, charging forward and shattering space, withstanding the attack of eight demon kings and appeared tens of kilometers away in front of a Mid-Mythical Stage demon king.
“How is this possible, the space here is chaotic and violent, how can you still rip and jump!”
Under the roar of alarm and anger, that demon king split its burning Origin into two, its silhouette like a shadow dividing into two—one charging at the Crimson Giant Beast, the other fleeing backwards.
Facing this terrifying behemoth, these demon kings had no courage to engage in close combat.
Boom!
The true body of the demon king that pounced on the Crimson Giant Beast exploded, and a terrible radiance rose from the Earth in an instant. Under the terrifying Destructive Impact, even the Gigantic Beast’s huge body couldn’t help but take a step back.
Watching the demon king, whose breath was now weak and barely two-tenths of its former strength, hundreds of kilometers away, both Jack and the Crimson Giant Beast showed a hint of regret in their eyes.
He (It) had said that he (it) would catch another meal for Freya Louise.
Feeling the rapid consumption of Soul Power and Spirit Qi within him, Jack turned around to look at Number One, still gnawing and digesting the corpse of the demon king.
Obviously, they had all overestimated Number One’s digestive capabilities. After consuming the true bodies of three demon kings in succession, this monstrous creature also needed time to digest.
Since that was the case, Jack’s gaze turned to a demon king stands tens of kilometers away, towering a thousand meters tall with Three-headed Six-armed and a Blood Colored Eye on its brow, his gaze icy cold.
Boom! The Crimson Giant Beast’s form thundered into action, and the demon king’s face immediately changed color, “Strike, block it together.”
Two demon kings stood on either side of this demon king, but as the Crimson Giant Beast disappeared in an instant, all three demon kings, including the one with the blood-colored eyes, began to retreat frantically.
Block what, that monster can only be dragged, to block is to seek death.
Boom Boom Boom! Ignoring the attacks from demon kings coming from all directions, the Crimson Giant Beast charged violently, leaving behind a thousand-meter wide, hundred-kilometer long Destruction Tunnel in the Earth.
At the end of the Destruction Tunnel, the demon king with Blood-colored Eyes watched as a crimson Tail Blade, nearly splitting the sky in two, descended from above, roaring in shock and anger.
Boom!
The Blood Eye Demon King’s combat knife in hand blazed with blood-colored flames, transforming into a blood-red saber light stretching over a thousand meters into the sky. Where it passed, a sea of blood boiled, and countless lives wailed in agony.
At the same time, the six remaining arms of this demon king wielded a demon tower, now swollen to a kilometer in size, slamming it down onto the Deep Red Giant Beast like a small hill. The other two heads opened their eyes, and a terrifying gaze flowed within them.
The Three-headed Six-armed form, inherited by The Purgatory Family, was not for show but evolved from battles spanning tens of thousands of years, each with a single combat strength that was tremendously frightening.
But at this moment, this demon king was facing the Deep Red Giant Beast.
Boom! The blood-red saber light, along with the demon tower, were instantly shattered by the Deep Red Tail Blade. The mountainous demon seal smashed onto the shoulder of the Giant Beast, yet it could not shake it in the slightest.
As for the strange power carried by those four eyes, when it fell upon the body of the Giant Beast, it dissipated immediately, the invincible defense almost driving the demon king to despair.
Boom! Boom!!
The Deep Red Giant Beast, with its claws furiously outstretched, grabbed the demon king’s eight arms, one on each side, as its double claws crackled with Chaotic Lightning. The thunderous noise continuously shattered the Demon King’s true body.
Roar! In the distance, Number One, clenching a demon king’s thigh, brightened its eyes.
“Roar! I won’t let you eat this guy,” growled the beast ferociously.
Boom! The Giant Beast’s double claws burst with endless Chaotic Lightning, its power on par with that of a Heavenly King Level containing the World’s Power, which suppressed the laws on Taros’s body, giving it no chance to self-destruct.
Following that, the Giant Beast’s huge maw opened wide, and a dazzling chaos light flashed from within.
“No!”
Boom!!
The terrifying Destructive Breath sprayed over Taros’s body. In an instant, the demon king let out a desperate roar as its True Body, Laws’ Origin, and Demon Soul dissipated under the Destructive Breath.
This scene turned the faces of the demon kings in the distance, who dared not flee, very ugly, filled with fear and dread.
While the Deep Red Giant Beast was eradicating the True Body of this demon king with its breath, Jack Clark on top of the beast downed two bottles of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid to maintain his state.
The battle had come to a point where he only had one bottle of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid left in his hand.
As the extraordinarily powerful Deep Red Giant Beast maintained its existence for so long, the consumption of Spirit Qi and Soul Power within Jack Clark’s body grew larger. At the same time, another force was eroding his body.
That was the price for dominating the Mid-Mythical Stage battlefields with an early Ninth Heavens entrance and even clashing head-on with a Great Demon King.
However, because the soul consciousness itself was integral, the price Jack Clark paid for summoning the Giant Beast was actually quite light, not as severe as Gentry Gail had feared.
Boom! Terrifying light flickered between the Deep Red Giant Beast’s double claws, and just as Taros’s true body and origin were ground to the last bit, it chose to self-destruct.
As the demon king self-destructed, a Blood Moon emerged in the sky under the resonance of the laws, slowly falling.
In the midst of the terrible explosion, as if crushing a Mid-Mythical stage demon king, the Deep Red Giant Beast stood tall, its fierce golden vertical pupils turning towards Barus hundreds of kilometers away, locked in fierce combat with Bud.
With one bottle of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid still in hand, he could fight another battle. If Bud could assist, perhaps today he really could Reverse Defeat a Great Demon King with only an entrance to the Ninth Heavens.
“Human, today I shall kill you,” roared Diorus suddenly from the sky, a towering world materializing behind him.
“Diorus, are you ignoring my presence?”
The Sky-based God King’s expression was cold, a world materializing behind him as well, or rather, a metallic-like continent emerged, signalling that the Demon God Level Powerhouses were ready to fight to the death.
But in that moment, suddenly the entire mythical world was illuminated by light, followed by the shaking of heaven and earth.
A gigantic, boundless fireball descended from the distant firmament, like a falling star, emitting a terror that seemed to destroy the world.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! As the tremendous star shattered layers of space-time, it approached the world’s earth, spreading an aura of destruction and collapse.
Every living being within this hundred-million-kilometer range looked up in horror at the ever-brightening, falling star in the sky.
The terror of that destructive force, capable of annihilating even space-time, caused even the four Demon God Level Powerhouses to turn pale.
“All retreat.”
“We can’t hold it.”
“Do not resist, I will take you away.”

chapters.title: Chapter 935: 396 The War Ends, Ripping Apart the Continental Plate
chapters.content:
Chapter 935: Chapter 396 The War Ends, Ripping Apart the Continental Plate
The catastrophic change in the sky shook everyone to their core.
Witnessing the destructive Great Sun falling at an indescribable speed and rapidly enlarging, faces of millions of soldiers from different races and the Human Race were etched with despair.
Under such a formidable entity’s impact, it was nearly impossible for those under the king-level warriors to survive the cataclysm.
The battling king-level demon kings were also startled, and the four Demon Gods in the sky momentarily ceased their onslaught.
Judging the path and angle of the falling star by its speed, the Sky-based God King determined that the impact site was still some distance away from them.
However, much like a comet striking Blue Star, such a terrifying collision would undoubtedly trigger a catastrophic shockwave, necessitating a retreat to withstand it with full strength.
Boom boom boom! The four Demon Gods above the firmament took action once again, but this time they were merely expanding the battlefield with their rules to prepare to evacuate their own soldiers.
Yet the battle had progressed to a point where it couldn’t simply be halted on command.
For instance, the queen wielding the Strange Long Sword turned her blade into an iceberg, pinning a demon king firmly to the Earth while rule energy erupted from her, erasing the Demon King’s True Form.
On the Third Battlefield, Bruce Lancaster, who had already shattered the Triangle Demon King’s true form three times, was burning another ten percent of his Origin, hoping to finish off the demon king before the Great Sun fell.
Decades of continual warfare had deepened the enmity between the Human Race and The Purgatory Family to oceanic depths.
The ferocity of the battle between the kings and demon kings hadn’t been fully unleashed merely due to the lack of opportunity, but now, with the chance to kill a demon king, how could they possibly give up?
Simultaneously, several Heavenly King-level Great Demon Kings were also fighting with real fury, especially the Great Demon King battling the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King.
This Great Demon King, named Jimtor, had only recently achieved a breakthrough and had come to the frontline under the Demon God Carthius to “earn his stripes”, intending to kill a few Human Kings.
But what it hadn’t expected was to be suppressed by this Human Heavenly King twice in succession, which it found somewhat unacceptable, as it was a Purgatory True Demon, invincible within its rank and a demon king who ruled supremely over a territory.
Watching the Destructive Great Sun drawing closer in the sky, Jimtor’s eyes revealed a cold light as it suddenly roared, “Human, you are doomed today.”
Boom!
The aura of Jimtor surged, its massive body swelling rapidly and transforming into a 3,000-meter-tall black monster with many huge tentacles protruding from its back, looking extremely vile and ferocious.
Black Demonic Qi materialized around Jimtor, flowing like swamp muck and emitting terrifying fluctuations capable of rotting and corroding space and even the Heavenly Energy of the uninhabited world.
Under the contamination of that demonic gas, the sky over tens to hundreds of kilometers became oppressively heavy, as if a Swamp Hell had descended, seeking to drown the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King.
With foul-smelling bubbles churning, several even larger illusory tentacles reached out, entangling the Divine Dragon from all directions, preventing escape.
“Overlord Dragon, be careful not to get caught by that thing,”
From afar, Gabriel shouted, “It is not a purebred Purgatory True Demon; its essence is a lifeform straddling the threshold between illusion and reality, and damaging this illusory body would only cause heavy injury.”
Roar!
In response to Gabriel was a soaring Dragon Roar, as the Divine Dragon stirred up the sky with its resplendent Divine Light, shattering the void and exploding every tentacle that reached down from above.
However, these tentacles existed in a state between illusion and reality, and under the burning of Jimtor’s Origin, for each one that exploded, another would appear, wielding space to blockade all directions, intent on trapping the Divine Dragon there.
Above the firmament, the aura emanating from Jimtor grew even more terrifying, and its eyes revealed a cold, frenzied light.
As long as it could trap the Human Heavenly King here, it was willing to sacrifice its disposable illusory body along with him.
Using the feat of killing a Human Heavenly King, it could gain sufficient Law Divine Artifacts to fully transform into a Purgatory True Demon.
Roar! Suddenly, a Dragon Roar thundered, and the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King erupted in even more dazzling light, accompanied by a resounding rage-filled roar: “Ten Thousand Dragons Destroying the World!”
Boom boom boom!! The figure of the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King exploded outward, transforming into hundreds of kilometer-long golden light dragons that smashed through space, shattered the tentacles, and tore apart the entire Swamp Hell with a terrifying strike.
Boom! As the earth shattered and the sky cracked, black fissures spread across the high altitude, accompanied by the roaring of Jimtor and the bellowing of the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King.
A tangled mass of gold and black radiance plummeted from the sky nearly a hundred times the speed of sound and exploded a mere hundred kilometers away from the Deep Red Giant Beast, instantly fracturing the Earth.
The terrible smoke and shockwaves swept across hundreds of kilometers, plunging the world between heaven and earth into darkness and tumult.
Standing tall over the battlefield, the Deep Red Giant Beast, which had just crushed a late-period mythic demon king, glanced coldly at Barus, who was engaged in combat with Bud far away.
With a ferocious roar, the Deep Red Giant Beast vanished, reappearing near the entangled battleground of the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King.
Jack Clark shouted, “Throne, I can still take a bite.”
Compared to the cunning Barus, the chances of killing the demon king entangled with the Overlord Dragon Heavenly King were higher.
Roar!
As Jack’s voice fell, the phenomenon of the Deep Red World emerged once more behind the beast, and an immense deep crimson dragon head slowly emerged from the twisted Deep Red World.
The apocalyptic Crimson Dragon head, so vast it blotted out the sky, was so formidable it devoured space and obliterated all in its path.
Roar! Witnessing this sight, the Golden Dragon let out an uplifting Dragon Roar, unleashing the full force of its Origin to transform into a titanic golden Dragon Claw that obliterated everything in its path.
The terrifying strike caused space to collapse, smashing both Jimtor and itself toward the engulfing dreadful dragon head.

chapters.title: Chapter 936: 396 The War Ends, Ripping Apart the Continental Plate_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 936: Chapter 396 The War Ends, Ripping Apart the Continental Plate_2
“Humans!” Jimtor roared, his tentacles behind him swelling and probing into the Void. At the same time, his demon king’s true form turned ethereal, intending to enter the space interlayer to dodge the incoming strike.
Boom! The crimson dragon head bit down, shattering the Void within a ten-thousand-meter radius, engulfing the area in darkness, and biting off half of Jimtor’s body.
At the very moment the Giant Beast bit off half of Jimtor’s true body, the gloomy blue space-time summoning mark under the beast’s feet dissipated, and an instant thereafter, a surge of space-time power arrived.
Under the pull of that distorted space-time force, the Deep Red Giant Beast vanished in the blink of an eye, ending the summoning.
At the same time, in order to take out a Great Demon King in a single bite, Jack Clark, who had consumed the last drop of Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid, descended from the sky, his aura weakened to the extreme.
This time, he truly couldn’t squeeze out even a drop more.
“My laws, my Rule Origin is damaged!” From the depths of the raging Void, Jimtor’s roar of shock and anger came, as his figure burst out from the shattered space.
At this moment, his aura continued to plummet as he frantically flew towards the rear battlefield. In the blink of an eye, he turned into a stream of light and appeared hundreds of kilometers away.
The entire battlefield fell silent. None of the kings and demon kings had expected that at the very moment the great battle was nearing its end, a Great Demon King would be heavily injured, even nearly perishing.
Roar!
In the Ice Crystal Divine Palace mountain ranges, accompanied by the distortion of space-time, the massive body of the Deep Red Giant Beast suddenly appeared, emanating a terrifying aura comparable to that of a Titan.
Boom!! With a terrible oppressive force, the surrounding atmosphere exploded, shattering the mountain peaks beneath, and in an instant, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the purple little dragon, and the Red Beast were all blown away by the terrifying aura.
In the distance, the Blue-White Giant Dragon, who had just closed its eyes to sleep, looked back again, a look of shock in its eyes: “Roar! How is that possible, the aura of that little guy.”
However, having lost the soul resonance boost from its true body, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s chaotic lightning dissipated, and its size shrank rapidly, quickly returning to its original size of over seven hundred meters.
Immediately, a sense of weakness spread from within.
But the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s visitation this time wasn’t lengthy, so the consumption from its gigantification wasn’t too great, including that final bite which fragmented the true body of the Great Demon King.
That move was its limit of gigantification, a new talent mastery acquired upon breaking through to the Titan level—Deep Red Devouring—drawing on the destructive power of the Deep Red World to devour everything.
Thus, the only cost it bore was the exertion of drawing upon the power of the Deep Red World.
Unfortunately, if that Great Demon King hadn’t possessed the talent for etherealization, that one bite would have been enough to drag it into the Deep Red World and obliterate a Great Demon King.
But every strong man who has cultivated to the Great Demon King Realm has a bunch of methods and life-saving trump cards. The difficulty of killing above one’s level is still very high.
In the central battlefield, at the exact moment Jimtor was heavily injured, a furious roar came from Diorus in the sky: “Kill that human, I will grant a Rule Origin of the Devil God!”
The more monstrous Jack Clark’s performance, the stronger Diorus’s killing intent became. He even offered a Rule Origin of the Devil God as a reward.
If it weren’t for the fact that he and Carthius were entangled with the Sky-based God King and True Martial Heavenly King, he would have killed that monstrous member of the Human Race with a single claw swipe already.
As Diorus’s words fell, all demon kings and even Great Demon Kings had their eyes turn red, looking down at the heavily weakened Jack Clark lying on the ground.
But envy was futile. The world was about to be destroyed. If they stayed any longer, not only would they fail to kill that human being, they might even get slapped to death by the supreme experts opposite them.
Boom Boom Boom!! The terrifying Destructive Impacts in the sky grew ever closer, with the plummeting brilliance of that massive ‘star’ almost lighting up the entire vast world.
The voice of the True Martial Heavenly King came from the heavens, carrying a powerful coercive force: “Everyone, retreat.”
The Human Race had already gained a huge advantage in this battle, and there was no need to continue the slaughter.
At this moment, the Destructive Great Sun was getting closer and closer, and the terrifying pressure even caused the four demon gods to feel a bit frightened, not daring to face it head-on.
In the sky, golden light and laws spread out, like a curtain descending from heaven, covering the heavens and earth. Instantly, each mountain and river within the Human Race’s domain trembled, resonating with heaven and earth.
At the same time, dark crimson laws also spread, triggering the restrictions laid down by Devil God Emperor Eros, with the entire world trembling under the force of the laws.
They planned to harness the world that was already ‘refined’ to their side to withstand the impending Destructive Impact.
As the golden curtain of law and the dark crimson regulations unfurled, the two sides continuously collided, tangled, and simultaneously cleared out each and every Heavenly King and King-level battlefield.
Pu! A strand of golden law swept across a late-period mythical demon king, causing him to spew blood instantly and fly back in terror with a look of horror on his face.
Boom! A terrible impact exploded in a distant battlefield; a Human King clutching a stone pagoda was shattered under the dark crimson law, the figure spewing Essence Blood and flying backward.
At this moment, the situation was actually even more dangerous.
As the supreme forces and the demon gods got involved, a slight mishap could result in annihilation by the laws.
Seeing this scene, each demon king and Human King who were in the midst of battle, unwillingly vibed their opponents and took the initiative to fly backward.
At this moment, both demon kings and Human Kings were all weakened, everyone wounded. The battle was too brutal.
Roar!
Number One’s eyes emitted blue-white super divine light speeds, repelling three encircling demon kings before retreating under the cover of the golden laws with some reluctance.
Boom! A distant battlefield suddenly revealed a Blood Moon slowly falling.

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 396 The War Ends, Ripping Apart the Continental Plate_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 937: Chapter 396 The War Ends, Ripping Apart the Continental Plate_3
It was indeed the demon king who once had his true body shattered by a Tail Blade from the Deep Red Giant Beast, and who was later suppressed by a Sword Queen wielding a Strange Long Sword, with the ice-sealed Sword Mountain suppressing him.
Seeing this, Diorus’s gaze from above the Firmament grew even colder, for the loss to his empire this time was too great, with over five demon king level strong falling.
Just then, a golden light spread over and enveloped the weakened Jack Clark, pulling him toward the rear.
“Human, today I must kill you,” accompanied by Diorus’s icy voice resounding through Heaven and Earth. In an instant, the Void trembled, and a demon claw that covered the sky reached for Jack Clark.
The terrifying demon claw darkened the sky, and before it even fell, it caused every bone in Jack Clark’s body to crackle, and the Earth shattered to form a palm print tens of kilometers wide.
In an instant, a strong aura of death enveloped Jack Clark.
Facing the strength of a Demon God Level, Jack Clark, who was only at the Ninth Heavens realm, couldn’t even resist; the gap was too vast, not to mention he was very weak at this time.
“Diorus!” roared the True Martial Heavenly King.
Boom!
A Divine Stele of ten thousand feet suppressed from above the Firmament, and Diorus’s arm was directly smashed, immediately spraying Black Gold radiance all over, emitting terrifying energy fluctuations.
At this moment, except for Diorus, thken aback.
Because that demon claw just now wasn’t a manifestation of Rule power but the true body of Diorus. To kill that human, he had actually severed his own arm.
“Be careful!”
Roar!
The severed arm of Diorus surged with demon light, transforming into a terrifying Black Demon Dragon ten thousand meters long, coiling around Heaven and Earth, biting a hole in the golden Rule Sky Curtain of the Sky-based God King.
Under the concept surpassing time, the Black Demon Dragon, along with Jack Clark shrouded in Rules, was swallowed in one gulp.
In an instant, the faces of demon kings and king-level from both sides revealed different expressions; the Purgatory Family demon kings were excited and thrilled, while Human Kings were astonished.
“Diorus.”
The Sky-based God King and True Martial Heavenly King struck out in rage, especially the golden light screen that covered half of the sky, which stirred up a destructive power capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth to suppress the Black Demon Dragon.
Boom!
Just then, a dazzling starlight exploded within the body of the Demon Dragon, shattering the Demon Dragon’s belly under the Rule strength comparable to a hit from a Supreme Expert.
Under the explosion of terrifying Void within a range of hundreds of kilometers shattered, and the Earth vanished, with a stream of starlight flying out from the violent, destructive flow of Chaos.
Watching Jack Clark, surrounded by starlight and swept away by the golden Sky Curtain, Diorus, who paid the price of an arm and still couldn’t kill him, roared in anger.
“Human!”
But by then, he no longer had the chance to make a move. An indescribable sense of oppression descended from the sky, and even the Demon Gods were solemn under that overwhelming power.
Because it was not a Great Sun at all, but an immense and boundless carcass of a Giant Beast, many times larger than a planet, emitting a dazzling Radiance.
Boom!
The terrifying carcass of theowed by a more dazzling light burst.
In that light capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth, there was vaguely a tail tens of thousands of kilometers long stretching across the Firmament, “slowly” falling towards them.
In an instant, a strong aura of death enveloped everyone, including the Sky-based God King and the True Martial Heavenly King, whose complexions changed.
His earlier calculations of the landing spot were not wrong; that terrifying existence really fell far, far away from them, and they only needed to withstand the impact.
But this tail that covered the sky…
“True Martial, let’s join forces!”
Boom!
Under the joint efforts of n thousand kilometers.
With a full force burst, the two Supreme Experts tore the land of the Frontline Battlefield, ripping space and moving backward, avoiding the terrifying tail descending from the sky.
As the continental blocks tore apart, the Earth outside Heavenly Abyss City crumbled, mountain ranges collapsed, and over a million soldiers at that moment were like ants, quietly waiting for Doomsday to arrive.

chapters.title: Chapter 938: 397: Next Time, I Will Be the Protagonist, Heading to the Chaotic Turbulent Region
chapters.content:
Chapter 938: Chapter 397: Next Time, I Will Be the Protagonist, Heading to the Chaotic Turbulent Region
The Sky-based God King’s tearing apart of the Continental Plate was terrifying; as the Earth continued to rise, billions of tons of dirt and rock pressed toward the city of Heavenly Abyss.
From afar, it looked as if a majestic mountain range spanning tens of thousands of kilometers was rising up, with Heaven and Earth splitting apart and rivers flowing in reverse.
In order to protect his army, Diorus also chose to tear apart the Earth with the Sky-based God Kings, avoiding the frightening tail of light that fell from the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!
Under the shocked gaze of everyone, that tail of light that spanned Heaven and Earth fell with the might to destroy Heaven and Earth, landing on the edge of the battlefield where not even the Heavenly Kings dared to tread—the forbidden area.
Boom!
With the terrifying Destructive Impact, the Heavenly Earth Laws collapsed, space distorted, and that forbidden area, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers in depth and width, emitted a dazzling light.
And when that last segment of the White Tail blasted through the forbidden area, bursting everything, and landed in what was once the Frontline Battlefield, now a vast Void Abyss extending twenty thousand kilometers across and thousands of kilometers deep.
“Be careful!” terrible power Burst forth from the bodies of the Sky-based God King and True Martial Heavenly King.
Boom!
A earth-shattering explosion came from afar; in an instant, everyone felt the world shaking, all was silent except for the Radiance brighter than a nuclear explosion that obscured Heaven and Earth.
The terrible impact hit the golden Sky Curtain created by the rules of the Sky-based God King, and the Sky Curtain trembled and collapsed instantly.
Boom!
It was then that a gargantuan stele descended from the sky, the ancient characters for “True Martial” flickering upon it, exuding a might to Suppress everything in its path.
Only the combined strength of two Supreme Level beings was able to block the destructive impact of that terrifying entity’s tail as it landed, which gives a sense of its fearsome and terrifying nature.
At that moment, every life within hundreds of millions of kilometers in the Sky Curtain Battlefield, the Outer Development Department, or simply put, this entire world, was looking towards the direction of the explosion, their vision filled with the blinding White Light.
Even the Black-red Colossal Beast, far away in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, saw the White Light flashing on the horizon and couldn’t help but reveal a look of surprise: “So far away.”
Considering the terrifying size of this being and the impact of light from its descent, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon over here could only see streaks of White Light and vibrations from the edge of the sky, which suggests just how far away this location was from the human Territory.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon, which had just closed its eyes not far away, was startled awake by the shine and the tremors at the horizon and couldn’t help but open its eyes and look back with a solemn expression.
“Has another Primordial Beast failed?”
……
It took nearly two days for the terrifying shockwave to subside, and at that time, the landscape of this World had undergone drastic changes.
The Frontline Battlefield was split by the tail tip of that terrifying entity, with the invisible force spreading as White mist, covering the sun and extending to the ends of Heaven and Earth.
Jack Clark, twenty Human Kings, a 6-tailed Heavenly Fox nearly 3 meters in body length, and three Heavenly Kings all stood at the edge of mountain ranges tens of thousands of meters high, their expressions grave as they looked out at the endless White mist.
Boom! At that moment, the White mist ahead began to shake violently, followed by a middle-aged man—radiating a terrible suppressive might and holding the stele—bursting out.
Hum! Space Distorted, and a 3-meter-wide golden spell emerged, through which the aged voice of the Sky-based God King came: “True Martial, what’s the situation inside?”
The True Martial Heavenly King took a deep breath and said gravely, “Inside there’s a strong suppression of rules; I couldn’t go deeper than a hundred kilometers. It’s very dangerous.”
“Right now, that One-side World is merging with the mythical world, the Boundary energy is volatile, and we can only explore it after the volatile Rule energies have settled.”
In front of them, an enormous, boundless ‘Giant Beast’ corpse had descended from the sky. Calling it a Giant Beast is one thing, but it’s also like a huge, boundless world, a world in the shape of a Giant Beast.
Or to put it another way, it is a Giant Beast, and during the night, it was one of the three stars that Jack and Freya Louise had seen in the sky.
In a space-time far beyond comprehension, these three beings—surpassing Ancient Titans and Ancient True Spirits, incomprehensibly powerful—met their defeat and fell, becoming One-side Worlds.
And beside this ‘Giant Beast,’ whose tail alone stretches tens of thousands of kilometers, the territory occupied by humans seems infinitesimally small.
At this moment, all Kings felt an overwhelming sense of insignificance.
In comparison to the vast, endless mythical world, the Human Race and The Purgatory Family are but a drop in the ocean.
Just as Jack and the other Kings were lost in the vastness of Heaven and Earth, the golden magic trembled slightly, transmitting the aged voice of the Sky-based God King.
“Although the war was short, the achievements were remarkable and met our goal of weakening the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.”
At these words, smiles crept onto the faces of all the Kings, who then turned to look at the pale-faced, still somewhat weak young man nearby.
Jack said politely, “Seniors, there’s no need to look at me like this. If it weren’t for Senior Sky-based God King, True Martial Throne, and the other Kings restraining the other side’s strong men, I wouldn’t have been able to play a role.”
The True Martial Heavenly King nodded slowly, “Jack is right. A Civilization-level war relies on the collective strength of the race, a single individual cannot hope to contend with a mighty enemy like The Purgatory Family.”
“However, credit is credit, Jack has indeed performed exceedingly well this time, or rather, done far more than we imagined.”
With that, the True Martial Heavenly King glanced down at the shattered mountain ranges and the various Human Race armies and bases, and said slowly, “The war is over, now it’s time to clean up the battlefield.”
“We’ll leave these matters to the higher-ups, we’ve all suffered considerable losses, so let’s first return and recuperate with Closed-door Cultivation. In five days, we’ll reconvene for the Throne Conference.”

chapters.title: Chapter 939: 397 Next Time I'll Be the Protagonist, Heading to the Chaotic Turbulent Region_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 939: Chapter 397 Next Time I’ll Be the Protagonist, Heading to the Chaotic Turbulent Region_2
“Including arrangements for the aftermath of Vince Vernon’s throne’s collapse,”
Upon hearing this, those kings nodded slightly.
If it weren’t for the possibility of unforeseen circumstances, they would have rushed back to Heavenly Abyss City to rest by now, almost all of them had burned their Origin in this great battle.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!!
Accompanied by a row of fighter aircraft cutting through the skies, greeting the emerging Golden Sun, this battle finally drew to a close, among them was Jack Clark’s Throne Fighter.
“It’s dawn already.”
At the Ice Crystal Divine Palace, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon watched the rise of the Great Sun at the edge of Heaven and Earth, a trace of sentiment in its eye, feeling time had passed so quickly.
In the blink of an eye, the night had passed.
At this moment, an exalted Dragon Roar came from the distant sea of clouds, and immediately a Silver Giant Dragon with a wingspan of nine hundred meters soared out of the clouds, whipping up a roaring wind.
Following close behind the Silver Giant Dragon was another giant dragon, three hundred meters in body length, golden-blue in color as if cast from crystal.
This golden-blue giant dragon exuded a quasi-mythical level aura, almost reaching that of a Mythical Giant Beast, its bloodline aura also immensely powerful.
“Roar! The Great Scythia has returned.”
Boom! The Silver Giant Dragon landed on all four claws, causing Mountain Peak rocks to shatter, creating cracks that spread for a mile or two.
Those rocks, some meters to a dozen meters in diameter, like cannonballs mixed with the violent wind wave, smash against the Black-red Colossal Beast, shattering upon impact.
Coming in front of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly roared, “Roar! Tim Abbott, the Great Scythia has invited another powerful beast to join the Dragon Palace.”
As he spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon stepped aside to make way, proudly introducing, “Roar! Tim Abbott, this is Telsafi, a good friend of the Great Scythia, a dragon that grew up with the Great Scythia.”
“Telsafi, this is Abbott, the Thunderflame Dragon King of our Dragon Palace, Brock Abbott.”
Eek eek eek!? The Purple Little Dragon on top of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon stretched out its little claws, pointing to itself, wondering why the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t introduce it.
But its words were completely unintelligible to the Silver Giant Dragon, or rather, it was directly ignored by the Silver Giant Dragon.
After the Silver Giant Dragon finished introducing, the golden-blue giant dragon took two steps forward, looking at the much larger, heavily scaled, and ferocious Black-red Colossal Beast before it, it roared softly.
“Roar! I am the great Torsa, son of the Titan King Caotena from next door. Pleased to meet you for the first time, the Dragon King known as Thunderflame.”
In contrast to the unreserved Silver Giant Dragon, the golden-blue giant dragon gave off a sense of elegance, poise, a feeling of being a young lady from a noble family.
Exceptionally beautiful and magnificent.
Hiss! Damn it, so beautiful. The Black-red Colossal Beast inwardly gasped, astonished that it found these fierce and ferocious giant dragons beautiful.
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon, secretly sneering to itself, nodded to the golden-blue giant dragon, exhaling a hot breath through its nostrils and slightly opening its fierce maw to emit a heavy, low roar.
“Hello, Torsa, welcome to the Dragon Palace.”
Woo!
As a sound like a ship’s horn resounded, the sea of clouds exploded, a Black Giant Whale with double fins spread over five hundred meters burst out of the clouds, emitting a cry at odds with its massive size.
Roar! Scythia, you’re finally back, let’s set out quickly to the Chaotic Turbulent Region, not to wreak havoc, but to find good food.
No sooner had it spoken, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish noticed the luxuriously beautiful and amazingly-auraed golden-blue giant dragon next to the Silver Giant Dragon, and its eyes showed surprise.
Roar, roar, roar! Scythia, did you bring your friend back too?
Following the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was a Red Beast that resembled the Eastern Divine Dragon.
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded, “Roar! Yes, Telsafi is now a Dragon King of the Dragon Palace as well, the Crystal Dragon King.”
“Telsafi, this guy is called Jerry Jones, the King of Black and White of the Dragon Palace, but we all call him Joe. That guy behind him is the Candle Dragon, the Day and Night Space-Time Dragon King.”
The corners of the gold-blue giant dragon’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
Although Scythia had already introduced the structure of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire on the way, it always felt somewhat like child’s play to it. A Beast Empire actually had so many kings.
Besides the five Dragon Kings it knew of here, there were two more in that Indigenous World.
Boom!
The Black-red Colossal Beast stood up, its enormous body resembling a small hill, stirring up a raging wind as it let out a low roar, “Scythia, let’s go greet your mother, and then we can set off.”
The participation of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon in the great battle at the Human Race frontline made it feel a strong deficiency; it was not powerful enough.
Not to mention Jack Clark’s early Nine Layers of the Ninth Heavens cultivation, even the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s influence on the battlefield was only at a mid-to-low level.
As a Giant Beast in its Crimson Gigantification, it could only fight early Heavenly King-level strong men; as for those who had reached mid-period Heavenly King or even those who had begun to touch upon the Rules in the late period, it was no match for them.
This made the Thunderflame Demon Dragon feel as though it stood amongst the ranks like a minion.
However, the stage of this great battle did not belong to it. Next time, it would surely dominate the entire battlefield.
“Roar! No problem, let’s set off,” the Silver Giant Dragon, already impatient, let out an excited roar and spread its wings to soar into the sky.
Soon, the group of five Giant Beasts arrived at a mountain peak tens of thousands of meters high at the front end of the mountain ranges, and right after, the Silver Giant Dragon tucked its double wings and plummeted like a meteor.
Boom!
The explosion of Ice Crystals and rock mixed with the roaring wind sprayed out, but the moment they approached the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s scale armor, they were frozen into powder.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon opened its eyes somewhat helplessly; since its daughter had returned, it seemed like it hadn’t had a good night’s sleep.
Under the gaze of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon proudly spread its double wings and roared, “Roar! Mother, the Great Scythia is going to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon let out a deep, heavy roar, “Go, grow up quickly to reach Mythical-level, and listen to Tim Abott and Telsafi; they are ‘a little’ smarter than you.”
“Roar! The Great Scythia is also very smart,” the Silver Giant Dragon replied, a bit displeased.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon roared helplessly, “I know, so I only said they’re ‘a little’ smarter than you.”
This was more like it; the Silver Giant Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
As the Thunderflame Demon Dragon flew through the air, it gave a polite roar to the Blue-White Giant Dragon, “Princess Adriana, rest assured, I will take good care of Scythia.”
“Thank you for the trouble.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon gave one last instruction, “Telsafi, don’t go crazy with Scythia. The depths of the Chaotic Domain are very dangerous.”
Facing the Giant Beast that had stepped into the Ancient Titan level, the gold-blue giant dragon behaved very obediently, letting out a soft roar, “I know, Princess Adriana.”
After the greetings were exchanged, the group of five Giant Beasts turned and took off, soaring into the sky.
