Standing on the ferocious and immense head of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, the Purple little dragon pointed excitedly at the rising Golden Sun in the distance and shouted, “Ee-ya, ee-ya!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 940: 560
chapters.content:
Chapter 940: Chapter 560
As the mighty army set off, surging towards the Sky Curtain Battlefield, a black-red colored Mecha, towering a kilometer high, slowly approached the edge of a dark area spanning a thousand kilometers.
The aura emanating from Number One at this moment was extremely heavy, with an ancient aura swirling around it as if an enormous creature from ancient times had descended.
With each heavy step it took, Heaven and Earth trembled, distant mountain peaks collapsed one after another, and smoke and dust billowed with a terrifying momentum.
Upon reaching the edge of the space-time distortion emanated by Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation, Number One halted its steps, and a look of solemnity appeared in its eyes as it gazed forward.
Deep within the darkness, the vague silhouette of a massive, terrifying creature could be seen, its presence fearsome.
“Freya Louise, you’re not heading to the frontline?”
With a surprised voice rising, a will descended from the darkness ahead, taking the form of a figure with shoulder-length black hair.
Hum!
Number One vibrated slightly, and Freya Louise’s gentle voice transmitted: “I can’t participate in this grand battle. My cultivation is on the brink of a breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, driven by Number One, and I must return to Blue Star.”
Jack Clark mused: “Is it because of the Second Mythical Impact?”
After gaining higher clearance, Jack Clark had also reviewed the plans for Number One, understanding that Number One was the third-ranked “Person” who supports the heavens.
But with the failure and subsequent half-year’s recovery of the original Primordial True King’s secret test, Number One had become the first choice for the sequence.
Originally, there was also a Sky-based God King who planned to merge with ancient Divine Weapons and become ‘God’, but due to Jack Clark’s nurturing, Number One’s growth rate far exceeded everyone’s expectations.
It even began to awaken the remnants of souls of that ancient creature, scattered in the river of time at the moment of its fall, now on the verge of resurrection and awakening.
Number One nodded slightly, conveying Freya Louise’s voice: “Yes, during my breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, I will undergo the first fusion with Number One.”
“And this fusion step must be carried out on Blue Star, without interference from the mythical world.”
“We’ve reached this stage already, haven’t we?” muttered Jack Clark silently.
Freya Louise’s mission was to support the heavens, to prop up the Blue Star World.
This world didn’t refer to the universe in which Blue Star resided, but to the Star System centered on Blue Star, which was now enveloped by the mythical world.
As the power of the mythical world devoured the Star System, the whole system was gradually detaching from its original universe, becoming an independent, special realm.
The Second Mythical Impact marked the moment when the Star System containing Blue Star was completely devoured, plummeting into the mythical world.
The Human Race’s plan was to center a Supreme Level strong man as the core, with the Rule strength merging into the depths of the now stripped Blue Star World, becoming the ‘Heavenly Dao’.
A Great Era with an independent Heavenly Dao consciousness, compared to one without, differs greatly.
As the Heavenly Dao, it would be possible to mobilize the World Rules to resist devoured by the mythical world.
Though not escaping the grasp of the mythical world, it can choose to attach to the outside of the World Crystal Wall, becoming an independent and complete Great Era.
Unlike those worlds that exist within the crevices of the mythical world’s space, the successful Blue Star World would have its independent Rules, while also linking the mythical world with its original universe.
If successful, the chances of the Supreme Experts from the Blue Star’s native life forms breaking through to become Civilization Emperors and their True Bodies evolving into beings of a particular Rule set would increase by thirty percent.
If it fails, the only Human with hope of a Monarch-level breakthrough is Jack Clark, with even the First Councilor Adam Garcetti having less than a ten percent chance.
This is because the mainstream of the mythical world consists of Giant Beasts, and for different races that are not giant beasts, shattering the shackles of the mythical world and advancing to become Rule life forms is dozens of times more difficult than on Blue Star.
Or one could say there is no hope at all.
This is also why beings from different races who have lost their territories find it difficult to attain breakthroughs, even for powerful beings like Tyris and Tarodel, who have stood at the peak of ancient times for an extended period, unable to break these shackles.
Following the failure of the original Primordial True King’s test, it was found that even Supreme Experts might find it a bit forced to try supporting the heavens, or rather, it might be impossible.
For their Rules had not yet reached grand accomplishment; not yet becoming Rule Level life forms, how could they earn recognition from the Blue Star World and merge with the World Origin to become the Heavenly Dao?
Thus, the Sky-based Divine King gave up on testing altogether, placing hope on Number One instead.
As an ancient creature, before its fall, the life level and strength of Number One were undoubtedly above the level of a Monarch, meeting the basic requirements to support the heavens.
Combined with Freya Louise as Blue Star life’s ‘ticket’, as long as both sides complete the initial fusion, they could begin the process of supporting the heavens.
During the process of this plan, Freya Louise could also use the Origin force of the Blue Star World to cleanse the life imprints belonging to the ancient creature inside Number One’s body.
At this point, according to the calculations of Sky-based supercomputers, Freya Louise’s chances of success had reached sixty percent.
The remaining forty percent were influenced by the ancient creature itself, because plans are just plans, and the future is full of uncertainties that no one can predict.
As for an ancient existence that had fallen tens of thousands of years ago, and still held hope of resurrection and return, no one knew how strong it truly was!
If it fails…
Looking at the black-red colored Ferocious Mecha standing tall upon the Earth, gazing directly into those blue-white eyes emanating a Terrifying Aura, Jack Clark slowly said.
“Although in the calculations of the Sky-based computer, your success rate is already quite high, do not rush.”
“Once back, try to slow down the pace of supporting the heavens. It would be best to wait until after I’ve broken through to the Supreme level before taking the final step, so that if anything unexpected occurs, I can suppress it.”
Given Jack Clark’s terrifying accumulation, he was confident that, like the Destruction Emperor Dragon, when he stepped into the Supreme Level, he would possess the combat power of a Civilization Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 560
chapters.content:
Chapter 941: Chapter 560
“When the time comes to join hands with the even more powerful Destruction Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark was confident that he could suppress it with absolute strength, even if the ancient resurgence took place in the core essence of Number One.”
“Worst case, he’d just kill it once more.”
Watching Jack Clark’s calm and steady gaze, Freya Louise inside Number One nodded slightly and said softly, “Mm, I know, goodbye, Jack Clark.”
Having said her greetings, Number One slowly turned around and took large steps toward the rear, preparing to return to Blue Star.
Jack Clark’s will incarnation stood at the edge of darkness, watching Freya Louise pilot Number One away, without saying anything more.
Although this farewell might mean ‘a long time’ before seeing each other again, in this tumultuous era, both had their own goals and missions, so there was no display of sorrowful parting.
Any words would wait until after the Purgatory Demon Race had been dealt with.
After Freya had left, the phantom of Jack Clark’s will also dissipated.
Sitting atop the dragonhead of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Jack was enveloped in the force of a time curse as substantial as reality within the dark center that devoured everything like a black hole distorting reality.
The passage of time was so intense around him that the surrounding space-time altered and interlaced, casting multiple overlapping shadows of him.
It was as if dozens of Jack Clarks were seated in different time segments, in different space-times, simultaneously—an eerie sight.
Behind Jack, a transparent small river stretched over three thousand meters, atop which a black-haired young man in ferocious black-red war armor and wielding a black-gold battle halberd stood tall.
Compared to the shadowy outline of a few days prior, which was barely more than a few lines, this Time True Body had now coalesced into something tangible, exerting such an aura that it made the transparent river beneath it tremble.
Even after enduring for so long, with the replenishment of the Creation origin, Jack was unharmed, but the Purple little dragon beside him had already lost weight significantly, his eyes white and nearly frothing at the mouth.
Looking at the exhausted Purple little dragon, Jack spoke slowly, “Misss Joseline, hold on a bit longer, my Time True Body is just a step away from being fully formed.”
Compared to the initial task of forming the Time True Body amidst a past space-time shrouded by the constant flow of time, the difficulty now was so great that it took Jack by surprise.
Or perhaps this was the normal speed of cultivating the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power.
Hearing that she just had to hold on a little more, the Purple little dragon was revitalized.
Yiyaya!! Keep going, strive harder. Saying this, the Purple little dragon stuck out its tongue, took a deep breath, and exhaled a stream of fine purple pure energy from its mouth.
Boom!
The aura around Jack, which had just faltered, soared once again, his hair wild in the wind, and most of the strands at the front of his forehead had turned white.
…
Within the Human Race’s Territory.
When the sky-covering golden light swept across Heaven and Earth and stretched more than a thousand kilometers across both sky and land, the sight of the mighty army passing by the outskirts of base cities left everyone shocked.
“Who are those people on the ground, they look so strange and there are so many of them!?”
“I don’t know, but the sky-based battleships ahead should be our own, probably.”
“Those must be members of the Divine Gods Alliance, that one is from the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe, the Phantom Serpent Alien, I have seen them when I was on a training mission over there.”
“The ones flying in the sky are the Heavenly Feather Clan’s warships, I saw those golden battleships at No.1 Logistics Base City last month when delivering supplies.”
“But there are so many more of those golden battleships this time.”
“Yeah, those Heavenly Feather Clan members, there must be at least several million, and then there are the Alien Corps of the Divine Gods Alliance.”
“Hiss! These Alien Corps are appearing inside our Federation, heading towards the Sky Curtain Battlefield. Could it be that they’re here to support us?”
“More than just support, we can hold off the Purgatory Demon Race’s attacks even on a regular day. This must be not just mere support; we’re likely launching a counterattack.”
“Hahaha… Good, very good, we’ve finally reached the day when we strike back. To kill those damned Purgatory Demons…”
Although the Federation hadn’t announced it openly, seeing such a formidable mobilization, the cultivators were no fools; they all understood the reason for the Federation’s massive supplies mobilization.
Indeed, the Federation was initiating a war with the Purgatory Empire, joining forces with two other powers.
In spite of the vast expanse of over twenty thousand kilometers, even with several forbidden zones in between, the Alliance Army reached the Frontline Battlefield in just half a day.
Because of their swift march, it was only at this moment that the Purgatory Empire received the information from an internal traitor.
Across from the Frontline Battlefield, twenty thousand kilometers away, an outcry suddenly rose from the edge of a camp that stretched across thousands of kilometers, within a grim and covert castle.
“What, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s army and the Divine Gods Alliance Army were spotted in the Human Race’s hinterland?”
In a room with a black altar, a Purgatory True Demon’s face was filled with shock as it incredulously read the message that appeared on the Stone Disk.
“The news must be reported to the Lord immediately,” the True Demon in charge of gathering intelligence reacted quickly, vanishing into a shadowy trace at once.
Soon, the True Demon moved through the corridors of the castle palace and arrived at the top level of the palace, where a fearsomely powerful Purgatory True Demon sat upon a throne.
“Report to the Lord of the Palace, an urgent message from a spy: the Divine Gods Alliance Army and the Heavenly Feather Clan’s army have appeared in the Human Race’s hinterland, rapidly approaching the Frontline Battlefield,” the True Demon conveyed.
On the throne, the ferocious-looking Bruce’s face revealed a terrifying murderous intent, “The Divine Gods Alliance has some nerve to interfere in our clan’s war with the Human Race, courting death.”
“As for the Heavenly Feather Clan, weren’t their forces being suppressed and fought against by our three powerful empires, how could their army appear here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 560
chapters.content:
Chapter 942: Chapter 560
With that thought in mind, Brooks spoke in a heavy tone, “Have our spies from the Human Race side provided any detailed explanation of the strength of the Callum Deity Alliance and the Heavenly Feather Clan army?”
“This… No, they haven’t.” The Purgatory True Demon was taken aback.
“No.”
“Then, approximately how many Demon King Level Strong and Grand Demon King Level Strong did the opponent allocate to support their army?”
The Purgatory True Demon hesitated: “This… Lord, there is no such information either.”
Brooks’s brow furrowed, and his gaze suddenly turned icy: “It’s one thing to lack detailed information, but to not even have an approximate number, how am I supposed to assess the importance of the intelligence?”
“If this time the two clans merely made a token gesture, dispatching just a few armies to aid the Human Race, yet we reported it as if they were committing their full strength.”
“When His Majesty makes a misjudgment due to incorrect information, causing the impending war of annihilation to pause and missing the optimal timing to attack, neither you nor I can afford the responsibility.”
The True Demon’s heart trembled instantaneously, and he quickly knelt down: “Yes, it is due to my lack of thoroughness in handling the matter, not inquiring carefully, I ask for Lord of the Palace to grant forgiveness.”
Brooks barked out: “Immediately go back and inquire from that human we turned, the more detailed the better regarding the strength of the two clans’ support.”
“Yes, Lord of the Palace.”
The True Demon, with a head full of sweat and not daring to delay, immediately rushed out of the office.
And just after that True Demon left, Brooks’s expression became solemn.
Indeed, there were still many within the human inner circle who had been turned by the Purgatory Empire.
Fortunately, since returning from my studies in the Purgatory Empire, I chose to take over the Human Race’s secret intelligence department, allowing me to intercept all information about that side in real-time.
If I can drag things out here a bit longer, I should be able to disrupt the Frontline as soon as the Purgatory Empire realizes what’s happening.
Thinking this, Brooks looked at the grey stone table in front of him with a cold gaze.
Hum! As Brooks laid his hand on the stone table, the control center of the Demon Palace, the stone table vibrated, and countless dark demon patterns flickered and floated above it.
The demon patterns spread out, forming a vast phantom of a Demon Palace in the air with nine levels, resembling a pyramid condensed from a Demon Array, with over a hundred rooms spread below it.
At this moment, most of these rooms were bustling with Purgatory True Demons, each responsible for a separate intelligence team.
These intelligence teams were scattered around the Human Race, at the edges of the Outer Development Department, and on the Frontline Battlefield, with even several secret lines within Blue Star.
The task of these teams was to turn, and collect all sorts of information about the Human Race.
At this time, the liaison demon responsible for infiltrating the human inner circle intelligence team had already returned to the sixth-level room and stood before a stone disk inscribed with demon patterns.
The True Demon placed a Black Crystal in the center of the stone disk and then maneuvered more than a dozen inscriptions on the disk.
Hum!
As the ‘number dialed’, the stone disk vibrated, and under the activation of the Demon Array, an invisible piece of information pierced through the Void and was sent towards the coordinates of another stone disk far away.
Soon there was a response from the other side, and a blurred shadow appeared on the stone disk.
Immediately, the True Demon asked anxiously, “Bert Richards, I forgot to ask earlier, approximately how many armies are supporting the Human Race?”
“There are many, warships alone have… Hiss!!”
The linked Spiritual Will was just about to reply when it suddenly dispersed with a hiss. The True Demon was taken aback: “This is unfortunate, the connection was disrupted by a Void Storm just as it was established?”
This wasn’t the first time such an incident had occurred, and the True Demon could only lament their bad luck, then replaced the Magic Crystal and redialed the number.
“This delaying tactic can only be used up to three times at most, or it will raise suspicion,” Brooks said coldly from the top of the Demon Palace.
While Brooks was delaying the Purgatory Empire’s reaction, Jack Clark opened his eyes again. In front of him, the Purple little dragon, weakly lying on the head of the Emperor Dragon, had its eyes rolled back.
It seemed close to convulsing.
Yi yi ya ya!! Brother, are you alright now? Misss Joseline, Misss Joseline can’t do it anymore.
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “No worries, it’s already taken care of.”
Behind him, a figure on a transparent river that meandered for miles became completely substantial, emitting a Terrifying Aura that was no less than the original.
Boom!
Jack Clark took a step, and the invisible power emanating from him caused the whole place to vibrate; he then disappeared along with the transparent river, turning into silver Radiance.
Suddenly, a strand of Jack Clark’s hair at his forehead turned silver, adding a mature vibe to his appearance.
Meanwhile, beneath the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Time-Space Summoning Altar covering a hundred kilometers blossomed with bright light, turning into numerous Rune Sequence Chains retracting towards Jack Clark’s left hand.
Without the maintenance of the Summoning Secret Skill, the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had stood its post for three days had time and space twisted around it, and it disappeared along with the Purple little dragon.
With the suppression from the Destruction Emperor Dragon gone, the distorted dark area exploded with a roar, forming a violent eruption of Heavenly Energy blasting in all directions.
Amidst the raging blasts, a beam of light soared into the sky, speeding towards the Sky Curtain Battlefield at a terrifying speed.
“Humans, you’re seeking death.”
Sky Curtain Battlefield.
The moment the Alliance Army appeared, Demon God Belidier, who was confronting the First Councilor Adam Garcetti above the Firmament, let out an enraged roar.
Perceiving the approach of five Demon God Level Terrifying Auras zooming towards the sky at breakneck speed, Belidier was taken aback.
Above ten thousand miles, Adam Garcetti, who held command over the Sky Curtain Battlefield, suddenly opened his eyes wide and let out a long howl: “Take action.”
Boom boom boom!! In an instant, heaven and earth shattered, towering figures descended above the Human Base, hurtling towards the “Act now!” over twenty thousand kilometers away.

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 398: The Ferocious Mother Dragon, For the Great Purgatory True Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 944 - 398: The Ferocious Mother Dragon, For the Great Purgatory True Demon
Blue Star, Mist River City, headquarters of the 7th Metal Refining Group.
Doris Clark followed the secretary to the top-floor office.
The secretary, a woman in her early twenties with a sweet and capable appearance, knocked on the door and respectfully said, "Chairman, Manager Clark has arrived."
A gentle voice came from inside, "Please let her in."
The secretary was mildly surprised by this attitude and then turned back to Doris Clark with a smile, "Manager Clark, please go in." She even helped Doris open the door.
Doris Clark was somewhat flattered and nodded politely before entering.
In the luxurious and stylish office, a man in his fifties standing behind the desk already stood up, his face showing a warm smile, "Manager Clark, you're here. Come, sit down and talk."
"Chairman."
Doris Clark walked over and sat down somewhat restrainedly, unsure of what the chairman of the neighboring headquarters building wanted with her.
After Doris Clark sat down, the chairman spoke in a gentle tone, "Manager Clark, you have been working at the company for over a decade now. Over these years, do you have any feedback for the company?"
Doris Clark hesitated, unsure why this concerned her as a regular production department manager, then she spoke up somewhat restrainedly, "I think every aspect of the company is very good."
"Manager Clark, there's no need to hold back, I called you here today mainly to discuss the matter of your position change."
"Recently, one of the group's vice-managers resigned due to health reasons, and I've been considering potential replacements for his work."
"Considering Manager Clark's performance over the years, I think you would be quite suitable for this position, so I had the secretary invite you to discuss your thoughts on this."
"Of course, if you are not satisfied with this position, I could also recommend you to the Federal Alloy Refining Group in Capital City. There have been some important vacancies there recently."
"Actually, I have a preference for you to go to the capital. As one of the three centers of the Federation, it would be better for your future development."
"This?" In that moment, Doris Clark was utterly dumbfounded.
She was a manager who just got promoted a few months ago, now suddenly being promoted to vice-manager of the group—wasn't the promotion happening a bit too fast?
And as for the Federal Alloy Refining Group in the capital, her family didn't have connections there, did they?
Something unusual was definitely at hand. At this thought, Doris Clark became vigilant.
Noticing the change in Doris Clark's expression, the chairman smiled and said, "Manager Clark, don't think too much, in fact, this promotion has something to do with Mr. Callum's."
Ten or so minutes later, when Doris Clark walked out of the office, she still looked somewhat dazed.
According to the chairman, it was Jack Clark, known as one of the most dazzling geniuses of the Federation, who had made outstanding contributions to the Federation after entering the mythical world last month.
For those who made such contributions to the Human Race, the Federation not only awarded them with sufficient Merit Points but also took care of their families to ease the warriors' concerns for their loved ones.
It was also today that Doris Clark found out that their company was actually a small department under the Federation's chief metal refining group, specialized in producing the outer casings for the 49-1 type missiles.
But these were not important, what was important was that her eldest son seemed to have made another breakthrough in his cultivation, becoming even stronger.
At six o'clock in the afternoon, Glenn Clark, over 2 meters tall, muscular and burly, yet still with the fresh-faced features of a junior high school student, returned home with a backpack.
But as soon as he entered the shabby neighborhood street, he noticed that changes had taken place around, for example, many areas of the street had been blocked off as if they were under construction.
Even a few houses not far from theirs, which were fine in the morning, were now surrounded by metal sheets, with rumbling smoke and dust emanating from within.
Stepping into the courtyard, Glenn Clark saw his mom wearing an apron and chatting with the aunty next door.
After greeting the aunty, Glenn Clark asked curiously, "Mom, are they going to demolish our place?"
Doris Clark shook her head, "Not demolition, just renovating the roads a bit. Oh, and those houses over there have been sold and are being remodeled, looks like they're building some kind of office."
Oh. Glenn nodded.
"By the way, Jack sent some stuff by courier for you, advised you to drink one bottle each day, and after drinking it, you won't feel that hungry."
Glenn's eyes lit up at once, "Brother sent me stuff, I'll go check it out."
Saying that, Glenn Clark ran into the house excitedly.
...
Above the sea of clouds at an altitude of tens of thousands of meters, five giant beasts, each at least two hundred and ninety meters in size, were flying, surrounded by sonic booms and rolling air waves.
On the head of the largest and most powerful black-red Colossal Beast at the forefront, a Purple little dragon two meters long with a slender body kept issuing naive cries.
At that moment, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, with its double fins in motion, resembling a giant whale soaring through the clouds, curiously cried out, roar! Thunderflame, what is Joseline saying?
Thunderflame Demon Dragon glanced over slightly, a weird gleam in its eyes as it growled, "Nothing much, just things about slaughtering everyone, seizing everything, and dominating the Chaotic Turbulent Region."
Immediately, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish's eyes brightened.
Roar! Joseline is right, our Dragon Palace should kill everyone, seize everything and eradicate all Giant Beasts to dominate the Vast World, become invincible.
The Purple little dragon stood upright on the Thunderflame Demon Dragon's head, both claws on its hips, nodding to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, roar!
Roar! Thunderflame, what else did Joseline say?
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon's gaze was odd, "It says you're a good little brother with firm beliefs. You may follow it from now on."

chapters.title: Chapter 945: 398: The Fierce Mother Dragon, For the Great Purgatory True Demon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 945: Chapter 398: The Fierce Mother Dragon, For the Great Purgatory True Demon_2
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s huge eyes widened: “Roar! Little brother? Shouldn’t I be Misss Joseline’s brother too?”
The Purple little dragon looked up with its dragon head, and in its agile purple and gold Dragon Eyes, a disdainful look showed as it extended its left claw toward the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish: “Chirp chirp chirp!”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish looked blankly at the Thunderflame Demon Dragon: “Roar? Thunderflame, what did Misss Joseline say again?”
The Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s lips curled slightly, revealing a ferocious smile, “It said you’re too weak, not even able to beat a Mythical Giant Beast, and not qualified to be its brother.”
“Roar! True, Joe is too weak.”
The flying Silver Giant Dragon roared triumphantly on the other side, “Roar! Only the Great Sethia is formidable. It reached Mythical-level strength just over a hundred Sun Wheels after hatching.”
With a body that broke through the quasi-mythical limit and boasting two Top Tier Talents that touched upon the law, one of which was the Higher-order Law of space, the Silver Giant Dragon was, in a sense, no different from a Mythical Giant Beast.
At that moment, the Red Beast, with its long tail having followed the group of beasts for half a day, suddenly growled lowly at the nearby elegant gold and blue Giant Dragon with its double wings spread.
“Welcome, Crystal, Dragon, King, to, join, the, dragon, palace.”
Instantly, the gold and blue Giant Dragon, which had been flying for a good part of the day, was taken aback and turned to look at the quasi-mythical behemoth that had been silent from the beginning with a puzzled expression in its eyes.
“Roar! Telsafi, didn’t the Great Sethia say? Because the Candle Dragon’s law involves time, its reactions are quite slow.”
The gold and blue Giant Dragon nodded in sudden realization, okay, understood. But then it roared.
“Sethia, how many times has the Great Torsa said, don’t call me Crystal Dragon King, my Title is Heaven Star Collapse, Heaven Star Collapse Dragon King, got it?”
“Roar! Got it, Torsa.”
Following that, the Silver Giant Dragon continued to growl lowly, “But the Great Sethia still thinks Crystal Dragon King sounds nicer; Heaven Star Collapse doesn’t look as good.”
The gold and blue Giant Dragon developed a few lines on its forehead… a Title also has to look good?
Just then, the Silver Giant Dragon suddenly cheered, “Torsa, look quickly, the flowers of the Cladis Sea are blooming, so pretty!”
As the Silver Giant Dragon roared, the Cloud Mist ahead dispersed, revealing the hundreds of kilometers of lake below.
At this time, the vast expanse of the lake was covered with countless gold and red flowers, each with a diameter between two and three meters. They bore some resemblance to lotus flowers but were even more delicate.
The endless sea of flowers was like a golden carpet spread across the lake—such a scene made even the Thunderflame Demon Dragon reveal surprise, and the eyes of the gold and blue Giant Dragon also lit up.
“Roar! Torsa, let’s go down there and have fun.” Caught up in the excitement, the Silver Giant Dragon, like a colossal Aerospace Aircraft Carrier, drifted downward with its double wings stirring up a raging wind.
“Wait for me, Sethia.” The gold and blue Giant Dragon also roared excitedly as it followed suit.
Chirp chirp chirp! The Purple little dragon atop the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s head also lit up, making a sweet, childish sound, waving its tiny claws and urging the Thunderflame Demon Dragon to go down quickly too.
Though they were Giant Dragon creatures, whether a human girl or a dragon, if they were feminine, they couldn’t resist such a sight.
Seeing this, the massive body of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon also sank slightly, ready to follow them down for a visit.
But just then, the Silver Giant Dragon, which had descended to an altitude of a thousand meters, gathered a Green Storm in its double wings and with a fierce flap, suddenly two sky-reaching, earth-penetrating tornadoes descended from the heavens.
Boom boom boom! With a diameter of a hundred meters and reaching thousands of meters high, the Tornado swept across the lake’s surface violently, shredding numerous golden flowers and mixing them with the lake’s water to surge into the sky.
And as the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, more Tornadoes kept forming, stirring Heaven and Earth with a grand momentum.
Roar!
The gold and blue Giant Dragon emitted a proud roar as well, with several ten-meter-sized crystals, radiating red, blue, purple halos and the like, forming around it, dropping like cannonballs from the sky.
Boom boom boom boom!!
Terrifying explosions erupted over the lake surface, each of these crystals as powerful as a intercontinental missile and containing various kinds of Attribute Energy, exceedingly fearsome.
Under the dreadful blasts, golden flowers within a radius of several kilometers were instantly destroyed, countless Unique Beasts ranging from several to scores of meters in length leapt madly from the lake.
In just an instant, this quiet and beautiful golden flower lake was filled with the howling of a hurricane, the thundering of explosions, and covered with the corpses of fish Unique Beasts.
This scene left the Thunderflame Demon Dragon somewhat speechless; right, it had forgotten about the Giant Dragon’s fierce and destructive nature.
Chirp chirp chirp! The Purple little dragon on the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s head became even more excited, waving its tiny claws and flying right down, appearing like a streak of purple radiance in the sky above the lake.
There, a Unique Beast resembling a golden koi, over ten meters long with scales all over its body and two Dragon Whiskers, had just leapt out of the water.
Roar! A huge, over ten meter purple dragon head suddenly appeared, swallowing the Unique Beast in one gulp.
Then as the dragon head shrank back, it revealed a contented Purple little dragon on its face, its small claws patting its belly, looking very pleased at the constantly leaping fish Unique Beasts around it.
Boom! Just then, a jet of white Ice Flame burst forth from the Silver Giant Dragon’s mouth, hitting the lake and exploding like a nuclear blast, with a skyful of Ice Crystal fragments and shockwaves sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
“Roar! The Great Sethia is invincible.”
“Roar! And so is the Great Torsa.” Accompanying the roaring, the gold and blue Giant Dragon furiously spread its double wings, the diamond-like scales on the edges emitting a dazzling light.
Boom boom boom!! A series of colorful Light Beams rained down from the sky, causing loud explosions on the lake’s surface, sweeping across an area of over ten kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 946: 398: The Ferocious Mother Dragon, For the Great Purgatory True Demon_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 946: Chapter 398: The Ferocious Mother Dragon, For the Great Purgatory True Demon_3
Under the rampage of two quasi-mythical giant dragons with monarch-level bloodlines, the entire lake seemed as if doomsday had arrived.
Immediately, the corners of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s mouth twitched involuntarily.
It finally understood why the Blue-White Giant Dragon, when leaving, had told the elegant and beautiful golden blue giant dragon, resembling a noble miss, not to go crazy with the Silver Giant Dragon.
After about half an hour of wanton ravaging, destroying the vast lake once over and barely leaving a few intact golden flowers on the surface, the two giant dragons soared skywards, satisfied.
Squeak, squeak!
The Purple little dragon slumped onto the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s head, its belly bulging; it had followed the two rampaging giant dragons and gobbled up many of those golden carp-like Exotic Beasts with dragon whiskers.
From the territory of the Blue-White Giant Dragon to the Chaotic Turbulent Region, they had to diagonally cross the domain of the golden blue giant dragon’s mother, with some distance to go even after passing through.
According to the description of the two giant dragons, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon estimated the distance to be over thirty thousand kilometers.
At the cruising flight speed of four hundred meters per second, after the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s breakthrough to Late Stage 9, it would almost take about ten days to fly this distance.
That was under normal circumstances; if they had to detour around some dangerous forbidden areas on the way or explore for some treasures, it might take half a month.
This is the difference between species; as a whale, even after evolving to Level 9, the speed of flight under the influence of domain power is still slow, and it’s only several times faster during a Burst in combat.
However, for the creatures of the mythical world where ‘one day’ equates to over a month, this seems to be only half a day’s time…
Meanwhile, as the Thunderflame Demon Dragon was en route to the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Opposite the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, where Purgatory Family and Human Race were engaged in battle, behind mountain ranges rising tens of thousands of meters, numerous barracks and Military Bases stood tall.
Right now, within one of the Purgatory Family’s main base, in a dark room that seemed like a prison and stood a hundred meters tall, a Purgatory True Demon was busy working.
This Purgatory Demon maintained its normal shape, standing four meters tall, clad in dark red armor with dark red fine scales visible on its arms, cheeks, and neck.
Before it, a large research apparatus featured a glass chamber in the middle, containing a Purgatory Demon’s head with many wires connected to its surface.
At this moment, the computer monitor displayed data refreshing frenetically, with synthetic images and graphics on the side.
After about half an hour, the device halted and a look of pity flashed across the vicious face of the Purgatory Demon.
“Indeed, the genetic differences between species are vast; even though we both have brains, decoding the cell information of the brain cortex is still too challenging.”
“Brooks, the legion commander orders a strategy meeting.”
“I’m on my way.”
Saying this, the Purgatory True Demon stored the machinery into its Storage Space and then its gaze turned icy cold, assuming the Purgatory Family’s characteristic contemptuous arrogance.
Stepping out of the shadowy and enclosed room, a somewhat chaotic base came into view for Brooks.
Figures of Purgatory Demons with Six and Seven Demonic Marks roamed the base everywhere, and huge Flying Exotic Beasts periodically soared overhead.
As Brooks walked through with heavy steps, the passing Purgatory True Demons showed him a look of respect on their faces.
Soon, Brooks arrived at the center of the base. There, a towering castle of the demon king spanned over tens of kilometers and reached a kilometer high, with numerous Purgatory True Demons emanating powerful auras converging there.
Brooks flew into the castle, to a majestic and vast Great Hall, and skillfully found a corner to sit down.
But as soon as Brooks had settled, a Purgatory True Demon with Eight Path Demon Marks and two pairs of forked horns approached him, gazing at him curiously.
“Brother, I am the five ten-thousandth commander of the Taro Bone Corps, Gulden.”
Brooks gave the Purgatory True Demon a glance, speaking with a deep voice: “I am Brooks.”
The Horned Split True Demon seemed overly familiar, looking at the imposing dark red True Demon before him and asked with curiosity, “Brother Brooks, which legion do you come from?”
“I’m from the Quesamodo Legion.”
Hiss!
The Horned Split True Demon sucked in a breath of cold air, a solemn respect painting his face: “I had not expected Brother Brooks to be from the empire’s strongest legion.”
Brooks sighed slightly, “The strongest legion is now past; most of our True Demon soldiers perished under that one Destructive Breath.”
The Horned Split True Demon consoled: “Brother Brooks, there’s no need to be sad; dying on the battlefield is an honor for us, great Purgatory True Demon soldiers.”
“Still, the casualties this time were indeed severe; four of our Main Battle Legions have been decimated. Eleven Vassal legions have been wiped out, and others have suffered heavy losses too.”
“Especially the legions that faced the humans’ Biological Mecha monster directly; they were completely obliterated—truly tragic.”
“Of course, the unluckiest was your Quesamodo Legion. Despite having retreated so far, to be wiped out directly by the terrifying Red Beast’s Breath… it’s too unfortunate.”
Even the Horned Split True Demon couldn’t help but feel sorry for the misfortune of Brooks’ legion while saying this.
Soon, as the two True Demons chatted casually—mainly the conversational Horned Split True Demon—the vast Great Hall gradually filled with Purgatory True Demons with Eight and Nine Demonic Marks.
Then, several figures emanating the presence of demon kings and Great Demon Kings appeared upon the Demon Pillars at the front.

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - 399 Demon God’s Curse, Exchange for a Large Amount of Resources
chapters.content:
Chapter 947: Chapter 399 Demon God’s Curse, Exchange for a Large Amount of Resources
In the solemn Great Hall, as the figures of three Demon Kings and one Great Demon King emerged on the Demon Pillar, the hundreds of high-order Purgatory True Demons below stirred.
Beside Brudos, the Split True Demon with forked horns gleamed with excitement, whispering in a subdued voice, “Brother, look quickly, it’s Great Demon King Barus.”
Brudos’s gaze flickered slightly before he spoke softly, “Have you seen this Great Demon King Barus before?”
“Not only have I seen him, but I often heard of the legends of Great Demon King Barus when I was in the army camps. He is the idol of us True Demons who have transformed from different races.”
The Split True Demon said excitedly, “As a True Demon of the different races, not only has he achieved the status of Great Demon King, but he has also been entrusted with a heavy duty, becoming one of the heads of the Purgatory Ancestral Court’s Assassination Department.”
“It is said that many human geniuses, elite strong men, and even king-level individuals have perished under his leadership, and he has also done an excellent job suppressing and infiltrating the neighboring ordinary different races’ forces.”
“Beside that, Lord Barus is also very brave in battle. In this war with the Human Race, he alone withstood that terrifying Deep Red Giant Beast for a long time…”
As the Split True Demon spoke of the various glorious achievements of Great Demon King Barus, a Demon King slowly began to speak, his voice cold and commanding.
“Silence.”
After all the Purgatory True Demons below became solemn, the aloof Barus, standing on the Demon Pillar with an indifferent demeanor, finally spoke dispassionately, “I am Great Demon King Barus, and I have called you here to select a portion of elites to join my Assassination Department.”
“Due to the fall of the Primordial Stars, changes have occurred in the space-time ahead, blocking the connection with the Human Race.”
“Following this, aside from leaving two armies stationed here, all the mighty armies will withdraw and head to the Sky Curtain Battlefield…”
Just as Barus was preparing to select the elites from among the high-order Purgatory True Demons of the scattered army corps to enhance the strength of the Assassination Department.
High above, tens of thousands of kilometers away, a figure shrouded in the sea of Dark Demon Air spoke in a deep voice, “The world evolved from this Primordial Beast is merging with this World, and if we go in there…”
Seated high on the throne made from the skulls of ancient beings, Diorus’s gaze was icy, “Primordial Creatures have touched Eternity; it’s not so easy for them to perish, and if we’re bold enough to go in, be careful not to be swallowed in one gulp.”
Looking at the unending white mist forbidden area stretching out on both sides, Diorus slowly said, “We should still focus on how to deal with the human race.”
“This time, not only did we fail to deal a heavy blow to the Human Race, but we also suffered tremendous losses ourselves, plus the previously fallen ones like Augusta and others, we have lost more than ten Demon Kings between a few Sun Wheels.”
“And those fallen Demon Kings, as well as that person called Darren Callum, whose real name is Jack Clark, have all been related to the human.”
“Based on what Barus said, the human’s realm was only at Six Path Devil Marks three or four Sun Wheels ago, and in what seemed like the blink of an eye, he has grown to the extent where he can affect the course of certain Civilization Wars.”
“Such potential makes it clear he should be the one the luck of the human world, which is about to be ruined, favors. If we can exterminate him, we can cut off the future of the Human Race.”
Over so many thousands of years, The Purgatory Family has annihilated many civilized races while expanding its Territory and naturally has become familiar with ‘Luck’ as well.”
Especially when those different race civilizations faced extinction crises, the shining talents that emerged during their final bursts of energy inflicted no small losses on The Purgatory Family.
Therefore, such monsters are the focus of The Purgatory Family’s attention, and once a suspected individual is discovered, they are exterminated with the force of Thunder, denying those geniuses any chance for growth.
However, compared to most ordinary different races’ civilizations that perished quickly, the human race is stronger and grows faster, requiring more attention.
This is also the reason Diorus personally reinforced from the rear with one Demon God Descendant, ten Demon Kings, and two Great Demon Kings.
It’s just that the human side seemed to have realized something and reinforced with some strength from their rear, causing this plan to fail.
Whoosh! Just then, the void distorted and shattered in the distance, giving way to a black shriveled head only about twenty meters in diameter surrounded by strands of black smoke.
In an instant, a Terrifying Aura spread out.
At the same time, a deep and cold voice came from the opposite side of the broken void, “Diorus, don’t forget the promise you made to me.”
Looking at the black head that emitted a terrible Aura, Diorus spoke sternly, “Rest assured, Tyris, the next time you battle Tarotio, I will make a move once.”
“Very well.”
As a low and satisfied voice echoed, the void slowly healed, leaving only the black head floating.
Boom! Diorus reached out and grasped the huge and ferocious black head in his hand.
Feeling the strong Rule Curse power on it, Diorus’s voice was deep, “Earlier I destroyed a Rule Forbidden Weapon on that human with a single strike; this time, I will utterly curse and kill him.”
In the final moment of the previous great battle, Diorus sacrificed a Rule-Level True Body arm to attack Jack Clark — not in a true fit of rage devoid of rationality, but in preparation for this curse killing.
Their Purgatory Demon descendants who showed monster talent were each granted a bloodline mark by the demon gods of their respective empires, enough to withstand a Rule Level attack once.
Given the monstrous talent of that person named Darren, the strong men of the Human Race would certainly provide similar protection to him.
Holding the black ferocious head, Diorus slowly said, “Carthius, when I curse and kill that human, I will rely on you to handle the backlash from cause and effect.”

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 399 Demon God’s Curse, Exchanging for a Large Amount of Resources_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 948: Chapter 399 Demon God’s Curse, Exchanging for a Large Amount of Resources_2
The figure shrouded in the ocean of demon gas nodded slightly.
Wanting to curse a ‘Person’ through the void was not so simple, even if Diorus was a Demon God Level powerhouse, he had to use the causation from a previous encounter with Jack Clark as a price to burn, and subsequently employ a forbidden weapon crafted by a demon god proficient in the laws of cursing to launch a precise curse.
Furthermore, at the instant the curse was initiated, a backlash from the causation would also form an attack of the same level.
……
At Heavenly Abyss City, inside the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark sat cross-legged.
One day after returning, the aura on Jack Clark’s body had stabilized and returned to normal, for unlike those kings who had burned their origins, what he had depleted was only his True Strength and Qi Blood.
As for the price of summoning the heavily powerful Thunderflame Demon Dragon True Body for an extended period… Jack Clark lowered his head slightly and looked at his left hand.
Centered around the Time-Space Mark on the back of his hand, a series of wave-like silver lines spread, entwining his entire arm.
Simultaneously, a row of transparent text emerged before Jack Clark’s eyes.
“Abnormal state of time erosion, stemming from the backlash of summoning the Giant Beast Avatar beyond normal limits. Each subsequent use of the Time-Space Mark will deepen the erosion marks.”
“Alert! When the marks of time erosion accumulate to a certain extent, it will attract the attention of life forms that feed on time. Please use caution.”
“Life forms that feed on time.” A grave look appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
Time belongs to a conceptual kind of power, existing but not clearly perceptible, influencing and measured only through the power it exerts.
Even in the vast expanse of the mythical world, transcendent life forms related to time are extremely rare; so far, Jack Clark knew only of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon and Scythia’s father.
He had not expected that life forms that fed on time existed and could only imagine how dangerous they must be.
It seems that in the future, he would need to be more cautious when using the summoning secret skill. Jack Clark thought gravely.
He certainly did not want to be suddenly swallowed by some unknown powerful creature one day, potentially getting lost forever in the endless space-time, even if he were not to die.
As Jack Clark contemplated, suddenly a black mark appeared on his brow, and his Heart’s Eye sixth sense detected an intense sense of danger—very dangerous, an acute peril.
In an instant, Jack Clark was startled.
Boom! An aura of terrifying will burst forth from Jack Clark, sweeping across several kilometers, but to his shock, he detected nothing.
But at that moment, Jack Clark’s consciousness sunk into a daze and he found himself in a pitch-black and distant void, where a towering figure with three heads and twelve arms stood tall, reaching ten thousand meters in height.
This formidable being appeared to overshadow the world like a deity, standing in the void, surrounded by a dark red glow that intertwined to evolve into a real existing hell.
When Jack Clark’s figure emerged, a massive, boundless black beast head appeared in front of the towering figure and silently opened wide to devour him.
Boom! Inside the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark’s consciousness vibrated, and he instantly regained clarity, his face turning white as he gasped for breath.
Crack! A cracking sound came from Jack Clark’s chest, and the True King Beast Seal worn around his neck, shaped like a beast head, started to show a network of cracks.
Bang!
The True King Beast Seal exploded suddenly, turning into a powerful surge of energy mixed with a blast of black smoke, sweeping across the entire Cultivation Room. Amidst the blowing wind, Jack Clark’s hair fluttered and his face grew pale.
He had just been hit with a curse. Had it not been for the True King Beast Seal provided by the Third Councilor, he would have been killed by the curse woven from causation by his opponent.
It was no wonder the Purgatory Family had so many methods at their disposal.
That Jack Clark might be cursed was something the supreme experts of the Human Race had anticipated long ago and had provided all-around protection for him, or else there could have been a real possibility of mishap, which even if not fatal, could have resulted in severe injury.
“Purgatory True Demon.”
Jack Clark’s expression was cold as he vanished in the blink of an eye, transforming into a streak of light that passed through several security checks to arrive at the Logistics Department of Heavenly Abyss City.
Choosing a room of over ten square meters, completely empty, Jack Clark said solemnly, “Vava, bring up my information.”
Hum!
Ripples flowed across the front wall, revealing Jack Clark’s detailed information. His rank had been promoted from Major General to General, and his merit had increased to over 800,000.
In this Civilization Great War, Jack Clark slaughtered a large number of high-order members of the Purgatory Demon Race, including the Legion commanders of the Nine Demonic Marks and even a few demon kings in direct confrontation.
For example, the Mid-Myth Dark Giant Beast, the demon king killed by the orbital bombardment, and another Late-Myth demon king that he later crushed to death with his bare hands.
Besides, during the clash at the center of the battlefield, he severely injured several other demon kings including the Crimson Giant Beast, and captured an Early-Myth demon king to feed to Number One.
He also heavily wounded Great Demon King Barus and another Great Demon King Jimtor; though he did not kill them, he still inflicted damage on the enemy.
All things counted, the merit settlement awarded him 810,000 points as a reward, equivalent to the heads of eight demon kings.
Such an enormous amount of merit was enough for Jack Clark to exchange Life Crystals to enhance all the talents of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon to God Transformation Level, and the remainder was more than enough to exchange for the God-level resources needed for cultivation.
And yet, Jack Clark’s original target in this battle was simply to rampage through the Transcendent battlefield, slaughtering dozens or hundreds of the high-order Demon Race, pretending to kill a few ordinary demon kings would suffice.
He did not expect the battle to become so fierce.
While this time Jack Clark’s gain in merit seems astonishing, his losses are also substantial. For instance, the time erosion marks entwined around his arm, and the two Rule-level life-saving forbidden weapons.
Especially those two forbidden weapons, capable of withstanding a blow from a Demon God and carrying Rule-level curses. Their value, in some respects, might be higher than the merit Jack Clark gained this time.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark couldn’t help but give a wry smile—it was a matter of give and take.
Even though he lost two Rule-level forbidden weapons this time, the Demon God also suffered significant losses.
For Supreme Experts, losing an arm is not a minor injury.
The True Body of a king-level being can recover by consuming the Laws’ Origin, and the Heavenly King is even transformed into rules, formless in gathering and dispersing. But once at the Supreme Level, the True Body becomes extremely important again.
The difference is akin to that between Soul Power and Soul Source, it relates to the hope of advancing further into Demon God Level, which is why the four Supreme Demon God Level beings engaged in a rule-dominated battle at that time.
Demon God Carthius was enraged because his True Body of the Demon God was cracked by the True Martial Stone Tablet and the Demonic God’s Essence Blood was wiped out by the force of the True Martial Heavenly King.
Jack Clark said solemnly, “Vava, what level of resources am I currently able to mobilize?”
“Currently, General Clark, your authority has been elevated to that of a Councilor. You can mobilize all Federation resources including Law-level resources and browse the corresponding confidential information.”
Jack Clark nodded in satisfaction; this was what he had fought so desperately for.
“Vava, gather crystals from within the Federation’s territory, equivalent to 400,000 merits, whether Level 1 or Level 9,” he commanded. This time he wanted to enhance all the talents of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon to the utmost, transforming them into laws.
Once the nine Higher-order Laws tempered his Mythical True Body, even if the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s Growth Level remained at the Early Myth stage, its strength would reach a terrifying level.
Moreover, to quickly enhance his own strength, Jack Clark didn’t bother with the allocation quotas of these Life Crystals and forcibly gathered these resources.
“Vava, with the remaining 400,000 merits, help me exchange them all for God-level resources that will enhance the Innate Demon God True Body,” he instructed.
In response to Jack Clark’s command, the figure of a silver-haired girl with red eyes appeared on the wall, politely saying,
“General Clark, the amount of Life Crystals and God-level resources you requested to exchange is massive. I need to contact Roger and mobilize from the logistics of various base cities, which will take two days.”
Jack Clark’s expression remained calm as he said indifferently, “No problem, I can wait.”
The near-death experience from the curse had instilled a sense of acute crisis in Jack Clark. He needed to become stronger in a short period, powerful enough to ignore assassination attempts from the Purgatory Demon Race.
And taking hits without retaliating was not his style.
Once he breaks through to king-level, it would be the beginning of a nightmare for his enemies.
As Jack Clark sat cross-legged waiting, the small-scale transmission rune array beneath the left wall kept flickering, and boxes containing resources and Life Crystals continuously appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 949 - 400 Heaven and Earth’s Gift, Destruction Emperor Dragon . Cang
chapters.content:
Chapter 949: Chapter 400 Heaven and Earth’s Gift, Destruction Emperor Dragon . Cang
After spending nearly half a day gathering and transporting, the silver-haired girl on the wall bowed slightly.
“General Clark, we have allocated 165,700 contribution points from Life Crystals currently. It will take two more days to gather the remaining crystals from within Blue Star,” she said.
Jack Clark nodded slightly at the stack of jade boxes before him, “Let me know when the rest arrive.”
Due to the rule of exhausting resources for immediate transformation into racial strength, the Federation’s stockpile of Life Crystals was never abundant.
After using over one hundred thousand contribution points to transfer all the Life Crystals from the Logistics Departments of various base cities in the mythical world, the remaining ones from within Blue Star needed to be rotated.
To this, Jack Clark was indifferent.
He hadn’t planned on using the resources intended for the Martial Arts School and the regular armies’ cultivation, but now, wishing to quickly enhance his strength, he had to burden the freshmen a bit.
After all, once his strength improved rapidly in a short time, the pressure on The Purgatory Family would intensify, and then the students would have more time for peaceful cultivation.
Jack Clark opened one jade box after another infused with the power of space, and collected the resources emanating the charm of the laws into his storage space.
In truth, in terms of quantity, they were neither too many nor too few. Resources with the charm of laws that reached God-level were highly valuable, starting at a thousand contribution points.
Not to mention, the resources Jack Clark needed, which had effects even on the body of an Innate Demon God, each cost over five thousand contribution points—ahead equivalent to that of a Ninth Heaven Purgatory True Demon.
Some of the top-tier divine objects and Law-level resources were worth tens or even hundreds of thousands of contribution points.
Taking the items, Jack Clark left the Logistics Department underground and soared directly into the sky, flying over the bustling city below, and returned to the Cultivation Room in the Heavenly Abyss Building.
Whoosh! Jack Clark dumped out all the Life Crystals, which were mainly Level 5 and Level 6, with a small portion of Levels 7 and 8, and the largest being two Level 9.
Jack Clark grasped a Level 9 golden crystal the size of a washbowl with both hands. A voice resonated in his mind, “Convert these Life Crystals into Attribute points.”
Boom! Instantly, a rich surge of Life Energy exploded and vanished into his body through his hands, transforming into another kind of energy that was imperceptible and stored away.
“You have converted a high-purity Life Energy Crystal, receiving 14,230 Attribute points.”
“You have converted a high-purity Life Energy Crystal, receiving 14,712 Attribute points…”
The two Level 9 Life Crystals contributed almost thirty thousand Attribute points. Then came Level 8, Level 7… As Jack Clark continued converting, his Attribute points skyrocketed at a frightening speed.
When all the Life Crystals had been converted, the Attribute points on the page had accumulated to 231,501 points.
Over two hundred thousand Attribute points; even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be excited.
So many Attribute points were sufficient to enhance four talents to God Transformation Level, mainly because most of these Life Crystals were high-order and had doubled in value due to overpricing.
When the next batch of low-level Life Crystals was transported from Blue Star, the Attribute points obtained from their conversion would be even more.
Phew! Jack Clark exhaled deeply, his gaze falling on the Thunderflame Demon Dragon talent at the bottom of the page.
Among the remaining six top-tier talents that had not yet been transformed by the laws, the Gigantification Talent belonged to a special category and required three times the normal points for enhancement.
After only a moment’s contemplation, Jack Clark decided to strengthen the Gigantification Talent first.
“Expend two hundred thousand Attribute points to enhance the Giantification Talent and Heaven Burning Golden Flame,” he decided.
As Jack Clark’s thought echoed in his mind, an immense and profound energy for enhancement immediately coursed through his body, entering the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s body via the Soul Channel.
Above the heavens, the Black-red Colossal Beast flying thousands of kilometers suddenly burst forth with a Terrifying Aura.
Boom! Under the tremendous pressure centered on the Black-red Colossal Beast, the surrounding air was instantly compressed into substance, like an invisible sphere expanding in all directions, exploding.
The terrible shockwave turned into a hurricane that swept for kilometers, flipping the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Silver Giant Dragon flying hundreds of meters away on both sides.
The sudden change left the Silver Giant Dragon confused. As it spiraled in the air, it roared instinctively, “Roar! Tim Abott, you’ve blown away the Great Sethia again.”
But by then, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon had no energy left to respond.
Boom, Boom!! A series of red lightning erupted on the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s body, with golden flames continuously colliding and burning, turning kilometers of space into a sea of fire.
Countless red and golden Rune Sequence Chains emerged inside its body, spread across every part, evolving into more complex patterns under the strengthening energy.
Simultaneously, as the Talent Runes evolved, the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s genes, muscles, and cells all underwent certain changes, taking its life to a higher level.
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon following behind was somewhat baffled and instinctively dodged the collisions within the sea of golden flames, “Roar! Torsa, what’s going on with Thunder-flame?”
The Single-horned Tiger Whale’s eyes showed envy as it cried out, “Roar, roar, roar! Telsafi, Thunder-flame’s talents and bloodline are evolving again.”
At once, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon was even more baffled. As it flew, it couldn’t understand why it was getting stronger out of the blue, “Why are its talents and bloodline evolving?”
Not far away, the Red Beast resembling an Eastern Divine Dragon growled slowly, “Roar! Because, Thunder, flame, when, it, wants, to, get, stronger, it, just, does.”
Yiya, yiya!!
Feeling the increasing vigor of the bloodline of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon, the Purple little dragon on its head was also excitedly shouting. As for the surrounding sea of fire and Destructive Lightning, it seemed completely unconcerned.
The terrifying power that approached the Purple little dragon was neutralized by an invisible force around its body, turning into primal Heavenly Energy and dissipating—utterly mystical.

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - 400 Heaven and Earth’s Gift, Destruction Emperor Dragon . Cang_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 950: Chapter 400 Heaven and Earth’s Gift, Destruction Emperor Dragon . Cang_2
Boom! A terrifying energy burst forth from the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s body, its size expanding continuously, and due to the Deification talent exceeding four types, it seemed to have broken some kind of shackle.
Roar!
The black-red colossal beast suddenly roared towards the heavens, and in an instant Heaven and Earth changed color. Above the firmament, endless golden radiance shimmered, like the aurora coming into view.
These auroras transformed continuously, gradually taking the form of a dragon-shaped giant shadow that spanned tens of thousands of kilometers, immense and boundless.
Roar!! At this moment, in the hearts of all life within the mythical world, a majestic, ice-cold, and supreme dragon roar reverberated, as though it came from the Heavenly Dao itself.
In an instant, many ancient Titan level giant beasts and even stronger beings that were cultivating or hibernating opened their eyes and looked instinctively in this direction.
Including the Supreme Experts of the Human Race in Heavenly Abyss City who were in closed-door cultivation, and Diorus who had failed to curse Jack Clark moments ago, all showed a hint of surprise in their eyes.
“The World Rules are responding, has another life form broken through to the Ancestor level!?”
As the dragon roared, that ferocious dragon-shaped giant shadow turned into endless radiance that descended from the sky, plunging into the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s body.
Boom! An indescribable bloodline pressure erupted from the Thunderflame Demon Dragon.
Under the terrifying pressure of the bloodline, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Candle Dragon, Silver Giant Dragon, and the gold-blue giant dragon instantly fell like meteors from ten thousand meters altitude, smashing heavily into the ground.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!! Several Late Stage 9 and even quasi-mythical behemoths struck the ground, shattering the Earth and collapsing mountain peaks, as four mushroom clouds slowly rose.
At the same time, every Unique Beast and living creature within a thousand kilometers trembled, prostrating on the ground, paying homage to the King of the Beasts that radiated a divine pressure.
At this moment, only the little Purple Dragon stood on top of the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s head, excitedly chattering away.
Including on the mountain peak in front of the Icebound Mountain Range, where the Blue-White Giant Dragon who had ‘just’ closed its eyes was also shocked awake by this terrifying aura.
Even though it was several tens of thousands of kilometers away, the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s perception, which had assimilated a part of Heaven and Earth, still sensed the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s somewhat familiar, yet more terrifying pressure.
“Roar! It’s that little guy, how has its bloodline aura become even stronger!!” At this moment, even the Blue-White Giant Dragon was once again stunned.
Weren’t they about to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region? How did it grow stronger before even stepping out the door?
…
Above ten thousand meters altitude, Golden-White flames burned, spreading across three kilometers, resembling a Golden-White sun radiating a horrifying temperature of several hundred thousand degrees Celsius.
Under the terrifying high-temperature radiation of the Golden-White ‘sun’, the surrounding clouds dispersed, creating a hollow space of several tens of kilometers, a sight both shocking and spectacular.
At this moment in the center of the scorching sea of fire, a ferocious behemoth eight hundred meters long stood proudly.
After what amounted to half a day in the Blue Star World, the enhancement of talents finally came to an end. The Thunderflame Demon Dragon slowly opened its eyes, its golden vertical pupils emanating a fearsome pressure.
This breakthrough changed the Thunderflame Demon Dragon’s physique once more, the originally thick scale armor became slightly more streamlined, appearing less cumbersome.
At the same time, golden-white spiral patterns wound around its arms and ferocious double claws, looking somewhat luxurious and domineering.
Feeling the power within the Thunderflame Demon Dragon that seemed capable of destroying Heaven and Earth, Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the attribute page with its changes.
Avatar Body: Thunderflame. Destruction. Azure Heaven Emperor Dragon
Level: Mythical Giant Beast [An ancient beast with three higher-order laws, two Deification talents, and four Top Tier talents, earning a Monarch’s True Name given by Heaven and Earth, Rex.
Note: The True Name of ancient times corresponds to the position pattern, it is very important, and should not be disclosed carelessly.]
Talent: Crimson Gigantification [Deification, a specialty class talent enhanced to the extreme, fusing all talent powers in the Gigantification form, becoming the Crimson Destroyer Beast.
In the Crimson form, basic strengths like Strength, Defense and others receive a twentyfold increase, with a certain decrease in Agility Speed.
Note: The stronger the talent, the stronger the power of the Crimson form.]
Reminders: The Destruction Law evolved from the Strength Talent overlaps with the destructive attribute of the Deep Red Thunder, under Crimson Gigantification, the Deep Red Thunder will ascend to Supreme Law, the Deep Red Destruction Thunder.]
Talent: Heaven Burning Golden Flame [Deification, fire talent strengthened to the extreme. Upon bursting forth, it forms a torrid domain that incinerates everything, as if it could burn the heavens and boil the seas.
Ability: Great Sun Nuclear Explosion, extreme compression leading to a devastating explosion, which can be deployed in conjunction with the right claw’s binding force field, making it even more powerful.
Ability: Falling of the Great Sun, instant release of all Heaven Burning Golden Flames, merging with the domain to form an indiscriminate Destructive Great Sun, annihilating everything within range.
Note: This talent now possesses the characteristics of the Fire Law, allowing direct contact with the law, advancing to the Higher-order Law [Heavenly Sun Golden Blaze].
This breakthrough is so strong. Watching the attribute changes of the Avatar Giant Beast, Jack Clark couldn’t help but reveal a hint of amazement in his eyes.
This time only two talents were strengthened, but the change in strength they brought about was a qualitative leap.
For instance, the suffix of the name has once again become Emperor Dragon. However, compared to the original title of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the middle of the name now includes the words “Azure Heaven.”
Azure is the true name given to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon by the mythical world.
Being named after the Azure Heaven, one can imagine how high this position pattern is.
Besides that, after the Gigantification Talent was strengthened to the Deification level, aside from stronger base enhancement, the combination of the destructive power of the Strength Talent and the Deep Red Form’s destruction allowed the fusion with lightning power to reach the Supreme level.
However, perhaps because it is a Special Talent, the Deification-level Gigantification Talent does not seem to be able to advance to a law, or there is no corresponding law for it to advance to.
Pondering, Jack Clark glanced over the information of the Golden Flame Talent after its deification, before finally withdrawing his gaze.
Phew! Above the Firmament, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon retracted its Heaven Burning Golden Flames and condensed its aura, the terrifying pressure and the high temperature that melted everything between heaven and earth faded away instantly.
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon that had been lying on the ground for half a day fluttered its wings and excitedly soared into the sky, roaring, “Roar! Tim Abott, how could you keep Great Sethia pinned down for so long.”
Can you choose your words more appropriately!? The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thought silently, then slowly opened its mouth and let out a deep roar, “This is a natural release of aura from bloodline evolution; I can’t control it.”
“Roar! It’s fine, Great Sethia forgives you,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared impatiently: “Tim Abott, let’s hurry on our journey, to the Chaotic Turbulent Region and wreak havoc.”
The surge in strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon gave the Silver Giant Dragon hope for dominating the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Haha, with Tim Abott’s freakish rate of strength enhancement, it won’t be long before Great Sethia truly reigns over the mythical world.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was delightfully thinking about this, the golden blue Giant Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast also flew up.
As for the little Purple Dragon, it had fallen asleep at some point, curled up into a ball and nestled in the crevices of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s scale armor, drooling slightly from the corner of its mouth.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the several Giant Beasts and slowly roared, “Roar! I will now enter a state of Hibernation for Law Transformation. As for the journey, I leave it to you.”
Every time a talent evolved into a rule, it had to enter a stage of Hibernation, eliciting the power of the laws to temper the body once.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was somewhat speechless about this, having to sleep every time a talent transformed into a law was a waste of its time, especially as there were four more talents to be strengthened afterward.
No sooner had the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finished speaking than the Silver Giant Dragon volunteered with a roar, “Roar! With Great Sethia’s talent being storm and space, I will carry you, Tim Abott.”
Fine!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded, then tapped into the Heaven Burning Golden Flames within its body to touch the laws, and closed its eyes to fall asleep.
“Roar! Destination: Chaotic Turbulent Region, charge.”
The Silver Giant Dragon spread its wings, grasped the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Dorsal Fin with its claws, and amidst the silvery Spatial Fluctuations around it, it shattered the air with a bang and shot forth.
And as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fell into slumber, its Mythical True Body beginning another transformation, Jack Clark also took out a pile of God-level Resources, ready to make a breakthrough to the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven.
But just then, his smart wristwatch on his left wrist flickered and transmitted an electronic voice.
“General Clark, you have a delivery.”
Delivery? Jack Clark was startled.

chapters.title: Chapter 951 - 401 Soul Energy, Freya Louise Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 951: Chapter 401 Soul Energy, Freya Louise Returns
“General Clark, this is an exclusive message from the Outer Development Department of the Divine Gods Alliance, designated for you to personally receive.”
At the door, a soldier spoke with a solemn expression, holding a wooden brown box in his hands.
“The Divine Gods Alliance,” Jack Clark said in surprise as he opened the door.
“Yes.”
“Thank you,” Jack Clark said with a hint of curiosity as he took the box, politely thanking the soldier, which somewhat flattered the rookie Human Race soldier, prompting him to salute hurriedly.
As he watched the soldier leave, Jack Clark went back to his room and placed the wooden box on the coffee table.
Click! With Jack Clark breaking the rune seal, the box opened, revealing a fist-sized black transparent crystal inside.
Besides the black transparent crystal, there was also a Sound Storing Stone shaped like a jade pendant.
This was an item capable of storing sound, used as a means of communication in the mythical world under certain special circumstances.
Although technology still worked in the mythical world, it had no signal once outside the realm of human influence, so many used Sound Storing Stones.
Jack Clark first picked up the Sound Storing Stone, infused it with True Strength, and immediately heard Jane Aiken’s deliberately soft voice from inside.
“Jack Clark, this is a Soul Crystal I acquired in the rear area of the Divine Gods Alliance, from a relic called Gunardo. It contains pure energy.”
“After absorbing this energy, it can nourish the soul. Aren’t you in possession of a Soul Cultivation Method inheritance you obtained in the Ruins Continent? See if it’s of any use to you.”
To his surprise, it was sent by Jane Aiken. Jack Clark was taken aback.
He had only mentioned it in passing, and he hadn’t expected that this girl would remember that he had once cultivated a Soul Cultivation Method and had sent him a related Heaven and Earth Treasure upon finding it.
A gentle smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
Setting down the Sound Storing Stone, Jack Clark picked up the black transparent crystal with some curiosity and immediately sensed a special pure energy from within.
At the same time, a row of transparent text appeared before Jack Clark’s eyes.
“Discovered crystallized soul energy, would you like to convert it into Soul Points?” In an instant, Jack Clark straightened his back and looked at the black transparent crystal in his hand in surprise.
It was actually Soul Points.
Attribute points, converted from Life Energy, could strengthen the body-related Cultivation Methods and talents, but had no effect on the cultivation of the soul-involving Illusion Meditation Scripture.
And the soul’s strength or weakness was crucial after breaking through to king-level, affecting the speed of comprehension of Heavenly Earth Law and the capacity to contain various rules.
The importance of the soul can be well understood.
Currently, Jack Clark’s Illusion Meditation Scripture, thanks to some opportunities, had already been cultivated to the Third Layer and his strong soul had condensed into the form of a Soul Emperor.
Moreover, after incorporating the nascent form of the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal into the blank rule, the incremental transformation greatly bolstered his soul.
If Jack Clark could acquire enough Soul Points to strengthen the Illusion Meditation Scripture and break through to the Sixth Level, his pure soul alone would be comparable to a king, becoming a Soul Emperor who could control soul-based laws.
When that time comes, with the fusion of his Rule True Body and the Soul Emperor True Body, not only will his True Body become even stronger, but it will also quickly break through to Heavenly King Level.
That’s because breaking through to Heavenly King requires not just a complete grasp of the rules but also the fusion of the transformed Divine Soul with the Rule True Body.
Currently, some of the Human Race’s Mythical Peak strong men are stuck at this step, unable to adequately fortify their foundational souls, and must slowly cultivate and enhance it.
In contrast, Unique Beasts seem to have a simpler cultivation process; they only need to continually grow, evolve, purify their bloodline, and temper their Giant Beast Body.
And the reason is related to the Heavenly Earth Rules.
Having gained access to the Federation’s core database after his clearance was elevated, Jack Clark had seen speculations on this matter while he waited for resources.
According to some relic data obtained in the mythical world and the First Councilor’s conjecture, the mythical world is likely an indescribably enormous ‘Giant Beast.’
This could explain why ‘it’ continually devours and integrates other worlds.
Meanwhile, both Unique Beasts from Blue Star World and those from the mythical world develop scale armor instead of fur after mutating, including those uncontrollable giants.
Because they are all influenced by this ‘Giant Beast.’
