In such conditions, humans, the Purgatory Demon Race, and other tribes may also cultivate and evolve, but their difficulty is far greater, for they are not ‘Giant Beasts.’
Pushing down the excitement in his heart, Jack Clark’s voice resonated in his mind: “Convert this Soul Crystal!”
Instantly, as with the conversion of Life Crystals, an Invisible Power enveloped the Soul Crystal in Jack Clark’s hand and began to extract the encapsulated energy and convert it into another form for storage.
As the black transparent crystal slowly crumbled and disappeared, the data in the center of the transparent page in front of Jack Clark’s eyes updated and refreshed, adding a new unit of energy.
Soul Points: 97 [Energy points converted from pure soul force, can be used to strengthen soul-based Cultivation Methods]
“Current Soul Points insufficient, unable to strengthen Illusion Meditation Scripture. The fourth layer enhancement requires 1,000 Soul Points.”
Not enough, huh? After a moment of contemplation, Jack Clark dismissed the idea of going to the Divine Gods Alliance for more Soul Crystals.
While the Soul Cultivation Method was important, the most significant task for him now was to improve his cultivation level and reach the late period of the Ninth Heavens to condense rules and temper his True Body.
With his strength then, he would be able to pressure and even slay Early Myth and mid-period strong men.
And with his sky-base summoning bottom card and the remaining two Rule-level forbidden weapons, not to mention dominating the mythical world, his ability for self-protection while venturing outside would greatly increase.
With that in mind, Jack Clark exhaled and returned to the Cultivation Room to sit cross-legged, proceeding to open a 30-centimeter tall jade bottle in front of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 401 Soul Energy, Freya Louise Returns _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 952: Chapter 401 Soul Energy, Freya Louise Returns _2
Suddenly, a strong chill pervaded the air.
In the jade bottle, the Nine Yin Moon Marrow resembled pure and clear water, containing extremely cold and yin abilities, but once consumed, it would transform from extreme yin to yang, releasing terrifyingly intense energy.
This extreme yang energy could augment the Extraordinary Body of a Ninth Heaven Expert, burning Spirit Qi to expand their domain power.
Boom! As soon as Jack drank the Nine Yin Moon Marrow, a cold energy containing intense heat exploded within his body, and wild energy enveloped him in a white ‘flame’.
Whoo Whoo!! Amid the towering white flames, Jack’s aura grew increasingly powerful.
Before this great war, Jack had exhausted all his resources to raise his cultivation to the brink of making a breakthrough to Mid-term of Ninth Heaven.
As his aura became stronger, the vicinity was filled with the ferocious and majestic sound of dragon roars. Behind him, four Divine Wheels emerged and spun, making him appear holy and imposing.
Boom! Jack’s aura surged explosively, and he fully stepped into the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven.
Whew!
The raging wind swirled around him, and as Jack opened his eyes amid his wildly dancing hair, he immediately picked up a plant in front of him that looked like a ganoderma, yet it split into nine segments—a Divine Object.
This Nine Leaves Divine Lucidum, a Heaven and Earth Treasure, contained rich Blood Qi and was as hard as steel, but Jack’s terrifying teeth crushed and chewed it bit by bit.
After consuming the Nine Leaves Divine Lucidum, Jack continued his closed-door cultivation.
As for the ‘tomorrow’s’ King’s Conference, he wasn’t a king, so why bother with such troubles? Let the big shots worry about that.
He was just a genius who hadn’t fully developed yet. Any issues could wait until he broke through to king level.
The next day, kings converged in the conference room above the Firmament. ‘No one’ knew what was discussed at the meeting, but just an hour later, the entire Heavenly Abyss City was astir.
The fourteen Main Battle Legions stationed in Heavenly Abyss City, along with the four supporting legions—with the exception of the two Reserve Legions—all set out.
Troop Transport Trains rumbled away one after another, and massive transports carrying missiles and other supplies continually took off.
The six, over ten-kilometer-long, sky-based battleships also thunderously moved, kicking up a Mountains and Seas shaking wave as they headed for the Sky Curtain Battlefield.
The more than ten base platforms of the Heavenly Abyss City division, each over five kilometers high with a striking range covering tens of thousands of kilometers, began to be disassembled for transport as well.
Under such circumstances, Jack, who had been in closed-door cultivation for just two days, was disturbed again.
At the door of his room, an intelligent robot, holding a 0.5-meter-sized white box and with light flashing in its eyes, emitted an electronic voice.
“General Clark, this is the Life Crystal you requested in exchange. It has been delivered in its entirety, please sign for it.”
A faint smile appeared on Jack’s face as he took the subspace box.
The Life Crystal he had exchanged with over two hundred thousand merits from within Blue Star had finally arrived, and next, he could strengthen all of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s talents to God Transformation Level.
However, after taking the box back to his room, Jack went out again to the lobby platform, where a luxurious hovering sports car was parked.
“Jack, over here.” Gabriella, with her blonde hair draped over her shoulders, called out to Jack from the driver’s seat.
As the gorgeous hovering sports car flew by, Gabriella, the driver, expressed some sentiment, “I didn’t expect that after only coming here for two big battles, the war in Heavenly Abyss City would end.”
Sitting in the passenger seat, Jack smiled slightly, “That’s the future, nobody knows what will happen tomorrow.”
“But for the ‘citizens’ below, it’s definitely a good thing. They won’t have to worry every day about the frontline being defeated and Heavenly Abyss City being breached.”
Yesterday’s King’s Conference, besides discussing the aftermath of this battle, also determined the future role of Heavenly Abyss City.
Due to the fall of the Primordial Stars, the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, where even Supreme Experts dared not delve deep, was being separated from the world that was merging with the mythical world.
This essentially declared the end of the war in Heavenly Abyss City.
From now on, this place will become a huge logistical Base City, responsible for developing the resources and minerals within tens of thousands of kilometers outside the city.
Because of the war, the resources and minerals contained within the mountains and rivers of that battlefield went undeveloped, so this area will likely prosper even more in the coming time.
At this moment, Gabriella suddenly said, “Jack Clark, you’ve already had a breakthrough to the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven, haven’t you?”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Mhm, two days ago.”
Because he had absorbed the Mysterious Yellow Air, and his true body evolved into the Innate Demon God’s Body, the time Jack initially estimated for his breakthrough to king-level might be delayed a bit.
Even so, Gabriella couldn’t help but feel envious.
Back on the Ruins Continent, her cultivation level was roughly similar to Jack’s, both at the Early Seventh Layer Sky, but she hadn’t expected that in just over two months, Jack would already be at Mid-term Ninth Heaven.
While she had only recently broken through to the Late Seventh Layer Sky.
This guy’s talent was just monstrous, even more abnormal than Damon Lopes, the Innate Awakened One, deserving of someone who nearly walked the Road of Heavenly Kings.
Inside the 13th Legion’s base, a dark golden creature that appeared both human and non-human stood tall at 300 meters, with enormous mechanical arms swirling and operating around it.
These mechanical arms hoisted and fitted massive pieces of armor over Number One, assembling and re-covering it.
“Because the core of Number One is a piece of an unknown broken biological heart, the evolving life form will transform uncontrollably once it goes on a rampage.”
“The biological information of ‘humans’ contained within these armors can help Number One re-stabilize its shape, restraining its form, so it doesn’t end up with an odd appearance of three hands and four feet.”
More than two hundred meters above the ground, on the command bridge, Jess Byron, whom they had met once before, was introducing everything to Jack Clark and Gabriella.
Sensing the suppressed terrifying power within Number One, Jack slowly asked, “How is Freya Louise now?”
“Right now Miss Flora’s spirit and physical states are stable, and as long as the external armor is fully mounted, the Teleportation Crystal is activated, and the internal pilot space is linked, she can be teleported out.”
“That’s good,” Jack nodded slightly.
During the previous major battle, Number One went on a rampage and was hit by a claw from a Demon God, blowing up most of its body, and the restraining armor on Number One was almost entirely torn away.
Furthermore, after absorbing the flesh and souls of over a hundred thousand senior life forms and devouring Three Demon Kings, Number One became even more terrifying.
Because of the rampage, Freya Louise was also bound inside Number One up to now.
However, upon their return earlier, tests showed that Freya was in a very good state, without danger, so Jack went about his own business until today when Gabriella informed him.
Crackle Crackle! Accompanying the embedding of the Teleportation Crystal into Number One’s chest, the grotesque eyes of the mecha suddenly lit up, emitting blue-white radiance.
Under those terrifying gazes, everyone in the base, except Jack, including Gabriella, felt an unexplained nervousness, their legs trembling.
Hum!
The crystal in Number One’s chest emitted White Light, forming a Light Beam on the ground. Within the beam, Freya Louise, who had been inside Number One for seven days, flew out.
Boom! The majestic mecha landed, and the ground trembled slightly under its heavy footsteps.
Compared to seven days earlier, the aura around Freya was much stronger, and her God Machine Armament had undergone some changes.
The already gorgeous mecha, primarily white and gold with hints of blue, had grown in size to over five meters tall, becoming even more powerful and handsome.
Wrapped around the surface of the mecha were dark golden patterns similar to the ones on Number One’s scale armor, invisibly exuding a subtle but terrible pressure.
Clearly, during Number One’s rampage, although Freya’s body was not assimilated, the God Machine Armament that helped her resist the assimilation was eroded by the power.
Crackle Crackle!!
The magnificent and majestic mecha cracked slightly, as if translucent energy was flowing through it, finally disappearing into the Subspace Equipment on Freya’s left wrist.
Looking at the girl wearing a silver tight battle suit, with a delicate and pretty face, Jack showed a hint of a smile and gently said, “You’re out.”
The girl, now with a touch of majesty between her brows and an indifferent gaze, nodded slightly, and as she looked at Jack, a feeling of familiarity gradually returned to her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 953: 402 Chaotic Sea Region, Naga of the Classic of Mountains and Seas
chapters.content:
Chapter 953: Chapter 402 Chaotic Sea Region, Naga of the Classic of Mountains and Seas
Noticing that Freya Louise’s gaze was off, Jack Clark immediately frowned, “Your state?”
The indifference in Freya Louise’s eyes gradually dissipated, her lips pursed slightly, revealing a familiar faint smile: “It’s nothing, my mind just lingered in the ‘spirit state’.”
At this point, Gabriella opened her mouth wide, somewhat shocked: “Freya junior, did you just break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven?!”
She remembered that before the great battle, Freya’s cultivation was at the Sixth-level Heaven.
Freya nodded: “Yes, while the Number One was devouring those different races’ flesh and soul, and even refining the demon king’s Rule True Body becoming more powerful, I also grew stronger.”
“Driving the Number One also has this benefit.” Jack was somewhat surprised.
The girl blinked playfully: “Of course, I am the ‘soul’ of the Number One; as it becomes stronger, naturally, there will be certain feedback for me.”
“Moreover, when I pilot the Number One for training, or cultivate inside the Number One, the speed of my cultivation’s improvement is also a hundred times greater than usual.”
“Jack, didn’t you notice my cultivation had improved a lot compared to two months ago?”
“…I hadn’t noticed.” Jack paused.
However, since Freya had no issues, Jack stayed a little longer until she finished checking her physical data and the Number One’s, and then he went back.
“You’ve converted a Life Energy Crystal, gaining 3 Attribute Points.”
“You’ve converted a Life Energy Crystal, gaining 12 Attribute Points…”
In the Cultivation Room, Jack picked up crystals from a small hill pile consisting mainly of Level 1, 2, and 3 Life Crystals, with a few Level 4 and 5, converting them into attribute points.
By the time Jack finished converting tens of thousands of Life Crystals, more than an hour had passed.
“Over three hundred forty thousand Attribute Points.” Looking at the number 345810 on the attribute page, even Jack took a deep breath, it was too many.
But at this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was in a state of cultivation hibernation, with the Golden Flame Talent leveling up to the Heaven Burning Great Sun Golden Flame Law status, so Jack couldn’t strengthen the talent without interrupting.
So Jack suppressed the excitement in his heart, took out a divine stone emitting a faint blue glow in his hand, and once again entered closed-door cultivation.
…
Boom boom boom!! Thunder roared between heaven and earth, shattering the stones below and causing the Earth to tremble.
Under the darkness of the Thunder Cloud Storm, four Giant Beasts were flying rapidly, one of them, a 400-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon, had in its claws an even larger Black-red Colossal Beast.
Roar roar roar!! Great Sethia, wait for me.
In the sky, a Single-horned Tiger Kingfish struggled to flap its huge Double Fin, surrounded by a radiating white domain, the roar of sonic booms echoed as its speed reached four times the speed of sound.
The Silver Giant Dragon looked back: “Roar! Joe, you’re flying too slow, delaying the Great Sethia’s conquest of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
Roar roar roar!! I’m already very fast. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish felt helpless.
It was just a Tiger Whale, not a flying bird or a Giant Dragon naturally adept at flying; the fact that it could fly at all was something, so what could it do?
As the Single-horned Tiger Whale chased behind with effort, the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s double wings shimmered with light, coming alongside the Silver Giant Dragon, its gaze landing on the four claws gripping the Dorsal Fin of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
“Roar! Great Sethia, you’ve been dragging Thunderflame for so long, consuming a lot of energy. Do you need the Great Telsafi to help you…”
Before the golden-blue Giant Dragon could finish, the Silver Giant Dragon realized: “Roar! No need, Great Sethia is fine.”
Alright then. The golden-blue Giant Dragon had a hint of disappointment; it had intended to take advantage of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s hibernating state to study its body.
The Red Beast, resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon, snaked through the sky, its sluggish gaze sweeping over the two Giant Dragons flying side by side before looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast being dragged below. Suddenly, it let out a slow growl.
“Roar! I, under, stand, now.”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flew over laboriously, curious: Roar roar roar!! Candle Dragon, what do you understand now?
But the Red Beast acted as if it hadn’t heard the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish at all, continuing to fly forward, leaving the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish somewhat speechless.
This guy has gone offline again.
Soon after, the five Giant Beasts quickly flew through the Thunderstorm area and entered the vast expanse of the desert, the air dry and the temperatures scorching hot.
Compared to the lush and vibrant domain of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the domain of the golden-blue Giant Dragon was more harsh.
Especially as they approached the Chaotic Domain, the energy between Heaven and Earth became more volatile, and the Unique Beasts inhabiting the mountain ranges and forests appeared more irritable.
However, even the most irritable Unique Beast trembled with fear and didn’t dare to move as they witnessed a group pass by, the weakest of whom exuded Late Stage 9, King-level bloodline auras.
Finally, after flying non-stop for what felt like ‘six days’, the indistinct and seemingly endless dark region appeared on the horizon.
As the few Giant Beasts approached, an indescribable sensation of chaos, oppression, and violence rushed forth.
They had finally arrived at the Chaotic Domain.
“Roar! Chaotic Domain, Great Sethia has arrived.” The Silver Giant Dragon bellowed excitedly.
Stimulated by the aura of the Chaotic Domain, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had been in hibernation for a few days under the Silver Giant Dragon’s grasp, slowly awoke, the Golden-White Flame dancing in its golden vertical pupils, exuding a terrifying pressure.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon regained composure, then let out a deep growl: “We’ve arrived at the Chaotic Domain, have we?”
The Silver Giant Dragon released its grasp, roaring excitedly: “Roar! Tim Abott, you’ve awoken just in time. Come on, let’s storm in; Great Sethia seeks a river of blood.”

chapters.title: Chapter 954: 402: Chaotic Sea Region, Naga from the Classic of Mountains and Seas_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 954: Chapter 402: Chaotic Sea Region, Naga from the Classic of Mountains and Seas_2
Nonsense, although there are plentiful resources here, it is also incredibly dangerous.
Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, speechless, let out a slow growl, “Don’t be careless, Great Sethia. Even your mother would sense danger in the Chaotic Turbulent Region. Be careful not to blunder into trouble.”
“Moreover, our primary objective this time is to find Heaven and Earth Treasures to enhance everyone’s strength and accelerate growth.”
“Besides that, if we encounter any high-intelligence Mythical Giant Beasts that can be subdued, we can attempt to ‘recruit’ them to join the Dragon Palace.”
“However, from now on, the Dragon Palace will not create additional Dragon King positions; new Mythical Giant Beasts that join will only be generals of the Dragon Palace.”
For Jack Clark and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at this point, the Life Crystal is no longer so important.
Once all of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s talents are enhanced to the God Transformation Level, the only function left for Attribute points will be to burn them to enter an epiphany state.
Therefore, if they encounter powerful Mythical Giant Beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wouldn’t mind recruiting them as subordinates.
Although devouring Mythical Giant Beasts accelerates his growth, doing so directly is somewhat wasteful.
Even in the mythical world, beasts that have grown to this stage are rare, considered Overlord-level divine creatures with high potential and combat power.
If they could recruit dozens of Mythical Giant Beasts and a few Titan Beasts, by the time he breaks through the Chaotic Turbulent Region and appears on the battlefield of the Human Race and The Purgatory Family, the scene would be quite interesting.
Thinking this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled menacingly, “Let’s go. According to the original plan, we’ll first establish a Territory in the Chaos Sea as a foothold.”
Before arriving, the Blue-White Giant Dragon gave the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon a Law Scale, which contained part of the information about its initial excursions into and out of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
For instance, entering here and delving over ten thousand kilometers to the left, circling around several dangerous areas, leads to the Chaos Sea.
It’s an ocean located in the Void, sprawling over billions of kilometers, inhabited by countless ferocious and irritable beasts and beings from different races, and rich in resources.
The sea water also possesses purifying, solidifying, and suppressing powers due to its oceanic nature, making it the only place suitable for healing, adjustment, and absorbing Heavenly Energy.
As for other places in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Heavenly Energy is too violent and the rules too chaotic, making them only suitable for adventuring, not sleeping, resting, or recovery.
“Roar! Charge ahead, the Great Sethia will dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region and rivers will run red with blood.” The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings excitedly and followed closely behind the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Then came the gold-blue Giant Dragon, spreading its wings elegantly and calmly trailing behind, a subtle suppressed excitement flickering in its calm vertical pupils.
Under the golden sunlight, the five Giant Beasts quickly crossed thousands of kilometers and plunged into a dim area.
At once, a sudden darkness engulfed the Giant Beasts’ vision as if they had entered another world, greeted by a violent and chaotic flow of Heavenly Energy and, at the same time, a terrifying gravitational pressure.
Boom, boom, boom!! Under the gravitational force that had increased a hundredfold, all five Giant Beasts sank heavily, and the weakest Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s full-body Scales Armor even emitted a creaking noise.
Such a terrifying gravity. There was a hint of seriousness in the eyes of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In that moment, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s single, large, blue horn on its head released waves of light: Roar! Thunderflame, I sense something good over there.
“What level?”
Roar! It’s not very intense, probably just ordinary God-level.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced in the opposite direction of their goal and let out a low growl, slightly shaking its head, “Forget it, ordinary God-level resources would only grow us a meter. Not worth wasting time.”
“Let’s keep moving.”
But just as the five Giant Beasts had barely flown a few hundred kilometers in the terrifying gravitational environment, suddenly, a powerful upward force was felt.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the sudden pull of a gravitational force hundreds of times in reverse direction, five Giant Beasts were catapulted into the high altitude at more than ten times the speed of sound, or rather they fell rapidly towards the opposite “Earth,” as the sonic booms and waves of air burst around them.
“Be careful.”
In the midst of this anomaly, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon burst into dazzling Golden-White flames.
Boom! The scorching Golden-White flames expanded rapidly, and in the blink of an eye, they formed a sun-like vacuum over three thousand meters in diameter.
Within this range, all powers and laws, including space and domain, were suppressed by the laws of the Great Sun Golden Flame, forming a domain unique to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In the domain, the silhouette of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Four Giant Beasts, which had been falling weightlessly just moments ago, paused and instantly let out a sigh of relief.
Roar!! Thank goodness for Thunderflame, this place is too terrifying, my domain power was torn apart in an instant. The Single-horned Tiger Whale was terrified.
However, at that moment, Thunderflame Emperor Dragon paid it no heed and instead fixed its gaze with a solemn expression towards “below.”
Above the Earth, over three thousand kilometers in altitude, a Black Crack stretched over a thousand kilometers, exuding a terrifying power that devoured everything.
It was from the depths of that crack that the inverse anti-gravity force enveloping them originated, and a massive shadow loomed vaguely within, exuding a fearsome pressure.
Roar!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a ferocious roar towards the Giant Beast lurking deep within the Space Crack, emitting a peak Mythical aura and full of provocation.
To think that upon entering the Chaotic Turbulent Region, they had encountered a Mythical Peak Giant Beast; the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s double claws itched to tear it apart.
Just as streaks of black lightning sparked in the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes and the Golden-White flames on its body burned even more fiercely in preparation for action, the massive shadow slowly receded into the depths of the crack.
At once, the pervasive reverse gravitational pull throughout Heaven and Earth weakened.
No, I only look about seven hundred meters long, and my aura is close to the Mid-Mythical Stage, why are you running away?
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon bellowed: “Roar! You sneaky and vile creature, only knowing to hide in the darkness, have the guts to come out, Great Sethia will tear you apart.”
Roar!! Me too, me too.
Emboldened by having the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at its side, the unsettled Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also joined in the provocations.
But perhaps sensing the dangerous aura emanating from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Mythical Peak Giant Beast did not turn back and simply vanished into the depths of the Black Cracks.
Seeing this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could only shake its head in disappointment and let out a low growl, “Let’s go, we must continue on our way.”
Having had the experience just now, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon surrounded itself with Golden-White flames and expanded its domain, enveloping the four Giant Beasts as they headed towards the Chaos Sea.
However, they were still on the edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, where the danger was not extremely high.
Having crossed a zone thousands of kilometers wide, where meteor showers and fiery stones fell incessantly, each strike equaling the power of a nuclear explosion at level eight or nine, they approached their initial destination.
Ahead, the ocean spreading into the Void was boundless, with the sea raging and waves rising hundreds of meters high.
At this moment, a beautiful creature from a different race, half-human in appearance with a pure and smooth complexion and essential parts covered by two blue shells, and half-fish in its lower body, the likes of which could be likened to the Naga from the legends in the Classic of Mountains and Seas, was fleeing desperately through the turbulent waves.
A Giant Beast a hundred meters long was pursuing it from behind, roaring violently and shaking the sea water.
With the remains of a bloodied corpse from a similar race in its mouth and flesh and blood oozing between its fearsome teeth, it was clear that the Black Behemoth had devoured many of these beings.
Yet, as it pursued its prey, the Black Behemoth suddenly stopped, frozen in fear as it looked ahead.
There, five enormous creatures stood upon the sea surface, looking at it with indifferent, cold, or curious gazes.

chapters.title: Chapter 955: 403: Tearing Apart the Mythical Giant Beast, the Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Long Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 955: Chapter 403: Tearing Apart the Mythical Giant Beast, the Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Long Chapter)
The tumultuous sea was a deadly standstill, as the fleeing Unique Beast Mermaid Girl from the sea and the Black Behemoth that was pursuing her were both completely petrified, daring not to make a single move.
For just a short distance ahead, on the vast expanse of the sea surface spanning kilometers, five menacing Giant Beasts stood tall.
On the forefront was a black-red ferocious giant beast extending over 700 meters and exuding the mythical aura of a true behemoth, with wings spanning over 900 meters in length and a physique surpassing the limit of Extraordinary Giant Beasts—a Silver Giant Dragon.
Additionally, there was a 300-meter-long, ornately shaped golden-blue Giant Dragon; a Red Candle Dragon with a long tail; and a Single-horned Tiger Whale with double fins like wings.
In front of these colossal creatures, the 100-meter-long Black Behemoth looked no more than a tiny snake.
High above, indifferent golden vertical pupils in the eyes of the black-red colossal beast glanced down as it opened its mouth slightly and let out a deep roar, “Kill that Black Behemoth.”
Roar! In an instant, the Black Behemoth let out a cry of alarm and rage, as a Power Explosion of black surged around it, forming a Black Power domain spanning over two hundred meters, filled with an aura of immense strength.
With the domain spread out, the Black Behemoth instantly transformed into a black shadow that shot forward.
Roar! “I’ve got it! I’ve got it!” The excited cries of the Single-horned Tiger Whale resounded as it erupted in White Light, covering a 700-meter radius and suddenly boosting its aura tenfold.
But before the Single-horned Tiger Whale could charge forward, the sky and sea within a ten-kilometer radius sunk into darkness, creating a dome-like dark area.
Boom!
Out of the darkness, a tail over two thousand meters long sprawled across heaven and earth, like a small mountain range dropping from the sky, with its passing causing explosions in the atmosphere that formed transparent ripples.
In an instant, the Black Behemoth that had burst forth several kilometers felt Soul Panic.
Boom!
Under the terrifying strike, the ocean exploded into two parts, forming a trench over ten kilometers long and over a thousand meters deep.
The powerful shockwaves lifted hundreds of meters high Tsunami waves that rushed toward both sides with great momentum.
As for the Black Behemoth, it was directly shattered into fragments of flesh and blood by the Giant Beast Candle Dragon’s strike; followed by the convergent impact of billions of tons of sea water, leaving no trace.
Following the erasure of the Black Behemoth, the darkness receded and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon’s massive form visibly shrank at a rate visible to the naked eye, rapidly diminishing from over three thousand meters to just over three hundred meters.
This scene left the Mermaid Girl Alien trembling stiffly, unable to move at all, staring in awe at the colossal red beast in the sky that resembled the Eastern Divine Dragon.
So, so powerful!!
Roar! “Red Candle Dragon, you’ve stolen my kill.” The Single-horned Tiger Whale sounded slightly annoyed, having claimed it would take the lead.
The Red Candle Dragon lazily glanced over without responding.
Roar! “I knew it would be like this,” lamented the Single-horned Tiger Whale, speechless.
That infuriating creature always goes offline, unresponsive to anything, but when there’s a chance to stand out, it moves faster than anyone.
Next to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon fluttered its double wings, looking at the Mermaid Girl Alien on the sea surface who dared not move. It seemed eager to act, “Roar! Tim Abott, shall we eat this one?”
Immediately, the Mermaid Girl below, sensing the killing intent of the Silver Giant Dragon, shuddered, her face turning pale.
“We won’t kill this one for now; we need a guide familiar with this sea area.”
“Roar! Alright.” The Silver Giant Dragon nodded somewhat regretfully.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to descend, its invisible oppression calming the sea within a several-kilometer radius, which lay smooth as a giant mirror amidst the Violent Ocean.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s four claws touched the sea surface, its cold golden vertical pupils inspecting the minuscule Mermaid Girl Alien below.
Of her four-meter-long body, two-thirds was covered with a fish tail sheathed in Blue Scales. Her upper body was human-like, starting from the waist up, and she appeared roughly 2 meters tall while standing in the water.
Her skin was pale and lustrous like jade, and black-blue hair draped over her shoulders, revealing a delicate oval face. Her fine features were accented by a pair of blue fin-like ears protruding amidst her locks, exuding alien appeal.
Simply looking at the upper part of her body, she was a beauty capable of toppling cities and kingdoms.
Particularly her bare shoulders and collarbones, as well as the peaks concealed by a pair of blue shells, were dangerously alluring, enough to cause a nosebleed with just a glance from any ordinary man.
Of course, judging this Mermaid Girl Alien beautiful was only the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s view; to the likes of golden and blue Giant Dragons and other behemoths, this little one wasn’t even substantial enough to fill the gaps between their teeth.
Especially the Silver Giant Dragon, whose servants in the Divine temple were like beautiful girls on top, and python snakes below.
After observing the Mermaid Girl Alien for a moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon lowly growled, its voice rippling with waves of spiritual thought, “Can we communicate?”
The Mermaid Girl, whose strength was of initial Level 7, nodded hastily and respectfully in her unique alien language, “Yes, we can, great Lord Dragon Beast.”
Good, that we can communicate.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction and then let out a majestic roar, “I am Tim Abott, king of the Dragon Palace of the Beast Empire—state your name, alien.”
The Mermaid Girl in the water bowed respectfully, “I have seen you, Thunderflame Dragon King. My name is Rain Lawson.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled again, probing further, “Do you have kin nearby? And what about Mythical Giant Beasts in this sea area?”
“Dragon King, I do have kin, but they are all enslaved by that wicked Giant Beast…”
In the ensuing back-and-forth between the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the alien, the group of Giant Beasts began to glean some understanding of their surroundings.
This sea area, known as the Violent Ocean, was home to many Unique Beasts and Mer tribe members, which the Mermaid Girl belonged to.
This tribe naturally had a strong affinity with water, innately able to control it. The strength of the tribe was centered around Level 4, with only a few reaching Levels 6 and 7, thus being on the lower end of the food chain.

chapters.title: Chapter 956: 403 Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Alive, The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Large Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 956: Chapter 403 Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Alive, The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Large Chapter)_2
Over the years, members of its tribe have been occasionally preyed upon by Giant Beasts, leading a life of extreme misery.
This sea area was dominated by a Mythical Giant Beast named Bi, which lurked in a “world” within spatial cracks, commanding a group of Level 9 and Level 8 Beasts.
Recently, the creatures of its tribe have been captured by the minions of that Mythical Giant Beast in large numbers, tasked with breeding a type of special fish.
However, breeding that Ice fish is very difficult, requiring the Mer tribe to consume their Origin talent in water control to speed up the fish’s growth. In this period, thousands of Mer people have been drained to death.
Struggling to survive, Rain Lawson and over ten of her tribesfolk took advantage of the Beast guards’ negligence, escaping through the seabed’s twisted spatial currents, only to be chased all the way here by the Black Behemoth.
After the Mermaid Girl finished speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon that had followed and flown down lit up with excitement. “Roar! This Beast Empire is so evil; the Great Scythia shall represent justice and vanquish them.”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also nodded excitedly: Roar roar roar!! Right, vanquish them and dominate this sea area.
The Red Candle Dragon standing by, seemingly in a daze, slowly roared: “Roar! Kill, take, rob, all.”
Having flown for so long and finally encountering opponents worthy of battle, these Giant Beasts felt a surge of excitement.
Looking at the Mermaid Girl Alien, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon emitted an authoritative low roar, “Lead us to that Rift World, and you and your tribe shall gain freedom.”
“But, Your Majesty Thunderflame Dragon King, that Mythical Giant Beast is very powerful,” the Mermaid Girl hesitated.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled softly, “How powerful?”
The Mermaid Girl said with awe, “I’m not sure. I only saw that Mythical Giant Beast from a distance once. Its size alone was twice as big as you, Thunderflame Dragon King.”
Twice as large, a Mythical-level Beast over fourteen hundred meters at the peak.
The Mermaid Girl’s words let the gold and blue Giant Dragon watching in silence show a look of solemnity; he hadn’t expected that Beast to be a Mythical-level Beast at the peak.
Given the strength of these Beasts nearly approaching the Titans, the gold and blue Giant Dragon couldn’t help but growl low, “Thunderflame, be careful, that Beast is quite strong.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared confidently, “Roar! No matter, Tim Abbott will burst it.”
“Indeed, it doesn’t matter.”
With a low growl, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon burst forth with a Terrifying Aura, rising to the sky. On its Dorsal Fin, streak after streak of blue-black Thunder sparked, exploding into electromagnetic waves.
In an instant, the Heavenly Energy within this area ran amok, dark clouds gathered, and formed a Thunder Cloud Storm vortex that spanned over a hundred kilometers, constantly spinning.
Boom boom boom!! Bolts of lightning a meter thick fell from the sky, exploding upon hitting the sea surface, sending electric arcs flying in all directions.
At the center of the storm vortex, the Black-red Colossal Beast let out a roar that shook Heaven and Earth, “Roar! Rain Lawson, lead the way. Today, this king shall slaughter those evil Beasts and uphold justice for the lives in this sea area.”
“Roar! The Great Scythia wants to see rivers of blood.” The Silver Giant Dragon, excited, circled in the air, its body enshrouded by a black storm radiating an aura comparable to that of a Mythical Giant Beast.
With its storm talent close to touching the rule and inducing the surrounding, the Silver Giant Dragon conjured numerous Tornadoes that extended to the heavens and churned untold volumes of sea water around it.
Roar roar roar!! Slay, today I will defeat ten. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also cried out excitedly.
The Red Beast lying in wait in the sky slowly roared as well, “Roar! Candle, Dragon, invincible.”
Inspired by the confidence emanating from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon, the gold and blue Giant Dragon felt its blood boiling too and let out roars of high spirits.
Yii ya yii ya!?
atop the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, the Purple little dragon, which had absorbed some special powers from the Heaven and Earth Resonance earlier, also opened its eyes in confusion after sleeping for several days.
Looking at the swirling Thunder Cloud Storm above and the Giant Beasts circling around with Killing Intent, it felt somewhat bewildered.
Boom! The Thunder Cloud Storm surged, and at the same time, a powerful force descended from the sky, enveloping the Mermaid Girl Rain Lawson and dragging her rapidly toward the distance.
Feeling the Terrifying Auras pervading between heaven and earth, the Mermaid Girl Rain Lawson turned pale and trembled as she experienced the pressure of quasi-mythical and even Mythical-level close-up.
Yet at the same time, the Mermaid Girl felt excited and agitated; if these Giant Beasts were really powerful enough to defeat that Mythical Giant Beast, then there might be hope for her tribe.
…
In the dimly lit Heaven and Earth, a waterfall thousands of kilometers high and a hundred meters wide fell from the sky, causing a thunderous roar as it splashed water high into the air upon hitting the sea surface.
At the end of the waterfall, there was a horizontal Black Crack extending hundreds of meters, through which one could see a continental block stretching hundreds of kilometers on the opposite side, standing tall.
The land was crisscrossed with mountain ranges and rivers that flowed together into a lake with a perimeter of over a hundred Li, with faint glimpses of Mermaid Girl Aliens flitting through the water at the edge of the lake.
Amidst the lake and surrounding mountain forest, Beasts with body lengths of a hundred to a few hundred meters were sprawled, numbering over a hundred and exuding powerful Level 8 and Level 9 auras.
The agitation and brutality of these Beasts were heightened by their environment, with them roaring frequently and even fighting among themselves at times.
Among these Beasts, the two most powerful were each three hundred meters long, radiating quasi-mythical level strength.
One of them was a Flood Dragon behemoth with three dragon heads and covered in black scales while the other resembled a mountain boar with a pair of hundred-meter-long fanged teeth and gray scale armor enveloping its body.
Those vast forms were like small hills, shaking the ground and causing trees to sway as they moved, their aura impressive.

chapters.title: Chapter 957: 403: The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Apart (Big Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 957: Chapter 403: The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Apart (Big Chapter)_3
In the center of the Earth, a mountain peak towering over twenty thousand meters stood erect, surrounded by Cloud Mist, with a Giant Beast that had a body length of one thousand five hundred meters, shaped like a gigantic tiger with a pair of sharp horns and covered in yellow scale armor, sprawled atop it.
This Giant Beast had awakened the ancient and ferocious Bi Bloodline, its aura was extremely terrifying, as each breath caused a raging wind to howl for dozens of kilometers around, shaking the mountain peak.
Suddenly, the Bi Giant Beast opened its eyes, its horrifying gaze piercing through the Rift World towards the ends of the sky, where a Thunder Cloud Storm was approaching at a shocking speed.
Most importantly, the storm was permeated with five powerful auras, one of which, belonging to a Mythical Giant Beast, even made the Bi Giant Beast’s heart skip a beat.
Roar!
In an instant, a vicious roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, as the Bi Giant Beast suddenly stood up, its massive body of over four hundred meters in shoulder height instantly created a tsunami-like wave of air.
Boom!
An oppressive force burst forth from the Bi Giant Beast’s body, a Mythical Peak power that was even stronger than that of an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast due to its bloodline reversion, causing the world to tremble.
The terrifying pressure and golden light caused the surrounding space to continuously shatter, forming Black Cracks that spread over thousands of kilometers, a sight of horrifying magnitude.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Under the roars of the Mythical Peak Bi Giant Beast, Giant Beasts on the ground also suddenly raised their heads to look in the distance, letting out brutal roars and bursting with power.
A mix of auras from Eighth Level, Ninth Level, quasi-mythical, and even Mythical Giant Beasts interwove, instantly causing the world within the Rift World to change its hue.
Yet facing the warning roars of these beasts, the far-reaching Thunder Cloud Storm, covering nearly two hundred kilometers in range, did not slow down but instead increased in speed.
Boom! Just as the Thunder Cloud Storm neared the waterfall hanging between sky and earth, it collided with an invisible Boundary Wall, roaring with airwaves and creating layers of atmospheric shockwaves that covered hundreds of kilometers.
Within the howling storm, a pair of gigantic claws wrapped in black lightning and golden-blue patterns reached out.
Boom! Space shattered, the fragile Boundary Wall of the Rift World was torn apart by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and amidst the chaos of spatial fragments, five Giant Beast silhouettes appeared.
Roar!!
Facing the two Silver Giant Dragons, a Red Beast, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, and a seven-hundred-plus-meter-long Black-red Colossal Beast below the Thunder Cloud Storm, the Bi Giant Beast roared viciously from over two hundred kilometers away.
“Roar! Kill them,” the Bi Giant Beast erupted with fury. A mere Mythical Giant Beast in its early phases dared to challenge its dominance, a death wish.
Without a second thought, the Bi Giant Beast immediately issued the attack order, intending to obliterate these intruders and rip them to shreds.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Giant Beasts on the Earth let out brutal roars, their domains of various Gifted Powers unfolding around them, emitting multicolored lights as they charged toward the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and its companions.
These Giant Beasts were enormous, their domains spanning from two to three hundred meters to six to seven hundred meters, collectively charging with a sight monstrous in scope.
The sheer number of these beasts was enough to surprise the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, as they had never before encountered a giant beast power with so many members.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s gaze fell upon the towering Bi Giant Beast and issued a command with regal growls, “Roar! Scythia, leave these ordinary beasts to you.”
“Roar! No problem, the Great Sethia will take on fifty today,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, then immediately spread its wings, bursting forth amidst the black storm.
“Roar! The Great Telsafi shall turn this into a river of blood today,” the golden-blue Giant Dragon also roared with excitement.
With its power nearly matching that of an Ordinary Myth Giant Beast, it wasn’t afraid of the Ninth Level Beasts despite their numbers being dozens of times greater.
Roar! The Giant Beast Candle Dragon let out a deep roar, moving like a streak of light, followed by the Single-horned Tiger Whale.
However, unlike the fearless trio of quasi-mythical behemoths, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, although blood boiled with excitement, targeted those Eighth Level Beasts swimming up the river.
A distance of one to two hundred kilometers, for these beasts, was just a matter of a few breaths to cross.
And just as the two parties came within tens of kilometers of each other in an instant, a series of red, blue, and purple Light Beams shot across the world, bombarding the Silver Giant Dragon and the others.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Suddenly, seven powerful breath attacks engulfed the Silver Giant Dragon, instantly releasing energy comparable to small nuclear explosions over several kilometers, dazzling with bright light.
Within the terrifying energy impact of the breath attacks, the four hundred meter-long Silver Giant Dragon, enveloped in black storms and Ice Crystals, let out exultant roars.
“Roar! The Great Sethia is invincible.” Its body, rivaling that of a Mythical Giant Beast, allowed the Silver Giant Dragon to ignore the breaths of the Ninth Level Beasts and charge into the herd with overwhelming might.
Boom Boom!! With space distorting around them, two claws enveloped in black Ice Crystal Storms pierced the Void, exploding domains and blowing off the heads of the two closest Ninth Level Beasts.
Immediately afterward, the Silver Giant Dragon pounced on a quasi-mythical Flood Dragon behemoth.
Boom!
A collision of domains between the two Giant Beasts sparked an energy explosion, with the powerful body of the Silver Giant Dragon ignoring the assault and biting onto one of the Black Colossus’s dragon heads.
Roar!
The Three-headed Flood Dragon behemoth let out a wail as the middle head was bitten off in one bite by the Silver Giant Dragon’s formidable jaw strength, and then the massive body was grasped by the dragon claws and brought crashing down from the sky.
Boom! In an instant, the Earth below shattered, and countless pieces of dirt and stone soared into the sky.
In just one encounter, the quasi-mythical behemoth was utterly crushed by the Silver Giant Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 958: 403 Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Alive, The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Large Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 958: Chapter 403 Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Alive, The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Large Chapter)_4
Elsewhere, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon sought out the Tusked Giant Beast on Earth’s surface. With a closure of its eyes, the heaven and earth within a range of over ten kilometers darkened, and from the darkness came the Giant Beast’s roar and the thunderous tremors.
As for the golden-blue Giant Dragon, it faced the remaining dozens of level eight and level nine Giant Beasts head-on. Its wings, with a golden-blue hue like crystal, spread wide, forming an eight-hundred-meter-diameter crystal around it.
Boom! Boom! Boom! A barrage of breaths struck the crystal, causing a terrifying explosion of energy, yet they were unable to shift the crystal, formed by special rules, in the slightest.
Simultaneously, within the surrounding Void, crystals containing various Attribute Energies, each with a diameter of over ten meters, formed and burst forth, emitting multicolored lights.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Under the bombardment of the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s crystal, one after another, the Giant Beasts’ domains collapsed, their scales shattered, their flesh and blood exploded, and they emitted wretched shrieks.
“Roar! Great Telsafi, invincible.” Standing high in the sky, surrounded by crystals, the golden-blue Giant Dragon let out a proud roar, its body emanating a dazzling seven-colored glow.
Within the crystal domain covering a range of kilometers, every second saw dozens of crystal missiles form, filling the sky as they flew toward those level nine Giant Beasts.
At this moment, the golden-blue Giant Dragon resembled a turret of destruction, bombarding fervently, making the sky tremble and suppressing over twenty level nine Giant Beasts more than ten kilometers away.
Such immense strength left the Mermaid Girl Alien from the different races, who had been swept in behind the battle, immensely excited— too powerful.
Meanwhile, atop a distant mountain peak, the Bi Giant Beast stood with an uneasy look in its eyes, as its underlings were being suppressed by the enemy’s three quasi-mythical Giant Beasts.
Roar! No.
The Bi Giant Beast let out a brutal roar, and in that instant, its enormous body moved explosively, radiating a dazzling golden light as if a Great Sun were hurling itself towards the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon standing beneath the storm.
First, slay this Mythical early-stage invading behemoth, then tear apart those quasi-mythical ones.
Squeak, squeak! The Purple little dragon, perched atop the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, stretched out its little claw, pointing excitedly at the gold ‘sun’ streaking across the sky in the distance.
Kill, today mighty Misss Joseline shall bring rivers of blood.
This little one.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was speechless. Following that, golden-white flames ignited in its eyes and red lightning emerged, as an even more vicious, overbearing aura burst forth in an instant.
Boom!
The earth trembled under the terrifying aura, and in the midst of the dazzling red light, a Deep Red Giant Beast 2,400 meters long and 1,000 meters tall when standing on its hind legs appeared.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Black-red Lightning coiled around the Deep Red Giant Beast’s body, shattering the nearby space and turning a range of one kilometer into a Dark Destruction Area.
In this moment, the behemoth standing in the darkness, emitting dazzling red light, looked like a Destruction Beast from ancient times, extremely brutal, emitting an indescribable, overwhelming heaviness.
Under the pure terror of Titan-level oppression, the Void cracked, the nothingness collapsed, and the entire Rift World groaned under the burden, the heaven and earth shook, and Earth crumbled.
In the face of such terrifying power, along with suppression stemming from their bloodline hierarchy, the level nine Giant Beasts, which the golden-blue Giant Dragon had suppressed, stiffened in an instant. They thunderously fell from the sky.
Even the Bi Giant Beast, which had flown over one hundred kilometers away, showed shock on its ferocious face, bellowing in crazed fury, “Roar! Impossible, how could this be possible! How could your strength surge to such an extent?”
Mad, this world has gone mad! How could a Giant Beast, relying on its Gifted Power, leap from early Mythical stage to Titan Level in an instant?
It can’t be, it simply can’t be; surely it’s a bluff.
Roar!
The Bi Giant Beast let out a ferocious roar, and its entire body’s golden light converged into its mouth. Instantly, a hundred-meter-wide golden light beam shot forth.
Boom!
The sky darkened under the breath of Mythical Peak terror, all things lost their color, leaving only the path of that golden light column that pierced through heaven and earth, destroying and shattering everything in its path.
From a distance, it appeared as if a golden light pillar, set amidst black, extended, crossing tens of kilometers at a deceptively slow yet terrifying speed, striking the Deep Red Giant Beast.
Boom! When the Deep Red Destruction Beast did not dodge or avoid, the Destructive Breath hit its chest, and in an instant, a blinding light shone between heaven and earth, turning into an ever-expanding golden mushroom cloud.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The terrifying impact transformed into a Destructive Hurricane, sweeping across tens of kilometers, shattering the Void where it passed, causing mountain peaks on the Earth below to collapse and explode.
Those Giant Beasts, including the golden-blue Giant Dragon fighting twenty or so kilometers away, were all lifted and tossed by the terrifying wind, reverberating with blasts that shocked all living beings.
At this moment, the only things remaining between heaven and earth were the golden Giant Beast continuously firing breaths and the distant, persistently expanding and exploding Destructive Glow.
After about ten minutes of continuous bombardment, the Bi Giant Beast took a slight breath, the light in its mouth fading, and it stood in the high sky, exuding a terrifying presence.
Meanwhile, in the center of tens of kilometers of energy explosion, amidst the raging Space Turbulence, the fierce and enormous form of the Deep Red Giant Beast appeared, its thick Red Scale Armor emanating an unbreakable will.
It wasn’t a bluff!! Despair filled the eyes of the Bi Giant Beast.
Having bombarded it with all its rules and Talent Energy breaths for so long, it had not even managed to break a single scale of the opponent. The gap in their strength was so vast that it drove even this Mythical Peak Giant Beast to despair.
Looking at the distant Bi Giant Beast, whose ferocity now mixed with shock and terror, the Deep Red Giant Beast’s lips curled slightly, revealing a gruesome smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 959: 403 Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Alive, The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Large Chapter)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 959: Chapter 403 Tearing the Mythical Giant Beast Alive, The Invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon (Large Chapter)_5
Boom! The massive body of the Deep Red Giant Beast roared into motion, its heavy footsteps crushing the Void as it stepped towards the Bi Giant Beast, exuding a terrifying oppressive aura.
Watching the encroaching Deep Red Giant Beast, the Bi Giant Beast instinctively stepped back under the invisible, destructive coercion.
Roar! Suddenly, the Bi Giant Beast let out a fierce roar, its body exploding with golden light that transformed into roaring golden flames, its aura swelling several times in an instant.
Boom!
Under the explosion of its bloodline power, the Bi Giant Beast shattered the space around it, turning into a golden light that shot explosively into the distance, not even thinking before turning to flee.
The sudden turn of events caused the Deep Red Giant Beast, which had expected a fight to the death, to halt, then its eyes flickered with murderous light.
Boom! Space within a ten-kilometer radius shattered, and the terrifying recoil sent the Deep Red Giant Beast vanishing on the spot, becoming a streak of red light that shot out at an indescribable speed.
Despite the speed and agility being somewhat reduced in its Crimson Form, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s ability to instantaneously move thirty times its body length with its Agility Talent was still terrifying.
With the appalling speed that covered tens of kilometers in the blink of an eye, the red light collided with the golden light in an instant.
Boom!
The instant the golden and red lights met, the Bi Giant Beast let out a pitiful scream.
The two giant beasts, with the might to destroy heaven and earth, pierced through the world and crashed into a mountain peak over a hundred kilometers away that was more than twenty thousand meters high.
Boom!
The bodies of the beasts, one thousand five hundred meters and two thousand meters long, collided at speeds tens of times the speed of sound, the mountain collapsing instantly, the earth splitting open, and billions of tons of boulders being hurled in all directions.
Roar! Amidst the explosion of smoke and dust, the Deep Red Giant Beast let out a fierce roar.
The Deep Red Giant Beast’s massive double claws clutched the shoulders of the Bi Giant Beast, and under the terrifying force, the Bi Giant Beast’s thick, law-tempered Golden Scale Armor shattered, and flesh and blood exploded.
Roar! Stimulated by the imminence of death, the Bi Giant Beast, nearly evolved into an ancient ferocious beast, had its eyes turn red and its huge mouth angrily ripped towards the Deep Red Giant Beast before it.
Boom! A single fanged tooth, tens of meters in size, bit into the Deep Red Giant Beast’s shoulder and arm with a thunderous explosion, the space itself shattering under the bite.
But the Deep Red Giant Beast’s defense had become so strong that it could drive any giant beast of the same level to despair; besides leaving several small pits, the Bi Giant Beast’s bite did not inflict even a scratch.
Roar! At that moment, the Deep Red Giant Beast let out a fierce roar, its arm muscles swelling as an indescribably terrifying power burst forth.
Crackle Crackle!! Under that terrifying force, the stout body of the Bi Giant Beast made sounds like metal being torn apart.
At the same time, waves of Crimson Destructive Thunders, comparable in might to the Supreme Law, burst forth, spreading from the Deep Red Giant Beast’s claws, engulfing the Bi Giant Beast’s entire body.
Roar! Wracked by the bombardment of the Crimson Destruction Thunder, the Bi Giant Beast let out scream after scream, while the golden light of the sharp and scorching Golden Law within its body burst forth under the stimulus of death.
Boom boom boom!! As the golden light collided with the destructive thunder, they made thunderous noises that shook heaven and earth, the terrifying leftover forces destroying everything in the vicinity.
The falling boulders from the sky, the crumbling mountain peaks, the trees—all within dozens of kilometers were obliterated.
Roar!
The Deep Red Giant Beast let out a fierce roar, its claws erupting with power, and with a boom, the one thousand five hundred meter-long Bi Giant Beast was directly torn in half.
Countless streams of golden blood sprayed out, drenching half of the Deep Red Giant Beast’s body in gold, emitting a strong scent of blood.
Roar roar roar!!
Atop the collapsed half of the ten-thousand-meter high peak, the Deep Red Giant Beast was holding the two halves of the Bi Giant Beast’s body, roaring towards the sky, its wildly fierce Terrifying Aura shaking heaven and earth.
Especially given its mighty vitality, the torn Bi Giant Beast was still alive, emitting scream after scream wrapped in the Destruction Thunder.
The two halves of the body, radiating golden light and surrounded by the Destructive Aura of black-red lightning, made the Deep Red Giant Beast at this moment appear unbearably terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 960: 404 Subordinate Species, Twins Sisters Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 960: Chapter 404 Subordinate Species, Twins Sisters Again
So strong!!
Gazing at the deep red giant beast standing atop the collapsing mountain peak, with its double claws gripping the torn halves of the Bi Giant Beast, and surrounded by chaotic lightning, the golden-blue giant dragon’s eyes revealed shock.
The golden-blue giant dragon had never seen the deep red form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon before.
In that instant, its body surged from the early mythical stage to the Titan Level, and with terrifying Defense and combat strength, it shook the golden-blue giant dragon to the point of doubting its own life.
That Giantification Talent was too terrifying, capable of unleashing such fearsome strength that it almost broke the limits of the rules.
A Mythical Peak Giant Beast, only a step away from the Titan Level, was torn in half at the beginning of the fight, a complete overpowering!
Under normal conditions, two mythical peak giant beasts, even if there were gaps in strength, would need a long and brutal fight to determine the victor.
Because the bodies of both beasts were incredibly powerful, resilient, and their vitality was almost infinite under the conversion of the Laws’ Origin, regenerating limbs was standard.
But in front of the deep red form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Mythical Peak Giant Beast had no power to resist, not to mention its Laws’ Origin being suppressed by that black and crimson chaotic lightning, unable to heal its wounds.
No wonder Scythia would say Tim Abbott is invincible, too strong!
Compared with the shock of the golden-blue giant dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon and its kind had long been accustomed to the aberration of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Is it just using the early mythical realm to kill a mythical peak giant beast? How normal, it’s nothing compared to the shock when Tim Abbott tore apart a Mythical Giant Beast at level nine.
“Roar! Today, Great Scythia shall dominate the battlefield,” the Silver Giant Dragon let out a triumphant roar.
The Silver Giant Dragon, learning from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, had its double claws gripping the only remaining head of the Three-headed Flood Dragon by the neck, with its foot crushing the body, and suddenly burst forth the strength to rip it apart.
Roar roar roar!! The remaining head of the Three-headed Flood Dragon let out a wretched scream, the scale armor at the broken necks shattered, and the muscle slowly tore open.
Boom!
Under the Silver Giant Dragon’s claws, which were on par with the physique of Mythical Giant Beasts, the neck of the Three-headed Flood Dragon was ripped apart, and instantly, scorching dark red blood sprayed like a high-temperature waterfall thousands of meters far, staining half of the Silver Giant Dragon’s body red.
Roar!
Holding the fierce head of the Three-headed Flood Dragon, with its foot on the body thrashing hundreds of meters in madness, the Silver Giant Dragon issued a proud roar, looking extremely fierce and savage.
To kill a quasi-mythical beast without injury in a short time was indeed something for the Silver Giant Dragon to be proud of.
After all, just five or six Sun Wheels ago, it was only at level eight, and even fighting a Level 7 Peak Giant Beast was a struggle.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, its massive double wings shook, and it soared into the sky, rushing toward those level nine beasts suppressed by the golden-blue giant dragon’s crystal bombardment.
Today it intended to make a river of blood.
Suddenly, the space above the head of a Level 9 Early Stage Beast distorted, and in the blink of an eye, a gigantic Silver Dragon Claw, spanning tens of meters, descended from the sky, concealing an extremely compressed black Ice Crystal storm within its grip.
Boom! The terrifying black Ice Crystal storm exploded, instantly destroying the Level 9 Giant Beast’s domain, and amidst the aggressive flow of energy, the Silver Dragon Claw fell.
Thud! With a horrific strike of the claw, the head of the Level 9 Early Stage Beast exploded instantly, blood and remains splattered everywhere, displaying absolute dominance.
Despite appearing rather ordinary in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon was an invincible presence to these level nine beasts.
Including the golden-blue giant dragon with its two top-tier talents, its combat strength was actually quite aberrant.
…
On the ruins of the collapsed mountain peak, the deep red giant beast held onto the remains of the Bi Giant Beast, erasing its soul and Law’s Origin with destructive lightning, while overlooking the entire “world”.
On the other side, the Red Candle Dragon had already completely suppressed the quasi-mythical Tusk Giant Beast.
With the alternation of day and night, the white flame form and tenfold increase in giant body combined with the Time Slowing Law, it had dealt heavy injuries to it in just over ten minutes.
Even as quasi-mythical beasts, there was a huge gap in combat power between them.
The golden-blue giant dragon, transformed into a destructive crystal cannon, covered half the sky with terrifying explosions, suppressing more than twenty Level 9 Giant Beasts.
With the Silver Giant Dragon joining in, their combined efforts led to the continuous blasting or tearing apart of Level 9 Beasts, causing a rain of blood to fall from the sky.
As for the weakest Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, it was also going on a frenzy in the lakes and rivers below.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, measuring nearly three hundred meters in length and with fins spanning five hundred meters, surrounded by the daylight domain, had its physical strength increased tenfold; its fins slashed like knives, bursting through everything.
The Eight Level Beasts, ranging from seventy to a hundred meters in size, were like chickens awaiting slaughter in front of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, one cut per beast.
That pair of fins, engraved with nearly a thousand Slash Runes, exercised supreme dominance, with each stroke shattering the domain of a Level 8 Giant Beast, severing its body, and the resulting blood dyed half the lake red.
This was the dual suppression of level and bloodline; facing the late-stage Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, these Level 8 Beasts had no power to fight back.
After their ranged attacks were weakened by the Black and White Domain, they could not breach the thick black scale armor. Once they got close, they would be split in two.
Facing such a desperate gap in strength, those beasts that rallied to attack under the Bi Giant Beast’s oppression gradually lost their will to fight.
Although the giant beasts of the Chaotic Turbulent Region were more fierce due to the ferocity of Heaven and Earth’s energy, those that grew to levels eight and nine still retained a certain level of intelligence.

chapters.title: Chapter 961: 404 Subordinate Races, Another Pair of Twin Sisters_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 961: Chapter 404 Subordinate Races, Another Pair of Twin Sisters_2
Especially when the Bi Giant Beast was torn apart by the Deep Red Giant Beast, and the oppressive aura of its powerful presence faded away… Roar! Suddenly, an Eighth Level Beast that was part of the group attacking the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish let out a terrified roar and turned tail to flee.
In an instant, it was like triggering a cascade of dominoes falling. The Eighth Level Beasts surrounding the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish in a frenzied and bloody onslaught scattered at once, rushing down from the Void Waterfall along with the river.
Roar roar roar!! Stop, I haven’t killed enough yet. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was suddenly anxious, stirring up raging waves in hot pursuit.
Having participated in so many great battles alongside the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this was the first time it had encountered an invincible massacre. It had said it wanted to kill fifty, but it wasn’t satisfied yet.
Seeing this scene, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon standing atop the mountain peak watched with an icy gaze, devoid of any intention to recruit subordinates.
This time, it commenced fighting upon sighting the beasts, with the purpose of slaughtering all these Giant Beasts for food and to establish dominance.
As for the matter of recruiting Mythical Giant Beasts to form a mighty army, that would have to wait until the Silver Giant Dragon and the others made their breakthroughs, or else newly recruited Giant Beasts would be difficult to manage.
Otherwise, once it enhanced its talent and underwent Evolutionary Transformation before entering Hibernation, without its suppression, only being quasi-mythical, the Silver Giant Dragon and the others would be absolutely unable to contain Mythical-level Giant Beasts.
Yiya yiya!!
Perched upon the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, watching the small world descend into a maelstrom of blood and warfare, the Purple little dragon seemed extremely excited, constantly chirping with joy.
As for its meaning…
Kill, kill! Great Misss Joseline loves watching rivers of blood the most.
Big brother is invincible, smash those evil guys, kill them all, eat them all, roar…
Hearing these words, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched uncontrollably. Too violent! This was just a dragon that was born a month ago; no, this little one’s propensity for violence must be corrected.
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon pondered on how to educate the Purple little dragon next, the struggle of the Bi in its claws ceased, and the aura of life and soul breath were wiped clean by Chaotic Lightning.
Feeling that the Bi Giant Beast had fallen completely, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon then shifted its thoughts, releasing its Gigantified form.
Suddenly, its massive and ferocious body visibly shrank in size, the Chaotic Lightning that coiled around its body gradually dissipated, and a feeling of weakness spread from inside.
Having just stepped into Titan Level from the early stages of Myth, although it was much stronger than an average early-stage Titan, the burden and consumption on the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon were still significant.
Having Gigantified for just over ten minutes, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt that it needed at least a day (24 hours) to recover.
Sensing that it had weakened considerably, the Purple little dragon turned into a streak of purple radiance, appearing in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s enormous eyes.
Yiya yiya!?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a low growl, “I’m fine, just like the last time. Gigantification consumes a bit too much. With some rest or eating the heads of Giant Beasts, I’ll be fine.”
Yiya!!
The Purple little dragon blinked its eyes, then opened its mouth wide, whoosh! A stream of pure Purple Energy burst forth, weaving into the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s eyes like a thread.
Boom! Along with that energy merging into its eyes, it transformed into an Invisible Power that surged through the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s entire body. Wherever it passed, cells and muscles rejuvenated with vitality.
Including the previously consumed Qi Blood and energy, which were instantly restored under the force of the Creation origin.
Moreover, the Creation origin from the Purple little dragon was greater than the last time, seemingly due to the increase in its strength.
Under the influence of this Creation Power, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could acutely feel that not only were its Qi Blood and energy restored, its physical body also underwent a faint Transformation.
But like the last time, after expelling a breath of Creation origin, the Purple little dragon seemed somewhat listless.
Yiya yiya!!
The weakened Purple little dragon folded its arms across its chest and shook its head, indicating the little energy it expended was no big deal. However, despite insisting it was fine, the Purple little dragon still flew back to lay atop the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head.
This little fellow. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook its head slightly.
It was about half an hour later that the great battle finally ended. Apart from the twenty or so Eighth-Level Beasts and a few Level 9 Giants that escaped, all of the Bi Giant Beast’s subordinates were killed.
Suddenly, the small world, half of which had been turned to ruins, quieted down. The corpses of dozens of Eighth and Ninth-level Beasts lay broken across lakes and Earth, their spilled blood dyeing the land red.
In the sky among these Giant Beast corpses stood two Giant Dragons, the Crimson Divine Dragon and the Black Single-Horned Tiger Whale, towering at high altitudes, radiating fierce auras.
In addition to the terrifying figure atop a collapsed Mountain Peak in the distance, and under the lake surface, where figures resembling Mermaids of different races trembled, too scared to move.
These Giant Beasts are so terrifying; they even killed such powerful Mythical Giant Beasts.
Early on at the Void entrance torn open by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Mermaid Girl, Rain Lawson, surrounded by the Golden Law Power, had already been shocked into stupefaction. Her mouth agape, she watched the scene in disbelief.
Over a hundred Eighth and Ninth Level Giant Beasts, even stronger Mythical Golden Giant Beasts, were so simply killed?
At this thought, the Mermaid Girl Rain Lawson was incredibly excited, because the Giant Beast known as the Thunderflame Dragon King had promised her, as long as she led the way, it would release her and her people.
Suddenly, with a softness in her tail, Rain Lawson’s cheeks flushed and her delicate nostrils quivered, as a warm moist stream flowed from below.
She wet herself!!
After the great battle ended, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, holding the half-corpse of the torn Bi, flew down and landed on the shore of the lake with a loud thud, causing the surrounding Earth to tremble and winds to howl.
At the same time, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish emerged from the water, driving a group of half-fish, half-human creatures towards him.
Roar roar roar!! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, these two guys have Life Crystals inside. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish used its domain to roll the corpses of two Peak of the eighth level Beasts onto the shore.

chapters.title: Chapter 962: 404 Subordinate Race, Another Pair of Twin Sisters_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 962: Chapter 404 Subordinate Race, Another Pair of Twin Sisters_3
“Hmm, well done,” nodded the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with satisfaction.
Although it no longer urgently needed the Life Crystal now that it had enough Attribute points, the energy that could incite an epiphany state was naturally beneficial to have in abundance.
At this moment, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon also flew over, clutching the corpse of the Tusk giant beast and quietly placed it to one side.
“Roar! And the Great Sethia.”
Amidst the roar, the Silver Giant Dragon descended from the sky, clutching the battered corpse of the Three-headed Flood Dragon, and with a thunderous crash, they both landed on the ground, “Roar! Tim Abott, there’s also a crystal inside this Giant Beast.”
Today, the Silver Giant Dragon had almost gone berserk, its body still streaming with dark red blood, exuding an exceptionally ferocious Aura that terrified the half-human different races watching from afar.
Finally, when the golden-blue Giant Dragon gracefully unfolded its Dragon Wings and flew in, the Silver Giant Dragon, proud and smug, curled its tail, “Roar! Telsafi, I’ve killed many this time, more impressive than you.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon elegantly stepped forward, looked at the silver Giant Dragon who was brimming with pride, and growled casually, “Sethia, your way of fighting is too brutal, not elegant enough.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared disdainfully, “Roar! What is elegance? We are the brutal dragons, fierce is the way to go.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon said calmly, “No, we are not brutal dragons, we are dragons destined to become gods. Majesty and strength are our true pursuits.”
“Becoming a Mythical Giant Beast or not, aren’t we still dragons?” the Silver Giant Dragon retorted.
However, faced with its contention, the golden-blue Giant Dragon simply elegantly moved to one side, seemingly unwilling to continue discussing such a childish issue with the Silver Giant Dragon.
While the two Giant Dragons argued over trifles, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon stood by a mountain of Giant Beast corpses, its gaze falling on the trembling Mer tribe in the water.
Each of these different races had a blue scaly fish tail for the lower body and the upper body of a pale-skinned human, with small fish fin-like ears.
Moreover, their body lengths ranged from 3 to over 4 meters, with some girls looking very immature and others much more mature, their appearances quite beautiful, easily scoring 80 points in the realm of goddesses among humans.
One of the Mer tribe girls with long black hair was even comparable in looks to Rain Lawson, with a high nose bridge and a cool demeanor, her skin white as jade.
Under the fierce gaze of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this Mer tribe girl instinctively felt fear, her coolly beautiful face pale and bloodless, giving her a pitiable appearance.
This Mer tribe girl, however, had a slightly inferior figure compared to Rain Lawson; by human classification, the rabbit was roughly a C, concealed by a pair of pink seashells, quite a bit inferior to Rain Lawson’s E.
Secondly, because they were Extraordinary Creatures, their appearances were all quite impressive.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon scrutinized them carefully, and a sigh of relief escaped its heart as it found its sense of beauty to be normal.
Of course, whether it was the Silver Giant Dragon or those Mer tribe individuals, none could guess what the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was thinking at the moment with its fierce and massive appearance.
At that moment, the mermaid who exuded a Level 7 Aura and was the most beautiful swam forward with courage, speaking respectfully in the language of different races, “Mer tribe Ning Lawson greets the Lord Dragon Beast; thank you for defeating that evil Mythical Giant Beast.”
Although the girl spoke a different language, the fluctuations of intent in her voice made it understandable to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and others.
Upon hearing this, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s fearsome jaws opened slightly, emitting a hot gust of breath and a deep rumble, “Ning Lawson, what is your relationship with Rain Lawson?”
The pink-shelled Mer tribe girl was startled, a glint of excitement in her eyes, “My Lord, do you know my sister?”
“Sister!”
“I do,” said the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, slowly nodding. Then, it looked toward the distance where the Mermaid Girl, enshrouded by the Vajra Law, was pulled by a force and smashed into the lake at dozens of times the speed of sound.
Boom! Amidst the spray of water, the figure of the Mermaid Rain Lawson emerged.
“Sister.”
“Rain, you’re alright.”
The lake boiled with excitement as the Naga swam over and surrounded the Mermaid Rain Lawson, chattering in their native language.
A few minutes later, after Rain Lawson explained the situation to her tribe, she swam to the water’s edge and bowed respectfully to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, “Thunderflame sire, thank you for saving my people.”
“Hmm, you are now free,” nodded the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon slowly.
It had made a promise to these different races and naturally would not go back on its word.
