However, just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon thought the different races were about to leave, Rain Lawson suddenly spoke nervously, “My Lord, I have a request.”
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked down slightly, peering at Rain Lawson, who seemed no bigger than an insect to it, and growled softly, “What request?”
Rain Lawson’s voice was tinged with nervousness and anticipation, “Thunderflame Dragon King, may we become one of your subordinate species?”
Rain Lawson’s words caused the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to pause, and the surprise was evident among the other Mer tribe members, although no one knew Rain Lawson’s status within the tribe; at this moment, no one raised an objection.
The towering Silver Giant Dragon leaned closer, looking down at the Naga, with the strongest among them only Level 7, and glanced dismissively, “Roar! Tim Abott, these different races are so weak, they don’t seem to be useful as subordinates.”
Rain Lawson became even more nervous, “My Lord, we can help you raise Ice Fish, as long as you don’t force us to consume our Origin Vitality.”
Their species had a hard time surviving in this sea area, constantly on guard against attacks from Giant Beasts, with tribe members being eaten by Unique Beasts every day.
Especially after being captured by the Bi Giant Beast, in a short time, their numbers plummeted from over three thousand to just over two hundred, barely escaping extinction.
Under such circumstances, Rain Lawson could not help but think about finding a protector.
Though these Terrifying Giant Beasts were fierce, they were also incredibly strong, and the leading Thunderflame Dragon King seemed honorable and not excessively brutal.

chapters.title: Chapter 963: 405 Talent Fully Deified, The Terrifying Transformation Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 963: Chapter 405 Talent Fully Deified, The Terrifying Transformation Begins
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wasn’t originally interested in subordinates or anything of the sort, but when the Mermaid Girl, Rain Lawson, mentioned Ice fish, his gaze inadvertently stirred slightly.
“Ice fish, it’s the thing that Mythical Giant Beast made you breed.”
“Yes, Dragon King, please wait a moment,” Rain Lawson said as she turned and grabbed the Mermaid Girl named Ning Lawson. The water flows around them and in the blink of an eye, they disappeared from the surface of the lake.
More than ten minutes later, the figures of the two girls reappeared from the lake, holding between them an Ice fish over 2 meters long, with a snow-white and nearly transparent body.
Under the control of the powers of water held by the two girls, the immaculate Ice fish could not move, only breathing faintly through its gills.
And just as this Ice fish, akin to an ice sculpture, appeared, the Silver Giant Dragon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon, and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, as well as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, all subconsciously swallowed.
It was as if a starving man was looking at a table of exquisite dishes; even the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was caught by surprise by the rich scent of fresh meat that filled his nostrils.
However, beyond the enticing aroma, the energy contained was actually quite weak; the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt that he might need to eat hundreds of them to grow just one meter.
Wheez Wheez! The Purple little dragon, lying listlessly atop the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, had its eyes light up and turned into a streak of purple radiance that appeared over the lake in an instant.
Roar! Accompanied by a majestic roar, a Purple dragon head, ten meters in size, appeared in an instant, swallowing the Ice fish whole.
Then, the Purple dragon head shrank back, revealing a Purple little dragon with a satisfied look on its face, its mouth cracking and munching on something delicious as the entire dragon seemed a bit more spirited.
This change gave the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon a moment’s pause, and he couldn’t help but growl, “Misss Joseline, how do you feel after eating that?”
Wheez Wheez!!
The Purple little dragon gestured with its double claws to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, signaling happily that these Ice fish contained a special type of Ice Origin Energy which could help it recover some of its expended energy.
There was actually that effect as well.
The corners of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth turned up slightly, his appearance becoming incredibly fierce, as he looked at the Mermaid Girl, Rain Lawson, and slowly nodded, “From today onward, you are my subordinates.”
“Your task remains the same—tend to those Ice fish, just as usual.”
“Thank you, Thunderflame Dragon King,” Rain Lawson wore a look of excitement, while the other members of the Mer tribe behind her stirred slightly, their expressions a mix of joy, apprehensiveness, and restraint.
The joy came from finally having a powerful backer, becoming subordinates to a mighty and terrifying Mythical Giant Beast.
The anxiety was from not yet knowing the Mythical Giant Beast well; they only knew from Rain Lawson that the other party kept its word and had principles, but what their destiny would be from now on was unknown to anyone.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon suddenly growled, “Since you have become my subordinates, you should have more commanding names. From today forth, you will be renamed Naga Tribe.”
Naga Tribe.
The different races like Rain Lawson paused slightly before respectfully bowing their heads, “Yes.
After taking in the Naga subordinates, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked at the Silver Giant Dragon, “Roar! Scythia, what do you think of this place as the Headquarters of the Dragon Palace in the Chaotic Turbulent Region?”
“Roar! The environment here is good, acceptable,” the Silver Giant Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
Roar roar roar! I like it here as well.
None of the Giant Beasts had any objections to the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s proposal.
The Heavenly Energy of this Rift World was several times denser than the Outer World, equivalent to more than ten times that of the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s territory and dozens to hundreds of times that of the Blue Star World.
Because the energy is too dense, it almost turns into Cloud Mist that permeates between heaven and earth.
In addition, the Heavenly Energy here is more calm and stable, suitable for long-term stationing and recovery, and it’s concealed from the Outer World except for the hanging waterfalls, making it not visible.
“Roar! Scythia, Telsafi, constructing the new Dragon Palace Great Hall is up to you. It can be centered around the edge of this inland sea lake, half water and half land.”
“By the way, our strength has grown too quickly; the new Dragon Palace Great Hall is best built larger, like your mother’s Ice Crystal Divine Palace, ten thousand meters tall at the least.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon, with a body length of three thousand meters and shoulder height of one thousand meters, would feel like a human walking in a ten-meter high lobby when walking in a ten thousand meter tall Ice Crystal Divine Palace.
And judging from the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s estimate of its own growth rate, as long as there is sufficient food and energy, its body length will soon exceed one thousand meters.
“Roar! No problem, leave the palace to me and Telsafi to handle. I’m going to construct a Dragon Palace Great Hall that is even more grand and splendid,” the Silver Giant Dragon replied excitedly.
After arranging the palace matters, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked toward the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Red Beast Candle Dragon.
“Next, I’m going to consume the flesh and blood of these Giant Beasts to enhance my strength, as for you two, take a member of the Naga Tribe to patrol the surroundings and see if you can discover some God-level Resources.”
In the Chaotic Domain, where the Heavenly Earth Law is in disorder, spatial cracks and fragmented world shards abound, including in the Chaos Sea, where there exist many Rift Worlds with small spaces.
These independent small worlds, due to containing unstable and extreme forces, often give birth to special Heaven and Earth Treasure and are hard to detect due to their concealment.
In this situation, the treasure hunting function of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was particularly important.
Roar roar roar! No problem, Thunderflame, leave it to me.
Soon enough, the excited Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Red Candle Dragon left with a Naga girl, flying out of the Rift World following the waterfall at the end of the river.
Boom!
Literal hurricanes of blue-green swooped down, causing countless lake waters to soar into the sky. Under the domain power of the Silver Giant Dragon, the water was molded and then frozen by the extreme coldness of ice-cold energy, forming an ice pillar hundreds of meters thick and ten thousand meters tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 964: 405 Full Talent Deification, The Terrifying Transformation Begins_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 964: Chapter 405 Full Talent Deification, The Terrifying Transformation Begins_2
The Silver Giant Dragon was already an expert and took the palace construction in stride, quite professionally.
After all, when it first met the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and formed the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Force, it was responsible for building the first Dragon Palace, the Ice Crystal Palace.
“Roar! Telsafi, I will solidify the overall shape of the palace, you help carve some images of the Great Scythia’s mighty shape on the outside.”
“Roar! Why are you carving the image of Scythia and not the Great Telsafi?”
With its tail cocked proudly, the Silver Giant Dragon retorted, “Roar! Because Scythia is mightier than you and grows faster than you. If you don’t believe me, shall we fight?”
“Roar! Bring it on.”
Boom boom boom!! Instantly, as the two dragons, stronger than quasi-mythical behemoths, battled, a few pillars that had just been built in the Ice Crystal Palace collapsed.
Under the terrifying aftermath of the battle, a tsunami hundreds of meters high was lifted on the lake’s surface before being frozen by a breath of Ice Flame, filling the skies and earth with the thunderous roars of powerful crystal explosions.
Such a terrifying scene instantly sent the Naga Tribe scurrying in panic, swimming down to thousands of meters below the center of the lake, not daring to surface.
The behemoths were too terrifying.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon glanced at the two fighting dragons and simply shook its head, disinterested. It grabbed the corpse of the Bi Giant Beast with its double claws and bit down.
Boom!
Its huge, razor-sharp teeth bit into the Golden Scale Armor and flesh and blood, causing a thunderous explosion as the Bi Giant Beast’s corpse was torn apart by the fearful biting force of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Boom boom boom!! As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon chewed, a thunderous rumbling came from its mouth, not like eating, but like gnawing on a piece of hard, huge metal ore.
As he chewed, some golden blood flowed from the corners of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s mouth, occasionally spitting out chunks of flesh and blood several meters in size, appearing extremely ferocious and fierce.
After a few casual bites, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon swallowed the piece of flesh and blood, tens of meters in diameter. Instantly, a massive amount of biological energy exploded from its stomach.
With a surge of scorching biological energy, cells all around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body greedily absorbed this energy, dividing and evolving.
The flesh and blood of the Mythical Peak behemoth, already tempered by the law to be exceedingly powerful and on the verge of entering a realm of complete law, contained massive energy. With ample supply of biological energy, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body grew visibly.
Crackle crackle! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s heavy scale armor kept expanding, its length slowly yet firmly increasing, one meter, two meters, ten meters…
The growth rate, defying common sense, brought the distant Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, who was fighting with the Silver Giant Dragon, to a pause, shock evident in its eyes.
“Roar! Scythia, how is Thunderflame growing so fast?”
Several kilometers away, with its double wings fluttering, the Silver Giant Dragon roared indifferently, “Roar! Thunderflame has always been like this, growing as he eats, you’ll get used to it.”
Though it seemed indifferent on the surface, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes betrayed a hint of amusement, as it had been waiting for Telsafi to be shocked by this scene.
It had been startled by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s abnormal growth rate at first, and now it was Telsafi’s turn.
Ha ha, this always clever fellow had been shocked many times lately, which was quite entertaining.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was delighted, pondering what else about the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon could shock Telsafi, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon’s eyes were filled with curiosity as it watched the Black-red Colossal Beast, which had grown from seven hundred and twenty meters to over seven hundred and thirty meters.
This behemoth from the Indigenous World was shrouded in mystery—breaking through its bloodline talent and transforming the law-packed, high-energy flesh and blood of Mythical Giant Beasts into terrifying energy conversion efficiency when eaten.
It was very tempting to research. Watching the Black-red Colossal Beast continue to feed and grow rapidly, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon’s eyes flickered with radiance.
Meanwhile, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon began to grow significantly, strands of Evolution Energy emerged through the Soul Channel in Jack Clark’s body within the sealed off Heavenly Abyss City.
Boom! A dreadful and heavy aura emanated from Jack, so powerful that the surrounding air, even the space itself, seemed to twist.
Under the influence of this dense and high-quality energy, Jack became like a black hole at that moment, the force radiating from him subtly vibrating the entire building.
This was a building fortified by the Heavenly King Law.
The Evolution Energy transformed inside the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was terrifying, and even though Jack’s body had already advanced to that of an Innate Demon God, it was still being strengthened at an alarming rate.
Moreover, as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon kept feeding and growing, Jack’s aura became increasingly formidable.
A colossal beast corpse, one thousand five hundred meters in length and over four hundred meters at the shoulder, loomed like a small hill, and even as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon kept devouring, it did so ‘very slowly.’
Almost half a day later, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon finally consumed about half of the giant beast’s body, and in the meantime, its length had increased to eight hundred meters, its overall size expanding several folds.
At the moment when its body length surpassed eight hundred meters, the four Higher-order Laws inside the Black-red Colossal Beast surged, bursting forth with a terrifying aura.
Boom!
The immense pressure from the laws shattered the earth for thousands of meters, causing it to collapse. The air was compressed by the invisible burst of force, creating a transparent shockwave that swept across several kilometers.
The frozen surface of the lake, shattered by the battle of the two giant dragons, broke apart, raising a tsunami hundreds of meters high that spread far and wide, its momentum terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 965: 405 Full Talent Deification, The Terrifying Transformation Begins_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: Chapter 405 Full Talent Deification, The Terrifying Transformation Begins_3
“Roar! Tim Abbott has reached the Mid-Mythical Stage, so quickly,” exclaimed the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly, observing the Black-red Colossal Beast with a body length of 800 meters from afar.
It always knew that Tim Abbott grew rapidly. Haha, the stronger Tim Abbott became, the faster it could dominate the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region. Surely, that would take its mother by surprise.
Watching the ecstatic Silver Giant Dragon beside it, the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon could not help but give a speechless roar, “Scythia, it’s not you who has broken through to the Mid-Mythical Stage, why are you so excited?”
The Silver Giant Dragon looked at it strangely, “Roar! I am the Dragon Palace Dragon King. Doesn’t Tim Abbott becoming stronger mean that the Great Scythia is also getting stronger?”
The logic of the Silver Giant Dragon momentarily stumped the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon… It seemed there was nothing wrong with it.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, having broken through to the Mid-Mythical Stage, appeared even more fierce and ferocious, then without paying attention to the two Giant Dragons spectating its meal, it continued to tear and devour the flesh and blood of the Bi Giant Beast voraciously.
For a time, the entire small world was filled only with the thunderous sound of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s chewing and tearing.
It took almost two days for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to finish consuming the Mythical Peak Giant Beast, a couple of quasi-mythical behemoths, and several Level 9 Giant Beasts, and by that time its body length had grown to 913 meters.
In addition, its Evolution value had surged by over ten thousand points. It seemed that by consuming just a hundred more Mythical Giant Beasts, it could reach the threshold for its sixth Evolution.
Of course, that was just a thought.
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon later grew to a couple of thousand meters, reaching the Titan Level, and then to six or seven thousand meters to become an Ancient Titan, the energy consumed with every additional meter of growth would be incredibly terrifying.
With a body length of over 900 meters, its shoulder height reaching 200 meters whilst standing on all four claws, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon looked even larger and more terrifying. Turning its head back to the two distant Giant Dragons, it gave a soft roar.
“Scythia, Telsafi, I am about to strengthen myself next, and it might cause a bit of commotion,” it growled.
Having finished consuming the flesh and blood of the behemoths, it was time to enhance its talents. The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon felt that this time its advancement might be formidable, so it gave a heads-up in advance.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, you want to enhance your strength again?” Even the Silver Giant Dragon was a bit surprised this time.
The Golden-Blue Giant Dragon was simply dumbfounded.
It grew to over 900 meters in such a short time, broke through the Mid-Mythical Stage, and now it still wants to further enhance its strength??
Why does it feel like improving its strength is as easy as drinking water for it?
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared, “After consuming the flesh and blood of these behemoths, my growth has led to insights into my other talents. I am planning to consume those Life Crystals to enhance my understanding.”
This slaughter of the behemoths had rewarded the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon with two Level 9 and two high-order Level 8 crystals, enough to transform into twenty to thirty thousand Attribute points.
As for the Bi Giant Beast, although it had also reached the Mythical Peak, behemoths that enter the Mythical-level would no longer possess Life Crystals, as they would be transformed into the Laws’ Origin.
Meaning, Life Crystals would only be found in behemoths below the Mythical-level.
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded in realization, “Roar! So that’s how it is, I almost forgot about your talent for comprehension, Tim Abbott.”
With a nod to the two Giant Dragons, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon soared into the sky, stirring a violent wind wave as it landed atop a ten thousand meter mountain that was half broken away.
Boom! The massive body of the Black-red Colossal Beast descended from the heavens. At the moment of landing, rocks shattered within a radius of thousands of meters, and the air billowed as the entire mountain peak trembled slightly.
Surveying the surroundings, now blocked by fragmented boulders, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s feather horns ignited with Golden-White flames, and the entwined Silver Patterns began to gleam faintly.
Whoom! In the center of the blazing ring of fire, a silver vortex emerged.
Suddenly, the purple little dragon’s eyes lit up: Yii ya yii ya!!
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon growled, “Good, I’m going to sacrifice Life Crystals.”
Yii ya yii ya!! The purple little dragon instantly became excited because last time in the Ice Crystal Divine Palace, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had sacrificed many Life Crystals and then became much stronger.
Today, it too wanted to sacrifice, and the great Misss Joseline also wanted to grow stronger.
But what should it sacrifice? The purple little dragon looked around and realized it seemed to have nothing to offer.
No, that’s not right! Its eyes lit up, and the little dragon fished out a palm-sized piece of uneaten eggshell from under its neck.
Meanwhile, in the Cultivation Room within Scythia, the increasingly terrifying aura of Jack Clark flashed with golden red light on his right arm, with a silver vortex of several meters in diameter appearing in front of him through spatial positioning.
Just as the silver vortex appeared, four high-level Life Crystals passed through the pathway.
However, just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was transporting the four Life Crystals, the purple little dragon let out an excited, childish roar and tossed the piece of eggshell towards the silver vortex.
Suddenly, both the corners of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark’s mouths twitched uncontrollably, What does he (it) want with a piece of egg?
Watching the eggshell pass through the Spatial Channel, the purple little dragon stood upright, raising its double claws high, and shouting yii ya yii ya ya as it began to make its wish.
What was this little guy thinking? A slight smile appeared on Jack Clark’s lips as he picked up the piece of eggshell from the ground and then, along with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, closed the spatial channel for material transmission.
Looking at the attribute page, where three hundred and forty thousand attribute points had been transformed, Jack Clark’s voice echoed in his mind.
“Consume two hundred thousand attribute points to enhance the Thunderflame Avatar’s talents of swiftness, regeneration, Annihilation True Thunder, Purple Void Poison.”
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, two hundred thousand attribute points vanished from the page in an instant, transforming into enhancement energy that passed through the Soul Channel and manifested powerfully within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body.
Roar! In a moment, the black-red Colossal Beast roared towards the sky, and between its Dorsal Fins, endless black and blue Thunder erupted, forming a Thunder Pool electrical grid that enveloped several kilometers around it.
At the same time, a circle of purple radiance exploded around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, enveloping a ten-kilometers range, corroding and annihilating everything in its path.
In this moment, the rune sequence chains that represented the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s four talents emerged one by one, densely covering its entire body, flesh and blood, bones, cells, even down to its genes.
Under the reinforcing energy, these talent rune sequence chains that represented ‘strength’ continued to evolve, becoming more complex and conforming to some kind of rule or law of Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
Impacted by the four Deification Talents that were advancing to the next stage, the four talents that had already transformed into the Destruction Law, Vajra Law, Chaotic Dark Power, and Great Sun Golden Flame Law were also activated.
Beyond these, the Deification Talent of Gigantification also manifested as rune sequence chains that enveloped the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s entire body.
In this moment, all the talent rune sequence chains of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon were vibrating, resonating, and echoing each other, starting a terrifying transformation at the level of life.
In an instant, an indescribable terror and pressure spread across Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 966: 406: The Undying Life of Heavenly Tier, Nine Layers of the Ninth Heavens Late Period
chapters.content:
Chapter 966: Chapter 406: The Undying Life of Heavenly Tier, Nine Layers of the Ninth Heavens Late Period
As the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon underwent a transformation, the entire Rift Small world began to shake, the sky vibrated with Air Vibration, and the Earth and its mountains thundered.
Beyond the Rift World, endless dark clouds gathered out of nowhere, enveloping an area of over tens of kilometers, as terrifying Thunder roared in the depths of the Void.
Especially that supreme, almost divine, Terrifying Aura that seemed to descend from ‘heaven’, put so much pressure on every creature of the Rift World that they were filled with trepidation.
The Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon suddenly went limp and, with a loud crash, fell from a kilometer high altitude to the ground, causing the Earth to shatter and smoke and dust to billow.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened in astonishment as it looked into the distance: “Roar! Tim Abbott has become so strong this time that even the Great Sethia feels its tail going limp.”
Compared to the previous breakthroughs in strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, this transformation was even greater, so much so that even the Silver Giant Dragon could not help but be shocked.
Feeling the trembling in their bloodline, the limp Gold-Blue Giant Dragon also trembled and roared softly, “Its bloodline feels as if it can undergo Infinite Evolution.”
From the time it first met this Giant Beast named Thunderflame to now, just half a Star Hours had passed, yet it had witnessed the other’s sudden rise in talent, completely defying all logic.
It was as if this creature from the Indigenous World had no limits.
At that moment, the Naga Tribe miles beneath the lake’s center lay limp at the bottom, continually blowing bubbles from their mouths, as they were stunned into unconsciousness by the fearsome pressure.
Yi ya yi ya!? Under the horrifying pressure of a transformation akin to that of the Heavenly Tier, the Purple little dragon could no longer stand easily as before, its body going limp as it lay atop the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon Head.
However, at this moment, the Purple little dragon’s eyes were full of confusion and doubt, because it too had made a sacrifice, yet while its brother had suddenly grown stronger, it felt no reaction whatsoever.
Could it be that the eggshells it sacrificed were wrong, and a Life Crystal was necessary instead?
Boom boom boom!!
Layers of Black Destructive Lightning exploded from the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, shattering the space they passed through and causing mountain peaks to collapse, followed by heavy golden light, dark Chaotic currents, sizzling Golden-White flames, and Blue Sea-colored Thunder…
As a variety of Higher-order Laws and Deified Gifted Powers were unleashed without restraint, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon transformed into a terrifying Light sphere several kilometers in diameter.
With the Chaotic Colors Light sphere as the center, all matter within tens of kilometers melted away, shattered, and was annihilated due to the intense heat of the destructive energy.
And within the center of that destructive radiance, the indescribable Terrifying Aura grew stronger and stronger, until finally, with a loud noise, it broke through some kind of shackles.
In an instant, the consciousness of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon shook, and a force pulled it into a ‘world’ filled with myriad colors, where its consciousness merged with an ancient character ‘Firmament’.
Boom!
Under the impact of boundless and vast information, the consciousness of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fell into a chaotic state between sleep and wakefulness, and at the same time, its soul underwent changes as it was nourished by the Transformation of its physical body.
At this moment, under the Deification of all its talents, the life level of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had comprehensively stepped into ‘heaven’.
Instantly, deep within the mythical world, there was a slight tremor, and in the sky far beyond the Firmament, at a distance of billions and millions of kilometers in the starry space, dozens of stars suddenly emitted dazzling light, clear even in the daytime.
Countless creatures within the boundless mythical world instinctively looked up, their eyes revealing curiosity, astonishment, and solemnity as they observed the shining stars.
Including many people in the Human Territory who were also surprised to look up, wondering why so many stars had suddenly appeared.
They remembered seeing three stars half a month ago, and not long after, one of the stars fell, almost destroying the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
In the area of the Divine Gods Alliance, Eddy Keller, dressed in white and built large and powerful, stood with his hands behind his back on top of a tree several hundred meters tall, looking at the sky and lamenting, “True to the mythical world, stars appear even during broad daylight.”
While countless creatures were surprised by the starry spectacle in the sky, Jack Clark also showed shock in his eyes.
Because of the dual focus of his consciousness, when the consciousness of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon fell into chaos, the other half of Jack’s consciousness was sensing the surroundings.
Those colorful bands of Radiance were not energy but rather a manifestation of certain Rules, representing one of the operating Rules of the mythical world, containing infinite mystery.
Boom! Jack merely ‘glanced’ at the surroundings, and instantly, an infinite flood of vast information surged into his consciousness and thoughts, whitening his face instantly.
Hiss!
Jack held his splitting head, took a breath of cold air, and immediately withdrew from the fusion with the chaotic state of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s other half of consciousness.
That place was too terrifying, far beyond the realm he could touch at the moment.
However, this brief fusion wasn’t without its benefits. Feeling the remnants of the World Origin in his mind, Jack’s eyes projected a three-dimensional shadow, clearly that of himself, or more precisely, the body of the Battle Demon God.
Once cultivators reached the Ninth Heavens, to improve their cultivation, they need to comprehend the essence of their own power, evolve their domain, and ultimately merge all their powers with the help of their domain power to touch upon the Law.
However, because Jack was too strong, with too many Divine Powers and powers that pointed directly to Higher-order Laws, even with ‘unmatched talent’ and sufficient resources, he couldn’t break through to king-level in a month.
But, with the opportunity this time, he felt that he would soon be able to cross into the late period of the Nine Layers.

chapters.title: Chapter 967: 406 Undying Heavenly Tier Being, Late Period of the Nine Heavens_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 967: Chapter 406 Undying Heavenly Tier Being, Late Period of the Nine Heavens_2
In the Cultivation Room, Jack Clark directly took out all the God-level resources he exchanged this time, absorbing and refining these energies at a terrifying speed. The body of the Demon God transformed at an astonishing rate.
Behind Jack Clark, four rings of light emerged, forming visions of a Fourfold World. In these Four Worlds, strands of Earth Law, Fire Law, Strong Wind Law, and Lightning Law intertwined.
As these law patterns merged, the Fourfold World became more perfected and stable.
In the mythical world, whether cultivators, different races, or giant beasts, the laws that were congealed during a breakthrough into myth were the ultimate transformation of one’s own power, in harmony with the corresponding laws of heaven and earth.
Because the law powers grasped and controlled belonged to the individual, their might was actually not as terrifying as imagined.
For example, a king who had mastered the Fire Law could not mobilize the Fire Law of the entire mythical world to smelt the world but could instantly turn an area of a dozen kilometers into a sea of flames.
Of course, this comparison is in terms of the mythical world. If placed in Blue Star, the king would be a deity from the mythical legends, able to destroy a city with a wave of a hand, comparable to a nuclear bomb in human form.
And it’s the kind that can be launched consecutively.
As Jack Clark devoted himself to cultivation and the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon underwent transformation, time rapidly slipped away, and in the blink of an eye, five days quietly passed.
In the center of the Rift World, the mountain peak that had collapsed and still stood thousands of meters tall had vanished, forming a Scorching Lava Lake with a radius of dozens of kilometers.
Within the churning lava lake, a Giant Beast, measuring nine hundred and eighty meters in length, stood tall. It exuded an indescribable terrifying pressure that solidified the entire “world.”
This time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s body underwent some changes again.
Originally, because the first three Deification Talents all involved the physical body, its frame had become more imposing, especially the Black-red Scaled Armor, which had become extremely thick.
But with all the talents transforming this time, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon reverted back to its robust and formidable form, with streamlined Black-red Scaled Armor that looked even more ferocious.
Especially that elongated tail, sharp like a slash blade, now exceeded more than half of its body length. The seventy meters it had grown this time almost entirely extended to its tail, fierce and domineering.
Also, atop the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head, aside from the two pairs of stout, sharp dragon horns, there were three pairs of signature feather horns, like red wings with Golden-White flames burning on them.
The biggest change was on its back, where two dark red wings that could fold and retract like bone wings sprouted on either side of the coral-like, sharp three rows of Dorsal Fins.
Crackle Crackle!!
At the thought of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, those Black-red wings, made of keratin and resembling a metallic texture, unfolded, spanning about one thousand and four hundred meters.
Hum!
Gold and Blue Radiance emitted from the edges of the Black-red feather horns. Then, a pair of light wings, like light membranes, extended hundreds of meters, forming light wings that covered more than one thousand and eight hundred meters.
Roar! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon spread its double wings and howled towards the heavens.
Boom!
With the roar that sounded like it came from ancient times, the entire Rift Small World trembled, and the rich energy between heaven and earth turned into a tidal sweep covering hundreds of kilometers.
At this moment, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed like a being born at the dawn of ancient times, merging with heaven and earth with every breath and exhale, almost as if it epitomized the essence of a certain power.
Majestic, divine, domineering.
Just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was exerting its pressure on the Rift World, feeling the changes from this transformation, Jack Clark also slowly awoke, with the imposing aura of the late period of the Ninth Heavens permeating around him.
“Late period of the Ninth Heavens, huh.”
It had only been six days since the breakthrough to the mid-period of the Ninth Heaven, and Jack couldn’t help but smile at the speed of this breakthrough. Then, with a thought, he summoned the attribute page.
Realm: Ninth Heavens [Late Period]
Dragon. Physique: 19.8124 [An ancient Innate Life with a lifespan as long as that of heaven and earth]
Dragon. Strength: 20.5590
Dragon. Agility: 18.9714
Spirit: 202372
Fighting Demon God True Body: The body of the Demon God, innately reforged, in harmony with heaven and earth, contains Fourfold Plane, able to mobilize the Power of Heaven and Earth on a large scale with ease.
Deification Talent: Soul Split, Void Double Pupils
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Third Layer]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark [Limit Break]
Equipment: Eight Desolate Battle Sky Halberd [Legendary-Level], Dragon Scales and Phoenix Feathers Battle Armor [Legendary-Level]
Attribute points: 95810
Avatar Body: Azure Heaven Thunder Flame Destruction Emperor Dragon
Level: Mid-Mythical Stage [Possesses four Higher-order Laws, five Deification Talents, recognized by Heaven and Earth, with its true name imprinted in the Origin Core of the mythical world, an ancient Heavenly Tier Colossus.
Note: The moment the soul’s consciousness merges with the true name and is imprinted on the Origin Core of the mythical world, it signifies that the Giant Beast Avatar will become undying.
Even if one day the Giant Beast Avatar and the original body both perish in soul and spirit, it could still revive and return in the future through the true name mark, unless the true name itself is also erased. Therefore, please be cautious in revealing the true name]
Law: Strength.Destruction [Higher-order, evolution fused 11%], Defense. Vajra [Higher-order, evolution fused 11%], Chaotic Dark Power [Higher-order, evolution fused 7%], Heaven Burning Great Sun Golden Flame [Higher-order, evolution fused 5%]
Physique Talent: Swift [Deification, an agility talent strengthened to the extreme, life force field fluctuation merges with Spatial Fluctuations, perfectly controlling oneself.
Divine speed Instant Movement: Fuses with the Origin Fluctuation of space, entering a special state akin to instant movement, breaking through the limits of speed while ignoring all obstacles.
Note: This talent has already touched upon a strand of the ultimate essence of speed and can be elevated to Higher-order Law of Speed]
Regeneration [Deification, a life talent strengthened to the limit, the life force fully emerges and merges with flesh and blood, allowing instant flesh and blood regeneration.

chapters.title: Chapter 968: 406 Undying Heavenly Tier Being, Late Period of the Ninth Heavens_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 968: Chapter 406 Undying Heavenly Tier Being, Late Period of the Ninth Heavens_3
Life Mark: Consuming a significant amount of Life Origin to condense a drop of Rebirth Blood, which contains the mark of the Soul Origin. It enables resurrection at the moment the physical body is shattered and obliterated.
Note: This talent has already touched upon the rules of life and can at any time transform into one of the branches of the Supreme Life Rules, a higher-order law.[Life Origin]
Special Talent: Gigantification [Deification]
Transcendent Talent: Annihilation True Thunder [Deification, a heightened form of the Thunder Talent to its extreme, capable of becoming an area of the Thunder Domain, possessing the power to crush and destroy everything.
Celestial Transformation: The dispersal of thunder forms a magnetic field covering an area of over a hundred kilometers, commanding the Power of Thunder in the storm, initiating widespread celestial changes.
Destruction Aura: The Thunderbolt Power outside the body forms ten ultimate Thunder Rings, merging and compressing personal thunder and the thunder of Heaven and Earth into destructive light beams that annihilate everything.
Hint: The destructive power of the light beams will become even more formidable when merged with other forces.
Note: This talent has already touched upon the Lightning Law and can transform into one of the higher-order laws, Annihilation Thunder of Chaos Hole.]
Purple Void Poison [Deification, Poison Series Power enhanced to its utmost transcendence of materiality, capable of corroding the void and obliterating the soul.
Void-Nether Fusion: This talent is a special class energy talent, capable of seamlessly merging with other transcendent talent rules to form an ultimate power of destruction.
Catastrophe Aura: The power unfolds and spreads, forming a Catastrophe Domain within a radius of fifteen kilometers, corroding and annihilating everything, causing all to wither, and eradicating life where it passes.
Note: This talent has already touched upon the mystery of corrosion and can at any time transform into the higher-order law of Corrosion.]
Evolution Value: 75430/2000000
The transformation this time can be said to be exceptionally terrifying. Not only did the avatar advance to a Heavenly Tier creature, but Jack Clark’s true body also received astonishing feedback from the Giant Beast Avatar’s transformation.
In addition, the Four Major Attributes also skyrocketed, becoming even more fearsome.
The strongest attribute, strength, is now comparable to the combined power of twenty ‘True Dragons,’ condensed into a human-sized body, while the note behind physique has changed to an ancient Innate Life form that shares lifespan with Heaven and Earth.
However, compared to the changes in the true body, the transformation of the Giant Beast Avatar is even more exaggerated.
Named after the azure heavens, commanding thunder, flames, and destruction, the note has now become a mark truly inscribed in the World Origin of the mythical world—a Heavenly Tier creature.
And the moment its true name was inscribed in the World Origin of the mythical world, it signaled that the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is ‘Undying.’
Even if one day, the Giant Beast Avatar, including Jack Clark’s true body, falls completely, it will be revived through the true name mark in the future.
And this is the true meaning of the ‘Heavenly’ tier, granting a lifespan as eternal as Heaven and Earth, a level of life even above that of Ancient True Spirits of the thirteenth tier.
According to Jack Clark’s understanding of the power system during this period, in summary, both humans and the Purgatory Demon Race, and Giant Beasts, the power system can be divided into thirteen tiers.
From one to the Nine Layers of the Ninth Heavens represent transcendence. After the tenth tier comes the Mythical-tier, followed by Titans that correspond to Heavenly Kings, Ancient Titans that correspond to the Supreme, and Ancient True Spirits that correspond to Civilization Emperors.
And that terrifying ‘Giant Beast,’ whose mere tail spans tens of kilometers and whose aftershocks have destroyed the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, falling from the sky like a star—is a terrible existence even beyond the Ancient True Spirits.
As for how high the tier of that terrifying Giant Beast is, Jack Clark does not yet have clarity, as he cannot yet reach that power level.
This transformation of the Giant Beast not only involves a leap in life level, but also a significant enhancement of the four talents to their limits, endowing it with even more potent talent abilities, and each has also touched upon the corresponding higher-order laws.
For example, the talent Speed has touched upon the Law of Speed, Regeneration has touched upon the Life Origin, Annihilation True Strength that can transform into the Annihilation Thunder of Chaos Hole, and Purple Void Poison corresponds to the Law of Corrosion.
Next, as long as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon completes the transformation of the four higher-order laws, the Mythical Giant Beast True Body will become incredibly horrifying after tempering by eight higher-order laws.
At that time, Normal Battle Strength alone will be enough to make it reach the Titan Level. In its Gigantification form, merging with the eight higher-order laws, it could even tear apart late-period Titan Giant Beasts and hard clash with Titan Peak.
Of course, how strong it actually is will only be known after finding a late-period Titan Giant Beast for a fight.
Phew!
Exhaling hot breath that pierced through space, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon seemed somewhat excited as it tucked its wings, drawing in its power and massive body, sinking into the Lava Lake to begin hibernation.
It begins its final transformation of the four higher-order laws, tempering its mythical physique.
This time, with the simultaneous transformation of the four higher-order laws, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon is expected to hibernate for a long time. When it awakes, it will be the moment to sweep through the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Meanwhile, on the head of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon, which absorbed a large amount of Heavenly Tier life essence emitted during its life transformation, also fell into a deep sleep.
And while sleeping, the Purple little dragon’s mouth opened and closed, dribbling drool.
Tens of kilometers away, feeling the breath of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon having completed its transformation and entering hibernation, the Silver Giant Dragon suddenly felt a bit bored.
Then a determined look appeared in the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes: “Roar! Great Scythia must also sleep, and also make a breakthrough to the Mythical-level.” With that, the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t bother to build a palace anymore, instead flying to a ‘small’ mountain thousands of kilometers high to lie down.
After consuming two types of Law resources earlier, its body had already reached the Mythical-level. It was just one step shy of a transformation in terms of its space runes and soul.
Now, sensing the increasingly terrifying strength of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon felt it needed to push itself, to fuse the Innate Space Rune earlier and step into the Mythical-level sooner.
As for the palace, that naturally fell to the responsibility of the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 969: 406 Undying Heavenly Tier Being, Late Period of the Ninth Heavens_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 969: Chapter 406 Undying Heavenly Tier Being, Late Period of the Ninth Heavens_4
…
In Heavenly Abyss City, Jack Clark, who had recently made a breakthrough to the late stage of the Ninth Heavens, had planned to continue his closed-door cultivation, but he stopped upon receiving two pieces of information that came to him suddenly.
At the 13th Military Base, troop after troop of elite forces were boarding the transport train one after the other, including all kinds of military equipment and large Mechas, making an impressive procession that stretched for several miles.
On the edge of the troops stood a ferocious black-red colored Mecha, standing three hundred meters tall and exuding an invisible pressure far more terrifying than that of any typical Mythical King.
Underneath Number One, Freya Louise looked at Jack Clark with some surprise, “Jack Clark, aren’t you going to the Sky Curtain Battlefield?”
Jack Clark, who had come to see her off, shook his head, “After my exposure this time, appearing on the battlefield in the short term would likely make me a target for Demon God-level beings. Such beings are not something I, as a mere late-stage Ninth Heavens, can withstand.”
“That’s why I’m planning to make a breakthrough to king-level before heading there, so that I won’t be so easily slapped to death by those Great Demon Kings or Demon Gods.”
“Jack Clark’s current situation is indeed very dangerous,” Gabriella Aiken said with understanding as she nodded.
“At the end of the last battle, Jack Clark was specifically targeted by the enemy’s Demon God-level beings, even while the True Martial Heavenly King and the Sky-based God King were entangled with them.”
“I’ve heard that the human inner circle has caught some traitors lately, all because they were exposed spying for information about Jack Clark, so it’s better to be cautious.”
As for Freya Louise, although she was also a prime target for the enemy’s attacks when appearing on the battlefield, Number One was too strong, and not even a claw from a Demon God-level being could kill her.
Compared to Jack Clark, Freya Louise was actually safer. She just needed to be careful about her safety when separated from Number One.
Looking at the black-haired young man whose aura had grown somewhat stronger than a few days before, Freya Louise said with a smile in her eyes, “Well then, I’ll go ahead to the Sky Curtain Battlefield and wait for you.”
Given the terrifying talent Jack Clark had displayed, Freya Louise felt it wouldn’t take him long to break through to king-level.
At this moment, Jack Clark looked up at the fierce Number One with a slightly solemn expression, “Never mind me, Freya Louise, you should be careful too. It’s best if you control the growth speed of Number One.”
“This time, you relied on cultivation methods to resist the Mecha’s spirit erosion and physical assimilation, but given Number One’s terrifying growth, or rather revival speed, you may not be so lucky next time.”
Freya Louise nodded, “Don’t worry, I understand. Next time I go into battle, I will control the frequency of Soul Synchronization and try not to exceed the 100% limit.”
After a few more brief exchanges, Freya Louise then flew into the cockpit of Number One, drawn by the light beam on its chest. Instantly, blue-white radiance shone from the eyes of Number One.
Even Jack Clark felt a strong sense of danger under that gaze.
However, Number One merely watched Jack Clark quietly, whether it recognized him as the provider of its ‘food’ from before or from a sense of wariness towards the Deep Red Giant Beast, it showed no violent reaction.
Boom! With a step from Number One, the Earth within a range of several kilometers trembled slightly as though an indescribable colossal entity was on the move.
Watching the black-red colored Mech that stirred up billowing air currents and departed, Gabriella felt her heart racing, “Every time Number One starts up, I get the illusion of facing a terrifying ancient beast.”
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “Because it essentially is an Ancient Beast.”
Gabriella shook her head, “Never mind that now, the strong individuals in the Federation surely know this and must have taken precautions.”
“I’ll be heading off too,” she greeted Jack Clark before releasing her King of Black and White Mech and piloting it to give chase.
After watching the two depart, Jack Clark fell into thought for a moment before his figure shot up into the sky towards Heavenly Abyss Building, to bid farewell to Gabriel and make a trip to the Divine Gods Alliance.
This time, aside from Freya Louise and others leaving, he had also received a sudden request for assistance from Jane Aiken saying she had run into some trouble.
Back when Jane entered the mythical world, Jack had promised to help her if she ever needed it.
Moreover, his cultivation had now broken through to the late stage of the Ninth Heavens and next, he would touch upon the rules and draw on the World Origin to condense a Rule True Body. This step was more a matter of time and effort.
So, it was a good opportunity to see if there were any Soul Crystals remaining in that relic.

chapters.title: Chapter 970: 407 Time Traces, Rule Tempering True Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 970: Chapter 407 Time Traces, Rule Tempering True Body
In the heart of Heavenly Abyss City, high atop a towering skyscraper.
When a young man with shoulder-length black hair, dressed in a grey leisure suit, stepped into Gabriel’s ‘office’, even a Heavenly King Level powerhouse couldn’t help but pause their gaze.
Standing amidst white radiance, surprise flashed in Gabriel’s eyes, “Jack Clark, your cultivation level…”
Jack Clark explained with a smile, “Earlier, I exchanged for many God-level resources, and after absorbing them, I had a breakthrough to the late stages of Ninth Heaven.”
It sounded reasonable—after all, absorbing and refining a pile of God-level, even Law-level resources, one’s cultivation would naturally soar quickly.
But that’s total nonsense.
This was Ninth Heaven; the journey to becoming a deity had begun. If high-order cultivation could be simply piled up with resources, the Human Race’s high-ranking powerhouses would have been in abundance long ago.
Let alone the Purgatory Demon Race, which occupied vast territories and countless resources.
However, advancing from the early to the late stages of Ninth Heaven in less than a half month was acceptable when it came to Jack Clark.
This was, after all, a young man who had cultivated to Ninth Heaven in less than a year and was able to Reverse Defeat a demon king while still at the early stages of Ninth Heaven—a feat even more extraordinary than that genius from over a decade ago.
Then Jack Clark stated the purpose of his visit, “King, a classmate of mine from the Divine Gods Alliance has sent a request for help. I’m planning to go there and take a look.”
As a civilization inheritor under the Federation’s close attention, Jack Clark’s status within the Federation was higher than that of an average king-level. Should he leave or go anywhere, he was required to report to the person in charge of his current location.
In simple terms, it was just a courtesy call, so that when he went there, Top Strong individuals—like the Third Councilor sitting at the Outer Development Department—would have their eyes on him, the Primordial True King.
“Going to the Divine Gods Alliance, it’s about the Gunardo Ruins?” Gabriel seemed surprised.
“King, you also know about this?” Jack Clark paused, his eyes filled with inquiry.
He had only received a help request from Jane Aiken, which related to the so-called Gunardo Ruins, but because there was no signal, the information transmitted was not detailed enough.
Gabriel nodded slightly, “A few days ago, together with Shenxiao and others, we held a high-level meeting with the Outer Development Department to discuss this matter.”
“Recently, in the Chaotic Ancient Region of the Divine Gods Alliance, the inner world of the Gunardo Ruins has opened. One of our Human Race bearing the Ruins Token has entered.”
“Currently, the entrance to that relic is controlled by various tribes, competing for the tokens that drop from the relic every day, waiting for the second pathway to open.”
“By the way, the first person who went in is someone you know, Howard Lambert.”
Howard Lambert, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
That guy had entered the mythical world before him and seemed to have gone to the outpost of the 30th Army Group. Unexpectedly, after several months of not seeing him, he had already advanced deep into the Divine Gods Alliance.
Gabriel continued, “That inner world relic is related to an Ancient Civilization. There is a strength restriction for entry, only allowing beings below thirty life-years (under thirty years old) to go in.”
“Or, to put it another way, the Divine Gods Alliance was established on the ruins of that civilization, and many Alien Deities have some connection with that civilization.”
“Especially the strongest of the Divine Gods Alliance, Tarodel, the Divine King, is said to have received a part of that civilization’s inheritance, which allowed him to enter the realm of a Supreme Divine King.”
“Currently, geniuses from various alien domains in the Divine Gods Alliance are converging, including some from our Human Race who are under thirty and whose cultivation levels are within the Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heaven Experts.”
“In addition, there are powerhouses from the five Great Demon Sects and The Purgatory Family who have joined the Divine Gods Alliance, as well as three demon kings from the Demon God Sect.”
“As a result, the situation is complex.”
“Initially, the Nether Heavenly King suggested you go there, but since you were in Closed-door Cultivation at the time, it was vetoed. After all, your breakthrough to king-level is more important to the Federation than exploring a relic.”
“Now that you’re planning to go, let’s put you in full charge of the relic matter. With your strength, you are more than capable of Suppressing all opponents.” At this, a faint smile appeared on Gabriel’s face.
Given Jack Clark’s ability to contend with Early Myth opponents while at the early stages of Ninth Heaven, now that he’s broken through to the later stages, it’s likely that he’s become even more formidable, possibly even able to match mid-stage Mythical powerhouses.
This level of power is enough to suppress all monsters. The so-called strongest Divine Child, the Main God’s holy sons, are no match for him, including the descendants of the Demon God Sect.
Then Gabriel seemed to recall something and reminded, “Right, remember to be careful of the Holy Light God Sect when you get there.”
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “Holy Light Sect, the one established by Jonathan Walker.”
Concerning this monster who had reached Ninth Heaven within a year more than a decade ago and then later betrayed the Human Race, Jack Clark had specifically looked up his information afterward.
In the decade since his betrayal, Walker had also joined the Divine Gods Alliance and maintained some connections with the Purgatory Demon Race’s Demon God Sect.
However, unlike the fully subservient Evil God Alliance, he founded the Holy Light God Sect, which was non-exclusive in its membership, spreading faith among various tribes within the Divine Gods Alliance.
Their tenet was to make the Vast World devoid of slaughter and strife with all life equal under the Holy Light.
Of course, such a Faith Concept was bound to fail in a world that esteemed martial strength, hence his followers and followers from different races were quite rare.
But any hopeful of the Holy Light Sect was exceptionally mysterious and tough to handle, especially since these cultists control the Sacred Sound Incantations that are as powerful as Divine Powers.
Nevertheless, Walker had disappeared for several years, and no one knew where he had gone.
There is speculation within the human inner circle that he went to the Purgatory Demon Race’s rear and transformed into the Purgatory Great Demon King, while others guess that he ventured deep into the Mythical world, seeking the chance to break through to the Supreme realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 971: 407 Traces of Time, Rule Tempering True Body_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 971: Chapter 407 Traces of Time, Rule Tempering True Body_2
As the genius that once shocked the Human Federation, this individual had entered the realm of Heavenly King a few years ago, with a talent that was truly terrifying.
Boom!
Above the high altitude of tens of thousands of meters, a sinister dark red fighter aircraft zoomed towards the direction of the Divine Gods Alliance at six times the speed of sound, creating sonic booms and rolling air waves around it.
In the cockpit of the Throne Fighter, Jack Clark sat in front of a large screen, looking at the detailed information about the Divine Gods Alliance displayed on it.
The Divine Gods Alliance was composed of more than forty strong men above the level of Myth, including seven king-level beings from the Human Race, four Evil Gods, and the Demon God Sect established by three Purgatory Demon Kings.
In fact, really counting, the king-level beings of the Human Race almost made up one-third of the alliance, except that those four Evil Gods were traitors from the Dark Age.
Among them, Akunus had already died at the hands of Jack Clark, leaving behind the Giant God Sect, the Shadow God Sect, and the Eternal God Church.
As for Jonathan Walker’s Holy Light God Sect, like himself, they were quite special and were not even recognized by the Divine Gods Alliance.
The strongest of the Divine Gods Alliance was named God King Tarodel, a being who had reached the late stages of Supreme power; this strong man was almost invincible in his own vast Divine Realm.
He did not even fear facing three Demon God Level Powerhouses directly.
Below the God King were three Main God-level (Heavenly King) powerhouses, each occupying vast areas, with the size of their Divine Realms being comparable to the size of Blue Star.
These three Main God-level powerhouses were the strongest existences among various races, who not only established their own race’s army but also drew several Mythical Powerhouses to form a Divine System.
Centered on the Divine System of these three Main Gods, twenty-four Alien Mythical Powerhouses were divided into three major factions.
One faction drew close to the Human Race, one to The Purgatory Family, while most belonged to the neutral Alien Deities.
The Alien Deities supporting the Human Race believed that, compared to The Purgatory Family, the Human Race was more reliable, and if the Human Race were defeated, the Divine Gods Alliance would be next in line.
On the other hand, those Alien Deities supporting The Purgatory Family believed that the emergence of the Human Race had broken years of peace within the Divine Gods Alliance.
If it were not for the Human Race exploring the current forbidden area, attracting The Purgatory Family, The Purgatory Family would never have appeared within the Divine Gods Alliance’s purview.
As for most of the neutral Alien Deities, they followed the strongest of the Main Gods and coldly observed the surroundings.
This information also mentioned that among the seven ‘neutral’ king-level humans who joined the Divine Gods Alliance, five actually had their own missions, which was to persuade the Alien Myths.
Originally, the strong men in the Federation thought that with the threat of The Purgatory Family, most of these Alien Deities should draw close to the Human Race to resist the enemy together.
But whether these Alien Deities had a low culture or had become ‘gods’ for too long and their thinking had become decayed, most of them actually maintained their own Divine Realms and stayed out of external affairs.
Furthermore, with the three Demon Kings and four Evil Gods from The Purgatory Family moving around, even a part of the Alien Deities and the Demon God Sect became closer.
Therefore, the plan to persuade the Divine Gods Alliance has been slow to progress for many years.
Including that Supreme Expert, who only coldly observed the great war between the Human Race and The Purgatory Family, exhibiting neither closeness to the Human Race nor hostility toward The Purgatory Family.
Hence, to avoid any unexpected incidents, there has always been a Supreme Expert stationed by the Outer Development Department for a long period.
After reviewing all the information, Jack Clark thoughtfully said, “The opponents in this relic expedition will probably be the Demon God Sect, the Evil God Alliance, and a few elite strong men from those Alien Races.”
Thirty Life Wheels, according to the age of humans, would be under thirty years old, but the time difference between the mythical world and Blue Star is quite large.
In the mythical world, thirty Sun Wheels count as ‘one year,’, meaning that, relative to humans, those Alien Race strong men are actually old men who have cultivated for ninety years.
However, unlike the humans who have Blue Star’s time traces and faster cultivation speed, these Alien Races, while they might have cultivated for a longer time, actually progress quite slowly.
Including The Purgatory Family, in their concept of time, it takes thirty Sun Wheels to make a year, whereas for the Human Race, thirty Sun Wheels would be enough to renew the lower and middle classes’ blood three times over.
And thirty Sun Wheels is the time it takes for a normal Purgatory True Demon to grow one year older.
This is also a reason why the Human Federation has been able to resist for so long – the fresh blood has been renewing way too quickly.
This issue seems to be related to the rules of their respective worlds, which is also why the Human Federation wants to prevent Blue Star from being devoured.
Once Blue Star is devoured by the mythical world, the human civilization species will be completely integrated into the mythical world and assimilated, losing the characteristic of rapid progress.
This characteristic is an important opportunity for the rise of the Human Race to become a great civilization in the mythical world.
In just fifty years, equivalent to five hundred cycles of the Sun Wheel (sixteen years), the Human Race has grown to the point where it can contend with the two empires of The Purgatory Family.
If the Human Federation is given another hundred years, at the current rate of development, it’s possible that several more Supreme Experts, twenty to thirty Heavenly Kings, and one to two hundred Mythical Kings will emerge.
By then, they might even be able to Reverse Defeat The Purgatory Family.
Unfortunately, neither the mythical world nor The Purgatory Family will give humans too much time.
Jack Clark rubbed his brow, casting these issues to the back of his mind.
For him, these were too distant; his current goal was to achieve a breakthrough to king-level as soon as possible. Only then would he truly possess enough strength to influence the battlefield.
After setting the fighter aircraft to autopilot, Jack Clark proceeded to the Cultivation Area and sat down cross-legged.
Huff! Jack Clark slowly exhaled, and then closed his eyes.
As Jack Clark held his breath and focused his mind, sinking into a state of deep observation within his body, strands of World Origin emanating White Light appeared.
Initially on the Road to Godhood, Jack Clark obtained more than twenty strands of World Origin, and later in the heart of The World within the core of the Black Forbidden Zone, he absorbed another twenty-plus strands while assimilating the Mysterious Yellow Air.
Currently, the World Origin he had accumulated amounted to forty-nine strands, conforming to the significant number of forty-nine in the Great Metamorphosis, sufficient for him to complete the transformation of five laws in a short time.
Boom! As Jack Clark activated a strand of World Origin, instantly a Terrifying Aura spread from his body.
Around his closed eyes, fine black and grey patterns emerged, and in addition, golden Flame Patterns appeared on his right arm while Thunder Patterns on his left.
These patterns seemed like some sort of profound truth of Heaven and Earth, emitting a Mysterious Aura.
Having reached the late stages of the Ninth Heavens, Jack Clark’s next step was to engage the World Origin to touch upon the laws and begin Tempering the Rule True Body.
This step of comprehending and touching upon the laws was one that stumped most late-stage ninth heaven experts, but for Jack Clark, it posed no difficulty whatsoever.
The enhanced Deification of his innate Death Double Eyes Talent allowed him to directly touch upon Void and Death, two Higher-order Laws.
Following that were the Anti-Innate powers of the Fighting Demon God True Body, the Hundred Tribulations True Thunder, and Positive Pole Heavenly Flame, which could also be directly transformed into the Higher-order Laws: Great Sun Heaven Flame and Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder.
Compared to his Avatar, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had begun its Transformation and mastered eight Higher-order Laws, Jack Clark could touch upon fewer Higher-order Laws, only four to be exact.
However, besides the four Higher-order Laws, Jack Clark’s Fighting Demon God True Body also possessed three Divine Powers akin to laws that would increase synchronously with his strength.
Adding it all up, he effectively had the equivalent of seven Higher-order Laws.
Additionally, upon achieving a breakthrough to king-level and condensing the Four-fold Plane Unity of Opening the Heavens, once he successfully grasped a Supreme Law, Jack Clark’s own body’s defiance of the heavens would not be inferior to that of his Avatar.
Still, compared to the four Higher-order Laws, the Four-fold Plane World behind Jack Clark’s head was of a lower level and still had a long way to go before meeting the requirements of Opening the Heavens.
There was no helping it; Jack Clark’s cultivation time was simply too short. Whether in terms of growth rate or intrinsic depth, the illusionary Plane World was insufficient, and there was nothing he could do about it.
This was also the reason why he was going to the Divine Gods Alliance.
Apart from wanting to acquire some Soul Crystals to strengthen the Illusion Meditation Scripture, another goal was to see if he could acquire some ‘world-class’ resources to bolster his Plane World.
Under normal conditions, even with his talent, it would take at least ten years for the Four-fold Plane World to grow to the stage of Unity Opening the Heavens.
As for the God-level resources in the Federation’s stores that could enlarge the Illusory World, although there were some, many had already been given to Jack Clark, such as those World Star Core Fragments.

chapters.title: Chapter 972: 408: The Monster Named Jack Clark
chapters.content:
Chapter 972: Chapter 408: The Monster Named Jack Clark
The Divine Gods Alliance, tens of thousands of kilometers from the Human Race’s Outer Development Department, within the Chaotic Ancient Region.
This is an area covering tens of thousands of kilometers that was destroyed due to an unknown great war, containing many relics of Ancient Civilization.
At this moment at the edge of the vast expanse of the Chaotic Ancient Region, a distorted architectural phantom appears in the sky tens of thousands of meters above, magnificent and spectacular as if it were a palace in the heavens.
Below this phantom of buildings lies a barren Gobi, with eroded rocks and crisscrossing canyons.
The atmosphere in this region is extremely serious, with many figures exuding the strength of the Late Eighth Layer and Ninth Heavens scattered and standing out on the edges of the canyons and cliffs.
Besides, there are a dozen or so strong beings exuding a mythical aura standing in the Firmament, confronting each other from a distance.
Roar!
In a canyon tens of kilometers long and several kilometers wide, a hundred-meter-long Divine Dragon roars, wrapping the Heavenly Energy to form Cloud Mist spiraling around, moving at a speed so fast it seemed like a streak of light sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
In the middle of the canyon stands a thirty-meter-tall being with the body of a human and the head of a tiger, clad in Red Battle Armor and wielding a fifty-meter-long Battle Axe.
This individual from a different race emits the aura of the late period of the Eight Layer Heaven, surrounded by a halo of blood light; each swing of their Battle Axe could cleave blades of wind two to three hundred meters long.
Boom, boom, boom! The blades of wind entangled with red light, like lightning, tore through the atmosphere wherever they passed, shattering mountain walls and carving out hundreds of meters long cracks.
Boom! The Divine Dragon circled, its claws sweeping through the sky with Divine Light, smashing each axe blade, while the White mist it stirred began to gradually fill half the canyon.
With the spread of the White mist, similar to that of a domain, the might of the Divine Dragon intensified, while the attacks from the strong man of the different race were gradually suppressed.
Roar! Suddenly, the Cloud Mist scattered, and a hundred-meter-long Dragon Tail swept across like a streak of light, instantly exploding everything in front of the Tiger-headed Alien.
With the terrible strike, the space rippled with transparent shockwaves, sweeping up the mist into an illusion of a few hundred meters long Dragon Tail with a momentum that shook the Earth and sky.
Roar! The Tiger-headed Alien roared angrily, gripping his axe with both hands as a layer of rich light, like fresh blood, burst forth, condensing behind him into a several hundred meters tall phantom.
That Blood Tiger phantom also wielded a Battle Axe, falling in line with the Tiger-headed Alien’s strike.
Boom! A hundred meters long axe light burst forth, splitting into three Shadow Axes in mid-flight that tore through the Earth, leaving three ten-meter-wide, hundred-meter-long cracks.
Boom, boom, boom! The three blood-colored axe lights collided with the Dragon Tail instantly, followed by a terrifying burst of blood light and an earth-shattering explosion.
The entire canyon shook under the impact, raging wind howled, countless shards of rock and dirt rose to the sky, creating a hundred-meter-high storm of smoke and dust that swept across several kilometers.
Amid the howling dust storm, the Alien with the axe was forcefully blown away, smashing into the mountain wall of the canyon a kilometer away, causing half the mountain wall to collapse.
Pu-chi! Amid the crumbling rocks, the Tiger-headed Alien vomited blood; his aura suddenly weakened significantly.
In the distance, the Divine Dragon soared out of the smoke and dust into the skies, circling the high altitude before transforming into a ray of light that landed on the opposite cliff, revealing a white-clothed man as grand as a snow mountain—Eddy Keller.
Eddy Keller stood with his hands behind his back at the cliffside, calmly looking at the distant Tiger-headed Alien and said indifferently in the language of the Divine Gods Alliance, “Is this the strongest of the younger generation of the Kota Clan? Disappointing.”
At once, the Tiger-headed being’s face flushed red, another mouthful of blood spewed out, his eyes bloodshot as he glared at Eddy Keller, wishing to split him with his axe.
Above the head of that Tiger-headed Alien, on the cliff, stood a Purgatory True Demon, five meters tall, with a lean body and arms sharp as blades, covered entirely in black scales.
Around this Purgatory True Demon stood several other different races’ strong men, with heights of three meters, seven meters, and over ten meters, all of varying appearances, each exhaling the pressing power of the middle to late periods of the Eight Layer Heaven and even the Nine Layers, emanating awe.
Yet, each time these individuals cast their gaze upon the Purgatory True Demon, a hint of reverence unconsciously appeared in their eyes.
That Purgatory True Demon then spoke slowly, “Kruddo, come up here. To the Human Race, the Kota Clan is but a minor tribe; it’s normal for your strength to fall short of a human expert of the same rank.”
“However, you’ve now joined the Demon God Sect. As long as you undergo the bloodline transformation and inherit from the True Demon Race, you’ll naturally become peerless within your rank.”
Eddy Keller spoke disdainfully from across the cliff, “Peerless within the same rank? That’s quite bold. Even a pure-blooded True Demon is no match for Old Eddy, not to mention a Purgatory True Demon converted from a different race.”
His words immediately turned the expressions of the Demon God Sect’s cultists cold.
Eddy Keller stood proudly, his hands behind his back as he proclaimed, “What’s the matter, can’t accept it? If you can’t accept it, send a Purgatory True Demon with Eight Path Demon Marks to die, and let Old Eddy show you what it means to be truly peerless within the same rank.”
At this moment, Eddy Keller was extremely arrogant—so arrogant that it even brought a hint of murderous intent to the eyes of the Purgatory True Demon, who said in a deep voice, “Human, you are courting death.”
Eddy Keller sneered, “You say I’m courting death as if that’s enough to kill me. What kind of dog thing do you think you are, or do you think just running your mouth from there will do me in?”
“Courting death!” Boom!
The Purgatory True Demon exploded with a terrifying aura, turning into a roaring Black Flames that surged towards the sky, instantly creating a circular blast around it, tearing apart the cloud layers at ten thousand meters altitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 973: 408: The Monster Named Jack Clark_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 973: Chapter 408: The Monster Named Jack Clark_2
The realm of Mid-Nine Demonic Marks, but the aura was almost reaching the terrifying presence of a demon king; the surrounding space trembled, pressuring the different races of Late Eighth Layer and Nine Layers to retreat continuously.
Boom! The terrifying aura akin to that of a demon king converged, forming a ghostly face phantom that spanned hundreds of meters above Eddy Keller’s head several kilometers away. Under the terrifying Demon Power, Eddy Keller narrowed his eyes involuntarily.
At this moment, his cultivation was still at Mid-eighth level, but he had made considerable progress compared to when he met Jack Clark half a month ago, nearing the Late Eighth Layer.
However, despite the terrifying strength of the Purgatory True Demon, Eddy Keller showed not a hint of fear.
Just as the ghostly face, formed by the innate power of the True Demon, was howling and about to engulf Eddy Keller, a deep and thick voice sounded.
“Sykes, do you think my Human Race has no one?”
Boom! Behind Eddy Keller, a terrifying Fist Intent soared into the sky, setting off a series of white shockwaves that spanned hundreds of meters and dispersed the ghostly face phantom with a bang.
Thump! At a several thousand meters altitude, a circular air explosion occurred, creating a violent wind wave that swept across tens of kilometers, the roiling clouds and mist creating a spectacle.
On the hillside behind Eddy Keller stood six young men and women of the Human Race, each exuding a powerful aura.
Among them were Joshua Welan, who participated in the earlier Heavenly Abyss Battlefield fight, Jane Aiken, who carried four Divine Swords, and three twentysomething young men, and a woman.
Joshua Welan’s injuries had not only recovered by then, but his aura had grown stronger by several degrees following the life-and-death battle.
As for Jane Aiken, a few months not seen, her cultivation had broken through to the Eighth Layer Early Phase, with progress more and more terrifying, almost catching up to Eddy Keller.
And the young man who had just unleashed the terrifying Fist Intent stood in the middle of the six, his cropped steel needle-like hair short and his sharp eyes faintly entwined with white lightning.
Gazing at the Purgatory True Demon several kilometers away, Sid Hawk spoke slowly, “Sykes, do you, a fellow with Nine Demonic Marks, feel good about using force against my Human Race’s Eight Layer cultivators?”
“Or is it that your so-called invincibility within the same rank, the Purgatory True Demons, is actually just a laughable title when compared with those a realm lower than you?”
The True Demon with arms like blades replied in a deep voice, “Hmph! Just now, I was merely teaching him a lesson to be careful of the trouble that comes from his mouth.”
“As for myself, if I wish to make a move, naturally I would look for you, Sid Hawk. Only by slaying a Descendant of the King like you would I feel a slight sense of achievement.”
Sid Hawk sneered, “Is that so, but I’m afraid you won’t even be able to take a single punch from me.”
As he spoke, Sid Hawk advanced two steps, an aura of Late Nine Layers emanated from him, mixing with a terrifying Fist Intent that suppressed Heaven and Earth, soaring into the sky.
Boom Boom!!
Two substantial terrifying pressures collided in the sky above the canyon, as if two immense beasts were clashing, the atmosphere exploding and creating a series of three-dimensional rippling shockwaves that swept across Heaven and Earth.
The mere presence was already so fearsome that it made many different races tens of kilometers around look on with concentrated gazes.
Some of these different races looked nearly human, with third eyes on their foreheads; others were over ten meters tall, with the bodies of horses and the heads of dragons; there were also beastly figures like explosive bears standing upright.
The geniuses from dozens of Alien Deities’ strengths represented these young and powerful, the weakest among them with a cultivation of mid-to-late Seventh Layer, most at the Eighth and Nine Layers.
