Among them, some Alien Deities with divine light circulating on their bodies had particularly terrifying auras, as if out of a myth.
Looking at the two forces clashing with great aura at a distance, one of the different races with feather-like eyebrows spoke solemnly, “The Human Race is so strong, they can’t even suppress one known as the peerless within the same rank from The Purgatory Family.”
On the opposite mountain peak, the three-eyed Alien Deity nodded slightly.
But some alien races chuckled coldly, their eyes filled with disdain, “What peerless within the same rank? That’s just a ridiculous self-proclaimed title by those True Demons. If it were true, the Human Race would have been annihilated long ago.”
“Indeed.”
While the alien races were discussing, Sid Hawk and Sykes confronted each other for a while, then suddenly both sides began to slowly retract their auras, no longer probing any further.
Pah! Eddy Keller looked dismissively at the opposite side of the canyon, then turned around and walked towards the rear, thanking the buzz-cut young man politely, “Thank you for stepping in just now, Senior Hawk.”
Sid Hawk shook his head, “No need for politeness, when we’re away from home, we of the Human Race naturally should take care of each other.”
After exchanging greetings, Eddy Keller turned to the girl standing with her sword and asked in a low voice, “Junior Aiken, didn’t you send him a message earlier? He’s going to come, right?”
“He will,” Jane Aiken said in a clear tone.
A woman standing nearby with her arms crossed and her hair tied in a high ponytail heard this and grew curious, “Miss Keller, what are you talking about?”
Eddy Keller said with a chuckle, “Nothing much, just that the relic is about to open, so I had Junior Aiken notify a Junior to come over.”
“Junior.”
Upon hearing this, the woman paused for a moment, and then frowned slightly, “Miss Keller, this relic is no joke.”
In that woman’s mind, since Eddy Keller had just graduated, his Junior must be a Second Grade student and, despite being a monster or genius, would probably only have reached the Seventh Layer Heaven in cultivation.
With the Seventh Layer Heaven in cultivation, coming here where the relics are full of Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heavens alien strong men is simply suicide.
The others also frowned slightly, somewhat dissatisfied with Eddy Keller’s actions.
Confidently, Eddy Keller said, “Don’t worry, Ida, Senior Hawk, Junior Clark is a monster, his talent is even more monstrous than Junior Aiken’s.”
Ida Carroll’s brows rose, “There is someone with even more monstrous talent than Junior Aiken? Miss Keller, are you sure you’re not joking?”
During her mission with the Divine Gods Alliance, Ida Carroll, who had known Jane Aiken for less than ten days, was shocked by the girl’s terrifying talent.
Not yet graduating First Grade, her cultivation had already made a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer Early Phase, and she had also condensed four grand accomplishments of Sword Intent, creating a Sword World with an out-of-this-world enlightenment; her combat power was far beyond her realm.
Such talent had already greatly shocked Ida Carroll, an Innate Awakened One, and Sid Hawk, a Descendant of the King. Now, Eddy Keller was actually claiming there was someone whose talent exceeded even Jane Aiken’s.
Joshua Welan suddenly said, “Wait a minute, Eddy, this Junior Clark you’re talking about, isn’t his name Jack Clark?”
“Eh! Senior Welan, you know Junior Clark?”
Both Eddy Keller and Jane Aiken looked at the young man who had arrived two days earlier with some surprise.
The expression on Joshua Welan’s face immediately became complicated, a mix of shock, admiration, and a wry smile, “Know him? That guy is indeed a monster.”
Earlier on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, Joshua Welan originally thought that with his early Ninth Heavens cultivation and quasi-mythical combat power, he’d make a sensational impact.
Yet just after completing a mission to destroy an Alien Corps, he encountered a Descendant of the Demon God from The Purgatory Family, whose combat power was even more exaggerated.
With no choice left, he used his life-saving trump card to escape with heavy injuries.
Then, while he was lying behind the Heavenly Abyss Battle City recovering, news came of this Junior named Jack Clark, who was in the same class as his brother, stunning the Heavenly Abyss Battle City with his exaggerated achievements.

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 974 409 Jack Clarks Arrival Sword Qi Across
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 974: Chapter 409: Jack Clark’s Arrival, Sword Qi Across the Sky Chapter 974: Chapter 409: Jack Clark’s Arrival, Sword Qi Across the Sky “`
As Jack Clark now possessed king-level combat strength, the secrecy surrounding his identity was no longer as strict as it had been.
However, the Federation did not deliberately publicize it.
While widely announcing the existence of Jack Clark could set a goal for the Federation’s mid and lower-level cultivators, boosting morale, it was deemed unnecessary.
After all, although his combat strength was comparable to that of an ordinary king, he was still a Ninth Heaven Cultivator.
Therefore, only a portion of the soldiers from the Third Battlefield, the intermediate battlefield, and the high-ranking powerhouses who had attended the King’s Conference knew about Jack Clark’s achievements in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
Like Joshua Welan.
Noticing the complex expression on Joshua Welan’s face, Ida Carroll grew curious, “Joshua, is that ‘Junior’ named Jack Clark really that prodigiously talented?”
“It’s more than just exaggeration.”
Joshua Welan gave a bitter smile, “Junior Clark, my brother Justin Welan, and Junior Aiken were all students of the previous class at South Sky Martial Height; they’re still considered Senior Ones since the summer vacation hasn’t ended.”
“But Junior Clark’s cultivation has already made a breakthrough to the Ninth Heaven, and his combat strength is even more exaggerated.”
“In the great battle that erupted on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield more than ten days ago, Junior Clark slain over fifty Purgatory Demon mercenaries above Nine Demonic Marks.”
“Later, he went on to slay four demon kings and severely injure two Great Demon Kings in the early stage of Ninth Heaven…”
“Hold on, are you sure you’re not mistaken?” Before Joshua could finish, Sid Hawk couldn’t help but interrupt, shock and doubt clear on the faces of everyone present.
Because what Joshua Welan described was too exaggerated.
Slaying four demon kings, even severely injuring Great Demon Kings in the early stage of Ninth Heaven—how could that be possible? The power gap between Great Demon Kings within the Nine Heavens was bigger than that between an ant and an elephant.
Even Jane Aiken and Eddy Keller were somewhat incredulous, as in their understanding, although Jack Clark’s talents and combat strength were monstrous, they couldn’t possibly be that exaggerated.
Joshua Welan was speechless, “Do you think I’m joking?”
Hum! Just then, the virtual shadow of the building that looked like a palace in the sky slightly distorted, sending out an invisible fluctuation and a humming resonance.
Suddenly, in front of the building’s main hall, a black iron shard emitting a faint white glow appeared out of nowhere, instantly causing all aliens within a hundred kilometers to grow restless.
“The third token has appeared.”
In an instant, including Jane Aiken, young warriors from over twenty different Divine Sects, the Human Race, the Demon God Sect, and the Evil God Sect Alliance looked up at the iron shard tens of thousands of meters above.
Whoosh!
The iron shard glinted, as if appearing from the depths of space and time, falling from the high skies.
“The token is mine.”
Boom!
From the mountain peak some ten kilometers away, a Ninth Heaven aura erupted; a three-meter-tall alien with ten-meter-wide wings unfurled, shooting up into the sky like a flash of light and crossing ten kilometers in the blink of an eye to reach the high altitudes.
But just as joy appeared on the winged alien’s face, and it was about to seize the iron shard, its face abruptly changed, and its figure vanished from the spot.
Whiz!
At the moment the alien vanished, a black arrow, hundreds of meters long and several meters thick, like a beam of light, pierced heaven and earth, emanating a terrifying aura.
Boom!
The black arrow exploded after traveling tens of thousands of meters, leaving behind a kilometer-wide hole in the layer of clouds, with the blast ringing endlessly between heaven and earth.
“Roar! That token is mine.”
With a bellow, a figure a hundred meters tall appeared, with feet planted on the earth and arms wrapped by two hundred-meter-long blue Flood Dragons emitting a formidable aura.
“Who dares to obstruct the Demon God Sect.”
Boom, boom, boom!! In an instant, numerous Ninth Heaven pressures erupted, turning into dozens of beams of light shooting into the skies, among them Joshua Welan, Ida Carroll, Sid Hawk, and others.
A chaotic battle immediately broke out around the iron shard.
Meanwhile, as those Ninth Heaven strongmen fought for the relic token, Jane Aiken and Eddy Keller became targets of the Demon God Sect’s subordinate aliens.
Leading them was a tiger-headed alien who had been wounded by Eddy Keller and three individuals in black scale armor, exuding an Eight Layer Heaven aura who shot forth.
“Seeking death.”
Eddy Keller let out a long howl, her body flashing with light as she transformed into a hundred-meter-long White Divine Dragon that soared to meet them, with Cloud Mist swirling and covering hundreds of meters around her.
Roar!
The tiger-headed alien’s blood light surged, wielding axes and striking down with the force of Opening the Heavens, while the Demon Cultist turned into a roaring Black Demon Ape.
Boom!
A colossal Dragon Claw clashed with the axe blade, the Dragon Tail sweeping at the demon ape, and in an instant, violent Overbearing strength burst forth, destroying the ground within hundreds of meters.
On the hillside, Jane Aiken’s gaze was cold as she looked at the oncoming Demon Cultist, with four intersecting Sword Lights appearing in her eyes.
Boom! A fusion of red, blue, black, and gray Sword Qi burst out from Jane Aiken, forming a three-hundred-meter Sword World around her.
Each strand of this Sword Qi was tangible, with red reflecting the ephemeral reality, blue flashing sharp and swift, and black Sword Light that could slice cracks into the space itself.
The moment the Sword World was formed, thousands of Sword Qi strands shot out, covering the sky and engulfing the two Demon Cultists.
In an instant, the faces of the two Mid-term Eighth Layer cultists drastically changed.
“`
“Not good!”
“Be careful!”
Phut, phut!
Under the horrifying sword light, the blade light and Spear Radiance released by those two Demon God Sect powerhouses, along with the demon gas that enveloped them in a radius of hundreds of meters, were all torn to shreds.
Especially the terrifying Sword Intent contained in the grey sword light, which instantly wiped out the spiritual will of the two ‘persons’ as well.
Whoosh!
After obliterating two Middle-Eighth-Layer strongmen, the sword qi swirling in the sky converged into four sword lights of crystal red, black, blue, and grey, returning to Jane Aiken’s side as four reforged streams.
Standing within the Sword Array, the girl’s black hair moved without wind, her body circulated a sword intent far beyond grand accomplishment, and her gaze was calm as she watched the grand battle in the Ninth Heaven.
Boom! Suddenly, a terrifying impact exploded in the sky.
The young man with a third eye on his forehead and unique patterns on his cheeks emanated endless golden light, like a Great Sun hanging across the Firmament.
Under the endlessly expanding golden halo, space itself began to wrinkle rapidly, the atmosphere exploded, forming circles of white waves, and in an instant, all competitors changed their expressions drastically.
Boom, boom, boom!!
One after another, the Early and Mid-Ninth-Heaven powerhouses were blown away like leaves in the autumn wind, scattered by the golden circle which had ballooned to over a thousand meters in diameter.
Then, even stronger figures scattered from within the golden circle, turning into streaks of light landing on cliffs and mountain peaks within tens of kilometers.
Among them were Sid Hawk of the Late Eighth Layer, Ida Carroll and Joshua Welan of the Mid-Eighth Layer.
Whoosh! Ida Carroll exhaled, then glanced down at the valley where the battle was still raging, “Miss Keller, can you handle it? You’ve been fighting them for so long without killing them.”
Boom, boom! Below, the white Divine Dragon let out a long cry, and the white mist surrounding it for hundreds of meters erupted like a Tsunami, releasing terrifying power that repelled the two Evil God Sect Cultists.
Swish!
The moment the two Evil God Sect Cultists were repelled, Eddy Keller transformed into a white dragon shadow and returned to the hillside.
Those two Evil God Sect Cultists snorted coldly and also transformed into a streak of black and red light that shot up into the sky, joining the Demon God Sect’s forces, standing behind the Purgatory True Demon.
With the struggle of high-end powerhouses over, there was no longer a chance for them to kill the two Federal Geniuses, and vice versa.
But at this moment, the Purgatory True Demon, with arms like slash blades, had an ugly expression, “Useless trash, to be killed instantly by that human.”
On the hillside, Eddy Keller spoke somewhat speechlessly, “Junior Clark, both of our opponents are Late-Eighth-Layer powerhouses. How could I possibly kill them in a few moves?”
Ida Carroll crossed her arms and did not let him off, “Shouldn’t it be that you are too weak? Look at Junior Aiken. She killed those two opponents with just one move.”
“I am on the path of True Intent Materialization, which is different from Junior Aiken. Her Sword Qi is too strong, and she has four sword intents of grand accomplishment.”
Then, Eddy Keller decisively changed the subject and looked at Sid Hawk, “Brother Hawk, did you fail to get the token?”
“No, it was snatched away by the Divine Child of the Tarodel Divine System.”
Sid Hawk spoke with a heavy tone, “This ‘person’s’ strength is terrifying, not only is their cultivation level at the Ninth Heaven Peak, but their combat power also far exceeds the Transcendent boundary.”
At this remark, the expressions of Ida Carroll and the others became somewhat serious.
Meanwhile, in the sky hundreds of kilometers away, where giants encircled the projection of the relic, stood nine beings emitting the aura of Mythical Powerhouses.
Among these strong figures were two Human Kings confronting two Demon Kings shrouded in rolling demon gas, with five Alien Deities enshrouded in Divine Light standing around.
At that moment, from within the cloud of demon gas obscuring the sky, a cold voice sounded, “Jewell, this is a Divine Gods Alliance relic. Why would your human geniuses appear here?”
Another Demon King spoke slowly, “Indeed, this relic belongs to the Divine Gods Alliance. It’s the ‘people’ of the alliance who should be exploring it. The human race has no right to interfere.”
In response, the middle-aged man clad in a white robe and surrounded by White mist spoke indifferently, “The human race has no right, but do you Purgatory Demon Clan have the right?”
“Besides, they have joined my Immortal Guard Forbidden Army, which is a part of the Divine Gods Alliance, naturally, they are entitled to enter the relic.”
“Jewell, stop quibbling. That human genius named Joshua Welan was participating in the war between the human race and our Purgatory Family in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield half a Sun Wheel ago.”
“Now you’re telling us that he has joined your Immortal Guard Forbidden Army, do you really take us for fools?”
The middle-aged man responded lightly, “Believe it or not, that’s up to you.”
While the Human Kings and the two Demon Kings faced off, the five Alien Deities remained cool and detached, not uttering a word.
Just then, from the distant horizon, a sinister crimson Throne Fighter jet approached at breakneck speed, its presence resembling a Mythical Giant Beast, which caught the attention of the nine mythical figures.
The Demon King hidden in the surging demon gas sneered, “It turns out to be a Throne Fighter of the human race.”
“It seems the human race really doesn’t take the main seat of the Divine Gods Alliance seriously, with a King even breaking the rules and piloting a fighter jet here.”
The cold gaze of the Alien Deities turned even icier.
One Alien Deity with the aura of a Mid-Mythical Stage uttered in a cold voice, “Humans, you’ve crossed the line. According to the rules, Human Kings are not allowed in the Divine Gods Alliance. Stop.”
Boom!
Before the two Demon Cultists could act, the Alien Deity unleashed a terrifying power that turned into a sky-covering giant hand to meet the King’s Battle Machine, intending to stop it.
“Get lost.”
Boom!
Within the indifference of the voice, from the oncoming fighter jet, an equally terrifying Aura burst forth. A Purple-red War Halberd, thousands of meters long, blasted out.
The War Halberd, wrapped in blue-black Thunder and burning with golden flames, pierced through Heaven and Earth,

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 975 410 Domineering and Defiant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 975: Chapter 410: Domineering and Defiant Chapter 975: Chapter 410: Domineering and Defiant Just as the Purple-red War Halberd appeared, the Heavenly Energy within a hundred kilometers radius surged wildly, causing the faces of the nine Mythical-level Powerhouses to change slightly.
“Higher-order Law!”
Boom!
The War Halberd, entwined with Thunder and golden flames, pierced through Heaven and Earth with a terror capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth, smashing the Law-congealed, kilometer-covering palm to pieces.
Boom! A nuclear explosion-like Radiance burst in the Firmament above, sweeping across thousands of kilometers, surrounded by a shockwave formed by Thunder and golden flames.
As the Cloud Mist within a ten kilometers range dispersed under the strike, the face of the Alien Deity who launched the attack suddenly changed dramatically.
Amidst the wild blast wave of the explosion, a hundred-meter-long War Halberd, radiating dazzling gold-purple light, appeared like a missile burst forth at a hundred times the speed of sound.
Because of its extreme speed, the Thunder-trailing War Halberd appeared like a Light Beam instantly in front of the deity.
Boom! Nine silver radiance rings emerged on the body of this Alien Deity, these silver rings spinning like gears, enveloping a kilometer radius.
In an instant, a viscous strength permeated the air, and within this range, space, matter, and energy were all slowed down and thickened by the power of Law.
As the Alien Deity’s Law Domain unfolded in an instant, the gold-purple War Halberd landed, with blue-black Thunder patterns and golden flame light patterns flowing on it.
Thud! Under the War Halberd, which was entwined with the Law of Great Sun Heaven Flame and Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, the silver gears spanning a kilometer and a hundred meters wide shattered instantly on one side.
Boom, boom, boom!! The Halberd, twined with two great Higher-order Laws, broke through the nine layers of Law gears almost in an instant, followed by a dazzling outburst of light!
Boom! An even more terrifying nuclear explosion Radiance exploded in the sky above, forming an endless sea of blue-black Thunder and golden flames, sweeping over ten kilometers.
The Terrifying power directly shattered the space in this area, forming a black region around the perimeter of the explosion, resembling a black sun emitting a Destructive Aura.
The shockwave caused the Heavenly Energy within a hundred kilometers radius to surge wildly, the Earth below shattered, forming white waves that spread in all directions.
With such a frightful strike, the faces of the surrounding eight Mythical Powerhouses all showed subtle changes, their Law Power encircling them, forming domains to block the impact.
Boom, boom, boom!! The Violent impact collided with these mythical domains, producing rings of Energy Halos, dazzling and gorgeous.
The strong impact of power and the intersection of Law Aura caused the Heavenly Energy within thousands of kilometers to tremble, attracting the attention of the Transcendent strong men in the distant relics towards this site.
Boom! The black Great Sun collapsed, and amidst the Violent energy shockwave, a figure over five hundred meters tall, resembling a humanoid Violent Dragon with body covered in Silver Scale Armor, stepped out.
However, at this time, the Alien Deity, resembling a humanoid Violent Dragon, was somewhat disheveled, with many areas burning with silver flames, restoring its destroyed Rule True Body.
Looking at the dark-red fighter aircraft standing tens of kilometers away, the face of that Alien Deity looked somewhat ugly: “Human, do you wish to start a war with our Divine Gods Alliance?”
“What are you to represent the Divine Gods Alliance and declare war on us humans?” In the cold voice, the undercarriage of the dark-red fighter opened, and a young man with black hair cascading over his shoulders stepped out into the void.
On Jack’s body, strands of blue-black and golden light patterns were entwined, radiating ultimate destruction and scorching Aura, with a cold expression and an Overbearing presence.
Instantly, all Mythical Powerhouses were slightly startled because the Aura on that young man was only that of the late period of the Ninth Heavens, no, there was an Aura of Law swirling around him.
This human has already begun to touch upon the Laws, and they are two types of Higher-order Laws!
Thinking of this, the two Demon Kings enveloped in Dark Demon Air glanced at each other, their eyes revealing intense killing intent.
Boom, boom!!
The Demon Kings exploded with endless demon gas, rendering half of the sky into a black hell, with a deep voice: “A mere Transcendent human, you dare to attack us deities.”
“Today, I will let you know what divine might is like hell.”
Boom boom!!
Just as the two terrifying demon kings appeared, two thousand-meter-long glazed sword lights crisscrossed Heaven and Earth in the distance, slashing towards the demon kings with a terrifying aura.
Under the illumination of those sword lights, the entire Firmament seemed to manifest a sword world, with mountains and rivers flowing within, and countless alien beings thriving.
With the power of a whole world in the sword lights, the two demon kings roared furiously, “Jewell, do you intend to start a war of gods?”
Boom boom!!
Space exploded, and the Void shattered; the dark demon air that concealed half the sky was torn apart by the two sword lights, revealing the figures of the demon kings with three heads and eight limbs.
The violent airwaves swept across tens of kilometers, and in the distance, a middle-aged man in a white robe stood tall with an aloof expression, holding a jade-colored long sword.
Jewell True Immortal spoke indifferently, “How dare you lay a hand on my Immortal Guard Forbidden Army commander. Do you think I do not exist?”
Behind him, the demon king with a Black Flames crown blazing roared low, “What Forbidden Army commander? This human is clearly the Human Clan Genius, Darren Callum.”
Jewell True Immortal responded calmly, “It is precisely because he is a genius of the Human Race that I invited him to join my Immortal Guard and become the commander of my Forbidden Army.”
“Do you have a problem with that?”
At this moment, not only the two Demon God Sect demon kings but also the five alien deities in the distance felt as if Jewell True Immortal was treating them like fools.
However, some matters were clear to everyone.
And just as the atmosphere in the Firmament grew tense, Jack Clark in the distance eyed the two demon kings and five alien deities, his gaze reflecting contemplation.
With his current strength, plus the two kings, Jewell True Immortal, he should be confident in defeating the demon kings and destroying their True Bodies, even with the obstruction of those alien deities.
As Jack Clark pondered whether to kill those two Demon God Sect demon kings, the strongest of the five neutral alien deities slowly spoke up.
“Since he is Jewell’s Forbidden Guard commander, he also has the right to enter the relic. Let’s all step aside.”
A faint smile appeared on Jewell True Immortal’s face as he nodded slightly to the alien deity, then turned to Jack Clark, who stood firm in the distance, and spoke in a gentle tone.
“Jack Clark, go and join up with Sid Hawk. You will lead this relic expedition. If anyone challenges you, you are authorized to kill them.”
With that said, Jewell True Immortal’s gaze towards the distant demon kings was cold.
Choosing not to take action.
A hint of regret flitted through Jack Clark’s eyes; he then bowed slightly to Jewell True Immortal, who was dozens of kilometers away, and flew back to his fighter aircraft, heading towards the relic.
Before coming, the Federation had already made arrangements for Jack Clark’s identity, with Jewell True Immortal’s Forbidden Guard commander as a cover to enter the relic.
The Human Federation and the Divine Gods Alliance have yet to break ties, so certain matters still need some care.
What the Federal Top Level and people like Jewell True Immortal didn’t know was that Jack Clark had already decided to embark on a massive killing spree after reviewing the information about the relic during his journey.
As his cultivation stepped into the late period of the Ninth Heavens, and he began to touch upon condensing his Rule True Body, Jack Clark’s mentality also began to change.
For instance, these king-level powerhouses that he once looked up to were no longer in his sight, and his way of doing things had become somewhat reckless and overbearing—or perhaps, this was the meaning of his cultivation.
Why did he cultivate so hard, if not to do whatever he wanted, and not do whatever he didn’t? If he was still timid after gaining great strength, then why the hell was he cultivating?

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 976: Chapter 411 Business mutual flattery, clearing the field Chapter 976: Chapter 411 Business mutual flattery, clearing the field Watching the dark red fighter aircraft disappear into the depths of the clouds at several times the speed of sound, tens of thousands of meters above, the soul fluctuations of the five alien deities standing tall in all directions spread.
The one that Jack Clark had injured with a halberd, resembling a Violent Dragon of the alien deities, had its consciousness vibrating the Void. Its voice was low, “Max, why let that human pass?”
The alien deity with a silver eye on its forehead, exuding the pressure of a mythical peak, slowly said, “Tarot, I know you are close to the Demon God Sect, but remember our standpoint.”
“No matter if he’s human or a Purgatory True Demon, as long as the identity meets the requirements, he can pass.”
Another deity, with the Sun Wheel rotating behind it, enveloped in golden divine light, said indifferently, “Tarot, you should not interfere with the affairs of the Human Divine Realm and the Evil God Alliance; be careful not to get caught in it.”
The Violent Dragon alien deity’s voice was cold, “That is my business.”
While the few neutral alien deities stood firm, two demon kings of the Demon God Sect were also shrouded in rolling dark demon air, with their divine soul thoughts vibrating.
“That Darren Callum, under Emperor Diorus’s curse, actually didn’t die and has now appeared here. How many life-saving forbidden weapons does he have in his hands?”
The other demon king’s voice was hoarse, “This human has monstrous talent; killing him definitely won’t be simple.”
“Moreover, his strength is even stronger than reported. Without summoning that terrifying Giant Beast, he is comparable to a king-level demon at the Mid-Mythical Stage.”
“This human must die, his talent is too monstrous. We must notify them that Darren Callum has appeared.”
As he spoke, a demon king produced a shattered stone slab, while the surrounding demon gas rolled, sealing all directions.
Meanwhile, a few kilometers away, Jewell and another Human King, surrounded by pervasive rules, were also discussing something.
At this moment, with the arrival of Jack Clark, what was initially just an exploration of relics involving the youthful geniuses of the Divine Gods Alliance suddenly became severe.
…
Whoosh!
Sonic booms resounded through the sky. As the dark red Throne Fighter approached, the facial expressions of many members of the different races and the cultists of the Evil God Alliance changed slightly.
The Holy Child of the Demon God Sect, Sykes, eyes darkened, somewhat grave, “What’s going on, how can a Human King actually penetrate deep into the Divine Gods Alliance in a fighter aircraft?”
On a mountain peak thousands of kilometers away, the young man with a silver eye in his forehead narrowed his eyes, “Strange, according to the agreement, aren’t both Human Kings and Purgatory Demon kings not allowed to enter the Divine Gods Alliance?”
The three-eyed youth behind him, standing dozens of meters tall, clad in dark golden battle armor with double wings on his back, spoke slowly: “It should be related to the battle that suddenly erupted earlier.”
“No, it doesn’t seem to be a Human King!”
As the energy waves surged, the fighter aircraft slowly landed, and under the watchful eyes of many stern-looking aliens, the aircraft’s cabin door opened, and a black-haired youth stepped out.
The human youth casually exuded an undisguised aura of the late-phase of the Ninth Heaven, immediately causing all the aliens and Sykes and the others to pause in shock.
“It’s not the Human King.”
At that moment, Jack Clark placed his hand on the aircraft, and with silver ripples of space flowing, the massive and ferocious aircraft slowly sank into subspace, vanishing from sight.
Seeing this, Eddy Keller couldn’t help but exclaim, “Junior Clark actually already has his exclusive Throne Fighter. It seems Joshua truly didn’t deceive us.”
At this moment, no one doubted what Joshua had said before.
In the Human Federation, each Throne Fighter stamped with the mark of a Divine Dragon entwined around crossed swords and blades symbolizes the status of a king.
Far away, Jack Clark flickered into view like a streak of light, traversing hundreds of meters to appear in front of everyone, his gaze falling on Jane Aiken admiringly.
“Just a short while not seen, and Student Aiken, you have already broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven. Worthy of you,” he said.
Gazing at the imposing and dignified youth with handsome features, the girl holding a sword smiled slightly, “It’s okay, but it’s still a bit lacking compared to you.”
With that, the two immediately laughed after a mutual exchange of flattery, feeling that the scene seemed somewhat familiar.
Ida Carroll stood off to the side with her arms crossed, watching the two youths from Senior One who hadn’t yet graduated, amazement in her eyes, “South Sky Martial Height has churned out quite a few monsters these past few years.”
Sid Hawk nodded slightly, “Indeed, a few years ago there was one who called himself ‘Hegemon,’ and now two more exaggerated ones have appeared.”
At this moment, after greeting Jane Aiken, Jack Clark stepped forward and said with a slight smile, “Joshua, Eddy, long time no see.”
Joshua smiled and said, “With Junior Clark here this time, the gains from the relic expedition will certainly be remarkable. Let me introduce you.”
“This is Sid Hawk, brother Hawk, 27 years old, at the late period of the Ninth Heaven. His Fist Intent that Suppresses the Heavens has already touched the edge of the rules, and his combat power is astonishing.”
Clark nodded politely, “Hello, brother Hawk.”
With hair as stiff as steel needles, Sid Hawk revealed a smile on his face and nodded slightly in recognition.
Jewell went on with the introductions, “Junior Clark, this is Ida Carroll, our sister Chen, an Innate Awakened One at the mid period of the Ninth Heaven, from Myth Academy in the Northern Battlefield.”
“This is Amos, and the Amos brothers as well, they are at the early stages of the Ninth Heaven like me, from Berlin…”
After Jewell’s brief introductions, Clark got a simple impression of the others—more accurately, these were all geniuses with monstrous talents.
However, at present, whether it was Jack Clark or Jane Aiken and the others, they were all inheritors from the five great Divine Realms of the Human Divine Realm within the Divine Gods Alliance.
After a quick greeting, Jewell pointed to a building projection covering a dozen kilometers in the sky tens of thousands of meters above.
“That’s the entrance to the relic’s Inner World, but it’s in a different Space-Time and cannot be approached, currently in a closed state.”
“It’s said to contain many resources and inheritances left by the ancient alien civilizations, which is why it has attracted the congregation of the young strong men from the entire Divine Gods Alliance.”
“To enter the relic, you need a special token. These tokens appear randomly without a specific time, and whoever snatches them first gets to keep them.”
“Apart from Howard Lambert who has already gone in, five more tokens have appeared, all taken by those strong men from different races.”
“Their stance is neutral, and our biggest competitors are the elites from the Shadow God Sect, Giant God Sect, Eternal God Church, and Demon God Sect.”
“Over the years, including the already obliterated Blood God Sect, the struggles within the Divine Gods Alliance between the five great Evil God Sects and our Human Divine Realm have become increasingly frequent.”
“During the previous few token contests, those guys from the Evil God Alliance, rather than keeping them for themselves, preferred to attack us jointly; that’s why brother Hawk and the others didn’t manage to grab any tokens.”
“Otherwise, with brother Hawk and sister Chen’s strength, it wouldn’t be hard to take at least two tokens when working together, even if getting all five is not doable.”
Jack’s gaze followed the direction Jewell pointed and looked into the distance, only to see four forces on the opposite side of the cliff, several kilometers away, spread around and looking over coldly.
Jack narrowed his eyes slightly and suddenly said, “It seems that they don’t want us entering the relic, if that’s the case, we need to clear the ground ahead of time.”
“Clear the ground.” Sid Hawk and the others paused for a moment.
“Exactly,” Jack nodded slightly, his gaze cold as he looked at the people from the Demon God Sect and Giant God Sect in the distance.
In fact, Jack’s original purpose for coming here was simply to find some Soul Crystals and see if he could get some resources in the relic.
But when he was leaving, Gabriel asked him to act more overbearingly, preferably stirring things up.
With the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield cut off, the main forces of the Human Race and The Purgatory Family were now concentrated on the Sky Curtain Battlefield, which means the direct pressure has actually decreased a lot.
Therefore, the plan was to eliminate the threats from the rear, which is the Divine Gods Alliance.
Even if they couldn’t make the Divine Gods Alliance side with humans, they needed to figure out a way to pull out the thorn that was the Demon God Sect, especially those few Evil God Sects that had betrayed humanity.
Feeling the chilly Killing Intent emanating from Jack, smirking, Sid Hawk’s eyes gradually showed a trace of excitement, “With brother Clark here, it seems we can indeed clear the ground.”
Before Jack’s arrival, on the human side, there were two Eighth Layer Experts and five Ninth Layer Experts. Their strength was not weak, but not enough to sweep away everything.
Especially on the other side, the Evil God Alliance, apart from Sykes from the Demon God Sect, who was close to the strength of a demon king, there were also four demonized strong men from different races at the Eighth Layer.
Then there was a Ninth Mid-term Divine Child from the Giant God Sect, three Eighth Layer Bishops, two Ninth Early and one Ninth Mid-period assassin from the Shadow God Sect.
On top of that, the Twin Divine Children from the Eternal God Church both at the mid-period of Ninth Heaven, the overall power between the two sides was close.
So despite being targeted by these ‘people’ from the Evil God Alliance, Sid Hawk and the others had no way to deal with them, and every attempt to kill one or two to establish authority was blocked.
But now with Jack Clark, who’d slain several demon kings and had heaven-defying combat power, on their side…

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 977 412 Grasping the Great Sun Unstoppable
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 977: Chapter 412 Grasping the Great Sun, Unstoppable Chapter 977: Chapter 412 Grasping the Great Sun, Unstoppable Feeling the increasingly terrifying killing intent emanating from Jack Clark, Sid Hawk and the others exchanged glances and nodded slightly.
Surrounding Ida Carroll, strands of blue water appeared out of thin air, her hair whipping wildly as her eyes showed excitement, “Let’s do this, I’ve been wanting to kill those guys for a while.”
Everyone who made it this far had been through numerous battles, including Jane Aiken, the weakest in terms of cultivation, who had also fought her way here.
So, when it was decided to take action, a powerful aura burst forth instantly from each of them.
Boom!
Around Eddy Keller, clouds and mist swirled, with the vague image of a white dragon coiling around him—standing amidst the clouds like a war god commanding a divine dragon.
Behind Jane Aiken, the four divine swords she carried soared into the sky, turning into streams of crystal red, black, cyan, and gray light that coiled around her, emitting a sharp and fearsome sword aura.
Then came Joshua Welan, Sid Hawk, Ida Carroll, and the brothers Amos.
The sudden surge from the human side drew the attention of all the different races and the Demon God Sect around them.
On the opposite cliff, several kilometers away, Sykes, whose arms were like knives and cheeks covered with dark red fine scales, said coldly, “Humans, what do you think you’re doing?”
Jack Clark spoke indifferently, “Nothing much, just preparing to kill all of you to settle some old scores.”
Instantly, there was a commotion among the surrounding different races.
In the distance, members of the Giant God Sect, the Shadow God Sect, and the Eternal God Church, who were originally dispersed, also had a change in expression, and a divine child of the Giant God Sect flashed behind Sykes in an instant.
At the same time, the imposing aura of four powerful beings at the late or peak stages of the Ninth Heaven soared into the sky in the distance.
One of them was engulfed in a white flame, ten meters tall, resembling a man but with a face covered in white tiger stripes; he stared coldly and emotionlessly.
“Humans, according to the agreement, large-scale fighting is not permitted before the token appears, to avoid triggering spatial shocks that could close the relic’s inner world.”
Jack Clark’s expression was cold: “What do your rules have to do with me? Right now, it’s personal between me and this Evil God Alliance, and you best not meddle.”
“Otherwise, I don’t mind wiping all of you out.”
With that said, Jack Clark took a step forward, crossing a kilometer in an instant to appear above the canyon, unleashing a terrifying force of law.
Boom! In the blink of an eye, the energy of heaven and earth in an area of over ten kilometers went wild, swarming towards him and forming a golden fireball hundreds of meters in diameter behind him.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the golden flames continued to compress and coalesce, the terrifying temperature exceeding 100,000 degrees Celsius below caused the air within a kilometer to explode into scorching blasts.
Under the scorching and twisting waves of heat, the temperature within several kilometers rose sharply, and the light and heat emitted obscured the red sun in the sky.
Boom, boom!!
Behind Jack Clark, two more golden fireballs, each five hundred meters in diameter, appeared, endlessly compressing the infinite golden flames as if they were three suns.
Especially the white light of law power emanating from the centers of the three golden fireballs—it’s fearsome energy fluctuations caused all the different races to pale.
Including Sykes and the others, whose expressions changed drastically, particularly the divine child of the Giant God Sect, who was ten meters tall and covered in black scales, appeared somewhat shocked.
“Such strong pressure from the force of law, what kind of flame is this!?”
Sykes let out a breath slowly, his voice grave, “Forget the kind of flame. Bring out everything you’ve got, or all demons will die today.”
Boom!
Black and red flames erupted from Sykes, engulfing hundreds of meters in flames as his body continued to swell. Crackling as he transformed into a hundred-meter-tall, three-headed six-armed Purgatory True Demon form.
Especially notable were Sykes’s six extraordinary arms that resembled six hundred-meter-long black combat knives, with the blades streaming with black light that radiated a terrifying sharpness.
Roar!
Behind Sykes, within the surging dark red demon gas, a giant phantom emerged. In that instant, an almost demon king-like terrifying pressure filled the area.
Boom!
In the moment the demon shadow dove down to merge, Sykes’s aura skyrocketed, his muscles swelled, and black bone spurs grew, making him look extremely fearsome.
Facing Jack Clark, who created three world-ending suns from the Great Sun Golden Flame right from the start, Sykes did not dare to be careless and immediately burned his bloodline to enter his strongest form.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The actual Demon Power that Sykes emitted covered the sky and sun, clashing with the golden radiance emanating from miles away from Jack Clark, causing the atmosphere to explode in a roar.
With the hot air surging and the howling wind, Jack Clark slowly spoke, his voice low containing terrible killing intent, “You Evil God Sect scoundrels, it’s always you making trouble, causing me to go to the battlefield after only a month of cultivation.”
“Back then, I was only at the Second Layer Heaven when I went to the Kelaya Battlefield. Do you know how ‘scared’ I was? Do you know how angry I was?”
“At that time, I thought to myself, once I become stronger, I’ll definitely kill all the Evil God Sect cultists. Today, let me settle the scores of the past.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark let out a long howl and spread his arms wide.
Boom!! The three golden suns above Jack Clark’s head suddenly moved, as if the ancient suns were falling, releasing terrifying energy fluctuations and dazzling light from the sky.
“Be careful!” Watching the three golden fireballs shooting towards them, all the Ninth Heaven Experts from the Shadow God Sect and the Eternal God Church, besides Sykes, changed their expressions.
Because two of the fireballs were heading straight for them, the bishops of the Eight Layer Heaven from Demon God Sect and the cultists from the Demonized Clan wore faces of utter despair, particularly those of the later.
Because the three golden fireballs were moving too fast to dodge; there was no choice but to withstand them directly.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The instant the three golden suns fell, the rocks on the cliffs within a kilometer radius melted into magma. The resulting collision unleashed an endless sea of magma tsunamis.
The ground within tens of kilometers shook wildly, and massive, deep cracks spread like an opening abyss. The heavens seemed to collapse, and the earth split; everything was being crushed to oblivion.
The land collapsed, and the sky seemed to tear apart.
The horrifying attack submerged an area of over ten kilometers in explosive firelight, instantly reducing the Eight Layer Heaven aliens and bishops from the Demon God Sect, the Shadow God Sect, and the Giant God Sect to ashes.
Such terrifying power instantaneously shocked all other races, including Sid Hawk and others who were about to join forces for an attack, causing them to halt in their tracks.
“Junior Clark’s strength is too strong now,” Eddy Keller said, somewhat shocked.
With a single strike that destroyed a ten-kilometer range, it was akin to obliterating an entire city, incinerating everything into oblivion. Such destructive power was truly frightening.
And this was now Jack Clark’s normal level of strength.
The difference between a Ninth Heaven Peak cultivator of quasi-mythical level and a mythical level is one has only touched upon and refined a bit of Law Power, while the other has already tempered and condensed their true body with this power, transforming their soul into a Divine Soul.
Under these conditions, a mythical powerhouse not only exerts greater force with every move, able to mobilize more Law Power, but also experiences a much lighter burden when wielding laws in combat.
In contrast, a quasi-mythical level powerhouse expends a shocking amount of energy with each usage of Law Power, and the toll on their spiritual will and even their soul is quite terrifying.
But for Jack Clark, whose soul was immensely strong and who had cultivated the Illusion Meditation Scripture to form the Soul Emperor, such pressure was insignificant.
Furthermore, with an Innate Demon God Body comparable to mythical powerhouses in control of the energy of the heavens and the earth and amplification, simply wielding the power of his fire talent was comparable to that of a mythical powerhouse.
And this was him only utilizing Law Power.
Roar! A furious roar erupted from the burning sea of fire, and a surge of dense Dark Demon Air shot into the sky.
At this moment, Sykes, who was unable to withstand even a casual blow from Jack Clark, was mostly burned to ash, his flesh charred black, appearing extremely wretched.
“He’s not dead,” Jack Clark observed as blue-black thunder patterns danced across his left arm.
Boom! As the energy of the heavens and earth surged, directed by those blue-black thunder patterns, it turned into a five-hundred-meter-long blue-black Thunder Dragon that in an instant streaked past as a bolt of lightning.
“How could I possibly die!” Sykes roared.
Boom! A burst of blood-colored flames erupted from Sykes, igniting all True Demon bloodline energy, his aura skyrocketing several times over in an instant, as a thousand-meter-tall Three-faced Six-armed phantom emerged behind him.
With six arms reaching out, the Demon King phantom wielded roll after roll of dark energy waves to grasp the winding and flashing Thunder Dragon.
Bang!
The Thunder Dragon, a manifestation of the power of the Higher-order Law of Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, exploded, turning into thousands of blue-black lightnings that enveloped a kilometer radius, obliterating everything they touched.
Including Sykes, whose eyes showed both horror and rage, his powerful True Demon Body disintegrated into black ash in an instant, killed on the spot.
Boom! In the moment when Sykes was eradicated, two figures burst into the sky from the edge of the burning golden sea of fire, remarkably the Twin Divine Children from the Eternal God Church.
At this time, both human youths, who followed the True Martial path of thought, were surrounded by Yin-Yang energy, creating a special domain within a hundred-meter range.
Within that alternating gray and white domain, all forces returned to the energy of the heavens and earth, including the golden flames that only contained scorching heat after the initial explosion had dissipated.
Yet at that moment, both youths, pale-faced with bloodied mouths and extremely weak aura, had been severely injured by Jack Clark’s casual attack of extreme nuclear explosion.
This was despite their combined strengths, which had been boosted tenfold or more as mid-term Nine Layer Heaven cultivators complementing each other’s powers.
After breaking free from the golden sea of fire, the two didn’t look back and sped away into the distance, nearly turning into a streak of gray light and covering several kilometers in the blink of an eye.
But… Boom! A blue-black lightning bolt, several kilometers long and over ten meters thick, flashed past, and in an instant, the Twin Divine Children from the Eternal God Church turned to ash.
“I said that today, I would settle our grievances,” Jack Clark said as he slowly lowered his arm, still traced with faint blue-black electric arcs.
This is the terrifying aspect of having a strong foundational soul; it allowed Jack Clark, who had just stepped into the Ninth Heaven Peak and brushed against the laws, to freely mobilize the power of those laws.
Contrary to the Giant Beasts that fought with their bodies and used innate powers and laws, human cultivators became more mystical after touching upon the laws and entering the realm of myths.
They could use their Divine Soul to control the laws, leveraging the power of Heaven and Earth, appearing like immortals of legend who could command the wind and rain, holding sway over the forces of Heavens and Earth.
Take Jack Clark, for example, who without using any weapons or the terrifying power of his physical body, could simply will into existence Great Sun heavenly fire and Thunder True Dragons to annihilate everything with a mere thought.
Compared to the battle styles before the late period of Ninth Heaven, the methods had undergone huge changes once again.
Of course, his strongest asset was still his True Body of the Fighting Demon God.
Witnessing the human youth standing atop the golden sea of fire, who just by breathing eliminated eleven experts of the Eight and Ninth Heavens, all different races present furrowed their brows with a hint of gravity.
Because the strength of Demon God Sect’s Divine Child, Sykes, ranked among the top six present, and at full power, he could even withstand a couple of moves from an average mythical powerhouse.
Yet, this extraordinary being who had broken through the limits was instantly killed by that human.
That human’s power is terrifying, and incredibly domineering.

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 978 413 Ancient Ferocious Beasts Giant Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 978: Chapter 413: Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Giant Beast with Heavy Injury (6000) Chapter 978: Chapter 413: Ancient Ferocious Beasts, Giant Beast with Heavy Injury (6000) Just as Eddy Keller and those alien geniuses from afar were shocked by the terrifying strength that Jack Clark had displayed, Jack himself narrowed his eyes slightly while standing above the flames.
Because the death of that Divine Child from the Demon God Sect seemed a bit too simple.
The talent of the Purgatory True Demon was no less than Joshua Welan’s, and its strength was only slightly inferior to that of Alex whom he had slain on the battlefield.
Such ‘genius’ of this level should have some life-saving final resort given by a Grand Demon King if not a forbidden weapon refined by a Demon God Level powerhouse.
Yet, until the moment of annihilation, the Purgatory True Demon had only burnt its bloodline to burst forth all its strength.
Of course, it was also possible that Jack Clark was overthinking it.
Perhaps that Purgatory True Demon originally had a life-saving trump card, but had already used it, just like he had.
These kinds of perfect rule or Rule-refined trump cards are precious while also being extremely taxing on the refiner, hence even Jack Clark couldn’t replenish his after use.
As for the Giant God Sect, the Shadow God Sect, and the Eternal God Church’s Divine Children, their strengths were actually very formidable, it’s just that they encountered Jack Clark today.
In front of Jack Clark, whose normal battle strength was already comparable to a Mythical King, these Mid-term of Ninth Heaven top strongmen didn’t even have the power to resist.
The top strongmen, whom Jack Clark used to look up to in the past, were now no match for him with a single strike.
Lost in thought, Jack Clark willed it, and the Golden Divine Wheel representing the Flame World slowly emerged behind him, radiating an endless suction force as it spun.
Whoosh! The infinite flames roared below, rising like a golden tsunami toward the sky, rolling up air waves and disappearing behind Jack Clark.
Gurgle gurgle!!
With the flames gone, three deep pits with a diameter of one kilometer each emerged on the ground. Both the pits and the surrounding ten kilometers of roiling hot magma were exuding scorching airwaves.
The magma, following the now collapsed and disappeared cliff slope, flowed down into the canyon below and formed a staggering Lava River.
From a distance, Eddy Keller gave a wry smile, “Junior Clark’s talent is too monstrous.”
Keep in mind that when the Void Relics opened just over two months ago, the first time he met Jack Clark, he was only at the Early Sevenfold Sky. Although his combat power was strong, it was still within the normal range.
And now, a little over a month later, upon reuniting Jack had already broken through to the Early Ninth Heaven, casually annihilating a Mid to Late-period Ninth Heaven bishop from the Giant God Sect.
Half a month of not seeing each other, he has already reached the latter period of the Ninth Heaven, and with a casual move, his battle strength is comparable to that of Mythical Powerhouses.
This terrifying rate of progress, along with the power that exceeds the norm even after the Ninth Heaven, is simply monstrous.
However, everyone present was a monstrous genius, and the oldest, Sid Hawk, was not even thirty years old. Thus, despite the inner shock, they all appeared relatively composed on the surface.
After Jack Clark flew back, the group settled on the hillside once again.
Sid Hawk praised, “Worthy of being the genius who reigns supreme in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, much more powerful than us old folks.”
Ida Carroll rolled her eyes, “What old folks, I’m only twenty-six years old. You’re talking as if I’m halfway into the grave.”
The burly, chesty-haired man from Berlin, Amos, laughed heartily, “Sid Hawk isn’t wrong. Compared to high schooler Jack Clark, we who graduated years ago are indeed the old ones.”
Jack Clark modestly said, “Not at all, you are all pretty amazing as well.”
Jane Aiken also gave Jack Clark a thumbs up, her mouth curving into a smile, “Impressive.”
Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile in response.
That’s when Joshua Welan suddenly said, “Pay attention, those alien Divine Children are converging together.”
Seemingly sensing the threat and pressure that Jack Clark brought, the small teams of the tribe that were dispersed over tens of kilometers began to converge.
They quickly formed four strong forces centered around the Divine Children of the three strongest Divine lineages, and the strongest Divine King lineage.
Sid Hawk slowly said, “The several kings from our Human Race who joined the Divine Gods Alliance have been there for many years, but there are not many alien deities who show kindness to the Human Divine Domain. We need to be careful.”
Looking at the alien geniuses in the distance, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “Let’s see, if they dare to make a move against us, we’ll annihilate them all.”
Is the Divine Gods Alliance strong? Very strong, convening dozens of Mythical Powerhouses, three at the Heavenly King Level and one at the Supreme Level.
If these powerhouses stood in the Divine Realm, empowered by the Power of Heaven and Earth, they could even achieve a three to one combat ratio, their battle strength immensely exaggerated.
But at the same time, what’s gained is lost. Once they leave their respective Divine Realms, their strengths would fall by several folds, much weaker than those of the same tier from the Human Race.
Thus, while the Human Federation has some reservations about the Divine Gods Alliance, they only have reservations. The current policy is mainly to pacify and win over, with both sides still in contact.
However, if these alien deities dare to side with the Purgatory Family and become enemies of the Human Federation, there are ways to destroy them, such as a saturation bombing with thousands of large-yield Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs in a single go.
A single saturated nuclear explosion would be enough to level an entire Divine Realm.
After obliterating the enemies of the Evil God Sect with thunderous might, what follows is a wait. Waiting for the emergence of the Ruins Token and the opening of the Inner World.
Jack Clark and Jane Aiken found a stone to sit on, and he looked at the long-haired girl across from him and curiously asked, “Student Aiken, have you found any news about that enemy of yours?”
He knew that Jane Aiken’s entry into the mythical world and her deep journey into the Divine Gods Alliance was to track down news of an enemy.
Jane Aiken shook her head, “There’s no definite news for the time being. The person has disappeared for several years, and where they went is unknown. Many traces they left have also been erased by time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 979 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast Giant Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 979: Chapter 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Severely Wounded (6000)_2 Chapter 979: Chapter 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Severely Wounded (6000)_2 The mythical world is vast, and indeed, finding a person within it is quite difficult.
While Jack Clark and the others were waiting for the Ruins Token to appear, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, who had ventured out for ‘treasure hunting’ for a few days in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, made a new discovery.
Thousands of meters deep, near the edge of the Bi Giant Beast’s territory under the sea, Heavenly Energy raged wildly, mixed with the sea water to form a vortex that covered an area of tens of kilometers.
Because the current was so extreme, surpassing the speed of sound, the powerful rotational force created a vacuum region of kilometers in the center, distorting everything around it like a black hole.
On the edge of the vortex, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, covered in thick black scale armor, swam around; its sturdy, sharp blue horn atop its head flickered with a halo, emitting an excited sound.
Roar! Candle Dragon, Candle Dragon, there are good things in the center of the vortex, at least High-Level Divine Resources.
This time, the Red Beast resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon didn’t drop offline. Its ferocious mouth opened slightly, emitting a slow roar, “Roar! I, go, in, front, to, take, it, down.”
Days passed, and both beasts had strengthened significantly by consuming many resources; for example, the length of the Single-horned Tiger Whale had already reached two hundred and ninety-eight meters.
The aura on the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was so heavy and terrifying that it was just one step away from breaking into the quasi-mythical level.
The strength of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon was even stronger. Having already stepped into the quasi-mythical realm, it was about to complete the Tempering of its rule and make a breakthrough into the mythical level with the help of an abundance of God-level Resources.
Of course, they had consumed all the resources they found on the command of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
For the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at that time, ordinary God-level Resources were of little help, so it simply instructed the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish to bring back any high-level or above God-level Resources they found.
But this sea area had already been ransacked by the Bi Giant Beast, and before this, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish hadn’t found any high-level or above God-level Resources.
After running around outside for so long, they finally had a harvest and could bring something back to report.
Thinking of this, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish turned its head and looked at a Naga girl with long blue hair beside it: Roar! Molly, you are too weak, wait for us outside.
Compared to the two enormous beasts, the tiny Naga girl nodded respectfully, “Yes, Black and White Great Lord.”
Roar! With a roar, the two Giant Beasts charged directly into the vortex, instantly the violent sea water crashed into them at the speed of sound, causing terrifying vibrations and booming sounds.
However, these seas capable of instantly smashing a person into a bloody mist couldn’t even shake the massive bodies of the beasts.
Through the rumbling explosive impacts, the two Giant Beasts swiftly approached the center of the vortex, and immediately a terrifying distortion force was felt, getting stronger the closer they got.
Crackle Crackle! Under the horrifying distortion force, the scale armor on the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, robust enough to withstand a normal nuclear explosion, began to deform slightly, a terrifying sight to behold.
Roar! Candle Dragon, the good stuff is inside.
“Roar! Watch, me.”
Accompanied by the Giant Beast Candle Dragon closing its eyes, the area spanning tens of kilometers around them turned pitch black instantly, and amidst the darkness, a terrifying Giant Beast over three thousand meters long appeared.
Boom!
The terrifying distortion force burst forth, yet it couldn’t move the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, which grew ten-fold in size, one bit. Clutching the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, the two Giant Beasts instantly charged into the ‘black hole’ at its center.
The moment the two Giant Beasts plunged into the dark center, they keenly felt strong Spatial Fluctuations around them and, in a blink of an eye, appeared in a ‘world’ where clouds and mist floated, with green mountains and clear waters.
And at the center of this picturesque world, a divine tree stretching over hundreds of kilometers, towering thousands of meters tall with a trunk like Dragon Scales, stood erect on the mountain ridge.
The branches of this great tree were lush, covering an area of tens of kilometers, its roots spread across the entire mountain range like claws deep into the Earth’s unknown depths, and its leaves, like red jade pieces, emitted energy halos in rings.
Hanging among the branches were red fruits, small as a few meters, large as tens of meters, radiating a dazzling light, each like a ‘sun.’
When the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish saw those fruits on the tree, its eyes instantly brightened as the Law Charm swirling around those Divine Fruits was potent, weaving some power.
Such phenomena only occur with Top-level Divine Resources.
This was a divine tree bearing Top-Level Divine Resources, a jackpot for them.
While the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was excited, the Red Beast’s gaze was grave, and it growled slowly, “Roar! Big, horn, be, careful.”
Below the mountain range where the red tree stood, a Giant Beast with double wings on its back, a lion-like head sporting a pair of long horns, and its body covered in dark red scale armor, stood tall, coldly watching the two Giant Beasts.
The beast, over one thousand one hundred meters in length and three hundred meters in shoulder height, resembled a small mountain range, emitting a dreadful oppressive force.
Resembling the legendary ferocious beast, its four paws burned with blood-colored flames, its massive mouth agape, roaring, shaking the world, “Roar! Get out of my Territory.”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish exploded with a black and white domain, covering nearly a kilometer around it as it emitted a sound like a steam whistle, Roar! Candle Dragon, this guy told us to roll.
The Red Beast roared, “Roar! Fight, it.”
The Mythical Giant Beasts were not something they hadn’t seen before; following the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, they had already battled several Mythical Giant Beasts, each one massive and fearsome in strength.
Boom! The Giant Beast Candle Dragon also had a burst of black and white Divine Light, but unlike the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, it was an alternating flicker affecting the power of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 980 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast Giant Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 980: Chapter 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Heavy Injury (6000)_3 Chapter 980: Chapter 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast, Giant Beast Heavy Injury (6000)_3 In the moment when the black and white light shone, an invisible impact swept across an area of tens of kilometers, slowing down everything in its path.
The clouds drifting in the sky and the leaves shaking on the mountain peaks below, all entered a super slow-motion state.
Roar…!
Under the envelopment of the Time Slowing Law Power, the Kamaitachi Beast let out a slow, furious roar. Endless blood-colored flames erupted from its body, slowly spreading, and the whole world trembled.
Just as the blood-colored flames on the Kamaitachi Beast reach tens of meters high in a slow eruption, darkness descended on Heaven and Earth, and a tail over two thousand meters long appeared in the darkness.
In the domain where time slowed, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon was unaffected. Its tail, swollen ten times in size, descended from the sky at a terrifying speed ten times that of sound, blasting everything to smithereens.
Boom!
The red dragon tail struck the Kamaitachi Beast, and instantly the blood-colored flames dispersed, and the earth within a radius of dozens of kilometers crumbled in an instant, splitting Heaven and Earth as dirt and stones surged into the sky.
Under the terrifying strike that shook Heaven and Earth, the erupting impact even shattered the domain of slower time, followed by a brutal and fierce roar.
Roar! The explosion of sound waves dispersed the smoke and dust and the Dark Domain, revealing a gigantic pit several kilometers wide and the towering figure of the Kamaitachi Beast within it.
Despite being struck by the tenfold Gigantification of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, this beast remained unharmed, its aura even more fierce and terrifying.
A hundred kilometers away, the Single-horned Tiger Whale flying at high altitude widened its eyes. The thought of jumping into the fray vanished in an instant: Roar! The Candle Dragon is too horrifying, unbeatable, time to leave.
But it was already too late to flee, as a terrifying aura erupted from the Kamaitachi Beast, forming waves of red shockwaves that swept Heaven and Earth.
Boom! The earth shattered, a blood-colored light shot into the sky, and in an instant, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast in the high altitude roared, brightening the surroundings for dozens of kilometers like daylight.
Just as the Candle Dragon Giant Beast turned into a white flame Fire Divine Dragon in the daylight domain, a giant claw burning with blood-colored flames fell from the sky, too fast for consciousness to perceive.
Boom!
Under the terrifying strike of the claw, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon was directly obliterated, scattering into the sky as white flames, then soon gathered dozens of kilometers away to reform.
Just as its form began to coalesce, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon closed its eyes, and in an instant, the daylight within a dozen kilometers turned to dark night, pitch black.
Roar! Endless blood-colored flames erupted from the darkness, sweeping over the surrounding darkness.
Boom! As the sea of blood-colored flames spread, a beast over three thousand meters long let out a scream as it descended from the sky, crashing into the Earth, instantly collapsing the land for dozens of kilometers around.
Above the Firmament, the Kamaitachi Beast stood in the sea of blood-colored flames like an ancient ferocious beast, its gaze cold and brutal as it looked down.
In the deep pit of the shattered Earth, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon had shrunk from over three thousand meters to just over three hundred meters, its aura weak, with scale armor broken in the middle of its body, flesh and blood blurred, exposing a section of crystal red spine dozens of meters long.
In a mere confrontation, the Candle Dragon with a King-level bloodline and two Top Tier Talents, comparable to an Ordinary Mythical Giant Beast in combat, was heavily injured.
This Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast was too horrifying, far stronger than an average Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast.
Roar!
The Kamaitachi Beast raised its head and let out a brutal roar, declaring its strength, invincibility, then the flames on its body burned, and its gigantic body disappeared from the spot at a terrifying speed.
Roar!
In the instant the Kamaitachi Beast disappeared, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon felt an imminent horror and could not help but let out an angry roar. The black and white light around it flickered rapidly, alternating like day and night.
Hum!!
Once again, the power of time enshrouded the area for dozens of kilometers. Under the Time Slowing Law, the silhouette of the dark red Giant Beast appeared above the head of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, slowly descending.
The hundred-meter-wide claw compressed with blood-colored flames radiated dazzling blood-colored light, filled with terrifying power.
Combined with the terrifying speed of the Kamaitachi Beast, the air and even space itself were compressed into substance, forming layers of transparent ripples that spread out in all directions.
This strike could not be taken, nor could it be countered.
In the instant the dazzling red blood light claw fell, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon flashed, turning into a red dragon-shaped light that streaked across the sky.
“Roar! Escape.”
With the Single-horned Tiger Whale in its claws, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon burst into the black vortex behind it with a thunderous boom.
And just as the Candle Dragon disappeared, the Time Laws dissipated, and the red claw that contained terrifying power fell from the sky to the Earth.
Boom!
The entire small world trembled crazily, the dazzling red light bloomed on Earth, mountains collapsed, and rivers evaporated wherever it went.
Roar!
Amidst the sand and dust waves that covered dozens of kilometers, the brutal roar of the Kamaitachi Beast was heard, followed by a flash of red light as the Kamaitachi Beast appeared before the Dark Vortex at ‘the end of the world.’
Gazing at the rotating vortex leading to the Outer World, the Kamaitachi Beast showed a hint of hesitation in its eyes, then turned to glance at the red tree at the center of the world.
After considering, it slowly retracted the burning blood-colored flames on its body without pursuing.
…
Thump! The turbulent sea water exploded, and the two beasts emerged somewhat bedraggled, crossing tens of kilometers in a blink of an eye to appear outside the vortex.
The Naga Tribe girls who were on guard were startled, “Black and White Great Lord, Candle Dragon Lord, are you alright!?”

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 981 413 Ancient Ferocious Beast The Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 981: Chapter 413: Ancient Ferocious Beast, The Giant Beast Suffers a Heavy Injury (6000)_4 Chapter 981: Chapter 413: Ancient Ferocious Beast, The Giant Beast Suffers a Heavy Injury (6000)_4 “`
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish looked back at the depths of the vortex and uttered an urgent sound: “Roar!! We’ve run into a tough one, don’t speak, let’s move.”
Boom!!
The domains of the two Giant Beasts unfurled, scooping up the Naga Tribe girls without looking back and dashing towards the Rift World, fearing the terrifying Giant Beast might give chase.
After swimming non-stop for over a thousand kilometers and seeing that the fearsome Giant Beast didn’t follow, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon finally slowed down their pace.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale felt a tremor in its heart: “Roar!! That guy is so strong, just one claw almost finished you off, Candle Dragon.”
The Red Beast swimming rapidly at their side did not speak; the flesh and blood across the tens of meters around the exposed spine on its back was writhing, trying to regenerate.
But around the wound, some blood-colored flames were burning, preventing the recovery. At this moment, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon was using the power of Time Laws to erase those blood-colored flames.
Looking at the somewhat pitiable Candle Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes were fierce: “Roar!! Candle Dragon, don’t worry, that guy dared to hit you, we must have our revenge.”
Roar! Let’s hurry back and get Thunderflame, let him blow its head off, and take and eat all those Top-grade Divine Fruits.”
Thinking this, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish became excited again.
Because there were many Top-grade Divine Fruits on that tree, more than a hundred, and although they were not yet ripe, they could first be taken and eaten slowly once they ripened.
By then, it could get at least ten, which would be enough for it to rapidly grow to the Mythical Stage.
Right, it had to save four for its wife and Tiger One, no, the wife needed to eat more to grow faster.
While the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was joyfully calculating how many Top-grade Divine Fruits it could get, the two giant beasts quickly crossed thousands of kilometers, passing through several dangerous areas to return beneath the Rift World.
With explosive splashes, the two Giant Beasts went upstream against the Void Waterfall and returned to the Rift World.
As soon as they entered the Rift World, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, Candle Dragon, and that Naga Tribe girl paused.
In the distance by the vast lake, an extensive and magnificent palace stood towering.
The palace, forged from crystal-white crystal, reached ten thousand meters high, supported by ice columns a hundred meters thick, and stretched more than twenty kilometers wide—majestic, imposing.
At the same time on the walls of the palace, were carved various statues of Giant Beasts roaring, in hibernation, spreading wings and such, filled with an archaic and desolate air.
Most of these Giant Beast carvings featured the golden-blue figure of Telsafi, the Silver Giant Dragon at the bottom, and the most ferocious of them all depicted the Crimson form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
In the center of the palace wall, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, more than a thousand meters tall, surrounded by lightning, stood upright, exuding a terrifying aura.
At that moment, behind the palace, a golden-blue Giant Dragon which was establishing its crystal domain and constructing a secondary hall on a ten-thousand-meter crystal column, took a breath.
Sensing the presence of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the others, the golden-blue Giant Dragon turned its head and was taken aback: “Roar! What happened to you two?”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish fluttered its Double Fins: “Roar!! We found a lot of Top-grade Divine Fruits this time, but there’s a very powerful Mythical Giant Beast there. Candle Dragon got injured by that Giant Beast.”
That guy is very strong; Candle Dragon couldn’t beat it.
“`
“So many top-tier Divine Fruits.” The golden-blue dragon’s eyes suddenly lit up, and it stood up straight.
Although its mother was a Titan-level Giant Beast, the golden-blue dragon hadn’t eaten many top-tier Divine Fruits, as most of the resources in its territory were ordinary God-level.
Looking at the Candle Dragon Giant Beast with its flesh and blood blurred on its back, the golden-blue dragon growled, “How strong is that beast?”
However, facing the golden-blue dragon’s inquiring gaze, the Red Beast with its mane and scale armor not yet recovered, flew in the air, lost and unresponsive.
Outside of combat, the consciousness of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon was enveloped in Time Power, existing out of this time segment.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish cried out, “Roar!! That guy is Mid-Mythical Stage, but very powerful, so powerful that with one claw, the Candle Dragon was heavily injured.”
While saying this, a trace of fear flashed in the eyes of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish.
In the past, these Mythical-level Giant Beasts were opposed by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon; it was always the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that took action, so they seemed to explode in a few moves, making Mythical Giant Beasts appear unformidable.
This was also why the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon dared to initiate a fight.
But today, when it and the Candle Dragon faced a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast alone, they realized how terrifying a Mythical-level Giant Beast was. That formidable body couldn’t even be penetrated by the Candle Dragon’s attacks.
Not to mention the attack’s destructive power; the Candle Dragon couldn’t handle even a single move.
If it weren’t for the Candle Dragon’s strength and its grasp of the Time Slowing Law, they might not have been able to come back today.
“A Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast.” The golden-blue dragon’s gaze suddenly turned solemn.
As a King-level bloodline with two top-tier talents, Telsafi’s strength was very formidable, not inferior to the Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
But if it was just two beasts comparable to the early stage Mythical Giant Beasts working together, they would certainly be no match for that Mythical Giant Beast, unless it used the Scale of Laws.
It’s just that using such a life-saving item like this would be somewhat of a waste.
Thinking this, the golden-blue dragon growled, “Joe, are those top-tier Divine Fruits ripe yet?”
Roar!! Not yet. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish shook its head.
“Roar! Since they’re not ripe, let’s set this aside for now. We’ll discuss it again when Scythia or Thunderflame wakes up; by then, we’ll go and kill that Giant Beast,” the golden-blue dragon decided.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was startled, “Roar!! Thunderflame is sleeping again?”
The golden-blue dragon nodded, growling slightly, “After you left, Thunderflame ate the flesh and blood of those Giant Beasts and then said that he had an epiphany and became stronger.”
“Now Thunderflame is over there sleeping, not knowing when he will wake up; Scythia also went to sleep near Thunderflame, saying she wants to achieve a breakthrough into Myth.”
Well, it seems that we can only wait for Thunderflame to wake up and then go kill that guy. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish felt somewhat disappointed.
Suddenly, the Red Beast next to the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish growled slowly, “Roar! That, Mythical, Giant, Beast, is, very, strong, I, can’t, beat, it.”
…The golden-blue dragon paused.

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 982 414 Supreme Meeting Everyone Present is
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 982: Chapter 414 Supreme Meeting, Everyone Present is Trash Chapter 982: Chapter 414 Supreme Meeting, Everyone Present is Trash In the middle of the Rift World, at the center of a Lava Lake tens of kilometers wide formed from the melted mountain peak, a black-red Colossal Beast a kilometer long lay in quiet hibernation.
Around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, an invisible power pushed aside the magma to create a vacuum zone with a depth of a kilometer and a diameter of several kilometers.
Within this area, strands of black, gold, dark blue, purple, and other substantialized radiances flowed, representing the eight Higher-order Laws of destruction, Vajra, chaotic dark power, corrosion, and others.
At this moment, the eight Higher-order Laws converged as if a vast galaxy was slowly rotating, akin to a complete ‘world’ covering an area of more than ten kilometers.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, like a Primordial Beast gestated at the dawn of the universe, responded with Heaven and Earth with each breath, drawing in and exhaling the Origin of laws from the depths of the Void to temper itself.
