This transformation was not just a simple tempering by laws, but also an evolution toward a higher existence within the Heavenly Tier, with its body undergoing changes.
For instance, clusters of black-red mane, each measuring more than 50 meters, grew from the crevices between the sharp horns and the scales around the fearsome head of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, making it look even more majestic and domineering.
Furthermore, the aura invisibly emanating from the body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was terrifying, immense, filling Heaven and Earth, pressing down so that the surrounding space continuously shattered, riddled with dense black cracks—a terrifying sight.
More than ten kilometers away, the Single-horned Tiger Whale opened its mouth, which seemed like a black hole, and revealed a look of shock: roar! Thunderflame’s transformation feels so powerful this time.
“Roar! Strong,, change,, freak.” Beside it, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, which had been disconnected, also came back to its senses, eyes filled with shock.
More than two months ago, when it had first met the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, the latter had only been ‘a little’ stronger than itself, and its level was only at the Early Stage of Level 9.
But as more than two months had passed, now the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had already made a breakthrough to the Mid-Mythical Stage, and its combat power was becoming increasingly terrifying with each strengthening, while it was still at the quasi-mythical level.
And if it hadn’t been for following the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon around, eating the Top-grade Divine Fruits, it wouldn’t know when it would have been able to touch upon the Time Laws and step into the quasi-mythical.
Looking at the distant black-red Colossal Beast, now being encircled by a cosmic array and with an increasingly terrifying aura, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast felt an inexplicable sense of crisis and couldn’t help but growl softly.
“Roar! Big,, horn,, we,, should,, also,, sleep.,, Get,, stronger.”
This time they had eaten quite a few ordinary God-level Resources, and with some cultivation (hibernation), their strength would greatly improve.
Moreover, after facing the Kamaitachi Beast on their own, the two Giants had come to realize the gap between themselves and the Mythical Giant Beasts.
Including the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, although its combat power was now comparable to an Ordinary Mythical Giant Beast thanks to the two Top Tier Talents and the Time Laws, in essence, it was still Transcendent.
The Single-horned Tiger Whale fluttered its Double Fins and nodded fiercely: roar! Work hard sleeping, then when Thunderflame wakes up we’ll go and kill that Giant Beast.
In fact, the Single-horned Tiger Whale bore no real malice toward that Giant Beast, as life among Unique Beasts naturally adhered to the law of the jungle; if they couldn’t beat it, it was only because they weren’t strong enough.
But once Thunderflame woke up, they would definitely go over to kill it, after all, those were more than a hundred Top-grade Divine Fruits.
The two Giant Beasts looked around and then found a mountain peak more than ten kilometers away from the Silver Giant Dragon to lie down on, closing their eyes and falling into hibernation.
Meanwhile, as it absorbed the residual energy of the two Law Level Divine Artifacts, the Silver Giant Dragon had grown to a length of more than 450 meters, its aura becoming increasingly powerful.
Around the Silver Giant Dragon, space Distortion occurred, and white Ice energy that froze everything spread around it, transforming several kilometers around the mountain peak beneath it into an Ice domain, with trees frozen and the air solidified.
Just then, the Purple little dragon that had been lying on top of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s head for a few days slowly opened its eyes and stretched out a claw to rub them: squeak squeak!?
In contrast to a few days ago, having absorbed the life aura released by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon during its breakthrough to the Heavenly Tier, the aura surrounding the Purple little dragon was now more profound, more divine.
Squeak squeak!!
The Purple little dragon curiously looked at the revolving cosmic chart around it, then its gaze fell on the towering Crystal Palace located dozens of kilometers away, and its eyes lit up immediately.
Swish! The Purple little dragon turned into a streak of light and soon appeared in front of the palace by the lake.
At this moment, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon was concentrating on building a second side hall; the beams and Crystal walls were already constructed, and it was now flying above, carving totems with its wings spread.
The pattern depicted the imposing image of the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon standing atop a Mountain Peak, looking down upon the vast Earth below, exuding an air of might and power.
The Purple little dragon excitedly flew in front of the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, pointing with its right claw at the wall: squeak squeak!!
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon growled lowly, “Misss Joseline, you want one too?”
The Purple little dragon nodded eagerly: squeak squeak!!
“It can be done.”
Squeak squeak!!
The Purple little dragon, fluttering in front of the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, kept gesticulating with its Double Claws, but its babbling was unfathomable to the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon.
Nevertheless, as a mighty dragon, Telsafi guessed the Purple little dragon’s intent with a slight nod of understanding.
Soon, just above the engraved figure of the prostrate Silver Giant Dragon, an image of a Purple Divine Dragon, a kilometer in length and sculpted from Purple Crystal, emerged.
Immediately, the Purple little dragon began to wave its Double Claws excitedly: squeak squeak!!
…
Within the pitch-black Void where rules interlinked, three colossal thought realms stood tall.
The middle-aged man sitting on a throne a whopping ten thousand meters high, his back adorned with six pairs of wings stretching out like those of a ‘God’s Mecha’, and the immense beast lying in the Void.
The Sky-based God King spoke slowly, his Will vibrating in the Void, “The news of Jack Clark’s appearance in the Divine Gods Alliance should have been known to the Purgatory Demon Race by now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 983 414 Supreme Meeting All Present Are
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 983: Chapter 414 Supreme Meeting, All Present Are Trash_2 Chapter 983: Chapter 414 Supreme Meeting, All Present Are Trash_2 Primordial True King nodded, the voice aged: “Hmm, Jewell has already told me before, as soon as Jack Clark arrived, he directly made his move, eradicating all the Divine Children and bishops of the four major Evil God Sects.”
First Councilor, with his half-black and half-white hair, Adam Garcetti’s face showed a faint smile, his voice calm, “This little fellow, always as overbearing as ever.”
Upon hearing these words, smiles also appeared on the faces of the other two Supreme Experts.
Having seen Jack Clark’s detailed profile, they naturally knew that despite appearing modest and amiable on the surface, this young man was actually very overbearing in character.
Adam Garcetti said slowly, “What do you think, will the Purgatory Demon Race make a move this time?”
The Primordial True King thought for a moment: “Recently, due to various mistakes, the Purgatory Demon Race has suffered losses several times, with the fall of more than ten demon kings; they may be cautious and not make a move this time. ”
“Of course, we cannot be careless. If they do contemplate action, there’s a high probability they will choose the moment the relics end.”
“The essence of Demon God Level beings is too powerful, prohibiting them from ‘crossing the Boundary’ to descend. Their Blood Sacrifice Array can at most support the distant transportation of Grand Demon King Level beings.”
“So, if they take action, they are likely to send an awakening-level Grand Demon King, striking with the momentum of a thunderbolt to assassinate Jack Clark.”
“Based on Jack Clark’s ‘strength’ revealed on the battlefield before, only a peak awakening-level Grand Demon King would be able to threaten the Summoned Giant Beast.”
Adam Garcetti and Sky-based God King nodded slowly.
Sky-based God King looked at Adam Garcetti, “Denny Kaye has secretly returned, hasn’t he? Should we have him and the Ghostly Shadows prepare at the edge of the Divine Gods Alliance?”
“As long as the Purgatory Family breaks the Rule first, we can legitimately step in. Once Denny Kaye and the others intercept that Grand Demon King, Primordial, you can immediately descend and eradicate him.”
“If we can capture a peak Grand Demon King who has the potential to enter the Demon God level, they will surely launch a frenzied counterattack.”
Adam Garcetti nodded slightly: “Denny Kaye has indeed returned. Moreover, Mysterious Martial and the messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan are on their way here, discussing the alliance.”
“Or rather, this team is coming to assess the strength of our Human Race.”
The Primordial True King said with a somewhat solemn expression: “Old Garcetti, I heard from Denny Kaye that the situation of the Heavenly Feather Clan does not seem very good?”
Adam Garcetti nodded: “The situation there is indeed not optimistic. The Heavenly Feather Clan is already being attacked on their homeland, facing the elite forces of three Purgatory Empires.”
“It is said that there are seven Demon God Level Powerhouses appearing on the battlefield, where the sky shatters and the stars collapse.”
Sky-based God King let out a long breath: “So many Demon God Level True Demons, indeed, befitting a civilization that has survived a hundred thousand years, with astonishing intrinsic strength!”
Adam Garcetti spoke evenly: “The Heavenly Feather Clan must not fail, or at least not fail so quickly. If the Purgatory Family has free rein, we will not be able to withstand the power of the Five Great Empires.”
“Therefore, we must stabilize the situation of the Divine Gods Alliance, ensuring that it does not explode in short order.”
The Primordial True King frowned slightly: “Garcetti, are you thinking of supporting the Heavenly Feather Clan?”
Adam Garcetti nodded slightly: “That’s right, now that the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield is isolated, and the Sky Curtain Battlefield has limited tolerance for ‘strength,’ our Human Race is under much less pressure for a short time.”
“Thus, after stabilizing the rear situation of the Divine Gods Alliance, I plan to have True Martial lead an elite force to support the Heavenly Feather Clan and, at the same time, utilize a great Rule battle to ascend realms.”
“As long as the Heavenly Feather Clan can hold on for a few more years, once Mad Wheeler and Jack Clark, who will master Supreme Laws, grow up, even when facing the assault of three Purgatory Empires, we will be able to withstand.”
“And as long as the number of our Human Race’s Supreme Level strong man reaches more than five, we may be able to withstand the second onslaught of the mythical world.”
But no sooner had the First Councilor finished speaking than the Primordial True King couldn’t help but give a bitter smile: “A few years to grow into a Supreme Level, Garcetti, aren’t you expecting a bit too much from Jack Clark?”
Sky-based God King shook his head slightly: “Primordial, it’s not necessarily impossible, don’t forget that Jack Clark has acquired the Ancient Emperor’s Inheritance. In my view, his chances of breaking through to the Supreme might even be greater than Mad Wheeler’s.”
Adam Garcetti glossed over the topic: “The reason I’ve convened this Void conference was to discuss with you the matter of the alliance between our two tribes this time…”
Meanwhile, as the three Human Race Supreme Experts discussed matters vital to the survival of their race, Jack Clark was sitting cross-legged and quietly cultivating.
Regarding the possibility that he might be used as “bait” this time, Gabriel had already discussed it with Jack Clark; it was one of the consequences of his previous domination in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
Jack was unfazed by this, reasoning that if the enemy dared to dispatch a demon king or a Great Demon King, it would provide the perfect opportunity to summon the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, now at Heavenly Tier, to come and devour them.
As for the potential scrutiny from Time Beings following the re-summoning of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s True Body due to the intensified erosion from Time Power, Jack was actually somewhat looking forward to it.
After breaking through to Myth, the genetic carrying capacity of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had become even stronger, capable of merging with one more new talent.
In this world, the flow of time has always been among the strongest at any given moment.
If his True Body could be used as bait to attract an attack from a being that roamed through time, and if it could kill the opponent, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would gain its tenth Time Talent.
And this talent, derived from a Time Being, would definitely be more comprehensive and powerful than the incomplete Time Slowing Law from the Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
As Jack quietly meditated while waiting, three iron pieces emitting a white light emerged from the distorted projection of buildings in the sky.
In an instant, all humans and beings of different races sharply looked up.
Sid Hawk said excitedly, “Attention everyone, more Ruins Tokens have appeared, and there are three of them.”
Ida Carroll, Joshua Welan, including Eddy Keller and Jane Aiken, all stood up, cautiously watching the three tokens in the sky while remaining vigilant about their surroundings.
Now without interference from the Demon God Sect, they were expected to get at least one token this time…
Boom!
A terrifying aura burst from Jack, shaking Heaven and Earth, and behind him, the yellow, gold, black, and blue Fourfold Divine Wheels slowly emerged.
Under the backdrop of the Fourfold World Halo, Jack’s figure flashed into the high altitude, overlooking the surroundings and stated calmly, “This time, these three tokens belong to the Human Divine Domain.”
Suddenly, the gathered strong men from four different races in the distance changed their expressions, with the one with tiger stripes on his face and white flames burning on his body speaking coldly.
“Human, what do you mean?”
“Can’t understand human language? I said, these three tokens, I’m taking them,” Jack’s tone was very calm, yet it carried an indomitable overbearingness.
The disregard evident in his attitude stirred a restless agitation among the beings of different races, many of whom showed expressions of anger, murderous intent, and sneers.
From the contingent of the most numerous different race, a young man with an eye on his forehead looked at Jack and spoke slowly, “Typical of the Human Race, so overbearing indeed.”
The words of the three-eyed young man made those strong men from different races look at Jack and the others with even more dissatisfaction, or rather, hostility.
Jack said indifferently, “This isn’t overbearing; you have already obtained five tokens before this, it is only fair that this time the three that have appeared belong to our Human Divine Domain.”
“Moreover, it’s not just these three; I would like everyone to yield the next eight tokens that appear to me as well.”
Such overbearing words made some beings of different races who had already taken a dislike to Jack suddenly roar, “Human, you are too arrogant. Don’t think we’re afraid of you.”
“Exactly, don’t think you’re the only one who had God-level strength in the Transcendence Realm, Dexter the Divine Child and the others have also stepped into the Deity Realm.”
“According to the rules laid down by the Divine Gods, all ‘people’ are qualified to fight for the Ruins Tokens. Are you saying you want to defy the orders of the deities?”
“Human, are you challenging the authority of all the deities in the Divine Gods Alliance?”
Looking at those indignant beings from different races, Jack spoke calmly, “Of course, I ‘dare not’ challenge the might of the powerful deities, nor do I intend to break the rules they’ve set.”
“It’s just that my strength has improved a bit rapidly lately, and I can’t perfectly control it. If someone accidentally gets killed, don’t blame me for not warning you.”
With that, Jack glanced over the four Divine Children from the three Main God domains and the Divine King domain, smiled at them with a slight smile, showing off his pearly white teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 984 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 984: Chapter 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human Race, the relic is opening Chapter 984: Chapter 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human Race, the relic is opening When Jack Clark made it almost clear that everyone present was trash, the previously indignant alien strong men suddenly quieted down.
Looking at him standing above the firmament, with four rings of light slowly revolving behind him, those aliens flickered a dangerous aura in their eyes.
The aliens present were under ‘thirty’ and had cultivated to the strength of the Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Layers Heaven, and both their talent and status were high.
But now, these young powerhouses were being called trash by a human.
At this moment, even those four transcendents, whose auras surpassed the Ninth Heavens’ limit, narrowed their eyes slightly as a fearful atmosphere emanated from them.
This aura intersected between heaven and earth, forming a terrifying mental pressure that remotely locked onto Jack Clark.
Under the combined focus of more than thirty Eight Layer Heaven auras and more than forty Nine Layers Heaven early to late period auras, Jack Clark remained calm, not taking these ‘people’ seriously at all.
If these alien strong men dared to make a move, he wouldn’t mind letting them know what real peerlessness within the same rank was, what despair was.
Down on the Earth, Ida Carroll, witnessing this scene, hesitated, “Isn’t Little Brother Jack being a bit too arrogant?”
The Federation’s current policy toward the Divine Gods Alliance is mainly conciliation and appeasement.
Therefore, in recent years, the Federal Genius who came here for missions or exploration never behaved too overbearingly, except when fighting with Evil God Sect Cultists.
Jane Aiken calmly said, “Sister Clark, Jack is probably doing this for a reason, don’t worry, we just need to be ready to make a move.”
Sid Hawk nodded, “Exactly, we just need to prepare for action.”
Just then, within the tens of thousands of meters altitude, the projection of the building twisted slightly, and the three Ruins Tokens materialized, flying toward all directions as if emerging from the depths of space-time.
Boom!
Jack Clark stretched out his hand to claw, and in an instant, the Heavenly Energy within kilometers above his head surged wildly, under the gathering of Invisible Power, forming three hundred-meter-large transparent palms.
Watching the palms reach for the three Ruins Tokens in the distance, many alien fools grew restive, subconsciously glancing toward the four strongest Divine Children.
Yet, until Jack captured all three tokens in his hands, those four deities, representing three of the Three Main God Systems, did not make a move.
Seeing this, Jack smiled faintly, “Thanks, everyone, for giving me face. Don’t worry, we just want eight tokens, the rest you all can distribute as you like.”
Although he said this, Jack still felt slightly regretful; he had actually been ready to annihilate all opposing aliens, to let blood flow into rivers.
As for the consequences, was he afraid? His mission this time was to start trouble, after all.
However, it was normal for those strongest Divine Children not to move. The previous five tokens that flew out had been taken by them, already securing a guaranteed entry qualification.
Therefore, they naturally did not act out of fear of Jack’s strength.
The alien strong men who had reached the late period or peak of the Nine Layers did not act foolishly, as both their talent and wisdom surpassed that of a general genius.
Of course, due to different stances, many times, actions that seem irrational are taken.
Under the watchful eyes of those alien strong men, Jack descended from the sky and landed on the hillside, then tossed two tokens to Jane Aiken and Joshua Welan.
“Student Aiken, Senior Welan, hold onto these two tokens for now.”
Jane Aiken didn’t need to be mentioned, she was not only a classmate but a friend; she had thought of Jack Clark the first time she obtained a Soul Crystal and had ‘mailed’ it to him for his soul-type Cultivation Methods.
As for Joshua, although Jack was not very familiar with him, he was Justin Welan’s brother; he felt obliged to look out for him.
Sid Hawk and the others had no objections; with the Demon God Sect no longer interfering, they were capable enough to seize tokens with their own strength, let alone with Jack there.
Sid Hawk looked into the distance, his expression serious, “Little Brother Clark, those few guys didn’t act out because they already had tokens, but do not let your guard down once inside the relic.”
Jack gave a slight nod, understanding that Sid Hawk was referring to those Divine Child deities of the Main God and Divine King Systems.
Actually, the nearly thirty alien Realms of the Divine Gods Alliance could generally be divided into four mainstream races.
For instance, the alien race with tiger stripes on their faces, towering figures standing ten meters tall, called the White Striped Race, had the Talent Ability to wield Glazed White Flame, making them very powerful in battle.
And those Divine Children surely had Life-saving Trump Cards given by Main Gods (Divine Kings).
On the other hand, resembling humans, standing three meters tall, with a third eye on their foreheads and distinctive markings on their cheeks, the alien race called the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe came from the Divine King System of Tarodel.
There were also the twenty-meter-tall Kata Clan with bull horns, rough features, and skin like an elephant’s hide, and the five-meter-tall, ten-meter-long Illusory Dragon Tribe with human upper bodies and serpentine lower halves, draped in blue scales.
The other alien races were evolutionarily derived from these four major races, especially the Phantom Serpent Alien, who are friendly to humans, while the Kata Alien Tribe is affiliated with the Evil God Alliance.
For example, the strong man under Demon God Sect Sykes who had appeared earlier descended from a branch of the Kata Alien Realm.
The White Striped Alien Race with tiger stripes on their faces was neutral, and also one of the most powerful forces, gathering over a dozen Alien Deities.
As for the secretive Tri-Eye Divine Tribe with a Divine King, they occupied half of the northern area of the Divine Gods Alliance, normally forbidding other aliens from entering their realm.
With Jack’s forceful seizure of the tokens, the atmosphere in the entire area below the relic became rather tense.

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 985 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 985: Chapter 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human Race, the relic is opening_2 Chapter 985: Chapter 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human Race, the relic is opening_2 As Jack Clark waited for the relic to open, in the castle palace enshrouded by demon gas in The Purgatory Family’s rear, seven figures emanating powerful auras stood atop the Demon King Pillars.
Barus’s voice was deep and resonant, “That human genius known as Darren Callum, or Jack Clark, has appeared in a relic of the Divine Gods Alliance.”
Instantly, one of the demon kings excitedly spoke up, “Lord Barus, this is an opportunity. Hasn’t Lord Diorus always instructed us to keep an eye on this human?”
“His appearance in the Divine Gods Alliance territory, if we can suppress and kill him, it would be a great achievement.”
However, after the newly arrived demon king finished speaking, he noticed that the other demon kings were looking at him with strange gazes. He instinctively reached out to touch his hideous cheek, puzzled.
“Why are you all staring at me like that?”
A demon king enshrouded in darkness across from him spoke slowly with a chilly voice, “Kratos, you should know that our Assassination Department originally had nine Demon King level strong men, right?”
The demon king nodded slightly, “I know.”
The shadowy figure continued speaking, its voice icy cold, “And now, because of that human genius, only six of us remain in the Assassination Department.”
In an instant, the newly arrived demon king hesitated.
At that moment, Barus, sitting in the principal seat, slowly began to speak, “That human is very strong. Although his realm is only at the late period of Nine Demonic Marks, according to the initial reports, his combat power is already comparable to the Mid-Mythical Stage.”
“What? Late period of Nine Demonic Marks, but his combat power has reached the Mid-Mythical Stage!”
The newly arrived demon king gasped in shock, then a terrifying killing intent emanated from him, “No wonder Lord Diorus wants us to kill him at all costs; this human must die.”
But after he finished, he found that the other demon kings were again looking at him strangely, prompting him to frown.
“Everyone, you all know I’m new to the Assassination Department and not very familiar with all aspects of our data. If there’s something I don’t know, can you please tell me directly?”
Barus spoke slowly from the principal seat, “Indeed, there are a few things. For instance, that human has mastered a certain Summoning Secret Skill that allows him to summon a Giant Beast with Grand Demon King Level combat power.”
“What? He can even summon a Titan Level Giant Beast!” The newly arrived demon king was startled once again.
The late period of Nine Demonic Marks with combat power of Mid-Mythical Stage was already shocking, but to also have the ability to summon a Titan Level Giant Beast that spanned two Great Mythical Realms, it seemed unbelievable.
“That Titan Level Giant Beast is very strong. Although its combat power is merely at the beginning stage of Grand Demon King, its Terror Defense is formidable. Even the attacks of a Demon King at the late stage cannot injure it.”
“Oh, and that human can maintain the Summoning for a very long time. Give up any thoughts of outlasting him to death.”
After Barus finished, the entire Demon Palace fell silent.
Especially the newly arrived demon king, whose intense aura of killing instinctively began to converge reluctantly. This human genius was too terrifying to provoke.
At this time, the demon king opposite slowly said, “This human must be the Child of Destiny chosen by the Human Race World before its destruction, which is why all his talents are so frightening.”
“Under the protection of the world’s destiny, his cultivation speed will be terrifyingly fast, and he has already made a name for himself. Killing him would require the coming of a Peak Awakened Great Demon King.”
Another demon king began gravely, “But the blood sacrifice needed to transport a Peak Awakened Great Demon King is highly noticeable and might attract the attention of the Divine Gods Alliance.”
“That indeed poses a problem unless we can get them to set up another sky-covering Demon Array beforehand to conceal the anomaly of a Grand Demon King’s arrival…”
Barus, at the principal seat, looked down at his subordinates discussing how to assassinate Darren Callum and said with gravity, “Haven’t you realized that this is a trap?”
“A trap!?” The six demon kings below paused.
Barus’s eyes twinkled with sharp light, “Don’t forget how Devianna and the others fell. The Human Race is cunning, insidious, and extremely ruthless.”
“The fact that the human Darren is blatantly exposing his whereabouts this time is very likely another trap aimed at us.”
“Darren showed terrifying potential on the battlefield, which even prompted Lord Diorus to take action, but he was blocked by the Rule Forbidden Weapon on him.”
“Given this, our clan’s killing intent towards Darren will be even stronger. We absolutely cannot allow such a high-level genius to grow up, and the humans undoubtedly know this.”
“It’s even possible that Darren’s appearance on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield was part of the conspiracy, a plot aimed against Grand Demon King level strong men.”
“If a Peak Awakened Great Demon King does arrive this time, they might be ambushed by the humans’ strong men.”
“The Divine Gods Alliance is far from our clan’s rear. If a Grand Demon King who descends there is truly ambushed, our clan will be unable to provide support, and they will be surrounded and fall.”
Hiss! Suddenly, all the demon kings inhaled sharply. Compared to the previous two ambushes, Barus’s speculation was very likely true.
The newly joined demon king clenched his teeth and a trace of fear appeared in his eyes, “These humans are too insidious.”
Barus said with a stern voice, “Humans have always been very cunning, devious, ruthless, even using a genius of Civilization Inheritance Level like Darren as bait. We must not be fooled this time.”
“We cannot be fooled.”
“Humans are too cunning.”
…
On a rock several tens of meters high at the cliffside, Jane Aiken looked at Jack Clark with curiosity in her eyes. “Jack Clark, didn’t you go to the Frontline Battlefield? The scene of our grand battle against the Purgatory Demon Race was magnificent, wasn’t it?”
Jack Clark nodded, “Indeed, it was grand. The great battle at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield mobilized eighteen army corps, over a million Senior frontline combat forces, and more than a million in logistics.”

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 986 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 986: Chapter 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human Race, the relic is opening_3 Chapter 986: Chapter 415 It must be a conspiracy of the Human Race, the relic is opening_3 “The Purgatory Demon Race side has an even larger number of participants. It’s estimated that the main battle forces of the Purgatory Demon Race and the vassal different races have reached over three million, with more than thirty demon kings. The front spans twenty thousand kilometers.”
Jane Aiken couldn’t help but reveal a hint of amazement on her face.
The image of several million experts with Fourth Layer Heaven strength or above, as well as fifty or sixty King-level strong men clashing in battle, was simply astounding to imagine.
“Right, I also saw Teacher Parma and Teacher Vernon Lowe on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.”
“Teacher Lowe, he’s at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield too?” Jane paused, as Vernon Lowe was her class teacher.
Jack Clark nodded, “Teacher Parma and the others originally belonged to the Second Corps of the Sky Curtain Battlefield. They were later reassigned to support the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, and I went over and greeted them at that time.”
Jane blinked her eyes, a smile appearing in them, “Did you fly over when you greeted them?”
“How did you know?” Jack Clark was surprised.
Thinking how Lori Parma, who had just made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven and entered the Mythical Battlefield, would feel seeing Jack Clark flying towards him, a barely Eight Layer Heaven image, Jane couldn’t help but smile slightly.
Suddenly, the relic buildings above the firmament began to tremble with an unusual phenomenon, as a dozen tokens appeared at once. Then, the projection of that structure began to slowly dissipate.
Below, there was a sudden stir.
“The ruins are opening.”
“This is the last batch of Ruins Tokens.”
“Grab them!”
Boom Boom Boom!!
In an instant, faced with the final opportunity, all the different races who had yet to obtain a token boiled over with excitement, their bodies surrounded by swirling powers as they rushed into the sky, including Sid Hawk and the others.
Jack Clark also paused for a moment, having not expected these tokens to be released all at once.
Boom!
Behind Jack Clark, four halos rotated, and with a single step and using Divine Steps in the Sky, he appeared as if by teleportation at ten thousand meters altitude, reaching for a piece of iron flying his way.
A thousand meters away from Jack Clark, an Innate Awakened One from the early period of Ninth Heaven with double wings on his back, his expression shifted subtly. He hesitated for a second but finally turned to fly far away.
This human was too terrifying, wiping out several mid to late period experts of Ninth Heaven with a single hit.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s hands transformed into claws, and two hundred-meter-long blue-black Thunder Dragons converged, roaring forth and exploding over tens of thousands of meters. They enveloped the dozen or so different race beings around two Ruins Tokens.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Triggered by a thread of Law Power, the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder bombarded down. The defensive energies around the dozen different race beings crumbled in an instant, spewing blood and plummeting towards the ground, bodies smoking black.
And all this while Jack Clark had no intention to kill.
His gaze cold, he looked at those different race beings blown away and in a flash grabbed the two Ruins Tokens in his hands.
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark, having forcefully secured three tokens, stood resolute in the high sky, eyes looking into the distance.
He saw, several kilometers away, Leo Hart showering in terrifying Fist Intent, his punch blasting the atmosphere over a kilometer, creating a Destructive Impact that sent three mid-term Ninth Heaven different race beings flying.
That Overbearing Fist Intent made Jack Clark recall the Heaven Suppressing War King, Leo Hart.
Elsewhere, Blue Radiance swirled in the sky, forming a tsunami thousands of meters high. As it moved, space itself distorted with transparent ripples, and the majestic force of the Tsunami hit with a mountain-shaking ferocity.
Crash Crash Crash!! With a single impact, Ida Carroll, transformed into the tsunami, destroyed the powerful assaults of four Eight Layer Heaven and two mid-term Ninth Heaven different race beings right on the spot.
Splurt Splurt!! Six different race experts spat out blood and were directly swept away for ten thousand meters.
This was the might of Innate Awakened Ones of Ninth Heaven. If it weren’t for the obstruction of the Demon God Sect and Evil God Sect before, even those strongest Divine Children would not have been able to stop them, and they would have grabbed at least two tokens.
However, after Ida Carroll and Sid Hawk obtained two tokens, they didn’t take any more action, turning into a beam of light that gathered around Jack Clark, watching the remaining different race beings contend for the leftover pieces of iron.
For the chance to enter the ruins, these different races that had previously united against Jack Clark now fought with real fervor, occasionally with ‘people’ heavily injured falling from the sky.
At this time, besides Jack Clark and his companions, there were a few different race beings who had already secured tokens standing in the distance, watching everything with cold indifference.
Half an hour later, the chaos had ended. Only twenty-three silhouettes were left above the firmament, and those different race beings that hadn’t secured a Ruins Token revealed unwillingness in their eyes.
But here, strength reigned supreme, and those who failed to secure a token naturally had no right to enter.
Boom! Above the firmament, space shattered, and from the violent depths of the Void, a thousand-meter-tall, over a thousand-meter-wide black Stone Gate slowly emerged.
The Stone Gate was carved with countless runes, resembling twisted different race figures worshiping an overwhelming figure that eclipsed the sky, emanating a grand, supreme aura.
Boom!
The Stone Gate slowly opened, and in an instant, everyone holding an iron token was enveloped by a powerful pulling force, irresistible and unopposable.
Including Jack Clark, everyone was dragged by that force into the Stone Gate, disappearing without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 987 416 Strengthening the Soul Ilisa Zabel
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 987: Chapter 416: Strengthening the Soul, Ilisa Zabel Reappears Chapter 987: Chapter 416: Strengthening the Soul, Ilisa Zabel Reappears In the desolate land, a massive black stone gate that loomed ten thousand meters high stood erect, its surface carved with ancient and mysterious runes that emitted a mysterious aura.
At that moment, Jack Clark and his companions stood beneath the enormous stone gate, appearing as puny as ants.
The land around the stone gate was undulating, with some weathered hillocks of stone standing tall among the hills, where more than a dozen grand gray stone statues stood, shrouded in clouds and fog.
These statues resembled the beings from the Divine Gods Alliance of different races in their solemn and fierce appearance.
However, the earth abruptly ended after extending several hundred kilometers, where the land fractured and shattered, mountains collapsed, breaking into countless massive meteorites floating in the void.
This void was not the result of a collapse in space but resembled the empty Cosmic Void, and the land, spanning a thousand kilometers beneath their feet, was but an ‘island’ floating within it.
Countless years ago, a cataclysmic battle had taken place here that shattered the world.
Feeling the chaotic rules and violent energy between heaven and earth, Jack Clark spoke gravely, “Everyone, be careful. There’s something wrong with this relic.”
“Hmm,” the seven members of Sid Hawk’s party nodded slightly.
At that time, a young man with three eyes on his forehead spoke slowly, “Ladies and gentlemen, our purpose in entering the Gunardo Ruins is to explore for resources and inheritances, not to engage in battle.”
“This relic is boundless and is the transformed remains of a once gargantuan Inner World that shattered. I propose that everyone choose a direction to explore on their own, without interfering with one another. How does that sound?”
As he spoke, the youth of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe looked towards the Human Race, his gaze settling on Jack Clark.
Apart from Jack Clark, the other humans were not even taken into consideration by this Ninth Heaven Peak being of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe.
Jack Clark nodded slowly, “That’s acceptable. However, the Human Divine Realm will take that direction,” he said as he pointed towards the left rear, even if that sector of space was strewn with more meteor debris.
Additionally, there were three intact stone statues in various directions; Jane Aiken had mentioned earlier that she had obtained her Soul Crystal from within one of those statues.
However, the statue she had shattered was much smaller, only a few hundred meters tall.
This time, entering the relic, Eddy Keller and Jane Aiken from the Human Race were both at the Eight Layer Heaven, and there was also Howard Lambert, who was at the peak of the Sixth Heavens upon entry, so Jack Clark directly claimed a large direction for themselves.
The youth of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe nodded, “That’s fine.”
Without concerning themselves with the division of exploration directions and areas by the different races, Jack Clark turned to Joshua Welan and the others, “Do you all plan to take separate paths, or shall two or three join forces together?”
Sid Hawk said in a deep voice, “Generally, relic exploration depends on opportunity. Sticking together is a waste of time; better we split up.”
“I have no objections.”
“Okay, then that’s settled.”
After a brief exchange of opinions, Jack Clark and his seven companions turned into streaks of light and soared into the sky, heading out in different directions, as did the other races.
It was unknown how long the relic would remain open, so naturally, they had to seize the opportunity to explore it hastily.
To leave voluntarily, one only needed to return to the vicinity of the black stone gate and activate the iron piece they held, and they would be yanked out of the relic by a strong pulling force.
Whoosh!
A thousand meters in the air, Jack Clark traveled a kilometer with each step, striding through the empty space. Not far from him, Jane Aiken turned into a hundred-meter-long green Sword Light, like a belt cutting across Heaven and Earth.
Under the flash of Sword Light, the two quickly covered a distance of over two hundred kilometers and arrived near a stone statue more than a thousand meters tall, which resembled the White Striped Alien Race with a human body and a tiger’s face.
Jane Aiken involuntarily halted her advance, gazing at the statue with a grave expression, “Jack, these stone statues lack long-range attack capabilities, but their strength is formidable and they are almost immune to energy attacks.”
“Immune to energy attacks!” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Jane Aiken nodded, “That’s right, it seems to be related to those special runes on their bodies.”
Looking at the statue that was as large as a mountain peak, Jack Clark felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity, as it reminded him of similar statues he had encountered on his way to the Seventh Legion Garrison previously.
Especially the seemingly simple runes on the statue’s surface that looked as though they were drawn on a whim were also very similar in appearance.
Boom!
At that moment, the alarming Sword Intent from Jane Aiken pierced the clouds, and the Sword Light on her black long sword swelled violently, transforming into a Sword Qi over two hundred meters long that shot up into the sky.
The black Sword Qi tore through the atmosphere, leaving a pitch-black trail as it blasted forward.
As the Sword Light containing the power to tear through space was unleashed, the statue, feeling the energy fluctuation, saw its body runes suddenly light up.
Boom! The huge stone statue moved, its massive arms flinging up waves of a tsunami with terrifying power toward the black Sword Qi.
However, compared to the speed of the Sword Qi, the statue’s movements seemed somewhat sluggish, and the light of the sword rotated and slashed the statue’s arm in the moment they drew close.
Boom!
Under the Sword Qi, which could tear a crack even in the space of the mythical world, the rocky arm of the statue shattered, leaving a slash over fifty meters long and several meters deep.
In the instant the stone arm’s rocks were cleaved, a terrifying counterforce erupted from the statue, shattering the sharp Space Tear Sword Qi into a sky-full of scattered energy.
Woo!
The statue emitted a vibrational sound like a steam whistle, and a power comparable to that of the Ninth Heavens burst forth from within it. Both of its arms swept up a tsunami of white waves, menacingly descending upon both Jane Aiken and Jack Clark.
At the same time, as the massive palms swung, the mysterious runes wrapped around the arms lit up, forming a heavy force that enveloped the surroundings of the two within a radius of hundreds of meters.
Under the nearly tangible compressing force, the gravity around them intensified, making it difficult for them to move.

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 988 416 Strengthening the Soul Ilisa Zabel
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 988: Chapter 416: Strengthening the Soul, Ilisa Zabel Reappears_2 Chapter 988: Chapter 416: Strengthening the Soul, Ilisa Zabel Reappears_2 Just as Jane Aiken’s Sword Intent burst forth with increased intensity, threatening to tear apart the air around her as heavy as steel, Jack Clark slowly spoke up, “Let me do it.”
As he said this, Jack’s figure moved, boom! The solidified atmosphere around him shattered, creating a series of transparent cracks that spread, and by then, Jack had already covered several hundred meters.
In his hands, a ferocious Eight Desolate Battle Halberd appeared, emanating an aura of extreme, heavy power.
Since the stone statue was highly immune to energy attacks, Jack didn’t bother wasting his True Strength and prepared to blast her apart with pure physical power instead.
Boom!
As the giant arms of the stone statue clapped together, the terrifying power compressed the air into solidity, like white high-pressure wind waves erupting from the crevices of the colossal elephantine fingers.
It wasn’t until this moment, in comparison to the stone statue where Jack looked no larger than a mosquito, that he finally reacted. Blood-colored radiance wound around the War Halberd in his hands, an effect of the Sea of Blood Doomsday Domain enhancement.
Beyond that, there were four streams of power augmentation from the Four-fold Plane Power.
Crackle! Under the trait of infinite pressure, a heavy pressure field formed on the surface of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, as if a mountain were compressed to four meters in size. The terrifying weight even caused the surrounding space to begin distorting.
Boom! In the instant when Jack swept across with his halberd at ten times the speed of sound, a black semi-circle covering dozens of meters formed around him. Everywhere it passed, space was pulverized by the Unrivaled Domineering Power.
The giant stone statue’s palms exploded directly into countless shattered rocks that blasted out under the terrifying impact, covering a range of over a dozen kilometers.
And right as Jack shattered the stone statue’s palms, behind him Jane Aiken erupted with four Sword Qi blasts, transforming into black, red, cyan, and gray streams that encircled like sashes.
Bang bang bang!!
The fragments of rock, blasting towards them like cannonballs at more than a dozen times the speed of sound, were instantly ground to dust by the Sword Qi, emitting rumbling vibrations and raising a whistling wind that was astonishingly mighty.
Such is the nature of battle at the high-order level and above; without sufficient strength, one wouldn’t even be able to get close, instantly wiped by the residual energy from the battle.
In the distance, amid the raging wind waves, the figure of Jack, who had just shattered the palm of the stone statue, suddenly appeared above the head of the statue. The Bloodlight intertwined on his War Halberd as he carried Terrifying Power in a sweeping strike down.
Boom!
In the instant the War Halberd struck the head of the stone statue, all the runes on its body shone, instantly distributing all the power contained in the War Halberd throughout the statue.
Boom! The vast body of the stone statue suddenly sank, the Earth within several kilometers radius beneath it shattered, with countless clods of dirt and fragments of rock blasted skywards under the power of Jack’s strike.
However, Jack’s physical strength was too terrifying, resulting in only a momentary stalemate, as black cracks began to spread on the head of the statue.
Crackle Crackle!! These cracks continued to spread rapidly, soon covering the upper body of the statue and tearing apart those runes, instantly dispelling that integrated power.
Boom! The upper body of the stone statue exploded into numerous fragments that scattered, the lower part crumbling like a mountain peak, kicking up a sky filled with raging wind and smoke and dust.
As he looked down at the collapsing ‘mountain,’ Jack’s gaze fell on a watermelon-sized, semi-transparent black Crystal Stone amidst the shattered stone remains.
Whoosh! Jack’s figure flashed down to the ground, kicking up the Soul Crystal, and immediately a row of transparent text emerged in front of him.
“Detection of high purity soul energy crystallization, do you wish to convert it into Soul Points?”
Jack’s face showed a faint smile as he pocketed the Soul Crystal. With Jane Aiken there, it certainly wasn’t convenient to convert it right away.
Wuwu!! At this moment, the sounds of stone statues activating echoed from other directions. Sid Hawk and Ida Carroll also targeted two statues a hundred kilometers away.
However, compared to Jack, who demolished a statue in a single strike, their fight was fierce, with various powerful forces bombarding the statue and blowing rock fragments in all directions.
But these statues had strong immunity to energy, somewhat similar to the Chaos Dark Power talent of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, so although Sid and Ida had the upper hand, it would take a long time to destroy them.
Jack glanced at those two statues and, after thinking for a moment, decided against the idea of competing for them. After all, they were on the same side, and moreover, there were faint outlines of statues drifting in the Void in the distance.
After destroying the statues in this direction, it didn’t take long for Jack and Jane to reach the edge of the Void.
Looking at the girl with the four swords on her back, Jack reminded her, “Student Aiken, your Sword Qi seems a bit restrained by the statues, remember to be careful.”
“Don’t worry, I understand. I won’t explore relics beyond my strength,” Jane Aiken nodded before leading the way into the chaotic Void of Heavenly Energy.
Boom boom boom!!
With Jane Aiken transformed into a streak of Sword Light, extending over a hundred meters like a ribbon, she destroyed every rock she encountered along her path, rocks ranging in size from dozens to hundreds of meters, as if obliterating them on a straight line.
As Jane Aiken plunged into the Void, Jack Clark turned and flew in the other direction. Under his terrifyingly keen vision, he had already spotted an almost intact building two hundred kilometers away.
Boom!
Enveloped and breathed by the purplish-red Halberd Skill that spanned hundreds of meters, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd swept through, causing an explosion of a two-kilometer-sized chunk of rocks, and the shockwave, mixed with smoke and dust, swept over tens of kilometers.
Standing in the Void holding the War Halberd, a faint smile appeared on Jack’s face. This feeling of destroying everything was exhilarating.
Who could have thought that just half a year ago, he was a low-level cultivator who could only muster a few hundred kilograms of strength with the swing of an arm, and had to rely on that brute force in combat?
And now, he could fly and burrow, casually destroying mountain peaks and shattering the earth with a single strike.
After the exhilarating experience, Jack turned into a streak of purple-golden light and flew toward the front, skirting around some fragments of the Earth before approaching the relic building.
It was a large ‘island’ floating in the Void, with a diameter of over twenty kilometers, and in its center stood ancient buildings spanning several kilometers.
Most of these buildings had already collapsed, leaving only ruins and broken walls, except for a palace made of white rocks, standing a kilometer high.
The carvings on the walls and pillars of the palace had blurred over the years, and only some of the Gunardo Runes were still emitting some energy fluctuations.
In front of the best-preserved palace’s main gate, on the square stood eight five-hundred-meter-tall stone statues, all broken and missing limbs.
Boom! Jack descended from the sky at speeds over ten times the speed of sound, and upon landing, the ground within a radius of dozens of meters shattered, rocks exploding outwards like bombs in all directions.
Hum!!
Sensing the ‘person’ infiltrating, runes lit up on the eight dragon-head human-bodied stone statues, and energy comparable to the Eight Layer Heaven began to emanate from within them.
Crackle Crackle!! The eight broken statues slowly turned their heads, their gaze falling on Jack, and an invisible wave of thought erupted, shaking the air.
“Invader, kill.”
But before the eight statues could act, a three-hundred-meter-long purple-golden War Halberd shot out from amidst the swirling smoke and dust, shattering and exploding the stone statues in its path.
Under Jack’s Unrivaled Domineering Power, the statues were instantly destroyed, with a sweeping force.
In the midst of the dust-filled raging wind, Jack’s figure flickered a few times as he collected eight fist-sized black transparent Crystal Stones, and finally landed on the head of a statue tens of meters high that had shattered in the middle.
These statues were indeed very resistant to externally amplified attacks that included Heavenly Energy, but this resistance had its limits; beyond a certain threshold, they could still be destroyed.
For instance, these several-hundred-meter-tall statues that could unleash the strength of Eight Layer Heaven were generally immune to external energy attacks from the Eight Layer realm and could only be destroyed by physical damage.
And the previous statues that were over a thousand meters tall were immune to the external strength of the Ninth Heavens, comparable in combat to the Nine Layers, and also contained larger Soul Crystal Stones within them.
“You converted eight crystallized soul energies, obtaining 72, 83… 91 Soul Points respectively.”
“You converted high-purity soul energy, obtaining 391 Soul Points.”
Grasping the Soul Crystal Stones, Jack chose to convert them directly.
Instantly, along with his existing 97 points and the previous Level 9 Soul Crystal, the Soul Points on his display accumulated to 1143, meeting the requirements to strengthen the fourth layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture.
The speed of this gain was exciting even for Jack.
Glancing at the palace ahead, barren except for twelve stone pillars, empty inside, Jack sat down on the stone, and an intention resonated in his mind.
“Spend 1000 Soul Points to strengthen the fourth layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture.”
Boom!
An explosion of soul energy converted by 1000 Soul Points erupted within Jack’s body, surging into the depths, where his Soul True Body, spanning a hundred meters and clad in a black Imperial Robe, appeared.
Under the soul enhancement, the Illusion Meditation Scripture operated at a terrifyingly fast pace, immediately causing the aura around the Soul True Body to surge violently, growing more terrifying and slowly increasing in size.
And as Jack’s Soul Cultivation Method made a breakthrough, and other people and different races were delving deeper into the Void to explore the relics, deep in the Relic World, a young man clad in a white robe opened his eyes.
This young man looked nearly identical to ‘Ilisa Zabel,’ who had once entered the Southern Battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 989 402 The Eternal Glow of Holy Light
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 989: Chapter 402 The Eternal Glow of Holy Light, Refining the World Chapter 989: Chapter 402 The Eternal Glow of Holy Light, Refining the World In the depths of the Relic World, where the power of the Laws’ Origin permeated, entwined by rules, a young man in white sat cross-legged, his presence terrifying as if he were an Innate God Demon.
As the youth in white slowly opened his eyes, a pair of colossal golden eyes, spanning tens of thousands of meters, appeared behind him, covering the entire “world” with their gaze.
Ilisa Zabel spoke slowly, her voice deep and indifferent, “Someone has entered again from another entrance, and this time, there are even more of them.”
“Good, this world lacks little to complete its refinement. Before I leave, I can plant some seeds of light within the Divine Gods Alliance.”
As she spoke, a gentle smile appeared on Ilisa Zabel’s face, and her eyes, which were cold before, now shone with a warmth that seemed to love the world. In a soft murmur, she intoned, “The Holy Light shall shine upon the Eternal World.”
As she spoke, behind Ilisa Zabel’s golden eyes appeared the ethereal shadows of about twenty people, including Howard Lambert, who sat cross-legged within a relic’s structure surrounded by red Killing Intent.
Ilisa Zabel’s gaze swept over each person, showing no change as she passed over Jack Clark, as if she did not know him.
But when Ilisa Zabel’s gaze landed on Jane Aiken, her gaze faltered, revealing a hint of confusion, “Why is she here? No, it’s not her, but they are so similar.”
Looking at the shadow of the black-haired girl, whose sword intent clashed about her as she stood atop the structure of a relic, Ilisa Zabel’s eyes slowly grew complicated.
“Life traces only seventeen moments, which is… time…” Ilisa Zabel stopped mid-sentence and suddenly clutched her forehead, showing a flash of pain in her eyes.
“I have severed all ties, I shall be eternal, and my glory shall illuminate the entire Eternal World!!” Grinding out each word with clenched teeth, the pain in Ilisa Zabel’s eyes gradually faded away.
Ilisa Zabel closed her eyes, and when she opened them again, they returned to their usual indifference. Then dozens of white radiances appeared before her, exuding a Mysterious Aura.
These white radiances seemed to be of the World Origin, yet they were slightly different from the true World Origin.
“Go forth and merge with the Holy Light.”
With a thought from Ilisa Zabel, the Void silently cracked open in front of her, and dozens of white radiances penetrated the Void, merging into a Golden Lotus, white Jade Fruits, and other God-level resources.
These God-level resources were located in the shattered relics tens or hundreds of kilometers away from all the different races, including Jack Clark. They would inevitably find them as long as they continued to move forward.
Simultaneously, under the influence of an Invisible Power, the buildings that contained these resources began to show cracks on their surfaces, appearing even more dilapidated.
Yet, all the relics infused with the white radiances avoided the route taken by Jane Aiken.
Moreover, on the path she traveled, several colossal floating islands tremored, with some of the better-preserved structures on them beginning to collapse.
Including the remaining giant stone statues outside these structures, which bore runes that continuously cracked and became more fragmented, markedly reducing the danger they posed.
……
Atop the meteorite with a diameter of over a dozen kilometers stood a well-preserved tangible building, its surroundings protected by an Invisible Power from the erosion of the raging Heavenly Energy.
Meanwhile, outside the building’s gate stood a stone statue over six hundred meters tall, with a crocodile head and slightly bowed figure, devoid of any signs of life or energy fluctuations.
But seeing the intact Rune Trails on the statue, Jane Aiken did not dare to be careless, her formidable Sword Intent circulating as her hair lifted without any wind.
Just as Jane Aiken was about to strike down the statue and explore the relic, suddenly, a crackling noise came from the statue, and then cracks began to appear.
Boom! To Jane Aiken’s astonishment, the statue collapsed thunderously, turning into rubble with a resonating quake.
Then the building itself started showing cracks on its gray stone pillars, tearing apart the inscribed runes, causing the protective Invisible Power surrounding it to disappear.
As the rune power was disengaged, the violent energy between heaven and earth surged over like a deluge, wearing down the entire building visibly fast.
In just the blink of an eye, the building aged as if it had endured hundreds to thousands of years of weathering, looking ever more dilapidated.
“This…” The girl blinked in surprise, not expecting the statue and building to suddenly decay and crumble.
But of course, not needing to fight was for the better. Jane Aiken showed a faint smile and with a flash, she rode a sword beam over, digging out a Soul Crystal from the rubble.
This Crystal Stone, containing pure soul energy, was not only vital to Jack Clark but also a rare soul-related resource for a cultivator like her.
After absorbing the pure soul energy within, it could enhance her Soul Strength by a fraction.
Tucking away the Soul Crystal Stone, Jane Aiken looked at the now half-collapsed building. Surrounded by Sword Qi, she condensed four hundred-meter-long sword beams that shot out explosively.
Bang Bang Bang! Amidst the deadly Sword Intent, the collapsed rubble was directly shredded, sending smoke and dust billowing in a raging wind, as a water basin-sized red bead emerged.
This bead, originally held in the palm of a statue seated in a high position, blazed with red flames on its surface and Law Charm flowing around it, releasing astonishing energy fluctuations.
“It’s actually a God-level Fire-elemental Resource,” Jane Aiken’s eyes sparkled as she flashed over to the red bead. The Sword Qi in her hand gathered as she sealed and collected the bead.
Such a generic God-level resource might no longer interest Jack Clark, but it was incredibly valuable to Jane Aiken, who was only in the Eighth Layer Early Phase.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 990 402 The Eternal Shine of the Holy Light
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 990: Chapter 402 The Eternal Shine of the Holy Light, Refining the World_2 Chapter 990: Chapter 402 The Eternal Shine of the Holy Light, Refining the World_2 Especially because Jane Aiken rarely accepted tasks, she was “very poor.” Apart from the sufficient resources given by the official to cultivate to the late stages of Ninth Heavens, she had no “money.”
After Jane Aiken nearly traversed the Road of Heavenly Kings last time, her talent level reached the level of a Civilization Inheritance and she obtained a large amount of resources inclined towards her from the official.
Tucking away the red bead, Jane Aiken turned into a red sword light that shot up into the sky and plunged into the Void.
And while Jane Aiken was sweeping across various relics, collecting various resources and discovering Soul Crystals, Jack Clark also made a breakthrough in his Cultivation Method.
The Fourth Layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture allowed Jack Clark’s Soul True Body to reach one hundred and twenty meters, becoming more refined, and the Imperial Crown Pendant he wore on his head now had ten strands, looking even more majestic.
At the same time, the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal he held in his left hand rotated with a miniature cosmos inside it that seemed to have expanded slightly.
Under the long-term transformation by the Primordial Rule, Jack Clark’s Soul True Body and the Emperor Seal both underwent some changes, with a hint of the aura of the Rule lingering around him.
However, this transformation towards a Rule life form was very slow; in just two to three months, the essential change wasn’t very significant.
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, feeling the invisible but stronger Soul Power inside his body, a faint smile appeared on his face, “This feeling of a surge in strength is really wonderful.”
The “strength” of the soul could only be fully shown after transcending the Mythical King level and transforming into a Divine Soul, but even so, the Fourth Layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture still made Jack Clark feel much stronger.
The breakthrough over, Jack Clark immediately stood up.
Just entering the relic and reaping such a reward, he felt that by destroying some more ancient statues, he could quickly strengthen the Illusion Meditation Scripture to the Sixth Layer.
Boom! The Earth shattered within hundreds of meters range, and Jack Clark turned into a Radiance that shot up to the sky, smashing through tens of meteorites ranging in diameter from several to hundreds of meters before abruptly stopping.
In the Void, a colossal, broken stone statue floated, still over four hundred meters tall even with only its upper body remaining.
Boom! A three-hundred-meter-long purple-red Halberd Skill streaked across the sky, shattering the Void, like a massive missile crossing through the Void and striking the head of the statue.
Boom! A dazzling purple-red light burst open, transforming into an energy ring surging out for several kilometers; amidst the violent shockwave, only some broken stones tumbled.
Jack Clark’s gaze swept through countless shattered stones within a range of several kilometers, pondering, “These broken statues devoid of energy fluctuations really contain no Soul Crystals inside, is it because all the energy has dissipated?”
Jack Clark turned his head to look around the dark Void, with countless meteorite fragments spread in all directions, as well as “lakes” where water had gathered and areas of flames formed by the burning magma underground.
Especially the magma that burned for tens of kilometers, the light and heat it emitted brought some radiance to the dark Void.
But since the entire “world” was shattered, Jack Clark couldn’t tell if this world was a flat continental block or a massive planet before its destruction.
However, since statues that were too badly broken did not contain Soul Crystals inside, Jack Clark’s next targets would be those more intact statues.
Soon, after flying several hundred kilometers through the Void, Jack Clark found another target.
A landmass exceeding a hundred kilometers in area floated in the Void, with a meteorite crater tens of kilometers wide in the center of the island and a two-thousand-meter-long, gray stone statue with three eyes and broken arms lying within.
Beyond the statue stood a towering structure several kilometers high that had collapsed a great deal, but vague energy fluctuations emanated from within.
Boom!
In the distance, a blue-black Thunder-enveloped radiance cut through Heaven and Earth, like a Destroy Heaven and Earth meteor, shattering the meteorites it passed.
Hum! The two eyes of the broken-arm stone statue suddenly lit up, and a surge of energy beyond the Transcendent, reaching the Early Mythical level, Burst forth.
Boom! The statue trembled and stood up amid an Aura of Mountains and Seas shaking, angrily roaring at the light traversing the Void in the distance.
The arm of the statue, massive as a mountain ridge, wrapped in black energy, lashed out at Jack Clark with a palm strike so terrifying that it distorted and broke the space around it with Unrivaled Domination.
Compared to the other statues he had encountered, this three-eyed statue possessed a Terrifying Power.
But as terrifying as the power of the three-eyed statue was, Jack Clark’s strength was even more astonishing, his War Halberd enveloped in Higher-order Law Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder and Great Sun Heaven Flame, destroying everything.
Just as the War Halberd, condensed with Terrifying Power, collided with the gigantic palm in an instant, a momentary burst of dazzling Radiance and Destructive Impact erupted.
Boom!
In an explosion of extreme lightning and flames, the more than one hundred-meter-long giant palm of the stone statue shattered, followed by the thick arm exploding under the onslaught of the advancing halberd.
The runes on the surface of the stone statue giant provided a strong immunity to energy, but when the level of strength reached the Law Level, that exempt effect plummeted abruptly.
But it was expected.
If such statues, reaching Early Myth level could be immune to all Mythical stage energy attacks, this already collapsed civilization would have become invincible long ago.
At least within the range of several tens of millions of kilometers.
After all, just by creating a few thousand such statues, this Ancient Clan Civilization would have been able to dominate everything around it, more terrifying than The Purgatory Family.
But just as Jack Clark shattered the statue’s only arm and was ready to destroy its enormous body in one fell swoop, the statue’s forehead eye suddenly lit up.
Boom!
Instantly, a several tens of meters thick black Light Beam blasted out from the statue’s forehead, annihilating everything it passed, destroying everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 991 402 The Eternal Radiance of Holy Light
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 991: Chapter 402 The Eternal Radiance of Holy Light, Refining World_3 Chapter 991: Chapter 402 The Eternal Radiance of Holy Light, Refining World_3 “`
Boom! The moment Jack Clark dodged, the black Light Beam struck the Earth below, causing the entire ‘world’ to tremble slightly, and the ground to shatter.
Boom boom boom!! Half of the island collapsed under the stone statue’s Light Beam, innumerable giant chunks of dirt scattered into the surrounding Void, disintegrating with a terrifying momentum.
Even Jack Clark was somewhat taken aback by such power; had the strike hit him directly, the strength of the Fourth Layer Boundary around his body would have collapsed in just a few breaths.
Whoosh! Jack Clark appeared above the stone statue’s head in an instant under the Heaven-walking Divine Steps powered by Divine Power, his War Halberd in hand emanating a terrifyingly heavy aura that shattered the space around it.
The infinitely heavy War Halberd almost turned black as Jack Clark, with his normal full strength in one strike, nearly became a black flash of light that descended onto the stone statue’s head at an appalling speed, nearly twenty times the speed of sound.
Boom! The stone statue’s body vibrated, all the Ancient Runes on its surface flickered, spreading the force of the blow throughout its body, causing an explosion across ten-plus kilometers of the Earth below it, and sending countless chunks of dirt soaring into the sky.
Amidst the pervading smoke and dust, a massive crack appeared on the stone statue’s head, originating from the center of the forehead and slowly splitting half the skull, like a mountain peak thundering down to the ground.
As the sculpture’s head broke apart, the runes along its body dimmed, gradually losing their luster, until finally, what remained was a huge, broken stone statue standing on the Earth.
And at the center of the half-split head of the statue, there was a black transparent Crystal Stone as big as a basin, surrounded by black lines that sprawled like blood vessels.
Looking at those black lines that resembled circuits, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly; these stone statues felt somewhat similar to the principle of Mechas and robots.
Or perhaps, whether it be cultivators or Mechas, these ancient puppets, stone statues, including the mechanical devices of Blue Star society, actually all conform to the fundamental rules of the world.
It’s just that one is driven by electronic energy, and the other by Heavenly Energy; different paths leading to the same destination.
Lost in thought for a moment, Jack Clark dug out the huge Soul Crystal, his mind resonating with the thought: “Convert the soul energy within this Soul Crystal.”
Whoosh! Instantly, a magnificent, pure surge of soul energy burst forth from the Crystal, flooding into Jack Clark’s body and disappearing under the shroud of a special power.
“You have converted a high-purity soul energy Crystal and received 2928 Soul Points.”
“Nearly three thousand points.” The amount of Soul Points gained from this conversion surprised Jack Clark.
But of course, the more Soul Points the better; if he could destroy two more stone statues over two thousand meters tall, the Soul Points gained would be enough to enhance the Fifth Layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture.
The enhancement requirement for the Fifth Layer of the Illusion Meditation Scripture is ten thousand points, and for the Sixth Layer, Jack Clark estimates at least fifty thousand points or more, feeling somewhat similar to the enhancement requirements of talent.
With the stone statue guarding the relic destroyed, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted towards the majestic buildings in the distance; this relic had more than just Soul Crystals, including resources and so-called Inheritance from the Ancient Civilization.
Jack Clark’s figure flashed, and he appeared in front of the relic building.
But just as Jack Clark was preparing to explore the relic, deep within the Relic World, ‘Ilisa Zabel’ in a white dress showed a hint of surprise in her eyes.
After musing for a short while, Ilisa Zabel slowly stood up.
Initially, she hadn’t regarded those entering the relic as important—just a bunch of cultivators at the Transcendence Realm, who could all be controlled with minimal effort.
But the spectacle just now informed her that this young man from the Human Federation was somewhat strong, even stronger than she had anticipated.
Just at the late period of the Ninth Heavens realm, and yet he destroyed a Mythical-level ancient war puppet in two moves.
Although the War Puppet had been so damaged it hadn’t possessed more than fifty percent of its full strength, it still wasn’t something the average Mythical King could destroy in a short amount of time.
In such a situation, she naturally couldn’t allow this human genius to continue exploring the relic; otherwise, it might cause some impact on her plans.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 992 418 The Fall of Eternity Assimilation of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 992: Chapter 418: The Fall of Eternity, Assimilation of Holy Light Chapter 992: Chapter 418: The Fall of Eternity, Assimilation of Holy Light Standing before the arch-shaped relic gate over two thousand meters high and a kilometer wide, Jack Clark appeared as tiny as an ant.
The members of this different race known as Gunardo must have been colossal in stature, surpassing hundreds of kilometers in height, otherwise they wouldn’t have built such gigantic structures.
Pondering, Jack Clark reached out with his left hand.
Boom! The air in front of him vibrated, as ripples spread out from the palm of his hand, circling around the barrier that wrapped the monumental structure.
Hum!! As the strength in Jack Clark’s hand increased, the space in front began to vibrate violently, with transparent cracks spreading in all directions.
When those transparent cracks reached a hundred meters in depth and extended for kilometers, the white jade-like stone pillars behind also began to crack, tearing apart the runes.
Boom! The barrier enveloping the entire structure burst open with a loud bang, the earth trembled, forming a violent shockwave sweeping over tens of kilometers, with rolling white waves surging like tidal water.
Amidst the white waves and raging wind, Jack Clark indifferently withdrew his left hand and walked through the cracked open gate, immediately a vast space unfolded before his eyes.
The architectural style within the Great Hall bore some resemblance to ancient Rome, dominated by columns with a dome overhead, preserved immaculate due to the protective barrier.
The cliff-like walls all around were engraved with exquisite patterns. Amidst depicted mountains and rivers, countless different races, meters or even hundreds of meters in height, knelt down, worshipping the Firmament above.
The likenesses of these different races were clear, numbering in the thousands. Some resembled members of the Divine Gods Alliance, including the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe, indicating how powerful the ancient Gunardo civilization must have been once.
But time is merciless, and in the face of history’s tide, no matter how powerful this civilization was, it still vanished after an apocalyptic war.
Looking at this scene, Jack Clark couldn’t help feeling somewhat melancholic.
It was just like the once resplendent Ancient Civilizations of the Human Race on Blue Star, which, despite being suppressed by seven Monarchs who transcended the Supreme, ultimately dissipated in the river of time.
Time passes, the sun and moon cycle, and what once was eventually becomes legend.
Lost in his thoughts, Jack Clark looked up at the top of the Great Hall, where a figure bathed in endless White Light stood, illuminating the entire world like a Great Sun in the sky.
However, in contrast to the clear carvings of the kneeling different races, that towering figure was somewhat blurred. Despite the deep engravings, its shape could not be depicted.
It seemed as though an Invisible Power was preventing beings from recording its likeness through engravings, paintings, or even memory.
‘No trace in all ten directions, no path in the six realms’?
As Jack Clark gazed intently at the towering figure, silver Radiance emanated from the figure’s palm, wrapping layers upon layers around the entire palace.
Under the influence of this power, time around him subtlety changed, and the faint illusion of a bustling city began to appear within the Great Hall.
The sudden transformation halted Jack Clark’s gaze. He offered no resistance and allowed the force to envelop him.
Clearly, he had triggered some kind of Inheritance from the different races.
But as the Invisible Power tried to pull Jack Clark into an unknown period, it felt as though it was attempting to move a Divine Mountain—an impossible feat.
Boom!
The entire structure shook as cracks spread across the walls, the traces of passing ages flowing over them grew fainter, rendering them even more dilapidated.
…Wait, what about the Inheritance? Looking at the fissured walls around him, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised—this was the first time he had encountered an Inheritance that directly shattered like this.
Jack Clark shook his head, “Forget it, this power couldn’t even shake me, so it’s probably not a powerful Inheritance.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark looked at the figure above, which held a massive silver Crystal emanating layer upon layer of silver halos and releasing powerful energy fluctuations.
“It’s actually a High-Level Divine Resource,” Jack Clark revealed a smile, reached out his hand, and in an instant, Heavenly Energy from the high altitude swirled, forming a several-meters-wide transparent hand.
But as the transparent hand grasped the silver Crystal and pulled it towards him, Jack Clark frowned slightly, sensing a faintly dangerous Aura emanating from the Crystal Stone.
There was something wrong with this crystal.
With that thought, Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils, and instantly everything in Heaven and Earth lost color, as all material substance began to fade away before the Void Death Pupil.
Under the gaze of the pupil, the silver crystal enlarged, revealing the terrifying energy contained within, akin to silver threads.
These threads of silver carried a Law Charm, each one condensed from endless pure energy, where even a single thread was comparable to the combined True Strength of a Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator.
And within the Divine Crystal’s silver threads, a strand of White Light was intermixed, seemingly of the World Origin, emanating a warm, pure, powerful aura.
Under normal conditions, even if a cultivator who entered the relic sensed this strand of energy, they would excitedly believe it to be a strand of World Origin.
However, Jack Clark was all too familiar with this ‘strength’ called World Origin, and he was certain something was off about that strand of White Light. Moreover, the Void-Striking Heart Eye sensed danger from this energy in the depths of his being.
After a moment of contemplation, Jack Clark collected the High-Level Divine Crystal – any issues with it could be examined after leaving.
At that moment, the entire structure began to shake as Jack Clark had removed the silver Divine Crystal that upheld the relic’s presence. The shaking grew more intense until the structure violently collapsed.
Boom! The collapse of the structure, thousands of meters high, was like a falling mountain peak, with an astonishing sound. Countless boulders fell from the sky, the Earth trembled continuously, and smoke and dust billowed.
Meanwhile, a young man dressed in white emerged from the Void at a high altitude, looking towards the black-haired young man walking out of the smoke and dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 993 418 The Fall of Eternity Assimilation of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 993: Chapter 418: The Fall of Eternity, Assimilation of Holy Light_2 Chapter 993: Chapter 418: The Fall of Eternity, Assimilation of Holy Light_2 And just as Jack Clark caught sight of the young man, the Void-Striking Heart Eye in his forehead sent a strong surge of danger. This person was dangerous and very strong.
