“Ilisa Zabel, brother Ilisa, what are you doing here?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Hearing Jack Clark call him brother, the youth in white couldn’t help but his gaze flickered slightly: “You know me?”
“We’ve met before on the Southern Battlefield, haven’t we? Back then you were guiding Student Aiken in understanding Sword Intent.”
At this point, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly: “However, it seems you are not brother Ilisa, even though your appearance, demeanor, and the soul aura you give off feel exactly the same to me.”
The youth in white fell into a brief silence and then said lightly, “What you saw before must have been another Avatar of mine.”
“Similar to a soul avatar dispatched by a king-level figure.”
The youth in white shook his head slightly: “Sort of, but slightly different.” The white-clad youth had no intention of elaborating on the state of his existence and that of the one named Ilisa Zabel.
Looking at Jack Clark who was standing at the edge of the ruins in the distance, the white-clad youth, whose original purpose had been to suppress him, did not immediately make a move.
Just as Jack Clark sensed a dangerous aura coming from him, the white-clad youth’s Heart’s Eye also sensed a danger emanating from this black-haired young man.
And it was a serious danger, even though the other’s realm was clearly just late Ninth Heavens, starting to touch upon the Laws.
A gleam of sharp light flashed in the white-clad youth’s eyes, deducing that this genius must possess a forbidden weapon bestowed by Supreme Experts, capable of unleashing a strike with the might of the Supreme Level.
Only a forbidden weapon of that caliber could pose a threat to him from a cultivator in the late Ninth Heavens.
While the two stood off against each other, neither making a move, Jack Clark suddenly smiled and said, “I didn’t expect to meet brother Ilisa’s original body here; that’s also a kind of fate.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark introduced himself: “Jack Clark, from Eastern Summer’s South Sky Martial Height. May I ask how you are called?”
“South Sky Martial Height.” A look of surprise flashed in the white-clad youth’s eyes, and the indifference previously present there vanished, replaced by a gentle smile as warm as a spring breeze.
“I never thought you would come from South Sky Martial Height. It has been over a decade since I graduated from South Sky; by that account, I guess I am your senior. You may call me Left Saint.”
With that, the previously frosty atmosphere between the two eased considerably.
Left Saint, Ilisa Zabel!!
A thought flashed through Jack Clark’s mind, and he showed a warm smile: “I never expected to encounter a senior from my school in this place.”
“But senior, how come you are in this relic? Isn’t it said that only those under the age of thirty with the Life Mark Wheel can enter here?”
Left Saint stepped forward, traversing several dozen kilometers in just a few blinks, appearing before Jack Clark, and explained, “This relic covers the entire Chaotic Ancient Region and has more than one entrance, each with different restrictions.”
“I see.”
Jack Clark nodded as if enlightened, then feigned curiosity as he asked, “By the way, senior, are you familiar with this relic? For instance, are there any powerful inheritances or precious resources?”
Left Saint gave a slight smile: “Although I’ve been in this relic for a few years, most of that time I spent in a secret realm, so my knowledge is limited.”
“All I know is that this relic world is evolved from the fragmented inner world of a terrifyingly strong being, within which once lived over a thousand strong civilizations of different races.”
“But later, it seems that the horrific life failed in its attempt to ascend to a higher realm, the heavens collapsed, the earth shattered, the world broke apart, and countless alien races perished with it.”
The world crumbled, and the heavens fell apart.
Jack Clark’s gaze flickered as he thought of the Giant Beast that descended from the skies onto the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, a monstrous life form whose tail alone stretched over thousands of kilometers.
At this moment, Left Saint’s tone carried a faint longing, “That is an indescribable strong existent, vast and boundless, even though only a fragment of the world remains.”
“Within this Inner World, there are many races that follow that powerful being, inheriting ancient Divine temple ruins, including some Divine Objects that serve as forbidden cores.”
“For instance, the relic you just explored was once a Divine temple belonging to the Joteta Alien Race, a race with a massive stature, each adult possessing the Strength to Carry Mountains…”
Just as Jack Clark inquired Left Saint about the information on the relics, other directions where different races and Sid Hawk and others had also gained some rewards.
Boom!
Islands spanning over twenty kilometers in diameter in the Void shook, countless rocks around them crumbled.
In the middle of the island, a stone statue a kilometer tall collapsed, and on top of its crumbling head stood a Divine Child from the main god lineage of the White Striped Alien Race, enshrouded in white flame.
Below the shattered head of the stone statue was an ancient building, half-ruined and toppled.
At the center of the building, a lotus made of ice crystal and half a meter in diameter slowly rotated, emitting intangible Law Charm that excited Leo slightly.
“It’s actually a High-level Divine Object, and it’s a cultivation-class frost resource.”
The excitement on the face of the young man with tiger stripes increased as he reached out with both hands into the void, his domain power enveloping and drawing the Ice Crystal Lotus before him, immediately a more potent energy fluctuation spread out.
“No, there seems to be a fluctuation of World Origin within this frost lotus,” Leo said, somewhat surprised.
For him, in the late period of the Ninth Heavens, even a single High-level cultivation-class God-level Resource could advance his cultivation further, but to his surprise, this frost lotus also contained World Origin.
This unexpected delight excited even Leo, who, holding the frost lotus, glanced around at the pitch-black Void and then swallowed the frost lotus in one big gulp.
Such a high-quality resource should naturally be consumed earlier to transform into strength, especially the ‘World Origin’ it contained, for once absorbed by him, even if someone killed him, they could not take it away.
Boom!
The moment Leo swallowed the frost lotus, a cold strength exploded within, freezing even his sturdy True Body with a layer of frost wherever it passed.
Leo dared not delay, as the strong Colored Glaze Flame within his body burned fiercely, starting to refine the cold energy, merging with that wisp of World Origin…
At this moment, not only Leo, but other different races’ strong individuals who had found ‘World Origin’, including the Human Race twins strong men, the Amos brothers, also began to refine it on the spot.
As they refined those cultivation-class God-level Resources, all of them had a hint of White Light emerging in their eyes, a vacant look that faintly shone through, lacking the sharpness and Overbearing manner typical of Ninth Heaven Experts.
Moreover, as they refined deeper, their consciousnesses were gradually engulfed by the endless White Light and brought to another world.
Here, mountains were verdant and waters clear, and on the Earth stood cities composed of gorgeous White Jade buildings, the sky fluttering with white petals, and the atmosphere peaceful, devoid of strife and conflict.
Meanwhile, in the Void, countless voices seemed to whisper as if in prayer, as though chanting.
The Holy Light will shine on the world, we will stand with God, and those who sing the true name of God shall live eternally…

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 994 419 Jonathan Walker The Inevitable Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 994: Chapter 419 Jonathan Walker, The Inevitable Battle Chapter 994: Chapter 419 Jonathan Walker, The Inevitable Battle Upon the broken ‘island,’ Left Saint was like a true senior, withholding nothing, sharing all the information he knew about the relics with Jack Clark.
However, the information was limited.
For instance, Left Saint only knew that the Void of this world was about the size of a dozen or so Blue Stars, and scattered with many fragments of Earth and relics.
But as time passed, most of the relics and the residual strength of the stone statues had dissipated, turning into cold rock and dirt floating in the Void.
Even the power of this World Fragment was continuously being devoured by the true Void, leaking energy and silence enveloping everything.
Currently, only a radius of over ten thousand kilometers at the ‘world’s’ center still contained Heavenly Energy and some relics remained intact, which was also where the entrance that Jack Clark and others had come through was located.
After Left Saint finished speaking, Jack Clark slightly furrowed his brows, “So this means the resources of this relic are limited.”
Left Saint nodded, “Indeed, not only are the resources limited, but the tokens you hold will only sustain for seven days. After seven days, you will be expelled from the relic.”
“So, if you wish to inherit some powerful ancient alien strength, it’s best not to waste time on these broken relics, especially fighting those War Puppets.”
Jack Clark slowly addressed, “Thank you for the reminder, Senior. In that case, there’s indeed no time to waste.”
Boom!
A powerful aura burst from Jack Clark, and from his hands, the Sumeru emitted beams of light, which crackled and transformed into a set of Dark Red Armor covering his entire body.
Clad in the magnificent and ferocious War Armor, holding a War Halberd, Jack Clark was like an ancient War God, his aura growing heavy and overbearing, his black hair cascading down as he looked at Left Saint.
“Senior, I’ll be taking my leave first.”
Left Saint smiled faintly and nodded slightly, “Be careful.”
Boom! Within a hundred-meter radius, the Earth collapsed as Jack Clark instantly turned into a streak of black-red radiance, shooting off and disappearing into the ‘Cosmic Void’ after smashing through various meteorites.
Watching the black-red radiance fade away, the smile on Left Saint’s face slowly disappeared and he murmured in a low voice, “I didn’t expect that after more than a decade, the Human Federation would have another such monster of a genius. His Ninth Heavens cultivation level actually makes even the current me feel some danger.”
“And that fool Nell Walker, she actually sneaked back to the Blue Star. Isn’t she afraid of being surrounded and exposed by those old folks and revealing our movements?”
As he said this, Left Saint’s eyes took on a golden hue, cold and detached like the Heavenly Dao looking down upon all living beings, devoid of any emotion, while all the scenes within the relic reflected in his eyes.
This included Jane Aiken, who was rampaging through, ‘picking’ up resources.
Only when his gaze passed over that long-haired girl did Left Saint’s eyes show a faint fluctuation, but then his expression shifted slightly.
“How did it happen so quickly?”
Boom Boom Boom!
Over two hundred kilometers away in the void, a streak of blue-black lightning flashed, and as it passed, five towering stone statues hundreds of meters high crumbled in succession.
Amidst the flying debris, Jack Clark pocketed five level eight Soul Crystals, then his figure flashed, soaring into the dark Void.
As for what that suddenly appeared Left Saint had said, Jack Clark naturally did not fully believe it, or rather, he remained alert and guarded.
This person was mysterious and dangerous, unsure of what his purpose was in approaching, but it was certainly not just to provide information about the relic.
Moreover, it was later discovered that Ilisa Zabel originated from the Evil God Alliance. Her identity was too mysterious, and the trail went cold from there, but it also indicated that this Left Saint was no simple character.
Ilisa Zabel was even his Avatar, and it was even possible that this Left Saint was not even the true body, this guess made Jack Clark very wary of him.
So whether what he said was true or false, Jack Clark still needed to quickly destroy those stone statues, acquire enough Soul Crystals, so that any unexpected changes later on wouldn’t matter.
For the current Jack Clark, what he needed most weren’t God-level resources to increase cultivation, but Soul Points that could strengthen the Soul Cultivation Method and ‘World Resources’ to enlarge his Plane World.
Jack Clark traversed the void, his eyes pulsing with black gold vertical pupils. He observed the heavens and the earth, with the whole world seeming to dematerialize before him, turning into countless subtle points of converged energy.
“Found it.”
Bang!
The Void exploded, and Jack Clark transformed into a streak of black-red radiance, piercing through Heaven and Earth, rapidly spanning hundreds of kilometers to appear above an island spanning dozens of kilometers.
Below, on the Earth, stood a relic that had collapsed half, and beside it was a stone statue resembling a towering dinosaur rising on two legs, a kilometer high.
Hum! Sensing Jack Clark’s appearance, the eyes of the stone statue suddenly lit up, opening its gaping maw…
Boom! Heaven and Earth illuminated, as a three-hundred-meter-long War Halberd condensed from the most intense golden flames plummeted from the sky, emitting a dazzling radiance.
Everything the War Halberd passed was annihilated, encircled by rings of white Energy Halos, magnificent and filled with a Destructive Aura.
Roar! The stone statue roared, its arms wrapped in purple radiance, creating a tempest as it met the Golden War Halberd slashing towards its head, trying to block it.
Bang Bang Bang! The Golden War Halberd, wrapped in Higher-order Law Power, was unstoppable, crushing the arms of the Violent Dragon statue segment by segment until it finally struck its head, and an intensely hot firelight burst forth instantly.
Boom!
Like a Star exploding, golden light shone brilliantly, and under the terrifying blast, the upper body of the stone statue crumbled instantly, its pieces melting into magma within the Golden Firelight and hurled in all directions.
Above the altitude of tens of thousands of meters, Jack Clark in the Dark Red Armor stood emotionless, observing the expansive explosion below that spread over twenty kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - 995 419 Jonathan Walker The Inevitable
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 995: Chapter 419 Jonathan Walker, The Inevitable Battle_2 Chapter 995: Chapter 419 Jonathan Walker, The Inevitable Battle_2 For him now, these war puppets with immense strength and Defense Strengthening enough to dominate the battlefield were nothing but a strike away from being crushed.
Soon, Jack Clark found a Soul Crystal in the flowing magma below.
According to Left Saint’s explanation, the Soul Crystals within these war puppets actually originated from a kind of Void beast.
Under normal conditions, the soul energy within these crystals could not be directly absorbed, or else one would be eroded by the mixed Void Energy. Therefore, they were used by the Ancient Civilization of different races as the driving core of these war puppets.
However, as years beyond count passed, these Soul Crystals within the stone statues continuously purified, turning into pure soul crystals, which could strengthen the soul to a certain extent upon absorption.
Still, this strengthening had its limits. The base soul of each person was different, and with each crystal absorbed, the effect weakened, with a roughly 30% increase in Soul Strength being the limit.
Jack Clark put away the Level 9 Soul Crystal and then turned his gaze to the crumbling ruins not far away in the shock of the explosion, particularly the Golden Lotus that appeared after the ruins collapsed.
The Golden Lotus floated in the air, slowly rotating and radiating circles of splendid Golden Law Charm.
“Heaven Heart Golden Lotus.” A flicker of surprise crossed Jack Clark’s eyes; he had seen the information about this Heaven and Earth Treasure in the core data library of the Heavenly Think Tank.
This was a Heaven and Earth Treasure close to Top-Level Divine Resources, containing the true Origin of the world. A Ninth Heaven Peak cultivator who refined it could greatly enhance their cultivation and accelerate the Tempering and conversion of laws.
Yet, while looking at the Golden Lotus and the white energy mixed within the World Origin inside the lotus, coupled with an indistinct gaze from behind that seemed to come from nowhere, Jack Clark narrowed his eyes.
“Is there indeed a problem, what is he trying to do?”
In contemplation, Jack Clark sealed the Golden Lotus and placed it into his Storage Space. Then, without making a sound, he soared into the sky and disappeared into the Dark Void.
…
In the fully preserved black palace, the nearly substantial Dark Red Glow of the Blood Fiend rolled continuously, enveloping a range of hundreds of meters, with an Aura of murder reaching the sky.
At the center of the Blood Fiend, Howard Lambert sat cross-legged. Below him, an Array Diagram that resembled a Hellish Demon Map circulated, covering a three hundred meters range and emitting a terrifying Dark Red Glow.
Behind Howard Lambert, a thirty meters tall true martial arts phantom stood upright as if it were a real entity, strikingly a fully formed true martial arts phantom.
This true martial arts phantom, like a demon from Hell, had a burly figure covered in black armor, with a pair of curved horns on its head, emitting an aura of madness like a demon.
Meanwhile, above Howard Lambert’s head, a blood-colored jade stone with a diameter of 0.5 meters rotated, with endless Dark Demonic energies gushing out from the stone, continually absorbed by the Lambert sitting below.
As he absorbed the power of the Heritage of Ruins, the Aura Lambert emitted became increasingly stronger. Little by little, he approached the shackles of the Eight Layer Heaven.
Boom! The Hellish Demon Map below Lambert burst into blood light, turning into a phantom of Dark Hell that enveloped the entire relic, causing a surge of energy within the relic at that moment.
At this time, the fully formed Dark Demon True Body phantom behind Lambert merged into his body, and as it enveloped the entire relic, emitting endless blood light, the Dark Hell also violently collapsed.
Boom! As the Dark Demon True Body and the embryonic form of his domain, the Dark Hell, merged, Lambert’s aura skyrocketed in an instant. With the raging wind surrounding him, he stepped into the Eight Layer Heaven.
After a long while, Howard Lambert slowly opened his eyes, which glowed dark red and were filled with endless madness and demonic influence. His face revealed a crazed laugh: “Hahaha… Eight Layer Heaven, I’ve broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven.”
Amidst the laughter, Lambert slowly stood up, causing the air around him within a dozens of meters range to tremble as if it wasn’t a human that stood up but a huge Giant Beast.
Howard Lambert’s cultivation of the Bull Devil Battle Body mainly focused on Body Refinement, which rendered great strength and a madness like that of a demon upon cultivation.
Later, entering the Void Relics, he gained the Inheritance of one of the 108 Demon Generals of the Ancient Human Civilization, the Heavenly Evil Demon General, which made his strength even more Overbearing and his Demonic Aura to rise to the skies.
The Inheritance of the Ancient Civilization gave him formidable combat power. After joining the Outer Development Department of the 30th Army Group in the mythical world, he directly plunged into the battles and fights of the mythical world.
Just two months in cultivation and Lambert had broken through to the Early Sevenfold Sky, with a remarkable rate of progress.
But more than ten days ago, as Lambert ventured deeper into the Divine Gods Alliance, he encountered Jane Aiken and was shocked to find out that the girls’ cultivation had already broken through to the Eighth Layer Early Phase.
This terrifying rate of cultivation progress left Lambert dumbfounded.
Back when they first entered the Martial Arts School, there wasn’t a large gap between his and Jane Aiken’s cultivation, as they were the top two Top-notch Geniuses, suppressing the whole school.
However, later, even more of a monster of a guy emerged, and Lambert fell to third place, but he still closely followed Jane Aiken, looking down on his peers.
Who knew that after just two months, Jane Aiken had actually broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven, catching up to Jack Clark’s realm from over two months ago.
As for Jack Clark, that monster’s realm was probably even higher, perhaps already having made a breakthrough to the Nine Layers.
But now, Lambert was not far behind. After more than ten days of inheritance from the relic, he had leaped across the Eight Layer Heaven. Thinking of this, a confident smile appeared on Lambert’s face.
Now, bearing the double Inheritance, his Innate Divine Strength talent had undergone a Transformation, making his strength even more formidable and terrifying, and his cultivation talent had also become stronger.
With more time, catching up to that guy Jack Clark wasn’t hopeless.
After all, reaching the Ninth Heavens was the pinnacle of Transcendence, and even a genius with monstrous talent would slow in progress. Furthermore, the quasi-mythical Threshold from the late period to the peak of the Ninth Heavens would take even more time.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 996 419 Jonathan Walker The Inevitable
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 996: Chapter 419 Jonathan Walker, The Inevitable Battle_3 Chapter 996: Chapter 419 Jonathan Walker, The Inevitable Battle_3 Although Jack Clark had traversed the King’s Road and possessed a vast amount of World Origin, it would likely take him several months or even a year to cross the threshold between the Transcendent and Myth realms.
By then, he should have also made a breakthrough to the late period of the Ninth Heavens and could fulfill the agreed-upon battle.
Given that their realms were roughly equal, Howard Lambert was confident that he now had the strength to face Jack Clark in combat, at the very least to withstand ten of his moves without defeat.
Indeed, Howard’s goal was no longer to defeat Jack Clark but rather to withstand a few more moves from him.
There was no helping it, that guy was just too abnormal, and his combat power was terrifying.
When the time came, if he could withstand a few moves from Jack Clark without defeat within the same realm, then once that guy made a breakthrough to king-level or even became a Heavenly King, he would have a boasting right.
After all, he was one who had challenged that man. Thinking of this filled Howard’s rugged face with confidence.
Walking with heavy footsteps, Howard soon left the ancient Great Hall and looked into the distance.
Below the stairs of the Great Hall, in the midst of the square, stood a majestic stone statue over two thousand meters tall, like a mountain peak, exuding a terrifying pressure invisibly.
According to the inheritance information, as long as Howard could defeat this War Stone Statue guarding the relic, he would gain control over it.
But that was just a thought to be entertained.
This Guardian Stone Statue, belonging to the Karuna Alien Tribe, possessed early Mythic combat strength, and due to Petrification, it had a fifty percent immunity to Law Power and full immunity to Transcendent strength.
With such terrifying defense and combat power, it was not yet something Howard in the Eight Layer Heaven realm could handle.
Just as Howard lamented his inability to take away the War Puppet with early Myth combat strength, a black-red radiance suddenly pierced through the void in the distance.
Boom!
Far away, the Earth within a kilometer radius shattered, countless fragments of stones burst upwards in a circular shock wave, soaring hundreds to thousands of meters into the air before clattering down, the scene was awe-inspiring.
Whoosh! An unseen raging wind howled, blowing away the explosion’s smoke and dust, revealing Jack Clark clad in black-red Ferocious War Armor and holding a War Halberd.
“Jack Clark!” The moment he saw Jack Clark, Howard’s eyes bulged, uncertain why Jack would be there.
And then there was the aura he emitted.
Hum!
Sensing the powerful energy fluctuations and threatening aura emanating from Jack, the stone statue resembling the Furious Ape, with two heads and six arms, lit up with runes one by one.
The ferocious head, as large as a mountain peak, slowly turned to look at Jack, who appeared like an ant from several kilometers away. The Furious Ape Stone Statue slowly opened its mouth and roared with a faint sense of thought.
“Roar! Intruder, die.”
Boom! The Six-Armed Furious Ape Stone Statue thundered into action, each step spanning a kilometer, and the Earth trembled with its footsteps.
On the six arms of the Furious Ape Stone Statue, ancient runes wrapped around and glowed, energy converging to form golden light blades hundreds of meters long, exuding a sharp aura.
Rip! The golden light blades, fast as lightning, tore through the air with a piercing howl heading towards Jack, while the statue’s six arms swung down with speeds several times the speed of sound, nearly blotting out the sky.
Boom! Boom! Boom! The moment the twelve golden light blades struck down, the earth within a kilometer radius shattered, followed by giant fists raining down from the sky, completely annihilating the area.
The terrifying bombardment caused the land within a ten-kilometer radius to collapse, with smoke and dust billowing and the violent impact whipping up a typhoon that swept through heaven and earth.
Such fearsome power, coupled with the attack speed of thunderous urgency, left Howard Lambert, watching from a distance, utterly dumbfounded.
If he had been the target of that strike, he would have been blasted into mincemeat in an instant.
Just then, a heaven-shaking roar erupted from the center of the explosion, and a twenty-meter-long War Halberd, wrapped in dazzling blood light and blackness, soared into the sky.
Bang! Bang! With heavy, overbearing strikes from the War Halberd, the Furious Ape’s two arms were instantly obliterated, followed by Jack Clark swinging the halberd to blast away an approaching stone arm.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Black-Red Radiance, like a bolt of lightning, streaked across the sky, exploding everything in its path and effortlessly shattering all six arms of the Furious Ape Stone Statue.
Amidst the explosion of stone debris and the howl of the wind, Jack Clark instantly appeared in front of the Furious Ape Stone Statue. The extremely heavy War Halberd glimmered with dazzling blood light, as if cleaving the heavens and the earth with a single strike.
Boom!
With Jack Clark’s near full-strength blow, the Furious Ape Stone Statue’s head instantly exploded, sending countless stone fragments shooting toward the rear amid clouds of dust.
With its head destroyed and its Rune Matrix shattered, the Furious Ape Stone Statue momentarily froze, becoming a true lifeless object, like a mountain slowly toppling backward.
Boom! The colossal body of the statue smashed onto the ground with a tremendous crash, breaking apart and shaking the earth.
Swoosh!
Jack Clark descended from the sky amidst the flying debris, skillfully finding a Soul Crystal the size of a washbasin and storing it in the Sumeru Bracelet, then turned his gaze towards the distant ruins.
There stood Howard Lambert, watching this scene, dumbstruck.
The Mythical-level stone statue had been so easily destroyed by Jack Clark – was this for real, or was Howard Lambert dreaming?
Crack! The faceplate on Jack Clark’s face split open, revealing a handsome countenance as resplendent as jade. He gave Howard Lambert, who was still in shock, a small smile, “Howard Lambert, long time no see.”
“Yeah, long time no see.” Howard Lambert’s gaze was somewhat complicated.
Damn it, he thought, this guy’s only been gone for two months, and he’s become even more of a freak. A Mythical-level stone statue couldn’t withstand two hits from him – what was he even swinging his own weapon for?
As Howard Lambert’s expression grew complex, preparing to step out from the relic to catch up with Jack Clark, Jack abruptly said, “Stay inside for now, don’t come out.”
He then turned his head, looking behind him at the pitch-black Void, and spoke lightly, “Senior Left, no, I should call you Jonathan Walker, Senior Walker.”
“You’ve been following me from behind and watching for so long, are you finally unable to resist making a move?”
A sigh emerged from the Void, “Actually, I don’t really want to kill you, but you insist on not refining those resources, always destroying those War Puppets.”
“Especially those God-level War Puppets, they are an important part of my plan to refine this realm and forge a War World.”
“So don’t blame me.”
In the cold voice, the figure of Left Saint, no, Jonathan Walker, appeared soundlessly from the distorted Void, immediately followed by an aura that threatened to shake the world, enveloping the area.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 997 420 Battle Demon God . Dragon The Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 997: Chapter 420 Battle Demon God . Dragon, The Battle of Destiny Chapter 997: Chapter 420 Battle Demon God . Dragon, The Battle of Destiny In the black void resembling the cosmos, Jonathan Walker stood as if he were an unparalleled genius, clad in snow-white garments with a handsome face, coldly watching Jack Clark.
“So don’t blame me,” Jonathan said as an infinite burst of golden light erupted from him.
Boom! Centered on Jonathan, the free-floating energy that filled the void exploded like the atmosphere in an instant.
The infinitely expanding golden radiance carried intense heat and a sharp aura, shattering and dissolving asteroid-sized rocks wherever it passed, forming a golden divine realm that covered several kilometers.
At the center of the golden divine realm, endless streams of Law Power compressed the void into oscillation, creating rings of white shock halos that spanned ten kilometers, a sight both grand and shocking.
In the center of the golden divine realm, a sacred body stretching a hundred meters tall appeared, Jonathan Walker, like a supreme deity standing high above, with a cold and majestic demeanor.
As he emitted boundless light and heat, he resembled the first sacred flame born at the creation of the world, and the invisible peak pressure of the Mythical stage shook the entire “world.”
Under this terrifying aura, void islands over a hundred kilometers away trembled; rocks along their edges broke apart, disintegrating continuously.
Within the relic, Howard Lambert suddenly felt a heavy burden, as if carrying a mountain on his back. The terrible pressure bent him bit by bit, and the hard rock ground beneath his feet cracked open.
“I will never kneel!” Howard’s eyes revealed a mad look as he erupted with an insane, demonically charged Battle Intent to fight against Heaven and Earth under the peak pressure of the Myth.
Boom!
A dark red Blood Fiend burst out from Howard, forming a Hell Domain spanning three hundred meters, barely blocking the overwhelming pressure that descended like a covering sky.
This was the horror of a Mythical Peak existence, nearly bringing the mastered Laws to perfection. At this moment, the Divine Might emitted by just standing about ten kilometers away was unbearably oppressive for Howard.
Boom! On the square, a dazzling blood light burst forth from Jack Clark, turning into a Blood Sea Doomsday that covered a kilometer range with golden flames burning within it and blue-black Thunder leaping about.
At the same time, Jack’s figure swelled, including the black-red armor he was wearing, which expanded rapidly, transforming him into a hundred-meter-tall, three-faced, six-armed ghastly figure.
Behind the figure resembling a Demon God, four halos rotated, each gripping a two-hundred-meter-long black-gold battle halberd, immediately bringing forth a heavy Overbearing pressure that soared to the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The heavens and earth quaked between Jack and Jonathan, the atmosphere exploded with a deafening roar, and the clashing pressures formed transparent cracks that spread in all directions, creating an alarming momentum.
For cultivators past the Mythical-level, their aura has merged with their Will, intangible and formless, interfering with reality.
Under the unrestrained pressure of a Mythical King, ordinary people don’t even have the right to stand, let alone approach. True Divine Might is like Hell itself.
Jack stood in the center of the blood-fire domain, his four arms behind him shaping seals that supported the Divine Wheels, each wrapped in blue Thunder patterns and golden flame patterns, emanating the terrifying Aura of Higher-order Laws.
Besides that, his left face was covered with red scales and looked cold, his eyes filled with endless blood light, while faintly, the Power of Hell descended.
Meanwhile, his right face had eyes closed, surrounded by black and grey lines that spread and emitted the Aura of the Laws of Void and Death.
With the four Higher-order Laws entwined, reinforced by the Power of Hell, and the rotation of the Fourfold World Halos behind him, Jack seemed to be an ancient War God suppressing Hell.
The pressure he emitted was comparable to the late Mythical stage, terrifying and dreadful.
That was with Jack having only just touched upon the four Higher-order Laws, gathering a bit of their divine patterns without having completed the Transformation of his Rule True Body; otherwise, his might would be even more terrifying.
Even so, the power and prestige Jack exhibited at this moment were such that even Jonathan could not help but take notice.
Because when Jonathan had been at that stage, his combat power had barely been comparable to the mid-Mythical stage, and even then, he had been acclaimed as an Unparalleled Genius by the First Councilor.
Inside the relic building, Howard’s eyes widened, he was shocked and dumbfounded: “Jack, how are you still such a freak even after reaching the Ninth Heavens?!”
When Jack was in the Seventh Layer Heaven, his combat power was already exaggerated, sweeping the Void Continent with the cultivation of the Seventh Layer, slaughtering a million and amassing towering Blood Fiends.
Now at the Ninth Heavens, his combat strength remained terrifying, leaping straight from the Ninth Heaven late period to the horror of the Mythical late period.
This ability to always maintain combat power that leaps across Major Realms is just too abnormal.
Feeling the dangerous aura emanating from Jack, Jonathan’s gaze was cold as endless golden radiance concentrated in his hand, forming a three-hundred-meter-long golden War spear.
Holding the golden War spear, Jonathan’s voice was ice-cold and deep, “Jack Clark, I’ll give you one more chance. Join my Holy Light God Sect, or today you will surely fall here.”
Although Jack was formidable, Jonathan did not consider him a threat.
A Ninth Heaven Expert is still a Ninth Heaven Expert. Without a True Body to sustain the Laws, without a soul Transformed into a Divine Soul, without mastery of powerful Law Combat Skills.
Therefore, even though the Laws swirling around Jack reached four types and each was very powerful, Jonathan remained unconcerned.
For a cultivator at the peak of the Ninth Heavens, each Law mobilized during combat consumed ten times the True Strength and Soul Will of a king-level cultivator, and thus, he was certain Jack couldn’t sustain peak output for long.
However, Jack’s talent was too terrifying, giving even Jonathan a covetous admiration for such a prodigy.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 998 420 Battle Demon God . Dragon Battle of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 998: Chapter 420 Battle Demon God . Dragon, Battle of Fate_2 Chapter 998: Chapter 420 Battle Demon God . Dragon, Battle of Fate_2 Regarding Jonathan Walker’s recruitment, Jack Clark dismissed it indifferently, “Sorry, I’m not interested in being a traitor who hides and doesn’t even dare to show his true face.”
Jack had once seen information about Jonathan Walker, but his appearance and physique differed greatly from those of Left Saint before him, which was why he hadn’t thought of him immediately.
However, both Ilisa Zabel and Left Saint were avatars of a strong man from the Evil God Sect, with immeasurable cultivation levels, and they similarly hailed from South Sky Martial Height.
All signs pointed to that brilliant and dazzling traitor from the past.
In fact, this conflict was beyond both Jack and Jonathan’s expectations.
For example, Jonathan had not anticipated that among the cultivators and different races who entered this time, there would be a monster like Jack, whose exaggerated combat power could sweep through the entire relic.
Even those god-level war puppets with defenses comparable to a Mid-Mythical Stage, which stymied the higher-ups from the Divine Realm, could not withstand a few moves from him.
Under normal conditions, the young, strong men who came in this time simply couldn’t defeat those Mythical-level war puppets; they could only honestly gain inheritance by passing the tests of the relic.
So even if they moved at random, it would not affect Jonathan’s plan to refine the relic world. But Jack appeared unexpectedly.
Just a few moves were enough to blow up a Mythical-level war puppet, and if left unchecked, it likely wouldn’t take many days before these precious puppets would be destroyed by Jack.
Even at the Early Myth Stage, with combat power comparable to the defense of the Mid-Late Myth Stage and a massive frame, these war puppets were actually very precious, becoming one of any power’s trump cards.
Such as Number One, with the combat power of a Mythical King.
This was the reason Jonathan appeared; once he refined this world fragment and gained control rights, these Mythical-level war puppets would demonstrate even stronger power.
At the same time, including Jack, no one had thought that under the limitation of thirty moments of life, there would actually be a Mythical Peak powerhouse lying dormant within the inner world of the relic.
And just like that, by a twist of fate, Jack came face to face with this monster that had once dazzled the entire Cultivation World.
At this moment, both looking at each other, there seemed to be an inexplicable illusion of a new-old transition amidst a clash of time and space.
One was an Unparalleled Genius who shocked the Cultivation World more than a decade ago; the other was a present-day monster who suppressed an era, as if it were destined by fate for them to battle today.
Suddenly, both Jack and Jonathan sprang into action.
Two radiances pierced through Heaven and Earth, like a collision between a golden star and a gold-red Blood Sea World; the two instantly crashed into each other, and in an instant, a dazzling light shone through Heaven and Earth.
Because of the extreme speed, it wasn’t until then that the sonic booms that resulted from their instant movements burst forth, followed by a thunderous, earth-shattering explosion.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the collision of two Divine Realms, rings of golden-red shockwaves burst forth, sweeping across tens of kilometers, destroying everything in their path and causing the sky to collapse and the earth to split.
The terrifying fluctuations even caused the Relic World itself to shake slightly, and everyone involuntarily turned their eyes in that direction, faces showing astonishment and shock.
“What’s going on, how could there be a Mythical Peak existence here!”
“Those two strengths, so powerful!”
More than two thousand kilometers away, Jane Aiken also looked in the direction of the great battle with a serious expression.
Boom boom boom!! Golden Holy Light collided with blood-colored Gold Flame Thunderbolt, continuously causing energy explosions, while Jack, wielding his War Halberd, and Jonathan, frenetically dueled.
Their speeds reached an extent neither the eye nor the consciousness could follow; in an instant, thousands of moves burst forth, destroying everything.
Under the enhancement of his domain and Fourth Layer Boundary, the Black-gold battle halberd in Jack’s hands was exceedingly heavy, wrapped with blue and gold Law patterns; each sweep created vast areas of Dark Vacuum.
That was the Divine Power, Supreme Vacuum, with the characteristic to crush the very vacuum, and at this ultimate display of power, everything was blown up, including the Law Power swirling around Jonathan.
Meanwhile, Jonathan’s strength was even more astonishing, his Sacred Body shining with golden radiance contained terrifying power on par with a Mythical Giant Beast. His war spear was entwined with Higher-order Law, every move as if carrying the majesty of a realm of Holy Light.
Therefore, each heavy clash between the battle halberd and the war spear caused a terrifying Destructive Impact, shaking the Void and breaking space into Areas of Destruction.
Boom boom boom!! The intertwining gold and blood radiance in the Dark Void destroyed everything it passed.
Particularly when the Higher-order Law clashed, causing the sky to fall and the earth to sink, chunks of meteorites floating through the Void exploded, destroying everything within hundreds of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
Then, in Howard Lambert’s stunned gaze, the golden star and the blood-red Doomsday World continued to entwine, radiating dazzling light and fearsome energy fluctuations, gradually moving away.
This was the terrifying combat power of the Late Mythical Stage and Peak, where even the aftermath of a few breaths of a fight could obliterate everything within hundreds of kilometers.
If those king-level, demon king-level, and Heavenly King battlegrounds from the Heavenly Abyss Battle City’s great war had been on the ground, the mere aftermath would have been enough to cause immense casualties on both sides.
In the ‘Cosmic Void,’ with the Blood Sea Doomsday, Thunderstorm Domain, and Golden Flame Domain unfolding around him, Jack felt as though time itself had come to a halt with every swing of his War Halberd.
Or rather, it wasn’t time that had halted, but that his attack speed had become so fast that it surpassed the meaning of conventional time, causing this illusion.
This was a level of perception of time exclusive to life, a domain belonging to Mythical Kings. For example, the speed of attack and reaction displayed by Jonathan at this moment was no less than his.

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 999 420 Battle Demon God vs. Dragon Battle of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 999: Chapter 420 Battle Demon God vs. Dragon, Battle of Destiny_3 Chapter 999: Chapter 420 Battle Demon God vs. Dragon, Battle of Destiny_3 Boom, boom, boom!!
In an instant, Jack Clark swung his War Halberd to exchange over a thousand moves with Jonathan Walker. With each collision between the War Halberd and the golden spear, a terrifying rebound force came through.
This force was further divided into nineteen layers, each layer doubling in power and shaking Jack’s arm muscles continuously as his Qi Blood boiled.
At the same time, the endless golden light erupting with each exchange was like billions of golden steel needles piercing through everything, penetrating layer by layer the Boundary Wall that surrounded Jack.
But when the golden law lights penetrated the Fourfold Boundary Walls, they were blocked by a resilient and strong barrier, unshaken.
Physical Divine Power Absolute Barrier.
Although Jack’s pressure and limit of Power Explosion could only compare to the late period of the Mythical Realm, the outcome of a battle isn’t always determined by who has a higher realm.
Otherwise, there wouldn’t be Combat Techniques or fights, and everyone would just measure up their realms upon meeting.
With the support of three Great Divine Powers and the four Higher-order Rules, even when facing Jonathan, who was at the Mythical Peak, Jack could still withstand firmly, though he was slightly disadvantaged.
However, Jonathan’s strength was indeed terrifying, as he suppressed Jack with just a golden spear. In merely a few minutes, they spanned over three thousand kilometers.
But as the fight went on and he felt that Jack was maintaining his peak condition at all times, Jonathan, who originally planned to drag out the fight until Jack could no longer bear the backlash of the laws, frowned and the radiance intensified in his hand.
Boom! A Golden Sun exploded in the Void, and under the impact of the Furious Power, Jack retreated in response, getting blasted tens of kilometers away.
In the distance, Jonathan, standing in the midst of the Golden Divine Realm with his spear raised high, was wrapped in the dazzling golden law, and he said with a cold, deep voice, “Holy Light Judgment!”
Boom!
Above Jack, the Void twisted as a giant golden vortex emerged, and from the center of the vortex, a huge sword over three thousand meters long descended from the sky, like a sword meant to end all existence.
Before the terrifying huge sword even touched down, the asteroids within a range of tens of kilometers below shattered into pieces, splitting even the Void in two.
As the huge sword fell from the sky at a terrifying speed, a Law Power involving cause and effect locked onto Jack.
There was no avoiding or escaping this strike, only a head-on clash. This was the particular trait of Jonathan’s Law Combat Skill.
Jack let out a long howl, and from within his dazzling domain, a thousand-meter-long Purple-red War Halberd emerged, entwined with Thunder and flames, piercing the sky to meet the huge sword.
Boom!
Gold and purple light exploded, forming a Destructive Shockwave that swept across tens of kilometers. As it passed, chunks of floating asteroids exploded, creating a vacuum area several tens of kilometers wide.
In the center of the near-Chaotic explosion, where Furious Energies tumbled, Jack’s figure was revealed.
At that moment, the Sea of Blood Doomsday Domain surrounding Jack had dimmed significantly, and there was a narrow crack in the Dragon Scales and Phoenix Feathers Battle Armor on his chest, appearing somewhat ragged.
Jack slowly said, “It seems I’ve been a bit too presumptuous.”
The outbreak of the late period of the Myth Realm still fell short against a strong man from the Mythical Peak, not to mention one who had once been a Monster Genius.
The Law Power that had dissipated from that sword strike just now still managed to slice through his Absolute Barrier Defense, leaving a sword mark on his chest armor.
Amidst the golden light, Jonathan, who seemed like a holy being descending, held his Golden Battle Spear and said indifferently, “Jack Clark, your strength is indeed formidable, but the gap between Major Realms can’t be bridged by talent alone.”
“Mortal remains mortal, while a deity is a deity. A brief surge of strength comparable to the late period of the Myth Realm doesn’t mean you truly possess the power of that realm.”
Jack nodded slowly, “You’re right. Under normal conditions, it is indeed very difficult to break through the gap in the Major Realms, but I am an exception to the rule.”
Boom!
A tangible Blood Flame ignited around Jack, instantly covering his entire body in radiant light, emitting an immense, purely masculine Qi Blood that pierced through the Cloud Sky.
Roar!
Amidst the Void, a domineering Dragon Roar could be faintly heard as Jack’s body was covered in black and red Dragon Scales under the burning blood-colored flames. Behind him, a hundred-meter-long slender Dragon Tail appeared.
At the same time, dragon horns emerged from the splitting helmet, black spikes grew at the joints of his hands, and his hands became like claws, resembling a humanoid Demon Dragon.
Meanwhile, the Flame Domain, Thunderstorm Domain, and the Blood Sea Doomsday Hell that surrounded him all retracted and merged into his body, instantly spreading a Terrifying Aura that was indescribable.
He was like a Horrific Life form from ancient times, dominating over billions of beings and even deities, Overbearing, aggressive, and ferocious.
Just by standing there, Jack’s uncontrollable strength distorted everything around him, breaking space and devouring light, like a humanoid Black Hole.
His True Body’s strongest form, the Battle Demon God. Dragon.

﻿Chapter 1000: Chapter 421 World Smelting, Summoning the Thunderflame Behemoth Again Chapter 1000: Chapter 421 World Smelting, Summoning the Thunderflame Behemoth Again The Demon God in its Dragon Form and the Crimson Form of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon bear some resemblance, igniting the Demon God’s origin to activate the strength of ‘dragon’ in the flesh and enter an extreme state.
In this state, all strength merges with the flesh, with no distinction between laws and domains, only the sheer power of destruction.
At this moment, the hundred-meter-tall Jack Clark stood in the Void, his invisible terrifying power distorting the space for kilometers around, causing the Void to collapse and form a dark area.
Such a terrifying presence made Jonathan Walker’s gaze sharpen as he felt solemn, “Is this the source of the danger I sensed before?”
And on a floating meteorite hundreds of kilometers away, Eddy Keller’s face was full of shock: “This guy, he’s become so powerful!”
Wrapped in blood-colored flames, Jack Clark held his War Halberd, feeling the nearly Destroy Heaven and Earth ultimate strength within his body and couldn’t help but look towards the distant Jonathan Walker, standing in his Golden Divine Realm, with a deep voice.
“Let’s go again,” he said.
Boom!
The Void shattered, and the extreme form of Jack Clark turned into a red light, leaving behind the sound of the space squelching and breaking under the unbearable strain wherever he passed.
At the instant Jack Clark made his move, Jonathan Walker’s cold voice echoed through the Void: “I am the Lord of Holy Light, and I will grant equality to all beings. Heaven’s Arrival.”
The Void vibrated instantly, and kilometer-high Golden Crystal Walls rose around Jonathan Walker, one after another, exuding an unbreakable will.
The difference between a Mythical King and a Heavenly King lies in the integration of one’s understood laws into their limit grand accomplishment, forming an exclusive Laws World.
In the deployed Laws World, only the cultivator’s laws exist, even the power of the Heavenly Earth Law is suppressed, and the cultivator is the only god.
This Laws World, unlike the Plane World opened by Jack Clark, operates at a higher dimension between illusion and reality, and is the source of power for kings and Heavenly Kings.
And Jonathan Walker, who had reached the Mythical Peak, had already begun to condense his Laws World.
Boom boom boom! The War Halberd, entwined with Blood Flame, shattered layer upon layer of the several tens of meters thick Golden Walls, turning them into a shower of golden energy that dissipated, powerful as a force of nature.
The Golden Holy Light Law Power swirling around him couldn’t even get close to Jack Clark and was directly shattered by the invisible terrifying power he emitted.
With an Unrivaled Domination, Jonathan Walker’s gaze sharpened, golden War Spear in hand with dragon-shaped streams of energy circling it, and behind him, a kingdom seemed to emerge faintly.
Boom! The War Halberd, wrapped in blood-colored flames, clashed again with the golden War Spear, instantly shattering the space around it, tearing apart Black Cracks spreading in all directions.
The terrifying Destructive Impact formed a circular shockwave, shattering the Golden Holy Light domain that spanned thousands of kilometers, releasing a dazzling light so bright that from afar, it looked like the cosmic starry sky was exploding in a supernova.
Bang bang bang! Continental blocks within tens of kilometers under the golden shockwave exploded.
This scene shocked Eddy Keller from afar, and then his expression drastically changed: “Not good.” He saw two intertwined lights approaching at a terrifying speed a hundred kilometers away.
Everything in their path was destroyed, forming a raging area tens of kilometers wide and extending for thousands of kilometers.
Boom!
Eddy Keller was sent flying by the invisible impact, his meteorite exploding beneath him, and he turned into a white Divine Dragon desperately flying away, spurting blood from his mouth.
Too perverse, he can’t even block the aftermath.
In his Battle Demon God. Dragon Form, Jack Clark’s physical strength became extremely terrifying; at this moment, even when facing Jonathan Walker at the Mythical Peak, he was not at a disadvantage.
The Divine Power Supreme Vacuum granted him the ultimate destructive strength, while the defensive Divine Power of Absolute Barrier allowed him to ignore all explosion impacts.
Additionally, with the Heaven-walking Divine Steps that reached the ultimate speed, even in his ‘Dragon’ form and limited to a True Body fight, Jack Clark virtually had no weak points.
Boom! In the Void, a continental block with a diameter of hundreds of kilometers exploded, and in the center of the shattered block, golden black light intertwined, clashing hard repeatedly and unleashing a horrifying Destructive Impact.
In just over ten minutes, the two beams of light covered tens of thousands of kilometers.
Such a terrifying scene left Joshua Welan and Sid Hawk shocked, daring not approach, hastily avoiding the area upon sensing those two fearsome forces.
“Junior Clark’s strength has increased again,” Joshua Welan remarked, standing on a meteorite, marveling at the hundreds of kilometers away radiating light, also pleased that his junior had made such a friend.
In the Cosmic Void, a young man with a third eye on his forehead had a solemn expression: “Such a terrifying member of the Human Race, it’s good that I didn’t confront him at that time. And where did that Mythical Peak strong man come from?”
This question was not only on the mind of the three-eyed young man, but other different races, including Sid Hawk, were also astonished, unclear how this relic’s Inner World suddenly produced a Mythical Peak strong man.
Such a level of a strong man, if harboring malice towards them, could nearly annihilate everyone except Jack Clark in a surprise attack and without giving them any chance to resist.
And while Sid Hawk and the others felt the gravity of the sudden Mythical Peak battle, Jonathan Walker grew increasingly grim as he fought because Jack Clark’s strength appeared to be infinite.
Although Jonathan Walker did not understand the Cultivation Methods of Jack Clark in his extreme explosive state, he knew that such bursts came with great burdens.
Not just True Strength and energy, but also the will of the spirit that consumes during the burning of the origin, including the soul power expended in the continued transformation of Law Power to maintain the burst.

﻿Chapter 1001: Chapter 421 World Smelting, Summoning the Thunderflame Behemoth Again_2 Chapter 1001: Chapter 421 World Smelting, Summoning the Thunderflame Behemoth Again_2 “`
The burst of strength fueled by burning one’s true blood origin should be strong, yet short-lived, but Jack Clark not only persisted, he also maintained peak condition throughout, completely defying the rules.
Almost a thousand kilometers in diameter and ten thousand meters high, the Stone Gate stood tall. Above the continental block where Jack Clark and the others had once descended, golden light shimmered as if a Great Sun was descending from the sky.
Boom boom!! Two mountain peaks, separated by over a dozen kilometers, collapsed, hurling countless rocks mixed with magma in all directions, amid a rolling cloud of smoke and dust of astonishing momentum.
Above the collapsing mountain peaks stood a hundred-meter-tall figure with three faces and six arms, whose body was covered with black-red dragon scales—Jack Clark, holding a halberd, with blood-colored flames burning on his body, exuding a terrifying aura that seemed to crush the Void and distort space.
The Earth below even vibrated under the immense pressure of his presence, seeming unable to bear his existence.
In the distance, on the mountainside of another collapsing peak, Jonathan Walker was surrounded by endless golden light. The golden war spear in his hand had broken, leaving only half, and cracks had also appeared on one side of his Sacred Body.
The cracks emitted golden light, slowly dispelling the golden flames and the power of the Blue Thunder enshrouded around it.
Looking at the demon god standing in the distance, with his halberd and an overpowering aura, Jonathan Walker spoke with a cold expression and a deep voice, “Your strength has far exceeded my expectations.”
“Who would have thought that, after more than a decade, the Human Federation would produce such a monstrous genius? To say there was none like you before, and there will be none after, is no overstatement,” he added.
In the face of Jonathan Walker’s praise, Jack Clark’s expression remained indifferent, with his voice carrying a dragon’s roar and growl: “You are also very strong, worthy of the genius who once shook the Federal Cultivation World. To have such terrifying strength in just an Avatar.”
Jonathan Walker’s eyes narrowed slightly: “You actually guessed that I am also but an Avatar.”
Jack Clark spoke indifferently: “Does that even need guessing? Given your talent, mastering the Ninth Heavens within a year and creating a Top-tier Secret Manual, how could your strength be just at the peak of Myth after more than a decade?”
Seeing that Jack Clark’s aura hadn’t slipped in the slightest by now, Jonathan Walker sighed lightly, “It seems I must leave this place sooner than expected.”
As he spoke, a special power began to spread from Jonathan Walker, connecting to the depths of the Void.
Boom!
A tremor came from deep within the Relic World, and immediately the entire Inner World of the ruins began to shake, the floating meteorites at the edges of the Void starting to disintegrate.
Boom boom boom!!
Inside the Inner World of the ruins, fourteen stone statues over two thousand meters tall, along with thirty-seven statues over a thousand meters tall—scattered across various locations—all shook violently.
Around these statues, space distorted, and under the influence of an Invisible Power, spatial jumps occurred, and they suddenly appeared around Jonathan Walker, encircling him like towering mountains.
Above the Void of the Firmament, a stream of Green Light cascaded down, covering Jonathan Walker. Under the radiance of the Green Light, Jonathan Walker’s aura changed, becoming like the lofty and supremely authoritative Heavenly Dao.
Cold and majestic.
At the same time, under the illumination of the Green Light, the fifty-one war puppets—comparable to the early stages of Myth and the Ninth Heavens—seemed to come alive, their eyes lighting up abruptly.
All the runes on the war puppets’ bodies began to shine, responding to each other, forming a formation that spanned hundreds of kilometers. Within the formation, countless black mists appeared out of thin air.
As the black mists engulfed all the war puppets, suddenly a chilling, gloomy, and terrifying aura spread, and the whole world seemed to darken.
Whoosh whoosh!!
Raging winds howled between heaven and earth; projections of fourteen three-thousand-meter-tall black banners appeared, flapping wildly in the wind and rolling up the black mist, giving the stone statues standing in the mist an oppressive feeling.
All of these changes happened in an instant.
At this moment, Jonathan Walker’s aura was immensely vast and majestic, transcending Mythical kings and suffusing Heaven and Earth, covering the entire Inner World of the ruins, below which was the Earth shrouded in rolling black mists.
At this instant, everyone was shocked as they looked towards the center of the Relic Gate, in disbelief.
“Main God-level Divine Might, how is that possible! How could an existence of such level enter this Relic?”
Standing atop a structure within the ruins, Sid Hawk wore a grave expression: “This presence… it’s that of the expert who was fighting Jack Clark earlier. This is troublesome, very troublesome!”
“`
Because the aura sensed from a distance was too powerful and terrifying, no one dared to approach the entrance gate of the relic located on the floating continent.
Including Sid Hawk and others, although they were somewhat worried about Jack Clark’s situation, they also dared not come close.
Facing a battle of Mythical Peak or even Heavenly King Level, their approach would not only be of no help but they could not even withstand the aftermath and would become a burden to Jack Clark.
Compared to the concerns of Sid Hawk and the others, many from different races had cold smiles on their faces because they knew that the human with an exceptional talent was doomed.
So what if he had the battle strength of Mythical Peak in the late period of the Ninth Heavens? Facing a terrifying being at the Main God-level (Heavenly King), he was no match at all.
Especially since the Ninth Heaven Expert had not yet condensed a Rule True Body and did not have the characteristic of being undying and indestructible, he might be killed by a single hit from that terrifying presence.
But after the cold smiles, those few remaining members of different races not assimilated by the Holy Light showed concern and gravity on their faces again.
No one knew what that Main God-level existence would do after killing the human.
At the Black Stone Gate towering ten thousand meters away, Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath. Even his expression became serious at this moment, not expecting Jonathan Walker to have this move up his sleeve.
Above the Firmament, Jonathan Walker, enveloped in a green light, had a cold expression as he looked towards the distant three-faced six-armed Jack Clark, his eyes filled with icy coldness and murderous intent.
Because of Jack Clark’s great strength, he had to start refining this World Fragment earlier than planned, costing him greatly.
At the moment, only Jonathan Walker perceived that at the edge of the Relic World, roughly the size of more than a dozen Blue Star, several cracks were spurting ‘energy’ into the deep Void as if a balloon had deflated.
This energy was the Laws’ Origin of this world, and every bit of its loss would cause an indelible damage to it, reducing the strength of the world.
During the years spent in this relic, most of Jonathan Walker’s time had been devoted to refining the World Origin and repairing the crystalline barrier at the edges of this fragment of the world.
Beyond that, at each node, he used Mythical-level War Puppets as nodes, condensing the Great Array Inheritance obtained from deep within this relic.
Originally everything was proceeding very smoothly, and in just a few more months once he had refined the Inner World of an Ancient Supreme Being and fused it with the Holy Light Rules, he would be able to make a breakthrough to the Heavenly King Level in one fell swoop.
By then, with nearly twenty Mythical-level War Puppets forming the All-Heaven Demon Flag formation, his battle strength would become extremely terrifying, far stronger than an average Heavenly King.
But now…
As he thought this, Jonathan Walker’s slight fondness for the genius Jack Clark, born of admiration, disappeared in an instant, leaving only icy killing intent as he spoke coldly.
“Let me escort you on your final journey.”
Speaking, a pair of golden eye shadows tens of thousands of meters large slowly emerged behind Jonathan Walker, instantly engulfing Jack Clark with a strong aura of death.
Jack Clark looked up at the white-clothed youth above the Firmanent, who seemed like the ‘Heavenly Dao,’ and at those golden eyes emitting terrifying power, and slowly said, “Don’t think you’re the only one with a trump card.”
Boom!
Blue runes burst from the back of Jack Clark’s left hand, turning into endless chains of blue rune sequences that encircled him, instantly forming a Summoning Altar covering a diameter of a thousand meters.
The moment the altar formed, it connected with a horrific creature in a distant region, and immediately a world-shaking, violent roar echoed between heaven and earth.
Roar!
Amid the roaring, the altar’s light shimmered, and a ferocious Black-red Giant Claw thundered out, followed by a vast and mighty Black-red Dragon Head with pairs of red feather horns burning with Golden-White flames on both sides.
Under Jonathan Walker’s serious gaze, a shadow of a colossal Black-red Beast that was a thousand meters long, dragon-like but not a dragon, rose up from behind Jack Clark.
This time, it was the power projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which was currently in a state of hibernation. Summoning the real body would interrupt its transformation.
But even a projection with only thirty percent of its strength was terrifyingly shocking. Upon its arrival, an aura of domineering Predatory Primordial and Myth-devouring ferocity permeated the entire inner world of the relic, causing everyone to instinctively feel palpitations, panic, and unease.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1002: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter) Chapter 1002: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter) Atop the Time-Space Summoning Altar, a black-red Colossal Beast, a kilometer long and over five hundred meters tall as it stood upright, towered above everything.
The beast bore the destruction of black, the vajra gold, and the purple of corrosion, among the halos of eight different Law Radiance, exuding a Terrifying Aura that seemed to compress the heavens and the earth.
With the interweaving of the eight kinds of Law Power, a Law Divine Domain spanning ten kilometers in radius formed around the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon at its center.
Within this area, everything else was repelled and suppressed, leaving only the circulation of the eight Higher-order Laws’ strength, as if a realm of laws had descended.
This was the terror of a Heavenly Tier life form, and even though the growth level of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was only at the Mid-Mythical Stage, it still displayed a fearsome might comparable to that of an initial stage Heavenly King.
This was still due to the fact that it wasn’t the strongest True Body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon that had descended, but merely a Power Projection, otherwise, if it had included the physical strength, it could have been at least as powerful as an expert in the mid period of Heavenly Kings with thirty percent of true strength.
However, as soon as the Avatar of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon descended, the transparent marks on Jack Clark’s left arm emerged, and the corrosion from time deepened bit by bit, which Jack had already anticipated.
“Impossible, eight Higher-order Laws!”
Far above in the firmament, Jonathan Walker, as if he were the embodiment of Heavenly Dao, showed shock on his face for the first time, watching the Law Radiance wrapping around the colossal beast with disbelief.
From the emergence of the giant golden eyes thousands of meters behind Jonathan Walker to Jack Clark activating the Time-Space Summoning Altar, all these events transpired in an instant.
Real battles are not turn-based, allowing you time to react. Therefore, these trump cards as ultimate moves are Instantaneous Explosions, with no preparatory actions.
But at this moment, Jonathan Walker was struck dumb, because that beast was unreservedly more powerful than the rules allowed.
Eight Higher-order Laws, completely shattering his knowledge and understanding.
It must be known that whether they were human cultivators, demon kings from The Purgatory Family, or those deities from the Divine Gods Alliance, only a minority had grasped the Higher-order Laws.
Even he had only mastered the Higher-order Law of Holy Light, and even so, his battle strength was already among the strongest in his tier.
Being a Mythical-level existence, the laws were incredibly powerful, but there were limits, and over the years, the Human Alliance had obtained detailed data through numerous tests.
For example, the difference in True Body Strength between late-stage ninth heaven experts and ninth heaven peak quasi-mythical beings was between one to five times, including the might of True Strength Bursts.
The gap between the True Body of a late-stage ninth heaven expert and a Mythical King was ten times at the base level.
This tenfold difference refers not only to the strength of Rule True Bodies but also the containment of Law Divine Power, and the gap in might between Law Divine Power and True Strength—all at tenfold.
This testing did not even include the additional features of the comprehended laws.
For instance, in addition to the law power of the Law of Fire being ten times more powerful than that of a late ninth heaven cultivator, it also contained the ultimate heat and explosive combustion.
Furthermore, with the activation of a kilometer-wide Law Domain for suppression, a complete crushing dominance was formed, hence the saying, “Below the Mythical, all beings are mere ants.”
And these are just the Lower Laws; the Middle Laws provide a fundamental boost of twelve times to True Body and Law Divine Power, while the Higher-order Laws by fifteen times.
While the difference between Lower and Higher-order might seem a mere fivefold, that gap widens significantly when advancements in comprehending the laws are taken into account, both in minor and grand accomplishment stages, further amplifying the True Body and Divine Power.
For example, when a Mid-Mythical being reaches minor accomplishment in a law, their True Body and Divine Power receive a transformational increase of 1.5 times, and upon grand accomplishment, 2 times—and these increases, while not outrageous on their own, become frightening when applied to a tenfold or twentyfold base.
This means the disparity is substantial, as this increase applies across the board, including True Body Strength, Divine Power capacity, Divine Power might, and domain strength.
The basic domain suppression range of a Lower Law is one kilometer, while for Middle Laws it is two kilometers, and for Higher-order Laws, it’s three kilometers, which becomes six kilometers when a Higher-order Law reaches grand accomplishment.
Beyond that, when a king burns their Origin, the resulting increase in might varies greatly depending on the strength of their foundation.
This is merely the difference between individual laws. When someone condenses and understands a second or third law, their Law True Body and the might of Law Divine Power, tempered by multiple laws, also become greater.
Understanding an additional Lower Law increases the True Body Strength and Divine Power might by an additional fold on the existing base, Middle Laws by two folds, and Higher-order Laws by three folds.
Therefore, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon possessing eight Higher-order Laws had its Giant Beast True Body Base Power at fifteen plus twenty-one, thirty-six times that of the late-stage nine heavens.
With the Mid-Mythical increase of 1.5 times, it reached fifty-four times, and this was just the base increase, not counting the additional characteristics of the eight laws’ Divine Might. It’s imaginable how terrifying that could be.
This was the reason for Jonathan Walker’s shock.
Eight Higher-order Laws—even with his monstrous talent, he had not comprehended that many, and even if the talent was sufficient, the soul’s foundation could not bear it.
Such a frightening number of Higher-order Laws could allow even an Early Myth to confront the early stage of a Heavenly King.
Moreover, these increases in battle strength are backed by the fact that Higher-order Laws embody completion and offer a much faster comprehension and advancement speed than Lower or Middle Laws.
Yet it was a Giant Beast, branded for their low wisdom and known for treading the path of physical Evolution, that had mastered these eight Higher-order Laws.
At this moment, Jonathan Walker felt that either he had gone mad or the world itself had gone crazy, for how else could such a heaven-defying, rule-breaking Colossal Beast appear?
“Impossible! It’s all illusory.”
A cold and harsh light shone in Jonathan Walker’s eyes. The radiance of the golden eyes behind him intensified, and vague outlines of grand structures emerged in the sky above, while the Void echoed with the sacred chant, praising Eternity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 1003 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1003: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_2 Chapter 1003: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_2 Boom!
In that palace that seemed as real as the heavens, a grand figure materialized, waving a hand to project a golden long spear that measured thousands of kilometers in length.
The long spear, as if tangible, bore exquisite patterns with nine circles of golden halos swirling around it, emitting a terrifying power.
Boom, boom, boom!! The space beneath the golden spear shattered like glass, forming black cracks that spread across the firmament, as if doomsday had arrived, striking terror into all who witnessed it.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the golden long spear neared the five-kilometer range of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, it collided with the Law Domains woven from eight Higher-order Laws, unleashing a horrific energy impact.
However, this attack, infused with divine power from Jonathan Walker’s golden eyes, was terrifyingly potent, and it pierced through everything with the unstoppable force of a thunderous decree, even amidst the halo of eight Higher-order Laws.
Boom! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon reached out with its right claw, the gold of Vajra and the grey hues of Chaotic Dark Power swirling on it while simultaneously being intertwined with the black lightning of the Destruction Law, the blue-black Thunder, and the Golden Flame and purple corrosion of three other Laws.
Entwined with the power of five Higher-order Laws, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon extended its claw, emitting a colorful halo, eradicating space as it went, catching the golden long spear.
In that instant, a hush fell between heaven and earth, followed by an explosive burst of golden light.
Boom!
A blinding explosion echoed through heaven and earth, the entire world shaking as the lands collapsed under the ferocious impact, cracks spreading for hundreds of kilometers.
In that moment, nearly half of the floating continent was obliterated, countless boulders rolling about, drifting into the depths of the dark void under the onslaught of the Destructive Impact.
And in the moment the golden long spear shattered, waves of golden light burst forth, carrying fearsome will and sharp strength, inundating the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon like a destructive golden torrent.
Under the golden thunderous onslaught that obliterated the surface space, the black-red Colossal Beast remained immovable, exuding an unshakable Terrifying Aura.
Immuned to the damage of Law energy by the Chaotic Dark Power, protected by the indestructible intent of the Vajra Law, and with a body forged from the Destruction Law, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s Defense had become terrifyingly formidable.
And these were the unique powers conferred by the Laws, each Higher-order Law representing an aspect of ultimate strength.
The horrific explosion lasted for minutes, but when the golden torrent finally subsided, it revealed the unharmed black-red Colossal Beast and beneath it, Jack Clark standing proudly on the altar.
And below Jack was the endless Dark Void, the floating continent with a diameter of several hundred kilometers, half destroyed by the aftershocks of that devastating blow.
All that remained were tens of War Puppets standing firm on the other side, shrouded in spreading black mist.
Witnessing this scene, and standing amidst a green light like the embodiment of ‘Heavenly Dao,’ Jonathan Walker suppressed the shock in his heart and spoke slowly, his voice resounding with heaven and earth.
“I came into contact with the theories of cultivation at the age of ten, began formal cultivation at sixteen, and perfected my path in just three months, advancing a realm a month, reaching the Ninth Heavens within a year.”
“I originally thought that with my talent that had no precedent and my achievement of reaching the Mythical Realm in just one year and three months, I was the Child of Destiny favored by the Blue Star World’s luck.”
“But after meeting you today, I’ve realized that my previous thoughts might be wrong. You, perhaps, are the true Child of Destiny of this world’s era.”
“In the late period of the Nine Layers realm, yet you possess a battle strength comparable to the Mythical Peak and can summon such a powerful Avatar. Even I was not your equal back in the day.”
Jack Clark spoke indifferently, “If you once thought of yourself as the Child of Destiny favored by the luck of the Blue Star World, then why did you later betray the Human Race?”
Seemingly acknowledging Jack’s strength, Jonathan’s voice grew low, “I have never betrayed the Human Race. Back then, I merely separated a Purgatory True Demon aspect from myself.”
“It’s just that they feared I was influenced by the will of Purgatory and did not approve of my path, so they expelled me.”
“Jack Clark, haven’t you noticed the Blue Star is too small, insignificant and frail compared to the boundless mythical world inhabited by humans?”
“Not to mention the eternal, Primordial beings that hang above the firmament, just one Purgatory True Demon Clan is powerful enough to drive one to despair.”
“Had it not been for the Purgatory Family being entangled with two other mighty civilizations, humans would have already been annihilated.”
“That’s why, once I saw that their path could not save the Blue Star, I chose a different one. If I can break free, I alone could Suppress it all.”
Jonathan’s words caused Jack’s eyes to narrow slightly.
A Purgatory True Demon aspect separated, so besides Ilisa Zabel and the Left Saint, was there also a Left Demon Avatar?
Or to say, none of Ilisa, the Left Saint, or the Left Demon integrated into the Purgatory Family are Avatars, but all are Jonathan Walker’s True Body, three aspects from one?
Of course, these were just Jonathan’s side of the story; what actually happened back then was known only to them.
But regardless, Jonathan Walker was currently a traitor. That stance had been determined the moment he acted against Jack, and all this talk was likely just to buy time.
After all, the drawback of the Summoning Secret Skill is that the stronger the being summoned, the greater the cost.
These thoughts flashed through Jack’s mind in an instant, and then a cold smile appeared in his eyes as he stood defiantly on the Summoning Altar, his gaze icy as he looked at Jonathan Walker.
If it were the true body of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, he indeed could not withstand it for long, but a mere thirty percent Power Projection of its strength would give him enough time to annihilate Jonathan Walker.

﻿Chapter 1004: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_3 Chapter 1004: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon.
