Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_3 Moreover, this time Jack Clark summoned the power projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, not only to suppress Jonathan Walker’s Avatar, but Jack suddenly spread his six arms wide.
“Deification, fusion.”
Boom! A soul fluctuation burst forth from deep within Jack’s body, resonating with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon above his head, and in an instant, both emitted blinding White Light.
Roar! Enveloped in the divine White Light, the black-red Colossal Beast let out a world-shaking bellow, its massive form pouncing onto Jack’s hundred-meter-tall figure.
Boom! In that instant, a terror-inducing aura erupted, the entire relic’s Inner World began to shake.
Above the Firmament, streaks of White Light appeared out of nowhere, illuminating half of the world as everyone gaped in the direction of the distant spectacle.
Under that indescribable Terrifying Aura, members of different races instinctively fell to their knees, a palpable dread pervading their hearts as they trembled in panic.
“Damn it, I can’t kneel, I mustn’t kneel,” Eddy Keller’s expression was frantic. In the instant his body instinctively weakened and was about to kneel, he forcefully suppressed the fear in his heart and collapsed to the side instead.
Bang!
Eddy Keller, dressed in white, lay on the ground with a smile on his face because he hadn’t knelt down.
At this moment, it wasn’t just Eddy Keller. Howard Lambert, Joshua Welan, Ida Carroll, and other known geniuses and monsters, all flipped over at the moment they were about to kneel. Some lay flat on their backs on the ground, others fell straight down.
Those flying in the Void simply floated limply.
At that moment, only Sid Hawk, emanating fearsome Fist Intent, Jane Aiken circled by four grand-accomplishment-extreme Sword Intents that transformed into four Divine Swords hanging in each cardinal direction, and a Third-Eyed young man whose brows flickered with Divine Light did not kneel.
All three sat cross-legged, straining against that primal fear of submission that came from the depths of their being, their faces full of shock.
It was horrifying. The mere aura was so dreadful, and this was across thousands of kilometers of separation.
In that moment, not only Jane Aiken and the others, even Jonathan Walker, who was directly facing the Deification transformation, showed a look of shock, and his spirit fluctuated briefly, withdrawing from the state of Heavenly Dao.
“How is this possible! How can you possibly still become stronger! What kind of Secret Skill or Divine Power is this?!”
Feeling the increasingly terrifying aura from a distance, Jonathan Walker had the insane notion that this world had gone mad.
He could accept that a Nine-fold Peak cultivator could summon a projection of a beast comparable to an early-stage Heavenly King, confident that by relying on the World’s Power and burning his Origin he could fight and endure against Jack Clark.
But it was inconceivable that this monster still had means to enhance his strength, with seemingly endless trump cards that shocked people every time.
Feeling the ever-increasing terrifying aura from a distance, Jonathan Walker’s eyes sharpened, knowing he could not allow Jack Clark to continue breaking through, or else he would not only fail to assimilate this world and step into the Realm of Heavenly Kings, but could even fall right here.
Boom! An immensely vast aura burst from Jonathan Walker, filling Heaven and Earth as if his words were an imperative Decree that resounded across the world: “War, descend.”
Boom!
The Void at the edge of the Relic World collapsed, and as the world shattered, a terrifying power descended, enhancing the War Puppets circling beneath Jonathan Walker.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Empowered by the World’s Power, each of the War Puppets shrouded in black mist swelled massively in size, the weakest growing to nearly two thousand meters tall, with the tallest nearing three thousand.
In an instant, thirty-seven War Puppets emitted energy fluctuations of the Nine-fold Peak, while fourteen puppets at the early-phase of Myth displayed strength close to the Mythical Peak.
Such astonishing enhancement was terrifying, and the price was widespread world fracturing.
Especially when these fifty-one War Puppets, temporarily enhanced by more than tenfold in strength, formed the All-Heaven Demon Flag formation, endless Dark Mist erupted, engulfing the Void.
The surging Dark Mist flooded everything like a tide. Fourteen flags, now grown to ten thousand meters tall, crackled fiercely, their rolling dark mist even enshrouding Jonathan Walker.
The chilling, gloomy Dark Mist fused with Jonathan Walker, who radiated Holy Light and golden Radiance. Instantly, the entire world darkened, leaving only the towering silhouette of three thousand meters high to emerge.
Standing atop the endless Dark Mist covered in a cloak of green radiance, Jonathan Walker’s figure dazzled with Infinite Light. With a gentle press of his palm towards Jack Clark, he chanted solemnly,
“I am the lord of the Holy Light and of the War of Darkness; I will dominate all of time—Suppress!”
Boom! In an instant, a formidable force descended, compressing the space filled with endless White Light and spanning over a dozen kilometers into solid matter.
Crackle Crackle! Under the terrifying Divine Might, the space where Jack was located began to shrink rapidly, from over a dozen kilometers to ten, and then to eight kilometers…
As the being who had absorbed most of the Origin of this World Fragment, Jonathan Walker was the ‘Heaven’ of this world, able to summon the Power of Heaven and Earth to suppress everything with a single thought.
Even space itself could be affected and controlled, shifting colors with a single thought.
But the cost was consuming more of the World’s Power, leading to the world crumbling continuously.
Originally, once he completed the last step, finding the Heart of the World and merging with it, followed by restoring the broken crystalline barrier, summoning the World’s Power would not have caused catastrophic damage.
But all of this was disrupted by the emergence of Jack Clark.
Thinking of this, Jonathan Walker’s gaze grew even colder, the power in his hands strengthening, forcibly compressing Jack’s space from thirteen kilometers to one.
But just as the space was about to be completely sealed, suddenly, all the unending streaks of White Light disappeared, revealing a figure with a human body but dragon horns and a Dragon Tail, radiating dazzling White Light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 1005 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1005: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_4 Chapter 1005: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_4 At this moment, Jack Clark, having merged his human form with the “Thunderflame Emperor Dragon” in a godlike transformation, had his ‘realm’ leap from the late period of the Ninth Heavens straight to the early stages of the Heavenly King.
The ‘realm’ of another at the early stages of the Heavenly King was radiating an indescribable aura of terrifying power, making even Jonathan Walker feel its solemnity.
With a casual swing of his Black-gold Battle Halberd, now a mere eighty meters after being compressed to one kilometer, Jack Clark caused the surrounding space—which had been compressed many times over—to violently shatter and even obliterate, forming a dark and chaotic area with a radius of tens of kilometers.
In the midst of the wild Spatial Storm, a thousand-meter-tall figure radiating dazzling White Light stepped forward, the Black-gold Battle Halberd in his hand also wrapped in White Light.
Without wasting words in his Godlike Form, Jack Clark’s figure flickered in an instant, silently crossing tens of kilometers, ignoring all obstacles and appearing in front of Jonathan Walker.
Beyond the perception of consciousness, the White Light-entwined War Halberd swept across. In an instant, the space, laws, and the World’s Power ahead were all annihilated, forming a continuously spreading black flat layer.
“I am the lord of this world!”
Jonathan Walker let out a long howl as he thrust his restored golden War spear, wrapped in Higher-order Law-comparable black smoke and Higher-order Law golden Holy Light.
Amplified by the World’s Power, the golden War spear, measuring over five thousand meters, emitted a dazzling Radiance, capable of piercing the world with its powerful might… Boom!
The moment the golden War spear touched the spreading black layer, it shattered under the White Light-entwined Halberd, followed by the destruction of half of Jonathan Walker’s True Body.
Boom! A terrifying explosion shook the heavens and the earth; half of the Void was devoured by darkness, creating a desolate Area of Destruction where only wild energy roared.
Roar roar roar!!
In an instant when half of Jonathan Walker’s True Body was obliterated by a single strike, fourteen War Puppets at the Mythical Peak level below let out angry roars. Holding a black Demon Banner, they advanced towards Jack Clark amid a sky filled with black smoke.
Amplified by the formation of the All-Heaven Demon Flag that was born for war, this strike was immensely fearsome. The Dark Demon aura wrapped around it even contained terrifying features that could erode the soul, strong enough to heavily injure early-stage Heavenly Kings.
Bang Bang Bang!!
Rows of Demon Banners reaching ten thousand meters, just as they neared a range of a thousand meters in front of Jack Clark, began to rupture under the white light formed by twelve different Higher-order Laws.
However, with the interference of the War Puppets, the half of Jonathan Walker that had been destroyed appeared hundreds of kilometers away in the form of golden light, reconsolidating.
“You think you can stop me with this.”
A deep voice vibrated through the Void as Jack Clark transformed into a white bolt of lightning, tearing through the war formation. In an instant, he landed among dozens of War Puppets.
Boom! Endless Divine Light erupted, shattering sizeable War Puppets one after another, like collapsing mountain peaks.
Then the ‘continental blocks,’ floating in the Void with a diameter of over a hundred kilometers and tens of kilometers thick, crumbled loudly, like exploding stars ejecting endless White Light and Scorching Magma.
In the midst of the terrifying explosion, Jack Clark, wielding his Halberd and radiating fearsome might, stepped out from the Void. His figure flashed, and he crossed hundreds of kilometers in a single step, appearing in front of Jonathan Walker.
At this time, under the flickering of enormous golden eyes thousands of meters behind him, Jonathan Walker raised one hand toward the sky, his gaze coldly fixed on Jack Clark as he spoke in an icy voice, “By my Decree, true Heaven’s Arrival.”
Boom! The entire world shook once more, the vast expanse of Void, comparable to over a dozen Blue Stars, collapsing by nearly half in an instant.
Meanwhile, above the heads of Jack Clark and Jonathan Walker, a massive, boundless city of White Jade appeared—majestic and exquisite—as if the legendary Heaven itself had manifested.
Boom!
The Void trembled, and the limitless phantom of the White Light Heaven’s Arrival enveloped both Jack Clark and Jonathan Walker. In an instant, the scene before Jack Clark changed, and he found himself in a square made of White Jade.
All around him, tens of thousands of figures stood at heights of a hundred to several hundred meters, each with a unique pair of light wings, all emanating a powerful Aura.
Meanwhile, Jonathan Walker, like a god of creation, stood at the edge of Heaven and Earth, lightly waving his hand toward this side. “Decree, Heaven’s Divine Punishment descends, kill.”
Boom Boom Boom!!
In an instant, endless Golden Sword Light slashed at Jack Clark from all directions, while huge swords thousands of meters long fell from the sky above like meteors.
Just as Jack Clark was engulfed by countless attacks, a low growl bearing the roar of a dragon echoed across the world: “Flashy nonsense!”
Boom!
Within the sea of golden light, a streak of White Light penetrated Heaven and Earth, exploding everything, and as the Halberd Skill that destroyed everything pierced through, it even penetrated Heaven itself, including Jonathan Walker’s True Body.
As the three-thousand-meter-long White Light Halberd Skill penetrated Jonathan Walker’s True Body, an endless outburst of White Strength erupted.
Boom!!
Under the radiance of a nuclear explosion from the Laws Mystery’s Great Sunburst, the entire Heaven was destroyed, the Void collapsed, forming a hundred-kilometer-wide Area of Destruction.
In the midst of the wild explosion of Radiance, Jack Clark, holding his Halberd, soared through the Void towards the distance, where Jonathan Walker was once again reconstituting his True Body by exhausting the World’s Power and the Origin of Laws.
However, having his True Body shattered twice in a row had weakened his Aura by a fifth, and the collapse of the entire relic’s Inner World accelerated even more.
With Jonathan Walker repeatedly pushing the limits by mobilizing the World’s Power for battle, the entire world was plunging into destruction.
Bang Bang Bang!!
In his Battle Demon God Emperor Dragon Form, Jack Clark’s combat strength rose to an indescribable level of terror, like a white light that shattered the consecutive layers of Spatial Barriers gathered by the World’s Power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - 1006 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1006: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_5 Chapter 1006: Chapter 422 The Fusion of Human and Dragon. Deification, Exploding the World (Long Chapter)_5 Under the illumination of the ice crystal-like shards of light filling the sky, the War Halberd swept across the air, shattering Jonathan Walker’s True Body once again with a perception that surpassed even consciousness and time.
The terrifying strike caused tens of kilometers of space to collapse, resulting in an explosion of the Void.
“It’s impossible for me to lose to you, ‘Time Stop’!” bellowed Jonathan Walker, who appeared over a thousand kilometers away, igniting the Laws’ Origin without any hesitation and mobilizing the World’s Power to interfere with time.
In an instant, a ring of golden light radiated across the whole world, bringing everything it touched to a halt.
Flames that were burning, chaotic streams of exploding energy, floating meteorites, and even the flowing Heavenly Energy were all congealed and motionless.
But in this world where even time was interfered with, Jack Clark, with a white flame that turned into white light burning on his body, slightly raised his head; his eyes with dark gold vertical pupils were cold, and his lips slightly parted.
Because time stood still, though Jack opened his mouth, no sound came out, but Jonathan Walker saw clearly what he was saying.
“Time, is ineffective against me.”
With Divine Steps in the Sky magnified to the extreme, Jack took a step forward, turned into a ray of white light, ignored all obstructions, and appeared in front of Jonathan Walker, bringing the War Halberd down with the momentum of Opening the Heavens.
Boom!
The golden war spear that Jonathan Walker had condensed in his hands, along with his True Body, was once again shattered by the blow, ripping a hundred kilometers-long pitch-black crack in the Void.
As Jonathan Walker exploded, the influence of time also vanished in an instant, and the different races kneeling on a meteorite several kilometers away revealed a look of despair on their faces.
Bang! The meteorite and the different races from the Ninth Heavens exploded in an instant, along with the Void, vanishing without a trace.
Boom boom boom!!
In front of the invincible Jack Clark, even Jonathan Walker, who seemed like the ‘Heavenly Dao’ at this moment, couldn’t withstand a single blow; his True Body was shattered time and again, repeatedly expending his Origin and the World’s Power to reform.
The power that destroyed everything, a defense that ignored all attacks, and the Speed Divine Power that transcended time and space.
At this moment, Jonathan Walker, who had no power to fight back, could only choose to keep running and delaying, to see if he could outlast until the moment when Jack’s strength was exhausted and the Summoning backlash occurred.
Everything they passed through was destroyed, matter vanished, and space collapsed into a chaotic Area of Destruction.
As the battle raged and intentionally spared the direction of the Human Race, some of the different races who couldn’t avoid in time or even sense the battle were wiped out by the devastating aftereffects of the destruction.
Boom boom boom!! As Jonathan Walker desperately mobilized the World’s Power time after time, the destruction within the entire relic’s Inner World intensified, and the Void at the edges constantly collapsed and shattered.
The terrible Great Destruction spread like contagion towards the central area, swiftly engulfing half of the Inner World as the violent Void devoured it; darkness passed over and the floating meteorites continuously crumbled and vanished.
At this moment, the entire world shook violently.
And just as Jonathan Walker’s True Body was shattered for the eleventh time, and two-thirds of the entire relic’s Inner World had collapsed, the green light enveloping Jonathan Walker suddenly vanished.
Instantly, his aura plummeted, dropping him directly from the Heavenly King Realm to the Mythical Peak, late period, mid period.
The sudden change caused Jonathan Walker’s face to drastically alter, and just then Jack Clark had once again traversed a thousand kilometers, appearing before him stepping on the light of time.
“Wait…”
Boom! Without pointless talk, under the strike of the War Halberd wrapped in white light, Jonathan Walker’s Rule True Body was completely shattered, and infinite white light erupted.
“How could I possibly die here…”
Beneath the erasing white Divine Light, the golden light in the sky continuously disintegrated, and amidst it, the reluctant screams of Jonathan Walker could faintly be heard.
He was the Child of Destiny favored by the luck of time on Blue Star, not yet having saved the world, not yet having broken the shackles to become one of the Primordial Stars hanging in the heavens.
He… how could he possibly fall!!
Within the chaos of the space-shattering streams of destruction, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, a thousand meters tall, with white flames burning on his body, emanating a terrifying Aura that shook the world.
In Jack’s eyes, the dark gold vertical pupils flickered with light, his gaze cold as he searched the heavens and the earth, ensuring not a single Remnant Soul of Jonathan Walker could escape, all being obliterated by the Deification powers.
After nearly three minutes, feeling that Jonathan Walker’s aura had completely disappeared, Jack slowly exhaled, his thought realm moving to dissolve the Summoning.
Instantly, the barely visible gloomy blue runes wrapped around Jack’s body under the white flames vanished, coalescing into streams of light converging on the back of his left hand.
And with the end of the Summoning, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which had merged with Jack in the form of an energy projection, also disappeared under the force of Space-Time causality, forcibly exiting the Godlike Form.
Immediately, the white flames on Jack’s body were extinguished, his form crackled as it shrank rapidly, and in the blink of an eye, he returned to the size of an ordinary person.
Thump!
Jack fell with a thundering crash, with the surrounding violent air currents trembling, his Aura weak to the extreme, his face pale, like a flame that could go out at any moment.
This Deification trial had nearly exhausted all of his Soul Power.
At the same time, the transparent traces representing the erosion of time nearly wrapped around his entire arm, emitting mysterious, obscure, and ominous Auras.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - 1007 423 The Trinity of Man God and Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1007: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter) Chapter 1007: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter) “`
Just as Jonathan Walker’s Rule True Body was utterly annihilated by Jack Clark’s final strike, extinguishing his Divine Soul in an instant, the seven different races within the relic’s Inner World and the Amos brothers all revealed a look of astonishment.
Thereafter, the ‘Person’ whose body had integrated the Holy Light Origin disguised as a strand of World Origin while refining God-level Resources, ignited a layer of white flame.
Under the scorching burn of that holy white flame, even the True Body of a Ninth Heaven Expert that could withstand a missile could not hold up; to say nothing of burning even more fiercely—energy, flesh and blood, and even the soul inside them were all fuel.
“Amos, what’s wrong with you?” dozens of kilometers away, Ida Carroll, rushing toward the center of the world, looked at the Amos brothers screaming in the white flames in the distance, her expression grave.
Only half of their true forms had been burned, and the brothers, whose souls were obliterated at the first instance, paid her no attention.
Beyond that, in the vast Divine Realm of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe behind the Divine Gods Alliance, more than ten cities filled with alien styles suddenly emitted screams of agony.
In these cities, tens of thousands of people from different races ignited white flames on their bodies.
Within those flames that emitted holiness, all turned to ashes and dissipated, whether ordinary Fourth Layer Heaven tribe members with innate talent or high-order strong men from the Seventh and Ninth Heavens.
The sudden change stirred immense agitation in these cities.
Furthermore, outside the Divine King City in the center of the Tri-Eye Divine Realm, on the Divine Mountain, a three-eyed young man from a grand palace complex that occupied half a mountainside shot up into the sky.
The white flames that burned on this Ninth Heaven Expert’s body had him crying out in despair as he flew up, “Save me, divine father, save me!”
Boom! Heavenly Energy obstructed the view, and from a temple in the distance, a beam of purple divine light soared into the sky, instantly bringing with it a Mythical Peak Aura, transforming into a colossal phantom.
Watching the three-eyed young man engulfed by the white flames in the high altitude, that God-level powerhouse’s expression turned cold, his third eye gleamed, and he sent out a beam of purple light.
In an instant, the world grew still; under that light beam that was several meters in diameter, everything solidified, including the Heavenly Energy and space, turning into crystal-like purple formations.
Yet, even as this Mythical Peak powerhouse exerted his Innate Divine Ability to freeze everything, he could only watch as the Ninth Heaven Expert burned to ashes.
The white Holy Light Flames completely disregarded his Divine Power.
This scene made the look of the strong man somewhat unsightly.
At this moment, from the depths of the Void, a terrible will rewarded, soon followed by a slow, solemn voice: “Useless, Kayla, it is a power that involves the rules of causality and the origin of Holy Light which not even I can reverse.”
“Now that the Holy Light is burning, it signifies that the Left Saint, being the source, has indeed perished. It seems he has failed.”
Standing above the Firmament, that God-level powerhouse looked slightly solemn: “That guy actually perished; then, the ancient holy artifact that our father had given is all but wasted?”
“Wasted, is it? That’s not necessarily so,” came the indifferent voice, as the terrifying and vast Will gradually receded, vanishing from sight.
Meanwhile, in a time-space far away, as the Left Saint perished, two other individuals felt something.
In a mountain forest where pink peach blossoms danced in the sky, a wooden house filled with the peaceful and beautiful atmosphere of the South was built, where Ilisa Zabel, who once had a brief encounter with Jack Clark, stood with her hands behind her back under the eaves of the house.
Ilisa Zabel slightly lifted her head to look into the distance, her eyes revealing a trace of surprise: “This fluctuation… It’s the fall of a Divine Body.”
As she spoke, Ilisa Zabel extended her right hand and closed it slightly, immediately a terrifying Aura of a mid-period Heavenly King spread, making this World tremble under the fearsome pressure.
Hum! Behind Ilisa Zabel, a giant golden sun and silver moon spanning ten thousand meters rose, with the silver moon orbiting the sun, a strong Distortion Force erupted.
Boom! In front of Ilisa Zabel, space twisted and shattered, then from the darkness beyond, a fist-sized golden eye appeared, transforming into a beam of golden light rushing out of the crack.
Whoosh! The golden eye floated in front of Ilisa Zabel, emitting rings of sacred golden halos.
But at this time, those golden lights were filled with sanctity, pure, free from any impurities, not at all like the fervor and Overbearing presence that was in the hands of Left Saint.
Looking at the floating golden eye, Ilisa Zabel pointed a finger at it, and immediately a whisp of remnant thoughts vanished into her body through her finger.
This trace was a part of Left Saint’s memory information.
But the final details on how he perished were somewhat incomplete; Ilisa Zabel only saw an image of a figure that stood a kilometer tall, its body and dragon tail engulfed in white flames.
And just this single image made Ilisa Zabel feel rather solemn.
After a long while, Ilisa Zabel slowly spoke up: “He was only at the Mythical Peak when he perished; indeed, the Holy Path is insufficient. But the person who killed ‘me’ in the end, so strong…”
“Indeed, the Mythical World is vast and boundless, with monsters and strange creatures emerging constantly.” With a sigh, Ilisa Zabel pressed the golden eye into her right eye.
Boom! Just as the golden eye merged with Ilisa Zabel’s right eye, it unleashed an incredibly vast and powerful holy energy.
At the same time, a pure and flawless, jade-like heart in the region of Ilisa Zabel’s heart emitted light, merging with the golden divine energy emitted by the golden eye.
Besides, from within the golden eye, a sanctified, pure Soul Source containing a thread of Rule Aura surged forth.
This faint Soul Source was of the same origin as Ilisa Zabel and instantly merged with her soul. In a flash, her Aura began to soar.
Boom!! An endless expanse of greenish-golden light exploded, painting the entire world in shades of greenish-gold under its resplendent glow, radiant as jade.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 1008 423 The Trinity of Man God and Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1008: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter)_2 Chapter 1008: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter)_2 Jack Clark’s true body and the Giant Beast Avatar shared the same soul, yet their consciousnesses were distinct. Ilisa Zabel, years ago, with great determination and the help of three ancient relics, used a secret skill to divide herself into three separate entities.
Each represented man, god, and demon, respectively.
The soul sources chopped off from the three bodies were entrusted to ancient relics, and their consciousness and bodies became independent, with the ancient relics only guiding the return upon the demise of one.
But what was brought back was only the ‘refined’ ancient relics and a portion of the soul source.
This separation also caused great damage to Jonathan Walker, not only did his cultivation fall to the level of a Myth, but his talent was also divided into three.
In such a state, even with his once peerless talent and a foundation of soul power ten times that of his peers, after more than a decade, his ‘person’ form had only reached the mid period of Heavenly King.
In comparison to the ‘person’ form that had re-cultivated to the initial period of Heavenly King, the divine form had even worse talent. Holding the sacred eye of the ancient relics, it had only cultivated to the peak of Myth.
He also needed the help of external objects to break the shackles and step into the Realm of Heavenly Kings.
At that moment, with a part of the ‘god’ soul source returning, the soul became even more complete and powerful.
With the integration of the power of the refined and problem-free ancient relics, Ilisa Zabel’s cultivation was set to become even more frightening after a period of secluded cultivation.
Meanwhile, at the moment of Ilisa Zabel’s breakthrough,
Billions of kilometers away from the Human Race territorial area, in another battlefield base far from The Purgatory Family, a Purgatory True Demon quietly observed the floating golden eyes before it.
This Purgatory True Demon, standing five meters tall, bore a close resemblance to Ilisa Zabel, its face covered in dark gold scales, with horns on its head, and vicious wings and a serpentine tail extending behind.
The aura of this Purgatory True Demon was even stronger than Ilisa Zabel’s, having reached the terrifying later stages of a Great Demon King (Heavenly King), with Demon Power that filled the sky.
The Left Demon’s finger slowly retracted from the golden eye, his gaze cold and his voice low and soft, “Useless thing, over ten years and only cultivated to the peak of demon king.”
Boom!
The Left Demon, clutching the golden eye, pressed it to his left eye, and instantly a section of black gold spine emerged within his body, and the terrifying dark demon air burst forth, causing the entire palace to tremble.
At the same time, the golden eye emitted a vast, magnificent golden power and a strand of soul source.
Boom! The terrifying dark demon air collided with the holy power, but there was no conflict. Instead, they began to merge eerily, forming an astonishing black-gold power.
Feeling the increasingly terrifying power within, the Left Demon’s expression was icy cold, and a powerful realm of thought sounded outside the palace, its voice cold and overbearing.
“Inform His Majesty Tyris that I shall enter closed-door cultivation for a period of time. Talrodel will take charge of the frontline battles and the war affairs of the ten Main Battle Legions and the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
At the entrance of the Great Hall, two Purgatory True Demons radiating the aura of Nine Demonic Marks knelt on one knee, bowing respectfully, “Yes.”
…
Amidst the violent chaos of spatial collapse, Jack Clark, covered in black-red armor, was sinking and floating with the currents, his aura weak.
The trial of fusing the soul’s deification with the power projection had cost more than Jack had anticipated; his Qi Blood, True Strength, and will had almost been exhausted, and his soul had also suffered damage.
Deification is the sublimation achieved by the resonating fusion of two complete souls, but this fusion had only been with the power projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon.
Therefore, it was the burning of Jack’s soul power alone, an incomplete fusion.
This time, although Jack appeared unrivaled and invincible, it was actually due to the overlap of twelve Higher-order Laws and the power of three Divine Abilities, not because of a fused sublimation.
If it had been a true fusion and unification of the soul, with all Laws and Divine Powers and the physical body merged, the transformation would have been unspeakably dreadful.
This could be observed from the trial.
Merely overlapping powers almost rendered him invincible, exploding everything.
Accordingly, as the summoning ended, the projection of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon vanished in an instant under the forces of space-time and causality, and Jack’s soul, already burning in preparation for unification, lost its resonating counterpart.
The result was the near complete burning out of his soul power, and the appearance of cracks in his soul’s true body.
At that moment, within the depths of Jack’s body, the one hundred and twenty meter tall figure of the Soul Emperor became ethereal and transparent, lined with cracks all over.
This was still under the suppression of the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal held in his left hand.
As the Primordial Rule continued to temper, the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal became more wondrous. It now radiated rule fluctuations, enveloping the Soul True Body to mend the cracks.
However, the speed of this self-repair was rather slow, and it was estimated that it would take half a year to recover, unless soul-related resources were used to make up for it.
Moreover, there was the breakthrough of the Illusion Meditation Scripture, having just destroyed dozens of war puppets above the Ninth Heavens.
Those Soul Crystals, if collected and converted into Soul Points, would be enough to strengthen the Scripture to the Sixth Level, and to condense a true Soul True Body to touch upon the Soul Law.
But previously, during the pursuit of Jonathan Walker, there had been no time to collect those shattered Soul Crystals.
As Jack lay in the violent chaos, allowing the wild currents formed by the collapse of space to wash over his body like a leaf bobbing amidst the waves, he pondered his gains from the great battle.
And while the violent currents that could injure a Ninth Heaven Expert neared within a few meters of Jack, they were blocked by an Invisible Power.
Though Jack’s ‘strength’ was depleted during the battle, the defensive boost from the World’s Power of four conjoined planes helped. With the coordination of four layers, it was enough to ignore any attacks beneath the level of a Myth.
As he reflected on his gains from the battle, Jack spared a moment of attention to observe the changes in the time scars on his arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 1009 423 The Trinity of Man God and Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1009: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter)_3 Chapter 1009: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter)_3 “`
The backlash from summoning the shadow of the Giant Beast this time was actually not as intense as the last time in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, when the expended Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid even made Supreme Level beings wince.
But perhaps it was due to the erosion by time that had already taken place, the intensity of the erosion this time was several times that of the previous, and even Jack Clark faintly felt as if time was wrapping around his left arm.
It was just unknown whether it was because there were no Time Beings ‘nearby,’ or whether the degree of time erosion was not enough, but no attacks from Time Beings had been attracted yet.
However, although no Time Beings had been drawn, Jack Clark lying amidst the tumultuous turbulent flows managed to catch the attention of a different-race strong man.
In the Void a hundred kilometers away, a fierce-looking member of a different race with horns on its head and standing over twenty meters tall was hiding behind a meteorite that spanned more than ten kilometers.
Watching Jack Clark lying unmoving within the violent energy streams, so weak that he was barely detectable, the foreign strong man’s eyes flashed with a cold light.
But this foreign strong man didn’t immediately make a move, for the fierce battle between Jack Clark and Jonathan Walker had been too terrifying.
After waiting for almost another ten minutes, Jack Clark was still floating in the turmoil, appearing weak, giving off the impression that he could die at any moment.
Watching this scene, the foreign strong man’s eyes flickered coldly, and he gritted his teeth, “Damn Human Race, daring to kill my brother.”
Having said that, the strong man of the different race no longer hesitated, afraid that if he delayed any longer Jack Clark would recover some strength.
He then took out a gigantic bow made from the polished spine of a special Giant Beast, with tendons for strings nearly thirty meters tall, followed by an arrow over forty meters long crafted from black beast bone.
Hum!
As the foreign strong man slowly drew the bow, runes lit up on the bow and arrow, circles of black halos wrapping around them, emitting an astonishingly sharp aura.
Whoosh!
The foreign strong man’s hand loosened, and the arrow instantly turned into a black afterimage that pierced through the Void, crossing over a hundred kilometers at a terrifying speed tens of times that of sound, resembling an aurora.
Boom! The bone arrow, as sharp as a siege spear, exploded with a loud noise against a transparent crystalline layer just five meters from Jack Clark, unleashing rings of black radiance.
Under the terrifying shock comparable to a nuclear explosion, the transparent crystalline layer stood undisturbed, unshakeable.
In an instant, the foreign strong man was shocked, “How is that possible!”
During the intense explosion, Jack Clark opened his eyes, his expression indifferent, “Why not possible? I’ve suppressed strong men comparable to Heavenly King Main Gods; did you really think you could launch a stealth attack on me?”
“No good,” the different race strong man’s eyes showed a hint of regret, not expecting that Jack Clark was not critically injured by the strong man, and still had spare strength left.
But it was already too late for regrets; just as the foreign strong man began to entertain thoughts of escape, Jack Clark had already appeared at his side, closing his hand slightly.
“No!”
Boom! With a casual squeeze, Jack Clark reduced the Nine Layers Heaven strong man of the different race to a cloud of blood mist, then vanished without a trace.
After a short while, he had already recovered some ‘physical strength,’ which was a hallmark of having one’s physical body enhanced to the extreme—not only was the strength unparalleled, but the recovery power was also astonishingly fast.
Jack Clark took a step in the Void and disappeared in a blink, quickly covering hundreds of kilometers toward the direction of the black Stone Gate.
Although Jonathan Walker had already been suppressed by him, due to the preceding battle, this Relic World had already been pushed to the brink of collapse.
Though the battle was short-lived, the two had crossed over ten thousand kilometers, leaving the aftermath of their fight scattered throughout the Void, with Space Turbulence howling in the areas of destruction.
On his way back, Jack Clark also casually collected several ordinary God-level resources.
Soon, Jack Clark crossed thousands of kilometers to return to the central area, where hundreds of kilometers around were covered by seething magma and Black Cracks due to his strike.
In the Space Cracks that had lost their ability to self-repair, a strong Devouring force emanated, consuming all energy and matter around it.
As soon as he approached the explosion range, Jack Clark saw a washbasin-sized black transparent Crystal tumbling in the air flow, his face revealing a smile.
One, two, in quick succession around the perimeter of the explosion, Jack Clark collected eleven Mythical Grade Soul Crystals and twenty-three Level 9 Soul Crystals.
As for the remaining Soul Crystals, they were no longer to be found, either destroyed in the Deification strike or devoured by the Space Cracks.
It couldn’t be helped, he was in a hurry to pursue Jonathan Walker back then, so he used a wide-range attack of destruction, destroying the war formation in one strike, and even piercing through the Void.
Just as Jack Clark finished collecting the Soul Crystals and stood tall in the Void, the black Stone Gate that had remained intact despite the Heavenly King Level battle waves suddenly trembled and sent a faint resonance towards him.
The Gate!
Looking at the formidable Stone Gate in the distance, a look of surprise flashed in Jack Clark’s eyes because this Stone Gate had not suffered any damage from the aftermath of the Heavenly King Level battle.
At that thought, Jack Clark’s figure flashed as he flew towards it, and the trembling of the black Stone Gate grew even more intense.
After confirming through his Void-Striking Heart’s Eye that he sensed no danger or unease on the Stone Gate, Jack Clark placed his hand on it.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark’s hand touched the black Stone Gate, the ten-thousand-meter-tall Stone Gate shook thunderously, a wave of intangible fluctuations mixed with information flooding into his Sea of Consciousness.
After a long while, Jack Clark’s eyes showed surprise and admiration, “Who would have thought that the World’s Heart that Jonathan Walker wanted to assimilate was actually this Stone Gate.”
This Stone Gate, known as the Gateway to Heaven, was the door once refined by that fallen strong man, suppressing the entrance and connecting to the Outer World.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 1010 423 The Trinity of Man God and Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1010: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter)_4 Chapter 1010: Chapter 423 The Trinity of Man, God and Demon, Gateway to Heaven (Major Chapter)_4 As a Great Real World, when the strong man worshipped by countless different races still existed, the Inner World was connected to the Outer World, and countless living beings entered and exited every day.
Later, as the strong man failed in his attempt to reach Eternity and fell, the Inner World also collapsed and exploded, leaving the Stone Gate and this fragment of the world here.
Over time, the Stone Gate, which had been continually washed by the force of a Real World, became even more solid and formidable.
Meanwhile, as it became the core of this world fragment, the Stone Gate gave birth to a strand of weak spiritual essence.
This strand of spiritual essence, looking down upon Jonathan Walker, who had sneaked in attempting to refine this world fragment, always subtly disguised itself as the entrance to the relic.
In an earlier battle between Jack Clark and Jonathan Walker, which displayed indescribably terrifying potential and combat strength, the Stone Gate seemed to have recognized him.
“It possesses the traits of suppressing and connecting worlds,” Jack Clark said, his face revealing surprise.
Because his Four-fold Virtual Plane needed to integrate the Fourfold World in order to open the heavens and ascend to a Real World after it had grown to its limit.
This is also why the Heaven Opening Supreme Law is so difficult to grasp.
If simply creating a Fourfold Illusionary World were enough to unite and Open Heaven and Earth, then under the nurturing of the Human Federation over the years, there would have emerged a second or third strong man capable of doing so.
However, an understanding of the world, along with the requirement for the integration of the Fourfold World, stopped many individuals of great talent and monstrous nature.
Even for a powerful race like The Purgatory Family, Mythical Powerhouses who had mastered the Opening Heaven Law were still rare, hardly appearing once in a thousand years.
Now, as long as Jack Clark could refine this Stone Gate, it would act as the center to connect the four planes, suppress heaven and earth, and make the path of Opening the Heavens smoother.
It could even be used as a weapon to directly smash enemies to death.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark suppressed the excitement in his heart and, following the information transmitted to him by the Stone Gate, began to form hand seals, his Spiritual Will summoning a complex rune.
Humm! As the golden light converged in Jack Clark’s hands, forming two intricate runes, he vanished and reappeared atop the Stone Gate that was like a ten thousand-meter mountain.
Boom! Jack Clark brought his palms together, imprinting the refinement rune filled with his Soul Power onto the Stone Gate, which instantly began to tremble violently.
Boom Boom Boom!! Ancient patterns emerged on the surface of the Stone Gate, emitting powerful shockwaves that swept across tens of kilometers, with the Stone Gate at the center.
In the midst of the raging wind, Jack Clark’s black hair danced behind him, and faintly, a connection had already been formed with the Stone Gate.
Yet now it was just a connection that had been established; fully refining it would take time, and there were some things to do before refining the Gateway to Heaven.
With that thought, Jack Clark’s figure flashed atop the Stone Gate, as he willed his hand seal to descend.
Boom!
The Black Stone Gate trembled once more, slightly opening a crack in an instant, and a powerful force of suction emanated from the Stone Gate, causing the iron pieces in the hands of all who were still alive to emit light.
Swish swish swish!!
Under the force of the world, Jane Aiken, Ida Carroll, and others appeared out of thin air, stunned to see Jack Clark standing atop the Stone Gate.
Beyond Sid Hawk and his six companions, there were six strong beings from different races, including the youth with golden vertical pupils; as for the rest, they were all dead.
Jane Aiken immediately asked, “Jack Clark, are you alright?”
Jack Clark smiled faintly, “I’m alright.”
Sid Hawk’s eyes were filled with doubt, “Jack Clark, that Mythical Powerhouse…?”
Jack Clark calmly stated, “Don’t worry, he has been suppressed by me.”
Hiss!! Instantly, shock showed on the faces of everyone present, including those from different races.
From those two auras earlier, whether it was Jack Clark or the other Mythical Powerhouse, both were terrifyingly formidable, seemingly even beyond the boundaries of Myth.
And yet, such a powerhouse had been slain by Jack Clark in such a short span of time—how could his strength possibly be this immense?
At this moment, even those like Joshua Welan, who already knew about Jack Clark’s astonishing combat prowess and his ability to summon a terrifying Giant Beast, couldn’t help but question their life choices.
As for the different races, they were even more fearful of the strength of the ‘Human Race’. If just one Ninth Heaven Human Race strong man was this terrifying, what about those Mythical Kings?
But that’s not right, the Mythical Kings who joined the Divine Gods Alliance were indeed powerful, but not to such an exaggerated extent, right?
The few strong beings of the different races exchanged glances, their eyes filled with confusion and surprise. They felt increasingly that the Human Race was mysterious and unpredictable, no wonder they could rise so quickly to block The Purgatory Family.
At that moment, Jack Clark said indifferently, “That Mythical powerhouse came in through another entrance and also happens to be a traitor of my Human Race, named Jonathan Walker.”
“However, it seems that what I just suppressed was merely one of his Avatars, not his True Body.”
“What, Jonathan Walker!” Ida Carroll was somewhat shocked, as she had also heard of this monstrous figure’s infamous name.
Jane Aiken’s face directly showed astonishment.
Howard Lambert’s eyes widened, “Holy shit, Jack Clark, you actually defeated that traitor!”
Boom! At that moment, the entire world shook violently, Heaven and Earth trembled, and a gigantic crack, stretching for tens of kilometers, appeared in the distant Void.
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed, “We can talk about this later, I need to get everyone out first.”
Boom! As he spoke, a powerful suction emerged from the gap of the door, instantly sweeping up everyone except for Jane Aiken, and they disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Looking at Jane Aiken, Jack Clark’s face revealed a smile, “Student Aiken, this world is about to fall into destruction. Would you like to stay and observe the process of destruction?”
“I would.”
Jane Aiken suppressed the words that had almost slipped out. Witnessing the destruction of a part of the Real World was a tremendous opportunity for her.
Under these circumstances, any doubts could wait until they were out of here.
Jane Aiken and Jack Clark stood atop the Stone Gate, gazing into the distance where darkness seemed to devour everything at the world’s end.
Connected to the World Fragments through the Stone Gate, Jack Clark’s consciousness expanded infinitely, enveloping the entire ‘world’. In his perception, the World was already mostly collapsed.
Hundreds, thousands of kilometers of cracks appeared, threatening to Destroy Heaven and Earth. Large swathes of the Cosmic Void crumbled amidst thunderous collapse, exploding into chaotic torrents.
At this moment, all things ceased to exist, laws dissipated, and some of the fundamental rules and forces that constituted the World also began to crumble.
The laws and rules revealed under the Great Collapse bore traces of mystery. Having once contemplated a complete small world, Jack Clark saw this scene and gained immense enlightenment.
Creation and destruction are opposites; the Void and Death coexist, while Thunder and flames also belong to Heavenly Earth Law, which manifests in many forms.
Jack Clark’s Black Gold eyes with golden vertical pupils glimpsed the essence of Heaven and Earth, his body radiating with Mysterious Aura, as the World Origin within him consumed and transformed at an astonishing speed into his own law.
After touching upon the Law in the late period of the Ninth Heaven and starting the Tempering of the True Body, one could even be considered at the Ninth Heaven Peak quasi-mythical level.
However, Jack Clark had just begun his encounter with the Law; his body only had the faintest traces of Law patterns, so he remained in the Ninth Heaven late period.
But at this moment, witnessing the scene of the World’s Destruction, he gained immensely. The Void, Death, Thunder, and Fire Law transformed and Tempered the True Body at an astonishing speed, his aura becoming more terrifying as he stepped into the Ninth Heaven Peak.
Similarly, for Jane Aiken, who already had incredible enlightenment and had nearly completed the Road of Heavenly Kings, observing the Origin of a complete small World,
Her previous comprehension now contrasted with destruction, leading to equally massive gains. Four powerful Sword Intents erupted around her, unfolding behind her to form a Sword World.
However, this world filled with endless Sword Qi was collapsing, with the four Sword Intents hanging in the corners gradually merging into one, forming an immensely destructive force of Great Collapse.
The utmost of the sword, destruction of the world, is itself the Great Collapse!
Outside, as the Relic World began to shatter, the entire Chaotic Ancient Region started to shake, space crumbled, forming massive and terrifying Black Cracks.
Raging wind howled between heaven and earth, whipping up sandstorms that shook Heaven and Earth.
The sudden change immediately caught the attention of Jewell and others in the distance, as deities traversed the gap.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 1011 424 Annihilation of the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1011: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon Chapter 1011: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon The sky collapsed and the ground caved in; above the entrance to the relic where sandstorms raged, nine deities who had revealed their true forms stood towering, looking down with grave expressions.
Below, Sid Hawk, Joshua Welan, Howard Lambert, Eddy Keller, and Ida Carroll, along with six individuals from different races, respectfully said, “We greet you, exalted deities.”
They were not Jack Clark, who possessed the strength to easily suppress mythical powerhouses.
Even the strongest among them, Sid Hawk and the young man of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe, did not dare to be negligent in the face of these divine beings. Without reaching the status of a mythical being, one is still transcendent.
Jewell True Immortal slightly bowed his head, his expression grave, “Sid Hawk, what happened?”
Under normal conditions, exploring a relic would take at least a Sun Wheel (thirty to forty days), but now these people had come out not long after entering, and there were less than half of them left.
Sid Hawk smiled wryly, “There was an accident. The Federation’s traitor from those years, Jonathan Walker, appeared. His strength was at the Mythical Peak, and he ambushed many, even killing the brothers Amos with Holy Light Flames.”
“Later, Jonathan Walker confronted Jack Clark, and the two of them fought fiercely, collapsing much of the inner world of the relic. In the end, that traitor was still slain by Jack Clark.”
Many had witnessed the initial fierce battle between Jack Clark and Jonathan Walker, so they had sensed the terrifying might of Walker’s Mythical Peak prowess.
No one saw the later phase where they battled to the relic’s core and entered a Limit Breakthrough, and the different races they encountered afterwards also died from the aftermath of the battle.
Therefore, although the fluctuations of the battle between them became terrifying as it progressed, no one could have imagined that the level of the fight had reached that of a Heavenly King Level.
Even so, the five alien deities present all tightened their expressions.
The aura of the Violent Dragon Deity trembled as it growled in a low and heavy voice, “Humans, are you sure there is no mistake, that human named Jack Clark has really slain a Mythical Peak powerhouse!?”
In an instant, everyone below felt a sudden heaviness. Sid Hawk’s expression turned cold as he said indifferently, “I would not dare to lie about such a matter. If you do not believe me, ask them.”
At that moment, the young man from the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe slowly spoke up, “He is not lying. There was a great battle inside, and a strange Mythical Peak powerhouse appeared.”
“…And indeed, it was that formidable figure named Jack Clark who won.” Facing the heaven-defying Jack Clark, the arrogant young man from a different race also offered a respectful tone.
Then, another king from the Human Race asked in confusion, “Sid Hawk, besides the Amos brothers, what about Jane Aiken?”
After becoming a civilization inheritor, Jane Aiken would be the focus of kings wherever she went, holding additional life-saving trump cards.
“Oh! Right, what about Jane Aiken? Why hasn’t she come out with Jack Clark, since they’re still inside?” Howard Lambert also realized this and looked around.
Ida Carroll hesitated, “There might be something.”
“The Chaotic Ancient Region has changed, we should leave first.” Saying this, the deity also with three eyes rolled up its Divine Light, taking the Divine Child of the Divine Realm and soaring into the sky.
Soon, the other alien geniuses were also taken away, including the two demon kings from the Demon God Sect, their expressions somewhat grave as they disappeared in a flash of demon light.
Quickly, only two Human Kings and Eddy Keller remained.
In the distance, in the blink of an eye, the two Demon Kings flew out over a hundred kilometers, and a low, cold voice rose from within the rolling Dark Demon Air, “That human must have used the Summoning Secret Skill again.”
The other Demon King nodded solemnly, “It is inevitable. Otherwise, he could not possibly have suppressed a Mythical Peak powerhouse. But wasn’t it said that his secret skill had significant drawbacks?”
“That’s just the military’s Intelligence Department speculation. The backlash may not be as severe as we imagine,” said the Demon King, her voice turning cold and cruel.
“No matter what, we must find a way to kill this human. If he grows up, he will pose a great threat to our clan, and the threat is imminent.”
The other Demon King smiled bitterly, “Of course, I know the human poses a great threat, but there has been no reply from there yet. Just the few of our Demon Roots present can’t handle that human genius.”
“Although I hate to admit it, we are currently no match for him.”
With that, the two Demon Kings fell silent.
As invincible Purgatory True Demons and overlords of their realms, they were facing an insurmountable dilemma against a transcendent ninth-tier human.
…
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
As the collapse of the starry sky hastened, the Void was filled with dazzling light and red flames that annihilated matter, while the hurricane that shattered space descended.
Amidst the destruction of the world, various phenomena representing extreme forces of destruction appeared, obliterating everything with their catastrophic impact, and layers of space dissolved.
Under these forces of Great Destruction that only emerge when the world comes to an end, even mythical powerhouses will perish—terrifying beyond imagination.
Looking at this scene, Jack Clark and Jane Aiken, who were in a state of enlightenment about the destruction of Heaven and Earth, instinctively showed shock on their faces.
After all, few have the chance to witness the destruction of a world.
Boom! Boom! As layer upon layer collapsed and annihilated, what emerged behind them was the Dark Void that engulfed everything, with chaotic streams composed of endless spatial fragments sweeping across everything.
However, whenever these destructive forces approached a radius of tens of kilometers around the black Stone Gate, they were suppressed by an invisible force and rendered immovable.
As a Stone Gate crafted by a powerhouse who had fallen in pursuit of Eternity, this black Stone Gate was stronger than Jack Clark anticipated.
Or rather, his greatest gain from this relic expedition was this Stone Gate, which stood against the destruction of the world—a Gateway to Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 1012 424 Annihilation of the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1012: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon_2 Chapter 1012: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon_2 Standing atop the Heaven-Piercing Stone Gate, Jack Clark and Jane Aiken’s eyes reflected Heaven and Earth, while their minds were immersed in enlightenment, vast amounts of information washing over their Sea of Consciousness every second.
At the same time, four kinds of Higher-order Laws rapidly transformed within their bodies, and amidst the Tempering of their True Bodies, the violent energy that filled the area suppressed by the Stone Gate surged towards Jack Clark like crazy.
The energy was so dense that it even formed a tangible mist, centering around Jack Clark and Jane Aiken and transforming into a white vortex covering several kilometers.
At this moment, aside from the crazy surge in Jack Clark’s cultivation strength, Jane Aiken’s aura also skyrocketed due to her realm advancement.
However, compared to an entire world, ‘persons’ are too insignificant. Even if they were geniuses with supreme talents like Jack Clark and Jane Aiken, they could only comprehend a limited scope of the rules’ mysteries at this time.
Moreover, as the world collapsed faster and faster, both of them chose to absorb as much as they could, and any enlightenment they couldn’t understand was imprinted deep in their minds.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In just half a day, the whole world had completely collapsed, dispersing into a boundless darkness of the Void and the rampant chaos of Spatial Storm currents.
In that destructive Void that swallowed everything, a black Stone Gate tens of thousands of meters tall stood firm, emanating an unshakable aura.
Above the black Stone Gate, Jane Aiken, with four Divine Swords floating behind her, opened her eyes, a slow dissipation of pure destruction Sword Intent fading from her gaze.
Under this fortuitous enlightenment, Jane Aiken, who had already brought the Four Great Sword Intentions to grand accomplishment, touched upon the Boundary of her Sword Path.
With just one more step, she could unite the Four Great Sword Intentions, condense the Destruction Sword Path, and invoke the force of Great Destruction that only appears when a One-side World is ending—extremely terrifying.
Moreover, Jane Aiken’s cultivation also broke through to the Mid-eighth level as a matter of course.
With her current realm of swordsmanship, as long as she cultivates in peace and has enough resources, she could quickly make a breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens.
Jack Clark, who had already stopped cultivating, smiled lightly, “Congratulations, Student Aiken, for advancing another step in your cultivation. After a period of closed-door cultivation, you should be able to break through to the Ninth Heavens very soon.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark felt a sense of emotion, “A genius reaching the Ninth Heavens within a year; after more than a decade, another genius has achieved this record, which is enough to shake the entire Cultivation World.”
Among the current generation of Senior One at the Federation, aside from Jack Clark, Jane Aiken, who has advanced to Mid-eighth level, stands above everyone else, her talent terrifying.
As for Howard Lambert, who also advanced to the Eighth Layer Early Phase, his talent is at least two levels behind Jane Aiken.
This guy’s talent is strong at South Sky Martial Height, but when looking at the entirety of Eastern Summer, he’s only second-tier, yet he has the craziness and ruthlessness of a Demon.
Stimulated by Jack Clark, Howard Lambert pushed himself like a mad Demon in the early phase, breaking his limits in near-death battles, barely keeping up after the two and entering the Void Relic Continent.
Plus, with the opportunities in the Ruins Continent and the early battles and chances in the mythical world, he astonishingly broke through to the Eighth Layer Early Phase as well.
But when Jack Clark encountered Howard Lambert earlier, he saw that he had reached his limit.
Relying on the Heritage of the Ruins to forcefully break through to the Eighth Layer, he would need a long time to assimilate both powers and integrate the Inheritance; his cultivation won’t make rapid strides for a while.
Of course, this short time is for Jack Clark; for Howard Lambert, it’s only a matter of months or half a year.
Looking at the admiring dark-haired young man, Jane Aiken always felt something was amiss, after all, the one praising her had already been at the Ninth Heaven Peak for a year.
Even with his talent, it wouldn’t be much longer before he breaks through to Mythical, becoming the One-Year King.
Jane Aiken nodded slightly, calmly saying, “I must thank you this time. Without this opportunity, it would take me another month to break through to the Ninth Heavens.”
After speaking, Jane Aiken stopped, her lips curling into a smile as she looked at Jack Clark, who was waiting to engage in a mutual praise session with her.
Jack Clark was speechless, “Student Aiken, why aren’t you playing by the book this time? I’ve already complimented you; you should at least follow suit and reply with a couple of compliments.”
Jane Aiken’s eyes showed amusement, and then her brows furrowed slightly, “Jack Clark, are you sure the Mythical Powerhouse you fought earlier was Jonathan Walker?”
“Indeed.”
Jack Clark nodded, then hesitated, “Student Aiken, don’t tell me the person you want to kill is Jonathan Walker?”
Jane Aiken calmly affirmed with a nod, “Yes, it’s him. Jonathan Walker and my mother grew up together, entered South Sky Martial together, were classmates and good friends.”
“But after he betrayed the Human Race, not only did he injure my mother, ruining her foundation, but before she died, she said that my grandparents’ deaths were also related to him.”
It really was Jonathan Walker. Jack Clark was a bit surprised; he knew Jane Aiken had an enemy, but he never thought it would be Jonathan Walker.
Suddenly, Jack Clark said, “Student Aiken, you’ve actually met Jonathan Walker before. The Ilisa Zabel we met on the Southern Battlefield was one of his Avatars.”
“Ilisa Zabel is also one of Jonathan Walker’s Avatars!” Even Jane Aiken was somewhat astonished this time.
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s right, I don’t know what Cultivation Methods he’s practiced, but he can completely cut out more than two independent Avatars, and there should be one with the Purgatory Demon Race as well.”
As he spoke, even Jack Clark felt admiration.
The Federation is not without Secret Skills for creating avatars or splitting off avatars, but the requirements and restrictions are significant, many of which cause heavy injury to the original body, so very few strong men possess avatars.
Jane Aiken spoke in a composed tone, “I never expected I had already brushed past my enemy.”
Feeling the calmness in Jane Aiken’s voice, Jack Clark grew curious, “Student Aiken, from the sound of it, it seems you don’t harbor much hatred for Jonathan Walker?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 1013 424 Annihilation of the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1013: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon_3 Chapter 1013: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon_3 “Hatred? Hardly,”
Jane Aiken said calmly, “My mother only told me about these things the moment she left, so I haven’t had deep feelings about them. But as her final wish, I will do my utmost to fulfill it.”
“After I go out, I should enter a period of closed-door cultivation to strive for an early ascension into the Legendary Realm. Otherwise, let alone kill him for revenge, it might be difficult even to find his traces.”
Jane had delved deep into the Divine Gods Alliance this time, initially to seek information about the Holy Light God Sect and Jonathan Walker. She hadn’t anticipated that due to an error in judgement, Jonathan Walker had already been killed by Jack Clark.
Seeing the girl’s gaze as resolute as ever, Jack didn’t say much; after all, this was a family vendetta: “Student Aiken, allow me to send you out.”
Boom! The stone gate vibrated slightly, unleashing a powerful suction force that swept Jane away and out of sight.
After sending Jane away, Jack sat cross-legged atop the black stone gate, with four layers of halo emerging behind him.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The illusory world of the Fourfold World unfolded and expanded, turning into four illusory worlds, each 14 kilometers in diameter, slowly moving towards the black stone gate. In an instant, the Fourfold World shook violently.
While Jack was assimilating the Heaven-Piercing Stone Gate, in the Rift World, a purple little dragon floated above the surface of the lake.
Below the water, several Naga with human torsos and fish tails, beautiful in appearance, surrounded by a blue glow, were herding a dozen transparent ice fish upwards.
Bang!! The surface of the lake exploded, with a transparent ice fish over 2 meters long leaping out of the water.
Yiya yiya!!
Immediately, the purple little dragon cried out with joy; then, a 15-meter-diameter purple dragon head materialized from thin air, swallowing the ice fish in one gulp, followed by the second fish, the third fish…
Crackle Crackle, within moments, a dozen ice fish herded up were devoured by the purple little dragon.
Looking at the satisfied purple little dragon, which had returned to 2 meters in size, the ‘new’ chieftain of the Naga Tribe, Rain Lawson, reverently said, “May, all the mature ice fish are here.”
Yiya yiya!! The purple little dragon nodded in satisfaction; full and content, it swayed leisurely towards the incomplete Crystal Palace being built in the distance.
Thanks to the efforts during this period, the golden-blue Giant Dragon had already constructed three subsidiary palaces reaching 8,000 meters in height, made from crystal, glittering magnificently and resplendently.
The purple little dragon flew beside the golden-blue Giant Dragon; the 2-meter-sized creature was like a tiny insect, its voice childlike: Yiya yiya!! Telsafi, I’m so bored.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon had transformed and was in hibernation, Scythia was absorbing Law Power to breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Red Beast Candle Dragon were also in hibernation for cultivation, which made the whole ‘world’ quiet.
In these boring days, with nothing to do, the purple little dragon could only communicate with the golden-blue Giant Dragon and then slowly learned to speak.
With its double wings spread, the busy golden-blue Giant Dragon turned to glimpse at it, letting out a low growl: “If you’re bored, go to sleep. A nap will make time fly.”
For dragon species lifeforces, a nap could last for more than a dozen sun cycles; the passage of time hardly mattered.
Just as this tedious palace-building seemed uninteresting and troublesome to the Silver Giant Dragon, to the golden-blue Giant Dragon it was nothing more than an unimportant matter not even lasting one sun cycle.
The purple little dragon, with its double claws akimbo, stood in mid-air and roared: Yiya yiya!! I don’t want to sleep. The great May wants to see rivers of blood.
Saying so, the purple little dragon glanced towards the distant mountain peak.
There, the Silver Giant Dragon had grown to over 490 meters, its vast body covered with a thick silver semi-transparent scale armor, becoming more majestic and stunning, akin to a Silver Ice Crystal Peak.
At that time, frigid ice raged around the Silver Giant Dragon. With each breath, it exhaled a white, cold current, turning the forests within a radius of dozens of kilometers into a frozen wasteland.
However, the aura of the Silver Giant Dragon had begun to stabilize, still a bit away from a breakthrough to the Legendary Realm.
Unlike the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, which could evolve into the Legendary Realm in a single step, even for Giant Dragons like the Silver Giant Dragon with sufficient resources and bloodline talent, it was still quite difficult.
If there were no accidents, it would need to hibernate for at least one or two sun cycles before it could hope for a complete breakthrough.
Feeling the slowly stabilizing aura of the Silver Giant Dragon, the purple little dragon suddenly flew over, surrounded by an Invisible Power that disregarded the pervasive icy Law Power in the vicinity.
Yiya yiya!! Scythia, wake up fast, let’s go fight. Amidst its juvenile roar, the purple little dragon flew in front of the Silver Giant Dragon and opened its mouth, spewing a mouthful of purple Origin Power.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Under that Creation Origin Power, the bloodlines inside the Silver Giant Dragon surged, its body emitting dazzling Silver Brilliance. In an instant, the surrounding space vibrated.
Subsequently, black storms mixed with ice crystals whirled around the Silver Giant Dragon, covering an area of several kilometers with an extreme aura of freezing destruction.
Boom! Under the Higher-order Law of the Destruction Ice Crystal Storm and the Power of Space, the Silver Giant Dragon erupted with an aura far surpassing that of an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast.
Under its mighty Divine Might, the entire Rift Small world shook, awakening the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon from their days-long hibernation digesting God-level resources.
Even the Naga caring for ice fish at the lake’s bottom surged to the surface, their gaze filled with awe as they looked into the distance.
Including the golden-blue Giant Dragon solidifying palaces too, couldn’t help but look back, envy in its eyes.
Back when Scythia ran away from home, it was only in the early stages of Level 8, while it was already Level 9. However, it never expected that after a few sun cycles, not only did Scythia catch up, but also stepped into the Legendary Realm ahead of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 1014 424 Annihilation of the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1014: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon_4 Chapter 1014: Chapter 424 Annihilation of the Evil God, Mythical Dragon_4 “`
Roar!
The Silver Giant Dragon that had been slumbering for several days opened its eyes and let out a majestic roar to the sky, its double wings spread out, covering 1,100 meters, eclipsing the sun and filled with an endless aura of prestige.
At this moment, the entire Rift World trembled under the Silver Giant Dragon’s oppressive power.
The nearly 300-meter-long Single-horned Tiger Whale flapped its double fins excitedly and called out, “Roar! Roar! Great Sethia, you look so fierce and awesome now.”
The Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by the radiance of space and a destruction storm, roared proudly: “Roar! The Great Sethia has always been mighty and invincible.”
Despite often falling just short in front of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, upon its arrival in the Blue Star World, the Silver Giant Dragon had beaten both the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, acting in an overbearing manner.
At that moment, the red Giant Dragon, resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon, also flew over and growled softly, “Roar! Congratulations, Sethia, on your breakthrough into the mythic.”
The Silver Giant Dragon, with its tail held high in pride, roared back: “Roar! Not bad. By the way, wasn’t Tim Abott supposed to send you to find good stuff? Why are you sleeping at home?”
The Single-horned Tiger Whale hurriedly called out.
Roar! Roar! We found a lot of top-grade Divine Fruits, but there was a very powerful creature there we couldn’t beat, so we had to come back, and the Candle Dragon got hurt.
“A lot of top-grade Divine Fruits!” The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up.
For them, Mythical Giant Beasts, such top-grade Divine Fruits are rare resources, consuming them can greatly enhance their bloodline purity and accelerate growth.
If the Law Charm contained in the Divine Fruits coincides with their talent, it could also enhance the power of their rules.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon became rather excited, roaring: “Roar! Joe, lead the way, let’s go kill it and take back all the Divine Fruits.”
The Single-horned Tiger Whale cautioned: “Roar! Roar! Sethia, that creature is a bit strong, its Growth Level has reached the Mid-Mythical Stage, quite formidable.”
“Roar! Just a Mythical Mid-Stage Giant Beast; now that the Great Sethia has also become a Mythical Giant Beast, I can smash it.”
Although the Silver Giant Dragon spoke confidently, it pondered for a moment and then growled: “However, to prevent that Giant Beast from escaping, Telsafi and the Candle Dragon should come as well, so we can attack together.”
The Gold and Blue Giant Dragon and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, both possessing double Top Tier Talents, of quasi-mythical behemoths with bloodline levels among the mightiest of Monarchs, had combat power comparable to an Ordinary Mythical Giant Beast.
With them plus its own presence, there was nothing to fear from the Giant Beast, even if it were at the Mid-Mythical Stage.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon became absolutely confident: “By the time Tim Abott wakes up and sees lots of top-grade Divine Fruits, he will definitely be very pleased.”
With the Silver Giant Dragon putting it this way, it seemed truly possible, suddenly the Single-horned Tiger Whale was no longer cautious and excitedly called out: “Roar! Roar! Let’s kill that creature, slaughter and loot everything. ”
With the Silver Giant Dragon’s strength, having made a breakthrough into the mythical stage, even if they couldn’t win, they could still retreat.
Roar! Roar! The Great May also wants to go. The slightly weak Purple little dragon on the side quickly let out a childish roar.
“Roar! No problem, but when the time comes, just watch with Joe,” the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t refuse.
Its ability to break into the mythic stage ahead of schedule was partly due to the little fellow’s efforts, and having been in contact for some time, they had long noticed the extraordinariness of the Purple little dragon.
That was the creature that, even during the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s battle outbursts, could ignore the flames that could even burn through space.
The determined Silver Giant Dragon retracted its aura of Law Domains, flapped its wings to stir up raging winds, and flew to a spot not far from the palace while roaring: “Roar! Torsa, let’s go, we’re going to fight.”
Let’s fight. The Gold and Blue Giant Dragon, flying at a high altitude of several thousand meters, looked back.
However, before the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon could speak, suddenly the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened as it looked at the murals carved on the walls of those majestic palaces.
“Roar! Torsa, why are there only your statues on the palace walls? No, there’s the Great Sethia, but why at the bottom? And why is there only one of my paintings?”
Observing the angry Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon growled indifferently, “Not satisfied?”
“`
“Roar! The Great Sethia is furious, I am the Big Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, and yet there is not a statue of the Great Sethia on the palace mural,”
the Silver Giant Dragon declared as it flew in front of the golden blue Giant Dragon, its double wings spreading wide enough to block out the sun, showing off a figure that was even more colossal and powerful than the golden blue Giant Dragon’s.
The golden blue Giant Dragon casually growled back, “If you’re not satisfied, it’s simple, just knock down the palace and then build a new one yourself.”
…Instantly, the imposing Silver Giant Dragon paused, and looking at the towering palace that was thousands of meters tall and spanning over a dozen kilometers, it inexplicably felt a tad weak at the knees.
It seemed like it nearly died from exhaustion when it first built the Dragon Palace Ice Crystal Palace.
The Silver Giant Dragon blinked and then suddenly growled, “Roar! Forget the palace for now, Telsafi, let’s go fight and take back those top-grade Divine Fruits.”
Without waiting for the golden blue Giant Dragon’s response, it turned around and its wings shook as it shot into the sky: “Roar! The Great Sethia is invincible.”
Roar! Wait for us.
“Roar! Charge.”
One small, four great five-headed Giant Beasts roared as they followed the leader, a Silver Giant Dragon with wings spanning a kilometer, out of the waterfall, flying towards the Deep Sea Whirlpool World.
In the howling raging wind, the several Giant Beasts quickly crossed thousands of kilometers to reach their destination.
Boom boom boom! The Silver Giant Dragon clenched its wings, and with a thunderous crash, it smashed into the sea surface, instantly causing the sea to rise to the heavens, and the ordinary fish and Unique Beasts within a radius of several kilometers were stunned.
Boom boom boom! The other Giant Beasts also smashed into the sea at supersonic speeds, creating vast waves.
Soon, the Giant Beasts reached a depth of several thousand meters and directly plunged into the violent sea vortex.
Boom!
The moment they approached the center of the vortex, a heavy force of Space Distortion exploded, only to be blocked by a circle of silver transparent ripples emanating from the body of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Amid the Spatial Fluctuations, the Giant Beasts once again descended into that small world with crystal clear waters and lush mountain ranges.
At the center of the small world’s mountain ranges stood a red giant tree thousands of meters tall, resembling a mountain range itself, radiating halos of light.
Roar!
At the very moment the four Giant Beasts appeared, a Giant Beast with double wings, a lion-like head with a pair of long horns, and a body covered in dark red scale armor let out an enraged roar from below the mountains.
The creature was over eleven hundred meters long and three hundred meters at the shoulder, its size dwarfing that of the Silver Giant Dragon by several times, exuding an overwhelming presence.
