But the Silver Giant Dragon wasn’t afraid at all, it let out a majestic roar: “Roar! You despicable Giant Beast, quickly hand over the tree of the Great Sethia.”
…?
In that moment, not only the Kamaitachi Beast but also the heads of the Single-horned Tiger Whale and several other Giant Beasts were marked by question marks.
Only the golden blue Giant Dragon wasn’t surprised at all, since Sethia’s personality was just like this, and it immediately roared, “Hand over the Divine Fruits, or die.”
Boom!
As it spoke, the golden blue Giant Dragon’s wings, which seemed made of crystal, flared up. With a wingspan of seven hundred meters—twice the size of an average aircraft carrier, it obscured the light.
On the sharp horn of the Single-horned Tiger Whale, a vicious little purple dragon roared menacingly: Yiya yiya! You wretched Giant Beast, hand over May’s divine tree, or I’ll kill you.
All members are vicious dragons.
Roar! The enraged Kamaitachi Beast let out a roar, while blazing red flames soared up from its body, almost shrouding half the sky. Its double wings spread out, covering a two thousand meter area, appearing even more formidable and oppressive.
The great battle erupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 1015 425 A Fierce Battle Illusion Meditation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1015: Chapter 425: A Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Major Chapter) Chapter 1015: Chapter 425: A Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Major Chapter) Unlike humans and other cultivators who control the power of Heaven and Earth with their Divine Souls and maneuver the laws, the beasts traversing the path of Evolution excel in sheer forceful impacts.
They lack fancy techniques and the intricate manipulation of Law Power.
When two Mythical Giant Beasts have similar sizes, strengths, and levels, what they rely on are their instincts and combat experience forged in the heat of battle.
Roar!
Surrounded by blood-colored flames, the thousand and one hundred meter long Kamaitachi Beast resembled a red light streaking across the sky, igniting a sea of flames that seemed to burn everything between heaven and earth.
In that area, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its double wings, bolting at over ten times the speed of sound, surrounded by a storm tinged with black and loaded with Ice Crystals, enveloping an area of five thousand meters, freezing and shattering everything within.
Boom! The sea of blood-colored flames collided with the Ice Crystal storm, detonating a dazzling halo of black and red energy that burst forth, shining brightly between heaven and earth and continuing to spread.
And in the instant their Law Domains clashed, the two massive Giant Beasts collided at supersonic speed.
Boom!! The Dragon Claw enveloped in silver light collided with the flame-wrapped double claws, instantly unleashing a burst of pure, terrifying Black Power that sent transparent ripples cascading outwards in all directions.
Crackle Crackle!! The Silver Giant Dragon trembled, and the space beneath its feet cracked further, spawning massive fissures that spread rapidly.
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon bellowed, its double claw muscles bulging, and its scale armor on double arms and shoulders stood erect even more sharply, appearing incredibly fierce and mighty.
As a dragon species, their bodies have almost evolved to perfection, with immense strength, impervious defense, and the abilities of sharp claws and flying.
The Silver Giant Dragon, having broken through limits multiple times with the help of Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, and evolved its bloodline, had grown into a top-tier Monarch-class beast with double Top Tier Talent.
This breakthrough into the Mythical stage, aided by the Innate Space Rune and the awakened Destruction Ice Crystal Storm, transformed into a Higher-order Law, further strengthening the Giant Dragon’s body.
At this moment, with full power bursting out, it was an even match with the Kamaitachi Beast, also possessing a King-level bloodline, in the mid-Mythical stage.
Roar! The even larger Kamaitachi Beast let out a savage roar, its maw resembling a lion’s, gaping wide as it attempted to crunch down on the dragon head of the Silver Giant Dragon.
In close combat among giant beasts, the one with the larger body has an advantage—like the Kamaitachi Beast now, whose gaping maw could nearly swallow the Silver Giant Dragon’s head whole.
But just then, a hundred-meter-thick, ten thousand-meter-long Ice Crystal pillar streaked from the sky, bringing with it the immense force of suppressing Heaven and Earth, crashing down upon the head of the Kamaitachi Beast.
Boom! With the terrifying force akin to a mighty mountain, the robust body of the Kamaitachi Beast could only buckle as the massive Ice Crystal pillar drove its head down.
Roar!
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a ferocious howl, its claw strength exploding as it pulled downward, plunging forward and ramming its shoulder hard into the Kamaitachi Beast’s neck.
The massive impact followed by a fiery explosion caused the Kamaitachi Beast to emit a scream, and its huge body was brutally smashed into the Earth beneath a sky filled with red flames.
Boom! The ground within several kilometers shattered, mountains collapsed, and numerous clumps of dirt and stone erupted skyward.
In the explosion that seemed to shake Heaven and Earth, a ring-shaped shockwave swept tens of kilometers across the landscape, breaking and burning trees as it passed, filling the sky with rolling smoke and dust.
In a smooth engagement orchestrated by the two Giant Dragons, the Kamaitachi Beast found itself at a disadvantage from the outset.
Roar!
In the center of a shattered pit, the Kamaitachi Beast, surrounded by a halo of red flames, rose to its feet, angrily roaring at the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon soaring tens of thousands of meters above.
This despicable quasi-mythical behemoth dared to ambush it.
Boom! With a flap of its massive double wings, the Kamaitachi Beast instantly released a repelling force field, its strong rebounding power vanishing in a flash.
“Roar! Your opponent is the Great Sethia.”
Knowing well the terrifying speed of this beast, the Silver Giant Dragon created Space Distortion around it, appearing instantly below the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon with its claws wrapped in a black Ice Crystal storm.
Boom! The howling Ice Crystal storm met another onslaught, and the two Mythical Giant Beasts clashed amidst a sky scorched with red flames.
Roar! The Kamaitachi Beast, blocked by the Silver Giant Dragon, let out an enraged roar, ignoring the crushing black Ice Crystal storm and its claws aiming at the dragon head of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Boom!!
The Dragon Claw, charged with the Higher-order Destruction Ice Crystal Law, struck the chest of the Kamaitachi Beast, and the protective shield of flames shattered under the crushing power that obliterated everything, followed by the explosion of thick, dark red scales, sending flesh scattering.
And as the Silver Giant Dragon’s claw shattered the chest scales of the Kamaitachi Beast, the latter’s formidable claw engulfed in blood-colored flames also slammed into the shoulder of the Silver Giant Dragon.
Boom! The tyrannical and scorching power shattered the translucent crystal shielding on the Silver Giant Dragon’s body, with scales exploding and revealing the silver-golden flesh beneath.
Boom!!
Trading injury for injury, the Silver Giant Dragon was blasted away by a single swipe, while at the same moment, the Kamaitachi Beast was rocked by the explosive power of the Destruction Ice Crystal storm, blood cascading down from the sky.
Roar!
From the Firmament above, the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon let out a lofty roar, with hundreds of crystal shards radiating red, blue, and purple light, descending like shooting stars to engulf the landing Kamaitachi Beast.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In an instant, hundreds of crystal fragments exploded with the magnitude of intercontinental missiles, unleashing violent energy that obliterated everything around, forming numerous mushroom clouds that rose high.
However, as a beast whom had awakened an ancient ferocious Kamaitachi bloodline, this dark red behemoth’s defense was dreadfully strong, with the power to wrestle dragons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - 1016 425 A Fierce Battle Illusion Meditation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1016: Chapter 425: A Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Major Chapter)_2 Chapter 1016: Chapter 425: A Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Major Chapter)_2 Thus, when the smoke and dust from the explosion below had cleared, an undamaged dark red Giant Beast stood tall in the vast crater several kilometers wide.
Its chest wound, caused by the impact from the Silver Giant Dragon, had healed with flesh and blood, save for its scale armor, while flames burnt all over its body, emitting a ferocity that was extreme to the core.
Above the firmament, the Silver Giant Dragon stretched its wings in fury, its shoulder wound also regenerating rapidly amidst the swirling black storm that surrounded it, confronting the Kamaitachi Beast below.
Not far away, the golden-blue Giant Dragon and the Red Beast lay coiled, their bodies shimmering with the light of seven-colored crystals in alternate flashes of black and white, radiating an aura as savage as that of an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast.
Looking at the four great beasts confronting each other in the distance, the Purple little dragon on the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s head waved its double claws excitedly, “Eeeya, eeeya! Fight, fight to the death, May wants to see rivers of blood.”
Roar! Get to it!
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was also excitedly waving its Double Fin, its eyes bloodshot and filled with Killing Intent, and would have joined the fray already if it had been strong enough.
As a beast that had fought its way up alongside the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, every bone of it was steeped in bloodthirsty malice.
Roar! Suddenly, fierce roars echoed between heaven and earth, as the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, descending like a streak of silver-black light from the heavens, its aura mighty and overwhelming.
The dark red Giant Beast below, which resembled a small mountain range, also soared into the sky, entwining the heavens and the earth with flames, its might shaking the very foundation of the world.
At that moment, darkness enveloped the land, and within a radius of several kilometers, everything plunged into absolute darkness, while time also slowed down, everything seeming hundreds of times slower.
Roar! With a slow growl, a red tail over two thousand meters long swept through the darkness, blasting the atmosphere and rolling up billowing white waves that crashed upon the Kamaitachi Beast.
The formidable strength exploded the sea of fire, creating a wave of flaming air that rolled slowly to both sides, carrying the power to destroy heaven and earth as it struck the Kamaitachi Beast.
Boom! Despite the powerful hit, it was the tail scales of the Candle Dragon Giant Beast that burst apart, flesh flying in every direction. The Kamaitachi Beast covered in dark red scales stood unyieldingly firm, its defense terrifying.
Though it failed to breach the Kamaitachi Beast’s Defense, the force of the attack still shoved it several hundred meters sideward. At the same time, the Time Power that had enveloped the world disappeared, restoring everything to its normal state.
Roar! Propelled by the inertia of its strength, the Kamaitachi Beast leaped skyward, colliding once again with the Silver Giant Dragon, which had descended in an instant.
However, because of the Candle Dragon’s intervention, the Kamaitachi Beast’s double claws swiped at empty air, while the Silver Giant Dragon, twined with silver Space Power, slashed the space with its claw tips, creating eight Black Cracks with its double claws that sliced past the side of the Kamaitachi.
Roar! The Kamaitachi Beast cried out in agony; during that split instant, its side was torn open by the Silver Giant Dragon’s double claws, rendering eight gashes over three hundred meters long and nearly forty meters deep.
On either side of those two-yard-wide wounds, the golden-red flesh was peeled open like flames, while red blood, bright as fire, spewed forth, revealing the writhing organs beneath.
This strike had nearly inflicted a heavy injury on the Kamaitachi Beast. The torrent of blood and the stabbing pain sent the beast into an utter frenzy.
Boom! The wings on the back of the Kamaitachi Beast flapped furiously, it vanished in an instant.
Roar! Thousands of meters above, the golden-blue Giant Dragon roared, its surroundings shimmering with crystal light, condensing the space into a blue Ice Crystal a kilometer in diameter.
Boom!
The instant the crystal formed, a giant claw appeared; under the terrifying force, the Ice Crystal formed by the domain and Gifted Power of the golden-blue Giant Dragon was immediately shattered.
But at the very moment the Kamaitachi Beast shattered the domain crystal, space distorted behind it, and the roaring Silver Giant Dragon, which had moved instantaneously, gathered an astonishing energy in its maw.
Boom!
At close range, the Kamaitachi Beast took the full brunt of a Cyan-White Breath, including its flames; half its body and its wings were instantly frozen.
Meanwhile, amidst the ferocious gales of the crystal’s explosion, a Breath wrapped in a seven-colored light, thirty meters thick, shattered the space and struck the Kamaitachi Beast’s chest.
Roar! Hit by both Breaths front and back, the dark red Giant Beast let out a brutal roar. Ignoring its wounds, it countered with a strike of its claw against the side of the golden-blue Giant Dragon.
Boom! Under the mighty blow of a Mid-Mythical Stage Beast, the freshly formed domain around the golden-blue Giant Dragon crumbled, its Ice Crystal scales burst apart, and its massive body plummeted from the sky with a thunderous crash.
“Roar! How dare you attack Telsafi? I’ll kill you,”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared viciously, its wings outstretched, as boundless black destructive energy began to converge crazily. Mysterious runes appeared on its sharply pointed horns, forming a Black Hole at the center.
The moment the Black Hole materialized, a strong sense of danger enveloped the Kamaitachi Beast, startling it.
Roar! With a flap of its wings, the Kamaitachi Beast Burst forth with power, shaking off the thick ice and shattered scale armor on its surface, revealing its bloodsoaked flesh and blood as it attempted to avoid the strike.
But the world darkened once more, and a tail over two thousand meters long wrapped around its hindquarters in the darkness. Four huge claws seized its wings from behind, preventing it from escaping.
The appearance of the Candle Dragon Giant Beast startled the Kamaitachi Beast, its eyes turning red with rage.
Then, as the Silver Giant Dragon roared, the Black Hole shot out, its passage twisting everything terrifyingly, obliterating everything around it.
Roar! Court death.
The Kamaitachi Beast fired back with a brutal roar, its body erupting with boundless red flames that burned heaven and earth. Under the terrifying heat, the domain shield around the Candle Dragon Beast was instantly burnt through, followed by its thick scale armor.
But at that moment, black and white rapidly alternated on the Candle Dragon Beast’s body, and the slowing Time Power descended once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 1017 425 A Fierce Battle Illusion Meditation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1017: Chapter 425: A Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Major Chapter)_3 Chapter 1017: Chapter 425: A Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Major Chapter)_3 Under the power of Time, everything slowed down tremendously, only the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, which had been tempered by the Time Laws, could ignore the effect and move, its massive body streaking like a red light and dashing tens of thousands of meters in the blink of an eye.
The moment the Giant Beast Candle Dragon left, the fleeting Time Power that slowed everything down once again vanished, and a black hole, with endless destructive storm energy compressed by space, appeared right in front of the Kamaitachi Beast.
Roar! Boom!
In a ferocious roar filled with endless rage, a black ice crystal storm exploded, forming a black storm that enveloped more than ten kilometers, freezing and grinding everything into dust.
The powerful energy shock reverberated through the entire ‘world’, the Earth shook, and as the raging wind howled, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its double wings furiously, displaying its terrifying and Overbearing presence.
Huff, huff! The Red Beast, who had used Time Power twice in succession from afar, was panting heavily, its breath weak.
At the same time, on the Earth below, the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon with rapidly regenerating ice crystal scale armor stood up, let out an uplifting roar and shot up into the sky.
In the air, crystals gathered around the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon, forming four sharp hundred-meter-thick crystal pillars shooting towards the explosive storm area, while the Silver Giant Dragon also charged in.
Mythical Giant Beasts are not so easy to kill; their formidable Giant Beast Bodies, refined by the laws, possess indescribable robust vitality, capable of rapid regeneration even if half their bodies are blown apart.
Roar! As the storm burst open, revealing the Kamaitachi Beast with half its scale armor shattered and red flames burning in its wounds, its blood-red eyes emitted an extremely ferocious aura as it pounced towards the Silver Giant Dragon.
Just then, four hundred-meter-thick and thousands of meters long crystal pillars penetrated Heaven and Earth, forming a cross that blocked the Kamaitachi Beast’s path.
Boom! With a swipe of its giant claw, the Kamaitachi Beast blasted the crystal pillars apart, but in the instant they shattered, the heavens filled with crystals released a dazzling light.
Boom, boom, boom! The explosions in the sky caused the Heavenly Energy there to become extremely chaotic, which also caused the Kamaitachi Beast to stagger.
Boom! The Silver Giant Dragon pounced on the Kamaitachi Beast, and the strong impact sent both beasts crashing to the ground like meteors, enveloped in a dazzling light.
Roar, roar, roar! An even more brutal battle erupted in an instant.
With the assistance of the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon, wielding the power of condensing elemental crystals and elemental fusion explosions, and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, controlling the power of time slowing and the alternation of day and night, the Kamaitachi Beast was momentarily at a disadvantage.
However, this beast was equally ferocious and formidable, and as it fought wildly against the Silver Giant Dragon without regard for its wounds, the Silver Giant Dragon also sustained continuous damage.
Meanwhile, as each casual strike from the Giant Beasts could destroy the Earth and collapse mountain peaks, the entire small world shook, the Earth cracked, and flames raged as if Doomsday had arrived.
The battle nearly destroyed the entire ‘world’ and only stopped suddenly after several hours.
Underneath the collapsed mountain ranges, the Kamaitachi Beast lay prostrate, its Full-body Scales Armor shattered, flesh and blood mangled, double wings broken, and spine almost entirely snapped.
Several kilometers away, the Silver Giant Dragon stood tall, its body covered in nearly shattered magnificent silver scales, its left claw broken and hanging limp, and half of its neck torn open, the injury severe.
From those battered wounds dripped droplets of Silver Dragon Blood, which froze the rock upon contact, exuding a strong chill.
In a large pit tens of kilometers away, the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon lay weakly on the ground, one of its lustrous crystal-like Dragon Wings torn, and half its crystalline body shattered.
The Candle Dragon Giant Beast fared worse, its hundred-meter-long tail bitten off by the Kamaitachi Beast, a piece torn away during its retreat, and the flesh on its abdomen blurred.
Although the three-headed Silver Giant Dragon won this battle, it was a Pyrrhic victory, testament to the strength of a Mid-Mythical Stage Monarch Bloodline Giant Beast.
This was the kind of battle Mythical Giant Beasts should have; when the levels and true strength of both sides were not far apart, victory was almost always costly.
As for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, who previously, at a Late Stage 9, unleashed the power of Late Mythical Stage to overwhelm and kill a Black Obliteration Giant Beast, also comparable to Late Mythical Stage, with just light injuries, it was an exception.
Now, with all three beasts heavily injured, even with their vitality, it would take a long time to recover.
However, the Silver Giant Dragon paid no mind to these injuries, its aura exuding ferocity as it let out a roar that shook Heaven and Earth, “Roar! The Great Scythia, invincible.”
Having defeated a Mid-Mythical Stage beast of the same Monarch Bloodline at the Growth Level of an early Mythical Stage, the Silver Giant Dragon was very pleased with its achievement.
But the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon rolled its eyes upon hearing its roar.
Invincible, my foot. If it weren’t for their assistance today, the Silver Giant Dragon at best could have drawn with this Mythical Beast; there would be no chance of seriously injuring or defeating it.
Shaking its head, the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon slightly shifted its position to appear somewhat more graceful.
Yi ya yi ya! We won, the divine tree Divine Fruit is all Great May’s now.
With a childish voice, the purple little dragon joyfully flew in front of the Silver Giant Dragon, opened its mouth wide, and spat out a fine stream of Purple Energy at the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes.
However, this time, the amount of Creation Origin was very little, only one-tenth of what was used earlier to help the Silver Giant Dragon make a breakthrough.
But even so, the power of Creation still caused an outburst of bloodline strength in the Silver Giant Dragon’s body, and once-depleted Life Energy erupted continuously.
Boom! Under the boundless surge of Life Energy, the Silver Giant Dragon’s wounds visibly healed, a spectacle that filled the far-off, weak and powerless Kamaitachi Beast with despair and unwillingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 1018 425 The Fierce Battle Illusion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1018: Chapter 425: The Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Large Chapter)_4 Chapter 1018: Chapter 425: The Fierce Battle, Illusion Meditation Scripture Sixth Level (Large Chapter)_4 “`
These despicable creatures not only besieged it but also brought a Giant Beast with healing abilities.
From a distance, the golden blue Giant Dragon slightly raised its head with a weak roar, “Roar! May, we are here too.”
Yiiya yiiya!!
The Purple little dragon turned into a purple radiance and appeared in front of the golden blue Giant Dragon, spitting out a burst of purple energy from its mouth, which instantly merged into the body of the golden blue Giant Dragon.
Roar! In an instant, the golden blue Giant Dragon’s body released a Seven-Colored Glow, and its aura surged as its broken Dragon Wings and injuries visibly started to regrow and heal at an observable rate.
Moreover, under the influence of the Purple little dragon’s Creation origin, the golden blue Giant Dragon acutely sensed an evolution in its bloodline, surprise evident in its eyes.
It originally thought the Purple little dragon’s power was just for healing, it never expected it could also evolve its bloodline!
While the golden blue Giant Dragon was still in shock, the Purple little dragon flew in front of the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, giving it a wisp of Creation origin as well.
Hum! The Candle Dragon Giant Beast’s body displayed alternating black and white patterns, emitting strong temporal fluctuations, and its aura dramatically increased, almost seeming like it was on the verge of a mythical breakthrough.
Crackle Crackle!! The Candle Dragon Giant Beast’s fractured tail bones grew back, and its flesh and blood regenerated.
But after spitting out three more wisps of Creation origin, even the Purple little dragon, which had consumed a large amount of Ice fish to replenish its origin, was out of strength and listlessly landed on the Silver Giant Dragon’s head.
Yiiya yiiya!! May is so tired and needs to eat Divine Fruits to replenish.
“Roar! No problem, the first ripe Top-grade Divine Fruit will be for you, May,” the Silver Giant Dragon, now mostly recovered from its injuries, said while eyeing the towering red Divine Tree in the distance, with hundreds of Top-grade Divine Fruits hanging on it, its eyes reddening slightly.
Hundreds of Top-grade Divine Fruits, even its mother’s treasury didn’t have so many.
This precious Divine Tree was deliberately avoided by both sides during the previous great battle; even the suppressed Kamaitachi Beast did not consider destroying it.
Or rather, even if it wanted to, it couldn’t; Red halos of substantial thickness enveloped the Divine Tree, radiating incredible energy fluctuations that blocked the resonance from the Giant Beasts’ battle.
Half an hour later, the three partially healed Giant Beasts, the Purple little dragon, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish that had flown over, stood proudly before the Kamaitachi Beast.
Looking at the proudly standing Silver Giant Dragon, fierce unwillingness and rage flashed in the eyes of the Kamaitachi Beast, as it let out a low growl from its bloodied mouth.
This detestable Giant Beast; had they not outnumbered it, how could it possibly have been defeated by a mythical early stage Giant Beast.
But just as the Kamaitachi Beast thought its death was certain, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon exchanged glances, nodded slightly, and then let out a proud roar.
“Roar! I am the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire, the Great Sethia. Today, the strength you have displayed has won my recognition, and now you have two choices,” the Silver Giant Dragon proclaimed.
“Submit to the Great Sethia and join the Dragon Palace. Then your matter of occupying the Divine Tree will be overlooked.”
“As for the second choice, naturally it is to refuse joining the Dragon Palace, in which case I will kill you and take your corpse back to Tim Abott as a meal.”
The Purple little dragon atop the Silver Giant Dragon’s head was surprised, “Yiiya yiiya!! Sethia, aren’t you going to kill it? The Great May wants to see rivers of blood.”
The Silver Giant Dragon paused before roaring, “…Roar! Tim Abott once said, when you are out in the world, you must talk about power, and fighting alone can lead to being besieged like this guy.”
“So Tim Abott once said that when we come across suitable Giant Beasts, we should see if we can subdue them to strengthen the Dragon Palace.”
I see.
The Purple little dragon nodded in realization, and looking at the vast Kamaitachi Beast, resembling a small mountain range, it roared like a child, “Yiiya! Hurry up and submit to the Great May, otherwise, let Sethia bite you to death.”
… The Kamaitachi Beast was stunned for a moment; these creatures were actually not going to kill it.
But the idea of submitting to this Giant Dragon, whose level was lower than its own and whose strength was just barely on par, left the Kamaitachi Beast somewhat reluctant as it was a Beast awakened with ancient bloodline.
Noticing the reluctance in the Kamaitachi Beast’s eyes, the Silver Giant Dragon’s gaze turned icy cold, and it let out a low growl, “Roar! It seems you want to die. Since that’s the case, we’ll kill you and take you back to Tim Abott for food.”
However, just as the Silver Giant Dragon’s mouth began to gather White Light, signaling the approach of death, the Kamaitachi Beast ultimately let out a low growl, “… I am willing to join the Dragon Palace.”
Looking at the Kamaitachi Beast with a hint of reluctance, the Silver Giant Dragon raised its head proudly, “Roar! Don’t be dissatisfied, if it weren’t for the Great Sethia wanting to see how strong the breakthrough is, you’d have been killed already.”
As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon’s Reverse Scales flickered with light, followed by the appearance of over a dozen Green-White Dragon Scales, each several meters thick and over ten meters in size, radiating the Law Aura of Titan Peak.
“`
“Roar! Not bad, if we had wanted to kill you, we would have done it a long time ago.” In the middle of the roar, the Reverse Scale under the neck of the golden-blue Giant Dragon flashed, and more than a dozen thick golden Dragon Scales, each a few meters thick and about ten meters in size, emerged.
The Titan Level Giant Beasts’ Law Aura was likewise emanating from these Dragon Scales.
As a descendant of another Titan Level Giant Dragon, the golden-blue Giant Dragon naturally had the Scale of Laws given by its mother.
At this moment, more than twenty Scales of Laws, each capable of unleashing a Mythical Peak strike, converged, and the invisible Destructive Aura they emitted alarmed the Kamaitachi Beast, its eyes widening in horror.
How is that possible…
At that moment, any indignation in the Kamaitachi Beast’s heart dissipated, clearly recognizing that both Giant Dragons were formidable and not to be provoked.
After willingly submitting, the Kamaitachi Beast looked towards the Purple little dragon expectantly, also desiring the miraculous power that allowed for instant recovery.
Above the head of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Purple little dragon shook its head with hands on its hips: Yiya Yiya!! “Great May has no more strength, you’ll have to recover on your own.”
As the Kamaitachi Beast was slowly absorbing Heavenly Energy to heal, the Silver Giant Dragon growled, “Roar! What kind of tree is that divine tree? When will its Divine Fruits mature?”
The Kamaitachi Beast weakly growled back, “I don’t know, I only found this place a few Sun Wheels ago, and I can’t get close. Each Sun Wheel, a Divine Fruit will mature and fall off.”
“One matures each Sun Wheel.”
The gathered beasts exchanged glances.
“How long until the next Divine Fruit matures?”
“Soon, probably a few star cycles (a few days).”
A few days, huh? The Silver Giant Dragon pondered, then looked at Joe, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish beside him, and gave a low growl: “Roar! Joe, take May back, let it recover by eating Ice fish. We’ll wait here for the Divine Fruit to mature.”
“After Tim Abott wakes up, tell him we’re here. He’s so clever, by then, he should have a way to make these Divine Fruits mature faster.”
Roar roar roar! No problem.
…
While the Silver Giant Dragon was defeating the Kamaitachi Beast, in the imploded ruin of the Void, Jack Clark was also on the last step to refine the Gateway to Heaven.
Amid the wild Void, with the ten-thousand-meter tall Black Stone Gate at the center, the Yellow Earth World filled with Black Wind howling like a hurricane, along with a world of Thunder radiating with lightning, were slowly converging around the Black Stone Gate, emitting a thunderous tremor, shaking internally as if it were Doomsday.
However, under the suppressive force of the Black Stone Gate, all the vibrations were suppressed, eventually forming a projection of four overlapping worlds, with the Black Stone Gate standing at the deepest part of the Fourfold World.
Whew! Jack breathed out and slowly opened his eyes.
Feeling the four Plane Worlds layered across different spatial tiers, all connected and suppressed by the Stone Gate, a smile appeared on Jack’s face.
However, having completed the refinement of the Stone Gate, he didn’t choose to leave. Instead, he flipped his hand and took out a basin-sized black transparent Crystal Stone from the Sumeru Space.
Feeling the vast soul energy coming from the Soul Crystal, Jack thought resounded in his mind: “Transform into Soul Points.”
“You have transformed a High-purity Soul Energy Crystal, gaining 3657 Soul Points.”
“You have transformed a High-purity Soul Energy Crystal, gaining 412 Soul Points…”
As Soul Crystal after Soul Crystal was transformed, the Soul Points on the attribute page increased at an alarming rate, quickly surpassing ten thousand, twenty thousand, thirty thousand…
In the end, the fourteen Mythical Grade Soul Crystals and over twenty Level 9 and level eight Soul Crystals were all converted into a total of 63570 Soul Points.
As his cultivation became stronger and stronger, many resources precious and necessary for Jack were now available in abundance, sparing him from accumulating bit by bit.
“Expend sixty thousand Soul Points to enhance the Illusion Meditation Scripture to the Fifth Layer, Sixth level.”
Instantly, only 3570 Soul Points remained of the newly gained points on the attribute page. Simultaneously, a vast surge of power exploded within Jack, rushing into the depths of his soul.
Boom!
As the overwhelming strengthening energy enveloped him, his Soul True Body, wearing the Imperial Robe and wielding the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, emerged, soul luminance flashing upon him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 1019 426 The Awakening of the Heavenly Tier
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1019: Chapter 426: The Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan Chapter 1019: Chapter 426: The Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan The moment the intense soul power enveloped Jack’s true soul body, the imperial robe glittered on the surface of his person, transforming back into countless ancient characters.
These characters, written in the primitive script from the Illusion Meditation Scripture, were even more abstract and ancient than oracle bone script, with each stroke representing some trace of power, exuding a mysterious aura.
These characters constantly dissolved and reformed, integrating into the true soul body and forming a series of chains resembling both meridians and runes.
Boom!
The true soul’s stature surged, its soul pressure growing stronger and stronger, the pervasive soul energy even forming a halo behind the head, similar to a Buddha’s halo, yet black in color.
Under the relentless strengthening of pure soul energy, the true soul nearly swelled to three hundred meters before stopping, with a throne condensed from soul power materializing underneath it as well.
Hum!
The very moment the true body, donning the All-Heaven Emperor Crown and encircled by a halo of soul divine light, sat upon the throne, an invincible ripple of vibration burst forth.
Whirrrrr!
Behind the throne, chains of black soul links appeared, extending deep into the soul space like a web from the hell of legends, lending an unparalleled majesty to Jack, clad in an emperor robe.
The breakthrough to the sixth level of the true soul was terrifying; the pervasive soul power was so fierce that it continuously shook the entire soul space.
Jack’s consciousness merged with his soul, silently experiencing the changes from the Cultivation Method breakthrough before he called up the attribute page with a thought.
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture+[Sixth Level, cultivated to perfection, sitting high upon the Soul Throne, embodying an Emperor of Souls.
Note: This Cultivation Method has touched the essence of the soul, ready to reach out to one of the Supreme Laws of Soul Divergence, the Higher-order Soul Sequence Chain]
The breakthrough to the sixth level of the Illusion Meditation Scripture didn’t bring significant ‘changes,’ only made the true soul stronger and touched the Soul Sequence Chain law.
But when Jack, seated upon the throne, slightly pressed his right hand forward.
Boom! In an instant, a profound and mighty soul power erupted, violently shaking the entire soul space with that one palm strike.
“So strong,” Jack exclaimed in surprise as he retracted his hand.
At that moment, Jack felt that with just his true soul body alone, he could rival a Ninth Heaven Peak strong man, descending upon the Outer World to disrupt reality.
However, the biggest change this time was in the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, the Initial Soul Treasure that had fused with Jack’s soul. As the Cultivation Methods broke through, it too underwent a transformation and advanced.
Moreover, with the Primordial Rule contained within, Jack felt that even if a mythical powerhouse in the mid-mythical stage stood before him, he could scatter their divine soul with a single strike from the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal.
However, attacks involving the soul are akin to sacrificing eight hundred of one’s own troops to kill a thousand enemies; it’s unnecessary to use the power of the soul unless absolutely indispensable, or when it concerns divine powers related to the soul.
As a cultivator, the real benefit of a strong soul is the comprehension, control, and endurance of laws, allowing the same power to exert a far greater might.
In contemplation, Jack, in his true soul form, slowly turned his head to the side. His eyes were like black vortexes, his gaze penetrating dimensions and seeing the Giant Beast’s soul that resided in another plane.
Compared to the main body’s soul, which had condensed into an Emperor of Souls by the Cultivation Method, the soul of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was kilometer-long just like its physical form, with white flames of soul burning on its surface.
But unlike its outer appearance, the soul of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was transparent, almost crystallized, with the primitive character ‘Vast’ faintly emerging at the center of its forehead.
The transformation of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was not limited to its physique but extended to its soul, which had also evolved under the life restructuring of a Heavenly Tier being, resembling a colossal glass crystal laid across the void, invisibly exuding terrifying pressure.
With the increase in strength and differences in the power system, the differences between the body and the Giant Beast Avatar, both in physical form and soul, were growing larger.
If not for the Soul Talent suppression and the uniqueness of the Soul Origin, the main body and the avatar would have long become two independent entities like Jonathan Walker.
In truth, the Illusion Meditation Scripture, inherited from ancient times, wasn’t so powerful; the strongest cultivator that practiced this secret soul technique only reached the king-level in the mythical stage.
The substantial transformations Jack experienced now were due to his innately incredibly robust soul, which, under the feedback of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, had already exceeded that of ordinary people by a hundredfold.
Withdrawing from the merged state of the soul, Jack slowly opened his eyes.
Now that the Illusion Meditation Scripture had also made a breakthrough to the sixth level, nearly thirty strands of World Origin within him had been consumed, translating laws and completing seventy percent of the Tempering True Body, with his cultivation approaching the limit of the Ninth Heavens.
Jack felt that with just a bit of solidification in his realm, he could break through to the Mythical King Realm.
But it still wasn’t enough, there was the final step missing.
Due to the rapid advancement in cultivation, the scope of the four Illusory Plane Worlds had only extended to fourteen kilometers, quite a distance from the Overlapping Opening Heaven’s standard.
Initially, he contemplated leveraging the power of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to hunt more beasts from the Ninth Heavens and Mythical Giant Beasts, using their skeletons to rapidly expand the Plane World with their refined essence.
However, both his and the Thunderflame Behemoth’s strength had advanced too quickly, so much so that past arrangements and plans needed readjustment.
Given the current situation, Jack no longer had the time to wait for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to hunt Mythical Giant Beasts and was preparing to seek assistance from the Federation.
With his talent, which forecasted him to reach the mythical stage in just one year, and the frightening combat power that could Reverse Defeat mythic beings even at the Ninth Heavens level, it shouldn’t be a problem for the Supreme Experts to mobilize the entire Federation’s power.
Even though the Federation’s logistics didn’t have many world-class resources, many Mythical Powerhouses and Heavenly Kings were sure to have such collections in their possession.

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 1020 426 The Awakening of the Heavenly Tier
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1020: Chapter 426 The Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan_2 Chapter 1020: Chapter 426 The Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan_2 For instance, War King Elmore Hall had casually handed out four World Star Core Fragments to Jack Clark as a reward.
Hum! Behind Jack Clark vibrated, a black Stone Gate opened, and with it, Jack Clark’s figure silently disappeared into the depths of the Void.
Outside, it was already ‘The third day’ after the Collapse of the Ruins, and the once violently shaking space had returned to tranquility.
Dressed in white robes, Jewell and a middle-aged man in a magnificent golden battle armor stood back to back on the hillside; Sid Hawk and others had not left yet, each finding a large rock to sit on and cultivate.
Although this venture into the relics was brief, everyone had gained something.
Especially Jane Aiken, who emerged the day before yesterday and was now sitting cross-legged on a weather-worn Hundred-meter Stone Peak, surrounded by Sword Intent swirling and distorting the space, revealing a Sword Domain projection.
In addition, the towering Howard Lambert was quietly cultivating in his ferocious black armor, enveloped by a thick dark red Aura of Killing Intent, foreboding and overwhelming.
Just then, in the high altitude hundreds of meters above, Space Distortion occurred, and Jack Clark, with black hair cascading over his shoulders and clad in black and red opulent battle armor, appeared out of thin air, instantly awakening everyone.
There was no helping it; although Jack Clark had restrained his Aura, there was still an invisible heavy oppressive sensation that spread out, making Sid Hawk and others feel stifled in their breathing.
It was as if not a person stood there, but a giant that overshadowed the Firmament.
Jane Aiken’s Sword Intent receded as she stood up, “Jack Clark, you’ve finally come out.”
The others also stood up to greet him.
Looking at Jack Clark descending from above, Howard Lambert sighed, “You’ve become more and more abnormal in the few months that we haven’t seen each other. It feels impossible to catch up to you.”
Jack Clark nodded at Joshua Welan and the others in the distance as a greeting, then turned to Howard Lambert with a slight smile, “Everyone’s physique is different, there’s no need to compare with me.”
“If you really feel the pressure, you can go back and take a look at those classmates of ours. Many of them are only at Third or Fourth Layer Heaven by now. You would surely feel a sense of superiority then.”
“Eh… I’d rather not,” Howard Lambert said, speechless.
What fun is there in comparing oneself with weaker classmates? One’s motivation can only be ignited by comparing with someone stronger, like the goal he had initially set out to surpass, Jane Aiken.
However… it seemed like he still hadn’t caught up to Jane Aiken.
At that moment, Jewell True Immortal and the middle-aged man in the golden battle armor flashed before them, somewhat surprised, “Jack Clark, your Aura is at the Nine-fold Peak… nearing perfection!”
A few days ago, when Jack Clark entered the relic, he had just touched upon the rule, and had not fully stepped into the Ninth Heaven Peak. They had not expected that he would almost complete the rule Tempering now.
This terrifying pace of cultivation progress surprised even the two Mythical Powerhouses.
Jack Clark nodded with a smile, “This time in the relics, I achieved some gains, plus witnessing the scene of the world’s destruction provided some insights, which have refined my cultivation a bit more.”
Jewell True Immortal shook his head, “What you’ve achieved is more than just a bit.”
The step of the Ninth Heaven Peak halts too many Transcendent strong men, and many with outstanding talent who have sensed the rules can only slowly complete the real body’s Tempering over a long time.
One reason is the need to slowly extract and refine the Origin strength from between heaven and earth, and the other is that the soul is not strong enough to withstand the prolonged consumption of Tempering the rules.
Suddenly, Jack Clark spoke in a low voice, “Jewell Throne, have there been any reactions from that side after a few days?”
Jewell True Immortal softly shook his head, “No, the Divine Realms of the three Evil God Sects, including that of the Demon God Sect, are all under surveillance, but until now, no strong waves of blood sacrifice have been detected.”
“The Purgatory Family didn’t take the bait this time,” Jack Clark said, somewhat surprised.
The Imperial Capital True Immortal in golden battle armor pondered, “It must be due to their previous defeats making them more vigilant. They must have sensed something.”
Being ambushed ‘accidentally’ two or three times in a row and having lost a few Demon King Level Strong men, the Purgatory Family would be too foolish if it did not react this time.
Though the previous incidents of ambushing Augusta’s two Demon Kings were a matter of chance.
Since the Purgatory Family was not fooled this time, Jack Clark naturally did not want to waste more time here, “Jewell Throne, Imperial Capital Throne, I already feel the opportunity for a breakthrough and plan to return to the Outer Development Department for Closed-door Cultivation. I’m planning to put aside the affairs here for now.”
Jack Clark had another plan for this arrival, which was that if the Purgatory Family did not fall for the lure, he would take up the role of the chief guard of the Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain and, together with the five king-level warriors of the Human Divine Domain, suppress the entire Evil God Alliance.
They would crush all the enemies of the Human Race, including the Giant God Sect, Shadow God Sect, Eternal God Church, and the Demon God Sect, thereby stabilizing the situation on this front.
Ready for a breakthrough? Jewell True Immortal and Imperial Capital True Immortal exchanged a look, both revealing astonishment as Jack Clark’s records showed he had only been cultivating for one year.
A one-year Myth, what kind of monster was this?
Whoosh!
High above, a terrifying dark-red fighter aircraft sped across, tearing through the seas of clouds. In the living area, Jack Clark, Jane Aiken, and Howard Lambert sat on one side, sipping their drinks.
As for those with higher cultivation levels like Sid Hawk, Ida Carroll, and Joshua Welan, they had other missions.
As Ninth Heaven Experts, they counted as core forces in the Human Race. After spending a rapid period of cultivation advancement, they would often be entrusted with important missions.
The towering Howard Lambert sat in a chair in the fighter aircraft’s living area, feeling a tinge of regret, “I was lucky this time, obtained an inheritance from the Bloodslaught Domination Clan and managed to forcefully make a breakthrough to Eight Layer.”
“However, the power system of this different race conflicts somewhat with the power system of the Ancient Civilization’s Heavenly Evil Demon Manual, so it might take me a few months to adjust and reforge my True Body.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 1021 426 Awakening of the Heavenly Tier
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1021: Chapter 426: Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan_3 Chapter 1021: Chapter 426: Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan_3 “So I’m planning to return to Blue Star for a trip, to retreat for some cultivation and relax my spirit.”
Across from him, Jack Clark took a sip of condensed fruit juice and then a smile appeared in his eyes, “Howard Lambert, I guess your real goal is to go back and attend the school’s freshman opening ceremony.”
Although Howard Lambert seemed calm and honest, at his core, he was still a seventeen-year-old youth with a desire to show off.
“You actually figured it out.”
Howard Lambert’s rugged face broke into a smile as he turned to Jane Aiken, “Student Aiken, do you want to go back and join the fun?”
Jane Aiken shook her head indifferently, “I won’t go back. I’m planning to enter closed-door cultivation to strive for an early breakthrough to Nine Layers or even become king-level.”
As for showing off, the girl wasn’t very interested. Now, with Jack Clark on the verge of breaking through to Mythical King status, and her only at Mid-Eighth Layer, she was prepared to work hard to catch up.
With a foundation that had almost completed the Road of Heavenly Kings and the World Origin, coupled with the insight into the Sword Path from the destruction of a world, her cultivation realm was already sufficient.
The next step was silent cultivation.
“It looks like it’s just me going back this time.” With that, Howard Lambert let out a sigh of relief and a grin spread across his face.
With Jack Clark entering closed-door cultivation to break through to Mythical King and unable to return, and Jane Aiken not going back, his one-year Eight Layer cultivation would be enough to suppress the entire South Sky Martial Arts School.
Ha ha… It was finally Howard Lambert’s turn to show his mettle in front of others.
As for geniuses like Justin Welan and Crystal Lewis, their cultivation was at most at the Sixth Layer now, not enough to cause concern.
On the way, the three of them exchanged their cultivation experiences, and the fighter aircraft flew at nearly ten times the speed of sound for more than ten hours, approaching the base of the 30th Army Group.
Unlike the Seventh Corps built around a divine tree, the base of the 30th Army Group was on a floating island ten thousand meters in altitude, with the island covering hundreds of kilometers.
A city filled with a futuristic sci-fi vibe stood under the red sunlight. As the dark red fighter aircraft approached the base of the 30th Army Group, many people below showed looks of excitement.
“Look! It’s a Throne Fighter aircraft.”
“A new king-throne has come to our base.”
“Eh… What are you excited about? This king is probably just passing through and not staying at our base.”
Amidst the excitement, curiosity, and awe of the Special Forces Soldiers and the ‘new humans’ of the city, the fighter aircraft landed at the central circular airport guided by the base.
Clack! The rear hatch of the fighter aircraft opened, and Jack Clark and his two companions, clad in battle armor, walked down where three young soldiers in military uniform were waiting.
Seeing Jack Clark and the others descending, the three soldiers saluted respectfully, “Hello, General Clark, Colonel Aiken, Colonel Lambert, my name is Li Feng, and I’m in charge of welcoming you.”
After a brief exchange of pleasantries, Jack Clark followed Li Feng to see Sky Knife King Sheehan Wade, and Jane Aiken went with another soldier to a place for closed-door cultivation.
As for Howard Lambert, he was left with the remaining logistics soldier who arranged for transport to Base No.1’s Logistics City.
This is the life of cultivators, coming and going in a hurry, as everyone’s time is extremely valuable.
Or you could say that in the current situation, no one has time to enjoy leisure, including those kings who are either in closed-door cultivation or holding ground in their domain.
Soon after, with Jack Clark having met the Sky Knife King and communicated with the Third Councilor guarding the Outer Development Department through the base’s communications.
A few minutes later, the Primordial True King, using the authority of a Councilor, convened the Councilor Conference.
In the Dark Void created by the power of law, a total of sixty-five stone thrones stood tall, each throne flickering with special runes.
Boom! As strong wills descended, appearing as projections on each throne, the entire Void world trembled.
Especially when three terrifying wills descended on the main seats, the whole Void world even cracked, as if unable to bear the presence.
…
In the Rift World, while the kings were holding their meeting, the purple little dragon perched on the head of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish had also returned to the Rift World.
Thump!
The Giant Beast Tiger Whale plunged into the lake, instantly causing the water to explode and its massive body stirred up violent waves as it dove a thousand meters underwater to a palace made of shells.
In the palace at that moment, numerous white-skinned Naga girls with human torso and fish tails were frolicking playfully. When they saw the enormous beast approaching, they all paused and then bowed respectfully.
“Greetings to His Majesty, the King of Black and White, and to Lady May.”
Then a Naga with long black hair and a stunningly beautiful face swam out and said respectfully, “King of Black and White, Lady May, may I ask what brings you here?”
The purple little dragon on top of the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish waved its double claws, chirping excitedly, “Yiyi yiyi! The great Lady May wants to eat fish.”
Instantly Ning Lawson showed hesitation on her face, “But Lady May, the new batch of Ice fish is not yet mature, and if eaten now, they won’t contain enough energy.”
Yiyi yiyi! It doesn’t matter, just eat a couple more if they’re not enough.
“Alright then.” Ning Lawson nodded, since the purple little dragon was not particular, she certainly did not dare to disobey.
But at that moment, the little purple dragon’s eyes suddenly lit up, looking excitedly towards the surface of the lake in the distance, chirping: Yiyi yiyi! Big brother is waking up.
Just as the purple little dragon finished speaking, a terrifying aura that made the entire world shudder erupted in the distance.
Boom!
In the center of the Lava Lake, the region where eight law powers converged like a Chaos egg suddenly collapsed, the law radiance faded away, revealing a beast over one thousand and thirty meters long.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 1022 426 Awakening of the Heavenly Tier
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1022: Chapter 426: Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan_4 Chapter 1022: Chapter 426: Awakening of the Heavenly Tier Colossus, Messenger of the Heavenly Feather Clan_4 After completing the Heavenly Tier Transformation, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s form hadn’t changed much; its entire body was still covered with black-red scaled armor, its physique was strong and fierce, and its tail was long and whip-like.
Three rows of sharp extensions that resembled mountain peaks ran along its back to its tail, and from its double shoulder grew black-red scaled metallic blade-like wings, folded behind and appearing even more thick and ferocious.
The most noticeable change was in its head; not only did dense black mane sprout from the gaps in the scale armor, but also three pairs of feather horns extending back on each side like a pair of red wings.
At the same time, in addition to the split black dragon horns in front, three pairs of sharp, spiral black horns grew backward on both sides, forming a crown-like ring.
But these were only the external changes. Now, with each breath the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon took, the entire small world’s Heaven and Earth resonated, stirring up surges of energy tides.
And as the energy tides of the Rift World’s Heaven and Earth formed, the environment of the entire world was changing too.
For example, flames appeared out of nowhere at the world’s edge, burning the rock and dirt into magma, while above in the Firmament, the cloud mist was pervasive, with streaks of thunder flashing.
At this moment, the entire Rift World was influenced by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, transforming the environment to suit it.
However, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon wasn’t concerned with these changes and was silently experiencing the tempering of the eight Higher-order Laws, feeling its terrifying body that had transformed after reaching the Heavenly Tier.
For instance, in the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s perception, its body was like a world linked to the ‘Chaos Void’, absorbing massive amounts of pure energy every moment for its Evolution and growth.
The Evolution value was also increasing bit by bit.
This is the essence of a ‘Heavenly Tier’ being; it is a complete world in itself, independent of Heaven and Earth.
Of course, this ‘world’ is only an analogy. It doesn’t mean that within the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon there exists a realm like the Void world Jack Clark created, but rather that in terms of position pattern, it is equivalent to a world.
This is what is meant by being a ‘Heavenly’ Tier being; essentially, it is equivalent to a complete world.
Even without plundering God-level resources or hunting down God-level Giant Beasts, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon’s power will grow at an astonishing rate.
For example, after hibernating for several days, it had grown by more than thirty meters—if we calculate, it could grow two hundred meters in a little over forty days.
Under normal conditions, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon would only need about one to two Sun Wheels, which is equivalent to ‘two days’ in other Mythical Giant Beast concepts, to grow from the Mid-Mythical Stage to the late period.
This speed could be said to be terrifyingly frightening.
And just as the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was awakening, surprise showed in Jack Clark’s eyes as he waited for the meeting results in the conference room.
Inside his body, every moment there was a strand of strengthening energy emerging, continuously and slowly fortifying his True Body, and the powerful aura emanating invisibly from his body became more and more profound.
“This is the change of ‘Heaven’, isn’t it.”
Feeling the changes within and the terrifying power contained by the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark slowly exhaled and then called up the attribute page again.
Avatar Body: Cang. Tian. Destruction Emperor Dragon
Level: Mid-Mythical Stage [Possesses eight types of Higher-order Laws, one Special Deification Talent, recognized by Heaven and Earth and engraved with a true name at the core of the mythical world in ancient times]
Laws: Strength.Destruction [Evolution fusion 32%], Defense. Vajra [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 31%], Chaotic Dark Power [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 30%]
Great Sun Golden Flame [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 22%], Law of Speed [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 8%], Origin of Life [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 9%]
Annihilation Thunder of Chaotic Hole [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 9%], Corrosion Law [Higher-order, Evolution fusion 8%]
Special Talent: Gigantification [Deification]
Evolution value: 87154/2000000
After the transformation was completed, the Giant Beast Avatar’s information became very concise. The ‘Cang’ and ‘Tian’ in the name were separated, and Thunderflame disappeared, becoming the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
All eight Higher-order Laws had undergone transformation, among which Strength.Destruction, Vajra, and Chaotic Dark Power, the earliest ones it had, had reached a state of minor achievement in their Evolution and growth.
As for how strong it really was, Jack Clark wasn’t clear at the moment without a comparison; he would need to fight a Titan Giant Beast to know.
But at this moment, a look of indulgence appeared in the eyes of both Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as they saw a purple radiance shooting towards them from a distance.
Aieee ya, Brother, you’re awake.
In the childish and milky voice, the Purple little dragon appeared in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon with excitement towards his terrifying golden vertical pupils.
An invisible majestic pressure emanated from him, crushing the surrounding space and forming a dark distorted area of several thousand kilometers. The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly curved the corners of his mouth into a fierce smile, emitting a dull low roar from his nostrils.
“Mhm, I’m awake,” he said.
“But Misss Joseline, why does your aura seem a bit weak?” The Destruction Emperor Dragon sensitively noticed something off about the Purple little dragon’s aura.
At the mention of this, the Purple little dragon became spirited: Aieee ya, May led Scythia and the others into a fight.
A fight?
The Purple little dragon excitedly shouted: Aieee ya, Joe found a huge divine tree, and it bore over a hundred top-grade Divine Fruits…
The Purple little dragon then explained the battle that took place, dancing and exaggerating the details with glee to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
She briefly glossed over the ferocious combat of the Silver Giant Dragon and others, mainly mentioning how important she was by releasing the power of Creation to help them recover from their injuries.
After the Purple little dragon finished speaking, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could not help but let out a surprised roar, “Over a hundred top-grade Divine Fruits? That many!”
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon was somewhat astonished by this impressive haul.
Rooooar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, you’re awake.
Then the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish flew over excitedly, calling out jubilantly from afar, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked frightening after his breakthrough, with even his presence making it tremble.
It was clear that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had become even more powerful.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared lowly, “Joe, lead the way. Let’s go see the divine fruits at Scythia.”
Rooooar! Okay.
The freshly returned Single-horned Tiger Kingfish excitedly nodded and immediately flew back towards the rift world beyond.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon followed the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish to inspect the Divine Fruits, millions of kilometers away from Human Territory, a golden battleship tens of kilometers long swiftly soared through the sky.
Upon this vast battleship, the Mysterious Martial Sky King with imposing demeanor stood with his hands behind his back at the edge, staring blankly at the quickly receding landscape beneath.
Having been away for several months, he wondered if Misss Joseline had successfully awakened.
Actually, apart from the importance of his mission to different races, which no ordinary Heavenly King could handle, Mysterious Martial Sky King also feared hearing bad news.
As the last living relative, even the Mysterious Martial Sky King was somewhat afraid to lose his composure the moment Mathilda Ward fell into Hibernation.
He feared that if he heard Mathilda Ward had failed, he would lose control of himself and his killing intent, and once more wage into the rear of The Purgatory Family.
Sigh! Ilisa will definitely be fine, the Mysterious Martial Sky King exhaled.
At that moment, a middle-aged man with golden hair, standing at 1.9 meters tall and with three pairs of wings made entirely of golden light emerged in the distance.
He radiated with the terrifying aura of a late-period Heavenly King.
“After passing three more Great Forbidden Zones, we’ll be in the Human Federation Territory.”
“The area where the Human Race resides is that dangerous?”
“Yes, if it wasn’t dangerous, the Purgatory Family wouldn’t be held back. There’s always a give and take,” the middle-aged man replied.
Relative to other expansive areas, the Human Race’s domain is like a dark jungle teeming with danger, making expansion difficult.
As the Mysterious Martial Sky King led the Heavenly Feather Clan’s messenger towards the Human Territory,

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 1023 427 The Throne Conference The Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1023: Chapter 427: The Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World Chapter 1023: Chapter 427: The Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World In the Dark Void, thirty-nine figures stood erect upon sixty-five thrones.
Some of these empty thrones belonged to monarchs who had fallen, their radiance dim and hidden in aspect, while others belonged to those kings who delved deep into the mythical world, no longer within the Human Race’s domain.
This included the five members of the Divine Gods Alliance, such as Jewell True Immortal.
As for why there were seven monarchs that joined the Divine Gods Alliance, yet only five were present, it was because the other two had truly forsaken the Human Race and proclaimed themselves as gods.
After all, as long as someone is human, they have selfish desires, and even under the pressure of racial extinction, it’s only possible to unite most of the top strong men.
Soon, after all the kings and Heavenly Kings who could arrive, including the will of three Supreme Experts, had descended, Adam Garcetti on the main seat, his form towering, slowly spoke.
“Eric, you’ve suddenly called for a Throne Conference; has there been a change of events with the Divine Gods Alliance?”
Compared to his usual middle-aged appearance, the First Councilor, with his will descended, had an immensely towering figure, sitting ten thousand meters tall on a throne deep in the Void.
His hair, half black and half white and a thousand zhang long, moved without wind, emitting a dark fluctuation, forming a complete world projection around him that radiated a terrifying pressure.
The Sky-based God King at his side was similar, with a ten-thousand-meter-tall Mecha Projection standing erect; a pair of wings stretched behind him, exuding boundless golden radiance as though a god had descended.
The expression of the will of the Primordial True King was that of a creature resembling an ape yet not an ape, with long arms and a massive frame ten thousand meters tall, slightly hunched and seated on the throne.
Other Heavenly Kings and Mythical Kings were much the same, their Will Projections all revealing their essence of strength, like Sky King Denny Kaye, enveloped in a fearsome shadow hidden in darkness.
As for True Martial Heavenly King, just one step below the three Supreme Experts, he appeared more normal, still with the dignified figure of a middle-aged man, with a ten-thousand-meter-tall stele rising behind him.
Faced with the inquiry of the First Councilor, the Primordial True King, with a voice as deep as a world-ending demon ape, said, “There has indeed been an unexpected incident here, but it’s not much related to the Divine Gods Alliance.”
“This time, The Purgatory Family has been very cautious. They did not send a Peak Awakening Great Demon King to assassinate Jack Clark, and the plan to subsequently level the Evil God Alliance must also be temporarily set aside.”
“Because Jack Clark’s cultivation has progressed too swiftly, he’s already at the point where he’s about to condense his True Body; he needs to go into closed-door cultivation for a breakthrough.”
No sooner had the Primordial True King finished speaking than the True Martial Heavenly King across from him expressed surprise, “Wait, Primordial True King, did you say Jack Clark is about to condense his True Body?”
Having departed for other important matters after the battle at Heavenly Abyss, the True Martial Heavenly King still remembered that just over ten days ago, Jack Clark was only at the early stage of the Ninth Heavens.
Across from him, Gabriel, shrouded in White Light, spoke with a warm smile, “True Martial, you’re behind on the news. Four days ago when Jack Clark went to the Divine Gods Alliance, he was already at the late stage of the Ninth Heavens.”
“But for him to go from the late stage to the peak limit of Nine-fold Peak in just four days, this young man’s cultivation speed is becoming more and more exaggerated, as if there’s no limit.”
At this, Gabriel King couldn’t help but bitterly smile.
Under normal conditions, the higher the cultivation level, the slower the speed of breakthroughs, similar to the change from a barrel to a lake.
A cultivator at the First Layer Heaven is akin to a barrel, where adding one-tenth of the water only takes a few days, but when reaching the Ninth Heavens, the cultivation has expanded to a lake.
At that level, adding one-tenth of the water becomes a vast amount.
However, Jack Clark’s performance completely defied normal principles, and it was no longer appropriate to describe him as a monster or an Unparalleled Genius, for even monsters were not so exaggerated.
Also cloaked in darkness, Sky King Denny Kaye exclaimed, “Three months ago when Mysterious Martial and I met this young chap, he seemed to have just broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, and now to think…”
At this point, those strong figures who had once encountered Jack Clark showed astonished and bewildered expressions, while the kings guarding the Sky Curtain Battlefield appeared somewhat at a loss.
In addition to this, these kings were also surprised that this genius named Jack Clark had already become acquainted with so many ‘big shots.’
Then the Primordial True King spoke in a somber tone, “I’ve called for a Councilor Conference this time because as Jack Clark is about to break through to king-level, he also wishes to perform Opening the Heavens and condense the Supreme Law.”
“But because his cultivation has risen too rapidly, the Four-fold Virtual Plane World he opened up when breaking through to the Eighth Layer Heaven over a month ago is not strong enough, or rather, it’s far from sufficient.”
“Therefore, I hope you all can bring out any resources that can strengthen the world type to lend him a helping hand. Of course, these resources will be exchanged for merit records.”
“By the way, here’s the record of this young fellow’s cultivation journey since he entered Martial Arts School a year ago.”
As he spoke, the Primordial True King waved slightly, and in an instant, several streams of dark red Divine Light fell before each king.
Because of Jack Clark’s ever-increasing authority and identity, half of these kings had never heard of Jack Clark, and although the rest had come into contact with him after the battle at Heavenly Abyss, they knew very ‘little’ about him.
But now that Jack Clark was about to break through to king-level, all this information could be made public.
In their puzzlement, each king’s projection caught the dark red Divine Light that they received, and immediately, a surge of information about Jack Clark’s experiences emerged.
This included his trial performances on the Kelaya Battlefield, his sweeping rise on the Southern Battlefield, followed by the ambush and assassination of several demon kings with the Evil God Clone, and other merits.
Moreover, there was his terrifying performance on the Ruins Continent, such as completing the Path of the Gods and receiving the Inheritance of the Ancient Civilization Emperor.
Especially the Inheritance of the Ancient Civilization Emperor left all kings in shock.
Most kings and Heavenly Kings were familiar with the Void Relic Continent, having entered in the past to acquire inheritances and the World Origin to break through to king-level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 1024 427 The Throne Conference The Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1024: Chapter 427: The Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World_2 Chapter 1024: Chapter 427: The Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World_2 Including the Three Great Speakers.
So naturally they knew how difficult it was to complete that path. One needs not only a foundation of soul strength tens of times greater than that of their peers, but also a stunningly brilliant talent for comprehension.
Otherwise, even if one’s soul strength is adequate, there will not be enough time to comprehend the World Origin projection to traverse the Road of Heavenly Kings.
“Hiss! The Legacy of the Civilization Emperor.” A king-level figure couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression on his face.
Sky King Denny Kaye was also somewhat astonished, “This little guy actually completed the Road to Becoming a God!?”
A king-level figure with a burly build laughed heartily, “Hahaha… I didn’t expect that another peerless monster, a talent unprecedented in our history, would emerge from the Human Race.”
“True King Councilor, I just happen to have a Dragon Rock World Stone in my hands that can strengthen the foundation of a world. Consider it a congratulatory gift for his advance to the mythical realm.”
Another king-level figure also showed a smile, “I didn’t expect such a monster to appear before the eruption of the Second Mythical Impact, a one-year myth, peerless within the same rank. It seems that ‘Heaven’ has not abandoned our Human Race.”
“Let’s not bother with contribution and such; as it happens, I have two Construction Wood Tree Branches on hand. Let’s make them his congratulatory gifts for advancing to the mythical realm.”
“Last month, when I slew a Mythical Giant Beast, I ‘picked up’ a Sky Cloud Illusion Divine Crystal that contains a dense amount of Boundary strength…”
After reviewing Jack Clark’s ‘data’, the atmosphere at the Throne Conference became charged with enthusiasm.
Immediately, twenty-three king-level figures and two Heavenly Kings offered to provide resources from their collections that could strengthen worlds.
Compared to that similarly dazzling but treacherous traitor of yesteryears, Jack Clark’s ‘record’ made him appear upright and loyal.
Not only was his cultivation talent unsurpassed, but his contributions to the Federation were also immensely impressive—for instance, more than ten demon kings had either died indirectly or directly by his hand before he even made his breakthrough to king level.
There was naturally no concern about him betraying their expectations.
Moreover, given Jack Clark’s astonishing combat power, once he successfully performs Opening the Heavens and grasps the Supreme Law, his strength would be enough to dominate at the Mythical King level, unbeatable on the battlefield.
Even a typical Heavenly King might not be his match.
In the face of such talent, who could be considered the future hope of the Human Race, at this moment, all the kings were generous, willing to offer up any world-strengthening resources they had at hand.
Once the atmosphere quieted down a bit, the First Councilor sitting in the main seat turned to the Primordial True King, “I and Heaven’s Foundation are now suppressing the Sky Curtain here and can’t leave, so I’ll need you and Denny Kaye to protect Jack Clark when the time comes.”
“It’s a shame Mad Wheeler, in pursuit of a breakthrough chance to the Supreme, has already ventured deep into the mythical world for several years; otherwise, he would be more suitable to protect Jack Clark.”
“As the only one in the Federation who completed Opening the Heavens, grasping the Supreme Law, his experience in establishing worlds would likely be helpful to Jack Clark.”
Jack Clark’s initial breakthrough to the Eighth Layer Consolidation and Fourfold World manifestation was already a magnificent event, let alone this time when he attempts the breakthrough to the mythical realm and performs Opening the Heavens to ‘prove his path.’
The scene then will be unimaginably spectacular, yet also incredibly dangerous—not only might the Purgatory Family take action to stop him, but it might also attract some unknown and terrifying entities.
There’s no help for it, the mythical world is too vast and mysterious, inhabited by numerous frighteningly powerful lives.
…
In a room that looked just like an ordinary office, in the rest area, an elder sitting on a sofa slowly opened his eyes and looked at Jack Clark, who was drinking tea opposite him, and smiled slightly.
“No problem now, I’ve just finished discussing your request at the meeting, and those old fellows all agreed to provide their world-type resources to help you breakthrough.”
“In a moment, these resources will be transported here through a designated Spatial Channel. They should be enough to strengthen your Four-fold Plane World to the level of a small world.”
Jack Clark sincerely thanked him, “Thank you, Primordial Senior, and all the king-level seniors.”
The Primordial True King shook his head, “No need for formalities, this is what we should do. Only with a continuous and abundant source of cultivated blood from the younger generation can our Human Race keep growing stronger.”
Then the Primordial True King gave Jack Clark some more reminders, alerting him to the things he should pay attention to when breaking through to king level later.
While the two were speaking, inside the Logistics Warehouse center of the 30th Army Group, within the independent space transmission rune array, radiance flickered, and sealed jade boxes kept appearing.
In addition to those items requiring firm jade seals, there were also several crystal ores of several meters in diameter…
Soon, all these resources were taken into a Storage Bracelet.
Half an hour later, the doors of a closed-door cultivation room in the Floating City slowly closed.
In the massive closed-door cultivation room of a thousand square meters and a hundred meters tall, Jack Clark sat cross-legged, while nearly a hundred god-level resources containing Boundary strength floated before him.
These divine objects varied, some were like a soft and formless cloud mist, others like a winding galaxy flowing in the jade box, dazzling and mysterious, and some looked like several-meter-long withered branches, their exterior cracked and their aura profound and elusive.
Looking at these resources, Jack Clark could not help but slowly exhale, a yellow world projection occupying the entire cultivation room emerged behind him, followed by golden flames, black wind, and blue thunder.
Within the depths where multiple worlds overlapped, a black stone gate stood tall, emitting an aura heavy enough to Suppress Heaven and Earth.
After the Plane World projection unfolded, Jack Clark’s realm of thought commanded, and the floating strengthening resources under an Invisible Power suddenly shook and rushed into the world projection behind him.
Boom!! The Four-fold Plane World trembled violently…
At the same time, with Jack Clark entering closed-door Cultivation, the entire 30th Army Group’s station began to go on alert, awaiting that moment he emerges from seclusion, Opening the Heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 1025 427 Throne Conference The Giant Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1025: Chapter 427: Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World_3 Chapter 1025: Chapter 427: Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World_3 While Jack Clark was in closed-door cultivation making his final preparations, deep within the Divine Realm of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe, where the Divine Gods Alliance’s rear was located, great divine temples stood with pillars stretching thousands of meters tall, interwoven and towering.
Now on either side of the temple, eight divine beings exuding a Mythical Aura stood erect, and upon the main seat, a Terrifying Will descended, manifesting as a golden pupil.
Looking down at the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe’s young man kneeling respectfully below, a thick and authoritative voice transmitted from the golden pupil, “So, it means that the Left Saint was suppressed and killed by a genius of the Human Race in the late period of Transcendence.”
The Tri-Eye young man who had entered the relic respectfully lowered his head, “Yes, Ancestor God, the battle between both sides nearly destroyed half of the Relic World.”
