“Also, because of their battle, we had to leave before we could find the ancient relic.”
The golden pupil’s eyes swirled with a terrifying Radiance as the authoritative voice echoed once again, “I didn’t expect that in just over a hundred Sun Wheels, the Human Race has produced another stunning individual.”
“Thor, you have had contact with this human. What do you think of him?”
The Tri-Eye young man fell silent for a moment, then respectfully said, “This human is very Overbearing and harsh in his methods. As soon as he appeared, he slew all the Divine Children from the Demon God Sect and the Giant God Sect.”
“Furthermore, after entering the Inner World of the relic…”
…
In the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the raging wind howled, lifting tsunamis hundreds of meters high on the ocean’s surface, where a Black-red Colossal Beast a kilometer long was flying at an extreme speed.
On the back of the Black-red Colossal Beast, a pair of wings, seemingly forged from metal, spanned 1,800 meters, and a keratinous feather horn sharp as a Blade Edge on its rear shot out Golden-White flames, forming a radiant light wing over 2,000 meters wide.
Under the propulsion of the light wings, the Giant Dragon’s regular flight speed instantly reached more than twenty times the speed of sound, emitting a thunderous roar reminiscent of roaring Thunder.
Due to its great speed and the resulting friction with the air, a blue-red layer of flames formed a shock wave around its body, trailing a radiant display of light tens of kilometers long.
In the tremendous foreclaws of the Giant Dragon was grasped the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, whom it carried in flight.
Compared to the Giant Dragon’s massive size, the nearly 300-meter-long Single-horned Tiger Kingfish resembled a child with no semblance of might, creating a comical scene.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, feeling somewhat uncomfortable being carried this way, couldn’t help but cry out, “Roar! Thunderflame, I can fly by myself, let me fly on my own.”
The deep voice of the Destruction Emperor Dragon grumbled, “Forget it, you’re too slow and it’s a waste of time.”
Fine, then. The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish reluctantly nodded, as if to blame itself for its slow flight.
Yi ya yi ya!!
Atop the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a 2-meter-long Purple little dragon was happily wrapped around a tens of meters long, 0.5-meter thick mane tip, swinging in the wind and thoroughly enjoying itself.
With a thunderous explosion, the Destruction Emperor Dragon crossed thousands of kilometers in mere ten minutes and appeared above the Deep Sea Whirlpool, then suddenly plunged downward.
Boom! At over twenty times the speed of sound, the Destruction Emperor Dragon descended like a massive meteorite, instantly exploding a ten-kilometer radius of the ocean’s surface and forming an annular shockwave.
In the center, countless amounts of sea water shot up tens of thousands of meters high and then fell like boundless waterfalls, mixed with the innumerable corpses of ordinary fish and Unique Beasts.
In just the blink of an eye, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had plummeted thousands of meters without dropping, crashing into the sea water vortex, ignoring the Space Distortion around it and vanishing from sight.
Upon entering the twisted space, the scene before the Destruction Emperor Dragon changed, and it emerged in a world of clear mountains and waters.
However, at this time, most of this world had become ruins, and at the edge of the central mountain ranges stood a Red Beast, a divine tree thousands of meters tall.
At the edge of the divine tree, a Silver Giant Dragon, a golden-blue Giant Dragon, and a Candle Dragon Giant Beast were curiously approaching, studying whether they could penetrate the red halo.
Beneath the mountain ranges, the dark red Colossal Beast had already recovered most of its injuries, with flesh and blood regenerating and new scale armor visibly growing back.
But the recovery was only superficial; the dark red Colossal Beast still had a deficit in the Laws’ Origin and Vitality, with a weakened Aura.
The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon arrived, the entire small world began to tremble violently, as if what entered wasn’t a kilometer-long Giant Beast, but a horrifying presence tens of thousands of meters in size.
The invisible pressure caused Heaven and Earth to change color, with dark clouds gathering out of nowhere, as if Doomsday had arrived.
The sudden change startled the Silver Giant Dragon and the other Giant Beasts; however, upon turning around and seeing the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon emitted an excited roar.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re awake.”
The 500-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon flapped its double wings, transforming into a silver radiance encircled by a storm, crossing the sky in a blink and arriving before the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Looking at the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head and the black Mane, along with the terrifying Aura it emitted, the Silver Giant Dragon was surprised, “Roar! Tim Abott, your transformation is huge after this breakthrough.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Indeed, this upgrade is significant but my various talents have reached their peak, and I won’t be hibernating again in the short term.”
“Roar! Tim Abott, does that mean we can finally start sweeping through the Chaotic Turbulent Region?”
Yes, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s excited roar burst forth, “Roar! The Great Scythia will dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region, and those Giant Beasts will bleed rivers.”
As it roared, the Silver Giant Dragon circled excitedly around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, acting like a child ready for a big fight.
Astride the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, the Purple little dragon stood fists akimbo, emitting a childish roar in a youthful voice, “Yi ya yi ya!! The Great May will also witness rivers of blood.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 1026 427 The Throne Conference The Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1026: Chapter 427: The Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World_4 Chapter 1026: Chapter 427: The Throne Conference, The Giant Beast that Carries the World_4 Just then, a voice came from beneath the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish: “Roar!! Thunderflame, can you let go of me now?”
Almost forgetting about this fellow, the Destruction Emperor Dragon paused, then stealthily released its giant claw.
At this moment, the golden-blue Giant Dragon and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon also flew over.
The elegantly poised giant dragon, with golden-blue crystal radiance twinkling on its body, stretched its double wings and floated in the air, its gaze flickering as it looked at the imposing Destruction Emperor Dragon and let out a low growl.
“Thunderflame, congratulations on your new breakthrough in strength,” it said.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly.
After exchanging greetings among the few Giant Beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon arrogantly roared with pride, “Roar! Tim Abbott, during your hibernation, Joe and the others discovered this divine tree that bore many top-grade divine fruits.”
“However, their strength was too weak; they were no match for the Giant Beast that guarded this small world. In the end, it was the Great Scythia who took action to conquer this world.”
“The Giant Beast was strong, so we did not kill it, opting instead to take it in and have it join the Dragon Palace.”
Looking at the giant tree radiating rings of red halos in the distance, as well as the fierce and massive Giant Beast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled with satisfaction, “Impressive, truly worthy of Scythia.”
Instantly the Silver Giant Dragon’s tail pricked up, and it roared with delight, “Roar! The Great Scythia has always been powerful, but Telsafi and the Candle Dragon are also quite remarkable.”
“If it hadn’t been for their assistance this time, even the Great Scythia would have needed at least half a day to defeat this Giant Beast.”
Hearing this, the golden-blue Giant Dragon couldn’t help but shake its head; this creature always loved to brag.
If it wasn’t for their joint effort and mutual restraint, the Silver Giant Dragon would have had to use the Scale of Laws to smash the Dark-red Giant Beast to death; otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to handle it at all.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded and growled in agreement, “Everyone did a good job this time.”
Having said that, the Giant Beasts flew towards the divine tree in the distance, soon landing in front of the Dark-red Giant Beast measuring one thousand and one hundred meters.
The Silver Giant Dragon growled, “Roar! This is one of our Dragon Palace Dragon Kings, the Thunderflame Dragon King, Tim Abbott.”
Upon seeing the Black-red Colossal Beast appear before it, the Dark-red Giant Beast showed a trace of awe in its eyes; although they were similar in size, it felt an instinctive fear.
This was due to the immense difference in the life levels between them.
The Dark-red Giant Beast roared with respect, “I greet thee, Thunderflame Dragon King.”
Looking at the Giant Beast before it, which had a head like a lion and double wings on its back, resembling the Kamaitachi Beast of mythical legends, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slightly.
“Scythia, what is its name?”
Right, what was it called?
The Silver Giant Dragon paused for a moment, then looked down at the Dark-red Giant Beast lying on the ground and growled in inquiry, “Roar! …Tim Abbott is asking you, what is your name?”
…The golden-blue Giant Dragon and the Candle Dragon also paused; it seemed they had also forgotten this detail.
“Roar! I… do not know, I have no name,” the Dark-red Giant Beast revealed with confusion in its eyes.
As a Giant Beast that grew up in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Dark-red Giant Beast, despite its formidable power and having grown to Mythical-level, was still just a beast and had never contemplated philosophical questions like who it was or what its name was.
To not have a name, the Destruction Emperor Dragon thought for a while and then growled, “Then from today onward, you will be called Kamaitachi, the Dragon Palace’s first Mythic War General.”
This Giant Beast had awakened the bloodline of ancient Ferocious Beasts, reaching a bloodline tier equivalent to a typical Monarch-level, making it a very capable high-level enforcer for the Dragon Palace.
“Roar! From today on, my name shall be Kamaitachi.” The Black-red Colossal Beast’s eyes sparkled with a radiance, its gaze towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon filled with not only reverence but also a touch of excitement.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon casually gave this Giant Beast a name and then turned its attention to the divine tree above, as a greenish energy emerged in its golden vertical pupils.
Following its transformation into a Heavenly Tier lifeform, apart from the surge in strength, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body acquired some mystical functions.
For instance, this unique energy born within its body can link Heaven and Earth, and when it covers the eyes, it can even directly perceive the essence of all things.
This function is somewhat similar to the ‘Eyes of Void and Death’ passive ability of its original form, Jack Clark.
Hum! As the Destruction Emperor Dragon mobilized the Sky-Blue energy, in an instant, all things in Heaven and Earth lost their surface appearance in its eyes, and the red halo circling the divine tree turned into a layer of Boundary Power.
This Boundary Power was immensely strong, existing independently of Heaven and Earth.
The roots, which appeared to be deeply embedded into the rocks of the mountain ranges and resembled red jade, stretched deep into the Earth, probing into the depths of the Void to absorb its energy.
This scene surprised even the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
No wonder the Kamaitachi Beast could not get close to the divine tree in the past; the tree forms a world of its own. One could even say that the entire small world relies on the existence of this tree.
After a while, the green glow in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly faded away. It turned its head to look at the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish beside it and praised, “You’ve done well this time, Joe.”
Roar! What is it, Thunderflame? The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was a bit confused.
“This is a highly valuable divine tree, even more precious than the usual Law-level resources,”
Feeling its energy fluctuations become smooth, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a low growl: “Roar! Tim Abott, is there any way to speed up the maturation of the Divine Fruit on this tree? Maturing one every Sun Wheel is too slow, it’s not enough for us to eat.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon pondered: “Speeding up the maturity of the Divine Fruit is quite simple, just take it with us, transplant it into a larger world to absorb enough energy.”
Roar! A Power Explosion of limitless strength formed a Thunder Cloud Storm covering hundreds of kilometers, with Law Power glowing like substance, enveloping the entire world.
Boom! As the Destruction Emperor Dragon made a Power Explosion, it took on the weight of the world on its shoulders, and with a mighty step, forcefully pulled the world towards the Rift World.
And as the Destruction Emperor Dragon moved the world, the divine tree’s roots vibrated, pulled out from the Void, spanning tens of kilometers, exuding the pure Aura of Divine Objects.
Instantly, countless Unique Beasts within thousands of kilometers were shaken and turned their gaze in that direction.
But upon feeling the invisible, fierce Dragon Might emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the eyes of these Unique Beasts revealed a look of awe and hesitation.
However, over 20,000 kilometers away, a behemoth avian Giant Beast with a body length of more than 2,000 meters, covered in feather-like Golden Scale Armor, suddenly stood up.
Cheep! Accompanied by a shriek that tore through space, the Golden Roc perched on the broken cliff flapped its double wings and burst through the gaps in space.
With terrifying speed, it quickly navigated several hazardous areas within the stormy regions and approached.
In a blink, a Terrifying Aura of mid period Titan pervaded the area.
Under the intimidating presence, Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts such as the blue-golden Giant Dragon surrounding the world projection shifted their gazes as the Candle Dragon and Single-horned Tiger Kingfish were pressed down with a bang onto the sea surface.
Roar roar roar!! A powerful oppressive force erupted from the bodies of the Silver Giant Dragon and several Giant Beasts amidst the storm, letting out outraged roars at the Titan Level Giant Beast.
The Golden Roc inherently restrains the life of Dragon species.
The Divine Light on the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew intense, and it couldn’t help but stop, its eyes coldly fixed on the Titan Giant Beast.
It hadn’t expected to encounter a Titan Level Giant Beast here; it was a good opportunity to test its strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - 1027 428 The Arrival of the Crimson

﻿Chapter 1027: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K) Chapter 1027: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K) Tens of thousands of meters high above, atop a cliff that sundered the sea, a Golden Roc Giant Beast measuring over 2,400 meters in length suddenly rose, gazing towards the direction of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Despite the distance of more than 20,000 kilometers, it still sensed the aura of a Law Level Divine Artifact emanating from the divine tree’s roots, a fluctuation filled with the energy of the world that instinctively made this Giant Beast want to devour.
Chirp!
With a sound that tore through space like clashing metal, a terrifying aura erupted from the body of the Golden Roc Giant Beast, shaking the atmosphere and creating a ring of white wave shockwaves around it.
Boom!
As it unfolded its 4,000-meter-wide wings, covered with feather-like golden scale armor, space shattered violently, turning into countless transparent fragments like broken glass.
With one flap of its wings shattering the very space around it, the Golden Roc Giant Beast instantly turned into a burst of golden light that shot forth, vanishing in the dim space between heaven and earth.
This Giant Roc Beast, with a normal flying speed surpassing a hundred times the speed of sound, caused the transparent fragments of space to whirl about, creating a thunderous din of destruction that reverberated through heaven and earth.
Before long, the Giant Beast crossed thousands of kilometers, and ahead lay a forbidden zone formed by grey tornadoes.
Boom boom boom!! Between heaven and earth, countless thousand-meter-thick tornadoes soared through the sky, rolling up endless seas, filled with a terrifying tearing force capable of tearing apart Level 9 Giant Beasts.
Bang bang bang!! With bursts of golden light flashing past, tornadoes after tornadoes were directly smashed by the Golden Roc Giant Beast, and the scattering raging winds bellowed throughout heaven and earth.
After passing through the hurricane area that spanned thousands of kilometers, ahead were bolts of thunder several meters thick descending from the skies…
……
Above the sea surface, the furious water churned, creating hundred-meter tsunamis, and above at an altitude of ten thousand meters, a black-red Colossal Beast measuring a kilometer in length with eight kinds of Law Power light swirling around its body, bore a small world upon its double claws as it moved along.
At this moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took heavy steps, with each footfall causing a vast expanse of space to collapse, forming black cracks that spread in all directions.
Within the space distortion area dozens of kilometers above the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, one could see mountains collapsing and earth shattering within the small world, as countless ordinary Unique Beasts frantically fled as if doomsday had arrived.
Simultaneously, beneath the red giant tree rooted in the Void, Crystal Red roots stretched tens of kilometers, the scene emerging from the Void was shockingly stunning.
And as the Destruction Emperor Dragon moved with the world on its back, an impact wave similar to a shockwave swept across tens of kilometers, creating a massive spectacle.
In the distance, the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, “Roar! Tim Abott, you’re amazing! To think you can move a small world.”
On the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, a small 2-meter-long Purple little dragon also stood on the forked dragon horns, excitedly waving its tiny claws, “Eeya eeya!! Charge, invincible!”
The Single-horned Tiger Whale also flapped its Double Fins, its blue single horn flashing as it chirped excitedly, “Roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, you’re freaking awesome, you blow everything apart!”
At this time, it wasn’t just them – the eyes of other Giant Beasts, including the blue Giant Dragon, the Candle Dragon, and the Kamaitachi Beast, also revealed shock.
As they watched the black-red Colossal Beast bearing the world and walking, the blue Giant Dragon felt a surge of heat in its blood, and its tail went limp, this Dragon-type Giant Beast from the Indigenous World was just too strong.
Telsafi felt that even its own mother couldn’t perform the feat of bearing a small world and walking with it.
Not to mention the ability to gather Law Power into chains for control, there was also the necessity for laws to reach into the Void and envelop the outer wall of the small world, and to bear the weight of a small world.
Such an immense strength was something even its mother, who had reached the late stages of a Titan, could not bear.
And as the Giant Beasts surrounded and cheered, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked ahead with cold eyes, taking giant steps of a kilometer each, remained unmoved.
However, at this moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon wasn’t as relaxed as it appeared, the weight of ‘Earth’ spanning hundreds of kilometers pressed down on it, feeling quite burdensome.
This was after most of the weight had been cut off by the separation of the world and the Void, and it had been careless.
Although it seemed feasible to drag the world ahead, it hadn’t anticipated the immense pressure of bearing a ‘big’ Real World, and after just a few hundred kilometers, its legs were starting to feel weak.
But as the strongest Giant Beast of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire, it could not show any signs of struggle, regardless of the difficulty.
“Roar! Be careful,” suddenly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon bellowed softly, stopping in its tracks as its golden vertical pupils looked ahead coldly.
It sensed a Titan-level terrifying aura approaching rapidly from that direction, soon arriving mere hundreds of kilometers away.
Instantly, an immense aura that could primal devour True Dragons surged over, engulfing everything, and the Silver Giant Dragon along with other Giant Beasts like the blue Giant Dragon all showed a change in their expressions.
Bang bang bang!!
Under the oppressive might of the Titan that laid waste to heaven and Earth, the Single-horned Tiger Whale, the blue Giant Dragon, and the Candle Dragon Beast all plummeted from the skies, crashing fiercely into the ocean.
At that moment, aside from the Silver Giant Dragon and the Kamaitachi Beast, none of the other Giant Beasts even had the right to stand before the Titan Beast releasing its pressure unabashedly.
While the Candle Dragon and the blue Giant Dragon had combat power on par with an early Mythical being, Myth was Myth, Transcendent was Transcendent — not to mention a being above Mythical Giant Beasts: a Titan Level.
Roar roar roar!!
The Silver Giant Dragon’s body shimmered with silver divine light, surrounded by a maelstrom of Black Destruction Storm, roaring angrily as it resisted the fearsome pressure coming from the far horizon.
Especially the violent aura that suppressed the bloodline of Dragon species, it caused the Silver Giant Dragon and the blue Giant Dragon, these Dragon-type Giant Beasts, to instinctively shudder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - 1028 428 Deep Red Destruction Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1028: Chapter 428 Deep Red Destruction Descends, Ripping Apart a Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_2 Chapter 1028: Chapter 428 Deep Red Destruction Descends, Ripping Apart a Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_2 That was the aura of a natural predator.
In mythical legends, Giant Roc Beasts prey on dragons, innately restraining dragon life, and the same is almost true in the mythical world.
Chirp!
Accompanied by the clashing sound of tearing through space, a gleam of golden light emerged in the distance as a Golden Roc Giant Beast with a wingspan of four thousand kilometers appeared tens of kilometers away, its cold gaze sweeping over all Giant Beasts before finally settling on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
In the eyes of this Golden Roc Giant Beast, other creatures like the Silver Giant Dragon or the Kamaitachi Beast were nothing more than food to be consumed in one bite; only this Mythical Giant Beast that seemed to carry the world on its shoulders posed a bit of a threat.
As for Golden-Blue Giant Dragons below the level of myth, they were outright ignored.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon released its double claws as the law chains wrapped around it retracted, causing the space above its head to tremble and the projection of the divine tree world to quiver.
Standing tall at high altitude, black lightning and blue-black thunder danced around the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, and golden-white flames burned on the three pairs of feather horns on either side of its head, confronting the Golden Roc Giant Beast.
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon was several times smaller in size, the invisible and immense pressure it exuded as a Heavenly Beast was no less threatening than that of the Titan Giant Beast.
Crackle Crackle!!
The opposing pressures collided in the void in front of them, nearly squeezing the air into a solid mass that repeatedly cracked, creating transparent fissures hundreds to thousands of kilometers long—a terrifying sight.
At this moment, there was no communication, no roaring dialogue.
When the Golden Roc Giant Beast, at the mid-Titan stage, realized the strongest among the group of Giant Beasts was only at the Mid-Mythical Stage, a terrifying murderous aura spread from its body.
Boom!
Golden light Burst from the body of the Golden Roc, these golden law lights sharp beyond compare, spreading over an area of more than forty kilometers, dyeing all of Heaven and Earth and the sea golden.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a fierce roar as its double wings, sharp as blades, spread angrily behind it, with endless flames, thunder, black lightning, and purple halos Bursting forth from its center.
Boom!
Eight Higher-order Law Powers Burst and diffused, similarly dyeing an area of over thirty kilometers with their presence, forming a Law World unique to it, gatherign the Power of Space to suppress everything.
This is the power of a Titan Level creature, whose domains and Demon Domains unfolded through rule and the Power of Space are far more terrifying in both prestige and scale compared to humans and Purgatory True Demons of Heavenly King and Great Demon King status.
Boom!!
A riot of colors in the Law World collided with the golden world, and under the collision of the complete golden sharp laws and the eight Higher-order Laws, the entire sky emitted sounds of unbearable strain.
And just as the two Law Worlds exerted pressure on each other, neutralizing the Power of Space contained within, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already collided with the Golden Roc Giant Beast.
Boom!!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws intersected with an even larger set of golden claws, immediately causing the surrounding space to collapse in layers, the invisible impact making the sea surface within a range of several kilometers abruptly subside.
Chirp! Watching the smaller black and red dragon-like creature block its double claws without being overturned, the Golden Roc Giant Beast let out a ferocious cry, vibrating its double wings behind it.
Boom! In an instant, an even more powerful strength Burst from the Giant Roc’s double claws, crushing the Void, shattering everything, and making even the Destruction Emperor Dragon falter, as the space beneath its feet fractured.
But it was just a momentary tremor.
Tempered by eight Higher-order Laws and having advanced to Heavenly Tier life, the strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was immensely powerful and invincible, pushing against everything—even when facing a Titan Giant Beast from a Major Realm above.
Just as the two Giant Beasts unleashed their power in a hard clash, the tips of the Golden Roc Giant Beast’s claws, glowing with golden light, began to slowly pinch together, and the Vajra Law Power circulating around the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body emitted a crackling sound.
Then it was directly torn apart.
As a bird, the Giant Roc’s beak and claws are its strongest weapons, incredibly sharp, and even more terrifying after becoming a Titan Giant Beast.
Under the claws of this Golden Roc Giant Beast, countless Giant Beasts with Dragon Bloodlines had been torn apart, with a single swipe breaking through space effortlessly, a sight of pure terror.
Yet when that single claw, measuring a hundred meters alone, tore through the Vajra Law and landed on the black-red scaled armor of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s arms, it emitted a screeching noise along with sparks.
Looking at the unharmed black-red scale armor on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s clawed arms, the gaze of the Golden Roc Giant Beast sharpened.
Whoosh! A searing breath escaped from the nostrils of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its golden vertical pupils shining coldly as it opened its gaping jaws to emit a deep growl, “Are you finished scratching?”
Roar!
Amidst its roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s muscles swelled, and in that instant all the boundless strength within burst forth, slamming down on the Golden Roc Giant Beast’s double claws with a smash.
Boom!
Under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s world-shaking terrifying strength, the huge Golden Roc was flipped over with a crash, like a meteor plunging from the sky and smashing into the sea.
Boom!
Instantly, the sea surface collapsed, revealing the seabed thousands of kilometers below, followed by quaking and fracturing of the Earth, as countless stones, dirt, and sea water surged skyward amidst dazzling golden light.
From afar, it looked like a ring-shaped curtain of water had appeared on the sea surface, with countless waters rising tens of thousands of meters before turning into waterfalls and falling back down, an imposing spectacle.
And all this actually happened in the blink of an eye.
Boom! A belligerent aura Burst up from the violent underground explosion, and a ray of golden light shot into the sky, hurtling toward the Destruction Emperor Dragon at a hundred times the speed of sound.
It was none other than the Golden Roc Giant Beast.
This time, sharp and dazzling golden light gleamed on the beast’s large and pointed beak, emitting a frightening aura capable of piercing through everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - 1029 428 The Arrival of the Crimson
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1029: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_3 Chapter 1029: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_3 Meanwhile, as it flapped its wings, space shattered, forming countless transparent fragments. Under the contamination of the Law of Gold, these transformed into arrows of golden shards that burst forth with explosive force.
Boom!!
Tens of thousands of space fragments converged to form a golden destruction storm, which swirled around the Golden Roc Giant Beast and pounced towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon with a momentum that shook Heaven and Earth.
The attack was met by a black-red Tail Blade that stretched for more than 600 meters.
On that blade edge, a golden purple light shimmered, radiating extreme heat and sharpness, cleaving space into dark nothingness with unparalleled sharpness.
Especially the compressed power on the blade edge of the Tail Blade, that was the fusion power of the Higher-order Laws – Great Sun Golden Flame and Corrosion Law.
The reason why Titan Level Giant Beasts are so strong is that in addition to merging with an already grandly accomplished law, which makes them a representative of a Law forming its own Laws World, they also have the fusion of multiple Laws.
This fusion is not just the superimposition of domains around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but the integration of the Origin power of Laws, where the fusion of two Laws can unleash a force several or even ten times more terrifying.
And the higher the level of the Laws, the more numerous the fusions, the greater the unleashed power.
This is also why the Crimson Form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon is so powerful, not only enhancing basic strength and talent amplification but also uniting all internal powers for a Limit Breakthrough.
And the Purple Void Poison, born of Toxin, possesses a special ability called Void-Nether Fusion, which allows it to fuse with other Transcendent Talent Laws without any barriers.
Therefore, although this talent seemed unremarkable at first, it is actually very powerful.
It’s just that because the Destruction Emperor Dragon possesses too many powerful Gifted Powers, it often gets overlooked.
At this moment, wrapped with the fusion power of two Higher-order Laws, the Tail Blade, with the force of Opening the Heavens and Earth, cleaved through space, forming a dark Sky Curtain that descended with indescribable speed in an instant.
Boom boom boom!! The Tail Blade, like a master of Sword Skill, shredded the overwhelming golden space fragments that swept over, and after changing direction dozens of times in an instant, it struck the beak of the Giant Roc Beast.
Boom! Under the collision of the extremely compressed Law of Gold’s sharpness and the golden purple Law Power, a dazzling explosion occurred, forming an even more dazzling Energy Halo that burst open.
Boom boom boom!!
Amid the powerful impact force, thousands of golden shards passed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, piercing through Heaven and Earth, scattering the dark clouds above tens of thousands of meters.
At the same time, beneath that terrible rebounding force, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but step back several paces, crushing space underfoot, while the Golden Roc Giant Beast too was sent flying backward with a shake of its wings.
Chiu!
A hundred kilometers away, the Golden Roc Giant Beast let out a fierce cry, surrounded by a Golden World akin to flames, its gaze towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon heavy with brutality and solemnity.
At this time, a long cut, over a hundred meters in length and several meters deep, appeared on its sharp golden beak.
On the tail of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Blade Edge near the tail tip, a stretch of a hundred meters, was also completely broken off, showing that neither side had gained an advantage this time.
Just then, a golden light flowed across the beak of the Golden Roc Giant Beast as the fractured bones began to regrow, visibly healing at a speed observable to the naked eye.
On the other side, the broken Blade Edge on the tail of the Destruction Emperor Dragon also rapidly returned to its original state under the Law of the Life Origin.
At this level, ordinary injuries already had no impact on these beasts; only injuries that involved the soul’s will and the Life Origin could cause serious damage.
After a brief standoff, the Golden Roc Giant Beast suddenly flapped its wings, its massive body instantly disappeared from its original spot, turning into a streak of Golden Light that began to encircle the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This was the Golden Roc Giant Beast’s hunting habit, circling around its prey, looking for an opportunity to deliver a killing blow.
Upon realizing that this Black-red Colossal Beast, though only at the Mid-Mythical Stage of growth, was able to clash with it without falling short in strength, the Golden Roc Giant Beast suddenly got serious.
As for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it stood tall at an altitude of ten thousand meters, surrounded by a colorful Laws World, unmovable and majestic.
Chiu! Suddenly, from afar, a brilliant golden light flared. The Golden Roc Giant Beast opened its mouth wide, and from within, an energy Breath imbued with a sharp Destructive Aura burst forth.
Boom! At the blow of a Titan Level Giant Beast’s Breath, Heaven and Earth trembled, a thick Light Beam a hundred meters wide pierced through, and in the blink of an eye, it blasted onto the Laws World of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom boom boom!!
The Laws World vibrated continuously, and as the Light Beam pierced through rapidly, layers were torn apart, emitting brilliant light and powerful shocks of Law power.
However, the Laws World surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon, though consisting of the convergence of eight types of Law Powers and not a fusion, still had a strong resistance and suppression power.
By the time the Breath appeared in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it had already been considerably weakened, reduced to just over fifty meters in width, and its might had plummeted.
Boom! In a burst of dazzling golden light, the Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its right claw to block the Breath in front of it, standing unshaken amidst the golden light of the Breath.
Standing on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Mr. Loore, who was 2 meters long, excitedly waved his claws: Yiya yiyah!! Charge, kill this despicable Giant Beast.
The sudden, childish voice of the Purple little dragon seemed somewhat out of place.
And as the Purple little dragon ‘roared’, the black lightning and flames entwined around the Destruction Emperor Dragon disappeared, and its entire body was enveloped in a layer of transparent Law power.
Whoosh!
Surrounded by the Law of Speed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with a body length of a kilometer, disappeared in a terrifying speed, appearing nearly a hundred kilometers away as if folding space itself.
Roar! Standing behind the Golden Roc Giant Beast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon spread its claws wide, its muscles swelled, and in an instant, a power capable of destroying worlds exploded forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - 1030 428 The Arrival of the Crimson
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1030: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_4 Chapter 1030: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_4 Boom! A claw wrapped in black lightning tore through space, collapsisng the world of the Golden Law as a golden-purple ‘star’ with a hundred-meter diameter landed on the back of the Golden Roc Giant Beast.
Bang! The terrible claw strike cracked and shattered the golden scale armor, followed by endless eruptions of searing Destructive Glow.
Boom!
Above the firmament, a golden-purple fireball with a tens of kilometers diameter rapidly expanded, emitting intense and dazzling light. Its powerful pressure squeezed the surrounding air into a white wave that surged out a hundred kilometers.
In an instant, heaven and earth shook, the cosmos turned upside down.
Amidst the terrifying blast of light, another golden light beam descended from the sky, fiercely smashing down on an island with a diameter of tens of kilometers below.
Boom!
Beneath the Giant Roc Beast, rocks crumbled and the earth collapsed. The annihilative shockwave liquefied the rocks, forming a ring of erupting magma fire.
The surrounding sea surged with tsunamis kilometers high, spreading in all directions as if doomsday had descended.
Perched above ten thousand meters altitude, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze was cold. Intent on striking down its foe in its weakened state, its double wings spread wide with anger as its mouth opened, emanating dazzling light.
Behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the dorsal fin lit up segment by segment. In an instant, blue-black electric arcs exploded, endlessly directing energy into the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The lingering thunder cloud storm in the sky burst with thunder, converging upon the Destruction Emperor Dragon from all directions and forming ten dazzling thunder rings in front of it.
Roar! From the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a golden-purple Law-fused Light Beam burst forth, shrinking slightly with each thunder ring it crossed, yet growing ever more dazzling.
When the Breath Light Beam penetrated through the tenth thunder ring, it compressed from a hundred meters thick to thirty meters, emitting an eye-searing golden-blue-purple tricolor light and terrifying energy fluctuations, illuminating heaven and earth.
At this moment, only that descending tricolor light beam existed between heaven and earth. Its terrifying power caused even Giant Beasts like the Single-horned Tiger Kingfishmore than two hundred kilometers away to tremble with fear.
Boom! Fused breath instantly hit the collapsed island center below. In an instant, an even more dazzling light erupted, expanding into a destructive light sphere.
Boom, boom, boom!! In the blink of an eye, the light sphere expanded to ten kilometers in diameter, annihilating everything – space, rocks, seawater, all evaporating, truly a destruction that shattered heaven and earth.
Under the terrifying collision of heaven and earth, creatures like the Silver Giant Dragon felt the entire world shake, with tsunamis several thousand meters high roaring and the raging wind howling.
The powerful energy explosion created waves of substantial white air, sweeping across hundreds of kilometers, revealing the shattered seabed below.
From the sea-seared seabed, cracks extending for tens to hundreds of kilometers emerged, with intense firelight bursting from their depths, seeming to have penetrated the Earth’s crust – a sight of sheer terror.
Chirp!
In this moment, a fierce cry reverberated between heaven and earth as a streak of golden light soared from the explosion, its double wings unfolded blocking the sky, emitting an extremely violent aura.
The Golden Roc Giant Beast was now in a sorry state, with many areas of its scale armor broken and flesh charred. A blood hole several tens of meters wide had been pierced through its left side.
However, these wounds were rapidly healing under the golden light, and the Golden Roc Giant Beast’s aura weakened only slightly.
Such is a Titan Level Giant Beast, with soul, body, and Law fused to grant it vigorous vitality and a body of unmatched strength and solidity. Even such an explosion resulted only in a ‘light injury’.
Chirp! The Golden Roc Giant Beast’s eyes burned with blood-red ferocity as it emanated a violent aura and dove toward the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Surrounding golden light swirled, sharply tearing through space.
As the two mighty beasts collided in an instant, the Giant Roc’s massive double wings swept across, breaking space on a grand scale with terrifying might.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double wings also swept across, wreathed in black Destructive Lightning, colliding viciously with the Golden Roc’s wings. The powerful reverberating forces pushed both creatures back a step.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, charging again. Its black and red double claws clashed with the golden claws, and its ferocious maw collided with the beak.
This time, the two began a fierce close-quarters fight, tearing flesh and blood, as a Tail Blade swept through amidst the flurry of double wings and claws.
Boom! The Tail Blade, wrapped in the power of dual-system Law fusion, swept across the void, carving a hundred-meter long gash across the chest of the Golden Roc Giant Beast.
Instantly, golden blood sprayed into the sky, falling on the broken seabed below, eroding the rocks and dirt, and turning them into Golden Crystal Stones imbued with the essence of Law Charm.
Boom! The strike again forced both combatants to reel from the force, each flying back several kilometers.
Chirp!
The Golden Roc Giant Beast let out another fierce cry, its surrounding world of Law forcefully contracted, forming a physical layer of golden strength over its body – as if it had become a pure gold beast.
Under the extreme compression of Law Power, the Golden Roc emitted a sharp golden light from its body, so intense that merely standing there, it shredded the surrounding space.
Seeing this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon also roared, its world of Law contracted, compressing space and the Power of Heaven and Earth to form a layer of energy that emitted a Seven-Colored Glow around its body.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The two beasts, almost turned to pure Law, collided once more, tangling and clashing at terrifying speeds, leaving behind a trail of devastation wherever they went – heaven shattered, earth crumbled and space broke apart.
Occasionally, a golden-purple flame would sweep by, instantly evaporating several kilometers of seawater, each burst of golden light beams piercing through everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 1031 428 The Arrival of the Crimson
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1031: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_5 Chapter 1031: Chapter 428: The Arrival of the Crimson Destruction, Tearing Apart the Titan Level Giant Beast (9K)_5 The terrifying aftershocks of the battle caused the Silver Giant Dragon and other giant beasts to continuously retreat, not daring to come close.
In a battle of this level, a single aftershock could eradicate them; meanwhile, around the Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue dragon, scales of Laws swirled.
However, under the control of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the battle moved further and further away from the Silver Giant Dragon and the others.
Watching the earth-shattering battle in the distance, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s tail trembled with excitement: roar! Thunderflame is too powerful, not even the Titan beasts can match it.
The Giant Beast Candle Dragon also revealed a look of shock in its eyes and growled slowly, “Roar! Thunder, Flame, invincible.”
“So strong.” The Kamaitachi, a dark red beast that was one thousand one hundred meters long, also widened its eyes, breathing heavily with intense firelight, revealing fanatical worship in its eyes.
The Thunderflame Dragon King is too formidable, at only a Mid-Mythical Stage level, yet it can fight so fiercely without being outmatched by that terrifying Titan beast. Its combat power is terrifying.
It’s a good thing it was the Scythia Dragon King and the others who came forward to fight it; otherwise, if the Thunderflame Dragon King took its place, just one claw would heavily injure or even erase it.
No wonder the Scythia Dragon King boasts every day about dominating the Chaotic Turbulent Region; the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire is too strong.
At this moment, any reluctance the Kamaitachi Beast had about being forced to join the Dragon Palace vanished instantaneously, replaced by a sense of pride.
Boom!
In the distance, the two battling giant beasts suddenly separated, retreating hundreds of kilometers, revealing the Destruction Beast with some traces of injury on its body and slightly damaged wings, and the Golden Roc Giant Beast covered in blade marks.
Pant, pant!! The Golden Roc Giant Beast flapped its wings rapidly, breathing hurriedly, with a look of gravity and disbelief in its eyes; it couldn’t believe it was no match for a Mid-Mythical Stage giant beast.
In the skies far away, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was also slowly catching its breath, coldly eyeing the Golden Roc Giant Beast.
After this battle, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a rough idea of its current combat strength.
Without entering its Giantification Form, at full strength, it could suppress a Mid-Titan Level beast, but killing it would be difficult.
And just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was deep in thought, the Golden Roc Giant Beast across from it showed a hint of retreat in its eyes.
For Titan Level giant beasts, a fight to the death is rare, unless there are bonds and hatreds they cannot let go of.
Therefore, after realizing there was no hope of seizing the divine tree that lured beasts, the Golden Roc Giant Beast planned to retreat.
But at that moment, the distant Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Warm-up is over, now this king is getting serious.”
Boom!
As it growled, red lightning burst from the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, covering half the sky.
At the heart of those red lightning bolts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon radiated dazzling crimson light, and in an instant, a terrifying aura that horrified Heaven and Earth pierced through the Cloud Sky.
Boom, boom, boom!! Under the terrifying aura, the entire sky truly trembled, Laws were in disarray, and within a thousand kilometers, Heavenly Energy ran amok, causing raging wind and Tsunamis.
The sudden change alarmed all the giant beasts, and in the astonished gaze of the Golden Roc Giant Beast, a Deep Red Destruction Beast, standing erect at two thousand meters tall and three thousand meters long, appeared.
Black and red Thunder enveloped this Deep Red Destruction Beast, and wherever it passed, space shattered like fragile paper, obliterated, creating an Area of Destruction ten kilometers wide.
Even because the power was too terrifying, under the infinite crimson light, a world projection formed behind the Deep Red Destruction Beast.
It was a world where only crimson light existed, and within the projection, indistinct images of terrifying creatures thousands or tens of thousands of meters long appeared, emitting an aura that drove all living beings to despair.
Pant, pant, such powerful strength. The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled a Destructive Aura, excitement shining in its eyes.
After transforming into the Deep Red Beast again, it felt its power had grown strong enough to destroy the world, touching the limits of an extreme level.
It needed only to break the shackles, and it could enter a new Heaven and Earth.
Even from behind it in the Deep Red World, a pulling force emerged, calling it to enter the crimson world, where the power it sought lay.
Suddenly, the eyes of the Destruction Giant Dragon flickered.
It had a premonition that the opportunity for its Giantification Talent to evolve into a Law, even into the rule of Deep Red Giantification, lay deep within that mysterious and eerie Deep Red World.
However, now was not the time to explore that mysterious world. With that thought, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked towards the Golden Roc Giant Beast, who was as if facing a formidable enemy, and took a step.
Boom!
As the Void shattered, the Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly crossed over a hundred kilometers, appearing in front of the Golden Roc Giant Beast, extending its claws wrapped in Deep Red Destruction Thunder, striking down with a speed imperceptible to consciousness.
Squeak! Under the intense aura of death, the Golden Roc Giant Beast let out an enraged cry, its massive golden double claws shooting out to strike the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but it couldn’t shake the deep red scales one bit.
Even its sharp beak, capable of piercing space, pecked at the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s chest, only to produce a dazzling firelight without leaving the slightest dent in the scale armor.
At this moment, having merged all talents and laws, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strength, defense, speed, and mastery of the deep red destruction thunder had all reached terrifying peaks.
Roar! Emitting a ferocious roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon ignored the enemy’s attacks. Its double claws crushed space and shattered the law of gold, landing on the wings of the Golden Roc.
Then, following another brutal roar, the muscles in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claws swelled, and in an instant, a terrifying power capable of shaking the whole world burst forth.
Even in the Void, there resonated chants of might, supreme might.
Squeak!
The Golden Roc Giant Beast screamed as its chest scales shattered amidst the terrifying vibration of squeaks, its flesh torn apart bit by bit like super alloy, followed by its extremely hard bones.
This deep red Giant Beast was forcibly tearing it apart.
At this moment, the Golden Roc Giant Beast went completely insane, its infinite strength erupting, converging in its mouth into an extremely dazzling golden light beam and shooting forth.
Boom! A close-range Breath struck the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s neck, unleashing a horrific energy impact and dazzling light, illuminating the entire Heaven and Earth.
But it was useless.
Roar! The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon roared again, and under the burst of power, the Giant Beast with a length exceeding two thousand meters and a wingspan of four thousand meters was completely torn in half.
Immediately, hot and sharp golden blood spewed out like a waterfall, turning into a sky of golden light falling down.
Squeak! The two halves of the Golden Roc Giant Beast in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claws struggled and twisted, the powerful law of gold’s sharpness erupting, piercing everything.
Especially the half containing the neck and head, which let out a piercing scream. As the glow gathered in its mouth, it attempted to burst forth another Breath.
Boom!
Just as the golden light Breath erupted from the Golden Roc’s mouth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s vast and fierce giant mouth snapped down, and the sharp and terrifying golden light beam exploded inside it.
Yet, it still couldn’t harm the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its deep red Destruction Form in the slightest.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Under the large fangs of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, wrapped in red lightning, the scales on the Golden Roc’s head continuously shattered, flesh tore apart, followed by the unbelievably hard skull.
Thump! With a horrific bite, the Golden Roc’s head was crushed and then swallowed whole.
Instantly, the aura on both halves of the Giant Beast corpse weakened.
Yet even so, the Golden Roc Giant Beast still didn’t die, as most of its soul at the mid-Titan stage had already fused with its body and laws, possessing terrifying vitality.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claws wrapped in deep red destruction thunder, furiously eroded the Golden Roc Giant Beast’s soul and law power, releasing rings of golden light.
This erosion lasted for nearly ten minutes, after which the two halves of the corpse in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s hands finally quieted down, utterly annihilated.
Even in death, the two halves of the Giant Beast corpse, over two thousand meters long like a small mountain range, still emitted a terrifyingly heavy aura.
Their flesh and scale armor gleamed like pure gold, exuding thickness, sharpness, and a heavy suppressive force, enough to burst the consciousness and soul of any ordinary Giant Beast that came too close with the complete aura of laws.
Roar! Standing high in the sky, the Destruction Beast that tore apart a Titan Giant Beast howled to the heavens, emitting a world-shaking destructive might that caused the Heaven and Earth to tremble.
This scene left the golden-blue Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts in the distance utterly shocked. Too strong.
“Roar! Tim Abott, invincible,” the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes turned red with excitement, its tail swishing, and its legs feeling a bit weak.
Just then, a milky roar came from the head of the majestic deep red Giant Beast, suppressing the Heaven and Earth: Yiiya Yiiya!! The great May is invincible, dominating the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Roar… howl.
Overcome with excitement and attempting to let out a majestic roar, the Purple little dragon’s roar transformed into a howl, the Husky version.
Suddenly, the previously serious and solemn atmosphere was broken.

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 1032 429 Soul Unity Devouring Titan
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1032: Chapter 429 Soul Unity, Devouring Titan Chapter 1032: Chapter 429 Soul Unity, Devouring Titan Atop the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose body stretched three thousand kilometers, just the head measuring hundreds of kilometers, the two meters long Purple little dragon seemed smaller than a flake of dandruff.
At this moment, an invisible force field of Creation enveloped the Purple little dragon, emitting fluctuations identical to the life aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
That was also why the Purple little dragon could disregard the Deep Red Destruction Thunder, which held the ultimate destructive power that even Mythical Giant Beasts couldn’t withstand for an instant.
In such a case, the Purple little dragon was just like a ‘hair’ on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, naturally impervious to its own power.
It was just that the little guy suddenly let out a roar, directly interrupting the terrifying aura amassed by the Titan Giant Beast torn apart by the Destruction Emperor Dragon; pretending was no longer an option.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head, the realm of thought triggering the release of its Gigantification.
Instantly, the Deep Red Destruction Thunderflame leaping upon its body began to fade, and its massive form started to shrink at a visibly rapid speed, reverting to a kilometer in the blink of an eye.
At the same time, its aura plummeted, appearing somewhat weakened.
Although it had torn the Golden Roc Giant Beast apart with just two moves, erasing the opponent’s Soul Will and the Laws’ Origin had consumed a considerable amount of energy.
Yiya! Yiya! Feeling the change in the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon transformed into a streak of purple radiance and appeared before its huge golden vertical pupils.
“Misss Joseline, no need, my exhaustion isn’t very severe this time,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared low, stopping the Purple little dragon, which had its mouth wide open.
Yiya! Are you really okay? Purple little Joseline blinked her large eyes.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “It’s not a big problem, I will recover after a short rest.”
Having become a Heavenly Tier life form and connected with the Chaos Void beyond the mythical world, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could continuously draw energy from the Chaos Void for recovery.
That energy, different from the Heavenly Energy, was of a higher level and closer to the Origin.
Roar!
Accompanied by a Dragon Roar, the Silver Giant Dragon became a streak of silver light and flew over, roaring excitedly, “Roar! Tim Abott, you’re too awesome, very fierce.”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also flew over, chanting excitedly, “Roar! Thunder Dragon Thunderflame, you’ve burst onto the scene this time, worthy of you.”
My awesomeness hasn’t burst. Several dark lines appeared on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, forcibly resisting the urge to send this creature flying with a swipe of its claw.
At this moment, the gold-blue Giant Dragon, Candle Dragon, and the Kamaitachi Beast flew over as well.
The gold-blue Giant Dragon roared in amazement, “Roar! Thunderflame, what level is that Gigantic form of yours? It even boosted your strength so much, it’s unbelievable!”
From birth till now, the gold-blue Giant Dragon had seen many powerful talents, and some talents of Giant Beasts and different races were tricky and even unresolvable, involving concepts.
But there was a limit to the enhancement that those talents and laws could provide. Like the terribly fearsome talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, this was the first time it had seen.
The ability to match a Mid-Mythical Stage against Mid-Titan strength was already exaggerated, but to think that after entering the Gigantification form, it would tear apart the Giant Beast that had previously fought evenly with it within a few moves.
It was a complete crush, too strong, and it was so eager to learn what that Talent Ability was.
Facing the burning gaze of the gold-blue Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “This is a Giantification Talent I learned from a Level 9 Giant Beast, which through my Epiphany Talent, I’ve deduced to the ultimate limit.”
Immediately, envy and admiration appeared in the eyes of the other Giant Beasts.
Comprehension was too distant for Giant Beasts—they were better at sleeping and letting their bodies grow on their own.
After a brief rest, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “Scythia, Kamaitachi, help me haul this Giant Beast corpse, I will continue to move that small world.”
To the Destruction Emperor Dragon, this Titan Giant Beast was a great nourishment; consuming it, he could at the very least transcend to the late Mythical Stage, if not grow to the Mythical Peak.
There was no helping it, as becoming a Heavenly Tier being and after eight Higher-order Laws tempered the Giant Beast Body, the originally formidable physique of the Destruction Emperor Dragon became even more fearsome.
As a result, its combat power was unprecedentedly strong but the biological energy required to grow another meter also increased because fundamentally, its Giant Beast Body was now comparable to a Titan Beast.
“Roar! No problem, Tim Abott,” the Silver Giant Dragon nodded in reply, a mere half of the Giant Beast corpse.
“Continue.”
With a flick of its claw, the Destruction Emperor Dragon tossed the half of the Giant Roc Beast corpse, measuring over two thousand meters in length, to the Silver Giant Dragon, where the massive Giant Beast corpse stirred up rolling white waves as it moved.
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon reached out with its double claws, as its internal power burst forth, firmly grasping the wings of the Giant Roc Beast corpse, followed by an indescribable heavy force that exploded.
Boom! The Silver Giant Dragon, like a meteor from outer space, crashed with a loud bang into the sea along with the Roc corpse, lifting a skyful of water waves.
After being repeatedly tempered by the laws, the now law-bearing Roc Beast corpse was not only extremely solid but also immensely heavy as if it was a ten-thousand-meter mountain.
Of course, the most important thing was the Roc Beast’s aura, which emitted a suppressive aura to Dragon-type Giant Beasts, making the Silver Giant Dragon’s legs weak instantaneously upon contact.
Boom! The sea surface below exploded, and amid the raging winds and forming ice crystals surrounded by the black storm, the Silver Giant Dragon struggled to carry the Roc Beast, slowly flying up.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s lips curled up slightly, not bad, it overcame the fear stemming from the bloodline.
After the Kamaitachi Beast struggled to carry the other half of the Roc Beast corpse, the Destruction Emperor Dragon once again came to the lower part of the twisted spatial region linking the divine tree world to reality.
With a majestic and Overbearing roar, chains formed from condensed laws sprouted from the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, wrapped around the Boundary Wall of the divine tree world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 1033 429 Soul Unity Devouring Titan_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1033: Chapter 429 Soul Unity, Devouring Titan_2 Chapter 1033: Chapter 429 Soul Unity, Devouring Titan_2 “`
Boom! The colossal clash of the double claws exploded with Power Explosion, shaking the entire Mythical Giant Beast world in an instant, tearing space, lifted directly by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
On the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple Little Dragon Man stood erect, swinging his double claws and shouting, “Yi ya yi ya!! Charge, let’s go home.”
The corner of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched, and then it took heavy steps, with Space Cracks spreading beneath its feet, moving toward the direction of the Rift World.
It took just over ten minutes to travel several thousand kilometers on the way there, but nearly half a day to return; the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish was the first to enter the Rift World.
Bang! Water exploded from the lake surface as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish arrived a kilometer below.
Ying ying ying!! All members of the Naga Tribe, follow me.
Immediately, the Naga Tribe became flustered, not knowing what had happened. Rain Lawson, who had been at the very bottom herding Ice fish, swam up, perplexed and inquiring.
“King of Black and White, my lord, what has happened?”
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s huge mouth, akin to a Black Hole, slightly opened, letting out a roar: Ying ying ying!! Thunderflame’s order, you’ll know once you follow me out.
Without caring for these ‘weaker’ different races, the Single-horned Tiger Whale turned its massive body, stirring up furious currents and swimming out of the lake.
Seeing this, although Rain Lawson was puzzled, she still led hundreds of her tribespeople behind, following the river to the World’s Edge, and then rushing out of the waterfall.
As these Mermaids surrounded themselves with blue aquatic strength and followed the waterfall down into the sea, their faces showed shock as they looked towards the distance.
There, the thousand-kilometer length of the Destruction Emperor Dragon shone with ear-shattering Law Radiance, multicolored, with double claws propping up a world projection high up in ten thousand meters altitude.
Around the Destruction Emperor Dragon were the Silver Giant Dragon and another unfamiliar Mythical Giant Beast, each grasping or carrying half of a gold Giant Beast corpse, as large as a mountain peak.
The surroundings were encircled by Giant Dragons of golden blue and Red Beasts, exuding a Terrifying Aura.
Upon seeing their subordinates and tribe emerge, the massive form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon finally roared into motion, dragging the coordinates of the divine tree world and crashing into the waterfall.
Roar! With a Heaven and Earth-shaking howl, the two worlds collided head-on, and in that instant, the reality of the world exploded with space Burst, unleashing waves of Destructive power.
Both the Rift World and the divine tree world were intact, independent small worlds, like bubbles existing within an interlayer of space in the mythical world.
At this collision, the depths of the Void shook, with projections of two worlds hundreds of kilometers in range appearing, where Earth shattered, and mountain ranges shook as if Doomsday had come.
Roar! As the two worlds collided violently without any signs of fusion, the dazzling crimson radiance erupted from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
In an instant, a Terrifying Aura descended, making Heaven and Earth tremble, as Black-red Lightning spread, covering half the sky and shattering space, annihilating everything.
Under the reflection of this monstrous strength, a projection of the Deep Red World materialized in the Void, with colossal figures as vast as mountain ranges standing tall, emitting ominous Auras.
Under the daunting suppression comparable to Titan Peak, Rain Lawson and others of Level 7 sixth-level Naga shuddered uncontrollably, their faces flushing red as they floated on the sea surface, frightened and thrilled beyond measure.
So strong, their king was unimaginably powerful.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts, they also thunderously crashed into the sea, none able to stand before the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Crimson Destruction Form.
Uh… not quite, there was one.
On the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the little Purple Dragon excitedly waved its little claws: Yi ya yi ya!! Great May, invincible, charge, brother, let’s shatter the world.
Roar! The roar vibrated Heaven and Earth. The Destruction Emperor Dragon, stretching its paws into space, tore viciously, and instantly a Black Crack tens of kilometers long opened straight through to the depths of the Void.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon charged into the Void, standing between two worlds wrapped in transparent Boundary Walls, with Black-red Thunder gathering on its claws, emitting a dazzling light.
The Strength Talent had undergone a Transformation under the Destruction Law, and like the Deep Red Thunder attained in the Deep Red Form, held a part of the Supreme Law ‘Destruction’s’ power.
Thus as the Destruction Emperor Dragon now entered its Deep red Destruction Form, the Destruction it controlled with Deep Red Thunder was very close to the essence of the Supreme Law ‘Destruction’, possessing extreme Destructive power.
At this time, in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claws, endless Black-red Lightning gathered, compressed, and slowly formed two horrifying Thunder Balls of Destruction hundreds of meters in diameter.
The undetectable Destructive Aura emanating from it even made the surrounding Void tremble and twist.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon howled, pressing the nearly uncontrollable Deep Red Thunder Balls of Destruction onto the Boundary Wall of both worlds, and in an instant, dazzling radiance flashed in the Void.
Boom, boom!! A series of Black-red Destruction Thunder erupted, and under the horrific power of Destruction, the Boundary Walls of the two small worlds shattered and tore apart, blasting a massive crack.
Looking from both the divine tree world and the Rift World, a vast Hollow appeared in the sky, surrounded by Black Cracks of space tens of kilometers long.
On the other side of the bleak and violent Hollow stood a Giant Red Beast tens of thousands of meters high, radiating a terrifying power to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Because of the distortion of power, the projection of the Destruction Emperor Dragon appeared extremely immense in the small world.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon tore apart the Boundary Wall on one side of both worlds, the divine tree world shook, and Crystal Red roots tens of kilometers long stretched over.
Boom!! With the red Giant tree’s trunk penetrating into the Rift World, delving into the Earth and continually spreading, finally reaching the ‘core’ of the world, both worlds trembled and started slowly drawing together, fusing.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 1034 429 Unity of Souls Devouring Titan_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1034: Chapter 429 Unity of Souls, Devouring Titan_3 Chapter 1034: Chapter 429 Unity of Souls, Devouring Titan_3 Seeing this scene, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly exhaled.
As expected, a divine tree with the ‘world’ attribute inherently has the ability to fuse with other small worlds.
In fact, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not certain it could merge two worlds, but Jack Clark had once come across some introductory material about this type of giant tree.
For instance, the Silver Glow Divine Tree at the garrison of the Seventh Legion of the Outer Development Department, in reality, contained a space within itself, and there were also some studies by the Human Alliance on other giant trees, which is why it decided to give it a try.
If successful, it could solve the issue of the slow maturation of the divine fruits of the tree, and even in the future, it could continue to pull in and merge small worlds to strengthen them and cultivate the divine tree.
If it failed, the worst-case scenario would be to change the garrison location, so it had called the Naga Tribe out in advance.
However, it seemed that it had made the right bet.
Standing amidst the roaring spatial storms in the Void, the Destruction Emperor Dragon willed its Gigantification to disengage with some anticipation, watching as the two small worlds merged.
Earth collided, World Origins united, and crystal walls came together.
After several hours, the fusion of the two worlds finally stabilized.
The area of the merged Rift World expanded twofold, becoming a small world more than 700 kilometers long and over 400 kilometers wide, with a 6,000-meter-tall red giant tree standing in the middle.
As the two worlds fused, the red giant tree visibly grew by a kilometer in height, and on its branches, four divine fruits, each with a diameter of 15 meters, ripened.
Over these crystal-like divine fruits, the charm of law flowed, emitting rings of red halos and astonishing energy fluctuations.
And in the perception of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as the ‘world’ grew stronger and the red giant tree rooted deeper into the Heart of the World and reached into the Void to absorb energy, its rate of energy absorption became faster.
Based on the current energy fluctuations it emitted, two fruits could mature every Sun Wheel (forty days), representing a stable source of top-tier divine fruit production.
…
Beneath the several-kilometer-tall red giant tree stood many massive beasts, all of whom were excitedly looking up at the four huge divine fruits floating in the air.
The Thunderflame Emperor Dragon let out a low growl, “Joe’s contribution was the greatest in discovering the divine fruit this time; he is awarded one.”
As it spoke, an invisible power sent one of the red divine fruits flying towards the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which almost drooled with excitement.
For the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which was at Late Stage 9 and close to the quasi-mythical, eating this top-grade Divine Fruit and absorbing the charm of law contained within would allow it to enter the quasi-mythical realm directly.
“The remaining divine fruits, Candle Dragon and Telsafi, each of you take one, strive to break through to the Mythical-level quickly so that you can fully utilize the potential of Higher-order Laws in the future.”
“The last one, Misss Joseline, you take it so that your power can increase and you can produce more Creation Energy, serving as a safeguard for future battles.”
The Silver Giant Dragon and the Kamaitachi Beast had no objections to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s distribution.
Top-grade divine fruits had the strongest effect on giant beasts below the Mythical-level, as the charm of law they contained could allow them to touch the law in advance or accelerate the Tempering of the rule.
For beasts above the Mythical-level, although the effects were also good, it would only accelerate growth slightly, and after consuming several fruits, the effect would progressively weaken.
Otherwise, with the ‘estate’ of the Silver Giant Dragon and Gold-Blue Giant Dragons, they would have already soared with resources long ago.
Of course, both giant dragon beasts had actually already soared; whether it was the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon or the Silver Giant Dragon, the growth rate of both was exceedingly terrifying.
By human reckoning, they are only in their teens, yet they have already grown into quasi-mythical beasts and mythical beasts.
Yiya yiya!! The Purple little dragon joyfully pounced on one of the several-meter-wide divine fruits, and then a giant dragon head, also several meters wide, appeared.
Boom! The purple dragon head directly swallowed the divine fruit in one bite.
Don’t think the Purple little dragon is just 2 meters in size; that’s just its reduced state. The Destruction Emperor Dragon felt its true size had already surpassed 100 meters.
Roar roar roar!! I’m going to break through; I’m going to become a quasi-mythical giant beast.
In its excitement, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish also swallowed the top-grade divine fruit in one bite, and instantly a terrifying force exploded within its body. Vast energy erupted, forming a red halo around its body.
Then, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, also each swallowed a top-grade divine fruit as their auras surged massively.
Phew! The three giant beasts laid down in the distance, quietly hibernating and digesting the rich exploding energy within their bodies. The Purple little dragon also flew back on top of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, finding a wide groove between scale armors and settling down to sleep.
The Silver Giant Dragon issued a roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, you go eat; the Great Sethia is going to patrol the newly acquired territory of the Dragon Palace.”
With that, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, and its enormous body soared into the sky, circling the small world with great enthusiasm—this was its territory.
Only the Kamaitachi Beast was notably less present, having recently joined the ‘family’ of the Dragon Palace; it quietly found a corner to lay down and absorb Heavenly Energy to heal its wounds.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon watched the several beasts slowly grow stronger from absorbing the divine fruit energy, a thoughtful look crossed its eyes.
It was considering whether to send the Candle Dragon Giant Beast back to the Blue Star World when it awoke to bring the Female Tiger Whale, the Blue Giant Crab, Kidora, and other beasts over.
Compared to the barren Blue Star World, the growth rate of its subordinates would be faster here.
Especially since it would definitely plunder more God-level or Law Level divine objects, training its subordinates to quasi-mythical or even Mythical-levels.
Latterly, these subordinates going out in all directions to explore the Chaotic Turbulent Region would lead to it collecting resources even faster.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 1035 429 Unity of Souls Devouring Titan_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1035: Chapter 429 Unity of Souls, Devouring Titan_4 Chapter 1035: Chapter 429 Unity of Souls, Devouring Titan_4 “`
As for the matter of subduing other Mythical Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon would continue to do so, but it did not desire just any Giant Beast. For instance, the Golden Roc Giant Beast it encountered this time was simply killed.
Although the legend that the Roc feeds on dragons is just a mythical tale, this particular Giant Roc Beast did indeed exert a bloodline suppression on Giant Beasts like the Silver Giant Dragon.
In the eyes of the Giant Roc Beast, creatures like the Silver Giant Dragon were mere food, and even if subdued, it would only submit to the Destruction Emperor Dragon temporarily, possibly taking advantage of the situation to devour the Silver Giant Dragon and others one day.
Therefore, such a ticking time bomb was definitely not an option.
Of course, there was another reason: it was hungry. Having become a Heavenly Tier Colossus, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s demand for energy and food had grown higher, necessitating the devouring of even more powerful Giant Beasts to hasten its growth.
Lost in thought, the Destruction Emperor Dragon tread with heavy steps, shattering the Earth to approach a vast Golden Beast corpse lying horizontally on the ground, hundreds of meters tall.
Bang! The Destruction Emperor Dragon bent slightly and grasped the wings, over a thousand meters in length, causing a dull vibration, followed immediately by its ferocious maw snapping shut with a bite.
Boom!
The sharp and massive teeth bit into the wing of the Golden Roc Giant Beast, creating an explosion-like boom and firelight, similar to tearing bit by bit into a hard metallic ore vein.
Boom boom boom!! The flesh and blood of a Titan Level Giant Beast was incredibly tough and solid. As the Destruction Emperor Dragon chewed, it created energy impacts like missile explosions, with golden light flickering and an impressive momentum.
After merely two bites, the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed directly, an instant burst of scorching and massive biological energy exploding in its stomach, rich with Law Factors.
Under the vast surge of biological energy, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body crackled as its scale armor split and expanded, and its size began to grow at a rate visible to the naked eye.
Meanwhile, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon devoured its prey voraciously, a terrifying aura burst forth from Jack Clark, who was in the Closed-door cultivation room, causing the ground to crackle and sink, as if unable to bear his presence.
Whoosh! The air around Jack Clark burst from the sudden release of his aura, forming a raging wind that howled and sent his black hair flying wildly; there were even dragon roars echoing inside him.
That was the roaring of his Qi Blood, surging powerfully through his veins.
As Jack’s physique continued to strengthen and his aura grew more terrifying, the Yellow Earth behind him that had absorbed a vast amount of resources had expanded by more than a dozen times, now spanning over a hundred kilometers in diameter.
At the thick core of the Yellow Earth stood a Black Divine Mountain, thousands of meters tall, slowly growing taller, and emanating a magnificent aura that seemed to Suppress Heaven and Earth.
The Earth World, being the base of the Fourfold World, needs to be solid and substantial for its role of heavy bearing.
The second layer, the Golden Flame World, was filled with endless flames. High above, a Golden Sun formed by the Great Sun Heaven Flame Law burned fiercely, radiating infinite light and heat.
The third layer, the Strong Wind World, which had expanded to a hundred kilometers just like the Earth World, was intangible and filled with endless Black Wind, featuring a Tornado that appeared like a Black Hole connecting heaven and earth.
At the core of the most central Thunder World, boundless Thunder converged and compressed into a liquid state, resembling a Thunder Pool, emitting an extremely terrifying Aura.
At the far end of the Thunder World stood a black Stone Gate, Suppressing the Fourfold World.
