Currently, the expansion of the Fourfold World had reached its mid period, and there were still vast amounts of world-class resources yet to be absorbed. It would need to expand to 300 kilometers in range before meeting the requirements to Open Heaven and Earth.
While his world was expanding, Jack also engaged in cultivation.
Within him, streams of World Origin continuously transformed into four Higher-order Laws to Temper his True Body. As for the fifth Soul Law, he had only touched upon it slightly, and it had not yet coalesced.
Since he had only forty-seven streams of World Origin at hand, plus the three strands he acquired from the Top-level Divine Items, the Heaven Heart Golden Lotus, he had just reached fifty streams in total.
The Holy Light Origin contained within the Heaven Heart Golden Lotus had already dissipated with the fall of the Left Saint.
Aside from the coalesced Higher-order Laws of Void, Death, Thunder, and Flames, the remaining ten origins were reserved for the imminent touch upon the Supreme Law.
As such, the Soul Law would have to wait until after the Mythical breakthrough for it to coalesce.
This illustrates the difference between human cultivators and Giant Beasts: Giant Beasts only require the activation of ancient aura within their Life Origin to transition and step into myth. In contrast, human or different races of cultivators need a sufficient amount of World Origin to complete the transformation into Law and step into kinghood.
However, although the Soul Law had not coalesced, within Jack’s body, the Soul Emperor True Body was merging with the Rule True Body.
This time during his breakthrough, Jack aimed not only to Open Heaven and Earth, take hold of the Supreme, but also for his Soul True Body and Rule True Body to become one, directly achieving the foundation of a Heavenly King.
Just as a Giant Beast transitioning into a Titan must fuse its soul with its Giant Beast Body, after achieving the Completion of Law, a human king must unite Divine Soul and True Body in order to break through to Heavenly King.
By merging the Soul True Body with the Rule True Body ahead of time, Jack just needed to cultivate his comprehended Laws to the Great Realm to make a direct breakthrough to the status of Heavenly King.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - 1036 430 A Glimpse from Time Spawn Roc the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1036: Chapter 430: A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc the Giant Beast (7.6K) Chapter 1036: Chapter 430: A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc the Giant Beast (7.6K) In the closed-door cultivation room, as he continued his meditation, a black, eye-like rune suddenly appeared at the center of his forehead, emitting a faint radiance.
In an instant, Jack Clark opened his eyes, revealing a pair of black gold vertical pupils that seemed to overshadow the sun and sky.
Under the gaze of the Void Death Pupil, Heaven and Earth lost their color, and the essence of all things came into view. In the depths of the black-and-white world, a blurry phantom loomed at the very end.
A hazy, transparent light surrounded this blurry figure, disappearing in the blink of an eye without a trace, as if it existed outside the bounds of this span of space-time.
Time Being!
The black gold vertical pupils in Jack Clark’s eyes slowly faded as his eyes reflected a sense of gravity.
This Time Being was very strong, existing neither in the present nor the past but standing in an unknown span of time, scrutinizing him as its prey.
Although it had only glanced at him momentarily, through the intuition of Heart’s Eye, Jack could sense an overwhelming aura of danger.
Even with his strength at its limit, comparable to that of the Mythical Peak, he felt he might not be a match for this Time Being.
Titan Level!
But after all, who the prey was, wasn’t yet certain. Excitement glittered in Jack’s eyes; the strength of this Time Being suggested powerful command over Time Power.
Once the Destruction Emperor Dragon devoured it, the acquired abilities would be even stronger.
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s current comprehensive strength taking control of time, it would become so formidable as to bring despair to its enemies.
However, this Time Being was very cautious. It merely glanced at Jack and then vanished without attacking from the shadows.
Jack waited for a while and, confirming through his psychic premonition that the Time Being had departed, closed his eyes somewhat regretfully.
…
Roar!
In the Rift World, a Black-red Colossal Beast, over one thousand three hundred and sixty meters long and over four hundred meters tall at the shoulder, roared up to the heavens, head crowned with wildly dancing black mane, exuding an extremely ferocious and terrifying aura.
In front of the Black-red Colossal Beast, a two-thousand-meter-long, golden, broken skeleton lay horizontally, oppressive like a Golden Ore Mountain, with the Charm of the Law of Gold pervading it.
As a Titan Level Giant Beast that had integrated a complete Law, even in death, its flesh and skeleton retained a portion of the Law, combined with a rich repository of biological energy, amounting to the sum of several Top-level Divine Items.
This was also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon had distributed the four Top-grade Divine Fruits to its subordinates earlier.
Although it had devoured a Golden Roc, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had only grown by three hundred meters, and its level had advanced from Mid-Mythical Stage to late Mythical Stage, approaching the peak.
There was no helping it, the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was simply too strong.
Its density was already tens of times higher than that of other Giant Beasts of the same level. Coupled with the Tempering from eight Higher-order Laws and the Transformation of Heavenly Tier, the Giant Beast Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was fundamentally no less than that of a Titan Beast.
Therefore, the amount of biological energy needed for every meter of growth was colossal. In the span of one day, to grow more than three hundred meters by consuming the flesh of a Titan Beast was already staggering.
For instance, the Kamaitachi Beast, which was nearby recovering from its injuries, had its eyes widen, staring at the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose body had significantly swollen in size.
Too terrifying, this rate of energy conversion and growth.
Huff!
Ablaze with a searing breath, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt the terrifying power in its body surge manifold, and a cruel smile crept onto its face.
With the increase in body size, it wasn’t just physical strength that was enhanced; the eight grand Higher-order Laws growing in sync also made significant advances towards grand accomplishment, most notably the powers of Destruction, Vajra, and Chaotic Dark Power.
Yet, once a cultivator breaks through to king-level, even with exceptional talent, achieving even a minor breakthrough in one Law to reach the mid Mythical Stage would take years, if not decades.
After basking in the surge of power within, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its attention to what lay before it.
At that moment, a tub-sized clot of golden Essence Blood hovered in front of it, a radiant golden glow swirling with Law Charm and emanating an aura violent enough to shake Heaven and Earth.
This was the Essence Blood that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had extracted from the Golden Roc, roughly one-fifth of the total volume.
As for why it didn’t extract all the Essence Blood from the Titan Beast, naturally it was to leave some for eating; otherwise, the ‘energy’ in the remaining blood and flesh would plummet after the extraction.
Roar! Emitting a low growl, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, akin to a small mountain range, thunderously moved with each step, causing cracks in the Earth for hundreds of meters range, with its claw prints sinking more than ten meters into the ground.
That was even with the domain force field around it; otherwise, the current weight and density of the Destruction Emperor Dragon would bury it straight into the ground.
Stirring up a violent wind wave, the Destruction Emperor Dragon soon reached the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, which was meditating, absorbing the energy of the Red-striped Divine Fruit, by shaking the Earth underfoot.
Boom! With a single swipe of its claw, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had grown to three hundred meters in length, emitting a faint Law Aura, was blasted a hundred meters deep into the Earth.
With the Burst of impact force, the rock and dirt within thousands of meters range rolled like wild sea waves, shattered, and kicked up billowing clouds of smoke and dust.
The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, suddenly struck, was somewhat dazed, and then with a flap of its Double Fin, it leapt into the sky out of the raging wind and dust clouds, looking somewhat aggrieved at the Black-red Colossal Beast.
Roar! Thunderflame, why did you hit me?
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared lowly, “I didn’t hit you, just gave you a pat to wake you up, that’s all.”
To wake up? The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish looked down at the kilometer-wide pit and the thousands of meters range of shattered Earth beneath it, suspicious if the intent wasn’t to kill it with one blow.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “This is a portion of Titan Beast Essence Blood that I extracted. In a moment, I will help you stimulate your bloodline and potential to see if you can absorb some of this strength for Evolution.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - 1037 430 A Glimpse from Time Spawn Roc Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1037: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_2 Chapter 1037: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_2 Emperor-level gigantic beasts possess the power to catalyze and purify the bloodlines of their subordinates with their inherent talents, allowing creatures such as the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish and other Giant Beasts to evolve into those with Monarch Bloodlines.
Otherwise, without Law-level resources that align with their attributes, they would have had no hope of making the transition from King-level to Monarch-level bloodlines.
After the Destruction Emperor Dragon ascended to become a Heavenly Tier being, this ability became even stronger. The potential activated by the stimulation of bloodlines could even help subordinates merge with other bloodlines for evolution, offering a certain probability of success.
This represents another kind of power bestowed by Creation, hinting at just how terrifying the Purple little dragon’s Creation Talent is.
However, the Purple little dragon is not a Heavenly Tier being, something the Destruction Emperor Dragon is certain of. Its level of life remains at the Pseudo-Heaven Tier, similar to what it was before its evolution.
According to the rule that offspring of Mythical Giant Beasts drop one level, the parents of the Purple little dragon must be of at least the Heavenly Tier.
Yet the fact that they couldn’t even protect their offspring’s egg, nearly dying as the Source of Life drained away, led the Destruction Emperor Dragon to surmise that the Purple little dragon’s parents likely perished.
Heavenly Tier beings are undying and unyielding only under normal circumstances. If they encounter Giant Beasts or enemies that are even more powerful, it’s possible to erase the existence of a Heavenly Tier being right from its source.
That’s why, even though it is now a Heavenly Tier being, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose level is still in the late Mythical stage, remains extremely cautious and does not let down its guard.
Of course, there are significant restrictions when the Destruction Emperor Dragon aids in merging Essence Blood to purify bloodlines of subordinates; the Essence Blood to be merged must be compatible with its own.
For instance, Spawn and Roc.
In Mythical Legends, Spawn and Roc are considered inseparable. However, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish only awakened the ancestral bloodline of Spawn, lacking that of Roc. If it could successfully merge the bloodlines, it would undoubtedly undergo a transformative leap.
This is also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon plans to send the Candle Dragon back to bring over the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles and other Giant Beasts.
Compared to enhancing the strength of the Mythical Giant Beasts it subdued later, it trusts these subordinates who have fought their way up alongside it even more, especially in terms of loyalty.
Take the Blue Giant Crab, for example; it wouldn’t even blink if the Destruction Emperor Dragon ordered it to battle against a dozen Eighth Level Beasts.
roar! As it eyes the floating golden blood before it, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes gleam with excitement about merging with the Titan Beast’s Essence Blood.
As for whether the merger will succeed, the Tiger Kingfish doesn’t even consider the possibility of failure; if Thunderflame said it would be fine, then there would be no problem.
With that thought, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish opens its nearly hundred-meter-wide mouth, like a Black Hole, and swallows the Giant Roc Beast’s Essence Blood in one gulp.
Boom! The Essence Blood, carrying the Giant Roc Beast’s bloodline factors and the power of the Law of Gold, explodes, unleashing terrifying energy.
Under the assault of the golden light beams sharp like swords, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s flesh and blood, impenetrable even to missiles, is continuously pierced, and it cannot help but scream in agony.
Roar! As the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish rolls in pain in the air, the Destruction Emperor Dragon lets out a space-shaking roar, and mysterious blue patterns emerge on its right claw, striking down on the head of the Tiger Kingfish.
Boom! As space fractures under the terrifying power, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish is instantly pinned to the ground by the claw, unable to move, flapping only its tail and Double Fins, causing explosions on the Earth’s surface.
The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon presses down on the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, an aura bursting with the blood of a Heavenly Tier life explodes from its claw, instantly triggering a detonation within the bloodline of the Tiger Kingfish.
Boom! The boundless power of the Tiger Kingfish’s bloodline explodes within, forming a vast torrent that inundates everything, sweeping the golden Essence Blood throughout its body and deep into its cells and genetic sequences.
Woof! In an instant, the consciousness of the Tiger Kingfish quakes, and it faintly hears a deep, resonant, desolate horn echoing throughout Heaven and Earth.
In a haze, it envisions a Giant Beast resembling both Spawn and Roc spanning the sky, its massive form so expansive that a single pair of wings can cover the sun, like clouds looming high above.
As the silhouette of this colossal Giant Beast becomes clear, streams of immense information flood into the consciousness of the Tiger Kingfish, causing its head to spin, and it lets out a deep roar like a ship’s horn.
Woof!
Boom! The Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s body erupts with a conflux of black and white radiance, intermingled with strands of golden light. Its aura surges, stepping firmly into the quasi-mythical level.
Under the immense suppressive force, the entire Rift World trembles slightly. The Heavenly Energy of the entire world runs amok and rushes toward the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish, swirling around in a White Mist.
Amid the endless absorption of energy, the body of the Tiger Kingfish undergoes transformation.
Its Double Fins evolve and extend, transforming into massive wings with feather-like Black Gold scales. Its previously bulky shape slightly contracts, becoming more streamline.
Its round eyes extend at the corners like an eagle’s, making them appear fierce and penetrating. Its tail fins spread wider, with slender, tassel-like material sprouting along the edges.
Surrounded by encircling white clouds, the now winged Tiger Kingfish resembles a Spawn Roc radiating a wildly Overbearing presence.
With the aid of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish… no, it should now be called Single-horned Spawn Roc, has successfully evolved into a being with dual Top-tier Talents of Monarch Bloodline.
The sudden transformation leaves all the Giant Beasts in awe. The Kamaitachi Beast, which had been recovering from its injuries in the distance, stares in disbelief, while the hibernating Candle Dragon Giant Beast, absorbing the power of the Divine Fruit, is jolted awake.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon, patrolling its territory hundreds of kilometers away, is alerted by the sudden eruption of powerful Aura and flies back.
Upon seeing the towering figure of the Single-horned Spawn Roc within the ‘Cloud Mist’ that spreads over ten kilometers, the Silver Giant Dragon is taken aback and exclaims, “Roar! Tim Abbott, what has become of Joe?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 1038 430 A Glimpse from Time Spawn Roc Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1038: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_3 Chapter 1038: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_3 The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly let out a low growl, “Nothing much, I just fused a portion of the Essence Blood from the Golden Roc Giant Beast into it, aiding its bloodline evolution. It seems the effect is rather good.”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes immediately brightened, and it roared excitedly, “Roar! Bloodline Evolution! Tim Abott, the Great Scythia also wants to fuse Essence Blood for evolution.”
For Giant Beasts, there wasn’t such a concept of ‘impure bloodline’—as long as it could enhance their strength and purify their bloodline, the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t care about fusing with any type of Essence Blood.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon paused, “… That requires finding a Titan Dragon that is compatible with you, and you must slay the opponent to refine its Essence Blood. Moreover, the success isn’t guaranteed to be one hundred percent.”
“Roar! No problem, Tim Abott, let’s go, to the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region to slay a Titan Level Giant Dragon,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly.
Uh… You think Titan Dragons are cabbages, something you can kill whenever you want?
The Destruction Emperor Dragon was speechless.
Titan Level Giant Beasts are the overlords of their domain. Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon, since arriving in the mythical world, had only met one (the mother of the Silver Giant Dragon) and heard of another (the mother of the Golden Blue Giant Dragon).
Furthermore, although the ability to draw on bloodlines is strong after reaching the Heavenly Tier, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt that at most, the Silver Giant Dragon could evolve one more time, obtaining a Top Tier Talent and reaching the peak of a King-level bloodline.
As for reaching the Monarch level bloodline, it was best not to even think about it—it was too difficult, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon had only become a Monarch level bloodline Giant Beast by reinforcing all its talents to the top level.
Unless the Silver Giant Dragon encountered some other creation in the future, there was no hope of it becoming a Monarch.
Having dealt with the Silver Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon glanced at the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which was still in the state of evolution, and then looked towards the Giant Beast Candle Dragon that had already woken up in the distance.
After consuming another Top-grade Divine Fruit, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast radiated flickering red light from its body, but it was still a bit short of making a breakthrough into myth.
The reason being that unlike the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it didn’t possess the aura of ancient times within its body and needed to rely on the power of its bloodline little by little to revert to its ancestral form.
Therefore, even after the Candle Dragon Giant Beast had consumed two Top-grade Divine Fruits and eaten top-level Divine Items that quicken the Tempering of laws from the treasury of the mother of the Silver Giant Dragon, along with some high-level top-tier Divine Object resources, it was still slightly lacking.
Thinking of this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low growl, “Candle Dragon, return to the Blue Star World for a bit, and bring Horned Lady, Kidora, Domination, and Crab General here.”
“Though we now hold territory in this sea area, we lack the force to gather all resources. We need more Giant Beasts.”
“Roar! No, prob, lem, Thunder, Flame.”
The Red Beast, resembling an Eastern Divine Dragon, slowly inclined its head and then let out a slow roar, turning into a streak of red light that shot up into the sky, leaving the Rift World in the blink of an eye.
After the Candle Dragon’s departure, the Destruction Emperor Dragon got busy once more.
Dragging the skeletons of the mythical peak Bi Giant Beast and the Titan Roc Giant Beast with its double claws and stepping with heavy footfalls, the Destruction Emperor Dragon headed towards the edge of the Rift World.
Hum! An eye-catching golden radiance converged from the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon as a purple halo flickered over its body. In a split second, a stream of gold and purple fused flames burst forth.
Boom! The flames, a fusion of dual Higher-order Laws, released a terrifyingly high temperature that could boil the sea and burn the skies, engulfing an area of several kilometers, melting everything.
Under the horrifying high temperature, the dirt and rock on the ground instantly vaporized, with space distorting. The skeleton of the Bi Giant Beast was the first to emit light, dissolving continuously.
The skeleton of the Golden Roc Giant Beast followed next, shining with brilliant golden light under the gold and purple fused Flame Power, as the mountainous golden skeleton slowly melted away.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon was tempering the skeletons of the two Giant Beasts, the flames it spewed radiated an intangible scorching heat, making the entire Rift Small world grow stiflingly hot.
Eventually, half of the sky was filled with firelight, and a hundred kilometers at the world’s edge had turned into a Magma Fire Sea, where scalding golden magma tongues of flame surged and flicked.
About half a day later, the flames from the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon gradually extinguished to reveal the half energy-materialized essence of the skeletons.
The essence of the Bi Giant Beast’s skeleton resembled a yellow crystal column a hundred meters long and over thirty meters wide, while the essence of the Roc Giant Beast’s skeleton appeared to be a gold mountain over two hundred meters with several tens of meters in height.
Especially that gold mountain, with its sharp, dazzling light flowing over it, emanated strong energy fluctuations and the charm of laws.
Gazing at the two massive essences of the Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled a breath of searing air, then endless golden-white flames erupted from its body.
Boom! Golden-white flames exploded around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, forming a hemisphere of fire with a ten-kilometer diameter that obscured heaven and earth and also blocked the sight of the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts.
Hum! Silvery light flickered on the feather horns on either side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head. In the circle of fire fueled by the flames, a silver vortex emerged, and it rapidly collided and shrank into a vortex with a diameter of over a dozen meters.
Meanwhile, in the Closed-door Cultivation room, Jack Clark had also awakened, with his arm’s clothing turned to ashes, revealing his right arm covered in golden red space runes.
As the space runes operated, a large silver vortex also appeared in front of Jack Clark.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon clasped the hundred-meter-long yellow crystal column with its double claws and with a Power Explosion snapped it into torn pieces, amidst energy blasts comparable to missile explosions concurrent with the refining of the skeleton essence.
Then came the skeleton essence of the Roc Giant Beast, which was also broken into four pieces by the Destruction Emperor Dragon amid thunderous explosions, making it easier to transport to Jack Clark for the strengthening of his world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 1039 430 A Glimpse from Time Spawn Roc Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1039: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_4 Chapter 1039: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_4 Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s feather horn shone with silver light, and in an instant, the Silver Vortex swelled to more than 50 meters, followed by pieces of skeleton essence containing vast energy piercing through it.
But just as the last piece of skeleton essence passed through the Spatial Channel, a purple little dragon, which had been in hibernation, absorbing energy from the top-grade Divine Fruits, suddenly woke up between the cracks of the scale armor on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head.
Yiya yiya!! Wait, Miss Joseline, the great Miss Joseline, too, must make a sacrifice.
As it spoke, a flash of light from the Reverse Scale beneath the purple little dragon’s neck revealed a piece of Life Crystal ‘fruit skin’ about 0.5 meters in size, with red patterns flowing on its surface.
Whoosh! Under the expectant gaze of the purple little dragon, the piece of Divine Fruit ‘fruit skin’ passed through the Silver Vortex.
Immediately, the purple little dragon stood excitedly on its hind legs, spreading its double claws and let out a naive shout: Yiya yiya!! The great May has made a sacrifice; the great May will become strong, so strong.
However, as the Silver Vortex disappeared, the purple little dragon didn’t feel any change, and at the same time, the flames burning around the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly extinguished.
Watching the Destruction Emperor Dragon turn and walk towards the edge of the Magma Fire Sea, the purple little dragon looked somewhat confused: Yiya yiya!? Big brother, why is there no change in May?
The corner of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched, then it slowly rumbled, “This time I did not sacrifice the Life Crystal, I just sent a little something to foster a good relationship.”
Yiya yiya!? Gifts are needed to build a relationship? Confusion dawned on the face of the purple little dragon.
In the memories of its Inheritance, it had not seen anything about building relationships when making sacrifices to unknown beings.
Soon the Destruction Emperor Dragon reached the edge of the Lava Lake and, stepping with heavy feet onto the shore, the Earth shook, and the scorching magma cascaded down like a waterfall along the claws encased in scale armor.
Watching the Black-red Colossal Beast with a terrifying aura, the Silver Giant Dragon, with wings spread floating in the air, roared expectantly, “Roar! Tim Abott, can we depart now?”
At this moment, not far away, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, having completed its Evolution, was excitedly dancing among the clouds, emitting steam whistle-like cries.
Meanwhile, the Kamaitachi Beast, measuring 1,100 meters long, had also nearly restored its aura, exuding the dominance of a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast.
As for the Golden-White Giant Dragon, it lay hibernating on a distant mountain peak, with its powerful aura swirling around, on the verge of making a breakthrough into Mythical-level.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded with a low growl, “Let’s go. This time, we won’t return until we break through to become Titans when we venture deep into the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
Since entering the mythical world, it had either been in hibernation or on the way to hibernation, undergoing a complete Transformation of its rules and ascending to a Heavenly Tier in terms of life stature.
Having reached this step, its Talent Ability and life stature could no longer increase; its next goal was Evolution, frenzied Evolution, to break through to become a Titan sooner and ascend to an Ancient Titan.
Only then would it possess the absolute strength to dominate the battlefield.
Roar! With a roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its body measuring over 1,300 meters in length, took off, its near 3,000-meter Golden-White light wings shining brilliantly, its presence as titanic as the Titans themselves, shaking Heaven and Earth.
At the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s side was the Silver Giant Dragon, measuring over 500 meters in length with 1,000-meter wingspan, the Kamaitachi Beast that was 1,100 meters long, and the 300-meter Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Besides them, there was also the purple little dragon that had briefly awakened on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head and had fallen asleep again.
A little one and four great beasts roared forth, surrounded by a raging wind wave, plunging deep into the Chaotic Domain, heading towards continental blocks at the edge of the Chaos Sea.
Soon, the four Giant Beasts had flown over ten thousand kilometers, and the barren and fragmented land appeared before them.
Having absorbed the Essence Blood of a Roc and possessing dark golden double wings, the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s flying speed skyrocketed, reaching more than ten times the speed of sound in its normal state.
But the Chaotic Domain was not like the Outer World; it was full of dangers. Just after flying out of the sea area, the Kamaitachi Beast roared, its dazzling red flames exploding.
Bang bang bang!! The Kamaitachi Beast shattered the mending Space Cracks in the Void ahead, creating violent Space Turbulence.
With the Kamaitachi Beast cleaving a path, the four beasts flew another 2,000 kilometers. That’s when the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s blue horn lit up.
Suddenly, its eyes brightened: Roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, there’s something good over there.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled softly, “Lead the way.”
After flying about a hundred kilometers to the left, the Single-horned Spawn Roc halted, pointing with its left wing at a kilometer-wide, bottomless Hollow on the distant land and crying out.
Roar! Thunderflame, the good stuff is down there; it smells like it’s about a High-level Divine Object.
Smell?
Looking at the thick horn on the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s head, both the Silver Giant Dragon and the Kamaitachi Beast were puzzled, not sure how exactly it was ‘smelling’ with its horn.
However, since the Single-horned Spawn Roc said there was something good here, it was likely not wrong. The ferocious and mighty Kamaitachi Beast volunteered with a roar, “Roar! King, I’ll go.”
Watching the Kamaitachi Beast gearing up to prove itself, the Destruction Emperor Dragon rumbled softly, “Go ahead, if that good stuff is a Resource category, you can eat it directly.”
A High-level Resource-type Divine Object was somewhat useful for a Mythical Giant Beast, but the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already lost interest.
Boom!
The Kamaitachi Beast, wrapped in red flames, plunged directly into the Earth’s Hollow, instantly causing the space around it to shake and the ground to collapse, revealing a meteorite floating in the subspace below.
On a black stone with a diameter of a hundred meters, there thrived a ten-meter-sized purple orchid, its roots spreading and probing into the Void, emanating a rich energy aura.
Roar! Without any hesitation, the Kamaitachi Beast bit the orchid emitting the purple Divine Light and swallowed it whole. Immediately, its aura churned, improving slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 1040 430 A Glimpse from Time Spawn Roc Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1040: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_5 Chapter 1040: Chapter 430 A Glimpse from Time, Spawn Roc Giant Beast (7.6K)_5 After discovering the purple orchid, the Four Great Beasts traversed a perilous region filled with pillars of fire, then the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes lit up as it looked towards the distance.
Under the dim sky, several mountain peaks that rose ten thousand meters into the sky could be seen hundreds of kilometers away, forming a stretch of majestic mountains
Roar! Thunderflame, I smell something good over there.
“Let’s go, head over there,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double wings shook, shattered the space, and erupted violently forward.
Very soon, the Four Great Beasts arrived between two ten thousand meter peaks, in a valley stretching hundreds of kilometers below, which was filled with a blue flower and tree species, with many giant black ‘bees’ buzzing through it.
At the end of the valley, a hive several meters in size clung to the mountain wall, the air thick with the fragrance of royal jelly and intense energy fluctuations.
In this shattered world, where the rules of Heaven and Earth were chaotic, these bee-like creatures were also mutated, with a regular black bee emitting a sixth level Aura.
Some Giant-headed Venomous Bees that were over twenty meters in length exuded even a Level 7 Aura.
Especially the black toxins needles, several meters long, at the tail of these Poison Bees, were extremely sharp and shrouded in a dark light containing terrifyingly powerful Toxins.
“Roar! Leave this to the Great Sesi, kill! The Great Sesi wants to see a river of blood,” roared the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly, encircled by a black storm, flying toward the distant hive. Instantly, the swarm in the valley below erupted into chaos.
But the Silver Giant Dragon was too fast, ignoring the ordinary high-order Poison Bees, appearing above the several thousand meter hive in the blink of an eye.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
In an instant, thousands of Poison Bees surged out, with Sixth and seventh level, even level eight Auras emerging, swarming densely towards the Silver Giant Dragon to drive away this intruder.
However, these black bees with thick carapaces couldn’t get near the Silver Giant Dragon, all being frozen and shattered by the black Destruction storm that spanned thousands of kilometers.
Roar! Just then, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a resounding roar, and a tsunami-like burst of white frost extended over a dozen kilometers, spreading all around.
Crackle Crackle! Under the icy tintide that even faintly froze the space around, a layer of one meter thick ice formed on the mountain wall, and thousands of bees in the air were outright annihilated.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Countless corpses covered in frost smashed to the ground, shattering into pieces and forming a thick layer of a mountain of corpses, the scene was staggering.
This was the power of a Mythical-tier Giant Dragon, where a Burst of strength could clear an area on the map in an instant.
The Silver Giant Dragon tore apart the hive’s shell after a single strike, including the Level 9 Aura emanating queen inside it, and inside found a several hundred meters large golden hive.
Holding the golden hive, the Silver Giant Dragon took a bite and instantly its eyes shone bright: “Roar! Delicious, feels great, Tim, you should try some.”
The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, holding onto the remaining half of the golden hive, and flew to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Seeing the huge bite marks on the half of the hive, the Destruction Emperor Dragon hesitated only for a moment before nodding its head and took a bite.
Suddenly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes lit up, it was indeed delicious.
Not only was it rich with energy comparable to that of senior Divine Objects, but the fragrant taste was delightful to the soul, and after eating it, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt its mood improve drastically.
It felt so content that it wanted to slay a Mythical Giant Beast and tear it apart violently.
“Roar! Let’s continue,” said the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Roar! Charge, let’s slaughter them all, devour everything.
Having ‘landed’ for such a short time and already discovering two high-level divine objects, worthy of being the Chaotic Turbulent Region that’s filled with endless resources.
Soon, guided by the excited Single-horned Spawn Roc, after delving thousands of kilometers, they made another discovery.
In the distance, a black mountain peak tens of thousands of meters high could be seen, a thousand-meter-long serpent, its body covered with crystal-like scale armor, coiled at the foot of the mountain.
In front of that Mid-Mythical Stage white Giant Dragon, the Earth cracked open, and a thick black liquid energy kept surging out, emitting intense energy fluctuations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1041 - 1041 431 Breakthrough the Myth the Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1041: Chapter 431 Breakthrough the Myth, the Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends Chapter 1041: Chapter 431 Breakthrough the Myth, the Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had just approached within a hundred kilometers when the white python, over a thousand meters in length, suddenly reared up, emitting a ferocious roar like a cross between a lion and a tiger.
The powerful shockwaves of the sound caused the earth within a kilometer to tremble, and rocks to tumble down.
A gray-white power explosion erupted from the python’s body, covering a range of three kilometers. Wherever it passed, the air rotted away, and rocks corroded as if weathered for tens of thousands of years, its aura staggering.
Seeing the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Silver Giant Dragon, and the three massive bodies of the Kamaitachi Beast approaching from afar, murderous fury filled the eyes of the white python.
Even with the intense aura of danger the Destruction Emperor Dragon exuded, the white python still assumed an attack stance, showing not a hint of fear.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which had just made a breakthrough to the quasi-mythical level, it was completely ignored by the white python.
Looking at the python, which bore traces of the ancient ferocious Dust Giant Python and whose law power involved toxins and corrosion, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a slow growl.
“This time, this king shall come forth.”
Boom!
The light wings behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon flared, instantly accelerating to over thirty times the speed of sound, causing a sonic boom. Its enormous body, with the friction against the air, turned into a scorching blue plasma, emitting a dazzling light.
Roar!
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon burst forward, the white python let out an angry roar, and a dazzling gray-white light converged in its mouth. Suddenly, a beam of light burst forth.
Boom!
The several tens of meters thick gray-white light pierced through heaven and earth, expanding endlessly, surrounded by rings of ghastly white halo, emanating an extreme aura of corrosive deadly toxins.
When the ghastly white breath spanned tens of kilometers and appeared in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it had expanded to hundreds of meters, engulfing the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had not yet deployed its Law Domain.
Boom! The dazzling light shone in the sky, the endless eruption of ghastly white breath contained not only terrifying corrosive power but also extreme energy impact.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a vicious roar. Its huge body descended from the sky, directly facing the breath of the white python. Amidst the dazzling white energy impact, a claw struck down.
The black-red Giant Claw, wrapped in black lightning, tore through domains, shattered space, and pressed down upon the python’s head, which was as huge as a mountain peak, with a fierce push.
Boom!
Under the terrifying force, the earth within thousands of kilometers crumbled. Half of the white python’s body was directly pressed into the earth hundreds of meters deep, while the rest of its thousand-meter-long body twisted wildly outside.
Boom boom boom!!
The sweeping body of the python crushed rocks into dust, whipped up violent airwaves, and the impact burst loudly upon hitting the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Then the white scale armor shattered, and blood gushed out.
No matter how much the white python struggled, it could not free itself from the dragon claw of the Destruction Emperor Dragon. The corrosive and deadly toxin laws on its body were also suppressed by the black destructive lightning.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon, holding down the white python, let out a roar, on its body blue-black thunderbolts, scorching golden-white flames, and purple halos erupted explosively.
Boom boom boom!!
With the addition of destructive lightning, four higher-order laws suppressed and burned, causing the laws entwined around the white python to collapse. Its scale armor shattered, letting out piercing, tragic screams.
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s current strength, dealing with such a mid-mythical stage beast was almost like crushing an ant.
If it were not for the life force and the Undying characteristic endowed by the laws after reaching the myth stage, it could have directly blasted the python’s head with one claw, instantly killing it.
Just then, as the white python’s body twisted along the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s clawed arm, trying to coil around its neck, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze turned cold.
Thump! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s left claw reached out, grasping the white python’s contorted body, and Power Explosion ensued.
Boom! Under the terrifying strength, the white python, with a thickness of over sixty meters, had its scale armor shattered, flesh and blood exploding, spewing copious amounts of white blood, as it was directly snapped in half by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Instantly, the white dragon emitted even more piercing cries and wails. Its aura weakened; half of its body was pressed to the ground by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, while the other half was held in its claw, twisting wildly.
Roar! Just as the white python was torn into two by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the mountain wall beside it exploded, and a ferocious roar shook the mountain peak.
Through the sky full of scattered rock and smoke, a thousand-eight-hundred-meter-long python, covered in black scales with a single horn on its head, bearing the peak of mythical power, roared out.
Upon seeing the two halves of the python’s body in the claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Black Python’s eyes turned red, filled with insane murderous intent. The hundred-meter-long single horn radiated black light.
Boom! The Black Python instantly burst forth at a frightening speed of nearly a hundred times the speed of sound, turning into a black streak of light piercing through space, appearing directly in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head.
Underneath the razor-sharp black single horn, space itself was pierced, creating a hollow. The python’s massive mouth gaped open, like a black hole devouring everything.
Even the golden-white flames and blue-black Thunderbolt Power burning around the Destruction Emperor Dragon were bitten into a void as if directly erased.
This peak myth-level python possessed a very strong innate talent, even capable of devouring the power of higher-order laws, but…
Boom! Space in front of the Black Python tore apart, and a black-red Tail Blade emerged, its blade shimmering with the integration of golden-purple law light, exuding a keen aura that terrified the Black Python.
Under the fearsome Tail Blade, space was Annihilated. With the Law of Speed, the motion was so swift that the Black Python’s senses couldn’t keep up, and it was bisected in an instant.
Boom boom!!
The Black Python’s bisected massive body crashed to the ground, shattering rocks; copious amounts of black-red hot blood gushed out like fountains, staining the Earth red.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 1042 431 Breakthrough the Myth the Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1042: Chapter 431 Breakthrough the Myth, the Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends Part 2 Chapter 1042: Chapter 431 Breakthrough the Myth, the Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends Part 2 These bloods exuded a strong energy and Law Aura, merging with the Earth to form crystallized energy materials.
However, just as half of the Mythical Giant Beast’s blood had spurted out, it was instinctively locked by the muscle tissues of the Black Python’s body, which writhed, attempting to draw closer and merge.
Boom boom boom! Endless gold-purple fusion flames enveloped the body of the Black Python, forming a Destructive Great Sun with a diameter of two thousand kilometers.
Under the extreme heat and the combined might of two Higher-order Laws, the Earth melted, creating a hollow over three thousand meters wide, while the surrounding rocks and dirt dissolved into magma under the terror of temperatures exceeding a million Celsius.
As the roaring flames burned, the air within tens of kilometers rapidly heated, with the surface flames transforming the land into a forbidden zone of death.
This was the current state of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose every movement was akin to a Catastrophe, turning everything it passed into ashes under the force it released invisibly.
Roar! In less than a minute, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low roar, the surrounding flames and thunder dissipated, revealing its massive and fearsome body.
The two sections of the White Python in its claws and the twisted body of the Black Python floating nearby no longer moved, their life auras vanishing to become corpses.
With the corpses of two Mythical Giant Beasts for contrast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood above the Magma Fire Sea, radiating a Terrifying Aura so oppressive that the surrounding Void shattered.
To tear apart two Mid-Mythical Stage and Mythical Peak Giant Beasts in less than a minute—such battle power was indeed shocking.
No one could have imagined that this terrifying Black-red Colossal Beast had been nothing more than palm-sized Six-legged Salamander a year ago.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you are so powerful,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared cheerfully, transforming into a beam of silver light as it flew over, stirring up rolling white waves.
Following were the Kamaitachi Beast and the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Both Giant Beasts were relatively calm.
After witnessing the image of the Destruction Emperor Dragon tearing apart a Titan Giant Beast, such Mythical Giant Beasts could no longer shock them; instead, it seemed only natural.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc arrived at the cracked surface at the foot of the mountain, where black energy spring water still flowed amid the burning flames, and cried out, “Roar! Thunderflame, that good stuff is deeper inside the space.”
“Deeper inside the space, huh.”
With a low growl, the Destruction Emperor Dragon tossed the corpse of the White Python it had been clutching down with its claw, its colossal body slowly flying over, its presence overpowering.
It reached the crack in the mountain wall, over ten meters wide and diagonally extending for hundreds of meters.
Breathing out scorching breaths, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws reached deep into the crack, grasping the invisible sides of the space, and suddenly the Power Explosion burst forth.
Boom! Under the power of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, more terrifying than the usual Titan Giant Beast, the mountain crumbled and the entire mountain peak shook violently as a massive crack spread for thousands of kilometers.
The space, made of invisible materials, was torn straight through, creating a pathway crack spanning a kilometer long and hundreds of meters wide, leading into the depths of space, with a subspace at the end of the crack.
In that subspace, which resembled a bubble about a kilometer in diameter, was filled with a vast amount of black liquid, equivalent to a soccer field in volume.
Instantly, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes lit up.
The black energy liquid flowed out of the cracks like a stream, emanating a rich energy aura, pure and profound, containing a hint of Law Charm.
In terms of level, it was roughly equivalent to ordinary God-level Resources, but this liquefied Heaven and Earth Treasure could be easily absorbed by both cultivators and Giant Beasts without much resistance.
Furthermore, the quantity was substantial.
“Roar! Tim Abott, so much energy marrow liquid,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly.
Roar roar! Thunderflame, we’ve struck it rich!
Compared to the excited and agitated two Giant Beasts, the newly joined Kamaitachi Beast appeared somewhat restrained, its massive body simply standing behind, stepping excitedly.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “This haul is indeed substantial. Divide the energy marrow liquid into ten parts—four for me, and the remaining six are for you two, each taking two parts.”
The three Giant Beasts had no objections to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s allocation; it being the strongest naturally meant it should get the larger share.
Boom!
With a swipe of its claw, the Destruction Emperor Dragon covered the skies, forcibly extracting the subspace hidden deep within the Space Interlayer, including the energy marrow liquid.
Encircled by its unseen domain power, the black energy liquid floating in the air was divided into four parts.
“Eat it all; after we’ve absorbed it, we’ll continue sweeping through the area,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon bellowed, opening its maw wide and inhaling towards the soccer field-sized pool of energy liquid before it.
Boom!
Under the powerful suction, the hundred-meter-wide liquid, about one-tenth the volume of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, was swallowed in one gulp, causing an infinite Power Explosion within its body.
Crackle crackle!
With an abundance of energy, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body continuously collided, its bones growing and its scale armor expanding under the pressure of the growing muscles, radiating intense energy fluctuations all over.
By the time all the energy had been absorbed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had grown by over thirty meters, reaching a terrifying length of one thousand four hundred meters, nearing the Mythical Peak.
According to the standard size limits of Mythical Creatures, the maximum length is around one thousand five hundred meters.
Glancing at the Silver Giant Dragon and the other Giant Beasts, who had also swallowed all their energy marrow liquid and were radiating intense energy waves as they absorbed the resources, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned towards the corpses of the two Mythical Giant Beasts.
Clutching the corpse of the White Python, the Destruction Emperor Dragon tore off a huge chunk of flesh and blood with its mouth, its maw chewing with thunderous sounds, and blood and meat spilt flowing down its jaws, appearing incredibly ferocious.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 1043 431 Breakthrough Myth The Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1043: Chapter 431 Breakthrough Myth, The Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends_3 Chapter 1043: Chapter 431 Breakthrough Myth, The Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends_3 Feasting on the flesh and blood of Giant Beasts of its own level or even higher was the fast track to growth for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
And just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon delved deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, beginning its massacre, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s flying ship, emissaries of the Human Race, was also approaching the Human Territory.
Atop the tens of kilometers-long golden and magnificent flying ship, the Mysterious Martial Sky King and a Heavenly Feather Alien Clan strong man of late Heavenly King realm stood on the edge, looking ahead.
There, a boundless red mist appeared at the horizon, connected to the depths of the Void above, emanating a dangerous aura.
With an imposing expression, the Mysterious Martial Sky King said solemnly, “Alus, pass through the hidden pathway in the forbidden area ahead, and that will be where the Thirty-first Corps of our Human Race’s Outer Development Department is stationed.”
The blonde middle-aged man known as Alus smiled, “So we are finally reaching your Human Territory, are we?”
…
Inside the Closed-door cultivation room of the 30th Army Group headquarters of the Outer Development Department, Floating City.
As Jack Clark tossed eight chunks of essence refined from the Mythical Peak Giant Beasts and Titan skeletons into the four Plane Worlds, the four worlds immediately became turbulent.
Enveloped by the World Core space, the unlimited energy, Law Power, and materials released from the eight chunks of Giant Beast skeletons caused the Plane Space to expand at an astonishing rate.
In the yellow Earth World, rock and dirt were born out of nowhere, the Earth became thicker, and the crystalline walls enveloping the world in the Void also expanded and thickened, increasing the space’s carrying capacity.
This transformation was also occurring in the other three Plane Worlds, with the width of the worlds rapidly breaking through two hundred kilometers, two hundred and ten kilometers, two hundred and twenty kilometers…
As time went on, the Four-fold Plane World gradually approached the breakthrough requirement for the Opening the Heavens event.
And as the worlds grew more mighty, the invisible World’s Power that spread also grew stronger, merging with the Divine Absolute Barrier around Jack Clark to form an even more solid Boundary Wall.
With the breakthrough approaching, Jack Clark had also nearly completed the Tempering of his Rule True Body.
The transformation of the Void, Death, Great Sun Heaven Flame, and Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder laws was done, and in addition, some Soul Law had also been consolidated, utilizing two strains of World Origin.
Under the Tempering of nearly five Higher-order Laws, the Aura emanating from Jack Clark was increasingly terrifying and heavy.
The five types of Law Power spontaneously exuded a charm that converged behind him, vaguely forming a three-faced, six-armed Demon God Illusion towering three hundred meters.
Apart from the oppressive force of the five Higher-order Laws, this Demon God Illusion also circulated three auras on par with the laws, which were the powers of the three Great Divine Powers.
Time passed, and suddenly Jack Clark’s eyes snapped open, and a terrifying force burst forth from him, cutting through the Cloud Sky, instantly changing the color of the heavens and the Earth.
Boom!
The rooftop of a Closed-door cultivation room in the west side of the Floating City suddenly exploded, a golden-blue Light Beam shot up into the sky amidst a swirl of rock and dust.
Boom!
The Gloomy blue sun hung in the Firmament, shining its cold rays below, causing Heavenly Energy within hundreds of kilometers to rage, with endless dark clouds converging out of thin air.
In just the blink of an eye, these dark clouds turned into a dark cloud vortex above tens of kilometers in the high altitude, eclipsing the sun, as if Doomsday had arrived.
The sudden turn of events instantly caught everyone’s attention, and the several hundred thousand inhabitants of the city instinctively looked up, with some High-Ranking Powerhouses shouting excitedly.
“Look quick, it’s the king-level breakthrough phenomenon.”
“Someone is breaking through to king-level.”
“Haha… Heaven blesses our Human Race, another powerhouse has broken through to king-level.”
In the center of the Floating City, a handsome and scholarly middle-aged man appeared out of nowhere atop a kilometer-high building, looking up at the Firmament and smiling faintly.
“So this kid is finally about to break through to king-level, is he?”
Not far from the Sky King Denny Kaye, the space split open and Sky Knife King Sheehan Wade appeared, smiling, “Sky King Denny, what do you think about how many laws Jack Clark will condense this time around?”
Sky King Denny Kaye thought for a moment, “At least two or more, I’d say. Didn’t Jewell say earlier that he demonstrated the power of both flame and thunder when he clashed with the Alien Mythical Powerhouses?”
“That strike directly injured the Mid-Mythical Stage Alien Deity; it was extremely Overbearing, and there’s a very high chance it was a Higher-order Law’s power.”
Even the Sky King Denny Kaye couldn’t help but marvel when talking about this.
“Two Higher-order Laws, and also his imminent Opening the Heavens—if he successfully controls a Supreme Law, he will be able to stand invincible amongst his peers as soon as he enters the King Realm.”
Sky Knife King Joel Moore spoke thoughtfully, “Actually, even without his breakthrough to king-level, he’s already invincible in the Legendary Realm.”
“Let’s not mention that battle in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield from a long time ago; recently, in the Gunardo Ruins, he killed the Left Saint’s Mythical Peak Avatar.”
Suddenly Sky King Denny Kaye paused and gave a wry smile, “All right, perhaps I’ve been thinking too small. With such a monstrous talent, when he breaks through, he should be able to clash with Heavenly Kings.”
At that moment, an elderly voice arose behind the two men, “Be careful, the commotion from Jack Clark’s breakthrough this time might be quite massive.”
Both men became serious at once, nodding slightly to acknowledge they understood.
Boom!
Suddenly, infinitely dazzling golden flames ignited above the sky, gradually forming a Golden Sun with a diameter of a kilometer, radiating endless light and heat.
Just as the Golden Sun emerged, a formidable oppressive force descended from the heavens, weighing down on everyone in the Floating City all at once, making them gasp.
At the same time, the temperature between heaven and earth shot up rapidly, climbing dozens of degrees Celsius in the blink of an eye, turning the vegetation yellow, then withered—and that was with the source still tens of kilometers away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1044 - 1044 431 Breakthrough Myth Ancient Thunder
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1044: Chapter 431 Breakthrough Myth, Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends_4 Chapter 1044: Chapter 431 Breakthrough Myth, Ancient Thunder Tribulation Descends_4 “`
The awe in everyone’s faces was clear to see.
Sky Knife King released a breath, “Such a powerful Law pressure, indeed it’s a Higher-order Flame Rule with the characteristics of the Stellar Sun.”
Just as Sky Knife King finished his exclamation, in the sky darkened by overcasting clouds, a series of dazzling Blue Thunder burst forth, densely packed like a net of lightning covering the Firmament.
Tens of thousands of Thunder boomed and exploded, causing the entire Heaven and Earth to tremble as the atmosphere churned and thunderous roars echoed without end, the sheer scale of it terrifying.
Under that almost spine-chilling aura of destructive Thunder, endless lightning converged into a Thunder Dragon over a thousand meters long, with fierce Scale Horns and clearly visible whiskers.
With a roar, just as the Thunder Dragon formed, a Terrifying Aura on par with Myth burst forth, even emitting a ferocious howl, utterly otherworldly.
Looking at the large day and Thunder Dragon in the sky, radiating blinding Radiance, Sky King Denny Kaye nodded, “Such intense destructive energy, indeed it’s a Supreme Thunder Law.”
But it didn’t end there. Just then, an infinite darkness spread above the Firmament, vast and pure like the cosmic Starry Sky.
Within that Void, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils appeared, shrouding Heaven and Earth, surrounded by sixteen rings of countless Black runes converging—a Law Chain—emanating an astonishing Aura.
Boom!
As the third manifestation of Void Law appeared, the pressure permeating between Heaven and Earth surged again, the terrifying pressure causing the air to solidify, forming waves of white blasts sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
Countless cultivators struggled under the force of the three manifested Higher-order Laws, all showing expressions of shock on their faces.
Including Sky King Denny Kaye and Sky Knife King, who were both startled and surprised, “It’s the Void Law! He’s actually condensed the power of the Void?”
Before everyone’s shock subsided, an endless grey Gate appeared in the Void of high altitude, reaching up to ten thousand meters.
The grey Gate seemed tangible, engraved with the ethereal forms of numerous Living Beings. As the Gate cracked open slightly, a grey power spread out, carrying the essence of all things withering and the quietude of life approaching Death.
In an instant, the pressure across Heaven and Earth surged once again.
Boom, boom, boom! Four Higher-order Laws manifested, causing explosions in the high-altitude atmosphere, even making space tremble, forming transparent ripples that swept across Heaven and Earth.
“Four Higher-order Laws, containing Void and Death, two of the superior Higher-order Laws!”
Even the likes of Sky King Denny Kaye couldn’t help but feel a bit shaken in this moment.
For a cultivator, condensing a single Higher-order Law qualifies one for the stature of a Heavenly King, not only giving them far greater combat power than their peers but also accelerating their future cultivation speed.
But even among Higher-order Laws, there is a distinction.
For example, Laws like those of Flames, Thunder, Ice, Water, Earth, and what Jack Clark is now condensing, Death and Void, belong to two different levels.
Compared to those Laws that reach their limit merely at the Higher-order, like Earth and Thunder, Death and Void, including the Destruction Lightning of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, are part of the divergence of Supreme Laws.
These Higher-order Laws touch upon a portion of the jurisdiction of Supreme Laws, hence their level and strength are almost on par with Higher-order Laws, but with a higher ceiling. If cultivated to the ultimate end, they can even aspire to attain Supreme Law.
Thus, they are categorized as Superior Higher-order Laws.
“`
And the so-called Supreme Law refers to some kind of basic rule power related to the myriad worlds of the universe, like time, space, death, reincarnation, destruction, creation, and so on.
That is why the Sky King Denny Kaye and his group were so shocked; they never expected that Jack Clark would condense four High-Order Laws just after his breakthrough, and two of them were among the top-tier.
If he successfully opens the heavens and grasps a Supreme Law afterward… Hiss!
Sky Knife King immediately inhaled sharply, his face quickly revealing an excited expression. As expected of the monster who received the Ancient Civilization Emperor Inheritance, too terrifying.
Before the astonished eyes of countless cultivators below, Jack Clark, wearing black and red Dragon Scale Armor and wielding a ferocious War Halberd, appeared in front of the ‘sun’ burning with golden flames.
Behind him, a golden Great Sun burned with a diameter of a kilometer, surrounded by Thunder Dragons spiraling and roaring, and with the Black Gold vertical pupils veiling the void, set against the backdrop of the Gate of Death, he seemed like a War God from ancient times descending.
“So strong!”
“Is he that genius of our Human Race? He’s so powerful that just the Divine Might of breaking through to king-level suppresses Heaven and Earth. Once he successfully forges his Rule True Body, I can’t imagine how powerful he will be.”
“I have a premonition; he will become the fourth Supreme Expert of our Human Race.”
At this moment, countless cultivators within the Floating City were thrilled, with some High-Ranking Powerhouses from the Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heavens already certain that Jack Clark possessed a Supreme bearing.
Just as everyone was shocked and excitedly watching Jack Clark in the midst of his breakthrough in the sky, suddenly hundreds of kilometers above, the ‘sky’ slowly cracked, forming a black crack hundreds of kilometers long.
This crack, like an eye of the sky, exuded an indescribable Terrifying Aura, filling Heaven and Earth and shaking the space-time.
In an instant, Sky King Denny Kaye, Sky Knife King, and the Primordial True King standing in the Space Interlayer all had a serious change in expression.
The Primordial True King spoke slowly, his voice ancient and grave, “The spectacle of this youngster’s breakthrough is indeed magnificent; before even opening the heavens, the Mythical Heaven Tribulation has appeared!”
Since Supreme Laws involve the fundamental rules of the world, during the Opening of the Heavens, a terrifyingly powerful Heavenly Calamity will occur. If you withstand it, you can successfully take control of a Supreme Law; if you fail, if not dead, you are gravely injured, and the breakthrough fails.
The three had not expected that before Jack Clark even opened the heavens, his terrifying potential had attracted a Mythical Heaven Tribulation.
“A Mythical Heaven Tribulation, huh.” Above the Firmament, Jack Clark slowly looked up at the crack in the sky resembling the eye of the Firmament and revealed a strong Battle Intent in his eyes.
Boom! Four laws entwined around him, and endless blood light exploded from his center, turning a range of thousands of meters into a Sea of Blood Hell.
In an instant, Jack Clark’s War Halberd sank with the domain power of the Sea of Blood Hell making it incredibly heavy. Following that, streaks of lightning and flames flashed, their Radiance erupting.
Facing the Mythical Heaven Tribulation, which only appeared when opening the heavens, Jack Clark was not afraid but he also did not dare to be careless.
Boom! A dazzling golden light flashed within the Black Cracks, turning into a hundred-meter-thick Golden Thunderclap Pillar descending from the sky, emanating a Terrifying Aura.
The moment the Golden Thunderclap Pillar appeared, a terrifying pressure belonging to the heavens descended, immediately shaking the souls of all present, their internal powers dispersing and unable to be condensed.
Under the soul-shaking force, the laws within Sky Knife King’s body suddenly dissipated, and his expression changed drastically as a sharp and unrivaled Blade Intent shot up into the sky.
Boom! A golden blade light pierced through heaven and earth, tearing apart the soul-shaking pressure.
Just as Jack Clark’s War Halberd smashed the thunder from above the Firmament, the Great Sun behind him merged into his body, and his aura skyrocketed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1045 - 1045 432 Ancient Emperor Divine Soul and True
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1045: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite Chapter 1045: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite After the disappearance of the golden thunderclap pillar, the awe-inspiring pressure of the Heavenly Calamity lingered between heaven and earth, causing the hearts and minds of hundreds of thousands of cultivators in the Floating City to quiver, unable to regain their senses for a long time.
High above in the tens of kilometers altitude, within the slowly healing black pathway, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, a layer of transparent crystal wall emerging around him, blocking the raging Void Storm, radiating an unshakeable resolve.
This scene left many advanced cultivators deeply shocked.
“So powerful, he actually withstood the Heavenly Calamity without a scratch!” many faces below revealed expressions of amazement.
The power of the golden heavenly thunder just now was truly terrifying. Not only did its destructive strength reach the Mid-Mythical Stage, but it also contained a shaking force that could shock the soul.
Especially that attack aimed directly at the soul, it was extremely dangerous for most cultivators.
Currently, the Alliance Core Think Tank has very few Cultivation Methods related to the soul, and the difficulty of cultivation is very high. Therefore, typical Ninth Heaven Experts only condense the power of the soul.
As for combat and defense techniques relying on the power of the soul, these are few and far between, let alone resisting the shock of Heaven and Earth’s might.
While those cultivators below were in shock, Jack Clark above the Firmament also slowly exhaled, suppressing the slight boiling of Qi Blood within his body.
As a Divine Power, the Absolute Barrier would grow stronger with Jack Clark’s increase in cultivation level.
Furthermore, with its diameter magnified to 300 kilometers, the strength of the Four-fold Plane Power, transformed into a crystal wall, made for a defense so terrifying that it could disregard most attacks from Mythical Powerhouses.
This is the advantage of being enhanced to the extreme in all aspects, without any weaknesses.
Just then, amidst the healing chaotic Void around Jack Clark, strands of pure golden energy appeared, and in an instant, all the cells in his body emitted a strong longing.
A longing to absorb that golden energy.
This energy… Jack Clark’s eyes flickered slightly.
From the floating strands of golden energy around him, he sensed a power similar to the Creation Energy exhaled by the Purple little dragon, but there was a different aura to it.
Without hesitating, Jack Clark reached towards those strands of golden energy, and an Invisible Power began to draw that energy into his body.
Boom! The instant that golden energy merged into Jack Clark’s body, behind him, the sunlight of the Stellar Sun, transformed by the Great Sun Heaven Flame Law, surged tremendously and suddenly collided with him.
In that moment, the Heavenly Energy vibrated, and within the Stellar Sun, Jack Clark’s form swelled enormously, transforming into a 150-meter-tall Demon God with three faces and six arms.
At the same time, the surrounding golden Great Sun kept compressing, merging into the True Demon God Body of Jack Clark, his aura skyrocketing, crossing the chasm between Transcendent and Myth in a single step.
At this moment, Jack Clark truly became a Mythical King, wielding the Higher-order Law of the Great Sun Heaven Flame.
And at this time, under the influence of that golden Creation Energy, Jack Clark’s realm stabilized, unlike other newly-advanced kings who would need several months of Closed-door Cultivation to solidify their realm.
Before Jack Clark could become familiar with his new realm, a more terrifying pressure spread across the Firmament above.
Looking up, the crack in the sky, reminiscent of a black eye, kept tearing wider, quickly expanding to over 500 kilometers in length, with dazzling White Light emerging from its depths.
An endless tide of White Flame surged, forming a flame long sword that stretched over two kilometers in length.
And it didn’t end there; within the endless sea of white flames, a giant beast composed of fire spread its wings over five thousand meters across emerged.
Chirp! The White Flame Phoenix-like beast uttered a cry that shook heaven and earth, and instantly an aura of ancient and primal majesty mixed with extreme ferocity spread throughout.
Boom! The very moment the White Flame Phoenix appeared, a vortex of energy formed across hundreds of kilometers as the energy of heaven and earth surged tumultuously towards the sky above.
When the mist-like concentration of heavenly and earthly energy touched the white flames, they ignited instantly, and in the blink of an eye, the entire sky was obscured by white flame, radiating intense heat.
Looking at the vortex of flames spanning tens of kilometers in the sky above, many advanced cultivators below involuntarily swallowed hard, their eyes filled with horror.
Chirp! The White Flame Phoenix let out a ferocious cry, its flaming wings beat once, and with a sword gleam clenched in its beak, it descended from the heavens amidst the sea of fire, like a World-ending Phoenix.
This strike, while not one that shook the soul, brought with it the bloodline pressure of the ancient Ferocious Beasts, making countless people’s legs tremble as they fell back onto the ground once again.
It was a fear that originated from the deepest parts of their genetic makeup, reverence for the Divine Might of Mythical Creatures that dominated the skies and Earth in ancient times, now crossing time and space to descend once more.
Roar!
Stimulated by the Mythical Legend creature’s imposing pressure, a Dragon Roar emerged from within Jack Clark, and in an instant, an even more ferocious Dragon Might burst forth, scattering the Phoenix’s might.
Boom!
The air vibrated, and the War Halberd in Jack Clark’s hand shone brightly with golden light. The Great Sun Heaven Flame Law wrapped around it, transforming into a two-kilometer long Golden War Halberd that soared into the sky.
As everyone held their breath and watched, the golden fiery War Halberd clashed with the White Flame Phoenix in the blink of an eye, followed by an explosion of boundless Radiance.
Boom! Under the overlay of Jack Clark’s True Strength’s explosive properties, the supremely compressed Heavenly Flame exploded with Terrifying Power, instantly shattering both the White Flame Phoenix and the sword gleam.
The release of the furious energy made it seem as if a ten-kilometer diameter golden-white sun had actually appeared in the sky, emitting endless light and heat to illuminate the world.
Around the scorching Great Sun, a white flame ring circulated, sweeping over tens of kilometers, shattering the dark cloud vortex gathered during Jack Clark’s breakthrough, its grandeur immense.
An invisible blast, carrying hot raging winds, descended from the sky, burning everything in its path.

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 1046 432 Ancient Emperor Divine Soul and True
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1046: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite_2 Chapter 1046: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite_2 However, when this fiery assault got within three thousand meters of the Floating City, a layer of blue energy shield emerged above the city, enveloping everything and everyone within it to provide protection.
Boom, boom, boom! The roiling clash between the twenty-plus level fiery hurricanes and the shield sparked dazzling energy impacts, with the thunderous rumble echoing nonstop.
At this moment, the exploding firelight in the sky gradually dissipated, revealing Jack Clark’s figure resembling both god and demon, with three faces and six arms. Not far from him floated a white flame, emitting a pure radiance.
Under Jack Clark’s slight beckoning, an invisible force drew the white flame into his hand, merging into his body.
Whoosh! The moment the flame integrated into Jack Clark’s hand, an invisible force surged through his entire body, instantly making his freshly consolidated Law True Body even more powerful.
Most importantly, under the energy of the white flame, Jack Clark’s physical Qi Blood as well as his Law Talent strength, both became more active, as if they were purified anew.
Roar! Below, the Thunder Dragon, transformed by the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder Law, roared with blinding lightning, and with a thunderous blast, surged into Jack Clark’s body, causing his aura to swell once again.
With lightning entwining him, Jack Clark’s True Body rapidly expanded, his aura becoming more terrifying and oppressive, causing the surrounding space to emit cracking sounds, unable to bear the weight.
Looking up at the figure two hundred meters tall in the firmament, far more imposing than average Mythical Powerhouses, a smile emerged on the Sky King Denny Kaye’s face.
“Jack Clark’s strength is too formidable; what would be a perilous Mythical Heaven Tribulation for other Heaven Openers is a blessing in disguise for him.”
“By continuously absorbing the Origin Power of two different Heavenly Calamities, not only has he stabilized his newly achieved realm, but even his Law True Body has undergone an immediate Tempering transformation.”
“Indeed,” nodded the Sky Knife King, impressed.
Becoming a Heaven Opener is difficult because all their energy is consumed in comprehending the mysteries of the world and gathering the Plane World.
Therefore, under normal conditions, regardless of whether it’s the Transcendent True Body or Combat Techniques and Cultivation Methods, they are somewhat weaker than other Ninth Heaven Peak powerhouses, making them naturally more vulnerable when facing the Heavenly Calamity of opening the heavens.
But for Jack Clark, whose strength comparable to a Mythical Peak was already evident in the Nine-layer Late Period, this emerging Mythical Heaven Tribulation was an opportunity.
The essence of the Mythical Heaven Tribulation is essentially the world’s response from the Mythical Realm’s rules when an individual is too powerful for a breakthrough, causing a sympathetic vibration.
Therefore, the stronger the individual undergoing the tribulation, the greater the power of the Heavenly Calamity. However, its intensity always stays within the limits of the Mythical Realm and will not exceed the extreme.
Otherwise, it would not be a Mythical Heaven Tribulation but rather divine punishment.
As Jack Clark’s aura continued to boil, the crack in the heavens above expanded once more, tearing and spreading across seven hundred kilometers, instantly amplifying the pervasive might of Heaven and Earth.
Amid the terrifying pressure where even the atmosphere was compressed into rings of white waves spreading outwards, a ferocious beast, two thousand meters long and completely formed from black thunder, emerged from the deep chasm.
This beast had two horns on its head, its body covered in scale armor, resembling a Kirin but far more ferocious, with black thunder swirling all around it, somewhat similar to the mythical wolf dragon from the legends.
The moment the ancient ferocious wolf dragon appeared, a terrifying aura capable of devouring True Dragons permeated through heaven and earth.
Under the oppressive aura that feeds on dragons, the ‘dragon’ power within Jack Clark’s body trembled slightly, seemingly a bit suppressed, but then an endless surge of Power Explosion erupted.
Roar!
A terrifying Dragon Roar echoed from Jack Clark’s body, and one after another, black and red Dragon Scales surfaced on his skin, his aura soared, as fierce and Overbearing as a humanoid ferocious beast.
In legend, the wolf dragon fed on dragons, relishing dragon brains, and was extremely ferocious.
But the Dragon Bloodline from Jack Clark’s Avatar Giant Beast was no ordinary dragon blood; it was of Emperor level strength, completely disregarding natural predator-prey relations.
Boom!
Lightning flashed in the sky, and the ancient ferocious wolf dragon, vast as mountain ranges, trod upon the void, compressing the atmosphere, Heavenly Energy, and space into solidity as it moved.
From afar, it seemed as if the ferocious beast descended from the heavens amidst layers upon layers of transparent Tsunamis, striding across the sea.
This spectacle made even the Sky Knife King’s pupils contract—not merely due to the destructive prowess of the ferocious beast itself but also because of the sheer terror of the transparent Tsunamis encompassing thousands of kilometers around it.
Even he was not confident of slicing through those spatially compressed transparent Tsunamis, and an average Ninth Heaven Cultivator would be shattered upon contact.
Boom! The 200 meter tall, three-faced six-armed Jack Clark turned into a golden-blue streak of Radiance shooting skyward.
In his hands, the over five hundred meter long War Halberd shimmered with gold and blue, almost completely transformed into light due to the extremely concentrated Law Power, outshining even the most revered deities.
Boom!
With two Higher-order Laws intertwined, the hefty, Overbearing War Halberd tore through the spatial Tsunamis, charging forward, transforming into a two thousand meter long golden-blue Halberd Skill that cleaved towards the Thunder ferocious beast.
Roar!
The Thunder ferocious beast roared, and in an instant, countless black thunders glittered around it, solidifying the spatial tides condensed within kilometers of its surroundings.
