There was no explosive destruction like before, nor an overwhelming shock of force.
Under those spreading black thunder flashes, space cracked like fragile glass, and in the blink of an eye, disintegrated into a myriad of shattering reflections, forming a powdered area several kilometers in diameter.
In that apocalyptic force of world-shattering Terrifying Power, the Halberd Skill disintegrated, and cracks appeared on the Four-Layer Plane Barrier enveloping Jack Clark.
Thud!
The Combat Techniques infused Boundary Wall collapsed, and Jack Clark uttered a muffled groan.
Cracks emerged across his body, now covered in black and red Dragon Scales and fused with his battle armor, and slender Bloodstains appeared on his arms and cheeks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1047 - 1047 432 Ancient Emperor Divine Soul and True
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1047: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite_3 Chapter 1047: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite_3 While it was also the power of thunder, the black thunder that manifested as the ancient ferocious beast, a wolf dragon, was not the ultimate heat and destruction, but instead, pulverization.
In the face of such immense power, where space shattered and laws dissipated, even Jack Clark sustained light injuries, despite his body being more formidable than the Boundary Wall of the plane.
Jack Clark sighed lightly, “As expected of the power of the Mythical Heaven Tribulation, it truly must not be underestimated.”
As he spoke, the cracks on his body disappeared at a visible rate, recovering in the blink of an eye; then Jack Clark focused on the rampaging void before him.
There, a black lightning several meters long serpentine flashed, exuding pure energy of the Laws’ Origin.
The moment Jack Clark grasped that black thunder, his entire being was enveloped in dense black lightning, and simultaneously, the golden vertical pupils that manifested the law of the void entered his body.
Boom! Jack Clark’s aura surged wildly, including his True Demon God Body, which expanded to over 250 meters, emitting an even more terrifying and profound aura.
Huu huu!!
Around the three-faced six-armed Jack Clark, black void, golden flames, and blue thunder manifested, forming three substantial chains of law sequences that encircled him, sacred and imposing.
With each successive, grand heavenly calamity, countless cultivators and new humans within the Floating City below watched in shock, their eyes blazing with fervor.
Too powerful.
Boom! The cracks in the Eye of Heavenly Path above the firmament tore further, reaching a terrifying span of 900 kilometers, resembling a dark abyss, permeating an even more potent authority of the Heavenly Dao.
Under the terrifying might of heaven and earth, countless people were shaken to their cores, with some cultivators below the Seventh Layer Heaven turning pale, unable to withstand the increasingly potent divine pressure and fainting away.
In just the blink of an eye, more than a hundred thousand people had fallen, a horrifying sight to behold.
Hum! The energy shield above the Floating City shone brighter, becoming more massive and blocking most of the oppressive force that filled the space between heaven and earth.
“This is the grandeur of a king’s breakthrough, how terrifying.”
“Indeed, just the invisible pressure emitted makes it hard for us to breathe…”
Many cultivators sighed with relief, their faces still filled with shock.
At that moment, countless rays of light converged in the depths of the dark cracks in the sky, materializing into a hazy palace complex.
On the vague steps of that palace, a colossal phantom tens of kilometers tall emerged, standing atop time, as if an emperor descending from ancient times, exuding an indescribable kingly aura.
“How is this possible, it’s actually the Ancient Emperor’s Tribulation!” Sky King Denny Kaye’s face slightly changed.
The fuzzy emperor’s figure slowly lowered its head, looking down on the three-faced six-armed Jack Clark below. In an instant, Jack Clark felt a strong sense of danger.
Boom! Heaven and Earth collapsed, and the entire world shook mightily.
The ancient phantom slightly waved its hand, and instantly, an enormous golden Emperor Seal, thousands of kilometers in size, fell from the sky, with an aura of suppressing heaven and earth and crushing all eons.
Beneath that Emperor Seal, which descended as if a Divine Mountain, a vast area of space shattered, annihilating all existence and creating a continually descending dark tide of destruction.
Watching the heaven-shattering descent of the firmament, Jack Clark, standing at a high altitude, was not a bit nervous.
One could see his right face, with eyes tightly closed, slightly tilting up, an indifferent expression on his face, and black law patterns starting to emerge on the edges of his eyes, followed by his eyes suddenly snapping open.
Boom!
Under the gaze of sixteen-fold amplified, Black Gold vertical pupils concentrated with the law of the void, the tide of destruction spreading across the firmament halted.
Crackle Crackle! The golden Emperor Seal began to show cracks, which rapidly spread, blanketing the entire seal in the blink of an eye.
Boom!
The dazzling golden light above the firmament exploded, forming a golden halo that swept across tens of kilometers. Everywhere it passed, space continuously shattered and exploded, a spectacle that shook heaven and earth.
In the howling winds, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, his right face with eyes that exhausted the energy of the void and unleashed a destructive strike slowly closed.
At this moment, Reverse Defeating the ancient, standing above the firmament, Jack Clark’s aura grew even more terrifying as the raging wind howled around him, blowing wildly through his black hair.
As the golden Emperor Seal shattered, wisps of fairy-like white radiance fell from the sky, enveloping Jack Clark in white light, making him appear even more otherworldly.
And as the fourth Ancient Emperor’s Divine Tribulation was passed, the Gate of Death standing in the depths of the void shook, transforming into a gray law chain that rushed into Jack Clark’s body.
Boom!!
Under the integration of higher-order laws, Jack Clark’s true body once again expanded to 300 meters, and at the same time, a divine and noble aura diffused from his being.
Suddenly, excitement appeared on many faces below.
“He has succeeded, the great one has completed the integration of the Laws Integration True Body. Next, as long as the law’s origin in the soul birthed within the body transforms and metamorphoses into a Divine Soul, then…”
Boom!
Just as tens of thousands of high-level cultivators in the Floating City thought the breakthrough had ended, an immense and boundless soul pressure erupted from Jack Clark.
Behind him, a figure just as tall at 300 meters, wearing an Imperial Robe and crowned with the Twenty-Four All-Heaven Emperor Crown, emerged, holding a black Emperor Seal in its hand.
Whoosh! Black, grey, gold, and blue flames blazed on Jack Clark’s figure, which were the Laws’ Origin formed inside his body.
Under the burning of these Laws’ Origin, the Soul Emperor True Body also began to transform, turning towards an immortal soul that would never wither.
As the soul began its transformation, the Soul True Body and the three-faced six-armed true body of Jack Clark also gradually drew closer, and suddenly, a sense of complete and formidable aura emitted from him.
Boom!
The Eye of Heavenly Path above the firmament, which was about to fade, shook, the cracks tore further, and a black abyss a thousand kilometers long was formed. From the depths of the abyss, an even more terrifying power emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1048 - 1048 432 Ancient Emperor Divine Soul and True
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1048: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite_4 Chapter 1048: Chapter 432: Ancient Emperor, Divine Soul and True Body Unite_4 As the Eye of Heavenly Path trembled, everyone below widened their eyes, in disbelief at the sight of the Soul True Body behind Jack Clark.
Even Sky King Denny Kaye, and the Primordial True King himself, showed a touch of shock on their faces at that moment.
Sky King Denny Kaye’s eyes widened in astonishment as he looked at the Soul True Body wearing the Imperial Crown: “How is it possible? This youngster’s soul has actually condensed a Soul True Body.”
“Moreover, it’s as high as three hundred meters. To condense such a massive Soul True Body, the foundation of the soul must be at least a hundred times more than that of his peers!!”
Even an old stalwart Heavenly King Level powerhouse like Sky King Denny Kaye lost his composure in this moment.
As for Sky Knife King, he was so stunned that he didn’t know what to say, repeatedly muttering words like ‘monster,’ ‘pervert,’ ‘impossible.’
“No wonder he was able to complete the Road to Becoming a God and obtain the Ancient Civilization Emperor Inheritance; his foundational soul is too strong, indeed his talent is not in the physical body awakening, but in the soul.”
At this moment, Sky King Denny Kaye finally understood the terrifying reason behind Jack Clark’s talent.
Because Jack Clark’s foundational soul was so strong, much stronger than anyone could comprehend, under the counter-supplement of the soul, his enlightenment as well as his cultivation speed were both horrifically astounding.
While everyone was still shocked by the sudden appearance of the Soul True Body, Jack Clark frowned slightly.
Because his soul was too strong, the transformation speed of his Divine Soul was too slow.
With this thought, Jack Clark couldn’t help but look up at the firmament above, where the shadow of an ancient emperor deep within the abyss manifested again, along with an even clearer view of that palace complex.
What it represented was an even more powerful and terrifying Majesty of the Emperor, even faintly surpassing the bounds of myth.
Watching Jack Clark below trying to breakthrough to Mythical King, intending to merge with the Soul True Body in one step, that vague shadow of the ancient emperor slowly lifted his right hand and then suddenly flipped it.
Boom!
As Heaven and Earth trembled, a palm with a diameter of one kilometer, its lines clearly defined, descended from the sky, rolling the atmosphere as it passed, creating rings of white waves that spread in all directions.
Under that palm from the ancient emperor, the laws of Heaven and Earth instantly collapsed, all forces were suppressed, annulled, including the energy permeating between heaven and earth.
Even the four Higher-order Laws within Jack Clark’s body, including his innate heavy pupils, were suppressed and sealed under this palm, unable to be mobilized.
This was the Majesty of the Emperor, with just a thought suppressing all things in Heaven and Earth, irrefutable and inescapable.
“The power of the waning law, huh?” Jack Clark exhaled, his robust six-armed wrists moved, and instantly a terrifying power that could shake the world spread from within his body.
His strongest power has never been the laws, nor True Martial, but that physical body which was even more terrifying than the Mythical Giant Beasts of the same tier.
Looking at the palm that covered the sky, Jack Clark let out a roar resembling the dragon’s chant, all acupoints in his body glowed with Blood Qi, and in an instant, an Overbearing and extreme power was unleashed.
At that moment, Heaven and Earth shook, everything around Jack Clark was distorting, even light was devoured, forming a kilometer-wide dark area.
Within this range, everything was deforming, and an Aura of terror that could crush Heaven and Earth, no less than the ancient emperor’s majestic oppression, spread out.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon broke through to the late Mythical stage, nearing the Mythical Peak, and with the feedback enhancing Jack Clark’s physical body to even more frightening levels, in addition to the bolstering of the Supreme Vacuum Divine Power.
Boom! Jack Clark brought his six arms together, holding the War Halberd and turned into a black radiance shooting up into the sky.
Boom!
Under the strike of the War Halberd, seven hundred meters long and entwined with black radiance, the emperor’s palm descending from the sky exploded, and the space around it turned into chaos.
The Unrivaled Domineering Power continued unabated, forming a spreading black radiance, as if a black War Halberd tens of kilometers long had pierced through Heaven and Earth.
The terrifying aura of power caused the very heavens and earth to shake, even the floating islands tens of kilometers below were trembling, the sight was fearsomely overwhelming.
At this moment, everyone was in a trance, staring in horror at the sky above, at the figure standing firm in the dark, holding a halberd.
A Ninth Heaven Expert took a long breath, expressing shock and awe, “Are you sure he’s breaking through to become a Mythical King, not a Heavenly King?”
Above the sky at that time, within the exploding chaotic air waves, a stream of golden light emerged, transforming into a hundred-meter-long golden dragon shadow, which surged into Jack Clark’s body.
Boom! The flames transformed from the Four Laws’ Origin on Jack’s body soared, burning fiercely as if they were inexhaustibly intense.
With enough of the Origin burning, the Soul True Body standing behind Jack transformed at an astonishing speed, dozens of times faster than before.
In the midst of everyone’s excitement, emotion, and disbelief, the Soul True Body, clad in an Imperial Robe, completed its transformation, gradually merging with the Three-faced Six-armed Jack.
Watching this scene, the Primordial Heavenly King took a deep breath, “One step at the base of Heavenly King, with the talent he’s showing now, it might not be long before he breaks through to the Heavenly King level.”
“Add to that the Ancient Civilization Emperor Inheritance he has acquired, the path to supreme power has no obstacles for him, all he needs now is time…”
At this point, the Primordial True King paused.
Even the Primordial True King felt, at this moment, that Jack’s limit was not just Supreme, but that he had a glimmer of hope to break the shackles and take that legendary step to become a Civilization Emperor.
Thinking this, the Primordial True King’s expression became very serious, “It seems I need to find Old Qian and Tian Ji, to craft some forbidden weapons for this young fellow.”
After the battle in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, Jack now only had two life-saving forbidden weapons left, one with a teleportation function and one that could act as a life substitute once, and that life-substituting forbidden weapon was only effective against those below the Mythical level.
That meant Jack was left with only one Rule Forbidden Weapon at this time.
Initially, when the First Councilor and others prepared the Rule Forbidden Weapons for Jack, they took into account all aspects, such as a Star Ring capable of withstanding a frontal strike from a Demon God, the Beast King Seal against curses, transportation, and life substitution – the four kinds of forbidden weapons.
But who would have thought that Jack would grow so fast – a Myth in one year.
And now, the ‘potential’ he showed was even greater than what the Primordial True Kings had predicted; initially, they just thought he had the pose of the Supreme, but now things were completely different.
If Jack grows successfully, even if he fails to withstand the Second Mythical Impact and Blue Star is devoured, the Human Race still has hope.
Under normal conditions, a Supreme needs the existence of their original world to have a glimmer of hope to take the final step.
But as one who has received the Primordial Rule Inheritance, Jack doesn’t need it because he already has the key; as long as he can break through to Supreme, he has a great chance of becoming a Civilization Emperor.
Looking at the figure emanating a terrifying aura in the firmament, many people thought it was over.
But just then, four rings of light appeared behind Jack, and projections of the yellow, golden, black, and blue Fourfold World emerged amidst the shining light.
Boom!
With a single thought from Jack, the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Four Realms united, instantly shaking the four planes, causing the Earth to collapse, the Great Sun to rage, and a raging wind and thunder to howl.
But under the suppression of the black Stone Gate, the Fourfold World gradually united.
Suddenly, above the firmament, the previously vanished Eye of Heavenly Path reemerged, radiating an even more terrifying oppressive force.
Ignoring the ancient palace above the firmament, Jack stepped into the Chaotic World and transformed into a towering figure of ten thousand meters, with the World’s Power entwined around him as if he were the Lord of Creation.
With the Gateway to Heaven on his back, Jack, holding the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, which was over twenty thousand meters long and entwined with the four series of laws and converged with the World’s Power, swept across in an instant – the heavens shattered, the earth split, and all things broke asunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1049 - 1049 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1049: Chapter 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens, Supreme Law Chapter 1049: Chapter 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens, Supreme Law “It’s not over yet!!”
Watching the four-fold world projection with a diameter of 300 kilometers, almost obscuring the sky above the Firmament, hundreds of thousands in the Floating City were all numb with shock.
The fusion of four rules had triggered four Divine Tribulations, and the transformation of the soul and the fusion with the True Body had even summoned the aid of an ancient emperor’s projection.
This terrifying phenomenon was enough to be recorded in the annals of the Human Federation’s cultivation history. Yet, nobody thought that it still hadn’t ended at this step.
Looking at the four-fold Plane World projection appearing in the sky, it was clear that it was preparing to unify Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder to Open the Heavens. Such audacity left everyone in awe and shock, beyond words.
Sky King Denny Kaye slowly exhaled, “Finally, it has reached the step of Opening the Heavens,” he said, his figure flashing to appear tens of kilometers above Jack Clark’s world projection, separated by tens of kilometers.
Boom!
A boundless, soul-crushing, terrifying Aura emanated from Sky King Denny Kaye, filling the entire Heaven and Earth after avoiding the scope of Jack Clark’s breakthrough.
In an instant, the Heaven and Earth darkened.
Despite the blue sun hanging high above the Firmament and the radiant glow from the four-fold world projection, everyone felt as though the world had turned black and white.
Especially the vague black terrifying shadow that appeared behind Sky King Denny Kaye, it made everyone instinctively feel fear and tremble, an awe from the depths of their souls.
As Sky King Denny Kaye unfolded his Soul Law and the Aura of his strength spread to intimidate all directions, the figure of the Primordial True King in the Spatial Interlayer sank.
Thump, thump, thump!! The space around the Primordial True King cracked layer by layer, forming a Spatial Channel that penetrated deep into the Dark Void.
The image of the white-haired Elder that was the Primordial True King stood in the Dark Void, with a faint White Light flickering behind him, the pathway to the Material World.
In an instant, a powerful Aura spread from the darkness afar, and a Void Creature over seven hundred meters long with a myriad of bizarre tentacles and no solid form emerged.
Looking at the pathway to the Material World, the cruel eyes of that Void Creature revealed a greedy gleam.
However, before the Void Creature could act, the Primordial True King looked over with an indifferent expression, his non-human, dark red, fierce eyes appearing in his gaze.
Boom!
Under the gaze of the Primordial True King, the Mythical-level Void Creature suddenly dispersed, exploding into a wild surge of Dark Void Energy.
This was the might of Supreme Experts.
Under the Rule’s power, ordinary Mythical Creatures had no strength to fight back; they couldn’t even react before they were annihilated with a single look.
After killing the Void Creature that lurked in this area, the gaze of the Primordial True King coldly turned towards another side of the deep darkness, where an even more terrifying dark Aura loomed.
However, unlike those lower-level Void Creatures that went mad upon sensing life, this one seemed to fear the Primordial True King. It only confronted him briefly before slowly retreating into the darkness.
Facing the final step of Jack Clark’s breakthrough, both protective strong men had taken action.
As for Sky Knife King today, he was just an onlooker; after all, he couldn’t even defeat Jack Clark, let alone face a possible terrifying being.
While the Primordial True King stood in the Void, suppressing one side, suddenly a powerful force violently shook the nearby Void, vibrating through matter and void alike.
Instantly, a hint of surprise appeared in the eyes of the Primordial True King: “Is it already beginning to unify the world?”
Outside, above the sky.
As the Boundary Walls of the four-fold world collided, the entire world began to shake. Mountain peaks in the Yellow Earth World collapsed, the Earth crumbled, and even more black cracks appeared in the sky.
From those fractured cracks, scorching flames fell from the sky, burning the heavens and boiling the seas, consuming everything.
Simultaneously, black World-ending Tornadoes descended through the cracks, destroying Heaven and Earth. The Tornado Storms were filled with resonating thunder that flashed brilliantly.
At this moment, the four-fold world was like a boiling pot, with four elements contacting each other, causing violent explosions and emitting endless destructive power.
Soon the entire Earth vanished from sight, turning into Scorching Magma under the high temperature of golden flames, then shattered and exploded under the sweep of the Black Hurricane and Thunder.
Under normal conditions, such a brutal and forceful unification method would directly cause the collapse of the Plane World.
But at this time, under the suppression of a black Stone Gate at the center of the world, as the four attributes kept colliding and exploding, the crystals of the four-fold world gradually unified.
Beyond that, as all matter was destroyed and shattered, the interior of the world gradually became turbid, resembling a micro Chaotic World.
This process lasted for several hours.
When the Plane World projection became turbid, and all matter inside ceased to exist, leaving only the wild elements of Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder, Jack Clark outside the world finally moved with a thunderous momentum.
Standing three hundred meters tall, with three faces and six arms, Jack Clark holding a War Halberd took one step forward.
As the ‘World Lord’, surrounded by the World’s Power, Jack Clark could enter the Plane World anytime. But the Plane Worlds of the past were too fragile to sustain his presence.
As soon as Jack Clark appeared in the mini Chaotic World, the raging elements of Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder around him became even more wildly violent, gushing towards Jack Clark with a Destructive Aura.
Boom!!
The raging Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder elements, upon approaching within tens of meters of Jack Clark, hit an invisible barrier, exploding with earth-shattering booms, yet failed to budge the Absolute Barrier even slightly.
Ignoring the wild energy surging around him, Jack Clark walked towards the black Stone Gate standing at the center of the world, towering ten thousand meters tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 1050 - 1050 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1050: Chapter 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens, Supreme Law_2 Chapter 1050: Chapter 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens, Supreme Law_2 Meanwhile, as Jack Clark took each step forward, his figure continued to expand: five hundred meters, seven hundred meters, one thousand meters, three thousand meters…
In a plane world with weak spatial constraints and without the suppression of space, Jack’s true body could unleash its strength unrestrained; or rather, this was the essence of his true form.
Including other king-level beings or demon king level strong men, don’t be fooled by the mere two to three hundred meters they seem to manifest in reality. As Mythical-level beings, their true essence is unimaginably terrifying.
It’s just that the spatial suppression of the mythical world is so strong and its foundational rules so stable, that their forms appear only that large.
Including the Blue Star, which has already been partially devoured by the mythical world, is likewise permeated with the power of the mythical world, suppressing all transcendent life between heaven and earth.
And as Jack approached the Heart of the World, the Eye of Heavenly Path that had disappeared above the firmament reappeared, tearing a giant crack over fifteen hundred kilometers long.
Boom! In an instant, an even more terrifying pressure from the Heavenly Dao burst forth, under which even Sky King Denny Kaye’s form slightly sank.
The energy shield covering the Floating City vibrated madly, generating ripples of energy shockwaves, and even the entire floating island swayed.
Under the frightening pressure of the Heavenly Dao, light converged within the depths of the crack, once again forming an ancient palace, and this time, only one palace appeared, with a clearer image.
Instantly, an ancient and desolate aura spread out, filled with an ineffable heaviness that made everyone’s chests feel congested and their breathing uncomfortable.
This time, the phantom of the Ancient Emperor did not appear, but the sense conveyed was even more fearsome.
Gurgle! On the rooftop of a skyscraper at the City Center, a Ninth Heaven Expert swallowed nervously as he looked up at the huge crack in the sky, his face turning pale.
“Just the invisible pressure is this terrifying. What exactly is that palace? Could it have been the dwelling of an ancient emperor that once existed?”
Another Ninth Heaven Expert beside him, also the deputy commander of the 30th Army Group, smiled wryly and shook his head, “The mythical world is too mysterious, who knows what it is.”
The Sky Knife King above the city exhaled slowly, his expression solemn, “It’s different from the divine tribulation phenomena when Mad Wheeler opened the heavens back in the day, but he should be able to withstand it, right…?”
However, at this moment, due to the murkiness of the world, everyone had lost sight of Jack and did not know what would happen next.
While countless people below were filled with nervous anticipation, Jack had already transformed into a giant standing ten thousand meters tall next to the black stone gate.
Around him swirled chaotic currents, his three faces and six arms bearing an over twenty-thousand-meter-long War Halberd, resembling a Demon God born innately from chaos, with a terrifying aura.
As Jack stood amidst the chaotic currents, he, acting as the ‘World Lord’ of this realm, had a comprehension well up within him.
Opening the Heavens!
And he must do so.
As the world congregated elements of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, merging the Fourfold World into one, if he could not complete the Opening the Heavens, even with the Gateway to Heaven suppressing this realm, it would collapse.
“Opening the Heavens, huh,” Jack murmured softly, his voice thunderous as it shook the world, the breath he exhaled stirring up raging wind, giving him a sensation of omnipotence at his towering ten-thousand-meter stature.
But he knew this was merely an illusion, simply due to the plane world’s weak constraints on power, causing his true body to expand exponentially.
A simple analogy would be a difference in density; essentially, his strength had not changed compared to when outside.
Whoosh! Jack took a deep breath, his expression gradually becoming more indifferent. His three faces were expressionless, like the statues of deities sitting stoically in a Taoist Temple.
At the same time, the terrifying physical strength inside of Jack began to boil, activating the dragon’s power within him and merging it with the Divine Power Supreme Vacuum to form an Overbearing power.
Simultaneously, the radiance of laws representing the Void, Death, Heavenly Flame, and Divine Thunder flickered, forming four Law Chains circling around, slowly merging into the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in his hands.
At the same time, with Jack as the center, a dazzling blood-colored radiance spread out, turning half the world into a Doomsday Hell imbued with the Sea of Blood, subtly merging with this world.
In that world filled with endless blood light, where Doomsday Hell unfolded, countless Void Creatures and Giant Unique Beasts struggled and hissed, connecting to the Hell Plane in the void, and in an instant, one corner of Hell descended.
Boom!
With Hell merging with Doomsday, a force of the Power of Hell descended, enveloping Jack, and suddenly his aura surged, appearing like a Bloody Prison Demon amidst the endless flashing blood light.
At the same time, under the bolstering of the Power of Hell, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd grew even heavier, its terrifying mass and weight warping everything around it like a Neutron Star.
“Open for me!” Jack bellowed, his six arms coming together, wielding the War Halberd as immense as a mountain range to sweep across the chaos before him.
Boom! A resplendent and blinding Halberd Skill exploded through the chaos, like a crescent moon tearing through everything, and in an instant the entire world trembled violently.
As the Halberd Skill expanded and spread, the chaotic currents it passed were continuously torn apart and cleaved, and finally, the entire world was bifurcated by Jack’s strike.
In an instant, the entire world froze, and then the shaking intensified even more.
Amidst the ferocious energy, the world, now split in two, did not recombine. Instead, it was as if an invisible Boundary Wall had formed between the top and bottom, segregating them.
Within the tumult of energy, the lower Earthen, Fired, Wind, and Thunder mixed with chaotic currents sank down, gradually turning into a yellow, murky energy that continued to sink, while the chaotic currents above became a buoyant gas rising.
This scene left everyone gazing in awe, watching the evolution of the world and the imposing figure standing in front of the black stone gate at the world’s center.

chapters.title: Chapter 1051 - 1051 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1051: Chapter 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens, Supreme Law_3 Chapter 1051: Chapter 433 Creation of Opening the Heavens, Supreme Law_3 The figure who opened heaven and earth, towering ten thousand meters tall, was stately, exalted, and grand, resembling the legendary majestic war god, Pangu.
Above the closed-door cultivation room, Jane Aiken, bearing four swords on her back, showed amazement in her eyes, “Has the Opening of the Heavens succeeded!”
However, just as everyone was shocked and looking up at the sky, thinking that Jack Clark had succeeded in Opening the Heavens, the expressions of Sky Knife King and Sky King Denny Kaye gradually became solemn.
Because they knew that Opening the Heavens was not that simple, for instance…
Boom! Heaven and Earth shook.
Above the firmament, deep within the cracks of the Eye of Heavenly Path, that towering ancient palace descended from the sky, suppressing Heaven and Earth, suppressing the world, and with a thunderous crash, it landed on the projection of the Plane World.
In an instant, the entire world shook even more violently, especially the barrier that separated the whole world, which Jack Clark’s halberd power had drawn upon the World’s Power to create, continued to shatter.
Boom boom boom!! Under the ancient palace’s suppression, the entire world shook continuously, with clear qi sinking and murky qi swirling to the point of convergence.
“You think to stop me from Opening the Heavens? Impossible!”
Jack Clark let out a long, sky-reaching howl, his War Halberd horizontally poised between heaven and earth like a pillar supporting the sky, while with his six arms raised high, he propped up the ‘Firmament’ pressing down on him.
Boom!! Jack Clark’s figure suddenly sank, feeling an indescribably heavy force pressing down on him, and even he could not help but take a deep breath.
So heavy!
Roar! Jack Clark let out a low growl similar to a dragon’s roar, as an infinite and boundless Power Explosion erupted from within his mighty body, fending off the increasingly heavy force above him.
Crackle Crackle!! Under the circumstances of extreme stimulation of physical strength, a layer of thick, dark red Dragon Scales emerged on Jack Clark’s body, including his cheeks where fine scales gradually grew.
Besides, a pair of bifurcated fierce dragon horns sprouted on Jack’s head, followed by a Dragon Tail behind him.
Boom!
The whole world shook, the ‘Firmament’ which had already sunk somewhat, trembled, and was slowly propped up again by Jack Clark in his Demon God Emperor Dragon Form.
Even though the weight of the ancient palace above the world continued to press down relentlessly, it could not shake the tower-like figure who stood as unyielding as a ten-thousand-meter-tall Divine Mountain, unshakable.
Huff huff!! Jack Clark let out heavy breaths, stirring up a raging wind.
As Jack Clark stabilized the heavens once more, the entire Plane World began to separate and evolve again, expanding and inflating with its crystal wall at the edges thickening.
Manifesting his True Body to support the heavens, Jack Clark seemed to merge with some ritual intrinsic to the universe at that moment, his soul, his True Body, his consciousness becoming one with the world, falling into a supreme state.
At this moment, he ‘saw’ chains of rules that pierced through heaven and Earth, spanning the mythical world, the boundless Chaos Void, traversing countless worlds.
Each of these chains of rules radiated a Mysterious Aura, emitting indescribable Radiance.
And to say they were chains, in truth, they had no concrete shape or form; the chains were merely Jack Clark’s way of defining what he ‘saw’ at that moment.
Each of these radiant strands represented a Supreme Law, encompassing time, space, causation, reincarnation, Creation, destruction, Yin-Yang, light and dark…
At this time, these rules force were gradually spreading to the Plane World that was evolving into a Real World.
In such a state, merged with the world, Jack’s consciousness merely needed to brush against them to gain an understanding of these great forces, mastery over one Supreme Law.
And this is why those who Open the Heavens can grasp Supreme Laws.
But at the moment, although Jack Clark ‘saw’ these Supreme Rules, truly comprehending them was extremely difficult, and he only had one chance to touch them.
He needed to choose a Supreme Path that resonated with his own within the time it took for the evolution of heaven and earth to end.
If he chose the wrong Supreme Path, even if with the opportunity provided by Opening the Heavens he barely grasped it, it would be difficult to break through the minor accomplishments realm in the future, let alone reaching grand accomplishment and merging with the Law.
Amidst the various Supreme Laws permeating heaven and earth, Jack Clark calmed his mind without making a rushed choice, instead beginning to sort through himself, his own path.
What did he need?
His physical body was unparalleled in strength, like a mythical giant beast from the Early Myth compressed into humanoid form, possessing the three Great Divine Powers: Supreme Vacuum, Heaven-walking Divine Steps, and Absolute Barrier.
The True Martial Way had already grasped the Higher-order Laws of death, Vacuum, Great Sun Heaven Flame, and Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, including the not fully consolidated soul.
Add to that his talent for the Void Death Pupil, the Doomsday Blood Sea Domain, and the Soul Emperor True Body, one could say that all aspects were balanced and powerful, capable of unleashing extreme strength beyond realm limitations.
So, which Supreme Law did his path resonate with?
…
While Jack Clark contemplated his path and chose his Supreme Law, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon arrived at the entrance of the Blue Star World Channel.
Without the ‘drag’ of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Candle Dragon, as a dragon species Giant Beast, traveled over several hundred thousand kilometers in just one day with speed not inferior to flying creatures.
Blue Star World.
In the deep sea over three thousand meters deep, a six hundred plus meters tall blue vortex slowly rotated, an invisible domain force forming a vacuum area spanning a thousand meters radius around it.
In the sea not far away, a sixty-five-meter-long Black Tiger Whale swam leisurely, exuding a level eight ‘mighty’ Aura, causing countless regular Mutated Fish to flee in terror wherever it passed.
Close by the Black Tiger Whale swam a forty-meter-long Female Tiger Whale, her black and white scale armor covered Dorsal Fin carrying a white ‘backpack’ several meters big.
Watching the leisurely wandering Black Tiger Whale, the Female Little Tiger Whale softly called out, “Leader, you are a Dragon Palace Brave General, why choose to come here to guard the pathway?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1052 - 1052 433 Creation of the World The Supreme
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1052: Chapter 433 Creation of the World, The Supreme Law_4 Chapter 1052: Chapter 433 Creation of the World, The Supreme Law_4 The female Little Tiger Whale was somewhat puzzled, not knowing why their leader had given up the task of leading the mighty army of Mutant Beasts to guard the pathway here instead.
Compared to the prestige of patrolling the sea with an army of Level 7 and Level 8 Giant Beasts, being here with just the two of them, Tiger Whales, made the place seem oddly desolate.
In response to his ‘wife’s’ query, Tiger Whale Third Brother let out a proud roar, “Miss Keller, you don’t understand, this is the place where Uncle and the others left from.”
The eyes of the female Little Tiger Whale revealed confusion. What did this have to do with the departure of Lord Thunderflame Dragon King and his companions?
Noticing his ‘wife’s’ puzzled look, Tiger Whale Third Brother showed great patience and roared, “Think about it, when Uncle and the others return one day, what will they feel when they see us receiving them at first sight?”
The female Little Tiger Whale tilted her head, still somewhat bewildered.
Seeing this, Tiger Whale Third Brother shook his head and issued a roar, “Forget it, you won’t understand even if I explain. Anyway, you’ll know when the time comes.”
Oh. The female Little Tiger Whale nodded obediently.
Just then, the distant blue vortex suddenly began to shake violently, and the Black Tiger Whale’s eyes lit up with excitement, roaring, “Quick, let’s go over, it must be Uncle and the others coming back.”
Boom!
The blue vortex trembled, and out flew a Red Beast, more than 50 meters in length, resembling an Eastern Divine Dragon, instantly filling the surroundings with an aura comparable to that of a Mythical Giant Beast.
The Black Tiger Whale, surrounded by the domain, sank slightly as it exited the Waterless Range, then enthusiastically approached, roaring, “Uncle Candle Dragon, you’re back! Oh, and is Uncle Thunderflame back too?”
Looking at the exuberant Black Tiger Whale that had come up to him, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon paused for a moment before slowly growling, “Roar! Thunder, Flame, they, have, not, returned.”
“Tiger, Three, why, are, you, here?”
The Black Tiger Whale waved its tail and let out a joyful roar, “After you left Uncle, I feared enemy beasts might destroy the pathway and you wouldn’t be able to return, so I specifically applied to guard this place.”
Appreciation slowly emerged in the Red Beast’s eyes, and after a few more minutes, it growled slowly, “Roar! Well, done.”
As it spoke, beneath the neck of the Red Beast, the Reverse Scale glittered, and then a blue Crystal Stone with a diameter of 3 meters, shaped like a ‘mangosteen’, emerged, emitting an astonishing aura of energy.
“Roar! This, is, a, Senior, Divine Crystal, which, possesses, the, ability, to, enhance, the, body, of, Giant Beasts, and, also, somewhat, purify, bloodlines.”
This time back, as an elder, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon naturally had to make his mark when meeting younger ones like Tiger Whale Third Brother.
It just so happened that it had a Divine Crystal left over from earlier sweeps with the Single-horned Spawn Roc that was no longer beneficial since it had developed a resistance, perfect as a welcome gift.
Feeling the Law Charm emanating from the blue Crystal Stone, the Black Tiger Whale let out an excited roar, “Thank you, Uncle Candle Dragon! Oh, and Miss Keller is also guarding the pathway with me.”
With that, the Black Tiger Whale looked back and called out to the female Little Tiger Whale in the sea, “Miss Keller, hurry, come meet Uncle Candle Dragon.”
With a splash, the female Little Tiger Whale’s head emerged from the sea water, looking at the Giant Beast Candle Dragon with its massive frame and terrifying aura. Her gaze was full of reverence as she respectfully roared.
Roar!! Miss Keller pays her respects to Lord Candle Dragon.
…Looking at the female Little Tiger Whale, a Level 6 creature, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon hesitated for a moment before the Reverse Scale under its neck flickered slightly, and a Divine Fruit of several meters in size appeared.
“Roar! Your, strength, is, too weak, a, Senior, Divine Object, you, cannot, absorb, here, is, a, normal, Divine Fruit, take it.”
The Black Tiger Whale called out joyfully, “Miss Keller, aren’t you going to thank Uncle Candle Dragon?”
Roar!! Thank you, Lord Candle Dragon. The female Little Tiger Whale was somewhat excited; at that moment, she finally understood why the leader had chosen to guard the pathway.
As expected of our leader.
Watching the Black Tiger Whale surrounded by its domain and hovering in the air, the female Little Tiger Whale’s eyes sparkled with fervent admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 1053 - 1053 434 Space-Time as King Strength as
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1053: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme Chapter 1053: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme But just as the Candle Dragon Giant Beast returned to Blue Star and Jack Clark sorted out his own path,
more than a dozen high-level cultivators stood atop a mountain peak over 20,000 meters high, located two thousand kilometers away from the 30th Army Group’s base, watching the spectacle in shock.
This spot was an Outer Development Department resource mining point, mainly extracting a transcendent metal ore known as Mixed Copper, with over a hundred Special Forces soldiers stationed there.
The person in charge was three high-ranking powerhouses in the early to late phases of the Eighth Layer, responsible mainly for driving away and suppressing the nearby wandering behemoths.
Looking up at the world projection that had expanded to over four hundred kilometers and the enormous black cracks in the firmament spanning a thousand kilometers, the three Eighth Layer experts were stunned and lost in wonder.
After a long while, the lead expert in the late phase of the Eighth Layer finally let out a breath and exclaimed, “I don’t know which peak strong man of our Human Race is making a breakthrough this time, but the momentum is terrifying.”
Another middle-phase Eighth Layer elder, his face showing his age, nodded in agreement, still in shock, “The Fourfold Divine Calamity Phenomenon, it’s clear that he has refined four rules to the higher-order, only then could he provoke a Divine Tribulation.”
“To say nothing of successful Opening the Heavens, he’s about to comprehend the Supreme Law, which almost guarantees that he’ll be an invincible being just after breaking through to king-level.”
Speaking of this, the elder could not help but let out a hearty laugh, “Hahahaha… Heaven bless our Human Race, another king with a supreme stature has arisen.”
The third, a young man in his twenties at the Eighth Layer early phase, also showed a smile and nodded in agreement.
After watching the continually expanding world projection in the sky for a while longer, the leading big man exhaled and said, “That king should be in the process of condensing the Supreme Law now. All right, let’s disperse.”
“This breakthrough by that great one has caused a commotion among the Unique Beasts within thousands of kilometers. Pay attention to patrol the surroundings and be cautious of high-rank behemoths wandering over.”
“Yes!”
The Special Forces soldiers who had also been watching the spectacle seriously received the orders, their expressions becoming solemn, as they began to depart with excitement.
Kordas, an early-phase Eighth Layer, stood atop the mountain peak, took one last deeply impressed look at the heavenly phenomenon, and also turned to leave.
As an Eighth Layer Expert, even from two thousand kilometers away, he could clearly see the anomalies above the 30th Army Group’s base; after all, two thousand kilometers in a straight line is really only two million meters.
Naturally, this was mainly because the arrival of the Mythical Heaven Tribulation meant that the pressure of the Heavenly Dao spread out, clearing the clouds for tens of thousands of miles around, plus Jack Clark located at an altitude of tens of thousands of meters.
Especially that scene of his ten-thousand-meter True Body performing Open Heaven and Earth was incredibly shocking.
And Kordas had recognized the person breaking through as the Human Race’s most monstrously talented genius of this era, Jack Clark, through the features of the three-faced six-armed figure wielding a War Halberd.
This man also had another name, Darren Callum.
Why, why does he get to ascend to Myth in a year, why does his breakthrough to king-level trigger a Mythical Heaven Tribulation, and even control the Supreme Law with the power to Open Heaven and Earth?
At this moment, Kordas’s heart was filled with unwillingness and jealousy.
As a cultivator who practiced the Genetic True Martial Way, he too was once a genius, graduating with the cultivation of the Fifth Layer Heaven, and then entering the mythical world to join the Outer Development Department.
But unlike his initial pride and ambition, after ten grueling years of cultivation in the mythical world, he had barely managed to break through to the Eighth Layer.
This rate of progress was actually not slow, and continuing to work hard meant there was hope to break through to the Nine Layers within the next ten years, becoming a top-tier transcendent strong man.
But this achievement paled in comparison to that one-year Mythical ascension monster, and even the batch of geniuses who had recently entered the mythical world overshadowed him.
Like Balderas, another monster from Berlin, who had broken through to the Eighth Layer right after graduation. The reason being that now the Federation’s education and nurturing of freshmen, along with resource allocation, was far greater than it had been ten years ago.
And because of the considerable resources tilted towards the newer generations, the ‘older’ cultivators like him had their benefits slightly reduced recently.
For instance, he had wanted the top-tier resource, White Disdain Blood, which he couldn’t exchange for now due to the cancellation of the merit discount offer, forcing him to wait until next month.
Thinking of this, Kordas was filled with outrage, thinking it so unfair, these damned people, these damned geniuses.
As Kordas’s indignant feelings grew stronger, a flicker of dark red radiance passed through the depths of his eyes.
But while his heart was full of anger, Kordas’s appearance remained unchanged, and he returned to his office with a smile on his face.
It was only after the office door had closed that Kordas’s expression turned cold, as he took out a tablet from his Sumeru Bracelet and pressed it against the wall.
Hum! An invisible force unfolded, enveloping the whole office, and under this influence, spatial fluctuations solidified, creating a defensive prohibition.
Only then did Kordas completely let down his guard, cautiously taking out a black stone disk the size of his palm, followed by a black crystal stone, from his bracelet.
Compared to the grey stone plate Charles Klein had used to communicate with The Purgatory Family’s Assassination Department, the black disk in Kordas’s hand was evidently of much higher grade.
As the black crystal was placed at the center of the disk, suddenly dark power emanated from it, causing black runes to flicker and a palm-sized virtual figure to materialize.
The tiny figure spoke in a low voice, using stilted Federation language, “Kordas, you have contacted me so suddenly; have you discovered new information on Darren Callum?”
Though the Assassination Department had abandoned the plan to dispatch the Great Demon King to assassinate Jack Clark, they still had commanded their branches to monitor his movements closely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054 - 1054 434 Space-Time as King Strength as
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1054: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme_2 Chapter 1054: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme_2 Kordas nodded. “Indeed, I have information about him.”
Looking at the halted Kordas, the palm-sized shadow spoke in a deep voice, “Speak, what do you want?”
A smile appeared on Kordas’s face, and then he unceremoniously said, “I want resources that can help me quickly make a breakthrough to the late phase of the Ninth Heavens.”
“Resources that could help you achieve a quick breakthrough to the late phase of the Ninth Heavens in the Human Race?”
The shadow frowned, “Kordas, it seems you’ve only just made a breakthrough to the early phase of the Eighth Layer Heaven not long ago, do you realize how precious the resources to help you quickly break through to the late phase of the Ninth Heavens are?”
“I know, but the information I control about Jack Clark, also known as Darren Callum, is even more important, it could even shake you Demon God Level Powerhouses.”
The projection’s expression suddenly turned solemn.
Watching Kordas who appeared confident about his information, the voice of the Purgatory True Demon projection deepened, “Rest assured, my True Demon Race has always been trustworthy. If the value of your information is great enough, the resources will be delivered before the sky turns dark.”
“Good.”
Kordas nodded in satisfaction, and then said, “Just now, Jack Clark appeared above the 30th Army Group’s headquarters and made a breakthrough to become a Mythical King.”
“He broke through to king-level!!” The True Demon projection exclaimed in shock.
As the new person in charge on the side of the Human Clan’s Outer Development Department, it naturally knew the detailed information of this human, such as the fact that he had only been cultivating for one year, equivalent to ten Sun Wheels.
Ten Sun Wheels, in their Purgatory True Demon conception of time, is equivalent to two to three months for humans.
Yet in such a short period of time, that human had grown from the status of one with Demon Marks to demon king level, such a terrifying rate of improvement was indeed incredibly alarming.
At that moment, Kordas continued, “Not only did he make a breakthrough to king-level, but he also triggered the descend of the Mythical Heaven Tribulation and has solidified four Higher-order Laws right after his breakthrough.”
“Furthermore, he manifested a world projection of Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder at the Fourth Layer, succeeded in Opening the Heavens, and is now comprehending Supreme Law above the 30th Army Group’s headquarters.”
“What, four Higher-order Laws, and he’s successfully Opened the Heavens!!” The True Demon shadow exclaimed in disbelief, its face showing incredulity.
“That’s right,” nodded Kordas, his eyes flickering slightly as he said, “If you wish to make a move against him, now is the best opportunity.”
“Otherwise, once he completes his breakthrough, even a Great Demon King may not be able to defeat him, let alone kill him, unless a Supreme Demon God descends.”
After a long while, the Purgatory True Demon slowly exhaled and spoke with a solemn face, “I need to report this to the higher-ups immediately. The resources you request will be delivered to you by a demon later.”
With that, the projection flickered faintly and then vanished from sight.
In the depths of the mythical world, over twenty thousand kilometers away, lay the same cliff shrouded in black fog, with figures radiating dark strength coming and going.
Inside a room within the mountain wall, a Purgatory True Demon over five meters tall with a sturdy figure and a grave expression on its face, flashed instantly to the central altar of the headquarters.
Hum!
As the energy from the Crystal Stones flowed, the Purgatory Demon Pattern shone, and in an instant, an invisible force pierced through the Void, establishing contact with a distant other end.
Soon, dense Black Demonic Qi began to fill the air above the altar, gathering to form a vague and massive silhouette.
The sizeable Purgatory True Demon bowed respectfully: “I greet the Great Demon King Barus, I have important matters to report.”
The will projection of Barus looked down with a cold gaze, his voice stern and detached, “Kakaros, what important matter has occurred on your end that you bypass the demon king in charge here and contact me directly?”
“Great Demon King Barus, it is regarding the Human Clan Genius, Darren Callum. He has broken through to the Mythical level, and has triggered a Mythical Heaven Tribulation…”
Soon, the entire Assassination Department was shaken by the news of Jack Clark.
And because the news was so shockingly dreadful, Barus reported it directly to Devil God Emperor Eros.
Behind the Sky Curtain Battlefield, towering figures stood in the depths of the Firmament, thousands of kilometers up in the sky, their Demon God Level might causing vibrations throughout the Void.
Seated on an ancient being’s skull as his throne, Diorus was enveloped in rolling Dark Demon Air, with a terrifying intent to kill, forming myriad images of living beings wailing in agony.
“This human has a potential that is even more astonishing than we anticipated; not only has he stepped into the Legendary Realm within a short time but also succeeded in Opening the Heavens and mastered the Foundation of the Demon God.”
“It is now confirmed that this individual is the Child of Destiny for the Human world behind us in this generation.”
“Now that he has begun his rise, if we cannot assassinate him subsequently, with the Luck and talent potential gathered upon him, he will soon step into the Great Demon King Realm and quickly reach the peak.”
“By then, even we may not be capable of subduing him,” said Diorus, and the expressions of the four Demon God Level Powerhouses turned somewhat grave.
Over the years, The Purgatory Family had conquered and wiped out countless civilizations of different races. Before their destruction, each civilization had similar Children of Destiny emerging.
Most of them were systematically eradicated by them, effortlessly.
After all, compared to the mightily powerful Purgatory Family, these so-called Children of Destiny were merely the last struggle of the Luck of those different races, easily crushed.
But this was when those ‘Person’ had not yet grown.
There had also been Children of Destiny who had grown under fortuitous circumstances, causing heavy blows to The Purgatory Family, with grievous losses.
Opposite Diorus, standing in the depths of the Void, an entity that seemed like a fusion of countless eerie shadows spoke, its voice the collective hum of countless insects.

chapters.title: Chapter 1055 - 1055 434 Space-Time as King Strength as
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1055: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme_3 Chapter 1055: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme_3 “This human has mastered the foundation of the Demon God and, coupled with the Secret Skill of summoning Great Demon King-level Giant Beasts, his strength is no less than that of an ordinary Great Demon King.”
“Moreover, Diorus, you’ve already attacked him twice before, including the curse with the Dark Demon Skull imbued with my rule power, yet it failed to kill him. It’s apparent that the Human Race also places an incredible value on him.”
“Under such circumstances, unless one among us demons makes a move, even a Great Demon King at the peak of awakening wouldn’t pose a threat to him.”
“So, who will take action against him?” As he spoke, this Demon God’s head, which seemed to consist of countless worms, squirmed and looked towards the other three Demon Gods.
Clearly, it had no intention of taking action, including the other two Demon Gods, who remained silent.
Seeing this, Diorus paused for a moment before speaking in a deep voice, “Since none of you are interested, then I shall deal with this human.”
And just as The Purgatory Family was preparing to deploy a Demon God Level Powerhouse to strike down Jack Clark with the force of raging thunder, without giving him any further time to grow, Jack Clark’s breakthrough was also gradually reaching its end.
Above the firmament, as the Plane World expanded, rising clear air gradually transformed into the sky, while sinking turbid air evolved into an even vaster and more substantial earth.
Having expanded to nearly six hundred kilometers, the Plane World had become as vast as a province, with a Golden Sun high in the high altitude, radiating light and heat. Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder roared between heaven and earth, and lightning thundered.
At this stage, the Plane World was almost indistinguishable from a normal world; the Earth supported all things, space was stable and solid.
In the center of the world, the Emperor Dragon Form of Jack Clark’s True Body was supported by six arms, and strands of Mysterious Yellow Air appeared out of nowhere around him, silently merging into his True Body.
With the influx of the Mysterious Yellow Air from the opening of the heavens, Jack Clark’s aura became increasingly vast and divine, sacred and majestic, like a true ancient god who had opened the heavens.
Besides, not far from the black Stone Gate that suppressed the world and around the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd that stood like a pillar supporting the heavens and the earth, strands of Mysterious Yellow Air also materialized from nothing.
However, compared to the amount absorbed by Jack Clark’s True Body, the Mysterious Yellow Air that merged into the Gateway to Heaven and the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd was much less, about one-tenth.
But even so, as the Mysterious Yellow Air of creation that only appeared during the opening of the heavens seeped in, the black Stone Gate vibrated slightly, and its surface revealed yellow, ancient patterns.
The Eight Desolate Battle Halberd also emitted a divine glow.
As a weapon of Opening the Heavens, at this moment, in addition to the integration of the Mysterious Yellow Air, a force that represented the power of creation and destruction at the moment of opening the heavens enveloped it.
Under the Tempering of the powers representing creation and destruction, the halberd, primarily black and wrapped in fine golden scales, was advancing towards Law Level weaponhood.
Jack Clark was aware of the changes occurring in the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, but at that moment, his heart and soul were immersed in sorting out his own path, slowly realizing what road he must take.
That road was absolute strength.
His advantage had always been his True Martial prowess and his incredibly powerful body. Combined, they gave him absolute speed and destructive power in his class, shattering everything.
Whether it’s the True Martial Arts Secret Book of the Battle Demon God or the strength Divine Power of his Giantification Talent emanating from his physical body, both resonated with the Law of Strength.
Therefore, the Supreme Law that matched him the most was the Law of Strength.
In the Supreme Laws that spread throughout heaven and earth, besides the Law of Strength, Jack Clark was also quite compatible with the Law of Space-Time, the Law of Life and Death, the Law of Cause and Effect, and Chaos, as well as the Soul Law.
The foundation of Jack Clark’s Fighting Demon God True Body was the Basic Space Rune from the innate runes of the Silver Giant Dragon, bearing the Giantification Talent of the Dragon Elephant Behemoth and the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s five major talents.
Latterly, to allow resource sharing between the main body and the Avatar Giant Beast, the right arm was inscribed with the Space Channel Inscription, while the left arm, due to the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill, was eroded by Time Power.
In addition, the Summoning Secret Skill he cultivated involved time, space, and cause and effect, making his compatibility with the Law of Space-Time second only to the Law of Strength.
As for conformity with the Law of Life and Death, it comes from the Prison Blood War Intent, the Doomsday Blood Sea Domain, and the Death Law, all of which touch upon a part of the cycle of life and death.
The Soul Law was even simpler. As a person who had an Innate Awakening of Soul Talent and cultivated soul-related Cultivation Methods, Jack Clark naturally had a high affinity with the Soul Law from the very beginning.
As for the Law of Chaos, it stemmed from the various Law Powers he mastered and the Plane World he opened.
The Void, Death, flames, Thunder, and the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder elements, these combined already matched part of Chaos’ essence.
Besides these Supreme Laws of Creation, Jack Clark could also rely on this opportunity from Opening the Heavens to touch them, or even enter an enlightenment state and ‘start’ by burning Attribute Points.
But the result might be that due to the low compatibility, the cultivation speed would halt.
In the face of the temptation of these Supreme Laws, Jack Clark calmly completed the sorting of his own path, clarified what he was after, firmed up his will, and chose the Law of Strength.
The Law of Strength, while it might sound very narrow and descriptive of strength only,
in reality, it was profoundly mysterious and encompassed all forces: physical strength, Law Power, and Divine Power, able to integrate all the powers that Jack Clark held.
Besides being incredibly powerful on its own, it could also enhance all the Laws and Divine Powers he mastered, even unifying all forces to become even stronger.
This function seemed somewhat similar to the Deep Red Form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but it was far more powerful.
After all, the Deep Red Form was essentially just an attribute of the Giantification Talent; were it not for the fundamentally terrifying nature of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it could not possibly have unleashed such fearsome power.
Jack sighed and slowly exhaled, the breath turning into a raging wind that swept across heaven and earth. Then, in his realm of thought, a command echoed, “Expend 10,000 Attribute Points to enter enlightenment state.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1056 - 1056 434 Space-Time as King Strength as
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1056: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme_4 Chapter 1056: Chapter 434 Space-Time as King, Strength as Supreme_4 This time he was to comprehend the Supreme Law, and Jack Clark naturally gave it his all.
Boom! As Jack’s voice fell, a boundless power erupted within him, turning into an aura of enlightenment that enveloped him.
At the same moment he entered the state of enlightenment, Jack’s consciousness merged with the ‘world’, slowly touching the radiance representing the Law of Strength.
Boom!
In an instant, Jack’s consciousness trembled as a grand and supremely unwavering Law Aura descended, causing the entire plane world to violently shake under its power.
Cultivators tap into the Law Power they possess to deduce the mysteries of heaven and earth, transforming and evolving through their talents and Cultivation Methods.
As one of the Supreme Rules, even a secondary Law Power was not something Jack or the other newly breakthrough Mythical experts could withstand.
The power transformation required the nurturing of an opened world to be completed, thereby truly possessing their own Supreme Strength.
Hu hu!!
As Jack’s comprehension of the Law of Strength progressed at an increasingly rapid pace, the aura around him grew more terrifying, and the surrounding energy of enlightenment was consumed at an alarming rate, a hundred times faster than usual,
Under the amazed gaze of all, the plane world above expanded to 800 kilometers before it slowly stopped, standing mightily above the Firmament like a real world.
And as the world became fully stable, cracks appeared in the projection of the Ancient Palace above, followed by a thunderous shattering, turning into myriad fragments that fell like rain.
Boom boom boom!! As the fragments from the crumbling Ancient Palace merged, the plane world once again shook violently, the land stretching endlessly, and the crystalline barrier swelling.
Even the Supreme Energy Aura diffused between heaven and earth surged violently.
Looking at this scene, Sky King Denny Kaye, who was guarding the surroundings, smiled and let out a sigh of relief, “The Divine Tribulation has dispersed; he has succeeded.”
Sky Knife King appeared next to Denny Kaye in a flash, looking up at the towering figure in the sky with an envious sigh.
“Supreme Law, eh? Next, as long as he can comprehend it to grand accomplishment, he will step into the Heavenly King level with a talent even more monstrous than you, Denny, in your early days.”
Denny Kaye smiled slightly, “Talents emerge in succession in this world. This means our Human Race is becoming ever stronger.”
While Denny Kaye and Sky Knife King were relaxed, standing in support of Jack Clark, who was still in the middle of his breakthrough, the Primordial True King in the depths of the Void was being besieged by countless Void Creatures.
Watching the enormous pathway connecting the material world and the Void, created during Jack’s Opening the Heavens, various Void Creatures were drawn to it, seeking to invade.
The weakest of these creatures were at Level 9, strong among them were not lacking Mythical-level, and even in the dark depths were a few Heavenly King Level Terrifying Auras pervading.
However, the Primordial True King, guarding the pathway, made it impossible for these Void Creatures to approach, turning them all to ash and extinguishing them with a wave of his hand.
While indiscriminately annihilating those Void Creatures, Primordial True King’s gaze grew solemn as he looked to the left, where a presence loomed, one that even he found somewhat dangerous.
A roar erupted from a creature that was not quite human, standing over two thousand meters tall, dragging the corpse of a Giant Beast, emerging from the depths of darkness.
Looking at the huge passage leading to the Material World, the creature, with countless tentacles atop its head like an octopus, let out another savage roar.
Boom!
An endless surge of Dark Void Energy burst from the creature, turning into thousands of kilometers of enormous tentacles that swept towards Primordial True King.
The tentacles, entwined with a Dark Red Glow, annihilated everything; numerous Level 9 and early Myth creatures were shredded, turned into pure Void Energy, and devoured.
“Seeking death.”
As he gazed upon the Void Creature exuding the early pressure of a Heavenly King, Primordial True King’s eyes grew cold, and, without holding back in the face of a dreadful monster lurking in the dark depths, he took action.
A roar!
An earth-shattering howl echoed through the Void as a three-thousand-meter-long, mountain-thick arm covered in black scales reached out from behind Primordial True King.
Thump thump thump!! Under the slash of the Rule-entwined ape arm, the tentacles powerful enough to shatter mountain ranges crumbled, turning to black ash and vanishing.
Boom!
The Void exploded from Primordial True King’s strike, instantly annihilating the Void Creature and the Giant Beast corpse that hadn’t even touched the tentacles, reducing them to dust.
“`
The terrifying aftermath even pierced through numerous layers of the Void, creating a dark chaos destruction area spanning hundreds of kilometers.
The intangible aura of Law Power that was emitted caused several Heavenly King Level monsters lurking in the distance to grow restless, and even that covertly hidden Supreme Level aura fluctuated for a moment before falling deathly still.
Feeling that somewhat agitated aura subside into silence, the Primordial True King’s gaze was cold and indifferent.
Meanwhile, the giant arm that had emerged behind him slowly retracted, vanishing into the darkness at his back, leaving only his tall and steadfast figure standing before the pathway.
Under the deterrence of the Supreme Experts, those Void Creatures that had been attracted by Jack Clark’s Opening the Heavens were once again suppressed.
Simultaneously, as the projection of the Ancient Palace faded and the Eye of Heavenly Path that tore through more than a thousand kilometers of the sky above slowly vanished, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Hum! The Plane World, which had expanded to nine hundred kilometers, vibrated.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone, the Plane World gradually shrank until it disappeared, revealing the clear expanse of the Firmament and Jack Clark, holding a halberd as he stood tall in the high altitude.
At this time, Jack Clark had returned to his normal form, clad in his battle armor with a Mysterious Aura swirling around him. His eyes, distinctly black and white, opened and closed slightly, exuding an indescribable majesty.

﻿Chapter 1057: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K) Chapter 1057: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K) Standing upon the firmament, with light clouds swirling around him, Jack Clark’s eyes swept over the various data on the attribute page, the corners of his mouth slightly lifting.
A one-year legend, huh.
This achievement was enough to shock the entire Federal Cultivation World, a feat unmatched in history.
And half a year ago, when Jack Clark exchanged for the Advanced Skill, Dragon Elephant Overlord Body, he heard from his class teacher, James Crane, that someone reaching the Ninth Heavens in one year had been shocking for quite some time.
But after only a slight reflection, Jack Clark looked at the attribute page, his expression becoming contemplative.
The changes in various data points after this breakthrough were quite straightforward, yet the actual changes were far more significant.
Upon entering the king-level realm, his physical body had undergone Tempering, increasing the base by thirty-four times, and on the display of strength attribute, it had changed from the power of twenty-three dragons to fifty-five.
And the former note that had only mentioned ‘dragon’ now included the word ‘Heavenly Dragon’, prefixed with a ‘Heavenly’.
Simultaneously, True Strength transformed into Law Divine Power, and the power containing the Law Charm was also thirty-four times stronger than that of True Strength in the late period of the Ninth Heavens.
Fifteen times of that was the foundational enhancement from the first Higher-order Law, with each of the subsequent three Higher-order Laws adding threefold strength, plus tenfold from the Supreme Law of Strength.
Still, this was merely the basic improvement, not including the mighty Law Mysteries.
With his Extraordinary Body transformed into a Rule True Body, and with his soul fused, Jack Clark could now leverage the Power of Heaven and Earth with even greater might through Law, while also consuming less energy.
After reaching the king-level realm, the comparison of strength is divided into three parts: Rule True Body, the strength of the comprehended laws, as well as the Law Mysteries and the strength of the soul.
A formidable Rule True Body can accommodate more divine power, with stronger instantaneous output and Burst.
An analogy would be a True Body with a strength of a thousand could hold ten thousand points of Divine Strength, and its instantaneous Burst could reach three to five hundred, whereas a True Body with a strength of three hundred may only have an Instantaneous Explosion of twenty to fifty.
Like Jack Clark now, his physical body was incomparably strong on its own, and now after being tempered by five laws, completing the transformation from mortal to divine, he was powerful enough to shake Heaven and Earth.
His mere physical strength was already enough to dominate the Legendary Realm.
And with an unmatched True Body, Jack Clark could carry a more vast well of Divine Strength, unleashing bursts of divine power tens of times greater than his peers to propel the laws, with a might that would be terrifyingly extreme.
Not to mention the power of five Higher-order Laws and the devastating secret techniques.
This is the advantage of being strong in all areas, the more terrifying as various aspects amplify each other further down the line.
Aside from these, in this breakthrough, both the weapon and the battle armor also absorbed the creation forces of Mysterious Yellow and advanced, especially the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, whose name changed to the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, imbued with the intent of Opening the Heavens.
Besides that, four Plane Boundaries turning into a real Plane World also became part of Jack Clark’s intrinsic strength.
As the World Lord, Jack Clark could call upon an even more massive World’s Power, and when fused with Divine Absolute Barrier, the defense it formed was nearly indestructible.
And as the Plane World continues to grow and expand to 1,000 kilometers, reaching the level of a small world, it will be able to form a domain.
This kind of world domain is similar to those realms of the deities who have refined a part of Heaven and Earth, with the Law merged into Heaven and Earth, invincible within their domain.
However, under normal conditions, Jack Clark rarely used this ability because this world was the foundation of his path to divinity.
Currently, the Plane World is nurturing the Law of Strength, and later when Jack Clark breaks through to the Supreme Level, it will merge with the world, assuming control over the Rule of Power.
Then, along with the Primordial Rule in the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, he will become a terrifying existence that commands two types of rules.
Just as Jack Clark envisioned a bright future, radiant seven-colored rainbows appeared out of nowhere in the sky, transforming into thousands of rays of light that enveloped him, immediately making his entire being seem sacred and ethereal.
“Is Heaven and Earth celebrating for me?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Looking up at the figure enshrouded by thousands of light rays above the firmament, a strong man suddenly bowed to Jack Clark, exclaiming excitedly, “Congratulations to our tribe’s strong man for ascending to the throne, for martial prosperity, and for proving eternal life.”
Instantly, the cultivators around also came to a realization, and they, too, began shouting excitedly, “Congratulations to our tribe’s strong man for ascending to the throne, for martial prosperity, and for proving eternal life.”
Just like a cascade of dominoes, countless people from all directions in the city paid their respects to Jack Clark in the sky.
“Congratulations to our tribe’s strong man for ascending to the throne, for martial prosperity, and for proving eternal life.”
In a moment, the shouts of hundreds of thousands of advanced cultivators shook Heaven and Earth.
With a population of over two billion but only more than ten million cultivators, and the number of kings even fewer, at only dozens, it was almost as though a king emerged for every few million cultivators.
This kind of high-end combat power, each additional person strengthened the Human Race’s foundation, and the number of kings also determined the quantity of Heavenly Kings and Supreme Experts.
Standing with hands behind her back on the roof of the Closed-door cultivation room, the girl holding four swords looked up slightly, gazing at the dazzling figure in the sky. A hint of admiration appeared on her subdued face.
“A One-Year King, it seems I too need to work harder,” she mused.
Since joining South Sky Martial Height, Jane Aiken had stood head and shoulders above the rest, with a talent so high that even throughout Eastern Summer, she ranked within the top three, surpassing even the Innate Awakened Ones.
Yet facing Jack Clark, even she felt inferior, not having the confidence to become a One-Year King, let alone reaching the Ninth Heavens in one year felt just out of reach.
The road of cultivation becomes increasingly difficult the further one progresses.
“Hahaha… Student Clark, congratulations on becoming a one-year legend, stepping into the realm of kings,” boomed a voice.
With a hearty laugh, Sky King Denny Kaye stepped forward, distorting space and appearing in front of Jack Clark, his face showing astonishment, “Who would have thought that in just a short three months, you would’ve broken through to king-level.”
