﻿Chapter 1058: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K)_2 Chapter 1058: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K)_2 Jack Clark smiled and said, “Senior Kaye flatters me. My rapid breakthrough has been partly possible due to the abundant resources provided by the Federation.”
When breaking through to the Eighth Layer Heaven, the Federation had amassed enough resources for him to cultivate up to the late period of the Ninth Heavens, including those Divine Objects used for strengthening the world this time.
Although due to the transformation into the Mysterious Martial Demon God’s body later on, those resources were not even sufficient for him to break through to the mid period of the Ninth Heavens, Clark remembered all of it deeply.
Sky King Denny Kaye shook his head, “It is your own ability that you were able to quickly convert resources into cultivation. For others, even if they had those resources, it would be useless, otherwise the Federation would have already used resources to produce a group of king-level practitioners.”
Clark smiled at this and refrained from further modesty: Suddenly thinking of something, he asked, “By the way, Senior Kaye, is Miss Ilisa awake now?”
Since entering the mythical world, he had been busy with cultivation and closed-door cultivation, so he did not know if Mathilda Ward had woken up yet.
Speaking of this, a smile appeared on Sky King Denny Kaye’s face, “Misss Joseline has already awakened more than a month ago, and she’s currently familiarizing herself with the transformed strength within the inner parts of Blue Star.”
“When Mysterious Martial returns, that guy will definitely go crazy with happiness.”
“Although, when he was sent on a mission to the Heavenly Feather Clan, he acted as if it was nothing; I knew he was very scared. He feared for Misss Joseline, afraid the ritual would fail and she would die completely.”
“It’s good that she’s awake.”
While the two were talking, Sky Knife King transformed into a streak of golden light and flew over, congratulating from afar, “Student Clark, congratulations on achieving the king-level status.”
“You are too kind, Senior Sky Knife.”
Looking at the young man in front of him, with black hair cascading over his shoulders and a handsome face that was almost perfect, the Shepherd Army eyes revealed admiration, “Student Clark, you have truly shocked everyone this time.”
There was no helping it; Clark’s achievement this time was too shocking, even for a king-level practitioner like the Shepherd Army, who was still somewhat dazed.
Before Clark could continue to be modest, space shattered nearby, and the aged-faced Primordial True King emerged from the depths of the Void, his aura fluctuating around him.
In the final moment, that Supreme Level Void Creature, which had been lurking in the depths of the Void, finally lost its patience, but was still intercepted by the Primordial True King.
Unlike the beings of the Material World who could tear through space and move in and out of the deep Void at will, these Void Creatures were severely restricted by the rules and found it difficult to enter the Material World.
Moreover, the stronger they were, the greater the suppression by the rules.
Also, because they were neither fully alive nor dead, these Void Creatures did not possess the vitality of those in the Material World; a blow exceeding their limit was enough to kill them.
Even Mythical-level Void Creatures would die if struck in the head, unlike Mythical Kings who require the grinding away of both Divine Soul and Laws’ Origin.
Looking at the Primordial True King surrounded by Killing Intent, Clark bowed deeply, “Thank you, Primordial Senior, as well as Senior Kaye and Senior Sky Knife, for guarding me.”
The Primordial True King smiled gently, “There’s no need for formalities, Jack. As a Federation senator and Speaker, it is our duty to protect the younger generation.”
“I just hope you won’t forget what happened today. When in the future, other juniors need your protection, I hope you will also lend a hand.”
“Moreover, reaching the Legendary Realm is just a new beginning for you. Remember not to become complacent and continue to be valiant and diligent to break through to the Supreme level as soon as possible.”
Clark nodded solemnly, “I will keep that firmly in mind.”
Seeing Clark’s attitude, the Primordial True King’s smile warmed, and he gently said, “Now that you have broken through to king-level, you automatically obtain the status of a senator. Have you thought about what title you will take for your throne?”
Each king-level practitioner has a unique title, which also serves as the honorific title for their role as a Federation senator.
However, looking towards the direction of the Divine Gods Alliance, Clark spoke slowly, “The title for the throne is not urgent. Having cultivated for so long and finally breaking through to king-level, I intend to find someone to test my blade on first.”
Noticing Clark’s gaze, Sky King Denny Kaye’s expression shifted slightly, “You intend to continue dealing with the Evil God Alliance?”
Clark nodded, “Exactly.”
One of the reasons he had come to the Outer Development Department this time was to coordinate with Jewell True Immortal and the five king-level practitioners to launch a siege against the Evil God Alliance and destroy the timed bomb behind the Human Race.
However, due to his imminent breakthrough to king-level, the matter had been temporarily put on hold.
Now that he had made the breakthrough, without the need for Jewell True Immortal and others to take action, Clark was confident that he alone could sweep through all four Demon God Sects and suppress all the Evil Gods.
“It’s a bit troublesome,” the Primordial True King pondered. “After you have broken through to king-level, you can no longer use the identity of the commander of the Immortal Realm’s Imperial Guards to enter the Divine Gods Alliance.”
“If you were to enter directly, it might provoke an attack from the alien deities of the Divine Gods Alliance.”
Normally, the Divine Gods Alliance turns a blind eye to skirmishes between the Human Divine Domain’s Imperial Guards and the cultists of the Evil God Alliance, but they maintain it below the Mythical level in accordance with the agreement.
According to the agreement, Human Mythical Kings are not allowed to enter the Divine Gods Alliance casually, let alone those above the Heavenly King Level.
This is also one of the reasons the Evil God Alliance has survived for so many years. With Human Race already embroiled in warfare on two fronts—Heavenly Abyss and the Sky Curtain Battlefield—they dare not rush into opening a third battleground.
Especially when those alien deities within the Divine Gods Alliance could be persuaded to join the fray.
Clark was well-prepared for this issue, “This problem is easy to resolve. For instance, I could simply say that this time I am entering the Divine Gods Alliance due to a personal vendetta with the Evil God Alliance.”
“In the past, when I was cultivating on the Southern Battlefield, I had been greatly impacted by an incursion from the Evil God Alliance and a Purgatory True Demon from the Demon God Sect.”

﻿Chapter 1059: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K)_3 Chapter 1059: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K)_3 Upon saying this, Jack Clark’s gaze grew slightly cold, “Now that I have broken through to the king-level realm, I naturally have to settle the score with those from the Evil God Sect.”
“When the time comes, if those alien deities dare to interfere, I won’t mind taking them down as well. Unless someone of the Heavenly King Level makes a move, even a dozen deities attacking me together is nothing to fear.”
Immediately, the three of them looked at him oddly.
Having read Jack Clark’s dossier, they certainly knew that the invasion of the Southern Battlefield by the Evil God Alliance was the beginning of his rise.
At that time, his cultivation was only at the Fifth Layer Heaven, yet he had successively slain several Sixth Layer strong men from the Evil God Sect, including a late-stage Six Path Devil Marks Purgatory True Demon by Reverse Defeating.
After dealing with the invasion of the Evil God Sect, he single-handedly swept the entire Southern Battlefield, consolidated his Battle Intent, broke through to the Sixth Layer Heaven, created his own Secret Book, and took part in the hunt for Evil God avatars and other tasks.
But this time, it was indeed worth a try.
If a strong man like Sky King Denny Kaye were to barge into the Divine Gods Alliance for personal grievances, he would definitely be blocked by the joined hands of those alien deities.
But if it were Jack Clark, who was only at the early king-level realm, the other party would not have an excuse to band together.
The Primordial True King pondered slightly, “This is indeed a good reason. However, for safety, Jane Aiken and I will support you in secret.”
This was exactly what Jack Clark wanted. A smile appeared on his face, and then he looked down to nod and greet Jane Aiken, who was standing tall on the roof.
Boom!
Covered in ten thousand rays of light, a terrifying oppressive force burst forth from Jack Clark, who had just broken through to the king-level. It whipped up billowing white waves that swept across several kilometers with tremendous momentum.
Under everyone’s watchful eyes, Jack Clark burst through the air with a loud bang at a terrifying speed that was more than twenty times the speed of sound, shooting towards the direction of the Divine Gods Alliance.
In just the blink of an eye, he had disappeared into the horizon, leaving behind a trail of white waves that lingered for a long time.
Immediately after, except for Sky Knife King who needed to stay to guard the base, both Sky King Denny Kaye and the Primordial True King disappeared without a trace.
Sky Knife King transformed into a blade of light and descended from the heavens into the City Center. Then, a message was sent to Jewell True Immortal and others through a special Formation.
……
Blue Star, beneath the deep sea.
Following the Black Tiger Whale, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast returned once again to the entrance of the Water and Fire World, and from afar saw a majestic statue standing tall at over a thousand meters high on the seabed.
Carved out of a small underwater hill, the statue was unmistakably that of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon before its Evolution into a Heavenly Calamity Beast.
The statue’s muscular body was on full display, scales bulging, exuding great strength, and its mouth, nearly split to the ears, appeared ferocious and intimidating.
With its four exaggerated and massively thick claws, and the abstract and powerful tail that twisted and turned into several knots, the statuesque Candle Dragon Giant Beast was awed.
The ever-aesthetic Candle Dragon Giant Beast let out a slow growl and praised the Blue Giant Crab standing guard not far from the gate, “Roar! Crab General, your sculpting skills have improved again.”
The distant Blue Giant Crab excitedly rose to its feet, bubbling enthusiastically.
Blurp blurp!! It’s only because you, Great Candle Dragon, have an eye for art. I’ve always wanted to carve a majestic statue for the Great King, to be erected at the entrance of the Dragon Palace for all Giant Beasts to worship.
Then, the Blue Giant Crab looked somewhat puzzled at the Candle Dragon Giant Beast: Blurp blurp!! Candle Dragon Dragon King, why have you returned so quickly? Did the Great King give any orders?
To the Blue Giant Crab and the other Giant Beasts, the venture of the Destruction Emperor Dragon into the mythical world was expected to take years, but it had been just over a month when one of the Beasts returned.
Waiting for a while, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast slowly growled, “Roar! This time, I have returned on a mission; let’s go inside and talk.”
“All right.”
The Blue Giant Crab, now over one hundred and twenty meters long at Level 9 Early Stage, glided forward on its eight legs, following the Candle Dragon into the Water and Fire World.
As the accompanying Black Tiger Whale passed the statue, confusion flickered in its eyes.
The carving by the Crab General made it look like his Uncle was powerful and massive, but the Black Tiger Whale felt something was off, yet it couldn’t pin it down.
It had a premonition that if Uncle Thunderflame ever saw this statue, he would definitely smash it with one swipe of his claw.
Roar!
Just as the Candle Dragon Giant Beast entered the Water and Fire Mini World, the terrifying aura almost on par with that of Ordinary Mythical Giant Beasts flared up, prompting three Level 9 auras to burst out from within the Ice Crystal Palace in the distance.
Bang!
The sea waves exploded in front of them, revealing the massive carapace of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and its fierce head glancing at the roaring Candle Dragon Giant Beast with some confusion.
Roar roar!! Candle Dragon, why have you come back so quickly?
Then, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah, measuring over three hundred and ten meters long and exuding a Late Stage 9 aura, also swam out from the palace.
Nearby, a patch of darkness emerged, followed by the appearance of a Female Tiger Whale measuring one hundred and thirty meters, likewise having broken through to the Early Stage 9.
Benefiting from the flesh and blood of the Mythical Giant Beast provided by the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s sweep through the ocean, along with exclusive access to all marine resources during this time, all three Giant Beasts had gained a small breakthrough in their strength.
Looking at the three Level 9 Giant Beasts gathering around, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast growled slowly, “King has conquered a Territory in the vast world and sent me to bring you over.”
Instantly, all three Giant Beasts’ eyes lit up, and the nine heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon whirled excitedly, roaring in a frenzy, “Roar roar roar!! It’s no wonder Abbott is so strong. He’s only just arrived and has already conquered a Territory there.”
But after the excitement subsided, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon began to hesitate, “Roar! But if we all leave, what about this place? Without a Level 9 Giant Beast to guard it, the Dragon Palace cannot suppress the ocean.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 1060 435 A Myriad of Rosy Lights Assault on
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1060: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K)_4 Chapter 1060: Chapter 435: A Myriad of Rosy Lights, Assault on the Divine Gods Alliance (7K)_4 The Candle Dragon Giant Beast slowly shook its head: “Roar! It doesn’t matter. The vast, boundless world is our true battlefield.
Roar roar!! Indeed, this territory is too small and uninteresting. The vast world offers a much greater challenge.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, long wishing to visit the mythical deep sea, excitedly roared: “Kidora, no need to hesitate, only by following Thunderflame can we slaughter and devour to our fill.”
Alright then.
Seeing this, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon also nodded in agreement.
As for the Female Tiger Whale, she had no objections either, as she too had long desired to behold that mysterious and vast world.
Then, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle suddenly thought of something and curiously growled low: “Candle Dragon, what about that guy Joe now?”
The Candle Dragon Giant Beast paused for a moment before slowly growling, “Roar! Joe has already made his breakthrough to the quasi-mythical level.”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s eyes widened with envy, almost bulging out of their sockets: “Roar roar!! That guy actually broke through to the quasi-mythical level!”
Indeed, following Thunderflame is the way to eat and drink well. Even though everyone’s growth level was about the same, I didn’t expect such a huge gap to form in just over a month.
With the decision to go to the mythical world made, next was the arrangement for the Dragon Palace. During this time, the empire of Dragon Palace Giant Beasts had expanded greatly, with the number of Tiger Whale Unique Beasts under their command reaching over a thousand.
After their departure, the beasts capable of overseeing the affairs of the Dragon Palace would only be Tiger One, Tiger Two, and Tiger Three, the three Cavalry Generals.
Among the three, Tiger Three was more steady and intelligent. Thinking of this, the Female Tiger Whale, the Chief Steward of Internal Affairs, looked toward the Black Tiger Whale not far away.
Before the Female Tiger Whale could speak, Tiger Three had already started crying out: “Uncle Candle Dragon, I want to go too! I want to serve you in the vast world!”
“Roar! You?” The Candle Dragon Giant Beast looked at Tiger Whale Third Brother with confusion.
Strength at the early stages of Level 8 seemed a bit weak for the vast world, which was about to witness mythical-level battles.
The Black Tiger Whale quickly volunteered: “Roar roar!! Uncle Candle Dragon, although I’m not much help in direct combat, I am very capable when it comes to gathering intelligence.”
Remembering the performance of the Black Tiger Whale in previous battles, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast slowly nodded, then turned to look at the Female Tiger Whale.
Seeing the excited Tiger Whale Third Brother, wanting to follow them, the Female Tiger Whale, nicknamed Kitty Jones, thought for a moment, then nodded and cried out: “Now that Third Brother has broken through to Level 8, he can utilize his domain to fly slowly; he can go if he wishes.”
However, with Tiger Whale Third Brother set to leave, the beasts responsible for the Dragon Palace were left with a bit of trouble.
Looking at Tiger One and Tiger Two, two Tiger Whales with flames on their bodies and sixty meters in length at the peak of Level 7, the Female Tiger Whale let out a gentle cry.
“Boss, Second Brother, after we leave, divide our mighty army into four directions to guard the nearby sea areas, and give up control over further regions.”
“Once we’re settled there (and have broken through to the Mythical level), I’ll come back to bring you over.”
Suddenly, both Tiger Whales’ eyes lit up: “Roar roar roar!! Mom, you go ahead; we’ll surely take care of things at home.”
“Roar!! We will definitely guard the Dragon Palace well.”
The two Tiger Whales showed no hint of disappointment at being left behind. Instead, they grew excited at the prospect of being left in charge of the Dragon Palace.
At this, the Female Tiger Whale shook her head slightly. These two fools—do they not know that only by following the king can they obtain resources far beyond their strength and grow faster?
But since they weren’t begging to go along, the Female Tiger Whale couldn’t very well ask them.
Soon, with everything arranged, a group of giant beasts let out deep roars and swiftly swam through the entrance to the Water and Fire World towards Channel One.
The team of giant beasts headed for the mythical world included the original members and a forty-meter-long Female Little Tiger Whale at the early stage of Level 6 growth.
This Little Tiger Whale, a last-minute request by the Black Tiger Whale, could breathe and survive for a short time out of water even as a Level 6 Colossus. Once in the mythical world, the Female Tiger Whale named Kitty Jones would fly with the Little Tiger Whale.
The Life Crystals were stored in a small backpack on the back of the Little Tiger Whale. This backpack came from a special Level 7 Colossus that the Black Tiger Whale had killed.
This colossus’ stomach pouch had a space-storing effect, much larger inside than it appeared on the outside, and after being refined by being scorched by the flames of Tiger One and Tiger Two for several days, it was made.
Of course, to persuade its two older brothers to rely on the space backpack, it painfully brought out some treasured goodies.
Back then, the two were nearly equal in strength and level, but now, just over a month had passed and the gap had widened.
Let’s go, depart.
As the Candle Dragon Giant Beast set off with the Female Tiger Whale, Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Blue Giant Crab, and Tiger Whale Third Brother, as well as the Female Little Tiger Whale wrapped in Tiger Whale Third Brother’s domain, Jack Clark also arrived at the Divine Gods Alliance.
The Divine Gods Alliance spanned a vast territory, with seven Divine Realms separating the Human Race’s areas; crossing through two Divine Realms to the left led to the Phantom Serpent Alien region, known for being relatively amiable to humans.
To the right, passing through three more Divine Realms including Beautiful Scene, lay the territory of the Kata Alien Tribe, who harbored hostility towards humans, with the Evil God Alliance situated on the edge of that area.
Therefore, when Jack Clark unabashedly emanated the aura of a Mythical King while passing the edge of the Radiant Divine Domain, a white light spanning tens of kilometers suddenly trembled.
Immediately after, deep within the Divine Realm, a formidable aura erupted.
Boom!
Within the light screen, countless white radiance converged, forming a hundreds-of-meters-tall white figure in the high altitude, its late Mythical-level imposing pressure permeating the air.
Observing Jack, clad in luxurious Black Gold battle armor and brandishing a War Halberd that exuded a terrifying aura, the Mythical powerhouse paused slightly.
Then, Jack quickly crossed over ten thousand kilometers, and the Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain next to him vibrated with light as the figure of Jewell True Immortal emerged: “Jack Clark, your aura!?”
Jack respected this Human King, smiling as he said, “Senior Jewell, I have made my breakthrough into mythology.”
Jewell True Immortal’s face beamed with a radiant smile: “Excellent, excellent, excellent.”
“Next, I plan to deal with those from the Demon God Sect.”
“I’ll notify Imperial Capital.”
“No need, Senior, I alone can overpower them now; your intervention might complicate things.”
Considering Jack’s previously terrifying combat strength that suppressed even Mythical Peak powerhouses before his breakthrough, Jewell finally nodded slowly.
As Jack passed the third Divine Domain, the figure of Imperial Capital True Immortal appeared at the boundary of the Sky Curtain.
Boom! In the distance, a figure over a hundred meters tall with tiger stripes on its face—the Kata Alien Deity—appeared, watching Jack with a stern expression and a deep voice.
“Stranger Human King, this is the land of the Divine Gods Alliance, and according to our agreement, you cannot enter our alliance’s territory at will.”
Jack’s expression was cold: “I’m not here on a whim; I’ve come for revenge.”
“Revenge!” The Alien Deity’s eyes sharpened instantly, warily observing Jack.
Jack replied indifferently, “Rest assured, neither you nor the Kata Aliens behind you are my enemies. My grudge is with the four from the Evil God Sect.”
“This is a personal vendetta, irrespective of the Human Race or the Divine Gods Alliance. I’d prefer you don’t interfere; otherwise, I won’t hesitate to take you down along with them.”
“Human, you’re too arrogant,” the late Mythical-level deity burst out with a terrifying aura.
At that moment, Jack radiated merely the strength of an Early Myth. In contrast, as a deity who had assimilated an entire Divine Realm, even a Mythical Peak powerhouse couldn’t defeat it from within its domain.
Boom!
An indescribable Power Explosion emanated from Jack, with black and yellow light flickering on his War Halberd. In an instant, the heavens shattered, and the sun and moon lost their light.
Under the terrifying blow of the halberd, vast areas of the Sky Curtain shattered, and the True Body of the Alien Deity exploded, followed by an unstoppable force that struck the Earth, instantly creating a crack tens of kilometers long.
The terrifying strike filled the air with smoke and dust, and a mushroom cloud rose tens of thousands of meters, with the powerful energy fluctuations alerting the nearby two Alien Divine Realms.
Soon, two powerful Wills descended from the sky, turning into two Will Projections.
The Divine Gods Alliance isn’t merely a territorial demarcation; upon joining, it also connects to a divine network derived from the Supreme Divine King’s Rule, capable of immediately sensing situations nearby and lending aid to each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 1061 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1061: Chapter 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God Alliance, Destroy Heaven and Earth Chapter 1061: Chapter 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God Alliance, Destroy Heaven and Earth Standing above the heavens, at ten thousand meters altitude, Jack Clark faced the alien deity Makula across a white light screen, separated by tens of kilometers.
And when Makula declared that without its permission, Jack couldn’t pass through the edges of its divine domain, a shockwave of Law pressure that could shake Heaven and Earth burst forth in an instant.
Boom! In an instant, Heavenly Energy within a several hundred kilometers radius erupted chaotically, wildly converging towards Jack.
This Heavenly Energy swirled around Jack, transforming under the Higher-order Law Power into golden flames and blue lightning, forming ribbons of flame thunder that surrounded him for five kilometers.
Unlike before his breakthrough into the Mythical Realm, Jack now bore an incredibly grand momentum, resembling a deity wielding flames and thunder.
Boom!
With a swing of his War Halberd, Jack unleashed a golden-blue Halberd Skill that shot out three thousand kilometers in length, piercing through Heaven and Earth and exuding an aura of ultimate destruction.
Boom! Faced with the tremendous golden-blue Halberd Skill, the white light screen formed by the divine domain’s power violently shattered, exploding into a sky full of white speckles.
“Human, you are too arrogant,” bellowed Makula, who hadn’t expected Jack to actually make the first move. A powerful Mythical pressure burst forth from it.
As an alien deity sent to suppress the Human Divine Domain, Makula’s strength wasn’t just at the late period of the Mythical Realm, but it also possessed a very powerful Life Law, classified as a mid-tier Law.
Boom! The entire divine domain trembled, with countless green light spots converging in the forests spanning thousands of kilometers below, forming an enormous green sea.
This green Life Energy, carrying the Power of Heaven and Earth under Makula’s Law enhancement, coalesced into green vines that stretched for ten thousand meters, covering the heavens as they wrapped towards the Halberd Skill.
Bang bang bang!!
Under the Halberd Skill, which took on the semblance of a small mountain range thanks to the dual Higher-order Law Powers, the vines capable of tearing apart mountain peaks crumbled and burst incessantly.
They withered and broke effortlessly, unstoppable.
“How is this possible!” Makula, whose confidence had been unwavering, watched in shock as its face drastically changed before vanishing into a sky filled with green radiance.
And in the instant Makula disappeared, the golden-blue Halberd Skill shone blindingly bright, bringing with it a terrifying energy of Destroying Heaven and Destroying Earth as it descended from the sky.
Boom! A huge golden-blue Light sphere rose in the center of the forest, shattering the Earth within a radius of dozens of kilometers and causing innumerable chunks of dirt and rubble to soar into the sky.
The terrifying energy explosion resulted in a blazing golden shockwave that swept across more than seventy kilometers.
In its path, countless leaves from the trees over hundreds of kilometers withered, and weeds and bushes fifteen meters high below instantly turned to ash. The trees caught fire from the intense heat, burning fiercely.
At the center of the explosion, within a golden-blue circle of light spanning several kilometers, two dragons formed from Heavenly Flame and the Thousand Tribulation Thunder Dragon spanned thousands of kilometers, annihilating everything.
Such terrifying force left Makula, who appeared suddenly tens of kilometers away, with a gravely serious expression, still in fear.
Had it faced that strike head-on, it would have either died or sustained severe injuries; the flames and thunder exuding Higher-order Law aura were too terrifying, not strength that should belong to the early Myth realm.
“What are you looking at.”
Just as Makula was stunned by Jack’s strike, a faint voice sounded behind it. Unknown to Makula, Jack had already entered the range of the divine domain and appeared behind it.
In a flash, Makula’s face changed drastically: “How is this possible!”
Boom!
An intensely heavy aura burst forth from Jack, while a Black-gold battle halberd twined with gray Law Chains transformed into a dazzling gray radiance, cleaving downward with the might to Open the Heavens.
In an instant, an overwhelming sense of death enveloped Makula—Death was imminent!
“No!” In sheer horror and with his Divine Soul locked, Makula, too late to dodge, erupted with endless green Life Energy, shining like a green sun.
Boom!
Under the stroke imbued with the intent to Open the Heavens, the green sun released by the endless Life Energy, along with Makula’s True Body, exploded instantaneously, and, immediately after, a gray Halberd Skill a kilometer long continued its trajectory, unimpeded as it struck the Earth below.
In an instant, the Earth below shattered, chunks of dirt and rubble soared into the sky, and a chasm tens of kilometers long and one kilometer wide, was torn open.
Simultaneously, the green Light connected to Makula below broke apart, countless leaves and branches within hundreds of kilometers exploded from the rebound force, the trees shook violently, the impact was immense.
And as the Rule True Body was destroyed, Makula screamed in agony.
Wrapped around its Divine Soul and recondensed Rule True Body were chains imbued with the power of death, continuously burning and obliterating its vitality and Divine Soul.
At that moment, the entire divine domain shook, with buildings collapsing in dozens of cities inhabited by alien races, the ground quaking, and countless different races falling into chaos, kneeling on the ground, praying.
After inflicting heavy injury on Makula with a single strike, Jack did not attack again. He just stood tall in the high altitude, expression indifferent as he gazed into the distance.
Behind him, a one-meter-diameter golden wheel slowly rotated, wrapped with yellow, golden, black and blue patterns, exuding a terrifying might like a Demon God of World-Destroying.
The Hidden Deity’s strength allowed Jack to temporarily erase his own presence, becoming undetectable unless he stood right in front of someone and was directly observed.
Moreover, after his breakthrough into the Legendary Realm, the strength of his Speed Divine Power, allowing him to traverse over a hundred kilometers in a step as if teleporting, had synchronized and increased significantly.
This was the current strength of Jack; under the tenfold passive amplification of the Law of Strength, he had heavily injured Makula, a being comparable to the peak of Mythical strength, with just two casual moves.

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - 1062 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1062: Chapter 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God Alliance, Destroy Heaven and Earth_2 Chapter 1062: Chapter 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God Alliance, Destroy Heaven and Earth_2 This was still the norm, without manifesting the Three-faced Six-armed Rule True Body to burst out all of his strength.
At that moment, a green radiance gathered in the distance, and the figure of Makula, over two hundred meters tall, appeared once again, his face distorted with ugliness, his aura weak.
Dazzling green flames danced upon him, burning the Laws’ Origin, annihilating strands of the grey Death Law Power that entwined his form.
Jack Clark spoke indifferently, “Out of respect for the Divine Gods Alliance, this time I’m merely teaching you a lesson, but if you dare to block my way again, I will directly blow up your Domain.”
Makula’s face flushed, his gaze fixed on Jack.
Even though he was now extremely angry, he didn’t dare to make another move, because this human truly had the power to slay him.
As a deity who had refined a part of Heaven and Earth, although he stood mightily in the Divine Realm, unconquerable even by beings two minor realms above him,
his weaknesses were also quite apparent.
For instance, once they left the Divine Realm their strength would plummet, and besides that, by destroying the rule congregation points one by one within the Divine Realm, the ‘Divine Realm’ could be collapsed.
Although each Divine Realm had different rule congregation points, similar to formation foundations hidden all around, what if the other party had a way?
Of course, the simplest method was to directly locate their True Bodies within the Divine Realm, to shatter them repeatedly, wearing away the Laws’ Origin and Divine Soul just as well as erasure.
Glancing indifferently at Makula, Jack Clark then looked up at the Firmament above and, transforming into a golden light, burst through the air and rushed out of the Divine Realm.
Amid the thunderous sonic booms, trailing a tail of light that extended thousands of meters, Jack Clark, moving at over twenty times the speed of sound, blinked away into the horizon.
Watching Jack Clark depart, at an altitude of ten thousand meters above the Divine Realm, three wills emanating the pressure of Heavenly Kings descended, forming projections of three colossal figures reaching a kilometer in height.
Looking in the direction where Jack had vanished, the faces of the three Main Gods were rather solemn.
The Main God with three eyes upon his forehead spoke in a low voice, “That Human King, how strong!”
Another Main God, with the torso of a human and the tail of a snake of the Phantom Serpent Alien Tribe, spoke slowly, “Have you noticed that with the passage of time, the Human Race has become increasingly powerful?”
“From the initial outbreak of the Civilization War when they were oppressed by The Purgatory Family, now they can stand their ground in a frontal battle without falling behind.”
“Furthermore, the geniuses of the Human Race keep emerging one after another, like the previously mentioned Jonathan Walker, and now this genius named Jack Clark, whose talent is even more terrifying.”
“I feel that compared to the Purgatory Family, which seeks to demonize everything, cooperation with the Human Race might align more with our alliance’s future interests.”
Hmph!
The Main God of the Kata Clan, with golden tiger stripes on his face, snorted, “The Human Race acts overbearingly, and their growth is likewise detrimental to our alliance.”
“But it’s still better than The Purgatory Family,” said the Phantom Serpent Main God coldly.
“Currently, the Human Race is weak, and by cooperating with them, we can still dominate. If we wait until the Human Race is annihilated by the Purgatory Demon Race, we will be left with only two choices: demonization or demise.”
“And once demonized, we will be driven by The Purgatory Family for all eternity, never able to transcend,” the Phantom Serpent Main God said, glancing at the Kata Clan Main God with a cold smile.
“Although I know you want to break free from the limitations of the Divine Realm, it’s a shackle not even the Divine King can break. Do you think you stand a chance?”
“Kata, I hope you won’t continue to be deluded. It would be best not to intervene this time, otherwise you’ll die.” After these words, the Phantom Serpent Alien Main God gave a deep look to the Kata Alien Tribe Main God, then his projection dissipated into nothingness.
Watching the Phantom Serpent Alien Main God vanish, the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe’s Main God pondered briefly, then a vast will surged out in all directions, the voice resonating.
“This is a personal grudge between the Human King Jack Clark and a deity of the Demon God Alliance; other deities are not to intervene, or they will bear the consequences.”
The Evil God Alliance was a term given by the Human Race. Within the internal stratification of the Divine Gods Alliance, five Evil God Sects with the Demon God Sect at the head were known as the Demon God Alliance.
Immediately, the Kata Alien Tribe Main God’s expression turned somewhat ugly, “Cooper, what do you mean by this? Doesn’t this make it seem as if our Divine Gods Alliance fears the Human Race?”
The Tri-Eye Divine Tribe Main God gave him an indifferent look and replied faintly, “The Demon God Alliance cannot represent the entire alliance. This time, no matter who dies, it does not affect us.”
“Moreover, steadfastly guarding our old territories is our clan’s duty, the affairs of the Human Race and the Purgatory Demon Tribe are none of our business.”
“Of course, this is the duty of our clan and is irrelevant to you. Whatever you wish to do, I will not interfere.” With that, the projection of the Tri-Eye Alien Main God also scattered into points of light and vanished.
Instantly, only the projection of the Kata Main God remained standing above the Divine Realm, his gaze lowered, his thoughts unknown. After a moment of silence, he too dissipated into light.
Meanwhile, following the command of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe Main God, deities from several different races’ Divine Realms in the vicinity shifted their gaze towards the Demon God Alliance.
The Divine Gods Alliance was more than just a name; under the Rule Power of Tarodel the Divine King, all Divine Realms within the alliance were connected, forming a network that covered the entire alliance.
As the most authoritive and strongest of the Main Gods, the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe Main God controlled a part of the network of rules and possessed immense Divine Might within the scope of the alliance.
However, he did not summon the deities of different races to attack Jack Clark but instead watched with a detached gaze, nor did he notify those deities of the Demon God Alliance, including several demon kings of the Demon God Sect.
……
In the wake of a battle where he heavily injured a Mythical late-period Alien Deity and following the command of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe Main God, Jack Clark encountered no resistance when he crossed the edge of another Alien Deity’s Divine Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 1063 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1063: Chapter 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God Alliance, Destroy Heaven and Earth_3 Chapter 1063: Chapter 436 Sweeping Through the Evil God Alliance, Destroy Heaven and Earth_3 This time, Jack Clark didn’t just break through to myth status and kill his way into the Divine Gods Alliance without a plan.
As the rear of the Human Race, temporary pathways connecting to Blue Star often appeared around the Outer Development Department, and over the years, those Evil God Sect Cultists infiltrated Blue Star through these rift channels.
With Jack Clark’s performance in the Heavenly Abyss Battle City, and the terrifying phenomena of his rapid breakthrough to myth, he had become the Purgatory Family’s first assassination target.
Under such circumstances, not only was he at risk, but his relatives, Doris Clark and Glenn Clark, were also likely to be targeted by the Purgatory Family and the Evil God Sect.
Although Jack believed the Federation would send protection, facing the constant threat of assassination, the best method was, of course, to kill those causing the problem.
As long as he could eradicate the Evil God Alliance and kill all those evil gods, he wouldn’t need to worry about the safety of his relatives on Blue Star for the short term.
With this thought, Jack’s gaze grew even colder, and soon, a Black Mountain Range spanning over 3,000 kilometers and extending over 8,000 kilometers came into his view.
The mountain range was made up of peaks stretching thousands upon tens of thousands of meters high, amidst which greyish-brown vegetation and trees were scattered, with black mist spreading between their branches, forming a black fog sea of clouds reaching up to ten thousand meters high, resembling a sky curtain.
At the same time, constantly eroded by black energy over the years, the rocks of the mountain range had also turned black, and one could vaguely see some shadows shuttling through the forest, creating an eerie atmosphere.
Boom!
The black sky curtain that permeated the space between heaven and earth shook, and a golden light streaked across the sky like a sharp blade tearing through the sea of clouds, rushing towards the center of the Shadow Divine Domain mountain range.
In an instant, the Shadow God Alan Hill was alarmed.
“Who’s there!”
With a fierce shout, the distant black sea of clouds churned, and shadows converged to form a black figure hundreds of meters tall, exuding late-period mythic power and pressure.
As a veteran Evil God, Alan Hill’s strength was formidable, already nearing the mythical peak.
At the same time, the sea of fog below roiled, and shadows shot up into the sky, appearing within a hundred-plus kilometers around, emerging from the tops of several ten-thousand-meter peaks that breached the sea of clouds.
These shadows shrouded in black robes exuded a powerful aura.
Among them, there were more than a dozen of the Ninth Layers, over forty of the Eight Layers, and even more than a hundred high-ranking Seventh Layer Shadow Assassins, all elite members of the Shadow God Sect.
Above the sea of clouds, golden flames burned around Jack Clark, forming a dragon of fire thousands of meters long, and the intense heat emanating from it incessantly annihilated the surging black mist.
“Of course, the person who’s here to kill you.”
Looking at the towering black figure in the distance, Jack Clark said indifferently, “A few months ago, you sent cultists to invade the Southern Battlefield of Eastern Summer and killed more than a dozen of my seniors. I’ve come here today for vengeance.”
“Shadow God Alan Hill, prepare to die.”
Boom! Brilliant golden flames erupted from Jack Clark’s body, like a Stellar Sun radiating endless light and heat, forming a golden fireball with a diameter of 3,000 kilometers.
The energy within a hundreds-of-kilometers radius between heaven and earth surged chaotically, flocking to the golden sun and feeding the fire, radiating a destructive and intense temperature.
In just the blink of an eye, the surrounding swirling black fog was wiped clean, creating a vacuum zone over thirty kilometers wide.
“How is this possible!” Far away, Alan Hill’s face twisted in shock.
As the Lord of the Divine Realm, he was unable at that moment to control the Power of Heaven and Earth around Jack Clark; instead, the force he had already refined felt suppressed by an even stronger power.
Roar!!
The boundless black fog rolled like a sea of clouds, when suddenly a shadow demon dragon, measuring tens of kilometers in length, roared forth, converging the Power of Heaven and Earth as it pounced towards Jack Clark.
Boom!
The moment the shadow demon dragon neared the Golden Sun, endless flames erupted, and a terrifying explosion sent golden flames shooting out in all directions, illuminating the entire world with their radiance.
Under such an unconventional and unexpected strike, the demon dragon, condensed from the shadow law, was instantly shattered, and the resultant golden scorching shockwave annihilated the black fog sea of clouds within a hundred-kilometer radius.
In the midst of the terrifying explosion, Alan Hill let out a muffled grunt, followed by a dramatic change in facial expression as he turned into a shadow and vanished, with a roar of shock and anger echoing between heaven and earth.
“Be careful, let’s go!”
The instant Alan Hill disappeared, a war halberd wrapped in Blue Thunder appeared out of thin air and struck down, shattering the space within a kilometer, a sight horrifying to behold.
Watching Alan Hill vanish in an instant with the aid of the shadow law, Jack Clark’s eyes grew cold, then he transformed into a bolt of blue lightning, snaking over a hundred kilometers, appearing atop a ten thousand meter mountain peak.
In an instant, the faces of the more than a hundred high-ranking powerhouses from the Shadow God Sect changed drastically.
“Not good!”
“Dodge it.”
From a distance, one could see a kilometer-long Thunder War Halberd descend from the sky and land on the mountain peak.
Boom!
With one strike, the mountain collapsed, and thunder emitting dazzling radiance enveloped half of the sky, spreading thunder turned each Shadow Assassin to ash.
As rocks tumbled and smoke and dust filled the air, Jack Clark had already turned into spreading lightning, reappearing dozens of kilometers away on another mountain peak.
With his Speed Divine Power combined with the Lightning Law, Jack Clark’s speed had become almost indescribable.
“My god save me.”
“Run!”
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the terror of the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, the high-ranking cultists of the Evil God Sect were no different from ants, turning to ash in the blinding blue lightning.
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark traversed hundreds of kilometers, collapsing four ten thousand meter mountain peaks, and wiping out all elites of the Shadow God Sect. The aftermath of the explosions shook heaven and earth, with thunderous echoes resonating unceasingly.
And just then, a silent shadow appeared behind Jack Clark, it was none other than the Shadow God himself, with a one-meter-long black sharp blade in his hand aiming at Jack Clark.
The path of the black blade was devoid of any fluctuations, killing intent, or sense of presence.
As the Shadow God, Alan Hill had mastered the arts of breathing suppression and assassination to the pinnacle.
At this moment, in complete silence, the surrounding Blue Thunder around Jack Clark was directly erased by the black blade of assassination, and there was no energy reaction triggered at all, which was terrifying.
However, when the black blade got within 3 meters of Jack Clark, it suddenly halted, blocked by an invisible force field, with waves of golden halos rippling around the knife edge.
Suddenly, a look of astonishment appeared on Alan Hill’s face. The Shadow Stab in his hand had the power to erase all physical and energy matter, and it had even penetrated the protective laws of Mythical Peak strong men before.
The Thunder-wreathed Jack Clark slowly turned back, his gaze cold and detached.

chapters.title: Chapter 1064 - 1064 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1064: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics Chapter 1064: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics “`
As the Blood Moon fell, mountain ranges spanning over 8,000 kilometers shook continuously, while the remnants of the shadow laws merging with heaven and earth dissipated and vanished.
Upon collapsing mountain peaks and amidst a sea of fire extending over thousands of kilometers, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, his body crackling with the power of thunder, emitting a heavy oppressive presence.
In his eyes, the Black Gold vertical pupils that had consumed half of the Void Energy slowly faded away, and the black and gray rune lines at the corners of his eyes gradually disappeared, his brow slightly furrowed.
“These Evil Gods refined from the Divine Realm are really troublesome.”
With his current strength, under normal conditions, no one from the Legendary Realm could withstand a blow from his peak solidity strength.
Even those strong late in the Legendary Realm could be shattered with one strike, their Rule True Body destroyed, and within a few moves, their Origin ground away by Law Powers, defining their Divine Soul’s death.
As for the consumption required to erode the Origin and Divine Soul of the others, it was practically irrelevant for Jack Clark, whose True Body was powerful and whose Divine Soul’s strength was vast.
But these deities in the Divine Realm, besides being stronger, also possessed many special abilities, such as characteristics akin to Law Integration of a Heavenly King. With a mere thought, their True Body could disperse and vanish, escaping hundreds of kilometers away.
Besides, they could also draw on the power of faith to replenish what was consumed, infuse the Power of Heaven and Earth to amplify the strength of their cultists, and even temporarily elevate a few to a quasi-mythical realm of power.
This is also why these Evil Gods would choose to refine Heaven and Earth – if it weren’t for the tremendous advantages, nobody would choose to confine themselves within the Divine Realm.
Moreover, if one day they could break through to the Heavenly King Level and become the Main God, they could even form a Divine Nation, not only stronger but also less vulnerable.
Thus, to slay these Evil Gods swiftly, one must figure out a way to restrain their Divine Realm powers first.
Thinking this, Jack Clark seemed contemplative, then reached out and made a slight gripping motion towards the ground below.
Whoosh!
A powerful force curled up the space where it had shattered, and a black ring flew upwards — It was the Storage Ring left behind by the fallen Alan Hill.
Unlike the slain Blood God Akunus, being an Evil God in his prime, Alan Hill certainly had many treasures accumulated over the years.
Consequently, during the earlier disintegration of the Void, Jack Clark deliberately avoided destroying this Space Equipment.
However, there’s no time now to break the ring’s seal; he must strike the other Evil Gods by surprise before they receive the news; otherwise, they might abandon the Divine Realm to escape.
The Divine Realms of these deities are widely distributed, with most areas in between filled with forbidden zones and dangerous regions, but if ‘someone’ were to notify them…
…
Five thousand kilometers to the left of the Shadow Divine Domain, beyond a vast marshland, lies the expanse of the Eternal Divine Domain.
Within the towering golden light screen that reached the sky, the ground was cracked, rocks eroded, and not a trace of vegetation or life to be seen; it resembled a realm of death.
This view extended for thousands of kilometers, and at the terrestrial edge, a cyber-styled city sprawled over hundreds of kilometers appeared.
The City Center was filled with skyscrapers, some rudimentary flying vehicles shuttled through the air, and nearly a million large and bizarrely-shaped figures of different races moved to and fro on the ground, making the place seem highly prosperous.
All these beings of different races bore traces of mechanical modifications, with sizes ranging from five to ten meters, and even over twenty meters; many looked like they were half ‘person,’ half mecha.
Apart from them, there were also ‘humans’ fully metalized in mecha armor, resembling transforming robots.
The god of the Eternal God Church, Brut from the Simon Empire, was a famous scientist back in his day, fond of conducting human modification experiments in pursuit of eternity.
When his vile experiments were exposed, he fled to the mythical world with tens of thousands of people, pursued by a large number of Human Experts.
These ordinary people, upon entering the mythical world, saw over ten thousand of them die from genetic collapse due to the infusion of Heavenly Energy within just a couple of days.
The rest mostly mutated, with only a small number adapting to the mythical world and surviving, and those that did mutate were used by Brut as material for his experiments.
Decades passed, and the first generation of humans nearly all perished, leaving behind the descendants of those who successfully merged with the genes of different races. These people mostly had defects; they were bloodthirsty and insane.
Over the years, the cultists invading Blue Star were mainly from the Blood God Sect and the Giant God Sect,
As for Shadow God Sect and Eternal God Church, together with the Demon God Sect’s demonized army, they have been confronting the Human Divine Domain, occasionally erupting into battles and localized conflicts.
Now, in the immense City Center of Eternal City, stood a Divine temple made of gold, reaching ten thousand meters into the sky. Upon the throne sat a figure a kilometer tall and shimmering with golden radiance, appearing like mecha.
Streams of golden light, akin to liquid, circulated along the palace floor, walls, and pillars, continuously melting into the mecha-like body, invisibly exuding terrifying auras.
This golden energy was the essence of minerals from the Divine Realm. After decades of refinement and fusion, it had made Brut’s Immortal Gold Body incredibly powerful and impervious.
Combined with the peculiarities of gold’s eternal nature, there was a faint sense of the eternal and undying emanating from him.
Although his realm was only late in the Mythological Phase, the oppressive feeling Brut invisibly exuded far surpassed that of the Shadow God and was even stronger than most at the Mythical Peak.
Suddenly, the golden giant’s eyes opened slightly, revealing a look of astonishment, followed by a deep booming voice: “An enemy has invaded, activate the Vajra Divine Array.”
Boom!!
As Brut’s voice thundered through the Eternal City, the whole city suddenly stirred, and over a hundred skyscrapers emitted golden lights, each resonating with the others.
In the blink of an eye, mighty energies converged, forming an enormous golden Rune Array that encircled the city, resembling concentric circles of golden gears.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - 1065 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1065: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_2 Chapter 1065: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_2 At the same time, a series of powerful auras from the Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Layers Heaven erupted, as dozens of bishops and priests in human form appeared.
These individuals looked towards the Golden Divine Temple with fanatic gazes, where a mountainous figure strode out. Each step it took shook the earth and stirred up waves of air that resembled the roaring of mountains and seas.
Standing atop the three-thousand-meter-high steps, the golden Mecha emitted dazzling golden light, forming a Golden Sun behind it, looking incredibly sacred and majestic.
Watching this scene, the million cultists of different races in the city, the weakest of whom were Level 4, revealed fervent looks in their eyes. They knelt down to worship Brut, shouting loudly.
“Behold the great Eternal God.”
“You are the True God who created the world, we thank you for blessing us with creation.”
“Beloved Eternal Lord, your radiance shall illuminate the world for all eternity…”
Brut seldom emerged from the divine temple, so the cultists who worshipped eternity were exceptionally excited. Gazing at the figure exuding an aura of eternal and undying, some cultists even became somewhat frenzied.
Ignoring the worshipping cultists from all directions, Brut slowly raised his head and looked into the high altitude afar, his deep voice vibrating Heaven and Earth, “Come out, I know you have already arrived.”
In an instant, high above the city in the ten thousand meters altitude, space twisted slightly, followed by Jack Clark appearing soundlessly in his black and red ornate battle armor, his aura concealed.
At this moment, many people saw him standing there, yet they had the surreal and uncomfortable impression that he did not exist.
Such terrifying stealth ability made Blues’s pupils contract.
Just a few moments ago, a will had informed it through the divine network that Alan Hill had fallen, and someone had infiltrated his Eternal Divine Domain.
And yet, it had not sensed anything, which was almost unimaginable for someone who had refined this World with the law of gold and could sense the situation of the Divine Realm at any time.
Clearly, this person had mastered the Law of Space or a law related to the Power of Space, and without exception, such laws were extremely powerful.
Gazing at the golden Mecha standing on the steps of the Golden Divine Temple, Jack Clark slowly spoke up, “With your strength, it’s impossible to detect Void stealth that erases one’s presence. It seems someone notified you.”
Jack Clark wasn’t surprised by this situation; after all, among the three Main God-level powerhouses of the Divine Gods Alliance, one clearly leaned towards the Evil God Alliance.
It was evident that the other party had been watching him closely, warning Brut in advance.
It just wasn’t clear whether the other Main God would make a move, or maybe Jack Clark hoped they would.
Having broken through to king-level and mastered the Supreme Law, Jack Clark wanted to test the limit of his strength, and what better way than to use a Main God-level strong man for practice?
After all, for him now, the enemies in the Legendary Realm were too weak, even those at the Mythical Peak were the same.
At that moment, Brut, whose height reached a kilometer, opened his mouth slightly, his heavy voice resonating with Heaven and Earth, “I’ve mastered the Higher-order Law of Gold’s Solidity, and for decades I’ve refined all the gold mineral essences of this World, creating an Immortal Gold Body that is indestructible.”
“Even if you can slay Alan Hill and possess formidable strength, you cannot break my defense.”
“However, today is my seventieth birthday, and I do not wish to shed blood, so leave, Human King.”
…Brut’s words made Jack Clark pause for a moment before replying indifferently, “I didn’t realize today was your ‘big seventieth celebration’. If that’s the case, I ought to give you an even larger gift.”
Boom!
An immense aura of utmost rigidity and positivity spread from Jack Clark, filling Heaven and Earth as the energy within a few hundred kilometers instantly converged, turning into tangible white Energy Cloud Mist swirling around him.
Despite only being in the Early Myth realm, he emitted a terrifying danger that even made Brut apprehensive.
Just then, endless blood light burst from Jack Clark, covering thousands of kilometers. The surrounding Heavenly Energy turned into golden flames that burned fiercely, with flashes of Thunder.
In the blink of an eye, a shattered world appeared, exuding an ear-shattering Destructive Aura.
Great Thousand Burial.
Boom! The shattered world, spanning kilometers in diameter, trembled violently, and as Jack Clark swung his War Halberd, it swept across like a world-ending meteor, smashing down with huge waves of white air, overwhelming in its grandeur.
“Ungrateful for favor, today I shall let you know what immortality of the golden body truly means.”
Dazzling golden light erupted from Brut, his aura connecting with the rune array of the Eternal City. In an instant, layers of golden gears enveloped the whole city, radiating with brilliance.
At that moment, the Power of Heaven and Earth from the entire Eternal Divine Domain converged, turning the entire city into a vision of gold, glowing with Radiance and Solidity.
Meanwhile, the shattered world descended from the sky, landing on the Eternal City.
Boom! In an instant, a dazzling light illuminated Heaven and Earth.
Upon contact, the world, made from two kinds of Higher-order Law Power and the Power of Hell, shattered, and in that instant, a terrifying Power of world destruction burst forth.
Endless destructive power swept down; the layers of golden gears surrounding the Eternal City continually broke and exploded, shaking the entire city violently.
Outside the city, the Earth cracked open; countless chunks of dirt and stone exploded into the air like a Tsunami, then turned into magma in the intense Firelight, erupting in all directions, covering tens of kilometers.
Such a terrifying strike had almost surpassed the boundary of Mythical-level strength, and the invisible pressure that it emitted was so immense that it filled the countless fearful cultists in the city with dread.
Even though their faith was strong and zealous, their instinctive fear of Death as living beings remained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1066 - 1066 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1066: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_3 Chapter 1066: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_3 “`
After the intense explosion subsided, the Eternal City, now with more than half destroyed, revealed its broken golden wheels amidst a pervasive golden radiance symbolizing indestructibility.
At the steps of the golden palace that towered ten thousand meters high in the City Center, Brut, rising a kilometer tall, stood proudly with divine golden light flowing around his heavy aura.
“I have said my Immortal Gold Body is eternal and invincible in Defense,” he declared.
“Your Defense is indeed strong, but now it’s time for me to get serious,” came the reply.
Above the ruins formed by the aftermath of the blast outside the city, a terrifyingly indescribable aura emanated from Jack Clark as his form swelled massively.
Boom!
In an instant, the heavens and the Earth shook as endless dark clouds mysteriously gathered into a Black Vortex spanning tens of kilometers, while within it, streaks of Blue Thunder rumbled and exploded.
Beneath it, the figure of a three-hundred-meter giant with three faces and six arms, wielding a seven-hundred-meter Black-gold battle halberd, emerged, with golden flames burning around it, exuding an extremely terrifying pressure.
Jack Clark, now in his Rule True Body, was horrifyingly formidable; just his presence and the intangible Aura he emitted caused the golden city below to continuously tremble.
The surrounding space kept cracking, forming Black Cracks that shattered, and then under an Overbearing force to the extreme, distorted and deformed, creating a Dark Domain of a thousand meters in radius.
Within this domain, everything was crushed and collapsed by the force Jack Clark released; even the Void seemed to resonate with faint, reverent choruses as if welcoming His descent.
This terrifying phenomenon caused Brut to involuntarily contract his pupils, feeling an instinctual shudder before the might of Jack Clark at this moment, with a look of horror unavoidably appearing in his eyes.
“How is it possible, how can your Aura be so powerful!!”
In this moment, even before the battle commenced, Brut felt an urge to turn and flee, despite his being a deity who had broken through to the Legendary Realm for decades, supposedly possessing higher cultivation and deeper Intrinsic quality.
Boom! Without any waste of words, amidst space quaking, Jack Clark appeared at the edge of the Eternal City in one step. He concentrated all his strength and brandished his War Halberd at a terrifying speed of a hundred times the speed of sound.
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
Beneath the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd wrapped in black Radiance, space exploded, everything was blasted to oblivion, including the golden gear that had just withstood the Mythical Limit Burst.
The Overbearing strike of the halberd, after pulverizing the nine rings of golden gears, maintained its unstoppable force, creating a crescent-shaped Halberd Skill, a thousand meters long, like a black Vacuum cutting through everything.
Where it passed, buildings hundreds of meters high crumbled, different races exploded into fragments, leaving behind a Destruction Tunnel stretching for tens of kilometers, and a kilometer wide.
With a mere casual strike, the divine array of runes bolstered by the entire force of the Divine Realm was destroyed, and the pervasive Destructive Aura caused Brut to shudder all over.
He was frightened, afraid of Death; it was his fear of Death that had led him to pursue Eternity. He wanted to be Undying and Immortal, and for this, he would betray anything.
And now someone wanted to kill him, the power displayed by Jack Clark brought a strong threat of death to him.
Under the fear of Death, Brut’s eyes suddenly turned blood-red, staring fixedly at the three-faced, six-armed Jack Clark: “I don’t believe that you can maintain this Limit Breakthrough forever. Even if it exhausts my decades of accumulation today, I will fight to the Death with you.”
“I am the Eternal God and shall be eternal and undying. Burn, and offer everything to me,” he roared.
Boom!
The entire Eternal City burst into flames, not sparing its devoted believers or the structures, all turning to ash within the golden flames, releasing countless amounts of golden light.
An infinite amount of golden strength converged, the Golden Divine Temple trembled as if liquid in flow, encasing Brut and transforming him into a more than three-thousand-meter-tall golden giant.
And all this happened in the blink of an eye, at the moment when Jack Clark’s halberd destroyed the rune divine array of the Eternal City.
As a deity who feared death to the extreme, Brut had countermeasures for various dangers.
For example, this move: should he face attack by a Heavenly King Level powerhouse and found himself unable to resist, he would burn everything in sacrifice to transform into an indestructible Immortal Gold Body.
This move gathered all the metal material of the entire Divine Realm, including the gold-rich minerals and Divine Objects he had collected over the years. He forged an unshakeable body.
Added with the blessings of the Power of Heaven and Earth from the entire Eternal Divine Domain, his defense was powerfully augmented to a level that even a Heavenly King Level powerhouse found difficult to break, unless they could destroy the whole Divine Realm in one blow.
Just as Brut completed his Eternal Golden Body, Jack Clark, as if teleporting, crossed tens of kilometers in an instant and appeared above him, his six arms holding the halberd aloft.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s profound and terrifying Qi Blood shook Heaven and Earth, while golden-blue Radiance flashed; a ferocious and brutal, Overbearing Dragon Might spread out, like a Demon God opening the heavens with a halberd strike.
Boom!
With the halberd’s skill shaking, a vast Space distorted as if a Black Sky Curtain was descending, obliterating everything. The intangible force immediately weighed heavily on Brut.
“I am eternal and undying.”
Brut roared to the heavens as a pair of arms, a kilometer long and as sturdy as mountain ranges, crossed in front of him. Simultaneously, he burned the Laws’ Origin within him, creating a golden barrier a hundred meters thick.
Boom!
Under the Overbearing force, space turned into a stream of Chaos. The golden light from burning Origin continuously shattered; the barrier, a few hundred meters away, blew open like actual metal.
Thud!
The War Halberd that ripped through the solidity’s golden rule impacted on Brut’s arms, and instantly his expression changed, his colossal body violently shook, an indescribable heavy force hit him.
Boom!
Beneath the nearly three-thousand-meter tall golden peak that was Brut, the ground shattered, with a myriad of dirt and stones exploding, forming a series of massive cracks spreading for tens of kilometers.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1067 - 1067 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1067: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_4 Chapter 1067: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_4 “`
Crackle Crackle!! In the brief standoff under the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, cracks began to spread over Brut’s left arm, swiftly covering the entire limb.
“How is this possible!” Brut roared in shock and rage. His Invincible Golden Body, which he had prepared for decades, failed to withstand even a single halberd strike from his opponent.
Boom! The moment his left arm exploded, Brut swung his mountainous right arm, and with a mighty sweep, blasted everything in its path, compressing the space into layers of transparent shockwaves.
Boom! Jack Clark, with the seven-hundred-meter-long black-gold battle halberd in hand, barred the massive golden palm in front of him, his figure unshaken.
“You are too weak.”
With that faint voice, Jack flicked his wrist, and instantly a vast, ocean-like force burst forth, repelling Brut several kilometers away.
And in the instant Brut stepped back, Jack’s four arms formed a seal, while from his empty left hand emanated a soul fluctuation that struck terror into Brut.
Boom!
The world darkened in Brut’s eyes. Within his soul’s darkened perspective, a black seal as vast as the heavens fell from above, its invisible oppressive aura freezing his divine soul in place.
Within this heaven-destroying and earth-shattering black seal, a faintly visible microcosm spun, emitting an aura of profound mystery.
At this moment, with his soul suppressed and unable to move, Brut emitted a roar full of rage and despair: “Why, according to the alliance’s rules, has no one come to rescue me for so long!!”
Boom!
The three-thousand-meter-tall golden giant shook, the golden light in its eyes dimmed, and Jack Clark, with a single strike, shattered its soul source, or what one might call its divine soul.
Just then, a vast will, bearing the pressure of the Main God, descended along the network of the Divine Gods Alliance, its voice indifferent: “This is a private feud between you, the Demon God Alliance, and him. It is not appropriate for us to intervene.”
“I cannot accept this!”
Boom! As his divine soul dissipated, Brut’s massive body collapsed like a mountain, thundering to the ground and causing the earth to tremble and dust to billow.
Countless golden lights sparkled on his body, turning into a dense Heavenly Energy that dissipated into the air and gradually formed a mountain range over three thousand meters in length.
Meanwhile, the entire Divine Realm quaked, as streams of gold solidity law power dissipated, making the whole world seem suddenly more vibrant.
That was the power of Heaven and Earth, previously suppressed by the law of gold solidity, now restoring its normal “order”.
“His realm is clearly at the early Mythical Stage, how can he be so powerful!?”
Hundreds of kilometers above the Firmament, more than a dozen alien deity wills, having arrived early through the network of the Divine Gods Alliance to witness the battle, were shaken and horrified.
As a veteran Mythical powerhouse, Brut’s defense was notably strong even within the Divine Gods Alliance.
Although he had rarely left the Divine Realm in recent years, when he first joined the Divine Gods Alliance, a Mythical Peak powerhouse from a different race came to challenge him.
At that time, Brut was at the Mid-Mythical Stage, and with the blessing and suppression of the Divine Realm, that alien powerhouse could only exert the strength of the Late Mythical Stage.
Yet despite being attacked by that alien powerhouse, Brut remained utterly immovable.
Decades have passed, and Brut’s cultivation has broken through to the Late Mythical Stage. Moreover, just now he ignited his Origin to gather all the power of gold from the Divine Realm into an Eternal Golden Body, making his defense even more terrifying.
The intangible essence of solidity that spread out impressed even them, hundreds of kilometers away, as something that not even a newly advanced Main God could breach.
But such a mighty defense and solid true body lasted only two moves in the hands of that early Myth human king before being obliterated.
At this moment, these watching alien deities even found themselves questioning their own existence.
“Could it be that we are false Mythical Powerhouses?”
They all stood at the Mythical Stage, yet why could that human be so powerful, possessing combat prowess at the Main God-level despite only being at the early stage of Myth?
As Mythical-level Powerhouses themselves, yet they struggled to fight across even a minor boundary.
Every being that has reached the Mythical Stage is a genius with exceptional talent; otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to break through the limits and enter Myth.
Thus, under normal conditions, although there might be variances in strength among Mythical-level Powerhouses, the gap should not be too wide, unless their realms are vastly different.
For example, between the early Mythical Stage and the Mythical Peak.
While these alien deities were still reeling, Jack down below gradually retracted his size back to normal and then slammed his halberd into the chest of Brut’s mountainous body, retrieving a Space Bracelet.
As Jack turned into a ray of light and shot off into the distance, high above the Firmament, within a deep Area of Destruction tens of thousands of kilometers away, stood a figure that appeared old.
This Primordial figure emitted an invisible aura that suppressed the universe, calming the destructive winds that were tearing space apart within tens of kilometers.
Opposite the Primordial True King, a figure shrouded in golden light stood tall, its form indistinct, its aura even more terrifying, as if it were an eternal and undying star.
Golden light streamed around it, and the towering figure spoke slowly, its voice resonating through space-time: “To have a Divine King-level powerhouse watch over him, it seems you hold him in high regard.”
The Primordial True King nodded slowly, his voice ancient: “Of course we value him, whether it be me, Adam Garcetti, or Henry, we all have high hopes for him.”
As he said this, the Primordial True King’s voice shifted: “You saw that battle just now, what do you think?”
“A talent without peer, unparalleled in history.” The voice enshrouded in golden light spoke slowly, its sound carrying a terrifying power that shook space-time.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - 1068 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1068: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_5 Chapter 1068: Chapter 437 Invincible Immortal Gold Body, Ancient Relics_5 “`
“His Life Mark Wheel only has seventeen marks, and according to your Human Clan’s Cultivation System which requires one to begin cultivation at the age of sixteen, this means that he has only been cultivating for ‘one year’.”
“In one year, to step from an ordinary creature into the Transcendent realm, and even into the domain of myth, such a speed of cultivation is unheard of even in my tens of thousands of years of existence.”
“And it would already be noteworthy if it were just his fast cultivation speed, but his foundation is also incredibly solid.”
“Just now, during his battle, I sensed four types of Higher-order Law Power emanating from him, as well as an elusive fluctuation that towers above the Higher-order Laws.”
“Moreover, when he landed the killing blow on Brut, I sensed a powerful Soul Fluctuation, shaped like a black seal; he has also mastered a mighty Soul Law power!”
Even Tarodel couldn’t help but reveal a hint of astonishment in his tone at this point, the talent of this Human Clan genius was so monstrous it surpassed even his imagination.
Reaching this point, Tarodel’s voice trembled slightly as he slowly said, “To let loose such a monster… it seems you’re ready to completely eradicate the Demon God Alliance this time.”
At this moment, the tone of the two individuals conversing was relaxed, nothing like the neutral, unfamiliar relations rumored on the outside.
The Primordial True King nodded, “Indeed, some unexpected changes have occurred at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield recently, with the aftermath of the impact of the Primordial Stars that descended from the sky causing a separation.”
“Currently, the only battlefield where our Human Race is in contact with The Purgatory Family is the Sky Curtain, which, due to its unique topography, cannot accommodate the forces of two Purgatory Demon empires.”
“Therefore, before a new battlefield is opened, our Human Race can spare some forces. Hence, we are preparing to stabilize the affairs on the alliance’s side, and fully exploit the resources to the rear.”
“Although The Purgatory Family has sent three Demon Kings over the years to establish the Demon God Sect, they haven’t sustained their investment of strength.”
“Even with Jack Clark as bait this time, no peak-level Great Demon Kings have descended, which seems to indicate that they’ve sensed something.”
“They probably haven’t detected our agreement, it’s just that the Demon King-Level Strong from your Human Race that have been lost are too many, so they have become more cautious.”
“That’s a possibility…”
While the two Supreme experts were conversing, Jack Clark had already traversed more than ten thousand kilometers to appear outside the divine domain of the Giant God Sect; then he paused, looking into the distance.
He saw that about a dozen kilometers away, on the mountainside of a mountain peak several thousand meters high, Eddy Keller and Sid Hawk were hidden beneath the leaves of a Sky-touching Tree, their smart wristwatches emitting a faint signal.
Noticing that Jack Clark had spotted them, Eddy Keller’s figure flashed and appeared on a tree leaf several meters in size, waving at him.
Jack Clark’s figure flashed, turning into a streak of golden light before appearing before the two men, saying with surprise, “Senior Keller, Brother Sid, what are you doing here?”
Just as Jack Clark approached, an invisible pressure spread out, so oppressing that Sid Hawk, who was in the late period of the Ninth Heavens, found it difficult to bear, showing a frightened look in his eyes.
Eddy Keller, clad in white snow-like clothes and sturdy in build, almost fell to his knees on the leaf, quickly managing a bitter smile as he said.
“Junior Clark, quickly withdraw the pressure you’re exuding; we already know that you’ve made a breakthrough to the king level.”
“So you already knew,” Jack Clark said with a smile, easily retracting the invisible pressure spreading from his body, his demeanor casual with not a trace of embarrassment.
Immediately, Eddy Keller and Sid Hawk breathed a sigh of relief, then smiled wryly, not expecting that Jack Clark, who always seemed so steady, had this side to him.
Because of his cultivation, everyone had forgotten that Jack Clark was just a seventeen-year-old youth.
Sid Hawk spoke up, “Brother Clark, the reason we’re here is because we’ve taken on a mission regarding the Giant God Sect.”
“The Giant God Sect has been acting mysteriously these past few years, a consequence of the Supporting Heaven Giant God Gaya finding an ancient relic, and they have been trying to enter it for years, even cooperating with other Evil Gods.”
“Based on the information we got recently, it’s said that there’s a secret treasure inside the relic that holds secrets to breaking through to the Heavenly King level, and it might even help him sever his Divine Realm body.”
“`
“`
“Therefore, during this period, our surveillance of him has become even more stringent; a king-level powerhouse even took action, lurking in the vicinity of the Giant God Sect’s Divine Realm.”
“But who would have thought that Gaya had long since left the Divine Realm, disappeared for quite some time, and apart from some cultists of the Giant God Sect and subordinates of different races, only a Nine Layers Archbishop remained in the realm.”
“He’s actually not there, no, Gaya must not have left long ago.” Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed.
Earlier, when he made his breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens, the Black Forbidden Zone collapsed, and a Void Storm swept him to the edge of the Divine Gods Alliance; he took the opportunity to save Eddy Keller and others.
After sending Eddy Keller and the others into the Beautiful Scene Immortal Domain, he felt a spying force. He had a clash across the Void with the Supporting Heaven Giant God Gaya by using the Void Death Pupil.
