According to the approximate distance and direction sensed at that time, Gaya should have still been in the Giant God’s Divine Realm, presumably having left after that clash.
Jack Clark pondered slightly, “My goal this time is to completely suppress the Evil God Alliance and stabilize the rear. Although Gaya is not present, his Divine Realm cannot be left behind.”
For the deities that refine Divine Realms, everything is closely related to their realm. If a Divine Realm is forcibly destroyed, the main body will suffer great damage.
Because the Divine Realm is a part of their very foundation.
Boom!
Under the shocked gazes of Eddy Keller and Sid Hawk, the ground in the distance split apart, and terrifying energy fluctuations burst forth, the dazzling Golden Firelight illuminating the sky.
In just over ten minutes, a ‘world-like’ area spanning tens of thousands of kilometers turned into a sea of fire; the Earth cracked, mountains toppled, and numerous cities of different races were obliterated, with countless Giant God Sect followers turning to ash in despair.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark spared no expense in Law Divine Power, observing the heavens and the earth with the Void Death Pupil, and destroying the Divine Realm along with the Giant God’s law that had integrated into Heaven and Earth.
In the depths of the mythical world, far from the Divine Gods Alliance, among collapsing mountainsides, a stone palace relic covered in vines was revealed.
At the majestic entrance of the palace ruins, the burly Gaya’s complexion changed, his aura plummeted, and demon gas churned, bursting the air to form a white wave of raging wind sweeping thousands of kilometers.
Amidst the roiling demon gas, Gaya looked dismal; he turned his head towards the direction of the Divine Gods Alliance, his voice ice-cold, “My Divine Realm has been destroyed. Did they dispatch a Heavenly King Level powerhouse?”
To destroy a Divine Realm that has refined a mythical powerhouse, at least a Heavenly King Level powerhouse must take action, because mythical powerhouses do not have so much Law Divine Power to expend.
What made Gaya’s expression dismal was the Divine Gods Alliance’s lack of reaction, allowing a Human Clan’s Heavenly King Level powerhouse to penetrate deep into the alliance and destroy his Divine Realm.
“These damnable different races, truly unreliable.”
Suppressing the boiling killing intent in his heart, Gaya closed his eyes again.
In front of him, a gray Stone Disk slowly rotated, emitting a subtle fluctuation that resonated with the relic palace, conducting some sort of decryption.
As the key to open the relic’s gate, there were originally two Stone Disks, one of which was in the hands of Blood God Acunus.
The two had agreed to explore the relic together, but unexpectedly, that guy’s Rule True Body was shattered by the Mysterious Martial Sky King. Although he managed to escape later with the help of the Blood God Demonic Tome, he never resurfaced.
As Acunus’s Divine Realm collapsed recently, signaling his complete fall, that Stone Disk also disappeared without a trace.
He had been sending people to look for Acunus’s whereabouts but to no avail.
And just some time ago, several of his bishops perished suddenly, and as he used faith to link and recall the Remnant Souls of these bishops to investigate, he exchanged a blow across the Void with a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils.
After that strike, he inexplicably felt an approaching crisis and, on a whim, Gaya decisively left the Divine Realm and came here, planning to use the relic’s power to make a breakthrough.
However, because he only had one key, he could not open the relic’s gate, and could only rely on the Stone Disk’s connection to gradually erode the restrictive force bit by bit.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - 1069 437 Dominating the Era Blasting the Main
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1069: Chapter 437: Dominating the Era, Blasting the Main God Chapter 1069: Chapter 437: Dominating the Era, Blasting the Main God Under the waning glow of the setting blue sun, the Divine Realm of the Giant God Sect had been turned into ruins.
Mountain ranges had crumbled, the Earth had collapsed, scattered with several kilometer-wide meteorite craters, and everything within tens of kilometers was destroyed by shockwaves, with flames burning and magma flowing.
Walking slowly out of the sea of fire in the sky above the ruins of Giant God’s City was Jack Clark, his body surrounded by a halo of golden flames, resembling a Demon God of World-Destroying.
Looking at Eddy Keller and Sid Hawk who had followed from a distance, Jack Clark slowly said, “Senior Keller, Brother Sid, I must now rush to the Demon Domain of the Demon God Sect; I’ll take my leave first.”
“When I destroyed the main cities of the Giant God Sect earlier, I didn’t have the time to collect some resources. If you’re interested, you could go take a look.”
After saying this, with a thunderous noise, Jack Clark shot into the sky at more than twenty times the speed of sound, with the friction between his body and the air creating over a hundred meters of blue ionic flame tail lights.
Jack Clark’s undisguised behavior gave off a sense of arrogance, as though he was rampaging unscrupulously and overwhelmingly.
After all, under normal conditions, strong men who had stepped into the Legendary Realm would fly surrounded by the rules that eliminated air resistance, or directly warp space to leap.
Looking at that vanishing streak of golden light in the sky, Sid Hawk suddenly smiled bitterly, “It feels like being born in the same era as him is both our fortune and misfortune.”
“The invincible might to cross a Major Realm even after reaching the Legendary Realm, and the terrifying rate of cultivation, it’s simply driving the geniuses of his generation to despair.”
Eddy Keller, feeling this deeply, sighed and nodded in agreement, “There is indeed some despair.”
Before meeting Jack Clark, he was the top genius of the Military Secret Martial Arts Academy, who made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven with perfect harmony with higher-level cultivation methods in his Second Grade.
Even if he later took half a year to waste creating a Self-created Secret Manual and condensing a true martial phantom in his Senior year, he cultivated to the pinnacle of Seventh Layer Heaven, a genius monstrosity.
With his talent, a notch stronger than the Innate Awakened Ones, he should have been the one dazzling in the upcoming Void Relics, dominating all peers of the Younger Generation.
But who knew that a monster who had made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer Heaven in his Freshman year would appear.
Moreover, during the entry into the relics, he exhibited terrifying combat strength and endurance, slaughtering over a hundred thousand senior and high-order Void Creatures in just under ten days, overpowering everyone of the younger generation.
And due to the spoils from the relics, he smoothly made a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer Heaven a few days after the Road to Becoming a God had ended.
But before he could take pride in his achievements for even a moment, Jack Clark, who was merely at the early stages of the Seventh Layer a little more than ten days ago, also emerged from seclusion, breaking through to the Eighth Layer and condensing a world-shaking Four-fold Plane World.
Now, over two months have passed, and he has only recently broken through to the mid-eighth level, while his opponent has already surpassed the Mythical King, suppressed several Evil Gods and demon kings, and destroyed an entire Divine Realm.
This terrifying feat and heaven-defying battle records almost made this talent who proudly looked down upon his peers feel despair.
In this era of great contention, the emergence of such a shockingly talented monstrosity is both their fortune and misfortune.
Lucky because his brilliance takes on all the hope and pressure, allowing other young geniuses to cultivate and grow more comfortably.
And unfortunate because with his presence, other geniuses who need enough pressure to break their limits and fully ascend may see a decrease in their future achievements due to the lack of external pressure.
For example, his swift growth in the mythical world was because he took on tasks from the Giant God Sect, constantly battling and growing through fights with high-level archbishops.
Under normal conditions, as the ‘main character’, he would have continued to grapple with the Giant God Sect, growing gradually, and eventually even becoming the main force to overthrow and destroy the Giant God Sect.
But who knew Jack Clark would suddenly appear and directly destroy the entire Divine Realm.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Giant God Grayson was not present, Jack Clark might even have taken the opportunity to kill this Evil God as well, so now he needed to find another battlefield that could provide him with pressure for progression.
Such as, the frontline.
…
Demon God Sect.
As a Demon Domain concocted by the combined effort of Three Demon Kings, it spans over twenty thousand kilometers in every direction, with more than a dozen mountain ranges and hundreds of small and large rivers.
But at this moment, this area, once brimming with vitality, was enveloped in Black Demonic Qi like fog, the Earth ablaze, magma flowing, and all living things demonized as though it were Hell.
Within this vast region, innumerable demonized Unique Beasts made their homes, along with several million demonized different races corrupted by the demonic qi, living in the form of tribes scattered about.
In the mythical world of different races, adult ‘persons’ possess physical prowess equivalent to that of Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivators as a starting point.
And as for the weaker species among these races, they had long been eliminated by nature, such as being devoured by nearby Giant Beasts as food or by sudden Catastrophes that sweep across thousands of miles.
Compared to the Evil God Sect established by human traitors, the Three Demon Kings had continued to erode the Heaven and Earth since establishing the Demon God Sect, building armies and expanding their forces.
Now, outside the three castles of the Demon Kings in the center of the Demon Domain, a million demonized elite alien soldiers stood tall on the plain.
These demonized alien races, led by Purgatory True Demons with the strength of Nine Demonic Marks, with strong men of eight marks as the commanders of ten thousand, formed ten armies of a hundred thousand each.
In the midst of these armies was a demon banner that stood a kilometer tall, with special patterns drawn on it, or rather, those weren’t just patterns, but powerful forbidden weapons that were sealed.
At this moment, under the command of these formidable demon banners, the demonic qi emitted from the hundred thousand demonized alien soldiers merged, forming a vast sea of demonic qi and ten terrifying Demon Arrays with terrifying power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1070 - 1070 437 Dominating the Era Blasting the Main
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1070: Chapter 437: Dominating the Era, Blasting the Main God_2 Chapter 1070: Chapter 437: Dominating the Era, Blasting the Main God_2 And between the ten Demon Arrays, Three Demon Kings revealed their True Bodies, transforming into 300-meter-tall forms with three heads and six arms. The surrounding black demon air rolled and obscured the sky, forming a Dark Demon Cloud that enveloped the Earth.
Just like Brut, the Three Demon Kings had also received the news that Jack Clark had broken into the Divine Gods Alliance and had slain the Shadow God and the Eternal God in a short period of time.
The ‘person’ who reported in secret said that the strength Jack Clark displayed surpassed the Mythical Limit and was comparable to an early existence of a Main God, extremely terrifying.
Standing atop the castle, the Demon King Gormos, with dark red flames burning behind him forming a crown, said with an icy voice, “To possess the strength of an early Great Demon King right after breaking through Mythical realm, he truly is the genius whom Emperor Diorus himself ordered to be executed.”
“But the Human Federation’s belief that Darren Callum has us completely under control is rather premature. We are not as worthless as those other fellows.”
As a long-standing and powerful civilization, the demon kings of The Purgatory Family are far stronger than the Evil Gods like Akunus, who are being hunted down by the Human Race.
Take for example Ansem, the strongest among the Three Demons, with its peak demon king realm mastery and the Higher-order Law Hell’s Spear, dominating the Demon Domain and standing firm even against the average Great Demon King.
Besides, it and another demon king, Langmere, were at the late period of demon king cultivation, controlling one middle-order law and two lower laws.
The three laws, combined under the governance of the inherited demon codex, could unleash power not inferior to the Higher-order Law.
Furthermore, with the amplification of the Demon Domain and working together, they could withstand a clash with a regular Great Demon King. Under the lead of Ansem, even the extraordinary might of that Human Clan Genius could be worn down to death.
After all, they were fighting on their home ground and were not afraid of consumption.
At this moment, the Three-headed Six-armed Demon King Ansem, with nine demon horns on each head, shook its head, “We must not be careless, that Darren Callum had reached the peaks of Myth even before breaking through it, his strength is against the heavens.”
“Such a monster cannot be judged by normal standards. After his breakthrough, his strength has become even more terrifying, and he also controls a Secret Skill of Summoning giant beasts with Titan Level strength.”
At this point, Ansem paused for a moment, then a cold light flashed in his eyes, “When the time comes, we will sacrifice all the lives in the Demon Domain directly, opening the Abyssal Corridor to cut off Heaven and Earth and suppress his Summoning Secret Skill.”
“Besides that, don’t hold back, and burn your origins directly to unleash strength and clash with Darren Callum, even if we cannot suppress him, we must land him a heavy injury and damage his foundation.”
“As long as we can damage Jack Clark’s foundation, it will be considered a great achievement, and even if our Rule True Bodies fall apart, we can still use the intrinsic artifacts of the Kordosta Clan to transfer our Demon Souls back.”
“His Majesty has already promised me that he will expend resources to help us reconstruct our demon king bodies, and even grant us resources that allow for further progress.”
Immediately, the eyes of the Three Demon Kings blazed with fervor, while their gaze towards the million Demonized Alien Race below was cold and emotionless.
Contrary to the Human Race that had only risen for a few decades, The Purgatory Family possessed countless Secret Skills, demonic codices, other civilizations’ power systems, inheritances, and forbidden weapons.
This was also why they liked to demonize and enslave different races as subordinates; they could act as cannon fodder in normal times and as sacrificial fuel when facing strong enemies.
Upon learning of Jack Clark’s imminent arrival, they had already contacted the rear of The Purgatory Family and transferred over more than a dozen Civilization Forbidden Weapons as the foundation of the Demon Arrays.
These inherited weapons from various civilizations each had amazing power and were usually kept as the intrinsic heritage of The Purgatory Family.
Those inheritances, powerful as they were, would be scrapped after being forcefully activated with demonic energy, and using one meant losing one.
After the simple conversation, the Three Demon Kings fell silent, waiting coldly for the coming great battle.
In fact, the Three Demon Kings were well aware that they had been abandoned, including the Demon God Sect and other arrangements that had been made for decades.
Under normal conditions, Jack Clark, the Human monster, penetrating deep into the alliance of deities, would present an excellent chance to ambush him, yet no peak Great Demon King strongmen had descended from the rear.
Therefore, they could only fight with their backs against the wall, suppressing Jack Clark or grievously wounding him before their Divine Souls departed, with no second option.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Dark Demon Cloud above the Firmament trembled, and a mighty pressure descended from the sky.
A thousand-kilometer long golden light tore through the demon cloud, and orbs of golden flames, each a hundred meters in diameter and radiating intense heat and the power of destruction, came crashing down from the sky.
“Be careful!”
Watching the golden fireballs falling from the sky, demonic airs burst forth from dozens among the ten Alien Corps, drawing in the demon air to unleash the corps’ attack.
Roar! Roar! Roar!!
With the surging of the oceanic Dark Demon Air, black Dark Demon Dragons, each a thousand meters long, soared into the sky, roaring as they pounced at the golden fireballs.
Boom!!
The instant hundreds of golden fireballs came into contact with the Dark Demon Dragons, they exploded violently, releasing dazzling light and endless golden flames, annihilating everything around them.
The scorching blast from the explosions shook Heaven and Earth, lighting up half of the sky, and the demon air above the nearest two corps’ Demon Arrays also trembled incessantly.
Boom! Boom! And then, amidst the Firmament, lightning flashed, and hundreds of blue thunders, each several meters thick and winding for ten thousand meters, struck down from the sky, the Earth trembling in an instant.
The bombardment of hundreds of Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunders caused the demon air below to churn violently, and over ten thousand Senior-strength Alien soldiers instantly turned to ash, leaving behind dozens of cratered empty plots.

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - 1071 437 Dominating the Era Blasting the Main
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1071: Chapter 437: Dominating the Era, Blasting the Main God_3 Chapter 1071: Chapter 437: Dominating the Era, Blasting the Main God_3 Amid the resplendent thunder radiance, Jack Clark, clad in a black and red luxurious battle armor and wielding the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, slowly emerged from the torn rifts in the Demon Cloud.
Golden flames formed steps beneath his feet as he descended step by step, his immense and overbearing aura filling Heaven and Earth, so much that it weighed down upon the millions of soldiers from different races below.
Gazing at the formidable Jack Clark, Ansem, whose body was covered in dark golden scales, looked on with an icy stare, “Human, I never expected you to bring yourself to our doorstep.”
“Since you’ve come, you might as well stay.”
Without further ado, at the moment Ansem’s voice faded, the entire scene began to tremble.
Among the mountain ranges that stretched for thousands of kilometers, within the Scorching Magma Rivers that meandered through the entire Demon Domain, Demon Pillars thousands of meters tall rose up.
As the Earth crumbled around the Demon Pillars, countless jets of scorching magma erupted from cracks, swallowing numerous Unique Beasts and tribes from different races in its path, as demonic aura shot into the sky.
With the Demon Domain that spanned over twenty thousand kilometers serving as the array, and the Demon Pillars as its foundation, supplemented by the sacrifice of over two million soldiers from different races and countless demonized Unique Beasts, the instant turned the complexion of Heaven and Earth.
Endless streams of blood light soared into the sky, turning into dark red tentacles reaching up into the depths of the Firmament, slowly pulling down a twisted, bloody world.
Boom! Boom! Boom! As the inexhaustible power of the Abyss descended, the whole world trembled, submerged by the black and red power hanging from the sky.
And all this happened in an instant, Jack Clark only felt the scene around him change, the space flipped, forming a ‘world’ akin to a corridor.
In this world, the sky was only ten kilometers high, filled with a terrifying heavy pressure, the closer one was to the sky, the greater the gravity.
Even Jack Clark thundered down from the sky under the strong gravity, instantly shattering the Earth within hundreds of meters, creating a ring-shaped shockwave that swept for several kilometers.
Not just Jack Clark, the Three Demon Kings, who manifested their True Bodies in the distance, too fell to the ground under this terrible pressure, and at that moment, all ‘People’ could no longer fly.
Besides, the power of Heaven and Earth disappeared, leaving only Abyss Demonic Aura similar to Void Energy, and under the dense Abyss Demonic Aura, all demonized races saw their aura surge violently.
Even as the demonic aura was so intense, it burned like black flames upon their bodies, consuming their flesh and blood, essence, and soul.
Meanwhile, with the sacrifice of demonized alien races in the Demon Domain, the aura of the Three Demon Kings surged, and they broke through the limit to enter the realm of the Great Demon King with a roar.
The True Bodies of the three-headed, six-armed Demon Kings expanded continuously, swelling to terrifying proportions of a kilometer, each movement causing tremors like mountains and seas shaking, their imposing aura frightening.
As the Three Demon Kings grew in strength due to the arrival of the Abyss, Jack Clark found himself under severe suppression.
In this environment deprived of the Power of Heaven and Earth, he could not leverage the Law to harness the Power of Heaven and Earth to burst forth with dozens to hundreds of times amplification, and each expenditure of Law Divine Power could not be replenished.
This was the confidence of Ansem and his Three Demon Kings: with this loss and gain, they did not believe they could not defeat Jack Clark.
“Attack.”
Boom! At Ansem’s command, ten corps of the demonized alien army erupted with demonic gas, and countless Dark Demon Air converged on the flags of the Demon Array to form a massive vortex.
In the center of the vortex, on the banners that appeared like the leg bones of a Giant Beast, a fragmented slash blade, a broken bronze mirror, and other forbidden weapons emerged, shining brilliantly, emitting strong energy fluctuations and firing out.
The force of these weapons, powered by the demonic gas of an entire army, was terrifying. For instance, the fragmented slash blade cut the space itself in half, releasing a terrifyingly sharp aura.
Or the black Giant Beast leg bone, which, upon appearing above Jack Clark’s head, caused a terrifying gravitational Law Power to Burst, forcing him to feel his form sink.
Boom! The Earth caved in within a kilometer radius around Jack Clark, forming a massive hole a hundred meters deep shaped like a Giant Beast’s footprint.
This type of Demon Array that harnessed the energy of an army was one of the intrinsic strengths of the Purgatory True Demon Race, similar to the high-tech of the Human Race, invincible on the frontal battlefield.
If it weren’t for human technology and Unmanned Mechs supporting logistics, the Federation simply couldn’t compete with the two Purgatory Empires in terms of logistical consumption.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Jack Clark was instantly engulfed by the powerful attacks of various corps, each strike reaching the mid period of a demon king’s power, and even stronger due to the special force of the forbidden weapons.
For a moment, the world shook, and everything within several kilometers was blasted apart, the Earth exploded, and space was squeezed to burst, forming shockwaves.
But when the trembling of the explosion subsided, there was Jack Clark, unscathed and indifferent, standing above the crater with a diameter of three kilometers.
Around him, rings of golden rhombus haloes flickered, exuding an aura of immovability and indestructibility.
Such a terrifying Defense made the Three Demon Kings, who wanted to first wear him down with their underlings, narrow their eyes; their nine heads glanced at each other, knowing their plan of exhaustion had failed.
“Kill!” The three towering Demon Kings thundered into action,
[Whew! The name of the giant god Grayson was written wrong yesterday; it’s not Gaya, it has been corrected]

chapters.title: Chapter 1072 - 1072 439 Hell Messenger Soon to Return to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1072: Chapter 439: Hell Messenger, Soon to Return to Blue Star Chapter 1072: Chapter 439: Hell Messenger, Soon to Return to Blue Star Since Jack Clark entered the Demon God Sect’s Demon Domain, only a little over ten minutes passed before the collapse of the domain, with most of the time spent eradicating the True Bodies of the Three Demon Kings.
Even so, the speed at which the Three Demon Kings fell shocked the alien deities who had been watching the whole time.
Because they died too quickly.
The weakest of the Three Demon Kings of the Demon God Sect were all in the late period of the Legendary Realm and due to possessing powerful ancient Inheritances, each was considered among the stronger in their own level.
Strong men of such a level, even when facing the early Myth contenders, could hold on for a while, to say nothing of the three of them together.
Add to that the amplifications of standing firm in the Demon Domain and the suppression of their Boundary, and the fact that they were defeated so swiftly made one wonder, just how strong was this human king? Or perhaps…
At this thought, a shocking idea emerged in the minds of all alien deities present.
Supreme Law!
Every powerhouse who had reached the Legendary Realm had been forged through countless battles and was rich in combat experience. Thus, when everyone’s realms were similar, the difference in strength lay in the True Body and Law.
And for cultivators who followed the path of Law, even the strongest True Body couldn’t be as powerful as a Giant Beast. Thus, the greater disparity lay between the Laws.
In addition, the Power of Intent could influence combat strength, such as Sword Intent and Blade Intent, which the Human Race was particularly adept at.
The Purgatory Family followed the path of racial bloodline inheritance, while the alien deities took the path of Divine Realm Laws; the inheritances of their respective powers varied greatly.
When he previously cut down the Shadow God and the Eternal God, Jack Clark had displayed Higher-order Laws of Thunder and flames, and also powers related to the Void.
But even three Higher-order Laws could not account for how powerful he became in the early Myth stage, at most making him invincible within the Legendary Realm.
Therefore, it could only be the Supreme Law.
As a supreme power talked about in legends, one that even the Purgatory Family rarely saw, a single Supreme Law was comparable to the combined might of three fused Higher-order Laws.
It was a terrifying power capable of breaking the limits of bounds.
And because the central area of the Demon Domain was covered by the Abyssal Corridor, neither the alien deities nor the covert Main God Kata could see the specific process of the battle.
But at that moment, with a serendipitous guess, these alien deities all speculated that Jack Clark must possess a Supreme Law.
No wonder he, being in the initial stages of the Myth, dared to kill his way into the Divine Gods Alliance alone.
Just after his breakthrough into the Legendary Realm, he had already mastered one Supreme Law and displayed the power of three Higher-order Laws—such a terrifying talent for this human was simply startling!
While countless alien deities were shaken and perplexed by Jack Clark’s talent, strange changes were also starting to appear in the Demon Domain below.
With the fall of the three rounds of the Blood Moon, the ‘world’ of the Abyssal Corridor that had arrived as the sacrifice of the Three Demon Kings began to dissipate as well, turning into a thick dark red that vanished into the Void.
But at that moment, the Sea of Blood surrounding Jack Clark suddenly roared, and an extremely terrifying Will descended.
Boom!
The Sea of Blood erupted like a real sea, a sky-high tsunami submerging the entirety of Heaven and Earth, as if a true Sea of Blood Hell had descended.
In an endless sea of blood-colored world, a figure towering ten thousand kilometers high, wearing a robe of blood, appeared slowly, its features indistinct yet filled with oppressiveness.
Even though it was just a sliver of Will arriving, the invisible coercion shook Jack Clark’s spirit and mind.
The planetary-scale projection slightly lowered its head, its blood-red eyes like the Blood Moon hanging in the sky, emanating circles of red halos and an indescribable majesty.
The sudden change made Jack Clark’s expression solemn.
However, though the Void-Striking Heart’s Eye at his brow twitched slightly, it didn’t sense any malice from the colossal projection. Thus, Jack Clark slowly suppressed the shock in his heart.
Looking down at the diminutive Jack Clark below, the towering figure spoke slowly, its terrifying Will vibrating the entire world, “I am one of the Wills of the Supreme Hell Plane, the Lord of Hell, Alvaron.”
The Lord of the Supreme Hell! Jack Clark paused, then replied slowly, “Hello, what brings the esteemed Lord of Alvaron coming to me?”
As he spoke, a mountainous black Emperor Seal faintly emerged behind him.
With his breakthrough to the unified Mythical Divine Soul, the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal also upgraded to be comparable to a Law-level weapon, specifically an artifact for soul-based attacks.
At that moment, should Jack Clark activate the Emperor Seal, the facade of the Demon God, condensed from the Sea of Blood Hell, could shake away the connection with this fearsome entity.
The Hell Will named Alvaron opened its mouth slowly, the sound thunderous, “Because you have drawn upon the Power of Hell to defeat the Abyss, you have earned the qualification to become a Hell Envoy.”
“Hell Envoy! What is that?” Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Alvaron spoke slowly again, “The Hell Plane encompasses endless Space-Time, countless Planes, and universes, in every civilization and world there lies a legend of Hell.”
“And the qualification of a Hell Envoy is to be recognized by the Supreme Hell’s Will, each an exceptionally talented and powerful being with interboundary combat strength.”
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly again, “Could Lord Alvaron please tell me, what are the benefits of becoming a Hell Envoy, and what responsibilities must be borne?”
There is no such thing as a free lunch in this world; every gift of Destiny comes with a hidden price tag.
The towering figure spoke slowly, “As a Hell Messenger, you will gain the authority to oversee a piece of Hell and can summon even more powerful Hell forces.”
“And when you encounter agents of other Supreme Planes, or enemies that summon the power of a Supreme Plane, you can draw upon Hell to descend and Devour them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1073 - 1073 439 Hell Messenger About to Return to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1073: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_2 Chapter 1073: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_2 “For each Supreme Plane’s power that you devour, you will receive an equivalent gift. Hell’s gift can be converted into Power of World Origin to enhance your strength.”
“Furthermore, by signing a contract, you will permanently obtain coordinates to a location within the Hell Plane and Apostle Authority.”
Added strength from the Power of Hell, plane coordinates, authority, and transforming the absorbed power of a Supreme Plane into World Origin.
Jack Clark pondered for a moment.
The Power of Hell within him originated from the Prison Blood War Intent congealed from countless slaughters and the Limit Enhancement of the perfected Eight Desolate Purgatory Halberd Skill, forming the domain of Blood Sea Doomsday runes.
The will materialized in grand accomplishment combined with the domain that had absorbed the blood fiend of numerous Unique Beasts to condense a Demon God Illusion, drawing upon the Power of Hell.
This power’s greatest use was to amplify the Blood Sea Field. To the present Jack, this boost was only equivalent to an ordinary rule enhancement—it wasn’t very strong.
Of course, this not ‘very strong’ was in comparison with several Higher-order Laws and three Great Divine Powers.
If he signed the contract and the Power of Hell increased, the minimum boost he should receive would be the strength of a mid-level law, give or take.
However, what truly concerned Jack was the Power of World Origin obtained after devouring a Supreme Plane’s power.
For cultivators, even after a breakthrough, the Power of World Origin from the mythical world remains crucial.
For example, after comprehending new mysteries of Heaven and Earth, one could rapidly transform and metamorphize into laws. Besides, the World Origin is also the core of improving the strength of a Heavenly King.
When a law breaks through to grand accomplishment and unites with the True Body and soul to incarnate into a rule, amassing a Laws World thereafter, copious World Origin can swiftly magnify the Laws World.
Eventually, the abstract becomes concrete, spawning rules, and stepping into Supreme.
Jack has already completed the unification of his Divine Soul and True Body, and having successfully opened a Real World, he is already fostering a Supreme Law.
If he had adequate World Origin, not only could he rapidly complete the Transformation of the Soul Law, but he could also hasten the growth of his Plane World and swiftly strengthen the Law of Strength.
However, under normal conditions, the process of refining World Origin through the inhalation and exhalation of Heavenly Energy is slow, frustratingly slow.
As Jack looked ahead at the towering figure that seemed to stand before him but was infinitely far across space-time, he became somewhat moved and asked politely.
“May I inquire, Lord of Alvaron, what use is that so-called permanent coordinate and Apostle Authority?”
In response to Jack’s question, a voice that shook the world began to sound slowly, “That permanent Hell Plane coordinate is essentially your position in the endless space-time.”
“Should a day come in the future when you fall into a place you cannot escape, or into another space-time, another world, you can rely on these coordinates to enter the Hell Plane and break free.”
“Using the coordinates you have marked in the Hell Plane, you can leap back to another set of coordinates left in your current world.”
“There will be restrictions when leaping through Hell Coordinates; the energy spent is minimal in the same world space-time, but if you cross a Great Era from a different world, the consumption will be enormous.”
“As for the Apostle Authority, it denotes your contribution to the Supreme Hell Plane; the more power of other Supreme Planes you devour, the greater your authority will be.”
“When your authority reaches a certain level, it will form a Position Pattern, allowing you to summon Hell to devour a world, pulling it into Hell, and even eventually becoming a Lord of Hell like me.”
After Alvaron finished speaking, Jack couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
That so-called Hell Coordinate could actually ignore the distance of space-time and the world for leaping. This was very important.
Due to the erosion of time power, Jack had attracted the scrutiny of Time Beings and wanted to capture one for the Destruction Emperor Dragon as food.
But while plotting against this being, Jack also had some concerns.
What if, for example, he was pulled by that Time Being into another timeline, unable to contend, and unable to summon the Destruction Emperor Dragon due to space-time interference—what then?
He could end up wandering other space-times, appearing hundreds or thousands of years in the past or future, or even lost forever, unable to return.
But with the Hell Coordinate, even if unable to summon the Destruction Emperor Dragon, unable to return on his own, he could still leap back to the current time-space through the coordinate.
Could it really be that simple?
After a moment of silence, Jack finally said, “May I ask the great Lord of Alvaron, how do I sign the contract and become a Hell Messenger?”
Sensing Jack’s interest, the voice of that towering existence resounded again.
“It’s simple. You just need to imprint a strand of your Soul Source into this Hell Rune Contract.”
As he spoke, blood light converged between heaven and earth, and an aura of Supreme Hell merged, forming a 0.5 meter-size complex rune that looked like an eye, yet not, before Jack.
The moment the rune took shape, the Demon-God Facade to Jack’s left began to resonate intensely, emitting a strong impulse to devour and assimilate the rune.
Suppressing the impulse coming from the depths of his soul, Jack exhaled and slowly placed his hand on the rune. Instantly, the rune emitted a dazzling red radiance.
Sensing the formidable suction from the rune, Jack did not immediately mobilize his soul aura.
Indeed, at that moment, a row of transparent text appeared before Jack, just like the scene when he first touched the True Martial Stone Tablet at the South Sky Martial Arts School.
“Identified impending capture of Soul Source Aura by Supreme Law Power. Presently, you can opt to expend 60,000 Points Attribute to simulate the Soul Source as a substitute. Would you like to simulate?”
As opposed to the mere 20 attribute points required to simulate the soul breath before, this time the requirement to fool the demands of Supreme Hell Plane had increased three thousandfold.

chapters.title: Chapter 1074 - 1074 439 Hell Messenger About to Return to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1074: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_3 Chapter 1074: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_3 However, Jack Clark didn’t hesitate and directly chose to confirm.
The soul source was not mere soul breath; it involved the power at the core of his being. If the attribute page couldn’t simulate and transform it, Jack Clark would have given up on the spot.
Even though the function of Hell’s Coordinate, whether enhanced with the power of Hell or after devouring and transforming the power of the Supreme Plane into the World Origin, was very enticing.
Yet, in terms of importance, it still couldn’t compare with a strand of the soul source.
As Jack Clark confirmed, his attribute points on the attribute page dropped instantly from 85810 to 25810. At the same time, a powerful soul fluctuation burst forth from within him.
Boom!
An immense and majestic soul aura shook the Void, forming a towering Monarch’s phantom hundreds of meters tall behind him. The intangible, diffusing fluctuations even surprised Alvaron.
Under the cover of the full-strength burst of soul aura, a power embodying his soul breath, will, and seemingly indistinguishable from the true soul source emerged within Jack Clark.
Hum! As the soul source merged, the blood-red runes emitted dazzling blood light, exploding thunderously and turning into a sky-full of blood light that merged into the left side of the Demon-God Facade.
These blood lights turned into a red eye at the center of the Demon-God’s brow, filled with endless blood light, majesty, and an ice-cold presence, like the real Lord of Hell.
Through Hell’s Eye in the brow of the Demon-God Facade, Jack Clark vaguely sensed the existence of an incredibly terrifying plane.
But before he could explore further, suddenly, an aura of the Heavenly Dao from the mythical world descended, its oppressive might far exceeding ten thousand times what he experienced during his breakthrough.
Boom! The entire red world shook violently, including Alvaron’s projection, large as a planet, which also shattered under that oppressive force.
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark reappeared in the Demon Domain.
By this time, the corridor formed by Abyssal Power had vanished, revealing the torn earth and the figure of Jack Clark standing on it, three-faced and six-armed, his head crowned with dragon horns amidst endless blood light.
After consecutively slaying deities of the Evil God Sect, demon kings, destroying three Divine Realms and a Demon Domain, and slaughtering countless beings of different races, the aura that now converged around Jack Clark was terrifying.
That invisible Killing Intent rose into the sky, almost tinting the Firmament red as the Dark Demon Cloud dissipated, shaking Heaven and Earth.
Jack Clark lifted his head slightly, his gaze ice cold as he looked up at Kata, the Main God standing above the Firmament, and slowly said, “I have said before, whoever dares to block my path of vengeance should bear the consequences.”
“It seems you wish to test that.”
Sensing the challenge in Jack Clark’s eyes, Kata, the Main God with golden tiger stripes on his face, grew cold, “Human, haven’t the strong men of the Federation taught you to maintain reverance in the presence of a Main God-level existence?”
“An early myth king dares to speak to me in such a manner. If not for considering the face of the Human Alliance, I would have crushed your true body with one palm long ago.”
As soon as Kata, the Main God, finished speaking, a cold smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face, “No, you don’t need to consider the Federation’s face. My deep entry into the alliance is a matter of personal grievance.”
“Come on, let me see how strong a Main God’s power is. I’m very curious how many halberd strikes you can take.”
In front of this Main God-level strong man with close ties to The Purgatory Family, Jack Clark was not the slightest bit courteous and even wanted to anger the other party to take action, to directly crush its true body.
He was merely an equivalent to a Grand Demon King-level Main God, after all, and Jack Clark had killed one before.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had torn apart an Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven Giant Beast during its mid-stage, and he had also just slain three demon kings with equivalent early-stage ‘Grand Demon King’ fighting strength.
Although their true realms were in the late period and peak of demon king, together they counted for the head of an early-stage Grand Demon King.
If the other party dared to make a move, he could just use this alien Main God to test the might of the Law of Strength now reigning supreme over the integration of the four Higher-order Laws.
Breaking through to the Legendary Realm and crushing a Main God right after his breakthrough was an achievement that would make its way into human cultivation history, inspiring cultivators for ten thousand years to come.
Unfortunately, it seemed Kata, the Main God, did not wish to give Jack Clark such everlasting fame.
Sensing the increasingly heavy Killing Intent from Jack Clark, Kata, the Main God, took a long look at him, snorted coldly, and his true body over two thousand meters tall vanished amid Space Distortion.
With the fall of the Three Demon Kings of the Demon God Sect and the collapse of the Demon Domain, it was pointless for him to take further action.
As Kata, the Main God, left, the tense atmosphere that filled the space between heaven and earth eased instantly, and the wills of those alien deities who were observing from outside the rules also sighed with relief.
The Main God with a human head and serpent body, the Phantom Serpent Main God, looked at Jack Clark with a faint smile, “You truly are the pride of the Human Race, sweeping all directions with the power of one, and suppressing an entire Demon God Alliance.”
A smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face, “You flatter me, Christ Throne. It wasn’t quite a sweep through all directions. I merely took advantage of my breakthrough to settle a past revenge.”
The massive Phantom Serpent Main God tilted its head down, curious, “King Clark, if I may ask, what grievance do they hold against you?”
It wasn’t just the Phantom Serpent Main God; the other alien deities watching were also curious. They always assumed Jack Clark’s personal grievances were just an excuse to kill his way into the Divine Gods Alliance.
But from his tone, it seemed there was true grievance, or else he wouldn’t be so persistent about revenge.
“It’s not something I can’t talk about. About five Sun Wheels ago, the cultists from the Demon God Sect and three other Evil God Sects invaded our Human Race’s Blue Star World.”
“Back then, I was at the Initial Stage of Fifth Layer Heaven, cultivating in a secret realm. When the Sixth Layer Heaven cultists launched their sudden attack, I was nearly injured.”
“After a bloody battle, I killed all the invading cultists I encountered, but my other classmates were not as fortunate. More than ten seniors died at the hands of those cultists.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1075 - 1075 439 Hell Messenger About to Return to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1075: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_4 Chapter 1075: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_4 At this point, Jack Clark’s face turned icy cold, “I swore at that time, once I achieved the breakthrough to king-level, I would certainly exterminate all the disciples of the Evil God Sect including the Evil God himself, to avenge those senior students.”
Seeing the murderous aura surrounding Jack, the Phantom Serpent Main God and others with the symbol ‘Person’ in their eyes revealed a realization, so that’s it… what a load of nonsense.
All the alien deities showed expressions of shock and wariness on their faces.
What shocked them was that Jack Clark was only at the Fifth Layer Heaven before the five Sun Wheels, which was the equivalent to the realm of a Fifth Tier soldier in the Divine Gods Alliance.
And in just five days (five Sun Wheels), this monster had broken through to the Legendary Realm, a horrifying cultivation talent that struck fear into others.
As for the wariness, it was naturally due to his vindictive nature.
It was only because, during his ‘weaker’ times, he had a conflict with a Senior Cultist, he went all the way to their lair, not only destroying the Divine Realm but even slaying the deities along with it.
This human should not be provoked.
At this moment, all the alien deities unanimously decided to avoid crossing paths with him, including the Phantom Serpent Main God who seemed to have left but still had a will lingering in the network of rules.
At this time, it was extremely relieved it hadn’t taken action to teach this human a lesson, or else not to mention if it could overpower him, the most terrifying aspect would be the need to always prepare for him growing stronger and coming after them.
With the terrifying rate of this human’s cultivation and his heaven-defying combat strength, it might not be long before he reached Main God-level, and then…!
“So that’s how it is.” At this time, the Phantom Serpent Main God suddenly nodded in understanding, then his face showed an even warmer smile.
“King Clark, I have some matters to attend to and must take my leave now. When you have time, you are welcome to visit the Phantom Sea Divine Domain.”
Jack Clark nodded politely, “Goodbye, Christ Throne.”
His attitude was more courteous towards this Main God who was friendly with the human race because Jack’s character had always been that if someone respected him by an inch, he would respect them by a yard, with clear delineation between gratitude and grudges.
As the Phantom Serpent Main God departed, the other alien deities also withdrew their wills.
Only when Jack sensed that their gazes had disappeared did he retract his power, causing his three hundred meter-tall True Body to shrink continuously, while the oppressive might shaking Heaven and Earth slowly vanished.
When he returned to his normal size, the aura on Jack’s body weakened.
Entering the Demon God Emperor Dragon Form, he had unleashed his peak strength to forcibly grind away three temporary Demon King’s True Forms on par with the early stages of a Great Demon King.
Combined with rushing over two hundred thousand kilometers and unleashing his Law Divine Power to destroy the domains of the Three Great Evil Gods, even Jack had experienced a significant expenditure of energy.
Of course, this expenditure was of Law Divine Strength and the origin of Laws, while his physical strength had just started warming up.
After resting briefly, Jack got busy.
Following the end of the great battle, it was naturally time to reap the rewards. Over the years, the Demon God Sect had scoured quite a few good things in this place, such as the resources contained within the surrounding forbidden areas.
All of these things were in the hands of the Three Demon Kings.
However, because the previous battle was too intense, Jack spent some time locating their Space Equipment in a crack within a space interlayer, the Magma Fire Sea, and a rift going down tens of thousands of meters into the Earth.
A fist-sized, black bag laced with many dark red lines, a basin-sized beast bone necklace, and a ring that could be worn around the neck.
After cleaning up the battlefield, Jack’s wrist shone with radiance, revealing a black and red menacing fighter aircraft, his exclusive ride, Cloud Sky One.
Boom! The fighter aircraft soared into the sky, shattering the air, and in the blink of an eye, it turned into a speck disappearing towards the direction of the 30th Army Group’s base.
Inside the fighter aircraft’s cockpit, Jack sat in his chair recovering from his recent exertion, and simultaneously began to remove the Spiritual Will from the collected Space Equipment and took inventory.
Once all five pieces of Space Equipment had been checked, Jack’s face couldn’t help but reveal a radiant smile.
As the collections of the five weakest beings who were all at the late stages of Legendary Realm strength, although most of the God-level resources that were useful to them had been used up, there were still many that left Jack surprised.
Mountains of Top-tier resources, minerals, a large quantity of ordinary God-level resources, High-Level Divine Resources, as well as some special weapons, such as those from the weaponry of the Demon God Sect’s alien civilization.
Just with a rough estimate, Jack calculated the total value of these resources to be over five million merits, and that was without counting the accomplishment of destroying the Evil God Alliance.
The most valuable among them was an alien civilization weapon seized from the hands of Demon King Ansem.
This weapon resembled the True Martial Divine Stele that the True Martial Heavenly King had, a kind of Intrinsic Weapon of a civilization’s race, but much weaker and not to be used recklessly.
Jack then began to carefully categorize those resources, planning to keep some useful ones and give most of the rest to the Federation at no cost.
Since the beginning of his cultivation, the Federation had supported him with a great deal of resources. Although it was related to the talent he had shown, he believed one should not be ungrateful.
Now that he had stepped into king-level, it was time for him to give back.
Besides that, it was already September 13th, more than two months since he had entered the mythical world, and so Jack planned to make a return visit.
Of course, he wasn’t going back to show off.
The Freshman’s inauguration ceremony last year was on September 4th, which was the second day of the next semester, therefore the time he had agreed upon with Justin Welan and the others had long passed.
His return was primarily to check on Doris Clark and Glenn Clark, as well as to deliver some resources to acquaintances, like General Tyler Lance, the military commander of the Southern Battlefield.
When Jack had advanced to the Late-Stage Fifth Layer Heaven, he participated in the mission to surround and kill the Evil God Soul Split, for which the reward was a Top-tier Secret Manual, but Tyler had instead given him two.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1076: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_5 Chapter 1076: Chapter 439 Hell Messenger, About to Return to Blue Star_5 “`
The extra part was Tyler Lance’s own merit exchange, to assist Jack Clark in creating his Self-created Secret Manual, a favor that Jack had always remembered.
There was also Lori Parma, a teacher with whom he had little contact but who had helped him a bit, and Sylvia Lyons, whom he had looked after; Jack remembered each of these individuals.
He had also prepared gifts for his good brother Justin Welan and classmates like Crystal Lewis.
For Jack Clark at that time, those top-tier resources from the spoils were useless for ordinary God-level resources but precious to advanced cultivators like Justin Welan.
Especially Justin Welan, who had given Jack a very “expensive” Blue Crystal back when he was in the Second Layer Heaven.
Although later, due to the Life Crystal, Jack’s progression was too rapid, and he didn’t heavily rely on the Blue Crystal, he definitely hadn’t forgotten this favor.
There was also Glenn Clark, who, with his awakening of the Innate Overlord Body talent, had a huge demand for energy—ordinary Alien Beast Meat alone couldn’t maximize his physical potential.
Beyond that, this guy would need even more resources for his cultivation in the future; there was no helping it, his foundation was too solid, so it was necessary to prepare early.
Although after he enrolled in school, the official resources would definitely favor him, Jack definitely wanted to lay an even more terrifying foundation for him in advance.
When the time came and this guy began his cultivation, he might break many records, such as establishing Foundation Establishment in one day, entering Triplex immediately, reaching Fourth Layer in a month…
Besides that, Doris Clark’s body also needed some conditioning. Although ordinary people couldn’t cultivate, the Federation had a top-tier resource that could forcibly enable Foundation Establishment.
Later, he would try exchanging for some mild God-level energetic resources to strengthen Doris Clark’s physique to the point where it could compare to a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator.
Even without Cultivating True Martial Arts then, her strong physique would still give her some self-protection.
But the most important thing was the imminent Second Mythical Impact.
By that time, if the Human Alliance failed to defend and Blue Star’s time was Devoured by the mythical world, there would be no need to worry that she couldn’t endure the Heavenly Energy pouring into her body and die.
However, after handing over the useless resources to the Federation, Jack planned to continue exchanging for more Life Crystals with the merits he earned from the five demon kings and Evil God.
While breaking through to Mythical King Level meant he no longer needed to bolster his Cultivation Methods and talents, entering an epiphany state by burning attribute points was still very important for Jack.
In an epiphany state, he could perfect his rules a hundred times faster than usual, and by burning attribute points, he could quickly propel his rules to minor accomplishment, grand accomplishment, and step into the Heavenly King level.
Suddenly, Jack felt very busy.
Even though he had already broken through to become a revered Mythical King.
And just as Jack was flying towards the Outer Development Department, on Blue Star, in Mist River City.
In an elegantly decorated coffee shop, Justin Welan and Howard Lambert were sitting together by a floor-to-ceiling window, chatting with some pastries and drinks on the table in front of them.
Because it was Saturday, a day off, the Commercial Street outside was very bustling with couples holding hands and the rare leisure of office workers.
Looking at the busy scene outside, Justin Welan felt a bit emotional, “A year has passed in a blink of an eye, time flies so fast.”
Howard Lambert, a giant of a man sitting opposite, agreed and nodded, “Yeah, a year has gone by, you’ve broken through to the Sixth Layer, and I’ve already made it to the Eight Layer Heaven.”
Justin Welan rolled his eyes, “Howard Lambert, can you not bring up the Eight Layer Heaven? Since you came back, I’ve already heard it from you eight hundred times.”
Howard Lambert laughed, “I’ll pay attention next time, unless you guys ask me first, otherwise, I won’t say I made it to the Eight Layer Heaven in a year.”
… Damn, Justin Welan didn’t want to talk to this guy anymore.
Ever since this guy suddenly returned over a week ago, he’s been inviting him and familiar faces like Crystal Lewis out for tea every day, bragging about breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven whenever he could.
It seemed like he was afraid others wouldn’t know he had broken through to the Eight Layer Heaven.
So after coming and going a couple of times, Crystal and White Veil stopped showing up, mainly because they didn’t want to see Howard Lambert showing off and doing it so crudely.
Thinking of this, Justin Welan felt a mix of envy and irritation.
What’s the big deal about breaking through to the Eight Layer Heaven early because of some serendipitous opportunity? Give him some time, and he could break through too. There was nothing to be so proud of, and Jack was even stronger.
With that in mind, Justin Welan couldn’t help but ask, “Howard Lambert, didn’t you mention when you came back Jack was already at the Ninth Heaven Peak? When do you think he could break through to Mythical King Level?”
“I’m not sure about that question myself, since I don’t have the experience of breaking through to king-level.”
Then Howard Lambert hesitated, “But there’s a huge gap between king-level and transcendent. Even with Jack’s talent, I feel it might take a month or two.”
Justin Welan shook his head, “I don’t think it will take that long. With Jack’s rate of cultivation, at most half a month.”
Having said that, Justin Welan got a bit excited, “King-level, I, Justin Welan, actually have a friend who’s a king-level brother, that’s so awesome, haha… ”
“And my brother has also broken through to the Ninth Heavens. After the freshers’ opening ceremony the day after tomorrow, I’m going to apply to enter the mythical world. Then let’s see who dares to bully me.”
Because of the adjustment of the new edition of the Federation’s basic cultivation materials, the enrollment for Senior One was delayed by ten days, hence Justin Welan and the others had not yet entered the mythical world.
And seeing the delighted Justin Welan opposite, even Howard Lambert felt a tad envious of his good fortune.
Having a prodigious friend who became mythical in one year and an exceptionally talented brother who reached the Ninth Heavens before twenty, he would indeed be able to swagger around in the mythical world.
But this swagger was acceptable only within the Human Race’s stronghold; if he dared to go out…
Thinking about it, Howard Lambert couldn’t help feeling a bit schadenfreude, “Justin Welan, I think when you enter the mythical world, you’d better not mention that your brother is Jack, and your older brother is Joshua Welan.”
Justin Welan was taken aback and asked subconsciously, “… Why?”
“Because you’ll be targeted by the Assassination Department of the Purgatory Demon Clan, and they might even dispatch a Purgatory True Demon from the Nine Layers to kill you.”
Suddenly, the smile froze on Justin Welan’s face, almost having forgotten about that.
“`
