﻿Chapter 1077: Chapter 440 The Delegation Arrives, Titan’s Melting Giant Chapter 1077: Chapter 440 The Delegation Arrives, Titan’s Melting Giant In the No.1 Cloud Sky Fighter Jet that was flying at high speed through the sky, after completing the inventory of resources from several pieces of space equipment, Jack Clark stroked his chin and pondered slightly.
This time, sweeping through the Evil God Alliance, he had basically achieved his expected goals.
He eradicated the threats to the Human Race’s rear, obtained a large amount of resources and martial achievements, and familiarized himself with the power of the new realm he had reached after the breakthrough to king-level, allowing him to have a more precise positioning of his own strength.
With the four Higher-order Laws, comparable to the True Body of a Mythical Giant Beast compressed into human form and the passive amplification of the Supreme Law, he was invincible in the Legendary Realm even in his human form.
No matter if you are a strong man at the peak of the Legendary Realm or a monster genius with mastery over a Higher-order Law, profound rule mastery, and powerful innate divine talents, you would not be able to withstand a direct hit from his halberd.
When unleashing all his strength in his True Body form, he could instantly break through the shackles to step into the Heavenly King Realm; his Demon God Emperor Dragon Form could even obliterate a demon king with the early-stage power of a Great Demon King in a single blow.
Such a terrifying display of power seemed even stronger than many late-stage Heavenly Kings, after all, several Heavenly Kings and Great Demon Kings had fought for half a day on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield without a victor emerging.
But in reality, he was not that powerful, because those three ‘Great Demon Kings’ were augmented by external forces.
His attack and Power Explosion reached the early stage of Great Demon King, but his mastery of Rule Magic, secret techniques, and the Demon King’s True Form were still in the late and peak stages of the demon king realm.
Therefore, after being blown apart by Clark’s strike, the fragmented Demon King’s True Form was directly suppressed by the power of Higher-order Laws and could not coalesce, ultimately being ground away.
According to Clark’s estimation of himself, in the form of the Demon God Emperor Dragon, he was still in the early phase of the Heavenly King Realm, nearing the mid phase; only in the Opening the Heavens form could he rival the strength of an average mid-phase Heavenly King.
This ‘average’ refers to top-tier Heavenly Kings who do not possess Supreme Laws or more than two kinds of powerful Divine Powers and Higher-order Laws.
For instance, a monster like Clark, once he cultivates the Five Higher-order Laws, including the Soul Law, and a Supreme Law to grand accomplishment and breaks through to the Heavenly King, his battle strength will reach a terrifying extreme.
By then, he could even Reverse Defeat the Supreme while in the Heavenly King Realm.
After analyzing the gains and losses of this battle, Clark said thoughtfully, “It seems I need to find a way to enhance the power of the dragon’s bloodline.”
The strength of his True Demon God Body form was comparably early Heavenly King level, and the ultimate strength of the Demon God Emperor Dragon Form was still within the early Heavenly King level.
Although this is related to the greater gap between the small realms within the Heavenly King boundary, it was also linked to the insufficiency of the integrated Dragon Bloodline.
When he initially integrated the Essence Blood of the Giant Beast Avatar, the growth level of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon was only Level 9. The reason for the substantial boost before was because its life level belonged to the Monarch-tier.
But now, for the True Demon God Body that had reached the early Heavenly King level, the effects of augmentation had surpassed the limits and couldn’t briefly burst with tens of times amplification as before.
Therefore, he needs to ‘renew’ his bloodline.
Since he was not on the path of bloodline cultivation, the Dragon Bloodline that Clark obtained by integrating the avatar’s Essence Blood would not evolve autonomously as his strength improved.
Unless he switched to cultivating Genetic Martial Arts, following a path of unity between man and beast, dedicating all his energy to evolving and developing his own genetic powers.
But there was no need, the loss outweighed the gain.
For Clark, life evolution with the Destruction Emperor Dragon was enough; he just needed to ‘update’ his bloodline regularly, such as when the Destruction Emperor Dragon breaks through to the Titan Level.
By then, the strength of the Dragon Bloodline at the Heavenly Tier and Titan Level will surely make the Demon God Emperor Dragon Form truly terrifying.
Even Clark couldn’t help but look forward with anticipation to this, and then he asked, “Cloud Sky, how much longer until we reach the base of the 30th Army Group?”
From the cockpit ahead of Clark, the intelligent electronic voice of No.1 Cloud Sky responded, “Reporting to master, at the maximum fifteen-fold flight speed, it is estimated that we will arrive in thirteen hours.”
Clark nodded and then vanished in a flash to the Cultivation Area, to recover through cultivation while studying the Hell Coordinates through the Eye of the Demon God inside him.
And it was exactly when Clark was preparing to rush back to the base of the 30th Army Group before making a trip back to Blue Star.
Far away from the base of the Thirty-first Corps of the Outer Development Department, a golden spaceship, tens of kilometers long, resembling a floating island in the sky, appeared, moving and rolling up great white waves as it did so.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King and the emissaries of the Heavenly Feather Clan had arrived.
……
The sky collapsed, the earth shattered, and the laws of order faltered in a dark world where four fierce and enormous beasts were flying at the speed of sound ‘slowly’.
It had been three days since the Destruction Emperor Dragon and several Kamaitachi Beasts had delved deep into the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In three days, they had crossed over a hundred and ten thousand kilometers, passed through dozens of dangerous areas, hunted five Mythical Giant Beasts, and found a massive amount of Heaven and Earth Treasures.
The most valuable resource among them was a golden divine tree over ten meters tall, resembling a ginseng, which after being consumed directly caused the Destruction Emperor Dragon to grow more than twenty meters in size.
Along with the flesh and blood of several Mythical Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had now grown to over 1430 meters in length, becoming even more massive and formidable.
Aside from the most valuable Golden Divine Tree, the other God-level resources were shared by the Destruction Emperor Dragon with the Silver Giant Dragon and Three-headed Giant Beast.
Especially the spatial fragments discovered deep within the interlayers of Space Cracks, which hosted more than twenty Senior-level God-level Resources of Nine-Leaf Jade Mysterium Grass.
With these and other God-level resources of various properties, the Three-headed Giant Beast had grown substantially over the past few days.
The Silver Giant Dragon had grown to over six hundred meters, and the original Kamaitachi Beast, which was over 1100 meters long, had now entered the late Legendary Realm, reaching over 1200 meters.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - 1078 440 Delegation Arrives Titan Forge
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1078: Chapter 440 Delegation Arrives, Titan Forge Giant_2 Chapter 1078: Chapter 440 Delegation Arrives, Titan Forge Giant_2 As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, under a significant supplement of God-level resources, it underwent a Law Transformation with astonishing speed.
Especially the ancient Aura within its body, akin to the World Origin, made the transformation speed of the Single-horned Spawn Roc at the quasi-mythical level dozens of times faster than that of the Candle Dragon Giant Beast.
Of course, even with the abundant resources in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the fact that so many Heaven and Earth Treasures could be found in just a few days was mostly due to the efforts of the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
As for the other part of the merit, it belonged to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Many Heaven and Earth Treasures existed in dangerous areas; many places would even shred a Mythical Giant Beast that ventured in, only the invincible Destruction Emperor Dragon could charge through unimpeded.
Suddenly, floating a kilometer at ‘Low altitude’ above the head of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, its blue single-horn emitted dazzling light, forming circles of invisible light waves that dispersed into the surroundings.
At once, the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s eyes lit up, letting out an excited chirp.
In the distance, the Silver Giant Dragon, with its Dragon Wings spread across more than a thousand meters, fluttered its wings and flew over, roaring excitedly, “Roar! Joe, did you find something good again?”
In the past few days, each time something good was discovered, the single-horn on the head of the Single-horned Spawn Roc would emit light, acting like a treasure radar—very mystical indeed.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc nodded excitedly, making a whining sound through its nostrils: Mmm-mmm, I sense strong and abundant waves of good things over there.
Behind them, the Black-red Colossal Beast, resembling a small mountain range, let out a deep roar, “Joe, lead the way.”
Whine!! Good point, Thunderflame. Saying so, the Single-horned Spawn Roc turned and flew to the right, its huge wings creating two white waves as they sliced through the air.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon Three-headed Giant Beast followed behind.
But just after flying a hundred kilometers or so, the Single-horned Spawn Roc slowly came to a stop, as the Earth ahead shattered, countless rock-like mountain peaks lost gravity and floated in the air.
And across the meteor belt that spanned an unknown number of kilometers, Black Cracks continuously appeared and disappeared, exuding a dangerous Aura.
These Space Cracks, short as a few meters and long as over a thousand meters, were silent and anything material would be ripped apart when they appeared, then slowly vanished again.
This was a region of unstable spatial ruptures; the Single-horned Spawn Roc and even the Kamaitachi Beast found it very dangerous.
The Silver Giant Dragon flew in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, roaring expectantly, “Roar! Tim Abott, this time let the Great Sethia take the lead.”
As a Giant Beast that mastered the Higher-order Space Law, the Silver Giant Dragon could completely ignore these Space Cracks, thus the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly.
“Charge.” Overjoyed, just like a little girl who had found a new toy, the Silver Giant Dragon roared and plunged into the meteor belt.
Boom!
A strong Spatial Fluctuation burst from the body of the Silver Giant Dragon, releasing silver transparent ripples.
Wherever the spatial ripples passed, the Black Space Cracks disappeared, the rampaging Spatial Fluctuations calmed down, and a stable region with a ten-kilometer radius was formed.
Following the Silver Giant Dragon, the Four Great Beasts flew over a hundred kilometers and passed through that meteor belt, discovering their target.
In front, the Earth had split, forming an abyssal fault thousands of kilometers long and of unknown depth. On the edge of the fault, a crack thousand meters high and ten thousand meters wide emerged.
Inside the crack, hot dark red Magma boiled and Flames burned, radiating a fiery light, and it was clearly a layer filled with lava – a sandwiched space.
Unlike bubble-like small worlds, this type was a sandwiched world formed by a piece of World Fragments due to special reasons after the Great World shattered.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc’s tail swayed, emitting a prolonged whining chirp: Sethia, the good stuff is inside.
The Silver Giant Dragon flew to the edge of the immense crack, its fierce dragon head peering into the crack and looking left and right, then turning back in confusion, “Roar! Joe, I don’t see anything good?”
Whine, whine! It’s behind that mountain range, I can smell the Aura of something good.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc gently flapped its wings, pointing to the end of the Lava World approximately two hundred kilometers away, where a Black Mountain Range lay across, obscuring the view.
“Going that deep.” The Silver Giant Dragon, with its attributes of space and Ice Burst, instinctively disliked the world full of Magma Flames.
Because its storm and frost powers would be somewhat suppressed in such an environment.
At this moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon walked over with heavy steps, letting out a low growl, “I feel a faint Titan Giant breath, be careful.”
Instantly, a look of seriousness appeared in the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast, for there was a Titan Level Giant Beast within this layer filled with magma.
Boom!
The thick, pillar-like Black Dragon Claw reached into the Magma Fire Sea, immediately splashing sparks all over, the immense forepaw almost sinking two hundred meters in before touching the ‘ground.’
Within the Magma Fire Sea, the Black-red Colossal Beast and the Kamaitachi Beast walked, stirring up billows of white waves and a Magma Tsunami, while above, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and Silver Giant Dragon took flight with widespread wings.
Soon, the Four Great Beasts crossed the two hundred kilometers and reached the edge of that Black Mountain Range.
There, two mountain peaks towering ten thousand meters stood erect, and a Lava River a few kilometers wide flowed between them, Flames burning and continuously joining the ocean beneath the feet of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
By the edge of the Lava River stood a Lava Giant, three hundred meters tall, built of black coarse rock, its surface cracked, with magma flowing through the fissures.
Around this Lava Giant, hot golden red light swirled, the invisible high temperatures distorting the space, emanating a Peak Level 9 Aura.
At this moment, the Lava Giant, as if facing a formidable enemy, watched the Four Great Beasts in the distance, and from its fiery mouth came a tyrannical roar, “Intruders…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - 1079 440 Delegation Arrives Titan Forge
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1079: Chapter 440: Delegation Arrives, Titan Forge Giant_3 Chapter 1079: Chapter 440: Delegation Arrives, Titan Forge Giant_3 Boom!
Before the Lava Giant could finish speaking, space above its head distorted, and a colossal silver Dragon Claw materialized out of thin air, spinning with a hundred-meter-diameter White Light vortex in its grasp.
The instant the silver Dragon Claw appeared, the Lava Giant’s figure abruptly sank, and the ground beneath it shattered for hundreds of meters.
Under the powerful spatial suppression force, the Lava Giant had time only for a cry of shock and rage before it was struck, like an insect in a transparent lake, by the claw.
Bang!
Frozen instantly by the ultimate frost Law Power, the quasi-mythical Lava Giant’s internal flames extinguished, and its body exploded into countless black rocks with a loud blast.
A one-hit kill.
As a Mythical Giant Beast that had mastered two Higher-order Laws, the Silver Giant Dragon had Absolute Domination over any lifeform beneath its level.
Such a brutal scene made the Single-horned Spawn Roc shrink its neck—it too was only at the quasi-mythical level, implying that the Silver Giant Dragon could also kill it with one swipe of its claw.
Roar! Great Sethia is so strong, so impressive.
Facing the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s flattery, the Silver Giant Dragon displayed an almost human smugness on its face, retracting its left claw from the Silver Vortex and then turning its gaze toward the Black-red Colossal Beast.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly with a low growl, “Sethia, your control over space is getting stronger and stronger.”
“Roar! Of course, the Great Sethia is invincible,” the Silver Giant Dragon immediately perked up its tail, clearly very pleased.
With the ground trembling, the Destruction Emperor Dragon emerged from the Magma Fire Sea, approaching the Lava Giant’s corpse with steps heavy enough to shake the Earth, inspecting it briefly.
No flesh and blood, no blood, what remained of the Lava Giant after death was merely a pile of black rocks, ranging from a few meters to a dozen meters in size, blanketed with white frost.
On these black rocks were ancient patterns resembling runes, possibly indicating some trace of power.
Besides that, at the chest area of the Lava Giant, a 3 meters Red Crystal was exposed, circulating with dark-red energy akin to magma.
Looking at that Red Crystal, the levitating Single-horned Spawn Roc’s eyes lit up: Roar! Thunderflame, the good stuff I smelled is this.
“It is this crystal,” said the Destruction Emperor Dragon, pausing briefly.
It had thought that the Heaven and Earth Treasure the Single-horned Spawn Roc discovered was something nurtured by the Lava World; it had not expected it to be a Crystal Stone within a Lava Creature’s body.
Sensing the energy fluctuation inside the Red Crystal, the Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its right claw, delicately pinching the Red Crystal between two black fingertips, each dozens of meters long.
For the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which spanned over one thousand four hundred and thirty meters long, a 3 meters Crystal was almost as insignificant as a grain of sand.
However, as it swallowed the Crystal, a scalding energy burst within its body, causing cells to wildly absorb and divide wherever it went.
Crackle Crackle! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s scales slightly bulged on its skin, and its body grew a little bit larger, nearly by five centimeters.
It might not seem much, but for the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this moment, the flesh and blood of a quasi-mythical beast consumed was barely enough to sustain its daily activities, let alone growth.
Especially after carefully assessing the energy released by the crystal, the Destruction Emperor Dragon showed a hint of astonishment.
The crystal within this Lava Giant was quite special, containing an energy that was both vast and rich with the aura of Life Energy, incredibly pure.
These Lava Giants didn’t seem like living beasts, but more like energy collators and purifiers, absorbing, purifying, storing, and compressing the energy of heaven and earth.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon looked up at the distant mountain ranges, glimpsing the remains of some structures among the black rocks melted by fire through its terrifying vision.
That sent the Destruction Emperor Dragon into contemplation.
As it traveled further into the Chaotic Turbulent Region for over one hundred thousand kilometers, it found the Heavenly Energy here growing increasingly wild.
But this wildness did not imply that the energy was unordered. Rather, after the disruption of the heavenly earth’s orderly laws, a unique power akin to a Law pervaded.
After absorbing such energy, the spirit and Will of any creature would be violently affected, becoming increasingly savage, bloodthirsty, and mad.
These insidious effects could not be resisted, not even by Mythical Giant Beasts.
This was also why the Giant Dragon’s mother, even at the peak of the Titan Level, did not dare stay here for long.
Including the Giant Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, and Kamaitachi—the three Giant Beasts—started to become more impulsive and savage after several days, affected by this energy.
The Giant Dragon had been forewarned about these effects by its mother before they entered.
However, perhaps because it was a Heavenly-tier lifeform, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt that its consciousness and thought processes had not been affected and remained as calm as ever.
And these Lava Giants were apparently capable of purifying Heavenly Earth Energy to form crystallized Life Energy with a fiery attribute stored within.
Such energy belonged to almost perfect biological crystals. Any beast could consume and rapidly grow from them.
Moreover, within the energy just released from that crystal, there were also traces of Law Factors, suggesting these Lava Giants could even purify Law Powers.
If there were enough of these Energy Crystal Bodies, and that Titan-level aura also belonged to a Lava Giant…
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew excited at the thought. Hot air blasted out from its nostrils as it let out an earth-shaking roar, “Move on, keep going forward.”
Boom! As it spoke, the Destruction Emperor Dragon unfolded its double wings, bursting forth with Golden-White Light, forming enormous luminescent wings as it soared into the sky, eager to proceed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080 - 1080 440 Delegation Arrives Titan Forge
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1080: Chapter 440: Delegation Arrives, Titan Forge Giant_4 Chapter 1080: Chapter 440: Delegation Arrives, Titan Forge Giant_4 “Roar! Tim Abott, wait for the Great Sesi.”
The Four Great Beasts swiftly flew through the air with a surge of urgent Aura, quickly crossing the mountain range that spanned more than three hundred kilometers wide, and suddenly, an even vaster ocean of magma appeared before them.
In the distant dark red sea of magma, a volcano towering fifty thousand meters high with a mouth several kilometers in diameter stood erect, spewing forth innumerable dark red streams of magma.
Carved into the mountainside of the burning volcano was a throne, upon which sat a Lava Giant whose height reached over two thousand six hundred meters, with golden red flames burning all over its body.
Around this colossal giant, a golden light shrouded a fifty-kilometer radius, radiating indescribably high temperatures, melting all matter and energy.
Within that area, all matter and energy disappeared under the golden light, as if in a world unto itself, with the exception of the volcano behind it.
Moreover, the giant carried a huge furnace with a diameter of one kilometer on its shoulder, inside of which the scorching golden red magma flowed, resembling a Lava World.
Or rather, that furnace was a terrifying weapon forged from a small world, its invisible fluctuations causing Heaven and Earth to tremble.
In the distance from that terrifying Titan Level Lava Giant, five Mythical-level Lava Giants stood tall, the strongest being over one thousand meters, with the tallest reaching one thousand five hundred meters.
One at the peak, two at the mid-stage, and two at the early stage.
Besides, around those Mythical-level Lava Giants, hundreds of level eight and level nine Lava Giants circled, absorbing the scorching firepower and Heavenly Energy.
The instant the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Four Great Beasts appeared atop a mountain ridge over a hundred kilometers away, the Lava Giant seated high on the throne slowly raised its head, flames burning in its eyes as it looked towards them.
When the Titan Lava Giant’s gaze swept over the Silver Giant Dragon and the Kamaitachi Beast, both beasts instinctively shivered, a chill rising from the depths of their souls.
This Titan Lava Giant was terrifying.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared low, “Roar! Tim Abott, be careful, this guy is strong, very formidable.”
“I know,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded.
The mighty and terrifying aura of the Titan Lava Giant was at a late Titan stage, and its strength was formidable, especially with the added bolster from the furnace on its shoulder, amplifying its combat power even more.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt, at this moment, that a tough battle lay ahead.
Then the gaze of the Lava Giant fell upon the Destruction Emperor Dragon, immediately after, intense bloodthirst surfaced in its eyes, followed by a thunderous roar that shook Heaven and Earth.
“Roar! They have the scent of magma energy on them; they’ve killed our kin, tear them apart.”
Roar, roar, roar!!
Far away, the five Mythical-level Lava Giants suddenly moved, their potent energy Bursting forth, covering several to tens of kilometers in a Golden Firelight.
The surrounding Lava Lakes further erupted, shooting up to the sky, cascading over everything under the pull of the five Mythical Lava Giants, surging towards the distant Destruction Emperor Dragon and the other Giant Beasts.
In the engulfing magma that drowned Heaven and Earth, hundreds of level eight and level nine Lava Giants roared, flames burning all around them, their presence shaking the heavens and the earth.
From afar, it seemed as though a legion of apocalypse fire demons had descended.
Watching the overwhelming tide and the Lava Tsunami that surged towards them, the Silver Giant Dragon, the Kamaitachi Beast, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s eyes sparkled with excitement.
[There are still one thousand words unedited; it’s almost twelve o’clock, so I’ll update it now and then continue editing, haha.]
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “Kamaitachi, those two Mid-Mythical giants are yours to handle, Sesi, you take on those two Early-Mythical giants.”
“After you kill them, go help Joe.”
In a low growl, the double wings behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon flapped, emitting a golden-white light that transformed into a pair of massive Light Wings that burst forth, with an Aura of ‘Mythical Peak’ radiating from its body.
“Roar! Kill, let the Great Sesi see a river of blood.”
Already cruel by nature, the Silver Giant Dragon, influenced by its surroundings, became even more bloodthirsty, roaring as its double wings flapped powerfully, creating a vast black storm.
The Kamaitachi Beast also erupted in endless blood-colored flames, roaring as it pounced towards that head
Oo! Kill.
Boom! The moment of contact arrived, a Terrifying Aura erupted from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, endless dazzling lightning Bursting forth, sweeping across Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1081 - 1081 441 The Crumbling of the Blue Star World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1081: Chapter 441 The Crumbling of the Blue Star World and the Terrifying Giant Beast (7K) Chapter 1081: Chapter 441 The Crumbling of the Blue Star World and the Terrifying Giant Beast (7K) As the Lava Giant, towering over two thousand six hundred meters and colossal like a mountain peak of flames, rose to its feet, the entire Magma World began to shake.
The sky, obscured by volcanic ash and smoke, churned with black clouds; the roaring magma ocean erupted into a tide of flame tsunamis, causing the black mountain ranges spanning over a thousand kilometers to tremble.
Even the volcanoes, thousands of meters high, swayed, and the whole world seemed to resonate with the Titan Lava Giant.
As the Titan Lava Giant stood, the massive furnace on its shoulder swayed, the gold-red magma within churning and emitting thunderous, mountains-and-seas shaking rumbles.
Gazing at the Deep Red Giant Beast from a hundred kilometers away in the dark area, emanating black-red lightning and red light, the Titan Lava Giant let out a ferociously tyrannical roar.
“I will cast you all into the furnace and burn you to ashes.”
Standing within the devastating dark area, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled deeply, “Many giants have said the same before, and then they were all torn to shreds by this king.”
As it spoke, the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed the mythical Magma Crystal Core it held in its claw, and in an instant, a burst of pure energy exploded within its body as if a nuclear explosion had occurred.
Boom! The aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon surged wildly. Although its size remained three thousand meters, the invisible oppressive force that radiated from it became even heavier, more overbearing, and utterly destructive.
Looking at the Deep Red Giant Beast that had swallowed the crystal core of its kin, the Titan Lava Giant’s eyes revealed a ferocious gleam as it stepped forward, carrying the World-ending Furnace on its shoulder.
Boom! The space between the two instantly collapsed, forming a Dark Passage.
In the tumultuous Space Turbulence, the Titan giant, ablaze with golden flames, appeared before the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and in that instant, the golden light merging with space pervaded the area.
Boom, boom, boom!! The scorching gold light containing the one-side Magma World fought against the black-red lightning, and in an instant, two extreme forces of Law Power exploded on a grand scale.
The impact was like two worlds colliding, crazily destroying everything, shooting forth dazzling golden-black Energy Halos and creating waves of impact that warped space.
In the moment when the two Laws Worlds collided, the Titan giant, carrying the furnace as if holding a sun, smashed down towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon with thunderous force.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a fierce roar as its double claws, wrapped in black-red lightning, sprung open, and an indescribable surge of Furious Power erupted from within.
Boom, boom!!
The giant claws, as thick as pillars, smashed down upon the furnace, and in an instant, the entire world quaked with the epicenter being the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Titan Lava Giant.
Where the impact passed, space crumbled layer by layer, turning into a black tide sweeping across Heaven and Earth. From afar, it looked as if a black light sphere was expanding endlessly, with everything in its path annihilated.
Above the Firmament, the thick black clouds dispersed, creating a two-hundred-kilometer Hollow in the sky, while the magma ocean below discharged its fury in all directions, revealing the collapsing Earth beneath.
Such terrifying might startled the Silver Giant Dragon and others engaged in distant battles, prompting them to hurriedly retreat as their half-shattered bodies of the Lava Giant Beast fell back.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, having just sliced through two Level 9 Lava Giants, let out a cry of alarm as its surrounding domain of alternating black and white instantly turned dark and shot away as a shadow.
The other Lava Giants reacted quickly too, rushing out in a blaze of flames.
Despite their quick response, faced with the destructive impact that swept over them in an instant, still, twenty-some Lava Giant Beasts of Level 8 and Level 9 were wiped out, crumbled and eradicated.
Just one clash cleared everything in a two hundred kilometer radius, showcasing the terrifying strength of a Titan Peak Level Giant Beast.
And while all the giants were being ‘blown away’ by the aftermath of that one strike, the Lava Giant at the center of the battle let out an outraged roar.
In the instant that the formidable Dragon Claw struck the furnace, an extremely terrifying force containing the essence of destruction erupted with Unrivaled Domination, pushing across the world.
Under such overwhelming strength, even the furnace which contained the power of an entire world was blasted away, and the massive, mountain-like Titan giant also staggered backward from the powerful recoil.
Each step of those flaming feet shattered the Void, creating vast Black Cracks, and the whole Magma World trembled beneath its tread.
With that one strike, the raw strength of the Crimson Destruction Form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon proved even more powerful, nearly reaching the limit of Titan Level.
Even the Titan giant holding the World-ending Furnace was no match.
As for the high temperatures within the furnace capable of melting space, they were simply ignored by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, unable to shake its formidable, maximally amplified Defense.
At that moment, the Titan giant, having been smashed back over a hundred kilometers, let out a brutal roar. Inside the World-ending Furnace he carried, the gold-red magma exploded.
Boom!
The volcano, towering tens of kilometers behind, erupted furiously, spewing endless gold-red magma into the sky, and in the blink of an eye, the entire world’s sky was covered by the searing gold-red lava, forming the phantom of a furnace.
That volcano was the true furnace, or perhaps the Magma World, spanning over three thousand kilometers in diameter, had been melted into the furnace by the Titan giant.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon was somewhat shocked by such a feat.
“I will burn you to ashes,” roared the Titan giant, materializing above the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, wielding the entire world to strike down.
In an instant, a powerful Suppressing force descended from the sky, as if the entire world was pressing down on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Under the immense gravity of an entire world’s formation, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t bear the pressure and crashed down into the crater formed by the previous strike, causing the Earth for tens of kilometers to crumble instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1082 - 1082 441 The Fracture of Blue Star World That
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1082: Chapter 441 The Fracture of Blue Star World, That Terrifying Giant Beast (7K)_2 Chapter 1082: Chapter 441 The Fracture of Blue Star World, That Terrifying Giant Beast (7K)_2 “`
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon, standing tall upon the Earth, gazed at the expanding sky above as the World-ending Furnace transformed into a colossal structure thousands of meters high, unleashing a savage roar.
Due to the crushing pressure from the entire world, space solidified, making it impossible to dodge this strike—and there was no need to dodge it.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s muscles bulged as endless strength coalesced in its legs, gathered at its waist, its back strong as a dragon’s, coursing through its entire body.
In this moment, the Emperor Dragon resembled a Martial Arts Master, its claws, like fists or seals, channeling the power of its entire body and radiating intense red light, welcoming the descending World-ending Furnace.
Boom! The heavens shattered, the ground sank, and within a radius of hundreds of kilometers, the Earth exploded, mountain ranges collapsed, and gigantic cracks spread in all directions.
In the center of the terrifying strike, a hollow 30 kilometers in diameter formed, plunging hundreds of kilometers into the Earth and shattering the Boundary Wall, leaving the entire world pierced by the strike of the World-ending Furnace.
Outside the enraged world, a Void Storm roared as the thousands of meters tall World-ending Furnace continued to sink, its interior swirling with golden-red magma.
Below the furnace, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood upright, its massive claws imprinted on the bottom of the furnace, where large cracks spread outwards.
As more and more cracks appeared on the bottom of the furnace, golden light emanated from the depths of those fissures, emitting crackling vibrations.
Boom! The bottom of the World-ending Furnace shattered, and in an instant, inexhaustible golden-red magma erupted, forming a ten-thousand-meter wide flow of golden-red lava, engulfing the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Under the vast golden magma, as if it were the substance within a star, even the Spatial Storms were obliterated, radiating extreme energy and heat.
And just as the clash of the titanic beasts tore through the world, from the depths of the rules of the mythical world, a deep, resonant roar sounded.
Majestic, desolate, like the subconscious roar of an ancient beast that had existed for endless epochs, it sent an invisible shockwave sweeping across the entire mythical world.
Boom!
High above, where the setting Blue Sun was, its radiance suddenly intensified, and the gloomy blue light enveloped the entire mythical world, painting everything blue.
This formless light penetrated everything, including the Void.
Encompassing the Chaotic Turbulent Region that had formed its own realm after shattering, the terrifying Giant Beast World falling from the sky beyond the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, and various other worlds—all were enveloped in blue light.
Under the blue light, all humans, Unique Beasts, different races, whether they were Fifth Layer Heaven cultivators, Heavenly Kings, Supremes, or even existences above Supremes, felt their souls tremble.
It was as if an immensely powerful Giant Beast was exerting its pressure, making every living being in the mythical world feel as if they couldn’t catch their breath.
The sudden change caused everyone’s faces to shift slightly.
Inside the fighter aircraft meditating, Jack Clark’s figure flashed, and he appeared above the aircraft, his expression grave as he looked upwards and asked, “What’s happening?”
Roar Roar Roar!!
At that moment, in the firmament above the mythical world, several nearly imperceptible terrifying roars sounded as if in response to the shining Blue Sun.
On another side of the horizon, a moon had already risen halfway, also emitting endless bright light that illuminated Heaven and Earth.
In that instant, it seemed like the entire mythical world awakened under that roar.
And deeper within the mythical world, an invisible shockwave swept across the entire world, causing the solid crystal walls that enveloped the mythical world to tremble with the roar.
Under the powerful vibrations, many worlds connected to the mythical world were affected, and some weaker worlds exploded and shattered instantly.
Including the Blue Star World connected to the mythical world, the Domain Area was also impacted, and many unique spaces formed by the forces of both worlds shook continuously.
In the Southern Battlefield, within the depths of the mountain ranges, White Veil, Zac Maben, and others were all awoken by the shock, looking with horror at the trembling mountain ranges.
Outside Blue Star, on Earth, in the sky, beneath the sea, and even in Outer Space, a number of Black Cracks appeared, with boundless Heavenly Energy pouring backwards from the pathways.
The sudden anomaly triggered shrill alerts in all of Blue Star’s monitoring centers.
“Alert, intense Spatial Fluctuations detected at multiple locations, Space Cracks of Level 5 intensity have appeared at coordinates, latitude 140.15, longitude 347.48 in the southeast.”
“Alert, a powerful Spatial Fluctuation detected, coordinates in the western side of the Southern sea area, latitude 69.7, longitude 123.40 Space Crack of level eight intensity…”
In that moment, the military forces of the entire alliance were stirred, bases sounded their alarms, fighter aircraft, helicopters, and Ninth Heaven Experts stationed rose to the skies.
Mist River City, dusk.
After dinner, Glenn Clark, whose height had reached 2 meters and who was robust in stature, was pushing a modified barbecue grill motorcycle, preparing to go fishing.
Glenn Clark turned and called back into the house, “Mom, I’m going out to fish.”
From inside, Doris Clark’s voice came, “Okay, but don’t fish too late today. You still have school tomorrow.”
“You’re in the ninth grade now. You need to study hard and try to be the first in your class. After all, your brother was the top student; don’t disappoint him.”
“I’ll try my best,” Glenn Clark scratched his head, with no guarantees.
He wasn’t as smart as his brother, and maintaining a rank of tenth in his grade was already a struggle; aiming for the top spot seemed improbable to him.
Mounting his motorcycle, equipped Glenn Clark ignited the engine. Then, with the putt-putt-putt sound, he sped out of the courtyard and onto the riverside road toward the bridge.
About ten minutes later, Glenn Clark reached the outskirts.
With the influx of many fishermen recently, the big fish near his home had been almost all caught, so his fishing spot was gradually moving towards the suburbs.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1083 - 1083 441 The Blue Star World Shatters The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1083: Chapter 441 The Blue Star World Shatters, The Terrifying Giant Beast (7K)_3 Chapter 1083: Chapter 441 The Blue Star World Shatters, The Terrifying Giant Beast (7K)_3 However, just as Glenn Clark was carrying the barbecue grill to the riverside, he suddenly looked up at the sky and saw a black crack silently appear high above, forming a dark rift hundreds of meters long.
From the depths of the black crack, the roar of a Giant Beast resounded, followed by a powerful energy fluctuation that erupted. Glenn’s face changed drastically, “Not good.”
Boom!
Before Glenn could do anything, a powerful Aura burst forth from a distance. Then, a figure exuding the Aura of the Seventh Layer Heaven shot up into the sky, hurtling towards him.
Meanwhile, the figure urgently shouted, “Glenn, get back, that’s a Space Crack.”
But before the high-order strong man protecting Glenn could reach him, and before Glenn could retreat, the crack in the sky suddenly shook violently.
Then, a massive object fell from the sky with the force of over ten times the speed of sound. It smashed to the ground in front of Glenn, instantly exploding the air with water droplets and dirt.
Boom!
The powerful impact whipped up a raging wind that flung Glenn over ten meters away. He slammed into the Earth and rolled several times before coming to a stop, looking very disheveled.
At that moment, the figure appeared in front of Glenn, standing protectively in front of him.
“Glenn, are you alright?”
“I’m fine.”
Glenn shook his head and then looked somewhat surprised at the middle-aged man before him because he knew who he was—the new P.E. teacher who had recently transferred schools.
“Teacher Reid, what are you doing here?”
Doris cleared her throat and hastily made up an excuse, “I was just taking a walk over there after eating.”
Oh.
Without thinking too much about it, Glenn nodded and stood up. He then turned to look ahead where the head of a Giant Beast, covered in purple scales and about tens of meters in diameter, lay quietly by the riverside.
The Giant Beast’s head, resembling a fierce tiger, looked daunting and oppressive like a small hill.
At this moment, the Giant Beast was already dead, with many parts of its scale armor broken and cracks deep into its skull revealing themselves. Blood slowly trickled down.
Even so, the invisible yet pervasive quasi-mythical level Terrifying Aura still made Glenn shiver, while Doris’s face showed absolute terror.
Just then, as Glenn faced the oppressive force of the quasi-mythical beast, a powerful strength erupted from within him, enveloping him in a Black Gold Radiance.
Instantly, that suffocating pressure eased, causing him to turn pale and gasp for breath.
Seeing the Black Gold Radiance emanating from Glenn and the overbearing and profound Aura it gave off, Doris’s face showed a shocked expression. Such a strong Aura and strength were not of any ordinary physical talent.
Innate Awakening! Immediately, a terrifying conjecture surfaced in Doris’s mind.
No wonder he’s that person’s brother.
At this moment, Doris suddenly didn’t know what to say.
The brother, with monstrous talent, had reached the Ninth Heaven Peak in a year, shaking the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield. And now the brother also turned out to be an Innate Body Awakener, too terrifying.
As Glenn caught his breath, he suddenly paused, “Teacher Reid, there seems to be something in the mouth of that beast.”
Meanwhile, high up in the atmosphere hundreds of kilometers away, a High-definition Satellite nearby was violently penetrated as space collapsed under the influence of a powerful force.
The collapsing space created a temporary pathway with a diameter of a kilometer. The invisible energy fluctuations that spread out instantaneously triggered shrill alarms from the surrounding Energy Detection Satellites in Outer Space.
“Alert, coordinates 557, 93rd Energy Detection Satellite detected a strong spatial energy fluctuation 37 kilometers away in Outer Space, level eleven!”
“What, level eleven!”
In an instant, the entire Monitoring Center was shaken, and the Major General in charge spoke with a grave expression, “Immediately Mobilize the nearby High-definition Satellites to monitor that temporary Spatial Channel.”
“Also, inform the nearest No.2 Doomsday-level Sky Base Satellite to alert the Throne of Judgement’s Sword with the higher-ups stationed there. If any Mythical Giant Beasts come through the Channel, they will need to intervene.”
“Yes.”
As the information was relayed, the nearby satellites floating in space swiftly turned their cameras to focus on the area where the space had collapsed due to the clash between the forces of two worlds.
Meanwhile, in the Cosmic Void more than a thousand kilometers away from the atmosphere of Blue Star, a massive celestial body with a diameter of tens of kilometers floated in space. There, on one of its arms, a hundred-meter-tall Mecha’s eyes lit up.
In the grand control room controlling the Sky Base weapons, a solemn voice sounded, “Michael, a strong impact has occurred between Blue Star and the mythical world causing numerous cracks to form inside.”
“At coordinates 557 in the atmosphere, an eleven-level Space Crack has appeared. You need to go take a look to prevent the emergence of any Mythical Giant Beasts.”
“No problem.”
The Mecha nodded slightly and then, with two pairs of metal wings unfurling from its back and with streams of white waves shooting from its feathers, it blasted off with a roar.
In the weightlessness of Outer Space, the Mecha accelerated to over ten times the speed of sound in the blink of an eye, and within mere minutes, it crossed over a thousand kilometers to enter the atmosphere.
Following the coordinates, with dazzling firelight, the Mecha quickly reached the area of Spatial Collapse.
At this point, the violent Spatial Fluctuations had somewhat subsided, forming a rotating black vortex with some scenes from the other side vaguely visible.
Under a dim sky, the shattered Earth, and a sea of burning Magma Fire, stood the Deep Red Giant Beast, 3000 meters in length, towering over 2000 meters high within the hollow of a broken world.
The Titan Peak Destructive Pressure emanating from it, though on the other side of the world, still left Michael in immense fear.
At this time, the Deep Red Giant Beast stood atop golden Magma, facing off against a Lava Titan Giant of similar stature, more than 2000 meters high, supporting a furnace on its shoulder.
But at this moment, the bottom of the massive furnace crumbled, and the inside was empty.

chapters.title: Chapter 1084 - 1084 441 The Blue Star World Shatters the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1084: Chapter 441 The Blue Star World Shatters, the Terrifying Giant Beast (7K)_4 Chapter 1084: Chapter 441 The Blue Star World Shatters, the Terrifying Giant Beast (7K)_4 The scene was captured by a high-definition satellite, and suddenly the Monitoring Center erupted with an astonished shout, “It’s the Giant Beast codenamed Thunderflame.”
“What! The Giant Beast codenamed Thunderflame, hasn’t it entered the mythical world?” The Major General on duty showed a look of astonishment, looking at the deep red ferocious behemoth on the big screen, as well as the side-scan data.
He had seen pictures of the Giant Beast codenamed Thunderflame. Many aspects of it were similar, but the behemoth’s back seemed to lack wings.
Moreover, more than a month ago, that Giant Beast had already entered the mythical world, and its size was only five to six hundred meters. How could it possibly transform into a three-thousand-meter Titan Peak Beast all at once?
The staff member said gravely, “General, it is indeed the Giant Beast codenamed Thunderflame. The three pairs of red feather horns on the sides of its head are too distinctive.”
As the staff member pulled up some past images of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon for comparison, a chorus of gasps filled the Monitoring Center.
“It’s really that Giant Beast!”
“How terrifying, it has grown from the early mythical stage to the Titan Peak in just over a month!”
“It’s simply inconceivable, how could it grow so fast?”
Suddenly, a staff member exclaimed, “Look quick, the Giant Beast codenamed Thunderflame is fighting the Lava Titan Giant.”
…
In the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was taken aback as it glanced at the explosive space cracks in the distance and the opposite side’s blue sky, white clouds, satellites, and Mecha.
It never expected that the invisible impact just now, a combination of its strength and the Lava Titan’s strike, would actually tear open a temporary pathway to Blue Star.
This was the ‘mystery’ of space. Although Blue Star and the Chaotic Turbulent region, as well as the Human Territory, were far apart, many sudden space cracks spread across billions of kilometers.
While marveling, the Destruction Emperor Dragon unfurled its massive double wings that spanned seven thousand meters, darkening the sky and emitting an intense red glow.
Boom!
The Void exploded with terrifying propulsion, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned into a red streak of light as it burst into the Magma World, appearing in front of the Lava Titan Giant.
Roar!
The ferocious roar of the Destruction Emperor Dragon tore through the sky with its double claws, wrapped in the Deep Red Destruction Thunder, leaving nothingness where it passed, as if covered by a falling curtain of darkness.
Faced with the strike of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Lava Titan Giant, carrying the broken World-ending Furnace, radiated a blinding golden glow, once again drawing upon the world’s power and smashing it outward.
Boom! The two collided fiercely once again.
But this time, under the Full-Force Strike of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the already damaged World-ending Furnace finally shattered, exploding into the sky as fragments, like fiery meteors scattering in all directions.
As the furnace that melted the world’s power broke apart, the entire Lava World began to shake, its edges collapsing and exploding, and in the sky, huge cracks appeared one after another.
Even the volcanoes that had stopped erupting magma in the distance crumbled thunderously, slowly toppling like colossal pillars, immediately making the world even less stable.
As the world crumbled, the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had shattered the furnace let out a low roar, and a black-red Giant Claw descended from the sky with dazzling light.
Roar! The Lava Titan Giant let out a savage roar, refusing to retreat and instead advancing, its mountain-like huge arms spewing intense flames, its fists burning with Golden Firelight, punching upwards.
Boom boom!!
The double claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon clashed with the double fists of the Lava Titan, and in an instant, a world-destroying shockwave erupted, the tremendous force causing the already crumbling world to break apart even more violently.
Bang bang bang!!
Under their full-powered strikes, the arms of the Lava Titan Giant kept shattering and exploding, and finally burst with a loud bang, scattering countless liquid-like golden flames everywhere.
Deprived of the World-ending Furnace and the World’s Power, the Lava Giant in the late-stage Titan Realm was even less of a match for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
And just as a Full-Force Strike shattered the Lava Titan Giant’s double shoulders and sent its true body reeling, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, like a well-trained Martial Arts master, went on the offense without retreating. It instantly appeared before the Titan Giant.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws landed on the Lava Titan Giant’s double shoulders, instantly causing the giant body of the Titan to sink. Then, a brutal growl resounded from its eyes.
A blazing pillar of golden fire belched forth from the mouth of the Lava Titan Giant and landed on the chest of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, immediately resulting in a dazzling explosion and energy shockwave.
Boom boom boom!! With the golden flame energy Breath impacting over several hundred meters, the entire body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon radiated brilliant light, and the explosive roar shook Heaven and Earth.
Yet the Destruction Emperor Dragon, even close to the breath blast of the Lava Titan Giant, remained unmoved.
Even though the breath of the Lava Titan Giant contained temperatures of a million degrees Celsius and the utmost Fire Law and energy shock, it still couldn’t make the slightest dent in the crimson scale armor.
Such a terrifying Defense, even in the eyes of the Lava Titan Giant, couldn’t help but reveal shock and disbelief.
Just then, the muscles in the double arms of the Destruction Emperor Dragon swelled, and an immensely powerful strength Burst forth, grabbing the double shoulders of the Lava Titan Giant as if to rip it asunder.
Boom boom boom!! Under the horrifying tearing strength, the Titan Body of the Lava Giant, enhanced to the ultimate solidity and unparalleled strength, cracked and rumbled.
Crevices emerged on its surface, and deep within those cracks, golden light shone even brighter.
Roar!
Under the intense threat of Death, the Lava Titan Giant let out a brutal roar. An even brighter golden light erupted within it, transforming into chains of golden flame that wrapped around its entire body.
Instantly, as its Origin burned, the Lava Titan’s torn crevices healed, and its Aura surged, radiating an unstoppable Will.
At that moment, a crimson Tail Blade over a thousand meters long appeared, enwrapped with black-red Thunder of Deep Red Destruction, slashing like a flexible whip from below upwards.
Under the sharp blade of the crimson Tail Blade, the chaotic Space Turbulences surrounding it, already exploded by the force, were severed, creating a plane of absolute darkness.
With the exceedingly sharp Tail Blade slashing, the Law Chains on the surface of the Lava Titan Giant shattered, followed by its incredibly hard Titan True Body.
“Roar! No.”
Boom! With one slash of the Tail Blade and an eruption of strength from the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws, the Lava Titan Giant was torn in two, instantly unleashing a dazzling burst of golden light.
Boom boom boom!! Endless streams of Golden Law Flame erupted from both halves of the Lava Titan Giant, trying to break free from the grasp of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws.
But since it couldn’t shake the Destruction Emperor Dragon even with its concentrated, tens-of-times-stronger breath, its mere burst of Law Flame from burning its Origin stood even less chance.
Standing amidst the sea of Golden Law Fire, black-red Lightning flashed on the double claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, madly entering the body of the Lava Titan Giant, erasing its Divine Soul Intent.
[Haha, the part here isn’t finished yet, just a moment, brothers.]
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon extinguished the Lava Titan Giant’s existence, the collapse of the world accelerated, for the Lava Giant was the World Lord of this world.
Comparable to the Titan Peak.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon caught its breath, grasping a golden Crystal a hundred meters in diameter, with a Terrifying Aura swirling around it.
Actually, this Lava Giant was very powerful. Any ordinary Heavenly King encountering it would have exploded on impact, and under normal conditions, subjugating it would have certainly been a mighty aid to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But unfortunately, the Energy Crystal Body within such special creatures was very important.
Especially since within a Mythical-level Lava Giant, only such a Crystal would form, which could help the Destruction Emperor Dragon grow rapidly. By slaying this Lava Titan, it could directly Evolve into a Titan Beast.
Boom boom boom!! Amidst successive flashes of lightning, level eight and Level 9 Lava Giants exploded, and after sweeping up all their Crystals, the Destruction Emperor Dragon tore through the Void and burst out of the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1085 - 1085 442 The Return of Myth Urgent Return to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1085: Chapter 442: The Return of Myth, Urgent Return to Blue Star Due to Trouble Chapter 1085: Chapter 442: The Return of Myth, Urgent Return to Blue Star Due to Trouble The Lava World continued to crumble as the towering crimson Giant Beast, standing over two thousand meters tall, slightly lowered its head to gaze at the giant golden Crystal Core it held in its claw.
Feeling the vast, pure energy within the core, the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but curve the corners of its mouth upwards, revealing a sinister, human-like smile.
This core was the essence of a Lava Titan Giant, containing enough energy for it to grow to the Titan Level in one go.
In fact, the Lava Giant was very strong, especially since it carried the World-ending Furnace; if it could be subdued, it would definitely become a great aid to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Regrettably, the energy core within the giant was too important to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Compared to having another powerful minion, evolving to the Titan Level was more crucial; after all, minions could betray, but strength would forever belong to it.
Hum!
At that moment, a terrifying world projection formed behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon as interwoven crimson light and Destructive Aura emanated from its body.
Within that spectral world, endless red light spread, and the shadowy figure of a behemoth thousands of meters in length loomed, exhaling an aura of despair that seemed to doom all living beings.
The instant the Deep Red World Projection appeared, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt a strong call, and the reddish-black Thunder wrapped around its body went berserk.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Deep Red Destruction Thunder continuously struck the world projection, causing it to shake, twist, and the calling sensation to intensify.
It seemed as if entering it would grant the Destruction Emperor Dragon even greater power.
Gazing at the projection that tinted half of the Doomsday sky red, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a cold demeanor with no sign of perturbation, and the red light emanating from its body gradually dimmed.
This world projection, which appeared under its ultimate Gigantification Form, should be a special, powerful Plane similar to the Supreme Hell Plane.
In that world, there was an opportunity for the Gigantification Talent to transform into the corresponding Law Power.
However, it was clear that the world was terrifying and not suitable for entry by one at the Mythical Realm, perhaps waiting until after a breakthrough to Titan or even Ancient Titan would be more prudent.
Now, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon reverted from its Deep Red Form, a wave of severe weakness took over its body, causing it to gasp for air.
The effort to kill the Lava Titan Giant shortly before was greater than when it tore apart the Golden Roc Giant Beast; even it needed a moment to recuperate.
Yiya, yiya! The confused voice of the Purple little dragon came from atop the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head.
On the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, a section of black mane, tens of meters long, was coiled into a five-meter-wide circle to form a nest where the Purple little dragon was comfortably curled up and asleep.
The Purple little dragon was sound asleep, not even the cataclysmic battle that obliterated a world had awakened it.
However, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon exited its Gigantified Form and its aura suddenly weakened, the Purple little dragon twitched its eyelids, and a childlike, instinctive growl escaped its mouth.
Sensing the little one trying to wake up forcefully, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth moved slightly as it issued a deep, heavy growl, “I’m fine, Miss Joseline, it’s just some energy, I’ll recover in a moment.”
Yiya, yiya! The Purple little dragon, having already opened its eyes, paused for a moment, then yawned, lay down, curled its tail, and drifted back to sleep.
This little guy. A touch of tenderness appeared in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils.
The Purple little dragon had consumed a considerable amount of resources recently, accumulating enough for a growth Transformation similar to a breakthrough, hence its lengthy slumber.
Having caught his breath, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its gaze toward a distant battlefield thousands of kilometers away.
Seemingly stimulated by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the other three Giant Beasts fought fiercely.
The Silver Giant Dragon, being at the same initial stage of Myth, suppressed the two Lava Giants, each over seven hundred meters tall, amid enveloping black storms that shredded magma and extinguished flames.
Powerful Space Law Power spread around, suppressing their Law Domains and repeatedly shattering their molten true bodies.
As for the Lava Giants’ attacks, they were met head-on by the Silver Giant Dragon, with its formidable True Dragon body.
Refined under two Higher-order Laws, its True Dragon body was significantly stronger than that of other Giant Beasts at the same Mythical level, bolstered by the defense for which the Dragon species is renowned.
However, being refined under the same Higher-order Laws, the Law Power of the Silver Giant Dragon, transformed through its Top Tier Talent, was a level weaker than that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which was transformed through its Deification Talent.
The difference lay in the number of Law Mysteries and the strength of their Origins.
Compared to the Silver Giant Dragon, the Kamaitachi Beast, that was also ferocious in battle, appeared more distressed as it continually pressed and crushed the true bodies of two Lava Giants, each towering a kilometer high, while also enduring repeated injuries to itself.
However, the most miserable was the Single-horned Spawn Roc — amidst the siege of hundreds of level eight and nine Lava Giants, some quasi-mythical, it was repeatedly struck by fiery fists that blasted apart its scale armor.
Even its ability to become a shadow and evade within its domain of alternating darkness did not help; unfortunately, there were too many enemies.
Swarming in, they shattered the Black and White Domain, and numerous fiery giant palms engulfed the Spawn Roc, utterly exploiting their numerical advantage.
Consequently, after just a short skirmish, the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s scale armor was nearly shattered, its wings were mutilated, and it bore scorched marks from the intense heat.
Although seriously injured, the Single-horned Spawn Roc grew more excited as the battle continued, rampaging through the siege, destroying more than twenty level eight Lava Giants.
Every once in a while, it opened its mouth wide like a Black Hole, devouring a level nine early-stage Lava Giant in one bite, erasing it from existence.
Just in that brief moment, it had devoured over ten level nine Lava Giants, with occasional explosive burst of energy from within, signifying Destructive Impacts from the exploding Lava Giants.

﻿Chapter 1086: Chapter 442: The Return of Myth, Urgent Return to Blue Star Due to Trouble_2 Chapter 1086: Chapter 442: The Return of Myth, Urgent Return to Blue Star Due to Trouble_2 “`
This time it was fighting hundreds by itself; after it saw the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle later on, it could boast quite a feat.
In the past, those guys shouted about taking on ten or twenty opponents, fierce in their words but never having that many enemies to fight, and they couldn’t defeat them either.
But this time, it was badass to the max.
Boom!!
The shattered Lava World suddenly vibrated, as countless blue-purple lightning bolts thundered across the distant horizon, turning into serpentine flashes that enveloped heaven and earth.
In face of that terrifying Thunderbolt Power, space itself was shattered, and all the Level 8 and 9 Lava Giants in its path exploded into a rain of black rock debris.
The four heavily injured Mythical Lava Giants, under the fused power of two grand accomplishments in Higher-order Law, continued to crumble, unable to heal.
Roar, roar, roar!!
In their angry bellowing, the four Mythical Lava Giants were gradually ground to dust by the merged lightning, vanishing and leaving behind four golden-red Crystals, each about twenty meters in diameter.
“This place is going to be destroyed, let’s go.”
With a low growl, the Destruction Emperor Dragon erupted in Firelight, sweeping away all the Crystals before leading the charge out of the cracks.
As the four Giant Beasts rushed out, the cracks vibrated, and the entire Lava World collapsed in the explosion, disintegrating into fragments that disappeared into the depths of the Void.
Boom! The space crack that connected to the Chaotic Turbulent Region also collapsed with a loud bang, creating a destructive spatial shockwave that swept across tens of kilometers.
Amidst the wild explosive impact, four Giant Beasts of varying sizes stood imposingly, their aura ferocious.
Looking at the Kamaitachi Beast with its damaged wings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction and let out a deep roar, “This time, Kamaitachi did well. Our Dragon Palace Giant Beasts should always be bold in battle.”
“Roar! Thank you for the compliment, my king,” replied the nearly 1,200-meters-long, imposing dark red Giant Beast, somewhat excited.
Then the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued in a low growl, “Everyone performed well in battle this time. Kamaitachi, take a Mid-Mythical Stage and an early stage Crystal Core. Scythia, you too.”
“Joe, you take five Level 9 Peak energy Crystal Cores; consuming them should allow you to directly enter Hibernation and achieve a breakthrough into Mythical status.”
“The rest of those Level 8 and 9 Crystal Cores are for Domination and the others; their strength is too weak and needs further improvement, or they won’t even be able to guard our Territory.”
These Crystal Cores contain rich life and Law Factors, which Giant Beast Type Creatures can absorb when consumed, without any ‘drug resistance,’ making them very precious.
Therefore, to some extent, a Level 8 Crystal Core is comparable to ordinary God-level Resources, a Level 9 is on par with High-Level Divine Resources, and Mythical Crystal Cores are even more valuable than Top-Level Divine Resources.
That was the reason why the Destruction Emperor Dragon wanted to kill all the Lava Giants.
After allocating the loot, the Destruction Emperor Dragon opened its huge maw and swallowed the hundred-meter-diameter golden Crystal Core in one gulp.
The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed the Crystal Core, the one in its stomach exploded like a Hydrogen Bomb, releasing endless life energy and Law Factors.
Crackle Crackle!! Beneath the rich and abundant energy, the cells throughout the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body frantically divided, duplicated, bone structure grew, muscles swelled, and scale armor stretched.
One thousand four hundred and fifty meters, one thousand four hundred and seventy meters, one thousand five hundred meters.
Boom!
A terrifying aura, surpassing that of Mythical-level, erupted from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shaking Heaven and Earth. The invisible, pervasive pressure became a physical blast that sent the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast flying.
Tumbling wildly in the air and being thrown across tens of kilometers in the blink of an eye, the Silver Giant Dragon roared: “Roar! Tim Abott, you’ve blown Great Sethia away again.”
Nevertheless, at that moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon paid it no heed, its attention focused inward.
As its body reached one thousand five hundred meters, huge changes took place inside. Its solid and strong Genetic Sequence collapsed and continued to absorb energy from the Titan Crystal Core to reassemble.
Simultaneously, the eight matured Higher-order Laws began Transformation, with streams of black lightning, golden light, golden-white flame and thunder, and purple halos erupting.
Boom!
Interwoven with the power of the eight Higher-order Laws, a ‘world’ of a hundred kilometers in diameter formed around the Destruction Emperor Dragon as the center, dazzlingly colored and emitting brilliant light, undergoing some sort of change.
Within this area, everything was destroyed by the eight Law Powers, the rock beneath their feet, the Heavenly Earth Laws, all were destroyed and restructured.
Standing tall at the center of this nascent Laws World, the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew more terrifying still. Flesh and blood, bones, power, and life were all undergoing Transformation.
Suddenly, a strong impulse to Hibernation washed over the depths of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s being.
At such a terrifying rate of growth and transformation, even having witnessed it multiple times, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc were still shocked and envious.
The speed of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was countless times faster than other Mythical Giant Beasts; what others couldn’t achieve in hundreds or thousands of years, the Destruction Emperor Dragon managed in just over a month.
Suddenly, the vibrant Laws World in the distance collapsed abruptly, contracting and revealing the Destruction Emperor Dragon, now enveloped in black gold streams emitting terrifying pressure.
“Roar! Let’s go, back home,” it bellowed.
With a roar, huge claws descended from the sky, grabbing the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, then with a thunderous sound, smashed through space at a speed a hundred times the speed of sound.
Everything in their path, whether Space Cracks or Thunder Pool forbidden areas, was obliterated to form a dark passage teeming with turbulent currents.
Following behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Kamaitachi Beast engulfed in red flames and fluttering its double wings charged at extreme speed to catch up.
The transformation after breaking through to the Titan Level was more intense than the Destruction Emperor Dragon anticipated; it might have to Hibernates for a long time again. It needed to return to the safety of the Rift World to rest.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1087 - 1087 442 Myth Reborn Blue Star Trouble Return
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1087: Chapter 442 Myth Reborn, Blue Star Trouble Return Quickly_3 Chapter 1087: Chapter 442 Myth Reborn, Blue Star Trouble Return Quickly_3 This is the downside of rising too quickly, always on the path of either breakthrough and growth or hibernation.
…
Many in the Satellite Monitoring Center were still in a daze, staring at the frozen image on the large screen.
The Major General in charge spoke gravely, “It only took thirteen minutes to erase a Mythical Life whose energy at its peak burst was equivalent to that of a Titan Peak.”
Giant Beasts of the Titan level have even greater advantages in size and possess such vigorous vitality that they are much harder to kill.
And yet, the beast code-named Thunderflame managed to kill a strong man akin to the peak of the Heavenly King in just over ten minutes, shocking everyone.
After all, the Human Race currently only has eleven Heavenly King level strong men, and only four have reached the peak realm.
Of course, what’s most terrifying is that this beast code-named Thunderflame broke through to the Myth realm just over a month ago and could already crush an opponent at the Titan Peak.
Such a terrifying rate of growth is simply horrifying.
Fortunately, this Giant Beast has signed a friendly alliance with the Federation, and one of their top-tier prodigies is its ‘friend,’ so there’s no worry of it becoming an enemy.
Just then, alarms sounded again in the Monitoring Center.
A staff member responsible for energy detection shouted from a distance, “Report, high-intensity energy fluctuations detected on the southern coast of Eastern Summer, reaching level ten!”
The Major General in charge immediately ordered, “Contact the nearest main combat Military Base immediately and dispatch strong men above the Nine Layers for the possible emergence of a Level 9 Giant Beast.”
For such sudden Space Cracks, the Federation graded them into thirteen levels according to the strength of the energy fluctuations, corresponding to a thirteen-tier strength system.
However, these cracks are unstable Rift Channels with a carrying limit, allowing only the first creature with the energy intensity to pass through.
Furthermore, as these cracks are torn by the clash of the Boundary forces of two worlds, they contain intense Spatial Storms deep within that destroy everything.
For instance, the giant beast’s head that Glenn Clark encountered was killed by being torn apart by a Spatial Storm after being pulled into a crack.
Right now, cracks are appearing in various places of Blue Star, with some emitting dense and pure Heavenly Energy, while others dropping stones, dirt, or the corpses of Unique Beasts.
There are also some injured Unique Beasts appearing in mountain forests and cities.
These beasts are at least above Level 7, many reaching tens to hundreds of meters in size, and even a Mythical Creature spanning over a thousand meters appeared in the skies above a city in Berlin.
Suddenly, alarms were going off around the world, military units were being deployed, and news media reporters rushed around excitedly, as if witnessing the beginning of myth fifty years ago all over again.
Mist River City
Twenty or so kilometers away from Jack Clark’s home, the street was already blockaded, with officers, soldiers, and Martial Arts School teachers all helping to evacuate ordinary people.
“Everyone, don’t panic, retreat according to instructions, there’s still time.”
“Those over there, don’t push…”
While countless people were frantically dispersing in all directions, on top of a commercial building, Laurant Harris, the head instructor of South Sky Martial Arts High, looked forward with a heavy expression.
A black crack over 300 meters long had emerged there, emitting intense energy fluctuations, and that crack was still expanding as if something was squeezing through.
“Trouble, the energy emitted from this crack is nearing level nine, and it is very stable, enough for that Giant Beast to pass through,” said Harris.
Turning his head, Harris looked back at the Sixth Layer teachers, as well as Howard Lambert, Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis, Justin Welan, and White Veil Flynt Lance and others who had come back for the freshman opening ceremony.
“When that Level 8 Giant Beast comes through, Howard and I will take the lead in the attack. You all will be responsible for intercepting the residual combat waves and evacuating the crowd to avoid causing too many casualties,” he continued.
“Okay,” Crystal and the others nodded solemnly, faces earnest.
Justin Welan said regrettably, “If Jack were here, he could slap a Level 8 Giant Beast to death with one palm.”
“No worries, with me here, it’s the same. Today, watch me, Howard Lambert, dominate and blast that Level 8 Giant Beast head-on,” declared Howard.
Dressed in ferocious battle armor studded with sharp spikes, and carrying a ten-meter-long, half-meter-thick black iron column on his shoulder, Lambert’s face showed a look of excitement.
“`
Roar!
The crack, which had already spread to 400 meters, trembled and emitted a fierce roar; following that, a massive shadow of a beast descended from the sky.
Boom!
The 30-plus-meter-wide street crumbled, buildings on either side collapsed, and a violent shockwave whipped up a storm of broken stones and dust, the noise terrifying.
In the center of the decimated street stood a beast, a hundred meters tall, covered in red scales, and resembling a Furious Ape, exuding an air of brute violence.
However, at this moment, the four-armed Eighth Level Beast, with its fierce and grim visage, seemed somewhat bedraggled; many deep, bone-revealing wounds covered its body, from which blood spurted ceaselessly.
Roar!
Sensing the ‘thin’ energy between heaven and earth, as well as the unfamiliar environment, the Eighth Level Beast let out a roar as a show of defiance, its blood-red eyes staring toward the crowded throngs in the distance.
For Giant Beast Type Creatures, eating while wounded can speed up their recovery, especially in an environment where Heavenly Energy is thin.
Just as the Four-Armed Violent Ape was about to act, two powerful auras erupted from afar.
“Howard Lambert, strike with full force, and execute this beast on the spot,” Laurant Harris said, unleashing a long howl as an aura of the late Eighth Layer burst forth from him, shooting up into the sky.
Boom!
Laurant Harris appeared hundreds of meters above the Violent Ape in an instant, and the Sword Qi on his three-meter-long black war sword surged, transforming into a hundred-meter-long streak of black Sword Qi.
Roar! The Violent Ape roared ferociously as it witnessed the Sword Qi descending from above, its body erupting in a red radiance that covered a 200-meter radius, forming a domain.
This is the difference between Giant Beasts and humans; an Eighth Level Beast can develop a domain, albeit a nascent one with limited range, but its power is formidable.
The moment the Sword Qi released by Laurant Harris entered the red domain, its speed abruptly slowed, hampered by a force of great heaviness.
Boom! With a sweep of its four arms, the Violent Ape shattered the black Sword Qi, and its blood-red eyes revealed coldness, savagery, and a hint of mockery.
“Do you think I, the head instructor, earned my title for nothing?”
In a calm voice, Laurant Harris formed a sword seal with his hands, and the shattered black Sword Qi instantly reassembled, becoming strands of several meters long black Sword Light slashing horizontally.
Puchi Puchi!!
The sharp black Sword Qi, peerless in its sharpness, tore through invisible red radiance as it passed, immediately weakening the oppressive force around it.
Just as the domain of the Four-Armed Violent Ape was disrupted by Laurant Harris’s Sword Qi, another powerful momentum exploded in the distance.
“Your opponent is me.”
Howard Lambert, standing on a crumbling rooftop, shot into the sky, his figure swelling in the air, transforming into a thirty-meter-tall silhouette enveloped by a black and red aura of Killing Intent.
The iron column in Howard Lambert’s hand also grew enormously, reaching a hundred meters in length, like a mountain pillar sweeping across with rolling black waves to crash down, exploding the atmosphere in an instant.
Roar! Unable to evade in time, the Violent Ape brought together its four arms.
Boom! Under the crushing strike of terrifying power, the Violent Ape was hammered dozens of meters into the earth, the surrounding streets exploding into rubble, and countless stones and dirt shot skywards.
The shockwave formed a ring of explosive force, sweeping out in a circle, shattering every window within a kilometer radius.
“Be careful, block that impact,” Crystal Lewis exclaimed as True Strength burst from her, shielding in front of the ordinary people still in the process of evacuating far away, tearing through the gusting waves.
Even the residual waves of a battle at the Eight Layer could knock people a kilometer away off their feet and to their deaths.
Just as Howard Lambert’s frontal strike bore down on the Violent Ape, Laurant Harris merged with his sword, becoming over a hundred meters of Sword Light ripping through the air.
Puchi!
Under the merciless Sword Light, the Violent Ape’s scale armor shattered, its two left arms were chopped off, and scorching hot blood gushed out like a fountain.
Roar! The Violent Ape let out a pained scream…
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1088 - 1088 443 The Return of the King of Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1088: Chapter 443 The Return of the King of Divine Martial, Jack Clark Chapter 1088: Chapter 443 The Return of the King of Divine Martial, Jack Clark “East Planet Commander, Jack Clark!!”
