By the power of the rules of the Sky-based God King, combined with the links to satellite base stations, a virtual network space covering the globe was formed, where nine king-level figures sat high upon their thrones.
When they received the special assignment from the Three Great Speakers, most of the kings were taken aback.
One of the kings, who had been stationed in the Blue Star World for a long time, expressed surprise, “Has Jack Clark made his breakthrough to the king level?”
Among the nine, Marcellus Larry nodded, “Yes, he made his breakthrough one day ago.”
The king who had attended the King’s Conference before was quite shocked, “That means he really managed to break the record of reaching the Myth level in one year!”
A female king paused and somewhat speechless, said, “… Turus, that’s not really our focus here, is it?”
“With the talent of Jack Clark, his breakthrough to the king level is to be expected. What surprises me is that he’s been appointed the Eastern Half-planet Commander, given the title of General.”
It wasn’t that this king looked down on Jack Clark, but everyone seated was an old strong man, the weakest among them being at the mid period king realm, including Marcellus Larry, who had combat strength comparable to those at the Ninth Heaven Peak.
In such a situation, appointing Jack Clark to command the Eastern Half-planet stirred some discontent.
Marcellus Larry slowly explained, “I was a bit surprised by his appointment at first, but after you all review his newly updated profile, I believe you will have no objections.”
“He completed another King-level contribution mission?” The other kings were startled.
Generally, one’s profile is only updated after making significant contributions to the Federation, detailing achievements like a resume, accessible to all with the right permissions.
After this was mentioned, the projections of the nine kings dimmed as they logged off to check Jack Clark’s freshly updated personal profile.
And then their faces showed shock.
After successfully Opening the Heavens, mastering the Supreme Law, and breaking through to the king level, he stormed into the Divine Gods Alliance. With his own strength, he destroyed four Divine Realms, slaying four mid-period Myth beings and one Mythical Peak demon king.
Additionally, he achieved all this through direct confrontations bolstered by the Divine Realm, displaying invincible combat power comparable to a Heavenly King.
While the powerhouses on Blue Star were astounded by Jack Clark’s battle records, Jack himself was looking at the huge screen, momentarily confused by the phrase “all grown up.”
What did “all grown up” mean?
Was it referring to ‘Person’ growing up or something else, somewhere else?
Cough cough!! What am I thinking about? Jack shook his head to clear the strange thought that had suddenly popped into his mind, after all, the Primordial True King said there was nothing to worry about.
At this moment, Cloud Sky One had entered the radiation range of the 30th Army Group and connected to the Federation Information Network, instantly causing the screen to display a new image.
It was an assignment decree from the alliance, appointing “King of Divine Martial” Jack Clark as the Eastern Half-planet Commander, in charge of controlling the military forces of various nations, while also granting him the title of General.
Because Jack had not yet been granted an official king-level title before his incursion into the Divine Gods Alliance, the Heavenly Core Intelligence Agency, while updating his profile, temporarily bestowed upon him the title of “Divine Martial.”
This title “Divine Martial” was derived from the title “Unrivaled Divine Might, Unparalleled Under Heaven” he had earned when he swept through the Southern Battlefield.
“King of Divine Martial, not bad,” Jack murmured softly, feeling that although the title wasn’t very domineering, it seemed decent enough.
Then, Jack’s gaze fell on the gold-lettered title ‘General’ to the side, revealing a faint smile on his face.
The military ranks within the Federation were related to cultivation levels and the contributions one had made. For example, Eight Layer Heaven cultivators were typically colonels, Nine Layers Heaven were Major Generals, and Mythical Kings were Lieutenant Generals.
However, those with exceptional contributions, such as Eight Layer Heaven cultivators, could be appointed as Major Generals. For instance, those at Sixth Layer had joined the mission to Suppress the Evil God and managed to kill two Evil God Clones.
Besides, some supreme beings at the peak of Nine Layers were also exceptionally appointed as Lieutenant Generals when commanding an army group.
After all, while cultivators were mighty, not all were fit to manage and command a military group; more often, they served as high-end military assets.
Beyond this, Jack Clark was only granted the authority to control military forces, separate from the official local departments.
As a result, although Jack was appointed the Total Commander of the Eastern Half-planet, he only had authority over military forces and could not interfere with the official management of various nations at will.
But even then, the news was shocking to everyone.
A seventeen-year-old king, with a General’s rank and East Planet Commander title—such news would surely dazzle Doris Clark, who would certainly want to pay tribute to the Clark Family Ancestral Tomb.
After all, the most significant ‘official’ position within the Clark Family records over the last hundred years was held by his great-grandfather who became a village chief.
Soon enough, the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet returned to the 30th Army Group’s base.
Here, Jack made a brief stop to allocate the four space equipment items and most of the resources to the Shepherd Army. Afterwards, he piloted the fighter aircraft and left again.
Under the night sky, a silver vortex towering a kilometer high stood between heaven and earth. Outside the pathway, was the busy and bustling No.1 Channel Logistics Base City.
The industrial area of the Base City was brightly illuminated as countless mechanical factories worked overtime, producing missiles, Unmanned Mechs, Unmanned Fighters, and ammunition.
At the same time, in the suburbs, giant transport planes took off every moment, trains shuttled back and forth, with flying giant beasts escorting the transport of vast amounts of supplies and ammunition to the Sky Curtain Battlefield.
At that moment, under the cloak of night, a dark red menacing fighter aircraft appeared. After being recognized by the air defense signal, it flew in front of the pathway and gently touched down with a hot blast of air.
Click! The cockpit opened, and Jack Clark, dressed in a black leisure suit, stepped out. Though he suppressed his Aura, his every move still exuded an intangible pressure.
As he moved around, the Heavenly Energy became intensely active, fluctuating with his every breath, as if saluting him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089 - 1089 443 King of Divine Martial Jack Clarks
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1089: Chapter 443 King of Divine Martial, Jack Clark’s Return_2 Chapter 1089: Chapter 443 King of Divine Martial, Jack Clark’s Return_2 Such a miraculous scene made the middle-aged strong man in the Ninth Heavens shudder, daring not to neglect, he courteously said to Jack Clark, “I have seen King Clark.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “I have urgent business back on Blue Star; could you please shut down the firepower blockade?”
For the Human Alliance, the three channels connecting the mythical world were extremely important, each end not only had strong men stationed but also covered by firepower controlled by intelligent brains.
Normally, whether it was the transportation of supplies or the comings and goings of kings, everyone needed to register and report.
Henric Logan politely said, “I already received the order that King Clark would be passing through. The firepower system was shut down when the fighter aircraft landed, and it’s ready for you to pass through at any time.”
“Thank you.”
Jack Clark smiled faintly and then his left wrist radiated light as he stored the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet into subspace, subsequently transforming into a golden ray of light that rushed into the silver vortex ahead.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark entered Channel One, the entire pathway trembled under his ‘vast’ essence.
…
Blue Star
At the First Channel Base, a towering kilometer-high Silver Vortex trembled violently, emitting dazzling silver halos that spread in all directions.
Within the violent spatial shock, a young man’s silhouette slowly emerged, with a head of black hair waving without wind behind him, permeated with a heavy and terrifying pressure.
A hundred meters away, Marcellus Larry, who had been waiting, smiled, “Congratulations on your breakthrough to Myth, ascending to the throne; from now on, I shall call you King Clark.”
Jack Clark shook his head, “Thrones and such are for outsiders to address me by, Senior Marcellus, you can just call me Jack or Jack Clark.”
Jacks attitude toward these seniors who had helped him in the past remained humble and polite, unchanged by the increase in his strength.
Especially King Marcellus, who had helped him apply for many precious resources during his breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven, Life Crystals, Rule Forbidden Weapons.
Part of these resources were due to the talent he had displayed, but some were extra applications, including the two additional Rule Forbidden Weapons.
It was precisely because he held four Rule Forbidden Weapons that Jack Clark had the confidence to traverse the mythical world, successively suppressing multiple demon kings.
Otherwise, if he only had the Space-Time Summoning Technique as his trump card, he would have been much more low-key since at that time the Giant Beast Avatar was only comparable to an ordinary Heavenly King Level powerhouse.
Such strength against a direct hit from that Demon God would either leave him undead or heavily injured.
However, at that time, the blow from Lewus Demon God was deliberately not ‘intercepted’ with full strength by the Sky-based God King and others.
They knew that Jack Clark had the Star Ring, which could block that strike, so they burst forth with full strength when Lewus made his move, destroying one of its rule body’s arms.
It was the same with another Demon God that struck and heavily injured the rampaging Number One; Gabriel King had mentioned this to Jack Clark.
At that time, because Freya Louise and Number One’s Soul Synchronization Rate was too high, to avoid a complete loss of control, they deliberately allowed that Demon God to deal a heavy blow to Number One, breaking its growth rhythm.
Although the purpose of Number One reaching the Frontline Battlefield was to devour flesh and blood souls to grow, this growth pace had to match Freya Louise’s increase in strength.
As for why that Demon God was allowed to strike, it was naturally to avoid triggering Number One’s instinctive hostility.
Number One, while lacking autonomous consciousness, was not an inanimate object, still retaining some basic animal instincts, which is also why it didn’t actively attack humans while rampaging.
In the office, Marcellus Larry manipulated the star planet projection in front of him, which was covered with red and black dots, and introduced it.
“In preparation for the second impact from the mythical world, we were well prepared, and under precise positioning of Spatial Fluctuations, this Heaven-Earth Mutated event didn’t result in too much casualty.”
“However, despite our preparations, the random appearance of Space Cracks still caused some trouble.”
“For example, the Heavenly Energy that surged over from those cracks in high pressure, in less than a day, tripled the concentration of Blue Star’s Heavenly Energy.”
“That is indeed a problem,” Jack Clark nodded.
The higher the concentration of Blue Star’s Heavenly Energy, under normal conditions, the more beneficial it is for humans, as more individuals with cultivation qualifications will appear. But a sudden surge could be troublesome.
Because the energy from the mythical world had a stronger effect on animals with weak self-restraint in their soul consciousness.
A short-period surge in concentration could cause countless creatures to mutate and evolve into powerful Mutated Beasts, even Level 1 creatures could pose substantial danger to ordinary people.
Especially when the numbers were vast.
As he spoke, Marcellus Larry moved the star planet projection in front of him, “The first wave of the highest intensity shock has passed, and more than twelve thousand cracks have appeared.”
“Most of these detected cracks are temporary, appearing for only a short while before disappearing, with only over a thousand being relatively stable.”
“Under the intervention of the military’s strong men, most of these pathways were forcibly destroyed, with only about a dozen of Level 10 pathways preserved, waiting to be stabilized before exploring the other side.”
“If the other side is linked to a place of value, it will be preserved; otherwise, it will be destroyed.”
“In addition to this, during this impact, one Mythical-level Giant Beast, seven Level 9, and thirty-seven Level 8 Giant Beasts as well as several different races emerged from these passages.”
“The Giant Beasts have been entirely slain, the seven different races suppressed, and we are currently trying to interrogate and communicate with them to see if we can obtain some useful information.”
“The Blue Star of today is not the same as fifty years ago,” Marcellus Larry said with a faint smile on his face, which quickly turned solemn.

chapters.title: Chapter 1090 - 1090 443 King of Divine Martial Jack Clarks
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1090: Chapter 443 King of Divine Martial, Jack Clark’s Return_3 Chapter 1090: Chapter 443 King of Divine Martial, Jack Clark’s Return_3 The planetary projection shifted to a dark region.
“This is a stable channel in formation, reaching level 13. Its load-bearing capacity is sufficient to allow Heavenly King-level beings to pass through, which is why you were called back,”
“If a Titan-level Giant Beast comes through when the channel forms, you will need to engage and repel or slay it, then investigate the situation on the other side,”
“If the linked location poses a threat to the Human Race, you and Heavenly King Ares will join forces to destroy it,”
In addition to a detailed briefing on the current situation and international preparations, Marcellus Larry also shared information about other king-level defenders and reinforcements.
By the time their conversation concluded, over an hour had passed.
With the information provided earlier by the Heavenly Think Tank and now from Marcellus Larry, Jack had a detailed understanding of the current situation on Blue Star.
Using the large number of data points from excavated alien ruins and the pattern of the Mythical Impact from fifty years ago, it is estimated that the current shock wave will last for about ten days.
Before his return, a division of tasks was completed during a meeting attended by more than thirty military base leaders, under the oversight of the nine Mythical Kings and Heavenly King Ares.
The entire Blue Star was divided into eastern and western halves based on the detected spatial fluctuations and the areas with the highest probability of forming cracks, forming over three hundred defense zones.
These zones were anchored by six kings, branching out and assigned according to threat level to twenty-one Nine Layers experts, more than fifty Eight Layer experts, and several hundred Seventh Layer High Order Powerhouses.
As for Jack and another Heavenly King, they were mainly responsible for deterrence and oversight, which actually didn’t involve much on a regular basis.
Therefore, after concluding his business, Jack took his leave, preparing to return to Mist River City.
For there was a space channel reaching level 10 in formation, and he wanted to check on Glenn’s situation as well.
“Calling the Heavenly Central Control Tower, Cloud Sky One requests passage through the Circular Barrier,”
“Control Tower received. The barrier will now be unsealed. Please ensure Cloud Sky One passes through within three minutes…”
Accompanied by the electronic voice, an invisible curtain in the sky slowly split open, forming a rift hundreds of meters long, exposing the darkened night sky of the outside world.
Whoosh!
The fighter aircraft, belching fiery exhaust, rocketed into the sky. In the blink of an eye, it pierced the enchantment’s crack with sonic booms at several times the speed of sound, vanishing into the night.
Just past eight in the evening, in the courtyard of the Clark family.
Under the light, the colossal figure of Glenn, six meters tall and with a full beard, swung his fists excitedly. Each punch he threw caused an explosion in the air before him, creating violent wind waves.
Doris Clark stood at the door, her face showing a tinge of melancholy as she watched the scene.
Just before evening, her second son was fine, yet on his return, he had transformed into a mini-giant, and his face now sported a thick black beard.
Had her psychological endurance not strengthened considerably, she might have fainted on the spot.
At that moment, Glenn, equivalent to the height of a two-story building, stopped, looking down at Doris with a deep, booming voice: “Mom, why hasn’t Jack come back yet?”
“Not so soon,”
Doris shook her head. “Didn’t Colonel Davis say earlier? Your brother is rushing back from the mythical world; he won’t be here until tomorrow at the earliest,”
After Glenn’s near mishap, the person in charge of covert protection had to reveal his identity and ensure Doris that Glenn was fine.
To further reassure Doris, the Eighth Layer Expert also mentioned Jack’s imminent return and told her Jack had a way to restore Glenn to normal.
However, tactfully, he did not disclose that Jack had achieved a breakthrough in the mythical world.
But even so, the news delighted Doris and Glenn, who waited in the courtyard, and of course, Glenn couldn’t fit into the house, even if he wanted to.
In his boredom, Glenn noticed a flash of light streak across the sky: “Mom, look, there is an airplane in the sky.”
Before Doris could respond, Glenn, with his remarkable eyesight, suddenly became excited: “Mom, that airplane seems to be heading towards our house, it must be Jack coming back.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1091 - 1091 444 The Kings Return Shock Them Tomorrow
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1091: Chapter 444: The King’s Return, Shock Them Tomorrow (8K) Chapter 1091: Chapter 444: The King’s Return, Shock Them Tomorrow (8K) Jack Clark’s family was in an old neighborhood, where, despite some new faces recently, most of the previous neighbors were still around.
At this time, just past eight o’clock in the evening, with a gentle autumn breeze, middle-aged and elderly people were taking leisurely walks in the small park, some walking their dogs and children.
Just then, a humming vibration came from high above.
In the distance above the Clark residence, a fighter aircraft that was seventy meters long with four wings appeared.
On the menacing dark red fuselage of the aircraft, dark red rune haloes radiated, instantly drawing the attention of everyone around, making them instinctively look up.
At that moment, an invisible oppressive force from the bones of the Mythical Giant Beast permeated the area, causing everyone to instinctively tremble, their legs weaken, and they began to gasp for air with their hands over their chests.
The pet dogs were all cowering on the ground with tails between their legs, making whimpering sounds of fear.
And this was at a time when the Giant Beast material had already been refined into a fighter aircraft, and its aura was almost completely contained.
Although for the current Jack and the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Mythical Giant Beasts were nothing more than a bite of food, for ordinary people, they were incredibly terrifying creatures.
For example, the kilometer-long python that appeared in the Aohedi Sea several decades ago swallowed a million people before withstanding three nuclear bombs and countless missile strikes, before leaving with only light injuries.
At this moment, all the nearby people were shocked, staring at the menacing fighter aircraft hovering a hundred meters above the Clark residence.
Under the glow of the rune haloes, the hatch of the aircraft opened, and a black-haired young man stepped out of the void and slowly descended.
Because of the glow from the runes emitted by the fighter, the old people in the nearby park recognized Jack Clark, which immediately stirred them up.
“That seems to be the Cultivation Genius from the Clark family?”
“Jack Clark has returned.”
“Hiss! It’s really Jack Clark. I heard only those Stronger than the Eighth Layer Heavens can tread the Void. Has he already made a breakthrough to the Eight Layer?”
“He must be at the Eight Layer by now. My nephew in the enforcement squad mentioned that Jack Clark is our South’s number one genius, attracting the attention of top military figures.”
“It’s said that with his talent, he has the hope of breaking through to king-level within ten years, becoming a major figure who commands the entire Federation.”
All of a sudden, the group of seniors chatting and relaxing under the tree became more enthusiastic as they spoke.
One of the old men said enviously, “The Clark family’s ancestors must be smoking green smoke in their graves, having produced such a monstrous genius who could protect their family for three generations.”
Another retired professor shook his head, “Not just three generations, it should be for hundreds or thousands of years.”
“A king stands tall in myth, reportedly free from the limitations of life. As long as they do not die, their family’s younger generation will be akin to royalty, enjoying wealth and glory.”
With the chaos of Koroya and the information about True Martial increasingly being released online, a lot of experts have made common people more aware of True Martial.
They knew that each of the few dozen king-level figures standing at the pinnacle of the Federation were akin to deities, not only wielding the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth but also possessing infinite life spans.
Immediately, these seniors playing chess and minding toddlers grew contemplative, who could have thought that just last year the sick eldest son of the Clark family would become such a big shot in the blink of an eye.
As the surrounding onlookers watched in astonishment, Cloud Sky One turned into a stream of red radiance and was sucked into Jack’s left wrist subspace bracelet; then he gently descended.
Seeing his excited mother, Doris Clark, Jack’s face broke into a kind smile, “Mom, I’m back.”
“It’s good you’re back, good that you’re back,” Doris nodded excitedly.
Looking at Jack, who now had an aura of nobility as if a celestial being had descended to the mortal world compared to a few months ago, Doris felt somewhat dazed. Was this really her son?
At that moment, Glenn Clark, who stood six meters tall like a small giant, excitedly boomed, “Bro, look, I’ve gotten so big, I’m really strong now.”
Then, Glenn swung his thick arms, stirring up the air into a raging wind that made Jack’s hair flutter.
Jack naturally couldn’t miss Glenn’s large figure, but looking at his current appearance, the corner of his mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
Due to his sudden increase in size and the absence of scalable battle armor, Glenn’s clothes had long since been ripped apart, and he was now wrapped around the waist with a white bedsheet.
Combined with his bulging muscles, which made him resemble Zhang Fei with a full beard, he looked like a wild giant who had just run out of some forest.
Even though it was somewhat eye-watering, seeing that Glenn was his brother, Jack couldn’t help but ask, “Jim, how did you get like this?”
Touching the back of his head, Glenn answered somewhat sheepishly, “Didn’t I go fishing every evening? Today, when I reached the outskirts carrying the barbecue grill to the riverside…”
Glenn then detailed to Jack everything that had happened earlier.
Like how a crack appeared in the sky and a huge Beast head fell down, and that his school’s PE teacher turned out to be a High-Ranking Powerhouse.
As for the reason he grew so much, it was related to the now-dead Giant Beast’s head.
The Giant Beast’s head had held a stone about 0.5 meters in size that glowed in its mouth. While waiting for official personnel to come deal with the beast after mom called them, Glenn, curious about the stone, climbed into the Giant Beast’s mouth.
At the moment he touched it, the white stone turned into a liquid radiance and merged into his body.
Here, Glenn’s excitement was evident, showing no fear, “At that moment, I felt a powerful force explode inside me, my body began to swell, and I was filled with strength.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1092 - 1092 444 The King Returns Give Them a Shock
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1092: Chapter 444: The King Returns, Give Them a Shock Tomorrow (8K)_2 Chapter 1092: Chapter 444: The King Returns, Give Them a Shock Tomorrow (8K)_2 “Teacher Reid and a gentleman who arrived later helped me check, and they said that my transformation was due to the absorption of special talent resources,” Jack Clark said.
“As soon as I absorb that special energy, or if someone stronger helps me forcibly fuse this energy with my body, I can return to normal,” he added.
Special Talent Resources. A trace of surprise flashed in Jack’s eyes.
Special Talent Resources, as the name implies, are god-level resources containing talent, similar to innate runes but one level lower.
This type of Innate Divine Object, like innate runes, can be absorbed and merged directly as long as it is compatible, with no strength requirements.
“Give me your hand, let me take a look,” Jack said.
“Okay.”
Glenn Clark obediently placed his huge palm in front of Jack Clark.
Jack grabbed his hand and instantly, a powerful Divine Soul Intent swept across Glenn’s entire body, sensing a powerful special power circulating within him.
This power was similar to bloodline strength, slowly merging with and transforming Glenn’s body and genes, as his life structure evolved toward a much more powerful being.
However, this process was very slow, and it was estimated to take at least a full month to complete the fusion.
Boom!
A terrifying Power Explosion erupted from Jack, as a stream of pure golden Law Divine Power in his hand continuously decomposed, diluted, and turned into gentle and pure energy, pouring into Glenn’s body.
As he channeled the Law Divine Power, an invisible sense of overbearing presence spread from Jack, shaking the ground for hundreds of meters around and causing the buildings to tremble slightly, even though he was restraining his strength.
Under the Unrivaled Domination of the Law Divine Power, the special energy within Glenn’s body instantly dispersed, spreading throughout his muscles, bones, and cells, slowly merging into one.
As the talent energy continued to be absorbed and fused, Glenn’s body gradually began to shrink, and after about ten minutes, he had returned to his normal height of 2 meters.
Only then did Jack slowly retract his power.
Looking at his transformed hand, an excited Glenn Clark looked at Jack and said, “Bro, you’re amazing. Now I can finally go to school tomorrow.”
Seeing Glenn, still with a full face of beard, talking about going to school the next day made Jack twitch at the corner of his mouth, then he changed the subject: “Jim, try transforming into the Giant Form and give me a punch,” he suggested.
“I want to see how strong you are in that form.”
“Alright, bro, let me think about it,” agreed Glenn.
Glenn clenched his fists and took a deep breath, paused briefly, and with a thought, he activated the newly emerged power inside him.
Boom!
Glenn’s size exploded; in the blink of an eye, he had reverted to a 6-meter-tall Giant Form, and involuntarily entered the Innate Overlord Body state, his whole body covered in Black Gold radiance.
In an instant, an incredible overbearing aura of strength spread from Glenn, compressing the surrounding air until it burst, creating gusts of wind blowing in all directions, sending Jack’s long hair flying wildly.
“Bro, be careful,” Glenn said with a low shout as his right arm’s muscles suddenly swelled, endless strength converging into his Black Gold radiant right hand, unleashing a punch.
Boom!
Glenn’s gigantic fist, like a massive cannon, blasted out at Subsonic Speed, the formidable force compressing the air in front, forming a visible shockwave in front of Jack.
Thud!
The huge fist hit Jack’s palm with a dull thud, the impact of the mighty force causing the surrounding air to explode into a gale sweeping across the courtyard, causing Doris Clark to cover her eyes and retreat continuously.
Despite the punch’s formidable force, it failed to move Jack an inch, not even ruffling the hem of his clothes.
Instead, the rebound force made Glenn’s hand sting a bit, and as he rubbed his hand, he excitedly asked, “How about that, bro? Am I strong now?”
“Not bad,” Jack nodded.
With the combination of the Innate Overlord Body talent and the Giant Talent, Glenn’s punch reached a terrifying impact force of a hundred tons.
Excluding the boost from subsonic kinetic energy, his arm strength in Giant Form should be around twenty-odd tons, surpassing the limit of Fourth Layer Heaven and comparable to a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator’s combat prowess.
Of course, this comparison only refers to Power Explosion; if facing a real Fifth Layer Heaven strong man, he definitely wouldn’t be a match.
But even so, it was astonishing.
Compared to a year ago, when Jack himself was weak and even cultivating the Basic Body Forging Technique once took an hour, Glenn was truly the Child of Destiny of this era.
With his Innate Awakening of the Tyrant Body comparable to that of an Innate Awakened One, and the special Giant Talent that fell from the sky, allowing him to maximize his strength and Defense to the extreme.
Without cultivating, his pure strength was already comparable to a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator. If he later cultivated a matching True Martial Arts and acquired True Strength, it would be even more terrifying.
Later, once he established his Foundation in one day, condensed True Strength and broke through to the Second Layer, a week for the Third, and a month for the Fourth Layer Heaven…
At this thought, even Jack’s eyes revealed astonishment. Compared to himself, Glenn was truly the Child of Destiny of this era.
After all, if it wasn’t for Jack’s awakened memories and the activation of his Soul Split talent a year ago, he would have died of high fever in the hospital; thus, there wouldn’t be a future.
At this moment, Jack suddenly said, “Jim, stop playing, go back to the room and put on some pants.”
With the two transformations, the bedsheet that Glenn had wrapped around his waist had long fallen to the ground, and he now stood in front of Jack in the buff, which was a sight for sore eyes.
Instantly Glenn instinctively covered himself, somewhat embarrassed.
A few minutes later, in the living room, Jack Clark and Doris Clark sat on the sofa, chatting. Jack briefly mentioned some incidents about entering the Void Relic Continent and the mythical world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - 1093 444 The King Returns Give Them a Shock
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1093: Chapter 444: The King Returns, Give Them a Shock Tomorrow (8K)_3 Chapter 1093: Chapter 444: The King Returns, Give Them a Shock Tomorrow (8K)_3 Of course, such ‘reports’ naturally focused on the positive aspects, such as sweeping through the Void Relics and entering the mythical world to swiftly kill two demon kings and so on.
Glen Clark, now changed into fresh clothes and having shaved off his beard, came downstairs and flopped onto the sofa opposite, picking up an apple from the coffee table.
After taking a bite of the apple, Glen Clark looked curiously at Jack Clark, “Bro, you must have made a breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens by now, right?”
More than three months ago, when Jack left, he had already made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer. Coupled with the recent display of descending through the air, Glenn felt his brother must have broken through to the Ninth Heavens.
As for the Eighth Layer, that would be a joke; his brother was the top genius of the South, so three months couldn’t possibly mean he only advanced one layer.
Half a year had passed, and some senior students from the Southern Battlefield gradually returned to attend their graduation ceremonies. At the same time, they brought back the legend of Jack Clark sweeping through the Southern Battlefield, becoming the number one genius in the South.
At these words, Doris Clark also became curious.
“I’ve already achieved king-level.”
“King-level?” Glenn Clark subconsciously nodded but then he abruptly stood up, his eyes wide with disbelief, “Bro, what did you just say, king-level!!”
Jack Clark smiled and nodded, “Yes, king-level.”
Cough cough!! Doris Clark was so shocked she choked on her saliva. Jack quickly reached out and patted her on the back, allowing his invisible power to help her catch her breath.
“Mom, it’s just king-level, no need to be so excited.”
Compared to Doris Clark, Glenn had a stronger capacity to accept such news because, in his heart, Jack had always been the strongest. After the initial shock, he became excited.
“Bro, I knew you were the most awesome! King-level, huh? Wait till I tell Teresa Wilson at school tomorrow, she’ll definitely be surprised.”
…This guy, the first thing he thinks of is to share the news with a female classmate.
Right then, Jack Clark spoke with casual ease, “Not only have I broken through to king-level, but I’ve also returned in the capacity of the Eastern Half-planet Commander, controlling the military forces of various countries.”
“And because I entered the mythical world and subsequently slew several demon kings and two Evil Gods, my military rank has been promoted to General.”
“Commander, General!” This time, Doris Clark stood up straight away, her face flushed and her eyes wide with shock.
Even Glenn trembled, causing the apple he bit into to fall onto the floor.
King-level represented Jack Clark’s cultivation and strength, while the General rank and position of Eastern Half-planet Commander signified power and status, standing above billions of people.
Doris Clark seemed bewildered, “Jim, did I hear that right, your brother is a General now?”
“You heard right, Bro never lies.”
Watching the two astonished and bewildered, a smile also appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
That feeling of shocking and making his family proud was truly satisfying. Compared to showing off in front of strangers, making his family happy was more important.
At that moment, with tears welling up in her eyes, Doris Clark suddenly said, “Jack, Jim, let’s go back to our hometown next week.”
Glenn was a bit puzzled, “Mom, why are we going back to the countryside?”
“To pay respects to your father and clean the Clark Family Ancestral Tomb. Let them know that our Clark Family has produced a General, and a seventeen-year-old General at that.”
As she spoke, Doris Clark’s face was filled with pride and a joyful smile from deep within her heart.
These years, she raised the two brothers alone, ensuring they didn’t stray and instead achieve accomplishments that would shake everyone.
Jack nodded, “Okay, we’ll make time to go back.”
After waiting for the two to calm their emotions a bit, Jack Clark then looked at Glenn, “Jim, do you want to transfer schools directly to the Martial Arts School and start Cultivating True Martial Arts?”
“Transfer to the Martial Arts School for cultivation?” Glenn looked confused.
Jack Clark said, “Yes, because of your Giant Transformation Talent, your body, or life form, has stabilized, and you can start cultivation.”
Previously, when Jack Clark helped Glenn refine that bloodline talent, he also checked the awakening state of his Innate Overlord Body and found that he had ‘matured’.
This maturity was not referring to height or physique, but that his genes, cells, and life form were stable.
This was also why True Martial needed students to enter high school at sixteen before beginning cultivation, as the overbearing power of True Martial could cause genetic mutations and catastrophic transformation.
Yet, faced with the temptation of cultivation, Glenn hesitated, “Bro, I do want to cultivate True Martial, but can I not transfer schools?”
Jack shook his head, “Of course not, otherwise without proper guidance, you might encounter problems in your cultivation. I can only stay on Blue Star for about ten more days before I have to leave.”
Cultivating True Martial definitely requires attending a Martial Arts School with a complete education system; otherwise, one would easily encounter difficulties trying to learn by oneself at home.
At the Martial Arts School, they teach not only cultivation methods and combat techniques but also various cultivation knowledge, basic information, and systemic knowledge about Unique Beasts and other aspects of the Outer World.
Glenn rubbed the back of his head, “Then…Bro, what if I go to the Martial Arts School in the morning and return to junior high in the afternoon, would that work?”
“Do you think I own the school?” Jack was speechless.
At the same time, he was puzzled, unsure why his brother wanted to stay in junior high. Hadn’t he always wanted to start Cultivating True Martial?
As Glenn became increasingly embarrassed under Jack’s questioning gaze, the Television Station in the distance switched its coverage.
“Hello everyone, I’m Smile, the host from Mist River Television Station. We now interrupt our regular programming to deliver an important news update regarding the recent Heaven-Earth Mutated incident.”
“According to the latest Federal news release that just concluded, this Heaven-Earth Mutated incident is indeed similar to the one fifty years ago, with a sudden Burst of numerous cracks linking to the mythical world occurring across the globe.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - 1094 444 The King Returns Give Them a Shock
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1094: Chapter 444: The King Returns, Give Them a Shock Tomorrow (8K)_4 Chapter 1094: Chapter 444: The King Returns, Give Them a Shock Tomorrow (8K)_4 “In today’s peak outbreak, over ten thousand cracks appeared globally, from which many powerful Giant Beasts emerged, causing great turmoil,”
“But we are not the same as we were fifty years ago, the Federation was well-prepared for such incidents and immediately suppressed all the Giant Beasts.”
“In this event, there were only a little over three hundred injured globally, with no fatalities. Most of those injured were journalists from the media, who got too close and were caught in the aftermath of the battles.”
“The person in charge of the press conference reported that the Federation has both the confidence and the strength to suppress this mutation. Everyone is advised not to panic and not to believe any doomsday proclamations.”
“According to expert predictions, this aberration will continue for five to ten days.”
“During this period, if you hear air raid sirens, please evacuate according to the instructions of law enforcement officers and do not gather out of curiosity, which may cause unnecessary casualties.”
“Please value your life and stay away from the battle scene.”
“Also, if you find someone maliciously spreading doomsday messages or promoting the Evil God Sect online or offline, please call the police immediately, the emergency number is 028.88888888.”
“The above is a summary of the information released by the Federation News Office. Next up is the local news from Mist River City.”
As she said this, the screen behind the female presenter changed to show a street scene amidst ruins.
There, lights flickered as many people busied themselves in the rubble, with law enforcement officers on guard in the distance.
“This afternoon at 7 pm, a Giant Beast a hundred meters tall and at the Level 8 Mid Stage appeared in the South Bridge Area and was killed by a cultivator from South Sky Martial Height.”
“Although the battle was brief, it caused significant damage to the surrounding streets. At the moment, firefighters and construction teams are working hard to deal with the aftermath.”
“In this battle, the teachers and students of South Sky Martial Arts School made outstanding contributions. Mr. Laurant Harris, the head instructor, and Mr. Howard Lambert were the main forces in the fight.”
At this point, the female presenter’s tone became somewhat excited: “You definitely wouldn’t have guessed that Mr. Howard Lambert, who overwhelmingly suppressed the Eighth Level Beast, is only seventeen years old.”
“Yes, you heard right, Mr. Howard Lambert is just seventeen and a high school sophomore. He made a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven in just one year.”
As soon as the female presenter finished speaking, everyone sitting in front of the TV was shocked and amazed.
“Mr. Howard Lambert is currently on site assisting with the post-battle cleanup. In addition to him, there are a large number of Martial School Students and military soldiers. Next, we will connect to the scene,” she said.
As she spoke, the screen transitioned to a reporter holding a microphone.
“Hello, Xiao Jie, can you tell us about the situation on site?”
“Thanks to the efforts of all parties involved, we are about to complete the initial cleanup of the South Bridge Street.”
The slightly coy female reporter smiled at the camera, “In addition, the residents whose houses were destroyed are fairly stable emotionally and have been evacuated to temporary shelters.”
“That’s good to hear, Xiao Jie. I heard Mr. Howard Lambert is also at the site. Could you interview him for us?”
“Sure.” Saying so, the female reporter jogged over to a nearby spot.
Under the temporary laser lighting, Howard Lambert, 2.5 meters tall and muscular, wearing black ferocious battle armor, was slightly bent over, grabbing the edge of a collapsed concrete slab.
Boom! A floor slab weighing over a thousand tons and buried under many heavy objects was sent flying, crashing down not far away, kicking up smoke and dust and shaking the ground.
This scene made ordinary people watching the TV suck in a breath of cold air; lifting an entire floor effortlessly—how strong must he be?
The camera recorded as the slightly coy female reporter carefully approached and asked nervously, “Mr. Lambert, hello, may I interview you?”
“An interview, sure,” Howard replied, nodding slightly as he looked into the camera lens.
The reporter raised the microphone toward Howard Lambert, “Mr. Lambert, there are reports that although you are only a high school sophomore, you’ve achieved a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven. Is this true?”
Howard Lambert straightened up a bit, making himself look even more imposing, then said solemnly, “Yes, I have made the breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven. But my rapid advancement in cultivation is inseparable from the nurturing of my school and the Federation.”
Just as Howard Lambert declared his breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven, Justin Welan, who was carrying a two-meter-wide and tens of meters long concrete pillar in the distance, suddenly felt a pang of frustration.
Damn, this guy is at it again.
Watching the distant Howard Lambert being interviewed in front of the camera, Justin Welan took a deep breath and with a loud boom, slammed the concrete pillar down, the powerful burst of True Strength shattering it to facilitate subsequent transportation.
The interview continued, “Mr. Lambert, when you faced that Eighth Level Beast descended from the mythical world today, what made you rush forward without any hesitation? Were you scared at that moment?”
Faced with this question, Howard Lambert’s expression turned solemn, “It’s about responsibility. As a cultivator and a Colonel in the Federation, it’s our duty to protect the vulnerable.”
“As for being scared, there simply wasn’t time to think about that. At that moment, I had only one thought in my mind, which was to quickly click and kill that giant beast; otherwise, once it charged into the crowd, the casualties would be unimaginable.”
“He truly is one of our South Sky Martial Height geniuses,” the female reporter admired before moving on to other questions.
In the living room, watching Howard Lambert’s interview on TV, Glenn Clark was somewhat surprised. “Bro, Howard Lambert broke through to Eight Layer Heaven too, that’s amazing.”
During the Spring Festival Lantern Festival, Glenn Clark had met Howard Lambert, and he hadn’t anticipated that this school senior, who seemed even bulkier than him, had also broken through to Eight Layer Heaven.
It seems cultivation is indeed simple; Jack broke through to the king level in one year, and other seniors have broken through to Eight Layer Heaven.
Jack Clark nodded. “Howard Lambert does have impressive talent. His talent ranks in the top three at South Sky Martial Height. Breaking through to Eight Layer Heaven in one year is quite normal.”
After saying that, Jack Clark stood up. “Mom, keep watching the news. I’m going to make a phone call.”
During the news broadcast, Jack Clark had seen Justin Welan and suddenly remembered he hadn’t told these friends that he was back.
Stepping out onto the balcony, Jack Clark pulled out a mobile phone from his Sumeru Bracelet. Thankfully, even after two months of no use, the special phone still had ninety percent battery.
Finding Justin Welan’s number, Jack Clark dialed it directly.
At the ruins, Justin Welan lifted a cement block weighing dozens of tons, and with a slight effort, he hurled it several meters with a bang into the dump truck, making the entire vehicle shake violently.
The driver hastily grinned apologetically, “This student, go easy, easy. Otherwise, the truck will be smashed.”
Cough!
With a cough, Justin Welan looked slightly embarrassed. “Sorry, I got distracted by something on my mind just now. I’ll be more careful next time.”
“No, no, it’s all right; you’re working hard too,” the driver quickly stated with a smile, not daring to offend these powerful cultivators.
It’s too exaggerated to say that he could throw such a huge block of cement just like that.
That’s when Justin Welan’s pocket vibrated, prompting him to pat off the dust and take out his mobile phone.
And when Justin Welan saw the caller ID, his face instantly lit up with surprise.
But Justin Welan quickly suppressed the excitement in his heart and glanced at Howard Lambert in the distance before his figure vanished in a flash, appearing in the shadows hundreds of meters away.
Justin Welan spoke in a hushed tone, “Hey, Jack, are you back?”
Jack Clark’s voice came from the other end. “I just got back from the mythical world. I saw you on the news, so I thought I’d give you a call to say hi.”
Immediately, Justin Welan grew even more excited, lowering his voice. “Does that mean you’ve successfully had a breakthrough as a king?”
“Yep, I’ve broken through.”
Standing on the balcony, Jack Clark nodded and then asked, somewhat puzzled, “By the way, are you hurt? Why is your voice so low?”
“Heh, no, no, I’m fine,” Justin Welan suppressed his excitement and looked towards Howard Lambert, who was being interviewed in the distance, his smile growing brighter.
“That’s good to hear. By the way, have the class leader and the others entered the mythical world yet?”
“Not yet.”
Justin Welan explained. “We were planning to enter the mythical world after the school’s opening ceremony concluded, but due to the recent anomalies, we’ve been temporarily conscripted into the Mist River City Special Forces.”
“We have to wait until this incident is over before we can enter the mythical world.”
“Everyone is there.”
Jack Clark’s face lit up with a smile. “I’ll ask in the 3-9 Group later to see if everyone has time tomorrow or the day after to get together for a meal.”
For these classmates who had good relationships from the Koroya Trial, Jack Clark always considered them friends, and naturally, he wouldn’t become distant just because he had achieved king-level breakthrough.
But no sooner had Jack Clark finished speaking than Justin Welan quickly interjected, “Hold up, Jack, don’t message that in the group yet. Don’t tell them you’re back.”
“Why?” Jack Clark asked, puzzled.
[It’s midnight. I’ll post this update first. There are a few hundred words left unedited, so I’ll keep fixing it. I promised eight thousand words today, so it will definitely be eight thousand.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - 1095 445 Jack Clark Hello everyone long time
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1095: Chapter 445 Jack Clark: Hello everyone, long time no see Chapter 1095: Chapter 445 Jack Clark: Hello everyone, long time no see “The number you have dialed is currently unavailable, please try again later.”
On the balcony, Jack Clark called Mathilda Ward, but the voice on the other end indicated the call could not go through; this usually happened when the mobile phone was placed within the Storage Space.
It seemed that her awakening was more than just the completion of her soul. A faint smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face as he felt happy about Mathilda Ward’s Transformation.
Just as Jack Clark was considering whether to send a message to Crystal Boyce, his left wristwatch flickered slightly, indicating a file had been received.
His smart wristwatch was classified, contactable only by the Federal Top Level, so a file transmission at this time surely meant something urgent, prompting Jack Clark to lightly press on his wristwatch.
Hum!
The smart wristwatch projected a beam of Blue Radiance, forming a projection and text report about 0.5 meters in diameter in mid-air.
“Hello, Honorable Divine Martial Throne, regarding today’s suppression of several different races, the interrogation has concluded and I hereby present you with a summary.”
“The name of this alien tribe is the Kurta Dorakel Alien, translated as the Violent Dragon Civilization, and their rulers are called the Violent Dragon War Gods.”
“Comparing the information obtained through the linkage of the awakened ones, this race is located in an unknown region of the mythical world, with no findings related to the Human Race or The Purgatory Family.”
“Cracks appeared in their tribes after the world impact, and they were sent to investigate. The strength of their squad is generally within the Seventh Layer Heaven.”
“This race is widespread with seven major tribes, each tribe led by a Mythical-level Violent Dragon King and above them, a Violent Dragon War God estimated to be at the Heavenly King Level.”
With these words flickering, they were also accompanied by image information of those aliens.
About four meters tall, riding on Violent Dragon Alien Beasts over twenty meters long, their form slightly resembling humans, dressed in rough hide clothing.
Beyond that, these aliens had black scale armor covering their bodies except for their faces, their arms resembled claws, and they had high brow ridges that gave off a savage, primeval look, with fierce eyes.
“Has this impact connected us with a mid-level alien civilization?” Jack Clark mused.
The Human Federation classified the alien civilizations of the mythical world into four levels: low-level, seated by Mythical Powerhouses; mid-level, overseen by Heavenly King Level beings; and high-level, watched over by Supreme Level powerhouses.
Besides these, there were the ancient civilizations with Emperor level beings, such as The Purgatory Family.
In the information brought back by the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and other Human Experts who delved deep into The Purgatory Family’s rear, not only there were details of the Eight Great Empires but also the numbers of certain powerhouses.
In addition to a minimum of two Demon God Level Powerhouses for each empire, there was talk of an Ancestor Level existence above them all.
However, this Ancestor Level Demon God had been in Hibernation for tens of thousands of years without waking; otherwise, the Human Race and the other two civilizations at war with The Purgatory Family would have been destroyed long ago.
Therefore, counting them up, the Human Federation with its three Supreme Level powerhouses, eleven Heavenly Kings, and scores of king-level warriors was more formidable than many alien civilizations.
Including the Divine Gods Alliance.
Of course, this might was in the context of the surrounding area, as the mythical world was too vast; who knew what powerful civilizations lay in the distant reaches.
Jack Clark pondered for a moment and then sent a message to the Federal Blue Star Military Department: “Keep a close watch on all Rift Channels, especially the Violent Dragon Civilization aliens.”
“This race will likely send ‘People’ again to probe, so during interrogation, compile detailed data on this civilization’s culture, resources, and surrounding environment—the more detailed, the better.”
This kind of interrogation targeting alien civilizations of different races was very “material” consuming, mainly carried out by cultivators who had awakened spirit-type talents.
Even though communication through Will shock was feasible, to ensure the interrogees did not tell lies or provide misleading information, their Will would be forcibly shattered to extract memories.
After Jack Clark’s orders were acknowledged, the other side responded quickly with a confirmation, and only then did Jack Clark turn off the smart wristwatch.
His return this time was not for a family visit, but to stand guard over Blue Star in case of an encounter with an alien civilization.
Fifty years ago, when the Mythical Era began, alien creatures had appeared and were later suppressed by the First Councilor and other powerhouses, from which they obtained some data from the mythical world.
Later, as the three largest channels opened up, the grown Human Experts ventured into the mythical world and annihilated those hundreds of thousands of savagely primitive beings in the low-level civilizations.
The territory those beings once occupied now lay within a region of the Human Territory.
Back in the living room, Jack Clark greeted Doris Clark and Glenn Clark: “Mom, Jim, I’m heading upstairs to cultivate.”
Doris Clark, who was on a phone call, nodded at Jack Clark after hearing his words.
On the second floor, Jack Clark’s room had not changed a bit since he had left a few months ago, clean and tidy, and in the aquarium where he raised the Six-legged Salamander swam two goldfish leisurely.
Glancing at the aquarium, Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel sentimental.
Who could have imagined that the Six-legged Salamander, once smaller than the palm of his hand, had now grown into a ferocious behemoth 1,500 meters long, akin to a small mountain range?
Jack Clark had a premonition that when he commanded the entire mythical world decades or centuries later, this aquarium would become a priceless antique.
After all, it was the very place where the Emperor Dragon Giant Beast had first resided.
With that thought, Jack Clark chuckled to himself, and then, with a thought, he vanished into thin air.
Giving Jack Clark’s current level of cultivation, if he were to practice outside, the Heavenly Energy within hundreds of kilometers would be drained, creating an energy vacuum.
Furthermore, the imperceptible vibrations of the Higher-order Law Power he emitted would be terrifying enough to shatter the consciousness of all ordinary people nearby.

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - 1096 445 Jack Clark Hello everyone long time
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1096: Chapter 445 Jack Clark: Hello everyone, long time no see_2 Chapter 1096: Chapter 445 Jack Clark: Hello everyone, long time no see_2 The vast desolate world was ponderous with Earth, and black winds howled between Heaven and Earth as streaks of blue Thunder roared, and a golden sun hung in the high sky, radiating intense heat.
At that moment, atop a towering black Mountain Peak ten thousand meters high in the middle of the Earth, Jack Clark appeared out of thin air, and the sensation of holding dominion over Heaven and Earth spontaneously arose in his heart.
Having become a Real Plane, Jack Clark could now freely enter and exit this world located deep within the Space Interlayer, with an area equivalent to a large province.
This was a world that belonged solely to him. Not only could he enter and leave as he pleased, but he could also bring other creatures and items with him.
However, this world was filled with the violent power of the four elemental forces; ordinary people would be torn apart upon entering, and items would be eroded and destroyed over time.
Moreover, this world was of great importance to Jack Clark; it was the foundation of his path to Ascension. Therefore, he would not casually bring anyone in before making a breakthrough to the Supreme level, and he could not freely enter or leave during battle.
That was because he would leave coordinates in the outside when entering the Plane World.
If an enemy were to discover the coordinates of his Plane World and delve into the Void to destroy this world, Jack Clark would suffer heavy injuries, if not death.
Amidst the black winds capable of tearing advanced cultivators apart, Jack Clark hovered in midair, and thoughts began to echo in his mind.
“Burn 10,000 attribute points, enter the enlightenment state of Law.”
Before breaking through to king-level, Jack Clark could enter an epiphany state by burning 1,000 points, but the demand had multiplied tenfold after the breakthrough.
That was because the astonishing amount of Attribute Energy burned when comprehending the Heavenly Earth Law, verifying and perfecting his own Law pathway caused 1,000 points to deplete in an instant.
Suddenly, the Attribute points on the attribute page dropped from 25,810 to 15,810, and a rich energy emerged within Jack Clark’s body, enveloping him in an Epiphanic Intent Realm.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
In an instant, four terrifying Law Auras erupted from Jack Clark, and the entire Plane World began to tremble, prompting a Supreme force from deep within the World Core.
With Jack Clark at the center, darkness spread and transformed into the Void, covering ten kilometers. Within this range, Death circulated and strands of golden flames burned, while blue sparks of lightning danced.
It was at this time that the surroundings of Jack Clark distorted with darkness, forming two complete world projections with a diameter of a kilometer on each side, slowly rotating and exuding a Mysterious presence.
The world projection on the left side was a duplicate of the small world Jack Clark had comprehended when he first traversed the Road of Heavenly Kings, while the projection on the right was the Inner World of the relic from the Divine Gods Alliance.
Under the vast and ocean-like power of Jack Clark’s Divine Soul, the information that had been incomprehensible at the time emerged as projections, perfectly duplicating the scenes from back then.
For example, the relic’s Inner World, under the Devouring Void breaking everything apart, was in a state of heavens collapsing and Earth cracking, with all things vanishing into nothingness, imbued with an Aura of Great Destruction.
Using a complete world and a crumbling world for verification, and with the addition of the epiphanic aura, Jack’s thoughts and consciousness spun at a terrifying speed.
With every moment, insights flashed in his mind, and his four Higher-order Laws and the Law of Strength improved with astonishing speed, becoming more perfected.
At the same time, as the Law Divine Power within Jack Clark circulated to Temper his True Body, the entire Plane World vibrated, with endless, violent Heavenly Energy rushing toward him to be Devoured.
Although the Plane World was only eight hundred kilometers in diameter, it was growing continuously by absorbing energy from the Chaos Void, and the concentration of Heavenly Energy far surpassed Blue Star by more than a dozen times.
After all, there were no cultivators to consume it.
Time swiftly passed by as Jack Clark cultivated, and as his Aura grew stronger, the surrounding epiphany aura became increasingly faint.
To a certain extent, the epiphany aura is another method of enhancing attribute points; under the state of enlightenment, it transforms into strength for Jack Clark from another aspect.
As Jack Clark was immersed in cultivation, unaware of the passage of time, suddenly his smart wristwatch began to flicker, emitting a beeping alarm.
Instantly, Jack Clark’s eyelids twitched slightly, and the remaining epiphany aura around him vanished, along with the Dark Void, flames, Thunder, and even the two world projections slowly faded away.
“Is it morning already?”
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which had clear black and white pupils—his left eye burned with golden flames, while his right eye was surrounded by dancing blue Thunder, majestic and sacred.
Under his terrifying gaze, the space ahead silently shattered, forming twin black Cracks extending over ten meters in length.
This is the terror of Higher-order Laws; as Jack Clark’s cultivation level rose, the potent control of the Laws he commanded also grew stronger, especially having multiple Higher-order Laws within him.
After sensing the surge in ‘strength’ within his body, Jack Clark used his Hidden Deity power to suppress his Aura, then with a mere thought, he summoned the attribute page, his eyes settling on the Law information.
Law of Strength [Supreme, cultivation progress 5%→6%], Void Law [Higher-order, cultivation progress 5%→7%], Death Law [Higher-order, cultivation progress 5%→7% Higher-order], Soul Law [Higher-order, Transformation progress 22%]
Great Sun Heaven Flame Law [Higher-order, cultivation progress 5%→8%], Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder Law [Higher-order, cultivation progress 5%→8%]
After a night of cultivation, and burning ten thousand attribute points, all five Laws moved one step further; the fastest progress was with flames and Thunder.
Even though they were all Higher-order Laws, flames and Thunder Law advanced and perfected at a faster rate compared to the Void and Death Laws.
Based on the current rate of improvement, assuming enough Attribute points were available, Jack Clark, who had already achieved the unity of Divine Soul and body, could perfect the four Higher-order Laws to the peak within two months and break through to become a Heavenly King.
Consider that since the start of the Mythical Era, decades have passed and many king-level cultivators, like Marcellus Larry, have only managed to advance to the late stages of king-level after so much time, with only a few breaking through to Heavenly King.

chapters.title: Chapter 1097 - 1097 445 Jack Clark Hello everyone long time
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1097: Chapter 445 Jack Clark: Hello everyone, long time no see_3 Chapter 1097: Chapter 445 Jack Clark: Hello everyone, long time no see_3 Yet Jack Clark needed only two months, such a terrifying promotion rate was enough to shock the entire Cultivation World.
Of course, Jack’s rapid cultivation progress was also related to his inherently monstrous talent.
With the complete release of his soul potential and his terrifying physical body, Jack’s pure cultivation talent alone was unparalleled in the Federation, and his understanding of talent was no less than that of Jane Aiken.
Adding to this his attribute burning and the Road of Heavenly Kings, as well as the opportunities from the crumbling relics, it was somewhat acceptable for him to achieve a breakthrough to Heavenly King in two months.
After all, the Giant Beast Avatar was only a little over a month away from breaking through to Myth.
As for the Law of Strength, it not only required a higher difficulty in grasping and perfecting, but it also needed the growth of the plane world to keep up, or to put it another way, this plane world is essentially the “Law of Strength.”
Besides, this time his Soul Law also improved a bit. Under Jack’s refinement of World Origin from Heavenly Energy, his Transformation progress increased by two percent.
At this rate, under normal conditions, it would take two more months to complete the Transformation of the Soul Law.
It may seem long, but for other king-levels who gauge their progress in years for the Transformation of low to mid-tier laws they’ve newly understood, Jack’s speed was terrifyingly fast.
Especially for some Ninth Heaven Peak powers, even though they’ve touched and understood the laws, breaking through to Myth could take years or even a decade.
That’s also why Myths are rare.
This special power contains individual soul aura when refined and cannot be traded or given away, only a small portion of God-level Resources containing pure Origin can be absorbed by others.
At 7 am, Glenn Clark, wearing his middle school “school uniform,” called upstairs, “Bro, come down for breakfast.”
“Coming.” Jack Clark’s voice came from upstairs.
Soon, a figure appeared on the second floor; today, he was dressed in a white long-sleeved t-shirt, gray casual pants, and white flat shoes, looking very relaxed.
Next to the dining table, Glenn devoured the Mutated Beast Meat buns made by Doris Clark, murmuring, “Bro, do you have anything to do today?”
Jack took a sip of soy milk, then picked up a bun, “I need to go to school today, I’ve arranged a meeting with Mr. Willard and the others.”
“You have an arrangement with Mr. Willard and the others, huh.” Glenn nodded and swallowed another two buns.
At this moment, Jack’s gaze penetrated the walls, landing on the roadside outside where the neighborhood was bustling early in the morning, with groups of ladies surrounding Doris Clark.
One of the ladies curiously asked, “Jenny, I heard from my old man that your Jack came back yesterday?”
Doris Clark nodded and smiled, “Yes, Jack came back yesterday, but he’s here this time because the military has a task for him.”
An affluent middle-aged woman exclaimed, “A military task, no wonder, I was wondering why Jack flew back in a fighter aircraft last night.”
Doris Clark introduced with a smile, “That airplane is a custom warplane made specifically for Jack by the military, I heard there’s only a handful in the entire Federation.”
“What! Custom-made.” Immediately, the surrounding women gasped, barely able to hide their envy.
“Jenny, Jack has really made it this time.”
Doris Clark nodded with a chuckle, “It’s alright, Jack is mainly focusing on cultivation, but due to some reasons, he also manages some soldiers now.”
Seeing the smile that never faded from Doris Clark’s face, Jack chuckled and continued to have breakfast with Glenn.
Perhaps it’s because of cooking a large pot every day for Glenn, but Doris Clark’s cooking skills have improved a lot, making Jack eat more than ten extra buns.
When the pile of steamed buns on the table was finished, Glenn Clark gulped down a pot of porridge he had bought and stuffed ten fried dough sticks into his mouth, then said contentedly, “Bro, I’m full.”
“Now that you’re full, let’s head out, it’s already 8 am.”
Having said that, the two brothers tidied up the dining room a bit and then walked out of the courtyard. Glenn Clark, with his towering 2-meter figure, called out to Jenny, “Mom, I’m going to school.”
As Glenn’s voice rang out, the women chatting with Jenny felt a sudden impression of a fierce tiger approaching, making them instinctively take a step back with a bit of palpitation.
After activating his Innate Overlord Body with his Giant Avatar talent, Glenn had become comparable to an advanced cultivator, exuding an invisible aura of heavy oppression.
At that moment, Jack Clark stepped forward with a faint smile on his face, “Good morning, Auntie Doris, Auntie Lopes, and everyone else.”
As he spoke, Jack slapped a hand on Glenn’s back, sealing away the suffocating aura surrounding him with an invisible wave, immediately causing the dozen neighbors to unconsciously breathe a sigh of relief.
Then Jenny spoke up, “Go ahead, and Jack, remember to come back for lunch.”
“Okay,” Jack nodded, and he and Glenn walked past the crowd, heading toward the school along the roadside.
It was not until the two of them had walked far away that the atmosphere gradually returned to its lively state, and a plump woman exclaimed in amazement, “Jenny, your son Jack looks more and more handsome.”
“Yeah, just a few months without seeing him and he seems like a completely different person, with an air of a superior presence, noble, and unapproachable.”
Jenny modestly responded, “Sister Clark, you’re exaggerating. Jack hasn’t changed much.”
While Jenny was enjoying the complimentary and admiring glances of the neighbors, Glenn and Jack walking on the Pedestrian Walkway also drew the attention of many girls.
Of course, those people were all looking at Jack, whose 1.9-meter tall figure was straight and imposing. The muscles under his white t-shirt were slightly bulging, giving a robust impression.
Moreover, his already handsome face, perfected through successive Evolutions and breakthroughs, along with his black hair cascading over his shoulders, exuded a noble and transcendent demeanor, like a deity incarnate.
This character, as if stepped out of a comic book, with the innate attraction from higher lifeforms to their genes, had an unimaginable impact on ordinary people.
However, because of his excessive perfection, these women, after one glance at Jack, would subconsciously avert their gaze, feeling an inherent sense of shame.
Glenn said with some envy, “Bro, you look so cool now. It feels like you could become a big international star if you decided to be a big star.”
Jack gave him a sideways glance, “Have you ever seen a king-level fighter become a star?”
He was standing at the pinnacle among billions of people, wielding the power that could ‘Destroy Heaven and Earth’ — a Mythical King becoming a star was something only someone like Glenn could think of.
Glenn scratched the back of his head and chuckled, “Bro, I think being a star and a king-level fighter doesn’t conflict.”
Jack’s gaze turned somewhat strange. “Don’t tell me, you dream of becoming a star?”
“Heh, being a star is just my second dream. My first one is to cultivate True Martial Arts and become a King-level strong man like you,” Glenn chuckled.
“Do whatever you want, just don’t mess up when it’s time,” Jack didn’t interfere with Glenn’s dreams.
Everyone has their own hobbies, even cultivators are people — like Damon Lopes, that guy who likes chatting with beauties but doesn’t dare to act on his desires.
At this moment, they had already reached the crosswalk at the red traffic light, and across the street, three pretty schoolgirls in uniforms noticed Glenn and waved at him.
“Glenn, over here.”
[Shoot, it’s twelve o’clock already, I’ll update now. I still have more than a thousand words to edit, which I’ll add later. You can read it tomorrow morning.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - 1098 446
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1098: Chapter 446 Chapter 1098: Chapter 446 Everyone was startled and stood up subconsciously as the young man, who still exuded an air of nobility even after concealing his aura, suddenly appeared before their eyes.
Marcus Lindsay exclaimed in surprise, “Jack Clark, how come you’re back?”
Jack Clark’s gaze was gentle as jade, and he smiled lightly, “Didn’t a lot of World Rifts erupt on Blue Star yesterday? I was sent back to assist in suppressing them.”
The stunningly beautiful class leader, Sherry Lesser, took a deep breath and then her face showed a hint of shock, “You suddenly came back, does that mean you’ve succeeded in breaking through?”
Because Howard Lambert returned and bragged to them every day, they often talked about Jack Clark’s situation, so Crystal and her friends knew that Jack was engaged in Closed-door Cultivation at the 30th Army Group base.
Now that he had suddenly appeared at South Sky Martial Height…
Jack Clark nodded, “This time, with the help of the seniors from the Federation, I made an early breakthrough; otherwise, I would still be in seclusion.”
This time, he didn’t exhibit any false modesty. Without those king-level experts bringing out their strength-enhancing world resources, he indeed wouldn’t have been able to make such a swift breakthrough.
Otherwise, he would need to delve deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, hunting more Mythical Giant Beasts, or slay another Titan Beast to refine its essence.
Under such circumstances, he would need at least another ten days to half a month to make the breakthrough, as finding Titan Level Beasts also takes time.
Even so, White Veil couldn’t help but curse in shock, “Damn, I knew you were always a freak, but becoming a One-Year King is still a bit exaggerated.”
White Veil, seemingly in a daze, reached out his hand.
“Damn it, White Veil, why the hell are you pinching me?” Zac Maben cried out in pain, his late Fourth Layer Heaven True Strength bursting forth and knocking White Veil’s hand away.
“Sorry, wrong pinch,” White Veil said with a cheeky smile, retracting his hand.
“Get lost.”
Then Jack Clark laughed and said, “Everyone doesn’t need to be so surprised. The path of cultivation is long and arduous. I’m just temporarily a step ahead. With hard work, everyone can one day break through to king-level.”
Upon hearing this, the gazes of Justin Welan and the others became odd because they remembered Jack Clark had said this a few times before.
The gentle Mandy Lewis chuckled lightly, “Don’t worry, we are just surprised, not on the verge of a Dao heart collapse. After all, we’ve been used to your freakish ways for a long time.”
Everybody was deeply aware of Jack Clark’s record-shattering cultivation speed.
Justin Welan laughed heartily, “Cultivation is indeed not an overnight affair. Zac, you guys remember to cultivate diligently and strive to break through to king-level within a hundred years.”
Zac Maben asked instinctively, “Why us? How about you?”
Justin Welan said proudly, “I, of course, don’t need to; although I can’t compare to Jack, I’m confident that in no more than ten years I will break through to king-level.”
“You wish, Mr. Willard,” Marcus and Zac showed him the middle finger.
If king-level was so easy to break through, the Federation would be full of Mythical Powerhouses already. Even if Justin Welan received the inheritance of one of the 108 generals from an Ancient Civilization, it was the same.
As the laughter subsided, Sawyer Levin, Vera Wada, and Matt Watkins also stepped forward to warmly greet Jack Clark, “Congratulations on breaking the Cultivation World record, Jack Clark.”
“Commissioner Matt, classmate Sawyer, classmate Vera,” Jack Clark nodded with a smile, “Seeing everyone looking so composed, you must have improved a lot during this time.”
Matt Watkins shook his head with a wry smile, “Our progress is nothing compared to yours.”
After the greetings, everyone sat back down, with Jack Clark taking a seat next to Justin Welan.
Once seated, Marcus Lindsay curiously asked, “Jack Clark, why aren’t you going to the main stage?”
With Howard Lambert’s Eight Layer cultivation, he was on par with the school’s head instructor, not to mention Jack Clark the king-level fighter. Even the principal would have to greet him with courtesy.
Jack Clark shook his head, “I won’t be staying for more than a few days this time, so I haven’t contacted the school. Besides, if Mr. Willard hadn’t told me last night, I wouldn’t have known that the new semester’s opening ceremony hadn’t started yet.”
At this, Sherry Lesser turned around from the front, “Last night, when you called Justin Welan, he told you not to tell us you were back, right?”
“Right, I was actually planning to send a message in the group chat and find a time to treat you all to a meal,” Jack Clark responded with a smile, directly throwing Justin Welan under the bus.
Sherry Lesser’s eyes narrowed slightly, “No wonder Justin Welan was grinning so slyly yesterday.”
Justin Welan chuckled, “Sly? I was simply trying to give everyone a pleasant surprise. The shock and surprise on everyone’s faces earlier were quite rewarding.”
For this, Marcus Lindsay and Zac Maben showed him the middle finger again.
Meanwhile, as everyone chatted, Matt Watkins, sitting a row below Sherry Lesser, had a complex expression on his face.
Once he had been considered the second most talented in the class, establishing his Foundation within the same week as Crystal, and ranking in the top fifty in the Freshman Ranking Tournament.
When he heard about the opportunity to join the Koroya Trial, he volunteered without hesitation.
During that trial, he achieved much and smoothly broke through to the Triplex Realm; Jack Clark had also begun to make a name for himself but was only a small realm higher than Matt, which was still within the realm of acceptance.
But now, a year later, just as Matt made it to the Fourth Layer, Jack Clark had already become a king-level. The gap was huge, making Matt Watkins and his friends somewhat reluctant to speak after they sat down.
This also included Maria Jenkins, who had met Jack Clark several times and had once explored the Moon Lake Lotus together. She too stood by awkwardly after their initial greeting, not knowing what to say.
Jack Clark noticed this but didn’t express anything.
As time went by, not only was it impossible to compare with him, but even the gap between these classmates kept widening. For instance, Jane Aiken from the First echelon was about to break through to the Ninth Heavens, while Howard Lambert was at the Eight Layer.
From the Second echelon, sisters Crystal and Mandy Lesser and Justin Welan, having entered the Void Continent relic, had already broken through to the Sixth Layer because of the inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - 1099 446_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1099: Chapter 446_2 Chapter 1099: Chapter 446_2 “`
The geniuses within the top fifty of the freshmen such as Zac Maben, White Veil, and Marcus Lindsay from the Third Squad are still stuck in the Fourth Layer Heaven, including Laurant Harris who peaked at the top three of the Fourth Layer Heaven.
Then there are Sawyer Levin, Vera Wada, and other students who have managed to establish their foundation within half a month; they have barely made a breakthrough to the Third Realm after a semester.
Considering this, one can imagine how shocking Jack Clark’s breakthrough was for them.
Therefore, even though Jack Clark had already retracted his aura, the disparity in cultivation still invisibly transformed into suffocating pressure, making it difficult for many to breathe.
At this moment, the only ones who could truly relax in front of Jack Clark were Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, and the Lewis sisters.
As for Marcus Lindsay, White Veil, and the others, even though they were smiling and chatting, one could keenly sense a trace of unease in their manner, akin to ordinary people facing an official authority.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark and Justin Welan were chatting in the last few rows, people from the third grade, originally from the second-grade area, recognized him as well.
After all, there wasn’t a single senior student returning from the Southern Battlefield who didn’t know Jack Clark, whose exploits of traversing the battlefield in a single day were too astonishing.
Bruce Ramos, a burly figure who had encountered Jack Clark twice, turned his head in surprise, “It’s actually Jack Clark; he’s back from the mythical world.”
