Cicely Randall flickered her eyes, “I heard from Carney Turner that a few months ago on the Road to Becoming a God, he was just a step away from completing the Road of Heavenly Kings. His talent and combat power have become even more defying.”
“Look, it’s Jack Clark.”
“That freak is back.”
As more and more people began to take notice of Jack Clark, exclamations of surprise rang out from the seats.
“I heard that he participated in the exploration of ancient relics three months ago, and he was already at the Seventh Layer Heaven back then. His cultivation should have broken through to the Eight Layer by now, right?”
“I think it’s more than that. Howard Lambert also entered the relics and has now broken through the Eighth Layer. Given Jack Clark’s more extravagant talent, by now he should at least be at the Ninth Layer, and might even be in the mid-term of Ninth Heaven.”
“A year to reach the Nine Layers…!!”
Hiss!
Many people couldn’t help but draw in a cold breath.
Before long, students from the entire Martial Sects Area were whispering and turning their heads to look back with expressions of curiosity, shock, and surprise on their faces.
Even in the second-grade area, those classmates who had previously met Jack Clark briefly were also curious and turned their heads.
As senior students from the Southern Battlefield returned over the past few months, the legend of Jack Clark sweeping through the battlefield and breaching dozens of Martial Arts Schools in a single day had already spread far and wide.
In the entire South Sky Martial Height, excluding the new freshmen who had just enrolled this year, almost everyone had heard of Jack Clark’s feats, including the titles ‘Unrivaled Divine Might’ and ‘Unparalleled Under Heaven’ bestowed upon him.
At this time, a young man stood up, walked over to Jack Clark with a full smile, and took the initiative to greet, “Junior Clark, it’s been a while, but you seem more impressive than ever.”
Jack Clark smiled and nodded, “Senior Lockwood, you’re not bad either. I haven’t seen you for a few months, and your cultivation has advanced further. With your talent, you should be able to break through the Sixth Layer before graduation.”
When Denny Lockwood had sold information to Jack Clark on the Southern Battlefield, his cultivation was only in the Late Fourth Layer Heaven. Now he had broken through to the Mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven. Among his peers, his talent was above average.
After all, he had only started his Senior year.
Denny Lockwood quickly shook his head, “My progress is far behind compared to yours, Junior.”
Justin Welan nodded in agreement, “That’s true. Not to mention South Sky Martial Arts School, looking across the entire Eastern Summer or even the Human Federation, in terms of cultivation talent, no one can match Jack.”
“Even Jane Aiken, that monster, has been left far behind by Jack, hahaha…” With that, Justin Welan looked immensely proud.
After all, ever since they started school, Jane Aiken had stood unchallenged, making everyone look up to her until Jack Clark dramatically appeared and broke her ‘dominance’ over all of South Sky Martial’s new students.
Curious, Marcus Lindsay asked, “Mr. Willard, Jack Clark’s talent is surely unmatched by any in both the past and the future, but why do you seem so proud? It’s not like you have anything to do with it.”
Justin Welan chuckled proudly, “Me and Jack are as close as brothers; his prowess is as good as mine, isn’t it?”
At Justin Welan’s shamelessness, the others couldn’t help but shake their heads, while Carney Turner’s squad, including Cicely Randall and Bruce Ramos, who had met Jack Clark a few times, also came over.
“Junior Clark, it’s been a long time.”
Then, some third-grade students got up, each taking the initiative to come over and say hello.
Seeing the once quiet spectator seats suddenly become lively, one by one greeting the dark-haired young man like stars surrounding the moon, many freshmen below were somewhat surprised.
“Who is that guy? Why are all the seniors going over to say hello?”
“Right. He seems quite impressive, or those snobbish seniors wouldn’t be so polite. Besides, he’s really handsome.”
“More than just handsome, he’s absolutely stunning. It’s like he stepped right out of a painting.”
Down in the sports stadium, many Senior One female students couldn’t take their eyes off Jack Clark, their eyes shining with admiration—it was their first time seeing someone so handsome.
Among these freshmen, there was a beautiful girl with fox-ear hair clips, who was watching the bustling surroundings of Jack Clark and smiling radiantly.
On the main stage, the teachers also noticed what was happening in the audience seats, and both Laurant Harris and James Crane recognized Jack Clark immediately.
“Jack Clark, he’s back,” James Crane said, somewhat surprised.
Laurant Harris’s face showed excitement, “The super genius of our South Sky Martial is back!”
As the head instructor and an Eighth Layer Expert of the school, Laurant Harris had always been paying attention to Jack Clark and had some understanding of his situation even after entering the mythical world.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - 1100 446_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1100: Chapter 446_3 Chapter 1100: Chapter 446_3 For instance, he was making a breakthrough to king-level in closed-door cultivation.
As for the source of the news about Laurant Harris, it came from his uncle, the Heaven Suppressing War King, Leo Hart.
While the two teachers were surprised by Jack Clark’s unexpected appearance, Howard Lambert, who had been enjoying the worshipful gazes of the freshmen below, was dumbfounded. Wait, hadn’t this guy said he wouldn’t come back for the school ceremony?
Watching Jack Clark gradually attract the attention of the entire stadium, Howard Lambert, who had been sitting comfortably for half the day, suddenly felt a bit awkward and then, his face showed shock.
This guy suddenly came back, and it was clear that he had already made his breakthrough into the king-level.
While Howard Lambert was bewildered and uncomfortable, Laurant Harris suddenly stood up. He was preparing to invite Jack Clark to sit on the main stage, and to give a speech later on to encourage the new students.
He had also decided that, once the school ceremony was over, he would take a photo with Jack Clark and hang it on the Wall of Fame in the Teaching Building of South Sky Martial Height.
But before Laurant Harris could stand up, a terrifying Divine Soul Thought descended and enveloped him, with Jack Clark’s voice coming through.
“Director Harris, don’t worry about me; I’m just here to have a look. I have other tasks to attend to.”
This… Looking at the black-haired young man, who was hundreds of meters away talking to classmates with a smile, Laurant Harris paused slightly; then, a look of regret crossed his face as he sat back down.
On the main host stage, Carol Koch was also surprised: “He actually came back for the school ceremony.”
Next to Carol Koch, a beautiful female student dressed in a black dress and exuding a mature charm was curious: “Classmate Koch, who is that person?”
“Jack Clark.”
“Jack Clark, the one from our South Sky Martial Height known as ‘Unrivaled Divine Might,’ the ‘Unparalleled Under Heaven’ Jack Clark?” The mature female student paused.
As a humanities third-grade student, she had also heard this resounding name from time to time over the past six months: a cultivation genius, a monster, one who suppressed his era.
Carol Koch nodded: “Yes, that’s him.”
Looking towards the black-haired young man who was the center of everyone’s attention in the distance, the mature female student’s gaze flickered slightly: “He truly is the pride of our South Sky Martial Height. Just sitting there, he exudes an unruffled, rock-solid presence.”
However, before they could continue to reflect, the time reached nine o’clock.
With that, the mature female student smiled and, holding the microphone, began, “Respected teachers and classmates, good morning to everyone. I am Fay Swift from humanities Senior Class 1.”
“I am Carol Koch from Martial Arts Major Senior Class 1.”
“In this sunny and brilliant golden autumn season, we welcome a new year and hold the grand 2056 Autumn School Ceremony to welcome all the new students.”
“Now, please play the Federal Anthem.”
As Fay Swift finished speaking, a deep horn sounded throughout the stadium, and on the four big screens, a terrifying Mythical Giant Beast appeared, instantly shattering the earth and destroying cities.
As the giant beast, stretching a kilometer in length, wreaked havoc destroying heaven and earth, slaughtering countless ordinary people, powerful figures soared into the sky, and intense battles broke out instantly.
The shocking visuals and immersive music made the blood of the new students boil with excitement.
This scene caught Jack Clark by surprise, because their school ceremony last year had only the Federal Anthem, without any cinematic battle of giant beasts.
It seems that the education system had indeed gone through some changes this year.
As Jack Clark pondered, the national anthem soon finished playing, and the elegant and dignified Fay Swift held the microphone, smiling as she said, “Next, we will have the principal’s speech.”
The current principal of South Sky Martial Arts School was not a cultivator, but a kind-looking elderly professor, who stood up from the main stage and walked over to the host stage as Fay Swift finished speaking.
And just as the school ceremony entered the boring segment of speeches, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted slightly, his attention drawn to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
On its way back, having been submerged in a suddenly collapsed forbidden area, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to spend some time before it emerged with the Silver Giant Dragon and others from the deep Void.
On the savage surface of the sea, where a Hundred-meter Tsunami surged, a waterfall fell from the high altitude, thousands of meters above, while three Tiger Whales roamed below and Nine-headed Flood Dragon as well as the deep-sea giant turtle nested there.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that had just entered the mythical world with the Candle Dragon Giant Beast also happened to arrive, and the two parties collided by chance.
Looking at the terrifying behemoth descending from the sky, stretching 1500 meters in length, with black gold streams collapsing the Void and shattering the Heavenly Earth Law, all the Giant Beasts trembled.
The intangible, pervasive bloodline and level suppression terrified the Giant Beast and even the level eight and Level 9 Deep Sea Dragon Turtles.
But immediately, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out an excited roar: “Roar! Thunderflame, so strong, too amazing!”
Compared to just over a month ago when Thunderflame entered the mythical world with a body length of just five or six hundred meters, the now Mythical Peak Destruction Emperor Dragon was even more terrifying.
The intangible, emanating pressure was now a hundred times stronger than before, which made the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle extremely excited.
The stronger the Destruction Emperor Dragon, their leader, became, the more confident they’d feel when engaging in battle. If they encountered formidable Giant Beasts, they could rely on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, while they just needed to charge forward.
Feeling the invincible aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon suddenly started rolling frantically in the sea, stirring up the sky-high sea waves, while its nine dragon heads twisted wildly, emitting chaotic roars.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott is so strong, so terrifying, awesome explosion!”
In the midst of the raging wind and Tsunami, the hundred-meter-long Blue Giant Crab lay spread-eagled, limp on the sea surface, drifting with the waves, bubbles unconsciously spilling from its mouth and eyes turning white.
Gurgle gurgle!! Great King, invincible, my eight legs were frightened limp.”
This scene made the Destruction Emperor Dragon, standing mighty in the Firmament, involuntarily twitch, forcibly suppressing the urge to explode its subordinates with a claw.

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - 1101 446_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1101: Chapter 446_4 Chapter 1101: Chapter 446_4 Dammit, why do I get the feeling that Kidora and the Crab General are getting more and more twisted.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon with its thousand-meter-spanning double wings unfurled, descended from the heavens, issuing a majestic roar, “Kidora, Domination, Crab General, you’ve arrived.”
Under the immense pressure from the Mythical-level, several Giant Beasts quickly reverted to normal, with the Crab General hastily blowing respectful bubbles.
Gurgle gurgle!! Little one has seen Great Sethia, congratulations to the Great King on your breakthrough to Mythical-level, growing ever more powerful and mighty, only slightly behind the Great Thunderflame Dragon King now.
The Crab General’s flattery was crude, at least in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but it was quite satisfactory for the Giant Beasts with simpler minds.
Only to see the Silver Giant Dragon proudly arching its tail, “Roar! Nicely said, Great Sethia indeed has become increasingly formidable, now only a little behind Tim Abott.”
Then, the sea surface exploded as a Black Tiger Whale breached, emitting a yelping call: Uncle, Uncle, I, along with Mom and Miss Keller, have come to see you.
Bang! Saying so, the massive Black Tiger Whale plunged back to the sea surface, splashing water high into the air with a loud splash.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out an authoritative growl, “Not bad, already level eight, but why have you followed along?”
Speaking thus, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its gaze to the floating Red Divine Dragon, whose aura on the Red Beast’s body grew more obscure, veiled by Time Power and seemingly existing in a different time and space.
Facing the questioning gaze of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Giant Beast Candle Dragon slowly growled, “Tiger, Three, said, it, can, help, with, ocean, management, so, I, brought, it, along.”
Uttering each word deliberately, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast roared repeatedly, the one sentence taking several minutes to finish.
Alright then. The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly.
At this moment, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, who had been totally ignored by his son, excitedly flew down, showing off its fin-turned-wings to the one-hundred-and-twenty-meter-long Black Tiger Whale.
Roar roar roar!! Look dear, I’ve become even more mighty and handsome.
On the sea surface, the distinctively black-and-white Female Tiger Whale issued soft yelping calls, “You’ve become a bit mightier, but also uglier.”
With that, the Female Tiger Whale swam away, seemingly keen to distance herself, instantly the disdain in her attitude making the Single-horned Spawn Roc stiffen.
For the aesthetic standards of Tiger Whales, the evolved Spawn Roc, less and less resembling a whale, indeed was becoming uglier.
Watching the Single-horned Spawn Roc being disdained by his wife, Tiger Whale Third Brother proudly called out: Daddy really is becoming uglier, so unattractive, I’m glad I don’t look like you.
Hearing this, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but reveal an odd look in his eyes.
Just then, the several dozen meter long Little Female Tiger Whale added insult to injury, looking at the Black Tiger Whale with adoration, meekly calling out: The leader speaks the truth, the leader is the best looking.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “Alright, you’ve arrived at a good time, enter the Rift World first, this King has some matters to instruct.”
Boom!
Heaven and Earth trembled, a powerful invisible force descended from above, sweeping up a ten-kilometer radius of sea water along with several Giant Beasts into the sky, rushing into the Rift World.
In the Rift World, atop the Crystal Palace that was half on land and half over the lake, stood the Destruction Emperor Dragon wrapped in swirling black gold currents, exuding terrifying pressure.
At the side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood the Silver Giant Dragon, which was several times smaller in size. As the Dragon Palace Dragon King, it held a rank equal to that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Yet due to its size and aura, the Silver Giant Dragon somehow gave other Giant Beasts the impression of being the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s little spouse.
Looking down at the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, the massive Kamaitachi, Dragon Turtle, Spawn Roc, and Nine-headed Flood Dragon and other Giant Beasts standing on both sides, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled.
“I will soon enter hibernation to achieve a Titan-level breakthrough, therefore, all matters of the Dragon Palace shall be overseen by Scythia, with the objective of pushing deeper into the Chaos Sea.”
The areas they had swept through before were in the direction of the lands behind them; without it standing guard, other Giant Beasts would be unable to face a Titan-level Giant Beast and certainly should not venture too deeply.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon continued to give instructions, “Candle Dragon will soon enter hibernation to achieve a breakthrough, and at that time, Scythia, Kamaitachi, and Joe will continue the search for Heaven and Earth Treasures.”
“As for Kidora and the others, join forces to kill off all Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts within the territory of the Dragon Palace that have reached the peak of their levels. I need more Life Crystals,” he decreed.
Compared to the Blue Star Ocean, where low-level exotic beasts were widespread, the Unique Beasts in the Chaotic Sea Region were of a higher level, with the weakest starting from Level 4.
Although the overall number of Unique Beasts was somewhat smaller due to the harsh environment, the crystals they produced were high-order and of a superior grade, with a single one worth dozens or even hundreds of low-level ones.
Currently, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had no talents to enhance and his understanding of laws was linked to the growth of his body; he didn’t need to spend time in cultivating comprehension, but Jack still needed massive quantities of Life Crystals on his side.
As long as there were enough Attribute points, Jack would be able to quickly break through to Heavenly King and even Supreme level.
This was also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon had brought the Giant Beast Candle Dragon and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles—while they couldn’t participate in Mythical-level combat, they were perfectly capable of collecting Life Crystals.
As for the idea of using merits to exchange crystals with the Federation, Jack considered it only briefly before giving it up.
His previous exchanges had already drained the Federation’s stockpile of crystals, even going so far as to mobilize some of the basic Low-level life crystals reserved for training freshmen.
In such a situation, he naturally didn’t feel it was appropriate to call upon those resources again.
Of course, this reluctance was because the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s domain could collect a vast amount, otherwise, for the sake of accelerating his power increase, Jack wouldn’t mind using up the low-level crystals intended for the next few years of military expeditions.
After all, compared to the freshmen cultivating a bit slower in the next two years, his quicker breakthrough to Supreme level was far more important.
At this moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly thought of something and growled, “Horned Lady, when I left, didn’t I order you to collect Life Crystals? How many have you gathered?”
From within the lake, even before Horned Lady could answer, Black Tiger Whale excitedly roared, “Uncle, Uncle, after you left, Mom and I collected a lot of crystals, all carried on Miss Keller’s back.”
As soon as Tiger Whale Third Brother finished speaking, the several dozen meters long Female Little Tiger Whale obediently surfaced, showing the ‘little backpack’ hanging on her Dorsal Fin.
“Well done,” Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded with satisfaction. Its enormous Dragon Claw gestured slightly, and instantly a surge of power swirled up, lifting the small backpack from the back of the Female Little Tiger Whale.
Holding the few meters-sized backpack gently with its huge black and red claw, the Destruction Emperor Dragon projected its realm of thought inside, and immediately saw the mountains of Life Crystals amassed by Marcus Lindsay.
Though these Life Crystals were mainly of lower level, the quantity was astonishing, estimated to convert into more than two hundred thousand Attribute points.
The corner of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled up slightly in a dignified growl, “Scythia, give Horned Lady and Tiger Three one of the Divine Fruits when the red divine tree ripens.”
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded and growled back, “No problem, Tim Abott.”
After giving some more instructions, the Destruction Emperor Dragon spread its mighty double wings and its massive body soared into the sky, arriving above the Magma Fire Sea created by the earlier breakthrough attempt.
Boom! Instantly, the Lava Lake exploded, and the fiery magma erupted into the sky, climbing tens of thousands of meters and turning into a meteoric fire rain that fell from the sky with loud crackles and pops.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon dove tens of kilometers down into the magma, its powerful Law Power emanating and creating a hollow space several kilometers in diameter.
Meanwhile, the opening ceremony of the South Sky Martial High had entered its final phase.
On the podium, Fay Swift, an elegant and composed older woman, smiled and said, “Next, I would like to invite our distinguished alumnus who broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven in just one year, Howard Lambert, to come up and say a few words.”
Upon hearing this, Howard Lambert’s face lit up with a smile as he stood up, but his smile froze almost immediately because he saw Jack also rising from his seat in the distant audience.

chapters.title: Chapter 1102 - 1102 447 Time Silver Butterfly Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1102: Chapter 447 Time Silver Butterfly, Ancient Dueling Arena Chapter 1102: Chapter 447 Time Silver Butterfly, Ancient Dueling Arena Just as Howard Lambert felt a sense of foreboding while preparing to take the stage, Jack Clark, who also stood up, gave him a smile and waved his hand to signal him not to worry.
His return this time wasn’t for showing off, nor did he have any intentions of doing so; otherwise, he would have alerted the school beforehand.
By then, the school’s entrance would definitely have banners hanging, reading “Welcome back to our high school junior, Divine Martial Throne, for the 2056 Opening Ceremony”.
This time, Jack Clark’s visit was to see Doris Clark and Glenn Clark, as well as to meet old friends and acquaintances like Justin Welan, Marcus Lindsay, and Crystal Lewis.
As the cultivation gap between them widened, they could still talk together, but, essentially, they now belonged to two different worlds, their interactions and experiences no longer on the same level.
For instance, the adversaries Jack now faced were at the king-level, with enemies starting at demon king-level.
Meanwhile, Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, and others were still striving for a breakthrough to converge the true martial arts phantom at the Seventh Layer Heaven, and prodigies like Howard Lambert were similar.
Jack greeted them, “Mr. Willard, I need to use the toilet first.”
The toilet?
Justin Welan and the others were momentarily stunned. Did king-level cultivators still need to use the toilet?
Upon merging with the true martial arts phantom at the Eight Layer Heaven, a cultivator’s body begins to energize, maintaining its flesh-and-blood properties, but refining anything consumed.
Useful energy would be absorbed by the body, while useless matter turned into exhaled waste, leaving purity and undefilement.
And yet here you are, a Mythical King who has forged a Rule True Body, claiming you need to use the toilet. Could you not be so dismissive when you’re fooling us?
With Justin Welan and the others speechless, Jack Clark quickly moved to the corridor entrance behind them and disappeared into the twisted space.
On the rooftop of Building C where Jack once practiced Foundation Establishment cultivation, his figure appeared out of nowhere, his black hair dancing in the raging wind, silently waiting for something.
Through the instinctual feeling of the Heart’s Eye, that sensation of being watched by a being from a different space-time resurfaced.
This was also why he left the stadium.
Although he had the Hell Coordinate to prevent getting lost in unknown space-times, Jack still held a deep wariness of the power of time, cautious and prudent.
If that time being suddenly launched an attack and involved Justin Welan and the others, it would be quite troublesome.
Just then, Jack furrowed his brows slightly, and a pair of black gold vertical pupils emerged in his eyes. In an instant, the colors of the world faded, revealing the essence of all things.
At the far end of the skies turned black and white, a giant phantom shadow with wings spanning thousands of miles slowly faded until it disappeared without a trace, as if it had never existed.
The vertical pupils in Jack’s eyes slowly receded as he spoke in a solemn voice, “Gave up again, huh?”
The time being was cautious, so cautious that as a Titan-level being wielding the power of time, it was still hesitating to strike at an early mythical ‘prey’.
This type of enemy that remained hidden in the dark was troublesome, and Jack narrowed his eyes.
…
In the Plane World where the raging black winds howled and lightning thundered, Jack Clark appeared from nowhere atop the Black Divine Mountain, causing the whole of heaven and Earth to shake slightly.
Hum!
A gloomy blue light shone from the back of Jack’s left hand as countless Blue Law Chains erupted, intertwining and forming a Space-Time Altar hundreds of meters high.
With Blue Star and the mythical world spanning across two realms, forcing open a Trans-boundary Channel presented great pressure, and beyond that…
In the Rift World, just as Jack activated the Space-Time Summoning Altar and his blood and soul resonated, causing a shift in space-time, a vortex appeared in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Whoosh!
Tens of thousands of low-level life crystals poured out from the ‘small backpack’, spreading in the air and swept toward the summoning channel by a force.
Yiya, yiya!! Wait, the great Misss Joseline also wants to make an offering, the great Misss Joseline has more good stuff.
At this moment, the Purple little dragon, who was sleeping in the mane nest of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, slightly fluttered its eyelids, uttering a milky growl, and fumbled under its neck scales with its small claw.
Unlike scales elsewhere, a few scales under the Purple little dragon’s neck contained mysterious patterns, full of divine and strange auras as they shimmered with purple light.
To the little dragon, since its previous two ‘offerings’ were apparently disregarded as too mundane – eggshells and such might not impress the mighty one – it planned to pluck and offer one of its reverse scales, infused with the essence of creation.
The Purple little dragon’s persistent approach to ‘offering’ made the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitch, and it couldn’t help but growl, “Misss Joseline, this time I’m not making an offering, but giving a gift.”
Yiya! The Purple little dragon seemed puzzled, hadn’t it already given a gift last time?
As the bewildered Purple little dragon watched, the summoning vortex in front of it slowly disappeared, and nothing happened.
Boom!
After transferring the life crystals to his main body, an immense Terrifying Aura burst forth from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and the process of forcibly suppressing his break through to Titan started once again.
Roaring! Strands of black lightning, golden light, flames, and Higher-order Thunder Law erupted from around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, intertwining into Law Chains.
Terrible power shattered and annihilated everything, creating a ‘world’ with a hundred-kilometer diameter centered around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, bursting with kaleidoscopic colors.
In the center of this nascent Laws World, everything was being remade, including the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s flesh, bones, genes, and form, all undergoing transformation.
Enveloped in what seemed like a Cocoon of Chaos, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt an overpowering urge to hibernate, slowly closing its eyes.
In the Plane World, Jack stood atop the Space-Time Summoning Altar, with more than twenty thousand low-level life crystals floating in front of him, shining like a splendid galaxy of sparkling lights.

chapters.title: Chapter 1103 - 1103 447 Time Silver Butterfly Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1103: Chapter 447 Time Silver Butterfly, Ancient Dueling Arena_2 Chapter 1103: Chapter 447 Time Silver Butterfly, Ancient Dueling Arena_2 Looking at these Life Crystals enough to be converted into more than two hundred thousand Attribute points, Jack Clark couldn’t help but reveal a smile on his face as he waved his hand and collected the Life Crystals into his Storage Bracelet.
Just as Jack Clark stowed away the Life Crystals, that indistinct sense of surveillance from an unknown spacetime re-emerged, accompanied by an intense aura of danger.
Hum!
In the Void ahead, a creature with wings spanning over three thousand meters, resembling a silver butterfly, appeared surrounded by countless golden specks, exuding an air of magnificent opulence.
And at the very instant this time-being, covered in silver dragon scales, appeared, a Titan-level Terrifying Aura burst forth, causing the entire Plane World to shake frantically.
Mid-Mythical Stage! Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed.
A Titan-level Giant Beast already possesses immense strength, and this Time Silver Butterfly, with the power of the Supreme Time Laws, was no less formidable than the Lava Titan Giant.
“As expected of a creature that commands the power of time.” A powerful battle intent showed in Jack Clark’s eyes. Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon was in hibernation, he still had one last trump card.
That was to summon the Power Projection and enter the Mythical Fusion Form again.
At that moment, at the edge of the sky, the Time Silver Butterfly flapped its double wings, causing the surrounding golden specks to erupt, forming a transparent tide that overwhelmed everything.
Under the power of time, everything between heaven and earth slowed down, consciousness and thought came to a halt, and all that was seen became blurred, unreal, and transparent.
Feeling that power, which differed from spatial forces, Jack forcibly suppressed the urge to unleash the Law of Strength and shatter everything. Instead, he let that force sweep him into endless spacetimes.
With his command of the coordinates to the Supreme Hell Plane, Jack was not afraid of getting lost in unknown spacetimes; rather, he feared scaring away the Time Silver Butterfly.
He needed a stable space and time, a location, to release a full-force strike and obliterate this time-being.
However, the Time Silver Butterfly seemed highly wary of Jack, staying concealed within the chaotic currents, never approaching him after pulling him into the intersecting Space-Time Storm.
Within the Space-Time Storm, Jack continuously descended, not knowing how much time had elapsed; when the surrounding golden tide disappeared, he plummeted down from the sky.
Boom!
The earth shattered hundreds of meters around Jack, with the impact sending numerous fragments flying.
“What place is this?” In the midst of rising smoke and dust, Jack’s expression was grave as he looked around.
This was an Arena as wide as three hundred kilometers, resembling one hewn from rough boulders. On the edges of the mountain wall-like stone walls that towered five thousand meters high were some mottled bloodstains.
At the same time, around the vast Arena in the audience seats, thousands of stone statues of different shapes and sizes—some resembling humans, others outright Giant Beasts—stood erect, emitting Terrifying Auras.
As Jack surveyed his surroundings with a solemn gaze, a moment of realization dawned upon him.
The Ancient Dueling Arena.
This was a special relic known as the Ancient Dueling Arena, shrouded by the mighty ancient Rule power, where the “periodic” operation of the Rules happened every now and then.
And this “periodic” operation refers to the appearance of two selected Duelers.
When the two Duelers appeared as the Time Rules operated, only the victorious one could leave the Arena, with a random and astounding reward.
A formidable Rule Forbidden Weapon, a potent bloodline, an unrivaled physique, or a direct advancement from Early Myth to Mythical Peak.
Seeing this, Jack sported a smile.
Because the dueling Rule constituted an equal-level death battle, which meant that whichever enemy appeared next, whether it was from different races or a Giant Beast, would be at the Mythical level.
With his current strength, Jack was confident he could blow away any Mythical-level opponent, even those from civilizations more advanced than The Purgatory Family.
Regarding the Time Silver Butterfly that stirred the Space-Time Storm, although invisible, Jack could keenly sense its evasive gaze.
Clearly, this time being intended to use another to kill him by leveraging the Ancient Dueling Arena.
Of course, there was also the possibility that the Time Silver Butterfly was the pulling creature for this Arena, specially drawing powerful beings from different spacetimes here to duel.
While Jack was looking around contemplatively, dozens of kilometers away, the Space-Time distorted and a figure towering a hundred meters appeared, instantly bursting with a supremely Overbearing Aura.
Boom!
A semicircular white shock wave formed from around the figure as the central point, sweeping over more than ten kilometers and collapsing the ground beneath into a kilometer-wide crater.
Even the solely emitted power Aura was so astonishing that Jack’s eyes narrowed.
This was a being resembling a human but with a body covered in black fur, a face like that of a Furious Ape, protruding mouth and jaw, sharp ears, wearing a Red Battle Armor, and even a tail behind.
This Furious Ape Alien Race emitted the energy of Mid-Mythical Stage, but the omnipresence of its Power Pressure far surpassed the Legendary Realm, very powerful!
Worthy of being selected to enter the Ancient Dueling Arena as an alien.
Tens of kilometers away, the Furious Ape Alien Race exhaled a stream of raging wind, its dark red eyes fixed on Jack, its already fierce face revealing a cold, cruel smile.
“Insiginifcant alien, I am the mighty Kofder from the supremely strong Fude tribe. As my opponent, you deserve to have your name known to me.”
Due to the rules of the Arena, the Furious Ape’s speech automatically translated into Federation language while speaking.
Jack Clark slowly spoke, “Human Race, Darren Callum.”
Human Race.
Kofder thought for a moment and realizing he had never heard of this race in the inheritance memories of his bloodline, his face became even more ferocious, and his voice dropped lower.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104 - 1104 447 Time Silver Butterfly Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1104: Chapter 447 Time Silver Butterfly, Ancient Dueling Arena_3 Chapter 1104: Chapter 447 Time Silver Butterfly, Ancient Dueling Arena_3 “Human Race, never heard of it—sounds like some inconspicuous ordinary civilization beings, but I will remember this name,”
As it spoke, the Power Pressure emanating from the Black Violent Ape surged, and a red iron column that was as tall as a mountain and two hundred meters in length appeared in its hand, slamming onto the ground.
Boom! The Earth quaked, as the solid grey rock crumbled and tumbled like waves in all directions, clearly indicating the immense weight of the iron column.
“Within three breaths, the fight will be resolved.” A profound Battle Intent burst from the Black Violent Ape amidst the deep voice, as if a Demon God had descended, making heaven and earth tremble momentarily.
The moment the voice faded, the Black Violent Ape vanished, then appeared above Jack Clark’s head faster than the eye could follow, as though it had teleported, and only then did a sonic boom resonate between heaven and earth.
Roar!
In the midst of the roar, the red iron column fell from the sky, and with a terrifying strike, space shattered and the atmosphere exploded, creating a white pillar of air that stretched for ten thousand meters, making for a sight that shook the heavens and the earth.
Boom!
The terrifying strike caused heavens to fall and earth to split, tearing open a crack several kilometers wide and tens of kilometers long in the earth, the terrifying force making the whole world tremble.
Amidst billowing smoke and dust, red light shimmered on the Black Violent Ape’s body, its aura majestic, but a grave expression had appeared on its previously nonchalant face.
At the edge of the shattered earth, a figure, three hundred meters tall, emerged with a Three-Faced Six-Armed True Body, Jack Clark stood firm with a halberd in hand, blocking the strike from the Black Violent Ape.
Golden flames burned on Jack Clark’s body, surrounded by Thunder, emitting a Terrifying Aura that struck fear into the heart, his face cold and indifferent as he said lightly,
“Is this your strength? It seems a bit weak.” As he spoke, Jack Clark’s arm muscles slightly bulged, and an immense Power Explosion occurred within his body, the War Halberd sweeping across.
With an explosive noise, the space within a few kilometers shook violently as if hit by an earthquake, the mighty strength sending Kofder flying.
Boom!
The hundred-meter-tall Kofder shot out at many times the speed of sound, the strong force forming layers of transparent shockwaves around him due to the incredible speed, crashing into the walls of the Arena tens of kilometers away.
Instantly, the walls within a radius of thousands of kilometers crumbled, countless rocks fell, stirring up billowing clouds of dust.
It was just one move, and Kofder, who had boasted about resolving the fight within three breaths, was directly swept away.
Just then, from the collapsing ‘mountain wall,’ a low and thick voice emanated, “Human Race, Darren Callum, your strength merits my serious attention now.”
Boom!
The exploding mountain wall erupted, releasing an Aura that shattered mythical boundaries, the powerful, invisible Power Pressure causing the earth to quake.
Amidst the shaking earth, a figure over three hundred meters tall emerged from the smoke and dust.
Kofder’s eyes were now blood-red, filled with endless ferocity and Killing Intent; its appearance had greatly changed, its entire body now shrouded in golden red flames.
These golden red flames were the result of two grand accomplishment Higher-order Laws that Kofder mastered, merging within the bloodline power, wrapping his whole body in flames.
In this form, Kofder was incredibly powerful — the invisible force it emitted distorted the surrounding space and light, creating Black Cracks in the air.
This scene was somewhat similar to the Destruction Emperor Dragon entering its Deep Red Form, both representing an ultimate enhancement of physical strength by merging all powers to explode everything with absolute strength.
Under the humiliation of being thrown away with a single blow, Kofder directly entered its bloodline transformation form and, with an invisible threatening Aura, pushed back Jack Clark, who couldn’t help but feel somewhat solemn.
Early stage Heavenly King, no, that power was even stronger than a typical early stage Heavenly King strong man.
Roar! Kofder let out a ferocious howl, and with a thunderous crash, it shot up into the sky, instantly appearing at an altitude of tens of kilometers.
In Kofder’s hand, the red iron column that was seven hundred meters long swung, shattering the Firmament. As it wielded the iron column, infused with the merged power of two Higher-order Laws, a shadow of a world of destruction formed.
From afar, it looked like a red world, ten kilometers in diameter, descending from the sky, the formless destructive power churning Heaven and Earth, creating rings of white shockwaves.
Boom! The sky shattered, the cosmos sank.
Under the terrifying strike, the earth within tens of kilometers blasted apart, the rocks, as tough as Super Alloy, exploded outward in circles.
The formidable force even completely destroyed the space at the center of the area, creating wild streams of Chaos.
In the midst of the chaotic streams, Kofder continued to roar, and with the red iron column carrying the force of world destruction in hand, it slowly pressed down on Jack Clark, who stood below, merging his six arms to hold the halberd.
Roar! Kofder howled, a more immense strength Bursting from within it.
Under the terrifying force, Jack Clark was blasted out, crashing tens of kilometers away and sliding backward, plowing two trenches more than ten kilometers long in the ground.
Above the shattered earth, the three hundred meter tall violent ape’s face swelled with brutality, its voice low and thick, “Darren Callum, this is the true power of my Fude tribe.”
After the rage of being blown away by an unforeseen strike from Jack Clark and then transforming into a Bloodline Form, to return the favor by blasting Jack Clark away, Kofder felt exhilarated.
Indeed, their Fude tribe was truly peerless within the same rank.
Jack Clark slowly spoke, “Your strength is indeed very strong.”
The Bloodline Transformation coupled with the strength of the Higher-order Laws made Kofder’s fighting power almost approach the mid-stage Heavenly King, and Jack Clark’s ordinary True Demon God Body couldn’t contend with it.
Boom!
Dazzling golden flames erupted from Jack Clark’s body, forming a sea of fire that covered a ten-kilometer radius, with blue Thunderbolts, thick as dozens of meters, roaring within this fiery domain.
Simultaneously, Black-red Scales grew all over Jack Clark’s body, his Aura skyrocketing, a pair of black dragon horns sprouted from his head, followed by a Dragon Tail.
Without any wasted words, when two surpassing geniuses from different worlds and different tribes entered their strongest forms, the real battle Burst forth.
Boom!
The black War Halberd, wrapped in Golden Flame and Thunder, ripped through space, creating a Black Light Curtain that was tens of kilometers long and appeared in front of the Black Violent Ape.

chapters.title: Chapter 1105 - 1105 448 The Supreme Descent Hell and Crimson
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1105: Chapter 448: The Supreme Descent, Hell and Crimson Chapter 1105: Chapter 448: The Supreme Descent, Hell and Crimson Roar!
Kofder let out a roar, his body shimmering with golden red flames, vaguely forming a colossal shadow of a Crimson Violent Ape thousands of meters tall behind him.
Boom!
As the War Halberd collided with the red iron column, in an instant, a Destructive Impact force burst forth, shattering space over a large area and creating a dark area several kilometers in size.
Under the full-strength Power Explosion of two ‘Giant Beasts’ nearing the power level of a mid-period Heavenly King, the Void itself made sounds as if it could no longer bear the load.
Extreme strength was concentrated in the War Halberd and the red iron column, with not a trace spilling out, completely different from Jack Clark’s past casual and grandiose style of fighting.
Roar! The three-hundred-meter-tall Black Violent Ape let out a tyrannical roar, and under the powerful rebounding force, it and Jack Clark both retreated several kilometers.
Then, the two ‘Persons’ transformed into two streaks of Radiance and collided once again.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The two beings became one golden-blue and one golden-red Light Beam, continuously intertwining and clashing with a speed that transcended consciousness and vision in a frenzy of blows.
With each moment passing, they exchanged hundreds of moves, shattering the Earth below, tearing apart cracks and abysses reaching tens of kilometers in length, as if Doomsday had arrived.
Within a short time, the Dueling Ground spanning hundreds of kilometers was reduced to ruins; eventually, the two of them took their frenzied combat to the skies, with each collision making the sky ripple like the surface of a lake.
Under that extreme Overbearing power, space crumbled like fragile glass, breaking and healing, creating thousands to tens of thousands of meters of cracks while earthshaking roars echoed ceaselessly.
In the battle, both Jack Clark and Kofder became more and more excited, each moment exchanging hundreds of moves, with the heavy War Halberd swinging at speeds that had reached their peak.
Under the attack speed of more than a hundred times the speed of sound, they could not see each other’s moves, nor could they perceive clearly even with their consciousness, fighting entirely with instincts honed to perfection.
When Jack Clark wielded the War Halberd, it wasn’t just the ultimate speed and strength; the techniques were as skilled as instincts, sweeping like a stick trembling, piercing like lightning, and chopping, splitting Heaven and Earth.
Added to that, the constantly changing hooks and turns of the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd made the heavy weapon seem infinitely versatile in his hands.
As a Supreme monster from an unknown powerful race, the Black Violent Ape was no less formidable; even without sophisticated halberd techniques, its simple cleaves, sweeps, and thrusts were unstoppable.
But with absolute strength and speed, all attacks from all directions were blocked by it, and every collision between them erupted in dazzling light and Destructive Shockwaves.
In the midst of their wild fight, the Qi Blood of the Demon God Emperor Dragon and the Black Violent Ape, that shook Heaven and Earth, permeated the air, a manifestation of the physical strength being pushed to their limits.
Both Jack Clark and Kofder possessed terrifyingly powerful bodies, Overbearing strength, and followed the path of crushing all opposition with sheer force.
Kofder, a top-tier monster from an unknown powerful race, not only had a True Body comparable to a Giant Beast but also possessed the ability to increase his strength by more than tenfold through a bloodline transformation.
Moreover, with mastery over Vajra and Titan, two Higher-order Laws, especially the grand accomplishment of the fusion of Higher-order Laws, his strength and Defense skyrocketed tenfold.
The combination of these two effects allowed it to break through its limits, elevating its combat power from the Mid-Mythical Stage to nearing a mid-period Heavenly King — a terrifying level.
It could be said that as of now, Kofder is the strongest opponent of his level that Jack Clark has encountered, breaking limits in every aspect and fighting him evenly under normal peak conditions.
However, no matter how strong the two were, they could not break out of the range covered by the Dueling Ground.
As the battle progressed, sensing that Jack’s aura was becoming increasingly powerful, anxiety flashed across the face of the Black Violent Ape.
What’s going on? How is it that this Human named Darren Callum shows no sign of diminishing vitality?
Kofder’s bloodline transformation was powerful, but the transformation consumed a great deal of bloodline energy and was not sustainable, making it a trump card not to be used recklessly.
Initially, it had assumed that by entering its strongest form and combining the power of two Higher-order Laws, it could obliterate this alien and plunder everything from him to use as nourishment.
But who could have known this alien would be frighteningly powerful, actually possessing a secondary transformation that allowed him to unleash a combat force nearing the mid-period Titan stage, even with an Early Myth cultivation level.
That would have been enough, but strangely enough, despite fighting with all his might, the alien showed no signs of exhaustion after half a day of secondary transformation. How could this be possible?
Feeling the strength of his Qi Blood rapidly depleting, Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath, knowing he could hold on for no more than two Star Moments (half an hour).
Roar!
With a tyrannical bellow, Power Explosion surged within Kofder as the golden red light on his Iron Column soared and transformed into a stick shadow sweeping across two thousand kilometers, expanding like an exploding golden red Star Ring.
The might of the strike triggered a spatial tidal wave that repelled everything in its path and exploded upon contact with the black War Halberd that pierced through the Void.
Boom! The shattered space tide created a powerful impact force, causing the entire Arena to tremble slightly.
The force of the counter blow sent Jack, in his Black Violent Ape form, flying dozens of kilometers away, his body enshrouded with flames like a golden-red light bursting forth, his aura terrifying.
From a distance, Darren in his Three-faced Six-armed Demon God Emperor Dragon Form stood aloft in the high sky, the Thunderflame Domain contracting and transforming into two Law Chains that wound around the black War Halberd.
Amidst the vast and majestic intertwining of flames and Lightning Law Power, the halberd emitted a dazzling light, brightening the dim sky, its aura earth-shattering.
Kofder, who had been fighting for two hours, was slightly out of breath, his aura a bit chaotic as his bloodshot eyes stared at the still-peak condition Jack from afar, his voice deep and low.
“Darren Callum, you are the only one of our Tier who can fight me at full strength face-to-face,” he said.
“Out of respect for you, I will next show you my true power, the power enough to destroy everything. Come forth, Crimson!”
As Kofder’s chant-like roar filled the air, the world suddenly changed color, and endless blood-colored light poured down from the sky, laden with the ultimate Destructive Aura.
Boom!
Behind the Black Violent Ape, a crimson world descended, engulfing half the world. Under the cloak of the blood-colored light, Kofder’s form swelled monstrously, radiating dazzling radiance.
Jack was familiar with this scene—Deep red Destruction Form.
Roar!
Within the blood-colored radiance stood a Giant Beast, a Destruction Ape a kilometer tall with red lightning writhing over its body, exuding power that was wild to the extreme.
Under the release of terrifying power, the sky collapsed, the fractured Earth trembled, and within a hundred kilometers, laws dissipated under that horrifying power, causing countless stones to lose their weight and float up.
As Kofder summoned the power of Crimson, the vertical eye on the brow of Darren’s Demon-God Facade on the left opened, emitting a dazzling blood light, revealing a square of blood-red hell within.
Boom!
Centered on Jack, the blood light exploded, forming a Blood Sea Doomsday Hell that spread across tens of kilometers, followed by the descent of Supreme Power’s attraction.
Heaven and Earth vibrated once again, and a blood-colored streak swept across the Firmament, spewing endless blood-colored light like a crack, turning the entire world crimson.
Standing within the Lord of Hell, Darren in his Emperor Dragon Form had scales that turned blood red, and beyond his dragon horns, another pair of blood-red dragon horns grew.
Whoosh! A ball of flame burned between the blood-red dragon horns, resembling a Blood Flame crown of infinite majesty, while behind him, his hundred-meter-long hair fluttered without wind like a red waterfall.
Simultaneously, a kilometer-tall Blood-colored Demon God Illusion emerged behind Jack, looming like the Lord of Hell itself, radiating an utterly terrifying might.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Centered on Jack and the Crimson Violent Ape, the two Supreme Plane forces bisected the world—the entire world shook with their invisible collision, and the Void cried out under pressure it couldn’t bear.
Standing within the Deep Red World, the kilometer-tall Crimson Violent Ape spoke with a thunderous voice, deep and resonate: “Unexpectedly, Darren Callum, you too are an agent of a Supreme Plane.”
Jack with his Demon Dragon form’s expression was indifferent, his voice layered and equally deep: “The same goes for you. It seems our encounter is fated for an ultimate battle.”
At the moment the two Supreme Plane powers descended, Jack realized that between him and Kofder, one ‘Person’ must die—this was the warfare of the utmost.
[Crap, still 2,000 words short before midnight, I’ll update first and continue to revise this chapter to reach 5,000 words.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1106 - 1106 449 Mathilda Ward Returns One Star God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1106: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer Chapter 1106: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer Utilizing Hell Plane coordinates to jump, the greater the ‘distance’ of return, the higher the energy consumption.
With Jack Clark’s current strength, the fact that he felt weak in the legs from excessive energy consumption under such circumstances suggests just how distant the space-time of the Ancient Dueling Arena must be.
Fortunately, this scene wasn’t witnessed by anyone familiar.
After catching his breath for a short while, Jack Clark’s body surged with powerful energy, dispelling his weakness and fatigue.
This was the advantage of having a strong physique; recovery and stamina were astoundingly immense, almost restoring part of his strength with each breath he took.
Whoosh! In an instant, Jack Clark’s figure vanished, reappearing at the entrance of a distant clubhouse. At this moment, his aura was already concealed by the power of Hidden Deity, making him appear just like an ordinary person.
This Concealing Breath Secret Method, once exchanged in the Triplex, became terrifyingly potent once Jack Clark further enhanced it to its limit and merged it with the Innate Demon God’s Body, transforming it into the power of Hidden Deity.
While it might seem to be of little significance in day-to-day affairs, it was enormously useful.
When actively used, it could temporarily erase one’s presence to sneak around undetected. It also allowed Jack Clark to perfectly conceal his aura and appear as an ordinary person, as he was doing now.
This was something many king-level strong men couldn’t achieve.
As beings who have condensed the Rule True Body and undergone a Transformation in life, kings can be regarded as another form of high-energy aggregates. Their aura, even when concealed, inevitably radiates a strong life magnetic field.
Within this domain marked by divine and law vibrations, or perhaps better termed as radiation range, ordinary people’s consciousness, and even their souls, simply cannot withstand it.
This is why most Mythical Kings seldom make public appearances, and if they do, the ones who interact with them are advanced cultivators; ordinary people don’t even have the privilege of approaching them.
Only after breaking through to the Heavenly King and moving past the ‘Boundary’ can one retract the radiation formed by this life magnetic field.
“Jack, you’re back,” said Jack Clark, just having taken his seat when Justin Welan chortled with pride.
“When Howard Lambert was speaking, he kept glancing over here from time to time. He messed up the speech he had memorized this morning a couple of times, haha, serves him right for trying to show off every day.”
Justin Welan seemed to take some delight in Howard Lambert’s misfortune. An Eight Layer Expert who could forget his speech, it’s not hard to imagine how nervous Howard Lambert must have been up there on stage.
Or rather, it might not have been nervousness, but embarrassment instead because the speech prepared for him by the school contained a lot of self-praise, such as being dubbed the number one talent currently in the school.
If Jack Clark hadn’t returned, Howard Lambert would have confidently assumed such a title without hesitation.
But just thinking about the presence of a One-Year King monster sitting amongst the audience while proclaiming himself as the first in talent on stage made him feel inexplicably embarrassed.
Jack Clark laughed and said, “Actually, Howard Lambert’s talent is quite strong. There are less than ten people in the Federation from this generation who can surpass him.”
What made Howard Lambert strong wasn’t his Heavenly God Divine Strength, but that madness that feared neither death nor danger, having surpassed life-threatening injuries dozens of times to catch up with Jane Aiken’s mid period pace.
What followed goes without saying, a stroke of fortune leading him to obtain two types of ancient Inheritance.
After Howard Lambert’s speech, some teachers made their speeches. Then, Crystal Lewis turned back to look at Jack Clark, “Jack Clark, how long can you stay this time? ”
Jack Clark smiled slightly, “About ten days or so. Once this event is over, I’ll re-enter the mythical world; the Sky Curtain Battlefield has erupted into a Civilization War again.”
With his current strength, he already had the confidence to traverse the Frontline Battlefield, where he could blast apart a demon king with one halberd strike, directly depleting Law Divine Power to grind the opponent’s True Body into nothingness.
“A Civilization War, huh.”
Justin Welan exclaimed, “Think about it; on the Frontline Battlefield, Sixth Layer cultivators are just foot soldiers, high-order ones are everywhere, those of the Nine Layers are as common as dogs, and each major battle involves death and injury of tens to hundreds of millions.”
“What, millions of advanced cultivators killed or injured in a single battle!?” exclaimed Zac Maben and others, somewhat in disbelief.
“That’s correct. Death and injury of millions of advanced cultivators, and it’s said that every major battle changes the terrain within tens of thousands of kilometers, with mountain peaks collapsing and valleys being filled.”
“Ammunition consumption amounts to billions of tons, with thousands of large-yield hydrogen bombs being deployed, causing upheaval on earth and sky, and kings and demon kings constantly falling.”
Watching Justin Welan get more and more excited as he spoke, and noting the stunned looks from Mr. Willard and others hearing this for the first time, Jack Clark shook his head, “Don’t listen to Mr. Willard’s nonsense.”
“Although every major battle on the frontline is indeed gruesome, our Human Race’s casualties aren’t so severe; most of the destruction is caused by unmanned Mecha and Unmanned Fighters.”
“As for millions of casualties, that refers to the armies of the Purgatory Demon Race’s Vassal Races.”
“Take the recent Heavenly Abyss War, for example: Freya Louise piloted Number One and killed over eight hundred thousand of the different races’ corps. The weakest of them possessed the strength of the Fourth Layer Heaven, on top of that, there was a Purgatory Main Battle Corps comprising about seventy thousand, with levels above the Sixth Layer Heaven.”
“Freya Louise?”
“What is Number One?”
In an instant, including Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, and Matt Watkins, everyone was somewhat dumbfounded.
Freya Louise, the girl who handled guns.
Just a few months ago, when she parted ways with everyone, she was only in the Late-stage Third Layer Heaven, and now suddenly she emerged as a powerhouse traversing the Civilization Battlefield, slaughtering millions of high-level alien strong men — it seemed almost fantastical.
Especially for Crystal Lewis, whose roseate lips parted in disbelief, “How did Freya Louise suddenly become so formidable?”
Jack Clark explained with a smile, “Number One is a Biological Mecha developed by Simon. Its combat power is comparable to a king’s, and due to special circumstances, Freya Louise is the only driver.”
“I see.”
Marcus Lindsay breathed a sigh of relief, “You almost scared me to death; I thought Freya Louise had become a freak like you, Jack Clark, suddenly bursting through to king-level within a year.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1107 - 1107 449 Mathilda Ward Returns One Star God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1107: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer_2 Chapter 1107: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer_2 “But even so, it’s incredibly impressive, a Biological Mecha comparable to king-level creatures, and you’re the sole driver.”
At this point, the faces of several people revealed undisguised envy.
It was now the final moment of the ceremony, and everyone couldn’t help but turn their heads to look, while Jack Clark focused his attention on the arm of his left hand.
There was a new mark there, a combination of crossed swords surrounded by the gray imprint of a circular Dueling Ground, and as soon as Jack’s focus landed on that mark, a stream of information emerged.
One Star, God Slayer!
That was the title he had received for winning a duel, this mark connected to the Ancient Dueling Arena, and it would flicker whenever someone eligible to duel Jack appeared.
Faced with this situation, Jack could choose to decline or to accept and once again descend to the Ancient Dueling Arena to battle against unknown strong man from different races.
Defeat meant death, but victory promised astonishing rewards.
Besides, Jack could erase this dueling mark with just a thought if he wished; it wasn’t compulsory.
“One Star God Slayer,” Jack silently repeated to himself, choosing not to erase the mark.
The mysterious ancient relic was very special; although dangerous, the rewards it offered were also remarkable.
In addition to that, it also provided the opportunity to clash with monsters from other powerful civilizations.
For instance, Kofder, whose combat strength far surpassed the strongest bloodline inheritor of the Purgatory Family’s Demon God Level, clearly indicating that the Fude civilization was more powerful than The Purgatory Family.
Although the geniuses from these different racial civilizations were strong, Jack’s strength was even mightier, belonging to an exceptional class.
This recent battle seemed perilous, but in reality, Kofder posed no threat to him; Jack didn’t even use his Void Death Pupil during the fight, nor did he apply the profound mysteries of the Void or Death Laws.
Otherwise, he could have heavily injured Kofder during his transformation into the Black Violent Ape Bloodline.
If it weren’t for wanting to learn more about the power systems and combat methods of other civilizations, Jack would have finished it off much earlier.
As Jack pondered this, the opening ceremony came to a successful close.
Laurant Harris made the final speech from the podium: “School officially starts tomorrow. For now, the freshmen are free to explore the campus. This meeting is now adjourned.”
“Finally, it’s over.”
“Yeah,” the freshmen below were excitedly heading out, and Jack and his peers stood up to leave as well.
“Junior Clark, I haven’t seen you for half a year, and you seem even more handsome.”
“…Really?” Hearing the compliment on his looks, Jack couldn’t help but smile.
“Jack Clark, you’ve already gone to the mythical world, haven’t you?”
“Yes, I entered two months ago.”
Walking out of the stadium, many second and third year classmates greeted Jack enthusiastically, and he nodded back to each of them in response.
However, whenever a beauty tried to approach, Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis would subtly block the way, forcing them to speak with Jack from a distance.
This scenario caught Marcus Lindsay by surprise a few meters back.
Just then, the group arrived at the entrance of the stadium and ‘happily’ bumped into Fay Swift, dressed in a black dress and exuding an elegant mature charm.
Approaching Jack, Fay Swift smiled and said, “Hello, Junior Clark. I am Fay Swift from Senior Class 1, I’ve heard a lot about you.”
As she spoke, Fay Swift slightly turned sideways, extending her hand past Crystal Lewis.
“Senior sister Swift, hello. Your name was already introduced on the podium earlier,” Jack said with a slight smile, shaking her extended hand lightly before letting go.
“Repeating my name one more time will make a deeper impression on you,”
Ignoring Crystal, who stood coldly in front of her, Fay’s gaze lingered on Jack, revealing a multitude of meanings with a gentle laugh.
Fay Swift’s behavior surprised the people around her.
Fay was very beautiful with delicate features and fair skin; she would be considered a beauty on the internet, and her elegance and intelligence were accentuated by her maturity.
Furthermore, her figure was slender and attractive, especially in her form-fitting black dress, which gave her a voluptuous and enticing appearance.
However, in comparison with the incredibly beautiful Crystal Lewis and her similarly attractive figure, Fay Swift was still a notch below, which is why Jack merely offered her a slight smile.
As Jack prepared to greet her before taking his leave, a figure emerged from the crowd of freshmen, calling out happily, “Brother Callum!”
Seeing the girl rushing toward him, Jack didn’t dodge but let her hug his arm; her ample chest almost deformed from the squeeze. The sight caused Crystal Lewis and her sister to look sideways.
Looking at the Fox-eared girl clinging to his arm, Jack was a bit puzzled, “Ilisa, what are you doing at South Sky Martial Arts School?”
Jack had noticed her during the earlier ceremony, but it was unclear why a Descendant of the King and a ‘princess’ from Hundred Foxes Nation would come here.
“It was my grandfather, he sent me here to study,”
The charmingly cute Gwen Gail said happily, “He told me this place is the Federation’s Place of Fortune, not only has it produced a peerless prodigy like you, but also a sister with the posture of a Heavenly King.”
“Even if I can’t be as powerful as the two of you, just catching a bit of your good luck would be a huge gain.”
“…Is it so exaggerated?” Jack asked with a puzzled expression.
Being a place of Fortune may be true, but it definitely wasn’t because of him; after all, his current achievements relied on his efforts and his ‘Soul Split’ talent, and had nothing to do with luck.
Then, Sawyer Levin, a few steps behind them, eyed the girl hugging Jack’s arm with a mix of surprise and suspicion, “Wenwen, does that girl look familiar to you, as if she appeared next to Mathilda Ward a few months ago?”
About the battle against Blood God Acunus a few months ago, countless videos have circulated online, and most people in the Federation have seen them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1108 - 1108 449 Mathilda Ward Returns One Star God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1108: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer_3 Chapter 1108: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer_3 In that video, there was the figure of Gwen Gail trapped as well.
Vera Wada nodded her head, “It’s her, for sure, and Jack Clark must be Darren Callum. I recognized him as soon as he returned to the school, otherwise how could they be so similar?”
Thinking of Jack Clark as the Darren Callum, who had become a global sensation a few months ago, Sawyer Levin’s eyes revealed a look of amazement, “This guy, indeed, never ceases to astonish everyone.”
At that moment, Jack Clark smiled slightly and introduced to Crystal Lewis and the others, “This is Gwen Gail, the sister of a friend of mine, from the Gail Family in the Hundred Foxes Nation.”
“Moon, these are my friends, Justin Welan, Marcus Lindsay…”
Boom! Before Jack Clark could finish, the entire world seemed to tremble slightly, as an invisible surge swept across the world.
Under the tide-like wave, many places around the globe experienced strong space fluctuations, and a dark crack appeared in the high altitude two kilometers away from South Sky Martial Height.
“Alert, strong spatial fluctuations detected at Hole Source Road. All Martial Cultivation teachers are requested to hurry to the location to prevent any possible invading Giant Beasts.”
“Communications have been sent to all departments to urgently organize personnel to evacuate the crowd at the scene, to avoid unnecessary casualties.”
The moment the detector issued the alarm, all the cultivators above Fourth Layer Heaven in Mist River City received the notification. The nearby South Sky Martial Height especially saw figures shooting out one after another.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!! In just a few breaths, figures emanating the aura of Sixth Layer Heaven, Seventh Layer Heaven appeared atop the surrounding skyscrapers.
The sudden change caused a stir among the students of South Sky Martial Height. They swiftly poured out of the stadium and stood in the square outside, looking towards the distance.
Two kilometers away, at a height of several thousand meters, the crack was clearly visible without needing to approach it. It appeared like a dark scar across the firmament.
At the same time, Jack Clark’s wristband flickered, and the incoming message made him raise an eyebrow.
Whoosh!
Laurant Harris appeared beside Jack Clark, looking at him with a wry smile, “The principal was just saying that after the opening ceremony, he was going to invite you over for tea, but it looks like there’s no time now.”
Jack nodded, “Indeed, there is no time. A passageway crack with a strength over level ten has opened up in South City; I need to go there.”
Turning to Justin Welan and the others, he said, “I’ve got something to take care of so I’ll take my leave first, I’ll invite everyone for a meal when I am back.”
After saying this, he waved to everyone and his figure flashed, suddenly appearing in the firmament several kilometers away, casually striking at the nearby Black Cracks with his palm.
Boom!
A palm wrapped in intertwining golden flames and blue thunder made the space for hundreds of meters in front of him suddenly solidify, then, like a fragile mirror, shattered explosively.
The terrifying golden-blue Law Power palm imprint penetrated the Void, burst into the Rift Channel, and under the impact of the mighty Law Power the forces of the Boundary collapsed.
Boom!
The crack spanning two worlds collapsed, forming a black hole hundreds of meters in diameter. The invisible burst of impact emitted a dazzling black and white halo, sweeping through a range of ten or so kilometers.
Wherever it passed, the energy of heaven and earth plummeted, level ten violent winds, flying sand and rolling stones buffeted everyone below so much so that they had to instinctively shield their eyes.
As the raging wind dissipated, everyone looked towards the sky in shock. There, the collapsing space was self-repairing and had already mostly mended, shrinking like a black scar.
Beyond that, a faint mixture of golden and blue light filled the air, and the invisible Law pressure spread, making countless people’s breathing tense and rapid.
At this moment, the thousands of freshmen who had just entered South Sky Martial Height finally understood why so many Senior Students were proactively greeting the black-haired young man.
Too terrifying!!
A casual palm strike that could destroy vast expanses of space – if such a strike were to hit the ground, wouldn’t it be equivalent to a nuclear explosion?
After shattering the level eight fluctuating crack with a casual palm, Jack Clark turned into a streak of golden light and flew above the sea of clouds. He took out his mobile phone and called Doris Clark.
The call connected quickly, and Jack spoke directly, “Mom, something came up in South City, I need to check it out. I might not be able to come back for lunch.”
…
South City
As the number one economic giant of Eastern Summer, South City has a population of over ten million and is extremely prosperous.
However, at this time, the southeastern suburban area of South City had been sealed off by the military. The highways, city ring roads, and various other roads leading in and out of the southeastern area were barred.
Meanwhile, several villages and small towns nearby were also being evacuated under the guidance of the law enforcement team.
The reason being, more than ten kilometers from the city of South, a horizontal black crack appeared a hundred meters above the ground, stretching over a thousand and three hundred meters long and a hundred meters high.
This crack emitted strong energy fluctuations, and the Boundary forces spread, forming winds of over 10+ category typhoon strength, roaring and shredding everything within several kilometers to pieces.
Such a grand display naturally sent the whole of South City into an uproar, and numerous thrill-seekers, self-media personalities, and live-streamers excitedly rushed over.
“Everyone is prohibited from approaching the crack; it’s dangerous there,” the soldiers warned.
At a distance of ten or so kilometers, the people were stopped by soldiers, forbidden to get close.
“Don’t worry, brother, we definitely won’t cause trouble for the officials. We just want to have a look from the outside,” they assured.
“That’s right, just a look.”
With that, these people sprinted hundreds of meters towards the hillside several hundred meters away. Among them, some were cultivators of several layers of cultivation.
Soon, they found good spots from which they could see the crack on the plain ten or so kilometers away. They started live-streaming, clicking photos, and posting to their social circles.
