chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1109: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer_4 Chapter 1109: Chapter 449 Mathilda Ward Returns, One Star God Slayer_4 “`
Even drones were released, rising hundreds of meters into the high altitude to film from a distance, each displaying their divine powers.
In this increasingly networked world, traffic is money.
However, the officials had anticipated this and had already stationed personnel from South City Television Station to film up close in order to soothe the restlessness caused by the lockdown.
“Hello, everyone, I am Mickey, the host from South City Television Station, currently located in the southeast outskirts. As you can see behind me, there is a huge space crack.”
“This is a massive pathway connecting to the mythical world, extremely dangerous, and at any moment powerful and ferocious Giant Beasts might emerge, just like fifty years ago.”
“Therefore, for everyone’s safety, the officials have already started evacuating the nearby residents and blocking traffic. Please don’t panic and don’t add to the chaos by breaking into the restricted area.”
“No matter what creatures from the mythical world or unknown invading beings appear on the other side, the officials have the absolute strength to suppress everything.”
While that reporter was excitedly speaking to the camera, one military vehicle after another drove by, and soon Valentine Leach, the commander of South City Military Base, appeared.
Standing on a hundred-meter-high hillside, Valentine Leach looked at the massive passage ahead with a grave expression, then turned to his deputy, “Have you informed the higher-ups?”
“Yes, they’ve been notified, including Miss Ward, who will be arriving soon.”
Valentine Leach said solemnly, “The spatial fluctuations of this crack have reached level eleven. Once stabilized, it’s sufficient to let Mythical-level existences pass through. Miss Ward’s presence alone is not enough.”
The deputy nodded: “I know, I’ve already explained the situation to the higher-ups. The Federation’s Monitoring Center said they have notified the nearest King-level strong man, who will arrive soon.”
“That’s good,” Valentine Leach nodded.
Just then, a silver radiance flashed across the distant sky, and Mathilda Ward, with her silver hair like snow and wearing an elegant silver dress, descended from the heavens.
And the moment Mathilda Ward landed on the hillside where Valentine Leach was standing, not only was it captured by the television station’s camera below, but also by far-off drones and the cameras of social media personalities, all of whom instinctively zoomed in to the max.
In an instant, countless people were astounded.
“It’s Mathilda Ward, Ilisa is still alive!”
“Woo-woo!! My Ilisa is still here, she’s still here. She hasn’t appeared for several months, I thought she was dead.”
“Same here. After the one-month prayer event ended and she didn’t show up, with no news at all, I thought she was gone too.”
In South City, at this moment, countless young men and women watching the live news and paying attention to the crack outside the city became excited.
As an international superstar, especially after her globally sensational tour ended, Mathilda Ward’s popularity in Eastern Summer was frighteningly high, an idol for countless youths.
Not to mention her rumored reappearance months after her death.
“Wait a minute, why has Ilisa’s hair turned white?”
“What white, that’s silver. I think Ilisa looks even more beautiful with silver hair, with an air of noble grace and stunning delicacy, so gorgeous.”
“Aren’t you guys missing the point here? Didn’t you notice that Mathilda Ward flew over here just now?”
“You should know only those in the Eighth Layer can float by stepping on the void, whereas Ninth Heaven Experts can fly.”
“Hiss! How is that possible, Ilisa is actually a cultivator, and a Ninth Heaven Expert?”
While countless ordinary people were shocked and in an uproar over Mathilda Ward’s appearance, and her being a Ninth Heaven Expert, Mathilda Ward was looking at the crack with a serious expression.
“General Leach, the spatial fluctuations of this crack have exceeded level ten. Has the higher-ups mentioned calling over a King-level powerhouse?”
Valentine Leach’s deputy respectfully said, “Miss Ward, I just received a response from the Command Center. All the king-level thrones around the world are tied down, but the Divine Martial king is already on his way.”
This time, five king-level beings were called to aid, adding to the four king-level beings originally stationed on Blue Star, making a total of nine.
However, three of the king-level beings had to guard the world passageways of the three major empires and could not be mobilized at will, so only six king-level beings were dispersed among the nations of the world.
“`
Upon learning that Jack Clark was ‘nearby,’ the Command Center contacted him directly.
“The Divine Martial Throne?” The name made Mathilda Ward startle, as she didn’t recall hearing about a throne with such a title within the Federation.
During this time, Mathilda Ward had been in closed-door cultivation, practicing True Martial Arts, and re-condensing her Transcendent True Body.
Although fusing a complete Dragon Series Law and her Soul Source, her soul underwent a Divine Soul Transformation and she became half a king, reaching the peak of the Ninth Heavens in one step.
But as an ‘ordinary person’ without a foundation, she still needed to cultivate dragon attribute True Martial Arts compatible with her and refine her martial intent to truly master the strength of the Ninth Heaven Peak.
Thus, Mathilda Ward was unaware of the changes in the outside world.
In response to Mathilda Ward’s confusion, Valentine Leach couldn’t help but laugh: “The Divine Martial Throne is a newly advanced king-level powerhouse in the Federation, and it turns out he is also a good friend of yours, Miss Ward.”
“Good friend…”
Mathilda Ward paused, then a look of shock gradually crossed her face; she was surprised, “General Leach, don’t tell me that the Divine Martial Throne is Brother Callum!?”
Among the Federation’s newly advanced kings in the past three-plus months, and considering her circle of friends, Jack Clark was the first person she thought of.
Although she knew many high-ranking powerhouses, the only ones she considered friends were Jack Clark and Damon Lopes.
Mathilda Ward immediately ruled out Damon Lopes, considering that although he was an Innate Awakened One, only Jack Clark could have achieved this feat.
For others, going from the Seventh Layer to the mythic realm in three months might seem like a fantasy, but Mathilda Ward had blind faith in Jack Clark.
After all, how many individuals could break through the Sixth Layer in half a semester and within a month create a top-tier Secret Manual to break through the Seventh Layer?
Beyond that, his combat prowess was defying the heavens. With the cultivation at the late period of the Sixth Layer, he consecutively slew two Evil God Soul Splits, and his combat power even reached the Eight Layer Heaven.
“Miss Ward truly has a heart pure as orchid, guessing it right on the first try,” Valentine Leach said.
Valentine Leach nodded: “Indeed, the Divine Martial Throne is Mr. Jack Clark. Several days ago, he achieved king-level at the base of the 30th Army Group, becoming the fastest individual in the history of the Human Race to make such a breakthrough.”
“Then, he immediately entered the battlefield of the Divine Gods Alliance and single-handedly crushed the Evil God Alliance, suppressing the Three Demon Kings from the shadows, eternity, and the Demon God Sect.”
“The talent of the Divine Martial Throne is unparalleled, his combat power is terrifyingly formidable to a degree that is beyond both the ancients and anyone who will come after, making all of us look up in admiration.”
Speaking of this, even Valentine Leach couldn’t help but be amazed, as nobody would have anticipated that this king had just broken through the Seventh Layer at his base just over three months ago.
In the face of such a pinnacle individual, all cultivators could only feel respect and astonishment, without envy or jealousy.
All cultivators knew how difficult it was to practice a path; that person who had managed to cultivate to the King Realm in such a short time must have endured untold hardships.
Only by continuously pushing through obstacles, breaking limits time and again, could one ascend to myth in such a short period.
And while the cracks in South City grew larger, other black cracks surfaced across the globe, swiftly located due to spatial fluctuations.
However, this kind of location monitoring was somewhat inferior for the ocean.
Because of the sea’s isolating properties, human beings could not detect cracks deep under the sea, and countless pure and rich energies surged through these space cracks from the void.
Instantly, numerous mutated ocean creatures boiled with excitement, madly converging on those cracks.
Through hunting during this period, Dragon Palace had nearly eradicated the mutated creatures in the entire ocean, slaying all apex Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts of the same level.
A few hundred kilometers from the Dragon Palace Headquarters, at the Water and Fire World, also deep within the thousand-meter-deep sea, a massive black crack silently opened up.
As the crack stretched over a thousand meters, a dark red mist seeped out, spreading and enveloping the area.
The mutated creatures drawn by the crack stiffened upon contact with the mist; their eyes turned red, their bodies swelled, and ‘Crackle Crackle,’ sharp bone spurs sprouted ominously.
Meanwhile, on the other side of that vast pathway crack, a pair of terrifying eyes spied on this side.

chapters.title: Chapter 1110 - 1110 450 Divine Martials Arrival A Matching
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1110: Chapter 450 Divine Martial’s Arrival, A Matching Pair Chapter 1110: Chapter 450 Divine Martial’s Arrival, A Matching Pair “Report, a spatial fluctuation of Level 5 intensity was detected at coordinates xxx in the southeastern region and has already dissipated automatically.”
“A crack appeared in the center of Sangmo City in the Hundred Foxes Nation, revealing the presence of ordinary members of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, who have been captured.”
“A mutant awakener appeared in Riveredge City in Eastern Summer, causing several casualties. It has been suppressed by local advanced cultivators.”
“Towards the west coast of Berlin, a Level 9 fissure appeared in Canaan Valley, accompanied by an Eighth Level Giant Beast which has been suppressed…”
Above the sea of clouds at an altitude of ten thousand meters, accompanied by the roar of a sonic boom, Jack Clark, transformed into a streak of golden radiance, was flying while listening to the situation reported through his smart wristwatch.
The situation still seemed to be under the control of the Federation.
However, with such a large-scale anomaly, some people were unfortunate enough to perish, such as those whose houses were torn apart by the emerging Space Cracks, shredding the buildings and the people within.
In addition to this, many temporary cracks appeared and vanished during the impact, releasing a lot of contaminating energy.
Some of this energy came from dangerous forbidden areas, some from horrific creatures. It could strongly stimulate the people and living organisms nearby, causing mutations.
Over the years, the Heavenly Energy of the three major empires had become increasingly dense. Many people had already developed some Awakening Factors, but they were still not enough to undergo cultivation or awakening.
But this time, under the influence of the intense polluting energies, many individuals’ genes had undergone mutations, awakening Transcendent Powers, or even transformed them into monsters.
Among those who awakened abilities, those with stable spirits only needed to actively report to the local officials to avoid trouble.
However, those who were usually cruel-hearted and twisted, upon suddenly awakening and mutating, becoming endowed with great strength, would turn even more ruthless and aggressive.
Those people would then be quickly suppressed.
These mutants, who had never come into contact with the Transcendent, who knew nothing of True Martial, thought that an awakening would lead them to the pinnacle of life, that they were the protagonists, completely unaware of how terrifying advanced strong men could be.
“Hahaha… Glenn Clark, come out here, today I’m going to show you what strength is.”
In Mist River City, chaos had broken out at the school where Glenn Clark was.
On the Playground, a youth, no taller than 1.6 meters, covered in blue flames, was laughing maniacally while throwing balls of blue fire that exploded with deafening booms across the playground.
Those blue flames, like grenades, would explode violently upon hitting the ground, scattering blue flames that contained intense heat which turned the concrete surface into gray-white powder.
This terrifying scene scared the junior high students and teachers into hiding inside the Teaching Building, afraid to come out.
The junior high department, being unrelated to cultivation, meant that none of these schools had any cultivators, the teachers were ordinary people, and only the security guard was a low-level cultivator.
Yet, facing the astonishing power of the blue flames, the security guard didn’t dare to approach, only managing to pacify from a distance, “Classmate Carney Lawson, calm down. Your current state is very dangerous.”
“My current state is just fine. You’d best stay out of my way, or I’ll burn you to ashes. No one can stop me from teaching Glenn Clark a lesson today.”
At that moment, Teacher Reid appeared, speaking coldly, “Carney Lawson, stop immediately, or you’ll force my hand.”
“And what if I don’t stop?” The blue-haired youth looked at the sports teacher, who was kind to Glenn Clark, with intense disgust in his eyes.
Teacher Reid’s eyes turned frosty, “You’re looking for death.”
Just an ordinary Transcendent awakener, even if the blue flames he controlled were not weak, he was at most comparable to a low-level cultivator. Yet, he dared to be arrogant in front of her.
Then, Glenn Clark’s voice came from behind her, “Teacher Reid, let me handle this.”
Standing at 2 meters tall, far more imposing than his peers, Glenn Clark approached the edge of the Playground, eyeing the crazed Carney Lawson and asked, “Carney Lawson, what’s your grudge against me?”
He had some recollection of this classmate, who was usually quiet and reserved. They had no grudges between them, and they occasionally greeted each other with a nod.
Thus Glenn Clark was baffled, not understanding why Carney Lawson harbored such hostility towards him.
The blue-haired youth spat with hatred, “Humph! You despicable guy, relying on your towering height, no one dares to mess with you. You force Teresa Wilson and the others to hang out with you.”
“Today, I am going to be the agent of justice to punish you.”
From the second-floor corridor, a female student, who used to go to school with Glenn Clark, shouted angrily, “Carney Lawson, are you out of your mind? When did Teresa and the rest of us say that Glenn Clark forced us to hang out with him?”
Teresa Wilson also emerged, protesting, “Exactly, we are good friends with Glenn Clark, and we go to and from school together every day. What’s it to you?”
Another cute girl also ran out from another class, exclaiming, “If you dare to hurt Glenn Clark today, you’re dead. Glenn Clark’s brother is really powerful.”
Watching the three beautiful girls speak up for Glenn Clark, the youth grew even more infuriated, “Lies, all lies! Glenn Clark, you detestable guy, you actually coerced them to lie for you.”
… Damn.
Glenn Clark was speechless and couldn’t be bothered to argue with that guy, instead walking straight toward him. His towering 2-meter stature was overwhelming to the 1.6-meter Carney Lawson.
“Didn’t you say you wanted to teach me a lesson? Come on then, let’s see how you plan to do that.”
Seeing Glenn Clark advancing towards him with large strides, the blue-haired youth instinctively took a step back, his face twisting with madness, “You’re looking for death, I’m going to kill you.”
Boom! Carney Lawson’s hands gathered a dazzling blue fireball, about to…
Bang!
A hand covered in Black Gold Radiance appeared, crushing the intense fireball in Carney Lawson’s hand, followed by a palm grabbing his head and forcefully pressing down.

chapters.title: Chapter 1111 - 1111 450 Divine Martials Arrival A Matching
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1111: Chapter 450 Divine Martial’s Arrival, A Matching Pair_2 Chapter 1111: Chapter 450 Divine Martial’s Arrival, A Matching Pair_2 “`
Boom! The playground shattered, forming a small pit with a diameter of 3 meters, in which the blue-haired youth lay unconscious, his head pressed directly into the earth.
Glenn Clark, a burly figure, stood at the edge of the pit, emanating a heavy and oppressive overbearing might, shocking the students in the classrooms.
“Glenn Clark is so strong!”
In the eyes of Teresa Wilson and the other girls, it was even more sparkling.
…
In South City, as the massive black cracks expanded, the power of the boundary they emitted grew stronger, altering the colors of heaven and earth and gathering dark clouds amid howling winds.
The scene, as if doomsday had arrived, excited the new media journalists in the distance, with the number of viewers in their live broadcast rooms skyrocketing.
Suddenly someone pointed to the sky and shouted, “Look, what is that?”
Under the gaze of drones, camera lenses, and tens of thousands of onlookers, the dark clouds in the firmament suddenly dissipated, forming a hollow hundreds of meters in diameter, through which golden sunlight poured down.
Descending from the golden light beam, a black-haired young man wearing a white T-shirt and grey casual pants stepped out of the sky, like a deity descending into the world, creating a stunning scene.
“Flying in the air, there comes another Ninth Heaven top-level powerhouse to support us.”
“Damn, so handsome.”
“This guy knows how to make an entrance,” the onlookers exclaimed in awe and envy.
The shock was due to the prowess of the Ninth Heavens’ cultivation, the envy was because this guy knew how to show off; his entrance was even more impressive than Mathilda Ward’s.
As for the king-level figure, because Jack Clark had restrained his might, no one thought in that direction; after all, a Mythical King was a lofty big shot.
Mathilda Ward looked up and saw the black-haired young man coming with his feet on sunshine, a smile involuntarily appearing on her face. Her brother still had that ‘swagger’.
Jack Clark descended from the sky and looked at the beautiful Mathilda Ward with a smile, saying, “Sister Ilisa, congratulations on your return.”
Before his hibernation, Jack Clark had always addressed Mathilda Ward as Miss Ward, and calling her Sister Ilisa was something he could not bring himself to do, although their relationship had already been good enough to be friends.
It was only after Mathilda Ward fell into hibernation and Jack Clark opened the box to see the Mysterious Yellow Crystal Stone with the fresh seal that the barrier in his heart was broken.
In the moments before her soul’s exhaustion led her into hibernation, Mathilda Ward was still helping him analyze the construction methods of the Illusory World, and it was that very construction method that allowed him to condense the Four-fold Plane World ahead of schedule.
Even Jack Clark was somewhat moved by this affection.
Mathilda Ward, with her silver hair draped over her shoulders, smiled, “I should thank you for your help, or else I would still be forever asleep in the depths of the void.”
“It wasn’t just my effort; I only tore a crack in that restriction at the end,” Jack Clark shook his head, refusing to take credit for the feat.
Without the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s many years of preparation, and the intervention of the Sky King Denny Kaye, he wouldn’t have been able to help Mathilda Ward perform the ritual of Resurrection.
Then, Jack Clark examined Mathilda Ward up and down before effortlessly shifting the topic to admiration, “Sister Ilisa, I find this outfit of yours quite beautiful.”
“Beautiful? It was Aunt Boyce who helped me design it,” Mathilda Ward was delighted with Jack Clark’s compliment and spun around with her arms outstretched.
Mathilda Ward’s appearance was naturally beautiful and majestic, with a dignified and delicate air. Now, having awakened and transformed into a dragon-human body, her physical form had reconstituted into something even more perfect.
Her skin was translucent as jade without a pore in sight, her figure tall and full, and coupled with her flowing silver hair and the fitted silver armor skirt, she was both regal and breathtakingly gorgeous.
Now, as she twirled close by, Jack Clark even caught a faint, enchanting fragrance.
Cough cough!!
Valentine Leach coughed dryly, interrupting the two in their ‘romantic talk’: “Divine Martial Throne, Miss Ward, the spatial fluctuations in the distance are stabilizing. Should we make some preparations?”
“Indeed, let’s discuss the important matters first,” Jack Clark and Mathilda Ward both nodded with smiles, the reunion of old friends who had faced life and death making their moods very relaxed.
Finally, Jack Clark’s expression became solemn as he looked toward the distant Black Cracks, which had now torn open to a length of over 1,600 meters, while a pair of black gold vertical pupils slowly emerged from the depths of his eyes.
Suddenly, an invisible heavy oppressive force spread from him, causing even the weakest of his adjutants to sink, cracks spreading beneath his feet as a look of horror appeared on his face.
As Jack Clark gazed at the Space Cracks, someone more than ten kilometers away on the hillside zoomed in the camera lens to capture both him and Mathilda Ward, exclaiming in surprise.
“Have you noticed, that black-haired young man looks somewhat familiar.”
The low-level cultivator beside him thoughtfully said, “Are you meaning to say Darren Callum?”
The person nodded, “Yes, Darren Callum. Although there’s a slight difference in their faces, their build, demeanor, and facial contours are the same.”
“He is Darren Callum.”
“Hold on, I remember Darren Callum was only at the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage a few months ago, could it be that he’s made a breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens in just over three months?”
“What’s so impossible about that? You guys should recall, Darren Callum back then was the monster who Reverse Defeated an Eighth Layer Evil God with the Sixth Layer. Is it that exaggerated for him to breakthrough to the Nine Layers in just over three months?”
“It does seem plausible.”
Someone said excitedly, “Who would’ve thought, after over three months, Mathilda Ward and Darren Callum would appear together again. They look well-matched standing next to each other.”
“Although I don’t want to admit it, they do seem well-matched.”
At this moment, not only the new media journalists but also many viewers watching the live streams and news broadcasts felt the same way.
As for that once disliked bodyguard, after the incident of luring the Evil God Sect, while people admired Mathilda Ward, they were also amazed by Jack Clark’s exceptional abilities.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1112 - 1112 450 Divine Martials Arrival A Matching
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1112: Chapter 450 Divine Martial’s Arrival, A Matching Pair_3 Chapter 1112: Chapter 450 Divine Martial’s Arrival, A Matching Pair_3 Seeing them stand together again, he didn’t feel a hint of jealousy; instead, he thought they looked rather well-matched.
The Eyes of Void and Death possessed the ability to see through illusions and look directly at the essence of the world.
As Jack Clark’s gaze pierced through the void, delving deeper into the pathway, gradually some figures began to appear before his eyes.
They were a group of Giant Beasts with bodies over thirty meters long, resembling Violent Dragon Beasts, slowly squeezing through the World Rift.
“General Leach, order the Senior and High-level cultivators to fall back, Low-level cultivators and soldiers with ordinary heavy weapons should form a small encirclement centered around the rift.”
“Yes,” Valentine Leach paused and then nodded.
Under Valentine Leach’s command, the transport vehicles and Armored Cars that were on standby quickly mobilized, forming several echelons within three kilometers centered on the rift.
At the same time, some Rocket Launcher Vehicles with ordinary firepower from the rear base also began to adjust their angles.
Boom!
Suddenly, the rift trembled. Subsequently, a ferocious head several meters in size emerged, followed by a massive body thirty meters in length and ten meters tall.
Roar!
With a brutal roar, the Giant Beast fell from a hundred meters high, and the ground shattered, the Earth quaked, spreading a violent and brutal aura.
Under the formidable pressure of the Level 7 Colossus, Low-level cultivators and soldiers in the distance couldn’t help but take a step back, feeling nervous.
Just then, another violent Violent Dragon Beast emerged from the rift, thundering down, and soon twenty Violent Dragon Beasts, each over thirty meters long, appeared, spreading out in a fan shape.
Seated on the backs of these Violent Dragon Beasts were twenty muscular figures with ancient patterns all over their bodies, also exuding a Seventh Layer Heaven’s ferocious aura.
Looking at the distant bustling city and the soldiers a few kilometers away, who were small in stature and whose aura was as weak as ants, the aliens immediately became excited.
Wala wala!!
Gurulu wala…
The aliens let out excited shouts, but they didn’t charge forward. Instead, they spread out and confronted the soldiers around them, displaying caution.
Jack Clark said indifferently, “General Leach, have the soldiers initiate the attack.”
“Yes.”
Following Jack Clark’s order, gunfire and cannons roared, and amidst the flashing firelight, machine guns bellowed as countless large-caliber bullets rained down, engulfing those Giant Beasts and aliens.
Ula ula!! Seeing those humans daring to attack them first, the aliens roared angrily, and those special patterns on their bodies flickered.
Whirr whirr!!
Concentric circles that resembled runes—but were subtly different—of purple halos burst forth, forming a light screen several tens of meters in diameter, enveloping the aliens and Giant Beasts.
These halos interlaced, creating a protective screen a kilometer in diameter of purple light before them.
Bang bang bang!! Bullets, cannonballs, and even individual rocket rounds hit the purple light rings, causing intense impacts and firelight, but they couldn’t make it waver.
Whizz whizz whizz!!
Ten Rocket Launcher Vehicles roared in the rear, all launching twenty rockets—a total of two hundred—in one minute, which, with a piercing scream, crossed over ten kilometers and struck the light screen.
Boom boom boom!! Intense explosions and firelight engulfed the Giant Beasts and aliens, the ground shook, and the air blasted out waves of sound and pressure.
This spectacle left the reporters watching from afar utterly stunned.
But when the smoke and dust cleared, revealing those different races and Giant Beasts unharmed, the one-meter-thick purple halo was like an unshakable fortress wall.
Squeals and cackles!!
The different races within the purple halo laughed loudly, shouting incessantly, but still did not launch an offensive, instead they moved forward slowly.
Meanwhile, a member of the different races, an Early Sevenfold Sky, leaped down from the back of a Giant Beast and with a flash, returned through the pathway.
Watching that member of the different races retreat, Jack Clark’s expression remained calm without any attempt to stop them.
Compared to the Giant Beasts, the different races were actually of higher value, a value that reflected in the strength system.
Every strength system that could cultivate to the Legendary Realm represented a path, although not necessarily suitable for humans, its core elements could be referenced.
And the Federation had discovered in their research on the captured Violent Dragon Alien Tribe that the War Patterns on their bodies were very special, a strength system different from that of the Human Race and the Purgatory Demon Race.
In this case, the strategy was to play the long game for a big fish.
The member of the different races passed through the pathway and soon appeared at the edge of a bleak forest, where tens of thousands of soldiers from different races had gathered, the weakest amongst them at Fourth Layer Heaven.
In front of these different races stood a figure towering a hundred meters tall, imbued with the terrifying pressure of a Mythical-level being, so immense that even Heaven and Earth seemed to change color.
Beside this Violent Dragon King, lay a Mythical Giant Beast, over seven hundred meters long.
The member of the different races knelt respectfully: “Report to the great king, we have successfully invaded the opposite side and have been met with strong retaliation from the opposite civilization.”
The brawny Violent Dragon King tilted his head slightly, his voice booming like thunder, “What is the situation on the other side?”
“The opposite side is a very strange civilization. Those ‘people’ are only half the height of your subjects and have constructed countless tree-stump-like houses.”
“Their soldiers use some long-range shooting weapons, which are quite weak, probably only capable of injuring ordinary soldiers.”
“There are also some weapons that can detonate, slightly dangerous for senior soldiers, but useless against us elite warriors.”
“So weak,” Kavadola, the Violent Dragon King, was somewhat surprised.
The member of the different races who had carefully observed South City respectfully said, “King, although that alien civilization is weak, it seems to be quite prosperous.”
“Oh.”
“Also, the Heavenly Energy there is very weak, its concentration only a fraction of that in the Vast World. Living there long-term might affect our strength.”
Kavadola spoke gravely: “It doesn’t matter. That world can be conquered and used as our clan’s granary, rounding up all those aliens.”
Despite the abundance of resources and plentiful food in the mythical world, danger was ever-present, and even the population growth of the Violent Dragon civilization was slow.
If there was a stable granary continually producing ‘food,’ the population of their tribes would undoubtedly grow rapidly.
When the strength of their clan patterns increased, so would their own strength, and there would be hope of becoming the second War God.
Thinking of this, Kavadola couldn’t help but get excited, his huge Wolf Tooth Staff pointing towards the cracks ahead as he roared, “Kill, occupy the opposite world.”
“Kill, for the tribe.”
Boom! The Violent Dragon King led the way, riding the Mythical-level Violent Dragon Beast into the cracks, causing the massive rift to tremble wildly.
At the same time, the mighty army of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe also surged forward, ready to follow their Violent Dragon King to conquer the opposite world.
In the Blue Star World, a crack over sixteen hundred meters long trembled wildly while at the same time, a fierce and overwhelming Killing Intent spread throughout.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - 1113 451 The Halberd Explodes Traces of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1113: Chapter 451: The Halberd Explodes, Traces of the Ancient Human Race Chapter 1113: Chapter 451: The Halberd Explodes, Traces of the Ancient Human Race Tens of thousands of eyes were fixed on the scene as the black crack, stretching over a kilometer, vibrated wildly, and a ghastly dragon head with a diameter of over seventy meters slowly emerged.
Next, a massive body, three hundred meters tall at the shoulder, crashed to the ground like a small hill with a thunderous sound, instantly causing the Earth to tremble within a radius of several kilometers.
In an instant, an aura of Mythical might spread, causing everyone Below Sevenfold Heaven to tremble uncontrollably, while ordinary people went weak at the knees and knelt down.
Mythical Giant Beasts, deemed divine, supreme over billions of creatures, stirred breathlessness in countless viewers through their screens due to the disparity in genetics and bloodlines.
“This is a Mythical Creature, so terrifying. It looks even larger than the one killed in Berlin yesterday.”
“Can South City hold out this time?”
At this moment, millions of viewers huddled in dozens of Live Broadcast Rooms of the South City Television Station were shocked at the sight of the ferocious creature, and the number of viewers skyrocketed.
“Come and see, an alien army is invading South City.”
“Something’s happened, aliens are invading Blue Star.”
Soon the number of viewers for this battle surpassed ten million.
With the Federation no longer restricting Transcendent Information, its global official website was constantly updated with countless live feeds and video clips about cultivators and Unique Beasts.
As South City dealt with the Rift Crisis, only two publicly known ‘Ninth Heavens’ strong men had appeared, making many people anxious.
A Mythical Giant Beast, an ultimate lifeform that could not be killed even by conventional nuclear bombs, could only be lightly injured, posing a risk of immense casualties if it broke into South City.
Just like the Dust Serpent from fifty years ago.
While others were still in awe, Jack Clark’s gaze landed on the Mythical Giant Beast and the Violent Dragon King on its back, evaluating them minutely.
Unlike dragons from Eastern and Western cultures, this Mythical Violent Dragon Beast resembled a Tyrannosaurus, with a body covered in thick purple scales and black, sharp spikes on its back.
Astride the Violent Dragon Beast was the hundred-meter tall Kavadola, emanating an astonishingly heavy aura.
Both on the Violent Dragon King Kavadola and the Mythical Giant Beast were war patterns resembling runes, complex and mysterious, interacting with each other, making their auras seem as one.
Amplified, Kavadola’s Mid-Mythical aura was comparable to a late Mythical stage, surrounded by shimmering purple Divine Light, creating a war pattern halo that covered a range of three kilometers.
But as Jack Clark was observing those special war pattern halos, Kavadola, having just appeared, showed a look of shock in his eyes and stared in terror at the indigenous people in the distance.
“Gods!”
But no, they were not gods. Kavadola suppressed the panic inside and calmed himself down.
Though resembling ‘gods’ in form, these natives were too weak, so weak that a casual breath could annihilate a swath of them and their weapons held no danger for him.
Just a few natives in the distance had auras comparable to elite Violent Dragon Warriors. A native civilization this weak could not possibly be divine.
However, when Kavadola’s gaze landed on Jack Clark, ten kilometers away, even though that native’s aura seemed feeble, he instinctively felt his heart skip a beat.
An innate unease from being a Mythical creature surfaced, a spontaneous feeling.
That native was strong.
Kavadola’s eyes narrowed, and he let out a thunderous growl: “Be careful, something’s not right. All ‘Person’ gather around this king, activate war patterns.”
“Yes.”
The twenty Seventh Layer strength Violent Dragon aliens who had arrived earlier, as well as the tens of thousands of aliens that had surged from the rear, spread out to both sides, forming a formation encircling Kavadola.
Humming!!
The war patterns on those alien warriors lit up one by one, forming a purple halo that spread out, merging with the surrounding patterns.
Boom! The aura of the high-order alien warriors and the ordinary Violent Dragon People surged, with various enhancing halos appearing on them, strengthening their strength, solidity of Defense, sharpness of weapons, and so on.
While these halos provided benefits to the ordinary warriors, Kavadola’s presence doubled in intensity, with his surrounding Law Divine Domain expanding massively.
Boom Boom Boom!!
As the purple Divine Realm extended, the Earth cracked, forming rifts that spread in all directions, overturning Armored Cars, and scaring the low-level cultivator soldiers into retreating continuously.
Watching the purple Divine Light expand to a five-kilometer radius in the blink of an eye, Ilisa was somewhat excited: “Brother Callum, the power system of this alien civilization is quite special.”
At this moment, unless one was a fool, it was obvious that the war patterns of the Violent Dragon civilization were strong, capable of forming an army formation like that of The Purgatory Family, consolidating the strength of all soldiers.
Unlike The Purgatory Family’s army formation which could only unleash various powerful attacks, the war patterns of the Violent Dragon alien tribe also had various enhancement halos.
Beyond that, these could also merge with the Law Domains of Mythical Powerhouses to extend and strengthen the Divine Realm, similar to a portable Divine Realm.
If these war patterns could be combined with unmanned mech technology and controlled by a Supercomputer to form an army, with a king-level center creating an army formation, the overall strength of the Human Race could climb another level.
Surrounded by a hundred thousand Senior Mechas, with a Law Divine Domain covering tens of kilometers, the converged Power of Heaven and Earth would be enough to elevate an early Myth king to the late Myth period.
Not to mention the unmanned Mechas that would be stronger in strength, Defense, speed, attack, and energy Burst after receiving the same boosts.
Additionally, within the range of the Law Divine Domain, it could shield against interference from Violent Magnetic Fields on electronic signals, allowing the Supercomputer to control unmanned Mechas with even more precise soul manipulation.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1114: Chapter 451: Explosive Halberd, Traces of the Ancient Human Race_2 Chapter 1114: Chapter 451: Explosive Halberd, Traces of the Ancient Human Race_2 “`
When the time comes, the thought of a king-level being surrounded by a hundred thousand unmanned Mechs and fighter aircraft joining the battle is frightening, especially since these unmanned Mechs can also carry suicide mini nuclear bombs.
Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath at the thought, then said in a deep voice, “Leave the Mythical Giant Beast and the Violent Dragon King to me, Sister Ilisa, you intercept the residual battle waves.”
“No problem.”
Mathilda Ward’s body erupted with brilliant silver radiance, turning hundreds of meters around her into a world of flickering silver light, her powerful energy Burst forming a ring of circular shockwaves that exploded outward.
As a Ninth Heaven Peak power, who had touched upon the realm of rules, Mathilda Ward was very strong, but Jack Clark was stronger.
He took one step and instantly appeared like teleportation above the Firmament kilometers away, followed by the Burst of a repressed terrifying Power from within him.
Boom!
In an instant, Heaven and Earth shook, and dazzling golden flames erupted from Jack Clark as the center, burning, turning half of the sky into a sea of fire, radiating endless light and heat.
Under the illumination of the firelight, the temperature within tens of kilometers rapidly rose, became scorching hot and dry, the ground cracked, vegetation withered, and even wisps of flames began to jump.
Such terrifying might shocked everyone, and at the same time, these people never imagined Darren Callum (Jack Clark) was not a Ninth Heaven Expert but a king-level being.
Suddenly, in the Alien Corps of the Violent Dragon Tribe, the elite soldier who had gone back to report shouted, “Despicable natives, you’ve actually hidden your strength to deceive us.”
Wah-la-wah-la!! Thousands of aliens from the Violent Dragon Tribe roared out in anger, feeling deeply tricked by these cunning natives and nearly fell into their trap.
Kavadola’s pupils also shrank, as expected there were issues; that native who instinctively made it uneasy actually mastered Higher-order Law, but fortunately the opponent was only of Early Myth era.
But clearly, it could not linger here; these natives were too similar to ‘Gods’.
Just as Kavadola was contemplating retreat, the Mythical Violent Dragon Beast that shared a mental link with it, let out a ferocious roar, and dazzling purple Light gathered in its mouth.
Boom!
A massive purple Light Beam, tens of meters thick, burst forth, annihilating all matter in its path and creating rings of purple halos that pierced through Heaven and Earth.
The powerful Aura of energy plunged into the sea of golden fire and collided fiercely with the Great Sun Heaven Flame, exploding with a resounding rumble and dazzling light before Jack Clark.
Watching the purple Light Beam, now weakened several-fold by the Heavenly Flame Law domain, Jack Clark looked indifferent and extended his right hand.
Boom! A blinding golden-purple radiance Burst in the Firmament, the terrifying energy impact shaking Heaven and Earth, raising a scorching hurricane that swept across several kilometers.
In front of the purple Beam an invisible Boundary Wall appeared, radiating rings of diamond-shaped golden halos, stopping the Breath that could destroy a ten-thousand-meter mountain peak just ten meters away from Jack Clark.
This scene was captured by the drones in the distance and the camera lens of Television Station below, instantly leaving millions of viewers with their mouths agape, in disbelief.
After just a brief standoff, Jack Clark suddenly moved.
Boom! Jack Clark transformed into a golden light, descending from the sky through the roaring energy explosion, appearing in an instant before the War Pattern Divine Realm.
Bang! The War Halberd, wrapped in golden flames, pierced through the Void, gathering endless golden flames on it, forming a Star thousands of kilometers in diameter.
The moment the Golden Sun descended upon the War Pattern Divine Realm, the world dimmed, leaving only the shining golden light spanning Heaven and Earth, forming a giant mushroom cloud rising slowly.
Suddenly a stern shout echoed through Heaven and Earth.
“Be careful, don’t look.”
“Everyone close your eyes.”
Boom!
Only then did a earth-shattering explosion roar open, making everyone feel their brains trembling, the world rocking, the cosmos turning upside down.
Under the terrifying strike, the War Pattern Divine Realm spanning five kilometers crumbled, the Earth exploded, the terrifying shockwave transforming into a twenty-plus level hurricane sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
Wah-la-wah-la!!
Thousands of the Violent Dragon Tribe cried out in horror, swept off like countless ants by the blasting impact, together with numerous pieces of dirt and rock pattering down in all directions.
“Kill!”
In the midst of raging winds, Kavadola roared savagely, with the two-hundred-meter-long Wolf Tooth Staff in its hand, thirteen rings of purple War Patterns revolving around it, smashing forward.
Under the terrifying strength, the space of Blue Star shattered, creating a sea of Black Cracks covering a kilometer, where a War Halberd entwined with golden flames thrust forward.
Boom! Under the Unrivaled Domination of the Golden War Halberd, the thirteen War Patterns dissipated, the Wolf Tooth Staff shattered, followed by half of Kavadola’s True Body.
Roar! As Kavadola’s True Body was blasted away by a strike, the Violent Dragon Beast beneath it let out a vicious roar, its huge maw gaping open to bite at Jack Clark appearing above.
Between the huge sharp teeth, Black Cracks kept appearing, shattered, exuding terrifying Destructive Auras.
Bang!
The moment the Violent Dragon Beast looked up, heavy footsteps in battle boots landed on its head, and instantly the beast let out a wail, its massive body crashing onto the Earth.
With a single step, thick scales that even ordinary nuclear bombs couldn’t shatter broke apart, flesh and blood within tens of meters exploded, followed by cracks forming on the extremely hard purple-golden skull of the Mythical Giant Beast.
With just a casual halberd strike and a random kick, Kavadola who temporarily possessed late period Myth strength, had its True Body burst, and the Violent Dragon Beast beneath was critically injured and hammered to death.
Just as the Power under Jack Clark’s foot was about to Burst and he prepared to crush the Violent Dragon Beast’s skull, erasing it with a single stomp, Kavadola suddenly shouted.
“We surrender, Upper God, we surrender.” Immediately, Jack Clark paused his foot.
“`

﻿Chapter 1115: Chapter 451: Explosive Halberd, Traces of the Ancient Human Race_3 Chapter 1115: Chapter 451: Explosive Halberd, Traces of the Ancient Human Race_3 “`
What made him stop was not Kavadola’s pleas for mercy, but the fact that this fellow was actually using the somewhat rusty language of the Ancient Human Race to surrender.
In an instant, all became quiet between heaven and earth.
Golden flames burned, contracting the high temperature, merely forming Law Domains that covered a ten-kilometer range, suppressing all the different races and Kavadola who had been blown away.
Within the sea of golden flames, Jack stood on the head of the Violent Dragon Beast, whose scales and flesh and blood had burst apart to reveal its skull, his gaze indifferently looking down at Kavadola, who was left with only half his True Body, his will vibrating the Void.
“You actually know the language of the Ancient Human Race.”
Kavadola looked at Jack with a bit of fear and reverence, and said, “Great Upper God, please forgive my disrespect, I am willing to lead the Karola Tribe to surrender to the great Upper God.”
The terrifying power that Jack exhibited in that moment directly shattered Kavadola’s courage, bringing back memories of ancient terror and reverence.
However, at this time, what Kavadola spoke was no longer the language of the Ancient Human Race, but the guttural language of the Violent Dragon civilization, which Jack could understand only because it vibrated with the power of intent.
Feeling the genuine reverence and fear from Kavadola’s heart, Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Every strong man who cultivated to the realm of Myth was as resolute as iron, and even when facing a strong enemy they might not be defeated by, they would at most hold great reverence for that formidable strength, but would not fear it.
Jack said indifferently, “You haven’t answered my question yet, why do you speak the language of the Ancient Human Race?”
After the end of the Ruins Continent, Jack had specially looked up information about the Ancient Civilization, which is why he had some understanding of the ancient language.
Kavadola hurriedly replied with respect, “That, that language was taught to us by the Upper God, but I only know a few phrases.”
Upper God. Jack’s gaze flickered, and he said sternly, “Where is that Upper God?”
Kavadola shook his head, “I don’t know, the Upper God has been missing for over a thousand years, saying he was going to find the coordinates of some homecoming when he left.”
“Homecoming!” Upon saying this, Kavadola’s eyes moved, and his eyes gradually revealed a look of shock.
The forms of these indigenous people were so similar to that Upper God’s… Could this place actually be the homecoming the Upper God was seeking? No wonder this human was so terrifying, possessing such a frightening combat power at the early Myth realm.
While Kavadola was inwardly shaken, an incredible thought emerged in Jack’s mind.
Could it be that the Seven Great Emperors of the Ancient Human Race civilization, who have been missing for who knows how many tens of thousands of years, are still around?
Hu! Jack breathed out a breath, his voice grave, “Tell me everything you know about that Upper God. If the information is valuable enough, I might consider sparing your life.”
“Yes, yes…”
Kavadola nodded in a hurry, “The Upper God looked very similar to you, only much more powerful, at that time…”
In the following question-and-answer with Kavadola, Jack gradually learned more about the Violent Dragon civilization and that Upper God.
Over a thousand years ago, which was estimated to be over four thousand years ago according to the flow of time in the mythical world, when they were still weak, they encountered a powerful and terrifying being.
However, that being was heavily injured at the time and, while recuperating, subdued their small tribe and selected eight robust individuals from the Violent Dragon People as servants.
Later on, while the strong being was recovering from his injuries, he casually imparted them with a mighty strength known as War Pattern Power.
However, that being merely used them as a temporary resting place. After cultivating for a hundred years and somewhat recovering from his injuries, he disappeared, continuing his search for the coordinates of his homecoming.
With the aid of War Pattern Power, Kavadola and the other seven ‘Persons’ cultivated all the way and eventually made a breakthrough to Myth, establishing a powerful tribe that dominated their own Territory.
Among them, an individual named Cavadros was the strongest, revered as the Violent Dragon War God, with a tribe under him numbering a million and occupying the vastest and most resource-rich lands.
As for the territories of the other seven Violent Dragon Kings, they occupied ‘a small piece’ of land, surrounded by forbidden areas where even mythical powerhouses would fall.
Because the environment was too harsh and resources scarce, only enough to sustain a few hundred thousand tribe members.
For this reason, they chose to invade upon discovering that on the other side of the Rift Channel was a backward world with a very low concentration of Heavenly Energy.
By the time Kavadola finished speaking, Jack said with an icy tone, “So basically, you know nothing about that ‘Upper God.'”
“And since you realized our forms are quite similar to that Upper God’s, you still dared to invade this world, which clearly shows you don’t hold as much reverence for that Upper God as one might think.”
Feeling the chill emanating from Jack’s presence, Kavadola hurriedly shook his head and explained, “Great one, I didn’t know this was the Upper God’s homecoming site at first; otherwise, I would never dare invade.”
“Is that so?”
Jack remained noncommittal.
However, because these different races might have some relation to the Ancient Human Race civilization, Jack temporarily lost the urge to kill. Besides, he had been planning to capture some alive to study their War Pattern Power.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1116 - 1116 452 The Ancient Creature that Came
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1116: Chapter 452: The Ancient Creature that Came Pursuing, Destroying the Dragon Palace Chapter 1116: Chapter 452: The Ancient Creature that Came Pursuing, Destroying the Dragon Palace The sudden halt of the battle caught many off guard.
Witnessing the Violent Dragon King, whose half-materialized true body continued to heal after shattering, the Mythical Giant Beast with mutilated flesh and blood on its head, and the tens of thousands of different races being suppressed by the golden sea of fire, Valentine Leach’s face revealed astonishment.
“Worthy of being the Divine Martial Throne that overpowers the Evil God Alliance upon a king-level breakthrough, truly formidable.”
Mathilda Ward was also somewhat shocked and nodded, “Who would have thought that after Brother Callum’s breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, he would still retain his absolute domination over peers.”
At this moment, not only Mathilda Ward and Valentine Leach, but also the soldiers, the cultivators spectating from over ten kilometers away, and the millions of people in front of TVs and computer screens, were all immensely shocked.
They had all originally thought that this battle on the side of South would erupt into a fierce war, with the Federation ultimately relying on its powerful strength to exterminate and suppress the invading different races.
Yet, no one expected that the battle would come to an instantaneous end right as it erupted, with the tens of thousands of Senior Unique Beasts, Mythical Powerhouses, and Mythical Giant Beasts being suppressed by Jack Clark in the palm of his hand.
So powerful.
Looking at Kavadola, whose true form had been restored yet still carried a look of respect, Jack Clark said indifferently, “A mere surrender is not enough to earn my trust, unless you open your Divine Soul for me to impose restrictions.”
“Of course, you could choose to refuse, but daring to invade Blue Star, I will execute all of you right here.”
Immediately, Kavadola’s complexion shifted subtly.
Once a restriction is imposed on the Divine Soul, it would mean being forever controlled. If it dares to rebel, Jack Clark only needs to activate the restriction’s power to heavily injure or even destroy Kavadola’s Divine Soul.
But to refuse… seemed to make no difference.
In the presence of this early Myth Upper God Clan Member, it vaguely sensed an Aura of Mounts of Corpses and Seas of Blood, clearly indicating that should it dare refuse, Clark would instantly slaughter it and its subordinates.
After only a brief struggle, Kavadola spoke with a hoarse voice, “I… am willing.”
The corners of Jack Clark’s mouth lifted slightly.
Under normal conditions, it’s difficult to subdue a Mythical powerhouse. As God-level beings, their pride does not permit them to submit to others, let alone imprint restrictions within their Divine Souls.
Even within The Purgatory Family with its strict hierarchy, Imperial Demon Gods and demon kings are merely direct superiors and subordinates, akin to positions, not servants or underlings.
As for why Jack Clark was certain that Kavadola would choose to submit, it was because this creature feared death very much and lacked the resolute will typical of Mythical Powerhouses.
The reason was that it had acquired its strength too easily.
Initially, in order to heal conveniently, the strong man who subjugated them had immediately promoted their cultivation to the Ninth Heavens by imbuing it directly, and imprinted the modified War Patterns into their Sea of Consciousness.
After more than a thousand years (over four thousand years in Blue Star terms), they barely cultivated from the Ninth Heavens to the Legendary Realm, indicative of their poor aptitude.
The longer such being live, the more they fear death.
As Kavadola opened its Divine Soul, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils emerged in Jack Clark’s eyes.
In the dark void of the soul space, entwined with Death Law and an imprint made from a wisp of Divine Soul power transformed into a Black Gold eye, Kavadola’s true soul shook instantaneously.
To think it mastered two Higher-order Laws.
Boom! As the imprint descended amidst Kavadola’s horror, a dark gold eye mark appeared on the back of its Divine Soul, bearing down like a heavy mountain, causing its soul to suddenly sink.
“I pledge allegiance, great one,” Kavadola bowed respectfully.
Having subdued a Mythical Powerhouse, the next step was to manage these different races. Jack Clark first ordered them to set up camp, then he notified the other king-level beings.
Instantly, the news of an Ancient Human Race civilization—potentially still existing, including Seven Great Emperors—exploded among the Federation’s upper echelons.
And while Jack Clark was dealing with the invasion incident, ordering Kavadola and its subordinates to cooperate in studying the War Pattern power system, an anomaly occurred underseas.
Surrounding the crack that spewed dark red mist-like energy, tens of thousands of ordinary Mutated Fish were frantically slaughtering each other, their spilled blood almost dyeing the surrounding sea water red.
About an hour later, tens of thousands of Mutated Creatures had vanished, leaving behind thirteen Level 6 Unique Beasts, each over twenty meters long.
These beasts, covered in dark red scale armor and full of bone spurs, showed dark red eyes radiating madness and fury.
Roar! In the bloody water, those thirteen Unique Beasts let out chaotic roars, swirling the sea water as they swam to the edge of the Black Cracks, absorbing the dark red energy emanating from the other side.
Huff huff! As they absorbed the thick dark red energy continuously, these Mutated Beasts grew increasingly powerful, wildly digesting the flesh and blood they had just devoured.
Crackle crackle! The beasts visibly grew at a speed visible to the naked eye, their forms becoming increasingly fierce.
Soon, the size of these Unique Beasts reached the thirty-meter limit of Level 6, and as they absorbed more and more dark red energy, their consciousness became increasingly maniacal and violent.
Roar! Suddenly, one of the Unique Beasts that resembled a Bay Crocodile roared and pounced on another Shark Mutated Beast, sparking yet another frenzied battle and devouring.
Under the ferocity of the battle, the sea water exploded, and the tumultuous collisions of the enormous creatures resonated through the deep sea.
By the time a beast more than forty meters long appeared half an hour later, resembling a Black Tiger Whale in the front, replete with scale armor and bone spurs, and with eight tentacles at the back half of its body.
At the same time, the dark red energy of this Mutant Beast was furiously condensed, gathered and gradually a terrifying will revived. A mad, chaotic roar erupted from the seabed.
“Heaven, consume.”
Boom! The sea water exploded as the monstrous Giant Beast surged towards the sea surface with incredible speed.
Roar roar roar! This is the Core Range of the Dragon Palace, foreign Unique Beasts must leave immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117 - 1117 452 The Ancient Creature that Came
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1117: Chapter 452: The Ancient Creature that Came Pursuing, Destroying the Dragon Palace_2 Chapter 1117: Chapter 452: The Ancient Creature that Came Pursuing, Destroying the Dragon Palace_2 On the tumultuous sea surface, a squad of thirty Mutated Tiger Whales, ranging from Level 4 to Level 5 and Level 6, roamed, sending out warnings to a distant Bone Spur Giant Beast.
Although the Bone Spur Unique Beast had a terrifying aura, they were the Dragon Palace’s Tiger Whale patrolling soldiers, and they were not afraid at all.
However, no sooner had the thirty-meter-long Mutated Tiger Whale issued its warning than the Bone Spur Giant Beast’s dark red eyes displayed madness and brutality, roaring with a low growl.
“Kill, eat.”
Boom! Its tentacles, covered with sharp bone spurs, swelled wildly, transforming into hundred-meter-long giant claws that instantly wrapped around and shredded eight Mutated Tiger Whales.
Bang Bang Bang!!
The sea exploded, and before the thirty Mutated Tiger Whales could react, they were shredded, their broken corpses floating on the sea surface.
Suddenly, the thick blood dyed the sea red, emitting a shocking stench.
After killing the Mutated Tiger Whales, the Bone Spur Giant Beast devoured them one by one, growing larger as its body crackled, and the blood-colored light around it grew more ferocious.
At the same time, after absorbing the blood and flesh of the Tiger Whales, the Bone Spur Giant Beast gained some information from the flesh and blood, its eyes filled with madness and brutality, looking towards the direction of the Dragon Palace.
“Dragon, Palace, Heaven, eat.”
Boom! The sea exploded, and the Bone Spur Giant Beast rapidly disappeared from the sea surface.
……
Below the deep sea, the sea surface of the Water and Fire Dragon Palace erupted as one Mutated Tiger Whale after another swam in panic, their eyes revealing fear and emitting mournful cries.
“Great General, it’s bad; a monster is crazily hunting us.”
“Mournful cries! So many, so many of our family have been eaten.”
A sixty-meter-long Mutated Tiger Whale with red flames burning on its body looked a bit solemn and let out a mournful cry: Don’t panic, tell me one by one.
Tiger Two also cried out mournfully, “Stay calm, we are from the Dragon Palace that rules the ocean, no matter who it is, if they dare kill our ‘people,’ they must pay the price.”
With the reassurance of Tiger One and Tiger Two, the hundreds of Mutated Tiger Whales on the sea surface calmed down a bit, but panic still remained in their eyes.
This was the first time they had felt so embarrassed since joining the Dragon Palace. The Tiger Whales were powerful creatures in the sea, and after mutation, they were very strong and fought as a group.
However, after joining the Dragon Palace, the grand Mutated Tiger Whale Army swept through the ocean majestically, and even Eighth Level Beasts dared not come close wherever they went.
Who would have expected that today, a ferocious Giant Beast would appear, massacring them crazily? Those terrifying tentacles would twist and shred a family member in a flash—it was too horrifying.
At this moment, in the Water and Fire World, there were not only those Mutated Tiger Whales, but also more than twenty Level 7 and Level 8 Giant Beasts, like Sea Turtles, that had surrendered along with Tiger Three.
As these Giant Beasts were astonished that an animal dared to attack the soldiers of the Dragon Palace, a ferocious growl suddenly came from the entrance to the small world, mixed with indistinct roars.
“Dragon, Palace, eat.”
Mournful cries! Be careful.
Instantly all the Giant Beasts were alarmed and prepared for battle, looking down into the water. There, having devoured hundreds of Mutated Tiger Whales and growing to more than seventy meters, the Bone Spur Giant Beast appeared.
At this moment, this Giant Beast looked even more gruesome, surrounded by a thick blood-colored light, but most important was the terrifying aura that radiated from the Beast’s body.
It was a will beyond that of Mythical Giant Beasts, and under this terrifying invisible presence, all the Mutant Beasts went limp, instinctively feeling fear, despair, and utterly devoid of any will to resist.
Woo!
Just then, Tiger One and Tiger Two let out a whistle-like cry, their red flames bursting forth to forcibly break free from the oppressive will of that terrifying aura.
Tiger One and Tiger Two were different from the other Unique Beasts; because they had been through the challenging ordeals of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s breakthroughs, their wills were much stronger.
But…
Half an hour later, the sea water of the Water and Fire World was stained red with blood, leaving behind only a terrifying creature measuring a hundred and twenty meters in length and exuding the peak aura of Level 8.
The Bone Spur Giant Beast chewed the corpse of a Tiger Whale with red stripes, fresh blood mixed with chunks of meat dribbling from the corner of its mouth, as its tentacles writhed and crawled upon the shore below.
Bang, bang, bang! Under the sweeping tentacles that swelled to over two hundred meters, the Ice Crystal Palace continued to collapse, quickly turning it into a pile of ruins.
Surrounded by blood-colored fog, the Bone Spur Giant Beast stood amidst the ruins, its eyes a dark red, filled with madness and obsession, emitting a vague roar.
“Heaven, no, not here.”
Crackle Crackle!!
As it digested the energy from the flesh and blood, the Bone Spur Giant Beast grew another segment in size, appearing even more massive, yet its aura seemed unstable, as if it might collapse at any moment.
At the same time, from the flesh and blood it was devouring, the Bone Spur Unique Beast glimpsed some useful information.
“Vast, Endless, World, Chaotic, Turbulent, Sea.”
Soon the Bone Spur Giant Beast swam out of the Water and Fire Mini World, emanating an extremely fierce, terrifying aura as it headed toward Channel One.
Every fish within kilometers frantically fled as if a monster capable of destroying the world was chasing them.
In the mythical world, the moon hung high, casting its silver light and bringing some brightness to Earth.
Perched atop the hillside, a blue vortex standing over six hundred meters tall suddenly shook, and then a hundred and thirty-meter-long Giant Beast with barely a breakthrough to Level 9 appeared.
The Giant Beast floated in the air, with a body like a Tiger Whale covered in dark red scale armor, sprouting sharp bone spurs, while its lower half was like that of an octopus with eight tentacles, making it look extremely odd.
After passing through the pathway, the Bone Spur Giant Beast, with eyes full of wild brutality, looked toward the distant forest.
Before long, from deep within a forest over a thousand kilometers away, a thick scent of blood wafted forth as a tribe of the Kaleb Clan was devoured, leaving only ruins with the Bone Spur Unique Beast floating above.
Having devoured the flesh of the Kaleb Clan and absorbed memories contained within the flesh and blood, the Bone Spur Giant Beast slowly turned its head towards a remote direction: “Chaotic, Turbulent, Realm.”
“Roar! Seeking death, you dare to invade the territory of the great Lady Adriana.”
Amid the roar, a massive claw descended from the sky and with a thunderous strike demolished the Bone Spur Giant Beast along with the Earth below, forming a claw imprint several hundred meters in diameter.
High above the Firmament, the thousand-meter-long Black Colossus coiled itself, its gaze icy as it peered down at the pile of flesh and blood blown apart by a single claw strike.
At the moment the Bone Spur Giant Beast was obliterated, far away, an ancient creature that had been guarding Channel 3 suddenly shook violently.
The ancient creature, stretching for tens of kilometers like a mountain range, slowly turned its head, its severed will focusing on the location of the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s Territory.
“Found, at, last, Heaven.”
Not far ahead of the mountainous creature, a several hundred-meter-long crack appeared, with dark red energy still swirling around its edges.
Boom!
The ancient creature slowly rose, its colossal body creating an upheaval akin to mountains and seas roaring, fog tumbling, and even the space of this World shaking as it stood up.
Bang! The intense spatial shockwave caused the crack leading to the Blue Star World to collapse in an instant.
This ancient creature, awakened by the aura of a Pseudo-Heaven Tier life form and fixation on devouring the Destruction Emperor Dragon, had been enduring hibernation and guarding the channel.
And stimulated by the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its will partly awoke, finding traces of the Destruction Emperor Dragon through the crack that had just appeared.
For these beings, who slumber for tens of thousands of years, the time of two or three Sun Wheels is like a single breath, without any real concept of time.
Boom!
With every step of the mountain range creature, land within dozens of kilometers would crumble and collapse, and the explosive ring created by the blast obliterated everything nearby.
With strides of ten kilometers each, this seemingly slow-moving horrific creature quickly disappeared from sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1118 - 1118 453 Flame Tiger Whale Chen Hu My
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1118: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Chen Hu: My Invincible Brother (7K) Chapter 1118: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Chen Hu: My Invincible Brother (7K) The territory of the Blue-White Giant Dragon to the north is the Misty Area, which is also the domain occupied by the ancient creature that once pursued the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Passing through the former territory of the Black Oblivion King, lies the entrance to Channel 3.
Therefore, for this ancient creature to reach the Chaotic Turbulent Region, it must traverse the original Misty Area, the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s Territory, and the land of Telsafi, the mother of the golden blue dragon.
The estimated direct distance is about nearly 500,000 kilometers, interspersed with various dangerous areas and forbidden zones, requiring some time to traverse.
The Blue Star World.
At the seabed of the destroyed Water and Fire Dragon Palace, a small dirt hill suddenly moved.
Gurgle gurgle!! The lifeless hill emitted large bubbles, its surface dirt and sand falling off to reveal the head of the Sea Turtle Giant Beast.
There was still a look of panic in its eyes.
The Sea Turtle Giant Beast was in a miserable state, with only half of its more than 50-meter colossal body remaining; its turtle shell was damaged, revealing the grey-brown, dirt-like flesh and blood beneath.
Facing that terrifying Bone Spur Giant Beast, just one strike from its tentacle smashed half of its body to pieces.
Had it not been for its talent ability to fuse with the Earth Element and feign death as a stony dead object, it wouldn’t have escaped today and would have been eaten by that dreadful beast.
Bang! The front double claws of the Sea Turtle Giant Beast exerted a little force, making the seabed tremble. Its broken body stirred up rolling waves as it shot towards the sea surface, reaching it in the blink of an eye.
Boom! The sea water exploded, and the enormous head of the Sea Turtle, as large as a room, burst from the sea, with water running off its scales and creating a spray of droplets.
The mouth of the Sea Turtle Giant Beast opened slightly, revealing two red flames, each about a meter in diameter, and a faint growl could be heard through its breath.
Woo-woo!! Great General, Second General, that terrifying guy has left.
A slightly larger flame within one emitted a weak mental fluctuation, “That despicable fiend dared to attack the Dragon Palace—we must find Uncle and take revenge.”
The slightly smaller flame jittered, its mental fluctuation a bit puzzled, “Big head, why not seek help from Dad?”
The larger flame burned and leapt, “Dad is too dumb and not very powerful, what if he is not a match for that terrifying guy?”
Tiger Two’s flame flickered, “Right, Uncle is more formidable. Every time Dad got beaten, it was Uncle who avenged him.”
“Big head, first take us to the magma to absorb some flame energy. Once our condition stabilizes, we will go to the mythical world to find Uncle and Mom and the others.”
As creatures that live in the sea, under normal conditions, the talents awakened are either related to water or aligned with the creatures’ natural instincts, like the poison of a sea python or the deep sea vortex of a whale.
However, due to the Bloodline Crystal they obtained initially, Tiger One and Tiger Two underwent a change in physique, awakening a fire talent, making them weaker than Tiger Three.
Unlike the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as aquatic dwellers that awakened the fire talent they couldn’t break their limits time and again, ignoring environmental suppression.
So, not everything good could be ingested recklessly—there could be repercussions.
However, the Tiger Whales were fortunate. Following the lead of the bloodline talent of the former Destruction Emperor Dragon, which became a Monarch-Level Life, their flame abilities evolved twice, reaching Senior level and acquiring the Flame Transformation Ability.
Therefore, when their bodies were smashed by the Bone Spur Giant Beast, they unleashed all their Flame Power in a fiery fury, and their souls and Spiritual Will temporarily fused into the flames for preservation.
Yet, they were not Ninth Heaven Cultivators, and in their current flame state, they needed a massive amount of flame energy to maintain themselves.
Besides, there was another problem—without a body to inhabit, they might forever exist only as flames.
With just a slight negligence, they could be extinguished by water.
But for the two Tiger Whales, being alive was lucky enough; there was no time to consider much else. Any issues would be dealt with after reaching the mythical world and finding their parents.
Upon the orders of the Tiger Whales, the severely injured Sea Turtle Giant Beast struggled to climb ashore and slowly made its way to the edge of the Magma Fire Sea behind the Dragon Palace, moving its double claws with effort.
The dark red magma churned, radiating intense firelight. The Sea Turtle Giant Beast exhaled slightly, sending the two flames into the magma with a gust.
Boom! Instantly, the two flames flared intensely, attracting immense energy frantically from their surroundings.
Seeing this, the Sea Turtle Giant Beast heaved a sigh of relief, lying on the ground wearily, concentrating its Spiritual Will to draw energy floating between heaven and earth to heal its injuries.
With a Level 7 Colossus body that had elemental properties and vigorous vitality, as long as vital areas like the head and heart remained intact, even severe injuries could heal.
However, this Sea Turtle was relentless, dragging its half-shredded body for several kilometers before depositing the flames of Tiger One and Tiger Two into the magma, and only then did it begin to slowly recover from its wounds.
In the absence of ‘Person’ disturbances, the injury of the Sea Turtle Giant Beast regenerated, and the Tiger Whales burned even brighter as they absorbed a massive amount of flame energy.
Suddenly, the larger flame vibrated slightly, transmitting Tiger One’s mental fluctuation: “Little brother, do you feel that? Seems like there’s something in the depths of the magma?”
Ying ying!! I feel it too.
To the Tiger Whales that had transformed into flames, the entire world was composed of red magma, white air, and blue sea water.
At that moment, in the fiery depths of the Magma Lake, some even hotter golden radiance was circulating, exuding a subtle attraction.
Tiger Two’s flame leapt, “Big head, should we go check it out?”
Tiger One was somewhat tempted, “That’s where Uncle usually enters Hibernation for his breakthroughs; he might have left something good behind. Let’s go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1119 - 1119 453 Flame Tiger Whale Glenn Clark My
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1119: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Glenn Clark: My Invincible Brother (7K)_2 Chapter 1119: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Glenn Clark: My Invincible Brother (7K)_2 “`
The two flames paused slightly, then turned into invisible flames and rushed into the magma, quickly reaching the original position of the volcano before diving down.
In the past, with their strength, they couldn’t possibly dive thousands of meters under the magma, but now, as invisible flames, it was much easier.
Hu hu!!
In the depths of the volcano mouth, filled with intense pressure, two blazing flames appeared and immediately pounced on the even hotter light they sensed.
Boom!!
Just as Tiger One and Tiger Two absorbed a strand of intense golden aura, the flames they had become suddenly surged and burned even more fiercely.
The two burning flames emitted excited fluctuations, “Tiger Two, Tiger Two, these golden energies really are the good stuff left by Uncle, I can feel Uncle’s aura.”
Eat, eat more, I feel like we’re getting bigger.
The two flames leaped and madly dove toward the remaining golden light; with every strand of light they devoured and absorbed, they burned more vigorously and emitted strong energy fluctuations.
This light was the invisible life aura emitted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon during its hibernation and pseudo-Heavenly Tier transformation before, combined with the burning golden flames on its body to create a special energy.
This energy, under the intense pressure deep in the magma, gathered and absorbed magma energy to fuse, forming strands of special energy imbued with the charm of laws.
This was a unique resource created by external forces. As the two Tiger Whales absorbed and merged, their shapes gradually changed and began to converge into the likeness of Tiger Whales.
Deep underground, as the two flames absorbed dozens of strands of golden light, they had transformed into two Flame Tiger Whales each over twenty meters long.
Boom! Just as the two flames completely took on the form of Tiger Whales, an energy fluctuation equivalent to the sixth level erupted, along with a unique aura of life.
Woo!
Tiger One’s wings, resembling both fins and wings of flame, unfolded, emitting an excited whistle of a steam engine: “Tiger Two, it seems like we’ve got bodies again.”
The excited, flame-covered Tiger Two also nodded, “Roar, roar, roar!! Boss, we’ve resurrected, and our current form feels so powerful.”
However, after this ‘death’ experience, and having lost the constraints of a physical body, Tiger One and Tiger Two’s intelligence had increased somewhat and had become more mature.
Thus, after the excitement, they started frantically absorbing the fiery energy around them, and soon their aura grew stronger and their bodies gradually gained some substantiality.
While the two Tiger Whales were reborn as elemental Flame Tiger Whales with the help of the life aura left by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc was in hibernation.
In the Rift World, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, Single-horned Spawn Roc, and the gold and blue Giant Dragon each occupied a mountain peak and slept.
At that moment, the gold and blue Giant Dragon had grown to five hundred meters long, and around it, flames, ice crystals, broken stones, and raging winds covered several kilometers, creating an impressive and colorful display.
Unlike the Silver Giant Dragon that mastered space and ice crystal destruction’s Higher-order Laws, the gold and blue Giant Dragon’s top tier talent was elemental conversion and crystal control.
Elemental conversion allowed it to freely condense all kinds of elemental power; combined with the crystal’s solidification and compression, it could create crystal bombs with tens of times the power.
Besides, the area where the Single-horned Spawn Roc resided was shrouded in darkness; a white orb in the center of the dark slowly expanded and contracted as if it was nurturing some terrifying Giant Beast.
Out of the three Giant Beasts, the Candle Dragon’s anomaly was the most astonishing one. With its four-hundred-meter body coiled on the mountain peak, around it, within a ten-kilometer range, the seasons changed, the sun and moon moved, and time itself seemed to surround it.
Once the three Giant Beasts breakthrough, even the weakest Single-horned Spawn Roc would master a Higher-order Law and possess formidable combat power.
Furthermore, with the Silver Giant Dragon and Kamaitachi Beast, and the soon to break through to Titan Level, Destruction Emperor Dragon, at that time, the Dragon Palace could truly be called an overlord.
While the four Giant Beasts were in hibernation for breakthroughs, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Kamaitachi Beast deterred the surrounding sea area, expelling or killing many ferocious giant beasts.
Meanwhile, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, Female Tiger Whale, and Blue Giant Crab were hunting, slaying peak-level Unique Beasts and collecting Life Crystals.
Roar, roar, roar!! Leader, aren’t we going to help collect crystals?
Under the sea where raging winds stirred hundred-meter tsunamis, a voice questioned while looking ahead, at the Female Little Tiger Whale that had reached Level 7 after gaining the second-best resource from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Magma Core.
There, the Black Tiger Whale, which had reached the mid-stage of level eight with a hundred-meter body length, swam as if searching for something and let out a low cry upon hearing the question.
Roar, roar! The crystals can be collected by mom and the others; we’re going to do something big. Let’s see if there are any powerful giant beast powers nearby and collect information for Uncle.
