The Chaos Turbulent Sea was vast, and due to unstable space, both above and below the sea were filled with various danger zones. At the same time, it contained countless treasures of Heaven and Earth and innumerable Unique Beasts.
In such a situation, it was natural that the Dragon Palace was not the only giant beast power.
As for the issue of many giant beasts not caring or being helpless regarding the affect on cognition from absorbing violent Heavenly Energy over the long term and becoming increasingly violent and insane, that was common.
Apart from foreign Mythical Giant Beasts, the Unique Beasts that grew up in the Chaotic Turbulent Region were affected from the start, and by the time they grew to Mythical-level, they had already become bloodthirsty and ferocious with low intelligence.
Just like the two white and black pythons the Destruction Emperor Dragon encountered earlier.
…
Afternoon
Outside South City, within the black cracks that spanned the Earth, troops from the Violent Dragon Tribe kept emerging, gathering in force not far away.
These Violent Dragon People included soldiers as well as women, children, and elderly. Additionally, there were many Violent Dragon Alien Beasts with body lengths over ten meters, carrying loads of goods on their backs.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1120 - 1120 453 Flame Tiger Whale Glenn Clark My
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1120: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Glenn Clark: My Invincible Brother (7K)_3 Chapter 1120: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Glenn Clark: My Invincible Brother (7K)_3 With Kavadola’s surrender and the sealing of his Divine Soul by Jack Clark, he was essentially considered one of their own.
Additionally, considering the connections between them and the Ancient Human Race and some other factors, Jack Clark and several other king-level figures briefly discussed and then ordered Kavadola to have his tribe migrate over.
As members of an alien tribe from the mythical world, even the weakest adult possessed Fifth Layer Heaven strength, the elite possessed Seventh Layer Heaven strength, and coupled with their Violent Dragon Alien Beast mounts and War Pattern Power, they were naturally born soldiers.
Once there would be sufficient food, breeding and raising a large number would make them a powerful vassal race for the Human Race.
As for settling their territory, that was even simpler, as the human areas in the mythical world were vast enough to allocate a space large enough to accommodate millions of the Violent Dragon alien tribe.
Indeed, Jack Clark planned to subjugate the remaining seven Violent Dragon alien tribes as well.
Over the years, although the Human Race had managed to keep casualties extremely low thanks to technological advantages, each war on the frontline still resulted in a heavy toll of tens of thousands of soldiers dead or wounded.
If they could subjugate the entire Violent Dragon race and form an army of over a hundred thousand Violent Dragons, they would likely be able to reduce the pressure caused by the shortage of frontline soldiers.
As for the future possibility of the Violent Dragon alien tribe growing too powerful, Jack Clark hadn’t considered it at all, just as the Purgatory Family wouldn’t care about their vassal races.
At this time, as more alien tribes migrated over, they also attracted countless spectators, some from South City, others from nearby towns.
Simultaneously, the entire world was abuzz with the topic of Jack Clark subjugating an alien tribe.
Alien tribes! These were legendary creatures from the civilization of the mythical world.
Therefore, a bit further away from the twenty thousand or so Violent Dragon aliens that had already arrived, more than a million curious onlookers had gathered, creating a sea of people murmuring and pointing.
“Look, those Violent Dragon People are so tall, each standing taller than a building.”
“They even have scales on their bodies, as if they haven’t fully evolved.”
“It’s not that they’re not fully evolved; it’s probably because they need these scales for protection in their environment. After all, they come from the dangerous and mysterious mythical world.”
“That’s true.”
“But these aliens are so powerful; they’ve actually managed to domesticate such ferocious Violent Dragon Alien Beasts into mounts and pets.”
“That 2-meter-tall alien must be a Violent Dragon child, and the Violent Dragon it’s leading, which is over 8 meters long, must be in its growth period…”
Apart from those who were simply there to watch, many knowledgeable individuals were using appearances to analyze and research the Violent Dragon tribe.
Of course, amidst such a scene, there was no shortage of social media influencers and journalists, with mobile phones and video cameras clicking away non-stop, including those who were live streaming.
“Folks at home, do you see those aliens behind me? They look terribly fierce, but if any ‘brother iron’ shoots a rocket (emoji), I, Roy Carlson, will dare to go over and take a photo with a Violent Dragon Person…”
“Brothers and sisters, if someone gifts Jiajia a skyscraper, I’ll go dance under that small hill-like Mythical Giant Beast…”
At this moment, the scene outside of South City could be described as pandemonium, with excited faces and pointing fingers frightening some ordinary Violent Dragon people into continually retreating.
However, both sides were separated by armed soldiers, and only official journalists from the South City Television Station were allowed in to conduct interviews.
The host named Mickey was excitedly holding a microphone, standing by the toe of the hundred-meter-tall Kavadola, speaking into the camera.
“Hello everyone, this is the Violent Dragon King Kavadola. Under the overwhelming presence of the invincible Divine Martial Throne, he has abandoned the dark and chosen to submit.”
“Mr. Kavadola here is a Mythical-level Powerhouse, immensely powerful. Just standing before him makes my legs go weak…”
Kavadola looked down curiously at the tiny human at his feet, like an ant, wondering what she was muttering into that device.
Meanwhile, on a hillside in the distance, Jack Clark’s left wrist was flickering with Blue Radiance as he engaged in a video conference with ten other king-level figures.
Below the video feed of the ten kings, the Federation Secretary was reporting the current situation.
“Today’s residual impact of the Mythical Impact is much weaker than yesterday’s, with the highest intensity of the Space Cracks detected being Level 11, totaling over five thousand three hundred.”
“Following this rate of decay, it is estimated that the precursors of the Second Mythical Impact will subside in five days.”
“Due to the repetitive emergence of large-scale Space Cracks, the concentration of Heavenly Energy on Blue Star has increased by 0.9 times, resulting in 5,147 casualties.”
“These casualties were mainly caused by an Eighth Level Beast that emerged from a sea crack at noon today and rampaged through one of Berlin’s coastal resorts. The beast has been killed.”
“Also, today there were 312 incidents of dealing with extraordinary creatures worldwide, with over four hundred types of special minerals and materials collected, including more than a hundred from the Resource category, the rest are still being identified.”
After the Federation Secretary completed the report on today’s impact, Marcellus Larry slowly spoke up, “I didn’t expect that these Violent Dragon aliens actually have some relation to the Ancient Human Race.”
A female king-level figure with golden hair excitedly said, “If we could make contact with ancient civilization, under the guidance of the Seven Emperors, the Purgatory True Demon Race will not stand a chance.”
Another king-level figure from Berlin shook his head, “Difficult. According to that Violent Dragon King named Kavadola, the ancient Human Expert is also searching for the coordinates to Blue Star.”
“Clearly, when the Ancient Human Race triggered the Void Descent and destroyed the world back then, Blue Star also left its original location, causing those ancient expeditionary powerhouses to lose the coordinates.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1121 - 1121 453 Flame Tiger Whale Glenn Clark My
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1121: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Glenn Clark: My Invincible Brother (7K)_4 Chapter 1121: Chapter 453: Flame Tiger Whale, Glenn Clark: My Invincible Brother (7K)_4 Another king-level figure nodded slightly, “From the current situation, it seems that at least a few of the original Seven Great Emperors still exist, having reestablished the Human Race deep within the mythical world.”
“This is good news for our Federation, even if we end up losing to The Purgatory Family, the Human Race will still exist.”
After the other kings had spoken, Jack Clark smiled faintly, “Seniors, I think the matter of the Ancient Human Race is not urgent, for now. We should take some time to study those war patterns.”
“This inheritance of war patterns comes from the strong men of an Ancient Civilization, likely a new power system that they mastered after their expedition ended.”
“Due to the reason that it’s from the same Origin, integrating it into our current True Martial Body Type, technological system, and Genetic True Martial system is quite straightforward.”
“The war pattern power that Kavadola controls is of the Amplification Type, which unites the strength of everyone to form a War Pattern domain, enhancing strength, Defense, stamina, and recovery.”
“When forming a Ten Thousand People War Pattern Formation, it can extend the range of a Mythical Powerhouses’s Law Divine Domain by double, amplifying their strength by several times, and the more people who condense the war pattern, the stronger the amplification.”
“In theory, it can reach a number of one million. A million Fourth Layers could slay gods, or amplify a king-level expert from the early Myth stage to the Mythical Peak.”
“Therefore, I propose that the researchers of the Federation Think Tank drop everything and focus entirely on mastering the war pattern system to see if it can be integrated with the Rune System and applied to Unmanned Mecha and Unmanned Fighter.”
“Once successful, our warfighting model against The Purgatory Family will undergo a new transformation.”
No sooner had Jack Clark finished speaking than a smile appeared on Marcellus Larry’s face: “I agree with Jack’s proposal.”
“I have no objections.”
The other king-level figures also recognized these prospects, so they all nodded with smiles. After discussing a few more issues, they concluded the meeting.
This meeting’s minutes would be documented and sent to the Three Great Speakers.
However, a new round of the Civilization War was about to erupt, so everything concerning the Blue Star was discussed and decided by people like Jack Clark and another Heavenly King.
By the time Jack Clark returned, the war would have already started there, but only now had the various mighty armies gathered sufficiently for the high-end powerhouses to begin their standoff.
Small-scale skirmishes had already begun as well.
Unfortunately, due to the Blue Star Anomaly, Jack Clark had to stay and oversee things here; otherwise, he would have already rushed into battle.
After concluding the meeting, Jack Clark’s figure flashed up into the thousands of meters high altitude, where Mathilda Ward stood hovering above, overseeing the relocation process below.
Despite Kavadola’s orders, if one of the tens of thousands of Violent Dragon Beasts suddenly went berserk and charged into the distant crowd, it would cause considerable trouble.
Casting a glance at the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe spread out below over several kilometers, divided into tribes of hundreds and thousands, Jack Clark nodded slightly.
“It seems Kavadola has good control over the tribes. There have been no slip-ups in the relocation so far. Sister Ilisa, let’s go down.”
Mathilda Ward nodded, “Alright, Brother Callum.”
Jack Clark coughed slightly, “Sister Ilisa, could you just call me by my name? The term ‘Brother Callum’ always gives me the feeling that I’m still very young.”
Looking at Jack Clark, who seemed a bit embarrassed, Mathilda Ward’s eyes shifted, and with a smile in her eyes she nodded, “You’re right. You are now a king-level expert, and ‘Brother Callum’ indeed lacks a bit of seriousness.”
“Fine, from now on I will call you by your name.”
While talking and laughing, the two descended from the sky and came to Kavadola, standing between the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe and the distant crowd of onlookers.
Suddenly, the hundred-meter-tall Kavadola, who was emitting an invisible Mythical-level oppression, bowed respectfully, “My lord.”
Standing a hundred meters above, Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Kavadola, how many of your tribespeople haven’t arrived yet, and roughly how long will it take to complete the relocation?”
With respect, Kavadola responded, “One-third have already been relocated. Because we are spread out into over a hundred small tribes, even if the rest were to travel continuously through the night, it would take about ten star hours (30 hours).”
It would take another day, then.
Jack Clark nodded faintly, “In a while, someone will bring food for your people. Once everyone has gathered, you’re to take them to the temporary settlement before moving everyone into the mythical world together.”
“Yes, Master,” Kavadola said respectfully.
Jack Clark then turned to Mathilda Ward, “Sister Ilisa, please take charge of things here for a while, especially keep an eye on the stability progress of that rift channel.”
Mathilda Ward nodded, “No problem.”
After entrusting these matters, Jack Clark’s figure flashed and he disappeared, and this scene was captured by the cameras below and broadcasted nationwide.
In Mist River City, on the playground where a sports class was taking place, the huge pit that had been blasted open in the morning had already been repaired. However, dozens of junior high school students were now gathered around.
In the middle of these people was a group of female students, with male classmates standing on the steps around them. At this moment, all eyes were on Teresa Wilson at the center of the crowd.
Or rather, on the notebook she was holding, which was broadcasting the South Television Station’s footage.
When they saw the hundred-meter-tall ferocious giant bowing respectfully to Jack Clark, who stood in the air, Teresa couldn’t help but excitedly say, “Glenn, big brother is so cool. He even tamed such a fierce creature.”
Behind Teresa, the over 2 meters tall Glenn Clark nodded proudly, “Of course, my brother has always been amazing.”
Immediately, a classmate behind him gasped in shock, “How is that possible? Glenn, that Darren Callum—no, the Divine Martial Throne is your brother?”
Glenn nodded, “Yes, the Divine Martial Throne is my brother. Darren Callum was just a mission nickname he had a few months ago.”
Hiss! All the surrounding classmates sucked in a breath of cold air, including one boy who had seen Jack Clark and Glenn Clark walking together on the street and was now shocked.
“No wonder I always felt the Divine Martial Throne looked familiar. I can’t believe it’s your big brother, Glenn. No wonder you’re so powerful.”
“Wait a minute, Glenn. If I remember correctly, your brother only started at South Sky Martial Heights last year, right?” Suddenly, another classmate who got along well with Glenn realized.
Glenn proudly nodded, “Right, my brother only started Martial School Cultivation at South Sky Martial Heights last year. He became a king-level, unbeatable in battle, in just one year.”
“So impressive.”
“One-Year King, Glenn, your family hit the jackpot.”
“Yeah, having a king-level big brother, from now on, no one will dare to mess with Glenn. That would be suicide.”
At this moment, all the classmates looked at Glenn with envious eyes, and some precocious girls looked thoughtfully at Teresa and the other two girls.
So that’s it, they knew early on how powerful Glenn’s brother was.
While Glenn was boasting in front of his classmates, Jack Clark had already appeared in the Plane World, ready to enhance his strength further.
According to Kavadola’s instructions, the seven Violent Dragon Kings were all Mythical-level Powerhouses, each mastering a type of War Pattern Inheritance.
And the strongest among them, the Violent Dragon War God, was at the Mid Purgatory Demon stage, mastering seven inherited War Pattern Powers, with formidable strength. He had once suppressed a Violent Dragon Beast that had burst out of the forbidden area.
In addition to that, the Violent Dragon War God also possessed the Inherited War Order, a legacy bestowed by an Ancient Human Race expert, which had potent sealing powers when activated by the War Patterns.
That Violent Dragon Beast had been sealed in all its talents and Law Powers by the Inherited War Order, and ultimately, it was slain by the Violent Dragon War God.
When he heard about the Inherited War Order and its ability to seal talents and Laws, Jack Clark was determined to obtain it.
With the Inherited War Order in hand, the next time he encountered the Time Silver Butterfly, he would have a way to restrict it. If he could pull the Time Silver Butterfly out of time, he was confident he could slay it.
Otherwise, it was troublesome to be constantly monitored by a life form that could wander through time and risk an unexpected incident at a critical moment.
Therefore, before going to suppress the Violent Dragon War God and subdue the other Violent Dragon Kings, he needed to further enhance his strength and complete the Transformation of his Soul Talent.
For Jack Clark, who had grasped the Law of Strength, the more Rules he mastered and the stronger his physical strength became, the more terrifying his combined combat power would be.
Fortunately, he hadn’t had the chance to use the more than ten Origins he had acquired earlier, and he hadn’t had time to convert those Life Crystals sent by the Destruction Emperor Dragon into Attribute points yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1122 - 1122 454 Slaughter of a Million Demonic
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1122: Chapter 454: Slaughter of a Million, Demonic Flames Engulfing the Sky Chapter 1122: Chapter 454: Slaughter of a Million, Demonic Flames Engulfing the Sky “`
Upon the firmament at the edge of its territory, a blue-white Giant Dragon, spanning ten thousand meters through Power Projection, materialized, surrounded by black storms intermixed with Ice Crystals. Its immense Dragon Eyes gazed toward an area hundreds of kilometers away.
There, resembling a mountain range, an ancient creature had entered its domain, its every step raising a Tsunami-like white wave and breathing out raging wind, carrying an immense and powerful presence.
Roar! Deep and majestic, the Dragon Roar echoed between heaven and earth, laden with the authority of Rule.
In an instant, thousands of cities and tribes of Kaleb Alien Race within the territory, along with countless Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts, all knelt down, looking towards the Icebound Mountain Range with fear.
The king was enraged.
Faced with the warning roar of the blue-white Giant Dragon, the ancient creature seemed oblivious, its will deeply hibernating in petrification after a failed breakthrough, its thoughts slow.
Moreover, to Devour the “Sun”, nothing could stop its stride.
Boom!
The colossal footfalls, like pillars of heaven, moved, and each step shattered the Earth for more than ten kilometers, collapsing forests, breaking rivers, destroying everything.
Whether towering ten-thousand-meter mountain peaks or sprawling mountain ranges lying across the Earth were all smashed, leaving countless Unique Beasts in frenzied escape, birds soaring into the sky.
Seeing the ancient creature showing not the slightest intention to stop, strong murderous intent appeared in the eyes of the blue-white Giant Dragon.
It recognized this ancient creature, for even more than a hundred Sun Cycles ago when it had not yet reached Titan Peak, this ancient creature had invaded its territory several times.
Each time it would Devour millions of its Vassal Races and destroy several cities before leaving.
Not until it achieved a breakthrough to Titan Peak and mastered a strand of the power of Rule, which could destroy the petrified mountain peaks on the surface of that ancient being, did the creature cease invading here.
Because once its surface’s petrified mountain peaks were destroyed, it needed to consume what little Origin it had left to recover, an effort not worth the Vitality it would gain from Devouring millions of ordinary living beings.
Roar!
The blue-white Giant Dragon projection roared, and instantly the raging wind howled between heaven and earth, with boundless chill gathering toward it as the power of Rule pervaded.
Boom! A white Breath, hundreds of meters thick, pierced the sky above the Firmament, causing everything it passed to freeze, turning into countless Ice Crystals that spanned several hundred kilometers.
The absolute zero frost Breath fell upon the back of the ancient creature, and in an instant, rolling cold air engulfed it like a tide, covering most of its body, freezing and shattering it.
Thud thud thud!! The rocky material of the ancient creature’s surface, which had only blasted a few hundred-meter-wide pit under the fusion Breath of the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, was continuously shattering and collapsing.
It was only a while before a layer of the ancient creature’s surface was melted away, turning into countless shattered Ice Crystals, scattering and forming colorful rings of light around it.
The ancient creature roared, its mouth opening slightly.
Boom!
Instantly, a terrifying suction force erupted, shaking Heaven and Earth, breaking the ground in a range of more than ten kilometers, and sending dirt, trees, and Stone shooting up into the sky.
As the endless flow of rock and dirt was Devoured, the ancient creature’s form suddenly expanded, recovering most of the rock on its surface that had been shattered by the Breath.
This time, the blue-white Giant Dragon mobilized the Power of Heaven and Earth within the range of its territory, gathering the force of extreme cold into a Breath that lasted for more than twenty minutes.
When the Breath finished, the ground in front of it disappeared, leaving a huge pit more than a hundred kilometers in diameter, with the still massive form of the ancient creature at its bottom.
Looking at this scene, the Giant Dragon’s gaze turned even colder, issuing a Dragon Roar that shook Heaven and Earth.
“Today I shall see whether it’s your remaining Origin that is greater, or the Power of Heaven and Earth gathered by my territory is stronger. You even dare to invade,” it declared.
Boom!
The projection of the Giant Dragon shone with blue-white Light, and instantly the heaven and Earth it had refined shook, and the river tens of li away from the ancient creature was even more violently trembling, exploding.
You could see a river several kilometers wide changing its course, drowning the Earth under the power of Rule to form a Tsunami hundreds of meters high, surging mightily toward the ancient creature.
Just when the Tsunami was about a dozen kilometers away from the ancient creature, the river water exploded, shooting up into the sky, turning into ice pillars tens of kilometers long shooting out and covering the sky.
Boom boom boom!! Under the bombardment of the pure white Ice Pillars, the ancient being in the pit staggered, and then was engulfed by the endless river water flowing behind.
Crackle Crackle!!
In the blue-white Giant Dragon’s mobilization of Rule and the Power of Heaven and Earth, the water kept freezing, and in the blink of an eye under the night, transformed into an Icebound Mountain Range extending a hundred kilometers.
This is the strength of the blue-white Giant Dragon that has almost stepped into the realm of the Ancient Titan.
In contrast to the Sky-based God King and the Purgatory Demon God, who are somewhat constrained in their battles, the blue-white Giant Dragon, standing within its territory, remotely wielding the Power of Heaven and Earth, presents an even greater and grander might.
With mere gestures, it could alter the landscape, destroying Heaven and Earth.
Whoo! From within the Icebound Mountain Range came a sound as booming and deep as that of a steam whistle, followed by the fracturing Ice Layer atop the ancient creature, with massive Cracks spreading continuously.
Thud thud thud!! The Rule-enriched ice mountain crumbled, revealing the ancient creature whose rocky surface had been broken by hundreds more meters.
Whoo! With another deep and lingering moan, the ancient creature once again opened its mouth wide.
Under the terrifying force of Devouring, the Earth shattered within a range of tens of kilometers; trees, Dirt, and shattered Ice were Devoured, leaving a vast deep pit behind.
Whoosh whoosh!!
Amidst the white mist radiating from the ancient creature’s form, it inflated as the surrounding mist circled, its rock surface solidifying and restoring those layers of rock that had been shattered.
Because of petrification resulting from their failed attempt to breakthrough to True Spirit in ancient times, these ancient beings had no long-range attack methods, nor could they use Divine powers, Talents; they could only endure.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1123 - 1123 454 Massacre of a Million Demonic Flames
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1123: Chapter 454 Massacre of a Million, Demonic Flames Engulf the Heavens_2 Chapter 1123: Chapter 454 Massacre of a Million, Demonic Flames Engulf the Heavens_2 But at the same time, the Terror Defense was almost at its grand accomplishment, as the rule power dissipated and merged into the rock, transforming itself into an indestructible petrified body.
These rocks became harder the closer they were to the Core Area, containing stronger rule power, so even the attacks of the Blue-White Giant Dragon could only damage the surface.
To kill such an ancient petrified being, one would have to destroy its core solidified rock with even more powerful strength, or shatter the surface to exhaust its remaining Origin.
As long as the Origin was exhausted, the rocks on the surface of the ancient creature’s body that were destroyed could not recover, and piercing through continuously at one point could cause fatal damage to it.
Of course, this point was at least a kilometer in diameter.
The ancient creature that was continuously under attack slowly raised its head, its petrified huge eyes glancing at the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s phantom across the sky, then it stepped forward and continued moving.
However, this time, its direction of movement changed slightly, moving along the edge of the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s territory.
It instinctively sensed an invisible rule power covering the heaven and earth ahead, and the deeper into that area, the stronger the rules between heaven and earth became, inflicting greater damage to it.
Watching the ancient being exit his territory and move around the edge of it, the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s eyes were cold and indifferent, choosing not to continue the assault.
At this moment, it was in the final crucial phase of breaking through the Ancient Titan, and did not want to waste time and Origin entangling with this terrifyingly defensive ancient being.
At the same time, the Blue-White Giant Dragon was somewhat puzzled, not knowing where this ancient creature was heading to, as this distance was already far from its Hibernation ground.
Because it changed from moving in a straight line to a circular path, the distance between the ancient creature and the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly increased from around five hundred thousand kilometers to over seven hundred thousand.
By a stroke of serendipity, the Blue-White Giant Dragon inadvertently helped delay the ancient creature’s advance for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Meanwhile, Jack Clark was sitting cross-legged at the peak of a black mountain in the Plane World, in front of him a dense pile of Life Crystals formed a small hill, casually grabbing a handful and with a thought.
“Convert these Life Crystals into Attribute points.”
“You have converted a Life Crystal and gained 11 Attribute points.”
“You have converted a Life Crystal and gained 5 Attribute points…”
As the notifications came one after another, the Attribute points on the transparent page soared wildly, thirty thousand, fifty thousand, one hundred thousand…
When Jack Clark had converted all the Life Crystals, the Attribute points finally stopped at 261,987. More than two hundred thousand Attribute points were enough for Jack Clark to burn day and night, and make a breakthrough to the Mid-Mythical Stage within half a month.
Having once accumulated two to three hundred thousand Attribute points before, Jack Clark was very calm this time, “Burn ten thousand Attribute points, enter the enlightenment state.”
As his voice fell, a mighty wave of Attribute Energy turned into Mysterious Epiphanic Intent Realm that enveloped Jack Clark, and at the same time, a red radiance flickered between his eyebrows, as a Blood Colored Eye opened.
In that eye, which contained the Blood Sea Doomsday, twelve strands of White Light that were the World Origin appeared, one of which was drawn out by Jack Clark.
Boom! That strand of World Origin exploded within Jack Clark’s body, as the Illusion Meditation Scripture operated, and the Soul Law he had already touched transformed at an astonishing speed.
Rattle, rattle!! Chains of black soul wrapped around like spider webs piercing through the Void, and terrifying Soul Power spread out to form a black halo of soul light behind Jack Clark’s head.
At the same time, above his head appeared the All-Heaven Emperor Crown, he sat high on a black throne that the Soul Law had condensed, wearing the Mysterious Colored Imperial Robe, and with his left hand holding a Seal, exuding a terrifying oppression.
At this moment, Jack Clark was like a Great Emperor who ruled over souls, the entire Plane World shook under the pressure of those five Higher-order Laws and the Supreme Law.
Especially with the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal in Jack Clark’s hand, the rotating Primordial Rule inside was emitting an invisible fluctuation, subtly altering the essence of his True Body as it was being tempered by the Soul Law.
Transforming into a Rule-based Creature.
However, this unconscious transformation was very slow; it would only be faster when Jack Clark would actively refine the Primordial Rule after cultivating to the pinnacle of Heavenly King.
The current transformation merely allowed his soul and true body to contain a strand of rule aura.
Outside world.
As Jack Clark engaged in Closed-door Cultivation, the skies gradually darkened, yet South City outside was still brightly lit and bustling as ever.
Already over a hundred thousand Violent Dragon People sat on the ground, curiously watching the scene of humans cooking nearby.
“Captain, what are those humans doing? It smells so good.”
“Yeah, it smells delicious. It’s no wonder that it’s the world of the Upper God. It’s truly magical.” The Violent Dragon People drooled over the tempting aroma of the cooked food.
They usually hunted in the desert with the swirling sand, consuming barbecue, meat porridge, and a small portion of fruits, never having savored such exquisite food.
Kavadola was no exception.
Kavadola, now a hundred meters tall, even sitting on the ground he was several tens of meters in height. In front of him, a cultivator with fire talent was barbecuing a Unique Beast that was over ten meters long.
Although Mythical-level Powerhouses were not much in front of Jack Clark, for those soldiers and for the Federation, they were still considered high-end combat forces not to be taken lightly.
Sine Kavadola had been subdued by Jack Clark, his Divine Soul shackled by constraints, he too was considered a part of the Federation; thus, Valentine Leach did not neglect him.
At that moment, several people were gesticulating in front of Kavadola.
Glenn Clark, who was 2 meters tall, looked up powerfully at the formidable, fierce-looking Violent Dragon King: “Big guy, hello, I’m Glenn Clark. I heard you’re a new underling my brother recently took in.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1124 - 1124 454 Slaughter of a Million Demonic
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1124: Chapter 454: Slaughter of a Million, Demonic Flames Rise to the Sky_3 Chapter 1124: Chapter 454: Slaughter of a Million, Demonic Flames Rise to the Sky_3 As soon as Glenn Clark finished speaking, the nearby high-level cultivator hastily translated, his spiritual will vibrating the void, repeating what Glenn had just said.
Kavadola slightly bowed his head, emitting a humming, muffled sound, “Hello, Lord Glenn.”
Although the little one before him was very weak, weak enough that a single breath from it could kill him, the identity of the other party made Kavadola dare not take lightly.
That was the brother of the Upper God.
But if the Upper God was so powerful, why was his brother so weak?
As soon as Glenn had finished speaking, Justin Welan at his side couldn’t wait to excitedly say, “Kavadola, my name is Justin Welan, and I am Jack’s best friend.”
Kavadola paused slightly but still nodded, “Hello, Lord Justin.”
“Hahaha… Look, Zac, even a mythical powerhouse from different races is calling me a lord. I told you guys to come over and watch the fun, but you didn’t come.”
Holding his mobile phone, Justin Welan showed off to Zac Maben who was on a video call, proudly flaunting that they did not join.
After Jack Clark suppressed the alien Myth and the Giant Beast in a few moves, Eastern Summer was shaken, and then Justin Welan brought Glenn Clark over on the airplane from South City to join in on the excitement.
How could he not come when his brother was showing off?
Besides, he was curious about the Myth of different races, since with his current level of cultivation, under normal conditions, he had no right to contact a Mythical-level existence.
Glenn Clark curiously looked at the Violent Dragon King, who was like a small hill wrapped up, “Kavadola, how did you grow so big? I see that your subordinates are only four meters tall.”
As Glenn spoke, the high-level cultivator beside him translated simultaneously.
Facing this question, Kavadola thought for a moment, “It should be because I eat a lot. Since I was little, I had a huge appetite and was the tribe’s strongman.”
Is that so. Glenn reflected thoughtfully.
Then Glenn suddenly thought of something, and turned to shout, “Big Brother Justin, could you take a picture with me and Kavadola? I want to bring it back to show May and the others.”
Justin Welan’s eyes lit up immediately, “Sure, and I’ll take a few photos myself, too.”
“Jim, that’s not good, you’re too small; it seems… climb onto Kavadola’s shoulder.”
“Yes, yes, that’s right. It’s only then that you look imposing.”
While Glenn Clark and Justin Welan were taking photos with Kavadola, Mathilda Ward was also curiously sizing up Glenn from a distance on the hillside, wondering how he wasn’t as handsome as Jack Clark.
The brothers, one handsome and elegant, the other rough and burly, were too different.
At this moment, an aide hesitated, “General Ward, will their behavior possibly upset Lord Kavadola? What if Glenn gets hurt…”
Mathilda Ward smiled faintly, unconcerned, “Don’t worry. That Violent Dragon King is smarter than we imagined, or rather, knows the current affairs.”
After saying that, Mathilda Ward looked into the distance, where in front of the cracks extending over a thousand meters, dozens of high-level cultivators were busy, and many special mechanical devices were operational.
These devices were positioned on both sides, releasing special energy beams to stabilize the spatial fluctuations, in coordination with various special resources to stabilize the pathway.
This kind of spatial crack, formed by the clash of forces from two worlds, while penetrating both realms, is a temporary existence that will slowly collapse over time.
To make it a long-term feature requires the consumption of spatial resources, combined with a rune array to stabilize the pathway.
Otherwise, it would collapse before the migration of those from the Violent Dragon Tribe was completed.
Just as Jack was preparing to arrive on the opposite side the next day, to suppress the remaining Violent Dragon Kings and Violent Dragon War Gods, and subjugate all of the Violent Dragon Tribe, traces of the Purgatory True Demon appeared there.
Under the cover of night, a region spanning tens of thousands of kilometers was encased in terrifying power, and the air was filled with a horrendous cold that seemed to freeze even space itself.
And at this time, tens of thousands of meters below the frozen earth, more than thirty gaunt Purgatory True Demons six meters tall, wearing priest robes, were moving through an Earth’s Fissure.
Leading them was a ten-meter tall demon king covered in dark golden scale armor with nine sharp Demon Horns on his head like a crown, looking quite ‘young.’
The aura of this demon king was immensely terrifying, with dark red demon air swirling around, as if countless lost souls were wailing and screaming.
Alec, flying at the forefront, revealed a cold smile, “I did not expect to find another civilization of different races behind this ice-encrusted forbidden zone we’ve explored a few times and found devoid of resources.”
“As long as I can devour the flesh and souls of millions of different races this time, including those few Mythical Lives into my domain and perform the sacrifice, it should enable me to break my limits and become an Abyss Great Demon King,” he continued.
A priest with Nine Demonic Marks smiled, complimenting, “This is all due to Your Highness’s luck; otherwise, we Demons wouldn’t have discovered this pathway.”
Alec nodded slightly, “Don’t worry, I won’t forget your service. When the time comes, each demon will get a share of the Blood of Demon God containing the essence of the Laws’ Origin.”
All the True Demon Priests showed excitement, “Thank you, Your Highness, for your generous gift.”
The Blood of Demon God containing the essence of the Laws’ Origin is incredibly precious; even just one share could purify all True Demons’ bloodlines, strengthening them further, or even granting the qualification to glimpse the title of demon king.
Of course, it’s just a qualification. It’s like how there’s a multitude of Ninth Heaven Experts from the Human Race, but over decades, less than a hundred manage to breakthrough to the king level, which is an insurmountable gap.
Boom! The hard Ice Layer exploded, and under the night sky, figures surrounded by dark demonic air soared into the sky, standing ten thousand meters altitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125 - 1125 454 Slaughter of a Million Demonic
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1125: Chapter 454: Slaughter of a Million, Demonic Flames Engulfing the Sky_4 Chapter 1125: Chapter 454: Slaughter of a Million, Demonic Flames Engulfing the Sky_4 Behind the Frozen Death Zone, a sky full of yellow sand danced in the air, while at the horizon’s end, the Void cracked, forming a fissure of unknown length, filled with a destructive aura that even the demon kings found threatening.
To the left, the Frozen Death Zone; to the right, the Dark Rift, with the vast desert in between. Even Alex, who had seen and known much, was taken aback by such an environment.
“Your Highness, through the reconnaissance and interrogations conducted by my subordinates, we have learned that this civilization calls itself the Violent Dragon Civilization, ruled by seven Violent Dragon Kings and one Violent Dragon War God.”
“All seven Violent Dragon Kings are Mythical Powerhouses. Ranked by their strength, the tribes they lead occupy oases of various sizes throughout the desert, where they breed alien beasts known as Violent Dragons.”
“And the strongest among them, the Violent Dragon War God, is very powerful. Based on the energy fluctuations detected by my subordinates when they covertly approached, that Violent Dragon War God’s realm is at the mid period of a Titan, holding the largest oasis deep in the desert.”
“This terrain is highly advantageous for Your Highness, suitable for the blood sacrifice to the Abyssal Demon Domain. By the time we get close to the War God Tribe deep within, Your Highness should have already accomplished the final breakthrough.”
After the High Priest finished speaking, Alec coldly said, “Rest assured, even if that Violent Dragon War God were to appear now, I wouldn’t care.”
“I am the Son of the Demon God, inheriting the greatest strength of The Purgatory Family. A mere Titan powerhouse from a lowly civilization is no match for me.”
“Now go set it up.”
“As you command, Your Highness.”
More than thirty True Demon Priests bowed respectfully, then their demon gas retracted, gradually transforming into nearly imperceptible transparent shadows that shot out explosively.
Soon, more than thirty shadowy projections flew over two hundred kilometers across the desert, and under the cover of night, an oasis spanning more than ten kilometers came into view.
Seeing this scene, more than thirty True Demon Priests revealed a hideous smile, dispersed to land on the ground, and each took out a sinister-looking giant beast skull.
As demon gas surged into these eerie skulls, their inscriptions flickered, and the hollow eyes gazed toward the distant oasis, their mouths slightly agape.
Hum! Thirty-some intangible fluctuations converged, forming a strange force that enveloped the oasis ahead; in an instant, all different races and Violent Dragon Beasts revealed an intense urge to sleep.
“So sleepy.”
Thud, thud, thud!! All the Violent Dragon Aliens collapsed to the ground.
Just then, the distant sky turned dark red, and below, rolling Dark Demon Air swept in like a sandstorm, eventually engulfing the entire oasis.
Amidst the roiling Abyss Demonic Aura, over ten thousand Violent Dragon Aliens stiffened immediately, with black inscriptions emerging on their bodies, convulsing wildly, and uttering unconscious hisses.
Roar, roar!!
Suddenly some Violent Dragon Aliens bellowed, their bodies swelling dramatically, covered with black scales, as a sharp horn grew upon their heads, resembling the monsters of the Abyss.
The Violent Dragon Alien Beasts too mutated under the corruption of the Abyss Demonic Aura, their sizes doubling explosively.
In just over twenty minutes, all life had been contaminated by the Abyss Demonic Aura and demonized, turning into mindless monsters howling.
Alec stood tall within the hundred-kilometer expanse of the Dark Demon Realm, radiating the terrifying pressure of a peak demon king, with countless fierce shadows standing firm in the darkness below.
It was only after all the Violent Dragon Aliens were contaminated and their flesh and souls sacrificed and assimilated into the demon realm that Alec signaled with a thought.
Immediately, the dark red Abyss Demonic Domain churned, spreading like an apocalyptic shroud towards the front, as if Doomsday had arrived.
Tens of kilometers ahead of the demon realm, dozens of transparent phantoms flew close to the ground at high speed, like messengers of death from legend.
And the real name of these True Demon Priests was Death Priests, akin to bounty hunters within The Purgatory Family.
The mission of these Death Priests was to delve into the vast mythical world, scouting nearby civilizations of different races, and reporting back to the demon kings.
The only outcomes for those different races were either to surrender and become vassal fodder, or to be annihilated and used for blood sacrifices to enhance strength, or for the crafting of powerful demonic weapons.
Under the sleeping demonic weapon of the Death Priests, one by one, the smaller oases without Mythical Powerhouses were devoured by the Abyss.
With each oasis devoured, Alec’s Abyssal Demon Domain’s might surged, the range of the demon gas’s envelopment expanded, and countless roars of abyssal monsters emanated from within.
However, this silent devouring was discovered upon approaching an oasis spanning over fifty kilometers, home to over a hundred thousand individuals from the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe.
In the center of the massive, crude city at the heart of the oasis, a Mythical-level tremendous oppressive force burst forth, accompanied by a roar, “Who dares disturb the great Lord Kofi’s sleep?”
Boom! Law Power erupted in a sweep, and more than thirty Death Priests on the outskirts of the oasis simultaneously groaned, blood spurting from their mouths, faces turning pale.
At the same time, the entire tribe was awakened, and over ten thousand soldiers shot out, quickly assembling outside the city to form a battle array, with a towering figure standing a hundred meters tall in the sky above.
Surrounded by silver war patterns, Kofi, emanating a Mythical Aura, looked at the approaching dark sandstorm in the sky with a solemn expression, “Be careful, enemies are invading, assemble the battle array.”
“Fight, fight, fight!!”
The members of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe shouted fervently, their war patterns glistening with silver light, converging to illuminate the night sky like a silver ocean, forming massive silver rings.
With the rings’ luminescence, Kofi’s aura surged, as a silver battle sword a kilometer long materialized in his hand, exuding an earth-shattering sharpness.
Distinct from Kavadola’s war patterns, the ones Kofi wielded specialized in conjuring the Silver Light Holy Sword, capable of cleaving Heaven and Earth apart.
Boom!
The Abyssal Demon Domain spanning over a hundred kilometers swept across the sky, engulfing the oasis in sand, as millions of monsters within the darkness frantically rushed towards the battle array.
“Merely a different race, daring to hinder my progress,” a low and indifferent voice echoed throughout the entire Abyssal Demon Domain, as a terrifying aura burst forth in an instant, turning the entire demon gas into a huge demon head.
Boom! With one bite from the demon head that blotted out the sky, a vast hollow was gnawed out of the sky, and the terror that diffused instinctively made Kofi shudder.
“Kill!” bellowed the towering Violent Dragon King, his Silver Light Holy Sword soaring into the heavens, circled by silver halos that reflected upon Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
A supremely sharp beam of silver light pierced through heaven and earth, splitting apart the Abyssal Demon Domain, shining brilliantly before vanishing above the Firmament, with the demon gas then rolling over everything.
At the center of the demon domain, a Demon King with a height of a thousand meters and three heads with eight arms stood tall, clutching the shattered corpse of the Violent Dragon King, as endless Abyss Demonic Aura flooded in around it.
This was the power wielded by Alec, Demonization from the Abyss, the Laws Mystery of Higher-order Law Power of the Abyss, able to demonize everything through the Abyss Demonic Aura.
After nearly an hour, Kofi, now grown to two hundred meters with black bone spurs erupting along his body and surrounded by billowing demon gas, kneeled on one knee.
“From this day forth, you are my Abyssal War Demon,” declared the king.
With dark red eyes, Kofi respectfully lowered his head, “Yes, my king.”
Boom!
The Abyssal Demon Domain, now covering more than a hundred and thirty kilometers, continued its movement, the rolling Dark Demon Air devouring all in its path – life perished, and flesh and blood were corroded and consumed.
Boom after boom! Before Alec, at his peak as a Demon King, commanding two Higher-order Laws and the Demon God’s bloodline, one Violent Dragon Tribe after another was suppressed and devoured.
Subsequently, as four Violent Dragon Kings and a million Violent Dragon Aliens were demonized, the Abyssal Demon Domain expanded explosively to over a hundred and seventy kilometers, with towering demon gas.
Such a terrifying force directly caught the attention of the Violent Dragon War God thousands of kilometers away, whose gaze spanned the vast space to the all-consuming Dark Demon Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126 - 1126 455 Summoning the Future the Awe of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1126: Chapter 455: Summoning the Future, the Awe of the King-Level Chapter 1126: Chapter 455: Summoning the Future, the Awe of the King-Level “Purgatory Demon Race!”
As Jerold saw the black demon air flood over like a tide, his face instantly turned ugly.
As a Titan-level strong man, how could the forbidden areas on both sides of the Violent Dragon Desert possibly stop it completely? It actually went out hundreds of years ago but eventually retreated back.
Because more than 200,000 kilometers beyond the forbidden area lies the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, one of the Purgatory True Demons.
Within a million kilometers around their tribe, all different races had already been subjugated or annihilated by the Purgatory Demon Race. As for the situation even farther, he was unclear.
After sensing the surrounding environment was so dire, Jerold quietly withdrew, hoping this small place would never be discovered by The Purgatory Family.
Unexpectedly, after hundreds of years, this day still arrived.
Fortunately, there were only five demon king-level auras within the rolling demon air. If he could kill all the invading Purgatory True Demons this time, there was still a chance to lead some of the tribe to evacuate.
With this in mind, Jerold, who was a hundred meters tall, took a deep breath, his eyes showing a cold hue. At the same time, a golden crystal stone appeared in his hand.
Jerold’s Divine Soul Intent vibrated within the crystal, activating the seven strands of Divine Soul strength stored inside, “An enemy force is invading, hurry and lead your elite army towards me, gathering our forces.”
Immediately, two strands of Divine Soul strength inside the golden stone vibrated, conveying a powerful will.
“Enemy invasion!”
“Foreigners have entered our Yellow Sand Forbidden Land!?”
The atmosphere suddenly stilled, and Jerold’s face turned somewhat ugly, “Kofi, Kavadola, Andy… they’re in trouble, there’s no response from their Divine Soul fluctuations.”
As compatriots and strong men who acquired the Upper God Inheritance together, all seven Violent Dragon Kings and Violent Dragon War God Jerold were connected.
The connection required Jerold as the Violent Dragon War God to activate the crystal, shaking the Divine Soul strength, then the other Violent Dragon Kings would react and send a strand of will along the coordinates to descend.
But now only two Violent Dragon Kings had spoken, clearly indicating the other five Violent Dragon Kings had encountered trouble.
Jerold said solemnly, “You must hurry and bring the warriors here. The enemy this time is very strong; Kofi and the rest fell without even sending a signal.”
The other two Violent Dragon Kings did not dare to delay, being only a little over a hundred kilometers away from Jerold’s Oasis, located on both sides, they rapidly organized their military.
Soon, beneath the night, sand rolled, the earth trembled, and two groups of Violent Dragon Warriors, numbering over twenty thousand each, riding Violent Dragon Alien Beasts, hurried over.
Meanwhile, the rolling demon clouds in the sky had approached within a hundred kilometers, an imposing force darkening the sky, obscuring the moonlight.
Outside a city built of grey giant stones, spanning over twenty kilometers, two formations each of twenty thousand and one formation of fifty thousand stood tall, each emitting red, blue, and golden halos.
Above the formations, three colossal Violent Dragon Kings and Violent Dragon War Gods stood firm, their auras echoing the war patterns below, emitting dazzling radiance that illuminated the night sky.
In the cities of the War God Tribe, nearly a million ordinary Violent Dragon Alien Tribe’s elderly, weak, women, and children—all armed—stood on rooftops and city walls, watching into the distance.
Seeing the demon air dark clouds approaching at a frightening speed, Buddy, surrounded by a red war pattern halo, grimaced, “Where did these foreigners invade from?”
Jerold shook his head slightly and said deeply, “I do not know, but it should be from some gap that we are unaware of.”
He had already destroyed that entrance years ago, but the forbidden areas encircling the desert were vast, and no one knew if there were other crack entrances.
The Violent Dragon King Larkin, enveloped by a blue halo, appeared puzzled, “I could understand if Kofi and the rest, who were on the opposite side, encountered trouble, but why was there no response from Kavadola?”
Jerold and the others paused for a moment too.
Indeed, the Kavadola tribe was located in the rear, and the enemies appeared from another direction. How could there be no reaction from the Divine Soul when the Soul Stone trembled earlier?
However, there was no time to consider this now. The Abyssal Demon Domain, which covered nearly two hundred kilometers, had appeared in front, with countless fierce silhouettes roaring and howling from within the rolling demon air.
They were over a million already demonized Violent Dragon Alien Tribe members and Violent Dragon Giants.
Seeing this scene, all three, Larkin included, looked dismayed, “Damn it, to think they turned so many of our tribe into monsters; I swear I will obliterate you all.”
Boom!
Brilliant golden light burst from Jerold’s body, and the endless golden radiance spread, painting the sky gold and forming a thirty-kilometer golden halo.
In an instant, under the golden halo’s coverage, the auras of Larkin and Buddy’s subordinates, the Violent Dragon Kings, along with Jerold’s fifty thousand war-patterned army, surged by dozens of times.
The soldiers of the Fourth Layer Heaven were now comparable to those of the Sixth-level Heaven, those of the Sixth Layer temporarily broke through to the Seventh Layer, and all the seniors spanned an entire level.
Meanwhile, as nearly a hundred thousand high-order senior warriors’ strengths converged and reciprocated, Larkin and Buddy’s auras soared several-fold, both crossing from Mid-Mythical Stage to the late period.
And Jerold’s form swelled to a kilometer, like a Titan Warrior forged of gold, with seven kinds of golden, purple, blue, and other War Patterns converging to form a gigantic warhammer in his hands.
“Your strength is indeed problematic; it seems you must have gained some Inheritance of Ruins.”
In a deep voice, afar, hovering tens of kilometers away, the demon air churned, revealing the kilometer tall three-headed, eight-armed Alec, his body surrounded by a terrifying demon aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127 - 1127 455 Summoning the Future the Awe of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1127: Chapter 455: Summoning the Future, the Awe of the King-Level_2 Chapter 1127: Chapter 455: Summoning the Future, the Awe of the King-Level_2 On either side of Alec, four towering figures, each two hundred meters tall, stood with ferocious silhouettes, exuding a formidable demon power, making Alec appear like the Abyss Lord of Hell.
Gazing at Jerold who turned heaven and earth into gold across from him, Alec’s eye revealed an indifferent light.
No matter what Inheritance those different races acted upon, today they were destined to perish at the hands of the great Purgatory True Demon and become the skeletons beneath its feet as it ascended to the throne of the Abyss Great Demon King.
At this stage, there was no room for excessive talk, and in an instant, the world trembled with the rolling of endless demon gas, transforming into giant tentacles surging forward.
“I’ll hold it off, you all restrain Kofi and the rest.”
With a long howl from Jerold, his golden halo surged, gathering the strength of the seven war patterns, as a three-thousand-kilometer warhammer suddenly crashed down.
Boom!
Everything under the warhammer encircled by the seven war pattern halos collapsed, and the terrifying strike shook the world, causing the sands to crumble, instantly dissipating the sprawling tentacles of demon gas.
“Courting death.”
A thousand-meter-tall Alec sneered coldly, his eight arms reaching into the Abyssal Demon Domain behind him, causing the domain to tremble and space to shatter as he pulled out a two-thousand-meter-long magic spear.
Enveloped in a demon dragon-like swirl of demon gas, a dark red Abyssal chain coiled around it, with black Thunder rumbling and emitting the terrifying pressure of two higher-order laws.
Boom!
Channeling the Power of the Abyss, the magic spear encircled by two higher-order laws pierced through, clashing with the golden warhammer surrounded by the halo of seven war patterns.
Boom! A thunderous noise shook the world in an instant, as the terrifying impact caused space to shatter, forming a black shockwave sweeping across heaven and earth, making them quiver.
“Kill them!”
“Charge!”
As a great battle erupted in the sky, the soldiers below encircled in golden light, mounting Violent Dragons, charged towards the surging demon gas and a multitude of Abyssal creatures.
Instantly, a gruesome battle broke out, and as tens of thousands of Abyssal creatures faced off against those Violent Dragon Warriors, even more monstrosities, drawing the rolling demon gas, stormed into the cities behind them.
In an instant, buildings collapsed, and different races were torn to shreds and devoured, their blood dyeing the Earth red.
The eyes of the soldiers engaged in combat widened in rage, while in the heavens above, Larkin and another’s murderous aura surged, but they were promptly suppressed by two Abyssal War Demons.
Furiously, the Titan-level Jerold proclaimed, “Today, I shall exterminate you all.”
Boom boom boom! Golden light and vibrations followed as a rain of golden swords descended from the heavens, instantly annihilating tens of thousands of Abyssal creatures that had breached the city.
Boom!
Just as Jerold was distracted, the magic spear wrapped in terrifying radiance knocked aside the golden warhammer, striking his chest and shattering seven war pattern haloes.
Immediately followed by the explosive burst of the powerful Abyssal Law and the Law of Dark Annihilation Thunder, the terrible release of energy forced Jerold back tens of kilometers, his aura boiling over.
Alec, eight arms wielding the spear, standing proud atop the endless Dark Demon Air, calmly stated, “Your opponent is this king, be careful, or next time you’ll lose your head.”
Boom! The great battle erupted once again.
Alec, at the Mythical Peak, wielded two types of higher-order Abyssal Laws, the Higher-order Law of Dark Annihilation Thunder and a War Law that defied the heavens, along with the descending Power of the Abyss from behind him, his combat power nearly matched a mid-period Great Demon King.
With his powerful True Demon body bestowed by his Demon God bloodline, he held his own against Jerold in combat, shattering space and setting off golden explosions.
The terrifying aftermath of the battle forced Larkin and other Mythical Powerhouses to keep retreating, with many Violent Dragon Warriors and Abyssal creatures hurled about, and the yellow sand covering the sky as if Doomsday had arrived.
As the combat went on, Jerold’s expression grew more solemn.
Though he was at the Titan mid-period, each of the seven inherited War Patterns he controlled was only equivalent to a Lower Law, rendering his combat power rather average.
Initially, he broke through to the Titan Realm with the help of a combination of seven War Patterns, comparable to a Higher-order Law.
Now, engaged in a fierce battle with this supremely talented demon king, while he did not falter, he also couldn’t unleash greater combat power to heavily injure the adversary instantly.
Meanwhile, as the battle raged on, Alec became more and more excited, his dark red Abyssal demonic aura swirling around him, with his three heads emitting a chaotic, deep sound.
“Your strength is commendable, but you are destined to serve as nourishment for this king’s breakthrough to Abyss Great Demon King.”
“`
Boom! Jerold swung his warhammer, pushing back the demonic aura, and growled coldly, “You’re courting death, today I will surely reduce you to ashes.”
Boom! In an instant, a terrifying power erupted from Jerold, who didn’t want to drag things out. He directly summoned his true trump card.
A golden war order emerged from within him, radiating circles of radiance. The invisible, pervasive aura of power startled Alec, “Rule power.”
Boom, boom, boom! The golden war order split into seven, transforming into seven giant golden phantoms, each tens of kilometers tall. They descended and sealed the area in all directions. In an instant, the demonic aura between heaven and earth dissipated, and Alec’s aura plummeted.
His laws, his talent, all were sealed by the golden war order, and his aura dropped to that of a regular demon king at his peak.
“You actually possess a forbidden weapon with a sealing legacy!”
The moment Jerold summoned the Inherited War Order, he raised the destructive warhammer high and, amidst a sky filled with golden light shining down from above, suppressed space and hammered Alec into the earth.
Boom! The heavens broke and the earth cracked open, the terrifying strike causing the yellow sand to crumble and forming a shockwave spanning tens of kilometers. An endless raging wind carrying sand and gravel roared up into the sky.
The terrible strength nearly collapsed the Abyssal Demon Domain itself. Hundreds of thousands of abyssal monsters were annihilated by the aftermath, the spectacle so alarming that it quieted the entire field.
But just then, from the shattered depths of the earth, a cold and angry voice rang out, “You actually shattered my true body, I will definitely kill you.”
Boom! Below, a terrifying aura erupted.
Under the seal of laws and talents, Alec still had the power of his bloodline. The cold chant echoed through the skies: “Si Yu Luo Mong Xiang Xue, sacrifice the past, Summon the ancient presence…”
Boom! The golden warhammer was sent flying by a powerful force.
Two shattered heads and six broken arms with half of a true body in ruins, Alec slowly flew upwards, behind him a corner of a transparent long river appeared.
Upon the river of time, a version of Alec clad in black armor and a kilometer tall stepped out thunderously.
Boom!
Two demon kings from different times existed simultaneously, and instantly, an intense force of repulsion from the present burst forth but was blocked by the more towering phantom behind Alec.
Unlike Augusta, who had summoned his past self before, Alec had this time sacrificed the past to summon a fleeting future.
And the Alec from the future, with a stronger aura than his present self, and because he’s from the future and hence without any reservations, directly burned his laws and the origin of his bloodline to erupt in power.
Boom! Nine magic spears, each three kilometers long, fused into one and stretched across the heavens and earth. With one strike, the Violent Dragon War God was sent flying.
…
Meanwhile, the sky over Blue Star was gradually getting brighter.
In the Plane World, Jack Clark, who had cultivated all night, slowly opened his eyes, and the aura emanating from his body became even heavier.
With the addition of the Soul Law, five Higher-order, and one Supreme Law tempering him, his already extremely robust true body grew even more terrifying.
Boom! As Jack rose slowly from the Soul Throne, the entire heaven and earth seemed to tremble.
Feeling the terrifying power within his body, a faint smile appeared on Jack’s face. Then, he calmly faded his aura away, with a mere thought disappearing, he reappeared in the outside world.
“Greetings to the Lord of the Throne.”
“Greetings to the Divine Martial Throne.”
As Jack appeared out of nowhere, the soldiers and High-Ranking Powerhouses standing guard all bowed respectfully.
“Mhm, there’s no need for formalities,” Jack nodded slightly.
But as he said this, when he stepped and flickered past those soldiers, appearing in front of the cracks in the blink of an eye, everyone bowed respectfully.
Though Jack was only seventeen, his king-level cultivation inspired awe, and now only some old acquaintances and friends could be somewhat more relaxed around him.
And this relaxation came about because Jack’s cultivation speed was too quick, breaking through to king-level in just one year, catching people like Justin Welan and others off guard, who had yet to adjust their concepts and attitudes.
Otherwise, when facing a king normally, whether in tone or attitude, everyone would need to show the utmost respect—this is the reverence due to the powerful.
Just like how Jack had treated those king-level figures when he first broke through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1128 - 1128 456 Destruction of the Abyss The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1128: Chapter 456 Destruction of the Abyss, The Invincible Jack Clark Chapter 1128: Chapter 456 Destruction of the Abyss, The Invincible Jack Clark Jack Clark reached the edge of the crack and looked toward the middle-aged man who wore glasses, whose aura was only at the Sixth-layer Heaven level, “Has it been stabilized?”
The middle-aged man, whose cultivation was not high but who was responsible for reinforcing the Spatial Channel, respectfully replied, “For now, we have completed the first phase of solidification; it can steadily support the entry and exit of Mythical-level beings.”
Jack Clark nodded, “That will suffice. Let’s pause the second phase for now.”
“Yes, my lord.”
This plan to solidify the World Rift into a stable pathway is very resource-intensive and laborious, so what comes next is to see if the other side holds any developmental value.
If there’s no value in development, after subduing and relocating the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, Jack Clark will take action to destroy the crack.
While saying this, Jack Clark turned his head to look at the pitch-black rift that resembled an abyss a few hundred meters away, then his brow twinged slightly, causing him to pause.
In that mysterious connection, the Void-Striking Heart’s Eye sensed a trace of danger coming from the crack, or rather, from beyond the crack.
Although the fleeting feeling of danger was faint, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed in an instant.
Was it because the Violent Dragon War God was stronger than he had anticipated, to the extent that even he would have to engage in a tough battle, or had something unexpected occurred on the other side?
As Jack Clark hazily felt that something was amiss, on the other side of the crack and more than 700 kilometers away from the Kavadola Tribe Oasis, the battle had already ended.
The largest oasis in the desert had vanished, and where the Ancient Desert City once stood had turned into a crater over ten kilometers in diameter, the surrounding sand crystallized, the impact irradiated for over a hundred kilometers.
Alec stood a kilometer tall above the crater, treading on the Void, surrounded by a rolling Dark Red Glow that spiraled around him, like a World-Destroying Demon King.
However, this Demon King, with three heads and eight arms, was in some disarray at the moment; half of his True Body was shattered, four arms lost, and his expression extremely ugly.
This Violent Dragon War God was fierce and unyielding. Having his True Body blasted apart repeatedly by Alec of both the present and future, until only 30% of his Origin remained and he was about to be suppressed, he chose to self-destruct.
The self-destruction of a mid-period Titan burning his True Body, Divine Soul, and Laws’ Origin was terrifyingly powerful, nearly destroying the Abyssal Demon Domain formed by the Abyssal Descent.
As a result of the explosion, Alec’s future body was ripped apart, and half of his current True Body shattered, losing 10% of his Origin — a heavy loss indeed.
Beyond that, the other two Violent Dragon Kings, spurred by Jerold’s explosion, were also invigorated and chose to self-destruct.
After the successive blasts, two Abyssal War Demons were left with their True Bodies severely damaged; millions of Abyss creatures that had been accumulated over the years were decimated by over a million.
For Alec, the Son of the Demon God and an Imperial Highness who had enjoyed a smooth sailing cultivation journey up to this point, this was the first time he had suffered such a catastrophic loss.
Looking down at the crater where not even bones remained, Alec held a Golden War Order in his hand, his expression cold, “From today onward, the Violent Dragon civilization ceases to exist.”
Boom! The aura of Alec, who had exterminated a civilization, burst forth, shooting into the sky, engulfing a two hundred-kilometer area into a Dark Red Abyssal Demon Domain.
An instant later, screams of agony rose in the distance.
They belonged to the elite soldiers of The Three Great Tribes; at this moment, their War Pattern formations were already broken by over a million Abyss creatures. Now, as the Abyss Demonic Aura surged backward, they trembled continuously, black patterns beginning to surface on their bodies.
Boom!
Within the center of the Demon Domain, the Earth crumbled, and a black Demon King Pillar, a hundred meters thick and three kilometers high, surged from the Dark Red Radiance into the sky, wrapped in demon patterns that looked like black Demon Dragons.
Alec sat on the Demon King Pillar, below which a sea of over two million Violent Dragon Alien Tribe creatures turned monsters gathered, issuing unintelligible hisses in a terrifying scene.
Hum!
The demon patterns on the Demon King Pillar vibrated, emitting Dark Red Radiance that enveloped those Abyss creatures, streaks of pure red and black light rose from the bodies of those monsters.
This sacrifice of flesh and soul, transformed into the Power of the Abyss, gathered like an ocean, surging around the Demon King Pillar and causing Alec’s aura to skyrocket instantly.
The bloodline strength, magical power, and laws’ origin that he had lost were recovering at a remarkable speed.
Demonizing all life and sacrificing for the Abyss was a talent of the Demon God Bloodline, which is also why The Purgatory Family was so powerful.
With countless lives and the land tainted and demonized, The Purgatory Family had numerous high-order demonic generals, demon kings, and Great Demon Kings, including more than twenty Supreme Demon God-level beings.
This was why the Sky-based God King once said that The Purgatory Family would one day be devoured by their own actions.
As they continually plundered Heaven and Earth, demonized everything, and sacrificed billions of lives for their own growth, one day, the ‘awakening’ mythical world would react.
… … …
“Did Jim and the others come by last night?”
At the temporary dining hall set up on the hillside, Jack Clark, who had just sat down after checking on the situation with the crack, was informed of this unexpected news by Mathilda Ward opposite him.
Mathilda Ward, with her silver hair like snow, nodded slightly, a hint of a smile in her eyes, “Yes, your brother and a student named Justin Welan took an airplane over yesterday and took many photos with that Violent Dragon King.”
“They seemed worried that you’d reprimand them, so without waiting for me to invite them for a late-night meal, they flew back last night.”
“Those two guys,” Jack Clark shook his head and chuckled.
Following that, Jack Clark and Mathilda Ward chatted over breakfast about the handling of those different races.
At this moment, Valentine Leach’s adjutant hurried over, gave a slight bow to Jack Clark, and respectfully said, “My lord, a group of journalists from the Federation’s Propaganda Department wishes to meet with you.”
“Journalists from the Propaganda Department, what do they want with me?” Jack Clark was somewhat puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1129 - 1129 456 Destruction of the Abyss The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1129: Chapter 456 Destruction of the Abyss, The Invincible Jack Clark_2 Chapter 1129: Chapter 456 Destruction of the Abyss, The Invincible Jack Clark_2 The adjutant said respectfully, “They would like to follow you into the mythical world and make a tracking recording of the campaign to subdue the Violent Dragon civilization.”
“There will also be a special interview with you to learn about your cultivation journey, which will be compiled into a collection and broadcast throughout the Federation.”
“Ahem! Isn’t that a bit of an exaggeration?” Jack Clark coughed dryly.
At just seventeen, having a personal album interview and being a Federation-wide promotion was even for him a bit embarrassing.
Mathilda Ward smiled across from him, “Not at all exaggerated. With your proof of myth within a year and the records of directly and indirectly slaying more than ten demon kings, your achievements are enough to shock the whole world.”
“It’s just that, Jack Clark, you have progressed too quickly, spending most of your time in cultivation, so some of your perceptions have yet to shift.”
“Under normal conditions, every time someone in the Federation makes a breakthrough to king-level, there’s an entire Federation-wide promotion and a Throne’s Banquet and Councilor Authorization Ceremony held.”
“However, this time with the Blue Star Anomaly and the re-emergence of the Civilization War on the Frontline Battlefield, the Federation has postponed your Throne’s Banquet.”
“The meaning of this propaganda move from the Propaganda Department is probably to use you as a role model for an all-out promotion.”
“By then, the martial spirit of the entire Federation will undoubtedly become even stronger. With the increased concentration of Heavenly Energy from this Impact, it’s estimated to enhance two to threefold.”
“In such conditions, the cultivation environment will be better, more people with cultivation talents will emerge, cultivation speeds will increase, and resource development will be ramped up once the Outer Development Department stabilizes the rear.”
“With all aspects improving, in the next few years, the Federation will experience a surge of cultivators, with the growth rate of cultivators expected to double.”
Watching Mathilda’s growing excitement, Jack Clark simply shook his head slightly.
The situation was indeed improving for the Human Race in every aspect, but the problem was that humans needed sufficient time to grow, and The Purgatory Family wouldn’t grant humanity that much time.
Added to that was the prelude to the Mythical Impact that had already begun… Jack Clark suddenly felt a pressing urgency.
He needed to grow stronger, faster, strong enough to cope with the Second Mythical Impact, to face the full-frontal assault of The Purgatory Family.
Thinking this, Jack Clark flatly refused, “Tell those journalists from the Propaganda Department that the situation across the rift has changed, and it’s not suitable for tracking recordings.”
“…Yes, Your Majesty.” The adjutant was taken aback, not expecting Jack Clark to forgo such an opportunity for historic propaganda.
After the adjutant left, Mathilda Ward glanced at Kavadola patrolling the area of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe and voiced her confusion, “Jack Clark, is there something wrong with Kavadola?”
Jack Clark shook his head, “Kavadola is fine, it should be that something has changed over there; I vaguely sensed a hint of danger earlier.”
Mathilda’s expression turned serious, realizing that even Jack Clark sensed danger, “Should we invite Heavenly King Ares for a visit?”
Jack Clark shook his head, “No need. We require someone to hold the fort here. Besides, I am confident I can handle whatever problems may arise.”
“…Alright then.”
Soon after breakfast, Jack Clark and Mathilda, along with Kavadola, met in front of the rift. With a slight nod from Jack Clark, he entered first.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark entered, the Rift Channel that should have been stable enough for Mythical-level entities to pass through started to shake violently, distorting as if he had entered the belly of a colossal beast.
This scene caused many onlookers to gasp.
Because this indicated that Jack Clark, only in the early stages of Myth, had already exceeded the boundaries of the Legendary Realm, causing the rift to shake uncontrollably, unable to bear his presence –It was terrifying.
At the edge of the Oasis Forest where the Karola Tribe resided, thousands of torches burned, lighting up the night.
At that time, over ten thousand members of the Violent Dragon People were converging, lining up under the demand of the soldiers, casting anxious glances at the trembling Rift Channel.
Under the gaze of these different races, a black-haired young man of less than 2 meters tall slowly emerged from the depths of the pathway, exuding a somber and heavy aura.
Beholding Jack Clark descending from another dimension, the elite soldiers maintaining order promptly dismounted their Giant Beasts, kneeling on one knee and speaking respectfully, “Greetings to the Upper God.”
Upper God! The ordinary members of the Violent Dragon People were startled and quickly knelt down in fear, “Greetings to the great Upper God.”
Behind them, the rift shook again, and the hundred-meter tall Kavadola and Mathilda came out to stand behind Jack Clark.
“Kavadola, have them all rise and then immediately pass through the rift to the other side,” Jack Clark said before looking towards the sky and adding slowly, “Something has happened there.”
In Jack Clark’s eyes, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils appeared, his terrifying gaze piercing hundreds of kilometers, witnessing the rolling demon gas and the massive figure that appeared indistinct in the distance.
Following Jack Clark’s gaze, although Kavadola couldn’t see the scene more than 700 kilometers away, he similarly felt an ominous premonition.
“That’s where Jerold’s War God Tribe is located, the largest Oasis in this barren world… Could it be…” As the thought crossed his mind, Kavadola bellowed out an order.
“Tarkud, immediately have everyone pass through the channel, gather on the other side, and wait for instructions.”
“Yes.”
At once, the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe became restless, and then under the urgent prodding of the soldiers, they moved en masse through the channel.
Meanwhile, in Jack Clark’s hands, the dazzling golden light blazed fiercely, compressed into a half-meter sized sphere shining like it was made of pure gold, radiating a blinding radiance.
With a temperature of a million degrees Celsius, equivalent to a full-force strike from a Mythical Powerhouse wielding the energy of higher-order Fire Law, the terrifyingly intense heat being radiated was causing the space around Jack Clark to shatter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1130 - 1130 456 Destroying the Abyss the Invincible
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1130: Chapter 456: Destroying the Abyss, the Invincible Jack Clark_3 Chapter 1130: Chapter 456: Destroying the Abyss, the Invincible Jack Clark_3 The terrifying energy fluctuation caused Kavadola to subconsciously take a step back, while Mathilda Ward’s body shimmered with silver radiance, unleashing her domain to fend off the invisible destructive high-temperature radiation.
Jack Clark’s body crackled with streaks of blue thunder, forming hundreds of meters long thunder dragons, whose electric arcs crackled as they charged towards the golden fireball.
Boom boom boom!!
As the two higher-order law energies tangled and collided, they set off an appalling vibration and roaring. The pervasive destructive aura made the ordinary Violent Dragon People’s legs go weak.
