Soon, a pure blue thunderball appeared in Jack’s hand, with dazzling golden light flowing inside it.
Jack looked at Mathilda, “Sister Ilisa, traces of The Purgatory Family have appeared here, and the rest of the Violent Dragon alien tribe should have been wiped out.”
“I’ll go over with Kavadola to check it out soon. We need you to stay here until we’re certain of the situation, to prevent any Purgatory True Demons from sneaking into Blue Star.”
“I’ve sealed the power of a normal strike in here. If anything changes and you can’t hold them off, retreat into the cracks and then activate the power inside to destroy the pathway.”
“Destroy the pathway? What about you guys then?” Mathilda was startled.
Jack smiled slightly, “Don’t worry, Sister Ilisa, even if the pathway is destroyed, I can still make it back safely. Now, we shouldn’t delay any further, let’s go take a look.”
Boom! Without waiting for Mathilda to speak, Jack transformed into a beam of golden light that pierced the sky, instantly crossing tens of kilometers at more than 20 times the speed of sound and vanishing from sight.
Seeing this, Kavadola hastily followed suit, surrounded by a purple glow, streaking across the sky like a shooting star.
In just two minutes, Jack crossed more than 700 kilometers, appearing above ten thousand meters altitude.
Looking towards the overpowering dark red Demon Domain a hundred kilometers away, Jack licked his lips, excitement flashing in his eyes: “Such strong Power of the Abyss, jackpot.”
For Jack, serving as a Hell Envoy, slaying other agents from the Supreme Plane and devouring that part of the descending power from the Supreme Plane would grant him vast amounts of Origin.
As for the terrifying pressure emanating from the depths of the Demon Domain, comparable to that of a Great Demon King, Jack disregarded it completely.
With his current strength, as long as his enemies weren’t at the level of a late-period or peak Great Demon King, he could overlook the rest.
Then a purple radiance sparkled behind him, accompanied by the roaring of a sonic boom, as Kavadola caught up.
Looking at the sky-obscuring demon gas in the distance and the rolling Demon Domain full of Abyssal creatures with traces of the Violent Dragon alien tribe, Kavadola was completely outraged.
“Jerold, where are you?” Boom! In his roar, Kavadola’s dazzling purple light burst forth, forming a purple halo that covered several kilometers.
The intense murderous aura instantly alarmed Alec, who was in the midst of a breakthrough within the Abyssal Demon Domain.
Seated high on the Demon King Pillar, Alec slightly raised his head to look into the distance, his gaze sweeping over the hundred-meter-tall Kavadola, then settling on Jack next to him.
“To think that the Human Race would appear here,” Alec said with some surprise, slowly standing up.
Boom!
The dark red demon gas roiled and shook, splitting open like the Sky Curtain, revealing countless Abyssal creatures.
Above these Abyssal creatures stood four 200-meter-tall Abyssal War Demons, bowing respectfully, under them a thousand-meter-tall, three-headed, six-armed Purgatory True Demon slowly emerged.
At that moment, Alec’s aura boiled over, just one step away from breaking through to become a Great Demon King. His terrifying Abyssal Power condensed into a shadow several thousand meters tall, its oppressive force shaking Heaven and Earth.
Gazing at Kavadola and Jack Clark, Alec’s three heads all revealed a ferocious smile, his voice deep, “Merely two beings from alien races in the early and mid mything stages dare to stand before this king.”
“This is perfect, for I am just a bit short of achieving the stature of an Abyss Great Demon King. Adding your sacrifices should suffice for my breakthrough.”
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “Is that so? I’m afraid you might regret encountering me soon.”
Boom!
A wildly ferocious Power Explosion burst from Jack’s body. Amidst the blazing golden light, his figure expanded, assuming the form of a three-faced, six-armed True Body that reached 300 meters tall.
Black dragon horns grew from his head, his body became covered with black and red Dragon Scales, and a long, knife-like tail emerged from behind him.
In an instant, a terribly overbearing aura spread out, the sky shook, the Earth trembled, and countless objects lost gravity, floating in the terrifying power’s aura.
The space around Jack was under such unbearable strain that it began to crack and shatter, creating a kilometer-wide dark area.
In this domain, light, energy, and all matter collapsed, twisted, creating a horror-filled scene.
With the enhancement of one-fold strength from the Ancient Dueling Arena and the fifth Tempering of Soul Law from the previous night, Jack’s flesh had become almost terrifyingly strong.
Now, in his Demon God Emperor Dragon Form and fully unleashing his strength, the entire Heaven and Earth wobbled, collapsing the Void and forming an absolute domain of Distorted Power around him.
His formidable presence, comparable to that of a Heavenly King, made Kavadola swallow nervously.
What a relief that Jack did not reveal his true form when they clashed yesterday; otherwise, Kavadola might have been obliterated with a single strike, wiped from existence—too terrifying to contemplate.
But it didn’t end there. Jack Clark’s Blood Colored Eye in the brow of his left Demon-God Facade opened, and Hell descended.
A ten-kilometer-long blood-red crack tore open in the Firmament above, with endless blood light gushing like fresh blood, painting the Heaven and Earth red.

chapters.title: Chapter 1131 - 1131 456 Destroying the Abyss The Invincible
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1131: Chapter 456: Destroying the Abyss, The Invincible Jack Clark_4 Chapter 1131: Chapter 456: Destroying the Abyss, The Invincible Jack Clark_4 Boom! Jack Clark’s aura surged once again, his body shrouded in a blood light, as a pair of red dragon horns grew from his head, the red flames burning and transforming into a crown.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The Hell Plane covering half the sky collided with the Abyssal Demon Domain, the tremendous strength causing the space in between to shatter, forming black cracks that spread in all directions.
Within the Sea of Blood Hell, countless Void Creatures and Giant Beasts struggled, and in the Demon Domain, numerous creatures of the Abyss hissed and roared, as if two supreme worlds were about to go to war.
Dragging down Hell, and stepping into the Demon God Emperor Dragon Form, Jack Clark took a step forward, shattering the space, creating a hundred-kilometer-long black pathway appearing above Alec’s head.
Boom!
The War Halberd swept across the sky, sealing an endless blood-red world within it; surrounded by golden and blue Law Chains, space collapsed under the black halberd, exploding like a spreading dark sky curtain.
The intangible Destructive Aura made the land within hundreds of kilometers tremble, and facing this attack directly, Alec’s form sunk, immediately followed by an enraged roar.
“Ten Directions Demon Territory, Kill!”
The Abyssal Demon Domain, extending over two hundred kilometers, erupted into action. Nine Dark Demon Spears, each three thousand meters long, shot up amidst the rolling demon gas, merging into one in Alec’s hands.
In an instant, a mountainous black spear tip emerged from the Void, its terrifying aura meeting the Heaven and Earth-destroying Heaven-opening Halberd.
Boom!
The moment the Dark Demon Spear and the Heaven-opening Halberd collided, Heaven and Earth shook, the darkness that destroyed all exploded, and space within tens of kilometers collapsed, everything bursting into Chaos.
Amidst the violent waves of Destructive Aura, the Demon Spear crumbled bit by bit, and the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, over a thousand meters long, tore through everything with the momentum to split Heaven and Earth as it descended.
Boom!
Alec’s complexion changed drastically, he parried with his spear horizontally; he then felt an indescribably Terrifying Power, and his form crashed down from the sky with a loud bang.
The ground within tens of kilometers exploded, forming a ring-shaped shockwave, countless chunks of dirt and gravel mixed with sand shot into the sky, reaching tens of thousands of meters before slowly falling back down.
Alec, who had annihilated the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, slain six Mythical Powerhouses, and killed a Mid-Mythical Stage Titan, was directly smashed into the Earth by Jack Clark’s frontal Halberd strike.
This was his strength right now.
For Jack Clark, who had the Divine Power ‘Supreme Vacuum,’ the stronger his Basic Physical Body, the more horrifying the increase in his overall combat power.
And facing the strength of a Mid-Stage Great Demon King from The Purgatory Family, Jack Clark did not waste words, directly entering his most powerful form and preparing for a swift conclusion.
So, as he smashed Alec into the Earth with one Halberd strike, Jack Clark, with six arms wielding halberds and his body wrapped in endless flames, Thunderflame, and blood-colored light, unfolded into a world of destruction.
Boom!
A thirty-kilometer diameter World of Destruction ‘slowly’ descended, the intangible Destructive Aura made even Kavadola over a hundred kilometers away feel tingling on his scalp and his body tremble.
Just then, from deep within a pit of tens of kilometers, a terrifying bloodline Aura erupted, as the chant of The Purgatory Family echoed between Heaven and Earth.
“Si yi lu mo xian, xiān jì guò dù, zhào huàn mèi lì xiàng lín…”
Facing Jack Clark’s world-ending strike, Alec decisively burned the freshly recovered Demon God bloodline power, sacrificing the past to summon the future.
Boom! A transparent river of time emerged amid Heaven and Earth; Alec, also in black armor and a thousand meters tall, stepped out from the river above.
The Heaven and Earth trembled instantly, a fierce temporal-rejection force from the present burst out but was blocked by an even taller and unclear silhouette.
No sooner had the future Alec appeared than a layer of black and red fire burned upon him, his aura skyrocketing tenfold instantly, and the Abyssal Demon Domain behind him went into an uproar.
“I sacrifice everything, requesting the great and supreme Abyss to descend and bury this World!”
Boom!
In the future, Alec had burned fifty percent of his Origin to invoke the mysteries of the Abyssal Law, which made the dark red Demon Domain tremble, as a dark Demon Claw of ten thousand meters reach out.
The moment the Hand of the Abyss touched the world-shattering explosion, dazzling golden red light burst forth, as if a genuine world exploded and shattered in an instant.
Boom! The heavens collapsed, and the earth shattered.
An infinite release of destructive energy shone brightly, illuminating the entire ‘world’ of the forbidden area, the terrifying energy shock left Mathilda Ward tens of kilometers away utterly astounded.
In the center of the earth-shattering explosion, the Hand of the Abyss crumbled, the future Alec’s true body exploded, and deep within the shattered earth, Alec coughed up blood, his face revealing horror.
Could such terrifying power be unleashed by an Early Myth Human Race member!?
Had it sensed wrong before, or was this the true strength of the Human Race, not at all like those front-line demon kings had said—ordinary, and not worth a single blow?
Roar!
At that moment, from the roiling Abyssal Demon Domain in the distance, four Abyssal War Demons that had been demonized roared, releasing mighty mid-Mythical aura as they soared into the sky and rushed towards Jack Clark.
Seeing this, Jack, who was preparing to continue his attack and grant Alec no opportunity to catch his breath, his gaze turned cold.
Boom, boom, boom!!
A Golden Red Battle Halberd shadow of two thousand meters swept across the sky like a mountain range, and with a single strike, the true bodies of the four Abyssal War Demons were blasted apart.
Right then, the shadow of the halberd exploded, turning into scorching golden flames and bursts of blue thunder, creating a thunderflame area of several kilometers.
Instantly, the four War Demons shrieked as their true bodies were continuously eroded away in the destructive region filled with two Higher-order Laws.
One halberd crushing four mythical beings—this sight made Kavadola in the distance swallow hard. An Upper God’s combat ability was too incredible, and this was just the Early Myth stage?
However, with the obstruction from the four Abyssal War Demons, Alec finally found a moment’s respite and transformed into a black demon light, rushing back into the depths of the Abyssal Demon Domain.
Boom! The Demon Domain trembled, turning into rolling Demon Clouds that rushed wildly to the distance, covering everything.
Alec had fled.
Just one clash with Jack had left it wounded by a halberd strike, and the second attack burst its future body, causing a backlash in its bloodline.
Continuing the battle against such a terrifying enemy was pure suicide. It wasn’t a demon king—no, even an average Great Demon King couldn’t face such a monster.
“Do you think you can escape?”
An icy voice echoed between heaven and earth, followed by Jack releasing a terrifying power that could collapse the Void, the aeons, the world, shaking Heaven and Earth.
In the Void, chants of “strength, strength, Supreme True Strength” faintly rang out, a paean under the terrifying power’s aura that made this World and the forbidden area tremble.
“This power, the Supreme Law!” Alec’s voice of despair came from the Void.
Boom!
The space above the Abyssal Demon Domain shattered into a Destruction Black Hole, and a black halberd infused with five Higher-order Laws and Supreme Hell’s strength emerged.
Everything was annihilated beneath the black halberd containing supreme strength, and even time and space seemed to freeze at that moment.
In Alec’s gaze, the entire world crumbled under this strike—whether it was the Abyssal Demon Domain or Alec himself perched on the Demon King Pillar.
The formidable Demon King’s True Form, the Demon Pillar, everything was effortlessly crushed and destroyed.
Boom!
A single halberd stroke tore the earth open, creating a fissure canyon over two hundred kilometers long and several kilometers wide, with countless gravel soaring into the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1132 - 1132 457 The Rich Returns on Investment
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1132: Chapter 457: The Rich Returns on Investment, Preparations Before the Descent (8K) Chapter 1132: Chapter 457: The Rich Returns on Investment, Preparations Before the Descent (8K) The land deep within was crumbling, golden flames raging, thunder roaring, and all things corroded by the dark void. Added to this were the suppression of the soul and the eradication of death.
Under the fusion of the Law of Strength, Jack Clark already possessed a part of the terrifying power that came with law fusion well in advance, and it was a fusion of the five Higher-order Laws no less.
The power of the Supreme Law was so terrifying that Alec only had time to let out a miserable scream before his true body was blasted into nothingness.
In an instant, law disintegrated, Heaven and Earth intersected above the Firmament to form a dazzling Blood Moon, which then slowly fell down.
Above the Blood Moon, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, his human body with dragon horns and a dragon tail, exuding an aura that crushed the Void and heaven and earth.
In fact, Jack Clark had estimated that his current Demon God Emperor Dragon Form would rank in the mid-phase of a normal Heavenly King, but when invoking the Law of Strength, the burst of power was comparable to a Heavenly King in the late phase.
But under normal conditions, it’s impossible for someone in the late phase to instantly annihilate someone in the mid-phase, at most they would suppress and then gradually wear away the true body.
Yet Jack Clark’s intrinsic strength was too terrifying. Under the integration with the Supreme Law and the five Higher-order Laws, he wielded absolute suppression over people weaker than him.
As long as an enemy’s true body was destroyed, there was no chance for them to reconvene. Their soul and Life Origin would immediately be suppressed by the Supreme Law and eroded by the five Higher-order Laws.
Especially the Soul Law and Death Law, whose inherent traits nearly drove Alec to despair.
At the same time, the four Abyssal War Demons that Jack Clark had obliterated with a single halberd strike also had their true bodies completely dissipated under the erosion of the Great Sun Heaven Flame and the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder.
Immediately, four Blood Moons appeared in the Firmament, falling down, shocking Kavadola who was over a hundred kilometers away.
In just that short time, four Mythical beings, one of whom was comparable to the Titan Level, were suppressed and obliterated by Jack Clark. Was this the kind of strength a being at the early stage of Myth should possess?
Indeed, it’s the homeland of the Upper Gods, the Race called Human. Too terrifying.
Boom! The projection of Hell around Jack Clark erupted, turning into a sweeping blood light that submerged the collapsing Abyssal Demon Domain at the fall of Alec.
In an instant, the collision of two Supreme Plane forces caused Heaven and Earth to shake, the blood light became even more dazzling, with a tall blood-colored phantom vaguely visible between heaven and earth, its gaze shifting slightly towards Jack Clark.
In that terrifying look, there was a hint of surprise.
It seemed to marvel that this Hell Messenger, who had just assumed his role ‘recently,’ had already twice invoked the Power of Hell to devour projections from the Supreme Plane.
And when the projection of Alvaron, Lord of Hell, made its brief appearance, Kavadola felt an incomprehensible terror descend, shaking his divine soul and trembling continuously.
However, fortunately, the projection of Alvaron was only fleeting, so quick that Kavadola questioned if it was just an illusion.
Huff, huff!! It’s definitely not an illusion.
Kavadola breathed heavily, his complexion ashen. For a Mythical King, this was nearly impossible, as they no longer needed to breathe.
At that time, the blood light retracted massively and disappeared into the third eye on the Demon-God Facade to Jack Clark’s left.
In those red eyes containing a Blood Sea Hell, seventeen white-light emanating World Origins appeared, much to Jack Clark’s own surprise.
The sacrifice and devouring of countless lives seemed to have drawn on Abyssal Power from the Supreme Abyss even more than Black Violent Ape Kofder.
Then, Jack Clark reached out with his left hand towards the center of the wildly raging laws below, and gently grasped in the air. Instantly, three beams of light shot up from below.
Under Jack Clark’s full-force strike, Alec’s space artifacts were also destroyed; countless collected resources, items all vanished into spatial cracks or obliterated by the exploding laws.
What remained were no ordinary items; among them was a Golden War Order, a ferocious-looking, single-horned Giant Beast skull, and a few meters long deadwood.
Having stored the three items in his Storage Space, Jack Clark finally looked down.
At that time, the Demon Domain had collapsed, but the more than a million Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, having been demonized, were still scattered around, wandering aimlessly in the desert winds.
These Abyssal creatures, after being demonized, retained only the instinct of bloodthirsty madness, becoming quasi-living beings that would evolve by devouring the flesh and blood of living creatures, eventually turning into even more powerful Abyssal Demons.
Therefore, leaving them be would only be a nuisance.
The dazzling golden light on Jack Clark’s War Halberd shone as beams of golden radiance with lengths reaching five hundred meters burst forth, igniting ear-piercing sonic booms.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Earth erupted, and mushroom clouds of a kilometer in diameter rose continually, and amidst the scorching flames, Abyssal creatures turned into ash, extending over an area of more than a hundred kilometers.
In a rampage of unrestrained bombing, the remaining million-plus Abyssal creatures turned to ash, leaving behind hundreds of kilometer-wide craters on the Earth, the bottoms roiling with hot magma while the surrounding sands crystalized for kilometers around.
And Jack Clark, having instantly unleashed hundreds of ‘full strength’ strikes, appeared calm, as if he had expended no effort at all.
This scene once again stunned Kavaduo, who was flying towards Jack Clark, and some Death Priests lurking in the distance.
Was this man a monster, or was Law Divine Power inexhaustible?
In just a moment, he wiped out more than a million Senior Demonic Creatures, if this killing speed were brought onto the Frontline Battlefield with no peer of the same realm to restrain him, Jack Clark could slay billions from the Purgatory Demon Race in one day.
Approaching Jack Clark, Kavaduo said excitedly, “Thank you, my Lord, for avenging our race. With your unmatched strength, it is my greatest honor to follow you in this life.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1133 - 1133 457 The Rich Returns on Investment
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1133: Chapter 457: The Rich Returns on Investment, Preparations Before the Descent (8K)_2 Chapter 1133: Chapter 457: The Rich Returns on Investment, Preparations Before the Descent (8K)_2 Standing three hundred meters tall, Jack Clark slightly lowered his head to look at Kavadola, who was only as tall as his thigh, and spoke in a deep voice, resonant as thunder, “There are still some fish that slipped through the net. Go assist Sister Ilisa at the rear and prevent them from escaping into the pathway.”
Still some fish that slipped through the net…
Kavadola paused, a fierce killing intent flashing in his eyes, “Damn it, if I find them, I’ll crush them into meat paste.”
Not daring to delay, Kavadola turned into a streak of purple radiance that crossed the sky; meanwhile, Jack Clark turned to look at a sand dune over two hundred kilometers away.
More than ten Death Priests lurking there sweated profusely, their bodies becoming translucent and transparent as they exerted full strength to blend in with their surroundings, daring not to move a muscle.
From the moment Jack Clark appeared to the almighty Alec being slaughtered by demon power, it had only been a few breaths of time – the speed was so fast that the Death Priests hadn’t even had time to react, finding it hard to believe.
This human was too terrifying.
That was the Son of the Demon God, master of two Higher-order Laws, possessed the divine powers of Purgatory True Demon bloodline and the Power of the Abyss, a peak demon king who even Great Demon Kings couldn’t match.
Boom!
Suddenly, a sand dune exploded, and a transparent phantom shot up into the sky amidst the drift of yellow sand – it was a Death Priest who could no longer bear Jack Clark’s gaze.
The moment the Death Priest fled, roaring thunder resounded, and a ten-meter-thick, ten-thousand-meter-long Blue Thunder streaked across the sky, instantly causing the Death Priest at the early stage of the Nine Demonic Marks to explode.
Subsequently, the clouds roiled above, with thunder bellowing, and over twenty dazzling blue lightning bolts descended from the sky, their speed so fast that the remaining Death Priests had no time to react.
Boom, boom, boom!! Sand dunes exploded one after another, the Void shattered, and in an instant, these Death Priests who had merely glanced at Jack Clark were annihilated.
This was truly an instance of exploding at just one glance.
This time, however, Jack Clark held back. One Death Priest was only blasted in half; its upper body charred and lying on a dune, it watched in despair as a fierce silhouette slowly descended from the sky.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark landed on the ground, the sand within several kilometers shock and sunk, forming a three-kilometer-diameter pit, unable to bear his presence.
“No, don’t kill me, I can tell you everything I know. I can be an undercover agent for you,” the terrified Purgatory True Demon, who had already lost his nerve, pleaded hurriedly in the face of Jack Clark’s horrifying aura.
“I do not require a traitor of the tribe.”
In a voice deep as thunder, Jack Clark bent down slightly, his massive hand grasping the Priest’s broken body, as grains of sand slipped through his fingers.
The black light around Jack Clark’s left arm transformed into nine black Soul Chains that coiled around, clinking as they thrust into the True Demon Priest’s body.
“No!”
Along with the scream, an ethereal and transparent soul of the Purgatory True Demon was forcibly extracted by Jack Clark, then slowly ground into pieces by the Soul Chains.
Boom!
The True Demon Priest, equivalent to the Ninth Heavens, had his soul shattered in an instant, while at the same time, Jack Clark, by grinding those soul fragments, obtained some fragmented information.
Using the Soul Law to forcibly crush the opponent’s soul and read its information allowed glimpses into the most recent parts of memory, including some deeply ingrained details.
This method was convenient and quick, faster than interrogating with awakened Mental Talent abilities or reading memories from the brain cortex using genetic technology.
After reviewing this information, a hint of surprise showed in Jack Clark’s eyes, “This place is only a little over two hundred thousand kilometers away from the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.”
The distance in a straight line from the frontlines of the Human Race and the Purgatory Family to their far rear was more than four million kilometers, a distance based on the previous invasion by Denny Kaye and his forces.
This four million kilometers was relative to the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, the nearest to the Human Race out of all eight, while the other seven Empires were scattered in every direction, each with an immensely vast domain.
The furthest one from the Human Race was even tens of millions of kilometers away, showcasing the terrifying aspect of a race that had developed for over a hundred thousand years.
Although the Purgatory Family didn’t have enough numbers to occupy all Territorial lands, each Empire ruled over dozens, if not hundreds, of civilizations of different races within their vast domains.
The strongest Demon God Empire was said to have an influence that radiated over tens of millions of kilometers, ruling over hundreds of civilizations of different races, and had been at war with another mighty civilization for over a thousand years.
If it weren’t for the mythical world brimming with dangerous forbidden areas, where most regions were unsuitable for proliferation and habitation, and if transportation and communications were convenient, the Human Race would have already been overwhelmed by sheer numbers.
The two Demon God Empires warring with the Human Race were only the weaker ones among the Eight Great Empires, which were rejected by an alliance of six others split into two major camps.
All this information was sealed by the Federal Top Level and only known to King-level and above strong men; otherwise, if let out, everyone would fall into despair.
There was no helping it, the gap was just too large.
After reading through the information, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “I’ve just killed thirty-two, which means there are still two Death Priests that have escaped.”
Boom!
High above at ten thousand meters altitude, a ten-kilometer-diameter Great Sun hung in the sky, its endless radiance and heat illuminating the night sky, rapidly flying towards the direction of Earth’s Fissure.
Beneath the dominion of the Great Sun, countless creatures in the desert frantically fled – the One-horned Giant Lizard over ten meters long, the Desert Giant Python spanning dozens of meters, the Earth Dragon Birds that couldn’t fly.
And among these fleeing creatures was a transparent phantom hiding under a two-headed Giant Lizard over twenty meters long, subconsciously looking up at the ‘sun’ in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134 - 1134 457 Generous Investment Feedback
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1134: Chapter 457 Generous Investment Feedback, Preparations Before The Descent (8K)_3 Chapter 1134: Chapter 457 Generous Investment Feedback, Preparations Before The Descent (8K)_3 Suddenly, a chilling voice rang in its ears.
“The thirty-third one.”
Boom!
A light beam of golden flames, several meters in diameter, pierced through heaven and earth, and in an instant the ground exploded, a fireball hundreds of meters in diameter rose slowly, surrounded by a ring of white waves.
The scorching shockwave whipped up a raging wind, lifting up rolling clouds of sand and flying countless terrified animals in the vicinity.
After instantly killing the Death Priest, Jack Clark quickly covered thousands of kilometers to appear at the edge of the Ice-encrusted Forbidden Zone as the great sun set in the west, descending at more than ten times the speed of sound.
Boom! The ground exploded in an area spanning several kilometers, with countless pieces of dirt and rock mixed with scorching magma thrown in all directions, the sound thunderous and menacing.
Surrounded by burning golden flames, Jack Clark slowly made his way to a crack at the base of the mountain that stretched a kilometer long and over a hundred meters wide, deep into the earth.
This crack wasn’t actually so large; in the memory of that Death Priest, it was only a mountain wall crack about ten meters long.
However, Alec entered this time with the goal of annihilating the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe and demonizing everything, so he was very ostentatious, forcibly widening the crack.
Exhaling a breath of scorching air, Jack suppressed the impulse in his heart to pass through the crack and wreak havoc in the rear of the Purgatory Family.
The time wasn’t right yet. His current strength wasn’t enough to roam freely in the headquarters of the Purgatory Empire; he had to at least wait until the Destruction Emperor Dragon broke through and the Titan awoke.
By then, he would be able to summon the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, even if he encountered Demon God Level beings, to block for him while his original body escaped.
Boom!
Centred on Jack Clark, endless amounts of dark Void Power erupted, rushing into the Earth’s fissure like a tidal wave, mixed with the gray Power of Death.
Soon, the area for tens of kilometers around the entrance was shrouded in darkness while a range of over a hundred kilometers deep in the fissure was permeated with powers of Death and Void Law, turning it into a man-made land of death.
Under the intertwining of two Higher-order Laws, even ordinary Mythical Powerhouses risked falling upon entering, while those below the level of myth would die on contact.
At that moment, a black Mineral Stone about a dozen meters in size appeared in Jack Clark’s hand, with golden flames burning fiercely in his palm.
Soon, the black mineral turned into a liquid and gradually took shape, becoming a stele ten meters high, inscribed with the ancient rune ‘Suppress’ and containing a strand of Jack Clark’s Divine Soul Intent.
Boom! The stele landed at the entrance of the crack, and the ground shook instantly.
If a ‘Person’ were to pass through the crack, Jack would be alerted immediately. This was to prevent any Demon King Level Strong from sneaking in.
Although in the memory of that Death Priest, no demons knew about Alec and their entry, Jack still needed to take precautions.
After all, Alec was the son of the Devil God Emperor Eros, and his death might trigger a bloodline response from Diorus.
And there was still one Death Priest unaccounted for.
While Jack Clark sealed the crack, Mathilda Ward sat cross-legged at the edge of the dark space crack, surrounded by a shimmering silver Radiance covering an area of eight hundred meters.
“There’s another human here, a rift channel leading to the Human Race World.” Hiding in the dark forest, a transparent phantom watched Mathilda intently, its gaze excited.
If it could sell this information upon return, it would gain enough resources to break through to the Demon King level.
But just then, a roar that shook heaven and earth sounded in the distance, “Damned Purgatory Demon Race, daring to lurk over here, seeking death.”
Boom!
A Wolf Tooth Staff, a kilometer in length, crashed down, surrounded by bands of purple light. The tremendous strength compressed space into a solid, forming clear ripples in waves.
The Death Priest, excited by the discovery of a rift to the Human Race’s inner world, inadvertently leaked a trace of his aura, which Kavadola sensed instantly.
With one strike, a small mountain range over a thousand meters tall and stretching for kilometers collapsed, forest exploded, and amid the whirling winds and clouds of dust, a black figure burst forth, hugging the ground.
The figure radiated the Aura of a late-stage Nine Demonic Marks.
Guarding in front of the crack, Ilisa shouted, “Kavadola, keep a live one for interrogation.”
“No need.”
An indifferent voice filled the sky as Jack Clark, already back to normal, appeared instantly behind the black figure, his hand wielding a blinding blue Thunder that exploded violently.
Boom!
Under the force of a Thousand Tribulations Divine Power compressed by a hundredfold, the Death Priest didn’t even have time to manifest his Three-headed Six-armed True Body before he was instantly turned to dust, killed with a single blow.
Looking at the approaching Jack Clark, Ilisa’s expression turned grave, “Jack, how’s the situation?”
A smile appeared on Jack’s face, “It’s been taken care of. The Purgatory Family invaded here through an underground rift passing through the forbidden area.”
“But the invading Purgatory Demon King was very powerful. In an extremely short time, he annihilated the other tribes of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe including the Violent Dragon War God.”
Ilisa gasped in shock, “The Violent Dragon War God with Heavenly King Level Strength is dead? That Purgatory Demon King…?”
Jack casually said, “I have killed that demon king, including the thirty-four Death Priests who sneaked in, and the four demonized Violent Dragon Kings.”
“…As expected of you,” Ilisa inhaled deeply, her gaze flickering at the young man with black hair, somewhat fervent.
Jack turned to look at the shattered world behind him and spoke, “It’s safe here now, but there’s no need to stay. Let’s go over.”
“Yes, my lord,” Kavadola bowed his head, his expression a bit forlorn.

chapters.title: Chapter 1135 - 1135 457 Generous Investment Feedback
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1135: Chapter 457 Generous Investment Feedback, Preparations Before The Descent (8K)_4 Chapter 1135: Chapter 457 Generous Investment Feedback, Preparations Before The Descent (8K)_4 Just within a day or two, the Violent Dragon Clan had dwindled to only it and the several hundred thousand people of its tribe.
Moreover, had it not been for the appearance of the cracks, it might not have been able to evade this calamity by traveling through to conquer those ‘Indigenous People’ and happening to lead its people to surrender in the homeland of the Upper God.
As the Black Cracks trembled, Jack Clark, Mathilda Ward, and another person returned to Blue Star, immediately relieving the tense high-order cultivators on the outside.
“Greetings to Your Majesty.”
Valentine Leach also stepped forward, respectfully saying, “Your Majesty, what’s the situation over there?”
“It’s all settled now.”
“That’s a relief.” Valentine Leach breathed a sigh of relief.
The different races that had flooded over had brought news of the changes on the other side, and Valentine Leach had immediately cleared the surroundings, deploying High Precision Weapons aimed at the pathway.
In fact, just in case, he had also mobilized a high-yield Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb, capable of releasing millions of equivalent tons of energy in an instant to destroy the pathway.
Jack Clark glanced at the crowd of several hundred thousand onlookers in the distance: “General Leach, I’ll leave the task of settling these different races to you. Next, I need to convene a Throne Conference.”
“And as for those enjoying the spectacle, they’ve watched enough over these past two days. Have them disperse.”
“Yes, Your Majesty.”
As Valentine Leach turned to give the order, Jack Clark turned to Kavadola: “Although I’ve left two backups, continue to guard here in the meantime, Kavadola.”
“Yes, my Lord,” the hundred-meter-tall Kavadola replied respectfully.
Upon hearing this, Mathilda Ward was somewhat puzzled: “Jack, why don’t we just destroy the pathway? That way, even if another Purgatory Demon King emerges, it wouldn’t matter.”
Jack Clark smiled slightly, explaining, “I still have use for this pathway; it can’t be destroyed just yet.”
“You plan to…” Mathilda Ward was shocked, thinking of something, but before she could inquire further, Jack Clark disappeared with a faint smile.
…
In the Void, nine kings sat high upon their thrones, flanking both sides, with Jack Clark and Simon, the Heavenly King protecting Kava, seated at the main throne.
Sitting high upon his throne through will projection, Jack Clark related in detail the events that had occurred on the other side of the crack.
After Jack finished, one of the kings below spoke gravely: “I hadn’t expected the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe to be so close to the Purgatory Demon’s deep rear area. For safety’s sake, I suggest we destroy that pathway as soon as possible.”
Jack shook his head: “The pathway can’t be destroyed yet; I still have a significant use for it.”
“Currently, all the Purgatory True Demons who knew the internal situation of that forbidden area have been killed by me. In the short term, the Purgatory Demon Race won’t find out, and I’ve left Seals both at the entrance and the cracks.”
“If a demon king breaks through, I will be the first to sense it, and at that moment, I will trigger the explosive Light Sphere at the entrance of the pathway, destroying it.”
The Thunder Golden Flame Light Sphere Jack had earlier condensed for Mathilda Ward was still there, hovering at the entrance on the other side, with a strand of Divine Soul power stabilizing the Law Power within it.
At the time, a mere thought would be enough to detonate that strand of Divine Soul power.
Such a method of splitting Divine Soul power would be harmful for an average king-level practitioner, causing permanent damage to that portion of the Divine Soul upon explosion and destruction.
But for Jack, whose Divine Soul power was vast and immense and who had also cultivated the Illusion Meditation Scripture, it was of little consequence.
Marcellus Larry was somewhat puzzled: “Jack, what do you need that pathway for?”
Jack Clark smiled lightly: “I am preparing to enter Closed-door Cultivation to breakthrough to the Mid-Mythical Stage. Once I break through, I plan to delve into the rear of The Purgatory Family, hoping to alleviate some pressure from the frontline.”
“What!”
“Disrupting the rear of The Purgatory Family, no, it’s too dangerous,” Marcellus Larry decisively interjected.
The other kings also opposed the idea: “Indeed, it’s too dangerous. With your talent, Jack, you don’t need to take such risks; focus on your cultivation.”
“As long as you continue to grow, that would be a tremendous help to the Human Race.”
“Right. The Mysterious Martial Sky King and Sky King Denny Kaye almost met with trouble on their deep incursions before, with Mysterious Martial losing an early-stage Roc’s Avatar of the Heavenly King realm just to escape.”
“Your strength is formidable enough to contend with an average Great Demon King, but if you encounter a Demon God Level being, you might not even have a chance to escape.”
“A Demon God Level being can enact rules as they speak, shaping the rules of their domain. Only those of equal strength can contend with them.”
At this moment, all kings didn’t want Jack Clark, the prodigy of the Human Race, to take risks. If he was harmed, it would be a tremendous loss to the Human Race.
It would be almost as catastrophic as the fall of a Supreme being; thus, including Heavenly King Kava, everyone tried to dissuade him.
Jack spoke courteously: “Don’t worry, everyone. If I dare to go there, I have the confidence to come and go freely. With my current strength, unless I meet a Peak Awakened Great Demon King, no one can stop me.”
“Besides, my stealth capabilities are not weak; if I am cautious, not even a Great Demon King can discover me.” As he spoke, Jack’s thoughts moved, triggering the power of the Hidden Deity, and in an instant, his very presence seemed to vanish.
Although his projection was right in front of them, it caused an uncanny sensation of nonexistence in the past, present, and future, instinctively overlooked.
Such powerful concealment ability.
“Beyond that, I also possess forbidden weapons given by the Speaker, including the Heaven Divine Shadow Talisman that can instantly transport me back from millions of miles away.”
After Jack finished speaking, the kings fell silent.
An early-stage Mythical realm, comparable to a mid to late-stage Heavenly King in combat power, a secret skill that can briefly erase one’s traces, and a Rule Forbidden Weapon that can instantly transport one back.
Compared to Jack, they suddenly felt as if their own kingship was mocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1136 - 1136 457 Generous Investment Feedback
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1136: Chapter 457: Generous Investment Feedback, Preparations Before the Descent (8K)_5 Chapter 1136: Chapter 457: Generous Investment Feedback, Preparations Before the Descent (8K)_5 Seeing that no one objected further, Jack Clark continued, “The aftershocks of the mythical world will gradually weaken from now on, and we shouldn’t see any space cracks exceeding level ten.”
“I’ll leave the affairs of Blue Star to all of you. If you need my assistance, just let me know at any time. I will leave a Divine Soul Imprint Stone at Sister Ilisa’s place.”
The Divine Soul Imprint Stone is a special type of ore that can store a wisp of thought. When crushed, another stone with the imprint will also respond. It’s a means of communication used during isolated closed-door cultivation.
Normally, High-level cultivators use runic formations to shield their closed-door cultivation locations, making contact impossible, let alone someone like Jack Clark who enters another plane world to cultivate in seclusion.
The meeting continued for a while as everyone discussed matters regarding the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe and some other countries, after which the meeting concluded.
Once back at the Temporary Fissure Base outside of South City, Jack Clark found Mathilda Ward busy in the temporary office.
As a Nine-fold Peak power responsible for overseeing South City, Mathilda Ward had many responsibilities. Upon seeing Jack enter, the austere yet stunningly beautiful face immediately brightened with a smile.
“Jack, is the meeting over?”
“Yes, it’s finished,” Jack replied as he sat down on the chair opposite Mathilda, then took out a palm-sized golden vajra box.
“Sister Ilisa, could you please send this to General Brulu Warren of the Southern Region’s battle zones? Just say it’s a gift from me to him,” he said.
“Pure Origin of the World!”
Upon seeing the four strands of pure white radiance in the golden vajra box, along with the origin fluctuations that not even the box could contain, Mathilda Ward was somewhat astonished.
Jack nodded, “General Warren has been stuck at the Ninth Heaven Peak for many years. After inquiring, he estimated that he needs just four strands of Origin to complete his Law Transformation.”
That was Jack Clark’s gift of gratitude to Brulu Warren.
Jack had always remembered the kindness of this elder who had helped him breakthrough to the Sixth Layer and had exchanged his own merits for a Top-tier Secret Manual to swiftly complete his own Top-Tier Secret Manual.
However, Brulu Warren was different from him. He cultivated a Lower Law, and even after the breakthrough to king-level, his strength would be considered average.
After giving away four strands of Origin to Brulu Warren, Jack still had seventeen strands left. The four strands he had just given away were obtained after slaying the Black Violent Ape.
With the Pure Origin of the World he had accumulated, Jack could help three long-standing Nine-fold Peak powerhouses in the Federation to complete their Transformation and break through to king-level sooner.
But there was no need because he also required the World Origin to strengthen his Plane and enhance the Law of Strength.
As for Mathilda Ward, she did not need the World Origin, as she already possessed the complete Dragon’s Law and only needed her True Body to complete the Tempering before stepping into the Mythical stage.
That was something even Jack envied.
In contrast to the work he had put in to finally breakthrough to king-level, Mathilda Ward’s progress could be described as a sudden ascension.
However, Mathilda was an exception in the entire Federation. Just a complete Dragon Series Law on its own was already extremely rare, not to mention the soul that was in a state of decline and fragmentation, which took over a decade to merge.
In addition, it cost countless soul resources and life resources. Under normal conditions, even Supreme Experts would be distressed, depleting an accumulation that took a Heavenly King decades to build.
Then, Jack took out some more vajra boxes, Storage rings, and small Storage bags for Mathilda to help send to Justin Welan and others.
Originally, he had planned to give these items to those friends during a meal to avoid the awkwardness of private gifting, but unforeseen rapid changes occurred.
After arranging everything, Jack went into closed-door cultivation in the Plane World, to see if he could reach the Mid-Mythical Stage before the Destruction Emperor Dragon wakes.
With more than two hundred thousand attribute points burning day and night, his cultivation progress would be terrifying. Although the frenzied comprehension of the Heavenly Earth Law would put great pressure and consume his soul, it didn’t matter.
Because his soul was strong enough.
“Mom, has brother not come back yet?”
Past five in the afternoon, Glenn Clark, who was over 2 meters tall and carrying a ‘small backpack,’ returned from school with the excitement on his face yet to subside and a faint kiss mark.
Doris Clark’s voice came from the kitchen, “Your brother said he’s going into closed-door cultivation for a few days and will be back on Sunday to go back to the countryside with us for tomb sweeping.”
Glenn responded with an “Oh.”
At that moment, Doris walked out of the kitchen with a spatula in her hand, her eyebrows knitting upon seeing Glenn slumped on the sofa, “Jim, I heard that these two days at school you’ve been showing off about your brother’s deeds?”
“I haven’t really been showing off,” said Glenn with a chuckle. “It’s those classmates who keep asking me about my brother, and I showed them the picture of me standing on the shoulder of the Violent Dragon King.”
Doris Clark frowned slightly, “Although your brother has become a king-level cultivator, and ordinary people’s envy doesn’t matter to him, we still need to maintain a low profile.”
“Mom, I understand. You are worried about causing trouble for my brother,” said Glenn.
“It’s not just about trouble. Your brother has now become the Federation’s number one genius, a Mythical King that has shaken the world. Many people are watching us.”
“Many people will be circling around you and me in the future, with various motives, but all related to your brother.”
Doris cautioned, “Your brother only took one year to break through to king-level, and his achievements will only get higher, beyond our imagination.”
“So, I hope we don’t slow down your brother’s progress because of us. Do you understand?”
“Mom, I got it,” Glenn nodded.
“Good to know. Even though you have awakened as a cultivator, you haven’t yet started your cultivation, and you’re not as strong as those powerful cultivators. You need to be careful as well.”
“Okay, mom. I will definitely keep a low profile from now on, and besides fishing, I won’t go anywhere else,” said Glenn.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1137: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emits Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K) Chapter 1137: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emits Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K) “`
In the Plane World, lines of black dragon tornadoes pierced through the heavens and the earth like roaring Giant Beasts, while Blue Thunder snaked for tens of kilometers, the booming explosions vibrating Heaven and Earth.
Here, the power of nature was displayed to the fullest, shaking the Earth and causing all beings to tremble.
Sitting cross-legged at the top of the Black Divine Mountain, the raging wind made Jack Clark’s sleeves whip and crack loudly, his hair flying wildly. In his hands floated a palm-sized Golden War Order.
After the Violent Dragon War God was besieged and fell to Alec’s present and future bodies, he left behind this Inherited War Order bestowed by the ancients of the Human Race.
However, this Inherited War Order required the War Pattern Power at the ‘rule’ level, or a true Human Race cultivator to activate, so it was useless in Alec’s hands.
While it is called an Inherited War Order, what it actually contains are seven powers of rules, which can be used to Seal seven times, sealing all the target’s laws and talents.
But over the course of more than a thousand years, Jerold had used it six times, leaving only one rule power remaining.
And this Seal was targeted; besides sealing the opponent’s mastery of rules and talents, it had no other effects, such as on bloodline or physical strength.
This was also the cause of Jerold’s fall.
But for Jack Clark, this was enough. As soon as the Time Silver Butterfly appeared next time, he would Seal it and drag it out of time to shatter it.
A slight smile appeared on Jack Clark’s lips as he put away the Inherited War Order. At his brow, a red eye connecting to Hell surfaced, emitting terrifying blood light.
One by one, a total of seventeen white radiances appeared in front of Jack Clark, emanating a mystical aura of the beginning of all things, the Origin of everything.
Boom!
Jack Clark pressed down with one palm, and the space in front of him shattered, directly infusing the seventeen World Origins into the core of the Plane World, where a yellowish halo lingered.
In the halo suffused with Mysterious Yellow intention, a dark red substance akin to a Star Core slowly rotated, its invisible gravitational pull affecting the entire Plane World.
And the moment the seventeen World Origins merged with the Star Core, the entire Plane World trembled, the Black Wind roaring between heaven and earth, and Thunder booming.
Even the Golden Sun hanging above the Firmament shone brighter, the crystal barrier vibrated, and the speed at which it converted energies from the Chaos Void surged by several hundred times.
In Jack Clark’s consciousness, the entire Plane World expanded, on the edges of the Earth, countless dirt and rocks were born from nothing, the world’s spatial bearing capacity grew stronger, and the crystal barrier became more robust.
The Supreme Law of Strength, nurtured in the center of the world, also exploded mightily, transforming into a vast and Supreme strength that enveloped Jack Clark, Tempering his True Body.
Under the Supreme Law’s tempering, the invisible Aura emanating from Jack Clark became more formidable, pressing down on the surrounding space to continuously vibrate and Distort, forming waves that surged in all directions.
Simultaneously, countless insights about the Law of Strength flooded into Jack Clark’s mind, prompting him to move with a thought, and a voice echoed in his mind.
“Burn 150,000 Points Attribute, enter the epiphany state.”
Boom!
The profound strength in Jack Clark’s body Burst forth, enveloping him in an extremely dense Epiphanic Intent Realm, with millions of thoughts flashing through in almost an instant.
At the same time, darkness spread from the center of Jack Clark, transforming into the Void that covered several kilometers, with two world projections, each a kilometer in diameter, emerging on either side, with flames burning and Death swirling around…
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark was in Closed-door Cultivation, countless people outside were busy.
In the military base on the Southern Battlefield, the assistant knocked on Brulu Warren’s office door and saluted before speaking respectfully, “General, you have a package from the military’s internal mail for your collection.”
“A package? What is it?” Brulu Warren paused, then showed a puzzled look; he didn’t remember online shopping.
The assistant replied respectfully, “It’s a gift from the Divine Martial Throne to you, as a token of gratitude for your care in the past.”
“Jack Clark.”
Looking at the black delivery box on the table, now open, and the golden transparent jade box inside, sealing four World Origins, Brulu Warren felt both astonished and gratified.
He was astonished that he had received such a precious ‘gift,’ and gratified that Jack Clark had reciprocated those who had once helped him.
This behavior was not about the value of the gift, but rather, it was more important that he did not forget his roots.
In fact, these older cultivators had no personal agenda in nurturing the new generation—they only aimed to strengthen the Human Race.
Therefore, in every aspect of the educational system and the trials, as long as a freshman performed well, they would receive incremental resource support and protection from the strong.
However, Jack Clark’s progress was so rapid that before Brulu Warren could react, he already received a feedback several times over what he had given.
Mist River City.
At three in the afternoon, on the bustling street, people bustled back and forth, the golden sunlight of autumn sprinkled down like fine sand, draping a warm hue over everyone.
Outside a dessert shop that was doing well, Justin Welan, Zac Maben, White Veil, and Marcus Lindsay sat comfortably in the sun, sipping their drinks and chatting idly.
Marcus Lindsay suddenly asked, “Mr. Willard, you’ve already applied to enter the mythical world, right?”
Justin Welan nodded proudly, “Yes, I have applied. However, due to the Civilization War erupting at the frontline, the date of assembly has not been confirmed yet.”
Immediately, Zac Maben and the others showed envious expressions.
White Veil enviously said, “Damn, that’s not fair. Even though we all have similar talents, you managed to breakthrough to the Sixth-level Heaven in just one year.”
Marcus Lindsay nodded, “Indeed, I defeated Mr. Willard in the Freshman Ranking Tournament back then, yet now he has surpassed me by two Major Realms.”
“`

﻿Chapter 1138: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emanating Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_2 Chapter 1138: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emanating Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_2 Justin Welan spoke with disdain, “That was when I let you win, afraid of crushing the confidence of you classmates. Otherwise, you could pound away and still not budge my war shield.”
“Keep bragging. We all know what your strength was back then.”
At this moment, Zac Maben remarked with emotion, “But when it comes to a real freak, it’s got to be Jack Clark. This guy ranked only one place above me in the ranking competition, but afterward, his cultivation level soared like he was on a rocket.”
“No, not even a rocket is that fast, it felt like his cultivation was as easy as drinking water.”
White Veil nodded, “Yeah, a myth in a year, I wouldn’t even dare to dream of that. It’s hard to imagine he’s actually our classmate.”
Marcus Lindsay sighed, “I wonder if we ever stand a chance to step into the King Realm.”
Zac Maben shook his head, “Don’t dream about it, our chances are slim. If becoming a king was that simple, the Federation wouldn’t have just dozens, but hundreds or thousands.”
“Mr. Lewis is right,” Justin Welan agreed, nodding.
“Even if I achieve the Sixth Layer in a year, and my brother is a Ninth Heaven Expert, with my good brother Jack having already made the breakthrough to King, I still have no confidence in stepping into the King’s throne.”
“Get lost!” the three of them fiercely gave him the finger.
After the joke, Marcus Lindsay pondered, “In our group, besides Jack, Jane Aiken seems to be the one most likely to make a breakthrough to King, I heard she’s close to breaking through the Ninth Layer.”
Justin Welan shook his head, “Jane isn’t just the most likely, it’s a hundred percent certain for her to break through.”
Speaking of this, Justin Welan was somewhat amazed, “She has walked the King’s Road and has gone far on the Road of Heavenly Kings, a monster whose talent is only slightly less than Jack’s.”
“If it weren’t for Jack dominating this era, Jane’s talent could be called the first of this generation in Eastern Summer, or even the entire Federation, unshakable.”
“As for Howard Lambert, myself, and the Class Leader, as well as Mandy Lewis, although we all received the War General’s Inheritance, whether we can break through to King still depends on our personal Creation.”
At that moment, a splendid red sports car stopped on the road, the door opened, and a beauty with silver hair and a black trench coat stepped out, instantly making everyone pause.
With her exquisitely dignified features, tall figure, and a tailored black trench coat, her silver hair cascading down her back, she instantly captivated all the passersby.
“It’s Mathilda Ward!”
“She’s come to Mist River City.”
“Quick, take a picture.”
Soon the surrounding pedestrians recognized Mathilda Ward and became excited.
However, this time, no one dared to approach for an autograph because the current Mathilda Ward is not just a big star, but also a Ninth Heaven Expert.
To ordinary people, Ninth Heaven cultivators are not only terrifyingly powerful but also unreachable high-ranking individuals.
The silver-haired Mathilda Ward approached Justin Welan and Zac Maben, smiling slightly, “Mr. Justin, we meet again.”
“Hello, Miss Ward, are you looking for me?” Justin Welan stood up somewhat nervously, and the others, also shaken, stood up with him, as her fame and power were something they could only look up to.
“Sort of, Jack Clark asked me to deliver some gifts to you,” said Mathilda Ward as she placed a space ring and three storage bags in front of the four of them.
Instantly, they were surprised, but upon hearing the items were from Jack Clark, they unceremoniously accepted. After all, Jack was now a Mythical King, a man of means, no need for pleasantries with him.
After receiving the items, Justin Welan curiously asked, “Miss Ward, how did you know we were here?”
Mathilda Ward smiled slightly, “Simple, your smart wristwatches have a positioning function. A quick check, and I knew.”
Each cultivator’s smart wristwatch is like an identity card, holding personal information, communication, and with the right authorization, high-level cultivators can access some information of low-level cultivators, including their location.
After delivering the items, Mathilda Ward left directly. Watching the red sports car drive away, Marcus Lindsay and company couldn’t help but show envy, “Jack sure not only cultivates fast but also knows a lot of beauties.”
Justin Welan said with pride, “Of course, after all, Jack’s looks could make even men envious.”
“I feel like the Class Leader has the hots for Jack; didn’t you see her and Mandy Lewis block all the girls who tried to get close to Jack after the opening ceremony of the new semester yesterday?”
“You just noticed? I saw it on the first day of school. The Class Leader sneaked seven glances at Jack, she just hasn’t realized it herself.”
“What, Crystal Lewis had feelings for Jack all along?”
“Obviously, otherwise why did I hint at playing matchmaker for them several times, luring the Class Leader over.”
“Too bad, Jack was all about cultivation at that time, and with the Class Leader’s somewhat arrogant nature and her rapid Foundation Establishment, she ended up getting Freya Louise closer to Jack.”
“However, aside from the Class Leader and Freya Louise, I also know a few other female students interested in Jack, one is…”
Suddenly, the group was abuzz with gossip.
In the villa district of Mist River City, the Lewis sisters, Crystal and Mandy, sat in the courtyard after their cultivation, drinking tea and chatting, enjoying the last moments of tranquility before entering the mythical world.
Then, the doorbell rang.
“You are, Miss Mathilda Ward.” Staring at the silver-haired beauty at the door, the Lewis sisters were somewhat surprised.
They had also seen some videos edited online from yesterday, so they knew this silver-haired beauty was the returning Mathilda Ward and that she had a good relationship with Jack Clark.
Previously in April, when Jack left the Southern Battlefield, he went by the name Darren Callum to protect her.

﻿Chapter 1139: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emanating Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_3 Chapter 1139: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emanating Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_3 “Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis, hello. Before Jack entered closed-door cultivation, he asked me to help deliver some gifts he brought back from the mythical world to both of you,”
“Gifts.” The Lewis sisters were startled; why would that guy suddenly think of giving them gifts?
With a slight smile, Mathilda Ward said, “All his good friends have them, like Justin Welan and the others.”
“I see, thank you.” Crystal nodded and took the two storage rings that Mathilda passed to her.
“Miss Ward, would you like to come in for a cup of tea?”
“No need, I still have some matters to attend to.”
Since they were not familiar with each other, the Lewis sisters did not insist: “Well then, thank you for the trouble.”
After watching Mathilda leave, the Lewis sisters explored the storage rings with their spiritual will and immediately saw dozens of top-tier resources and one God-level inside.
These resources were sorted out by Jack from various Evil Gods and Demon Gods, suitable for their current level of cultivation.
These items were estimated to be worth tens of thousands of merit points, but they were already of no use to Jack.
At the Clark home, the sun was already beginning to set in the west, and Doris Clark was bending over with a small shovel in the courtyard, loosening the soil for the vegetables she had planted.
Because Jack was coming back in the next couple of days, Doris had taken a few days off.
At that moment, a red sports car slowly pulled up to the curb, immediately drawing the sharp gaze of a few pairs of eyes from the building nearby and from a few other houses not too far away.
However, as they saw Mathilda stepping out of the car, those sharp gazes paused, and the wariness in their eyes disappeared as they retracted their gazes.
Standing at the gate of the courtyard, Mathilda knocked gently and said with a polite smile, “Hello, auntie, this is the Clark home, right?”
“You are Miss Mathilda Ward? What can I do for you?” Doris was somewhat surprised, as she had not expected this celebrity, who had a good relationship with Jack, to appear here.
Mathilda, with a melodic voice, said, “Auntie, please just call me Ilisa. I am here today to help Jack with some things, and also to visit you.”
Hearing that it was to help Jack, Doris’s gaze softened immediately: “You have been troubled with Jack’s matters. Please come in and sit.”
“Thank you, auntie, but there’s no need, I must rush back to oversee South City.”
As she spoke, Mathilda took out a bag she was carrying: “Auntie, this is our first meeting. Inside are some gifts I prepared for you.”
“I can’t accept that, Jack has already troubled you enough,” Doris declined quickly.
Mathilda responded with a smile: “Auntie, you have got it backward. I should be the one thanking Jack. If it weren’t for his protection a few months ago, I might have been killed in the Evil God Sect’s surprise attack.”
She continued, “Moreover, these items are just some ordinary nurturing spirits, nothing very expensive. Their main function is to regulate your body to help you stay healthy.”
“Only when you are healthy and strong can Jack focus wholeheartedly on his cultivation progress without distractions, right?”
“This…” Doris hesitated, but then the wristwatch on Mathilda’s wrist suddenly lit up, flickering urgently. Seeing this, Mathilda’s expression turned serious.
“Auntie, there’s an issue in South City that requires my attention. I need to rush back. Next time, I will visit you again with Jack,” Mathilda said.
Saying this, Mathilda handed the bag to Doris and then hurriedly got into her car, which sped off with a roar of its engine.
…Watching the heavy gift bag in her hands and the sports car disappearing down the street, Doris couldn’t help but remember Freya Louise, who had visited their home at the beginning of the year.
Both women had exceptional demeanor—one delicate and serene, the other dignified and commanding—and both were beautiful, causing Doris to feel somewhat torn.
Meanwhile, far away on the Frontline Battlefield, Lori Parma also received the message from the rear.
Seeing Lori suddenly stop in her tracks, her ten-member high-order elite squad turned back. Concerned, Vernon advocated, “Lori, what’s happened?”
Lori shook his head: “Nothing much, just a message from the rear saying that I have a package.”
A package. The team was taken aback. Who was delivering packages on the Frontline Battlefield?
“I’ve already instructed them to leave it at the base for me. I’ll collect it after this battle is over,” Lori said, then continued with the squad through the dark mountain forest.
As members of an elite army squadron, they needed to infiltrate deep into enemy positions during each outbreak of war, searching for coordinates of alien corps long-range attacks to guide the strike of remote Hydrogen Bombs.
The squad quickly crossed the frontline and entered the territory of the Purgatory Demon Race position.
At the same time, across the war zone extending over ten thousand kilometers, mountain ranges stretched far beyond sight, and rivers meandered. Twenty-four legions of the Human Race had already settled into each of their forward positions.
On the four main battlefields, over two million Unmanned Mechs were positioned in the front, with long-range rocket positions, artillery positions, mid-range missile bases, drones, and bomber airports scattered in the rear.
Simultaneously, atop some mountain peaks reaching thousands of meters high, several super electromagnetic guns had begun charging, with eleven enormous sky-based battleships suspended in the Firmament overhead.
Opposite the Human Race, over one hundred vassal legions of the Purgatory Demon Race and their Main Battle Legions were gradually taking their positions, including the Demonic Flying Alien Beast Army in the sky and the Demonized Beast legions on the ground.
Above the Demon Clan’s position, several massive Demon King Fortresses floated, enshrouded by swirling Dark Demon Air, like rolling dark clouds that obscured the night sky.
In the sky hundreds of kilometers away, kings and demon kings stood off, Heavenly Kings and Great Demon Kings locked in a standoff from a distance, terrifying law pressure pervasive in the heavens, colliding and booming dully.
Tens of thousands of kilometers above, four even more fearsome figures stood tall: from the Human Race side were the Sky-based God King and True Martial Heavenly King wielding the Race Weapon; opposite them were two Demon God Level Powerhouses.

﻿Chapter 1140: Chapter 458: Ancestral Grave Emits Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_4 Chapter 1140: Chapter 458: Ancestral Grave Emits Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_4 Apart from this, behind The Purgatory Family, a towering Demon God stood, its presence exuding a terrifying aura for intimidation.
Similarly, behind the Human Race, there was also a subtly diffused Supreme-level pressure, confronting each other.
After two or three days of arrangement and deployment, both the Human Race and The Purgatory Family had their forces in place, and the great war was on the brink of eruption.
Suddenly, not knowing who made the first move, over a hundred rocket launcher bases established among forests and mountain peaks, hundreds of kilometers away from the frontline, fired simultaneously.
In an instant, hundreds of thousands of rockets filled the Firmament, densely packed, covering dozens of mountain peaks and exploding in a blaze that lit up the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!! Behind the position, thousands of artillery positions fired incessantly, and swarms of unmanned fighter aircraft emitted droning sounds as they went to meet the demonized Flying Exotic Beasts coming their way.
“Calling headquarters, the enemy is launching a fierce assault on our position, coordinates A-9774 need a saturation bombing with Tactical Crystal Energy Nuclear Bomb.”
“Headquarters has received, Tactical Crystal Energy Nuclear Bomb will arrive in 2 minutes 21 seconds.”
“Rocket Launcher Base 0-8911, immediately fire five volleys of high-explosive rockets at coordinates A-10115, quickly relocate to the second firing position after saturation bombing.”
“A giant alien corps legion, towering five hundred meters high, appeared at coordinates C-11023; heavy firepower can’t kill it, calling for Superpowered Electromagnetic Cannon for a physical penetration strike.”
“Calling headquarters, we’ve spotted a long-range alien corps of about 120,000 members, requesting two Strategic Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs for a devastating attack, while our squad will guide in real-time…”
The war erupted into a fierce confrontation in an instant.
The intensity of this battle made even the Sky-based God King and others tense up, as they saw the opposing side’s demon king fortresses begin to move, rolling up towering demon gas and entering the battle directly.
At the same time, the Demon Kings standing above the Firmament saw their auras explode several times over, directly burning up to twenty percent of their Origin and pouncing towards the Human Kings.
“Damn it, brothers, let’s kill them, if these guys aren’t afraid of death, are we?”
Boom, boom, boom!! Thirty-four Demon Kings and twenty-seven kings engaged in combat in an instant.
At the same time, five Heavenly Kings and six Great Demon Kings in the sky also burst into fierce battle, turning into laws, causing the entire world to tremble under the terrifying Law Power.
As the forces of the two empires converged on the two great battlefields, the power invested in this battle by both sides was even greater than that in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
And in the bases behind both sides, many armies, kings, and demon kings were in reserve, ready to be deployed to the battlefield at any moment.
And at the moment the battle erupted, Number One, standing more than one hundred and sixty meters tall, radiating an aura that instilled fear in countless beings, had already taken the lead and charged into the enemy’s position.
Hum!
A blue-white Light Beam spanning over ten kilometers swept across an entire vassal race legion’s formation, plowing a fracture on the Earth several kilometers long and one mile wide.
Everywhere it passed, fire exploded, tens of thousands from the different races turned to ashes, a whole legion blasted away in the assault.
As for the overwhelming ranged attacks from the other side, they were simply blocked by an invisible force field around Number One, impenetrable.
However, as soon as Number One entered the battlefield, two powerful pressures from late-period demon kings exploded from the opposing side.
Two demon kings, each five hundred meters tall and with three heads and six arms, covered in demon gas for kilometers, wielding dark long spears hundreds of meters long, entered the battlefield, surrounded by numerous members of the different races.
While the frontline Human Race and The Purgatory Family were engaged in fierce combat, within a sky-based battleship at the rear base, members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, their auras suppressed, stood on the bridge.
These members of the Heavenly Feather Clan were intently watching the big screen, curious about the human’s Mechas, rockets, missiles, Hydrogen Bombs, and super electromagnetic guns.
After battling for ‘half a day’, a Mythical-level member of the Heavenly Feather Clan expressed envy, “Those ‘technology’ things of the human race are really convenient, actually able to produce so many metal Mechs similar to war puppets.”
Another female member of the Heavenly Feather Clan nodded, “Those inexpensive metal Mechs are indeed very useful, allowing the Human Race to directly engage in ruthless expenditure with The Purgatory Family without fearing a break in fresh blood.”
“And those long-range explosive weapons are not weak in power either. According to the data they showed us, those weapons are also inexpensive and can be mass-produced.”
“The Human Race has managed to confront and exhaust the forces of The Purgatory Family on two battlefields, withstand the fierce onslaught of the two major empires for so long; they really do have something unique about them, great potential.”
At this time, another member of the Heavenly Feather Clan, with a cold expression, said indifferently, “But the Human Race’s weaknesses are still very clear; they severely lack mid to high-end strong men.”
“If The Purgatory Family goes all out, sacrificing everything, and all demon kings start to burn their Origin in rotation to wear down the other side, the Human Race at most can last a few dozen more Sun Wheel Mythical Realms before suffering severe casualties.”
“Or it could be that the two Demon God Empires have already felt threatened by the Human Race and have now begun to consume their Intrinsic resources, preparing to wear down the Human Mythical Realms.”
Suddenly, all the members of the Heavenly Feather Clan became very solemn, knowing their tribe’s mid to high-end strength was depleted by The Purgatory Family in precisely such a manner.
In just a few hundred Sun Wheels’ time, from a peak of two hundred Mythical Realm strong men to now fewer than fifty, the casualties were heavy, and those who survived also suffered severe Origin depletion.
On the other hand, the demon kings from the three major Demon God Empires could quickly recover their Origin through blood sacrifice, offering countless lives to the Supreme Abyss in exchange for its blessings.
Moreover, with their deeper accumulation, plundering countless Heaven and Earth Treasures to refine various Divine Medicines to restore Origin, the Demon God Empires’ losses were less than half of the Heavenly Feather Clan’s.
With such losses on one side and gains on the other, the three major empires, which previously only had a slightly higher number of Mythical-level and Titan-level strong men, now have an overwhelming advantage in all aspects.
