﻿Chapter 1141: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emanating Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_5 Chapter 1141: Chapter 458: Ancestral Tomb Emanating Blue Smoke, Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_5 Most of the territories of the Heavenly Feather Clan have been occupied by The Purgatory Family, with the remaining experts gathering their last strength and relying on three strongholds to hold on.
In contrast, the three great Demon God Empires are quite composed; those severely injured return to the rear for recovery, while other demon kings continue to deplete the resources at the frontline, granting no chance for the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Mythical Powerhouses to recover.
Sigh! A middle-aged man with three pairs of golden wings on his back let out a breath and consoled, “Don’t worry, the War of Extermination isn’t so easily initiated. The Human Race still has time.”
“To wipe out these human kings, the two Demon God Empires would need to prepare for the fall of at least twenty demon kings and engage in dozens of Sun Wheel-length battles to the death.”
“Under such circumstances, not all demon kings are eager to die, and there will definitely be resistance to the Demon God’s orders.”
“Moreover, didn’t that Primordial True King say that in the most recent Sun Wheels, the Purgatory Family has already lost more than ten demon kings at the hands of Human Experts?””
“Therefore, it should not be possible to initiate the War of Extermination in the short term or launch the final total assault on the Human Race.”
“Besides, our clan has already made contact with the Human Race, and as long as we cooperate, there is still hope.” The middle-aged man paused here.
“After this battle with the Human Race is over, we will begin discussions for an alliance.”
“According to the wishes of our ancestral deities, they are preparing to offer a sapling of the Eternal Divine Tree to the Human Race while the humans promise to share half of their territory with us.”
“By then, with our forces combined with those of the humans and leveraging the unique terrain here, we could still contend against The Purgatory Family and thrive anew.”
“Of course, if the Human Race doesn’t demonstrate sufficient strength in this battle, our ancestral deities plan to lead the remaining members of our tribe into the depths of the mythical world to start anew.”
“Thus, our clan still has hope; it’s not yet a time for despair.”
With the middle-aged man’s comforting words, the grave expressions on the faces of the other Heavenly Feather Alien Clan members eased somewhat, as their conversation was shielded within an enchantment.
In the following days, the battles at the Frontline Battlefield became increasingly brutal. Blue Star also experienced another five shockwaves, resulting in many Space Cracks.
However, as the Federation Think Tank had predicted, the shockwaves that followed were weaker each time.
Although the countless space cracks that appeared out of nowhere across the globe still caused some casualties and led to many people awakening with mutations, it was all under the control of the Human Race.
Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In the depths of the magma of the Rift World, the form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon has grown over 1,600 meters, its figure becoming more colossal as if it were a black and red mountain range, exuding a terrifying aura.
And as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strength slowly stepped into the Titan Level, Jack Clark’s True Body also underwent Synchronous Strengthening, with an increasingly terrifying aura that collapsed the Void.
Plane World
Jack Clark was seated in the Void, surrounded by death. His long black hair danced wildly amidst golden flames, his body enveloped in jumping blue arcs, looking both divine and demonic.
Suddenly, the realm of thought that enveloped him began to dissipate quickly. After five days of cultivation, Jack Clark’s eyelids twitched slightly, and he slowly opened his eyes.
In those eyes, clear-cut in black and white, reflected the Void and Death, looking down from a lofty position like a Supreme Deity in charge of life and death, majestic and overbearing.
Jack Clark slowly spoke, “Is it Sunday already?” With that thought, he reined in his aura, and the surrounding darkness receded, the flames vanished, and all manner of visions dispersed.
Having promised Doris Clark to accompany her to the countryside for a grave visit, Jack Clark only engaged in Closed-door Cultivation for five days this time, timing it perfectly to burn 150,000 Attribute points.
Although this retreat was a brief five days, the enhancements in his cultivation and other aspects were astounding.
Feeling the Law’s Origin and physical strength within his body, which were several times stronger than five days before, Jack Clark summoned his attribute page with a thought.
Realm: Mythical King[Initial Stage]
Heavenly Dragon. Physique: 61.2478→ 68.2471
Heavenly Dragon. Strength: 66.4627→ 72.3540
Heavenly Dragon. Agility: 31.2011→ 38.2413
Divine Soul.Spirit: 35.4708→ 42.1727 (5.3517)
Body of the Battle Demon God:[After tempering with five higher-order laws and the Supreme Law, the body of the Demon God commands an Overbearing Might of a One-side World, containing the bloodline force of Emperor-level gigantic beasts]
Law of Strength[Supreme 6%→ 24%], Law of the Void[Higher-order 7%→ 21%], Law of Death[7%→ 20% Higher-order], Soul Law[Higher-order, 5%→ 17%]
Great Sun Heaven Flame Law[Higher-order 8%→ 26%], Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder Law[Higher-order 8%→ 25%]
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture[Sixth Level 6%]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark[Limit Break]
Real World: Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder[Level: Small World, real range 1,100 kilometers, containing complete World Rules, nurturing the Supreme Law of Strength.
Absolute Domain: Mobilizing World Power for external projection, forming a World Projection covering thirty kilometers, exerting Absolute Domination over enemies within this area.
Note: External projection of the world projection will significantly consume the Power of World Origin, please use it sparingly.
World Wall: Compressing the World’s Power to form a crystal wall of Defense around, blending it with Divine Power Absolute Defense will make it impregnable]
Equipment: Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd[Law Level…]
Attribute points: 111987
Soul Points: 3570
With the growth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, just a few days have passed, and Jack Clark’s basic physical body has become stronger, comparable to the enhancement he gained by slaying a foreign prodigy on the Ancient Dueling Arena.
Furthermore, in just five days, his cultivation was nearing the Mid-Mythical Stage, and the Great Sun Heaven Flame was just four percent progress away from reaching minor completion.
Originally the slowest to improve, the Law of Strength, saw a sudden surge due to the Plane World breaking through to 1,000 kilometers, becoming a small world, and ultimately surpassing both the Void and Death.

chapters.title: Chapter 1142 - 1142 458 Ancestral Grave Emits Blue Smoke The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1142: Chapter 458 Ancestral Grave Emits Blue Smoke, The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_6 Chapter 1142: Chapter 458 Ancestral Grave Emits Blue Smoke, The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens (9.5K)_6 In five days, his cultivation soared close to the mid-period of Myth, an advancement speed so astonishing it could shake the entire Federation. This was the true “value” of a genius without equal throughout history.
Of course, Jack Clark was very clear about the reason for his rapid cultivation.
Moreover, this extreme closed-door cultivation was somewhat wasteful; burning fifteen thousand Attribute points a day for cultivation would have been enough for him to break through to the mid-period of Myth.
As the extreme closed-door cultivation progressed, Jack Clark’s improvements became slower and slower, as his consciousness was no longer able to process, absorb, and convert those realizations in real-time.
In every moment of soul interaction with Heaven and Earth, Jack Clark would comprehend countless mysterious information about the six Laws such as strength, Death, the Void, and the soul.
Then, this mysterious information piled up more and more, like a CPU over-clocked and struggling to keep up, causing a freeze.
And because he was constantly interacting with the Heavenly Earth Laws, Jack Clark’s Divine Soul also consumed a terrifyingly huge amount, which could be seen from the notes behind the Spiritual Attribute on the attribute page.
Normally, king-level cultivators cultivate by interacting their Divine Souls with Heaven and Earth, comprehending the Laws, confirming themselves, then withdrawing their Divine Souls to absorb Heavenly Energy and convert it into the Laws’ Origin and Law Divine Power.
They would then continue interacting their Divine Souls with Heaven and Earth, comprehending and confirming, similar to the cyclical flow of True Strength.
Every time a Mythical King’s Divine Soul delved deeply into the world, touching the world’s Laws and interacting with Heaven and Earth, it would consume a massive amount of Divine Soul strength.
Only someone like Jack Clark, who maintains a continuous connection and simultaneously comprehends five Higher-order Laws and one Supreme Law, could withstand such crazy actions. His consumption every moment was more than twenty times that of other Mythical Kings.
Taking his gaze off the attribute page, Jack Clark revealed a smile on his face, “After another two or three days of closed-door cultivation, all the Laws should reach minor completion, breaking through to the mid-period of Myth.”
Jack Clark was quite satisfied with his cultivation progress.
As long as he had enough Attribute points to burn, his progress in the Mythical Realm could rival the speed of advancement through the Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Layers Heaven. It would take him only a month or two to break through to Heavenly King.
By then, he would once again shake the entire Federation and stun everyone.
Imagining the awe-inspiring scene of breaking through to Heavenly King, Jack Clark vanished from the Plane World.
“Greetings to Your Majesty,” respectfully saluting the suddenly appearing Jack Clark, the two soldier cultivators stationed at the temporary Command Center stood with solemn expressions.
Jack Clark nodded slightly to them, “No need for formalities.”
At that moment, a flash of silver, and Mathilda Ward appeared not far away, looking at Jack Clark with his black hair cascading down his shoulders and a smile on her face, “Jack Clark, your closed-door cultivation has ended.”
“Yes, it has, Sister Ilisa. Nothing major happened these past days, right?” Jack Clark replied, smiling at the breathtakingly beautiful Mathilda Ward.
After a path of slaughter and battle to this point, it was only in front of acquaintances that Jack Clark would relax a bit.
“Nothing significant in the past few days; everything is under control, including the original territory of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe on the other side of the cracks,” Mathilda Ward reported.
As she approached Jack Clark and noticed the increasingly heavy aura of the young man, awe appeared in her eyes, “Jack Clark, you’ve made significant progress in your cultivation this time, haven’t you?”
Jack Clark didn’t hide it, “Pretty good. The closed-door cultivation was fruitful, and I should be able to break through to the mid-Mythical Stage in about a week.”
Hiss! Even Mathilda Ward involuntarily took a sharp breath. This guy was still so frightening after breaking through the Mythical Realm; he was simply monstrous.
“Worthy of you. To think, it took my father more than two years to go from the early Myth to the mid-period.”
“Not bad,” Jack Clark responded, smiling. Then he continued, “Since there’s nothing going on here, I’ll head back to Mist River City. I promised my mother I’d accompany her to the countryside to tend to the graves today.”
“Tending to graves,” Ilisa blinked.
After greeting Valentine Leach and Kavadola, Jack Clark transformed into a bolt of golden light shooting up into the sky, crossing over half of Eastern Summer at more than twenty times the speed of sound.
In just a few minutes, Jack Clark crossed over a thousand kilometers and appeared above Mist River City.
It was Sunday, nine in the morning. Doris Clark and Glenn Clark were already standing at the courtyard gate, carrying candles, a box of paper money, candies, fruits, white wine, and other offerings, along with firecrackers.
A black SUV was already parked there.
Once they put everything into the trunk, Glenn Clark spoke eagerly, “Mom, let me drive later, and you and brother can sit in the back.”
“You haven’t even gone to driving school, how can you drive? Not to mention whether you can drive safely, what if we get pulled over by the police?” Doris Clark replied incredulously.
Glenn Clark chuckled, “Mom, although I don’t have a driver’s license, I’ve already learned how to drive using Ilisa’s dad’s car. I assure you there won’t be a problem.”
“As for the traffic police, we don’t have to worry, since my brother is…”
Smack!
Doris Clark lifted herself onto her tiptoes and smacked Glenn Clark on the shoulder with a stern look, “Even if your brother is a king, you still have to obey the law, understand?”
Instantly, Glenn Clark shrank his neck and nodded hastily, “Mom, I know, I was just joking.”
Seeing him admit his mistake, Doris Clark’s tone softened a bit, “You’d better have been joking.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1143 - 1143 459 Awakening of the Titan Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1143: Chapter 459: Awakening of the Titan Emperor Dragon, Descent of the Crimson Will (7.4K) Chapter 1143: Chapter 459: Awakening of the Titan Emperor Dragon, Descent of the Crimson Will (7.4K) Looking at the 1.6-meter-tall Doris Clark standing on her tiptoes to scold Glenn Clark, who was as tall as a small giant at 2 meters, Jack Clark couldn’t help but ask, “What happened?”
Glenn Clark touched the back of his head, somewhat embarrassed, “Bro, I made Mom angry.”
Then Glenn Clark repeated what he had just said.
Hearing this, Jack Clark smiled and said, “I thought it was something serious. Mom, it’s okay, Jim may appear reckless, but he’s actually very thoughtful.”
“However, Jim, sometimes a casual joke is also an unconscious manifestation, you should be more low-key in your actions in the future.”
“Under normal conditions, it’s quite normal for King-level individuals to extend their benefits to family members. For instance, there are some High-Ranking Powerhouses lurking around our house right now, ensuring your safety.”
“As for wanting wealth, that’s even simpler. Those ordinary things I left for Mom are worth tens of billions, not to mention the Refined Giant Beast Blood and Flesh I send back each month, which is even more valuable.”
“But you have to understand that all this comes from me, not from you. For cultivators, only the strength they control themselves truly belongs to them.”
“So once you start cultivation, even if your progress is quicker compared to your peers, don’t be complacent, because you’re starting from a higher baseline. Naturally, you must have higher demands for yourself.”
“And what Mom said just now was not wrong— even though we possess power above the mundane, we still have to abide by basic rules.”
“This abidance is not for show, but to discipline oneself. A person without fear or boundaries will face madness and destruction.”
“Brother, I got it,” Glenn Clark said seriously, nodding his head.
Jack Clark patted his shoulder, “Of course, this adherence to rules applies only to our Human Race. When it comes to the likes of the Evil God Sect and Purgatory True Demons, we do whatever it takes, as long as we eliminate the enemy.”
After he finished, Jack Clark turned to Doris Clark and smiled, “Mom, get in the car, I’ll drive.”
“Alright,” Doris Clark nodded, somewhat reassured.
The Clark family’s old home was over seventy kilometers from Mist River City; leaving the city, they had to take the highway to town and then follow a village road for another ten plus kilometers.
Soon Jack Clark had the car on the highway, and feeling a bit cramped, Glenn Clark shifted his position and then curiously asked, “Bro, I read online that you suppressed the Violent Dragon King Kavadola with just one move?”
“Yes,” Jack Clark nodded.
Glenn Clark was puzzled, “But weren’t you just a new Mythical King? That Kavadola was said to be in the Mid-Mythical Stage, how come he was so weak?”
A smile appeared on the corners of Jack Clark’s mouth, “Jim, for a cultivator, realm is one thing, combat power is another, like a fourteen or fifteen-year-old you taking on a thirty-year-old man.”
“I understand, brother.” Although Jack’s analogy was a bit odd, Glenn Clark still chuckled hehe.
Once the brothers had finished their chat, Doris Clark then expressed her concerns, “Jack, is the mythical world really dangerous? I heard it’s full of Giant Beasts as massive as mountains and teeming with monsters.”
Jack Clark reassured her, “Mom, don’t worry, the dangers there are meant for ordinary cultivators. For us, the risks are not significant…”
Jack Clark then briefly introduced them to the situation of the mythical world, of course, only selecting what were safe to discuss.
Such as how he roamed hundreds of thousands of kilometers, cut his way through the Evil God Sect and ventured into a so-called dangerous yet ‘average difficulty’ forbidden area…
Clark Village was located outside Great Mountain Town. Although the number of ordinary Mutated Creatures in the wilderness had increased over the years, they were still suppressed in the deep mountain old forest under the annual major clean-ups by the military.
Therefore, most rural areas in Eastern Summer still existed and, due to environmental factors, had become more profitable.
The cultivated grains yielded higher output, the vegetables tasted better, and during their free time, people could capture small animals with slight mutations to sell, fetching high prices.
Of course, those who could afford it still wanted to move to megacities, as this increased the chances of their children becoming cultivators since the educational gap between villages and cities remained large.
Around ten in the morning, Jack Clark drove up to the outskirts of Clark Village and could see a group of about ten people sitting under a large tree chatting idly at the entrance of the village.
Seeing the three people getting out of the car by the roadside, they did not recognize the Clark brothers, who had not returned for over a decade, but they all knew Doris Clark.
Suddenly, a man in his seventies shouted, “Doris Clark, it’s good you’re back, go to Old Mountain behind your house and take a look—people say your ancestral grave is emitting blue smoke.”
…Ancestral grave emitting blue smoke. Not only Doris Clark and Glenn Clark, but even Jack Clark was somewhat puzzled.
What was going on?
The ancestors of the Clark family had been financial well-to-do for several generations, owning a small hill in Clark Village as a burial ground, which was called Old Mountain—just beyond Clark Village.
So, hearing that blue smoke was coming from their ancestral grave, Jack Clark immediately looked toward the village rear, golden vertical pupils emerging in his eyes as his gaze pierced through the forest on the hillside.
Overgrown with weeds and twisted small trees, the hillside hosted seven separate burial mounds, including the graves of Jack’s father, grandfather, grand-uncle, great-grandfather.
And at that moment, strands of blue smoke were rising in broad daylight from the desolate hill, looking eerily unnatural.
Yet in reality, the area was experiencing unstable space with a dozen or so fine Black Cracks appearing, with streams of blue energy leaking out—a sight resembling blue smoke being emitted.
“Jack, Jim, take the stuff on your backs and let’s hurry over to check,” Doris said.
“Okay, Mom,” Glenn Clark replied, excitedly slinging the box of candles and paper money onto his back, quickly bounding up the hillside of Clark Village, covering hundreds of meters in a few leaps, and then excitedly shouting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1144 - 1144 459 Awakening of the Titan Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1144: Chapter 459: Awakening of the Titan Emperor Dragon, Descent of the Crimson Will (7.4K)_2 Chapter 1144: Chapter 459: Awakening of the Titan Emperor Dragon, Descent of the Crimson Will (7.4K)_2 “Mom, it’s really emitting green smoke.”
“What…”
Doris Clark hurriedly ran up and looked at the hillside opposite her with a gaping mouth, incredulous, “Could it really be that our ancestral grave is showing its spirit, and that’s why Jack’s cultivation is so rapid.”
Suddenly, Doris Clark had a realization and became excited, “Quick, Jim, go offer some paper money to your dad and them, they must know we were coming back today.”
“Hold on, Mom, let me take a photo.” Glenn Clark excitedly took out his mobile phone and snapped a picture of the opposite side, posting it to a private group, mentioning everyone.
“May, Nora, Mengmeng, come out and see this, my family’s ancestral grave just blew up.”
…Watching the excited Doris Clark, Jack Clark just released a wisp of Divine Soul power without saying a word.
Boom! The space vibrated slightly, and the previously somewhat unstable fluctuations gradually calmed down, instantly healing the minute cracks and making them disappear.
What also disappeared was the spreading green smoke, which was actually a kind of violent energy containing toxic miasma.
Even though Jack Clark had smoothed the vibrating space, he felt that the tale of green smoke coming out of his family’s ancestral grave would turn more and more mysterious.
While Jack Clark was accompanying the excited Doris Clark in paying respects at the grave, the mythical world underwent a powerful quake that shook Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
Following the impact of an ancient creature that stretched over twenty kilometers, a brown mountain range as tall as ten thousand meters and extending tens of kilometers, with a metal-like appearance, trembled and collapsed.
In the midst of the mountains crumbling and the Earth splitting, the ancient creature briefly paused before continuing to forge ahead with rollicking white waves.
However, just as it passed through the mountain range, the Earth in front of it shook and tore again, and amidst thundering noises, another brown rock mountain range rose up, blocking its path.
The ten thousand meter high mountain peak was like a small hill in front of the ancient creature that was over twenty kilometers long with limbs touching the ground fifteen kilometers away, and its massive body bulldozed right through.
Boom!
The Earth vibrated, the mountain ranges shattered, and the Terrifying Power exploded, causing the entire mountain range to collapse under the impact, with giant boulders exploding and stirring up billowing smoke and dust.
But because of the obstruction by the rock mountain range, the ancient creature’s massive body paused once again.
Roar! Repeated obstructions caused the ancient creature, driven only by instinct, to let out an angry roar filled with frustration, slowly turning its head to look to the side.
Miles away stood a Crystal Red Giant Dragon, its body spanning two thousand eight hundred meters, with wings stretching thousands of meters, towering hundreds of kilometers above, with the faint illusion of the Earth surrounding it, exuding the Terrifying Power typical of a Titan in its late period.
The most important aspect was that the aura of the Titan Dragon was connected to that particular patch of Heaven and Earth, and with every move, it could invoke the Power of Heaven and Earth over a range of several hundred thousand kilometers, making its battle strength comparable to that of a Titan at its peak.
Sensing the connection between the Giant Dragon’s aura and the Heaven and Earth, the ancient creature eventually turned back and continued moving forward, causing the Earth to quake and split wherever it went.
Seeing the ancient creature surrounded by Cloud Mist leave into the distance, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon murmured a low growl, “Adriana, this is as much as I can help you.”
At that moment, a powerful Will descended, shaping into the phantom of a Blue-White Giant Dragon, which also let out a low growl, “This is enough.”
Although it was unclear what the ancient creature was planning to do, since they were natural enemies, the Blue-White Giant Dragon formed ice mountains in its path to obstruct it as the being moved around its territory.
After the ancient creature moved past its territory, the Blue-White Giant Dragon allowed its friend, the mother of Telsafi, to continue intervening.
Due to the consecutive obstructions from the two Titan Dragons, it took the ancient creature nearly ‘six days’ to traverse their territories and enter the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In the ferocious Chaotic Turbulent Region, where Heaven and Earth flipped and rules were in chaos, blue Tornadoes reaching from Earth to sky struck the ancient creature’s body, then burst apart in thunderous collapses.
Standing at the edge of the ‘world’ in ruins, a wisp of crimson energy circulated in the ancient creature’s massive gray stone eyes, transforming into the phantom of a transparent red Tiger Whale.
Utilizing the resonance between Tiger Whale bloodlines, the ancient creature moved with great momentum—covering several kilometers in a single step—and soon traversed thousands of kilometers to reach the Seaside.
Boom!
Its seven-kilometer-thick limbs entered the sea, causing an explosion of sea water, which raised a tsunami reaching over a kilometer in height, spreading in all directions, causing hundreds of kilometers’ worth of Mutated Creatures to flee in panic.
With clouds above and only its knees submerged in the three-thousand-meter-deep sea, the ancient creature raised surges of white wave with a thunderous motion.
As a life form that had grown to the peak of an Ancient Titan, once a wisp of its Will awakened, there were many ways it could locate the Destruction Emperor Dragon, even with its changed aura.
After creating a puppet Giant Beast through Power Invasion, obtaining information about the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and then using the bloodline Power obtained from Tiger One and Tiger Two, it found the Chaotic Sea area.
And what followed…
Deep in the thousand-meter-deep sea, a dark and cold place, a Flood Dragon behemoth of more than 150 meters was coiled on top of a small hill, in Hibernation.
Beneath it, clusters of green crystals shone, emitting a faint glow and rich energy, which the Flood Dragon behemoth absorbed with each breath.
But at that moment, a denser blackness spread through the darkness, silently enveloping the blue-scaled Flood Dragon behemoth and the small hill where it lay.
Under the force of that absolute darkness, the green crystals instantly lost their gleam.
Roar! The Flood Dragon behemoth suddenly let out an enraged roar, with blue Radiance intensifying on its body, forming countless sharp blue thorns that Burst out in all directions.
