﻿Chapter 1145: Chapter 459: The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens, the Crimson Will Descends (7.4K)_3 Chapter 1145: Chapter 459: The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens, the Crimson Will Descends (7.4K)_3 Just then, in the darkness, a ferocious maw akin to a black hole appeared out of nowhere, emitting a terrifying gravitational force that devoured everything, and it clamped down in a bite.
Boom!
The seawater exploded, mixing with countless remnants of flesh and blood, as the half-corpse of a Flood Dragon behemoth slowly settled on the ground amidst the darkness, and the silhouette of a Female Tiger Whale came into view.
Crimson blood sprayed out from the Flood Dragon’s corpse, quickly staining the surrounding seawater red. Amid the rich scent of blood, the Female Tiger Whale leisurely approached the halved Flood Dragon corpse.
Crack! The neck of the Flood Dragon behemoth was torn asunder, and from within its flesh emerged a golden Level 8 Life Crystal, radiating a dense aura of life.
Seeing this, the Female Tiger Whale’s eyes showed a satisfied smile, having collected another High-level Life Crystal for the king.
Controlling the current, the Female Tiger Whale used it to wrap the Life Crystal and swallowed it into her subspace. Then, she devoured the remaining half of the Flood Dragon behemoth’s corpse in one gulp.
Just as the Female Tiger Whale had swallowed the Flood Dragon behemoth, she suddenly turned to look ahead. From afar, a terrifying aura swept over everything, and the invisible pressure instinctively made her tremble.
A Horrific Creature had appeared and was rapidly approaching in this direction.
Boom!
The seawater exploded, and the Female Tiger Whale turned into a blur of black and white, frantically swimming to the side. In the blink of an eye, she dashed tens of kilometers away, planning to avoid the terrifying presence.
But soon, horror appeared in the Female Tiger Whale’s eyes, for she felt that the direction of the terrifying presence had also changed. Was she the target?
Feeling the indescribable terrifying pressure, the Female Tiger Whale once again changed direction, unfolding her Dark Domain to hide her presence and dived thousands of kilometers into the seabed.
But the shock waves from the water grew stronger and stronger, and that horrific aura was rapidly closing in on her.
Bang! The sea surface burst open, and the one hundred and fifty-meter-long Female Tiger Whale shot out of the water. Looking back, she immediately saw something that filled her eyes with terror.
Two hundred kilometers to her rear, a gigantic creature half-submerged in the sea, its body covered in rocks resembling mountain ranges, was making its way forward.
As it passed, the seawater exploded, causing tsunamis thousands of kilometers high, and with each breath, it exhaled an endless aura that enveloped Heaven and Earth.
Whistle!
The Female Tiger Whale let out a sound like a ship’s horn as all the strength within her body erupted. She transformed into a black and white sword, shooting out and tearing through the sea surface.
However, the direction she swam in wasn’t toward the Rift World.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon was powerful, the Female Tiger Whale felt the creature as big as mountain ranges was even more terrifying. Not even the king was a match, so she dared not lead it back.
Otherwise, not only she would die, but Joe and the third one would too.
Just as the Female Tiger Whale was resolved to lure away the Horrific Creature and sacrifice herself, the sea ahead exploded again, revealing a small island-sized brown mountain peak.
The head of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle peeked out. It looked at the Female Tiger Whale shooting towards it and at the towering tsunami and monstrous figure behind her with a shock.
Roar! Horned Lady, what’s happened? What is that thing following you?
Feeling the dreadful presence drawing increasingly close, the Female Tiger Whale let out an urgent cry: Domination, run in another direction! I’m being targeted by this Horrific Creature; I can’t escape it.
The limbs of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle moved, and it bellowed in pursuit of the Female Tiger Whale: Roar! Horned Lady, are you trying to lead it away?
Whine! Yes, I’m trying to lead it in a different direction. Otherwise, if it hits the Rift World, we’ll all be in danger.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle glanced back at the Horrific Creature, which was moving slowly but drawing ever closer, and let out an urgent bellow: Roar! You can’t outswim that thing, you’ll definitely be devoured.
Roar! Let’s go, find Thunderflame.
The Female Tiger Whale shook her head in refusal as she urgently called out with determination: No, the king will be in danger, and so will Joe.
Roar! Fool, Thunderflame is invincible, let’s go.
Boom! In a roar, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle slammed into the Female Tiger Whale’s side with a thud, knocking her a thousand meters away in the direction of the Rift World.
Whine! But…
Bang!
As the Female Tiger Whale attempted to argue, she was struck again by the thick shell on the back of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, catapulted for kilometers through the exploding seawater, and splashed down into the sea, sending water skyward.
Roar! You’re Joe’s wife; how can I explain to him if you die?
Roar! Don’t worry, Thunderflame is invincible; surely, it can shatter that creature. It dares trouble the beasts of our Dragon Palace, seeking death.
Bang! Bang! Bang! At this moment, the distant seawater exploded again as nine ferocious dragon heads emerged.
Seeing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle knocking the Female Tiger Whale away, Kidora’s nine heads swayed, emitting chaotic low growls: Roar! Domination, why did you hit Joe’s wife? Aren’t you afraid he will fight you to the death?
Roar! Stop talking nonsense, run!
In the midst of the roaring, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Female Tiger Whale kicked up a violent wave. With a bang, they shot past the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, splashing it all over its nine faces.
Although the Three-headed Giant Beast hunted high-level mutant beasts separately to collect Life Crystals for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, they weren’t too far apart from each other.
And at this time, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon noticed the immense figure blocking out the sky and sun a hundred kilometers away. Instantly, a terrifying oppressive force struck it, causing its entire body to tremble.
“What is this Giant Beast, how can it be so huge!”
Roar! Stop gaping and run, Kidora! The Deep Sea Dragon Palace turned back and roared.
Roar! Roar! Roar! Wait for me. The Nine-headed Flood Dragon finally reacted, its nine heads flailing in panic as its tail whipped around like a propeller, spiraling out explosively.

chapters.title: Chapter 1146 - 1146 459 The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1146: Chapter 459: The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens, the Crimson Will Descends (7.4K)_4 Chapter 1146: Chapter 459: The Titan Emperor Dragon Awakens, the Crimson Will Descends (7.4K)_4 As a member of the Flood Dragon species, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon was very fast in the sea, like a supersonic sharp blade, it quickly caught up with the two Giant Beasts and let out a chaotic roar, “Roar roar roar! How did you manage to provoke such a horrific creature?”
The Female Tiger Whale, having given up on ‘suicide,’ let out a whining cry, “It wasn’t me that provoked it; it seems I was its target all along.”
Instantly, all nine dragon heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon showed a strong Killing Intent, roaring, “Roar roar roar! Seek death, go back and find Abbott to kill it; how dare it actively bully our Dragon Palace.”
Like the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Kidora was also filled with blind confidence towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon, believing that no matter how terrifying this gigantic creature was, it would not be a match for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Though in terms of size, the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed to be just over 1,000 meters, but so what? It was the invincible Abbott.
Rift World.
As the ancient creature approached 1,000 kilometers, a pair of golden vertical pupils suddenly opened beneath the scorching Lava Lake, filled with indescribable majesty.
The eyes within the golden vertical pupils were cold, like the high and lofty ‘heaven,’ looking down upon all things, and in an instant, a terrifying Aura descended.
Boom!
The entire Rift World began to shake, and the Lava Lake spanning tens of kilometers erupted explosively, raising a magma Tsunami thousands of kilometers high, flinging it in all directions.
In an instant, an area of over two hundred kilometers was submerged by a Magma Fire Sea; trees burned, and some of the weaker Unique Beasts howled in anguish.
The terrifying aura instantly awakened the golden-blue Giant Dragon that had completed its breakthrough and was slowly reviving from afar. The elegant and beautiful figure promptly rose, looking into the distance.
There, in the center of the exploding Lava Lake, a gigantic Black-Red claw slowly emerged from the edge of a massive Black Hole, and with a loud thud, landed on the edge of the burning Earth.
Then, a body as vast as mountain ranges slowly appeared.
With a body length of about 1,900 meters, resembling a small mountain range, with a shoulder height of over 800 meters, it stood on Earth, exuding a sense of oppression.
At this moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was still in a state of Transformation. However, it had already stepped into the Titan Level in terms of strength, and its overall image had undergone many changes compared to the past.
For example, its form had become more symmetrical, with the tail ratio changing from 5.3/4.7 to 5.5/4.5; out of its 1,900-meter-long body, the tail now occupied just over 1,000 meters.
The body remained robust and muscular, with thick hind limbs, slender and sharp front claws, and a head resembling the Eastern Divine Dragon but more ferocious and oppressive. The Black mane on its head was thicker and longer and moved on its own without wind.
Its entire body was covered with Black-red Scaled Armor, each scale the size of a house, with surfaces covered in Black Gold and various other muted patterns.
The three rows of Dorsal Fins on its back were like sharp mountain peaks, with additional black mane-like hairs in the middle, snaking to the tail.
There, the Dorsal Fins still merged into sharp Black-Red Blade Edges, radiating a sharp and terrifying Aura.
Regarding the pair of wings formed by the scale armor on its back, they had become thicker, with sharp edges like blades, appearing as a pair of Black-Red metal Blade Wings, making it look even more domineering.
The now Titan Level Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed even more majestic and imposing, and due to the dense mane on its head and the hairs on its back, it had a touch of fluid elegance as well.
Golden-blue Giant Dragon’s eyes brightened upon seeing this form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as it was fond of elegance.
However, this was just a change in appearance. At this time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Scales and mane were surrounded by streams of black air. Calling it black was one thing, but a closer look would reveal it contained a variety of colors.
It was like the embodiment of all-encompassing Chaos, a sign of the initial fusion of Laws. With eight grandly accomplished Higher-order Laws merging initially within the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, they formed a development world akin to Chaos, invisibly radiating indescribable horrifying power.
Under normal conditions, the Destruction Emperor Dragon would only awaken after the ‘Chaos Law World’ transformation was complete, fully becoming a Titan Level Giant Beast.
But at this time…
Boom!
The entire world shook violently, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon emerged at the edge of the Rift World, looking towards the three Giant Beasts crazily swimming back and the massive creature moving behind them.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately recognized it as the ancient creature that had blocked world passageway number three and its eyes grew even colder. “I haven’t come looking for you yet, but you’ve come knocking first.”
“Since that’s the case, I’ll completely destroy you today.”
For the ancient creature that wanted to devour it in one bite, the Destruction Emperor Dragon certainly hadn’t forgotten. Even if it hadn’t come looking for trouble, the Destruction Emperor Dragon would’ve sought it out and killed it.
Beyond revenge, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was also curious about the petrified state of those who had failed to break through to the level of ancient true spirits. It wondered if their ‘flesh and blood’ was edible.
At that moment, the golden-blue giant dragon also flew over, radiating mythic pressure, but in front of the current Destruction Emperor Dragon, it seemed like a little girl.
However, when it saw the massive creature moving behind the Female Tiger Whale, its eyes widened, and it growled gravely, “Thunderflame, is that an ancient creature!?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a slow growl, “I know, but it doesn’t matter.”
Soon, the three-headed giant beast approached the Rift World. From afar, they saw the Rift World falling from thousands of kilometers up in the sky and the black-red colossal beast standing at the edge of the crack.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out an excited roar: Roar! Thunderflame, you’ve woken up just in time. There’s a big fellow that’s been chasing and trying to kill us, smash it.
F​​eeling the terrifying aura that crushed spacetime emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon rolled around excitedly on the sea surface, emitting chaotic roars.
“Roar roar roar!! Abbott, help us take revenge. This detestable creature nearly scared me to death. It’s too terrifying; my tail is still trembling.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon acted as the backbone for these giant beasts, instilling them with the courage to face opponents, no matter how strong, without fear when it appeared.
Even the Female Tiger Whale, which had thought the Destruction Emperor Dragon was no match for that horrific creature, also unconsciously sighed with relief upon seeing that fierce and majestic figure.
Roar!
The ancient creature that had been controlling its speed to chase the three-headed giants slowed down its steps and let out a deep growl from within the mountain peak in the rift.
Looking at the black-red colossal beast that had entered the Titan level, the ancient creature’s form trembled, cracks spider-webbed across its surface, and instantly, a terrifying aura filled the air.
It was as if some horrific existence was awakening, while its mouth emitted unconscious growls and chaotic fluctuations of will.
“Heaven, eat, you.”
Feeling the rule aura spreading from that ancient creature, intense battle intent shone in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Its mane of black hair moved as if blown by wind, flames burning upon it.
The six crystal red feather horns on either side shone brightly, giving it an incredibly majestic and fierce look.
“You all stay back a bit.” The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly as it slowly stepped out from the Rift World. Immediately after, from within its body a terrifying aura spread that made heaven and earth shudder.
Boom! Endless red light illuminated the heavens and earth, and black-red bolts of lightning crackled and whizzed across the sky like lingering bloodstains.
Amidst the dazzling red light, the size of the Destruction Emperor Dragon expanded rapidly. With crackling sounds, a 4,000-kilometer-long crimson destruction beast appeared.
Boom boom boom!!
The sky trembled under the presence of a being comparable to the ancient titans, the sea whipped up thousands of kilometers high tsunamis, forming a waterless zone a hundred kilometers across, revealing the collapsing seabed below.
Beneath the red light, space shattered like glass, annihilating and forming a black-red destruction area tens of kilometers across, resembling an independent world.
Standing tall in the midst of this black-red world, the three-thousand-meter-tall deep red Destruction Beast, enwoven with black, red, gold, and purple lightning intertwining and emitting a terrifying destructive aura.
In that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon embodied the primordial beast of destruction, its very presence annihilating and crushing everything.
At the same time, behind it, under the reflection of the infinite red light, the projection of the deep red world formed once more, and this time the world projection was even clearer.
In that world of red light and destruction, a terrifying figure tens of thousands of meters in length emerged, radiating a despair-inducing aura to all living beings.
That massive figure shrouded in red mist slightly lowered its enormous, blurry head, and immediately a dreadful gaze pierced through endless spacetime, focused on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Then, a powerful will trembled through spacetime, echoing in the depths of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s consciousness: “You, are you interested in becoming my crimson proxy, wielding destruction?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, its voice thundering through heaven and earth: “There’s no rush, let’s talk after I’ve killed it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1147 - 1147 460 The Nine Higher-Order Laws Advancing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1147: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-Order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction Chapter 1147: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-Order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction As the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered its Deep Red Form, cracks appeared all over the ancient creature’s body, and endless white mist sprayed out, filling an area of hundreds of kilometers.
Within this area, the laws of heaven and earth were suppressed, all forcibly subdued by the reviving ancient creature’s ruling power.
Roar! The Deep Red Destruction Beast let out a fierce roar, radiating dazzling red light as it instantly appeared above the ancient creature.
Boom! The moment the black and red domain surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon came into contact with the white mist, it was like two worlds colliding, unleashing a terrifying energy impact.
Under the horrific destructive force, space collapsed, creating a ring-shaped black tide that exploded, blasting the atmosphere, reversing the sea water, and revealing the shattered seabed below.
Just then, amidst the mist, an ancient being resembling a grey dragon lion suddenly raised its head, its massive mouth opening to form a vast black hole tens of kilometers wide.
Boom!
Under the horrendous Burst of Devouring power, the space within a radius of tens of kilometers crumbled; all matter and energy, including the sea water, were engulfed, forming a black Tornado devouring everything in its path.
In the center of that world-ending Devouring Vortex, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood firm, with black, blue, and purple lightning entwined around it, obliterating everything.
Whether it was tangible ruling strength or the intangible forces of gravity and suction, all were destroyed, impervious to all laws.
Meanwhile, more than two hundred kilometers away, a golden-blue Giant Dragon spiraled above the Firmament, emitting a grave roar.
“Thunderflame, be careful. My mother once said that although these ancient beings have lost their talents and divine powers due to petrification, leaving behind only their petrified bodies, one must never get swallowed by them. Otherwise, you will be refined by the rules inside,” the golden-blue Giant Dragon roared solemnly from afar.
Roar!
At that moment, as the mist below dissipated and seeing the Devouring suction unable to shake the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the ancient being’s colossal head lunged forward, biting with a seemingly slow but actually swift speed.
Boom! The black hole, bristling with teeth sharp like mountain peaks, chomped down, and space itself was bitten into a kilometers-wide Void, devoured by the abyss.
But at the very instant the Ancient Stone Lion lunged with its bite, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already turned into a streak of red lightning and appeared behind it, its double claws wrapped in eight types of lightning as it struck down.
Boom!
The terrifying double claws dispersed the mist, and the towering, ridgelike Dorsal Fins on its back shattered, with numerous petrified stones exploding to form a crater a kilometer wide and hundreds of meters deep.
Such formidable Defense made even the Destruction Emperor Dragon take note; truly, it was a creature from ancient times.
With its current strength, a single strike could blast half the body of a Titan Peak Giant Beast or collapse a mountain range, yet now it only created a small crater.
Roar! The Ancient Stone Lion let out an earth-shaking roar as the surrounding mist churned violently, exuding an indescribable pressure that bound everything between heaven and earth.
Energy, space, and laws all solidified under the power of the rule; that is the power of laws.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s power had also entered the Ancient Titan level; its black-red Destruction Domain clashed, exploded, and eroded fiercely with the mist.
When that ruling strength landed on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, black patterns flowed on its body, forming a layer of Chaos strength that could neutralize even laws.
Puff! The Tail Blade wrapped in eight types of lightning light cleaved through space, tore through the mist like a Black-Red Radiance, striking the lower jaw of the Stone Lion, which was turning to bite, at a terrifying speed.
Boom!
Rocks shattered as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s terrifying Tail Blade cut a fissure more than two thousand meters long and a thousand meters deep, its force causing the immense body of the Ancient Stone Lion to shake violently.
But immediately after, under the cover of the spreading white mist, wounds on the Ancient Stone Lion’s back and jaw visibly healed, with countless new stones materializing out of thin air, and more white mist spewed from the cracks on its body.
Amidst the roiling mist, a more formidable will awakened within the Ancient Stone Lion, and a faint flicker of other emotions appeared in its grey stone eyes—it was forcibly reviving itself.
“Roar! Heaven, I will devour you,” the Ancient Stone Lion growled deeply as it stomped with all four paws, instantly blasting the mist around it and sending the sea water within a range of over a hundred kilometers flying, causing the Earth to crack and shatter.
Boom boom boom!!
From deep within the cracks, sharp stone pillars surged skyward, while the Firmament inverted and fragmented, with giant, sharp pillars, tens of kilometers long, plummeting from the sky.
Witnessing this scene, the distant golden-blue Giant Dragon bellowed in astonishment, “Roar! How is this possible, it can still wield the mysteries of the laws!”
Boom!
A dazzling black and red Light Beam soared into the sky, shattering everything in its path, and in the thunderous explosion appeared high above, tens of thousands of meters in the air, revealing the silhouette of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Roar!
Looking down at the Ancient Stone Lion that had turned an area of two hundred kilometers into Stone Pillar Hell, the Crimson Destruction Beast let out a tyrannical roar as blue lightning exploded from its body, forming eleven Thunder Rings.
At the same time, a red radiance gathered in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth, each section of its Dorsal Fin radiating a more dazzling light, and instantly a terrifying aura of energy spread.
Boom!
A red Light Beam hundreds of meters thick shot out from the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth, doubling in aura with each Thunder Ring it passed through.
As the Breath passed through eleven Thunder Rings, heaven and earth darkened for an instant, and a red and white pillar of light, containing the ultimate destructive force, pierced through the Void, creating a black aura around it.
At this moment, the greatest sounds became silent, and the whole world grew quiet, leaving only the deceivingly slow-moving pillar of light, transcending past and future to appear above the head of the Ancient Stone Lion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148 - 1148 460 The Nine Higher-order Laws Advancing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1148: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction_2 Chapter 1148: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction_2 In the silent world, a pillar of light penetrated layer by layer through the thick, tens of kilometers of white mist, shattering stone pillars that stretched over like ten thousand meter mountains, finally landing on the back of the Ancient Stone Lion.
Boom!
The Earth trembled, the Silver Giant Dragon and other giant beasts were all deafened; their eyes could only see the dazzling red and white light in the distance, like the explosion of a star, releasing infinite light and heat.
Roar! Be careful.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out a terrified roar, followed by itself and all the giant beasts being engulfed by the Destructive Impact, tossed into the air by tsunamis thousands of meters high.
Boom boom boom! Heaven and Earth shook, the sun and moon reversed, and the breath infused with the ultimate power of destruction and impact force pierced through Heaven and Earth, continuously bombarding the Ancient Stone Lion.
Under the terrifyingly hot destructive force, half of the mountain range on the back broke apart, melted, exploded, being penetrated bit by bit.
Roar!
The Ancient Stone Lion let out a majestic roar, and from its mouth spewed a terrible suction force that enveloped dozens of kilometers ahead, causing the ground to fracture, and countless dirt and rocks to be devoured continuously.
Thus when the Destructive Breath that lasted for more than ten minutes dissipated, a giant pit with a diameter of over a hundred kilometers appeared in front of the Ancient Stone Lion.
With the Ancient Stone Lion at its center, sea water disappeared within a radius of hundreds of kilometers, and the air was filled with violent destructive energy, while the fractured seabed melted into magma under the diffusing intense heat.
Meanwhile, as the explosion and impact dissipated, the distant sea water poured back in torrents, raising an uproar like the mountains and seas were shaking.
Standing on the magma-covered Earth, the Ancient Stone Lion slightly lifted its head to look at the sky above, where a ferocious behemoth stood, emitting a dazzling red light, like a red sun.
With only a few exchanges, a hundred-kilometer range had been destroyed by two horrific creatures, the terrain altered, and they seemed to be evenly matched in strength.
Aloft above the Firmament, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked down with a cold gaze.
The breath bombing that lasted for more than ten minutes had nearly flattened the back of the Ancient Stone Lion and melted over a thousand meters of rock layers, about one-fifth of the Earth’s crust.
But now, countless rocks rose again on the back of the Ancient Stone Lion, quickly reforming into winding mountain ridges, radiating solidity and vastness.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, of course, was not surprised by this; after all, the opponent was an Ancient Titan at its peak, and even if it failed to breakthrough and was petrified, it wouldn’t be so easily destroyed.
Moreover, through the brief exchange, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had also gauged its own strength roughly.
As a Titan Beast wielding eight Higher-order Laws and a special Gigantification Talent, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stepped into Titan Level strength and became peerless within the same rank just as it entered, comparable to the peak of the Titans.
In the Gigantification state, its foundational strength, defense, and talents all soared twentyfold, directly breaking through constraints and stepping into the Ancient Titan level, capable of clashing with the force of laws.
Unfortunately, the Gigantification Talent had reached its limit by now, and provided limited amplification to it at the Titan level; for instance, its size had only doubled during this transformation.
And since the eight Higher-order Laws had not fully merged, it had only formed an extreme enhanced state with lightning attributes instead of more startling powers, which could have reached at least mid-period of an Ancient Titan.
This was also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not refuse the Crimson Will; if the power of gigantification could transform into a Higher-order Law, it would effectively be mastering three Supreme Laws.
Then, even when it later became an Ancient Titan or an Ancient True Spirit, it would have been unstoppable at the same rank and able to fight across ranks.
Of course, another reason was that Jack Clark had made contact with the Supreme Plane and possessed means to avoid contracts signed with the Soul Source, otherwise, he would certainly be cautious.
Between Heaven and Earth, the two horrific creatures faced off briefly, followed by the red sun plummeting from the sky, turning into a beam of light descending from above.
Boom! The great battle erupted once again in an instant.
Clutched within the Dragon Claw wrapped in eight kinds of lightning was a Golden Red Compressed Sun; a strike exploded the Ancient Stone Lion’s left claw, which was as thick as a kilometer, creating a massive gap.
Boom!
At that moment, a mountain range spanning ten kilometers fell from the sky, shattering space, leaving a long, dozens of kilometers black pathway in the Void before exploding the afterimage of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
In an instant, the once crumbled seabed exploded again, and a terrifying swipe of the tail directly tore a fissure over a hundred kilometers long, bottomless, with the impact force tossing the back-flowing sea water once more into the air.
Roar!
In the deep sea, two massive creatures let out savage roars, the terrifying sound waves crushed space, creating circles of black impacts sweeping across Heaven and Earth, and they began to fight fiercely.
The invisible force of the laws diffused, causing the entire ocean to rage chaotically, with black and red lightning tearing apart, destroying Heaven and Earth, affecting an area of over a thousand kilometers.
As the two horrific Giant Beasts fought, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Kamaitachi Beast, sensing the terrifying energy fluctuations from this side, flew back as well.
Within a level twenty-something apocalyptic typhoon, the Silver Giant Dragon circled with its wings beating, letting out an excited roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, kill it, the Great Sethia wants to stand on its head and shame it thoroughly.”
At this moment, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon that had been blown away by the previous explosion also flew back, also joining in with an excited roar, “Thunderflame, blow up that ancient creature!”
Watching the two massive creatures in their frenzied close combat, both dragons let out excited roars.
Upon the sea surface with tsunamis thousands of meters high, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Female Tiger Whale, and the Blue Giant Crab that had rushed back were constantly being tossed and falling, splashing the sea water explosively.
Under the full outburst of the Rule Level energies, these beasts, which hadn’t advanced to the Mythical level, had no power to resist at the moment.
And it wasn’t just these giant beasts; the seas around were filled with innumerable corpses of dead Unique Beasts, and countless marine beasts within thousands of kilometers were frantically fleeing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149 - 1149 460 The Nine Higher-Order Laws Advancing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1149: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-Order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction_3 Chapter 1149: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-Order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction_3 This is the battle of an Ancient Titan-level creature, where the mere aftermath is enough to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
The Kamaitachi Beast, spanning more than one thousand two hundred meters in length, excitedly flew through the air, its body trembling with exhilaration. Deep within the interlayer of the Void, only a waterfall served as a connecting mouth within the Rift World, where hundreds of mermaids lay limp on the surface of the water.
Their beautiful faces were flushed under the terrifying pressure, their eyes white, having fainted from the intimidation of the Ancient Titan’s aura.
At this moment, all the giant beasts… no, there was one small fellow who didn’t care.
Curled up comfortably in the mane nest on top of the Deep Red Destruction Beast’s vast, mountain peak-like menacing head, the Purple Little Dragon, now swollen to ten meters in length, slept soundly.
Wrapped in the flashes of rule lightning, it drooled from its mouth, making indistinct “yiya yiya” sounds as if it were saying, “Kill them, the great May demands rivers of blood.”
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but twitch the corner of its mouth at this.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, as long as four thousand meters, attacked like a bolt of red lightning around the Ancient Stone Lion, its double claws wreathed in lightning of various laws. Each strike caused space to shatter and mountain peaks to explode, leaving behind craters a kilometer across.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon consciously attacked one specific area repeatedly, almost blasting half of the Stone Lion’s side and back, creating a pit thousands of meters in diameter that bored deep into its abdomen.
Compared to the gray-white rock of its outer body, deep within, the Ancient Stone Lion’s body was even stronger and more formidable, like dark brown metal ore veins emanating an immovable terror.
Even the double claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon could only tear long cracks of several hundred meters that were tens of meters deep upon the dark brown body, and the act of tearing also triggered terrifying energy explosions.
At this point, it seemed the Destruction Emperor Dragon had the upper hand over the Ancient Stone Lion, but these injuries did not affect its core. The destroyed rocky parts of its body were regenerating at a shocking speed.
The white mist around the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew denser, and the suppression from the rule power grew stronger, continuously compressing the Black-Red Destruction Area that surrounded the Emperor Dragon.
The Ancient Stone Lion’s tactics were simple, relying only on Devouring to consume its target. Its “slow” attacks could not even touch the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Including the rule power, which was blocked by the Black-Red Destruction Area that surrounded the Destruction Emperor Dragon, being neutralized by the Chaotic Dark Power.
But at the same time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon also failed to inflict a heavy injury.
Compared to the rocky body formed by the fusion of dissipating rule power, the ununified eight Higher-order laws of lightning could not cause any harm and naturally dissipated upon slight contact.
Only by relying on the overwhelming strength of the Giant Beast Body was it possible to shatter the solidified rock.
The battle methods of the two giant beasts were incredibly simple and crude, but if the strength level hadn’t reached the Ancient Titan level, a single burst from either party would be enough to destroy everything.
Even the seemingly intangible white mist, once enveloped by a Titan Beast, could be instantly suppressed by the rule power and then Devoured by the Ancient Stone Lion.
As time passed, the battle range of the two giant beasts became wider, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon focused its attacks on the Ancient Stone Lion’s sturdy hind legs.
Roar! Suddenly, a roar shook Heaven and Earth, and the massive body of the Ancient Stone Lion explosively sat down, while at the same time, a mountain ridge spanning ten kilometers swept across.
Boom!
The instant the Destruction Emperor Dragon destroyed one of the Ancient Stone Lion’s hind legs, its massive body shot out like a red light shattering the void, flung over a thousand kilometers away.
In an instant, a stretch of sea spanning tens of kilometers exploded; countless sea water was vaporized by the horrific impact, causing a tsunami thousands of meters high to sweep in all directions.
Roar! With majestic and ferocious dominance, like the roar of an Ancient Beast, a red light soared to the heavens, standing in the sky over a hundred and fifty thousand meters high.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body was wrapped in rule lightning, its mere presence collapsed the Void, collapsed Heaven and Earth, and it gazed coldly into the distance with icy eyes.
There, the mist now covered a range of a thousand kilometers; within it, the sea water had vanished, and gray stone pillars rose up to the sky, each tens of thousands of meters tall.
Beneath the pervasive rule power, even space gradually petrified, becoming like a tangible world.
At the center of the misty world, the body of the Ancient Stone Lion had swelled to over fifty kilometers, larger and more imposing, its rule power even more frightening.
As it forcibly revived its will and continuously erupted with rule power, the last bits of the ancient creature’s Rule Origin began to dissipate, entering its ‘old age’.
But it wasn’t enough; an ancient creature in its old age could still exist for hundreds of thousands of years, possessing an unimaginably long ‘life,’ posing an ongoing threat.
Roar! The Deep Red Destruction Beast, towering three thousand meters high, roared and once again charged into the mist.
Bang! Bang! Bang! The petrified space, along with the stone pillars, was smashed layer by layer, and welcoming the Destruction Emperor Dragon was a terrifyingly large mouth that covered the sky for hundreds of kilometers.
Boom! Twisting space, a strike that seemed to Devour the sky and earth directly pierced the void, creating a Black Hole where law, space, matter, and energy were all Devoured.
But with the Law of Speed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was too fast, disregarding matter and spatial hindrances, and in an instant, it transformed into a red lightning bolt appearing behind the Ancient Stone Lion.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
At this moment, both parties were actually rapidly depleting, wondering whether the Rule Origin of the Ancient Stone Lion would fracture first, or the Destruction Emperor Dragon would no longer sustain its Crimson Form and die from exhaustion.
Or be petrified along with space by the rule power of the Ancient Stone Lion and Devoured in one bite.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150 - 1150 460 The Nine Higher-order Laws Advancing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1150: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction_4 Chapter 1150: Chapter 460: The Nine Higher-order Laws, Advancing to Deep Red Destruction_4 “`
As time passed, the range of the mist grew ever larger, eventually enveloping thousands of kilometers. The intangible pervading aura of the rules forced the Silver Giant Dragon and other giant beasts to retreat continuously.
And this battle had been raging for “two days”.
Feeling the terrifying energy fluctuations still bursting forth from deep within the mist, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles and other giant beasts floating on the sea surface couldn’t help but show concern in their eyes.
They had never seen the Destruction Emperor Dragon battle for so long before; opponents in the past would be obliterated by the Destruction Emperor Dragon within a few moves.
Despite the concerns of the Nine-headed Flood Dragons and others, the Silver Giant Dragon soared above the Firmament, emitting high-pitched roars, “Roar! Tim Abott is invincible, he will surely win.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon also elegantly soared in circles, firmly growling: “Indeed, Thunderflame will surely win, as long as it isn’t swallowed head-on by an ancient creature.”
Almost another day passed, and suddenly the horrific energy fluctuations at the depths of the mist disappeared, followed by a slight tremor that ran through Heaven and Earth.
Boom! The mist that enveloped tens of thousands of kilometers deep inside, the Ancient Stone Lion, which had expanded to hundreds of kilometers and had almost completely petrified, crumbled to pieces.
In an instant, endless rule power dissipated, Heaven and Earth quaked, and a gray mountain range stretching for thousands of kilometers rose up amid the rumbling Earth.
Roar!
At the forefront of the gray mountain range, atop a mountain peak reaching tens of thousands of meters, stood the three-thousand-meter-tall Deep Red Destruction Beast, roaring towards the sky with a terrifyingly ferocious aura.
Having just stepped into the Titan realm and slaughtering an ancient creature beyond its level, even it felt somewhat proud of this achievement.
However, at this moment, even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s aura was wildly fierce and terrifying, its energy was actually extremely weak, its red radiance dimmed, with only fine black lightning leaping across its surface.
The Qi Blood within its body was drastically depleted and weak, as the enormous consumption caused its previously ferocious and formidable body to look two sizes skinnier and somewhat shriveled.
This battle could be said to be the most difficult one the Destruction Emperor Dragon had fought since its Evolution.
There was no choice; the ancient creature’s blood was too thick, almost enough to exhaust it to death.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon caught its breath, an endless Crimson radiance spread between heaven and earth, the space-time intertwined, and the Deep Red World descended once again, enveloping this world.
In the depths of the Deep Red World, a terrifying existence tens of thousands of meters tall appeared once more, towering over the Earth with a body so vast it could have been a celestial body, stretching for countless kilometers.
In an instant, an invisible terrifying pressure spread across Heaven and Earth, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon… wasn’t affected in the slightest.
As a being of Heavenly Tier, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood equal to heaven, eternal and indestructible, quietly looking at the boundless phantom.
The two sides faced each other briefly, and then a piece of Deep Red Scales hundreds of meters in size pierced through Infinite spacetime, appearing before the Destruction Emperor Dragon alongside a stream of information.
This information detailed what it meant to become a Deep Red Destroyer—what it had to give up and what it would gain.
Compared to the painstaking explanations given to Jack Clark by the Lord of Hell, Alvaron, this being called Felix, the lord of the Deep Red, was somewhat more straightforward with its affairs.
There were also some differences between the Deep Red Destroyer and the Hell Messenger.
Upon signing the contract, a Deep Red Destroyer could invoke the power of the Deep Red Strength to descend, Evolving its Gigantification Talent into the Deep Red Strength of the rule, bringing destruction to billions of worlds.
The strength of the Transformed rule would depend on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s characteristic Gigantification Talent, as well as its own strength and the compatibility with the Deep Red World.
At the weakest, the Transformation could be to a Mid-order Rule but, with the Gigantification Talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon enhanced to the point of Deification, it could Transform at least to a Higher-order Rule.
And the Deep Red Strength did not require comprehension; all the Destruction Emperor Dragon needed to do was to continue fighting and killing, absorbing the power of destruction in great battles for advancement.
“`
And the fastest way to advance was to destroy worlds; if the power of Great Destruction that was born was strong enough, it could even evolve the Deep Red Strength into the Supreme Destruction Law.
Even one day, if the Destruction Emperor Dragon became strong enough to break through the Ancient Titan, it could delve deep into the Deep Red World, destroy worlds one by one, and ultimately become the lord of destruction of the Deep Red World.
[There are still a thousand words to follow, I’ll continue writing, please update first and refresh later to see it.]
The transformation directly into a Higher-order Law seemed to be stronger than the Power of Hell that Jack Clark controlled, given that currently, the Power of Hell’s strength was only comparable to a middle-order law.
But other than that, there were no other benefits, no Hell Coordinates.
Obviously, the conditions for each Supreme Plane were different, and furthermore, Jack Clark, unlike other travelers and the Destruction Emperor Dragon, was of a higher level.
His Qi Blood inside was depleted and weak, due to major consumption. His once fierce and mighty body now seemed to have shrunk, looking somewhat withered.
This battle was arguably the most difficult one that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had fought since its Evolution.
It couldn’t be helped, the blood of the ancient creature was too rich, almost completely draining the dragon.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon took a slight breath, endless crimson radiance spread between heaven and earth, space-time intersected, and the Deep Red World once again descended, shrouding this world.
In the depths of the Deep Red World, a terrifying existence standing tens of thousands of meters tall appeared again, towering over the Earth, its body stretching for countless kilometers.
In an instant, an invisible and terrifying pressure pervaded heaven and earth, pressing down on the Destruction Emperor Dragon… not affecting it in the least.
As a Heavenly-tier being, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Position Pattern was aligned with the heavens; eternal and indestructible. At this moment, it quietly observed that immense and boundless shadow.
The two forces stood off slightly, then a few hundred meters in size, a crimson scale pierced through infinite spacetime, appearing in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon. At the same time, there was a stream of information.
This information detailed what it would cost to become the Deep Red Destroyer, and what would be gained.
In contrast to Tim Abbott, the Lord of Hell, who patiently explained things to Jack Clark, this Deep Red Lord named Felix handled matters in a more straightforward and clear manner.
There were some differences between the Deep Red Destroyer and the Hell Messenger.
When signing the contract as the Deep Red Destroyer, one could summon the Deep Red Strength, evolving the Giantification Talent into the Law of Deep Red Strength and bring destruction to billions of worlds.
How strong the evolved Law would be depended on the unique Giantification Talent that the Destruction Emperor Dragon possessed, as well as its own strength and its compatibility with the Deep Red World.
The weakest would be able to transform into a middle-order law, and with the Destruction Emperor Dragon enhancing the Giantification Talent to the point of Deification, at the very least it would be able to transform into a Higher-order Law.
Moreover, the Deep Red Strength did not require comprehension; the Destruction Emperor Dragon just needed to continue fighting in countless battles, absorbing destructive power with each conflict to gain advancements.
And the fastest way to advance was to destroy worlds; if the power of Great Destruction that was born was strong enough, it could even evolve the Deep Red Strength into the Supreme Destruction Law.
Even one day, if the Destruction Emperor Dragon became strong enough to break through the Ancient Titan, it could delve deep into the Deep Red World, destroy worlds one by one, and ultimately become the lord of destruction of the Deep Red World.
[There are still a thousand words to follow, I’ll continue writing, please update first and refresh later to see it.]
The transformation directly into a Higher-order Law seemed to be stronger than the Power of Hell that Jack Clark controlled, given that currently, the Power of Hell’s strength was only comparable to a middle-order law.
But other than that, there were no other benefits, no Hell Coordinates.
Obviously, the conditions for each Supreme Plane were different, and furthermore, Jack Clark, unlike other travelers and the Destruction Emperor Dragon, was of a higher level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1151 - 1151 461
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1151: Chapter 461 Chapter 1151: Chapter 461 Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was invoking the power of the Deep Red World to undergo Law Transformation, it seemed to sense a fearsome will descending from the firmament.
Boom!
In an instant, the red ‘world’ where the Destruction Emperor Dragon resided shattered, and the terrifying astral shadow collapsed loudly.
However, because the Scale of the Contract was there, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was still drawing on the power of the Deep Red World to undergo Law Transformation, simultaneously quitting the Gigantified form with a mere thought.
Huff Huff!!
The black-red Colossal Beast, which had slimmed down considerably, stood on the mountain peak gasping for breath, feeling weak in all its limbs. It was the first time since setting out on the path of Evolution that it had fought to such an extent.
The Essence Blood was almost depleted.
This was the downside of the Deep Red Gigantification, as the energy consumed grew exponentially during a Limit Breakthrough, even its terrifying Giant Beast Body could only persevere for three days.
Luckily, with the Deep Red Law Metamorphosis refining the Qi Blood continuously, recovery began, and the body frantically absorbed energy from the Chaos Void.
Meanwhile, sensing the increasingly fearsome aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the sea water exploded outside of the mist, and one Giant Beast after another ascended to the skies after plunging into the sea.
The Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon, with the fastest speed, expanded their Dragon Wings furiously, resembling two massive fighter jets tearing through the mist at nearly twenty times the speed of sound.
Very soon, the two Mythical Dragons crossed thousands of kilometers, catching sight from afar of the Destruction Emperor Dragon atop a ten thousand meter mountain, its aura growing more terrifying.
Red lightning leaped around it, emitting a violent and frightening Destructive Aura.
“Roar! Tim Abott, invincible.”
The Silver Giant Dragon issued a triumphant roar, folding its Dragon Wings with a thunderous crash onto the mountain peak, immediately causing a several kilometers wide range of the Earth to shatter, and rocks to explode.
The raging blast of air, which approached the distant Destruction Emperor Dragon, was dispersed by the invisible encircling Power Pressure, exuding an air of supreme sanctity and ferocity.
“Roar! Damn it, Great Scythia said she would stand on your head and humiliate you thoroughly,” the Silver Giant Dragon scraped the grey rocks beneath its double claws, issuing a triumphant roar.
Just when the Destruction Emperor Dragon thought that this humiliation was over, the Silver Giant Dragon’s mouth was filled with a strong aura of Ice, and a rich white Ice Flame was spewed out.
Boom!
The Ice Flame containing the power of the ice Law spread across the mountain peak, reducing rocks to rubble, and revealing solid ice, forming a kilometer-wide ice layer with a thickness of over ten meters.
From afar, it seemed as if someone had spit several times on the mountain, a sight that made the corner of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eye twitch involuntarily.
The gold-blue Giant Dragon landed gracefully beside the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its crystalline, sparkling Dragon Wings tucking behind, took two steps forward with a low growl.
“Scythia has always been like this since childhood, its way of humiliating enemies is to stand on their heads and spit on them.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly lowered its head, looking at the gold-blue Giant Dragon on its body and let out a deep growl: “Does this mean it has always wanted to stand on your back and spit on you?”
The gold-blue Giant Dragon slightly raised its head, revealing a look of surprise: “Roar! Thunderflame, how did you know?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curved into a ferocious smile: “Because it has said it to me more than once, asking me to help it defeat you.”
Instantly, the gold-blue Giant Dragon instinctively took two steps back, its Dragon Wings slightly unfurling in a defensive stance.
The five-hundred-meter-long gold-blue Giant Dragon stood tall, with only two hundred meters at shoulder height, appearing like an adult next to a several-year-old girl in front of the one thousand nine hundred-meter-long Destruction Emperor Dragon.
And the invisible pressure they each emitted differed greatly in intensity; had the Destruction Emperor Dragon made a move…
Thinking about herself being stood on by that fool Scythia and being spat upon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon shuddered involuntarily.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curved upward, exhaling hot breath: “Rest assured, you are now a Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, naturally, I wouldn’t strike my own dragon.”
At that moment, the bragging Silver Giant Dragon turned back and roared, “Roar! Telsafi, Great Scythia is not so petty, Great Scythia has grown up.”
Grown up… Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon who had just finished spitting, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon both gave each other a peculiar look.
Then with a blast that tore through the mist, the Kamaitachi Beast, with its wings wide open, landed with a loud crash, causing dozens of kilometers to tremble around it.
“To see the Great King!” The Kamaitachi Beast, looking ferocious and grand, filled with excitement and adoration, gazed at the black-red Colossal Beast.
The King was too strong, having defeated such a terrifying and immense enemy, it was indeed worthy of being the King of the Dragon Palace.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, the nominal Dragon Palace Dragon King, it was completely ignored by the Kamaitachi Beast, who regarded the true King of the Dragon Palace, Thunderflame, as just a child in comparison.
Soon, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Female Tiger Whale, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Blue Giant Crab also flew up, expanding their domains, and then the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared excitedly.
Roar Roar!! Thunderflame, you are too badass, you exploded such a big enemy.
The Nine-headed monster Ghidorah was even more excited, rolling on the ground, the nine dragon heads twisted wildly emitting confused roars: “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, invincible, badass.”
This spectacle made even the Destruction Emperor Dragon feel its eyes stinging, sensing that as this creature grew stronger, its nine split consciousnesses became increasingly chaotic.
For example, now, because of too much excitement, all nine heads were giving orders, causing the body to twist wildly due to the overload of commands.

chapters.title: Chapter 1152 - 1152 461_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1152: Chapter 461_2 Chapter 1152: Chapter 461_2 “`
On the contrary, the Female Tiger Whale was much more normal, surrounded by a floating Dark Domain in the air, respectfully watching the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
As for the Blue Giant Crab…
Well, it wasn’t much better. Under the terrifying pressure emitted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its eight legs were limp on the ground, its eyes were rolling back and it was bubbling at the mouth.
In the end, the most obedient was the hibernating Purple little dragon, which gave the dragon one less thing to worry about.
Looking at these wildly acting subordinates, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Horned Lady, how many High-level Life Crystals have you collected during this time?”
Roar!! King, due to limited time, this is all we have for now.
As it spoke, the Female Tiger Whale’s mouth opened, and a bubble emerged from the dark and ferocious depths of its large mouth, wrapping around hundreds of High-level Life Crystals.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had only slept for a week this time, so it really hadn’t given the Female Tiger Whale and the others much time.
However, since all the kills were above Level 5, including Level 7 and Level 8 Peak Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon estimated that those crystals could likely be converted to around one hundred thousand Attribute points.
Immediately, the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction and growled softly, “Good job, you’ve worked hard. But where’s Tiger Three? Didn’t it come with you?”
Talking about its somewhat ‘clever’ son since childhood, the Female Tiger Whale hesitated: Third said it was going to do something big for the king.
Do something big, again going undercover in another Beast Empire’s forces? A string of question marks popped up over the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, somewhat impatient, “Roar! Tim Abott, can we start our journey to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region now?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Don’t rush, wait until I’ve completely achieved the Titan Level breakthrough.”
This time, it had been awakened and interrupted halfway through the breakthrough, with only the Giant Beast Body advancing to the Titan Level while its many Law Talents were still in the midst of Transformation.
Under normal conditions, a Mythical Giant Beast breaking through to the Titan Level would take at least dozens of Sun Wheels (several years), but thanks to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s hidden ‘Evolution’ talent, the process was significantly shortened.
Even so, it would still take at least one Sun Wheel to complete the transformation of both the Giant Beast Body and the Laws.
This kind of transformation is a slow change that doesn’t result in failure due to interruption during breakthrough, unlike what happens when one is rendered immobile and interrupted by an attack. It only disrupts the process.
Subsequently, the Destruction Emperor Dragon instructed on several matters, like having the Silver Giant Dragon and the others cautiously explore the surrounding situations and to turn and run upon encountering Titan Levels, etc.
At the same time, it ordered the Female Tiger Whale and the others to continue collecting Life Crystals, innovating these unlooted crystal resources before flying towards the Rift World with a group of Giant Beasts.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was preparing to continue its hibernation, far away, over 70,000 kilometers distant and across dozens of dangerous zones, the sea was flowing with blood, and corpses littered everywhere.
The hundred-meter-long Black Tiger Whale had broken scales covering its body and several deep wounds that exposed bone. The corners of its mouth were still clinging to numerous bits of flesh and blood, exuding a tragic aura.
Not far in front of it, another creature stood tall in the sea water. It was a hundred meters long, its lower body resembling a Flood Dragon while its upper body was the robust form of a humanoid with four arms belonging to an alien tribe.
Blue scales adorned the alien creature’s body, and its head looked like that of a half-evolved fish; fearsome and majestic, it wielded a massive Bronze Steel Fork.
Among the floating corpses around them, some belonged to the Flood Dragon alien tribe, while others were hideous creatures with numerous tentacles and wearing rudimentary armor.
Gurgle gurgle!! Watching the Black Tiger Whale that had helped it, the Flood Dragon alien spoke words that were incomprehensible and then made a few gestures.
Roar roar roar!!
Gurgle gurgle!!
After some communication, the Black Tiger Whale turned back and roared, “Miss Keller, let’s go. The big guy wants us to visit their home with it.”
From a distance, the Little Female Tiger Whale, which had been told to stay away during the fight, swam over, obediently following behind.
…
In Mist River City, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes on the wooden corridor of the backyard.
Having just made a breakthrough to Titan Level, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was somewhat strained in the face of a creature that once peaked at Ancient Titan. Thus, for the past three days, Jack Clark spent nearly all his attention there.
Now that the great battle was over, he could finally take a breather.
Having signed a contract with the Deep Red World and transformed his talent into the Higher-order Law of Deep Red Strength, Jack Clark was quite satisfied with the gains.
This new power gave him the means to contend with Demon God Level foes, bolstering his confidence for the upcoming mission to the rear of The Purgatory Family’s domain.
However, besides the Giantification Talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon undergoing transformation into the Laws Mystery of Deep Red Strength, there wasn’t much else gained from this battle.
The ancient beings were of the ‘Petrification’ class, no longer belonging to the realm of flesh, blood, and energetic life. Their essence was the manifestation of a different kind of Rule power.
Hence, when the last bit of their Rule Origin dissipated, they turned into mountain ranges stretching thousands of kilometers, returning to the mythical world, while their existence vanished into thin air.
This was also the reason why they had survived the backlash when their breakthroughs failed back then; they were, in essence, already ‘dead’.
It’s also why no Supreme Level strong men hunted ancient creatures. Normally, the entire body of an Ancient Titan was a treasure trove, with its flesh and blood containing the power of Laws, and its scales and bones being top-tier materials, the spoils from hunting one sufficient to enrich half a Federation warehouse.
But these beings, who usually hibernated for thousands to tens of thousands of years and moved slowly without the mystery of Laws to mobilize Rule power, garnered no attention.
There was no benefit in killing them, and instead, it would consume a considerable amount of Rule Origin. And carelessness might even lead to the danger of being assimilated if one were to be swallowed by them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153 - 1153 461_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1153: Chapter 461_3 Chapter 1153: Chapter 461_3 No one would engage in a business deal that leads to a loss.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s wristwatch flickered, and a message popped up.
Deep within the Void Space, as the King’s Intents descended, the Void trembled for an instant.
Marcellus Larry and the other eight king-level figures still sat on either side, with Jack Clark and Heavenly King Ares seated respectively on the two main thrones. At this moment, everyone’s expressions were somewhat grave.
Marcellus Larry said in a deep voice, “We’ve just received a report from the frontline; the Olympus Throne has fallen, the Gail Hills Throne has suffered heavy injuries, and the Golden Dragon Heavenly King has also been injured and withdrawn from the battlefield.”
“This civilization war is extremely brutal. Right from the start, the Purgatory Family’s demon kings have all ignited their Origins in a Burst state.”
“So far, the Federation has committed thirty-five king-level figures and seven Heavenly Kings, while the number of demon kings that have appeared from the Purgatory Family has reached forty-seven, with nine Great Demon Kings.”
“Including Number One, who has been besieged by three demon kings, the casualties it’s inflicted on the enemy army on the main battlefield are not very significant.”
“Now that Blue Star’s stability is secured, it’s almost time for us to provide support too. We need to relieve those thrones whose Origins have been severely depleted to prevent their fall.”
Ares’s expression was somber, “It seems that the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield has been isolated, leading to the fierce attack due to the concentration of the two Demon God Empires’ powers.”
As a frontline battlefield, the frequency of king-level powerhouses falling is actually quite high. Even with both sides using their high-end strength in the contest, there have been continuous king-level falls over the years.
This is also the reason why there are only a few dozen king-level figures left within the human inner circle.
Additionally, some of these kings have ventured deep into the mythical world and are not within the Federation, and some have other tasks, like Jewell True Immortal, who has joined the Divine Gods Alliance.
Otherwise, with normal accumulation over fifty years, the number of kings among the Human Race would certainly not be so few.
Especially during the early outbreak of the Mythical Era, due to the inheritance of the Void Relic Continent, the Human Race produced dozens of kings within a span of ten years.
Of course, while the Human Race has suffered many casualties, the demon kings of the Purgatory Family have also fallen in large numbers, such as the more than ten slain by Jack Clark recently.
It looks like both sides are fighting fiercely, but in fact, this is a normal casualty rate in the mythical world.
In the mythical world, being at the Mythical-level is only the threshold; Mythical Giant Beasts, Titan Level Giants, and Mythical Powerhouses from different races abound between heaven and earth.
Especially for a major tribe like the Purgatory Family, the death rate of demon kings is staggering, due to constant territory expansion and warfare.
For example, the Three Demon King Empires, battling the Heavenly Feather Clan and holding advantages on all fronts, have still lost dozens of demon kings and sacrificed over a hundred Mythical Powerhouses of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
At this moment, Jack Clark spoke, “Everyone, I will not be going to support at the Sky Curtain Battlefield this time. Instead, I will focus on achieving a breakthrough to the Mid-Mythical Stage.”
“After that, I’ll use the pathway of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe to infiltrate the rear of the Purgatory Family and try to destroy their Demon Clan cities to reduce the pressure on the frontline.”
With Jack Clark’s current strength, his presence wouldn’t be that impactful at the Sky Curtain Battlefield, even if he were to Summon the True Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to descend.
If he were to enter the battlefield with powers from both tribes not fully committed to the front lines, he would be targeted by either Great Demon Kings or Demon Gods at their peak awakening.
On the contrary, if he were to infiltrate the rear of the Demon God Empire with the bulk of their forces at the front lines, he could rampage freely. In the initial phase of his sudden attack, he could at least slay more than ten demon kings and Great Demon Kings.
Furthermore, he could use sky-base summoning to call upon the backstabbing Destruction Emperor Dragon for long-range destruction strikes, razing a city of the Purgatory Demons with each hit.
At that time, at the very least, he could force a Demon God Level figure to retreat for reinforcements, alleviating pressure on the frontline.
The other kings were aware of Jack Clark’s plan, and after a brief silence, Marcellus Larry said gravely, “Jack, be careful when the time comes and prioritize your safety above all.”
“With your current combat power, as long as you’re not besieged by more than two Great Demon Kings, nothing should be able to stop you from leaving if you wish. But do not let your guard down.”
“The Purgatory Family has existed for a long time, and their accumulated resources are unimaginably vast, especially considering the many relics they have unearthed, containing countless inheritances.”
“For instance, abilities similar to the Law of Cause and Effect can lock onto you even if you manage to temporarily erase your presence.”
Jack Clark nodded solemnly, “Thank you, Senior. I won’t be careless.”
Watching Jack Clark, who was preparing to venture alone deep into the Purgatory Family’s stronghold, the other kings showed respect on their faces, as they wouldn’t dare to do the same.
It wasn’t a matter of courage, but rather, they lacked the strength to do so and come back in one piece.
At this point, Ares asked, “Jack, how much time do you need to break through to the Mid-Mythical Stage? Is there anything we can assist you with?”
Ares had a favorable impression of Jack Clark, the responsible newcomer to the younger generation.
Jack considered it briefly, “I estimate it’ll take another three to four days to achieve the Mid-Mythical Stage breakthrough. As for anything else, there’s no need for help.”
At the Mythical-level, aside from personal cultivation, only rare Law Level and Rule Level strengthening resources can help in rapidly improving one’s power.
The Federation had none of these resources left, as they had all been used up.
No sooner had Jack Clark finished speaking than the other kings were stunned, with one of them exclaiming incredulously, “What, three to four days! Am I hearing it right?”
Even Marcellus Larry couldn’t help but say, “Jack, it’s only been about ten days since you broke through to king-level, right?”
Jack nodded, “Correct, it’s been exactly eleven days since my breakthrough. But there’s no need for surprise; my rapid progress is likely due to my successful Opening the Heavens.”
“When I opened the heavens, besides comprehending the Supreme Law, there were many insights imprinted deep within my soul that I didn’t have time to grasp, plus I had previously completed the Road to Becoming a God.”
“Thus, I’m another example of ‘accumulating in silence and lagging for a quick release.’ These accumulations were unleashed after my breakthrough, resulting in my cultivation advancing rapidly in a short period.”
“Once I’ve fully digested these accumulations, my cultivation speed will return to normal.”
“That makes some sense…” Upon hearing this, Marcellus Larry and the others slowly nodded their heads.
Although Jack Clark had only been cultivating for a year, his accumulations were actually quite astonishing. The gains from just the Path of the Gods alone were comparable to those of a Heavenly King, so there was nothing amiss… except there was.
In awe, the projections of the kings’ Wills dissipated.
Meanwhile, after dissipating his Will projection, Jack Clark also entered the Plane Space, preparing to receive the Life Crystals from the Destruction Emperor Dragon and commence his final Closed-door Cultivation.
Once he broke through to the Mid-Mythical Stage, it would be time for the chaos to ensue.

chapters.title: Chapter 1154 - 1154 462 The Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1154: Chapter 462: The Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite, Re-entering the Mythical World Chapter 1154: Chapter 462: The Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite, Re-entering the Mythical World In the Plane World, Jack Clark stood atop a black Divine Mountain that had already reached ten thousand meters in height, and behind him, a vague shadow of an imposing black Stone Gate flickered into existence.
However, the projection of the black Stone Gate vanished just a few moments later as Jack slowly opened his eyes, muttering to himself.
“The entrance to the Gateway to Heaven has now connected with Blue Star. Next, as long as I can enter the Supreme Hell Plane, I’ll be able to return to the Plane World through the coordinates and then back to Blue Star.”
To ensure the safety of his subsequent infiltration into the rear of The Purgatory Family, after much consideration, Jack decided to connect the entrance of the Plane World with Blue Star.
As the creator of his Plane World, Jack could freely enter and exit the Plane, and the point of his departure was the coordinate that connected to the material universe.
This method was convenient for normal cultivation, but if pursued by Demon God Level Powerhouses and he entered the Plane World, his location would be locked and they could tear through the space to descend.
Similarly, to utilize a leap via the Supreme Hell Plane also required coordinates, such as those of the Plane World, and then returning through it.
Of course, doing so came with downsides; for example, the next time he “exited the door,” it would be to Blue Star unless he severed the link to the Gateway to Heaven.
After making the final preparations, Jack took a deep breath, and the Space-Time Summoning Mark on the back of his left hand emitted a gloomy blue radiance.
Hum!
Centered around Jack, a Space-Time Altar composed of countless gloomy blue rune sequence chains covering a range of hundreds of meters emerged, with a Silver Vortex slowly opening above it.
At the same time, in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon back in the Rift World, space distorted, forming a spinning Silver Vortex.
After ‘modifying’ the Space-Time Summoning Technique, compared to forcibly opening a Trans-boundary Channel, directly linking two points with the altar was much easier.
Huh!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled hot gusts of breath, causing the floating space bubble to slightly shift, wrapping around hundreds of Life Crystals as they flew toward the vortex.
Yi ya yi ya! Feeling the familiar fluctuations of space-time, the Purple little dragon on top of the Destruction Emperor Dragon sleepily opened his eyes, its little claws subconsciously wiping away drool.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled softly, “Misss Joseline, this is not a sacrifice.”
Yi ya yi ya!? Still working on relations?
Confusion filled the sleepy eyes of the purple little dragon because it remembered that the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed to have given several gifts already, wasn’t that enough?
Watching the slowly disappearing Silver Vortex, the purple little dragon smacked its lips and lay back down to sleep, radiating a subtle but powerful aura.
Meanwhile, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon lay back down to continue its Titan Level Transformation, Jack grasped two golden Level 8 Life Crystals, his thoughts stirring.
“Attribute points conversion.”
“You converted two High-Purity Life Crystals and received 3980 and 3714 Attribute points respectively…”
This time, since all of them were High-level Life Crystals starting from level five, including many at level eight, when all were converted, the Attribute points on the page soared from over fifty thousand to over one hundred and seventy thousand.
A total of over one hundred and twenty thousand points were converted, befitting the mythical world where high-level alien beast creatures are plentiful.
Although breaking through to king-level meant that Attribute points could no longer directly enhance the rules or improve cultivation, nor could they further evolve the talents of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, they were still a great help to Jack.
For instance, when faced with the ‘temptation’ of the Supreme Plane Hell or the Deep Red World, if Jack didn’t have Attribute points to simulate the Soul Source Aura, he definitely would not agree to contract.
Moreover, without the boost from the epiphany state, his cultivation speed would have plummeted after the breakthrough to Myth, no longer able to advance bravely and intensively.
After reflecting on this, a command rose in Jack’s mind: “Spend one hundred and twenty thousand Attribute points to enter the epiphany state.”
Boom! The Void trembled, and an intense Epiphanic Intent Realm almost materialized around Jack, enveloping him and instantly plunging him into a deep state of cultivation.
While Jack began his closed-door push to reach new heights, the great battle on the Frontline Battlefield grew increasingly fierce.
With the support of Heavenly King Ares and five other king-level beings, king-level fighters who had suffered serious depletion of their origins, having approached the limit of sixty percent damage to their foundations, were pulled back from the Frontline.
Roar!
In the middle of the main Frontline Battlefield, where two late-period Demon Kings and one mid-period Demon King were jointly suppressing, Number One, because it had not devoured enough souls and flesh and blood of living beings, fought back more rampantly and roared violently.
Inside Number One, the driver Freya Louise’s eyes were ice-cold, devoid of any emotional fluctuation, as she silently observed the data flickering across the screen.
“Soul Synchronization Rate 98 percent, 99 percent…”
“Warning! Please suppress the Soul Sync Rate; if it reaches 100 percent, it will result in mental contamination. Warning, please resist Number One’s Soul Fluctuation.”
In that moment, Freya smiled faintly, “Reject suppression and release 20 percent of Number One’s restriction armor.”
“Command received, proceeding to execute… Number One’s exoskeletal control armor is released by 20 percent, Core Energy begins to unfold, Super God Energy fluctuation breaks through 1000 percent, 3000 percent…”
As the data on the screen skyrocketed, Freya’s gaze remained detached, as if she stood outside of Heaven and Earth, in a far-flung corner of space-time, silently witnessing everything unfolding.
Roar!
With Freya unlocking some of Number One’s restraints, Number One’s muscles instantaneously began to swell, pieces of armor exploded off, revealing the purplish-gold skin beneath.
In an instant, a terrifying aura burst forth from the Black-Red Colored Mech.
Hum! Two blue and white light beams burst forth from Number One’s eyes, the invisible Destructive Aura making the Demon Kings facing the onslaught instinctively dodge.
