﻿Chapter 1155: Chapter 462: Apocalyptic Heavenly Base Satellite, Reentering the Mythical World_2 Chapter 1155: Chapter 462: Apocalyptic Heavenly Base Satellite, Reentering the Mythical World_2 “`
Boom! An instant later, a dazzling mushroom cloud rose tens of kilometers away, shaking the earth and sweeping a terrifying shockwave across a range of several tens of kilometers.
“`
“`
At the same time, Number One’s massive palm reached out, grabbing at a shattered remnant of vassal alien race some twenty kilometers away.
“`
“`
Under that terrifying force, tens of thousands of aliens turned into blood foam, countless pieces of flesh and souls converging under the purple-gold radiance to form a war spear hundreds of meters long.
“`
“`
The purple-gold war spear seemed tangible, with mysterious ancient patterns flowing on it, releasing an eerie aura that even unsettled the Three Demon Kings.
“`
“`
“Be careful of the weapon in that monster’s hand,” the rear Demon King in his late period exclaimed in shock and anger.
“`
“`
But it was already too late. Number One’s form stretched forward and back, taking on a throwing posture, as the spear in its hand shone even brighter, emitting terrifying beams of light.
“`
“`
Boom! The purple-gold war spear turned into a burst of light and shot forth, piercing through the Void in an instant and leaving behind a black pathway in front of another late period Demon King.
“`
“`
That three-headed, eight-armed Demon King’s face suddenly paled, its eight arms coming together to cast a seal, with countless Dark Demon Air covering several kilometers around converging on the hefty war shield it held.
“`
“`
“Block it.”
“`
“`
Boom!
“`
“`
The horrific strike directly pierced through the hundred-meter-thick black gold war shield, radiating an unshakeable will, and heavily injured the true body of that Demon King.
“`
“`
However, Number One’s target was not him. In the instant it launched the spear and inflicted heavy injuries on that Demon King, its limbs hit the ground, and like a monstrous creature, it leaped high into the air.
“`
“`
“No, save me!” As the monster suddenly appeared above its head, the mid period Demon King, though truly three hundred meters tall and seemingly more gigantic, let out a scream of despair.
“`
“`
Boom!
“`
“`
Under Number One’s colossal palm, the space around the mid-period Demon King, extending for a kilometer, solidified, continually shrinking until caught by Number One.
“`
“`
This scene was exactly like the one on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield. The Demon King in his late period at the rear witnessed it and roared in shock and anger, thrusting out a dark Demon spear that was a kilometer long and pierced through Heaven and Earth.
“`
“`
Boom!
“`
“`
The fearsome blow landed behind Number One but was blocked by a golden barrier, causing the space within several kilometers to shake wildly. Still, it couldn’t penetrate that invisible crystal wall.
“`
“`
The force field surrounding Number One seemed somewhat similar to Jack Clark’s Boundary Defense, or perhaps it was even more powerful and advanced.
“`
“`
Crack! Number One bit down directly with its mouth, holding the Demon King. In an instant, most of the Demon King’s body ‘disappeared,’ wiped away by a force as if it were a Rule, devoured.
“`
“`
Such a terrifying sight made the two late-period Demon Kings extremely wary.
“`
“`
“Be careful, that Biological Mecha has entered an Awakened State. Don’t get close to it.”
“`
“`
Boom! Amidst the dire warning, a terrifying aura burst forth above the Firmament, as an early-period Great Demon King arrived to press from the rear.
“`
“`
Previously on the battlefield, Number One devoured over a million vassal aliens and Purgatory True Demons, along with several Demon Kings’ flesh and souls, growing even more horrific.
“`
“`
Now entering a berserk state once again, the strength it released meant that even if that Great Demon King joined hands with two other Demon Kings, they could only barely suppress it, lessening the pressure on their higher-ups.
“`
“`
[There are still 3,000 words that haven’t been edited yet, please wait.]
“`
“`
Tens of thousands of kilometers above, four monumental voices surrounded by prevailing rules confronted each other when the Sky-based God King slowly said, “Are you ready to initiate the War of Extermination?”
“`
“`
“What do you think?”
“`
“`
“Thinking of extinguishing our Human Race, let your two empires be the funeral offerings.”
“`
“`
“Activate the Sky Base.”
“`
“`
The command came from the rear in an instant, transmitted to the Third Passage base city.
“`
“`
“First Sequence Order, the target is directly ahead of the Sky Curtain Battlefield.”
“`
“`
“Execute First Sequence Order.”
“`
“`
At that moment, the entire Berlin Empire’s Third Passage trembled. Unlike the passages of Eastern Summer and Simon Empire, Berlin Empire’s passage was quite unique, surrounded by golden frames.
“`
“`
As the fixed passage tilted slightly upwards, tens of kilometers out in the Void beyond Blue Star’s atmosphere, inside the massive ‘Apocalyptic Heavenly Base No.1’, a Heavenly King Level powerhouse slowly opened his eyes.
“`
“`
A look of contemplation appeared in his eyes: “Have we reached the point where we need to activate the Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite already?”
“`
“`
Like a stretching spider, long mirrors unfolded across a hundred kilometers, exuding strong suction, instantly gathering endless Stellar Energy.
“`
“`
Meanwhile, inside, the Stellar Energy stored for over a decade rumbled, releasing waves of terrible energy, visible as radiance even in daylight to countless people.
“`
“`
Boom!
“`
“`
A golden light beam with a diameter of one kilometer pierced through the atmosphere, its core containing Stellar Energy compressed to the extreme, surrounded by rings of white waves, majestic and vast.
“`
“`
Boom, boom, boom!!
“`
“`
Above the tens of thousands of kilometers, four Demon God Level beings erupted, their rear Demon Gods and Supreme Experts striking from afar too, not allowing any obstruction.
“`
“`
Below, a Peak Awakened Great Demon bellowed, twisting Space-Time to block. But the golden beam, with a slight pause atop, destroyed everything, piercing through.
“`
“`
Boom! Half of that Peak Awakened Great Demon’s true body exploded, finally landing behind the frontline battlefield, instantly shining with dazzling light.
“`
“`
Endless Stellar Energy poured down, melting the earth, radiating destruction in all directions, creating a vast fan-shaped Area of Destruction covering tens of thousands of kilometers, spanning half of the battlefield.
“`
“`
An instant of silence fell upon both sides of the battlefield.
“`
“`
Because of its speed, the strike couldn’t harm the Great Demons; it blew away many Demon Kings but the terrifying rule of energy managed to disperse almost all of it, nearly wiping out a third of the opposing army and reserve forces.
“`
“`
The flank battlefield vanished entirely, the Main Battle Legions suffering a million deaths and injuries, and the rear and long-range armies also losing over three million.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1156 - 1156 462 The Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1156: Chapter 462: The Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite, Re-entering the Mythical World_3 Chapter 1156: Chapter 462: The Apocalyptic Sky Base Satellite, Re-entering the Mythical World_3 The elite Human Race squad had not ventured into that area, and from the beginning, preparations were made to activate the Apocalyptic Heavenly Base Weapons.
The great battle continued to erupt, but its intensity was much weaker than before.
The removal of a major battlefield from the front and the absence of reserve forces and long-range support weakened their stance.
Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane.
As the five Higher-order Laws continued to evolve, approaching the Mid-Mythical Stage, Jack Clark’s aura became increasingly terrifying.
The Blue Thunder surrounding him gradually transitioned to purple, the aura becoming more violent and filled with the intent of destruction, while the golden Great Sun behind him radiated intense light.
Among the five major Higher-order Laws, the Great Sun Heaven Flame and Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder were the most prominent; the Void swallowed the surrounding Heaven and Earth in silence and darkness, while Death and Soul were not manifest.
Boom!
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s aura surged, and streaks of blue-purple thunder descended from heaven to earth, striking the mountain cliff, causing rocks to rumble, and the Earth to shatter.
Not long after, the Sun Illusion behind Jack shone even more intensely, emitting an even hotter radiance, while the golden Star in the Firmament resonated with it.
At this stage, Jack Clark could be considered a strong man in the Mid-Mythical Stage, but his goal this time was to achieve minor completion in all Laws.
…
In the afternoon, at 5:30.
The burly Glenn Clark, wearing a school uniform and carrying a black ‘small backpack’, walked into the courtyard and saw Jack Clark speaking with Doris Clark.
“Brother, have you finished your cultivation?”
Jack Clark turned slightly and saw Glenn Clark’s still youthful face and smiled warmly, “Yes, my cultivation is complete.”
Admiration appeared on Glenn’s face, “Bro, you’re so diligent. It feels like since last year when you started Cultivating True Martial Arts, you were either cultivating or on your way to cultivate.”
At this point, Glenn paused: “Bro, I’ve thought about it for a few days and decided to transfer to South Sky Martial Height.”
“You want to start cultivation?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
The guy had been struggling with the decision to transfer schools for cultivating, and it seemed he was not very keen on leaving junior high.
“Yes, I want to cultivate,” confirmed Glenn seriously. Although Jack Clark hadn’t shared much, Glenn vaguely felt an inexplicable sense of crisis.
His brother had become the legendary king-level warrior, yet he still cultivated so diligently.
Adding the Space Cracks that had been appearing recently, the invading different races, and the sudden awakening of abilities in people, there seemed to be a feeling that a great change in Heaven and Earth was forthcoming.
Under such circumstances, it was naturally safer to have great strength. Otherwise, should any anomaly occur, one wouldn’t even have the power to protect others.
Jack Clark nodded, “Okay, I’ll make a call later. Tomorrow, you can just go to South Sky Martial Height directly; I have to leave and won’t have time.”
“Bro, you’re leaving again?” Glenn was taken aback.
This time, although Jack Clark had come back for about ten days, when counting, he had only stayed at home for one night.
Jack Clark nodded calmly, “Yes, an important mission. I might be gone for a long time this time. Take care of the house.”
After waving goodbye to Doris Clark and Glenn Clark, Jack Clark distorted the space. In a flash, his figure appeared above the clouds, several kilometers away, and took out his mobile phone.
3-9 small group.
@Justin Welan.
Jack Clark: Mr. Willard, are you cultivating? Tomorrow, my brother will report to South Sky Martial Height. Can you show him around and say hello to Principal Hong for me?
Justin Welan appeared, somewhat puzzled: Tiger, isn’t he only in ninth grade? Why is he suddenly reporting to South Sky Martial Height?
Jack Clark: Jim went fishing before and found God-level Special Resources that had fallen from the Space Cracks by the riverside. He ‘grew up’ a bit, so he can start cultivating earlier.
Justin Welan realized, “I see, no problem. Leave it to me.”
At this time, Crystal Lewis chimed in, puzzled: Jack Clark, why won’t you personally take your brother to school?
I’m currently rushing to South City, preparing to enter the mythical world through that crack on a mission, and I don’t have time, Jack Clark explained.
Mandy Lewis sighed, “You’re leaving so soon.”
Jack Clark replied, “Yes, the reason I came back this time is to oversee the eastern hemisphere of Blue Star and to deal with the cracks caused by the first wave of the mythical world’s impact.”
“I originally planned to invite everyone to dinner upon my return, but with so many things happening, I can only find another opportunity later. Mr. Willard, please send my regards to Zac and the others.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark felt a bit of regret. Because that meal might never happen, including the promised battle with Howard Lambert.
Soon, not just Jack Clark would be entering the mythical world, but Justin and the others were also close to making the transition. It would be difficult for classmates to gather as they did this time, so neatly dispersed across the globe,
including Freya Louise.
The group chatted for a bit more before Jack Clark put away his phone.
Meanwhile, in that chat group, Matt Watkins and Mandy Lewis, though present, didn’t say a word, possibly due to the increasing gap between everyone, opting to remain silent observers.
In South City, the area around the colossal cracks was cordoned off by the Military Base, no entry for non-personnel. Only more than ten kilometers away could some New Media Journalists and internet celebrities be seen with mobile phones and drones, filming to gain popularity.
Kavaduo stood coldly next to the crack, towering a hundred meters tall, with the Mythical Violent Dragon Beast, over seven hundred meters long, coiled beside him. Its invisible presence emitted a terrifying pressure.
As for the hundreds of thousands of other members of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, they had already evacuated.
After getting used to the rich and plentiful energy of the mythical world, the Violent Dragon Tribe could hardly tolerate their new environment for a few days and eventually boarded a train to their new dwelling in the mythical world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1157 - 1157 462 Apocalyptic Heavenly Base Satellite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1157: Chapter 462: Apocalyptic Heavenly Base Satellite, Re-entering the Mythical World_4 Chapter 1157: Chapter 462: Apocalyptic Heavenly Base Satellite, Re-entering the Mythical World_4 In South City, the vast surrounding cracks were cordoned off by the Military Base; no civilians were permitted. Only over ten kilometers away where some New Media Journalists and internet celebrities wielding mobile phones and drones were filming to attract attention.
By the side of the crack, standing over a hundred meters tall, Kavadola loomed with an indifferent look, while the Violent Dragon Beast, which was over seven hundred meters long, lay coiled beside him, exuding an invisible fearsome pressure.
As for the other several hundred thousand members of the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, they had already evacuated.
Used to the environment of the mythical world where Heavenly Energy was rich and abundant, the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe couldn’t bear it after just a few days, and finally, they entered the mythical world’s new habitat via train.
Suddenly, Kavadola’s face turned solemn, and he showed a respectful demeanor, while the Violent Dragon Beast that had been lying on the ground preserving its “energy” quickly stood up, respectfully bowing its head.
A young man with black hair draped over his shoulders appeared out of thin air in the air in front of them.
“Greetings, Upper God.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly and then said indifferently, “Kavadola, I have a task for you. If you complete it well, I will lift the Divine Soul Prohibition on you.”
Kavadola was momentarily stunned, somewhat excited, “Please rest assured, Upper God, no matter the task, even at the cost of my life, I will surely complete it.”
…What kind of assurance is that? Jack Clark was speechless.
“Forget death, from now on, you are to conceal your True Body and protect my brother and mother well. In three years, I will lift the Divine Soul Prohibition on you.”
This was the safety measure Jack Clark placed for his family.
It was not that he didn’t trust the Federation, but the enemy was too strong. Even though High-Ranking Powerhouses had been dispatched, they could not guarantee the absolute safety of Doris Clark and the others.
After all, there had been too many cases of king-level individuals’ family members being assassinated over the years – for example, now only Ilisa remains of the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s family.
Compared to the Human Race, The Purgatory Family had a greater number of high-order powerhouses; even if it meant a Purgatory True Demon with Nine Demonic Marks assassinating a Senior king’s relative, it would still be considered profitable.
“Yes, Upper God.”
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark descended on the opposite side, with a single thought he detonated the Golden Flame Thunderball at the entrance of the pathway. In an instant, a terrifying energy was released in an explosion, shaking the pathway, which then slowly began to collapse.
With that, the last connecting pathway between the mythical world and Blue Star vanished from this shock to the world.
Jack Clark turned into a streak of golden light, piercing through Heaven and Earth, flying toward the entrance of the underground cracks in the Ice-encrusted Forbidden Zone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1158 - 1158 463 The Arrival of Void Death
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1158: Chapter 463: The Arrival of Void Death, Slaughtering a Million Brave Heroes (10K) Chapter 1158: Chapter 463: The Arrival of Void Death, Slaughtering a Million Brave Heroes (10K) Mythical World
In the depths of the Violent Dragon civilization, as the Spatial Channel collapsed, a violent Spatial Storm devoured everything around it, creating a massive black hole several kilometers in diameter.
From the depths of the black hole, a figure wearing black-red armor, ten meters tall, slowly walked out. The Spatial Storm hit the invisible Boundary Wall around him, emitting a dazzling Energy Halo.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s footsteps landed on the ground, and the earth within several kilometers trembled slightly, with web-like cracks spreading out hundreds of meters with him at the center.
Without restraining the Aura of his True Body’s strength, Jack was like a huge beast. Every move he made vibrated Heaven and Earth with an overwhelming momentum.
Crack!
Atop Jack’s head, a pair of sharp black dragon horns, half a meter long, slowly grew out. Instantly, the Aura of power emanating from him grew even more terrifying, causing the ground to continually collapse.
“Not enough.”
Amidst the low sound, red scales began to emerge on Jack’s face, and his long black hair gradually turned blood-red, with Blood Flames burning and trailing behind him.
Boom!
From Jack as the center, endless blood light erupted, covering a range of twenty kilometers, turning this World into a Doomsday Hell.
In Hell, dark purple clouds tumbled, blood mist filled the air, distorting the atmosphere, blood rivers flowed, and all kinds of ferocious monsters and Giant Beasts struggled and howled in the Sea of Blood.
As endless Killing Intent was released, the Doomsday Domain fully unfurled. In the center of Hell, Jack, nearly engulfed by the thick purple-black Killing Intent that couldn’t be dispelled, became a blurry silhouette.
Only a vague image of a Hell Demon God standing firm could be seen, with a blood-red halo slowly revolving behind him and blood-red eyes filled with terrifying ferocity and murderous Aura.
This was Jack Clark’s disguise for the upcoming mission.
A strong man from a different race, who walked the path of slaughter, rampaging through the rear of the Purgatory Empire, was a completely different concept from a Human Expert slaughtering his way into the rear of the Purgatory Empire.
The former would initially only attract the attention of some Purgatory Demons for a kill, while the latter would immediately trigger the Great Demon Kings and even Demon Gods from the Purgatory Empire to come to their aid.
This would greatly affect Jack’s plan.
He didn’t come here simply to relieve the pressure on the frontline, not just to “trap Wei to save Zhao,” but also to slaughter more Purgatory True Demons, demon kings, and even Great Demon Kings.
On the edge of the frozen forbidden area stretching for tens of thousands of kilometers, the earth burst forth violently, with endless blood-red radiance gushing out like a blood river, enveloping a range of twenty kilometers.
Suddenly, endless expansive forests came into Jack’s view.
Under the night sky, the mountain ranges undulated, Sky-touching Trees towering hundreds to thousands of meters into the air, with some huge dark shadows flashing by, letting out roars that shook the mountain forest and were filled with a desolate and barren Aura.
If not for the Purgatory Demon Race, the mythical world for humans would be nothing less than the legendary Immortal Worlds and Divine Realms.
An area with no boundaries, inexhaustible resources, food, a variety of strange and huge creatures, plants, different from Blue Star’s physical rules, climates, and the rich Heavenly Energy.
Whoosh whoosh!
Like a living thing, the blood light spread rapidly towards the depths of the forest with astonishing speed. The trees turned yellow and withered as they passed, and Unique Beasts and poisonous insects turned into dry corpses under the erosion of the Blood Fiend.
This was the terror of the Doomsday Domain, bolstered by the Power of Hell. When Hell descends, all things wither, and the stronger the slaughter, the more fearful the domain’s power.
However, in the past, Jack’s enemies were too strong, either a demon king or a Great Demon King, so the Doomsday Domain seemed to have little effect on suppressing those foes.
Just as Jack hurried towards the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire region, a Blood Moon appeared behind the bright moon in the sky.
The red blood-like moonlight fell like blood, drenching the boundless mythical world in a scarlet color, emanating an ominous Aura, and under the blood light, many creatures became restless and bloodthirsty.
…
Under the night, a mountain range stretched for thousands of kilometers.
At the end of the mountain range, a True Demon in Ferocious Red Battle Armor, eight meters tall, covered in purple scales, looked up at the Blood Moon in the sky with a hint of unease.
“The Blood Moon has appeared again, with Blood Moons appearing for several days. Kazan, I always have an ominous premonition.”
Not far behind this True Demon, another imposing Purgatory True Demon, ten meters tall with three sharp Demon Horns on his head, showed a ferocious and disdainful look.
“Walla, you’re thinking too much. For our clan, standing at the pinnacle of the Vast World, even if something shocking happens, it should be the different races who feel uneasy.”
Both Purgatory True Demons emitted a strong Aura of Nine Demonic Marks, surrounded by solidifying Black Demonic Qi, with an oppressive Atmosphere and terrifying Aura.
Below the two True Demons was a settlement built around a mountain, where hundreds of Purgatory True Demons with the Aura of Six and Seven Demonic Marks bellowed and howled.
Further below, thousands of aliens, fifteen meters tall, slightly stooped and with robust limbs and dark skin, worked hard mining minerals.
This mountain peak had almost been hollowed out, dotted with ore tunnels tens of meters tall.
Deep underground, about ten kilometers down the ore tunnels, those aliens with long noses, resembling humanoid black elephants, clanged away at the Pale Gold Ore.
Meanwhile, in the buildings at the foot of the mountain, some Purgatory True Demons exuded a bloody smell, processing the corpses of huge creatures tens to hundreds of meters in size.
These Giant Beast’s flesh and bones were thrown into a massive Blood Pool, where bones piled up like mountains, and the blood and Essence Blood extracted were separately stored, like in Hell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159 - 1159 463 The Void of Death Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1159: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_2 Chapter 1159: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_2 And in the forest, a continuous stream of small squads kept returning.
These squads were mainly comprised of Purgatory True Demons with Seven Demonic Marks or Eight Demonic Marks, each carrying the corpses of Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts, dragged by about a dozen members of the Black Elephant Alien Race.
Watching the busy scene below, Walla, clad in blood-colored battle armor, asked, “Kazan, how’s the preparation of the flesh and blood materials you’re in charge of? They need to be handed over by dawn.”
“No problem, my subordinates have almost wiped out the Giant Beasts within thousands of kilometers around. We have gathered enough materials to refine for polluting this World with the Blood of Demon God,” Kazan replied.
Envious, Walla’s fierce face showed a hint of envy upon hearing this, “You have it easy. It might take me ten more Sun Wheels to gather enough gold-plated materials.”
The imposing Purgatory True Demon, with an indifferent demeanor, spoke, “But my losses are heavier than yours. I’ll need to replenish Demon Members and purchase slaves from the Black Elephant race when I return.”
Roar!
Suddenly, a fierce roar erupted from deep within the forest, causing the two Nine Demonic Marks True Demons to tense up: “That’s the Gigantified creature.”
A strong killing intent appeared on Kazan’s face: “It dares to come again.”
Boom!
The rocks beneath Kazan crumbled, and he burst into the sky wrapped in rolling Dark Demon Air, causing branches to shake and trees to fall throughout the forest.
During the alarmed shouts of “The Great Leader, that monster is here again!”, over a dozen Purgatory True Demons with Six Demonic Marks and Seven Demonic Marks rushed out, looking somewhat panicked.
Then, with another fierce roar, a Mountain Giant emerged, towering three hundred meters tall, its body covered in grey rock.
In its hands, it held a stone axe five hundred meters long, surrounded by a grey mist spanning a kilometer, exuding the aura of a Nine-layer Late Period being.
Roar!
As it lunged toward the Purgatory True Demons in the distance, the Mountain Giant’s petrified eyes overflowed with madness and slaughter, taking great strides forward amid rumbling thunder.
“Seeking death.”
With a low growl, Kazan, also in the late stage of Nine Demonic Marks, swelled in size to reveal his dual-headed, six-armed True Demon form, rising to a hundred meters, with Dark Demon Air bursting around him.
Boom!
Wielding the battle sword in his six hands, Kazan unleashed three-hundred-meter-long Three-headed Demon Dragons with a sweep, blasting through the air and sending shock waves rolling.
Roar! With a roar like a Martial Arts-trained human, the Mountain Giant wielded its axes expertly, sweeping with precision over the Three-headed Demon Dragon.
Bang bang bang!!
Under the massive blows of the axe, the Three-headed Dark Demon Dragons exploded, but the burst of demon gas forced the giant back. That’s when a battle sword suddenly appeared in the air.
Splash! In front of that dark radiance-entwined sword, the heavy domain encircling the Mountain Giant was silently torn apart.
Boom! The giant instinctively blocked with its axe, fending off the sword strike, only to be hit by a terrifying force, sending its mountain-heavy body stumbling backward.
Roar! Ignoring the attack, the giant roared and swung its axe at the Purgatory True Demon who was trying to pierce through its short head.
Boom!
The giant’s axe cleaved into the Earth, shattering the ground, cutting a fissure several kilometers long, throwing dirt and smoke into the air.
While the Mountain Giant and the Purgatory True Demon were clashing, another Nine Demonic Marks True Demon on the Mountain Peak showed a face of growing horror.
A boundless tide of blood light surged from the distant sky, as if Hell would swallow the sky and Earth. Within it, a terrifying figure stood, casting the powerful oppression of the Mid-Mythical Stage.
“A Mythical-level alien strong man is attacking, let’s go.”
Having annihilated many alien civilizations and knowing some escaped Alien Deities occasionally launched attacks on Purgatory Family settlements, these True Demons had plenty of experience with such events.
But all their experience was futile as, right after Walla’s command, the blood light previously over a hundred kilometers away suddenly flashed in the sky, enveloping the World.
In an instant, an extreme aura of malevolence engulfed all the Purgatory True Demons, their bodies rigid, images of mountains of corpses and seas of blood springing to their eyes, faces showing despair.
“Quick reaction, but pointless.”
Within the depths of the low voice, a fierce giant ten meters tall appeared before Walla and grabbed his head in trepidation.
Then, around Jack Clark’s arms, strands of black Soul Chains appeared, rattling as they penetrated into Walla’s body and dragged out a struggling translucent shadow.
Boom! As the soul was shredded, fragments of information were ‘seen’ by Jack Clark, who slowly said, “Another ten thousand miles or so, and it’s the City of Demon King Moss.”
Based on the fragmented information gleaned from the soul search, this forest stretching over a hundred thousand kilometers was called the Dark Forest, containing many dangerous creatures and forbidden areas.
Past the forest lay Demon King’s City, ruled by Demon King Moss Crator, with an army of hundreds of thousands of Purgatory True Demons and millions from the Black Elephant Alien Race known as Della.
The Purgatory Family operated under a Nobility Enfeoffment System and a semi-slavery system; the strongest Demon God was the Lord of the Empire, followed by the Duke Great Demon Kings and Marquis Demon Kings of the awakening peak.
Each Demon King possessed their own territory, reigning over tens or hundreds of thousands of kilometers, with absolute authority over all resources and vassal races within their domain.
Whenever a Civilization Great War erupted, the Imperial Demon God would summon some Demon Kings, including their True Demon Legions and Vassal Race Legions, to war.
As Jack Clark casually executed Kazan, the surrounding True Demons and alien races perished silently under the shadow of his Doomsday Domain, obliterated by the omnipresent Death Law.

chapters.title: Chapter 1160 - 1160 463 The Void of Death Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1160: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_3 Chapter 1160: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_3 Including the Kazan True Demon grappling with the Mountain Giant, who revealed a look of despair on its face before its body stiffened and it slowly fell.
At this moment, before Jack Clark, everything below the mythic was no different from ants, whether in the Ninth Heavens or at the peak of the Ninth Heavens, it was erased in an instant.
The unwillingness and resentment released by these True Demons and different races upon their deaths caused the blood light in the Doomsday Domain to surge violently, becoming ever more terrifying.
However, Jack Clark did not erase that Mountain Giant; instead, he slowly appeared in front of it because this was a Rampaging Giant that had lost its own consciousness and transformed from a human.
But why would a human appear here in the territory of The Purgatory Family, and furthermore, become an uncontrollable Rampaging Giant?
Roar!
The Giant, whose head was almost fused with its neck and whose muscular arms and shoulders had petrified into bursting rocks, let out a savage roar with its Battle Axe sweeping across the sky, as it faced the blood-colored figure exuding a Terrifying Aura.
Just as the Mountain Giant took a stance to attack, Jack Clark instantly appeared above its head and brought his palm down.
Boom!
Under the influence of Terrifying Power, the heavens and Earth were overturned, the ground shattered, and dirt and rock exploded into a crater several kilometers wide; the 300-meter-tall Mountain Giant lay in the crater with a weakened Aura, its body cracked.
But considering that it was also ‘human,’ Jack Clark did not kill it, and he slowly spoke from above, “Big guy, how did you end up in the territory of The Purgatory Family?”
Roar! The only response Jack Clark received was an unconscious roar.
Seeing this, Jack Clark gave the Rampaging Giant that resembled Punishing Heaven a deep look, then he rode away on Doomsday Hell, heading towards the City of Demon King Moss to the left.
After Jack Clark departed, the Rampaging Giant slowly rose, and grey mist emanated from the cracks on its body, turning to stone and repairing itself.
Roar!
Arriving in front of the desiccated corpse of the Kazan True Demon, the Rampaging Giant grasped its hundred-meter-tall, double-headed, six-armed True Body at the shoulder and opened its mouth wide.
Crackle!! The terrible biting force ripped half the flesh from the Purgatory True Demon, which the Rampaging Giant then started to devour voraciously.
Soon after, the corpse with the Nine Demonic Marks of the Purgatory True Demon was devoured, and the Rampaging Giant moved on to the next, with its body getting increasingly drenched in blood amidst the crackling sounds.
As it consumed more and more of the high-order True Demon flesh and blood, the Rampaging Giant’s Aura grew more and more ferocious, especially when it entered the warehouse under the mountain filled with the blood and Essence Blood of countless Giant Beasts, letting out excited low roars.
…
The City of Demon King Moss was located on a plain, covering more than one hundred kilometers, constructed from rough and towering buildings, surrounded by a black wall hundreds of meters high.
In each of the four directions outside the city was a massive military camp, where they trained enormous Demonized Beasts that howled and roared, the demon air filling the sky.
At this time, a Golden Crystal with a diameter of a kilometer floated above the city, radiating a dazzling Radiance that illuminated the city as if it were daylight.
More than one million beings from different races lived within the city, and besides those from the Black Elephant Alien Race under Moss Demon King, there were also beings from other Demon King’s Territories coming in and out to ‘conduct business.’
In the sky, massive Dragon-type Giant Beasts roared, with Purgatory True Demons or powerful alien traders from different races riding on them, ascending and descending, filled with an other-worldly Aura.
Although the Purgatory Family is known for its bloodlust, most of the True Demons and different races still needed to live, and as a result, manufacturing, industry, and commerce were actually quite developed.
Whenever a Purgatory Noble, wearing armor and surrounded by Dark Demon Air, walked on the street, the surrounding different races would quickly make way and bow their heads in respect.
Currently, in the Arena at the city center which occupied ten kilometers, it was bustling with activity, filled with members of The Purgatory Family, and on the main seat were two terrifying figures emanating the Aura of demon kings.
At this moment, the Arena had just concluded a fight, and after a thirty-meter-long Giant Beast devoured the flesh and blood of its opponent and was taken away, a gaunt member of The Purgatory Family stepped onto the High Platform.
“Next is a Human Race caught from the frontline, against a warrior from the Krodo Tribe, the odds are one to ten, ending when all of one side is dead.”
Following the noble’s announcement, a massive black iron gate on one side of the Arena slowly opened, and a group of over fifty humans wearing armor and leather with terrified expressions walked out.
These people, armed with weapons and ranging in height from 1.7 to 2 meters, had Auras from the Fourth Layer to the Seventh Layer. Their eyes filled with hatred when they looked at the surrounding Purgatory True Demons.
But when they saw the two terrifying figures seated on the throne, their faces involuntarily showed fear and despair, for they were demon kings.
“So this is the Human Race? How weak.”
“How has such a weak species resisted the attacks of His Majesty Demon God for over two hundred Sun Wheels?”
“It is said that because of the terrain, the frontlines where the empire and the Human Race clash cannot gather all the military forces, so the Human Race has been able to resist for so long.”
Watching those humans in the Arena, the surrounding audience of Purgatory Nobles chattered among themselves, with curiosity and also sneers, disdain, and confusion.
In the eyes of these Nobles above the Seventh Layer, these humans were too weak; their Auras were hollow, and their wills fragile.
To such a weak species, any True Demon in the battlefield could fight a hundred with one, slaughtering their peers like dogs, so they couldn’t comprehend how they had resisted the mighty army of the empire for so long.
At that moment, another black gate slowly opened, and a fifteen-meter-tall figure wearing tattered Bronze Armor walked out, clutching a huge Wolf Tooth Staff in his hand.
This fierce-looking warrior of the Krodo Tribe, exuding a Late Sevenfold Sky Aura and the strong scent of blood, had no idea how many lives he had slaughtered in the Arena.

chapters.title: Chapter 1161 - 1161 463 The Void of Death Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1161: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_4 Chapter 1161: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_4 “I bet on the Krodo Tribe to win. Crush those humans into a bloody pulp,” he demanded fiercely.
“I want to see those humans torn apart alive.”
“Wipe out those humans, Kuwala. I bet a hundred Demon Coins on the humans.”
“Uh… didn’t you just root for that Iron-Blooded Warrior to kill all humans? Why are you betting on them to win now?”
“Ten to one odds are hardly profitable. What if these humans pulled an upset? After all, they are the race that has been clashing with our tribe on the frontlines for so long.”
Suddenly, a Purgatory Demon of the Nine Demonic Marks stood up and shouted, “That Iron-Blooded Warrior, if you can blow up all those humans’ heads, I will buy you.”
Immediately, the creature from a different race’s eyes turned red. It let out a brutally low roar and burst forth with a boom, charging toward the humans over a thousand meters away like a launched cannonball.
The frenzied aura caused a change in the humans’ expressions, and the leading Seventh Layer Heaven human shouted, “Be careful, everyone. I’ll hold it off.”
As he yelled, a great True Strength erupted from the noble of the Human Race, drawing Heavenly Energy to form a fifteen-meter tall true martial arts phantom with a sword in hand.
Boom! Under the onslaught of the huge Wolf Tooth Staff enveloped in blood light, the true martial arts phantom collapsed, and the already weakened Seventh Layer Heaven strong man spat out blood and was sent tumbling backward.
“Kill!” Just then, two sharp sword lights burst forth from either side, swift and fierce, imbued with the Sixth Layer aura. They instantly struck the different race’s thighs.
Clang, clang! Firelight exploded. The sword light, capable of cleaving an armored car, left two deep marks on the armor but failed to penetrate the defense.
Boom!
The different race’s thirty-meter-long Wolf Tooth Staff swept across at Subsonic Speed, the massive airburst from the terrifying speed turned two humans into a cloud of blood mist with a single hit.
Their protective True Strength was instantly shattered by that overwhelmingly powerful force.
“Kill, kill all those humans.”
“Hahaha… good, blow them apart.”
Faced with the immense strength, swift speed, and higher realm of the Krodo Tribe, the humans were one by one obliterated by the different race, their spraying blood nearly painting the ground red.
This spectacle only fueled the excited cheering of the surrounding Purgatory Nobles.
Watching the ‘performance’ below, Demon King Clore on the throne was somewhat surprised, “Moss, these human slaves are quite valuable. Are you just wasting them like this?”
Demon King Moss shook his head, “These humans come from the Divine Gods Alliance. They haven’t learned technology; beyond a bit of strength, they’re useless.”
“From the Divine Gods Alliance? So Moss, you were tricked then,” Demon King Clore said with a smile on his face.
Moss’s gaze turned cold in an instant, “Those despicable slave traders, daring to deceive the great King of Purgatory. Next time they come to my territory, I will make them cough up everything.”
In the rear of The Purgatory Family, human ‘prices’ were high, and the Purgatory Demon Kings were very interested in the powerful technology and knowledge possessed by the Human Race.
And not just the Human Race, other races that had shown great strength in battles against The Purgatory Family were also the subjects of their research.
This was why The Purgatory Family had been able to stand tall in the mythical world for so many years, constantly absorbing advantages from various tribes and evolving their bloodlines.
At that moment, Demon King Clore spoke in a low voice, “Moss, I am here this time in connection with Prince Alec. His Highness has fallen.”
Demon King Moss was taken aback, “What? His Highness has fallen?”
“Indeed, the message was sent from the frontline. His Majesty sensed His Highness’s fall through the bloodline connection and has specially ordered me to investigate.”
“I don’t know much either.”
After a moment of thought, Demon King Moss said, “When it got dark earlier, Prince Alec came here with a group of Death Priests, briefly stayed, and then ventured deeper into the Dark Forest.”
“It seems he found traces of a different race’s civilization in a forbidden area and wanted to use a blood sacrifice on that civilization to breakthrough to become a Great Demon King.”
“As for where that different race is or which forbidden area it was in, I’m not sure. I’m not qualified to inquire about His Highness’s affairs, nor do I dare to.”
Moss was just a Demon King in the late period, which put a huge gap between him and Prince Alec, who was not only at the pinnacle among Demon Kings but also a Nobility with combat prowess on par with a Great Demon King.
Immediately, Demon King Clore’s brows knit together, his expression turning grave. How could he conduct his investigation now?
“Moss, have those Death Priests returned?” he asked.
“No, it seems they must have all perished in that forbidden area,” Moss replied gravely.
In The Purgatory Family, only Demon Gods with the bloodline of the Abyss or monstrously talented Demon Kings were qualified to be recognized by the Abyss, invoking the Power of the Abyss to enhance their strength, and to blood sacrifice all things.
Each of these Demon Kings was incredibly powerful, and yet this time one had fallen silently, indicating that the forbidden area was perilously dangerous and it was located on the periphery of their territory.
Such is the Vast World—immense, mysterious, perilous—even a Demon King with power to rival a Great Demon King can die suddenly.
“This complicates matters,” sighed Demon King Clore, massaging his brow. If he could not find useful information, explaining to Lewus Demon God would be challenging.
Moss shook his head, “It’s fortunate I chose not to join you in the Imperial Guard, to serve directly in the main city of the empire. Where there is land to rule, there’s comfort and ease.”
“I have prepared 150,000 sets of Gold-plated Battle Armor and Refined Demon Soldiers, and enough supplies for a vassal army of 500,000 to fight for twenty Sun Wheels’ time.”
“Now, I just await His Majesty’s command, and then I can lead the mighty army to march to the frontline,” Moss said, his expression turning somber.

chapters.title: Chapter 1162 - 1162 463 The Void of Death Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1162: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_5 Chapter 1162: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Heroes (10K)_5 “Is the situation at the frontline so grave that His Majesty is actually preparing to launch a War of Extermination, Clore?”
Initiating a War of Extermination was no easy matter, all demon kings needed to lead their elite Main Battle Legions, support them with the armies of the Vassal Races, and ensure their own logistics were prepared.
These logistics included food, fast-healing Heaven and Earth Treasures, resources for quickly recovering strength and Qi Blood, and sufficient support for prolonged engagement.
Once a nation embarked on a War of Extermination, the consequences could be dire. If it couldn’t destroy the enemy quickly after deploying most forces to the frontline, chaos could erupt in the exposed rear.
Without the Great Demon King and demon kings in command, the dozens of subdued Vassal Races might become restless.
Including the alliances formed by Mythical Powerhouses of different races that had escaped during previous annihilations, they might launch a counterattack, along with some monsters suppressed by the Great Demon King in the Deep Forbidden Zone…
Demon King Clore spoke slowly, “The situation at the frontline is indeed tense…”
Just then, a black radiance flashed across the sky, followed by a stern shout that echoed through Heaven and Earth, “An enemy is approaching; activate the Great Dark Array immediately.”
Boom!
In an instant, the entire Demon King’s City trembled, the demon patterns inscribed on the City Wall lit up, resonating with some of the buildings within the city, and from the four army camps outside the city, a black Demon Pillar, a kilometer thick, shot up into the sky.
The Firmament above was enveloped by the Dark Demon Cloud, demon gas churned, forming a black Light Curtain that fell and covered over a hundred kilometers, creating a powerful Enchantment barrier.
The sudden change shook the entire city, as figures surrounded by demon gas soared into the sky, scattering in all directions to take their positions, orderly and unpanicked.
Sitting high on his throne, Moss Demon King’s expression turned cold, “What’s happening?”
The black radiance descended, revealing the figure of a True Demon in the late stage of Nine Demonic Marks, kneeling on one knee, a look of fear in his eyes.
“Reporting to the Demon King, it is a Mythical Powerhouse of a different race, who has already annihilated eleven positions in the Demon City. All the resident True Demons and individuals of different races have been wiped out, and now they’re rapidly advancing towards the Demon King’s City.”
“Through the Demon Eyes observation, the realm of this alien is at the Mid-Mythical Stage, but its strength is extremely formidable, mastering a Blood Sea Slaughter Law Domain among other unknown abilities.”
Demon King Clore’s gaze was icy, “It seems to be a Mythical Powerhouse of a different race that has come for revenge after a breakthrough.”
Moss Demon King sneered, “Seeking death. Does it think that becoming a Mythical Powerhouse means it can contend with our clan? Naive. It just so happens that this king has recently made a breakthrough to the late stage of demon king.”
“Once I kill that mythical alien, I’ll hang its corpse at the entrance of the Demon City to let all different races know the fate of those who dare to resist our clan.”
“Someone, fetch my weapon.”
“Yes, Great King.”
Knowing that the incoming alien Powerhouse was only at the Mid-Mythical Stage, both Moss and Clore, who were in the late stage of demon king, did not take it seriously.
As powerful Purgatory True Demons, even at the Early Myth stage, they could suppress these weaker Mid-Mythical Stage Powerhouses of different races.
Soon, two giants of different races, more than 50 meters tall, appeared, laboriously carrying a black long spear that was a hundred meters long.
Boom! As Moss Demon King grasped the long spear, a Terrifying Aura burst forth, the formidable demon gas rose into the sky, merging with the churning Demon Cloud above, obscuring the sun.
“Moss the Great is invincible.”
“Daring to provoke our clan is seeking death.”
One by one, high-order figures soared into the sky from the Arena, following behind the Demon Cloud surrounded Moss Demon King, flying towards the City Wall as a thicker blood light spread across the sky, eclipsing even the Blood Moon.
Within the blood light that covered tens of kilometers, the vague figure of a ten-meter-tall being with black dragon horns on its head emerged, with the towering illusion of a Demon God Illusion a kilometer high behind it.
The immense Killing Intent radiating invisibly made even Moss, who had felt unconcerned moments ago, and Clore, tense up.
This approaching mythical Powerhouse of a different race was very strong.
Boom, boom, boom!! At that moment, the blood light, like a tide, crashed against the black Light Curtain surrounding the city, unleashing a tsunami-like impact, instantly causing atmospheric explosions and space to quake.
“The Purgatory Family, die.” The low voice sounded as the figure with dragon horns made a move, and a Blood Colored Battle Spear wrapped in black and grey order chains emerged in its hands.
However, in order to disguise its identity, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd had undergone some changes in appearance.
Instantly, Moss and Clore’s faces turned pale, and Clore, sitting on the Arena’s throne, shouted, “Moss, be careful, it is Higher-order Law! And there are two of them.”
At that moment, Jack Clark had already made a bold move, and amidst the explosion of blood light, a halberd a thousand meters long, reaching across tens of kilometers, pierced through Heaven and Earth.
Under the Terrifying Power, the Vacuum exploded, shaking Heaven and Earth.
With the combined forces of one side of the Power of Hell and two Higher-order Law Powers, along with the Divine Power of Supreme Vacuum amplified by the passive increase of Law of Strength, the halberd fell instantly upon the black Light Curtain.
Boom!
The entire Demon City trembled violently, the Earth around the city shattered and exploded, the demon patterns and some of the buildings on the City Wall crumbled and burst.
The Demon Pillars that had erupted from the four army camps also shook, and between the Light Curtain and the Blood Colored Battle Spear, circles of dazzling energy light exploded, the horrifying scene as if Doomsday had arrived.
All the Purgatory True Demons and different races displayed expressions of disbelief and shock.
The opponent had managed to shake the Dark Demon Array that had stood for more than several hundred years in the City of Demon King Moss, built by spending countless resources and linking it with Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1163 - 1163 463 The Void of Death Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1163: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Braves (10K)_6 Chapter 1163: Chapter 463: The Void of Death Descends, Slaughtering a Million Braves (10K)_6 Crackle Crackle!! It lasted only a breath before numerous cracks appeared on the thick Black Light Curtain that was robust enough to withstand the attacks of the Great Demon King’s initial strength.
“Stop for your king!” Moss roared in fury, displaying his 500-meter-tall three-headed, eight-armed Demon King’s True Form, and with black war spears in both arms, he soared into the sky.
At the same time, two of his six remaining hands formed Demon Seals, invoking the Divine Power of his bloodline to ignite Black Flames, and instantly, the black war spear swelled to over a thousand meters, emitting a terrifying aura.
The other four arms drew a bow and nocked arrows, each one wrapped in eerie black runes, aiming at Jack Clark, who was in the Hell Domain.
Boom! The Sky Curtain collapsed as the Blood Colored Battle Spear, like a massive missile of world destruction, descended from the sky, its might destroying the black war spear in one strike.
The terrifying power further shattered the Law Domain and blew apart half of Moss’s True Body before it fell into the center of the Demon King’s City, causing dazzling light to burst forth in an instant.
Boom!! Half of the Demon King’s City was blown away, the Earth crumbled, and countless buildings and dirt debris were thrown tens of thousands of meters into the air, shaking the entire Firmament.
“You are too weak, is this what they call the Purgatory True Demon?” Within Doomsday Hell, Jack Clark crushed the black arrow in his hand effortlessly, with a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils materializing behind him that blotted out the sky.
Instantly, the Dark Curtain of Void descended, enveloping an area over a hundred kilometers.
The Mystical Void, a Divine Power of the Void Law, creates a Dark Curtain that pervades a certain range, merging into the Void and depriving the enemy of their physical and Spiritual Will perception.
This move, when Jack was at the Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Layers Heaven, was only moderately powerful, but when he made his breakthrough to the Legendary Realm and the Void Law became proficient, it finally revealed the might of Higher-order Law.
At this moment, whether it was those of different races, True Demons, or Moss and Rockelle, two late-period Demon Kings, they all lost their perception of their surroundings.
Before Rockelle and Moss, who had instantaneously recovered their True Bodies by consuming their Origin, could react, those Black Gold eyes in the darkness emerged again, locking onto them with Terrifying Power.
Thump Thump!!
The Void around the two Demon Kings shattered, thoroughly at that, with the space where they stood and their True Bodies pulverized, instantly causing heavy damage to their Divine Souls.
“No, how is this possible!” In despair, the two Demon Kings had time only to let out an enraged wail of their Divine Souls before the formless substance of their Void shattered again.
Thump Thump Thump!!
Under the gaze of the Void Death Pupil, the two Demon Kings had no strength left to resist, and under the onslaught of more than twenty cycles of space repair and shattering, they were completely eradicated.
Amidst the darkness shrouded in Void, the Law converged, and two Blood Moons emerged, slowly falling.
After eradicating the two Demon Kings and veiling the spectacle of their downfall, Jack Clark looked down slightly, his gaze coldly fixed on the over two million beings of different races and the Purgatory True Demons beneath the black shadow of the Void.
“You enjoy the slaughter of different races, the sacrifices, don’t you? Today, I too will offer you as a sacrifice. Descend, Hell.” Accompanied by Jack’s deep voice, a bloody red split open in the heavens above.
Suddenly, an endless Blood Light spewed forth, inundating hundreds of kilometers. Everywhere it passed, individuals from different races and True Demons exploded into clouds of blood mist that merged into Hell.
The obliteration of a million Senior members of different races exploded, their Blood Qi nearly dying the sky red, with horrific resentment and unwillingness clinging to Jack, forming a purplish-red blood light.
Immediately, the Blood Light Halo behind him grew even more dazzling; the thousand-meter tall Demon God Illusion became clearer, more terrifying, surrounded by tangible rings of blood light.
This was the true blood flowing into a river; Scythia and Miss Joseline would definitely be very excited to see this.
[There are still a thousand words, working hard on revisions, promised ten thousand words today will definitely be ten thousand]

chapters.title: Chapter 1164 - 1164 464 The High Priest of Destiny
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1164: Chapter 464: The High Priest of Destiny, Surrounding and Killing Jack Clark Chapter 1164: Chapter 464: The High Priest of Destiny, Surrounding and Killing Jack Clark Thousands of kilometers away from the Sky Curtain Battlefield, atop a black mountain summit behind the Purgatory Family’s base, a stream aglow with seven-color radiance flowed, emitting a dream-like light.
Sitting above the Seven-color Stream was a shriveled and ancient Purgatory True Demon, so old that even teeth had fallen out, with an aura feeble as a candle in the wind.
At this moment, the elderly Purgatory True Demon slightly lowered its head, its murky gaze quietly observing the flowing Seven-color Stream beneath, seemingly trying to penetrate the stream to see something beyond.
At the edge of a distant cliff, Emperor Diorus sat atop the spiked head of an ancient creature, his oppressive aura restrained, his expression cold and indifferent as he waited.
Suddenly, the ancient Purgatory True Demon slowly raised its head, its voice hoarse, “Emperor Diorus, that human has left the Human Race territorial area.”
“Finally emerged, has he?”
Emperor Diorus’s eyes burned with endless dark flames, filled with terrifying majesty as he spoke in a deep voice, “Has that human reached the Frontline Battlefield?”
The ancient Purgatory True Demon slowly shook its head, its voice hoarse, “On the frontline battlefield, I have not seen the destiny threads related to that human.”
This ancient Purgatory True Demon was quite special; it was the High Priest of Destiny of the Purgatory Empire, its cultivation focused on ‘Destiny,’ ranking only below the two Demon Gods under Emperor Diorus.
Destiny is elusive and intangible, a special power system obtained by the Purgatory Family after they annihilated a civilization, integrated into their bloodline inheritance.
Purgatory True Demons capable of awakening the Power of Destiny were extremely rare, each inevitably becoming a High Priest of a Demon God Empire, worshipped and cultivated by the power of an entire nation.
But destiny is unpredictable, and every glimpse into it exacted an irreversible toll, so unless it involved a crisis of the empire, Emperor Diorus would not call upon its services.
Emperor Diorus’s voice was deep, “If Darren Callum has left the Human Race area without entering the Frontline Battlefield, it seems the higher-ups from his clan are aware that we are targeting him.”
“This person must have ventured deep into the Vast World through the Human Race’s Outer Development Department for cultivation and to explore relics. He probably won’t reappear on the frontlines until he’s made a breakthrough to the Grand Demon King level.”
“Shame, our pawns at the Divine Gods Alliance were destroyed, and we can’t mobilize forces to track Darren Callum’s whereabouts. Thus, it falls to you, High Priest, to take on this arduous task.”
Emperor Diorus had long anticipated that every race had protective ‘mechanisms’ to shield epoch-defining geniuses like this.
After all, at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, Emperor Diorus had twice attempted to suppress and kill that monstrous talent from the human race.
Yet as long as you enter the Vast World, I have ways to find you, Emperor Diorus spoke indifferently, “High Priest, can you see exactly where he is?”
The High Priest slowly shook its head, its voice hoarse, “The destiny thread of this human is very vague and constantly changing. Earlier, even after burning a thousand years of my lifespan, I only saw that he was not within the range of the Human Race.”
“However, I have captured a wisp of his Destiny Aura. As soon as his destiny undergoes another fluctuation, I will be able to pinpoint him instantly.”
As he spoke, the High Priest extended a black, sharp finger into the void, drawing out from the Seven-color Stream two strands of golden light that formed the names Jack Clark and Darren Callum in the air, emitting a dim radiance.
After doing this, the High Priest’s aura weakened once again, seeming even older, his body even radiating a decaying scent as if he were on the verge of death.
“It’s just that, your majesty, directly observing his location through destiny will likely draw substantial backlash from the Supreme Destiny,” the High Priest warned.
“Don’t worry, High Priest, I have prepared for this. Here is a whisker from a Time Dragon, its Time Power should grant you an additional five thousand years of life,” Emperor Diorus assured.
Presenting a dragon whisker over ten meters long and several dozen centimeters thick, floating in the air like a transparent ribbon, it gleamed with a fantastical and splendid radiance.
Emperor Diorus spoke decisively, “That human’s talent is too horrific. He must be suppressed before he reaches Demon God Level, or else our clan wil face a terrifying enemy.”
Seeing the dragon whisker imbued with Time Power, a smile appeared on the ancient face of the High Priest.
Glimpsing just a trace of destiny had burnt a thousand years of its lifespan; the upcoming vision to pinpoint the target’s location would likely consume two thousand years of its lifespan.
With the remaining two thousand years of Time Power, its life expectancy should return to around six thousand years.
“Rest assured, your majesty, for the eternal standing of our clan in this world, this old one would burn away all life to find him,” the High Priest then marveled.
“To have mastered four Higher-order and one Supreme Law upon breaking through to Myth, a prodigy of such talent has only been matched by our Ancestor in the annals of our clan.”
“Such a talented being from different races must be eradicated in the cradle.”
“This human must be a unique entity where all the human Luck has converged. Killing him would be tantamount to severing the last thread of Luck for the Human Race, cutting off their future.”
Emperor Diorus nodded slowly, “Indeed.”
In the eyes of Emperor Diorus and other Demon God Level Powerhouses, Jack Clark’s combat strength and cultivation speed were so terrifying; aside from his innate talent, it must have been attributed to accumulating the entire Human Race’s Luck.
In such a state, he could turn any peril into safety, his cultivation progress soaring, and if he entered a relic, he would receive Inheritance. He might even stumble upon God-level Resources simply by walking down a road.
Otherwise, how could a mere indigenous being break through to the Mythical-level in just ten Sun Wheels?
And just as Emperor Diorus was preparing to take personal action to suppress and kill Jack Clark…

﻿Chapter 1165: Chapter 464: The High Priest of Destiny, Surrounding and Killing Jack Clark_2 Chapter 1165: Chapter 464: The High Priest of Destiny, Surrounding and Killing Jack Clark_2 “`
Blue Star, South Sky Martial Height.
After assisting Glenn Clark with the procedures and meeting with the teacher, Justin Welan led him around the school campus to familiarize him with his new environment, to prevent him from feeling restrained.
Upon arriving at the base of a large building, Justin Welan pointed at the Teaching Building in front of them, “This is Building B, where students study and practice the Body Casting Skill.”
“The requirement for Foundation Establishment is to spiritually meditate a complete Lotus Stand within half an hour and transport Qi Blood through ten turns. The faster the Foundation Establishment, the higher the talent it demonstrates.”
“I’ve read about this online.” Looking at the towering thirty-story building, Glenn Clark asked curiously, “Justin, big brother, how long did it take you to establish your foundation?”
Justin Welan was somewhat proud: “I managed to successfully establish my foundation in just one week, while your brother took fifteen days to succeed, ranking over three hundred…”
At this point, Justin Welan suddenly stopped talking, then coughed dryly and said, “Tiger, actually the belief that the earlier you establish your foundation, the better your talent is can only represent the majority; some people who build up a strong base slowly over time are exceptions.”
Glenn Clark nodded, “I understand. Someone like my brother would be an exception, after all, no one could have imagined that someone initially ranked over three hundred in the school’s innate talent ranking could become a myth within a year, right?”
As they passed Building B, they came to the rear: “This is Building C. After achieving a grand accomplishment in Body Casting Skill, you will come here to establish your foundation. Back then, Jack…”
Before Justin Welan could finish, Glenn Clark interrupted him in surprise.
“Eh! Justin, big brother, what’s this?” Standing by the roadside green belt, Glenn Clark bent down and picked up a fist-sized grey stone from the bushes.
The stone showed no energy fluctuations and looked just like an ordinary stone, even covered with some dirt.
“This isn’t just a stone… wait, Tiger, let me take a look at it.”
Just as Justin Welan was about to say that it was merely a stone, his gaze landed on a fine crack on the stone, from which a faint radiance seemed to leak out.
In recent times, various Space Cracks have appeared across the globe. Aside from those large ones that could be traversed by different races and Giant Beasts, there were also some faint cracks.
When these small cracks spanned between two worlds, they brought in some materials from the mythical world, Heaven and Earth Treasures… Could it be…
Justin Welan took the stone, feeling its unusual heft and cold texture, and a surge of strength erupted from his hand.
Crack! Cracks started to form on the stone and its outer layer fell away, revealing a pure white Crystal underneath with a slowly flowing liquid white substance inside.
Though it wasn’t yet professionally identified, Justin Welan, who had seen much of the world, was certain this was a top-tier, absorbable energy resource…
What kind of luck is this?
…
In the ruins of the Demon King’s City, Jack Clark appeared above the Demon King’s castle.
As a demon king ruling over millions of different races, Moss’s castle was magnificently built, covering an area of over twenty kilometers with the main structure stretching up a thousand meters, entirely cast from black stones with the sheen of refined iron.
All the buildings and palaces of the castle were engraved with the imposing reliefs of Purgatory True Demons, with countless different races and Giant Beasts bowing at their feet.
However, at this moment, this castle situated in the West City direction was partially collapsed due to a devastating halberd strike, and all the guards and different races had turned into mists of blood and perished.
As Jack stood above the Demon King’s castle, his Divine Soul Intent quickly located the warehouse.
Boom! With a stretch of his palm into the void, the buried heavy black door shattered, revealing the Demon King’s treasure vault compressed within.
Inside were countless minerals, special materials, as well as Tempered Giant Beasts’ scales and skeletons piled up like mountains, emitting rich energy fluctuations.
While ruling over tens of thousands of True Demons and millions of different races, the Purgatory Demon King Moss also had significant consumption.
After all, it was responsible for their equipment, ‘wages’, and food; if not, its underlings’ Demon hearts would be unstable, and no demon would work or fight for it.
However, the number of God-level resources in the warehouse was few; most were Senior top-tier minerals and materials. But even so, Jack couldn’t help smiling at the sight of them.
The total value of these materials and minerals was immense, exceeding seven million merit points and even surpassing the haul from the previous raid on the Evil God Alliance.
In contrast to the ‘barren’ lands of humans, the territories occupied by these Purgatory Demon Kings were very rich, and just the materials crammed into the warehouse were astonishingly valuable.
The most precious top-tier and even Law-level resources naturally remained in the hands of the Moss Demon King, annihilated upon their demise and disappearing into the depths of the spatial cracks.
Actually, when Jack was suppressing the two Demon Kings, he had held back, wary of damaging their Storage Equipment.
But as the spaces and their True Bodies shattered repeatedly and they knew death was certain, Moss and Clore, the two Demon Kings, intentionally detonated their Storage rings with their Divine Soul strength.
Even in death, they didn’t want Jack to benefit.
It appears that the next time he kills those demon kings, he will need to seize their Storage Equipment first, then suppress and grind their True Bodies to dust.
While contemplating, Jack drew a line in the air before him, opening a Black Crack over a hundred meters long and several meters wide that connected to the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane.
Boom!
The atmosphere vibrated, and an intense suction force erupted, enveloping the warehouse for several kilometers. The piled mountains of Golden ore and the Giant Beasts’ essence bones soared into the sky.
In the Plane World, a black crack appeared above the Firmament, and a myriad of minerals and materials rained down from the heavens.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1166 - 1166 464 The High Priest of Destiny
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1166: Chapter 464: The High Priest of Destiny, Surrounding and Killing Jack Clark_3 Chapter 1166: Chapter 464: The High Priest of Destiny, Surrounding and Killing Jack Clark_3 Countless materials, the moment they fell, were torn to shreds by the raging black wind between heaven and earth, or destroyed by the roaring Blue Thunder, with the golden flames turning them to “void.”
Only a small portion of golden minerals could withstand the violent tempest of wind, thunder, and fire, falling to the ground and gradually piling up into a Golden Mineral Mountain.
As for those materials shattered and destroyed, the substance was absorbed by the Plane World, which trembled slightly and rapidly expanded, quickly extending for several kilometers.
This was one of the methods for the swift expansion of the Plane World, using countless essences of Heaven and Earth to strengthen itself.
As the Plane World grew, Jack could distinctly feel that the Law of Strength nurtured within the Plane was growing stronger, and numerous insights into the mysterious nature of Laws flooded his mind.
The progress of the Supreme Law’s cultivation level is related to the Plane World that carries the Law. Therefore, during his three days of Closed-door Cultivation, Jack’s four Higher-order Laws all achieved minor breakthroughs, but the Law of Strength only progressed from 24% to 28%, a slow advancement.
As for the Soul Law, due to just undergoing a Transformation, it also reached only 27%.
This is the downside of comprehending multiple Laws; each Law requires the consumption of energy and time for cultivation.
Had Jack not been able to burn Attribute points, maintaining a state of enlightenment continuously, his progress in the Laws would have become exceedingly slow after his breakthrough to king-level.
By the time he had “emptied” the warehouse, the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane had grown to include more than ten Golden Mineral Mountains of various sizes, while its diameter surged from 1,100 kilometers to just over 1,200 kilometers.
With the expansion of the Plane, not only its spatial bearing capacity and crystalline barrier strength improved, but also the speed of its consumption and conversion of Chaos Void Energy increased, continuously producing “Heavenly Energy.”
This was Jack’s reserve.
After “cleaning up” the battlefield, the Blood Sea Hell that blocked out the sun moved swiftly into the distance, traveling at a speed of over twenty times the speed of sound, over 30,000 kilometers per hour.
Not long after Jack left, over ten black radiances appeared in the sky, and soon several Purgatory True Demons, emanating the early to mid-Nine Demonic Marks, showed up in the heavens.
“Where is Moss Demon King!?”
Looking down at the ruins of what once was the Demon King’s City, those Purgatory True Demons who felt the terrifying energy fluctuations and rushed back from their respective stations were all shocked.
The territory controlled by Moss Demon King was too vast for Jack to have the time to completely eradicate everyone, and his targets were not these ordinary Purgatory True Demons.
Roar! Just then, a ferocious roar came from the distance; amidst the trembling mountain forest, a Rampaging Giant standing over 400 meters tall, covered in rock, made its appearance.
After Devouring the corpses of several high-order Purgatory True Demons, thousands of corpses from different races, and an abundance of Giant Beast flesh and Essence Blood, this Rampaging Giant, which had already reached the Nine Layers’ late period, stepped into the Level 9 Peak.
Gazing up at those Purgatory True Demons in the sky, with neck, head, and shoulders merged and wielding a Battle Axe, the Rampaging Giant that resembled the mythical Punishing Heaven let out a fierce roar.
Boom!
A massive force of heaviness enveloped those Purgatory True Demons, and under the dreadful rule of gravity, all of them turned pale as their demon gas burst from within.
More than half an hour later, a fleeing black radiance sped off into the distance.
On the shattered land, surrounded by swirling Blood Qi, the Rampaging Giant held the True Body of a hundred-meter-tall Purgatory True Demon, devouring it voraciously, with purple blood mixed with bits of flesh flowing from the corners of its mouth.
After consuming the flesh and blood of those few high-order Purgatory True Demons, the Rampaging Giant looked around and then seemed to sense the Blood Qi lingering between heaven and earth.
Boom!
The ground within a radius of several kilometers crumbled, and under the powerful recoil, the Rampaging Giant soared into the sky like a cannonball, flying tens of thousands of meters high, landing tens of kilometers away.
Immediately, mountains collapsed, trees toppled, and then a huge figure once more leapt up tens of thousands of meters high, tracing an arc across the sky and disappearing under the Blood Colored Moonlight.
Just as Jack approached the next Demon King’s territory, the news of the Moss Demon King’s downfall, slain by an Alien Deity, quickly reached the heart of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.
The news spread faster than Jack had anticipated.
“Poor Moss, killed by an Alien who cultivates the Slaughter Rule?”
Within the Demon Palace that towered into the clouds, surrounded by rolling Dark Demon Air, stood hundreds of figures bearing Nine Demonic Marks, and two emanating the presence of a Demon King.
Reclining lazily on the Main Position of the Demon Palace’s throne, a three-meter-tall, purple-haired woman, resembling a human and dressed in a luxurious red Battle Armor, said languidly, “He didn’t even attempt to hide his movements; he must really not regard our Purgatory Family with any consideration.”
A Demon King below bowed respectfully, “Yes, Lady Tarolia. In addition to Moss, Clore also was killed while investigating the fall of Prince Alec. As observed by the Eye of the Demon God, that Alien Deity’s aura was around the Mid-Mythical Stage, currently controlling the Hell Domain and heading towards Scott’s Demon King’s City.”

Boom!

The purple-haired woman licked her lips, smiling lazily and seductively, “Moving so openly, without disguise, it seems it does not take our Purgatory Family seriously.”
“However, both Moss and Rockelle were in the late period of demon king realm. To slay them in such a short time, without giving them a chance to escape, that alien deity’s true strength must be very formidable.”
“Mid-Mythical Stage in realm, yet the combat power has broken through the Mythical Limit, at least comparable to the early stage of the Great Demon King. Such a range of power is rare even among our clan.”
“Indeed, those alien tribes who refuse to submit to our clan must be eradicated to prevent future threats.” As she spoke, Tarolia straightened slightly, her gaze turning cold.
And as she sat up, the proud bosom of this voluptuous Great Demon Queen seemed even more majestic and towering, like mountain peaks that took one’s breath away.
Tarolia’s gaze was cold as she looked down, slowly saying, “Currently, Diorus and Prince Carthius are at the frontline. I, as the prince, and Taxes are each holding down the Southern and Northern Demon Domains and cannot leave lightly.”
“Therefore, we can only have Erbore take action. Although it, being at the mid period of the Great Demon King, can suppress that alien deity, it might still lack a bit of assurance to capture it.”
After reaching Mythical Stage, the power gap between each small realm is quite vast. Defeating an opponent who is one minor realm higher is easy, but killing them is challenging.
After all, one can boost their strength several times by burning Origin, and with some special Secret Skills and Divine Powers, one must completely overpower an opponent to capture them.
Tarolia said coldly, “Kudo, retrieve the Race Weapon of the Goldscale Tribe from the Secret Vault and give it to Erbore. Let it descend upon the City of the Demon King Scott and suppress that alien deity.”
“Yes, my lord,” another demon king below bowed in obedience.
Tarolia continued, “Also, inform Taxes guarding the Southern Region of the empire that the Five Demon Kings of Dolanze are to perform a blood sacrifice and descend, and they must eradicate that Mythical alien deity.”
The Purgatory Family acted quickly. After estimating Jack Clark’s ‘true combat power’, they swiftly responded.
They prepared to suppress him with a thunderous force, led by a mid-stage Great Demon King wielding an alien tribe’s Race Weapon, accompanied by six other demon kings, including Jack Clark’s next target.
[There are still over a thousand words, please wait]
As the command was issued by the Prince of the Black Abyss overseeing the Demon Domain over two hundred million kilometers away, a terrifying pressure from a Great Demon King surged into the sky, soon converging to meet Jack Clark, standing atop a demon fortress on a mountain peak tens of kilometers tall, seventy thousand kilometers from Jack Clark.
