chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1168: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race Darren Callum Chapter 1168: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race Darren Callum As the six towering demon steles, each reaching ten thousand feet high, descended, the archaic demon patterns on them, representing ‘Metropolis, Heaven, Town, God, Demon, World,’ shone brilliantly, transforming into the force of rules that covered an area of two hundred kilometers.
Under the rule-borne force being emitted by the Demon Suppressing Steles, everything in this world was severed, disconnected from the ‘Outer World,’ thus forming an independent prison.
Even those with space-time manipulation divine powers capable of traversing the Void wouldn’t be able to escape.
“Evan Lynch, today is your day of death,” roared the six Demon Kings atop the steles, their bodies swelling to reveal true forms hundreds of meters tall.
Two of the Demon Kings had three heads and eight arms, one had three heads and ten arms, radiating the oppressive might of mid and late period Demon Kings.
The other three transformed forms of Demon Kings from different races were slightly different: one had bat wings and its body was covered in blood-red scales like a blood-sucking demon.
The other two Demon Kings, standing five hundred meters tall, had bulky figures like mountains, resembling a yak standing on its hind legs, covered in black scales, with horns curving from their heads, each carrying two small hills as black as coal.
As the six Demon Kings channeled their strength into the Demon Suppressing Stele, it vibrated, summoning hundreds of pillars of dark demon air from the heavens, reaching the Earth and turning this world into a Dark Hell, and in an instant, an even more potent suppressive force descended.
Boom! The Hell Domain, which had covered over a hundred and sixty kilometers, shook, blood light flashed, and it was gradually compressed to a range of fifty kilometers.
At this point, no matter how the six Demon Kings tried to harness the power of the Demon Suppressing Stele, they couldn’t shrink the blood-drenched Hell Domain any further.
“What a powerful Sea of Blood Slaughter Domain!” All six Demon Kings had solemn expressions on their faces.
At the Mythical level, the range covered by a Law Domain and its suppressive effect can also be seen as a manifestation of strength.
For instance, the Doomsday Domain enveloping Jack Clark was infused with the terrifying suppressive power due to the integration of Void Law and Death Law; ordinary Demon Kings would have their strength suppressed by fifty percent upon entering.
Under the cover of the Doomsday Domain, they couldn’t harness the Power of Heaven and Earth, couldn’t absorb the demon gas between heaven and earth to recover, and could only rely on their Demon King bodies and the divine powers of their bloodline to fight.
Boom!
The Great Demon King Erbore’s body flashed with black and purple thunder light, showing a true form of over a thousand meters with three heads and twelve arms amidst the Higher-order lightning.
Surrounded by endless purple thunder, a range of thirty kilometers turned into a Thunder Prison, blowing up the land below, causing ceaseless explosions and destruction, as if rending the heavens and the earth.
Without any idle chatter and revealing his true form while unfolding his Thunder Prison law domain, Erbore crossed tens of kilometers in one step and appeared in front of Jack Clark, and the roars of thunder followed instantly.
Boom, boom, boom!! The Dark Thunder Prison collided with the Hell Domain, sparking a maelstrom of exploding demonic lightning and roaring seas of blood.
“Evan Lynch, take my strike, the Aba Demon Seal!” Erbore roared. Blood light entwined his ten arms as he gathered countless black and purple thunders into a single palm.
Boom! A palm print of a thousand meters in diameter, black and red as if substantial, clearly showing its patterns, emanated a destructive aura capable of suppressing heaven and earth and shattering the Void.
Under the formidable force, the Doomsday Domain shook, the red light receded, and space crumbled.
And in the instant that Erbore made his move.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The six Demon Kings’ bodies burned with black flames, igniting a fraction of their Origin, their auras swelling massively as billowing demon gas shot into the sky; the leader in the late period, Taxes, unified his eight arms.
“Moldoro, Cut, Heaven, Seal!”
Boom! An immense Dark Phantom several thousand meters tall emerged between heaven and earth, grasping towards Jack Clark with eight arms, channeling a thread of the Law’s power contained within the Demon Suppressing Stele.
Under the terrifying force, the Doomsday Domain was directly ripped apart, the Sea of Blood parted, leaving Jack Clark exposed under the black and red palm print, and a potent sealing force entwined him, suppressing the origin of the laws within his body.
Just in a flash, the six Demon Kings and the Great Demon King Erbore set up a deadly well coordinated assault that would severely injure even a real strong man at the beginning of the Heavenly King period under normal conditions.
But…
Boom! An indescribable Power Explosion burst from Jack Clark’s body, his terrifying will piercing through the Cloud Sky in an instant, shattering the joint seal of the Demon Kings who had burned their Origin.
At the moment the black and red palm print fell, Jack Clark, with an expression of cold indifference, took a step forward and vanished under the Divine Power Treading Heaven.
Boom!
With a full-strength palm strike from a mid period Great Demon King wielding his bloodline divine power, over twenty kilometers of the Earth instantly shattered, countless clumps of dirt and rubble were thrown all directions, thousands of meters high, covering the sky.
Amidst the terrifying release of energy, black and red lightning exploded, as though a nuclear explosion, melting the airborne debris into magma, illuminating the Dark Demon Realm.
In the earth-shaking explosion, the Mythical-level Demon King’s face showed a look of horror.
In front of him, a three hundred meter tall figure appeared out of thin air, with three heads and six arms, transitioning into the Demon God Emperor Dragon Form, his body emitting an extremely fierce and terrifying aura.
Jack Clark’s four arms burned with Thunderflame, his hands forming seals, and instantly a Dragon Roar Elephant Roar thundered from the Void, creating a mountainous Dragon Elephant Phantom.
Dragon Elephant Treading Heaven!
Boom!
The True Martial Combat Technique once used in the Third Layer Heaven now unleashed its terrifying power, wielding the Divine Elephant Divine Might to form a one-kilometer diameter transparent fist imprint.
Under this dreadful force, material, energy, and space within several kilometers were compressed by the fist imprint into a tangible form, creating layers upon layers of transparent liquid bursting forth like a tidal wave.
In an instant, Taxes felt a breath of death approaching and could not help but roar in shock and rage, once more burning thirty percent of his Origin.
Instantly, Taxes’ aura skyrocketed, the black flames around him nearly tearing through the sky, his eight arms coalescing into one as the black Half-Moon War Halberd in his grip grew to a kilometer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1169 - 1169 465 The Might of the Race Background
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1169: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race’s Darren Callum_2 Chapter 1169: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race’s Darren Callum_2 Boom!
The entire world trembled with a roar as the Stepping Heaven Fist shattered the thousand-meter-long War Halberd. Taxes screamed in agony as his Demon King’s True Form burst into pieces.
The All-Heaven Demon Suppression Stele towering tens of thousands of feet high also shook violently, with several cracks appearing on its surface. If Jack Clark struck once more, he could even demolish it.
Although this set of Combination Forbidden Weapons contained the power of restraint and suppression, they were only ordinary forbidden weapons. The attack of a Heavenly King level had reached their limit.
All of this happened in an instant, and it wasn’t until then that the angry roars of the remaining five Demon Kings echoed from afar, along with Erbore’s overwhelming Great Demon King’s aura that covered the sky and land.
“Evan Lynch, your opponent is me!”
Erbore shot forward like a black-purple streak of lightning, winding for tens of kilometers and appearing instantly behind Jack Clark, sweeping up the heavens with Thunder, standing a thousand meters tall within the Thunder Prison, like an ancient demon king who wielded the ancient law of Thunder.
Erbore’s eleven arms, except for the one holding a golden Light sphere, each wielded a Thunder Spear more than a thousand meters long, firing away.
Eleven Thunder Spears condensed with the mystery of the laws shot through the Void, with lightning flashing between them. In an instant, space exploded, and a ten-thousand-meter brilliance of lightning radiated.
Meanwhile, Taxes, whose True Form had fragmented, began to reconverge in the distance, but just then, a palm stretched out from the Void.
Boom! Taxes’s arm was shattered with a clap, and the black Space Ring on his hand was snatched away. Then Jack Clark disappeared silently under the power of the Void Law.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Eleven dark thunderbolts exploded, engulfing an area of several kilometers in a wild burst of lightning, and the devastating energy released caused Taxes to scream and be blasted away.
The mighty Demon Suppressing Stele continued to crumble, its edges splitting apart, and the ‘Suppress’ demon pattern on it flashing wildly.
“Be careful, he’s targeting you!” Erbore, having missed another hit from Jack Clark, was startled and looked toward the distance, where Jack Clark had already appeared a hundred kilometers away.
The one to face Jack Clark’s might were two towering black mountains, thousands of meters tall.
Boom, boom!! Two bull-horned Demon Kings bellowed, reacting immediately, wielding the black mountains and smashing them directly towards Jack Clark, instantly covering the Heaven and Earth with a heavy force.
The laws mastered by the two Demon Kings were related to gravity, which, coupled with the Dark Laws they gained after demonization and the mountains of laws refined from a heavy vein, maximized their strength.
Under their heavy and overbearing strength, space continuously shattered, forming black cracks that spread in all directions, with the terrifying power of a collapsing heaven and earth enveloping Jack Clark.
Roar!
A fierce and majestic Dragon Roar resounded through the Void as Jack Clark’s arms, resembling Dragon Claws, flexed and collided, with a terrifying force gathering in his fists and soaring skyward.
Boom, boom!!
Under the force of Unrivaled Domination, space collapsed, and the two exceedingly solid and heavy black mountains trembled violently, cracking and exploding continuously.
Spurt! The intrinsic weapons, solidified from Divine Souls, were destroyed, and the repercussion of the force caused the Demon Kings in the distance to shake as they spat blood and looked forward in horror.
Standing over three hundred meters tall and with three faces and six arms, Jack Clark suddenly appeared before them, pressing down with six arms.
Boom!
Under the power of the Void Law, the two Demon Kings, along with their surroundings for thousands of kilometers, were engulfed by darkness, shattered, and their True Bodies were instantly blown away and heavily injured.
In the violent turbulence, two palms appeared out of nowhere and grabbed two chunks of black scales, several meters in size. Immediately after, Jack Clark’s figure faintly flickered and vanished again, followed by Erbore’s furious roar.
With the Divine Power of Heaven-walking Divine Steps combined with the Void Power that allowed him to merge into the Void, Jack Clark’s speed reached an extreme, so much so that even Erbore, transformed into Thunder, couldn’t catch up.
Boom!
The Demon God Emperor Dragon, with one punch, obliterated the Demon King with Bat Wings, who, despite burning his Origin for a burst of power, was still directly crushed by a punch, and the Space Bracelet on his left wrist was seized.
The terrifying combat power shocked all the Demon Kings, and Erbore was furious.
It was only then that Taxes, the first Demon King whose True Body Jack Clark had shattered, had just finished reassembling. He then roared in anger, “He’s after our Space Equipment.”
Erbore roared, “Group up with me.”
Without needing his call, the remaining two Demon Kings, after witnessing Jack’s terrifying combat power, both turned into demonic lights and flew towards Erbore, their expressions grave.
Along with that, Taxes and the two bull-like Demon Kings who had reassembled their True Bodies closed in.
Spurt, spurt, spurt!!
Jack Clark held the head of the Demon King with Bat Wings with one hand, and grey and black chains of Death and Soul Laws emerged on his arm, entangling the half-formed True Body of the Demon King.
“Lord Erbore, save me!”
Under the suppression of the Higher-order Death and Soul Laws, the Demon King’s body stiffened, unable to mobilize its power and could only watch in horror as its True Body, Vitality, and Divine Soul dissipated steadily.
Jack Clark slowly turned back, his voice low as he looked across the dozens of kilometers at the towering Great Demon King and five Demon Kings, “Can’t you guys react a little slower?”
He had held back in his previous attacks to avoid the Demon Kings destroying their Space Rings when sensing impending death while attempting to seize their Space Equipment.
But it was unexpected that after seizing the Space Equipment from four Demon Kings, they finally reacted.
Or rather, it would have been problematic if they hadn’t reacted, given how obvious Jack Clark’s actions were.
But as they watched the Death and Soul Law power radiating from Jack Clark, Erbore looked extremely grave.
The Eye of the Demon God detected that this alien deity mastered the laws of the Void and Death—but what the hell was this sudden emergence of the Soul Law?

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1170: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race’s Darren Callum_3 Chapter 1170: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race’s Darren Callum_3 “`
Three Higher-order Laws, their might is equivalent to one Supreme Power, and they all involve distinctive powers of the Supreme Law, no wonder the opponent’s combat power is so terrifying.
Just then, the Demon King’s True Form that Jack Clark held in his hand dissipated like sand, a sense of the Laws between heaven and earth triggered, a Blood Moon emerged above the Firmament, slowly descending.
In just a few breaths’ time, Jack Clark has used the immense and boundless Law Divine Power to forcefully erode the Demon King’s origin.
Boom! A Thunder Spear, wrapped by a Nine Heavens Thunder Dragon and stretching over a thousand meters, appeared a hundred meters away from Jack Clark, emitting dazzling light and a destructive, scorching aura.
In front of the spear, an invisible Boundary Wall emerged, under the penetration of the Dark Thunder Spear, radiating concentric diamond-shaped golden halos that were immovable.
Looking at Darren Callum, the Great Demon King standing with his halberd, towering a thousand meters high, Jack Clark slowly spoke, “Do you truly believe that I am afraid of you?” A low voice accompanied the appearance of a four-meter-long Black-gold halberd in Jack Clark’s hands.
Blue-purple thunder shone, golden flames burned, and the ’embroidery needle’-sized Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd inflated to six hundred meters in an instant, the heavy overbearing aura spreading out.
One Great Demon King, six Demon Kings – at this point, Jack Clark no longer needed to conceal his identity.
Boom! The Halberd Radiance wrapped in Law Chains bloomed greatly, immeasurably heavy, sweeping into a virtual shadow more than two thousand meters long, destroying heaven and earth.
Under the terrifying power, everything was annihilated, forming a fan-shaped darkness spreading out, and the terrifying power that invisibly emanated even caused Erbore’s complexion to drastically change.
“How is this possible, five Higher-order Laws!”
Under the overwhelming and terrifying power, the Thunder Spear shattered, the Laws of Heaven and Earth dispersed, all things lamented, and Erbore subconsciously contracted the Lightning Law World to block in front of him, all eight arms becoming one.
Boom!
Dazzling Radiance flared between heaven and earth, and under the flash of terrifying blue and gold light, a dark silhouette burst out at dozens of times the speed of sound, smashing into the Long Demon Steles over a hundred kilometers away.
Under the powerful impact force, the stele exploded, and immediately the suppressing force between heaven and earth loosened, and the Doomsday Hell suppressed around Jack Clark exploded, covering an area of over sixty kilometers.
In the center of the Blood Hell, Jack Clark stood holding his halberd, a blood-colored halo spinning behind his head, with blue lightning and golden flame ribbons swirling around him; behind him, the infinite Void spread, filled with Death.
In this moment, Jack Clark’s aura was immensely powerful, shaking Heaven and Earth, like a Demon God of World-Destroying descending from ancient times.
Facing Jack Clark, who revealed his true strength and blasted away the Great Demon King Erbore with one strike, the five Demon Kings of Taxes reacted instantly, with powerful auras erupting from them.
“Run!”
Boom boom boom!! The five Demon Kings burnt their origins, without looking back they transformed into five rays of light and burst in all directions, with expressions of terror, showing no intent to fight back.
This Alien Deity actually possessed five Higher-order Laws, no wonder his combat power was so terrifying that he could reverse-attack among the Great Demon Kings.
“Did I give you permission to leave.”
The low voice echoed through Heaven and Earth, and with one step, Jack Clark appeared behind a Demon King, with a Halberd wrapped in five Law Chains descending with a Heaven-Opening force.
“No!”
Boom!
Under a Black-gold Halberd Skill reaching over a thousand meters, the Demon King’s True Body exploded, the Earth shattered, forming a chasm that stretched over twenty kilometers; Heaven and Earth shook.
In the center of the explosion, a Golden Great Sun, a kilometer in diameter, burned, emitting scorching high temperatures, continuously crushing and eroding the shattered True Body of the Demon King.
The instant he blew up that Demon King, Jack Clark vanished, crossing the Void and appearing behind Taxes, thirty kilometers away.
Bang! Under the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd wrapped in Law Chains, Taxes’ late-period True Body exploded once again, turning into countless pieces of flesh and blood scattering across several kilometers.
In this violently turbulent Void, darkness spread, a grey stele condensed from the Death Law descended from the sky, suppressing Taxes’ shattered True Body, eroding it bit by bit.
And at that moment, Jack Clark’s figure flashed, transforming into a streak of lightning traveling through the Void and disappearing in an instant.
The usual movement speed of a Mythical-level Powerhouse is around ten times the speed of sound, and they can instantaneously travel several kilometers by distorting space, reaching nearly twenty times the speed of sound.
But for Jack Clark, whose normal moving speed was already over twenty times the speed of sound, these Demon Kings were too slow; he nearly simultaneously blasted two Demon Kings to smithereens.
But just then, an angry roar echoed through Heaven and Earth from afar, accompanied by an even more rampant and terrifying pressure from a Great Demon King, “Evan Lynch!”
A blue crescent-shaped Halberd Skill, a thousand meters long, flashed across the sky, tearing through Heaven and Earth as if it were a bolt of lightning crossing over a hundred kilometers, targeting the ascending Erbore.
Boom! A dazzling explosion echoed through Heaven and Earth, a blue mushroom cloud several kilometers in diameter rose, while a white ring-shaped shock wave created a hurricane sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
In the moment when a True Thunder Instant Slash blocked Erbore, combining the Lightning Law, Speed Divine Power, and Void Power, Jack Clark appeared instantly behind two bull-headed Demon Kings.
One of the Demon Kings roared, “Brother, go, I will stop him.”
Boom! In the midst of the roar, that Demon King instantly burned the remaining fifty percent of his origin, swelling nearly tenfold in power, then smashed through the space, directly bursting into the deep Void.
Seeing that he could not escape from Jack Clark’s terrifying speed, this Demon King sought to avoid death by delving deep into the Void.
Although doing so might leave him lost in the depths of the Void, possibly never being able to return to the Material World, it was better than perishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1171 - 1171 465 The Might of the Race Background
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1171: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race Darren Callum_4 Chapter 1171: Chapter 465: The Might of the Race Background Weapon, Human Race Darren Callum_4 And the behavior of this Bullhorn Demon King made even Jack Clark pause for a moment, the other demon king, who had been moved and was about to burn its origin to block the enemy, was also stunned.
Unfortunately, Jack Clark’s attack was even faster.
Bang bang!! The War Halberd, reaching nearly 200 times the speed of sound in an instant, swept across and the Bullhorn Demon King’s True Body, which had just charged deep into the Space Cracks, exploded, and half of it was annihilated.
The other demon king also shattered under the spreading veil of darkness.
In the instant when he crushed the two demon kings, Jack Clark suddenly turned his head to look in the opposite direction at Demon King Scott who had already flown over a hundred kilometers away, with a pair of black gold vertical pupils that could eclipse the sun emerging in his eyes.
Boom! Under the powerful force of the Void Annihilation, one of the talents of the Void Death Pupil, Scott’s True Body along with the surrounding kilometer of space shattered, forming a violent Destruction Black Hole.
In that area where even the depths of the void shattered, powerful void forces spread, sucking the shattered pieces of Scott’s True Body into the depths of myriad cracks.
Ah! With his True Body and Divine Soul torn asunder, shattered into thousands of pieces, Scott let out a harrowing scream, exiled forever.
And because his flesh and blood was incomplete and his Divine Soul was fragmented, it wouldn’t be long before he perished under the erosion of the void.
This was the Absolute Domination over the Legendary Realm by Jack Clark after his breakthrough to king level; demon kings of the same tier couldn’t even withstand a single strike from him.
And the so-called powerful life force of the Mythical level, under the suppression of the vast ocean-like Law Divine Power and five Higher-order Laws, couldn’t last even a moment before being ground away.
If not obstructed by high-end power, Jack Clark alone could slaughter all the Demon King level strong from The Purgatory Family, the speed of his massacre surpassing even that of a Peak Awakened Great Demon King.
At that moment, from afar, an Aura as terrifying as that of a Rule began to permeate.
The exploding thunder and lightning cleared, revealing the True Body of Erbore, over a thousand meters tall, and his ten arms lifting a Golden Sun, his three fierce heads looking at Jack Clark with gnashing teeth.
“Evan Lynch, today you will surely die.”
Mid-Mythical Stage of the Great Demon King, within the empire he belonged to as an overlord, but today he arrived with six demon kings to jointly suppress an Alien Myth in the Mid-Mythical Stage, yet suffered heavy casualties in a short time.
Even if he subsequently used the Race Background Weapon which he had collected when annihilating the Goldscale Tribe to kill Jack Clark, he would still become the laughingstock of countless demon kings in the empire.
Thinking of this, all three of Erbore’s heads roared with fury, their insides continually feeding energy into the Golden Sun, and in an instant the entire sealed ‘world’ shook wildly.
The Golden Sun emitted a blinding Radiance, expanding continuously, turning into a ‘sun’ with a diameter of tens of kilometers, its scales unfolding and becoming surrounded by numerous golden rays.
Within the Golden Sun, a Real World began to emerge hazily, with an ancient creature tens of kilometers long that resembled both a dragon and a python, slowly awakening.
Boom! Suddenly, the entire sealed world shook even more violently, emitting the fluctuations of Rule Level power, which even made Jack Clark’s expression turn solemn.
A Race Background Weapon is actually a kind of alternative Rule, an alternative path, and also related to the strength of a race.
For example, the True Martial Stone Tablet in the hands of the True Martial Heavenly King is the transformation of the entire Human Race’s ‘True Martial’ Rule; the stronger the Human Race and the more peak the proliferation of True Martial, the greater the power of the True Martial Stele.
If in the future the Human Race were to dominate the entire mythical world, the Heavenly King’s Way would reach an unimaginable level, becoming the strongest Rule Power in the mythical world.
And a Race Background Weapon cannot be refined just at will; it requires not only a special inheritance, but also only one such weapon can be condensed for each race.
Roar! The Golden Sun exploded, and a Golden Dragon Python, ten thousand meters long, burst forth, carrying a certain intrinsic force of a civilizational race, rushing towards Jack Clark.
This strike almost reached the peak power of a Great Demon King, the Terrifying Power’s Aura causing the whole Heaven and Earth to continually collapse and shatter, with demonic steles bursting into pieces.
“Did you think you were the only one with a trump card?” In a deep voice, an overwhelming power Burst from inside Jack Clark, instantly causing the sky to tremble and the earth to fissure.
“`
The power of Supreme Law once again descended, and as Jack Clark broke through to the Mid-Mythical Stage and mastered the Soul Law, the potency of this force was far more terrifying than the previous two times.
Under the ultimate power of destruction, everything disintegrated, and time and space ceased to exist.
At this moment, time and space seemed to come to a halt, appearing as an ever-expanding black hole heading towards the Golden Dragon Python, followed by a dazzling golden explosion.
Boom!
As the endless power of destruction was unleashed, the All-Heaven Demon Sealing Zone, spanning two hundred kilometers, shattered. Strands of golden light pierced through the Dark Demon Cloud, illuminating the entire heaven and earth.
Under the terrifying power, massive cracks spread continuously, stretching across hundreds of kilometers. The Demon King’s City, set amidst the mountain ranges, trembled as rocks crumbled and buildings collapsed.
As for the millions from the Alien Demonization Army and the Purgatory True Demons, they knelt down in fear, trembling at the extremely terrifying aura of power.
Such a frightening surge of energy was immediately seen by the Eye of the Demon God that was monitoring the battle, but the whole world was overwhelmed by the golden light, obscuring the scene below.
However, looking at this scene, two million kilometers away, a purple-haired witch sitting high on her throne revealed a lazy smile.
“Who would have thought that Erbore would actually use the Goldscale Tribe’s Intrinsic Weapon. It seems that this mythical figure from the different races is indeed as powerful as I expected, even stronger than what has been shown.”
A Demon King below flattered, “Your wisdom is unmatched, Tarolia. Thankfully Your Highness bestowed the Intrinsic Weapon of the Alien Race upon Duke Erbore, otherwise we would certainly have seen that mythical alien escape today.”
The other high-ranking officials of the empire also chimed in with their flattery and praise.
As Tarolia and other Demon’s eyes watched, the purple pupils floating high above the Demon Palace slowly dissipated the exploding golden light, revealing a thousand-kilometer range of dispersed Demon Cloud and the scene below.
On the earth, there appeared a huge pit over seventy kilometers across, and the land within hundreds of kilometers was fractured and fissured, with terrifying energy currents roaring between heaven and earth, and black cracks that had not yet healed.
The figure standing above the center of the explosion, towering over three hundred meters tall, clad in black-red armor with dragon horns on its head and a dragon tail behind, stood holding a halberd.
The heavy and terrifying force that emanated from that figure compressed the surrounding space into a dark area with a diameter of over a thousand meters, the aura extremely oppressive.
The invisible gravity emanating out caused the laws of heaven and earth within tens of kilometers to disintegrate, while some burning magma and rocks below floated and revolved around it.
Such a terrifying sight made Tarolia suddenly sit upright.
Standing tall above the huge pit, Jack Clark looked coldly into the distance and spoke slowly, “Not bad, you are the first demon king who has not been suppressed by a single strike from my Supreme Law Divine Power.”
A hundred kilometers away, the severely damaged and weak Erbore stood at the edge of the huge pit, his expression one of disbelief and horror as he looked at Jack Clark.
Before he could speak, that Supreme and terrifying aura erupted again.
“Next, I shall send you to oblivion.”
The black halberd that brought time and space to a standstill pierced through heaven and earth, destroying everything in an instant, obliterating the true body of Erbore, and then landing on the ground with undiminished momentum.
Boom!
In an instant, the earth collapsed over tens of kilometers, space exploded, and a massive crack tore through the earth forming an abyss over a hundred kilometers long.
Just as Erbore was blown apart, Tarolia in the Demon Palace suddenly came to her senses, her expression fierce, “It’s him, Darren Callum of the human race, he has appeared in our empire’s territory.”
As a Peak Awakened Great Demon King and a prince of the empire stationed in the South Demon Domain, Tarolia was naturally well aware of the situation on the frontline, including about Jack Clark.

chapters.title: Chapter 1172 - 1172 466 Demon God Attacks Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1172: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens Chapter 1172: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens “Your Majesty, we’ve found that human!”
Atop the mountain peak, the names of Jack Clark and Darren Callum, condensed from a thread of the Power of Destiny, vibrated. In an instant, the spiritual will of the High Priest, with one palm strike, shattered the name of Jack Clark.
Bang! The shattered names reformed into golden light, twining around the High Priest’s palm and delving into the Seven-color Stream beneath him, an illusory existence.
Boom! The consciousness of the High Priest roared, extending infinitely, spanning millions of distances to appear above the City of the Demon King Scott.
Looking down at the terrifying figure that shattered Heaven and Earth and slew Erbore with one strike, the High Priest’s consciousness was shaken. Just then, a Dragon Roar burst out from the depths of the mythical world.
Roar! Along with the resounding Dragon Roar, a primitive character named ‘Cang’, reflected in the river of Space-Time within the deep Rule Origin of the mythical world’s rules, flashed and shook the River of Destiny.
In an instant, an intangible shock Burst forth, scattering the High Priest’s consciousness back to his physical form. A look of horror appeared on his aged face: “Your Majesty, that human is in the empire, in the territory of Demon King Scott; he killed Duke Erbore in one move.”
“What, Darren Callum is within the boundaries of my empire,” exclaimed Diorus, rising abruptly. In that moment, the entire Heaven and Earth trembled under the immense Demon Power, filled with a terrible murderous intent.
Just then, an intangible force of Destiny arrived, transforming into a layer of golden flames that enveloped the High Priest.
The golden flames seemed formless and intangible, like an illusory projection without the slightest heat, yet only the High Priest could keenly perceive his life span rapidly slipping away.
For such a scene, the High Priest had long been accustomed, quietly awaiting the end of the backlash from Supreme Destiny.
However, the High Priest gradually sensed something amiss; he discovered that this backlash seemed a bit too severe, with the rate of his vitality consumption accelerating as if there were no end in sight.
Soon, the burning life span exceeded his estimate of two thousand years: two thousand three hundred, two thousand five hundred… three thousand…
In just a moment, nearly four thousand years of his life span had slipped away. The High Priest’s aura became more decrepit and weak, his form withering away at a rate visible to the naked eye.
The High Priest, alarmed, exclaimed, “No good, this backlash is too great; my remaining life span is insufficient to offset it, Your Majesty, save me.”
“I still have a Time Dragon Whisker here,” Diorus said, also startled, as he waved his hand and took out a transparent dragon whisker more than ten meters in length, wrapped in Time Power.
Although the power of time was precious, it was of little use to Devil God Emperor Eros, for in theory, one who held the Rule, his lifespan was infinite.
As for why he wouldn’t give the two Time Dragon Whiskers to the High Priest at once, it was of course a means of controlling his subordinates.
With a swoosh! As the High Priest grasped the Time Dragon Whisker and absorbed the Time Power wound around it, his aura recovered slightly, losing that imminent putrescent sensation as if on the verge of death.
But the burning golden illusory flames on his body remained vigorous, showing not the slightest sign of dying out, madly incinerating his Life Origin.
If he couldn’t withstand what was to come, he would still be burned to ashes. With this in mind, the High Priest looked towards Diorus with a gaze full of hope.
Diorus slowly shook his head, his voice low, “I have no more. When I encountered that time-controlling giant dragon back then, I only managed to cut off two of its whiskers.”
“Even though the dragon was only at the peak of Titan level at the time, under its control of the Supreme Law of time, even I couldn’t suppress it.”
No more, then.
Feeling that the five thousand years of life span he had just replenished had been consumed by four thousand years in just a moment, the High Priest had a moment of clarity and calmed down.
The High Priest’s voice was dry and hoarse, “Your Majesty, it seems my end has come, and those who spy on Destiny are ultimately Devoured by it.” As he spoke, the few remaining teeth in the High Priest’s mouth fell out.
Besides, the fine scales on his body turned yellow and withered, and the odor of decay only found on the dead began to pervade the air around him, resembling the Five Decays of Heaven-human from the Mythical Legend.
“Nevertheless, even if I am about to dissipate between Heaven and Earth, I will aid the empire in severing the Human Race’s luck. That person must die—he is far more terrible than we anticipated.”
Boom!
A powerful Aura Burst forth from the High Priest, and mysterious Golden Patterns emerged on his forehead. The entire Demon City seemed to take on a sacred atmosphere, with the Seven-color Stream beneath him swelling even more.
One could see the High Priest’s hands reaching out, delving into the Seven-color Stream with some difficulty, and from within, he pulled out a wisp of golden light.
At the same time, the High Priest’s back split open, and from within the gaping wounds, a pair of emaciated arms stretched out to ruthlessly tear off a palm-sized scale from his chest.
Splat! The High Priest spat a mouthful of blood onto the black scale. At the same time, he drove the wisp of golden light into the scale, causing the entire demon aura to weaken, becoming utterly feeble.
“Your Majesty, just crush the Scale of Destiny, and you can re-locate that… per…”
Before the words were complete, the High Priest, like a dried corpse, was Devoured by the raging golden flames, turning into scattered ashes and being erased by an unknown force.
Looking at the floating black scale, Diorus wore an incredibly solemn expression. He hadn’t expected this event to lead to the fall of the empire’s High Priest.
The loss of a High Priest who cultivated the power of Destiny was significant for the Demon God Empire; at many crucial moments, he could play a vital role.
The fall of the High Priest further solidified Diorus’s resolution to kill Jack Clark.
The mere act of attempting to locate him had led to the death of a High Priest who cultivated the power of Destiny and whose cultivation reached the peak of the Demon King. The human’s fate’s terror even surpassed that of a Demon God level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1173 - 1173 466 Demon God Attacks Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1173: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_2 Chapter 1173: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_2 “This human must die,” Diorus’s eyes flashed with a killing intent, but he didn’t rush back to the empire immediately, instead looking towards the Frontline Battlefield tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Jack Clark, a ‘Child of Destiny’ like this, was difficult to suppress, especially since he had become significant and during a Limit Breakthrough, he even possessed combat power comparable to that of the peak of the Great Demon Kings.
Therefore, thorough preparation was necessary.
Because the High Priest died due to backlash, Diorus felt that to kill this human of the Legendary Realm, even a Demon God might not be safe.
At that moment, the frontline battlefield erupted into madness once again. The Blood Colored Moonlight illuminated the entire world as if it was the Blood Sea Hell.
A few days ago, a single Sky-base Annihilation Cannon obliterated one of the four frontlines of The Purgatory Family and wiped out thirty to forty percent of the rear remote and support vassal race legions.
But even so, it only momentarily alleviated the atmosphere on the battlefield; the human race army on the ground held the advantage, having pushed forward over a thousand kilometers, making the Purgatory Legion retreat steadily.
Yet, the battle above the Firmament was still intensely fierce, with The Purgatory Family retaining an advantage in the number of Demon King and Grand Demon King level strong men.
Nearly forty-four Demon Kings besieged thirty-seven king-level soldiers, eight Grand Demon Kings surrounded six Heavenly Kings, and three Demon Gods and two Supreme forces along with the True Martial Heavenly King did battle in the tens of thousands of kilometers above the heavens.
Terrible shockwaves of the battle covered over ten thousand kilometers of the frontline, tearing the heavens and shattering the Earth, the light of the rules almost brightening the Heaven and Earth, with the roaring echoes of the collapsing Void exploding incessantly.
Such an intense war was beyond everyone’s expectations, including the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan in the Sky-based battleships at the rear, who were also with solemn expressions.
The strength displayed by The Purgatory Family was too terrifying, for just two fledgling Demon God Empires established for several thousand years to have such intrinsic strength.
According to the custom of The Purgatory Family, they usually mobilized only half their strength in a great war with other civilizations, as the remaining half was needed to suppress and guard their own territories.
That is to say, the true power of these two Demon God Empires, on their own, was just slightly inferior to the human race, but if they combined all their forces, they could absolutely achieve overwhelming dominance.
Of course, this was an ideal state, as the vastness of their territories meant they had many places to suppress and prevent, making it difficult for the Demon God Empires to achieve this.
Even when a War of Extermination was initiated, they could only deploy two-thirds of their force.
On the other hand, the human race, which defended a territory two to three ten thousand kilometers wide, along with the rear Blue Star World, could muster all their forces to fight, including the supply drop speed.
Roar! Just at this moment, a fierce roar exploded from the Earth below, the terrifying aura penetrated the Cloud Sky making even the Demon Kings and the Great Demon Kings feel somewhat palpitated.
On the frontline battlefield, a monstrous creature over six hundred meters tall, covered in sharp spikes, and with a hideous and terrifying four-armed form stood towering, emitting an extremely ferocious aura.
At this moment, not a trace of ‘armor’ marking could be seen on Number One; with full strength unleashed, its combat power was terrifyingly vast, with every gesture capable of annihilating space and shattering the Void.
Its speed was so fast that the consciousness of the Demon Kings couldn’t keep up, a mere flicker led to an explosion of the Void, and a Demon King’s True Body was obliterated.
In particular, the light beams of cyan and white shooting out of its eyes melted peak after peak, and even the Grand Demon Kings were bombarded into retreat, an utterly terrifying sight to behold.
To restrain Number One, the opposition pulled out an early-period and a mid-period Grand Demon King along with four late-period Demon Kings, and at this moment, all six Demon Kings had entered a state of burning Origin in a Burst.
They had no choice, without bursting forth they couldn’t resist this terrifying creature that had devoured over two million army soldiers and killed two Demon Kings.
It was indeed due to Number One releasing its full power and restraining so many Demon Kings and Grand Demon Kings that the human race was barely able to hold off, with only one king-level soldier falling in these past few days.
At present, both sides were tense, but continuing to fight on would be difficult for those king-level soldiers of the human race.
Because the Demon God Empire had more reserve Demon King level strong men; after their origins were depleted, they could be replaced and sent to the rear to recover, but the Human Kings couldn’t afford that, and hence balance had to be broken.
Suddenly, at the rear base of Channel 3, shrill red lights flared up again.
“First Sequence Order, Sky-base Death Star activation, target: to eradicate Great Demon King Ceudo, adjusting space coordinates…”
In the depths of Outer Space beyond Blue Star, a sphere with a diameter of over thirty kilometers, unlike the Sky-based doomsday satellite, looking like a small black moon, floated in the void.
All of a sudden, the black celestial body trembled slightly, then, like transforming Vajra, it slowly split open, with arms unfolding.
Simultaneously, a peak king-level warrior who had been in hibernation for several years gradually awoke, his voice ancient: “Activating the Sky-base Death Star, has the War of Extermination begun?”
Relying on the world of technology, how could the human side not have contingency measures? They had created many of the celestial weapons speculated in the past, combining inscriptions and Transcendent Materials from the mythical world.
However, these weapons couldn’t be deployed casually. For one, activation consumed too much energy, and also, once used, the enemy would be prepared the next time, making it hard to achieve the desired effect again.
Just as the Sky-base Death Star was slowly activating, it suddenly paused, then slowly retracted, returning to silence and floating in Outer Space, all alone.
These were some of the reasons the Human Kings, and even some Heavenly Kings, were not on the frontline, as each had their own suppressive duties to attend to.
On the Frontline Battlefield, just as the Sky-based God King was preparing to activate an intrinsic equipment to break the balance and relieve pressure on the high-end combat forces, suddenly the power of the three Demon Gods Burst forth.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Six terrifying forces of the Rules descended from the skies, isolating Heaven and Earth, and immediately, the battling Heavenly Kings, Great Demon Kings, and Demon Kings below all retreated, ceasing combat.

chapters.title: Chapter 1174 - 1174 466 Demon God Attacks Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1174: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_3 Chapter 1174: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_3 Meanwhile, the Blood Moon in the sky gradually faded away as a golden-white radiance emerged on the horizon.
Dawn had arrived.
…
Just as the High Priest of Fate was using the Destiny to peer into the future, Jack Clark, who had just killed Erbore with a single blow, sensed something and looked up at the sky.
But aside from the blood-red night sky where the Demon Clouds had dissipated, he saw nothing.
However, the Void-Striking Heart Eye on Jack’s forehead started throbbing intensely, giving him a feeling that a great danger was approaching, which caused his expression to turn slightly solemn.
“Indeed, an ancient and powerful civilization has such quick reactions,” Jack marveled.
When the Mysterious Martial Sky King and companions had returned, they had thoroughly analyzed the details of being discovered and pursued; no matter how they concealed their aura and tracks, they couldn’t shake off the enemy.
Even fleeing tens of kilometers out of the Purgatory Empire’s territory made no difference, as it seemed the opponent possessed some locational ability involving causality or other rule-based powers.
In the end, it was only by sacrificing another avatar into the forbidden area in place of himself that the Mysterious Martial Sky King was able to draw away the pursuit of the Demon God Emperor Eros.
Therefore, Jack had long been prepared for this situation, but he hadn’t expected it so soon—he had only killed one Great Demon King and seven demon kings and hadn’t even swept through the entire Purgatory Empire yet.
The frontline was millions of kilometers away from here, plus a vertical distance of a million kilometers provided him with a little bit of time. With that in mind, Jack disappeared into silence without a trace.
At once, the blood light that pervaded heaven and earth dissipated, leaving only the shattered ruins of Earth and the aura of law from the fallen demon kings lingering between heaven and earth.
In the central Demon Palace of the Southern Demon Domain, the Eye of the Demon God also lost sight of Jack’s figure.
Looking at the battered Earth, as well as the terrifying combat power that had almost reached the peak of Great Demon King, Tarolia’s expression became grave as she spoke slowly.
“Notify all the Demon King’s Cities immediately, ready the blood sacrifice summoning ritual, and as soon as that human appears, we will descend upon him at the first moment.”
“At the same time, inform all the Demon King’s Cities surrounding Scott to deploy all Top-tier True Demons, including the high-order leaders of the vassal races, to search thoroughly for the human’s traces.”
“Also, prepare the Demon Prison Projection, contact Taxes in the Northern Demon Realm’s Imperial City, and remind them to be vigilant of the human possibly sneaking over.”
Because two Demon Gods joined forces to establish the empire, the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire possessed two demon realms and two imperial cities, divided into southern and northern systems.
This Taxes, who shared the same name but not the surname with the late-period demon king whom Jack had suppressed, was tremendously powerful, just like Tarolia, both belonging to the peak-awakened Great Demon Kings.
Against this human monstrosity whose burst of combat power was comparable to the peak of Great Demon Kings, Tarolia was confident she could suppress him.
After all, the human could only match her normal state at his limit, and after exchanging a few moves, he would exhaust his strength and grow weak. Not to mention, she was in possession of this empire’s ultimate treasure.
In the absence of the Demon God, she was the supreme ruler of the empire, commanding a territory that spanned millions of kilometers and billions of extraordinary creatures.
Meanwhile, countless Top-tier True Demons and strong warriors from different races from the Southern Mokaya Dark Demon Empire were pouring out, setting up a Heaven and Earth Trap to comb the skies and the ground.
In the cracks between space and the deep Void, Jack was flying toward the Demon Domain’s Imperial City at an astonishing speed, intent on pulling off a big heist.
As for the upcoming pursuit by the Demon Gods, he wasn’t concerned at all.
If the Destruction Emperor Dragon was with him, what was there to fear from Demon Gods? If he could fight them, he would; if not, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon held them off, he would directly draw upon the Power of Hell and enter the Supreme Hell Plane.
Then, using the coordinates of Supreme Hell, he would return to the Plane World and make his way back to Blue Star.
“I didn’t expect the Human Race to be so formidable. Just one appearance has shaken the entire empire.”
“Worthy of a civilization that has waged war against two empires simultaneously, so strong. I hope we don’t encounter that terrifying human; otherwise, we’re doomed for sure.”
At ten thousand meters altitude, two Top-tier Purgatory True Demons exuding the aura of Eight Path Demon Marks flew by at great speed, surveying the land with their eyes while chatting and patrolling.
And tens of kilometers above them, melding into the Void, Jack flashed past, also hearing their conversation, but because there was no vibration of Spiritual Will, he didn’t understand what they were saying.
At this moment, by consuming Law Divine Power and blending into the Void with Speed Divine Power, Jack flashed past tens of kilometers in an instant, moving at a terrifyingly fast speed.
While on his way, he casually took out four pieces of Space Equipment he had looted, ready to assess his gains.
Roar! As Jack’s Will entered a scale taken from the Bullhorn Demon King, a roar exploded in the darkness, and a vision of a hundred-meter-tall demon king emerged.
Thud!
A black light that resembled both a knife and a rune flashed in the Void, and this will was annihilated by the Void-Striking Heart’s Eye, instantly revealing a space with a diameter of one kilometer.
The ordinary God-level Resources, consisting of dozens of minerals and materials, resembled a pile of hills of black ore, a spine several hundred meters long that possibly belonged to a Mythical Giant Beast, and a golden box pulsing with the vibrations of Top-level Divine Resources.
This fortune was considerable for a mid-period demon king.
At the Mythical-level, one couldn’t expect to become wealthy just by killing an opponent, since God-level resources that aid in cultivation and improvement were used as soon as they were acquired.
Only those resources with incompatible attributes or those that had developed a ‘resistance,’ and were temporarily unnecessary materials and minerals, would be left behind.
Jack transferred some recognized resources from this space into his Space Bracelet, then tore open a black crack about one meter long and tossed it into the Plane Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 1175 - 1175 466 Demon God Attacks Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1175: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_4 Chapter 1175: Chapter 466 Demon God Attacks, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_4 “`
In the realm of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, the moment the scale appeared, it burst open with a boom, and countless god-level materials, minerals, and those black stones descended from the sky.
Bang Bang Bang!!
God-level materials were crushed by the wild elemental forces between heaven and earth, and only a small portion of minerals managed to land on the ground, causing the entire Plane World to shake once again.
Suddenly, another black scale appeared, followed by a black ring, a bracelet, and countless God-level resources rained down from the sky…
The Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane shook even more violently, its edges expanding continuously, its spatial capacity enhanced, and even the golden ‘sun’ above got brighter.
Even the Law of Strength, nurtured in the origin space of the plane, was affected, slowly approaching a minor completion.
As the master of the plane, Jack Clark was suddenly flooded with countless insights into the Law of Strength, and his body faintly radiated a heavy and terrifying aura.
However, with the power of the Hidden Deity withdrawn and merged into the Void, no demonic energy could detect him.
“Your Highness.”
In a space burning with Black Flames, Tarolia bowed respectfully, as a ten-meter-diameter black crystal flickered in the air, showing the shadowy figure of Diorus.
Diorus’s voice was low, “I am aware of what’s happened in the empire. Are you planning to intervene personally next, to suppress the human Darren Callum?”
Tarolia, who had just finished communicating with Taxes in the Northern Territory, was somewhat surprised, having not expected Diorus to be informed of the matter so quickly.
“Yes, Your Highness. That human has a lot of nerve, daring to venture alone into the empire with just a Mid-Mythical Stage realm, and even assassinating several demon kings.”
“Whether it’s my duty as a prince, or for the honor of The Purgatory Family, I must take action and suppress him, and I am confident in my ability to do so,” Tarolia said with confidence.
Inside the black crystal, Diorus slowly nodded, “I have faith in your strength, of course, but this human is quite unique and won’t be so easily slain.”
“Tarolia, once you locate that human, your task is to bring the Seven Dark Demon Kings and lay down the Heaven-sealing Demon Array to trap him and wait for my and Carthius’s return.”
“What, Your Majesty, you and Prince Carthius personally taking action!?” Even Tarolia was taken aback this time.
Was it not overkill for two Demon God-level powerhouses to return from the frontline to suppress just one Mid-Mythical Stage human?
The Purgatory Family always followed the principle of ‘even when hunting a rabbit, a lion uses its full strength.’ They might look down on the civilizations of different races strategically, but they took every tactical aspect very seriously.
Even if it was a low-level civilization with just a few Mythical powerhouses.
Still, no matter how seriously they took it, did it really require the arrival of two Demon God-level powerhouses?
Diorus, of course, noticed the change in Tarolia’s expression and spoke in a deep voice, “You just need to follow my orders.”
“Yes, Your Majesty,” Tarolia bowed respectfully.
Once the shadowy figure of Diorus disappeared, Tarolia walked out of the Demon Palace, where black flames burned with a solemn expression, speaking in a low voice, “Where are the Seven Dark Demon Kings?”
Instantly, seven powerful dark auras materialized in the Void, turning into seven black shadows that slowly rose from the ground, twisting and floating before Tarolia.
“May I ask what important matter has led the Prince of the Black Abyss to summon us?”
Tarolia gravely said, “His Majesty has decreed that you carry the Heaven-sealing Demon Flag and join me in trapping a human enemy.”
“We shall obey His Majesty’s orders,” the seven dark shadows bowed slightly, then silently merged with the Dark Void. Tarolia flashed slightly and disappeared into the twisted space, reappearing in the main hall.
Sitting high upon the throne, Tarolia looked upward at the Eye of the Demon God, hundreds of meters in the sky, quietly awaiting news.
“`
At this moment, the entire Mokaya Dark Demon Empire was in some disarray. Pillars of black light shot up into the sky as figures wreathed in dark demonic air soared by.
As these high-order True Demons patrolled the forests and rivers, there would occasionally be the brutal roars of giant beasts, unleashing powerful surges of battle.
Meanwhile, at the edge of the empire facing the Human Race Frontline Battlefield.
In a city with an alien-style architecture, within a room, a four-meter-tall Purgatory True Demon clad in Dark Red Armor was perusing some resources.
Suddenly, a loud shout came from outside, “Brooks, there’s an assignment from the higher-ups; come out quickly.”
“Coming.”
Brooks set down the ‘books’ he was reading and strode out to where a Purgatory True Demon with two pairs of split horns was waiting for him.
Brooks looked at the Split True Demon with curiosity, “Gulden, weren’t we here for advanced studies? Why is there suddenly a task?”
The True Demon with split horns spoke in a grave tone, “It’s said there was trouble in the southwest of the empire, a strong Human Expert has invaded.”
Brooks was ‘shocked’, “A Human Expert’s invasion? Could it be a few Heavenly King Level powerhouses sneaking in?”
The Split True Demon shook its head and spoke softly, “It’s not a Heavenly King; they say the one who sneaked in is merely a Mythical-level human called Darren Callum, but his strength is terrifying. Already, seven demon kings and one Great Demon King have fallen.”
Hiss!
This time Brooks was truly astonished and somewhat incredulous, “How is that possible, that Darren Callum…”
He paused and said in shock, “He’s only at the Mythical stage, and he’s consecutively slain seven demon kings and a Great Demon King? Is that for real?”
Brooks obviously knew who Darren Callum was. After all, he had presided over Mathilda Ward’s Reincarnation Ceremony and had entered the relic of the Void Continent together, hence his greater astonishment.
“Yes, it’s that terrifying. Now the Prince of the Black Abyss has ordered all demon kings, high-order True Demons, and high-order strong men of the Vassal Races to set out and find the intruder.”
“That includes us here as well. The Prince suspects that the invader may attempt to escape back to the Human Race territory unnoticed, so he’s ordered a mobilization of every demon.”
“Not just us, even the common soldiers are to be fully deployed, forming a Demon Web to cover the borders, allowing not a single demon to escape.”
As the two high-order True Demons spoke in hushed tones, Brooks could see the entire city stirring, teeming with eager and excited Purgatory True Demons and different races rushing toward the city outskirts.
That was because the rewards promised by the higher-ups this time were extravagant.
Merely by discovering traces of that human, all demons and aliens below the high order would be rewarded with a portion of Blood of Demon God, rise to become Purgatory Nobles, guarantee entry to the Nine Layers Demon Marks Realm, and attain a hint of demon king demeanor.
And if a high-ranking powerhouse should make the discovery, they could obtain a pure Law’s Origin, ascend directly to the quasi-mythical stage, and be a mere step away from becoming a demon king.
Therefore, apart from a few clever demons, every demon was whipped into a frenzy.
“Brooks, let’s head out quickly as well. This opportunity is rare; if we can find that Human Race’s trail…”
“Forget it, that’s just seeking death.”
Brudos spoke coldly, “Gulden, such beings represent the Grim Reaper to us, and we would already be dead the moment we lay eyes on him.”
“Nevertheless, we can’t ignore the mission. Let’s head out of the city later and casually mix into some forest.”
And while the Tarolian demons set up a Heaven and Earth Trap, including some demon kings with special abilities and weapons of prognostic Laws, searching for Jack Clark’s whereabouts.
Jack had already erased his presence, appearing outside the Demon Domain.
[One more thing, wrap it up in ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1176 - 1176 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1176: Chapter 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Desperate Future of the Human Race Chapter 1176: Chapter 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Desperate Future of the Human Race The golden sunlight pierced through Heaven and Earth, spreading a warm aura that enveloped the entire mythical world. However, it could not penetrate the demon domain shrouded in rolling dark demon air.
“That layer of rule, it’s hard to break,”
Looking at the towering black fog wall, Jack Clark’s expression was solemn, dispelling the idea of melding into the Void and sneaking in.
That layer of black fog was a manifestation of law power, forming a fault that isolated a portion of heaven and earth, setting the demon domain apart from the mythical world.
Therefore, only by destruction through brute force, thinking of this, the space-time mark emerged on the back of Jack Clark’s left hand, emitting a gloomy blue mysterious radiance.
Meanwhile, in the distant Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Rift World suddenly began to shake, and a red divine tree, standing over six thousand meters tall, swayed, releasing rings of red halos.
Beneath the mountain range where the divine tree was located, a Black-red Colossal Beast, over nineteen hundred meters in length, slowly rose to its feet, its back lined with ‘mountain peaks’, exuding a sense of oppression.
An invisible aura emanated from its body, filling heaven and earth. With its rise alone, the entire world shook, grand and majestic, causing the red light emitted by the divine tree to become even more dazzling.
In the few days of this slumber, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, in order not to trigger the collapse of this small world, chose to sleep at the edge of the red divine tree.
As the ‘core’ of this world, the space around the divine tree was more solid, with a stronger bearing capacity.
However, the Rift Small world was very ‘quiet’ at this time, except for the still hibernating Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon. The other ‘minions’ were not at home, having gone out.
As for the Naga vassals, they were a hundred kilometers away in the depths of the lake, raising snacks for the Purple little dragon.
Huff!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled a scorching breath through its nostrils, and turned its head slightly to reach out with its right claw, grabbing onto one of the hundred-meter-long, twenty-meter-thick black-blue Dorsal Fins on its back.
The muscles of the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly swelled, and in an instant, a terrifying amount of strength converged in its right claw.
Boom!
Under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s power explosion, the dorsal fin broke apart, releasing a terrifying amount of energy that even woke up the purple little dragon.
Yiyiyiyi!? The Purple little dragon, confused, opened its eyes and looked blankly at the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which was self-mutilating by snapping its own fin.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly curved its mouth into a smile and let out a humming roar, “It’s nothing, Misss Joseline. I am just preparing to create an Electromagnetic Railgun. Continue your sleep.”
An Electromagnetic Railgun?
The Purple little dragon blinked its eyes. Far from continuing to sleep, its spirit perked up, and it sat up, curious to see what the Destruction Emperor Dragon would do next.
Seeing this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t be bothered with it, and with heavy steps, it shattered the Void. Its form flickered, turning into a black-red streak of light that spanned hundreds of kilometers, bursting through the Rift World.
Massive mountain ranges extended across the ocean, surrounded by white mist. A raging wind howled through heaven and earth, lifting tsunamis hundreds of meters high.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon stood upon the void, its head crowned by gracefully floating black manes burning with golden flames, surrounded by a ring of blue-purple thunder, exuding a majestic and mystical presence.
Huff!
The Crystal Red feather horns on the sides of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head blazed with golden flames, the silver spatial runes entwined began to shimmer, resonating with Jack Clark’s space-time summoning.
Boom!
Heaven and earth changed color, dark clouds gathered, covering thousands of kilometers. In the blackened clouds, thunderbolts tens or even hundreds of kilometers long writhed and roared.
In the thunderous roar, scorching golden flames infused the purple power crazily into the black-blue sharp spikes in the claw. Instantly, the black spikes emitted blinding light.
When a tenth of the Heaven Burning Golden Flame and Corrosion Law merged into the black-blue spike, the spike almost completely turned into a light of gold and purple, vibrating and humming.
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s current strength, a tenth of the two Higher-order Laws were almost enough to Destroy Heaven and Earth, even its fin spike had reached its limit.
But it wasn’t enough.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claw was filled with golden power, like a layer of gold paint covering the spike, emitting an indestructible aura.
In addition to that, destructive lightning, red lightning entwined the spike while Chaotic Dark Law Patterns diffused around it, surrounded by Law Chain of Speed.
Instantly, the ‘light’ emitted by the spike sent terrifying energy fluctuations, causing the entire region to vibrate. Thunder rumbled in the sky, and hurricanes lifted tsunamis thousands of meters high.
Boom!!
Above the firmament, thunderclouds erupted violently, and tens of thousands of blue-black bolts of lightning fell from the sky, blazing with fiery radiance, converging ahead to form ten kilometer-wide Thunder Rings, like ten grand innate Rune Arrays.
This scene looked familiar to the Purple little dragon. It seemed like back at the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s Divine Temple, the Destruction Emperor Dragon did something similar.
Just as the Sky-based Electromagnetic Railgun tightened in the grip of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was ready, countless Rune Sequence Chains congregated around Jack Clark, transforming into a kilometer-wide gloomy blue altar beneath his feet.
Above his head, a gloomy blue vortex over two hundred meters in diameter spun wildly, causing a stir in space, reversing time, and emitting stunning energy fluctuations.
The intense aura immediately caught the attention of the demon domain’s patrolling guards.
Roar!
From the black mists, a Hell Demon Dragon, over two hundred and eighty meters long and ablaze with Black Flames, roared, and the Nine Demonic Marks true demon on its back was startled.
Looking at the gloomy blue light spot hundreds of kilometers away, the high-order True Demon flying at ten thousand meters altitude shouted, “Report, it’s that human! It’s the human Darren Callum; he’s here.”
Boom, boom, boom!! Instantly, the dark mists vibrated, and powerful auras of high-order beings erupted from a distance, including one Mythical-level terrifying demon power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1177 - 1177 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1177: Chapter 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Despair of the Human Race’s Future_2 Chapter 1177: Chapter 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Despair of the Human Race’s Future_2 In the heart of the Demon Domain, the Eye of the Demon God also immediately followed the coordinates to locate Jack Clark and saw the mysterious altar and the spinning vortex beneath his feet.
On the sea surface, where the storm roared, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, gazing at the gloomy blue summon channel that appeared in the distance, raised its right claw high, gripping the sharp spike that had completely turned into a beam of light, and suddenly swung it down.
Boom!
The space collapsed, the colorfully glowing spike instantly disappeared, traveling at a terrifying speed through a series of Thunder Rings, losing its shape entirely in the enveloping endless thunder as it entered the vortex.
Because the concentrated energy was so terrifying, the moment the spike entered the vortex, the summon channel collapsed with a bang, directly shattered and destroyed.
Including the vortex above Jack Clark’s head, which also collapsed at the same time, his aura weakened all at once, with only a burst of seven-colored glow piercing Heaven and Earth at a terrifying speed that was too fast for even consciousness to detect, crossing hundreds of kilometers in an instant.
Boom! The dazzling seven-colored glow burst forth, forming an expanding ring of light that blew a hole over a hundred kilometers in diameter into the thick black wall of mist.
A terrifying wave of energy swept across Heaven and Earth, destroying everything in its path, whether it was the Level 9 Demon Dragons, the True Demons, or the seven-hundred-meter-long black Demon Dragon.
In an instant, they were destroyed by the released power of destruction, obliterated, and the ground hundreds of kilometers below collapsed thunderously, with countless dirt and rocks shooting up into the sky.
Even the glorious and majestic buildings within the wall were instantly pulverized by the space-destroying black shock wave, forming a constantly expanding wave ripple, as if Doomsday had arrived.
The several hundred thousand Purgatory True Demon Nobles, servants, and the demon king’s subordinates living in that area didn’t even realize what had happened before they were all extinguished and killed.
Only then did the earth-shattering explosion resound, shaking Time and Space, stirring up rolling white soundwave currents and raging wind sweeping across Heaven and Earth, with numerous Purgatory True Demons looking towards this side.
This strike had reached Rule Level, destroying a corner of the black mist that was laid down by the same Rule power and blasting a huge hollow into it.
“Human Race Darren Callum!” A fierce roar resounded through Heaven and Earth as the black mist vibrated, and a terrifying aura descended instantly, accompanied by a three-thousand-meter-long slash of Black Flames.
Boom!
With a terrifying slash, the mountain range where Jack Clark was located collapsed, Earth split open, forming a chasm over a hundred kilometers long, with scorching magma burning in the depths of the crack.
Atop the Firmament, covered in battle armor, a hundred meters tall, a woman with purple hair and a voluptuous figure stood unwavering, wielding a combat knife over three hundred meters long.
Behind her, endless Black Flames burned, echoing with the dark fog that touched Heaven and Earth, igniting the Firmament and emitting a Terrifying Aura far surpassing that of a Great Demon King.
But by this time, Jack Clark had already vanished, merged into the Void, operating the power of Hidden Deity to erase his presence and sense of existence.
Looking at the mountain range below that had been slashed down, Tarolia’s gaze was sharp and icy cold, her vast Divine Soul power sweeping across hundreds of kilometers, yet failing to find any trace of Jack Clark.
Not a hint of his aura was left behind, nor any sign of space distortion; it was as if he didn’t exist at all, even her bloodline Secret Skill capturing no trace.
Suddenly, Tarolia’s brows furrowed slightly, “Such a strong stealth technique.”
Seeing Jack Clark had gone into hiding again, Tarolia glanced at the hundreds of kilometers of destroyed area behind her, her eyes narrowing slightly.
Above the Chaos Turbulent Sea, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned and seized another, even sturdier Dorsal Fin on its back. After the earlier test, it felt it could compress even more power.
Boom!
Under the Power Explosion from the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s bulging right claw, a gigantic blue-black sharp spike, one hundred and eighty meters long and forty meters thick at the widest point, resembling a small hill, was once again snapped off.
This scene made the Purple little dragon blink and, unable to help itself, turned back to look at its own back, only to find there didn’t seem to be anything it could snap off.
Boom!
Endless blue-black Thunder spread from the Destruction Emperor Dragon as the center, covering a hundred kilometers range, forming a vertical Thunder Ring releasing scorching Destructive Aura.
The one-kilometer-thick Thunder Ring continuously compressed and shrank, forming a powerful electromagnetic field converging toward the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and toward the colorful glowing spike in its claws.
Meanwhile, on the other side of the Demon Domain spanning a thousand kilometers, Jack Clark appeared silently two hundred kilometers away on a mountainside, with the Time-Space Summoning Altar emerging once more beneath his feet.
Standing on the gloomy blue altar, Jack Clark, with his long black hair dancing in the wind, regarded the distant black fog wall and the buildings and figures behind it with an indifferent gaze.
Just like the countries in human society, it wasn’t ordinary people who lived in the capital, not to mention these Purgatory Demons residing within the Demon Domain.
It can be said that every Purgatory Demon here is a genius, or a relative of a high-order True Demon or an offspring of the demon king.
Compared to killing another demon king, a mass slaughter of these Purgatory Nobles would actually be more fruitful, possibly including some Monster Geniuses comparable to the likes of Joshua Welan and Jane Aiken.
Hum! As the gloomy blue vortex reappeared above Jack Clark’s head, a powerful surge of energy spread out in an instant, distorting the surroundings of Time and Space.
“That human is there.” Instantly, a demon king’s aura erupted in the distance, a roar of shock and rage shaking Heaven and Earth.
But it was already too late, as the blue channel above Jack Clark’s head collapsed, and a more dazzling seven-colored radiance stretched across more than two hundred kilometers, like a splendid rainbow falling upon the dark fog wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 1178 - 1178 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1178: Chapter 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Despair of the Human Race’s Future_3 Chapter 1178: Chapter 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Despair of the Human Race’s Future_3 Boom!
The scene from moments before replayed, as dazzling seven-colored radiance pierced through heaven and earth, expanding continuously. At the edge of the growing light was a ring of black shock waves, destroying everything in its path.
Under that terrifying power, countless Purgatory True Demons let out desperate wails before turning to ash, along with the very space they occupied.
Roar!
An earth-shattering roar exploded from the depths of the Demon Domain. A Titan Peak Giant Beast’s aura erupted, and a terrifying figure three thousand meters in length soared into the sky.
“I’ve found you, human!”
“Heaven-Sealing Ultimate Seal, freeze time and space, activate the formation!”
Boom!
Above Jack Clark’s head, at an altitude of ten thousand meters, the Dark Demon Cloud spun, forming seven massive vortexes. From the center of each vortex, seven gigantic demon banners, each one ten thousand meters long, descended from the sky.
In just an instant, the seven demon banners pierced through the void and landed on the ground, shattering the earth. The black patterns wrapped around the poles shone brightly as the banners billowed out, connecting to form a black curtain that enveloped this world.
In the blink of an eye, Jack Clark found himself in an independent world with a diameter of over a thousand kilometers, where both sky and earth were black, and the periphery bore the towering silhouettes of seven colossal figures.
With the heaven and earth sealed and time frozen, the Space-Time Altar beneath Jack Clark instantly collapsed, and even the connection to the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane World became untraceable.
This turn of events made Jack Clark’s expression grow solemn.
Compared to the All-Heaven Demon-Suppressing Array set up by the previous six demon kings, the level of this Demon Array was even higher, sealing even time and space and leaving no way to shift into the Plane World.
Clearly, the Purgatory Demon Race was well-informed about his various trump cards and had already planned accordingly.
Indeed, a trump card is only a trump card if no one else knows about it.
“Human Race, Darren Callum, this is the grave I’ve picked for you. Are you satisfied?”
The icy voice was followed by a crack opening in the sky’s black curtain. Tarolia, clad in a resplendent red battle armor and a hundred meters tall, stepped in slowly, wielding a combat knife.
In an instant, endless Black Flames spread out, enveloping an area of a hundred kilometers and turning it into a Dark Hell where the very space was burned through.
At the same time, outside the black curtain, a three-thousand-meter-long Demon Dragon covered in black scales stood tall, its back bristling with black spikes, exuding the terrifying aura of a Titan Peak.
However, this Titan Peak Dark Demon Dragon didn’t enter; instead, it stood guard outside, preventing Jack Clark from escaping.
At this moment, Tarolia had prepared thoroughly in every aspect, ensuring that no matter what trump cards Jack possessed, even the Rule Forbidden Weapon bestowed by the Supreme Experts couldn’t provide him with an escape.
Because the items sealing this world were seven Rule Forbidden Weapons, today, Jack Clark was bound to die.
However…
Feeling the Heart’s Eye overlapping with the brow and instinctually ready to draw upon the Power of Supreme Hell from the Eye of Prison, the corners of Jack Clark’s mouth lifted ever so slightly.
It was no surprise that an entity that spanned countless worlds and time itself, the Supreme Plane, left none alive who had witnessed his summoning the Power of Hell. Nobody knew of this move he possessed.
Gazing at the human figure hundreds of kilometers away, who was no larger than one finger to him, Tarolia relaxed his demeanor and spoke lazily, “Human, you’re quite bold, daring to venture alone deep into the territory of our clan’s empire.”
“That would be all well and good, but to have slain seven of our demon kings and a Great Demon King, your feats are so impressive that even as an enemy, I can’t help but admire you.”
“With such terror-inducing strength across realms, even I couldn’t achieve that back in my day. What a pity you’re a human. Otherwise, I’d be quite interested in having your child.”
The sudden shift in topic caught Jack Clark off guard, who replied coolly, “…Sorry, I have no interest in Purgatory True Demons.”
Putting aside the issue of race and stance, just the sight of the one-hundred-meter-tall figure with limbs as immense as ten-meter tall houses made Jack Clark’s eyes twitch.
How would that even work? He could be stuffed in there and probably not even be noticed, unless he manifested his True Demon God Body.
But in doing so, that which was purely energy would yield no results, so the notion of having children was somewhat implausible, um… what am I thinking?
