As Jack Clark narrowed his eyes contemplating whether to directly call upon the Power of Hell and escape, all while pondering the impracticality of the topic at hand, Tarolia suddenly said.
“Human, your Human Race has no future. With your talent, it’s a shame to die here. Why not join our Purgatory True Demons?”
“Should you agree, I can go to the Ancestral Court and request a drop of Ancestor Blood to cleanse and renew your true body.”
Jack’s talent was monstrous, so much so that even after he had slain so many demon kings and over a million Purgatory True Demons, at this moment when Tarolia had ‘captured’ him, she still wished to recruit him.
With Jack’s talent, should he be willing to join The Purgatory Family and receive the Ancestor’s bloodline, he would rapidly ascend to Great Demon King and achieve Demon God status, possibly even establishing the ninth Purgatory Empire on his own.
It should be noted that for entities like Diorus and other Demon Gods, establishing empires required the cooperation of at least two Demon Gods.
In response to Tarolia’s offer, Jack Clark narrowed his eyes and suddenly asked, “Why do you all keep saying that my Human Race has no future? On the Frontline Battlefield, it seems our sides are evenly matched thus far.”
Since the order was to trap Jack Clark, Tarolia was in no hurry. Behind her, the Demonic Flames coalesced into a throne upon which she sat, crossing her legs and speaking with a lazy tone.
“Because over three hundred Sun Wheels ago, our Ancestor briefly awoke and commanded an eastward expansion from our empire’s borders with your Human Race.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1179 - 1179 467 Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1179: Chapter 467: Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Desperate Future of the Human Race_4 Chapter 1179: Chapter 467: Wave Days Heaven-Burning Demon Book, The Desperate Future of the Human Race_4 “So even if your Human Race grows rapidly and withholds against the assault of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire and the Grita War Demon Empire for over two hundred Sun Wheels, it’s still in vain.”
“Once the three major empires at war with the Heavenly Feather Clan and another trio of empires at war with a different civilization conclude their battles and redirect their strength, your Human Race will instantly be crushed into powder.”
“Compared to the Purgatory Empire that was established just over five thousand years ago, and the Grita War Demon Empire established over nine thousand years ago, the power of the other six empires is even more formidable.”
“The weakest of them has an overall might comparable to the combined forces of the current two empires, and the strongest two ancient empires have been established for a hundred thousand years.”
“Whether it’s in terms of the number of demon kings or Grand Demon King Level Strong, or the Main Battle Legions, they are not even in the same league as the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.”
“Especially those Supreme Demon Gods of the two ancient empires are beings that have almost reached the level of Ancestors; just one of their fingers could annihilate your Human Race.”
When speaking of the Supreme Demon Gods of those empires, Tarolia’s face showed utmost respect, not daring to show the slightest irreverence at the mere mention of their existence.
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “If your Purgatory tribe is so strong, why have you been at war with the Heavenly Feather Clan and two other civilizations for so long?”
The other party wasn’t in a hurry, so he naturally didn’t mind; this was a good opportunity to extract some information.
Tarolia said lazily, “Naturally, it is for the sake of training. My Purgatory tribe was born from slaughter and must constantly fight and kill to achieve the status of demon king. Ultimately, they refine themselves into kings.”
“Every time we engage in a Civilization Great War with a powerful tribe of different races, it strengthens the empire’s intrinsic qualities, accumulates the number of demon kings and Grand Demon Kings, and ultimately enhances the Law of the Demon Gods.”
No doubt, that must be the true goal of those Demon Gods.
This information shocked Jack Clark. He had not expected the entire Purgatory tribe to be just pawns for these Demon Gods, bred and culled through ceaseless slaughter like worms.
Slaughter the enemy, slaughter one’s kin, demonize all things in heaven and earth, and ultimately refine the strongest of the Demon Gods.
Sitting high on the throne, Tarolia said indolently, “More than three hundred Sun Wheels ago, commanded by the Ancestor, the three empires waging war against the Heavenly Feather Clan took the fight seriously and soon eradicated most of the clan’s Mythical Powerhouses with minimal losses.”
“Within the next twenty Sun Wheels at most, the Heavenly Feather Clan will be destroyed, and when the forces of the three empires turn and expand eastward, your Human Race will be instantly crushed.”
“Even before the three empires expand eastward, their Highnesses are preparing to launch a preemptive War of Extermination to eradicate your Human Race.”
“That is why I say your Human Race has no hope, no future. Only by joining the Purgatory tribe do you stand a chance to survive.”
“You now have a moment to consider. If you agree to become my companion before their Highnesses return, I can guarantee you will not die,” Tarolia said.
“What will it be, Darren Callum, do you choose death or life?” Tarolia looked at Jack Clark with some anticipation, finding this powerful human intriguing.
This man’s potent bloodline and Qi Blood almost fascinated it—so strong, so enticing.
‘Their Highnesses’, a moment to consider—Jack Clark keenly captured these key points, along with the commands of the Ancestor and information about other Demon God Empires.
Indeed, the power of even the weakest two Demon God Empires was suffocating for the Human Race, not to mention the other six empires that were even more powerful and terrifying.
But what of it? In twenty Sun Wheels, he was confident he could obliterate the entire Purgatory tribe.
“I choose to kill you.”
Roar! A ferocious and savage aura shot into the sky as Jack Clark’s figure swelled to over three hundred meters with dragon horns and a Dragon Tail sprouting, surrounded by dazzling blood light.
Within the hundred-kilometer expanse of the Blood Sea Doomsday, golden flames and blue Thunder shone, and behind Jack Clark, the Dark Void spread, making it seem as if an Ancient God had descended.
But that was not the end. Inside Jack Clark, a Qi Blood that shook Heaven and Earth erupted, with blood light shining brilliantly from all his body’s acupoints. In the interweaving light, an image of a Plane was formed.
Under Jack Clark’s might, comparable to a Titan in dreadfulness, he forcefully reopened a seal and tapped into the Plane’s power, invoking the Supreme Law of Strength.
“`
Suddenly, an overbearing force of ultimate power descended, so heavy and forceful that it burst space and collapsed the Void from Jack Clark’s body.
Between Heaven and Earth, even chants of “strength, strength, strength” could be heard.
Jack Clark, whose terrifying flesh was comparable to that of a Titan-level Giant Beast and who had integrated five Higher-Order Laws and the power of three Divine Powers, was like a black hole at this moment under the Supreme Law of Strength.
Boom!
Beneath the pure black War Halberd, the entire Sealed World shook uncontrollably; the space in front of it shattered extensively, creating an expanding curtain of darkness that surged towards Tarolia.
“Human, you’re seeking death. Do you think me as inept as that waste from Erbore?”
Jack’s ignorance incited Tarolia to release his anger, suddenly standing up; in an instant, countless Dark Flames surged, converging on the combat knife in his hand.
“Today, I will let you know what absolute strength is. It’s a gap that your explosive Secret Skills cannot make up for.”
Tarolia raised his combat knife high; on his body, the terrifying power of two fully realized Higher-Order Laws and three mid-tier Laws spread out.
“I’ve forged the Heaven-Burning Demon Book from all my life’s learning and the Laws I’ve mastered. It has three moves; the first strike, Extinguishing Burial.”
Boom! A sweeping Black Blade Light hundreds of kilometers long slashed down, cutting open the ‘world’ wherever it passed, creating a continuously tearing Sky Curtain.
Under that supremely overbearing blade light, the Laws of Heaven and Earth dissipated, and all matter, space, and energy were severed, indestructible and unstoppable.
Boom! The blade light unfolded the Sky Curtain, cutting through the Supreme Law, and with the force of Destroying Heaven and Earth, struck the thousand-meter-long black War Halberd.
In an instant, there was silence between heaven and earth.
There was but a brief pause before a dazzling radiance burst between the blade light and the halberd, with pure white light like the first ray at the beginning of Opening the Heavens and Earth – magnificent and terrifying.
Boom!
The whole world vibrated under a load it couldn’t bear, huge black cracks spread, and the Earth itself was slashed open with a vast fissure over five hundred kilometers long.
The released power shock surged over a thousand kilometers, striking the curtain that blocked heaven and earth, causing a violent tremor, even the seven gigantic shadows behind the curtain stepped back twice.
“Prince, be careful with your strength,” seven demon kings exclaimed in shock.
At the same time, a black shadow burst out, flying over two hundred kilometers before crashing onto a mountain range with a boom, causing the mountains to collapse and the sky to be filled with exploding debris and billowing smoke and dust.
Amidst the rolling smoke and dust, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, standing in a deep crater several kilometers wide, his expression solemn as he looked at Tarolia, standing firm in the firmament six hundred or so kilometers away.
How strong!
This was the first time Jack had been blasted away head-on by an enemy since his breakthrough to the king-level; it was no wonder he was facing the peak Great Demon King who presided over a Purgatory Empire.
Actually, this outcome was very normal.
Although Jack’s explosion had reached the pinnacle of the Heavenly King stage, his realm was still at the Mid-Mythical Stage, which naturally created a gap between him and Tarolia, who had reached the pinnacle of the Grand Demon King Level.
Moreover, Tarolia was an awakened Great Demon King, an existence that had reached the limits of a Grand Demon King, fusing all Law Powers into one, all insights melded together.
Next, as soon as the perfected Law World within it birthed Rule Power, it could step into the realm of Demon Gods.
Phew! What trouble.
Jack Clark let out a long breath, his eyes blazing with intense Battle Intent. Finally, he had found an opponent who could make him fight with ‘full strength.’
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1180 - 1180 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1180: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent Chapter 1180: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent “The second strike is coming up.”
Standing amidst an endless sea of black flames, Tarolia slowly spoke, with red light diffusing behind him and converging on the combat knife, causing his aura to become suddenly divine.
In the pervasive red radiance, a heavenly realm seemed to emerge faintly, with mountain ranges stretching out, rivers winding, and countless living beings residing and proliferating, perfectly blissful.
But at the moment that paradise-like domain appeared, Jack Clark inexplicably felt a surge of intense aura.
Clearly, Tarolia had not given up, wishing to subdue him with absolute strength, which left Jack somewhat speechless; he never expected that one day he’d actually be coveted by an infernal witch.
Crackle Crackle!!
Sounds of crackling came from Jack’s body, which slowly shrank. In the blink of an eye, his true body compressed to a hundred meters, three faces becoming one, and the four Thunderflame arms behind him retracted, leaving only a circle of golden radiant halo slowly rotating at the back of his head.
In past battles with enemies, Jack appeared to fight from a position of weakness against strength, but in reality, he was pressing the weak with stronger, more vast and magnificent force, shattering his opponents every time.
However, now facing a Peak Awakened Great Demon with a higher realm and true combat strength, his seemingly complicated and formidable Law Power crumbled upon contact.
Tarolia’s approach of fusing all powers into one and creating his own Demon Palace with various grand Law Mysteries was stronger, pushing a certain kind of power to its limit.
Actually, Jack had discovered this problem long ago; otherwise, he wouldn’t have created his own move when he made the breakthrough to Eight Layer Heaven.
It’s just that his cultivation had improved too rapidly, without time for consolidation, so he only created four moves: Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial, True Thunder Instant Slash, Endless Destruction, and Great Thousand Burial.
Of the four moves, only Great Thousand Burial involved three kinds of Law Power.
Sigh!
Jack exhaled slowly, looking at Tarolia, who stood over seven hundred kilometers away like a World-Destroying Demon King. Inside him, Law Power’s origin vibrated, forcibly consolidating the five grand Laws’ Power.
“Sea of Illusion, Eternal Burial!” a cold voice echoed through Heaven and Earth.
The combat knife in Tarolia’s hand released an endless red radiance, appearing like a burning laser beam shooting out, spanning the sky, turning the whole world red.
Under the red glow, be it space or the Heavenly Earth Law, everything turned red, even the invisible Boundary Wall surrounding Jack was penetrated by the red light.
Red light reflecting the cosmos, Jack’s consciousness involuntarily blurred for a moment.
Screech!
A Mercedes sedan screeched to a halt on the road, with the driver sticking his head out and cursing at Jack standing motionless by the roadside: “Motherfucker, are you looking to die, walking without looking?”
The traffic light had just turned green, and this driver seemed to be hurrying as if he were racing to be reborn, intending to dash across before pedestrians even stepped onto the zebra crossing.
Watching the driver, who swore at Jack, the surrounding people took out their mobile phones excitedly to watch the show; some even shouted for a fight, not minding escalating the situation.
However, Jack paid them no mind and instead marveled at the familiar sights of Earth before him and the ‘notebook’ he was holding in his hand.
Such a powerful illusion, acting directly on the soul, even capable of interfering with my consciousness; or perhaps, this is essentially a real world.
A temporary existence of a Plane fragment, everything here exists momentarily.
In Jack’s other pair of eyes, the world now appeared to be in two layers.
One layer was the Earth of his previous life, lined with skyscrapers, and the other was the sealed land painted in endless red radiance, with a blade stretching for tens of thousands of meters slicing towards him silently.
Beneath that blade edge gleaming with black light, space split open, forming a spreading black crack, tearing the Firmament apart.
“Come on, are you deaf, good dogs don’t block the way, move it!” Seeing Jack unresponsive, the driver grew even angrier.
But at that moment, endless golden flames erupted from Jack’s body, turning him into a star in rapid collision, destroying everything.
Boom! As flames of tens of thousands of degrees Celsius erupted, the air expanded rapidly and exploded.
Everything it touched evaporated and vanished, whether it was the Mercedes, its driver, or the onlookers around, and even the entire world itself crumbled into nothingness.
Boom Boom Boom!!
As the Sun-searing Golden Flame infinitely expanded, the red light dissolved. The ground exploded, countless clumps of dirt were turned into magma and flew in all directions, and the entire Sealed World shook.
Radiating endless light and heat, the thirty-kilometer-wide Great Sun contracted, becoming a War Halberd of golden flame tens of thousands of meters long, shooting up into the sky.
Surrounded by four Law Chains in the shape of fire dragons, the grand War Halberd emitted a world-shaking destructive temperature as the Law of Strength infused into it.
Where the flaming War Halberd and the blade light met, a brief stalemate ensued before the red blade light was cleaved apart, but at that moment, dazzling light erupted, as if a real star had exploded.
Boom!
The terrifying might of the Great Sun Heaven Flame Law’s Mystery, the explosion of a Great Sun star, directly shattered the red blade light, forming countless golden light beams that Destroyed Heaven and Earth.
Under the powerful Destructive Impact, the heavens split and lands flew, destroying everything within a two hundred kilometer radius, with gigantic cracks spreading incessantly.
Outside this domain, the shadows of seven demon kings shuddered, hurriedly pumping their essence into the Demon Banner to stabilize the Seal, blocking that terrifying impact.
Fortunately, Tarolia knew the goal was to Seal Jack, so he controlled his power, preventing any shock to the black curtain surrounding the heavenly Earth.
In a crater a hundred kilometers in diameter and tens of kilometers deep, with raging winds howling, Jack, dressed in Black-red Scaled Armor and with dragon horns on his head, slowly flew up, magma flowing on his body, his Battle Intent more fervent than ever.

chapters.title: Chapter 1181 - 1181 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1181: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent_2 Chapter 1181: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent_2 Gazing at Tarolia, hundreds of kilometers away, Jack Clark slowly spoke, “Your Heaven Burning Demon Scripture seems not strong enough.”
Although he was at a disadvantage after two moves, he had managed to block Tarolia’s attacks with his formidable True Body, even if the residual force from the last strike had sliced into the Earth, causing only some turmoil within his Qi Blood.
Moreover, while clashing with Tarolia, he had vaguely discerned a direction for the fusion and creation of his own Law.
For instance, the move just now had been an attempt.
“Worthy of being a human that caught my interest. Since it’s like this, I will let you witness what is the power of the limit.”
Boom! With a deep sound, Tarolia’s Aura burst forth, becoming incredibly terrifying; thick kilometer-wide columns of Black Flames erupted and shook Heaven and Earth within the sea of dark flames.
Crackle Crackle, black sharp spikes started growing out of Tarolia’s body, his purple hair whipping wildly as a fray of tens of kilometers silently split open behind him.
Suddenly, a power from the Abyss descended, and Tarolia’s Aura skyrocketed again.
However, unlike other demon kings who summoned the dark red Abyssal Power, the Abyssal Power that Tarolia summoned was pitch black and extremely dense, like the darkest force from the deepest Abyss.
As the Dark Abyss swallowed Tarolia whole, the entire form of the demon dissolved and disappeared, followed by the sea of dark flames, formed by the erupting black columns, quaking above the Firmament.
Boom! The Sealed World, spanning over a thousand kilometers, shuddered and fractured, the sea of fire tearing apart as a blade light burning with Black Flames descended from the heavens.
Through the torn sea of dark flames, a vague, colossal silhouette could be seen standing above, emanating a supreme and imposing aura.
Facing Tarolia’s slash that fused two Higher-order Laws with the Chaotic Dominance Devil True Self and unleashed the strongest strike “Abyss Annihilation,” Jack Clark was engulfed in an instant.
Boom! The Void exploded, and space-time shook violently.
Under the fire-blazing Blade Edge, mountains crumbled and the ground split apart, strength, matter, laws, and space were all cleaved in two, leading to a terrifying crack that kept spreading.
The fearsome strike almost cleaved the entire world in half, creating a horror-inducing crack nearly a thousand kilometers long, tens of kilometers wide, and seemingly bottomless.
“Damn, that human escaped!” Suddenly, the seven demon kings cried out in angry surprise.
Under the sealed and Suppressed sky and surroundings, Jack Clark had used the force from Tarolia’s strike to traverse hundreds of kilometers of Earth and emerge outside the Sealed “World.”
Amidst the raging Space Turbulence, Jack Clark appeared somewhat weakened.
A thirty-meter long wound sliced diagonally across his body, tearing through his battle armor and revealing the trained golden ribs and the beating organs within.
Near the wound, Black Flames burned, emanating a terrifying destructive dark force that ground against Jack Clark’s Vitality, clashing with the golden flames and Thunder, preventing the wound from healing.
Moreover, a crack of dozens of meters in the Void in front of him was slowly closing; that was the absolutely Defensive Boundary Wall cut open by the blade.
Tarolia’s strike had surpassed all limits, breaking free from constraints and reaching Rule Level with absolute power, a frightening sight, leaving even Jack Clark heavily injured by a single strike.
Roar!
Just as Jack Clark burst out of the seal, the Dark Demon Dragon that Suppressed the Sealed World outside roared loudly.
Boom!
With a flap of its double wings, the massive Three-headed Demon Dragon shattered space and instantly appeared a thousand kilometers away, its Dragon Claw shadowing the sky, bringing down a Terrifying Power that could Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Underneath the Dragon Claw wrapped in black Law chains, Space Turbulence collapsed, and a dazzling burst of Silver Brilliance quaked the Void.
“Do you really think I can’t kill you,” said a voice filled with extreme ferocity, causing even Tarolia to tremble at the Terrifying Aura that erupted.
Roar!
The majestic and Overbearing Dragon Roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, and beneath Jack Clark a vast Gloomy blue Summoning Altar of ten thousand meters unfolded in the Void, inverting space and reversing time.
Amidst the wildly shaking Space-Time Altar, a Huge Black-red Dragon Claw reached out, soaring skyward, to meet the even larger Demon Dragon’s claw.
Boom! The moment the large and small Dragon Claws collided, the surrounding Void exploded into a ten thousand-meter-diameter Black Hole.
In the astonished gaze of the seven demon kings, the three-thousand-meter-long Three-headed Dark Demon Dragon was blown away with a bang, its claw’s scale armor shattered and flesh and blood burst asunder.
Behind Jack Clark, a monstrous Black-red Colossal Beast, nineteen hundred meters long with a ferocious and immense body, emerged ‘slowly’ from the Time-Space Summoning Altar.
Around the Giant Beast, black and red lightning twined, black Mane on the ferocious dragon head rustled without wind, emitting an indescribable Terrifying Aura.
Although this Giant Beast’s growth realm was only at the Early Titan stage, at that moment, including Tarolia, everyone inexplicably felt as though they faced a Rule Demon God directly.
This Giant Beast was incredibly strong and terrifying. Standing atop the unfathomable sea of black flames, Tarolia became gravely serious.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon True Body descended, Jack Clark’s Soul Power, Law Divine Power, and Qi Blood all vanished by a tenth.
Compared to when he Summoned the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon in the Ninth Heavens, Jack Clark’s True Body was practically on par with an Early Titans Beast, capable of enduring the Destruction Emperor Dragon True Body’s presence for an extended time.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon descended and the atmosphere of the grand battle became solemn once again, suddenly an immature voice echoed from atop the ferocious behemoth.
Yi ya yi ya!? Where is this?
On the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a ten-meter-long Purple little dragon clutching a dragon horn looked around curiously, finally fixing its gaze on Jack Clark below.
It recognized this ‘Person’; its brother’s image had appeared in the Ice Crystal Divine Palace during his Hibernation, and the aura from Jack Clark was familiar and dear, very much like his brother’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 1182 - 1182 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1182: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent_3 Chapter 1182: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent_3 However, there was no time for the Purple Little Dragon Man to be confused, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon, fused with Jack Clark’s consciousness, unleashed the power of shaking space-time, radiating dazzling light.
Roar!
The three Dark Demon Dragons let out a scream as their massive bodies crashed through the Void with a loud bang, appearing outside the Demon Domain like a mountain range, smashing fiercely into the towering black mist.
Boom! The terrifying impact shook the black mist, causing it to erupt in violent ‘tsunamis’ that spread in all directions.
Bang! The three-kilometer-long Giant Beast fell to the ground, the Earth shattered, and hot, dark-red blood sprayed from an injury on the Demon Dragon where a head had been torn off, like a waterfall.
In just an instant, this Titan Peak Beast had its head torn off by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, displaying exponentially overpowering terrifying power.
With the last talent transformed into a Higher-order Law and completing the transformation into the Titan Level, the Destruction Emperor Dragon broke its limits, its normal battle strength barely edging into the realm of an Ancient Titan.
This is the horror of completing nine Higher-order Laws; the more advanced it gets, the more it defies the heavens.
Roar! Just then, that domineering Dragon Roar once again echoed through the Void, the Sealed World, not yet withdrawn, exploded with a loud bang, directly torn apart by a pair of Dragon Claws.
Spurt, spurt!! Seven Demon Kings vomited blood, and the seven combat banners they wielded cracked with fissures and shattered.
And as the Sealed World was torn apart, the ‘world’ separated by Law Power returned, the Heaven and Earth roared, and the entire land outside the Demon Domain undulated like sea waves.
A thousand-meter long Tail Blade spanned heaven and Earth, entwined with nine Law Chains, turning space into Chaos wherever it passed.
Under the terrifying speed of the Law, this blade was almost too fast to see, the seven Demon Kings couldn’t even react and were instantly annihilated, their Divine Souls obliterated.
Bang, bang, bang!! With the ‘Artifact Spirit’ fallen, the huge combat banners of the Demon Banner crumbled.
“Abyss Annihilation!”
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon grievously wounded three Dark Demon Dragons and destroyed Seven Demon Kings with one blade, Tarolia’s voice of surprise and anger came from the Firmament.
Boom!
The black flames obscuring the sky tore apart, and a blade alight with the ultimate Dark Flames descended once more, emitting a Terrifying Aura capable of cutting through worlds and annihilating everything.
Under that dreadful blade light, all things perished, the Void exploded.
Wrapped in black and red lightning, a Dragon Claw streaked with golden and black lines rose to the sky, aiming at the supremely powerful blade light.
Boom! The heavens inverted, the Earth sank.
Under the force of terrifying power, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon at its center, dirt and rocks exploded within a radius of tens of kilometers, flung in all directions, and a crack hundreds of kilometers long appeared once again.
In the midst of the raging Sword Qi turbulence, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood unharmed, its terrifying Aura circulating, pressuring space into continuous fractures, Law dissipating.
Yet above the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, Jack Clark stood amidst four dragon horns, his aura weakening once again, his feet covered by the Space-Time Summoning Great Array shining on the Emperor Dragon’s skin.
By Jack Clark’s side, the Purple Little Dragon Man, now grown to a length of ten meters, stood up excitedly, pointing ahead and chirping, “Yiyi yiyi!! Kill them, big brother, the great May wants to see rivers of blood.”
Without its command, the Destruction Emperor Dragon vanished on the spot with a roar, immediately causing the two remaining Dark Demon Dragons in the distance to let out cries of shock and rage.
Boom, boom!!
Two massive columns of black dragon breath roared, piercing through heaven and Earth, with a Terrifying Aura capable of wiping out everything, destroying the afterimage of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and landing on a mountain range over two hundred kilometers away.
Immediately, dazzling black Radiance erupted, flattening the cloven mountain range.
Just then, with another agonized screech, the Dark Demon Dragon appeared behind itself in the Void, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had grabbed its tail, its double claws’ muscles bulging.
Boom!
The three-kilometer-long Giant Beast, like a mountain, shot into the sky at a hundred times the speed of sound, crashing through the black clouds, bearing the Aura of Mountains and Seas shaking, appearing before Tarolia.
“Get out of my way!” Tarolia, now covered in black bone spurs and manifesting his Chaotic Dominance Devil True Self, roared, holding his combat knife transversely.
Boom!
Under the impact of a Titan Peak Beast, space around Tarolia shattered, forming a giant Black Hole, the power of the collision even sent him flying.
Just as Tarolia was knocked away by the Dark Demon Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked ahead at the wall of black mist and behind at the Demon City stretching thousands of kilometers, its mouth glowing brightly.
In the eyes of countless Purgatory True Demons in the demon domain filled with despair and fear, a beam hundreds of meters thick of Golden Blue Purple Destructive Breath shot out, radiating dazzling light.
Fusing Heaven Burning Golden Flame, Chaos Hole Divine Thunder, and Corrosion Law Power, the Breath tore through the ten-kilometer-thick wall of black mist, which shook and gradually dissipated, forming a hollow several kilometers in diameter.
Boom! In an instant, the Destructive Breath hit hundreds of kilometers away in the demon domain, and immediately the Earth was illuminated by a majestic golden blue Radiance, like a giant mushroom cloud.
And as the Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly turned its head, the beam swept across the land exploding, Heaven and Earth shaking, and countless Purgatory True Demons turned to ash under the Destructive Breath.
“Darren Callum!”
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath destroyed half of the demon domain with one sweep, a roar of surprise and anger ensued, followed by a terrifying blade light.
In addition, a Dark Breath a kilometer in diameter pierced the heavens and Earth, carrying an Aura of Destroying Heaven and Earth through the clouds.
Facing Tarolia’s Overbearing blade that even the normal state Destruction Emperor Dragon dared not take lightly, the Breath disappeared from its mouth, and it turned to sweep its Tail Blade.

﻿Chapter 1183: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent_4 Chapter 1183: Chapter 468 Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Demon God’s Descent_4 The mile-long Tail Blade, wrapped in the laws, was extremely sharp, and it annihilated space the instant it appeared in front of the blade light.
Boom! Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Tail Blade clashed with the strike of Abyss Annihilation, the merged Destructive Breath of the Dark Demon Dragon also engulfed the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and at once, dazzling light burst forth.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the deluge of the black pillar of Breath, the Destruction Emperor Dragon emitted a dazzling radiance. The earth shattered once more around it, spreading huge cracks far and wide, exploding, and countless black firelights soared into the sky.
Yet, even with the Titan Peak Beast’s Breath wildly assaulting, it couldn’t shake the Destruction Emperor Dragon in the least.
On its heavy black-red scale armor, the dim law lines flowed, emitting a chaotic aura, forming an invisible force field around it.
The Breath that could penetrate the earth and melt an entire mountain range merely approached the Destruction Emperor Dragon, only to dissipate and melt away under the fluctuations of chaotic dark power, eventually falling as a small fiery spark upon its body.
Aside from making the scales of the Destruction Emperor Dragon shine brighter, that bit of power inflicted no damage.
Witnessing this scene, Tarolia’s gaze turned grave as she slowly spoke, “Decules, stop. This beast has a high immunity to law energy attacks.”
Upon hearing these words, the other head of the Three-headed Demon Dragon, already grown halfway, gradually ceased its Breath.
Roar roar!! The furious roars of the Dark Demon Dragon echoed, its four eyes intently fixed on the black-red colossal beast standing on the shattered earth, over a hundred kilometers away.
Around Tarolia, the black sea of fire burned as her gaze fell upon Jack Clark on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and she spoke slowly, “Darren Callum, I didn’t expect you to complete the Summoning in the end.”
“This must be the real ace up your sleeve for daring to venture deep into our clan’s territory, a beast with such fearsome combat power. Its strength is far greater than the giant beast you summoned on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield before.”
Just one Sun Wheel ago, the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon Jack Clark had summoned on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield was only several hundred meters long, its Growth Level was in the early Myth phase, and its form was also slightly different.
Hence, Tarolia couldn’t imagine that this colossal beast was the same creature that had once dominated the Frontline Battlefield.
However, Jack had no intention of wasting words with it as he spoke slowly from atop the Emperor Dragon’s head, “Less than half a moment more, are you ready to face death?”
Only half a moment had passed since Jack and Tarolia faced off in the Sealed World.
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s now terrifying power, half a moment was enough to tear and suppress the Titan Peak Beast and heavily injure Tarolia.
Boom! Infinite flames and Thunder burst from the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, transforming the area spanning over a hundred kilometers into an Area of Destruction, then compressing continuously.
In the blink of an eye, a Fire Giant Beast with a body length of ten thousand meters and double wings that covered the sky in golden blue flames appeared, and in that instant, all of Heaven and Earth trembled with the terrifying fluctuations of energy.
This was the form that the Destruction Emperor Dragon completely broke through to the Titan Level, gaining the true “talent” title of Azure Heaven Dragon Form!
Unlike the Deep Red Form, this form did not instantly enhance its combat strength limit across realms but was a regular form, wielding the Power of Heaven and Earth to amplify its rule authority.
Since it was a ‘steady state,’ it did not cause further consumption for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Roar! The ferocious roar shook Heaven and Earth, as the ten-thousand-meter-long Fire Giant Beast with golden red flames flapped its wings, sweeping forth a heat wave that could destroy heaven and earth, appearing in front of the Three-headed Demon Dragon.
Roar roar roar!!
Before the true form of the laws, the Dark Demon Dragon, which had been heavily injured by a single blow from the Destruction Emperor Dragon earlier, let out a roar of shock and rage, its double claws swelling to more than ten times its size, striking out like two colossal mountains.
Simultaneously, its massive body instantly turned into pure black crystal, emitting an indestructible and powerful aura.
Boom!
Under the strike of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s huge Dragon Claw, Heaven and Earth quaked, and the black crystal claws of the Titan Peak Dark Demon Dragon shattered, like a dark ray of light descending from the sky.
Instantly, the earth below erupted over a hundred kilometers, magma spewed, and a terrifying impact swept across hundreds of kilometers, causing the black fog walls nearby to violently shake.
With its double wings outspread, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, having knocked the Dark Demon Dragon away, caused the space within tens of kilometers ahead to shatter, forming a roaring, sky-obscuring black tide that engulfed the charging Tarolia.
Boom!
The Tail Blade, burning with golden-blue flames, swept across like a 6,000-kilometer long mountain range, tearing through the Void, annihilating spatial storms as it appeared before Tarolia.
The invisible Destructive Aura made Tarolia’s expression tighten, the blade light in his hand surged, and in an instant, he slashed out thousands of strikes, forming a mountain of blades engulfed in Black Flames.
Boom!
The Tail Blade ablaze with golden-blue flames collided with the mountain of black blades, and the resulting terrifying explosion shook the Void, spreading giant Black Cracks across hundreds of kilometers.
Just as Tarolia burst with full strength, concentrating Law Power to shatter the Tail Blade, the Void above his head collapsed, and a massive Dragon Claw burning with flames descended from the sky.
Boom!
The Sea of Black Flames around Tarolia exploded, space shattered, half of his enormous true body was smashed, turning into a streak of light that crashed into the Earth more than a hundred kilometers below in an instant.
Suddenly, Dazzling Light burst forth from the Earth, as if a comet had struck the planet, destroying Heaven and Earth.
Roar!
It was but an instant when the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had sent flying and heavily injured both the Titan Peak Beast and the awakened Peak-level Great Demon King, roared, descending like a brilliant meteor from the sky.
Strike the iron while it’s hot.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon prepared to first tear apart that Dark Demon Dragon, two Demon God-level Terrifying Auras appeared thousands of kilometers away, instantly descending across that distance.
Boom, boom!!

In the face of an all-around targeting by the Purgatory Demon Clan, with the sealing of his Summoning Bottom Card and Plane Space, Jack Clark had not chosen to use the power of the Supreme Hell Plane to leave.
His goal was to forge a future. Today, even at the risk of heavy injury, he would fight for a bit of time for the Human Race, for himself.
