chapters.title: Chapter 1184 - 1184 469 Reversely Cut Down the Demon God The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1184: Chapter 469 Reversely Cut Down the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark Chapter 1184: Chapter 469 Reversely Cut Down the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark Roar!
In the Deep Red Destruction Form with eight kinds of grand accomplishment, just one had recently coalesced, totaling nine kinds of Higher-order Law Powers integrating and sublimating into the Supreme Destruction Law.
And because of the fusion of too many Higher-order Laws, around the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this moment, the blood-red lightning held a terrifying might, even more dreadful than the power of rules.
Under that half-sky shimmering blood-red lightning, everything would be destroyed and obliterated, forming a divine picture of world destruction.
Besides that, the body of the Giant Beast had swelled to six thousand meters; although its appearance seemed to have grown only to four thousand meters, its length had doubled, and in total, its size had increased nearly tenfold.
And with its size increasing tenfold came an even more terrifying base strength and Defense; the sheer power emanating invisibly was bursting the surrounding space.
From afar, it resembled a black hole several kilometers in diameter appearing between heaven and earth, with blood-red lightning permeating the depths of the black hole, and the Heavenly Energy within a thousand-kilometer radius roaring and shaking.
This terrifying power caused the laws of heaven and earth within hundreds of kilometers to collapse, the magnetic field to chaotize, the Earth to fracture, and countless rocks and dirt to levitate weightlessly in the chaotic magnetic field.
With such might, even the two Demon Gods, including Diorus, had solemn expressions, for the Giant Beast’s form was all too familiar to them.
Above the Firmament, Diorus’s voice resonated deeply, “It’s that Summoned Giant Beast; it has grown from the Early Myth to the Early Titan in the span of a day.”
They had witnessed Jack Clark Summoning this Black-red Colossal Beast at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield before, transforming into a monstrous shape that could directly enhance its strength by an entire Major Realm.
With their keen eyesight, they were shocked by the growth rate of this Giant Beast but naturally did not make the same mistake as Tarolia.
For a human to reach this level in the Legendary Realm, even they could not help but marvel, and then their intent to kill grew even more intense.
Roar!
The majestic and vast Dragon Roar shook Heaven and Earth, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon moved with a booming motion, unleashing a sky-covering burst of Deep Red Destruction Thunder toward the two Demon Gods.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered the Deep Red Form, Jack Clark’s “energy” consumption rate skyrocketed a hundredfold in an instant, lasting at most three minutes, hence he dared not waste it.
Boom! The sky-enveloping blood-red lightning collided with the overwhelming darkness of the Abyss, like three worlds clashing, erupting with a terrifying power that shook Heaven and Earth.
Upon collision, space itself was squeezed to burst, creating a black Spatial Storm that swept across the land, causing space within thousands of kilometers to quake, the Earth to tremble, and mountain peaks to collapse.
At the Demon God Level, which is the Ancient Titan Level for the Giant Beast, their internal Laws World is fully matured, turning illusion into reality, nurturing rules.
And a Demon God is the World Lord of these World Rules, their world projection interfering with the outer world, forming a Rule Domain unique to themselves.
Furthermore, with rules pervading and Suppressing the Heavenly Earth Laws, one can control a greater range of the Power of Heaven and Earth, and every movement wields power skyrocketing tens to hundreds of times greater—capable of destroying heaven and earth.
In such circumstances, unless met with the same level of Law Power, no matter whether it be a Great Demon King at the early stage or a pinnacle-level strong man, both would be defeated in one blow before them.
And this is only the gap in strength levels; beyond that, there’s also an overall crushing superiority coming from the life level and the Rule True Body.
But today, they encountered a monster who, at Titan Level, could Reversely Cut Down an Ancient Titan.
Boom!
Under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws wrapped with deep red annihilation lightning, the Rule Domain that surrounded Diorus and Carthius for two hundred kilometers was directly torn apart.
The destructive lightning, a unification of nine kinds of Higher-order Laws, reached a zenith of terrifying power, comparable to the Supreme Destruction Law.
Roar!
Then, from the left, came an extremely fierce Demon Dragon roar, and amidst the tumbling Dark Demon Air, a huge black Dragon Claw ten thousand meters in size extended.
At the same time, it revealed a corner of the True Body of the Demon God Carthius—it was a Dark Demon Dragon tens of thousands of meters long, condensed from endless Abyssal Demon Flame.
Under the enormous black Dragon Claw, the Earth crumbled, the invisible fabric of space was directly shattered into black dust, scattering into the sky as shattered transparent light points.
In front of the Dragon Claw, the Void collapsed, and the keen tail wrapped in blood-red lightning swept across, creating an ever-spreading dark fan shape that slashed onto the black Dragon Claw.
Boom!
The Dark Dragon Claw was instantly cleaved by an unrivaled force, followed by an explosion of endless blood-red lightning that turned it into dust, causing everything to tremble.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s “slash” held not only lightning comparable to the Destruction Law but also its formidable unparalleled Giant Beast strength; with both combined, its combat power was invincible.
And just as the black Dragon Claw was slashed apart, the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, its claws wrapped in Destructive Lightning fiercely striking forward.
There, a black-gold magic spear tens of thousands of meters long spun wildly, tearing apart space in a hundred-kilometer radius and forming a black hole shooting towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s chest.
Beneath the blood-red lightning, large areas of space fractured, and the Dragon Claw’s contained horrifying power further Suppressed heaven and earth.
Bang!
Under the Unrivaled Domination of a claw, the god-slaying magic spear, gathered by the power of Heaven and Earth, was directly smashed, the destructive energy shock causing a thousand-kilometer range of heaven and earth to shake.
Upon reaching the Ancient Titan Level, the encounters between the two sides seem ‘slow’, yet they are actually faster than the perception of consciousness, instantly crossing hundreds of kilometers.
And with just one exchange, the Destruction Emperor Dragon abandoned Diorus, who was stronger, and ferociously pounced towards the left side at Carthius, who must have just broken through to the mid period of Demon God not long ago.
Surrounding the Dark Demon Dragon over a hundred thousand meters long, inexhaustible Dark Demon Air from the Abyss filled the area, forming an Abyssal Rule Domain spreading across three hundred kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1185 - 1185 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1185: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_2 Chapter 1185: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_2 Meanwhile, under the radiation of rule strength, black flames burned across thousands of kilometers, engulfing the heavens and the earth and turning the entire “world” into a death forbidden area.
Boom!
The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon charged into the Abyssal Rule Domain, the blood-red lightning and demon gas that pervaded the surroundings collided, triggering a terrifying explosion of the two rule forces instantly.
From a distance, it looked like a demon cloud with a diameter of 300 kilometers, filled with endless blood-red lightning, and the invisible destructive energy fluctuations caused Tarolia and the Titan Demon Dragon to palpitate incessantly.
In front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with one claw, Tarolia and the Titan Demon Dragon fell from the sky and were directly blasted more than a hundred kilometers deep into the earth.
And now, seeing that red beast in its Destruction Form, both demon and beast subconsciously chose to ram to death instead of foolishly charging out.
Including Tarolia, who had previously overpowered everyone with three strikes that sent Jack flying.
Although it was arrogantly confident in its invincibility within the Great Demon King Realm, it was not foolish. Given the terrifying combat strength that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had now shown, daring to rush out would result in its true body being blown apart instantly, leaving it either dead or heavily injured.
Roar!
Inside the Rule Domain, a dark demon dragon with a length of tens of thousands of meters roared, its double wings covering the sky, and it stirred up endless Abyss Flames that submerged the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
These black flames were extremely terrifying, containing the strength of the abyssal rules and burning everything demonized. The Law Domain of the Great Demon King could be burned through in an instant, and its true body reduced to ashes.
Bang bang bang!!
The scorching Abyss Flames engulfed the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and as they got about a kilometer away from its body, they hit an invisible dam, producing a thundering shake and a scorching energy impact, unable to advance any further.
Atop the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, the Purple little dragon let out an excited roar: Squeak squeak!!! Kill it, brother, tear off its head, and viciously rip its wings apart.
Hearing the Purple little dragon’s milky roar, Jack couldn’t help but twitch at the corners of his eyes.
Because there had been no time for juvenile education, this little guy was becoming increasingly violent and fierce. It seemed that he would have to find time to guide its values.
As to why it followed the summoned, as the little dragon’s strength grew, the Creations Field surrounding it became stronger.
Under the Creations Field, the life vibration it emitted, its life magnetic field, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon nearly merged into one.
Originally, this instinctual imitation of life vibration was for it to not get hurt by the flames and thunder that surrounded the Destruction Emperor Dragon when it lay on it to sleep.
Boom!
Two giant beasts as large as mountain ranges collided, shaking the thousand-kilometer sky instantly, and the earth shattered.
Roar! The six-kilometer-long Crimson Beast roared up to the heavens, and the violent destruction strength on its body was unleashed to the extreme. Everything around twisted and deformed.
Boom! Compared to the Dark Demon Dragon, which stretched for tens of thousands of meters, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was more than ten times smaller. Yet, at the moment of impact, the vastly larger Dark Demon Dragon was flipped over.
Boom!
The tens of kilometers long Demon Dragon fell from the sky, causing the heavens to break and the earth to split instantly. All things exploded, mountain ranges collapsed, and the scorching black flame shockwave swept through thousands of kilometers…
Compared to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Carthius was merely a Demon God that mastered the Abyss Demon Dragon rules and manifested as a tens-of-kilometers-long Abyss Demon Dragon.
Its true body was condensed from rules and Abyss Flames, though it was truly strengthened, it wasn’t a real abyssal giant beast. The pure strength of its true body couldn’t compare to that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon flipped over the Dark Demon Dragon with a strike, nine enormous Black Gold rule chains, each as thick as a hundred meters, entwined towards it, piercing through space-time.
On those nine rule chains, time seemed to diffuse, causing everything they passed to halt. Instantly, they wrapped around the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, forming Eight Directional Sealing Chains.
Roar! Seeing the Black Gold chains wrapping around it dozens of times just a hundred meters from its body, the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared. Blood Red Lightning burst from within it.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the destructive force, the Black Gold Rule Chains continuously shattered, emitting a dazzling radiance. In that moment, the muscles in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws swelled, and its arms stretched out furiously.
With a resounding bang and Unrivaled Domineering Power, the rule chains containing a fragment of Time Power from Diorus shattered and exploded.
Because the rule chains entwined it, the Dark Demon Dragon that was flipped over by the Destruction Emperor Dragon rose with a roar, its huge double claws ablaze with black flames.
Boom!
The limitless Abyss Flames erupted like a volcanic eruption, submerging the Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly. The double claws of the Demon Dragon clashed with those of the Destruction Emperor Dragon within a column of fire thousands of meters thick.
Suddenly, all of the vacuum seemed to be overwhelmed, and under the overbearing ferocious power, the enormous body of the Dark Demon Dragon was violently launched into the sky again by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But at the same time, the terrifying recoil forced the Destruction Emperor Dragon to stagger back several steps. Behind it, an ancient creature covered entirely by grey rocks, stretching over several kilometers, emerged.
Roar!
It roared like an ancient petrified Tyrannosaurus. Its spiky head and gaping mouth opened wide, emitting a terrifying devouring suction aimed straight at the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The most frightening aspect of ancient beings was their devouring power. Once swallowed, even a Demon God could be dissolved by the perfected pinnacle of the Rule Origin.
Boom! A three-thousand-meter-long red tail sliced up from below in a swift motion like lightning, striking the lower jaw of the ancient creature instantly.
Under the terrifying edge of the blade, the rock shattered, splitting the gaping mouth of the ancient creature right down the middle, and the red lightning that pervaded burst forth, nearly blowing apart half of the mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1186 - 1186 469 Reversely Cut Down the Demon God The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1186: Chapter 469 Reversely Cut Down the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_3 Chapter 1186: Chapter 469 Reversely Cut Down the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_3 Meanwhile, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, like a Martial Arts Master, heavily stepped on the Void, subtly veered to the left, and passed by the incoming ancient creature.
Just as they passed by each other, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws reached out to embrace the charging ancient creature, the friction between the rock and the thick red scale armor causing a terrifying energy shockwave to explode.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, its muscles bulging as it released infinite strength during a flip and smash.
Boom!
The ancient creature, several miles long, plummeted down like a mountain range from the sky, the surrounding atmosphere exploding and flames burning when it fell at a hundred times the speed of sound.
The Dark Demon Dragon, having just gotten up below, had no time to react before being fiercely smashed by the ancient creature, causing the Earth around it to explode, collapse, and smoke and dust to billow.
In the midst of the collapsing stones, the time power pervading from the ancient creature dissipated under the Destructive Lightning, returning to a massive skull of an ancient creature.
Boom boom!! And just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon dealt with the ancient creature, a pair of demon claws reaching out above wrapped in terrifying rule power aimed at Jack Clark.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly looked up, its mouth emitting a dazzling crimson radiance.
Boom!
From the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a dazzling deep red Breath burst forth like a one-mile wide crimson Energy Beam, directly shattering the double claws Diorus had condensed from rule power.
After destroying the massive claws, the Breath turned into a red Light Beam, piercing through the Firmament, tearing the Abyssal Rule Domain, and forming a hollow ten kilometers in diameter that disappeared into the sky.
Surrounded by two Demon God Level Powerhouses who were in the mid period of the Ancient Titan, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was displaying terrifying combat strength, holding its own against two without falling behind.
Despite being a Giant Beast, it fought like a human, possessing master level combat consciousness and reflexes, pushing its tail, claws, bites, and Breath to the extreme.
Moreover, with defense that ignored the power of rules and the nearly unstoppable Deep Red Lightning, it was almost invincible.
However, the more terrifying the combat power the Destruction Emperor Dragon exerted in battle, the faster the energy was consumed within Jack Clark’s body, weakening his aura, and he felt he could maintain his Deep Red Form for no more than three minutes.
And this time, he did not have Reincarnation Heavenly Liquid to instantly recover the consumed energy, and even if he did, it would not achieve an instant recovery effect anymore.
After all, his cultivation was no longer at the early stage of the Ninth Heavens.
Diorus naturally felt the change in Jack Clark’s aura, towering at ten thousand meters tall amidst an endless sea of black flames, his form somewhat obscured, with time seemingly flowing around him.
Watching this moment, as ‘Jack Clark’ showed his heaven-defying combat power, Diorus remained cold and collected, showing no urgency or restlessness.
Summoning across a Major Realm and erupting in power over a Major Realm brought an unimaginable burden, enough to instantly drain a Mythical Peak demon king.
Even if this Human Race monster’s True Body was peerlessly strengthened, it couldn’t last ‘a few minutes’.
But as it had anticipated, this monster of the Human Race was difficult to kill. It was fortunate that it had been cautious, bringing Carthius back as well, for otherwise it would have been impossible to keep him.
Even a single Demon God would have trouble with this Destruction Beast and wouldn’t be a match for it.
“Carthius, this beast has an immunity to strength power; pure rule power cannot get close to it.”
Roar!
The Dark Demon Dragon on the Earth roared furiously, its double wings flapping and summoning endless Abyss Flames that soared into the sky, lunging at the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This time, its body, including its claws, were covered in a layer of crimson metal battle armor with black rule patterns twining around it, exuding an unbreakable heavy presence.
This length of tens of thousands of meters of Abyss Battle Armor, the culmination of countless resources and refining by Carthius, enabled it to exert its Dragon True Body to the ultimate limit.
Boom! The collision between the two Ancient Beasts erupted with such pure strength that it shook and vibrated the whole world.
This time, the Dark Demon Dragon was not flung away by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its True Body incredibly sturdy and its strength overbearing, amplified by the Rule-Level treasure.
Just as the Dark Demon Dragon was clashing with the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Diorus stepped forward, appeared outside the Demon Domain, and reached his claws into the heavenly black mist.
Boom! The entire Demon Domain shook, the Earth splitting from the middle, and a dark War Halberd—fifteen thousand miles long, as though it were a mountain range over ten kilometers long—was slowly drawn out.
Instantly, an aura so incredibly heavy spread that the surrounding space kept collapsing under the halo of rule power around the halberd, the presence terrifying.
This halberd was Diorus’s Rule-level weapon, usually nurtured in a side of the Purgatory Empire’s Demon Domain, tempered, and only used when the War of Extermination commenced to exhibit its power to the extreme.
And Rule level weapons were precious to Demon God Level Powerhouses, each requiring countless resources, God-level minerals, and Rule-level materials for forging.
Hence, not all Demon God Powerhouses possessed treasures.
Boom! As Diorus held the World Extermination Halberd, a sharp and overbearing will surged into the sky, shaking Heaven and Earth, as Black Cracks continually appeared high above ten thousand meters.
Indeed there was a problem. Jack looked back, his gaze intensifying upon seeing the Purgatory Demon God coming with the halberd.
As the core of one side of the Purgatory Empire, Jack had guessed that the Demon Domain was not that simple, which was why he’d been tearing the fog wall from the outside all along.
“Unknown Giant Beast, face my halberd, the Heavens-shattering World Extermination.”
The fifteen thousand mile long halberd, enshrouded in Black Gold Radiance and a layer of transparent Time Power, shattered the Void in an instant, surpassing time and appearing beside the Destruction Emperor Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1187 - 1187 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1187: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_4 Chapter 1187: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_4 And what clashed with the halberd was a dragon claw wrapped in blood-red lightning.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s left claw, bursting with a power so heavy it sent the Black Demon Dragon, dozens of times its size, flying back, reached with its right claw toward the mountainous black halberd.
The unmatched sharpness of the halberd shattered the void, ground destructive lightning to dust, and finally, pierced through the invisible world of laws right in front of the dragon claw, for the first time, truly touching the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Hum!!
The giant tip of the halberd struck the thick red scale armor on the palm of the dragon claw, emitting a deep, reverberating hum as the sound waves vibrated, forming a destructive impact that obliterated space within a hundred kilometers.
Wielding a Rule-Treasure Level War Halberd with his Rule True Body, Diorus’s stroke was domineering and terrifying, shattering space-time, and capable of sinking the earth with a single blow.
But the power contained within the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s massive claw was even heavier, more domineering, instantly shaking Diorus’s figure upon contact, and sending his enormous form retreating over a hundred kilometers, stumbling back multiple steps.
That unrivaled domineering power had surpassed some concept, almost on par with the laws, purely terrifying.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In the raging chaos of the void, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws obliterated everything, clashing with the World Extermination Halberd that trembled with the might of its skill thousands of times in an instant, each collision exploding with a destructive impact.
At the same time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s tail slashed through the void and engaged the onrushing Black Armored Demon Dragon, fighting two against one.
The fierce battle brought destruction on an unimaginable scale, and their speed was so fast that it almost transcended time, appearing thousands of kilometers away in the blink of an eye, the aftereffects of the fight destroying everything in existence.
Above in the sky, space collapsed to form giant hollows that delved into the void, while mountain ranges stretching thousands of kilometers on the land exploded, tearing the earth apart.
Many Giant Beasts, Unique Beasts, and cities and bases of Purgatory True Demons were wiped out under the pervasive law energies before they could even react.
Raging Abyssal Demon Flames covered the sky, while streaks of crimson lightning destroyed everything, and the sweeping black halberd vibrated space-time with every sweep.
In just a few breaths, without constraints, the area of thousands of kilometers became ruins, with energy in the heavens and earth going berserk and laws in disarray.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a ferocious roar, disregarding the halberd that pierced through space-time behind it, its power exploding and directly sending the Black Demon Dragon flying, landing heavily on the ground.
Boom! A mountain range several thousand kilometers long collapsed in the middle, and smoke and dust billowed as demonic flames surged to the sky.
Simultaneously, the World Extermination Halberd, wrapped in black gold law energy, struck the Destruction Emperor Dragon from behind with the power to destroy heaven and earth, shattering the scale armor and creating cracks.
By now, in the intense battle, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was ‘wounded’ for the first time. But before the two Demon Gods could feel excitement, those cracks on the scale armor healed instantly under the law of life.
Meanwhile, raging red flames burned upon the Destruction Emperor Dragon, emitting a destructive aura that alarmed both Demon Gods.
Roar! The Black Demon Dragon pinned beneath the Destruction Emperor Dragon erupted in a furious roar, “Are you insane? You’re just a Giant Beast summoned due to a contract; why fight so desperately?”
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared to the sky, its body exploding with endless destructive lightning, repelling Diorus and painting the entire sky in red radiance.
“Remember, I am the King of the Dragon Palace from the Beast Empire, Tim Abott, Brock Abbott.”
In its roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon spewed an endless torrent of blood-red thunder breath from its mouth, piercing the void and becoming a kilometer-wide beam of Destructive Breath that struck the Black Demon Dragon on the head.
Boom! In an instant, it was like a star exploding, with a dazzling red light sphere erupting, at its center were the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its endless crazily vented Origin Destructive Breath.
Under the Origin Destructive Breath fueled by its burning core, the red battle armor on the head of the Black Demon Dragon melted, shattered, and the intense shock forced its head to continuously sink.
Roar, roar, roar!!
The even larger Black Demon Dragon roared in shock and anger, struggling furiously, unleashing terrifying power that tore a crack over a thousand kilometers long across the land.
However, under the suppression of the smaller Destruction Emperor Dragon, it couldn’t rise at all, as if the weight of innumerable Mount Sumerus pressed down upon it.
On the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark looked extremely weak, swaying as if about to fall, but his expression remained calm and indifferent, his gaze resolute.
He planned to severely injure a Demon God, ensuring it couldn’t recover quickly or instigate a War of Extermination.
The extinction of the Human Race by the Demon God Empire involved not just the expansion order from the Purgatory ancestors but also destroying a powerful civilization and offering sacrifices to the Abyss, which would increase their strength.
However, if it were heavily injured and its laws impaired, it would likely be assailed by the supreme of the Human Race during the War of Extermination. This risk could cause its downfall, leading the Demon God to hesitate.
But just as Jack Clark was about to use his last bit of strength, risking the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s injury to severely wound a Demon God.
Boom! Suddenly, space-time was isolated between the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Black Demon Dragon, and a large white beast skin burned madly between them, unleashing endless ‘space.’
Roar!
With that space-class Rule Forbidden Weapon blocking, the Black Demon Dragon fell apart, becoming endless Abyssal Demon Flames that gathered above the sky, reconsolidating.
On its ten-kilometer long true body as a Demon Dragon, the red armor shimmered, and black flames burned while one side of the helmet was just moments away from being breached by the breath.
Had it not been for the protective Rule-Treasure Level Armor, it would have been severely injured by the Origin Destructive Breath as the Destruction Emperor Dragon burned its own origin.
Meanwhile, Jack Clark on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon swayed, nearly incapable of maintaining the war pattern, his feet on the flickering gloomy blue Space-Time Summoning Array.

chapters.title: Chapter 1188 - 1188 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1188: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_5 Chapter 1188: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_5 Jack Clark gasped weakly, “Indeed, one should never underestimate the devils of the world. These Demon Gods have existed for so many years, countless secret treasures lie hidden in their hands.”
Feeling the weakness in Jack Clark’s form and the limit of his vitality, a cold light appeared in the eyes of the two Demon Gods, thinking he was finally at his limit.
“Still not enough,” suddenly, Jack Clark roared from atop the head of the Emperor Dragon, with a layer of golden flames burning on his body, his aura surged, and the radiance from the Space-Time Summoning Technique beneath his feet shone once again.
As Jack Clark burned his Life Origin, an endless surge of strength burst forth from within him, sustaining the existence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared to the sky, blood-red lightning burst from its body, emitting dazzling red light.
“Exhaust him to death,” declared Diorus’ two Demon Gods, not daunted but spirited at the sight, as Demonic Flames soared high around them, ready to meet the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom boom boom!! An even more intense battle erupted in an instant.
The stronger the power displayed by Jack Clark, the more resolute Diorus and Carthius became in their resolve to kill him, while also acknowledging the increased difficulty.
At this moment, with Jack Clark actively burning his Life Origin, the two Demon Gods were actually thrilled and prepared to drag out the fight to exhaust him to death.
Both the Destruction Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark only had the strength to cross realms during Limit Breakthroughs, while both Demon Gods were inherently mid period Ancient Titans.
Their battle, though also consuming energy, was a normal state for them, and they could recover with just a bit of cultivation after the fight.
In contrast, Jack Clark’s type of explosion by burning Life Origin would damage his foundation, and like the High Priest, he would burn to ashes, exhausted to death in the end.
Under normal conditions, the lifespan of Mythical-level beings could be said to be very long, with enough vitality resources, they could live up to ten thousand years (thirty thousand years in Blue Star time).
Even some Innate lives break the shackles of lifespan, becoming infinite like Ancient Titan-level creatures, their lifespans bound with Heaven and Earth.
However, this type of immortality also had its limits—if the Life Origin is incomplete, they could still fall, like those ancient beings who failed their breakthroughs.
Unless the damaged Life Origin is repaired, which would require the power of Creation.
Yet, the rule resources containing the power of Creation, such as rule treasures, were extremely rare, even in the mythical world.
Roar roar roar!! The Destruction Emperor Dragon bellowed ferociously, facing off against two Demon Gods alone, every move unleashing terrifying power that pushed against Heaven and Earth, shaking the world.
However, the fighting prowess of Diorus’ two Demon Gods was equally terrifying, and once on guard, the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t find opportunities to exchange blows and heavily injure one of them.
While working together, the two Demon Gods consciously controlled the range of the battle, preventing the Destruction Emperor Dragon from using the aftermath to destroy other Demon King’s Cities.
As the two sides’ fierce battle continued, with the Life Origin rapidly burning and consumed, white strands gradually appeared interspersed within Jack Clark’s black hair. Surrounded by burning golden flames, his aura might seem strong and vigorous but gave an inexplicably empty feeling.
Yi ya yi ya!? Watching the Life Origin be crazily exhausted, and Jack Clark, who was becoming more and more “weakened,” the Purple little dragon blinked its eyes, its mouth opening slightly.
Feeling a kinship with Jack Clark like that with its brother, the Purple little dragon prepared to nurse him back to health.
But just then, Jack Clark suddenly winked at the Purple little dragon and whispered, his voice reaching its ears, “May, don’t spray the Air of Creation just yet.”
The Purple little dragon paused, then showed confusion in its eyes: Yi ya yi ya!? How do you know that the great May is called Misss Joseline?
To the Purple little dragon’s question, Jack Clark just ‘weakly’ smiled and didn’t answer; otherwise, it might be troublesome if the little one accidentally revealed more one day.
But soon after, Jack Clark’s expression turned solemn, his eyes showing hesitation.
Regarding the two Demon God Powerhouses of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, Jack Clark had inquired and knew their realm was at the mid period of Ancient Titans.
Originally, his plan was to delve deep into the Purgatory Empire and lure back a Demon God Level Powerhouse. At that point, the Destruction Emperor Dragon at its Limit Breakthrough had a great chance to heavily injure them.
And even if they could not heavily injure the enemy, he would still be able to retreat safely, achieving the first goal of alleviating the pressure on the frontline.
But unexpectedly, to confront him, a Mythical-level genius, two Demon Gods returned, and even with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s full strength Burst, they could only maintain a stalemate.
Even burning his Life Origin, he couldn’t find an opportunity as long as the opponents were prepared.
Just as Jack Clark took a deep breath, prepared to give up, suddenly the ‘world’s’ time slowed down, and a transparent river faintly emerged between heaven and earth.
A Giant Dragon, thirty kilometers long, stood upon this river of time.
This Giant Dragon was pure white, with scale armor transparent like crystal, extraordinarily ornate; the power of Time Rule enveloped it, allowing it to traverse past and future.
This was a Titan-level creature on the cusp of reaching Ancient Titan status and specialized in controlling the power of Time.
“Roar! Diorus, your opponent is the great Kulapavida,” a Dragon Roar seemingly from the future thundered across heaven and earth, followed by a burst of Time Power engulfing Diorus.
Boom! As the force that pierced through time erupted, Diorus and the silver Giant Beast vanished instantly, disappearing from this moment in time.
The sudden change caused Jack Clark to startle, and then the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a fierce roar, its endless blood-red lightning erupting towards the Dark Demon Dragon.
Roar! The Dark Demon Dragon issued an angry bellow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1189 - 1189 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1189: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_6 Chapter 1189: Chapter 469 Reverse Defeating the Demon God, The Sealed Jack Clark_6 Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon, engulfed in blood-colored flames, exploded with its origin power and plummeted from the sky, crashing onto the Earth with a thunderous impact.
The heavens shattered, and the Earth split open, hundreds of kilometers of land crumbled, countless clods of dirt and stones shot into the sky, flung thousands of kilometers wide, and the shockwaves killed all creatures below the mythical level in the vicinity.
Without Diorus and the World Extermination Halberd to contain it, the single Dark Demon Dragon was no match for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, especially when the latter relied on its invincible defense to exchange wounds for wounds.
Roar, roar, roar!! The two colossal destroyers of worlds frenziedly battled upon the Earth, or rather, the Dark Demon Dragon’s armor was constantly being torn apart by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Blood-red lightning struck the Destruction Emperor Dragon like ten-thousand-meter-long Thunder Dragons, coiling around the Dark Demon Dragon, madly eroding its rule True Body.
And the Dark Demon Dragon’s armored Dragon Claw slammed into the Destruction Emperor Dragon, tearing open cracks in its deep crimson scales and snapping off the mountain-peak-like sharp spikes of its Dorsal Fins.
Roar! Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was suppressing the Dark Demon Dragon, a roar came from behind – it was the Three-headed Titan Demon Dragon.
The Titan Peak Demon Dragon, which had been observing the battle, was now gathering an astonishing amount of energy in the mouths of its three dragon heads as it watched the Destruction Emperor Dragon overpower the Dark Demon Dragon.
Boom!
Just as that Demon Dragon was about to release its Breath in a long-range interference attempt against the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a Tail Blade wrapped in deep red annihilation lightning pierced through the Void, cleaving it in two with a single stroke.
At that moment, the Tail Blade swayed slightly, tracing a mysterious trajectory like a Sword Skill master, slashing hundreds of times in an instant, shattering the Three-headed Demon Dragon’s True Body.
As it shattered the Giant Beast True Body, the Blood Red Lightning coiling around the Tail Blade burst forth, breaking Space-Time, annihilating everything, and bit by bit eroding its Soul Will.
Such a brutal scene caused Tarolia, who wanted to intervene, to pause in her steps. Forget it, this was a Demon God Level battle, and it had nothing to do with her Great Demon King.
Meanwhile, Jack’s hair turned increasingly white, and the traces of Time wrapping around his left arm grew deeper.
But even so, he didn’t plan to stop, standing quietly on the head of the Red Beast, his expression chilly, like a divine statue seated in a dojo.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon that had slain the Titan Demon Dragon let out a bellow, once again lunging at the Dark Demon Dragon, and an even more ferocious battle erupted in an instant.
The entire Heaven and Earth were shattered, Abyss Flames scorched Heaven and Earth, and Destructive Red Lightning annihilated everything; the laws of this world grew even more chaotic and violent.
Boom!
Suddenly, Space-Time fractured, and Diorus returned, Halberd in hand. Some areas of its Demon God Battle Armor were broken, clearly having been in a fierce battle as well.
Roar! Just then, a Dragon Roar came from the past, enveloping Diorus with strong Time Power.
“Seeking death, truly think thou canst not cut down thou mother.” Amid the furious roars, Diorus disappeared again.
Roar!
It was then that the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, the crimson flames burning on its body soared into the sky, turning into a thousand-meter-high blood-colored blaze that burned furiously, its aura increasing tenfold.
“Have you gone mad? You’re just a beast summoned by contract,” the Dark Demon Dragon roared in rage and panic.
“The rest, about two thousand words, are being revised; please wait.”
Immediately after, half of its True Body was torn apart by the Destruction Emperor Dragon with a bang.
Under that terrifying strike that caused a vibration in the rules, a corner of its internal world collapsed, and cracks spread across half of Jack’s body.
“Human, you are doomed,” roared Carthius.
It just needed to hold on a bit longer, and this human would be exhausted to death; this human must die, his strength was too terrifying, and this frightful beast as well needed to be found through the power of the rule of karma and killed.
Being so powerful during the Early Titan stage and enemies with The Purgatory Family, it must be killed.
“I’m still all right!” Jack roared back, burning his Life Origin anew, frantically consuming it under the rules that sustained the existence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With his talent, even if only a hundred years of his Life Origin remained, it didn’t matter as long as he achieved a breakthrough to the Supreme Level within one or two years; he’d have infinite life.
As for employing the Deification Talent Unity with the Soul Talent in this place to burst forth and kill two demon gods, that wasn’t necessary; that was his trump card prepared for when his Avatar would break through to the ancient True Spirit and become a Civilization Emperor to ascend a higher level.
Boom! Just then, the world ripped apart, and the third Demon God Level being rushed over.
Jack’s face tightened immediately, “Today, I will spare you.”
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook off Carthius, and then a blood-colored Bloodstain appeared on Jack’s forehead as the power of the Supreme Hell Plane descended.
He dared not enter the Plane in front of these demon gods, for a single slap could burst the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, causing the Supreme Law to dissipate.
Thus, entering the Supreme Hell Plane coordinates and then crossing from the Hell Plane into the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane before returning to Blue Star was the safest choice.
“Darren, I said you wouldn’t escape today.”
“Diorus, your caution was indeed correct.”
As he spoke, a dazzling light shone from the hand of the Demon God arriving in the distance, like a Decree, emitting power that terrorized beyond the Demon Gods.
“Seal your link to the luck of the Human Race.”
“Seal your qualification for the Supreme Plane!”
“Seal your Supreme Law!”
“Seal your Space-Time Summoning!”
Boom, boom, boom!! With each seal descending, the exhausted Jack had no strength to resist. The Summoning mark on the back of his hand disappeared, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon left.
The Blood Sea Eye on his forehead was sealed, the connection to the Plane World was cut off, and there was still some vibration at the location on his head.

However, since the opponent had targeted him, he dared to delve deep into enemy territory, so how could he possibly not have other preparations?
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon, returning to the Chaos Turbulent Sea, roared, its feather horns on either side flashing with space, emitting terrifying spatial fluctuations.
While the space-time summoning mark on his left hand was sealed, Jack Clark’s right arm still had space inscriptions twining around it, coordinates that could allow the Destruction Emperor Dragon to tear open a temporary pathway at any time given its current strength and the presence of those coordinates.
If any Demon Gods dared follow its true body during its arrival, it would teach them what cruelty meant.
Without the cost of maintaining a summoned existence, its destruction form could last for days, which was enough to grind down those two Demon Gods.
However…
Above the Demon Domain, just as all the great forces were sealed in an instant, Jack Clark produced a teleportation forbidden weapon in his hand, crushed it, and instantly an outburst of rule strength erupted around him.

Four seals, powered by the Purgatory ancestors’ strength and one Demon God’s power of cause and effect, targeted Jack Clark’s ‘space-time summoning power,’ the plane world he had developed, the terrifying luck of the human race, and the ‘final card forbidden weapon’ that the human race would surely provide him.
But having realized that Jack Clark was an apostle of the Supreme Plane Hell and having some understanding of it, they knew these apostles had coordinates, so it instantly chose to seal the connection.
Therefore, the teleportation class forbidden weapon was not stopped.
“Human, you cannot escape.”
Boom! Diorus roared, his demonic grasp penetrating space-time, shattering the rule strength enshrouding Jack Clark with a palm strike, causing Jack Clark’s true body to crumble again, instantly vanishing into the depths of space-time.
Looking at the nearly destroyed Demon Domain, the three Demon Gods stood tall, expressions cold.
They had not expected that, even with three Demon Gods working together and holding four ancestral prohibitions, they still couldn’t keep that mid-mythical stage human monster.
The opponent had too many trump cards.
Meanwhile, the losses they suffered in this battle were also massive. Seven demon kings fell by Jack Clark’s hand, slain by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, along with a Great Demon King and a peak Titan level Demon Dragon.
The damage Jack Clark caused in this battle far exceeded that of the Frontline Battlefield, and together with the previously fallen demon kings, the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire could be said to have suffered heavy losses.
The Frontline Battlefield had been fought for over two hundred sunrises, with possibly just as many demon kings fallen during that time.

Jack Clark’s brows furrowed slightly.
At that moment, the power of time descended, and a silver butterfly once again emerged, standing firm in another space-time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1191 - 1191 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1191: Chapter 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory Ancestor, Expedition List Chapter 1191: Chapter 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory Ancestor, Expedition List “`
The space in the mythical world is extremely solid, King-level strength can only tear small cracks, and it takes Heavenly King Level strength to completely shatter it.
But what’s shattered is only the surface layer of space, behind which is a space interlayer ridden with storms, environments that can injure and cause the downfall of kings who linger long.
Continuing deeper into the space interlayer, Jack now finds himself in the Space-Time Chaos region, abound with even more intense spatial storms and time chaos.
Here, time overlaps, and only the grand accomplishment of complete Law Powers can withstand it. At the same time, this layer of chaotic Space-Time Chaos also serves as a barrier to the deeper Dark Void.
Although Heavenly King Levels can venture here, under normal conditions no one would stay, as the slightest inattention could lead to being torn apart by a Space-Time Storm or swept into unknown dangerous areas by a lesser chaos.
Including Demon God Level beings who, without the coordinates of the material world, would also become lost.
At this moment, a gigantic silver butterfly, surrounded by time, emerges within the chaos, its form hazy as if standing in a separate time period, watching over Jack Clark.
This Time Silver Butterfly is extremely cautious, having witnessed Jack’s strength comparable to that of a mid-period Ancient Titan in the ancient arena. Even now, as he is weakened to such an extent, it does not make a move.
And because the Time Silver Butterfly exists in a different time period, Jack is unable to use the Inherited War Order, so he can only continue to play dead, drifting in the Space-Time Chaos.
Or perhaps he is indeed now weak to the point of near death.
Indeed, when the two Demon Gods returned, his purpose of relieving the Frontline Battlefield pressure was achieved, and he could have turned away, not needing the struggle to this extent.
Including the information about The Purgatory Family’s strength that Tarolia revealed in an attempt to persuade him to surrender, which actually contained both truth and fabrication.
Jack Clark and the Human Race Upper Echelon are aware of the existence of Ancestors above the Demon Gods and the even more powerful other Six Great Empires.
And also, due to contact with the Heavenly Feather Clan, they have some understanding of the information on the three empires that fought against the Heavenly Feather Clan, such as the nine Demon Gods of the three major empires.
One of them is even a Great Demon King Level existence.
The so-called Great Demon King is the title of the Supreme Experts who have reached the peak of an Ancient Titan, with combat power reigning above ordinary Demon Gods and wielding the imperial treasures, their battle strength, horrific.
One of the two terrifying Demon Gods that Tarolia mentioned is likely this Great Demon King, but the other information was somewhat exaggerated.
For example, among the three Demon God Empires fighting against the Heavenly Feather Clan, apart from the empire secured by a Great Demon King, the overall strength of the other two empires is only slightly stronger than the Kaya Dark Demon Empire.
As for one empire being equivalent to the combined strength of the Kaya Dark Demon Empire and the Grita War Demon Empire, that is entirely an exaggeration.
Moreover, although The Purgatory Family has existed for one hundred thousand years, the structure of this tribe is very cruel, with all the power within the empire dominated by the Demon Gods.
By Rule Level, even a mid-period Ancient Titan killing an Early Titan could, in a dying struggle, drag the opponent to a heavy injury, causing irreversible Rule damage.
For instance, while the Destruction Emperor Dragon has already suppressed the Dark Demon Dragon in overall combat power, it still needs to burn its Origin and disregard the opponent’s attacks for a Limit Breakthrough to inflict Law damage.
It’s essentially sacrificing eight hundred of oneself to kill a thousand enemies.
In the earlier fight to exhaust an ancient creature of Early Titan level with exceedingly strong Defense, it took three days of fierce battle almost to the point of exhaustion.
Therefore, every time The Purgatory Empire fights with a powerful civilization with Supreme beings stationed, they first engage in attrition, gradually weakening the enemy, until finally joining forces to strike down and Devour the laws.
The Demon Gods will not fight to the death directly, which is the most foolish approach.
They are supreme Demon Gods, rulers who hold power over the life and death of countless Extraordinary Creatures, establishing empires with the goal of accelerating their own cultivation.
Therefore, within the Eight Great Empires, regardless of the high-end demon kings, the mid-level high-order True Demons, or the lower level strengths, the consumption is extremely astonishing.
For example, in the great battle with the Heavenly Feather Clan, the recorded number of fallen demon kings of the three empires exceeds seventy, five Great Demon Kings, and countless high-order True Demons.
Of course, the casualties of the Heavenly Feather Clan were even more tragic, from an originally powerful civilization able to compete against three empires, to now having middle and upper levels of strength even weaker than the Human Race.
Had it not been for the few Supreme Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan that relied on the forbidden area to repeatedly burn their Law Origins without care for the cost, they would have been exterminated.
Beyond this, the invincible Ancestor mentioned by Tarolia isn’t as frightening as suggested.
Because currently, the Ancestor is in hibernation, reportedly having suffered heavy injuries during a battle with a Horrific Creature tens of thousands of years ago and hasn’t yet recovered.
And The Purgatory Family also suffered heavy losses in that battle, almost facing extinction, with the current Eight Great Empires built afterward.
However, this information comes from the Heavenly Feather Clan and cannot be completely verified for truth, the Human Race Upper Echelon has not fully believed it.
Besides, the Eight Great Demon God Empires are actually eight demonized tribes, some of which are mortal enemies and would never join forces.
Were it not for that one true Purgatory True Demon Ancestor to suppress them, the eight Demon God Empires would have long since disintegrated.
Therefore, the current pressure on the Human Race is actually still within a controllable range, and even if two empires were to wage a War of Extermination, with the Human Race’s intrinsic strength, they could still hold out for a very long time.
Especially since the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield has been isolated, leaving only the ‘narrow’ Sky Curtain Battlefield, where the Human Race can utilize the Technological Weapons prepared for over a decade to great effect.
However, at present, the Human Race, in order to keep it secret and not to arouse the fear and fierce reaction of the two empires, has only shown the mid- to low-end Technological Weapons.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1192 - 1192 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1192: Chapter 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory Ancestor, Expedition List_2 Chapter 1192: Chapter 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory Ancestor, Expedition List_2 For example, rocket launchers engraved with runes, missiles, hydrogen and nuclear bombs with yields in the millions or billions, drones, unmanned mechs, sky-based battleships, and super electromagnetic guns, etc.
As for high-end strategic weapons, sky-based doomsday satellites have only been used twice; other weapons such as single death line satellites and doomsday hydrogen bombs with a yield of one billion have been sealed away.
These details were part of the information given to him by the Primordial True King when he returned after his breakthrough to king-level and swept through the Evil God Alliance, and was instructed to return to Blue Star to stand guard.
These ‘large yield’ weapons are always suspended in outer space, hence even when the Evil God Sect Cultists infiltrated Blue Star and took control of some country’s high-level officials, they could not find out about them.
This includes the Purgatory Family capturing some high-level cultivators for interrogation, and even using soul-searching secret skills could not reveal this information.
The more secrets of the Federation Jack Clark knew, the more he admired people like the First Councilor.
In such challenging conditions, they not only held off the attacks from the Purgatory Family but also secretly accumulated strength, preparing for the imminent race-annihilating battle and the Second Mythical Impact.
Originally, according to the Human Race’s think tank analysis, the battle to exterminate the race instigated by the Purgatory Family would erupt in about half a year, coinciding with the Second Mythical Impact.
But they did not anticipate it would come earlier.
As for the reason, Jack felt it was likely because of him, and though it seemed arrogant to think that way, the talent he had displayed was indeed becoming increasingly extraordinary.
In the intelligence reports of the Purgatory Family, he cultivated in the mythical world for one year, with a cultivation speed that was terrifyingly frightening and had mastered ‘four’ higher-order laws and one Supreme Law.
Such terrifying talent had indeed posed a strong threat to these Demon Gods.
One year on Blue Star is equivalent to ten sun cycles in the mythical world; to these Demon Gods, that’s like ten days.
If in just ‘ten days,’ this human managed to cultivate to the level of mythology, then what about another ten or twenty days? Wouldn’t he step into the realm of Demon Gods? By then, who could be his opponent with that kind of combat power?
That’s why Jack summoned the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, desperately burning his Life Origin to clash head-on with two Demon Gods to see if he could inflict a heavy injury on one of them and buy some time.
And failure was not an issue.
When his Life Origin was exhausted, and he ‘was defeated’ and fled, he would appear as a “cripple” in the eyes of those Demon Gods, no longer a threat.
After all, with an exhausted Life Origin and a damaged true body, it would take many years just to heal his injuries, let alone make further breakthroughs.
In this way, the opponents’ strong desire to annihilate the human race would certainly weaken, and he could quickly recover using the creation power of the Purple little dragon, ‘logging off’ for a while.
Then, just give him another one or two months’ time. After breaking through to Heavenly King level, he could take on early to mid-period Demon God Levels head-on instead of summoning Avatar Giant Beasts.
Moreover, if he could delay for even longer, once he made a secret breakthrough to Supreme Level, with the power he wielded, he could suppress all Demon Gods and sweep through everything.
However, he did not expect to nearly “mess up,” despite having so many trump cards, and even almost capsize the ship.
Unexpectedly, another Demon God descended, releasing four terrifying seals.
That power, surpassing the level of Demon Gods, directly sealed his Space-Time Summoning Technique, Supreme Law, and Eye of Prison, severing his luck.
As for luck, Jack didn’t care, because he was very clear that what he had relied on to get to this point was not luck.
After all, if luck was really so useful, everyone could just compare who has better luck when meeting and not bother cultivating so hard, just waiting for their strength to grow on its own.
He also didn’t care about being targeted by Eye of Prison, because that power came from a Supreme Plane.
At this moment, Jack felt a twisted ‘Seal’ rune slowly rotating on his forehead, suppressing the Eye of Prison in the forehead of his Demon-God Facade.
But right now, beneath that Seal rune, it was gradually turning red, eroded by the contract power contained in the Eye of Prison; at this rate, it was expected to be destroyed in just over a month.
The ancestor of the Purgatory Family was only at the level of an ancient True Spirit, which is worlds apart from the Supreme Hell Plane that spans countless worlds and covers innumerable space-times.
On the other hand, the sealing of the Space-Time Summoning Technique and the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane was somewhat troublesome for Jack.
“It seems that when I get back, I’ll have to bother First Councilor to grind away the seals,” Jack thought weakly, knowing that only the power of law could erase a rule-formed seal.
Although these four seals came from an ancient True Spirit level existence, they were just strands of the power of law, so the First Councilor should have no problem erasing them.
It’s just that the consumption might be somewhat significant, and it will take time.
While Jack was floating in the Space-Time Chaos, waiting for the Time Silver Butterfly to make a move,
above the Sky Curtain Battlefield, ten thousand kilometers away, three figures appeared.
The frontline battle had been over for half a day, and on the vast battlefield, countless soldiers from both sides were cleaning up.
Adam Garcetti looked toward the direction of the Purgatory Family base and slowly said, “I just felt that Jack used the Heaven Divine Shadow Talisman, but he has not returned.”
“When I crafted the Heaven Divine Shadow Talisman, the teleportation point was set at the Sky Curtain base,”
Suddenly, the Sky-based God King’s expression turned solemn, “With Jack’s current strength, forcing him to use a forbidden weapon to teleport, it must be a Peak Awakened Great Demon King, or even a Demon God Level.”
“But didn’t he discuss with us before he left that he would only cause chaos in the Purgatory Family’s rear and then leave as soon as he received the news of the Purgatory Family army’s retreat at the frontline?”
The True Martial Heavenly King forced a smile, “It’s quite obvious that this kid didn’t heed our advice and didn’t evacuate in time, or maybe something went wrong in between.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1193 - 1193 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1193: Chapter 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory Ancestor, Expedition List_3 Chapter 1193: Chapter 670 The Severely Injured Purgatory Ancestor, Expedition List_3 “The Purgatory Family army began to retreat ahead, and as three Demon God level powerhouses with the power of rules tore through the battlefield, we took action and entangled them for half a day,”
“From the time our inside informer sent a message to Jack Clark to the time he used the Heaven Divine Shadow Talisman, a day had elapsed, which would have been enough time for him to stealthily leave.”
Upon reaching this point, the True Martial Heavenly King paused, a bitter smile appearing on the faces of all three.
Obviously, the young fellow had not acted according to plan; after all, being an extraordinary monster who looked down upon an era, it was normal for him to have his own ideas or for some unforeseen incident to have made him change his plans.
“However, it is just as well that though he hasn’t teleported directly back, his soul breath is stable, he should be fine.”
The towering True Martial Stone Tablet stood erect behind the True Martial Heavenly King, emitting a terrifying aura that suppressed space-time, within which a thread of soul breath slowly rotated.
As the host of this thread of soul breath, should Jack Clark fall, his soul breath would also dissipate.
Adam Garcetti slowly nodded: “Now that the great war has ended, next up is discussing the affairs of the Heavenly Feather Clan, including the naming of those dispatched to support the expedition.”
At these words, the True Martial Heavenly King’s brows slightly furrowed: “The reaction from the Purgatory Family in this war has been rather intense, would it not be a great pressure if I were to leave here?”
Adam Garcetti spoke at a deliberate pace, “Rest assured, this battlefield is limited in space, and with half this world refined by me, within these rules, I am enough to withstand two Demon Gods of the same rank.”
“Additionally, with the support of the Sky-based, and with a Primordial ready to descend from the rear at any moment, even if the two great empires exhaust all their might, they could not breach it in a short period.”
As they spoke, the three gazed into the distance.
Above the base of the Purgatory Family, at the far end of the sky, stood two Demon God level existences, their gazes traversing the vast distance in confrontation with them.
The Sky Curtain Battlefield, between them, spanning over ten thousand kilometers wide and thirty thousand kilometers long, irregularly shaped, was enveloped by an invisible power of rules, splitting the field into two from the center.
These rules connected to the terrifying forbidden areas of emptiness on both sides, controlled by Adam Garcetti and another powerful Demon God, clashing against each other every moment.
This scene was much like the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield– at that time, the Sky-based God King and Diorus also confronted each other constantly.
Because the world was refined, the might of the Supreme Experts who held sway over this world was extremely terrifying and could tear apart the land over ten thousand kilometers wide, hurling it into the air.
It was almost equivalent to rending Blue Star into two halves.
And it’s not just this battlefield; the atmosphere in the human territory is also permeated by the powerful rules of three Supreme council members.
This is also the reason why no Demon God level powerhouse has infiltrated the Human Territory.
If a Demon God were to come, they would be suppressed by the joint efforts of the three Supreme Experts instantly. Besides, beneath the world refined by the rules, the speed of support is also terrifyingly fast.
For instance, between the Outer Development Department and the Frontline Battlefield, a distance of thirty to forty thousand kilometers, they can rapidly descend following the force of the rules, defending this ‘small’ Territory as solid as a rock.
“By the way, Blues earlier said he has infiltrated the high ranks of the Assassination Department and is now sent back for ‘further training’ to Purify his Bloodline and make a breakthrough into the Ninth Heavens.”
“I will have him probe into Jack Clark’s situation…”
…
In the depths of the Space-Time Chaos, sensing that Jack Clark’s aura was getting weaker, the Time Being finally could not hold back anymore.
Boom!
The Space-Time Chaos vibrated, and within the transparent river, a silver butterfly with wings spanning over three thousand meters, surrounded by countless golden light spots, descended majestically, exuding grandeur and authority.
On it, the Power of Time diffused formlessly, suppressing everything. Even the violent Space-Time Chaos settled down slowly, forming a stable zone of ten kilometers radius.
And Jack Clark was right on the edge of this stable space-time zone.
The Time Silver Butterfly’s enormous compound eyes rested on Jack Clark, particularly on the transparent trace entangling his left side, revealing a trace of excitement in its gaze.
With a slight flutter of its massive wings, the Time Silver Butterfly appeared above Jack Clark’s head, resembling a towering silver mountain range, filled with a sense of oppression.
At that moment, the Time Silver Butterfly’s large and ferocious mouth opened slightly, like a black hole hundreds of meters wide, unleashing an astonishing suction force that enveloped Jack Clark.
Boom! Under the terrifying suction force that seemed to swallow everything, the surrounding fragments of space-time rose up like a multicolored tornado, Jack Clark included within it.
But just as the Time Silver Butterfly was about to swallow Jack Clark whole, in an instant, a fearful Battle Intent that pierced heaven and earth surged up, and the aura skyrocketed.
Boom! Eruptions of blood light burst from Jack Clark’s body as the Doomsday Domain unfurled, dyeing tens of kilometers around in a blood-red hue.
In the Doomsday Domain, Jack Clark slowly stood up, appearing extremely weak yet conveying an illusion of immense power, making it seem as if he were even stronger than in his prime.
The gift of Prison Blood War Intent activated passively, Death Invincibility.
When seriously injured in combat causing a sharp drop in Qi Blood, the Invincible Intent activates, the greater the injury and Qi Blood loss, the stronger the Battle Intent becomes.
At this moment, Jack Clark was hanging on by a thread, his True Body’s Qi Blood drained, his life nearly exhausted. Under such conditions, the enhancement provided to Jack Clark was terrifyingly potent.
The mighty, brutal aura shook time and space, causing even the Time Silver Butterfly at its Titan mid phase to feel a potent threat.
Whir!
The Time Silver Butterfly let out an indignant buzzing, its wings vibrating, the surrounding golden light spots emitting dazzling radiance, ready to harness the Power of Time to flee.
But at that moment, a Golden War Order appeared in Jack Clark’s hand, radiating blinding golden light.
Boom, boom, boom! The Golden War Order split into seven, transforming into seven vast golden phantoms a thousand meters high, descending and spreading powerful forces that sealed off all directions.
Under the Rule of the ancient Human Race Expert, the Power of Time around the Time Silver Butterfly instantly dissipated, along with the golden light spots encircling it.
Suddenly, the aura of the Time Silver Butterfly plummeted from a peak mighty enough to rival the Lava Titans, down to the level of a common Titan Beast.
As the situation rapidly shifted, within the Blood Sea Doomsday, Jack Clark, holding a War Halberd, stood
Whir! This timid Titan creature let out another indignant buzz.

chapters.title: Chapter 1194 - 1194 Emperor 671 Jack Clarks Death Human Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1194: Emperor Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken Chapter 1194: Emperor Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken The Power of Intent is formed by the integration of a cultivator’s soul, will, mind, and enlightenment towards heaven and earth; peak strong men can even shake heaven and earth with their Battle Intent alone.
For example, War King Elmore Hall’s ‘Heaven Suppressing’ Fist Intent is unrivaled and domineering, integrating into the law itself to strike heavenward, reversing the Great Demon King with the peak strength of a king-level warrior.
Jack Clark’s Battle Intent is relatively special, it is the understanding touched upon while slaughtering countless Mutated Beasts under the Blood Moon, when his halberd technique reached its peak amidst the slaughter.
He later mistook it for undefeatable war intent and walked the Road of Invincibility, overpowering peers of the same realm, consolidating an invincible conviction.
Therefore, his Battle Intent contains both the traits of slaughter and invincibility; the more enemies he cuts down, the stronger his Battle Intent becomes, and every time he kills an enemy of a higher Major Realm, it further reinforces his invincible conviction.
Complemented by each other, Jack Clark’s Battle Intent is actually very powerful, not inferior to those veteran kings, it was just not perceptible usually when in sync with the Sea of Blood Doomsday Domain.
Now, under the intent of a desperate battle, Jack’s broken True Body seemed to reverse time, bursting with terrifying power.
Boom!
Surrounded by a towering blood light a hundred meters tall, Jack is like a Hell Demon God, his War Halberd sweeping across the sky and creating a blood-colored Halberd Skill a kilometer long that shot into the heavens.
Under the purely immense and unmatched power, the time-space chaos stirred up by the Time Silver Butterfly’s devouring suction instantly collapsed.
Whir! The Time Silver Butterfly let out a cry of shocked and angry buzzing.
Even though its time power and talent were sealed, it was still a powerful Titan-level creature, possessing a robust True Body and strength.
Splurt!
The butterfly’s two kilometer-long, spear-like silver front legs shot out, their immense force compressing the Void into substance, creating rolling silver shockwaves.
Boom! The overbearing and unbeatable blood-colored halberd edge exploded instantly, demolishing the butterfly’s long legs and repelling it forcefully with the burst of strength.
In the instant that Jack destroyed the butterfly’s front legs, his feet detonated the Void beneath him, and he became a streak of red light, tearing through the raging turbulence to appear before the Time Silver Butterfly.
Jack raised his War Halberd high overhead, bringing it down in a powerful strike reminiscent of cutting through Mount Hua, immediately causing the Halberd Skill to swell into a two-kilometer-long blood-colored blade edge.
This scene seemed like the reappearance of Opening the Heavens, the force of it invisibly tearing through space and time, the sharpness emitted causing the Time Silver Butterfly to feel a chilly sense creeping up from its tail.
The Time Silver Butterfly instinctively brought its wings together in defense, its silver scales emitting resplendent radiance, forming a hundred-meter-thick Energy Shield, resembling a silver metallic sphere.
Boom! Under the world-opening blow of the blood-colored halberd blade, a ring of glittering silver and blood-colored light exploded, the intense force shaking the time-space chaos within a hundred-kilometer radius.
The razor-sharp edge directly tore the silver butterfly apart, shattering the silver scales, ripping through them effortlessly, creating two vast cracks that nearly severed it.
Whir! In pain, the Time Silver Butterfly screamed painfully, all its strength bursting forth, forming a dazzling silver halo that swelled like a tsunami.
Bang!
The intense pure energy impact sent Jack flying tens of kilometers back, the invisible Absolute Barrier surrounding him shaking, exploding with energy radiance.
Butterfly creatures are too weak in True Body Strength, even a Titan mid-period being is equivalent only to an Early Titan scale-armored Giant Beast.
Boosted by fearsome Battle Intent, his physical strength stronger than at his peak, Jack was simply no match for the creature, sustaining serious injury in an instant engagement.
After releasing all it energy to repel Jack, the Time Silver Butterfly vibrated its tattered wings, transforming into a streak of silver light that shot toward the distance, plunging into the space-time chaos.
Bang! Suddenly, chaos surged, and in the blink of an eye, the Time Silver Butterfly appeared hundreds of kilometers away, its form vanishing into the depths of the multicolored space-time chaos.
Even in the space-time chaos imbued with the Power of Time, the speed of the butterfly, although its talents and Law Power were sealed, was still terrifyingly fast.
Bang! In the instant when the Time Silver Butterfly fled, Jack’s feet shattered the Void, turning into a streak of blood-colored light that shot out, bursting with horrifying speed.
Having exhausted his Divine Power and Divine Soul’s strength, unable to deploy Law Power, Jack’s powers of strength, Defense, and speed, his three Great Divine Powers, were not affected.
Boom!
The blood-light enshrouded Jack like the Demon God of World-Destroying, tearing through the space-time chaos, appearing above the Time Silver Butterfly in a blink, his Halberd Skill swelling enormously.
Whir! Below, the Time Silver Butterfly let out an enraged bellow, suddenly looking up, its mouth wide open as a terrifying wave of sonic disruption burst forth.
The sound waves from the Titan-level creature were like tangible torrents, instantly swallowing up Jack, the powerful shockwave blasting against the Absolute Barrier that surrounded him with a thunderous reverberation.
In the explosion of violent sound waves, Jack stood holding his halberd, his body erupting with incomparably dominant power, the surrounding blood light converting into a blood-red Sea of Blood Doomsday World.
The Great Divine Power, Supreme Vacuum, gathered all of Jack’s strength in a single strike, shaking the surrounding space-time, the invisible Destructive Aura terrifying the Time Silver Butterfly.
Boom! The Sea of Blood World exploded, the Time Silver Butterfly wailed.
Under the annihilating strike, the butterfly’s wings shattered, its flesh burst open, and myriad pieces of flesh and blood, mixed with shockwaves, scattered in all directions, filling the air with a thick, scorching scent of blood.
Instantly, the aura of the Time Being weakened.
Under normal conditions, a mid-period Titan being wielding the Power of Time could easily rival a Titan Peak in combat prowess, and even at Jack’s full strength, they might match each other at most.
The original plan for Jack was to lure it out, then invoke the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s arrival, to tear and devour it with absolute force.
But now, although the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill was sealed, under the seal placed by the Ancient Human Race’s Inherited War Order, the silver butterfly’s strength plummeted, and Jack could easily overpower it with just his natural combat strength.
