﻿Chapter 1195: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_2 Chapter 1195: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_2 “`
Buzz! Suffering a heavy injury, the Titan creature, realizing it could not escape today, had its fighting spirit ignited and let out a tyrannical roar.
With its forelimbs already regrown, the six massive silver legs, like columns of mountains, stirred the space-time chaos and overwhelmingly submerged Jack Clark.
Boom!
The halberd skill burst forth from the War Halberd in Jack’s hands, sweeping all directions, instantly exploding into a ring of red light, a kilometer high, that shattered everything in its path.
Bang! Bang! Bang!! Under the edge sharpened by the power of Opening the Heavens, the six massive legs of the Time Silver Butterfly were directly minced, followed by the explosive expansion of the light circle to five kilometers.
The violent explosion blasted tens of kilometers, and the sharp and fragmented halberd skill tore through the void, leaving huge wounds on the Time Silver Butterfly.
In the midst of the explosion, Jack took a step out and appeared above the Time Silver Butterfly’s head in an instant, where endless blood light condensed on his two-hundred-meter-long War Halberd, emanating a heavy and terrifying aura.
Boom! With one full-strength strike of his halberd, the head of the Time Silver Butterfly collapsed, its blood and fluids splattering everywhere, emitting a strong stench of blood.
However, the soul of a Titan-level creature was already fused with the Giant Beast Body and it would take more than smashing its head to kill it, given its strong vitality.
Unable to unleash Law Power to erode the opposing Soul Will, Jack could only use pure strength to blast apart its Giant Beast Body, destroying everything.
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
Under that incomparably sharp and heavy War Halberd, the Time Silver Butterfly’s flesh continuously crumbled, each blow tearing apart wounds hundreds to thousands of kilometers long.
This battle lasted nearly half an hour before it gradually subsided.
Giant chunks of silver corpse were sinking and floating within the violent space-time chaos, spreading over an area of tens of kilometers, as the broken silver wings emitted a faint silver glow in the turbulent flow.
Among these remnants of gigantic beasts, Jack Clark, standing a hundred meters tall, approached with his halberd, his black hair extending dozens of meters behind him, fluttering without wind, and his dragon horns majestic, exuding a terrifying killing aura.
At the same time, the Sea of Blood Doomsday Domain centered on Jack covered a thirty-kilometer radius, enveloping the Titan remains to prevent them from being swept away by the space-time chaos.
But at this moment, Jack didn’t have the time to collect the remains of the giant beast. His expression was cold as he looked into the distance, where a pure white Giant Dragon, three thousand meters in length, emerged.
It was the very Time Dragon that, during his battle with the two Demon Gods, had taken Diorus away.
The Time Dragon growled softly, “Roar! Unknown being, the great Kulapavida is not your enemy. In fact, Kulapavida helped you before.”
Jack nodded slowly, his voice resonating with will that shook space-time, “If we are not enemies, then what brings you here this time?”
The Time Dragon growled, “The great Kulapavida has been injured in his efforts to assist you and requires the Crystal Core of this Time Silver Butterfly to recover.”
With that, the Time Dragon’s gaze fell on the space-time chaos not far away.
Within the silver butterfly corpse, about a hundred meters in size, a silver crystal the size of a water tank emitted faint time power.
At the same time, the white dragon slightly lifted its left wing, revealing a three-hundred-meter-long wound beneath it, the flesh turned inside out and the edges wrapped with black Rule Power.
“No, I need this Crystal Core as well,” Jack replied decisively.
If the Time Dragon had asked for a portion of the Time Silver Butterfly’s flesh and blood, Jack might have considered it, given its ‘helpful’ role in the past.
But without knowing whether the Time Silver Butterfly’s corpse could be refined into essence or whether time runes could be comprehended from it, there was no way he would hand over the core Crystal Core of the giant beast.
Instantly, the Time Dragon’s pupils narrowed, and a dangerous aura appeared in its eyes.
With its strength, faced with Jack who had lost the ability to summon giant beast abilities, the Time Dragon had an absolute advantage, especially since its opponent was now extremely weakened and barely sustaining himself on special Battle Intent.
However, when the Time Dragon’s eyes swept over the Golden War Order floating beside Jack, it showed strong apprehension.
The Rule contained within that order was very powerful, surpassing the Ancient Titan level, capable of sealing any creature’s talent and Law Power.
If the human used the order to seal it, relying solely on the Giant Beast Body might not guarantee a victory, specially if the seal proved to be permanent…
While the Time Dragon hesitated on whether to act, Jack suddenly probed, “Do you know Princess Adriana?”
The Time Dragon roared reflexively, “Roar! How do you know the name of Kulapavida’s ‘wife’?”
Indeed, it was Scythia’s father. A look of surprise crossed Jack’s eyes, yet it all made sense.
Beings with Time Power are incredibly rare, with countless Mutated Creatures in both the Blue Star Ocean and on land, only the Candle Dragon had emerged under such conditions.
And among those creatures, a Dragon-type was even rarer – the only one he knew was Scythia’s father, who had been driven away by its mother many years ago.
Of course, the possibility that Scythia’s father was stronger than its mother and was of the Ancient Titan level didn’t exist, because if that were the case, he wouldn’t have been defeated by the Blue-White Giant Dragon.
“`

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1196: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_3 Chapter 1196: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_3 Jack Clark slowly opened his mouth, “You’ve seen my Contract Beast partner, it just so happens that it knows Princess Adriana and is good friends with Scythia.”
“Scythia once told Thunderflame that her father is a Giant Dragon who mastered the Power of Time, it’s quite a coincidence.”
“Scythia, has my daughter been born?” The Time Dragon asked with some excitement in its gaze.
Due to their bloodline inheritance, when the Blue-White Giant Dragon laid the Dragon Egg, the Time Dragon had already named Scythia.
At the same time, the Time Dragon was also surprised, it had not expected the Giant Beast that could enter Destruction Form to actually be Scythia’s friend.
Since they were ‘acquainted’, the tense atmosphere between the parties eased slightly, and Jack’s face revealed a faint smile.
“Scythia is doing well now, she has made a mythical breakthrough and has joined forces with my Contract partner to establish the Beast Empire known as the Dragon Palace.”
“Currently, they are located in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, preparing to sweep the surroundings. Moreover, Princess Adriana is doing well too, currently in the final stage of breaking through to the Ancient Titan level.”
Hearing that his wife and daughter were well, the Time Dragon’s gaze softened, and the corners of its menacing mouth curled up slightly, revealing a ‘smile’.
The Time Dragon growled lowly, “I had no idea your Contract partner and Scythia were friends, then we are all one of the dragon kind. You should devour the Crystal Core of this Time Being.”
“Your current situation is not good, you have been stricken with a Time curse, and absorbing the Crystal Core of this Time Being can temporarily suppress the speed of the curse.”
“Curse, are you referring to these marks of Time erosion on my body?” Jack frowned.
The Time Dragon nodded slowly, “Correct, that Summoning Altar of yours is mysterious indeed; it can actually cross Infinite spacetime to forcefully summon a creature from another set of coordinates.”
“According to the rule of equivalent exchange, summoning that Giant Beast requires the consumption of your energy, and once you run out of energy, the Giant Beast would depart.”
“But in your desire to keep that Giant Beast for an extended period, you repeatedly broke the Summoning Altar’s rule, hence you were afflicted with a curse from Time.”
“Every time you break the Summoning rule, it deepens Time’s erosion on you, drawing attacks from beings that feed on the Power of Time, such as that Time Silver Butterfly.”
“Besides, due to the deep erosion, even if your enormous strength fends off those Time Being attacks, you will ultimately transform into a Time Being under the curse.”
“Is this what they call the Time curse?” Jack paused, thinking it was some terrifying, certain-death curse, but it turned out to be just this.
Turning into a Time Being was the very goal the Giant Beast Candle Dragon had been pursuing after all.
“Becoming a Time Being, touching upon the Time Laws, and wandering through time sounds quite powerful, so why is it considered a curse?” Jack wondered.
The Time Dragon shook its head slowly, its growling voice shaking space-time.
“The passive transformation into a Time Being is different from beings like us with Innate talents to control the Power of Time. We can roam the edge of Time, but you will be imprisoned by Time forever.”
“Eventually, you will not exist in the past, nor in the present, you will forever disappear from the Material World, with no future.” As it spoke, awe appeared in the eyes of the Time Dragon.
“Time is an undefined ‘force’; even we who possess the Time Laws Innately are merely struggling within Time.”
“The more powerful the Time Being, the stronger the repulsion from the Material World’s rules it feels, and it cannot remain in the Material World for long.” The Time Dragon sounded somewhat melancholic.
Forever bound by Time.
Jack’s expression immediately became serious, as he hadn’t anticipated that this was the backlash from the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill. No wonder Gentry Gail had been urging him not to overuse his Burst earlier.
Clearly, Gentry Gail had sensed the flaw in the secret skill, although he probably didn’t know about the Time erosion.
Suppressing countless thoughts in his heart, Jack ‘curiously’ said, “So, you weren’t driven away by Princess Adriana?”
He was preparing to cozy up to this Time Dragon, to draw closer and see if it had a way to cure the curse.
At these words, an odd look flashed through the Time Dragon’s eyes, “Of course not. I am the powerful Giant Dragon that can halt local Time, peerless within the same rank.”
“It’s only because the Power of Time in me grew stronger, to avoid affecting Adriana and the newly born Scythia, I chose to leave in the end.”
“Calculating the time I have roamed the edge of Time is unclear— a thousand years, ten thousand, or just one year; and this is the terror of Time.”
“Not being able to feel the passage of Time is a truly terrifying thing.”
“Next, I can only wait until I break through to the Ancient Titan level, condense the Time Rule, and contain the Time Power within my body so as not to affect the outside world, then I can enter the Material World.”
“I see.”
Jack nodded, then suddenly asked, “Prince Kulapavida, do you know how to erase this curse on me?”
The Time Dragon’s eyes revealed a solemnity as it growled slowly, “It’s difficult. The curse on you is pure Time Power, fused with your True Body and soul.”
“To remove it, you must either be devoured by another Time Being or find a way on your own to comprehend the Power of Time and refine and master it.”
Instantly, Jack frowned; comprehending the Power of Time was no simple task.
He too had tried sensing the Time Power eroding his body and touching upon the Time Laws, but to his perception, those traces seemed as if they didn’t exist at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1197 - 1197 671 Jack Clarks Death Human Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1197: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_4 Chapter 1197: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_4 Imperceptible, unfathomable.
“Perhaps due to Scythia’s influence, the Time Dragon helped Jack Clark think things over and slowly gave a low growl, “For beings like you, who have not awakened the Talent of Time, trying to touch time is indeed difficult.”
“However, there is another way.”
“What way?” Jack Clark asked subconsciously.
“Leave everything to the guidance of time,” the Time Dragon growled.
“The Summoning Secret Skill you have mastered seems to involve a power system connected to time, but it’s incomplete and not enough to let you touch time.”
“Fortunately, we are in an Area of Space-Time Chaos, where time is disorderly and active. You could try to use the Time Power within the crystal core; perhaps ‘time’ will give you guidance.”
“But I must warn you, this method is very dangerous, and you may become forever lost in another space-time, unable to return.”
“Is that so.” Jack Clark pondered briefly before deciding to give it a try.
He had the coordinates to Hell, and the Gateway to Heaven entrance at the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane was bound to the Blue Star World. Once the seal was broken, he could return at any time.
Even if he were lost in an unknown space-time, the same held true.
With this in mind, the blood light that permeated Clark’s surroundings retracted, sweeping the main body of the Time Silver Butterfly Giant Beast back into his Storage Space, including that crystal core.
Grasping the tremendous Time Crystal Core, Jack Clark’s powerful Divine Soul Intent surged in…
“Wait, I haven’t left yet, no, how did you trigger the explosion already…”
Boom!
The transparent crystal core in Jack Clark’s hand exploded, a dazzling silver halo burst forth, sweeping hundreds of kilometers, as the dense Time Power blast created a Time Storm.
“No!” Amid the screams, the Time Dragon and Jack Clark vanished instantly in the Time Chaos, leaving behind the roaring Space-Time Chaos that shook the Void.
More than an hour after Jack Clark disappeared, two terrifying presences arrived. At once, the Space-Time Chaos became even more violent, radiating brilliant, multicolored rays.
Within the fierce chaotic currents stood a ten-meter-tall Demon God, dressed in a grand golden robe, with bronze skin devoid of scales, and a pair of curved Demon Horns on his head.
In this Demon God’s hand, a one-meter-tall black candle shone, emitting invisible waves in concentric circles, like a radar searching for something.
After a while, the Demon God spoke softly with a deep voice, “A Grand Demon King Level battle has taken place here, leaving some power traces within the Space-Time Chaos.”
“One of the forces is mixed with a strong aura of Killing Intent, similar to that human’s energy signature, while the other is a Titan Level Giant Beast’s fluctuation.”
“Apart from that, in the filament of the lamp, I see the outbreak of a Time Storm that devoured everything in this Space-Time Chaos.”
“I surmise that the human, having fled here, must have encountered a Titan Level Giant Beast and had no choice but to engage in a fierce battle with his broken True Body, getting swept up by the Time Storm in the process.”
Diorus’s face, indifferent and majestic, revealed a sly smile, “It seems that cutting off his link with the Human Race’s Luck has been effective.”
“Without the boost of the Human Race’s Luck, his fortune has hit rock bottom. He should be dead this time.”
“And even if by some fluke he’s not dead, given his injuries, he who has disappeared into another space-time will never be able to return, posing no threat to us anymore.”
Although he had only made contact with Jack Clark twice, Diorus was extremely wary of him.
So even though Clark’s True Body was broken and his Life Origin spent, and he had fallen into Space-Time Chaos, Diorus was still not at ease, thus he and the Demon God came in pursuit, relying on Rule treasures.
Now, having confirmed that he had not been taken away by Supreme Human Experts, and that in his heavily injured and dying state he encountered a Titan creature and was swept into a Time Storm, Diorus finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Diorus smiled slightly, “It’s good that you came from the Ancestral Demon God on short notice, Levides; otherwise, that human would definitely have escaped under the interference of the Time Dragon.”
The Demon God in the golden robe said indifferently, “All is for the Ancestor.”
Previously, Diorus and Carthius did not rush back to the empire after retreating from the Frontline Battlefield; instead, they visited the Ancestral home of The Purgatory Family millions of kilometers away.
The place wasn’t expansive nor part of the Eight Great Empires; it was the Hibernation site of the Purgatory True Demons’ Ancestor, guarded by powerful demon kings and Demon Gods.
After explaining the threat of ‘Jack Clark’ to the priests guarding the Ancestral home, they were instructed to leave first, and then a Demon God was dispatched with four Ancestral Decrees to assist them.
As for the Frontline Battlefield, it was still guarded by two War Demons from the Grita War Demon Empire, to prevent any Human interference.
After all, for dealing with a Human Clan Genius at the Legendary Realm, the personal arrival of two Imperial Demon Gods was already a considerable emphasis, and the addition of the Ancestral Demon God was quite extravagant.
If they were still anxious and continued to call for more Demon Gods for a collective attack, it would become a laughingstock among the entire Purgatory Family.
…
“Brudos, that human is dead, that human named Darren Callum is dead.”
In the border city of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, an excited Split True Demon pushed open the courtyard gate and looked at Brudos, who was stepping out the door, with an excited expression.
“That human Darren Callum is dead!?” Brudos frowned slightly, seeming to doubt the news.
The exultant Split True Demon nodded emphatically, “Yes, he’s dead. It is said that it took three Demon Gods to kill him. Brudos, you were wise; such an entity is not ours to fathom.”
“But that human had a lot of nerve; after being discovered, instead of fleeing from the border, he ventured further into the empire to the Southern demon city in the Demon Domain.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1198 - 1198 671 Jack Clarks Death Human Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1198: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_5 Chapter 1198: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_5 “I heard that half of the Demon Domain was destroyed in this battle, with over two million casualties among the Purgatory Nobles. The Earth was flattened for ten thousand kilometers around, and the losses were disastrous.”
“In addition to that, the guardian of the Demon Domain, a Titan Peak Demon Dragon named Kukutera, was killed by a Red Beast summoned by that human.”
“Terrifying, isn’t it? That human’s realm is only at the Mid-Mythical Stage, yet he was able to fight against the Demon God himself and required the cooperation of three deities just to suppress him.”
“It is said that even our great Prince Carthius suffered significant injuries in this battle and returned to the Eastern Demon Domain for closed-door cultivation immediately after it ended.”
“It’s a good thing that human is already dead; otherwise, with continued growth, he would certainly become a major enemy of our Purgatory tribe in the future,” said the Split True Demon with a palpable sense of alarm.
It was unimaginable for someone of the human race to be this powerful. The feat of slaying the Great Demon King Erbore at the Legendary Realm was already exaggerated enough, but to think he could even confront the Demon God directly.”
These words stunned Brudos, who then narrowed his eyes slightly. “Yes, it’s good that he’s already dead.”
The entire Kaya Dark Demon Empire was shaken by this news because it came from within the empire’s Demon Domain, as well as from surrounding Demon Kings and high-order True Demons who had witnessed the great battle.
The release of this news by Diorus was meant to stabilize the morale of the troops, informing all True Demons and Vassal Alien Races that the invading human who had been troubling their rear had been killed.”
But the effect of this news was somewhat the opposite.
Now, many Purgatory True Demons and strong members of the Vassal Races who had never been to the frontline were beginning to fear humans.
They had not imagined that the humans who had been at war with the empire for over two hundred Sun Wheels could be so terrifying, especially a human at the Legendary Realm.
How powerful then were the human experts at the frontline?
No wonder their empire had been unable to defeat the humans, despite joining forces with the Grita War Demon Empire and besieging them for so long. And with each Sun Wheel, they were continuously rallying more troops for reinforcement.
As Brudos pondered this news, a black radiance streaked across the sky, followed by the descent of a True Demon Aura at the peak of the Nine Demonic Marks.
“Greetings, my lord.” Faced with the arrival of a quasi-mythical True Demon, both Brudos and the Split True Demon bowed respectfully.
The True Demon with bat wings behind him nodded slightly. “You are all here—good. Because of the invasion by that human, the empire has suffered significant damage.”
“The Emperor has now decreed that the Empire’s treasury will open its top-level Divine Items to cultivate potential among the True Demon Nobles. I have already submitted your names.”
“Thank you for your support, my lord,” Brudos said with a look of ‘gratitude,’ bowing quickly, and the Split True Demon was also very excited.
The quasi-mythical True Demon nodded in satisfaction: “If you are lucky this time and the Emperor takes notice of you, you will have the chance to ascend overnight and receive a large allocation of resources.”
“You may even be granted Laws’ Origin and other Law Divine Artifacts, breaking through the Nine Demonic Marks, and perhaps even achieving Demon King level strength in a short time.”
“Now, go and prepare yourselves. Gather at the city gates in a Star Hour, and accompany me to the Demon Domain to meet with the Demon God.”
“Yes.”
After an excited Split True Demon left, Brudos returned to his room, activated the demon-suppressing array, and took out a palm-sized black stele from his Storage Space.
In the vast mythical world, communication methods vary, and the stele in Brudos’s hands came from the True Martial Heavenly King’s own True Martial Monument.
By activating the stele and inscribing words on it, the True Martial Heavenly King would receive a reflected image of the message. Although it couldn’t transmit sound or images, it was energy-wave free and very covert.
With a grave expression, Brudos extended his finger and concentrated his Spiritual Will, writing down all the information he knew.
However, at the conclusion, he only mentioned that Jack Clark’s current status was unknown and the news should be treated with caution since its source was the three deities.
Once the words disappeared, Brudos quickly stowed the stele away, collected some ‘normal’ research equipment from the room, and then left to gather with the others.
Soon, five black beams split the sky, flying towards the central region of the Southern Empire.
At this moment, not just this border city, but also other Demon King’s Cities and cities and tribes of the Vassal Races all had high-order auras rise into the sky and converge.
The damage inflicted on the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire by Jack Clark’s assault was substantial, with not only Demon King level but also high-order Purgatory True Demons suffering heavy losses.
Especially from the breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Meanwhile, the Frontline Battlefield’s True Martial Heavenly King, Adam Garcetti the Supreme, and the Sky-based Divine King also received the news from Brudos, which left them shocked.
They were not shocked by Jack Clark’s ‘death.’
Because of the soul breath in the True Martial Stone Tablet, they all knew Jack was safe and had apparently already escaped the pursuit of the Demon Gods.
What truly shocked them was the massive commotion Jack had caused in the rear of the Purgatory Empire, his slaying of numerous Demon Kings and Great Demons, and even the peak Titan Giant Beast, and how he defied the Demon Gods.
“This lad is truly worthy of having passed the Emperor Inheritance. His growth and strength are astonishing,” mused the Sky-based Divine King.
The True Martial Heavenly King also marveled and nodded: “And that Beast called Thunderflame, who was just at the Early Myth stage in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield a Sun Wheel ago, comparable to the Titan in its burst power.”
“I didn’t expect it to grow an entire Major Realm in just one Sun Wheel just like Jack, and its strength is even more heaven-defying.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1199 - 1199 671 Jack Clarks Death Human Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1199: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_6 Chapter 1199: Chapter 671: Jack Clark’s Death, Human Race Shaken_6 “`
Boom! Just then, at the edge of the sky, a Demon God Level terror burst forth, its fearsome aura enveloping and darkening half the world.
Over ten thousand kilometers away, a towering figure stood atop the Firmament, emanating a shaking Heaven and Earth Demon God presence that rippled through space-time.
Even at a distance of over ten thousand kilometers, it made countless people in the Sky Curtain Battle City tremble.
Boom! In the Sky Curtain Battlefield, an equally powerful presence burst forth. Azure Divine Light shot into the sky, dispelling the invisible Demon God pressure.
The gathered Azure Divine Light formed a towering, penetrating celestial apparition, and a deep, majestic voice echoed through Heaven and Earth, “Belidier, how is it, have I not hurt you enough before?”
The projected image of that Demon God huffed coldly, and in a low voice said, “Adam Garcetti, I am not here today to arrange a duel with you but to inform you that your Human Race genius Jack Clark is already dead.”
“A mere Legendary Realm human dared to venture deep into our Purgatory Family’s rear; he was practically seeking death. A single demon king from our clan easily slaughtered him.”
“Now, the human named Jack Clark’s corpse still hangs at the entrance to the Demon Domain, but I wonder, Adam Garcetti, do you have the guts to retrieve it?”
Back at the base, on the arm of an eighty-meter-tall, dilapidated Black and White Mecha, Gabriella, clad in a blue worker outfit, was busy with repair work. At these words, she looked up in shock.
In the Medical Department, Lori Parma, lying weakly on the hospital bed, also looked incredulously out the window, “How is it possible, Jack Clark is dead?!”
“Nonsense, how could a guy like Jack Clark possibly be dead.” Lightning flashed in the sky, as Damon Lopes soared up with a shocked and uncertain expression, looking towards the darkness that blotted out the sky.
At this moment, many in the Sky Curtain Battlefield who knew Jack Clark showed faces of astonishment and disbelief.
Boom!
Back at the 13th Legion base research department, a three hundred-plus meter tall, lean and fierce dark golden creature suddenly looked up, its eyes lighting up with blue and white radiance, terrifyingly horrifying.
Instantly, an aura that caused all beings to tremble with fear spread out.
“Jack…Clark…”
Boom boom boom!! Number One erupted with horrifying energy fluctuations, making the surrounding buildings shake and the ground sink. The dreadful aura alarmed countless people.
“Freya Louise, stabilize your Mental Fluctuation.”
“Freya Louise, control your emotions. Your soul is still merging with Number One, don’t let your consciousness re-emerge, or else you will be assimilated and devoured…”
Inside the research department building, countless people screamed in terror.
But within the space inside Number One, the silent God Machine Armament slowly raised its head, while inside, Freya Louise’s distant, faraway gaze began to slowly fade.
However, at that moment, Adam Garcetti’s indifferent voice came from the sky.
“Belidier, you think I would believe your words? True, Jack Clark did venture deep into the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, but he left unscathed.”
“Not only that, Jack Clark killed seven demon kings of your Purgatory Family, one Great Demon King, and one Titan Peak Demon Dragon. Even Diorus and the three Demon Gods together could not hold him.”
“Instead of spreading rumors here, you better consider how to prepare for his next attack. For all we know, Jack Clark might already be in the Grita War Demon Empire.”
In the sky, Demon God Belidier sneered, “Adam Garcetti, do you think anyone will believe what you say? How can a mere Legendary Realm human escape under the siege of three Demon Gods?”
“`
Adam Garcetti said indifferently, “That’s because the Purgatory Family’s Demon Gods are too weak; not even three Demon Gods could detain a single king-level warrior from our Human Race.”
“Since you claim that Jack Clark of the Human Race isn’t dead, it’s simple. Why don’t you call him out and let us see?”
“Hmph! Do you think I will fall for your trick and tell you where Jack Clark is?”
Demon God Belidier wanted to use the news of Jack Clark’s death to strike at human morale, but compared to the words of the Purgatory Demon Gods, the strong men from the Human Race were more inclined to believe the First Councilor.
Thus, after Demon God Belidier left, the Human Race’s morale soared instead.
There was no helping it. Jack Clark’s achievements were just too terrifying; he single-handedly cut through a Demon God Empire and escaped while being chased by three Demon Gods.
But compared to the words of the enemy Demon Gods, they naturally trusted the information of their own Supreme Experts more.
“It’s good that he’s not dead.”
“This guy, I knew he wouldn’t die so easily. He’s just too abnormal. Damn, truly worthy of being Daoist Master Damon Lopes’s good brother.” Damon Lopes was somewhat shocked.
Clearly, half a year ago, everyone was at the Sixth-level Heaven and acted together, but now, six months later, he had only reached the early phase of the Ninth Heavens, while that monster had already become a king-level warrior and even defeated Demon Gods.
Meanwhile, the Destruction Emperor Dragon reverted from its Crimson Form, awoke the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, and gathered the other Giant Beasts to prepare for a sweep through the Chaotic Domain.
“Not only did Jack Clark slay seven demon kings from your Purgatory Family, one Great Demon King, and one Titan Peak Demon Dragon; not even the three Demon Gods from Diorus could stop him.”
“Instead of spreading rumors here, you’d better think about how to defend against his next attack. Who knows, Jack Clark might have already appeared in the Grita War Demon Empire.”
Demon God Belidier from the firmament sneered, “Adam Garcetti, do you think anyone would believe what you’re saying? Can a mere human at the Legendary Realm escape while surrounded by three Demon Gods?”
Adam Garcetti said indifferently, “That’s because the Purgatory Family’s Demon Gods are too weak; not even three Demon Gods could detain a single king-level warrior from our Human Race.”
“Since you claim that Jack Clark of the Human Race isn’t dead, it’s simple. Why don’t you call him out and let us see?”
“Hmph! Do you think I will fall for your trick and tell you where Jack Clark is?”
Demon God Belidier wanted to use the news of Jack Clark’s death to strike at human morale, but compared to the words of the Purgatory Demon Gods, the strong men from the Human Race were more inclined to believe the First Councilor.
Thus, after Demon God Belidier left, the Human Race’s morale soared instead.
There was no helping it. Jack Clark’s achievements were just too terrifying; he single-handedly cut through a Demon God Empire and escaped while being chased by three Demon Gods.
[The rest, a few hundred words, will be released after some editing]
“It’s good that he’s not dead.”
“This guy, I knew he wouldn’t die so easily. He’s just too abnormal. Damn, truly worthy of being Daoist Master Damon Lopes’s good brother.” Damon Lopes was somewhat shocked.
Clearly, half a year ago, everyone was at the Sixth-level Heaven and acted together, but now, six months later, he had only reached the early phase of the Ninth Heavens, while that monster had already become a king-level warrior and even defeated Demon Gods.
Meanwhile, the Destruction Emperor Dragon reverted from its Crimson Form, awoke the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, and gathered the other Giant Beasts to prepare for a sweep through the Chaotic Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1200 - 1200 472 Emperor Dragon Roars Blood Flows
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1200: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows Into a River Chapter 1200: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows Into a River Just as Jack Clark was swept away by the Time Storm and vanished, blood-red lightning thundered across the Chaotic Sea Region, casting a destructive aura that could destroy Heaven and Earth across half the sky.
Under the terrible deep red annihilation lightning, space shattered, the ocean trembled, and countless Unique Beasts within a thousand kilometers frenziedly fled in all directions, panic-stricken.
In the dazzling red radiance, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood six thousand meters long and over four thousand meters tall, immovable like a mountain peak, as if it had crashed and was unresponsive.
Yi ya yi ya?! The Purple little dragon noticed the abnormality of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and flew in front of its gigantic eyes with some confusion.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils, vast as lakes, shifted slightly, and it exhaled a scorching breath, emitting a deep, slow roar, “I, am, fine.”
In the roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s realm of thought moved, reversing the Gigantification, and slowly the space inscriptions shimmering on the sides of its feather horns dimmed, as did the red light that radiated from its body.
As the blood-red lightning disappeared, the radiance faded, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s figure rapidly shrank, quickly returning to its black-red form measuring one thousand nine hundred meters.
Suddenly, a sense of weakness spread from within its body, though it was not very strong.
From the moment Jack Clark unfolded the altar to Summoning the Demon God, to the battle with the Time Silver Butterfly in the Space Turbulence, it had only been a few hours in total.
This transformation into the Destruction Form hadn’t drained much, but Jack Clark being swept away by the Time Storm had profoundly impacted the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon shared one Soul Source and one consciousness, with each typically multitasking to manage their respective affairs, the consciousness synchronized.
Thus, when Jack Clark was caught in the Time Storm, the connection between the two remained unaffected.
Furthermore, given their union, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could vaguely sense Jack Clark’s presence, only it couldn’t pinpoint his location; it seemed like he didn’t exist in the current timeframe.
However, with the shift to different spaces and times, there was now a delay in the connection between the original body and the Avatar, as if what used to be a hundred megabyte pathway had dropped to a few KBs.
And when the ‘signal’ was strong, responses were quicker, but when it was intermittent, the thought process became sluggish, similar to the state of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly shook its head and let out a slow roar, “Little, Ning, let’s, head, back, now, and then, it’s time, to take care, of serious, business.”
The matters with the Human Race had been temporarily concluded. Next, with the completion of the final Transformation to Titan, the real conquest of the Chaotic Turbulent Region and the path to domination of the mythical world would begin.
As long as there was a sufficient supply of Heaven and Earth Treasures and food, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could grow and make breakthroughs at an astonishing speed to reach the Ancient Titan level.
Boom!
In the Rift World, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon, resembling a small mountain range, entered through the waterfall gateway, the entire world began to shake, barely able to sustain its presence.
With a Giant Beast Body tens of times more robust than its peers at the Titan Level, and terrifying power containing nine Higher-order Laws within it, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was essentially like a star condensed with Terrifying Power.
The invisible life magnetic field emanating from it vibrated Heaven and Earth, subdued all laws, and space itself formed layers of transparent ripples wherever it went.
Bang bang bang!!
The water of a lake with a diameter of tens of kilometers exploded, and Rain Lawson, with her black hair over her shoulders, appeared with all the Naga, gazing at the Black-red Colossal Beast that stepped out of the Void with frenzied worship in their eyes.
“We greet our king.”
Several hundred Mermaids, their fair skin silky as jade and key parts covered by seashells, also revealed their beautiful figures as they respectfully saluted the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
However, to Giant Beast Type Creatures, aesthetics were different, so only the Destruction Emperor Dragon found this scene pleasing to the eye.
Especially the Lawson sisters, Rain and Ning, at the forefront of the Naga Tribe – one voluptuous and the other slender and tall, it’s just unknown what… on their mermaid tails.
Cough! What am I thinking about? I am a Titan Giant Beast, these little ones aren’t even as big as one of my scales, how could they possibly…
The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook those peculiar thoughts from its mind, and with a deep roar that reverberated across Heaven and Earth, inquired, “How, is, the, farming, of, the, Ice fish, going?”
Rain responded respectfully, “Currently, the overall number of Ice fish has increased by over eight hundred, including more than two thousand three hundred juveniles, over seven hundred mature Ice fish, and thirty-nine fully grown adults.”
Because Mr. Loore had been in Hibernation for some time, the mature Ice fish had accumulated.
“Good!” The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slowly in approval.
Those Ice fish, for the Titan-level Destruction Emperor Dragon, were too small even for a toothpick, but they were crucial for the Purple little dragon, as their Ice Origin essence helped it recover some of its expended strength.
Receiving praise from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, excitement shone on the faces of the Naga below.
As a subordinate race, the Naga viewed the Destruction Emperor Dragon virtually as ‘master’, utterly supreme.
Since becoming subordinates of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, they have witnessed it grow from a seven-hundred-meter Mythical Giant Beast to its current stature within the span of a Sun Wheel. Its power to slay huge Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Giant Beasts, and even carry the world, left the mermaids in utter awe and worship.
And that wasn’t to mention the recent slaying of that terrifying mountain-sized creature.
As the mermaids looked on with reverence, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood motionless in the sky. After a long while, the ‘signal’ suddenly cleared up, and it issued a deep roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - 1201 472 Emperor Dragon Roars Blood Flows
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1201: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows into a River_2 Chapter 1201: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows into a River_2 “Misss Joseline, go and devour those mature Ice fish to accumulate more strength. Next, I plan to call Scythia and the rest back to start sweeping through the Chaotic Domain.”
Immediately, the Purple little dragon’s eyes lit up, emitting an excited and childish roar: Aooo…roar! Kill, Great May wants to see blood flow into rivers.
Upon hearing that the Destruction Emperor Dragon was about to take them out to fight, the Purple little dragon became instantly overjoyed, as it loved fighting the most.
When the Purple little dragon transformed into a streak of light and rushed into the lake, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a look of bewilderment. After hovering in the air for a few minutes, it finally flew off into the distance.
Atop a mountain peak over seven thousand meters high, a Single-horned Spawn Roc, its body now stretched to five hundred meters, lay hibernating, surrounded by a Black and White Domain that spread over a five-thousand-meter radius.
On another mountain peak more than twenty kilometers away, a Red Beast whose body had grown to over seven hundred meters and whose long tail resembled that of an Eastern Divine Dragon sejourned.
Around the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, an extraordinary scene of alternating seasons and the surrounding sun and moon manifested, emitting an aura far more terrifying than that of a regular Mythical Giant Beast.
At level nine, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast had mastered a Top Tier Talent, the transformation state of alternating black and white, day and night. Finally, with the help of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it even touched upon the Time Laws and made a breakthrough into quasi-mythical.
And once it broke through to the status of a Mythical Giant Beast, its two great Top Tier Talents mutually influenced each other, becoming even more powerful, a result that even the Destruction Emperor Dragon found somewhat surprising.
The reason lay in the talent of the Candle Dragon Giant Beast.
The cycle of day and night under the Black and White Domain allowed the Giant Beast Candle Dragon to perceive time, and the Time Laws in turn affected the day and night, deriving seasonal changes, complementing each other.
Looking at the two subordinates still in hibernation, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took a deep breath. Immediately, a raging wind howled through heaven and earth, followed by a world-shaking roar that erupted.
Roar!
Under the terrifying wave of the Dragon Roar, the space in front was massively shattered, forming a series of huge Black Cracks that spread in all directions for tens of kilometers.
And the Divine Might contained within this Dragon Roar also spread in all directions, penetrating the Rift World, through space, and across vast distances.
Several thousand kilometers away from the Rift World, in the sea, a piece of Red Scale Armor lodged in a crack of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s neck vibrated, and it immediately let out an excited roar.
Roar roar!! Crab General, let’s get back. Thunderflame has awakened and is calling for us.
In the distant sea surface, a Blue Giant Crab, actively searching for a suitable target, excitedly waved its pincers, emitting large streams of bubbles from its mouth.
Gurgle gurgle!! The Great King has awoken.
On the sea surface more than ten kilometers away, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon rolled excitedly: Roar roar roar!! Tim Abbott is finally taking us out to fight again, and this time Kidora aims to take on nine rivals.
Before returning to hibernation after coming back from the deep part of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had torn off two pieces of its own scales to forge a batch of simple communicators.
These scale fragments were inscribed with Basic Runes of resonance, containing a wisp of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Law Power, capable of generating resonance with just a roar from it.
Of course, because these were Basic Runes, the radiation range was only a hundred thousand kilometers, and this was still because its scales were sufficiently powerful, carrying more than a hundred Basic resonance runes.
Now, having received the Summoning, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Female Tiger Whale, and the Blue Giant Crab made their way to the Dragon Palace.
At the same time, on a vast island more than thirty thousand kilometers away, a Silver Giant Dragon, a Gold and Blue Giant Dragon, and a Kamaitachi Beast likewise received the call.
The Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar: Roar! Tim Abbott has awakened, Telsafi, let’s hurry back. The path to Great Sethia’s dominance is finally about to begin.
Boom!
The Silver Giant Dragon blasted off amidst a black storm, transforming into a silver light that cut through the storm, striking out tens of kilometers like lightning in the blink of an eye.
However, compared to the hurried Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon was much more elegant; with a single flap of its massive and gorgeous Dragon Wings, it rose into the sky amidst a whirl of Seven-Colored Glow.
As for the even larger quasi-mythical late period Kamaitachi Beast, it spread its Red double wings and followed behind the two Giant Dragons, like a loyal guard.
While one Giant Beast after another received the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Summoning and hurried back, a frenzied major battle erupted more than eighty thousand kilometers away in the sea.
Roar roar roar!!
In the raging sea water, Giant Beasts measuring dozens to hundreds of meters in size roared madly, engaged in ferocious combat, with the sea strewn with Unique Beast corpses, the sea water stained red with blood.
Apart from these Giant Beasts, there were also two different races engaged in the fray, numbering up to a hundred thousand.
One of these races had the lower bodies resembling Flood Dragons and the upper bodies of strong human forms, terminating in four arms covered in blue scales, their heads fierce and resembling both fish and Flood Dragons.
Most had body lengths between twenty and fifty meters, with a few exceeding a hundred meters, all wielding weapons such as bronze-crafted tridents, spears, and axes.
These members of the different races, currently divided into small teams, numbering in the dozens to hundreds, surrounded the massive Giant Beasts and launched continuous attacks against their enemies.
During the fight, the team leaders of these races chanted bizarre syllables that resembled war songs or rituals, sending out blue waves that linked all the races and Giant Beasts together.
Under those ritualistic war songs, every member of the races, including the surrounding Giant Beasts, experienced an explosive increase in Aura, doubling their strength and enhancing their Defense, charging and smashing through the enemies.
The enemies of these members of the different races were upright creatures, resembling Black Armored Lizard People.
These Black Armored Lizard People were also typically between twenty and fifty meters in size, with six tentacle-like tails protruding from behind, donning rudimentary armor, looking fierce and daunting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1202 - 1202 472 Emperor Dragon Roars Blood Flows
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1202: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows into a River_3 Chapter 1202: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows into a River_3 The Armored Lizard People were surrounded by frenzied black heavy water, which, in coordination, would create violent tsunamis and ripping vortices, tearing apart many of the Four-Armed Alien Race each time.
In addition to the Armored Lizard People, there were giant beasts tens to hundreds of meters long.
These beasts looked uniform, resembling whales but more terrifying, with their entire bodies covered in black armor, and their backs and sides bristling with long, narrow tentacles.
Apart from that, dark red glows flickered between the scale armor on the front half of the giant beasts’ bodies, their mouths burning with intense firelight, constantly emitting scorching Flame Breaths.
These flames were like liquid magma, containing terrible heat and burning properties, wherever they passed, the sea water boiled, scorching the skies and cooking the seas.
Especially when those Four-Armed Aliens and giant beasts were drenched in flames, they would burn uncontrollably – neither energy shields nor fortified scale armor could stop them.
And when these flames combined with the heavy water controlled by the Armored Lizard People, despite water and fire being incompatible, the unleashed power was even more amazing.
The chaotic and crazy slaughter spread across thousands of kilometers, with the fiercest being the great battle between two Mythical Giant Beasts.
On the fringes of the battlefield, a Black Tiger Whale, over one hundred and ten meters long and approaching the peak of the eighth level, was also in a frenzied battle, roaring as it bit down.
Boom!
When the Black Tiger Whale, with its Devouring Talent and ferocious maw where black vortices swirled, bit down, the domain of the eighth level Black Flame Whale Beast collapsed, its body torn asunder, its flesh and blood ripped apart.
Suddenly, scorching blood sprayed out, and the Giant Beast screamed in agony.
Whoo!
The Black Tiger Whale let out a long, horn-like wail as its massive body twisted like a crocodile in a frenzy, and in an instant, its terrifying biting force ripped apart half of the Giant Beast’s body, along with its spine.
Ulla Ulla!!
Seeing the Black Tiger Whale tear apart a Late Stage Eighth Rank Beast of the same level, the surrounding Four-Armed Aliens let out excited shouts, their expressions uplifted as they ferociously pounced on the Armored Lizard People.
Crack!
The Black Tiger Whale chewed with its large mouth, swallowing the flesh and blood of the giant beast, its bloodthirsty and savage eyes looking towards another eighth level Giant Beast nearby, surging through the waves and shooting towards it.
However, as fierce as the Black Tiger Whale seemed in combat, heedless of death, it was actually very cautious when choosing its enemies.
For example, its opponents were always eighth level Giant Beasts of the same rank, with a lower Growth Level than itself, and besides that, it kept a distance from those Level 9 Giant Beasts, especially the Mythical Battlefield at the center.
In this way, the Black Tiger Whale seemed ferocious in battle, continuously ripping apart Giant Beasts of the same tier, all the while keeping danger within a certain range.
After about half a day of relentless fighting, suddenly, two powerful forces exploded at Battle Central, accompanied by two roars containing the pressure of myths.
“Kerla, next time I will definitely tear off your head.”
“Hmph! Dorus, you’ve said that rubbish dozens of times already.”
After dropping their fierce words, the two Mythical Giant Beasts each unleashed their powers to divide the battlefield, and immediately the great battle subsided, leaving only countless corpses scattered in the sea.
Amidst the crimson sea water, while watching those retreating enemies, the Black Tiger Whale let out a somewhat regretful moan, “Damn it, I haven’t killed enough yet.”
Around the Black Tiger Whale, the squad captain of the vanguard, a Four Meter Alien of fifty meters length, excitedly said, “Lord Tiger Overlord, you have already killed nine eighth level Giant Beasts, which is very impressive.”
The Black Tiger Whale was somewhat surprised, “Only nine? I thought I had taken down ten.”
At this moment, a hundred meter-long, hideous Four-Armed Alien holding a bronze steel fork swam over from a distance, looking at the Black Tiger Whale with a fierce smile on its face.
“Tiger Overlord, well done. Your performance in this great battle was incredibly valiant. Lord Kerla has specially sent me to bring you over, ready to bestow your reward.”
Ying Ying!! Not bad at all, mainly because these guys can’t take a hit. The Black Tiger Whale proudly called out and then followed the Four-Armed Alien into the distance.
On the violent sea surface, over a dozen Ninth Rank Giant Beasts, two to three hundred meters in size, loomed large, emitting an intense stench of blood, their powerful aura permeating the air.
Among these Level 9 Giant Beasts stood a four-armed alien of a kilometer in length, exuding the powerful pressure of Mythical-level.
In contrast to the half human figure standing over four hundred meters tall, like a small hill, the one hundred and ten meters long Black Tiger Whale seemed like a small dog.
But although there was a huge disparity in size and level, the Black Tiger Whale was not inferior, calling out, “Greetings to the great king, Kerla.”
Looking at the Black Tiger Whale floating on the sea surface in front of him, the gigantic Four-Armed Mythical Alien nodded slightly in approval and said, “I’ve heard about you from Karala. You’re called Tiger Overlord, right?”
Ying Ying!! Yes, Lord Kerla.
The Four-Armed Mythical Alien praised, “Although you’ve only recently joined our Longa Tribe, your performance in battle was quite outstanding, killing nine same-tier Giant Beasts.”
“Our clan always clearly distinguishes rewards and punishments, plus this being your first time on the battlefield with such a performance, your feats are doubled. This Ancient Clam Crystal Pearl is your reward for this time.”
As he spoke, a white ‘pearl’ the size of a water jar emerged in the hand of the Four-Armed Mythical Alien, radiating an astonishingly pure fluctuation, immediately making the surrounding Level 9 Giant Beasts envious.
Ying Ying!! Thank you, Lord Kerla, I will fight to the death for the Longa Tribe in the future, killing all those despicable Black Abyss Alien Race and Black Flame Giant Beasts.
With that, the Black Tiger Whale opened its mouth wide, a strong suction emanating from it, swallowing the Ancient Clam Pearl in one gulp.

chapters.title: Chapter 1203 - 1203 472 Emperor Dragon Roars Blood Flows
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1203: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows into a River_4 Chapter 1203: Chapter 472 Emperor Dragon Roars, Blood Flows into a River_4 Boom!
Just as the Ancient Clam Pearl was swallowed into its stomach, an instant release of endless, pure energy occurred, causing the Black Tiger Whale’s aura to surge and its body to gradually grow larger.
The sight instantly caused many Level 7 and Level 8 Giant Beasts in the surrounding sea to look on in envy.
The Ancient Clam Pearl was of high level, reaching the Peak of Level 9, containing enough energy to allow the Black Tiger Whale to reach the Peak of Level 8 after absorption, and break through to Level 9 in a short time.
And this scene was precisely what Kerla wanted to see.
The Black Tiger Whale had great potential, possessing amazing battle strength that could crush other Giant Beasts of the same level, and it showed tremendous growth potential with its fearless and ferocious way of fighting.
At the same time, under the watchful eyes of all the vassal Giant Beasts, lavish rewards would also encourage them to fight even more bravely next time.
While Kerla was considering giving the Black Tiger Whale more resources to help it break through to Level 9 sooner, the Black Tiger Whale who had swallowed the Ancient Clam Pearl suddenly let out a cry.
Ying ying! Thank you, Lord Kerla, for the reward. To serve the Longa Tribe, I’ve decided to go back and call over my mother, father, and Uncle to help.
These despicable creatures from the Black Abyss Alien Race dare to attack me, I must have Uncle give them a severe lesson.
Kerla paused slightly at the Black Tiger Whale’s words: “Tiger Overlord, you have other family members?”
The Black Tiger Whale nodded: Ying ying! Yes, but they’re in a distant place, it’ll take ‘several days’ to swim back.
“What is their strength like?” Kerla asked.
The Black Tiger Whale cried out: “Mother and the others are all Level 9 Giant Beasts, and Uncle is a bit stronger than mother. As for my father, he’s also very strong, just a bit slow.”
Kerla’s face immediately showed a smile.
Three Level 9 whale class Giant Beasts, and their strength should be quite formidable within their level. If they could be persuaded to join, it would be a significant addition to the battle strength.
With this in mind, Kerla nodded in satisfaction: “No problem, Tiger Overlord, go and bring back your father and mother. As long as they’re willing to exert themselves for our clan, I will definitely treat you all well.”
“By the way, here are three Ancient Clam Pearls. Take them as my greeting gift,” said Kerla, as three smaller but brilliant pearls appeared in the hands of the Four-Armed Mythical Alien Tribe.
Ying ying! For the great Longa Alien Race, I’ll bring back my father and mother without delay. I will go back with Miss Keller right now.
“Go, and be careful on the way.”
Due to the Black Tiger Whale’s brave performance in battle earlier, neither Kerla nor the surrounding Longa Alien Tribe members and Giant Beasts thought much of it.
Under the watchful gaze of these Alien Races and Giant Beasts, the Black Tiger Whale made waves as it swam, quickly covering hundreds of kilometers and leaving the reach of the mighty army.
At that moment, a smaller Female Tiger Whale appeared on the distant sea surface.
Ying ying! Leader, are you all right?
The Female Little Tiger Whale swam over, looking at some of the damaged scales on the Black Tiger Whale, her eyes revealing pain and concern, her gaze tender.
[There’s a bit more, currently being modified]
The Longa Tribe would form alliances with powerful sea Giant Beasts to complement each other, ruling over a mighty Plane World. The powerful Longa King is a Titan Level Giant Beast.
Under the Longa King, there is a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast Longa, and a Dragon Horse Class Mythical Peak Giant Beast.
A small world is home to Ancient Giant Clams that produce white pearls in their bodies. When a multitude of Heaven and Earth Treasures are placed inside, they will transform into white pearls of pure biological energy.
Comparable to the Fire Crystals in the body of Lava Giants, the larger the body of the Ancient Giant Clam that produces the white pearls, the larger the pearl, the more potent the energy effect, which can promote the growth of Giant Beasts.
Under King Ja, there is a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast Longa, and a Dragon Horse Class Mythical Peak Giant Beast.
A small world is home to Ancient Giant Clams that produce white pearls in their bodies. When a multitude of Heaven and Earth Treasures are placed inside, they will transform into white pearls of pure biological energy.
Comparable to the Fire Crystals in the body of Lava Giants, the larger the body of the Ancient Giant Clam that produces the white pearls, the larger the pearl, the more potent the energy effect, which can promote the growth of Giant Beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1204 - 1204 473 Jack Clark Descends from the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1204: Chapter 473: Jack Clark Descends from the Heavens into the Dharma Ending World Chapter 1204: Chapter 473: Jack Clark Descends from the Heavens into the Dharma Ending World In the Rift World, standing before the towering crystal palace that reaches tens of kilometers into the sky, an intimidating black-red Colossal Dragon Beast stands erect upon the more than 50-meter-high Crystal King Stage, its body radiating an invisible and terrifying aura.
Given the current size of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the more than 50-meter-high Crystal King Stage is like a small mound to it.
At this moment, in front of the Crystal Throne, a Single-horned Spawn Roc with a body length of 500 meters and double wings spread wide, covering a kilometer, circles in the air, emitting deep and excited steam whistle-like calls.
“Thunderflame, Thunderflame, the feeling of being a Myth is so strong, I feel like I can take on ten now,” it says.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, “Fight ten Level 9 Giant Beasts?”
“Of course, ten Mythical Giant Beasts,” the Single-horned Spawn Roc declared confidently.
With its breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, it had fully awakened the bloodline of the ancient Spawn Roc, evolving into a powerful creature from ancient myths and legends, its form more magnificent.
Not only had its two Top-tier Talents transformed into Higher-order Laws, but it had also awakened a powerful Inheritance Mystery, greatly increasing its strength.
Seeing this, the corners of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled upwards as it spoke in a deep voice, “In that case, go and spar with the Candle Dragon, it’s just completed its breakthrough to the Legendary Realm too.”
…Instantly, the Single-horned Spawn Roc hesitated, looking subconsciously into the distance.
There, awakened ahead of schedule by the roaring of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a Red Beast sprawled in the air, surrounded by swirling clouds, its figure blurred as if in another realm of space-time.
Seeing this, a sheepish look appeared in the eyes of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, as if it had perhaps over-inflated its own abilities just a moment ago.
Facing the Candle Dragon, which controlled the local cyclical power of the sun and moon and had the power of slow time, the Single-horned Spawn Roc felt that even its World Devouring Law Mystery might not be a match.
“Roar! The Great Sethia has returned,” came the excited roar of the Silver Giant Dragon from the waterfall entrance, followed by an explosion of the lake water, and amidst the howling of the raging wind, the Silver Giant Dragon returned.
With every flap, its massive Dragon Wings whipped up hurricanes, forming a series of black Tornado Columns that swept through Heaven and Earth, the display grandiose.
“Tim Abott, you’ve finally awakened. Come on, let’s fight. The Great Sethia shall dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region, blood flowing like a river,” roared the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly, circling the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “Let’s wait until all the beasts have returned.”
“Roar! No problem.”
In the midst of its roaring, the Silver Giant Dragon tucked its wings and crashed down next to the Destruction Emperor Dragon with a boom, instantly shattering and vibrating the crystal ground condensed with quasi-mythical power.
At that moment, the waterfall entrance exploded once again, and a gold-blue Giant Dragon, surrounded by a Seven-Colored Glow, flew in, followed by the massive Kamaitachi Beast.
The gold-blue Giant Dragon drew in its wings, landing gently with an elegant posture amidst the surrounding forces, and looked at the Destruction Emperor Dragon inquiringly with a growl, “Thunderflame, have you completely undergone the Titan Level Transformation?”
Hmm! The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, and immediately the eyes of the gold-blue Giant Dragon sparkled.
In its inherited memory, its mother took more than twenty Sun Wheels to sleep and complete the Titan Body and Law transformation when breaking through to the Titan Level.
This individual from the Indigenous World was just too extravagant, seemingly even more extreme than it and Sethia, who are considered standard Mythical Creatures, with seemingly limitless potential.
As the two Giant Dragons took their places on either side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon on the High Platform, the Giant Kamaitachi Beast, over a thousand meters long, landed prudently on the edge of the stage, looking ferocious.
While the Silver Giant Dragon and other beasts were farther away, their unmatched flying speed meant they returned earlier than the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and others.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon roared with curiosity, “Roar! Telsafi, why are you drooling?”
“Drooling?” The gold-blue Giant Dragon’s jagged mouth opened slightly, its Dragon Tongue sticking out to lick its lips, then realizing there was no drool.
“Telsafi, were you just thinking about something delicious?”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared complacently, “The Great Sethia understands you; just now, you looked exactly like you did when you discovered something tasty in the past, barely able to resist taking a bite.”
“Indeed, the Great Torsa had thought of something delicious just now, but alas, it is temporarily out of reach,” growled the gold-blue Giant Dragon elegantly as it lay down, looking quite languid.
As the two Giant Dragons growled back and forth, the colossal and majestic black-red beast in the middle stood still, lost in a daze.
Bang! The waterfall entrance exploded yet again, and amidst the spray of water, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Female Tiger Whale, the Blue Giant Crab, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah all rushed back.
Crossing the river water for tens of kilometers, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle vociferously roared as it swam into the lake, “Roar, roar! Jack, we’re back.”
Soon the four Great Beasts made it to the lakeside, congregating below the Crystal Stage. Seeing this, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Red Candle Dragon landed on either side.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, standing on the platform, its body length reaching one thousand nine hundred meters with seven hundred meters tall at the shoulder, flanked by the Silver Giant Dragon six hundred meters long and the Gold-blue Giant Dragon five hundred meters long stood at its sides.
Beneath them stood the Kamaitachi Beast of the late Mythical period, the newly awakened Single-horned Spawn Roc, and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
Below in the lake were the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Ghidorah, over three hundred meters long, the nearly three hundred meters Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the one hundred and fifty meters long Female Tiger Whale, and the Blue Giant Crab.
At this moment, the Dragon Palace finally had the aura of a sovereign ruler of a Beast Empire.
Yet as all the beasts were brimming with determination, waiting for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to give the command to burst forth from the Rift Small World and dominate the Chaotic Domain, they realized it had not responded for quite some time.
The Silver Giant Dragon, towering over two hundred meters tall, reached out its claw, giving a gentle tap on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s knee, and in an instant, the air beneath its claw surged, forming a ring of white shock waves.

Under the Silver Giant Dragon’s ‘slap’, the Destruction Emperor Dragon finally showed some reaction, slowly growling, “No… rush, wait… for Tiger Three… to return, then we’ll talk. Right now, it… is… after all, the Cavalry General of the Dragon Palace.”
In the perception of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Tiger Three, carrying the resonating scales, was hurrying back, though it seemed he was still quite a distance away.
But most importantly, it had things to deal with now and needed to focus all its attention.
The ‘slow’ reaction of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was immediately noticed by the Silver Giant Dragon as being off, causing it to glance down at the Giant Beast Candle Dragon with some confusion.
“Roar! Tim Abott, have you been infected by the Candle Dragon?”
But at that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon zoned out again, rendering the Giant Beasts like the Single-horned Spawn Roc below somewhat puzzled.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was now the undisputed Dragon King, and since it insisted on waiting for Tiger Three before talking, they could only wait, especially since their concept of ‘time’ was particularly slow.
Caught in the chaotic Time Chaos, even the consciousness of Jack Clark felt dull and groggy, not knowing how long he had flown when he finally passed through something and felt a release.
Then he felt himself falling rapidly, the speed increasing by the moment.
……
Under the grey sky, the Earth was desolate, and on the edge of a huge Ruin City, two figures were cautiously moving through the shadows of buildings, headed outside the city.
Just then, the sky lit up, and a meteor descended from above, emitting intense plasma firelight in shades of blue and red, leaving a long trail that illuminated the sky.
This scene immediately caught the attention of the two figures, who instinctively looked up and then noticed the meteor growing increasingly larger.
“Look out!”
One of them exclaimed, quickly embracing the smaller figure and darting over a hundred meters away in a flash, leaving several afterimages.
Boom!
In the instant they dodged away, the ground within a hundred-meter radius shattered, flames erupted, and the violent impact kicked up countless pieces of dirt and stones, scattering them in all directions.
The commotion stirred the half-reclaimed Ruin City, which resounded with savage roars, and the ground shook thunderously as if a behemoth was moving.
Hundreds of meters away, in the shadow of a collapsed building, the faces of the two figures changed slightly, “Not good, the Tyrants and wild beasts of this region have been alerted. Don’t make a sound later, no matter what.”
Yes, yes! The embraced figure nodded with a hint of fear.
As the two watched nervously, dust billowed in the distance, trees snapped, and buildings collapsed as a ferocious figure fifty meters tall appeared.
This monster had a humanoid shape, but its grossly muscular body was covered with black scale armor bristling with sharp spikes, its head fiendish like that of a demon, exuding a terrifying oppressive aura.
Around this monster were over a hundred creatures, ranging in height from 3 meters to more than a dozen meters, all covered in black and Red Scales, circling around it.
These creatures emitted mindless hisses, their greedy eyes fixed on the center of the distant, dust-filled explosion.
There, they sensed the rich scent of living humans, and the intangible smell of flesh and blood drove these monsters into a frenzy.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Two five-meter tall creatures on all fours, swift as the wind, crossed the hundreds of meters in just a few flashes and lunged toward the center of the explosion where flames were still burning.
Just as those two creatures rushed in, a terrible force exploded.
Boom!
The air exploded as if it were solid, forming a white waterfall-like blast that engulfed the two creatures, the Overbearing strength exploding them in midair.
After blasting the two creatures, the Terrifying Power continued unabated, carving out a pathway over a hundred meters long and more than ten meters wide before slowly subsiding.
Such Overbearing strength made the two people hiding in the distance tense up.
Meanwhile, as the smoke and dust cleared, a crater tens of meters in diameter was revealed on the Earth, with dirt and stones rolling down its edges, radiating out hundreds of meters.
Then, a figure with black hair mixed with strands of white, wearing damaged Black Gold battle armor, walked out slowly from the pit, an almost invisible Terrifying Aura swirling around him.
Hiss! Upon seeing the figure clearly, the two hidden people couldn’t help but suck in a breath of cold air.
Because on that person’s chest, there was a massive gash that nearly cleaved the chest diagonally, exposing the slowly writhing organs inside.
Beneath the shattered battle armor, multiple cracked wounds were visible, and on the young man’s exceptionally handsome face, there were also traces of blood.
The entire person was like a piece of porcelain that had been shattered and then put back together, ready to fall apart at any moment.
With such severe injuries, this person was actually still alive; his life force was incredibly resilient.
While the two people in the shadows were shocked by Jack Clark’s terrible wounds, the monsters in the distance were also deterred by an intangible oppression emanating from Jack Clark, hesitating to attack immediately.
But at that moment, Jack Clark was not in the mood to pay them any attention, he was thoughtfully surveying his surroundings.
At this time, he perceived that this world had not even a hint of ‘energy,’ like Blue Star had not entered the Mythical Era, with only air and oxygen floating between heaven and earth.
Beyond that, the rules of this world were stable, the laws unshakeable, as if it were a world utterly devoid of transcendent powers.
In this situation, he was unable to absorb the energy of heaven and earth to quickly heal his injuries, and the Law Divine Power that had slightly recovered inside his body was diminishing with every bit he used.
This realization made Jack Clark somewhat astonished. Was this the Guiding of Time? What place was this? Could there be a means here to resolve the Time Chaos eroding his body?
While Jack Clark was silently sensing the conditions of this World, the monsters in the distance began to grow restless.
Smelling the strong ‘scent’ wafting from Jack Clark’s body, the creature resembling an armored Demon could hardly contain itself and let out a furious roar.
Roar!
In an instant, all the monsters joined in with hissing roars, their eyes fixated on Jack Clark with a blood-red frenzy, and then, with a thunderous charge, they lunged toward him.
Seeking death.
Jack Clark raised an eyebrow; although this ‘world’ prevented the mobilization of Law Power, it didn’t affect his physical body.
[There’s more, I’m working hard to write it, I got back too late today…]
At that moment, a figure emerged slowly from a pit, his black hair speckled with white, dressed in tattered Black Gold battle armor, surrounded by an almost imperceptible terrifying aura.
Hiss! Upon clearly seeing that figure, the two people in the shadows subconsciously drew in a cold breath.
