chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1206: Chapter 474 The Lost Ancient Human Race, The Giant Beast Roars Chapter 1206: Chapter 474 The Lost Ancient Human Race, The Giant Beast Roars Looking at the black-haired young man slowly approaching, Sara Williams and Sherry Williams instantly felt their breath oppressed.
Although Jack Clark had already concealed his aura, the state of his ruined body, coupled with the terrifying strength capable of demolishing an entire district with a single punch, still created a formidable sense of oppression.
Suddenly, Sara moved in front of her sister, as a burst of pure and powerful Qi Blood exploded within her, bursting through the air to form a gust of wind.
This strength of Qi Blood could be compared to the Fourth Layer Heaven in intensity, proving to be “not weak.”
“What do you want to do?” Sara asked, her expression guarded and her gaze sharp, but Jack Clark couldn’t understand what she said.
However, Jack could guess what she meant from her serious and cautious demeanor.
“What is this place?” Jack’s voice was deep, resonating with soul power, and his eyes even revealed a pair of black gold vertical pupils that seemed to overshadow everything.
Boom!
Under the heavy gaze of those terrifying soul-powered pupils, the Williams sisters’ consciousness shook, invaded by a dreadful soul force.
Sara instinctively replied, “This is North River City.”
“What is this world called, and what is the current time?”
“This world is known as the Lost World, and the current year is 9088 according to the Lost Calendar…”
Subsequently, through a psychic connection and questioning the woman called Sara, Jack gradually gained some understanding of this world.
The Lost World consisted of a central continent stretching over 50,000 kilometers from north to south, about 30,000 kilometers from east to west, several overseas continents, countless islands, and an even more vast ocean several times larger in area.
This world was mainly populated by dinosaur-like creatures; the largest spanned hundreds of meters in length, as vast as mountains, while the smaller ones varied in countless species, measuring around 2 meters.
Despite their massive size, these dinosaur-like creatures were not the rulers of this world; it was the humans who had developed technology who were in command.
Comparing from Sara’s description of the level of technology, the civilization of this world was roughly equivalent to that of Blue Star in the ’60s, with inventions like airplanes and cannons already in existence.
Additionally, the entire world was divided into over forty countries, large and small, with a total population of over five billion.
Then, a few years ago, the End Day arrived.
It was said that an expedition team from the strongest country, the White Lion Empire, while exploring an overseas island, discovered ancient human remains there.
A terrible virus sealed within those ancient human ruins quickly spread into the air and water as the site was opened, causing mutations in all life forms worldwide.
Humans included, countless people became bloodthirsty mutants in the blink of an eye, furiously attacking all living beings around them, devouring flesh and blood to evolve in a frenzy.
Now, several years later, the entire world has been dominated by these evolved monsters, societal order has collapsed, and only a few survivors linger on in hiding.
However, crisis can also mean opportunity. With the outbreak of mutations, many people found their bodies growing stronger due to viral infection, and even developed ‘Blood Qi.’
Those with Blood Qi could circulate it within their bodies, practicing ancient Basic Body Refining techniques to step into the extraordinary. Sara, for instance, was one of the Body Refiners.
This discovery also confirmed that the legends that had been circulating for thousands of years were true.
Throughout this world, official media and folklore alike have perpetuated the idea that all humans here are fundamentally part of a more powerful branch of the human civilization.
However, due to unknown reasons, they were lost and fell into this world devoid of extraordinary energy, which prevented them from leaving.
Additionally, unable to practice cultivation due to environmental factors, their Qi Blood dried up, and the older generation of ‘strong men’ one by one passed away, their inheritances severed, leaving behind only some ineffective ‘Cultivation Methods.’
To combat nature and the colossal Dragon-type Giant Beasts, humanity has gone through multiple extinctions, evolving from an initial population of tens of thousands to now tens of billions.
Furthermore, hundreds of years ago, humanity took to the path of technology, aiming to use the power of technology to explore the world and leave this world behind.
While technology progressed, many ancient cultivation techniques continued to circulate among the people, and even official state archives guarded secret tomes.
Although in the past, the lack of Heavenly Energy made cultivation impossible, some Mental and Meditation Methods were still effective, albeit weakly so.
And as the mutations persisted over the years, humans could practice Body Refinement while the monsters evolved even more horrifically.
Powerful Mutant monsters could match the Overlord Dragons, akin to Catastrophes, penetrating large human bases, devouring flesh and blood, and even ‘souls.’
Currently, humanity in this world is on the brink of extinction, with communication across different regions broken, unable to produce and develop, and no one knows the state of affairs elsewhere.
As Sara ‘finished speaking,’ a look of surprise flickered across Jack’s eyes.
He hadn’t expected to discover traces of an ancient human race here.
It seemed that the ancient humans’ expedition truly had ventured into the mythical world, engaging in war with various mighty racial civilizations, but ultimately got ‘raided’ in the great battle themselves.
And in the aftermath of the triggered Void Descent, the coordinates of Blue Star and even the Solar System had shifted, leaving the powerful warriors of the ancient civilization unable to find their way home, unable to return.
This lost human tribe had fallen into this world nearly ten thousand years ago, having lost connection with the ancient civilization and unaware of their precise location in time and space.
From the vague connection with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s beast body, Jack deduced he must have returned to some point in the past, forming a link with this lost tribe of humans.
It appeared that the solution to the time curse could be found in the ancient human ‘Cultivation Methods.’
As Jack stood there deep in thought, Sara and Sherry wore expressions of panic on their faces, instinctively retreating a couple of steps in defense.

chapters.title: Chapter 1207 - 1207 474 The Lost Ancient Human Race The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1207: Chapter 474 The Lost Ancient Human Race, The Giant Beast Roars_2 Chapter 1207: Chapter 474 The Lost Ancient Human Race, The Giant Beast Roars_2 Under the terrifying pull of Jack Clark’s Soul Power, their consciousness had remained clear just now, so they remembered everything that had happened.
“Sister, what, what just entered our ‘bodies’?” Sherry asked in a somewhat panicked manner.
“I don’t know either, but don’t worry, Sherry, I will protect you.” Saying this, Sara slowly drew her long knife and looked at Jack Clark with a solemn expression.
Although the Human in front of her was terrifying, having survived the Doomsday with her sister until now, Sara had already experienced countless life-and-death battles over the years.
Even though she knew she was no match for this frightening man, she had the courage to draw her blade.
While Sara was on guard with serious caution, Jack Clark spoke indifferently, “Relax, I have no malice towards you. I only linked our spirits momentarily to facilitate communication.”
“Besides, with my strength, if I truly intended to do something to you, do you think you would have the power to resist?”
Jack Clark used the Lost Language this time, and his words made Sara pause for a moment.
Sherry blinked her eyes naively and said, “Sister, it seems like he has a point. This big brother probably means us no harm.”
At this moment, Jack Clark waved his hand towards the two women, “Alright, you can go now. I need to find a place to heal my wounds.”
Jack Clark’s injuries were serious this time. The blade from Tarolia contained ultimate power comparable to the Rule, and because of the Demon God’s Descent, he hadn’t had the time to dispel it.
Later, when using the Heaven Talisman to teleport, he was hit by Diorus with a halberd which shattered the surrounding power of the Rule, further injuring his True Body.
Moreover, after maintaining the Destruction Form of the Emperor Dragon for a long time, with only a hundred years of Life Origin remaining, his healing ability was also slightly affected.
Otherwise, even with the suppression of powers like those from Tarolia and a trace from Diorus, his terrifying physical recovery capabilities would have healed these external wounds long ago.
Watching Jack Clark, who was about to leave, Sara suddenly said, “Although you killed that Tyrant, this abandoned city is still unsafe.
“As fellow humans surviving the Doomsday, we should help each other. Our Survivor Base is just over fifty kilometers from here. It’s a hidden place, you can rest and recover there.”
Sara’s invitation made Sherry stunned, she instinctively said, “But sister, there’s no more room in our base…”
Sherry inexplicably feared this ‘Person’ whose body was battered.
“It’s okay, this gentleman can stay at our house.” Saying this, Sara took off her helmet, revealing an almost perfect face, and said with a slight smile,
“Hello, my name is Sara Williams, and this is my sister, Sherry Williams.”
Looking at Sherry, who was pretending to be innocent to lessen his malice, and then at Sara, who had taken off her helmet, especially noting the sincerity in her eyes, Jack Clark suddenly smiled.
“My name is Jack Clark, and I’m sorry for earlier, when I forced you to speak.”
When a strong man is angry, he draws his sword on someone stronger, while a weaker man, when angry, draws a knife on someone even weaker.
Similarly, although Jack Clark’s cultivation had already stepped into the realm of Myth, he remained amiable towards those weaker than him, much like how the Human Experts like the Mysterious Martial Sky King did.
Of course, if the other was an enemy, it would be a different story; in his eyes, enemies have no distinction between strong and weak.
But because of the red cracks on his face, Jack Clark’s smile looked somewhat frightening at the moment, bereft of his usual suave beauty.
Just as Jack Clark was preparing to follow the Williams sisters to find a place to heal his wounds before exploring this world,
in the Rift World, the Silver Giant Dragon patted the side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and let out an excited roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, Tiger Three is back.”
Tiger Three is back? The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly retracted some of its attention.
Just then, at the ‘world’s’ end, a waterfall burst apart as a Mutated Tiger Whale, one hundred and twenty meters long, and a Little Tiger Whale, sixty meters long, surged upwards.
After several days, the Black Tiger Whale, having absorbed the energy from an Ancient Clam Pearl equivalent to a High-level Divine Object, had reached the Peak of the eighth level.
Including the Little Tiger Whale, which had also reached the Level 7 Peak on the verge of a breakthrough to level eight, thanks to two pearls relative to God-level Resources.
Following Tiger Whale Third Brother for half a year, the Female Little Tiger Whale, which was initially just a common Mutated Tiger Whale, had grown surprisingly fast with a wealth of precious resources.
Looking at the two excited Tiger Whales swimming back, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes showed a daze. Two days had passed already?
While only a short while had passed for Jack Clark, in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s perception of time, two days had gone by – a nearly hundredfold difference in the sense of time between consciousness.
Boom! The lake surface exploded with water, and the Black Tiger Whale burst out of the water excitedly, looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast standing atop the crystal High Platform, calling out excitedly.
“Uncle, uncle, I’m back. I’ve found something good.”
Without waiting for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to speak, the Single-horned Spawn Roc floating a kilometer high in the air let out a steam whistle, “Tiger Three, what good thing did you find?”
The Female Tiger Whale Kitty Jones, also floating over the lake surface, tilted her head slightly, curious.
The Black Tiger Whale beat the water surface with its flippers, issuing a proud cooing, “This time I swam towards the Southeast for a long time and then I came across a different race.”
“That race lives in a large Plane World beneath the sea, inhabited by a type of ancient clam that can produce a good thing called Ancient Clam Pearl.”
“The larger these clams are, the stronger the pearls they breed, and it is said that the pearls produced by the largest Ancient Divine Clam can enhance the strength of even those at Titan Level.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1208 - 1208 474 The Lost Ancient Human Race The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1208: Chapter 474: The Lost Ancient Human Race, The Giant Beast Roars_3 Chapter 1208: Chapter 474: The Lost Ancient Human Race, The Giant Beast Roars_3 The Black Tiger Whale had just finished speaking when the Silver Giant Dragon roared and interrupted, “Roar! Tiger Three, that ‘pearl’ thingy, can it really enhance the strength of Titan creatures?”
Yeep!! It can, it was personally told to me by a member of a different race whom I saved. Tiger Whale Third Brother nodded affirmatively.
“Tim Abott, let’s hurry and kill those creatures from other races,” the Silver Giant Dragon said excitedly. A treasure capable of enhancing the strength of Titan creatures must at least reach the Law Level.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle also let out a low growling roar: Roar Roar!! Well done, Tiger Three, you’re much more useful than that Joe fellow.
Proudly nodding, the Black Tiger Whale boasted: Yeep!! I’ve always been smarter than Dad; it’s too stupid. One day, I will defeat it and take its Dragon King position.
Looking at the Black Tiger Whale who kept talking about defeating the Single-horned Spawn Roc every day, the other Giant Beasts all revealed looks of amusement, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched.
Boom!
Just at that moment, a massive whale tail descended from the sky and landed ruthlessly on the Black Tiger Whale’s head, instantly causing the sea water to explode. The terrible force directly blasted it hundreds of meters down underwater.
In the air, the Female Tiger Whale slowly retracted her tail and looked at the Black Tiger Whale emerging from underwater, softly chirping, “Third Brother, you must not speak ill of your father; it has been working very hard.”
Looking at the Female Tiger Whale with her serene gaze, the rebellious Black Tiger Whale instinctively shrank back, displaying a look of fawning.
Yeep!! The wife is the best. The Single-horned Spawn Roc in the sky was so touched it almost cried; life is so hard.
It remembered how it used to roam the seas for good things to provide for the family, often being chased by powerful Unique Beasts, nearly getting killed many times.
But its three sons were always rebellious.
The eldest and the second were still okay; though they wanted to challenge its position, they usually didn’t say it out loud. Only this third one was always shouting about defeating it, to take over its position.
At that thought, the Single-horned Spawn Roc somehow yearned for the ‘well-behaved’ eldest and second.
Meanwhile, on the lake surface, the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah’s nine heads peeked over, making a cacophony of roars: “Roar Roar Roar!! Tiger Three, what does that pearl look like?”
Yeep!! I almost forgot, I even brought back a sample.
The Black Tiger Whale opened its mouth and exhaled an air bubble containing the remaining palm-sized pearl, from which a rich Energy Halo emanated.
Suspended by an Invisible Power, the bubble soared up into the air to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which gently clamped it between the tips of its two Dragon Claws.
“This energy inside!” The Destruction Emperor Dragon revealed a look of surprise.
The energy within this pearl was very rich. Although it would be of little use to him if ingested, it was beneficial to all Transcendent creatures below the Myth Level.
This kind of energy was similar to that of the Lava Giant’s Crystal Core, containing rich and pure Life Energy, but gentler.
Instantly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly stood upright and let out a deep, resonant roar, “Third Brother, how many of these ancient clam creatures are there in that Plane World?”
Yeep!! I haven’t counted them. We, the Giant Beasts who joined, are not allowed to get close, but I heard there are many, many of them.
Many, huh? The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curved slightly upward.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s massive double wings spread furiously behind him, eclipsing the sky, and in a world-shaking moment, tore open a pitch-black crack several thousand kilometers long.
No sooner had the Destruction Emperor Dragon appeared above the sea than the whole of Heaven and Earth began to tremble, his body erupting with countless thunderbolts that transformed into a thunderous magnetic shockwave, sweeping over an area of more than a thousand kilometers.
Boom!
Above, the dark clouds stirred wildly, and dazzling lightning bolts twinkled, as if the Heavenly Dao was enraged. With the convergence of countless natural lightning bolts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Aura surged once again.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, emanating brilliant lightning all over his body, let out a heaven-reaching roar and shot up into the clouds.
In an instant, the oppressive dark clouds churned, and countless electric charges glowed brightly as they converged towards the center, forming a giant rotating Thunder Cloud Storm.
Indistinctly, the outline of scales and claws flashed within the Thunder Cloud Storm, their presence earth-shattering.
“Roar! Tim Abott, wait for the Great Sesi,” roared the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by a storm as it flew out of the thousand-kilometer-long crack along with the gold-blue Giant Dragon.
Following them were the Kamaitachi Beast stretching over a thousand meters, the red Candle Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, and the Female Tiger Whale with her domain unfurled, as well as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah.
In addition, there was also the Blue Giant Crab, carrying the Black Tiger Whale and the magnetic Little Tiger Whale.
From within the depths of the dark clouds echoed the Dragon Roar: “All beasts follow me, let’s move all those ancient clams back home.” Immediately, the storm of thunderclouds that spanned over a thousand kilometers moved thunderously.
“Roar! Slaughter them, the Great Scythia shall run rivers of blood today!”
Roar Roar Roar!! Charge, Kido wants to take on eighteen!
Gulp Gulp!! And there’s the Great Crab General, aiming for eighty today.
Amidst the raging wind and storm, the sea surface was hit by tsunamis a kilometer high as one Beast after another soared in the high altitude, unleashing ferocious roars into the vastness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1209 - 1209 475 Titan Longa King Destruction

﻿Chapter 1209: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible Chapter 1209: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible Within a small world with a diameter exceeding three thousand kilometers, tufts of cotton-like white clouds floated in the sky, while a gentle breeze wafted over the azure sea surface, shimmering with light.
Woo!
A whale-like Giant Beast nearly three hundred meters in length burst through the sea water, leaping hundreds of meters above the sea surface before crashing down with a thunderous splash.
Bang! The splash of water exploded into the sky, rising a kilometer high before slowly falling back down, creating a dazzling rainbow in the mist diffused by the light, a scene of utter beauty.
In contrast to the outside world where the raging wind caused Dark Heavens and Earth in the Chaotic Sea Region, this small world was like a wonderland with gentle energy.
In such a comfortable environment, the different races and Giant Beasts dwelling here showed only weak signs of hostility in their eyes, and enormous beasts could be occasionally seen swimming through the sea.
Beyond that, many colossal Ancient clams lay dormant on the seabed.
These Ancient clams had thick, white-gray shells; even the smallest had a diameter of over a hundred meters, with larger ones ranging from a few hundred meters to a kilometer, and the largest one spanned over seven thousand meters in diameter.
This most massive Ancient Divine clam sprawled on the seabed like a small mountain range, with its highest point reaching over four thousand meters, jutting out above the sea surface.
At such a height and area, calling it a small island was hardly an exaggeration, with even moss and low trees growing on it, bursting with Vitality.
At this moment, the Ancient Divine clam was slightly opening its shell, inhaling and exhaling Heavenly Energy and sea water, creating massive vortexes with the tide around it, an impressive display of power.
Besides this gigantic Ancient Divine clam, there were Longa Tribesmen surrounding the other Ancient clams, feeding them Heaven and Earth Treasure when they opened their shells.
Apart from below the sea, there were also numerous islands scattered throughout the vast small world, with many rugged buildings erected upon them, housing several hundreds of thousands of four-armed Longa Tribesmen.
These Longa Tribesmen, many of whom were in their juvenile phase spanning several to over ten meters in size, followed the “women” of the different races to cultivate seaweed plants and herd fish.
The islands were also planted with many fruit trees, with well-defined work roles, marking the beginning of tribe civilization.
However, outside of this peaceful interior, the atmosphere in the small world was somewhat tense.
In the shallow sea a kilometer deep, the waves raged and the sea water was murky, with over three hundred thousand Longa Alien Tribe members and over a thousand Giant Beasts spreading out over a hundred kilometers.
Ahead stood a Giant Beast with a shoulder height of over seven hundred meters and a body length of fourteen hundred meters; it had a horse-like form covered in blue scales, and a draconic head with Dragon Claws.
This Mythical-level late period Giant Beast was surrounded by blue light waves, undulating like sea waves and radiating a heavy and majestic presence that resonated with the ocean.
By the side of this Dragon Horse Beast stood Kerla, a thousand meters long, and a two-thousand-meter-long Titan Longa also with four arms.
This Titan Longa was covered with Golden Scales, with a lower body winding for over a thousand meters like a Flood Dragon, and a row of Dorsal Fins extending to its dragon tail, resembling a meandering mountain range.
The standing upper body was comparatively ‘slender’, with a tapered waist, a protruding chest, and Golden Dragon Scales covering the body like thick armor.
As the scales reached the face, they faded, leaving pale golden patterns and revealing a beautiful face similar to that of a human woman, complete with soft features. Hundreds of meters of golden hair hung down, threaded with a pair of dragon horns.
This six-armed Titan Longa King held a two-thousand-meter long Bronze Trident in one hand, a giant stone radiating red light in another, and a sea snail weapon in yet another hand.
The Titan Longa King, resembling a sea god, was surrounded by countless Giant Beasts and Longa soldiers, with the invisible pull of the rule summoning the Power of Heaven and Earth and covering a two hundred kilometer area.
Yet, at this moment, all the Longas had grave expressions, filled with a killing intent as they stared ahead. There, half the sea area was aflame with dark red flames, gathering over a million members from the Black Abyss Alien Race.
Among this army of Armored Lizard People resembling humanoid lizards, Giant Black flame whale beasts moved around, radiating intense heat with eyes full of brutality.
Hovering above these Black Abyss Alien Race members was a Titan Flame Whale, two thousand four hundred meters in size, comparable to an island, with dark red liquid flames burning around it, shrouding the sky.
This Titan Flame Whale was covered in thick black scales, with dozens of narrow limbs spanning hundreds to a thousand meters in length and just tens of meters in thickness, ablaze with fire along its back and sides, making it appear ferocious.
Meanwhile, in the sea floated an eight-hundred-meter-long Dark Flame Whale and a fifteen-hundred-meter-long Mythical Peak Flame Whale.
Between these two Mythical-level Dark Flame Whales stood a thirteen-hundred-meter-tall Armored Lizard King, upright and wielding a Rough giant blade.
Several days after the departure of the Little Tiger Whale, the Black Abyss Alien Race had once again amassed their mighty army to attack.
This time, deploying most of their strength, they aimed to conquer the Longa Tribe’s small world in one fell swoop and occupy this abundant Plane.
Looking at Kerla a hundred kilometers away, the Armored Lizard King’s voice was deep, “Kerla, I told you I would tear off your head.”
“And today, it’s not just you—your Longa King and all members of the Longa Tribe shall die as well.”
As the Armored Lizard King’s voice fell, the hundred thousands of Armored Lizard People behind him let out roars and shouts of excitement.
Kill.
Kill all those ugly Longa Tribes!
Roar! The Titan Flame Whale standing within the fire in the sky let out a savage roar, instantly causing explosions on the sea surface.
At the command of the Titan King, over a million Armored Lizard People’s bodies shimmered with black light, and their Heavy Water talent unleashed a Black Water Tsunami a kilometer high, roaring forth.
In the sea, each Black flame whale beast also let out a ferocious roar, expelling liquid-like dark red flames that ignited the heavy water, turning the entire ocean into a sea of fire.

chapters.title: Chapter 1210 - 1210 475 Titan Longa King Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1210: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible_2 Chapter 1210: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible_2 “`
In an instant, a fire sea tsunami, a hundred kilometers wide and a kilometer high, roared between heaven and earth, the sea surface ablaze. The burning, intense flames above illuminated the world below like a fiery inferno descending upon it.
Beholding this spectacle, the Titan King Ja of Longa raised his bronze trident high and proclaimed, “I am the supreme and mighty kin of the Longa, ruler of the seas. All who dare offend my majesty shall be buried in the ocean’s depths.”
Boom! With King Ja’s decree, a burst of endless golden light illuminated heaven and earth in an instant.
Under the radiance of the golden light, the sea water within a radius of hundreds of kilometers turned tumultuous. Golden sea water shot up to the sky, forming countless twisters of water, each hundreds of meters thick and stretching tens of kilometers long.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The golden water spears, imbued with the power of Laws, were terrifyingly potent, each strike powerful enough to destroy a mountain. They collided with the flames that engulfed the sky, unleashing a terrifying force.
The massive bodies of Titan-level creatures fused with the Laws, their outward strength capable of disrupting space, forming a ‘Laws World’ of a greater scope than even human Heavenly Kings.
King Ja of Longa swept his trident, the dazzling Golden Law Power swirling around it, tearing through the sea of fire and a dozen fiery tentacles.
Crash! Crash! Crash! The mighty collision caused the Laws to crumble, and heaven and earth trembled.
Just then, as the sea of fire below dispersed, a monstrous maw capable of devouring the sky and earth opened in a furious roar, its teeth tearing towards King Ja of Longa, ripping through space wherever it went.
The four arms of King Ja of Longa held a red boulder radiating dazzling red light, creating the shadow of a mountain tens of thousands of meters tall crashing down.
Boom! The furious force struck down upon the head of the Titan Flame Whale, and a terrifying shockwave burst forth in an instant, shattering space while the red mountain shadow dissipated under the mighty recoil.
The Titan Flame Whale was also repelled, its head’s scale armor cracking as it let out an enraged roar, causing the sea of fire to surge wildly with fiery tentacles thousands of meters long emerging.
As the two Titan-level creatures collided, their formidable powers shaking heaven and earth, the mighty armies of the two races also clashed thunderously.
The individual combat power of the two alien races wasn’t vastly different; though the Longa Alien Tribe had four arms and bronze weapons, the Armored Lizard People had sharp double claws and six flexible tentacles.
Additionally, with their talent for manipulating Black Heavy Water, and a numerical advantage that was several times greater, they gained the upper hand as soon as they engaged in combat.
However, compared to the chaotic formations of the Armored Lizard People, the Longa Tribe was considerably more elite.
Groups of thirty Longa aliens formed a squad, with a priest captain chanting archaic verses akin to a war song, unleashing a power of blue light waves.
Amplified by the song-like buff, the squads and the surrounding Level 7 Colossi had their strengths doubled, their coordinated formations proving sufficient to contend with several times their number of enemies.
When these squads of Longa aliens numbered in the hundreds, the battle formations they formed could amplify the strength of forces including Eighth Level Beasts by twofold.
An army of three thousand Longa, coordinated with a Level 9 Giant Beast, formed a giant blue shadow in the battle, rampaging through the battlefield and tearing apart numerous Armored Aliens and Black flame whale beasts.
The most imposing figures, however, were the Mythical Longa Kerla and the Mythical-level late stage Dragon Horse Beast.
Surrounded by tens of thousands of Longa elite warriors, and with the war chants from the priests enhancing their powers, the auras of the two Mythical creatures surged dramatically, nearly ascending an entire minor realm.
This scene bore some similarity to the War Pattern used by the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, another form of army amplification.
And when this kind of amplification was bestowed upon the Giant Beast creatures, the unleashed power was even more formidable, allowing the late-Mythical stage Dragon Horse Beast to face off against the Mythical Peak Black flame whale beast.
The mid-Mythical stage Kerla, brandishing a bronze trident, confronted both a mid-Mythical stage Armored Lizard king and a novice stage Flame whale beast.
As the two colossal races clashed, the sea surface was soon stained red with blood, and the violent energy threw the ocean within a thousand kilometers into chaos.
And amidst the great battle between the two tribes, suddenly, a Titan-level terrifying aura approached swiftly from afar.
Roar!
Feeling the presence of a foreign Titan-level creature, the Titan Flame Whale let out a roar. Its flames vibrated, and it moved away from King Ja of Longa, the two titans standing off against each other over a hundred kilometers apart.
“Cease fire!”
Roar!
Following the commands of the two Titan Kings, Kerla and the others also swiftly pulled back from their opponents. The mighty army retreated and, from a distance of several tens of kilometers, stood off against each other on the sea’s surface.
Kerla looked up, puzzled, and asked, “My king, what has happened?”
Standing amidst the golden ocean, trident in hand, the Longa King gazed into the distance with a grave expression, “A Titan-level creature has appeared. It is unknown whether it is friend or foe.”
Soon, as both alien armies watched, storm clouds thundered ominously on the horizon, casting the sky in darkness with colossal tornadoes stretching from cloud to earth.
Among the clouds, aside from the formidable Titan-level pressure, several auras of Mythical Giant Beasts were also present.
Boom! A thick bolt of lightning, tens of meters wide and tens of kilometers long, struck the sea surface in an explosive crash. The scattering electric arcs spread over a dozen kilometers, revealing the corpses of numerous sea creatures with each crackle.
The thundering light also illuminated the world. Between the tornado columns soared a Silver Giant Dragon with a wingspan of over a thousand meters, a golden-blue Giant Dragon roaring with nearly the same wingspan.
Besides them, there was a seven hundred meter long red Divine Dragon, a Single-horned Spawn Roc spreading its wings, and a dark red Kamaitachi Beast with wings spanning nearly three thousand meters.
One Titan creature, five Mythical Giant Beasts—this force made both alien tribes tense.
And below, amidst the churning waves, lay giant Dragon Turtles the size of small hills, Flood Dragons with nine dragon heads, Blue Giant Crabs wielding massive claws, and black and white Tiger Whales.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1211 - 1211 475 Titan Longa King Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1211: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible_3 Chapter 1211: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible_3 Wait, Tiger Whale…
Roar! Lord Kerla, I’ve called mom, dad, and Uncle to come and help.
Watching the black Tiger Whale that excitedly roared and leaped above the sea surface, Kerla and some Level 9 Giant Beasts, as well as the entire Longa Tribe, were all stunned.
Observing this scene, the Titan Longa King, standing amidst the golden ocean, paused, his gaze flickered, and he slowly said, “Kerla, do you know ‘it’?”
Previously, the black Tiger Whale, which had only recently joined the Longa Tribe and was just a level eight, hadn’t been qualified to meet the Titan Longa King.
Regaining his composure, Kerla nodded respectfully and said, “Yes, King, this Tiger Whale Giant Beast is named Tiger Overlord. It was introduced by Kelterta and joined our clan.”
“And during the battle that erupted earlier with the Black Abyss Clan, Tiger Overlord fought very bravely, killing eight same-level Level 8 Black Flame Whale Beasts.”
“At that time, seeing its bravery, I awarded it with a Top-level Divine Ancient Clam Pearl as a reward to help it make an earlier breakthrough to Level 9.”
“After eating the top-level Ancient Clam Pearl, Tiger Overlord said it wanted to go back and call its family to help. At that time, I thought its parents were just Level 9 whale Giant Beasts, but unexpectedly…”
Looking at the sky-covering Thunder Cloud Storm and the Tornado Column where five Mythical Creatures circled, Kerla didn’t know how to express his astonishment.
Damn, you said your parents were Level 9 Tiger Whale Giant Beasts, what’s with this group of Mythical Giant Beasts?
And the terrifying Titan Aura in those clouds, which was even more frightening than their King, had him, a Mythical Creature, trembling all over with fear even from over a hundred kilometers away.
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon unfolded its wings and arrived at the edge of the Thunder Cloud Storm. Gazing at the millions of different races, its eyes revealed a bloodthirsty excitement as it let out a ferocious roar.
“Roar! Tim Abott, should we slaughter all these creatures?” The words of the Silver Giant Dragon sent shivers down the spines of the Longa Tribe, who thought they had arrived as reinforcements.
Just then, a golden-blue Giant Dragon also flew out excitedly, its body radiating a resplendent Seven-Colored Glow: “Roar! The great Telsafi wants to see rivers of blood, let’s kill them all, Thunderflame.”
Roar roar roar!! Kill them all, completely annihilate them, Kidora is going to fight twenty today.
As the Nine-headed Flood Dragon ecstatically rolled about on the sea surface, their tails twisted together in a frenzy, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Blue Giant Crab, and Single-horned Spawn Roc, along with other Giant Beasts, also revealed a murderous intent in their eyes.
Lately, under the influence of the wild energy in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, these Giant Beasts had become even more savage, their combative and bloodthirsty nature intensified.
As for the overwhelming numbers of the enemy beasts, these Giant Beasts didn’t care, for the Destruction Emperor Dragon was invincible.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon and the other Giant Beasts were getting restless, eager to attack both alien tribes at once with their ‘numbers’, a deep and majestic roar resounded through Heaven and Earth.
“Scythia, we’ve come this time because we agreed to help Tiger Three, we can’t kill indiscriminately.”
Boom!
The Thunder Cloud Storm began to spin, creating a Hollow in its center a hundred kilometers in diameter, revealing a Black-red Colossal Beast that was one thousand nine hundred meters long, with a formidable and slender figure.
As the figure of the Destruction Emperor Dragon appeared, an indescribable oppressive force spread, all creatures instinctively felt palpitations, fear, and their tails went limp as they subconsciously wanted to bow down.
It was as if they weren’t facing a Titan Giant Beast but the supreme, majestic Firmament itself.
Such a terrifying presence left even the mid-period Titan Longa King and the Titan Flame Whale feeling a bit shocked, with a solemn look in their eyes. This early Titan Giant Beast was very strong.
Very frightening.
Boom boom boom!!
Dense lightning flashed chaotically within the Thunder Cloud Storm, radiating dazzling brightness and scorching heat that surged towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon, turning its surroundings within tens of kilometers into a Thunder Pool.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, with heavy footsteps that shattered the Void, moved seemingly slowly but actually covered tens of kilometers at a terrifying speed to the edge of the storm.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze slowly swept over the hundreds of thousands of Longa Alien Tribe and then over the other side, with the more than a million from the Black Abyss Clan, before finally looking at the golden Longa King and emitting a low growl.
“Greetings, King of Longa, I am one of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire’s Dragon Kings, Thunderflame Dragon King, Brock Abbott!”
The Titan Longa King paused, and slowly said, “Greetings, I am Alicia Cresty. May I know the purpose of Thunderflame Dragon King’s visit this time?”
In response to the Longa King’s inquiring gaze, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “As I said before, we’ve come here at the request of Tiger Three to help the Nobles.”
“Tiger Three is one of my Dragon Palace Cavalry Generals. It was lost and far from the power range of the Dragon Palace, and came across dangers in the ocean many times, getting heavily injured.”
“If it hadn’t been for good luck, meeting a warrior named Kelterta from your Nobles to help, it might have already died at sea.”
“While Tiger Three may be weak in strength, it is a descendant of my brother Joe, and by helping it, you’ve also helped our Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.”
“Therefore, at its request, I have specifically led a mighty army to come to your aid, to help you defeat this evil Black Abyss Clan.”
The low growls of the Destruction Emperor Dragon echoed through Heaven and Earth, all of Longa Alien Tribe and the Giant Beasts turned their gaze to the excitedly leaping black Tiger Whale on the sea surface, feeling some surprise and excitement.
They hadn’t expected the backer of that level eight Tiger Whale to be so strong, standing with five Mythical Giant Beasts and one terrifying Titan Giant Beast, this time they were sure to win.
And among the Longa Tribe’s mighty army, hundreds from the Longa Alien Tribe looked towards their leading shaman, leaving Kelterta somewhat baffled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1212 - 1212 475 Titan Longa King Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1212: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible_4 Chapter 1212: Chapter 475: Titan Longa King, Destruction Invincible_4 What is happening, wasn’t it rescued by the Tiger Overlord while leading a squad in a fierce battle against the Black Abyss Clan? How did it become it helping the injured Tiger Overlord?
Just as the jubilant roars of the Longa Alien Tribe reached their peak, the gaze of that distant Titan Flame Whale grew serious.
One-on-one, it was confident that it could slowly suppress the Titan Longa King, but if another Titan Level Dragon-type Giant Beast were to join the fight, it would be somewhat strained.
A smile appeared on the ‘immense’ beautiful face of the Longa King, and he spoke softly, “Our Longa Tribe has always treated the creatures of the sea kindly. It was a mere coincidence that we helped the Dragon Palace Brave General.”
“However, our clan did face some pressure in today’s battle. Now that we have the aid of the Thunderflame Dragon King, King of the Dragon Palace, it should be enough…”
Roar!
Before the Titan Longa King could finish speaking, an overbearing and fierce roar came from afar, and the Titan Flame Whale, covered with flames, flew off into the distance.
Seeing the Titans’ early-stage Giant Beast and the Longa King about to form an alliance, the Titan Flame Whale, knowing that it could not win today, decisively opted to retreat.
The Armored Lizard People and the three Mythical-level Creatures below burst forth with their strength, rolling up the sea surface and over a million soldiers as they withdrew.
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon and the other Giant Beasts grew anxious.
“Roar! Don’t go, stop for the Great Sethia.”
Boom!
The Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by a black storm and bursting forth with its fastest speed, instantly turned into a streak of silver light, spanning over a hundred kilometers in the blink of an eye, pouncing toward the king of the Armored Lizard People.
“And the Great Telsafi, Sethia, leave one for me.”
Woo! Lord Jerry Jones will take down ten today.
Gurgle gurgle!! And you, Crab General, leave some for me, Great Sethia.
Roar! Me too, don’t forget me.
Before the Longa Alien Tribe could react, the Giant Beasts from the Dragon Palace rushed crazily towards the retreating Black Abyss Clan, as if fearing they would not catch up if they were even a step slower.
Kerla was deeply moved by this scene and couldn’t help lifting his Trident and shouting furiously,
“Kill, don’t let those detestable Black Abyss Clan members escape.”
“Charge, annihilate all enemies.”
Tens of thousands of the Longa Tribe roared excitedly, gathering thousands of Giant Beasts to pursue the entangled Armored Lizard People, igniting an even more brutal battle.
“Emond, you won’t be able to leave today.”
Boom! The sea surface erupted, and hundreds of water columns more than a few hundred meters wide and tens of thousands of meters tall burst forth, creating a colossal wall of golden water reaching to the sky.
The golden water columns, imbued with powerful Law Power, collided with the fiery dark red sea of fire in the sky, unleashing a terrible energy shock that roared and shook Heaven and Earth.
As the golden sea water crumbled and exploded, the Titan Longa King, holding a halberd, stood tall, his body radiating endless golden light illuminating the skies, blocking the path of the Titan Flame Whale.
“Respected Thunderflame Dragon King, that Titan Flame Whale is named Emond, and he is very strong. In a moment, please help me distract him, and I will burn my Origin to deal him a heavy blow.”
The unexpected arrival of reinforcements gave the Longa King a glimpse of opportunity. Today, even if he could not kill the Titan Flame Whale, he had to find a way to seriously injure it.
“There’s no need to go to such trouble.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a deep, sonorous roar. The Thunder Cloud Storm, covering more than a thousand kilometers, trembled, darkening the skies and engulfing the world.
Boom! An extremely ferocious aura burst forth within the darkening storm clouds.
Roar!
In the midst of countless intertwining black and red lightning, blue-purple thunder rumbling, and enveloping the hot golden flames, the Black-red Colossal Beast, nearly 1,900 meters long, almost lost its form.
The dazzling Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its double claws, tearing the Law World that surrounded the Titan Flame Whale, and pounced with terrifying power.
Roar! Faced with the terrifying Giant Beast that tore through the domain and leaped across tens of kilometers in an instant, the even larger and more solid Titan Flame Whale let out an enraged roar.
Suddenly, the black fire sea surged as the near-liquid flames, hot enough to melt space itself, formed into scores of fiery tendrils thousands of meters long that entangled towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Thump thump thump!! These tendrils, each capable of shattering a Mythical Giant Beast, were destroyed by the supremely domineering black and red lightning as they approached the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Under the influence of two Higher-order Laws imbued with destruction, every bit of matter and energy that approached the Destruction Emperor Dragon was instantly demolished, leaving nothing but unrivaled domination.
After the Destruction Emperor Dragon stepped into the Titan Level and achieved grand accomplishment in Law, its Deification Talent underwent a Transformation displaying its truly terrifying power.
Each of the transformed Deification Talents belonged to one of the most powerful branches. Just mastering one was formidable, let alone the integration of nine Higher-order Laws.
At this moment, even without entering the Deep Red Form, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was more than capable of crushing any Titan Giant Beast, even though those beasts possessed Higher-order Law Powers as well.
Boom!
[Wait a moment, there are still over a thousand words until the kill is completed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1213 - 1213 476 The Chaotic Empire and the Conjoined
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1213: Chapter 476: The Chaotic Empire and the Conjoined Sisters Chapter 1213: Chapter 476: The Chaotic Empire and the Conjoined Sisters The ocean blazed with golden flames, covering an area of over two hundred kilometers.
The Burning Heaven and Cooking Sea Glow melted the Earth, magma churned, and the intense energy released burst the air, creating a scorching radiation ring several kilometers thick.
The sea water surged back outside the golden radiation ring, boiling and roaring, forming a steaming cloud that covered the sky, which was then scattered by the hurricane.
Below the dense Thunder Cloud Storm, the Titan Longa King, over two thousand meters long, stood erect, surrounded by golden light, gazing down with a shocking look.
There, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood amidst the sea of flames, its body writhing with blue Thunder and streaks of black and red lightning, erasing the remains of the Titan Flame Whale Beast.
As the Giant Beast Body was torn apart, and its Soul Will and Life Origin were suppressed by nine Higher-order Laws, the creature had lost the will to resist.
This sight left the Longa King Alicia in awe and horror.
Although at the instant of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s arrival, she sensed a strong danger from this Black-red Colossal Beast, knowing it was very powerful and should not be viewed as an Early Titan.
But even with both parties being Titan Level Giant Beasts, the other party shouldn’t have been able to kill a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast in just a few moves.
Even creatures in the late period of Titan would need to fight for a long time to defeat a Mid-Mythical Stage Giant Beast, let alone crush and kill them.
So its true strength… A chill rose from the tailbone of the Longa King.
The Silver Giant Dragon ahead, and the golden blue Giant Dragon seemed to be shouting about the slaughter of all ‘people.’ If not for the King of Thunderflame being rather “reasonable.”
Just as Longa King Alicia was terrified at the afterthought, space vibrated. The Destruction Emperor Dragon, dragging the over two-kilometer-long corpse of the Titan Flame Whale, slowly walked up.
With every heavy step, space shattered, leaving behind a giant burning footprint in the intangible void.
Looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast wrapped in an aura of various Law Radiance, the even larger Longa King bowed its head respectfully and spoke.
“Respected King of Thunderflame, thank you for helping our clan slay a great enemy. To express our gratitude, I am willing to pledge the allegiance of the Longa Tribe to the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon paused while carrying the Titan Flame Whale’s corpse.
What’s going on, is this how different races from the mythical world express gratitude? Directly surrendering all their forces.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon quickly caught on. Clearly, the strength it displayed had utterly intimidated the Longa King, prompting the decision to submit.
This is the difference between different races and Giant Beasts.
Unlike the ‘straightforward’ Giant Beasts, the civilized different races are more shrewd and intelligent and thus easier to subdue.
Just as the Titan Longa King, to everyone’s surprise, chose to join the Dragon Palace, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and other Giant Beasts in the tumultuous ocean were already killing frenziedly.
Roar!
Above the sea surface, the Black Heavy Water around the Mid-Mythical Stage Armored Lizard King swirled, forming a water column over ten kilometers high that reached the heavens, pulverizing everything with a brutal roar.
The Silver Giant Dragon, ringed by a storm of Black Ice Crystals in the sky, roared; a frigid white Breath burst from its mouth, striking the heavy water column.
Under the power of the ultimate Ice Law, the heavy water continuously froze, forming immense chunks of breaks in the ice that exploded fiercely under the vortex’s power.
As the Breath slowly began to freeze the heavy water domain, the Giant Dragon’s double wings shimmered with silver light, distorting and folding the surrounding space.
Boom! Space distorted, the heavy water domain collapsed, and the Armored Lizard King roared angrily at the approaching Silver Giant Dragon amidst the black storm.
However, up against the Silver Giant Dragon, which mastered double Higher-order Laws, the Armored Lizard King was suppressed the instant they confronted each other.
The Dragon Horse Beast at the Mythical Peak, on the other hand, was clashing fiercely with the Kamaitachi, shaking heaven and Earth.
Surrounded by tens of thousands of Longa Tribe members, amplified by their chants, they were comparable to the Mythical Peak.
And the Kamaitachi Beast, which had awakened its ancient bloodline and mastered a Higher-order Law, had a combat power also comparable to the Mythical Peak. Teamed up, they soon gravely wounded the Flame Whale Beast.
As for the early Myth Flame Whale, it was crushed by the Candle Dragon, wielding two Higher-order Laws, and exploded in half with a single blow amidst the alternation of day and night.
With High-end power dominating, the remaining Single-horned Spawn Roc went into slaughter mode, its dark golden wings cutting through the air with slashes over two thousand meters long.
With each blow, the ocean was torn apart, creating cracks over ten kilometers long; countless Armored Lizard People were slaughtered, and numerous Level 9 Giant Beasts were slain.
Upon stepping into the Legendary Realm, the Level 9 Giant Beasts, which the Single-horned Spawn Roc found barely worth fleeing from atop the great ocean, stood no chance.
Whining with excitement, the Single-horned Spawn Roc let out a harsh scream, its mouth gaping like a Black Hole.
Boom! The sea surface tens of kilometers away was engulfed in darkness, suddenly collapsing; in an instant, a kilometer stretch of sea water and a Level 9 Black Flame Whale Beast disappeared.
Unlike the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Mythical-level golden blue Giant Dragon also began its slaughter.
The golden blue Giant Dragon, hovering at ten thousand meters altitude, spread its mighty wings, emitting a blinding Seven-Colored Glow, and thousands of red, blue, and purple crystals emerged.
These crystals, dozens of meters in diameter, all contained violent fire, water, and Thunder energies, raining down like High-Yield Missiles, covering an area of hundreds of kilometers.
Boom boom boom! The crystal elemental bombardment boiled the sea surface; amid the intense bombardment, hundreds of thousands of Armored Lizard People screamed in horror, desperately diving into the deep sea for cover.
As the two Mythical Giant Beasts rampaged, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and Blue Giant Crab, among other Level 9 Giant Beasts, also indulged in a murderous frenzy, their eyes bloody red and filled with a ruthless intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1214 - 1214 476 The Chaotic Empire and the Bandi
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1214: Chapter 476 The Chaotic Empire and the Bandi Sisters_2 Chapter 1214: Chapter 476 The Chaotic Empire and the Bandi Sisters_2 Relative to the Dragon Palace Giant Beasts who were even more diligent than the Longa Tribe, the Black Tiger Whale refrained from joining the battle, instead patrolling outside the battlefield with the Female Little Tiger Whale.
It would only take action when it occasionally found an injured Eighth Level Black Flame Whale Beast attempting to escape.
Whenever the Longa people saw the Black Tiger Whale, they would stand solemnly, gratitude shining in their eyes.
If not for the assistance of this friendly Tiger Whale Giant Beast today, they might have managed to repel the attack of the Black Abyss Clan but at a great cost, severely weakening their vital energy.
It wasn’t until half a day later that the battle finally calmed down.
In front of the Titan Longa King who joined the fight later, not a single member of the Black Abyss Clan or Black Flame Whale Beast escaped; they were all killed, and the sea water within hundreds of kilometers was dyed red, with corpses scattered throughout.
However, the Longa Tribe also suffered many casualties in the chaotic battle, including the Blue Giant Crab and other Giant Beasts who were also severely injured in the frenzied slaughter.
When the great battle subsided, while the Longa Tribe treated the wounded, the Blue Giant Crab and other Giant Beasts dragged the corpses of the Level 9 Giant Beasts towards Battle Central.
Gurgle, Gurgle!! Great King, I killed seven this time and found a Level 9 Life Crystal.
The first to swim back was the Blue Giant Crab, carefully holding a ‘tiny’ golden Life Crystal between its huge pincers as it waved them around.
But even now, this fellow was heavily wounded; not only was the carapace on its back torn and pierced by formidable strength, but it also only had three legs left on the left side.
These injuries all came from a Ninth Level Peak Black Flame Whale Beast that the Single-horned Spawn Roc had slashed into two halves, leaving only the head.
Even in its death throes, the Giant Beast had nearly killed the Mid-Level 9 Giant Crab.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “You performed well, but be more careful in the next fight. When there’s a significant disparity in strength, strategy is important; learn more from the Horned Lady.”
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t make another move after killing the Titan Flame Whale, his gaze remained focused on the entire battlefield.
Compared to the Silver Giant Dragon who seemed to slaughter wildly, as well as the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the most outstanding performer in this battle was actually the Female Tiger Whale.
Mastering the Dark Domain and the Devouring Talent, and having just reached Mid-Level 9, the Female Tiger Whale killed thirty-one Eighth Level Beasts and fifteen Level 9 Giant Beasts this battle.
Most of these Level 9 Giant Beasts were in the mid and early stages, plus two injured Late Stage 9, arguably the most same-tier kills.
Every move she made was a silent, noiseless, and instant kill—practically a perfect assassin.
However, even so, the praise from the Destruction Emperor Dragon thrilled the Blue Giant Crab immensely, causing its remaining three legs to shake excitedly as if it were playing tambourine.
“Roar! Tim Abott, today, the Great Scythia slew a Mythical opponent. It’s just that the fellow was too good at running, making the Great Scythia chase for half a day.”
The Silver Giant Dragon flew back excitedly, its claws gripping the corpse of the Armored Lizard King which was over a thousand meters long.
At that moment, the Golden Blue Giant Dragon also returned, with two bathtub-sized golden crystals in its huge claws, landing elegantly on the sea surface, bringing the raging wind with it.
Crackle, Crackle!! Under the Seven-Colored Glow, the sea surface froze, forming a crystalline ground for several kilometers.
Standing atop the transparent crystal ‘earth,’ the Golden Blue Giant Dragon extended its right claw towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon and roared lowly, “Thunderflame, I’ve found two Life Crystals.”
“Good work, Telsafi,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon said with a smile in his eyes as he took the two Life Crystals.
In this attack by the Black Abyss Alien Race’s mighty army, there were only three peak-Level-9 Giant Beasts. Apart from the one the Blue Giant Crab found, the Golden Blue Giant Dragon had killed the rest.
After interacting all this time, the Golden Blue Giant Dragon also knew that the Destruction Emperor Dragon was quite fond of Life Crystals.
Woo!! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, today I slaughtered many enemies.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, emanating red Killing Intent all over, flew back, its blood-red eyes filled with brutal ferocity, evidently still enveloped in the state of slaughter.
Then came the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, the Seven-headed Flood Dragon with two heads missing, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle with one segment of its tail bitten off—each one of them brimming with a desire to kill.
Today, in this battle, these creatures all went berserk with killing. Usually, they clamored for rivers of blood, and today their wishes were fulfilled. Misss Joseline… Huh, where’s Misss Joseline?
The Destruction Emperor Dragon raised his head, slowly growled towards the excitedly circling Silver Giant Dragon in the sky, “Scythia, have we forgotten something?”
Yiiya Yiiya!! Brother… where are they?
In the Rift Small World, the surface of the lake exploded, and the Purple Little Dragon flew up somewhat haphazardly, looking around the empty Rift World in confusion.
After consuming too many Ice Fish at once, the cold essence they contained surprisingly induced a sense of drunkenness, and for the past two days, the Purple Little Dragon had been drowsily sleeping under the lake, thousands of meters deep.
…
In the ancient world of clams, blanketed by leisurely clouds, hundreds of thousands from the Longa Alien Tribe gathered on the largest central island. A sea of arms, a black mass, they all respectfully faced forward.
There, upon the vast stone platform, stood the Golden Longa King, over two thousand meters in length and more than eight hundred meters tall at the torso, shrouded in a halo of golden light, exuding dignity and sanctity.
At the Longa King’s side was the Destruction Emperor Dragon, coiling, with mountains of corpses piled up behind it—those of the Titan Flame Whales and the tri-headed Mythical Creatures. An indescribable aura that permeated the area made all Longa Aliens go weak.
Even the Giant Beasts circling in the distant sea looked towards the island with reverent gazes.
Flanking the Destruction Emperor Dragon were the Silver Giant Dragon and a Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, and below stood the Kamaitachi, the Candle Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, and other Mythical Giant Beasts.
Looking down at the countless subordinates below, the Longa King slowly said, “This time, with the help of the Dragon Palace Empire, our tribe annihilated the elite forces of the Black Abyss Clan in one fell swoop, slaughtering everyone including Emond.”
“To show our gratitude to the Great King of Thunderflame, I now declare that the Longa Tribe will join the Dragon Palace and offer all the Ancient Clam Pearls.”
As the supreme ruler of the Longa Tribe, the transcendent Titan King, Alicia had absolute dominion over her people, her will was the will of the tribe.
After the Longa King finished speaking, Kerla swam over with a clamshell platter hundreds of meters in diameter. As its robust and colossos Flood Dragon tail passed by, the ground trembled.
In the clamshell lay a pool of clear sea water and a pearl about thirty meters in diameter, its surface inscribed with the patterns of higher-order laws and radiant with the pure glow of white light.
Meanwhile, the hundreds of thousands of Longa Tribe members below all bowed respectfully and shouted loudly, “Greetings to the great King of the Dragon Palace, the supreme King of Thunderflame.”
Roar! Roar! Roar! Giant Beasts in the sea also let out respectful roars, bowing their heads in submission to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This was the ‘joining ritual’ prepared by the Longa King. It was nothing out of the ordinary for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but the Silver Giant Dragon was particularly excited by this scene.
For this was the sight that it had envisioned for the Beast Empire.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “Alicia, I have seen your sincerity. From this day forth, the Longa Tribe shall be subjects of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.”
“However, let me correct you here, the King of the Dragon Palace is the King of Storm and Frost, Sethia, not me. I am merely one of the Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace.” As it spoke, the Destruction Emperor Dragon glanced towards the Silver Giant Dragon at its side.
“Roar! Indeed, the Great Sethia is the Dragon Palace Dragon King,” boasted the Silver Giant Dragon, lifting its head proudly.
“…!” Both the Longa King Alicia and those below, including Kerla and the Dragon Horse Beast, were completely bewildered.
What was this? The king of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire wasn’t this terrifying Black-Red Colossal Beast but was, in fact, that Silver Giant Dragon still at the early Myth levels?
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued to growl: “Aside from Sethia and myself, there are five other Dragon Kings in the Dragon Palace: the King of Black and White, Jerry Jones, the King of Day and Night Spacetime, the Candle Dragon.”
“The King of Elemental Ice Crystals, Telsafi.”
“The King of Earth and Destruction, Domination, and the Nine-headed Dragon King, Kidora.”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon introduced them one by one, the Giant Beasts below let out majestic roars—including the Level 9 Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, a tri-headed beast.
And when the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking, Alicia, Kerla, and the Dragon Horse Beast were dumbfounded.
What was the deal with this Dragon Palace Empire? It was bad enough that the most powerful being, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, wasn’t the king, but what were these other Dragon Kings all about?
And since when could Level 9 Beasts call themselves kings?
As the Golden Titan Longa King grew somewhat disheveled, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already grabbed the pearl formed by the Ancient Divine Clam and swallowed it whole.
Boom! A vast expanse of biological energy erupted within the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as cells throughout its body exploded and split, frantically evolving.
Crackle Crackle!!
In the shocked gazes of all the surrounding Giant Beasts, the colossal body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon visibly grew at an observable speed. Its scale armor expanded, and its tail stretched out.
Amidst its Titan body’s growth and evolution, the nine integrated higher-order laws within the Destruction Emperor Dragon went berserk, and in an instant, a terrifying aura that defied description burst forth.
Boom! The entire ancient clam world trembled.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew more formidable, strands of pure Evolution Energy passed through the Soul Channel, situated in another dimension.
[There’s more to edit]

chapters.title: Chapter 1215 - 1215 477 Keeping Jack Clark the Damned Mating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1215: Chapter 477: Keeping Jack Clark, the Damned Mating Season Chapter 1215: Chapter 477: Keeping Jack Clark, the Damned Mating Season In the bathroom shrouded in mist, sisters Sherry and Sara Williams were wiping the sweat and dust off their bodies.
With a well-proportioned figure and a delicate, beautiful face, Sherry stood behind Sara, tenderly massaging a dark purple bruise on her back.
“Sis, does it still hurt?”
In Sherry’s hands, the powerful Qi Blood of a Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivator circulated, emitting a burning aura as it helped Sara heal and disperse the contusion.
They had encountered a war hammer monster in the Ruin City this time, a creature of terrifying strength. Had Sara not blocked a blow for her, Sherry would have been not dead, at least heavily injured.
“It’s fine; it’s just that my internal organs were displaced by the shock. It’s much better now.”
While speaking, Sara looked up, letting the gentle cascade of water rain down on her exquisite face, wetting her jet-black hair as the water trickled down along her collarbone.
Compared to Sherry’s standard figure, the 175-centimeter-tall Sara’s physique was somewhat exaggerated.
With her towering height, slender waist, and long, straight legs, such a woman would have been an exceptional beauty that countless men crazily pursued in peaceful times.
At this moment, Sherry cautiously whispered, “Sis, who do you think Jack Clark is?”
“He must not be from our world,” Sara pondered, recalling the way Jack had abruptly appeared, as if from the sky.
“The language he spoke at first was different from ours, not a dialect from the three major regions, and he even asked what world this was, and the time.”
“At that time, I didn’t sense any malice from him, or rather, he seemed to have no ill will towards ‘people.’ It’s very likely that he is a strong man from the Ancient Human Race.”
“The Ancient Human Race? That’s just a legend,” Sherry was stunned.
Sara opened her eyes, and a fierce heat diffused from her, with a faint red radiance shimmering beneath her skin as the strong Qi Blood coursed through her.
Pop!!
Sara’s body shook, causing all the water droplets on her to scatter, and the water pouring down from the showerhead was also blocked by an invisible force field, keeping it ten centimeters away.
Sigh! Sara exhaled slowly, her hot breath projecting a meter away, creating a powerful airflow before she calmly said,
“Sherry, do you think the Qi Blood running through our veins is a legend?”
“Moreover, when he blew apart that Level 7 Mutant monster with a single punch, even destroying half of a city district, his power far exceeded the described strength of the strongest current Level 8 strong man.”
“This was even with him being heavily injured; it’s hard to imagine how strong he must be at his peak, probably a Mythic War General of Level 9 or above.”
Having said this, Sara couldn’t help but show a look of astonishment again.
Because they cultivated the Cultivation Methods left by the Ancient Human Race, the hierarchy of strength in this world was divided into nine levels from one to nine, above which were War General, Monarch, and Emperor.
However, after several years of the Heaven-Earth Mutated, the strongest known cultivator had only reached the Peak of the eighth level, and no one had yet made a breakthrough to Level 9.
Most were ordinary Body Refiners of Level 1 or 2, with a Level 5 Body Refiner like Sara already being an expert. After all, geniuses were always few.
So when Sherry heard that Jack might come from beyond the heavens, from the Ancient Human Race as a War General level expert, she opened her mouth wide in disbelief.
“The Ancient War Generals, akin to deities in legend.”
Thinking back to when Jack’s restrained aura still gave her a dreadful feeling of supreme nobility, dignity, and a high-above gaze looking down upon all beings, Sara nodded affirmatively.
“Right, at the level of an Ancient War General.”
Suddenly, Sherry became excited, trembling slightly in certain parts of her body, “Sis, if he’s really that powerful, doesn’t it mean our world could be saved?”
“Not necessarily,” Sara responded more calmly compared to the excited Sherry.
“We don’t know what his purpose is for entering our world this time, and we also don’t know the attitude of the Ancient Human Race strong men towards us, the lost descendants.”
“If the Ancient Human Race has disdain for us lost ones, he might just leave after recovering from his injuries.”
“But no matter what, he indeed represents hope for rebuilding our homeland.”
“As long as he’s willing to take action, with his strength he could sweep through the entire world, even suppress those Overlord Dragons that are like Catastrophes.”
“So, we need to find a way to keep him here.”
…
The Ancient Clam world.
Watching the Black-red Colossal Beast whose body length had suddenly surged by more than one hundred and ninety meters, reaching two thousand two hundred meters, Longa King Alicia was so stunned she didn’t know what to say.
Because the Giant Beast Body merged with the Laws, and its bloodline itself was the Laws’ Origin, Titan Level Giant Beasts grow much more slowly than Mythical-level beings.
Every slight increase in strength required a long hibernation (cultivation).
At this stage, a Titan Beast’s body would slowly possess World Features, becoming a ‘world’ itself and nurturing Rules to break through as an Ancient Titan.
Therefore, every bit of growth for a Titan Beast required a terrifying amount of energy and time, even needing time to refine and slowly grow with Heaven and Earth Treasures containing the Laws’ Origin.
Over the years, it had consumed eight pearls condensed by the Ancient Divine Clam.
From initially taking ten years to absorb one as a Legendary Realm being to taking over two years per pearl after reaching the Titan Level.
But unexpectedly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had only spent a short time to absorb and refine the Ancient Divine Clam’s pearl, didn’t it need time for Transformation!!?
Compared to the shocked Longa, the Silver Giant Dragon and others were already accustomed, watching the Black-red Colossal Beast whose Aura shook the world, they let out excited growls.

chapters.title: Chapter 1216 - 1216 477 Keeping Jack Clark the Damned Mating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1216: Chapter 477: Keeping Jack Clark, the Damned Mating Season_2 Chapter 1216: Chapter 477: Keeping Jack Clark, the Damned Mating Season_2 “Roar! Tim Abott, shall we continue to sweep across the Chaos Sea or shall we burst into the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region next?”
The battle today annihilated a different races’ Giant Beast Empire, which sparked the Silver Giant Dragon’s desire to destroy and slaughter, making it somewhat impatient to annihilate the next Giant Beast Empire.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, resembling a small mountain range, let out a low growl, authoritative and profound, “No rush, let’s digest what we’ve gained this time first.”
“Moreover, we’ve yet to destroy the stronghold of the Black Abyss Clan. As a different races’ civilization that dominates a sea area, their nest should have some good stuff.”
Immediately, the golden-blue Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, “The great Telsafi loves shiny treasures the most, Scythia, let’s go and empty that different races’ lair.”
Woo! I’m the best at finding good stuff, I’m also going. The Single-horned Spawn Roc flapped its wings, stirring up a rolling white wave and emitting excited cries.
With the Titan Flame Whale, the Armored Lizard People King, and other lives beyond Mythical-level, as well as over a million elites killed, the Black Abyss Clan was no different from being extinct.
Next up, going to the lair was all about picking up things, so the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and other Giant Beasts were somewhat excited, each of them roaring.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head, these fools were too obtuse.
What good could the Black Abyss Clan possibly have left? They were surely already eaten, and they weren’t like human civilizations that knew how to mine minerals to enrich their treasuries.
And didn’t you see that the Titan Longa King, Alicia, had no reaction? If there really were good items to be had, would an enemy they had been fighting for many years not know?
The Destruction Emperor Dragon looked at Titan Longa King and growled, “Alicia, how often do these Ancient clams spawn pearls, what’s the current stockpile like, and are there any tolerance issues with long-term use?”
The Titan Longa replied respectfully, “Currently in the small world, there are over three hundred Ancient clam creatures, apart from the largest Ancient Divine Clam, there are seven of Titan Level, fifty-six of Mythical-level, and the rest are between Level 9 and level eight.”
“However, the Ancient clam creatures are special; they only have a large total of energy, but lack any attack power or control over rules.”
“The cycle for their pearl production is related to their ingestion and exhalation of Heavenly Energy, feeding them resources containing rich energy can speed up pearl production.”
“With the territories currently controlled by our clan, the resources collected can sustain the Ancient Divine Clam producing one top-grade Divine Bead every twenty years or so.”
“Titan Level Ancient clams can produce one high-level Divine Bead every five years or so, Mythical-level Ancient clams need one year to produce an intermediate Divine Bead, and Level 9 Ancient clams need three months.”
“These Divine Beads do not have any tolerance issues, but because the biological energy contained within is too pure, absorbing one high-level Divine Bead in the short term requires a three-year interval, otherwise a lot of energy will be wasted.”
“Currently, there are two high-level Divine Beads in stock, fifteen intermediate Divine Beads, and over fifty low-level and ordinary ones, all here.”
As he spoke, the Longa King’s gem on the back of his hand shimmered, and then over seventy Ancient Clam Divine Beads, pulsating with rich energy waves, flew out.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts all lit up their eyes, especially those two Titan Level Ancient clam’s concentrated high-level Divine Beads, which were infinitely close to being Law Level Divine Artifacts.
The amount of energy contained in a single high-level Divine Bead was roughly equivalent to five top-grade Divine Fruits condensed by the red Divine Tree.
This was still because they were grown quickly by resource infusion; otherwise, a Titan Level Ancient clam’s Divine Bead condensed over many years would be at least of Law Level.
As the true decision-maker of the Dragon Palace, the Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately allocated them, “Scythia, you and Telsafi, one high-level Divine Bead each.”
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly and opened its mouth to unleash a powerful suction, swallowing one high-level Divine Bead.
Boom!
The body of the Silver Giant Dragon burst with an incredibly dense energy, emitting a silver radiance all over, glittering, looking like a majestic dragon cast in pure silver.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon didn’t hold back, happily swallowing the other high-level Divine Bead, and energy exploded within its body, emitting a seven-colored glow, incredibly magnificent.
Compared to the pure silver one, which had its Dorsal Fin as the only ‘off-color,’ the golden-blue Giant Dragon, with scale armor resembling crystal, looked even more dazzling and elegant.
Damn this dazzle, I can’t believe I’m finding a Giant Dragon beautiful. A flicker of astonishment flashed in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils.
What’s happening, am I in heat, or why have I recently started to find these two Giant Dragons beautiful, along with an itch that’s driving me crazy?
Seeing the Black-red Colossal Beast that hadn’t reacted for a while, the Single-horned Spawn Roc couldn’t help but fly in front of it, flapping its dark golden wings and making ingratiating chirps.
Woo woo!! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, what about me, I want good stuff too.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon came back to its senses, suppressing the weird impulse inside and growled slowly, “You, the Candle Dragon, and the Kamaitachi, three intermediate Divine Beads each.”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon spoke, nine Divine Beads, about the size of water jars and radiating brilliant blue light, flew in front of the three Mythical Giant Beasts.
“Thanks, king.” Feeling the three Divine Beads which together were akin to two top-level Divine Items, the Kamaitachi Beast became somewhat excited.
Indeed, following the boss has its perks, joining the Dragon Palace for not even a month, and I’ve already harvested so many good things.
Instantly, including the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, who had previously been stuck, the three Giant Beasts swallowed the three Ancient Clam Divine Beads, and immediately violent energy burst inside them as well.
The remaining six intermediate Divine Beads were distributed, with the Female Tiger Whale receiving two, while the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, the Blue Giant Crab, and the Black Tiger Whale got one each.

chapters.title: Chapter 1217 - 1217 477 Keeping Jack Clark the Damned Mating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1217: Chapter 477: Keeping Jack Clark, the Damned Mating Season_3 Chapter 1217: Chapter 477: Keeping Jack Clark, the Damned Mating Season_3 In addition, each of them received ten lower-grade Divine Beads produced by Level 9 Ancient clams, and the remaining few were given to the female Little Tiger Whales by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Having distributed all the Divine Beads, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked down at the Titan Longa, growling, “Alicia, once Scythia and the others awaken, take them to the Black Abyss Tribe’s old lair.”
“Command them with Scythia as the lead when the time comes, and be careful not to have any accidents.”
“Yes, my king,” the Titan Longa bowed respectfully.
Although the Silver Giant Dragon was only at the early Mythical stage and could be blown away with a single slap by a mid-stage Titan lifeform like itself, the Titan Longa did not dare to be negligent.
If the Destruction Emperor Dragon declared it to be the Big Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, then no one dared to slight the Silver Giant Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon was very pleased with Alicia’s performance; this Titan Longa was strong, but even more importantly, it was wise and clear about its own position and status.
This was very rare among Giant Beasts.
“As a Titan-level creature, from today onwards, you are the eighth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, Titan Longa King, still governing all the different races of Longa, with a status only below mine and that of Scythia.”
