“As for Kerla and Dragon Horse Tait, they rank as vanguard generals like Kamaitachi, under your command.”
The Titan Longa King had performed very well, and its strength was not weak, so the Destruction Emperor Dragon made an exception to bestow upon it the position of “Dragon King.”
Instantly, a smile appeared in the eyes of the Titan Longa.
“All right, let them go about their business,” said the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon signaled the hundreds of thousands of reverently bowing Longa and the thousands of Giants that hovered above Level 7, which surrounded the island, to disperse, and then slowly turned around.
Next, it was time to “eat.”
Boom!
Under the ferocious, sharp fangs of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the thick scale armor of the Titan Flame Whale shattered, and its flesh and blood roared with explosive, thunderous booms as it was ripped apart bit by bit.
The flesh and blood of a Titan-level Giant Beast had transcended the concept of hardness, terrifyingly powerful, maintaining immortality for hundreds of thousands of years even after death, unless the rule factors dissipated.
And to digest the flesh and blood of a Titan-level Giant Beast, only another Titan-level creature could do so. If it was a Mythical Giant Beast, it would take a long while just to digest a single mouthful, and maybe even its teeth would shatter.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon only needed to chew thunderously a couple of times before swallowing the hundred-meter-sized flesh and blood, and immediately a rich energy containing Law Factors emanated from its stomach.
Crackle Crackle!!
The body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew slightly, and the speed of this energy transformation and growth once again made the Titan Longa’s eyes twitch.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued devouring the flesh and blood of the Titan, its body visibly became heavier and the aura it emitted grew more terrifying, causing the entire world to tremble slightly once again.
Meanwhile, the Evolution Energy surged inside the Destruction Emperor Dragon, flowing through the Soul Channel and appearing within Jack Clark’s body, spanning space-time to mend his wounds.
Yet it was unclear whether it was due to the consumption of crossing vast spans of space-time, or because most of the Evolution Energy was still “on the way,” only a tiny fraction of it reached the past.
Compared to the previously devoured Golden Roc, this Titan Flame Whale was also mid-stage Titan, but its bulky stature was nearly three times that of the Golden Roc.
In this case, the biological energy contained within was naturally more abundant.
After eating the flesh and blood of this Titan Flame Whale, along with the flesh and blood of two Mythical-level Flame Whale Giants, it should allow the Destruction Emperor Dragon to grow more than a hundred meters.
It couldn’t be helped, as the Giant Beast Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was tens of times larger than other Titan-level Giants, requiring tens to hundreds of times more energy for each meter of growth.
Especially once it grew to three to four thousand meters, reaching the Titan Peak, the energy required for further growth would increase even more due to the scaled-up body size.
While devouring the flesh and blood of the Titan Flame Whale, the Destruction Emperor Dragon thoughtfully looked towards the distant sky.
Hundreds of kilometers away, a huge clamshell emerged over a kilometer from the sea surface, with a horizontal width of over four thousand meters, resembling an island several kilometers in diameter.
That Ancient Divine Clam was comparable to an Ancient Beast in pure energy terms, and the energy contained within its flesh and blood was of similar magnitude.
If it devoured that Ancient Divine Clam, the biological energy obtained could potentially let it grow directly to the mid-stage Titan, and thinking of this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became somewhat tempted.
After all, a single consolidated Divine Bead had caused it to surge nearly two hundred meters in size.
That Ancient Divine Clam was comparable to an Ancient Beast in pure energy terms, and the energy contained within its flesh and blood was of similar magnitude.
If it devoured that Ancient Divine Clam, the biological energy obtained could potentially let it grow directly to the mid-stage Titan, and thinking of this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became somewhat tempted.
After all, a single consolidated Divine Bead had caused it to surge nearly two hundred meters in size.

chapters.title: Chapter 1218 - 1218 478 High-Dimensional Life Forms Eternal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1218: Chapter 478: High-Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling Chapter 1218: Chapter 478: High-Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling Gazing at the slowly rotating white galaxy light cluster within the colossal shell, the Destruction Emperor Dragon abandoned the idea of devouring the Ancient clam.
No meat.
This Ancient clam’s flesh and blood had already evolved into another form of strength, and fundamentally, it was already an Ancient Titan-level creature, so it acutely sensed the killing intent from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At this moment, by revealing an inner world that seemed “empty” when it opened its shell—signaling that killing it would be of no benefit—the Ancient clam aimed to dispel the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s thoughts.
Moreover, while the Ancient Divine clam might seem to have “no attack power,” that was relative to the Titan Longa King. If it truly became enraged and unleashed an energy tidal wave, it was enough to shake this small world.
Mythical creatures couldn’t even come close.
Its defense was also very strong; the shell, tempered by the power of rules, was indestructible. The Destruction Emperor Dragon felt that even the Longa King might not be able to shake it.
Therefore, better to leave it be, a steady stream for the long term, treating it as if there were hundreds more resource containers for collecting Divine Beads.
And the more resources they were fed, the faster they would produce Divine Beads.
Not all resources in the mythical world could be refined, such as energy-containing ores, special wood, and metals, and many Heaven and Earth Treasures had conflicting attributes or were poisonous, which could cause trouble if devoured by the Giant Beasts.
In this case, these Ancient clams became converters, making use of the useless resources and waste within the Territory of the Dragon Palace, tempering and condensing the essence.
At the same time, after absorbing those special substances, their growth rate was even faster, which was a mutually beneficial situation.
Next, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued to devour the flesh and blood of Titan-level creatures, its body grew at a visibly observable rate under the abundance of biological energy; no, it should be said to be swelling.
The later stages saw the ‘Evolution’ talent reveal more terrifying traits, allowing the Destruction Emperor Dragon to completely defy the rule that greater the strength of a powerful creature, the slower the rate of improvement.
Half a day later, when the Titan Flame Whale over two thousand meters long had been eaten halfway, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already grown to over two thousand one hundred and fifty meters.
Its overall form had become even larger and more majestic. It was estimated that after devouring two or three more powerful Titan Beasts, it could break through to the mid-period of a Titan.
“Roar! Tim Abott, this feeling full of strength is so comfortable,” the Silver Giant Dragon said after completing the initial refinement of the Divine Beads and had its body surge by more than ten meters, nearing seven hundred meters, given it wasn’t the Destruction Emperor Dragon with a hundred percent energy conversion absorption.
It would likely take about ten days to half a month for the Silver and Gold-Blue Giant Dragons to fully absorb that Divine Bead close to Law-level resources.
After feeling the changes within its body for a while, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t wait to roar lowly, “Tim Abott, the Great Scythia is going to completely wipe out that Black Abyss Alien Race.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, crimson residue of flesh and blood flowing from the corner of its mouth, “Go ahead. By the time you return, I should also have finished eating this flesh and blood. Then, we’ll carry the world back.”
As Headquarters, it wouldn’t be possible to split it into two, so the Destruction Emperor Dragon planned to carry this small world back with it.
With the red divine tree possessing attributes of the World Tree present, it could forcefully merge the two small worlds.
On hearing this, the Titan Longa King, who had been standing guard all this time, was stunned, “King, you’re planning to carry the world of the Ancient clam back to our territory tens of thousands of ‘kilometers’ away?”
Carrying a small world was something it could do, too, but bearing the weight of a world would drain its energy horrendously, and after traveling a few thousand kilometers, it would be exhausted.
If it encountered an enemy attack at that time, it would be extremely dangerous.
Had it not been for this reason, it would have dragged the Ancient clam world away from here long ago.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a deep growl, “The problem is not big to me.”
The Titan Longa King nodded in agreement. Indeed, the strength of the Black-Red Giant Beast before its eyes was terrifyingly powerful.
But then, the Titan Longa King hesitated, “However, King, tens of thousands of kilometers away in the direction you came from, I recall there is a Golden Roc Titan-level creature.”
“That area is the territory of the Golden Roc Giant Beast, and if you pass by carrying the world, it might launch an attack,” the Longa King said.
Before the Destruction Emperor Dragon could speak, the Silver Giant Dragon roared with pride, “Alicia, that Golden Roc Giant Beast has already been taken down by Tim Abott.”
“It has already been slain by the King,” said the astounded Titan Longa King.
Having been a Titan-level creature for many years, it had, at most, injured an Early Titan-level creature, but never killed one.
At Titan Level, a beast’s vitality is incredibly tenacious, and its defenses sturdy, making it difficult to determine a victor after months of battle unless the strength disparity is overwhelming.
Yet now, the allegedly Early Titan period Destruction Emperor Dragon had already slain two mid-period Titan Beasts, which was… For a moment, the Titan Longa King didn’t know how to describe it.
Standing on the several-thousand-meter tall stone platform, the Silver Giant Dragon roared at the Giant Beasts like the Single-horned Spawn Roc below, “Roar! All beasts, follow the Great Scythia. Let’s make a river of blood.”
Boom! With a roar, the Silver Giant Dragon’s wings flared wide, turning into a silver streak of light that burst forth, quickly reaching the entrance to the world passageways.
Woo! Roar!!
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, Kamaitachi Beast, and others also let out roars and shrieks, following the Silver Giant Dragon as they soared into the sky, including the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon that gracefully spread its wings.
Roar! Scythia the Great King is invincible.
With a surging aura radiating from it and on the verge of breaking through Level 9, the Black Tiger Whale let out a chorus of roars, excitedly following with the Little Tiger Whale.
Watching the two beautiful Giant Dragons disappear, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its massive dragon head, a strange color gleaming in its cold golden vertical pupils.

chapters.title: Chapter 1219 - 1219 478 High Dimensional Life Forms Eternal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1219: Chapter 478 High Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling_2 Chapter 1219: Chapter 478 High Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling_2 Dammit, that’s beautiful. It must be the mating season, huh?
The male Six-legged Salamander reaches maturity at eleven months, and the female at thirteen months. According to the normal timeline, the Destruction Emperor Dragon entering its mating season now seems about right.
But right my ass.
It’s a titan beast capable of destroying heaven and earth. Its bloodline and life essence have evolved to compare with mythical creatures, and it has long transcended any relation to the Six-legged Salamander.
Boom! The sea surface explodes, and over a dozen giant beasts, each hundreds to thousands of kilometers in size, surge into the sky with proud roars that shake heaven and earth.
Leading the charge is a Silver Giant Dragon with a wingspan of over a thousand meters, followed by a golden-blue dragon, a Kamaitachi Beast that stretches over fourteen hundred meters long, Candle Dragons, and a Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Below them, amidst the turbulent waves, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Kidora, the Blue Giant Crab, and the mating pair of Black Tiger Whale, tear through tsunamis and ride the wind and waves.
In the deep sea beneath Giant Beasts like the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Female Tiger Whale blends silently with the dim sea water, swimming without a sound.
And behind them, stretching over a thousand meters long, is Kerla, accompanied by the Titan Longa King, towering at over eight hundred meters with a golden body and six arms—mighty and imposing.
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon lets out an excited roar.
Now, the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire finally has a bit of imperial aura. With two titan beasts at the level of Overlords, seven of Mythical-level, tens of thousands of elite soldiers, and over a thousand gigantic beasts.
Looking towards the golden-blue dragon flying beside it, the Silver Giant Dragon lets out a triumphant roar, “Roar! Telsafi, isn’t the Great Scythia impressive?”
“Under the leadership of the Great Sethia, one day the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire will dominate the Endless World.”
The golden-blue dragon responds with an annoyed growl, “Don’t get too cocky with that tail up in the air. Saying you’re impressive is like saying you’ve got good luck.”
This idiot said it wanted to run away from home, heading to the indigenous world across a pathway on the edge of its family territory. I worried for quite a while and even lost many good things along the way.
Unfortunately, Scythia was too dim-witted and actually believed that those treasures were just lucky finds.
Yet with the Life-saving Trump Card given by its mother, going to an Indigenous World where usually only Level 9 Giant Beasts would come, there was no need to worry about safety.
But who would have thought that just upon entering the Indigenous World, it encountered a Mutant Beast gathering the luck of the world, whose talent was terrifying.
After fighting with the Thunderflame Beheamoth at the Peak of the seventh level, it then eagerly joined forces to establish the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.
In fact, had it been Telsafi at the time, it likely wouldn’t have teamed up with the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
Back then, the Silver Giant Dragon, at the early stages of level eight and a descendant of myths with Top Tier Talent, was surprisingly not a match for the Thunderflame Beheamoth at the Peak of the seventh level.
One can only imagine how terrifying the opponent’s talent and combat strength were, but this idiot actually believed it was on par with the Thunderflame Beheamoth.
However, it’s also because of the stupid dragon’s dumb luck that it was accepted by the Flame Tiger Whale and a few other Giant Beasts; otherwise, it would have been wiped clean a long time ago.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon was devouring the flesh and blood of titan beasts to grow, and the Silver Giant Dragon and others went to exterminate a different race,
Blue Star, Water and Fire World.
The ravaged Dragon Palace appeared even more dilapidated; even the Magma Fire Sea that occupied half of the island had extinguished and cooled into Black Volcanic Rock.
Only at the center, where the volcano originally collapsed, was there still some flames leaping, with a few hundred meters range of dark red magma churning.
Boom!
The magma explodes, and two massive Tiger Whales surge into the sky, causing the temperature between heaven and earth to soar rapidly as red firelight brightens the dim sky.
Engulfed in raging flames, two Tiger Whales over a hundred and ten meters long, Crystal Red all over as if cast from Crystal, are sinking and floating in the sea of fire, emanating a heat of late period level eight.
Roar, roar, roar! Brother, we’ve been reborn.
Roar! Not bad, and we’ve become stronger too.
The two Flame Tiger Whales circle excitedly in the air, feeling their new bodies.
After the original bodies of the two Tiger Whales were shattered and they retreated deep into the volcano relying on their fire talent, they absorbed the dissipated Life Energy of the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it made its Pseudo-Heaven Tier breakthrough and were reborn.
After undergoing this transformation for a while, not only have they become true fire element beings, but their levels also reached the late period of eight after absorbing the energy of the entire volcano’s flames.
Once they fully refine the fire energy stored within, they’ll reach the Peak of the eighth level and may even break through to Level 9.
After all, that was Life Energy from beyond King-level, Monarch-Level, Monarch-Level Life, even just a little of its dissipation was incredibly terrifying in terms of quality.
This is also why the Purple little dragon loved to stay on top of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head.
Every time the Destruction Emperor Dragon broke through, it would release a large amount of Life Energy that could subtly uplift the little dragon’s life quality and accelerate its growth.
At that moment, the seawater in the distance started boiling, and an eighty-meter-long Sea Turtle Giant Beast crawled up, excitedly roaring its congratulations to the Great General, and the Second General.
Looking at the Sea Turtle Giant Beast, Tiger One’s fins whipped up the fiery flames, uttering a roaring cry, “Big head, let’s go find mom and the rest. We must kill that monster and avenge our brothers.”
Whoo!! Yes, we must get revenge. The Sea Turtle Giant Beast nodded fiercely, cruelty gleaming in its eyes.
Roar, roar!! Let’s go, to the mythical world to find mom and the rest.
As they roared, Tiger One and Tiger Two retracted their external flames and plunged into the water like two Crystal Red Tiger Whales, diving swiftly.
That monster was too strong, especially that terrifying Aura that instinctively made them feel hopeless, even more dreadful than a Mythical Giant Beast by hundreds of thousands of times.

chapters.title: Chapter 1220 - 1220 478 High Dimensional Life Forms Eternal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1220: Chapter 478 High Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling_3 Chapter 1220: Chapter 478 High Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling_3 This enemy was definitely not something they could deal with, their father included, who would likely get beaten up and devoured, so seeking revenge would have to involve Uncle.
“That thing dares to destroy the Dragon Palace, Uncle will never let it go.”
Boom!
The sea surface burst open as two Crystal Red Tiger Whales, engulfed in flames, soared into the sky, and were promptly spotted by satellites above.
“Damn! What’s going on? Am I seeing things, or are those Tiger Whales flying in the sky actually on fire?”
…
Sky Curtain Battlefield.
The tall and slender Number One stood quietly in the 13th Legion Research Base, once again covered in black and red Ferocious Armor, emitting a Terrifying Aura that was almost imperceptible.
Beneath that invisible, pervading Terrifying Aura, every person and creature within tens of kilometers instinctively felt palpitations and fear.
“The Super God Energy surging within Number One has dropped to two thousand percent.”
“Young General Louise’s Soul Fluctuation has been captured. She’s in the process of separating from Number One, the sync waves are stable, and her soul form is taking shape.”
“Closely monitor Number One’s data status, and prepare to activate the Teleportation Crystal to guide Young General Louise back.”
In this major battle at the Sky Curtain Battlefield, Number One had devoured the flesh and blood, the souls, of over one million Senior life forms, including two Demon Kings, and achieved substantial growth.
However, during the battle, Freya Louise not only entered a berserk state but eventually released all restraints from her armor, with her Soul Sync Rate reaching three hundred percent and entering Ancient Form.
In this condition, Number One gained Terrifying Power enough to stand up against two Demon Kings in the early and mid periods of the Great Demon King realm, but it also fell into Returning Ruin, remaining inside Number One ever since.
In her Ancient Form within Number One, her soul was completely merged with Number One, while her spiritual will entered the Returning Ruin Realm within the Primitive Cultivation Method to remain independent and avoid contamination.
Moreover, her body became another form of existence in a higher-dimensional state within the more than ten thousand percent Super God Energy, disappearing from view.
Fortunately, thanks to God Machine Armament prepared by Emma Louise, and under the transformation of eternal power furnace energy, her physical form was stabilized and not assimilated.
Now, as various data declined, a transparent silhouette appeared within Number One’s space, like a human outline with only the edges visible.
About an hour later, Freya Louise’s figure finally fully restored, and her eyes slowly opened.
“Caught the existence fluctuation of Young General Louise.”
“Activate the Teleportation Crystal immediately.”
Whir! Number One’s chest crystal shone brilliantly, projecting a blue and white Light Beam ten meters in diameter, and within the beam, a figure flew out.
Watching the splendid Mecha land on the ground, everyone was a bit excited, and Team Leader Rodriguez’s face even showed a smile: “Miss Flora, welcome back.”
“Thank you, everyone, for the hard work,” Freya Louise’s voice was very flat, so devoid of any emotional fluctuation that it caused Team Leader Rodriguez and everyone else to pause.
At that moment, the splendid God Machine Armament gradually faded and, transforming into an energy form, was retracted into the space in her left wrist, revealing the girl in a silver pilot suit.
At this time the girl’s Aura was hidden and obscure, her appearance delicate, with black hair cascading over her shoulders, revealing a pair of indifferent and detached eyes, devoid of her usual warmth and instead resembling a deity gazing down upon all beings.
Immediately, everyone’s expression sobered up.
It appeared that Freya Louise’s mental state was not as optimistic as imagined. Although she avoided the mental contamination of Number One, the Cultivation Method caused some abnormalities.
Team Leader Rodriguez’s expression grew serious: “Miss Flora, something seems off with your mental state. I suggest a comprehensive check-up.”
Freya Louise replied indifferently, “Don’t worry, I’m fine. It’s just that my spiritual will delved too deep into the Returning Ruin this time, and I haven’t completely detached from it yet.”
“But…” Team Leader Rodriguez was about to say something when Freya Louise’s smart wristwatch suddenly flickered and transmitted an electronic voice.
“There is a communication request from Gabriel King. Would you like to connect?”
Gabriel King, Freya Louise paused, then nodded and confirmed. Immediately, Gabriel’s voice came from the smart wristwatch.
“Freya Louise, I’ve just received news that you’ve successfully detached from Number One. How are you feeling, any problems with your body or spirit?”
Freya Louise responded calmly, “Thank you, Larry Throne, for your concern. I feel fine now, no problems at all.”
“That’s good to hear. There’s a task at No.1 Logistics Base City that requires your attendance, and bring Number One along as well.”
Freya Louise paused, “Bring Number One back to the late period Base City?”
“Yes, the potential displayed by Number One in these recent Civilization Wars is too frightening and has already attracted high-intensity targeting by The Purgatory Family. It’s not suitable to stay at the frontline for now.”
“The Federation is planning to open a new battlefield with more numerous and stronger enemies, fitting for Number One’s growth.”
Soon, a massive transport airplane, a kilometer in length, rose up behind the Sky Curtain Battlefield, roaring as it flew towards Channel One City.
Traveling several times the speed of sound, the transport soon crossed twenty thousand kilometers, approaching Logistics City of Channel One.
Then, aboard the airplane, Freya Louise and Gabriella beheld the Earth below where a Golden Divine Tree, tens of kilometers wide and ten thousand meters tall, shot through the clouds with its golden brilliance.
The majestic and colossal Golden Divine Tree, like a mountain on high, whether with trunk or branches, leaves of gold, gleamed with dazzling Radiance in the sunlight.
“What is that?” Freya Louise’s bodyguard Gabriella was somewhat astonished.
“That tree must be related to the new battlefield,” Freya Louise mused, her gaze clear and warm again, having returned to normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221 - 1221 478 High Dimensional Life Forms Eternal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1221: Chapter 478 High Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling_4 Chapter 1221: Chapter 478 High Dimensional Life Forms, Eternal Tree Sapling_4 The massive transport plane soon landed at the logistics city airport.
Just as Freya Louise and Gabriella descended from the transport plane, a Warrant Officer was already waiting below: “Young General Louise, the Third Councilor has sent me to escort you.”
Freya Louise nodded, “Thank you for the trouble.”
While the two followed the Warrant Officer, flying towards the suburbs, other personnel at the airport were also carefully unloading the Number One from the transport plane with mechanical assistance.
Before long, Freya Louise and Gabriella reached the base of the ten-thousand-meter tall Golden Divine Tree, dozens of kilometers away. From afar, they could see over a hundred figures with golden light wings on their backs encircling the tree.
These beings from different races, emanating the aura from the Eighth Layer of Heaven, the Ninth Heavens, and even two with a Mythical aura, chanted incomprehensible ceremonial spells, seemingly connecting with something beyond.
Boom boom boom!!
The majestic branches of the Golden Divine Tree swayed, emitting a profound and terrifying energy fluctuation. Countless ancient golden rune trails emerged on its trunk, and its roots beneath vibrated.
These roots, as thick as dozens or hundreds of meters, writhed like Flood Dragons, tearing the Earth as they delved deeper, and some covered in Golden Dragon Scales extended into the Void, disappearing from sight.
Meanwhile, not far from the divine tree, hundreds of figures with faint yet powerful auras stood erect.
Among them were alien strong men with three pairs of golden light feather wings, as well as Human Clan’s Primordial True Kings, True King Heavenly Kings, and Mysterious Martial Sky Kings.
As these powerhouses observed the rooting of the divine tree, they pointed at the thousand unmanned Mechs standing firmly on the ground in the distance and spoke softly to each other.
Just as Freya Louise and her companion approached, they recognized a familiar face.
Seeing the two women walking over, the girl at the edge of the crowd with four long swords on her back and her black hair tied in a high ponytail smiled and said, “Freya Louise, Gabriella, you’ve arrived.”
“Student Aiken.”
Freya Louise was also somewhat surprised and then showed admiration, “As expected of Student Aiken, such a powerful aura. You’re almost at the mid-period of the Ninth Heaven, aren’t you?”
At that moment, Jane Aiken was surrounded by a sharp Sword Intent, giving the illusion she could cleave the Firmament and tear apart the world. She truly was the monster who had suppressed Jack Clark for several months.
Jane Aiken returned the smile gently, “You’re not too shabby either, Freya Louise. Just a few months without seeing you and you’re already in the late period of the Eighth Layer.”
Listening to the mutual flattery between the two girls, Gabriella said speechlessly, “Speaking of which, I’ve been wanting to complain for a while now, everyone from South Sky Martial Arts School must be monsters.”
When she had first met Jane Aiken on the Void Relic Continent, Jane Aiken was only at the Sixth Layer, one Major Realm lower than Gabriella.
And in the few months that had passed, just shortly after Gabriella broke through to the Eighth Layer, Jane Aiken had already reached the Ninth Heaven.
Besides that, there was also Freya Louise, who went from the Pinnacle of Seventh Layer of Heaven before the great battle at the Sky Curtain Battlefield to late Eighth Layer after a period of seclusion inside Number One.
Even including the eleven days of civilization war, it was only half a month. To have a breakthrough in a Major Realm in just half a month was like cheating.
However, with the assistance of a Biological Mech that had the combat power comparable to a Heavenly King, Freya Louise’s progression was indeed not too different from cheating.
And then there was the One-Year King, Jack Clark, which was also why Gabriella couldn’t help but complain.
That school called South Sky Martial Arts School was simply too exaggerated. In one semester, it produced three monsters who could dominate an era. It hardly left any room for geniuses like them to exist.
At this moment, Freya Louise asked, “Student Aiken, what’s the situation with that golden tree and those aliens?”
The girl carrying four long swords explained, “Those aliens are from the Heavenly Feather Clan, hailing from a powerful civilization that is at war with the Purgatory Clan.”
“As for that golden divine tree, it’s an Eternal Divine Tree sapling they brought over, said to have the ability to suppress Heaven and Earth and strengthen a particular world.”
“It’s just that the Heavenly Feather Clan’s situation is said to be even more dire than ours, facing an encirclement by three Purgatory Empires and teetering on the brink of collapse.”
“Currently, after several days of discussion, the Heavenly Feather Clan has formed an alliance with us, the Human Clan, and therefore the Primordial True Kings are preparing to dispatch an elite expedition to support the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
“The members of this team have been confirmed, led by the True Martial Heavenly King, followed by the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and five king-level powerhouses.”
“In addition to them and myself, there’s Senior Joshua, you, Freya Louise, and Number One, as well as several hundred high-ranking powerhouses including Senior Gabriella.”
“Aside from us, those high-ranking powerhouses all come from the Simon Empire, equipped with more than three million stockpiled unmanned mecha, carrying countless amounts of ammunition and heavy firepower weapons.”
“It’s said that this batch of unmanned mechas is of the experimental type, inscribed with war patterns obtained from the Violent Dragon Clan, which can form army-level amplification arrays.”
“Currently, war pattern technology has completed initial experiments, and the Federation has mobilized all military factories for retrofitting and production, with preparations expected to be complete within ten days.”
As a Ninth Heaven Expert and one of the expedition members, Jane Aiken also attended the previous alliance meeting, so she is very familiar with these secrets.
Especially the war pattern inheritance obtained by Jack Clark from the Violent Dragon Clan, it significantly enhances the expedition’s strength.
With an army of a hundred thousand capable of amplifying the strength of Mythical-level powerhouses, more than three million unmanned mecha can form three million-strong armies, effective even against Heavenly King Level powerhouses.”
Once the million-strong armies are deployed, the battle power of Sky King Denny Kaye and the Mysterious Martial Sky King, both in the late period of the Heavenly Kings, will become even more terrifying.”
However, although this inheritance of war patterns is complete, it has only been initially integrated with technological civilization, making this expedition also a trial, using the battlefield to test data.”
At this moment, Gabriella looked around and said, “By the way, Junior Aiken, has Jack Clark not returned yet?”
Jane Aiken shook her head softly, “Not yet, but I’ve already asked the True Martial Throne, and Jack’s soul breath is stable, nothing has happened.”
Freya Louise thought for a moment and softly said, “Jack Clark should have shaken off those Demon Gods by now, he should be back soon.”
From her understanding of Jack Clark, Freya Louise knew he never did things he wasn’t confident in; daring to venture deep into the rear of the Purgatory Empire’s territory must have had a reliable basis.”
Despite saying this, she couldn’t help but almost lose control of her consciousness when she heard the Demon God claim that Jack Clark had perished, while she was in a fused state with Number One.
Boom! Suddenly, the Eternal Divine Tree sapling in the distance trembled, and the space of this world shivered slightly with it.
A smile appeared on the face of Bordaea, with three pairs of golden light wings on his back, as he looked at the aged Primordial True King and slowly said, “Respectful Primordial Councilor, the sapling of the Eternal Divine Tree has been successfully rooted.”
“As per your request, the Eternal Tree sapling spans across both realms, reinforcing the spatial strength of the connection between your inner world and the mythical world.”
” ”
As the two strong figures were in fine spirits, Bordaea glanced at the Human Clan side, seeing one after another Eight Layer and Nine Layer Heavens, sensing that they were very young talents brimming with life force.
“Congratulations to our two tribes on your alliance. Why not have a friendly spar to let both sides’ talents understand each other’s strengths a bit?”
The Primordial True King paused, then with a smile looked at Jane Aiken, who had four swords strapped to her back, and said, “That’s feasible.”
Bordaea’s intent was clear to him; he knew the other party wanted to gauge the strength of the younger generation and establish prestige.
If the Heavenly Feather Clan’s geniuses could dominate the same-level members of the Human Clan, their status upon arriving in the Heavenly Feather Clan would be that of leaders. Conversely, if the strength of the human geniuses was astounding, it would make their peers and the Heavenly Feather Clan strongmen they meet later wary, ensuring they would not be treated lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1222 - 1222 479 Yes that Jack Clark is just that
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1222: Chapter 479 Yes, that Jack Clark is just that perverted Chapter 1222: Chapter 479 Yes, that Jack Clark is just that perverted Bathed in the radiance emanating from the Golden Divine Tree, Bordea swept his gaze over young life fluctuations like Jane Aiken, Joshua Welan, and other Human Clan Geniuses, and suddenly spoke.
“Primordial Councilor, although our two tribes are now allied, we still lack a deep understanding of each other. How about letting these young folks have a friendly contest?”
A faint smile appeared on the face of the Primordial True King: “This is indeed a good method to understand the power systems of both sides. Agreed.”
The Primordial True King did not refuse this request, precisely because he too wished to witness the power system and the strength of the younger generation of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
As a mighty civilization that directly confronted the three great Demon God Empires, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s strength was formidable, and their power system must have unique features.
“However, since this is a friendly match, let’s keep it simple and just send three youths from the Nine Layers to participate. The cultivation levels should be consistent.”
Bordea nodded: “Of course, only by competing with others of the same cultivation level can true strength be measured.”
Boom!
The moment the Primordial True King gestured with his hand, the Earth tore apart and rose up, forming a massive Martial Arts Arena with a length and width of fifty kilometers and a height of a kilometer.
The ground of the Martial Arts Arena, fortified by the power of rules, was incredibly solid; even Mythical Powerhouses would find it difficult to destroy it. Meanwhile, the power of rules permeated all directions, creating a small cosmos.
Instantly, all the people scattered around looked over in surprise.
This included the True Martial Heavenly King, Mysterious Martial Sky King, and others who were witnessing the unmanned War Pattern mecha. They appeared atop the Martial Arts Arena with a slight flicker.
Then, the voice of the Primordial True King resounded in everyone’s ears.
“Attention everyone, we will be holding three friendly sparring sessions with the Heavenly Feather Clan. Those above the Nine Layers who wish to participate are welcome to do so.”
“This competition will stop at the first sign of defeat. The main purpose is to familiarize everyone with each other’s power systems, to facilitate cooperation when we later go to the Heavenly Feather battlefield.”
The competition. Freya Louise and the others all showed a hint of curiosity.
Gabriella expressed some regret, “Too bad the requirement is Nine Layers and above, otherwise Freya, you could simply go up with Number One and suppress them all.”
Freya Louise smiled lightly, “That would be a bit too bullying.”
Suddenly, Jane Aiken’s eyes filled with fierce Battle Intent, eager to try, “I’ll go. It’s the perfect opportunity to test the might of the Four Great Sword Intentions I’ve mastered after my breakthrough.”
As Joshua Welan and the others on that side were also moved and prepared to go on stage to challenge the Heavenly Feather Clan’s geniuses of the same rank, a voice sounded, “I’ll go first.”
Jane Aiken’s voice, turning into Crystal Red Sword Light, spanned more than a dozen kilometers and landed in the center of the arena, already clad in a set of gorgeous Green Armor.
Looking at Jane Aiken, who was emanating an early Ninth Heavens aura, a young man from the Heavenly Feather Clan flew out, becoming a golden light that landed a kilometer away from Jane Aiken.
Standing 3 meters tall with a pair of Golden Light Wings behind him and a pair of semi-real golden wings in hand, the young man, holding a Red Giant Sword five meters long, looked at Jane Aiken and politely said,
“Heavenly Feather Clan, Kato. I specialize in Divine Text.”
Having reached the high-order, cultivators were able to use the Power of Spiritual Will. By infusing their voices with Vibrations that resonated through the Void, even if civilizations and languages were not in common, communication could still be accomplished with ease.
“Human Clan, Jane Aiken. I specialize in the Sword Path.”
Atop the arena, the two greeted each other courteously. Then, Kato’s pair of light wings behind him emitted a dazzling light, and he soared into the sky, appearing a kilometer above.
Boom!
Beneath Kato’s light wings, which emitted a golden radiance, Heavenly Energy erupted wildly, with endless majesty gathering to form a sea of golden light.
The young man standing amidst the golden ocean was like an angel from legends, surrounded by eleven solid-looking Divine Texts, emitting a Sacred Breath.
As the Heavenly Feather Clan powerhouse manifested his domain, Jane Aiken exuded an extremely sharp Sword Intent that shot into the sky.
Boom! Red, black, green, and gray Sword Qi burst forth around her, establishing a Sword Territory that spanned 800 meters.
Above this domain, four fearsome Sword Intentions appeared as though tangible, hanging in all directions, invisibly exuding a sharp essence that sliced through space, leaving black traces behind.
This spectacle startled many people, including the Mythical Strong of the Heavenly Feather Clan, who glanced sideways.
And Kato in the sky even tensed up, as the mere invisible sharp aura made him feel a chilling sensation, as if he were to confront it head-on.
But in an instant, Kato dismissed the fear in his heart. After all, he was a talented genius of the mighty Heavenly Feather Clan; how could he show weakness in front of a peer of a different race?
“Kill!”
Kato roared, and in an instant, the ancient Divine Texts surrounding him exploded with light, swelling to several dozen meters in size.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The golden Divine Texts, like missiles, fell from the sky, each shining with a golden glow and carrying the potent energy of a late-period Nine Layers.
In addition to that, each Divine Text contained a unique power: suppression, solidification, weakening – resembling several somewhat attenuated Talent Abilities.
Against the multitude of Divine Texts descending from the sky, Jane Aiken, standing in her Sword Territory, made a hand gesture, her tone cold, “The Four Extremes of Sword, God Slayer.”
Boom!
Countless Sword Qi erupted within the Sword Territory, merging with the four Sword Intentions that hung in the four directions, and in an instant, four beams of Sword Light, each 300 meters long, surged skyward.
Around the Sword Light, Red Phoenix, Black Fierce Tiger, Green Divine Dragon, and gray Mysterious Martial Phantom appeared.
When the Four Symbols Phantom emerged, an astonishing aura burst forth between the already peerlessly sharp Sword Intentions, invisibly enhancing the power of the Sword Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 1223 - 1223 479 Yes that Jack Clark is just that
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1223: Chapter 479 Yes, that Jack Clark is just that perverted_2 Chapter 1223: Chapter 479 Yes, that Jack Clark is just that perverted_2 “`
Thud Thud Thud! Four spiraling sword lights swept across heaven and earth, golden Divine Texts trembled and exploded in their wake, culminating in a golden domain.
Boom!
Under the terrible force of the four-directional sword lights, the golden domain shattered. The wild red, black, aqua, and gray Sword Qis blossomed like a lotus flower, beautiful yet filled with a destructive aura.
Spurt! Amidst the violent explosion, Kato spat blood and crashed to the ground from the sky.
Just one move, Kato, who boasted the strength close to the late period of the Ninth Heavens, was defeated by Jane Aiken’s single sword strike. The outcome stunned many powerful warriors from the Heavenly Feather Clan.
“How is this possible, Kato couldn’t even take one move from that human genius,”
Similarly, people like Joshua Welan from the human faction were also astonished; Jane Aiken, having broken through to the later stages of the Ninth Heavens, was too strong.
The combination of four types of Sword Intent, all touching upon the rules, amplified each another. A single Sword Intent alone was comparable to the late period of the Ninth Heavens, and the Four Great Sword Intentions intertwined could clash against the Nine-fold Peak.
In the Heavenly Feather Camp, a young man wearing an ornate crown exclaimed, “The four kinds of Sword Qi phenomena of this human girl are very special, they’ve touched upon some unknown power, forming an unstable force field.”
“This force field disrupted the structure of the Divine Texts when coming close to Kato’s, causing the power to become chaotic. That’s why they were so easily destroyed, otherwise, in a fair fight, Kato could have lasted at least three moves.”
Immediately, all those from the Heavenly Feather Clan around were speechless, having thought it had found that human girl’s weakness.
After defeating Kato, Jane Aiken did not leave the stage but looked towards the distant Heavenly Feather Clan camp, “I wonder, does anyone else wish to come up?”
The previous opponent was too weak, providing no sense of pressure, which left Jane Aiken somewhat disappointed as she hoped to find an opponent she could fight against with all her strength.
And watching this scene, the Primordial True Kings and True Martial Heavenly Kings above did not speak to prevent it but watched with great interest instead.
Including the Heavenly King powerhouse Bordea from the Heavenly Feather Clan, his face also showed interest, “Mysterious Martial Brother, is this the Power of Intent mastered by your Human Race? Indeed, it’s very strong.”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King showed a faint smile, “Actually, the normal Fist Intent, Blade Intent aren’t as formidable as that. The strength of that sword strike was mainly due to the person using it.”
Bordea nodded, “I understand what you mean, Mysterious Martial Brother. It seems this girl is the monster genius of your generation then.”
“That’s one way to put it, except for that little monster,” The Mysterious Martial Sky King didn’t deny it.
The moment Jane Aiken reached the Ninth Heavens within one year and created an Illusory World with the Four Great Sword Intentions, her talent shook the Federal Top Level immediately.
This kind of talent was no less than Jonathan Walker’s in his day.
It’s a pity that with Jack Clark preceding her, the Federation had already heavily publicized and greatly inspired the people.
“Since the first to take the stage is the monster genius of the Human Race, there’s no need to fight all three battles. Let’s have a match to decide the winner,”
As he said this, Bordea looked down, his gaze resting on the young man with the ornate crown and a golden feather pattern on his forehead.
“Augubas, you go. Among those at the initial stage of the Ninth Tier, only you might be able to put up a fight,”
Upon hearing this, the young man with the ornate crown rolled his eyes, “Lord Bordea, while I dare not claim to be unbeatable among all races at my rank, to merely put up a fight seems a bit of an understatement.”
Bordea’s face revealed a faint smile, “We’ll know if it’s an understatement when you go up and fight.”
The conversation between the two revealed the not-so-simple identity of this Heavenly Feather Clan talent named Augubas.
“Then I’ll go.”
With those words, a strong Battle Intent flared in Augubas’ eyes. His nearly fully incandescent twin pairs of golden wings vibrated slightly, taking him to the Martial Arts Arena in a blink, surrounded by dozens of afterimages.
Looking at the black-haired girl standing resolute in the Sword Territory, Augubas slowly said, “I practice the Great Divine Canon of my Heavenly Feather Clan, the Phoenix God’s Eternal Classic. You’d better be careful in the next round.”
“Please.” Jane Aiken’s eyes grew slightly more serious.
In the aura of this member of the Heavenly Feather Clan, entering the initial stage of the Ninth Heavens, she sensed a very strong danger. Clearly, this ‘Person’ was very powerful, very impressive.
Boom!
Behind Augubas, the two pairs of golden wings blazed with light, emitting terrible energy fluctuations, as if those wings were his source of energy and power reactor.
Within the dazzling golden radiance, a divine mountain shadow thousands of meters tall appeared behind Augubas. It resembled a mountain-shaped Divine Text, exuding an extremely heavy gravitational presence.
Just as the mountain shadow appeared, the air around Augubas exploded under the force of the gravity, creating concentric white waves that surged in all directions.
“Divine Mountain Suppresses Eternity!”
Boom!
With a long cry from Augubas, divine mountain shadows appeared one after another behind him. In an instant, the entire Martial Arts Arena trembled under the oppressive aura.
Especially when divine mountain shadows loomed over Jane Aiken’s head, the Sword Territory continuously quaked, Sword Qis dispersed, the earth beneath sank, and the might was terrifying.
At that moment, Jane Aiken’s eyes reflected countless Sword Qis, and a much sharper and more terrifying Sword Intent soared into the sky.
Especially when Jane Aiken began to slowly draw the black war sword on her back, her aura climbed to its peak, as if a peerless sword deity had descended.
Augubas pressed towards Jane Aiken with a gentle motion, “Suppress!”
Thud Thud Thud! Mountains carrying the weight of billions of tons fell from the sky. The overbearing force shook the space, and all creation thundered with a horrifying power that seemed to flatten heaven and earth.
Facing those heavily falling mountains, the reflection of a sword world appeared in Jane Aiken’s eyes, her figure fusing with her sword, ascending to the heavens.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1224 - 1224 479 Yes that Jack Clark is just that
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1224: Chapter 479 Yes, that Jack Clark is just that perverted_3 Chapter 1224: Chapter 479 Yes, that Jack Clark is just that perverted_3 “`
Pfft!
A hundred-meter long black sword light tore apart the space, forming a pitch-black crack, sharp beyond compare, severing seventeen divine mountains in one fell swoop.
But here, the sword light seemed to have expended its energy, and almost instantly it turned into a green light, bursting forth at a terrifying speed, passing through the illusion of dozens of divine mountains like a streak of light.
Suddenly, the illusory mountains toppled, immediately rumbling and exploding, the ground collapsing over an area of several kilometers, while the powerful energy shockwave swept across tens of kilometers.
Watching the green sword light ripping through heaven and earth, Augubas spread his golden light wings behind him and uttered softly, “Eternal Phoenix!”
Boom!
Behind Augubas, a pair of phoenix wings, resembling both divine text and burning flames, spread out, covering a kilometer radius, emanating a terrifyingly fiery aura capable of scorching the heavens and boiling the seas.
Boom!
With a flap of the phoenix wings, a hundred-meter high wave of fire tsunami swept towards the sword light transformed by Jane Aiken, overwhelming everything in its path and melting the ground into magma due to the intense heat.
Just as the sea of fire descended, the green sword light turned to crystal red, releasing a dazzling red radiance.
The sea of fire passed silently through the red sword light, as if transitioning from solid to shadow, causing no harm at all, Life and Death Illusion Annihilation.
This scene elicited praise from the Real Martial Heavenly King watching from above, “Using Sword Intent to touch upon the laws of illusion and reality, merging human with sword is also equivalent to merging with the laws, not bad.”
Then, once again, Augubas’s chant echoed between heaven and earth, “I am eternity, I am both heaven and earth, I lead and command the power of all creatures within!”
Behind Augubas, the golden light became even more brilliant, forming the roaring image of a giant beast shadow, a golden divine tree standing between heaven and earth, and the never-ending flow of roaring rivers.
Each of these shadows was a transformation of divine text, containing immense power, almost reaching the state where divine text evolves all things in the world.
Roar!
The giant beast shadow roared, shaking the heavens and earth, like a ninth-level late-stage beast lunging at Jane Aiken. Following that, the radiance from the golden divine tree surged as thousands of golden leaves were shot out.
“Well played.”
Jane Aiken’s face showed excitement as three war swords rose behind her, transforming into four swaths of red, black, green, and gray sword lights, expertly refined.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The interwoven sword lights shredded through the divine text illusions with the power reaching the pinnacle of Ninth Heaven, as the arena with a diameter of tens of kilometers kept exploding and collapsing under the fury of their battle.
The red sword light of Life and Death Illusion alternated between illusion and reality, the black sword light that tore through space was incomparably sharp, and the sword Qi of the Wind Spirit Instant Slash was as swift as lightning.
The seemingly inconspicuous grey sword light of Soul Slaying and Spirit Destruction, however, emitted an aura that caused Augubas’s spirit and soul to prick with pain, daring not to face it head-on.
While Jane Aiken’s sword light was swift as lightning, Augusta’s speed was equally astonishing, his light wings flapped and he reappeared over ten kilometers away.
And in his hands, the projections of divine text reflecting the myriad things of the world continued to condense.
These divine texts were powerful, each containing a special power that could project, giving the impression that Jane Aiken was not fighting against him but against the entire world itself.
“Junior Aiken is so strong now!” exclaimed Gabriella in amazement.
Freya Louise’s expression was slightly solemn, “That person from the Heavenly Feather Clan is also very strong, clearly at the early stage of Ninth Heaven in realm, but able to maintain a Ninth Heaven Peak burst for a long time as if his power is endless.”
At this moment, not just Freya Louise and Gabriella, but high-ranking powerhouses below the mythological level from both camps watched intently.
Human experts paid attention to Jane Aiken’s sublime transitions of sword Qi and mastery of sword light, while the Heavenly Feather Clan’s high-ranking powerhouses focused on Augubas’s divine text illusions.
Suddenly, Augubas soared into the sky, appearing at an altitude of ten thousand meters, with flaming double wings emerging behind him, resembling a kilometer-spanning flame phoenix in flight.
“Let’s decide the outcome with one move!”
Boom!
Behind Augubas, ninety-nine genuine divine texts emerged, merging to form a kilometer-tall golden shadow, exuding a grand aura of ancient vastness.
“`
In that moment, the entire heaven and earth seemed to tremble slightly.
This power had already transcended the Transcendence Realm, touching the domain of legends, bursting forth with strength comparable to a mythical strike at the early stages of the Ninth Heaven, a span that shocked everyone.
Even Joshua Welan, at the early stages of the Ninth Heaven, could only muster a full strength comparable to the peak of the Ninth Heaven when he exploded with his full power.
Then, in the heavens above, that golden figure formed a huge fist seal with his hands and brought it down from the sky, containing supreme gravity, and in an instant, the earth shook, and the resounding booms echoed endlessly.
And just as the golden ancient phantom appeared, a world of sword shadows emerged around Jane Aiken, with four sword lights piercing the earth and sky from each corner of the world.
Hum! The entire Sword World was like a massive array diagram, with Jane Aiken as the focal point.
Looking up at the destructive fist seal descending from the sky, Jane Aiken’s eyes reflected the Sword World, her arms spread out, and the array diagram trembled, with the sword lights hanging at the four corners surging and fusing into one.
Boom!
In an instant, a kilometer-long pure black Sword Qi soared into the sky, exuding a destructive aura that made everyone’s heart palpitate, and the level of strength stepped into the realm of myths.
To become the sword with one’s body, to use the world as an array, and to fuse the Four Great Sword Intentions as the backbone, is to perform Soul Slaying!
Under everyone’s gaze, the black Sword Qi intersected with the golden ancient fist seal, and then there was a moment of stillness, followed by an eruption of dazzling black-gold light.
Boom!
The shockwave exploded ten thousand meters in altitude, with shining gold and black halos flashing, generating circles of white shockwaves that swept across a hundred kilometers.
The invisible pervasive force shook the sky violently, with raging winds howling, blowing so hard that Freya Louise and the others could not help but burst out their True Strength to block it.
Almost ten minutes later, the explosive shock settled, the smoke and dust dispersed to reveal the torn and cracked Thunder, with Jane Aiken and Augubas standing a thousand meters apart.
At this point, both of them appeared somewhat weakened, and from their states, they seemed to have fought to a draw.
Augubas stood with his hands behind his back, looking at the distant Jane Aiken in admiration, “Your strength is very powerful, you can be considered the strongest person I have encountered of the same level.”
Jane Aiken said indifferently, “You are not weak either, I’m not sure I can defeat you.”
Hearing this, a faint smile appeared on Augubas’ face, “Let me introduce myself again, Augubas, the first person of the younger generation from the Supreme Institute of the Heavenly Feather Holy City.”
“With your talent, you must belong to the strongest among the younger generation of the Human Race, I don’t believe there are more outstanding figures than you in the Human Race.”
This was not an overstatement on Augubas’ part, for reaching the level of mythical power with an extreme burst at the early stages of the Ninth Heaven was a terrifying cross-realm fighting strength that was rare even among The Purgatory Family.
Including their Heavenly Feather Clan’s current generation, only he had achieved this.
Jane Aiken replied lightly, “Jane Aiken, a sophomore at South Sky Martial Arts School. However, I am at most among the top three in the younger generation of the Human Race, not the first.”
“What, there are people stronger than you in the Human Race?” Augubas was startled, hardly able to believe it.
The Heavenly Feather Clan had been observing the battle at the frontline battlefield, but they arrived here after the major battle had ended, so they had not witnessed the scene of the Purgatory Demon King confronting Adam Garcetti.
Jane Aiken nodded lightly, “Yes, that person is Jack Clark, a freshman, who broke through from the first stage of Transcendence to the Legendary Realm in just ten Sun Wheels.”
“He has slain several Purgatory Demon Kings in the early stages of the Ninth Heaven, a feat I naturally cannot accomplish at present.”
Hiss!
All the youngsters from the Heavenly Feather Clan took in a sharp breath, their faces showing shock and disbelief, with some even exclaiming aloud, “How is that possible!”
From below the Martial Arts Arena, Freya Louise said with a light laugh, “There’s nothing impossible, during the recent great battle at the frontline between our clan and the Purgatory Empire, Jack Clark ventured alone deep into the enemy’s rear.”
“With his mid-stage Mythical realm strength, he slaughtered seven demon kings, a Great Demon King, and a Titan Peak Demon Dragon, and managed to escape from the encirclement of three Demon Gods.”
As Freya Louise finished speaking, all the members of the Heavenly Feather Clan stood stunned on the spot.
Even the Heavenly King Level powerhouse Boris in the sky doubted if he had heard wrong.
In response to Boris’s inquiring gaze, the Mysterious Martial Sky King smiled faintly, “Brother Boris, you heard correctly, it’s indeed that exaggerated, although I was a bit stunned at the time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1225 - 1225 480 A World of Despair
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1225: Chapter 480: A World of Despair Chapter 1225: Chapter 480: A World of Despair As his “prestige” left the members of the Heavenly Feather Clan in awe in another space-time, a pink apartment room, Jack Clark also slowly opened his eyes.
Under the “unceasing” Evolution Energy, the severe injuries on his battered true body had finally recovered by seventy percent, with only the stab wound in his chest remaining.
That one strike of Abyss Annihilation was the culmination of all of Tarolia’s strength, its power akin to that of the rules, tearing even the Boundary Wall’s strength, which had merged with the Divine Power of Absolute Defense.
Furthermore, since this world was in the Dharma Ending Age, Transcendent Power was suppressed by the Heavenly Earth Rules. Jack was unable to restore his drained Law Divine Power and Laws’ Origin, so he could only rely on his Qi Blood to slowly wash away and wear down the injury.
But none of this mattered to Jack.
With a body as terrifyingly strong as an Early Titans Beast, he could suppress everything in this world.
That was the advantage of having a strong body. Even an accidental arrival in such a Dharma Ending World wouldn’t be feared, as there was no risk of his strength plummeting suddenly and being oppressed by enemies he could once squash with ease.
“Next, it’s time to explore this world, to find a solution for ‘time,’ and that Time Dragon…” Lost in thought, Jack slowly stood up.
The Time Dragon had also been swept up in the Time Storm explosion, and it was uncertain where it had ended up. Hopefully, it was okay, considering it was, after all, Scythia’s father.
If something really happened, Jack would feel a bit embarrassed.
“Mr. Clark, you’ve emerged from seclusion.”
As Jack opened the door to step out, Sherry Williams, who was dressed in a red long gown and tight jeans, quickly stood up from the sofa.
Looking at the black-haired girl who wasn’t in her Combat Suit and appeared to be only sixteen or seventeen years old, Jack nodded slightly, “Yes, I’ve emerged. Where’s your sister?”
As she looked at the calm black-haired young man, Sherry’s face turned slightly red, a touch of nervousness in her voice, “My sister is outside, teaching everyone cultivation. If you need anything, Mr. Clark, you can tell me.”
“By the way, would you like something to eat, Mr. Clark? We still have some rice, canned food, and Dried Dragon Back Meat.”
Because of Jack’s terrifying power that had destroyed half a city with a single blow and his almost shattered face that was too shocking, she hadn’t felt much at the time.
Now, looking at the young man dressed in a white T-shirt and gray casual pants, upright in stature, with a face like carved jade and almost perfectly handsome black hair, Sherry’s heart skipped a beat, as if she experienced love at first sight.
He was too handsome; how could there be such a good-looking man in the world, a thousand times more handsome than the big stars she had seen on television before?
Especially that indescribable regal quality, like a high and mighty god, with bright starry eyes, profound and indifferent, so cool.
Although she felt like a fangirl cheering wildly inside, Sherry maintained a very composed expression on her face, with just a slight tinge of red on her cheeks, giving away nothing unusual.
After all, she had lived through the Doomsday and had battled with Mutant monsters, as a Body Refiner.
Looking at the girl who was staring at him, Jack said indifferently, “I’m not hungry at the moment; I’m planning to go out for a while.”
“Mr. Clark, may I guide you?”
“…Sure.” Jack nodded, indeed in need of a guide to understand the situation here.
Although he had some knowledge of this world from controlling Sara Williams’ soul, the information was quite basic and not detailed enough.
As Jack opened the apartment door, his eyes lit up.
They were situated halfway up a cave, with buildings and rooms constructed on the mountain walls on either side.
Below was a space as large as a soccer field, where over thirty youths aged ten to fifteen were scattered about, seated on the ground in meditation, with the tall figure of Sara Williams standing in front of them.
At the top of the cave was a huge crack running through the mountain peak, through which sunlight filtered down, bringing some radiance to the base.
“This place used to be a large military research institute built inside the mountain belly, complete with accommodations, leisure, medical, including laboratories and other facilities.”
“Currently, the base has over ninety survivors, the youngest being ten years old and the oldest thirty-seven.”
“Everyone in the base is a Body Refiner, and the highest cultivation levels are with my sister and Teacher Jordan; they’re both Fifth Tier Body Refiners. Our main sources of food are hunting and some wild vegetables.”
“As for the usual spices and other supplies, we need to search in the city, including the obsidian needed for generating electricity.”
“Only over ninety people?” Jack Clark raised an eyebrow.
Because Sara and Sherry Williams’ room was at the entrance, Jack Clark had only glanced at the base when he came in earlier and had not expected there to be so few people here.
Sherry Williams smiled bitterly, “There’s no choice, after the outbreak of Doomsday, not only those Mutant Monsters, but even wildlife mutated under the virus became stronger and more aggressive, including insects and poisonous creatures.”
“Under such circumstances, ordinary people have no chance of survival, even if hiding inside the base; they could still be poisoned to death in their sleep by a creeping venomous creature.”
“Since the outbreak of Doomsday three years ago, my sister and I have followed the base through dozens of relocations, with the group of survivors once numbering over a hundred ten thousand.”
“But after repeated Mutant Monster attacks, those who scattered did, and those who died did, leaving only this many, relying on the concealment of this research institute.”
“In this world, ordinary people have already lost the right to survive.” Saying this, Sherry Williams’ expression became very complicated.
From her words, one could feel the despair of this world—three years into Doomsday, billions of humans possibly had only a few million survivors left, scattered and barely clinging to life.
Actually, this is the normal unfolding of a Doomsday World.
However, compared to the Lost World, where technology was at the level of several decades ago, Blue Star was in a much better situation; during the Heaven-Earth Mutated period, their technological civilization had reached the year two thousand.
Moreover, with the infusion of the energy from the mythical world and combining transcendent powers with technology, Blue Star’s strength quickly expanded, also benefitting from the heritage of ancient civilizations.
However, Jack Clark wasn’t concerned with these things; he was only interested in the complete Ancient Civilization Cultivation Methods.
The heritage of the relics from the Void Continent was fragmented, only encompassing part of the core strength; under such circumstances, the Human Race carved out their own path, but the limitations were also significant.
For example, all Human Kings, including Adam Garcetti and the Supreme Experts, had no path forward and needed to carve out a way on their own, bit by bit.
At that moment, the two reached the Playground below, attracting the attention of Sara Williams: “Everyone continue with your cultivation; if you have any questions, come ask me later.”
After speaking, the exaggeratedly voluptuous Sara Williams walked over to Jack Clark, a smile on her face: “Mr. Clark, are your injuries healed?”
“Yes, they’ve recovered.”
Jack Clark nodded and then went straight to the point, “I’d like to see the Cultivation Methods you’ve collected, including but not limited to those for Body Refinement.”
Sara Williams paused, then nodded decisively: “No problem, but these materials are all kept by Teacher Jordan. Mr. Clark, please follow me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1226 - 1226 481 - Breakthrough to Myth in a Single
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1226: Chapter 481 – Breakthrough to Myth in a Single Day, Everyone as Dragons (First Update) Chapter 1226: Chapter 481 – Breakthrough to Myth in a Single Day, Everyone as Dragons (First Update) Watching Jack Clark and his party walk away, the thirty-odd youths who were practicing stopped, and the eldest among them looked towards a girl beside him and asked curiously.
“Moon, is that the person Sister Sara and the others brought back?”
The girl dressed in black training attire, with eyebrows sharp as a sword and delicate facial features, raised an eyebrow and said irritably, “Arthur, how many times have I told you to call me sister? I’m the eldest here.”
The youth with a ponytail was unfazed, “You’re only a week older than me. Why do you keep making a fuss about it? Besides, who knows if you really didn’t lie about your birthday.”
Immediately, the girl’s eyes narrowed, sensing the invisible killing intent, the youth quickly relented and raised his hands, “Alright, alright, you’re older. Does that make you happy now, sister?”
Seeing this, Ivy Smith nodded in satisfaction, “That’s more like it. Yes, he’s the newcomer Sister Sara and the others brought back, but he looked quite ‘terrifying’ when they did.”
At this point, the fourteen-year-old girl revealed a hint of awe in her eyes.
Two days ago, the huge crack on Jack Clark’s chest and his face covered with dozens of red bloodstains were frightening, like a piece of fragile, cracked porcelain that could shatter at the slightest touch.
Pushing down the fear in her heart, Ivy Smith mused, “Sherry said that he’s very powerful, that he burst a Tyrant monster with just one punch.”
“What, he killed a Tyrant monster with just one punch!” A chorus of shock came from the group of children behind them.
“So awesome!”
“So strong, no wonder he’s so handsome,” a ten-year-old girl’s eyes shone with admiration.
Next to the girl, a young boy wiped his runny nose, somewhat puzzled, “… Orange, being handsome and being powerful don’t seem related, do they?”
The girl glared and argued, “Who says they’re not? All the male leads in those old DVDs were both handsome and powerful.”
“Right, I’ve seen those too, and big brother just now is a hundred times more handsome than them,” the surrounding children excitedly chimed in.
As the children’s conversation shifted to discussing which movie lead was more handsome, Ivy Smith wondered thoughtfully, “Arthur, do you think he will stay at our base?”
Arthur replied indifferently, “It doesn’t matter if he stays or not. Teacher Jordan always says we shouldn’t pin our hopes on others. Being strong ourselves is the fundamental way to stand our ground.”
“I am the genius who entered the realm of Body Refinement in less than half a year. Just give me a few more years and I’m certain to become a Great Master and bring back lots of dragon meat for everyone.”
Looking at the proud Arthur, Ivy Smith said coldly, “Okay, stop dreaming, continue your cultivation. By the time you become a high-order Body Refiner, the base might be long gone.”
“Besides, I broke through to the next level in just four months.”
In an instant, the pride on the ponytailed youth’s face stiffened.
…
Walking along the corridor that wrapped around the mountain wall, Sherry Williams, with her tall figure, spoke to Mr. Clark politely, “Mr. Clark, Sherry has already told you about the base, hasn’t she?”
Jack Clark looked indifferent and nodded slightly, “She briefly mentioned it.”
Compared to the budding Sherry, Sara Williams, who appeared to be in her twenties, seemed more mature and stronger, the equivalent of a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator.
Previously, she even dared venture deep into the perilous Ruin City, and when Jack fell from the sky, she had the courage to draw her sword.
But now, after becoming a little acquainted and talking again, Sara Williams spoke very softly, her face always carrying a gentle smile, as soft as her name suggests.
Moreover, this not only applied to her interaction with Jack but also to her demeanor while teaching the youths cultivation, similar to the gentle Mandy Lewis.
“Teacher Jordan used to be a university professor, then joined the Survivor Base after the Doomsday outburst, having practiced the Body refining technique, but he only reached the second level.”
“Normally, Teacher Jordan is responsible for managing the base’s supplies and taking care of the children, while the rest of us Body Refiners go out to gather resources.”
During their brief conversation, they quickly arrived at a room resembling a warehouse, where a cultured Elder with a genteel demeanor who was wearing glasses, was tidying things up with one arm.
Sara Williams knocked on the warehouse door that was ajar and said politely, “Teacher Jordan, we have something to discuss with you. This is Mr. Jack Clark.”
The Elder smiled and extended his right hand, “Hello, Mr. Clark, Sara has told me about you. I’m very grateful that you saved them the day before yesterday.”
Jack Clark shook hands with the Elder, replying modestly, “It was nothing; I just happened to be there. In fact, without me, they would have escaped unscathed.”
Sara had claimed it was Jack Clark who saved them, probably to help him integrate better into the base.
But Jack Clark knew that the ‘Tyrant’ and those mutant monsters, in fact, were drawn by the commotion of his arrival, and naturally wouldn’t really think he had saved them.
Sara Williams stated their purpose directly, “Teacher Jordan, Mr. Clark is interested in our Body refining technique and would like to take a look.”
“No problem, just a moment,” said the Elder, nodding his head, turning to a bookshelf behind him, and carefully took out a well-preserved book.
And the title on the cover caught Jack Clark’s attention.
[Red Sun Body Refining Technique, Simplified Version, Thirteenth Revision] Published on October 8, 9081, by Rain Flower Publishing House.
The Elder handed the Body refinement book to Jack Clark, smiling, “This is the Body refining technique we practice, the Red Sun Body Refining Technique. I have annotations for many of the ancient phrases in it, and it consists of six layers.”
“It is said the complete Red Sun Body Refining Technique has ten layers, and when cultivated to grand accomplishment, one’s Qi Blood burns like a furnace, and it’s like a Blood-coloured Giant Sun that can Destroy Heaven and Earth.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1227 - 1227 481 - Breakthrough to Myth in a Single
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1227: Chapter 481 – Breakthrough to Myth in a Single Day, Everyone as Dragons (Second Update) Chapter 1227: Chapter 481 – Breakthrough to Myth in a Single Day, Everyone as Dragons (Second Update) Jack Clark was somewhat puzzled, “Why are there only six levels?”
Teacher Jordan gave a wry smile, “Because it’s been too long. The chaos of ten thousand years and the Dharma Ending Age have resulted in people no longer believing in these Cultivation Methods, and naturally, they weren’t passed down.”
“This Red Sun Body Refining Technique was only passed down orally because many of the movements and breathing secrets had a certain training effect, and it was eventually compiled and printed into a book.”
“However, although the complete Ancient Techniques have not been passed down among the civilian population, the great families of various empires, including the state libraries, have collected some unique copies.”
“In addition to this, some Inheritance has been preserved from the Seal of the warships of the relics left behind when the strong men of the Ancient Civilization perished ten thousand years ago.”
“It is said that the strong men from the five major Survivor Bases obtained the complete Cultivation Method Inheritance from the relics, enabling them to cultivate so quickly and possess terrifying combat power.”
Well, it looks like this ordinary Cultivation Method is all there is to study for now.
Jack Clark took the books and said politely, “Teacher Jordan, do you have a dictionary here?”
Sara Williams was taken aback, “A dictionary, Mr. Callum, you don’t recognize these characters?”
The Lost World, though separated from the Expeditionary Army for ten thousand years, has maintained its cultural heritage, including written characters, hence Sara and Sherry Williams were surprised, mistaking him for an Ancient Civilization powerhouse.
Unaware he had been labeled an ‘Ancient Civilization strong man,’ Jack offhandedly said, “The characters here are a bit different from what I know, it should be…”
At that moment, Jack paused suddenly.
Just then, he felt an inexplicable feeling of rejection from time itself—as if his words had touched upon the ‘Time Paradox’.
As a person from the future, even though he was considered a semi-Time Being due to the erosion by the Power of Time, it still didn’t change the fact that he was from the future.
Between the past and the present lies a paradox, where a person’s smallest action could trigger a butterfly effect after going back in time.
For instance, Jack arriving in the Lost World and killing someone who wouldn’t have died otherwise.
In such a case, the descendants of this person who wouldn’t have died—their children, grandchildren, and many generations thereafter—everything related to them would undergo a dramatic change.
It could even lead to the disappearance of an empire that was supposed to exist, causing an increasingly widespread ripple through the rivers of time, eventually triggering the collapse of the established space-time and history.
Of course, there is also the possibility that, in the past timeline, it was destined that Jack would return to the past amidst a Time Storm, appear in the Lost World, and that person was fated to die by his hand.
There’s also the possibility that his recent arrival has had little impact on this space-time’s ‘past,’ so he hasn’t faced strong rejection yet.
But if he were to reveal ‘information’ of too great an importance or take actions with too significant an impact from now on, he would be repelled by this space-time immediately.
Lost in thought, Jack took the Secret Scripture and dictionary in hand and sat down at the desk to flip through them, tossing aside his speculations about time.
Time was too Mysterious, dealing with an infinitely ancient past, present, and future—it was not a force he was currently capable of probing.
In the eyes of scientists, time and space are mere forms in which matter exists, but to Transcendent Life, time is a ruler that records everything, measuring the historical rivers of countless worlds.
Even the Time Beings, such as the Time Dragon, know very little about ‘time.’ They perceive it as a force, a vast and supreme power.
But even they simply dwell in the cracks of time, unable to touch time at will, let alone traverse the timelines of the past, present, and future.
Whirr, whirr!!
Under the watchful eyes of the sisters Sara and Sherry Williams and the Elder, Jack, seated to the left, casually flipped through the dictionary in a flurry, and in less than a minute had picked up the body refinement book.
Then, turning the pages one by one, he completed reading the secret book of over a hundred pages—including images, summaries, comments, and other content—in only a minute.
Sherry Williams blinked in disbelief as she watched Jack put down the book and sit pensively, “Mr. Clark, have you finished reading it?”
Jack came back to his senses and nodded, “Yes, I’ve read it all.”
Is this real? The three exchanged glances, slightly dazed.
With the Evolution Energy feedback from the Giant Beast growing stronger with each iteration, Jack’s body was not only stronger and faster, but also improved overall.
For instance, his brain’s processing speed was faster, terrifyingly more so than a computer’s—his capabilities for instantaneous processing, analysis, simulation, and so on were staggeringly impressive.
A minute ago, he had imprinted all the contents of the dictionary and the secret scripture in his mind and completed the analysis and understanding.
If Jack were to become a scientist, he alone could serve as a large research institute.
However, science isn’t about calculation power; his personal talent lay more on the path of cultivation, and in just a moment, he had almost completed the analysis of the Red Sun Body Refining Technique.
