Looking at the three puzzled people beside him, Jack calmly said, “The three of you, I am preparing to try cultivating this technique. Please make sure no one disturbs me.”
Although they did not understand why ‘Ancient War General’ Jack wanted to practice the body refining technique, Sara quickly responded, “Mr. Clark, the base has a special Cultivation Room…”
“No need, anywhere will do.”
Saying so, Jack moved to a corner of the warehouse, then sat down cross-legged and closed his eyes.
The core of the Red Sun Body Refining Technique is to condense the Blood Qi in the human body into the power of ‘Qi Blood,’ forcibly absorbing the Power of Heaven and Earth from within to temper the body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1228 - 1228 481 Breakthrough Myth in a Day Everyone
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1228: Chapter 481: Breakthrough Myth in a Day, Everyone as Dragons (First Update)_3 Chapter 1228: Chapter 481: Breakthrough Myth in a Day, Everyone as Dragons (First Update)_3 And as a Transcendent Body Refining Skill, it naturally has a circulation of meridian routes and acupoints for gradual Transformation, and in some ways, it is similar to the True Martial Arts.
Or it could be said that both end up achieving the same goal through different means, given that Blue Star’s True Martial Way originated from the power system of an Ancient Civilization.
The first step of the Red Sun Body Refining Technique is to gather and condense Blood Qi, which is quite simple for Jack Clark.
However, just as he was preparing to start cultivation, Jack Clark noticed something amiss.
Because the bodies of modern humans on Blue Star have evolved for tens of thousands of years and have some differences compared to the Ancient Human Race, some meridians and positions are different.
In this situation, Blue Star natives holding a complete Cultivation Method would still be unable to cultivate, and might even suffer from cultivation deviation, leading to their demise.
Especially after tens of thousands of years, the languages and cultures of both civilizations have become distinct, and the misinterpretation of a few words in a Cultivation Method could lead to drastically different outcomes.
No wonder the emperors of Ancient Civilizations chose to erase all cultivation information from the Continent of Void Heritage when they departed, leaving behind only the core power inheritance.
They had clearly anticipated this day.
However, this issue was still irrelevant to Jack Clark, for with his current realm, his control and mastery over his flesh had long become instinctive.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under Jack Clark’s control, his flesh and blood squirmed as he made subtle adjustments to his dislocated meridians, while at the same time reining in the terrifying power within him that could Destroy Heaven and Earth, to prevent any interference with the Cultivation Method.
Fortunately, after the Fighting Demon God True Body broke through to the Legendary Realm, besides the condensed Law Divine Power, all traces of past Cultivation Methods had merged with the Divine Body.
Jack Clark’s True Body was the manifestation of a ‘Cultivation Method’.
In less than a minute, the internal structure of Jack Clark’s body became similar to that of the Ancient Human Race, and then a strand of scorching and majestic Blood Qi spontaneously arose, circulating.
Boom! A faint aura of the Red Sun emerged from Jack Clark, breaking through the first level of body refinement.
Following that, the strand of Blood Qi inside Jack Clark circulated at a terrifying speed, and with each cycle, its power would surge several times, completing sixty cycles in one minute.
Boom! An even more powerful aura of Red Sun Blood Qi burst from Jack Clark, his clothes fluttering without wind, breaking through to the Second Layer.
“Red Sun Second Layer, how is it possible to be so fast!” Sherry Williams and Sara Williams were shocked and stupefied, with the Elder missing an arm also frozen in place.
However, Jack Clark stopped there, because the Red Sun Technique of the Third Layer was a bit different and required him to adjust some subtle body structures.
But after mastering the basics of body refining technique, Jack Clark was too lazy to waste time adjusting his body structure.
Instead of adjusting his body to suit the Cultivation Method, it was better to let the Cultivation Method evolve to accommodate him, so Jack Clark’s voice echoed directly in his mind: “Consume attribute points, enhance the Red Sun’s Third Layer.”
Suddenly, the attribute page’s 56017 Attribute Points jumped slightly, becoming 55817, deducting 200 points.
Boom!
An instant energy boost appeared spontaneously in Jack Clark’s body, merging with the tempered strand of Red Sun Qi Blood, causing the Blood Qi to burst and start circulating on its own.
Although the attribute page’s enhancement function couldn’t deduce the Cultivation Methods on its own, it could optimize based on Jack Clark’s existing Cultivation Methods, making them more compatible with his body.
Under the power of enhancement, those meridians and routes for circulating Qi Blood were fine-tuned and unfamiliar routes were opened beneath the muscles and skin, running throughout Jack Clark’s body.
Boom!
After just a few minutes of pause, the aura of Red Sun Qi Blood around Jack Clark surged by more than ten times, radiating a faint blood-red glow.
Sherry Williams exclaimed in shock, “The Third Layer!”
“So powerful…” Sara Williams covered her chest, her heart beating rapidly, breathing hurriedly, and watched Jack Clark, who was sitting cross-legged, in disbelief.
During her struggles against successive attacks from Mutant monsters, it took her five whole months to break through from the Second to the Third Layer, and yet Jack Clark had taken only two minutes, two minutes!!
Just then, as Jack Clark felt the changes in his body’s strength, his voice once more resounded in his mind.
“Expend 400 attribute points to enhance the Red Sun Body Refining Technique to the Fourth Layer.”
In an instant, the Qi Blood within Jack Clark’s body exploded once again, with Blood Qi circulating madly within, several times more overbearing than the True Strength of the Third Layer Heaven. It absorbed all the Blood Qi energy in his body, rapidly expanding.
At the same time, as the Red Sun Qi Blood circulated throughout his body, Jack Clark’s physical body also underwent subtle changes, being strengthened and tempered bit by bit.
However, compared to the strength of his True Demon God Body at this moment, this enhancement from the Red Sun Body Refining Technique was almost negligible. If Jack Clark hadn’t been paying close attention, he wouldn’t have noticed it at all.
After cycling through one second one Heaven, which ran for three hundred and sixty circuits, the force had already skyrocketed by more than twenty times.
Boom!
After six minutes of cultivation, the aura on Jack Clark’s body surged once more, pushing him to seamlessly break through the Fourth Layer, setting off a layer of blood-red flames on his body, emitting scorching heat waves.
From beginner level to the breakthrough of the Fourth Layer, Jack Clark only took ten minutes, numbing Sara Williams and the two others to the point where they stood frozen in the distance, questioning whether they were hallucinating.
“Just like True Martial, the Fourth Layer of body refinement is also a quality change; the physique undergoes a transformation, life level begins to evolve, stepping into the transcendent,” Jack Clark thought to himself, feeling the ‘slight’ changes in his body as his thoughts resonated in his mind once again.
“Expend 1400 attribute points to enhance the Red Sun Body Refining Technique to the Fifth Layer, the Sixth Layer.”
As an Ancient Technique, the requirements to enhance it were higher than those of the same level True Martial Arts, needing 600 points for the Fifth Layer, 800 for the Sixth, and so on increasing progressively.
Boom!
The red flames burning on Jack Clark’s body soared, and a wild and scorching aura exploded from him as the center, blasting the air and creating a raging wind that swept through the entire warehouse.
Under the powerful gust, the ground trembled, and Sara Williams and her two companions, who did not dare to burst their Qi Blood for fear of disturbing Jack, kept retreating all the way to the door.
In the howling wind, Sara Williams’ long black hair danced wildly, and the white tracksuit she was wearing fluttered loudly, accentuating her curvaceous figure even more.
Looking at the towering flames of blood-colored fire around Jack Clark, Sherry swallowed, “Sis, he’s already broken through the Fifth Layer.”
“I know,” Sara replied, looking at the increasingly majestic flames of qi blood around Jack Clark, feeling even more certain of her hunch.
Boom!
The blood-colored flames burning on Jack Clark’s body surged once again, rising meters into the sky, faintly forming behind him a Blood-coloured Giant Sun, radiating intense heat.
Under the blood-red Qi Blood flames that seemed tangible, the concrete ground below cracked in a blink of an eye, showing signs of melting into magma, indicating how high the temperature was.
This world was in the Dharma Ending Age, where all supernatural forces were suppressed by Heavenly Earth Rules, but when the strength purely condensed from the flesh and blood reached a certain degree, it still compared to supernatural forces.
Suddenly, the one-armed Elder shouted anxiously, “Not good, Mr. Clark, stop quickly, those things…”
Just as the entire warehouse was about to be ignited by Jack, the vision of the Red Sun disappeared, the storm subsided, revealing the silhouette of Jack seated in a meditative pose.
Jack slowly opened his eyes, his gaze calm, showing not a trace of excitement for having in less than half an hour, brought a powerful Body Refining Technique to the Sixth Layer.
With his current intrinsic strength, given enough attribute points, not to mention the Sixth Layer, if the Cultivation Method was perfected, he could break through to the Legendary Realm in a single day.
After all, the most crucial ‘Blood Qi’ for such Body Refining Techniques was infinite for him, comparable to a Titan Level Giant Beast’s flesh and blood, enough for him to arbitrarily experiment and cultivate.
The time needed to cultivate Methods could also be bypassed directly through the enhancement of attribute points.
“However, this force is so weak,” Jack thought, as the terrifying power contained within his body erupted, directly devouring the Red Sun Qi Blood strength that had just been cultivated to the Sixth Layer.
This cultivation test, with himself as the experiment material, didn’t help much in terms of strength, but the gains were significant.
This kind of Body Refining Technique, which requires at its lowest the Blood Qi produced by the body, made him realize the potential for every person on Blue Star to become as powerful as dragons and for everyone to cultivate.
But for now, it was only a potential possibility.
He needed more Body Refining Techniques to experiment with, to verify and modify using his own body, step by step, until he could create a complete ‘Basic Body Refining Technique’ that was perfectly suited for the modern people of Blue Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 1229 - 1229 482 Guiding of Time Thousand Hands
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1229: Chapter 482 Guiding of Time, Thousand Hands Buddha Statue Chapter 1229: Chapter 482 Guiding of Time, Thousand Hands Buddha Statue “Everyone as Dragons.”
When Jack Clark thought about the possibility of creating a Body Refining Technique that would enable all people to practice it, inspired by the ancient Body Refining Techniques, he couldn’t help but lick his lips.
As a civilization new to the mythical world, the Human Race was clearly at a disadvantage compared to long-established tribes like The Purgatory Family.
There were too few Transcendent cultivators above the Fourth Layer Heaven, with only a few million accumulated over decades, but the Fourth Layer Heaven was just a basic standard for creatures in the mythical world.
Be it Unique Beasts, different races, or Purgatory True Demons, as long as they reached adulthood, even the weakest, without any cultivation, were comparable to the physique of Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivators.
Under these circumstances, with hundreds of millions of Purgatory True Demons in the two great empires, at least tens of millions were advanced cultivators, not to mention the even larger number of Vassal Races.
However, the Human Race also had its advantages, namely time and technological civilization.
Because the Heavenly Energy rules in Blue Star’s universe were different, the lifespans of humans from Blue Star were shorter than those of beings from the mythical world, and both their cultivation and physical growth were faster.
Technological products, including various precision Electronic Components, could only be produced in the Blue Star World due to basic physical Rule reasons, which was the core of the technological barrier.
Otherwise, with the means of the Purgatory Demon Gods, they would have captured some high-level cultivators on the battlefield to search their souls and plunder information about technology long ago.
It wasn’t that they were unaware of the importance of technology, but that they couldn’t produce it in the mythical world, and there was no way to quietly transmit machinery and equipment through the Evil God Sect Cultists.
Meanwhile, humans had another advantage: numbers. Without the problem of difficult reproduction seen in Transcendent lifeforms, the human population could double in a decade if they focused on amassing soldiers.
The population was maintained at around two billion, because if there were too many, Heavenly Energy on Blue Star would be spread too thin, resulting in even fewer possessing the talent for cultivation.
But if Jack Clark could solve the issue where Foundation Establishment depended on Heavenly Energy, and create a path where ordinary eating could strengthen Qi Blood without a cultivation threshold…
Let alone two billion, as long as hundreds of millions of humans made a breakthrough in the First Layer, and then, based on talent, the Federation provided a little resources, there would be another explosion in the number of human advanced cultivators.
After all, Blue Star had Heavenly Energy, and the environment was better than in the Lost World.
A vast base of cultivators meant more chances for high-ranking powerhouses to emerge, and as long as humanity could survive the threat of The Purgatory Family, it would become a dominant force in the mythical world within just a few centuries.
And Jack Clark, who would open the Great Era where everyone was as dragons, would undoubtedly be eternally sung about for billions of years.
Although he didn’t care much about fame and wealth, the idea that one day he might be revered as a Holy Ancestor in a cultivation civilization still excited Jack Clark slightly.
Hu! Jack Clark exhaled deeply.
It was still too early to think about these things now, as it was still questionable whether he could succeed. After all, it took the True Martial Heavenly King ten years to perfect the Body Casting Skill, causing a massive cultivation explosion among the Human Race.
Jack Clark looked towards the door where Sara Williams and her two companions were standing, “Miss Williams, do you know of any Survivor Bases that have Body Refining Techniques or where a national library might be located recently?”
Sara Williams paused, puzzled: “Mr. Clark, with your level of cultivation, our Body Refining Techniques shouldn’t be of much help to you, should they?”
They had also felt the disturbance from when Jack Clark disrupted the power of the Red Sun Qi Blood, which is why they were confused.
Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “How could there be no gain? The core of every Cultivation Method is a path, a way of a strong cultivator.”
“When I cultivated the Red Sun Body Refining Technique to the Sixth Level, I sensed another type of ‘fire’ power. If cultivated to its limit, it could master another Rule of Fire and condense a special Red Sun Divine Physique.”
“Unfortunately, this method is incomplete and not enough for me to reference and corroborate my own path, so I need more Body Refining Techniques.”
So that was it. Realization dawned in Miss Williams’ and her sisters’ eyes, followed by admiration.
They hadn’t expected Jack Clark to be so strong and still putting in such effort persistently like this. It was no wonder he was a Mythical Powerhouse from an Ancient Civilization.
“Only national libraries in various countries have collections of complete Body Refining Techniques, or possibly within ancient relics.”
Teacher Jordan thought for a moment: “We are currently in Heaven Mysterious City of the White Departure Empire, one of the four major empires. Its national library has a collection of many ancient texts.”
“The White Departure Capital is about five thousand kilometers away, one to the south and one to the north, and you have to pass through dozens of cities occupied by Mutant monsters, which is fraught with danger.”
Teacher Jordan’s tone became grave as he said this.
Over the years, although humans have acquired a certain self-defense strength through cultivation, the billions of human Mutant monsters have evolved to be even more powerful.
There were also Giant Beasts like dinosaurs, which before Doomsday required heavy weapons to kill, and had become even more terrifying through virus mutations.
This era was more dangerous than ancient times; nobody knew what they would encounter in the wilderness, where straying a bit farther could mean life or death separation.
However, for Jack Clark, travelling over five thousand kilometers was simple and could be accomplished in a moment, but without a map, it was difficult to find the way.
Just as Jack Clark was considering whether to bring someone with him for the journey, a commotion suddenly arose in the distance.
“Uncle Ladner, Uncle Ladner, what’s happened to you!?”
At the Survivor Base entrance, several figures covered in blood rushed back, causing all the youths practicing in the area to startle and crowd around in a fluster.
The blood-covered young man who was leading them looked around anxiously, “Where’s Captain Williams, Captain Brown? They’re trapped and need support?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1230 - 1230 482 Guiding of Time Thousand Hands
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1230: Chapter 482 Guiding of Time, Thousand Hands Buddha Statue_2 Chapter 1230: Chapter 482 Guiding of Time, Thousand Hands Buddha Statue_2 Ivy Smith said anxiously, “Sister Sara has gone to the warehouse, I’ll go call her right away.”
“There’s no need.”
As he spoke, a figure flickered in the distance, and Sara Williams, emanating a red glow like red flames from her Qi Blood, appeared in front of everyone after a few flickers.
Looking at the three heavily injured people with weak auras, Sara Williams’s expression turned grave, “Theo, what happened?”
The young man at the forefront gave a wry smile, “A couple of days ago, when we went hunting for Dinosaur-like beasts with Captain Brown, we found the tracks of a Sorghum Dragon and followed them.”
“That Sorghum Dragon was nesting in a valley over a hundred and ninety kilometers away, with strength probably in the late Fifth Tier. After a tough fight, we successfully killed it.”
“But unexpectedly, during the battle, something was triggered, and the entire valley floor cracked open, and everyone fell down.”
“Since there was an underground river below, only a few brothers were injured at the time, but at the same time Captain Brown also made some discoveries—it seemed to be a relic.”
“A relic!” Sherry Williams exclaimed in surprise, followed by excitement.
Many Mythical Powerhouses had fallen in this world in ancient times, and some of them even reached Mythical levels.
Unfortunately, in the Dharma Ending World, where the Life Origin could not replenish, the Rule True Bodies became increasingly weak under suppression, and even the longest-lived Mythic War General only survived for a thousand years.
Before their demise, these Ninth Tier peak quasi-mythical, Mythic War Generals Burst their last strength to seal their palaces and Warships, burying them together.
Over tens of thousands of years, as time passed, many seals dissipated, and numerous people became rich overnight because of the discovery of relics.
Especially in this era, when cultivation rose again due to the virus mutation, finding a relic meant an enormous benefit, perhaps enabling one to ascend to the pinnacle of the world swiftly.
Even Jack Clark was somewhat surprised that there was a relic nearby.
Jack Clark appeared out of thin air, looking at Theo and inquiring, “Tell me, where is that relic?”
“You are…?” Staring at the suddenly appearing young man, so handsome that it made him, a man, envious, Theo questioned in surprise.
Sara Williams introduced gravely, “This is Mr. Clark, a very powerful strong man. If he takes action, Captain Brown and the others will definitely be fine.”
“Now, Theo, tell us the situation in detail, especially about Captain Brown and their predicament.”
Theo didn’t dare to delay, gasping for breath he hurriedly said, “The location is in the direction to the left of the base entrance, just over the small mountain range about forty kilometers away, and you’ll see the valley and the cracks.”
“There are many Ground Dragons inside that relic, and it’s full of their caves. We had just entered when we were surrounded and attacked; only we managed to break out.”
“I’ll go and take a look first.” As soon as Jack Clark knew the specifics, his figure disappeared in an instant, moving almost instantaneously under the Heaven-walking Divine Steps.
“Let’s hurry over too.” Sara Williams’s Qi Blood Burst forth from within her body, transforming into a red arrow shooting out at Subsonic Speed.
After Body Refinement, their close combat and speed were stronger than cultivators of the same level.
Boom!
Under the twilight, the mountain forest exploded, trees shattered, and a virtual shadow pierced the Earth at more than ten times the speed of sound, crossing two hundred kilometers in less than a minute.
The terrifying speed and the resulting sonic boom impact left a straight pathway tens of meters wide and nearly two hundred kilometers long through the mountains and forest.
“This is the place.”
At the edge of the crack in the valley that extended for several kilometers and was hundreds of meters deep, Jack Clark appeared out of nowhere, and then his figure flashed to hundreds of meters underground in an instant.
Roar! Several pairs of red eyes lit up in the darkness, fixing a bloodthirsty and wild stare on Jack Clark.
These were three Unique Beasts, each over ten meters long with elongated bodies and four stout short legs, covered in black scales, with ferocious dragon-like heads.
After just a moment’s hesitation, the three Ground Dragons roared and Burst their strength, shattering and erupting towards Jack Clark like three black shadows whipping up a raging wind.
However, Jack Clark didn’t even glance at them. After opening his heart to sense and using his Five Senses to feel the underground environment, his figure vanished with a flash.
Boom boom boom!! The figures of the three Ground Dragons exploded in mid-air, blown into a shower of blood that rained down over a hundred-meter range, exuding a strong scent of blood.
Boom!
A figure with blue and red firelight flashed by in the darkness, the result of rapid friction between Jack Clark’s body and the air creating a plasma fire shockwave due to his extreme speed.
Every Ground Dragon they passed, whether ten or twenty meters long, couldn’t even let out a scream before being blown apart by the terrible shockwave and Invisible Power.
…
Thousands of meters deep underground, the cave ceiling was covered with blue mushrooms, casting a faint light.
Below stood a Stone Gate, five hundred meters high, carved with a Thousand Hands Buddha Statue, with a gaze cast down and an indifferent expression, as if guarding over Hell.
At this moment, in front of the Stone Gate, about a dozen bloodied people backed against the wall, holding slash blades, long spears, and high-powered rifles, gasping for breath.
A hundred meters away, hundreds of Ground Dragons with lengths over ten meters, the longest measuring over forty meters, surrounded them, their brutal gazes fixed on the people.
But whether it was out of fear of the Stone Gate or not, although these Ground Dragons kept emitting brutal hisses, they didn’t dare take a step closer.
Looking at the huge Ground Dragon emitting black radiance among the leaders, a middle-aged man holding a rifle smiled bitterly, “Captain Brown, do you think there’s any hope of us getting out alive?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1231 - 1231 482 Guiding of Time Thousand Hands
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1231: Chapter 482 Guiding of Time, Thousand Hands Buddha Statue_3 Chapter 1231: Chapter 482 Guiding of Time, Thousand Hands Buddha Statue_3 In front of the crowd, a burly middle-aged man holding a slash blade over 2 meters long said in a deep voice, “Everyone, don’t lose heart. As long as we are alive, there is still hope.”
“We have made it through so many dangers over the years; are we really afraid of these beasts?”
Immediately, those around them were invigorated, “That’s right, Captain Brown is right. We must never give up until the very end, and even if we die, the base still has Captain Sara and others.”
Suddenly someone paused, “Wait, there seems to be some noise.”
Before they could sense anything further, a blue and red radiance flashed through the darkness in the distance, followed by the booming and explosive vibrations that shook the underground.
Roar roar roar!!
In the agonized howls and roars of the Ground Dragons, countless flesh and blood exploded, and in the blink of an eye, dozens of Level 4 and Level 5, including an early Level 7 Ground Dragon King, were all dead.
Standing amidst the carnage of flesh and remnants, was a black-haired young man still emitting a faint blue and red glow, and an invisible aura of terrifying oppression radiated from him.
Under the weight of this formless pressure, Reg Brown and the others all trembled, not daring to move.
This black-haired young man was terrifying, extremely terrifying.
Just then, the black-haired young man spoke lightly, “Don’t be afraid. It’s Sara who asked me to come to save you. These Ground Dragons have been killed by me; you can get out now.”
Having said that, Jack Clark no longer paid attention to these people, but looked towards the Stone Gate behind them.
The moment he arrived here, his Void-Striking Heart Eye at the center of his forehead twitched slightly, and even the ‘Power of Time’ that had eroded the left side of his body was somewhat agitated.
It seemed that behind this gate, there was a force related to time, or perhaps the key to solving the time problem that plagued him was right behind this gate.
No wonder he had come here.
It was clearly the time hinted at by the Time Dragon.
Pondering this, Jack Clark stepped out amidst the terrified gazes of Reg Brown and the others, and in a flash, his figure arrived in front of the Thousand Hands Buddha Stone Gate.
Reg Brown hurriedly spoke up, “Sir, we don’t know what this Stone Gate is made from, it’s incredibly heavy… all of us together can’t budge it even a little…”
Boom!
Before Reg Brown could finish his last word, under Jack Clark’s slight push with his right hand, the entire mountain wall and even the whole underground trembled violently.
In an instant, countless boulders fell from above their heads, rumbling as though the sky was collapsing and the earth was splitting.
At the same time, the eyes of the Thousand-Armed Buddha on the Stone Gate suddenly lit up, emitting a majestic and stern aura, with a thousand arms reaching out from behind the Stone Gate.
Boom!
The whole world seemed to shake, and a terrifying, immense force descended, led by the awakening Thousand-Armed Buddha, its thousand hands bursting with a power that could Destroy Heaven and Earth, and grind everything before it to dust.
The mighty force made even Jack Clark take things seriously, and his muscles and bones vibrated slightly; his Qi Blood roared like a Tsunami.
Within Jack Clark, a force capable of shaking the world burst out. The power was so ferocious that space twisted around him, and the ground collapsed, as if some terrifying entity was awakening.
Boom! Under Jack Clark’s punch, all things crumbled, and the solidity of space itself was shattered, creating layer upon layer of fan-shaped, spreading black tides of destruction, obliterating everything.
Under that overbearing and absolute destructive force, the strength that reached the Myth Threshold and could completely destroy the entire underground cave, the Thousand-Armed Buddha was instantly annihilated.
Boom boom boom!! The earth-shattering explosion echoed incessantly, shaking the entire underground with that punch.
The mere sonic boom was enough to cause Reg Brown and the others to spit out blood, and the raging wind from the aftermath sent them flying backward, screaming as they went.
The violent explosion blasted like a tangible force, striking everything.
As the Thousand-Armed Buddha was destroyed, the white Stone Gate connected to the entire underground began to shake violently, cracking open with numerous fissures until it finally exploded with a bang.
With the collapse of the Stone Gate, the object behind it also came into Jack Clark’s view.

chapters.title: Chapter 1232 - 1232 482 Time Reincarnation Mark Suppressing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1232: Chapter 482 Time Reincarnation Mark, Suppressing Two Dragons Chapter 1232: Chapter 482 Time Reincarnation Mark, Suppressing Two Dragons “`
As the Power Explosion of the Thousand-Armed Buddha Statue dissipated, the Stone Gate shattered, revealing an even more vast space behind it, filled with Cloud Mist and a majestic Great Hall towering in the distance.
From beyond the door, Jack felt a strong surge of Spatial Fluctuations, clearly a piece of space that had been sealed off.
Once this fragment of space manifested into reality, it was immediately suppressed by the Heavenly Earth Rules, and the white Stone Gate constructed a kilometer high Great Hall that continually trembled.
Seeing this, Jack’s silhouette flickered, and in an instant, he turned into a residual image and rushed in.
As Jack’s figure disappeared into the haze, Reg Brown and others struggled to rise from the ground in the distance, their expressions hesitant as they gazed at the cloud-enveloped world behind the Stone Gate.
This time, Jack’s mission was to explore the relic and save people along the way, naturally not intending to accidentally harm them to death.
Although the residual force from the punch just now was terrifying, it only sent them flying when it hit them, forcing blood out with the strong impact.
Someone hesitated, “… Captain, should we go in?”
“There are some things we cannot touch, otherwise, we will die,” Reg Brown slowly shook his head.
Recalling the terrible power that burst forth from the Stone Gate and the terrifying combat strength of the black-haired young man who could Destroy Heaven and Earth with one punch, the others shivered uncontrollably.
Indeed, bite off only as much as you can chew.
“Everyone, clean up and head back the way we came, to see if we can find the corpses of the old generals and bring them back for a joint burial.” Immediately, all the faces turned somber, and they quickly turned and left.
The Great Hall, shrouded in Cloud Mist, seemed quite close, but actually, it was a dozen kilometers away from the Sealed Door.
The Great Hall had no doors, only two thick stone pillars standing tall like the South Heavenly Gate, with empty space in between that seemed as if anyone could just walk in.
But through Jack’s eyes, which now bore black gold vertical pupils, a powerful barrier stood within the seemingly empty air.
Boom!
A barrier as tough as the Nine Layers was directly shattered by Jack, as he stepped into the Great Hall, immediately causing the ancient runes engraved on the walls to light up.
These runes emitted radiance, converging at the center of the Great Hall to form a white figure a hundred meters tall, with a shadow of a thousand arms in the background, its hands forming mysterious seals.
Next, a grand and ancient Spiritual Will vibrated through the Great Hall, the voice expressing a tired lament, “Has this Sealed Hall finally been opened?”
The projection gazed emptily below, as if looking at Jack, but also as if it were just a past thought speaking to itself, continuing to say.
“Future generations, by entering this place, you must have reached at least the Ninth Tier, qualifying you to receive the Emperor’s Command Token in my hand.”
“I am Boris, General of War, the first among the seventeen generals under the Throne of the Wheel-Light Emperor, commanding the Expeditionary Army of the Earth to exterminate the remnants of the Void Pupil Alien Race.”
“Unfortunately, on the way back after completing the mission, we were ambushed by a powerful enemy, space-time collapsed, and the entire army fell into this trap of the Dharma Ending World.”
“However, as the first War General under the Emperor’s Throne, I am peerless within the same rank, and even King-level enemies are suppressed and slain by me burning my Origin…”
What follows is a monologue of the strong man that lasts for ten minutes.
In the war nearly ten thousand years ago, the army of both races almost destroyed half of the world, eventually perishing together, leaving only a few humans and Boris, who was heavily injured.
Because his injuries were too severe and his Life Origin kept flowing out under the suppression of the Heavenly Earth Rules of the Dharma Ending World, he had no strength to tear through the Boundary Wall and return to the mythical world.
In the end, after leaving some arrangements, this Ancient Powerhouse known as Boris, General of War, perished in this Great Hall.
And the so-called arrangements are tossing out some treasure hunting remnants, so that future Human Race members, if they can find this place and pass some trials, would obtain his Inheritance.
For example, to approach the Thousand-Armed Buddha Statue gate, one must pass through some levels, then decode the rune password on the gate to open it and enter the space fragment world.
Although he perished when this world was at the end of its Dharma cycle, both the world and life are a cycle; where there is an ending, there is also a time of Cultivation Event.
He believed that as long as the human civilization in this world continued, one day someone would step onto the path of cultivation again with the help of the Cultivation Methods they left behind.
And just as this strong man had predicted, ten thousand years later, the world experienced Heaven-Earth Mutated transformations, and the Human Race stepped onto the path of Body Refinement once again with the aid of a mutated virus.
It’s just that Jack, who arrived with a single strike, was a bit too strong, bursting the door outright.
After waiting roughly ten minutes, the Will Projection of the seal finally began to dissipate slowly, and a Heritage Jade Card and a palm-sized silver Token began to descend from the sky.
Especially that silver Token, wrapped with strands of Mysterious Aura, made the traces of the Power of Time eroding Jack’s body fluctuate somewhat.
A smile appeared on Jack’s face as he grabbed the silver Token and the Heritage Jade Card.
Storing the Heritage Jade Card that contained the Inheritance of Boris, General of War, Jack focused on the Token named the Emperor’s Command Token, which should be the key to resolving the Power of Time.
Ancient Civilization Powerhouses were divided into War Generals, Monarchs, and Civilization Emperors, with known War Generals all being Mythical-level Powerhouses, and Monarchs including those at the Heavenly King Level and Supreme Level.
As for the Civilization Emperor, they surpassed the Supreme beings, comparable to Ancient True Spirits, and everything they left behind was a treasure.
Only now the silver Token’s light was dim, and though it was wrapped in Mysterious Aura, it felt no different from an ordinary token in Jack’s hand.
Boom!
Jack’s Divine Soul Intent settled on the Token, and immediately, a terrifying repelling force Burst forth from within the Token, a flash of silver light shaking his consciousness and turning his face pale.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1233 - 1233 482 The Time Reincarnation Mark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1233: Chapter 482 The Time Reincarnation Mark, Suppressing the Twin Dragons_2 Chapter 1233: Chapter 482 The Time Reincarnation Mark, Suppressing the Twin Dragons_2 Huff! Jack Clark slowly exhaled, his expression somewhat solemn.
The Token bestowed by the monarch to Tim Abott was something that no one other than he himself was qualified to use, and with Jack’s strength, even at his peak, he would not be able to forcefully refine it.
“No, there’s another way.” Suddenly, Jack’s eyes flickered, becoming pitch black and hollow as terrifying Soul Power emanated from his body.
The dreadful Soul Power interfered with reality, warping space, and gradually an image emerged of a figure wearing the twenty-four All-Heaven Emperor Crown, clad in a black Imperial Robe.
At the same time, a black Emperor Seal condensed in Jack’s left hand. Within the Emperor Seal, a miniature white galaxy slowly revolved, emitting a Terrifying Aura that seemed to suppress all the heavens.
This was an Emperor Inheritance from the Void Relics that Jack had received, a complete Primordial Blank Rule left by a monarch named “Henry”.
As long as Jack could cultivate to the pinnacle of the Heavenly King, he could use this Rule Seed to step into the Supreme realm in one fell swoop and have the opportunity to become a monarch.
Because his Rule was complete.
Hum!
The moment the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal appeared, stimulated by the Rule Seed within the Emperor Seal, the Emperor’s Command Token radiated a dazzling Silver Brilliance that seemed to dye the ‘world’ silver.
Under the glow of the Emperor’s Order, surrounding time stood still, and the flow of time solidified.
With the power of another monarch invoked, the Primordial Rule within the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal also trembled slightly, releasing a dazzling White Light that penetrated everything.
As the two forces spread, the entire fragmented small world turned silver and white.
There, everything came to a standstill, independent from the Outer World, even the Law of Decline that was gradually suppressing the small world was blocked out.
In this silver-white world, Jack, with an Imperial Crown atop his head and clad in a black Imperial Robe, stood like a Dark Emperor, his gaze profound, silently comprehending the information from the Emperor’s Command Token.
Not only was Tim Abott a War General under the Wheel-Light Emperor, but he was also half a disciple of the monarch, possessing a special Divine Power talent, hence he was bestowed with the Emperor’s Command Token.
This Token was not only able to command all the legions under the Wheel-Light Emperor but also a Divine Power Inheritance known as the “Time Reincarnation Mark”.
“Roar! Tim Abott, Tim Abott…”
Just as Jack’s consciousness was delving into the special Divine Power Inheritance, in the ancient clam world, the Silver Giant Dragon, radiating a bloodthirsty Killing Intent, stood in front of the Destruction Ground, continously growling lowly.
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, having eaten all of its ‘food,’ had grown to a length of over two thousand two hundred and thirty meters with a standing height of over eight hundred meters, appearing even more imposing and fierce.
The Silver Giant Dragon, about seven hundred meters in length and around three hundred meters tall at the shoulder, stood in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon like a small child, just about the height of its knee.
With each roar of the Silver Giant Dragon, the golden vertical pupils of the Destruction Emperor Dragon stirred, then it slowly lowered its head and growled slowly, “You, have, returned, Great, Sethia.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly, “Roar! This time, under the leadership of the Great Sethia, the Imperial Giant Beast Army slaughtered to the point where blood flowed like rivers, wiping out the remaining Black Abyss Alien Race completely.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly scanned the equally excited golden-blue Giant Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, and other Giant Beasts that followed, then hesitated before slowly nodding.
“Not, bad, Sethia, impressive.”
“Roar! Of course, the Great Sethia has always been impressive, it’s just that it usually lets Tim Abott off easy.” With the praise from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon’s tail instantly raised in pride.
Watching this scene unfold, the Titan Longa King, standing in the distance on Earth, looked somewhat amused, as if watching an adult cajole a child.
The clean-up of the Black Abyss Tribe’s nest this time had presented no difficulty whatsoever.
With the main force eliminated, the magma cracks under tens of kilometers of deep sea were left with only a hundred thousand or so ordinary Armored Lizard People and over a thousand ordinary Black flame whale beasts.
To deal with these Transcendent Lives, they didn’t need it to act, as the Silver Giant Dragon and the other Giant Beasts excitedly rushed forward and killed them all, without any mishaps occurring.
At this moment, the elegant golden-blue moved up a few steps and growled with a slight uplift of its dragon mouth, “Thunderflame, this time, the Great Telsafi has found a lot of Life Crystals and has brought them back for you.”
Without waiting for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to speak, the Silver Giant Dragon instinctively roared, “Roar! Telsafi, where did you find the Life Crystals, why didn’t the Great Sethia see them?”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon shook its head, “Sethia, you’re so dumb, of course you wouldn’t notice. While you were chasing those different races, the Great Telsafi had already delved deep into their nest.”
“And then, deep within the magma, in a massive cave, they discovered a hollow filled with Life Crystals and the eggs of armored lizard people, which appeared to be a hatching chamber.”
It seemed that the word ‘fool’ had touched a sore spot, for the Silver Giant Dragon instantly reared up, its dragon wings flaring in rage as it roared, “Roar! Cursed Telsafi, you called the Great Scythia a fool again.”
“The Great Scythia will duel with you, and today I must defeat you and shame you by standing fiercely on your back.”
At once, the golden-blue giant dragon too spread its wings, emitting a dazzling seven-colored glow as it roared: “Roar! Let’s duel, and we shall see who is stronger, you or the great Telsafi.”
The sudden change dumbfounded the following creature, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon among other giant beasts that were about to boast of their own exploits.
Wait, why are you two sisters suddenly fighting? Just moments ago, you were still on good terms, jointly unleashing your breath to utterly destroy the seabed cracks.
Just as the silver and golden-blue giant dragons were about to come to blows, two enormous black-red dragon claws descended from the sky.
Boom! Under the terrifying force, the surrounding silver giant dragon, engulfed in a black storm, and the golden-blue giant dragon, crystallized with crystal, both sank heavily.
Underneath the double claws of the two giant dragons, the rock shattered, and their huge bodies were directly smashed into the earth by the clasp of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, leaving only two dragon heads and folded wings visible on the surface.
This scene made the Kamaitachis, Candle Dragons, and other gigantic beasts twitch at the corner of their eyes, instinctively taking two steps back.
It was too brutal—mythical-level giant dragons appeared like two little chicks in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this moment, smacked into stupefaction with a single slap.
“Roar! Tim Abott, what are you doing hitting the Great Scythia? Let go of the Great Scythia right now, I must teach Telsafi a harsh lesson today.”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon reached for them, the jolted silver giant dragon immediately let out a roar, struggling constantly, and as its tremendous strength burst forth, the entire island shook.
The earth cracked open, with fissures tens of kilometers long spreading in all directions.
But no matter how forcefully the silver giant dragon released its power, it couldn’t budge the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claw by a fraction.
Conversely, the suppressed golden-blue giant dragon, knowing that they won’t be able to fight today, couldn’t be bothered to move, quietly watching the opposite silver giant dragon struggle.
Indeed, that guy was as foolish as ever. Thunderflame had already made a move to stop it; they definitely couldn’t fight today.
Amidst the violent smoke and dust, the recovered Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a deep, rumbling growl: “All right, Scythia, quit it. We have serious matters to attend to.”
Upon hearing that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had business to attend to, the silver giant dragon immediately halted, raising its dragon head, and looked at the black-red colossal beast with some confusion: “Roar! There’s something else?”
“Didn’t I say that once you all returned, we would carry this world back? Let’s go.”
With that, the Destruction Emperor Dragon released its grip on the two giant dragons’ double claws, its massive body stomping through the Void, with its black-red scythe-like tail that stretched over a thousand meters languidly swinging behind it.

﻿Chapter 1234: Chapter 484: The Path of Antiquity, Condensing the Body of Space-Time Chapter 1234: Chapter 484: The Path of Antiquity, Condensing the Body of Space-Time In the sky above, the black-red Colossal Beast, wrapped by the chains of law, carried the Boundary on its journey. Wherever it passed, the earth trembled, space quaked, and ordinary danger zones were directly destroyed.
Take, for example, the sea surface covering thousands of kilometers, dotted with sharp reef rocks overgrown with a kind of black-iron mushroom-shaped plant.
Potent currents leapt and danced upon these black-iron mushrooms, drawing down thunderous, dark clouds and unceasing bolts of lightning to form a high-voltage Thunder Pool.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, carrying the world, hadn’t even approached when the invisible, pervasive spatial shock shattered the reef rocks hundreds of kilometers away, flinging sea water into the air, creating a stunning sight.
Around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, silver and gold-blue Giant Dragons circled and roared excitedly, emitting resounding Dragon Roars.
This scene was like a musclebound man on stage lifting weights to show off his muscles, with two fanatical little fangirls underneath jumping and shrieking in excitement.
Compared to the two Giant Dragons, the other Giant Beasts acted with a bit more restraint.
For instance, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, the Kamaitachi Beast, and the newly joined Longa King, the Mythical Longa Kerla, and the Dragon Horse Beast, just followed excitedly with gleaming eyes.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had another little fan who was even more thrilled.
“Roar, roar, roar!! Too strong, Abbott is too freakish now.”
In the midst of a tsunami a kilometer high whipped up by a raging wind, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon shook with excitement, its tail almost uncontrollably twisting into a figure-eight.
Not only that, its nine ferocious dragon heads tugged crazily – three twined together, two tearing to the left and right, another two slamming into each other, and the remaining two foaming at the mouth.
Flying low beside the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Single-horned Spawn Roc said speechlessly, “Whimper! Abbott, did you beat up Kidora after I left? Why does it seem to get more freakish by the day?”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle shook its head and growled softly, “Normal, it’s always been this freakish, just more so now.”
Whimper! This guy is indeed dumber than us. The Single-horned Spawn Roc murmured with a dignified fierceness in its round eyes, exuding a sense of smugness that seemed somewhat comical.
The sight of the two Giant Beasts whispering to each other was like two onlookers by the roadside gossiping about the latest scandal.
Boom!
The sea water exploded, and a thick whale tail soared up from the sea, striking the belly of the Single-horned Spawn Roc with tremendous force, instantly causing an air explosion with a thunderous blast.
At this moment, the Single-horned Spawn Roc had already surpassed the Mythical level with a body length of over five hundred meters and an even more rugged body, so the two hundred meter Female Tiger Whale simply couldn’t shake it.
Although more powerful than his wife, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, after taking a hit, didn’t dare to retaliate and looked at the Female Tiger Whale with a somewhat aggrieved expression.
“Whimper! Wife, why did you hit me?”
The Female Tiger Whale surfaced, her gaze calm, crying softly, “How many times have I told you? You and Kidora are brothers who have been through life and death, and you shouldn’t mock or talk about him behind his back.”
The Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle immediately showed sheepish expressions.
Trailing behind, the Blue Giant Crab bubbled along, its big eyes rolling, “Gurgle gurgle!! The White Black King is so useless, such a big guy and still under his wife’s thumb.”
It boasted of its own prowess — during this time in the Chaos Sea, it bullied dozens of crab-like Unique Beast Giant Beasts, capturing them all to be its wives, with not one daring to resist.
In time, General Crab would sire many offspring and pass down its most powerful sculpting techniques.
This time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shouldering the world, traversed tens of thousands of kilometers, taking “two days” without encountering any dangers.
Under the unconstrained outpouring of its terrifying aura, before even arriving, countless Giant Beasts and Unique Beasts thousands of kilometers away had already fled in panic.
Waterfalls descended from the heavens, splashing down upon the Rift World sea surface. As the Destruction Emperor Dragon approached with the Ancient clam world, the entire world began to shake.
Boom!
As the power of the Destruction Emperor Dragon erupted, the two worlds collided with a bang, and in an instant, the Void exploded, the space within thousands of kilometers quaking.
A wave of black impact burst from the center of the collision between the two worlds.
Both the Rift World and the Ancient clam world were complete, independent small worlds, like bubbles within the interlayer of space in the Mythical World.
Upon collision, the phantoms of the two worlds emerged clearly between heaven and earth, the Earth crumbled, and the seas roared as if Doomsday had arrived.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, experienced in merging worlds, roared. In an instant, it emitted blinding red light that gleamed, and a myriad of red lightning Burst forth.
Boom, boom, boom!!
A power more terrifying than the collision of the two small worlds erupted, shaking the very sky under its dreadful aura, causing chaos among the rules and exploding the sea water.
Before the awe-struck eyes of the Longa King, the Mythical Longa, and the Dragon Horse Beast, a six-thousand-meter-long, power comparable to an Ancient Titan Destruction Beast made its appearance.
Around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, wrapped in dark crimson lightning, space cracked like fragile paper under the red light, annihilating, emitting an aura of despair and terror that made all life cower.
Merely sensing the invisible, destructive aura instinctively filled them with fear and reverence.
Especially the Longa King, who was immensely shaken.
He was already formidable enough at the Early Titan Growth Level to tear apart and kill a Titan Flame Whale in a few moves; he did not expect such a horrifying Destruction Form to exist.
While the Longa and several Giant Beasts were still stunned, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an even more excited roar, “Roar! Tim Abbott, the Great Scythia loved this form of yours most.”

﻿Chapter 1235: Chapter 484: The Path of Antiquity, Condensing the Body of Space-Time_2 Chapter 1235: Chapter 484: The Path of Antiquity, Condensing the Body of Space-Time_2 “`
“So mighty, so impressive.”
Feeling the destructive aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it stepped into Ancient Titan Level, the golden-blue giant dragon felt its tail go weak, its golden-blue dragon eyes blazing with excitement.
Under the watchful eyes of all the giant beasts, the Deep Red Giant Beast tore through layers of space, charging into the deep recesses of the space interlayer, appearing between two worlds wrapped in transparent boundary crystal walls.
In the double claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, streaks of deep red lightning converged, compressed, forming two dazzling red light spheres, whose emitted destructiveness caused the surrounding Void to crumble.
It was the ultimate destructive force.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, pressing the destructive lightning spheres onto the boundary walls of the two worlds, and in an instant, dazzling red light shone in the depths of the Void.
Boom!!
Endless deep red annihilation lightning exploded, shattering the boundary walls of both worlds under the terrifying force of destruction, blasting open two giant cracks.
In the eyes of over 700,000 members of the Longa Tribe in the Ancient Clam World, a crack a thousand kilometers long appeared in the firmament above, and on the opposite side stood a colossal Red Beast, a hundred million meters tall, radiating the terrifying might of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
Under the twisted power of the world, the projection of the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed immensely huge when it appeared in the eyes of the beings in the small world.
Or perhaps that was the true essence of the Giant Beast Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it’s just that in the much more solid and powerful mythical world, its body was suppressed.
Yiyaya!! In the Rift World, Purple Little Dragon watched excitedly as the immense Red Beast from beyond the sky, spinning in the air as a purple radiance with joy.
Just as the crystal wall was destroyed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Rift World trembled, and crystal red roots shot out from the edge of the world, following the cracks in the crystal wall into the Ancient Clam World.
The trunk of the Red Striped Divine Tree penetrated into the Ancient Clam World, into the ocean, the earth, spreading continuously until it reached the ‘core’ of the world, whereupon both worlds shook.
Under the influence of the Red Striped Divine Tree, which carried the traits of the World Tree, the Origins of the two worlds fused, slowly approaching, merging.
Boom!
As more of the World Origin was absorbed, the Red Striped Divine Tree shone with an even more dazzling red halo, its trunk swelled, and its branches stretched out.
Moreover, bolstered by the robust power of the world, the dozen or so Divine Fruits on the tree shone with more powerful energy fluctuations, their rule patterns becoming perfected.
This fusion of the worlds took almost half a day to complete.
When the violent Spatial Fluctuations finally settled and the Heavenly Energy calmed down, the diameter of the Rift World had dramatically expanded to 4,000 kilometers, and its height to over 3,000 kilometers.
Most of the world’s surface was covered by the ocean, with a 1,000-kilometer wide continent to the east. At the center of the mountain ranges where the continent met the ocean, stood an 8,000-plus meter tall Red Striped Divine Tree.
Hundreds of thousands of Longa Alien Tribe gathered in the ocean at the base of the mountain ranges, interspersed with hundreds of beautiful mermaids, and in addition, more than a thousand Giant Beasts above Level 7 sinking and floating.
At this moment, all the different races and Giant Beasts were emotionally overwhelmed, looking towards the mountain ranges with aspiring eyes.
There, beneath the Divine Tree, numerous colossal beasts stood tall, all turning to look at the black-red Colossal Beast in the forefront, or rather, the ten-meter-long Purple Little Dragon on the Giant Beast’s head.
Yiyaya!! Smelly brother, you all went to fight and didn’t bring May, the Great May is very angry, very angry.
On the nose of the enormous and fierce Dragon Head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple Little Dragon Man stood with its double claws on its hips, constantly yiyaya-ing out loud, adorably fierce.
This scene left the mythical Longa and Dragon Horse Beasts staring dumbfounded, this tiny creature, smaller than a palm, was so audacious, actually daring to scold the great Thunderflame Dragon King.
That was a mighty being capable of forcibly pushing two worlds to fuse.
On the side, Silver Giant Dragon roared, “Roar! Misss Joseline, who let you play below the lake, take a nap instead, and besides, it’s very normal for us to overlook you because you’re too little; you can’t blame us.”
“Roar! But rest assured, seeing as we are good friends, I’ll definitely call you next time we go out and blood flows like rivers.”
Purple Little Dragon blinked its eyes: Yiyaya!! Sesi, you’re nice, next time you’re out of strength, Great May will spit out more saliva to help you.
Suddenly the Silver Giant Dragon glared, “Roar!… What, that purple energy that can restore our strength is your saliva, May?”
Yiyaya!! Yep. Purple Little Dragon nodded proudly.
“Roar! That’s despicable, May, you actually spat saliva to the Great Scythia.” The Silver Giant Dragon’s face showed a humanized disgust.
“But keep it in mind, next time the Great Scythia is injured, remember to spit out more.”
Suddenly the golden-blue giant dragon showed a look of disdain, the stupid one who was just now disgusted by someone’s saliva, now in a blink of an eye… wait, it seemed like Sesi got a bit smarter.
If that fellow truly disliked something before, it would’ve roared it out loud.
Seeing Purple Little Dragon got its attention diverted by the Silver Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon flashed a hint of amusement in its eyes, then turned to look at the other Giant Beasts around it and slowly growled.
“With the fusion of these two worlds this time, the Red Striped Divine Tree has grown thirteen Top-grade Divine Fruits that have matured. Let’s divide these fruits among ourselves.”
A single Top-grade Divine Fruit was no longer much use to the Destruction Emperor Dragon unless it consumed a dozen or more at once for a few meters of growth, but that wasn’t necessary.
Compared to itself, which had reached Titan Level, the Top-grade Divine Fruit had a better effect on the Silver Giant Dragon and others like the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, who had just broken through to the Legendary Realm.
Moreover, they had yet to digest half of the energy from the Divine Beads they consumed earlier; once they digest this new bounty, they are bound to leap across a sub-level at least.
“`

﻿Chapter 1236: Chapter 484: The Path of the Ancients, Condensing the Body of Space-Time_3 Chapter 1236: Chapter 484: The Path of the Ancients, Condensing the Body of Space-Time_3 Especially the Blue Giant Crab that had just advanced to Mid Level 9 was particularly excited, as consuming just one more Top-tier Divine Fruit would allow it to digest it and directly advance to the Late Stage 9.
This rate of growth was like riding on a rocket; that was the advantage of following the right boss, feasting on delicious food every day. The Blue Giant Crab thought joyously.
Under the leadership of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the thirteen Top-grade Divine Fruits were distributed among subordinates like the Silver Giant Dragon, the Golden Blue Giant Dragon, and other Giant Beasts, including the Black Tiger Whale.
Given there was a sufficient quantity, even the newly joined Dragon Horse Beast and the Mythical Longa received one each.
The Titan Longa, however, did not receive one. After reaching Titan Level, it would need resources at the Law Level to significantly increase its strength, so giving it Top-grade Divine Fruits would be a waste.
Next, the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued to growl, “Now I am going to delve deep into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, and it’s going to be a long trip this time. I plan to only take Joe, Scythia, and Telsafi with me.”
“After we leave, Horned Lady, you are responsible for commanding all Mythical Giant Beasts except for Jerry Jones and Kidora, and continue to collect Life Crystals.”
“Crab General, your task is to guard the gate to the Rift World.”
“Yes, king.” surrounded by a black domain, the Female Tiger Whale flying in the air bowed respectfully, and the Blue Giant Crab also bubbled excitedly.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon looked toward the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, as large as a small hill, “Domination, Kidora, the two of you need to work harder to absorb the energy within your bodies and break through to Level 9 Peak sooner rather than later.”
As one of the first Giant Beasts to follow him, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had hoped to help them while he himself rapidly grew stronger.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded vigorously: Roar Roar!! I will definitely work hard.
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon made chaotic roars with its nine heads, each pair of dragon eyes firm: Roar Roar Roar!! Don’t worry, Abbott, this time we won’t sleep and will work hard fiercely.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction and turned to the enormous Golden Longa King, “Alicia, you are responsible for commanding all Mythical Giant Beasts and defend our territory.”
“Besides that, have Kerla and the rest lead the Longa Legion to excavate all resources within our territory and feed them to the ancient clam.”
From the Rift World to the original world of the ancient clam, across the territory of the Black Abyss Clan, the straight-line distance exceeds one hundred thousand kilometers.
Currently, within this range, the Golden Rocs and the Titan Flame Whales have all been killed and consumed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and the Titan Longa have been subdued, making the territory vast and extensive.
Such a colossal territory naturally nurtures countless resources, Heaven and Earth Treasures, special minerals, etc.
Most of these resources are not suitable for cultivation; they cannot be directly consumed, but they can be used to feed the ancient clam, thereby accelerating the condensation of Divine Beads. It’s like a continuous production line.
Facing the assignments of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Titan Longa King bowed respectfully: “Yes, king.”
Yiyaya!! Kill them, May, the Great, is going to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Atop the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, where the black dragon’s mane danced, the little Purple Dragon roared excitedly.
“Roar! The invincible Great Scythia, charge ahead.”
“And the great Telsafi too.”
Behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which resembled a small mountain range, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon roared with excitement, followed at last by the Single-horned Spawn Roc with its wings unfurled.
Under the gaze of tens of thousands from different races and numerous Giant Beasts, the four large and one small, five Giant Beasts rushed out of the Rift World, swiftly disappearing over the turbulent sea surface.
With this deep venture into the Chaotic Domain, the Destruction Emperor Dragon aimed to grow to the Ancient Titan level, devour all Heaven and Earth Treasures, and consume all Mythical and Titan Giant Beasts.
As for bringing along the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it was because of its treasure hunting talent; the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon were there to digest those resources below the Law Level.
Such things were not very effective for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and throwing them away would be somewhat wasteful.
As possessors of dual Top Tier Talents and a bloodline at the Monarch peak, the two Giant Dragons had the potential for growth and an acceptable rate of resource digestion, and they could still accompany him for a while longer on his journey.
…
In a world frozen in silver-white space-time, Jack Clark with the twenty-four All-Heaven Emperor Crown on his head, slowly opened his eyes.
After absorbing the inheritance of the Monarch’s Divine Power, nine ring-shaped silver halos appeared in Jack’s eyes, like a cycle, emitting a Mysterious Aura.
The Time Reincarnation Mystic Power’s core involves using the Power of Time to extract a cultivator’s Time Mark from a past moment, condense it into a Mark, and form a past True Body.
This past True Body possesses the cultivator’s strength at its prime and can condense up to Nine Time Marks, forming a cycle.
In such a state, the combat power would soar to an extremely terrifying extent.
The strongest move is the reincarnation, where nine seals combine into one, instantly merging past selves to step into an even more terrifying realm and delivering a strike that can Destroy Heaven and Earth.
However, such a powerful mystic power is naturally more difficult to cultivate and requires a person with a Time Talent, otherwise, it would be impossible to touch time and hence impossible to draw the Power of Time.
Furthermore, the stronger the strength, the more the Power of Time needed to condense a Time Mark.
And these past bodies are not Avatars, but Marks; they cannot be sent out to become another ‘Person’; otherwise, the Wheel-Light Emperor alone would amount to nine Ancient Emperors.
But even so, this mystic power left Jack amazed with its strength.
“It’s a pity this is a mystic power, and only those with a mystic power seed can inherit it, otherwise, if the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body could also cultivate it…”
Thinking of the Destruction Emperor Dragon entering the Deep Red Destruction Form, while simultaneously Summoning nine Giant Beasts, also in the Crimson Destruction Form from the past, converging into one entity, Jack felt somewhat excited.
Currently, the Destruction Emperor Dragon indeed cannot use it, but what if one day the human and beast bodies underwent Deification Unity, becoming one complete entity?

chapters.title: Chapter 1237 - 1237 484 The Path of the Ancients Condensing
chapters.content:
Chapter 1237: Chapter 484: The Path of the Ancients, Condensing the Body of Space-Time_4 Chapter 1237: Chapter 484: The Path of the Ancients, Condensing the Body of Space-Time_4 One can only imagine how powerful he’d become by then.
Hu!
Jack Clark suppressed the excitement in his heart, closed his eyes, and prepared for cultivation. Having obtained the inheritance, he still needed to gather Time Marks to unleash the power of this Divine Skill.
Jack Clark’s voice resonated in his mind, “Burn ten thousand attribute points, enter into an epiphany state.”
The epiphany state would not only help Jack understand the Heavenly Earth Law faster, but it was also a super accelerator for cultivation.
In the epiphany state, his mind and Heaven and Earth meld as one, increasing his cultivation speed by tens to hundreds of times the norm. This was the reason behind Jane Aiken’s astonishingly fast cultivation pace.
Hum! In the epiphany state, half of Jack’s body showed transparent traces of being eroded by time.
These intangible and usually imperceptible forces of time were gradually drawn out under the guidance of divine power, slowly forming a transparent stream behind Jack.
A silhouette wearing an Imperial Crown and donning a black Imperial Robe emerged from nothingness upon the Time Stream, condensing into existence, strikingly resembling Jack from a quarter of an hour prior.
As time passed, the transparent traces on Jack’s body became fewer, and concurrently, the silhouette behind him grew clearer.
Finally, when the second Jack was almost fully condensed, a burst of space-time rejection exploded.
Boom! Under the Time Rule, having two ‘persons’ exist simultaneously in the same period was forbidden and violated the taboo zone of the Time Rule.
But just as the force of space-time rejection erupted, silver patterns appeared on either side of Jack’s brow, unfolding like wings, or resembling indescribable Great Path Characters.
Under the mark of Divine Power, the rejecting force of space-time instantly vanished.
Correspondingly, the silhouette behind Jack and the Time Stream also dispersed, turning into silver radiance that tinted a strand of his forehead hair, transforming it to silver.
Jack slowly opened his eyes and murmured softly, “So this is the Time Mark? What a strange feeling.”
[There are two thousand more words being edited]
At this moment, Jack became aware of the existence of time.
His past self was constantly washed by the currents of time, which allowed him to continue absorbing time to perfect the mark.
Next, he would be able to draw upon time and create a true Body Refinement technique.
With a thought, Jack summoned the attribute page.

﻿Chapter 1238: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City Chapter 1238: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City “Heaven Mysterious City!”
Clad in black combat suits and holding a slender combat knife, Sara Williams spoke with a somewhat grave expression, “Mr. Clark, before the outbreak of Doomsday, the population of Heaven Mysterious City was nearly ten million.”
“Because of the massive population, it fell on the first day of the virus outbreak, becoming infested with countless monsters. A large number of terrifying creatures emerged almost immediately.”
“Now, several years have passed, and that place might be even more terrifying than Hell. Last year, when the base’s radio was still functioning, we received signals indicating the emergence of a Ninth Tier Overlord-level monster there.”
Sherry’s face also turned somewhat pale: “It’s said that once a monster reaches the Ninth Tier, it becomes an entirely different, horrifying form, powerful like a demon.”
In the past few years, the strongest monster they had seen was a Seventh Tier Tyrant, immensely powerful, capable of destroying skyscrapers with a casual strike, and its defense was indestructible.
Not to mention the monsters of even higher tiers, but…
“It doesn’t matter.”
Jack Clark said indifferently, “You just need to help me navigate, as for mutant monsters and such, I will take care of them.”
The distance in a straight line was more than five thousand kilometers, a slight change in angle could result in a difference of a thousand kilometers, so Jack Clark needed someone who had been to Heaven Mysterious City or who knew the way to lead.
Sara paused, her voice gentle, “That’s true, I almost forgot Mr. Clark’s strength. In front of sir, no monster can stand a single blow.”
“However, getting to Heaven Mysterious City requires passing through two large provinces and more than twenty cities; it’s a long journey. This time, I will accompany Mr. Clark, Sherry, you go back and let everyone know.”
“Okay, sister,” Sherry nodded, understanding Sara’s concern for her safety.
Since the outbreak, other than fleeing with the main forces from the pursuit of those monsters, she had never traveled more than a hundred kilometers away.
There was no choice, the outside world was full of human mutated monsters and Mutated Creatures, especially the already powerful Dinosaur Alien Beasts, which became even stronger after the same virus transformation.
Just then, Jack Clark shook his head: “There’s no need to trouble yourself, it’s only a few thousand kilometers, and the round trip won’t take too long.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark’s wrist subspace bracelet vibrated slightly, his powerful spiritual will spread out, space expanded, and a black and red warplane with a wingspan of more than fifty meters and nearly seventy meters long appeared.
In this world without Heavenly Energy, even with the Last Dharma Rule Suppression on transcendent power, opening Storage Equipment and accessing subspace requires spiritual will, so it’s unaffected.
Gazing at the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet that appeared out of nowhere, the Williams sisters who had never seen space equipment widened their eyes in disbelief.
“What, what is this!”
“This is my fighter aircraft, come on, let’s use this to fly over.”
With Jack’s strength, he alone could cross over five thousand kilometers in a short while, but with the two sisters with him, it was necessary to take the warplane.
Click!!
The rear end of the airplane opened up, and the somewhat befuddled Williams sisters followed Jack Clark inside, their eyes filled with the shock of encountering an alien.
Buzz!
With the three of them entering, the auto-pilot control system activated and the kinetic energy of the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet converted into a Nuclear Fusion Power Furnace, its powerful energy making the aircraft vibrate.
Whoosh! A raging wind howled and air burst forth as the aircraft began to ascend, then with a boom, it blasted through the air, tearing through the clouds.
Excited, Sherry marveled in front of the cockpit glass, “Is this what flying in an airplane feels like? It makes the whole world seem so small.”
“Sister, we just flew past Mountain Looking City, right? Those houses look so tiny, like matchboxes.”
“Yes, that’s Mountain Looking City.”
As they watched the rapidly retreating Cloud Mist and the Earth’s mountains and rivers below, Sara’s heart beat furiously with excitement, making even the already dramatic mountain peaks seem like surging waves.
It was her first time on an airplane. In this technologically backward world, airplanes were as rare as they had been during the Republic era, accessible only to important figures.
However, after the initial excitement, Sara quickly calmed down and hesitantly said, “Mr. Clark, your plane is flying too high; I can’t make out the cities below.”
“Besides, although I’ve been to Capital City before, it was years ago on a train. I can only confirm the direction by recognizing some memorable cities.”
“That’s simple, Cloud Sky, maintain low altitude at three thousand meters.”
Instantly, the warplane high above tens of thousands of meters plunged suddenly, shattering the cloud mist and quickly descending to the ‘low altitude’ of three thousand meters, bringing everything on the ground clearly into everyone’s view.
Looking at this spectacle, the two sisters exclaimed once again.
Indeed, he was a strong man from the ancient Human Race, his accompanying fighter aircraft so advanced that it didn’t require manual piloting, and any request could be fulfilled with just a word.
So strong.
The expression of the Williams sisters was akin to someone from the Eighties being told that in just over two decades, televisions would be in color, and computers would be reduced to the size of a palm.
Following the shock, Sara turned to glance at Jack Clark, then paused.
As the sunset cast its orange hues, sunlight pierced through the fighter aircraft’s glass, enveloping the three in its light, casting Jack Clark’s almost perfect profile in a soft radiance.
The silver streak in his hair, tainted by the Time Mark, hung slightly over his brow, adding an indescribable sense of age and refinement, and making him appear more charismatic.
A roar! Just then, the clouds on the side exploded, and a brutal growl thundered across the sky.
Beneath the sunset, a beast seventy meters long, covered in black and silver scale armor, looking like a Pterosaur but with four claws and a ferocious head, swooped down.
Roar!
Upon seeing the low-flying Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, the Flying Dragon Giant Beast let out a tyrannical roar and flapped its wings, lunging forward.
