﻿Chapter 1239: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City_2 Chapter 1239: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City_2 Although the Giant Beast had no energy swirling around its body, its double wings were thick and heavy. The leading edge of its wings was lined with air vents that absorbed air and converted it into a type of flame fuel, which it expelled from the rear, containing powerful kinetic energy.
As they watched the enormous beast rapidly approaching, Sara Williams said with gravity, “Mr. Clark, it’s a Level 7 Hegemon Pterosaur, we’ve entered its territory.”
“It’s fine,” Jack Clark said, his gaze indifferent as he watched the beast lunging towards them, making no move to act.
Meanwhile, the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet’s wings split open beneath, revealing two five-meter-long Anti-air Crystal Energy Missiles, their tails erupting with scorching blue and white fire.
The two Surface-to-air Missiles burst out at five times the speed of sound, gaining velocity as they flew, and in the blink of an eye they’d traveled several thousand meters to accurately hit the Hegemon Pterosaur flying on the side.
Boom boom!! A dazzling fireball exploded in the sky, and the violent explosion’s roar created a circular wave of light that swept across several kilometers.
Suddenly, the fiery light dissipated, revealing the beast with battered scale armor and half of its flesh and blood blown open, charging out.
The injured beast’s eyes were blood-red as it saw the fighter aircraft whizzing by. With a contraction of its wings, it shot out dazzling red shockwaves like a fighter jet erupting forward.
“It’s still alive?”
Surprised, Jack Clark watched the Mutant Beast speeding up behind them.
The two missiles, imbued with demon-slaying power, were very strong. Under normal conditions, a Level 7 Giant Beast would be blown to death instantly, but that so-called Level 7 Colossus only suffered heavy injury.
The reason was its even more formidable physique, comparable to an Eighth Level Beast.
In this world, due to the lack of Heavenly Energy, at the same level, the physiques of Alien Beasts were stronger than those of Giant Beasts due to virus-induced Evolution and mutations, which even surprised Jack Clark a bit.
Then it sparked his interest.
It seemed the virus that triggered the mutations across the entire world was somewhat special. Perhaps he could bring back some samples for research.
With the current technology on Blue Star, if they could develop a harmless strength-enhancing genetic potion, it might enable the entire human population of Blue Star to fortify their physique at once.
Then, if they also cultivated the Body Refining Technique he planned to create next, perhaps everyone could achieve Transcendence in a short amount of time.
As Jack Clark pondered, the side of the Cloud Sky opened up, revealing a two-meter-wide cannon barrel that extended out, with a powerful and scorching white Radiance converging.
Boom!
A blaze of white Light Beam pierced the sky, and, in an instant, the head of the Hegemon Pterosaur, whose body was comparable to an Eighth Level Beast, exploded. The massive body, emitting rolling flames, fell to the ground.
Assembled from Mythical Giant Beast Bones and equipped with various weapons, the Throne Fighter, primarily meant for auxiliary functions, could still unleash destructive power on par with quasi-mythical beings.
A mere Level 7 Colossus was no match for Jack Clark’s intervention.
As the Flying Giant Beast was dealt with, a broken city built upon a mountain appeared ahead. Sara Williams promptly said, “Mr. Clark, ahead is Ring Mountain City. We need to veer a bit to the right.”
“No problem,” Jack Clark nodded, and skillfully tilted the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, drawing an arc in the sky as they flew over the city.
Roar roar!!
As the black and red warplane thundered across the sky, the monsters dwelling in the city raised their heads to the heavens, hissing and roaring. Even a dozen of them chased after it, rushing out from the city.
But it wasn’t long before the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet left those Mutant monsters behind, disappearing into the forest.
“What was that flying overhead?”
At three times the speed of sound, the fighter aircraft quickly crossed over two thousand kilometers of a large province under the navigation of Sherry Williams, with a speed that shocked the two sisters once more.
And this was still with the precaution of not flying too fast, in case Sherry Williams could not keep up with the need to identify the coordinates based on the ruin cities they flew over below.
“Look! There’s an airplane in the sky.”
“An airplane, really?”
Atop a mountain thousands of meters high, half-covered by stone houses, thousands of people stood stunned and excited, gazing at the black and red fighter aircraft that sped across the sky.
“This airplane must come from some large Survivor Base; they’ve developed more advanced technology, actually breaking through the blockade of the flying pterosaurs to come here,” said a robust man with a powerful aura, shouting, “Quick, light the fire, send up smoke signals to tell the airplane there are people below.”
But before they could ignite the beacon, the Cloud Sky flashed across the heavens at astonishing speed, zipping past the mountain in an instant, quickly becoming a mere speck.
Even so, those survivors on the mountain were incredibly excited, with hopeful light flickering in their numb eyes.
What they didn’t know was that it wasn’t a product of this world’s technology at all.
On the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, Sherry Williams looked back and hesitated, “Sis, there seemed to be a large Survivor Base back there.”
“I saw it,” Sara Williams nodded, but remained silent without further comment.
What of it, after all?
Even their own base was barely hanging on, and had Jack Clark not intervened to rescue Reg Brown and the others, their heavily reduced fighting force would have been left in despair.
Even with the sisters’ strength, it was difficult to sustain dozens of youths in this perilous world.
Squeak squeak! Just then, the air ahead filled with numerous creatures rising into the sky.
A swarm of over a thousand ordinary Pterosaurs, each with a wingspan of over ten meters and about ten meters in length, flew majestically towards them, attacking the Fighter Jet that had breached their territory.
Ratatatata!!
Beneath the Fighter Jet, two Six-barrel machine guns with a caliber of one hundred millimeters thundered, firing over three thousand ‘bullets’ per minute, creating a death curtain that enveloped everything in front of them.
Bang bang bang!!

﻿Chapter 1240: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City_3 Chapter 1240: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City_3 Under the horrifying firepower, one after another, Level 4 Mutated Winged Dragons exploded, their bodies torn directly by the kinetic energy of the bullets, then turning into pieces in the subsequent explosions of incendiary bombs.
In just the blink of an eye, over a thousand winged dragons were killed, the thick blood mist in the air spreading over a range of more than ten kilometers, emitting a rich scent of blood.
Witnessing such an astonishing rate of slaughter, Sherry Williams couldn’t help but turn pale; it was too terrifying.
Roar!
Shortly after the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet disappeared, a torrential blood-rain fell, and in the mountain forest, a gigantic dinosaur over a hundred meters long raised its head and let out a brutal roar that shook the forest.
In the following half hour, the fighter aircraft slaughtered two more groups of mutated winged dragons and several large flying giant beasts, finally approaching Heaven Mysterious City.
In sight at the extremity of the earth was a sprawling city with skyscrapers standing tall, hinting at the prosperity during the outbreak of Doomsday.
Only now the city had turned into ruins, most buildings collapsed, streets overgrown with weeds, and decayed streetlamps peeking through the vines.
Besides, many streets were blocked by abandoned and deformed vehicles, surrounded by large pits from missile and cannonball explosions, exuding an air of desolation and death.
As the Capital City, Heaven Mysterious City quickly fell when Doomsday erupted, but it seems that the military forcefully attacked it afterward.
After arriving here, the following steps were straightforward; under Jack Clark’s control, the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet stopped high above the city, at an altitude of 10,000 meters.
“Cloud Sky, scan the entire city map, and scan those street signs to find the library’s location.”
Linking mentally, text about the Lost World appeared in Jack Clark’s mind, which he transmitted to the Cloud Sky’s AI system, while the lightwave scanning system of the fighter aircraft was activated.
Soon, the structure map of the entire city appeared on the large screen.
“Scanning complete, building comparison complete, language comparison complete… Library of Congress location is locked.”
“Report, a large number of suspect biological spectral models detected in the shadows of the buildings by the lightwave scan, exceeding 300,000 in number, with a medium degree of danger.”
“Only a little over 300,000 mutated creatures left, huh?” Jack mused.
A city with a population of millions, after several years, only more than 300,000 remained, which was not good news for those survivors.
But it had nothing to do with him.
Having determined the library’s location, the Cloud Sky Fighter descended from the sky, controlled by Jack Clark, and appeared above a square building over forty meters high.
Whoosh whoosh!! The hot air howled as the fighter aircraft slowly stopped on the library’s rooftop, the 70-meter-long jet occupying only a third of the space.
By now, the sky was growing dim, with only a sliver of sunset glow remaining.
“We’ve arrived…” Stepping off the fighter, the Williams sisters looked around the dangerously eerie Ruin City and were somewhat dazed.
In just over an hour, they had traversed half the empire and had made it through countless dangers to the imperial capital.
Unlike the bewildered sisters, Jack felt nothing and glanced at the sky, “It’s getting late; we should go have a look.”
Although Jack could now ignore the dark night and see everything clearly in the pitch-black environment, nighttime was definitely less convenient than daytime.
Creak! The already rusted rooftop’s iron door was casually torn off by Jack, and the trio stepped inside.
As the Library of Congress, the entire building was squarely structured with six floors extending up and down and a transparent glass ceiling in the middle.
Therefore, even without electricity or lights, the entire library was clearly visible in the setting sun.
However, the library was in disarray, with collapsed bookshelves and rotting books everywhere, dried and blackened bloodstains, and some scattered human remains.
Clearly, when Doomsday erupted, many people hid here and were then slaughtered by the mutant monsters that chased them inside.
Finding the ancient cultivation manuscripts among tens of millions of books in the chaotic library was going to be troublesome.
Sara Williams said softly, “Library management has a catalog, and those ancient books are certainly recorded on it. As long as the catalog is intact, we’ll quickly find the cultivation secrets you’re looking for, Mr. Clark.”
“Of course, that’s assuming no one has carried those methods away or that they haven’t rotted or been damaged.”
Jack’s gaze swept over the library, and he slowly said, “In this world, one could cultivate only after Doomsday, condensing Qi Blood and refining the body through the virus-enhanced physique.”
“So by the time someone realized that they could cultivate with those body refining techniques, the remaining people had either fled the city or been eaten by those mutant monsters.”
“However, we’ll need to clean this place up before looking for the books,” Jack said, turning his attention downwards.
Looking into the dark corners on the first floor, several long, slender creatures, 3 meters tall and 10 meters long, with limbs bent backwards like spiders, were lurking and had already noticed the trio.
“You two go find the management directory on each floor, I’ll take care of that trash.”
With that, Jack’s figure flashed and disappeared, and using the Divine Steps in the Sky, he appeared on the first floor as if by instantaneous movement, facing the monster and tightening his grip slightly.
Boom!
Under the overbearing terrifying power, the air in front of him instantaneously exploded and collapsed, along with the Level 6 beast that erupted with powerful Qi Blood.
Roar Roar Roar!!
As the beast turned into a spray of blood in that instant, vicious monsters from all directions hissed and pounced toward Jack, blurring with afterimages.
Greeting these monsters was Jack’s hand pressing down lightly.
“”

﻿Chapter 1241: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City_4 Chapter 1241: Chapter 485: Dark Star Battle Body, One Man Slaughters a City_4 “`
As that slender, fair-skinned palm pressed down, over twenty afterimages appeared from all directions, and with the force of an invisible power, space suddenly congealed and then collapsed.
Bang bang bang! The solid cement floor shook, and over twenty palm-sized, one-meter-deep impressions appeared, with an unrecognizable mass of flesh and blood in the center of each imprint.
Around the palm prints, with clear lines, the severed limbs of those creatures were still twitching, creating a gruesomely bloody scene.
With Jack Clark’s current strength, if he wasn’t concerned about causing destructive damage to the entire building, he could have smashed the area with a single slap, let alone deal with dozens of Level 4 and Level 5 Mutant monsters.
As Jack Clark made his move, the Williams sisters didn’t dare to delay, their figures leaping down, respectively landing on the sixth and fifth floors, and then quickly descending to the third and fourth floors.
This kind of library had a manager on each floor, including their positions, so they were easy to locate.
“Found it, Mr. Clark, it’s here.” In a corner of the second floor, Sherry Williams moved a collapsed bookshelf that had smashed the management desk and excitedly picked up several thick catalogs from beneath it.
Whoosh! Air distorted, and Jack Clark appeared in front of Sherry Williams.
“Let me see.” Jack Clark took a management catalog from Sherry Williams and flipped through it quickly, his sharp gaze scanning over every letter.
“Not in this one.”
Saying that, Jack Clark picked up another one, and soon a smile appeared on his face—he had found the sections that housed the ancient texts, on the Third Floor, A Section, shelves 15 to 48.
“Third Floor, let’s go.”
Between the dozens of half-collapsed bookshelves, Jack Clark threw aside any irrelevant books and said in a deep voice, “Aside from Cultivation Methods dating back to ancient times, we don’t need any data or content from other eras.”
This area not only contained a small portion of Cultivation Methods but also many ancient books from the past 5000 years of the Lost World, everything from poetry to songs.
Moreover, because some of the books were old and the texts were blurry, even Jack Clark had to open them and check to be certain, which was quite time-consuming.
While Jack Clark and the others were searching for information, as the sky darkened, the entire Heaven Mysterious City seemed to awaken, and sinister figures began to emerge.
Roar!
Suddenly an aggressive and terrifying roar burst forth, with the horror of the sound waves shaking heaven and Earth, causing the glass of the entire city to tremble, its might terrifying.
Whimpering! Under that terrifying roar, countless Mutant monsters in the city shivered, looking towards the south with reverence.
There, a monster stood over three hundred meters tall, covered in dark red scales, with a head likened to a demon and a pair of dragon wings on its back, and black chains wrapped around its body.
This creature emitted the terrifying aura of a Level 9 Peak and had reached the quasi-mythical realm with its pure flesh and blood.
At this moment, just standing there, the invisible force emanating from its body caused the air to explode, creating rings of white waves and raging winds that swept over more than a thousand meters in every direction.
In the raging wind, the geomagnetic field was chaotic, the ground vibrated and cracked, numerous rocks lost weight and floated slowly, and its presence was terrifying, like a god or demon.
This was the terror of physical strength brought to its limit, and even though this world’s Last Dharma Rule suppressed the transcendent, it still allowed for the thick and frightening Qi Blood to cause anomalies.
At this moment, the creature was looking towards the library some tens of kilometers away, eyeing the futuristic Cloud Sky Fighter Jet with a cold and savage gaze.
Roar! The Dragon-winged monster roared again with tyrannical ferocity.
Roar roar roar! In an instant, the whole city erupted in turmoil, with countless Mutant monsters raising their howls to the sky, then thundering into motion, rushing towards the library from all directions.
Boom! The building collapsed as a sixty-meter-tall Tyrant roared past, shaking the ground with every step and raising clouds of dust and debris.
Beyond that, among the skyscrapers in all directions, sinister silhouettes of ten to several tens of meters appeared, each leap spanning hundreds of meters.
This scene was like zombies breaking out in a movie.
Only these weren’t zombies, but powerful Mutant monsters, where even the weakest possessed the strength of the Third Layer Heaven, with explosive speeds of over a hundred meters per second and formidable power and Defense that ignored bullets and guns.
Not to mention the Tyrant monsters that were over fifty or sixty meters tall, covered in thick scale armor, and that ignored heavy ordnance and missile bombardments.
“`
The tyrants of this world were true tyrants, each capable of slaughtering through tens of millions of zombies, leaving ordinary people to face such monsters with nothing but despair and awaiting death.
Such commotion obviously didn’t escape the notice of Jack Clark and his two companions.
Feeling the ground shaking more and more violently, and sensing the approach of Seventh Tier, Eighth Tier, and even the terrifying aura of ferocity, Sara Williams grew somewhat nervous.
“Mr. Clark…”
Jack Clark spoke indifferently, “They are courting death. Continue with your tasks; I’ll go handle this.”
As he spoke, Jack flipped his hand, producing a fist-sized White Crystal Stone; its invisible radiance dispelled the darkness and illuminated half the library.
Bathed in the light, the tension in the Williams sisters eased slightly.
Leaving behind a Holy Light Stone for illumination, Jack’s figure flickered and he appeared on the library’s rooftop, his gaze cold as he looked towards the Dragon-winged monster more than ten kilometers away.
These monsters dared to interrupt his work. They were seeking death.
In just the short time before, Jack had already found over ten ancient Cultivation Methods, including three Body Refining Techniques. One of these, capable of refining to only the Eighth Tier, had caught his eye.
This Body Refining Technique was called Dark Star Battle Body. It gathered Qi Blood, absorbed the energy of Heaven and Earth, and the heavy elements of metallic substances in the surroundings to temper the flesh, unyieldingly Overbearing.
If one could cultivate this battle body to the highest boundary of the eighth layer, one would gain an invincible Tyrant Body—a body so impenetrable, so exceptionally heavy, that just its invisible gravitational pull could tear apart everything around it, and a single punch could burst through anything.
However, entry requirements for this technique were steep, necessitating Innate Awakening of the flesh and a Metal Compatibility Talent. Moreover, this world lacked Heavenly Energy, so no one could cultivate it.
Not to mention that absorbing heavy metallic substances into the body was tantamount to suicide.
Even for Jack, the power of the technique itself was mediocre, but he was intrigued by its characteristic of absorbing and merging with heavy metals and elements.
His own body was already incredibly robust, akin to an Early Titan Beast compressed to the utmost limit. Should he absorb and fuse with countless heavy metals and heavy matter…
With the strength of Jack’s body, he could devour and merge with several metallic mountain ranges, and then he would truly become a human-shaped Black Hole.
Whoosh!
At the thought, even Jack couldn’t help but feel a bit excited. Then, with a flash of light in his hand, a four-meter-long Black Gold battle halberd materialized.
Without wasting words, eager to return and test the Cultivation Method, Jack let out a long howl, and as if a condensed burst from the sky, he descended thunderously.
Boom!
In an instant, the earth shattered. Originating from the library, a hundred-meter-wide black storm erupted, causing collapses and pulverizing floors while monsters burst into mists of blood and dissipated on the spot.
Before Jack, while moving at a hundred times the speed of sound and wielding the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd at over a hundred times the speed of sound, everything was annihilated.
[There’s still a point undergoing modifications…]
With the strength of Jack’s body, he could devour and merge with several metallic mountain ranges, and then he would truly become a human-shaped Black Hole.
Whoosh!
At the thought, even Jack couldn’t help but feel a bit excited. Then, with a flash of light in his hand, a four-meter-long Black Gold battle halberd materialized.
Without wasting words, eager to return and test the Cultivation Method, Jack let out a long howl and, in a thunderous descent from the sky, charged down.
Boom!
In an instant, the earth shattered. Originating from the library, a hundred-meter-wide black storm erupted, causing collapses and pulverizing floors while monsters burst into mists of blood and dissipated on the spot.
Before Jack, while moving at a hundred times the speed of sound and wielding the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd at over a hundred times the speed of sound, everything was annihilated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1242 - 1242 486 Cell Planet Limit Enhancement
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1242: Chapter 486 Cell Planet, Limit Enhancement Cultivation Methods (First Update) Chapter 1242: Chapter 486 Cell Planet, Limit Enhancement Cultivation Methods (First Update) The raging wind howled in the night, sweeping up clouds of smoke and dust.
Jack Clark stood atop the void, his black hair fluttering behind him as he looked down indifferently like a deity upon a crack that stretched for tens of kilometers, bottomless and profound.
At the peak of Jack’s strength, a single blow could destroy an area of over a hundred kilometers, shatter the void, and the burst of Destructive Impact would even affect several hundred to a thousand kilometers.
Compared to those countries with smaller territories, this could be considered a strike capable of annihilating an entire nation.
Although this ‘nation’ was somewhat small.
Even now, unable to mobilize the Rule’s power, his physical strength alone could destroy Heaven Mysterious City and eradicate all the Mutant monsters.
But doing so would also destroy the library, which is why he chose a slightly more troublesome method of leveling the city to the ground by circling around it at extreme speed and strength for dozens of laps.
Of course, there was another reason: he liked the feeling of blasting everything away, just as he disliked dissipating air resistance when flying at high speeds, preferring to create sonic booms instead.
This kind of ‘fist to meat’ approach, where monster after monster exploded into Blood mist under the halberd, felt great. It was a pity that it was only a Level 9 Peak Giant Beast, not enough to satisfy his thirst for battle.
In contemplation, Jack put away the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd and returned to the library.
Seeing Jack descend from the sky, the Williams sisters blinked in astonishment and instinctively asked, “Mr. Clark, those Mutant monsters…?”
Jack smiled slightly, “They’ve all been dealt with.”
Incredible. The Williams sisters silently marveled, but only for a moment.
From the moment they met Jack until now, they have become accustomed to being shocked.
Under the bright radiance, the three of them then went through over a hundred thousand ancient books on the bookshelf, and in the end, they collected over a hundred Cultivation Methods.
Most of them were ordinary techniques left behind by high-level cultivators and were incomplete after tens of thousands of years, useful only as a reference for Jack.
Among the Body refining techniques, there were seventeen, and the strongest was a complete technique that one could cultivate to the Ninth Tier, the Great Sun True Body, the complete version of the Red Sun Technique.
Dusting off the volumes, Jack collected dozens of them and, looking at the dust on the Williams sisters’ faces, smiled slightly, “Thank you for the hard work.”
Today’s haul put Jack in a very good mood.
The Emperor Inheritance he obtained during the day had resolved the issue of time corrosion, and he had mastered a powerful Divine Power. This time, he successfully found a vast number of Body refining techniques.
Next, as long as he spent time cultivating each one, constantly adjusting and researching, he should have hope for success.
Sara Williams, with her full figure and resolute eyes that gave off an impression of a strong woman, shook her head gently, her tone soft, “Compared to the help Mr. Clark has given us, this is nothing.”
The delicate and pretty Sherry nodded in agreement, “Yeah, my sister and I haven’t really done much, Mr. Clark, you don’t have to be so polite.”
After exchanging courtesies, the three of them jumped back to the rooftop, and then the sisters were dumbfounded.
Under the dim light of night, the surroundings were empty, just uneven, damaged Earth. Heaven Mysterious City and the countless lurking Mutant monsters had all disappeared.
Only then did the two women snap back to reality, understanding what Jack meant with his words ‘They’ve all been dealt with.’
Indeed, everything had been dealt with, but it was the entire city that had been erased; such terrifying power reinforced their belief that Jack was a strong man from an ancient civilization.
Whew!
Amid the eruption of hot air, a dark red fighter aircraft rose slowly, and then with a bang, it broke the sound barrier, accelerating to three times the speed of sound in a matter of seconds.
Roar! Just as the aircraft flew a few hundred kilometers out, a massive dark shadow surged into the sky from the forest below, emitting a ferocious roar.
Boom!
A dazzling white Energy Beam pierced Heaven and Earth, its light illuminating half the sky, and a single shot from the main cannon blew the head of that Level 8 Pterosaur Giant Beast to pieces.
Roar, roar, roar!! The moment the Pterosaur Giant Beast was killed, the powerful energy disturbance attracted the attention of Mutated Creatures within a hundred-kilometer radius.
But by then, the aircraft had already reached the horizon.
The Mutant monsters were more active at night, so on the way back, Crystal Energy Missiles from the two wings of the aircraft roared, the underbelly machine gun thundered, and the two auxiliary and one main energy cannons constantly unleashed their fury.
After nearly depleting the reserve of ordinary Crystal Energy Missiles, the aircraft finally returned to the research base in the sky. Below, lights turned on, the magnetic levitation system activated, and the wind kicked up as it slowly descended.
The ferocious, sci-fi-styled aircraft immediately made everyone at the base alert.
“Be careful.”
“Everyone, don’t go out.”
Reg Brown and the others guarded the entrance of the mountain wall, their expressions solemn and shocked as they watched the massive aircraft crushing a few small trees while landing.
They were seeing something so ‘high-tech’ for the first time.
Clack!! The hatch at the aircraft’s belly slid open, revealing the silhouettes of the Williams sisters and Jack Clark. Everyone paused at the sight, then their expressions turned excited.
“It’s Captain Williams.”
“And that powerful young man.”
“What young man, that’s Mr. Clark, Jack Clark.”
As they spoke, Reg Brown and others rushed forward, and behind them, a dozen youths cheered and ran out.
“Sister Sara, you’re back, how did you get on that thing?”
“Sister Sherry, what is that, is it an airplane?”
Jack did not disembark, silently watching as the Williams sisters were surrounded by people bombarding them with questions. Once it was mostly over, he spoke, “I’ll be entering into Closed-door Cultivation for a few days, don’t disturb me unless it’s important.”
“Closed-door Cultivation.” The Williams sisters and others paused.
Jack continued, “These are two energy crystals. You can hold them in your hands while cultivating; the energy contained within can help you with your Cultivation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1243 - 1243 486 Cellular Planet Limit Enhancement
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1243: Chapter 486 Cellular Planet, Limit Enhancement Cultivation Methods (First Update)_2 Chapter 1243: Chapter 486 Cellular Planet, Limit Enhancement Cultivation Methods (First Update)_2 Speaking, Jack Clark handed over two fist-sized golden crystal stones to the two of them, and without waiting for them to ask questions, he turned and entered the fighter aircraft.
Watching the hatch snap shut, everyone glanced at each other in bewilderment.
This strong man named Jack Clark seemed to be somewhat aloof.
In the mythical world, the cultivation of ancient body refining techniques required powerful Blood Qi as a basic condition, and under normal conditions, one would also need to absorb Heavenly Energy to make rapid progress.
However, the mutated viruses in this world caused all living beings to evolve, possessing terrifying endurance and robust physiques, which allowed for cultivation through Blood Qi alone.
And these body refiners who could reach the Senior and even high-order levels in a barren environment, each was actually a genius, who would definitely make leaps and bounds in strength if they appeared in the mythical world.
Just like the First Councilor of Blue Star and others.
As the first batch of strong ones awakened by the Heaven-Earth Mutated event, their Innate talents were already terrifyingly strong. Coupled with the inheritance of the Heavenly King’s Legacy from an ancient civilization, they stepped into the realm of the Supreme in a short time.
And those two energy crystals were Jack Clark’s reward, a thank you for their ‘running an errand’.
Arriving at the Cultivation Area of the Cloud Sky, Jack Clark sat down cross-legged and took out the Dark Star Battle Body technique that had piqued his interest, his gaze sweeping over all the content and patterns like a scanner.
After a while, Jack Clark put it down thoughtfully.
Like the Red Sun Body Refining Technique, the Dark Star Battle Body was tailored to the ‘physique’ of the Ancient Human Race. Jack Clark had to first alter his physique to get started.
As for the powerful physical body of the Innate Awakened One and the preliminary cultivation requirement of the Metal Compatibility Talent, those could be outright ignored.
After all, what Innate Awakened One’s physical body could compare to his flesh, and as for the Metal Compatibility Talent, it was there to prevent the initial stages of cultivation from being unable to control the metal, avoiding heavy elements injuring the body.
Crackle Crackle! Under Jack Clark’s control, his flesh and blood writhed, and his meridians and acupoints adjusted, swiftly completing the simulation of the Ancient Human Race’s physique.
Then with a thought, Jack Clark chanted the incantation silently and mobilized a strand of Blood Qi to converge, rushing through a dozen obscure meridians like a force unstoppable.
Boom! In just a few seconds, Jack Clark had stepped into the First Layer of the Dark Star Battle Body, as effortlessly as if he were drinking water.
However, he stopped there, and a basin-sized black stone appeared in his hand, its surface gleaming with metallic luster and mysterious patterns.
This stone came from the storage equipment of a demon king, and Jack Clark didn’t know the exact type of mineral but was aware that it was very heavy and hard.
Just a piece of this size weighed over a hundred tons.
At the same time, Jack Clark’s voice resounded in his mind, “Consume 100 Attribute points, strengthen to the Second Layer of the Dark Star Battle Body.”
After entering the realm of thought, one could directly enhance with Attribute points.
In the instant a hundred Attribute points disappeared, a surge of strengthening energy flowed into the strand of Dark Star Blood Qi, bursting forth violently, circulating at dozens of times the previous speed like mad.
And during its circulation, it split into numerous fine strands of Blood Qi, piercing through some of Jack Clark’s finer meridians, eventually forming a ‘net’ that enveloped the black mineral stone.
Hum! Beneath the Blood Qi net that seemed to cover a ‘planet,’ the hard and heavy mineral stone began to vibrate slightly.
In Jack Clark’s perception, strands of weak Metal Elements were transformed by the Blood Qi net and wrapped with Blood Qi, entered his body through his hands, and circulated together.
In the instant those Heavy Metal Elements entered Jack Clark’s body, an intense stimulation burst forth, causing his meridians to… tremble slightly.
If it were a Low-level cultivator just starting their cultivation, they would instantly be injured by the Heavy Metal Elements entering their body, requiring time to nourish and heal before continuing the cultivation.
After thirty-six cycles, all the meridians of the Second Layer would become more durable and stronger due to the fusion of Heavy Elements. Only then could one attempt to breakthrough to the Third Layer.
Additionally, the cultivation of the Dark Star Battle Body had progressive steps. In the first instance, it absorbed ordinary Metal Elements, and for the Third Layer, it absorbed stronger and more abundant Metal Ores.
As for Jack Clark’s current cultivation, he was essentially ‘cheating.’
Boom!
Under the enhancement of divine-grade material elements, Jack Clark’s Blood Qi circulated over a hundred times within two minutes, directly breaking through to the Third Layer.
Without wasting time, Jack Clark continued as his voice echoed in his mind, “Consume 400 Attribute points, strengthen to the Fourth Layer of the Dark Star Battle Body.”
In an instant, an even more violent, formidable energy within Jack Clark exploded, and the dark red Blood Qi burst forth, forming a dense network of Blood Qi that covered his entire body.
Simultaneously, the black stone that had shrunk slightly in his hand vibrated, enveloped by the tangible dark red blood net, slowly turning gray-white.
More Heavy Metal Elements were absorbed into Jack Clark’s perception, circulated with the Blood Qi covering his entire body, and began to merge with his skin and dermis.
This fusion was peculiar; under the transformation of the cultivation technique’s Blood Qi, those Heavy Elements changed form, existing between matter and energy.
After merging with Jack Clark’s skin and underlying dermis, the nature of his flesh remained unchanged but now had a hint of metal’s hardness and weight.
And as more and more Heavy Metal Elements were absorbed and fused, his skin and dermis became more robust.
Though for someone with Jack Clark’s physique, such a small enhancement in skin durability was negligible and didn’t much improve his strength, the changed properties intrigued him further.
“Consume 600 Attribute points, strengthen to the Fifth Layer.”
“Consume 800 Attribute points, strengthen to the Sixth Layer…”
Boom boom boom! With Jack Clark’s disregard for consumption, the power of the Dark Star Blood Qi on his body kept ‘swelling,’ breaking through effortlessly all the way to the Sixth Layer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1244 - 1244 486 Cell Planet Limit Enhancement
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1244: Chapter 486 Cell Planet, Limit Enhancement Cultivation Method (First Update)_3 Chapter 1244: Chapter 486 Cell Planet, Limit Enhancement Cultivation Method (First Update)_3 The sixth-level body refining technique covered the whole body’s muscles, and as the heavy black metal elements continuously fused and were absorbed, the muscle fibers also gained the heaviness characteristic of metal.
Moreover, under the microscopic view of Jack Clark’s Divine Soul Intent, some muscle cells underwent changes, frantically absorbing and compressing the heavy metal elements, storing them, and gradually radiating a metallic luster.
When every single cell turned into a black gold color, resembling a metallic ‘planet’, a faint gravitational magnetic field began to emanate from within the cell.
The change in a single cell was insignificant, but when the black mineral stone in Jack’s hand completely turned ashen white, millions of muscle fiber cells in his body had already undergone transformation.
“Not enough yet,” Jack suddenly opened his eyes, took out an even larger piece of black mineral stone, and a thought echoed in his mind.
“Consume 2,200 Attribute points, enhance the Dark Star Battle Body to the seventh and eighth layers.”
Boom!
Violent enhancement energy burst forth, and Jack’s whole body was shrouded in dark gold radiance, emitting an overbearing aura heavy as mountains, causing the fighter aircraft below him to sink slightly.
Under the thick and majestic operation of Qi Blood, strands of substantial dark gold light enveloped the black mineral stone, rotating in nine inner and outer layers, containing a certain profound truth.
With the Cultivation Methods in motion, even heavier and sharper heavy metal elements surged into Jack’s body, passing through his muscles and integrating into his bones as his Qi Blood circulated.
As these divine-grade materials and heavy metal elements merged, the originally pure golden bones began to show some black patterns on their surface, somewhat similar to the Talent Runes on the Giant Beast’s skeleton.
Meanwhile, during his cultivation, Jack was also observing the changes and directions of the cultivation technique, corroborating them with his ‘body’.
This time, he practiced for about half an hour, and only when the ore, weighing over two hundred tons, also cracked and turned into ashen white stone on the ground did Jack open his eyes.
Surprise flashed in Jack’s eyes: “My body’s strength has actually improved a bit.”
The fully realized eighth level of the Dark Star Battle Body had improved Jack’s physical strength by a bit, which seemed negligible.
But one must know that his physique was now comparable to an Early Titan Beast, and even a one-thousandth improvement in ‘strength’ was quite formidable.
And this was still just the eighth layer, equivalent to the Eighth Layer Heaven cultivator’s realm—if one could practice up to the ninth, the tenth layer in the Legendary Realm…
Unfortunately, this technique only had eight layers. Jack willed the attribute page to appear in his mind.
Cultivation Methods: Dark Star Battle Body+[Eighth Level]
When Jack’s gaze fell on the plus sign behind the Dark Star Battle Body, a row of transparent text emerged, “Do you want to spend 3,000 Attribute points to Limit Enhance Dark Star Battle Body?”
Limit Enhancement was a special function of the attribute page, allowing the consumption of Attribute points to enhance a Cultivation Method to the ultimate pinnacle.
Jack’s initial cultivation of the low-level martial arts Dragon Elephant Art and the Heart-Eye Blade Technique became even more formidable after Limit Enhancement, even evolving into ‘Talent’ Runes.
Unlike advanced martial arts with a sixth level cap, Ancient Body Refining Techniques have a higher limit, reaching up to eight and even the peak ninth level.
The reason was the big difference between the power systems of the new and old eras.
And cultivating higher-level ancient techniques, in fact, was slightly weaker than the True Martial currently practiced on Blue Star, not as comprehensive as modern cultivators.
Especially after the Seventh Layer Heaven, the top-tier Secret Manuals not only strengthen the True Body unbelievably but also condense the true martial arts phantom to control the Power of Heaven and Earth, with a broader span of combat power.
But for Jack, these ancient techniques also had their advantages: they could be Limit Enhanced.
Thump! Jack took out a several meters tall, platinum-colored ore from his Storage Space; the entire Cloud Sky Fighter Jet shook violently, as if a small hill had been placed on it.
If it weren’t for the fact that the material of the fighter jet was refined from the remains of Mythical Giant Beasts, it would directly collapse and get crushed through.
“Consume 3,000 Attribute points, Limit Enhance Dark Star Battle Body.”
Boom!
An energy of enhancement exploded within Jack, the already maxed-out Dark Star Breath and Blood bursting, turning into a thick dark gold blood mist that spread throughout his body, enveloping both him and the ore.

chapters.title: Chapter 1245 - 1245 487 Falling of the Great Sun Steel
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1245: Chapter 487: Falling of the Great Sun, Steel Attribute Chapter 1245: Chapter 487: Falling of the Great Sun, Steel Attribute Just as the eight-layer peak Dark Star Breath and Blood exploded into a dense mist of blood, enveloping Jack Clark and the platinum ore, the receded Qi Blood within Jack’s body was also stirred.
Boom, boom, boom!
Roaring like the outcry of mountains and seas echoed within Jack’s body, the sound of blood heavy to its extreme flowing, a terrifying burst of Qi Blood erupted.
In an instant, the entire Cloud Sky Fighter Jet shook again, and a fearsome aura permeated through, engulfing the base and the mountain forests for tens of kilometers around.
Under the awe-inspiring aura containing the Emperor Dragon’s might and the dignity of the Innate Gods and Demons, everyone who had just returned to the base showed horror on their faces, their legs went weak, and their hearts palpitated as they looked outside the base.
At the same time, all the Unique Beasts within the tens of kilometers of mountain forests, dinosaurs, and even the smallest of creatures trembled and lay on the ground, not daring to move.
Bang!
In Jack’s hands, the platinum ore, with law patterns all over its surface and on par with top-tier divine items, crumbled, dispersed, and turned into white mist, merging with the blood fog into his body.
At the same time as the blood fog spread, Jack’s skin, muscles, bones, and even Internal Organs slowly merged with the platinum heavy elements, undergoing a special qualitative change.
And as his flesh and blood true body refined and transformed with the platinum heavy elements, strands of special power began to converge within him, phenomena formed by the condensation of Cultivation Method Runes.
Jack was very familiar with this scene, having experienced it several times before.
Thus, while a part of his attention monitored this, he directed his other senses to his transforming body, his skin emitting a faint metallic sheen like that of metal.
Both muscles and bones were entwined by black and platinum patterns, many cells stained with a metallic luster, yet still fundamentally flesh and blood.
This transformation lasted a little over an hour; the strands of special power converged and evolved until finally, they formed a dark gold ‘star’ on Jack’s chest.
Just as the dark gold rune formed, an uncontrollably wild and heavy aura burst from Jack.
Boom!
Under the weight of the tremendous force, the fighter aircraft plummeted, the Earth shattered, and dirt and stones soared like a tsunami into the sky, causing the ground to sink and the entire mountain to tremble.
Fortunately, this leaking power was but a fleeting moment, quickly reigned in by Jack.
Inside the fighter, Jack sat cross-legged, his hair moving without wind, the dark gold star in his eyes slowly spinning, distorting the Void with its invisible but terrifying gravitational force.
Of course, all of this was merely the ethereal shadow of Power Projection.
After a long while, Jack slowly exhaled and his gaze fell upon the attribute page, which had undergone subtle changes.
True Body: Battle Demon God [Forged with the power of Mysterious Yellow in the body of an Innate Demon God, acquired the Steel Attribute through special Cultivation Methods and Limit Enhancement.]
Steel: A special attribute gained by absorbing heavy metal elements, making the true body heavier, more solid, and containing more Overbearing power.]
Battle Demon God. Steel Emperor Dragon: In the Demon God Emperor Dragon Form, release all refined heavy metal elemental power within the body and enter the Steel Form.]
In Steel Emperor Dragon Form, both strength and Defense will experience a significant surge, while speed and agility will decrease, with enhanced intensity dependent on the total amount of heavy metal elements contained within the body.]
Rune: Dark Star [Rune concocted from Qi Blood and heavy metal elements, allows one to absorb and refine all heavy metal elements to strengthen oneself when operating rune power.]
The speed, intensity, and capacity of the Rune’s power to refine heavy element metals depend on the body’s ability to withstand it.]
There was no earth-shattering increase in strength; the Limit Enhancement of the Dark Star Body Refinement only gave Jack’s battle true body the Steel Attribute, making it slightly heavier and more solid.
The condensed Dark Star Rune also possessed a singular trait, absorbing and refining all heavy metal elements to strengthen Jack’s true body.
Until now, the spending of thousands of attribute points had not significantly enhanced Jack’s strength—after all, his power was too formidable already.
But this was precisely the result Jack had wanted from the start, and a light smile appeared on his face, “As expected, after Limit Enhancement, I’ve acquired the Dark Star Talent Rune.”
Next was to test how far the Dark Star Rune could enhance his true body.
Whirr! The Cloud Sky Fighter Jet buried a hundred meters underground vibrated, and immediately, hot air gushed from below, breaking through the surface and soaring into the sky under the levitation magnetic field.
Being too strong could sometimes be inconvenient, such as a slight leak of power during cultivation could cause astonishing damage to the surrounding buildings and life, so Jack was preparing to move to another place.
Soon, the fighter jet sliced through the night sky and landed in a meadow a hundred kilometers away.
Bang, bang, bang!
Chunks of ore and materials of various sizes were ‘poured’ out by Jack, shaking the Earth, and even collapsing under a pure black stone a meter in diameter.
Any material treasured by a demon king had to be at least ordinary God-level or Transcendent Level; such materials were nothing to scoff at.
After all, they were items fit for Mythical Powerhouses ruling over tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Jack grabbed a red Crystal Stone the size of a water barrel, weighing over two hundred tons, and with a thought, activated the rune on his chest, instantly a ring of dark gold halo spread out.
Puff, puff! Under the power of a Talent Rune similar to the Dark Star, streams of pure red substance emerged from inside the red Crystal Stone, flowing into Jack’s body through his hands.
Immediately, Jack’s aura sank, radiating an even heavier presence, and the ground beneath his feet cracked open with crevices.
This Dark Star Rune was potent, and if Jack could absorb all the heavy matter from these ores and materials, his raw body strength would increase by at least thirty percent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1246 - 1246 487 Falling of the Great Sun Steel
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1246: Chapter 487: Falling of the Great Sun, Steel Attribute – Part 2 Chapter 1246: Chapter 487: Falling of the Great Sun, Steel Attribute – Part 2 And the basic improvement represented an increase in strength.
Originally, with the problem of time erosion solved, he just needed to wait for the Eye of Prison to break the seal, then he could use the Hell Coordinates to return.
Unexpectedly, there was this unforeseen fortune before leaving.
And just as Jack Clark was absorbing “Metal Ore” for cultivation, wanting to see the limit of the Dark Star Rune, the Destruction Emperor Dragon delving into the Chaotic Turbulent Region also made a discovery.
Woo! Thunderflame, I feel something good.
In the ‘world’ shrouded in Cloud Mist, five Giant Beasts, four large and one small, were flying.
This was a dangerous area within the Chaotic Turbulent Region, where white mist obscuring vision and perception lingered. The beasts had ventured deep into the Chaotic Domain, tens of thousands of kilometers, garnering some treasures along the way, though they were not significant.
Hearing the Single-horned Spawn Roc announce a discovery, the Silver Giant Dragon instantly let out an excited roar, “Roar! Joe, lead the way, this time let the Great Scythia lead the charge.”
Woo! Follow me.
The enormous dark gold double wings of the Single-horned Spawn Roc shook, stirring up the fog and flying toward the left where at the end of the mist vaguely stood a mountain peak tens of thousands of meters tall.
“Roar! Tim Abott, Telsafi, hurry and keep up.” The Silver Giant Dragon burst out roaring with excitement, chasing after them.
Atop the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon turned into a streak of purple radiance shooting out: Yi ya yi ya!! Sethia, wait for the great May.
Then came the equally excited golden blue Giant Dragon.
Giant Dragons were inherently brutal creatures that enjoyed collecting treasures. Although the intelligence of these two Giant Dragons had increased after becoming Mythical Giant Beasts, their nature remained unchanged.
Finally, the Black-red Colossal Beast behind them slightly spread its double wings, its vast body bursting through the air, dispersing the clouds and forming a passage several kilometers in diameter wherever it passed.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon hadn’t flown far when the Silver Giant Dragon, which had dashed over a hundred kilometers away, let out an angry and surprised roar, along with the screech of the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Roar! An earth-shattering roar exploded, followed by the rising Terrifying Aura of an Early Titan.
Within the dazzling purple radiance that colored half of Heaven and Earth and the clouds, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc were knocked back, penetrating the mist and smashing heavily onto a mountain peak tens of kilometers away.
Boom boom!! The mountain collapsed, and the Earth trembled.
In the blinding purple glow, a Titan Giant Beast stood tall, resembling a Giant Dragon over eighteen hundred meters long but with a pair of enormous Bat Wings.
And this Titan Giant Beast, unlike the Destruction Emperor Dragon, was slender in shape, its whole body covered with thick purple scale armor resembling an exoskeleton, with long and sharp double claws.
At this moment, the beast stood upright, atop the Mountain Peak, wings spread furiously, surrounded by purple radiance, coldly and viciously looking towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the other Giant Beasts.
Compared to the Silver Giant Dragon and other Mythical Giant Beasts, which were only slightly larger in size, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, also in the early stages of Titan, posed some ‘threats’ to it.
The sudden change made the Destruction Emperor Dragon pause.
Due to the special environment of the surrounding mist, even its perception was hindered, and it failed to detect the Titan Giant Beast just over a hundred kilometers away.
Of course, the most important thing was that this Titan Giant Beast posed no threat to it, which is why it didn’t trigger its instinctual alert.
At this time, as the mountain rocks exploded, the Silver Giant Dragon roared angrily as it emerged, “Roar! Damn you, how dare you injure the Great Scythia, you’re dead today.”
The Silver Giant Dragon was in disarray, its body ripped open by three wounds on its side, each over two hundred meters long and thirty meters deep, spewing Silver Dragon Blood profusely as if it cost nothing.
Despite suffering a heavy injury from the surprise attack of the purple Giant Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon was not afraid at all, instead letting out a tyrannical roar, glaring fiercely at the purple Giant Beast.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was howling in rage, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which was slightly better off with only one wing broken, also took flight, looking towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon and making a woeful sound.
Woo! Thunderflame, you must help us take revenge. If it wasn’t for Scythia’s help just now, I might have already been dead.
Saying this, the Single-horned Spawn Roc couldn’t help feeling a bit scared after the fact, as its talent for treasure hunting did not include warning and detecting dangers.
Furthermore, with the environmental issues here and the Titan Giant Beast having a talent for stealth, it nearly got killed in one strike.
Fortunately, at that time, the Silver Giant Dragon was also following behind. In the instant the Titan Giant Beast launched its surprise attack, the Silver Giant Dragon distorted the position of both parties with the Power of Space, blocking the hit.
Although the Silver Giant Dragon wasn’t strong enough, he still fulfilled his role as the Big Dragon King of the Dragon Palace quite competently. He would genuinely step up in serious situations, just like when he encountered the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah.
In contrast to the two giant beasts that were wounded in a single strike, the golden-blue giant dragon and the purple little dragon hesitated for a moment and stopped tens of kilometers away.
The purple little dragon blinked its large eyes, “Yiyayiya!! Great Sethia, do you need May’s help?”
The Silver Giant Dragon shook its head and roared lowly, “Roar! No need, this minor injury will heal soon, let’s not waste your strength just yet.”
At this moment, the golden-blue giant dragon flew in front of the Silver Giant Dragon and roared lowly, “Sethia is indeed a fool. One doesn’t need to think to know that places with good treasures will be guarded by mighty beasts.”
As he spoke, the golden-blue dragon’s claw pressed on the Silver Giant Dragon’s wound, and a rainbow crystal spread out, sealing off the purple strength attached to the wound and flaking it off.
Instantly, the aura around the Silver Giant Dragon relaxed, and the flesh and blood at the wound grew back at a visible rate.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared ferociously, “Damn Torsa, you actually dare mock the Great Sethia. You were just luckier and slower just now.”
The golden-blue giant dragon raised its head elegantly, its eyes revealing pride, “No, I am just more cautious than you.”
While the several giant dragons ‘spoke,’ black and red lightning jumped around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with a terrible aura of destruction emanating from it.
Boom! The space beneath the Destruction Emperor Dragon shattered, creating a black broken area with a range of several tens of kilometers, and with the powerful rebound force, the Destruction Emperor Dragon disappeared instantly.
Roar!
An instant later, a brutal roar exploded in the distance. Dazzling purple radiance collided with black and red destructive lightning, causing the void to collapse and reverberating through Heaven and Earth.
The two Titan beasts approached each other in an instant, and even before they clashed, the Law Domains that circled around them collided as if two worlds were impacting each other.
And in that moment of collision, the hundred-kilometer-wide purple domain surrounding the purple beast collapsed with a bang, and a dragon claw wrapped in black destructive lightning and deep red lightning reached out.
Roar! The purple beast let out a mournful scream, as its eight sharp dragon horns broke, its scale armor and flesh burst open, and even its skull was shattered by the strike, half of its head exploding.
Boom!
The terrifying force of the strike, unabated, forced the vast body of the purple beast to crash heavily into a mountain peak, causing the sky to split and the fabric of space-time to shake.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared towards the heavens.
From within the collapsing mountain peak, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood atop the purple beast with a crushed skull. With double claws ablaze with golden flames, it grabbed the wings on its back and tore viciously.
Boom Boom!!
The explosive release of terrifying strength tore the Titan beast’s wings off along with bones and flesh, as searing, weighty blood sprayed out in an instant.
With its wings torn away, the purple beast let out another harrowing scream, its massive body emitting a blinding purple glow and terrifying power as it struggled.
Boom!
Under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s heavy foot stomp, the body of the purple beast sank, the impact of the mighty force causing the ground to collapse; rocks exploded, forming a ring-shaped shockwave tens of kilometers in diameter.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon standing on top of the purple beast roared as the blazing golden flames on its body ignited, its dorsal fins lit up one after another, and blue-purple thunder jumped around.
Boom!
At the center, where the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood, golden flames burst forth, expanding and releasing infinitely, forming a ten-kilometer-diameter star that emitted a terror-inducing, everything-melting high temperature.
The scorching star was surrounded by a blue-purple thunder ring hundreds of meters thick, exuding a fearsome destructive aura.
Laws Mystery: Falling of the Great Sun, instantaneously releasing all Great Sun Golden Flame, merging with the domain to form an indiscriminate Destructive Great Sun, obliterating everything within its range.
At the terrifying high temperature of a million degrees Celsius, everything around the golden star was annihilated, dissolved, creating a black circle of destruction.
The intangible destructive high temperature, along with the terrifying strength, excited the distant Silver Giant Dragon and golden-blue giant dragon, their eyes ablaze.
How powerful, Tim Abott and Thunderflame.

chapters.title: Chapter 1247 - 1247 488 The Great Battle of the Twin Dragons
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1247: Chapter 488: The Great Battle of the Twin Dragons, the Roots of the Void Chapter 1247: Chapter 488: The Great Battle of the Twin Dragons, the Roots of the Void “`
Equally in the early stages of Titan growth, but the purple giant beast, which only mastered one higher-order law, stood no chance against the Destruction Emperor Dragon and was heavily injured in an instant upon clashing.
The advantage of mastering nine higher-order laws wasn’t just in having more mysteries of the laws, but an overwhelming dominance in all aspects.
More than ten minutes later, the terrifyingly hot Golden Sun slowly receded and extinguished, revealing the black-red Colossal Beast that stood defiantly within the raging Void.
Amidst the scorching heatwaves, the Destruction Emperor Dragon held a purple Dragon Wing in its claw, with the lifeless corpse of the purple giant beast underfoot.
Besides, within a twenty-some-kilometer radius centered on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, everything had been vaporized, be it the white mist or the rocks and dirt, even the surface layers of space.
Yiya yiya!! Big brother is awesome, totally badass.
The purple little dragon turned into a streak of light, covering tens of kilometers to appear in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, excitedly letting out naive roars of yiya yiya.
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, emanating a terrifying aura that seemed to tear Titans apart, paused and with a slightly open ferocious maw, let out a resonant growl, “…Misss Joseline, the word ‘badass’ doesn’t suit girls; don’t use it anymore.”
Yiya yiya!! Is it not good?
The purple little dragon blinked its large eyes, somewhat puzzled.
When it was just born, standing on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and following them as they swept across the sea, it heard the Giant Crabs and other behemoths exclaim how badass and awesome the Destruction Emperor Dragon was.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon appeared indifferent, the purple little dragon could sense that it took great pleasure in those moments.
Could it be that its posture was incorrect? The purple little dragon, reminded of the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah’s frenzied twisting of its nine dragon heads and the knotted tails when excited, pondered thoughtfully.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re too amazing.” The Silver Giant Dragon shouted joyously, with wings folding back thunderously, and landed next to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Standing atop the corpse of the purple giant beast, the Silver Giant Dragon slapped its claws vigorously, “Roar! Stupid fella, daring to ambush the Great Sethia, you’re asking for it.”
By now the wound on the side of the Silver Giant Dragon had mostly healed, with only the new scale armor still growing, revealing the white dragon skin underneath, adorned with snowflake-like patterns.
At this moment, a golden-blue Giant Dragon flew over, with transparent scale armor covering its wings, hovering in the air and uttering an awed growl, “Incredible, one can’t imagine how powerful you will be as an Ancient Beast, Thunderflame.”
Since the golden-blue Giant Dragon knew the black-red Colossal Beast, only three Sun Wheels had passed, and the latter had grown from Mythical-level to Titan Level.
Moreover, it had already killed four Titan Level Giant Beasts with its claws, with the strongest, the Lava King, close to Titan Peak in strength, and each battle was resolved in an extremely short time.
It was as if the Destruction Emperor Dragon wasn’t slaying a ruling Titan creature but just a common Mythical Giant Beast.
Every time the Silver Giant Dragon saw those mighty Titan creatures torn apart by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it felt a hot restlessness coursing through its body and its tail going weak, filled with a roaring urge to vent the surging feelings within.
But it is the Great Telsafi, always elegant, not a bumbling fool like Sethia who yells and shouts all day long.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon looked around at the ’emptiness’, then set its gaze upon the Single-horned Spawn Roc flying towards it and let out a deep growl, “Joe, where’s the good stuff you found?”
The Mythical Giant Beasts were noted for their astonishing recovery ability. In just a short while, the broken wing of the Single-horned Spawn Roc had also healed. At the mention, it looked down into the crater.
Woo! Thunderflame, it’s underground.
Beneath the scorching blaze of the Golden Sun, a once proud mountain peak vanished, leaving behind a crater tens of kilometers in diameter and over six thousand meters deep.
The base and walls of the crater had crystallized under the influence of terrifying heat and pressure, turning into dark red, hard crystal surfaces.
A black-red Tail Blade, over a thousand meters long, descended from the sky, entwined with black and red lightning, cleaving through space, and upon striking the earth, the world shook.
Boom! Under the force of terrifying power, the crater exploded, tearing a hundred kilometer-long and several kilometer-wide fissure in the Earth, casting countless rocks and dirt in all directions.
Through the billowing smoke and dust, the Destruction Emperor Dragon led the way, followed by the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast, charging into the cracks and making their way down tens of thousands of meters.
Beneath the earth wasn’t the searing magma of the underground, but a colossal hollow space, extending tens of kilometers long, filled with cracks in the air.
These cracks appear to lead to unknown destinations, with energy much purer than from the Outer World, pouring out a hundredfold in concentration alongside six roots, hundreds to thousands of kilometers long, colored green.
These roots, covered in Dragon Scale Patterns, emerged from one spatial crack and disappeared into the depths of another, even the thinnest being over 200 meters in thickness.
The origin and destination of these roots remained a mystery even as they traversed the void spaces.
As for the ‘good stuff,’ it was the pure green light flickering inside the roots, flowing like blood vessels, supplying ‘nutrition.’
At that time, only four of the roots maintained intact surfaces, their interiors flashing with green conduits, emitting dense and pure energy auras.
The other three roots were pitted and laced with bite marks, their energy previously devoured by the purple giant beast, and were now slowly recuperating.
With just a segment of the root growing a few hundred meters thick and drilling into the void, one can only imagine the colossal size of the actual tree, possibly surpassing a hundred thousand meters.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon glanced at the three intact roots and let out a dull growl, “These roots contain rich energy; each of you take one.”
No sooner had the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking than the Silver Giant Dragon shook its head in disagreement, “Roar! Tim Abott, you should eat more since you were the one who killed that Titan Giant Beast.”
