chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1248: Chapter 488: Dual Dragon Battle, Void Tree Root_2 Chapter 1248: Chapter 488: Dual Dragon Battle, Void Tree Root_2 “Yes, we hardly exerted ourselves this time, give Joe just one and you can have the rest.” The gold-blue Giant Dragon nodded in agreement.
Unlike human society, the inner structure of the giant beast power is quite simple, with strength being the most revered and the basic rule of getting as much as you exert being followed.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “The energy contained in these roots is roughly equivalent to one top-tier Divine Fruit each, even if I ate them all, my strength would not increase much.”
“On the contrary, it would be more effective for you to consume them.”
“Next, we will continue to delve deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region. You are too weak right now, you need to improve quickly, alright, distribute them as I have said.”
Having said that, the Destruction Emperor Dragon flew upwards, preparing to consume the corpse of the Purple Giant Beast.
The harvest this time was actually pretty good, equivalent to the roots of ‘three’ top-level Divine Items, almost enough for the Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon to make a breakthrough into the mid period of the Legendary Realm.
The two giant beasts, although they had not been in the Legendary Realm for long and lacked Evolution Talent, had consumed a large amount of resources during this time, including two High-Level Divine Beads nurtured by Titan ancient clams.
Plus the roots from this time, piling them up alone could push them into the mid Mythical Stage.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it was almost the same, having gained strength quickly by following the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it’s estimated that consuming two more top-grade Divine Fruits would enable it to break through to the mid Mythical Stage.
Such level of resources, even Titan-level giant beasts would be envious of, as consuming them could improve a bit of their strength.
Unfortunately, although these roots are Regenerative Resources and their overall value is comparable to Law Level Divine Items, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the others don’t have the time to guard them here.
After distributing the three ‘roots’ to the Silver Giant Dragon and the others, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, who had returned to the surface, came in front of the Purple Giant Beast corpse and grabbed it with double claws, biting down directly.
Boom! Under the horrifying bite force, the heavy scale armor of the Purple Giant Beast, resembling an exoskeleton, shattered, and its flesh and blood were torn apart, emitting a thunderous explosion.
To the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the flesh and blood of Titan giant beasts were still more nutritious.
As a large mouthful of Giant Beast flesh and blood entered its stomach, in an instant, the searing biological energy containing Law Factors exploded from the stomach, and the cells throughout its body began to absorb it like a parched desert.
Crackle Crackle!!
The full-body scales armor of the Destruction Emperor Dragon made a frictional crackling sound, slowly being raised by the swelling muscles and bones beneath it, continuously elongating and extending.
This was the terror of the Evolution Talent; as long as the flesh and blood were consumed, they could transform into biological energy and grow.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew in size, radiating a rich aura of life, the Purple little dragon lying comfortably on its head was also absorbing the life aura emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Because the Purple little dragon had absorbed the Life Origin of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and, due to its talent, it could absorb this intangible emitted aura to grow.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon noticed this as well, but it didn’t mind too much because if the Purple little dragon did not absorb this invisible life aura, it would dissipate anyway.
These life auras are like the heat that a person emits all the time from their body.
About an hour later, the Silver Giant Dragon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, all emanating a green glow, flew up from under the Earth.
The aura and sizes of the three Giant Beasts had both surged, with the size of the Silver Giant Dragon growing from 760 meters to more than 780 meters.
Glancing at the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had already consumed half of the Purple Giant Beast’s flesh and blood, the three Giant Beasts each found a small hill to lie down on to digest the rich energy inside their bodies.
Looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast in the distance, eating greedily with resonant rumbles, the round-bellied Silver Giant Dragon felt envious and let out a low growl.
“Roar! Telsafi, the Great Scythia has noticed that Tim Abbott looks so ferocious when eating.”
Lying nearby, the round-bellied gold-blue Giant Dragon lazily growled back, “Isn’t that obvious, Sethia? Thunderflame has always been ferocious.”
In the eyes of the gold-blue Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, covered in Black-red Scaled Armor, with three rows of sharp Dorsal Fins on its back, a slender tail, and a robust figure, was akin to a male god in human society.
Especially that flowing Dragon’s Mane and the wide and fierce dragon head were definitely eye-catching.
At that moment, the gold-blue Giant Dragon growled casually, “But, Sethia, you’re so thick-headed that it’s only natural for you to notice this now. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be you.”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon got agitated, “Roar! Damn you, Telsafi, you’ve once again called the Great Scythia a fool. Today, I must teach you a good lesson.”
As the Silver Giant Dragon roared and suddenly stood up, its body emanated a chilling coldness, and a raging wind howled, signaling an imminent battle.
The gold-blue Giant Dragon rose slowly and proudly lifted its head, “Roar! You think you can teach a lesson to the great Telsafi? You’re dreaming, Sethia.”
“You were never my match from the start, and today will be no different.”
Reminded by the gold-blue Giant Dragon of past matters, memories of past agonies provoked the Silver Giant Dragon to bellow, “Damn it, today the Great Sethia will definitively thrash you.”
Bang Bang!!
Instantly, the two seven-hundred-meter-long dragons roared, transforming into two beams of light that shot into the sky, followed by powerful waves of energy erupting at ten thousand meters altitude.
The sudden turn of events left the nearby Single-horned Spawn Roc confused. What happened? Why did these two close Giant Dragons suddenly start fighting?
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which was eating meat, couldn’t help but look up at the sky.
“So these two dragons have finally started to fight.”
The relationship between the Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon was good, which was undeniable. But at the same time, the competitive nature of the Dragon species to strive for dominance meant that neither of them would concede to the other.

chapters.title: Chapter 1249 - 1249 488 The Great Battle of the Twin Dragons
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1249: Chapter 488: The Great Battle of the Twin Dragons, the Roots of the Void_3 Chapter 1249: Chapter 488: The Great Battle of the Twin Dragons, the Roots of the Void_3 “`
Especially when two giant dragons grow up together and the gap in strength isn’t large, it’s even more normal for them to burst into battle.
Therefore, the Destruction Emperor Dragon merely looked up, then lowered its head and started eating again.
With its current growth rate, it thought that after eating a couple more Titian Beasts or a few kinds of law-level resources, it should be able to reach the mid period of Titan.
Roar!!
Within the white mist thousands of meters high, eighteen pathways of black ice crystal tornado storms, hundreds of meters thick, were swirling around with a silver giant dragon roaring at their center.
Boom!
A white light beam infused with extreme cold energy burst forth, spanning Carney Turner, freezing, shattering the mist it passed through, and creating a hundred-meter-wide Destruction Tunnel.
Just as the silver giant dragon burst forth with its breath, some tens of kilometers away atop the sea of clouds, a golden-blue giant dragon was also roaring, firing a rainbow breath from its mouth.
The two breaths crossed over ten kilometers and collided with a bang.
Instantly, the atmosphere exploded, a rainbow halo rapidly expanded in the collapsing Void, releasing a dazzling light that lit up Heaven and Earth.
The destructive aura within the myriad of lights, the raging energy light sphere kept expanding, soon reaching its ten-kilometer limit, and then it released an even more dazzling light.
Boom!
The terrifying shockwave swept across Heaven and Earth, everywhere it passed the air solidified into white ice crystals, then shattered, forming a destructive wave that covered tens of kilometers.
Roar Roar!! Amidst the explosion, the silver giant dragon roared, its double wings furiously spread as it dove towards the golden-blue giant dragon, surrounded by eighteen black ice crystal tornado storms that reached to the heavens.
To welcome the silver giant dragon were hundreds of fifty-meter-diameter crystal bombs, filled with raging energies of various elements, hiding the sky and covering the earth as they engulfed it.
Boom Boom Boom!!
In the crystal bombardment, each blast was comparable to a large yield intercontinental missile, the entirety of the sky shook, releasing multicolored explosion lights.
Amidst the earth-shaking explosion, black ice crystal storms shattered, creating raging winds that froze and blew away the surrounding mist.
“Roar! Damn you Torsa, take my claw.”
Among the roaring, the space twisted behind the golden-blue giant dragon, and the silver giant dragon appeared out of thin air, holding a hundred-meter-diameter black twisted storm in its claw.
At the black hole-like center of the storm, an Ice Crystal Lotus slowly rotated.
In this period, aside from following the Destruction Emperor Dragon around on adventures, the silver giant dragon had also been diligently cultivating, almost engraving force field binding runes on over two thousand fine scales of its right claw.
The overlapping of over a thousand Basic Runes bolstered the force field’s power to an astonishing level, compressing a tenth of the Destruction Ice Crystal Storm’s Laws in its body by a hundredfold.
Even just the destructive energy fluctuations it emitted made the golden-blue giant dragon’s gaze shrink, but it had long been prepared for the silver giant dragon’s Space Power.
Crack!! Between the two giant dragons, a layer of crystal hundreds of meters thick materialized out of nowhere, forming a semi-circular dome that enveloped the golden-blue giant dragon.
“Roar! Torsa, your move is outdated.”
The silver giant dragon, holding the Destruction storm in its claw, struck out, the space in front folded and distorted again, directly passing through the crystal shield and appearing in front of the golden-blue giant dragon.
Boom!
In an instant, an endless burst of Destruction Ice Crystals exploded, forming a black storm halo that blasted out for over ten kilometers, the entire sky shook under the impact of this strike.
And the golden-blue giant dragon directly facing this strike was blasted into smithereens… The silver giant dragon paused mid-shattering.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Beneath them, the earth shook and shattered, tens of crystal pillars soared into the sky, creating towering mountain peaks of crystal that stood over a dozen kilometers.
“`
Atop the most central and low crystal mountain peak stood the golden-blue Giant Dragon elegantly. What had just been shattered was merely one of its crystal Avatars.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon growled, “Scythia, you’re still so foolish.”
However, even as it said this, the golden-blue Giant Dragon was shocked, because the Silver Giant Dragon’s mastery of the space laws had now reached the point where it could ignore Law Domains entirely.
Under the Law Domain of a Mythical Giant Beast, space itself was influenced, interfered with, and suppressed, making the difficulty of twisting space to open wormholes dozens of times greater than usual.
“Roar! Detestable Telsafi, today the Great Scythia must spank you severely,” bellowed the Silver Giant Dragon, plummeting from the heavens with a thunderous roar.
On the body of the Silver Giant Dragon, silver light flowed and condensed, eventually forming a silver force field that distorted space within a hundred-meter radius around it, radiating an amazing Aura.
Bang, bang, bang!! Crystal pillars, a hundred meters thick, surged towards the sky, but before they could get close to the Silver Giant Dragon, they were shattered by the distorted and vibrating space.
Those very crystal columns, which even the Kamaitachi Beast could not escape from instantly, were now unable to even approach the Silver Giant Dragon.
This scene made the golden-blue Giant Dragon pause before roaring savagely, “Roar! Scythia, don’t think you’re the only one whose strength has increased during this time.”
Boom!
The crystal mountain forest within a range of several kilometers vibrated, and crystal mountain peaks over two to three kilometers high collapsed towards the golden-blue Giant Dragon. Heaven and Earth trembled fiercely, and a crystal Giant Dragon, two thousand kilometers in height, emerged.
This move was the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s Higher-order Laws Mystery, similar to a True Body Domain, merging the elemental laws, crystal laws, including all gifted powers and domain.
Although it was not comparable to the Deep Red Form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its strength still surged tremendously, possessing the indestructible real body of the crystal dragon.
Boom!!
The space quaking force field encircling the Silver Giant Dragon collided with the crystal Giant Dragon, and in an instant, the earth within a range of twenty-some kilometers shook violently, crumbling and forming a ring explosion, with countless chunks of dirt and stone shooting up tens of thousands of meters into the air.
Under the hard clash of the two Giant Dragons, the crystal Giant Dragon’s double claws developed several cracks due to the space force field, and at the same time, the powerful rebound also pushed the Silver Giant Dragon back.
In rapid succession, the two Giant Dragons roared and lunged at each other again, sparking an even more intense battle.
Both nearing the Mid-Mythical Stage and both possessing two types of Higher-order Laws, the two Giant Dragons were evenly matched in strength for a time, destroying everything around them in their no-holds-barred struggle.
Occasionally, a breath exhaled would destroy mountain peaks, erasing the cloud mist.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1250: Chapter 489: Time and Metal, Suppressing a Boundary Chapter 1250: Chapter 489: Time and Metal, Suppressing a Boundary Nearly two kilometers long and hundreds of meters tall, the purple-gold skeleton of a colossal beast stood next to a black-red Colossal Beast that was even more massive and majestic, measuring two thousand three hundred meters in length.
The fog that had gathered again around the Destruction Emperor Dragon swirled like an immense, ethereal mountain range, invisibly emitting a sense of oppressive enormity.
Devouring an Early Titan Beast provided the Destruction Emperor Dragon with biological energy that only caused it to grow a few dozen meters taller in a short time.
This phenomenon was similar to when it first evolved into a Sword Armor Beast and made a breakthrough to Level 4, devouring a same-level Level 4 Mutated Beast only to gain a bit in size.
The reason wasn’t that the energy had diminished, but that more energy was required for each bit of growth.
At the moment, in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s left claw, a potent and scorching Qi Blood strength was converging and circulating, slowly revealing the imprint of a Dark Star Rune on one of the fine scales.
However, as soon as the rune, which resembled a ‘planet’, appeared, its internal structure shook violently and then burst back into pure Qi Blood strength.
“As expected, the Talent Runes formed by Cultivation Methods can’t be directly condensed,” pondered the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its cold golden vertical pupils showing a hint of thought as it slowly lowered its left claw.
After devouring the purple giant, and seeing the two Giant Dragons still fighting, the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but attempt to refine the Dark Star Rune that Jack Clark had just acquired.
It then failed over thirty times in succession.
Compared to Basic Runes like the restraining force field, a Dark Star Rune that was cultivated step by step through Cultivation Methods—amalgamating the cultivator’s Spirit Qi and Heavy Metal Elements to elevate—was quite complex and mysterious.
This type of rune was already equivalent to an Innate Talent, and one step further was Divine Power.
Therefore, it was almost impossible for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which couldn’t cultivate body strengthening Cultivation Methods, to condense a Dark Star Rune under normal conditions, unless it possessed a Metal Talent.
By then, by absorbing Heavy Metal Elements with its Metal Talent and using Qi Blood to simulate the Dark Star Talent Rune, it could refine and obtain its tenth Top-tier Talent.
After Jack Clark absorbed a massive amount of Heavy Metal Elements to change part of his ‘attribute’ and condensed a Dark Star Rune, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became somewhat interested in this ability.
Compared to the Time Talent mastered by the Time Silver Butterfly, the ability to absorb Heavy Metal Elements and alter the properties of flesh and blood was more suitable for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
That was because the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s biggest advantage was its unsurpassably strong Giant Beast Body.
Talents like the Time Laws and the Destruction Law could potentially encounter situations where they were sealed or restricted, like the Time Silver Butterfly that Jack Clark had killed earlier.
But a strong Giant Beast Body would not be subject to such restrictions, especially when bearing the chaotic dark power and having full-body scales armor engraved with the talent ‘Impervious to all laws’.
If the tenth talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon were to be ‘Dark Star,’ combined with its terrifying evolutionary growth rate, there was a possibility that one day it could truly become a ‘black hole’.
At that time, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon standing tall in the firmament, its mere invisible gravitational pull could be enough to tear apart and destroy worlds, its terrifying defense ignoring all attacks.
Of course, this was a pleasant thought, but there was still an issue as to whether the Dark Star Rune condensed by Jack Clark had a limit and whether the Destruction Emperor Dragon could gain the Power of Dark Star with the help of Metal Talent.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon was swaying between the time and Dark Star abilities, the two giants who finished their fight came back limping heavily.
Seeing the somewhat disheveled state of the two Giant Dragons, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a slow growl, “It’s over.”
The Silver Giant Dragon landed on three claws and, lifting its broken left claw, roared triumphantly, “Roar! This time Great Scythia was only a little short of defeating Telsafi.”
The gold-and-blue Giant Dragon looked up and let out a disdainful roar, “Was that a little short, Scythia? It was clearly a great distance, and that was Great Telsafi going easy on you.”
At this moment, one of the dragon horns on the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon’s head was broken, and its left cheek was marked by a blow from the Silver Giant Dragon. Despite no blood being shed, the scales were broken, and it lacked its usual elegance.
“Roar! Damn Telsafi, it was actually Great Scythia who held back this time, otherwise your wings would’ve been broken long ago,” the Silver Giant Dragon bellowed defiantly.
Seeing this, the purple little dragon on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon became excited, waving its double claws and squealing, “Yi ya yi ya!! Fight, fight.”
…Knock it off. The Destruction Emperor Dragon snapped.
At that moment, the Single-horned Spawn Roc tentatively came over, looking at the two Giant Dragons still emitting a fierce killing intent, before finally chirping tentatively.
“Thunderflame, shall we continue on our journey?”
“Wait, there’s one last thing to take care of.”
In a low growl, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head, looking at the enormous Titan beast skeleton in front of it as its mouth opened slightly, and in an instant, a dazzling gold and purple radiance shone from within.
Boom! The scorching gold and purple Flame Breath erupted, enveloping the Titan beast skeleton.
The breath, blended with the Corrosion Law and the Great Sun Heaven Flame, contained terrifyingly high temperatures and destructive power, visibly melting the purple giant’s skeleton under the fiery refinement.
The bodies of Titan-level creatures had already merged with the laws; even in death, with the flesh eaten away, the bones still contained astonishing amounts of energy and Law Factors.
This refined essence of heaven and earth from such materials was a top-level divine item for strengthening Plane Worlds, more precious than Law-level mineral resources, because the quantity was much larger.
So far, aside from the Lava Titan Giant’s corpse that exploded and dispersed into lava material, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had collected the skeletons of the Golden Roc and the Titan Flame Whale.
All it needed was for Jack Clark to return so they could be used to reinforce the Plane Space, expanding the plane to thousands of kilometers in one fell swoop and elevating the Supreme Law to a grand accomplishment.
This time, refining the skeleton took several hours, ultimately forming a four-hundred-meter-long, hundred-meter-wide irregular purple crystal that was semi-translucent, resembling a spine.

chapters.title: Chapter 1251 - 1251 489 Time and Metal Suppressing a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1251: Chapter 489 Time and Metal, Suppressing a Boundary_2 Chapter 1251: Chapter 489 Time and Metal, Suppressing a Boundary_2 Upon this Titan Giant Beast’s spine flowed pure purple rule patterns, containing the partial secrets of the Purple Giant Beast’s talents.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon deemed the talents and rules controlled by this Giant Beast as unworthy, and with a direct grasp, it was collected into the space beneath its Reverse Scale under its neck.
Standing amidst a sea of fire that even burned through space, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head to look at the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast that had already recovered from their injuries, emitting a deep roar.
“Let’s go.”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, its Dragon Wings opened wide, and it soared into the sky: “Roar! Charge, Great Sethia will kill all, plunder all, devour all.”
Roar roar roar!! Kill all, plunder all. The Single-horned Spawn Roc was also excited and followed suit.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon also stretched its double wings, its body emanating a Seven-Colored Glow, following behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Thousands of crystals orbited around it, refracted light making it look very beautiful and elegant.
Soon the Four Great Beasts disappeared into the mist.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued to delve deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, considering whether it could find a Giant Beast with metal-related talents, Jack Clark had also refined all the mineral resources.
Dawn broke, and the sky gradually brightened.
On the plain, the ground had collapsed, forming a crater thousands of meters in diameter and several hundred meters deep, with web-like cracks spreading all around—a horrifying sight.
In the air, Jack Clark, dressed in a gray leisure suit, stood on the void, his black hair moving on its own without any wind, emanating an extremely heavy and terrifying aura that distorted space and even devoured light.
Even because of the invisible gravitational force he emitted, the overwhelming strength caused the surrounding Earth’s magnetic field to become chaotic, suspending countless fragments of rocks within a kilometer range.
However, at this time, Jack Clark, feeling his more solidified and powerful physical body, as well as the several tens of thousands of tons of “self-weight” he had gained, couldn’t help but frown slightly.
Because the effects of the Dark Star Rune were a little lower than he had anticipated.
Originally, he estimated that by refining those minerals and material resources, his basic physical body strength could increase by thirty percent, but it turned out to be only about twenty percent.
And this twenty percent was also because his physical body’s carrying capacity was terrifying enough, plus he absorbed and refined resources accumulated by several demon kings; otherwise, the improvement would be even lower.
After all, even though the Dark Star Body Refining Method was special, it was still only a Transcendent level Cultivation Method, even if Jack Clark had strengthened it to the limit with Attribute points.
Jack Clark pondered, “It seems that I need to find a way to integrate the Dark Star Rune into the Combat Divine Body, turning it into a ‘Divine Power.'”
All Cultivation Methods ultimately aim to serve the cultivator, and Jack Clark’s Combat Divine Body is the grand accomplishment of his Cultivation Methods, fusing all his strengths together.
Including the power of the Hidden Deity and the Heart Eye Rune, as well as domains like the Doomsday Blood Sea Hell.
If Jack Clark could integrate the Dark Star Rune into his Combat Divine Body, evolving it into a Dark Star Divine Power that would simultaneously strengthen with the increase of cultivation level, he should then be able to endlessly absorb Heavy Metal Elements to enhance his physical body.
And to solve this, the method is simple: read more books (Ancient Techniques), cultivate more, and research more.
Thinking this, Jack Clark couldn’t help but think of the previous battle with Tarolia.
As a demon king who had already half-stepped into the Demon God Level, with a realm reaching the peak of awakening. Tarolia unified all talents and rules with the power of her bloodline, creating her own Supreme Secret Manual.
Her combat power was so supreme that even Jack Clark was not a match, receiving heavy injury from three strikes, especially the last strike called Abyssal Sending, which cut through the Plane World’s Power, comparable to a Demon God.
Actually, this is the path to supremacy.
Upon reaching the Ninth Heaven Peak through top-tier Secret Manuals and breaking through as a Mythical King, cultivators mainly focus on comprehending rules, and eventually breaking through as a Heavenly King, merging with the rules.
But when reaching the pinnacle of the Heavenly King, one needs to refine all knowledge and power learned throughout life to the utmost, creating one’s own path.
This path is the Rule mastered by the cultivator, recognized as an official ‘Rule’ by Heaven and Earth. When the Rule is complete and engraved within Heaven and Earth, that is the moment of becoming the Rule itself.
Therefore, even the Ancient Emperors who left behind the Primordial Blank Rules could only help Jack Clark to step into supremacy.
As for whether he could break through as a Civilization Emperor, he would need to strive on his own.
“Perhaps, I should start preparing in advance,”
said Jack Clark, as the terrible oppressive feeling around him slowly receded. Then, putting away the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, his figure flashed and disappeared without a trace.
Compared to the Supreme Experts of the Human Race and the Demon Gods of the Purgatory Demon Race, Jack Clark, who rose to prominence in just one year, lacked intrinsic depth. He was short on time and accumulation.
Currently, he could rely on burning Attribute points to enter a state of enlightenment and quickly enhance his comprehension of the rules, but what about later when he needed to start refining his own path after breaking through to become a Heavenly King?
…
On the base’s training field, over thirty youths excitedly surrounded Sherry Williams. Arthur, the eldest among them, looked incredibly surprised, “Sherry, did you really break through to the fifth layer of the Red Sun Body Refining Technique?”
Sherry rolled her eyes, sounding annoyed, “Arthur, what do you mean by that? Are you saying I can’t break through to the fifth layer?”
The youngster with a ponytail scratched the back of his head sheepishly, “No, it’s just that the news is so shocking, especially since you were still at the late period of the fourth layer yesterday.”
“I am a genius, so breaking through is very normal, isn’t it?” Sherry said, tilting her head proudly.
At that moment, among the crowd, a boy with a runny nose shouted, “I know, it was the treasure that big brother gave! I saw it while hiding in the back yesterday.”
Another girl also exclaimed excitedly, “I saw it too, it was a shiny crystal stone, Sister Sara has one too.”
Suddenly, Sherry’s proud expression faltered, followed by a touch of annoyance. Why were these kids so clever—couldn’t they have let her bask in her glory for a bit longer?
As a genius who had forcibly cultivated to the Fourth Tier in just a few years, solely relying on her Basic Physical Body’s Qi Blood, Sherry’s cultivation soared after absorbing the energy contained within the Top-tier Crystal Stones.
And it wasn’t just her—Sara’s improvement was even greater, skyrocketing straight from the mid period of the Fifth Tier to the peak, an effect that left the two girls who had cultivated overnight utterly shocked.
Both their bodies were like parched deserts, gaining a significant increase in strength with every bit of energy absorbed.
At this point, Ivy Smith, who had been smilingly watching Sherry ‘show off’, brightened and called out, “Sherry, that big brother has come back.”
Suddenly, everyone turned their heads, only to see a young man with black hair walking in from the entrance of the pathway.
Whoosh! Sherry used a movement technique, leaving a trail of afterimages as she appeared before Jack, somewhat excited, “Mr. Clark, have you finished cultivating?”
“Mhm.”
Jack nodded slightly, glancing at the curious children looking at him, and casually asked, “Sherry, where’s your sister?”
Sherry replied respectfully, “My sister is still cultivating. The crystal stone you gave us yesterday, Mr. Clark, contained powerful energy, and both our cultivations have soared rapidly after absorbing it.”
“Is there something you need from my sister, Mr. Clark?”
With a calm expression, Jack said, “I’m preparing to visit the other Three Imperial Capital Cities to have a look and wanted to ask if anyone knows the way.”

“Mhm.”

[One moment, please.]
Sherry replied respectfully, “My sister is still cultivating. The crystal stone you gave us yesterday, Mr. Clark, contained powerful energy, and both our cultivations have soared rapidly after absorbing it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1252 - 1252 490 Im Running Out of Time Preparing to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1252: Chapter 490 I’m Running Out of Time, Preparing to Leave (First Update) Chapter 1252: Chapter 490 I’m Running Out of Time, Preparing to Leave (First Update) Looking at the youth with raven-black hair as perfect as a God before her, Sara Williams hesitated, “Mr. Clark, Sherry said you want to visit the libraries of the other empires?”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “That’s right, does anyone ‘know the way’?”
The old man with a severed arm smiled bitterly, “I’m afraid we’re going to disappoint Mr. Clark. Before the Doomsday, we were all rather ordinary, and no one has ever left the White Departure Empire.”
“However, although no one has been abroad, I have saved a geography book that includes a simple map of the world, indicating the locations of the four major empires and their Capital Cities.”
“A simple map will do, as long as it can show the directions,” Jack Clark said with a faint smile on his face.
This world was not ‘large,’ but it was not small either. If one were to fly randomly, even Jack wouldn’t know how long it would take to find those three Capital Cities.
Teacher Jordan said respectfully, “Mr. Clark, please wait a moment, I will go fetch it immediately.”
As soon as the Elder had left, Sherry Williams spoke with some anticipation, “Mr. Clark, can you take my sister and me with you on this trip to the three major empires’ Capital Cities? We can help you sort out the materials.”
“You can, or rather, let’s all go together.”
All go together…? Everyone around was taken aback.
Sara Williams doubted she heard correctly, “Mr. Clark, do you mean that we, along with Captain Brown and others, are all going with you to the other empires?”
“Yes,” Jack Clark confirmed with a nod.
Suddenly, Sara Williams hesitated, “But if we leave, what about these children? The base needs to be guarded by some people, otherwise, if a Unique Beast comes…”
Before Sara Williams could finish her sentence, Jack Clark interrupted, “I mean everyone goes together, including these youth.”
“Our encounter is also a kind of fate, so before departing, I plan to find a safer and more suitable place for you as a new base.”
“What, Mr. Clark, you’re leaving!” Instantly, everyone was thrown into a panic.
Especially sisters Sherry Williams and Sara Williams, who were caught off guard, as they had not had enough time to draw closer to him due to the short time.
“Mr. Clark, has someone at the base displeased you?”
Sara Williams’s expression turned serious as she looked back at the youth, thinking one of them must have said something wrong that upset Jack Clark, or else he wouldn’t have suddenly decided to leave.
With a strong man like Jack Clark, who could decimate a city in a blink of an eye and slaughter millions of Mutant monsters, this Survivor Base had an absolute guarantee of safety.
And it wasn’t just for them – Jack Clark’s presence could be said to be the hope of this world.
If he was willing to issue a call to arms, he could certainly gather most of the surviving humans of the Lost World and rebuild a human empire to Suppress all surrounding monsters.
Jack Clark said indifferently, “It has nothing to do with them; my time is running out. This world, ‘Space-Time’, is rejecting me. I have a premonition that I will leave within a few days.”
It was as Jack Clark had thought initially; the longer he stayed, someone who did not belong to this Space-Time, the more influential his actions became, and the stronger the mysterious rejection became.
And it was trying to expel him from this piece of Space-Time.
The current strength of this rejection was not very strong, but as time passed, it slowly grew stronger, like the tide that eventually turns into a Tsunami, devouring everything.
Therefore, he needed to quickly finish his affairs, such as collecting Ancient Techniques from the libraries of the other empires.
Jack Clark’s words shocked everyone, disbelief evident on their faces, finding it hard to imagine how powerful Jack must be to be rejected by the world itself.
“I never expected it to be for this reason,” Sara Williams said with a bitter smile.
As Jack Clark’s departure was due to an irresistible force, there was nothing the others could do. Teacher Jordan, who had just come back, paused and then bowed deeply to Jack Clark.
“Thank you, Mr. Clark, for thinking of us. I’m an old man, so it doesn’t matter much to me, but these children and Sara need a better environment.”
Teacher Jordan then hesitated, “Mr. Clark, is it possible to choose the location for the new base?”
“Do you have a suitable suggestion?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Teacher Jordan nodded, “Yes, Cavapod, holy mountain of the White Lion Empire, where the adventure and exploration team found ancient relics and also the origin of the virus outbreak.”
“During the Doomsday, our radio station received wireless signals from Cavapod.”
“The survivors there controlled the relic and said they would try to find a cure for the virus to save the world. It’s also been spread from there that people infected with the virus could practice Body refining technique.”
“Alas, we waited a year but never heard any news about the cure. The last message from Cavapod was that they had found hope to save the world.”
“Although they have been out of contact for over two years, I feel that there might really be a way to save humanity there.”
After Teacher Jordan finished speaking, Jack Clark looked at the Williams sisters, “What are your thoughts?”
Compared to others, he was more familiar with the two sisters, and if it weren’t for their relationship, he would not have been able to find the relic and obtain the Emperor’s Command Token so quickly.
This was also the reason why Jack Clark was ready to help them before he left.
Sara Williams mused, “Cavapod is the source of the virus outbreak; there might indeed be hope to save the world there. It’s just that it would trouble Mr. Clark if so.”
“Fine, then we will go to Cavapod,” Jack Clark said nonchalantly, with his strength, he was an invincible existence in this world.
With the departure confirmed, Sherry Williams and Reg Brown began arranging for everyone to pack, taking everything that needed to be taken.
Teacher Jordan and Sara Williams followed Jack Clark into the Cloud Sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253 - 1253 490 Im Running Out of Time Preparing to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1253: Chapter 490 I’m Running Out of Time, Preparing to Leave (Second Update) Chapter 1253: Chapter 490 I’m Running Out of Time, Preparing to Leave (Second Update) Jack Clark held a geography textbook from this world, placing it beneath the large screen in the cockpit, “Cloud Sky, scan the map, compare it with our current coordinates and orientation.”
Upon Jack’s command, a beam of light fell upon the pages, scanning the text and the simple map within, then projecting it onto the large screen.
The map included only the central continent of the Lost World, with the four great empires and a dozen smaller countries. The blinking red dot on the southwestern side of the White Departure Empire was their location.
Jack mused briefly before he drew a line on the big screen, “After this, we’ll cut straight through the southern region of the White Departure Empire and enter the White Lion Empire. After collecting the Cultivation Methods from the library, we’ll cross over this small country and enter the Mysterious Tiger Empire.”
“Then, we’ll take a detour to the capital of the Green Dragon Empire, make a small loop, cover over ten thousand kilometers more, and then enter the Sadolara Forest to head toward the Cavapod Holy Mountain. No problems, right?”
Sara Williams replied respectfully, “No problem. We will follow Mr. Clark’s lead; we have no objections.”
The red line on the map was winding and stretched over sixty thousand kilometers—a distance that not even Sara and her colleagues in the peaceful era could imagine crossing.
Taking a train would mean several months of travel, passing through numerous countries.
It took about an hour for Reg Brown and the others to finish packing; the youths emerged from the base carrying large and small bags, their faces filled with trepidation.
For these youngsters, the weakest of whom was only at level one and the strongest at the early stage of level three, the outside world was very dangerous. A single encounter with a mutant monster or a strong Unique Beast could spell death.
Following Sherry Williams, the youngsters boarded the fighter aircraft. Arthur, at the front, widened his eyes and exclaimed, “It’s so big inside, it looks like a base!”
The Cloud Sky appeared to be only seventy meters long from the outside, but its internal space had expanded to seventeen times that size, with just one rest area big enough to accommodate everyone.
For these youngsters entering the sci-fi-style fighter aircraft for the first time, they forgot their nervousness and stared wide-eyed, excited and thrilled by everything around them.
At that moment, Jack’s faint voice came through the sidewall of the plane, “Sherry, take them to the rest area to rest. Don’t wander around, other areas are for ammunition and the power reactor.”
“Yes, Mr. Clark.”
As soon as everyone (over fifty people) was aboard, the hatch of Cloud Sky closed, and the engines below spewed hot air bursts. Supported by the levitation field, it gradually ascended.
When the altitude reached a hundred meters, a powerful thrust exploded from behind the fighter aircraft, breaking the sound barrier to enter supersonic flight instantly, and the speed kept increasing.
“Look, it’s the clouds.”
“Yeah, it’s flying beautifully.”
“Mr. Clark is so amazing. I wish I had such a cool airplane too.”
On the edge of the aircraft’s resting bay, all the youngsters excitedly gathered at the glass window, watching the rapidly receding clouds outside with exhilaration.
With the guidance of the map, even though it was not precise and only provided a general direction, Jack directed Cloud Sky to enter the maximum flight speed of ten times the speed of sound when they were about ten thousand kilometers away.
He planned to slow down and search cautiously as they neared the White Lion Empire’s capital.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Air exploded in front of the fighter aircraft, traveling at ten times the speed of sound, producing thunderous roars and white shockwaves, with a long tail of light tearing through the clouds behind it.
Roar!
A Giant Beast below, with nearly a hundred meter wingspan, roared, but as soon as it surged towards the sky, the invading fighter aircraft had already disappeared from sight.
At ten times the speed of sound, they had entered the realm of movement typical of Mythical Powerhouses. Even flying giants needed to be at the peak of Level 9 to match this speed.
Plus, flying at an altitude of thirty thousand meters meant that Jack and his companions encountered no monster blockages on their journey.
In less than an hour, the fighter aircraft approached the estimated vicinity of a thousand kilometers from Lion King City in the White Lion Empire, and immediately both speed and altitude began to fall.
The Earth magnified, mountains and rivers sped past, and soon a city appeared in front of Jack and the others.
Roar!
A monster, over sixty meters tall and covered in black scales, looking like a Demon, roared at the slowly descending fighter aircraft from the ruins of the city below.
Furthermore, the appearance of the fighter aircraft attracted the attention of many mutant monsters around, their blood-red eyes staring coldly and cruelly at the invading machine above.
As the fighter aircraft descended to an altitude of one thousand meters, the level eight Demon Tyrant roared, tearing the ground with its arms, the immense strength ripping a skyscraper from the earth.
Boom! In the terrifying power of the Demon Tyrant, the hundred-meter tall building, like a massive cannonball, whipped up a raging wind, howling towards the fighter aircraft in the sky.
Just then, a flash of firelight came from beneath the fighter aircraft. The building that had flown into midair exploded with a roar, its fiery light scattering countless chunks of concrete that rattled down onto the ground.
And in the instant the building was destroyed, a white Light Beam several meters thick burst through the smoke and dust, bombarding the head of the Tyrant with dazzling Radiance.
Boom!
A mushroom cloud, akin to a nuclear explosion, slowly rose under the might of the main cannon, comparable to a strike from the peak of the Ninth Heaven. It swept across half the city in a terrifying blast. The Earth shook, buildings ignited under the high-temperature impact, and mutant monsters within several kilometers let out agonizing screams.
Just one blast had demolished and set half the city ablaze with such astonishing power; the sight left newcomers like Reg Brown and the others utterly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1254 - 1254 490 Im Running Out of Time Preparing to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1254: Chapter 490 I’m Running Out of Time, Preparing to Leave (Third Update) Chapter 1254: Chapter 490 I’m Running Out of Time, Preparing to Leave (Third Update) And what they found even more shocking was that the blow had come from the fighter aircraft beneath them.
The one-armed elder glanced at the indifferent young man with black hair standing hands behind his back near the glass edge, feeling a surge of emotions and an inexplicable shock.
Where exactly did this Mr. Clark come from? Could it be true, as Sara and the others speculated, that he was from a lost ancient civilization?
At that moment, data refreshed on the large screen to the side, and the electronic voice of the Cloud Sky announced, “Advertising information of use detected. Current location: Forest Water City, near Lin River mountain ranges.”
“Based on the location of the mountain ranges, recalculating the position of the Lion King City. Calculation complete, it’s located seven hundred kilometers to the northeast.”
As a grand accomplishment of Blue Star’s current technology, the primary function of the Throne Fighter was to assist rather than combat, after all, even the strongest firepower of a fighter could not compare to its owner who was king-level.
Jack Clark said indifferently, “Depart.”
Hum!
The engine roared as the fighter aircraft once again soared to the skies, heading towards Lion King City seven hundred kilometers away, and soon a city built by the water came into view for everyone.
The Lion King City of the White Lion Empire was even larger and more prosperous than Heaven Mysterious City, with a population that exceeded ten million even before the Doomsday Burst.
But at this time, almost the entire city had become ruins, the earth was shattered, and only a few buildings remained intact. The entire city was eerily quiet with not a single Mutant monster in sight.
Hovering thousands of kilometers above the city in the Cloud Sky, Jack Clark instructed, “Cloud Sky, scan the entire city’s streets and signs for advertisements, looking for the library’s location.”
“Lightwave scanning in progress…”
Soon, under the amazed gazes of the others, a three-dimensional hologram of the city appeared on the big screen.
“Building comparison complete, Lion King City’s building damage has reached sixty-seven percent. Lightwave scanning in progress. No intentional Mutated Creatures detected in the city.”
“Language comparison complete, location of the national library found.”
No sooner had the Cloud Sky finished reporting when Sara Williams, who had seen this spectacle before, suddenly exclaimed in astonishment, “There are no Mutant monsters in Lion King City! How is that possible?”
“Indeed, there aren’t, because those Mutant monsters have all been devoured,” said Jack Clark indifferently, his pupils with their golden vertical slits slowly appearing as he looked towards the edge of the city.
There, the ground had caved in to form a canyon several kilometers long and hundreds of meters wide. Around the canyon, the ground was cracked, and buildings had collapsed as if shattered by some force.
Through Jack’s eyes that could see through the void, he saw a Mutant Beast lurking beneath the earth, over two hundred meters long, resembling an octopus, covered with brown scale armor.
However, calling it similar to an octopus did little justice, especially since its mouth, which took up half its head, was filled with sharp teeth.
The layers upon layers of teeth resembled a vortex that could devour everything, terrifyingly ferocious and sickening to behold.
Jack Clark said slowly, “Miss Williams, you take the others to the library to help me collect the Cultivation Methods. I’ll go outside the city and deal with that Mutant Beast.”
“Yes, Mr. Clark.”
Whoosh!
In a flash, Jack Clark appeared outside the fighter aircraft, his Divine Power allowing him to step through matter unimpeded, and in another step, he appeared above the canyon tens of kilometers away.
Meanwhile, the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet flew directly to the other side of the city, quickly stopping above the library’s square that resembled a forklift alley.
Roar!
Because he did not conceal all his Aura, the very moment Jack Clark appeared above the canyon, the Level 9 Peak Giant Beast underground roared in alarm and fury.
The ground swelled like sea waves, and the earth cracked open as thick, enormous tentacles crushed the rock and shot into the sky, followed by a monstrous mouth that could swallow the heavens.
But before the Giant Beast could fully emerge, an extremely terrifying power was released from Jack Clark. In an instant, Heaven and Earth trembled and the earth roared.
Boom!
A fearsome punch changed the color of the sky. Above the Firmament, the clouds dispersed, forming a hollow expanse several kilometers in diameter, and below the fist imprint, space within several kilometers was distorted and deformed.
Under the force of Unrivaled Domineering Power, even the light was Devoured, creating a black, transparent fist imprint. Below the fist imprint, space appeared as transparent ripples, layered upon layers.
There was no earth-shattering explosion with this punch. Under the concentrated power, the ground let out a dull roar, forming a crater three kilometers in diameter and a kilometer deep.
At the bottom of the crater, the Level 9 Peak Giant Beast had been smashed into oblivion, leaving nothing but a pool of dark red flesh and blood mingled with the dirt.
In front of Jack Clark at that moment, these Gigantic Beasts, which could normally withstand nuclear bombs, were no different from ants—an effortless slap could kill them.
After changing the landscape with one punch and destroying the Gigantic Beast, Jack Clark slowly moved to a hundred meters above the crater, his hand making a grasping motion and then tearing slightly through the air.
Boom!
The steel-hard bottom of the crater trembled and tore open, creating a massive crack with edges of flesh and dirt mixed together.
“So there really isn’t one,” Jack Clark said, somewhat disappointed.
In this world, though creatures had mutated, since their evolution relied solely on flesh and they hadn’t absorbed Heavenly Energy, their bodies did not contain a Life Crystal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255 - 1255 491 Stellar Sun Ancient Coordinates
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1255: Chapter 491 Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates Chapter 1255: Chapter 491 Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates As Jack Clark dealt with the Giant Beast, it seemed he had touched upon a thread of the future—a powerful spatial rejection force Burst forth, forming waves.
Boom!
Invisible rejection shocked the surroundings, space Distorted, but Jack Clark’s figure stood immovable, emanating an aura heavy as a mountain and terrifying.
The rejection force was not very strong, unable to shake Jack Clark, who did not wish to leave yet.
Besides, Jack Clark unexpectedly found that under the Power of Dark Star, his True Body became not only heavier and more solid but also seemed to contain a trace of an ‘unmovable’ essence.
At the same time, Silver Patterns appeared on both sides of Jack Clark’s forehead, like unfolded wings, crazily absorbing the invisible power of time scattered around.
This wave contained an astonishing amount of the Power of Time. As the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power circulated, a lock of hair in front of Jack Clark’s forehead turned white at a visible rate.
Behind him, the illusion of a transparent stream reemerged, and the second phantom slowly became clearer on the stream…
While Jack Clark absorbed the Power of Time, Sara Williams and others had already entered the library, including the excited teenagers following behind.
The library here was just as chaotic: bookshelves toppled, dried-up dark stains of blood and debris everywhere, cobwebs covering everything.
“Everyone, be careful and don’t spread out too far. Let’s find the management directory first and determine the locations of the ancient texts,” Sara Williams instructed.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh! All these cultivators dashed out like leopards, quickly dispersing, and soon fourteen-year-old Ivy Smith cried out excitedly.
“Sister Sara, the directory is here!”
An hour later, when Jack Clark arrived at the library, Sara Williams and the others on the Third Floor had nearly finished their work.
“Mr. Clark, your hair…” Sara Williams said, slightly stunned as she looked at Jack Clark approaching, her gaze lingering on the silver strand of hair at his forehead.
Jack Clark gave a slight smile, “It’s nothing, just a side effect of the Cultivation Method.”
Switching topics, Jack Clark inquired, “How did it go? Are all the Cultivation Methods sorted out?”
“They are all sorted. There are one hundred twenty-three related Cultivation Methods, but most of them are incomplete. Only thirty-one are intact.”
“Among those complete methods, some overlap with the techniques from Heaven Mysterious City. There are three Body Refinement ones, and the rest are the ancient techniques of Qi cultivation and Divine Power, which can’t be practiced.”
“Good job, everyone,” Jack Clark said, acknowledging their efforts.
Packing up the Secret Scripture, the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet soon soared into the sky, heading towards the next empire’s Capital City.
Traveling tens of thousands of kilometers took only a few hours, and the invincible strength displayed by Jack Clark astounded and earned the admiration of the youths like Arthur.
No matter how powerful the Mutant monsters were, they were no match for Jack Clark—in the face of his terrifying punches, the Void shattered, exploding everything in its path with Unrivaled Domination.
However, the library of the Mysterious Tiger Empire had become ruins, all books burnt by a great fire, and at the Green Dragon Empire, they collected over twenty non-overlapping Cultivation Methods.
Over ten thousand years, most of these methods had become incomplete, their lineages broken.
Still, since these methods originated from Mythical-level War Generals, Monarchs, and partial Emperor Inheritance, the fundamental ideas contained within them still held significant value.
“According to the map’s direction, we’ll cross the forest below to reach the Kava Mountain Range, and the holy mountain called Cavapod is deep within the mountain ranges,” Jack Clark observed while standing at the window of the rapidly advancing Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, looking down below.
Standing by Jack Clark’s side and behind him were Sara Williams, Reg Brown, Teacher Jordan, and others, all excitedly watching the fast-receding forest below.
With a trembling voice, Teacher Jordan expressed, “I wonder what the situation down there is like and if any of the explorers are still alive.”
Reg Brown, with his solid build, said gravely, “It’s hard to say. There has been no contact with that region for nearly three years, it’s likely they’ve all perished in some accident.”
Sara Williams was indifferent to the fate of those people; her greater concern was Jack Clark’s impending departure.
Stepping forward, Sara Williams approached Jack Clark, her gaze on his near-perfect profile, puzzled, “Mr. Clark, why does the Lost World reject you?”
Jack Clark replied calmly, “Because I do not belong here.”
Sara Williams fell silent, then could not resist asking, “Although this request may be difficult, Mr. Clark, would you consider staying to help us for the sake of our shared Human Race?”
Sara Williams saw in Jack Clark’s power, akin to that of a God from legends, the hope to end the Doomsday.
Jack Clark responded indifferently, “It’s not that I don’t want to help you, but the more I intervene, the faster I must leave.”
“Right now, what seems like calm energy to you is actually surrounded by a strong force that you cannot perceive, constantly pulling at me.”
Hearing this, Teacher Jordan and Reg Brown both showed disappointment.
Jack Clark did not intend to deceive them, nor was there a need to. Clearly, he could not remain in this world much longer.
Nevertheless, Jack Clark’s appearance had brought them a glimmer of hope: there were worlds beyond this one, where humanity could become as powerful as the God Demons.
If these young ones continued their diligent cultivation, perhaps one day they could reach such realms and usher in humanity’s rise.
With everyone’s hopeful gaze, the fighter jet split the Firmament, and soon a mountain range stretching thousands of kilometers appeared on the horizon.
Following the undulating mountain ranges deep into over a thousand kilometers, a towering mountain peak more than ten thousand meters high, wrapped in Cloud Mist at its mountainside, came into everyone’s view.

chapters.title: Chapter 1256 - 1256 The 491st Stellar Sun Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1256: The 491st Chapter: Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates_2 Chapter 1256: The 491st Chapter: Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates_2 “We’re here, Cloud Sky, circle around the mountain peak and proceed with the scan,”
The dark red fighter aircraft circled around the mountain peak, and quickly discovered an area enveloped by greenery at over six thousand meters high on the snow-covered mountainside.
These plants were neither trees nor grasses but vines, which occupied tens of kilometers of the mountainside.
The vines were emerald green, the long ones measuring thousands to tens of thousands of meters, with the short ones covering everything. Their surfaces were covered with sharp spikes, and they had leaves shaped like swords.
As the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet approached a low altitude of a thousand meters above the mountainside, the vines down below writhed as if they were alive and responded.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh! Vines tens of meters thick and stretching up to ten thousand meters shot up to the heavens like terrifying tentacles sweeping across Heaven and Earth, creating raging winds.
The sudden change startled Sara Williams and the others, “How is this possible? Even plants have mutated.”
A dozen Crystal Energy Missiles were fired from the fighter aircraft’s belly, while its machine guns roared, instantly filling the sky with intense firelight and loud explosions.
Boom boom boom! A dozen missile bombardments made the four green vines that were coiling upwards shake like crazy pythons, twisting violently.
But despite the missile bombardment with the power of intercontinental missiles, the four vines only showed slight surface damage, and the exposed green liquid healed in the blink of an eye.
As for the machine gun cannonballs larger than a hundred millimeters, they were completely blocked by the vine’s armor-like, incredibly tough skin, leaving only fist-sized pits.
This Defense was beyond Level 9.
At this moment data flashed on the big screen, and an electronic voice announced, “Report, Extraordinary energy fluctuations detected deep within the vines, threat level, medium.”
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “I feel it; maintain high altitude circling, I’ll go down and take a look myself.”
In this Dharma Ending World, the emergence of plants comparable to Mythical-level, even if only in ‘physique’, was still somewhat surprising to Jack Clark.
Then there were the rune-like energy fluctuations that flickered deep within the vines, most likely that relic.
As he spoke, Jack Clark’s figure flashed and appeared in the air, his gaze indifferent as he watched the massive vines sweeping toward him. The movement of the vines caused the wind to howl and the air to surge with turbulence.
Boom! The air vibrated, forming a ring of white circular waves.
In front of Jack Clark, a vine about eighty meters thick and ten thousand meters long shook violently, but it was blocked by his single hand, causing the vine to twist and sway under the strong Kinetic Energy.
Under normal conditions, Jack Clark should have penetrated the vines as easily as a nail through tofu.
But within Jack Clark’s palm, there was an invisible and strong force—a manifestation of pure physical strength altering matter—gripping that section of the vine firmly.
Then, Jack Clark’s palm exerted slight pressure and clawed.
Boom!
In an instant, the ten thousand meter long vine was pulled tight, the powerful force transmitted along it caused the vines covering tens of kilometers below to shake, the Earth beneath them to crack and shatter, and countless Ice Crystals and rocks to explode.
It even caused the whole mountain peak to tremble slightly.
Hiss! The sight took everyone’s breath away on the fighter aircraft, such terrifying strength.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
Feeling the intense threat, the vines shook violently, hundreds of thousands of them writhing like pythons in the sky, those longer than a kilometer rose and covered the heavens.
Watching the eerie vines that almost submerged the sky, Jack Clark’s gaze turned cold, “Seeking death.”
Bang bang bang!! Instead of retreating, Jack Clark advanced and transformed into a black ray of Radiance piercing through Heaven and Earth, bursting through the vines at a terrifying speed a hundred times the speed of sound, and finally descending deep into the valley.
Boom! The moment Jack Clark landed, Heaven and Earth trembled, and the Earth collapsed; a ten-kilometer radius of land shattered, with ice, snow, rocks, and dirt shooting into the sky.
The surrounding tough vines quaked under the Destructive Impact, destroyed by Unrivaled Domination, ultimately forming a crater several kilometers in diameter.
At the bottom of the crater, rocks crumbled away, revealing a two-thousand-meter-long warship.
This warship, made of a black wood, resembled a submarine, its surface covered with trails of Ancient Runes, exuding an unbreakable aura.
But at this time, the warship was split in the middle, with many green vine roots entwined around it, some even penetrating deep into the interior of the warship.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
As Jack Clark approached the warship, the entwined roots automatically contracted, clearly afraid of the strength Jack Clark had shown.
“So it has developed a consciousness,” Jack Clark’s gaze settled on the warship’s bow, where a giant hollow had been formed by a powerful force.
At that moment, a root with a diameter of several hundred meters occupied the hollow. The main root of the vine was green and transparent, piercing through the warship and extending deep into the Earth.
As Jack Clark approached, the remaining vines frantically converged, covering half the sky. In their writhing, they seemed like giant pythons exploding the air, the commotion was massive.
But Jack Clark paid no mind to this display of power, the approaching vines continuously retreated, eventually stopping several hundred meters from the main root.
Jack Clark said coldly, “You have two choices, submit or be destroyed by me.”
“Also, I know you can understand me, you have ten seconds to decide, one, two…” As Jack Clark murmured the countdown, terrifying blue lightning flickered in his hand.
Even though the world suppressed the laws of Heavenly Earth, after several days of absorbing the power from the Chaos Void, Jack Clark’s internal Laws’ Origin had restored a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1257 - 1257 The 491st Stellar Sun Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1257: The 491st Chapter: Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates_3 Chapter 1257: The 491st Chapter: Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates_3 At this moment, as he stimulated the Origin Power to manifest the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, a terrifying aura instantly spread out from him as the center.
Boom!
Just as strands of Lightning Law Power appeared in Jack Clark’s hands, the entire world slightly trembled, and endless dark clouds gathered above the Firmament, altering the colors of Heaven and Earth.
In an instant, a powerful Will of Heaven and Earth descended, suppressing the Void with a thunderous sound upon Jack Clark.
However, this Heaven and Earth’s pressure was “very weak,” almost like the pressure of the Ancient Divine Tribulation he’d experienced during his breakthrough to king-level; it couldn’t shake the current Jack Clark in the slightest.
The main root of the vine trembled uncontrollably, the vines danced wildly, and then, without waiting for Jack Clark to speak again, all the vines drooped to the ground, shivering violently.
Seeing this, Jack Clark, who had not counted to three, paused, not expecting this Mutated Vine to be so time-aware.
As the vines were subdued, the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet hovering in the sky began to descend and eventually stopped at the bottom of the large pit formed by Jack Clark’s impact.
However, by the time Sara Williams and others disembarked from the fighter aircraft, Jack Clark had already entered the interior of the Battleship, which was spacious inside, resembling a small town.
But at this time, the interior of the Battleship was in disarray; as Jack Clark followed his perceptions deeper into the rear of the Battleship, he discovered some human and Mutant Monster corpses along the way.
Beyond that, there were areas for human living and research, including some mechanical equipment, but all had been damaged, suggesting that a fierce battle had taken place here.
By the time Jack Clark reached the rear of the Battleship, the only thing he found was a stone platform resembling an altar, five meters tall and shaped like the Eight Diagrams, inscribed with many Ancient Runes.
Apart from that, there was also a ‘recording device’ on the altar with some dried blood on its surface.
Click! Jack Clark pressed the play button on the recording device, but there was no response, “Out of battery?”
After two or three years, the battery inside the recording device had long run out, but this problem was simple.
Crack, crack!!
A faint electrical arc jumped from Jack Clark’s fingertips, landing on the battery he took out with a sizzle, instantly emitting a slight crackling sound.
“This should work now, and if not, I’ll have to take it back to the Cloud Sky to charge,” Jack Clark said while putting the two batteries back in and pressing the switch.
Fizz, fizz!! The recording device emitted a static noise, followed by a deep, hoarse voice of a man.
“Lost Calendar year 9084, July 7th, we have found a complete set of ancient relics, and a significant discovery was made, finding hope for re-cultivation.”
“Lost Calendar year 9085, January 4th, we are sinners of the human race, we opened the Demonic Box, we destroyed the entire world.”
“May 11th, we still have hope; they have succeeded, they can cultivate now. We must make the Cultivation Methods public.”
“Hahaha… Tell everyone in the whole world immediately, we have discovered the hope to save the world, we have found the key to embark on the expedition again.”
“This is bad, the monsters are becoming more numerous, we’ve been sealed inside the relic.”
“Why, why can the altar coordinates not be activated, indicating insufficient energy, what energy is needed to open the connection with the Ancient Legion’s coordinates.”
“We have failed, we are the sinners of all humans in the Lost World.”
“This world has no energy, we’ve been sealed here forever, we, creatures from beyond the stars, are destined to be erased by the Lost World…”
Fizz, fizz, fizz!!
The person who left the recording device had summarily recorded the events ‘that had happened’ over a few years, and the tone went from initial joy and excitement to panic and despair.
When the recording featured nothing but static noise for a long while, Jack Clark pressed the switch again, his gaze settling on the altar with an excited gleam in his eyes.
“Coordinates that can contact the Ancient Legion.”
Taking into account the clues from the Void Relics, the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe civilization, and this place, it was obvious that the Seven Great Emperors who led the main forces of the Ancient Civilization on an expedition still existed.
Although it was unknown how many of the Seven Great Emperors and Monarchs remained after the expeditionary wars of that time.
But as long as they could establish contact with the Ancient Human Race, and as long as a single Civilization Emperor existed, it would turn the tide for Blue Star, directly demolishing the Purgatory Demon Race.
After all, those people had broken through to Monarch level so many years ago, their cultivation would surely be even more terrifying after all this time.
Just as Jack Clark’s hand reached towards the altar coordinates, intending to take them into his Space Bracelet, the Space-Time power surrounding him erupted more violently than ever before.
Boom!
A terrifying expulsion force reflecting upon Space-Time emerged, distorting the surrounding Void around Jack Clark as a long river that traversed past and future roared into existence.
An instinctive feeling told Jack Clark that just one step closer, and he would be swept into the violent Space-Time Chaos instantly.
This outcome made Jack Clark frown before he slowly withdrew his hand, deciding to give up, and immediately the violent Space-Time expulsion force weakened around him.
He still had some matters to take care of and couldn’t leave just yet; even if he wanted to try, he would wait until every preparation was made.
By the time Jack Clark returned to the broken entrance in the middle of the Battleship, Sara Williams, Teacher Jordan, Reg Brown, and others were already excitedly surveying their surroundings.
“Mr. Clark,” recognizing the approaching Jack Clark, everyone bowed respectfully.
Jack Clark spoke calmly, “I’ve already checked this place; no one survived and no monsters. Apart from that, there are a lot of living supplies, enough to last you several years.”
“As for that Mutated Vine outside, I’ve subdued it. It won’t pose a threat to you for the time being.”
“As for what to do next and any plans, handle them yourselves. I’m going to cultivate, don’t disturb me unless absolutely necessary.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1258 - 1258 491 The Stellar Sun Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1258: Chapter 491 The Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates_4 Chapter 1258: Chapter 491 The Stellar Sun, Ancient Coordinates_4 “Yes, Mr. Clark.”
After briefly explaining the situation, Jack Clark’s figure flashed and appeared at the snow-covered holy mountain peak.
Atop the Ice Crystal-covered mountain peak, Jack Clark sat cross-legged, taking out all twenty-eight body-refining techniques that he had collected.
Among these techniques, there were six complete ones, including the Great Sun True Body as well as the Mysterious Light Holy Body, the Purple Thunder War Body, the Broken Star Overlord Body, the Azure Dragon Nine Changes, and the Heavenly Gate Divine Body.
All body-refining techniques had nine levels; when fully mastered, one could cultivate up to the Ninth Heaven Peak. As for becoming a myth, one would need to forge their own path, as the techniques could no longer guide you.
Jack Clark did not begin cultivating immediately but picked up each technique to flip through them, imprinting all content in his mind, including the twenty-two incomplete techniques.
After he had gone through all the techniques, Jack Clark slowly closed his eyes, the content and diagrams of the Great Sun True Body he first received emerged in his mind, as he once again adjusted the muscles and meridians inside his body, simulating the bodies of ancient humans.
A minute later, a Qi Blood that was hot like the sunlight’s radiance gathered on Jack Clark’s body, directly entering the first level of the Great Sun True Body.
Given Jack Clark’s current realm and combined with his previous experience in cultivating various body-refining techniques, cultivating these techniques was as easy as drinking water.
The issue of conflicting Qi Blood strengths after cultivating the techniques was also nonexistent because these transcendent techniques couldn’t even shake the true body of the Combat Divine Body.
“Consume 100 Attribute Points to strengthen to the Great Sun True Body Second Layer.”
Jack Clark had no time for slow cultivation, so he chose to consume attribute points to enhance the technique. Accompanied by a thought, the hot Qi Blood inside his body burst instantly.
With the attribute enhancement, Jack Clark’s aura ‘exploded,’ directly breaking through to the second layer of the technique, and the hot aura like the sunlight on his body intensified.
“Consume Attribute Points to strengthen the Great Sun True Body to the ninth level.”
In an instant, the attribute points went from 35917 to 30217, a total of five thousand seven hundred points consumed, and instantly Jack Clark’s body’s hot Qi Blood exploded, transforming into countless golden radiance piercing his whole body.
Boom!
The Great Sun Breath and Blood exploded rapidly on Jack Clark’s body, instantly breaking through the third layer, the fourth layer, and the surrounding hundred meters of sunlight energy converged on Jack Clark.
As the sunlight above converged, strands of overbearing hot energy penetrated Jack Clark’s skin being tempered by the wildly circulating Qi Blood inside his body, growing stronger and burning fiercely.
Boom! Jack Clark’s aura ‘surged’ again, breaking through the fifth level, and soon the sixth level, and the seventh layer.
In an instant, a layer of white flame began to burn on Jack Clark’s body, emitting a terrifying high temperature, melting the surrounding Ice Layer, with steam rising.
As the Great Sun True Body broke through to the Seventh Layer, sunlight from a kilometer radius converged on Jack Clark, forming a golden light beam enveloping him, making him appear incredibly divine.
Under the increasingly scorching tempering of the Great Sun Qi Blood inside, Jack Clark keenly felt his physique slightly enhanced.
And as the Great Sun True Body broke through to the eighth layer under the Attribute Energy enhancement, the white flames on Jack Clark’s body exploded, fiercely burning several meters high.
The intense firelight behind him vaguely formed a white Sun Illusion as if it was a corona, his black hair wildly dancing under it, making him appear even more majestic, with sunlight within three kilometers converging towards him.
An infinite amount of sunlight energy poured in, and the white flames burning on Jack Clark grew even more vigorous, expanding, and fiercely jetting up more than ten meters high.
Jack Clark’s body erupted with an ‘Overbearing’ aura of the Nine Layers, and in that instant, the sun in the sky seemed to shine brighter, with sunlight from tens of kilometers converging toward him.
Boom!
The Sun Illusion behind Jack Clark blazed with radiance, from illusion to reality, like a white Stellar Sun dozens of meters in diameter, releasing endless light and heat.
Instantly under the terrifying high temperatures, the accumulated snow on the mountain summit melted, the Ice Layer shattered, and then the entire mountain peak shook, unleashing a snow avalanche that covered a hundred kilometers.
In the midst of the earth-shaking avalanche, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, revealing a trace of astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1259 - 1259 492 Tearing Through the World Spacetime
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1259: Chapter 492: Tearing Through the World, Spacetime Descent Chapter 1259: Chapter 492: Tearing Through the World, Spacetime Descent As Jack Clark cultivated the Great Sun True Body to the ninefold grand accomplishment realm, he discovered that his body had gained a new ability, absorbing sunlight.
This ‘sunlight’ doesn’t merely refer to the radiance emitted by the sun, a star in the Solar System; it also includes the sun suspended in the heavens of the mythical world, as well as the sunlight of this world.
This ability originates from the Great Sun True Body technique.
Starting from the Second Layer, he absorbed sunlight to strengthen his body, directly ignited the Qi Blood’s fire to temper the flesh at the Fourth Layer, and formed Solar True Fire at the Seventh Layer.
Step by step, tempering the flesh, changing the physique, he gained the innate ability to absorb solar energy, similar to the ability of the Dark Star Rune to absorb metals and heavy elements.
Clearly, after cultivating a body refining technique to grand accomplishment, the characteristic of gaining innate traits is not unique to the Dark Star Body Refining Method but is central to all ancient body refining techniques.
Unlike cultivating qi to the ninth tier to control laws, ancient body refining techniques pursue the path of innate divine powers, focusing differently on either qi cultivation or body refinement.
And unlike the techniques of ancient civilizations, the True Martial of Blue Star follows a path that combines both aspects.
Before the Seventh Layer Heaven, it pays more attention to body refinement; after the Seventh Layer Heaven, it forms the true martial arts phantom, integrates the phantom at the Eight Layer to reshape the True Body, until reaching the domain of the Ninth Layer, the Rule True Body.
In such cases, Human Kings with both Rule Power and strong True Bodies are incredibly formidable, but they are also not extreme or pure enough to cultivate divine powers.
The reason Jack Clark could master the three divine powers of strength, defense, and speed is because of the innate runes from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Of course, there is no stronger or weaker between the techniques of the ancient civilization and those of the Blue Star Human Race, but rather each has chosen different paths; True Martial is more suited to the Blue Star Human Race.
Moreover, the path of the Genetic True Martial, which combines man and beast, leads to mastery of monstrous innate talents in the later stages, similar to the ancient body refining methods.
However, these are not the most important concerns, as Jack Clark discovered that he could use these body refining techniques to gain several talents with special abilities.
Under normal conditions, these talents wouldn’t help the current Jack Clark much.
For example, the talent of absorbing sunlight he acquired this time only converts energy at one-thousandth the rate the Demon God’s Body absorbs energy from the Chaos Void per minute.
Even the perfected Great Sun True Body only increased Jack Clark’s strength marginally, equivalent to the ‘strength’ of a Nine-fold Peak cultivator, barely a bonus.
However, if Jack Clark were to push it to its Limit Enhancement and transform it into a Talent Rune, fusing it with the Combat Divine Body to evolve into a Divine Power, his combat prowess would greatly increase.
Especially during the fusion process, divine powers and laws with matching attributes can meld, leading to more terrifying Laws Mystery Divine Power.
For example, the Solar True Fire Divine Power and the Higher-order Law Great Sun Heaven Flame both belong to the flame category, and combined with the shared ‘solar’ attribute, perhaps it could ascend to become a Supreme power.
Sigh! Jack Clark slowly exhaled, suppressing the excitement in his heart as his gaze fell upon the remaining five complete ancient techniques.
The Mysterious Light Holy Body has a total of nine levels, inherited from a mythically powerful ancient War General; upon reaching grand accomplishment, it yields the innate protective Mysterious Light with unrivaled defense.
This Mysterious Light, if evolved into a Divine Power and overlapped with the Absolute Barrier and the World’s Power, will form an even more terrifying defensive force, outright ignoring attacks from enemies of the same tier.
