The Purple Thunder War Body is inherited from the Monarch Lord of Thunder of the ancient civilization, complementing the Thunder Prison True Body obtained by Damon Lopes; reaching the ninth level grants the innate True Thunder Divine Power.
The Broken Star Overlord Body is inherited from one of the ancient thirty-six Monarchs, the Lord of Catastrophe, providing a crushing innate ability with unmatched brute strength upon great completion.
This talent could be merged with the explosive property of the Dragon Elephant True Strength obtained during the breakthrough of the Four Layer Heaven, evolving into an even more powerful crushing explosion Divine Power.
With each release of strength comes a destructive explosive force.
The Azure Dragon Nine Changes technique is somewhat special; it requires cultivators to have Dragon Bloodline, and each breakthrough brings about a dragonic transformation, each one doubling the cultivator’s strength.
Upon reaching the great realm of the Ninth Level, after nine transformations, the cultivator’s strength will be over five hundred times higher than their peers, sweeping aside all with ease.
Furthermore, it grants the innate ability to transform into an Azure Heaven Dominant Dragon in human form; if Jack Clark were to cultivate and evolve it into—
As for the last Heavenly Gate Divine Body technique, it is relatively ordinary; reaching grand accomplishment opens a Heavenly Gate within the body, capable of storing a lifetime’s worth of energy.
When power is depleted in battle, opening the Heavenly Gate instantly restores peak strength, akin to having a second ‘dantian’.
Glancing at the remaining thirty thousand Attribute Points, Jack Clark gave up on immediately pushing the Great Sun True Body to its limit to test the Sun Rune, and instead the content of Azure Dragon Nine Changes emerged in his mind.
With but a slight concentration, a faint Dragon Might emerged from Jack, forming a dragon-shaped Qi Blood.
“Spend 100 Points Attribute, strengthen Azure Dragon Nine Changes Second Layer…”
“Spend Points Attribute, strengthen Azure Dragon Nine Changes Third Layer, Fourth Layer…” Boom! Boom! Boom! As the Points Attribute rapidly depleted, Jack’s aura became more and more magnificent.
When the breakthrough to the ninth level occurred, the massive and vast aqua-golden Qi Blood converged, faintly forming an Azure Dragon Phantom over a hundred meters long behind him.
Mountains shook beneath the invisible but overbearing pressure, and raging winds howled.
While Jack Clark was in closed-door cultivation, Sara Williams and the others on the mountainside were also busy, organizing supplies.
“We’ve found a high-frequency signal tower here, as well as a radio for the exploration team to contact the outside world, but the radio is somewhat damaged and can’t be used.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1260 - 1260 492 Tearing Apart the World and Leaving
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1260: Chapter 492: Tearing Apart the World and Leaving, Space-Time Descent_2 Chapter 1260: Chapter 492: Tearing Apart the World and Leaving, Space-Time Descent_2 “Teacher Jordan, most of the dried meat, canned goods, and vegetables stored in the cold storage are still edible, pretty much as Mr. Clark said, enough to last us a few years,”
At this, smiles appeared on everyone’s faces; food was the scarcest resource in the apocalypse.
Although it was possible to hunt Unique Beasts for their flesh and blood, it also came with great danger. The outside world was teeming with powerful Mutated Creatures, and a moment of inattention could lead to casualties.
As for farming, there was no point in discussing it. With cities having fallen, there were no seeds and no suitable land to till, so what could possibly be planted?
“What a pity, the research equipment is severely damaged, and all the data have been destroyed…”
…
Atop the Mountain Peak, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, which were cold and profound, as if a deity high above was looking down upon all living beings.
As the remaining thirty thousand Attribute points were exhausted, Jack also cultivated the remaining five Body Refining Techniques to the ninth level, making his Aura even more elusive.
Although for the current Jack, cultivating six Body Refining Techniques to the Nine Layers did not significantly boost his strength, the five additional talent abilities he gained were a pleasant surprise.
With this thought, Jack’s gaze fell on the attribute page.
Cultivation Methods: Great Sun True Body[Ninth Level, talent acquired, solar energy absorption, Qi Blood coalescing into Solar True Fire, intensely Overbearing]
Mysterious Light Holy Body[Ninth Level, talent acquired, Protective Mysterious Light]
Purple Thunder War Body[Ninth Level, talent acquired, Divine Thunder of the Firmament]
Broken Star Overlord Body[Ninth Level, talent acquired, Crushing Strength]
Azure Dragon Nine Changes[Ninth Level, talent acquired, Azure Heaven Dominant Dragon]
Heavenly Gate Divine Body[Ninth Level, talent acquired, Door of a Lifetime]
Due to a lack of Attribute points, the six Cultivation Methods would have to wait for Limit Enhancement back in the real world, and then the rules would be combined and the Secret Book recast.
Once Jack successfully integrated various Divine Powers and rules, his strength would skyrocket. As soon as he made the breakthrough to Heavenly King, he could Reverse Defeat the Demon God.
This Reverse Defeating wasn’t about brute force, but about slaying.
However, these tasks had to be temporarily postponed. While he could still stay in this world for a few more days, he needed to first perfect and create the framework for the ‘Basic Body Refining’ technique.
Creating a Body Refining Technique that everyone could practice, allowing all of humanity to step into the Transcendent, was Jack’s initial goal in collecting Ancient Body Refining Techniques.
But achieving this was no easy feat.
Squeak, squeak!
Jack’s right hand, wielding a sword, struggled to slice his left palm, forcing out a drop of purple-gold blood. As soon as the blood left his palm, it floated in midair, radiating halo after halo and terrifying energy fluctuations.
Puff! The blood, imbued with Jack’s Divine Soul Intent, dispersed into a rich blood mist before converging to form a human figure; flesh and blood began to derive.
Soon, a body similar in appearance to Jack, and with physical strength comparable to the Fourth Layer Heaven, materialized out of thin air, like a miraculous creation from Heavenly Production.
This was the terrifying nature of Jack’s True Body at that moment—practically capable of rebirth from a drop of blood, as long as his Divine Soul remained unextinguished.
Jack’s mind whirred at an astonishing speed, combining the experiential knowledge of practicing seven complete Body Refining Techniques, and very quickly, a basic framework emerged in his mind.
Once the first layer’s basics were perfected, Jack moved his will, beginning to test it within the experimental body, first step sensing Blood Qi, second step condensing Blood Qi, third step circulating…
Bang, bang, bang!! The test body’s arms, abdomen’s three blood vessels burst open directly, spraying blood mist.
Suddenly, Jack frowned, “The Upper Burner is wrong, the Qi Blood conflicts with the meridians, it needs adjustment.”
Bang, bang!! The test body’s shoulder meridians exploded…
While Jack was slowly experimenting with the technique, the repulsive force of space-time surrounding him grew stronger and more tangible with time taking on an almost physical form.
From a distance, the seated Jack was surrounded by a vaguely visible, translucent river, with the flow of time within it, and a silver mark on his forehead, resembling twin wings, growing increasingly luminous.
Under the Time Reincarnation Mark, the third strand of Jack’s hair on his forehead gradually turned silver, his presence became heavier, so heavy that the surrounding space vibrated.
Soon, three days passed.
The mountainside, where Jack had created a several-kilometer-wide crater with a single strike, had been roughly leveled into a square. On the field, over thirty youths were earnestly practicing cultivation.
At the opening in the mountain wall where half of the Battleship was visible, several young men were hammering away, using the same type of ‘wood’ stored within the ship to patch up the cracks.
Just then, the green vines encircling the Battleship and the crater shook, resembling an array of Dust Serpents as they parted to reveal a pathway.
There, the black-haired Jack Clark, now with three strands of silver hair at his forehead, appeared out of nowhere. With each step a flash, he arrived in front of everyone in a blink of an eye.
In front of those youths, overseeing their practice, Sherry Williams was instantly surprised and delighted, “Mr. Clark, you’ve emerged from seclusion.”
Jack merely nodded slightly, “Yes, I’ve finished. How are your sister and the others?”
Sherry answered respectfully, “My sister is repairing a radio at the fore-end of the Battleship. Teacher Jordan and the others are inside, studying some of the materials left by the exploration team, especially the journals concerning the virus.”
“Your sister knows how to fix radios,” Jack said, a little surprised.
Sherry said proudly, “Before the apocalypse, my sister was a gifted student who got into the Continent’s Top University at sixteen. Fixing a radio is just a matter of reading the manual for her.”
Alright, a true scholar indeed.
Jack instructed directly, “Call your sister down for me, I have some matters to delegate.”
Sherry hesitated for a moment, slightly nervous, “Mr. Clark, please wait a moment.”
Sherry harnessed her Qi Blood, turning into a red afterimage as she dashed toward the Battleship. After the girl left, Jack’s gaze fell upon the massive Mutated Vines.

chapters.title: Chapter 1261 - 1261 492 Tearing Apart the World and Leaving
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1261: Chapter 492: Tearing Apart the World and Leaving, Space-Time Descent_3 Chapter 1261: Chapter 492: Tearing Apart the World and Leaving, Space-Time Descent_3 While he was here, he could naturally deter this mutated plant which had reached the peak of Level 9, with a physique as strong as that of an ordinary legend.
But once he left, the strongest among them, such as Sara Williams at the peak of the Fifth Tier, would not stand a chance in front of this mutated plant. A mere vine could crush them with ease.
Lost in thought, Jack Clark watched as Sara Williams, dressed in a blue worker’s uniform, rushed out of the battleship with Sherry Williams trailing behind her.
Sara’s gaze was complex as she looked at the resplendent young man, her voice soft, “Mr. Clark, are you leaving?”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “I plan to teach you the complete Great Sun True Body before I leave, so that even if I’m gone, you’ll have the strength to protect yourselves.”
“I estimate I can stay for one more day, during which you can ask me any questions about cultivation.”
These top-tier Body Refining Techniques that aim for the peak of the Ninth Heavens and point directly at the Legendary Realm are generally not something ordinary people can practice, as the requirements for each are extremely strict.
For instance, the Great Sun True Body requires cultivators to have fire talent, as well as a sturdy body capable of withstanding the Tempering of the Solar True Fire.
However, the sisters Sara and Sherry Williams had already cultivated the Red Sun Technique to the fourth and fifth levels, their Qi Blood was like the Red Sun, and their physiques were strong enough to switch to cultivating the Great Sun True Body.
The same was true for other survivors who had cultivated the Red Sun Technique to the fourth level; they too could switch to the Great Sun True Body.
Sara Williams nodded solemnly, her expression filled with gratitude, “Mr. Clark, I thank you for your generosity.”
Sherry Williams, too, was somewhat excited, “Thank you, Mr. Clark.”
To the sisters’ gratitude, Jack Clark just shook his head slightly, “You’re welcome.”
His kindness to Sara and Sherry Williams was naturally not because they were beautiful nor did he have any designs on them, but rather as ‘repayment’ to them.
After descending into the unknown space-time and gaining the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power, solidifying three Marks of Time, Jack Clark became increasingly sensitive to the past, present, and future.
He vaguely felt that his descent this time was not an accident but a predestined past from the unfathomable mysteries of the universe.
“Now sit tight and don’t resist.”
“Yes.”
Upon Jack’s request, the sisters sat cross-legged on a stone at the edge of the area while Ivy Smith and other youths watched nervously and curiously from a distance, not daring to make a sound.
Under the watchful eyes of Teacher Jordan and others who had arrived later, Jack Clark placed a palm directly on top of Sara Williams’ head.
Boom! Instantly, Sara’s consciousness vibrated, her head throbbed with pain, as if something had entered her body.
[There are still more than two thousand words left unedited, brothers, please wait half an hour]
Jack Clark’s spirit projected into their Sea of Consciousness, and in an instant, the internal Cultivation Methods began to change.
Yet, these Cultivation Methods all had some alterations, being an experiment between the physiques of the Ancient Human Race and the current residents of Blue Star as Jack imparted them.
“This is Arthur and Ivy Smith.”
Sitting before Jack, they discussed cultivation issues.
Watching the silhouette of the young man on the edge of the snowy cliff, Sara and Sherry Williams’ eyes were filled with gratitude.
At the edge of the altar coordinates, Jack turned back to Sara Williams and the others, “Next, I’ll create a pathway for you.”
“Leading to the mythical world. You can only enter after cultivating to the eighth layer. It is more dangerous there, with Level 8 and Level 9 Giant Beasts everywhere, and myths abound.”
Boom!
Terrifying Power erupted, tearing space and the World Crystal Wall, as Jack Clark directly ripped open a huge pathway to the mythical world.
In an instant, the oppressive power of the world bore down.
Boom! Jack Clark revealed a three-hundred-meter-tall Three-Faced Six-Armed True Body, his Terrifying Power so overwhelming that even the rules of the Lost World could not suppress it.
This was the might of a battler nearly equal to a Heavenly King at his peak.
But as Jack released such Terrifying Power and tore through the cracks in space, a violent storm of spacetime rejection attacked, and he was swept into it instantly.
He didn’t retrieve the coordinates because he couldn’t.
Before leaving, Jack looked back at Sara Williams and the others and nodded slightly to them. He felt they would meet again, then disappeared without a trace.
The intense energy of the mythical world flowed in, leaving everyone in shock. The whole base vibrated, and they all felt their strength increasing with every breath.
“There is hope now.”
“Crackle! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain; we’ve discovered the method to save the world. All survivors are welcome to come.”
“Crackle! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain; we’ve discovered the method to save the world. All survivors are welcome to come…”
The signal from the signal tower echoed across the central continent, and the radios of many Survivor Bases that had been silent for two years sprang to life.
The message left everyone in surprise, excitement, shock, and amazement.
Soon, some smaller Survivor Bases began to relocate, and larger ones sent out elite teams to Cavapod Holy Mountain to investigate.
Jack Clark’s spirit projected into their Sea of Consciousness, and in an instant, the internal Cultivation Methods began to change.
Yet, these Cultivation Methods all had some alterations, being an experiment between the physiques of the Ancient Human Race and the current residents of Blue Star as Jack imparted them.
“This is Arthur and Ivy Smith.”
Sitting before Jack, they discussed cultivation issues.
Watching the silhouette of the young man on the edge of the snowy cliff, Sara and Sherry Williams’ eyes were filled with gratitude.
At the edge of the altar coordinates, Jack turned back to Sara Williams and the others, “Next, I’ll create a pathway for you.”
“Leading to the mythical world. You can only enter after cultivating to the eighth layer. It is more dangerous there, with Level 8 and Level 9 Giant Beasts everywhere, and myths abound.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1262 - 1262 492 Tearing the World Apart to Leave
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1262: Chapter 492: Tearing the World Apart to Leave, Space-Time Descent_4 Chapter 1262: Chapter 492: Tearing the World Apart to Leave, Space-Time Descent_4 Boom!
Under the eruption of terrifying power, space tore apart, the World Crystal Wall split open, and Jack Clark himself ripped open a massive pathway connecting to the mythical world.
Instantly, the violent World’s Power bore down oppressively.
Boom! Jack Clark manifested a three hundred meter tall, Three-Faced Six-Armed True Body, his terrifying power so immense that not even the rules of the Lost World could suppress it, it was extreme terror.
This was the terrifying combat strength comparable to the peak of a Heavenly King.
However, as Jack Clark unleashed such terrifying power and tore asunder the cracks, an overbearing space-time rejection storm instantly swept in, engulfing Jack Clark directly.
He didn’t go for the coordinates because he couldn’t.
Before departing, Jack Clark looked back at Sara Williams and the others, nodded slightly at them, feeling that there was still an opportunity to meet again, then he vanished without a trace.
Under the surge of extremely rich energy from the mythical world, everyone was stunned, the entire base vibrated, and within a breath, they all felt their strength increasing.
“There’s hope now.”
“Zzzt!! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain, we have already mastered the method to save the world, all survivors are welcome to come.”
“Zzzt!! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain, we have already mastered the method to save the world, all survivors are welcome to come…”
The signal sent from the signal tower reverberated across the entire central continent, bringing many Survivor Bases’ radios that had been silent for two years to life.
The content astonished everyone, causing surprise, excitement, shock, and almost disbelief.
Soon, some of the smaller Survivor Bases began migrating, and the larger Survivor Bases also dispatched elite squads to Cavapod Holy Mountain to investigate.
Jack Clark’s spirit sent into their Sea of Consciousness, and in an instant, the Cultivation Methods within them began to circulate remotely.
However, these Cultivation Methods all had a certain change, a hybrid between the physique of the Ancient Human Race and the current Blue Star physique; Jack Clark was also experimenting while imparting these Cultivation Methods to them.
“This Arthur, Ivy Smith.”
Sitting cross-legged in front of Jack Clark, discussing cultivation issues.
Looking at the youthful figure at the edge of the snowy cliffside, Sherry Williams and Sherry Williams’ eyes were filled with gratitude.
At the edge of the altar’s coordinates, turning back to Sara Williams and the others, “I will open up a pathway for you soon.”
“Leading to the mythical world, only after reaching the eighth layer can you enter, it’s more dangerous there than here, with level eight and Level 9 Behemoths everywhere, myths all over the place.”
Boom!
Under the eruption of terrifying power, space tore apart, the World Crystal Wall split open, and Jack Clark himself ripped open a massive pathway connecting to the mythical world.
Instantly, the violent World’s Power bore down oppressively.
Boom! Jack Clark manifested a three hundred meter tall, Three-Faced Six-Armed True Body, his terrifying power so immense that not even the rules of the Lost World could suppress it, it was extreme terror.
This was the terrifying combat strength comparable to the peak of a Heavenly King.
However, as Jack Clark unleashed such terrifying power and tore asunder the cracks, an overbearing space-time rejection storm instantly swept in, engulfing Jack Clark directly.
He didn’t go for the coordinates because he couldn’t.
Before departing, Jack Clark looked back at Sara Williams and the others, nodded slightly at them, feeling that there was still an opportunity to meet again, then he vanished without a trace.
Under the surge of extremely rich energy from the mythical world, everyone was stunned, the entire base vibrated, and within a breath, they all felt their strength increasing.
“There’s hope now.”
“Zzzt!! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain, we have already mastered the method to save the world, all survivors are welcome to come.”
“Zzzt!! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain, we have already mastered the method to save the world, all survivors are welcome to come…”
The signal sent from the signal tower reverberated across the entire central continent, bringing many Survivor Bases’ radios that had been silent for two years to life.
The content astonished everyone, causing surprise, excitement, shock, and almost disbelief.
Soon, some of the smaller Survivor Bases began migrating, and the larger Survivor Bases also dispatched elite squads to Cavapod Holy Mountain to investigate.

chapters.title: Chapter 1263 - 1263 493 Blazing a Trail of Hope Treading
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1263: Chapter 493: Blazing a Trail of Hope, Treading Through Time and Departing Chapter 1263: Chapter 493: Blazing a Trail of Hope, Treading Through Time and Departing As the three-faced, six-armed, Fighting Demon God True Body clad in ferocious black-red war armor emerged towering three hundred meters tall, an intensely powerful will that could shake the world shot up into the sky in an instant.
Boom!
The terrifying will caused the clouds to disperse, creating rings of solidified white waves that swept across all directions, forming a hollow hundreds of kilometers across.
Surrounding Jack Clark, dazzling blue thunder flickered while golden flames burned on his six arms and shoulders, emitting a scorching heat capable of melting the Void.
Amidst the crackling thunder and burning flames, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, his four arms behind him forming hand seals, slightly raised, as if supporting the spinning platinum light wheel above him.
This scene was like a supreme deity descending from ancient times, an awe-inspiring and grand aura filling Heaven and Earth, making countless living creatures tremble within a thousand-kilometer radius under its suppressive force.
In the Boundless Forest, some Level 9 Giant Beasts, whose bodies had stretched hundreds of meters long through physical Evolution, trembled without daring to move.
Especially that Mutated Vine, its main root quivering, and countless branches covering tens of kilometers lay like limp pythons on the ground, not daring to stir.
But what was most shocking were Teacher Jordan and others, along with those youths who had arrived in the square early to begin cultivation—they were all astounded and looked reverently toward the direction of the battleship’s head.
They gazed at the towering figure enshrouded in Thunderflame like a god or demon.
Teacher Jordan’s voice trembled with excitement, unable to believe, “This, this is the legendary divine visage, Mr. Clark is indeed a strong man from the ancient Human Race, a deity!!”
Sherry Williams, too, was awoken by the shock, her gaze passing through the lifted roof and landing on the vast three-faced and six-armed figure in the distance, overcome with awe, “So, so huge…”
Meanwhile, in front of Jack Clark, Sara Williams was dumbfounded, her size smaller than Jack’s fingernail, trembling as she lifted her head, yet she could only see the roaring thunder and flames.
At this moment, although Jack had revealed his True Body, he had contained a portion of his oppressive force, or else those like Sara Williams, who were not high-order Body Refiners, would have been directly killed by the crushing pressure of the collapsing space at such close range.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Just then, Heaven and Earth violently trembled, and above the Firmament, endless dark clouds converged, instantly covering thousands of kilometers, with the black clouds churning as dazzling purple lightning roared within.
As the clouds gathered, a desolate and supreme will descended as though it were the will of the Heavenly Dao, causing countless Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts to instinctively let out mournful cries.
Following Jack Clark’s release of all his strength breaking the suppression of the Heavenly Earth Rules, he triggered an instinctive reaction from the Lost World.
Similar to a Heavenly Calamity, it sought to kill or expel him, the outsider who had exceeded the world’s limit of strength.
In the sky, choked with thick dark clouds, endless purple lightning erupted, illuminating Heaven and Earth. At the center of the bright purple radiance, a column of thunder descended from the sky.
Boom!
Several hundred meters thick and radiating with the ultimate purple light, the thunder column pierced the heavens and the earth. The invisible and pervasive Destructive Aura made everyone feel despair.
If this thunder column, imbued with Heaven and Earth’s Will, were to fall, it would have the power to obliterate Cavapod Holy Mountain completely and erase everything within a hundred-kilometer radius in an instant.
“Begone!” A cold voice thundered across Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
A Black-gold battle halberd Shadow, surrounded by chains of Death, Void, Soul, Thunder, and Flames—five laws—burst forth, radiating brilliant light.
Empowered by the burning power of the five Higher-order Law sources, the halberd Shadow swelled to thousands of meters in length in an instant, like a mountain range stretching across Heaven and Earth.
The rising halberd and the thunder column intersected tens of thousands of meters in the high altitude.
Boom!
In an instant, the sky appeared to have a second sun, as the two terrifying forces collided, creating a multicolored sphere with rings of purple lightning swirling around, a staggering scene.
But as the sphere expanded to several kilometers in a moment, it burst open, discharging infinite purple, blue, and black radiance as the Void collapsed, and everything was annihilated by the Destructive Impact.
Cavapod, rising more than ten thousand meters high, was directly shattered down the middle, with rocks, snow, and dirt layers melting away.
The heavy dark clouds in the sky also dispersed under the infinite light, immediately forming an atmospheric hollow hundreds of kilometers across, with the surrounding Cloud Mist surging in all directions like a Tsunami.
And as the world-destroying impact erupted, sweeping across the land causing mountains to crumble and the earth to split, an invisible domain power spread from Jack Clark, enveloping the mountainside.
Even so, Sara and the others felt their brains trembling and their ears ringing endlessly as the entire Earth shook wildly, like the undulating waves of the sea.
It took more than ten minutes for the terrifying explosion to subside. Sara and the others, their mouths agape, watched incredulously at their surroundings.
The towering Cavapod Holy Mountain, with their surroundings as the boundary, was entirely gone. At the same time, at the foundation of half the mountain, a hundred-kilometer expanse of forest and ground had been wiped clean, the Earth stripped of a layer.
The trees hundreds of kilometers away were mostly knocked down, broken, and engulfed in flames, with billowing black smoke rising into the sky as if Doomsday had arrived.
Meanwhile, high above at an altitude of ten thousand meters, a Black Hole over a kilometer in diameter emerged, surrounded by countless Black Cracks, wriggling hundreds and thousands of kilometers.
The clash between Jack Clark’s ‘full strength’ strike and the Power of Heaven and Earth of the Lost World resulted in the collapse of the space and the creation of a Black Hole that penetrated deep into the World Crystal Wall.
Inside the Black Hole, the turbulent forces of five Higher-order Laws lingered, hindering the space from self-repair.
Although this world was in the Dharma Ending Age, with the Heavenly Earth Rules suppressing all transcendent powers, when Jack Clark burned the little Law Power he had recovered in past days, he directly shattered the suppression of Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1264 - 1264 493 Blazing a Trail of Hope Treading
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1264: Chapter 493: Blazing a Trail of Hope, Treading Through Time and Departing_2 Chapter 1264: Chapter 493: Blazing a Trail of Hope, Treading Through Time and Departing_2 Although it would be a terrifying consumption of energy that could only be maintained for a short period, it didn’t matter anymore because he was about to leave.
While everyone was shocked and lost in thought, Jack Clark slightly lowered his head to look at Sara Williams and the others, his deep and authoritative voice slowly ringing out, “I’ll make a move shortly, to forge a pathway for you to the mythical world.”
“However, the vast world is boundless and even more dangerous than here, with level eight and level nine Giant Beasts and even Mythical Giant Beasts everywhere. Therefore, you should reach at least the eighth rank before you go.”
“That altar is an ancient coordinate. After you enter the vast world and activate the altar, it can guide you back onto the ancient path.”
Without waiting for their response, enveloped in Thunderflame, Jack Clark, holding his War Halberd, already took a step, shattering the Void and plunging into the depths of the Void behind the black hole.
Boom!
Exactly when Jack Clark entered the black hole, the Void trembled, as if he hadn’t entered a ‘small point’ of three hundred meters, but a massive entity.
But the Lost World reacted violently too. As Jack Clark charged into the depths of the Void, a mighty repulsion force burst forth from deep within the world.
In an instant, the Void fluctuated wildly, with space fragments imbued with the Will of Heaven and Earth forming a black storm that swept over towards Jack Clark from all directions.
Thump thump thump!!
Jack Clark stood like a reef stone against the Ocean of Destruction, letting the Destruction Storm wash over him without moving. Around him, five chains of law wound around, forming five layers of light screens with the Divine Absolute Barrier.
As for the World Wall, it could no longer be used after being Sealed by the Supreme Rule in the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane.
Ignoring the violent Destruction Storm washing over his surroundings, Jack Clark’s expression was cold as he steadily stepped, shattering the Void and exploding everything, charging directly towards the transparent crystal wall deep within the world.
And as he neared the World’s Edge, that repulsion force from the entire world grew more terrifying—mixing with the space storm capable of ripping apart Mythical Giant Beasts in an instant.
Even the Absolute Barrier that Jack Clark had fused with the Source of Higher-order Law was gradually unable to withstand.
Bang! As Jack Clark approached the World Crystal Wall, the outermost golden flames barrier finally crumbled under the pressure, followed by the second layer Thunder Barrier, the third layer grey Death Barrier…
But when the space fragment storm fell upon the black-lit Void Barrier, it was as if piercing through Void Space, appearing directly on the other side.
Boom boom boom!! The surrounding Destruction Storms that passed through in all directions collided with each other, erupting with fearful energy blasts. Amidst the dazzling Radiance, Jack Clark raised his War Halberd high.
In that moment, a catastrophic Aura erupted that made the entire Lost World tremble—an Opening the Heavens presence that caused Heaven and Earth to still, and it seemed as though everything fell into stasis.
One saw a pitch-black Halberd Skill stretching a thousand meters appear, emitting an indescribable brilliant Radiance. Everything in its path was cleanly severed.
That included the Boundary Wall that enveloped the entire world, which was manifested by the world’s space Rule and appeared outwardly as a crystal wall—it too was gashed open by a massive fissure.
Outside the Boundary Wall lay an endless, vast world, where at the horizon of Heaven and Earth one could faintly see several enormous creatures slowly flying, surrounded by Cloud Mist.
The Lost World, unlike the Blue Star World, is a world that exists deep in the interlayer of the mythical world’s space, similar to a larger bubble attached to the edge of the mythical world.
Therefore, when the Boundary Wall was sliced open, it directly linked to the mythical world.
And because Jack Clark’s halberd strike contained the essence of Opening the Heavens, even this world could not heal, forming a stable world passageway.
This was the hope Jack Clark left for these humans before his departure, as a token of gratitude for what he had gained from this world.
Including the stone altar that could establish contact with the Expeditionary Army, he also abandoned the thought of taking it with him, or rather, he couldn’t take it at all.
This was a premonition from the Void-Striking Heart Eye.
As his cultivation grew stronger, the Heart’s Eye Perception once condensed by mental power became even sharper, surpassing the sixth sense.
Just then, the space-time repulsion Jack Clark had diffused approached again, and this time the backlash that erupted was even more terrifying.
Boom!
In the depths of the Void, a transparent river spanning past and future descended, obscuring the sky and sweeping over everything magnificently.
Amidst the ‘furious’ time, Jack Clark turned his head back, nodded slightly to Sara Williams and the others below the pathway, and then, along with the transparent river, silently vanished.
“Mr. Clark has left…” As they watched the imposing figure at the depths of the passageway disappear, Sara Williams felt somewhat dazed.
Huff huff!! Just then, a fierce raging wind surged out from the depths of the black passageway. It was the rich Heavenly Energy from the mythical world, vast and boundless.
Because the energy was so dense, it almost turned into tangible white mist. Sara Williams and the others inhaled instinctively, and instantly their internal Qi Blood surged violently.
Hah! As Qi Blood roared and refined the Heavenly Energy, everyone had the illusion that they could enhance their strength simply by breathing.
No, it was not an illusion, rather it was just that exaggerated.
At this moment, everyone’s body felt like a parched desert suddenly deluged by a downpour, as every piece of flesh and blood, every cell was frantically absorbing energy.
This scene once again shocked everyone beyond measure.
Suddenly, Teacher Jordan’s eyes became slightly red and his voice trembled, “The legends haven’t deceived us after all, the vast world contains rich spiritual energy, consuming it could extend life, could even lead to divinity.”
Then, Teacher Jordan knelt down reverently, worshipping the black hole in the sky and performing an ancient rite that Sara Williams and the others could not comprehend, respectfully saying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1265 - 1265 493 Pioneering Hope Stepping Through
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1265: Chapter 493: Pioneering Hope, Stepping Through Time and Leaving_3 Chapter 1265: Chapter 493: Pioneering Hope, Stepping Through Time and Leaving_3 “We bid farewell to His Excellency, Lord of Thunder and Flames, as he departs. We shall conscientiously follow Your Majesty’s teachings, strive in our cultivation, and set out on the expedition path once again at the earliest, in pursuit of the ancients.”
Reg Brown was somewhat baffled, “Teacher Jordan, why did you call Mr. Clark ‘Your Majesty’?”
Teacher Jordan, kneeling on the ground, solemnly nodded: “Indeed, Your Majesty. Although Mr. Clark has no official status, he must be one of the kings from our ancient Human Race.”
“The rules of Doomsday in this world are strict. Ten thousand years ago, even Boris, the General of War at his peak of the tenth tier, could not break free from the world’s suppression, which shows how terrifying this world’s suppression is.”
“Yet today, Mr. Clark directly withstood the Will of the world and even tore apart the world, indicating that his strength exceeds that of Boris, the leading War General of ancient times, and belongs to the Monarch level.”
“Eh… Teacher Jordan, how do you know all this?” The people around were suddenly somewhat confused, feeling as if they were listening to something beyond their understanding.
Ten thousand years have passed, and everything ancient has become fragmented legends in the Lost World.
Although with the outbreak of Doomsday, everyone knew those legends must be true, no one knew the more detailed information from ten thousand years ago, including the identities of those powerful beings.
Gazing at the pathway emitting White mist in the sky, Teacher Jordan’s eyes revealed complexity as he slowly said, “Because I am descended from one of the branches of the Tianluo family, carrying the bloodline of the General of War, Boris.”
“However, with ten thousand years gone by, the once glory has dissipated in the wars. Unable to cultivate, my family’s complete Inheritance has long been severed.”
Gulp! Reg Brown swallowed, somewhat astonished: “I never expected you to have such a significant background, Teacher Jordan.”
Teacher Jordan smiled bitterly, “What background? I am merely an ordinary university professor, and under the eruption of Doomsday, my cultivation talent isn’t even as good as yours, a disgrace to my ancestors.”
As he stood up, Teacher Jordan looked sternly at everyone, “Now, as the Spiritual Qi from the Vast World pours into this world, the path to cultivation has opened, and this world will undergo a transformation.”
“Especially you, Sara, and Sherry, you two who have received the Cultivation Methods bestowed by His Excellency. You must cultivate even harder to not disappoint His Excellency’s expectations.”
“Perhaps, the hope for the human race in this world to once again set out on the expedition lies with you.”
Sara Williams nodded slowly, “We understand, Teacher Jordan.” Saying this, Sara Williams looked up, her eyes resolutely fixed on the dark pathway in the sky.
Jack Clark’s visit was brief, but his appearance brought hope to this world.
And his departure, even more shocking to Sara Williams and the others, is followed days later by the emergence of a majestic statue on the remaining section of Cavapod Holy Mountain.
Three-faced and six-armed, surrounded by Thunder, with flames burning, the statue stood proudly above the Firmament.
“Zzzt!! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain. We have deciphered the method to save the world and are now summoning all of the human survivors to convene.”
“Zzzt!! This is Cavapod Holy Mountain. An Ancient Monarch King descended here three days ago, opening a pathway of hope and reestablishing the path of cultivation…”
Transmitted by some still-operating signal towers, the signals sent from Cavapod spread throughout the central continent, stirring life into radios that had been silent for two years in many Survivor Bases.
The messages from the radios excited, shocked, and puzzled everyone.
In this world of despair, even a glimmer of hope was enough to drive people mad, let alone the descent of an Ancient Monarch King, promising to save the world.
Soon, some smaller Survivor Bases began to migrate, disregarding danger, and set out with a pilgrimage-like fervor.
A few larger Survivor Bases with Eighth-tier powerhouses in charge sent elite squads to Cavapod Holy Mountain to investigate the veracity of these claims.
The current strongest survivors in this world were of the Eighth Tier, which was stronger than Sara Williams who had just broken through to the Sixth Tier.
However, having mastered powers comparable to those of an Ordinary Mythical-level Powerhouse with the vine, Sara Williams did not worry about those surviving strong men daring to do anything, and thus announced the anomaly of Cavapod to the entire world.
The pathway of hope opened by Jack Clark belonged not just to them or any one person but to everyone from the Lost World.
……
Boom!
In the silver, endless flowing Time Chaos, Jack Clark spun like a leaf in the storm, unable to find any direction.
However, compared to being swept into the Time Chaos earlier, Jack Clark had a modicum of ‘retaliatory power’ this time.
Behind him, a silver circle of reincarnation slowly turned, and the intangible Time Power that it emitted took the form of a pair of grand silver wings, shielding him from the ravaging temporal forces around him.
Though the primary function of the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power was to gather the Mark of Time and unify it into reincarnation, Jack Clark had also grasped a bit of the Power of Time, aside from the marks.
But under the Time Storm, this bit of strength was ineffectual, merely allowing him to barely protect himself.
It didn’t matter, though. At worst, he’d be swept into another space-time.
Once the Eye of Prison on his forehead was unsealed, he would be able to use the Hell Coordinate to jump back at any time, although the price might be quite steep.
Roar!
Just then, a robust Dragon Roar exploded through the Time Chaos. Subsequently, time trembled in the distance as a three-thousand-meter-long White Giant Dragon appeared.
Atop this White Giant Dragon, standing firm in the river of time, silver Radiance flowed, and with its double wings fiercely spread, it looked both majestic and magnificent.
“Roar! Human, do not resist, I will bring you out,” the Time Dragon bellowed, its silver wings sparkling, and hundreds of Dragon Scales bursting to emanate dazzling silver light.
Under the invisible spread of this silver Radiance, everything came to a standstill—it was the Law Talent of Time Stop controlled by this Time Dragon.
With the talent touching the essence of the Time Rule, even the violent Time Chaos paused for a moment.
However, this region’s Time Chaos only halted for a thousandth of an instant before roaring back to life, sweeping everything along as countless world phantoms flashed within the river.
As for Jack Clark, he had already vanished from sight.
[There are two thousand more words being edited. First updating what’s ready, brothers, please wait. As soon as the editing is finished, it will be posted at the end of this chapter.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1266 - 1266 494 Dust Serpent Friction Giant Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1266: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, Friction Giant Dragon Chapter 1266: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, Friction Giant Dragon Above the desert swept by raging sandstorms, a silver giant dragon, with wingspan over 1,500 meters and body length of more than 800 meters, was surrounded by a storm that kept the sandstorm at bay, ten kilometers away.
Within the domain range, a black-red colossal beast, gigantic as mountain ranges, ‘slowly’ flew by, with a golden blue dragon on the other side.
As for Jerry Jones, it led the way at the edge of the domain with its blue single horn on its head, detecting possible Heaven and Earth Treasures.
Suddenly, from the blue single horn on Jerry Jones’ head, rings of halo spread out.
Roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, I’ve found more good stuff. Excited cries came from Jerry Jones, and with a fierce smack of its huge tail, the air behind it exploded into rolling waves.
But Destruction Emperor Dragon did not react to Jerry Jones’ cries and continued flying forward, its head covered with dense black mane fluttering, exuding dignity and domineering presence.
On the gigantic head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon blinked its large eyes, “Eee! Brother has disconnected again, Joe you take the lead.”
Roar! Everyone, follow me.
As it spoke, Jerry Jones’ huge wings swept once, and its nearly 800-meter-long sturdy body flew towards the left front side, charging with a loud ‘boom’ right into the vast sandstorm.
Bang bang bang!!
In an instant, ‘gravel’ as small as fists came sweeping in at the speed of sound, pelting down like a storm on the unarmored body of Jerry Jones, but its thick black scale armor stood unscathed, turning the gravel into dust upon impact.
Even when rocks the size of hundreds of meters came crashing down, Jerry Jones did not dodge; it barreled through the intense explosions, charging toward the center of the sandstorm.
It was only at this moment that the Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly shifted its gaze and let out a deep growl, “Another great find, is it? Let’s go.”
Boom!
The dragon wings behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, strikingly similar to black metal, flapped once, causing the space around to tremble slightly as its huge body caused rolling waves to turn.
Several days have passed since they killed the purple Titan, and along the way, under Jerry Jones’ talent for treasure discovery, they found quite a few treasures and each of their strengths had greatly advanced.
Meanwhile, because of Jack Clark falling into Space-Time Chaos again, the signal was intermittent, and he frequently disconnected, so the several giant beasts had already gotten used to it.
Eee! Charge, brother, the great May wants to see rivers of blood.
On the black-red colossal beast’s head, the ten-meter-long Purple little dragon was coiled on the tip of a huge black dragon horn, waving its little claws and uttering a tender roar.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon nearby let out a lofty Dragon Roar, “Roar! Good, we must kill everything, eat everything.”
The golden blue dragon followed excitedly on the other side, issuing a brutal roar, “Charge, kill everything.”
The roar of two giant dragons and the little one made the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon twitch involuntarily; it felt as if the Dragon Palace was increasingly resembling a den of bandits.
Whether it was killing everything or looting everything, wanting blood to flow into rivers or little brothers shouting their admiration and awe with slogans that were bombastic, so crude.
The deeper they delved into the sandstorm that stretched for thousands of kilometers, the greater the windforce became, as well as the speed of the flying gravel, eventually reaching more than twenty times the speed of sound near the center.
Under the powerful kinetic energy, those rocks, harder than steel, even had plasma firelight surrounding them, forming a blue-purple sandstorm capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
In such a terrifying environment, even the confident Jerry Jones in the front unfolded its domain and entered the dark side, like a phantom wandering within a ten-kilometer shadow.
Under the transformation into a phantom, those horrific pieces of gravel passed directly through the dark domain.
The Black storm surrounding the Silver Giant Dragon was like being bombarded by hundreds of thousands of conventional missiles every moment, the terrifying explosive impacts causing the domain to shake violently.
Under such circumstances, the energy inside the Silver Giant Dragon was rapidly depleted, and the domain’s range continuously shrank.
The heart of the sandstorm was a forbidden area where even a Mythical Giant Beast would suffer heavy injuries or even Death with a moment’s carelessness.
At this time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Let me take the lead.”
Boom boom boom!!
The numerous explosions and firelight engulfed the Destruction Emperor Dragon ahead, the intense blast reverberating through Heaven and Earth, overpowering the hum of the raging wind but unable to shake its colossal body in the slightest.
Several tens of meters from the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, an invisible and heavy terrifying forcefield enveloped it, causing Distortion in space, shattering the approaching diamond-hard gravel with its heavy force.
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon leading the way, the group of giant beasts quickly traversed over a thousand kilometers and reached the center of the storm.
There, the wind speed suddenly weakened, forming a windless Hollow several kilometers in diameter, surrounded by sky-reaching blue-purple Tornado Storm walls.
In the center, a thick cluster of tangible yellow currents swirled in a vortex, each of them emanating an Aura as heavy as mountains, mixed with Mysterious Law Patterns.
Immediately, Jerry Jones became excited, “Roar! What is that? It smells so good, so good.”
A smile also appeared in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, “This is the Laws’ Origin infused with Mysterious Yellow Aura, although it’s quite chaotic, it’s already approaching the level of a Law Level Divine Artifact.”
“What’s most important is the sheer quantity, equivalent to the total amount of about a dozen top-level divine items, and the Earth Origin contained within, upon absorption, can significantly enhance the solidity of our bodies.”
“Roar! Great job, Joe,” exclaimed the Silver Giant Dragon, and then happily flew over, extending its black storm-wrapped Dragon Claw.
With a tearing sound, the heavy Laws’ Origin currents were ripped apart, dividing into five groups of different sizes floating in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 1267 - 1267 494 Dust Serpent the Friction Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1267: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, the Friction Giant Dragon_2 Chapter 1267: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, the Friction Giant Dragon_2 “Tim Abott, you are our Dragon Palace Empire’s prime war strength, and your energy conversion efficiency is even greater. You eat more, and we’ll divide what’s left,”
In the distribution by the Silver Giant Dragon, the ‘Big Dragon King’ of the Dragon Palace, the portion for the Destruction Emperor Dragon accounted for half of the total.
The remaining half was to be shared by the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon, with a tenth going to the Purple little dragon, and two tenths to the treasure hunting hero, the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
None of the beasts had any objections to this distribution, including the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Watching the yellow vortex that had re-formed in front of them, with a diameter of a hundred meters, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly opened its huge mouth, emitting a powerful suction, and slurped up the Earth Origin like eating noodles.
Boom! The moment the Earth Origin, imbued with the Mysterious Yellow aura, was swallowed, an explosion of power, heavy with significance, burst forth from the center of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s stomach.
Crackle Crackle!! Under the rich and pure Origin Energy, the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon inflated and expanded continuously, as if it had eaten a miraculous growth agent.
And, strengthened by the Law Factor of the Earth Law, the flesh and blood, bones, and even the strength of its scale armor of the Destruction Emperor Dragon… increased by a fraction.
There was no other way; this bit of enhancement from the Earth Law was like rising from 10000 to 10001 for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose physical body was already extremely powerful.
Instead, its size increased from 2380+ meters to 2410 meters.
As the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon crackled and swelled, the Purple little dragon roared excitedly, awww! …roar!
As the milky roar turned into a majestic Dragon Roar, a thirty-something-meter-long Purple dragon head appeared, swallowing its portion of the Origin in one bite.
Yiyayiya!! Delicious.
The head of the Purple little dragon shrank rapidly, happily clutching its round, bulging belly as it flew back to the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, lying back contentedly in the gaps between the black-red scaled armor.
The Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast also excitedly swallowed the Earth Origin, causing their rich internal energy to burst forth, their auras surging in an instant.
However, compared to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which quickly completed the conversion and absorption, the bodies of the Three-headed Giant Beast were suffused with intense yellow light, and it was estimated that it would take at least a day or two to fully absorb it.
“Let’s go, keep moving.”
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon moved, directly smashing a black pathway through the sandstorm, with an invisible power spreading across the two-kilometer-wide channel, unable to close for a long time.
Under the lead of the Black-red Colossal Beast, several Giant Beasts quickly crossed the sandstorm area.
Upon reaching this point, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowed down and growled softly, “Joe, keep leading the way.”
Roar roar roar!! Watch me.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc flew confidently ahead, its blue horn emitting waves of light, carefully sensing everything between heaven and earth.
The horn on the head of the Single-horned Spawn Roc had evolved from initially being able to filter sea water and sense Heaven and Earth Treasures within a few kilometers, to later filtering air and sensing tens of kilometers.
Later, as it broke through to Mythical-level, its talent evolved to even filter fluctuations of Heaven and Earth, sensing the concentration and flow direction of Heavenly Energy within thousands of kilometers.
In such scenarios, even if those Heaven and Earth Treasures were hidden in the cracks of space or deep within dangerous forbidden areas, they couldn’t escape the senses of the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Sometimes, if the ‘scent’ emitted by the Heaven and Earth Treasures was potent, the Single-horned Spawn Roc could even vaguely ‘smell’ it from several thousand or even tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Of course, this vague sensing often led to mistakes, so for the next day or more, the few Giant Beasts roamed left and right across tens of thousands of kilometers without any findings.
Roar!
Within the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Giant Dragon roared, and a white cold Breath a hundred meters thick erupted, crossing tens of kilometers to strike a region shrouded in black fog.
A crack tore through the earth there, extending over a thousand kilometers, with countless black fogs spewing from below and covering heaven and earth, emitting an intense, dangerous, rancid odor.
Boom!! In an instant, a dazzling White Light erupted, and with the spread of the frost, everything became frozen, forming a frozen area of over a hundred kilometers.
Boom!
Just at that moment, a Seven-Colored Dragon Breath pierced through heaven and earth, striking the center of the frozen area, causing an even more potent explosion to erupt, releasing blinding light and solidifying into crystal.
Under the bombardment of the two Dragon Breaths, the canyon in the center froze over, forming an Ice Crystal Channel over a hundred kilometers wide.
At this moment, a faint fishy breeze blew from the opposite side of the channel, and as the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s horn flickered slightly, it let out an excited cry.
Roar roar roar!! Scythia, I smell it; that good thing is right on the other side, and it looks like there’s a lot of it.
A day passed, and after absorbing the Earth Origin and growing to over 850 meters long, the Silver Giant Dragon roared with excitement, “Roar! Well done, Joe.”
Standing on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, clutching one of its dragon horns, the Purple little dragon was also impatient, Yiyayiya!! Let’s go, charge!
Roar Roar!!
In the midst of roars, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Silver Giant Dragon rushed into the Ice Crystal Channel first, followed by the slow-reacting Destruction Emperor Dragon, and then the graceful Golden Blue Giant Dragon spreading its wings.
As the line of Giant Beasts crossed the black fog-filled canyon, an endless blue ocean appeared before them.
But there was not a single sign of life in this sea; as water splashed and rippled, it emitted a terrifying aura of corrosion, eroding a layer of rock with every sweep, continuously expanding.
Apart from that, a thin blue mist spread over the sea surface, blocking out the sun, making hissing noises as space itself began corroding under that mist.
The horrifying Corrosion Fluctuations made the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Mythical Beast feel an intense sense of danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1268 - 1268 494 Dust Serpent the Friction Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1268: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, the Friction Giant Dragon_3 Chapter 1268: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, the Friction Giant Dragon_3 This was a forbidden area formed by corrosive poison water. Even Mythical Giant Beasts entering would be eroded by the Fog Corrosion Law Domain and their bodies would eventually dissolve into the sea water.
Seeing this, the Three-headed Giant Beast couldn’t help but look towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“Follow, behind, me,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, a circle of substantial purple light Bursting from its body.
Boom!
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon as the center, a hundred-kilometer radius became engulfed in purple radiance, forming a Catastrophe Domain. Within this range, all things withered and life ceased to exist.
Everything, including tiny creatures in the dirt or the air and the ones that inhabited the rocks, all dissolved, and the Earth turned pitch black, emitting purple fumes.
This was the terror of the Corrosion Law pushed to its limit, annihilating all life. The formless aura of death made even the Giant Dragons like the Silver Giant Dragon feel a twinge of fear in their hearts.
Compared to the fearsome power of Destructive Lightning and Heaven Burning Golden Flame, the silent, unnoticeable poison commanded even more respect from living creatures.
The Catastrophe Domain that enveloped a hundred-kilometer radius was like a purple fierce beast, bursting with a roar into the Death Blue Sea and stirring up a violent Blue Radiance in a raging wind as it flew towards the deeper regions.
May May!! Thunderflame, a bit to the left, more to the left…
Under the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s meticulous direction, several Giant Beasts roared, quickly crossing over four thousand kilometers to the deeper parts of the Toxic Blue Sea.
In the distance, an island with a span of hundreds of kilometers came into view for the Giant Beasts.
On the perimeter of the island, more than forty Blue Crystal Trees, reaching a kilometer tall, stood majestically. Their trunks were rugged and straight, their branches and leaves resembled blue crystals, emitting a magnificent glow.
These trees took root deep within the island’s rocks, a part of them reaching into the sea. The formless Blue Radiance they emitted repelled the poison mist outside the island, forming a safe area.
Among the branches of these trees, which were like ordinary mountain peaks, hung white fruits, ranging from several meters to ten meters, with pure white liquid energy flowing inside them.
Instantly the eyes of the Giant Beasts lit up.
The Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but let out an exalted Dragon Roar, “Roar! So many good things, the Great Sethia can’t even count them all, we’ve struck it rich, Tim Abott.”
The Golden Blue Dragon shook its head elegantly, “Sethia, you’re still so dull, can’t even count over five hundred fruits.”
“Roar! Curse you, Telsafi, once again you call the Great Sethia a fool. After we finish eating these good things, I’m definitely going to teach you a lesson,” it shouted.
“Just afraid that later it’ll be the Great Telsafi teaching you a lesson.”
May May May!! Fight, fight hard, the Great May loves watching the Giant Beasts fight the most.
On top of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, the Purple little dragon was excitedly instigating trouble, causing the Destruction Emperor Dragon to feel somewhat speechless.
The currently online Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a deep and profound roar, “…Alright, you two stop bickering, let’s go take a look first.”
Boom! The Black-red Colossal Beast landed on the ground, and in an instant, the whole island trembled slightly, the Earth cracked, and the surroundings were full of rolling air currents.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head slightly to look at the ‘big trees’ that were nearly as tall as it was, its mouth opened slightly, and an invisible suction swept up a raging wind, engulfing the Blue Crystal Trees.
Whoo-whoo! Amid the howling wind, three ten-meter-wide fruits and several smaller fruits were engulfed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon in one gulp, directly falling into its stomach through its throat.
Bang, bang, bang! Bursts of pure Life Energy exploded within the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body.
Suddenly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes brightened, and it growled softly, “These Divine Fruits are not bad.”
These Divine Fruits, purified from the violently toxic energy of the Blue Sea, had shed all impurities and contained pure energy along with Corrosion Law Factors. They could stimulate the rapid growth of flesh and blood in living creatures.
Although the energy contained within a single fruit was not substantial, with the largest being at most akin to a High-level Divine Object, their sheer quantity could not be overlooked, having accumulated several hundreds of them over countless millennia.
“Eat up. Take as much as you can.”
Due to the abundance, the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not bother to ration them out as, in any case, the Silver Giant Dragon and its peers definitely could not out-eat it.
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon having tested the fruits and given permission, the Silver Giant Dragon, Single-horned Spawn Roc, and the other Giant Beasts roared excitedly and dived towards the blue Divine Trees.
Whoo-whoo! Amidst the roaring wind, every Giant Beast opened their huge mouths and sucked fiercely at the trees, swallowing one white Divine Fruit after another.
However, due to the Energy Attribute of these Heaven and Earth Treasures, after swallowing over ten fruits, the Giant Beasts like the Silver Giant Dragon began to develop resistance, diminishing their effectiveness.
But it didn’t matter. As long as they still had an effect, they would continue to eat.
As for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it did not have to worry about resistance. Standing firmly in the middle of the island, its domain enveloped over a hundred kilometers, sucking in one white Divine Fruit after another.
As each ‘missile’ of energy exploded within its body, the Destruction Emperor Dragon began to rapidly increase in size under the abundant and rich energy, swiftly growing to more than 2,450 meters.
And this was the correct way to utilize the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In this grand world where chaos occasionally broke through the Void, chaotic energy constantly flowed into the Chaotic Zone, which was rich with countless Heaven and Earth Treasures.
The more dangerous the area, due to its extreme environment, the greater the likelihood of finding good things, including many hidden layers of Void and small worlds.
In these forbidden areas, a moment of carelessness could lead to the downfall of Mythical Giant Beasts or even injury to Titan Beasts, and not all Ancient Titans dare say they fear nothing.
Therefore, even though Giant Beasts know there might be good things inside the forbidden areas, many do not dare to venture in. A slight mishap could lead to heavy injuries or even death.
Hence, the Heaven and Earth Treasures claimed by powerful Giant Beasts are only a minority.
Including the Destruction Emperor Dragon. If it weren’t for the treasure-hunting talent of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it wouldn’t have been able to precisely locate so many Heaven and Earth Treasures.

chapters.title: Chapter 1269 - 1269 494 Dust Serpent the Friction Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1269: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, the Friction Giant Dragon_4 Chapter 1269: Chapter 494 Dust Serpent, the Friction Giant Dragon_4 After consuming more than forty Divine Fruits, the Silver Giant Dragon stopped, its entire body emanating a rich white Life Energy.
The Silver Giant Dragon walked with heavy steps, swaying as it approached the Destruction Emperor Dragon and rubbed its somewhat dizzy head against it.
In an instant, the sharp silver dragon horns grinded against the Black-red Scales, creating rumbling explosions and sparks, followed by a joyful roar from the Silver Emperor Dragon.
“Roar! Tim Abott, today Great Scythia is so happy, feels like it won’t be long before Scythia can have a breakthrough to Titan and become as powerful as Mother.”
At this time, the size of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already approached two thousand five hundred meters, and when standing on all fours, its shoulder was about nine hundred meters tall, becoming increasingly massive and oppressive.
In front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, over eight hundred meters long and over three hundred meters tall at the shoulder, seemed like a ten-year-old child throwing a tantrum.
Before the Destruction Emperor Dragon could speak, another gold and blue dragon also staggered over, imitating the Silver Giant Dragon by rubbing against the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Squeak! The scales, transparent like crystal, rubbed against the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, sparking a large amount of fire, which made the gold and blue dragon appear even more beautiful and elegant.
“Roar! Thunderflame, come close, Great Telsafi feels a bit dizzy.”
“Why does it feel like the time we stole and drank from Mother’s treasury of divine wine? Weren’t we eating Divine Fruit?” said the gold and blue dragon, dizzy as it shook its head.
Looking at the two silly dragons rubbing against it from time to time on its left and right, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head, too lazy to pay attention to them.
At that moment, the Single-horned Spawn Roc also stopped. After consuming more than thirty Divine Fruits in one breath, it staggered and flew behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, then its wings went limp.
Boom!
With a thud, the Single-horned Spawn Roc landed heavily, instantly shattering the Earth within several kilometers, its powerful impact tossing numerous stones pitter-patting against the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Corrosion Law Factors contained within these white Divine Fruits had a bit of toxicity. Eating too many at once, even Mythical Giant Beasts could feel dizzy if they couldn’t digest them quickly.
Feeling that something was off, all three Giant Beasts instinctively moved closer to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as in their subconscious, the safest place was by its side.
At this moment, the three Giant Beasts – no, plus a small excited creature devouring Divine Fruits one bite at a time – together they had consumed more than a hundred white Divine Fruits.
Counting the more than two hundred eaten by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, there were still many hanging on the blue divine trees.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, and instantly the entire island trembled. Under the unseen domain power, the remaining hundred or so white fruits vibrated, snapping off branches.
After the several Giant Beasts had their fill, the Destruction Emperor Dragon naturally did not hold back anymore and gulped down all the remaining Divine Fruits.
Boom! Swallowing more than a hundred Divine Fruits in one go caused an explosion inside the Destruction Emperor Dragon akin to a one hundred megaton Hydrogen Bomb, releasing infinite energy.
The energy was so dense it even pierced through its body, radiating White Light.
Crackle Crackle! The body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon started to swell…
[There are 1,000 more words, please wait]
Normally, Giant Beasts have a body size of one thousand seven hundred meters at the early Titan stage. Growing to two thousand four hundred meters signifies the mid-Titan stage, two thousand eight hundred for late Titan, and three thousand for peak.
However, upon Transforming into a Heavenly Tier life form, with a tail that becomes much more slender and occupies more than half of the body, the creature gets longer compared to the growth stages of a conventional Giant Beast.
Just after the breakthrough to Titan Level it had reached one thousand nine hundred meters. By its own estimation, it would grow to about two thousand six hundred meters before reaching mid-period, and just over three thousand meters for late period.
Breaking out of the Sea of Corrosion, the Four Great Beasts continued deeper. The Single-horned Spawn Roc’s horn shone as it detected the density and flow of the energy veins.
Soon, an endless sea of flowers appeared. The two excited Giant Dragons roared and then destroyed it. watching this scene made the Destruction Emperor Dragon shake its head and release a Destructive Breath from its mouth.
Boom! An area spanning hundreds of kilometers was destroyed, swept aside as they devastated this World.
This time, the feeling of causing explosive destruction felt too exhilarating.
At the heart of the mist, there lay a fragment of the world hanging in the Void, half shattered.
“Roar! Thunderflame, there are good things in here, really good things.”
In the frenzied Chaos Void, four massive creatures stood tall, looking ahead at the vast expanse of nothingness.
There, a crumbling fragment of the world was dim and grey, while the blue solitary horn atop the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s head shone with a dazzling light, signaling the discovery of at least Law-Level resources.
Boom!
As the world shook, the metallic-like Giant Beasts dwelling on the Earth looked up to the skies, where a huge crack had torn open, and a Black-red Scales Dragon-type Giant Beast entered first.
Roar!
In the Dark Heavens and Earth at the heart of the great land, a bronze Giant Beast, three thousand meters long like a mountain range, roared, its gaze fixed intently on the newly arrived Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon, the Three-headed Giant Beast in the rear.
“Roar! Kill, let the Great Sethia see rivers of blood.”
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately shifted into the Deep Red Destruction Form, transforming into a terrifying Destruction creature over six thousand meters long, and lunged at the bronze mountain range Giant Beast as countless life forms from different races watched in despair.
The Silver Giant Dragon and others also charged at those subordinate different races, instantly sparking a brutal battle.
Boom Boom Boom!!
In their normal state, Giant Beasts at the Early Titan level measured one thousand seven hundred meters. Growing to two thousand four hundred meters signified the mid-period Titan, reaching two thousand eight hundred meters marked the late period, and three thousand meters was the pinnacle.
However, upon Transformation to the Heavenly Tier, with tails becoming more slender and making up more than half their body length, their size became similar to that of serpents, longer than the growth size of regular Giant Beasts.
Having just made a breakthrough to Titan Level, they measured one thousand nine hundred meters. By their own estimation, they would need to grow to two thousand six hundred meters to reach the mid-period and just over three thousand meters for the late period.
Rushing out of the sea of corrosion, the Four Great Beasts continued further, with the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s solitary horn flickering, detecting the density and flow of the energy veins.
Soon, a boundless sea of flowers appeared, and the two excited Giant Dragons roared, then destroyed it. Watching this spectacle, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head as a Destructive Breath erupted from its mouth.
Boom! Hundreds of kilometers were laid to waste, swept away in a path of destruction through this World.
The thrill of this intense devastation was exhilarating.
At the heart of the mist, there lay a fragment of the world hanging in the Void, half shattered.
“Roar! Thunderflame, there are good things in here, really good things.”
In the frenzied Chaos Void, four massive creatures stood tall, looking ahead at the vast expanse of nothingness.
There, a crumbling fragment of the world was dim and grey, while the blue solitary horn atop the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s head shone with a dazzling light, signaling the discovery of at least Law-Level resources.
Boom!
As the world shook, the metallic-like Giant Beasts dwelling on the Earth looked up to the skies, where a huge crack had torn open, and a Black-red Scales Dragon-type Giant Beast entered first.
Roar!
In the Dark Heavens and Earth at the heart of the great land, a bronze Giant Beast, three thousand meters long like a mountain range, roared, its gaze fixed intently on the newly arrived Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon, the Three-headed Giant Beast in the rear.
“Roar! Kill, let the Great Sethia see rivers of blood.”
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately shifted into the Deep Red Destruction Form, transforming into a terrifying Destruction creature over six thousand meters long, and lunged at the bronze mountain range Giant Beast as countless life forms from different races watched in despair.
The Silver Giant Dragon and others also charged at those subordinate different races, instantly sparking a brutal battle.
Boom Boom Boom!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1270 - 1270 495 The Ancient Covenant the Python
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1270: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World Chapter 1270: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World Outside the hazy world, upon seeing the Gray-White Python with a body length of over four thousand meters, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a grave expression in an instant.
Judging by its size, this Ancient Giant Python was still in the ancient early stage, on the verge of a breakthrough to the mid-period.
If one were to judge purely by realm, it seemed to be no match for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had previously, in its Deep Red Form, been powerful enough to fiercely contend with two mid-period Demon Gods.
Although it had no way to defeat the two united Demon Gods, this also demonstrated that its combat strength was comparable to the ancient mid-period.
Yet the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt a strong sense of danger from this Giant Python close to the ancient mid-period, sensing that its strength far exceeded its realm.
Just then, the Ancient Giant Python lying atop the mountain peak within the World Fragments opened its jaws angrily.
Roar!
In an instant, a majestic and raging roar echoed between Heaven and Earth; the entire world trembled under the roar, the ancient oppressive force penetrating the world and spreading throughout the Void.
In that instant, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, Silver Giant Dragon, and Golden Blue Giant Dragon all trembled, showing instinctual awe in their eyes.
Compared to this Ancient Giant Python, they, merely at the Mid-Mythical Stage, were too far behind in both Growth Level and bloodline level, and were overwhelmed by just one roar.
However, the Purple little dragon on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon showed no reaction, coiling its tail and turning over to find a comfortable position within the black mane to continue sleeping.
Under the warning and deterring roar of the Ancient Beast, the blood in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body boiled.
As a Giant Beast whose bloodline level had reached the Heavenly Tier and had been bestowed a true name by Heaven and Earth, the pride of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was etched deep within its genetic bloodline.
In this world, no Giant Beast of equivalent strength had the right to make it ‘roll’.
Roar! A ferocious roar shook the Void, filled with Overbearing Dragon Might. As it collided with the realm-separating Aura of the Ancient Giant Python, the Void within a thousand kilometers vibrated violently.
Bang bang bang! Within a range of tens of kilometers around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, chunks of asteroids hundreds and thousands of kilometers in size exploded and shattered under the roar’s soundwaves, creating a terrifying momentum.
In the midst of the violent sonic assault, the Destruction Emperor Dragon put down the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon it was holding in its claws and growled softly, “This Ancient Giant Beast is very strong, you guys should stay further away later.”
As it spoke, red lightning wrapped around the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and then a Terrifying Aura that made Heaven and Earth shudder burst forth.
Boom boom boom!
Under the Terrifying Aura, the entire world trembled, the laws of Heavenly Earth became chaotic, and Heavenly Energy within thousands of kilometers furiously mobilized, endlesly pouring in.
A dazzling red light illuminated the Void, with a Deep red Destruction Beast 7,000 meters in length and standing over 3,000 meters tall at its center.
In its Deep Red Form, the look of the Destruction Emperor Dragon became even more ferocious. Its entire body was covered with thick Red Scale Armor, each piece of armor tens of meters in size and adorned with red lightning patterns and sharp protrusions.
Besides that, its chest, abdomen, legs, and shoulders were covered with even thicker red armor. Its double claws became twice as large as usual and looked exaggeratedly huge.
Those sharp claws shone with a dazzling red light, emitting an extremely dangerous Aura, as if a slight sway of them could tear apart everything between heaven and earth.
The most ferocious aspect was the dragon head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Upon its head were two straight and sharp red dragon horns covered with spiral dragon patterns, and behind them were two more horns branching like antlers, regal and strange.
Between the two sets of dragon horns, red lightning intertwined, forming a crown that appeared regal and sacred.
At the same time, the spine-like scales behind the two sets of dragon horns, resembling a mane, became even more wild and sharp, with hundreds of meters of red mane moving as if alive amidst them.
Bang bang bang!
Red lightning, infused with the Supreme Destruction Law, flashed, and wherever it passed, space shattered like fragile paper, annihilated, creating an Area of Destruction with a radius of over twenty kilometers centered around the Deep red Destruction Beast.
In this area, an endless red light spread, forming a projection of the Deep Red World and emitting the terrifying Aura of Great Destruction.
“Tim Abott is so strong!”
The Silver Giant Dragon and Golden Blue Giant Dragon, as well as the Single-horned Spawn Roc, flung tens of kilometers away by the shock, floated in the Void, their drunken state of mind instantly dispersed by the ancient oppressive force.
Looking at the enormous figure standing in the center of the red light, the two dragons instinctively felt weak all over, with their tails drooping in the Void, wanting to submit.
At this moment, the Deep red Destruction Beast moved thunderously, its footsteps shattering the Void instantly appearing before the hazy Barrier Wall of the world, its claws piercing deep into the Space Interlayer.
Boom!
The entire Earth World trembled, and a crack tens of thousands of meters long appeared in the sky, resembling an abyss, out of which emerged a Terrifying Aura-emitting Red Beast.
Roar!
Gazing at the Red Beast that had torn through the world to enter, the Ancient Giant Python, now over 4,600 meters long, let out a majestic roar, causing the Earth spanning over twenty thousand kilometers to shake.
In a flash, heaven and earth swayed, and a heavy force descended, causing the recently arrived Deep red Destruction Beast’s form to sink, its colossal body plummeting down like a red comet from the sky.
