Boom!
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon at its center, the Earth within hundreds of kilometers shattered, countless rocks surged like a Tsunami, erupting in rings, reaching heights of over a hundred thousand meters.
This land stretched over more than twenty thousand kilometers, made up of gray mountain ranges and rocks, was permeated with the Rule power of the Ancient Giant Python, or rather, the entire world had been refined by it.
Therefore, with a thought, this Ancient Giant Python could mobilize the World’s Power and turn it directly into an extremely heavy strength to suppress the Destruction Emperor Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1271 - 1271 495 The Ancient Covenant the Python
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1271: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World_2 Chapter 1271: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World_2 This scene was like a continental block with a diameter of over twenty thousand kilometers falling, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon was suppressed.
But just then, a dragon roar erupted amidst the smoke and dust, and a powerfully malevolent force of destruction soared into the sky.
Under the terrible power, in an instant, the smoke and dust covering a thousand kilometers dissipated, revealing the shattered Earth, a huge pit more than a hundred kilometers wide, and the Red Beast at the bottom of the pit.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the Red Beast, the oppressively dense gray Vajra Ground started to break apart, forming cracks that spread, trying to crush the Destruction Emperor Dragon beneath the Earth.
But no matter how the world’s heavy pressure pressed down upon it, the Crimson Destruction Beast remained unyielding, with red lightning coiling around its body and its golden-red vertical pupils coldly looking into the distance.
There, the Ancient Giant Python coiled atop mountain peaks tens of thousands of meters high, also watching it with a cold gaze, standing off over a thousand kilometers apart.
Boom! Suddenly, the over three thousand meters tall Crimson Destruction Beast slightly raised its head, and its huge and fierce Dragon Claw reached into the Void, as if grasping something.
Roar! The muscles in the Crimson Destruction Beast’s double claws swelled, and an indescribable terrifying strength burst from within its body, tearing fiercely.
Boom! The entire Stone World shook, Heaven and Earth collapsed, mountain peaks fell, and in the middle of the Earth, a crack several thousand kilometers long was torn open.
As the Crimson Destruction Beast tore through the rules, the weight from the One-side World that enveloped it also disintegrated.
Just as the rule suppression disappeared, the space under the Red Beast’s feet shattered, the Earth exploded, and countless rocks within hundreds of kilometers shot into the sky.
Under the terrifying counterforce, the Crimson Destruction Beast vanished in an instant, crossing over a thousand kilometers with extreme speed, and appearing above the Ancient Giant Python’s head.
Roar!
Just as the Crimson Destruction Beast appeared, the over four thousand meters long Ancient Giant Python roared, its body emitting a dazzling gray light, expanding in size.
In an instant, a giant python tens of kilometers long, covered in thick gray jade scale armor, stretched across the Void, its tail as thick as mountain ranges swept across, pulverizing everything in its path.
Boom!
At the instant the two giant beasts collided, a black spherical shock burst forth, a phenomenon of space itself being destroyed by pure force, and everything it passed was pulverized, destroyed.
Under the force of the impact, the Earth collapsed, mountains shattered, and rolling smoke and dust swept across a thousand kilometers.
Roar! Suddenly amidst the violent torrents, a vicious roar echoed through Heaven and Earth. The Destruction Emperor Dragon, who was holding onto the Ancient Giant Python’s tail, suddenly stepped down, its internal power exploding.
The Ancient Giant Python let out an angry roar, being smashed to the ground by a fierce strike from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, like a mountain peak falling, and unleashing a world-shattering terrible force.
Boom! The entire World Fragment trembled with it, the Earth exploded, creating a Destruction Tunnel over a thousand kilometers long.
And just as the Ancient Giant Python was smashed into the Earth, the Crimson Destruction Beast suddenly released its double claws. With speed that didn’t match its huge size, it transformed into a streak of red afterimage, appearing hundreds of kilometers away in an instant.
Whoosh! Just as the Red Beast vanished, a thick gray Breath pierced through the smoke and dust, and wherever it passed, the space was petrified, frozen.
In a blink of an eye, within a range of hundreds of kilometers, the world turned to stone.
Such a strong Petrification Law. Watching this scene, the Crimson Destruction Beast’s eyes revealed a touch of solemnity.
Although under the Chaotic Dark Law, it could ignore any Transcendent force that did not exceed its strength limit.
But with the surrounding space petrified, trying to explode a rule petrified space within hundreds of kilometers, even it would need to exert some effort.
Roar! Watching the Crimson Destruction Beast dodge its strike, the Ancient Giant Python with a body length of ten kilometers stood upright, radiating an even more vicious aura.
Boom! The entire world once again shook violently, and the force of the World’s Power, steering the rules, descended again.
This time, however, it was not to suppress the Crimson Destruction Beast, but to strengthen the Ancient Giant Python itself.
Crackle Crackle!!
The aura of the Ancient Giant Python surged, the thickness of its gray-white scale armor increasing several fold, wrapped in patterned rules that radiated an unshakable solidity.
Boom!
The Ancient Giant Python, like a streak of gray light, shattered and exploded the Earth it passed, instantly raising mountainous and Tsunami-like waves as it appeared in front of the Crimson Beast.
Its massive python head, anger-distorted, emitted a terrifying suction force capable of swallowing Heaven and Earth; gray mist spewed from its mouth, carrying the dreadful breath capable of petrifying everything.
Just as the Ancient Giant Python appeared in front of the Red Beast, the beast slightly tilted its body, and a Tail Blade wrapped in red lightning cut through the Void, turning into a streak of red light that flashed by.
Boom!
The terrifying strike annihilated everything, creating a fan-shaped flash of red light, its sharp blade slicing below the Ancient Giant Python’s neck, breaking the scale armor, and exploding the rock.
The contained terrifying force even sent the Ancient Giant Python flying, turning into a gray phantom that smashed into the Earth, only stopping after demolishing more than a dozen mountain peaks.
Roar!
With an angry roar shaking Heaven and Earth, the smoke and dust dispersed, showing the vast form of the Ancient Giant Python, revealing a several hundred meters long, dozens of meters deep gash under its neck.
Such a terrifying defense caused even the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s pupils to constrict.
Roar!
A fierce roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, the Ancient Giant Python, having demolished tens of mountains, rushed towards the Crimson Beast once again, carrying the terrifying momentum of Mountains and Seas shaking.
And just as the Ancient Giant Python roared, the Earth within tens of kilometers around the Crimson Beast collapsed, the rocky ground closing up like a massive palm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1272 - 1272 495 The Ancient Covenant the Python
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1272: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World_3 Chapter 1272: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World_3 Boom!!
The red Tail Blade, spanned thousands of kilometers, wrapped in lightning as it swept across heaven and earth, pulverizing everything, fracturing the converging earth in all directions while the figure of the beast dipped slightly as its double claws reached out.
The Deep Red Giant Beast, like a Martial Arts Master, shot out its right claw in an instant and grasped the side of the Ancient Giant Python’s head, as its left claw plummeted onto its neck with a powerful press.
Boom! The earth exploded within a range of hundreds of kilometers, countless rocks soared into the sky, mixed with the angry roars of the Giant Beast.
In the violent surge, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon prepared to step on the body of the Ancient Giant Python and tear apart its head, sharp stone pillars hundreds to thousands of kilometers thick burst upwards from beneath it.
In the blink of an eye, a vast span of a thousand-plus kilometers turned into a Stone Shoot Forest, each sharp mountain peak looming thousands to tens of thousands of meters tall, radiating an aura of solidity.
Boom!
Under the mighty impact force, even the Deep Red Giant Beast was sent flying, crashing as a red streak onto the earth a thousand kilometers away, its body coiled with red lightning, emitting a Destructive Aura powerful enough to destroy heaven and earth.
Roar! Gazing at the Deep Red Destruction Beast standing atop the shattered earth, the Ancient Giant Python wrapped around the stone peaks emitted a brutal roar.
This Ancient Giant Python could petrify the entire world, gathering the power of a One-side World into Rule-enhancing abilities, making its defense terrifyingly formidable.
Under the influence of the Rule strength, this Ancient Giant Python, with its petrification capabilities, possessed a physique of sheer terror, and its strength was only ‘slightly’ inferior to that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Therefore, even in a brief exchange of blows, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, even in its Deep Red Form, was only barely able to suppress the opponent.
Roar roar!! After a momentary standoff, both Giant Beasts simultaneously let out ferocious roars, turning into a red and a gray beam of light that shot forth and collided fiercely.
Boom! In an instant, the entire world was violently shaken.
This time, the two Giant Beasts were entwined in a furious battle, collapsing space and exploding the earth as they went; in just a few breaths, a ten-thousand-kilometer range was devastated.
At the Ancient Titan level, the combat of the beasts ultimately returned to the most primitive form, because their strongest aspect was the mighty Giant Beast Body itself.
In close-quarters frenzied combat, red lightning danced and burst upon the body of the Ancient Giant Python, exploding and shattering its grayish-white scale armor.
The glowing red double claws tore massive gashes, and taking advantage of an opportunity, the Tail Blade almost severed the Ancient Giant Python’s tail.
However, in contrast with the powerfully formidable and terrifyingly defensive Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Ancient Giant Python quickly found itself at a disadvantage after only a brief scuffle.
Restricted to only biting, entwining, and simple tail sweeps, it was outmatched by the ‘Martial Arts’ acumen of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, who blocked every attack.
As for the mountain peaks and earth surging from all directions, they were directly shattered by the charge of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, including the Petrification Breath from the mouth of the Ancient Giant Python, which was also ignored.
As the two Ancient Beasts fought fiercely, in no time half a continent was obliterated, plunging the entire world into a doomsday scenario, with smoke and dust obscuring heaven and earth.
Roar! Suddenly, a brutal roar erupted, followed by a gray beam of light that soared into the sky, reaching the firmament tens of thousands of meters high.
At this point, most of the scale armor on the Ancient Giant Python was shattered, covered with long, bone-deep gashes extending thousands of kilometers, its Aura chaotic and ferocious.
Especially on its enormous head, fearsome as a mountain, there was a huge gash as if something had bitten off almost half its skull, its edges writhing with gray strength.
Gazing down at the Deep Red Destruction Beast standing on the fractured earth, wrapped in red lightning, the Ancient Giant Python’s eyes were bloodshot as it bellowed savagely.
“Roar! Invader, you have thoroughly enraged the great Carmen Dodd,” it roared.
In the midst of the roaring, not giving the Destruction Emperor Dragon time to react, the Ancient Giant Python explosively disintegrated, transforming into an endless gray force that merged with the world.
Boom boom boom!!
Instantly, the whole world trembled, the earth cracked open, heaven and earth swayed, and in the horrified gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast outside the world, a terrifying Python that encircled the entire world manifested.
With the Rule strength constructing it, the Void Annihilation occurred, the Gray Python’s phantom, tens of thousands of kilometers in length, coiled outside the world, its cold gaze fixed on the Deep Red Giant Beast within.
Gazing at the Python that encircled the world, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt a moment of shock.
Worthy of an Ancient Beast that made even him feel a sense of danger, having at least mastered three kinds of Higher-order Laws, along with ascended Rule strength and this world-encircling Rule Mystery.
But what of that?
Roar! The Crimson Destruction Beast standing on the earth roared towards the sky, its body erupting with endless red lightning that covered half of the Firmament.
Under the crimson Destructive Lightning, the Rules of the Ancient Giant Python branded between heaven and earth were gradually destroyed and erased.
Roar! Sensing the loosening of its fusion with the world below, the Gray Python let out a ferocious roar, its massive head thrusting into the world with its huge mouth agape.
Boom!
Darkness fell over heaven and earth as that vast Giant Beast head obscured everything, and in an act of Devouring that seemed to consume both sky and earth, an instantaneous Hollow of a thousand kilometers in diameter was bitten out of the world.
In this span, space, earth, and all matter and forces were Devoured, including the Deep Red Destruction Beast, leaving only the Python that spanned the world, exuding an indescribable aura of terror.
But before the Silver Giant Dragon and others outside the world could express their outrage with furious roars, the Python that had entered the world suddenly let out a roar of alarm and rage.
Boom! The Ancient Giant Python’s neck exploded with a loud bang, a red and white beam of light wreathed in red lightning pierced through heaven and earth, exuding an overwhelmingly terrifying Destructive Aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 1273 - 1273 495 The Ancient Covenant the Python
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1273: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World_4 Chapter 1273: Chapter 495: The Ancient Covenant, the Python Encircling the World_4 As a strike pierced through the interior space of the Ancient Giant Python, shattering its neck and landing onto the earth below, an instantaneously dazzling red circle of light rose from the ground.
Boom!
The sky shattered and the earth split, as endless destructive red light swept across heaven and earth. Rocks as hard as iron within a radius of over a thousand kilometers burst into the sky, shaking the entire world even more intensely.
At the same time, in the raging Void, the Red Destruction Beast, surrounded by red lightning, stood tall, the glow on the three rows of Dorsal Fins on its back slowly dimming.
Roar!
The Ancient Giant Python entwined around the world roared, a powerful strength Burst forth from its body, slowly suppressing the shaking world. The blown-up neck had already healed back to its original state.
In this form, it had no physical body and was a manifestation of the Law Power.
Looking at the huge python wrapped around the sky, the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly spoke in a deep and majestic roar that echoed through heaven and earth, “Stop fighting, let’s not fight anymore.”
…Having prepared to burn its Origin to suppress and expel the Red Beast, the Ancient Giant Python paused.
Looking at the terrifying beast below, the Ancient Giant Python let out a roar that shook heaven and earth, “Foreign Red Beast, what do you mean by this?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, “The meaning is simple. Your strength has gained my recognition; you are qualified to guard the Law Divine Object nurtured by this world.”
The strength of this Ancient Giant Python was formidable; the Destruction Emperor Dragon estimated that to kill the adversary, it too would have to burn its Origin, which would be a great expenditure of power.
Of course, it had another purpose in stopping the fight.
In the Ancient Giant Python’s gaze of surprise and suspicion, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled again, “Get to know me, I am the Beast Empire’s Dragon Palace Thunderflame Dragon King, Tim Abott, Brock Abbott.”
The Ancient Giant Python fell silent for a moment, seemingly weighing the Dual Forces, before finally growling slowly, “I am the great Carmen Dodd Felix Copperfield…”
After speaking, the Ancient Giant Python paused, and confusion showed in its enormous eyes, “Wait a minute, King of the Dragon Palace Thunderflame, did you just say I am qualified to guard the Law Divine Object nurtured by this world?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, “Yes, I entered your world with the goal of obtaining the Law Divine Object nurtured by this world.”
“This time I led the mighty army of the Dragon Palace deep into the Chaotic Turbulent Region to collect all resources to strengthen ourselves, naturally, I would not overlook a Law Level Divine Artifact.”
As he spoke these words, the tone of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was filled with a matter-of-factness.
This was the rule of the Giant Beast World, the law of the jungle where nothing was off-limits to be seized by sheer strength.
However, after the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking, the eyes of the Ancient Giant Python revealed a trace of sorrow and indignation, unable to help but roar, “Roar! Why didn’t you say so earlier? If you had said you wanted those two Stone Hearts, the great Carmen Dodd would have given them to you.”
The Law Level Divine Artifact sensed by the Single-horned Spawn Roc was a kind of Stone Heart, nurtured in the depths of this world’s Earth and containing rich Earth energy along with complete Law Charm.
But to the Ancient Giant Python, which had already stepped into the Ancient Titan level and mastered Higher-order Laws like Earth Law and Petrification, such a thing had little use; consuming it would only boost a bit of energy.
At the Ancient Titan Level, the precious Law Level Divine Artifacts were no longer helpful to Titan behemoths; only higher-grade Heaven and Earth Treasures could make a difference in their advancement.
Over countless years, this world had condensed two Stone Hearts, which were simply devoured as snacks by the hibernating python upon its awakening.
Never did it expect that today, because of such a commonplace item, it had been given a thrashing by this abnormally powerful Red Beast. Thinking of this, the Ancient Giant Python felt both aggrieved and indignant.
If it weren’t aware that it couldn’t defeat this terrifying Red Beast, the Ancient Giant Python would have already lashed out in fury.
Er… Watching the slightly agitated Ancient Giant Python, the Destruction Emperor Dragon also paused, and the atmosphere between them grew somewhat subtle.
After about a few minutes, the Ancient Giant Python’s emotions finally settled, and the shattered center of the continental blocks below trembled, tearing open a crack hundreds of kilometers long.
From the depths of the cracks, two ten-meter-sized, lotus-shaped, grey jade stones imbued with the Earth Law Charm slowly rose and finally came to a halt in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Though these two Lotus Jades did not appear large, their interiors contained boundless, ocean-like pure energy and Law vibrations.
The Ancient Giant Python took a deep breath, and in an instant, a hurricane of over twenty levels swept the world. It growled softly, “This is what you want, Thunderflame Dragon King—take it.”
This… seemed a bit too easy to obtain. The Destruction Emperor Dragon, glowing in red light, extended its massive claw and grasped the two Stone Hearts.
Seeing that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had taken the items but showed no sign of leaving, a hint of wariness flashed in the Ancient Giant Python’s eyes, “Thunderflame Dragon King, is there anything else?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled softly, “Carmen Dodd, today our fight has led to an acquaintanceship; I wonder if you’d be interested in joining the Dragon Palace.”
“…Join the Dragon Palace?” The Ancient Giant Python paused.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, “Yes, an upheaval is about to occur in the Chaotic Domain, and once I break through to the Ancient Level, I plan to lead the rest of the Dragon Kings to sweep through the Domain.”
“By then, all the behemoths that do not submit will be Suppressed and eliminated.”
As he spoke of sweeping through the Chaotic Domain, an invisible and terrifying aura of slaughter emanated from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, coloring the sky red and causing the Ancient Giant Python to involuntarily twitch at the corners of its eyes.
The mention of the other Dragon Kings by the Destruction Emperor Dragon made the python somewhat solemn, “Thunderflame Dragon King, there are other Dragon Kings in your Dragon Palace Empire?”
[There are still a thousand words being fine-tuned, please wait]
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, “Indeed, apart from me, there are seven other Dragon Kings in the Dragon Palace Empire, each wielding various formidable powers.”
“For example, ‘day and night'”

chapters.title: Chapter 1274 - 1274 496 True Name Reaction Return to Blue
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1274: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star Chapter 1274: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star Over the broken continent, a ferocious Giant Beast stood like a mountain of Red Scales, surrounded by blood-red lightning that exuded an aura of destruction capable of annihilating heaven and earth.
When the Ancient Giant Python hesitated about joining the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire with seven Dragon Kings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took out a ten-meter, token-shaped Black-red Scale from the Reverse Scale Space.
A deep and authoritative Dragon Roar then resonated through Heaven and Earth, “This is my Dragon Palace Token. You only need to intertwine a strand of the Power of Law on it.”
As a giant beast power, with territory expanding and membership increasing, the Destruction Emperor Dragon developed the second-generation Dragon King Scale with an identification feature for communication and connection.
Every Giant Beast holding a Dragon King Scale had an ‘esteemed’ status and could activate a strand of law within it to contact the Destruction Emperor Dragon and summon a projection of its Will for conversation.
This function was similar to how the Level 9 Black Python once contacted the Black Oblivion King.
“Dragon Palace Token, huh,” the Ancient Giant Python’s Power of Will enveloped and twined around the Black-red Scale with a low roar.
Under the Will imbued with the Power of Law, all the mysteries within the Dragon King Scale were unveiled, instantly dispelling the last of the Ancient Giant Python’s concerns.
It seemed the Red Beast was not deceiving it—it indeed intended to form an alliance.
At this thought, the Ancient Giant Python willed it, and in an instant, a gray-white rule power descended between heaven and earth, weaving into threads that marked the Thunderflame Dragon King’s Mandate.
Watching the Ancient Python swallow the Dragon King Scale with one gulp, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled into a vicious smile as it roared softly, “Welcome to the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.”
“From today onwards, Carmen Dodd, you are the ninth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, titled the Serpent that Entwines the World, with the right to participate in the Dragon King Hall deliberations.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon also granted a Dragon King title to the powerful Ancient Titan Python.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon once thought there were too many Dragon Kings in the palace and did not intend to appoint any more, but then, after the Titan Longa King joined, he gave it a rightful place in the Dragon Palace, consolidating its position with the title of Dragon King.
Now, since there were already so many Dragon Kings, one more or one fewer made no difference, especially if Ancient Titan Beasts were not qualified to be Dragon Kings, then certainly no other Giant Beasts would be.
As for the so-called Dragon King Hall, it was an ‘institution’ for deliberation that Destruction Emperor Dragon temporarily came up with.
As the Dragon Palace Empire grew stronger, with more Titan Level and even Ancient-level Giant Beasts joining, the Silver Giant Dragon, as the Dragon Palace Dragon King, found it increasingly difficult to suppress these Giant Beasts.
That included the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, both with Dragon King titles.
These two Giant Beasts, currently at quasi-mythical Growth Level, were a mismatch amongst a crowd of Mythical Giant Beasts, Titan Beasts, and even Ancient Beasts.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon suppressed any discord for the time being, it still needed to balance things in advance.
Such as establishing a Dragon King Hall, to which only those holding a Dragon King title could enter and join the deliberations with its permission. Currently, the Nine-heads and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle only had the right to enter without any right to deliberate.
They would, at least, have to break through to the Mythical level before they could speak in the Dragon King Hall.
Of course, the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not mean to belittle these earliest followers; on the contrary, this act was a form of protection for them.
In the Giant Beast World, the hierarchy is strict. To Mythical Giant Beasts, Titan Level Beasts are kings; they must either submit or risk being expelled or killed—not to mention Ancient Beasts.
The Dragon Palace was currently so ‘harmonious’ precisely because the Level 9 Giant Beasts could freely roar in front of Titan Beasts, all due to the suppression exerted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Otherwise, in the rage of a Titan, not just Level 9 Beasts but even Mythical Beasts would suffer heavy injuries, torn to shreds within a few moves.
At that moment, as the two sides became allies, the tense atmosphere between heaven and earth eased, and with a thought, the Destruction Emperor Dragon began to dissipate the red lightning around it, its body rapidly shrinking in size.
Soon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon returned to its normal state of over two thousand five hundred meters, its Aura slightly weakened.
At the same time, the Ancient Giant Python that twined around it dissipated, and as endless gray-white Power of Law converged, it retransformed into its Giant Beast Body of a Gray Python measuring over four thousand six hundred meters.
This scene made the Destruction Emperor Dragon pause, uncertain whether to say the opponent was daring or recklessly fearless.
The path of Giant Beasts is different from humans. Inside the body of a Titan Giant Beast, the Law Talent and the Giant Beast Body merge to form a complete ‘world’, giving birth to rules, breaking through to ancient times.
After breaking through to Ancient-level, under normal conditions, one should assimilate the Power of Heaven and Earth from the mythical world, continue to strengthen the merged Giant Beast Body, and ultimately reach a limit.
Once the shackles are broken and the rules held are acknowledged by heaven and earth, the true name is etched deep into the core Origin of the mythical world, and life is elevated to an Ancient True Spirit Level Giant Beast.
If the breakthrough fails, one either falls or petrifies, becoming an ancient creature.
That is to say, the Destruction Emperor Dragon at the Mythical level was already acknowledged by heaven and earth and would naturally evolve to become an Ancient True Spirit Level Giant Beast.
And this was not even the limit for the Destruction Emperor Dragon; due to its Heavenly Tier Position Pattern, its starting point was already at the Ancient True Spirit Level.
This was also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon was surprised; this Ancient Giant Python from the ancient early stages had actually spent time and consumed its Origin to petrify this World Fragment.
In petrifying this fragment of the world, it even merged its Giant Beast Body into this realm, creating a world fragment the size of Blue Star surrounded by the Void, nurturing its own rules.

chapters.title: Chapter 1275 - 1275 496 True Name Reaction Return to Blue
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1275: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_2 Chapter 1275: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_2 The advantage of doing this was that once successful, its Giant Beast Body would become incredibly strong, its every movement equivalent to the terrifying power of a planet, including Defense.
And by bearing the rules of One-side World, its Rule evolution and growth speed were also faster.
However, its weakness was evident; until it completely refined and recast the Giant Beast Body from this World Fragment, it could not leave this place, or its strength would plummet to the Titan Peak.
Furthermore, if it encountered a stronger Giant Beast that destroyed the world before it completely refined this World Fragment, or even just demolished a corner, it would cause it irreversible heavy injury.
Because this was a Fragment of Great World, exposed and not an intact small world that could hide in a Space Interlayer, the destruction would be much simpler.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, gazing at the Giant Python that was massive like a gray mountain range, suddenly said, “Carmen Dodd, I feel your name lacks impact, shall I help you change it?”
“Change my name?” The Ancient Giant Python was startled.
Its name came from what some minor different races called it after it became a Mythical Giant Beast, and after those minor different races went ‘sick’ and became extinct, it had been hibernating here ever since.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded and roared softly, “Yes, I think you should be named Jormungand.”
“Jormungand.” Just as the Ancient Giant Python whispered this name in a low hiss, it felt something indescribable, as if it connected with some powerful force.
As an ancient creature that had mastered rules, although not very intelligent due to ‘experience,’ the Ancient Giant Python felt the extraordinariness of this name instantly.
So after a brief pause, the Ancient Giant Python slightly swaggered and issued a declarative and majestic roar that shook Heaven and Earth, “From today onwards, my name shall be Jormungand Felix Kobophel.”
In an instant, the Sea of Consciousness of the Ancient Giant Python trembled slightly, and deep within its body, it seemed like some power was awakening, with strands of ancient and desolate aura spreading from the Giant Python.
This change caused the Destruction Emperor Dragon to pause once more before roaring, “Jormungand, continue refining the world here. I will continue to delve deeper into the Chaotic Domain to collect resources.”
With that said, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly released its right claw, swallowing the two Stone Hearts in one gulp.
Boom!
The moment the two Law Level Divine Artifacts were swallowed, two dense and heavy bursts of yellow energy exploded, sweeping over the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s entire body like a tsunami.
Amidst this surge of Earth Origin yellow energy, numerous pure Law Charms were mixed, and instantly the Higher-order Law merged with the Emperor Dragon’s body and flesh became unruly.
Crackle Crackle!! Under the forceful wash of Earth Origin energy, the Destruction Emperor Dragon radiated yellow light all over, inflating like a balloon being blown up.
Two thousand five hundred and forty meters, fifty meters, seventy meters… six hundred meters…
Boom! Just as its body length breached two thousand six hundred meters, endless golden flames erupted from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Corrosion Law-infused purple-golden flames burned, enveloping an area of two hundred kilometers, invisibly releasing fierce heat that pierced through space and vaporized rock and Earth.
Within the sea of fire, blue-purple Thunder Dragons roared, black and red Destructive Lightning danced, and the invisible Destructive Aura caused even the Ancient Giant Python to feel apprehensive, subconsciously appearing more than two hundred kilometers away.
Looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast standing within the purple-golden flames, the Ancient Giant Python’s eyes widened in disbelief.
“How is this possible, its digestion and growth speed are so fast!?”
It seemed that as soon as it consumed the Stone Heart, its body size grew just as if its Giant Beast Body and the Law Talent fused with its body didn’t need to evolve at all.
And those powers wrapped around it, one, two, three… Hiss!
Feeling the nine Higher-order Law Powers entwined around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Ancient Giant Python couldn’t help but take a sharp breath as a raging wind howled between heaven and earth.
No wonder this fellow is so terrifying, nine Higher-order Laws! What kind of freak is this, it’s too frightening.
As a Giant Beast mastering three Higher-order Laws and various talents, the Ancient Giant Python was acutely aware of how fearsome the Destruction Emperor Dragon was, especially when it stepped into the Ancient Level.
But in contrast to the Ancient Giant Python’s shock, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, feeling the ‘surge’ in strength within, wasn’t very satisfied.
After reaching the Titan Level, the paths of the Giant Beasts and human cultivators overlapped somewhat, with both at this realm integrating the rules and talents they possessed.
This integration wasn’t just a simple embedding but a fusion at the Laws’ Origin, where the base might of each equi-level rule doubled with each integration, cumulatively stacking.
Under these circumstances, Law Mysteries that could unleash several times or even up to fifteen times the might, and Combat Techniques with even more potent destructive power, could be triggered.
Therefore, those king-level beings at the same level, wielding three or four laws, were far stronger in battle capability and had more methods than those with just one or two laws.
However, this Law Integration only doubles for the same level; lower the level of Law integrated, the smaller the enhancement gain, e.g., Higher-order Law integrates Lower Law X1.2, integrates Intermediate Law X1.5.
This is also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon, upon entering the Deep Red Form, could experience a Major Realm surge in combat power.
With the Deep Red Form, the integration of nine Higher-order Laws granted traits that only Ancient Beasts possessed, and coupled with an increase in size bringing twenty-fold base strength and Defense enhancement, this allowed it to clash with Ancient Beasts head-on.
As such, when it later reaches the Ancient Titan Level, only the sheer scale increase provided by the Deep Red Form will amplify its power, while the advantage of the Law Integration will be leveled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1276 - 1276 496 True Name Reaction Return to Blue
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1276: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_3 Chapter 1276: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_3 And this was actually the norm; after all, the Deep Red Strength evolved from the Giantification Talent was only a Higher-order Law, not even at the Supreme level. Its considerable improvement was due to the strong foundation of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
However, the advantages of law fusion after reaching the Ancient Level would be flattened, but this did not mean that the strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon would weaken.
Or rather, only upon stepping into the Ancient Titan could its Giant Beast Body and the nine advantages of Higher-order Laws be fully unleashed, taking control of the Rule to suppress everything.
The effects of the two Law Level Divine Artifact Stone Hearts were roughly equivalent to the flesh and blood of two Titan Giant Beasts, causing the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body to surge in length to two thousand seven hundred meters in one breath.
Huff! The increasingly colossal Destruction Emperor Dragon stood amidst the searing chaotic streams, exhaling hot gales through its nostrils, with the Thunderflame that wrapped around its body gradually converging, its voice deep and resonant.
“Jormungand, I’m leaving.”
Boom!
The space beneath the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s feet, not yet healed, shattered again, and its massive form flashed to the edge of the Void a thousand kilometers above, its double claws reaching into the Void, tearing the Boundary Wall.
Instantly, the entire grey rock world shook once again as the Boundary Wall was ripped open by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, creating a crack tens of thousands of meters long.
“Roar! Tim Abott, aren’t we going to kill that Ancient Beast this time?”
As they watched the Black-red Colossal Beast return through the mist to the Void, both the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, along with the Gold-blue Giant Dragon came flying over with some confusion.
Because they were separated by a One-side World, although they could see the bright light of the battle, including the last strike that enveloped the world, they could not hear the conversation between the two Giant Beasts.
“Jormungand has considerable strength and has earned my recognition. I have already invited it to join the Dragon Palace Empire,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled as it briefly explained what took place within the world.
This included the fact that the Ancient Giant Python could not leave temporarily due to its refining of the world.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon grew somewhat excited, “Roar! Tim Abott, you’re so mighty, an Ancient Beast has actually become a subordinate of the Great Sethia.”
Roar Roar!!
The excited Silver Giant Dragon circled around the Destruction Emperor Dragon incessantly, letting out a succession of elated Dragon Roars: “If Mother knows about this news, it’ll definitely give her a shock.”
Looking at the satisfied Silver Giant Dragon circling around, the Gold-blue Giant Dragon was also somewhat in a daze.
The mother of the Gold-blue Giant Dragon was at the late period of Titan Growth Level, and the mother of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Blue-White Giant Dragon, was even stronger, having stepped into the Titan Level and on the verge of the final breakthrough.
And for the two dragons that were still at Level 9 and had just broken through to Mythical Giant Beast not long ago, their titan-level mothers were already unimaginably powerful beings.
But now, their Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire had already subjugated an Ancient Titan as their underling, the change had come too quickly, and both Giant Beasts were feeling overwhelmed.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon had defeated the ancient creature before, even driving it to its demise, the shock was still not as great as subjugating an Ancient Beast now.
Looking at the formidable and immense Black-red Colossal Beast in front of them, the Gold-blue Giant Dragon’s tail quivered with excitement.
This dragon, known as Thunderflame, was too strong. Just a few Sun Wheels ago when it followed Sethia and got to know Thunderflame, it had just broken through the Legendary Realm.
Such a terrifying growth rate, paired with its fearsome battle strength—if they were to have an offspring…
As the Gold-blue Giant Dragon daydreamed, the Single-horned Spawn Roc also came over, uttering excited yelps: “Thunderflame, Thunderflame, you are so mighty, you have subdued such a huge fellow.”
Roar roar roar!! It’s a pity that Domination and Kidora aren’t here; they missed the moment when you were so awesomely badass.”
…After enjoying the flattering feeling from his juniors for a while, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low growl, “Sethia, Jormungand is the ninth Dragon King of the empire, titled the Serpent that Envelops Worlds.”
“In terms of level, all Dragon Kings are equal, so there is no question of who is whose subordinate, understand?”
“Roar! Don’t worry, Tim Abott, the Great Sethia isn’t a fool.” The Silver Giant Dragon understood the reminder from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, to hold reverence for power.
The other was an Ancient-level Giant Beast, two Major Realms higher than it who had just broken through the Legendary Realm, and could swallow it whole in one bite if provoked.
“Alright, let’s go.”
Roar!
A fierce and majestic Dragon Roar thundered through the Void, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon spreading its double wings, over four thousand meters wide, and flew towards the depths of the Void, eclipsing the sky.
Roar Roar!! The Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-blue Giant Dragon also let out lofty Dragon Roars, spreading their wings and orbiting around the mountain-like Destruction Emperor Dragon.
As the feedback of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strength increase rippled through him in another space-time, Jack Clark felt the vibrations within his body, and streams of Evolution Energy emerged unceasingly.
Under the reinforcement of this bizarre Evolution Energy, Jack’s flesh became even more formidable, and the invisible aura surrounding him caused the calm lake below to ripple slightly.
This human’s strength was growing stronger again!!
From afar, a three thousand meter long White Giant Dragon lay across the Void, its vast Dragon Eyes observing Jack as his aura continued to rise, revealing a numb expression.
In the chaos of intersecting space-times, Jack Clark had been in Closed-door Cultivation for over two months.
During this time, his aura had been constantly rising, and the rapid rate of growth shocked the Time Dragon, astonished that there could be such a terrifying race between heaven and earth.
At that moment around Jack, a pair of silver wing-like phantoms spreading over a thousand meters faintly appeared, frenziedly absorbing the Time Power pervading their surroundings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1277 - 1277 496 True Name Reaction Return to Blue
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1277: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_4 Chapter 1277: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_4 Behind him stretched a transparent stream for a kilometer, upon which nine figures of Jack Clark stood tall, their overlapping forms causing time itself to tremble and emanate a terrifying aura.
The ninth figure was still somewhat blurry, but it was visibly solidifying bit by bit at a speed discernible to the naked eye.
After over two months of closed-door cultivation, fueled by an ample concentration of the Power of Time, the Mark of Time was nearing grand accomplishment.
Besides, although the Time Hollow was isolated from space-time and lacked Heavenly Energy, as an Innate Demon God, Jack Clark could draw strength directly from the Chaos Void.
With the suppression of the Last Dharma Rule removed, a little accumulation had allowed the True Demon God Body and his laws to breakthrough the late period of Myth.
Only the Supreme Law was progressing slowly due to the sealing of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, and he would need to wait to return to the present world to seek the help of the First Councilor and others to undo the Seal.
As time passed, the ninth shadow behind Jack Clark became increasingly distinct, and when it finally coalesced completely, an aura of Perfect Reincarnation, terrifyingly profound, spread out.
Boom! An invisible, horrifying aura spread, causing the originally calm Time Hollow to shake violently, making the lake roar in alarm, startling the Power of Time itself.
Roar! The Time Dragon roared, bursting into a dazzling display of silver radiance, where everything it passed fell into stasis, including the trembling time itself.
But within this frozen domain of time, the winding stream behind Jack Clark continued to flow unaffected, invisibly carrying the aura of a self-contained cycle of reincarnation.
Upon the stream stood nine majestic figures, as vivid and solid as if Jack Clark were occupying different segments of time.
The Time Dragon roared, “Roar! Human, hurry up and retract your Time Mystic Power, or else the Hollow will soon shatter under the impact of two Time Powers.”
With black hair cascading over his shoulders, Jack Clark smiled slightly, apologetically saying, “I apologize, Prince Kulapavida, I was unable to restrain my aura when the Mystic Power was first accomplished.”
Saying this, Jack Clark moved his thoughts, and the silver feather shadows that unfolded around him dissipated, including the stream and the nine marks behind him, which turned into silver light and tinted the nine strands of his frontal hair silver.
A strand consisting of about twenty to thirty hairs, the nine silver strands mixed within his black hair lent Jack Clark a more mature look, and an indefinable sense of age.
As Jack Clark retracted the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power, the Time Dragon also gradually dissipated the force of the Time Rule, and the lake surface below once again became calm.
Looking at the white Giant Dragon that had finally breathed a sigh of relief, Jack Clark smiled lightly, “Prince Kulapavida, you’ve had a hard time these days; next, I plan to leave this place.”
“What, you can go back now?” The Time Dragon was stunned.
Due to a different perception of time, in the Time Dragon’s view, the ‘time’ Jack Clark mentioned as needing ‘to break the seal gradually’ meant at least several years, if not decades.
After all, it was not uncommon for it to sleep for several decades, and it had not expected that Jack Clark could return so soon, in what amounted to merely the duration of a nap to it.
Jack Clark nodded, “Yes, the Hell Power sealed inside of me has been broken through, and I can now jump back using the Hell Coordinates.”
This Time Dragon, lurking around the Demon Domain of Diorus, surely had witnessed his summoning of Supreme Hell; therefore, there was no need to conceal the matter of the Hell Coordinates.
Or perhaps it had known this all along, which is why it was convinced Jack Clark had a way to return.
At that moment, the Time Dragon growled lowly, “Human, wait for me a moment.” With that, the Time Dragon took a deep breath and extended its claw, vigorously pulling at its chest.
Boom! With the vibration of terrifying power, a diamond-shaped Dragon Scale, over seventy meters in diameter and more than thirty meters thick, was wrenched off.
The Time Dragon then carefully slit open the Dragon Skin at its chest, allowing a droplet of bright silver Dragon Blood to fall onto the Dragon Scale, and then the dragon flame in its mouth erupted.
Huff Huff!!
Under the roaring white dragon flame, the Dragon Scale emitted a blinding Radiance, slowly absorbing the blood imbued with a trace of the Time Dragon’s soul breath.
Seeing this, Jack Clark stood with his hands behind his back, his expression calm as he waited from afar.
In fact, over a month ago, the Hell Eye had already corroded and broken the seal of the Supreme Rule, but Jack Clark had delayed for another month to refine the Mark of Time.
This trip to a past time-space had yielded substantial gains for Jack Clark. Apart from acquiring the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power, his greatest achievement was collecting a vast number of Ancient Techniques.
Each of these techniques represented a path, although the lengths of these paths varied, and while they could not be cultivated, they enriched Jack Clark’s cultivation intrinsic knowledge as references.
For example, by assimilating the essence of these techniques, combining the five Higher-order Laws, the Supreme Law, the three great Divine Powers, and the newly acquired six ‘Innate’ traits, he could reconstruct his True Demon God Body.
He would forge his own Combat Divine Scripture, preparing for the breakthrough from Heavenly King to Supreme.
Even the Basic Body Refining Technique had finished its ninth level deduction during this time, ready to be taken back for others to cultivate and test.
The reason he did not stay here to cultivate for a few more years or decades and elevate his cultivation to the peak of Heavenly King before returning, was that he could not afford to delay any longer.
A delay would lead to trouble.
The Power of Time covered billions of worlds, vast and boundless, crossing an infinite past and an infinite future, profoundly mysterious.
Even a Time Being like the Time Dragon, which had almost stepped into the Ancient Realm, only grasped a mere fraction of Time Power, let alone the ability to traverse to the future at will.
Usually, they roamed the edges of time, through some cracks in time.
The reason the Time Dragon and Jack Clark came here was due to the sacrifice of a Titan Time Being’s Crystal Core that detonated, triggering a Time Burst in the depths of the Space-Time Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 1278 - 1278 496 True Name Reaction Return to Blue
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1278: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_5 Chapter 1278: Chapter 496 True Name Reaction, Return to Blue Star_5 Under normal conditions, being swept up by a Time Storm would result in appearing in an unknown time or the future, forever rejected by time and unable to return to one’s original space-time.
This was also the reason for the Time Dragon’s panic at the time.
Jack Clark could return because he had the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which was part of him, anchoring and locking down to the original time period, and with the aid of the Hell Coordinate, he leaped back.
Otherwise, even with the Hell Coordinate, he wouldn’t be able to accurately lock onto the time to jump back to.
If the jump was incorrect, appearing in a time period before he was caught in the Space-Time Chaos, the simultaneous existence of two ‘Jack Clarks’ would instantly trigger a local space-time confusion.
Then he would be completely devoured by time and never able to return.
And if the jump led to dozens or hundreds of years in the future, the consequences would be equally severe. By then, the Human Race might have already been annihilated by The Purgatory Family, and relatives and friends would have long turned to ashes.
Naturally, Jack did not wish to see this outcome.
At present, with his other half, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, anchoring time, Jack only knew that more than ten days had passed in the future, but the specifics were unclear.
Because the time he was in was increasingly chaotic.
From the beginning in the Lost World, a day or two would directly pass on the side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, to the future where a short while for the Destruction Emperor Dragon was several days passing on his side.
Under this chaotic perception of time, Jack and the thoughts of the Destruction Emperor Dragon often became confused, stagnant, and blank in this period, feeling as if they were going insane.
So there could be no further delay; otherwise, Jack couldn’t be sure what unpredictable risks might occur.
At this moment, the Time Dragon extinguished the dragon flame in its mouth. An Invisible Power swept up a silver dragon scale, about a meter in size, and flew it in front of Jack, who was greeted with a low growl.
“Human, once you return to the future space-time, just activating the strength within will allow me to locate and return. I’m indebted to you,” the Time Dragon spoke very politely.
Jack smiled lightly, “Don’t worry, Prince Kulapavida. I’ll keep my promise to you; the word of our Human Race is as good as gold.”
“And not to mention the twice you aided me; even for Scythia’s sake, I would choose to help you. After all, the Thunderflame Beheamoth it contracted with is a good friend.”
Jack’s words eased the anxiety in the Time Dragon’s heart because it too had worried that Jack would not assist it upon returning to the future, which would mean it would have to wander forever in the Space-Time Chaos.
The Time Dragon’s face showed a humanized fierce smile as it quietly growled, “Thank you. From today onward, the Human Race will be great Kulapavida’s good friend.”
“If you need help in the future, Jack, you may activate the power of the Heart Scale and inform me. I can help you out once for free.”
“You’re too kind, Prince Kulapavida,” said Jack, with a light smile, though he did not refuse.
This Time Dragon had already taken half a step into Ancient Level. Once it made its breakthrough and completed its transformation, its strength would become unimaginably terrifying.
Especially the Time Power it wielded.
Hu!
Jack took a deep breath as dark red fine scales emerged on his face, with a blood-red eye slowly opening on his forehead. In an instant, a terrifying aura of Blood Fiend ferocity burst forth.
The surroundings were engulfed in endless blood light radiating from Jack, space-time distorted, and a shadow of a Supreme world filled with endless blood light emerged, submerging Jack within it.
Boom!
Space-time trembled; under the power of Supreme Hell, Jack vanished in an instant, only to reappear in a world where both the sky and Earth were dark red.
This world was shrouded in crimson blood light; the thick red glow, like blood, obscured vision, and even Jack’s eyesight could not penetrate very far.
He could only make out at the ends of Heaven and Earth, a massive shadow as large as a planet standing upright, surrounded by endless blood light circling it, forming a twisted world shadow.
And the moment Jack glimpsed that majestic figure, an indescribable, deathly threat loomed over him, as if he could die the next instant.
This sense of deadly threat was the most intense Jack had felt since he started on the path of cultivation.
“Go!”
Boom!
Dazzling blood light burst from Jack, the price to pay for his return to the future. The endless Qi Blood erupted like a supernova explosion, sweeping across more than a thousand kilometers.
The brilliance caught the attention of the towering figure almost immediately.
With a slight expression of surprise and a terrifying gaze descending,
Boom!
The area where Jack had been collapsed, space-time distorted and shook, and a dreadful strength even traced back through time, slowly revealing Jack’s silhouette.
But just as Jack’s projection surfaced, as if triggering some power, a more vast will descended from the Supreme Firmament above.
Thud!
The gaze filled with dreadful will dispersed, and then a deep voice infused with grandeur echoed throughout Hell.
“I did not expect that a mere Level 2 Hell Messenger would attract the attention of the great Origin of Supreme Hell. Interesting…”
With a resonant voice, the majestic figure moved, walking amidst the shaking space-time; the twisted world’s shadow that enveloped it collapsed with a thunderous sound, and the countless Living Beings within it wailed in despair.
“I did not expect that a mere Level 2 Hell Messenger would attract the attention of the great Origin of Supreme Hell. Interesting…”
With a resonant voice, the majestic figure moved, walking amidst the shaking space-time; the twisted world’s shadow that enveloped it collapsed with a thunderous sound, and the countless Living Beings within it wailed in despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279 - 1279 497 The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1279: Chapter 497 The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back! Chapter 1279: Chapter 497 The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back! “`
“This time, I’ve really been drained dry…”
In front of the colossal black gate that soared ten thousand meters high, Jack Clark weakly leaned against the stone gate, listless and out of breath.
At this moment, his body was covered with blood-colored cracks, like a shattered porcelain cruelly pieced back together with glue.
This ‘injury’ was even more severe than when he had fallen into the Lost World. The instant he leaped and returned, the Divine Soul power, Law Divine Power, Qi Blood, and even vitality within Jack Clark’s body were completely siphoned away.
And none was left—not even a drop—leaving him so weak that an average demon king could defeat him.
As for those below the demon king, they need not be considered; they couldn’t even breach Jack Clark’s defenses. Merely the oppressive force field emanating from his True Body was enough to prevent them from approaching, even if he were to lie there motionless.
Feeling the extreme emptiness of his True Body, along with the tearing sensation from his Divine Soul, Jack Clark felt that he would be weak for at least half a day this time.
As for why it would only be half a day, that’s because once he regained a bit of strength, he would directly seek the First Councilor’s aid to break the Seal.
Afterward, by activating the Space-Time Altar and summoning the True Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, he could have the Purple little dragon nurse him back to health.
Earlier, in the clash against Diorus’s two Demon Gods, he had sustained a heavy injury from maintaining the Crimson form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon for an extended period, nearly burning out his Life Origin.
Under normal conditions, such an injury would have already damaged the foundation of his being.
Although later on, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew and made a breakthrough, the Evolution Energy that ensued fortified his physical body, healing most of the wounds. However, the depleted Life Origin couldn’t be restored.
Unless there was a Creation-level Divine Object to supplement it, or he could make a breakthrough to a higher realm in a short period, breaking free from the shackles of life and undergoing another Transformation.
For Jack Clark, both issues were easily solvable; even without the aid of the Purple little dragon, he was confident he could break through to the Heavenly King realm in a short time.
The reason for fighting to the limits was but to kill three birds with one stone.
While pretending weakness to the enemy and reducing the perceived threat he posed to those demon gods from Diorus, it was also to lure the Time Silver Butterfly into action.
In addition, enduring heavy injury, he managed to delay the War of Extermination instigated by the two great empires, granting him and the Federation more time to grow.
Considering it all, his covert mission into the rear of the Purgatory Empire to steal crystal had achieved all its objectives perfectly.
Just as Jack Clark leaned against the stone gate and pondered, his body was also frantically absorbing the energy of the Chaos Void to recover, the wounds on his skin visibly fading away.
About an hour later, Jack Clark finally let out a breath.
In that hour, the Law Divine Power inside him had recovered by ten percent, his physical wounds had mostly healed, and his strength had returned to about twenty percent.
Feeling the ‘strength’ once again fuelling his body, Jack Clark stood up with a faint smile on his face and looked forward to the world of black winds howling and thunder roaring.
Although Jack Clark was currently within the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, there existed an invisible barrier between him and the entire Plane.
Under that Seal, both the Law of Strength and the Plane’s power were unresponsive. This was a force concerning the Supreme Rule; only power of an equal level could break it.
However, as this Rule force had no foundation, the First Councilor should have no problem breaking through it.
After casting a deep glance at the sealed Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, Jack Clark pushed open a sliver of the black gate and vanished from sight.
In Mist River City, just after four in the afternoon, the warm autumn sunlight spilled in from outside the window, brightening the living room.
At this time, the second-floor bedroom door opened, and Jack Clark, with long black hair cascading over his shoulders, walked out, his face a bit pale, giving off a very ‘weak’ appearance.
He was dressed in a long-sleeved gray T-shirt and white pants, casual attire.
During this time, Glenn Clark was still in school, and Doris Clark should’ve been at the company, so the house was empty.
But as soon as Jack Clark opened the door, the sound immediately alerted the strong men in the surroundings, and a series of subtle auras fluctuated.
Jack Clark, who had deliberately made noise, said indifferently, “Everyone, there’s no need for alarm—it’s me.”
Immediately, a voice filled with surprised restraint responded, “Divine Martial Throne, you’ve returned!?”
Jack Clark replied indifferently, “Yes, I’m back from handling some business. By the way, let Marcellus Larry know that I’ll visit him tomorrow morning and enter the mythical world.”
“Understood.”
The news of Jack Clark’s return spread rapidly among the Federal Top Level. In less than a few minutes, all the denizens of the Ninth Heavens and several king-level figures who safeguarded the realm were aware of his return.
Many exhaled in relief.
At the Military Base on the Southern Battlefield, under the shelter of the World Origin given by Jack Clark, Brulu Warren, with his aura concealed and on the verge of fully stepping into the Legendary Realm, showed a smile.
“I told you he couldn’t possibly come to harm. A talent of such calibre possesses great Luck—this time, perhaps his strength has surged tremendously due to this misfortune.”
…
After lifting the nearby alerts, Jack Clark made his way to the living room on the first floor.
Leaning back on the comfortable sofa, he sighed in content as the soft warmth of the sunlight fell upon him through the window.
It had been a long time since he had felt such an easy and leisurely sensation; ever since he had been to the Kelaya Battlefield, his spirit had gradually tensed up.
The more secrets he uncovered with the rise of his power and the stronger enemies he faced, the more intense Jack Clark’s feeling of an unseen urgency became.
It was so intense that it compelled him to constantly cultivate and improve.
This, in fact, was a manifestation of insecurity, a subconscious distrust of everyone around.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1280 - 1280 497 The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1280: Chapter 497: The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back!_2 Chapter 1280: Chapter 497: The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back!_2 “`
Feeling insecure is easy to explain. As a transmigrator with my memory restored, in this world with extraordinary strength, one always feels insecure unless they become the strongest.
As for distrust, it means doubting whether those kings, Heavenly Kings, and Supreme Experts could withstand the threats from foreign races.
This was Jack Clark’s miscalculation of the overall strength of the Human Race, partly because his rise was so rapid that the Supreme Experts of the Human Race didn’t have time to thoroughly understand him.
Under normal conditions, even without Jack Clark, the situation for the Human Federation might be a bit more difficult, but it wouldn’t collapse, as could be seen from the performance on the previous two battlefields.
Especially the Sky Base weapons and Apocalyptic Weapons orbiting outside of Blue Star, it was evident that the Federation had always been accumulating its resources, preparing for a major showdown.
That includes the contingency plan of retreating with a part of humanity into the deeper areas of the mythical world if they ultimately couldn’t hold off The Purgatory Family.
There is also the Divine Gods Alliance in the direction of the Outer Development Department, which is another secret weapon, a force no less powerful than an ordinary Purgatory Empire.
Plus, with the arrival of messengers from the Heavenly Feather Clan, it was clear that the Federal Top Level had always been forming strategic alliances. It’s just unknown how the negotiations between the two tribes are going currently.
And there’s also the expedition that Senior Marcellus Larry mentioned before, I wonder if it has already set out?
Leaning on the sofa, Jack Clark let his brain wander aimlessly for a while before his Divine Soul Intent finally lightly buzzed, “Kavadola, nothing unusual lately?”
A few streets away from the Clark Family’s house, at a street corner, a burly man leaning by a tricycle and sweet potatoes paused, then respectfully replied, “Reporting to Upper God, everything is normal up to now, including those undercover agents guarding mother and younger brother.”
While ‘speaking’, the burly man who stood 2 meters and 6 centimeters tall, with a rugged face and somewhat ferocious appearance, smiled as he skillfully wrapped up a roasted sweet potato and handed it to the waiting old lady.
“Here’s your sweet potato, that’ll be 19 yuan.”
The old lady took the sweet potato and complained while paying, “Old Kava, your sweet potatoes are really tasty when roasted, but could you make them a bit cheaper?”
Kavadola shook his head: “Can’t do it any cheaper, I’d be losing money if I did.”
“Look at my sweet potatoes; they are roasted from raw and take over two hours to cook through. The sugars inside are completely brought out and it smells delicious.”
“This method of roasting is completely different from those who just roast the surface of already boiled sweet potatoes and claim they’re selling roasted sweet potatoes.”
“Whether it’s the time or the cost of the charcoal fire, my expenses are higher than those of other sweet potato roasters, so naturally the price is a bit higher.”
“Alright, if it’s expensive, then it’s expensive,” the old lady said, seeing she couldn’t get a discount. She shook her head and sat down on a nearby stool with her sweet potato.
Jack Clark, who sensed this scene with his Divine Soul, was also somewhat astonished.
I mean, as a Mid-Mythical Stage powerhouse, you’re selling roasted sweet potatoes – isn’t that a bit out of place? I only asked you to covertly protect my family for three years.
Only a few king-level experts like Marcellus Larry knew about Kavadola’s existence on Blue Star. And below them, no one knew that there was a Mythical Powerhouse suppressing the surroundings of the Clark Family.
Including those from the Federation charged with protection—who can predict human hearts? Everyone’s thoughts can differ from one moment to the next.
Moreover, The Purgatory Family has numerous Secret Skills, who knows whether they might have some strange ability to infiltrate Blue Star and lurk over.
As for moving Doris Clark and the others to a more secluded place and have them protected along with the families of other royals, Jack Clark did consider this.
If he hadn’t subjugated Kavadola, he would have talked with Doris Clark before delving deeper into the rear of the Purgatory Empire, asking them to move to a Rift World reserved for families of the royal class, which would be safer.
They would stay there until he swept through The Purgatory Family, eliminating the threat and returning.
However, with Kavadola’s protection, there was no need for Doris Clark and the rest to hustle; it’s more comfortable staying at home.
Just as Jack Clark was astounded that Kavadola had compressed his True Body and learned the Federation language so quickly, Glenn Clark entered into his Divine Soul’s range of perception.
Glenn was dressed in the uniform of South Sky Martial Height School today, but he was carrying a middle school backpack on one shoulder and was followed by three beautiful middle school girls.
Glenn said with a laugh, “May, look, that tricycle is the street stall I mentioned. His sweet potatoes are very sweet, tasting like the kind we used to eat back in the countryside when we were kids.”
The gentle and lovely Teresa Wilson showed some interest, “For you to praise it so highly, Jim, it must taste really good.”
“Come on, I’ll treat you guys to a taste,” Glenn said as he led the three classmates to Kavadola’s sweet potato stall. He confidently ordered, “Boss, give us five well-roasted sweet potatoes, the kind that are dryer with more sugar content.”
“No problem, just a moment,” Kavadola replied, pulling open the oven door and reaching directly into the scorching furnace to shuffle some around, then brought out five steaming sweet potatoes and placed them on the electronic scale.
And to this sight, those around felt nothing out of the ordinary.
With the Federation’s half-year long dissemination of Transcendent Information, coupled with the previous Heaven-Earth Mutated event, and Jack Clark suppressing invading forces from Outer Space on the outskirts of South City, everyone worldwide has grown completely accustomed to the ‘Transcendent’.
And Kavadola’s unusually hulking figure made it obvious that he wasn’t ordinary; he must be a power user with a physical mutation.
However, considering that he’s been reduced to selling sweet potatoes and hasn’t been scouted by some major company, he must be weak, belonging to that most common type with a meat body variation.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1281 - 1281 497 The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1281: Chapter 497: The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back!_3 Chapter 1281: Chapter 497: The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back!_3 “Five sweet potatoes, a total of 97 yuan, but since you’re regular customers, I’ll give you a 40% discount. 50 yuan will do.”
As he spoke, Kavadola packed the five sweet potatoes into paper boxes, putting a small fork in each box for convenience.
However, hearing that five sweet potatoes cost 100 yuan, Teresa Wilson and the two other girls widened their eyes in shock: “97? Why are your sweet potatoes so expensive?”
The girl who was only 1.5 meters tall, but already had a notable figure, was also surprised: “Yeah, isn’t one sweet potato usually around ten yuan?”
Though the three girls came from well-off families, they still had some understanding of prices, and they immediately felt that Glenn Clark was being ripped off.
But before they could continue, a middle-aged woman sitting nearby on a stool, who had just finished eating some, also objected: “Kava, I’m a regular customer too, why do you only give them a 50% discount?”
“You’re not a student, so you don’t have to worry about not having enough pocket money, why would I give you a discount?”
Kavadola seemed to have fully immersed himself in the role and said solemnly: “These are the Federation’s future flowers, and they are growing right now. When they’re hungry and want some sweet potatoes, of course, I should be more generous.”
Growing… The woman glanced at Glenn Clark, who was over 2 meters tall, just slightly shorter than Kavadola’s imposing figure, feeling like this guy was taking her for a fool.
Your future flower is over 2 meters tall in middle school? Still growing? Growing my foot.
Glenn Clark watched the scene with a chuckle. He knew the woman; she came here to eat sweet potatoes at this time nearly every day, then would chat about this and that with the owner.
It seemed like she had taken a liking to this tanned, somewhat rugged middle-aged uncle.
“Boss, you don’t need to give me a discount every time, your business isn’t easy. Here,” said Glenn Clark, pulling out a hundred yuan note and handing it to Kavadola.
“No way, a discount is a discount. You are the future of the Federation.” Kavadola couldn’t break his promise in the presence of an Upper God, so he forcefully found a fifty to give back.
The two then went back and forth over the fifty yuan for a bit, until finally, Kavadola accepted it, stating that if Glenn didn’t take it, he would no longer sell sweet potatoes there, forcing Glenn to keep it.
Only after Glenn and his companions had left did Kavadola finally relax and wipe the cold sweat from his forehead.
Usually, when Glenn refused once, Kavadola would just accept it, but today was different.
On their way to the Clark residence, Teresa Wilson, holding a warm sweet potato, asked curiously, “Glenn, do you know the name of the man selling the sweet potatoes?”
Glenn shook his head: “Don’t know; he never said. I just know that people around here call him Old Kava.”
Another beautiful girl giggled and said: “May, are you suspecting that the sweet potato salesman is related to Glenn because they both look so tall?”
The slightly shorter girl nodded in agreement: “I get that feeling too.”
“Uh… Shouldn’t be, I guess. I’m this bulky because of my body’s talent from awakening, and my brother’s height is very normal,” Glenn rubbed the back of his head.
“That seems about right,” the three girls mused.
“Speaking of which, Jim, I heard everyone outside saying that your brother, the Divine Martial Throne, has entered the mythical world. Is that true?”
Glenn nodded: “Yeah, after dealing with the world’s anomalies, my brother went back there. I heard that our humans and different races are at war again there.”
“Different races, huh? I’ve heard those monsters are even scarier than Unique Beasts, very frightening.”
“No worries, those different races can only make small trouble in the mythical world. With my brother and other king-level figures suppressing them, they can’t stir up much trouble.”
“In a couple of years, once I reach king-level through cultivation, I’ll rush over and join my brother in wiping them all out,” Glenn said confidently.
Listening to Glenn talk about reaching king-level in a few years, the three girls not only didn’t think he was bragging but were full of confidence in him.
Teresa clenched her little fist: “Jim, keep it up. With your incredible talent, you’ll definitely make it, and you might not even need two years to break through to king-level.”
“I feel Jim could break through to king-level in just a year and a half.”
“Indeed, his brother is the Divine Martial Throne, an unprecedented monster who became a king in just one year.”
As the group of four walked toward the Clark home, chatting away while munching on sweet potatoes, Jack Clark watched them with a quizzical look and retracted his will.
If he kept listening, he’d start to feel a bit embarrassed.
Truly, the naive have no fear of tigers. To the three girls, becoming a king seemed so easy, achievable within a year or two, completely unaware of how many cultivators this hurdle had stopped.
But it was normal for Glenn to be confident.
As an Innate Awakened One, he already had a high level of talent, almost certain to reach the Ninth Heavens. Moreover, he had a chance encounter, gaining the Talent Ability of Gigantification.
Plus, with the generous resources from his king-level brother and the new Body refining technique created, it was a conservative estimate that he could become a king within two years.
Slouching on the sofa, taking a break to rest and relax, Jack found himself slightly bored and switched on the television with the remote from the coffee table.
“Welcome to Cultivation Information. Yesterday evening, October 1st, a conflict broke out between cultivators in the subway of South City, causing extensive damage to public facilities. There have been no reports of ordinary people being injured.”
“The relevant authorities repaired the damages last night, and law enforcement immediately acted, detaining the two advanced cultivators involved.”
“The exact cause of the conflict has not been disclosed yet. Our station will keep a close eye on updates from the law enforcement department.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1282 - 1282 497 The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1282: Chapter 497: The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back!_4 Chapter 1282: Chapter 497: The Deity of Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Bro, You’re Back!_4 As the supporter spoke, the large screen behind them jumped to an image of a subway station, with pillars collapsing and the ground trembling amidst a chaotic scene.
“Next is the latest news. Mr. Barry Leonard, chairman of the Eastern Summer First Martial Arts Center and high-level cultivator, has announced the completion of the martial arts hall’s reintegration and welcomes students from across the nation with cultivating qualifications, who wish to practice advanced skills, to visit.”
“Since the announcement this morning, many families, wealthy yet not talented enough to acquire more than low-level martial arts after entering the martial arts school, have rushed to visit.”
As they spoke, the screen behind the host changed to show a grand building, with a dozen or so young and middle-aged people standing in a line on the steps, partaking in a ribbon-cutting ceremony.
“Following the high-profile reintegration news from Valentine Martial Arts Hall, we have international news coming up.”
“Clyde, once the foremost among the younger generation in the Genetic True Martial Cultivation World, after his defeat at the Divine Martial Throne, witnesses Kovatuo’s failure to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, and he is currently greatly weakened.”
“Kovatuo’s failure has once again cast doubt among those cultivators who practice genetic martial arts, questioning if the True Martial Way truly surpasses genetic martial arts.”
“In response to these speculations, high-level cultivators from the genetic martial arts lineage have stepped forward to clarify that Kovatuo’s failure is not indicative of the inadequacy of genetic martial arts.”
“There’s a saying that goes, ‘The master leads the entrance, but practice depends on the individual.’
“As for that traitor Clyde, there’s no need to draw comparisons. Despite his high talent, he was up against the Divine King Throne, the unparalleled genius who used Sixth Layer Heaven cultivation to reverse-defeat the Evil God Clone of the Eight Layer Heaven.”
“Additionally, our station, through special channels, has received firsthand news from the sea.”
“Just a few days ago, a flying, flame-type Mutant Beast evolved in the ocean, an evolution that completely defies the rules of marine life mutation.”
“Experts have pointed out that this is an ongoing effect of the mutation that occurred in heaven and earth over half a month ago; we can expect not only more diverse mutations in marine creatures, but also those on land.”
“However, please rest assured, compared to those beings undergoing passive evolution, we humans, having mastered cultivation and technology, are much stronger.”
“For example, one of our country’s famous tech companies, Tianhua Group, has recently developed a Strengthening Pill which can enhance Qi Blood, allowing ordinary people a certain chance of acquiring cultivating qualifications.”
“However, supplies of the Strengthening Pill are currently limited. Interested viewers can scan the QR code at the bottom left corner of our broadcast to place an order on the website…”
The advertisement for the Strengthening Pill that could provide ordinary people with certain cultivating qualifications caught Jack Clark off-guard as he was watching with great interest.
Since the mutation of heaven and earth and the invasion of different races half a month ago, the official release of cultivation news had become even more open, reaching the point where it was being discussed by everyone.
