In a well-regulated (controlled) online environment, cultivators and Mutated Beasts had been integrated into everyone’s daily life in less than a year.
The hottest topics on the internet now are no longer celebrities and gossip, but instead where cultivators have clashed, showing how strong they are and how much destruction they have caused to their surroundings.
Or where low-level cultivators have teamed up to enter the Deep Mountain, kill ordinary Mutated Creatures, and brought back their corpses to sell for millions.
Click! The sound of the door opening came from outside, along with Glenn Clark’s warm voice.
“Everyone come in and take a seat. I mentioned to my mom this morning that we invited everyone over for dinner. She’s already bought the groceries, and later I’ll show off a bit of my cooking skills…”
“Brother…!”
[Crap, still a thousand words to go, it’s almost twelve o’clock. I’ll update to maintain daily posts, planning to finish a detailed revision by one and add it after this chapter. Everyone can refresh tomorrow morning.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1283 - 1283 498 Ancient Body Refining Darkness
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1283: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness Chapter 1283: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness Watching Glenn Clark chomping at the bit, Jack Clark didn’t outright reject the idea but asked, “When does the competition start, and what are the rewards?”
Glenn Clark chuckled and said, “It begins on October 15, one round every three months, divided into provincial, national, and global competitions.”
“Provincial competitions are further divided into over a dozen city-level districts, where Martial Arts School cultivators from each city sign up first, selecting the top ten students from two grades.”
“When it comes to the later provincial competitions, they don’t differentiate by grade but by cultivation level, with Third Layer Heaven, Fifth Layer Heaven, and Sixth-level Heaven, determining the top ten within each rank.”
“It’s said that just making it into the provincial top ten comes with top-tier resources capable of breaking through realms, and the national competition rewards are even God-level resources,” he continued.
“However, the difficulty of the national competition is much higher, only cultivators at Fifth Layer Heaven and above can participate, and only the top twenty from the three major empires are qualified for the global competition.”
“The teacher said that the rewards for the national competition are even more extravagant, with the top three having the opportunity to attain godhood, awarded personally by the Three Great Speakers.”
“Besides the top three, the top ten and the top fifty also have different rewards.” As he spoke about this, Glenn Clark’s face was already filled with excitement, while Jack Clark pondered thoughtfully.
The Federation organizes these competitions not only to discover and specifically cultivate genius talents with monstrous abilities but also partly in response to the strong offensives launched by The Purgatory Family.
Thus, they are preparing to accelerate the cultivation of the new generation’s blood.
And the competition segments are quite fair, with Second Grade and third grade cultivators able to sign up, initially differentiating by realm.
This gives everyone a chance to stand out.
With a grand contest every three months and rewards each time, even those who started slower but accumulated strength gradually could have time for growth and explosive development.
First Grade students were not included because school had only started half a month ago.
Sitting on the sofa, Jack Clark smiled, “Having investigated the process and rewards so thoroughly, it seems like you really want to participate, Jim.”
Glenn Clark nodded excitedly: “Indeed I do. The competition will be broadcast live from the start, and making it to the global competition would mean fame and wealth.”
Though Glenn Clark usually came across as honest and stable, he was after all only fifteen and full of youthful passion and striving ambition.
But he was still relatively rational, only aiming to compete globally and not necessarily to win the championship.
Jack Clark then nodded in agreement after a slight ponder, “Since you want to go, then go ahead.”
Jack Clark wasn’t worried about Glenn Clark’s strength; although he had just made a breakthrough to Triplex, that was just on the surface.
As an Innate Awakened One, Glenn could take on a Fourth Layer rank in the state of Innate Overlord Body, and with the surge in strength from his Giantification Talent, sweeping through Fifth Layer was definitely not an issue, let alone Sixth Layer.
With the ability to overpower the Fifth Layer while being in the Triplex realm, Glenn’s current strength was even stronger than Jack’s at the time.
However, this was due to the lower level, and once he reached Seventh Layer High Order later on, the pure power of Innate Awakening would, at best, make Glenn peerless within the same rank and with Gigantification, he might fight across a single Major Realm.
Excluding individuals like Jack Clark who had already ‘graduated’, the highest level of cultivation among the Second Grade students in Eastern Summer was at the middle to late period of Fifth Layer, such as Marcus Lindsay and others.
After obtaining resources from Jack, Marcus Lindsay, White Veil and the others made their breakthrough to Fifth Layer and have now returned to Southern Battlefield for hard cultivation.
Now, it seems they will probably sign up for the competition too.
“Bro, you’ve agreed, but my identity…” Glenn Clark was a mix of surprise and hesitation.
He was somewhat worried about his identity as a relative of a king-level individual, and Doris Clark had reminded him repeatedly to keep a low profile and avoid attracting too much attention to spare Jack Clark any trouble.
Jack Clark laughed, “It’s just the identity of a king-level relative, no big deal. No one will give you any special treatment in such competitions.”
“Aside from the identity, your talent has already surpassed those Innate Awakened Ones, not inferior to those known as Demon God Descendants. All you need to do is cultivate diligently, and you should at least make it into the top five globally.”
Even though Glenn is starting from a lower level at Triplex, time is on his side.
With provincial competitions every three months, national competitions, and global finals, plus the rewards from each contest, by then, he might have already made a breakthrough to Eight Layer Heaven.
An Innate Awakened One at Eight Layer Heaven with a talent for amplifying strength and Defense, combined with Gigantification, would be enough to Suppress everything.
However, as Glenn became thrilled with the permission he had received from Jack Clark, Jack fell into contemplation again, “But participating in the competition is not without drawbacks, such as safety.”
After thinking it over, Jack took out a fist-sized Red Crystal Stone from his hand.
Inside the crystal, it was as if it contained a whole world, with a shadowy figure struggling and howling — the forbidden weapon given by Marcellus Larry when he entered the mythical world at Eight Layer Heaven.
Rebirth Soul Crystal.
After learning that Jack had obtained Emperor Inheritance, the First Councilor plunged deep into the mythical world to slay a being of Early Myth and refine its soul bone.
The moment Jack was killed by an enemy, the Rebirth Soul Crystal, bound by Rule to his life, would take the Death for him.
However, this life substitute effect was only effective below the king level, and Jack’s cultivation pace was so fast that he had stepped into the realm of Myth before facing a certain Death situation.
As a result, this Rebirth Soul Crystal had become somewhat redundant in his hands, while the other three forbidden weapons had all played their roles.
Jack wiped the imprint inside the Soul Crystal clean and placed it into a Storage ring, handing it to Glenn, “Take it. After dinner tonight, I’ll teach you how to refine it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1284 - 1284 498 Ancient Body Refining Darkness 2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1284: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness, 2 Chapter 1284: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness, 2 “As for this storage ring, I’ve prepared some basic resources for you corresponding to Fourth Layer Heaven to Sixth Layer, including some for Seventh Layer High-Rank,”
After reaching Triplex Heaven, cultivators could harness True Strength and Spirit Power, which enabled them to use storage equipment. This was perfect as Jack Clark had provided him one as well.
As for the reason it was basic resources, it was because he didn’t know beforehand which True Martial path Glenn would follow for his cultivation, naturally making it impossible to prepare a matching set of resources.
“Hehe, I knew big brother would prepare these for me,” Glenn didn’t stand on ceremony, happily accepting the storage ring and promptly placing it on the index finger of his left hand.
His brother was a Mythical King, and he was his only younger brother; why wouldn’t he give the good stuff he couldn’t use to him?
Ah! Suddenly, an exclamation came from the kitchen, followed by the clang of a kitchen knife hitting the floor.
Glenn was startled at once, “May, what’s going on with you all?”
From inside came the slightly flustered voices of Teresa Wilson and the others, “It’s nothing, just that the bone of the golden fish was a bit too hard, and the knife slipped.”
“I almost forgot, that fish is after all an ordinary mutated creature, let me handle it,” saying so, Glenn hurried into the kitchen.
The girl named Nora Martinez said from the kitchen, “It’s fine, Jim, we can handle it. You go keep Brother Clark company and chat outside.”
“No way, what if you all get hurt?”
“Rest assured. After dinner, I’ll have lots of time to talk with my brother. Hand me the knife, Melinda, start rinsing the rice, prepare ten cups since there are more people today.”
“Is ten cups going to be enough?”
“It should be. That big rice cooker can only fit ten cups, about one and a half pounds of rice.”
“May, you and Nora prepare the side dishes. Keep those lettuce leaves for the bottom of the pot; my brother loves lettuce leaves the most…”
Hearing the harmonious scene in the kitchen, Jack Clark suddenly felt as if he might be getting old.
Forget about that guy. Jack Clark leaned back on the sofa, pondering Glenn’s participation in the competition.
After musing for a moment, Jack Clark suddenly stood up and returned to his second-floor room, then tapped his smart wristwatch a moment, connecting with Roger and convening the Throne Conference.
Five minutes later, feeling it was about time, Jack Clark locked onto the smart wristwatch signal. With the help of a satellite, a terrifying will erupted from him and surged towards the heavens.
…
The void sub-space suddenly vibrated, and soon after, four king-level wills descended, transforming into vague figures appearing atop four thrones.
Then, an even more majestic and overbearing will arrived. The mere formless suppressing pressure was comparable to a Heavenly King’s, causing the entire Void Space to tremble.
However, seeing the enormous shadowy figure on the throne attired in a black Imperial Robe and standing over five hundred meters tall, the other four seated kings felt neither surprise nor shock.
After all, this individual dared to infiltrate deep into the rear of the Purgatory Empire, slew seven demon kings and one Great Demon King, and retreated unscathed even under the siege of two Demon Gods.
Marcellus Larry broke into laughter, “Hahaha… Jack Clark, you did a splendid job this time, giving the Purgatory Demon Race a heavy blow to their arrogance.”
Another king praised, “Indeed, with so many demon kings and the Great Demon King falling, those Demon Gods from Diorus must be coughing up blood in frustration.”
The female king among the four expressed concern, “Thankfully, Jack, your incursion this time distracted them, or we might have had to play quite a few of our trump cards.”
“True. This would make them cautious about our satellite weapons and other tools, diminishing our chances of achieving greater results later on,” another king added.
In response to the four kings’ praise, Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “You are giving me too much credit. I merely did what needed to be done.”
“However, the rear of The Purgatory Family was indeed more lax than I expected, or rather not lax, but so vast that they cannot entirely control it.”
“It’s a pity that we currently can’t contend with the high-end strength of the Purgatory Empire, otherwise, guerrilla warfare deep in their territory would quickly exhaust them to collapse.”
Having vast territory meant controlling more plundered resources, but it also meant there were greater constraints.
Take, for instance, the incursion into the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire; if those Demon Gods had not engaged and instead allowed Jack to fight face to face with Tarolia, he could have cut his way through the entire empire on his own.
Even if he couldn’t eradicate all the demon kings, he could still force them to retreat into the Core Demon Domain, abandoning territories spanning over a million kilometers.
Next, Jack Clark briefly discussed with Marcellus Larry and the others about the situation in the Purgatory Empire, glossed over some battle details, and then stated the purpose of convening this Throne Conference.
“The Federation is organizing the Global Martial Arts Competition, and my younger brother plans to participate.”
Marcellus Larry was taken aback, “Your brother, Jack? Isn’t that kid only trained for about ten days?”
As the king in charge of the Eastern Summer Passage, Marcellus was naturally attentive to Jack Clark’s family and had kept watch especially after Jack entered the cracks, so he knew about Glenn starting school early.
He was also aware of Glenn’s Innate Body Awakening and his acquisition of the Giantification Talent.
However, a king has endless responsibilities, and there was much to manage, so the follow-up was not within his continuous observation—only anomalies would draw his attention again.
Jack Clark nodded, “To be exact, Jim has only been cultivating for nine days, but thanks to his notable talent, he has already made his breakthrough into Triplex Heaven.”
“What!” Each of the four kings was taken aback, almost believing they had misheard.
Nine days to surpass Foundation Establishment, cracking through First and Second Layer to break into Triplex Heaven—that was even more outrageous than what the Innate Awakened Ones could achieve. Was the entire Clark Family composed of monsters?
Or was it that the Clark Family’s genes were so extraordinary? Having produced a monster like the One-Year King wasn’t enough, now there was another…

chapters.title: Chapter 1285 - 1285 498 Ancient Body Refining Darkness 3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1285: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness, 3 Chapter 1285: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness, 3 At this moment, including Marcellus Larry, everyone was pondering whether their families had any younger generation still in high school, and whether they should transfer to South Sky Martial Arts School.
This was not about the power of king-level forces, but rather the Clark Family’s ‘genes’ were simply too exaggerated.
When the time comes, it’s not a matter of whether to form marriage alliances; if they could produce a descendant with the same terrifying talent as Jack Clark and Glenn Clark, their families wouldn’t have to worry for at least ten thousand years.
Of course, this was predicated on the Human Race withstanding the threat of The Purgatory Family.
As for Jack Clark, who had already made a mythical breakthrough, there was no need to consider him. It was said that there were many outstanding girls around him, such as Jane Aiken, who in one year had a combat power comparable to the mythical world just short of the Ninth Heavens.
Also, there was Freya Louise, the unbridled driver of Number One on the Frontline Battlefield; they too had astonishing talents, and coupled with being classmates of Jack Clark, no one else could compete.
Right, there was also Mathilda Ward, who herself was half a step into the myth realm, and her father was even a late-period powerhouse of the Heavenly King level.
At this time, Marcellus Larry mused, “As Glenn Clark is your brother Jack, he does not lack resources, and he himself is an Innate Awakened One, I don’t think there is any need for him to participate in the competition.”
“Senior Larry is worried about his safety.”
Jack Clark smiled slightly, “That’s exactly why I have called everyone here. As my brother, Jim should make a very good target, and we can arrange strategies around him.”
“Do you want to follow Ilisa’s approach?” Marcellus Larry paused.
“There are reasons for that, but it’s not the main one.”
Jack Clark smiled, “Since you seniors are using the national martial arts competition as a new trial ground, it would be a good opportunity for Jim to gain some experience too.”
“While I can provide him enough cultivation resources, I can’t give him the will of the strong nor the combat experience from life and death struggles.”
“As for safety, there is no need to worry. I have already given him the Rebirth Soul Crystal, and perhaps by utilizing the Evil God Sect Cultists lurking on Blue Star, we might even draw out a big fish.”
While the Evil God Alliance in the mythical world had been eradicated by Jack Clark, there were still some Evil God Sect Cultists lurking on Blue Star.
However, after several purges, not many remained, and those who did were in deep hiding. As elite infiltrators from the beginning, they should have a way to contact the Purgatory Demon Race.
Using Jack Clark’s brother as bait, especially since this brother had also demonstrated the terrifying talent of one year in the myth realm, well then…
Suddenly, several people became somewhat interested.
Marcellus Larry nodded slightly: “This plan… is feasible.”
His initial opposition to Glenn Clark participating in the competition was mainly out of fear of complications, for Jack Clark was the hope of the Human Race, and he had only this one brother; they didn’t want any accidents.
Now that Glenn Clark had a forbidden weapon forged by Supreme Experts in his hand, and with Jack Clark’s permission for him to participate, they naturally had no objections.
Jack Clark smiled slightly, “I’ll have to trouble the seniors with Jim’s matters then.”
For the majority of the time to come, he would certainly be in the mythical world, and Glenn Clark’s safety could only be entrusted to Marcellus Larry and the others; that’s why Jack Clark had specifically convened this meeting.
As for Kavadola, after Glenn Clark left for the competition, she was responsible for the safety of Doris Clark and could not leave.
After discussing Glenn Clark’s matters, Jack Clark continued: “This time when I escaped from the pursuit of the Purgatory Demon Gods, I entered a ‘relic’ and discovered traces of the ancient Human Race.”
“Jack Clark, you’ve discovered an ancient Human Race relic. Did you find anything, like messages from the Expeditionary Army?” Marcellus Larry and the others were first shocked, then somewhat excited.
An Ancient Civilization, that was the pinnacle of human civilization, with seven Civilization Emperors existing at the same time, a single one of whom could suppress the entire Purgatory Civilization.
Jack Clark nodded, “There are some useful findings.”
“The relic is located deep within the Void, full of ancient Cultivation Methods, and it seems there are clues that the Expeditionary Army might have entered deep into the mythical world.”
The female king-level figure began to breathe somewhat rapidly, “So you’re saying that those powerful beings from the Ancient Civilization are still alive.”
“There’s a high probability they are all still alive. However, due to the loss of Blue Star’s coordinates, these strong beings can’t return.”
“Of course, another possibility is that these powerhouses found a new environment more suitable for the Human Race to inhabit, hence abandoning Blue Star.”
Everyone, including Marcellus Larry, nodded slightly at Jack Clark’s speculation, signaling their agreement.
Originally, the Ancient Civilization gathered all its strong beings and elites, tore through space-time to go on an expedition, aiming to plunder the Origin of other worlds to supplement the waning Heavenly Energy on Blue Star.
Later, Blue Star was ambushed by the combined elites of different races, causing a Void shock that led to mutual annihilation, and at the same time, the displacement of Blue Star and even the Solar System resulted in a loss of coordinates.
In these circumstances, the Expeditionary Army could only make a desperate move, sweeping through those different races and establishing a new human civilization deep within the mythical world.
As for the ancestral land of Blue Star, maybe there were those who haven’t given up on searching, but with so many thousand years passed, the older generation has either perished or given up.
Whew!
The brawny king-level figure from Berlin exhaled and stated gravely, “It’s better to rely on ourselves than on others; we shouldn’t pin our hopes on the Ancient Civilization.”
“Naturally, although I didn’t find any trace of the Ancient Civilization, I have gained quite a lot this time.”
Jack Clark smiled, “While in retreat healing my wounds in that relic, I took the opportunity to cultivate some Ancient Techniques and created a Basic Body Refining Technique.”
“This Basic Technique is relatively moderate in power, but it only requires a strong physique to practice; there are no mandatory requirements to naturally sense the Heavenly Energy.”
“Moreover, as long as the Body Refining Technique is cultivated to the Third Layer, equivalent to cultivators reaching the Third Layer Heaven, they can also switch to cultivating True Martial.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1286 - 1286 498 Ancient Body Refining Darkness 4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1286: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness, 4 Chapter 1286: Chapter 498 Ancient Body Refining: Darkness, 4 “`
Hiss!!
This time, the four king-level experts gasped in unison. Marcellus Larry stood up from the throne immediately, somewhat excited, “Jack Clark, are you not joking?”
“Senior Marcellus, do I seem like I’m joking to you?”
Seeing Jack Clark’s calm demeanor, Marcellus Larry and the others saw shock and excitement in his eyes.
If what Jack Clark said was true, wouldn’t it mean that more than two billion humans could practice cultivation? With the help of Basic Body Refining Technique, they could step into the Transcendent and usher in an era where everyone is as powerful as a dragon!!
Given ten years’ time for humanity, hundreds of millions of advanced cultivators could emerge, and the combined strength of the middle and lower echelons would be more than enough to overpower the two Purgatory Empires.
By then, with war nurturing war, the number of Mythical Kings would definitely surge, and by that time, Jack Clark might have even made a breakthrough to Supreme strength, becoming peerless within his rank…
Just as the excitement in the minds of Marcellus Larry and the others was mounting, Jack Clark threw cold water on it, “Seniors, hold your excitement for now. Although the Cultivation Method has been created, it has not yet been extensively tested. It remains a theory of mine.”
“Moreover, even if the results are very promising, it’s not possible to release the entire method; at most, we would make public the first four levels of the basics—the higher realm techniques would need to be selective.”
“Naturally,” all four nodded.
As the saying goes, human hearts are unpredictable. Even with the threat from The Purgatory Family, the human inner circle is not united; traitors and spies are ever-present.
Aside from traitors, not everyone who becomes a cultivator wishes to exert effort for the Federation, for the Human Race, since most people are only interested in immediate gains.
Once the complete Nine Layers Cultivation Method is released, many who become cultivators might hide their strength and continue to cultivate in secret among the crowds, turning into ticking time bombs.
It’s not that these people are foolish or selfish, but that a person’s height, status, and surroundings determine their perspective.
After all, you can’t expect a commoner who struggles daily to provide for themselves, to suddenly develop an ideal to fight for the human future upon gaining strength.
Marcellus Larry pondered for a moment, “The dissemination and disclosure of the Cultivation Method can be managed by the Federation Think Tank when the time comes; they will be able to rapidly draft a complete plan.”
The Federation operates as a whole; king-level experts are strong but are usually deterrents for high-end conflicts. These matters of education and training are handled by specialists.
Jack Clark nodded, “Tomorrow morning, I will go to Base No.1. There, I’ll upload the Cultivation Methods to the Heavenly Think Tank, along with the original texts I’ve acquired.”
The Ancient Emperor who initially erased information about cultivation from the heritage continent, leaving behind only the core strength inheritance, did so to prevent future humans from treading a similar path.
After all, the environment of later eras was definitely not the same as theirs.
Now that the Federation’s True Martial system is stable, taking out the data erased by the Ancient Emperor wouldn’t cause too much of a disturbance.
On the contrary, cross-references with Ninth Heavens and ancient strong men would yield the effect of learning from others’ stones.
Just as the five of them were about to proceed with their discussions, suddenly there was noise from downstairs: Doris Clark had returned, and Glenn Clark was calling for him to have dinner, causing Jack Clark to pause.
“Seniors, I’ll have to trouble you with the matters we discussed earlier,” he said.
With a greeting, Jack Clark’s projection vanished.
As they watched Jack Clark depart, after a long while, a king-level expert from Berlin exclaimed, “Earlier, when you, Marcellus, said he was the hope of the Human Race, I still had my doubts, as our current human predicament can’t be resolved merely by the addition of another Heavenly King or a Supreme Expert.”
“But I never expected that just over half a month after his breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, he’d bring us so many surprises, or rather, shocks.”
The female king-level expert also smiled wryly and nodded, “Indeed. Even disregarding his achievements in deeply infiltrating The Purgatory Family, just the contribution of that Basic Body Refining Technique is frighteningly significant.”
“If there are no issues with that Cultivation Method, just one year’s time would suffice to advance the entire human race’s overall strength by one level.”
As the three king-level experts marveled, Marcellus Larry let out a slight smile, “I’ve always said that Jack Clark’s talent surpasses all imagination, he is the lucky star of the entire Human Race.”
“Did you not notice? Although he seemed a bit ragged while being pursued by the Demon God, in just over ten days of not seeing him, his cultivation seems to have broken through again.”
“I’ve taken note of it too; while his Divine Soul is weak, the Law Aura enveloping him has reached grand accomplishment, he has made a breakthrough to the late period of the Myth.”
However, compared to his cultivation’s progress to the late Myth period in just over ten days, what was more shocking was the Body Refining Technique Jack Clark had created that allows everyone to practice cultivation.
While Marcellus Larry and the others were preoccupied, the Clark family was having dinner at home.
Because Jack Clark had just left ‘Ninth Heavens’, although Doris Clark seemed somewhat happy to be back, she was still quite composed.
On the other hand, Teresa Wilson and the other two girls seemed rather constrained and nervous at the table.
When dinner was nearly over, Doris Clark looked towards Glenn Clark, “Jim, remember to escort May and the others back after dinner. It’s unsafe for them if it gets too late.”
Melinda hurriedly responded, “There’s no need, Auntie. Our driver will come to pick us up later.”
Teresa Wilson also politely said, “Yes, Auntie. We’ve already informed our families, and Melinda’s driver will take us back separately later. There’s no need to trouble Jim.”
“Is that so?” said Doris Clark, somewhat surprised.
Even though her status had changed several times over the past month, the idea of a personal driver was still a bit foreign to Doris Clark, who was just an ordinary employee a year ago.
Clearly, Melinda’s family was not simple.
Across the table, Glenn Clark showed a simple and honest smile, but he didn’t offer to drive the three girls, as he had matters to attend to later in the evening.
Jack Clark was going to impart to him a Cultivation Method named “Ancient Body Refining. Dark”.

chapters.title: Chapter 1287 - 1287 499 Reverse Resonance Jack Clark Arrives
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1287: Chapter 499 Reverse Resonance, Jack Clark Arrives Chapter 1287: Chapter 499 Reverse Resonance, Jack Clark Arrives On the outskirts of the Logistics City, the Eternal Tree Sapling stood tall at ten thousand meters, with the dense energy of Heaven and Earth enveloping it like Cloud Mist, tinting it into a Golden Cloud Sea under the sunlight.
Around the divine tree, members of the Heavenly Feather Clan floated, their dual pairs of golden wings unfurled, emitting a faint Radiance that harmonized with the tree, their Aura fluctuating.
Between the divine tree and the Logistics City, ten black sky-based battleships, each several kilometers long, hovered in the sky casting vast shadows that blotted out the sun, filled with an invisible oppressive feeling.
Thousands of Energy Bombers were docked on the outer deck of the battleships, with figures moving around them, performing final checks.
On the black deck of the battleship labeled Expedition No.1, The Number One, three hundred meters high and covered in black-red Armor with a tall and lean ferocious appearance, stood erect.
In front of The Number One, Freya Louise floated over two hundred meters in the air, dressed in a silver Combat Suit with red trim that looked extremely stylish.
At this moment, intense energy fluctuations radiated from inside The Number One, its eyes sparkling with blue-white Radiance.
Meanwhile, on Freya’s exposed neck and chin, some dark golden Patterns emerged, her Aura, already at the peak of Eighth Layer Peak, was slowly strengthening in sync with The Number One.
As her soul fluctuated in harmony, and with the aid of The Number One’s cultivation, even The Number One’s Terrifying Aura, which filled countless Living Beings with dread, began to emerge around Freya.
At that moment, a raging wind howled in the distance as a black and white Mecha eighty meters tall flew over, its rear blasting out scorching hot waves as it slowly landed next to The Number One.
The Black-White Demon King Mech looked up, its eyes flickering with White Light, and Gabriella’s voice came out, “Freya, the higher-ups suddenly issued a notice; the departure has been delayed by two days.”
Upon hearing this, Freya looked down slightly, her eyes exuding a faint sense of desolation and timelessness, and as she lowered her head, The Number One, in a synchronized state behind her, also lowered its head accordingly.
Instantly under that gaze of blue-white eyes, even Gabriella, shielded by the mech, felt a palpitation of the heart.
In a soft voice, Freya said, “Weren’t we supposed to depart today? Why the sudden delay?”
“It’s said that some areas are not yet ready.”
“Is that so,” Freya nodded lightly.
Looking at the girl with the somewhat terrifying Aura that invisibly gave her a sense of overwhelming dread, Gabriella hesitated, “Freya, there’s nothing wrong with you… right?”
Freya’s eyes flickered for a moment as she shook her head slightly, “I’m okay. The Patterns on my body are a manifestation of refining The Number One, or rather, a sign of reverse assimilation.”
The Mecha technology of Simon’s cultivators is not just about human-mech fusion but integrates a large amount of Giant Beast material, a fusion of Extraordinary Creature technology, far beyond mere Human-Machine Integration.
It’s like treating the Mecha as a complete biological shell, cultivating an external avatar.
This pathway diverges from the one Freya discussed with Jack Clark in the Triplex Heaven, the route of integrating technology and Martial Arts, which no one has yet mastered.
The pathway of Biological Mecha cultivation currently has its strongest practitioner in the Sky-based God King, whose super divine Mecha core material comes from an Ancient Beast, granting it staggering combat power.
After her breakthrough to the Eighth Layer, Freya began the formal “refinement” of The Number One, and due to Soul Synchronization, the two became “one,” hence The Number One did not resist.
However, the gap between them was vast. As Freya refined The Number One, she was also being eroded by its power, which was essentially another form of assimilation.
One form was controllable, while the other was uncontrollable.
…
In the room, Glenn Clark sat cross-legged, enveloped by black-gold strength, exuding a heavy and terrifying Aura.
He resembled not a man seated on the ground but a vast Giant Beast.
In Glenn’s arms, he held a chunk of bronze-colored ore the size of a washbasin. Dark Star Breath and Blood coursed through his body, forming supple strands of Qi Blood that created a ‘net,’ enveloping the Bronze Ore.
Under the net of Dark Star Breath and Blood, the sturdy and heavy ore trembled, and bits of Heavy Metal Elements were transformed by the net, wrapping around his hands and entering his body for circulation.
As the overbearing and heavy elements entered, Glenn’s meridians instantly felt a sharp pain, even as if they were being slashed and ground to pieces.
Yet, covered by the Innate Overlord Body, his flesh, blood, and meridians were extremely tough, and the severe pain of his body tearing only made his eyebrows knit slightly.
Jack nodded satisfactorily and slowly withdrew his hand upon seeing this.
Although Glenn had always followed him, he was very independent and resolute.
Although Glenn had directly achieved a breakthrough to the Second Layer of the Dark Star Domination Body with his help, Jack did not leave but sat down behind him, quietly resting and providing protection.
After all, he was his brother and deserved some care.
Glenn was unaware of this as he was immersed in the sensation of strengthening, excitedly circulating his Breath and Blood over and over, absorbing the Heavy Elements from the Green Gold Pupil Ore in his hands.
Because of his Innate Body Awakening, coupled with his Giantification Talent’s physiological changes, Glenn’s physical body was exceptionally strong, which made his Body Refining Technique cultivation even more effective.
Therefore, every time his Dark Star power circulated, his Breath and Blood strengthened twofold, and the meridians and flesh throughout his body became even more robust with the strengthening of the Heavy Elements.
As time passed, the Aura around Glenn became heavier and more terrifying, and within the Black Gold strength covering his body, streaks of green Patterns even began to emerge.
Boom!
Glenn’s Aura surged, enabling him to break through to the Third Layer of the Dark Star Domination Body, equivalent to tripling his strength in both Body Refinement and True Martial Arts, his formidable power causing the air around him to stir into gusts of wind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1288 - 1288 499 Reverse Resonance Jack Clark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1288: Chapter 499 Reverse Resonance, Jack Clark Arrives_2 Chapter 1288: Chapter 499 Reverse Resonance, Jack Clark Arrives_2 Meanwhile, the bronze ore in Glenn Clark’s hands made a cracking sound, and with a loud bang, it turned into a pile of grayish-white rubble scattered on the ground.
Whew!
Glenn Clark took a deep breath, slowly opened his eyes, and his pupils were shining with black-gold radiance, filled with an overbearing and domineering presence, fierce as a tiger.
Just then, Jack Clark’s voice sounded, “Not bad, now that your body refining technique has reached the entry level, the next step is to practice steadily.”
“Let’s go, go out for breakfast, and by the time we finish, I will almost be ready to leave.”
Jack Clark’s words made Glenn Clark pause, and only then did he notice that it was already daylight outside the window. The overbearing look in his eyes faded, and he was somewhat confused, “Brother, have I been cultivating all night?”
“What do you think?” Jack Clark said with a smile.
With that, Jack Clark opened the door and walked out, where Doris Clark had already prepared breakfast.
Looking at the tall figure of Jack Clark and the even more imposing figure of Glenn Clark following behind him, Doris Clark revealed a gentle smile on her face, “Jack, you two are up.”
“How is it, Jim, did the cultivation go smoothly?”
“Mom, Brother is a king-level cultivator, with him protecting me, how could anything go wrong?”
Saying so, Glenn Clark clenched his right fist, and the muscles on his robust shoulders and arms bulged, filled with a sense of power, “The Cultivation Method Brother gave me is amazing, I feel like I could blow away yesterday’s me with a single punch now.”
“As long as it went well.”
Doris Clark nodded, then reminded him, “But I told you to cultivate, not to fight. Don’t bully others just because you have your brother’s backing. Understand?”
“Mom, I know. As long as no one provokes me, I definitely won’t throw a punch recklessly.”
After ‘lecturing’ Glenn Clark, Doris Clark looked at Jack Clark with a slight hesitation, “Jack, be careful after you go there this time.”
“I was startled when rumors on the internet said you were being hunted down by the Purgatory Demon God and killed in the mythical world.”
Jack Clark smiled, “Don’t worry, Mom, I’ll be careful. As for those rumors on the internet, there’s no need to pay them any mind.”
Previously, after Jack Clark disappeared under the pursuit of three demon gods in Diorus, not only did the enemies disrupt morale on the Sky Curtain Battlefield, they even spread rumors on the Blue Star network.
However, the news on the internet was locked down immediately, and thereafter several Evil God Sect Cultists were captured in a country in Berlin.
But because it involved Jack Clark, the Divine Martial Sky King at the zenith of his power, the news spread quickly, and thus Doris Clark heard some of it as well.
After having breakfast with Doris Clark and the rest, Jack Clark and Glenn Clark left the house just like they were going to school on any regular day.
On the roadside, watching the about-to-depart Jack Clark, Glenn Clark said with a cheeky grin, “Brother, remember to leave a couple of demon kings for me. When I make my breakthrough to king-level, I’ll blow them all up.”
“Alright, I’ll leave two for you to practice on.” Saying so, Jack Clark patted Glenn Clark on the shoulder and then soared into the sky, transforming into a beam of golden light that pierced through the clouds.
…
Above the sea of clouds, a streak of golden light sped past at more than twenty times the speed of sound, creating a sonic boom that formed a miles-long trail of turbulent light in its wake.
But in just a short while, the sky ahead was filled with dark and dense mists, bringing him to the edge of the forbidden area.
Boom! The terrifying impact caused the space to tremble, and the golden radiance pierced directly through the Enchantment that isolated the Outer World, appearing over the First Channel Base.
There, Marcellus Larry was already standing on the rooftop of a building.
The golden light fell from the sky and, landing in front of Marcellus Larry, revealed Jack Clark’s figure.
“You’re here, Jack. Let’s go, we’ll head to the Core Area of the Heavenly Think Tank first.”
Knowing that Jack Clark had ‘business’ to attend to, the two of them didn’t waste words, and Marcellus Larry directly led Jack Clark deep underground, a kilometer down to the core of the Heavenly Think Tank.
As the system that linked the entire Federation and managed all major cores, the Defense around the core entity of the Heavenly Think Intelligent Brain was extremely tight.
However, Jack Clark had been here before, so he was familiar with the place.
But as he walked into the spacious underground base and saw the immense Rubik’s Cube at the center, blue Thunder started to ripple over Jack Clark’s body, and soon it transformed into an electric net that covered the entire base.
“…What’s going on, Jack?” Marcellus Larry was taken aback by Jack Clark’s actions.
“This time, I’ve brought back not only Cultivation Methods but also a kind of virus.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark’s wrist flickered, and over two hundred ancient Cultivation Methods densely appeared, causing Marcellus Larry’s eyes to narrow instantly.
In his perception, some weak, cell-like substances fluttered out from those dense volumes, floating in the air and spreading at an astonishing speed.
Jack Clark said with a grave expression, “Marcellus Senior, this is a special virus that spreads indefinitely, ignoring air and liquid mediums, capable of causing biological mutations and evolution, including in plants.”
“Mutation and evolution, similar to the Heavenly Energy of the mythical world?”
“Somewhat similar, but the mutation caused by these viruses primarily affects the physique of the living organism, making them a perfect complement to the Basic Body Refining Technique.”
“However, these viruses are highly dangerous. There’s a seventy percent chance of mutation for ordinary people upon infection, and a single mishap could trigger Doomsday.”
Marcellus Larry became solemn in an instant, “It seems that this matter requires us to personally conduct the research. It’s not safe to entrust it to others.”
Jack Clark nodded, “That’s also the reason I came here to upload the Cultivation Methods.”
The viruses from the Lost World are terrifying, even more so than Biological Viruses—they reproduce infinitely and attach to substances, and under normal conditions, even the strongest defenses would have loopholes.
After tests, Jack Clark found that only the Law Power of Mythical Powerhouses could completely seal off this virus.
Although this virus is frightening, its effects are also quite exaggerated, causing the physiques of ordinary people from the Lost World to skyrocket. In just a few years, their physical bodies were comparable to high-order Senior cultivators.
And those that underwent complete, uncontrolled mutations evolved into high-order creatures within three years. Hence, after deliberation, Jack Clark still chose to bring it back.
While it is a double-edged sword, with the virus combined with the Basic Body Refining Technique, and an abundance of Heavenly Energy, the strength of the Human Federation could be greatly terrifying.
Moreover, cultivators have strong resistance to the virus. As long as we can erase the virus’s ability to spread and retain its mutation function, it would be enough to further enhance the physique of those cultivators.
However, just then, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted slightly, and Marcellus Larry was also startled.
“Not good, these viruses are being neutralized by the Heavenly Energy.”
Boom!
A formidable Sword Intent shook the base, isolating the Heavenly Energy and forming a vacuum with a diameter of ten meters, enveloping those viruses, which were hundreds of times smaller than dust particles.
