chapters.title: Chapter 1289 - 1289 500 Grinding Away the Rules Starting
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1289: Chapter 500 Grinding Away the Rules, Starting Again (First Update) Chapter 1289: Chapter 500 Grinding Away the Rules, Starting Again (First Update) In the heart of a silvery halo vortex that reverberated over thousands of kilometers, the young man with black hair cascading over his shoulders walked out with an indifferent expression, and warriors guarding the pathway around him all bowed respectfully.
“Greetings to the Divine Martial Throne, Your Excellency.”
For the warriors who were cultivators of the Fifth and Sixth-level Heaven, with the leader being from the Eight Layer Heaven, kings were not much different from gods in some respects.
Even though they all knew Jack Clark was very young, they still admired him wholeheartedly.
And their respect wasn’t just for Jack’s cultivation level, but also for his contribution to the Human Federation.
Since the Demon God Belidier was on the Sky Curtain Battlefield at that time, it had been just over ten days, and the ‘biography’ about Jack in the mythical world had already spread far and wide.
Starting from his participation in the Evil God Clone mission in the Sixth-level Heaven to his combat achievements deep within the rear of the Purgatory Empire, the number of Evil Gods and demon kings that had indirectly and directly fallen by his hand already exceeded twenty.
Twenty! This almost accounted for half of the current kings in active service within the Federation.
Such a terrifying battle record, when spread to the mythical world and all the cultivators, including the Heavenly Feather Clan who heard the legends, were immensely shocked.
To know that, after so many years fighting the three major empires, the Heavenly Feather Clan had lost over a hundred Mythical Powerhouses while the three empires had lost only over forty.
At this moment, Jack alone had almost killed half of them, which was simply unimaginable.
Although this was related to the battlefield where the high-end powerhouses of the Heavenly Feather Clan were entangled by a larger number of Great Demon Kings and Demon Gods, it still didn’t deny the terror of this human named Jack Clark.
Facing the fervent gaze from the cultivators below, Jack nodded slightly, “There’s no need for such formalities.”
After signaling the warriors that they needn’t continue with over-the-top respects, Jack turned to look at the sky-based battleships not far away, and then at the divine tree that stood ten thousand meters tall and radiated dazzling golden light.
The moment he saw the Eternal Divine Tree, an involuntary image of golden vertical pupils, large enough to eclipse the sun and sky, appeared in Jack’s eyes.
In an instant, everything in heaven and earth paled in his vision; all things dissipated, leaving only the Golden Divine Tree whose roots extended into the Earth and the Void.
Especially those golden roots that stretched into the Void were entwined with runes of golden radiance, reaching endlessly across the furious World’s Power between the mythical world and the Blue Star World, and probing into Blue Star.
Following those golden roots spreading from Channel One, Jack could even vaguely see the entity of Blue Star ‘world.’
That entity was an endless, brilliant crystalline barrier which now touched another terrifying power. The contact area under the power of the mythical world was slowly enveloped, forming a separate sphere of light.
Within the orb, a star system slowly revolved, with stars surrounded by several points emitting a hazy halo.
At this moment, with the help of the roots of the Eternal Divine Tree at the connection point of the two world passageways, Jack peered into the true vision of the mythical world devouring the Blue Star World.
The brilliant crystalline barrier was evidently the universe where Blue Star was located, vast and boundless, and compared to the universe, the Blue Star and its Star System that were being devoured by the mythical world were but a minor point.
Currently, the mythical world was instinctively eroding that region, and once it was completely finished, it would be the moment the Star System where Blue Star was located was cut off and devoured.
Furthermore, since the mythic power’s erosion had reached the late period, there was no stopping Blue Star from being devoured by the mythical world.
The only thing that could be done to save the world was ensuring that Blue Star would maintain its integrity and not shatter when it was devoured—that is, during the outbreak of the Second Mythical Impact.
Carry Heaven!
This word that Freya Louise once spoke to him suddenly flashed across Jack’s mind.
It appeared that the First Councilor Senior and others had also witnessed this scene, which is why while fending off the Purgatory Family’s attacks over the years, they were simultaneously searching for ways to save the world.
However, shouldering a Star System differed from the Destruction Emperor Dragon dragging a small world with a thousand-kilometer diameter. The pressure to bear would be frighteningly immense.
Even Supreme Experts would be overwhelmed and crushed instantly.
As Jack frowned slightly, a few kilometers away on a battleship, thunder roared and a purple-black lightning snake several kilometers long revealed the figure of Damon Lopes.
“It’s definitely you, Jack. Only someone who’s made such great strides like you would be so showy even just passing by.”
Looking at Damon Lopes, still in his Daoist robe, Jack’s face showed a smile, “Mr. Lopes, it’s been a while.”
Damon Lopes shrugged his shoulders, “Not too long, just two months. But you, my friend, are still as flamboyant as ever. This time you’ve even made your way deep into the Purgatory Family’s back lines.”
Jack chuckled, “It was completely coincidental. If that pathway hadn’t appeared, I wouldn’t have been able to venture so far into the territories of the Purgatory Demon Race.”
Upon saying this, filled with curiosity, Damon Lopes asked, “Jack, are you planning to join the expedition this time as well?”
“We’ll see. I’m going to head over to the Sky Curtain Battlefield first and meet with the First Councilor Senior.” Jack had heard from Marcellus about the expedition, and whether to participate or not would depend on the situation.
Jack had many things lined up next: breaking seals, collecting Life Crystals for Limit Enhancement of his five great body refining techniques, and merging them into Talent Runes to refine the Combat Divine Scripture.
After exchanging greetings with Mr. Lopes, Jack transformed into a ray of golden light, speeding towards the Sky Curtain Battlefield at over twenty times the speed of sound.
It wasn’t until half an hour later that Freya Louise and Jane Aiken, onboard expedition battleships Nos. 1 and 3, over a hundred kilometers away, learned of Jack’s arrival.
“I just knew he’d be okay.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1290 - 1290 500 Grinding Away the Rules Starting
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1290: Chapter 500 Grinding Away the Rules, Starting Again (Second Update) Chapter 1290: Chapter 500 Grinding Away the Rules, Starting Again (Second Update) Standing on the shoulder of Number One, Freya Louise looked towards the Sky Curtain Battlefield, a faint smile appearing on her face.
Meanwhile, on the deck of Battleship Number Three, the black-haired girl who was sitting cross-legged at the edge of the deck, floating above the Cloud Mist, slowly opened her eyes, radiating a terrifying Sword Intent.
“He’s back, huh.”
…
In less than an hour, Jack Clark had traversed nearly 20,000 kilometers to arrive outside the Sky Curtain Battle City, due to the need to save time he hadn’t chosen to travel by Cloud Sky Fighter Jet.
“Detecting high-energy fluctuations, rapidly approaching at twenty-six times the speed of sound.”
“Divine Soul fluctuation detection normal, corresponding with the Divine Martial Throne fluctuation.”
“Welcome to the Sky Curtain Battlefield, Divine Martial Throne…”
As Jack Clark’s smart wristwatch received the signal, projecting an electronic voice, he had already passed through the various bases located one thousand kilometers outside Sky Curtain Battle City.
Simultaneously, the voice of the Sky-based God King echoed in Jack Clark’s ears.
“Jack Clark, come here.”
Guided by an invisible force, turned into a streak of golden light, Jack Clark soared into the sky, one hundred kilometers, two hundred kilometers, quickly reaching high altitudes.
Boom!
Just as Jack Clark crossed the thousand-kilometer Boundary, a heavy and dreadful pressure descended from heaven and earth, as if invisible rules were trying to press him down.
Bang!
The very moment that suffocating pressure, which restricted Mythical Lives, appeared, it was shattered by an invisible Burst of strength emanating from Jack Clark, who continued to ascend at a frightening speed.
As he flew higher and higher, the gravity acting upon him from heaven and earth grew stronger, and the terrifying gravitational pull distorted and shook the surroundings.
In the end, even golden flames ignited on Jack Clark’s body, with blue lightning flashing, emitting a radiance even more dazzling than the Golden Sun in the sky.
This immediately drew the attention of many below.
However, from the high altitude exceeding two thousand kilometers, even the king-level could not clearly see Jack Clark’s figure, only God Kings like Gabriel knew that he had returned.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As Jack Clark, radiating dazzling light, rocketed to an altitude of more than 3,000 kilometers, the invisible gravity permeating the area became so terrifying, it even reached the extent of crushing space.
The dreadful tearing strength that enveloped him made even Jack Clark frown slightly; its intensity had already reached the mid period of a Heavenly King.
“The Heaven of the mythical world is layered, do not forcefully cross over, we will pull you up,” an aged voice sounded, and a field of White Rules enveloped Jack Clark.
Without a sound, Jack Clark appeared tens of thousands of kilometers above the Firmament.
In an instant, Jack Clark felt everything around him become somewhat unreal, with the Earth below beginning to blur. This wasn’t just because of the swirling Cloud Mist; it was as if a few thin membranes were in the way.
As the Earth below became hazy, the Law Patterns permeating heaven and earth became clearer, including the golden light cast from the sun, which seemed to have taken on a physical form.
This highly contradictory sensation made Jack Clark frown.
Not far from Jack Clark in the Void, Adam Garcetti with half-white, half-black hair, smiled slightly: “Do you feel a bit uncomfortable?”
“Not really, just suddenly feeling a bit awkward,” said Jack Clark, withdrawing his gaze from the floating Earth, looking ahead.
There, the First Councilor Adam Garcetti stood on Yin-Yang, forming a Tai Chi Diagram Domain that distorted space-time within a range of several kilometers, emanating a Mysterious Aura.
Not far from Adam Garcetti, the Sky-based God King manifested a 3-meter diameter Golden Rubik’s Cube, rotating slowly.
Jack Clark directly stated his purpose: “Senior Garcetti, Senior Carthius, when I was escaping pursuit from the two Demon Gods sent by Diorus, I encountered an attack from a third Demon God.”
“There was a third Demon God?” exclaimed both Adam Garcetti and the Sky-based God King, surprised that Jack Clark had faced three Demon Gods at once, and yet managed to escape unscathed.
That’s not right, at the end of the recent battle, they could feel two Demon Gods standing off against them on the other side, so besides Diorus and Carthius, the extra Demon God…
The Golden Rubik’s Cube rotated, and the voice of the Sky-based entity came forth: “Jack Clark, was that Demon God from the Purgatory Ancestral Court?”
Jack Clark thought for a moment: “I don’t know where it’s from, but when the opponent was using the Rule force of decree manifestation, the chanting prefix was always ‘Ancestral Decrees’.”
“Those bizarre powers separately sealed my Plane World and Summoning Secret Skill, almost causing an accident, but fortunately, at the last moment, I used a forbidden weapon to teleport.”
“But those Purgatory Demon Gods are indeed very strong, even after I escaped deep into space-time, they shattered the forbidden weapon’s strength with a strike that transcended space-time… ”
Some things, of course, would not be completely revealed, so Jack Clark stuck to the story of falling into the Void Relics.
Still, when they heard that Jack Clark had fallen into an ancient relic of the Human Race and obtained a large amount of Cultivation Methods, including creating a basic Body Refining Technique himself, they were still quite shocked.
Looking at the young man standing in the Void before them, a few strands of white hair in front of his forehead adding a touch of maturity – yet he was only seventeen years old, already shouldering so much for the Federation.
Adam Garcetti suddenly said, “Jack Clark, have you ever thought about establishing a new path of cultivation?”
“Launching a new path of cultivation, what do you mean?” The sudden shift in the conversation startled Jack Clark.
Looking at the young man before him, Adam Garcetti spoke gently, “Do you know about the Intrinsic Weapon in the hands of the True Martial Heavenly King, the True Martial Divine Tablet?”
Jack Clark nodded: “I know.”
Familiar with the True Martial Heavenly King, who, as a pinnacle Heavenly King wielding the True Martial Divine Stele, could clash against and even injure an Ancient Titan Demon God at the mid period, Jack Clark was not unfamiliar with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1291 - 1291 500 Erasing Rules Starting a New Path
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1291: Chapter 500 Erasing Rules, Starting a New Path (First Update)_3 Chapter 1291: Chapter 500 Erasing Rules, Starting a New Path (First Update)_3 Adam Garcetti spoke slowly, “The so-called Race Background Weapon is actually just another pathway of rules, like the ‘True Martial’ condensed on the True Martial Divine Tablet!”
“The naming of the True Martial Heavenly King is also related to the Race Background Weapon. Initially, his title was not True Martial, but it was changed later to align with the rules.”
“Moreover, the Intrinsic Rules do not affect your own strength. If the body refining technique you created meets expectations, it’s like opening another pathway in the Federation.”
“It’s a body refinement system that allows everyone in the Federation to become Transcendent. Once it grows and becomes the ‘Intrinsic’ of the Human Race, it can form an intangible and powerful force.”
“When the time comes, you just need to find an object to carry the Intrinsic; it can form a second rule reinforcement for you.”
Adam’s words piqued Jack Clark’s interest. With his talent, it wouldn’t be long before he could carve out a path and make a breakthrough to Supreme, mastering a Rule.
Together with the Primordial Blank Rule contained within the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, he already possessed two Rules. If he could also master the Power of Race Background…
Jack mused, “Senior, there must be limits to this Intrinsic Rule, right?”
Adam nodded, “Naturally, everything has its pros and cons.”
“The Intrinsic Rule of a tribe is related to civilization. If the civilization collapses, the Intrinsic will dissipate as well. If the bearer of the Intrinsic has only this one Rule, then they will directly fall back to the Realm of Heavenly Kings.”
“Even if a cultivator controls multiple Rules, the disintegration of the Intrinsic will tear the True Body and cause heavy injuries.”
“Of course, the benefits are significant. The Power of Race Background is related to civilization and does not require your effort to cultivate; you only need to overlook and push the civilization’s development.”
“And the stronger the civilization, the stronger this Rule will become. For example, True Martial has already propagated to Supreme, which is why the True Martial Divine Tablet is so powerful.”
“Likewise, the reason Senior Tarolia, Adam, and Diorus were able to step into Supreme so quickly and withstand the Purgatory Demon God without falling behind is also related to this aspect.”
“If a new lineage is re-opened, with our support and the full promotion of the Path of Body Refinement, you could break through the Realm of Heavenly Kings within half a year and start carrying the Intrinsic, touching the Rules ahead of time.”
“By then, skipping the intermediate process and with your talent, perhaps you could break through to Supreme within three years.”
Jack suddenly understood and nodded.
Using a continuously strengthening civilization as a foundation to condense a kind of Intrinsic as a Rule does seem like a shortcut to increase combat power.
But as much as he says that, the conditions for bearing the Intrinsic of a tribe clearly seemed difficult, even for him, who qualified only because he created another pathway of cultivation.
Moreover, the downside was quite apparent for Jack, who was different from Adam and others. His path was longer and broader, so he could not be confined.
So, in the end, Jack shook his head, “Senior, let’s forget it. I have found my own path and am confident that I can surpass the Heavenly King level in a short time.”
“Thus, instead of dividing body refinement, it might be better to continue incorporating it into True Martial. By then, the Divine Stele in the hands of True Martial Senior will also become stronger.”
“This… Well then,” not expecting Jack’s refusal, both Adam and Tarolia paused and then understood, recalling that he had once obtained the Emperor Inheritance.
They had suggested Jack carry the Intrinsic to help him break through to Supreme sooner.
Under normal conditions, to reopen a cultivation pathway would consume a massive amount of resources and energy, especially the ‘weapon’ needed to carry the Intrinsic, which usually requires the efforts of an entire tribe.
However, since Jack refused, Adam and Tarolia did not bring it up again and pondered for a moment.
“The Seal on you is a bit troublesome; it comes from the power left by a true Purgatory True Demon during its Hibernation. Even Mad Wheeler almost got suppressed by the Purgatory Decree back then.”
Jack’s gaze shifted slightly, “Mad Wheeler, the Senior who opened a world and mastered the Supreme Law.”
The Golden Rubik’s Cube rotated slowly, “Yes, when Mad Wheeler stepped into the Realm of Heavenly Kings, he directly killed a Great Demon King on the battlefield, which triggered a targeted response.”
“Also, because of Mad Wheeler’s actions back then, we learned just how formidable the Purgatory Family’s intrinsic power is, and while we accumulate our own intrinsic strength even faster, we thought of ways to delve into the enemy territory to gather more information.”
“Heavenly Base, this time I’ll go, leave the matters of the battlefield to you and Primordial.”
“Mm.” The Rubik’s Cube rotated slightly.
Boom!
Above ten thousand kilometers, the Yin-Yang radiance flourished greatly, forming an eclipse-like Tai Chi Diagram that slowly rotated. The sudden change once again caused everyone below to look up in astonishment.
However, at this moment, no one knew what had happened that made the First Councilor take such serious actions, revealing anomalies of rule.
Above ten thousand kilometers, as the Tai Chi Diagram rotated, it seemed like an apocalyptic millstone, emitting terrifying power. The invisible suppressive pressure made it difficult for everyone below to breathe.
Even the Purgatory Demon Race base located over twenty thousand kilometers away felt it, and the two defending Demon Gods also turned their gaze.
However, the moment the Demon Gods’ gaze neared the Human Base, they were blocked by a Mecha standing at ten thousand meters tall, like a god emitting endless white Divine Light.
The strange occurrence lasted for about a day and a half, and then the Tai Chi Diagram disappeared. Above the ten thousand kilometer sky, Jack Clark and Adam Garcetti were visible once more.
“Senior, thank you,” Jack Clark said solemnly, offering a slight bow to Adam Garcetti seated in the Void.
Compared to the ease of eroding the Seal of Hell’s Eye, asking Adam Garcetti to obliterate those two seals was harder than Jack had imagined. That was a rule power surpassing the Supreme.
Even Adam Garcetti, who is known as the strongest among the Human Race, had to expend Rule Origin to do it, with a ten-to-one consumption ratio.
Adam Garcetti, noticeably weakened, shook his head: “This is what I should do. Whether it’s because of your contribution to the Federation or as a younger generation of the Human Race, I have an obligation to look after you.”
“Now that your Seal has been obliterated, what comes next is indeed a matter that requires your troubles.”
Jack Clark replied courteously, “Senior, please speak.”
“There’s no need to be so formal; it’s about the expedition.”
“This time, we’ve formed an alliance with the Heavenly Feather Clan, dispatching an Expeditionary Army led by the True Martial Heavenly King to provide support, but both we and the Heavenly Feather Clan understand that the clan’s destruction is certain.”
“The main purpose of this support is, first, to delay the destruction of the Heavenly Feather Clan, and second, to show strength to those wavering within our allies.”
“With the True Martial at the Heavenly King level, and you among the younger generation present, the strength you’ll showcase should be sufficient to bolster those ‘persons” confidence.”
“The Heavenly Feather Clan will be destroyed but not annihilated. We need to win over the remaining members of the Heavenly Feather Clan to stand with us against our enemies.”
“According to the information brought back by Mysterious Martial Denny Kaye and the others, Diorus and its empires are expanding recklessly because of the command of a Purgatory ancestor.”
“Therefore, after the Heavenly Feather Clan’s destruction, with the three empires freed up and their main forces recovering, they will definitely divert some of their strength here, and our pressure will accordingly double.”
Just as Jack had thought earlier, the information he got from Tarolia was already known to Adam Garcetti and others, and preparations were already underway.
“I understand, Senior,” Jack Clark nodded slightly.
“However, although the Seal is now broken, I need some time to heal my injuries, so the Expeditionary Army will have to wait for me for a day.”
Adam Garcetti nodded: “No problem, I’ll notify them.”
Soon, a golden light streaked across heaven and earth, flying toward Channel One City. Jack Clark would find a place to summon the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Purple little dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1292 - 1292 501 The Resurrection of the God Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1292: Chapter 501: The Resurrection of the God Demon Body, The Chaotic Giant Dragon Family Relations Chapter 1292: Chapter 501: The Resurrection of the God Demon Body, The Chaotic Giant Dragon Family Relations Over a continuous cluster of lakes, large ones spanning tens of kilometers and small ones a few hundred meters across, a light mist clung to the surface, shimmering like pearls under the golden sunlight.
Forests encircled these lakes, among which Unique Beasts with bodies stretching dozens to hundreds of meters made their home.
In those lakes, Mutated Fish fifteen to twenty meters long would occasionally leap from the water only to smash back down with a booming sound, causing water to spray everywhere, encapsulating the wildness of the place.
It was then that a golden light flashed in the sky and, all of a sudden, Jack Clark appeared in the air ten thousand meters above the Chain Lakes with an indifferent look on his face, and he slowly said, “This will do.”
By now he had traveled tens of thousands of kilometers away from the Frontline Battlefield, circumventing the various transportation routes between the Logistics City and the front lines, finding himself in a secluded, uninhabited area.
Feeling that the time was right, Jack Clark raised his left hand, and a gloomy blue mark emerged on it, signifying the unsealed Space-Time Summoning Altar.
Hum! As Jack Clark reactivated the long-unused Summoning Secret Skill, the mark on the back of his hand suddenly blazed with light, radiating dazzling brilliance, from which countless gloomy blue Rune Sequence Chains flew out.
The Rune Sequence Chains spread out from Jack Clark as the center, grandly unfolding into a flat array covering a three-kilometer radius.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark unfolded the Space-Time Altar, in the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region under the brilliant sunlight, the Earth’s hills undulated, and a sea of flowers blooming in gold and red stretched for hundreds of kilometers.
Roar Roar!!
Above the sea of flowers, the Silver Giant Dragon, with wings spanning over a thousand meters, let out excited roars. After circling around, their mouths flared with light, and instantly, a breath of white Ice Flame and a roar of colorful breaths blasted forth.
Boom Boom! Under the terrifying breath of the Mythical Dragons, the ground exploded, numerous flowers were frozen by the sweeping breath, shattered and exploded.
“I knew it would be like this,” muttered the Black-red Colossal Beast, over two thousand seven hundred meters long, standing tall on a distant hillside, shaking its huge head feebly, as if at a loss for words.
Its massive head, like a mountain peak, stirred up a raging wind when moved, causing the eight hundred-meter-long Single-horned Spawn Roc nearby to sway slightly and cry out involuntarily.
Roar Roar Roar!! Thunderflame, the Great Sethia, you’re so childish.
Childish?
The Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head slightly, its gaze settling on the Spawn Roc beneath it. There, over a range of one kilometer, the fresh flowers and even the dirt had been devoured by some immense strength.
You’re a Spawn, not a bee.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a deep, powerful roar, “Joe, how do those flowers taste?”
The Single-horned Spawn Roc flapped its massive wings and murmured subconsciously, Roar Roar Roar!! Can’t taste much.
These guys, none of them give me peace of mind, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head, then roared lowly, “Joe, I must leave for a while, tell Great Sethia and the others not to wander off.”
Without waiting for a reply from the Single-horned Spawn Roc, a vast gloomy blue altar suddenly appeared under the feet of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shining brightly.
Amidst the Distortion of Radiance, where even space twisted, the figure of the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly vanished.
Feeling the sudden disappearance of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Aura, distant Dragon Roars bellowed, and the Silver Giant Dragon along with the Golden Blue Dragon transformed into two streaks of light. Whisking up a violent storm, they appeared.
“Roar! Joe, where did Tim Abott disappear to?”
Rollicking Roar!! Thunderflame, he’s been summoned by that human named Jack Clark again.
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon roared, “Cursed humans, to have called Tim Abott to fight for them again. Next time the Great Sethia sees him, we must teach him a harsh lesson.”
Since the Destruction Emperor Dragon had explained to them several times that the one summoning it was the human ‘Jack Clark’ who had made a contract with it before.
In the presence of that human who had a ‘terrifying’ aura on the sea surface, the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts all had an impression.
However, at that time, Jack Clark was only at the Eight Layer Heaven stage, which, compared to level eight, was terrifying indeed, having inflicted a heavy injury on the Level 9 Giant Beast Kidora with a single blow.
But this level of strength was no longer regarded by the Silver Giant Dragon that had grown to the Mid-Mythical Stage.
…
Boom!
As the nearly three-kilometer-long Black-red Colossal Beast descended, suddenly a Terrifying Aura permeated over the Chain Lakes, discoloring the sky and earth as dark clouds gathered and thunder roared.
In the blink of an eye, an area of several hundred kilometers was cloaked in oppressive dark clouds, from within which dazzling lightning flashed violently, illuminating the heavens and the Earth as if Doomsday had arrived.
The intangible, ferocious Dragon Might that spread between heaven and earth caused all Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts within a thousand kilometers to tremble in fear, huddling close to the ground.
This was the might of a Titan mid-stage Giant Beast; its even stronger presence merged with Heaven and Earth, inciting a climactic disturbance effortlessly.
Under the flashing lightning, Jack Clark gazed at the colossal, ferocious behemoth over a kilometer tall before him, and an overwhelming sensation of a behemoth’s oppression surged toward him.
“If Jim saw ‘me’ like this, he’d probably jump in fright,” he mused.
Reflecting on the time when the Six-legged Salamander was only a few tens of centimeters long, and Glenn Clark threatened to ‘eat’ it, both Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon revealed a hint of a smile in their eyes.
But soon after the laughter, it was time for serious business.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strength grew ever stronger, the energy cost of summoning the physical body of Jack Clark became greater too. Although his own cultivation had improved quite a bit, he still could not sustain it for long.
Jack Clark’s expression gradually became solemn, and he watched as the Destruction Emperor Dragon reached its claw towards the Reverse Scale under its neck. Instantly, space vibrated, and a four-hundred-meters-long piece of pure golden skeleton was pulled out.
Boom!
The moment the skeletal remains of the Titan mid-stage Golden Roc Giant Beast appeared, the waves of rule fluctuations it released naturally whipped up a sharp, cutting wind.
The golden gales, like dozens of golden feathered swords, each tens of meters long, were exceedingly sharp, cutting through everything, causing the space ten meters around Jack Clark to constantly resound with rumbling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1293 - 1293 501 The Resurrection of the God Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1293: Chapter 501: The Resurrection of the God Demon Body, The Chaotic Giant Dragon Family Relations_2 Chapter 1293: Chapter 501: The Resurrection of the God Demon Body, The Chaotic Giant Dragon Family Relations_2 “`
As a Giant Beast that has fused with the Laws, even if a Titan Level Giant Beast perishes, the Law Power remaining in its skeleton will continue to affect the surroundings.
Similarly, the skeletons of Titan Giant Beasts are extremely precious essences of Heaven and Earth.
Rip!
Behind Jack Clark, a crack stretching for a kilometer slowly opened, revealing the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane where black winds howled and thunder roared, exerting a powerful suction that absorbed the Golden Roc Titan’s skeleton.
Boom!
The moment the skeleton of a Titan Giant Beast fell in, the entire Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane trembled, and space became ethereal, pulling the skeleton into the Plane’s Origin Space.
Just then, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took out a dark red Flame Whale’s spine measuring over seven hundred meters long and a piece of amethyst-colored skeleton from the Reverse Scale Space.
Boom, boom!!
As the skeletons of two more Titan Giant Beasts entered, the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane shook even more intensely, with the three skeletal sections emitting dazzling purple, gold, and red radiance.
These lights were intermixed with the talents, Law Origin Factors, mastered by the three Titan Giant Beasts, releasing an overwhelming semi-material energy.
Suddenly, the Plane World with a diameter of eleven hundred kilometers expanded at an astonishing rate, with countless rocks and dirt appearing out of nowhere at the edges, and the space’s capacity to bear became even stronger.
Even the crystal walls surrounding the Plane visibly thickened and solidified at a rate noticeable to the naked eye.
As a world that carries the Supreme Law, the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane also nurtured the Law of Strength during its expansion, with countless mysterious Law Auras surging up from Jack Clark’s heart.
But now was not the time for cultivation. Jack Clark turned his hand over, took out the Time Dragon’s scale, and tossed it to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, then with a flash, he appeared on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Eeeya eeeya!!
Seemingly feeling Jack Clark’s approach, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mane trembled, and the Purple little dragon coiled up inside let out an unconscious sound in its sleep.
Jack Clark approached the Purple little dragon, which was ten meters long, and patted its head: “Misss Joseline, stop sleeping, wake up and feed me a little.”
Eeeya!? The Purple little dragon, still half asleep, opened its eyes and looked at Jack Clark in front of it somewhat blankly.
Jack Clark rubbed the Purple little dragon’s head: “Stop eeeying, you’ll get extra treats later, and remember, don’t reveal my existence to anyone.”
Eeeya!! You really are my brother!
The Purple little dragon suddenly became fully alert, its eyes wide.
Although earlier, it sensed that the life Auras and Soul Fluctuations of Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon were somewhat similar, which led to this speculation, it was still somewhat uncertain.
Because the souls of this human and the Destruction Emperor Dragon were completely independent, each belonging to a whole individual, and were by no means an Avatar.
It was unexpected that this human now acknowledged that he and the Destruction Emperor Dragon were indeed one and the same.
Suddenly, the Purple little dragon’s eyes lit up – haha, only the great May knew this secret, far cooler than Scythia.
Eeeya eeeya!! No problem, brother, leave it to May!
The Purple little dragon promptly ‘stood’ up, took a deep breath, and its Full-body Scales Armor began to emit purple light, with energy converging towards its mouth.
Aooo… Roar!
As the Purple little dragon roared, a robust stream of Purple Energy sprayed out and landed on Jack Clark, vast and mighty.
The moment the Creation origin inherent in the Purple Energy was integrated into Jack Clark’s body, it ‘exploded’ with a bang, and countless cells and genes revived with Horrific Life force, resurrecting once more.
Boom!
Instantly, a Terrifying Aura burst forth from Jack Clark, shaking Heaven and Earth; the air exploded, forming concentric rings of explosive waves that spread out in all directions.
Under the oppressive might of an ancient God Demon, even the Purple little dragon’s eyes bulged, pinned firmly atop the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, its eyes shining with excitement.
But just then, countless Gloomy Blue Sequence Chains gathered below and vanished on the back of Jack Clark’s hand as time and space reversed, turning the Destruction Emperor Dragon into a phantom before it disappeared.
Suddenly, the continuous flow of energy inside Jack Clark ceased.
With the supplement of the Purple little dragon’s Creation origin, Jack Clark’s body, which was already on the verge of exhaustion, revived, undergoing a special Transformation that felt like breaking and then standing anew.
Coupled with the frantic expansion of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, and the continuous emergence of profound insights from the Law of Strength at the forefront of his mind, he needed some time to digest it all.
So Jack Clark simply sat cross-legged high in the air and began cultivating, his Innate Aura becoming more and more terrifying.
Meanwhile, as time and space reversed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon reappeared above the sea of flowers, and the Silver Giant Dragon came over immediately, growling in confusion.
“Roar! Tim Abott, why have you returned so soon this time?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly lowered its head and said to the Silver Giant Dragon below, “Scythia, do you want to see your father, Kulapavida?”
“Roar! My father?” The Blue-White Giant Dragon was startled.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon next to it also came over with interest: “Thunderflame, how do you know Scythia’s father’s name is Kulapavida?”
The corners of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth lifted slightly, revealing a vicious smile as it opened its left claw: “This is the Heart Scale of Scythia’s father. As soon as we activate the power within, your father will appear.”
Activating the power contained within the Heart Scale to bring back the Time Dragon was, of course, a task for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Additionally, with Scythia’s bond, the Destruction Emperor Dragon wanted to see if it could keep the Time Dragon and bring it into the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.
By then, with both daughter and husband in the Dragon Palace, it would make no difference whether the Blue-White Giant Dragon joined or not.
By the way, they could also bring in the mother of the golden-blue Giant Dragon and, together with the territories ruled by the two dragons, the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire would rapidly inflate to rival an empire on the scale of the Purgatory Empire.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1294 - 1294 501 The Resurrection of the God Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1294: Chapter 501 The Resurrection of the God Demon Body, The Chaotic Relationships in the Giant Dragon Family_3 Chapter 1294: Chapter 501 The Resurrection of the God Demon Body, The Chaotic Relationships in the Giant Dragon Family_3 Looking at the white Dragon Scale in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claw, the Silver Giant Dragon hesitated a bit: “Roar! Tim Abbott, maybe don’t shout just yet, the Great Sethia isn’t quite ready.”
Since hatching, the Silver Giant Dragon had lived with the Blue-White Giant Dragon, and although it had heard that it had a father and retained some inherited memories, it had never met him.
Now, suddenly hearing news of its father, the Silver Giant Dragon felt something akin to… stage fright as it neared home.
Just then, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon suddenly roared: “Scythia, the magnificent Telsafi has sensed it, you are afraid.”
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened: “Roar! Curse you, Telsafi, the Great Sethia could never be afraid, I’m just preparing to activate it in a moment.”
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon gracefully raised its head: “I don’t believe it, Scythia, you are definitely scared.”
“Roar! The Great Sethia has never been afraid of anyone, it’s just about calling my father back,” said the Silver Giant Dragon as it fiercely snatched the white Dragon Scale from the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claw.
Hum! With the power flowing within Sethia, the white Dragon Scale, instilled with the Time Rule, emitted rings of silver ripples in an instant.
The silver ripples spread across ten kilometers, distorting space-time wherever they passed. Strands of transparent timelines emerged as if tangible, giving all the Giant Beasts the sensation that space-time was starting to intertwine.
This distorted space-time gradually began to overlap with a particular segment of time, a certain moment, and a vision of a grand three-thousand-meter-long white dragon emerged from the depths of time.
Roar! A majestic and lofty Dragon Roar resounded through Heaven and Earth.
Amid excited roars, the Time Dragon, radiating with white light, returned from the past and descended: “Humans, you have indeed kept your promise.”
No sooner had the Time Dragon spoken than a look of astonishment appeared in its eyes. Its gaze swept over the slightly smaller Black-red Colossal Beast in front of it.
What’s going on, wasn’t it that human who activated the Heart Scale?
The Destruction Emperor Dragon glanced around at the now calm space-time and growled slowly: “Welcome back, Prince Kulapavida. Allow me to introduce myself formally, I am the King of the Beast Empire’s Dragon Palace Thunderflame, Brock Abbott.”
The Time Dragon, having witnessed the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s fierce confrontation with two Purgatory Demon Gods, looked solemn and nodded slowly: “I’ve heard of you, mighty Thunderflame Dragon King. Thank you for activating the Heart Scale.”
The corners of Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled slightly: “There’s no need for formalities, Prince Kulapavida. However, it wasn’t I who activated the Heart Scale, but your daughter Sethia.”
Roar!
No sooner had the Destruction Emperor Dragon spoken than the Silver Giant Dragon beside him let out a shocked roar and instinctively hid behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shielding itself with its immense body.
My daughter Sethia! The Time Dragon’s gaze suddenly became a bit excited.
Until now, its attention had been solely on the terrifying Black-red Colossal Beast and had not noticed the few Giant Beasts nearby, including the Silver Giant Dragon to which it felt a blood connection.
Boom!
The White Giant Dragon took a step forward, and with every heavy step, the Void itself shook, the invisible time power radiating from its body eroding the fabric of reality and once again bringing forth a sense of intertwining space-time.
The Time Dragon, somewhat excited, said, “Sethia, don’t be afraid, I am your father Kulapavida.”
A Silver Dragon head peeked out from behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon and roared in irritation: “Roar! Damn it, the Great Sethia knows you,” it bellowed.
“And knows that you went to peep on Auntie Caotena next door, making mother very angry, and in the end, mother gave you a good thrashing and drove you away.”
Instantly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became dumbfounded.
Because earlier, the Time Dragon and Jack Clark had talked about this matter, attributing its departure before the Silver Giant Dragon’s hatching and living with the Blue-White Giant Dragon to the erosion of surrounding time.
Now the Silver Giant Dragon was suggesting the reason the Time Dragon had left was to sneak a peek at another Titan Dragon next door.
Wait, are relationships among you dragons also this complicated?

chapters.title: Chapter 1295 - 1295 502
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1295: Chapter 502 Chapter 1295: Chapter 502 When the Silver Giant Dragon mentioned sneaking a peek at the neighboring auntie and then getting chased away by the Blue-White Giant Dragon, there was a moment of silence among the few Giant Beasts present.
Not only was the Destruction Emperor Dragon dumbfounded, but even the Single-horned Spawn Roc, who felt some reverence for this Time Dragon under the pressure of the Titan Peak Beast, was greatly shocked.
Is it really such a mess among the Mythical Dragons?
With this thought, the Single-horned Spawn Roc subconsciously glanced at both the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon, and then turned its gaze to the imposing Black-red Colossal Beast, its eyes flickering.
It seemed to have found a blind spot.
“What sneaking a peek? I was merely planning to visit the Chaotic Turbulent Region in search of resources and just happened to pass by Caotena’s Territory,” the Time Dragon growled in defense against the ‘accusation’ of the Silver Giant Dragon.
However, from its tone, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt an inexplicable lack of confidence.
Also, the Destruction Emperor Dragon noticed that ever since the Time Dragon had returned, the Golden Blue Giant Dragon had tucked its wings and stood elegantly to one side, watching quietly.
There was neither the warmth of seeing the ‘Uncle’ next door for the first time, nor any curiosity about the legendary dragon rumored to have been chased away.
The Silver Giant Dragon poking its head from behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, “Roar! The Great Scythia is no fool, clearly, what Mother said holds more credibility.”
After all, being raised by the Blue-White Giant Dragon, Scythia’s stance at that moment was very firm.
However, with this interjection, the Destruction Emperor Dragon knew it was not appropriate to invite the other party into the Dragon Palace Empire now, so he growled to interrupt, “Prince Kulapavida, according to the agreement with the Contractor, I have already pulled you from the past.”
“What are your plans moving forward as we continue deeper into the Chaotic Domain to gather resources and enhance our strength?”
With the distraction provided by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the slightly awkward atmosphere relaxed, and the Time Dragon somewhat regrettably withdrew its gaze and growled solemnly, “My rule body is in the final stages of Transformation, and next, I must delve deeper into the Time Rift, so I cannot accompany you all.”
“However, speaking of resources, I’ve collected quite a few during my wanderings through the Time Rifts over the years.” As the Time Dragon said this, its Reverse Scale flickered and an intense energy and Law Aura spread out in an instant.
In front of the White Giant Dragon, seven beams of Divine Light flashed, and among the Divine Objects, five emitted Law Level vibrations.
They were a Green Twelve-Product Lotus with a diameter of five meters, a Pure Golden Crystal Stone the size of several meters, a Purple Vine tens of meters long, a white flame in which a shadow of a Unique Beast flickered, and a black crystal fruit several meters in diameter.
Remaining was a Nine-leaved Orchid resembling a bloom several meters high and a mass of pure sky-blue liquid. Although not at the Law Level, both had reached the pinnacle of Top-level Divine Items and emitted a Law Charm.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but be dazzled, surprised by the Time Dragon’s ‘wealth’ as it brought forth so many Law resources all at once.
After all, it had previously fought against an Ancient Giant Python, a formidable adversary, for just two Law Level Stone Hearts.
Under the cover of a Silver Light Cover, the six Divine Items separated and each floated in front of the Giant Beasts.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon received the Purple Vine. The Green Lotus and Pure Golden Crystal Stone flew to the Silver Giant Dragon, while the White Flame and Black Crystal Fruit went to the Golden Blue Giant Dragon.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc got the Nine-leaved Orchid, and the mass of Heavenly Blue Pure Water flew above the Destruction Emperor Dragon to the Purple Little Dragon, who had become somewhat weaker after releasing a breath of its Origin and had fallen back asleep.
This distribution once again confirmed the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s thoughts.
The Time Dragon giving it a Law Divine Artifact made sense as a token of gratitude for helping it return from the past. Giving two items to the Silver Giant Dragon was not surprising either, as she was its daughter.
But treating the Golden Blue Giant Dragon on par with the Silver Giant Dragon seemed rather unusual.
After all, ‘officially’, the Golden Blue Giant Dragon was the daughter of its neighbor, and to give a Law Level Divine Artifact as a housewarming gift, even something a Titan Beast would envy, was already quite generous.
The Time Dragon growled, “These are some of the resources I’ve ‘picked up’ while wandering through time over the years, which are of no use to me anymore. Today, I give them to you all as gifts upon our meeting, so please don’t be modest.”
“Prince Kulapavida is too courteous.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled into a fierce smile, then it opened its formidable jaws slightly and with a strong suction, it swallowed the items in one gulp.
Boom!
As a Divine Object embodying a pure strand of Law’s Origin, the moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed it, the Purple Vine burst open, releasing a violent burst of purple light.
Under the onslaught of this Overbearing power, the cells within the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s flesh and blood vibrated, its bones stretched, and its whole body crackled as it was permeated by the purple light.
Roar! How is this possible!
As the Time Dragon’s eyes widened, the slightly smaller Black-red Colossal Beast in front of it began to swell at a visible speed after swallowing the Purple Vine.
And it wasn’t just simple growth; the Aura of Laws permeating its body also rose and merged, with the invisible pressure of the Titan Giant Beast becoming even more terrifying.
Watching the shock on its father’s face, the Silver Giant Dragon growled with some disdain, “Roar! Stop being surprised. Tim Abott has always been quick to digest and convert energy; it’s quite normal.”
Normal my ass, this Black-red Colossal Beast’s energy digestion and conversion rate is nearly a thousand times that of mine, a Titan Peak Giant Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1296 - 1296 502
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1296: Chapter 502 Chapter 1296: Chapter 502 Although the Time Dragon internally mocked, since its daughter had already spoken, it couldn’t show its surprise.
Compose yourself, stay calm, I am about to step into the realm of ancient Giants, and even though the Black-red Colossal Beast digests quickly, it’s only at the mid-period of Titan, who knows how long it will take to break through to ancient times.
Comforting itself, the Time Dragon quickly regained its composure.
The Silver Giant Dragon glanced at the increasingly strong aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, then raised its head and let out a disdainful roar, “Roar! Don’t think that by giving a few nice things to eat, the Great Scythia will forgive you.”
However, no sooner had the Silver Giant Dragon finished speaking than the golden-blue Giant Dragon elegantly stepped forward, “Scythia, if you don’t want it, then give it to me.”
With that, the golden-blue Giant Dragon extended its right claw to grab the Green Lotus in front of the Silver Giant Dragon.
At the same time, the low soul fluctuation of the golden-blue Giant Dragon resonated in the ear of the Silver Giant Dragon, “Idiot, don’t worry about what this guy says for now; grab the benefits before you worry about anything else.”
“Roar! Damn Telsafi, don’t you dare steal what belongs to the Great Scythia.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared hastily, twirling its tail to wrap the Lotus and the Golden Crystal Stone behind itself to protect them, and then glared fiercely at the golden-blue Giant Dragon.
But as Mythical Giant Beasts, their exchange of soul fluctuations was almost no different from speaking directly in front of the Time Dragon.
The Time Dragon suddenly felt somewhat awkward.
But it didn’t matter whether the Time Dragon felt awkward or not. After the Silver Giant Dragon had taken the two Law Divine Artifacts away, the golden-blue Giant Dragon leisurely collected the Black Divine Fruit and the white flame.
They were not like the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which could directly digest Law Level Divine Artifacts upon consumption.
Roar! Thank you, thank you, Prince Kulapavida.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc wasn’t so concerned. After expressing its gratitude with pep, it happily opened its huge mouth and swallowed the Nine-Leaf Lotus.
This is the advantage of following the boss; there are always good things to eat.
Yi ya yi ya!!
The half-asleep Purple little dragon opened its tiny mouth barely and swallowed the Heavenly Blue Pure Water floating in front of it, its body instantly wreathed in a rich wave of energy.
Hoo!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled a hot breath through its nostrils and slowly opened its eyes, golden vertical pupils shimmering with black lightning, and let out a low rumble, its hum vibrating Heaven and Earth.
“Thank you for the gifts from Prince Kulapavida, which have again refined my strength a bit more.”
As the Purple Vine Energy was mostly digested, its body length soared from 2,700 meters to over 2,780 meters, its aura growing even more terrifying.
The six Golden Red Feather Horns on either side of its head, aside from the silver spatial Rune Trails, were now oozing with other Law Patterns such as destruction, Vajra, and Chaotic Dark Power, appearing even more dazzling.
Looking at those six feather horns, the Time Dragon’s eyes revealed shock, “May I ask out of curiosity, Thunderflame Dragon King, how many Supreme talent rules have you mastered?”
There was no need to conceal such a matter, hence the Destruction Emperor Dragon casually roared, “Not many, just nine.”
Hiss! The Time Dragon couldn’t help but gasp in shock. Truly a freak of nature, no wonder its strength was so formidable—it could standoff against two Purgatory Demon Gods even at the Early Titan Growth Realm.
Wait… Early Titan.
Looking at the nearly 2,800 meter-long Black-red Colossal Beast and the Silver Giant Dragon that had reached the Mid-Mythical Stage, the Time Dragon was taken aback once more.
“I didn’t expect that a brief return to the past would mean so much time has passed when I returned to the present,” the Time Dragon mused softly.
“Thunderflame Dragon King, I entrust Scythia and Telsafi to your care. Once I’ve completed my transformation into a rule body, I shall be surely indebted to you.”
After speaking, the Time Dragon’s body shimmered with silver light, and its form twisted slightly, disappearing as if it had entered another time.
As soon as the Time Dragon left, the Silver Giant Dragon sighed in relief, “Roar! Finally, that guy is gone. In front of it, the Great Scythia doesn’t feel majestic at all.”
Uh… At this train of thought, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon was somewhat at a loss for words.
When this guy met his father, whom he had never seen before, he wasn’t excited or affectionate at all but was instead concerned that he wasn’t looking majestic enough in front of a larger white dragon.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly approached the Destruction Emperor Dragon, roaring happily, “Roar! Tim Abott, since that guy gave us two great items, the Great Sesi will give you one if we can’t finish them.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon also stepped forward, rumbling softly, “We’re only at the Mid-Mythical Stage and can only digest one in the short term. You take the other one, Thunderflame.”
Without waiting for the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon to refuse, the golden-blue Giant Dragon cocked its head, “You digest faster, and after eating, you can quickly transform it into strength so that we can gather more resources.”
Looking at the two Giant Dragons sharing half their spoils with the Destruction Emperor Dragon, envy was evident in the eyes of the Single-horned Spawn Roc standing behind them.
Approaching the floating Green Twelve-Product Lotus and Black Crystal Divine Fruit, the Destruction Emperor Dragon hesitated briefly and then roared softly, “Then I shall not stand on ceremony.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon did not refuse the kindness of the two Giant Dragons; as the golden-blue Giant Dragon said, it could transform the items into strength at the first chance.
Once it had made its breakthrough into ancient times, the efficacy of the Law Level Divine Objects would sharply diminish, and by that time, they would mostly be left for the Silver Giant Dragon and the others to use.
Boom Boom!!
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed the two Law Level Divine Artifacts, more violent Laws’ Origin and energy exploded within its body, and its aura surged once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1297 - 1297 502_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1297: Chapter 502_3 Chapter 1297: Chapter 502_3 So it turns out, today it scored three law-level resources from the Time Dragon, which is practically a windfall.
As the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon surged to three thousand meters, a thread of Evolution Energy invisibly passed through the Soul Channel and appeared within Jack Clark’s body out of thin air.
Above the distant Chain Lakes, a mysterious yellow light group ten meters in size hovered, slowly expanding and contracting, emitting a terrifying gravitational force that inhaled the Heavenly Energy within a thousand kilometers.
Endless energy gathered below, almost forming a white vortex inverted in the sky, devoured by the horrific life within the light group.
As the terrifying aura within the light group grew stronger, the entire world trembled, and the dark clouds, once dispersed, gathered again, shrouding an area of hundreds of kilometers.
Boom!
Suddenly a dazzling lightning bolt descended from the sky, brutally striking the light group and exploding, releasing a powerful current that whipped through the air within a range of hundreds of meters.
That was followed by a second and a third bolt of lightning, and as heavenly thunders fell one after another, the light group was engulfed by lightning, radiating blinding light, with an immense impact.
However, these forces of heavenly thunder that hit the light group were all devoured by the formidable life inside.
With his Life Origin exhausted and replenished by the Purple Little Dragon’s relentless Creation Origin, Jack Clark’s Innate Demon God Body, like being reborn from destruction, burst forth with a terrifying vitality.
It seemed to align with certain rules; all the Mysterious Yellow Air absorbed in the body from the Black Forbidden Zone World Origin Space and the Mysterious Yellow Air gathered when opening the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane exploded.
With this originally integrated Mysterious Yellow Air becoming detached and reshaped, Jack Clark’s physique underwent another transformation, becoming even closer to the Beginning of Heaven and Earth.
Additionally, with the Evolution Energy fed back from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, at this moment Jack Clark’s physique became increasingly formidable, the mere intangible release of his power shattering the space around him.
In the collapsing darkness of the space around Jack, two black chains representing Void, representing the soul, grey chains of Death, blue chains of Thunder, and golden chains of Flame encircled him, forming five halos.
The five fully grown chains were now merging with Jack Clark’s True Body at an astonishing rate, with their aura rapidly approaching the Mythical Peak.
The life at the Beginning of Heaven and Earth naturally aligns with the laws and rules of Heavenly Earth.
Therefore, when Jack Clark turned misfortune into a blessing, and his life and physique metamorphosed from acquired to innate, becoming akin to the life at the dawn of Heaven and Earth as Innate God Demons, they naturally began to merge with the laws.
Even Jack Clark was somewhat surprised by this result.
But at that moment, Jack was immersed in the state of Cultivation, absorbing the rush of law information, unknowingly experiencing the transformation occurring throughout his body.
Time passed as Jack cultivated and healed, the golden sun in the sky slowly set, and the red star rose, standing tall in the sky, casting red radiance.
Under the invisible red sunlight, all living beings in the mythical world inexplicably became somewhat restless.
Especially the Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts with lower intelligence, they became more aggressive and savage, and soon from the distant horizon came the roars of Level 9 Giant Beasts and the hiss of battle.
At the same time, the Mysterious Yellow Light Group, after a day of cultivation, shook and then exploded into a sky filled with yellow light that disappeared.
In the hundreds of meters wide Dark Void created by the collapse of space, Jack Clark, seated cross-legged, wearing a white T-shirt, with black hair cascading over his shoulders, slowly opened his eyes.
His eyes, distinctly black and white, dazzled and emitted an indescribable majesty and indifference, as if standing above the Firmament, overlooking all beings like an ancient deity.
Huff!
Jack Clark slowly exhaled, feeling the power within him that seemed capable of destroying the world with a single blow, and with a thought, summoned the attribute page.
Compared to figuring out the changes bit by bit on his own, nothing was more direct than looking at the attribute page.
Realm: Mythical King [Late Period]
Heavenly Dragon. Physique: 70 → 85
Heavenly Dragon. Strength: 74 → 89
Heavenly Dragon. Agility: 41 → 57
Divine Soul. Spirit: 46 → 63
True Body: True. Fighting Demon God [Reborn from destruction, born Innate Demon God Body that conforms more with the laws of Heavenly Earth, attacks carry an additional thirty percent amplification based on the original strength.
Traits: Halberd, Hidden Deity Strength, Void-Striking Heart Eye, Hell’s Eye, Divine Might Entwining, Divine Powers [Supreme Vacuum, Absolute Barrier, Heaven-walking Divine Steps]
Possesses Demon God True Body, Fighting Demon God. Dragon, Fighting Demon God. Doomsday Emperor Dragon. Dark, three major forms.
Remark: Upon actualizing the Fighting Demon God True Body, all traits and divine powers will be fully unleashed.]
Deification Talent: Soul Split, Void Death Pupil
Law of Strength [Supreme 27%→ 48], Void Law [Higher-order 75%→ 88], Death Law [Higher-order 76%→ 89], Soul Law [Higher-order 71%→ 85]
Great Sun Heaven Flame Law [Higher-order 81%→ 93], Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder Law [Higher-order 82%→ 94]
Rune: Dark Star
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Sixth level 61%→ 69], Great Sun True Body [ninth level]…
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark [Limit Break]
Superior Divine Power: Time Reincarnation [Mark of Time +9]
Special Trace: Ancient Duel Mark
Real World: Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder [Small world, true range seventeen hundred kilometers, rapid expansion status digesting Titan skeleton essence]
Attribute points: 17
Soul Points: 3570
Avatar Body: Cang. Tian. Destruction Emperor Dragon
Level: Mid Period Titan [Possessing nine kinds of Higher-order laws, true name engraved at the World Core of the mythical world, a Heavenly Tier Colossus]
Evolution value: 887631/2000000
This time, after the injury recovered, the Demon God’s Body completely evolved into an Innate, and just the base amplification of heaven and earth obtained by the True Demon God Body had increased by thirty percent once again.
This increase might not seem very strong, but one has to know that after becoming a Myth, a cultivator’s every explosive attack would draw upon dozens of times the energy of Heaven and Earth.
And when Jack Clark had just turned Innate, the base heaven and earth energy amplification brought by the Demon God’s Body was a hundred times that of the Ninth Heavens.
Besides that, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had consecutively devoured three Law Divine Artifacts, the rebounding Evolution Energy during growth, coupled with the Tempering during reconstruction of the True Body, had made Jack Clark’s physique even more formidable.
Basic physique had directly soared from the equivalent of 70 Heavenly Dragons to 85, almost doubling the overall strength enhancement.
To put it simply, if the previous Jack Clark’s physical body was compressed relative to a single Early Titan Beast, now it would be equal to two, making Jack Clark’s strength even more terrifying.
In addition, all major laws had skyrocketed in cultivation, with the greatest progress being made by the Great Sun Heaven Flame and the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder having already dealt with the Mythical Peak, and the Law of Strength was the same.
In the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, absorbing the Titan Colossus skeleton was facilitating rapid expansion, and only part of the skeleton essence had been absorbed in a day’s time.
Next, with the conversion of the Titan Colossus energy, the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane would continue to expand rapidly for a long period, making up for the original most time-consuming aspects of Plane World and Supreme Law.
It could be said that in just one day, Jack Clark’s strength had undergone earth-shattering changes, increasing manifold.
Now, facing the peak awakening of the Great Demon King Tarolia, Jack Clark was confident that even if he couldn’t kill the adversary, he could push through with absolute power without losing ground.
After scanning all the data changes, Jack Clark slowly said, “Almost ready, it’s time to head out.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark slowly stood up, and instantaneously, an immensely vast aura filled the world, causing it to tremble slightly with a tsunami-like disturbance as he rose to his feet.
Boom!
Jack Clark stomped the ground, and the space within a kilometer radius instantly shattered, the rebounding force vanishing into the sky, leaving behind a black trace hundreds of kilometers long that lingered for a long time.
That was the shattered space…
“What’s the matter, wasn’t it agreed that we would set off today? Why is the Human Race asking us to wait another star cycle (one day)?”
In the middle of a golden divine tree thousands of meters high, on a leaf tens of meters across, a young man with a pair of gold light wings and half materialized golden wings spoke displeasedly.
Surrounded by dozens of geniuses from the Heavenly Feather Clan young generation standing on branches and leaves around this young man named Kato, previously defeated by Jane Aiken with a single sword strike.
Including one with a golden feather mark on his forehead, whose strength was not inferior to Jane Aiken’s, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s monster Augubas.
After Kato spoke, another tall Heavenly Feather Clan woman also frowned, “Indeed, what is going on with the Human Race? Why keep delaying?”
“All right, quiet down everyone. If we have to wait another star cycle, then we will wait,” said Augubas indifferently.
“As a great tribe, after setting the departure time in alliance with our Heavenly Feather Clan, it is clear that the situation is somewhat serious with them delaying twice consecutively.”
“However, instead of speculating here, it’s better to just ask directly. Let’s go find those Human Race members and ask them. Come on, let’s go down.”
