﻿Chapter 1298: Chapter 503: Jack Clark Descends, The War of Destruction Chapter 1298: Chapter 503: Jack Clark Descends, The War of Destruction “The Human Race has even sent out civilization inheritors like this one.”
When they heard of Jack Clark’s impending arrival, Augubas and his companions were initially stunned, then a touch of awe appeared on their faces, and they felt their goodwill towards the Human Race greatly increase.
With Jack Clark breaking through from the Transcendent first rank to the Legendary Realm in just ten Sun Wheels and slaying the Demon King across the Nine Layers Realm, he has even cut down the monster of a Great Demon King after entering the Legendary Realm.
Whether it was cultivation speed or combat prowess, he dominantly pressed down his era, fully capable of carrying the legacy of a great civilization’s tribe.
Such a genius, as long as he did not perish, would be able to step into the Divine King Realm (Supreme) in a very short time, and even had hopes of contending for the position of an ancient deity (Civilization Emperor).
The cultivation realm division of the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Divine Gods Alliance are the same, king-level = deities, followed by Main God, Divine King, and ancient deities.
Considering the True Martial Heavenly King, whose combat power is comparable to that of a Divine King, Senior One Mysterious Martial in the late period of the Main God realm, Sky King Denny Kaye, plus Jack Clark, this young prodigy, the strength of the military support the Human Race offers is very formidable.
This legion’s combined force is even comparable to half the strength of the Purgatory Empire.
At the front end of the deck of a black battleship that stretched over a dozen kilometers, members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, bearing golden light wings, hovered in the air, with a towering and ferocious Black-Red Colored Mech standing before them.
Looking at Jane Aiken on the Mech, Augubas’s face revealed a smile as if basking in the spring breeze and exclaimed, “Although the Human Race hasn’t stayed long this time, the sincerity is palpable from all that you have said and done.”
“With the addition of the expeditionary support legion, we should be able to buy enough time for the remaining members of our clan to evacuate and preserve more vital forces.”
“As the third-generation heir of the Talor family, I stand here on behalf of the Divine Phoenix Lineage to salute you, wishing for everlasting friendship between our two tribes.”
Seeing Augubas suddenly adopt a serious expression, Jane Aiken and Freya Louise paused.
But before they could say anything, a streak of golden-black radiance emerged at the edge of the sky, followed rapidly by an overwhelming might that approached with a sweeping force.
“He’s here.”
Feeling that somewhat familiar but even stronger aura, smiles appeared on the faces of Freya Louise and Jane Aiken.
At the same time, mythical auras and Heavenly King auras exploded from within the fleet, soaring up to meet the powerful presence that was approaching swiftly.
Boom!
The distant Golden Divine Tree, standing tens of thousands of meters high, shone brightly as endless golden light spread out like an ocean in the sky, covering hundreds of kilometers.
The sky full of golden light converged, turning into the leading Heavenly King of the Heavenly Feather Clan, Boris, with three golden light wings unfurled behind him, as if a Seraph from legends had descended.
Above the Firmament, a shadow of a black stele emerged, and an intangible, pervasive pressure that suppressed Heaven and Earth caused the Void to shatter and collapse, creating an awe-inspiring spectacle.
Jack Clark did not conceal his aura as he descended; two Heavenly Kings in their late periods and peak strength personally welcomed him, a treatment that made many shudder internally.
As the Divine Martial Senior and the Heavenly Feather Main God appeared, Jack Clark also descended above the legion, enveloped in the dominating presence of Innate Gods and Demons.
Looking at the two figures standing beneath the black stele, their bodies enwrapped in strands of golden and blue radiance and emitting the ambience of Innate Gods and Demons, Jack Clark gave a slight smile.
“I haven’t seen you in just over a month, True Martial Senior, but your aura has become so much stronger that I feel quite pressured standing before you.”
The True Martial Heavenly King couldn’t help but laugh heartily, “Hahaha… Well, if it were a king-level figure speaking here, I might agree, but Jack, you can forget it. You are, after all, the King of Divine Martial who didn’t fall behind even when facing a Demon God.”
Jack, who had initially planned to just exchange pleasantries, paused: “Uh… facing the Demon God head-on, that’s an exaggeration, Senior. I had to fight with all I had just to escape at that time.”
“That’s not important. What matters is you did indeed slay numerous demon kings, greatly boosting the morale of our Human Race,” said the typically stern True Martial Heavenly King with a smile. “Come, Jack, let me introduce you. This is the Main God powerhouse of the Heavenly Feather Clan, Mister Boris.”
Jack turned to the Heavenly Feather Strongman beside him, and politely said, “Hello, Mister Boris.”
Boris, with a smile on his face and a warm air, admired, “As expected of the Human Race’s number one prodigy, you’ve already reformed the body of Innate Gods and Demons, truly extraordinary.”
“Oh, not at all. I’ve just been lucky with some opportunities that allowed me to break through,” said Jack modestly.
Because of the recent Transformation, all the genes in his cells were still in the recovery state, so the power of the Hidden Deity made it impossible to contain his aura.
As the nearby soldiers in military uniform onboard several sky-based battleships watched the young man talk and laugh with the two Heavenly King Powerhouses in the sky, their eyes filled with curiosity and admiration.
“Is that General Jack Clark? He’s incredible; even against Heavenly King Powerhouses, he seems not to be at a disadvantage.”
“Isn’t that obvious? General Clark has slain the Great Demon King and has faced a Demon God head-on.”
“It is hard to imagine that he has been practicing cultivation for only a year. Back when we were in Senior One, we were just at the Triplex realm, and even that was considered the level of a genius in the general sense.”
“Whenever a Great Era arises, a monster does too. Clearly, General Clark is the Child of Destiny chosen by the Great Era to lead the rise of the Human Race…”
As the soldiers on the decks excitedly discussed Jack Clark, Freya Louise and Jane Aiken, along with Augubas and dozens of other geniuses from the Heavenly Feather Clan, also looked up.
Feeling the invisible pressure emanating from Jack Clark, comparable to that of a Main God, even Augubas, who has been surrounded by various Halos since birth, felt a sobering seriousness.
Is this the strength of the Human Race’s number one prodigy? So strong… The intangible aura alone fills Heaven and Earth, leaving me with no desire to resist or fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1299 - 1299 503 Jack Clark Descends Apocalypse War_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1299: Chapter 503 Jack Clark Descends, Apocalypse War_2 Chapter 1299: Chapter 503 Jack Clark Descends, Apocalypse War_2 At this moment, the True Martial Heavenly King, who had exchanged a few pleasantries in the sky, said, “Now that Jack Clark, you’ve arrived, we can depart. Mysterious Martial and Denny Kaye have already left ahead of us; we’ll discuss the details below.”
Jack Clark nodded, “Okay.”
As he spoke, the space around the three of them distorted, and they vanished instantly.
More than ten minutes later, broadcasts echoed across the decks of the sky-based battleships.
“Attention all personnel, the army will depart in half an hour. All sky-based battleship combat staff must swiftly take their positions and perform final checks.”
“Other participating army members should stay on the decks of their respective warships. Do not wander about, and anyone needing to leave due to special circumstances must report to their commanding officer.”
Suddenly, the dozens of sky-based battleships, spanning over a hundred kilometers and suspended thousands of meters in high altitude, began to vibrate thunderously, their interiors radiating powerful energy fluctuations.
Simultaneously, staff on each battleship were bustling and running, continually calling in and reporting their positions, conducting the final checks.
Energy sources, fuel, food, ammunition, the sealed subspace Unmanned Mech army, whether all energy fighter aircraft were securely fastened, and personnel roll calls were all carried out.
Surrounding the Golden Divine Tree, members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, including Augubas and others, descended from the sky in beams of golden light, all returning to the Golden Battleship.
Half an hour later, deep throbbing foghorn blasts resonated across Heaven and Earth. Following that, eighteen engines on the stern of the leading No. 1 Battleship simultaneously spewed out scorching white waves.
Boom!
The ten-kilometer-long, island-like sky-based battleship activated, the air in front vibrating and forming concentric circles of white waves that rippled outward, gaining ever-increasing speed.
After the No. 1 Battleship came No. 2, No. 3… one after another, a formidable fleet extended over two hundred kilometers in length, creating tsunami-like waves that tore through the clouds, an impressive and grand sight.
Watching this science fiction-like scene unfold, countless people in the Logistics City felt a mix of awe and pride.
Several decades ago, when technological civilization entered the year 2000, global mobile phone coverage was not yet widespread, computers were still cumbersome desktop machines, and the most extravagant science fiction fantasy was merely landing on the moon.
Yet, in just a few short decades, human civilization had progressed to marching into the mythical world, constructing colossal spacecraft akin to universe battleships.
Even battling against tribes as formidable as the Hell demons of legend, humanity did not falter.
Above the hundred thousand-meter-high sea of clouds, the black battleships sliced through the wind, traveling at ten times the speed of sound. Runes flickered on both sides of the battleships, forming powerful energy shields that blocked the raging winds.
In the midst of the fleet, Jack Clark walked out of the conference room aboard the No. 5 Battleship, standing at the edge and watching the clouds rapidly recede on both sides, a surge of lofty aspirations welling up in his heart.
Compared to his previous life of ordinary mediocrity, this life’s experiences were far more splendid, especially since embarking on the path of cultivation.
After a brief bout of sentimentality, Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a complex expression, preparing to fly to the No. 1 Battleship to meet his classmates, Freya Louise and Jane Aiken.
This expedition would cross tens of millions of kilometers, and according to the planned speed, they would leave human territory in an hour, departing from the 31st Army of the Outer Development Department.
It was expected to take about a month of flight, traversing through hundreds of dangerous areas before reaching the territory of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
During this time, Jack Clark had many tasks to undertake, like striving to cultivate and achieve a breakthrough to the level of Heavenly King and to forge all rules, talents, and Cultivation Methods into his own Combat Divine Scripture.
However, before that, he needed to find Freya Louise to get a Life Crystal and transform the runes of the five ancient Body Refining Techniques already cultivated to their ninth level limit.
Then, during the creation of the 2.0 Combat Divine Body, he planned to integrate and elevate them together with the Dark Star talent into a Divine Power.
On the way here, Jack Clark had contacted the Vava smart brain through the signal stations along the way, preparing to exchange some Life Crystals.
However, he learned that since the conclusion of the Heavenly Abyss War, the majority of Life Crystals obtained by the various logistics cities in the mythical world had been exchanged by Freya Louise.
This news took Jack Clark by surprise, as he did not recall Freya Louise needing the resource, Life Crystal.
As for what she exchanged these crystals for, with just a brief thought, Jack Clark had a good idea, leaving him feeling somewhat moved but also complicated.
The greatest difficulty is in accepting the grace of a beauty…
Jack Clark sighed internally, but as he was about to leave, his steps paused slightly, his eyes narrowing as he focused all his attention on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
…
Deep within the Chaotic Turbulent Region, within a territory two million kilometers into the Chaotic Domain, the desolate and cracked earth was teeming with tens of millions of Alien Beasts and Giant Beasts.
The majority of these Alien Beasts were Level 5, measuring twenty to thirty meters in length with sharp spikes lining their backs, resembling brown-scaled earth dragons with four sharp claws and a Scorpion Tail.
Beyond that, the number of Level 8 and Level 9 Behemoths also reached upwards of two hundred thousand, even more enormous and ferocious in appearance, looking very different from the Level 5 Alien Beasts.
Among this ocean of behemoths, there were over a hundred Ancient Giant Elephants with a length of a kilometer and a height of five to six hundred meters, their bodies covered in thick armor and emanating Mythical-level fluctuations.
These Alien Beasts covered the skies and the underground, surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon amongst the Four Great Beasts, emitting ear-piercing hisses with menacing auras.
They seemed to pay no heed to the discrepancy in levels between them and the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This time, it was not the Behemoths seeking out resources from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but rather these behemoths had proactively surrounded them, treating the several Titan and Mythical Giant Beast as prey.
What truly put the Destruction Emperor Dragon on high alert was the subtle and terrifying Spiritual Will fluctuation permeating among the tens of millions of behemoths.

﻿Chapter 1300: Chapter 503: Jack Clark Descends, The War of Destruction_3 Chapter 1300: Chapter 503: Jack Clark Descends, The War of Destruction_3 This Will linked all the Giant Beasts together, forming a huge entity, including the energy aura of these Giant Beasts, which converged into one and created a powerful Domain suppression.
The suppression formed by the power of millions of Giant Beasts was so strong that it rivaled rules, covering tens of thousands of kilometers.
Under the mighty suppression force, the Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc were directly pressed down to the ground, simultaneously unable to expand their Law Domains.
In such a situation, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon was unable to use its domain for wide-range extermination.
Watching those slowly approaching Unique Beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes flickered with ferocity: “Roar! These detestable creatures are courting death by daring to attack the Great Sethia!”
The Gold and Blue Giant Dragon’s gaze was solemn, “Thunderflame, we’re in a bit of trouble this time, we seem to have encountered a destruction behemoth disaster.”
“Destruction behemoth disaster, so this is what it refers to.” The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes narrowed slightly, watching the surrounding Giant Beasts that blanketed the sky and the earth, coldness gleaming in its golden vertical pupils.
Earlier, upon entering the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Blue-White Giant Dragon had mentioned to them some of the dangers deep within the Chaotic Domain, including the destruction behemoth disaster.
According to the Blue-White Giant Dragon, these swarms of Giant Beasts composed of dozens of Unique Beasts were like locusts, devouring everything in their path – other Giant Beasts, different races, plants, minerals, everything.
Moreover, these Unique Beasts were controlled by a ‘Beast King,’ who consolidated their strength to form a special Rule Domain, suppressing all the Power of Heaven and Earth, which even it could not withstand.
Furthermore, under the enhancement of the domain, the more there were, the higher the damage inflicted. With claws and fanged teeth possessing innate armor-piercing and magic-breaking effects, hundreds of Level 8 Giant Beasts attacking together could even breach the defense of a Mythical Giant Beast.
Under the onslaught of millions, they could even exhaust a Titan, and this time, their numbers had reached tens of millions…
Upon this thought, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low growl, “The weakness of these Giant Beasts lies in the hidden Beast King. Kill it, and these creatures will collapse without a fight.”
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon lifted its head and let out a vicious roar, releasing the wildly raging power within its body to the extreme, its black and red wings that resembled blade edges furiously spread.
“Wipe them out.”
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, measuring over two thousand nine hundred meters in length and one kilometer at the shoulder, abruptly moved, instantly causing the earth within a hundred kilometers beneath its feet to shatter and collapse, with countless fragments soaring into the sky.
A terrifying impact force whipped up a sandstorm thousands of meters high and swept across hundreds of kilometers, tossing tens of thousands of high-level Unique Giant Beasts into the air, shattering them with the invisible burst of impact force, turning into a sea of flesh and blood that stained the earth red.
“Roar! Wipe out these detestable creatures.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared furiously, spreading its double wings and transforming into a silver radiance that hugged the ground as it charged behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Thick ice crystals covered the surface of the Silver Giant Beast’s body, instantly forming a hundred-meter-thick Mysterious Ice scale armor studded with huge, sharp ice spurs, making it look extremely ferocious.
Although it could not externally harness the talent Law to invoke the Power of Heaven and Earth, the combat strength of the Silver Giant Dragon, as a Mythical Creature, had not diminished much.
Amidst the smoke and rising dust, the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon silently followed, with crystals also spreading across its body, forming a colorful battle armor several tens of meters thick.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, although it could not condense battle armor made of Law Domains, it relied on its thick and hard scale armor to emit a long whistle like a steam train’s horn, following behind with a murderous aura.
And just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon made its move, at an altitude of tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of meters, creatures that looked like bulky giant pythons with bodies ranging from a hundred meters to several hundred meters, even a kilometer long, with bat wings on their backs, roared.
Boom boom boom!!
From the bellies of these red giant python-like creatures, bone spurs thirty meters, fifty meters, up to a hundred meters in length, wrapped in green radiance, were explosively ejected at speeds dozens of times the speed of sound, emitting a sharp whistling sound.
In an instant, hundreds of thousands of bone spur missiles blanketed the sky, enveloping the Destruction Emperor Dragon and other Giant Beasts.
Boom!
A black and red Tail Blade over a thousand meters in length tore through Heaven and Earth, cutting through the Void, and with terrifying speed and strength formed a black Blade shadow tens of thousands of meters long, sweeping in all directions.
Beneath the horrific Tail Blade, a destructive pressure zone formed over a ten-kilometer range above its head, where all bone spur missiles that entered this zone were completely shattered and exploded.
In an instant, the violent explosions shattered Heaven and Earth; the space over a hundred kilometers above was obliterated, and the entire world was illuminated by the green glow of the explosions.
Hundreds of thousands of bone spurs, each comparable to ordinary missiles, high-yield missiles, and even nuclear bombs, exploded, and even the pressure field created by the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strike collapsed in an instant.
But by this time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already traversed more than a hundred kilometers, charging into the sea of Unique Beasts with a momentum that peeled mountains and overturned seas, as if teleporting.
Thud thud thud!!
With the body size and terrifying movement speed of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, there was no need for attacks; every Mythical Giant Beast or Unique Beast it encountered simply burst into a bloody mist.
The enormous black and red claws swept with terrifying speed, causing large areas of space to collapse. In an instant, more than twenty Level 9 Giant Beasts, two to three hundred meters in length, were obliterated.
The Tail Blade swept close to the ground behind it, forming a black planar cut, the invisible condensed destructive force and sharpness clearing a dozen kilometers in the vicinity, causing the Sea of Blood to burst open.
At that moment, lights flickered on dozens of mountain peaks in the distance.
Immediately after, hundreds of red Light Beams, thick as ten to dozens of meters, ripped through Heaven and Earth, emitting energy fluctuations comparable to those at the peak of Level 9, and even a Mythical energy fluctuation, appearing in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
These Energy Beams originated from Giant Beasts a hundred meters, several hundred meters in length, shaped like spiders with thick black shells, and a giant red eye on their heads.
Thud thud thud!!
The hundreds of Energy Beams that hit the Destruction Emperor Dragon caused a strong impact force, but contrary to expectations, they did not blow the Dragon to bits and merely flickered like bursting bubbles before disappearing.
Roar!
Standing on the shattered Earth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood up, roaring towards the heavens, while dazzling light converged in its mouth and the black and blue Dorsal Fins on its back lit up one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1301 - 1301 504 Cang Roaring Sky Biological Weapon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1301: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Roaring Sky, Biological Weapon Chapter 1301: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Roaring Sky, Biological Weapon Nearly a million Unique Beast corpses paved a deadly pathway stretching hundreds of kilometers, at the end of which stood a ferocious behemoth covered in heavy black and red scale armor.
On the Earth a hundred kilometers away, an Ancient Beast stood towering — over two thousand meters tall and over five thousand meters in length.
This Ancient Beast was clad in purple heavy armor across its body, the upper half stood upright like a human, with a fierce-looking head and two pairs of curved knife-like claws resembling those of a mantis.
On its upper back were also a pair of wing-like structures, but these were just a few purple sharp spikes with slight gaps, radiating a sense of profound danger.
The lower half of its body was round and hefty, reminiscent of a massive spider with eight curved, robust claws for support, and a tail like that of a wasp, sporting a spike hundreds of meters long.
At the same time, the back of this Ancient Beast King was littered with purple spikes, like antennas, emitting tangible purple light waves that spread in all directions.
These purple light waves represented the terrifying will that even the Destruction Emperor Dragon found alarming.
Apart from this purple Destruction Beast King, which exuded an ancient aura, there were also two Giant Beasts radiating the aura of the Titans at their peak, serving as its guards.
One of these two Giant Beasts was over four thousand meters long, resembling a python but covered in yellow scales armor, with a pair of feather-covered gigantic wings on its back.
The other Giant Beast was similarly over four thousand meters long and resembled a Nine-headed Flood Dragon, its body covered in Blue Scales Armor.
This Nine-Headed Flood Dragon, unlike Kidora, had menacing snake-like heads that hadn’t evolved into dragons, and its belly had only a pair of massive claws.
Thus, when the nine python heads of the upper body stood erect, the hefty hind body dragged on the ground, with a row of fins extending from each python head to the tail, appearing utterly ferocious and formidable.
However, whether it was those two Titan Beasts or the Destruction Beast King enveloped by a terrifying Soul Will, they all gave the Destruction Emperor Dragon the impression of being somewhat breathless, as if they lacked a certain amount of vital energy,
And this seemed somewhat mismatched with the aura of the peak of Titans and the mid-period of ancient Titans they emitted.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Confronted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had slain through the ocean of Giant Beasts, the Ascending Snake Beast and the Nine-Headed Flood Dragon Serpent let out brutal roars, their sonic waves shattering the Void and their terrifying aura of the Titan Peak quaking Heaven and Earth.
And on that Ancient Beast King, an even more frightening will burst forth.
Boom! In an instant, countless Giant Beasts behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon went berserk, tens of thousands of Level 9 Giant Beasts, and the closest twenty or so beasts exuding a Mythical Aura madly roared as they charged forward.
Among them, the two Titan Peak Beasts also bellowed furiously, with the Ascending Snake Beast’s double wings furiously spread, stirring up a vast sandstorm of yellow dust attacking the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Nine-Headed Flood Dragon Serpent’s nine heads flickered with dazzling light inside their mouths, and immediately upon opening wide, nine Light Beams shot out with roars.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Nine hundred meter-thick greenish breaths pierced Carney Turner, their terrifying power causing space to collapse, forming a series of black light-swirled greenish black Light Beams, an imposing sight.
Beast breaths are attacks where internal energy is compressed to its limit; though they lack the amplification from revealed Law Domains drawing upon the Power of Heaven and Earth, their strength is even more extreme and Overbearing.
Just then, as the nine terrifying energy light columns in the sky merged into one, instantly a beam several hundred meters thick of dazzling light illuminated Heaven and Earth.
At this moment, the world lost its color, replaced only by the spreading light of the massive greenish five hundred-meter column, moving at an apparently slow yet actually swift pace, it materialized instantly in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
From the appearance of the Destruction Emperor Dragon cutting through the sea of Giant Beasts, to the roar of the Ancient Beast King and the attack of the Titan Beasts, everything happened in the blink of an eye.
Both the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Ancient Beast King knew from the onset they were adversaries, so no words were wasted, each only intent on bringing death to the other.
Boom!
In the instant the battle erupted, endless red light burst forth from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the ominous red light of destruction brightening the whole world.
Instantly, an Aura so terrifying that it shocked this World surfaced, and amidst the gleaming red, a monstrous Destruction Beast nearly eight thousand meters long made its appearance.
Boom!
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered its Deep Red Form, the surroundings within a hundred kilometers instantly collapsed, space shattered, and all things were ground to dust by the pervasive red force of destruction.
The force was so formidable and Overbearing that even in the depths of the Void, faint sounds arose.
These sounds were like the chants of countless different races in worship, or like the melodies of Heavenly Earth Law, flowing between heaven and earth as if welcoming the arrival of destruction!
Bang Bang Bang!! Under the invisible spread of the red Destructive Glow, any Giant Beast within a hundred kilometers of the Deep red Destruction Beast instantly exploded into a rain of blood.
Including several of the closest Mythical Giant Beasts, which also disintegrated under that red glow imbued with the ultimate power of destruction, completely annihilated.
Boom!
The merged breath of the Nine-Headed Flood Dragon Serpent’s nine heads, the greenish Light Beam that spanned over seventy kilometers, fell upon the fifty-kilometer radius Deep red destroy area, resulting in a blinding light and intense energy impact.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Amidst the eye-searing mix of greenish and red explosion of light, the green Light Beam slowed as it delved deeper, and finally dissipated completely ten kilometers away from the Deep red Destruction Beast.
At this moment, before the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Deep Red Form, even the combined full power strike of the Nine-Headed Flood Dragon proved insufficient to even approach it.
Although unable to manifest Law Domains due to rule suppression, it did not mean that talents such as Gigantification couldn’t be utilized.
It was just that previously, fearing that displaying its strength too openly might scare off the Destruction Beast King, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had not immediately entered its Deep Red Form.

chapters.title: Chapter 1302 - 1302 504 Cang Skys Roar Biological Weapon_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1302: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Sky’s Roar, Biological Weapon_2 Chapter 1302: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Sky’s Roar, Biological Weapon_2 Boom! Boom! Boom!
At that moment, the surrounding Void vibrated explosively, as the invisible suppressing rules that permeated the area around the Destruction Emperor Dragon were directly shattered by the Deep Red Destructive Power formed from the integration of nine Higher-order Laws.
Roar!
The ferocious roar that descended from the ancient spacetime echoed through heaven and earth, as a massive Red Claw, in a flash of red light, overshadowed the sky and struck down upon the Ascending Snake Beast’s head.
A horrifying red glow shattered the space within tens of kilometers, the laws of heaven and earth collapsed, unstoppable and unblockable.
Boom! Before even a scream could be uttered, the body of the Ascending Snake Beast, over four thousand meters long, burst apart explosively, its flesh and blood dissolving continuously under the erosion of the Destructive Glow.
After the strike that killed the Ascending Snake Beast, the power sank and landed on the Earth.
Boom!
Instantly, the ground within a thousand kilometers trembled. Over two hundred kilometers of land violently collapsed and fractured. Immediately after, countless red lights erupted from underground like erupting volcanoes mixed with countless rocks and dirt shooting into the sky.
Under the terrifying impact, the rocks, some tens to hundreds of meters in size, flew in all directions like cannonballs, killing countless Extraordinary Giant Beasts over an area of a thousand kilometers.
Including the Nine-Headed Dragon Serpent, which was several tens of kilometers away, it too was flung into the air by the aftershock of that single claw, uttering a series of roars.
As for that ancient Beast King, the moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strike landed, it burst forth with strength from beneath its eight claws, its mountainous body instantly rising into the sky with a series of afterimages.
Boom!
The ground under the distant ancient Beast King exploded, and a mountain range over a hundred kilometers long collapsed directly, with several mountain peaks thousands of meters high thrown into the air.
Roar! Just as a claw crushed the Titan Peak Ascending Snake Beast, another earth-shattering fierce roar echoed between heaven and earth.
In an instant, under the blasting and shock, the nine heads of the Nine-Headed Dragon Python, which had been flung up tens of thousands of meters along with countless fragments of rocks and dirt, issued furious roars, their bodies crackling with streaks of blue lightning.
After the oppressive rules that enveloped this world were destroyed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, these guard beasts could also use their innate Law Powers.
In just a moment, Higher-order Law Green Light Blue Thunder enveloped a hundred-kilometer area, forming a Thunder Pool destruction zone filled with sharp, pulverizing, paralyzing, and destructive auras.
In the center of the Laws World, the nine heads of the Nine-Headed Dragon Python bared ferociously, their mouths once again lighting up with dazzling blue light.
But this time, it was no longer Breath; instead, nine beams of lightning, pure and blue, burst forth with a terrifying aura, spreading erratically over a hundred kilometers in an instant.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Nine strikes of green snake lightning from the Titan Peak beasts hit the Deep Red Destruction Beast, exploding with dazzling halos and forming nine green halos that annihilated everything in their path.
However, such an attack, barely approaching the power of the ancients, couldn’t even shake the Deep Red Destruction Beast, its heavy crimson scale armor simply ignoring it.
Boom! In a forceful clash against the Nine-Headed Dragon Serpent’s Full-Force Strike, a tail blade wrapped in red lightning severed the Void, creating a black and red curtain that split the sky in two.
And with it was eradicated the enormous body of the Nine-Headed Dragon Serpent, over four thousand meters in length.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the Destroy Heaven and Earth red lightning, the bisected serpent’s body continually exploded, turning into a shower of blood and bones and scales.
These two Giant Beasts, though seemingly at Titan Peak level, were merely hollow shells; the energy and density of Law Factors in their flesh and blood were low, hence they were easily obliterated by a single strike from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Such ‘Biological Weapons’ lacked the horrific vitality and Laws’ Origin of true Titan Beasts, unable to regenerate flesh and recover wounds instantly.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly slaughtered two Titan Peak guard beasts with lightning speed, intense fear shone in the eyes of the distant ancient Beast King.
Boom!
A terrifying Soul Will vibrated through spacetime, forming purple rays of light that spread hundreds of kilometers in all directions around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, each ray intersecting at nodes that shone with purple light.
These flickering purple lights twisted space, and in an instant, millions of Giant Beasts appeared, each over twenty and one hundred meters in length, their upper bodies like giant ants and lower bodies like spiders.
The round bellies of these Giant Beasts resembled translucent red gems, with red liquid circulating inside, emitting dazzling light and then exploding intensely.
The instant the million Burst Giant Beasts exploded, they released an indescribable glow, like supernovae bursting, their combined terrifying forces instantly covering thousands of kilometers creating earth-shattering devastation.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Under the expanding red shockwave at hundreds of times the speed of sound, the land collapsed, sparse vegetation was reduced to ash, the ground surface melted instantly into Scorching Magma and was thrown into the air, as the bodies of countless Extraordinary Giant Beasts shattered.
Roar!
The Silver Giant Dragon, the gold and blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc more than 700 kilometers away, emitted terrified roars invoking all their strength to form a hundred-meter-thick Energy Shield, only to be devoured instantly.
The combined force of this explosion was so powerful that it even pierced through the destructive red light surrounding the Deep Red Destruction Beast, furiously assailing its scaly exterior.
But it still couldn’t shake the extreme defenses of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With both physical and Mana Resistance heightened to the limit, attacks from the same level could not breach the defenses of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, who could stand unharmed even if assaulted by those ‘ordinary’ Ancient Beasts.
However, at the moment when the million Burst Giant Beasts exploded, piercing the destructive red aura surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon, an overwhelmingly terrifying Soul Will descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 1303 - 1303 504 Cang Roars Biological Weapon_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1303: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Roars, Biological Weapon_3 Chapter 1303: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Roars, Biological Weapon_3 Boom!
Under the soul-targeting attack, the consciousness of the Destruction Emperor Dragon trembled, immediately appearing in the pitch-black Soul Void where a giant shadow of a beast stretching tens of kilometers emerged.
However, different from the physical form of the ancient Beast King outside, its soul form was surprisingly that of a purple octopus-like ‘Giant Beast’ surrounded by nine rings of purple radiance.
These halos contained strong soul fluctuations, similar to Jack’s Soul Talent, but even the emitted purple light made the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s soul feel ‘a bit’ uncomfortable.
In contrast to the nearly solidified soul will of the ancient Beast King, the soul of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not outdone at all, albeit having a form only three kilometers in size, but also solidified as if it were tangible, with white flames burning all over it.
This layer of white flames was a gift from the Blue-White Giant Dragon, a Law Divine Artifact.
That mass of white flames possessed the characteristic of intense Soul Strength and granted the Destruction Emperor Dragon the passive ability of soul flames.
However, this kind of ordinary soul fire was not taken seriously by the ancient Beast King; although its Giant Beast Body in battle was no match for the Black-Red Colossal Beast, in terms of soul, it was naturally peerless within the same rank.
Roar!
The ancient Beast King let out a soul-shaking roar. Beneath it, two purple tentacles over seven thousand meters long swelled, wrapped in circling rings frenziedly rolling towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the invisible strong soul fluctuation shaking the Dark Void.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, its body ablaze with white fire that burned the Void, and from its mouth, it spewed a scorching white Flame Breath that incinerated ‘Heaven and Earth’.
Bang!
The Flame Breath was directly shattered by the tentacles enveloped by nine rings of soul energy, taking with them terrifying soul fluctuations as they rushed into the white flames, swirling towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Meeting this attack were two massive claws, sweeping up skies of soul flames to grab at the tentacles stretching tens of kilometers across the firmament.
Boom! At the instant the Dragon Claw and tentacle met, both giants’ souls violently shook.
The attacks on the soul didn’t involve many superfluous movements; it was a contest of soul strength, robustness, and the held Talent Abilities and might of the Soul Will.
Yet, the result of this strike took the ancient Beast King by surprise.
For the soul strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was incomparably formidable, almost indistinguishable from its true Giant Beast Body, and not even a strike imbued with the talent of the Soul Law could shake it.
This outcome infuriated the ancient Beast King, which had thought it held the winning ticket, letting out a roar of shock and anger; its will shook the Void.
“Roar! How is this possible? Your Growth Level is clearly only mid-phase Titan, how can your soul be so resilient?”
“There’s nothing impossible.”
The deep and robust voice echoed throughout the entire Soul Void, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly stepping out from the white sea of fire, its body exuding an invisible Terra terrifying Aura that reigned supreme above all beings.
That was the oppression belonging to ‘Heaven’.
Having all talents strengthened to the Deification Realm, undergoing a Transformation of life into a deity, and given the name ‘Cang’ after receiving the core rule of the World Origin from the mythical world, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had transformed not only its body but its soul as well.
In essence, the Soul Source of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, unified with Jack, was exalted high above, on par with Heaven, hence the soul also became exceptionally powerful.
This power didn’t refer to the Soul Strength but to the essence.
“Roar! I refuse to believe it!”
The ancient Beast King let out a tyrannical roar, with the surrounding nine rings of purple radiance blazing intensely, forming nine purple serrated halos each ten kilometers in diameter.
Boom boom boom!!
The spinning purple halos tore through the Soul Void, split the sea of fire, and struck the soul of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, only to be shattered by an invisible force field emanating from the ‘Cang’ character between the Emperor Dragon’s brows.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, a tempest of white flames surging towards the ancient Beast King, instantly igniting a battle far more perilous and fierce than in the Outer World.
Or rather, a one-sided overwhelm commenced.
Boom! Under the blow of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the larger ancient Beast King was sent flying, its tendrils wrapped in flames torn apart by claws.
At the same time, a razor-sharp tail slashed across and with a splurch sound, it cleaved the soul will of the ancient Beast King in two.
But just then, the ancient Beast King emitted wild soul fluctuations, followed by a dazzling burst of purple radiance that exploded directly.
After the intense self-destruction, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s consciousness reeled from the blast.
Roar!
The ancient Beast King in the Outer World also let out a scream as blood gushed from its eyes like fountains, fear evident as it looked up at the explosion in the sky, all eight of its curved claws suddenly bending.
Boom! The earth shattered for hundreds of kilometers, space collapsed, and the rebounding force unleashed a fearsome speed as it appeared as a purple streak of light thousands of kilometers away in an instant.
“Do you think you can escape?”
The deep and majestic roar shook Heaven and Earth, and a red lightning bolt shot down with even greater speed directly above the ancient Beast King, its nearly eight-thousand-meter massive body exuding a terrifying pressure capable of crushing the world.
Boom!
The tremendous red Dragon Claw descended from the sky, instantly causing the Void to explode, forming a Destruction Black Hole tens of kilometers wide that emitted the horrifying aura of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
Roar!
The ancient Beast King, knowing it couldn’t flee, flashed a vicious look in its eyes. Its two pairs of Mantis Sickle-like claws spread wide; the Blade Edges entwined with golden Radiance, like four long beams of light stretching for kilometers.
Under those four mantis sickles wrapped in the force of rules, the world itself was cleaved, creating four spreading Black Abysses that intersected with the descending Destruction Black Hole from above.
Boom boom boom!! The Black Hole and the Black Abyss collapsed together, creating a Chaotic Destruction Flow from which the red Dragon Claw, transcending time, shattered the sickle lights with indescribable speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1304 - 1304 504 Cang Heaven Roars Biological
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1304: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Heaven Roars, Biological Weapon_4 Chapter 1304: Chapter 504 ‘Cang’ Heaven Roars, Biological Weapon_4 In the Ancient Beast King’s terrified gaze, the terrible crimson dragon claw obscured the sky and sun, bringing with it the endless Divine Might of Destructive Space-Time as it landed on its head.
“Compared to your Soul Will, this shell is too weak,” it said.
Accompanied by a deep Dragon Roar echoing between heaven and earth, the Ancient Beast King’s head, including its upper body, instantly exploded, directly smashed by the claw of the Deep Red Destruction Beast.
Boom! The terrifying strike shook the universe, collapsing the earth within a thousand-kilometer radius, annihilating all things.
Amidst the apocalyptic explosion, the over four thousand meters tall Deep Red Giant Beast stood up, clutching the Ancient Beast King’s massive abdomen in its claw, and violently tore it apart.
Bang! Countless dark red blood spurted out like a tsunami, engulfing the shattered Void.
From within the torn-in-half corpse of the Giant Beast, a spherical object emerged, measuring a kilometer in diameter and covered in hundreds of narrow tentacles and Purple Scaled Armor.
In the center of this sphere was a huge eye hundreds of meters in diameter, which now watched the overshadowing Deep Red Destruction Beast in front of it with trembling terror.
This was the true body of the Beast King that controlled millions of Unique Beasts, forming a cataclysm that even the Blue-White Giant Dragon and other Titan Beasts dreaded.
Looking at the terrifying beast filled with crimson Destructive Lightning in its eyes, the Purple Sphere trembled with fear, “No, don’t eat me. I’m willing to submit to you.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head, its fierce and enormous maw opening slightly, emitting a terrifying growl that vibrated Space-Time, “Submit? What use do I have for you?”
The Purple Sphere, highly intelligent, quickly emitted strong Soul Fluctuations when it realized that the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t kill it right away, “I can help you fight. I can control many, many Giant Beasts.”
The corner of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth turned up slightly, revealing a cold and cruel expression, “You couldn’t even handle a single claw of mine, what would you use to fight against enemies that can oppose me?”
The Purple Sphere said anxiously, “I am very powerful. Although I’m not as strong in direct combat as you, I excel at soul and Will attacks.”
“Like this Ancient-level Giant Beast I am currently parasitizing; its soul and will were shattered by me initially. Keeping me around will definitely be of some help to you,” it argued.
For the sake of survival, the Purple Sphere kept promoting itself.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was very aware that this Titan Peak realm beast had submitted only temporarily, intimidated by the Terrifying Power it had demonstrated.
Indeed, the aura emanating from the beast at the moment spoke only of Titan Peak realm strength.
Yet this beast not only had an extremely powerful soul, but it also possessed special talents and rules that allowed it to exert a Terrifying Power far beyond its realm.
As the towering Deep Red Giant Beast remained silent, the Purple Sphere thought it might survive today. Suddenly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “Too bad, you’re too weak. I might as well eat you.”
With that, a massive crimson claw descended, grabbing onto the sphere’s narrow tentacles under its frightened gaze and brutally tearing them.
Bang bang bang!!
The hundreds of tentacles, akin to nerves, were ripped off, causing the Purple Sphere to let out a piercing scream, before being grasped by the Destruction Emperor Dragon and tossed aside.
As all the ‘nerves’ were torn apart, the already soul-heavily injured Purple Sphere’s aura weakened even further.
At the same time, the glow of crimson lightning on the Destruction Emperor Dragon weakened. Its aura plummeted, its form shrank, and it soon returned to its normal size of over two thousand nine hundred meters.
In this battle, the area spanning thousands of kilometers was destroyed, with rampant streams of chaotic energy spreading between heaven and earth, the earth collapsing and shattering, with searing hot magma flowing through cracks that extended for tens or hundreds of kilometers.
Further away, sporadic battles still erupted—those were the Silver Giant Dragons that had regained their full strength after the removal of rule suppression, hunting down the remaining Giant Beasts.
Once the Destruction Emperor Dragon transformed into its Deep Red Form, they knew that victory was certain in this battle.
[There’s another thousand characters at the end of this chapter. I aim to update by twelve o’clock. Just wait, and refresh later on. There won’t be an extra charge.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1305 - 1305 505 As Time Goes By The Throne Ceremony
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1305: Chapter 505: As Time Goes By, The Throne Ceremony Chapter 1305: Chapter 505: As Time Goes By, The Throne Ceremony The Silver Giant Dragon was naive, but not truly foolish, so it immediately felt that something was off with the gaze of the purple orb, and suddenly became enraged.
“Roar! Despicable creature, what is that look in your eyes? Are you implying that the Great Sethia is a fool?”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon nearby instantly turned its head, looking at the Silver Giant Dragon with an odd glance, as if to say, isn’t that obvious?
The Silver Giant Dragon grew even angrier, exhaling a frosty white mist through its nostrils as it bellowed, “Roar! You wretch, the Great Sethia is going to have Tim Abott eat you.”
Although the Beast King, even heavily injured, possessed the strength to crush Mythical Giant Beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon was not at all frightened because the Destruction Emperor Dragon was right beside them.
Facing the threat of the Silver Giant Dragon, the purple orb was startled and emitted a feeble Soul Will, shaking the Void, “Don’t, don’t eat me, I didn’t mean to mock you, I just didn’t think of a good response earlier.”
“Roar! Is that so?” the Silver Giant Dragon looked dubious.
“Really, truly.”
The purple orb hastily fluttered the newly regrown tentacle-like flesh buds, its gaze sincere, showing none of the dignity and brutality that one would expect from a Beast King that dominated thousands of Giant Beasts.
“Roar! True or false, you’re doomed for attacking us, Tim Abott will tear you in half and then devour you,” pronounced the Silver Giant Dragon, lifting its head proudly.
Then the golden-blue Giant Dragon also growled slowly, “That’s right, Thunderflame prefers to peel the scales off its food while it’s still alive before eating it.”
“At that moment, blood explodes with each bite, and the food’s desperate screams add to Thunderflame’s excitement.”
The words of the two Giant Dragons once again sent a shiver through the purple orb, which glanced at the Black-red Colossal Beast devouring the corpse of an Ancient Beast beside them, growing even more afraid.
The difference between a Giant Beast and an intelligent creature lies in the coexistence of animal intelligence and bestiality.
Under normal conditions, even Mythical Giant Beasts are mostly driven by their beastly instincts, making their thinking and actions more brutal and bloodthirsty.
But those clever intelligent creatures are different; they know how to establish civilization and order, and their internal strife is constant, including betrayal.
The more intelligent the creature, the more it reflects on moderation, because more thoughts naturally lead to a greater fear of death, like the current purple orb.
The Silver and golden-blue Giant Dragons also noticed that the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed to have no intention of eating it; otherwise, given the character of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it would have torn the Beast King apart instead of merely inflicting heavy injuries.
Clearly, the Destruction Emperor Dragon must be thinking of subjugating this Beast King, just as he had done with the dominating Titan, Longa King, and the Ancient Giant Python before.
As the two Giant Dragons were collectively threatening the Beast King, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon was voraciously devouring the flesh and blood of the Giant Beast, its body visibly began to swell slightly.
Meanwhile, aboard a sky-based battleship, having just left the Outer Development Department’s territory, streams of Evolution Energy began appearing from nowhere within Jack Clark’s body, making his already formidable and terrifying physique grow even stronger.
At the same time, he once again halted his steps that were originally headed towards Freya Louise, extending his hand to touch the smart wristwatch on his left wrist, and instantly a transparent holographic screen sprang up.
Jack Clark spoke, “Link to the core of the Expeditionary Army fleet intelligence, God-Suppressed Think Tank.”
“To send link request to the core intelligence database… identity verification, Jack Clark, rank General… verification passed.”
“Welcome to the God-Suppressed Think Tank. How may I assist you?”
Jack Clark said indifferently, “God-Suppress, pull up all the information on Contract Runes and Secret Skills, particularly those regarding the control of Giant Beast creatures.”
“Please wait…”
As Jack Clark’s orders were given, the projection from the smart wristwatch quickly shifted, revealing more than twenty types of Contract Runes and Secret Skills.
Over the years, the Federation had extensively researched, and many cultivation strong men had the habit of raising and nurturing Mutated Beasts and Giant Beasts, with the Hundred Foxes Nation being the most famous.
Some of these Mutated Beasts were domesticated from a young age, some were captured for their research value, and some were wild, hence humans conceived numerous control methods.
Included were Contract Methods created from the study of Basic Runes and also Blood and Soul Contracts unearthed from relics.
Jack Clark’s eyes scanned over the introductions to these Secret Skills, and finally, he turned his attention to something called the Ghost Subdue Beast Mark, a Contractual prohibition modified from a secret method of an unknown ancient relic.
This Secret Skill relied on the Ghost Seal as its core, using the Soul Source of the Giant Beast intended for subjugation as fuel, to congeal a Soul Suppressing Seal that dominates and captures the soul.
The requirements for this Secret Skill were high; the user’s soul had to be stronger than the controlled Giant Beast’s, otherwise, it would be impossible to suppress the opponent and congeal the Soul Seal.
“This is it,” Jack Clark’s mouth curled upward.
The Beast King was too powerful, especially that strong Soul Will, which had even slain Ancient Beasts from the earliest times.
If not fully confident in controlling such a Giant Beast, the Emperor Dragon would rather devour it than accept it, for a lapse in control could lead to the destruction of the entire Dragon Palace.
This included the Blue-White Giant Dragon and Time Dragon that might join later; they would fall under the dominion of the Beast King, let alone Mythical Giant Beasts like the Silver Giant Dragon.
“God-Suppress, transmit the data on Ghost Subdue Beast Mark to me.” As he spoke, Jack Clark’s figure flashed, instantly appearing tens of kilometers away on the fourth Battleship, and then, in another step, appeared on the third Battleship.
With the Secret Skill decided upon, the next step was to practice it before attempting to execute it.
On the deck of the first Battleship, a few soldiers who were inspecting fighter aircraft were startled to see Jack Clark materialize out of nowhere at a low altitude of a hundred meters; they quickly and respectfully saluted.
“General Clark, sir!”
Jack Clark nodded at them slightly, “At ease,” he said as his figure flickered and disappeared from view.

chapters.title: Chapter 1306 - 1306 505 Time Flies The Throne Ceremony_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1306: Chapter 505 Time Flies, The Throne Ceremony_2 Chapter 1306: Chapter 505 Time Flies, The Throne Ceremony_2 On the deck several kilometers away, the black-haired girl sat on a raised piece of Number One’s shoulder armor, quietly holding and reading the scripture of tranquility.
Despite the energy shields protecting the battleship during high-speed flight, to maintain air circulation, the rune array still left some cracks open.
At this moment, with the raging wind howling, Freya Louise’s long hair danced wildly behind her, the black strands interweaving with the ribbon of her white butterfly knot, giving off the vibe of a poetic young woman.
But when Jack Clark appeared out of nowhere, his brow immediately furrowed.
He sensed that Freya’s vitality was very similar to Number One’s, including soul fluctuations, even though she wasn’t piloting, she remained in a state of synchronization.
Sensing Jack’s arrival, the black-haired girl looked up. Her face, even prettier than before, broke into a smile as she spoke softly, “Is the meeting over?”
“Yeah, we’ve finished discussing everything,” Jack nodded, walked over and sat down next to Freya.
Although they hadn’t seen each other for a while, there was no sense of unfamiliarity between them. Jack directly asked after sitting down, “Freya, is your body starting to be eroded by Number One?”
“Looking at my current condition, do I seem to be eroded?”
With a smile, the young woman pursed her lips and said, “I know what you’re worried about. Rest assured, my current state is not one of erosion and assimilation by Number One’s power, but a transformation.”
“It’s similar to using the Giant Beast Essence and Blood after reaching the late Fourth Layer Heaven to obtain Transcendent Traits. This step is a prerequisite for full synchronization with Number One.”
“Of course, if one day my Spiritual Will is assimilated and my soul merges into Number One in reverse, it would mean that my refinement has failed.”
“And the consequence of failure is to vanish, right?”
“Right.”
The young woman nodded, “And that’s the consequence of seeking higher levels of power. If I succeed, I’ll leap upwards at least to a presence comparable to a Heavenly King.”
“As for failure, I would naturally dissipate.”
As she spoke, Freya brushed away the hair beside her ear which had been scattered by the wind, her face beaming with a smile, devoid of any fear.
In fact, the path that Freya was on, although seemingly perilous, was already envied by countless people compared to those cultivators who could not break through to king-level in their lifetimes.
After all, there’s no such thing as perfect in this world.
Jack understood this and just nodded, “Keep it up, but if you ever feel like you’re losing control one day, you can ask me for help.”
With that, Jack glanced at the massive head of Number One.
This mysterious Biological Mecha was very strong, especially when Freya’s Soul Synchronization broke through one hundred percent and it went into a rampage, even fully unleashing its power, it became even more terrifying.
But what of it? Even without summoning the Giant Beast Avatar, with Jack’s strength now almost reaching the pinnacle of the Heavenly King, he was more than capable of suppressing Number One.
Of course, neither Jack nor Number One had reached their limits in strength yet.
Hum!
It seemed as if Number One had detected the terrifying intent in Jack’s eyes, a dreadful energy inside it vibrated, and a blue-white radiance lit up within its eyes.
Freya quickly soothed it, “It’s okay, Jack is just joking, there’s nothing wrong.”
Underneath the invisible calming influence of Freya’s Spiritual Will fluctuations, Number One’s stimulated biological instincts paused momentarily before settling down again.
Although this Biological Mecha didn’t have ‘consciousness’, it didn’t mean it lacked innate instincts. It could even autonomously respond upon detecting a strong hostile intent or killing intent.
This was also the reason why during the events on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, when the True Martial Heavenly King saw signs of Number One losing control and going on a rampage, he did not intervene personally but instead used Demon God Carthius to deliver a crippling blow.
He certainly didn’t want to be remembered with resentment by this creature with terrifying potential.
After finishing her own matters, Freya Louise’s gaze fell upon Jack Clark’s forehead, “Jack Clark, what’s happening with your hair, did you suffer a grave injury this time under the chase of the demon gods?”
Considering Jack Clark’s vigorous vitality at only seventeen, having already broken through to the Legendary Realm, having white hair seemed utterly abnormal.
Jack Clark shook his head, “This is an external manifestation of divine power that I cultivate, but indeed I was seriously injured under the Purgatory Demon God’s pursuit earlier on, but now I’m already fine.”
“It’s good that you’re fine, but this time you gave everyone quite a scare, actually going alone into the rear of The Purgatory Family…”
Next, Freya Louise, like a typical girl, excitedly asked about what happened after Jack Clark entered the Purgatory Empire, and even gasped when hearing about the ambush by seven demon kings and one Great Demon King.
Louise was even more shocked by the strength of the Peak Awakened Great Demon King when Jack stormed into the demonic battlefield of Tarolia.
As for the exaggerated combat power displayed by Jack Clark, Freya Louise was not too surprised; after all, this guy has been shocking her continuously since the start of his cultivation journey.
Sitting atop the shoulder of a mecha standing over two hundred meters tall, Freya Louise gazed at the white clouds receding in the distance and the increasingly handsome and dashing young man with black hair, feeling somewhat nostalgic.
“Jack Clark, sometimes I feel as if everything that has happened during this period has been a dream.”
“Why?” Jack Clark asked, puzzled.
“Because things have changed too quickly.”
The girl’s face showed reminiscence, “A year ago, we and the Class Leader were still in the classroom cultivating the Foundation Cultivation Method, working hard for our half-hour session moving ninth-turn qi blood.”
“Back then, you completed foundation establishment in half a month, and when breaking through to the First Layer Heaven, your arm strength was just over a hundred kilograms, right?”
Jack Clark corrected, “Arm strength 102, punching power 210 kilograms.”
Freya Louise nodded, “Right, back then your full power punch was just over two hundred kilograms—you couldn’t even kill an ordinary water buffalo, and among the classmates, you belonged to the category with ordinary talent.”
“Of course, including me as well because of cultivating the Primitive Cultivation Method, my strength was even weaker than yours.”
“But who could have thought that you, appearing so ordinary during foundation establishment, would be the one with the strongest talent.” As she said this, a smile appeared on Freya Louise’s face.
“I still remember your participation in the ranking competition, sweeping through all your opponents, and the surprised looks on Justin Welan and Class Leader’s faces when you secured the 49th rank.”
“Speaking of which, I have always been curious, Jack Clark, how strong were you really back then?” the girl asked as her gaze lingered curiously on Jack Clark.
As the person who had spent the most time with Jack Clark, Freya Louise felt that he was still concealing his strength at the time, but she had no idea how strong he really was.
Jack Clark thought for a moment, “Actually, I wasn’t that strong back then. My strength had only just begun to surge, and my real power was probably around the top ten of my age group.”
At that time, the Six-legged Salamander had only evolved once, providing not much evolutionary energy, just enough to make Jack Clark’s physique comparable to a Second Layer Heaven body refiner.
With the strength of the Second Layer Heaven combined with True Strength, he was no match for those with Innate Divine Strength, like Howard Lambert and Jane Aiken.
At this point, Jack Clark also felt a bit perplexed and disoriented.
Indeed, compared with his current power, which could easily shatter space, slice through mountain ranges and slaughter gods and demons with terrifying strength, he was as insignificant as an ant a year ago.
Back then, he couldn’t even imagine that he would become so exceptionally powerful in just a year.
Even after going to the Kelaya Battlefield, witnessing the ‘impressive’ strength of Lori Parma and others from the Sixth Layer, he thought that toppling a building was incredibly mighty.
Reflecting on the journey so far, his bloody battle with Carlos, the late Fourth Layer Heaven Blood Envoy, his formidable confrontation with the Purgatory True Demon Mikus, sweeping through the Southern Battlefield, facing the Akunus Avatar… Gradually, Jack Clark fell into a particular special state of mind.
Although his cultivation level was constantly rising, because he was advancing faster and faster, Jack Clark was also gradually losing many things.

chapters.title: Chapter 1307 - 1307 506 King of Blade Edge The Kings Gift
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1307: Chapter 506: King of Blade Edge, The King’s Gift Chapter 1307: Chapter 506: King of Blade Edge, The King’s Gift “Attention all personnel, the fleet is about to enter the Heaven Scars Forbidden Zone.”
“The strong magnetic field and violent energy within the forbidden area will temporarily disrupt communication between ships. Please do not panic, and do not move around unnecessarily…”
As the broadcast echoed across the more than ten warships, the horizon ahead was engulfed in cyan raging winds, forming tangible tornadoes that reached from earth to sky.
The tornadoes, stirred by the power of Heaven and Earth, created a tumultuous expanse of Heavenly Energy over tens of thousands of kilometers, shattering space and presenting a terrifying scene.
Boom!
The lead vessel, stretching over ten kilometers and resembling an island, was the first to plunge into the forbidden zone, its outer energy shield bursting into intense vibrations under the assault of the cyan winds.
However, the winds surrounding this ‘narrow path’ were much weaker, and the force of their impact was only comparable to an Early-stage Level 9 Beast, unable to shake the shield of the sky-based battleship.
Amid a series of dazzling cyan-white energy halos, the battleship followed its predetermined course, cutting through the wind and waves, and in the blink of an eye, it was gone, followed by the No.2 battleship.
As the ships entered the forbidden zone, the explosive energy impact also startled Jack Clark from his slumber. When he came to his senses, he felt a relaxing sensation from the inside out.
Jack turned his head, looking at the dark-haired girl beside him with some surprise: “I didn’t expect that you, Freya Louise, could now influence me with your spiritual realm.”
As someone who had cultivated the Heart’s Eye Blade Technique and could sense malice, hostility, and even foreboding danger through others’ gazes, Jack knew all too well how profound the elusive power of the spirit was.
In the realm of spiritual cultivation, Freya, who practiced the Primitive Secret Technique, was in some aspects even stronger than Jack.
For instance, on this occasion, Freya had inadvertently influenced Jack with her mindset during their conversation—otherwise mere flashbacks would not have distracted him.
“That’s because you’re not on your guard against me.”
The girl gave a slight smile, not taking it seriously, then she took out a storage ring: “Congratulations on ascending to the throne, this is the Mythical Congratulatory Gift I have prepared for you.”
In the Federation, every king who breaks through to the Legendary Realm is a cornerstone, and each breakthrough is announced to all, followed by the organization of a King’s Ceremony to be congratulated by all citizens.
It’s just that after Jack broke through to the Myth level, he immediately infiltrated the Evil God Alliance followed by the Heaven-Earth Mutated standing guard at Blue Star, before delving deep into the rear of the Purgatory Empire.
Having just returned and immediately joining the Expeditionary Army, there was simply no time for his King’s Ceremony.
“The King’s Gift you prepared for me, is it to collect all the Life Crystals ‘produced’ during this time by the Federation?” Jack said with a smile as he took the storage ring without hesitation.
Freya swung her legs that dangled in the air, her tone light: “Didn’t you say your awakened physical talent allows you to absorb life force and enhance your bodily strength?”
“However, exchanges go both ways. Remember to prepare a gift for me when I break through to the Legendary Realm.”
“Sure, I’ll prepare a big gift for you when the time comes.”
Jack nodded and then stood up: “I’m going to cultivate now, aiming to break through to Heavenly King before we reach the Heavenly Feather Clan, or at the very least reach the Mythical Peak.”
The fleet was scheduled for a month of flight time, which naturally could not be wasted.
Watching the young man standing tall amidst the raging wind, his long hair billowing, a look of admiration flashed in Freya’s eyes: “To break through from late-stage Myth to Heavenly King in one month, only you would dare say something like that.”
Every realm beyond Myth is a chasm, a qualitative change in strength, making each minor advancement incredibly arduous and often requiring many years of arduous cultivation and meditation.
Yet with Jack, there seemed to be no such bottleneck, and even after entering the Legendary Realm, his cultivation continued to rise rapidly, reaching late-stage Myth in just over twenty days.
Thus, the idea of reaching Heavenly King in a month seemed rather reasonable…
Bidding farewell to Freya, Jack headed to the rear area of the battleship.
The battleship, tens of kilometers long with a height of a kilometer, offered ample space, with the residential area in the middle not much different from a city thanks to spatial expansion technology.
But with Jack’s upcoming cultivation likely to be conspicuous, he did not choose the Closed Area.
“I plan to do Closed-door Cultivation here. Unless there’s something important, don’t disturb me.”
On the deck, the Major responsible for the rear security information control nodded respectfully: “Understood, your majesty.”
After the Major left, Jack settled at the edge of the battleship’s tail end, sitting cross-legged, then a layer of Dark Void power spread out around him, creating a half-circle of blackness with a hundred meters in diameter.
Having enveloped his surroundings in his Void Domain, Jack then took out the ring gifted by Freya. As his consciousness entered it, he instantly sensed densely packed High-level Life Crystals.
Besides the Life Crystals, which were worth more than two hundred thousand Points Attribute, there were also resources worth twenty times more that could be used to expand the Plane World.
Most of these resources for expanding the Plane World came from the Frontline Battlefield, collected from high-order Purgatory True Demons and demonized members of different races.
Additionally, the storage equipment from the Three Demon Kings consumed by Number One had also fallen into Freya’s possession, which included some world-class resources.
Jack exhaled deeply, then poured out all the Life Crystals before reaching his hand into the Void.
The Black Wind howled as the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane World now expanded to over eighteen hundred kilometers, with a palm materializing out of thin air above the Firmament, dropping a storage ring.
Boom! Struck by a bolt of Thunder that flashed across Heaven and Earth, the storage ring exploded, immediately revealing dozens of sparkling items.

chapters.title: Chapter 1308 - 1308 506 King of Blade Edge The Kings
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1308: Chapter 506 King of Blade Edge, The King’s Congratulatory Gift_2 Chapter 1308: Chapter 506 King of Blade Edge, The King’s Congratulatory Gift_2 Spanning tens of meters, the black crystal roots imbued with the Power of Space, the rocks containing scorching magma within, a bead several meters in diameter, seemed as if it contained a miniature world…
Boom! The entire Plane World was once again in turmoil, expanding at a startling rate under the thick World’s Power and Space Power…
By this time, Jack Clark had already withdrawn his right hand, picked up a golden Life Crystal, and a voice full of thoughts echoed in his mind: “Attribute points conversion.”
“You have converted a high-purity life crystal, obtaining 3980 attribute points.”
“You have converted a high-purity life crystal, obtaining 1024 attribute points…”
As Jack Clark continued to convert Life Crystals, his previously mere thirty-something attribute points skyrocketed at an alarming rate, soon breaking through thirty thousand, fifty thousand.
By the time all the Life Crystals had disappeared, the accumulated attribute points on the transparent page reached 218094 once again.
Looking at the more than two hundred thousand attribute points, a smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face: “Next, I can freely use them again, burning 1000 points to envelop the Destruction Emperor Dragon.”
After the breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, Jack Clark would typically burn ten thousand attribute points at a time since only by doing so could he sustain the consumption of comprehending laws throughout the night.
However, this time he intended to comprehend the Ghost Subdue Beast Mark, which didn’t require burning that many.
Boom! In an instant, a surge of Strengthening Power appeared within Jack Clark’s body, traveling through the Soul Channel to the Chaotic Turbulent Region, covering the Destruction Emperor Dragon that was feeding.
All of a sudden, the black-red Colossal Beast, which had just torn off a large chunk of flesh and blood, froze in place, standing still as the dark red blood trickled down the corners of its mouth like a small stream, appearing exceedingly ferocious.
While the other half of his consciousness began “cultivating” the Ghost Subdue Beast Mark, Jack Clark’s voice of thought continued in his mind: “Consume 7000 attribute points, Limit Enhancement of the Great Sun True Body.”
All six body refining techniques acquired in the Lost World had been cultivated to the ninth level. At this step, it was necessary to perform a Limit Enhancement to condense Talent Runes.
Boom!
Inside Jack Clark, the blazing Qi Blood exploded, igniting into a raging white flame, generating intense heat and bright radiance, penetrating the Void domain and illuminating the outside world.
The intangible force converged, forming a huge phantom of the Great Sun spanning hundreds of meters in diameter. The power fluctuations comparable to the Ninth Heaven Peak immediately alarmed the surrounding Special Forces Soldiers.
Chiu!
A sharp, majestic cry echoed in the void. Suddenly, the phantom of the Great Sun blazed brighter, and at its center, a vague shadow of a flying creature appeared emerging, with three feet hanging below its belly.
The Firmament within tens of kilometers vibrated, and even as the azure raging wind howled, obscuring the sky, an intangible sunlight energy penetrated the void and gathered.
This red sunlight, similar in energy to the Stellar Energy from the Solar System, contained the overbearing power of flames. At once, the firelight burning on Jack Clark’s body flared tremendously, gradually merging with the Great Sun phantom behind him.
In the center of the Great Sun, Jack Clark sat cross-legged, surrounded by roaring flames, with a golden crow dancing behind him, resembling a Heavenly God born of the sun, sacred and majestic.
“It’s indeed the Divine Martial Throne. Even just the cultivation process is so grand.”
Since everyone knew that Jack Clark was cultivating, the event’s grand scale didn’t cause much concern among the distant Special Forces Soldiers on duty.
After all, that was the Divine Martial Throne of the One-Year King.
Whoo!
Half an hour later, the raging white Great Sun suddenly contracted, transforming into countless white flames that disappeared into Jack Clark’s eyes.
At this moment, a faint Great Sun seemed to materialize in Jack Clark’s eyes, and all over his skin lay faint white lines, emanating an invisible, overbearing heat.
The main goal of the body refining technique was to strengthen the constitution, but Jack Clark’s physique was too robust, and even the Limit Break of the Great Sun True Body only increased his strength slightly.
However, this wasn’t his primary goal anyway. Jack Clark’s gaze fell on the transparent page that appeared before him.
Rune: Great Sun [A special rune condensed from Qi Blood and Solar Energy. When activating the rune power, it will instantly boost the flame power tenfold, and quintuple the proficiency of flame-class rules.
Passive: Can absorb all ‘Sun’ light energies, transforming them into one’s own power, with the absorption and transformation speed depending on the strength of the flesh body.]
Compared to the Dark Star Rune that could absorb heavy metal elements to strengthen the flesh body, the effect of the Great Sun Rune mainly manifested by increasing the power of flames and added a passive ability.
And the tenfold increase in flame power directly propelled the potency of the Great Sun Heaven Flame Law mastered by Jack Clark, second only to the Law of Strength.
This result was within Jack Clark’s expectations.
After all, this is a top-tier cultivation method that could reach the Ninth Heavens and touch the Great Realm, where one could sense the rule at its peak. The rune acquired from the Limit Enhancement already belongs to the realm of thought with the law.
“Consume 7000 attribute points, Limit Enhancement of Azure Dragon Nine Changes.”
With the disappearance of seven thousand attribute points, the Qi Blood within Jack Clark designated for the Azure Dragon Nine Changes exploded, forming a layer of red light that permeated every corner of his body.
Instantly, the dragon bloodline power within Jack Clark activated, and threads too faint to detect, already integrated into his entire body, the essence of the Emperor Dragon Essence Blood converged.
Roar! A fierce and majestic Dragon Roar erupted within Jack Clark, gradually solidifying into a phantom of a black and red Emperor Dragon.
This black-red Emperor Dragon bore some resemblance to the Destruction Emperor Dragon yet was different. Instead, it was a black-red Eastern Divine Dragon with a slender and handsome shape, exerting a Terrifying Aura.
As the Azure Dragon Phantom became clearer and clearer, gradually a grandiose aura spread, possessing an extraordinary atmosphere of reigning supreme over Heaven and Earth, capable of nine transformations and above the clouds.
Just then, as the Azure Dragon Phantom, about to complete the rune condensation, trembled slightly, a strong force within seemed to be struggling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1309 - 1309 506 King of Blade Edge The Kings
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1309: Chapter 506: King of Blade Edge, The King’s Congratulations_3 Chapter 1309: Chapter 506: King of Blade Edge, The King’s Congratulations_3 Indeed, there was an impact.
Jack Clark’s expression grew stern as a voice echoed in his mind, “Use another three thousand Attribute points to further enhance the Azure Dragon Nine Changes.”
Boom!
In an instant, three thousand Attribute points vanished, transforming into an even more overwhelming strengthening energy that infused into the Black-red Azure Dragon Phantom, which immediately solidified once more just as it was about to disperse.
The Azure Dragon Nine Changes Cultivation Method required those with Dragon Bloodline to practice, and the formed Nine Changes Qi Blood took the shape of the Eastern Divine Dragon.
