Therefore, when Jack had cultivated the method to a grand accomplishment, he anticipated a conflict when forming the runes.
As ‘pseudo’ Monarch-Level Life’s Essence Blood naturally contains the form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, using the Essence Blood to form another Azure Dragon shape would naturally lead to conflict.
This was also why Jack had not ‘updated’ the Emperor Dragon Bloodline within him earlier.
The Essence Blood of a ‘pseudo’ Monarch-Level Life required the consumption of ten thousand Attribute points to suppress; if it were the Emperor Dragon Essence Blood of a Heavenly Tier life, who knows how many Attribute points would be needed to form the rune.
Updating the Bloodline would have to wait until after the Azure Dragon runes had been formed.
While Jack began to fortify his Cultivation Method, horizontally enhancing his strength and intrinsic qualities, the Epiphanic Intent Realm slowly dissipated around the Chaos Turbulent Region where the Destruction Emperor Dragon lingered.
In those golden vertical pupils, a complex black-blue rune flickered, emitting an Aura that instinctively unsettled the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts.
The Silver Giant Dragon took a step back and let out a roar, “Roar! Tim Abbott, stop looking at Great Sethia like that, Great Sethia is a bit scared.”
As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon folded its Dragon Wings behind, instinctively shielding its behind.
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon likewise took a subconscious step back, curled its tail beneath itself, and sat down on the ground with a more graceful posture.
Uh… what kind of reaction is this?
The reaction of the two Giant Dragons caught the Destruction Emperor Dragon by surprise, leaving it somewhat speechless. Soon after, it stopped paying attention to them and turned its gaze to the purple orb crouching on the ground, not daring to move.
Crackle Crackle! In two bites, the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed the flesh and blood of the Giant Beast it had been calling for, then slightly opened its mouth, immediately releasing a deep and powerful voice that resonated between heaven and earth.
“Do you want to live or die?”
Suddenly, the purple orb blinked its large eyes rapidly and tensely said through its Soul Will vibrating the Void, “Live, Great One, I want to live, please don’t eat me.”
“Your Soul Will is too strong for me to trust. If you want to live, use the power of your Soul Source to sign your mark on this Contract Rune,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon said bluntly. After speaking, the Ghost Contract Mark that had condensed in its eyes flew out, turning into a Gloomy Blue rune with a diameter of tens of meters that flickered and emitted a strange Radiance.
Suddenly, hesitation appeared in the purple orb’s eyes.
Its potent and keen Soul Talent told it that once it signed the contract, it would forever be controlled and enslaved by this Black-red Colossal Beast.
But if it didn’t sign… “I will sign!”
Under the cold gaze of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the purple orb ultimately chose to submit. A wisp of pure purple Radiance flew out from its eyes.
Under the control of the purple orb, the streak of powerful Soul Fluctuation Origin slowly merged into the rune.
Boom!
In an instant, the Ghost Subdue Beast Mark burst into brilliant light, exploding into countless Gloomy Blue Rune Sequence Chains that pounced on the purple orb, enveloping its entire body and merging into its flesh and blood, even its soul.
With the contract complete, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s low roar echoed throughout Heaven and Earth.
“I am the Thunderflame Dragon King, Brock Abbott, of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire. From this moment on, you are the Dragon Palace’s first War General, the King of Blade Edge, directly serving under my command,” it thundered.
“Your mission is to form an army for the Dragon Palace, an army comprised of Mythical Giant Beasts.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1310 - 1310 507 Seven Talents Forging the Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1310: Chapter 507: Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Codex Chapter 1310: Chapter 507: Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Codex “`
Looking at the somewhat confused purple sphere, the shoulder height of the giant beast had already reached nearly a kilometer, resembling a small black and red mountain range, as it let out a low growl.
“The Dragon Palace is different from the ordinary empires of giant beasts, having several Dragon Kings with the highest realm being of Ancient Titan level and the lowest two currently at the quasi-mythical stage.”
“What, even quasi-mythical creatures can be Dragon Kings!?” The purple sphere’s eyes widened, even more astonished than when it had heard that the Silver Giant Dragon was the Dragon Palace Dragon King.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “No need to be surprised, because in the Dragon Palace Empire, Dragon Kings are not judged by strength but by contribution to the Dragon Palace.”
“Take Joe, for example, although it is only at the mid-period of the mythical stage, back in the day, it was one of the eight founding members of the Dragon Palace Empire and possessed the treasure-hunting talent.”
“Over these ‘years’, Joe has found a vast number of Heaven and Earth Treasures, accelerating the strengthening of our forces, hence making a significant contribution.”
“You have just joined the Dragon Palace, but if your future contributions are sufficient, you too have the chance of being granted the title of Dragon King and earning the right to participate in the discussions at the Dragon King Hall.”
“Even when I feel that you can be fully trusted, I will unlock your Soul Seal.”
After the Destruction Emperor Dragon had finished speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon roared in agreement, nodding its head, “Roar! That’s right, as long as you work hard, the Great Sethia and Tim Abott will not shortchange you.”
The purple sphere was suddenly excited, “Rest assure, King of Thunderflame, I will do my best to establish a Mythical Giant Beast legion and campaign in all directions for the Dragon Palace.”
Since there were Silver Giant Dragons and quasi-mythical behemoths that had been granted the title of Dragon King, the purple sphere felt the Destruction Emperor Dragon probably wasn’t deceiving it.
As long as it worked hard in the coming days, it wouldn’t take long to become a Dragon King and break free from the control over it.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction, then seemed to remember something and turned to the purple sphere, “Oh right, I almost forgot to ask your name, what is it?”
“Reporting to the flavorsome King of Thunderflame, my name is Toriad,” said the purple sphere respectfully, quickly adapting to its role as a subordinate.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, “Toriad, what are the laws of your talents, what abilities do you possess, and how do you usually control the tens of millions of giant beasts?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon was somewhat curious about the specific talent abilities of this destruction beast king.
Since embarking on the path of evolution so long ago, it was the first time encountering a beast with such potent talents, capable of controlling tens of millions of beasts in combat and whose own combat power had leaped an entire realm.
The purple sphere waved its half-grown tentacles that surrounded it and said respectfully, “I possess three higher-order laws—the Soul Touch, Life Absorption, and Biological Parasitism.”
“With my naturally powerful soul, it becomes even more potent under the amplification of the Soul Law, allowing me to suppress and kill even ancient early-stage giant beasts that attempt to ambush me.”
“I can control those beasts because their soul wills have been shattered by me and then, using the Soul Talent, I transform them into puppets that extend my own will.”
“However, because their souls have been shattered, these will puppets can no longer grow in terms of their life stages, even if I use the Law of Life to evolve their bodies to higher levels.”
“Life Absorption belongs to one of the Supreme Law branches of life; it can absorb and transfer the vitality of other beasts and even control the evolution of living beings in specific directions.”
“For example, the front-line unit, the Armoured War Elephant, the aerial, long-range assault unit, the Flying Winged Python, or the Explosive Death Beast that can detonate and perish together with the enemy at close quarters.”
“Additionally, under my talent ability of life, I can form a vitality field. The more giant beast puppets I control, the stronger the rule of life becomes.”
“Biological Parasitism is a parasitic talent that allows me to occupy a powerful giant beast’s body as an external shell.”
“Due to my life structure, my close-quarters combat is very weak without a host; my attacks are based on the soul, needing these soul tentacles to launch.”
“It’s just as I had thought,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded.
During the previous battle, through the abilities displayed by the purple sphere, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could sense that its talent abilities must have some flaws.
For instance, those puppet beasts whose vitality had been drained became ’empty’ and univariate, mechanically operating under control and losing their autonomy.
Of course, such flaws are not considered shortcomings under normal circumstances.
Unless facing an Ancient Titan beast, Titan Level, or Mythical-level beast, these would be suppressed by the rule of life, drained by tens of millions of beasts, without ever catching sight of the purple sphere.
Moreover, this purple sphere beast had terrifying talents; it was close to the Monarch level in life stages and possessed three top-tier talents, with overall combat power comparable to the ancient middle stage.
Unfortunately, it met the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose realm was two minor levels below but whose combat power was even more heaven-defying and utterly overpowered it in every aspect.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “Toriad, in the future, don’t waste energy trying to control the Transcendent Giant Beasts. Once they reach Titan Level, Ancient Level, those Transcendent Giant Beasts are of no use.”
“Yes, King of Thunderflame,” responded the purple sphere respectfully, blinking.
In the past, it believed in the tactic of numbers overpowering might, thinking that the more beasts it controlled and the stronger the rule of life oppression, the more powerful it would be.
But facing the Destruction Emperor Dragon today, it realized that against such powerful ancient-level beasts, those Level 9 Giant Beasts and regular Mythical Giant Beasts were totally incapable of making an impact.
Therefore, rather than wasting vitality sustaining those puppet giants, it would be better to control more Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts, cultivating them into special behemoth species.
With the ‘matter’ settled, the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued its meal.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1311 - 1311 507 The Seven Talents Forging the Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1311: Chapter 507: The Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Canon_2 Chapter 1311: Chapter 507: The Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Canon_2 “`
The purple Parasitic Beast that had been encapsulated in a sphere was already eaten by half, and the remaining half, which was over three thousand meters long and more than four hundred meters tall, lay on the ground like a mountain of flesh.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Under the terrifying biting force, the scale armor of the purple Giant Beast’s corpse shattered, its flesh and blood tearing apart with thunderous explosions, emitting terrifying energy fluctuations.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon feasted, the Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon spread their wings and flew away, landing on a ‘stone’ that rose thousands of meters high, dozens of kilometers away.
Both Giant Beasts had depleted a lot of energy in the previous battle, and their Dragon Scales were broken and dented, slowly repairing themselves.
The Silver Giant Dragon sat on the stone, sweeping its tail behind it, looking enviously at the Black-red Colossal Beast, which was visibly expanding at a rapid pace in the distance.
“Roar! If only Great Sethia could grow right after feasting like Tim Abott, how wonderful that would be.”
When the gold-blue Giant Dragon heard this, its grim mouth slightly opened, emitting a low, muffled growl through its nostrils.
“Stop dreaming, Sethia. Thunderflame’s Evolution Talent involves Supreme strength, and it’s a rare kind of Supreme power that even billions of Giant Beasts would struggle to possess,” the gold-blue Giant Dragon said.
“However…”
At this point, the gold-blue Giant Dragon paused, prompting the Silver Giant Dragon to lower its head curiously, “Roar! However, what, Telsafi?”
The gold-blue Giant Dragon’s mouth corners lifted slightly, revealing an elegant ‘smile’, “However, although you have no hope of obtaining that talent, your children might stand a chance.”
“Roar! Children, what children?” the Silver Giant Dragon blurted out in confusion, failing to catch on.
Blinking its gold-and-blue Dragon Eyes, the Giant Dragon murmured softly, “Of course, the children you will have with Thunderflame. They might inherit its Evolution Talent.”
The Silver Giant Dragon suddenly sat up straight, roaring in surprise.
“Roar! Wretched Telsafi, what are you saying? Great Sethia is less than four years old (12th Year of Blue Star); how could she possibly have children now?”
“Damn it, you go and have children with Tim Abott if you wish. Great Sethia’s goal is to conquer the Chaotic Turbulent Region and dominate the Endless World.”
As the Silver Giant Dragon roared, a large amount of icy cold mist spewed from its mouth, agitated to the point of nearly losing control of its internal power because of the mention of having children.
In contrast to the somewhat flustered Silver Giant Dragon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon lounging on the ground glanced at it lazily and murmured softly, “I’m not asking you to have them now. Sethia, what are you so nervous about?”
“As for me, I’m only two Sun Wheels older than you. Even if I wanted to, I’d have to wait until I’m of age.”
The Silver Giant Dragon was even more shocked, staring at the gold-blue Giant Dragon, “Roar! Wretched Telsafi, you actually want to have children with Tim Abott!”
“Is that so strange?”
The gold-blue Giant Dragon looked back at the Silver Giant Dragon with a puzzled look and murmured softly, “Although we are Mythical Dragons, our natural instinct for reproduction still exists.”
“When we encounter strong and admirable Dragon-type Giant Beasts, it’s natural to feel the urge to breed. Or are you planning to choose a different Giant Beast as your mate in the future?”
Although there was only a two-day (slightly over two months) age difference between the two Giant Dragons, the gold-blue Giant Dragon was much more mentally mature compared to the Silver Giant Dragon.
The words of the gold-blue Giant Dragon left the Silver Giant Dragon feeling somewhat overwhelmed, prompting it to roar, “Roar! Damn it, Great Sethia needs no mate, and as for Tim Abott…”
The Silver Giant Dragon paused mid-sentence, then glared fiercely at the gold-blue Giant Dragon lying on the ground, spreading its wings and soaring into the sky.
It did not want to stay with this wretched creature any longer. Wretched Telsafi, actually wanting to have children with Tim Abott. How infuriating, unbearably so.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had been feasting on the flesh of an ancient early stage Ancient Beast for almost two days before finishing, its body swelling to a size of three thousand three hundred meters, fueled by an abundance of biological energy.
And that was despite the life force of the Ancient Beast’s flesh being insufficient.
The Black-red Colossal Beast, whose shoulders reached a kilometer high, and whose tail extended more than one thousand seven hundred meters, spanned across the sky, moving slightly, resembling a true mountain range, emanating an overwhelming presence.
That Terrifying Aura, close to the Late-stage Titan Realm and essentially as dense as an Ancient Beast, put so much pressure on the surroundings that space itself kept shattering, forming Black Cracks that spread for hundreds to thousands of kilometers.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly turned its massive body. As its immense feet touched down, the ground within several kilometers radius shattered and exploded, whipping up a mountains and Seas shaking wave along with smoke and dust.
A single movement causing the earth to shake, the scene was reminiscent of the awakening of an ancient creature.
Gazing at the kilometer-wide purple sphere now grown out slender tentacles and floating in the air, the Destruction Emperor Dragon emitted a deep roar, “Next, we will continue to delve deeper into the Chaotic Domain, gathering resources.”
“As for you, Toriad, there’s no need for you to accompany us. You shall sweep through the Chaotic Domain from another direction, building up the Mythical Giant Beast legions.”
“After ten Sun Wheels, regardless of how many Mythical Giant Beasts you’ve subdued, rush back to the Dragon Palace for assembly. The Soul Seal will guide you.”
With the purple sphere having reached Titan Peak Realm, and being a Top-tier Divine Object and Law Divine Artifact, its growth wasn’t significantly affected by their presence, making following them a waste of time.
And it would even split the resources, slowing down the growth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
After all, having become its underling and following along, discovering resources enshrined by the laws or even more precious Heaven and Earth Treasures would definitely require sharing a portion with others; otherwise, the subordinates would become disloyal and disaffected.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1312 - 1312 507 Seven Talents Forging the Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1312: Chapter 507: Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Codex_3 Chapter 1312: Chapter 507: Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Codex_3 “`
In such a situation, it is naturally better to separate and go our different ways.
The Chaotic Turbulent Region is too vast, even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its kind have delved over a million kilometers deep, they have only explored a ‘straight line’ that is no more than a few tens of thousands of kilometers long.
Compared to the vastness of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, this area does not even make up one ten-thousandth of it.
After all, this is a forbidden area of a shattered Great World, a world that is many times larger than the Solar System, even though the mythical world has devoured most of it.
Purple spherical eyes flickered, and a strong soul will vibrated the Void, the tone respectful and sincere, “Yes, great King of Thunderflame, I will do my utmost.”
After speaking, the purple sphere, a kilometer in diameter and covered with long tentacles each ranging from one to two kilometers, shot up into the sky with a deceptively gradual yet rapid pace and quickly disappeared into the dim depths of the Chaotic Domain.
At this moment, the Single-horned Spawn Roc flew over, somewhat curiously watching the direction in which the purple sphere disappeared.
Roar! Thunderflame, is it okay to let that fellow leave just like that?
Although the Single-horned Spawn Roc wasn’t very bright, it understood that the purple sphere was not simple; after all, it was a Destruction Beast King that once dominated a part of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
For the past couple of days, it seemed very compliant, but that was because of the suppression by an even more terrifying Destruction Emperor Dragon.
If it were just the silver giant dragon and them alone encountering it, they would have long been killed by that fellow, life force sucked dry, and possibly even turned into its puppets of will.
Knowing what the Single-horned Spawn Roc was worried about, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked on with cold indifference and slowly growled, “It doesn’t matter, as long as the task is completed.”
No matter whether this giant beast, after leaving, wildly absorbs the life force of other giant beasts, tries to break through to the ancient level, or attempts to unravel the soul seal, the Destruction Emperor Dragon doesn’t care.
Within that soul seal prohibition, a trace of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s ‘Azure’ aura had merged, so unless the other party’s life level also reaches the Heavenly Tier, it will never have hopes of breaking free from control.
Boom!
The mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon emitted a dazzling golden-blue-purple flame that seemed to scorch the heavens and boil the ocean, enveloping the skeleton of the ancient beast, commencing its tempering.
As the skeleton of an Ancient Beast, nearly unyielding under the force of laws, not being smelted would mean that even if thrown into the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, the Plane World could not absorb it temporarily.
However, with the skeleton of this giant beast, combined with those resources from the three previous Titans and Freya, the accumulated energy is enough to push the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane to the next level in the short term.
By then, the Supreme Law of Strength might just be the first to reach completion and break through to the Heavenly King.
…
On the stern deck of Battleship No. 1, roaring dragon cries echoed through heaven and earth; the energy of the surroundings became riotous, converging to form dragon shadows each a kilometer long.
Nine black and red Divine Dragon Shadows encircled the center, where a white Great Sun burned fiercely, within which a golden gate stood tall faintly visible, and a Terrifying Aura permeated from within it.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon digested that Ancient Beast, Jack Clark’s physical body also became more terrifyingly powerful under the influence of the evolving energy appearing out of thin air.
Beyond that, with a total consumption of forty-five thousand Attribute points, all six Ancient Body Refining Techniques had been limit-enhanced by him, condensing unique Talent Runes.
Whew! As the cultivation phenomena dispersed, Jack slowly opened his eyes, gazing at the transparent page before him.
Rune: Dark Star, Great Sun, Azure Dragon [Refines the power of the Dragon Bloodline, condenses the Talent Rune, enhances the current thirty percent of the base strength, defense, speed.
Azure Dragon Transformation: Upon activating the rune, it will burn the bloodline energy, bestowing the power of the ancient Azure Heaven Dominant Dragon, greatly enhancing the battle power of the Battle Demon God. Emperor Dragon Form.
Note: The stronger the bloodline, the stronger the boost from the Azure Dragon Transformation]
Mysterious Light [A special rune condensed from the innate aura of mystery and Qi Blood, merging with the cultivator’s bio-magnetic field, forming a powerful defensive force field.
Note: The stronger the physique of the cultivator, the stronger the bio-magnetic field, the more robust the Mysterious Light force field becomes, which can merge with the Absolute Barrier Divine Power and the power of the Plane]
Purple Thunder [An innate rune condensed from the thunder of heaven and earth that can activate to summon the Heavenly Purple Thunder to temper the body, transitioning towards an Innate Thunderbolt physique.
Note: Driven by the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, it can double the power of the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, and if it evolves into a Divine Power and fuses with the Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, there is a certain chance to touch upon the Supreme Law of Purple Heavenly Thunder.]
Broken Star [A rune of sheer destructive force, under which all power in the body contains the Overbearing trait of shattering everything.
Note: The power of Broken Star has already fused with the lesser trait ‘explosion’]
Heavenly Gate [A Talent Rune with the properties of space, opening up a second life space, capable of storing the force of a lifetime, ablaze with vitality, and in the event of heavy injury, can break through the Heavenly Gate and instantly recover to peak state]
Alongside Dark Star, each of the Seven Talents is particularly powerful, and a single rune alone could let a late-period cultivator of the Ninth Heavens take on an early myth-level strong man.
Even now, with the enhancement of the seven Talent Runes, Jack’s power had once again increased.
But this was still not enough.
Glancing at the howling azure wind outside of the battleship, Jack’s voice of intent resounded in his mind, “Burn ten thousand Attribute points, enter enlightenment state.”
Boom!
Suddenly, he was engulfed in an aura of epiphany, which, in the state of enlightenment, increased his thinking, reaction, and comprehension abilities a hundredfold, along with an understanding of the sudden inspirations of the cosmos.
In the state of enlightenment, instead of contemplating the laws, Jack’s mind was filled with all the information about the Combat Divine Body and his insight into the five Higher-order Laws and understanding of the three Great Divine Powers.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1313 - 1313 507 Seven Talents Forging the Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1313: Chapter 507: Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Codex_4 Chapter 1313: Chapter 507: Seven Talents, Forging the Divine Codex_4 Including the insights from the Seven Major Body Refining Techniques practiced before and after, all surfaced in his mind. The sparks of thought exploded at a terrifying speed, with tens of millions of thoughts arising and perishing every second.
He intended to melt all the Cultivation Methods, rules, Divine Powers, and talents to create his own Supreme Divine Canon, reshaping his True Body.
As Jack Clark fell into enlightenment, a Terrifying Aura that could not be contained spread from his body. In an instant, the entire sky-based battleship sank with a rumble, plummeting hundreds of meters.
“Be careful.”
“Increase the battleship’s anti-gravity magnetic field propulsion immediately.”
“Report, the current battleship load has increased by thirteen percent. To maintain the energy cycle balance, we need to activate the spare fifth and seventh engines at the tail.”
“This anomaly is caused by the phenomena triggered by the Diviner Martial Throne’s cultivation and cannot disturb the throne. Permission granted to activate the fifth and seventh engines.”
Hum! The battleship vibrated, and a more powerful propulsive force and lifting strength Burst forth from the tail, rebalancing the flight state of the battleship.
However, compared to before, the battleship’s energy consumption had increased dramatically, as if laden with a Giant Beast as vast as a mountain.
Meanwhile, many High-level cultivators aboard the several-kilometer-long battleship were instinctively looking toward the rear, their faces showing shock.
Even separated by several kilometers, over ten kilometers away, the invisible yet pervasive Terrifying Aura made it difficult for them to breathe and naturally evoked fear and awe in them.
Including Number One, which was also trembling under the Aura emanating from Jack Clark’s body, feeling an instinctive need to revive the Terrifying Power within, its eyes lighting up with blue-white Radiance.
Freya Louise stood on Number One’s shoulder, her black hair dancing in the raging wind, and softly said, “It’s alright. Jack Clark will not hurt you; he is our friend.”
Looking back in the direction of the rear of the battleship, Freya Louise said with some amazement, “But it’s just like him, just the Aura of cultivation is enough to make Number One feel a strong threat.”
“It looks like I need to work harder too.” With that, Freya Louise’s figure fluttered, and she slowly flew to a diamond-shaped Crystal Stone on Number One’s chest, silently merging into it.
In an instant, Number One trembled.
Boom!
At this moment, Number One fully ‘awakened’, its eyes exuding dazzling blue-white Radiance, inducing a primal fear in all Living Beings.
As Jack Clark refined his strength, laying the foundation for the Supreme, drastic changes were also occurring in the Blue Star World.
For example, the official suddenly announced a Cultivation Method called Basic Body Refining, which could be practiced by people over the age of thirteen, offering the effect of strengthening muscles and bones.
The Cultivation Method consisted of three layers. The stronger the body, the faster the cultivation speed, and reaching the Third Layer meant stepping into the Transcendent realm and beginning True Martial cultivation.
In an instant, the entire world was shaken, everyone was boiling with excitement.
In an era where animals and fish were mutating—rats as big as dogs, tigers over ten meters long, sparrows as large as hawks and falcons—the wilderness became increasingly dangerous for ordinary people.
In such an environment, everyone longed for power, formidable power.
However, only a few people possessed cultivation talent, and most people had to accept that they might be ordinary for life, so they could only envy and follow the news about cultivation online.
But this Cultivation Method called Basic Body Refining could be practiced by everyone, giving everyone the chance to become Transcendents.
Such news was like a Nuclear Bomb exploding in the City Center.
In the villa of Teresa Wilson’s family, three girls watched the downloaded Basic Body Refining Technique on the computer with excitement, and couldn’t help but look back at the burly youth sitting beside the bed, somewhat in disbelief.
“Jim, can we really start cultivating now?”
Glenn Clark nodded with a buzz, “You can. This Cultivation Method was created by my big brother after exhaustive effort. The goal is for everyone to be able to cultivate, making everyone as mighty as a dragon.”
The beautiful and adorable Melinda said with admiration, “It’s no wonder Brother Clark, who broke through to the Mythical King level in just one year, could create such an amazing Cultivation Method.”
The voluptuous Nora Martinez also excitedly nodded, clenching her little fists with excitement, “Yeah, Brother Clark is so amazing.”
Teresa Wilson eagerly asked, “Jim, is this Body refining technique difficult to cultivate?”
“It’s not difficult, quite simple actually.”
Glenn Clark confidently assured, “Moreover, I’ve already cultivated a stronger version of the Body Refining Technique. With my guidance, you’ll pick it up in no time.”
“Jim, is that stronger version of the Body Refining Technique really powerful?” The three girls suddenly became curious.
“Of course, it’s powerful. That’s a technique my big brother customized just for me.”
Glenn Clark rubbed the back of his head, “Unfortunately, this technique requires a high level of cultivation, needing an Innate Body Awakening to practice. You won’t be able to cultivate it.”
Jack Clark had not said that the Ancient Body Refining Technique couldn’t be taught to others when he transmitted it to Glenn Clark. Plus, considering the ‘very good’ relationship the three girls had with him, he had thought about teaching them as well.
Teresa Wilson said nonchalantly, “It’s fine, Jim. As long as you’ve cultivated it, that’s enough, since you will protect us.”
The three girls were merely curious about what Body Refining Technique Jack Clark had passed on to Glenn Clark, feeling indifferent about being unable to cultivate it themselves.
Glenn Clark patted his sturdy chest, “Don’t worry, no one can bully you with me around. Let’s go to the activity room, I will start by teaching you the basics of cultivation.”
“Sure.”
An hour later, in the spacious activity room behind the villa, the three girls were drenched in sweat, lying on the floor gasping for air.
[Some parts still need a little revision, wait for about ten more minutes]
All the Martial Arts Schools began their internal selection for the National Martial Arts Competition; all the applicants had to fight in a preliminary round, and only the Top 50 could participate.
After all, with two grades in a Martial Arts School totaling to a hundred people, and a city having at least two to three Martial Arts Schools and as many as six or seven, a pre-selection was necessary to avoid prolonged citywide competitions.
“Big Tiger, you guys are back,” Glenn Clark greeted Marcus Lindsay and the others.
“Glenn Clark, have you started cultivating?”
“Yes.”
“All participants will take the stage for five matches, gaining a point for a win and losing a point for a defeat. The Top 50 in points will qualify.”
The beautiful and charming Melinda admired, “It’s no wonder Brother Clark broke through to Mythical King in just one year. He actually created such a powerful technique.”
Nora Martinez, with her stunning figure, also nodded excitedly, clenching her fists with excitement, “Yeah, Brother Clark is incredible.”
Teresa Wilson asked eagerly, “Jim, is this Body Refining Technique difficult to practice?”
“It’s not difficult, quite simple actually.”
Glenn Clark confidently assured, “Moreover, I’ve already cultivated a stronger version of the Body Refining Technique. With my guidance, you’ll pick it up in no time.”
“Jim, is that stronger version of the Body Refining Technique really powerful?” The three girls suddenly became curious.
“Of course, it’s powerful. That’s a technique my big brother customized just for me.”
Glenn Clark rubbed the back of his head, “Unfortunately, this technique requires a high level of cultivation, needing an Innate Body Awakening to practice. You won’t be able to cultivate it.”
Jack Clark had not said that the Ancient Body Refining Technique couldn’t be taught to others when he transmitted it to Glenn Clark. Plus, considering the ‘very good’ relationship the three girls had with him, he had thought about teaching them as well.
Teresa Wilson said nonchalantly, “It’s fine, Jim. As long as you’ve cultivated it, that’s enough, since you will protect us.”
The three girls were merely curious about what Body Refining Technique Jack Clark had passed on to Glenn Clark, feeling indifferent about being unable to cultivate it themselves.
Glenn Clark patted his sturdy chest, “Don’t worry, no one can bully you with me around. Let’s go to the activity room, I will start by teaching you the basics of cultivation.”
“Sure.”
An hour later, in the spacious activity room behind the villa, the three girls were drenched in sweat, lying on the floor gasping for air.

chapters.title: Chapter 1314 - 1314 508 Update Heavenly Tier Bloodline Luck
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1314: Chapter 508 Update Heavenly Tier Bloodline, Luck Abundant Chapter 1314: Chapter 508 Update Heavenly Tier Bloodline, Luck Abundant Although the misunderstanding had been cleared up, Marcus Lindsay still looked rather disappointed, prompting Teresa Wilson to blush and quickly change the subject, “Big brother, weren’t you at the Southern Battlefield? Why did you come back all of a sudden?”
“Of course, it’s because of the competition.”
Marcus Lindsay said proudly, “Your brother is a Fifth Layer Heaven expert. With this strength, I could at least get into the top three at the city level, and the top 50 of the entire province’s Fifth Layer Heaven.”
It’s been just over half a month since the sophomore year started, and in reality, they had only been cultivating for a little over a year, with the majority of second-year students being in the Third Layer Heaven realm, with a few in the Second and Fourth.
Even a genius from a first-class martial arts school like Marcus Lindsay would normally only be at the Late Fourth Layer Heaven or peak under normal conditions.
If it weren’t for Jack Clark returning earlier and providing some senior and top-tier resources, he would have needed at least another three months to break into the Fifth Layer Heaven, which was where Marcus Lindsay’s confidence came from.
After Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis and others who had obtained the Heritage of Ruins and broken through the Sixth Layer Heaven entered the mythical world, he and White Veil had become the strongest trio among the sophomore students at South Sky Martial Arts School.
He didn’t even consider the cultivators from other Second-tier and Tier 3 martial arts high schools in the same city.
However, the provincial competition was divided by realms, so he would have to face many third-grade seniors who were also in the Fifth Layer Heaven, which is why Marcus Lindsay was only confident in making it into the top 50.
Teresa Wilson said excitedly, “Is it that national competition? It’s perfect; Jim is also participating. If you come across him, big brother, remember to go easy on him.”
“Tiger is participating too?” Marcus Lindsay was taken aback.
He had left on the day that Glenn Clark started school and only knew that Justin Welan had deliberately postponed his trip to the mythical world by two days to show him around the martial arts school environment.
As for his sister favoring others over her own brother, he completely ignored it, convinced of the old saying that daughters are supposed to be married off eventually.
Glenn Clark scratched the back of his head, revealing a simple and honest smile, “Big brother Marcus, I’ve already broken through to the mid-period of the Third Layer Heaven. My teacher said I could sign up to compete.”
“Damn! Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase?”
Marcus Lindsay’s eyes widened in shock, as surprised as when Justin Welan witnessed Glenn Clark establishing his foundation in one day and breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven.
Nora Martinez, who knew Marcus Lindsay, happily said, “Big brother Marcus, isn’t Jim’s cultivation talent amazing? I heard from May that it took you several months to initially break through the Third Layer Heaven.”
After composing himself, Marcus Lindsay looked at the youth, who was even bigger and more robust than himself, and felt somewhat dazed, “Not just amazing. His whole family must be monsters.”
The terrifying speed of cultivation, being at the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase after just over half a month, was even more exaggerated than Jane Aiken’s back then, and felt no less than those legendary Innate Awakened Ones.
Or maybe he was an Innate Awakened One, just like Jack Clark, except Jack’s talent was latent and only gradually revealed through cultivation.
Sensing the faint but heavy aura emanating from Glenn Clark, Marcus Lindsay became contemplative.
Because Jack Clark had mentioned his special physique along with the horrifying cultivation speed, Marcus Lindsay and his friends were convinced Glenn Clark was indeed an Innate Awakened One.
Suppressing the shock in his heart, Marcus Lindsay cleared his throat and spoke with an air of seniority, “However, Tiger, although you have broken through to the mid-phase of the Third Layer Heaven, you must not become complacent.”
“The path of cultivation is about persistence. The higher the realm, the slower the progress in cultivation. Early advantages don’t guarantee smooth sailing in the future, so be sure to remain diligent and patient.”
Glenn Clark nodded seriously, “Thank you for the reminder, big brother Marcus. I will continue to work even harder at cultivating and strive to break through to the Fourth Layer Heaven within half a month.”
Having absorbed the Divine Crystal contained within the mouth cavity of the Giant Beast’s skull, Glenn Clark’s Innate Overlord Body talent had been further enhanced.
Combined with the supremely compatible Ancient Body Refining Dark Cultivation Methods taught by Jack Clark, and the absorption of Heavy Metal Elements from advanced mineral resources, Glenn Clark’s cultivation speed was advancing by leaps and bounds.
So he was confident in breaking through to the Fourth Layer Heaven within half a month, especially since he had already been at the Third Layer Heaven Middle Phase for two days now.
…Damn. Marcus Lindsay suddenly didn’t feel like talking to Glenn Clark anymore.
At this moment, Glenn Clark looked at the watch on his wrist. It was six o’clock, and he bade farewell, “May, Nora, Melinda, it’s getting late, I’ll be going back now.”
Since Teresa Wilson and the others knew that Glenn Clark had to return home for dinner on time to avoid worrying Doris Clark, Melinda asked, “Tiger, do you want the driver to take you home?”
“No need, I can just run back. It’s not far,” Glenn Clark said, then greeted Marcus Lindsay again, “Big brother Marcus, I’ll be going now.”
“Go on, and remember to send my regards to Aunt Doris.”
“Will do.”
Smiling, Glenn Clark waved his hand before striding through the front yard and exiting the Lewis family mansion. Soon after, his leg muscles swelled slightly, and with a burst of strength, the ground trembled beneath him.
Bang!
Glenn Clark shot out like a cannonball in an instant, kicking up a raging wind as he sprinted wildly along the pedestrian walkway, his speed so fast that ordinary people could only see a flickering afterimage flash by.
With the strength of the Third Layer Heaven and a physique even more formidable than his cultivation, Glenn Clark burst forth at full strength, reaching a speed of two hundred meters per second, quickly covering several kilometers.
Whoosh!
However, as Glenn Clark reached an intersection, a piercing siren blared out, and a senior cultivator on duty shouted from afar.
“Hey, kid over there! Didn’t your teacher tell you not to exceed fifty meters per second within the city to avoid traffic accidents?”
Glenn Clark halted, a simple and honest smile across his face as he respectfully nodded, “Sure thing, Uncle.”
As the streetlamps on the opposite side came on, Glenn Clark walked obediently with the crowd across the pedestrian walkway before picking up his pace again, running like the wind at a steady fifty meters per second.

chapters.title: Chapter 1315 - 1315 508 - Upgrading the Heavenly Tier
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1315: Chapter 508 – Upgrading the Heavenly Tier Bloodline, Luck is Prosperous_2 Chapter 1315: Chapter 508 – Upgrading the Heavenly Tier Bloodline, Luck is Prosperous_2 And it wasn’t just Glenn Clark; the streets were filled with sprinting figures, agilely leaping over various obstacles, some with delivery boxes strapped to their backs.
As the atmosphere for transcendence became more open, the official suppression of cultivators also gradually relaxed, making the entire society increasingly magical and exciting.
“Boss, give me six baked sweet potatoes to fill my stomach.”
“Sure thing, just a moment.” While packing Glenn Clark’s sweet potatoes, Kavadola curiously asked, “Student Clark, is six enough for you today?”
Glenn Clark grinned and said, “Well, I’m about to have dinner. If I eat too much, I won’t finish the meal my mom made, and then she’ll scold me, so I can’t eat too much.”
As he spoke, Glenn Clark took out a hundred-dollar bill and handed it to Kavadola, receiving the paper bag in exchange.
“See you, boss.”
Waving goodbye to the baked sweet potato vendor, Glenn Clark ran towards home while pulling out a piping hot sweet potato, tearing off the charred skin, and gobbling it down in two bites, before taking out another one.
By the time he finished eating, Glenn Clark had just arrived home.
“Mom, I’m back.”
From the kitchen, Doris Clark’s voice called out, “You’re back just in time, come and serve the rice.”
“Alright.” Glenn Clark tossed the ‘backpack’ he was carrying onto the sofa and then made his way into the kitchen, quickly returning with a big pot of rice.
At the dining table, Doris Clark watched her son hold the big pot and eat, asking with concern, “Jim, how was your cultivation today? You didn’t bully any classmates at school, right?”
Grabbing a big braised bone of an Alien Beast, Glenn Clark took a vicious bite before vehemently responding, “Mom, I’m the future Heavenly King of Overbearing Tigers of the Federation. How could I possibly do something so low?”
“Good to hear that,” said Doris Clark with a nod.
There was no helping it. Compared to Jack Clark, who had been mature and reliable from a young age, Glenn Clark had a more exuberant personality, which was why Doris Clark was worried that he might bully other students.
After all, her son was such a big guy and had awakened Innate abilities; a single punch could demolish a wall, and if ordinary people provoked him, they would be blown away.
“By the way, remember to hold back a bit in tomorrow’s school competition and try not to inflict heavy injuries on your classmates, alright?”
Glenn Clark nodded, “Mm, I know, Mom. I’ll be careful.”
Before the start of the national competition at the city level, each Martial Arts School had to first conduct a round of selection, with only the Top 50 eligible to participate.
After all, just the sophomores and third-grade students of South Sky Martial added up to over a thousand. Besides them, there were also two Second-tier Martial High schools and four Tier 3 martial arts high schools. Without a preliminary selection, the city level competition alone would take half a month.
As usual, after dinner, around 7 pm, Glenn Clark excitedly went to the courtyard and pushed out his barbecue grill.
“Mom, I’m off to fish.”
“Go ahead, just make sure you’re back before midnight.”
“Got it.”
Riding his beloved little motorcycle, Glenn Clark followed the riverside and made it to the suburban area six kilometers away with a putt-putt-putt. This was the intersection between Mist River and the Great River.
It was from here that the Hexagonal Armored Beast had entered the Great River.
By this time, many anglers were already seated by the riverside, holding fishing rods made of alloy, with super polymer fiber fishing lines that were a hundred times tougher and more flexible than steel wire.
Seeing Glenn Clark putt-putting over on his bike, one middle-aged man below greeted him warmly, “Tiger, you brought your barbecue grill again.”
Carrying the grill down from the bike, Glenn Clark cheerfully greeted back, “Uncle Zhang, how’s the catch today? Good evening, Big Brother Li, Brother Clark.”
“Not bad today, I only caught a hundred-pound Blackfish.”
Immediately, Glenn Clark swallowed his saliva, “A hundred-pound Blackfish, huh? That’s enough for a meal. By the way, Uncle Zhang, what bait mix did you use today?”
“I used Ice Scale Shrimp and Meat Fragrance Powder today. I found that ice shrimp smeared with Meat Fragrance Powder attract those Mutated Fish more.”
“Is that so? I’ll try it later. But today, I brought Alien Beast Meat residue.”
Saying this, Glenn Clark went to a spot about ten meters away from the riverside, set up his barbecue grill, and then took out a fishing rod as thick as an arm and eight meters long when extended.
He tore open a packet of Meat Fragrance Powder for fishing bait, grabbed a bowl to add some water, and then from a bag pulled out some Alien Beast Meat scraps, trimmed off during Doris Clark’s cooking, and mixed them in.
Ever since Jack Clark became king-level, the Mutated Beast Meat supplied by the Clark Family was of an even higher grade, a special sixth-level Giant Beast Meat, filled with gentle and easily absorbed energy, even Doris Clark could consume it.
Using this grade of Alien Beast Meat as bait had a huge attraction to the ordinary Mutated Fish in the river, which was Glenn Clark’s unbeatable tactic for never coming home empty-handed.
Soon, the bait was ready, and Glenn Clark hooked a piece of the scraps onto a fishhook larger than his palm and cast it with force.
Splash! A water splash erupted more than a hundred meters away on the river surface.
Immediately, the several middle-aged men beside him praised, “Nice arm strength, over a hundred meters in one cast, Tiger is getting stronger.”
“Hehe, it must be because I’ve been eating more, so my strength has grown,” Glenn Clark said with a simple smile on his face, but his expression quickly turned serious, as his fishing rod was trembling slightly.
Although the force of the tremble wasn’t great, and the float hadn’t sunk, Glenn Clark, through his keen sense of strength, knew that Mutated Fish had been drawn over.
However, these were just ordinary ‘small’ fish weighing a few or a dozen pounds, unable to bite off the bait in one go, nor rip apart the Alien Beast Meat.
At this moment, on the tumultuous surface of the river, a surge was stirring, followed by a powerful tug on Glenn Clark’s fishing rod, prompting him to excitedly shout, “Here it comes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1316 - 1316 508 Upgrading to Heavenly Tier Bloodline
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1316: Chapter 508: Upgrading to Heavenly Tier Bloodline, Luck is Flourishing_3 Chapter 1316: Chapter 508: Upgrading to Heavenly Tier Bloodline, Luck is Flourishing_3 Boom!
Glenn Clark’s feet exploded into the dirt, unleashing a powerful pulling force. In an instant, the fishing line tightened into a straight line, and the alloy fishing rod bent sharply.
Feeling the astonishing force transmitted by the fishing rod, Glenn couldn’t help but get excited, “This is a big one; I feel it weighs at least 300 pounds or more.”
“Holy moly, a big one over 300 pounds, can you handle it, Tiger?” The three people not far away exclaimed, then quickly gathered around.
“No problem, it’s my turn once it’s finished thrashing,” Glenn said confidently.
Under normal conditions, a fish in the water has a strength that is over three times its own weight; after mutation, these fish can exert over ten times their weight.
Even as the big fish thrashed in the water, it couldn’t shake Glenn’s arms in the slightest. His bulging muscles were like cast alloy, containing terrifying power.
And if he weren’t afraid that bursting out with his full strength would tear the fish’s mouth during its struggle, Glenn would have already gone all out.
“I can do it now.” Sensing that the mutated fish’s plunging force was weakening, Glenn’s arms exploded with power, pulling the fishing rod back fiercely.
A massive force tore open the river surface over two hundred meters away. A four-meter-long golden fish burst from the water, shooting a hundred meters into the air.
Boom!
The heavy fish, weighing over 300 pounds, hadn’t even had the chance to react before Glenn sent it flying onto the road behind him, making the concrete surface tremble violently with the impact.
However, the mutated fish was very resilient and not killed by the impact, but before it could jump up, a massive fist came crashing down from the sky.
Crack! The fish’s head, harder than metal, collapsed, and blood mixed with fluid sprayed out, dyeing the ground red.
Seeing this, the middle-aged man couldn’t help but shake his head, “Tsk! Tiger is still as violent as ever.”
Hehe!
Glenn laughed and dragged the four-meter-long golden fish down the river bank, his towering height of 2 meters and 3 centimeters exuding an oppressive aura.
Having caught a big fish, naturally, it was to be grilled for eating.
Dragging the fish, which resembled a giant grass carp, to the riverside, Glenn placed it on a large stone. He skillfully peeled off palm-sized scales, finishing the job in minutes.
He then took out a half-meter-long alloy knife, ready to gut the fish, and cut it into pieces for easier grilling.
Glenn plunged the knife into the belly of the golden fish and tore a two-meter-long gash following the midline, spilling its guts and blood.
Huh!
As he glanced at the riverside tainted with the vivid red of the fish’s innards, Glenn uttered a light gasp of surprise. Inside the fish’s belly, half a meter in size, there was a flash of golden light.
“Could it be something good again?” Glenn was somewhat excited. Since the Heaven-Earth Mutated, his luck seemed to have turned for the better, having found quite a few resources recently.
Therefore, his immediate thought was that he had come across another fine object.
Plop!
Glenn stabbed straight into the belly, forcefully opening it up, revealing a fish corpse that had not yet been digested, along with a golden jade-like object.
The golden jade emitted a faint glow, but other than that, it seemed rather ordinary, like just another piece of transcendent ore.
But the moment he saw the golden jade, Glenn’s body instinctively craved to absorb it, and the dormant force of the Innate Overlord Body emanated from within, casting a black gold radiance.
However, Glenn quickly suppressed the Innate Overlord Body’s power because Billy Rigby and the other two came over, curious to see the piece of golden jade amidst the pool of blood.
“Tiger, you’re in luck. There’s actually something good inside this mutated fish. It looks like a low-tier transcendent ore,” one of them observed.
The trio, daring enough to fish for mutated fish by the riverside, were no ordinary people. Although they weren’t very powerful, they were cultivators at the Second Layer Heaven and Third Layer Heaven.
Since there were no energy fluctuations coming from the golden jade, they assumed it was just a common piece of transcendent ore, still feeling a bit envious.
Of course, their envy was just that. After all, it was just an ordinary piece of transcendent ore; they weren’t going to harbor ill intentions towards a young middle schooler.
“Hehe! Looks like I’ve got a good haul today.”
“But let’s study this thing later. Right now, the most important thing is to eat meat,” Glenn said with a simple smile, washed the stone, placed it in his backpack, and then busied himself again.
Although there was enough Alien Beast Meat supplied at home every day for him to eat his fill, Glenn had developed the habit of going out to fish in the evening and having a bit of a feast before going to bed.
“`
……
In the mythical world, the sky-based battleship that Jack Clark was aboard trembled violently after flying for a day, breaking free from the forbidden area where azure raging winds howled.
Under the red sunlight, mountain ranges undulated, and an endless forest spread between heaven and earth, dotted with ancient trees hundreds to thousands of meters tall.
Roar! Suddenly, a tyrannical roar that shook heaven and earth exploded, instantly agitating countless Unique Beasts within a radius of tens of kilometers.
On a mountain peak tens of kilometers away, a quasi-mythical behemoth stood towering at over 200 meters tall and 300 meters long, issuing a warning to the sky-based battleship that had intruded into its territory.
However, before the quasi-mythical behemoth could launch an attack, the underside of the sky-based battleship split open, revealing a cannon muzzle with a diameter of 50 meters where dazzling White Light was converging.
Boom!
The atmosphere exploded with the roar of thunder, and a Light Beam 50 meters thick burst forth, piercing through heaven and earth with blinding radiance, and in the blink of an eye, it struck the ten thousand meter mountain.
In an instant, the mountain crumbled and the peak was directly destroyed by a shot from the battleship’s secondary cannon.
However, the quasi-mythical behemoth reacted quickly, vanishing in the instant the Energy Beam burst forth, reappearing tens of kilometers away at a terrifying speed.
Behind it, the air exploded once more as another black battleship, stretching over a dozen kilometers, flew out, followed by a third, a fourth…
Watching the fleet that blotted out the sky and stretched over more than two hundred kilometers, the quasi-mythical behemoth that had been shot by a secondary cannon hid in the forest, not daring to emerge again.
“Have we already flown out of the forbidden area?”
On Battleship No. 1, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, with the vision of a colossal three-faced, eight-armed figure standing in his eyes, exuding a Terrifying Aura that suppressed Heaven and Earth.
After continuously burning 20,000 Attribute points and reaching enlightenment for a day, with the Combat Divine Body as the core, Jack Clark had completed the basic restructuring based on the divine canon theory.
Several months earlier, after condensing the Innate Demon God True Body, due to the split of his Soul Talent, the previously suppressed Comprehension Talent was completely unleashed.
Innate Living Beings naturally resonate with Heaven and Earth, and with his powerful and terrifying soul, Jack Clark was even stronger than Damon Lopes and the other Innate Awakened Ones in terms of Comprehension Talent.
Moreover, with the Epiphanic Intent Realm fueled by burning attribute points, his cultivation speed was frighteningly fast.
Based on his current progress, he was confident that he would complete the divine canon in half a month, and then it would be time to rebuild his True Body and break through to the Mythical Peak and even Heavenly King in one go.
But now there was another matter to attend to.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark slowly stood up and looked toward the Major who was on guard duty to prevent any disturbances: “I need to step out for a bit; no need to concern yourselves with me. I’ll catch up later.”
The Major hesitated for a moment, then replied respectfully, “Yes, your Majesty.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly to the Major, and then the surrounding space Distorted, instantly positioning him tens of kilometers away; with another flash, he disappeared into the horizon.
In the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had just finished Tempering the Ancient Beast’s skeleton into several hundred-meter-long purple crystals made of semi-energy materials.
Having stayed there for a day and eager to find good resources, the Single-horned Spawn Roc flew over, roaring in its language!
“Wait a minute, I still have something to do.”
As the Single-horned Spawn Roc looked on in astonishment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its massive right claw, revealing a sharp Black-Red claw tip, and stabbed toward its chest.
Boom!
The sharp, robust claw tip and the thick Black-Red Armor made contact, creating a terrifying energy explosion and vibration, sparking dazzling fireworks.
Even under its Terrifying Armor, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to exert some effort to injure itself, and with a low growl, the claw fiercely plunged into its chest.
“Roar! Tim Abott, why are you hitting yourself?” the Silver Giant Dragon and the blue and gold dragon in the distance were also shocked, unable to understand why the Destruction Emperor Dragon was suddenly self-harming.
The Black-red Colossal Beast’s massive head shook slightly as it rumbled deeply, “It’s nothing; I’m just preparing to condense a droplet of Essence Blood.”
Before reconstructing the God and Demon True Body, Jack Clark needed to ‘refresh’ the bloodline strength in his body; otherwise, once the body was rebuilt, absorbing new power wouldn’t result in a perfect fusion.
The Six Major Laws, a formidable body, and the power of the Dragon Bloodline, these three elements formed the core of Jack Clark’s strength.
Supplemented with the Void Death Pupil and three Great Divine Powers allowed him, even in the Mid-Mythical Stage, to unleash the power of a Heavenly King at the peak of his ability.
However, to be able to challenge and even slay a Demon God after stepping into the Heavenly King tier, relying solely on his current foundation was not enough; after all, every Supreme Demon God was a monster of their era.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1317 - 1317 509 Eight-armed Demon God Time Talent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1317: Chapter 509 Eight-armed Demon God, Time Talent Chapter 1317: Chapter 509 Eight-armed Demon God, Time Talent As the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claws tore through thirty meters thick scale armor, entering the chest that very instant, a vast vitality burst forth from the surrounding muscles, about to heal instantaneously.
However, this healing instinct had barely emerged when it was suppressed by the will of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s soul; the heart rumbled like a thunderous drum, gathering heart’s blood and Life Origin.
Gradually, a drop of purple-golden blood, several meters in size, slowly converged, eventually forming a pure purple-gold crystalline substance, which immediately emitted a dazzling seven-colored radiance, and a terrifying energy wave spread out.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Within the purple-golden blood, the phantom of a black-red Colossal Beast roared, exuding a Terrifying Aura that made even the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Silver Giant Dragon, and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon tremble in fear.
Even the very world around them shook under the radiance expelled from the Essence Blood, endless dark clouds converged, obscuring the Firmament, while sky-reaching tornadoes hung down, and blue-purple lightning flashed in the heavens and earth, as if Doomsday had come.
Essence Blood contains the very essence of a Giant Beast’s entire body. When spread out and absorbed and merged by another Giant Beast, it becomes a new bloodline, thus being extremely precious.
For instance, this drop of Essence Blood from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, just the energy contained within is equivalent to a Mythical Peak Giant Beast, not to mention the Heavenly Tier Soul Power and complete Law Charms within.
Therefore, when this drop of Essence Blood was condensed, even the Aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon drastically weakened for a moment, injuring its very foundation, requiring at least the Consumption of two Titan Beasts to recover.
Looking at the colorful, world-affecting purple-golden blood, the Silver Giant Dragon subconsciously swallowed and roared, “Roar! Tim Abott, the Great Sethia wants that.”
It wasn’t just the Silver Giant Dragon; even the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon felt some desire, and the Single-horned Tiger Kingfish’s eyes gleamed too.
If they could absorb the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Essence Blood, the power it contained would be enough to purify their bloodlines to reach higher levels, even to the legendary Emperor level.
“You?”
Glancing at the three Giant Beasts, the enormous mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon opened slightly, issuing a terrifying low roar that shook the heavens, “You are too weak. If you consumed it, you would explode outright.”
The Law Charms of the nine Higher-order Laws, the Aura and energy of a Heavenly Tier life, even a Mythical Giant Beast with two Top Tier Talents and two Higher-order Laws couldn’t withstand it.
“Moreover, this drop of Essence Blood is what I’ve prepared to ‘trade’ with Jack Clark, condensing one more drop of Essence Blood is my current limit; any more would slow down my growth.”
“Trade? Thunderflame, is that Jack Clark the same human who summoned you away those previous times?” the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon asked with some curiosity.
Although it had not seen Jack Clark, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon had also heard from Scythia that humans were the civilized beings of that Indigenous World, with great strength.
And that human named Jack Clark was said to be a genius of that race, very powerful, capable of heavily injuring a Level 9 King-level Giant Beast while at level eight, having met the Destruction Emperor Dragon when it was weaker.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, “Correct.”
Upon hearing this, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help being curious, its majestic and mighty dragon head leaning forward, “Roar! Tim Abott, what does that human have to trade with you?”
Since the upcoming event couldn’t be concealed from them, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “The corpse of a Titan Beast in exchange for one drop of my Essence Blood and the remains of an Ancient Beast.”
Suddenly, the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon widened, and it couldn’t help but roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, are you an idiot?”
“To trade a Titan Beast’s corpse for one drop of your Essence Blood and these Ancient Beast essences… even the Great Sethia knows you’ve made a bad deal.”
Upon saying this, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but roar, “Damned humans, daring to deceive Tim Abott. If it dares to show up before the Great Sethia, I must teach it a harsh lesson.”
Because the Destruction Emperor Dragon was often summoned to help fight, the Silver Giant Dragon harbored great animosity against that human named Jack Clark.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc also nodded in agreement, uttering a yelping cry, “Right, you lost out big this time, Thunderflame.”
But just when both Giants thought the typically astute Destruction Emperor Dragon had suddenly become foolish, it was only the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon that felt things couldn’t be that simple.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth corners tilted upward slightly, revealing a fierce smile, “Of course, it’s not just a simple Titan Beast’s corpse; you will know in a moment.”
“Alright, you should back up a bit.”
As it spoke, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head had three pairs of gold-red feather horns like branches, with silver spatial runes lighting up one by one, emitting strong Spatial Fluctuations.
Whoosh, whoosh!! Billowing golden flames burned, forming a golden ring of fire above the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, with a Silver Vortex appearing at the center, expanding continuously.
With the increase in power, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s loading capacity for space became stronger, and the Spatial Channel torn apart under precise positioning with Jack Clark’s original body became larger and more stable.
Suddenly, a hundred-meter diameter Silver Vortex appeared before the eyes of the several Giant Beasts, and because the channel was so stable, they could even see the scene on the other side of the Silver Vortex.
There, a black-haired young man stood with his hands behind his back, atop a peak ten thousand meters high, his demeanor noble, making him seem like a banished immortal against the backdrop of the surging white sea of clouds.
And in the moment they saw that black-haired young man, a terrifying Aura beyond description spread through the channel, forcing a shift in the expressions of the three Giant Beasts.
Boom!!
The ground under the claws of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon shattered, suddenly sinking more than ten meters, as web-like cracks spread for several kilometers, kicking up billowing smoke and dust.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc fared even worse, falling from ‘low altitude’ with a bang, the Earth heaving like a waking Ground Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1318 - 1318 509 Eight-Armed Demon God Time Talent_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1318: Chapter 509 Eight-Armed Demon God, Time Talent_2 Chapter 1318: Chapter 509 Eight-Armed Demon God, Time Talent_2 The Silver Giant Dragon, crushed by an invisible might, widened its eyes in disbelief, looking at the other side of the pathway, “Roar! How is it possible, that human, that human was only level eight a few sun wheels ago!?”
When the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon first encountered Jack Clark at sea, his cultivation had just broken through the Eight Layer Heaven, and although he had strong combat power, he was never taken seriously by the Silver Giant Dragon.
After all, it is a descendant of myths, possessing two kinds of Higher-order Law, and its bloodline has reached King-level, a Mythical Giant Beast. In terms of both strength and growth speed, it towers above billions of lives.
But at this moment, the aura emitted by that human actually reached the late period of mythology, and his power was even more terrifying, making it feel a strong danger across the remote Spatial Channel.
It had an illusion that the opponent could shatter and slay it in one strike, how could this be possible! It was the Great Scythia, the King of the Dragon Palace.
In face of the Silver Giant Dragon’s astonishment, Jack Clark, standing in front of the silver pathway, simply smiled lightly, then with a wave of his hand, chunks of Time Silver Butterfly corpses and remnants appeared in front of him.
In the prior battle within the Space-Time Chaos, the Time Silver Butterfly, which spanned more than two thousand meters, was cut into hundreds of pieces under the seal of its talent by Jack Clark with his halberd, with the largest piece being less than a hundred meters.
Boom! Just as a huge chunk of Silver Butterfly remnants entered the pathway, the Spatial Channel suddenly shook violently.
As the corpse of a Titan Giant Beast, these remnants wrapped in silver patterns and covered in silver scales, though dead for some time, still contained rich energy and the Titan’s might.
Soon, under the tremors of the Silver Vortex, hundreds of Time Silver Butterfly corpses passed through the channel and appeared on the other side.
Looking at those hovering Giant Beast remnants in the air, along with the mid-period Titan might and entwined time aura upon them, both the Silver Giant Dragon and the golden-blue Giant Dragon showed terror in their eyes.
That late-mythical human had actually slain a mid-period Titan time Giant Beast!!
At this point, Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon both became solemn.
Boom! The instant the purple-gold Essence Blood entered the channel, an even more intense shaking erupted, with the Spatial Channel emitting circles of dazzling silver radiance.
Under the powerful backlash, the feather horns on both sides of the Destruction Emperor Dragon trembled, with the Innate Space Runes on them flickering with dazzling light.
Almost in an instant, the purple-gold blood containing terrifying energy passed through the channel and appeared before Jack Clark.
But it was not over yet. The Destruction Emperor Dragon turned around, reached out its double claws, grasped the three hundred-meter-long Purple Crystal Substance on the ground, and stuffed it directly into the channel.
Instantly, the Silver Vortex trembled even more violently, and as the three segments of the Ancient Beast Essence passed through, the Spatial Channel simply burst and exploded.
Boom!
Under the terrifying space backlash, Jack Clark’s figure sank, his right arm’s clothing burst apart, revealing an arm wrapped in golden-red runes and the dozens of cracks upon it.
“Tsk! This backlash is a bit strong,” he said, glancing at his arm, which recovered in the blink of an eye, then turned his attention to the hovering Essence Blood and Ancient Skeleton in front of him.
Thump!
Behind Jack Clark, space shattered, forming a kilometer-long Rift Channel leading directly to the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, exuding a strong suction force that enveloped the three segments of remnants.
Roar roar roar!!
On the three hundred-meter-long Purple Crystal Substances, one could hear the roars of Giant Beasts and the dazzling halos, the remnants of the rules of some Ancient Beasts contained within.
The Ancient Beasts, masters of the Law, even in death still hold great Divine Might, and intuitively struggled when feeling they were about to be devoured and refined by the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, clinging on the edge of the crack.
Seeing this, Jack Clark’s gaze turned cold: “I could slay you even when you were whole, let alone these bit of bones left after death,” he said, stretching out his right hand.
Thump!
As Jack Clark slightly clenched, a supremely Overbearing power shattered a kilometer of the Void, and the three strands of entwined Law Aura were directly crushed and exploded.
In the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, among the torn spatial cracks, three ‘mountain peaks’ emitting purple glows fell, and the Plane World, which had already expanded to two thousand kilometers, stirred violently once again.
The Golden Sun hanging in the sky emitted dazzling Radiance, thunder roared throughout the world, Black Wind howled, and rocks and dirt on the edges of the Earth spontaneously materialized.
As the Plane World expanded rapidly, Jack Clark looked at the hovering purple-gold Essence Blood, several meters in diameter, opened his mouth wide like a Black Hole, and emitted a terrifying force.
Boom!
The instant the Essence Blood was devoured, a wildly violent force exploded within Jack Clark’s body, releasing endless purple-gold light.
At the same moment, a roar capable of destroying the soul of a Mythical King blasted, causing Heaven and Earth to resonate.
But Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Divine Souls were innately one, and with strong bodies, along with the same bloodline power within, the integration proceeded without any hindrance at this moment.
In the presence of that strand of Heavenly Tier life soul breath, Jack Clark’s soul space vibrated, manifesting a Divine Soul dressed in a black Imperial Robe and wearing the All-Heaven Emperor Crown on his head.
In the void, a strand of Heavenly Blue Power emerged, merging into the Imperial Crown atop Jack Clark’s head.
At the same time, his muscles, bones, cells, and even his genes painted in purple-gold blood light underwent earth-shattering changes, evolving into a higher-level life form.
Meanwhile, outside of Jack Clark’s body, the permeating purple-gold light formed a ten-meter-diameter purple-gold sphere, with the Heavenly Energy within a thousand kilometers stirring frenetically, converging towards him.
Under the convergence of endless Heavenly Energy, a several-kilometer-wide White mist Vortex formed, being devoured and absorbed by Jack Clark at its center, resembling a Black Hole.

chapters.title: Chapter 1319 - 1319 509 Eight-Armed Demon God Time Talent_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1319: Chapter 509 Eight-Armed Demon God, Time Talent_3 Chapter 1319: Chapter 509 Eight-Armed Demon God, Time Talent_3 “`
Although he was merging the Emperor Dragon Essence Blood, Jack Clark, as an Innate Demon God, didn’t shift towards ‘dragon’ form but used the power of the Heavenly tier blood to evolve into another perfect form.
As Jack Clark’s body was evolving and perfecting, the seven runes of Dark Star, Great Sun, Azure Dragon, Mysterious Light, Purple Thunder, Shattered Star, and Heavenly Gate exploded inside him, transforming into countless mysterious Rune Sequence Chains and integrating within him.
The so-called Divine Powers are one with the body, involving a power concept akin to ‘Law’ in the unfathomable cosmos, similar yet distinct from talent.
Having had the experience of merging with the Hidden Deity and other Talent Runes, Jack Clark was now preparing to merge the Seven Great Talent Runes all at once during the absorption of Essence Blood and life’s transformation, to lay the foundation for the True Demon God Body of the Combat Divine Scripture’s Eight-armed Demon God.
Then, by entwining the Six Major Laws with his body as one, like when Jack Clark broke through as a Heavenly King, it would also be his path to supreme power moving forward.
If he could complete the recasting of the True Demon God Body and step into the status of Heavenly King before reaching the battlefield of Heavenly Feather, he would become so strong that enemies would fear him, and he wouldn’t shy from facing even a Demon God.
Boom Boom Boom!! As Jack Clark merged the Seven Great Talent Runes, terrifying phenomena gradually emerged around him.
Behind him, a black celestial body with a diameter of several hundred meters appeared, its surface burning with white flames, like a black Dark Star Great Sun.
At the center of the Great Sun was a golden gate, with nine black-red Divine Dragon shadows entwining upon it, as if sealing some terrifying power inside.
Moreover, purple lightning appeared out of nowhere, exploding and releasing a fearsome aura of destruction and roar, while strands of glaze Mysterious Light descended from the firmament…
Such a terrifying momentum instantly attracted the attention of the Giant Beasts lurking in the surrounding forests.
Yet, feeling that invisible pervasive Dragon Might, every Unique Beast and Giant Beast, whether Level 4 and 5 or Level 8 and 9, within a thousand-kilometer range, lay trembling on the ground, not daring to move.
In the fleet that had already flown over two thousand kilometers away, many strong men were alerted by this aura of terrifying pressure, including True Martial Heavenly King and the Main Gods and deities of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Appearing out of thin air above Battleship Number Five, True Martial Heavenly King gazed in Jack Clark’s direction, pondering, “This aura… Is this why he wanted to leave the fleet.”
As one of the main forces of this expedition, news of Jack Clark’s abrupt departure was quickly reported to True Martial Heavenly King and other Mythical Kings.
A smile appeared on True Martial Heavenly King’s face as he praised, “Worthy of being the Child of Destiny of this generation, his cultivation is like having no limits, improving every moment.”
“Jack Clark, has grown stronger.”
Aboard the deck in front of Battleship Number One, Number One slowly turned its head to look in that direction, its eyes flashing blue and white light, spanning over two thousand kilometers and capturing the terrifying phenomena in its vision.
Inside the dark space of Number One, Freya Louise’s magnificent God Machine Armament was semi-transparent.
Through the energy-form God Machine Armament, one could see dark golden patterns like blood vessels covering the Mecha up and down, even connecting with Freya Louise inside.
These dark golden patterns branched into the void like blood vessels, linking with Number One, swallowing and regurgitating Number One’s Super God Original Force.
Under the continuous support of Number One’s power, Freya Louise, who had reached the Eight Layer Peak, had her aura dramatically improving at an astonishing rate, gradually approaching Ninth Heaven.
But as she was inversely ‘tempering’ Number One, amidst the Super God Energy, the soul information belonging to Number One surged wildly, bombarding Freya Louise’s spirit.
Under normal conditions, faced with soul information from an unknown ancient creature like Number One, even the spiritual will of a Ninth Heaven Cultivator would instantly collapse and become assimilated, devoured.
However, at this moment, Freya Louise’s eyes were cold and indifferent. Her spiritual will, as vast as the cosmos, withstood the bombardment of Number One’s soul information unperturbed.
But as her spiritual will continuously merged with the ‘Heaven’ from the Primitive Secret Technique over extended periods, Freya Louise’s personal imprint was also being slowly diluted.
Consequently, this state could not be maintained for too long. She had to stop every half-day of cultivation, or the consequences would be severe.
…
Deep within the dim Chaotic Turbulent Region.
On the Earth, a Black-red Colossal Beast that was more than three thousand meters long stood in the middle of a Lava Lake, its mouth spewing gold, blue, and purple flames that melted through the void, emitting a terrifyingly high temperature.
Under the fusion of the three higher-order Law Powers, comparable to the future Supreme Law, the shattered body of the Time Silver Butterfly steadily disintegrated, leaving only the essence contained within its flesh and skeleton to converge.
At the edges of the tens of kilometers wide Lava Lake, a Silver Giant Dragon and a gold-blue Giant Dragon spread their Dragon Wings and flew in the air, curiously observing.
Having consumed a large amount of Heaven and Earth Treasures and continuously fought to digest the energy, the strength of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast was also growing rapidly.
Although their growth rate couldn’t match the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon had approached nearly nine hundred meters in length, while the Single-horned Spawn Roc was more than eight hundred and fifty meters long.
The gold-blue Giant Dragon was somewhat puzzled, “Scythia, why didn’t Thunderflame eat the flesh of that Time Giant Beast this time? Isn’t he wasting it by burning it directly?”
