Since knowing the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon had rarely seen it miss the flesh and blood of a same-level Giant Beast since consuming those would enable it to grow.
So, this was the first time it saw the Destruction Emperor Dragon being so wasteful.
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a low growl, as if realizing something, “Tim Abott must be wanting to contemplate the Time Laws.”
“Contemplate the Time Laws?” The gold-blue Giant Dragon was somewhat confused.
“Telsafi, Tim Abott is very formidable,” the Silver Giant Dragon growled proudly. “It can not only enhance its own talent abilities but also learn the talents of other Giant Beasts through the Law Rune Trails tempered from their skeletons.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1320 - 1320 509 Eight-Armed Demon God Time Talent_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1320: Chapter 509 Eight-Armed Demon God, Time Talent_4 Chapter 1320: Chapter 509 Eight-Armed Demon God, Time Talent_4 “Originally, Tim Abott killed a Level 9 Furious Ape Giant Beast and learned the Gigantification Talent by tempering its skeleton and drawing on the incomplete talent traces left behind.”
Suddenly, the gold-blue Giant Dragon’s eyes widened in shock, and it roared in disbelief, “Roar! How is that possible? That terrifying Gigantification Ability, it learned it from a Level 9 Giant Beast’s skeleton!?”
At this moment, the gold-blue Giant Dragon, who was hearing about this for the first time, was utterly dumbfounded, wondering if it had heard wrong.
The Crimson Gigantification Talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was monstrous. Once it entered its Gigantification state, its combat power instantly soared by a Major Realm, enough to crush Ancient Beasts.
Yet such a fearsome Talent Ability was actually learned from the remains of a Level 9 Giant Beast’s skeleton—how could this be possible?
If it weren’t for the knowledge that the Silver Giant Dragon had always been a simple creature since childhood, very stupid but never lying, the gold-blue Giant Dragon would have already swiped at it with its claw.
At this time, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which was lying on the ground out of boredom, also let out a smug cry.
Roar! It’s true, Telsafi, we all saw Thunderflame gradually succeed in Gigantification and learn the Gigantification Ability from that spine.”
“This…” The gold-blue Giant Dragon didn’t know what to say for a moment, feeling as if its entire worldview had collapsed.
Even when it witnessed the Destruction Emperor Dragon evolve its talents time and again, mastering nine Higher-order Laws and transforming into a Horrific Life, it hadn’t been this shocked.
This ability to learn whatever talent one desires from the incomplete talent traces left on the skeletons of dead Giant Beasts and to evolve it into a Higher-order Law was simply too terrifying.
Doesn’t this imply that the Destruction Emperor Dragon could learn and master a dozen or twenty Higher-order Laws if it wished to?
Or to say, out of the nine Higher-order Laws it possesses, aside from the Deep Red Strength of the Gigantification Talent, were the other Talent Laws also acquired in this way?
At that moment, the gold-blue Giant Dragon felt like it finally understood the reason behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s monstrous nature.
It wasn’t some Supreme Evolution Talent, but its horrifying ability to learn other Giant Beasts’ talents, allowing it to continuously master powerful talents and upgrade its bloodline level.
Too strong, too powerful, this strength…
Staring at the Black-red Colossal Beast that was spewing flames in the distance, the gold-blue Giant Dragon felt its body trembling, hot breath spraying from its nostrils, its limbs and tail going weak.
Noticing the fervent gaze in the gold-blue Giant Dragon’s eyes, the Silver Giant Dragon instantly showed vigilance, “Roar! Telsafi, why are you staring at Tim Abott like that? Are you harboring some ill intentions?”
The Silver Giant Dragon knew the gold-blue Giant Dragon well; whenever it had that look in its eyes, the Mythical Giant Beasts within its territory would suffer misfortune.
Exhaling deeply, the gold-blue Giant Dragon settled elegantly on the ground, folding its Dragon Wings, uninterested in dealing with the fool Scythia.
Ignoring such a mighty partner and instead fixating on dominating the Chaotic Turbulent Region, striving to rule over the Vast World—what else could that be but idiocy?
With the talent and potential of the Silver Giant Dragon, even if it spent tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years, it wouldn’t come close to dominating the Vast World or become a Primordial Giant Beast hanging in the sky.
But if it were to become mates with this powerful Black-red Colossal Beast…
The dismissive look in the gold-blue Giant Dragon’s eyes instantly frustrated the Silver Giant Dragon, who stamped its feet, “Roar! Curse you, Telsafi, what are you implying with that look? Are you calling the Great Scythia stupid?”
The gold-blue Giant Dragon, sitting elegantly on the ground, glanced sideways at the Silver Giant Dragon hovering in the sky and let out a soft growl, “Do I even need to say it?”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon grew angrier, spreading its wings and roaring furiously, “Roar! Curse you, Telsafi, the Great Scythia will harshly teach you a lesson.”
But this time, the gold-blue Giant Dragon had no intention of fighting, and it lazily growled, “The Great Telsafi refuses, I fear I might become stupid if I fight you too much.”
What’s the point of fighting with this idiot? Its strength was growing stronger and it could no longer be beaten with just a little ‘trick’ like in the past.
If it couldn’t win the fight, it was better to rest than to waste energy.
Just then, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, hiding in the distance, suddenly cried out, Roar! Scythia, hold off the fight, Thunderflame has finished its task.”
In the distance, the flames in the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon gradually subsided, revealing the silver substance it had suspended in the air.
Due to the biological characteristics of the Time Silver Butterfly, this Titan beast didn’t have much flesh and blood; most of its body was made of a cartilage-like substance.
Under the refinement of the flames, it finally turned into a pair of wings spanning over sixty meters, resembling butterfly wings cast from pure silver, floating in the air with rings of magnificent halos.
On the surface of the silver wings, Silver Patterns swirled, exuding an Aura of the Time Laws.
The shape of the butterfly wings was deliberately crafted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and because it did not consume the flesh and blood this time, the flow of the Time Talent Rune on it was somewhat more intact.
Hum! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils focused with terrifying Will, and in an instant, the silver butterfly wings magnified in its sight until they nearly obscured Heaven and Earth.
Under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze, which magnified the view tens of thousands of times like a microscope, the swirling silver lights also formed some incomplete Talent Runes.
“Time Tide, Time Attraction.”
[The last few hundred words to conclude the text were not edited in time; please refresh in ten minutes.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1321 - 1321 510 Alien Evil Gods Destroyer Colossus
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1321: Chapter 510: Alien Evil Gods, Destroyer Colossus Chapter 1321: Chapter 510: Alien Evil Gods, Destroyer Colossus In the central region of the swamp, which stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers and was dotted with sky-touching trees and vines, four gigantic beasts loomed in the sky tens of thousands of meters high.
Gazing down at the fog-enshrouded swamp below that emitted a rotting odor, the silver giant dragon with wings spanning over sixteen hundred meters let out a low growl of confusion, “Joe, are you sure there’s something good around here?”
Roar!! I definitely smelled something good, but now that we’re here, I can’t find it anymore.
As the single-horned spawn roc spoke with confusion, it looked around, its sturdy blue single horn radiating faint light waves, the invisible fluctuations sweeping across heaven and earth, sensing the surrounding Heavenly Energy flows.
They were more than two hundred thousand kilometers away from where they and the calamity had burst into battle, crossing several hazardous regions and a chaotic void stretching tens of thousands of kilometers.
But for all their trouble, the journey had been fruitless, everything was deathly still, and the land lay barren.
At that moment, the blue-and-gold giant dragon, as if struck by a thought, looked towards the distance and roared, “The Earth’s magnetic field over there is off, and the elemental composition of the Heavenly Energy is strange.”
Roar! The dragon’s double wings furiously spread behind it, each of its crystal-like scales flashing with a seven-colored glow.
Biubiubiu!! Thousands of seven-colored Light Beams burst out from those crystal scales in all directions, covering a range of hundreds of kilometers.
Each of these energy beams was very weak, equivalent to the strike of a Level 7 colossus; when they hit the swamp below, the ground exploded instantly, and trees shattered.
Somewhere tens of kilometers away, the main area hit by the beams suddenly trembled, and the fog-enshrouded swamp forest scene vanished, revealing the black swamp stretching for tens of kilometers.
In the center of that muddy black swamp grew six pure white lotus-like plants, emitting halos of pure white light that purified the surrounding foul air.
Under the purification of the six lotuses containing pure energy, the surrounding black swamp mud boiled even more fiercely, with countless bubbles bursting like magma.
Besides, at the edge of the swamp, thousands of black crocodile-like beings stood on two legs, clad in armor and holding weapons—an alien race.
These swamp crocodile men, about five meters tall and radiating a level four and level five strength, with a few at Level 7 and level eight, were all looking up in terror at the sky.
To these transcendent alien races, a Mythical Dragon nine hundred meters long was unimaginably powerful, not to mention the three that had appeared in the sky at once.
What filled those swamp crocodile men with fear, though, was the three Mythical Beasts and the titanic black and red beast behind them, spanning more than three thousand meters in length, akin to a range of mountains lying across the sky.
Just as those crocodile men were shrouded in fear, the silver giant dragon above let out an excited roar, “Roar! So it’s over there. The power emitted by these white flowers has actually formed its own Enchantment.”
In their excitement, the silver giant dragon plunged from the sky, white light gathering in its mouth.
Boom!
A beam of Ice Flame breath, tens of meters thick, descended from the sky and instantaneously the swamp exploded; the wildly spreading extreme cold energy caused ice to quickly spread, and in the blink of an eye, most of the swamp crackled and froze.
Urgakalak!
The crocodile men shouted in terror and quickly retreated.
But it seemed that the white lotuses were very important to them, for even facing four terrifying giant beasts, the crocodile men stopped after running a kilometer, gripping their weapons tightly.
Yet, both the silver giant dragon and the single-horned spawn roc ignored those swamp crocodile men completely; one after another, the beasts descended from the sky onto the ice.
Thud!
As the immense Destruction Emperor Dragon descended, a segment of the Ice Layer along with the swamp below, broke and exploded within a radius of several kilometers, sending chunks of ice careening in all directions along with the raging wind.
The swamp crocodile men at a distance once again cried out, frantically dodging the ice meteors falling from the sky.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low roar, “Five top-level divine objects, this time Joe gets two, the rest Sethia, Telsafi, and Miss Joseline, one for each beast.”
“Tim Abott, you’re not eating?” The silver giant dragon was somewhat surprised.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head slightly, “These things aren’t of much use to me anymore.”
As the Growth Level approached the Titan late period, the giant body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already surpassed many Ancient Titan Beasts, and naturally, the biological energy needed for its growth was even more terrifying.
Now, consuming these Top-level Divine Items might not even suffice for it to grow two centimeters, making it a waste to do so.
Looking at the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s increasingly frightening form, which was even larger than that of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the silver giant dragon felt a tinge of envy, “Roar! If only Great Sethia was that big.”
Roar!! One is enough for me; the other I need to take back to my wife.
As it spoke, the single-horned spawn roc opened its ferocious maw, a hundred meters wide, and excitedly bit down on a ten-meter-diameter white lotus.
Boom! With that bite, the white lotus, along with the surrounding space and the roots in the swamp below, were all swallowed by the single-horned spawn roc.
Ulakala!
The swamp crocodile men, twenty or so kilometers away, suddenly became agitated, and one particularly strong crocodile man, over eight meters tall and radiating the aura of a Level 9 Early Stage, roared in anger.
The crocodile man issued an angry bellow, his dual-pronged weapon held high, and began to chant with a gurgle, his body emitting a spreading black light that formed a hundred-meter-covering rune array.
Hum!
The black array connected with a powerful force, and in an instant, a Mythical Breath descended, and above the array appeared the giant shadow of a Black Gold Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 1322 - 1322 510 Alien Evil Gods Destroyer Colossus_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1322: Chapter 510: Alien Evil Gods, Destroyer Colossus_2 Chapter 1322: Chapter 510: Alien Evil Gods, Destroyer Colossus_2 This Giant Beast was incredibly strong; just the aura emitted by its projection alone was comparable to that of a Mythical-level entity in the late period, and those Crocodile People around it knelt down in fervent worship.
Resembling a Kirin, covered in Black Gold scale armor, the Giant Beast growled, “Unknown formidable Giant Beasts, you have invaded the sacred territory of the great Lord Kutadire Thunder.”
“Please lay down those Holy Divine Flowers immediately; they belong to Lord Kutadire Thunder. Otherwise, you will incite his wrath.”
Though the Destruction Emperor Dragon, in terms of size, was nearing that of a late-period Titan, this projection of a Mythical Giant Beast over a thousand meters long did not show much apprehension, speaking in a vehement tone.
What met its challenge was merely a casual tail swipe from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
Entwined with black lightning, a dark red slash of light thousands of kilometers long, like Opening the Heavens and Earth, descended from the sky. The terrifying power that it invisibly emitted startled the Black Gold Giant Beast.
Boom! In an instant, the sky shattered and the earth split apart, space collapsed.
Before the Mythical Giant Beast’s projection could even react, it was obliterated by the terrifying power, and the Earth was torn asunder, leaving chasms over a hundred kilometers long.
As for those Swamp Crocodile Men, most of them exploded due to the residual waves of the Destructive Impact, while only a few, who were a great distance away, barely escaped disaster and were blown away for over ten kilometers.
“Roar! Dammit.”
The Black Mountain Range stretched over tens of thousands of kilometers, and atop a mountain peak more than ten thousand meters high, a Black Gold Giant Beast over one thousand four hundred meters long bellowed in rage.
The oppressive might of the unseen Giant Beast shook Heaven and Earth, and in the city built around the mountain below, hundreds of thousands of Swamp Crocodile Men fell to their knees in terror, shouting for the great God Kutedora to calm his anger.
“Kutedora, what’s happened?” A deep and authoritative roar resounded through Heaven and Earth; the dark clouds dissipated to reveal an imposing mountain nearly twenty thousand meters tall.
Or rather, that was not a mountain peak at all, but a Black Colossus of staggering immensity.
Standing nearly twenty thousand meters tall, with a body length of thirty thousand meters, it was even more colossal than the ancient creature that once pursued the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With each inhale and exhale of the terrifying Giant Beast, its breath resonated with the mountain ranges, stirring Heaven and Earth, simply standing there gave ‘Persons’ a fearsome sensation of dominating an entire world.
The Black Gold Giant Beast suppressed the savagery in its eyes and bowed respectfully: “Reporting to the great king, an anomaly has occurred in the Vast World, and Dolon and the others who guard the Holy Divine Flowers have come under attack by mysterious Giant Beasts.”
“The attacking beasts were three Mythical-level, one Titan-level. Upon receiving Dolon’s Summoning, I sent down a Will Projection.”
“Who would have thought that right after I warned those Giant Beasts to leave immediately, stating that the Holy Divine Flowers belong to the great king, my projection was destroyed by that Titan Giant Beast.”
“Is that so?” The deep and authoritative roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, and the terrifyingly enormous Black Colossus slowly spoke.
“Those Divine Flowers contain Law Charms unique to the Vast World; when six mature ones combine, they can form a complete law, which is of significant use to me.”
“Those Giant Beasts dare to covet my king’s possessions; they are truly courting death.”
The eyes of the Black Gold Giant Beast flashed with ferocity: “King, please grant me two Rule Scales. I shall immediately enter the Vast World and exterminate those Giant Beasts.”
“It’s already too late.”
The terrifying Black Colossus growled slowly: “Since those Giant Beasts are after the Holy Divine Flowers, by the time you, Kutedora, get there, they would have likely consumed them and left.”
“I am about to complete the final step, and even without the Law Power of the Holy Divine Flowers to counteract it, I will only be delayed by a few years in my breakthrough.”
“By then, when we enter the Vast World, if we encounter those beasts, just kill them in passing. No need to waste my Rule Power.”
This terrifying Giant Beast was very cautious and steady, not getting angry despite ‘his’ items being stolen.
However, in those vast Black Gold eyes, which resembled stars, the gaze was indifferent and cold—clearly, he, too, harbored a murderous intent towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its companions.
“Yes, my king,” the Black Gold Giant Beast roared respectfully, suppressing the savagery within that urged it to rush off and slaughter those other Giant Beasts.
While the two Giant Beasts did not plan to seek revenge on the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its allies, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, at this moment, did not intend to let them off.
On the frozen shattered black swamp, the Silver Giant Dragon that had consumed the white lotus, along with the gold-blue Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, all emanated a thick white energy.
Beyond that, the Purple little dragon inside the mane on top of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head belched contentedly and curled back up into a ball to sleep.
This little fellow had exerted a lot during his assistance in helping Jack heal earlier and had been sleeping to recover ever since, only briefly waking up when there was good food to eat.
Looking at the three Giant Beasts who had finished their meal, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Scythia, use your Space Power to conceal our auras and forms.”
The Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat puzzled, “Roar! What’s happening, Tim Abott?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon gazed into the distance, its terrifying gaze landed on the Swamp Crocodile Men who had fled a hundred kilometers away, and it nodded slowly, “I’ve made a discovery, you’ll see in a moment.”
Alright, the Silver Giant Dragon, who trusted the Destruction Emperor Dragon unconditionally, nodded. Complex and Mysterious silver runes flickered on the Dragon Scales between its brows, emanating immense Spatial Fluctuations.
Hum! Within the power of Space Law, a ten-kilometer radius of space distorted, and the forms of the Four Great Beasts vanished without a sound or trace.
Earlier, when casually annihilating the projection of the Black Gold Giant Beast with a single strike, that Giant Beast would naturally not sit idly by; it instinctively tried to Burst forth with its strength to resist.
Most importantly, the strength displayed by that Black Gold Giant Beast was related to metal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1323 - 1323 510 Alien Evil Gods Destroyer Colossus_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1323: Chapter 510: Alien Evil Gods, Destroyer Colossus_3 Chapter 1323: Chapter 510: Alien Evil Gods, Destroyer Colossus_3 Huff, huff, huff!!
In the rotten and damp forest, over a hundred Swamp Crocodile Men were gasping for breath with frightened and uneasy expressions, frantically running toward a certain direction deep in the marsh.
While fleeing, these Crocodile Men would occasionally look back, deeply fearing that the terrifying Giant Beasts might have followed them.
Fortunately, the Giant Beasts only had eyes for the Divine Flower and cared not for these insignificant creatures, so after running for more than two hundred kilometers, the Swamp Crocodile Men finally let out a sigh of relief.
Although the Giant Beasts hadn’t caught up, these Crocodile Men whose strength lay between the Sixth and Seventh Level did not stop, continuing their journey at a bursting speed, gliding through the swamp.
Half an hour later, after traversing over a thousand kilometers through the perilous swamp, these Crocodile Men finally stopped in front of two Sky-touching Trees.
The trees, over two thousand meters tall, were nearly indistinguishable from two mountain peaks, with trunks so thick at the base that they spanned hundreds of meters and branches so lush they covered ten kilometers.
Between the two giant trees, hundreds of meters above the ‘low altitude’, there was a kilometer-long Black Crack stretching across the Void like a scar.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!! Without hesitation, the Crocodile Men leaped high into the air and charged into the crack, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
“So it’s a complete world passageway.” A deep and sonorous voice rang out through the Void. Not far off, Space Distorted, revealing the silhouette of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Four Great Beasts.
“Roar! Tim Abott, shall we enter?” The Silver Giant Dragon showed a hint of dread in its eyes.
A world passageway is different from those subspace cracks; it implies that there is a complete world on the other side, and such worlds naturally repel and suppress unfamiliar Mythical Creatures.
Additionally, an unfamiliar world also means the unknown, making it uncertain how strong the suppression by Heaven and Earth might be over there, along with the number and strength of enemies.
Therefore, even the Silver Giant Dragon was not in a hurry to rush over at this moment.
After all, it was no longer the creature it used to be.
“Don’t worry, with me here, let’s go.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon flared its massive double wings behind, sending a wave of air, like mountains and seas shaking, that violently swayed the two giant trees, snapping off limbs tougher than metal.
Looking at the Black Crack that was only a little over a thousand meters long, the Destruction Emperor Dragon reached out its double claws into the crack.
Boom!
Endless golden flames erupted from the double claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with Black Destructive Lightning dancing about, mixing with countless Blue-purple Thunder that spread throughout the entire world passageway.
In an instant, the entire world passageway shook violently.
Roar!
Just then, the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared up at the sky, stomped its feet to the Earth, and its double claws swelled with muscles. In that moment, an earth-shaking terrifying Power Explosion burst forth from within.
Boom!
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon at the center, the Earth within a hundred kilometers crumbled like building blocks, countless mountain-like boulders and dirt soared into the sky, raising clouds of smoke and dust.
Under the terrifying force, the Black Crack vibrated madly, tearing like a piece of cloth, creating a crack expanding over ten thousand meters in length.
And right at the instant when the Destruction Emperor Dragon ripped through the world passageway, the dim world of the Black Mountain Range shook violently.
The already crumbling Firmament completely shattered, with a Black Crack in the sky spreading continuously for a million meters, hanging in the sky like a dark Abyss.
On the opposite side of the Black Crack stood a massive and fierce Black-red Colossal Beast, with golden flames burning on its body and Black Lightning swirling around it, resembling an Evil God attempting to invade this world.
Merely the invisible Destructive Aura it emitted caused this world to shake, with endless dark clouds gathering and bolts of purple lightning thundering as though Doomsday had arrived.
Such terrifying might caused the Swamp Crocodile Men below to be in utter terror.
In the Black Mountain Range, the Black Gold Colossus suddenly stood upright, looking up at the sky and roaring furiously, “My king, it’s that one, the Giant Beast that shattered my Will Projection.”
As the Black Gold Colossus roared, the Black Colossus, thirty thousand meters in length, had already raised its head. Its gaze met with that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon through the passageway, revealing a grave expression.
Likewise, on the other side of the passageway, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could also feel a strong sense of danger emanating from this Black Colossus.
This Colossal Beast was very strong; although the Aura emanating from it ‘only’ reached the Ancient Middle Stage, its size was unimaginably huge, akin to a mountain range extending thirty kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1324 - 1324 511 Lord of the Earth Metal Conversion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1324: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent Chapter 1324: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent The world where the Black Colossus existed was an intact world that delved into the Void, resembling a place where the sky is round and the earth is square.
Looking down from outside this world, the Destruction Emperor Dragon estimated that the central region of the continent spanned over sixty thousand kilometers in length and more than thirty thousand kilometers in width, with an irregular shape.
Surrounded by oceans, the area of the seas was comparable to that of the continental blocks, altogether rendering the total area even more massive than Earth.
However, this world lacked life and green vegetation; whether the land or the mountain ranges, everything appeared in the form of black mineral stone, filled with desolation and oppression.
Even the oceans presented a faint blackness, and the occasionally visible reef rocks and islands below were likewise akin to black metallic ores.
Seeing this scene, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze grew solemn, for under the influence of the rule power of that Black Colossus, this world was on the brink of total metallization.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head, roaring at the Three-headed Giant Beasts behind it, “Don’t go in this time. This beast is strong, and I won’t be able to look after you if we start fighting.”
The gold-and-blue Giant Dragon growled somberly, “Thunderflame, be careful.”
Roar roar roar! Go Thunderflame, kill it.
“Roar! Tim Abott, go in and wipe them out; let their blood flow into a river.”
Contrary to the serious gold-and-blue Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, having followed the Destruction Emperor Dragon until now, were rather excited, brimming with confidence in it.
Boom! As the Destruction Emperor Dragon stepped in, the Black Cracks, which tore more than ten thousand meters outside, violently vibrated.
In the eyes of the Swamp Crocodile Men in the Black Mountain World, the crack in the sky stretching a million meters long on the other side seemed to twist under the projection of the World’s Power, as a Black Colossus tens of thousands of meters in size was squeezing through.
Roar!
A beast thirty thousand meters long, resembling a black Kirin, roared towards the heavens, bursting with an aura that shook the world, with even more terrifying energy converging in its mouth.
Any Ancient Beasts that had grown to such a size had experienced innumerable skirmishes and were rich in combat experience; of course, they wouldn’t simply watch as the Destruction Emperor Dragon descended.
Boom!
In an instant, heaven and earth lost color, leaving only a kilometer-wide black beam piercing through, surrounded by rings of dazzling dark-red energy haloes, appearing immensely vast.
The black column that reached through the heavens contained ultimate destructive power. Everything it passed through, including space itself, was annihilated, forming an even darker pathway of destruction.
In just an instant, the breath crossed thousands of kilometers and appeared above the Firmament, crashing into the Black Cracks, instantly bursting with even more dazzling light.
Boom! The entire world shook violently, deafening all the Swamp Crocodile Men and the Black Gold Giant Beasts.
Under the breath of the Ancient Beast, the deep crack in the sky burst apart, releasing endless black and red light.
Within the explosion’s glow, reminiscent of a second sun in the sky, a Deep Red Destruction Beast nine thousand meters long slowly emerged, its heavy footsteps shattering the Void.
Wrapped around the Deep Red Destruction Beast were blood-red lightning bolts, with lightning spreading across the sky, forming persistent bloodstains.
With increased strength, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s power boost in its Deep Red Form became even more terrifying.
Now, like a true Destroy the World Beast standing atop the Firmament, its formless aura of red light nearly turned the entire world crimson, radiating an ominous breath.
As an entire Deep Red World slowly emerged within the endless red light, an even more terrifying Destructive Aura descended, the pervading destructive aura colliding with the World Rules of this world.
Boom boom boom!!
The whole Black Mountain World began to shake violently, with hurricanes of over twenty scales howling between heaven and earth, thunder roaring, and the oceans raising kilometer-high tsunamis that swallowed everything.
Roar!
An extremely fierce roar echoed between heaven and earth, the glow of red light above the Firmament intensified, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon became a beam of red light falling from the sky. Its speed broke through over a hundred times the speed of sound, and kept increasing.
From afar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon resembled a meteor with a diameter of nearly ten kilometers, and as it burned through the air at hundreds of times the speed of sound, it formed a dazzling tail of light hundreds of kilometers long that illuminated the earth and sky.
Roar! Watching the red beast fall from the sky, the Black Colossus roared furiously, bursting with a heavy aura and emitting a dazzling Black Gold light.
At the same time, the entire world trembled. The Earth, the mountain ranges, even the oceans emitted black light, converging toward the Black Colossus and forming an even more terrifying giant shadow that rose into the sky.
In just an instant, the red meteor from the sky collided with the black light that had just surged tens of thousands of meters high into the atmosphere.
Boom!
The collision seemed like a primeval clash between heaven and earth, releasing dazzling red and black light that radiated over three thousand kilometers, shattering mountain ranges and breaking the Earth as if it were made of blocks.
Under the terrifying Destructive Impact, the hard black ore melted into Scorching Magma in the blink of an eye and erupted in all directions.
Roar!
Under the terrifying Destructive Impact, separated by tens of kilometers, the Black Gold Giant Beast at the Mythical Peak roared in terror, instantly flung across thousands of kilometers by the Destroy Heaven and Earth impact.
As for the cities of the Swamp Crocodile People below the mountains, they melted away in the scorching radiance in an instant, turning to ash, and then were drowned by the subsequent impact.
Roar!
At the center of the explosion, within a hundred-kilometer-deep crater, the thirty-thousand-meter-long Black Colossus roared, its double claws tearing through the shattered Space-Time and rising up to meet the five-thousand-meter-tall Deep Red Giant Beast that arose with its double claws.
Although the Deep Red Giant Beast was smaller in size, the power released by both sides at that moment was evenly matched.
Even though the Black Colossus gathered the rules of an entire world to bolster its strength to a terrifying extent, it was unable to suppress the Deep Red Giant Beast, whose nine Higher-order Laws had integrated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1325 - 1325 511 Lord of the Earth Metal Conversion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1325: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_2 Chapter 1325: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_2 Hum! Just then, the Black Colossus’s mouth shone with a black light.
Roar!
The Deep Red Giant Beast roared, its mouth also emitting a red light, and at that instant, a dazzling beam of red light burst out, colliding with the breath unleashed by the Black Colossus.
Boom!
In an instant, a radiant black and red sun exploded between the two giant beasts, like a crashing ring of black and red light, entwined with streaks of red lightning.
Under the force of rampant destruction, space shattered like layered transparent tides sweeping over heaven and earth; both giant beasts involuntarily staggered back multiple steps from the impact of the terrifying energy.
The two giant beasts stood a hundred kilometers apart, with a ferocious aura brimming in both pairs of eyes.
Above the Black Colossus, a black gold light shone, resonating with the Earth below, its presence terrifying, each movement carrying the terrifying strength of one-sided world.
At the same time, an invisible and heavy force of rules spread throughout the space between heaven and earth, turning into a faint black light that suppressed the world.
Before the manifestation of one-sided world power, an average Mythical Giant Beast would be instantly crushed, and even a Titan could not move.
Even an Ancient Beast of the same level would have its rule power suppressed upon entering this world, thus diminishing its strength.
However, as soon as these black rule forces approached within tens of kilometers of the Deep Red Giant Beast, they were destroyed by the leaping blood-colored lightning upon it, resulting in exploding cracks of thunder.
Moreover, upon the Deep Red Giant Beast, an intangible, dazzling red light spread out, connecting with the Deep Red World, forming a shadow of the Deep Red World that gradually eroded this side of heaven and earth.
Roar roar!!
After a brief standoff, the two terrifying giant beasts lunged at each other once more, clashing in an instant.
Boom!
The terrifying strike caused both beasts to tremble, the Earth beneath them to crumble, and the Void to shatter, turning everything within a thousand kilometers into chaos under the black and red impact.
Within the raging waves of chaos, the two giant beasts separated again, and at that moment, a nearly five-thousand-meter-long red Tail Blade, entwined with blood-colored lightning, sliced across the Void, suddenly appearing in front of the Black Colossus.
Roar!
A ferocious and majestic roar echoed through heaven and earth, shaking the void in all directions. Thousands of black spikes, each ten kilometers long, pierced through the void, engulfing the Deep Red Giant Beast and the blade light together.
Yet, before the lightning-fast blade light, all metal spikes were pulverized, the aftermath tearing the Earth into cracks stretching thousands of kilometers.
Several streaks of blood-colored blade light struck the Black Colossus, tearing through its thousand-kilometer thick Black Gold rule domain, its waist scales shattering, leaving three kilometer-long, several hundred meters deep cuts.
But at the same time, the firmament collapsed, forming an abyss over six thousand kilometers long. A two thousand kilometer-long black mountain range fell from the sky, crashing down through space-time.
Compared to the Ancient Giant Python, the Black Colossus, with almost full command over this world, was even more terrifying.
As the mountain range swept over it, the Deep Red Giant Beast, which had just slashed the Black Colossus, had no time to dodge; it wrapped its double claws in blood-colored lightning as a shield in front of it, and was immediately engulfed by the mountain range.
Boom! With a terrifying strike, the entire continental block shook, the Earth tore open into a chasm tens of kilometers long, bottomless abyss.
The powerful impact swept through heaven and earth, raising smoke and dust that blocked out the sky, nearly destroying half of the Earth’s surface all over again.
Suddenly, the already few giant beasts that roamed the mountain ranges and plains of this world bellowed in terror, erupted with power, and ran to avoid the cataclysmic impact.
Including the Black Gold Colossus that was sent flying a thousand kilometers away; it unfurled its Rule Domain, forming a Black Gold rule canopy that covered a range of a hundred kilometers.
Inside the canopy lay a city several kilometers wide, where hundreds of thousands of Swamp Crocodile Men knelt terrified on the ground, praying to the Black Giant Beast Statue in the city center.
Roar! The Black Gold Colossus roared in panic, dragging the city on its back as it desperately flew towards the world’s edge.
Boom!
An explosion erupted thousands of kilometers deep in the Earth’s crust; endless Scorching Magma spewed forth, and a Deep Red Giant Beast with wings spanning over ten thousand meters soared into the sky.
Roar! As if a black beast tens of kilometers long roared, it bravely pounced forward, and an even more fierce battle erupted in an instant.
The souls and bodies of Ancient Beasts are already merged with the laws; their giant bodies possess world features and nurture the force of rules, their strength enhanced by rule powers to become incredibly mighty.
And upon a breakthrough beyond the Ancient level, these beasts refine a one-side world, World Fragments, or merge a piece of the mythical world into their bodies, strengthening their own rules and evolving themselves.
Such beasts, with every move, carry the might of rules, influencing the surrounding heaven and earth; beasts below the Ancient level cannot even approach their power.
The battles of the Ancient Beasts are frenzied; under the influence of rules, they collide like two worlds. Each strike contains the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
For example, this Black Colossus, whose body has completely metalized under the rules, possesses unparalleled strength and Terror Defense.
Being part of this world’s will itself, it influences the entire world’s operation standing atop the black land, its power inexhaustible, its mastery of the Laws Mystery also immensely terrifying under the enhancement of heaven and earth.
Hum! Under the Black Gold rule power, around the Deep Red Giant Beast, space and matter within a hundred kilometers were metallized, and then they twisted and collapsed violently.
Boom!
As the hundred-kilometer range of metal disintegrated, it released an extremely terrifying destructive force, like tens of thousands of Nuclear Bombs detonating in an instant, the land within over two thousand kilometers shattering once again.
Roar!
The Deep Red Beast, standing firm at the epicenter of the explosion, roared skyward, emanating a Terrifying Aura, unscathed and in an instant turned into a red light appearing in front of the Black Colossus.

chapters.title: Chapter 1326 - 1326 511 Lord of the Earth Metal Conversion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1326: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_3 Chapter 1326: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_3 In an instant, the two giant beasts clashed again.
Unlike the Black Colossus, whose talent-based rule powers were amplified by the laws of this world, the Deep Red Form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon merged all its strength, unable to deploy the mysteries of other talent-based rules.
But for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, none of this mattered.
The integration of three higher-order laws was comparable to a single Supreme Law, and now inside the Destruction Emperor Dragon with the fusion of nine higher-order laws, the Deep Red Strength was virtually tantamount to the Supreme Law of Destruction.
Adding the twenty-fold increase in its foundational strength, defense, and terrifying combat powers, it wielded the Deep Red Destruction Rule to obliterate everything, forcefully colliding with the Black Colossus.
Roar, roar, roar!!
The two beasts, both incredibly powerful and unequaled in strength, defense, stamina, and healing, ravaged the entire land in their battle, destroying it in a matter of moments.
As they plunged into the sea, they unleashed tsunamis tens of thousands of meters high, evaporating countless sea water and exposing the seabed.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, kill it, slay it!”
Roar, roar, roar!! Thunderflame invincible.
“So strong, how impressive.”
Watching the terrifying fight in the Black Mountain World—causing massive cracks hundreds to thousands of kilometers long—the Silver Giant Dragon and the three-headed giant beasts roared excitedly, their bodies trembling with agitation.
It felt as if they themselves were in battle against that ancient creature.
As the two giant beasts fought frantically, the battle lasted two days, shattering the sky and earth, turning over 60,000 kilometers of continental blocks into hundreds of pieces mixed with sea water.
Roar! Suddenly, an oppressively brutal roar thundered throughout the world, followed by a deathly silence after an earth-shattering explosion.
Under the shattered firmament, amidst the red glow, stood a Red Beast towering over 5,000 meters tall, with its sharp metallic blade-edged Dragon Wings tattered and torn.
Besides, the three rows of sturdy, sharp red dorsal fins on its back were also broken in half from the battle, the full-body scales armor was in tatters, and its aura extremely wretched.
This sight shocked the Silver Giant Dragon and the three-headed giant beasts observing from outside the cracks.
It was the first time they had seen the Destruction Emperor Dragon suffer such ‘serious’ injuries, engaged in battle for so long. The last battle that had lasted over ‘one day’ was in the exhausting fight against that ancient being.
In comparison to that peak ancient being who failed to become a True Spirit, this terrifying beast’s defense was even stronger, its combat power horrifying, almost on par with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s.
Although the ‘injured’ Destruction Emperor Dragon was covered with wounds, the Destructive Aura enveloping it was even more terrifying. The formless might collapsed the Void, causing laws to dissolve.
Furthermore, the ‘wounds’ on the Destruction Emperor Dragon were healing at a rate visible to the naked eye, the shattered scales regenerating in just a few breaths.
Even the dorsal fins on its back continued to grow back, and the Dragon Wings spread out once again.
As for the injured Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Black Colossus was not doing much better.
Hundreds of kilometers away, the Black Colossus, confronting the Deep Red Giant Beast, had lost half of its left side. Its body was covered with miles-long gashes and claw marks.
In addition, two pairs of antlers on the Black Colossus’ head had been severed, and its right claw was hanging by only a bit of ‘flesh and blood’, nearly cleaved in half.
However, standing upon the Earth and drawing in the World’s Power, the wounds on the Black Colossus were also healing at an alarming rate.
And at the edge of the world, under the protection of the Black Gold Giant Beast, the Swamp Crocodile Man who had fortunately survived, watched the subsiding roars and tremors in the sky with terror.
Observing the Black Colossus a few hundred kilometers away, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, its voice infused with terrifying Dragon Might and resounding throughout the world, like thunder.
“Since becoming a Titan Giant Beast, I’ve fought many ancient beasts and Demon Gods of different races, but this is the first time I’ve gone to such lengths with an ancient-level giant beast.”
“I am the Thunderflame Dragon King, Abbott of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire. Black Colossus, you are worthy of letting me know your name.”
The tone of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was arrogant, but indeed, it had every right to be proud.
As a beast in the mid-period of its Titan growth level, it had actually fought evenly matched against an ancient-level Giant Beast in the Ancient Middle Stage, a being who had even refined the powers of one-sided world.
Such combat strength was frightening, almost beyond description.
Hundreds of kilometers away, the Black Colossus growled slowly, the entire world vibrating with its voice: “Thunderflame Dragon King, your strength is truly formidable, and you have the right to say those words. Remember it well, my name is Kutadire.”
Although the battle was somewhat baffling, the power displayed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon had indeed shocked the Black Colossus.
As they spoke, the tension between them eased slightly.
The Crimson Destruction Beast growled low again: “Kutadire, your strength has earned my recognition. As for the matter regarding the offensive tone of your subordinate, let’s just leave it at that.”
…?? Suddenly, not only the Black Colossus but also the Black Gold Beast protecting the city at the edge of the world were amazed.
This great battle was because of the tone used during the Summoning speech?
So you stormed at my doorstep, tearing through the world passageways and almost blasted this world apart simply because I sounded unpleasant during a projection?
In this moment, the Black Colossus and the Ancient Giant Python felt bewildered, also filled with a brutal urge to tear the Destruction Emperor Dragon to shreds.
Too overbearing, too much bullying for a beast.
Staring at the distant towering Deep Red Destruction Beast, the Black Colossus fell silent.
Under normal conditions, this battle would not just end like this, especially since that giant beast not only ate the Divine Flower it was guarding but also intruded its world and fought it head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1327 - 1327 511 Lord of the Earth Metal Conversion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1327: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_4 Chapter 1327: Chapter 511: Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_4 But after such a prolonged battle, the Giant Beast that had burst forth in a crimson form still radiated a vigorous aura, maintaining its peak, which made the Black Colossus quite wary.
This Giant Beast was very strong, so strong that even it had to harness the World’s Power just to avoid being overshadowed. If it were to appear in the Vast World outside, it would not be a match.
Moreover, it still needed some time to completely assimilate this world, to fuse with it, and it would not be advisable to stir up more trouble until it had fully completed its rule transformation.
With this in mind, the Black Colossus suppressed the violence in its heart and growled indifferently, “For the offense caused to Thunderflame Dragon King through the words of Kutedora, I express my apologies.”
“Since you, Thunderflame Dragon King, have decided not to pursue the matter further, let today’s battle end here.”
As the two Giant Beasts faced each other, the Silver Giant Dragon outside the World Rift suddenly roared, “Roar! The Great Sethia foresees that Tim Abott is about to invite that Giant Beast to join the Dragon Palace.”
Knowing the Destruction Emperor Dragon well, it was obvious that they would tempt—no, invite the other party to join the Dragon Palace.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon nodded lightly, “This Giant Beast is very powerful, even Thunderflame could not defeat it. If it is willing to join, the strength of the Dragon Palace Empire will greatly increase.”
At this point, the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s eyes revealed schadenfreude, “However, Sethia, your status as the Big Dragon King might be challenged.”
“With your strength at the Legendary Realm, Sethia, you would not be able to deter this terrifying Giant Beast, including the Ancient Giant Python Jormungand.”
However, the Silver Giant Dragon did not care about the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s schadenfreude, roaring proudly, “Roar! With Tim Abott here, no beast can challenge the Great Sethia’s status as the Big Dragon King.”
“Although this Giant Beast is strong, Tim Abott could not defeat it this time, it does not mean that it will still be a match after some time.”
The Single-Horned Spawn Roc nodded and echoed at the side.
Roar! Sethia is right, Thunderflame will soon grow even stronger, and no beast can shake its status as Big Dragon King—it is the order of Dragon Kings set by Thunderflame initially.
… The golden-blue Giant Dragon paused, okay, it seems that this was indeed the case.
Based on the terrifying growth rate of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it might have made a breakthrough to Ancient times after a cycle of the Sun Wheel, and by that time, the Black Colossus definitely would not be its opponent.
Just like the Silver Giant Dragon had said, within the world, the Crimson Giant Beast suddenly roared, “Kutadi Lei, today we have met in battle—an encounter through strife. Would you be interested in joining our Dragon Palace Empire?”
“Join the Dragon Palace Empire?” The Black Colossus was once again bewildered.
Wait, weren’t we just fighting so fiercely, each wishing to kill the other, and now you suddenly invite me to join your Beast Empire? Doesn’t that feel out of place?
The Crimson Giant Beast growled, “The Dragon Palace Empire is expanding into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, and we have already ventured deep here. All Giant Beasts within our reach either join the empire or are expelled.”
The tone of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was Overbearing, just like its form.
“If you are willing to join the Dragon Palace Empire, I can offer you the position of Dragon King, equal in status to mine.”
“The Dragon Palace Empire currently boasts a host of Dragon Kings, governed by the Dragon King Hall, which reigns over all directions. Among them, nine great Dragon Kings exist, with the World Serpent Dragon King Jormungand being second only to me in strength.”
“Besides the Dragon King, the empire’s first War General, the King of Blade Edge at his zenith, also possesses fighting power comparable to the Ancient Middle Stage, dominating the Chaotic Domain, and is known as the Destroying Beast King.”
“However, the millions of Giant Beasts he ruled were all slain by me when they confronted me previously, including two Titan Peaks and an ancient early stage Giant Beast puppet, so his strength has considerably diminished, needing time to recover.”
Even the Black Colossus was somewhat taken aback at this revelation.
It was shocked not only by the recent massacre of millions of Giant Beasts by the Crimson Giant Beast, including two peak Titans and an ancient early stage Giant Beast, but also by the might of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.
With nine Dragon Kings, the one named Jormungand is only slightly less powerful than the Crimson Giant Beast.
If Jormungand had been present in this recent battle, teaming up with the invaders against the Black Colossus, even it would not stand a chance.
With these thoughts, the Black Colossus became even more wary of the Dragon Palace Empire and thus did not outright refuse. It roared after a brief silence, with a majestic and deep voice that reverberated through Heaven and Earth.
“Regarding the matter of joining the Dragon Palace Empire, I need to consider it.”
The Crimson Giant Beast nodded slowly, “You may consider it, and in light of our battle today, I shall ‘later’ restrain the other Dragon Kings from taking action against you.”
“However, in this world, fighting alone is not the best strategy. When you venture out, you must consider your background and power. If I had attacked today with Jormungand, Kutadi Lei, do you think you would be a match?”
The words of the Destruction Emperor Dragon made the Black Colossus pause momentarily, hesitant. Seeing this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not rush.
It had invited this Giant Beast to join the Dragon Palace because it was very powerful and was almost comparable to the Ancient Giant Python, its body having evolved into an incredibly hard Metal Element Matter under the influence of the rules.
Otherwise, even if it could not kill its opponent today, once it reached the Titan Peak in the future, the Emperor Dragon would come again.
After all, the Black Colossus’s massive body, if still flesh and blood, would be enough for the Emperor Dragon to directly make a breakthrough to the Ancient rank upon consuming it.
Of course, if not for the Metalization of the Giant Beast Body under the rule powers when assimilating this world, the Black Colossus would not have been able to grow to such an immense size, nearly surpassing the Ancient Limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1328 - 1328 511 Lord of the Earth Metal Conversion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1328: Chapter 511 Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_5 Chapter 1328: Chapter 511 Lord of the Earth, Metal Conversion Talent_5 After a brief silence, the Black Colossus finally nodded, “Since the Thunderflame Dragon King has extended a sincere invitation, I am willing to join the Dragon Palace Empire.”
“However, I am currently eroding this world with the strength of rules, and there’s still some time before my true body and this world fully integrate, so I’m temporarily unable to move.”
The Deep Red Giant Beast’s mouth corners slightly lifted, revealing a fierce smile, “No problem, for now, the Dragon Palace hasn’t encountered a formidable opponent, there’s no need to mobilize all forces.”
Then, the Destruction Emperor Dragon deftly took out a ten-meter long token-shaped black-red scale from the Reverse Scale Space, the sonorous and majestic dragon roar echoing through Heaven and Earth.
“This is the Dragon King’s Mandate of the Dragon Palace Empire, representing the identity of the Dragon King and the faction. You just need to weave a thread of rule strength on it.”
“Dragon King’s Mandate.” The Black Colossus’s gaze fell on the black-red scale, its will infused with the strength of rules coiling around it, detecting no traps.
Giant Beasts that have grown to the Ancient Level possess an intelligence no less than that of humans and are extremely cautious in their actions.
After confirming there were no issues with the Dragon King’s Mandate, the Black Colossus willed a powerful surge of Black Gold rule strength to converge and imprint upon the Dragon King’s Mandate.
Standing amidst an endless crimson radiance, the Deep Red Giant Beast let out a grand and authoritative roar, “Welcome to the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire.”
“From today on, Kutadire, you are the tenth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, titled Lord of the Earth, with the right to participate in the Dragon King Hall’s council.”
Lord of the Earth, a title suggesting when the Black Colossus stands upon the Earth, its strength is boundless as it metalizes plains and mountain ranges.
“Lord of the Earth, I like this title,” the Black Colossus nodded in satisfaction.
With the joining of the Dragon Palace, the atmosphere between the two beasts relaxed considerably, and suddenly the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “Kutadire, I’m a bit hungry after our fight. It wouldn’t be too much to eat a Level 9 Giant Beast, would it?”
Saying so, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze shifted towards the fractured land in the distance.
Over two thousand kilometers away, a Late Stage 9 beast, covered in Black Gold scale armor resembling a massive deer, stood atop a recently risen mountain peak, gazing over with reverence.
Under the onslaught of the two Giant Beasts, the already scarce life in this world was nearly wiped out, with only a few Level 9 Giant Beasts and the Crocodile People protected by the Black Colossus still alive.
But the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s target was a creature with a Metal Talent, although in truth, the Metal Talents of the Black Colossus and the Black Gold Giant Beast weren’t really suitable for it.
The talents of the two Giant Beasts had already evolved into grand accomplishments of Law, and even if killed, the comprehension gained from tempering their skeletons would already be fixed Law Talents.
This was also why the Destruction Emperor Dragon hesitated over the Time Silver Butterfly’s Talent—the Level 9 Giant Beast’s talent was still in the early rune stages, and after comprehension and strengthening into Deification, it would be more compatible with the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“It’s fine,” the Black Colossus growled indifferently.
These Giant Beasts were actually a result of its rule influence evolving creatures into beasts with Metal Talents; the Destruction Emperor Dragon could kill them all without concern.
Boom!
In the despairing screams of the beast of over two hundred and seventy meters in length, a massive crimson claw crossed space, eclipsing the sky and snatching it.
The beast’s domain was directly crushed, and along with the Giant Beast, it was suppressed and obliterated under the Destructive Lightning.
“Kutadire, I must continue to expand the territory with Joe and the others, so I’m leaving first.” After the greetings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stepped out of the Black Mountain World.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon left, the Black Colossus felt it needed to hasten the refining and devouring process of the world.
The outside world was changing too rapidly, and it hadn’t expected such a powerful force to arise in the Chaotic Domain, brimming with turmoil for so many years. That a single Dragon King from the Dragon King Hall could possess such formidable strength was surprising.
Roar! Under the Law Flame, the Giant Beast was directly reduced to ash, leaving behind a diamond-shaped Black Crystal with intricate Talent Rune Trails.
Within a purple and gold sphere of devouring and expelling, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, a voice resounding in his mind.
“Burn 1000 Points Attribute to enhance the epiphany state of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.”
After speaking, Jack Clark cast a glance at the figure atop the distant mountain peak and closed his eyes again, the transformation of his flesh from devouring Essence Blood nearing its late stages.
Not far away stood Jane Aiken, carrying four swords and having broken through to the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven, her terrifying Sword Intent permeating and intimidating her surroundings.
Although Jack’s strength was formidable, knowing that he was in closed-door cultivation here, Jane had volunteered to come and provide backup for him.
The outside world was changing too rapidly, and it hadn’t expected such a powerful force to arise in the Chaotic Domain, brimming with turmoil for so many years. That a single Dragon King from the Dragon King Hall could possess such formidable strength was surprising.
Roar! Under the Law Flame, the Giant Beast was directly reduced to ash, leaving behind a diamond-shaped Black Crystal with intricate Talent Rune Trails.
