“Burn 1000 Points Attribute to enhance the epiphany state of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.”
After speaking, Jack Clark cast a glance at the figure atop the distant mountain peak and closed his eyes again, the transformation of his flesh from devouring Essence Blood nearing its late stages.
Not far away stood Jane Aiken, carrying four swords and having broken through to the Mid-term of Ninth Heaven, her terrifying Sword Intent permeating and intimidating her surroundings.
Although Jack’s strength was formidable, knowing that he was in closed-door cultivation here, Jane had volunteered to come and provide backup for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1329 - 1329 512 The Tenth Talent Deification Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1329: Chapter 512 The Tenth Talent Deification: Ancient Resurgence Chapter 1329: Chapter 512 The Tenth Talent Deification: Ancient Resurgence On the edge of the swamp, a boundless desert stretched out with yellow sand swirling in the sky.
In the howling raging wind, the black-red Colossal Beast with a body length of three thousand three hundred meters slightly bowed its head and spat out golden flames that enveloped an area of one kilometer below it.
Underneath the intense flames, gravel melted into magma, forming a Lava Lake spanning several kilometers, and the dark red air waves rolling beneath cast the Destruction Emperor Dragon in a hideously menacing light.
Under the controlled breath of golden flame, the entire Full-body Scales Armor of the Level 9 Black Gold Giant Deer Beast dissolved, its flesh and blood evaporated, and some essences merged into the continuously dissolving skeleton.
In less than a few minutes, the flames from the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon gradually extinguished, and a black gold object about ten meters in size and diamond-shaped slowly floated in the air.
The object, which appeared to be made of bone yet also like crystal, was engraved with some black lines and surrounded by a faint black halo, exuding an aura of heavy solidity.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon flew over with spread wings. The nine hundred meter long beast circled around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, looking at the Level 9 Giant Beast Skeleton Essence with some confusion.
“Roar! Tim Abott, are you interested in this Extraordinary Giant Beast’s Talent Ability?”
Roar!! Thunderflame, don’t you already have the Skeleton Essence of the Time Giant Beast? The Single-horned Spawn Roc was also somewhat puzzled.
In the eyes of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, time-related talent abilities were very strong, like the Candle Dragon Giant Beast that mastered the slowing of time.
Under the slow time, only the Candle Dragon’s ability to move unrestricted was too overpowered, especially combined with its ability to instantly grow tenfold in size with day and night cycles, making it nearly invincible among Mythical Giant Beasts of the same level.
It was only a monster like the Destruction Emperor Dragon that could suppress the Candle Dragon with absolute strength.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “For me now, what I need are abilities that can complement and synergize with other rules. Though time is strong, it’s not necessarily suitable for me.”
“Of course, I still have to see how this Metal Talent turns out before deciding which one to choose.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon nodded, “Indeed, Thunderflame, you have comprehended too many rules and talent abilities, having one more Time Power might not necessarily offer you the greatest improvement.”
It seemed to make sense, and both the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc understood and nodded after thinking it through.
Under the gaze of the three giant beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked at the black gold diamond-shaped Crystal. Its Soul Will enveloped it, and in an instant, the engraved talent traces on it expanded tens of thousands of times.
These talent traces, forged from the carcass of a giant beast, were incomplete, missing the part that fused with the soul, and only contained the part imprinted in the flesh and bones.
But this was irrelevant to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which only needed to understand the basics.
“Absorption and conversion of Metal Elements, Material Metallization, Metal Control, Realm of Gold…” the Destruction Emperor Dragon quickly analyzed these talent abilities that the giant beast possessed.
Among them, the Metal Elements Absorption Talent was its target, and suddenly the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s corners of its mouth lifted slightly, revealing a ferocious smile.
Its ability to battle across Major Realms was core to its Giant Beast Body’s strength being dozens of times more formidable than that of same-level giant beasts.
Already having an incomparably powerful base, along with the continuous Tempering from nine Higher-order Laws, after successive layers of enhancement, the overall strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body was now more than two hundred times that of other giant beasts of the same level.
Apart from that, there were the mystical insights of the nine Higher-order Laws talents, such as the Higher-order Law of Destruction that evolved from the Strength Talent, which still maintained a hundredfold increase in strength.
In addition, the Higher-order Metal Talent Vajra and the Higher-order Swift Talent of speed still retained their original hundredfold and thirtyfold increases in body displacement, respectively.
Then there was the Chaotic Dark Power’s invulnerability to all laws, all of which were layered on the Giant Beast Body, making its close combat even more invincible.
As for flames and thunder, as well as the Corrosion Law, these just provided it with more ranged and area attack methods, while the Law of the Life Origin greatly enhanced its recovery and endurance.
Therefore, compared to time, comprehending the Metal Talent, consuming Attribute Points to strengthen and raise the level, while merging it with the Dark Star Rune and gaining the Power of Dark Star was actually more suitable for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Someday, it could continuously increase the physical strength of its body by absorbing Heavy Metal Elements, increasing its density, bringing its Giant Beast Body’s strength to a limit realm.
Perhaps one day it could truly become a celestial creature comparable to a Black Hole, where just standing in the Void could twist Space-Time and tear apart a One-side World.
Beyond that, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had another consideration, and that was the matter transformation aspect of the Metal Talent.
Ancient Titan level giant beasts, aside from their initial stage, most started to become rule-based, their flesh transforming into another, more powerful material.
In that case, once it breaks through to the ancient level, it might become even more difficult to accelerate evolution by hunting Ancient Beasts for Evolution Value.
As for the True Spirit Beasts of ancient times, it goes without saying that such entities have completely become rule-based, having transformed into a rule lifeform long ago, no longer constituted of flesh and blood.
Therefore, the matter transformation feature of the Metal Talent was very important to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon withdrew its gaze and looked down at the three giant beasts, “Next, I plan to ponder the Metal Talent of this giant beast. You all may wander around the vicinity but remember, do not venture too far.”
They had ventured more than one million five hundred thousand kilometers deep into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, an area riddled with danger; here, even Mythical Giant Beasts had no assurance of self-preservation.
“Roar! It’s just as well, the Great Sethia needs to digest a bit.”
Roar!! Without you, Thunderflame, I wouldn’t dare to run around.
Being well aware of the dangers in their surroundings, the three giant beasts had no intention of wandering off. They each found a sand dune about ten or twenty kilometers away and lay down on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1330 - 1330 512 The Tenth Talent Deification Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1330: Chapter 512 The Tenth Talent Deification, Ancient Resurgence_2 Chapter 1330: Chapter 512 The Tenth Talent Deification, Ancient Resurgence_2 Moreover, during this period, they consumed too many resources and indeed needed time to digest.
As the Three-headed Giant Beast dispersed, on a distant mountain peak, within the towering vortex of Heavenly Energy, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, the phantom of the three-faced and eight-armed figure in his eyes growing increasingly distinct.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s True Body Transformation had entered the late stage, and it was just a little short of completion.
After briefly sensing the terrifying power contained within his body, Jack Clark’s thought echoed in his mind: “Burn 1000 points of attribute to transform into an Epiphanic Intent Realm that envelops the Destruction Emperor Dragon.”
Instantly, the attribute points on the transparent page dropped from 153094 to 152094, as a stream of Attribute Energy passed through the Soul Channel, turning into an epiphany state that enveloped the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom! In an instant, within the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the diamond-shaped Crystal engravings that bore traces of talents burst open, transforming into millions of runes dancing in the air.
In the state of epiphany, a strong Soul Will picked out from millions of Basic Runes those containing information on the absorption of Metal Elements as part of its talent.
In the state of epiphany, unaware of the passage of time, it was unknown how long had passed, until only over a hundred thousand runes remained spinning, combining, and optimizing in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had rich experience in reconstructing talent from studying the incomplete traces on the skeleton of the Giant Beast.
When the 1000 points of Attribute Energy burned out, a dark gold rune composed of hundreds of Rune Sequence Chains slowly rotating emerged in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The rune resembled a phantom stag, radiating a sense of solidity and heaviness.
Puff! The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled a hot breath through his nostrils, revealing a look of satisfaction in his eyes.
The Metal Talent reconstruction was completed, next was to adjust the structure to fit its form, then condense the runes, and fully become its Talent.
“Burn another 1000 points of attribute to transform into an Epiphanic Intent Realm that envelops the Emperor Dragon.”
Hum!
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, the mysterious Epiphanic Intent Realm once again enveloped the Destruction Emperor Dragon, in its mind, the Black Gold runes dematerialized and expanded into complex chains of runes.
Simultaneously, a giant shadow of a Black-red Colossal Beast over three thousand meters in length, simulated by Soul Will and Qi Blood, emerged and started to approach those rune sequences slowly.
Bang!
Just as the rune sequences came close to the semblance of Qi Blood, hundreds of them collapsed instantly due to a conflict with the powers of nine Higher-order Laws, and the Qi Blood shadow also disintegrated along with them.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon was well-prepared for this and remained calm, ready to try again.
Soon, under the concentration of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s will and Qi Blood, a shadow reflecting its own data reappeared, while the hundreds of collapsed rune sequences underwent adjustments.
Bang! The three-thousand-meters-long Black Colossus shadow disintegrated again, continuing…
And as the Qi Blood shadow inside gathered and dispersed time after time, the nine great Higher-order Laws inside vibrated and spread out, causing the space within tens of kilometers around the Destruction Emperor Dragon to shake.
Under the force of the tremendous power fluctuations, the Silver Giant Dragon, the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which had just laid down to cultivate for a while, were all alerted.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, having witnessed this scene before, felt a bit envious: roar! Thunderflame is so powerful, he is going to learn a new Talent Ability so soon.
The Silver Giant Dragon also stretched its wings in excitement, letting out an excited roar: “Roar! Come on, Tim Abott.”
The stronger the Destruction Emperor Dragon became, the more formidable the overall strength of the Dragon Palace Empire would be. If the Dragon Palace Empire grew stronger, it meant the Great Sethia became more powerful as well.
So, the logic that the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strength equaled the Great Sethia’s increasing strength was sound.
Thinking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon became even happier.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was happily thinking about how soon the Dragon Palace would dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region thanks to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon felt envious.
As for feeling shocked, that had faded, as it had been too shaken too often recently and had become numb to it.
This time, it took the Destruction Emperor Dragon only half a day to complete the rune adjustment, and with the Attribute Energy not yet completely burned, it began the condensation process immediately.
To reinforce talent with attribute points, like with Cultivation Methods, it’s necessary to first condense the fundamental Rune Sequence Chains and have the attribute page record the Metal Talent.
Boom!
World-shaking Qi Blood surged inside the Destruction Emperor Dragon as infinite Qi Blood gathered, dark gold rune sequences congealed, intertwining like threads with muscles, bones, and scale armor throughout the body.
And as the tenth Talent began to coalesce, the nine Higher-order Laws already merged with the Giant Beast Body inside the Destruction Emperor Dragon went completely berserk, emitting dazzling radiance and terrifying energy.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Gleaming with golden Vajra and streaked with black Destructive Lightning, blue-purple lightning erupted in all directions, and boundless golden flames burned from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
In that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon resembled a rapidly expanding star, releasing terrifying energy as the surrounding space fractured, the sands melted, an act that could Destroy Heaven and Earth.
The Silver Giant Dragon, the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which were tens of kilometers away, had not yet reacted when they were swept up by the rapidly expanding Destructive Impact.
In the raging waves of destructive force, the tumbling Silver Giant Dragon struggled to maintain balance, letting out an annoyed roar: “Roar! Tim Abott, you’ve blown the Great Sethia away again.”
The Silver Giant Dragon could no longer recall how many times it had been blown away by the sudden outbursts of the Destruction Emperor Dragon; that guy was too hateful.
Every time there was a breakthrough, it had to show off its strength without any restraint..
In the blink of an eye, the three giant beasts were flung thousands of kilometers away, flapping their wings in the air in shock as they looked ahead. An Area of Destruction had formed over hundreds of kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1331 - 1331 512 The Tenth Talent Deification Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1331: Chapter 512 The Tenth Talent Deification, Ancient Revival_3 Chapter 1331: Chapter 512 The Tenth Talent Deification, Ancient Revival_3 Under the violent upheavals of the nine Higher-order Law Powers, all matter around was destroyed and obliterated as if a colorful black hole sprawled between heaven and earth, emitting a terrifying aura.
In the center of the multicolored luminescent black hole, the Giant Beast, with a body length of over three thousand meters, stood tall. Dark golden patterns continuously emerged on its thick scale armor, merging with the golden Vajra Law patterns and the black trails of Chaotic Dark Power runes.
As the tenth talent coalesced, the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon became even more terrifying, with the invisible force permeating so intensely that it made the colors of heaven and earth change.
For thousands of kilometers, the sand trembled, and under that horrific aura that dominated all creatures of heaven and earth, countless Giant Beasts and Unique Beasts lurking in the desert madly fled into the distance.
Above the Firmament, endless black clouds converged, forming a black vortex that covered tens of thousands of kilometers, layered upon layers, with lightning flashing amidst them, as if Doomsday had arrived.
Meanwhile, in the eyes of Jack Clark, who was far away, a new line of transparent text emerged below the attribute page beneath the data for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Talent: Metal Conversion [Level: Low-grade. Incomplete, can absorb the metal elements contained in minerals to strengthen the body, enhancing certain strength and Defense]
Compared to the Gigantification talent initially obtained from the six-armed demon ape, which started as a mere common talent, this newly understood talent was more complete due to the greater strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But whether it was a common talent or a low-grade talent, the enhancement for the current Destruction Emperor Dragon was minimal.
“Do you want to spend six hundred attribute points to upgrade the Metal talent to intermediate level?”
Looking at the question mark that appeared on the transparent page, Jack’s gaze was calm, and a voice rose in his mind: “Spend sixty-three thousand six hundred attribute points to strengthen the Metal talent to Deification.”
Enhancing the talent to a Senior level only required a few thousand attribute points, but to upgrade it to Top-tier needed ten thousand, and to enhance a Top Tier Talent to the God Transformation Level required fifty thousand.
However, for Jack Clark now, tens of thousands of attribute points could be collected with a bit of time.
Over sixty thousand attribute points were converted into strengthening energy, rushing mightily through the Soul Channel into the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, where the newly condensed Metal Talent Rune exploded in an instant.
Roar! A fierce and majestic Dragon Roar echoed between heaven and earth, as a terrifying aura shot up into the sky amid the roar.
Under the influence of the strengthening energy, the Metal Talent Runes wildly evolved, growing more numerous and complex, soon covering the entire body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With the emergence of the tenth Deification Talent, the life level of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had reached the Heavenly Tier, was elevated once more, and the body of the Giant Beast began to grow again.
Crackle Crackle!!
The muscles and bones of the entire body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon stretched, its body became stronger and more robust, and its slender double claws thickened up a size, with the edges of the claw blades radiating a dark golden metallic gleam.
Along both sides of the Tail Blade, which was over one thousand seven hundred meters long, scale armor protruded, forming sharp raised edges like blades, while the previously degenerated sword spikes at the tail tip reappeared.
This time the sword spikes became broader, resembling a one hundred meter long reverse slash blade, making it more convenient and flexible for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to fight, capable of slashing in both directions.
Meanwhile, the originally metal mecha-like double wings, which were a little smaller than those of the typical Giant Dragon, became even heavier. The edges emanated a dark golden sharpness, fully transforming into two pairs of gigantic folding slash blades.
In addition, the three rows of dorsal fins extending to the tail, resembling robust mountain peaks, also became sharp and pointed, all radiating a dark golden luster, like three rows of stout four-sided bayonets.
Under this talent Evolution, including the horns mixed in with the mane on top of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head, became as sharp as blades, nearly armed to the teeth.
Even the shape of the head became more ferocious, with the edges of the dark red small scales (about ten meters in size) on its face also covered in angular horns.
The new form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was almost wholly wrought for battle, like a terrifying Slaughter Machine.
And this was only the external change; with the birth of the tenth Deification Talent, the soul of the Destruction Emperor Dragon vibrated, returning once again to the colorful Origin of the World of the mythical world.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s true name, “Jack,” vibrated, radiating ripples of dazzling Radiance as it moved deeper.
But as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s true name moved, an indescribable resisting force came from all directions, and those colorful lights formed a series of Rule Chains.
These Rules were not the ‘weak’ rules born within the body of the Ancient Beast but the origin rules of the mythical world itself.
As these Rule Chains emerged and the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s consciousness touched the true name, seeing the Rule Chains manifestation at that instant, a flood of information washed over it.
Boom!
Under the massive deluge of rule information, the consciousness of the Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly fell into a state of chaos, with its brain directly crashing.
Although the information was too vast to be interpreted and absorbed in an instant, under that fundamental information, the soul of the Destruction Emperor Dragon underwent another ‘Evolution.’
At the same time, the body of the Giant Beast continued to grow stronger, supported by the soul’s vicarious reinforcement.
The changes in the true name of the Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately attracted the attention of some Horrific Creatures.
In the depths of the Firmament of the mythical world, several dozen stars once again emitted dazzling Radiance, clearly visible even under the glare of the red sun in the sky.
Under the sudden turn of events, countless Living Beings in the boundless mythical world looked up, startled at the gleaming stars above them.
From within the darkness, a deep and terrifying voice emerged: “Such a celestial phenomenon has appeared twice in such a short time; I wonder which two ancient beings have broken their limits and stepped into the Primordial.”
At that moment, many ancient and powerful beings in the mythical world revealed envy in their eyes.
Boom!
A range of mountains stretching tens of thousands of kilometers collapsed, and within the sky-darkening smoke and dust, two pairs of gigantic dark red eyes slowly opened, casting a terrifying gaze toward the sky.
And while the entire mythical world was shaken by the Transformation of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with some ancient beings waking from their slumber,
the body of the Demon God, Jack Clark, which was already in the late stage of Transformation, also underwent changes due to the elevated life level of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as a Terrifying Aura spread from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1332 - 1332 513 Jack Clarks Marriage Alliance Innate
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1332: Chapter 513: Jack Clark’s Marriage Alliance, Innate Divine Holy Chapter 1332: Chapter 513: Jack Clark’s Marriage Alliance, Innate Divine Holy The Destruction Emperor Dragon went into a crash because it received too much information in an instant.
Although the life-layered Destruction Emperor Dragon had reached the point of condensing a True Name, its realm and understanding of Heaven and Earth did not match its life level.
It was like a Third Layer Heaven cultivator suddenly coming into contact with rules equivalent to the Heavenly King Realm.
However, because the filtering by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the chaotic rule information that flowed through the Soul Channel was scarce, only causing Jack Clark’s soul to shake and his brain to throb with pain.
Before Jack Clark could gather his wits to comprehend these rule fragments, his evolving True Body burst forth with a powerful suction.
Jack Clark’s body shook violently, the God Demon True Body that had already been melding into the Seven Great Talent Runes and Heavenly Tier Essence Blood and had evolved to a fixed shape in its late period suddenly disintegrated.
Boom! Jack Clark exploded completely.
The explosion of the God Demon’s Body released energy comparable to a hundred-million-tonnage Hydrogen Bomb, sending out blinding light, and the mountain peak thousands of meters below was instantly collapsed under the Destructive Impact.
The vortex gathering Heavenly Energy within a thousand kilometers in the sky, including the clouds above the Firmament, also instantly dissolved, forming a vast Hollow that continuously spread for hundreds of kilometers.
And in the instant of the explosion, boundless flesh and blood converged at the center, reforming in the blink of an eye into an imposing figure standing five hundred meters tall, with three faces and six arms.
Boom! As soon as Jack Clark’s God Demon True Body reformed, it exploded again.
However, this time he was prepared, so the ‘yield’ of the explosion was much smaller, merely equivalent to an ordinary Nuclear Bomb, and the burning flesh once again converged at the center of the explosion.
The formidable flesh gave Jack Clark a terrifying vitality.
Without consuming the Laws’ Origin, copious flesh and blood extended and merged, instantly reforming the three-faced, six-armed form, and this time Jack Clark’s Aura felt even more powerful and stable.
Forcefully suppressing the erupting energy inside his True Body, Jack Clark’s eyes showed a trace of astonishment, “This is… Innate Evolution.”
At that moment within Jack Clark, the True Demon God Body was autonomously evolving as it continuously absorbed the chaotic rule information, without his control.
This evolution might seem chaotic, but Jack Clark felt it was stronger and more perfect than the Eight-armed Demon God True Body he had constructed through deduction.
The previous Eight-armed True Body was a fusion driven by Dragon Blood, at the core containing the Combat Divine Scripture Technique with spatial foundations, blended with the Three Great Divine Powers and the Seven Great Talent Runes.
This kind of fusion, because it had traces of joining, wasn’t perfect, and Jack Clark would need to spend time slowly refining it after making a breakthrough to the Heavenly King.
Yet now, after absorbing those Soul Channel fragments, the God Demon True Body broke down and reconstituted itself through autonomous evolution.
Just slightly astonished, a smile appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes, as he hadn’t expected such a serendipitous joy.
The so-called Innate Demon Gods refer to lives bred by the Mysterious Yellow Air at the Beginning of Heaven and Earth, possessing the might to call forth wind and rain from the moment of their birth.
But there were distinctions among Innate Demon Gods.
For example, the Innate Lives bred by small worlds like the Lost World or the Black Mountain World, and the Demon Gods bred by vast worlds like those encompassing the size of the Solar System, or even the Milky Way, were on entirely different levels.
The reason lay in the strength and integrity of the rules and laws contained when the Demon God’s Body was formed.
For instance, Jack Clark had condensed the Innate Demon God True Body, but apart from his robust flesh and the Six Major Laws, he was at most only two minor levels above other king-level beings of the same realm.
Like an early Myth fighting a Late Mythical being.
Even though, under normal conditions, a king-level being at the early Myth stage possessing late-stage combat power was already strong, and among the Human Race’s kings, only a few could achieve this feat.
But Jack Clark always felt somewhat lacking, without exhibiting the full might of an Innate Demon God.
Now, the absorption of those chaotic and mysterious rule fragments, despite being incomprehensible to Jack Clark, did not hinder the perfecting of his True Body.
With the melding of those rule fragments, every cell in Jack Clark’s body instinctively felt more complete and fulfilled.
It was like a house initially constructed with six pillars and some spatial frameworks, becoming more complete as the rule fragments filled in the gaps.
Including the Seven Great Talent Runes newly integrated into his flesh and the Three Great Divine Powers, the repulsion between the Emperor Dragon Bloodline subsided.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Terrifying Power erupted from Jack Clark’s body, the one hundred eighty-eight-meters-tall True Body shrinking under the pressure of his Divine Soul Intent, eventually returning to a normal human shape of 1.88 meters.
At this point, Jack Clark, aside from maintaining a normal human appearance externally, essentially embraced a three-faced and eight-armed form, completely releasing control of his True Body to allow it to evolve autonomously.
At the same time, a portion of his consciousness descended upon the Destruction Emperor Dragon, suppressing the speed of the Deification Talent’s life Transformation, striving to extend this opportunity as much as possible.
Because the longer the Destruction Emperor Dragon remained in Hibernation, the more fragments Jack Clark could absorb from the mythical world’s World Core.
Of course, this subconscious suppression could only delay things slightly, probably turning three days of hibernation into five.
Even so, it was a huge gain; for Jack Clark, this was a once-in-a-lifetime chance to forge an even more perfect and powerful Innate Demon God True Body.
It would be best if all these talents, Divine Powers, and bloodline forces fully merged, resulting in a few even more powerful Innate Divine Powers.
By then, Jack Clark might not need to make a breakthrough to Heavenly King and could potentially cut down the Demon God at the peak of the Mythical Realm with a reversal attack.
Boom!
With a sonic boom, Jack Clark instantly transformed into a streak of golden radiance that soared to the heavens, vanishing beyond the sea of clouds in the blink of an eye, leaving behind a hundred-kilometer-long trail of golden light in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1333 - 1333 513 Jack Clarks Marriage Alliance Innate
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1333: Chapter 513: Jack Clark’s Marriage Alliance, Innate Divine Holy_2 Chapter 1333: Chapter 513: Jack Clark’s Marriage Alliance, Innate Divine Holy_2 Under the natural evolution of his True Body, Jack Clark no longer needed to control it himself, thus there was no need for him to stay here any longer.
…
On the edge of the sky-spanning Dark Destruction Area, a fleet stretching over two hundred kilometers hovered at ten thousand meters altitude.
In front of the fleet, a pitch-black gap as deep as the Abyss with a diameter of ten thousand meters cut off even time and space, a terrifying phenomenon.
After emerging from the forbidden area, the fleet had flown for two days and covered over five hundred thousand kilometers to arrive at the predetermined route through the space-time rift.
This was a region of destruction formed after the collapse of some unknown world, filled with many dreadful hazardous phenomena.
The rift in front of them held the ability for a leap, allowing the fleet to cover more than three million kilometers in a very short time, jumping to the other side of the destruction area.
This route, including the “shortcut” through the Outer Development Department’s Boundary Forbidden Zone, cost the Federation many “resources” to discover.
On the deck of a golden warship stretching over ten kilometers, the True Martial Heavenly King apologized, “I’m sorry, Lord Bordea, we need to stop here for a moment because of Jack Clark.”
The middle-aged man with three pairs of golden light wings behind him smiled slightly, “True Martial brother, no need for politeness. This stop is due to a breakthrough by the noble Divine Martial Throne.”
“Compared to the minor delay, Mr. Clark’s increase in strength is of course more important.”
Although Lord Bordea was eager for the fleet to reach the Heavenly Feather Clan a day earlier, he would not show his impatience outwardly, and Jack Clark’s enhancement in strength was also a positive for them.
However, at this point, Bordea suddenly asked, “True Martial brother, what do you think of my earlier proposal?”
“Proposal, are you referring to the matter of a marriage alliance between our two tribes?” the True Martial Heavenly King paused.
Bordea nodded, “Yes, the talent of the noble Divine Martial Throne is astounding, and what is even more valuable is his youth, being only seventeen by the standards of life span.”
“Such an achievement, in the tens of thousands of years history of our tribe becoming a Transcendent species, was only reached by four Innate Divine Holy ones, including the Divine King of Light.”
“A few!” The True Martial Heavenly King was visibly moved.
With the talent and the strength, as well as the combat achievements that Jack Clark had demonstrated, he had even surpassed the Supreme Experts who achieved greatness in less than ten years, including the first Councilors.
And within the Heavenly Feather Clan, there were a few who could be compared with such a degree, well-deserving as the powerful species that can withstand the full force attack of three Demon God Empires for hundreds of years.
Bordea smiled, “True Martial brother, don’t be surprised. Talent only represents potential; one must grow to look down upon eternity.”
“Of the four Innate Divine Holy ones in our clan, aside from the Divine King of Light who reached the peak Divine King realm, attained the Primordial Light and the title of Eternal God, the other two perished along the way.”
“As for the last one, she is a bit special; she was born from the lineage of the Divine King of Light, the Heavenly Feather Lineage, and inherited the Origin of Light from the pool of life.”
“Born as an Innate Divine Holy, she mastered the Higher-order Law of Light and continued to cultivate later on, eventually grasping three other kinds of Higher-order Laws related to light in a short span of time and made a breakthrough to the Realm of the Main God.”
“Last year, when she stepped onto the battlefield, she killed three Demon Kings, one Great Demon King, and heavily injured a Peak Awakened Great Demon King, then retreated unscathed from a sneak attack by a Demon God.”
“According to your human’s age division, she is only twenty years old and, with her talent, it won’t be long before she enters the realm of Divine Kings as long as no accidents occur.”
The True Martial Heavenly King became solemn, “Mastering four Higher-order Laws and breaking through the Heavenly King Realm at the age of twenty, such a talent is astonishing, even to me.”
It seemed that this person was like Jack Clark, born with the great luck of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
The True Martial Heavenly King praised, “To confront a Demon God in the early stages of the Heavenly King Realm and emerge unscathed is a cross-realm combat strength that even I am somewhat ashamed to admit I cannot match.”
Even with his command of the Race Background Weapon, only at the pinnacle of the Heavenly King Realm could he confront a mid-period Higher-order Supreme Expert.
Bordea smiled slightly, “That’s why I’m proposing this. With her talent, she is a perfect match for your noble Divine Martial Throne.”
“Though our two tribes are currently allied, I feel we need some deeper cooperation to cultivate more trust between us,” he continued.
“Especially in anticipation of a full-scale pushback from The Purgatory Family that might come next.”
The True Martial Heavenly King certainly understood Bordea’s meaning, and he knew that a marriage between the most monstrous genius of the Human Race and the Innate Divine Holy from the Heavenly Feather Clan would bring great benefits to both tribes.
Such an alliance would tie the futures of the two tribes together, however…
The True Martial Heavenly King gave a wry smile, “Lord Bordea, even if the First Speaker and the others agree, it depends on what Jack Clark thinks.”
Bordea laughed, “I understand, no one can constrain such geniuses, including the one from the Heavenly Feather Lineage.”
“However, as long as there’s no disagreement among our high-level officials and we reach a consensus, we can then look for ways to create some conditions for their meeting, and perhaps…”
“Ahem! Let’s see how it goes when the time comes,” the True Martial Heavenly King coughed dryly, without outright refusal.
Knowing Jack Clark as he did, the True Martial Heavenly King felt the proposition was unlikely to succeed, since each of Jack’s ‘friends’ was exceptionally beautiful.
But so far, his ‘information’ had not revealed Jack getting particularly close to any of them.
Even with Freya Louise, their relationship seemed to be just a bit more than friendship.
The fleet didn’t have to wait long, just a little over four hours, for Jack Clark to catch up, following the temporary Signal Transmitters thrown out by the Expedition Fleet every ten thousand kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1334 - 1334 513 Jack Clarks Marriage Alliance Innate
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1334: Chapter 513: Jack Clark’s Marriage Alliance, Innate Divine Holy_3 Chapter 1334: Chapter 513: Jack Clark’s Marriage Alliance, Innate Divine Holy_3 “`
Boom!
Just as Jack Clark approached within a thousand kilometers of the fleet, the King presiding over the rear aboard Battleship No. 13 felt a powerful oppressive force bearing down on him head-on.
The sky filled with a seven-colored radiance, rapidly closing in on the fleet, and the immense invisible pressure intensified, rolling up a white wave as a raging wind swept through Heaven and Earth.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
Shadows flickered aboard Battleship No. 13, as all the High-Ranking Powerhouses were alerted, their expressions grave as they watched the overwhelming seven-colored glow engulfing the heavens.
One of the late-stage Ninth Heaven experts spoke in a deep voice, “Everyone, be careful!”
“What’s going on, is a strong enemy attacking?”
While the high-level cultivators and ordinary soldiers on the few vessels behind were growing restless due to the increasingly terrifying pressure, a majestic voice emerged.
“There’s no need to panic, the newcomer is not an enemy.”
With that, a figure flashed above the battleship, the Sky-splitting Golden Sword’s silhouette appeared who had been presiding over the 30th Army Group and had also joined this expedition, looking into the distance.
With King Cyril’s reassurance, the cultivators on the battleship relaxed. It was good news that it wasn’t an enemy.
“This Aura feels so familiar.” Standing firm amidst the gale, Damon Lopes’s Daoist robe fluttered with a calamitous sound, and his face showed an expression of sheer annoyance.
Because he knew who had returned.
At that moment, the entire sky’s radiance extended to Battleship No. 13, and within the seven-colored glow, a young man with black hair cascading over his shoulders appeared, a circle of golden halos revolving behind him, radiating an aura of divine nobility.
Looking at Jack Clark, who had returned stepping on a seven-colored cloud, King Cyril was taken aback, “Jack Clark, what’s with the aura around you?”
Jack Clark replied somewhat helplessly, “I apologize, Senior Cyril, I didn’t want to alarm everyone, but my True Body is still in the midst of a breakthrough and can’t contain the aura.”
“No worries, as long as there’s no issue with your cultivation, that’s fine. And you look pretty good now, hahaha…” King Cyril couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
Jack Clark currently resembled a glowing bulb, shining wherever he went, completely contrasting with his usually steady and low-profile nature.
“I’m glad you understand, Senior.” Jack Clark then looked down, his gaze landing on Damon Lopes.
“Mr. Lopes, it’s good that you’re here. I have something for you.” As he spoke, Jack moved as though he was blending into the light, silently appearing before Damon Lopes.
Damon Lopes exclaimed with some admiration, “You’re truly unique, Brother Callum, making such distinctive entrances every time.”
“This is totally accidental.” Jack sighed.
Then Jack Clark took out a Golden Crystal Stone, “Mr. Lopes, this is an Ancient Technique I came across by chance, called the Purple Thunder War Body.”
“Purple Thunder War Body! Could it be…?” Damon Lopes’s eyes widened, followed by a surge of excitement.
Jack Clark smiled and nodded, “Yes, the very one you’re thinking of, inherited from the Thunder Monarch, is the exact opposite of the Thunder Prison True Body you obtained.”
“If you can integrate it with your Thunder Prison True Body upon full mastery and combine it with the Innate Thunderbolt you command, breaking through to grasp the higher-order thunder rule should pose no problem when you ascend to Mythical status.”
Damon Lopes took the Golden Crystal Stone with evident excitement, “Brother Callum, I can’t thank you enough. From now on, I’ll be your loyal wingman, ready to back you up anytime you need to show off.”
“By the way, Brother Callum, I’ve met quite a few beauties on the battleship recently, some of whom are only slightly less impressive than Sister Ilisa. Would you like me to introduce them to you?”
Too excited, Damon Lopes was almost speaking nonsense.
“Cough!… Keep the beauties to yourself for chatting, I’m not interested. As for showing off…better not to bother, I’m leaving now.”
Jack Clark shook his head, too lazy to bother with the guy.
It was indeed pleasant to be celebrated like a sage before others, but it seemed he had never deliberately shown off before. The guy made it sound like he was showing off all the time.
But there was Damon Lopes, who was already a Nine Layers cultivator, and his hobby hadn’t changed over time, even making friends with beautiful female friends aboard the expedition battleship.
Jack Clark wondered if any of the beauties had sent him photos; he might take the opportunity to enjoy them together sometime.
Deep in thought, Jack Clark was bathed in the seven-colored glow, with golden halos revolving behind him, looking like a deity returned from ancient times as he flew over each battleship.
Instantly, exclamations erupted from below, as countless cultivators looked up in excitement.
“It’s the Divine Martial Throne.”
“Such a powerful aura; just flying overhead makes me tremble all over. Truly befitting of our Monarch.”
“Our Monarch looks so handsome.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1335 - 1335 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1335: Chapter 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker, The Tyrant’s Path Chapter 1335: Chapter 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker, The Tyrant’s Path Leaping over three million kilometers, the fleet bypassed the dangerous area where the world was shattered and arrived above the boundless celestial ocean.
The density of the sea water here is very low, only one percent of normal sea water density, and the rules between heaven and earth are somewhat chaotic with a light and floating gravity.
Wooh!
The deep horn of the ship’s whistle echoed through heaven and earth, and a gray whale, over eight hundred meters long, leapt high into the pale blue mist-like ocean before crashing down again with a thunderous boom.
This was a Mythical Giant Beast, but the aura on this Giant Beast was quite peaceful, lacking the brutality common to most Giant Beasts.
Upon seeing battleships each spanning over ten kilometers long, the Mythical giant whale merely glanced before disappearing into the Deep Ocean.
On the left side of the central area of Battleship No. 3, more than a kilometer above the deck, Jack Clark and Jane Aiken stood with their hands behind their backs, casually chatting against the raging wind.
Jack Clark was still surrounded by a seven-color halo, covering the several battleships behind him for tens of kilometers, as if traveling on a Seven-color Cloud Sea.
These seven-colored halos were an extraordinary phenomenon formed by heaven and earth during his Innate Evolution casting of Divine Power, which he indeed had no control over.
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
Suddenly, the sea surface in front blasted open as thousands of Unique Beasts each dozens to hundreds of meters long leapt out of the sea, reaching a height of a kilometer before curving back and plunging into the water, creating a shower of splashes filled with vigorous vitality.
Watching this scene, Jack Clark felt somewhat reflective, “This is how the mythical world should be, completely in line with my original fantasies about the mythical world.”
Last year, when he was a freshman at the Martial Arts School, Jack Clark and his classmates imagined the mythical world to be filled with Giant Beasts and a desolate, wild, and mysterious aura.
Who knew that after making a breakthrough into Eight Layer Heaven, what they saw was a Transcendent Civilization City fused with technology, the Development Legion, and Frontline Battlefields filled with blood and fire.
Far from a relaxed adventure upon entering the mythical world, as he had imagined, it was instead full of urgency and oppression.
With four Divine Swords strapped to her back and her long hair tied into a ponytail, Jane Aiken smiled slightly, “In the beginning, the mythical world was indeed as we imagined.”
“According to the records from the pioneers who ventured into the mythical world fifty years ago, including the First Councilor, they all thought they had discovered the legendary ‘Immortal World’.”
“Over the following years, countries joined forces to sweep the creatures around the three world passageways, Mythical Giant Beasts, exploring dangerous areas, and relics with passion.”
At this point, even Jane Aiken’s eyes revealed a hint of longing.
Unfortunately, they were not born in that turbulent and passionate era but in this one where the new generation of cultivators finds it both a fortunate and unfortunate time of great contention.
If they survive the threat of annihilation from The Purgatory Family in the next few years and withstand the Second Mythical Impact, then the Human Federation will soar to new heights.
But if they fail, apart from a few Top Strong who can take some people and flee deep into the mythical world, the remaining twenty billion would be obliterated.
Even the world of Blue Star will be devoured and explode by the Mythical Impact.
At this, Jack Clark was somewhat puzzled and asked Jane Aiken, “Student Aiken, why did you join this expedition? Logically, shouldn’t you be in closed-door cultivation or gaining experience in the Outer Development Department, striving for a king-level breakthrough?”
With the potential and talent that Jane Aiken displayed on the Void Relic Continent, almost completing the Road of Heavenly Kings, like Jack Clark, she was granted the privileges of a civilization inheritor.
Though her cultivation speed couldn’t match Jack Clark’s terrifying pace of reaching Nine Layers in a year, it was almost certain she too would step into the realm of Heavenly King.
Geniuses of such caliber, under the Federation’s protection plan, are only allowed to venture into dangerous places like the Frontline Battlefield after achieving the Mythical King realm.
Otherwise, once they appear on the battlefield, they would be immediately targeted for assassination by demon kings or even the Great Demon King, just like Jack Clark.
Facing Jack Clark’s question, Jane Aiken fell silent for a moment before softly saying, “I am going to kill someone.”
“To kill someone.”
Jack Clark paused briefly, then reacted with some surprise, “The real Jonathan Walker is on the Heavenly Feather Battlefield. Student Aiken, how do you know?”
Clark was naturally familiar with Jonathan Walker, the top genius from more than a decade ago; he had previously slaughtered one of Walker’s ‘Avatars’ in the Divine Gods Alliance relic.
This stunning genius from a bygone era was also Jane Aiken’s nemesis.
Looking into the hazy Sky Ocean in the distance, Jane Aiken softly said, “On the Heavenly Feather Battlefield, there is a Great Demon King named Cortes Left, commanding all legions of the Demon King Dark Sky Empire.”
“That demon king appeared on the battlefield four years ago (the 12th Year of Blue Star), where he slaughtered seven deities of the Heavenly Feather Clan, along with two Main Gods. Countless elites perished by his hands.”
“Moreover, his combat strength is exaggerated. A year ago on the battlefield, that late-period Great Demon King clashed head-on with a Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan without falling behind.”
“As for how I found out about his whereabouts, someone told me,” Jane Aiken added, pausing for a moment.
As soon as Jane Aiken finished speaking, Jack Clark looked at her curiously, “Student Aiken, you’ve always been very rational in my memory; surely you can’t be this impulsive.”
“That ‘Person’ who may be Jonathan Walker’s Avatar or True Body, has already reached the late period of a Great Demon King with combat strength on par with a Demon God.”
“Such a strong man could stand still and let you strike, but with your current level of cultivation, you couldn’t even breach his defenses, let alone seek revenge.”
Jack Clark’s words were blunt, but they were indeed true. A Demon God Level Aura indicated that this Left Demon’s true ‘cultivation’ was already comparable to the Supreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 1336 - 1336 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1336: Chapter 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker, The Path of the Overlord_2 Chapter 1336: Chapter 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker, The Path of the Overlord_2 Just like him, he appeared to still be in the late Legendary Realm, but whether it was the strength of his True Body or the power of his Divine Powers, he had actually reached a level comparable to the late Heavenly King Realm, and with a Limit Breakthrough, he was even invincible in the Heavenly King Realm.
And once he used Time Reincarnation, even without Summoning the true embodiment of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the unification of the nine seals could even fiercely clash with a Supreme Expert at the early stage of the Demon God.
Jane Aiken said softly, “Don’t worry, I certainly won’t act rashly. This time, my role is just to assist, responsible for luring him out, someone else will take the shot.”
“Luring him out…”
Jack Clark’s gaze shifted slightly, “The other ‘avatars’ of Jonathan Walker?”
“Not bad, Student Clark, you guessed it so quickly.”
Jane Aiken nodded, her gaze somewhat complex, “That’s right, the one who told me this information was another Jonathan Walker, and he will also be the one to take action.”
“Wait a moment, let me sort this out,” Jack Clark rubbed his temples.
Even he was a bit confused this time, feeling that the relationship between these ‘Jonathan Walkers’ and Jane Aiken was quite chaotic.
Before, he had slain a ‘Jonathan Walker’, there was a Jonathan Walker who had joined The Purgatory Family on the Heavenly Feather battlefield, and now another Jonathan Walker had emerged and was plotting to kill the Purgatory Jonathan Walker.
Beyond that, hadn’t Jane Aiken said that her enemy was Jonathan Walker?
She practiced cultivation hard to fulfill her mother’s longtime desire, aiming to one day kill this once first genius of the Human Race, but now she was planning to help Jonathan Walker to kill ‘Jonathan Walker’.
Was Jane Aiken’s plan to Use another powerful force to destroy another weaker force, or to sit on the sidelines and watch the tiger fight, or to wait until both sides were injured before reaping the benefits?
Jack Clark thought for a moment, then realized he couldn’t make sense of it, and finally just asked directly, “Never mind, just explain the whole situation again. There must be more to it since you brought this up out of the blue today.”
“Actually, I only recently found out about these things,” the girl’s expression was somewhat complex as she gazed out at the sea of clouds, her eyes distant.
“Sixteen years ago, Jonathan Walker made a breakthrough into the Legendary Realm and entered the Frontline Battlefield. In that battle, he alone killed three Demon Kings and heavily injured a Great Demon King.”
“And if that Great Demon King hadn’t fled quickly, he was even confident he could have overpowered him at the cost of incurring a heavy injury.”
“That battle made Jonathan Walker famous, and it also put him on the must-kill list of The Purgatory Family. Not long after, during the erupting Civilization War, he was targeted by three Great Demon Kings, with one Demon God taking action.”
“However, because Jonathan Walker had cultivated the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, solidified the Heart’s Eye, and pushed it to the point where it could terrifyingly sense fragments of the future in the unknown, he managed to evade all those ambushes.”
“After that, he distanced himself from the frontline and ventured deeper into the mythical world for experience, preparing to cultivate to the Heavenly King Realm before returning.”
“But while he delved into the mythical world, gaining many opportunities and braving several Alien Ruins, he encountered a very terrifying Demon God.”
“However, the Demon God did not attack him but invited him to join The Purgatory Family and took him for a tour of The Purgatory Family, showing him some information that made him despair.”
“Then came the betrayal.”
Jane Aiken continued calmly, “But he didn’t completely betray the Human Race. Instead, he used a Secret Skill gained from the relics, combined with his talent, and split himself in three with a single cut.”
“You have already slain his Sacred Body, and the remaining two are the human and Demon Bodies, both above the Heavenly King Realm.”
“Due to the Secret Skill, when you killed that Sacred Body, its strength was halved and returned to the human and Demon Bodies, both of whom gained a significant increase in strength.”
“If the Demon Body is slain next, the remaining Jonathan Walker will achieve a triple unification, making a breakthrough to Supreme strength in one fell swoop.”
Jack Clark said thoughtfully, “So, Student Aiken, what you’re saying is that your mother’s situation and the deaths of your grandfather and those people actually had nothing to do with Jonathan Walker, and does the Human Race Upper Echelon know about this?”
Jane Aiken shook her head, “No, my mother’s injury and the death of my grandfather were indeed caused by the demonized Jonathan Walker. As for whether the Federal Top Level knows about it, I’m not sure.”
“Since your mother and your elders died because of Jonathan Walker, you still want to help him?”
Jane Aiken fell silent for a moment before speaking softly, “Because the dead cannot be brought back to life, and the living must strive to survive. Moreover, everything that happened back then was done by the demonized Left Demon, who no longer recognized any kin.”
“At the time those things happened, the human Jonathan Walker was in a state of heavy injury, undergoing Closed-door Cultivation in some corner of the mythical world, never expecting things to turn out this way.”
“And what my mother probably desired was also for me to slay that Demon Body.”
“If I can kill the Left Demon and allow Jonathan Walker to become whole again, making a breakthrough to Supreme strength, the Human Federation will gain a Top-tier combat force, so there’s no reason for me to refuse, both emotionally and rationally.”
“Moreover, with the fusion of half of the Sacred Body’s Origin, the Left Demon’s cultivation might have already broken through the peak of the Great Demon King.”
“If we don’t take the opportunity to kill the Left Demon before he breaks through to a Demon God, once he achieves that breakthrough, his combat strength will become so formidable that even the First Councilor would be unable to suppress him.”
“At that point, it will be him who turns around to hunt down Jonathan Walker and unify the three parts. Then his strength will become unimaginably terrifying, and he might even have the chance to step into the Emperor Realm.”
“By then, he will become the greatest enemy of the Human Federation.”
Looking at the girl in front of him with a calm expression, Jack Clark slowly said, “So this is the real reason why you believe in Jonathan Walker and help him hunt down the Left Demon.”
Jane Aiken wasn’t a fool who believed whatever others said, even if that person was her ‘father’.

chapters.title: Chapter 1337 - 1337 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1337: Chapter 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker, The Path of the Overlord_3 Chapter 1337: Chapter 514 Demonization Jonathan Walker, The Path of the Overlord_3 About Jonathan Walker’s identity, Jane Aiken must have already guessed it, but the real reason she chose to let go of “hatred” was actually to add another Supreme to the Human Race.
The known top fighters of the Human Race currently include the Three Great Speakers and the True Martial Heavenly King, totaling four Demon God Level combatants, barely enough to contend with the two Great Purgatory Empires.
If Jonathan Walker could kill that Left Demon this time and return to full strength to breakthrough to Supreme, the balance of the top combatants of the Human Race would be broken.
Moreover, Jonathan Walker’s true goal is not to be Supreme, but above that, a Civilization Emperor. Otherwise, with his talent, even without splitting into three, he might have made the breakthrough to Supreme in just over a decade.
Therefore, Jack Clark only believed half of what Jonathan Walker told Jane Aiken.
The incident from those years was certainly not that simple; in the three Avatars generated from Jonathan Walker’s split, Jack Clark saw the power of the Divine Gods Alliance on the Holy Avatar.
The Divine Gods Alliance had a hand in Jonathan Walker’s betrayal back then, and the Three Great Speakers must also know a lot about it.
At the same time, Jack Clark also had a guess about Jane Aiken’s intention and slowly said, “You want me to help, to help Jonathan Walker kill the Left Demon, right?”
Jane Aiken calmly nodded, “Yes, he said he isn’t sure about killing the Left Demon, but with your help, the likelihood of killing the opponent would be sixty percent.”
Looking at the girl in front of him, calm and only seventeen years old, Jack Clark felt a bit emotional and then agreed straight away, “Alright, call me when it’s time to make a move.”
For the sake of the Human Race, Jane Aiken could even set aside her own hatred; he naturally had no reason to refuse.
Although Jane Aiken had once said that it was only on her mother’s deathbed that she was told those things, so she didn’t have much hatred for the person who caused her mother’s death.
But how could she possibly have no hatred in her heart, she simply didn’t want to show it.
After all, if not for Jonathan Walker, the mother who raised her wouldn’t have died before reaching forty. If it were Jack Clark, he’d seek revenge regardless of the consequences, and he wouldn’t stop until the enemy was personally dispatched.
Even all associated parties would have to be killed, he wouldn’t rest until the different races were wiped out.
Jack Clark’s straightforward agreement surprised Jane Aiken, who then showed gratitude in her eyes, “Thank you.”
“No need to be polite, that guy is indeed a threat to the Human Race. Whether from a friend’s standpoint or as a Human King, I have no reason to refuse,” Jack Clark said, then shifted the topic, “By the way, do the True Martial Heavenly King and the others know about this?”
“They don’t.”
“I understand,” Jack Clark nodded.
After finishing the conversation with Jane Aiken about Jonathan Walker, the two chatted for a while longer, then Jack Clark returned to the No.1 Battleship.
Although his Demon God’s Body was in a state of Innate Evolution and did not require his control, and each talent, divine power, and rule was in a state of fusion, which meant he could not cultivate, this did not mean he had nothing to do.
This form of Innate Evolution was also an opportunity for him. Paying close attention to the changes at every moment might give him a glimpse into Creation.
The mythical world is vast and boundless, with numerous powerful civilizations and countless living beings.
Given the growth and cultivation speed of Jack Clark and the Giant Beast Body, just one more year would be sufficient for him to pulverize anything, whether it be Demon Gods or Ancestors; he alone could annihilate everything.
Therefore, his gaze had long transcended to the future, not missing any chance to enhance his strength.
While Jack Clark contemplated the changes in his God Demon Body and occasionally chatted with Freya Louise after she finished cultivating, a few days blinked by, and the Expedition Fleet drew ever closer to the Heavenly Feather battlefield.
……
Meanwhile, at Blue Star, in Mist River City, at the Central City Martial Arts Convention competition site.
At this moment, the area around the square was packed with people, with over a hundred thousand excitedly watching the screens all around, focusing on the host with the microphone on the big screen.
“Welcome everyone to the Federation’s first national Martial Arts, the Mist River City city level selection competition.”
“To respond to the Federation’s call, most Second Grade and Third Grade students from our city’s five Martial Arts Schools have signed up, with the final count of three hundred meeting the city level competition requirements.”
“Today is the Second Grade students’ competition, with a total of ten Martial Arts Arenas. To ensure fairness and save time, all competitors must undergo ten rounds of fighting.”
“Each fight won gives one point, and one point is deducted for a loss. After ten rounds, the ranking is based on points scored, with the top ten securing the qualification to participate in the provincial competition.”
“The drawing of numbers starts now, freshmen whose names appear on the big screen, please step onto the stage, No.1 arena, Buena Raabe versus Winter, No.2 arena, Glenn Clark versus Rex…”
When Glenn Clark’s name was called, at the edge of the arena, a burly youth was surrounded by three excited girls, “Jim, you’re in the No.2 arena.”
“Go Jim, you’ll definitely win.”
“Jim, be careful out there.”
[A few hundred words conclude the story, please wait ten minutes.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1338 - 1338 515 Devouring Mountain Ranges The True
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1338: Chapter 515 Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction Chapter 1338: Chapter 515 Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction Chaotic Turbulent Region.
The perilous expanse, once shrouded in billowing yellow sand, disappeared, replaced by golden flames burning in the firmament, from which cascading blue-violet thunder pillars pierced heaven and earth, radiating dazzling radiance.
In addition, between heaven and earth, bands of black and red lightning danced, purple light diffused, emitting an aura of space corrosion and death.
With the tenth talent undergoing Deification and transforming into a Higher-order Law, the hibernating Destruction Emperor Dragon’s power became unrestrained within its body, rampaging without inhibition, turning thousands of kilometers into a Death Forbidden Area.
Apart from the subdued Vajra Law, Chaotic Dark Power, Origin of Life, and Law of Speed, five types of Destructive Type Higher-order Law powers roared, threatening to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Occasionally, a bolt of black lightning would cleave the firmament and even the faintly destructive aura it released would make the Giant Three-headed Beast at heart tremble, an icy chill surging up its tail.
Usually, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon concealed its power, they felt nothing, roaring and spiraling playfully around it.
But now, as these forces completely spiraled out of control, the Giant Silver Dragon realized that at the Mid-Mythical Stage, they seemed incapable of withstanding even a casual bolt of lightning leaping from the Emperor Dragon’s body.
Roar! The Thunderflame grows ever more intense, it’s getting so bright, I fear I can hardly see!
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, with its body length of over nine hundred meters, circled in the air, spreading its dark golden double wings wide like an Aerospace Aircraft Carrier exuding oppression—only, its eyes betrayed a touch of dejection.
Reflecting back on a year ago, when it first encountered the Thunderflame Behemoth at sea, the latter was merely over ten meters long and, despite its fierce appearance, was significantly smaller than its own massive form.
And then began a magical journey.
Since meeting the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Single-horned Spawn Roc lived as if on a miraculous path, engaging in battle, Devouring various resources, and growing wildly.
In merely a year, it evolved to the Legendary Realm—a feat it once dared not even dream of.
But compared to the increasingly exaggerated and still rapidly growing Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc felt a burgeoning sense of powerlessness.
As the gap between them widened, the Single-horned Spawn Roc feared it might not be long before it could no longer see the Emperor Dragon’s tail and keep up with it.
“Roar! Tim, becoming more powerful is a good thing, isn’t it?” The Silver Giant Dragon flew excitedly, feeling thrilled by the increasingly horrific aura from deep within the Death zone, and its tail went limp with excitement.
Hearing this, the gold and blue Giant Beast sighed in the air, “Scythia, you really are still so dumb.”
The Silver Giant Dragon immediately grew upset, “Roar! Curse you, Telsafi, for calling the Great Scythia stupid. Was there something wrong with what I just said?”
The Gold and Blue Giant Dragon elegantly spread its wings, “Of course, there’s a problem; but you’re too dumb to understand, so the Great Telsafi can’t be bothered to explain.”
“Roar! Dammit, Telsafi, it’s your words that are nonsense,” the Silver Giant Dragon retorted, unconvinced.
But the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon no longer paid it any mind; speaking to such a dimwit was a complete waste of breath, especially since it failed to perceive the worry in the words of the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
With the terrifying growth rate of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, not just the Single-horned Spawn Roc, but in no time, many might step into the Ancient Realm or even beyond.
When that time came, the difference would become so vast that even they would be left behind, an unavoidable conclusion.
It was perhaps better that Scythia couldn’t conceive of this fact, preventing it from feeling downhearted. Living carefreely like a fool might be the happier choice.
Roar!
Suddenly, a fierce and majestic roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, and with it, a terrifying aura erupted. In that instant, the Three-headed Giant Beast felt as if the world shook.
Above the firmament, a sea of golden flames boiled, and countless flames descended like meteors. Amidst pillars of lightning and bolts of electricity, a formidable Giant Beast slowly emerged.
With every step of its 3,300-meter long body, predominantly black and red with patches of dark golden patterns, the Void trembled, and earth and mountains quaked.
Without drawing near, the Three-headed Giant Beast instinctively fell to the ground, bowing its head by instinct.
In the presence of this horrific creature, which seemed like the Lord of the World, no living being was worthy of the skies; its existence was to be looked up to by all life, a reverence etched deep into their genes.
But no sooner had it bowed its head, the Silver Giant Dragon realized and roared excitedly, “Roar! Tim, how do you feel now? Can we continue our rampage?”
The now even more fearsome Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly opened its mouth, emitting a deep hum of a growl, “I feel good now, just a bit hungry.”
“Let’s go find something ‘to eat’.”
With a low growl, the power-concealing Destruction Emperor Dragon took a step, causing a tumultuous wave of energy with every movement, and ripples spread across the Void as if space itself couldn’t bear its existence.
As Jack Clark had predicted, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slept for five days to complete the transmutation of its Talent and Law.
This augmentation of its Talent met his expectations and even exceeded them. With the combination of the Dark Star Rune, the Destruction Emperor Dragon gained the ability to devour heavy matter and enhance its Giant Beast Body.
This heavy matter includes Heavy Metal Elements and broadly refers to all substances containing Heaviness special abilities, including minerals, rule-based materials, and Law materials.
Including the Titan and Ancient Beast skeletons it once neglected to devour, these too could be transformed into heavy matter for absorption and conversion by the Giant Beast Body.
This ability compensates for the drawback that its Evolution Talent could only devour the flesh and blood of Giant Beasts and Heaven and Earth Treasurer. Now it would accumulate Evolution value even faster.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1339: Chapter 515 Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction_2 Chapter 1339: Chapter 515 Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction_2 Including growth speed.
The Four Great Beasts moved at a seemingly slow but astonishingly fast speed, and in just a moment they flew out over a thousand kilometers, then the Destruction Emperor Dragon came to a halt.
In front of the Four Great Beasts, a rare plain appeared where lush grass and trees stood over ten meters tall, and a group of herbivorous Giant Beasts, each a hundred meters long, grazed leisurely, full of vitality.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc flew in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, somewhat puzzled.
Roar! Thunderflame, I don’t sense anything good here.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, “No problem, I’ll eat something first,” and its gaze fell on the mountain ranges in the middle of the plain that stretched over a thousand kilometers, with the highest peaks reaching over seven thousand meters.
In the talent ability perception of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, there was a metal vein under this mountain range, the rich heavy matter element radiating an urge that it wanted to devour.
It was very hungry, very hungry.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, its gaping maw wide open, dazzling blue-purple light beaming in front of its mouth, and the scales on its back lit up one by one.
Hum!
In front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaping maw, a Thunder Ring gathered, forming an energy focal point, and a blue-purple Light Beam several dozen meters thick descended from the sky, sweeping across Heaven and Earth like a laser.
Boom Boom Boom! The Light Beam, fused with Thunder and the Corrosion Law, intrinsic with the propensity to violently shatter, caused the mountain peaks it passed over to collapse, stirring up dazzling Firelight and thunderous roaring that shook the Earth.
In just a moment, the mountain ranges that stretched over four thousand kilometers were shattered by a mere Breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and amidst the resulting smoke and dust, a dark red metal vein emerged.
The entire mountain range stretched for thousands of kilometers, rose over a thousand meters above the Earth, with its widest point extending over twenty kilometers, and its narrowest just a few kilometers, resembling an irregular, twisted spine.
Or you could say that this mountain range was the petrified evolution of an unknown ancient beast that fell in ancient times, its bodily rules and laws dissipated.
Without waiting for the Three-headed Giant Beast to ask, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly approached the dark red vein after shattering the mountain range—it radiated endless golden light.
Boom!
The golden light, like a black solar eclipse, passed over the metal veins, causing them to crumble and devour everything in its path, eventually engulfing the entire mountain range.
In just the blink of an eye, a golden Great Sun with a diameter of a thousand kilometers appeared above the Earth, its invisible heavy Aura distorting space and light, terrifying beyond measure.
“Roar! This is Tim Abbott’s new ability, but what use is it?”
Above the high altitude of a hundred kilometers, the Silver Giant Dragon looked somewhat bewildered at the dark golden star that spanned the Earth below, feeling only a heavy, twisting sensation that seemed to tear apart, nothing particularly powerful.
The Golden-Blue Giant Dragon growled slowly, “This new talent ability of his, I think, is not meant for attack.”
Sensing the heavy Aura invisibly radiating from below the Dark Sun, the Single-horned Spawn Roc also thoughtfully crooned, “This ability of Thunderflame seems somewhat similar to my Devouring Heaven and Earth.”
Within the Dark Sun of golden light, countless metal and heavy matter decomposed, transforming into innumerable dark red specks that continuously merged into the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, being absorbed by it.
As these heavy matters merged and were absorbed, transmuting into another substance and integrating with muscles, bones, and cells, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became increasingly ‘heavier’.
Meanwhile, with the endless ‘energy’ being devoured, the vast Life Origin that had been spent during the initial condensation of Essence Blood within the Destruction Emperor Dragon rapidly regenerated.
However, heavy metal material is not Giant Beast flesh and blood, and the ‘biological energy’ converted was not much; most of the material merged with the Giant Beast Body.
Half an hour later, the golden Great Sun slowly vanished to reveal a Black-red Colossal Beast that had grown several meters in length, its body swelling, with Full-body Scales Armor that looked even thicker.
Simultaneously, the thousand-kilometer-long dark red mountain ranges beneath it had disappeared, turning into a grayish substance, as if rocks had weathered for thousands of years, permeated with tiny holes.
What truly frightened the Three-headed Giant Beast was the invisible heavy oscillations emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which unintentionally distorted the surrounding space and light, creating a gravitational vortex.
Gurgle! The sight made the Single-horned Spawn Roc swallow its saliva reflexively, feeling a deep-rooted fear.
Since waking up this time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed even more terrifying and fearsome to it. The mighty Giant Beast Body standing there gave off the impression it could crush Heaven and Earth itself.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, you’re so awesome, you actually devoured such a huge mountain range.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared with joy and excitement as it pounced down toward the Black-red Colossal Beast below, startling the Destruction Emperor Dragon into quickly retracting the invisible Dark Star force field around it.
Thump! The Silver Giant Dragon, nearly nine hundred meters long, landed on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which was over three thousand meters long with a wingspan of over five thousand meters, roaring excitedly.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, charge! The Great Sethia is going to conquer the Chaotic Turbulent Region, let blood flow like rivers.”
Now that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had become even more formidable, the Silver Giant Dragon saw a real chance to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region, and it was overjoyed.
As for fear… what was that?
In that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon was like a little girl climbing onto an adult’s back, shouting ‘Daddy, run faster!’ The sight made the corner of the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon’s eye twitch.
Having just eaten a metal mountain range and still feeling hungry, the Destruction Emperor Dragon licked its lips and looked up to the Single-horned Spawn Roc in the sky, letting out a low growl.
“Joe, lead the way. We’ll go wherever the Heavenly Energy is the strongest. It’s best to find an Ancient Beast.”
With the talent ability to devour and transform heavy matter, the next step was to devour everything crazily, rapidly growing to the late period of Titan, the peak, or even the level of the Ancient.
