﻿Chapter 1340: Chapter 515: Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction_3 Chapter 1340: Chapter 515: Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction_3 Roar!! No problem, watch me.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc’s robust horn emitted Blue Radiance, flashing like a signal tower, sending out radar-like waves to sense the chaotic magnetic field of Heaven and Earth around it.
Roar!! I feel like there’s something good over there, I “saw” a huge ball of light.
“Roar! Charge.”
Amidst the excited roar of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Black-red Colossal Beast carrying it suddenly moved, winding through Heaven and Earth like a mountain range, its momentum terrifying.
In just a moment, the vegetation disappeared before them, and a vast Icebound Mountain Range loomed ahead of the several Giant Beasts, a terrifying white chill pervading the sky and freezing over tens of thousands of kilometers.
Roar!
The Black-red Colossal Beast let out a savage roar, and with a thunderous crash, it knocked down a ten-thousand-meter-high Ice Layer mountain peak from the sky. Upon landing, ice shattered within a hundred-kilometer radius, and the Earth soared into the air.
Bang, bang, bang!!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon rampaged, pulverizing mountain peaks and even Icebound Mountain Ranges before it, carving out a pathway a hundred kilometers wide and over twenty thousand kilometers long in this dangerous forbidden area where even Mythical Giant Beasts risked being frozen.
The Golden Blue Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc followed behind, and after passing through the frozen forbidden land, they saw a vast Void Rift before them.
Within that limitless void, violent energies roared, emitting multicolored light like the cosmic dust convergence during a universe’s great explosion.
At the center of the splendorous flowing lights, cloud-like energy materials converged to form a Star Ring around a massive gray sphere of light, magnificent and spectacular.
This scene caused the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden Blue Giant Dragon to light up. “Roar! Tim Abott, it’s so beautiful here.”
The Single-horned Spawn Roc also called out excitedly, Roar!! Thunder Dragon, Thunder Dragon, I can feel it, inside that sphere of light, there’s something good in there.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc had initially just chosen this direction, but now, nearing a thousand kilometers, its horn suddenly had a strong reaction, detecting something good.
Looking at the rotating gray light sphere amidst the Void Ocean, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils held an indifferent gaze as he growled lowly, “Wait here, do not approach.”
Boom! As the Black-red Colossal Beast moved, the Void trembled, its massive body stepping towards the gray sphere of light.
But as the Destruction Emperor Dragon drew near, the gray light sphere shook instantly, and a terrible Will burst forth, forming a gigantic head outside the sphere.
The Beast head had a diameter tens of thousands of meters wide, resembling a White Tiger with Golden Scale Armor covering its body. Looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast shaking the Void as it approached, it let out a savage roar.
“Roar! Stranger beast, get out of this Void Ocean, this is my Territory.”
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed to have only mid-period Titan growth Aura, that physique surpassing the limits of a Titan, along with the invisible dangerous aura it gave off, instinctively made the Ancient Beast somewhat wary.
But concern was concern, and a mere Titan Beast still wasn’t significant in its eyes. Should the other dare to get any closer, it wouldn’t mind tearing this upstart apart.
To the Giant Beasts that dwelled in the Chaotic Turbulent Region, these bubble-like small worlds were very important.
Inside these small worlds, the Heavenly Energy was calm, and the rules were stable, crucial for their growth.
Boom! In response to the Giant Beast’s warning, what greeted it was a dazzling pillar of golden blue light that pierced through the Void, erasing everything in its path.
Instantly, violent energy exploded like the detonation of a star, and the breath fused with three Higher-order Laws collapsed the projection of the Ancient Beast, shaking the gray sphere of light.
Roar! I’m going to tear you apart. An even more savage roar instantly reverberated through the Void.
In the Wilderness World covered in jungles, an Ancient Beast four thousand meters long, covered in white and gold scale armor resembling a White Tiger but with six tails, raised its head in an angry roar.
Under its terrifying ancients’ Presence, countless Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts inhabiting the whole world shuddered in fear, not daring to stir.
The Six-tailed White Tiger was extremely outraged, as it hadn’t expected the Titan Giant Beast to blatantly ignore its warning, and worse, even initiate a provocation. It was courting death.
But before the Giant Beast could charge out of the small world, the entire world began to shake violently.
Boom!
The Firmament shattered, forming a black crack hundreds of thousands of meters long. Deep within the crack, Crimson light spread out, half of the sky painted deep red, emitting an ominous aura that terrified all life.
Including the Ancient Beast that watched the sky as if facing a formidable enemy.
Amidst the astonished gazes of countless Giant Beasts, a Deep red Destruction Beast over nine thousand meters long slowly emerged from the sky bathed in red light.
In an instant, a wildly brutal and violent aura spread throughout Heaven and Earth as if a Primordial Wilderness terror had descended, devouring the world with a mere glance.
In its Deep Red Form, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became even more terrifying, the power released from its body reaching unprecedented extremes.
Simply standing atop the Firmament, the invisible heavy force it radiated destabilized the entire world, causing the sky to shake, the Earth to split, and everything to distort.
Around it, space shattered and twisted, forming a Black Hole spanning several hundred kilometers, the entire world quaking as if it could no longer bear the strain.
Compared to the Black Mountain World where the Kirin Beast dwelled, this small world, with just over twenty thousand kilometers of land and the Void enveloping its edges, was quite small.
Roar! On the Earth below, the Six-tailed Giant Tiger unleashed a roar, initiating the attack. Its body gleamed with eye-catching Platinum Radiance that filled half the world.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1341: Chapter 515: Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction_4 Chapter 1341: Chapter 515: Devouring Mountain Ranges, The True Beast of World Destruction_4 “`
In an instant, streams of platinum light burst forth from beneath the Earth, resembling auroras shooting up from the ground and emitting an incredibly sharp Aura.
Empowered by the strong Rule strength, the space over half the world was torn apart by sword lights of tens of thousands of meters in length, creating black cracks that spread towards the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!
Each strike, powerful enough to heavily injure a Titan, approached the vicinity of the Deep Red Giant Beast only to be shredded and exploded by an invisible force field.
Roar!
A brutal roar echoed between heaven and earth as the Void above the head of the Deep Red Giant Beast collapsed, and a gigantic claw descended from above, darkening the sky and earth, leaving only the blinding platinum light of the gigantic claw.
Boom! The impact of this strike from the Six-tailed Giant Tiger was terrifying; the whole world shook under it, collapsing the Void and suppressing the Heavenly Earth Law.
Roar! At that moment, the Deep Red Destruction Beast roared, and its right claw, wrapped in blood-red lightning, reached out, shattering the platinum tiger claw with one blow.
At the same time, the Deep Red Giant Beast stomped and instantly turned into a streak of blood-red lightning that zigzagged between heaven and earth, appearing more than ten thousand kilometers away.
There, half of the Six-tailed Giant Tiger’s body had already plunged into a crack, attempting to escape, while the attack just now was merely a feint.
Facing the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Deep Red Form and sensing the apocalyptic Terrifying Aura, the ancient beast had the urge to flee immediately.
Boom!
The Six-tailed Giant Tiger caught by the Deep Red Giant Beast let out a mournful cry, followed by a golden red light descending from the sky and slamming into the Earth with a loud noise.
In an instant, the whole world shook, thousands of kilometers of land shattered and exploded, and countless fragments of rock and magma burst into the sky, with the scorching shockwave sweeping across the surface.
Beneath the world-shattering impact, countless trees ignited, rivers evaporated, and numerous ordinary Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts let out cries of despair, being burned to cinders and blasted away without time to react.
This scene resembled the Blue Star millions of years ago when a comet fell from the sky, creating shockwaves that annihilated countless dinosaurs.
Roar! Another bellow of the Giant Beast emanated from the center of the explosion.
Under the claw of the much larger and more ferocious Deep Red Giant Beast, the four-thousand-meter-long Platinum Giant Tiger was pressed into the Earth with its lower half pinned down, immobilized.
As for its six tails, each a kilometer long, they had been severed by the Tail Blade wrapped in blood-colored Destructive Lightning and were now suppressed and entwined in the air with blood lightning.
Roar! The Deep Red Giant Beast holding the Platinum Giant Tiger roared, and a dazzling red light gathered in its mouth, emitting a Destructive Aura that frightened the Platinum Giant Tiger.
Roar! No!
Under the intense Death Aura, the Rule Origin burst from within the Six-tailed Giant Tiger, shining like a supernova with dazzling platinum light.
Boom, boom, boom! Under the unparalleled sharpness of the platinum Rule light, space was annihilated, time stood still, and even the World Crystal Wall was pierced one by one.
But when these Rule lights fell on the Deep Red Giant Beast, they only produced thunderous explosions and halos, unable to shake the thick Red Scale Armor in the slightest.
Including the Platinum Giant Tiger, when erupting with the Rule Origin, its Giant Beast Body released tens of times more strength but still could not budge the red double claws.
It was as if what was pressing down on it was not a Titan Giant Beast, but an incredibly heavy celestial planet.
This scene only drove the Six-tailed Giant Tiger further into despair, staring at the Deep Red Giant Beast so close by, frantically gathering all its strength in its mouth and radiating platinum light.
Boom! Just then, from the mouth of the Deep Red Giant Beast, a breath glowing with the ultimate red light burst out, engulfing the Six-tailed Giant Tiger like a torrent that destroys everything.
Roar, roar, roar!
Under the scouring of the Deep Red Destructive Breath, which was the integration of the ten great Higher-order Laws, the white platinum tiger let out cries of despair as its Soul Will was gradually worn away.
The terrible Breath, after drowning the Platinum Giant Tiger, turned into a vast red flood that pierced through the Earth, obliterating all matter, space, and Laws along its path with the Destructive Breath.
Boom!
After drilling a tunnel over a thousand kilometers deep, the terrible Breath pierced through the World Crystal Wall, causing the whole world to shake even more violently and become increasingly unstable.
At the same time, under the Deep Red Form, the power of the Deep Red World brought forth by the Destruction Emperor Dragon spread around, turning into invisible red light that covered the sky, infesting it.
Since there was no resisting power, and with the World Crystal Wall pierced by the Breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the basis of the world began to collapse, and soon the red light engulfed the entire world.
Crackle Crackle! The sky shattered like a mirror, fracturing into cracks that spanned hundreds to thousands of kilometers, and immediately more red light encroached.
Instantly, the shaking of this world intensified, the land sank, mountain peaks collapsed, and the red light also seeped into the deep chasms that had opened up.
As the world destroyed itself, a Great Destruction Aura enveloped everything.
Roar!
In the epicenter of the collapsing world, the over five-thousand-meter-tall Deep Red Giant Beast roared up to the sky, its claws holding the torn-apart corpse of the Giant Tiger, now devoid of the breath of life.
After completing the Limit Enhancement, the forming power of the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Deep Red Form is unspeakably terrifying.
In the face of it, unleashing its full strength, the Ancient Beast, equivalent to a Purgatory Demon God, had no power to resist and was crushed to death in a short time.
At this moment, surrounded by the collapse of the world, the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was incomparably horrifying.
[There are still over a thousand words to conclude, the content involves the protagonist’s new Demon God Form; please wait a moment, as today’s update will indeed be eight thousand words.]
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1342 - 1342 516 The Divine King is Severely Injured
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1342: Chapter 516: The Divine King is Severely Injured, Situation Worsens Chapter 1342: Chapter 516: The Divine King is Severely Injured, Situation Worsens [Some content on the attribute page is free and will not be counted in the charged word count]
Among the strong men watching from a distance, the visions surrounding Jack Clark became more and more magnificent, with a Great Sun spanning the sky, Thunder like a prison, and eventually, even the Void, devouring everything, descended.
In the dark Void that enveloped heaven and earth, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils phantom slowly emerged.
Under the gaze of that terrifying vision, everyone felt a chill rising from their spine, as if being stared at by the Death Ancient God.
Even the True Martial Heavenly King at the peak of the Heavenly King realm and Bordea, the Main God of the Heavenly Feather Clan, felt a strong sense of danger.
The eyes were powerful, so powerful that they could pose a threat even to them.
Among the Heavenly Feather Clan, a strong man in the Legendary Realm showed astonishment on his face, “The foundation of this Human Expert is too profound, it’s hard to imagine how he accumulated it.”
The phenomena appearing between heaven and earth during the breakthrough reflect the strong powers they command, responding to the Heavenly Earth Law during the breakthrough.
At this moment, the various visions surrounding Jack Clark represented a terrifying power comparable to Higher-order Law, which was the reason for the shock of those Heavenly Feather Clan Experts.
But at that moment, the vision that enveloped hundreds of kilometers of heaven and earth suddenly collapsed, rushing towards the majestic Eight-armed Demon God at the center.
The ten-kilometer diameter of the Golden-White Great Sun collapsed, compressing the flames and turning into a Golden-White Light sphere in the palm of a hand, slowly emanating a terrifying high temperature that could burn the skies and boil the sea.
In addition, the thunderous Thunder Pool contracted, the Thunder Light converged, forming a purple Thunder Light War spear hundreds of meters long, grasped by an arm.
The Golden Door also shrank continuously, then split into nine, as if existing in nine different space-times overlapped together, upheld by one of the Demon God’s arms.
The nine black-red Dragon shadows then issued roars, turning into nine Dragon patterned chains wrapping around the Golden Door.
Moreover, apart from the strongest pair of arms at the front, the remaining three also respectively held a black chain probing into the Void, a rotating Grey Roulette, and a ten-meter-tall pitch-black door.
At the same time, the central face remained indifferent, with a silver vertical pupil in the center of the forehead and silvery wing-like divine patterns on the sides, exuding majesty and sanctity.
The left face continued to be covered with red fine scales, a blood-red Hell’s Eye in the center of the forehead, filled with endless slaughter, as countless Giant Beasts and monsters wailed and struggled within it.
And the right face with both eyes closed, a pitch-black Hollow pupil stood in the center of the forehead, the closed eyes gave an indescribable terror, as if opening them would Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Only at this moment did the True Demon God Body fully materialize.
Boom!
An aura that shook heaven and earth erupted from Jack Clark, with three faces and eight arms, his black and white hair wildly dancing, like a supreme deity arriving, haloed by the Golden Divine Wheel.
Under his overwhelming Divine Might, all matter and even space around him twisted, collapsed, and exploded, forming layer upon layer of transparent shockwaves cascading in all directions.
Instantly, everyone outside the battleships changed their expression.
“Be careful, it’s a spatial tide.”
“Immediately turn the battleship energy shield power to its maximum…”
This tide formed by the collapse and explosive compression of space was extremely terrifying, even more destructive than the space debris storms in the Space Interlayer, requiring even king-level individuals to be cautious.
“Everyone, no need to panic.”
As the high-level cultivators watching began to panic and wanted to retreat, the True Martial Heavenly King spoke indifferently from above, and instantly, a shadow of the True Martial Stone Tablet sprawled in the middle.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The layered transparent shockwaves struck the projection of the True Martial Stone Tablet, exploding with earth-shattering roars but failed to shake the projection even slightly.
Gulp!!
Gabriella swallowed and said in shock, “Jack’s… his breakthrough this time is too exaggerated, the mere aura he’s exuding is enough to heavily injure ordinary king-level beings.”
Initially, Gabriella unconsciously wanted to call him junior, but when she spoke, she changed to a respectful address for the throne.
However, at this moment, nobody minded her, as everyone anxiously looked into the distance, where Jack Clark appeared contemplative, his gaze looking forward as if pondering something.
Regardless of the curiosity of those onlookers, they would never guess that Jack Clark was observing his own “data.”
On the transparent page in front of him, as both his main body and Giant Beast Body underwent transformation and breakthrough, every piece of data underwent earth-shattering changes.
Realm: Mythical King [Peak]
Heavenly Dragon Physique: 70→ 92 (10 points from the Emperor Dragon Body’s feedback enhancement, 12 points from the leap of the Demon God’s Body)
Heavenly Dragon Strength: 74→ 97
Heavenly Dragon Agility: 41→ 65
Divine Soul.Spirit: 46→ 71
Battle Demon God. Eight-armed True Body: Fusing all power, absorbing a large number of Rule Fragments to remake the Innate Demon God’s Body.
Open Heaven Divinity: Halberd, when wielding the Eight Desolate War Halberd, every attack will gain sharp, tearing, and severing properties, Annihilation in front of everything.
Top-tier Divine Power: Vacuum Destruction, the power Divine Vacuum Supreme combined with the talent Broken Star remade, containing fierce and devastating properties.
In front of the power of Vacuum Destruction, everything will be blown apart by you.
Top-tier Divine Power: Absolute Force Field, the defensive Divine Absolute Barrier merged with the talent Mysterious Light remade, integrates with the biological magnetic field to form a defensive force field that interferes with the surrounding space-time.
With the Absolute Force Field enveloping you, you will ignore all physical, energetic, and illusory attacks unless the attack received exceeds ten times the limit that your physical body can bear.
