chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1343: Chapter 516: The Divine King Suffers Heavy Injury, Situation Worsens_2 Chapter 1343: Chapter 516: The Divine King Suffers Heavy Injury, Situation Worsens_2 “`
Senior Divine Power: Cross-World Divine Walk, a movement and teleportation ability; vastly enhanced upon rebuilding the Demon God’s Body with the absorption of some fragments of Rules.
Underneath this Divine Power, one can instantly traverse a thousand miles, ignoring barriers such as enchantments, prohibitions, and the Barrier Walls of small worlds.
Common Divine Power: Hidden Deity’s Eye, Peeping Void Eye.
Eight-armed Demon God: Upon entering the True Demon God form, all strength and divine power are unleashed, with the Lord of Purgatory controlling Hell, and the Lord of Void presiding over the Void.
Demon God Combat Techniques: World-Destroying Great Sun [Talented Rune Great Sun, Higher-order Law Great Sun Heaven Flame, and the might of the Demon God’s Body fused with a lifetime of Martial Arts to form this mysterious combat technique.
It possesses an instant, wide-ranging destructive power tens of times beyond the limit, capable of scorching heavens and boiling seas.]
Thunder God’s Spear [Talented Rune Purple Thunder, Higher-order Law Thousand Tribulations Divine Thunder, and the might of the Demon God’s Body fused with a lifetime of Martial Arts to form this mysterious combat technique, containing the ultimate instantaneous piercing force, powerful enough to penetrate worlds.]
Wheel of Death [A mysterious combat technique formed from the might of the Death Law’s mysteries absorbing some fragments of Rules, the might of the Demon God’s Body, and a lifetime of Martial Arts, capable of eroding and severing all vitality under its rotation, defining death itself.]
Soul Judgment [A mysterious combat technique formed from the might of the Soul Law’s mysteries absorbing some fragments of Rules, the might of the Demon God’s Body, and a lifetime of Martial Arts, with average destructive power against life forms of the Primary Material World but possessing extremely lethal effects against fantastical, illusory life forms.]
Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate [Dark Star Rune, Nine Dragon Rune, Heavenly Gate Rune fused with the Demon God’s Body, sealing a special mysterious technique concentrated with the essence of a lifetime of Martial Arts.
Behind the Heavenly Gate is sealed the dragon of world destruction. Upon breaking the first Layer of the Heavenly Gate and releasing a dragon pattern chain in the Eight-armed Demon God true form, strength, defense, and attack are all doubled, stacking in succession.]
Deification Talent: Soul Split
Law of Strength [Supreme 88%], Void Law [Higher-order 86%], Death Law [Higher-order 84%], Soul Law [Higher-order 81%]
Great Sun True Flame [Higher-order Fusion Law 99%, Strength +20], Purple Heaven Thunder [Higher-order Fusion Law 98%, Strength +20]
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Sixth level 51%]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark [Limit Break]
Supreme Divine Power: Time Reincarnation [+9]
Special Traits: Ancient Duel Mark, Hell’s Eye
Real World: Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder [Small world, true range of 3,700 kilometers, Capabilities: Absolute Domain, World Wall]
Equipment: Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, Demon God Battle Armor
Attribute points: 90,494
Soul Points: 3,570
Avatar Body: Cyan. Heaven. Destruction Emperor Dragon
Level: Titan Late Period [Possessing ten kinds of Higher-order Laws, an Ancient. Heavenly Tier Colossus, with a body length of three thousand five hundred and seven meters]
Laws: Strength.Destruction, Defense.Vajra, Chaotic Dark Power, Great Sun Golden Flame, Law of Speed, Origin of Life, Annihilation Thunder of Chaotic Hole, Corrosion Law [all grand accomplishments]
Deep Red Strength [Higher-order Law, grand accomplishment, Strength +10]
Dark Realm Power [Higher-order special category Law, 55%, with the ability to absorb and devour all heavy matter to strengthen oneself]
Evolution value: 997,047/2,000,000
The reconstruction of this Demon God’s Body directly caused Jack Clark’s cultivation to breakthrough to the Mythical Peak, and there were significant changes in his Laws and Divine Powers.
After integrating the seven great Talented Runes of the Ancient Body Refining Technique, the power of strength and defense Divine Powers became even stronger, and the Hidden Deity’s power and Void-Striking Heart Eye also ascended to the level of Divine Powers.
In addition to the split power of the Void Death Pupil, the Death Law’s power merged into the Wheel of Death, integrating into the five innate evolved Demon God Combat Techniques.
Beyond changes to the Divine Body, the flame and thunder Laws among the five Higher-order Laws were significantly strengthened due to the integration of the two Talented Runes.
The note of Strength +20 refers to an index close to Supreme; when the strength increases to +100, it will advance to the Supreme Law.
For example, the Deep Red Strength possessed by the Emperor Dragon on the attribute page, after destroying a ‘small world’ and absorbing the pervasive destructive energy from its collapse, increased in strength by +10.
This means that after destroying nine more complete ‘worlds’, the Deep Red Strength possessed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon will transform into the Supreme Deep Red Destruction Law.
And just as Jack Clark had anticipated, due to the absorption of enough ‘resources’, the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane expanded crazily, growing from over a thousand kilometers to over three thousand kilometers.
“`
“`
The expansion of the plane guided by the Law of Fertility has led the cultivation progress of this supreme law to surpass that of Death and Soul.
While Jack Clark was carefully examining the attribute page, perceiving the changes in all aspects,
deep within the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the corpse of the six-tailed white-golden tiger held in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claws was almost completely devoured, and this time even the bones were crushed and swallowed.
As for fusing the skeleton into an essence to strengthen the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, that’s not urgent.
Several Titans, an ancient beast, and a huge accumulation of world enhancement resources are sufficient for the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane to expand to five thousand kilometers, nurturing the Law of Strength to grand accomplishment.
Compared to the expansion of the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, the breakthrough of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to the ancient level is more crucial.
After devouring the ancient beast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body swelled by two hundred meters, becoming even more massive, and this happening even when some of the energy was used to enhance the Law of the Dark Realm.
As a Giant Beast Type Creature, the Destruction Emperor Dragon doesn’t need to comprehend the laws as human cultivators do; it only needs the growth of its bloodline to drive the advancement of the laws.
Boom!
After consuming the last tail of the white-golden tiger, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth emitted roars akin to a nuclear explosion, swallowing it in a few bites, causing its figure to suddenly swell again.
Whoosh!
The breath of the black-red colossal beast exhaled scorching hot airwaves, annihilating all matter and energy within several kilometers before it in the tremendous heat.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s fierce mouth opened slightly, and then a deep, powerful voice echoed through the void, “So hungry, Joe, continue looking for good stuff.”
At this moment, all cells in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body were expressing a desire, longing to merge more heavy metal substances, absorb more biological energy, and evolve to become stronger.
Roar! There, Thunderflame, in that very distant direction, I can scent something good.
“Well done, let’s go.”
Boom!
The body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as vast as mountain ranges, moved, shaking the void and whipping up waves of a shockwave that stirred the air, forcing the silver dragon and the golden-blue dragon to flap their wings to stabilize themselves.
With the three nearly nine hundred meters long giant beasts circling around, the four great beasts quickly disappeared from sight.
…
In the conference room of Sky-based Battleship No. 5, True Martial Heavenly King, and Jack Clark, who was just informed of the meeting after his recent breakthrough, sat on the throne, flanked by five king-level experts.
Besides them, on the lower meeting seats, sat dozens of experts from the Nine Layers Heavens and over two hundred from the Eight Layer Heavens of the Human Race.
At the main seat, True Martial Heavenly King said in a grave voice, “We just received messages from Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others; amid the siege by the demon kings of the three major empires, a Heavenly Feather Divine King has been heavily injured, incapacitated for further combat.”
“As the peak strength of our species, already at a disadvantage, the situation on the Heavenly Feather battlefield has taken a turn for the worse, teetering on the brink of collapse.”
“Hence, the battleship will enter overdrive mode, rushing at full strength in hopes of arriving at the battlefield sooner.”
“In overdrive mode, all the energy will be supplied to the battleship’s engine, the battleship will shut down all life activity areas, energy barriers, cultivation areas, and so on.”
“During this time, no one can leave the battleship’s shield, nor can they cultivate, in order to prevent the cultivation from triggering disturbances in the overloaded force field due to the movement of Heavenly Energy.”
The words of the True Martial Heavenly King startled everyone present; they had not anticipated that the situation on the Heavenly Feather battlefield would worsen even before they arrived.
Next, True Martial Heavenly King discussed some battlefield matters, then declared the meeting concluded.
Instantly, figures flew toward their respective battleships to announce the upcoming arrangements, but Jack Clark and several king-level experts, including Freya Louise, did not leave.
True King Heavenly King looked towards the few people, earnestly producing seven White Crystal Stones: “Inside are the detailed conditions of the Heavenly Feather battlefield, including the surface strength of the three Purgatory Empires. Take a look.”
With that, the seven White Crystal Stones containing the information flew towards the seven individuals.
The reason for using Crystal Stones to seal the information instead of directly transmitting it through smart wristwatches was that the stones also carried some of the known scent marks of the Purgatory Demon Kings, Great Demon Kings, and even demon gods of the three empires.
Compared to the Human frontline battlefield, the situation on the battlefield of the Heavenly Feather Clan is even more complex; after hundreds to thousands of years of war, those demon kings are stronger and more cunning.
It’s common for demon kings and great demon kings to hide their aura, blending in with the Transcendent Corps and launching sneak attacks.
[There are 2,000 more words, please wait a moment for me to finish editing]
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1344 - 1344 517 Descending onto the Battlefield
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1344: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update) Chapter 1344: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update) As they approached the battlefield, the fleet exceeding its flight limit began to reduce speed, and the wildly retreating Cloud Mist and the mountains and rivers below gradually became clear.
Whirr!
Number One on the deck vibrated slightly, and from its chest crystal shot a blue-white beam of light. Freya Louise, dressed in red and white opulent battle armor, flew out along the beam.
As Freya’s strength improved and she absorbed Number One’s Transcendent Origin for Tempering, the level of her energy-based God Machine Armament, which resembled battle armor when condensed, was also enhanced.
Click-clack!! The battle boots landed heavily on the deck with a metallic clang; black hair draped over her shoulders, the valiant Freya stood behind Jack Clark, looking excitedly at the golden light screen expanding on the horizon.
“We’re finally here.”
Jack nodded slightly, “Yes, we’ve finally arrived.”
This was timely, as he had just completed the 2.0 version of his Demon God’s Body, greatly increasing his strength. Stepping onto the battlefield, he could now slay even more demon kings and Great Demon Kings.
For now, there was no need to confront a Demon God.
His realm was currently at the Mythical Peak, and the gap in strength between him and a Demon God was too large. Even though his strength could enter the Supreme Level when the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate shattered or he reached the Limit of Time Reincarnation Burst,
such an outburst was somewhat forced, and revealing his full strength too soon would be detrimental.
After all, his ability to withstand a clash with a Demon God from the ancient early stage was due to a Limit Breakthrough, while the opponent was in their normal state. The most important fact was that withstanding a blow didn’t equate to defeating the opponent, let alone slaying them.
On the contrary, it might attract the intervention of a peak Great Demon King, because challenging a Myth as a God with such an extraordinary talent would definitely mark you for death.
At this moment, Jack’s gaze fell on Freya and he cracked a smile, “By the way, when did you break through to the Ninth Heavens?”
“Yesterday.” The girl’s lips curved upward; others couldn’t cultivate under the extreme flight of the warship, but it was different for her. Her cultivation improvement mainly relied on ‘absorbing’ the Transcendent Origin from Number One.
However, it still took her nearly half a year to break through from the Fourth Layer Heaven to the Ninth.
Reflecting on this, Freya sighed, “But even with Number One’s assistance, I feel like there’s no hope of catching up to you; you’re just too monstrous.”
“Perhaps without me breaking through to king-level, you’ll already have broken through to the Supreme.”
She had originally thought that Jack’s one-year king-level cultivation speed was shocking enough, but in just over a month after reaching the Myth, his realm had advanced to Mythical Peak.
After witnessing the spectacle of his physical body’s reformation, everyone had the feeling that within a month, he would break through to Heavenly King.
To leap from king-level to Heavenly King in two months—such a speed of cultivation was unthinkable for other kings.
For instance, Gentry Gail, who rose to king-level decades ago during the chaotic era, was once a dominating Monster Genius, but even now was only at Mythical Peak.
In response to Freya’s admiration, Jack just smiled, “Physique differs from person to person, there’s no need to compare with me, and your cultivation speed is not slow at all, Freya.”
Freya nodded, “Under normal conditions, it’s indeed not slow. In the Federation, among all those who started cultivating in the same year as me, aside from you, only I and Student Aiken have reached the Ninth Heavens.”
Freya was certainly aware of this, but she wasn’t arrogant about it, “However, my method of cultivation is quite unorthodox, and in terms of true talent, I fall far behind Student Aiken.”
“Student Aiken’s talent… indeed, it’s quite monstrous.” Even Jack had to admit that.
Unlike him, with his Giant Beast Body and attribute page, and Freya, with Number One as her cultivation cheat, Jane Aiken, who also reached the Ninth Heavens in a year, was a true genius.
That bizarre talent for entering an epiphany state at any moment was even enviable to Jack.
Speaking of which, Jack pondered slightly, “According to the plan, I and Mysterious Martial Senior and the others will act independently. I’ll accompany you for a while.”
“It’s the first time entering the battlefield. We can reap the most before the enemies understand us. Let’s see if we can help you (Number One) devour a couple of Great Demon Kings.”
Number One possessed the special characteristic of devouring the flesh and souls of living beings to strengthen itself, capable of devouring everything from Level 4 Transcendent Life to demon kings—the more it consumed, the stronger it became.
This was even more potent than the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Because the Destruction Emperor Dragon could only accelerate its growth by devouring the flesh of Giant Beasts, while the flesh of Purgatory Demon Kings, Great Demon Kings, and those from different races was of little use when consumed.
Because these ‘persons’ were not Giant Beasts—their bodies were too small and their flesh was scarce. As for the Demon Kings’ True Bodies that manifested as hundreds or even thousands of kilometers in size, they were aggregates of rule energy that dissipated when slain.
And by now, for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, consuming any Mythical or lesser Giant Beast was like snacking on chickpeas—one could munch on them, but it had no effect.
In comparison to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s terrifying Giant Beast Body, the energy contained in the flesh of ordinary Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts was too meager.
At this point, the thirteen warships had slowed down to normal speed and came to a stop a hundred kilometers away from the light screen.
As the fleet halted, the Golden Warship of the Heavenly Feather Clan that had followed closely behind shuddered, stirring up a tumult of white waves, moving to the front to stop at the edge of the light screen, which seemed to be a barrier of the world.
Whoosh! Boris Deya with the three pairs of Golden Light Wings on his back, along with the elite fighters of the Heavenly Feather Clan, took off. All of their wings radiated dazzling Radiance from behind them.
Boom! A vast expanse of golden light gathered into a golden column, striking the Sky Curtain above. In an instant, the entire Sky Curtain shook and dissipated wave after wave of light, opening up.
Behind the torn Sky Curtain lay a staircase, thousands of kilometers wide, with each step towering tens of meters high, leading up to a massive gate that stood tens of thousands of meters tall at the end of the stairs.
At that moment, on the staircases on either side of the Heavenly Gate, supported by four stone pillars, stood thousands of figures, each with a pair of white light wings on their backs, standing tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 1345 - 1345 517 Descending onto the Battlefield
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1345: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update)_2 Chapter 1345: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update)_2 These ‘people’ were all clad in white armor, wielding golden long swords, their faces handsome, and each ‘person’ surrounded by falling white feathers, exuding a holy aura.
In front of this ‘angelic’ troop, a silver-haired youth with a Mythical aura and two pairs of white light wings growing from his back was treading on the Void, resembling the legendary seated angels.
Looking at Bordea, who had opened the Sky Curtain of the world, the four-winged youth smiled slightly, “Welcome back, Main God Bordea.”
The Heavenly Feather soldiers on either side also paid their respects, “We welcome the return of the Main God of Judgment.”
But looking at the four-winged strong man greeting them, Bordea’s brows furrowed slightly, “Megadir, why is it only you here?”
The Human Race had dispatched an army to support them, but to be greeted by only one Mythical Powerhouse from the Heavenly Feather Clan unavoidably felt like a slight.
Hearing this, the youth gave a bitter smile, “Lord Bordea, it’s not that my tribe is neglecting our allies, but the current battle situation is extremely urgent, and all the Main Gods and Divine Kings are tied up.”
“Especially with Divine King Shaliedi heavily injured in the encirclement of three Demon Gods and having to withdraw from battle, the three major empires have launched a new round of full-scale offensives.”
“At present, the ninth Plane has fallen, and the surrounding tenth to fourteenth Planes have also been subjected to fierce attacks…” As he spoke, the silver-haired youth suddenly began to cough fiercely, his aura fluctuating weakly.
“The situation is this grave?” Bordea furrowed his brows.
Although the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King had passed the message to Bordea, he had not anticipated that The Purgatory Family would once again initiate a full-scale offense.
According to the recent pattern, after each repulse, The Purgatory Family would briefly regroup and then launch another assault after half a Sun Wheel had passed.
At that moment, Space Distortion occurred beside Bordea, and the True Martial Heavenly King appeared silently, the invisible oppressive aura instantly startling the silver-haired youth.
So this is the support from the Human Race, how strong, it almost felt like facing a Divine King.
True Martial Heavenly King said in a deep voice, “Lord Bordea, there’s no time to lose. Let’s head straight to the battlefield, and on the way, let this Megadir fill us in on the details of the battle situation.”
“Thank you.” This was naturally what Bordea was eagerly wishing for.
In the face of an extinction crisis, the Heavenly Feather Strongmen spared no words, swiftly boarding the massive sky-based battleships which then entered the cracks and flew into the light curtain.
As they passed through the tens of thousands of meters tall Heavenly Gate, a Golden Divine Tree stretching over hundreds of thousands of kilometers in height appeared before everyone’s eyes, leaving even Jack Clark with a trace of shock in his eyes.
In the Void, the colossal Golden Divine Tree towered, its branches spreading over an area of hundreds of thousands of kilometers, nearly the size of Jupiter, emitting a dazzling halo.
The golden Sky Curtain where the fleet was located was at the edge of that halo, forming an even larger golden light sphere, within which the layered images of mountains and rivers appeared as a phantom.
However, at that moment, a small part of the golden light sphere had turned dark red, releasing a strong evil and dark aura.
By the edge of the deck, looking at this scene, Freya Louise was somewhat shocked, “Is this the Eternal Divine Tree’s domain?”
In the detailed information about the Heavenly Feather Clan, it was mentioned that at the core of the Heavenly Feather Clan was an immensely large Eternal Divine Tree, reaching Rule Level.
This divine tree was said to have flown out from the cracks in heaven tens of thousands of years ago when the world of the Heavenly Feather Clan was devoured by the mythical world, taking root in the world of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
With the power of the Eternal Divine Tree, the Heavenly Feather Clan fended off the devouring of the mythical world, existing in a state of half integration into the mythical world.
As the Eternal Divine Tree thrived in the nourishment of the Heavenly Feather world, it grew from thousands of meters tall to its current height of hundreds of thousands of kilometers, equivalent to a Supreme Level life form.
Centered around the Eternal Divine Tree, the world of the Heavenly Feather Clan evolved into eighteen layers of Plane Worlds, stacked upon one another, covering an area a hundred times larger than it seemed from the outside.
In addition, in the outer mythical world, the Heavenly Feather Clan ruled a territory spanning nearly ten million kilometers, with a total population of several hundred million, and over twenty Vassal Races underneath them.
In the past, only the Heavenly Feather Clan could enter the Eternal Divine Tree’s domain.
But with the onset of the conflict and war with the Purgatory Empire, over the centuries, all the outer territories had been occupied, the clan members had suffered heavy casualties, leaving only over twenty million left, and tens of millions of Vassal Races.
Moreover, during the subsequent decades-long War of Extermination, many of the Mythical Powerhouses also perished, and eight layers of the Eternal Divine Tree’s domain were occupied.
No, now nine layers have been occupied, approaching the trunk.
Once the trunk of the Eternal Divine Tree is eroded by the Purgatory Empire’s forces and begins to be polluted, the Heavenly Feather Clan would be considered completely defeated, and extinction is just a matter of time.
This is also the reason why the Heavenly Feather Clan fights to the death without retreat.
As long as the ancestral land of the Eternal Domain is intact, the chance for the Heavenly Feather Clan to produce Divine King Level powerhouses increases, and the strongest Divine King of Light still has the hope of breaking through to ancient True Spirit and achieving Monarch status.
But once they lose their ancestral land, unless they have heaven-defying talent to break the Heavenly Earth Rules of the mythical world, the Divine King of Light will never have the hope of stepping into Monarch level.
A tribe without an ancient True Spirit Level strongman seated in the mythical world is considered just an ordinary, small tribe; encountering any strong enemies, such as The Purgatory Family, would lead to their obliteration.
As the fleet neared the golden light sphere, the sheer wave of invisible energy released grew more enormous and majestic, giving Jack Clark and the others the illusion of approaching a Sun-star.

chapters.title: Chapter 1346 - 1346 517 Descending onto the Battlefield
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1346: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update)_3 Chapter 1346: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update)_3 And as he flew, Jack Clark keenly sensed that every thousand kilometers, he would encounter a golden light curtain, a powerful prohibition, like layers of shells protecting the Eternal Domain.
However, with Bordea’s Golden Battleship leading the way, the fleet passed through ten layers of the Sky Curtain without a hitch and arrived at the edge of a branch that stretched for ten thousand kilometers.
The ten-thousand-kilometer-long branch was like a continental block spanning the Void, with golden leaves the size of several kilometers each. It was covered in divine and strange patterns and had a grand and magnificent palace built upon it.
Within and outside the palace, many figures emanating the aura of the Fifth Layer Heaven rushed about in haste, while the transparent world shadows on both sides of the branch distorted continuously. Occasionally, Heavenly Feather soldiers with incomplete bodies appeared.
“Quick, take this lord to the healing pool.”
“This Lord Phoenix Feather has a damaged divine heart, requiring the water of the spring of life. Hurry, take it to the Wheel Light Divine Temple…”
As the differently-winged race with two pairs of transparent dragonfly-like wings bustled around, accompanied by the Golden Battleship, a convoy of fourteen warships drew closer to the trunk.
At the same time, a will as vast as the ocean descended, its Supreme Level pressure sweeping over the fleet, followed by an old and weak will that resonated through the Void.
“Bordea, you have finally returned.”
On the Golden Battleship, Bordea’s expression was solemn, “Divine King Salie, how is your injury?”
“Not bad, I won’t die for now, but I currently need to stay in the Heart of Eternity to heal and cannot appear in person,” said the weakened will echoing through the void.
“Dear Human Experts, thank you for coming to support us. Unfortunately, our clan is currently in a critical state of battle, and we cannot host a grand welcome banquet for you all.”
True Martial Heavenly King, standing beside Bordea, slightly smiled, “Divine King, you are too kind. The Purgatory Family is a common enemy to both our races, and helping you is akin to helping ourselves.”
“As for the banquet, we can always host it after we repel the invasion of the Purgatory Empire,” he said.
“Hahaha… Indeed, once we push back the Purgatory Empire, I will surely hold a grand banquet to celebrate for all of you…” Yet, as he laughed, the Divine King’s will paused mid-laughter.
In the Void, the exchange of three powerful wills lasted but a moment. The ten-thousand-kilometer-long branch trembled, as bursts of resplendent golden light erupted.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
In front of the fleet, space-time distorted, forming three massive golden vortices, as the Divine King’s will in the void vibrated.
“The three passages from left to right lead to the tenth, twelfth, and Thirteenth Planes, respectively. The situation there is most grave, and we are barely able to withstand the offensive of the Purgatory Empire.”
“From now on, we rely on all of you,” he imparted.
Meanwhile, the thirteen warships, having received orders from the True Martial Heavenly King, dispersed. Except for No. 5 flagship, which stood still in the Void, the remaining twelve split into three smaller fleets.
Each fleet had a Heavenly King Level powerhouse, two King Level forces as mainstays, with more than ten thousand elite Transcendent Warriors supplementing them, equipped with an army of a million unmanned Mechas.
Among them, the fleet Jack Clark was in consisted of numbers one to four, with him as the main force, King Cyril with the Sky-splitting Golden Sword and Freya Louise as aides, and as of now, Jane Aiken, Gabriella and Damon Lopes were also present on No. 1 warship.
Originally, Damon Lopes was assigned to warship No. 13, but he requested a transfer three days after the meeting ended.
After all, Jack Clark was only second to the True Martial Heavenly King in combat strength, and they were “brothers”; following him naturally felt safer.
“Let’s go, set out.”
On the deck of No. 1 battleship, Jack Clark stood with his hands behind his back at the edge of the warship, his expression calm, behind him stood King Cyril and Freya Louise perched on the shoulder of Number One.
Boom!
At Jack Clark’s command, the warship, spanning tens of kilometers, shuddered as it headed for the first golden vortex on the left, guided by a thousand Heavenly Feather soldiers with white light wings, and then disappeared from sight.
At the same time, the other two fleets entered the other two vortices respectively, the Mysterious Martial Sky King and Sky King Denny Kaye had already advanced into those two planes.
On No. 5 flagship, True Martial Heavenly King held a black stele in hand, his expression indifferent as he observed both sides, his terrifying gaze piercing through the distorted Plane Boundary Walls, watching the intense battle inside.
…
In the Thirteenth Floor Plane of the Eternal Domain, boundless white clouds floated between heaven and earth, with islands of various sizes, ranging from a few kilometers to several hundred kilometers in area, drifting about.
These islands had mountain peaks, continuous forests, and numerous birds and beasts inhabiting them, with streams winding through the forests and waterfalls plummeting from the edges of the islands.
However, the world that was once full of vitality was now engulfed in war.
In the air, figures with silver light wings carrying out battle cries, towering tens to hundreds of meters tall, swung their gigantic weapons ablaze with silver flames in frenzy.
Beneath the floating islands, dark clouds churned, countless Purgatory True Demons and Demonized Alien Races surged skyward, outnumbering the Heavenly Feather soldiers by more than tenfold, with torn corpses falling every moment.
On those floating islands with diameters exceeding a hundred kilometers, stood white stone castles thousands of meters high, their sharp designs evoking a fortress-like appearance.
At the moment, the gorgeous relief carvings on the surface of these castle buildings were flickering, emitting golden light curtains that enveloped the islands.
At the same time, from the sharp tops of these buildings, beams of golden light, a hundred meters thick, slashed across the sky for hundreds of kilometers, turning all Purgatory Demonic Creatures into ash where it passed.
Meanwhile, surrounding these islands, giant beasts roared, their bodies measuring a hundred to two hundred meters in length, with four wings on their backs and their bodies covered in Golden Scale Armor, resembling dragons.
Beneath the tail of these Level 9 Giant Beasts, many of the Purgatory True Demons attempting to reach the floating islands were torn apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1347 - 1347 517 Descending onto the Battlefield
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1347: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (Fourth Update) Chapter 1347: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (Fourth Update) At the same time, high above in the sky, thousands of Divine Phoenix Warriors with golden wings formed battle arrays, surrounded by dozens of similar Divine Texts.
These similar Divine Text combinations formed red arrays covering tens of kilometers, each burst unleashing a wide-ranging strike that spanned tens of kilometers.
Meteoric flames rained down from the heavens, churning the dark demon clouds below and turning countless demonized aliens into ash.
While the Silver Wing Soldiers engaged in close combat and the Divine Phoenix Warriors supported from a distance, elite squads of ten to a hundred, flapping white light wings, divided the battlefield.
Composed of the Heavenly Feather Lineage’s strongmen, these squads specialized in hunting the formidable Purgatory True Demons, their battle swords burning with white flames, slashing out sword lights hundreds of meters long.
These white-flamed sword lights possessed a strong restraining power against Purgatory Demonic Air, tearing apart the domains and Protective Body Demon Shields of the Purgatory True Demons beneath them.
Moreover, once wounded by those sword lights, the wounds would burn with white flame until the True Demons burned to ash in desperate screams.
More than a million Heavenly Feather elites, relying on the Floating Fortresses, clashed with the countless Purgatory True Demons and Demonized Alien Army; the battlefield spanned tens of thousands of kilometers.
The entire plane was almost split in two, the sky above painted by golden light as innumerable figures with light wings fluttered like angels, exuding a holy and powerful aura.
Beneath, dark clouds billowed, and numerous demonized aliens, like demons, charged out in a stunning scene.
However, the most intense battle was of the Mythical level.
Twelve Mythical Powerhouses with pairs of white, golden, and silver wings and seventeen demon kings engaged in battle across twelve battlefields.
With the speed of movement and the scale of combat of the Mythical Powerhouses, Floating Islands exploded into golden and black light as they passed, shaking space itself.
Occasionally, a sword light or black spear shadow extending for kilometers would explode, turning hundreds or thousands of Divine Phoenix Warriors and Purgatory True Demons into ash.
Unlike the Human Race’s Frontline Battlefield where the forces were evenly matched, these demon kings and Heavenly Feather Gods didn’t care if their surrounding soldiers were affected during their fierce battles.
Or perhaps, this was precisely the result the demon kings desired.
With the numerical advantage, it only took one demon king to restrain an opponent for a moment to inflict devastating attacks on the surrounding Heavenly Feather Soldiers.
Under the tremendous power of the laws, each strike cleared out kilometers, especially the Divine Phoenix battle arrays launching long-range attacks with Divine Text, which were wiped out one by one by the demon kings.
This scene filled the Heavenly Feather Gods with fury.
“Outnumbered, all should consolidate towards the Floating Fortresses and rely on the Divine Leaf Shield to resist the demon kings’ attacks.”
Boom!
As the Mythical stage Heavenly Feather Strongman had just finished speaking, he was struck by two demon kings materializing hundreds of meters tall True Bodies and slammed into an island with a diameter of tens of kilometers.
Instantly, the island exploded into pieces, and an even more horrific battle broke out.
Apart from the great war affecting half the plane, at the plane’s edge, a Main God of the Heavenly Feather with three pairs of white light wings was locked in fierce combat with two Great Demon Kings, causing heaven and earth to shatter.
This Heavenly Feather Main God was incredibly powerful, holding his own against two, but the two Eight-armed True Demons he faced were indifferent, showing no sign of urgency.
Boom! Two dark Demon Realms spanning tens of kilometers and a white Divine Realm resembling a sun with a diameter of a hundred kilometers intersected, like three worlds colliding, causing a thunderous rumble.
The fearsome laws burst forth causing space to shatter as three figures exchanged thousands of lightning-fast blows, eventually forcing each other hundreds of kilometers apart.
At the burning heart of the dark red laws world, a Great Demon King a kilometer tall with three pairs of red demon horns stood, exuding the terrifying pressure of a late stage Great Demon King, turning half the sky dark.
Looking at the Main God of the Heavenly Feather, Hexagonal Great Demon King said in a deep voice, “Anstice, stop your futile resistance, the demise of your Heavenly Feather Tribe has been destined.”
“With your talent, it’s a shame to fall like this. Our king has said, if you are willing to join our clan, you can be granted the blood of the Ancestor for rebirth.”
At the center of the laws world filled with dancing white feathers, an eight-hundred-meter-tall figure stood firm, with three pairs of dazzling white light wings.
Opposite the True Body of the Great Demon King, however, this figure was somewhat transparent, with a blonde girl around one meter eighty tall, clad in exquisite white battle armor and wielding a sword at the heart’s position.
The blonde girl spread her three pairs of white light wings, with a white halo suspended above her head, her tall figure and flawless face like a legendary Seraph.
Facing two late-stage Great Demon Kings with the aura of an early stage Heavenly King, the blonde girl was even more dominant, her gaze cold, “Rather than surrender, I’m more interested in exterminating your Purgatory Demon Race.”
“Courting death, choosing punishment over toast,” the two Great Demon Kings’ gazes turned cold.
Had it not been for the Demon God’s orders to capture this Main God of the Heavenly Feather alive if possible, they would have burned their Origin for a decisive battle, even if it meant taking heavy injuries.
But as the two Great Demon Kings prepared to continue their assault, the void above the Firmament shattered, four golden beams descended from the sky.
Within those earthshaking golden beams, four black Battleships each several kilometers long appeared, floating above the battlefield at an altitude of three thousand kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1348 - 1348 517 Descending onto the Battlefield
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1348: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update)_5 Chapter 1348: Chapter 517: Descending onto the Battlefield, Eighteen Planes (First Update)_5 At the edge of the four massive battleships, over a thousand silhouettes with white wings fluttered.
Suddenly, the voice of a Mythical Strong from the Heavenly Feather Clan echoed across the entire battlefield, inspiring everyone, “Hold on, our support is here.”
Because the Mysterious Martial Sky King and a Heavenly Feather Mythical Strong had rushed back in advance, the upper echelons of the Heavenly Feather Clan were all aware that an alliance with the Human Race had been formed, and that an Expeditionary Army was coming to their aid.
On the Number One battleship, Jack Clark slightly lowered his head to survey the vast battlefield below, his eyes cold and indifferent, “Apart from those staying behind to guard the ships, all hands launch the War Pattern mechas immediately and enter the battlefield centered around the Splitting Sky Throne.”
“Yes sir.”
As Jack Clark gave the order, figures flew out from the four battleships one after another.
However, as they saw from the ten-plus-kilometer-long battleships emerged five thousand figures with the Aura of Sixth-level Heaven to Ninth Heavens and then vanished, many of the Heavenly Feather soldiers on the battlefield below were stunned.
What use could so few Senior soldiers be?
Just then, the Firmament above flickered with Radiance, revealing around those dispersed Human Experts massive black mechas standing five, ten, twenty meters tall.
These mechas primarily wielded combat swords and combat knives that were thirty meters in length, with a small number of them carrying 1-meter diameter cannons, half-meter caliber machine guns, and high-powered rocket launchers as standard weapons.
Besides these, there were also some powerful special weapons, such as mini Crystal Energy Nuclear Bombs the size of a 1-meter diameter, mounted on a small shipping container launch frame.
Each of these unmanned War Pattern mechas formed around a cultivator at their center, with every one hundred and twenty forming a squad formation that spread out, instantly multiplying their number to six hundred thousand.
King Cyril with silver hair cascading over his shoulders took a step forward, the Sword Intent around him sharp and piercing, shooting up into the sky and transforming into a golden light beam that dazzled Heaven and Earth, cutting through the Firmament.
“I am the Human Race’s Splitting Sky Golden Sword King; I dare the Purgatory Demon King to come and face his death.”
“Arrogant!”
Beneath the Dark Demon Cloud that roiled thousands of kilometers below, it formed into a vortex tens of kilometers across, at the center of which a Three-headed Six-armed Purgatory Great Demon of the late period emerged.
Provoked, King Cyril let out a long cry as the terrifying Sword Intent coiled around him and morphed into a Thunderous golden light beam that descended from the sky, causing the Void to explode and shatter everything in its path.
At the same time, the engines within the six hundred thousand War Pattern mechas under the battleship activated, and a network of purple War Patterns lit up on each, forming a series of purple halos.
These purple halos spread out, interconnecting to form a Divine Realm that spanned over a hundred kilometers, instantly boosting the Aura of all mechas and cultivators within the battle formation.
They gained enhanced strength, reinforced Defense, and their weapons were enchanted with various augmentations.
“Kill!”
As if one entity, the battle formation, following closely behind the Splitting Sky Sword King, plummeted rapidly towards the battlefield. When they dived a thousand kilometers, the mechas in the formation wielding rocket launchers on their back lit up with dazzling light.
A simultaneous launch — a hundred thousand high-yield rockets screamed through the air, increasing in speed as they fell, accelerating to ten times the speed of sound, enveloping three separate Alien Corps spread across hundreds of kilometers and numbering in the hundreds of thousands.
However, these Demonized Aliens were all Transcendent strong men who, despite having never seen such rockets, cautiously chose to mount a long-distance attack.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The intense explosions and firelight illuminated hundreds of kilometers as the brutal shockwaves shattered tens of thousands of Demonized Aliens and injured countless others who vomited blood.
At the same time, several hundred mini Crystal Energy Nuclear Bombs also launched, cloaked by the protective blaze, and appeared in the skies above Purgatory armies numbering in the thousands to tens of thousands, across a thousand kilometers.
Boom!
Mushroom clouds with a 1-kilometer diameter rose up, emitting Terrifying Aura and blinding light, while the dreadful shockwaves of the nuclear explosions reduced everything within ten kilometers to rubble.
In an instant, the entire battlefield spanning thousands of kilometers stood silent, as countless Purgatory True Demons, Demonized Aliens, and Heavenly Feather soldiers looked up in shock toward the purple circle in the sky.
The Heavenly Feather Gods and demon kings who were clashing also instinctively separated from each other.
All these Heavenly Feather Gods, demon kings, and Purgatory True Demons were experiencing for the first time the power of the Human’s hot weapons, stunned by their potent lethality.
The force of those mini Crystal Energy Nuclear Bomb explosions almost matched a single Early Myth strong man in intensity, but the instantaneous destruction and the aftermath were much greater.
Had such an extensive attack been launched by a demon king, the impact would have been considered normal, because Mythical Powerhouses were just that powerful.
Yet, when this widespread attack originated from a group of Transcendents, which in a single strike covered thousands of kilometers, slaughtering hundreds of thousands of Purgatory True Demons and wounding a million more, the significance was utterly different.
Suddenly, a cold voice resounded through Heaven and Earth, “Taroko, ignore those opponents. Dispatch five demon kings, and extinguish those aliens with all your might.”
Boom! Boom! Boom!
At the command of the Great Demon King, and within an instant, demon kings entangled with twelve Heavenly Feather Gods erupted with Power Explosion, and in a dominant position, five demon kings were the first to break away from the fight.
Seeing this, Jack Clark revealed a faint smile on the battleship’s deck, “Now it’s our turn to take the stage.”
The power of the Human’s hot weapons was best exemplified in the first round, catching the opponents unprepared; once they were ready for it, subsequent rounds were significantly less effective.
Buzz!
The Number One mecha, covered in black and red Ferocious Armor, suddenly flashed with blue-white light from its eyes, emitting a Terrifying Aura that enveloped the battlefield and struck fear into the hearts of numerous Purgatory True Demons and Heavenly Feather Alien soldiers.
Boom! The moment the Number One mecha leaped into the air, the ten-plus-kilometer battleship’s bow plunged downward with great force.
“Hahaha… Daoist Master is here too,” laughed Damon Lopes as purple lightning burst from his body, transforming into a glaring Purple Thunder Light that pounced on a quasi-mythical Purgatory Great Demon.
Jane Aiken, with four Divine Swords on her back, gently nodded to Jack Clark then turned into a sword light descending from above. Her target, however, was a Purgatory Main Battle Corps with over three thousand soldiers.
Seeing this, Jack Clark smiled slightly, took a step forward, and appeared to teleport next to a demon king thousands of kilometers away in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1349 - 1349 518 Crushing the Battlefield Frenzied
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1349: Chapter 518: Crushing the Battlefield, Frenzied Massacre Chapter 1349: Chapter 518: Crushing the Battlefield, Frenzied Massacre Above the Firmament, raging winds howled.
In the skies engulfed by rolling Dark Demon Air, covering a dozen kilometers, stood the Demon King, towering over eight hundred meters tall, with three heads and six arms, each holding a burning Black Flame War Spear.
Yet at this time, this Mid-Mythical Stage Demon King was as if facing a formidable enemy, all three hideous heads looking in terror to the left, where a young man with shoulder-length black hair appeared out of nowhere, hundreds of meters away.
In contrast to the mountainous Demon King, Jack Clark, who had retained his True Body form, seemed as insignificant as an ant before it, barely discernible, with an aura that was covertly emitting a Mythical-level presence.
What shocked the Demon King was that the other had blatantly disregarded its Dark Law Domain and teleported there by distorting space.
“Abyssal Wheel of Annihilation, all ten directions obliterated!”
In the blink of an eye, the Demon King roared in response and flashed to a spot twenty or so kilometers away, as roaring Black Flames burst from its body and soared into the sky, instantly swelling tenfold.
Boom!
A circle of black gears exploded behind the Demon King, instantaneously creating a Black Hole several kilometers in diameter, from which 108 Black Flame War Spears, each a kilometer long, burst forth, enveloping all directions.
Wrapped in Black Flames, these war spears resembled roaring Demon Dragons—each strike possessing the might of a late Mythical, the intensity of their twists and turns shaking space itself.
Feeling a strong threat of Death from the tiny figure of a different race, the Demon King immediately burned half its Origin in desperation.
And just as the Demon King explosively burned its Origin, a four-meter-long Black-Gold Battle Halberd appeared in Jack Clark’s hand, instantly filling the air with a heavy presence.
After Jack Clark’s breakthrough into the Legendary Realm, his battle armor and Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd had already been refined with the Origin of Laws and unified; they were strengthened once more when his Demon God’s Body was re-forged.
The excessively heavy halberd simply held in Jack Clark’s hand distorted the surrounding space invisibly, just like a collapsing Black Hole.
The indifferent Jack Clark held the halberd in one hand, and the radiance of gold and purple on it surged, sweeping out a Halberd Skill a kilometer long.
Booom!
Space collapsed within a twenty-some-kilometer radius in front of him, everything exploding and shattering under the Overbearing power of the Vacuum Destruction Divine Power, forming a massive Black Hole.
That included both the Demon King and the Abyssal Black Hole behind it—all were obliterated together, and the powerful Destructive Impact even swept over an area of a hundred kilometers, creating a massive surge of energy that sent distant Purgatory True Demons and Heavenly Feather soldiers flying.
Such terrifying combat power instantly startled the two Demon Kings flying towards the War Patterned drones, causing looks of horror to appear on their faces a thousand kilometers away.
What did annihilating a Mid-Mythical Stage Demon King with a single strike imply? It showed that this otherworldly Expert, emanating a Mythical Peak aura, had a true combat power comparable to a Great Demon King.
This kind of cross-realm strength made the two Mid-Mythical Stage Demon Kings involuntarily pause.
If he could obliterate CaTodes with one strike, then they, being a minor level lower in realm, would stand even less chance against him.
However, as the Demon Kings hesitated, in the far-off roiling Black Hole where Demon Gas surged, the Demon King’s True Body with a Dragon Tail quickly reassembled.
But by then, the Demon King’s aura was weak, its complexion deathly pale. After burning half its Origin and having its True Body shattered by a single strike, its power had plummeted to an early Demon King stage.
Most crucially, the Overbearing power contained in that halberd had nearly exhausted another tenth of its Origin for it to restore its True Body.
Looking at the indifferently standing Jack Clark in the Void, the Demon King’s face twisted with difficulty, “Kurou, Dels be cautious; this ‘Human Race’ individual is very strong.”
“His power cap remains at the Legendary Realm, but the strength he wields is supremely Overbearing, nothing can withstand it—it must not be countered head-on.”
“Forget the Transcendent Corps; join me in holding him off. Today, even if only a Remnant Soul of mine remains, he must be killed.”
“I offer my bloodline as a guide, and sacrifice my flesh and soul, come forth, Abyss Bone Demon.”
With a creepy chant, the Demon King let out a vicious roar, six arms gruesomely penetrated its chest, then tore it open in a quick move, immediately spraying out copious amounts of Black Demonic Blood and revealing a huge Black Eye.
Instantly, an incredibly sinister Blood Mist spread, voraciously devouring the vitality contained in the surrounding flesh and blood.
“CaTodes, have you lost your mind!” Seeing that black eye seemingly connected to the Abyss, the two Demon Kings immediately showed looks of utter dread.
“Just now, to restore my True Body, I exhausted another tenth of my Origin; I’ve broken the limit,” the Demon King explained.
“Instead of stagnating henceforth, better to gamble it all.” With that, the Demon King looked towards the distant Jack Clark with a casual demeanor; the dark red eyes in all three heads revealed a crazed intent to kill.
For a Mythical Powerhouse, burning more than sixty percent of their Origin does irreparable harm to the Divine Soul and the Laws’ Origin, making further progress difficult.
This was something CaTodes, who aspired to obliterate the Heavenly Feather Clan and ascend to a Great Demon King by consuming this great tribe’s intrinsic wealth, could not accept.
Rather than living with that, it chose to bet its life, offering up its True Body and soul in sacrifice, borrowing power from the Abyss. If it could kill him and offer the Human Expert as a sacrifice to the Abyss, perhaps there was a glimmer of hope.
Under the influence of the Blood Mist from that eye, CaTodes rapidly withered to skin and bones, looking like a desiccated skeleton, surrounded by Blood Mist, appearing extremely fierce and terrifying.
Crackle Crackle!!
The ghastly Bone Demon expanded to a kilometer tall, its aura reaching the peak of Demon King, with a scythe over a thousand meters long appearing in hand, emanating a deadly presence.
Whether the conversation between the three Demon Kings or CaTodes’s sacrifice, everything occurred in the blink of an eye, completed in merely a few seconds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1350 - 1350 518 Crushing the Battlefield Frenzied
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1350: Chapter 518: Crushing the Battlefield, Frenzied Massacre_2 Chapter 1350: Chapter 518: Crushing the Battlefield, Frenzied Massacre_2 Under normal conditions, that amount of time would have been enough for Jack Clark to have destroyed the Three Demon Kings, but facing this scene, Jack remained unmoved, holding his halberd erect tens of kilometers away.
Including the Demon King named Catodes, he had been holding back just now, using only a fraction of his strength, merely blowing apart the True Body without opting for an instant eradication.
The reason was that this plane was being watched by a Divine King and a Demon God.
High above in the Firmament, the golden light that obscured the sky and the endlessly rolling dark Demon Cloud beneath were the Law Manifestations of those two Supreme Experts in the late Legendary Realm.
However, at this moment, those two strong men were clashing outside, distorting space and time so intensely that they had no time to pay attention to anything else.
But Jack was clear that if he had displayed the strength to kill the Great Demon King instantly, that Demon God would have torn through the plane and descended in an instant.
By then, even if he could have retreated safely, he would have lost the opportunity to slay the dozen or so Demon Kings and the Great Demon King on this plane, causing Mecha Number One to miss out on a lot of sustenance.
“Kekekeke!! Human Race, die!” Emitting a sinister, eerie laugh, the monster, whose Aura burst forth to the Mythical Peak after sacrificing the Abyss Bone Demon, flashed and instantly appeared in front of Jack.
In its hand, the scythe forged as if from leg bones swept across, and in an instant, space was silently and seamlessly severed as if it were a solid, forming a kilometers-long horizontal black plane.
Under that supremely sharp bone scythe, all matter, energy, and laws were cut through, its power almost transcending the limits of the Mythical Boundary.
Boom boom!! Two powerful Auras of Demon Power erupted in the distance.
As seasoned fighters constantly battling in the Heavenly Feather battlefield, the two Demon Kings decisively burned one fifth of their Origin, unleashing their limit strength as they pounced towards Jack Clark from both sides simultaneously.
But then…
Boom! A kilometers-long Black Gold Halberd Skill swept across, and under the force of Unrivaled Domineering Power, the Mythical Peak Bone Demon’s scythe, forged from an unknown creature’s leg bone, instantly shattered and exploded.
“How is this possible!?”
Bang bang!! The Law Domains around the two demon kings who had just pounced were shattered, and before they could even react, they were obliterated by the sky-obscuring Halberd Radiance.
In that instant, under the Bound Crossing Divine Ability, Jack Clark split into three and traversed hundreds of kilometers, instantly obliterating the True Forms of the three Demon Kings.
And at the moment when Jack used his power to destroy the Three Demon Kings’ True Forms, the other two Demon Kings who had jumped towards the War Pattern Legion had already been intercepted by Number One.
“Scram!”
Looking at the Biological Mecha that appeared before them, which was not emitting any fluctuations of Law Power, the True Body of the three-headed, seven-armed Demon King, towering over seven hundred meters in height, roared.
Boom!
Under the seven arms of the just advanced Mid-Mythical Stage Demon King, the demon gas between heaven and earth rolled tumultuously, forming dozens of hundred-meter-sized demon claws that struck at Number One, eclipsing the Firmament.
With the enhancement of that formidable Law Power, each demon claw contained Terrifying Power, the force so strong that space itself twisted and sunk, displaying astonishing might.
Bang bang bang!!
The thirty-six massive demon claws struck the body of Number One, only to be blocked by a golden force field a few hundred meters away, radiating circles of Golden Rhombus Halos, utterly immovable.
Roar! Number One’s mouth gaped in an inhuman roar, its muscles began to swell, stretching out its mecha.
At the same time, the cockpit inside its body flashed with a blinding red light.
“Warning, Synchronization Rate has surpassed one hundred percent, reaching one hundred and one, one hundred and fifteen percent…”
“Warning, sixty percent of Number One’s restraining armor is released. Warning, Number One is entering Destruction Form Rampage…”
As it freed itself from one restraining armor piece after another, Number One’s body began to swell, rapidly growing to over four hundred meters tall, becoming a fearsome dark golden monster.
The sudden transformation stunned the Demon King that had just struck, as well as the other Demon King pouncing towards the War Pattern Legion from afar.
What does it mean to switch into another mode and erupt in power without even making a move in the fight’s beginning?
Looking at the dark golden monster with the continuously breaking space around it, and the increasingly terrifying Aura spreading between heaven and earth, the two Demon Kings, in the Late and Mid Mythical Stages, felt an instinctive fear.
Whiz!
The Number One that had ballooned to over four hundred meters and entered Rampage Mode, its eyes shining with Radiance, fired two blue and white Light Beams, which instantly appeared in front of the two Demon Kings.
“Be careful!”
Boom boom!! The Super God Beam shattered the space with one strike, exploding the dark domains around the two Demon Kings and their True Bodies, spraying their blood in countless fragments.
From the moment Jack wielded his power to the moment Number One blew away the True Bodies of two Demon Kings, everything had taken place within a few breaths of time, and the overwhelming power they demonstrated took all the demon kings and the Great Demon King on the battlefield by surprise.
“So strong!”
“Be wary of those two humans.”
At the edge of the Plane Battlefield, where two Late Stage Titan Great Demon Kings were besieging Anstice, one of them exclaimed in shock. The Hexagonal Great Demon King roared, “Amand, I’ll stop her; you go deal with those two humans.”
The demonstration of strength by Jack Clark and Number One had upset the balance of the battlefield, as demon kings of equal rank were faltering in a single strike against them.
Although they couldn’t inflict heavy injuries on those Demon Kings due to their current Mythical Realm power limits, restoring a True Body required a massive expenditure of Origin.
If their True Forms were obliterated repeatedly, even Demon Kings would eventually be ground down to nothing.
“Thinking of escaping without asking me?”
Boom!
In an instant, a figure akin to a Seraph erupted with dazzling light, its infinite Divine Light casting white flames that consumed all, igniting a roaring inferno of white fire.
Even the Law Worlds revolving around those two Great Demon Kings, including the Laws themselves, were set ablaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1351 - 1351 518 Dominating the Battlefield Frenzied
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1351: Chapter 518 Dominating the Battlefield, Frenzied Slaughter_3 Chapter 1351: Chapter 518 Dominating the Battlefield, Frenzied Slaughter_3 Meanwhile, above the Firmament, a golden vortex spun as a white huge sword nearly ten kilometers long descended from the sky, burning with even more intense white flames, as if heaven’s punishment had arrived.
The formless aura of destruction startled both Great Demon Kings.
In the instant the two Great Demon Kings were entangled, Number One, in its Rampage Mode, did not go after the two Demon Kings who were reshaping their True Bodies; instead, it suddenly plunged downward.
Boom! In an instant, covering hundreds of kilometers, Number One landed on the battlefield below with blood light bursting forth, forming a shockwave that swept across a hundred-kilometer radius.
Bang Bang Bang!!
As the blood light swept through, more than two hundred thousand Sixth-Layer Heaven Purgatory True Demons and those from the Fourth Layer Heaven above from the Demonized Alien Race all exploded, including thousands from the Heavenly Feather Clan caught in the blast.
Whoosh!
In the instant of eradicating more than a couple hundred thousand Transcendent lives, Number One emitted a strong suction force; countless bursting blood droplets mixed with invisible Soul Power rushed towards Number One, forming a massive blood river.
In the blink of an eye, Number One had devoured a large chunk of the battlefield.
With the absorption and devouring of the flesh and souls of more than two hundred thousand Senior creatures, Number One’s size crackled and swelled to over four hundred eighty meters, and the aura it radiated grew even more terrifying.
Such a horrifying scene shocked the Demon Kings and the Purgatory True Demons in the distance once more, making them wonder whether they were the demons or these humans were the demons? Why did it feel like one was more ruthless than the other?
The scene of Number One indiscriminately devouring everything also caused many of the Heavenly Feather Gods to frown, and the surrounding Heavenly Feather soldiers, who had been excited and agitated, were somewhat taken aback.
It was at this moment that Jack Clark’s voice echoed across the battlefield.
“Friends of the Heavenly Feather Clan, be careful; that Mecha is a Biological Weapon created by my tribe. Although it is powerful, it is still in its experimental phase.”
“Just now, Number One autonomously entered Rampage Mode when threatened by the powerful Demon Kings, failing to distinguish friend from foe. Please do not approach within a hundred-kilometer radius of it.”
As he spoke, Jack’s figure vanished, followed by a kilometer-long Black Gold Halberd Skill sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
Bang Bang Bang!! The three Demon Kings, who had just reformed, were blown apart again, and the powerful impact swept across tens of kilometers, annihilating everything.
Roar!
Number One roared with blood light swirling around it; the golden barrier around trembled, emitting concentric rhombus halos, blocking the overwhelming attacks from the two Demon Kings.
Inside Number One, driving through the Void, Freya Louise looked indifferent, without a trace of emotional fluctuation, as if she stood outside Heaven and Earth, quietly watching everything that was happening here.
Roar!
Number One let out a fierce roar under the attack of the two Demon Kings, but did not counterattack, instead ignoring their assaults and diving toward the ground below.
In the churning Dark Demon Cloud below, millions from the Demonized Alien Race and the True Demon Legion gathered, stepping on clouds as substantial as reality, battling with the Heavenly Feather Clan above.
Compared to the panic caused by devouring a Demon King and the ‘energy’ obtained, it was naturally more worthwhile to wipe out more than a hundred thousand Transcendent creatures and devour their flesh and souls all at once.
As for those Demon Kings, they could be saved for last as a treat.
After multiple instances of hundred percent Soul Synchronization, and even entering the Primordial Form once, Freya realized that what Number One really needed was not the energy from flesh, but from souls.
It needed to devour large amounts of high-quality Soul Energy to recover its Primordial Form.
Boom!
A dark-golden beast nearly five hundred meters tall fell from the sky; instantly, a ring of blood light shockwaves erupted at its center, sweeping across a hundred kilometers in an instant, causing the True Bodies of countless Purgatory True Demons to explode.
As the Demon Kings could not stop it, Number One began a frenzied massacre.

chapters.title: Chapter 1352 - 1352 519 Treading on the Light of Time
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1352: Chapter 519: Treading on the Light of Time, Suppressing a Boundary Chapter 1352: Chapter 519: Treading on the Light of Time, Suppressing a Boundary The Mythical World
The red sun had already set, while the Great Blue Sun hung across the sky, casting a gloomy blue radiance; beneath its glow, all living beings instinctively felt a chill.
Above the realm, on the other side of the golden sky curtain spanning Heaven and Earth and a million kilometers apart, dark clouds churned in the Firmament, so thick that not even sunlight could penetrate.
Beneath the Dark Heavens and Earth of this world, the Earth was cracked, filled with fissures from which dark red magma flowed, belching plumes of black poisonous smoke as it churned.
In this hellish place, not a sign of life was to be seen; vegetation lay withered, and trees that had once towered hundreds, thousands of meters now were but bare, blackened trunks, their twisted forms like ghastly claws.
Compared to the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire locked in combat with the Human Race, the three major empires that attacked the Heavenly Feather Clan were more fearsome, polluting everything, leading to the extinction of living beings.
Above the land, a mountain peak rose tens of thousands of meters high; atop it sat a colossal demon king’s fortress, with dark demon air swirling around it.
The fortress’s main hall was a skull of dragon-type Giant Beasts, a thousand meters tall, with three pairs of hundreds of meters long, sharp dragon horns reaching into the dark clouds, a sight both solemn and terrifying.
At that moment, amid the dragon horns, stood a five-meter-tall Purgatory True Demon, hands clasped behind its back.
This Purgatory True Demon’s features greatly resembled Ilisa Zabel, her face covered with dark golden scales; she had horns on her head, bat-like wings on her back, and a sharp tail.
Gazing towards the horizon where a giant black vortex touched the sky, Left Demon spoke in a deep voice, “You can’t wait to make your move despite not yet having made your breakthrough to Demon God Level.”
Boom!
A terrifying will descended amidst the churning dark clouds, making the clouds rotate and forming a gigantic Demon God face, tens of thousands of meters in size, whose majestic will shook the Void.
“Cortes, has your other True Body come?”
“Yes, he has.”
Left Demon nodded slightly, “I had planned to deal with the Heavenly Feather Clan before going to the Human Race to force him into battling, but I didn’t expect him to come knocking on my door.”
The Demon God’s Will resonated with a powerful and dignified voice.
“Good, you’ve made a breakthrough to the peak of Great Demon Kings and entered awakening. If you absorb your final True Body, you should be able to step into the Demon God Realm.”
“With the last True Body absorbed, I am one hundred percent confident I can make the breakthrough.”
Left Demon’s eyes sharpened, and she spoke in a low voice, “Although I vaguely sense his arrival, a force is shielding him, preventing me from determining his location.”
The Demon God’s Will said coldly, “It’s simple. Your target is each other, just step out of the Demon Domain, and he will naturally come to you.”
“On the battlefield of the Eternal Divine Domain, some strong men from the Human Race have appeared, and the attack is stalled. Since you’ve come out of seclusion, you might as well take care of it.”
“The Human Race… has appeared here,” mused Left Demon, her eyes narrowing slightly.
“The Heavenly Feather Clan must have forged an alliance with that member of the Human Race, sending some of their strength to offer support. Perhaps your other True Body is hidden among them.”
“So it is. I shall take a look at the Frontline Battlefield then.” With a faint hint of remorse, the Purgatory True Demon covered in purple-gold scales vanished without a trace.
With Left Demon’s departure, the gigantic face of the Demon God in the Firmament also disintegrated.
In the raging depths of the Space Interlayer, a golden Light sphere of a million kilometers in diameter shone brilliantly, its center a majestic Golden Divine Tree standing tens of thousands of kilometers tall.
However, around the Light sphere, boundless Dark Demon Air churned, forming shadows of Nine-headed Evil Dragons tens of thousands of kilometers in length, savagely tearing at the golden Light sphere.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Around the golden Light sphere, golden gears like Star Rings spun, annihilating everything in their path, grinding the Dark Demon Dragons into oblivion, their collisions unleashing a Terrifying Power that shook Space-Time.
At the edge of the Light sphere, four colossal figures stood firm, their heights reaching tens of thousands of meters; they shone with the light of rules in resonance with the Eternal Divine Tree, emitting a heavy, suppressive aura that weighed down Heaven and Earth.
Confronting the four Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather were eight Demon Gods showing their True Bodies, arrayed in all directions, their Demon God’s Bodies tens of thousands of meters tall, standing amidst the rolling Dark Demon Air.
Behind each of the eight Demon Gods, a portion of the Abyss World emerged, invisibly emitting an aura of darkness and supreme evil that spread desolation.
Among the eight Demon Gods, the one with the most terrifying presence sat on a giant beast skull about ten thousand meters in size, made of gray rock.
Likewise having slain an ancient creature, using its skull as a throne, this Demon God clearly had slain a stronger ancient being than the one whose skull was under Diorus, which had been refined to a mere few hundred meters.
Seated high on the ancient throne, the Demon God’s voice vibrated through the Void, “Metastat, do you think by pulling in a few experts from the Human Race, you can save your tribe from annihilation?”
Within the golden Light sphere, endless White Light shone like a Great Sun. At the center of the White Light was a figure with twelve white light wings, reminiscent of an angel of creation.
As Divine Light flowed, a venerable and commanding voice slowly rose, “I do not know whether we can avert our fate of annihilation, but I do know you still don’t dare to step into the Eternal Domain.”
“Metastat, don’t waste your efforts; provocation won’t work on us.”
“Indeed, we are wary of the Eternal Tree. Our True Bodies temporarily cannot enter the Domain, but do you think you can hold out for much longer?”
The creation angel-like figure spoke indifferently, “Who will win and who will lose is yet to be determined.”
The Eternal Tree had already been eroded, its nine layers of planes polluted and turned into the Abyss.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1353: Chapter 519: Treading Through Time, Suppressing a Boundary_2 Chapter 1353: Chapter 519: Treading Through Time, Suppressing a Boundary_2 At this moment, five peripheral planes were also being shadowed by the dark invasion, their projections surfacing, filled with countless Purgatory True Demons and demonized alien races furiously clashing with the Heavenly Feather warriors.
Those Purgatory True Demons and their vassal alien races were extensions of their rule and will.
If they could flatten those five planes and reach the trunk of the Eternal Divine Tree, they would be able to draw upon the power of the Supreme Abyss and corrupt the entire domain.
Therefore, in the three fiercely contested battlefields, those Human Race Heavenly King strongmen and the War Pattern Mech Legion that suddenly appeared were immediately discovered by several Demon Gods.
The presence of humans was not unfamiliar to the existences at the Demon God level of the Eight Great Empires, just as Diorus and the others were aware of the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan and another battlefield.
However, the rest of the Six Great Demon God Empires had not cared or paid attention to the Human Race, a common civilization.
After all, not even Diorus and other Demon Gods, let alone two Empires, considered each other worthy of their attention, let alone a common minor tribe that had fought with them for more than two hundred Sun Wheels.
Regrettably, this Heavenly Feather tribe was cowering in the Eternal Domain.
The vitality level of that Eternal Divine Tree had already taken half a step into the Ancestral True Spirit level, with a huge and boundless True Body, possessing a sea-like vastness of Rule Origin.
Together with the protection of those Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, even with their overwhelming advantage, they could only gradually corrupt and erode the tree.
…
“Fools, attacking five planes simultaneously. Do they not understand the principle that it’s better to break one finger than to injure ten?”
Standing atop a Titan Demon Dragon that was over two kilometers in body length, Left Demon, standing five meters tall with his hands behind his back on the already contaminated ninth-level plane, looked on with a cold gaze.
A peak Great Demon King with three heads and eight arms, standing over two thousand meters tall on the Earth, was surrounded by swirling Dark Demon Air.
Facing the diminutive Left Demon’s criticism, the peak Great Demon King did not rebut, only offering a wry smile, “Cortes, I too wish to gather all my forces and storm one plane.”
“But the problem is, I can only mobilize the Demon King Legion; I have no authority over the legions of the other two empires aiming for those planes.”
Left Demon snorted coldly, though he knew that this was not the fault of the Great Demon King.
Without his restraint, the objective of the legions spreading out and attacking five planes at the same time was obvious—the planes of the Eternal Domain were overlapped in space-time, not in a straight line or stackally arranged.
Therefore, each of the planes was very close to the main trunk of the divine tree.
Left Demon slowly began to speak, his voice deep and frosty: “Talrodel, immediately notify all legions from the three major empires to pull all frontline forces to launch an assault on the twelfth plane.”
“Within a Star Hour (a day and a half), I want this plane to be captured.”
“Tell them, any who defy the command shall be executed, whether they be demon kings or Great Demon Kings. Should anyone dare disobey my orders, I will personally take action to suppress them.”
Left Demon’s words made the peak Great Demon King’s expression tense, but he knew the other party was not joking.
Since Left Demon appeared on the Heavenly Feather battlefield years ago and assumed command of the three major empires’ legions as a late-period Great Demon King, he had already executed three rebellious demon kings and one Great Demon King.
He had even ruthlessly slaughtered the five vassal races that followed those demon kings in defiance, killing millions in a bloodthirsty manner.
The thirteenth plane.
The over five-hundred-meter-tall dark gold Number One let out a ferocious roar and suddenly turned around, its eyes shooting out two blue and white light beams that obliterated the Void.
“Be careful!”
The two pursuing Demon Kings were startled, but prepared, they teleported instantly to a spot tens of kilometers away to dodge.
Boom, boom!!
The blue and white light beams were terrifyingly powerful, obliterating everything in their path and forming two black pathways over two hundred kilometers long and a kilometer wide.
In the instant it repelled the two demon kings, Number One pounced towards a location hundreds of kilometers away.
There, a high-order True Demon Squad, a thousand feet in size, commanded an army of a hundred thousand demonized vassal legions besieging a floating island fortress.
Boom! With a blood-colored shockwave, the sprawling vassal legion within a hundred-kilometer radius exploded into a blood mist in the sky.
As blood light surged, the floating island, hundreds of kilometers in diameter, shook wildly, exploding rocks and roaring fortifications containing Golden Leaves, turning the complexions of the Heavenly Feather soldiers inside pale with fright.
More fearsome than dying in battle against True Demons, they were afraid to explode and perish under the blood light, devoured by that terrifying dark gold monster.
Roar! With the devouring of numerous Transcendent lifeforms, flesh, and souls, Number One’s aura surged again, growing more terrifying still.
Watching the beast shrouded in blood light, the two chasing Demon Kings slowed their pursuit.
In the mere minutes since these humans entered the battlefield, this monster had already devoured eight of their vassal legions and a million from the two Main Battle Legions.
Woo! From the turbulent Dark Demon Cloud below, a horn imbued with the pressure of a Demon God’s might sounded a deep and rumbling retreat, catching all True Demons and demon kings off guard.
At this moment, every demon king and Great Demon King grimaced as the highest orders from Left Demon came through the imperial communication emblems they wore.
This scene unfolded simultaneously on the tenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth planes, all engaged in combat.
With a deep glance at the black-haired young man who was suppressing three demon kings in the sky, with casual blows shattering their True Bodies, the two Great Demon Kings entangled by Anstice exchanged a look.
Boom!!
A terrifying aura erupted from The Hexagonal Great Demon King, and a ten-kilometer-wide dark red moon emerged behind him, radiating a bloody scarlet light, and exploded.
