chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1354: Chapter 519: Treading on the Light of Time, Suppressing a Boundary_3 Chapter 1354: Chapter 519: Treading on the Light of Time, Suppressing a Boundary_3 An instant was like the shattering of a world; even Anstice was forced backward by the terrifying force of destruction.
When the Hexagonal Demon King unleashed his bloodline divine power and struck Anstice back, another Great Demon King’s voice, cold as ice, thundered through heaven and earth, “The Grand Marshal has ordered all legions to withdraw from this plane immediately!”
All the Purgatory True Demons covering a battlefield of tens of kilometers were taken aback.
“…Yes.”
Roar roar roar!!
At the command of the various army commanders, the legions that had been embroiled in a savage slaughter began to pull away from the battlefield, with demonized Giants, war behemoths, plunging toward the churning demon clouds below.
The sudden turn of events also caught Jack Clark off guard.
No, I haven’t even warmed up. I was planning to lay low, conceal my strength, and gradually take out some demon kings. Why are you suddenly withdrawing now?
Looking at Number One, which had barely sustained any damage, Jane Aiken who was surrounded by sweeping sword light, and the Mecha army forming the War Pattern Legion that enveloped the Splitting Sky Sword King while entangling the late-stage demon king from the Mythical Peak Realm, Jack Clark sighed.
“It seems I have to reveal some of my cards.”
In the midst of his sigh, Jack Clark swung his War Halberd, and a Black Gold radiance surged, transforming into a kilometer-long Halberd Skill that materialized in front of Todes—who had just reconstituted his True Body—tens of kilometers away.
Boom! The demon king, whose Aura had weakened from having his True Body shattered five times consecutively, exploded once again.
Jack Clark, holding a halberd, looked up into the sky, “Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan, I’m about to go all out to retain these Purgatory Legions and demon kings. Help me block the might of the opposing Demon Gods.”
A calm voice resonated across the entire plane, and in an instant, an Aura that terrified all Great Demon Kings and demon kings erupted.
Boom boom boom!!
With Jack Clark as the center, infinite Golden-White flames spread in all directions, instantly enveloping a hundred kilometers as if a Great Sun was suspended above.
The terrifying invisible high temperature emitted vaporized everything between heaven and earth as if a red solar corona covered a two-hundred-kilometer radius.
Two floating islands each tens of kilometers in diameter, shrouded by the corona, saw their trees ignite and turn to ash in the blink of an eye, while rock and dirt continuously melted into magma that flowed downward.
Besides that, purple lightning encircled the Golden-White fireball, shattering space wherever it passed, leaving behind long-lasting black cracks that failed to heal.
At the center of the Golden-White fireball, Jack Clark, now in an eight-armed form, wields an Eight Desolate Battle Halberd that is a kilometer long, recklessly emitting strength that has surged to an extreme frenzy.
Under that overbearing power that was emitted invisibly, everything in Jack Clark’s surroundings, including light, was distorted and collapsed under the terrifying mass of his True Body.
Under the pressure almost akin to the peak of Great Demon Kings, all powerful beings above the Ninth Heavens within tens of thousands of kilometers gazed in terror towards the horizon.
This included the fourteen demon kings who were about to withdraw, as well as the two Great Demon Kings.
However, after just a moment of shock, the Hexagonal Great Demon King roared in madness, “Retreat, retreat!”
The Mythical Peak Realm, manifesting a True Body and surprisingly skipping an entire Major Realm, was emitting an invisible oppressive weight that was no less formidable than that beast.
But as the demon kings snapped to attention, the strong beings of the Heavenly Feather Clan felt equally shocked and exhilarated.
Anstice, suppressing the surprise in her eyes, let out a long howl as an eight-hundred-meter-tall angelic phantom raised its battle sword high, “Stop them, don’t let them get away.”
Boom boom boom!!
All the demon kings and the powerful of the Heavenly Feather Clan went into a frenzy, chaos enveloping the Plane Battlefield.
Simultaneously, the dark demon clouds rolling down below shook explosively as a formidable Will descended, with countless Dark Tentacles each thousands of meters long bursting into the sky.
“Oroberna, have you forgotten that this is my territory?”
Boom!
Above the firmament, golden light shined bright as another Supreme Level Will descended, with beams of golden light falling from the sky, penetrating the heavens and the earth to obliterate those dark tentacles.
From the moment Jack Clark displayed his True Body until the entire plane was in an uproar, everything happened within a few seconds, with demon kings, Heavenly Feather Gods, and Gods and Demon Gods outside the plane all reacting instantly.
Especially the Demon Gods from outside the plane, they wanted to intervene forcefully and suppress Jack Clark, enabling those demon kings and legions to withdraw and minimize their losses.
Naturally, the opposing Divine King of the Heavenly Feather wouldn’t accommodate their wishes.
“Only a part of your Will can descend, hindering you from unleashing much ‘power,’ right?”
Standing tall within the Great Sun, Jack Clark looked indifferently at the colliding Wills, filled with confidence as he sensed the strength that the opposing Demon God could muster.
It seems the Heavenly Feather Clan is not so weak after all, being able to block an enemy Demon God on their own territory. Since that’s the case, let’s keep them all here today.
“Freya Louise, directly consume these three guys.”
In the chill of his voice, three streams of purple radiance pierced through heaven and earth, flying toward Number One a thousand kilometers away.
The three streams of purple light were three weakened demon kings. The moment Jack Clark revealed his True Body, they were suppressed by the Higher-order Law of Purple Heaven Thunder without any chance to resist.
If it weren’t for the purpose of leaving them as food for Number One, those three demon kings would have been annihilated by the Death Law in that instant of eruption.
After cultivation reached grand accomplishment, the Death Law finally demonstrated its true might, defining death, erasing all signs of vitality from any living being.
Even those purportedly Undying demon kings.
Boom! The hundred-kilometer-diameter Golden-White Great Sun fell from the sky like a collapsing star, crashing into the rolling Dark Demon Clouds below with a thunderous impact.
[Two thousand more words to be edited, please refresh in half an hour, heading for a complete slaughter today]

Watching the beast shrouded in blood light, the two Demon Kings following behind couldn’t help but hesitate in their steps.

This scene took place simultaneously on the engaged planes numbered ten, fifteen, and sixteen.
Taking a deep look at the black-haired young man in the sky suppressing the three Demon Kings, easily bursting their True Bodies with a casual strike, the two Great Demon Kings entangled by Anstice exchanged a glance.
Boom!!

With a sigh, Jack waved his War Halberd, and a black gold radiance grew into a kilometer-long Halberd Skill, appearing in front of Todes, who was just reconstructing his True Body tens of kilometers away.
Bang! The Demon King, whose Aura was weak and had its True Body burst for the fifth consecutive time, exploded again.
Jack stood holding his halberd, raising his head towards the sky, “Your Excellency the Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan, I’m going to go all out next to keep these Purgatory Legions and demon kings. Please help me block the might of the opposing Demon Gods.”
His indifferent voice echoed through the entire plane, and in an instant, an Aura of terror that made all demon kings and Great Demon Kings tremble erupted.
Boom, boom, boom!!
From Jack as the center, endless golden-white flames spread in all directions, in the blink of an eye engulfing a hundred kilometers, as if a Great Sun were hanging aloft.

Apart from that, around the golden-white fireball, purple lightning twirled, shattering space wherever it passed, creating lasting black cracks that could not heal for a long time.
At the center of the golden-white fireball, Jack Clark had transformed into a form with three faces and eight arms, wielding the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd that was a kilometer long, unrestrainedly radiating energy that was violent to the extreme.
Under that invisible overbearing force, everything around Jack Clark was distorting and collapsing, including the light which was warped by his terrifyingly massive true form.
Under that terrifying aura, comparable to the peak of a Great Demon King, all powerful lives above the Ninth Heavens within tens of thousands of kilometers looked towards the sky in horror.
That included the fourteen demon kings and the two Great Demon Kings who were preparing to retreat.
However, after being stunned for just an instant, the Hexagonal Great Demon King bellowed furiously, “Retreat, retreat!”
At the Mythical Peak realm, after manifesting his true form, he had directly crossed over a Major Realm. That invisible oppressive force was even no less than that of the monster.
But just as the demon kings realized what was happening, the strong members of the Heavenly Feather Clan were equally shocked and excited.
Anstice suppressed the surprise in her eyes and let out a long howl. The eight-hundred-meter-tall angelic apparition lifted the battle sword high. “Stop them, don’t let them escape.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
All the demon kings and Heavenly Feather strong members went into a frenzy, and the whole Plane Battlefield turned into chaos.

Bang!

Naturally, the Heavenly Feather Divine King opposing them would not oblige.

If not for leaving them as food for Number One, the three Demon Kings would have been eradicated by the Death Law in the burst earlier.

Even for the so-called Undying demon kings.

﻿Chapter 1356: Chapter 520: Sweeping Through All Directions, The Gaze of Fate Chapter 1356: Chapter 520: Sweeping Through All Directions, The Gaze of Fate Above the firmament, massive golden light beams, hundreds of meters thick and imbued with the Divine King’s will, descended from the heavens, striking down upon the Dark Demon Clouds that shrouded the plane below.
After the destruction of the plane rifts, the Dark Demon Clouds, which enveloped half of the plane, also lost the bolstering of the Demon God’s will and continuously dissipated and melted away under the golden pillars.
What shocked everyone the most were the nine figures standing in the firmament, all clad in black imperial robes with identical faces, whose late-stage Heavenly King-level oppressive might swept across Heaven and Earth.
No words were wasted when the nine Imperial Robed True Bodies appeared over the tens of thousands of kilometers battlefield; they struck down boldly, setting their sights on the remaining forty Demon Kings.
Boom!
The nine Imperial Robed True Bodies manifested the Three-Headed Six-Armed True Demon God Bodies, wielding the phantoms of War Halberds that were hundreds of meters long, enwreathed with golden flames and blue thunder.
“Be careful!”
“Run, don’t foolishly try to block them.”
The Demon Kings targeted by the Imperial Robed True Bodies were panic-stricken, their bodies engulfed in raging dark flames that soared into the sky, choosing to burn their origins in an Instantaneous Explosion, shaking off the Heavenly Feather Gods that entangled them.
Boom!
One of the Three-Headed Six-Armed Demon Kings exploded, turning into dozens of black streaks of light that flew in all directions, aiming for the continually collapsing dark clouds below.
The other Demon Kings desperately fled; one spat blood that spread across its body, forming dark red demon patterns, breaking out at a terrifying speed of a hundred times the speed of sound and vanishing.
There is but a single realm separating Mythical-level from Heavenly King-level, under normal conditions, the difference in strength isn’t significant.
For example, a late period Mythical-strong man facing an early stage Heavenly King-level strong man can hold out for a few moves and might have the chance to burn his origin and explosively flee.
After all, every life capable of reaching Mythical-level is a talent with monstrous gifts, involved in many Secret Skills and Divine Powers over the course of several hundreds or thousands of years of cultivation.
However, early and late stages of Heavenly King are two different concepts entirely; facing a being on the verge of finishing the Heavenly King stage and nurturing rules, a Mythical-level Powerhouse stands no chance at all.
Not to mention a monster that had mastered five Higher-order Laws.
Boom!
Five golden semi-circular Halberd Skills traversed the firmament, expanding while radiating blinding light, and had already surged to several kilometers across when they appeared above the heads of five Demon Kings, like lightning.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Endless golden flames erupted, forming five suns over five thousand meters in diameter, with golden fire dragons circling around, unleashing terrifying heat and sharp Halberd Skill.
The five Demon Kings had only time to let out a scream before their encircling Dark Domains and True Demon King Bodies were shredded by the fierce energies, followed by instantaneous melting under the released high temperatures of the Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial.
The moment the five suns appeared, eight two-thousand-meter-long blue Halberd Skills swept across Heaven and Earth, at speeds so swift—over a thousand kilometers in a second—they appeared above the eight fleeing Demon Kings.
Spurt!
Compared to the Heavenly Flame Dragon Burial, the True Thunder Instant Slash was characterized by sharpness and speed, like a blue lightning bolt, instantly slicing through Law Domains, True Demon King Bodies, and space, creating pitch-black cracks that were two thousand meters wide and over a hundred kilometers long.
At the instant when the eight Imperial Robed True Bodies, separated by tens of thousands of kilometers, took action, the final True Body unfolded a boundless Sea of Blood that covered a range of a hundred kilometers.
Within the gleam of blood light, the immense face of a ghostly deity emerged, and a three-thousand-meter-long Halberd Skill, wrapped in thunder and flames, descended ‘slowly’ from the sky.
Before the terrifying strike even hit, the space formed layers of transparent shockwaves under the immense force, instilling fear in every True Demon of the Purgatory Legion that was standing by in tight formation below.
Compared to the fleeing Demon Kings, twelve hundred thousand Purgatory Elites stood staunch on the dark clouds roiling with demon gas, with a Mythical Peak Demon King at the center forming an encompassing firmament Demon Array.
What was originally contending with this main elite force was a Heavenly Feather War Fortress, an island floating in the air with a diameter of hundreds of kilometers that almost resembled a Golden War City, radiating dazzling light.
The Demon King, reaching over eight hundred meters tall and clad in Thorn Dark Demon Armor, looked up to the sky with its three heads and roared ferociously, “Killing me won’t be that easy.”
Boom!
The Thorn Demon King’s six arms swelled, drawing upon all the power of the great array, transforming into a two-thousand-meter tall Demon God Illusion wielding a three-thousand-meter warhammer to meet the descending War Halberd.
But in the blink of an eye, the warhammer shrouded in rolling Dark Demon Air clashed with the black-gray War Halberd that had fallen from the sky.
Boom!
In that moment, the sky shattered and the Void collapsed, releasing the boundless power of four Higher-order Laws to form a twenty-something-kilometer-wide four-colored Light Sphere.
And just as the sphere expanded to its limit, it suddenly collapsed, forming a vortex within. The space continued to crumble until completely shattered, turning into a pitch-black spot akin to a Black Hole.
The instant that black hole-like spot appeared, an overwhelming gravitational force that twisted space-time emerged, devouring everything within a hundred kilometers in the blink of an eye and forming a pitch-black Hollow.
Within that range, Heavenly Earth Laws vanished, all things perished, as if a chunk of the entire world had been bitten away, including those hundred thousand Purgatory True Demons and the Demon King.
Such a terrifying strike left even the Heavenly Feather Gods within the distant Gold Fortress shivering.
From the moment the nine Imperial Robed True Bodies took action to the obliteration of fourteen Demon Kings, it all happened within a few seconds, with fourteen Mythical-level Demon Kings suppressed without a chance to resist.
Indeed, suppressed, not utterly erased, for these Demon Kings were nourishment for the growth of Number One, and to directly eradicate them would have been too wasteful.
In the centers of those riotously exploding areas where the True Bodies of the Demon Kings burst apart, Dark Flames burned; amidst the blazing fires, the True Forms of the Demon Kings reassembled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1357 - 1357 520 Sweeping Across the Eight Directions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1357: Chapter 520: Sweeping Across the Eight Directions, A Glance of Destiny_2 Chapter 1357: Chapter 520: Sweeping Across the Eight Directions, A Glance of Destiny_2 However, on the bodies of these demon kings, there were flames materializing into reality, with chains of the Lightning Law wrapped around them, suppressing the source of the Laws within as if they were cocooned in light.
Beyond that, a massive black imprint, dozens of meters across and ethereal in nature, floated above the weakened demon kings’ heads.
Under the projection of the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, imbued with the Soul Law, the divine souls of all the demon kings trembled, unable to muster any strength, their eyes filled with despair and terror.
In an instant, sweeping across Heaven and Earth and suppressing fourteen demon kings, the nine true forms clad in imperial robes standing above the Firmament slightly clenched their hands, making a clawing motion.
Bang Bang Bang!!
Arms of some demon kings shattered, chests of others exploded, and from their bodies flew storage rings, black demon scales, strange bones, and other storage equipment.
“Freya, they are yours now,” a detached voice said, as the nine true forms clad in imperial robes vanished without a trace, leaving behind countless stunned Purgatory True Demons and Heavenly Feather soldiers.
At the edge of the Plane, Jack Clark, with a War Halberd in hand and three faces with eight arms, stood in the Void, opposite Anstice, a kilometer away to the left and right, blocking the two Great Demon Kings.
Just a few seconds after disappearing, the nine true forms clad in imperial robes reappeared without making a sound, scattering in all directions, surrounding the two Great Demon Kings who had no time to flee.
This scene made the Great Demon Kings Buddy and Hexagon look very grave.
Looking at the Eight-armed Demon God standing in the midst of golden flames, Buddy’s voice was somber, “Human, your strength is formidable, but we are confident that, before our downfall, we can inflict a heavy injury upon you.”
“You are not a ‘Person’ from the Heavenly Feather Clan; there’s no need to fight so hard for them. How about you step aside, and in return, we can offer ample compensation?”
Jack Clark paused at the demon king’s words, not expecting to be threatened at this juncture.
Before Jack could speak, Anstice’s gentle yet firm voice came from afar, “Ally, don’t believe them. These Great Demon Kings are cunning and deceitful. They’re only saying this to buy time.”
“I’ll block their counterattack. You just go ahead and strike, don’t worry about me.”
“Merely two Great Demon Kings, and they dare to threaten me.”
A deep voice echoed through Heaven and Earth, and in an instant, including Jack Clark’s original form, ten terrifying auras erupted, shaking the entire Plane at that moment.
Boom Boom Boom!!
A dazzling light lit up half the Plane. Ten Great Suns, each a hundred kilometers in diameter, appeared in the sky, and the invisible force of destruction made a thousand kilometers of space-time tremble and distort.
Roar!
Faced with a formidable sense of death, the two Great Demon Kings let out insane roars, their blood erupting as they burned fifty percent of their origin and their bloodlines all at once.
In an instant, the aura of the two Great Demon Kings surged, their huge true forms of the Demon King swelling to over 1,700 meters, with boundless Black Demon Air swirling around them like World-Destroying Demon Kings.
At the same time, in their eight demon palms, ancient stone towers, bizarre bone giant swords, and broken bronze curved knives, among other relic items, appeared, immediately spreading a desolate ancient aura all around.
In the instant that the ten golden-white Great Suns descended, an ancient silhouette of a different race stood with a sword behind Buddy, the Great Demon King, radiating a steadfast protective spirit.
Beyond that, a murky river, as if descending from the underworld, wound through the Void, and below, a giant ghost head manifested, screaming as it grasped the broken stone tower.
At this moment, in a space-time twisted and sealed off in extremis, the two Great Demon Kings unleashed all their tricks, only to be immediately engulfed by the burning heat of the ten Great Suns.
Boom! A full-force nuclear explosion from the nine true forms clad in imperial robes, coupled with Jack Clark’s casting of the Demon God Battle Skill, World-Destroying Great Sun, caused the entire Plane to tremble wildly.
The moment when the ten Suns merged into one, it was as if a real Star had appeared, forming a rotating halo thousands of kilometers in diameter, radiating endless light and heat.
Around the Stellar Sun, terrifying Destructive Impacts formed nine rings of golden light, each tens of kilometers thick, sweeping over ten thousand kilometers, with Void Islands collapsing, melting, vanishing everything in their path.
The aftermath of the horrifying explosion made Anstice change color, her six white wings spread furiously behind her, forming a ten-kilometer diameter Light sphere.
Boom!
As the golden halo swept over, the Law-compressed white Light sphere quaked, the surrounding space shattered, and a powerful force directly blasted it thousands of kilometers away.
The powerful energy fluctuations left all the beings of the Plane in awe, still not recovered from the shock of the suppression of the demon kings, they instinctively looked in that direction.
Though tens of thousands of kilometers away, all the Purgatory True Demons, Heavenly Feather soldiers, and human Transcendent Warriors saw the light that shone across the world.
And while all the ‘People’ were stunned in shock, Number One was filled with excitement.
Roar! The dark golden beast let out an excited and ferocious howl, turning into a flash of dark golden light in the sky, appearing instantly in front of a demon king, reaching out with a palm.
Boom!
Under the force of the Invisible Power, the more than six hundred meters tall demon king, along with the surrounding space collapsed, shrank to just over ten meters, grabbed by Number One and stuffed straight into its mouth.
In an instant, a Blood Moon emerged in the sky, then swiftly fell.
At the same time, the blood light on Number One surged, its aura growing even more terrifying.
Crackle Crackle!! The more than five hundred meters tall Number One swelled up, its powerful muscles nearly bursting the remaining armor on its body, emitting cracking sounds.
However, the armor covering Number One’s chest, shoulders, and lower body was crafted to restrain Number One and possessed a degree of elasticity, expanding as it grew in size.
After devouring three demon kings previously and continuing with a fourth, Number One rapidly grew to over six hundred meters tall, a tail covered in bone spurs extended out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1358 - 1358 520 Sweeping Across the Eight Directions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1358: Chapter 520: Sweeping Across the Eight Directions, A Glance of Destiny_3 Chapter 1358: Chapter 520: Sweeping Across the Eight Directions, A Glance of Destiny_3 The intangible, fierce aura awoke the surrounding Purgatory True Demons lost in a daze, and dozens of Nine Demonic Marks peak Purgatory True Demons roared with rage.
“All Vassal legions, Giant Beast legions, and Flying legions, regroup with the Main Battle Legions, converge towards the location of the Rift Channel below, and wait for rescue from His Majesty the Demon God.”
The Purgatory True Demons’ Main Battle Legions were primarily composed of Six Demonic Marks true demons, with those of Seven Demon Marks as centurions and those of Eight Path Demon Marks as chiliarchs, led by Nine Demonic Marks true demons, numbering around fifty thousand.
The force unleashed by such a number of transcendent strongmen under the leadership of legions equivalent to the Ninth Heavens, or even quasi-mythical ones, was powerful enough to contend with Mythical-level beings.
Add to that around one hundred thousand to over a hundred thousand members from each Demonized Vassal Legion, and together they still constituted a formidable force.
Trapped in the thirteenth Plane, as long as they could hold on for a while, the Demon God of the Purgatory Empire would surely take action.
The strongmen of the Heavenly Feather Clan were also aware of this fact, so Anstice, who got blasted away by the explosion, raised her long sword high, “Shatter those Main Battle Legions and don’t give them a chance to regroup.”
“Kill, eradicate all these evil beings of the Purgatory Demon Race.”
The twelve deities of the Heavenly Feather Clan who had been suppressed in battle all along roared furiously, spreading their glowing wings behind them and pouncing on the Purgatory Legions with dazzling radiance.
From a distance, it looked like angels with golden, silver, and white wings, towering hundreds of meters high, descending from the heavens to pounce on the endless hordes of hell demons.
“Charge!”
“Kill!”
Following the more than a dozen Mythical Powerhouses, over a million elite Heavenly Feather soldiers let out frenzied cries, red-eyed, as they charged towards the Purgatory Empire’s elites numbering ten times their own.
From the beginning of the battle to now, they had never fought such a lavish battle; without the leadership of a Demon King, millions of Purgatory elites seemed like a massive slab of fat meat ready to be slaughtered.
At the same time, the War Pattern Legion from the Human Race, divided into sixty thousand ‘person’ small legions, scattered in all directions under the control of cultivators, pouncing on various Purgatory Legions.
The purpose of coming here to support was to test the data of the War Pattern combined with unmanned legions, and naturally, they would not miss this opportunity.
Roar!
The Number One, with an even more ferocious appearance, let out a fierce roar as it charged towards the demon king over three thousand kilometers away that Jack Clark suppressed, sparing none of the Purgatory Legions it encountered on the way.
Surrounded by terrifying blood light, Number One swept across a hundred-kilometer radius with utter disregard for defense, causing everything that lived to explode into a sky filled with blood mist.
Such a crazed and terrifying slaughter scene made the Heavenly Feather Clan keep a wide berth when they saw Number One from afar, daring not to get close.
Even the Mythical-level strongmen of the Heavenly Feather had fear in their eyes and did not dare block the path.
As the entire Plane plunged into even crazier slaughter, Jack Clark appeared silently over two thousand kilometers in the sky above the battlefield, standing with his halberd, his gaze indifferently overlooking below.
At the epicenter of the explosion at the edge of the Plane, nine silver streaks of light spanned Heaven and Earth, transforming into beams of silver light merging into Jack Clark, turning the nine strands of hair on his forehead to silver.
In the explosive center that affected tens of thousands of kilometers, the broken True Bodies of two Great Demon Kings emerged, riddled with cracks like chipped porcelain.
On the bodies of the two Great Demon Kings, six kilometer-long phantoms of Black Gold Halberd Radiance pierced through them, sealing and suppressing them in the Void, unable to move.
As for the Storage Equipment on their bodies, it had already been taken away.
From the moment he used the Mystic Power of Time until now, it had been only a few breaths, and Jack Clark had suppressed two Late Stage Great Demon Kings among the more than a dozen demon kings spread over tens of thousands of kilometers.
Effortlessly overpowering, unrivaled.
In that moment under the golden Firmament, Jack Clark seemed like a supreme deity descending from ancient times, an invisible terror binding around him as he gazed disdainfully upon the world.
But Jack Clark did not take action further.
The Time Reincarnation Mystic Power was potent, and the nine Marks of Time could manifest projections of Jack Clark’s past, possessing the strength of his prime.
However, the energy required to summon nine True Bodies of Time was also immensely fearsome. Based on the energy spent just now, Jack Clark estimated that each True Body’s Power of Time could only combat for three minutes.
Yet, at the levels of power of a Heavenly King, three minutes was actually very strong; an outburst was enough to resolve what had been evenly-matched foes.
Alas, as strong as this Mystic Power was, it also had significant limitations.
The True Body formed of the Power of Time only possessed the strength Jack Clark had at the moment of formation; for instance, the current three True Bodies of Time would always remain at Mid-Mythical Stage, and the six at Late Mythical Stage.
Therefore, this trump card needed to be used frequently, and opportunities to deplete it sought; otherwise, in another ten days or half a month, once Jack Clark had achieved a breakthrough to Heavenly King Level, the Reincarnation merge wouldn’t boost him significantly anymore.
This was also why Jack Clark directly used the Mystic Power of Time – since things had changed and he couldn’t keep a low profile, he might as well show off some of his power to suppress everything.
“Hahaha… from now on, I, Daoist Master, command the battlefield.”
In the grand battlefield, which spread tens of thousands of kilometers and was divided into many sections, Damon Lopes became a purple lightning bolt sweeping through a disintegrating vassal army of thousands of Demonized aliens, shattering everything.
No matter if it was Purgatory True Demons with Seven Demonic Marks, Eight Demonic Marks, or enormous one to two hundred meter tall Demonized alien races, all of them were blasted to smithereens by the Thunder.
Having acquired the matching Ancient Body Refining Techniques, Damon Lopes, who already broke free of the shackles of being an Innate Awakened One, was even stronger; not even Purgatory True Demons at the peak of Nine Demonic Marks, at quasi-mythical level, stood a chance against him.
……
Boom!!
Outside the eighteen layers of the Plane, phantoms of Nine-headed Evil Dragons, each tens of thousands of kilometers long, roared fiercely as they pounced on the golden orb, slamming into the Golden Star Ring Gears that surrounded it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1359 - 1359 520 Sweeping Across the Eight Directions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1359: Chapter 520: Sweeping Across the Eight Directions, A Glance of Destiny_4 Chapter 1359: Chapter 520: Sweeping Across the Eight Directions, A Glance of Destiny_4 Under the collision of powerful rule forces, the surrounding void was completely shattered.
Only three Demon Gods roared at this time, steering the earth-shaking abyssal rules to assault the Eternal Divine Domain, while the other Demon Gods stood indifferent in all directions.
Because they knew it wasn’t yet time to fully invade the Eternal Domain, to exhaust the power of rules against the Eternal Divine Tree was merely a waste.
And when all Purgatory True Demons in the thirteenth plane had fallen, in the ninth plane, above the shadow-covered Demon City, standing on the head of a Titan Demon Dragon, Left Demon felt that something was wrong immediately.
Looking at the legions retreating from the tenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth planes in a vast procession, Left Demon’s gaze grew cold, “What’s happening? Where are Buddy and the others from the thirteenth plane?”
The Great Demon King named Talrodel replied with some gravity, “Buddy and the others didn’t dare to disobey your orders, Lord Cortes. They haven’t shown up yet; something must have happened.”
“Report…!”
A black radiance crossed the void, emanating an aura of Nine Demonic Marks’ peak, covering thousands of kilometers in just minutes, crossing one Demon Race Legion after another to appear in the sky.
The ten-meter-tall Purgatory True Demon knelt on one knee, his expression fraught with panic, “Reporting to the Grand Marshal, the number thirteen plane has fallen, requesting support.”
As the crack that invaded the thirteenth plane, the entrance was naturally guarded by the elite of the Purgatory Demon Race.
The moment Jack Clark transformed into the World-Destroying Great Sun and pierced through the Dark Demon Clouds to descend, this quasi-mythical level Purgatory True Demon, along with his elite subordinates, rushed into the pathway and returned to the ninth plane.
As for resistance, that was a joke; the horrifying power possessed by that existence was beyond their capacity to withstand.
So, trouble did arise. Left Demon slowly spoke, “Repeat everything you know about the situation.”
“Yes, Grand Marshal.”
The True Demon respectfully said, “Just over half a ‘Star Moment’ (more than ten minutes) ago, a legion claiming to be from the Human Race appeared on the battlefield where our tribe initially had the upper hand.”
“Among that different race’s support army was a terrifyingly strong individual, whose aura was a hundred times more horrifying than Lord Buddy and the others. A single casual strike destroyed the rift channel of the plane.”
“A hundred times stronger than Buddy and the others, has the Supreme strength of the Human Race arrived!?” Left Demon’s eyes narrowed slightly.
But immediately, he felt something was off. If there were Supreme [level] human experts supporting, His Majesty Tyris, the Great Demon King, would most certainly have informed him. He was only told that some Human Experts had appeared and needed his attention.
Left Demon let out a cold snort, “Useless, you can’t even clearly discern the enemy’s strength.”
The quasi-mythical level True Demon trembled all over, hastily explaining, “Grand Marshal, at that time, separated by thousands of kilometers and with such a great disparity in strength, I could only sense that the human’s aura was extremely powerful.”
Luckily for him, Left Demon didn’t kill him. His voice indifferent, “Talrodel, let’s go over and take a look. Hopefully, it’s not too late.”
As he spoke, space distorted around them, and Left Demon and the peak-level Great Demon King vanished in an instant, appearing at the edge of a plane more than a thousand kilometers away.
In front, turbulent Dark Demon Air rolled, the Boundary Wall crumbled, forming various incomplete cracks, with one over a hundred thousand meters long where the violent space power vibrated intensely.
This region’s domain power was so fierce that without nearing it, even Left Demon didn’t know the channel on the other side had already collapsed.
Splat!
The fine scales around Left Demon’s brow split open, revealing a pure gold eye that radiated a holy and noble aura, completely opposite to the dark strength he possessed.
However, at that moment, the two powerful forces did not clash but instead merged perfectly, forming a terrifying Black Gold power.
Om!
The pupils in the golden eye turned into a cross shape, and in an instant, a terrifying gaze pierced through planes and across time and space, bringing the fiercely battling Plane Battlefield into view.
With the power of the Eye of the Ancient Relic, Left Demon saw the Purgatory Legion, which had already suffered millions of casualties, and the dark gold monster that roared through Heaven and Earth, swelling to over seven hundred meters after devouring nine demon kings.
Besides that were the Seraphim with six wings dominating the battlefield, the remaining eight demon kings who were sealed, and two Great Demon Kings impaled in the Void.
Especially those two Great Demon Kings nailed in the Void caused even Left Demon’s pupils to constrict.
It had been only about ten minutes since the fall of the thirteenth plane, and two late-period True Demons had already been suppressed. Achieving this would require some effort even for him now.
But just then, Left Demon’s expression became stunned as his gaze landed on four sword lights dominating the battlefield.
Within the hundreds of meters long sword lights of black, red, cyan, and gray, stood a girl clad in gorgeous Crystal Red battle armor, surrounded by sword Qi crisscrossing to form a Sword World encompassing several kilometers.
What’s more, he found that figure all too familiar.
“Dammit, damn it all, you actually brought her here,” Left Demon’s eyes turned red with blood as an incredibly terrifying intent to kill erupted from him.
The dreadful aura of murder even distorted the surrounding space-time, creating spatial rifts that startled Talrodel, who also stood as a peak Great Demon King.
Not knowing what had happened, Talrodel was shocked to see the normally cold Cortes so enraged.
While Left Demon’s gaze was locked onto Jane Aiken surrounded by sword light, suddenly, in the golden eye, a pair of Black Gold eyes that seemed to blot out the sky looked back.
Boom!
In an instant, a tremor that shook Heaven and Earth erupted as the two terrifying gazes collided from distant time and space, causing the Void ahead to shatter extensively and space-time to become chaotic.
After the blow, the golden eye at Left Demon’s brow dimmed for a moment before slowly closing.
Looking at the collapsing rifts ahead, Left Demon fell silent for a moment and then said indifferently, “That human is very strong, and I don’t know if this is the full extent of the support they have provided.”
“Now that Buddy and others are dead, there’s no need for rescue. Considering it might be a trap, it is not wise to approach for now.”
“Talrodel, pass the word, except for keeping the fortress at the twelfth plane’s rift, all legions are to retreat to the ninth plane for repairs.”
“Afterwards, let the ‘Person’ of the Heavenly Feather Clan find out the detailed information about this round of support from the Human Race, then consider how to attack.”
After centuries of war, the Heavenly Feather Clan had suffered countless casualties, and with the situation growing more and more desperate, there naturally arose traitors.
After all, as long as they are intelligent beings, there will be those who fear death and crave life; traitors will appear in any race, especially since The Purgatory Family can demonize and absorb other races.
“…Yes,” Talrodel nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1360 - 1360 521 Subverting Jack Clark Giant Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1360: Chapter 521: Subverting Jack Clark, Giant Beast Chapter 1360: Chapter 521: Subverting Jack Clark, Giant Beast Faint black Cloud Mist drifted between heaven and earth, permeated by a thick, pungent stench of blood, causing all creatures to tremble in fear.
Over ten million Senior high-order Transcendent Life forms died, including the fall of more than a dozen demon kings, and the concentrated smell of blood was nearly comparable to the slaughter of hundreds of billions, while the powerful aura of death nearly shrouded the entire Plane.
However, looking at the floating limbs and broken bodies in the sky, neither the soldiers of the Heavenly Feather Clan nor the human cultivators showed any pity in their cold eyes.
He who kills must be prepared to be killed; stepping onto the battlefield naturally comes with the readiness to face death.
Moreover, these Purgatory True Demons were bloodthirsty and cruel, having taken the lives of countless beings over the years, including hundreds of millions from the Heavenly Feather Clan and several billions from the Vassal Races.
“We… won!”
In the sky, a Ninth Heaven Expert of the Heavenly Feather Clan fluttered its light wings, looking around in bewilderment and excitement.
In its hundred years of life, it had participated in hundreds of battles both great and small, growing from a Fourth Tier upon entering the battlefield to a pinnacle of the Ninth Tier, and witnessed the decline and fall of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Although the clan had claimed numerous victories in the years of warfare, for the most part, they were on the retreat.
Such an astonishing victory, with tens of millions of Purgatory Elite perishing in battle, seventeen demon kings falling, and two Great Demon Kings sealed, had only happened twice before in the entire history of war.
And on those two occasions, two Demon Gods had fallen, while the Heavenly Feather Clan also lost two Main Gods, with both sides suffering extremely heavy casualties.
At this moment, above the tens of thousands of kilometers of the battlefield, many soldiers of the Heavenly Feather Clan were visibly trembling with excitement, and eventually, some of the female warriors couldn’t help but cry.
They had been suppressed for too long, with their high-end strong men restrained and even besieged by the more numerous demon kings and Great Demon Kings. Every outbreak of war would result in countless casualties and even the fall of Mythical-level beings.
This despair had almost pressured countless members of the Heavenly Feather tribe to the brink of mental collapse, becoming their inner demons and slowing their cultivation progress increasingly.
Under the golden Firmament, Jack Clark looked down indifferently, the overbearing and heavy aura on his body retracted, and the burning flames and Thunder around him dissipated, returning to normal.
At this moment, space in front of Jack twisted, and the real body of Anstice, now back in her normal form, appeared.
Clad in a white, magnificent battle armor, her 1.8-meter-tall figure was only slightly shorter than Jack’s, and behind her, three pairs of pristine light wings fluttered gently, exuding White Light from the inside out.
Along with a halo above her head that resembled a Divine Wheel, her resplendently beautiful face was framed flawlessly.
Despite being quite beautiful, Jack found it surprising to sense the ‘youthful’ life fluctuations emanating from her.
Every creature, upon its birth, undergoes changes in its life vibration with age, forming growth rings, which powerful cultivators can even see through at a glance to discern one’s age.
However, as one breaks through to Mythical-level, the life rings become obscured, and except when purposefully revealed or detected by special testing items, they remain hidden.
Yet even then, there’s a significant difference between the life vibration of a person who has lived for a thousand years and one who is only a few decades old, such as increased vitality.
She is a transcendent genius of the Heavenly Feather Clan, Jack thought to himself.
“Heavenly Feather Main God, Anstice, thank you for your assistance; otherwise, under the continued reinforcement and assault by the Purgatory Empire’s army, I’m afraid this Plane might have fallen.”
“Main God Anstice, there is no need for courtesy; as allies, we naturally should help each other,” Jack replied, introducing himself as well, “Human Race, from the Eastern Summer Empire, Jack Clark.”
Jack Clark. Anstice repeated the name silently in her mind.
However, since they were not acquainted with each other, after coming forward and exchanging greetings, Anstice flew down to direct the aftermath recovery work.
Such as organizing the treatment of the wounded and the repair of fortifications.
Watching the ‘Seraph’ leave, Jack turned his gaze to the edge of the Plane, where a dark golden creature nearly nine hundred meters tall arrived in front of two suppressed Great Demon Kings, over twenty thousand kilometers away.
Number One, having devoured seventeen demon kings, over six million Purgatory Demon Race, and Demonized Alien Race, was wrapped in a blood light so dense it looked like actual blood, enveloping thousands of kilometers.
After absorbing a vast amount of flesh and blood and souls, Number One’s aura grew even more terrifying, its eyes emitting a dazzling blue-white Radiance, appearing more like a Hell Devil than the two Great Demon Kings.
Roar! Without any nonsense, Number One immediately pounced on the Hexagonal Great Demon King, more than a thousand meters tall, with three heads and six arms.
“No!” Even the Great Demon King felt terror at the sight of the gaping, dark golden creature’s maw, preferring to self-destruct rather than be consumed.
Unfortunately, under the suppression of the War Halberd projection, which contained the power of five Higher-order Laws of death and soul, the Hexagonal Great Demon King could not mobilize its Divine Soul or the Laws’ Origin at all.
Ah!
Alongside a scream, the Hexagonal Great Demon King was torn in half by Number One, and dark red blood sprayed out. Under the pressure of the compressed space, it turned into pieces tens of meters in size, half swallowed in one bite.
Boom! In an instant, Number One’s aura surged, its strength advancing towards the Heavenly King Level.
Indeed, after consuming the flesh and blood of so many Transcendent beings, totalling over twenty demon kings, Number One’s aura was only now on the verge of breaking into the Heavenly King Level.
But like Jack, for a creature as unique as Number One, Realm breath is merely a measure and not representative of its combat power.
For example, Number One’s Rampage Mode and its unrestrained Primordial Form would both result in a terrifying surge in power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1361 - 1361 521 Subverting Jack Clark Giant Beast_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1361: Chapter 521: Subverting Jack Clark, Giant Beast_2 Chapter 1361: Chapter 521: Subverting Jack Clark, Giant Beast_2 During the battle at the Sky Curtain Battlefield, Number One, in its primordial form, was powerful enough to fight against two Great Demon Kings of the Early Titan period.
Not to mention now.
Jack Clark wasn’t surprised by this scene; it would be more accurate to say that Number One was recovering from ‘injuries’ rather than growing by devouring the flesh, blood, and souls of living beings.
He only hoped that Freya Louise could withstand the surge of power from Number One’s growth, otherwise, he would have no choice but to destroy it.
As Jack Clark’s gaze traversed over twenty thousand kilometers and observed the increasingly terrifying aura of Number One, it seemed to sense the ‘killing intent’ from him, and the dark-gold creature suddenly turned its head to look in his direction.
Roar! Looking at the indifferent young man with black hair in the sky, Number One let out an extremely vicious roar, its eyes flashing with an ever more terrifying blue-white light.
In response to Number One’s threat, Jack Clark’s gaze turned frosty, and he spoke in a deep voice that echoed through the sky, “Don’t forget, almost all of the demon king meat you’ve been feasting on was obtained by my hand.
“If you’re not grateful, that’s one thing, but to threaten me? Do you want to test if my War Halberd is sharp enough?”
As he spoke, the black-gold Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd silently appeared in Jack Clark’s hands, instantly exuding a heavy presence that pervaded the area, distorting the surrounding space.
However, this Biological Mecha was driven by instinct alone and was particularly sensitive to killing intent.
Whether it sensed the nearly imperceptible Heavenly Tier Dragon aura from Jack Clark or didn’t want to provoke its ‘provider’, in the end, Number One merely growled softly and continued devouring the Great Demon King’s flesh and blood.
Seeing this, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, and then he put away the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd.
Meanwhile, on the 13th plane battlefield where the cleanup was underway, the wars on the other four planes had already ended, but most of the Heavenly Feather soldiers were unaware of what had happened or why the once dominant Purgatory True Demons had suddenly retreated.
The ninth level of the plane.
In a gloomy and lifeless world, reminiscent of doomsday, a five-meter-tall Purgatory Demon God stood aloof on a mountain peak, overlooking what lay below.
As the armies retreated from the four planes, the military camps stationed on the ninth plane, covering thousands of kilometers, were surrounded by Dark Demon Air that blocked out the sky.
But at this time, the soldiers of the Purgatory Legion and the Demonized Alien Corps were feeling restless, with rumors spreading among the various armies.
Rumors such as the Heavenly Feather Clan receiving strong civilization support, the Grand Marshal showing no mercy, leading to the fall of millions of elite troops and more than a dozen demon kings, among others.
At that moment, dark clouds swirled above Left Demon’s head, forming a massive Demon God’s face, followed by a majestic and powerful voice reverberating around Left Demon.
“Cortes, your human race is truly blessed with fortune, flourishing in luck, to have another Son of the Race emerge in just a few years (over a decade).”
Although standing beyond the domain of Eternity, everything that had occurred on the various plane battlefields was witnessed by this Great Demon King.
Besides the two who had previously made their appearance on the battlefield, the human powerhouses at the late stage of the king-level realm, the one with the halberd had left the deepest impression on it.
Especially that time-splitting Divine Power.
As one of the most mysterious forces, temporal power is rare even among Demon God-level beings. Among the current Purgatory Family Demon Gods, only Diorus possesses the Divine Power of time.
Moreover, Diorus’s Divine Power is similar to that of this human’s, but instead of summoning nine past selves, he coalesces two past and future selves.
With a past existence, Diorus cannot be slain, and his future self is even stronger than his current self, which is his ultimate trump card.
Because of his time-related Divine Power, even Tyris, a Demon God who emerged later, couldn’t help but take notice and remember this human’s name.
Moreover, because of the integration of Divine Power into his bloodline, the descendants of Diorus can also wield the Power of Time upon awakening their bloodline, summoning a past or future self for battle.
And when these descendants utilize the Power of Time, the repercussions from the past and future are nullified by the bloodline powers of Diorus.
“That person’s talent and strength are indeed formidable,” Left Demon acknowledged, nodding slightly at the Great Demon King Tyris’s praise.
When he left the Human Race over a decade ago, he didn’t remember such a king-level being in the Human Federation, including those known to have the potential to make a breakthrough to the Nine-fold Peak.
Therefore, the young man who had clashed with him across the void, resisting the power of the Ancient Eye was clearly a genius who had just recently made a breakthrough.
To cultivate to the Mythical Peak in such a short time, with battle strength crossing a Major Realm, almost surpassing the pinnacle of Great Demon Kings, was something even he couldn’t have achieved his in his day.
Suddenly, Left Demon said, “Your Majesty’s will has descended upon us to mention this matter. It seems you are interested in that person.”
The massive face of the Demon God above the Firmament nodded slightly, “Indeed, I am somewhat interested in that human.”
“Haven’t you planted some pawns over there? Find an opportunity to make contact with him and let him know there is no hope for the humans in the eastward expansion.”
“Even if they can hold off Diorus and the other demons for a while, it’s useless. Once the Heavenly Feather Clan is annihilated and we digest the spoils of war, we too shall march eastward.”
“That is the will of the Ancestor, which no demon can defy, including Carthius who is on another battlefield.”
The will of the Ancestor… Left Demon nodded, “Rest assured, Your Majesty, I will find a way to make contact with that person.”
Unlike other Purgatory Demon Gods, Tyris, who had reached the pinnacle of the Great Demon King realm, liked to subjugate and nurture the talented among the demonized alien races he favored.
Or rather, the Purgatory Family, in truth, has very few pureblooded Purgatory True Demons left; casualties in constant warfare simply cannot keep up with reproduction, hence they would demonize and recruit other races to bolster their numbers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1362 - 1362 521 Subverting Jack Clark Giant Beast_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1362: Chapter 521: Subverting Jack Clark, Giant Beast_3 Chapter 1362: Chapter 521: Subverting Jack Clark, Giant Beast_3 And every genius favored by Tyris possessed terrifying potential, such as him over a decade ago, as well as the two Demon Gods currently in the Demon King Dark Sky Empire.
Moreover, Tyris was not at all afraid of these geniuses betraying him; he did not have any control measures over them, which was also why Left Demon was willing to join The Purgatory Family in those years.
Of course, there’s no such thing as a free lunch, Tyris must have had his reasons for acting this way.
As for what those reasons were, Left Demon didn’t care, as long as he could step into the Demon God Level, even if the other party harbored any conspiracies, he would have the strength to counter them.
If he could kill Jonathan Walker this time and achieve a breakthrough to the Demon God Level, mastering the powers of the rules contained in the three Ancient Relics, he wouldn’t even fear Tyris, confident that he could make it out intact.
…
Boom boom boom!! The boundary where the branches of the Eternal Divine Tree stretched out trembled in space, forming four huge golden circles, through which four sky-based battleships passed.
At the edge of the tree branches which extended for tens of thousands of kilometers, nine black battleships were already docked; the Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others had returned ahead of time.
Soon, under the guidance of the Heavenly Feather soldiers flying ahead, led by Number One battleship, the four sky-based battleships approached and eventually slowed down to dock alongside as well.
As soon as the battleship drew near, a hearty laugh echoed through the void.
“Hahaha… Jack Clark, I heard you wiped out more than a dozen demon kings and suppressed two Great Demon Kings this time. Impressive indeed.” Amidst the laughter, a burly middle-aged man with a full beard appeared on the deck of Number One battleship.
Jack Clark stood at the edge of the deck with his hands behind his back, his aura retracted, appearing like a ‘world-weary’ yet handsome young man, and he smiled faintly, “Mysterious Martial Predecessor, it’s been a while.”
“Indeed, it has been a while.”
Looking at the young man before him whose demeanor was steady and whose eyes flickered with formidable majesty, resembling a ‘Monarch’, the Mysterious Martial Sky King also felt a sense of nostalgia.
Half a year ago, when he saw Jack Clark at his daughter’s Hibernation Ritual, the young man was somewhat shy, being a promising newcomer who had just broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Who could have known that in less than half a year since his mission to the Heavenly Feather Clan, Jack Clark had already reached the Legendary Realm, Reverse Defeating and killing Great Demon Kings, and even having records of a hard fight with Demon Gods and retreating safely.
At this moment, the Mysterious Martial Sky King solemnly saluted Jack Clark, saying reverently, “Here I, as a father, want to thank you for your assistance to Miss Joseline; otherwise, she…”
But before the Mysterious Martial Sky King could finish, Jack Clark quickly moved aside to avoid accepting the grand gesture.
Jack Clark politely said, “Mysterious Martial Predecessor, there’s no need for formalities, Ilisa Sister and I are good friends, I naturally wouldn’t stand by in a situation where I am able to help.”
“Besides, setting aside my personal friendship with Ilisa Sister, even for the contribution of Mysterious Martial Predecessor to the Federation, I would have intervened regardless at that time.”
Being a person of ‘mature mind’, Jack Clark rarely admired someone.
But in this world, he held in high esteem many of the Human Federation’s senior figures, like the Mysterious Martial Sky King who had battled for the Human Race for decades and nearly lost all his family and kin.
Besides him, there were First Councilor, Marcellus Larry, and others, including Brulu Warren who, despite not being king-level, were High-level cultivators.
Without these seniors one after the other standing against the threats and impacts from the mythical world, the Blue Star World could not possibly have enjoyed decades of peace.
Therefore, Jack Clark had also indirectly received their grace.
“Mr. Winston, didn’t I say that Jack Clark Junior wouldn’t accept your grand gesture?”
The light laughter continued. Appearing like an elegant scholar, the dashing Senior Denny Kaye appeared out of nowhere, disdainfully saying, “You’re decades old, still acting all coy, isn’t that embarrassing?”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King replied irritably, “What coy, I was merely expressing my gratitude to Junior Jack Clark.”
At this moment, Jack Clark courteously greeted, “Senior Kaye, long time no see.” He had a deep impression of this Heavenly King who mastered the Higher-order Law of the soul.
Senior Denny Kaye smiled suavely, “Actually, it’s only been a few months, but Junior, you’ve really shocked us all, earlier you even ventured alone into the rear of Purgatory Empire.”
Jack Clark humbly said, “That’s nothing, I dared to venture deep only because several Demon Gods were on the frontline, tied down by Exalted First Councilor Senior and the others.”
“Haha… Young friend, don’t be modest. Even us old folks feel ashamed compared to your battle achievements…”
While Jack Clark and the two Heavenly Kings had been talking for quite some time, not a single spectator was present on the battleship deck that stretched for over ten kilometers—only a dark golden monster towering a kilometer high stood in the middle of the deck.
At that moment, still digesting the essence of the two Great Demon Kings, Number One’s aura was terrifying, shrouded in a dense fog of blood, faintly discernible.
As the trio exchanged pleasantries, Heavenly Feather’s Main God, Bordea, appeared as a streak of golden light, his face breaking into a smile as he greeted them.
“In the following period, there shouldn’t be any large-scale racial wars. Those Purgatory Empires also need time to recuperate and gather resources.”
“Next, I will take the three of you to the heart of the Eternal Divine Tree’s world, where we’ll meet with several Divine Kings of our tribe and other Main Gods to discuss the upcoming arrangement.”
“…Meet, Lord Bordea, may I abstain?” Jack Clark pondered for a moment.
“These matters can be decided by True Martial Senior and Mysterious Martial Predecessor. Although I’m not weak in strength, I am far inferior in this regard compared to everyone.”
“Of course, the most important thing is that I’ve reached the bottleneck of the Mythical Peak, and I’d like to go into closed-door cultivation to see if I can make a breakthrough to Heavenly King before the next great war.”
…Watching the young man who talked about breaking through to Heavenly King as if it were nothing, the Mysterious Martial Sky King and Sky King Denny Kaye blinked and suddenly didn’t know what to say.
Bordea paused for a moment and then his eyes shone with fervent light: “I hadn’t anticipated that Divine Martial had already found the opportunity to break through to the Main God level. The talent is astonishing.”
“I wonder if the Divine Martial has any specific requirements for the secluded cultivation environment, including resources. If you need anything, just ask, and our tribe will fulfill it with all our might.”
Are you sure?” Jack Clark was suddenly intrigued.
Bordea affirmed solemnly, “Certain, and this is also the collective will of our tribe’s Divine Kings.”
Given Jack Clark’s exaggerated power, if he could break through to the Main God level, perhaps his strength could leap directly to Divine King, effectively boosting the strength of the Heavenly Feather Clan as the two were now allies.
In addition, Jack Clark’s recent suppression of an entire boundary had helped the Heavenly Feather Clan enough that they were fully willing to help him.
Jack Clark contemplated briefly and then spoke unabashedly: “If that’s the case… I need a large number of life crystals and various minerals of legendary level and above.”
“…This.” Bordea was taken aback for a moment.
“What, is there a problem?”
“Indeed, there is… a bit of a problem.”
Bordea smiled bitterly, having expected Jack Clark to ask for cultivation resources and explained: “Our tribe mainly relies on the Eternal Mother Tree for cultivation and has little need for life crystals.”
“Therefore, our stockpile of resources like Life Crystals has always been limited and was usually given to the strong men among the vassal races. After centuries of war, they have long been exhausted.”
“Including minerals above God-level, due to the loss of our outer territories, resources used to craft legendary-level weapons and fortify armor have long been depleted.”
At this point, Bordea’s tone was tinged with bitterness.
An incredibly powerful race like the Heavenly Feather Clan now found itself embarrassed by the scarcity of what were once common resources, a scenario that was unimaginable a few centuries ago.
Then, Bordea hesitated: “However… although we lack Life Crystals and minerals of God-level and above, would Transcendent-level mineral resources suffice?”
Half an hour later, on the seventeenth plane at the edge of the main roots of the Eternal Divine Tree, a golden radiance twisted, and Jack Clark and Bordea appeared out of nowhere, hovering over a mountain range that stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers.
Gazing down at the mountain ranges emitting a bronze tint, Bordea explained: “Divine Martial, this plane does not support any living beings and is teeming with various minerals, currently serving as the main source of materials for our warriors’ weapons and armor.”
“The most precious here is this copper mine, extending over ten thousand kilometers, housing a massive quantity of top-tier Mixed Copper. It’s sturdy, weighty, and contains strong Transcendent energy conductive amplification properties.”
[Shoot, it’s twelve o’clock again, and I still have over a thousand words to revise for closure. Brothers, refresh in half an hour and wait a bit.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1363 - 1363 522 Neutron Star Evolution Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1363: Chapter 522: Neutron Star Evolution? Battle Preparation Chapter 1363: Chapter 522: Neutron Star Evolution? Battle Preparation “Dark Soul Mysterious Stone, I’ll keep this one.”
“This seems to be a fragment of a rule-level forbidden weapon, its energy is elusive, I’ll refine and ‘consume’ it later too.”
Sitting cross-legged on a bronze rock that stood a hundred meters tall and a kilometer in diameter, Jack Clark was inventorying supplies seized within each of the Demon King’s Storage Equipment.
He set aside all mineral materials, whether they were dark red stones burning with flames or Nether Iron emitting dark demon gas.
As for the special items such as skeletons of unknown Giant Beasts, powerful biological horns, scales, and hides, he placed them on another side.
There were also some highly poisonous substances and forbidden weapons that could only be wielded with the Power of the Abyss. He temporarily put away these, including ancient relics looted from different races of other civilizations.
These would later be handed over to the Federal Logistics Department, where professionals would recast these forbidden weapons and transform them into weapons suitable for human cultivators.
As for cultivation resources, it was very rare to find any useful ones in the storage equipment of strong men above Mythical-level. Usable ones had been absorbed and refined, and unusable ones had been traded for the resources needed.
After clearing out more than a dozen Storage Equipment, the minerals around Jack Clark had piled up into a small hill, radiating multicolored light and the fluctuations of Law Charm.
These things had been collected and treasured by the Purgatory Demon King and the Great Demon King, with at least every one of them being of God-level ore, used to repair weapons damaged in great battles or to enhance and Temper battle armor.
Although all the cultivable ones had been used, there were some unsuitable ones left, including some ancient relics looted from different races of other civilizations.
Rip!
With both hands tearing into the Void, Jack Clark violently tore it open, shattering the Void and creating a hundred-meter-long Black Crack that spanned the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The skeletons, horn scales, and other items of unknown Mythical-level Giant Beasts fell into the plane and were immediately shattered by the purple lightning roaring above, turning into pure substances that the world Devoured.
With the enhancement of ample resources such as Ancient Titans and several Titan Giant Beasts, the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane had already expanded to more than four thousand five hundred kilometers, looking like a vast continent.
But this world, despite its size, wasn’t suitable for living beings.
Affected by the heavy Earth’s Strength, the gravity on the surface was nearly a hundred times that of Blue Star, and ordinary people would have their blood vessels burst under the pressure as soon as they entered.
At the same time, raging wind howled between heaven and earth, not only reaching up to level twenty, but the tangible Black Wind was as sharp as a knife, tearing the surface layer by layer.
There was also the relentless Thunder, along with temperatures above a hundred degrees Celsius that baked and cracked the earth’s surface, just like Hell.
After tossing those ‘miscellaneous items’ into the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, with a thought, Jack Clark summoned his attribute page, his eyes landing on the remaining Attribute points below.
Having understood the tenth talent from the Giant Beast and spent a lot in recasting the Demon God’s Body, the Attribute points transformed from Freya Louise’s Life Crystal had now dwindled to ninety thousand.
After pondering briefly, Jack Clark’s voice echoed in his mind, “Burn eighty thousand attribute points, enter the state of enlightenment.”
The Thunder and Fire laws were nearing perfection, and the Void, Death, and Soul laws were at the state of grand accomplishment. Under normal conditions, without burning Attribute points, it would take several months to make a breakthrough.
And that was the case with Jack Clark’s current exaggerated talents.
Next, as long as the five Higher-order Laws reach perfection, having completed Road Casting, and possessing an inner Plane World, Jack Clark could directly step into the Realm of Heavenly Kings.
Once the five Higher-order Laws start merging with the Supreme Law, along with his incredibly tough True Body and several Great Divine Powers, he would possess the strength to slay a Demon God at the onset of the Realm of Heavenly Kings.
Boom!
Inside Jack Clark’s body, eighty thousand attribute points worth of special energy appeared out of nowhere, forming into a Mysterious Epiphanic Intent Realm that enveloped him, his spirit in absolute harmony with Heaven and Earth.
In this state, whether Jack Clark was comprehending laws or cultivating, his speed was dozens of times faster than usual, terrifyingly quick.
But the consumption was large, ten times that of the past.
Hum! Rings of dark gold halos diffused from Jack Clark as the center, forming a semi-circular light sphere with a diameter of one kilometer, covering the surrounding minerals.
Under the Power of Dark Star, bits of black, red, purple, and other colored points of light flew from those stones, endlessly engulfing Jack Clark, silently merging into his skin upon contact.
The Power of Dark Star was mysterious, not a type of natural force in the conventional sense. It could transform heavy metal materials into a state between matter and energy that could blend with flesh and blood.
As he ‘devoured’ a massive amount of God-level mineral heavy elements, an extremely heavy Aura spread from Jack Clark’s body, the surrounding space creaking under the unbearable weight.
At the microscopic level, Jack Clark’s cells were collapsing and splitting like mad after absorbing a large number of metal elements, radiating red and dark gold metallic lusters.
And as more and more of Jack Clark’s muscles, fibers, bones, and fascia cells became like tiny metal planets, the invisible electromagnetic waves emanating from his body grew stronger and stronger.
These electromagnetic waves were not life magnetic fields, nor Law Domains, but resembled the potential fusion of atomic nuclei under pressure with protons to form neutrons.
This sight made even the microscopically perceptive Jack Clark pause for a moment.
Also absorbing heavy metal elements, with heavy matter integrating into the True Body for Strengthening, Jack Clark keenly realized that his True Body’s transformation process was quite different from that of the Giant Beast Body of the Emperor Dragon.
His cells were collapsing and splitting autonomously like black holes, emitting electromagnetic waves, whereas the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s absorption and integration of heavy matter merely made its flesh and blood heavier and more solid.

chapters.title: Chapter 1364 - 1364 522 Neutron Star Evolution Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1364: Chapter 522: Neutron Star Evolution? Battle Preparation_2 Chapter 1364: Chapter 522: Neutron Star Evolution? Battle Preparation_2 What’s happening? The talent born from the final stage of Dark Star Body Refining Method eventually returns to physical laws?
Or is it because my true body and the Giant Beast Body are not following the same path? Jack Clark pondered thoughtfully.
Meanwhile, as he frantically devoured and absorbed the minerals surrounding him, his physical body grew increasingly powerful, and the dark golden halo enveloping Jack Clark kept expanding, voraciously devouring the metal elements contained in the Mixed Copper Mountain Range beneath him.
No one is the center of the world, so as Jack Clark approached his breakthrough to Heavenly King, others were also busy with their endeavors or cultivation practices.
The twelfth plane.
On a desolate and broken earth, towering gold war fortresses rose into the clouds. Behind them, over two thousand kilometers away, twelve sky-based battleships spread out, forming a defensive line that stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers in conjunction with the war fortresses.
At the same time, those who had performed outstandingly in the frontline support battle had received gifts from the Heavenly Feather Clan.
For instance, Jane Aiken received a piece of a broken stone sword, Damon Lopes obtained a drop of root sap from the Eternal Divine Tree, and this included others such as Joshua Welan on another battleship.
The one who had undergone the greatest change was Freya Louise; seated within the cockpit space of Number One, her aura had already broken through to the mid-term of Ninth Heaven, pushing towards the late period of Ninth Heaven.
This time, as Number One stepped into the Heavenly King tier, it drove an explosive increase in Freya Louise’s cultivation base as well.
Outside of the Eternal Domain, within the Dark Void, nine majestic figures stood tall. They emitted an invisible Demon God Level terrifying pressure that caused shakes across this part of the world.
Then, a gloomy voice echoed through the Void, “Unexpectedly, the distant Human Race has meddled, sending an army to assist, disrupting our offensive rhythm.”
Another Demon God slowly spoke, “Merely a Human Race, they are already struggling at full strength against Diorus and the like; they can’t possibly divert much power here, they’re negligible.”
“I propose that we gather all the Great Demon Kings and demon kings for a collective assault to decide the victor. Let’s completely destroy the twelfth plane and attract the Supreme Abyss to contaminate and despoil the Eternal Tree Trunk.”
Despite previous reports of other tribal legions appearing and the uncertainty of intelligence, to avoid ambushes, there was a temporary halt in the attack.
But these Demon Gods knew more, and thus they didn’t care about the Human Race’s support force.
Concerns about possible ambushes bothered them even less; all forces of the three major empires combined were enough to flatten everything, even if the Human Race offered full support, they’d still be crushed.
The peak Great Demon King wielding the world’s weapon, along with two other Demon Gods in the late stage also wielding world weapons, were already unstoppable at this moment.
“Second that.”
“I agree.”
The rest of the Demon Gods nodded slightly, expressing their agreement with the proposal.
The Heavenly Feather Clan was almost at its wits’ end, with all their gods, Main Gods, and Divine Kings seriously injured and their Origins severely depleted.
On the contrary, due to the advantage in numbers and with enough resources, all demon kings and Great Demon Kings from the three empires were in peak condition.
Although many Mythological Legion forces had perished over the years, many True Demons on the verge of the Nine Demonic Marks had stepped into becoming demon kings.
After all six Demon Gods had nodded, everyone’s gaze turned to the figure seated high upon the Ancient Throne.
Enshrouded in darkness, the Great Demon King Tyris spoke with a deep and authoritative voice, “This Civilization War with the Heavenly Feather Clan has been ongoing. It’s indeed time to bring it to an end.”
“As for the timing, let’s set it at the moment the next Sun Wheel rises.”
“Apart from the necessary personnel to garrison the rear of the three major empires, all Main Battle Legions, Vassal Race Legions, and any recuperating demon kings, all forces must be assembled.”
“In addition, open the logistical reserves. Distribute everything that helps recover strength, heal injuries, and provide a short-term boost to power—issue all explosive elixirs three times over…”
Soon, information about the Demon God conference was conveyed downwards, and Left Demon received the order immediately.
Standing atop an enormous mountain peak, Left Demon gazed at the edge of the plane in the sky, his eyes narrowing slightly, “There are about thirteen days left until the next dawn. Time is a bit tight.”
“`
Within half a month, find a way to make contact with that human genius, convey the will of the Great Demon King Tyris, and draw out the other True Body to kill it.
With the order of the demon king issued and transmitted back through the spatial demon array, the vast territories controlled by the three major Purgatory Empires began to stir.
One demon king after another started to summon legions and vassal races within their domains, rallying hundreds of thousands of elite troops to pilot the Demon King Castles and fly towards the Heavenly Feather battlefield.
…
In the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, where time and space were severed, a chasm sprawled across the Void, filled with grey streams of chaos that even ancient beasts sensed as dangerous.
A thousand kilometers from the edge of the chasm, the already nearly thousand-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon, with the golden-blue Giant Dragon beside it on the Earth, was struggling to stand upright.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it was flying at low altitude, its tail trembling, emitting whining cries.
Whine, whine, whine! Thunderflame, there’s no way through here, the front is too scary, let’s go around it.
The Silver Giant Dragon, too, wore a rarely seen grave look in its eyes, and roared ferociously, “Roar! Tim Abott, those are destructive currents mixed with chaos, capable of dissolving anything; we must not enter.”
Next to the three giant beasts, the Black-red Colossal Beast, which had grown to a length of 3600 meters and standing shoulder height over a kilometer, let out a low growl with a hint of speechlessness, “Do I look that foolish?”
“You do,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon replied bluntly, and the three giant beasts unanimously nodded in agreement.
Since acquiring the ability to fuse the tenth type of heavy matter, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had refined several mineral mountain ranges along the way, making its corporeal body increasingly powerful and heavy.
Whether facing regions of intense heat that melted everything or the perilous forbidden areas filled with Space Cracks, the Destruction Emperor Dragon with its formidable physique charged through directly.
Barging forth without the past caution, it appeared incredibly overbearing.
“Let’s go, we’ll detour from here and continue forward.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly turned, and as its colossal body moved, it set off mountain-and-sea shaking waves of air, causing the Earth to burst and explode within tens of kilometers with each heavy step it took.
The invisible impact even caused the land within a thousand kilometers to shake, as mountains collapsed and the ground undulated like sea waves, with a grand momentum.
This was still with the law domain of the Destruction Emperor Dragon enveloping the surroundings, reducing its own weight to some extent, otherwise, a single step would have submerged it into the depths of the Earth.
The Silver Giant Dragon took to the air, watching the surging Black-red mountain ranges below, and roared loudly, “Roar! Tim Abott, we’ve been in here for so long, when are we going back?”
Although following the Destruction Emperor Dragon to sweep through the Chaotic Domain was exhilarating, after a while of just the four of them, the Silver Giant Dragon gradually felt boredom creeping in.
Without the reverent cheers of the Tiger Whales and the Blue Giant Crabs, it somehow felt like something was missing.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, “No rush, we’ll return after I breakthrough to the Ancient Level, and you grow to the Titan Level. Making a trip out should at least yield some improvement.”
But while it said that, they had all the while been moving steadily in a particular direction, delving deeper and deeper.
