The Destruction Emperor Dragon was using the connection between itself and Jack Clark to determine the direction, venturing further into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, wanting to see just how vast it was and what the diameter measured.
If the diameter spanned only twenty or thirty million kilometers, once a safe route was paved, the next step would be to return and integrate their forces.
For example, invite the Blue-White Giant Dragon, which should have broken through to the Ancient Titan, and the mother of the golden-blue Giant Dragon to join the Dragon Palace, including the Time Dragon as well.
Paired with the two Ancient Titan Beasts they had already conquered and a Titan Peak Beast King, plus the forged Mythological Legion, they would be more than capable of sweeping through the entire Chaotic Domain.
By then, gathering a dozen or more Ancient Beasts, twenty to thirty Titan Beasts, and a few hundred Mythical Giant Beasts to step out of the Chaotic Turbulent Region should suffice to dismantle the Purgatory Empire.
As for the possible awakening Purgatory Ancestor, that would be a matter to consider at that time.
With Miss Joseline in the picture, initiating Deification early and fusing the Giant Beast Body with the human form, crushing the ancient True Spirit with absolute strength wasn’t impossible.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon pondered, while skirting the edge of the space-time fault, they hadn’t gone a few thousand kilometers before a host of astonishingly large creatures appeared in the foreground.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1365 - 1365 523 Sky Beast Meet the Big Dragon King
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1365: Chapter 523: Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King Chapter 1365: Chapter 523: Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King Dim and oppressive, the deeper one went, the more intense became the chaotic turbulent region filled with void storms higher up.
Connecting heaven and earth, on the edge of the gray streams that cut off space-time, three giant dragons, each stretching a kilometer long, circled around a black-red colossal beast even larger than themselves.
At this moment, all four titanic creatures turned their gaze forward.
In those gray streams, a threat even to ancient beasts, eight massive creatures, each over ten to twenty thousand meters in length, roamed like floating islands in the air.
These behemoths resembled batfish to some extent, with a pair of bat wings as large as the length of their bodies, though the thickest part of their bodies was merely a kilometer thick.
The beasts had wide, flat heads with mouths connecting to pectoral fins in a void; on the front of their heads were two protruding bony horns, like sharp horns on the head of a demon.
The narrow tails behind them took up one-third of their length, with their bodies covered in gray scale armor; the slight fanning of their wings stirred up rolling currents, exuding an overwhelming aura.
Despite the astonishing size of these creatures, each one nearly twenty kilometers in length, the aura they emitted was only at the Titan level.
And like inflatables in a vacuum, their enormous bodies were comparable in size to ancient creatures, but in reality, they were hollow inside.
The mouths of these behemoths remained perpetually open, filtering the gray currents like sieve through seawater, consuming some type of energy materials, with the remaining gray streams expelled from the pores on their bodies and rears, resembling steam.
The chaotic destructive currents that fell upon these creatures were like sea waves crashing against reef rocks, imposing yet inflicting no harm.
“Roar! Those beasts are so strong to be able to nest within the chaotic destructive currents!” exclaimed the Silver Giant Dragon with a fierce wide-open draconic mouth, somewhat shocked.
The golden-blue giant dragon growled gravely, “These beasts must have been born from this forbidden area, their bodies and strength attuned to the chaotic destructive currents, which is why they can dwell within.”
Like how the sea nurtures schools of fish and the earth fosters birds and beasts, special environments also give birth to creatures that are in harmony with them.
Including the dangerous environments that the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its kin had recklessly traversed, there were also powerful beings with special abilities, some of which were eaten directly by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At that moment, the Single-horned Spawn Roc seemed excited, its eyes shining as it gazed at those batfish beasts, particularly the gray crystals on their heads.
Roar roar roar!! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, those beasts have good stuff on them, eating the shiny things on their heads is beneficial.
“Treasure.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly raised its head, looking over at those beasts over a thousand kilometers away; the items that excited the current Single-horned Spawn Roc were at least Law-level natural treasures.
Yet, these treasures were actually growing on the heads of those beasts.
Woo woo woo!!
Sensing the chilling intent in the eyes of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the batfish behemoths roaming the edge of the gray area also looked over, letting out long, ship-horn-like cries.
However, relative to their massive size, those creatures in the distance were just little brothers.
Not to mention the Silver Giant Dragon and the others around a kilometer in length, the tiny Kami; even in front of these behemoths, the Destruction Emperor Dragon seemed like the difference between a sturdy man and a three-year-old child.
Plus, with the strongest Destruction Emperor Dragon’s aura being “only” late Titan level, those behemoths didn’t bother with them and continued to drift leisurely within the gray currents.
Watching those batfish behemoths start to swim deeper into the gray currents, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Scythia, you wait outside, I’ll take a look inside.”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes reflected seriousness, “Roar! Tim Abbott, be careful.”
“Don’t worry, these currents can’t hurt me.”
Boom!
In an instant, the earth shattered for hundreds of kilometers around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, like struck by a comet, lifting a ring of magma fire ten thousand meters high and shooting it in all directions.
Under the powerful recoil, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as massive as mountain ranges, vanished in an instant, bursting forth at a terrifying speed, shattering everything in its path as it plunged into a spatial rift.
And the moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered the gray forbidden zone, the gray currents, sensing the intrusion of foreign matter and energy, surged violently like living entities.
Boom boom boom!!
The currents, resembling liquid metal, embodied the ultimate destructive and dissolving nature, instantly dissolving the Thunderflame Domain world surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon upon approach.
Or rather, the gray currents disregarded the Law Domains, striking the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, bursting with a spectrum of colored energy halos.
Across the thick scales of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, mysterious dark patterns flowed, likewise emitting a field that dissolved all energies, impervious to all rules.
Even the gray currents with a hint of Chaos Qi couldn’t shake the terrifying defenses of the Destruction Emperor Dragon; the opposing forces cancelled each other out, causing a roar that could shake the stars.
Although the gray currents were powerful, in reality, they could not harm the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Even Ancient Beasts of ancient times could withdraw unscathed if they didn’t venture thousands of kilometers deep.
But the silver giant dragon and the others couldn’t withstand such extreme dissolving forces, which is why the Destruction Emperor Dragon prepared to take a detour.
It just didn’t expect to encounter beasts nesting in the spatial rift, and furthermore, these beasts were covered with copious precious Heaven and Earth Treasures.
In such circumstances, naturally, the Destruction Emperor Dragon wouldn’t miss out.
Though these beasts had bodies as hollow as vacuum balloons and not much flesh, eating them all would be comparable to consuming an ancient creature from the early stages.
Woo!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1366 - 1366 523 Sky Beast Meet the Big Dragon King_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1366: Chapter 523: Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King_2 Chapter 1366: Chapter 523: Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King_2 Watching the Black-red Colossal Beast riding the wind and breaking through the waves within the gray currents, catching up with astonishing speed, the Batfish Beasts that had already penetrated more than a thousand kilometers into the currents let out roars of shock and rage.
What shocked them was this Titan Beast’s seeming indifference to the damage of the Chaotic destructive current; their rage stemmed from the audacity of this lone Titan Beast daring to provoke them, a creature courting death.
In an instant, eight giant beasts flapped their wings, reversing their bodies as they emitted strong currents of air, and the two Titan mid-period Batfish Beasts in the rear burst with intense energy fluctuations within.
Boom, boom!!
Two gray bubbles with a diameter of kilometers, solid as reality itself, burst forth from the colossal mouths of the giant Batfish Beasts, like two enormous cannonballs shooting toward the Destruction Emperor Dragon at a hundred times the speed of sound.
The moment the bubbles were released, they spun at a terrifying speed, stirring the gray currents within tens of kilometers to form an extending tornado vortex.
And not just one—during the instant of the Chaotic bubble release, including the two Batfish Beasts, all eight giant beasts radiated strong gray light; bubble after bubble burst forth.
In the blink of an eye, hundreds of gray bubbles were released, stirring the currents within thousands of kilometers, obscuring the sky and submerging the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had no chance to evade.
Boom, boom, boom!! In an instant, the heavens shattered, and the earth cracked, the entire world trembling.
Each Chaotic air cannon explosion unleashed energy equivalent to the full-strength strike of a Titan Beast, filled with an overbearing destructive dissolving characteristic.
Hundreds of air cannon explosions unleashed violent energy, forming a series of Destructive Shockwaves that blew open the currents within thousands of kilometers, creating a vast vacuum area.
A roar resounded furiously and majestically from the Void, shaking Heaven and Earth.
The violent explosion of turbulent air was suddenly dispersed, and a Black-red figure shot out at a speed inconceivable to consciousness, appearing in an instant before a Batfish Beast measuring over eighteen kilometers in length.
Boom!
Under the Dragon Claw wrapped with black and red lightning, the massive Gray Behemoth let out a scream as half of its body’s scale armor shattered and its flesh and blood exploded, sent flying over a hundred kilometers by a current as forceful as a Tsunami.
Thump!
A hundred kilometers away, space shattered, the airwaves exploding, and before it could avoid, an even larger Batfish Beast was struck flying by the Beast that was sent hurtling by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The moment the two colossal beasts, each about twenty kilometers in length, collided, a terrifying energy impact burst forth, shaking Heaven and Earth.
Right then, a nearly two-thousand-meter-long Black-red Tail Blade, wrapped in golden flames and blue-purple Thunder, sliced through the Void and appeared lightning-fast before another Batfish Beast.
Whooo!
The Batfish Beast, over twenty-three kilometers long, took a deep breath and instantly grew larger, followed by a stream of fearsome black sonic waves erupting from its mouth.
Boom, boom, boom!! The Black impact spread out in a fan shape, sweeping across hundreds of kilometers, breaking space layer by layer, and forming a black tide of destruction.
In the direct path of this radiating sonic wave impact, the Black-red Tail Blade cut through everything, instantly slashing through the middle of the Batfish Beast.
Boom!
With a terrible slash, the colossal beast over twenty kilometers long and about a thousand meters thick was cut in half, spewing a sky of gray-red blood, and releasing an intense heat with a dissolving Aura.
The instant the mid-period Titan Batfish Beast was halved by that slash, the Void collapsed under the feet of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose massive body appeared three hundred kilometers away in an instant, under the Law of Speed.
Boom! With a claw wrapped in the power of Black Power lightning, the two-thousand-kilometer-long Batfish Beast’s Dorsal Fin shattered, its spine broke, and a pit thousands of kilometers deep collapsed.
Under the formidable impact force, the Giant Beast let out a scream as its huge body smashed through space, sinking thousands of kilometers, nearly falling into the even more terrifying Dark Rift below.
Whoo, whoo, whoo!! Just then, several cries of anger erupted from the rear, and three gray sharp spikes a hundred meters thick pierced through the Void, appearing instantly behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Thump, thump, thump!!
Upon the Emperor Dragon’s lack of evasion, the four spikes, containing the essence of gray strength on their surfaces, landed on its thick scale armor, unleashing a terrifying impact.
Yet, even the Combined full strength of four Titan Beasts couldn’t shake that impenetrable Black-red scale armor, leaving behind only a few faint white marks a hundred meters in size.
Hum!
The dark gold Dorsal Fins on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon emitted blue-purple light, instantly firing several bolts of Thunder mixed with the Corrosion Law in forms of laser beams.
Scarce had the blue-purple Light Beams sped through space, rapidly expanding, and crossed hundreds of kilometers to hit the three Batfish Beasts, releasing terrifying destructive energy as effortlessly as a Breath.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the assault of the beams as thick as hundreds of meters, the three Giant Beasts screamed as their scale armor melted, their flesh and blood exploded, and their bodies were perforated with colossal blood holes.
From the moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon made its move until it grievously wounded eight colossal Titan Beasts, only an instant had passed.
Standing amid the turbulent gray currents, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils shone coldly as it regarded the several heavily injured colossal beasts around, feeling somewhat puzzled.
Because it seemed these beasts were somewhat… weak.
Although tempered by the Chaotic destructive current, the Batfish Beasts’ bodies were more robust than an average Titan Beast’s, their attacks seemed scarce in comparison.
Moreover, they appeared to lack any Law Talent, as if all their energy had been funneled into evolving their bodies.
It appeared to be due to environmental factors.
Contemplating this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s immense double wings shook behind it, tearing through the current as it descended, arriving atop the head of the Batfish Beast that had been cleaved in two.

chapters.title: Chapter 1367 - 1367 523 Sky Beast Meet the Big Dragon King_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1367: Chapter 523: Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King_3 Chapter 1367: Chapter 523: Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King_3 “`
As a Titan Beast, the Batfish Giant Beast possessed an incredible vitality, and at this moment, its bisected body had already reconnected, with its flesh and blood at the point of injury attempting to regenerate.
Beyond that, even the scattered gray-red blood around the beast was flowing back into its body as if it were alive, not dissolving in the gray airflow that pervaded its surroundings.
Bang!
The Batfish Giant Beast, weakened in spirit, was about to dodge when its head was seized by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, trailing afterimages. Fear immediately flashed in its eyes.
Whoo whoo!
Sensing the ferocious and murderous aura of this terrifying Giant Beast, the Batfish Giant Beast flapped its massive wings and contorted its body, unleashing a surprisingly strong struggle.
The gaze of the Black-red Colossal Beast instantly turned cold.
Boom!
The space exploded as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claw struck the flattened head of the Giant Beast, shattering its scale armor and collapsing its skull. Grey blood gushed out mixed with other fluids, weakening its struggle instantly.
With its head crushed, even the Titan Beast’s strong vitality couldn’t prevent it from suffering heavy injuries and approaching death, as its soul had already largely fused with its body.
It was not until this point that the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its attention to the Giant Beast’s head, which between its cracked skull housed five gray crystals varying in size from about a dozen meters to over thirty meters in diameter.
These gray crystals were flat and round, with half of them embedded in the flesh and blood beneath the Giant Beast’s scales. Compared to the beast’s massive size, these gray crystals were almost imperceptible.
Furthermore, even with the strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it didn’t feel anything special from these gray crystals until it curiously reached out with its giant claw.
Squelch! Under the claw of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the scale armor and flesh and blood on the Gray Behemoth’s head shattered, carving out five bloody holes and revealing some vessels and fascia.
As soon as the gray crystals separated from the flesh and blood of the Giant Beast, they instantly transformed, and the material inside underwent a change, shifting from solid to a kind of energy liquid, releasing dense fluctuations of energy.
This energy had a turbid quality to it, but it even surprised the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which saw a fervent gleam in its eyes, “Chaos.”
These crystals on the heads of the Giant Beasts actually contained turbid Chaos material, which was in a solid state while attached and became active as soon as it was separated from the body of the Batfish Beast.
Grasping the five gray crystals, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked again at these beasts, no longer with a killing intent but with the sense of having discovered a treasure trove.
With advancing cultivation and a deeper understanding of the world, especially as a Heavenly Tier lifeform, it naturally knew Chaos was the foundation of everything.
Chaos begot all things, including the mythical world and the universe where Blue Star was situated; all matter and energy originated from Chaos.
This Chaotic Turbulent Region also contained so many resources because it was shattered, exploded, and pierced through the World Crystal Wall during the consumption by the mythical world, allowing many elements of Chaos to surge in.
Unexpectedly, these Batfish Beasts could grow crystals containing chaotic material on their heads, where each crystal was on par with Law-level resources, or even more precious.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly threw the five gray crystals into its mouth, crushing and swallowing them.
As the crystals entered its body, a surge of violent and Overbearing energy burst within the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as if the Qi of Chaos was scouring everything around it.
This turbid energy, strong enough to explode and dissolve the flesh and the rules of a Mythical Giant Beast, was nowhere near unsettling the incredibly formidable body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Instead, it was greedily absorbed by countless cells.
Crackle Crackle!!
The aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon surged as its massive body visibly swelled at an eye-catching speed, its terrifying power effortlessly compressing the surrounding space into black explosive shockwaves.
In just a short time, the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had grown by more than fifty meters.
It might not seem like much, but considering the current strength and hardiness of the Emperor Dragon’s body, even consuming an entire Ancient Beast would at most result in a hundred-meter increase.
This meant that the Chaos Crystal Cores from the Titan Beasts’ heads were equivalent to the total biological energy contained in the blood and flesh of four Ancient Beasts.
And it wasn’t just energy; the Destruction Emperor Dragon keenly felt that under the influence of those chaotic materials, its Heavenly Tier bloodline had evolved slightly, and its Giant Beast Body became even more perfect.
Although this bloodline improvement was minute, it had an effect even on it, so what about the King-class Silver Dragon and the others whose bloodlines were still at the Monarch level?
Besides, might these chaotic materials affect Jack Clark’s original body? Could they strengthen the Body of the Eight-Armed Demon God and enhance its potential?
If it could improve the qualities of human cultivators, then…
Whoo! The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled a hot breath, and the value of these Giant Beasts suddenly rose in its eyes.
Whoo!
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was preparing to subdue these Batfish Beasts, a forlorn and profound ship’s horn echoed through the space-time fracture, followed by the rapid approach of an Ancient Level Terrifying Aura.
Instantly, the injured Batfish Beasts all showed excitement in their eyes, and aside from the one held by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the remaining seven responded with excited calls.
Within a range of thousands of kilometers, the gray airflow rolled and dispersed, revealing a Batfish Beast that was over sixty thousand meters long.
This beast was covered with even thicker scale armor, its entire body a dark gray color, and the surfaces of its scales were covered with Mysterious Rule patterns.
Clearly different from the Titan-level Batfish Beasts, this Ancient-level Beast had undergone a Transformation and commanded some kind of powerful Rule force.
At that moment, strong gusts of wind blew out from behind the Giant Beast as if it were an Aerospace Aircraft Carrier over sixty kilometers long. Huge shockwaves rolled out to either side, filled with a sense of oppression.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1368 - 1368 523 Sky Beast Meeting the Big Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1368: Chapter 523 Sky Beast, Meeting the Big Dragon King_4 Chapter 1368: Chapter 523 Sky Beast, Meeting the Big Dragon King_4 The Destruction Emperor Dragon, stretching over 3600 meters, appeared minuscule, like a tiny insect, before this Giant Beast.
Furthermore, its body exuded a Titan Level aura that could easily cause illusions among beasts. Consequently, it was utterly disregarded by the Ancient Batfin Beast, which charged at it with an overbearing momentum.
Especially when the Giant Beast closed the distance to a thousand kilometers and saw the wretched and weak aura of its underlings, it let out a long, angry roar.
“Woo! Strange titan beast, you dare to invade the great Alius’s territory and wound my kin? Unforgivable.”
Boom!
A powerful Power Explosion surged from the Ancient Batfin, instantly causing a thousand-kilometer grey airflow to riotously spiral and collapse inward, forming a violent destructive vortex with a massive Black Hole emerging at its center.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a ferocious roar, hurling the Batfin Beast it had clutched behind itself. Its body stepped forward and in an instant, an aura capable of destroying heaven and earth burst forth.
Boom!
Blood Red Lightning exploded from the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, spreading in all directions, dissolving even the grey airflow that could melt away the rules of everything, leaving behind bloody trails.
Amidst the dazzling red Radiance, a Deep red Destruction Beast, ten thousand meters in length and towering over five thousand meters high, emerged, causing the surrounding space to collapse and forming a dark area spanning hundreds of kilometers.
After absorbing the heavy elements from several large ore veins, the flesh of the Destruction Emperor Dragon became incredibly dense and solid.
In its Deep red Destruction Form, its size multiplied several times, and it unleashed its strength in all directions without restraint, nearly becoming a beast-shaped Black Hole.
Its mere presence distorted space-time, creating a Black Hole spanning hundreds of kilometers that devoured light, including the red radiance it emitted.
Such a terrifying form, just by its intangible aura, filled the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast with despair.
As for the other Titan Level Batfin Beasts, they trembled all over, their eyes revealing fear, unable to muster any will to resist under the terrifying presence of that bloodline.
“Woo! No fight, no fight, the great Alius surrenders, surrenders,” it whined.
Facing the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose aura had become terrifyingly extreme after entering its Destruction Form, the originally aggressive Ancient Batfin Giant Beast abruptly stopped and promptly surrendered.
To show sincerity, it dissipated the grey airflow converging around it under the influence of the rules, revealing its colossal body.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon paused for a moment, with Blood Red Lightning flickering in its golden-red vertical pupils, and its terrifying gaze fell upon the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast as it slightly opened its mouth.
A low growl filled with a destructive aura rose, shaking space-time, “We haven’t even fought; why surrender so readily? Is there a chance I’m merely bluffing, appearing stronger than I am?”
Even if a fight were to start, the Destruction Emperor Dragon wouldn’t kill the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast, but to enter Destruction Form without a battle would be a waste of expression.
Moreover, it wanted to test the strength of the Ancient Beast born from the Chaos and destruction environment, to see if it could withstand its claws or Tail Blade.
Although it had crushed and killed an ancient early stage beast before, there was a significant gap between the ancient middle and early stages; it could not be careless and needed to find more powerful beasts to battle and become familiar with its power.
The farther one progresses on the Transcendent Path, the larger the gap between each minor realm becomes.
The Ancient Batfin Giant Beast slightly shook its head, “Wooh! Strange, great Giant Beast, my instincts tell me you are very strong, unbeatable, unbeatable.”
Of course, it was not foolish. Its prompt surrender was because it had seen that the Destruction Emperor Dragon hadn’t killed the other Batfin Beasts and it sensed no killing intent from him.
Otherwise, it would have fled long ago.
Too terrifying was this beast; it may only be of the Titan Realm, but upon entering this red state, the aura it emitted alone was enough to instill fear and dread.
Looking at the intelligent gleam in the eyes of the Ancient Batfin, the Destruction Emperor Dragon fell into silence; it was the first time it had encountered such a readily surrendering ancient beast.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Surrender is acceptable, but a mere statement of defeat does not redress the affront to my dignity by your underlings.”
“When I first encountered them, they came flying over, and I was going to ask for directions, but your underlings immediately attacked me—unforgivable.”
The surrounding eight Batfin Beasts all showed astonishment in their eyes.
No, your approach was too aggressive, not at all like you were asking for directions; it looked more like you came to kill us, right?
The Ancient Batfin let out a long angry roar, “Woo! Foolish creatures, you dared to offend this great Monarch Beast, that’s courting death! Don’t just stand there; apologize to this great King of the Beasts right now.”
Woo woo! Sorry.
Woo! Please, great Monarch Beast, forgive our transgression …
These beasts that dwelled in the streams of destruction, unlike those outside influenced by the power of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, possessed high intelligence and only a weak, tyrannical aura.
Now they apologized voluntarily, lowering their proud heads in a very respectful manner.
However, having caught the eye of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, their apologies were futile. With an indifferent growl, it said, “If apologies were effective, why would we strive so hard to grow?”
“In my eyes, the creatures of the world fall into three categories: those who are my subordinates or friends, those who are insignificant, and then there are the enemy beasts.”
“Towards enemy beasts, my longstanding policy is to cut the grass and eliminate the roots, kill and consume them all, sparing no one.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1369 - 1369 523 Sky Beast Meet the Big Dragon King_5
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1369: Chapter 523 Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King_5 Chapter 1369: Chapter 523 Sky Beast, Meet the Big Dragon King_5 The cold words of the Destruction Emperor Dragon made the Batfish Beasts tense up.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s tone changed, “But the strength you just exhibited seems decent. The body of the Giant Beast did not explode under a normal claw from me.”
“At present, my Beast Empire is expanding, absorbing powerful giant beast creatures. If you are willing to become a member of the Dragon Palace, I naturally won’t hold your offense against you.”
“Beast Empire?” All the giants, including the Ancient Batfin Beast, were taken aback.
Habituated long-term within the currents of destruction, they had not contacted creatures from the Outer World. Although very intelligent, they were hearing about this ‘organization’ called an empire for the first time.
Perceiving their confusion, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “An empire is an even larger group of giants, comprising hundreds of thousands of giants and tens of millions of creatures from different races.”
“And I am the Thunderflame Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, Brock Abbott, as well as the master of the Dragon King Hall. There are ten more Dragon Kings in the Dragon King Hall besides me, each of them incredibly powerful.”
“Now, the Dragon Palace Empire is expanding in all directions and will soon unify the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region. Alius, if you join the Dragon Palace, I can offer you the position of Dragon King.”
“Of course, if you choose to refuse, I can only opt to kill and consume you.”
While talking about consuming the giants, a terrifying aura of killing intent spread from the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Deep Red Form.
If these giants chose to refuse, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was truly ready to kill them all, using their flesh and blood, along with the Chaos Crystal Stones, as nourishment for its growth.
Considering that this rift in space-time was boundless, if they were let go today, they might not be found again.
Sensing the killing intent from the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the shock of there being ten more Dragon Kings in the Dragon Palace Empire, the Ancient Batfish Beast nodded very sensibly.
“Woo! To join, to join the mighty Thunderflame Emperor is an honor for me.”
This straightforward attitude left the Destruction Emperor Dragon somewhat regretful; it was the first time it had encountered such an ‘obedient’ Ancient Beast that was subdued without a fight.
Suppressing the desire for violence within that could Destroy Heaven and Earth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly exhaled a hot stream of red energy, annihilating all matter and energy within a dozen kilometers.
“Since you’ve chosen to join, from now on, we are one family. You are now the twelfth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, King of the Sky, and have the right to discuss matters in the Dragon King Hall.”
The growl subsided, the Blood Red Lightning swirling around the Destruction Emperor Dragon receded, and its size rapidly shrank until it returned to over three thousand meters.
Standing in the turbulent gray currents, the gaze of the Destruction Emperor Dragon fell on Alius’ head, and it growled in confusion, “Alius, why don’t you have a Chaotic Crystal on your head?”
“The great king, what is a Chaotic Crystal?” The immensely large Ancient Batfin was taken aback, somewhat bewildered.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lower, “It’s those gray crystals on the heads of your subordinates.”
“Woo! So that’s what it is. Those things are impurities accumulated on our heads after we consume and attempt to absorb this murky flow, unable to dissolve them and carried by the blood.”
“However, after becoming an Ancient Beast, all those impurities were completely broken down and refined, so I don’t have any.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon paused, realizing that the Chaotic Crystals were actually impurities that these Batfish Beasts could not absorb. This explained why they hadn’t consumed them themselves.
Perhaps these Batfish Beasts also didn’t realize that once those impurities are removed from their bodies, they transform into another form of energy.
Thus, these Batfish Beasts could indeed become a constant source of Chaotic substances for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to harvest.
It simply remained unknown how long it took for one to grow.
Thoughtfully, the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued to inquire, “Alius, having lived here, do you know how long and wide this space-time fracture zone is?”
“How long and wide.”
Lacking a concept of kilometers, the Ancient Batfin thought for a moment before growling, “Great king, I don’t know the exact dimensions, only that it’s immense.”
“However, when I was breaking through to the Ancient Level, I once flew along the edge of the Area of Destruction for about a Sun Wheel to reach the other side.”
“Moreover, the Area of Destruction isn’t uniformly shaped, it’s wider in some places and narrower in others. To cross the narrowest part, it took me three Star Hours.”
“And deep within the Area of Destruction, there are many places that even I find threatening. If the king wishes to traverse the Area of Destruction, it would be best if I led the way.”
Besides the Batfish Beasts, there’s scarcely any other life within the Area of Destruction, so over the long years, Alius and the other giants have grown quite bored.
Out of boredom, they would find things to do, like familiarizing themselves with the place they lived in.
