chapters.title: Chapter 1370 - 1370 524 December Breeding Season Damn
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1370: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instincts Chapter 1370: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instincts “`
The space-time rift flowed like sea water before suddenly dispersing, and a Sky Beast over sixty kilometers long appeared.
In front of the massive body of the colossal beast, whose wingspan cast a vast shadow, the three-thousand-meter-long Destruction Emperor Dragon was almost negligible.
Including the eight Batfish Beasts around it, ranging from ten to twenty kilometers, they all seemed mundane.
Watching this scene, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened: “Roar! Telsafi, why are these beasts so huge!?”
The golden-blue giant dragon pondered while looking at the beasts filtering the gray airflows: “These creatures are so large; it must be due to their body structure.”
Roar! Indeed, those fellows are huge, but at this moment, following behind Thunderflame, they seemed to have been ‘persuaded’ by Thunderflame to join the Dragon Palace.
After Single-horned Spawn Roc finished speaking, the Silver Giant Dragon also realized and let out an excited roar: “Roar! Joe is right, Great Sethia is going to be invincible.”
With the addition of this group of Giant Beasts exuding Titan and Ancient Level auras, the number of Ancient Level Giant Beasts in the Dragon Palace Empire now reached three, with more than ten at the Titan Level.
If later on, Great Sethia returns and manages to persuade Mom, who should have completed the Rule Transformation, to join, as well as Dad, who is about to step into the Ancient realm, there will be five Ancient Level beings.
Most importantly, Tim Abott’s strength is still rising rapidly, ha ha… Great Sethia is really going to be invincible. All the beasts will be its underlings.
After assessing the current might of the Dragon Palace Empire, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes squinted with happiness and excitement, and even a string of silvery sticky saliva flowed from the corners of its ferocious mouth.
Immediately, the golden-blue giant dragon took a step back in disgust and let out a low roar to remind: “Scythia, wake up, you’re drooling.”
“Roar! Ah… Ha, haha…” The Silver Giant Dragon came back to its senses, showing a human-like blank expression on its face to cover up the embarrassment.
However, as ‘best friends’ who grew up together, the golden-blue giant dragon saw through its thoughts at a glance and became unusually serious, hissing softly between breaths.
“Scythia, Great Telsafi wants to remind you, although you are the Dragon King in name, you are only at the Mid-Mythical Stage of the realm, so you must show respect to those Ancient Giant Dragons that have joined the Dragon Palace.”
“Roar! Don’t worry, Telsafi, Great Sethia is no fool.”
The Silver Giant Dragon nodded earnestly: “Great Sethia is only the Dragon King in name. All matters of the Dragon Palace are decided by the Dragon King Hall, with Tim Abott making the final decisions.”
Seeing that the Silver Giant Dragon understood, the golden-blue giant dragon nodded slightly and said no more.
Although this idiot Scythia liked to do stupid things, after gaining so much experience outside, it seems to have grown a bit, with a clear grasp of significant matters.
As the three beasts conversed, ten Giant Beasts located thousands of kilometers away quickly arrived at the edge of the space-time rift, exiting the range of the gray airflows.
Provoking a maelstrom of waves, the Ancient Batfin Beast slowly approached overhead of the three beasts, while the Black-red Colossal Beast fell from the sky.
Boom!
In an instant, an area spanning hundreds of kilometers collapsed, its edges – countless broken rocks and dirt – slid into the space-time rift and were immediately shredded and dissolved by those destructive gray airflows.
Standing on the collapsing Earth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled.
“Let me introduce you, this is Alius, an Ancient Middle Stage creature, which has joined the Dragon Palace and received the title of King of the Sky.”
“Alius, this is Scythia, King of Storm and Frost of the Dragon Palace, Telsafi, Ice Crystal Elemental King of Dragon Palace, and Jerry Jones, King of Black and White of the Dragon Palace.”
“Also, Scythia is the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace.” The Destruction Emperor Dragon added at the end.
His words made the Ancient Batfin Beast and its surrounding subordinates stun, looking incredulously at the tiny three figures below.
“Roar! Great King of Thunderflame, are you sure this little guy is the Dragon Palace Dragon King?” The Ancient Batfin was somewhat dumbfounded.
It had assumed that the Dragon King waiting for them at the edge of the Area of Destruction would be a Giant Beast of immense size, even more powerful than the Black-red Colossal Beast.
But instead…
On the Earth below, the scorned Silver Giant Dragon roared: “Roar! Alius, don’t underestimate Great Scythia.”
“Even though you’re an Ancient Level creature, Great Scythia’s mother is also an Ancient Giant Dragon, and it won’t be long before Great Scythia is confident of surpassing you.”
Uh… are you joking? Just a Mythical Giant Beast. Looking down at the Silver Giant Dragon that it could swallow whole, the suspended Ancient Batfin paused.
Although it didn’t believe the words of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Ancient Batfin Beast didn’t show it.
After all, this little one is the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, and looking down on the Silver Giant Dragon would be tantamount to looking down on the King of Thunderflame; upsetting it could have unimaginable consequences.
Still, the Ancient Batfin looked towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon on the ground, its eyes full of questions. It needed a reason that would convince it to ‘truly submit’ to this Mythical Giant Beast.
As an Ancient Beast, it held its own pride. If, besides the King of Thunderflame, the other Dragon Kings of the empire were so weak, then there was no point in joining such an empire.
It was too childish.
If that was the case, don’t blame it for first ‘humoring them’ and then looking for an opportunity to head deep into the Area of Destruction with its kin, not to emerge for hundreds of years.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1371 - 1371 524 December Breeding Season Damn
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1371: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instinct_2 Chapter 1371: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instinct_2 The Destruction Emperor Dragon spoke slowly, “Alius, the position of the Great Dragon King of Scythia is an honor as the creator of the Dragon Palace Emperor Dragon, and its status is unshakeable.”
“However, Scythia doesn’t manage specific affairs normally, the empire’s main resolutions are presided over by the Dragon King Hall, where various Dragon Kings discuss and decide.”
“Among them, the Dragon Kings of the Dragon King Hall, besides you and me, include Jormungand and Kutadire, both of whom are Ancient-level Giant Beasts. Their strength in some aspects is even stronger than yours.”
“Besides that, the position of Dragon King within the Dragon Palace Empire isn’t solely based on strength, but also on contribution to the Dragon Palace.”
“For instance, Joe, Torsafi, Domination, and Kidora, who guard the empire’s Headquarters, may not be particularly strong, but they made significant contributions during the establishment of the empire.”
“Roar! So that’s how it is.” The Ancient Batfin Giant Beast suddenly realized.
So it was a ceremonial Great Dragon King; the main controller was still the King of Thunderflame. It wondered how the powerful King of Thunderflame could ever yield to the status of another beast.
However, the empire was heavily flavored with beast sentiments. These weaker giant beasts, simply because they were elders when the empire was established, still held the noble position of Dragon King after the empire’s growth.
With this thought, including the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast, all Batfin Beasts let out a sigh of relief, the unease in their hearts about joining a strange organization dissipated.
Having a beast sentiment was good; as long as they made the effort to mingle with the Great Thunderflame, he would probably not treat them unfairly.
On the contrary, if the other party was cold, ruthless, and brutal, they would feel afraid. In an instant, countless thoughts passed through the smart Batfin Beasts’ heads.
Upon understanding the structure of the empire, the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast felt much more relaxed and let out a deep and polite bellow, “Roar! Respected Scythia Dragon King, please don’t mind my tone.”
“I was just surprised upon hearing that you are the great Dragon King of the empire, it wasn’t to question your intentions, Scythia Dragon King.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly, “Roar! It’s fine, the Great Scythia is a Giant Dragon destined to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region and rule the Vast World. He won’t care about these trivial matters.”
“Roar! The Scythia Dragon King is truly the Lord of the Empire, magnanimous and broad-minded.”
Seeing the Silver Giant Dragon so easy to talk to, the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast didn’t mind delivering a bit of flattery.
Immediately, its attitude softened the looks of the gold-blue Giant Dragon and Single-horned Spawn Roc, this huge creature seemed very easygoing.
After they recognized each other, the Destruction Emperor Dragon started to talk about serious matters and sternly roared.
“Scythia, Torsafi, this space-time rift spans over a hundred million kilometers, severing the Chaotic Turbulent Region. We probably won’t be able to get around it,” he said.
“Roar! What, over a hundred million kilometers!” The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened, and the gold-blue Giant Dragon was also surprised.
Having spent so much time with the Destruction Emperor Dragon, they had some understanding of the ‘kilometer’ scale he used: for example, one kilometer is about a third of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body length.
A hundred million kilometers meant, given their strength, they would need to fly for a very long time, and that’s only if there were no forbidden areas or dangerous terrains blocking the way.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared lowly, “This forbidden area is too vast, to get across you can only ride on the backs of Alius and the others and have them lead you across by flying.”
Looking at the black-red Colossal Beast with calm eyes, the gold-blue Giant Dragon hesitated, “Thunderflame, do you want to go over there?”
“Yes, I want to see what’s on the other side,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded.
Due to the restrictions of the Blue Star World Channel allowing only the passage of Mythical Giant Beasts, if he wanted to lead the Giant Beast legions to assist during the great battle between the Human Race and The Purgatory Family, he must cross the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Therefore, while gathering resources to grow and increase his strength, he needed to explore a safe route as soon as possible.
Once he broke through to the Ancient level, he could return to summon all giant beasts, consolidate strength, and subdue all Mythical and above giant beasts surrounding the Chaotic Turbulent Region and begin the expedition.
After the Destruction Emperor Dragon made the decision, the other giant beasts naturally had no objections.
However, before setting off, they needed to divide the spoils of this trip.
Squelch, squelch! Without the Destruction Emperor Dragon having to act, those Batfin Beasts controlled their tail spikes to pry off chunks of gray crystals from their heads.
Compared to their hundreds-of-meters-long tail spikes, those ten-plus-meter to maximum thirty-plus-meter gray crystals looked like mere dandruff, almost insignificant.
Moreover, since these Batfin Beasts filter ‘chaos’ materials every day, even if those gray crystals were activated and turned into energy materials they could absorb, the effect on them was minimal.
It was like they had maxed out their resistance; the Destruction Emperor Dragon had tested this on the way back using a few-meter-sized gray crystal.
When the thirty-one gray crystals were pried off the seven Batfin Beasts’ heads and floated mid-air, a rich wave of energy radiated out.
Instantly, the single horn on the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s head emitted dazzling light, its eyes excited: Roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, I want to eat, I want to eat.
The two Giant Dragons’ eyes also lit up, staring ardently at the gray crystals in the air.
At the instant when the materials inside those crystals activated, the bodies of the Silver Giant Dragon and its companions felt a strong urge, instinctively driving them to devour and plunder.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, “These crystals contain chaotic materials and violent energy, which can promote evolution and improve bloodline.”
“But you are too weak for large chaotic crystals, which you can’t digest. Joe, this piece is for you; this piece is Scythia’s, and this one for Torsafi.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1372 - 1372 524 December Breeding Season Damn
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1372: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instinct_3 Chapter 1372: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instinct_3 The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low growl as an Invisible Power enveloped the smallest three gray Crystals, about eight to nine meters each, and levitated them to the front of the Three-headed Giant Beast.
Roar! Staring at the gray Crystals that flew before its eyes, the Silver Giant Dragon could hardly wait, and devouring one with a single bite.
Boom!
The Overbearing turbid energy exploded within the body of the Silver Giant Dragon, the violent strength dissolving all matter and energy as if countless Divine Weapons’ swords were tearing apart the surrounding flesh and blood, dissolving them.
In an instant, even the Silver Giant Dragon let out a scream of pain, its body covered with silver scale armor oozing silver blood, its four muscular limbs swelling, and Power Explosion shattering the Earth beneath its feet.
Compared to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s overwhelmingly indescribable Giant Beast Body, the Silver Giant Dragon, though strong, was only about ten times stronger than a same-tier Mythical Giant Beast.
Faced with the Chaotic substance that even Titan Giants were unable to digest, naturally, its muscles and bones couldn’t withstand it, continuously being dissolved.
However, even as its entire body was being torn apart like death by a thousand cuts, the Silver Giant Dragon stubbornly endured, sealing the Overbearing turbid energy within its body to avoid wasting a single bit.
Chaos is filled with endless destruction, yet it also contains life.
Therefore, as this Overbearing power dissolved the muscles and bones within the Silver Giant Dragon and corroded them into countless small holes, it released an extremely rich Vitality.
Through destruction and repeated repairs, the Silver Giant Dragon keenly felt its Giant Beast Body growing stronger, the concentration of its bloodline also incrementally increasing, and along with it, the intensity of both Supreme talent rules also improved slightly.
As the Silver Giant Dragon’s body underwent Transformation, the golden-blue Giant Dragon and Single-horned Spawn Roc also devoured the Chaotic Crystals, immediately eliciting a series of pitiful wails from the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
As for the golden-blue Giant Dragon, its body was enveloped by rich energy, tiny rainbow-colored spots seeped out from the edges of its crystal scale armor, shaking with pain all over its body.
But even with such unbearable pain, the golden-blue Giant Dragon didn’t let out a scream, instead emitting a Crackle Crackle of grinding teeth colliding from its mouth.
Endure, I am the great Telsafi, I must be graceful, graceful…
Flying at a ‘Low altitude’ hundreds of kilometers above, witnessing the Mythical Giant Beasts below whose bloodline aura was continuously growing in strength, the Ancient Batfin Beast and its underlings were both surprised and envious.
Evolution of bloodlines, this is what they long for in their dreams, and yet these Mythical Giant Beasts, even with just temporary enhancement, are equivalent to the efforts they made filtering the Chaotic destructive current for over a decade.
Thinking of this, the Ancient Batfish Beast let out an envious long cry: “Woo! It’s a pity, even if activated, those impurities are useless to us.”
On the Earth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled softly, “Normal, your bodies are already accustomed to those destructive forces, or to say, have reached the limit of enhancement from those currents.”
“Next, if you, Alius, want to advance further, aside from spending countless time grinding through, the best option is to leave this forbidden area.”
“Devour other Heaven and Earth Treasures, absorb strength different from the Chaotic destructive current to refine your own Rule, only then can you accelerate your bloodline Evolution.”
“Leave…” The Ancient Batfish Beast shook its massive head.
Although it knew what the Destruction Emperor Dragon was saying made sense, it decided against it. It was unnecessary; here, it and its species were naturally invincible, fearing no powerful enemy beasts.
Even same-tier Ancient Beasts couldn’t fight it in the Area of Destruction for long, needing to expend more energy to resist the corrosion of Chaos from all directions.
Of course, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was an exception, for it was too abnormal.
Seeing this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze remained calm; it did not matter that these Giant Beasts didn’t want to leave for the time being. It would wait until it needed them later to forcibly command them to join the expedition.
While waiting for the Silver Giant Dragon and others to digest, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked at the remaining twenty-eight gray Crystals, opened its vast mouth, and in one breath swallowed the largest twenty pieces.
Boom!
Instantly, even more Overbearing turbid energy exploded within the Destruction Emperor Dragon, sending its terrifying aura skyrocketing into the heavens, almost tangible, shaking space itself into forming layers of transparent waves.
Under the impact of that powerful oppression, the eight Titan Giants floating above were directly blown away, their colossal bodies creating Mountains and Seas shaking currents, terrifying in their momentum.
The Ancient Batfish Beast, which was not blown away by the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, showed shock in its eyes, disbelieving as it watched the Black-red Colossal Beast below.
There, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body visibly swelled at an alarming rate, growing, while the invisible aura it emanated frantically soared, becoming even more fearsome.
Under the weight of the invisible heavy force, the Earth around the Destruction Emperor Dragon collapsed and sank, while the surrounding space was twisted and shattered by the invisible released power.
Such a terrifying speed of growth shocked all the Batfish Beasts hanging in the air.
“The great Thunderflame Dragon King is too… abnormal, no wonder his strength is so formidable!” exclaimed the Ancient Batfish Beast, its reverence for the Destruction Emperor Dragon growing.
Half an hour later, atop the Earth that had collapsed into a crater a hundred kilometers in diameter, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, now grown to a length of three thousand eight hundred and seventy meters, slowly opened its eyes.
“It’s close, just a bit more until I reach the Titan Peak.” Huh! Breathing out a scorching breath, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was quite satisfied with its recent gains.
Although it had swallowed more Chaotic Crystals this time, expanding its body by over two hundred meters, the bloodline optimization was very faint, even less than before.
It seems that there is also a limit to the enhancement from these Chaotic Crystals, or rather, the effect on the bloodline of a Heavenly Tier life form is not significant.

chapters.title: Chapter 1373 - 1373 524 December Breeding Season Damn
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1373: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instincts_4 Chapter 1373: Chapter 524 December Breeding Season, Damn Instincts_4 “`
There was no other way; it was too strong.
With a sigh, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked at the remaining eight Chaotic Crystals, chose not to consume more, and with a thought, gathered them into the Reverse Scale Space.
These items could significantly enhance the ‘ordinary’ Mythical Giant Beast’s bloodline. Later, he would let Domination and Kidora have some to strengthen their powers.
Besides them, there was the Purple little dragon, which was key to its trump card; it also needed a way to enhance its power.
The stronger the Purple little dragon was, the more and purer the Creation energy it would spew.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon waited, almost a day passed before the Silver Giant Dragon and the others had absorbed the energy of the Chaotic Crystals, completing their transformation.
The first to open its eyes was the Silver Giant Dragon. Its double wings unfurled, and its kilometer-long body shot up into the sky, circling the Destruction Emperor Dragon with excited roars.
“Roar! Tim Abott, Great Sethia feels so powerful, like I could kill a Titan Giant Beast.”
…You’re thinking too much. Watching the Silver Giant Dragon spiraling around like a little girl, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head.
The Silver Giant Dragon had undergone significant changes; its shape was now full of even brighter Silver Scale Armor, translucent and lustrous, looking like half-transparent silver-white crystal, sparkling and stunningly beautiful.
In addition, its robust body had become longer and more streamlined due to the bloodline Evolution, shedding its former ferocious appearance for something more pleasing to the eye.
And that was it. Although the aura of the Silver Giant Dragon had grown somewhat, it seemed like its innate ability had much improved, but it hadn’t awakened a third Top Tier Talent.
Not to mention approaching the base requirements of a Monarch-Level Life with four top-tier talents.
Nevertheless, the newfound power left the Silver Giant Dragon elated. An enhancement in innate power meant stronger combat prowess and more energy contained within.
Once Giant Beast lives step into the Legendary Realm, their talents transform into rules, but the transformation of talents into rules only makes their abilities stronger, it does not mean those talents become obsolete.
Soon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the golden-blue Giant Dragon awoke one after another. Similar to the Silver Giant Dragon, their bloodline evolution had enhanced their inherited abilities.
However, after this slight evolution, the golden-blue Giant Dragon became even more stunning, with a streamlined body covered in transparent golden-blue crystal-like scale armor.
Especially the dragon head covered with fine golden-blue scales, its horns shone like transparent crystal, forming a crown emitting seven-colored radiance, exuding a sense of regal elegance and beauty.
Damn it’s beautiful! The Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly shook its head, suppressing the strange feelings that surged in its mind.
As it grew larger, the Destruction Emperor Dragon sensed something amiss in its body, feeling an adult-like sensation, with occasional strange impulses arising instinctively.
But it was clearly only a year old?
That’s not right, Six-legged Salamanders seem to meet the reproductive requirements after twelve months of birth…
“Roar! Tim Abott, Tim Abott…”
“What is it, Scythia?” The Destruction Emperor Dragon snapped back to reality and turned to look at the Silver Giant Dragon, which was flapping its wings and hovering a hundred meters away.
The Silver Giant Dragon looked at him puzzled: “Roar! Tim Abott, what happened to you just now? You didn’t respond even after I called you several times.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon found a casual excuse: “It’s nothing, I was just thinking.”
“`
Is that so?
Looking at the black-red colossal beast with calm eyes in front of it, the Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat suspicious; it always felt that when the Destruction Emperor Dragon had looked towards Telsafi in the distance just now, there was something off about its gaze.
“Since you have all awakened, let us set out and prepare to enter the Area of Destruction.”
Speaking this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon calmly looked towards the golden-blue giant dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc that flew towards it and let out a low growl, “I have some Chaos Crystal Cores here. After you digest the remaining energy in your bodies, try eating a piece.”
Instantly, the eyes of the golden-blue giant dragon brightened, and its gaze towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon became even more gentle.
This kind of divine object that can greatly purify the bloodline of Mythical Giant Beasts was something their mother would at most give them only one piece of, no more.
…Don’t look at me like that. Under the gaze of the golden-blue giant dragon’s jewel-like crystalline Dragon Eyes, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt a faint strange sensation in its body.
Frightened, the Destruction Emperor Dragon hurriedly spoke, its deep and majestic Dragon Roar echoing between heaven and earth, “Set off, traverse the Area of Destruction. Alius, please take Scythia with you.”
“Roar! Leave it to Alius, Great King of Thunderflame.”
After witnessing the terrifying growth rate and energy absorption conversion efficiency of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the ancient Batfin Beast showed even more respect in its attitude.
Boom! Powerful Rule forces permeated between heaven and earth, forming an invisible isolation field on the back of the ancient Batfin.
After the three-headed beast landed on its back, the ancient Batfin flapped its wings, breaking apart space, and powerful air currents blasted out from the edges behind its wings.
Following that were the Destruction Emperor Dragon and those Batfish Beasts with lengths of dozens of kilometers, who with a roar, charged into the grey, turbulent, dangerous region and disappeared.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the others were traversing the space-time rifts, at the edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, two Mutated Tiger Whales, over a hundred meters long and burning with flames, appeared at the edge of the Chaos Turbulent Sea.
Following the two Mutated Tiger Whales was a Sea Turtle Giant Beast, also a hundred meters long.
After flying for nearly a month, following the bloodline connection with the Female Tiger Whale, Tiger One and Tiger Two finally neared the Rift World.
Roar roar roar!! At last, we are nearly there, Tiger Two, I can already feel that Mom is right ahead.
Tiger One was somewhat excited.
Roar! I feel it too, hurry, let’s find Uncle and seek revenge, I must burn that monster to ashes.
Tiger Two was equally excited, spewing intense flames from its body, illuminating the sky, the intense heat forcing the Sea Turtle Giant Beast behind them to hurriedly retreat.
However, as soon as the three giant beasts entered the Chaos Sea area for just a few hundred kilometers, massive tsunamis erupted explosively below.
Soon after, several Eighth Level Beasts over a hundred meters long, one Level 9 Giant Beast, and thirty human-bodied, snake-tailed creatures emitting Level 7 and Level 8 auras of the Longa Alien Tribe appeared.
“Unknown giant beasts, halt.”
The leading Level 8 Longa looked up at the Flame Tiger Whale in the sky and bellowed, “I am Kelterta, the Sea Patrol Captain of the Dragon Palace Empire. You have entered the empire’s territory, leave immediately, or don’t blame us for being inhospitable.”
The Dragon Palace Empire!

chapters.title: Chapter 1374 - 1374 525 Ancient Revival Separation and
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1374: Chapter 525: Ancient Revival, Separation and Fusion Chapter 1374: Chapter 525: Ancient Revival, Separation and Fusion Under the lead of a member of the Longa Alien Tribe who had once encountered the Black Tiger Whale, they flew over the sea surface for half a day, passing through several sea patrol defense lines before the Three-headed Flame Tiger Whale drew near to the location of the Dragon Palace.
Then, all three heads of the Giant Beast widened their eyes, stunned as they beheld what lay before them.
On the tumultuous sea surface, towering icebergs burst forth, forming Icebound Mountain Ranges that stretched for tens of kilometers, merging sky with earth.
Around the ice mountains, there spiraled icicles towering ten thousand meters high, like an Ice Crystal forest, majestically spectacular, with a winding river ascending hundreds of meters in the center.
At the end of the river stood a silver gate several thousand meters high and a thousand meters wide, supported by four ice pillars, with the words “Dragon Palace Empire” inscribed in four large rune characters in the center, exuding an imposing and domineering presence.
Behind the dragon gate, there was a colossal world phantom, containing oceans and lands, with several enormous beasts perched atop mountain peaks, consuming Cloud Mist, and countless members of the Longa Alien Tribe and Giant Beasts dwelling in the sea.
And at the end of that ocean, faintly visible was an Ancient Giant Clam the size of a mountain range, its shell slightly ajar, swallowing and exhaling Heavenly Energy across thousands of kilometers, stirring the winds and clouds.
Facing this scene, the Three-headed Tiger One immediately felt an overwhelming aura approaching them.
This was the true Dragon Palace, in comparison, the underwater palace of Blue Star was like the difference between a thatched cottage in the countryside and a villa.
At that moment, beneath the dragon gate, a Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that appeared like a brown small hill and radiated a quasi-mythical aura made its appearance, causing all the members of the Longa Alien Tribe below to bow their heads in reverence.
“We greet the King of Earth Destruction.”
…
“Report, the Super God Energy that was storming inside Mecha Number One has now calmed, and the numerical curve has returned to normal fluctuations.”
“Young General Louise’s Soul Sync Rate is steadily decreasing; it’s now close to one hundred and ten percent… one hundred and five percent… one hundred percent…”
“Number One has exited the berserk state.”
“Begin loading the Life Form Restraint Armor immediately.”
“Yes.”
Measuring fourteen kilometers in length and resembling a floating island, in the central section of the sky-based battleship of Number One, the silhouette of the Mecha had shrunk to five hundred meters.
By now, Mecha Number One had returned to a humanoid form, and its tail had retracted and disappeared, revealing arms and legs that had grown Dark Golden Scales, instead of its former skin.
Atop the slender humanoid head of Number One, beneath some of the deployed head armor, there were glimpses of bone-like Dark Golden Patterns, which, accentuated by the flashing blue-white gaze, appeared ferociously intimidating.
However, compared to the horrifying appearance at the end of the battle two days prior, Mecha Number One already seemed much more normal.
Soon, from the tower a kilometer to the side, massive hangar doors slowly opened, and a series of engineering vehicles emerged, trailing behind them armor plates that were dozens of meters in size.
For the eventuality of Mecha Number One breaking free from its armor in a rampage, the Logistics Department team had prepared, and the warehouse was stocked with multiple sets of matching armor.
These armors, forged from special minerals, fitted to Mecha Number One’s life fluctuations and engraved with powerful force field runes to constrain its form, served as inhibitors to stabilize the Mecha’s life form under normal conditions.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the efforts of mechanical arms and the advanced cultivator engineers, piece by piece, the giant Black-Red Colored Mech armor was reassembled over Mecha Number One.
While those engineers outside were occupied, inside Mecha Number One, in the void expanse within its structural space, Freya Louise stood in mid-air, her gaze indifferent and icy, devoid of any emotion.
Just like the statues of gods and Buddhas seated in temples, looking down upon all living beings from their lofty heights.
The God Machine Armament on Freya Louise’s body was almost completely transparent, covered with dark golden patterns, resembling numerous blood vessels connecting Number One and Freya Louise.
Under the erosion of the Super God Energy, even more pronounced dark golden patterns appeared on Freya Louise’s body, on her cheeks, the backs of her hands, emitting an aura of ancient and mysterious significance.
Even her life force and soul breath had changed under the influence of these energies, giving off an illusion of ‘antiquity.’
As the Soul Synchronization gradually weakened, Freya Louise’s consciousness reflected in an alternate ‘world’ also began to return, and a hint of human emotion surfaced in her flickering eyes.
Soon, Freya Louise’s consciousness fully returned, but the indifference in her eyes remained undiminished. She cast a detached glance at the busy engineers outside and took a slight step.
Humm! Freya Louise passed through the setup space like a phantom, slowly flying out from the diamond crystal on Number One’s chest.
Immediately, the expressions on the faces of the members of the Logistics Department turned to utter disbelief.
“Young General Louise is out!”
“What’s happening? Number One’s soul is still waking up, and its Soul Sync Rate with Young General Louise is maintained at fifty percent.”
While those Logistics Department staff were somewhat panicked, the black-haired girl standing in the air turned her head slightly, her gaze indifferent as she looked over.
At the same time, the head of Number One, which was in a state of awakening, also moved slightly, turning to look at those Logistics Department staff.
In an instant, everyone felt an indescribable terror, fear emerging from the depths of their souls, rendering their bodies rigid and faces deathly pale.
Amid the staff’s terror, Freya Louise slowly spoke, her voice light and indifferent, “Do not worry, it’s just that my synchronization state with Number One has become more compatible.”
As she spoke, a powerful Power Explosion burst from Number One, and an invisible shockwave blast sent all engineers who had just loaded the armors flying.
Boom!
Number One took a step, and the entire sky-based battleship sunk slightly with its step, the deck emitting screeching tearing noises, as if a massive behemoth had just moved.
Dressed in golden-white magnificent battle armor, Freya Louise floated in the air. As Number One walked, she came to the edge of the deck under the surprised gazes of those staff members and stood there.
Currently, Number One was located above the altitude of ten thousand meters, surrounded by clouds and mist with mountain ranges winding below, towering with the Heavenly Feather Clan’s fortress bases.
The raging wind howled, whipping Freya Louise’s black hair into a wild dance. She stretched out her hand and grasped towards the ground, and instantly, an Invisible Power spread.
Boom!
Ten or so kilometers away on the land, the space within a range of kilometers twisted violently, like a folding piece of paper, and thousands of meters high mountain peaks instantly shattered and exploded.
All of the cultivators on the deck had their faces show shock.
This strike was almost on par with that of a king-level, even stronger than the average king, yet the aura emitted by Freya Louise was clearly only at the late period of the Ninth Heavens!
No, that’s not right, Young General Louise’s realm had just broken through to the early period of the Ninth Heavens a few days ago, and now it’s the late period!?
Freya Louise looked down at her hand where the dark golden patterns were gradually fading, and whispered in a voice only she could hear, “How strong, truly worthy of being an undying ancient creature, just merging a strand of a soul force resurrected from ancient times has allowed me to possess the power to control space.”
Saying this, Freya Louise raised her head to look at the Firmament above, her gaze pierced through this Plane, quietly observing another ‘world’ that only she could see.

chapters.title: Chapter 1375 - 1375 526
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1375: Chapter 526 Chapter 1375: Chapter 526 The Golden Divine Tree, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers high into the Void, resembled a star as it radiated endless golden radiance in all directions, seeping into space-time and forming multiple planes.
In the seventeenth plane located at the base of the Eternal Divine Tree, ripples of gold undulated in the heavens as several warships, each ten kilometers long, crossed dimensions and descended.
These were ships responsible for transporting weapon equipment; since they operated within internal planes, only a few Silver Wing Brigades were stationed on them.
Now, at the edge of the lead ship, several members of the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan, each over seven meters tall with silver light wings, gazed towards the center of the mountain ranges, where a huge dark golden light shield dwelled.
Days had passed, and the Power of Dark Star surrounding Jack Clark had expanded across tens of kilometers, swallowing the sky and the earth, voraciously absorbing the heavy metal elements from the veins beneath.
When the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan became restless, one of the high-order Heavenly Feather Strongmen with the cultivation of the Eight Layer Heaven blinked in astonishment.
“Is that the place where the Human Expert has been in closed-door cultivation? So strong. Even hundreds of kilometers away, the invisible pressure is enough to send shivers down my spine.”
The most powerful Heavenly Feather Alien Clan in the group looked up reverently and said, “That being has, by his own power, suppressed more than a dozen demon kings, including two Great Demon Kings; of course, he’s formidable.”
“It’s fortunate that the Human Race has provided support this time, or we might have lost two more planes again.”
The Eight Layer Heavenly Feather Alien Clan nodded gratefully, “Yes, during the previous battle, planes twelve and thirteen were the most fiercely attacked. Had those two planes been lost, our Heavenly Feather Alien Clan would truly have no hope left.”
While engaging in casual conversation, the warships hurriedly flew toward a base more than a thousand kilometers away, where plumes of black smoke soared into the sky, reminiscent of an industrial boom in the middle ages.
However, as the warship flew further away, the Eight Layer Heavenly Feather Alien Clan looked back, casting a deep glance towards the dark golden light sphere.
Three hours later, in a bronze-colored mountain range, a silver figure dashed quickly along the shadows between the rocks, traversing several kilometers with each flicker.
Soon enough, the figure, who had suppressed its aura, stopped not far from the dark golden halo, revealing a towering stature of seven meters.
It was, unmistakably, the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan member from the warship earlier, with the cultivation of Eight Layer Heaven.
Gazing at the dark golden light circle that enveloped a bronze mountain peak ahead and radiated a terrifying aura, Boris’s gaze flickered.
After several days of investigation, the internal spy among the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan had found out about Jack Clark and joined the logistics to enter the seventeenth plane.
What followed was making contact with this human, conveying to him the will of the Great Demon King.
By doing so, its identity would also be exposed. If one of the humans were willing to betray the Human Race, it could continue to lie low like it had, waiting for the right moment to burst forth.
If the human rejected it, however, its identity would be exposed, and then…
At this thought, the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan’s eyes revealed hesitation because under normal conditions, the likelihood of such high-level powerful beings betraying their race was extremely low.
Suddenly, the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan had a shock—this was a suicide mission. How did it come to enter the seventeenth plane?
The moment the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan realized this, a streak of black radiance appeared in its eyes, and in an instant, its gaze turned cold, indifferent, and filled with a sense of superiority.
As its consciousness was overtaken, the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan became a silver flash of light and plunged into the dark golden halo.
Boom!
The moment Boris stepped into the range of the Dark Star, a terrifying gravity descended from the sky, shattering the Earth beneath it, pressing half of its body into the ground and creating cracks that spread in all directions.
With silver double wings unfurled behind it, a surge of quasi-mythical will rose up from within Boris, barely shielding it from the intangible pressure all around, and it shouted aloud.
“Human, I am a messenger of His Majesty Tyris, the Great Demon King. I wish to speak with you.”
“Great Demon King!”
Boom!
As a deep voice rose from the depths of the Dark Star Domain, a bolt of purple lightning appeared, encircling Boris like a distorted flash of electricity.
At that very moment, the Demon King’s Will inside Boris shuddered as it sensed the aura of death from the purple lightning.
This human is strong, just a single display of the Lightning Law Power makes me feel utterly unable to resist, even the arrival of my True Body would be instantly shattered.
Whoosh!
As the purple lightning entwined around him, Boris felt the scene before him flash and found himself on a mountainside thousands of meters high. Then, an extremely terrifying aura approached him head-on.
Boom!
Under an even greater oppressive force, hundreds of times stronger than before, Boris’s figure sank, its knees bent in submission, and it was pinned down on the weathered grey rock, unable to move.
Crackle Crackle!! The ground continued to collapse and fracture around the center where the seven-meter-tall Boris stood, forming a meteoric crater hundreds of meters in diameter.
Pinned at the bottom of the crater, Boris roared in shock and anger, “Human, I am the messenger of the Great Demon King, and you dare to make me kneel!”
Despite its immense fury, it couldn’t resist even slightly, managing only to lift its head with effort and stare ahead where a majestic three-faced and eight-armed figure sat cross-legged.
Surrounded by numerous heavy and oppressive green specks of light, forming light ribbons that made it somewhat hazy and difficult to see clearly.
Amidst the swirling green light ribbons, Jack Clark, showing his eight-armed True Body, slowly opened his eyes with a gaze cold and commanding as he addressed the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan member in a somber voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1376 - 1376 526_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1376: Chapter 526_2 Chapter 1376: Chapter 526_2 “To think that they would sacrifice a high-order traitor lurking within the Heavenly Feather Clan just to see me, speak up, what do you want?”
Jack Clark wasn’t surprised at the existence of a traitor within the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan—in a civilization war, how could there not be insiders and traitors?
Some of these traitors are willing, some can’t resist the temptation, and some are forced to be ‘refined’ by Mythical-level and above strong men, through Secret Skills or Innate Divine Abilities.
And the traitor before him must be one who couldn’t resist the resources’ temptation and also, was controlled by a Demon King of the Purgatory Empire with special methods.
Borna spoke somewhat strenuously, “His Majesty Tyris commanded me to tell you that both the Heavenly Feather tribe and the Human Race are destined for extinction.”
“Your talent isn’t bad; dying like this would be a pity. If you’re willing to join our Purgatory Empire, you can be granted the blood of Ancestor, have your body demonized, and be appointed as a Monarch of a region.”
After speaking, Borna gasped for breath with a pale face.
Jack Clark’s gaze was indifferent, without the slightest ripple. He had actually anticipated the other party’s purpose for seeking him out, as there was nothing else but to try and turn him aside.
Jack Clark said indifferently, “Tell that Great Demon King that I’m quite content being a human. A mere ordinary race from the mythical world doesn’t qualify to make me change my life form.”
“As for whether the Human Race will be annihilated, only we can decide that.”
Boom! Without giving Borna a chance to speak again, Jack Clark swung his arm, which was making a hand seal behind his back, and a burst of Overbearing Power Explosion erupted.
Splat!
Borna spewed blood. Under that power, he turned into a beam of silver radiance that shot into the sky, and in the blink of an eye, he was cast out of the Dark Star Domain and appeared above at an altitude of one hundred thousand meters.
There, a Heavenly Feather deity with two pairs of Golden Light Wings, exuding a Mythical Aura, stood tall, watching Borna with a cold gaze. At the same time, Jack Clark’s voice echoed from the Void.
“Lord Kordes, this traitor from the Heavenly Feather tribe is now in your hands. It has a Demon King’s Will attached within it, which I have temporarily sealed.”
The Heavenly Feather deity named Kordes nodded slightly, “I apologize for the disturbance caused by this traitor to the Divine Martial Throne.”
A faint voice came from below, “Don’t mention it.”
As a key Plane for the rear logistical equipment and weapons of the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan, there were naturally Powerhouses stationed here, and they also had the responsibility of guarding Jack Clark’s surroundings during his Closed-door Cultivation, to prevent any disturbances.
Thus, the moment Borna appeared within a hundred kilometers, he was discovered by that Mythical Powerhouse.
However, to avoid alarming others, they did not act immediately, waiting for Jack Clark to seal the Demon King’s Will within him.
Watching Kordes take away the Heavenly Feather traitor, Jack Clark closed his eyes below in the Dark Star Domain and once again fell into a state of cultivation.
As he absorbed more and more Heavy Metal Elements, Jack Clark’s True Body became incredibly heavy, and the gravitational magnetic field it emitted distorted and collapsed the surrounding space.
Besides, the aura of Laws becoming more vast wrapped around him, faintly forming five layered illusory Laws Worlds behind him.
Within the depths of these five worlds, representing soul, Void, Death, Thunder, and flames, there was an even more massive and stable Plane that was currently overlapping with the five-layer Laws World.
As the Great Sun True Flame and Purple Heaven Thunder Law reached completion, Jack Clark was making a breakthrough as a Heavenly King.
While contemplating the remaining three Higher-order Laws, the Supreme Law, he also dedicated a part of his concentration to devouring the Heavy Elements of the Mixed Copper Mountain Range and strengthen his Demon God’s Body.
The appearance of that traitor was nothing but a minor interlude that Jack Clark didn’t take to heart.
As for the pronouncement that the Human Race was fated for annihilation, he had heard it many times from those members of the Purgatory Demon Race. Under normal conditions, they indeed had that strength.
The Eight Great Demon God Empires, more than twenty powerful Demon God-level combatants, True Spirits of ancient times, equivalent to the Hibernation Purgatory ancestors of the Civilization Emperor.
In terms of high-end combat power, the Purgatory Demon Race was entirely crushing the Human Race.
Only, it was a pity, he had already grown up.
Half an hour later.
In the heart of the crown of a Golden Divine Tree, which stands dozens of thousands of kilometers high, countless streams of Golden Divine Light flow like substance where the Rules are pervasive, forming a world filled with endless White Light.
In the world immersed in light, five figures tens and tens of thousands of meters tall stand, their backs to sprawling Light Wings that cast immense shadows, radiating an unrivaled sense of sanctity and nobility.
However, at the moment, these five figures, despite appearing strong, mysteriously gave off a feeling of being quite ‘insubstantial.’
Especially one of them, a Divine King with five pairs of Silver Light Wings, whose aura was so weak that the Divine King’s True Body seemed somewhat transparent.
With twelve White Light Wings behind him, Metastat, who was like a Creation Angel, spoke with a voice that was both majestic and gentle, “Bordea, how is your recuperation proceeding?”
At these words, the Silver-winged God King gave a wry smile, “My Inner World has been shattered, and the foundations of my Laws are damaged. Even the utilization of the divine tree’s heart sap fails to restore me.”
Immediately, the other Divine Kings fell into a slight silence, their gazes on the somewhat transparent true body of the Silver-winged God King as though they saw their own future.
After a long while, Metastat sighed, “We have obtained some disturbing news from the Demon King’s Will captured in that traitor’s body.”
“Combining that with the abnormal information sent back by our pawns placed among them, it seems that the three Purgatory Empires are gathering all their forces in preparation for a final all-out assault.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1377 - 1377 526
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1377: Chapter 526 Chapter 1377: Chapter 526 Among the five Divine Kings, the one with five pairs of golden light wings on his back calmly said, “They finally can’t hold back anymore, huh? It’s just uncertain how many Demon Gods are prepared to fall.”
As he spoke, the Golden Winged Divine King turned to Metastat: “Metastat, I think we need to adjust the seed plan. Boris and I will stay behind to snipe those Demon Gods.”
“Both my foundation and his have been severely damaged, with no hope for further progress.”
“Moreover, the strength of the Human Race is formidable; it is already known that they possess the power of four Divine Kings, especially the First Councilor, whose strength is unfathomable, to the extent that the Eternal Domain Stone cannot precisely locate his realm.”
“Under such circumstances, it is even more necessary to have an Extreme Realm Expert stationed here to maintain a position of equal standing with the Human Race and to avoid becoming a vassal.”
The other two Divine Kings also nodded slightly: “That’s right, as long as you, Metastat, are here, our clan will still have the hope of rising.”
Metastat shook his head slowly: “This plan must be carried out by me alone, only I can unite with the mother tree.”
The Golden Winged Divine King said gravely, “But by doing so, you too will die; the price of prematurely touching the power of the Ancient God (True Spirit Level) is the collapse of your true body of rules.”
Metastat looked serene as he lightly said, “Don’t worry, with my cultivation, as long as I do not wish to die, not even Tyris can kill me.”
“Don’t forget the split-off sapling of the mother tree, within which lies not only the complete heart of the mother tree but also a pure origin of my light source.”
“As long as the Eternal Tree Sapling absorbs the power of both worlds and regrows, I will be resurrected and return from that essence of the light source.”
As a civilization that has existed for tens of thousands of years, the Heavenly Feather Clan naturally would not sit still awaiting doom. Anticipating this day, they had long made multiple preparations.
More than fifty years ago, the Heavenly Feather Clan had already dispatched Main God-level powerhouses deep into the mythical world, choosing two new dwellings in areas away from various threatening forbidden zones.
One location was over a hundred and seventy million kilometers deep, while the other was even more remote, spanning four hundred and fifty million kilometers, with no threatening powerful civilizations nearby.
However, the cost of abandoning their homelands was too great, and the Purgatory Empire would not allow them to retreat so easily, so they had been preparing in secret all along.
With the emergence of the Human Race, after evaluating some costs and possibilities, the Heavenly Feather Clan ultimately abandoned their retreat plan and chose to form an alliance with humans instead.
At the same time, as beings in control of the rules, whether it be those Demon Gods or the Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, all possessed many life-preserving methods.
For example, Metastat, the Divine King of Light, possesses abilities similar to the Life Marks of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, that can revive and resurrect from the brink of physical annihilation.
Unlike the Life Mark of the Destruction Emperor Dragon that consumes the life origin to condense Rebirth Blood, allowing resurrection at the instant of bodily destruction, his is the Light Revival.
After the fall of his original body ruled by the true body, he would resurrect and be reborn from the essence of light containing his soul source and the rules.
However, the revival time of the Divine King of Light is a bit long, and the cost a bit high, without the incredible power of the Life Mark Mysteries gained by the Destruction Emperor Dragon after strengthening his talent to the Deification Realm.
Upon noticing the movements of the Purgatory Empire, soon enough, the entire Heavenly Feather Clan also sprang into action.
In the frontline outposts across different planes, many of the newer generation and elite youngsters received orders, and were relocated to a special plane world in the rear.
In addition to this, over fifty God-level powerhouses and more than ten Main God-level strong beings among the elderly, the weak, and the injured who had foundational damage, received long-awaited orders of upcoming decisive battle without retreat.
Those remaining, including Anstice, were instead given orders to evacuate along with the Human Race upon receiving the retreat signal.
Additionally, about twenty heavily injured Mythical Powerhouses and Main God-level beings with damaged foundations, who were usually in hibernation sealed within the Eternal Divine Tree, were awakened.
This included a large number of Eighth and Ninth Tier elites slumbering within the trunk of the tree.
At the same time, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s warehouses were fully opened, and the little resources that remained were all distributed, signaling that they were going to evacuate regardless of whether the Purgatory Empire launched their final assault or not.
However, such great battles of civilized races require a long time to rally their forces.
For instance, the Demon Kings of the Purgatory Empire, who were on a break in the rear, had to first lead their legions to converge at the empire’s border, joining forces with the Peak Awakened Great Demons holding fort at the core demon domains of the empire.
Like Tarolia, each of these Great Demon Kings had reached the pinnacle of Grand Demon King Level, having forged demon books and wielding powerful weapons refined from the intrinsic strength of the empire.
At full strength, these Peak Awakened Great Demons could briefly resist the Demon Gods of the ancient early stages.
The nine Demon Gods were just the visible might of the three major empires; naturally, the foundational depth of the empires was not limited to this, given that the Human Race possessed crossover strong beings such as the True Martial Heavenly King.
These venerable Purgatory Empires had one rule: once a Demon King reached the pinnacle of Demon King level or Grand Demon King level, they would withdraw from the frontline and return to the rear.
They would only participate in new wars once they broke through to Grand Demon King or even Demon God Level.”
Thus, through countless years of warfare with different races’ civilizations, these old Purgatory Empires amassed deep intrinsic strength, with an endless supply of Demon Kings and Grand Demon Kings emerging continuously.
Even the falling of one or two ancient early stage Demon Gods was not much of a concern.
Otherwise, if each time a civilization like the Heavenly Feather was extinguished and two or three Demon Gods fell, the Demon God Level power of the Purgatory Empire would have been long gone.
…
In the Eternal Domain, stretching over kilometers upon the branches of the Golden Divine Tree, True Martial Heavenly King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and Mysterious Martial Sky King stood upon a massive leaf.

Tens of kilometers behind the three Heavenly King Powerhouses, Sky-based Battleship No. 5 was quietly docked at the edge of the trunk.
Watching the distant streaks of gold and silver radiance flashing by, signifying the suddenly busy civilization of the Heavenly Feather Clan, Mysterious Martial Sky King couldn’t help but show a bitter smile: “I didn’t expect that our arrival would hasten the start of the final battle between the two civilizations.”
As allies, upon detecting the anomalies of the Purgatory Empire and starting to prepare for the grand battle, the Heavenly Feather Clan had immediately informed True Martial Heavenly King and the others.
“This was an inevitable outcome,”
Sky King Denny Kaye said calmly, “Before we arrived, the Heavenly Feather Clan was already unable to hold out for much longer. Their intrinsic strength has been depleted after years of bleeding.”
“Our appearance was merely a catalyst that made those demons who were still somewhat hesitant make up their minds.”
“Of course, according to our plan to feign weakness and strength, this battle should have been postponed by another two to three Sun Wheels but…”
At this point, Sky King Denny Kaye’s face also revealed a trace of a bitter smile.
A smile appeared on True Martial Heavenly King’s solemn face: “But Jack Clark showed such exaggerated fighting strength that he alarmed those Demon Gods, right?”
“Indeed.”
Sky King Denny Kaye nodded, “Originally, we wanted him to restrain his strength a bit, not to appear too powerful. Unexpectedly, in one battle he wiped out more than a dozen demon kings, including two late period Great Demon Kings.”
“Such a huge loss, even for an empire like the Purgatory Empire, would be painful, a blow like this could seriously weaken an empire’s high-end power.”
“Instead of giving the enemy a chance, it’s better to gather all forces and crush everything.”
After observing the conference, True Martial Heavenly King stood at the summit of the Eternal Divine Tree, chatting with Mysterious Martial and Denny Kaye, when Jonathan Walker appeared.
All three showed some indifference toward him, as seniors who had watched him rise, they all felt a sense of disappointment.
Jonathan Walker’s current state was somewhat calm, even indifferent, including that of Left Demon: soul, spirit, and will, all split into three, with his seven emotions and six desires similarly divided.
The Left Demon represents adherence and desire for slaughter.
True Martial Heavenly King’s attitude toward Jonathan Walker was complex, appearing somewhat cold.
With his talent back then, if he had not chosen betrayal, he should have achieved a breakthrough to Supreme by now, adding another top-tier strength to the Human Race.
Now, although he has reached the late period of the Heavenly Kings and is close to the peak, he has been wasting away for years.
Moreover, he can no longer be fully trusted by the Human Race. His so-called betrayal actually involved several preparations: success would make him a pillar of the Human Race, failure would turn him into a Great Demon God.
If the Human Race were to perish, he would still be able to lead a part of the demonized Human Race to continue existing.
In his view, as long as he considers himself human, then he is human, but in True Martial Heavenly King’s view, after complete demonization, the first generation might retain their cognition, but the subsequent ones would not.
It’s like those who emigrate and take citizenship of other countries; the first generation might retain their identity, but after undergoing the baptism of the Purgatory True Demon civilization, it wouldn’t take half a year for them to be fully assimilated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1379 - 1379 527 Devouring World Beast Titan Peak
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1379: Chapter 527 Devouring World Beast, Titan Peak Chapter 1379: Chapter 527 Devouring World Beast, Titan Peak As the various parties were preparing for the final battle, time flew by rapidly, and three days passed in the blink of an eye.
As the blue sun in the sky disappeared beyond the horizon, the entire mythical world plunged into darkness, with only the silver moon rising slowly at the eastern edge bringing a sliver of light.
In the mythical world, a day cycle lasted forty days, with three Great Suns—gold, red, and blue—sweeping across the sky during the day, and at night, only one moon hung high.
As for the emergence of the Blood Moon, the sight of dual moons in the sky rarely appeared.
But whenever the Blood Moon appeared, it always presaged some kind of ominous event.
Above Plane Number Seventeen, at an altitude of over one hundred thousand meters, a golden crack appeared in the firmament, and right after, Bordea with three pairs of golden light wings descended.
Looking at Kordes, the mythical strongman guarding this plane, Bordea’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, “Kordes, you’ve sent an urgent message all of a sudden, is there another traitor here?”
“It’s not a traitor.”
Kordes pointed towards the distance, hesitantly saying, “Uncle, I called for you this time because it relates to that Human Clan Divine Martial Throne. Look over there.”
In the central region of the Mixed Copper Mountain Ranges more than two thousand kilometers away, a dark golden light sphere with a diameter of over a thousand kilometers appeared, resembling a giant bowl half-embedded in the earth, emitting an incomparably heavy presence.
“That Divine Martial Throne is devouring the essence of the Mixed Copper Mountain Ranges. The coverage area is expanding, and at the rate of doubling every half an hour, it won’t be long before the entire mountain ranges are devoured.”
“This mountain range is the core of resources of Plane Number Seventeen. If it gets devoured, the entire plane will experience instability, and the derived ore veins will also fall into depletion.”
Compared to Kordes’s concern, Bordea seemed very calm, “You’re wondering whether we should stop him, right?”
Kordes nodded with a bitter smile, “Yes.”
Plane Number Seventeen is currently an important Resource Point for the Heavenly Feather Clan, responsible for producing weapons and equipment for all ranks below Myth, as well as basic materials for War Fortresses. It is very important.
If the ore veins of this plane become exhausted, it will put even more pressure on the logistics of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
In contrast to the worried Kordes, Bordea simply said, “If that Divine Martial Throne wants to devour and refine, then let him be. It no longer matters.”
“It no longer matters.” Kordes was stunned.
Since Kordes, who stayed in the rear, was only a strongman at the Early Myth level, he had received the message that a great battle would soon erupt but was unaware that it was the final battle.
Currently, only Main God-level powerhouses and those at the late Myth or Mythical Peak levels were privy to the withdrawal news to prevent any leakage of information prematurely.
Bordea reminded him, “Don’t concern yourself with other matters. From now on, ensure that this place is secure and prevent anyone from disturbing this Divine Martial Throne’s cultivation.”
“Once this Human Clan Genius breaks through the Main God realm, he will be a tremendous aid to our Heavenly Feather Clan, understand?”
“I understand, uncle.” Kordes nodded. He could subtly infer something from Bordea’s words.
While the two Heavenly Feather strongmen were conversing, inside the dark golden light sphere where the mountain range resided, terrifying gravity filled the space, and countless azure light spots flew out from the ores, thronging toward the central area.
The mountain peak that had been over ten thousand meters tall had disappeared, and the surrounding earth had collapsed, forming a black hole a hundred kilometers in diameter with a heavy, terrifying gravitational field twisting everything around it.
At the center of what seemed like a black hole, a three-faced, eight-armed Demon God, towering over six hundred meters tall, sat cross-legged, six arms behind him forming seals, supporting a slowly rotating golden Wheel of the World.
As his realm transformed towards Heavenly King, integrating with the laws, the gear that originally only had the appearance of a light sphere behind him also became a projection of a one-sided world, as if he were the Master of the World.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s aura was terrifying; his flesh was like an abyss, madly absorbing the heavy metal elements of the mountain range, making his already fearsome body even more terrifying.
And as Jack Clark was having his breakthrough to Heavenly King, the Destruction Emperor Dragon finally traversed the space-time rift and arrived on the other side of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Woo!
The deep and desolate cry echoed through Heaven and Earth, filled with a destructive aura. The gray currents carrying the aura of destruction dissipated, and an Ancient Batfin Giant Beast, sixty kilometers in length, emerged.
Alongside the Ancient Batfin was a Black-red Colossal Beast that was more than ten times smaller, nearly four kilometers in length.
Just as they broke through the space-time rift, the Silver Giant Dragon on the back of the Ancient Batfin let out an excited roar: “Roar! Tim Abott, we have finally made it out.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a slow growl, “Be careful. It’s more dangerous here.”
Compared to the other side of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, where there was solid ground, after they crossed the space-time rift area, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its companions were faced with a completely shattered ‘world’.
Ahead of them was like outer space, pitch black and void, with chaotic magnetic fields and no gravity; there was also no Heavenly Energy. Looking around thousands of kilometers away, all that could be seen were fragments of rock floating, like cosmic dust.
At that moment, the Ancient Batfin Giant Beast let out a low cry, “Woo! Oh great king, there’s nothing here, so I won’t go with you guys. I’ll wait here for your return.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slowly, “Hmm, I will contact you through the Dragon King’s Mandate when the time comes.”
As a newly joined Ancient-level Giant Beast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon naturally had to give the Ancient Batfin a token, which served not only for contact but also as a symbol of its status.
“Let’s go, let’s see how vast the Chaotic Turbulent Region really is. Also, don’t stray too far from me.” With a low roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon spread its enormous wings, shaking the space as it flew forward.
Despite the vast and chaotic nature of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not afraid of getting lost, thanks to the position of its counterpart, Jack Clark.

chapters.title: Chapter 1380 - 1380 527 Devouring the Beast of the World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1380: Chapter 527 Devouring the Beast of the World, Titan Peak_2 Chapter 1380: Chapter 527 Devouring the Beast of the World, Titan Peak_2 “Roar! Charge, the Great Sethia shall conquer the entire Chaotic Domain.” Amidst cheers, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, stirring up a rolling black storm as it soared into the sky.
Then, an equally excited golden-blue Giant Dragon followed gracefully, letting out a high-spirited roar, “The Great Telsafi is also here to conquer the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
In the eyes of the two dragons, the moment they successfully crossed the entire Chaos Void represented their conquest of this forbidden area.
Roar roar roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, wait for me.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc flapped its wings and sturdy tail forcefully, like a primeval giant ked flying through the cosmos, struggling to keep up.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s realm reached the Titan Peak, its body grew even larger, comparable to the Ancient Beasts. Its strength increased and it’s normal movement speed became faster and faster.
Flying in the pitch-black Void, it didn’t take long for the four beasts to cross over three thousand kilometers.
At this moment, a fifty-plus kilometer-sized dark brown meteorite floated by hundreds of kilometers away, and upon seeing it, a slight brightness flashed in the Emperor Dragon’s mouth, and an instantaneously hundreds of meters thick golden Breath blasted out.
Boom!
The massive meteorite exploded, numerous rocks instantly melted into Scorching Magma, creating a ring-shaped shockwave that swept hundreds of kilometers, then quickly cooled, forming countless floating black substances.
“Roar! Tim Abott, why did you blow up that stone?” wondered the Silver Giant Dragon flying beside the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Emperor Dragon casually shook its head, “Nothing much, just felt a bit itchy in my throat.”
An itchy throat? The Three-headed Giant Beast were somewhat confused.
Buzz!
Just then, a Blue Radiance lit up in the Emperor Dragon’s mouth, and instantly a blue Light Beam crossed the Void, striking a meteorite more than two hundred kilometers to the side like a laser beam.
Boom! Instantly, the twenty-something-kilometer-sized meteorite exploded, evolving and releasing brilliant light, illuminating space.
Next, under the dumbfounded gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon, the golden-blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, like a space vessel, continuously fired star-destroying cannon blasts at the meteorites in its path.
As for energy consumption, the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t even take it into account.
Although there was no replenishment of Heavenly Energy in the pitch-black space, its Giant Beast Body had long since been a realm unto itself, capable of absorbing energy from the Chaos Void for growth and recovery.
Boom boom boom!! After demolishing hundreds of meteorites with diameters exceeding ten kilometers, the Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but let out an excited roar.
Roar! It’s so exhilarating.
“Roar! Tim Abott, the Great Sethia wants to play too,” called out the Silver Giant Dragon, feeling the excitement emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and a white light gathered in its mouth.
Bang!
A twenty-plus kilometer diameter meteorite in the Void exploded under the icy breath, and the fragments of the exploded rocks froze, forming an area covered with Ice Crystal fragments for tens of kilometers.
Are these broken stones as pretty as a sea of flowers? Are they that fun? The golden-blue Giant Dragon looked puzzled.
Soon, the vessel firing the star-destroying cannons became three, with only the Single-horned Spawn Roc trailing behind, clueless as to why their throats would be itchy.
After about a hundred thousand kilometers of bombardment by the three beasts, they suddenly stopped, as a continental block several thousand kilometers across appeared ahead.
The continental block was undulating with mountain ranges, but there were no plants or streams, nor any signs of life.
The Emperor Dragon growled, “Joe, do you feel anything good up there?”
Roar roar roar! No. The Single-horned Spawn Roc shook its head.
“So desolate, huh? Let’s go, take a closer look.” Saying this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took the lead and flew toward the large continental block, approaching it after about five thousand kilometers
And just as the four beasts were nearing within two thousand kilometers of the block, suddenly, a ferocious and brutal Aura exploded from the center of the block.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, the sky shattered and the Earth cracked, mountain ranges collapsed. Amidst clouds of smoke and dust, a monstrous Black Colossus tens of thousands of kilometers long, resembling a centipede with hundreds of legs on each side, burst forth.
This Black Colossus creature was covered in an armor-like Black Shell, layer upon layer, resembling a metallic life form, and emanating a Terrifying Aura comparable to that of the ancient early stage.
However, unlike normal Ancient Beasts, this centipede Giant Beast did not emit a very strong Rule Aura, only the fluctuation of unrivaled bodily strength.
Roar!
Seeing the four beasts including the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and sensing the living flesh and blood on them, the centipede Giant Beast let out another savage roar and, riding the billowing black waves, pounced fiercely.
“Seeking death.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, too, let out a roar, with black and red lightning erupting from its body. Its double wings flared furiously, like a giant Black-Red Meteorite falling from the sky.
And just as the Emperor Dragon entered the airspace over the continental block by a little over a thousand kilometers, it felt like it had passed through an invisible barrier, and thin air and energy appeared between heaven and earth.
Because of the presence of air, the Emperor Dragon, which was already falling at more than two hundred times the speed of sound, ignited red flames on its surface due to its immense momentum.
Boom!
The two massive beasts collided in an instant, causing the surrounding Void within a thousand kilometers to collapse, creating a ring of black shock waves that swept across thousands of kilometers.
In the quaking Void, a Black-Red Radiance descended from the sky like a pillar of light, smashing into the continental block with terrifying speed.
Boom!
The explosive force shattered the Earth, and a continental block with a diameter of thousands of kilometers instantly broke apart. Under that dreadful power, countless rocks and dirt melted into scorching material, flowing in all directions and tossed into the vacuum of space.
